“The three evolution paths respectively represent low-class commander rank, middle-class commander rank, and high-class commander rank. The evolution conditions also change from easy to difficult.
“First is the Ice Crystal Phoenix Butterfly, of low-class commander rank. The strongest racial skill that can be awakened is Blizzard.
“Next is the Ghost Beauty Butterfly, a middle-class commander-rank dark-element pet. It’s good at curses, sneak attacks, and assassinations.
“Then there’s the Goddess of Light Butterfly, a high-class commander-rank light-element pet. It can master all kinds of light and is proficient in illusions.
“Apart from certain specific materials and food, to evolve into these races, the minimum requirement is for the silkworm to reach expert-level before the cocoon is formed. Perfected-level would be best. This can maximize the potential of the pet during evolution.
“But it’s too difficult to nurture Worm Silk to perfected proficiency. There’s no need to force it.. After all, the life span and talent of the Green Silkworm are limited.”

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Breaking the Rules
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After Lu Qingyi finished talking about the three evolution paths, she waited for Shi Yu’s choice. In any case, Shi Yu couldn’t take all of them, because the Green Silkworm could only evolve into one type of creature.
“Ice Crystal Phoenix Butterfly, Ghost Beauty Butterfly, Goddess of Light Butterfly…”
To be honest, Shi Yu felt that it was all pretty good. After all, it would be a commander-rank creature, no matter what. A commander-rank creature’s growth limit was much higher than that of a transcendent-rank one. If he could contract with a commander-rank creature, as long as he could afford it, becoming a professional Beast Tamer would be almost certain.
At this point, if it were any other Beast Tamer, they would probably have already chosen it excitedly.
However, after hearing it, Shi Yu didn’t immediately choose one happily. It wasn’t that he had difficulty choosing, but he had heard a key piece of information.
In order for the Green Silkworm to evolve into a commander-rank creature, apart from some necessary evolution materials, its Worm Silk proficiency actually only needed to be expert level?
He had previously thought that it would need to at least be perfected level.
It was simply difficult to even reach perfect proficiency for the Worm Silk skill.
But what if he did pursue perfected-level Worm Silk proficiency?
At that time, would it stimulate the potential of the pet to 200%…
“Are there any Green Silkworms that have reached the skill level of perfection before evolution?” Shi Yu asked.
Lu Qingyi said, “It’s not impossible.
“If you can find mystic realms and ruins suitable for the growth of the Green Silkworm and spend a huge fortune to nurture it, you might then be able to raise its Worm Silk proficiency to that level in its lifetime.
“Or, when you get to the level of a legendary Beast Tamer, you can return to nurture the Green Silkworm. However, putting aside the cost-effective ratio, this Green Silkworm won’t be able to live until then.
“There are roughly only two methods. At the moment, it’s not like there are no successful cases in the country. There was a Green Silkworm that evolved into a monarch-rank Ice Phoenix Moth. Why? Are you tempted by this?”
Shi Yu smiled. “I’m just asking.”
Lu Qingyi said, “Don’t be too greedy. If you plan to evolve it, the level of the Green Silkworm’s Worm Silk isn’t ‘the higher the better’.
“The higher the level of the Worm Silk, the greater its potential after evolution. However, the evolution process will also be more difficult. There’s a greater risk of failure in breaking out of the cocoon, so this is the reason why there’s no need to deliberately pursue perfect proficiency.
“…Unless you can guarantee that the evolution materials you use can?
definitely?
allow the Green Silkworm to awaken powerful new racial skills during the evolution process and that with this skill, it can?
absolutely?
break through the cocoon.
“But this kind of thing… even the best evolution planner can’t guarantee it.”
Shi Yu roughly understood.
The level of the Green Silkworm’s Worm Silk, the level of the cocoon formed, the difficulty of breaking through the cocoon, and the potential after evolution — these were all positively correlated.
And if he wanted it to successfully break out of the cocoon, he would need it to successfully awaken a powerful new species skill inside the cocoon and use this ability to break out of the cocoon.
As for how to awaken new racial skills during the evolution process, one needed to provide it with suitable evolution materials before it cocooned.
If the evolution materials provided were wrong, the awakening skill would fail, and the evolution of the cocoon would also fail.
After thinking about it carefully, Shi Yu’s heart stirred.
If the Green Silkworm’s evolution mechanism was like this, perhaps he didn’t have to take the known evolution path.
Shi Yu looked at the Green Silkworm in the birdcage.
So, what would the outcome be if he taught it a skill from the skill index before it cocooned?
In this way, there would be no need to take the traditional evolution path. He could directly use the skill index before its evolution to have it break out of the cocoon. As long as the skill level was high enough, there was no risk of it not breaking out of the cocoon.
At the same time, the Worm Silk level could also be stacked to the maximum without any worries, allowing the highest-level worm cocoon to nourish the Green Silkworm inside.
This method seemed to be feasible!
Initially, Shi Yu thought that commander-rank creatures were pretty good, but now, he suddenly wanted to nurture a new evolution form for himself to take a look at.
He could completely break the normal evolution method and use an unscientific evolution method!
Skills learnt before evolution + Perfected-level Worm Silk + Deciding attributes at will = ???
Shi Yu suddenly understood those researchers who liked to study the new evolved form of the Green Silkworm. It was really awesome to win a prize.
He nodded and said, “Then I’ll choose the Goddess of Light Butterfly.”
Although it might not necessarily evolve into this, it was definitely correct to choose the rarest one at the moment.
He wanted to take a look at how the evolution materials of other evolution paths were matched.
Lu Qingyi said, “As expected, you chose the highest level… But as I’ve just reminded you, the evolution difficulty of the three of them is from easy to difficult, so you have to be sufficiently prepared before letting the Green Silkworm try to evolve.
“Wasting precious evolution materials is a small matter. If it fails to break out of the cocoon, your Green Silkworm might die trapped in it.”
“Okay.”
The evolution method was probably Lu Qingyi’s private collection or harvest. She wrote down the evolution method on the spot for Shi Yu, and the quantity and level of the materials listed were also very comprehensive.
An evolution method that could nurture the disgraceful Green Silkworm of the Beast World into a high-class commander-rank creature… Its value was naturally needless to say. It could totally have been the foundation for a powerful Beast Tamer family, yet Lu Qingyi had very casually told Shi Yu the method.
This also made Shi Yu believe even more that the Bureau Eleven mentioned by the other party might really be very powerful.
He might really be able to arrange for a legendary Beast Tamer bodyguard in the future!
[Race]: Green Silkworm
[Evolution Route]: Goddess of Light Butterfly
[Skill Requirement]: Worm Silk skill above expert proficiency
[Evolutionary Materials]: Uncooked Heart of Light aged one to three years (one), mature Sun Petal (ten), Firefly Nucleus (three), Luminous Fungus (50 grams), Sunlight Rock Powder (large amount), mature Light Containing Grass (large amount)
[Evolution Method]: After the Green Silkworm’s growth level reaches Level 9, it needs a 9:1 ratio of Sunlight Rock Powder to soak the Light Containing Grass as its main food. The food soaking time is 1 hour. Feed until the Green Silkworm’s growth level reaches Level 10.
After the Green Silkworm’s growth level reaches Level 10, it needs to eat one uncooked Heart of Light within a day, ten mature Sun Petals, three Firefly Nuclei, and 50 grams of Luminous Fungus. After finishing all of them, it can then use the Worm Silk skill to make a cocoon.
The evolution process requires about 30 days. If it’s successful, the Green Silkworm will awaken the skill Rainbow Light in the cocoon and break out of the cocoon to evolve into the Goddess of Light Butterfly.
“These materials…”
The Heart of Light was the name of a special fruit. The Sun Petal was a high-level spiritual plant. The Firefly Nucleus was the energy crystal of a fluorescent worm. The Luminous Fungus was a True Core creature on the Rainbow Light Mushroom. The Sunlight Rock was a rare mineral, and the Light Containing Grass was also a rare spiritual plant…
Just by looking at the name, Shi Yu could already imagine the price of this pile of materials. He couldn’t help but feel a headache.
If he had to buy all of them, would his 10,000,000 yuan be enough??
Iron Bamboo was already so expensive as the cheapest material among the lowest first-level resources. None of the materials here were lower than third-level…
Little Bug, as expected, we should research an even more impressive evolution path ourselves. High-level commander rank is still too low!
If he wasn’t confident of his own path when the time came, then he would choose this backup!
After handing the Green Silkworm’s evolution method to Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi left with her Wind Demon Lion. Only Shi Yu, the Iron-Eating Beast, and the Green Silkworm were left in the courtyard.
After watching Lu Qingyi leave, Shi Yu sighed. He didn’t know whether it was a good or bad choice for him to join Bureau Eleven…
Although he resisted his old profession vocally, it was indeed as Lu Qingyi said. If he really resisted from the bottom of his heart, he wouldn’t have resonated with that stone statue.
“Forget it, I won’t think too much. In any case, I’ll have money tomorrow. I can squander a little today!”
Shi Yu put away the evolution blueprint and decided to buy a cell phone first.. He had been eyeing this thing for a long time, and now, he could finally steel his heart to buy one.

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Opening of the Ruins
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After figuring out the truth behind the stone statue’s mutation, and knowing the huge sum of money that was about to be transferred to his account, Shi Yu was overjoyed.
That day, he came to the building of Century Corporation and prepared to look around.
Century Corporation was the leading company in the high-tech field of the Dong Huang Nation and had stores in almost all cities above level three.
Shi Yu planned to buy a smart cell phone here.
Actually, when Lu Qingyi was around, Shi Yu had already asked her if the organization would give him a phone.
And the answer he got was naturally no.
The other party had asked Shi Yu to use a portion of the initial funds of 10,000,000 yuan to purchase it himself. At Shi Yu’s level, there was currently no real need for him to equip himself with a private phone.
This was uncomfortable… But whatever, even if he bought a relatively high-end cell phone, it would only be 100,000 yuan. It was nothing compared to 10,000,000 yuan.
“Welcome, Sir. How can I help you?”
After Shi Yu entered the cell phone department, a receptionist immediately welcomed him.
“I want to choose a cell phone.”
“What is your basic requirement?”
“It can connect to the Internet. It should also have the ability to detect energy and the Pet Catalog function.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the receptionist immediately took out a silver-white cell phone from the counter and said, “What do you think of this one?”
“This is the newest model of Century Corporation, the Index Machine M30. It contains information on 6,029 types of pets and their skills. In addition, it can accurately detect the energy level of pets below transcendent level.
“Its price is 99,998 yuan. If you choose this one, you can even get a thousand yuan as a gift if you buy it now.”
“Can I try it?” Shi Yu asked.
“Of course.”
Shi Yu took the cell phone and found the index function.
This function was actually not that magical. It was similar to the face-detection feature of Earth’s smartphones. It needed to use the cell phone camera aimed at some creature to take effect.
After opening the index function, Shi Yu aimed his cell phone at a black and orange dog with a ferocious expression lying outside the hall. In an instant, the cell phone immediately broadcasted a voice message.
[Species]: Mechanical Hound
[Attribute]: Machinery
[Race Level]: Mid-level Transcendent
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening
[Race Skills]: Image Storage, Aura Detection, Electric Bite, Self-Explosion
[Introduction]: Artificial mechanical life used for care, tracking, and investigation.
Not only was there a voice broadcast, the cell phone screen also displayed specific information about the mechanical dog.
The information was relatively comprehensive, and one could also get more detailed information through clicks or voice commands.
[Skill]: Self-Explosion
[Skill Level]: Advanced
[Introduction]: Explode all the energy in your body. You will die after using it.
Shi Yu: “…”
This skill’s level was really high, but if he wanted to replicate it, would there be a bug?
Seeing and touching… Those were the requirements for him to copy the skill.
They would have already been blown to pieces.
What would be left for him to touch?
Forget it, forget it. Eleven and the Green Silkworm didn’t need this skill anyway…
Because of the basic energy-wave-detection function, the mechanical dog’s growth level was also successfully registered.
Level 10 was considered pretty high. It was just a step away from becoming a transcendent creature.
Very good
, Shi Yu thought to himself. This index function was what he would find most useful.
Although he was also considered a genius, he only understood transcendent-ranked creatures the most, and he didn’t dare to say that he could understand everything.
But with this cell phone, in the future, no matter if one encountered rare or precious pets of high races or with rare skills, they could find relevant information immediately.
Although he definitely had to continue learning if he wanted to become an outstanding Beast Tamer, using high-tech products could more or less supplement his shortcomings and aid him.
In short, this cell phone was good in every way, and its looks were alright, but… it was so expensive!
If he bought it now, his savings would go straight to the bottom.
The 10,000,000 promised by Lu Qingyi was supposed to be transferred to his account tomorrow. If not, he and Eleven could only eat dirt then.
Roasted Earth Rat, ugh!
If he had known it would drain his finances, he would have come tomorrow instead… Shi Yu deeply realized the shortcomings of his personality.
He was very curious and had a rather impatient personality. Such a personality was very suitable for courting death. No wonder he was someone who had transmigrated.
“Forget it, I’m already here.”
She had already given him the rare evolution method, so why would she run away with the 10,000,000?
“Give me one,” Shi Yu said to the receptionist.
“Yes, Sir.” The receptionist immediately smiled. He seemed to be quite happy with the sale.
…
After buying the cell phone and settling a series of business matters, Shi Yu left in pain.
But he wasn’t in a hurry to go home. Instead, he went to another company, Talent Group.
Talent Group and Century Group were two of the five largest corporations in the nation. They were both widespread.
The latter focused on high-tech products, while the former focused on rare spiritual plants, minerals, pet food, and nutritional supplements.
Since he had already spent so much money, Shi Yu didn’t mind spending a little more.
Eleven had eaten enough Iron Bamboo every day for the past month. Although it liked it, Shi Yu wanted to give it something better.
In the end, he bought some level-two resources, Iron Heart Wood. This was also a recommended food in the metal-eating-beast cultivation manual given by Lin Xiuzhu, and it was of a higher level than Iron Bamboo.
Iron Heart Wood, as the name suggested, was wood with metal minerals growing inside. It was considered a spiritual plant with stuffing and also one of the best foods for Iron-Eating Beasts.
Its attributes were also inclined towards gold and wood, which could effectively strengthen the iron-eating beast’s hardening ability and its vitality.
This kind of ingredient provided more nutrition than Iron Bamboo. Typically, only transcendent-rank Iron-Eating Beasts would eat it as their main food. Otherwise, it would be very easy for it to be over-nourished.
Although that was the case, Shi Yu considered the expenditure of his Iron-Eating Beast… He felt that it wasn’t a problem for it to consume all this nutrition. After all, its appetite was several times that of an ordinary Iron-Eating Beast.
As for the Green Silkworm, it grew quickly anyway. It didn’t lack the nutrition needed for the occasional Skill Index upgrade, so Shi Yu didn’t spend too much on it.
What he ate was what the Green Silkworm ate… This was a restraint! A restraint that even Eleven didn’t have to deal with!
Later on, Shi Yu even planned to see if there were any higher-level supplements. After all, his body was about to develop resistance to the Refreshing Capsule already.
Besides, the level of the Capsule was indeed not high… He would be rich soon. Shi Yu also planned to treat himself better. Only if he was good could his pets be good.
However, considering that the capsules at home had yet to be finished, Shi Yu finally decided to use them all up before looking for new substitutes.
After squandering money to his heart’s content, Shi Yu returned home feeling refreshed.
As usual, Eleven pulled the Green Silkworm along to do daily training.
As for Shi Yu himself, apart from meditation, he could also lie in the courtyard and use his cell phone to learn.
After browsing for a while, because Shi Yu had registered with his Beast Tamer identity, he suddenly received a message notification from the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng regarding all trainee Beast Tamers there.
The ruins near Icefield City have already been opened. Those who wish to explore it can sign up for the Beast Tamer Association’s field combat training and participate in the assessment.. Those who pass the assessment can obtain the right to explore. Everything you find in the ruins will belong to you!

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Decision
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“The access rights are open just like that? Isn’t it said that all the treasures in these ruins and mystic realms belong to the person who discovers them?
“Heh, no wonder that Lu woman said that there’s a chance to enter even without the identity of Bureau Eleven. How is this a gift? It looks like she’s just recruiting cannon fodder.
“We don’t even know if there are treasures inside. Maybe there are only monsters.”
Shi Yu sensed that something was wrong.
In order to gain access, one had to go through the field combat training organized by the Beast Tamer Association.
From the looks of it, one of the entry requirements was to have a certain amount of combat ability?
What would happen if he didn’t have actual combat ability…?
Needless to say, he would most likely die in the ruins.
“There are hundreds of millions of pitfalls.”
Just as Shi Yu wanted to search for more information about the mystic realm ruins, he suddenly heard a “gurgle~” from the side.
“Auu—”
Eleven staggered over and asked when the meal would start.
At this moment, the Green Silkworm was lying limp in the birdcage like a crippled worm.
It really didn’t have a single thread left!
“There’s a sumptuous meal today. Don’t worry, I’ll get it right away.”
Shi Yu looked at the time. Good heavens, it was actually so late.
Usually, when he was meditating, days felt like years, and time passed very slowly. Now, he had just swiped his phone for a short while, and the sky was actually almost dark.
If the cell phone could evolve into a mechanical life form, it would most likely be able to awaken racial skills that could control time… like that TV show “Silly Girl”.
Eleven wasn’t the only one who was hungry. Shi Yu realized that he also felt a little hungry, so he quickly went to prepare the food.
A moment later.
Eleven’s Iron Bamboo pole, bamboo shoots, bamboo leaves, and Iron Heart Wood.
Shi Yu’s steamed buns and tomato egg soup.
The Green Silkworm’s vegetable leaves.
The three of them started eating their own food.
As they ate, Shi Yu asked Eleven, “Are you interested in field combat training?”
After returning from the battle hall the last time, Shi Yu had already thought of getting some field combat experience.
At the moment, this was probably the only thing that could put pressure on Eleven.
Although this training was said to be a field battle, the safety of the whole process was still guaranteed. After all, it was organized by the Association to train local Beast Tamers.
To be honest, he was still a little afraid of the mystic realm ruins to explore it. After all, he didn’t even know what was going on inside.
But if it was just field combat training, participating in it didn’t seem to be a big deal.
Firstly, he could continue to train his and Eleven’s combat abilities, and secondly, he could use this opportunity to see how the assessment was related to the ruins of the mystic realm.
“Wuu!!!”
Eleven raised its arms.
Charge! Charge! Charge!
Its eyes were bright, indicating that of course, it wanted to participate.
The whole point of tough training was to show off the results! Otherwise, it would be meaningless!
That Ice-Armored Beast and that group of Earth Rats couldn’t let it showcase all the training results.
The only thing that made it feel a little pressured was the Wind Demon Lion, but Eleven knew that he definitely couldn’t defeat it in the first place.
The Wind Demon Lion was of commander rank. The pressure created by a commander-rank creature was still very strong for an infant at the growth stage like Eleven.
Even worse, the pressure produced by monarch-rank creatures could directly kill low-level creatures.
After a pet reached the rank of monarch, it could automatically awaken its deterrence ability.
This was also why the deterrence skill duplicated by Shi Yu was referred to as the “kingly aptitude”. The act of mastering it wasn’t something just any creature could do.
To master this special ability of a monarch rank in advance meant that one had “the aptitude of a king”. A being with potential.
“Then let’s participate and take a look.”
Shi Yu nodded. Then, he looked at the Green Silkworm in the birdcage and said, “You too.”
“Ji??”
The Green Silkworm showed a confused and innocent expression.
“As far as I know, with the info I found using my cell phone… the evaluation criteria for the assessment in field combat basically depends on what kind of creature is defeated or what rare resources have been gathered.
“Of course, I’ll leave the fighting to Eleven, but gathering things can be done with your worm silk.” Shi Yu smiled.
For example, he couldn’t be bothered to pick those plants growing on a cliff or those resources protected by biological communities. Giving them to the Green Silkworm would be easiest. Stealing would definitely be more efficient than fighting.
“Ji!” The Green Silkworm lowered its head and started eating its “Last Supper”.
…
The next day.
Lu Qingyi came again.
She brought along identification documents representing Shi Yu’s status as a reserve member of Bureau Eleven.
At the same time, she also handed a bank card with 10 million yuan in savings to Shi Yu. As for the Bamboo Stone Dojo’s recommendation letter, it was nothing compared to the first two.
“With this certificate, you can have the authority to directly explore most of the ruins. For example, you can enter the Ping Cheng Ruins directly with it.
“As for the Ice Dragon Ruins in the snowy mountain… Well, I suggest that you should reach the abilities of a professional before exploring there. Otherwise, even if you wear a cold-proof suit, your physique definitely won’t be able to withstand that temperature.”
“Are there any bodyguards?” Shi Yu asked.
“You can apply for a bodyguard for the Ice Dragon Ruins on the snowy mountain, but not for this one that you triggered. I’ve said before that this ruin is relatively special, so, unfortunately, you can’t.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched. “So what exactly is going on inside this ruin? You might as well tell me directly.”
The cracked stone statue was still waiting for him to restore the truth, but if it was too dangerous, he would have no choice but to do it next time.
“There’s no harm in telling you in advance.
“The predecessor of the mystic realm ruins is the Beast Taming Space of a Beast Tamer. You know this, right?”
Shi Yu nodded.
“Firstly, the space in this ruin is very unstable. According to an experiment, only trainee Beast Tamers can enter normally. If the Beast Tamer’s level is too high, the Beast Tamer’s space in the ruins will have a spatial rejection reaction.
“Of course, we can also forcefully develop it, but that could easily cause the space to collapse. That wouldn’t be worth it. After all, the most precious thing is the ruin itself.”
“I guessed it. Otherwise, the Ping Cheng District Association wouldn’t have been prepared to give a large number of Beast Tamers access to such an important ruin,” Shi Yu said.
“Then, this ruin is a challenge-type ruin. It should have been modified by that Beast Tamer postnatally. Its purpose was to train the new-generation Beast Tamers of their own tribe.
“After Beast Tamers enter, they will randomly arrive at an independent environment. No one can meet each other. Elemental creature clones will appear in the environment. Only by defeating them can they enter the next environment.
“It’s a little similar to a level challenge. At the moment, there are actually already Beast Tamers from the Ping Cheng Beast Tamer Troops who have entered to explore, but as for battle results…” Lu Qingyi shook her head.
The strength of the Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng was still too weak. Even if transcendent creatures didn’t appear in this ruin temporarily, they wouldn’t be able to clear it all.
If there were some Beast Tamer trainees from big cities, they would definitely be able to discover the secret of the ruins faster.
However, this ruin appeared in Ping Cheng after all. The priority of exploration should definitely belong to Ping Cheng. Then, it would be the other districts and counties in Icefield City. In the end, it would still be impossible to crack before multiple cities attempted it together.
“Is it dangerous inside?” Shi Yu asked the question he was most concerned about.
“According to the people who came out, those elemental creatures only aim to defeat their opponents, not kill them. But if the challenger is too weak, there will still be danger.
“Wait a minute. I’ll give you an address and an invitation number. Your ten million starting capital can buy cultivation resources through here. You’ll also get a certain discount.
“Use this ruin and this ten million yuan reasonably, and then go to the Bamboo Stone Dojo to learn for a period of time. I believe you can become a professional-level Beast Tamer very soon.
“In any case, don’t pay attention to the Ice Dragon Ruins first. Instead, use the ruins as your primary investigation target.”
Shi Yu said, “It still sounds a little dangerous… My Iron-Eating Beast is only at level five, and those elite clans’ Beast Tamers who are proficient in combat can probably defeat it. It’s useless even if I go.”
“If you want to investigate the historical truth of Icefield City, you don’t necessarily have to clear it. There should be some clues in every independent environment. Your listening talent should be very useful when the time comes,” Lu Qingyi said. “After all, this ruin appeared because of you. Of course… you should?
still
?have the most basic ability to protect yourself.
“Learning two new skills with your Iron-Eating Beast at the Bamboo Stone Dojo should be enough. It’s still too difficult with just a hardening ability.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Then continue training for a while.”
He didn’t intend to enter directly with the identity of a member of Bureau Eleven. After all, there was no benefit to it. He would only receive more meaningless attention.
As expected… he should still participate in the Beast Tamer Association’s assessment first. It would put him more at ease to enter through this channel.
The criteria for passing this assessment should mean that one could survive safely in the ruins.
If he couldn’t even achieve satisfactory results for this assessment, he shouldn’t go to the ruins either. His life was more important.
Shi Yu slowly made plans for himself. Then, he quickly realized that something was wrong.
F*ck, didn’t he say that he wouldn’t touch ruins in this lifetime? What was with the anticipation and excitement…?

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Training
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After investigating Shi Yu’s identity and background, the Homeland Ruins Strategic Investigation and Backup Security Bureau, which was also known as Bureau Eleven, currently had a free-movement policy towards Shi Yu.
Although Shi Yu was talented and had a clean background, he was too lousy.
Even Lu Qingyi, who had the least experience in Bureau Eleven, had the title of doctorate in Dong Huang Capital University, one of the nine major universities, so one could imagine Shi Yu’s position as the junior of the organization.
Investigating the historical truth of Icefield City alone was also training for Shi Yu.
Using this, one would be able to see the subsequent manifestations of Shi Yu’s ability to listen to the echoes of history… his “listening” talent.
At the moment, Lu Qingyi was the one who paid the most attention to Shi Yu’s growth in Bureau Eleven. After all, she had already greeted those big bosses, making sure it was known that she was the one who discovered Shi Yu and dug him up. After Shi Yu became an official member, he had to be her assistant first. They couldn’t snatch him away from her.
“I hope you can pass the vocation assessment in half a year.”
After Lu Qingyi left Shi Yu’s house again, she had some thoughts. As someone with a certain level of experience, she naturally didn’t want Shi Yu to wait for the vocation assessment happening then. That would only be the standard for ordinary Beast Tamers like Chen Kai.
Now, she had provided Shi Yu with a huge amount of starting capital and also helped him get a learning opportunity at Bamboo Stone Dojo. Her goal was to let Shi Yu catch up to the next vocation assessment.
After becoming a professional Beast Tamer, one would be considered to have stepped into the real door of the Beast Tamer world. Every step was lengthy, and there was never enough time. Every step a Beast Tamer took was a race against time.
“Sigh…”
At this moment, in the courtyard, Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh as he watched Lu Qingyi leave.
With the rich lady gone, they could only rely on themselves to work hard.
Shi Yu took out his black Bureau Eleven ID and sighed as he looked at his handsome profile picture.
Bureau Eleven was roughly equivalent to the final strength and trump card of the Dong Hua Nation when facing various ruins. Its status was very high.
In his previous life, the archaeological field might not have been much, but many ruins here were related to various guardian totems and Mythical creatures. There were a lot of secrets involved.
It could be said that decrypting ruins was the most critical pathway for Beast Tamers to reach the Mythical Domain.
Therefore, as the most elite group of people in the archaeology world, it wasn’t strange for Bureau Eleven to have a Legendary-rank Beast Tamer serving as a bodyguard.
“Sigh.”
Shi Yu sighed twice. Although he was unlucky enough to enter the archaeology field again, he had entered such a high-level organization in just a few months here.
As expected of you, Shi Yu.
Indeed, after changing worlds, you’re still so outstanding.
“Can this certificate let me enter most ruins?
“At the same time, I’d be able to apply for a bodyguard from Bureau Eleven with this certificate to explore ruins?”
Shi Yu suddenly felt that the certificate was a little heavy. It was convenient, but it was equivalent to a Pandora’s Box. If he used it, it would definitely mean that he was courting death again.
“I’ll keep it away first.”
After putting away the documents, it was already noon. Shi Yu had to prepare food for Eleven and the silkworm again.
“WUUU—”
During this process, Eleven roared at the sky in the courtyard, scaring the Green Silkworm.
“You gave me a fright, dammit!” It also gave Shi Yu a fright.
But because of his mental connection with Eleven, he roughly knew what was going on.
Eleven’s growth level increased again, reaching Level 6 Awakening!
Today was July 25, 177, and he had joined Bureau Eleven on July 4, 177.
It had only been slightly more than twenty days, but it had already advanced by three levels…!
This speed would definitely make many Beast Tamers cry.
Under normal circumstances, even if Eleven could eat a lot and did a lot of training, this growth speed was still unscientific.
The reason it could grow so quickly was mainly related to the teaching of the skill book.
The increase in skill proficiency would lead to the growth of the pet itself. This was the reason why Eleven’s growth was so fast.
It could also be understood in this way… The physical strength and energy consumed by Shi Yu had all been converted into the nutrition needed for the growth of his pet during the teaching process.
Shi Yu carried a metal basin and walked out. He looked at Eleven, who was waving excitedly at him, and estimated. “Your height is almost one meter.”
“Hmm?” The Little Iron-Eating Beast nodded in confusion.
The current size of the little Iron-Eating Beast was a lot bigger than when it was first brought back from the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base. However, it was also normal. Currently, it was at its fastest growth phase.
“Congratulations, let’s eat first,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
He quickly prepared food for Eleven and the Green Silkworm. Then, he picked up his cell phone and checked the situation of the two pets.
[Species]: Iron-Eating Beast
[Level of Growth]: Level 6 Awakening
[Species]: Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: Level 4 Awakening
One was at level six, while the other was at level four. However, he couldn’t treat them as normal pets of this level. After all, their skill proficiency far exceeded other pets of the same level.
If he signed up for the field combat assessment organized by the Beast Tamer Association, Shi Yu was very curious about what kind of assessment results he could get with these two little guys.
…
That afternoon, Shi Yu went to the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng again. This time, he came openly.
Of course, this time, he came here to register for the field combat assessment organized by the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng.
“This is ridiculous. Why are there so many people?”
However, after coming here, Shi Yu’s scalp immediately went numb.
There were so many people that it was?
ridiculous
. It seemed that… all of them were here to register for the field combat assessment.
The appearance of mystic realm ruins in Ping Cheng was no longer a secret, and most Beast Tamers knew what the ruins represented.
It represented opportunities and wealth!!
This time, the Beast Tamer Association announced that all the gains from the mystic realm would belong to the individual. This directly made those Beast Tamers whose families were as poor as he used to be go crazy.
A gamble was a chance to change one’s fate.
“Looks like a batch of Beast Tamers with no potential will be eliminated from the field combat assessment organized by the Association. Then, the Beast Tamers with potential will be sent further into the ruins to train.”
“This way, after a period of time, another batch of Beast Tamers qualified to challenge the vocation assessment will appear in Ping Cheng.”
In a sense, just the news of the appearance of the ruins had completely mobilized the enthusiasm of Ping Cheng’s Beast Tamer trainees. In the past, there hadn’t been so many people signing up for wilderness training.
After a while, it was finally time. There were three combat training venues in Ping Cheng. The venue designation would be according to the situation of the Beast Tamer.
There were definitely simple and difficult spots in the three locations. Shi Yu estimated that at his level, he definitely wouldn’t be getting the hardest spots.
“Hello, the location of your assessment is Mount Tian Mang. The assessment is held for a total of three days. The time starts on July 28, which is three days later, and ends on the 30th. Please arrive at the training base at Mount Tian Mang by 9 a.m. on the 28th. If you are late, you are considered to have given up voluntarily. The registration fee will not be refunded.”
The lady at the front desk added sweetly, “As for the details, please go to the hall to take a look.”
“Thank you.” Shi Yu turned and left.
The registration fee for an assessment was 10,000 yuan. Actually, it wasn’t expensive. It was already considered cheap.
After all, in every training location, there were high-level Beast Tamers from the Beast Tamer Association who had eliminated the risk factors in advance. They also had professional security teams who were responsible for the safety of the trainees throughout the entire process.
In order for them to gain more experience, the Beast Tamer Association would also transfer a large number of pets that were not local to be placed in it for the apprentices to broaden their horizons.
Apart from that, the rare resources in the training venue had also been controlled to a full extent. Experts could freely obtain them. After they came out, they would be split at a certain ratio with the Beast Tamer Association.
Therefore, as long as the Beast Tamer who was training didn’t take it too far, with a little bit of ability, this registration fee could be recouped, and the stronger ones could even earn money.
Shi Yu’s goal this time was not to earn but to not lose out.
Then, Shi Yu took a look at the things to take note of in the registration hall.
In fact, there wasn’t much to pay attention to. The trainees were just reminded that they needed to bring some necessities on their own.
After paying a little attention, Shi Yu returned home.
There were still three days until the so-called field combat assessment. Shi Yu planned to just pass it normally. There was no need to train desperately at the last minute, or else it would affect his pet’s condition.
His goal was only to train Eleven’s combat ability so that its combat ability and growth level wouldn’t be out of sync. He also wanted to see if he could replicate some rare skills instead of only combat abilities.
If he wanted to go on a killing spree, he wouldn’t have been in such a hurry to register. After stably developing for half a year with 10 million yuan, he would have had everything ready.
…
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
These three days were indeed passed normally.
Eleven and the Green Silkworm still had the usual training and food.
Shi Yu, on the other hand, spent his days on meditation and playing with his cell phone.
The only thing worth mentioning was that during this period, Shi Yu used the skill book three more times.
He taught Worm Silk twice and Hardening once.
In this way, including the previous time, Eleven was probably taught two more times by the skill index on top of its already expert-level Hardening skill.
On the other hand, the Green Silkworm was taught twice by the Skill Index on the foundation of the expert-level Worm Silk it already had.
It was just an additional two times, so their skill proficiency naturally wasn’t at the perfected level yet. As for their daily bit of training, the relatively large experience gap made it naturally insufficient.
After this, Shi Yu was thinking about a mathematics problem.
When a pet that didn’t have any foundation for a skill was taught by the skill index once, it would be at initial level; teaching it twice equaled proficient level, and teaching it four times was expert level.
Then how many times did he have to teach it for it to be at perfected level?
Eight or sixteen times?
This question is too difficult. I can’t figure it out…
?Shi Yu gave up struggling. It would be better to wait and verify it personally.
That morning, Shi Yu woke up very early. Now that he was rich, he decided to use a taxi for once.
When he arrived at the street under the training base of Mt. Tian Mang, he discovered a large number of Beast Tamers gathered at the entrance. They were basically around twenty years old.
“Shi Yu!”
When Shi Yu arrived, he heard someone calling out to him. He looked around and immediately saw a guy with dark eye circles that looked like an Iron-Eating Beast.
“As expected, you’re here too,” Chen Kai, the top student of his class, said. “I knew you wouldn’t miss this.”
Shi Yu: “…”
No, what’s with your dark eye circles? Don’t tell me you really ate supplements like candy when you went back??

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: A Strange Creature
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Why are you here too?” Shi Yu raised his eyebrows and looked at Chen Kai.
This guy was so weak. The Ice-Armored Beast couldn’t even withstand Eleven’s attack previously.
What was it doing here?
“What’s wrong with me? It’s not just me. Most of the students in our class are here. The teachers are pretty encouraging. Did you know that after we left that day, that stone statue in the garden exploded that night? How exciting!”
Yes, I remember how exciting that was…
Shi Yu scratched his cheek.
What else could he say? He couldn’t possibly say that he was the one who had caused the explosion, right?
Even that mystic realm ruin was something he caused by talking to the statue.
“By the way, your training method is pretty useful. My Ice-Armored Beast is already level seven.”
Chen Kai thanked Shi Yu. He had worked hard before realizing how great his and the Ice-Armored Beast’s potential was.
He had long wanted to thank Shi Yu. He had had a premonition that Shi Yu would definitely come for this assessment, so he had paid attention to his surroundings in advance. He didn’t expect to really bump into him.
In short, this week was too fulfilling.
“I advise you to control yourself.” Shi Yu’s face was rather speechless.
Your story has spread all over the pharmacy in Ping Cheng! Stop it!
He didn’t want to be the culprit behind the destruction of the country’s youth.
“Yes, I have control.”
Chen Kai looked up at the sky. In short, the assessment this time would depend on his performance.
In order to find Shi Yu, Chen Kai deliberately didn’t follow the students who came to participate in the training earlier. On the way to the training base with Shi Yu, Chen Kai said, “I heard that there are a hundred applicants in each batch for a training site. Teacher Zhang revealed that only those who are ranked in the top twenty of each training base can enter the ruins.
“To be honest, I’m a little unsure…”
“One-fifth? That’s not low.” Shi Yu walked beside him and said, “Don’t worry, you’re an excellent student.”
If it was a level-six Ice-Armored Beast, it might be difficult, but Shi Yu didn’t expect Chen Kai to really break through by using all those Refreshing Capsules…
The current environment was too complicated.
Chen Kai blushed.?
Son of a b*tch.
?After all, he had already realized back then how he was a shitty top student.
After witnessing Shi Yu’s strength, he knew that he could only be impressive in school. He couldn’t compare to the Beast Tamers outside.
However, although he said he wasn’t confident, Chen Kai was still a little confident.
Although his Ice-Armored Beast was only level seven, its strength wasn’t weak.
Shi Yu’s Iron-Eating Beast’s growth level was even lower, wasn’t it?
But its strength was similarly ridiculous.
The growth level of an Awakening Stage pet didn’t mean anything at all.
A level-ten Green Silkworm, without any training, might not even be as strong as a dog!
This growth level was at most a reference. The battle-power test was still the various training conditions of the Beast Tamer on the pets. Otherwise, there would be no need to organize any combat assessment. Everyone could just compete for levels.
“By the way, have you participated in similar events before?” Shi Yu asked again.
“The school organized it once, but the scale was definitely incomparable to this time.” Chen Kai shook his head and asked, “What about you?”
“First time.”
“That’s right. You’re from the Feeding specialization. You definitely wouldn’t have participated in it before…”
Shi Yu nodded. After transmigrating, this was indeed his first time coming to such a relatively dangerous place. At this moment, even his cells could not help but feel excited.
Sigh… I’m indeed a restless person.
A moment later, the two of them arrived at the inner area of the training base. At this moment, there were more than fifty Beast Tamers who had already arrived.
Currently, these Beast Trainer trainees carrying backpacks were talking in groups of two or three.
In the distance, five Beast Tamers in green camouflage clothes were talking to each other. They seemed to be the people in charge of this training.<segment 3348 ?>
The surroundings became noisier and noisier. Eleven, who was sleeping soundly in the Beast Taming Space and preparing for a big battle, was still alright. It couldn’t feel anything, but the Green Silkworm in Shi Yu’s backpack subconsciously woke up from its sleep and hurriedly breathed through the gap in the backpack.
“Are the two girls from before here?” Shi Yu looked around and asked Chen Kai.
Chen Kai said, “That Yu Jingjing had some ideas, but she was dissuaded by her parents. As for Zhuang Yue, it’s already difficult for her Iron-Eating Beast to catch a rat, let alone participate in the training…”
Those who dared to sign up to participate in the wilderness training were actually considered brave warriors. After all, this training wasn’t completely without danger. Therefore, looking over, there were indeed not many female students. After all, even if they didn’t include dangerous creatures, the ordinary animals like bugs and snakes could already persuade a large number of people to leave.
“Chen Kai, come here. What are you doing over there?!”
Just as Chen Kai finished speaking, a few people suddenly called out to him from afar. Chen Kai hurriedly said to Shi Yu, “My classmate. Um, I’ll go over first. See you later.”
“Sure.” Shi Yu nodded.
Then, Chen Kai jogged over. Shi Yu continued to look around.
He mainly observed the group of Beast Tamers in camouflage clothes and was curious about their identities.
Were they the Beast Tamers hired by the security company or the Beast Troops?
The former were only workers, while the latter were more like soldiers on Earth.
Actually, for ordinary people with poor family backgrounds who wanted to become Beast Tamers, joining the Beast Tamer Association’s Beast Tamer Corps was also a pretty good choice.
After passing the evaluation in all aspects and entering the new recruits’ training camps, the officials would distribute the cubs all together and then set the Beast Tamers and their pets up for cultivation.
During this period, all the costs were provided by the association.
After the training ended, they could also be assigned work by the officials, such as guarding the city walls in various places or cleaning the wilderness.
There were advantages and disadvantages to this method. The advantage was that it could fulfill the dreams of people who couldn’t otherwise become Beast Tamers, but the disadvantage was that they might lose some freedom. It was their first duty to obey orders, and the pets didn’t completely belong to them.
His predecessor had also considered this path back then, but it was very difficult for ordinary people to withstand such harsh training, so in the end, the original Shi Yu had given up.
“Beep!”
“Silence—!!!”
As Shi Yu observed his surroundings, in the distance, a square-faced middle-aged man took out a whistle and blew hard. The loud sound immediately attracted the attention of all the Beast Tamers present.
“Time’s up. Everyone present, maintain silence. Immediately line up in an orderly manner to sign the safety notice!
“During this process, listen to me explain the things to take note of in this assessment.
“Firstly, I’m the overall person in charge of the assessment at this time. I, Zhou Wanshan, will be in charge of your assessment. There are also four other professional Beast Tamers and a group of security personnel.
“I won’t say any more nonsense. Next, after you’ve signed the form about taking responsibility for your own safety, we’ll give each of you a monster index.
“There are a large number of ferocious beasts and rare resources in Mount Tian Mang. All their types are recorded in this illustrated booklet, and they have corresponding points. Hunting ferocious beasts and collecting rare resources is the way for you to obtain points and increase your ranking in the assessment!
“In addition, before you enter, we will issue a location tracking device. There are a large number of safe sites that we have set up inside Mount Tian Mang for you. Security personnel will be stationed there. If you encounter any danger and want to give up the assessment, you can choose to call for help.
“At the same time, your spoils of war can also be transferred to the security guards at a safe site midway. They will be in charge of recording your results.
“What you need to do is to obtain as many points as possible within three days. In the end, the Beast Tamers ranked in the top twenty can obtain the right to enter the ruins!”
This instructor called Zhou Wanshan had shouted at the top of his voice so that every Beast Tamer could hear the important points clearly.
Behind him, the other four professional instructors smiled as they sized up this group of newbies, recalling the scene of their first experience.
“The average age isn’t that old. Quite a couple of them look chubby? Is that really okay?”
“Sigh, I also want to return to the trainee level. This ruin is so f*cked up. The high-level Beast Tamers actually aren’t allowed to enter.”
The instructors cursed.
Otherwise, why would this group of pampered newbies get such a good opportunity?
“Cut the crap. Don’t relax. Do our job well. Don’t let any casualties happen during this training.”
The five professional Beast Tamers, together with a bunch of security personnel and technicians, were all in charge of this assessment.
As they evaluated this batch of candidates, Shi Yu had already signed the form about taking responsibility for his own safety. He also received a wristwatch-like positioning call device and a photo album.
The function of the wristwatch was very simple. Shi Yu wore it casually after understanding it a little, but his focus was on the monster index.
Shi Yu flipped to the first page of the booklet. It actually recorded his old friend, the Earth Rat.
Hunting this thing could earn 20 points.
He continued to flip through it. It seemed that the fewest points that could be given was 20 points. This Earth Mouse really didn’t have much respect.
But it was also true. Apart from the Earth Mouse, the other creatures like Red-Crowned Snakes, Great Blade Mantis, Man-Eating Grass, and Thorn Monsters only gave a few more hunting points, but their names sounded like they weren’t to be trifled with.
As Shi Yu flipped to the last few pages of the ferocious beast catalog, he discovered that the ferocious beasts that appeared were getting more and more ridiculous.
[Name]: Mad Python
[Attribute]: Water
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening
[Race Level]: Mid-level transcendent
[Race Skills]: Berserk, Torrent Tail
[Introduction]: Green Water Lake and Little Mang Lake are located on the map. There are two of them. It’s extremely dangerous. It’s not recommended to hunt.
[Points]: 4000
Shi Yu: “?”
These guys didn’t recommend hunting them… but they were still assigning 4,000 points to them?
That was equivalent to 200 Earth Mice…
Although he was complaining, Shi Yu naturally understood that it was not recommended for weak Beast Tamers to hunt.
It was specially labeled as prey prepared for those Beast Tamers who were confident in their abilities.
Shi Yu continued flipping through a few more pages and discovered that there were several Boss-type prey like Mad Python marked in the book.
To be honest, that Mad Python’s Berserk Transformation skill was pretty good. After using it, it could increase its strength and speed completely. The disadvantage was that it would lose its mind.
But if he could increase the proficiency to Perfected Level, it should be able to overcome the shortcomings, right?
A Berserker Iron-Eating Beast?
The training base really was a different place. Such a skill couldn’t be found at the farms near Icefield City.
“Huh?” Shi Yu, who was still reading the booklet, suddenly stopped.
He saw a strange creature.
[Name]: Electric Slime
[Attribute]: Thunder
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening
[Race Level]: Mid-level transcendent
[Race Skills]: Multiplication, Electricity
[Introduction]: The Magnetic Mountain Range is on the map. There are three of them, and they are extremely dangerous. Hunting is not recommended.
[Points]: 4000
“Slime?”
Shi Yu felt that the training base really knew how to play. It was just like how the Iron-Eating Beasts were unique creatures of Dong Huang. Slimes were unique creatures of other countries, but there weren’t any in Dong Huang.
In order to broaden the horizons of the Beast Tamers, the training base had even captured this thing to be a Boss?
“Wait, this Multiplication…!” Shi Yu was suddenly attracted by the Slime’s skill again.
If he remembered correctly, this Multiplication was a skill that could let the creature control its size at will.
It could shrink or expand.
In the shrunken state, it could maximize the preservation of physical fitness and increase the speed of physical recovery.
The enlarged state was a state of extreme energy consumption, sacrificing speed in exchange for greater strength!
“This skill seems to be very suitable for Eleven? I wonder if I can learn it…”
The size of the Iron-Eating Beast was still too small. It was only two meters even when it reached adulthood. It was still alright now, but if it faced those huge beasts that were dozens of meters tall at every turn in the future, it was a little too small…
On the other hand, if he could learn this Multiplication, Shi Yu could easily imagine the scene of a huge Iron-Eating Beast tearing apart a huge dragon with its bare hands.
Then, in the blink of an eye, it would be another scene of a small Iron-Eating Beast panda cub being held in his hand. This skill was equivalent to giving a pet three forms.
That was, the shrunken state for preserving physical fitness and accelerating energy recovery, the normal state for both strength and speed, and the huge transformation for extreme strength enhancement!

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Entering Mt. Tian Mang
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“I want this Multiplication skill!”
Slimes were mud-like creatures that could become bigger and smaller, so only the Slimes would frequently have multiplication skills.
There were very few transcendent creatures who had mastered the Multiplication skill, so it was very difficult to encounter them.
Therefore, Shi Yu had no intention of letting go of a Slime if he managed to encounter one.
Even a monkey like Sun Wukong could learn that Lawful Embodiment of Heaven and Earth skill and turn itself into a giant monkey… so it’s not that unscientific for his panda to learn Multiplication!
In short, this was a universal skill. All pets were suitable to learn it. It was not a loss to keep it.
“Everyone, listen up!”
After searching for a proper skill to obtain for a long time, Shi Yu finally felt that he couldn’t miss this one. At this moment, the professional Beast Tamer, Zhou Wanshan, who was in charge of training, suddenly shouted.
“The training will officially begin in half an hour. In this half an hour, you can still go to the store beside the training base to replenish your food and medicine.
“But after entering Mount Tian Mang, except for some special circumstances, you can’t come out again for three days.”
In any case, everyone only had one backpack. How many items they could store would depend on the candidate’s own arrangements.
Shi Yu had naturally prepared the basic items, but they wouldn’t last more than three days. He would still have to find the follow-up food after entering Mt. Tian Mang. At the same time, he also prepared a sleeping bag and a tool worm.
At this moment, Shi Yu started to feel helpless. If only the Beast Taming Space could store other things… It was so troublesome without spatial equipment.
Speaking of which, was there spatial storage in this world?
This was a question worth considering… If there was, he had to get one in the future.
We-boys-have-to-get-what-we-want.jpg.
Right, that mystic realm ruins in Ping Cheng looked like a very large spatial storage? It could even contain non-living things.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“Shi Yu.”
Just as Shi Yu was wondering if the mystic realm ruins could also belong to him, Chen Kai suddenly came over.
“Do you want to form a team?” Chen Kai asked immediately. “Our class plans to form a team to hunt the Mad Python.
“My Ice-Armored Beast can play control. There’s someone in the class with a thunder-element pet who can blow up fish in a lake…”
Shi Yu asked, “You can also team up this time? How do we split the loot?”
Chen Kai said, “In any case, the examiner didn’t say no. It should be possible. Don’t the lakes around the Mad Python still have rare resources? It should be enough.”
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “No, you guys go ahead. I have other goals.”
He felt that following these guys might not be as efficient as him going solo, and it was also inconvenient.
“Ah, I see. Alright.”
Although Chen Kai wanted to team up with Shi Yu more, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of pity since he and his classmates had already agreed to act together.
Regarding whether or not candidates were allowed to form teams, there were indeed no clear rules in the training base. However, the only similarity was that both the lone wolves and some small teams had their eyes on the few small Bosses whose growth levels were above level-nine and were few in number.
If he took down one of them, perhaps he would be in the top 20.
Next, Shi Yu went to the store to buy an insulation glove. Before long, he returned.
It was still early to set off, so Shi Yu simply continued to read the monster index on the spot.
He had only flipped through the Fierce Beast section just now and had yet to look at the resource section. Collecting resources also gave points. Overall, it was similar to the assessments in the past years.
Well… apart from the ferocious beasts and resources, there were also two more pages.?
“Have You Learned a Daily Survival Technique?”
Time passed very quickly. In the blink of an eye, half an hour passed. The person in charge of the training gathered everyone again.
“Currently, it’s ten in the morning. Everyone, set off immediately. You’re free to climb the mountain from the four entrances.”
There was a blockade around Mt. Tian Mang, with only four entrances and exits in the area. The environments of the different entrances and exits would be different.
All the Beast Tamers present had studied the map carefully. They also had hunting targets in mind, so they also had some idea of which one they should go to.
Therefore, as soon as Zhou Wanshan finished speaking, the 100 Beast Tamers immediately dispersed.
At the same time, a certain number of mechanical birds the size of sparrows started to fly up from the training base and the safe areas in the mountain. They started to circle above Mt. Tian Mang.
[Race]: Mechanical Bird
[Attribute]: Machinery
[Race Level]: Low-Level Transcendent
[Race Skills]: Image Storage, Acceleration
<Notes>: Artificial mechanical life that is used to track, investigate, and monitor.
After the mechanical bird flew up, the situation at the various locations of Mt. Tian Mang started to clearly appear on the big screens in the monitoring room and various monitoring rooms in the training base.
Especially those ferocious beasts with higher growth levels, they were all important targets for monitoring.
This was not only to ensure the safety of the trainees but also to see their performance more directly. The viewing process was also one of the few pleasures these examiners had.
Wouldn’t it be too boring to directly wait for the assessment results?
At the foot of Mt. Tian Mang, at a certain midway point, was the entrance of the Magnetic Mountain area. Shi Yu and about twenty beast trainers chose to enter from there.
As for Chen Kai and the others, they entered from another direction and prepared to form a team to hunt the Mad Python.
“Eleven, come out.”
The outermost area of Mt. Tian Mang must have been cleaned up. There were basically no ferocious beasts lingering around, so most Beast Tamers chose to summon their pets here and have them as protection.
It was the same for Shi Yu. He had seen it before. There were many rare spiritual plants on this mountain. There was no need to be afraid that Eleven would exhaust his physical strength. He could let Eleven eat as he walked, so he should be able to maintain the basic physical consumption.
“Huh?”
At this moment, after coming out of the Beast Taming Space, Eleven looked around in confusion.
Was this the place?
Where were the opponents? Where were the opponents?
“I’ll bring you to find them.” Shi Yu was still very confident in the Little Iron-Eating Beast’s strength.
The ferocious beasts here could be said to be wild creatures that had not undergone training. Most of their battle power might be a little inferior to the pets carefully cultivated by Beast Tamers.
Although his Little Metal-Eating Beast was only level-six, with its proficient-level Super Vision, High-Speed Healing, and proficient-level Hardening, its battle power should be at the top of the food chain…
As long as they didn’t encounter a group of ferocious beasts, they were invincible.
“Wuuu~”
Eleven waved and followed beside Shi Yu.
Shi Yu added, “By the way, pay attention to your surroundings.”
Unlike its vision, the Iron-Eating Beast’s sense of smell was very good…
However, Eleven had both!
With this assurance, they could basically relax and not encounter any sudden danger.
Now, it was time to train Eleven in this area.
The final objective was the Magnetic Mountain area’s Electric Slime!
After the pet summoning, Shi Yu’s next target was very clear as he advanced towards the mountain.
He glanced at the map in the booklet. To reach his destination, he would first have to pass through the Wild Boar Forest…
A ferocious beast named “Longthorn Wild Boar” lived in this forest. It had extraordinary strength and looked fierce. Its fangs were sharp; its skin was thick, and it was covered in spikes that could defend against attacks like a hedgehog. It was a medium-level transcendent creature that would scare a child to tears, but its meat was fresh and juicy.
Shi Yu was still young at heart. Tears involuntarily flowed down the corners of his mouth.
According to the book, the average growth level of the Longthorn Wild Boar in the Wild Boar Forest was at the sixth level of Awakening. They were considered to be the backbone of the training segment.
The Longthorn Wild Boars probably weren’t creatures to be trifled with. Their battle power wasn’t weak, so the points assigned to them weren’t low either. However, the more it was like this, the more Shi Yu was delighted.
“Eleven, I’ll bring you to hunt pigs!”
“Wuuu~”
…
Wild Boar Forest.
The Longthorn Wild Boars were transcendent creatures that lived in groups. But in most cases, in fixed environments, they hunted separately, which gave the Beast Tamers here an opportunity.
Dealing with a group of wild boars would definitely be a headache, but just dealing with one alone, most of the Beast Tamers participating in the assessment this time should have some confidence.
Shi Yu and Eleven traversed a forest path and arrived near the Wild Boar Forest. During this period, they encountered other creatures, but they were all Earth Rats worth 20 points. Shi Yu was not interested at all.
It was too troublesome to travel with a bunch of burdens for dozens of points. There were even creatures that did not give points, such as Green Silkworms, that Shi Yu was even more unwilling to take another look at.
“Found it.”
However, just as he arrived near the Wild Boar Forest, Shi Yu discovered a long-spined wild boar foraging at the edge.
[Race]: Longthorn Wild Boar
[Attribute]: Earth
[Race Level]: Mid-Level Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Petrifying Fangs
<Notes>: Mutated beast evolved from a wild boar. It’s good at Sudden Pig Charge and is very strong. When its fangs hit, it can petrify the enemy.
“Phhh! Phhh!! Phhh!!”
It wasn’t only Shi Yu and the others who discovered the Longthorn Wild Boar. The wild boar had also discovered Shi Yu and the others.
The natural enemies of the Longthorn Wild Boar were ferocious beasts such as wolves, bears, leopards, and ferocious birds. Therefore, they had to be wary of any sudden attacks. They were very smart, fierce, and very vigilant.
At this moment, it sensed danger and raised its head. The long spikes on its body suddenly protruded as it let out a grunt of warning.
The Longthorn Wild Boar, which often lived in the wild, knew very well that it might have been locked onto by some hunters.
It started searching cautiously, but when it saw the thin and weak Shi Yu and the even smaller Iron-Eating Beast panda cub, Eleven, it was immediately stunned.
That was it?
Tears of shock involuntarily flowed down the corners of the Longthorn Wild Boar’s mouth. Wild boars were omnivorous animals. They ate plants and meat. To the current Longthorn Wild Boar, it only felt that the situation had suddenly reversed!
The Hunter is actually me!
Food had come knocking on his door!

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Wild Boar Killer!!
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Ug! Phhh!!!”
After the boar saw Shi Yu and Eleven, it even thought of which parts to eat first.
Saliva dripped from the corners of its mouth, and its eyes glowed. Its strong and powerful limbs stepped on the ground restlessly.
Pig Rush!
This wasn’t a skill, but a simple charge.
The Longthorn Wild Boar first locked onto the cub of an unknown bear-type creature that might pose a greater threat to it. It raised its fangs fiercely and charged over.
‘Be careful not to let its fangs touch your body, or you’ll be petrified. In addition, its attack method is mainly charging around.’
Shi Yu used telepathy to give Eleven a simple order. He immediately retreated to a tree and planned to watch the show.
This wild boar was nearly two meters long. Compared to Eleven, who was nearly one meter tall, it was a big difference in size. As it rushed over, Eleven experienced a completely different feeling from when he fought the Ice-Armored Beast.
The charging speed of the Longthorn Wild Boar wasn’t any slower than that of the Ice-Armored Beast. Moreover, in terms of strength and physique, it was even more threatening.
To Eleven a week ago, perhaps it could have only resisted or dodged in a hurry, but now…
The black and white hair standing on its legs swayed with the wind. Under its extreme concentration, its eyes flashed with a bright light.
Intermediate skill Super Vision!
Under the proficient-level Super Vision, Eleven’s vision ability was enhanced to the limit. Its dynamic vision was now unexpectedly outstanding.
At this moment, the whole world seemed to have slowed down in its eyes. The ferocious-looking pig suddenly attacked with its petrified fangs, but in Eleven’s eyes, it was very slow.
Since his vision could clearly capture the enemy, Eleven naturally had more time to react.
Bang!!!
Because the Longthorn Wild Boar’s movements mainly focused on charging forward, it was very difficult for it to change its direction. Using this point, it was actually very easy to dodge the attack and counterattack.
During the process of the Longthorn Wild Boar charging over, Eleven directly turned sideways and successfully dodged!
Eh? Where’s the prey?
In an instant, the board lost its prey as it disappeared from its sight. After it missed, it became extremely confused.
The next moment, the little Iron Eating Beast, who had dodged sideways, reacted abnormally quickly and launched a counterattack. After all, it had started practicing this in its mind ever since it saw the attack mode of the long-spined wild boar.
At this moment, its bear paw was instantly covered by Hardening and directly slapped towards the boar that had passed by!
Crack!!
When the hardened bear palm came into contact with the long spikes on the wild boar’s body, the long spikes instantly broke. Immediately following that, a huge impact came from the side, making the Longthorn Wild Boar’s body feel like it was overturning rivers and seas and sense that something was wrong.
“Ugh…”
With a painful howl, under the inertial force of the wild boar’s charge and Eleven’s impact, the huge wild boar actually rolled diagonally.
“Howl, howl, howl…”
After being knocked over, the Longthorn Wild Boar became dizzy as it kept rolling on the ground. The pain then made it unable to stand up. Its expression was filled with horror.
The food had hit back…!
“Eleven, go for the kill.”
As an outstanding Beast Tamer, Shi Yu would always teach his pets some outstanding abilities.
Under his command, Eleven immediately turned on all fours and stepped forward at the same time with its left front and right rear feet. It charged at the wild boar, looking even fiercer than the pig’s sudden charge just now.
Hardening, head, impact!
With the force of the sprint, Eleven directly hardened its head and made intimate contact with the Longthorn Wild Boar’s head. With a bang, the boar’s eyes turned white, and it completely fainted.
“Green Silkworm, tie it up.”
Shi Yu opened the zipper of his backpack. A little green worm came out reluctantly and used its worm silk on this huge wild boar.
Soon, a Level 7 Longthorn Wild Boar worth 350 points was easily hunted by Shi Yu and his pets.
“As expected, the battle power is not on the same level.”
Shi Yu looked at the long-spined wild boar bound by white threads and gained a new understanding of Eleven’s battle power.
From the looks of it… the only ones who could pose a threat to Eleven in this state were probably those little Bosses whose growth levels were at level 10.
For a long-spined wild boar with only one attack pattern, it was easily countered to death by Super Vision and Hardening!
However, if it were Chen Kai’s Ice-Armored Beast, Shi Yu felt that even if it could win one-on-one, it would have taken a lot of effort.
“Wuuu~”
At this moment, Eleven was in the midst of the joy of defeating the Longthorn Wild Boar. Shi Yu bent down and picked up one end of the thread and threw it to Eleven.
“Your favorite training segment is here. Carry the spoils of war and move forward with a heavy load.”
Eleven: ? (O _ O;)!
Eleven originally thought that it would be over after defeating the Longthorn Wild Boar. It completely didn’t expect that the wild boar’s body could still be used as a training tool.
As expected of its Beast Tamer, he was really thoughtful!
Eleven excitedly picked up the worm silk and dragged the wild boar with a thump. It looked expectant and curious about what was waiting for it in front.
“Let’s continue deeper.”
After confirming the battle power of the Longthorn Wild Boar, Shi Yu was relieved and brought Eleven into the Wild Boar Forest, planning to cross this place.
At this moment, in the nearest safe area, in the monitoring room, a staff member who was browsing through the surveillance cameras suddenly noticed that something was up. He hurriedly enlarged a surveillance video.
“Brothers, someone has already opened for business here.”
“A Beast Tamer has already killed a Longthorn Wild Boar and entered the Wild Boar Forest alone.”
“Alone?” The surrounding security guards heard him and immediately looked over.
In the overlooking image transmitted by a mechanical bird, an Iron-Eating Beast panda cub was dragging the body of a long-spined wild boar with a white rope, following beside Shi Yu.
The man and beast boldly entered the forest marked with a certain level of danger on the map.
“That Iron-Eating Beast… Looking at its size, it seems to be a cub? Its growth level shouldn’t be more than seven. How did it easily defeat the Longthorn Wild Boar?”
The reason why it looked easy was because Eleven was leisurely dragging the wild boar.
If it was a difficult victory, the first thing Shi Yu and the others would do was to take the relatively safe path marked on the map and enter a safe area. They would first convert the wild boar into points to rest and not drag the wild boar further into its territory.
“I didn’t see it. Let’s watch the replay tonight,” the security guard who had noticed Shi Yu and the others at the start said.
With so many things happening, how could he have noticed Shi Yu and the others from the start?
“Watch him carefully first. It’s definitely dangerous for a person to enter the Wild Boar Forest alone, but as long as they are smart enough and know how to climb trees, the Longthorn Wild Boar won’t be able to hurt them,” said a security guard.
Shi Yu’s group was the first batch of candidates to have any major gains, causing them to immediately receive special attention from the security personnel of the nearest safe area.
Soon, under their attention, Shi Yu went deep into the forest and quietly found a few Longthorn Wild Boars gathered together.
Hiding behind a tree in the distance, Shi Yu and Eleven looked at the four Longthorn Wild Boars foraging in the woods in front of them with different expressions.
Shi Yu was thinking about whether Eleven could fight against four alone… while the little Iron-Eating Beast was thinking about why Shi Yu didn’t let it charge forward.
“Eleven, do you want to give it a try? You have expert-level Hardening and can fight with your whole body hardened. They shouldn’t be a threat to you.”
Shi Yu felt that there was no problem with its proficiency in Hardening and Super Vision. After all, the wild boars’ movements were simple, and their growth level wasn’t high.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven’s wild nature appeared.
1 VS 4!
It sounded so exciting!
“Alright, the Green Silkworm and I will cheer you on from behind the tree. It’s all up to you…” Shi Yu encouraged.
Eleven was discouraged. Alright then.
Then, Eleven put down the spoils of the wild boar that he was dragging and left Shi Yu behind. It walked towards the group of Longthorn Wild Boars alone.
“Damn, this group is really going for this?”
This action had attracted the notice of the security guard in the security-area monitoring room who was watching Shi Yu.
The guard’s shout once again attracted the attention of the other security guards in the room.
“What’s wrong?”
“That Beast Tamer who brought the little Iron-Eating Beast along, it’s now charging towards the four Longthorn Wild Boars alone!”
“What? He became arrogant after defeating one?”
Even if it was a tenth-level pet, it would be very difficult to face four Longthorn Wild Boars alone.
Then, under their surveillance, Eleven walked into the perception range of the four boars.
“Ehh, phhh, phhh!!!”
“Phhh!! Phhh!! Phhh!!”
An unknown creature had approached, and it was a bear-type creature that looked like a natural enemy. The four boars immediately revealed wary looks.
However, after discovering that Eleven was just a tiny cub less than a meter tall, their hearts immediately underwent a hundred million changes just like the first Longthorn Wild Boar had before it was defeated.
What was going on? Where did this guy come from? Was it giving them extra food?
The four Longthorn Wild Boars were still in the observation stage, but at this moment, something unexpected happened.
The Little Iron-Eating Beast in the distance suddenly stretched out its two paws, opened its mouth wide, and made a face to provoke.
“Oh, oh, oh…”
Eleven mocked.
“Holy shit.” The security guards were even more shocked.
Courting death?
“Ehh, phhh, phhh!!!”
“Phhh!! Phhh!! Phhh!!”
The four Longthorn Wild Boars suddenly charged forward at the same time, their sharp fangs ready to stab into Eleven.
As the four wild boars rushed over from different directions, and because Eleven’s Super Vision had yet to reach 360° without any blind spots, it didn’t dare to be careless and directly hardened its whole body!
In an instant, a metallic luster filled its entire body!
The metallic texture of the black fur was incomparably deep. The white fur became as hard as silver and dazzling. After it was fully armored, Eleven let out a howl and used the method of fighting against the previous wild boar to directly smash the first wild boar that approached it.
The next second, the second wild boar hit Eleven’s body, but the boar felt as if it had hit a huge lump of steel. It didn’t know how its enemy felt, but it knew that its fangs were about to shatter.
“Howl—” The second wild boar cried out in pain. Eleven, who was hit, definitely wasn’t injured. The other party didn’t even break its defense. It only made the hardened area a little more earthy.
However, the huge impact had still made Eleven stagger, and its body was pushed aside a little.
As it was hit, Eleven’s wild nature was aroused. With an especially fierce expression, it directly pounced at the wild boar beside it and knocked it over with a collision.
Then, its gaze became fierce as it searched for the remaining enemies.
As for the remaining two Longthorn Wild Boars, because they were too far away at the start, they couldn’t come into contact with Eleven immediately, causing the battle range to be occupied by the first two wild boars.
During this process, they clearly saw how their two companions were defeated by this little guy who had suddenly turned into a steel lump.
“Wuuu—”
At this moment, they had no intention of continuing the battle. The creatures in the wild were very pragmatic. If they weren’t trapped, their first reaction when they encountered a strong enemy was definitely to run.
However, Eleven didn’t intend to give them a chance to escape. It locked onto a Longthorn Wild Boar that had turned around and fearlessly bumped into it, scaring the wild boar into howling and jumping up as it ran.
“Holy sh*t!”
This was already the third “what the f*ck” in the monitoring room of the safe area.
The four security guards surrounding the surveillance video looked at the screen in disbelief and rubbed their eyes hard.
Wait a minute, they… they didn’t see wrongly, right??
