An Iron-Eating Beast panda cub, facing four Longthorn Wild Boars, defeated two in two moves.
Then, it scared the other two into fleeing and even chased after them?
It was like a wild boar killer!
“Expert-level Hardening? Who is this candidate?” a security guard suddenly said with a serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: First Place For Now
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Expert-level skills were clearly unscientific on a two-year-old Iron-Eating Beast panda cub.
Iron-Eating Beasts were not pets that liked to train in the first place, so the skill proficiency on most of them was not very high. Most of the time, they relied on their strong physiques to defeat their opponents, not their skills.
Even if this Iron-Eating Beast started training when it was in its mother’s womb, it would still be too ridiculous. It was fine if this was an adult Iron-Eating Beast, but the key was that it was a cub.
“Shi… Yu… I think that’s his name. Do you know him? I remember you studied at Bamboo Stone Dojo. Is he from your dojo?”
A person beside held the name list and asked the security guard who Shi Yu was.
“No… I’ve never heard of him,” the security guard said.
The few of them looked at each other.
So, what was going on with this Shi Yu and this little Iron-Eating Beast?
“A Green Silkworm?”
At this moment, another painful scene appeared on the screen.
On Shi Yu’s side, Eleven had already successfully defeated the four long-spined wild boars.
At this moment, it was the Green Silkworm’s turn again. It crawled out of Shi Yu’s backpack and used all its strength to spit out worm silk to tie up the boars.
“Isn’t he a Beast Tamer trainee? Why does he have a second pet?”
Seeing the Green Silkworm, the few of them were even more surprised.
“Maybe it’s just an additional pet without a contract?”
It wasn’t that no Beast Tamer had done this before, but for ordinary Beast Tamers, this was too difficult.
It was alright to raise a pet like a pet cat or a pet dog, but if one wanted to nurture a battle pet that understood commands and was willing to fight, it was very difficult without contracting with it. It was probably equivalent to the difference between a pet dog and a police dog.
It was only because Shi Yu had the gift of telepathy that the Green Silkworm could understand his meaning slightly. Otherwise, this Green Silkworm would definitely not be as obedient as it was now.
“This candidate is awesome. Not only does he have such a strong Iron-Eating Beast cub, he even raised an additional Green Silkworm.”
“I think this Green Silkworm Silk’s level isn’t low either. It’s inevitable that it will evolve into a Wind Crystal Butterfly.”
“Brothers, let’s bet on a cigarette. I bet they can rank in the top three of this assessment.”
The security guards at the security area’s monitoring room started talking noisily.
“Alright, alright.”
“Forget about him for now. Someone’s already injured.”
But soon, the discussion stopped. The few of them were reprimanded by a serious security guard.
It was time for work right now, so they couldn’t place all their attention on Shi Yu. It was good enough that they knew that Shi Yu wasn’t there to court death. The other Beast Tamers also needed a certain amount of attention paid to them.
This… Although the training had just begun, there were already Beast Tamers and pets injured. They had to deal with it quickly.
Wild Boar Forest.
“Big harvest.”
Shi Yu and his pets still didn’t know that their battle results had already been noticed by a portion of the security personnel.
At this moment, he was happily looking at the tied-up long-spined wild boars. He was in a good mood. Very good. He had 1,750 points now.
These points didn’t look that difficult to obtain…
Compared to points, Shi Yu was hungrier for the meat of the Longthorn Wild Boar.
Previously, he was fortunate enough to have eaten spicy stir-fried wild boar meat once in the canteen of the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base in Icefield City. He wondered how it would taste if it was handled by him…
“Speaking of which, the spoils of war should be edible, right?” Shi Yu looked at Eleven, who shook its head.
“Wuu!”?
I don’t know. Don’t ask me.
It was only in charge of fighting and wasn’t interested in wild boar meat.
Compared to wild boar meat, it was more concerned about the bamboo shoots in Shi Yu’s backpack.
“Gulp…”
After the battle, Eleven’s stomach rumbled.
Although it was very fierce, it was still a cub after all. The consumption from such a battle was also very high.
“I know, I know.” Shi Yu took out two sections of sliced Iron Bamboo shoots and threw them to Eleven.
At the same time, Shi Yu also placed the Green Silkworm on the tree trunk and said, “Go and find some leaves to settle yourself. I don’t think there are any spiritual plants in this wild boar forest…”
After vomiting so much silk, the Green Silkworm must have consumed as much as Eleven.
Green Silkworm: “…”
Shi Yu and the others rested for about twenty minutes before continuing deeper.
This time, dragging five Longthorn Wild Boars was a little difficult even for Eleven.
Shi Yu, of course, had no problems letting this training-addict panda carry the load. He treated it as him exercising too.
Next, they had to continue passing through the Wild Boar Forest and reach the nearest safe area.
Then, after passing through that safe area, they could head to the Magnetic Mountain area for the Electric Slime.
In front, Shi Yu and Eleven were pulling two ropes made of worm silk. The Green Silkworm was lying in the backpack behind him to replenish its strength because it might need to tie up wild boars later.
After walking for another five minutes, Eleven suddenly stopped.
“There’s a wild boar?” Shi Yu asked.
Eleven nodded.
Then, Shi Yu heard a commotion not far away.
However, when he heard the sound, Shi Yu’s expression was odd.
This sound was similar to the cry of a wild boar, but not entirely.
Instead, it sounded more like a human scream!
“Ahhh, run! There’s a tree in front! Run to the tree!”
“F*ck, why are there suddenly ten Longthorn Wild Boars? How do we fight them?”
Before long, Shi Yu saw clearly that it was a group of wild boars chasing after two people.
Beside the two of them, there was also a level-six Icefield Hound and a level-seven Snow Stripe Mink running together.
Using the terrain and their skills, the Icefield Hound and Snow Stripe Mink would interfere with the wild boar group’s speed from time to time, creating an opportunity for them to flee.
As for the Longthorn Wild Boars behind, their levels were all above six. It was probably very difficult for two to defeat 10, and these pets clearly didn’t number 11. It was no wonder that the two Beast Tamers would run away crazily.
They didn’t dare to face such a large pack of Longthorn Wild Boars, but they didn’t want to give up the assessment by seeking help. They could only run and decide what to do later.
The nearby trees were all very thick, and the Longthorn Wild Boars wouldn’t be able to knock them down for some time. As long as they climbed onto the trees, the wild boars would be at their wits’ end.
“Wait, there seems to be someone ahead.” A Beast Tamer who was running suddenly saw Shi Yu in front.
“Ugh, phhh, phhh!!!”
“Phhh! Phhh! Phhh!!!”
It wasn’t just them. The group of Longthorn Wild Boars also smelled these newcomers.
“Ten at once?” Shi Yu and Eleven stood there. Shi Yu was calculating the chances of Eleven winning against 10 Longthorn Wild Boars…
Ordinary Longthorn Wild Boars couldn’t break through Eleven’s defense in his hardened state. Even if they did, it could still heal at a high speed. Therefore, it would be a test of Eleven’s physical strength.
“Forget it, what am I overthinking about?” Shi Yu quickly shook his head. This was because when this group of pragmatic wild boars saw their companions on the ground and being dragged in a pile, they immediately turned and ran without a word. They had no intention of fighting at all.
“Ugh, phhh, phhh!!!”
“Phhh! Phhh! Phhh!!!”
Let’s run for it!
At a distance, the group of wild boars scattered and escaped, directly leaving the two Beast Tamer trainees, the Icefield Hound, and the Snow Stripe Mink stunned on the spot.
“They ran away? They stopped chasing?”
Right on the heels of that, they saw Shi Yu and the little Iron-Eating Beast walking over slowly with the five Longthorn Wild Boars’ spoils of war.
The scene was extremely striking.
“Oh my!” the Icefield Hound’s Beast Tamer exclaimed and looked at the spoils of war dragged by Shi Yu in disbelief.
He had some impression of Shi Yu. They had entered Mt. Tian Mang through the same entrance together. It had only been such a short period of time, so what was with the pile of Longthorn Wild Boars behind Shi Yu??
At this moment, the Snow Stripe Mink’s Beast Tamer also noticed why the group of Longthorn Wild Boars had run away. It was because at this moment, Shi Yu and his pet, who were dragging a group of Longthorn Wild Boars, had an especially strong aura. Even he was shocked, let alone the boars.
“If you want to find lone Longthorn Wild Boars, go to the periphery. Don’t go deep into the forest.”
After Shi Yu passed by them, he casually reminded them and continued to drag a bunch of Longthorn Wild Boars with Eleven.
“I understand. Thank you, big boss.”
The two of them hurriedly thanked him, but after being chased by the wild boars, they temporarily had no intention of hunting anymore. They planned to go to the safe area to rest first.
After taking a breath on the spot, they chose to follow far behind Shi Yu. After all, the path Shi Yu took was the path that would allow them to safely pass through the forest and reach the safe zone.
Following that, because they were dragging the five Longthorn Wild Boar spoils of war, the other Longthorn Wild Boars completely treated Shi Yu and the others as top-level hunters. No matter how easy it might look to bully Shi Yu and Eleven, no wild boar dared to approach them.
As for dragging so many Longthorn Wild Boars along, Shi Yu temporarily had no intention of taking the initiative to find trouble with the boars. It was almost afternoon now, and he still hadn’t had time to eat lunch. It was better to directly go to the safe area to submit the boars.
After spending some time, Shi Yu and the others finally arrived at a small safe area surrounded by wood and thorns. It looked like a small village.
When Shi Yu arrived, there were already five to six people there. It was unknown if they had passed through the Wild Boar Forest or directly walked through the safer paths.
There were no extra houses in the safe area, only the monitoring room and the infirmary, so the candidates could only sit and rest for a short while under the straw shed outside.
At this moment, half of the candidates who were resting outside looked pretty normal, but the other half were covered in dust.
Shi Yu even saw a young man whose clothes were dyed red and whose arm was tied with a white bandage.
Was he attacked by a wild boar?
There was also a Beast Tamer with a scab on his face. This scab looked like a scar.
What the f*ck, was he disfigured by the Great Blade Mantis and then healed?
Because of the existence of healing-type pets, as long as the candidate didn’t die on the spot, the chances of saving him were still pretty high… Although that was the case, when Shi Yu saw the two to three bandaged Beast Tamers, he still subconsciously swallowed his saliva.
How miserable… It was kinda scary.
Shi Yu felt that this group of injured people was dispelling his motivation to continue hunting the level 10 Boss.
“This…” When Shi Yu entered, his gaze swept across the candidates who had already arrived at the safe area. The candidates were also paying attention to Shi Yu who had just entered.
When the six people saw Shi Yu and the little Iron-Eating Beast dragging five Longthorn Wild Boars in, their eyes immediately widened as though they had seen something unbelievable.
One, two, three, four, five… Did they count wrongly? Five?
After taking a closer look, they were certain that Shi Yu had entered alone.
In other words, Shi Yu had hunted five Longthorn Wild Boars alone?
Where did this god come from…?!
Although the Longthorn Wild Boar wasn’t the most powerful ferocious beast on Mt. Tian Mang, not everyone could easily hunt five consecutive wild boars in one go. After all, the pet’s physical strength was limited, and not much time had passed.
“You’re finally here.”
At this moment, a security guard in a blue uniform walked out of the control room and said, “We’ve been watching you through the surveillance cameras for a while now. Your Iron-Eating Beast is very strong.
“Do you want to register your points? I’ll help you register.”
Shi Yu looked over and nodded. “Yes, please. By the way, can I eat this wild boar?”
The security guard was stunned. “How do you want to eat it?”
“Roasted?”
“I advise you not to eat it. The meat of the Longthorn Wild Boar is indeed delicious, but that has to be processed through multiple procedures.”
“This…” Shi Yu was greatly disappointed.
Then, he could only eat the braised beef instant noodles in his backpack?
He had originally wanted to eat well here and then go replicate the skill in the afternoon…
…
At the training base of Mt. Tian Mang.
In the main control room.
Unlike the situation where each safe area of Mt. Tian Mang only needed to monitor fixed areas, this place had to pay attention to the situation of the entire Mt. Tian Mang, so it didn’t have a very good oversight over the situation of individual candidates.
However, as they looked at the points transmitted in real-time from the safe areas, the five professional Beast Tamers here quickly knew which contestants had performed very well.
At the moment, the first place on the big screen was a Beast Tamer named Xie Fei. He had 1,500 points. Not long after he entered Mt. Tian Mang, he had successfully hunted a Rockback Lizard that had grown to level nine.. He had been in first place for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - Iron-eating Beasts Lightning Training Roads
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Iron-eating Beast’s Lightning Training Roads
“Oh, number one in the rankings has finally changed.”
In the main monitoring room, the five professional Beast Tamers were enjoying the air conditioner and started commenting on the real-time points.
They weren’t directly responsible for the security work. Generally speaking, the security company’s personnel were still in charge of rescuing the candidates.
“I think they hunted five Longthorn wild boars. Good lord, they look like a rather energetic combination of Beast Tamers and pets.”
With just a slight evaluation, they changed the topic. They didn’t pay too much attention to this change. After all, only a few hours had passed, and it was still a long way before the end of the assessment…
…
Professional Beast Tamers were undoubtedly Beast Tamers who had transcendent pets. However, those security personnel who had yet to pass the vocation assessment might not necessarily have transcendent battle power.
The Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space, upon reaching level two, will result in the spatial crystal wall turned from colorless to gray. The pet’s growth level would also have reached transcendent level. This was the basic condition for participating in the vocation assessment.
And the so-called professional Beast Tamer were elites selected from thousands of Beast Tamers who had fulfilled this requirement. They had to have theoretical knowledge, survival skills in the wild, and combat ability. They had to be very outstanding in all aspects.
Therefore, these Beast Tamers who were qualified to participate in the vocation assessment but didn’t pass it didn’t necessarily mean they were as lousy as most Beast Tamer trainees. Compared to them, the title of quasi-Class Beast Tamer was more suitable for the assessment qualifiers.
For example, Yan Qi, one of the security personnel this time, was a quasi professional Beast Tamer. His level was enough, and his pet level was also enough, but he just didn’t pass the vocation assessment and couldn’t sweep up others. That was why he didn’t get that certificate.
Yan Qi was a native of Ping Cheng. His initial pet was an Iron-eating Beast. He had entered the Iron-eating Beast’s base, Bamboo Stone Dojo, to learn. Therefore, he understood the Iron-eating Beast pretty well.
From the first moment he saw Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast’s performance through the surveillance cameras, he realized that Shi Yu and Eleven weren’t simple.
After staying in the Iron-eating Beasts’ headquarters Bamboo Stone Dojo for so long, he had never seen an Iron-eating Beast that mastered expert level hardening when it was still a cub. This was ridiculous.
After all, his Iron-eating Beast was already at the transcendent level. It had been cultivated for five to six years… The current hardening proficiency level had only just reached the expert level.
In short, Shi Yu was definitely not simple. Out of curiosity, when he changed shifts to rest, he used his private cell phone to call Bamboo Stone Dojo and found Hall Master Lin, who was a disciple in the dojo.
“Master Lin, do you remember me? I’m Little Qi, that Yan Qi with the nickname Little Bear.”
The other side of the phone said, “That Little Bear Yan Qi who participated in the two-year vocation assessment, hasn’t passed, and went to work at a security company?”
It hurt.
Yan Qi smiled bitterly. “Sorry, I’ve embarrassed our Bamboo Stone Dojo…”
“Master Lin, I’m currently in charge of security at the training base of Mt. Tian Mang. I encountered a very interesting Beast Tamer.”
“His Iron-eating Beast is only about two years old, but it has mastered expert level hardening. It’s so ridiculous. Isn’t this our Bamboo Stone Dojo’s new junior brother?”
“I really don’t have any impression of him, nor have I heard of him before, so I came over to ask you. By the way, his name is Shi Yu.”
Inside the Bamboo Stone Dojo…
In a very elegant room with mountains and rivers, a middle-aged man with a meticulous expression fell silent.
An iron-eating beast about two years old, expert level in hardening?
Was this Yan Qi sure that he wasn’t kidding? How was this possible?
It could be said that all the iron-eating beasts in the entire Icefield City were from the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base. If there were such a talented iron-eating beast, it was impossible for him not to know.
“What did you say his name was?”
“Shi Yu. His name is Shi Yu.”
Shi Yu!
“It’s him?” Lin Hongnian recalled that a few days ago, Dr. Lu from the Ancient Capital University came to visit him at Bamboo Stone Dojo.
The other party seemed to be saying that she had entrusted him to help nurture a distant relative… That relative was called Shi Yu?
Because Shi Yu’s initial pet was an Iron-eating Beast, she had found him.
Moreover, she even used a high-level resource obtained from the ruins as a reward.
Towards this Shi Yu, Lin Hongnian also investigated the situation of the pet collection in the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base. The result of the investigation was that… Shi Yu’s information was very ordinary. The pets were all bought with loans. He was a native of Ping Cheng. He had no idea how Shi Yu was related to Lu Qingyi, who was considered a proud daughter of heaven in the country.
However, he couldn’t not sell Dr. Lu a favor, not to mention that the other party had also given him a sufficiently precious reward.
“This Shi Yu, the iron-eating beast he received is clearly only a year old. Moreover, the time he received the iron-eating beast didn’t exceed a month, right?”
“Expert Level Hardening?” Lin Hongnian discovered the blind spot and his expression became serious.
“Did Dr. Lu help him nurture it using a special method?”
Otherwise, Lin Hongnian couldn’t imagine how a Beast Trainer could cultivate the racial skills of an Iron-eating Beast cub to expert level in such a short period of time…
Perhaps Lu Qingyi had given Shi Yu some rare cultivation resources.
“Master Lin, Master Lin…” Realizing that there was no sound for a long time, Yan Qi spoke again.
“Yan Qi, you mean that Shi Yu is training at Mt. Tian Mang, right?”
“Yeah.”
“Yes, I understand.”
“You do? So is he really an apprentice of our Bamboo Stone Dojo…”
Lin Hongnian said, “Not yet, maybe later. By the way, since his Iron-eating Beast’s hardening has reached the expert level and he is also coincidentally at Mt. Tian Mang with you there… Guide him to the magnetic mountain area. Let him mainly train there, even if it’s to lay the foundation for him to learn dojo skills in advance.”
“Huh?” Yan Qi had yet to react.
Damn it, what was going on? He hadn’t even entered the sect, and he was already teaching the unique skills of the dojo? He was so jealous…
…
At the safe area.
Shi Yu finished his hot instant noodles and ate two ham sausages. Only then was he barely not hungry.
After preparing to rest for a while, he went straight to the magnetic mountain area to find the Electric Slime to play with.
As for the five Longthorn wild boars, there was finally no need to continue dragging them. It was fine to leave them here.
“Shi Yu.”
While Shi Yu was quietly resting in the corner of the straw shed, the security guard who was in charge of registering his points came over again.
“What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu opened his eyes and turned to look at him.
Yan Qi chuckled and said, “It’s nothing. Let’s get to know each other. I’m Yan Qi.”
“Are you still planning to continue hunting in the afternoon?”
Shi Yu nodded.
“Then I suggest going to your magnetic mountain area. There’s electric ore there. It’s considered a level-one energy iron ore resource, one of the recipes for iron-eating beasts.”
“Electric iron ore?” Shi Yu recalled. This did indeed seem to be a recommended food in the Iron-eating beast cultivation manual, but the recommendation priority was not very high.
Compared to the Iron Bamboo, it was not very useful for hardening skills and its own growth. At most, it could be said to just fill one’s belly.
“Come with me.”
Yan Qi called for Shi Yu and planned to talk in a relatively empty place.
“What does this person want?” Shi Yu was stunned. He followed and decided to see what this security guard was up to.
“I’m actually an apprentice of Bamboo Stone Dojo. My initial pet is also an Iron-eating Beast. By the way, do you know what the two great mysteries of Bamboo Stone Dojo are?”
After leaving the straw shed, Yan Qi said.
“I remember that it’s a skill called Thunder Palm and a skill called Cannon Fist, right?” Shi Yu recalled.
So this guy was an apprentice from Bamboo Stone Dojo… No wonder he was so interested in him and the Iron-eating Beast.
The Iron-eating Beasts taught by the Bamboo Stone Dojo were famous for their ability to control fire and lightning. Their unique skills were the Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist. Of course, Shi Yu knew this. After all, he still had to go to the dojo to learn later.
“Well, it’s the Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist. With special cultivation methods, there’s a chance that the Iron-eating Beast can awaken the ability to control fire and lightning.”
“For example, if you want to control lightning, one of the basics is for the Iron-eating Beast to eat some metal minerals with the nature of electricity, like electrical minerals.”
“Why are you telling me this?”
If a pet wanted to master skills other than species, it had to undergo targeted cultivation. Food was a very important part of it, and Shi Yu knew this.
However, just eating electric ore was definitely not enough. Otherwise, this would not have become the unique skill manual of the Bamboo Stone Dojo.
Even if the evolution method wasn’t as complicated as the Green Silkworm to the Goddess of Light Butterfly, it was impossible for only one food to be enough.
“I heard from Master Lin of Bamboo Stone Dojo that you might be going to the dojo to learn later, so I greeted you in advance.”
“The minimum requirement to eat an electric ore is for the Iron-eating Beast’s hardening to reach the expert level. Your Iron-eating Beast’s hardening has already reached the expert level. It definitely won’t be a problem to perfectly absorb the nutrition of the electric ore.”
“If you plan to enter Bamboo Stone Dojo to learn in the future, the most suitable training environment for you at Mt. Tian Mang is actually the magnetic mountain area. There are many electrical ores there, and many thunder-element creatures…”
“Eating electric ores and letting the body constantly receive lightning attacks is actually the basic training to master the Thunder Palm. I think you can come into contact with it in advance.”
Skill: Thunder Palm
Skill Level: Intermediate
< Introduction > It’s a thunder-type skill. It gathers high-intensity electricity in the palm, making the palm like a sharp blade with strong penetration power. It has a paralyzing effect.
Yan Qi said with a smile, but he sighed in his heart. This was because his Iron-eating Beast was already at the transcendent level and had yet to successfully master the Thunder Palm. It could only have a tiny electric current lingering around its palm, unable to form a skill at all.
If he could master the Thunder Palm, he would have long passed the vocation assessment.
The Thunder Palm alone was already powerful. If it was a combination skill of Hardening and Thunder Palm… That power was something Yan Qi looked forward to.
“Is that so, thank you.”
Shi Yu did not expect that before he even went to visit Bamboo Stone Dojo, there would already be apprentices from the dojo who knew him.
Was this the first lesson that Hall Master Lin had taught him?
Initially, he had planned to go to the magnetic mountain area to replicate the multiplication skill. Now, it seemed that there were other reasons why he had to go.
When it came to food… Shi Yu felt that the electric ores in the magnetic mountain area no longer needed to be exchanged for points. If Eleven’s combat and training intensity were too high, the ores would probably enter Eleven’s stomach for the next three days.

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - Electric Ore
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Electric Ore
Yan Qi didn’t chat with Shi Yu for too long. After all, he still had work to do next.
“Eleven, I’ll take you to eat good food.”
In the afternoon, Shi Yu called Eleven out of the Beast Taming Space.
Eleven was exhausted from the battle and travel in the morning. It had only slept and rested in the Beast Taming Space for a while before it was almost completely recovered. This was the power of the Beast Taming Space.
On Shi Yu’s side, he rested a little and was rather energetic.
With a new goal, Shi Yu didn’t want to delay any longer and planned to continue setting off with Eleven.
“Wuu—”
In the outside world, Eleven’s figure slowly appeared. When it heard the word ‘eat’, it subconsciously wiped its mouth with its arm.
…
Due to the skill index, Shi Yu’s physique should be relatively outstanding among Beast Tamers of the same level.
When he prepared to set off again, the other candidates, regardless of whether they arrived at the safe area first or later, were still resting.
When these people saw Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast leave the safe area, they looked at each other… Didn’t they just hunt five Longthorn wild boars in the morning?
He actually went to hunt again in the blink of an eye. Was his liver alright???
If Chen Kai were here, he would definitely say, “As expected of you guys, you’re simply our role models.”
In the magnetic mountain area.
This was actually a mountain covered by a special electromagnetic field. The special environment made many magnetic metals known as electric ore appear here.XZ
Electric ore was very dangerous. It would suddenly release electricity, but this kind of electricity was also a favorite snack for many thunder-element creatures.
The map in the booklet marked that the magnetic mountain area was one of the most dangerous areas of Mt. Tian Mang. There were tenth-level ferocious beasts living there.
Moreover, most of them were thunder-element ferocious beasts known for their skill, attack power and destructive power.
Apart from that, the special magnetic field here, although not very strong, was also not suitable for Beast Tamers with weak physiques to stay long.
If too much time passed, it might have a certain impact on the Beast Tamer’s liver and brain, causing the Beast Tamer to hallucinate.
However, despite the danger, Shi Yu still had to come. Compared to the ruins, this place was already very friendly, and it even produced food.
“That’s the electric ore?”
With a clear target, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others avoided some ferocious beasts to avoid wasting unnecessary physical strength. They only spent half an hour on the road before arriving at the edge of the magnetic mountain area.
At the border between the mountain and the ground, Eleven quickly discovered a special blue and white mineral. It howled and reminded Shi Yu.
The electric ore was a prismatic mineral, sandwiching between the ground and the magnetic mountain like a protruding rock. Electricity shot out from time to time. From the surrounding black scorch marks, the current strength didn’t seem to be low.
“In your hardened state, go break a piece to eat?” Shi Yu encouraged.
“Σ (° △ °lll) Well…”
To be honest, Eleven had never eaten electric ore before, just like how it had never eaten a Green Silkworm. Therefore, when it encountered such novel food, it would always doubt whether it could be eaten.
Foodies were also very particular. They didn’t eat everything.
If it ate something bad, it would affect his training.
“Don’t worry, it’s edible.”
The basic requirement for the Iron-eating Beast to eat a level-one thunder-element metal mineral resource was expert level hardening. Since Eleven was at that stage already, digestion would definitely be no problem.
“Wuu…”
When Eleven heard that, it reluctantly approached the electric ore carefully. It hardened its palm and pried with all its might.
Bang!
When the Electric Mine was pulled out, the lightning suddenly cracked, and the sound shocked Eleven, causing it to sit on the ground.
Shi Yu :”…”
How could it be so stupid? It was so fierce in battle, how could it explode from digging ore?
“Wuu!” Eleven also felt very embarrassed.
It hurriedly crawled up and picked up the fallen Electric Mineral again.
At this moment, the electric current stimulated Eleven’s entire body, making it feel numb. Its hair stood up, and it was very uncomfortable.
Whether it was before it ate the iron bamboo or before it ate the iron heart wood, Eleven could smell the fragrance of the food in advance.
However, this thing didn’t! Instead, it looked and felt very dangerous. Could it really be eaten?
Eleven turned around and handed it to Shi Yu. Maybe it would be better for the Beast Tamer to eat it first?
“It’s alright, eat it first. You don’t have to worry about your body getting injured. Your high-speed healing is already proficient, and the electrical burns in your body can also heal on their own.”
What Shi Yu said made sense.
He wanted the Iron-eating Beast to master proficient level hardening that allowed it to be fully armed before it ate the Electric Mine, so that the electric current wouldn’t hurt the fragile cells in the Iron-eating Beast’s body.
However, it was actually fine even if Eleven was injured.
The entry-level healing speed could heal external injuries. The proficient level healing speed could also heal the injuries in the body.
Therefore, there was no problem at all. Shi Yu was very relieved. Even with such a healing skill, Eleven could still eat a large amount of Electric Mineral in the short term. He did not have to worry about his body being burdened, and from that, he could awaken his thunder talent faster.
Expert level healing at a high speed… This was also why Shi Yu thought that Eleven could eat such big amounts of food in three days…
“Wuu—” Since the Beast Tamer had said so, Eleven showed a determined expression.
Crack!
It hardened its entire body and bit at the Electric Mineral in its mouth with its hardened teeth.
Crack! Crack!
Eleven tried hard to chew the electric ore. Under the pulsing current, it ate the electric ore like a candy.
After the chewing was completed, Eleven tried hard to swallow the Electric Mineral Fragment.
“Wu—”
As Eleven swallowed the electric ore, the electric current spreading in its body made it numb again. Then, Eleven was extremely shocked.
Although it couldn’t be said to be delicious, the numbing feeling after swallowing the Electric Mineral made it feel as if lightning had exploded in its body, making it feel very strange.
It didn’t reject this feeling. It even felt that it was as comfortable as during the special training. It seemed that it could really eat this?
“Burp ~” Eleven opened its mouth and spat out a weak electric arc. Then, it patted its stomach and looked at Shi Yu.
Anything else?
“Well… looks like there’s no problem. Then, let’s continue looking for more electric ore to eat,” Shi Yu said.
According to the description of the apprentice from the Bamboo Stone Dojo, after the Iron-eating Beast ate a large amount of electric ores, it would produce a certain amount of lightning affinity and accumulate a certain amount of lightning talent.
During this process, being struck by lightning more could also accelerate the development of thunder-element talent.
These were the basic conditions to master thunder-type skills.
In fact, Shi Yu was still very interested in thunder-element skills. If there were any fire ores or cold iron ores here, he definitely wouldn’t be so interested.
With the limited number of skills recorded in the skill index, compared to the Fire-Attribute Cannon Fist, he was more inclined to let the Iron-Eating Beast learn thunder-type skills.
The reason was very simple. Metal and thunder types were more compatible than metal and fire types.
For those powerful Beast Tamers, a single skill was only the foundation.
Only by combining different basic skills and forming a combination skill could one truly be considered to have entered the door of the pet taming industry.
Combination skills were very difficult for ordinary Beast Tamers because it tested the proficiency between different skills. If the proficiency was not high enough, the skills could not be perfectly combined and connected.
In a situation where the skill proficiency was really difficult to train, there were very few Beast Tamers who could have results that exceeded the original combination. It was basically something that only master-level Beast Tamers could do, but for Shi Yu, it might not be that difficult.
Because he could quickly increase his proficiency.
For example, he could upgrade Hardening to perfection. This skill could even form a long-range combination skill with thunder-type skills.
The perfect level symbol for Hardening Skill was flowing and superimposing. As for above that, the transcendent level symbol, it was releasing and applying. It was said that in the entire Icefield City, only one Iron-eating Beast had reached this level.
It meant that the Iron-eating Beast could use hardening substances to condense weapons that left its body, or stack a layer of hardening on other external items.
Shi Yu found this effect very interesting.
Therefore, Shi Yu was thinking about how violent it would be if Eleven condensed a metal cannonball in front of his palm after mastering Perfect Level Hardening and used the electromagnetic force to accelerate and throw it.
The Hardening skill at close range directly turned into a double-element high destructive long-range combination skill, Electromagnetic Cannon!
Metal and thunder types were the main cultivation routes for iron-eating beasts that Shi Yu had temporarily set.
Most pets only had one main attribute, and in order to form powerful combination skills, some powerful Beast Tamers liked to teach their pets skills with other attributes to assemble. The attributes of this secondary cultivation were usually called secondary attributes.
Shi Yu planned to focus on metal supplementary lightning. The main reason was that these two attributes were easier to form a combination skill. Compared to them, metal and fire elements weren’t that compatible.
“This is an Electric Scorpion?”
As they continued searching for the electric ore and Electric Slimes, Shi Yu and the others were the first to discover new electric ore. This time, the electric ores were not alone, but three or four combined.
However, unlike before, there was a ferocious beast guarding the side of the electric ore this time. The Electric Scorpion, which was the size of two forearms and had lightning patterns on its purple body, was absorbing the Electric Qi leaking from the Electric Mine.
[Name]: Electric Scorpion
[Attributes]: Thunder
[Race Level]: Low-level transcendent
[Race Skill]: Electric Thorn
Electric Scorpion can absorb lightning and store it in its body. Then, it will input poisonous electric currents into the enemy’s body with its tail thorn, killing the opponent.
Although its race was a low-level transcendent, on the same level as the green worm, it was much more threatening than the green worm.
“Zi!!”
At this moment, seeing other creatures approaching, the two Electric Scorpions, whose growth levels were around level five, seemed to be facing a great enemy.
But before they could react, they were held in Eleven’s hands. As for their electric spikes, they couldn’t penetrate Eleven’s hardening at all…
“Wuuuuu!!” Eleven’s arm shook like a windmill. It spun a few times and threw the Electric Scorpion far away.
Because the target was three level-ten Electric Slimes, Shi Yu simply ignored these minor characters.
After chasing away the competitors, Eleven started to dig these electric ores. Their goal… was to eat all the electric ores in the magnetic mountain area!
Since the registration fee had been paid, there was no need to save resources at all. Presumably, the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng wouldn’t really mind the disappearance of these Electricity Ores either…

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - Replication and Multiplication
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Replication and Multiplication
“What are these two guys doing?”
The magnetic mountain area was clearly also an area focused on by the staff.
In the monitoring room of the training base headquarters, as Shi Yu temporarily obtained first place in points through the five Longthorn wild boars, he also became the main focus of the five professional Beast Tamers.
On a whim, a professional Beast Tamer searched for Shi Yu’s figure on the surveillance cameras, but he really found him.
However, Shi Yu’s current behavior was really unfathomable.
On the screen, Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast were like bullies, charging into the territories of thunder-element ferocious beasts.
Then, the little Iron-Eating Beast defeated the thunder-element ferocious beast in a few moves. Then, a turning point came.
Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast did not have the slightest mentality of participating in the assessment. They directly threw the ferocious beasts far away, looking like they did not feel the value at the points they represented.
In addition, they had unearthed the Electricity ore that represented points, but they had no intention of exchanging points.
Instead, the iron-eating beast opened its mouth and eliminated them with a crack.
It was simply walking all the way and snatching all the way…
“Expert Level Hardening. There’s something wrong with this Iron-eating Beast.”
A professional Beast Tamer leaned over to look at the scene. He opened his mouth slightly and said, “Where did this monster newcomer come from?”
Real outstanding Beast Tamers and pets couldn’t be hidden. Shi Yu and the others could easily kill the ferocious beasts blocking the way because they relied on their expert level Hardening and proficient level super vision.
They were completely invincible.
The group of professional Beast Tamers naturally sensed Shi Yu and Eleven’s extraordinariness, and they spoke in shock.
“No wonder they could hunt five wild boars. When I was an apprentice, I was far inferior to them.”
“This candidate clearly can’t be bothered with these small points. His target is definitely a level-ten creature.”
“From the performance of this Iron-eating Beast in the image, fighting a level-ten creature is not a problem at all.”
“The level ten creatures in the magnetic mountain area… are those three Electric Slimes imported from outside, right??”
The person in charge of training, Zhou Wanshan, said, “It’s the slime. I wonder if they can handle it.”
“But even if they can’t deal with it, it won’t be a problem to retreat unscathed.”
Slimes were creatures with relatively slow movements. As long as they passed the high school physical test, they wouldn’t be caught up by the Slimes jumping around.
However, on the contrary, even if Shi Yu and his panda could defeat the Electric Slime, they would probably have to pay a price.
The main reason was that the Electric Slime’s Electric Release Skill was a thunder-element skill. Its penetration power was very strong according to its power. In addition, there was a four-level difference between the two, so even if it was expert level in Hardening, it might not necessarily be able to deal with it unscathed like dealing with low-level ferocious beasts.
Mt. Tian Mang, Magnetic Mountain, Electric Cave.
After eating a pile of electric ores, Eleven successfully imprinted the taste of the electric ores in his mind.
Then, with its sensitive sense of smell, they found this place.
“I’ve finally discovered the first Electric Slime.”
Outside the small cave, Shi Yu’s expression was excited. He had finally discovered an Electric Slime.
The Electric Slime was a blue-purple mud-like creature, very similar to an electric ore. Electric currents shot out from its body from time to time.
At this moment, it was in a shrunken state, lying in the middle of a pile of electric ores. It was not afraid of the electric current around it. Instead, it looked very comfortable.
After all, with their attributes and physiques, they could be immune to weak corresponding elemental powers. Lightning was nourishing to them, not harming.
“They found the Electric Slime.”
Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast finally arrived at the Electric Cave. The few professional Beast Tamers watched with interest.
Although this Iron-eating Beast looked agile and had astonishing strength, it clearly didn’t have long-range skills.
As long as he fought, he would definitely come into contact with the slime.
As for the slime, its entire body was wrapped in electricity. As long as one touched it, they would be hit by its discharge. It was very unsolvable.
Therefore, in their opinion, this battle might be quite interesting. It was a brilliant battle between evenly matched opponents.
In the Electric Cave, the Electric Slime sensed that an enemy was approaching. It immediately woke up from its meal and bounced out to look at Shi Yu and the others cautiously.
A huge battle was about to break out.
At this moment, an unexpected development occurred.
Shi Yu quickly opened his backpack and threw the high-pressure insulation rubber gloves he bought to Eleven. “Put it on, catch it, and squeeze out all the electricity in its body.”
“Wuu—!”
Eleven put on the insulation glove skillfully. Obviously, this was a battle strategy arranged in advance by Shi Yu and Eleven.
Right on the heels of that, under the stunned expressions of the professional Beast Tamers, the little Iron-Eating Beast wearing insulation gloves charged towards the Electric Slime.
At the same time, the Electric Slime’s entire body was filled with electricity as it bounced and hit Eleven under the discharge state.
Electricity was a low-level skill that could only release electricity through contact. Moreover, this skill’s control over electricity was not high, so it was very easy to crack.
Without a doubt, the power of the Slime was not very strong. What was strong was its electrical current strength.
However, before it reached the transcendent level, its thunder-element skill facing the high-pressure insulation rubber gloves was like a son meeting his father, immediately getting shut down.
Eleven caught it in its hand like it was picking up a baseball.
Crack…
The Electric Slime kept releasing electricity in mid-air, and at the same time, it was stunned.
Eleven, who was wearing an insulation glove to catch the slime, turned its head sideways and didn’t dare to look at the electric current shooting out of the slime’s body.
This is so scary. It doesn’t look like it can be eaten like an electric ore…
“Holy shit.” This development directly made the professional Beast Tamers in the control room widen their eyes.
What was going on?
It could even be done this way?
“The base store sells insulation gloves?”
“It does, right?”
“But before this, no Beast Tamer was so clear-headed as to put them on a pet to challenge thunder-element ferocious beasts… Usually, they wear it themselves?”
“It’s mainly because the power of the Electric Slime is all in its discharge and defense. Its other qualities are ordinary, and it happened to be countered by the insulation glove!”
“Who captured the slimes and set such a high number of points for them?”
The professional Beast Tamers were stunned. The level-10 creature slime with the highest points in the training was being controlled just like that?
Oh no, the other two Slimes were probably going to be killed by this strange Beast Tamer.
12,000 points was equivalent to a free gift?
“Don’t worry… It’s not that simple,” Zhou Wanshan said with a complicated expression.
…
“Yes, Eleven, pinch it and let it continue to discharge and release electricity…”
When Eleven and the Slime were “fighting”, Shi Yu was fanning the flames beside them.
Apart from releasing electricity, the strength of the Electric Slime’s body was trash. There was no possibility of it breaking free.
Its defense was strong, because the Slime’s soft mud-like body could withstand a huge impact. Even a hard punch might not be able to instantly kill it.
However, there was no need for Shi Yu and the others to waste their energy hitting it.
It could just pinch it with the insulation glove and wait for it to release all the electricity in its body.
This was called Tactics.
“Hu!!!”
The Electric Slime was very aggrieved and angry.
The current was released even more fiercely, but it still couldn’t affect the insulation glove.
In fact, facing a level ten Boss, it was really not that easy to cheat through the fight.
Even in this situation where it was restrained, the slime still had a chance to resist.
However, unless it was desperate, the Electric Slime was very unwilling to use this skill.
High-level skill, multiplication!
If it used this skill to multiply its size, its strength would increase, and the electric current in its body could be stimulated at a greater limit. But the side effect… would make it exhausted for a long time.
The purpose of the Slimes was to shrink and act cute if possible. Unless there were special circumstances, they would never multiply their size into giant, scary demon king slimes.
And now, the Electric Slime that had encountered a desperate situation clearly encountered a special situation.
“Wu!!!!”
It cried out in extreme anger and its size began to increase continuously. At this moment, no matter how strong Eleven was, it definitely couldn’t pinch it with its two hands and could only retreat.
Rip!!!
As the Electric Slime rapidly enlarged, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
I’m not afraid of you becoming bigger. This is what I’ve been waiting for.
“Eleven, harden your whole body,” Shi Yu immediately instructed.
During the Electric Slime’s transformation, Eleven’s entire body hardened.
In the next second, the Electric Slime, which had finally escaped its control, launched a counterattack and directly bumped into it with its electrifying body.
After enlarging to a huge Electric Slime with a diameter of 1.5 meters, the impact power and the current strength of the Slime were much higher than before.
Bang!!!
Eleven also slapped him. In an instant, neither side won.
The huge Electric Slime was sent flying by Eleven, but due to its soft physique, it did not suffer much damage.
Although Eleven was wearing an insulation glove, the current released by the huge slime was too much. After all, Eleven was only wearing gloves and not an insulation suit, so he couldn’t completely defend.
The other parts of his body were still accidentally invaded by the electric current. Even the hardening of the metal attribute couldn’t completely defend. The combination of multiplication and discharge had already begun to take shape.
“It’s reversed.”
“Although the energy consumption of the Electric Slime is huge, that Iron-eating Beast definitely won’t feel good either.”
“It’s probably a situation where both parties are injured.”
The professional Beast Tamers watched the show.
However, the reversal occurred again. Eleven finally used the skill of high-speed healing.
Although it couldn’t be seen from the outside, the place where Eleven’s body was paralyzed and burned by the electric current was immediately healed by a green wave of life.
“Wuuu, wuu, wuu, wuu!!!” After being cured, Eleven became braver the more he fought. Like a bear, it continued to charge at the huge Electric Slime.
This scene directly shattered the views of the professional Beast Tamers.
“Is Expert Level Hardening that strong? It can even defend against a huge discharge?”
“Or is that Iron-eating Beast’s willpower strong? It resisted the stimulation of the current and counterattacked forcefully?”
After all, Eleven had a history of eating electric ores as candy.
At this moment, the slime was stunned again because after that attack, it completely lost its energy.
When it was first captured, it wasted too much electricity, causing it to be unable to counterattack after multiplying…
“Capture it and continue to squeeze it dry.” Shi Yu’s evil command came from the side.
…
Meanwhile, outside the Electric Cave…
The Electric Slime, which had all its energy drained, dimmed significantly. There was really no electricity at all, and it returned to its normal size.
It was hugged by the excited and panting Eleven and fell asleep.
At this moment, Shi Yu began to approach with a smile. He touched the slime with his loving hand.
In the initial five skill sections of the skill index, upon contracting the first pet, Eleven, there were five new skill sections.
Next, the index was about to record the seventh skill, multiplication.
Discharge wasn’t worth it, however. The skill level was too low, so it was inferior to the Thunder Palm. Shi Yu chose to give up.
When he touched the slime, Shi Yu recalled the scene when he saw the multiplication skill. At the same time, he activated the skill index.
In the next moment, the seventh page of the stone illustrated handbook flipped open in Shi Yu’s mind.
The image of the thunder-element pet Electric Slime appeared.
Skill: Multiplication
[Skill Level]: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a special ability. It can shrink and expand the body. Under a shrunken state, the strength will decrease and the energy recovery speed will increase. Under the enlarged state, the energy consumption will increase and the strength will increase.
He had obtained the all-purpose skill!
Great!
When Shi Yu ravaged the level-ten creature Electric Slime in his hand like it was made of rubber, all the professional Beast Tamers in the control room fell silent.
Not only did he defeat it, but he even dared to personally destroy a level-ten creature? This was so scary for Beast Tamers and pets. Was this really a newbie intern??

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - Forget the Skill Index
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Forget the Skill Index
Next, the Electric Cave occupied by the Electric Slime was undoubtedly taken over by Shi Yu.
There were many electric ores here, enough for Eleven to feast on.
In addition, Shi Yu was not in a hurry to exchange this Electric Slime for points.
“I’ll give you two electrical ores every day as food, but no matter how much electricity you eat, you have to release it.”
Shi Yu communicated with the blurred Electric Slime telepathically.
This guy was a very good generator. The discharge skill could train Eleven’s lightning resistance and increase its thunder affinity.
It was roughly equivalent to lightning forging the body.
Ordinary pets definitely couldn’t go about it like this, but Eleven was an exception.
A trace of thunder-element talent and proficient level high-speed healing could recover the damage caused by the lightning stimulation at the fastest speed, allowing Eleven to train with lightning without restraint.
Electric Slime: I might not be human, but you’re really not.
Just like that, the drained Electric Slime directly became the second training tool after the Green Silkworm.
“Wuuu!”
After hearing the new training content from Shi Yu, the Little Iron Eating Beast danced around.
Eleven was still very interested in this new training method.
Eating electric ores and being electrocuted by a weakened version of the discharge skill seemed to be no worse than jumping off a building.
It was just that after training like this, Eleven’s hair became fluffy, causing it to look fat.
“This…”
In the safe area, Little Bear Yan Qi, who had told Shi Yu that he could come to the magnetic mountain to train, fell into deep thought.
He looked at the Iron-eating Beast carrying the Electric Slime running in the image with a question mark on his head.
Although he had told Shi Yu that allowing the Iron-eating Beasts to undergo the lightning baptism after eating the electric ore could also increase their thunder-element talent…
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to directly take down the Electric Slime as a tool pet.
His telepathy talent was so overpowered…
Shi Yu’s even more inhumane actions didn’t stop there. Using the insulation glove, they quickly found another companion for the first slime.
The Electric Slime resting in another Electric Cave in the Magnetic Mountain was also captured by Shi Yu and the others.
The next day, the third Slime couldn’t escape either. It was captured by Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast.
In the end, the situation clearly evolved into the three Slimes helping Eleven train.
The three exhausted Electric Slimes were surrounded by Shi Yu in a triangle, with Eleven in the middle.
Shi Yu provided an electric ore. The Slime that absorbed a little energy had to release some electricity and let the little Beast in the middle train its body.
Although the Slimes were unwilling, they could only surrender due to the power of Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast.
It couldn’t be helped. Shi Yu’s control was too good. He definitely didn’t give the Slimes too much food. He had been keeping their battle power at the level of electric rubber, causing them to be unable to resist at all.
Regarding controlling food, because of Shi Yu’s rich experience with the green worm, the Electric Slimes were simply miserable.
Just like that, Shi Yu and the others only stayed in the magnetic mountain for a day before reaping the harvest from the large amount of Electric Ores and the slime’s discharge forging.
29th, noon.
At this moment, after a day, Shi Yu and the others had already gotten all the ores that were easier to find in the magnetic mountain area.
Eleven ate crazily while undergoing lightning training… Then, something went wrong.
“Wuuu!”
After being electrocuted once, the fluffy Eleven stretched out its palm.
In the next second, a blue and white electric current shot out of its palm and entangled crazily!
Intermediate-level skill, Thunder Palm!
“Holy shit.”
This change made Shi Yu, who was resting beside him, nearly fall.
What was going on?
Eleven… comprehended the Thunder Palm on its own???
Shi Yu hurriedly put the three Slimes in the Worm Silk Sack and returned to the previous safe area.
He found Yan Qi to register again and called out Eleven.
“Mr. Yan Qi, is the Thunder Palm you’re talking about referring to this?”
Bzzt.
The Little Iron Eating Beast stretched out its palm with an extremely serious expression. A second later, more than ten blue and white electric arcs shot out of its palm.
Amazing. There was no need for the skill index.
“Wuu.” This time, it had successfully learned a new skill without Shi Yu’s addition!
“Holy shit.”
Yan Qi exploded on the spot.
“How is that possible?”
“This doesn’t make sense.”
He looked at Eleven, the iron-eating beast cub that could already be filled with electricity, dumbfounded, and fell into deep thought about life.
“It’s only been a day. How can your Iron-eating Beast awaken its thunder talent so quickly?”
At the moment, his own Iron-eating Beast’s control over lightning seemed to be even inferior to this little Iron-eating Beast!
This was ridiculous. In general theory, it was impossible to awaken lightning talent so easily with just the electric ore and Electric Shock.
Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so few Iron-eating Beasts who mastered the Thunder Palm in the Bamboo Stone Martial Arts Hall…
He should still need the support of other steps. Why did Shi Yu and the others rely on simple materials to complete all the training in a day?
“Perhaps we worked very hard?” Shi Yu pretended to be in deep thought.
Yan Qi was suddenly speechless. Because every time he noticed Shi Yu and this iron-eating beast, they were definitely fighting, training, and eating!
It was rare to see them rest. They only rested for a while before quickly moving again.
He wasn’t afraid that he had seen a fake Iron-eating Beast. Are you sure that this was an Iron-eating Beast and not a hyperactive husky?
“It still doesn’t make sense…” Yan Qi looked at the little Iron-eating Beast. Even so, this talent was too strange.
“So this is the Lightning Palm, right?” Shi Yu chuckled. It was indeed unscientific.
However, he should know what was going on. Perhaps it was because of the high-speed healing.
The high-speed healing of wood-type skills was a form of use of one’s life force, representing growth.
In the system of the five elements and eight trigrams, lightning was also connected with wood. The damage caused by lightning forging the body was healed by wood-element skills. Not only did it increase the efficiency of training, but there was also probably some magical reaction between the two, which accelerated Eleven’s mastery process.
This didn’t make sense, but it was very surreal.
“I…” Yan Qi still doubted life.” Although its power seems a little weak, it’s indeed the Thunder Palm…”
“Well, the strength isn’t enough. At most, it touched the entry criteria. When the palm can withstand high-intensity electric currents and let the condensed lightning have a strong numbing penetrating effect, that’s when the Thunder Palm’s true power is.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded, feeling happy.
This came without any effort. He originally thought that he would have to go to the dojo to replicate it before Eleven could master the Thunder Palm, but Eleven actually learned it himself. It was a complete surprise for Shi Yu.
From the looks of it, there seemed to be a certain connection between the different skills.
After learning one skill, learning another skill would be much easier.
For example, the Thunder Palm could actually be seen as a high-level skill for discharge. Since it could even use the Thunder Palm, it was actually equivalent to being able to use discharge as well.
However, although Eleven had learned it on its own, Shi Yu still decided to record the Thunder Palm in the index later.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, the skill proficiency function of the index was also very important. When a mid-level skill was maxed out, the effect was not necessarily worse than a super-level skill.
“Then can I trouble Mr. Yan Qi to help me register the Slime’s points?”
“Are you still going to the magnetic mountain area next?”
“No, there aren’t many electric ores over there anymore.”
Yan Qi :”…”
Beast!!!
The accumulated points of the electric ores were probably more than the three Slimes. These guys ate it all?
After Shi Yu left, Yan Qi still couldn’t calm down. He stiffly called Master Lin of Bamboo Stone Dojo.
“Yan Qi? What’s wrong?” Lin Hongnian’s master said.
“Master Lin, that Shi Yu indeed went to the Magnetic Mountain to train as I said.”
“Oh? How’s the effect?”
“The effect was very good. His Iron-eating Beast ate all the electric ores in the mountain. Then, they captured three Electric Slimes to assist in training. Now, it has successfully mastered the Thunder Palm.”
Lin Hongnian was speechless.
What was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - End of the Training
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: End of the Training
After Eleven mastered the Thunder Palm, Shi Yu felt that it was time to change places to train.
Although he could continue to look for electric ores to strengthen the thunder-type skills Eleven had just learned in the magnetic mountain, it was not very meaningful.
Electric ore was only a level-one resource, not very expensive and rare. Its value was not much different from iron bamboo. When he returned, it was better to purchase or buy higher-level resources in bulk.
The more exposed electric ores in the Magnetic Mountain area, such as the three Electric Caves, had basically been searched by them. The remaining were hidden and difficult to find. If they searched again, the efficiency wouldn’t be very high.
It was better to take advantage of the remaining time to earn some other resources.
“Eleven, let’s help the green worm find some nutritious food.”
After thinking about it, Shi Yu said to Eleven, “The Green Silkworm has followed them for so long, but it seems like it hasn’t eaten anything decent.”
The Green Silkworm had also helped a lot these two days. Even if it didn’t contribute much, it had worked hard. It was time to reward it.
“Yes!!!”
Eleven nodded indifferently. Of course, of course!
Every day, Buggy looked like he was about to die after training. Eleven was really afraid of losing this little partner.
“Ji ji!!!” The green worm in the backpack cried.
Generally speaking, the evolution materials that were prepared for the Green Silkworm were only used when it was approaching cocoon transformation at level nine or ten.
At other stages of growth, the value of using rare materials was not very high. After all, only at the cocoon transformation stage, with the nourishment of the cocoon, would the Green Silkworm have a high chance of comprehending new racial skills.
In other stages, it seemed that only the worm silk was worth strengthening.
At this moment, Shi Yu also started to consider what direction he should nurture the Green Silkworm in.
It was very important to determine the direction of a pet in order to train it.
For example, Eleven and Shi Yu were cultivated according to the standard battle pet template. It was fine as long as they were good at fighting and were all-rounded.
As for the Green Silkworm, Shi Yu did not want it to be like a traditional battle pet. After all, he had the skill index, so it was relatively easy for him to DIY it.
It was better to choose some rare and more practical evolution directions.
Healing butterfly?
This way, it might be able to learn a skill that could help him, a Beast Tamer, recover his physical strength and energy in the future, and use it with the skill index.
Support butterfly?
For example, the Goddess of Light Butterfly, which had light control and illusion abilities, was a very good personal bodyguard of the Beast Tamer. Its abilities were very widely used.
Or… nurture it in the direction of mythology?
Traditional Mythical creatures, such as dragons and phoenixes, were all naturally noble races.
For example, the first Ice Phoenix Moth in the country to master the evolution of a transcendent-level worm silk that Lu Qingyi mentioned was an evolution completed after integrating the Ice Phoenix bloodline during the evolution process.
It was also because it possessed the Mythical Bloodline that this Green silkworm could directly become an honorable monarch-level race from the lowest position in the pet world.
Also… if the compatibility was enough, he could choose some rare attributes.
For example, space and time!
If he had a pet that could master Instant Transmission, its escape skills would be considered full. It would basically be fearless if it encountered danger.
Moreover, these rare attributes might not be weak in other aspects.
With this concept, Shi Yu realized that there were simply too many evolution paths for the Green Silkworm. It was so dazzling that he had no choice.
“The key is still skills and materials!”
“It’s not that easy to obtain rare skills and materials. For example, where can I find the evolution materials used by the Ice Phoenix Moth? I guess I can only use Bureau 11’s channels.”
“Forget it, it’s too early to think so much. I’ll see what materials I can find first.”
“At the moment, the most important thing is to nurture the worm silk to the highest level!”
Shi Yu flipped through the booklet and found a spiritual plant that was very suitable for the Green Silkworm as food.
Dragon Whiskers Grass.
A level-one spiritual plant was named after its beard that looked like an Eastern dragon.
It was the favorite food of pets who had mastered silk skills. It could effectively increase the tenacity and sharpness of the worm silk.
“This is it.”
During the search for the Dragon Whiskers Grass, he brought Eleven along to challenge powerful ferocious beasts. The next day would be used for this.
Collecting Dragon Whiskers Grass was actually much easier because the spider-type ferocious beasts around the Dragon Whiskers Grass were basically not that powerful.
The most powerful one was a level ten awakened ferocious beast, the Ghost-Faced Wolf Spider. It was worth 4,000 points.
But in the end, it was still killed by Eleven.
Although the battle process was a little more difficult than fighting an Electric Slime, it did prove that Eleven’s current battle power was stronger than these untrained wild level ten ferocious beasts.
The reason was very simple. Even if these wild creatures grew at a higher level, their skill proficiency was too low. They basically relied on instinct. Very few creatures would train independently.
For example, that slime. Be it its discharge or multiplication skills, they were both initial-level.
The race skill of the more difficult Ghost-Faced Wolf Spider that Shi Yu encountered later was only at the proficient level, so when it faced Eleven, who had multiple proficient and even expert level skills, the difference in level was not that obvious.
In fact, Shi Yu hoped that the nearby spider-type ferocious beasts were more powerful. It would be best if he could master a premonition danger skill like spider sense… Then, he would be very happy.
Shi Yu wanted Eleven to use the Haki of the famous comic One Piece on Earth. Now that he had Armament Haki Hardening and Conqueror’s Haki, he was just short of Observation Haki.
But so be it. Since it had super vision, it could pretend to make do with it.
A proficient level super vision could allow Eleven to have extremely strong dynamic vision. It was already very impressive that he could clearly lock onto his target like a fog in various extreme environments.
In the future, when he reached the expert and perfect level, according to the information Shi Yu found on his cell phone, he could even have a 360-degree perspective and see the effect of the energy flow.
As for the transcendent level… he wasn’t sure, but the effect would definitely be stronger. When the time came, with perfect super vision as a reconnaissance skill, the effect wouldn’t be too bad.
In short, the green worm was very happy on this last day. It felt that its trip this time was not in vain. This Dragon Whiskers Grass was much more delicious than Shi Yu’s leftovers.
In less than three days, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the Green Silkworm had different gains.
Shi Yu obtained the multiplication skill. Eleven learned Thunder Palm on its own, and the Green Silkworm had an extra meal… It was obvious who was the one who profited the most.
In the blink of an eye, the three-day training event at Mt. Tian Mang was about to end.
In the training base.
The five professional Beast Tamers carefully looked at the final points displayed on the big screen.
First place, Shi Yu, 20,000 points.
Apart from the four level-10 creatures and five Longthorn wild boars, Shi Yu also collected some resources on the way and handed them in, gathering 20,000 points.
“He’s indeed in first place.”
“Although hunting the Slimes was a cheap trick, hunting the Ghost-Faced Wolf Spiders alone later undoubtedly proved their true strength.”
The one in-charge, Zhou Wanshan, listened to the evaluations of his surrounding teammates and silently looked at Shi Yu’s information.
“The average level of the pets of the Beast Tamers in charge of this training base is low. None of the Beast Tamers have reached level ten.”
“Level ten is the strongest ferocious beast in Mt. Tian Mang at the moment. It’s indeed very impressive for him to be able to control a level-six Iron-eating Beast to defeat four level ten ferocious beasts. He deserves to be first.”
“It’s rare to see such a Beast Tamer who can fight above his level in Ping Cheng… I wonder how his performance in the ruins will be next.”
With Shi Yu’s current results, he had undoubtedly obtained the qualifications to enter the ruins!
…
“It’s over!!”
“It’s finally freaking over. I ate tree fruits for two whole days. I vomited.”
“I want to shower, I want to shower. I’m going to die if I can’t shower anymore!”
“Am I that popular with the mosquitoes? I’ve gotten 49 bites in less than three days.”
After the training base announced the end of the assessment through the mechanical bird, the Beast Trainers on Mt. Tian Mang went down the mountain and complained.
As for Shi Yu, he looked at the sky with a calm expression as he walked. It had been tough on him this time. Maybe he should take out a portion of the 10,000,000 yuan to reward himself? It was time to buy some high-end supplements.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - Purchasing Supplement
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Purchasing Supplement
At the training base of Mt. Tian Mang was a huge field. On the huge field, miserable Beast Tamers stood.
In the beginning, a total of 100 people entered Mt. Tian Mang, and now only 73 were left standing here.
As expected, the 27 who were missing withdrew midway.
Perhaps it was because they couldn’t tolerate the wild environment, or because they were injured during the training process and had no choice but to stop the assessment.
“The fact that you can still stand here means that you still have some qualifications. Mt. Tian Mang is just an artificial training environment. If you can’t even stand here, don’t talk about exploring ruins, let alone participating in the vocation assessment in the future. It’s better to go home and raise pets obediently!”
The person in charge of the training, Zhou Wanshan, stood on the platform and said impolitely.
Below, the Beast Tamers were silent. This guy was the boss here, so they let him say whatever he wanted.
However, compared to this nonsense, these candidates wanted to know what rank they could get in the assessment this time.
Although they could roughly calculate their points during the training process, they didn’t know anyone else’s at all, so the ranking was a mystery.
“Alright, if you want to know your specific points ranking, you can look at it yourselves. The results have been pasted on that wall.”
“Among them, the top 20 can obtain the qualifications to explore the ruins. A week later, I’ll lead you into the ruins for the first time in a week. Be mindful of the association’s notification regarding the specific situation.”
“This assessment is over. You can leave after exchanging your points.”
After a simple announcement, the person in charge of the training base, Zhou Wanshan, turned and left, leaving behind the noisy crowd.
Unsurprisingly, everyone rushed to the wall beside the platform.
Ten copies of the same score list were printed in the training base. They were spread out on the wall and could be clearly seen by everyone.
In the crowd, Shi Yu went over with the main group and looked down directly.
This feeling… How should he put it? It made him feel like he was returning to high school in a dream. Every time he finished his monthly exam, he would be surrounded by his classmates to look at his grades.
“First place, Shi Yu, 20,000 points? Who’s Shi Yu?”
“No… It’s not our school.”
“Not from our school either.”
Most of the Beast Tamers present were still students. After all, the average level was not high.
The older batch of Beast Trainers with average pets at level ten were all assigned to another training base.
At this moment, the candidates at the scene started discussing among themselves.
As for Shi Yu himself, he turned around and left the moment he saw his name, hiding his merits and reputation.
The first place in the assessment was nothing much.
It was better to quickly exchange points for real money to heal his bank account…
Although that was the case, he was still betrayed.
“Holy shit, Shi Yu.”
In the crowd, Chen Kai, the top student, looked at the name in the first place of the points and had a special feeling.
Although he knew that Shi Yu was very strong, he still felt a faint sadness when he saw that Shi Yu had taken first place.
20,000 points was equivalent to five awakening level ten ferocious beasts…
He looked at his ranking again. Why did he feel that after working hard for a week, he was getting further and further away from Shi Yu?
Was he not working hard enough?
“You know this person??”
After Chen Kai exclaimed, his classmates asked one after another.
“Who is this person?”
“Uh, a Beast Tamer from a key school in the city. I bought the Refreshing Capsule under his suggestion to train my pets. As expected, he’s still impressive.”
Chen Kai’s classmate was stunned. No wonder Chen Kai’s Ice-Armored Beast had broken through again and its strength had improved at lightning speed. It turned out that it had received guidance from an expert.
Was it the capsule that Chen Kai often ate during his training?
They took note of it and looked into it immediately when they returned.
…
Then, Shi Yu ran to exchange points.
He encountered someone familiar.
Yan Qi looked at Shi Yu with a smile and said, “I’ll help you exchange it.”
“By the way, I’ve told Master Lin about your Iron-eating Beast mastering the Thunder Palm.”
“Oh? What did Hall Master Lin say?”
Yan Qi chuckled in his heart. What else could he say… Yan Qi could even guess Hall Master Lin’s doubtful expression.
This apprentice might not be teachable anymore!
“Master Lin asked you to make a trip to the dojo when you’re free. There are some special nutritional supplements, food, and insights on Thunder Palm. He’s planning to give them to you.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
This Lin Hongnian, head of the dojo, was probably that panda senior’s father. He didn’t know if this man had any other high-level skills other than the Thunder Palm… After all, he was one of the most powerful Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng. He should have some heritage.
After exchanging the points, Shi Yu went home directly.
He missed home, the soft bed, the hot shower, and normal food.
In short, the wilderness was really not a place for humans to stay.
“When I have money in the future, I must form a Mechanical Life Contract and become a Mechanic.”
“I want those that are like Transformers. They can turn into Gundams, planes, cars, and people, and houses.”
In this way, when he went to the wilderness in the future, it seemed that he would be able to live a modern life?
After returning home, Shi Yu stretched before lying down.
He turned around, picked up his cell phone, and logged on to the website that that person had given him.
The other party said that if he wanted to buy resources, he could just buy them from this website. There seemed to be a discount and they were delivered to his door. It was just nice, it saved him the trouble of going out to buy them.
“If I’m bringing this candidate to the ruins in a week… Isn’t the scheduling a little tight?”
Shi Yu wanted to develop steadily first… But his suicidal spirit seemed to be restless again.
Damn… I can’t control myself… I want to go take a look.
“Forget it. I heard from Lu Qingyi that this ruin isn’t dangerous. It’s a training-type ruin. I’ll just take a look and not court death. It’s not a big problem.”
“But no matter what, I should squander my resources first.”
After all, he was also a rich man now. As long as he didn’t buy high-level evolution materials for the Green Silkworm, he could squander for a long time and buy many things…
As expected, for the happiness of the whole family, it was better for the green worm to explore the evolution path on its own.
If it went smoothly, perhaps he could find suitable evolution materials in the ruins?
All of this was reasonable investment.
Shi Yu was not searching for resources for pets, but for Beast Tamers. Those supplementary resources that could allow Beast Tamers to fight for ten days and ten nights without any worries.
It was still alright at the Beast Tamer stage. Some Beast Tamers with enhanced talent still couldn’t use their talent in combat and could only use it for training.
However, after leaving the initial level, the advantages of those Beast Tamers who had mastered enhanced battle-type talents became apparent.
One Beast Tamer with a special telepathy talent, compared to a Beast Tamer with an enhancement talent… As the levels of both parties increased, the latter would only widen the gap between the former in terms of actual combat.
However, in contrast, after a battle, the energy consumption of a Beast Tamer with the battle enchantment talent would definitely be greater.
These supplements were prepared for them.
“Uh…”
Unlike medicine synthesized with a certain component of low-level materials like the Refreshing Capsule, most of the resources sold on this special website were purely natural.
Of course, the price was even more expensive, but Shi Yu felt that it didn’t matter if it was expensive. As long as it was effective.
Plant-type transcendent creature ginseng baby’s whiskers?
Centaurea Queen Bee’s Honey?
The frog oil of the Dragon Swallowing Frog?
The divine beans produced by the mystic realm of the divine tree. It could restore the Beast Tamer’s physical strength and energy in the shortest time possible under the Beast Tamer’s extreme fatigue state… And adjust his body to its optimal state?
Why did it look so familiar? The strange but extremely familiar supplements had increased.
“This divine bean is not bad, but the lowest quality is still 100,000 yuan per bean. It’s a little expensive… But I can buy one to see its effect. With this, I might be able to try teaching high-level skills. Multiplication, Absolute Sleep, Deterrence… I can arrange for one first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - The First Advanced Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: The First Advanced Skill
As he did not know the exact effect of each supplement, Shi Yu did not dare to buy too much at once.
After careful selection, he chose three supplements and bought some each.
Five ginseng baby whiskers were worth 250,000 yuan (minimum five units per purchase).
A small bottle of Centaurea Queen Bee’s Honey was worth 300,000 yuan.
Five divine beans that probably wouldn’t fill his belly were worth 500,000 yuan (minimum five units per purchase).
He spent 1,050,000 yuan in one go… Including the discount, nearly one tenth of the initial 10 million yuan was gone.
Shi Yu felt the pinch. How could he squander like this?
