However, when he thought that he might be able to teach Eleven all the high-level skills with these supplements and max out the proficiency of a few skills, he gave in.
Money was meant to be spent!
Moreover, using this million yuan to buy food and nutritional supplements for Eleven might not necessarily be as useful as buying supplements for himself.
“This is still the cheapest batch of supplements…”
Shi Yu sighed. After placing the order, he fell asleep again.
When he woke up, it was already night.
At night, if he stayed up late to meditate and play with his cell phone, it might affect his state during the day.
Shi Yu decided to continue sleeping, but the problem was that after sleeping for a while, he wasn’t that tired anymore.
Therefore, after preparing dinner for the two pets, Shi Yu could only teach the worm silk skill to the Green Silkworm in the birdcage in the courtyard.
After his stamina fell, sleepiness returned.
This skill index seemed to have the ability to treat insomnia. Not bad.
The next day, the sun was shining brightly.
Shi Yu woke up feeling refreshed. Today, he had planned to go to Bamboo Stone Dojo to take a look, but a cell phone message made him change his mind.
The supplements he bought yesterday were already in the midst of distribution and had arrived at Icefield City. They could reach today.
“How efficient…”
“In that case, I’ll just wait at home today.”
In the morning, Eleven was pondering about the Thunder Palm in the courtyard. The Green Silkworm continued to sleep, while Shi Yu was meditating.
About noon when Yu was about to go prepare lunch, there was a knock on their door.
“There’s a delivery for you.”
“Coming.”
As he had experienced being given warmth by the community the last time, Shi Yu hurriedly replied, afraid that his house would be destroyed again.
He opened the door and saw a young man in a blue delivery suit. Beside him was a two-meter-tall, weaponized giant bird.
The giant bird had strong muscles, gorgeous golden-brown feathers, and sharp eyes. However, although it looked domineering, it was only doing the work of a tool pet for the time being. A huge delivery box was hanging on it.
[Name]: Wings of Wind
[Attributes]: Wind
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Wind Wings, Ripping Claw, Super Sight, Wind Blade
The young man took out the box containing the supplements from the delivery box hanging on the Wings of the Sky and handed it to Shi Yu.
“Please sign here.”
Shi Yu :”…”
They actually used transcendent-level creatures to deliver packages.
The Wings of Wind was the bird pet with the highest overall strength among transcendent-level creatures.
“Little Brother, you’re a professional Beast Tamer?”
When Shi Yu signed it, he asked casually.
“Yes, I just joined this year. If there’s anything I’m not doing well, please inform me,” the young man said.
After Shi Yu received the goods, he felt extremely stifled.
In this day and age, even the threshold of the delivery industry was so high. Though… the salary must be very high. After all, the resources assigned to that website were all high-end goods.
After signing the letter, Shi Yu handed it over.
The delivery man took the delivery order and looked at Shi Yu.
This little guest… was a Beast Tamer intern, right?
Speaking of which, why did he buy so many high-level supplements… Even as a professional, he himself didn’t need so many.
He decided to forget it.
“Good luck. Have a good day.”
“Thank you.”
After the delivery boy and Shi Yu thanked each other, the bill was completed.
Then, in the courtyard, Shi Yu began to take out tonics one by one. He was very careful, afraid that it would break.
He first took out a bottle with five green beans. After looking at the accompanying manual, Shi Yu called Eleven over.
“Eleven, come here.”
“Huh?”
Eleven, who was playing Electric in the courtyard, ran over.
At this moment, with higher-level supplements, Shi Yu’s heart surged.
Skill: Multiplication
Skill Level: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a special ability. It can shrink and expand the body. Under a shrunken state, the strength will decrease and the energy recovery speed will increase. Under the enlarged state, the energy consumption will increase and the strength will increase.
Status: Can be taught
Shi Yu planned to teach eleven the multiplication skill first.
As for why it wasn’t the deterrence skill that allowed Eleven to have the aptitude of a king, or even the absolute sleep that could increase the efficiency of his and Eleven’s training, it was very simple… Because the multiplication skill was more interesting!
In any case, with so many supplements, there were still only three high-level skills in total. It was the same whether he taught them early or late. Shi Yu first chose the multiplication skill that he found relatively interesting.
In the enlarged state, Eleven could increase his battle power. In the shrunken state, he could accelerate the recovery of his physical fitness. Learning this skill first was not a loss.
Shi Yu took out a divine bean and placed it in his mouth.
“Skill Index!”
As Shi Yu chose to teach, his right hand suffused with a white halo again.
At this moment, Eleven was stunned to see this familiar scene.
It panicked.
This Beast Tamer… was he going to make it reap the benefits without working for them again?
“Wuu!”
He had just learned the Thunder Palm on his own, and the Beast Tamer was going to use cheats to invade its mind again… This wasn’t good…
Eleven stretched out its head. Since it couldn’t resist, it chose to enjoy it.
He would double his efforts later.
Just like that, the white light that represented the multiplication of skill experience flowed into Eleven’s body, and Shi Yu’s legs started to soften.
Cooldown Time: 168 hours
The levelless worm silk skill was about eight hours.
Low-level skills were about 24 hours.
The intermediate skills were about 48 hours.
Shi Yu originally thought that the high-level skill was 72 hours, but in the end… it was more than doubled.
In his extremely weak state, Shi Yu felt that he was about to die. He hurriedly swallowed the divine bean.
In the next second, energy began to flow in Shi Yu’s body.
Just as the introduction said, in an extremely short period of time, the divine bean erupted with immense nutrition and began to nourish Shi Yu’s body.
One second, two seconds, three seconds… Shi Yu’s body suddenly surged with power.
[Cooldown Time]: 48 hours.
Although it didn’t completely allow Shi Yu to recover, the consumption was reduced to an acceptable range.
In an instant, Shi Yu felt as if he had not just taught a high-level skill, but just an intermediate-level skill.
Judging by his experience with getting weak after teaching a skill, Shi Yu felt that he could do it again.
It looked like… advanced skills were the current limit of his teaching. Before his physique improved by a lot, even if he had stronger supplements, he definitely couldn’t touch super skills…
“This is killing me…”
Shi Yu let out a long sigh and ignored the dirt on the ground. He sat down on the spot and looked at Eleven.
At this moment, Eleven was closing its eyes and digesting the experience from the advanced level multiplication skill.
Shi Yu stared at it for nearly a minute before Eleven returned to its senses.
“You’ve mastered it?” Shi Yu asked.
Eleven nodded hard.
“Then let’s see how big you can get.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the round Eleven nodded seriously and used the multiplication skill with a serious gaze.
In the next second…
Buzz!
Ripples seemed to spread out from Eleven’s body. Accompanied by the ripples, its body began to tremble slightly. Then, as the transparent ripples vibrated, its body began to expand in circles!
Buzz!
Buzz!
It didn’t suddenly become bigger, but its body gradually enlarged in proportion. Its limbs, torso, head, and hair were all changing at this moment!
“Wuu!!!”
A moment later, a round Eleven that was still no different from before but had doubled in height and size appeared in front of Shi Yu.
At this moment, Eleven slowly waved its arm, but it still wasn’t used to it. It felt that the energy in its body was being consumed rapidly, but at the same time, its strength seemed to have increased by more than just a little.
It was probably the difference in strength between a young panda and an adult panda in reality.
In this state, Eleven felt that if it encountered those long-spined wild boars again, it could send them flying more than ten meters with a slap!
Eleven’s eyes were filled with battle intent.
“Gulp…”
However, there was no battle intent in his stomach.
Eleven:… @ _ @ | | | |
In less than ten seconds, Eleven started to feel dizzy. After all, it had consumed a lot of its physical strength just now.
“Alright, alright, quickly shrink and show me.”
It was called multiplication. There was the option of double and triple… Naturally, there was also one-fifth, one-fourth… That was the so-called shrinking state.
As a Beast Tamer, Shi Yu hurriedly made it shrink and recover its strength after sensing the power of the transformation.
In the next second, Eleven looked like it was leaking air. It first quickly circled and shrunk to the size of an ordinary person, which was about a meter tall.
Then, it continued shrinking. Soon, it shrank into a real round ball half a meter tall, round, and short.
In this state, it was closer to how it looked when it was eleven years old. It looked harmless, and its big eyes revealed innocence.
“Sob.” Eleven touched its stomach and let out an aggrieved cry.
It had become smaller, but it was still hungry.
“Cough, looks like for the initial level multiplication, doubling in volume and shrinking to half, is already the limit.”
It was still lacking some proficiency compared to the Ultraman-sized huge Iron-eating Beast in Shi Yu’s mind, as well as the mini Iron-eating Beast that could stand on his shoulder.
But it was also very good. After all, he had just learned it.
“Alright, let’s eat.” Shi Yu was in a good mood as he looked at the little iron-eating beast.
“Let’s have you eat like this in the future. I think we can save a lot of food expenses,” he joked.
Eleven: (ε ε ε ε?)?! What!!

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - Always Making Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Always Making Money
Shi Yu was very pleased that Eleven had finally learned the first high-level skill.
Although it was still far from the legendary surmounting skill with the ability to move mountains and drain seas, or the divine skill that could change the world that was recorded in myths and legends… It was still a huge improvement.
However, looking at the “cooldown time: 48 hours”, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He didn’t prepare lunch for Eleven and the others immediately. Instead, he picked up the bottle with the divine beans.
One divine bean canceled out the 120-hour weak period. If another one came, could it immediately revive him to full health and even make things better than before?
The manual said that… the divine beans could be eaten in a large amount in a weakened state until the user recovered to their perfect state.
He bought the lowest-grade divine beans, so he didn’t have to worry about overdosing on this. Therefore, eating two or three in one go shouldn’t be a problem.
Amazing!
This was a joy that couldn’t be enjoyed with the Refreshing Capsule, which was a synthetic medicine.
However, Shi Yu, who was about to eat a second divine bean, quickly hesitated.
The effect of the divine bean was clearly greater than the 48-hour weak period. Wouldn’t it be a loss to directly eat it?
The manual didn’t say if he could split half of it and eat it. If he ate it like this, he would waste tens of thousands of yuan.
“The price of a divine bean is 100,000 yuan per grain.”
“Baby Ginseng’s whiskers are 50,000 yuan each.”
“So, maybe I can use another supplement next.”
“No, even the roots of a ginseng baby aren’t safe.”
Shi Yu took out the Centaurea Queen Bee’s Honey and placed it in a small bottle.
Although the Queen Bee had the word Queen, it wasn’t a monarch-level creature. It was just a commander-level creature.
This kind of creature grew by absorbing the nectar of different strange flowers.
There were also many other titles such as royal honey jelly and king bee jelly. They were supplements even in his previous life.
As for this world, the nourishing effect was even greater.
Shi Yu found his red date cup, poured out the contents, and poured in the supplement.
Although this small bottle of honey was worth 300,000 yuan, it could be used multiple times. It would be fine after warm water was poured into the inner pocket.
Therefore, theoretically speaking, using this supplement first was the best way to control the amount and strive to not waste anything.
Shi Yu soaked a third of the honey in a large cup.
After mixing it fully, he took a sip and waited.
This effect was much slower than the Divine Bean. Shi Yu waited for a few minutes before his body reacted.
Cooldown Time: 46 hours
After taking a small sip, his weakness period was reduced by two hours.
Shi Yu was excited on the spot.
“It’s so good to be rich!!!”
People got what they paid for, after all. The Refreshing Capsules he could buy outside the pharmacy didn’t have such an effect at all!
The Refreshing Capsule only relied on the effect of the medicine to forcefully restore his spirit. The cooldown time was even more impossible to directly jump up and down on a large cooldown number like this. At most, it was only a support recovery.
It was nowhere like the honey, which was greatly influencing the cooldown time… Shi Yu seemed to see a new life.
It would be fine if he didn’t go to this pharmacy in the future. He wouldn’t have to suffer the strange looks of the employees anymore.
He gulped it down.
Shi Yu took another sip and brought a cup with him.
He planned to clear the cooldown time today and teach skills again at night.
It was really good to spend money. His teaching efficiency increased immediately.
It seemed like the 10,000,000 starting capital wouldn’t be given for Eleven and the Green Silkworm to enjoy too much. It was better to use them to buy supplements for himself at a higher price.
He was probably the only Beast Tamer who could use these supplements to such an effect.
…
That night, Shi Yu drank almost half a cup of Happy Water.
His teaching cooldown was finally cleared.
Shi Yu was happy, but not too happy either.
Because he used a third of this honey to make this cup of Happy Water, half a cup was about 50,000 yuan.
However, he had only recovered 48 hours of weakness.
The divine bean worth 100,000 yuan recovered a full 120 hours.
The difference in cost-effective ratio was immediately obvious.
“It’s not quite right to calculate it this way. After all, the divine beans are mainly supplements to recover physical strength and energy, and apart from similar effects, the honey can also prevent diseases.”
Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to count it. The problem now was that he had eaten supplements for the whole day and was a little too awake. It would probably be very difficult for him to sleep again.
“As expected, worm silk should still be the first choice for tonight’s teaching skills.”
“The eight-hour cooldown period of teaching the worm silk skill is suitable for sleeping.”
Shi Yu decisively went to look for the Green silkworm and taught it the fourth time. It was still at the expert level.
The proficiency level increased, but there was no qualitative change.
It looked like he still had to continue teaching if he wanted to reach the perfect level of the worm silk.
“It’s alright. In the future, I’ll just rely on teaching worm silk at night to tire myself and sleep. It’ll probably max out soon.”
“Not only can it increase the proficiency of the worm silk, but it can also prevent insomnia. It can promote sleep and ensure mental health. It’s amazing.”
…
August 2.
Morning.
Shi Yu took out another divine bean and half a bottle of Happy Water, planning to teach Eleven another high-level skill.
“Eleven.”
After Eleven’s morning training and breakfast, it was called over by Shi Yu again, which made it a little nervous.
To be precise, it had a bad premonition.
As expected, under Eleven’s gaze, Shi Yu’s right hand lit up again.
“Wuu!”
What was it this time?
The Little Iron Eating Beast covered its eyes.
“This time, it’s a skill that can increase the efficiency of training.”
Skill: Absolute Sleep
Skill Level: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a spiritual skill that can allow one to enter a super deep sleep and quickly recover their various states.
Status: Can be taught
Absolute Sleep looked like it didn’t have much effect, but it was actually very strong.
In fact, after the pet entered the Beast Taming Space, its state was similar to this absolute sleep.
It could be said that if a wild pet mastered this skill, it was equivalent to carrying a partially functioning Beast Taming Space with them.
Moreover, it was a high-level Beast Taming Space.
Generally speaking, even if it was initial-level absolute sleep, the effect on the physical recovery of the pet should be greater than the Beast Taming Space of the Beast Trainer trainee.
If Eleven learned this, apart from some special circumstances, it basically didn’t need to return to Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space to rest at all.
Unless Shi Yu could increase the level of the Beast Taming Space.
However, Shi Yu kept feeling that the speed at which he increased the level of the Beast Taming Space might not necessarily be faster than the speed at which Eleven increased the absolute sleep proficiency.
In short, after teaching Eleven this skill, as long as he had enough food to ensure its nutrition, coupled with absolute sleep and high-speed healing… Eleven could completely train on his own, and the training efficiency would be very high.
At the same time, if Eleven didn’t rely on the Beast Taming Space to rest, Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer, would have more time and energy to strengthen the Beast Taming Space and increase his Beast Tamer level.
This felt very right… Beast Tamers should grow up along with their pets.
Otherwise, when Eleven was already at the transcendent level, his Beast Tamer level would still be that of an apprentice. That would be awkward.
“Wuu—”
After Shi Yu introduced the skill, Eleven opened its eyes.
This skill was good!
“Not only that, after this skill’s proficiency is higher, it can be used in battle.”
The absolute sleep recovery speed of low proficiency was relatively slow, and the recovery efficiency was low. However, the absolute sleep of high proficiency might only require a short nap to recover a lot of physical fitness.
“At that time, when we encounter the enemy, we can directly multiply, harden, and charge forward with Thunder Palms.”
“If you’re injured, heal yourself with high-speed healing.”
“When you run out of stamina, quickly shrink and sleep. Continue fighting after being woken up. Have you learned it?”
Eleven nodded crazily.
Eleven understood! This strategy was pretty good.
That day, Shi Yu ate divine beans and drank Happy Water. He watched Eleven train on its own and recuperate.
He also concluded a life realization: It was awesome to spend money all the time.
…
With money, both Shi Yu and his two pets were clearly more comfortable.
He had taught two high-level skills in two days. He could still use his energy to teach worm silk every night. This was something Shi Yu did not dare to imagine.
On the third of August, Shi Yu originally wanted to repeat yesterday’s routine and continue teaching Deterrence. However, although there were supplements, Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel a little uncomfortable letting his body be put through this stress for two consecutive days.
Psychological factors were his concern.
“Forget it, I’ll take a day off today to teach a low-level skill to relax.”
In addition, he had previously promised to pay a visit to the Bamboo Stone Dojo when he was free. In the end, it had been two days and he had yet to leave. It was time to take a look.
After all, the dojo seemed to have prepared training resources for the iron-eating beasts. It would be a waste not to.
Bamboo Stone Dojo was also in Ping Cheng. If Shi Yu took a taxi, he could reach it in half an hour. However, before going, Shi Yu first investigated Bamboo Stone Dojo’s phone number.
He planned to make an appointment before visiting, in case the one in-charge wasn’t around when he arrived. That would be boring…
…
Inside the Bamboo Stone Dojo…
Was one of the iron-eating beasts’ headquarters in Donghuang.
The owner of the dojo, Lin Hongnian, was a rare master-level Beast Tamer in Icefield City.
Although he didn’t become an expert-level title because of an Iron-eating Beast, nor was his strongest pet… his representative pet was undoubtedly the Iron-eating Beast.
The Iron-eating Beast was the first pet Lin Hongnian had contracted. Because of this relationship, he had always hoped to find a better cultivation method or even an evolution method for the Iron-eating Beast.
Unfortunately, due to race restrictions, it had always been difficult for the Iron-eating Beast to break through a certain bottleneck.
It was the same even if he had developed two skills of other races that were very suitable for the iron-eating beasts to learn.
Over time, even if Lin Hongnian contracted a stronger pet, he couldn’t let go of this thought.
In the end, Lin Hongnian did not give up. On the basis of inheriting the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base of the family, he chose to open a Bamboo Stone Dojo and recruit disciples widely.
As long as it was a Beast Tamer who contracted an Iron-eating Beast, they could join the Bamboo Stone Dojo to learn.
Talented apprentices even had the chance to come into contact with Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist manuals.
He hoped to use this method to nurture more powerful Iron-eating Beast Tamers. At that time, more people would nurture Iron-eating Beasts. Perhaps, there would be people more talented than him who could find a better cultivation route for Iron-eating Beasts.
In the training ground of Bamboo Stone Dojo, ten apprentices of different ages were undergoing training with their Iron-eating Beast.
Bamboo Stone Dojo only accepted initial level apprentices and provided basic training content.
After becoming a professional Beast Tamer, one was almost considered to have graduated. However, there were also apprentices like Little Bear Yan Qi who gave up halfway after failing the vocation assessment.
Of course, this was only for ordinary apprentices. For talented apprentices, Hall Master Lin Hongnian would take them in as his personal disciples and teach them seriously without holding back.
Unfortunately, apart from his own daughter, no Iron-eating Beast Tamer had been able to enjoy the teachings as a personal disciple.
Although he had cultivated a bunch of professional Beast Tamers, Lin Hongnian still couldn’t find a disciple worth teaching with all his might.
Until Lu Qingyi found one and entrusted Lin Hongnian to help take care of him.
Since he had agreed to the request, no matter how talented or untalented that person was, Lin Hongnian would definitely do his best to teach him. After all, his two mid-level skill manuals were nothing compared to someone like Dr. Lu.
Then, Lin Hongnian heard Little Bear Yan Qi mention Shi Yu.
In less than a month, he had reached expert level Hardening.
Genius!
Moreover, if it was related to a genius like Dr. Lu, his future was immeasurable. It was entirely possible to nurture the iron-eating beast to the level of a monarch.
Such a genius Beast Tamer, even if he had no relationship to Lu Qingyi… He had to teach with all his might.
Lin Hongnian thought so at the start.
However, when Yan Qi, the little bear, told him that Shi Yu and the others had learned the Thunder Palm in a day, Lin Hongnian understood.
Sorry, he didn’t deserve to teach this person.
He himself also wanted to know how to rely on the Electric Slime and Electric Mineral to learn the Thunder Palm in a day.
“Father.”
On the high platform of the training ground, Lin Xiuzhu looked at his father, who was looking at the training ground below, and said in a low voice, “Let’s eat outside at noon, we’ll go to the Dragon Palace Fish Plant.”
Lin Hongnian frowned and said, “Have you completed your daily training?”
“Ah…” Lin Xiuzhu was speechless.
Lin Hongnian looked at his disobedient daughter and felt a wave of regret.
Originally, under his guidance, Lin Xiuzhu had a great prospect of passing the professional Beast Tamer assessment at the age of 18. Perhaps she could surpass him and nurture the iron-eating beast to the level of a monarch.
However, who knew that Lin Xiuzhu would actually choose the Feeding specialization and even choose to study the evolution research department of the Iron Eater?
At that time, he didn’t know what had gotten into him to agree. As for the outcome… Lin Xiuzhu didn’t get on either side. Her strength fell, and she didn’t research any results on the evolution path.
“We’ll talk about it after your training is completed,” Lin Hongnian said seriously and meticulously.
“But mom wants to eat fish,” Lin Xiuzhu said. “Not me.”
Lin Hongnian was silent for a moment.
“Just this time, then. You can’t waste your training in the future.”
Lin Xiuzhu :”…”
Just as the father and daughter were discussing what to eat for lunch, a dojo apprentice rushed over.
“Master Lin, a Beast Tamer named Shi Yu said that he might come to visit today and ask if you’re free.”

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - Visiting Bamboo Stone Dojo
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Visiting Bamboo Stone Dojo
“Shi Yu?”
“Yes, that’s the name,” the apprentice said.
“Let him come over,” Lin Hongnian said. This boy was finally willing to come to the dojo.
The apprentice nodded and immediately left.
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu, who was beside Hongnian, vaguely felt that this name was a little familiar.
“You know this Shi Yu, right?” Lin Hongnian was the first to ask his daughter.
“I remember you previously mentioned to me that a very disciplined iron-eating beast was taken away by a person called Shi Yu.”
The first time Lin Hongnian heard the name Shi Yu, it wasn’t from Lu Qingyi, but from Lin Xiuzhu.
However, because Shi Yu was only a Beast Tamer intern, he didn’t deliberately remember it.
It was only when Lu Qingyi mentioned it and he investigated again that he realized and remembered that it was the same person.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “It’s really him? Father, you still remember. What’s wrong… Is he going to enter the dojo?”
Lin Hongnian shook his head and said, “No, I was entrusted by someone to guide his growth.”
“By the way, after he left, do you know the growth of that Iron-eating Beast?”
Lin Xiuzhu also shook her head and said, “I’m not sure, but I told them that if they have any problems, they can come to the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base to consult at any time. Since he didn’t come again… Everything should be normal, right?”
How could it be normal… It was too abnormal.
After a moment of silence, Lin Hongnian said, “That Shi Yu and that Iron-eating Beast participated in the assessment at Mt. Tian Mang was organized by the Beast Tamer Association a few days ago and took first place.”
Lin Xiuzhu was stunned and had yet to react.
Then, her beautiful eyes widened. “Impossible. That Iron-eating Beast only awakened level three a month ago…”
At this level, he probably couldn’t even defeat a wild boar.
Even if she thought very highly of that Iron-eating Beast and thought that the self-disciplined Little Iron-eating Beast Eleven would definitely be able to do something, she clearly didn’t believe what her father said.
How could there be such a speed of growth…
“It’s hard for me to believe too, but he’ll come to visit later. We’ll know then.” Lin Hongnian looked at the group of useless apprentices on the training ground.
If only this group of people were half as outstanding as the rumors said.
Level 6 growth… Mastery Level Hardening… Learning Thunder Palm… was simply unbelievable.
“Then, then what about the fish??” Lin Xiuzhu asked another key question. The ridiculous thing about Shi Yu was put aside for the time being. Eating was the most important thing.
“No,” Lin Hongnian said.
It was better to wait for this Shi Yu.
Although he had yet to meet Shi Yu, this genius Beast Tamer, he found Shi Yu more pleasing to the eye than his own daughter.
This was like some parents always comparing their own kid to other people’s children.
He could not wait to see who this Shi Yu and that iron-eating beast were.
“But I’ve already told mom that you’ll go together.”
Lin Xiuzhu looked at her father strangely. Her father actually stood up today? He dared to disobey his wife? Wasn’t he afraid of going back to sleep on the bamboo board at night?
Lin Hongnian turned around calmly.
“Where to?” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
“Tell that Shi Yu to come in the afternoon. I’m suddenly a little hungry.”
…
…
“In the afternoon?”
On Shi Yu’s side, he heard from the apprentice of the dojo that Hall Master Lin Hongnian would be at the dojo in the afternoon. After arranging that, he stretched in anticipation.
He decided to find a place to eat lunch before going.
At about ten in the morning, Shi Yu started to move. In order to save time, he still chose a taxi.
After arriving near the dojo, he casually found a high-level restaurant and ordered a bunch of dishes, including the wild boar meat he didn’t eat last time.
After eating and drinking to his heart’s content, Shi Yu glanced at the time. It was getting closer to the appointment time, so he headed straight for Bamboo Stone Dojo.
Outside Bamboo Stone Dojo.
“Excuse me, is anyone here?”
Shi Yu knocked on the door.
A moment later, the door was opened, and a person in a familiar costume opened the door.
Shi Yu looked down and subconsciously said, “Panda senior…”
“No… Breeder Lin Xiuzhu?”
The person who opened the door was Lin Xiuzhu, who was wearing panda-style shorts and a T-shirt.
“Hello, we meet again.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled at Shi Yu.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu nodded. When he bought the Iron-Eating Beast, he felt that there was something wrong with this Lin Xiuzhu. Later on, he learned that she was actually Lin Hongnian’s daughter.
In short, she was another rich heir.
He wanted to sigh. He had just gotten 10,000,000 from Lu Qingyi, and now he wanted to collect cultivation resources from this girl. As expected, he was someone who relied on women to get him stuff…
Speaking of which… he hadn’t finished repaying his loan. He had originally planned to return it monthly, but now… was there a need to return it??
“Follow me, Father is inside.” After Lin Xiuzhu finished speaking, he started to lead the way.
A moment later, Shi Yu was invited into the waiting room of the dojo.
At this moment, Shi Yu finally saw Lin Hongnian. Chen Kai, Zhuang Yue, and the others had said this man might be the number one Beast Tamer in Ping Cheng.
“Sit.” In the room, Lin Hongnian, who was wearing a gray battle suit, extended his hand and invited Shi Yu to sit.
Sensing the aura of Hall Master Lin Hongnian, Shi Yu thought to himself that this person was obviously an expert. Since he was an expert, he wondered if his pets had any rare skills…
Shi Yu sat down cautiously, and Lin Xiuzhu, who had brought him over, naturally sat opposite him.
Lin Xiuzhu still didn’t believe the battle results of Shi Yu that Lin Hongnian mentioned just now. After all, she could also claim that she took care of Eleven… How could she not know Eleven’s strength a month ago?
Moreover, during the meal, she also asked her father what was going on. However, Lin Hongnian himself was ambiguous and couldn’t answer. He only said that Shi Yu had a special opportunity… Ridiculous!
“Dr. Lu already told me.”
“If you plan to come to Bamboo Stone Dojo to learn, I’ll teach you everything.”
“However, according to my understanding, there seems to be a limit to what I can teach you in the cultivation of iron-eating beasts.”
Among the training methods of Bamboo Stone Dojo for Iron-eating Beasts, the most precious were undoubtedly the skill manuals of Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist.
Apart from that, although special nutritional supplements and food were also very expensive, they were clearly still a little inferior to the value of skill manuals. There were also many substitutes.
Shi Yu and Eleven had already learned the Thunder Palm Skill. It was no wonder Lin Hongnian said that there was not much left to teach.
“You’re too polite.” Shi Yu expressed that he was just a newbie.
“How about this? Next, the three training grounds of the Bamboo Stone Dojo are open to you. You can use the training equipment as you wish. In terms of the cultivation resources of the iron-eating beasts, the Bamboo Stone Dojo will also provide them all.”
“Xiu Zhu should have given you the basic cultivation manual of the Iron-eating Beast, right? I’ll give you a cultivation method for advancement later for your reference.”
“If you have any problems with training, you can come to me anytime to ask. You don’t have to undergo training in the dojo like other apprentices.”
“What do you think?”
There should be a special treatment for geniuses.
Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had already mastered mastery level Hardening and Thunder Palm, so there was no need for it to do the daily training of ordinary apprentices.
Therefore, Lin Hongnian gave Shi Yu a lot of convenience. This was something other apprentices, even his own daughter, couldn’t enjoy in the beginning.
“Thank you, Hall Master Lin,” Shi Yu said. “This is pretty suitable for me.”
Food and drink were managed, freedom was not restricted, and a master-level Beast Tamer who he could ask questions to at any time. This treatment… was perfect.
Alright, looks like that 10,000,000 yuan could only be used to buy supplements without any reservation. Wouldn’t Eleven’s cultivation resources be resolved if he did this? It was just that Eleven’s appetite was a little big, and he didn’t know if the dojo could handle it… It was alright under normal circumstances, but he was afraid that Eleven would eat more after getting into the habit.
As for the food of the green worm… it was everywhere outside.
It seemed that joining this Bureau 11 was indeed the right choice. Otherwise, he might still be recuperating at this time.
“If I’m not wrong, your Iron-eating Beast has already learned the Thunder Palm, right?”
“In addition, the proficiency of Hardening has also reached mastery level.”
Shi Yu nodded. “Yes.”
Lin Xiuzhu: (^ _ ^)?
These two were getting more and more ridiculous.
“Then let’s focus on training the Thunder Palm skill first. The learning difficulty of the Thunder Palm is slightly lower than Cannon Fist. Don’t bite off more than you can chew. If you want to learn Cannon Fist, my suggestion is to master the Thunder Palm first.”
Shi Yu nodded. Indeed, one shouldn’t bite off more than one could chew. He couldn’t even level up the current Iron-eating Beast skills comfortably right now.
As for the cannon fist… forget it.
Ordinary Iron-eating Beasts might lack this skill, but he didn’t lack Iron-eating Beasts at all. A similar skill was enough with the Thunder Palm, there was no need for a fire-element cannonball fist to increase the attack power.
Even if there was such a requirement, he still would definitely use that slot for higher-level skills in the future.
“There are very few records regarding the Thunder Palm in the outside world. Next, I’ll bring you to the training ground and explain the Thunder Palm in detail.”
“Before that, I’ll also introduce you to other apprentices. In the future, when you come to the dojo, you’ll inevitably come into contact with them.”
“As for the various training facilities in the dojo, I’ll let Xiu Zhu bring you around to familiarize yourself.”
Lin Xiuzhu had many questions, but he didn’t dare to interrupt when his father was speaking.
In the family hierarchy, she was below her father, who was below her mother.
“Speaking of which…” Lin Hongnian looked at Shi Yu.
“Although I heard about you from Yan Qi, I still don’t seem to know much about your situation.”
“Do you mind having a battle with the apprentices of our dojo to let me understand your specific situation?”
“That’s good.” Lin Xiuzhu answered for Shi Yu. Combat was good, and she also wanted to see how Shi Yu and the others were currently doing.
(ω ? ω ? ω ?) ?) Fighting time!
Shi Yu was extremely calm. He was invincible, so they could do whatever they wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - The Might of the Thunder Palm
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: The Might of the Thunder Palm
The Bamboo Stone Dojo was very large. There were three training grounds the size of a stadium alone, but there were very few apprentices in the dojo at this time.
“Under normal circumstances, only trainee-level apprentices will often stay in the dojo to undergo strict training.”
Lin Hongnian brought Shi Yu to the rooftop of a training ground and said, “This is the basic training ground. It’s used for after-dinner activities between the apprentices of the dojo and the iron-eating beasts.”
Below, Beast Tamers and the Iron-eating Beasts beside them were jogging and warming up on the fake lawn.
The Beast Tamers were alright, but the giant pandas looked reluctant and kept crying.
They had just finished lunch and it should be lunch break. Running directly after a meal was too much for a panda.
However, with the Beast Tamers’ forced orders, they had no choice.
“Iron-eating beasts have lazy personalities. This had to be changed slowly in daily training. Otherwise, when it comes to battle, it’s very easy for big problems to arise,” Lin Hongnian said.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “But Eleven should be very self-disciplined, right?”
Shi Yu nodded. “Yes. Generally speaking, it won’t eat until it has completed a certain amount of training. Otherwise, it won’t feel at ease eating.”
Lin Hongnian: “?”
He looked at Lin Xiuzhu. There was such an Iron-eating Beast?
Lin Xiuzhu also turned her head in surprise. Why did this sound even more ridiculous than when it was at the breeding base!
What exactly did Shi Yu do to Eleven after that? She looked at Shi Yu.
“Cough.” Shi Yu had an innocent expression. Perhaps he had helped Eleven cheat too much and stimulated its desire to train?
Eleven: (*+ ￥+*~ It was disgraceful to reap without sowing. The Beast Tamer gave too many cheats, so it has to recover its sweat even if it had to train hard.
“After the warm-up, they will undergo basic hardening training here. In pairs, they will practice with each other.”
Lin Hongnian looked down again. Hardening versus hardening had saved him the cost of a batch of steel plates. Unlike Eleven, who could only rely on gravity and steel plates to train the hardness.
“Their iron-eating beasts are basically between level eight and ten. I’ll randomly choose the strongest one for you,” Lin Hongnian continued.
Pick the strongest one? Sorry?
Right now, the ten dojo apprentices in the training ground had just finished warming up. They were about to start the basic hardening training in pairs.
Under the organization of a tall young man with a crew cut, they quickly divided into teams.
“Jiang Rui.” At this moment, Lin Hongnian shouted.
The tall youth with the crew cut, Jiang Rui, who had just organized the other apprentices into groups, looked up.
“Let’s go down,” Lin Hongnian said.
A moment later, they arrived at the training ground below.
“Master Lin, what’s wrong?” Jiang Rui and the other apprentices looked over.
His gaze looked at Lin Hongnian and Shi Yu, but he quickly looked away. All his attention was focused on Panda senior.
Great, she came to the dojo again today. Training suddenly became more energetic!
Youths at this age were at the stage where they were extremely hazy about the opposite sex. After days of boring training, they indeed needed something to heal their hearts.
As Lin Hongnian’s daughter, a famous genius, Lin Xiuzhu’s looks were also very outstanding. In addition to that giant panda T-shirt that showed off her assets, she was completely the goddess of all apprentices.
Even the two young girls among the ten apprentices secretly envied Lin Xiuzhu’s figure. They looked down at themselves and couldn’t help but feel sad.
“Your training will be suspended for now,” Lin Hongnian said. “Let me introduce you. This is Shi Yu. He will come to the dojo to learn next.”
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Everyone looked at Shi Yu.
They were wondering who it was just now. So it was a newbie from the dojo.
Newbies were good. With newbies, the ones who were scolded by the head were the newbies who couldn’t quickly adapt to the intensity of the training, and no longer them.
This was called transferring firepower, and the status of everyone’s dojo instantly increased by one!
Everyone found Shi Yu pleasing to the eye. The environment of the dojo was harmonious.
“Hello, everyone.” Shi Yu’s expression was also kind.
Everyone nodded. That Jiang Rui said, “My name is Jiang Rui. If you have any questions later, you can look for me.”
“Jiang Rui, don’t organize training first. Have a battle with Shi Yu,” Lin Hongnian said.
Jiang Rui was the most outstanding of the ten apprentices, so when Lin Hongnian and the other teachers of the dojo were not around, the basic training was basically led by Jiang Rui.
“Me?” Jiang Rui pointed at himself and said surprisingly.
“That’s you. If you lose, your training with the Iron-eating Beast will double.”
Jiang Rui’s heart skipped a beat, but he quickly realized that it was just teaching a newbie. How could he lose?
“Alright.” He nodded quickly.
As for the other apprentices, they showed an “why not me” expression.
They understood what Master Lin meant. Wasn’t it to give the newbie a show of strength and let him understand the strength of the apprentices in the martial hall?
At the same time, Master Lin might also want to know about this newbie’s situation.
They could do it too!
How could Jiang Rui snatch away such an opportunity to show off his training results in front of his master and senior sister? How come he got to show off his mighty image in front of the newbie?
They were quite envious.
…
Because Shi Yu and Jiang Rui were going to battle, everyone’s training temporarily stopped. This made the apprentices and the iron-eating beasts secretly rejoice.
At Lin Hongnian’s signal, unrelated people scattered and went to the side to watch the battle, leaving the battlefield for the two of them.
“Shi Yu, send your pet out.”
After saying that, the Iron-eating Beast beside him walked out. Because it was warming up just now, the Iron-eating Beast had been outside the whole time.
This was a big panda that was 1.45 meters long. Its growth level should be much higher than Eleven.
“Alright.”
Shi Yu nodded and communicated with the Beast Taming Space.
Fwooo…
In the next second, because of the ripples in the surrounding space, a weak airflow blew nearby, and the fake grass on the ground swayed.
Under the outline of the light spots that appeared out of thin air in front of Shi Yu, the transparent summoning array revealed its full appearance. Amidst the water-like ripples, Eleven walked out in a daze.
It came outside and looked up at the big guy in front of it.
Eleven’s current normal height, without multiplication, was only 1 meter. Compared to Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast, he was clearly still a child.
“A cub?”
At this moment, as Eleven appeared, these martial arts apprentices who cultivated iron-eating beasts immediately judged Eleven’s growth level.
It was only around level six. He was indeed a newbie.
Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast that had awakened to level ten and mastered proficient level hardening… This cub might not be able to win easily.
“You guys attack first,” Jiang Rui said after a moment of silence.
If they directly attacked, Master Lin wouldn’t be able to examine this newbie’s strength very well. It was better to let the newbie do it.
“Eleven.” Shi Yu didn’t stand on ceremony and directly ordered Eleven to attack.
“Ow.”
In an instant, Eleven attacked the iron-eating beast opposite him fiercely.
“Block it.”
Jiang Rui was very confident in the hardness of his Iron-eating Beast.
Although this little Metal-eating Beast’s explosive power looked very strong, it was still in its infancy, after all.
Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast stood still as if it was showing off its skills.
Buzz!
It directly chose to harden its entire body and wait for the Little Iron Eating Beast’s arrival.
With the strength and hardness of the Little Iron Eating Beast… It was impossible to hurt it. Jiang Rui was very certain.
In fact, it was indeed so. Even though Shi Yu knew that Eleven’s hardening strength was definitely above this iron-eating beast’s hardening strength, he wasn’t sure if Eleven could heavily injure it with hardening.
The reason was that although Eleven’s skill proficiency was very high, its strength was definitely inferior to this level-ten Iron-eating Beast.
Even though he had the Hardening Strength, if its strength couldn’t keep up with the opponent, the attack clearly wouldn’t cause too much damage.
However, at this moment, Eleven wasn’t only hardened to fight enemies.
Zi Zi Zi Zi Zi!!!
When Jiang Rui and his Iron-eating Beast were extremely confident and planned to use proficient level Hardening to check the strength of the “newbie” in front of them, Eleven, who pounced nearby, didn’t Harden the sharp claws attack or harden the head impact as everyone imagined.
Instead… After it approached its opponent, it immediately raised its arm backward. In the next instant, a blue and white light intertwined and shot out of its palm.
A high-intensity electric current filled Eleven’s palm, forming a chaotic and violent electric current.
Zizizizizi—!!!
The voice was like the cry of a thousand birds.
Intermediate-level skill, Thunder Palm!
Under the illumination of the lightning, Eleven’s entire body was still in the dazzling light, looking especially dazzling.
This scene made Jiang Rui lose his ability to think on the spot, and also made the other apprentices lose their ability to think.
This was…???
They widened their eyes and found it unbelievable. Because this skill definitely couldn’t appear on Iron-eating Beasts below the transcendent level…
Under the condensation of the high-intensity electric current, Eleven’s palm had an extremely strong penetrative force like a sharp blade. It was more suitable to attack than using hardening!
At this moment, because the proficient level Hardening could not allow the panda to be moved, Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast could only watch as the Thunder Palm with electricity passed through.
It was already too late to cancel Hardening and dodge.
With a bang, under the thunder roar, the blue and white interweaving lightning surged into Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast’s body, passing through the hardening crazily and corroding its body.
Bang bang bang bang bang!!
In the next second, electric currents shot out from its entire body. This iron-eating beast’s entire body was directly paralyzed, and its body subconsciously leaned down. Although it hadn’t lost its battle ability, it clearly suffered heavy injuries.
Apart from the silent Lin Hongnian, all the other apprentices, including Lin Xiuzhu, opened their mouths and looked at the Little Iron Eating Beast, who was cautiously retreating. They couldn’t believe it!

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - Profound Truths
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Profound Truths
“It’s really… Thunder Palm?!”
Lin Xiuzhu stood beside his father and looked at Eleven in disbelief.
Compared to being told about something, it was clearly more shocking to see it personally.
Thunder Palm skill… was actually really mastered by a level-six young Iron-eating Beast?
“Impressive.”
Lin Hongnian nodded. Moreover, it was the Thunder Palm that had just gained power. It seemed that this Iron-eating Beast had put in a lot of effort to practice after mastering the Thunder Palm.
“Although it won’t lose its battle ability, if it takes this move head-on, Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast’s entire body will probably be paralyzed.”
Lin Hongnian looked at the venue and judged.
Zi! Zi! Zi!
Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast was crackling all over.
At this moment, Jiang Rui was at a loss and shocked.
How could this be… This didn’t make sense!
“Wuu—” Just as Jiang Rui was stunned, the Iron-eating Beast’s roar woke him up.
The battle wasn’t over yet.
“Hard Claw.”
Only then did Jiang Rui react and hurriedly give the order to attack.
“We can’t lose…”
It was fine to lose to a newcomer. After all, the other party had already used the Thunder Palm. Who the heck would call this a newcomer?
However, after losing, the training volume would increase. It would really be devastating for a panda.
In order to not train twice as much, even if Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast was paralyzed, it still erupted with fighting spirit.
“Wuu—”
Under the Beast Tamer’s command, its body shot out lightning as it pounced at Eleven.
Buzz—
However, under the paralysis state, the iron-eating beast’s speed was more than just half a beat slower.
Opposite it, Eleven, who had pulled away, instantly saw hundreds of openings in Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast’s attack under the lock of its super vision.
“Don’t dodge. Fight it head-on and counterattack.” Shi Yu ordered. He didn’t plan on showing the super vision to everyone.
Eleven:???
Although it could easily dodge the attack trajectory with its super vision, Shi Yu had not forgotten the purpose of the battle.
It was to show Lin Hongnian Eleven’s Hardening and Thunder Palm Proficiency, not to showcase the power of his super vision.
“Wuu!” The Beast Tamer had already given the order. What else could Eleven do?
It directly stood on the spot like Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast just now, its whole body hardening!
“Proficient Level Hardening!”
At this moment, when they saw the changes in Eleven’s body, the disciples of the dojo were shocked again.
Not only did he master the Thunder Palm, even its Hardening Proficiency looked very high!
That made sense. After all, one of the requirements to learn Thunder Palm was proficient level Hardening!
While everyone was amazed by the little Iron-Eating Beast’s monster-like talent, Jiang Rui’s Iron-Eating Beast swiped its claw at Eleven.
Screech…
Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast mainly trained the hardness of its claws. In daily training, the hardening skin of the Iron-eating Beasts of other martial arts apprentices was often torn by the hard claws of his Iron-eating Beast.
But this time, under the claw of Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast, it only left a white mark on Eleven’s hardened skin. It didn’t break through his defense at all!
It was just a very light injury!
“How is this possible?!” Jiang Rui felt that it was ridiculous again.
In the next second, an even more ridiculous scene appeared.
After taking the palm, Eleven maintained his hardening state and tried his best to hit his Iron-eating Beast.
Because the lightning energy accumulated in his body was limited, it was very difficult for Eleven to use the second powerful Thunder Palm. This time, he could only choose to harden his skin against the enemy.
Boom!!!
Because they thought that the other party had only mastered proficient level Hardening, Jiang Rui and his Iron-eating Beast didn’t have any defense awareness at all, causing them to directly eat all the damage from this impact!
Plop!
Jiang Rui’s Iron-eating Beast was sent flying. The maximum power Thunder Palm plus full damage Hardening impact directly made his Iron-eating Beast lose its battle awareness!
“Thank you,” Shi Yu said in embarrassment.
At this moment, Jiang Rui and the apprentices’ worldview gradually shattered.
“Expert level… Hardening…”
This was… a level-six young Iron-eating Beast??
Even the iron-eating beasts cultivated by the senior brothers and sisters who passed the vocation assessment were only so-so.
“Wuu!!!”
At the same time, Eleven let out a cry of victory when he saw his opponent fall.
However, it still felt that it wasn’t enough.
The strength of the apprentices in Bamboo Stone Dojo seemed to be limited.
At the moment, probably only pets of the commander rank and above could pose a threat to Eleven.
“Jiang Rui, you lost. Your training will be doubled when you go back.” At this moment, Lin Hongnian spoke beside him.
“I…” Jiang Rui expressed that he had lost for no reason.
This, this, this, a newbie???
He looked at Eleven and Shi Yu with a blank expression, then at Lin Hongnian and Lin Xiuzhu. He suspected that they were Master Lin’s illegitimate children.
Otherwise, how could he be so strong?
The other apprentices from the dojo also looked confused, but at this point in the battle, Lin Hongnian felt that it was enough.
“Jiang Rui, bring the Iron-eating Beast to treat it. The others continue training. Shi Yu, come with me.”
“Alright.”
Lin Hongnian turned and left. Shi Yu could only call Eleven to follow.
As for Lin Xiuzhu, he was still pondering on the spot.
Was this really the Eleven she knew?
“Senior Sister Lin, that person is…” The other apprentices surrounded Lin Xiuzhu.
Lin Xiuzhu returned to his senses and said, “Your training will also be doubled.”
With that said, she hurriedly followed her father and Shi Yu, leaving the confused apprentices behind.
How was this a rookie at the bottom? It was clearly a monster genius who only knew how to provoke people. Damn!
…
In the inner area of Bamboo Stone Dojo, in an empty training hall, Shi Yu was brought here by Lin Hongnian.
Following beside Shi Yu, Eleven observed the strange middle-aged man leading the way. It kept feeling that he looked a little familiar.
“Eleven.” Lin Xiuzhu called Eleven after following him.
Eleven turned around and couldn’t help but be pleasantly surprised when it saw Lin Xiuzhu.
It was the Big Sister.
Well… in Eleven’s eyes, Lin Xiuzhu, who often wore a panda costume, was one of them. She was a panda to it.
“Eleven, long time no see.” Lin Xiuzhu touched Eleven’s head and hugged it to observe.
Well… Eleven was still that Eleven, but what exactly happened???
Why was it suddenly so strong…
“Your Iron-eating Beast is pretty outstanding.”
“It’s the most outstanding iron-eating beast I’ve ever seen.” Lin Hongnian was not stingy with his praise in front.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven left its stuffy place and clenched its fists. Of course… It also remembered who this uncle was. It seemed to have seen him in the breeding base, but it didn’t know who he was.
“Thank you.” Shi Yu acknowledged the praise slightly. Sigh, wasn’t this all thanks to his training?
“In short, your future is immeasurable.” Lin Hongnian sighed.
“Unfortunately, I can’t teach you much. Next, I plan to show you the training direction after Hardening and Thunder Palm. You can take a look.”
After saying that, a blue summoning array appeared beside the old man. A two-meter-tall adult Iron-eating Beast walked out.
This iron-eating beast had a fierce expression. Its whole body was muscular and looked extremely strong. It was completely unlike the laziness of ordinary iron-eating beasts. It was not cute at all.
It seemed that under the nurturing of Hall Master Lin Hongnian, this pet had already overcome some habits and become a symbolic battle pet.
“The different proficiency symbols for hardening should be clearly recorded in that basic cultivation manual.”
“As for the Thunder Palm…”
Lin Hongnian looked at his Iron-eating Beast and nodded.
The next moment, in Shi Yu and Eleven’s eyes, the Iron-eating Beast’s palm also filled with a high-intensity electric current that was interweaved between blue and white!
Zizi!!!
As lightning lingered in his palm, the strong Iron-eating Beast’s surroundings flashed with lightning, appearing especially dazzling.
“Your Iron-eating Beast’s Thunder Palm proficiency is currently at initial level.”
“Once hit, after the chaotic high-intensity electric current erupts, it can put the enemy in a strong numb state.”
“However, the penetration power is still not enough. Otherwise, it could have directly shattered the hardening layer and killed the opponent just now.”
“And the symbol of the proficient level Thunder Palm is reflected in the piercing and penetration effect of the Thunder Palm.”
Zizi!!!
As Lin Hongnian finished speaking, the chaotic blue and white lightning on his Iron-eating Beast’s palm started to wander. They gathered and looked even stronger.
The Iron-eating Beast casually waved its arm. As the lightning flashed, the lightning seemed to really become a sharp blade. Its penetrative power increased visibly, and the air started to hiss.
“With the proficient level, no matter how hard the steel is, it can still be shattered with the Lightning Penetration.”
“As for the expert level Thunder Palm… If I’m not wrong just now, your Iron-eating Beast was a little weak after using the Thunder Palm.”
Shi Yu nodded.
“The symbol of an expert-level Thunder Palm is the normalization of it.”
After Lin Hongnian finished speaking, his Iron-eating Beast moved again. This time, both its palms were covered in lightning and it maintained this state continuously.
“Not only can it let the lightning cover the palm like the vambrace, but it can also use the Thunder Palm with both hands. This is the symbol of an expert-level Thunder Palm.”
“Then…”
After saying that, he looked at his Iron-eating Beast.
“It’s the state where you train the Thunder Palm to perfection!”
“Wuu!!!!”
The strong Iron-eating Beast roared, and the lightning from its palms began to spread throughout its entire body, invading its body.
Zizi!!!
Under the lightning, its mouth and eyes seemed to be filled with lightning.
In the next moment, all the hair on its body stood up. As if it were a bolt of lightning, it streaked past and instantly appeared 50 meters away from the training hall. Then, it instantly returned to its original spot.
Everything happened in the blink of an eye, leaving the ground charred.
“Perfect proficiency. Borrowing the high-intensity electric current of the Thunder Palm to stimulate the whole body, using this to produce a powerful instant explosive force, obtaining speed that can’t be seen with the eyes.”
“After training the Thunder Palm to perfection, the penetration power of the lightning and its own speed can even cut open real lightning!”
“His vision is so strong,” Shi Yu thought.
After Lin Hongnian finished speaking, Shi Yu was still feeling alright. Eleven, who was beside him, however, looked at Shi Yu excitedly.
This one looks so powerful…
Shi Yu, increase points!
He would make up for it afterwards with training.
“However, this isn’t even anything!” Lin Hongnian wasn’t done speaking. “This is what you should be pursuing.”
This time, Shi Yu also perked up and looked at Lin Hongnian.
Was he going to show him theTranscendent Thunder Palm?! What effect would it have?
Obviously, he was overthinking. Even Lin Hongnian, a master-level Beast Tamer, didn’t train his Iron-eating Beast’s Thunder Palm to that level.
At this moment, Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast dispersed the lightning and actually entered a hardening state.
Then, it raised its head and clenched its fists.
Boom!
Under the metallic texture of its entire body, an even stronger electric current shot out from its body. Black and white intertwined, and under the flickering of the blue electric current, it was as if the iron-eating beast was wearing lightning armor!
Boom!
Boom!
In this state, the Iron-eating Beast’s strength was full. Its attack, defense, and speed reached the peak together. The explosive sound of the lightning armor seemed to be able to shatter the enemy’s will.
“A combination skill of Hardening and Thunder Palm?” Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly.
“Yes, but it’s more powerful than ordinary combination skills.” Beside him, Lin Xiuzhu didn’t expect his father to display it to this extent.
“When ordinary two skills are successfully combined, it’s called a combination skill.”
“But Father’s Iron-eating Beast’s Hardening Proficiency and Thunder Palm Proficiency are both above Perfect Level.”
“In the master domain, Beast Tamers call the perfect combination skill formed by two skills above perfect proficiency ‘profundity’.”
“Right now, this is one of the profundities mastered by Father’s Iron-eating Beast, ‘Thunder Armor’. With this profundity, it can temporarily battle monarch-level creatures.”

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - Dont bite off more than you can chew
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Don’t bite off more than you can chew
Combination skills were very difficult.
It didn’t mean that if an Iron-eating Beast mastered Hardening and Thunder Palm at the same time, it could combine the two skills.
Even if it only used both Hardening and Thunder Palm on his palm at the same time, it wasn’t that easy to do.
First, he had to consider whether his pet had the ability to use two skills at the same time. Second, he had to consider whether the energy of the two skills would conflict.
If he wanted to resolve these contradictions, there was no doubt that he had to solve them by increasing the proficiency of his skills.
Only when the proficiency of the skill was enough and the pet was extremely familiar with a certain skill could this skill be combined with other skills to be used.
The higher the skill proficiency, the higher the combination skill completion.
There was a saying in the Beast Taming Domain: Combination skills might not be the strongest, but the strongest skills must be combination skills.
Therefore, on the basis of this sentence, the high-level Beast Tamers gave the combination skill of two and more perfect-level skills a name, called “profundity”.
Whether a pet could master the profundities was often the most critical factor in evaluating the level of cultivation of a Beast Tamer in a higher field.
It was clearly a little early for Shi Yu, who wasn’t even a professional Beast Tamer.
It was even very early for professional Beast Tamers.
After all, even ordinary professional Beast Tamers might not necessarily be able to train their pets’ skills to perfect proficiency.
However, because he thought highly of Shi Yu’s talent, Lin Hongnian still chose to broaden Shi Yu’s horizons in advance.
He hoped that Shi Yu could work hard in this direction!
At the side, after Lin Xiuzhu finished introducing the profundities of the “Thunder Armor”, Lin Hongnian looked at Shi Yu without leaving any trace, waiting for Shi Yu’s shocked expression.
Geniuses were geniuses, but being compared to a senior like him who had sufficient accumulation, he was definitely still a little lacking.
This experience could be used by Shi Yu and the others.
However, Shi Yu’s next words made Lin Hongnian’s heart skip a beat.
“This Thunder Armor… feels like it can still be improved?” Shi Yu discovered the flaw in the Thunder Armor.
“Why do you say that?” Lin Xiuzhu didn’t understand.
“Because the iron-eating beast’s vision isn’t very good. With the speed just now, I wonder if it can control its movements well…”
The strong Iron-eating Beast beside him was stunned.
Lin Hongnian was also stunned.
How could there be perfection? It was already very fragrant to have this move to deal with opponents with large bodies and not good speed.
Shi Yu added, “If there’s a perception skill that can predict the enemy’s movements or clearly capture the enemy’s position, the effect of the Thunder Armor might be stronger.”
He looked at Eleven.
Perfect Level Hardening plus Perfect Level Thunder Palm plus Perfect Level Super Sight… This felt like the perfect Thunder Armor profundity.
However, this was more like a three-skill profundity.
As for facing a large-sized opponent, wouldn’t it be better if it was Perfect Level Hardening+Perfect Level Thunder Palm+Perfect Level multiplication!
“The key is that it’s not easy for iron-eating beasts to learn perception skills.” Lin Hongnian’s face was speechless.
Did this person think learning skills was that simple? He could go ahead and try learning it if he wanted!
“However, your idea is pretty good. Every profundity isn’t perfect. It has its own flaws and shortcomings. By integrating new skills into the combination profundities, it can increase the effect of the profundities.”
“Of course, this is still too far from you. Your current goal should be to train the Iron-eating Beast to increase the proficiency of the Thunder Palm.”
“Then, try the simple combination of hardening and Thunder Palm.”
“It’s not easy to increase the proficiency of Thunder Palm. After all, this skill isn’t an Iron-eating Beast’s racial skill.”
“From initial level to proficient level, the palm needs to have extremely strong endurance and lightning resistance.”
“To be proficient in it, the pet needs to have strong energy control and strong physical support.”
“As for going from expert level to perfection, during the training process, a single mistake will cause the pet to be covered in injuries. The training process is extremely dangerous!”
“Every step is very particular. In short, if you have any problems in your cultivation, come and find me.”
Although he had shown Shi Yu the characteristics of the Thunder Palm at each proficiency stage, there were still many ways to practice in this direction.
“Alright, I’ll work hard.” Shi Yu nodded.
At the side, Little Iron Eating Beast Eleven kept feeling that the two of them weren’t on the same wavelength.
It was right.
Lin Hongnian thought that he would first let Shi Yu develop a normal combination skill that was proficient in hardening and proficient in the Thunder Palm. This skill was enough for Shi Yu to pass the vocation assessment in the future.
Shi Yu was thinking about when he could reach Perfect Hardening, Perfect Thunder Palm, and Perfect Multiplication to directly activate the Thunder God Armor Mode… He could destroy a city with one strike.
Skill index really was a good thing.
…
Then, Sister Panda began to introduce Shi Yu and the others to the training hall facilities.
There were all kinds of targeted equipment to train the Iron-eating Beasts, but Eleven felt that it was a little boring.
It didn’t look as ferocious as jumping off a building…
One of the rooms was an electricity-generation training room specially designed for Iron-eating Beasts to train their lightning resistance. The highest it could provide was transcendent-level electricity.
There was also an electric swimming pool nearby. Not only could it train the iron-eating beasts to fight in the water, but it could also increase their lightning resistance.
Eleven liked it a lot.
Apart from that, things like the canteen and infirmary were standard.
Shi Yu looked around and nodded. If he could use the equipment here, it would indeed be more scientific and comprehensive than the Iron-Eating Beast working itself to death.
Most importantly… They could eat and drink for free here!!!
In order to find out what the food in the dojo was, Shi Yu deliberately stayed until it was time for dinner today.
“Father…”
Lin Hongnian was hurriedly summarizing his insights into cultivating iron-eating beasts, planning to give it to Shi Yu before he left.
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu knocked on the door and entered.
“Have they finished eating?” Lin Hongnian asked. “It’s still to their liking, right?”
Lin Xiuzhu pondered. “It should be very suitable. Shi Yu is alright. That little Metal-eating Beast ate a lot.”
Lin Hongnian smiled and said, “If it really is as self-disciplined as you say, it probably will have a lot of exercise. It’s normal to eat a little more.”
Lin Xiuzhu said, “Electricity Mine, Iron Bamboo, Iron Heart Wood, Gold Spirit Mine Spring, and the growth package of the special gold and lightning dual-element energy crystals in our dojo. It ate the double portion of normal Iron-eating Beast training.”
Lin Hongnian raised his brows. “That is indeed a lot, but that’s normal.”
“But this is only their appetite in the afternoon when they only fought one battle and didn’t do any training…”
Lin Hongnian fell into deep thought.
He felt that he had to prepare more food resources in the future.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. He still had enough food. It was just an Awakening Stage Iron-eating Beast. No matter how much nutrition was needed, would it be more than when it needed to grow into a commander rank Iron-eating Beast?
At the same time.
Shi Yu was taking a walk in the martial arts hall. He was in a good mood.
With the guarantee of absolute sleep and accelerated digestion in the Beast Taming Space, he didn’t have to worry about Eleven eating too much. He could completely absorb the nutrition.
At this speed, he was confident that he could nurture Eleven to transcendent level in a few months.
In this world, the average lifespan of iron-eating beasts was around 35 years old.
Usually, when wild iron-eating beasts had sufficient nutrition and good growth conditions, it would take about ten years for them to naturally grow to the transcendent level.
Generally speaking, iron-eating beasts around this age had long become adults. They were in their mature prime and could be considered the normal growth speed of the iron-eating beasts.
As for the Iron-eating Beasts with Beast Tamers, they could accelerate the process. For example, Eleven. It looked like there was hope of accelerating his growth to the transcendent level before it became two years old.
“In the vocation assessment, there’s no need to worry too much about Eleven’s level, but my own level…”
Shi Yu stopped. It looked like he had to see if there were any cultivation resources that Beast Tamers could use. Just the supplements weren’t enough.
In the evening.
Shi Yu planned to bid farewell to Lin Hongnian and Lin Xiuzhu and go home for the night. After all, there seemed to be a worm at home that he needed to feed.
Before leaving, Lin Xiuzhu handed the metal-eating beast advanced training manual to Shi Yu.
“This contains the training method for each stage of the Thunder Palm. Remember to keep it well. All the best!”
After Lin Xiuzhu handed the skill manual to Shi Yu, he waved his fist.
She could tell that her father had placed all his hopes on Shi Yu, hoping that Shi Yu would nurture the iron-eating beast to break through the racial limit.
Shi Yu took the skill training manual and looked at Lin Xiuzhu. “Don’t worry…”
As long as there was enough food in the dojo, Eleven would not disappoint everyone’s expectations. Otherwise, Eleven would not feel at ease eating this meal.
Eleven wasn’t like him, who could accept everything with a clear conscience.
It was said that after a Beast Tamer and their pets contracted for a long time, their personalities would affect each other. Shi Yu was also very curious as to who could affect whom between him and Eleven…
…
At night, when Shi Yu returned home, the green worm was still sleeping.
Apart from eating, this guy slept. He was even more of an iron-eating beast than Eleven.
Since it was sleeping, Shi Yu decided not to feed him anymore…
After a simple shower, Shi Yu prepared supplements and called Eleven over.
“Wuu—”
After so many times, according to Shi Yu’s tone, Eleven knew what he wanted to do to it!
Eleven obediently ran over to the training hall. After staying at the Bamboo Stone Dojo for the whole afternoon, it had an eye-opener.
The attitude displayed by Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast deeply attracted Little Eleven.
Eleven: (? ? ? ? ?) ? “Come on, Beast Tamer! Show me your limits!”
“You’re getting more and more accepting…” Shi Yu was speechless.
However, in Eleven’s opinion, it was just harvesting results in advance. It was overdrafting consumption, training, and sweat before replenishing it. Was there a problem? No problem.
Skill: Thunder Palm
Skill Level: Intermediate
< Introduction > It’s a thunder-type skill. It gathers high-intensity electricity in the palm, making the palm like a sharp blade with strong penetration power. It has a paralyzing effect.
Status: Can be taught
Shi Yu had a day off today and planned to only teach mid-level skills.
Buzz!
After Shi Yu added the points, Eleven’s Thunder Palm proficiency immediately went from initial level to proficient level.
As for Shi Yu, he fell asleep after drinking less than half a cup of honey milk.
Eleven looked at Shi Yu and dragged him to the bed. After covering him with the blanket, it immediately ran into the courtyard.
The long night was coming, but Eleven had absolute sleep at its side. Did it care about the night? It didn’t care.
Tonight, it was going to train hard and combine the Thunder Palm and Hardening.
Tonight would pass like this, night after night.

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - Panda King Eleven
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Panda King Eleven
On August 4, early in the morning, hunger woke Shi Yu up.
When a weakened person skipped just one meal, the hunger would be unbearable. They had to be full in the morning, afternoon, and evening.
“Ha—” Shi Yu yawned and stretched before getting out of bed.
Shi Yu put on his cat slippers and pushed the door open.
In the courtyard, Shi Yu wasn’t sure if Eleven had slept that night. When he went out, he happened to see Eleven sitting under the tree thinking about bear life.
In the birdcage on the tree, the green worm looked at Eleven quietly because it didn’t sleep as soundly as Shi Yu. It was woken up by this bear.
“Ji—”
The green worm shed tears. Not only had it seen the steel plate training at four in the morning, it had also seen the Iron-eating beast that stayed up late to discharge electricity!
Under the moonlight, the lightning was dazzling, like thousands of birds crying together. How could it sleep!
“What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu casually asked Eleven.
“Wuu!”
Eleven turned around and stretched out her hand. It meant that it was so difficult to combine Hardening and Thunder Palm…
It seemed a little difficult to assemble the expert level Hardening and proficient level Thunder Palm.
It studied for the entire night. It tried supper plus absolute sleep plus constant trying, but it still didn’t successfully complete the combination skill.
“Then the skill proficiency is still lacking. It’s alright, let’s eat first. I’ll give you some more later.”
“You can make it up after you work hard.”
What a Beast Tamer who was good at understanding his panda’s will.
…
Using this breakfast, Shi Yu got Eleven and the Green Silkworm to destroy the remaining food resources in the house.
After that, he would just go to the dojo to eat.
However, the dojo was too far away. It was a waste of time to go there every day. After all, he might not necessarily need to use the training equipment of the dojo every day…
Well, he would go and ask later if they provided packing and take-out services.
That day.
Shi Yu arrived at the dojo again.
However, this time, not only was Panda Senior not around, but Lin Hongnian was also preparing to go out.
This was also normal. Senior Panda spent most of her time studying Iron-eating beasts in the breeding base. Meanwhile, as a master-level Beast Tamer, it was impossible for Lin Hongnian to stay in the martial arts hall all the time.
“Shi Yu.”
“You participated in the assessment at Mt. Tian Mang, so you probably want to explore that ruin.”
Before leaving, Lin Hongnian asked.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“According to the feedback of the Beast Tamer trainees in the Beast Tamer Troops, that ruin is indeed very suitable for training. With your strength, you might have an unexpected gain.”
“Jiang Rui and the others will also explore the ruins this time. You guys can compete again.”
Lin Hongnian looked in the direction of the snow mountain and sighed slightly. “I’m leaving Ping Cheng for a period of time. If you have anything you don’t understand in the martial arts hall, you can ask Xiuzhu directly.”
Master Lin left in a hurry, and Shi Yu had yet to ask if there was any delivery service at the dojo… Helpless, he could only run to the canteen to ask.
In the canteen, the middle-aged man said, “Of course. Most of the Iron-eating Beast nutritional supplements and food in Ping Cheng, no, Icefield City are basically ordered here. There has to be a delivery service.”
“Hall Master Lin said that you can freely use the cultivation resources of the dojo and support delivery. You just need to tell me the number, address, and delivery time.”
“Alright, thank you.”
When he heard that it could be delivered to his door, Shi Yu immediately felt comfortable. Then… he would first order three times the normal Iron-eating Beast’s appetite daily.
However, from the looks of it, Panda Senior’s family was more generous than he imagined!
That made sense. How could a normal family afford a private panda breeding base?
After making an appointment for three days of food resources, Shi Yu left the dojo.
“Three more days.”
There were still three days to the exploration of the ruins organized by the Beast Tamer Association.
On August 7, Shi Yu could follow the large group into the ruins.
Because he had heard that it was a trial-type ruin, Shi Yu decided to take advantage of the past three days to desperately increase Eleven’s strength again using the skill index.
Now that he had so many supplements, food, and nutritional supplements, Eleven’s strength could definitely welcome an explosive increase.
After returning, Shi Yu directly prepared all the supplements and started teaching Eleven how to use deterrence!
He planned to first teach all the high-level skills before helping Eleven increase the proficiency of Hardening and Thunder Palm to complete the combination skill.
Eleven covered its eyes and left a gap to silently bear the weight.
Skill: Deterrence
Skill Level: Advanced
<Introduction> It’s a spiritual skill. It can intimidate, overwhelm, and lead creatures with its aura. It can also make creatures much weaker than itself faint. It’s a symbol of “king aptitude”.
Status: Can be taught
At a certain level, the deterrence skill could actually be said to be a common skill. Transcendent creatures above the level of monarchs could automatically awaken it.
However, among awakened, transcendent, and commander rank pets, it would be very impressive if they could master deterrence.
It had not grown to the level of a monarch, but it could grasp deterrence in advance. This almost represented that this pet had the potential of a monarch.
As the largest official breeding base in Icefield City, there were really crouching tigers and hidden dragons. Powerful beasts all around them. It seemed that the owner of that snow wolf was not simple either.
Shi Yu didn’t know much about deterrence skills.
He only knew the symbol effect of deterring for the first three proficiency stages.
Initial level: Intimidate the opponent, weaken the opponent’s fighting spirit, and increase one’s own willpower. It has a certain commanding effect on creatures of the same race.
Proficient level: It can directly destroy the opponent’s will and stun the opponent, causing mental damage.
Expert Level: Can carry out a large-scale deterrence. A glance can make countless creatures faint with spiritual aura.
As for Perfect Level Proficiency and Transcendent Level Proficiency, he really couldn’t find it on his cell phone. However, Shi Yu could guess it pretty easily.
In short, being classified as an advanced level skill, the skill potential was naturally very high.
“Teach.”
“From today onwards, you are the Panda King, Eleven!”
Shi Yu reached out and touched Eleven’s head.
As the light flowed in, Shi Yu swallowed the divine bean with difficulty before heaving a sigh of relief.
At this moment…
In the empty courtyard, as Shi Yu completed his teaching, Eleven closed his eyes to receive the experience. Time seemed to have stopped.
One second, two seconds, three seconds…
A moment later, Eleven opened its eyes. The fallen leaves on the ground trembled. There was clearly no wind, but all the leaves rustled. The scene was extremely abnormal.
Boom!!!
A moment later, Eleven opened its eyes. The fallen leaves on the ground trembled without wind. There was clearly no wind, but all the leaves rustled. The scene was extremely abnormal.
