A young little king of beasts was still a king.
Eleven opened its bright eyes. Every movement revealed a natural domineering aura, blooming with a ferocity that made one’s heart tremble.
“That’s it???”
However, Eleven soon couldn’t hold it in anymore and was questioned by the Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu looked at the strange and cute Iron-eating beast in front of him and did not feel the aura at all.
Damn, the appearance of the Iron-eating beast cub was too harmless!!!
Even with the support of mental deterrence, the effect was limited at the moment.
It seemed that Eleven had to grow up a little or multiply in order to make the enemy truly afraid in terms of vision.
“Wuu.”
Eleven canceled the uncontrollable deterrence skill and showed an aggrieved expression.
This skill didn’t feel that useful… It didn’t understand the effect.
“Ji—”
However, just as Shi Yu and Eleven were complaining that the deterrence skill was still waiting to be upgraded, the green worm with white eyes fell from the tree. It had been affected by the deterrence.
Looking at the green worm that had fainted on the pile of leaves, Shi Yu and Eleven fell into deep thought.
Shi Yu: “Deterrence Skill… Isn’t it only at the proficient level that there’s a certain level of mental shock effect??”
But this Green Silkworm…
The corners of his mouth quickly twitched as he understood. The weakest of the pet world. As expected of you, you can be scared even by this?

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - Combination Skill Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Combination Skill Success
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
For the current Eleven, the practical value of the deterrence skill was temporarily not comparable to the absolute sleep and multiplication skills. Of course, compared to the combination skill of hardening and thunder palm, its value was temporarily inferior as well.
Therefore, after thinking about it, Shi Yu decided to continue following the original plan and help Eleven perfect the first combination skill.
According to the standard, the combination of two perfect-level skills was called a profundity… This standard was still a little early for Eleven. It was mainly because Shi Yu’s body couldn’t hold on, and the supplements might not be enough.
Therefore, they planned to pursue ordinary combination skills first.
In theory, as long as the proficiency of the two skills were above the proficient level and the skills were compatible, there was a hope of forming a combination skill.
Lin Hongnian hadn told Shi Yu the minimum requirements for the Hardening and Thunder Palm combination skill.
Expert Level Hardening and Proficient Level Thunder Palm.
Eleven had already reached this threshold, but even if it was the same proficiency, there would definitely be a gap.
Although he had reached the minimum standard, after a night of hard work, Eleven realized that he was clearly lacking in firepower to complete the combination skill.
What else could he do? Continue training… No, continue increasing his points!
Shi Yu also went for it with all his strength.
After teaching deterrence, he swallowed a divine bean and gulped down the Happy Water. He finished most of the remaining bottles from yesterday.
Just like that, there were two more of the five divine beans left. There was still a third of the bottle of Hundred Flower Queen Bee’s Happy Water left. As for Baby Ginseng’s five roots, they hadn’t been touched yet.
It was almost night four when Shi Yu recovered and planned to teach Eleven Thunder Palm again.
“Wuu—”
In the courtyard, Shi Yu and Eleven looked at each other.
Eleven, who had trained independently for a long time, looked at Shi Yu and took a step back.
Although it said that it wanted to see the limits of Beast Tamers…
However, judging from Shi Yu’s appearance, it was very afraid that Shi Yu would suddenly die!
The frequency of teaching skills was much higher than before.
Eleven took another small step back and turned around. Forget it, I’ll train myself first.
Shi Yu decided to go for it.
“It’s not a big problem.”
Shi Yu reached out and pulled Eleven back.
He could still hold on!
If he didn’t work hard despite having a cheat, he was no different from a salted fish.
It was mainly because of the strengthening feedback from the skill index that he recovered very well every time.
Therefore, as long as there were supplements, he could still persist.
The skill index was not only a pet’s strengthening cheat, but also his strengthening cheat.
After teaching for so long, every time his weakened state recovered, Shi Yu could feel that he was slowly becoming stronger.
It wasn’t that the various attributes of the Beast Taming Space in the Beast Tamer system had become stronger.
Instead, Shi Yu felt that his physique was becoming stronger.
Every time he recovered from his weakened state, he would be full of strength.
Although the one-time increase was not as obvious as the feedback from when the pets became stronger, the frequency was higher.
After all, it was not easy for a pet to level up even once. However, teaching a skill once and recovering from a weakened state took less than a day or two.
It looked like every time he finished teaching the skill, Shi Yu was recuperating, but this process, in terms of training, was really often.
Therefore, frequently using the skill index and supplements, Shi Yu didn’t just upgrade his pet. During this process, he was also strengthening his physique.
Although the increase in the current feedback effect wasn’t very large, and his physique hadn’t undergone a qualitative change like that of a professional Beast Tamer, it would accumulate.
After all, it had only been less than a month.
Shi Yu’s final goal was to be like the protagonist of a certain cartoon where he could fight against pet skills with his body.
At that time, he could directly transform into a Super Earthling. When he courted death, his safety would also greatly increase.
“Eh, why do I subconsciously want to court death?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Perhaps… Although courting death was very dangerous, it was also very joyful?
In short, with so many supplements now, it would be a waste not to use the skill index.
It was not only to make Eleven stronger quickly, but also to have a good body!
The price of strengthening the body was to fall into a weakened state first. It was a little painful.
Shi Yu sighed slightly. Then, he opened the Thunder Palm page again and chose to teach.
“Pa!”
He pressed a palm on Eleven’s head.
After the teaching was completed, Shi Yu’s eyes sank in. He was tired.
He was much more tired than after teaching the worm silk. He wished he could never wake up again.
Shi Yu was so shocked that he hurriedly chewed the whiskers of a ginseng baby to calm himself down.
“This thing’s recovery is so slow!”
After the teaching was completed, Shi Yu stared at the words [Cooldown Time] and felt that the time was altered even less than the joy water.
As expected of the cheapest supplement he had bought…
However, no matter how cheap it was, it was still worth 50,000 yuan. Shi Yu compared it with the price of the divine beans and the honey. He felt that Baby Ginseng’s whiskers should be able to recover from at least 40 hours of weakness.
Next, it was time to wait for his body to recover to its peak condition… Shi Yu glanced at the sky and decided to wait in his sleep.
“Wuuu!!!”
At this moment, Eleven was almost done accepting the Thunder Palm experience.
Its previous Thunder Palm was at the proficient level. After this, its proficiency level increased.
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, the next time he taught Thunder Palm, its proficiency in Thunder Palm would increase to expert level.
At this moment, after sensing a new understanding of the Thunder Palm, Eleven’s eyes lit up with vitality. He couldn’t wait to try the combination skill.
“Ji—”
However, a certain pet seemed to be very uncomfortable…
In the birdcage on the tree in the courtyard, the Green Silkworm, which had recovered from its fainting state, looked at Eleven, aggrieved.
“Ji—”
Don’t come over!!!
It just wanted to sleep soundly. Was it that difficult?
Buggy cried. It looked at the round moon and looked at Shi Yu for help.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Cough.”
Shi Yu made a decision. It seemed that Eleven was indeed too hardworking.
Although there was enough food and the absolute sleep skill for it to quickly recover stamina, its mental health should be taken care of too.
“Alright.” Shi Yu pulled Eleven back and said, “In any case, with Absolute Sleep, you don’t have to return to the Beast Taming Space.”
“You rest for the night.”
“Coincidentally, I want to sleep on a panda pillow.”
Under the green worm’s grateful gaze, Shi Yu dragged the confused Eleven into the house.
In the room, Shi Yu stroked Panda Eleven’s hair at an astonishing speed. Then, he shook its head and made it shrink.
Then, Shi Yu touched Eleven’s hair again. As expected, the softness was more suitable, and the size was more suitable.
Tonight, he would be rewarded with a night of sleep with a panda pillow.
On another day, he would reward himself with the panda bed after having Eleven become big.
“Wuu!” Eleven originally wanted to resist and train.
However, Shi Yu completely fell asleep and lay on it.
Eleven was slightly stunned. It knew that he couldn’t train tonight…
Next, in order not to wake the weak Beast Tamer, it could only slowly relax its body and soften its body. In the end, it gradually closed its eyes.
…
The next day, at four in the morning.
“I hate it!”
Shi Yu looked at Eleven, who was planning to get up and train, angrily. He supported his chin on the bed and watched it quietly.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven looked at Shi Yu seriously.
It had rested enough. It was time to train!!!
Together!!
“What a pain…” Shi Yu rubbed his eyes. Eleven didn’t need to enter the Beast Taming Space anymore, but it had become his time alarm.
However, as he had recovered pretty well, Shi Yu simply got up after sighing.
August 5th.
Shi Yu taught Eleven Thunder Palm again.
Eleven’s Thunder Palm directly entered the expert level.
At this moment, it could already control the lightning energy with both hands.
However, due to the restriction on its growth level, its physical fitness still couldn’t keep up, and it couldn’t maintain the Normal Thunder Palm for a long time.
Shi Yu felt that… he might have to find a physical strengthening skill for Eleven.
As if hearing Shi Yu’s request, Eleven underwent a growth transformation today and finally reached Level 7 Awakening.
In a month, it went from level three to level seven. The growth was astonishing.
However, these weren’t the greatest gains.
The greatest gain was that after the Thunder Palm reached the expert level, there was no need for Eleven to practice too much. Hardening and the Thunder Palm formed naturally.
Ji, ji…
In the courtyard, Eleven looked at the blue and white electric current on its hardened palm and was pleasantly surprised.
The strength of the hardening, in addition to the penetration power of the lightning… It was considered a dual physical and elemental attack. In terms of destructive power, the unpalatable steel plates at home had become experimental subjects.
Bang!
Eleven could already easily penetrate the steel plate with one palm.
“Wuu—”
Looking at the broken steel plate on the ground, Eleven let out a king’s cry.
It swelled.
If it encountered that elite Iron-eating Beast again, it would definitely be able to insta-kill it! The Panda King had to beat down Elite Guy!
“His name is Jiang Rui, not elite guy.”
“Eat the steel plate, don’t waste it…”
Shi Yu was fussing at the side. Although he was rich now, he still had to maintain his frugal spirit…
The expanding panda looked rather aggrieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - Departure
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Departure
On the day that Eleven completed the initial Hardening and Lightning Palm combination skill, Shi Yu used the ginseng baby whiskers to replenish his health again.
In the afternoon, he taught hardening again without any burden.
This time, it was considered the third lesson on the foundation of Eleven’s expert level Hardening.
After that, Shi Yu’s teaching intensity temporarily decreased.
They were about to enter the ruins the day after tomorrow. Although there were supplements, they had to control themselves a little. After all, the weakened state still had some psychological impact.
It didn’t matter if he had a good physique. Shi Yu felt tired!
Beast Tamers had to worry about their lives.
Relying on the Happy Water to replenish his energy for the night, Shi Yu taught the worm silk skill again before sleeping.
August 6th.
Shi Yu’s teaching frequency slowed down again. He only taught hardening once during the day.
In addition to the worm silk that night, with the supplements, his condition was basically adjusted to its optimal state.
In short, after the assessment at Mt. Tian Mang ended, Shi Yu basically spent the entire week at home to increase his strength.
Apart from going to Bamboo Stone Dojo a few times, he didn’t go anywhere else.
And the achievements he obtained were naturally extraordinary.
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
[Level of Growth]: Level 7 Awakening
[Skill]: Hardening (Expert+4), Thunder Palm (Expert), Super Sight (Proficient), High Speed Healing (Proficient), Deterrence (Initiate), Absolute Sleep (Initiate), Multiplication (Initiate)
< Name > Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: Level 7 Awakening
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Expert+6)
Up to now, Eleven had already mastered two expert-level skills, two proficient-level skills, and three entry-level high-level skills.
Among them, one of the two expert skills was a mid level skill. Although the other was a low-level skill, it was Eleven’s own racial skill. Moreover, it was taught four more times by the skill index after reaching expert level.
It could be said that although Eleven’s growth level was only at level seven, in terms of battle power, Shi Yu felt that it was comparable to the cub of a monarch-level transcendent creature of the same race…
As Eleven’s Beast Tamer, Shi Yu really wanted to retreat strategically. This little guy was already invincible among its peers.
At this strengthening speed, Eleven was getting out of control.
Well… As for being comparable to a young divine beast, Shi Yu didn’t have any fantasies. After all, he didn’t know how powerful a young divine beast was.
To be precise, he didn’t know much about the cubs of monarch and overlord-level creatures.
As for the Green Silkworm, it had been taught so many times that its growth speed was naturally very fast.
After the Worm Silk Expert level, it basically increased its growth level every two times he used “teach” on it. Its growth speed was far faster than Eleven’s, and it had directly caught up to Eleven’s growth level.
Of course, this was also related to the fact that it was an insect-type creature. Although its growth level had increased, its battle power was obviously weak.
As a result, Shi Yu did not pay much attention to the changes in its growth level. After all, before its evolution, the growth level of the green worm had no reference value.
“After entering the ruins, I’ll see if there are suitable evolution materials inside. If there are any gains…”
On the morning of August 7, Shi Yu said to the dispirited Green silkworm. If he had any gains, he felt that he could take the time to nurture the worm next.
After all, if he could nurture a monarch-level Green silkworm to evolve, he would have a second contracted pet. At that time, it and Eleven would be a pretty cool combination!
“Ji—”
Shi Yu welcomed the Green Silkworm’s cry filled with complicated emotions…
…
Today was the day that the professional Zhou Wanshan of the training base at Mt. Tian Mang mentioned to lead the candidates into the ruins.
Shi Yu asked around these two days. Combined with Lu Qingyi’s introduction previously, he had a deeper understanding of this ruin.
Only Beast Trainers with a level-one Beast Taming Space could enter this ruins steadily.
Apart from Beast Tamers of this level and their contracted pets, any other creature that entered either caused the instability of the ruins or couldn’t see anything after entering. They also couldn’t come into contact with the things inside the ruins.
As he had obtained information about the interior of the ruins, Shi Yu considered it for a moment. For the time being, he did not bring the burden, the Green Silkworm, along with him like he did during the previous training. Mainly, because there was no connection to the Beast Taming Space, he could not guarantee that the Green Silkworm could successfully enter the ruins and not leave him at all times.
In short, this place was very strange. It was so strange that it seemed to have been specially customized for Shi Yu. It was very difficult for Shi Yu not to guess that someone was behind this, waiting for him to explore.
It seemed like an unknown life form was controlling the ruins, as if it wanted to test Shi Yu!
This was Shi Yu’s guess.
After all, no matter what, this ruin was awakened by him.
Of course, it was also possible that it wasn’t a life form, but the “spirit” Lu Qingyi mentioned, which was also a trace of history that produced consciousness.
Until now, no one had been able to completely research a consciousness like “spirit”.
Early in the morning, Shi Yu returned Eleven to the Beast Taming Space at home and headed to the Beast Tamer Association with some anticipation.
No matter what secret was hidden in this ruin, he, the Mythical Scholar, the Archeologist, and the Beast Tamer, Shi Yu, had decided to explore it.
He had to finish exploring the ruins he had summoned even if he had to cry.
“This day has finally come.” The archeological soul in Shi Yu’s body became active again.
Indeed, it was better to go out and court death. After this addiction, he would definitely develop well and lead a stable life.
That morning.
About 80 people gathered at the designated location of the Beast Tamer Association.
These 80 people were all elites among the Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng.
Their pets’ growth levels were basically above level seven. Moreover, their species level was not low, and they had proficient racial skills.
Most of these people were geniuses who had passed the Beast Tamer Association’s assessment.
Apart from those who accepted the assessment and obtained spots, there were also candidates directly recommended by the local dojos and schools.
For example, apprentices like Jiang Rui from the Bamboo Stone Dojo were recommended by the Bamboo Stone Dojo. They could follow this trip directly into the ruins to explore.
To be precise, this exploration was the third exploration of the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng.
The first exploration was when the ruins first appeared. Beast Tamers of various levels in the vicinity came to study the ruins.
During that exploration, they discovered the secret that only trainee Beast Tamers could better excavate the ruins.
The second exploration was when the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng mobilized the elite soldiers of the local Beast Tamer Corps and sent them to explore the ruins.
During this exploration, the Beast Tamer Association roughly understood what kind of ruins this was.
This was the third large-scale exploration.
The Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng had organized outstanding Beast Tamers from all walks of life in Ping Cheng!
This exploration was a trial for the Beast Tamer trainees in Ping Cheng, and also a gift!
After all, according to the experience of the previous exploration, there was still a certain amount of rare resources in the ruins. Although it was very difficult to obtain, it did exist.
Seizing the opportunity, every explorer had the hope of using this to increase their strength.
“I wonder if anyone in this batch of Beast Tamers can crack the ruins.”
In the tall building of the Beast Tamer Association, the president of the Association in a gray suit silently watched the latest batch of explorers gathered below.
This ruin had descended in Ping Cheng. According to the Dong Huang Ruins Method, the local Beast Tamer Association had the priority to explore.
However, if the Association of the Region couldn’t crack the ruins within a certain period of time and control it completely, the exploration rights of the ruins would gradually be opened.
It would be publicized to the nearby districts, counties, and cities!
At the moment, the priority to explore this ruin was still Ping Cheng.
But after a month, if they couldn’t crack the ruins, the Beast Tamers in the other districts, counties, and even downtown areas of Icefield City could come and explore and share the pie.
If it was still impossible to crack after a period of time, the Beast Tamers of the cities outside of Icefield City could also interfere in this ruin. At that time, the resources obtained would not belong to Ping Cheng or even Icefield City.
Therefore, the president of the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng hoped that the candidate to crack the ruins would appear in Ping Cheng. This was because only in this way would Ping Cheng City’s Beast Tamer Association and Ping Cheng gain more benefits.
If he missed this opportunity to develop quickly, he might not encounter such a good thing again.
…
“A total of three familiar faces?”
There were only 80 people in total. After careful observation, it was still easy to recognize.
Outside the Beast Tamer Association, Shi Yu saw the top student, Chen Kai. This fellow was pretty lucky to have barely entered the top 20 of the assessment.
In addition to Chen Kai, he also saw Jiang Rui from the Bamboo Stone Dojo and the other four apprentices.
Because he had only fought Jiang Rui, he was more familiar with this person.
Apart from them, Shi Yu also saw the young doctor from the Hundred Herb Hall’s pharmacy beside his house. This fellow was also a Beast Tamer intern. She was the one who had told Shi Yu about the ruins. Shi Yu didn’t expect her to come too.
To be precise, there was still a familiar face left. It was the judge who presided over the competition between him and Chen Kai that day, White Stone.
He wasn’t very old either, looking to be in his twenties. It looked like he was also a Beast Tamer intern. However, for him to be a judge of the battlefield hall, apart from being a judge and a graduate of the venue management specialization… His strength must be pretty good.
“Everyone’s here, right?”
Seeing that it was about time, a man in a gray suit with narrowed eyes walked out of the association.
Seeing this person, the 80 Beast Trainers stopped talking.
The president of the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng… Master-level Beast Tamer!
“Then let’s go.” He narrowed his eyes and said to his secretary beside him.
Soon, the sound of a large car engine that had stopped outside the Beast Tamer Association rumbled as it started.
“Everyone, get in the car in an orderly manner. Next, I’ll lead you to the entrance of the ruins.”
In the crowd, Shi Yu followed in the car. Chen Kai, Jiang Rui, and the others also saw Shi Yu, but because they had other companions, they only greeted Shi Yu.
However, the young doctor from the pharmacy was alone. He took the initiative to sit beside Shi Yu.
He said, “Good lord, why are you here too?”
“Your body… is it alright???”
Although Shi Yu had not bought supplements from him for nearly half a month, the young doctor still had a pretty deep impression of Shi Yu.
“There’s nothing wrong with my body. It’s very good,” Shi Yu said.
The young doctor smiled, clearly not buying it.
How could he buy medicine at that frequency if he was in good health?
However, he didn’t expect Shi Yu to obtain the qualification to enter the ruins.
It looked like he was still an inspirational Beast Trainer.
“It’s strange. I don’t know why, but recently, the ‘Refreshing Capsules’ from various pharmacies have been selling very quickly. Our pharmacy is the same. Previously, I was worried that you would come over to buy it and run out of stock.”
The young doctor sighed. He was indeed lacking in goods a few days ago, but Shi Yu happened to not come again.
“Uh…” Shi Yu was speechless. So fast?
Previously, Chen Kai had done it because of him. It couldn’t be this time, right? Well, it had nothing to do with him.
Shi Yu was just about to say something when he was suddenly interrupted.
The president of the Ping Cheng Association followed the Beast Tamers.
At the front, like the tour guide, he looked at the rookies with a gentle smile. “It will take us about 40 minutes to reach our destination.”
“During this process, let me explain some things to take note of when exploring the ruins. You are all elites among the Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng. I really hope that you can obtain good gains in the ruins.”

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - Entering the Ruins
chapters.content:
56  Entering the Ruins
Icefield City, in a valley on the outskirts of Ping Cheng.
There were already many layers of blockades established here. There was a Beast Tamer Corps stationed here, and more than ten professional Beast Tamers were present. Their goal was to protect the entrance of the ruins that appeared in the valley.
Outside the silent valley, soldiers stood guard everywhere like towering rocks. They only turned when they heard the sound of a car driving.
After discovering that it was a vehicle gifted by the Beast Tamer Association, a sergeant gave the order:
"Let it in!"
The next moment, the pass at the sealed area opened, and the car Shi Yu and the others were in successfully entered the valley.
"We're here."
After a bump, the group from the Beast Tamer Association finally arrived at their destination. In the car, Shi Yu looked out the window and felt that the environment was unfamiliar.
He had never been to this place before, but from the surrounding environment, it seemed to be pure natural, unlike Mt. Tian Mang where there were signs of artificial modification.
Such a place… was usually more dangerous.
"I'm starting to look forward to it." Beside Shi Yu, the young doctor, Qiao Liang, was overwhelmed with emotions.
"Ruins? I didn't expect to have the chance to come into contact with them."
"I originally planned to be a medicine seller for the rest of my life. Looks like there's still a chance to change my luck…"
"If I don't gain anything this time, I won't struggle to be a professional Beast Tamer anymore. I might as well live in peace with my girlfriend who I had just gotten engaged to in her hometown."
Qiao Liang looked at the photo of his girlfriend in his wallet and asked Shi Yu, "You definitely don't have a partner yet, right?"
Well, after all, his body was so weak. Which girl would like that?
Shi Yu shot him a glance and said, "Do you know what you're doing?"
"In our hometown, your behavior is called setting flags."
It was usually very difficult to return safely.
They were showing off their love to him? Didn't they know that archeologists were all wiped out in movies?
Shi Yu did not expect that this doctor was even better than him in establishing a Flag!
"Uh."
The doctor clearly realized that he had made too many red flags and couldn't help but feel guilty.
Sigh… The association had already confirmed that the ruins aren't too dangerous. It should be fine, right? He thought.
"But speaking of which, the ruins this time have made those soldiers suffer…"
He hurriedly changed the topic. "The Beast Tamer Troops are strong because of their teamwork, but this ruin can only be explored independently, greatly weakening their performance. It's not surprising that they can't overcome the ruin."
The young doctor looked at the Beast Tamer Corps' probationary-level soldiers standing guard and resting in the outside camp and said, "Although their personal qualities are good in various aspects, they might not necessarily have an advantage over us in terms of pet cultivation."
In this day and age, the Beast Tamers who went to the Beast Tamer Troops basically had poor family conditions.
They contracted the pets distributed by the association, received unified training, and used quantitative resources. Perhaps the teamwork, combat, willpower, and execution were very good, but after all, the resources the association could provide to the base members of the army were limited. Compared to some Beast Tamers who were willing to pay a lot of money to their pets, these soldiers would definitely be lacking in some aspects.
Of course, it couldn't be ruled out that some Beast Tamers were rich and had also gone to accept the arduous training of the army camp. Such a big boss would indeed be very strong.
However, such a person would only go to the special elite training camp in the city. It was unlikely that they would stay in a small Ping Cheng.
If the Beast Tamer trainees of the Beast Tamer Troops could level the ruins, the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng wouldn't place their hopes on these Beast Tamer trainees from various fields anymore.
"Perhaps…" Shi Yu had just finished speaking when he was immediately interrupted.
"Alright, we've arrived at our destination. Let's get off."
The car drove all the way outside the center of the blockade line, and as the president in the car stood up and spoke, the intern Beast Tamers in the car became restless.
In accordance with the order, the Beast Tamers in the car started to get off.
In the car just now, President Feng introduced the environment of the valley to everyone and the experience concluded by the soldiers of the Beast Troops entering the ruins.
Therefore, when they got out of the car, everyone was already mentally prepared.
"So cold…"
But even so, the environment in the center of the valley still made many Beast Trainers shiver.
It was as if there was no sunlight here and it was filled with cold mist. The people who got out of the car only felt that their vision was blurred.
In the environment he was in, it seemed that he could only see a withered sun on the horizon.
A thin layer of frost hung on the surrounding mountains, trees, and plants. This was under the premise that the surrounding camp had heating facilities. Otherwise, the surroundings would probably be even colder.
According to President Feng, the elemental creatures in the ruins were mainly ice-element creatures. At the moment, the ruins space and the blue planet space were in a half overlapping state, so the internal situation affected the outside world.
It wasn't just the temperature that was affected… Everyone looked at the six stone giant statues in the heavily sealed area, which were several meters tall, and the thing in the center that looked like a formation, and fell into deep thought.
This was what appeared after the ruins overlapped with Blue Planet, the "Earth" that Shi Yu was in right now.
The formation protected in the middle by the six stone giants was the spatial door that led to the ruins.
As for the six stone giant statues, they seemed to be guardians of the ruins, but they were clearly dead.
"This…"
When Shi Yu saw the stone giant statues around the arena, he felt a little panicked.
After all, this stone giant statue looked a little similar to the one in the Association Garden District… He had broken off the conversation with the previous one. Could these be its relatives or something?
At the moment, as everyone looked at the six stone giant stone statues, they could clearly see that the first two stone statues flickered with light, while the other four were dim.
President Feng of the Ping Cheng Association stood forward and said, "According to our guess, these six stone statues might represent the cracking progress of the ruins."
"Our Beast Tamers of the Beast Tamer Troops triggered the stone statue's reaction when they passed the first two trials in the ruins."
11:09
"Therefore, we speculate that there are a total of six stages in this ruin. As everyone Although President Feng had already told everyone about this in the car, everyone couldn't help but feel puzzled when they saw the six stone statues.
If the Beast Tamer Corps' intern Beast Tamer could only pass two stages… How many more stages could they themselves overcome?
Because they had heard the information about the checkpoints in the car, most of the people present did not even have the confidence to pass the three levels.
Not to mention the last three stages that had no information at all.
President Feng smiled and said to everyone, "You don't have to feel too much pressure."
"Every time you pass a level, the ruins will give a certain amount of rewards. This is a very good opportunity to improve yourselves."
"Besides, this isn't the only opportunity for you to enter. In the next month, you can enter at any time and undergo repeated challenges."
"The nearby camp is equipped with an infirmary, a resting area, and perfect facilities. After the backup work, it will all be prepared by the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng. Your mission is to challenge the checkpoint as much as possible and work hard to become stronger!"
"Tell me, are you confident!!!" President Feng's narrowed eyes suddenly widened as he shouted.
This change directly gave many Beast Trainers a fright, making some people subconsciously reply loudly, "Yes!!!"
"Very good!" President Feng said. "Prepare yourselves a little. After you're ready, you can apply to enter the ruins."
"Remember what I said in the car. You have to prioritize your own safety!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the new Beast Trainers nodded.
Nearby, the soldiers guarding the perimeter were silent and expressionless.
Although they didn't say anything, they suspected if these Beast Tamers with different abilities and qualities could really do better than them??
…
In the crowd, Shi Yu listened quietly and continued to recuperate. His gaze kept moving across the stone statues.
Occasionally he would concentrate, trying to see if he could hear any more sounds of history, but there seemed to be nothing.
After observing for a long time, he finally gave up on this behavior. He planned to enter the ruins to take a look.
He sighed. He thought he could awaken the giant of light at once and let the six giants recognize him as their master. Clearly, he was overthinking.
"I don't know about the latter three stages, but maybe I can do the third stage that no one can overcome at the moment."
After analyzing it in his heart, Shi Yu relaxed. He walked to register and decided to enter the ruins immediately.
Not only him, almost all the new Beast Tamers decided to explore the ruins immediately.
Once they passed the ruins trial, they would receive rewards and the honor of representing their strength. Everyone was eager to try such a good thing.
"I feel that this fellow will definitely obtain pretty good results. He might even have a chance of passing the third round."
In the crowd, Chen Kai searched for Shi Yu among the students and thought to himself.
"This monster can definitely pass the third level." Jiang Rui and the others from the Bamboo Stone Dojo also looked at Shi Yu's figure.
It was said that the third trial in the ruins was an Ice Armor Giant with a growth level of tenth level awakening and a low class commander rank.
The Ice-Armored Giant was an elemental transcendent creature. Its strength was not bad, and the few racial skills it had reached the proficient level.
Although this kind of strength couldn't be considered very strong for the new generation geniuses in big cities, it was indeed a little pressure for the Beast Trainers in small places like Ping Cheng.
"Enter."
Soon, someone finished registering and walked to the shining arena's array. Then, the figure blurred and this person disappeared from the spot.
Shi Yu didn't waste too much time. He registered and walked onto the stage, landing on the array in the middle of the six stone giants.
After he went on stage, a few more gazes looked at him, including President Feng of the Ping Cheng Association.
"This person is number one on Mt. Tian Mang's training. The Iron-eating Beast has expert level Hardening?"
"Lin Hongnian asked me to pay attention to him. He said that he would definitely give me a surprise. I want to see what kind of surprise it will be."
As Shi Yu's figure disappeared from the stage, President Feng looked in the direction of the snow mountain. It was really a troubled era this year.
There was a beast tide earlier, and now ruins… He didn't know if the two were related…
This time, apart from the new 80 explorers, the Beast Tamer soldiers who had entered the Beast Tamer Troops previously would also enter again.
The Beast Tamer Association selected a batch of people from among them and focused on nurturing them. Everyone's strength improved temporarily.
For the sake of the exploration speed of the ruins, the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng had already decided to give it their all.
At the same time.
Stepping onto the stage, under the light, Shi Yu, who had decided on the words "enter the ruins", felt his mind go blank.
[After completing the six trials, you can obtain the ownership of the ruins and the key to history.]
In his daze, Shi Yu didn't know if he had heard a new voice. In the next second, he seemed to have undergone Stellar Transposition and Space Transformation as he stepped into another space.
Shi Yu opened his eyes. He was already on a white glacier. It was not large and was surrounded by a spatial crystal wall.
Before he could react, countless ice elements gathered in the distance, and a giant-like creature formed.
< Name > Frost Stone Giant
[Attributes]: Ice
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Ice Hammer, Cold Breath
[Introduction]: A mutation of the stone giant, an Ice Stone Elemental Creature. Its frozen arm hammer is extremely strong, and the cold breath it spewed can easily freeze everything.
The first environment of the ruins was an icy plain space. There was only Shi Yu alone. Inside, there was a Frost Stone Giant with a growth level of eight…
This was the first trial of the ruins.
"Eleven."
Beside Shi Yu, the Little Iron-eating Beast walked out of the Beast Taming Space with an excited expression and looked at the enemy.
The Panda King roared, "Wuu!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - Historical Image
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Historical Image
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
On a large white glacier, Shi Yu looked into the distance.
A hundred meters away, a Frost Stone Giant was floating over.
Although this creature was called a giant, it didn’t look like a person, because it didn’t have a lower body.
Its main body was like an irregular cylindrical shape, its body was fat like a small mountain.
Because it was an elemental creature, it could float at a low altitude. The most eye-catching thing about it was its huge arm that was nearly as tall.
This was the main organ used to cast the Ice Hammer skill.
“This is the first time I’m seeing a Frost Stone Giant…”
Shi Yu smiled and looked at the one eye that looked like an energy crystal on the other party’s huge mouth.
He said rather sincerely, “Hello, friend, we’re actually not here to fight. We were invited by your Big Brother Stone to restore the truth of history.”
“Look, there’s no need for a fight… Just get whatever reward you have…”
Eleven, who was getting ready to fight, was stunned.
“???”
Not fighting?
As expected, Eleven was still too young. Why would Shi Yu fight something that could be solved with a chat?
However, when Shi Yu tried to use telepathy to negotiate, the approaching Frost Stone Giant had already launched an attack. It didn’t care about virtue.
Dozens of meters away, it had already begun to open its mouth and spit cold air.
In an instant, a cold aura that looked like a condensed ice mist swept towards Shi Yu and the others.
A thick layer of ice formed on the glacier land where the icy mist passed.
Its performance power was roughly equivalent to a strengthened version of a fire extinguisher? The ice-blue cold air was like a gradually spreading ray.
It could be said that it was fortunate that this stone giant’s cold breath skill was only at entry-level. Not only was its shooting speed slow, but its frost power was also not strong enough. Otherwise, the first stage would be enough to make many people suffer.
“Tch… I can’t communicate with him.”
“Eleven, directly finish the other party.”
At the same time that Shi Yu took a small step back, he directly issued an order, leaving Eleven speechless. They should have done this from the start!
Eleven looked up and focused. With super vision activated, everything in the outside world seemed to slow down.
The range of the cold aura wasn’t large, and the powerful area was only a few meters. The energy that spread out was only equivalent to ordinary cold air. Eleven, with his thick skin, didn’t even need to harden before choosing to pass through it head-on.
The Frost Stone Giant breathed as it floated closer. Eleven also attacked the stone giant like a ferocious beast. When the two parties were about to get close, the threat of the cold breath increased. In the next instant, it easily dodged the high concentration of cold breath nearby with its super vision and circled around the stone giant, not giving the slow stone giant any chance to react.
Boom!!!
Eleven suddenly pounced over, and only then did the Expert Level Hardening. He hit the Frost Stone Giant with his palm.
Crack!
With just one hit, the three-meter-tall Frost Stone Giant shattered from the hit point, transforming into countless ice elements that disappeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
At the same time, a blue energy crystal fell from the Frost Stone Giant’s disintegrated body.
Moreover, not far away, a bright Teleportation Array appeared on the glacier ground.
“As Lu Qingyi said, the creatures here are indeed not real life forms, but something similar to elemental clones…”
Seeing the Frost Stone Giant collapse, Shi Yu stood on the spot without moving. He quietly looked at the ice elements in the sky.
At the same time, he observed his surroundings and didn’t forget his most important goal of entering the ruins.
What was this place trying to tell him?
“In the most widespread story of the Snow Queen in Icefield City, an ice dragon descended nearby and triggered the Little Ice Age.”
“Then, the Beast Tamer Tribe, which settled in Icefield City in ancient times, started a war with the Ice Dragon.”
“The icy plain environment in the ruins, is it simulating the environment after the Ice Dragon descended?”
As he was guessing… Shi Yu’s mind was in a daze as countless voices entered his ears.
Sounds of battle and communication.
His brain rumbled, and just like the voice of the stone statue, it triggered the traces of history.
At this moment, as the voices interweaved, Shi Yu seemed to see brief images.
It was an image of a group of young boys and girls in ancient clothes resisting the snow mountain beast tide.
The image was very short, and it almost disappeared in a flash. Shi Yu returned to his original state and remained silent on the spot.
“What’s this?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask.
“That… was that something that happened a long time ago?”
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, his gift of listening to the Voice of History had just taken effect again.
He saw the scene of an ancient Beast Tamer riding a Frost Stone Giant and fighting a group of snow mountain ferocious beasts!
Apart from that, there was nothing else.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought again and deduced from the clues he saw.
He simply restored the history of Icefield City according to the current information:
[A Beast Tamer Tribe lived normally around Icefield City. One day, an ice dragon descended and triggered the Little Ice Age.
The Little Ice Age changed the surrounding environment and affected the normal life of this Beast Tamer Tribe, so this Beast Tamer Tribe decided to attack the Ice Dragon.
However, because the ice dragon was too powerful, this Beast Tamer Tribe could only seal it on the snow mountain with special methods.
However, although the ice dragon was successfully sealed, it couldn’t change the already formed environment.
The Beast Tamer tribes could only adapt to new environments. Their totem stone giants also began to mutate towards the Frost Stone Giant.
At the same time, the number of extraordinary creatures with ice attributes had also greatly increased because of the evolution of the environment.
Moreover, due to the influence of the sealed ice dragon, the snow mountain ferocious beasts were very violent and often raised beast tides.
Therefore, for the next hundred years, this Beast Tamer Tribe was doing work to resist the beast tide.
Until now, the Ice Dragon Ruins and the Beast Tide still existed, but this Beast Tamer Tribe had already disappeared for various reasons.
The ruin before them was a mystic realm modified by a legendary Beast Tamer who was about to die after the tribe sealed the ice dragon for a long time. This was to train the clansmen.
Therefore, the environment in this ruin is inclined towards the icy plain…]
“Is that so??” Shi Yu looked up, but there was no response.
At this moment, Eleven picked up the blue energy crystal and ran back.
“Wuu!!!”
Spoils of war!!!
Eleven was excited.
This thing… it had seen and eaten it.
In the nutritional meals of the Iron-eating Beasts in the Bamboo Stone Dojo, energy crystals with both gold and thunder attributes were provided.
The so-called energy crystal was formed when the elemental energy concentration reached a certain level. It was a universal resource to strengthen the pet’s attributes.
However, there were very few of them. The higher the quality, the rarer it was. Although the strengthening effect was more singular than most food, it was better, so it was very expensive.
What Eleven had eaten was a level-one energy crystal.
And this ice-element energy crystal seemed to be also level one.
“As expected, the reward is still this?” For the time being, he didn’t think about whether he had heard or seen the scene just now. Shi Yu looked at the energy crystal.
It was alright. If it were before, he would definitely be very happy to have picked up an ice-element energy crystal. Although the attributes were wrong, if he sold it, he could also exchange it for a lot of iron bamboo.
However, the current them did not lack resources of this level at all. However, considering that this was only the first trial, and almost everyone could obtain one, Shi Yu was relieved. The rewards later would definitely be better.
“Forget it. Since there’s no response, let’s continue challenging the level and see if we can find anything new.” Although Shi Yu felt that the speculation just now corresponded to many things, the truth was definitely not that simple. The Ice Dragon story might have hidden things, but other aspects might not have changed.
After all, this Ice Dragon part of a very widespread historical story had been refuted by the stone statue once before. However, ignoring this place, the background of the ruins might really be a mystic realm for training to resist the beast tide. He sighed. The main thing was that it lacked key information!
Shi Yu looked at the summoning array not far away and planned to challenge the second trial.
But before that, Shi Yu took the energy crystal from Eleven’s hand and said, “You can’t eat this. You’ll get diarrhea.”
“Give it to me. I’ll change it into ice cream for you to eat when we get home.”
Eleven: ..???.

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - My Nephew Has the Talent of a Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: My Nephew Has the Talent of a Master
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The second trial space was still on a glacier. The overall environment was similar to before.
This time, the elemental creature that appeared not far from Shi Yu and the others was still the previous Frost Stone Giant.
However, the other party’s energy level was clearly higher. This was a level-ten Frost Stone Giant.
Moreover, it had mastered the proficient level Cold Breath and Ice Hammer. Unlike the previous one that had only mastered entry-level skills, it was very difficult to deal with.
The Ice Giant’s Ice Body was harder than steel to begin with. In addition to the long-range Cold Breath and the huge destructive Ice Hammer, the second stage should be the limit for most challengers. Even if the Ice Giant didn’t have intelligence and was slow, there were probably very few who could win.
However, this was clearly for ordinary people. To Shi Yu and Eleven, a level-ten Frost Stone Giant was no different from a level-eight Frost Stone Giant.
In the face of the stronger stone giant, Eleven still used super vision and hardening to defeat it. Compared to the previous one, it might only be the difference between hitting it once and hitting it a few more times.
This time, the frost stone giant also dropped energy crystals. In terms of quality, it seemed to be higher than the previous one. It was a level-two energy crystal that could be sold for more money.
“Is my historical talent useless this time?”
After changing the environment, Shi Yu tried to transform into a historical listener again. Unfortunately, the same scene didn’t appear.
Forget it, forget it. Let’s continue challenging the levels. We’ll talk about the truth of history later. Let’s charge through a few more levels to get the rewards.
If it was said that a level-one energy crystal was nothing, but a level-two energy crystal, depending on the quality, was at least worth six digits.
Shi Yu began to taste the benefits and planned to see what treasures were in the third round.
“No one has passed the third level yet. I wonder what will drop. It won’t be an energy crystal, right?”
Although this thing’s value was indeed high among resources of the same level, what he wanted was rare resources.
It would be best if it was something that couldn’t be bought in the outside world. Things that were priceless, such as space and time types… This way, the evolution form of the Green Silkworm would be extremely unique.
“If the next rewards are also ice-element resources… Unless the Green Silkworm evolves into the Ice Crystal Phoenix Butterfly, there’s no need for these.”
“I’m still limited in my thinking. The Ice Phoenix Moth is also an ice-element type.”
However, even if it was the Ice Phoenix Moth or the Ice Dragon Butterfly, Shi Yu still felt that it was lacking, so he continued forward.
It was still the familiar glacial environment, but this time, the one in front of them wasn’t the Frost Stone Giant.
Under the condensation of the ice element, a humanoid figure with hands, feet, and head appeared. Apart from its form resembling a human, it didn’t look like a human anywhere else. It was as if an Ice-Armored Giant wearing ice armor had appeared.
[Name]: Ice-Armored Giant
[Attributes]: Ice
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
[Race Skill]: Ice Hammer, Ice Armor, Ice Regeneration
[Introduction]: It has an invincible and extremely high defense. Its whole body is filled with ice that won’t melt. Even if its body is broken, it can recover to its original state by consuming energy.
In the distance, as the three-meter-tall Ice-Armored Giant appeared, Shi Yu and Eleven felt a sense of pressure.
This guy would probably be very difficult to deal with…
“Wuu!!!” Eleven subconsciously released its deterrence skill to increase its battle intent.
According to the information provided, the three skills of the Ice-Armored Giant were all proficient level. Although its growth level was only level ten, the Beast Tamer trainee Beast Tamer of the Beast Troops was completely not its match.
This was also normal. In other words, even if it was a level-ten Iron-eating Beast that had mastered expert level hardening, it might not necessarily be able to deal with this thing.
Firstly, its defense was not easy to break. Even if it did, it could quickly regenerate.
There were only two ways to defeat it.
Consuming the other party’s energy, or instantly causing a huge wound that made it unable to regenerate. Fortunately, there was still some restriction on the proficient level Ice Regeneration.
This was the first time Shi Yu and Eleven were fighting a commander rank creature… The other party’s racial skills were much stronger than transcendent creatures.
Shi Yu was still very envious of this Ice Regeneration. If the worm evolved into an ice element, this was a very good combination. However, he didn’t know if the skills here could be replicated.
“Eleven.”
With a shout from Shi Yu, Eleven’s body hardened on the glacier and slowly approached his opponent.
On the other side, the Ice-Armored Giant made a running posture. Its whole body, covered in Ice Armor, approached and hit Eleven.
No, to be precise, after approaching, it instantly swung its huge arm and used the ice hammer.
With its invincible and high defense, the Ice Armor skill covered its entire body again, plus a layer of frost covered by the Ice Hammer. The Ice Armor Giant’s arm was equivalent to folding three layers of buffs, containing dense power.
Bang!!!
The Ice-Armored Giant’s arm hammer hit the ground, and the glacier instantly shattered into pieces, ice shards flying everywhere.
As for Eleven, with the help of its super vision, rolled to the other side and used expert Level Hardening to smash at the leg of the Ice-Armored Giant.
Click.
The Ice Armor slightly caved in and shattered.
Although the defense was broken, it wasn’t completely broken.
Because the surrounding ice elements gathered, the damage to its body immediately recovered. The Ice-Armored Giant raised its leg and kicked after taking this punch.
Eleven:!!!
Eleven was shocked. He had finally encountered a decent opponent.
As for Shi Yu, he felt that the other party was ridiculously strong. Moreover, the accompanying move was even more shameless than Eleven! It was more difficult than he imagined!
“Shrink!” Shi Yu instantly gave the order.
The Ice-Armored Giant casually kicked. As the distance was too close, it was difficult for Eleven to react even with super vision.
Fortunately, Shi Yu’s command was timely. Eleven relied on shrinking to let the Ice-Armored Giant miss.
“Multiplication, hardening, Thunder Palm.”
Shi Yu gave the order again, intending to end the battle quickly. In the next moment, the originally half a meter large Eleven’s volume immediately increased, reaching a height of more than two meters. Although it was still one meter away from the Ice-Armored Giant, the difference in size was not as big as before.
“Wuu!!!”
After transforming, its strength increased greatly, and a huge aura erupted. It immediately launched a counterattack.
Its palm hardened, and then a shocking blue and white light spread on its palm.
It was a combination skill of Expert Level Hardening and Expert Level Thunder Palm!
There was also a multiplication skill in effect!
Multiplication was simply a combination of all-purpose skills. It was very compatible with most skills.
Eleven’s Hardened Thunder Palm pierced through the Ice-Armored Giant’s abdomen. However, the Ice-Armored Giant’s reaction was not slow at all as it continued to smash the ice hammer.
Boom!!!
In the next second, Eleven’s Hardened Thunder Palm directly penetrated the Ice-Armored Giant’s body, causing a hole to appear in its abdomen.
It was very difficult for it to recover from such an injury.
However, although Eleven was a One-Punch Panda, Eleven was also hit by the ice hammer at the same time. The other party was so strong and had a level suppression on top of that. Even if it was expert level Hardening, it couldn’t completely resist. Eleven was sent flying immediately, causing Eleven’s Hardening to disappear. At the same time, it returned to its normal state and rolled on the ground a few times before recovering.
“Wu wu wu!!!”
On the ground of the glacier, Eleven hurriedly crawled up despite the pain and injuries and looked at the opponent who was gradually starting to collapse from the abdomen.
Well… it had already disappeared.
Yes, it won!
“Eleven!”
At this moment, looking at Eleven’s performance, Shi Yu spoke.
“Real men don’t look back at the explosion!”
“The first choice you should have made just now was to use high-speed healing to treat your injuries.”
“Or, if it’s a formal battle, you can pretend to faint and take the opportunity to use absolute sleep and give a good performance.”
“I’ll remind you if there is a change in the enemy’s state.”
Eleven nodded crazily.
Understood!
“I’ll replenish my energy first.”
Shi Yu didn’t care what the Ice-Armored Giant dropped and hurriedly dragged his backpack to Eleven.
He took out an energy crystal from his backpack and fed it to Eleven while falling into deep thought.
It had defeated his opponent, but the process was a little more difficult than he had imagined.
If not for the multiplication, hardening, and thunder palm, it would probably be very difficult to instantly kill this guy.
Since they couldn’t insta-kill him, the two parties could only fight a battle of attrition. Eleven, whose physical fitness was low, would definitely fall into a disadvantage.
Although the other party was three levels higher than Eleven, this was only a low class commander rank creature whose skill proficiency hadn’t reached expert level.
He felt that he had been a little arrogant when he said that Eleven’s battle power could match a young monarch level creature of the same level…
“It’s not a big problem. Eleven still has room for improvement…”
At the same time.
In the outside world.
Most of the Beast Tamers in this batch had already entered.
One by one, professional Beast Tamer officers predicted the situation.
“Do you think anyone has a chance of defeating that Ice-Armored Giant this time?”
“It’s difficult. The pets of our Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng are basically at the transcendent level. They can’t compare to commander-level pets at all.”
Under the same growth level, the higher the race level, the stronger the overall battle power. This was already common knowledge.
With the difference in race, the hope of victory might lie in the restraint of attributes, skill restraint, and skill proficiency.
Also, Beast Tamers could also bring some recovery pills in. Defeating the opponent with pills was also a kind of strategy.
At the edge of the camp not far from the arena, President Feng of the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng looked at the six stone statues and said, “Everyone has already entered. In about an hour, maybe we will know that no one can pass the third level…”
“President, I remember that one of the challengers is your nephew, right?” The president’s secretary stood beside him and hugged the folder.
President Feng narrowed his eyes and smiled. “Yes, he’s studying in the city and specially rushed back for the ruins. That nephew of mine has pretty good talent and the aptitude of a master. He’s also very prepared for this challenge. He can definitely break through the third level. He’s also someone I have my eyes on.”
Just as the president finished speaking, with a buzz, the third of the six stone giant statues suddenly lit up.
This change stunned the Beast Tamers in the surrounding camps.
What happened…
Someone had already passed the third trial?
However, less than 20 minutes had passed since the earliest Beast Tamer entered today! Who was this fierce Beast Tamer?

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - New Record
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: New Record
“President?”
As the third stone giant statue lit up, the secretary looked at the president of the association.
The record… was broken?
President Feng was slightly stunned.
The third trial that the Beast Tamer trainees of the Beast Tamer Troops had not overcome for so long… was defeated in less than half an hour after this batch of Beast Tamers entered?
Should he consider increasing the training volume of the Beast Tamer Corps?
At this moment, He Biao, the deputy commander of the Beast Tamer Troops stationed in this place, also walked out of the camp with a whoosh and walked to President Feng and the others.
“What’s going on!” he shouted.
“It’s obvious. Among the Beast Tamers I brought over, someone has already overcome the third trial…”
“The standard of our army really needs to be improved.”
“F*ck this. You guys are just spouting nonsense. Why don’t you pay up to train them!” He Biao, the deputy regiment commander, spat.
“You want a good horse, but you don’t feed it grass. How can there be such a good thing?”
The president’s secretary was silent beside him. She was already used to it. These two were life-and-death friends. They had a life-and-death relationship during the beast tide ten years ago and had a very good relationship. It was common for them to talk and fight.
President Feng fell silent. He also wanted to pay more. Wasn’t Ping Cheng poor? It wasn’t his fault.
“President, who could it be? Could it be your nephew…”
“The second stage, level ten Frost Stone Giant.”
“The third stage, level-ten Ice-Armored Giant.” President Feng narrowed his eyes and shook his head. “I know my nephew’s strength.”
“He has very good talent. Perhaps he can pass, but he definitely won’t pass so quickly. There must be someone else.”
He had trained his nephew before coming, so he knew very well.
The president’s secretary coughed dryly and said, “What if? Maybe your nephew performed extraordinarily this time.”
“Impossible, if it’s him, I’ll eat…”
“What will you eat? Fried Green Silkworm?” He Biao looked at him. “Freeloading meals again?”
“I said, I’ll still doubt it.” Chairman Feng straightened his clothes.
However… Who could it be? The three Beast Tamers who ranked first in the three assessment rankings, or the Beast Tamers recommended by the various dojos?
For a moment, President Feng couldn’t make a judgment.
He looked in the direction of the stone statue with a deep gaze, curious if the fourth stone could light up.
…
Back in the ruins, in the third trial space…
Shi Yu picked up the translucent stone in the shape of a pebble that the Ice-Armored Giant had dropped and fell into deep thought.
It wasn’t an energy crystal anymore. Not bad, not bad… But what was this?
“Wuu.”
Eleven, who was beside him, also looked confused.
This thing… It had never seen or eaten it.
“My cell phone can’t be connected to the Internet here. I can’t check…”
“This…”
Shi Yu was not in a good mood.
The awards should have been exciting and tense, but in the end, it was something he didn’t know. This was uncomfortable.
“Forget it, I’ll put it away first. I’ll find out after I go out.”
Shi Yu placed the transparent stone in his backpack and looked around. He sensed the environment through telepathy.
Alright! Apart from the first trial space reacting, there was no reaction from the second and third trials.
He continued…
“Why don’t you sleep on the spot for ten minutes before we continue the next round?” Shi Yu looked at Eleven and suspected its condition.
After all, the Ice-Armored Giant’s hammer just now directly sent Eleven flying.
After adjusting its state, the next stage would have a higher success rate. Only then could he better investigate the truth of history.
It didn’t matter if the reward was there or not. The main reason was that he didn’t want history to be hidden.
“That doesn’t seem to be what I said in the previous stage… Forget it, the meaning is similar anyway.”
“Wuu.”
In order to not get beaten up in the next round, Eleven nodded obediently.
Its concept was very simple. It could get injured during its training, but not during battle!
That would make it seem like its training was for nothing, after all…
Then, Eleven became smaller, slept, and quickly recovered.
After another delay, they stepped into the teleportation array of the fourth trial.
…
“Has the environment changed?”
Just as he opened his eyes, Shi Yu realized that he was already on a certain mountain in a snow mountain environment.
Eleven was beside Shi Yu. They looked down and saw a snowstorm coming from below.
Under the gathering of countless ice elements, a wolf-shaped creature gradually formed.
Name: Snow Wolf
[Attributes]: Ice
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Ice Crushing Fang, Ice Splitting Claw, Cold Breath, Snow Concealment
Whoa, it was an old friend.
Seeing that it wasn’t the Stone Giants this time, but the Snow Wolf, Shi Yu was immediately intrigued. Eleven was also eager to give it a try.
However, soon, Shi Yu and Eleven’s expressions collapsed.
Even Eleven, who hoped to test the results of the training through battle, showed a difficult expression.
Because, under the gathering of the ice elements, the snow wolf was only the first creature to appear.
At the next moment, nine more snow wolves formed.
Right on the heels of that, ten of the wild boars living in the snow mountain, mid-level transcendent Ice Fang Boars, appeared.
Then, another ten Ice-Armored Beast, ten Ice Scaled Snakes, and ten Snow Apes appeared!
The snow mountain where Shi Yu was this time was very large. They were scattered everywhere, but Shi Yu and Eleven could see everything clearly on the mountain.
There were a total of 50 creatures!
Don’t tell them that the fourth stage was to defeat all the creatures in front of them…
Shi Yu: ???
Was this place a sore loser? What was this unfair wave of beasts?
Eleven:?_?
Eleven also felt a hundred million pressure.
If the fourth level was already like this, how was he to fight the fifth level?
Fortunately, unlike the first three levels, the aggro of these ferocious beasts was not on Shi Yu and the others at the moment.
They had ample time to develop strategies and think about how to clear the level.
“I miscalculated!!!” Shi Yu was filled with hatred as he stood on the snow mountain peak.
He observed carefully and discovered that fortunately, these ferocious beasts’ growth levels didn’t seem to be high. They didn’t reach level ten.
But even so, the difficulty completely exceeded the previous round.
Shi Yu hated it. Why didn’t he teach deterrence to expert level previously?
Otherwise, at this moment, Eleven’s expert level deterrence might directly defeat 50 ferocious beasts in an instant.
It was fine even if it was the multiplication point that was at the expert level. When the time came, Eleven, who was dozens of meters tall, would crush them with a stomp.
Unlike now, where it was neither right nor wrong to fight…
“Why don’t we go out and develop for another half a month before coming back?” Shi Yu suggested.
“(っ`- ?c) Au!”
Eleven took a step forward.
No, it was already here. It’ll try before going back.
The Iron-eating Beast was fearless!
“Do you want to fight?”
It wasn’t that Shi Yu felt that he couldn’t fight, but with its current strength, even if it passed, it would be very difficult.
“Their numbers are huge. Even if they attack together, it won’t be that easy to cooperate.”
“Your whole body should be covered constantly with hardening. They basically can’t break through your defense. What’s tested is your physical fitness.”
“In this aspect, you have absolute sleep and the shrinking ability to deal with it. It’s not like there’s no hope of clearing it.”
Shi Yu slowly analyzed and said, “Wanna try?”
Eleven nodded.
Soon, Eleven skied down the mountain (rolling like a ball).
“Wuuu!!!”
It was a life risking fight. This was a rather tragic battle no matter how it looked at it. It would kill a bunch of them with its steel rolling tank move first.
…
In the outside world.
It had been a long time since the third stone statue lit up.
At this moment, more and more people came out.
In the ruins, as long as the Beast Tamer put the pet back into the Beast Taming Space and confirmed the “exit” with his mind, he could easily return.
Because of this, as long as Beast Tamers didn’t court death too much, there usually wasn’t much danger.
“Chen Kai… One… One stage.”
After coming out, the Beast Tamers had to accept the soldiers’ questions and register their battle results.
Chen Kai, who was a top student, felt very uncomfortable.
He had only passed one level!!!
Most of the people present only passed one round.
The Frost Stone Giant in the second stage was already very difficult to deal with, let alone the third stage.
Thinking about it, it made sense. The ruins space might be used by a powerful Beast Tamer Tribe that could seal super creatures like dragons for their young clansmen to train.
In terms of difficulty, definitely not everyone could pass it easily. No matter what, Ping Cheng was only a third-rate small city.
“White Stone, level two.”
“Qiao Liang, level two.”
“Jiang Rui, level two…”
These people had all defeated the level-ten Frost Stone Giant but were beaten up by the Ice-Armored Giant.
Originally, when everyone had this battle result, it was nothing.
However, when the people who came out realized that the third stone statue was bright, their minds immediately went blank.
“Holy shit, someone defeated that Ice-Armored Giant?”
The third stone statue lit up, which meant that someone had already passed the third level.
“Well, who passed the third round?”
A Beast Tamer asked the soldier who registered for him.
The soldier Beast Tamer glanced at him and shook his head. “How would I know? He hasn’t come out yet.”
“The third stone statue lit up half an hour ago. That person is probably challenging the fourth level now?”
“F*ck…” The Beast Tamers who came out collectively cracked. He defeated the Ice-Armored Giant more than half an hour ago? This person. Was he really human?
The Beast Tamers came out one after another. Then, even the two that got first place in the other two professional assessments came out.
They also couldn’t pass the third round. This couldn’t help but disappoint President Feng, He Biao, and the others, who were all waiting.
“Cheng Gong, the third stage.”
However, at this moment, as a Beast Tamer with a poor expression came out, he immediately attracted everyone’s attention when he registered.
“You passed the third level?” The registered staff looked at the pale-faced Beast Tamer in front of him and asked.
“Mhm.” Cheng Gong looked at the third stone statue that lit up, as well as the shocked gazes of the surrounding people, and his heart was immediately filled with satisfaction.
Although he was defeated in the fourth round, he had at least broken the record!!!
He didn’t embarrass Old Feng, did he?! He looked for President Feng.
“Brother, you’re awesome!” The soldier couldn’t help but give him a thumbs up and say, “You cleared three levels in ten plus minutes. Impressive.”
“But why did it take so long to come out? Is the fourth level very difficult? Speaking of which, what’s the fourth level?”
“The fourth level… isn’t something that trainee Beast Tamers can pass at all.” Cheng Gong couldn’t help but grumble, but suddenly, he felt that something was wrong.
When did he clear the third level in ten minutes? The third level clearly took a long time…
He was rather confused. At this moment… the fourth stone statue lit up with a hum.
Everyone turned their heads in confusion. They were first stunned, then shocked.
“The fourth stone statue lit up too!”
Everyone naturally knew what this meant.
Outside a certain camp, President Feng was also shocked. The fourth level… was it really cleared?? He roughly knew who it was.
Lin Hong was an old thief. What was wrong with this Shi Yu??
At the same time that the president’s secretary and deputy regiment commander were shocked, they looked at the register near the stage… It really wasn’t President Feng’s nephew?
At the same time.
At the moment, the only top student in the city who had seen the difficulty of the fourth level, Cheng Gong, was confused.
“This… How is this possible? How can a person clear the fourth level…? 1VS50!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - Ethereal Stone
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Ethereal Stone
At this moment, although Cheng Gong said that he had passed the third stage, everyone present wasn’t stupid.
Through the changes in the stone statue, they could also know that the first to break the record was someone else!
As for the nephew of the Ping Cheng Association’s president, Cheng Gong, he fell into deep thought.
At this moment, President Feng and He Biao walked over.
“Cheng Gong, what’s the fourth level?”
“You passed the first three levels. You should have seen the situation of the fourth level, right?”
President Feng went straight to the point.
The surrounding Beast Tamers and soldiers also pricked up their ears.
Yes, the third level was already so difficult, so what kind of monster was the fourth level?
“The fourth level…” Cheng Gong took a deep breath and said,” That’s a new snow mountain environment. Compared to the icy plains and glaciers of the first three levels, the range is larger. ”
“The moment I entered, this trial space formed 50 snow mountain ferocious beasts, 10 snow wolves, 10 Ice-Armored Beast, 10 Ice Fang Boars, 10 Ice Scaled Snakes, and 10 snow apes!”
“In terms of growth, there shouldn’t be any lower than level-seven, and their skill proficiency isn’t low.”
“I originally wanted my Moon Flame Beast to give it a try, but there was no breakthrough.”
Silence fell.
“Damn, 50?” A moment later, He Biao, the deputy commander of the Beast Tamer Corps in Ping Cheng, widened his eyes.
The first three levels were all one opponent. Why did it suddenly increase so much in the fourth level!
This was almost comparable to a small-scale beast tide!
The other Beast Tamers who didn’t even pass the second and third rounds also felt that the fourth round’s difficulty was very ridiculous.
How could he achieve 1VS 50 when entry was restricted to the level of a Beast Tamer trainee…
Eh?
Everyone suddenly realized something and looked at the fourth stone statue that lit up.
Everyone was silent for a moment. It seemed like someone had gotten through, right?
Who was it…
“Alright, you’ve done very well. There’s still a chance next time.” President Feng encouraged his nephew and turned to the record player.
“Look at how many people haven’t come out yet.”
“Yes!” The record register immediately compared the information, which was just a few seconds. He said, “Currently, there seems to be one person left.”
No one expected the case to be solved so quickly.
Indeed, regardless of whether he could pass the first three levels, 1VS1 wouldn’t take too much time.
But if he wanted to pass the fourth level, he would definitely have to spend a lot of time. It was normal for only this person to be left in the end.
“Who is it?” Although he already knew who it was, President Feng subconsciously wanted to confirm it.
At the same time, in the crowd, the Beast Tamers also tried their best to look around to see who was missing.
At that moment, Chen Kai, Jiang Rui, Qiao Liang, and the others looked a little strange. They kept searching, but they still didn’t find anything.
Damn… No way…
“Shi Yu, his name is Shi Yu!”
Coincidentally, just as the record holder finished speaking, light flashed again on the teleportation array in the center of the six stone statues.
Someone else came out of the ruins.
A young man in a dark-blue adventure suit with a backpack casually hanging on his shoulder walked out with an unhappy expression.
Shi Yu really wanted to communicate with the broken stone statue for a hundred rounds.
The fourth level was so difficult! Though, it wasn’t that he and Eleven couldn’t pass with all their trump cards.
In fact, it also proved that although the process was very difficult, they finally succeeded. It was doable.
However, Shi Yu only took a glance at the fifth level and found it boring.
This was not prepared for ordinary Beast Tamers at all.
In the fifth level, there were a total of 100 ferocious beasts. The number of them increased, the types increased, and their growth levels were higher overall. There were even level-ten ferocious beasts.
Although there were no commander-level ferocious beasts, just defeating 50 alone was enough to exhaust Eleven. Shi Yu didn’t think they could pass this level, so he directly withdrew.
Well, they would definitely come back. When the day came when they mastered deterrence, they would definitely avenge their previous humiliation.
“Eh?” When Shi Yu’s mind was active, he realized that many gazes from the outside world were on him.
Shi Yu felt creeped out by so many strange gazes.
“You’re Shi Yu?” The record register closest to the platform’s teleportation array asked.
“I am. Is there a problem?”
“You passed the third and fourth levels?”
“Yes.” There was no need to hide such a thing. Shi Yu nodded.
He looked in the direction of the stone statue. As expected, only two stone statues had lit up previously, but now, there were four.
“This!”
Beside him, as Shi Yu nodded in confirmation, Cheng Gong, who was the only one who had experienced the pressure of the fourth level, found it unbelievable.
He really couldn’t imagine how a Beast Tamer intern could get 1VS50.
Even more ridiculous than Cheng Gong were the few people who were familiar with Shi Yu.
Chen Kai, White Stone, Jiang Rui, and the others opened their mouths slightly and felt that it was unbelievable.
Although Shi Yu was indeed very strong, that little Metal-eating Beast didn’t seem to have a high level of growth. It was still very far from level ten!
If his growth level was not high, it meant that his physical fitness was limited. How did he pass the fourth level…
They didn’t know that Eleven had the ability to shrink and kite opponents, recover physical fitness, and absolute sleep. It could use the shortcomings of these non-living ferocious beasts with low intelligence to rest for a short period of time.
“F*ck.” However, the one who felt the most incredulous was still the young doctor, Qiao Liang.
In his impression, Shi Yu was a weak but slightly hard working newbie. How could he be a big boss who broke the four levels in a row?
“Well done.”
At this moment, although he didn’t know how Shi Yu had cleared the level, new progress in cracking the ruins was good news.
President Feng looked at Shi Yu with a smile and said, “You’re an apprentice of Bamboo Stone Dojo, right? Hall Master Lin actually mentioned you to me before.”
“He said you would give me a surprise… But I didn’t expect it to be such a big surprise.”
“Young heroes emerge.” President Feng clapped and said, “Can you tell me the situation of the fifth level?”
Hall Master Lin Hongnian even mentioned him to the president of the Ping Cheng Association?
Shi Yu was stunned before saying,
“The fourth level is 50 ice-element ferocious beasts whose growth levels are between seven to nine. The fifth level is 100 ice-element ferocious beasts whose growth levels are between eight to ten.”
“Their race levels are all at the transcendent level, and their skill proficiency is uncertain.”
“As the fifth level is a little difficult, we only took a look and left. We didn’t challenge deeper.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the surrounding people suffocated again.
The fourth level was already sick enough. Would someone really be able to pass the fifth level?
President Feng was also silent for a moment. Then, he looked at everyone and said,
“Since everyone has already entered the ruins once, I have news to announce to everyone.”
“In the next month, the Ping Cheng Association will take out a sum of resources to increase everyone’s strength.”
“Anyone who can pass two rounds can receive pet training resources. The resources increase with each round you can pass.”
In order to accelerate the cracking progress of this ruin, no matter how poor the Ping Cheng Association was, they couldn’t afford to not nurture their challengers. Otherwise, there would really be zero progress.
“Today, everyone can rest. Those whose pets are injured, remember to go to the infirmary to recover.”
“Cheng Gong and… Shi Yu, right? Do you need to go to the infirmary? Come with me later.” President Feng called out to the two Beast Tamers who had passed the third round.
In the Beast Taming Space, although the pet’s injuries would generally recover slowly and stop worsening, the healing effect was still the best.
“Alright.” Cheng Gong nodded.
