“There’s no need for me. My pet isn’t injured,” Shi Yu said.
Eleven recovered on its own as it fought. It lacked physical fitness and was currently sleeping in the Beast Taming Space to recover.
Everyone was stunned.
What was this person saying?
Cheng Gong, who was beside him, felt emotional pain. He opened his mouth again. This guy was telling him that after doing a battle 1 VS 50, he wasn’t injured?? Huh?
“I see… Then you, follow me first.” The corners of President Feng’s mouth twitched.
It was already lucky enough that Bamboo Stone Dojo had nurtured an 18-year-old professional Beast Tamer, Lin Xiuzhu. What was with this Shi Yu?
In any case, President Feng couldn’t understand the information at all.
Then, under the silent gazes of everyone, Shi Yu followed President Feng into the camp.
Vice Commander He Biao also followed.
“Little brother, you really passed the fourth round?? I just took a look at your pet information. How can that be? By the way, I’m the deputy commander of the Beast Tamer Corps in Ping Cheng. My surname is He.” He didn’t understand.
It wasn’t just him who didn’t understand. President Feng also had many questions.
At this moment, Shi Yu directly took out the reward for passing the third round, the transparent stone.
And the reward for passing the fourth level, transparent stone x3.
The rewards for the two stages were the same, but there was a difference in the number.
“President Feng, Commander He, these are the items I obtained when I passed the third and fourth levels.”
“What’s this? A pet cultivation resource?”
Shi Yu took out the clearing reward, and the two of them immediately turned their attention to it.
President Feng was stunned when he saw it.
“Ethereal Spirit Stone?”
“The rewards for the third and fourth levels aren’t energy crystals anymore, but Ethereal Stones?” He Biao was rather shocked.
“That Ethereal Spirit Stone is?” Shi Yu had never heard of such a resource.
“F*ck, you made a killing. This is a rare spatial resource!” He Biao said roughly.
“It’s a resource even rarer than energy crystals. You can’t buy it even if you have money. There are very few of them. Ordinary people can’t come into contact with them at all. This is indeed a ruin. The mystic realm spaces like to produce it!”
“Spatial resources?” Shi Yu was stunned as he looked at the four transparent rocks in his hand.
Holy shit, this was the evolution ingredient he was looking for? A rare attribute?
Buggy, Eleven, and him were really going all out for it this time.
“Yes, spatial resources are also resources that all Beast Tamers dream of. Using this stone can accelerate the leveling of the Beast Taming Space.” President Feng nodded and said, “This is a good thing to increase the level of Beast Tamers…”
“This can be used to strengthen the Beast Taming Space?” Shi Yu was stunned again as he asked.
Both of them nodded.
“Well…” Shi Yu looked at the rock again. It was alright then.
He wanted to see if there were better resources for Buggy in the later stages. The spatial element was too low for it.
As a Beast Tamer, he used these stones reluctantly.
“From the looks of it, Cheng Gong should have also obtained the Ethereal Spirit Stone. Not bad, with this, your Beast Taming Space can be raised to level two earlier and contract a second pet…”
President Feng nodded, but soon, his expression changed. “Wait, Shi Yu, when you go back, don’t work hard to increase the level of the Beast Taming Space.”
“This ruin can only be suitable for trainee Beast Tamers for the time being…”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded, indicating that he understood. He wouldn’t level up so quickly. As long as the Beast Taming Space’s level reached the standard before the vocation assessment, that would be enough.
With this, he had an idea. Eleven’s leveling speed shouldn’t be too fast, or he might go above the entry requirement and be unable to enter.
At the same time, Cheng Gong’s treatment speed was fast. In just two minutes, he arrived.
This was normal. The military doctors stationed nearby were all professional Beast Tamers. Treating an Awakening Stage pet was just a skill.
Even if it was a bunch of injured pets, a group healing skill would be enough.
“President, Regiment Commander He.” Cheng Gong didn’t want to show his relationship with President Feng outside.
This would make it seem like his success was dependent on his family background, not his own hard work.
“Cheng Gong, what’s your reward for the third level?” President Feng looked at Cheng Gong.
“It’s an Ethereal Spirit Stone.” Cheng Gong immediately took out a transparent stone, just like Shi Yu’s.
President Feng and Commander He looked at each other and nodded.
President Feng said, “You guys keep your spoils of war. This is what you deserve.”
“In this challenge of the ruins, only two of you passed the third level. Cheng Gong, you passed three levels. Shi Yu, you passed four levels. Your performance was very good.”
“You heard it just now. Next, the association will draw out a sum of money to increase your strength.”
“Your performance this time is the most outstanding. The association will definitely give priority to nurturing you. With a certain amount, you can feel free to ask for anything.”
President Feng had already placed his hopes on the two of them.
As for the Beast Tamers outside, they could only be cultivated along the way.
Giving some resources to let them gain more growth in the ruins and nurturing more professional Beast Tamers for Ping Cheng was not a loss.
As for the main force, it would definitely be Shi Yu and Cheng Gong.
“Alright.” Cheng Gong was clearly mentally prepared for this. He immediately nodded.
As for Shi Yu, who was beside him, he fell into deep thought. Was there such a good thing?
As for needs… At his level, money was indeed better. The rest were all fancy fluff.
“By the way, you don’t know each other yet, right?”
“Let me introduce you. This is Cheng Gong, from Ping Cheng, but he goes to school in the city.”
“Shi Yu, an apprentice from Bamboo Stone Dojo, you seem to have studied in the city previously?” President Feng tried hard to recall Shi Yu’s information.
“Well, Icefield High, Feeding specialization,” Shi Yu introduced himself.
Cheng Gong and Commander He:??
The two of them looked at Shi Yu. This guy defeated the commander-level Ice-Armored Giant and succeeded in 1 VS 50. And now he dared to start telling them that he was from the Feeding specialization??
Don’t tell them that after Shi Yu entered the ruins, he used the method of feeding to make those ferocious beasts surrender directly!
“Uh…” After Cheng Gong’s eyelids twitched, he reached out to Shi Yu and said, “Hello.”
“To be able to pass the fourth level… you’re very impressive.”
“I have a presumptuous request. Can we have a battle after our pets recover?”
Because he was too curious about Shi Yu’s strength and how he cleared the level, Cheng Gong couldn’t help but challenge him.
Beside him, Guild Leader Feng was stunned, though there was no need to stop him.
His nephew was born to be a strong person. After being defeated this time, it was normal for him to be unhappy and want to see the difference.
At the same time, as the president of the Ping Cheng Association, he had no idea what was going on with Shi Yu. He also wanted to see Shi Yu’s strength.
The situation inside the ruins couldn’t be seen, but the battle outside could at least be seen, right?
Cheng Gong’s active challenge was an opportunity.
“Battle?” Shi Yu also extended his hand and shook the other party’s hand.
Apart from himself, the other party was the only one who defeated the Ice-Armored Giant. He probably wasn’t weak.
“Alright.” Shi Yu didn’t refuse. Beast Tamers needed to spar with each other to improve…

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - Monster Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Monster Talent
“You guys want to fight?”
Commander He was obviously a boorish person who didn’t bother with trifles. He said, “Damn, interesting!”
“I’ll get someone to empty the venue for you guys!”
“This is a good opportunity for those soldiers to broaden their horizons.”
One was Old Feng’s relative, while the other was a monster rookie who had somehow cleared the fourth level. In short, the two of them were not simple.
He also wanted to see the strength of these two people.
Well, at the same time, he could also encourage the new recruits under him. Not bad.
“It’s good to be young,” President Feng said with a smile.
He narrowed his eyes. No matter how he looked at it, it didn’t look like he was lamenting. Instead, it looked like he was preparing to watch the show.
“Then wait until after lunch. You guys have enough rest first. Fight after you’re full.”
“Sure,” Cheng Gong said indifferently.
Shi Yu naturally didn’t mind.
…
Outside, the Beast Tamer Corps’ sergeant was speaking to this batch of Beast Trainers.
The general content was that everyone could challenge the ruins again in the next month.
However, they could only challenge it once a day.
In this month, everyone could go home or stay here. Anyway, the camp here was very sufficient, and they would definitely be full from three meals a day.
“I’ve decided to stay here. I won’t leave until I pass two trials.”
Chen Kai, who had only passed one level, felt ashamed.
He was really a little trash. He actually only passed one level…
“But is your Refreshing Capsule enough?” A close classmate who passed the assessment with him asked. He was the only other classmate who passed the entry requirements.
“Damn, it doesn’t seem to be enough. We have to go back and prepare a month’s worth of food first,” Chen Kai said after reacting.
Damn it! He was clearly eating the Refreshing Capsule, so why wasn’t it as effective as Shi Yu?
In the previous battle, there wasn’t much of a difference in their strength.
However, it had only been a short while. He passed the first stage, and Shi Yu passed the fourth. The difference in strength was simply breaking through the horizon.
Could it be that Shi Yu had upgraded the supplements?
“I have to prepare some too,” Chen Kai’s classmate said. He was also a candidate from Mt. Tian Mang.
As the two of them conversed, Qiao Liang, the Hundred Herb Hall doctor who didn’t want to eavesdrop, had a strange expression.
Why were there still people discussing supplements in the ruins?
What exactly was going on with the supplement heat recently?
Including Shi Yu. How did a weak Beast Tamer who ate tonics every day become a super big boss?
Could it be that… Did these supplements really have hidden effects?
Doctor Qiao Liang, who had received relevant education, also hesitated in the face of reality.
Why not he give it a try too?
The people here were quickly disbanded. Some planned to stay and take a look, while others planned to go back and prepare.
But at this moment, a group of soldiers suddenly started drawing the venue, making many people puzzled.
The venue was quickly drawn. A Beast Tamer was more curious and went forward to ask.
This question stunned the Beast Tamer.
A moment later, news spread to the nearby camp.
Not only did the Beast Tamer Troops stationed here know, but the 80 new Beast Tamers also knew.
“Holy shit, this is bad. That Cheng Gong who passed the third level is going to battle with that Shi Yu who passed the fourth level!”
“President Feng and Commander He allowed it. Everyone can watch the battle!!!”
When this news spread, everyone instantly wasn’t tired or hungry anymore. They were all energetic.
“There’s still a battle to watch? Then I won’t leave. I want to see the difference between me and the big boss.”
“I’ll stay with you.”
“Me too. ”
These were the new Beast Tamers.
The Beast Tamers of the Beast Tamer Troops were extremely silent.
Those professional-level officers were still alright, but the ordinary trainee-level soldiers had complicated feelings.
After all, none of them passed the third round.
And these two people, one who passed three levels, and the other who passed four levels… It was simply infuriating to compare.
“I want to see how powerful they are.” Many people thought.
The area around the ruins became lively.
At noon, almost everyone stayed behind and chose to eat at the camp.
At this moment, no one could find where Shi Yu and Cheng Gong were.
They only appeared after lunch.
Because the two of them were called to eat special nutritional meals by Commander He.
The nutritional meal could accelerate the recovery speed of the pets in the Beast Taming Space. After eating it, the two of them were almost at their peak state.
Although… it was the same for Shi Yu if he didn’t eat it. After all, Eleven had the dual recovery buff of Absolute Sleep and the Beast Taming Space.
…
“Coming, coming.”
As Shi Yu and Cheng Gong appeared outside, the disciplined soldiers were still alright. The new Beast Tamers immediately became noisy, looking forward to it.
Under Commander He’s call, all the probationary-level soldiers surrounded him, planning to broaden their horizons.
In an instant, Shi Yu and Cheng Gong became the center of attention.
“Isn’t this arena formation a little too big?” Cheng Gong was nervous.
He was not convinced and wanted to challenge Shi Yu to see the difference. Why was he the center of attention by Commander He and Shi Yu?
If he lost, wouldn’t it be very embarrassing?
Shi Yu also felt that the atmosphere was a little too grand, but since it was already like this, he might as well make do…
Then, the two of them walked to the two sides of the arena.
Commander He came to the edge of the arena with a smile and said, “Then I’ll be your judge.”
“Alright, thank you,” said the two fighters.
Commander He nodded and became serious for once. “You two, send out your pets together.”
“Then, listen to my command and start the battle!”
After saying this, the entire place fell completely silent. Everyone stared at the two of them intently.
That was because not everyone knew the situation of their pets.
“Moon Flame Beast.”
A huge summoning array appeared, and Cheng Gong’s pet walked out of the spatial ripples.
“Roar!!!”
When this pet walked out, it brought with it rolling heat waves.
It was a creature more than a meter long with scarlet flame-like hair all over its body. Its body was turned sideways and had a “crescent” pattern around its buttocks.
It looked like a ferret-type creature from Earth, a ferret bear. It might be an evolution species of a ferret.
[Name]: Moon Flame Beast
[Attributes]: Fire
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Exploding Flame, Flame Assault, Flame Claw
It wasn’t an ice-element creature, but a rare fire-element creature in Icefield City…
“Wuu—”
Compared to the Moon Flame Beast, everyone present was much more familiar with Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast. After all, it was a unique pet of Ping Cheng…
At this moment, Eleven was also very unhappy. It had not been able to clear the ruins in one go previously, making it feel that its training intensity was not enough!
He had to work harder. Only then could he live up to his reputation of increasing Shi Yu’s points.
It looked at its opponent this time. It decided to start from insta-killing the opponent in front of it… If it couldn’t do it, the training volume would double!
Eleven’s thoughts were transmitted, and Shi Yu’s expression was complicated. He cheered Eleven on.
At that moment, as Eleven, who was one meter tall, walked out of the summoning array, everyone was silent.
Because Eleven was too small, it looked like a cub.
Everyone was from Ping Cheng, so they naturally knew that adult Iron-eating Beasts were nearly two meters tall. This one meter difference was too much.
It wasn’t even two years old?
After seeing the Iron-eating beast, Cheng Gong’s eyes were filled with disbelief because of its size.
Shi Yu relied on this Iron-eating beast cub to pass the fourth level? How was that possible!
“Apprentice Beast Tamer, Cheng Gong, Pet Moon Flame Beast, growth level, awakening level ten.”
Cheng Gong had taken the initiative to introduce himself in exchange for information about Shi Yu.
“Trainee Beast Tamer, Shi Yu, pet Iron-eating Beast, growth level, awakening level seven.”
There was nothing to hide about pets, so Shi Yu said it out loud.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, many people were stunned.
Level-seven Awakening? Was this a joke???
Everyone knew that Shi Yu was very impressive for breaking through four consecutive levels, but at least, there had to be some logic to be strong.
If your Iron-eating Beast’s growth level was at level ten, no one would say anything.
After all this time, not only was the pet a cub, but its growth level had also not reached the pinnacle of the Awakening Stage?
“It was still level-six a few days ago. Did it break through?”
The discussion of the apprentices in Bamboo Stone Dojo dealt another heavy blow to the surrounding people.
Damn it!
Not to mention these Beast Tamers… Even President Feng, who was nearby, felt that it was ridiculous.
According to Shi Yu’s information, when he participated in the assessment at Mt. Tian Mang, the Iron-eating beast was only level-six.
Therefore, this was what he didn’t understand… Even if an Iron-eating Beast with expert level Hardening had a growth level below level ten, it couldn’t possibly pass the fourth or even the third level.
The Beast Tamers at the scene were very confused, and so was Commander He. He chose the most direct way to understand this mystery.
“Damn it, let the battle begin!”
As soon as he finished speaking, Cheng Gong immediately issued an order.
“Moon Flame Beast, Exploding Flame!!!”
The Moon Flame Beast’s expression was ferocious as it roared. All the fiery red hair on its body exploded, and a ball of fire condensed in front of its mouth.
In an instant, a huge fireball nearly a meter in diameter, containing the power of the explosion, and rolling heat waves formed directly!
[Exploding Flame]: Intermediate fire-element skill. It can create flames with an explosive nature. Its lethality is huge!
As the Moon Flame Beast attacked, the surrounding frost instantly melted. The Beast Tamers present also felt a wave of heat.
“The proficiency of this Bursting Flame is at least proficient!”
Commander He thought to himself, No wonder it could defeat the Ice-Armored Giant. This fire skill was very lethal to ice-type creatures…
No, not only for ice-type creatures, but also for all creatures!
Boom!!!
Bursting Flames exploded. Just this move alone made many Beast Tamers understand the difference between them and Cheng Gong.
However, what was most unbelievable was that Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast actually looked calm and composed in the face of this powerful attack.
“Eleven, harden, Thunder Palm!”
As the flames attacked, Eleven stood on the spot. Its hair originally fluttered with the hot wind, but in the next moment, it was like a motionless mountain with the hardened version.
Low-level skill, Hardening!
Looking at the little Iron-eating beast, everyone was not unfamiliar with this move.
However, not dodging? Instead, he planned to use Hardening to forcefully resist the skill? Everyone didn’t understand.
Zi, zi, zi, zi…
In the next second, everyone who didn’t understand Shi Yu’s order discovered a new change in the little Iron-eating Beast.
Countless blue and white strong electric currents suddenly spread out of the little Iron-eating Beast’s entire right arm. Its might looking extremely shocking.
A terrifying electric current spread on the metal arm. The Beast Trainers might still be a little confused by this scene, but it directly made the expressions of all the professional Beast Tamers change slightly.
“Combination skill!” All the professional Beast Tamers were shocked. It was a skill with different attributes!
At this moment, the flames closed in.
Eleven used the combination skill of expert level “Hardening” and expert level “Thunder Palm” and directly punched out.
Zizizi…
The sound of thunder was like the cry of a thousand birds. Eleven’s arm was like a lightning spear, extremely shocking.
This action made Cheng Gong’s eyes widen.
Boom!!!
With a boom, Eleven seemed to have been swallowed by the explosive flames, but what everyone saw was that the moment the fireball made contact with the Little Iron-eating Beast, it was instantly divided into two, and a passage was pierced out from the middle!
The proficient mid-level skill Exploding Flame was actually sliced open with a palm.
This was not the end, because Bursting Flames contained the nature of an explosion. Although its form was instantly destroyed, causing its power to decrease, the remaining Bursting Flames still exploded instantly.
At this moment, Eleven had already walked in front of the Exploding Flame that had been sliced open. Its hardened body actually made use of the shockwave impact of the Exploding Flame Explosion to attack the Moon Flame Beast like a ferocious beast made of interweaving thunder flames. Its speed was so fast that the Moon Flame Beast lost its sense of propriety.
“Roar!!!” The Moon Flame Beast’s pupils constricted. It didn’t understand what kind of monster this was. It could actually cut open its Bursting Flames.
This was also normal. After all, the penetration power of a perfect-level Thunder Palm could even cut apart the lightning strikes in nature. Although Eleven’s Thunder Palm’s proficiency wasn’t enough, with the enhancement of hardening, its power wasn’t much worse.
Although this Exploding Flame was strong, its strength was clearly insufficient.
“Flame Assault! Flame Claw!”
Facing the surging little Iron-eating Beast, Cheng Gong’s scalp went numb. He felt a strong pressure, but the only thing he could do was fight back.
[Flame Assault]: Intermediate fire-element skill, causing the flames in the body to explode and transform into kinetic energy, obtaining stronger speed.
Cheng Gong planned to let the Moon Flame Beast win with speed. After all, the Iron-eating Beast’s vision wasn’t very good.
Boom!
Flames erupted from the Moon Flame Beast’s body, as if it had turned into a flaming afterimage. The proficiency of this flame attack had clearly reached the proficient level, and it wasn’t as simple as entry level.
Swoosh!
The Moon Flame Beast didn’t intend to fight Eleven head-on. Its claws were filled with scorching flames, and it swayed left and right strangely while charging at the Iron-eating Beast that was attacking it.
A moment later, the two passed each other.
However, Cheng Gong and the Moon Flame Beast completely miscalculated.
The speed interference tactic they chose didn’t have any effect on Eleven, who had super vision.
Bang!!!
The flaming claw of the Moon Flame Beast stopped in the sky, and its body also stopped in midair. At the critical moment of its attack, Eleven’s palm hit its stomach.
The scene seemed to have stopped, and in the next moment, the Moon Flame Beast seemed to have encountered a huge impact, flying backwards!!
Bang bang bang bang bang bang!
It rolled for more than ten meters before stopping.
The scene instantly fell silent.
“Good fight.” In the silent scene, Shi Yu was the first to speak.
In the instant of the attack, Eleven canceled the combination skill and only used hardening to fight the enemy. This way, the damage to the Moon Flame Beast was not big. Otherwise, with the combination skill, even if the Moon Flame Beast didn’t die, it would still be severely injured.
Apart from Shi Yu himself, no one knew that Eleven had mastered the expert level Thunder Palm.
“I…”
At this moment, Cheng Gong was still a little confused when he saw the Moon Flame Beast flying backward instantly.
How was this possible? How could this Iron-eating Beast keep up with the Moon Flame Beast’s speed…
His face instantly turned pale.
Even when fighting the Ice-Armored Giant, they didn’t feel so much pressure.
What kind of monster was that… level-seven? He must be kidding!
“Wuu!!!” At this moment, Eleven stood on the spot unscathed and looked straight at the enemy who crawled up.
As for the Moon Flame Beast, although it could still climb up, the two rounds of confrontation just now completely made it lose its battle will. At this moment, its body was trembling slightly as it looked at Eleven in horror!
Although it didn’t initiate a deterrence, Eleven’s aura completely left a shadow in his heart!
“Kid, you lost.” Commander He, who was at the judge’s seat, was silent the whole time. Only now did he say to Cheng Gong.
With that said, he spoke to Shi Yu in an incredulous tone.
He asked the question that everyone wanted to ask.
“Not only is it expert level Hardening, but your Iron-eating Beast also mastered proficient level Thunder Palm?”
“Moreover, you guys even perfectly combined them into a combination skill?”
Also, this Iron-eating Beast’s battle awareness and experience were also ridiculously strong… It actually could find an opportunity to hit the opponent’s vital points in one hit after the Flame Assault move accelerated itself?
What kind of monster combination was this… This was the first time Commander He had seen such a fierce newcomer.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded in response to the question.
As he nodded, everyone fell silent for a moment. Then, there was an uproar.
“That’s Bamboo Stone Dojo’s ultimate skill, Thunder Palm?”
“What ridiculous power. It actually split the flames with one palm.”
“Are you stupid? That’s not an ordinary Thunder Palm, it’s a combination skill. At least, it’s superimposed with the power of expert level Hardening. It has an extremely high requirement for skill proficiency!”
“Is that so?” Someone asked the apprentice from Bamboo Stone Dojo.
At this moment, the apprentices of Bamboo Stone Dojo were also very stunned and had no idea what had happened.
But what happened in front of them told them that this was the case.
Jiang Rui was stunned on the spot. He didn’t understand if Shi Yu had improved greatly during this period of time, or if he didn’t use his full strength at all when they dueled last time.
Beast Tamers of every level had things they needed to study.
At the trainee level, it was already very outstanding to train the pet skill to the proficient and expert levels.
Combination skills were probably things that only professional Beast Tamers would research.
As for master level, it was to study the profundities formed by perfect-level skills.
This was the route that ordinary Beast Tamers should experience, but with Shi Yu and this little Iron-eating Beast…
Therefore, even the Beast Tamers such as Chen Kai, White Stone, and Qiao Liang were stunned. They didn’t understand how this level-seven Little Iron-eating Beast was cultivated.
“I lost.” Facing such an Iron-eating Beast, Cheng Gong’s voice was dry and hoarse. There was nothing he could do even if he refused to admit defeat.
As for the others, they also knew why Shi Yu could quickly pass the first three levels.
Even the Ice-Armored Giant probably couldn’t withstand that combination skill!
Their world views were shattered. This was the first time they knew that a Beast Tamer intern and a pet team of a middle-rank species that was less than level ten could be so brutal!
In a corner, the secretary of the Ping Cheng Association’s president looked at his silent president. He finally received a comment.
“Should I say this about the Iron-eating Beast… Or this Beast Tamer? It’s simply a monster-like talent. It’s so strange that it doesn’t make sense,” he said with a heavy tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - New Special Training Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: New Special Training Target
If there were anyone who had doubts about how Cheng Gong and Shi Yu had broken the record in succession, then now, their doubts gradually dissipated.
Although the Moon Flame Beast was beaten helplessly in this battle, the strength quality displayed during the battle was obvious to all.
The powerful Bursting Flames skill’s attributes completely countered various ice type creatures!
The speed brought by the Flame Assault was probably incomparable to the creatures in the ruins!
Coupled with the agile Flaming Claw, the Moon Flame Beast’s battle method could be close-combat and long-range. Its three skills were all proficient level, and with the advantage of its attributes, it completely had a chance to defeat the Ice-Armored Giant that had a higher racial rank.
As for Shi Yu… there was no need to doubt his strength.
The battle process of the Moon Flame Beast being completely crushed was the best proof of Shi Yu and his panda’s strength.
This was the first time everyone had seen such a ridiculous little Iron-eating Beast.
It was completely understandable that such an outstanding pet could break through four levels in a row!
Although there were still people who were puzzled as to why a level-seven Iron-eating Beast could defeat 50 ferocious beasts in a row, they could only dispel their doubts. They passed all four levels, after all.
Then, they looked at Shi Yu and Eleven as if they were looking at a monster.
…
This battle was different for Beast Tamers of different levels.
The Beast Tamer trainees didn’t understand why Shi Yu and the others could be so strong, while master Beast Tamers like President Feng had greater expectations for cracking the ruins.
He thought that he should deduct some resources from his nephew to Shi Yu. At such a time, cracking the ruins was the most important… His nephew would understand.
Fortunately, Cheng Gong didn’t know what President Feng was thinking. Otherwise, he would definitely think that he was an adopted nephew or something.
As for now, he was thinking about why Ping Cheng had such a monster trainee Beast Tamer that he had never heard of before.
Even those geniuses in Icefield City might not necessarily be able to compare to Shi Yu, right?
“Alright, the battle is over. Go do what you need to do.”
Commander He, who was the judge, blasted these trainee soldiers and said angrily, “Today’s training is doubled!”
His words immediately made the trainees wail.
He Biao, who had expected better from the men, chose to squeeze his new recruits dry.
President Feng secretly wiped his sweat. He was very afraid that He Biao would bring the regiment commander and to ask for training funds.
After the battle ended, Cheng Gong and Shi Yu withdrew their pets.
“Let’s fight again next time,” Cheng Gong said to Shi Yu and left from the other side. He ignored everyone and went off to do something.
As for Shi Yu, he was feeling helpless.
It was Eleven!
It was Eleven who wanted to vent its feelings of failure in this battle, causing the situation… to seem a little lopsided.
Shi Yu shook his head slightly and planned to leave.
To be precise, it was to leave this valley and go home to prepare for battle again.
“President Feng.”
When Shi Yu walked out of the venue, Chen Kai, Qiao Liang, and the others wanted to come over. However, when they saw President Feng walking towards Shi Yu, they immediately stopped.
“Shiyu, your strength… has really broadened my horizons.”
President Feng narrowed his eyes and said. He was pretty happy.
With the aptitude displayed by Shi Yu and the others, they also had hope of becoming master-level Beast Tamers in the future.
Ten years later, Ping Cheng might have another master-level Beast Tamer!
“I still have much to learn,” Shi Yu said humbly.
This was nothing. Although Shi Yu wanted to show off, he also knew that he wasn’t invincible. He wasn’t even considered much among his peers.
Ping Cheng was just a third-level small city.
Icefield City was only one of the more ordinary level-two cities in Dong Huang Nation.
The second-generation heirs of first-level big cities were probably using first pets of commander-level races. Moreover, the age of the contracted pets might be even younger.
Shi Yu was more curious about their strength.
But he should know soon.
Because Lu Qingyi had previously suggested that he go to a first-level city to participate in the vocation assessment. Such a vocation certificate was more valuable…
This woman liked to increase the difficulty of the game too much.
“Hahaha, you don’t have to be humble. You guys are indeed very outstanding.”
“Do you have any thoughts on the fifth level?” President Feng asked.
“I already have one. I plan on returning to prepare for battle,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s good.” President Feng’s eyes lit up.
“It’s good to go back and prepare for battle. Wait a minute, I’ll give you my private contact information. If you have any needs, just tell me directly.”
“The resources allocated by the association will also be in your hands in the future.”
“Your first goal now is to become stronger and attack the ruins!”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
Then, President Feng hurriedly called his secretary over and prepared to get someone to escort Shi Yu home.
Although Shi Yu wanted to refuse, he couldn’t resist the president’s enthusiasm.
This treatment… was like a lemon squeezed in the eyes of the surrounding Beast Tamers.
Was this the treatment of a genius? Even if it was a master-level Beast Tamer, or even the president of the Beast Tamer Association, they had to talk to him with a smile.
“F*ck, I’ll buy the Refreshing Capsules until it’s all gone!”
“I don’t believe that eating the same supplement as Shi Yu won’t make me reach ten percent of his strength!”
At the back, Chen Kai made a great wish.
“What Shi Yu supplements? Hey, what did you mean just now…”
After Shi Yu left, discussions and exclamations came from the crowd.
Doctor Qiao Liang felt that he might know where the heat of the supplements in Ping Cheng came from.
…
“Thank you…”
Shi Yu, who was escorted home in a military car the whole time, was slightly embarrassed. In his previous life, he had never sat in a police car and only sat in an ambulance. Now, it was actually a military car.
The pressure was huge… He had to quickly research how to pass the fifth level.
Shi Yu returned home with a sigh.
Because he knew that if he wanted to pass the fifth level, he might have to spend money to replenish his supplements.
His small body… Even if he had supplements, teaching high-level skills was too painful.
If it weren’t because he had to be teaching skills, Shi Yu really wanted to use low-level skills to increase his physique first.
“Ji!!!!”
After Shi Yu pushed the door open and entered, the green worm on the persimmon tree in the courtyard immediately let out a cry when it heard the sound.
Shi Yu understood through telepathy.
It meant “Welcome home”.
“This worm’s intelligence is getting higher and higher.”
Shi Yu discovered that as the green worm’s growth level increased, its intelligence level was also slowly increasing.
At level one, he was still silly and dumb, but now, he could communicate with him more normally. It was really not easy.
“Is there any food?”
Shi Yu glanced at the Dragon Whiskers Grass on the iron plate under the birdcage. There was still… That was fine.
That made sense. After all, it was only released in the morning. No matter how big the Green Silkworm’s appetite was, it wouldn’t be like Eleven, eating three to four meals at once.
He added some more food for it. After entering the house, Shi Yu threw down his backpack and lay down.
The harvest this time was not small. Even excluding the energy crystal, the four Ethereal Stones were still very rare resources.
He had asked President Feng. If he used these four Ethereal Stones, even without high-intensity meditation, it would almost allow him to reach level two in the Beast Taming Space in three to four months.
Moreover, it was a level-two Beast Taming Space that focused on spatial strength, spatial range, and spatial environment.
In other words, at that time, he could contract a second pet.
At the same time, if the Beast Taming Space had reached level two, it was easier for Eleven to reach the transcendent level. Otherwise, it was more common for a level-one Beast Taming Space to restrict the growth of pets.
In short, the Ethereal Stone was very cost-effective for Shi Yu, who started very late and became a Beast Tamer much later than other people his age…
“I wonder how the compatibility between the spatial element and the Green Silkworm is.” Shi Yu thought again.
Space element was undoubtedly a very powerful attribute. However, it was said that the Ethereal Stone had always been a resource for Beast Tamers. Shi Yu really didn’t know how to use this thing on pets, especially the Green Silkworm.
Compared to this, it was better to have a spatial skill.
If he could really obtain the spatial attribute, Shi Yu felt that the insect’s evolved race level might even be at the monarch level.
Did monarch-level, spatial-type butterflies exist in nature? The Ethereal Butterfly or the Space-splitting Butterfly, maybe?
…
Shi Yu did not let his imagination run wild on the silkworm for too long. After all, things had not started yet. The most important thing now was to conquer the ruins.
There were currently two paths for Shi Yu to pass the fifth level successfully.
First, complete the profundity “Thunder Armor”.
He needed to raise Hardening and Thunder Palm to Perfect Level.
At the moment, Eleven and Green Silkworm still hadn’t mastered any perfect-level skills. Shi Yu still didn’t know how many times he had to teach them from expert to perfect-level.
However, he had a premonition that the higher the proficiency, the harder it was to increase.
It was a common saying. For a skill that was easier to train, as long as the pet’s talent was not bad, along with an alright training environment… Then after training hard for a year, it would be able to master it.
Because of this, the pets of those professional Beast Tamers basically mastered multiple expert racial skills.
However, Perfect Level Proficiency Skills were not as simple as just keeping at it as time accumulated.
Perfection represented the pinnacle of a skill, the pinnacle of an art. Many creatures would find it difficult to achieve this even after spending their entire lives.
Compared to the time-consuming cultivation, this level relied more on talent and training methods.
Pets with perfect proficiency were basically the symbols of master-level Beast Tamers.
As for the transcendent level, it meant that it had transcended the skill itself and directly let the skill leave its original level, belonging to an even deeper level.
Even among master-level Beast Tamers, it was possible that they could only train their pets’ low-level skills to perfection at most. Moreover, it would take them half a life to do so.
It was too difficult to reach perfection for middle to high-level skills.
The higher the skill level, the more complicated it was. The harder it was to master it perfectly, let alone surpass perfection.
“I should start with high-level skills.”
The second method to conquer the ruins was to increase the proficiency of high-level skills.
Shi Yu made a simple judgment and felt that it was more difficult to master the Thunder Armor. To defeat 100 ferocious beasts… Actually, it was possible that he only needed to have three high-level skills reach expert level.
It was relatively easy to reach the expert level.
An expert level deterrence could carry out a large-scale mental pressure on the ferocious beasts. If one was lucky, they could instantly kill 100 beasts.
Expert level multiplication… Although Shi Yu still didn’t know what kind of increase it could bring to Eleven, it seemed like its size and strength would be even greater. It wasn’t impossible for him to crush a group with one punch.
Expert-level Absolute Sleep could use a shorter sleep to recover more stamina. It was simply a recovery skill.
Which one should he increase?
“I shouldn’t have difficulty choosing. I’ll just teach them all.”
“I’ll also raise super vision and high-speed healing to the proficient level.”
“I’ll go after Eleven is expert level in all the skills. Not to mention the fifth level, even if the sixth level throws transcendent creatures at me, I’ll definitely be able to crush it!”
Shi Yu spoke boldly as his body trembled. After all, this was a huge project.

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - Just Add More Points
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Just Add More Points
August 7th, afternoon. Sunlight was good.
In the courtyard, the energetic Eleven was training seriously.
Shi Yu held a Space Spirit Stone and meditated.
If that group of Beast Trainers saw this, they would definitely be embarrassed.
After all, Shi Yu and Eleven had just broken through four ruins in a row in the morning and had gone through countless battles.
In the end, they didn’t even have any intention of resting in the afternoon, and just continued training… This was simply animal behavior.
“It’s indeed much faster than my own meditation.”
Shi Yu put down the Ethereal Stone and felt relieved.
“If only there were more of these rocks.”
Shi Yu found the reason why his cultivation was slow.
If he wanted to quickly increase the level of the Beast Taming Space through meditation, he had to concentrate completely.
But every time he finished teaching the pet skill, he would be both physically and mentally exhausted. How could he be in the mood to meditate?
As time passed, the level increase in the Beast Taming Space slowed down.
In the end, it was still Eleven’s fault.
Shi Yu completely solved the reason for his slow cultivation.
Eleven in the middle of training: (.?ˇ?ˇ?.)???
After giving Eleven more points, I have to take some time to increase the level of the Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu thought.
However, before that, Shi Yu opened his cell phone and logged onto the previous shopping website.
He bought fifteen more beans and other supplements scattered around. It cost about two million yuan.
At this point, there were less than 7 million yuan left from the initial 10 million yuan.
But with these, he could almost raise all of Eleven’s skills to expert level.
“It’s really expensive…”
Looking at the balance, Shi Yu felt the pinch.
From the looks of it, even with the skill index, the 10,000,000 starting capital might not necessarily be able to raise all 11 skills to perfect level, let alone transcendent level.
In the future, if a super skill or Mythical ability was used, wouldn’t the supplements cost hundreds of millions of yuan to reach the maximum level?
At that time, the pets would probably have to eat some outrageous thing like “dragon liver or phoenix marrow”…
In the end, he was still short on money. The skill index could allow him to increase the proficiency of his pet skills faster than other Beast Tamers, but the cost was money.
However, it was also worth it to spend money. After all, other Beast Tamers had to spend money to buy nutritional supplements to train their pet skills. In terms of cost-effective ratio, it would definitely be higher on Shi Yu’s side.
That night…
Shi Yu took out one of the two remaining divine beans and a ginseng baby beard and started to call Eleven over to level it up.
Eleven: ?·°(???_???)°·?!!
Eleven, who had been training for half a day, endured it with tears in its eyes. It was very worried that it would disappoint this bonus.
It also set a goal for itself to clear all six stages next time.
“Don’t worry, if we combine hardwork and cheating, even a god won’t be able to stop the progress,” Shi Yu comforted.
That night, initial-level deterrence was raised to proficient level.
The deterrence that could only be used to increase battle intent and weaken enemy battle intent… Immediately became an attack skill on the spiritual level.
The increase in the deterrence level didn’t mean that Eleven could insta-kill weaker opponents with just its aura. It also meant that any mental-type skills might not have much effect on him.
However, after teaching the skills this time, Shi Yu didn’t seem to be the only one with side effects.
Some special skills could slightly change the temperament and personality of the pet.
For example, if he issued a Berserk command frequently, it was easy for his pets to become crazy, violent, and irrational.
Deterrence was the same. It could nurture a domineering aura that came from the spiritual level of the pet!
Eleven: (/ ^ Д ′) / Howl!!!
As expected, after the deterrence level increased, Eleven immediately became arrogant again.
It wanted to challenge the fifth level now, one against 100.
Shi Yu was silent. He didn’t expect deterrence to have a low intelligence buff.
“Damn it, sleep.”
Eleven could be irrational, but so could Shi Yu.
It didn’t matter if someone came to stop him this time. He had to develop first!
He had to aim to get there in one go and max out his skill level. When the time came, he would break through all the levels in a row, saving himself the trouble of frequently re-challenging and wasting time.
In order to calm Eleven down, Shi Yu had captured it again tonight to use as a pillow…
This made Panda King Eleven fall into deep thought.
A king couldn’t be humiliated!!!
Unless it was its Beast Tamer.
…
The next morning.
Shi Yu was still lying leisurely on the sofa in the courtyard, meditating.
Occasionally, he would glance at his cell phone and check the transport progress of yesterday’s shopping.
As he watched, he put on his earphones and started chasing after a TV series.
As expected, watching dramas was still fun.
However, Shi Yu did not admit that he was procrastinating. He convinced himself he only wanted to stimulate his brain with various movies to pave the way for him to find new skills in the future.
The movies in this world were all related to pets. Very few were purely about people.
Pets were definitely a popular topic. As long as the pets in the show attracted enough attention, the box office would not be low.
For example, the movie Shi Yu was watching currently described the story of the high school student and the beast-eared girl, A story of the different races meeting in a dream and looking for each other.
“Good lord.”
Shi Yu was stunned. This alternate world’s “Your Name”?
Using the male lead to contract the Mermaid Princess in the end and work together to solve the tsunami?
They really dared to film it!
Just as Shi Yu was thinking about why he didn’t encounter such a good thing, he felt his body being stabbed.
He looked up and saw Dumb Eleven staring at him.
“What?”
“Wuu!” The furry Eleven widened its eyes and pointed outside.
It meant that the delivery had arrived.
Shi Yu was too engrossed in it and did not hear any sound.
“!!!” Shi Yu put away his cell phone and ran to collect the package.
Outside, it was still the familiar Wings of Wind, and the familiar delivery guy.
“Brother, it’s you again…”
The delivery man pondered. He had thought that this address was a little familiar. After arriving, he immediately remembered.
Isn’t this the Beast Trainer who spent a lot of money to buy supplements previously?
It had only been less than a week. Again?
Heh!
“I wish you good health.”
The delivery guy didn’t know anything and didn’t dare to ask anything. He could only wish Shiyu good health.
“Have a safe trip and be careful,” Shi Yu also blessed him, making the world filled with true love.
Just like that, Shi Yu obtained another large box of supplements.
A moment later, in the courtyard, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the Green Silkworm looked at the large box of supplements and fell into deep thought.
In the past, when there was no supply of supplements, Shi Yu was afraid to teach skills.
Now that he had a pile of supplements, Shi Yu was still afraid.
Although he was afraid both times, the two types of fear didn’t mean the same thing. Shi Yu could only say that the meaning was broad and profound.
“Sigh!!!”
He had to make use of the talent he had awakened! He just had to just increase his points!
…
At the same time.
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
At the headquarters of the Beast Tamer Association.
Apart from the first day where he went to the ruins to observe the situation, President Feng returned to the association the next day. He handed all the responsibility to Commander He Biao to guard the place.
As the president of an association in a city, he had too many things to do.
At this moment, in the huge conference room, President Feng was holding a video conference with the presidents of the associations in the other eight districts and counties in Icefield City.
Among the nine districts and counties in Icefield City, four of them belonged to the downtown area and were located in the center of the city. They developed better, while Ping Cheng and the other four districts and counties were adjacent to the snow mountain and belonged to the suburbs.
“According to Old Feng’s intelligence… Let’s discuss the use of the Evolution Holy Spring.”

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - Evolution Holy Spring
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Evolution Holy Spring
9th August, clear.
Yesterday, Shi Yu did not touch new supplements. Instead, he used the remaining divine bean and, together with other supplements, raised Eleven’s Absolute Sleep skill to the proficient level.
From then on, he only had one ginseng baby’s beard left.
“Say, if I nurture a ginseng baby myself, nurture it, and teach it the Broken Limb Rebirth skill, will I be able to bug the world and have free supplements to eat every day?”
Shi Yu muttered to himself after waking up in the morning because of a dream where he was falling in love with a Baby Ginseng.
Why did the protagonist of the movie get to dream of the Mermaid Princess and swimming in the sea, while he dreamed of chasing supplements?
He clearly had the potential to be a protagonist… Although compared to the protagonist, he lived more like a cheater.
“Forget it, forget it.”
Soon, Shi Yu shook his head. Forget about the wild ginseng baby, it was strange to eat it after making it his pet.
After getting out of bed and washing up, Shi Yu planned to upgrade Eleven’s multiplication skill to the proficient level today.
This way, he might be able to experience the giant panda bed at night.
This was the Perfect Harmonization. Skills that supported one purpose after another. Everyone had a share.
It was just that only one pet had multiple skills now. In the future, when he had more pets, he could enjoy more benefits.
In the courtyard, under the persimmon tree.
After the two of them had a warm breakfast, Shi Yu was just about to add more points when there was a knock on the door.
…
“Who is it?”
At this moment, it didn’t seem like the time for a dojo delivery. Shi Yu was still wondering who it was.
However, when the person outside replied, Shi Yu was immediately stunned.
He hurriedly ran to open the door and saw the middle-aged man in a gray suit with a small mustache.
“Guild Leader Feng?”
“Why are you here?”
“I’ve only rested for two days. Don’t tell me I’m going to explore the ruins?”
Shi Yu touched his liver.
President Feng smiled and said, “How could that be?”
“I understand. You must be here to talk about the cultivation resources!” Shi Yu suddenly understood.
He almost forgot that the Ping Cheng Association had decided to take out a sum of resources to nurture the Beast Tamers.
Could it be that the number of resources had been decided?
“Yes, and no. There’s something more important.”
…
A moment later, in the room, Shi Yu served President Feng with red date tea.
“President Feng, what’s the important thing you’re talking about?”
President Feng chuckled. “It’s also related to the ruins this time.”
He drank a mouthful of tea and praised it.
“It tastes good.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Of course!
Shi Yu was quite proud.
“Let me start by talking about the law of our country.”
“According to the legacy law of our country, if the ruins appear in Ping Cheng, we have the right to explore it first.”
After President Feng finished speaking, Shi Yu nodded.
“But during a certain period of time, if we can’t crack the ruins and obtain the right to control the ruins, this exploration and development authority will gradually be opened to the surrounding cities and gradually have its scope expanded.”
“For example, if Ping Cheng can’t crack the ruins in a month, the other districts and counties in Icefield City can come and explore together.”
Guild Leader Feng sighed.
“You also know the difficulty of this ruin. Just the fifth level will probably keep us stuck for a long time, let alone the unknown sixth level.”
“With our current progress, the other Beast Tamer Associations in Icefield City don’t think that our Ping Cheng can crack the ruins independently at all. Therefore, they have already started preparing in advance.”
“They’re going to prepare for the challenge of the ruins in Ping Cheng a month later…”
Although President Feng was very annoyed, he couldn’t do anything to them.
He was very confident in Shi Yu, but it was clearly unrealistic for Shi Yu to crack the ruins in a month.
Passing the fifth level in a month was already a blessing!
At that moment, after hearing President Feng’s words, Shi Yu was stunned.
Who are you looking down on? Shi Yu muttered in his heart. You can choose not to believe the Iron-eating Beast, but you have to believe that box of supplements!
A month later, the ruins would be long gone!
Of course, this was too arrogant. Shi Yu was afraid of being beaten up by the president, so he could only continue nodding.
“After you left the day before yesterday, I reported the information about the fourth and fifth levels of the ruins.”
“Haha, there’s no doubt that the situation at the fourth and fifth levels also shocked the presidents of the other associations.”
“They all think that it’s too difficult for trainee Beast Tamers to pass.”
“However, even if it’s difficult, I have to overcome it. Therefore, Icefield City has decided to activate the Holy Spring.”
“Holy Spring, what’s that?”
President Feng said, “That’s a holy land for training pets in our Icefield City. It’s a fixed resource. The pet can be reborn after soaking in the power of the Holy Spring.”
“Let me give you an example. Pets are divided into growth levels and race levels. The latter represents potential.”
“The higher the species level, the greater the potential. Why is that? Why is it stronger under the same level of growth?”
“Putting aside the racial skills, that’s because the life level of high-level pets is higher. The most direct manifestation of this life level is strong physique and vigorous physical fitness.”
“The same growth level and the same skill… But a pet of a regular transcendent race might exhaust its physical fitness after using it ten times, while a commander rank species pet might be able to use it fifteen times. This is the advantage!”
“The spring water in the Holy Spring won’t increase the pet’s growth level, but it can improve the pet’s physique, stimulate the pet’s potential, and even increase its life level.”
“It’s a rare resource that can increase the racial level of the pet, which is also its evolution potential. For example, your Iron-eating Beast might have exhausted its physical fitness after using the Thunder Palm ten times previously, but after this baptism, its physical upper limit will increase a lot. It might not be a problem to use it more than ten times.”
“Do you understand its value now? In short, you can see this opportunity as a super training to challenge the fourth and fifth levels of the ruins.”
“Of course, this Holy Spring only has the best effect on pets in the awakening stage. At the same time, the lower the species level, the better the effect. There was even a time when pets directly evolved after bathing in the Holy Spring, so it’s called the Evolution Holy Spring. It can increase the chance of evolution chance. But this depends on fate.”
After President Feng finished speaking, Shi Yu was clearly stunned.
What he lacked, came.
Eleven’s greatest drawback was that there were too many powerful skills, and its physical fitness was insufficient for it to use them.
It wasn’t something that could be done overnight.
Bathing in this Holy Spring could increase Eleven’s upper limit?
Then, the exploration of the ruins would be even more stable.
As for evolution… Eleven soaking in spring water could even make it evolve… He didn’t believe it.
“You mean?”
“In order to prepare the fourth and fifth levels for the Beast Tamers in the major cities in advance, the Beast Tamer Associations of the four downtown and five suburb districts each have a Holy Spring spot for recommended Tamers to use.
“The Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng intends to recommend you. After all, you can be said to be the strongest Beast Tamer intern in Ping Cheng at the moment.”
“Don’t worry, apart from this spot, the Ping Cheng Association won’t forget about the other cultivation resources.”
Shi Yu really felt that the Ping Cheng Association was very kind. Not only did they let him borrow money to buy pets at the start, but they also gave him so many resources!
He also smiled, but soon, his smile disappeared because of President Feng’s next words.
“However, the regeneration of the Holy Spring in Icefield City is very slow, and the effect can’t be used too many times. Therefore, only one pet can enter at one time, and the effect will definitely be the best if it’s used first. At that time, there will be inevitable competition. You have to be prepared.”
What, there were competitors even in a hot spring?
Shi Yu’s gaze gradually turned sharp.
It was really rolling up everywhere. However, if they were all at the probationary level, he felt that he should be able to defeat them randomly?

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - Fighting Elites
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Fighting Elites
“When is this?”
Shi Yu immediately asked.
He felt that he should challenge the ruins after soaking in the hot spring.
Otherwise, if he wasn’t given this Holy Spring opportunity after clearing the ruins too early, he would have suffered a huge loss.
Of course, this was only just a thought. If this ruin was really very important and he conquered it, he wouldn’t abandon that over soaking in the spring for too long.
“It’s about a week later. After all, we have to give the other associations sufficient time to choose their recommended Beast Tamers.”
President Feng was silent for a moment before continuing, “I wonder what kind of Beast Tamer they will send…”
To be honest, Guild Leader Feng wasn’t too sure either.
Although Shi Yu’s talent was extraordinary, it would be uncomfortable if a second-generation heir popped out of nowhere with a commander race pet contracted at the start.
It had been some time since he had paid attention to the situation of the newbies in the other districts and counties. He really couldn’t tell what the situation was like in the recent year.
He only knew that Cheng Gong wasn’t the best in their school. He was only at the top.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. Resources like the Holy Spring emphasized on absorption efficiency. Even if it wasn’t the first to use it, the effect might not be bad.
President Feng gave himself a heads-up.
“In other words, I have a week to prepare.”
“Yes, you should be sufficiently prepared. The Ping Cheng Association will first distribute 1 million yuan in cash resources to you.”
“For the subsequent resources, if you need anything, you can apply directly.”
President Feng took a sip of red date tea.
1 million!
Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. Although it wasn’t too much, it was quite a bit.
At the very least, the consumption of supplements during this period of time could be made up for directly.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Heh, I won’t disturb you then.”
“It’s a pity that Old Lin isn’t around during this period of time. Otherwise, he could still give you temporary guidance.”
“Although I’ve never cultivated an Iron-eating Beast, if you have any problems, you can come directly to me.”
President Feng shook his head and put down the cup.
“Alright.” Although he didn’t need any guidance, Shi Yu still thanked him.
He didn’t have any special requests. When the time came, he could just ask President Feng to bring out all his pets and let him broaden his horizons.
Then, President Feng left.
After Shi Yu sent him away, he fell into deep thought in the courtyard.
He still had a week to level up…
In order to stabilize his position and fight for Eleven’s spot to soak in the Holy Spring, he should work overtime.
…
A week. With a goal, it would pass quickly.
Apart from going to Bamboo Stone Dojo a few times, he had been training at home.
After visiting the dojo a few more times, Shi Yu learned that Hall Master Lin Hongnian and Senior Lin Xiuzhu were no longer in Ping Cheng…
The former went to carry out a mission, while the latter seemed to have returned to her alma mater to do something.
No wonder no one came to ask in shock after the news of him mastering the combination skill spread. So they weren’t around. How boring!
With few familiar faces around, Shi Yu’s life was boring and boring. He cultivated and cultivated.
In the blink of an eye, a week passed.
Eleven’s attributes changed completely.
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
[Attributes]: Metal
[Level of Growth]: Level 7 Awakening
[Skill]: Hardening (Expert+4), Thunder Palm (Expert), High Speed Healing (Expert), Super Vision (Expert), Deterrence (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Proficient), Multiplication (Proficient).
From this terrifying interface, one should be able to see how hard Shi Yu worked.
Compared to a week ago, four skills have gone through significant changes.
High-speed healing, super vision, deterrence, multiplication!
Their effects had more or less changed as well.
Compared to the proficient level’s high-speed healing, the expert level’s high-speed healing completely reflected the word “high-speed”.
As long as the energy consumed was enough, even if the injury was great, it could be healed instantly within a certain range.
Next was super vision. Compared to proficient level, expert level super vision could already achieve 360 degrees vision without any blind spots.
At the same time, he could easily see through illusions of the same level.
With this, Eleven was still invincible on the battlefield even if its back was facing the enemy.
Upon reaching this symbol, Shi Yu felt that Eleven’s cosplay was completely successful.
Observation Haki: Supervision!
Armament Haki: Hardening!
Conqueror’s Haki: Deterrence!
It couldn’t be the Pirate King, but it could be the king of the Pandas.
In seven days, Eleven’s deterrence skill had also reached expert level.
This was its only expert high-level skill.
It was just that Shi Yu had yet to experiment with the upper limit. The green worm was too weak.
However, according to Shi Yu and Eleven’s initial estimations, as long as the opponent was in the Awakening Stage, even if the opponent was at level ten of Awakening, it might not necessarily be able to withstand the deterrence of an expert level.
After all, deterrence was mainly carried out on the spiritual level.
Eleven, who had upgraded deterrence and super vision to expert level and absolute sleep to proficiency level, had a lot of spiritual power feedback. No one could say for sure how strong its spiritual power was.
As for proficient level multiplication, the increase could only be said to be average.
In the shrunken state, it could turn Eleven’s height into 25 centimeters. It was ridiculously small and its combat power was also ridiculously weakened. However, it was strangely cute. It seemed like it was fine to put it on his shoulder or something.
In the multiplication state, it could transform the originally one-meter-tall Eleven into a four-meter-tall giant Iron-eating Beast. Its strength increase was astonishing, but its consumption was also astonishing.
At least, the current Eleven couldn’t maintain it for long. It wasn’t suitable for battle.
In short, he still lacked “mana”.
Let’s see if this trip to the Holy Spring could change Eleven’s lack of mana.
…
August 16.
On the day they set off for the south city area of Icefield City, where the Holy Spring was located, it was President Feng who personally came to fetch Shi Yu.
Next, the two of them headed to the destination together.
“How was your rest?” In the car, President Feng narrowed his eyes and observed Shi Yu through the window with a strange expression.
Why did he feel that after a week, Shi Yu’s mental state wasn’t as good as he imagined? Didn’t he rest well?
Could it be that because of his words, he had trained hard for a week???
What a genius!!! President Feng cried.
He was talented and hardworking! Why would Ping Cheng have to worry about the development of the city if there were more Beast Tamers like him?
“Not bad.”
Shi Yu raised his thumb. There was no problem.
With that, he opened the door and got into the car.
President Feng was in the front passenger seat, and Shi Yu sat in the back. As for the driver… it was President Feng’s female secretary.
It seemed like being a president was a pretty good experience.
“There’s no need to be nervous. With your talent and strength, you’re an elite even in a big city!”
“The newbies from the other districts and counties who compete with you for the Evolution Holy Spring might not necessarily be as outstanding as you.”
President Feng was quite confident, mainly because Shi Yu was indeed quite outstanding.
Shi Yu: “I’m not nervous. They should be the ones who are nervous.”
President Feng and the female secretary:??
Good heavens, this kid was arrogant enough.
Before noon that day, Shi Yu and President Feng arrived at the south city area of Icefield City.
As a downtown area, this place was much better than the suburbs of Ping Cheng.
Coincidentally, the school Shi Yu attended and the place where he interned were in this particular district and county.
It wasn’t the first time Shi Yu had come to the Beast Tamer Association in the southern area. This place was still the same as before. It was very imposing and grand.
In the huge building complex, President Feng and Shi Yu didn’t seem to have arrived early. After all, Ping Cheng was relatively far…
Therefore, before they arrived, the presidents of the associations in the other eight districts and counties, as well as the representatives from their districts and counties, had already arrived.
It could be said that at the moment, this was the gathering place of the big shots of Icefield City and the elites of the newbies.
However, Shi Yu suddenly remembered… Eleven seemed to like fighting elites!

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - Battle Power Unit
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Battle Power Unit
After Shi Yu and the others arrived at their destination, the South District Association naturally welcomed them warmly.
The president of the South City Association, a round-faced middle-aged man with a red face and short stature, greeted him with a smile.
“Old Feng, you’re finally here.”
With that said, he looked at Shi Yu, who was beside President Feng, and said, “This must be the genius who conquered the fourth level of the ruins in Ping Cheng.”
“He does look talented.”
“Haha… His name is Shi Yu.” President Feng smiled. Of course.
However, the president of the South District Association could smile now, but the president hoped that he’d be crying later!
Although on the surface, it was everyone splitting the resources of the Holy Spring together…
In essence, it was also a secret race for ruins.
The other districts and counties didn’t think that Ping Cheng could successfully explore the ruins independently, so they decided to open the Holy Spring.
In the process of competing to enter the Holy Spring this time, the presidents likely also wanted to see whose newbie was the strongest.
In a sense, this ranking already represented the progress of the various districts and counties attacking the ruins later.
At this moment, President Feng naturally hoped that Shi Yu could perform better.
He didn’t want the ruins of Ping Cheng to really be taken away by other districts and counties…
“Hello, President Sun.”
At the same time, Shi Yu also greeted.
It wasn’t because of anything else, but because this President Sun had good taste and could tell that he was a talent.
“Alright, alright. Let’s go to the hall quickly. A welcome party has been prepared there. Everyone, eat your fill and rest well before discussing the Holy Spring,” President Sun said with a smile.
…
In the banquet hall, the presidents and newbie representatives of the other associations were also present.
When the presidents of the other associations saw President Feng arrive, they immediately greeted him warmly with “Old Feng”.
As for the other Beast Trainers who weren’t even 20 years old, they didn’t care about President Feng, this middle-aged official from a remote village. Instead, their attention was on the handsome Shi Yu.
“The representative of Ping Cheng District supposedly cracked four out of the six levels of the ruins in Ping Cheng…”
“He seems to be a very good combat unit. We can test his level when he enters the ruins.”
Although they did not say it out loud, every newbie, and even the presidents of other associations, treated Shi Yu this way.
As a local “lucky guy” in Ping Cheng, Shi Yu was the first to come into contact with the ruins and obtained pretty good results, but he didn’t completely conquer the ruins. This was a template for a proper battle power competition.
At this moment, if the rookie representatives of the other eight districts and counties wanted to find someone to fight, it would definitely be Shi Yu.
“I keep feeling that their gazes are a little unfriendly…”
Shi Yu was also observing the others. There were eight young boys and girls in their twenties. Six boys, and two girls.
Hmm… They didn’t look weak. They should all be stronger than Cheng Gong, right?
He hoped that their strength could please him a little.
This way, his hard work and points wouldn’t be in vain.
“Shiyu, let me introduce you.”
Then, President Feng began to introduce the other presidents to Shi Yu.
At the same time, the presidents of each association also introduced their newbies.
However, this basic introduction was basically superficial. No one could get any valuable information from each other.
Soon, everyone’s attention was on the food buffet.
He didn’t know if others were hungry, but Shi Yu, who had been sitting in the car all the way and hadn’t eaten much in the morning, was starving.
Therefore, everyone started eating soon.
Shi Yu realized that the people of Dong Huang also had a national characteristic. They weren’t quiet during meals and liked to discuss things as they ate.
The newcomers from the nine districts and counties were still alright, since there were many big bosses here. As a result, they appeared very shy, low-profile, and silent.
However, the presidents of the nine associations started to discuss the order of entering the Holy Spring excitedly as they ate.
“To be fair, let the nine of them take turns fighting. In the end, we’ll decide the order to enter the Holy Spring according to the points. How about that?”
“Our South City Association provides recovery items and healing pets. We guarantee that they will be at their peak in every battle.”
President Sun of the South City Association gave a suggestion.
“Isn’t this too slow?”
A lean president of the association shook his head and said, “The nine of them taking turns to fight… How long would that take?”
This was a classic example of an impatient person.
However, his words also obtained the agreement of others.
Although the presidents of the associations also wanted to know the strength of their representatives,
They were all master-level Beast Tamers. They really didn’t have much desire to watch the newbie competitions.
Compared to the process, they paid more attention to the results.
As long as there were results, the process was not important.
“How about this, use the form of the arena battle. Whoever wants to be the first to enter will guard the arena.”
“Those who don’t accept it will attack the one in the arena.”
“It can both ensure that everyone has the opportunity and reduce some unnecessary battles.”
The lean president gave a different suggestion. The meaning was very clear. Whoever was confident in their strength should go and defend the arena. After showing their strength in one or two battles, some people who knew their own limitations should be able to understand the difference.
At that time, compared to wasting time fighting, it was better to directly give up the attacking arena. This way, many battles could be avoided at once.
With that said, he glanced at the representative of his association, a short-haired young man in a white battle suit. Clearly, he was very confident in the strength of his rookie representative.
“This is fine.”
The lean president’s suggestion was immediately supported by the other presidents.
The idea was good.
“Then, who’s going to defend the arena first?” President Sun said.
After he finished speaking, the rookies were still very shy.
After all, even if they were confident in their own strength, the pressure was a little too great to be the first to stand out and defend the arena.
“I’ll do it.”
Just as no one made a decision, at the dining table, Shi Yu finished a piece of steak and silently put down his chopsticks.
“I’ll be the first to defend the arena,” Shi Yu said as he looked up.
His initiative instantly attracted everyone’s attention.
“Uh.”
This guy was really fierce.
President Feng was stunned. Then, he quickly smiled and expressed his support.
The other presidents and newcomer representatives were also stunned. Then they thought to themselves,
“This guy… is very knowledgeable!”
At this time, whoever defended the arena first would never have a better effect than Shi Yu, the only combatant who had entered the ruins.
With a reference like Shi Yu, everyone could roughly guess their level in exploring ruins.
“Good, you have guts.”
The presidents of the associations praised Shi Yu one after another. After saying that, they started educating their geniuses. “You guys should learn more.”
Of course, these were all pleasantries… Everyone was waiting for the battle in the afternoon.
Time passed quickly.
Soon, everyone finished eating. The presidents were all busy people, so naturally, they hoped for the results to appear as soon as possible.
Therefore, after everyone rested for a while after dinner, they decided to start the competition.
…
In the building complex of the Beast Tamer Association in the South District, in an arena the size of a stadium.
Everyone who had rested came here in the afternoon. There was actually a stone arena here.
Apart from the two competitors, the others could watch the battle from the higher seats.
“Let’s start directly. There won’t be a referee.”
With nine master-level Beast Tamers here, it didn’t matter if there was a judge or not. The battle process was definitely under control.
Apart from determining the outcome of the battle, the main purpose of the judge was to ensure the safety of both parties.
After all, it was difficult to control the speed of a pet in battle. It was inevitable that it would be injured. Even Beast Tamers might be injured.
An outstanding judge could definitely eliminate all unstable factors.
A tall and handsome young man, as the guardian, was the first to go up the arena.
Although there weren’t many spectators, they were all heavyweight. The top batch of Beast Tamers in Icefield City were all sitting here.
Shi Yu felt that it was alright. The pressure was not high.
In Lu Qingyi’s words, when he explored the Ice Dragon Ruins in the future, he could directly call these nine people to be his bodyguards.
“Shi Yu, the most powerful Beast Tamer trainee in Ping Cheng.”
“The third stage of the ruins is a level ten Ice Armor Giant of a low class commander species.”
“The fourth level of the ruins is a total of 50 ice-element ferocious beasts…”
“If he can pass the fourth level, he must be very strong.”
The rookies present still knew some information about Shi Yu. After all, the guide information of the ruins was synchronized in the city.
However, they didn’t know much about Shi Yu’s exact strength.
Therefore, although everyone regarded Shi Yu as a combat unit, they also felt a certain amount of pressure.
If they couldn’t defeat this combat unit, didn’t that mean that they didn’t even have any hope of passing the fourth level of the ruins?
Not to mention the fifth and sixth levels…
Therefore, no matter what, everyone’s immediate thought was to defeat Shi Yu forcefully and prove their strength.
Then, to enter the Holy Spring Baptism, conquer the ruins, and rise up.
“Who’s the first to attack?” The presidents looked at the newcomer representatives beside them.
There was actually a disadvantage to fighting in advance, which was that once the pet’s race, combination moves, and battle style were figured out, it was very easy for the following opponent to devise battle strategies in advance. The first challenger would then suffer in the subsequent battles.
“I’ll do it.”
The young man in white battle clothes beside the lean president who suggested the group arena spoke up.
“Then let’s do it first. Bai Qi. We’ll just do it normally.” The lean president smiled at him.
“Yes.” The young man named Bai Qi nodded.
“Go ahead, go ahead.”
The presidents of the other associations said indifferently. Anyway, it was an arena battle. It didn’t matter who came first.
With that said, they looked at Bai Qi.
Everyone was not too unfamiliar with Bai Qi.
He came from the White Plains District in the downtown area of Icefield City. His father was a master-level Beast Tamer, and he could be said to be a second-generation heir.
From the fact that the daughter of a master-level Beast Tamer, Lin Hongnian, could pass the vocation assessment at the age of 18 with a middle-rank Iron-eating Beast, one could tell how powerful the strength of these second-generation heirs was.
In short, the sons and daughters of a master-level Beast Tamer were definitely better than the type like Cheng Gong, who was just a nephew of President Feng.
Then, the young man in the white battle suit slowly walked down the stage and came opposite Shi Yu.
At that moment, the 16 spectators, be they big shots or rookies, focused their attention on the two of them.
The battle was about to begin.

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - Kings Aura
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: King’s Aura
In the arena of the South District Association.
In the arena, Shi Yu and Bai Qi stood on both sides.
After they nodded slightly in greeting, Shi Yu was the first to speak.
“Let’s send our pets out together.”
“Alright,” Bai Qi replied.
In the next second.
As the field rippled, two huge transparent array formations appeared in front of them.
“Jiu!!!!!!”
“Gwah?!”
In the summoning array, two voices sounded. Their pets directly appeared!
Hu hu hu!!!!
On Bai Qi’s side, a two-meter-tall eagle pet with strong muscles, beautiful golden-brown feathers, and sharp eyes flew out.
“Jiu!!!!!!”
After it appeared, it raised its head and let out a long cry. A whirlwind lingered around it, and its voice was especially domineering, like the overlord of the sky.
[Name]: Wings of Wind
[Attributes]: Wind
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Wind Wings, Ripping Claw, Super Sight, Wind Blade
This was a pretty impressive aerial battle pet, a top-notch pet among extraordinary races.
However, on the other side of the Wings of Flight, Eleven, who appeared, fell into deep thought.
Wasn’t this guy… the bird that delivered the package to Shi Yu?
To be precise, it was the same race as that bird!
His opponent this time was this?
Could he lose to a courier? No!
Eleven’s gaze was fierce. In addition, because it had never fought with a flying pet, it subconsciously made a “Gwah” to express its excitement.
“It’s the Wings of Wind versus the Iron-eating Beast!”
At this moment, as the two pets appeared, everyone made comments.
Everyone naturally attached great importance to this tenth-level and seemingly outstanding Wings of Wind.
At the Awakening Stage, pets that could fly agilely had a huge advantage. After all, most pets didn’t have battle experience in the air.
Therefore, the moment they saw the Wings of Wind, the remaining Beast Trainers felt that this Bai Qi was very difficult to deal with.
