The race of the Wings of Wind was not bad, and it had a lot of accompanying skills. As the new representative of the White Plains Association, Bai Qi’s proficiency in pet skills would definitely not be low. After all, he was a descendant of a master-level Beast Tamer…
A strong enemy…
In comparison, on Shi Yu’s side…
Everyone was first stunned, then they were infinitely stunned.
Although he knew that Shi Yu’s pet was an Iron-eating Beast, but…
Everyone looked at the little fatty standing about a meter on the ground and fell into deep thought.
Why did this Iron-eating Beast look like it had a low growth level?
The increase in the level of growth would also lead to the development of the pet. Therefore, age could have a deceiving effect, but still… The development of the pet wasn’t something that could be hidden.
This one-meter-tall Little Iron-eating Beast’s growth level was definitely not high!
“What’s going on?”
The presidents of the associations subconsciously looked at President Feng.
How did Shi Yu pass the four levels of the ruins with this little Iron-eating Beast? It had to be a joke.
“Look, watch quietly.” President Feng was silent.
At the same time, he had a lot of inner thoughts.
The Wings of Wind… He didn’t know if Shi Yu could handle the flying pets.
According to his judgment, this Wings of Wind was definitely harder to deal with than Cheng Gong’s Exploding Flame Beast.
After all, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast didn’t have any long-range skills at all. Facing a flying pet, it was naturally at a disadvantage!
At the same time, in the arena, Bai Qi looked at Eleven and was stunned.
“What level has your Iron-eating Beast awakened?” he asked.
“Level-seven,” said Shi Yu.
Everyone was silent.
The corners of Bai Qi’s mouth twitched. “Then how did you guys pass the four stages of the ruins? Didn’t they say that there were commander-level ferocious beasts and small-scale beast tides??”
Eleven’s appearance made everyone doubt the authenticity of the ruins’ difficulty. It couldn’t be helped. Eleven’s appearance was too deceptive.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Then how many stages do you think my Wings of Wind can pass?” After arriving at the arena, Bai Qi spoke a lot more.
“Perhaps it will fall in the fourth level,” Shi Yu analyzed seriously.
After he finished analyzing, Bai Qi was amused. It meant that the Wings of Flight definitely couldn’t defeat this guy’s Iron-eating Beast, right?
Then he wanted to see what kind of tricks Shi Yu could nurture with a level-seven Iron-eating Beast.
Even if there were additional skills, even if its racial skill reached expert level… It would definitely not be so easy to resist against the Wings of Wind.
“Let’s begin.”
Bai Qi stepped forward menacingly.
His expression turned serious. At the same time, green ripples spread out on the Wings of Wind, still flying in the sky.
Hu hu hu!!!!
The wind around the Wings of Wind got even stronger.
And at this moment, the things displayed by the Wings of Wind were also very commendable.
“Green energy cloak, expert level Wind Wings. This Wings of Wind has a racial skill that has reached expert level!”
The presidents of the associations present all saw the skill situation of the Wings of Wind!
At this moment, the strength quality displayed by the Wings of Wind made some of the newbie representatives even more worried.
Wind Wings was a skill that increased speed. An expert level Wind Wings meant that the speed of this Wings of Wind would be very terrifying.
Not only was its speed terrifying, but it also had super vision that could quickly lock onto his target at high speed, as well as two powerful attack skills. In addition, he could fly. Damn, how was he to fight?
“I feel that that little Iron-eating Beast is completely helpless…”
Even the master-level Beast Tamers couldn’t think of what the little Iron-eating Beast could use to fight the enemy.
Even President Feng, who knew some of Shi Yu’s background, froze slightly.
Could Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast handle it?
It should… be alright, right?
“Jiuu!”
As the Wings of Wind in the sky let out another cry, it attacked.
It didn’t use wind blades because it would conflict with the wind wings. Instead, it used the tearing claw that could even tear steel apart.
The Wings of Wind planned to showcase its speed advantage.
The speed of the wind wings and the sharpness of the huge claws.
The combination of the two became the simplest and most basic combination skill.
However, it was very practical.
“Grandmaster Bai’s son isn’t bad…”
Everyone thought to themselves as they looked at the huge bird that was like a beam of light flying towards the little Iron-Eating Beast below.
Could it withstand it by hardening?
It definitely couldn’t dodge.
“It can’t possibly take the hit.”
In the arena, Bai Qi’s gaze flickered with extreme determination.
However, in the next second, he sensed that something was wrong.
It was as if his whole body was trembling.
Even the Wings of Wind, which was flying towards Eleven, couldn’t help but freeze.
It was as if it could feel the aura of a top-notch predator from the little Iron-Eating Beast below.
“What happened?”
At this moment, no one realized the seriousness of the matter.
But as the little Iron-eating Beast, which no one was optimistic about, raised its head slightly and looked at its opponent, everything changed.
Boom!!!
It was as if there was an invisible wave emanating from the iron-eating beast!
As it looked at its opponent, the air around Eleven began to hum and vibrate. A nearly substantial deterrence wave formed a transparent tide beside it. This scene suddenly shocked everyone.
In the next moment, a terrifying deterrence wave spread out directly and swept across the arena like a storm.
Voom!
The Wings of Wind seemed to have touched a forbidden domain, yet it felt as if it had not touched anything. But in this instant, its eyes couldn’t help but turn white. Its entire body went weak and powerless, as if it had suffered a serious injury. It directly fell from the sky!
Bang!
The Wings of Wind fell to the ground heavily. Bai Qi’s expression gradually exploded.
As he didn’t really want to battle the eight of them, Shi Yu immediately started with a big move.
He simply insta-killed the opponent. The others could feel free to challenge him if they still wanted.
At the same time, all the master-level Beast Tamers watching the battle stood up at the same time and said with greater shock,
“King’s aura, expert in deterrence, how is this possible!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - Spirit Medium
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Spirit Medium
“This is… deterrence?”
A deterrence that only monarch-level creatures could master?
The eyes of the presidents of the associations were filled with shock. Although they had already made a judgment, their hearts were still in turmoil.
Everyone looked at the Wings of Wind that lost its ability to fight in an instant, and their mouths opened wide.
This was impossible. This didn’t make sense. This was simply unscientific!
The presidents denied it three times in their hearts!
As master-level Beast Tamers, they naturally knew what this meant.
Although a pet that had grown to the level of a monarch could definitely awaken deterrence, and while this was technically a sort of common skill within the realm of top masters… The problem was that this iron-eating beast was only f*cking level-seven!!
If Eleven was a cub of a monarch, they would accept it. But the key was that the Iron-eating Beast’s race level was only medium transcendent!
Their eyes nearly popped out when such a deterrence skill awakened on such an Iron-eating Beast!
Moreover… This was no ordinary deterrence!
Entry-level deterrence, even if it was proficient-level deterrence, could not possibly have such performance power!
Deterrence materialized and attacked indiscriminately on a large scale. The Beast Tamer world called it the “king’s aura”!
Even monarch-level creatures required a certain level of aptitude to master high-level deterrence abilities!
However, such an ability had actually appeared on a Beast Tamer trainee…
The other presidents of the associations looked at the confused and shocked President Feng.
President Feng looked at them as if to say, “If I said that I just found out, would you believe me?”
Everyone clearly didn’t believe it.
Then, he looked at the Little Iron-eating Beast with an incredulous gaze.
With this potential, it would definitely become a monarch.
…
“This…”
On the other side, when they saw the Wings of Wind instantly being insta-killed, all the trainee rookies widened their mouths and were stunned.
The reversal of the battle situation was too sudden, causing them to not understand what had happened.
“Why, why can pets in the Awakening Stage awaken deterrence skills!!”
They roared in their hearts. Even if the talent was good and they could awaken deterrence in advance, they should at least only think about it after commander rank.
Deterrence at the awakening level, what was this?
But, the most shocked and surprised person at this moment was still Beast Tamer Bai Qi of the Wings of WInd.
He was completely stunned, dazed, and had lost the ability to think.
Hm?
Lost?
It was insta-killed before it even started?
Bai Qi couldn’t understand.
“I was wrong. He’s expert level in Wind Wings. He might be able to pass the fourth level.”
Shi Yu thought to himself…
These words completely shattered Bai Qi’s mental defense and almost made him black out.
Monster!
The Beast Trainer in front of him and the iron-eating beast with an innocent expression were definitely monsters!!!
“#% $# ￥@%!!!”
Then, Bai Qi returned to the audience seats in a daze.
At this moment, as Shi Yu easily obtained the first victory and completed the arena defense, everyone fell silent.
Why…
Why could an ordinary pet of the Beast Tamer Awakening Stage awaken deterrence skills and upgrade them to expert level?
It was completely incomprehensible. What was even more incomprehensible was that even with such a deterrence skill, he actually couldn’t pass the fifth stage of the ruins?
How difficult was this ruin!
Many of the trainees began to hesitate and retreat.
They believed that they could not insta-kill the Wings of Wind, so there currently seemed to be no solutions at all to counter Shi Yu.
“Anyone want to continue attacking?”
In the arena, after Shi Yu threw a small fruit to Eleven to recover its stamina, he looked at the other seven Beast Tamers and spoke in an especially piercing voice.
It made the seven of them subconsciously clench their fists.
Was this guy out of his mind?
How could they fight! How could they fight!
That seemingly very strong Wings of the Wind was directly insta-killed. Most people did not have the confidence to defeat Shi Yu.
The presidents of the associations looked at the silent rookies with complicated expressions.
They also didn’t think that anyone could defeat such an Iron-eating Beast.
Expert-level deterrence wasn’t something any creature could challenge.
“Let me try.”
However, there were still brave warriors. At this moment, a quiet girl with short hair stood up.
She took a deep breath, her eyes flickering.
As she stood up, everyone looked at her.
“Jingyin…” In the audience, President Sun of South City looked at the girl. She was from their association.
…
“I’m Xu Jingyin, a Spirit Medium, pleased to meet you.”
After going on stage, the short-haired and quiet girl introduced herself.
She also came from the city, after the Spirit Medium family.
Spirit Medium!
Spirit Mediums were a branch of Beast Tamers. Beast Tamers who called themselves that way basically only contracted undead pets!
After saying that, the girl started to summon her pet.
Hu hu hu ~ ~
Under a stifling cold wind, a huge black spirit body with red eyes walked out of the summoning array.
< Name > Nether Cat
[Attributes]: Undead-type, Spirit-type
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Soul-Crushing Claw, Illusion, Hidden Spirit
At this moment, as the Nether Cat appeared, the presidents of the association were slightly stunned. It was actually a rare dual-element undead pet.
The rarity of this pet was even higher than the Wings of Wind!
As expected, none of the representatives from the four major cities were easy to deal with. The presidents of the suburbs thought to themselves.
The resources that geniuses got… were really different.
“Because her pet is a spiritual type, she thinks she can withstand the deterrence?”
“Can she hold on?”
Everyone guessed.
At the same time, in the arena.
“Hello,” Shi Yu replied curtly to the black-dressed girl in front of him.
The girl was pretty cute, but he still had to fight.
At this moment, as the Spirit Medium Xu Jingyin appeared, everyone’s evaluation changed.
Just now, they were still curious if Shi Yu’s Little Iron-eating Beast could withstand the opponent’s attack.
And now, it had become an issue of whether the opponent could withstand the little Iron-Eating Beast’s deterrence.
After all, the deterrence was too insane…
The deterrence skill focused on the spiritual level. If it was a pet that mainly dealt in spiritual power, perhaps it could withstand it?
“Nether, Hidden Spirit, Illusion!”
As soon as the battle began, Xu Jingyin focused all her attention and gave her pet an order.
In the next moment, the giant black cat’s figure directly turned transparent and disappeared from the arena.
[Hidden Spirit]: A low-level undead skill. Eliminate your aura and enter a concealed state.
[Illusion]: A high-level mental skill. It can create illusions that interfere with perception.
The former was the basic skill of an undead pet, while the latter was a very difficult illusion skill.
After the Nether Cat entered the Concealed Spirit state, it used illusions to assist in its concealment and interfere with Eleven’s vision. Its traces of existence were immediately difficult to fathom.
“Is the battle style to use the Lost Soul Claw to apply a curse through concealment?”
The Beast Tamers gradually deduced Xu Jingyin’s battle style.
The Soul-Crushing Claw was also an undead skill, an ability to attack the soul. It could put a curse on the enemy it hit.
In the cursed state, as time passed, the curse would erode the opponent’s state until it was close to death.
“But the Nether Cat might not necessarily be able to get close to the opponent.”
The gazes of many masters gathered. If, if the Iron-eating Beast used deterrence again, even if the Netherworld Cat could withstand it, it would definitely cause a flaw in its concealment state!
In the end, this might be a battle of spiritual domains between both parties…
Although that was the case, the masters also made the “most correct” judgment. However, the development of the matter didn’t go as they imagined.
In the arena, Eleven didn’t use deterrence again at all. Instead, it found it very interesting. Apart from earlier, which was the first time it fought a flying pet, this was the first time it was fighting an undead pet…
He had to try the new effect that its upgraded skills had.
Intermediate-level skill, expert level super vision, activate!
“Hardening, Thunder Palm.”
In order to test Eleven’s expert level super vision effect, Shi Yu directly gave commands.
Buzz!
In the next second, not only did everything in the arena seem to slow down in Eleven’s eyes, but it also seemed to see a vague outline slowly approaching it!
It was the Nether Cat!
The expert level super vision that could already see through illusions directly cracked the Art of Concealment and Illusion!
Zi, zi, zi, zi…
Under the situation where everyone was confused, Eleven’s palm first turned into metal with a hum, and then a blue and white high-intensity violent electric current filled the air!
It was as if a lightning vambrace had condensed on his right fist!
The power of the lightning was vast, lighting up the entire arena. The electric current that shot out made Eleven’s body surrounded by lightning.
“Expert-level Thunder Palm, at least expert level Hardening. Otherwise, it can’t form a combination skill. This is the unique skill of Bamboo Stone Dojo. How can this Iron-eating Beast master it at its level!”
At this moment, the presidents were shocked again, but soon, they were relieved.
Forget it, after all, it even had deterrence…
With the deterrence from before, the Hardening Thunder Palm combination skill this time was barely within everyone’s acceptable range…
There was nothing acceptable about this!
It still didn’t make sense, it was too unscientific!
“But it’s not deterrence they’re using, but a combination skill of Bamboo Stone Dojo. What do they want to do?”
As the Little Iron-eating Beast showed its new trump card, the group of rookies’ mentalities collapsed.
Xu Jingyin herself was also stunned by the combination skill, but she still felt lucky.
However, at the next moment, under an operation that no one could understand, Eleven swung his arm and shook to the right!
In an instant.
Bang!
A figure appeared.
Under everyone’s stunned gazes, a huge spiritual cat with a size comparable to a tiger or leopard, appeared in the air. Its claws were in mid-swing in mid-air.
Because Eleven didn’t use deterrence for a long time, Xu Jingyin and the others chose to attack quickly!
However, the scene in front of them directly told everyone that every action under the concealment state of the Netherworld Cat had always been under the control of Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast!
Eleven didn’t move on the spot. With a wave of its arm, the Armored Thunder Palm hit the Nether Cat in the air!
“Meow!!!!” The Nether Cat let out a painful cry.
Its spirit directly caved in, and its entire body was instantly wrapped by lightning. With a bang, it exploded in the air. After the lightning rumbled, it fell and smoke rose.
At this moment, Xu Jingyin’s expression changed drastically.
It was as if her heart had been squeezed. She looked at the scene in front of her in confusion.
“You lost.”
“Why?” Xu Jingyin looked at the Iron-eating Beast and the Nether Cat in disbelief.
Why did the Iron-eating Beast know the location of the Nether Cat?!?!!
How was this possible? How could it be so easy…
“Hiding is useless,” Shi Yu said calmly.
“Wuuu—” Eleven glanced at the Nether Cat. So weak.
The opponents of the new races were so boring!
Xu Jingyin almost fainted too.
She shouldn’t have come up to challenge him!!!
A breath of air was stifled in her chest. Even if Shi Yu had insta-killed her through deterrence, she would not be so depressed.
At this moment, not only did she not understand as a newbie intern, but because there was no special effect from supervision at all, even this group of master-level Beast Tamers was a little confused.
“This!” President Sun was stunned. He didn’t expect such an outcome.
At the same time, he immediately looked at President Feng. The other presidents also looked at President Feng in unison.
Tell me, what’s going on?
No matter how they looked at it, it looked like the panda had used X-ray vision!
At that moment, President Feng was also very silent. Expert level Thunder Palm and that terrifying battle awareness… Why was it even more ridiculous than when he fought Cheng Gong!
Or could it be that Shi Yu had deliberately gone easy on him back then, and Cheng Gong was too lousy? Was he not worth going all out to deal with?
As expected, Cheng Gong was too lousy…
After all, that terrifying deterrence was simply ridiculous. It didn’t show at all at that time. Where exactly did this sneaky Lin Hongnian find this Shi Yu?!
“If I say that this Iron-eating Beast only has outstanding battle awareness, would you believe me?”
As for the fact that the infamously near-blind bear had super vision… No one even considered that possibility.
As soon as he finished speaking, the other presidents cursed in their hearts. F*ck, a level-seven Iron-eating Beast’s battle awareness could be so terrifying that it could instantly kill a concealed dual element undead with a single punch??
What a joke! Be quiet!
However, when they recalled that this little Iron-eating Beast had monarch-level aptitude, they trembled again.

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - Super Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Super Skill
After the victims Bai Qi and Xu Jingyin returned, the remaining six rookie representatives were extremely silent.
As long as they weren’t fools, they could understand the value of Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer who had cleared the four stages of the ruins.
The remaining rookie representatives present did not have confidence in defeating Shi Yu in front of them.
It was the right thing for Shi Yu to show his full strength.
No, Shi Yu and Eleven had yet to show their full strength.
To be precise, it was the right choice for them to show that they could instantly kill their opponents.
This immediately made the other rookie representatives hesitate, not daring to challenge.
Because they felt that they would lose even if they tried.
Young people were basically more concerned about their reputation. They would rather pretend that there was no winner or loser in the challenge than go up and take a beating. This guy was way too much, he was insane!
No one particularly wanted to go up and get insta-killed. The others could do whatever they wanted, but they themselves weren’t masochists.
“Eh, is there no one else?”
Before Shi Yu could say a word, President Feng suddenly said,
“Among the newbies in our Icefield City, no one contracted a commander pet?”
“Didn’t any pet break through to the transcendent rank while still at the first-level Beast Taming Space?”
Pleased.jpg.
Generally speaking, unless Beast Tamers had special talents or special methods, their first pet was basically just transcendent types, not to be confused with transcendent rank.
The Beast Tamer trainees couldn’t withstand the nutrition needed to turn their pet into commander rank.
Similarly, if the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space was still at level one, after the pet’s growth level reached level ten, the space would suppress the pet’s growth, and it would be very difficult for the pet to break through to the transcendent rank.
Because the growth nutrition required by a transcendent rank pet was not something that a level-one Beast Taming Space could withstand.
After all, if a Beast Tamer wanted to have a powerful pet, they still had to work hard to increase their Beast Taming level.
However, there were exceptions to everything.
There were always some special geniuses.
At the moment, President Feng was asking about this special case.
At the same time, he was overjoyed.
Damn, this Shi Yu was much more impressive than he imagined.
If it weren’t for the two special cases of Beast Tamers he mentioned, probably no Beast Tamer trainee could compete with Shi Yu!
Old Feng’s behavior gradually became like that regiment commander…
“No!”
Many presidents of the associations looked at President Feng with unfriendly gazes. They wanted to beat him up.
This batch of Beast Tamers was the best this year. Who else was better?
Damn it, where did this old thief Feng find this monster newcomer??
The presidents looked at Shi Yu and the little Iron-Eating Beast and felt that even the disciples cultivated by those legendary Beast Tamers were only so-so when compared to Shi Yu during the probationary stage.
A level-seven Iron-eating Beast with expert level deterrence was f*cking ridiculous!
“Aha.” President Feng was amused again.
He was taking advantage of this!
He didn’t do anything, but Ping Cheng already had a genius like Shi Yu, who could be said to be the strongest newcomer in Icefield City. He was simply taking advantage of the situation.
But soon, President Feng’s heart tightened. He understood that Little Ping Cheng would definitely not be able to keep Shi Yu in the future.
“I have to invest more while this Shi Yu hasn’t grown up,” President Feng decided secretly.
…
At the same time, Shi Yu realized that his work was completed after realizing that no one was coming down to challenge him.
Eleven, on the other hand, was still at a loss.
Huh???
No opponents?
It clearly didn’t even use half its strength!
“It’s enough.”
Shi Yu thought to himself.
If it were before the points were added, this group of opponents might be a little difficult to deal with.
Unfortunately, after adding points, Eleven’s target was now 1VS 100.
This group of peers immediately appeared to be lacking.
In this arena, the criteria for strength was different.
The less moves he used to beat his opponents, the stronger he was.
“Is this considered a success in defending the arena?” Shi Yu asked the presidents.
At this moment, apart from Old Feng, the others felt more and more upset.
Initially, they had decided to open the Holy Spring in order to nurture the Beast Tamers in their districts and counties in advance and strive to kill and pass through the ruins a month later.
Why did it look like it had become a dowry, a gift for Ping Cheng instead?
What was wrong with this Shi Yu… The presidents were really afraid that Yu would clear the ruins less than a month after bathing in the Holy Spring.
The more they thought about it, the more furious they became. Their lungs exploded, and their hearts bled…
They looked at the newbie from their association in disappointment. However, they also knew in their hearts that there was no other way. Even if they forced their Tamers to attack the arena, they probably wouldn’t be his match.
“Of course!” Guild Leader Feng said.
With that said, he looked at the other presidents.
“Then you guys continue playing. I’ll bring Shi Yu over first.”
President Feng laughed. He didn’t plan to finish watching the matches either.
After confirming that his Beast Tamer was the strongest, that was enough.
…
“Ah, Well…”
A moment later, Shi Yu was really pulled out by President Feng.
Shi Yu didn’t expect President Feng to be so impatient. What was going on?
That girl’s Illusion Skill was something. He had yet to ask for her cell phone number.
The pets of other geniuses must be very rare too.
At least let him watch the battle.
Shi Yu felt that he had lost 100 million skills.
Old Feng, this isn’t over. You have to let me leech off your pet’s skills when we get back!
“Use the Holy Spring a second earlier, and you’ll get to return a second earlier to digest the results.”
“As for cracking the ruins… I’ll leave it to you!”
“By the way, the method you mentioned to break the fifth level is expert level deterrence??”
President Feng suddenly thought of something and asked.
“Yes.”
Shi Yu’s calm reply made President Feng’s balls hurt.
“I say… Do you know what expert level deterrence means? What’s wrong with your little Iron Eater?!”
“Even that old man Lin Hongnian can’t do this.”
“Shi Yu, who exactly are you?”
President Feng stopped and couldn’t help but ask. Shi Yu was definitely not as simple as he looked.
“Well…” Shi Yu walked to the side and said, “Just an interested Beast Tamer who likes archeology.”
…
The location of the Evolution Holy Spring was very special. It was located in a forest.
After spending some time, President Feng brought Shi Yu to this special protected area.
Surprisingly, there was no Beast Tamer guarding the Holy Spring of cultivation in Icefield City.
In fact, there wasn’t even a single creature nearby. Along the way, it made Shi Yu rather puzzled.
But soon, his doubts were dispelled.
After arriving at the periphery of the forest, President Feng started talking to the ancient tree in front of him.
“Ancient Tree, according to the previous agreement, this is the first Beast Tamer to use the Holy Spring this time.”
Just as President Feng finished speaking, a pair of green eyes opened in the center of the tree closest to Shi Yu and the others.
“Shi Yu, this is the guardian of the Evolution Holy Spring, the Ancient King Tree of Life. He’s the pet of a deceased senior in our Icefield City and one of the guardians of the City.”
“A monarch-level life form!” Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. No wonder this place didn’t need a Beast Tamer to protect it.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Before Shi Yu could react, a branch appeared in the forest and extended from afar to Shi Yu.
“Shiyu, let the Ancient Tree of Life bring you over next. You have to grab onto the branches, or you’ll get lost.”
“Alright.”
Shi Yu subconsciously grabbed the tree branch.
At this moment, Shi Yu was stunned.
Because the skill index reacted.
After judging the information, Shi Yu trembled.
[Confirm recording]
Skill: Plant Control
[Skill Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a wood-type skill. It has the absolute right to control natural plants. It can control plants, control the growth of plants, and increase the quality of plants. It is the king of plants.
Status: no target

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - Iron-Eating Beast Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Iron-Eating Beast Evolution
Shi Yu’s heart surged as he followed the branch.
Look, what was this!
Super skill!
Shi Yu felt that the greatest gain from this trip might not be the Evolution Holy Spring, but the control of this plant.
This Ancient King Tree of Life actually used a surmounting skill to lead the way casually. It was simply too cute.
Shi Yu studied the skill’s effect briefly and felt that it was powerful.
There was naturally no need to say anything about plant control. It could probably evolve into many low-level and mid-level wood-element skills.
The truly impressive thing was the subsequent abilities.
The ability to control the growth of plants and increase the quality of plants.
The former was still alright. For example, if a tree sprout had just been planted and he used this ability on it, this sapling might immediately become a towering tree.
Of course, this sapling could also be used to refer to spiritual plants. This was an ability that many gardener-type plant-type pets had. However, those low and intermediate skills with the same effect were definitely not as impactful as super skills.
The most impressive thing was actually the ability to increase the quality of the plant.
Perhaps this ability could upgrade ordinary plants to spiritual plants.
Coupled with the ability to control the growth of plants, it was simply too amazing.
And if he thought about it in an exaggerated manner and regarded plant-type life forms as plants, could this ability still help plant-type pets develop their potential?
In short, this super skill, plant control, looked like a wood-element skill. Shi Yu felt that he was really lucky.
“But here’s the problem. Can Eleven and the Green Silkworm be compatible with such a skill? It feels like a stretch.”
“Should we nurture the Green Silkworm towards plants?”
“Or should I wait until the third one in the future and contract a plant-type pet?”
“Also, also, high-level skills require a week of weakness. This super-level skill…”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. When he thought of his weakened state, it was as if cold water had been splashed on his face.
It was too early to be excited. He felt that this super skill might not even be useful for a long time.
Wu wu wu!!!
Eleven seemed quite disappointed.
…
[We’re already here.]
Shi Yu was distracted as he was dragged away by the tree branch.
As he was researching plant control, suddenly, a light female voice entered his mind.
Shi Yu was slightly shocked before nodding and replying.
[Thank you.]
It turned out that this Ancient King Tree of Life was a big sister.
After that, Shi Yu gradually returned to his senses.
At this moment, he had indeed arrived at the side of a spring.
In front of him, clear spring water spewed out of the rocks, emitting a rich aura of life.
The spring was very small. If the pet was too big, it might not necessarily be able to enter completely.
“Eleven.”
Under the pleasant sound of clear spring flowing, Shi Yushen took a deep breath of fresh air and summoned Eleven.
In the next second, a fresh-faced Eleven walked out of the summoning array.
Eleven: (???????) Wuu?
After coming out, Eleven looked at the spring excitedly and could already smell the deliciousness of the spring water.
It was so hungry that its saliva dripped down.
“This is the Evolution Holy Spring. Eleven, go in, but you can’t drink it!!”
“The Evolution Holy Spring can only be absorbed by the body through soaking. You mustn’t drink it!!”
“After soaking for a while, your physique can increase. Remember not to drink it!”
Important things were reminded thrice.
President Feng had told Shiyu to remember it. The Evolution Sacred Spring could only be absorbed by soaking. Drinking it would instead harm the body.
Although he didn’t know the mechanism and felt that it didn’t make sense, Shi Yu could only choose to believe in this fantasy world.
What else could he do, have Eleven try drinking it?
“Wu wu wu.”
Eleven: o(╥_╥)o
After hearing that it couldn’t be drunk, Eleven cried like a storm.
Why was its Tamer making things difficult!
[Improve physique!]
However, as it cried, Eleven suddenly discovered a blind spot.
It pointed at itself hesitantly.
Then, it pointed at Shi Yu.
“Wuu?”
What it meant was, perhaps Shi Yu could bathe inside?
“Are you sure the effect of me bathing is greater than the effect of you doing it?”
Perhaps it could release a few more skills if Eleven went in.
However, if Shi Yu took a bath, he might be able to teach dozens of skills!
Eleven simply calculated this mathematics problem and easily obtained the optimal solution.
Shi Yu was more suitable to soak in this Evolution Holy Spring than him.
“I…” Shi Yu was speechless.
“If a person can soak in this Evolution Holy Spring, I want to too.”
[You’d die.]
At this moment, the Ancient Tree of Life spoke again and reminded him.
[Thank you…]
Look, it wasn’t just President Feng who said this. Even the Ancient Tree of Life King had said this. Shi Yu didn’t want to die young.
This was clearly not prepared for human Beast Tamers.
“In any case, hurry up and go. Cut the crap.” Shi Yu wanted to kick Eleven in the butt and send it into the spring.
“Wuu!”
Since the Beast Tamer had said so, Eleven could only regretfully soak in it himself.
Sigh, how good would it be if Beast Tamers could soak in it?
After Shi Yu’s physique improved, he would not have to recuperate every day…
Plop!!!
As he thought about it, Eleven directly leaped into the spring.
A fleeting flower splash rose.
At the same time, Eleven opened his eyes wide inside the spring while holding its breath.
Danger, danger… It almost drank it accidentally. Because of the jump training method, it was too familiar with jumping, so it didn’t control its strength well!
“Focus on absorbing,” Shi Yu reminded again.
In the spring, Little Iron-eating Beast Eleven immediately nodded and closed its eyes.
The evolution spring water was not cold at all. Instead, it was warm.
“I wonder how Eleven’s absorption efficiency is…”
Beside the spring, Shi Yu was in thought.
President Feng said that pets’ efficiency in absorbing the evolution spring water was also different depending on their race, talent, and potential.
Some pets could receive huge benefits, but some pets might only receive a trivial increase.
As Shi Yu was thinking about it, Eleven suddenly felt its body getting hotter and hotter in the spring.
ITs body involuntarily used Hardening.
However, the hot temperature did not make Eleven uncomfortable.
It only brought it into an unknown territory.
Bang, bang, bang.
Eleven didn’t know how it felt, as if the spring water could awaken something in its body.
Bang, bang, bang.
“What’s wrong?”
As Eleven’s Beast Tamer, Shi Yu could more or less feel that Eleven’s state was very strange.
Should it say that its blood was boiling, or did its DNA move?
[Don’t worry.]
[It is searching for an ancient bloodline.]
The Ancient Tree King of Life said.
Ancient bloodline?
Shi Yu was stunned. What did he mean?
He didn’t understand, but he quickly closed his eyes.
He tried to use his spiritual connection with Eleven to sense its condition.
In the next second.
Shi Yu also seemed to be in a different world and saw an Iron-eating beast.
This Iron-eating Beast looked like Eleven, but different at the same time.
It was a huge Iron-eating Beast in bronze armor.
This iron-eating beast was very strange. It seemed to have an additional layer of armor on the foundation of its hardened body.
However, its other features didn’t change at all from that of a giant panda. He felt that the panda had relied on Perfect Level Hardening to create a set of battle clothes.
[Ancient bloodline, the lost evolution form…]
The Ancient King Tree of Life muttered.
This Iron-eating Beast had terrifying potential and talent.
It actually found traces of evolution in the ancient times from the small traces of the bloodline.
“Why does this fellow look so similar to Chi You’s Iron-eating Beast mount in that painting from back then?” At this moment, Shi Yu, who was in a daze, suddenly jerked up.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - Legend
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Legend
“Is this the evolutionary form of an iron-eating beast?”
Still in a daze, Shi Yu left that state.
However, that form still left a deep impression on Shi Yu.
The Holy Spring was also known as the Evolution Holy Spring. It had a very small chance of increasing the evolutionary aptitude of the pets while stimulating their potential.
Shi Yu did not have much hope at first. After all, he had never heard of an iron-eating beast evolving.
However, what Eleven was experiencing now did not seem to be simple.
If that form was the evolutionary body of the iron-eating beast, it indeed looked more suitable for battle than the current iron-eating beast!
Its body far surpassed that of ordinary iron-eating beasts. Coupled with its metal armor, it looked like it was born for battle. No, for war.
Unlike the current iron-eating beasts, who, though they could also fight, were clearly more suitable for acting cute.
The image he saw just now actually reminded Shi Yu of a story that was circulated on Earth.
Legend had it that in the ancient era, when the Yellow Emperor fought a mythical figure called Chi You, gods appeared everywhere. using many birds and beasts as battle pets.
Among them, there was a battle pet called the Iron-eating Beast. Its fur was black and white, and its armor was pitch-black. It ate iron and drank water, and its feces could be used as a weapon. Like iron, the beast’s combat strength was peerless.
Chi You raised two of these monstrous beasts. One of them was well-trained and had a muscular body. Chi You trained it to be his mount and equipped it with various weapons and armor.
However, because the iron-eating beast was extremely cute, Chi You treated the other one as his pet. Later on, in the battle with the Yellow Emperor, because Chi You was in a hurry, he rode the iron-eating beast that was his pet by mistake…
In the end, Chi You was killed because of this panda. During the final battle with the emperor, because his mount was weak, he was killed by Ying Long, who was invited by Emperor Huang to help!
Of course, this mythical story was still a joke no matter how one looked at it.
However, even if it was just a joke, one could still tell that the iron-eating beast’s status seemed to be very special.
The truth of history was impossible to investigate. If the iron-eating beast was really the mount of demons, gods, and Chi You, it would definitely not be as simple as it seemed.
After all, even if Chi You had lost, one had to remember who the opponent was.
Ying Long was the Dragon God of Creation in ancient myths, the True Dragon and Ancestral Dragon of legend, one of the Four Great Divine Dragons!
During the battle between the Yellow Emperor and Chi You, Ying Long had killed Chi You and Kuafu in the South Pole to help the Yellow Emperor fight for the throne.
Helping Da Yu subdue the great flood, establishing the Dragon Gate, capturing Wu Zhiqi… He could be said to be the peerless war god with the best achievements in mythology.
Even if the iron-eating beast wasn’t its match, it had to at least be a Mythical creature to be able to participate in such a battle, right?
“I’m freaking imagining things again.”
Shi Yu hurriedly stopped his fantasy.
He had already transmigrated and was in two different worlds. It was best not to imagine things.
Even if the iron-eating beasts had evolved, their racial rank would definitely not increase too much. Commander and Monarch Stage experts would probably be at the strongest existences. Myth Stage experts were simply a fantasy for iron-eating beasts.
“But…”
However, from a different perspective, since there were such strange things like transmigration, then perhaps the various historical myths on Earth were not that simple?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. At that moment, with a splash, the little iron beast in the Evolution Sacred Spring was picked up by a branch and thrown to the ground.
[It’s over.]
The Ancient Life Tree’s voice sounded in Shi Yu and the iron-eating beast’s ears.
Shi Yu regained his senses and looked at the wet Eleven.
“What? It’s over?”
“But it hasn’t evolved yet.”
The Ancient Life Tree: “?”
[The Evolution Holy Spring water is not enough for it to evolve. It only activates its weak ancient bloodline. You have to search for the true path of evolution yourself.]
The Grandma Ancient Tree stretched out her branch again, wanting to bring Shi Yu and the iron-eating beast away from this place.
“Ah…” Shi Yu looked at Eleven.
At this moment, Eleven did not think about evolution. Instead, it subconsciously clenched its fists.
“Huh?”
It did feel as if it had been reborn.
This feeling of physical strength made it feel that there was nothing wrong even if it doubled its training…
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu knew that after its physical fitness increased, Eleven would definitely not be thinking about how its battles would change, but that it could last longer in training.
“Alright, we’ll leave now.”
Shi Yu retracted Eleven into the Beast Taming Space and then pulled the branch again to leave the forest.
Seemed like he had thought too much.
The Holy Spring was not enough for Eleven to evolve. However, he seemed to have used this opportunity to obtain good news.
That was that there was indeed a possibility for iron-eating beasts to evolve, but the method was unknown.
The unknown covered a wide area. Who knew if they could find it in their lifetime?
“It’s good that you’re not evolving.”
Shi Yu thought to himself as he walked. Although that evolutionary form looked more powerful and powerful, how could it be used as a pillow or a bed?
Therefore, it wouldn’t be a problem for it not to evolve. In any case, he had the skill index. If he was lucky, he could teach a few Mythical level abilities in the future. Even if it maintained this form, who would dare to underestimate the iron-eating beast?
However, if it could maintain its cute panda form and transform in battle, that would be great… Though Shi Yu might be too greedy to think that.
A moment later.
Shi Yu groggily returned to the entrance.
This forest was like a huge maze. If not for the branches leading the way, he might not have been able to walk out on his own.
“How is it?”
“What did you find?”
President Feng, who was still waiting outside, immediately asked.
Shi Yu’s iron-eating beast was not simple at a glance. It had definitely gained a lot. Old Feng believed it.
“Its physique had been successfully enhanced, and its physical fitness had increased a lot. It’s probably doubled.”
Shi Yu made a judgment.
“Really?” This number clearly surprised Guild Master Feng.
“Yes, the most important thing is that it seems to have had its evolutionary aptitude increased. The iron-eating beast might still have a chance to evolve,” Shi Yu said.
This sentence clearly surprised Guild Master Feng.
“That would be incredible.”
“In this aspect, perhaps you can go and ask Lin Hongnian and his daughter. This father and daughter pair has been studying the evolution of the iron-eating beasts for many years. Perhaps you can discuss with each other and share some information.”
“Well, I don’t have to remind you. After all, you’re from the Bamboo Stone Dojo.” President Feng laughed.
From the looks of it, the harvest was very good.
“Thank you, Ancient Tree King of Life,” President Feng said to a pile of ordinary-looking trees.
This was because the entire forest was actually a clone of the Ancient Tree, or rather, plants that she controlled.
No one knew where its real body was.
“Thank you (for your super level skill),” Shi Yu also thanked the Ancient Tree of Life.
He definitely wouldn’t waste this super skill. He would definitely develop it to perfection!
However, that would be a long, long time from now.
Shi Yu didn’t want to send himself to death just to teach a super skill, after all.
“Where are we going next? Has the battle over there ended? Do you want to take a look again?” Shi Yu still couldn’t forget the little girl’s Illusion Spell.
President Feng: “What’s so good about a probationary-level competition? Your journey is in the vocation examination hall. Well, before that, why don’t we hurry back to Ping Cheng and try the ruins again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - New Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: New Home
In the end, Shi Yu still returned to Ping Cheng with President Feng.
It didn’t really matter, since he had already replicated a super level skill.
Skills below the super level could be found anywhere when needed in the future, so there was no need to be anxious about those.
Moreover, he couldn’t really support increasing his existing skills anymore. Unless the new skills were especially rare, there was no need to rush.
After all, he only had one skill slot left. If he learned a high-level skill, the skill index’s page would be full and he wouldn’t be able to learn a super level skill if he found one. That would really suck.
“Our Ping Cheng exploration duration is still more than 20 days away. Are you confident of passing the fifth level now?”
That night, Shi Yu arrived at Ping Cheng. After President Feng sent Shi Yu off, he also got out of the car and asked.
“I’m certain about the fifth level, but I don’t know what the sixth level is yet.”
“No hurry, no hurry. Let’s take it one step at a time.” President Feng narrowed his eyes and smiled.
“Then when do you plan to explore the ruins?”
His idea was to hurry.
Even if he couldn’t pass the sixth level, it was also good to know the information of the sixth level in advance.
At that time, all the Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng would help Shi Yu think of a solution!
In any case, it was best to crack the ruins within the exploration period of Ping Cheng. At that time, the people from the other districts and counties could only twiddle their thumbs and watch.
It was definitely a little late today, so he asked Shi Yu’s next thoughts.
“Give me a little more time. I can’t confirm the exact date.”
“But it shouldn’t be more than half a month.”
Shi Yu still planned to get it done in one go, such as strengthening Absolute Sleep and multiplication to the expert level, or increasing Eleven’s growth level before going.
Eleven’s growth level was still a little low at level seven. During this period of time, Shi Yu had been focused on strengthening powerful skills other than racial ones. He had neglected its racial skills.
If he wanted to quickly increase the growth level of his pet, it was best to give points to racial skills.
This kind of skill that they were born with through the awakening of their bloodlines, after all, was the most suitable to promote their growth after raising it.
Now that he had four Ethereal Stones, he didn’t have to worry about Eleven’s growth level increasing too quickly and him being unable to keep up with its growth.
Therefore, it seemed that he could start to go back and look at Eleven’s low-level racial skill.
“Alright, as I said before, feel free to contact me if you need anything.”
President Feng nodded and suddenly thought of something.
“By the way, is it inconvenient to train pets in your courtyard?”
“There are also two empty training villas in Ping Cheng. I’ll bring you to move in tomorrow. I’ll give you one.” Old Feng winked.
Shi Yu thought to himself that the Ping Cheng Association was quite generous with him.
Shi Yu was stunned, indicating that he understood.
“You’re too generous, President. It doesn’t matter if it’s a villa or not. Since it’s convenient to train pets and attack the ruins as soon as possible to contribute to Ping Cheng, I’ll accept it.”
…
Shi Yu didn’t admit that he liked new things over old things, but this old house was indeed a little old.
This courtyard could barely withstand the initial panda cub, so now, it couldn’t possibly withstand the Panda King’s high-intensity training.
Training villa.
As the name suggested, it was a villa with a training ground. Even in a small place like Ping Cheng, such a villa couldn’t be bought without at least ten million yuan.
“Then, today is the last day of living here?”
After Shi Yu entered the courtyard, he didn’t hear the Green Silkworm’s welcome cry this time.
He didn’t have to think to know that the Green Silkworm had fallen asleep.
In the birdcage, the Green Silkworm was lying on the Dragon Whiskers Grass bed, sleeping soundly, looking especially comfortable.
However, it could only be at ease for now. When he took time to study the evolution direction of the Green Silkworm, it wouldn’t be able to laze around like this after evolution.
Eleven set the standard.
“Forget it today. I won’t teach high-level skills anymore. I’ll sleep after teaching Hardening.” After Shi Yu made a decision, he summoned Eleven out of the Beast Taming Space.
“Wuu!”
After Eleven came out, they stared at each other.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
Skill: Plant Control
Status: Cannot be taught
He looked at the Green Silkworm again.
Status: Cannot be taught
He still couldn’t teach it.
“Neither of them match?”
Shi Yu actually felt that the teaching compatibility of the skill index was quite broad.
Among the eight skills he had recorded, deterrence, worm silk, super vision, high-speed healing, absolute sleep, hardening, thunder palm, and multiplication, only the worm silk could not be taught to iron-eating Beast Eleven.
According to the index, only the Thunder Palm could not be taught to the Green Silkworm.
Everything else was still compatible.
This was the first time that neither pet could learn the same skill.
Shi Yu guessed that there were three reasons.
First, it was simply not compatible. There was no way to teach it. They couldn’t be kings of plants.
Second, their strength wasn’t enough to learn super level skills.
Third, the index was afraid of killing Shi Yu if he taught this. But no matter which one it was, it could be confirmed that he couldn’t teach it at the moment.
“Forget it, forget it.”
Shi Yu shook his head. In any case, he didn’t plan to teach super skills at the moment. To play it safe, he had to at least be a Master before he risked the extreme exhaustion this skill would bring him.
Shi Yu felt that he might not necessarily be able to withstand it even if he were a professional level Tamer.
“But from the looks of it, there are only two ways to use this plant control skill.”
“Why don’t we nurture the Green Silkworm into a wood-element pet? Or, the third pet can be a plant-type pet.”
Shi Yu thought about it and decided to lean towards the third pet.
After all, as the complete mutation pet with the highest evolution potential, the green worm could choose too many routes.
Especially since he had mastered the skill index and could push the worm silk to the maximum level, the potential of the green silkworm was not inferior to those young monarch level cubs.
If he gave up rare Time, Space, and Dragon attributes just for a super-level wood-element skill, that would be a huge loss!
On the other hand, regarding the third pet, Beauty Lu Qingyi seemed to owe him a high racial rank one…
At that time, wouldn’t it be easier to choose a suitable high-level plant sprout?
“Everything’s going in the right direction.”
“Wuu?”
Eleven looked at Shi Yu, who stood on the spot and then smiled. Its body trembled and it quickly turned around to train itself.
It had never felt as energetic as today!
Tonight!
Sleepless night!
However, Shi Yu’s voice came at this moment.
“Rest for the day tonight and let me sleep well. Tomorrow, we’ll move to a bigger house for you to train.”
“Wuu!”
…
The next day.
Shi Yu moved into the training villa that President Feng mentioned.
Apart from the residential parts was a huge courtyard garden with a pond and a spiritual plant to cleanse the environment. Behind the residence was an independent huge training ground.
In addition, unlike Shi Yu’s hometown, the houses here all use high-level sound insulation materials, so Shi Yu didn’t seem to have to worry that Eleven’s noisy training would lead to poor rest.
“The environment is pretty good, right?”
After President Feng brought Shi Yu around, he said with a smile.
Generally speaking, only master-level Beast Tamers who lived in Ping Cheng District were qualified to be assigned such villas.
Shi Yu was the first to be assigned to such a villa at the trainee level.
However, Shi Yu had the right. As long as he didn’t die prematurely, becoming a master-level Beast Tamer in the future was almost 100%, and the value that the ruins Shi Yu had conquered might bring to Ping Cheng in the future… It was completely incomparable to a villa.
“Very good,” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say. Eleven, who was following beside him, couldn’t help but nod.
Great!
The training ground was even larger!
However, it would be even better if the spiritual plants in the courtyard could be exchanged for bamboo.
Not only Eleven, but the Green Silkworm also popped out of the backpack Shi Yu was carrying and sized up the new environment.
Back then, it had hidden in the remote Shi Yu family to distance itself from competition and escape its natural enemies. It was even used to the Shi Yu family’s persimmon tree. It was really not used to suddenly coming to such a beautiful place.
“There are still many empty places in the courtyard. When you have time, you can plant the spiritual plants you like.”
As Shi Yu walked, he used telepathy to speak to Eleven and the Green Silkworm.
After walking around for two rounds, Shi Yu was completely familiar with the environment here.
Seeing that Shi Yu was very satisfied, President Feng smiled and said, “It’s good that you’re satisfied. Then, I won’t disturb you anymore. Next, the ownership of this villa is yours.”
“Thank you, President Feng.”
Shi Yu felt pretty good after moving into his new home. He felt that his liver was slowly recovering. In such a beautiful environment, it would even feel good to level his pets up, despite the exhaustion.
President Feng indeed had other things to do. After helping Shi Yu enter, he quickly left.
In a short while, only Shi Yu, Eleven, and the Green Silkworm were left in the huge villa.
“Once he leaves, this big house instantly feels empty.”
“It looks especially lonely. Sigh, even if the house is big, it’s annoying.” Shi Yu put it up.
There was no need to say anything else. In order to celebrate the moving, he had to work very hard today!
…
After moving into a new home, he had to have some time to adapt. Shi Yu adapted very well because the environment here was very suitable for “recuperation”.
A week later, his body seemed to have completely integrated with this place.
Eleven and the Green Silkworm had adapted pretty well, too. To live was to adapt.
During the adaptation process, Eleven and the Green Silkworm’s attributes also underwent a “minute” change.
[Name] Iron-eating Beast
[Level of Growth]: Level 8 Awakening
[Skill]: Hardening (Expert+9), Thunder Palm (Expert), High Speed Healing (Expert), Super Sight (Expert), Deterrence (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Multiplication (Expert)
< Name > Green Silkworm
[Growth Level]: Level 9 Awakening
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Expert+10)

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - The First Perfect Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: The First Perfect Level
Shi Yu was tired.
Not only because he had to work overtime for a week, but also because upgrading the skill proficiency seemed like an endless journey.
This skill proficiency was at the entry level in one try, proficient level in two tries, expert level in four tries. This was already more than ten tries, why wasn’t it perfect level yet?
Shi Yu suspected that the skill index was messing with his mentality.
According to his mathematical thinking, he couldn’t guess what the index was thinking.
Otherwise, logically speaking, expert+4 should be perfect level already.
“Perfect level isn’t as simple as I thought…”
After thinking about it carefully, Shi Yu gave up.
After all, from entry level to expert level, as long as the pet trained hard, it could ignore the problem of potential and talent.
And to reach perfect proficiency… There were areas that some pets, even Beast Tamer’s pets, might not be able to reach in their lifetime.
They were no longer in the same dimension.
Let’s try again!
With the mentality of trying it out, Shi Yu taught the green silkworm twice more.
Surprises were always sudden.
“Ji…”
After the green silkworm in Shi Yu’s hand underwent a growth transformation, its cry entered Shi Yu’s ears.
As an insect-type pet, it was very normal for the Green silkworm to grow quickly. After being taught worm silk twice, Shi Yu was not surprised that it had awakened to level ten.
However, apart from that, the information that Buggy transmitted to Shi Yu was not simple.
“What, the worm silk has finally undergone a qualitative change?”
Shi Yu’s hand trembled and he nearly threw Buggy out.
After Worm Silk (Expert+12), it finally reached Worm Silk (Perfect).
“Ji, Ji!” The green worm nodded with bright eyes and jumped down from Shi Yu’s palm.
Then, it looked at a huge rock in the courtyard that was used for decoration.
Whoosh!!!
The green worm spat out worm silk. There was not only one, but more than ten wrapped together, so it was especially thick, about the size of a thick straw.
Then, the silk shot at the stone like a gunshot. With a sound, a crack appeared on the ordinary stone.
Shi Yu was just about to say, “That’s it?” It wasn’t as powerful as entry-level hardening. However, when he recalled that this was only a worm, he couldn’t help but feel gratified. “Not bad.”
Today, the worm silk had finally entered the perfect realm, and the worm was one step closer to evolution!
< Name > Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening
[Race Skill]: Worm Silk (Perfect)
This should be the current attributes of the green silkworm.
“Ji, Ji!” At that moment, after receiving Shi Yu’s praise, the green silkworm also cried out happily.
At this moment, Shi Yu finally sensed that something was wrong.
He looked at the Green Silkworm and reacted for a long time before realizing that he seemed to be able to communicate more normally with the Green Silkworm.
In the beginning, the green worm only had instincts. Shi Yu could not communicate with it at all.
Later on, Shi Yu nurtured it for a while. After its growth level increased, the two could communicate simply through telepathy.
However, at that time, the communication was only limited to some ordinary commands. The Green silkworm’s intelligence at that time might have been about the same as a pet cat or dog, or even a little inferior.
But now, as the Green Silkworm reached Level 10 and its worm silk reached Perfect Level, Shi Yu could almost clearly feel its emotions.
Also, when it communicated with Shi Yu, it began to look like a child who could think independently.
Perhaps he wasn’t as smart as an iron-eating beast, but Shi Yu was still relatively happy to have come this far.
The level-ten Green Silkworms in the breeding base weren’t that smart. It looked like it was thanks to its perfect level racial skill.
“In that case, on the foundation of the expert level, teaching twelve more times would be the threshold of perfection! In other words, teaching a skill sixteen times would allow it to reach perfect level!”
Shi Yu looked in the direction of the training field in the backyard. In other words, if he taught Eleven’s Hardening skill three more times, it would also be perfect, right?
Perhaps two would do. After all, Eleven was very hardworking in its own training. It would definitely increase its proficiency.
However, after thinking about it, Shi Yu judged that it should still be three times. After all, Perfect Level Proficiency required many years of hard work. Although Eleven was very hardworking, it had only been training for a month after all.
Compared to the huge experience bar of the perfect level, its bitter training was more like it claiming the experience Shi Yu gave to it as its own, owning it instead of relying on external forces alone.
“I was already impatient from being such a shut-in and had planned to challenge the ruinsX tomorrow… But from the looks of it, I’ll go after Hardening reaches perfect level.”
After considering it, Shi Yu made a decision. Then, he looked at the little worm on the ground.
He wanted to tease the little worm. In the past, the green silkworm couldn’t understand what he meant when it talked too much. What about now?
“Buggy, come here.”
Shi Yu shouted for Buggy, who immediately crawled over.
“There are several pheasants and rabbits in a cage together. They all have one head each. The chicken has two feet, the rabbit has four feet, and from the top, there are 35 heads. From the bottom, there are 94 feet. Tell me, how many pheasants and rabbits are in the cages?”
The green worm was speechless.
The green worm looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
“Forget it, Eleven won’t know this either. It’s a little difficult for you guys.”
“Alright, next question. Dragon Whiskers Grass, bamboo Leaf, persimmon Leaf, great cabbage leaf, which one do you like?”
“Ji!”
The green worm was not stupid.
It indicated that it liked all of them.
If he had to choose one, it would be the one with the highest number.
If it was a moderate number, the Dragon Whiskers.
Shi Yu nodded. Alright, this IQ was still passable for the time being. It would definitely become great in the future after nurturing it.
“Next question, who is good to you, Eleven or me?”
The green worm fell into deep thought.
It recalled that Iron-eating Beast disturbed its sleep every day and pulled it along to train together. It was too troublesome.
In comparison, not only did Shi Yu build a house for himself, but he also prepared food for him every day. The difference was obvious!
“Ji!”
You.
The green worm confirmed.
“This child is worth teaching.”
“One last question. Why do you like to sleep so much?”
Shi Yu was actually quite puzzled. He had studied the Green silkworm more deeply. After all, during the three months he was an intern breeder, he had been dealing with the Green silkworms almost every day.
Normal Green Silkworms didn’t sleep so much either.
Sleep…?
The green worm crawled around on the spot, as if it was thinking about how to explain.
However, there was no need for it to explain too clearly. Because Shi Yu had telepathy, Shi Yu could roughly deduce it.
“Because… I can enter another world… I don’t have to worry about food… I don’t have to worry about dodging my natural enemies… I’m free… in different places in the way I like…?”
After repeating it, Shi Yu was stunned. “You mean in a dream?”
“It should be…” Shi Yu was originally wondering why this bug was so sleepy. So it didn’t like to sleep, but it liked to daydream.
But could a bug-type pet like the Green silkworm dream?
In his previous life, Shi Yu still knew that some animals could dream, but most animals couldn’t. In this world, creatures had already evolved to this level, so it didn’t seem strange for a worm to dream.
Shi Yu extended his hand and the green worm slowly crawled up.
“Should I give you a name?”
“Forget it, I’m horrible at making names. I’ll just continue to call you Buggy.”
From the way Eleven directly used the name Eleven, one could tell how useless Shi Yu was. He didn’t name the Green Silkworm because he was afraid that he would give strange names like “Shi Er”, “Little Green” and “Small Green”.
Buggy was pretty good. The sound was cute.
“Ji…” The green worm was speechless.
“Forget it, that’s not the most important thing.”
Now that the green worm could communicate normally, Shi Yu was suddenly relieved. This was because he no longer had to worry about the green worm’s evolution path alone.
Right now, it had reached level ten awakening. The next stage of its skill was to make it a transcendent level skill. Before its short lifespan ended, it had to quickly evolve into a cocoon.
After ensuring that it had enough potential, he decided to give the green silkworm some autonomy and let it eliminate some options for itself.
The Green Silkworm would decide which types it wanted to evolve into, and then Shi Yu would think of a way. This way, he would at least have some direction.
Shi Yu took out his cell phone and placed the Green Silkworm on his shoulder. He opened a page as the worm looked confused.
“Let me introduce you to various attributes first… You tell me your first, second, and third choice. We’ll see how it goes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - Volunteer Buggy
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Volunteer Buggy
After buying his cell phone, Shi Yu had been playing with it alone. He had never shared this divine weapon with his pet. This was the first time.
Buggy thought that the cell phone was pretty interesting, and he stared at the shining screen without blinking.
“Let me introduce you…”
Next, Shi Yu introduced the characteristics of the various attributes to the green worm.
“First, the five elements…”
As the introduction was too long, Shi Yu tried his best to give Buggy a simple introduction.
For example, the metal element represented metals, the wood element represented plants, the water element represented liquid, the fire element represented fire, and the earth element represented earth…
Shi Yu felt that he was f*cking speaking nonsense.
However, if he accidentally got too profound, Buggy couldn’t understand it at all. For example, how would he explain that earth-type abilities could control gravity? Where was the explanation for this for the Green Silkworm?
In short, it was very difficult. It was very similar to parents who taught homework to their children.
Apart from the basic five elements, there were also the attributes of insects, dragons, poison, ice, wind, light, darkness, lightning, undead, spirit, and machinery.
In addition, there were also some other rare attributes like time and space, but because there were too few pets from those elemental groups, ordinary Beast Tamers couldn’t come into contact with them.
Among these attributes, the most interesting were insects, dragons, and machines.
This was because bugs and dragons could also be considered in the regular animal group. They usually had other attributes.
However, because these two types of pets were too special, they were separately divided by the Beast Tamers.
As for the reason, insects were the largest pet race in nature.
Dragons were the strongest creatures in nature.
As for machinery, it usually referred to artificial mechanical lives. This was an attribute for technology.
Shi Yu explained the characteristics of each attribute to the bug one by one and even thoughtfully found diagrams for it to understand, so the bug was very accepting!
“Ji!”
“Ji!”
The green worm started discussing with Shi Yu.
In the end, after about two hours, they came to a conclusion.
After discussing the outcome, Shi Yu could still accept it.
Fortunately, the Green Silkworm did not choose attributes like mechanical and undead.
Because even if it was a Green Silkworm, it was really difficult to evolve these two attributes.
Machinery modification, or suicide to become a spirit… That was too weird.
The way the green worm chose attributes was different from Shi Yu.
It had its eyes on the space element.
This was because spatial-type abilities could be used to teleport and escape. This way, there was no need to worry about being hunted by birds.
Regarding this, Shi Yu could only say that it was too small of a mentality.
This was not used to avoid birds at all, but to help him, a Beast Tamer, escape danger!
Then, the Green Silkworm even took a fancy to the mental-type skill because Eleven had mastered a mental-type skill, Absolute Sleep. It was very hungry for this skill.
The scale was small again. The key was that even now, it could learn Absolute Sleep without needing to evolve at all.
Shi Yu could tell that it liked to dream, but spiritual-type skills were compatible. After all, there were many spiritual-type skills related to dreams.
Shi Yu gave it three chances to choose. In the end, it chose one. Buggy struggled for a long time on the wood and dragon.
Because controlling plants was related to eating. As for dragons…
The reason surprised Shi Yu. It said that it had dreamed of becoming such a creature. It was very powerful, very tall, and very strong.
In the end, considering that Shi Yu was already making food for it, it chose Dragon.
Although Shi Yu didn’t know why a worm like it would dream of becoming a dragon, Shi Yu still silently included this attribute.
Then, Shi Yu confirmed the three attributes.
Space, Dragon, Spirit.
“It’s actually similar to what I confirmed at the start, but there are also some differences…”
Shi Yu had decided. Then, he would work hard to find the skills and attributes materials in these three aspects. If he found two types, he could try to evolve it. After all, most pets only had two special attributes. If there were more, they would not be good. As for what he found and what he evolved into, he could only leave it to fate.
The Absolute Sleep skill of the spirit attribute seemed to be readily available?
Shi Yu thought about it. This skill didn’t seem like it would help when Buggy went into a cocoon…
Moreover, there was a possibility of letting the Green Silkworm sleep to death in the cocoon…
However, it was also possible that this skill could allow the Green Silkworm to better absorb the nourishing power of the cocoon during the evolution process.
There seemed to be more Ethereal Stones… He decided to see if there were more in the ruins.
“Ji!”
“Ji!”
At this moment, after filling in the form, the green worm became much more lively. It even wanted to look at more information and choose carefully.
Snatch!
However, Shi Yu mercilessly put away his cell phone and pushed the green worm away.
“Children shouldn’t be obsessed with cell phones. You’ve been on it for two hours. Go play on the tree yourself. I’m going to level up Eleven.”
“Ji…”
…
“1, 2, 4, 16… How many times will it be until transcendent?”
After leaving Buggy, Shi Yu prepared to look for Eleven in the backyard.
He planned to get Eleven’s Hardening perfection first before fighting the ruins.
The matter of Buggy wasn’t urgent. After all, the worm silk had just reached perfection and it was far from the evolution standard.
The Green Silkworm could freely control the time of the cocoon transformation. Generally speaking, most wild Green Silkworms risked their lives before their lifespans ended to fight for an opportunity to evolve.
As for the Green silkworms cultivated by Beast Tamers, their control was greater. After all, the Green silkworms cultivated by Beast Tamers grew very quickly.
The Green Silkworm had a lifespan of about a year. If it had a better cultivation, it might be two years.
The time before the end of one’s lifespan, it was actually all preparation time.
It wasn’t too late to turn the Green Silkworm into a cocoon after the Beast Tamer was completely ready.
Shi Yu’s one was only about two months old. It was still early.
Therefore, Buggy still had more than a year to prepare. There was an ample opportunity for Shi Yu to find evolution materials.
Shi Yu no longer thought about this nonsense. He quickly found the confused Eleven and started teaching. He was now a man with plenty of supplements, after all.
A day later, a new transformation had finished.
[Name] Iron-eating Beast
[Growth Level]: Level 9 Awakening
[Skill]: Hardening (Perfect), Thunder Palm (Expert), High Speed Healing (Expert), Super Sight (Expert), Deterrence (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Multiplication (Expert)
There was nothing to say about expert level Absolute Sleep. The symbol from entry-level to expert level for this skill was just to sleep and recover physical strength. It was just a matter of efficiency.
Only at the perfect level would there be a qualitative change.
There was nothing to say about the multiplication skill either. Previously, the proficiency level multiplication could allow Eleven to reach a height of four meters, but now, it was eight.
Similarly, a shrunken Eleven of more than ten centimeters could already be held in Shi Yu’s hand and placed in his pocket.
This state was quite matching for the green worm. They were both weak chickens when they were that small.
These weren’t the most important things. The most important thing was the hardening, which was a racial skill!
The symbol of Perfect Level Hardening, flowing, strengthening, and focusing. These factors would unleash the extreme effect of Hardening.
The power of Eleven’s combination skill could directly make its power level rise through the roof.
Coupled with the deterrence skill expert level proficiency in group attacks, which was the king’s aura mentioned by the master-level Beast Tamers, Shi Yu didn’t believe that Eleven would have a formidable enemy during its awakening stage.
Unless the opponent was the cub of a Mythical creature.
At the same time, because of the upgrade of its racial skills, Eleven’s growth level had also reached level nine. In addition to the baptism of the Evolution Holy Spring…
If it was with all of this… it could at least kill its way through the ruins, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - Battling the Ruins Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Battling the Ruins Again
August 26.
After adjusting his state, Shi Yu finally decided to challenge the ruins again.
Their goal was to break through the fifth and sixth levels in a row!
After informing President Feng, Shi Yu arrived at the periphery of the valley.
“Please show me your ID name!”
After Shi Yu arrived, the eyebrows of the soldiers at the outermost blockade twitched.
Good lord!
It was the monster newcomer who had broken through four levels in a row and mastered a combination skill as an intern, causing their training volume to double!
He had been missing for half a month, no, preparing for half a month. Was he finally here to challenge the ruins again?
However, although the soldier knew Shi Yu, he still had to follow the procedures.
After passing through layers of security checks, Shi Yu entered the valley.
The environment here was still the same as before, but there were more campsites.
Obviously, the Beast Tamers who had come with Shi Yu previously chose to stay here and prepare for battle.
Although this way, they would have less freedom and would need to undergo regimental training, at least they would be able to eat and sleep. With the guidance of a professional Beast Tamer Sergeant and many people his age, it was still very worth it.
When Shi Yu arrived, he discovered a strange phenomenon.
A young man with a pale face and a little freckles was using his Wind Strengthening Talent to train his Wind Crystal Butterfly’s Wind Blade skill.
He hadn’t reached the professional level yet. Due to the limited physical fitness of the Beast Tamer, this strengthening talent was very difficult to use in battle. He could only use it daily to assist pets in training wind-type skills.
But even so, the consumption would still consume the Beast Tamer’s physical fitness, and it was quite a lot.
In order to conquer the ruins, it was understandable for him to train so hard. After all, Shi Yu himself was pretty hardworking. He had used the skill index to help his pet increase points a lot.
However, what confused Shi Yu the most was that at this moment, the Beast Tamer training here actually took out a medicine that he was very familiar with after training for a while. It was the Refreshing Capsule. He directly stuffed one into his mouth and continued training.
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu: “?”
Was he so hardworking?
Eating medicine like this… Was it really healthy?
Control yourself! Isn’t it good to rest normally?
With money, Shi Yu no longer ate lousy things like the Refreshing Capsule. Instead, he ate natural supplements.
Who was the one who caused this kind of unorthodox behavior?
“It’s Shi Yu.”
“Shi Yu is here.”
Although Shi Yu came very quietly, he was currently a famous person in the ruins.
After all, apart from him, there was no other Beast Tamer who could clear the fourth level.
As for the third stage, two more people completed it in half a month.
“Shi Yu… he’s finally here again.”
Somewhere in the camp, Cheng Gong and his Moon Flame Beast walked out.
Apart from that, Chen Kai, Doctor Qiao Liang, and the others, who were one of the culprits behind the trend of supplements, were also shocked. They came out to look at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu had been missing for half a month. They thought that Shi Yu had given up on clearing the ruins.
“Stop, stop, stop!!!”
When a group of people wanted to surround Shi Yu, the boss arrived.
Old He. He stunned everyone and was the first to laugh as he came to Shi Yu’s side.
“You’re here?”
“Old Feng told me. Do you need to prepare a little more? He might need a while to rush over.”
“I’ll go in first,” Shi Yu said to Commander He.
He wasn’t someone who liked to wait. He had already prepared for so long, and he couldn’t wait to see the sixth level of the ruins…
Of course, what he wanted to see wasn’t what the Boss was in the sixth level, but what the reward was in the sixth level.
“Alright, let’s go over then!” Uncle He said, “All the best, we must win the fifth round this time!”
“When the time comes, I’ll get the whole team to sing you a mountain song to celebrate.”
All the Beast Tamers wondered if this was appropriate.
Shi Yu fell silent as well.
There was no need for that.
What was so good about a group of old men singing at the top of their voices? His Beast Tamer Troops didn’t have any female soldiers, so stop embarrassing himself.
“Well, I’ll go over first.”
Shi Yu looked in the direction of the stone statue in the ruins. There were still six familiar stone statues. Four of them were slightly bright, and two were dim.
He didn’t hesitate anymore and decisively walked in the direction of the Teleportation Array. The soldier in charge of locking it didn’t need Shi Yu to register this time and directly let Shi Yu pass.
At this moment, everyone’s gazes were focused on Shi Yu. They were very curious if Shi Yu could pass the fifth level of the ruins after half a month.
1VS100, that was…
Then, under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu quickly disappeared from the outside world.
…
In the ruins, at the fifth level.
This ruin apparently had “save files”. Shi Yu stood on the familiar snow mountain peak and quietly watched as the snowstorm blew over and the ferocious beasts gathered.
Snow Wolf, Ice Fang Pig, Ice-Armored Beast, Ice Kirin Snake, Snow Ape, Frost Stone Giant, Ice Jade Scorpion, Ice Crystal Butterfly, Ice Elemental Fairy, Ice Ridge Rock…
There were a total of ten ice-element ferocious beasts of various transcendent races. Their growth levels were inconsistent from eight to ten, and their numbers added up to 100.
Logically speaking, there was no way to play this at all.
If a Beast Tamer Trainee could withstand such a beast tide of 1VS100, would he still be a Beast Trainer Trainee?
Previously, Shi Yu and Eleven were persuaded to leave after seeing this scene, but that was in the past.
