Although Shi Yu didn’t know how the lousy planner of this ruin hoped the players would attack this ruin, the lousy planner definitely didn’t expect that a pet could master the deterrence skill during the Awakening Stage, and it was an expert-level deterrence!
“Eleven!”
Eleven walked out of the Beast Taming Space at Shi Yu’s command.
It stood on the snow mountain and looked down at the ferocious beasts below with Shi Yu, who had yet to realize the seriousness of the problem.
Eleven: ( ?) Ow!
The time for revenge had arrived!
The fight that forced them to give up… This fight would now be their stepping stone into the next level!
Boom!
“Wuu!!!!!!”
Eleven howled again, and the air around it vibrated!
Under its feet, snow and wind blew, as if an invisible deterrence wave spread from its body, sweeping outwards from the snow mountain peak!!
“Wuu!!!”
Eleven’s roar instantly attracted the attention of all the ferocious beasts. However, before they could react, a transparent wave swept across like a storm and hit every ferocious beast!
Buzz!!!
After a boom in the ears of all the ferocious beasts, it was as if the world had fallen silent.
Then, an extremely shocking scene occurred.
Bang…
Sounds of bodies falling ensued. So many of these sounds piled together that even the snow and wind couldn’t cover them.
Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang…
After a hundred voices, the hundred ferocious beasts in the snow mountain environment all fell to the ground and turned into ice elements that disappeared.
Shi Yu looked at the scene in front of him and felt a sense of pride. He had a domineering aura.
That’s it?
“Wuu.”
However, before Shi Yu could get excited for long, Eleven’s weak voice came from the side.
Bang.
Eleven also sat on the ground and rubbed its head, feeling tired.
It couldn’t help but knock its head… It hurt.
Wu wu wu, the consumption was a little high. He felt that this group of people was much more difficult to kill than the Wings of Wind.
“The number is indeed a little large. But things turned out actually better than I expected,” Shi Yu said.
Initially, he had thought that if he couldn’t kill them in the first round, he would take a break and settle them one by one.
But now, from the looks of it, Eleven’s growth level had risen by two levels. In addition, after the baptism of the Evolution Holy Spring, its condition was better than imagined!
1 VS 100, instant kill!
This wave was invincible!
“You rest first. I’ll go down and see if any loot has fallen.” Shi Yu really looked like he was entering a dungeon.
“Sob.” Under Shi Yu’s suggestion, Eleven immediately nodded and started shrinking on the spot.
Shrinking, shrinking, shrinking… In the next second, it shrank to more than ten centimeters.
Shi Yu bent down and picked up the furry Eleven. He casually placed it in a deep pocket, revealing only Eleven’s upper body and head.
“You can sleep for a while. We should have passed this round. There’s no more danger.” Shi Yu looked at the Teleportation Array that lit up in the distance.
“Wuu!”
Eleven shook its head. Not sleeping!
It was as if it was saying, “Don’t even think about opening the award without telling it.”
It also wanted to see what treasures had fallen in this round.
It wouldn’t be too late to rest after watching it.
“Alright, alright, alright…” Shi Yu had no choice but to bring Eleven down to take a look.
A moment later.
Shi Yu, who was standing beside the teleportation array, looked at the five Ethereal Spirit Stones he had picked up from this level and fell into deep thought.
“Ah, this…”
Should he be happy or disappointed?
There were no new treasures, and it was still the Ethereal Stones, a spatial resource.
The third level was one stone, the fourth level was three, and the fifth level was five…
At this moment, he had a total of nine Ethereal Stones. He felt that it was not a problem to give some of these to Buggy.
Of course, it seemed like it was also a problem for the Green Silkworm to digest the stone. This thing didn’t feel like it was suitable for the Green Silkworm. Should he grind it into powder and mix it into water for it?
“Howl…” At this moment, seeing that it was all Ethereal Stones again, Eleven was no longer interested and closed its eyes to sleep.
The expert level Absolute Sleep coupled with the energy crystals and recovery fruit from Shi Yu’s backpack made its physical recovery speed very fast. It was estimated that it would recover completely in a while. After all, the upper limit of the pet’s physical fitness in the Awakening Stage wasn’t so high.
At that time, it would be time for them to enter the sixth level.
At the same time.
In the outside world.
As Shi Yu entered the ruins less than a few minutes later, the stone statue at the fifth level lit up. Everyone was stunned.
“F*ck?”
“Didn’t they say that there were 100 ferocious beasts in the fifth level?”
“What’s going on, what happened??”
Countless people widened their eyes and couldn’t think straight.
President Feng arrived late. He listened to the crowd’s discussion in silence and looked in the direction of the stone statue with mixed feelings.
What did these people know? That was expert level deterrence!!!
Under the aura of a monarch, the weaker opponents at the same level were simply trash!
Right now, he wondered if Shi Yu and the others had entered the sixth level or not. What exactly would this final level be??
…
Many people actually made guesses regarding the sixth level.
Some people guessed that it was an even stronger commander species creature, such as a tenth rank high class commander species.
Some people guessed that it was a commander species creature bringing a beast tide. It was equivalent to the merging of the third and fifth levels.
Some people guessed that it was a creature that had fully grown to transcendent level…
There were even more ridiculous people who said that there was a monarch species cub guarding the final level.
Either way, it was very difficult for trainee Beast Tamers.
And regarding this, Shi Yu, who had entered the sixth level, could only say that their mentality was too small a scale. Too small.
With Eleven by his side, they looked at the Dragon formed by countless snowflakes in silence and fell into deep thought about life. This was too exciting.
“F*ck, it’s an Ice Dragon…”

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - The Strongest Creature
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: The Strongest Creature
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu looked at the creature in front of him with a complicated mood.
The strong body of the creature in front of him seemed to be made of ice and stone. The color was ice-blue and dark purple, as if it represented extreme cold.
Not only its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong and powerful feet, as well as its pair of wings, were all made of ice and stone. Its scales revealed coldness, and there was wind and snow lingering around it. As expected of the Ice Dragon.
A great roar boomed!
In the distance, the ice dragon that had just formed roared and flapped its wings.
During the roar, Ice Dragon glanced over with its deep eyes. Its little ice-blue beard fluttered in the wind, looking majestic.
But the problem was…
“So damn small.”
Shi Yu looked at the two-meter-tall “dragon” and felt that he had accidentally entered the alternate Pokémon world.
A dragon… Even if your title is loud and your appearance is domineering, if your body can’t keep up, it still seems to be lacking.
The King of Beasts, Tiger, is fierce, right? But what’s the difference between a tiny tiger and a cat!
After careful observation, Shi Yu judged from its size that it was clearly a shrunken Ice Dragon.
This was because there was almost no orthodox dragon less than ten meters tall. Its size was supposed to be quite spectacular. Just its physical strength alone could kill many creatures without any skills!
There was naturally a reason why the name of the strongest race was on them.
“This guy is still an illusion!”
In an instant, Shi Yu made the judgment that this ice dragon was not a real life form because his telepathy was useless!
Just like the creatures in the previous five levels, they were illusions condensed from ice elemental energy!
No… It was still a little different. Although this ice dragon wasn’t a life form, the feeling it gave Shi Yu was very real. There was an indescribably strange feeling.
Regardless of what it was, there was no time for Shi Yu to determine at this moment. This was because the guardian of the sixth level seemed to be this fellow.
At this moment, Ice Dragon had already released its strong dragon might at Eleven!!!
The dragon’s might that was like a cold wind was not weaker than the deterrence skill at all. It was a deterrence ability unique to the dragons!!
“Roar!!!!”
Under the dragon roar, the ice dragon emitted a shocking aura wave. The substantial aura seemed to have turned into ice and snow, freezing the air.
Shi Yu’s heart thumped. While he felt that it was dangerous, he couldn’t bear to look away from this beautiful creature.
“Wuu!!!”
At this moment, in the face of this terrifying dragon might, Eleven stood in front of Shi Yu and used all its aura to deal with the dragon’s might head-on. With a boom, the two auras seemed to make space collide, wrapping the entire icy plain in the impact of this aura!
Crack! Crack! Crack!
Under the collision of the two auras, it was very surprising that the mutated version of the deterrence skill, Dragon Might, actually lost to the deterrence of the Panda King. It showed a hint of the dragon itself almost being suppressed!
“It’s winnable!”
At this moment, Shi Yu shouted.
Although it was a dragon, the strength of this illusory ice dragon was limited to a certain extent, just like the previous monsters!
Facing Eleven, whose skill attributes were ridiculous, it might not have much advantage!
[Name]: Ice Dragon (Illusion)
[Attributes]: Dragon, Ice
[Race Level]:???
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening
[Skills:???]
So, this ruin was using the illusion of the Ice Dragon on the snow mountain to test its clansmen?
Smart!
Shi Yu’s gaze became excited. Sensing Shi Yu’s inner thoughts, Little Iron Eating Beast Eleven also looked at its opponent excitedly and fiercely.
“Wuu!!!”
This was a dragon!!
It was known as the strongest creature in nature.
As long as it was a slightly orthodox dragon, its race level was no lower than that of a monarch. It was basically an overlord race. Among Mythical creatures, dragons were also the ones that were most legendary!
Even if it was a sub-dragon, it was not rare for its species level to be above that of a monarch. One could imagine how superior this species was!
At this moment, Eleven’s blood boiled, and it had the intention to tear the dragon apart.
If it couldn’t bully a true dragon, he should be able to bully a fake one, right?
At that moment, Eleven’s aura completely suppressed the Ice Dragon, and its aura was suppressed. The Ice Dragon roared and flapped its wings!!
“Roar!!!”
During the process of the Ice Dragon flying over, it raised its dragon claws. There was frost and cold air lingering on them. It used the most basic Ice Rending Claw skill of the ice-type skills.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven rushed over at this moment and bent its arm backward. Metal matter first filled his palm, and then lightning-like blue and white lightning wrapped around it, forming the sharpest lightning spear.
Zizizizizi!!!
A combination skill of Perfect Level Hardening and Perfect Level Thunder Palm!
As for the Ice Dragon, it only used a single mid-level skill, Ice Rending Claw!
Because of its super dynamic vision, Eleven could clearly see the enemy’s movements. At the moment when the two were about to collide on the icy plain, Eleven dodged the Ice Rending Claw at the critical moment and made the Ice Dragon tear the air. Its Hardened Thunder Palm ruthlessly penetrated the Ice Dragon’s body!!
“Roar!!!!”
Shi Yu and Eleven were waiting for Ice Dragon to roar in pain, but what happened next stunned them.
Shi Yu and the others had spent half a month to complete the Perfect Level Hardening and the Perfect Level Thunder Palm super combination skill. The combination skill was only one stage away from the profundity domain. When it penetrated the dragon scale of the ice dragon, there were actually only extremely minute traces of marks. The ice dragon seemed to be fine as it directly resisted with its body.
At this moment, Eleven could feel its Perfect Level Hardening disintegrating. It was as if its Perfect Level Hardening skill wasn’t as strong as this ice dragon’s pure physical strength.
Apart from that, the lightning that should have spread all over the ice dragon’s body was instantly frozen by the cold air flowing in the cracked dragon scales the moment it hit the ice dragon.
The cold air spread and even started to corrode Eleven’s arm!
Eleven: w(?Д?)w!!!
Eleven, who had always had a smooth battle, had never seen such a situation and was instantly shocked.
“WDNMD!!!” As a Beast Tamer, Shi Yu was also stunned. He had never expected this situation.
This was too unscientific!
Usually, it was others who assessed Shi Yu and Eleven. This time, Shi Yu wanted to say it himself.
Was this a level-10 awakening beast?
Boom!!!
The confrontation just now, as well as Eleven and Shi Yu’s mental processes, happened in an instant. Although Eleven relied on its super vision to dodge an Ice Rending Claw from the Ice Dragon illusion, Eleven, whose arm was frozen and whose reaction speed had decreased due to the lingering cold air, couldn’t dodge the second attack at all!
However, although it couldn’t dodge the attack, in the extremely dangerous situation… It still successfully relied on the hardening and high-speed flowing nature to quickly cover its whole body to receive the next attack from the Ice Dragon.
The dragon’s tail swept across. It wasn’t a skill, but a sweep with its physical strength. It directly sent Eleven, whose whole body had hardened, flying more than ten meters away.
During the process of flying backwards, Eleven was forced out of the hardening state due to the huge impact. He was directly beaten back to his normal state and was slammed onto the ground. It rolled for a long time before stopping.
At this moment, although he didn’t know the exact racial level of the Ice Dragon, Shi Yu finally understood why dragons were called the strongest creatures.
In a situation where they were almost at the same level, this ice dragon seemed to be able to suppress Eleven with its terrifying physique without using any skills…
“Sob, sob, sob.”
At this moment, although Eleven was suppressed, Eleven wasn’t that weak.
Hardening still successfully helped it neutralize this attack. Unfortunately, there wasn’t enough time for Eleven to concentrate all the hardening substances at the affected area. Otherwise, it might not have needed to be injured when facing this attack.
Eleven quickly crawled up. Its light injuries healed instantly under the high-speed healing. It looked at Ice Dragon fiercely again.
Not convinced.
Eleven was extremely unconvinced.
Not only that, even Shi Yu was very unhappy.
The Panda King that he had worked so hard to nurture was actually destroyed by an ice dragon. Oh, wait, an ice dragon illusion! And without using any skills?
He clearly had the upper hand in the deterrence battle just now…
Even a level-10 overlord cub couldn’t be this powerful!
As for whether the Ice Dragon was a Mythical creature, there was no need to think about it. It was impossible. During the historical period, Mythical creatures had long been lost.
“Eleven, under normal circumstances, we don’t seem to be able to defeat it.”
“I can only bet everything on this.”
“If we can’t win, we can only slip away. We’ll come back after adding some points.”
Faced with this scene, Shi Yu immediately judged that he couldn’t use normal battle methods.
Eleven also seemed to understand the Beast Tamer’s meaning and nodded heavily.
“Roar!!!!”
In the next second, the dragon turned around and locked its gaze on Eleven. A terrifying cold aura condensed in its mouth!
It was another basic ice skill!
As the strongest creature, the dragon race, it was impossible for the Ice Dragon to not have mastered high-level and super skills. However, at the moment, it had only used low-level and intermediate-level skills, but it gave Shi Yu and the others a lot of pressure, giving them a headache.
Sorry, daddy dragon, I shouldn’t have mocked your small size just now. This concentrated essence…
However!
Swoosh!!!
The cold aura condensed like ice light shot towards Eleven. After freezing everything in its path, Eleven quickly rolled and hid. Its goal was to get close.
With the support of its super vision, it was relatively easy to dodge the skill. Soon, it arrived near the Ice Dragon.
At this moment, the Ice Dragon canceled its cold breath and flapped its wings, waving its Ice Rending Claw at Eleven again!
“Wuu!!!”
On the ground, Eleven looked at Ice Dragon fiercely. With a hum, its body quickly expanded to eight to nine meters tall. At the same time, an even more shocking deterrence was emitted. This change directly stunned Ice Dragon and made its movements slow down.
This hesitation was the key to deciding the winner.
The huge Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, raised the Hardening that was completely focused and strengthened. It formed a combination skill with the most powerful Thunder Palm and directly smashed this attack that consumed all its physical strength!
Expert Level Deterrence Control+Expert Level multiplication output+Perfect Level Hardening Output+Expert Level Thunder Palm Output!
This attack was Eleven’s current limit. With all the power gathered in its palm, this smash instantly became a super sure-kill that could penetrate everything!
Boom!!!
Under the circumstances where Shi Yu and Eleven’s hearts were raised to the extreme, no accident happened this time. Ice Dragon’s defense was finally broken through by Eleven’s attack. Its entire body was directly sliced into two by this huge hardening Thunder Palm combination skill!
It really tore apart a dragon with its bare hands!
Plop!
After completing this attack, Eleven, like a leak, quickly shrank from the enlarged state to a floppy state of more than ten centimeters.
The pocket-sized Eleven sat on the frozen ground and panted as it looked at the disappearing dragon illusion in front of it. It felt ridiculous.
So powerful…
The dragon was really powerful…
Eleven couldn’t help but clench its hand. Its hard work was still not enough. In the future, it would use the dragon as a reference!
When it trained its body to the point where it didn’t need to use skills to be on equal fighting ground to a dragon, it would then consider itself to have passed the initial stage!
Before Eleven could finish swearing, it suddenly discovered that something seemed to have appeared under the disappearing Ice Dragon Phantom.
“Are you alright, Eleven?”
At this moment, Shi Yu also ran over quickly. He was also panting. His body was still weak. His mental fortitude as a Beast Tamer was not good. The battle just now had completely frightened him nervously. He was afraid that Eleven would lose.
Was this thing in the sixth level of the ruins really meant to be cleared?
If it weren’t for the fact that Eleven had a wealth of skills, he would probably have been tortured to death if he had even one less skill to use.
“Sob.” Eleven shook its head to indicate that it was fine. It weakly pointed ahead and quickly let Shi Yu see what it was.
“I almost forgot.” Only then did Shi Yu remember that there seemed to be a reward for passing the round!
After throwing Eleven some recovery food, he immediately walked forward and looked under the disappearing Ice Dragon Phantom. Then, he fell silent.
On the broken icy plain ground, a thin ice-blue hair that looked like the whiskers of an ice dragon was lying there quietly.
“This is… Ice Dragon’s hair?” Shi Yu was stunned.
He took out a glove and some necessary tools from his backpack and gently picked up the hair. Nothing unusual happened.
After observing for a while, he silently put away this supreme-grade material.
Apart from that, there was also a shell.
A gray stone bead was placed in the shell.
Shi Yu hesitated for a moment before reaching his hand out to the shell.
However, the shell was like an illusion as it directly penetrated the glove and even Shi Yu’s hand.
In the next second, the shell illusion gradually dissipated, and the stone bead fell to the ground.
F*ck, what’s going on?
Following that, Shi Yu did not pick up the stone bead. Instead, he was slightly stunned on the spot.
That was because when his body didn’t know if he had touched the shell illusion just now, his skill index talent did. “It reminded” him.
After a long time, Shi Yu [Confirmed].
The five new pages were completely full.
On the tenth page of the illustrated handbook, the image of a shell-type creature [Overlord Level: Fantasy Bead] appeared.
Below was a pile of words.
Skill: Illusionary Phantom
[Skill Level]: Advanced
[Introduction]: A dual-element ability of the spiritual attribute and spatial attribute.. It can materialize the illusions constructed in dreams and illusions into reality and summon or transform them. The quality of the illusions conjured depends on the authenticity of the constructed illusions, the sacrifice materials, the prerequisite skills, the user’s compatibility…

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - Master of the Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Master of the Ruins
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu was stunned for a long time before reacting.
He knew it. There must be a mastermind controlling everything in this ruins.
Otherwise, how could all kinds of monster illusion phantoms appear so uniformly in different environments and checkpoints?
Although Shi Yu did not know what kind of creature the shell in the picture book was, he guessed that it was not weak.
After all, the owner of this Beastmaster Space was at least a Legendary Beastmaster.
As for Legendary Beast Tamers, they were existences that were qualified to control overlord-level creatures.
He just didn’t know if the shell was also an illusion or if it still existed somewhere in the ruins.
If it was still alive, that would be impressive. It would have lived for at least a few thousand years.
And if the shell was only an illusion and was protected in the ruins by the Beast Tamer’s will, it would also be very powerful.
It had been judged as a “life” by the picture book and had only dissipated after he had passed through the ruins. This meant that this shell had at least trained that skill to perfection, right?
Shi Yu returned his attention to the [Illusionary Phantom]. This was the first time he had seen a dual-attribute ability.
After seeing the skill’s [Introduction], Shi Yu felt that the high-level rank was too low for this skill.
Such a powerful ability was only high-level?
The beast tide and even this ice dragon that had been conjured completely gave Shi Yu a headache. In his opinion, at the very least, it was a super or even divine skill.
After all, if he could materialize a few divine beasts, he would be invincible.
It was only when he saw the latter half of it that Shi Yu understood why this skill was only at the high-level.
This skill required too many prerequisites, and wasn’t something that could just let him materialize anything he wanted.
It was not created out of thin air. The basic principle of this skill was “equivalent exchange”.
The user could imagine it boldly, but if he wanted to materialize his imagination, he would have to pay an equivalent or even higher price.
For example, even that shell could not directly transform into an ice dragon. Instead, it had to use a true ice dragon’s whiskers as a medium.
Moreover, even so, it did not have the complete body of an ice dragon. At least, an ice dragon that only knew ice splitting claws and cold aura was too weak.
Still, Eleven almost lost…
In short, compared to a skill of the same level, this skill had a much higher requirement to use. It was also difficult to train, but its advantage was that its ability was flexible and variable.
“This skill seems to be very suitable for Green Silkworms.”
This was the reason why Shi Yu chose to replicate it.
When handing him its choices, the Green Silkworm chose a total of three choices: spirit, space, and dragon.
Originally, Shi Yu had planned to find one or two.
However, this new skill seemed to perfectly match the Green Sponge Insect’s entire will and personality!
Didn’t it like to dream and appear in various forms in those dreams?
After learning Illusionary Phantom, it could even materialize the imagination in the dream into reality.
Fantasy becoming reality was the power of the spatial attribute.
And a dragon… That shell just now perfectly demonstrated how to make an illusion dragon using a shell.
Although it hadn’t become a real dragon and couldn’t even simulate the super-level skills of the dragon race… Through this skill and some special materials, it might be able to temporarily borrow a dragon “vest” to wear.
In an instant, three wishes would all be satisfied.
Spirit and space were the foundation, and the dragon would be materialized from fantasy using this skill.
“Perfect, it’s practically tailor-made for it…”
This was a skill with very high growth potential. Shi Yu felt that if he could hit this to perfection level, the results would be surprising.
After all, no matter what, it already had a spatial attribute.
If this skill was used as the core and evolved in the direction of the spiritual and spatial attributes, what would the Green Silkworm evolve into?
A Dream Butterfly Branch that could materialize abilities?
Shi Yu really couldn’t remember if there were similar pets in nature.
“Wuu!!!”
“Wuu!!!”
Perhaps because Shi Yu had been distracted for too long, the iron-eating beast could not wait any longer.
“Wuu!!” Why was the Beast Tamer always staring at the disappearing illusion? There was still a stone pearl there.
“Yes, stone bead…”
Shi Yu returned to his senses and looked at the stone bead in the shell.
Could this be that pearl that these sea shells had or something? Perhaps it could be smashed into powder and fed?
He picked up the stone bead, and then something unexpected happened.
The moment he picked up the stone bead, Shi Yu’s brain rumbled. His vision seemed to be overlooking the entire ruins space.
…
Somewhere else within the ruins…
A soldier Beast Tamer in a camouflage suit looked at the disappearing Ice-Armored Giant in front of him in confusion, very confused.
He and his pet looked at each other. Where were the monsters?
They were clearly still fighting the Ice-Armored Giant just now, why did the monster suddenly disappear from their eyes?
It was as if they had defeated the monster, but the real situation was that there was no teleportation array for the next level.
This situation also appeared on the other Beast Tamers who were charging through the levels.
They had no idea what had happened when the monster illusion in front of them suddenly disappeared.
“This is…”
At this moment, Shi Yu seemed to be standing in an omniscient view and seeing everything in the ruins.
This change shocked Shi Yu greatly.
It was as if he, who was holding the stone pearl, could control the changes in the ruins.
At this moment, he also seemed to know everything inside the ruins. For example, at this moment, apart from Beast Tamers like them, there were no other creatures in the ruins. There were no traces of the shell at all, as if it had completely turned into a phantom and disappeared just now.
Apart from that, Shi Yu also discovered a large number of ice-element energy crystals and Space Spirit Stones in some places. The number was so great that it stunned him.
“What’s going on?”
“Could it be that after passing all the levels, I became the owner of the ruins and obtained the right to control the ruins?”
At this moment, it was not only the inside of the ruins that were changing.
In the outside world…
Under everyone’s stunned expressions, the sixth stone statue lit up.
“It lit up, it lit up. The sixth stone statue lit up. Shi Yu must have passed the sixth level!” Commander He shouted from outside.
“It must be him!”
Beside him, President Feng was first at a loss. Then he was instantly overjoyed.
Holy shit, he really passed.
Although he didn’t know what happened inside, in short, Shi Yu was awesome.
At that moment, the stone statue lit up. It was equivalent to shouting to everyone outside: Shi Yu blasted through all six stages and cracked the ruins.
“F*ck…”
All the Beast Trainers were devastated.
They weren’t as ecstatic as President Feng. Instead, they felt endless disappointment and envy.
Why wasn’t it them who passed the ruins…
Shi Yu was already so powerful. What benefits would he obtain in the sixth level?
At the thought of this, everyone felt even more jealous.
Just as the crowd was feeling sour, the six stone statues cracked open one after another, and figures were teleported out.
These were all challengers who had entered before Shi Yu challenged the fifth level. As for after Shi Yu entered, no one else followed. They were all waiting outside to see Shi Yu’s battle results.
At this moment, this group of people and their pets were suddenly teleported out and were still a little stunned.
“What happened?”
“Why am I suddenly teleported out?”
“Where’s the giant? Where’s the huge Ice-Armored Giant?”
“How come my pet’s able to come out without going into the Beast Taming Space?”
The few of them looked at each other. Then, they discovered the group of people surrounding outside, as well as the six stone statues that lit up but cracked. Their eyes widened.
“Come down first,” Uncle He shouted.
“Tell me, what happened? Why did you guys come out together?”
“I was fighting the ferocious beast when it suddenly disappeared. Then, I seemed to have been expelled.”
“Me too.”
“I’m in the same situation.”
The people who were teleported out spoke one after another.
“Regiment commander, what’s going on?” One of them asked Regiment Commander He about the situation.
Why did the stone statue light up and shatter???
Commander He was silent for a moment before saying, “Shi Yu entered the ruins after you and passed the fifth level. Perhaps he has passed the sixth level now.”
“In any case, let’s wait and see how it goes. We’ll see when he comes out.” When he finished speaking, the soldiers opened their mouths wide.
The entire outside world was silent. Everyone looked at the Teleportation Array.
In the ruins.
Shi Yu, who was holding the stone bead, was stunned when he realized that he could really forcefully teleport the others out.
This thing was indeed the controller of this ruin space.
Previously, it was in the hands of that shell phantom, but now, as he cleared the level, the shell phantom dissipated,… And the stone bead became his?
So, what did this have to do with the historical truth of Icefield City?
What did those historical traces want him to know through this ruin?
Or could it be that this stone pearl was related to the Ice Dragon Ruins on the snow mountain?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought, but he quickly shook his head. He decided to think about it after getting some rest.
“Eleven, come to my pocket.”
Shi Yu called out to Eleven, who looked confused. Eleven immediately crawled into Shi Yu’s pocket.
Shi Yu sighed. He felt like he couldn’t be bothered to put Eleven back into the Taming Space… In the future, Eleven could stay outside in this form. It was quite cute.
He wasn’t afraid of others asking him why his Iron-eating Beast could do this.
He would tell them not to ask, that it was something about awakening an ancient bloodline in the Evolution Holy Spring and awakening a new species skill.. If they wanted to nurture the same thing, they could go there and try.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - The Great Plantation Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: The Great Plantation Skill
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the valley, outside the ruins.
Everyone was waiting for Shi Yu to appear.
After an unknown period of time, a figure finally appeared.
As this familiar figure appeared, many people held their breaths.
“There are so many people.”
The new figure was the first to speak. This person was undoubtedly Shi Yu.
He came out after studying the stone pearl that could control the ruins.
He realized that this stone pearl was the real body of the ruin.
It was like spatial equipment. Inside was a huge ruin space.
This ruin was quite special. There were clearly many icy plains and snow mountains before, but the actual situation inside was actually empty and barren.
In essence, it wasn’t an ice-element space, but an extremely malleable ordinary space.
Everything that they saw when they entered should have been conjured by that “Artifact Spirit” shell with illusions.
However, the pile of ice-element energy crystals and Ethereal Stones was real. After all, without these, that “Artifact Spirit” shell probably wouldn’t have been able to support hundreds of people clearing the ruins so easily.
“Shi Yu, you passed the sixth level?”
After Shi Yu came out, Old Feng looked at the disappearing summoning array under his feet and asked nervously.
“I didn’t disappoint.” Shi Yu nodded.
As soon as he finished speaking, Commander He shouted instantly, “All of you. Go do what you need to do. Stop surrounding here and scram back to your camp.”
His shout directly shocked the surrounding Beast Tamer trainees.
It was obvious that it wasn’t suitable for too many unrelated people to be present at this discussion.
…
A moment later, Shi Yu was warmly invited to the battle center by President Feng and Commander He. There were only the three of them left.
President Feng looked at Shi Yu with a smile. He never expected Shi Yu to be so awesome!
At this moment, the Beast Tamer Association of the other districts and counties would definitely be stunned!
They’d cracked the ruins already, not giving those people a chance at all!
“Shi Yu, after you passed the sixth level, did you obtain something similar to the core of the ruin that can control the entire ruin?”
Based on the changes just now, the two of them came to this conclusion. President Feng asked with anticipation.
“The other resources in the ruins are all yours, but this ruin’s true body itself might not be.”
The most valuable thing in the ruins was still the ruin itself. After all, its predecessor was a Legendary-level Beast Taming Space.
After development, regardless of whether it was raising pets or spiritual plants, they were all top-notch equipment.
The value of a ruin wasn’t inferior to the Evolution Holy Spring at all. In fact, it might even be higher.
“I know that.”
Shi Yu nodded. This was also something that everyone had agreed on in advance in the contract before entering the ruins.
After cracking the ruins, the items obtained in the ruins belonged to the explorer, but the ruins themselves didn’t belong to them.
Even the ownership of this ruin didn’t go to the Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng.
The relevant laws in this country were actually similar to the country Shi Yu was in previously.
All the ruins that were unearthed in the country belonged to the country.
Only those passed down by their ancestors could be claimed personally.
However, although it belonged to the country, as ruins unearthed by Ping Cheng and cracked by the Beast Tamer, Ping Cheng still had priority in using the development right.
After the country sent its own personnel to investigate the ruins and confirm the historical information represented by the ruins, as long as this ruin had no other value, there was no need to hand it over. Actually, it would be no different than just giving it to the Ping Cheng Association.
This was also the reason why President Feng hoped that someone in Ping Cheng could crack the ruins. With the right to develop the ruins, if he used this to farm crops, Ping Cheng would probably be able to harvest a large number of high-level resources.
The effect of using it to nurture newbies and pets was definitely top-notch. Ping Cheng would be about to enter a rapid development stage.
“Do you mean this?” Shi Yu took out the stone bead.
At this moment, when they saw this stone bead, President Feng and Commander He’s eyes lit up.
“That’s it. We might have to hand this to the Archeological Association for research first,” Uncle Ho said.
“Old Feng, you’ll inform the higher-ups?”
“Maybe these guys can really investigate something. If only they can find out the truth of the beast tide.”
Commander He looked at President Feng and said, “Hurry up and let the group of archeologists finish studying it. It’ll be easier if they study it earlier.”
It was a good thing to learn something, but it would be good if no results came out of the study too.
“Alright, I’ll inform the higher-ups to send someone to study it.” President Feng nodded.
“Actually, there’s no need to inform them…” Shi Yu chuckled and put away the stone bead.
“Leave this in my hand first. When I’m done studying it (if I can’t use it), I’ll give it to Ping Cheng.”
The two of them:???
When Shi Yu finished speaking, President Feng and Commander He looked at Shi Yu.
Hm?
Was Shi Yu crazy? Even the Ping Cheng Association didn’t dare to dock such a ruin. They had to wait for the country to distribute it.
Did Shi Yu think that he could obtain the ownership of the ruin just by cracking the ruins?
“This…”
President Feng was just about to explain the severity of the matter when Shi Yu took out his identification.
He sighed. This lousy certificate might be useful at this time.
He flipped to the first page and they saw Shi Yu’s handsome profile picture and his identity certificate.
The reserve member of the Homeland Ruins Strategy Investigation and Backup Security Bureau, Shi Yu.
At the bottom of the certificate, the person in charge of the Beast Tamer Association headquarters of Dong Huang stamped his seal.
“According to the rules, I have a higher right to investigate the ruin than the Archeological Association.”
“I still have other missions at the moment, so I might be able to use this Ruins Bead. So, I’ll hold onto this thing here for the time being.”
In order to start exploring the Ice Dragon Ruins, he still needed this thing. Shi Yu planned to study it for a while in his hands.
He had asked Lu Qingyi about this before conquering the ruins. Bureau 11’s power was greater than Shi Yu had imagined.
Lu Qingyi said that if Shi Yu could conquer the ruins, he could directly show President Feng the identification documents for Bureau 11.
President Feng had risen strongly during the beast tide ten years ago and saved countless lives. He had been fighting with Commander He and the others on the front line of the beast tide to cover the retreat of the people. Although he wasn’t strong, his character was undeniable.
In the future, if Shi Yu wanted to investigate the Ice Dragon Ruins, he could also find President Feng and Commander He to be his bodyguards. The two of them had clean identities. Over the years, they had been thinking of ways to solve the beast tide from the source and restore the historical truth of Ice Dragon City.
In short, when the time came, after showing Bureau 11 credentials, this ruin would belong to Shi Yu. He could use it anytime he wanted. Shi Yu could do anything he wanted with it when he didn’t need it anymore.
After asking about this news, Shi Yu sighed. He didn’t join Bureau 11 for nothing. It was awesome to have an official legal identity.
If he could hold such a ruin space at the trainee stage, the benefits were obvious. It could quickly assist his growth. Lu Qingyi also had this intention of letting Shi Yu use this ruin reasonably first.
“F*ck.”
At this moment, President Feng and Commander He were still a little stunned.
They looked at the documents Shi Yu had placed on the table and felt dizzy.
Although they didn’t know much about the Ruins Strategic Investigation and Backup Security Bureau, they were stunned when they saw the huge seal and the code name of Bureau 11 below.
In Dong Huang, there were thirteen special organizations that represented the various territories. They gathered the most elite batch of people in this area and called them Bureau 1 to 13 respectively. They were directly responsible for the highest in-charge of the Beast Tamer Association’s headquarters and had great power.
Although they didn’t recognize the long string of irritating names, when they saw the sign of Bureau 11 and the seal, President Feng and Commander He opened their mouths slightly.
Especially President Feng, who looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
So Shi Yu was actually from Bureau 11?
He recalled Shi Yu’s evaluation of himself previously. He said he was “just an interested Beast Tamer who likes archeology.”
Holy shit, so that was what he meant by liking archeology? He was an archeologist?
At this moment, President Feng finally understood why Shi Yu could crack the ruins so quickly.
He finally understood why the previously unknown Shi Yu had suddenly risen so quickly.
If Shi Yu was recruited by such an organization, his starting point would definitely be incomparable to the Beast Tamers of the same batch in Ping Cheng and even Icefield City.
“I knew your background wasn’t simple…” President Feng looked at the documents and said in a daze.
“This ruin might be related to the Ice Dragon Ruins on the snow mountain. It’s the key to resolving the beast tide, so I want to study it for a while…”
“Of course.” President Feng nodded heavily.
After being shocked, Commander He also said, “It would be good if we can resolve the beast tide. The mutation at the snow mountain is even more serious. Commander and Lin Hongnian and the others have gone into deep exploration a few times, but what they transmitted back was not good news.”
“Could it be that you’ve already investigated something?” Seeing that Shi Yu was certain that this ruin was definitely related to the beast tide and even the Ice Dragon Ruins, President Feng couldn’t help but ask.
Shi Yu took back his identification and nodded. “The sixth level of the ruins holds an ice dragon.”
“What???”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the two of them widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu in disbelief, wondering if they had heard wrong.
“It’s just a level-ten Ice Dragon Illusion Phantom. It’s not that scary.”
The two of them opened their mouths slightly. Clearly, they wouldn’t believe this crazy kid.
If it was an ice dragon, its species level was at least at the level of a monarch, or even an overlord!
With such racial values, even if its growth level was relatively low and it was only level ten, it probably wouldn’t be difficult for it to kill transcendent-level creatures.
Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast could defeat a dragon of the same level?
Didn’t that mean that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast already had the qualifications to compete for the strongest creature?
Although the two of them knew about Shi Yu’s battle results when he was competing for the Evolution Holy Spring, they still couldn’t help but look at Shi Yu like he was a monster.
Defeating a dragon of the same level… This was something that ordinary Beast Tamers didn’t even dare to imagine.
Dragon Tamers, known as the strongest branch of Beast Tamers, had mostly cultivated subspecies dragons.
The image of a dragon was still very invincible.
However, when they thought of Shi Yu’s identity as Division 11, they could only accept the ridiculousness of Shi Yu’s strength.
After all, they had no idea how this organization had nurtured Shi Yu.
“In that case, I’ll leave the Ruins Bead with you. However, we might need to adjust the information we release to the public,” President Feng said after a moment of silence.
Although Shi Yu’s identity was powerful, his strength was too weak. It would be bad if such a treasure was placed in Shi Yu’s hands and attracted coveting.
Therefore, they naturally couldn’t say that the Ruins Bead was in Shi Yu’s hands.
“I’ll leave that to you, President Feng.”
“Alright…” President Feng smiled bitterly. Shi Yu had really given him a big problem.
But from the looks of it, Shi Yu might have more potential than he imagined.
The previous investment was the right one. He really was quite smart.
With Shi Yu becoming a big figure over Ping Cheng, this ruin might only be the beginning. Next, the Ice Dragon Ruins that had not been cracked for thousands of years in the entire Icefield City might also be cracked by Shi Yu in the future!
The truth hidden in the ruins was the most important to Icefield City.
…
Following that, Shi Yu was escorted back to his residence by President Feng.
During this process, Shi Yu also informed Lu Qingyi of his mission progress. He didn’t know if there were any additional rewards.
Then, he started to take the Ruins Bead and summarize his gains.
At the moment, there were more than 1,000 level-one ice-element energy crystals and more than 300 level-two ice-element energy crystals in the ruins.
In addition, there were also 45 Ethereal Stones.
If these resources were converted into money, the energy crystals would be alright, but if it was the Ethereal Spirit Stones, there might be more than a hundred million.
This was what it meant to become rich overnight.
However, the greatest gains might still be the phantom illusion skill, the Ice Dragon Whiskers, and the ruin itself.
The phantom illusion skill confirmed the cultivation path of the green worm.
Perhaps the Ice Dragon Whiskers could be used to strengthen the worm silk of the Green Silkworm to increase its potential.
The dragon whiskers were the strongest and sharpest thread in the world. It was completely different from the worm silk.
Shi Yu was wondering if there was any way to extract the essence power in the dragon whiskers.
Then, it was the ruins themselves.
Apart from being the key to cracking the Ice Dragon Ruins, it was actually equivalent to a spatial equipment. Moreover, it was a spatial equipment that could store living creatures.
Moreover, although the growth environment inside had already been washed away by time and greatly decreased, for most low-level pets and spiritual plants, it was still a holy land.
“The Beast Tamer Association of Ping Cheng probably wants to use the ruins to farm. In this way, with the environment of the ruins, many high-quality spiritual plants can be cultivated quickly.”
“With enough resources, we can develop the economy and the Beast Taming Domain of the city.”
“This idea is actually not bad. After studying it, I might be able to use this ruin to farm…”
“At that time, I’ll carry the farm space with me and let a plant pet be a gardener inside to take care of the spiritual plants. In the future, I’ll be able to casually pick up resources, food, and supplements…”
“Looks like I still have to contract a plant-type pet to control the plants…”
The farming method was good!
Moreover, there was ready-made land now.
With the Ethereal Spirit Stone, his Beast Taming Space should be able to quickly reach level two or even three.
Contracting a second and third pet might not be very far away. He might be able to reach the standard within a year.
Or perhaps, he could repeat the current cultivation method of the green worm?
He wouldn’t contract a new pet for the time being. He would take care of it outside and communicate with it through telepathy. When his level and the relationship between the two parties were right, it wouldn’t be too late to contract it then.
This also gave himself and his new pet a test trial period.
Shi Yu hurriedly sent Beauty Lu a message.
“Do you remember the pet cub you mentioned last time?”
“Are there any plant-type pet cubs that have very high racial levels, low growth levels, gentle and obedient personalities, and can farm as professional gardeners?”

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - Time to Nurture Buggy
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Time to Nurture Buggy
Dong Huang was an ancient country with thousands of years of history. It formed a civilization far earlier than other countries.
In ancient times, Dong Huang had several dynasties, but they were all destroyed for different reasons.
There was one unified feature of these dynasties, which was that they liked to build their capitals in the same place.
It was not until they entered the modern era that the Beast Tamer Association finally moved to the capital. The political centers of the various dynasties were now known as the ancient capital.
The ancient capital had always been a place where soldiers fought. Countless battles had happened here in the past thousand years, so there were several places with the greatest yin aura in Dong Huang where a large number of undead creatures had gathered.
In an old battlefield plain outside the ancient capital of a first-level city…
Dark clouds lingered, and the sky darkened. On the ground were countless bones, and a large number of skeleton soldiers were wandering.
Apart from that, countless undead were inserted between reality and fantasy.
The desolate land was lifeless. It was completely a paradise for undead.
However, in such a place, there were people who traversed the sky indifferently.
“Jiu!!!!”
It was a huge bird with a sky-blue color, beautiful blue feathers, bright colors, and a light body.
Its wings were as green as the sky, and the gentle light that suffused them dispelled all the Yin Qi everywhere it passed, causing the undead below to involuntarily stop and not dare to move.
If a Beast Tamer with good knowledge reserves were here, he would definitely be able to recognize that this was a Green Spirit Wind Bird with the bloodline of the Phoenix.
Furthermore, it was at least a Green Spirit Wind Bird whose growth level reached the monarch level.
On the huge green bird, a woman with short brown hair and a casual white research suit stood there, silently reading the message on her cell phone.
“Plant, gardener?”
“Looks like I’ve successfully cracked the ruins. It’s much faster than I imagined.”
Unfortunately, she looked around and saw that there were no plant-type pets that could farm. Though, there were a bunch of skeleton soldiers.
Facing Shi Yu, who did not treat herself as an outsider at all, she really wanted to send a skeleton soldier to help Shi Yu farm.
At this moment, she rubbed her temples with her long fingers. This trip to the ruins was more exhausting than she imagined. She would deal with Shi Yu later.
“Wait until you pass the vocation assessment,” she replied.
…
“We have to wait…”
In the training villa in Ping Cheng District of Icefield City, Shi Yu looked at the message on his cell phone and stretched in boredom.
He asked Lu Qingyi about plant-type pets and thought that she would directly throw out a few options for him to choose.
However, the vocation assessment was soon anyway.
There should still be four months?
At that time, his Beast Taming Space should be able to reach level two. At the same time, Eleven should be almost at the transcendent level.
At this moment, after returning home, Eleven immediately ran over to train.
This battle with the Ice Dragon had caused it a huge setback!
At that time, if it was a real Ice Dragon cub and not an illusion, Eleven would have gotten wrecked!
He had to work harder!
“Ji!”
The green worm surrounded Shi Yu, wanting to continue filling in a few more “career choices”. It was even addicted.
“No, this kind of thing depends on the initial feeling.”
“How can you change it just because you want to?”
Shi Yu put away his cell phone and chased the Green Silkworm away as he told the Green Silkworm his experience in answering multiple choice questions during the exam.
This kind of thing… The more it was changed, the more wrong it became.
Moreover, this little bastard… The skills and materials were almost ready. If the Green Silkworm suddenly said that it wanted to evolve into something else, wouldn’t that be tormenting?
Shi Yu felt that it was pretty good already for it to take the Dream Butterfly route that was materialized in his dream.
“Ji, Ji.”
The green worm looked regretful. Then, it fell silent for a moment and looked at Eleven’s departing figure.
A moment later, it crawled over too, wanting to train with Eleven.
Shi Yu explained to it clearly that all the applications were for evolution into stronger races.
If it was in the past, the green worm might not have understood what it meant, but now that its intelligence had slightly awakened, it understood.
Evolution represented an opportunity to change one’s fate.
As a small worm that could be seen everywhere, it was at the bottom of the food chain. From the way it escaped to Shi Yu’s house to avoid its natural enemy, one could tell how low it was.
However, from liking to dream and dreaming that he was soaring in the sky in different forms, it also meant that the green worm was not satisfied with the current situation.
It wanted to change its fate, but because it had no intelligence before, only instinct, it was confused and didn’t know what to do.
Or rather, even if he knew, he might not be able to do it. It wouldn’t change anything.
Although the evolution conditions of the Green Silkworm were very simple, that was for the Green Silkworms contracted by a Beast Tamer. The probability of the wild green worm evolving was probably less than one in ten thousand.
“Ji, Ji.”
However, that was in the past. Now that the little green worm had some intelligence, it knew what it should do to change its fate.
Train hard and change its fate!
To be honest, this was not the concept Shi Yu had transmitted to the green worm that had just gained sentience. The first to transmit this concept was Eleven…
This training maniac and self-disciplined bear had already told the Green Silkworm the benefits of training when it was very weak.
This was the only way to change one’s fate, but at that time, the green worm didn’t understand at all. It was only forced to train.
But now, the Green Silkworm finally understood what becoming stronger meant. Moreover, it had been influenced by Eleven and the temptation of evolution mentioned by Shi Yu. It actually decided to take the initiative to train with Eleven.
This was impossible for the green worm that only wanted to eat and sleep previously.
“Ji ji…” In the blink of an eye, the green worm disappeared.
As Shi Yu watched, he fell into deep thought.
Buggy had grown up and become sensible.
However, he seemed to have forgotten to tell the bug that the evolution path he’d prepared for it was Dream Butterfly. It could become stronger after sleeping and dreaming dreams, so why would it go and suffer with Eleven?!!
If it had the time, he might as well sleep more.
Learn how to control dreams and have lucid dreams.
A lucid dream was not a skill. It was a physiological phenomenon to maintain a conscious state during a dream.
In this state, dreamers could maintain consciousness and lucidity in their sleep state, even changing their dreams.
Even an ordinary person could learn it as long as they underwent training.
Before Shi Yu transmigrated, he had tried to do similar things, but he didn’t seem to have the talent. He had only succeeded once or twice in a long time.
That was on Earth without transcendent powers. In this world, lucid dreams were very common. After all, there were things like dream beasts.
Generally speaking, dream beasts could easily control dreams. Their dreams, and the dreams of other creatures.
They were born lucid dreamers. Shi Yu hoped that the Green Silkworm could do something similar. This was very important for building dreams in the future.
“Forget it, let it train with Eleven for a while first. It’s not bad to use Eleven as an example.”
“When it’s tired from training, I sleep better.”
Today was a day worth celebrating. Shi Yu prepared to give himself a day off. He didn’t even add any more points, and still he would have to work and rest occasionally.
To be precise, he planned to study this ruins bead and how to turn the Ethereal Stone into an evolutionary material.
As for the dragon whiskers, Shi Yu thought about it and decided to forget it for the time being. He would keep it for now.
What if this was an important tool to activate the Ice Dragon Ruins? It would be bad if it was destroyed by him.
Moreover, the current Green Silkworm did not need this material to strengthen the worm silk at all.
After all, its worm silk had yet to reach transcendent
This was Shi Yu’s next target.
For the next period of time, Shi Yu planned to focus on nurturing the Green Silkworm. He could set aside Eleven’s points for the time being and let it train its combination skills.
Combination skills, even if there was a skill proficiency guarantee, needed to be trained and coordinated by oneself. This couldn’t be completely relied on the index.
It was said that in professional battles, they essentially competed in combination skills.
In a master-level battle, the strength of the pet was determined.
The combination skill and creation of profundities tested the Beast Tamer’s imagination and intelligence.
This kind of thing was harder to train than a single skill. Pets often had to work harder than when just training single skills.
All Shi Yu could do was help Eleven build up the foundation before they slowly studied the strange combination skills and profundities together.
It was time to place his focus on the bug…
Moreover, Shi Yu was also very curious. How many times before a perfect level skill became transcendent level?
The worm silk was currently costing a cooldown of less than eight hours. It was nothing to Shi Yu. It was suitable for experimentation.
After the worm silk reached transcendent, it would usher in a qualitative change.
That was the change in attributes.
Depending on the food it ate during a period of time, the Green Silkworm could use the Perfect Level Worm Silk with different attributes.
If it ate thunder-element resources for a period of time, the worm silk would upgrade to a worm silk with electricity, with a little paralysis effect.
If it ate ice-type resources for a period of time, the worm silk would change into a frost-type worm silk that could freeze the enemy after binding them.
It looked pretty strong, but it was actually still just fluff. After all, the Worm Silk at this time was at most comparable to a low-level skill at the expert level.
In short, it was precisely because of this nature that Shi Yu thought about how much the dragon whisker could strengthen its worm silk.
Or rather, how much could the Space Spirit Stone strengthen the worm silk?
A string of silk that could cut through space?
He was thinking too much again…
“Bead, bead, can you hear me?” Shi Yu finally looked at the ruins bead in his hand and activated his telepathy talent, hoping to hear the traces of history.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - Ancient Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Ancient Capital
Two days later.
At the edge of the snow mountain.
Two Beast Tamers in winter clothes walked out of the snow mountain with dozens of people and entered the camp outside the city wall.
Against the background of the white snow mountain, the environment of the soldiers stationed outside the nearby city wall appeared especially arduous.
If it weren’t for their protection, the living environment of the entire Icefield City wouldn’t be as comfortable as it was now.
Shi Yu’s predecessor of this alternate world had very high respect for these people.
After all, if not for them, the young Shi Yu would not have been able to escape Ping Cheng.
And Shi Yu, who had transmigrated, naturally had a good impression of the Beast Tamers of the Beast Tamer Troops.
They were very similar to the soldiers in his previous life. They had always been guarding places that were difficult for anyone to notice, silently protecting the people behind them. They were very noble.
Shi Yu happily accepted Bureau 11’s assessment and prepared to investigate the Ice Dragon Ruins in the snow mountain. Apart from his archeological soul acting out, he also wanted to investigate the situation of the snow mountain from the source and see if anything could change.
If the archeological path could be helpful, then there would be more motivation.
“Haha, looks like there’s good news.”
In the camp outside the city wall, the busy President Feng looked at the Beast Taming Troops who had returned with a load. When he saw the smile on their faces, he couldn’t help but ask, “How’s the situation?”
Wang Meng, the commander of the Beast Tamer Corps in Ping Cheng, glanced at him and nodded. “It’s alright.”
Lin Hongnian, the gold medal fighter not part of the military, said, “The beast tide’s abnormality has temporarily stopped.”
“Double joy.” President Feng chuckled. “We have also successfully cracked the ruins that Old He is in charge of.”
Wang Meng and Lin Hongnian were stunned.
It was cracked?
Wasn’t the progress still stuck at the fourth level?
At the moment, it didn’t seem to be the time to allow the other districts and counties to take their turns.
“Old Lin, come here. I’m telling you…” President Feng pulled Lin Hongnian over.
After that, he praised a certain duo.
From the beginning of the order of entry to the Evolution Holy Spring, Lin Hongnian was stunned and couldn’t believe it.
What?
A combination skill of expert level Thunder Palm and expert level Hardening?
A little metal-eating beast that mastered expert-level deterrence?
It was suspected that an ancient bloodline had awakened after the Evolution Holy Spring bath?
The sixth level of the ruins was an Ice Dragon Phantom? Shi Yu even defeated it?
What the f*ck was this? Did some snow maiden in the snow mountain cast an illusion on him before he came out?
“Old Lin, where are you going…”
“Returning to Ping Cheng to look for Shi Yu!”
…
Training villa.
Lin Hongnian came to Shi Yu’s new home.
At this moment, Shi Yu was leisurely sunbathing. He did not expect that someone would visit him at this time.
Who was it…
Shi Yu ran to open the door.
“Hall Master Lin, why are you here?”
After Shi Yu opened the door of the courtyard, he saw the serious-looking Lin Hongnian and was surprised.
“By the way, you’ve been to the snow mountain recently, right? How’s the situation over there?”
“It’s still manageable,” Lin Hongnian said. “I heard that you cracked that ruin?”
Back then, he did suggest that Shi Yu could go there to train, but he never expected that Shi Yu could break through the sixth level and grow so quickly.
Eleven had just started learning the Thunder Palm when he had decided to go to the snow mountain for the expedition…
Why did it become a combination skill that was expert in Thunder Palm and expert in Hardening in the end??
It was as if he had been out for several years.
However, this was not important. After all, Shi Yu was introduced by Lu Qingyi, a genius who had reached the master level in his early twenties.
With Lu Qingyi’s help, it was normal for Shi Yu to be a little ridiculous.
At this moment, Lin Hongnian’s most important goal was to ask about the Evolution Holy Spring and the ancient bloodline of the iron-eating beast.
“Moreover, I heard that your Iron-eating Beast gained something from the Evolution Holy Spring. It seems to have awakened some ancient bloodline?”
“Can you tell me about it?” Lin Hongnian looked serious.
Everyone in Ping Cheng knew how obsessed Lin Hongnian was with finding the evolution form of the iron-eating beast.
“Come in first.”
Shi Yu invited Hall Master Lin Hongnian into the courtyard.
At this moment, Eleven was training, and the Green Silkworm was trying its best to have a lucid dream as per his request. It was quiet here.
The two of them sat at the bamboo table. Shi Yu said, “I think that should be an ancient bloodline. It might be what the iron-eating beasts looked like thousands or even tens of thousands of years ago.”
“The form is actually not much different from now. It’s like an Iron-eating Beast wearing armor, but it doesn’t feel like a transcendent Hardening skill.”
The Transcendent Level Hardening symbol was that the Hardening Material could be released to form weapons and equipment. In addition, it could also attach the Hardening Material to other objects.
At the moment, only Master Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast in front of him had reached this proficiency.
Logically speaking, by relying on Perfect Level Hardening, one could create an armor suit. However, the feeling that the bloodline awakening gave him back then was that it was not as simple as Hardening. It was indeed a completely new life form.
“Battle armor…” Lin Hongnian fell into deep thought.
“It’s possible to form battle armor with transcendent hardening, but if you don’t think so… Then is it possible that transcendent hardening is one of the evolution conditions for the iron-eating beast?” Hall Master Lin guessed.
“It means that using transcendent Level Hardening to form a similar weapon and then stabilizing this form in a certain way… Is the evolution method of the iron-eating beast?” Shi Yu said. “Isn’t it a little too perfunctory…”
If that was the case, even if the evolved Hardening skill could still be added to armor and become double Hardening, it didn’t feel like there was any future.
A commander rank was the limit, in this scenario.
“It’s just a guess.” Lin Hongnian also felt that it was too simple. He couldn’t help but laugh and leave it at that.
“However, in short, it’s an experimental direction.”
“By the way, did any other changes happen after your Iron-eating Beast awakened its ancient bloodline?”
“Apart from having a better physique and slower growth, there are no other changes.”
Ordinary iron-eating beasts that had reached level nine of awakening should be a little taller than Eleven, but Eleven was a little short.
However, compared to the ancient bloodline, Shi Yu felt that it should be because the Evolution Holy Spring had strengthened Eleven’s life force.
“I see…” Lin Hongnian was silent. Unfortunately, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had only awakened a weak ancient bloodline. If only it had evolved directly…
This way, he might be able to study the evolution path of the iron-eating beasts more clearly.
Lin Hongnian suddenly thought of something and looked at Shi Yu, not knowing what to say.
“Do you have something to say, Hall Master Lin?”
Lin Hongnian nodded and asked, “Well, Shi Yu, did Miss Lu Qingyi help you to crack the ruins?”
“Uh…” Shi Yu did not expect this question.
How should he put it? Lu Qingyi’s 10 million yuan had indeed helped a lot, so it should be considered something, right?
Shi Yu nodded.
Lin Hongnian showed an “as expected” expression.
But then again, was Shi Yu really one of Lu Qingyi’s distant cousins? This was too ridiculous.
“You’re very close to Miss Lu. You must be very knowledgeable about archeology, right?”
Shi Yu nodded again.
“A ruin related to iron-eating beasts was discovered in the ancient capital. Do you know?”
“Originally, I didn’t pay attention to this news, but after hearing that the Iron-eating Beasts have ancient bloodlines, my thoughts changed. Perhaps the ancient Iron-eating Beasts really are special in some way.”
“Ruins related to iron-eating beasts?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Yes, Xiu Zhu told me.”
“Before I went to the snow mountain, she told me that she discovered a ruin related to the iron-eating beasts in the ancient capital. Her teacher was the first to receive the news and called her over. If I’m not wrong now, they should still be at the ancient capital ruins.”
“This child, Xiu Zhu…” Lin Hongnian shook his head and started chatting with Shi Yu.
As his daughter, Lin Xiuzhu had received elite nurturing since young. He had high hopes for her to become a powerful Beast Tamer.
After that, Lin Xiuzhu’s accomplishments were indeed not bad. She passed the vocation assessment to become a professional Beast Tamer at the age of 18 and was even accepted by Ancient Capital University, one of the nine major universities.
However, it was also after school that father and daughter had a disagreement.
The dream of this father and daughter was to unearth the possibility of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.
But Hall Master Lin wanted to use the training method of the iron-eating beasts to let the iron-eating beasts break through the racial limit and see if there was any possibility of evolution.
On the other hand, Lin Xiuzhu believed that the Iron-eating Beast had an evolution method similar to the Green Silkworm. It needed to meet certain conditions and rely on research, not training alone.
Because of different ideas and limited energy, Lin Xiuzhu finally chose the Feeding Department and Research Department, wanting to study the iron-eating beast evolution path in his own way.
However, this research project with no results was really difficult to complete. During her university days, she mainly studied this. It was also because of this that when her teachers in university learned that there were iron-eating beasts related ruins appearing, they would immediately inform Lin Xiuzhu, who had already graduated, and use their own connections to let Lin Xiuzhu be an archeological consultant.
“Senior Lin is already very outstanding…” Shi Yu thought that Lin Hongnian was unhappy with Lin Xiuzhu’s choice.
“I naturally know that,” Lin Hongnian said.
How could his daughter not be outstanding?
“I understand what you mean.”
Iron-eating beast ruins had appeared in the ancient capital, and there were suspected to be traces of ancient iron-eating beasts.
Initially, Lin Hongnian didn’t mind, but after Shi Yu discovered that the iron-eating beast’s evolution path was ancient, the ancient iron-eating beast information immediately had value for reference.
In addition, Shi Yu had cracked the Ping Cheng Ruins and was related to the archeological world’s new star, Lu Qingyi. Moreover, his Iron-eating Beast had awakened its ancient bloodline. Therefore, no matter how one looked at it, Shi Yu was very suitable to go to the ancient capital to investigate this Iron-eating Beast Ruins.
“Are you free to go? I can get Xiu Zhu to pick you up over there.”
“It’s a pity that Ping Cheng has been on guard recently. I still have to help protect Ping Cheng. Otherwise, I would definitely have gone along.”
Lin Hongnian mainly hoped that Shi Yu and Lin Xiuzhu could investigate something together over there.
“It shouldn’t be a problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
He was also confused about the evolution direction of the iron-eating beasts. Now that a ruin related to the iron-eating beasts had appeared, it was indeed worth looking at.
It was also a good opportunity to travel to a big city.
As one of the nine major cities of Dong Huang, the development of the Ancient Capital was completely incomparable to places like Ping Cheng and Icefield City.
He sighed. He was forced to take a break again and not add any points for the time being. Fine!
“Is the Archeological Association in charge of the investigation of the ruins over there?”
“No, it’s from the Archaeology Department of Ancient Capital University,” Lin Hongnian said. “They should be juniors who cultivate bamboo. After all, it’s just a small ruin related to the Iron Eater and not a ruin space. It’s not that important.”
“A student from Ancient Capital University… That’s also an elite like senior, I assume.”
There was a super institute in each of the nine first-level cities. It was a holy land for all Beast Tamers to pursue.
Generally speaking, only by passing the vocation assessment before the age of 20 would one have the hope of entering the nine major universities to further their studies.
“You don’t have to be humble. I guess if you participate in the vocation assessment, you will definitely be fought over by the nine major schools.” Lin Hongnian smiled.
“Unlike Xiu Zhu, she just barely entered Ancient Capital University.”
“Barely?”
“Well, when she participated in the vocation assessment, the Iron-eating Beast was just a beginner transcendent. It mastered the combination skill of proficient level Thunder Palm and mastery level Hardening.”
“Apart from that, there’s also a contract with another extraordinary creature with pretty good strength. But such a configuration can only be ranked at the bottom of the list of people who passed that batch. In the end, they still entered Ancient Capital University with the advantage of age.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Was it that hard?
“It can’t be helped. She chose to participate in the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital City. The vocation assessment in a first-level city is very difficult. However, it’s precisely because she participated in the assessment here that she had the chance to enter Ancient Capital University after passing it. After all, those universities won’t care about the vocation assessment organized by the Icefield City Association at all.”
It was too realistic. This was too cruel to Icefield City.
Shi Yu suddenly recalled that Ancient Capital City seemed to be the nearest first-level city to Icefield City. Lu Qingyi recommended him to participate in the assessment in a first-level city. Did he have to participate there too?
If it was, he wondered what results he, Eleven, and Buggy could achieve.
“Then I’ll set off to Ancient Capital City tomorrow.”
Shi Yu said, “In short, let’s take this opportunity to take a look first.”
“Then I’ll help you prepare the plane tickets,” Lin Hongnian said.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - Leader Eleven
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Leader Eleven
However, there was another problem.
Could the green worm eat the Ethereal Spirit Stone?
The answer was obvious. It definitely couldn’t be eaten directly.
Even Eleven wouldn’t be able to eat to its heart’s content.
Could it be that the Ethereal Stone had to be soaked in water?
Or grinded to powder?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought for a long time. He felt that it was unreliable.
At the side, the Green Silkworm and Eleven had already run off to experiment with the magical effects of the Perfect-level Worm Silk.
The worm silk was extremely strong and sharp.
Although it had yet to reach the transcendent level, after adding dozens of points, the Green Silkworm’s strength was not small.
Using this worm silk, he could easily cut ordinary rocks and trees.
With multiple entanglements, the power of the Worm Silk exceeded that of an arrow and could easily penetrate a large rock.
In terms of cutting power, the coverage of the attack would become greater after multiple entanglements, but it would also consume more physical strength.
In fact, with the current proficiency of the Green Silkworm towards the worm silk, it could even instantly weave a huge and complicated worm net to trap the enemy. It had already become more agile than humans.
Unfortunately, with its current attributes, it was only strong and sharp. There was nothing extraordinary about it, and it was still in the range of the insect class.
If he wanted to increase its power a little more and use the nature of the transcendent-level worm silk to absorb the attribute energy in the food.
On Shi Yu’s side, he couldn’t find out if the Ethereal Spirit Stone could be eaten at all. Just as he was about to ask Lu Qingyi, President Feng, and the others if they had any ideas, he suddenly slapped his head.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, being poor really made you dumb.”
“Why don’t you just buy space-type plants as food? Instead, you keep thinking about rocks.”
Shi Yu had yet to change his mindset. He had not realized that he was already a rich person after obtaining a ruin.
It didn’t seem wrong to sell an Ethereal Stone for money and buy a suitable spatial plant.
Even if there was a middleman who earned a difference in price, it wouldn’t be much. It was better than letting bugs eat rocks.
If it ate the rock and it stuffed its body up, the Green Silkworm could directly ascend… Into heaven.
…
After figuring it out, Shi Yu opened the all purpose shopping website and searched for the spatial resource interface. The last time he was on that page, he quit right away.
[Ethereal Spirit Stone]: It can assist Beast Tamers in strengthening the level of the Beast Taming Space. (shortage)
Good lord, not only was it in a shortage state, but there was also no price tag. It looked like a rare item.
But it was also normal. This thing was the same as energy crystals, a universal resource.
Energy crystals could be used by any pet with corresponding attributes. Although the conditions for the birth of energy crystals with common attributes were quite harsh, it was not that impossible.
However, the Ethereal Spirit Stone was different. It could only be born in special places like mystic realm ruins.
Moreover, the need for the Ethereal Stone was far greater than for ordinary attribute materials. Just by being a resource to increase the level of the Beast Taming Space, it meant that any Beast Tamer needed it.
Moreover, it was the kind of thing that you couldn’t have too much of.
After all, no matter how strong a pet was cultivated, it wasn’t as strong as being strong yourself.
After the level of the Beast Taming Space increased, even if the Beast Tamer did not use his pet, he could still suppress powerful extraordinary creatures himself.
Firstly, every time a Beast Tamer’s level increased, their physical fitness would undergo a qualitative change.
This qualitative change was more terrifying than the pet’s feedback and Shi Yu’s increase in points.
The improvement of the former was still in the category of normal people. The difference was at most the difference between ordinary people and national athletes.
However, the latter would become the difference between an ordinary person and a transcendent. Shi Yu estimated that only at that time would he dare to teach his pets super skills. At the same time, the weakening time for teaching low to high-level skills would also clearly decrease. Unlike now, where the timer would only decrease by ten minutes or so if he was feeling especially good. It was still in the same range.
However, this was not the most important thing. After all, even if one’s body was strong, no Beast Tamer would be dumb enough to fight with a pet’s physical body. This power up of the Tamer was, at most, to ensure the resistance of Beast Tamers in extreme environments.
No matter how strong a human’s body was, it was very difficult to compare with a pet.
The most obvious and crucial aspect of the increase in Beast Tamer level was actually the strength of the Beast Taming Space.
A high-level Beast Taming Space was just like those magic weapons used to lock demons in xianxia novels, the master ball in Pokémon, and the sealing technique used to seal tailed beasts in Naruto. It could directly suppress transcendent creatures. A powerful Beast Tamer could control powerful pets with just the Beast Taming Space.
Of course, this wasn’t the main killing method after all. It could only provide support.
But even so, it could be seen that the most important foundation of a Beast Tamer was not a pet, but the Beast Taming Space.
For some Beast Tamers who pursued the strength of the Beast Taming Space, bonds and cultivation were not important at all.
As long as the level of the Beast Taming Space was sufficiently high, he could directly control the powerful extraordinary creatures in the wild to fight for him.
[Space Crystal Fruit]: Level 1 spatial-type resource, a fruit that contains weak spatial power. It’s produced in the mystic realm space.
Price: 500,000 per pill.
“Cough, cough, cough.” Shi Yu choked.
This price was more than a hundred times higher than other resources of the same level.
Moreover, one fruit might not be enough for the green worm to eat.
However, perhaps a meal could last for days?
That was still very expensive. After all, it had only cost Shi Yu 400,000 yuan to increase the Green Silkworm’s silk speed to perfection.
“…I’ll buy it!”
