“Forget it, forget it. I won’t fight anymore. I’ll take a look.” Shi Yu yawned. He decided to walk around and go back to sleep!
…
In the northern campus of Ancient Capital University, there were quite a lot of battlefield halls.
During the opening day, the school also supported the young Beast Tamers who came to visit to compete.
As for the judges, they were naturally the seniors who had stayed in the school to volunteer. As long as the school gave them some credits, there were still many people who were willing to stay and act as NPCs.
“F*ck, so fierce.”
As Shi Yu strolled around, he arrived at a battle hall. The scale of the battle hall was even larger than the one competing for the evolution holy spring that day. It was divided into several venues, and at this moment, it was extraordinarily lively.
He had just arrived at the edge of a field when he heard someone cry out from the side.
Shi Yu looked at the arena. Two Beast Tamers who might not be much older than him were fighting.
One of the pets on both sides was the Blackwater Crocodile Tortoise, and the other was the Ground Rock Lizard. The growth levels of both pets had reached the transcendent level, so the power of their moves was abnormally strong.
This was because after a pet entered the transcendent level from the awakening stage, its energy level would undergo a qualitative change.
If the energy of an Awakening Stage pet was like a weak air current, then the energy of an extraordinary pet was like a thin stream, with a higher quality.
The change in energy brought about by the pet skill was the increase in the power of the skill!!
A boom sounded.
In the arena, the wind and sand raised by the Lava Lizard formed the Sand Wall. Although it was a low-level skill, judging from the condensation speed and wall structure, its proficiency had already been trained to expert level.
“Roar!!!”
However, it was precisely such a wall of sand that was easily penetrated by the water cannon condensed in the Blackwater Crocodile’s mouth, successfully allowing the skill to hit the Rock Lizard.
Intermediate-level skill, Water Cannon!
From the looks of it, its skill proficiency had yet to reach expert level, but due to the restraint of its attributes, it still gave the Rock Lizard a heavy blow.
However, unlike the trainee level battles that were often short and small, the battles here were very long. After the Rock Lizard was thrown a few meters away, it immediately stood up as if nothing happened and looked at its opponent angrily.
“Water Strengthening Talent, Elemental Resistance Talent…”
During the process of the two attacks, countless water-elemental fluctuations surrounded the Blackwater Crocodile Turtle’s Beast Tamer. This was a very common water-elemental talent that could be used to enhance the water-elemental skills of the Blackwater Crocodile Turtle. Although it was a proficient water cannonball, after the enhancement just now, in terms of power, it was probably not inferior to the expert water-elemental cannonball without the water-elemental talent.
As for the Beast Tamer talent on the Rock Lizard’s side, it was even simpler and cruder. It was known as the talent for Elemental Resistance in the Strengthening System. It could let pets have a certain resistance to any elemental attack. So even if the Rock Lizard faced the water cannonball that countered it, it still directly resisted it. Its condition looked like it could still fight for 300 rounds.
Quasi-vocational and professional-level fights were indeed starting to become a talent based thing.
“Thankfully, I don’t have a combat talent.” Looking at their battle, Shi Yu chuckled inwardly.
After this battle, these two Beast Tamers would probably be weakened for a while. It was unknown if they had prepared any tonic.
His skill blueprint was still the best. As long as he added some points in his daily life, he could just command them as he pleased in battle. There was no need for the other Beast Tamers to expend so much effort. They also had to invest a lot of stamina and energy.
On the other hand, when Shiyu encountered such a Beast Tamer with a strengthening talent in the future, he might suffer a little. At that time, the outcome would depend on the effect of his points on the pets. Whether it was comparable to the effect of others using enhancement talent on the pets’ battle power would depend on the effect.
“If it’s at this level, I think Eleven can fight. However, he probably has to fight with all its battle power and successfully kill it in one hit, like with that dragon…”
Shi Yu quickly determined the difference between Eleven and the two pets on the field. However, this was also because the races of these two pets were not high. They were not commander races. Furthermore, their growth levels were just at the initial transcendent level. Otherwise, if the other party’s attributes were a little stronger, Eleven might not have a chance.
Following that, Shi Yu continued strolling.
He discovered that the pets that dared to stand out and fight here were at least transcendent level.
However, this was normal. There were still four months until the vocation assessment. At this time, the pets that had yet to reach the transcendent level wouldn’t have much of a chance of entering this university.
At the same time, Shi Yu also discovered that this group of extraordinary pets had at least one proficient skill. Occasionally, he could even see two simple combination skills. This made Shi Yu sigh with emotion. These young Beast Tamers who were preparing for the professional assessment were indeed something…
His opponents four months later wouldn’t seem to be the same people as when he was competing for the Evolution Sacred Spring.
Like him, those people had yet to meet the requirements to participate in the vocation assessment.
If he participated in the professional assessment at the Ancient Capital Association, he might be facing a group of Beast Tamers who had reached the second level of the Taming Space and were qualified to have two transcendent pets…
Furthermore, because the professional assessment was once a year, some second-generation royal children could advance two levels in a year. They might even contract three pets. As for those with commander level pets, it should not be rare anymore…
“I understand. Although they’re all newbies, this is like the chunin Ninja Examination in Naruto. There were people in the lowest genin class who could do some insane things, like opening tai gates or using a tailed beast’s power…”
As everyone knew, genin were the strongest.
Similarly, it was not impossible for a group of monsters to be hidden in the vocation assessment.
No wonder Lu Qingyi said that the professional assessment of the Ancient Capital Association was challenging and that he should use the ruins bead to develop faster…
As far as the universe knew, the annual class assessment did not have a set standard for passing. Instead, it was done according to the ratio. Therefore, it was not guaranteed that one could pass the assessment just by reaching the pro level and owning a transcendent beast.
It was also because of this that the vocation assessments in these big cities were even more difficult than those in small cities. This was because if one passed the vocation assessment in big cities, there was a higher chance of being selected by top colleges and top corporations.
This was actually the same on Earth. A top 500 corporation wouldn’t recruit just anyone from any school. However, the graduates of Qingbei could be fought over by various corporations. The professional assessment was also so realistic.
This model also created a strange phenomenon.
People who could have easily passed the vocation assessment in a small city didn’t give up and tried applying for several years in a big city. The strength of these people was probably ridiculous. After all, the vocation assessment had no age or number of tries restrictions. Their accumulation time was clearly higher!
It was even possible to meet an 80-year-old elder in the vocation assessment.
Of course, although it was encouraging for such an old man to participate in the vocation assessment, probably no school or company would think well of him… Even if he obtained the first place in the current year, he didn’t have much potential. For example, the Ancient Capital University had a certain limit on the age of the applicants.
Therefore, although strength was important, the potential and talent displayed were also important.
“No problem, no problem…”
Although Shi Yu felt a sense of pressure, as he had started much later, he still felt that there was no problem.
All he had to do was add some points, and there was no hurry. Anyway, he didn’t want to be first place in the same cohort. Passing the test would be considered a victory!
…
For the entire afternoon, Shi Yu was watching the battle, mainly to see the performance of the various Beast Tamers’ Beast Taming Talents. He would not admit that he was looking for some Beast-eared Lady.
Unfortunately, after watching for the entire afternoon, he discovered that these Beast Tamers basically had enhancement-type talent. He didn’t see any special combat talent at all. This couldn’t help but dampen Shi Yu’s spirits.
As evening approached, Shi Yu left the battlefield in the northern campus and headed for the ten-star hotel he had reserved in advance.
Although he could live in the pearl, since he was rich, it was not a bad idea to enjoy it.
That night, Shi Yu had a huge meal in the hotel. He only returned to his room after he was satisfied. He lay on his bed and began to meditate with an ethereal stone.
After playing for a day, it was time to work hard…
Moments later, Shi Yu opened his eyes.
“I didn’t add any points today. I feel so good. One piece of ethereal stone doesn’t seem to be enough for me anymore. I feel that with my current focus, maybe I can use both pieces at the same time!”
“No, three!”
“Wait a moment, there are dozens in the inventory. Three feels pretty bad. Damn it, if only I could set up a Spirit Gathering Formation like the spirit stones in the Xianxia novels!”

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - The Beast-eared Lady Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: The Beast-eared Lady Is Here
The next day.
Shi Yu woke up feeling refreshed.
This was the most comfortable sleep he had in the past month.
It was more comfortable for him to cultivate himself than for his pets.
“Today…”
After washing up, Shi Yu switched on his phone and looked at the number Lu Qingyi had given him.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. Since Lu Qingyi had entrusted someone to show him around the school, it was a waste not to.
If he were to wander around by himself, he would really be confused. He might be stuck in the same place for the entire afternoon like yesterday without any gains.
“87237387…” Shi Yu dialed and planned on finding this guide for himself.
A long time later, a clear and experienced female voice sounded.
“Who is it?”
“Hello, this number was given to me by Senior Lu Qingyi…”
Just as Shi Yu was about to continue explaining, the other party immediately understood and said, “I understand. You plan on visiting Ancient Capital University?”
“Yes.”
“In an hour, I’ll wait for you outside the battlefield hall at Northern Campus District No. 18.”
Shi Yu scratched his head and could only agree silently.
Sigh, the other party didn’t give him a chance to say anything. Forget it, he’d ask later.
“Eleven, come out and rest!”
Just as he was about to leave, Shi Yu thought of something and shouted for Eleven, who was in the ruins bead. Without giving it a chance to refuse, he teleported Eleven out with his identity as the master of the ruin.
In the room, Eleven looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
“Wuu!”
This couldn’t do. If it didn’t work hard, it wouldn’t even be able to defeat Buggy.
“It’s alright, then I’ll also stop it from working hard.”
Shi Yu summoned the sleeping Green Silkworm and threw it into his backpack.
At the same time, he reminded the Green Silkworm, “Don’t go materializing illusions. Just sleep and dream today.”
Green Silkworm: “Zz…”
Eleven was silent. It still felt off, but Shi Yu’s hand had already grabbed the back of its neck.
After being grabbed by fate, Eleven revealed a bitter expression. It could only be forced to shrink to the point where it could lie on Shi Yu’s shoulder. Shi Yu threw it onto his shoulder.
“Training is very important, but so is increasing one’s horizons!”
“Do you know how many exciting battles you missed yesterday?” Shi Yu educated Eleven.
Eleven pricked up its ears and listened.
“As the saying goes, knowing one’s enemy and oneself is the only way to win a hundred battles. Growing experience is also a way to increase strength. From tomorrow onwards, you take two hours to train and memorize the Pet Encyclopedia with me.”
Eleven: Huh???
Eleven was confused. Wasn’t it enough that pets could fight? Why did they have to memorize books!
Isn’t that what Beast Tamers should do?
“You have to develop in all aspects!” Adding points saved Eleven a lot of training time. It wasn’t too much to ask it to memorize the information of thousands of pets.
With enough energy, it was definitely not a bad thing to develop fully without shortcomings.
It was way more convenient for Eleven to know the details of the enemy instead of letting him tell it.
In short, he could also let Eleven memorize it. Shi Yu felt that if he encountered questions he didn’t know how to do during the exam, he might even be able to ask Eleven.
As expected of him. This was the cultivation idea that was 80 versions ahead of this era.
…
Just like that, Shi Yu hung the baby bear on his shoulder and went out.
This was the first time Shi Yu had Eleven show up in such a manner, but it didn’t matter because the passers-by didn’t say anything as he walked past.
In such a big city, there were too many rare pets. Mutated pets, multicolored pets, pets wearing clothes, pets with a layer of makeup on by their owners, there were a bunch of strange pets that were rarely seen in Ping Cheng.
In contrast, the shrinking of Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder made many people directly treat it as an iron-eating beast cub that had developed pretty well in various aspects. It was just that simple.
He bought two ice creams by the roadside, one for himself, and eleven. Then, Shi Yu headed for the destination he had arranged with the other party.
He arrived 20 minutes earlier than yesterday. Although it was early in the morning, there were already many people outside the battlefield hall of Ancient Capital University.
[How is it? Do you feel that the pets nearby are all very strong?]
When they were bored, Shi Yu said to Eleven on his shoulder telepathically.
“Wuu.”
Eleven kept looking around and indeed discovered that there were many pets beside Beast Tamers with powerful energy waves.
However, Eleven didn’t know the exact strength, but perhaps it could be detected with expert-level deterrence?
[If you don’t want us to be beaten up, you better not do this.]
Good heavens, using group deterrence in such a place, wasn’t this a provocation? He would get beat up.
Shi Yu held his cell phone and checked the surrounding energy fluctuations. He couldn’t detect it at all.
This meant that the pets nearby were basically all above the transcendent level. Very few of them had Awakening Stage.
What did this mean?
Did this mean that the Beast Tamer level in the big city was very high? No, it meant that he should change his cell phone.
Although he had just bought this cell phone not long ago, it seemed to be insufficient at this time. If it was the next one… At least, it had to bring a higher-level combat power detector.
As for this phone, he would leave it to the Green Silkworm and Eleven!
They could do whatever they wanted with Ice Dragon movies or selfies.
Just as Shi Yu was considering whether he should change to a cell phone with a value above seven digits, his lousy cell phone rang.
“I’m under the streetlamp.” After Shi Yu picked up the call, a voice came from the other end.
“I see it.”
Shi Yu looked around and immediately saw a girl in combat shorts, short sleeves, and knee guards under the streetlamp nearby.
The other party wasn’t tall. She had short black hair, fair skin, and a small figure. It was a standard fitness figure without any extra fat.
It was this person?
Shi Yu walked over. The other party also saw Shi Yu and revealed an assessing gaze.
“You’re that Shi Yu that Senior Lu introduced?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Hello.”
The combat girl nodded and said, “Hello, I’m a student of Ancient Capital University’s battle department, Bai Xi. At the same time, I’m also a reserve member of Senior Lu’s archeological team. Since I’ve promised Senior Lu, I’ll show you around Ancient Capital University in the next two days.”
With that, she looked at Eleven, who was staring at her with dark circles under its eyes, and fell silent.
“You still seem to be a Beast Tamer traineeern?”
“Yes, is there a problem?”
“No, but do you have a place you thought of visiting?” Bai Xi asked.
“How about I give you a suggestion?”
Shi Yu was stunned and nodded.
“Then come with me.” Bai Xi smiled and said, “Actually, it’s not my suggestion, but Senior Lu’s suggestion.”
“Huh?”
“She said that if you come to me, I don’t have to bring you to the archeology department’s territory first. Instead, I’ll help you increase your strength.”
“My strength??”
Bai Xi didn’t say much. Instead, she quickly brought Shi Yu to a training ground on the side of the battlefield hall that wasn’t open to the public.
Then, she walked away from Shi Yu step by step. At the same time, a huge summoning array appeared, appearing not far from Bai Xi and Shi Yu.
“Wu’er!!!”
After a high and bright cry, a transcendent creature that looked like a fox, more than a meter tall, appeared. It was covered in white hair, had a pair of blue eyes, a proportionate body, and appeared noble and elegant. Six long and smooth tails surrounded it.
< Name > Six-tailed White Fox
[Attributes]: Light
[Race Level]: High-level commander
“Not the strength of your pet commanding, but the strength of your own body when facing the threat of your pet.”
As Bai Xi finished speaking, a white pillar of light condensed in the mouth of the six-tailed white fox she summoned. With a boom, it attacked Bai Xi under the stunned expressions of Shi Yu and Eleven!
Intermediate-level skill, Destruction Ray.
In an instant, Bai Xi’s entire body was swallowed by the light. A violent explosion occurred where he was, and even the ground exploded. Dust and strong wind were suddenly lifted, forcing Shi Yu, who was not far away, to take a step back.
“F*ck.” “Wu wu!!” The six-tailed white fox shook its tail and glanced at Shi Yu and the others, giving Shi Yu and Eleven a fright.
What happened?
“Just like this, in the face of the attack of supernatural creatures, as a Beast Tamer, do you have enough strength to protect yourself?”
At this time, from the smoke, Bai Xi’s voice came from the shattered ground. She directly withstood the Six-tailed White Fox’s Destruction Ray with her body. Her surroundings were in a mess, and she didn’t seem to have suffered any injuries at all.
“My Beast Taming Talent is’ Fusion ‘, so I can fuse with my pet to obtain a physical fitness that exceeds my own and that of my pet. It’s fine if you don’t have this Beast Taming Talent, but no matter what, a Beast Tamer has to master at least one type of pet in battle and can also ensure their own safety in combat skills.”
“In fact, protecting myself is only a part of the foundation. I can also have the strength to fight against pets. That’s the real safety. For example, in my current state, I can tear apart commander-level creatures with my bare hands.”
“Senior Lu said that you should apply to the Archaeology Department. Then, do you know that the most important thing in the Archaeology process is not professional archeology, but strength? Various ruins are filled with danger. Archeologists themselves don’t have enough strength. Even if they have more bodyguards, they can’t enter the door of this industry. This profession might not necessarily have lower requirements for overall strength than traditional professional Beast Tamers.”
As soon as she finished speaking, Shi Yu had already opened his mouth slightly. It was not because this strange woman had really resisted the pet skill, but because of her current appearance…
Her short black hair had completely turned into furry white short hair, and her eyes had also turned blue. There were also two more things that looked like cat ears or tiger ears!!
Special Fusion Beast Taming Talent?
This was the beast-eared girl?!

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - Regarding the Life-Saving Ability of Beast Tamers
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Regarding the Life-Saving Ability of Beast Tamers
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu’s gaze could not move away immediately. After all, this was the first time he had seen this Beast Taming Talent. It felt very novel!
Moreover, in the intense explosion just now, it was one thing for Bai Xi’s body to be enhanced, but why were her clothes so sturdy?
Shi Yu was purely curious. Was there any battle suit that could resist energy? He wanted to buy two sets too!
“Have you seen enough?”
At this moment, Bai Xi saw that Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast were staring at her. Her figure disappeared directly and she came behind Shi Yu. She patted Shi Yu’s shoulder and picked Eleven up.
“So fast.”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. Eleven was already being held by the other party. Eleven subconsciously wanted to resist, but the other party’s strength was unexpectedly strong. Eleven couldn’t break free at all.
“Wuu!” Eleven immediately felt that it had returned to the days when ite was dominated by Big Sister Lin Xiuzhu.
This fellow’s strength was even more ridiculous than Sister Lin Xiuzhu!
“Sorry… This is the first time I’ve encountered this talent.”
“Don’t you need to summon your pet to use this talent?” Shi Yu looked at the six-tailed white fox at the edge and then at Bai Xi’s transformation characteristics.
Although it was also white, it clearly didn’t match with the Six-tailed White Fox.
“No need. The Fusion Talent is relatively special. It can directly fuse with the pets in the Beast Taming Space. My current fusion target is another tiger-type pet.”
Bai Xi picked Eleven up and stared at it carefully before handing it back to Shi Yu.
“So it’s the multiplication skill…”
At the same time, her beast characteristics slowly disappeared, and she returned to her previous appearance.
“Do you understand what I mean now?”
Bai Xi said, “The battles you previously engaged in should all be battles where Beast Tamers are in relatively safe conditions. Otherwise, it would be formal competitions, or else you would be under high protection…”
“The professional level is actually a threshold. After stepping into the professional level, the comfortable environment will greatly decrease.”
“Because of this, one of the first two pets of the Beast Tamers will basically be perfectly compatible with themselves to protect themselves.”
“Of course, you’ll definitely think that it’s easier for me to do this because I have the talent of fusion, but that’s not the case. There are countless similar techniques, and it depends on whether the Beast Tamer will dig them up.”
“Xiao-Xiaobai, come here.” Bai Xi shouted for the Six-tailed White Fox, and the fox immediately walked over.
“Circle Dance,” she said.
In the next second, the six-tailed white fox waved its six tails, forming a dazzling light that swept towards Bai Xi.
Bang!!!
Shi Yu and Eleven were shocked again. This Senior White was really a tiger! She let her pet hit her all the time. Although it was to show him, it was so scary.
This time, Bai Xi didn’t fuse into a body. However, the six-tailed white fox’s tail stopped in midair.
This was because during the process of it sweeping towards Bai Xi, countless streams of water gathered out of thin air, forming a water shield in front of Bai Xi. The Six-tailed White Fox’s Circle Swing skill directly hit the water shield, but it couldn’t break through.
Splash!!
When the water shield disappeared, Bai Xi said, “It’s my other water-element pet. It has mastered the ‘Water Shield’ skill and also majored in this skill. It has already trained its skill to the proficiency of automatically sensing danger and defending, so it can help me block the damage at the moment the danger approaches me.”
“Well, in battle, I actually prefer to change my form and let it transform into the form of a high-pressure water saber to fight…” Bai Xi licked her lips.
Shi Yu and Eleven were speechless.
Then, Eleven looked down at Shi Yu. Why did his Beast Tamer retreat whenever he could in battle?
The difference between people is indeed huge!
“Alright, it’s time to talk about you guys. Do you have similar thoughts?” Bai Xi asked.
“This…” Shi Yu thought for a moment. In the future, Buggy might be able to materialize into pets with similar skills, or it could directly materialize into armor to protect himself?
However, he couldn’t explain this to the beast-eared senior in front of him.
“Looks like you don’t have any ideas.” Bai Xi smiled and said, “I’ll give you a suggestion.”
“I know two master-level Beast Tamers with iron-eating beasts that do this.”
“What?” Shi Yu was stunned. Iron-eating beast?
Bai Xi said, “One of the symbols of the Iron-eating Beast’s racial skill, Transcendent Level Hardening, is to apply it. It can apply the Hardening Material to other objects, including life forms. At that time, you can hang it on your shoulder and let it give you a layer of Hardening. If you do that, you can also have the skill to resist and tear your pet apart with your bare hands.”
“When your Beast Taming Space upgrades and your physique undergoes an extraordinary transformation, you might be able to give it a try.”
“Of course, the premise is that you can cultivate Hardening to transcendent level. This isn’t easy.”
“!!!” Shi Yu and Eleven looked at the smiling Bai Xi. Ten thousand Green Silkworms crawled across their hearts. Could hardening be done in this way? Shi Yu and Eleven had never thought of it.
Was this how they played in the city?
Shi Yu: I can also use Armament Haki Hardening?
However, this definitely had to be given up. Eleven was an ace. How could it always be a bodyguard on his shoulder?
But it was really an idea.
High-speed healing could even be used to heal Beast Tamers, so it was completely fine to apply other skills to Beast Tamers.
“Of course, the above are all off-topic. The goal is to give you a warning. Remember to think about this yourself as much as possible in the future direction of pet training. After all, you, the Beast Tamer, are the most important,” Bai Xi said.
“These are still far from where you are now. Senior Lu said that if you come to me, I can teach you a special skill that you can use right now.”
“She originally planned to teach it herself… But she’s been rather busy recently, so she entrusted it to me. Of course, if you didn’t come to me, she might have taught it to you herself later.”
Shi Yu asked, “What skill…”
Bai Xi crossed her arms and looked at the fox. The six-tailed white fox once again swung its tail.
This time, Bai Xi displayed her third life-saving skill. The first was the Fusion Transformation, which came from her Beast Taming Talent. The second was the Water Shield, which came from her pet’s skill, and the third…
Its six tails swept across. This time, it was as if it had hit an illusion. It directly passed through Bai Xi’s body, causing Shi Yu to fall into confusion again.
“This skill is called ‘Etherealization’. Beast Tamers can use their willpower to transfer their bodies into alternate spaces to avoid damage. In theory, in that state just now, I was no longer in this space.”
“The conditions you would need to harm me in that state are very restricted.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Beast Tamers mastered spatial skills?
“This is an ability that only legendary Beast Tamers can master, but…”
Bai Xi pointed at the ruin bead hanging on Shi Yu’s neck and said, “But people who have a legendary Beast Tamer’s relic can also use this ability with special spatial tools. Although there are some restrictions, it is enough to protect their lives in low-level battles.”
When she finished speaking, Shi Yu subconsciously touched the ruins bead.
“Don’t be surprised, it was Senior Lu who told me. She said you successfully cracked a ruin, but you probably don’t know the best way to use this spatial tool, right?”
“The best usage method is what I showed just now. It allows ordinary Beast Tamers to have the same ethereal ability as legendary Beast Tamers in advance.” Bai Xi waved the bead on the chain and said, “Do you want to learn it?”
“Most people only know that the growth enhancement of spiritual plants and pets in the mystic realm ruins is the most valuable. They don’t know that the space left behind by a legendary Beast Tamer can be used like this. You’re lucky.”
Shi Yu was stunned. He looked at the bead in the other party’s hand. This was also a rich lady!
The Ruins Bead was also called the Mystic Realm Bead!
This Bai Xi actually had one!
Super second-generation heir???
“Yes,” Shi Yu said subconsciously. With this skill, what was there to be afraid of?
He thought that the ruins bead could only be used to hide in times of danger. It turned out that it could be used so easily? It could directly etherealize its body outside?
No wonder Beauty Lu said that this ruin bead was his best cheat before he became an official member of Bureau 11.
He had completely gathered all the spatial storage, cultivation enhancement, and life-saving divine skills.
“Well, then you should learn from me first,” Bai Xi said. “There’s a place in the school that specializes in training the life-saving abilities of Beast Tamers.. I’ll take you there to take a look first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - Time to Let loose
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Time to Let loose
During the opening day, although the campus of Ancient Capital University was open to the public, there were actually very few training facilities that could be used by passers-by. Probably only battle areas could be completely open to the public.
As for training facilities that required energy to be activated, they were at most introduced to the visitors to evoke their yearning.
If it really opened all of them, Ancient Capital University would probably suffer a huge loss in a month.
However, nothing was absolute. There were privileged people everywhere. Next, Beast Ear Lady Bai Xi brought Shi Yu to a huge high-level building in the northern campus.
Bai Xi walked in front while Shi Yu and Eleven followed behind her. The other party took out a school card and swiped it briefly before they successfully entered.
“Granny, are you there?”
After entering, Bai Xi looked in the direction of the counter. On the other side, a white-haired old woman was typing on the computer. She seemed to be working and was very immersed, completely ignoring Bai Xi and Shi Yu who had just entered.
Then, Bai Xi and Shi Yu walked closer to take a look and immediately fell silent.
“When I’m done playing this round, immediately.” The granny stared at the game interface, her wrinkles trembling.
In the video, the sound of people being attacked kept coming out. “Uh, uh, uh!! Ah, ah, ah!”
How modern, Granny!
After lamenting, Shi Yu and Bai Xi watched quietly by the side. After a long time, the granny smashed the keyboard in anger before returning to a kind expression. “Ah, it’s Little Bai Xi. Why are you here?”
“Granny, help me set up a time-limit card and open a prep room. There’s a junior who hasn’t entered school who wants to experience this facility.”
“Oh, oh.” The granny glanced at Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eater and nodded with a smile. “How long will it take?”
There was a hidden policy in Ancient Capital University. All the teachers and visitors brought by the students had the right to temporarily use some training facilities in the school, and they had different treatment from the students who came to visit.
Bai Xi glanced at Shi Yu and said, “Half a month.”
“Alright.” The granny nodded.
Then, Bai Xi said to the administrator, Granny, “Granny, help us open the most basic pass now. I’ll bring him to prepare first.”
After Bai Xi finished speaking, the granny expressed her understanding. She began to lead Shi Yu to the preparation room on the first floor.
…
In the lounge, Bai Xi got Shi Yu to sit down and began to transform into a teacher.
“You definitely know the basic ability of using the Ruins Bead to store items and take out items.”
“At the same time, you must have mastered how to enter the ruins bead yourself. This is the foundation to master the ability of ‘etherealization’.”
“And if you want to use the ability that only this legendary Beast Tamer can master in advance, the key is to establish the connection between your Beast Taming Space and the space storage.”
Then, Bai Xi began to teach Shi Yu a special method to control the ruins bead.
There were too many secrets hidden in the Beast Taming Space. Sometimes, Shi Yu was also very curious why the evolution direction of the humans in this world just happened to be Beast Taming. If it were any other world, they would have long become super mighty figures.
As he explained, Bai Xi constantly added,
“Using this ability isn’t without cost.”
“Every second of etherealization consumes a lot of physical strength. In fact, in a sense, this ability can be seen as a second life-saving Beast Taming Talent that can only be awakened at the Legendary level. There’s nothing wrong with that saying.”
“I understand…” Shi Yu looked like he had seen through life.
Previously, he was still glad that he didn’t have to consume his physical strength to command the battle.
It had only been a day, and he immediately had a virtualization ability that consumed physical strength to activate.
This ability was simply deliberately appearing to bait him into courting death. Etherealization… This ability really had two meanings…
Next, Shi Yu spent about half an hour to understand how to first establish the connection between his Beast Taming Space and the Ruins Bead with his mind before completing the etherealization. Although the steps were a little complicated every time, it was said that once the proficiency was high, it would only take an instant.
It was indeed important to have a good teacher to guide him. Bai Xi explained everything in detail to Shi Yu.
“Try it out?”
As Shi Yu finished meditating, he opened his eyes. Bai Xi was smiling in front of him.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and focused. It was as if lightning flashed in his mind.
Spatial secret skill, Etherealization!
In an instant, with a “Wuu!!!”, Shi Yu’s figure seemed to have turned into an illusion and disappeared from this world for a second. At the same time, Eleven, who was resting with its eyes narrowed, woke up abruptly and fell to the ground!
Eleven: ┗|`O′|┛ Wuu!!
What was going on?!!!
It didn’t hurt, but it scared the panda. What happened just now?
“Did it really succeed?” After turning incorporeal for a second, Shi Yu quickly recovered with a pleasantly surprised expression.
Eleven looked over in confusion.
Faced with Eleven’s confusion, Shi Yu naturally explained the etherealization to it happily.
“Very good. Then let’s practice in actual combat.” Bai Xi smiled.
“I’ve organized a time-limited card for you for half a month. You can come here to practice your abilities in half a month.”
“Follow me.”
Bai Xi’s way of doing things was swift and decisive. She did not give Shi Yu any time to catch his breath. She immediately left the lounge and came to the old lady administrator.
“Are you ready? The basic level has already been opened. You can enter at any time,” the granny said.
Bai Xi looked at Shi Yu and signaled for him to come closer. He looked at the computer screen.
On the computer screen, an environment had already been displayed. At the same time, various extraordinary creatures appeared around it.
Wind Crystal Butterfly, Fear Bear, Gold-Eating Mouse, Poison Dart Frog, Ice-Armored Beast, Skeleton Soldier…
When Shi Yu saw the scene, he felt that something was wrong. He had a bad feeling.
“These transcendent creatures are all energy bodies formed by machines. There’s no difference between their battle patterns, skills, forms… compared to real creatures. The only difference is that their strength has been weakened to the minimum. Even if an ordinary person receives the skill, they will only feel some pain and not be injured.”
“There are a total of ten transcendent creatures in the basic stage. What you need to do next is to last ten minutes while dodging the danger as much as possible here.”
“Oh right, you don’t have to bring your Little Iron-eating Beast with you. In any case, the skills you need to train don’t need pets. You can rely on yourself.”
As Bai Xi finished speaking, Eleven was stunned. It gave Shi Yu an encouraging look. Good luck, you can definitely do it.
Shi Yu: “???”
Shi Yu pointed at himself and said, “Me alone?”
“Yes.” Bai Xi nodded and said, “It’s alright. This is only one of the most basic obstacles. It mainly trains the Beast Tamer’s own reaction speed and ability to deal with danger.”
“If you bring your pet in together, the effect on your training will be lower. After all, your life-saving skills don’t need the help of your pet.”
“Alright…” Shi Yu nodded. Then, under Bai Xi’s guidance, he headed to a room on the second floor nervously.
…
On the second floor, in the huge room, ten transcendent creatures were distributed in various corners of the room. After discovering that the space was very large, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. At least this way, he wouldn’t be immediately beaten up…
However, he was still too naive. Not long after he stepped into the room, the ten monsters in the room immediately attacked at the same time!!
The Butterfly directly waved a wind blade, and the Poison Arrow Frog also shot a poisonous arrow. In the distance, the skeleton soldiers had already raised their bone swords and charged at Shi Yu…
The ten transcendent creatures attacked at almost the same time, scaring Shi Yu into hurriedly entering the ethereal state.
Fortunately, he had turned incorporeal. Otherwise, Shi Yu felt that even if he brought Eleven along, it would definitely not be able to help him block all the attacks unless it used deterrence to instantly kill all the enemies.
Perhaps only by reaching transcendent in Hardening and adding a layer of buff to himself would he have a chance of resisting.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Shi Yu completed the etherealization and those skills missed.
In the outside world…
The granny administrator, Bai Xi, and Eleven were using their computer monitors to look at the situation inside the checkpoint.
“It’s actually etherealization…” The granny saw the life-saving technique Shi Yu used and immediately looked at Bai Xi.
“This little classmate you brought doesn’t have a simple background, right?”
Bai Xi nodded. How could a newcomer that Senior Lu liked be simple?
He had cracked a ruin during the trainee period and obtained the ruins bead. On the other hand, those top second-generation heirs were only so-so.
“He just mastered the ability to turn incorporeal. With the physique of a Beast Tamer intern, supporting the ethereal state for about half a minute is the limit.”
“If he can’t use this ability reasonably, he will quickly fall into danger and fail the challenge,” Bai Xi said as she looked at Shi Yu on the screen.
She looked speechless. It was too wasteful!
Etherealization was not a permanent buff. It had to be activated at a critical moment. This Shi Yu, it would save him trouble if he kept it on, sure, but was his physical fitness cost-free?
Did Shi Yu understand the purpose of this training!
“After all, it’s his first time. He would have to adapt slowly…” The granny was experienced and said very considerately.
In the scene, Shi Yu still maintained his ethereal form, making the ferocious beasts attack like headless flies, but they couldn’t hit Shi Yu.
Just like that, 30 seconds passed.
40 seconds passed…
After 45 seconds, the expressions of the granny and Bai Xi gradually became strange!
“How could he etherealize for so long?” Bai Xi didn’t understand. She had also mastered the ability to etherealize during the intern period. She knew very well the approximate time to maintain it at various levels and states.
However, when it came to Shi Yu, something seemed to have gone wrong?
“Sob!” At this moment, Eleven silently looked at the scene and analyzed their thoughts through the expressions of Granny and Bai Xi.
Eleven looked calm, as if to say, “Don’t make a fuss. Didn’t Shi Yu show extraordinary stamina?”
Eleven wanted to say that actually, it wasn’t that Shi Yu’s physical fitness exceeded other Beast Tamers of the same level by a lot, but that he had rich experience in “etherealization”.
Shi Yu, who could remain calm even after falling into a weakened state for dozens of hours after points were added… So what if he overdrew his physical strength and turned incorporeal for a while? It was very reasonable!
“This doesn’t make sense.” Bai Xi stared at the image.
At that moment, in the room, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He felt that this couldn’t continue. He felt that he couldn’t hold on anymore.
This etherealization consumed more physical energy than he imagined!
“Hu hu hu hu!!!”
As Shi Yu was thinking about how to crack this level, the skeleton soldier’s large bone sword kept waving in front of Shi Yu’s eyes, making him feel vexed.
“Wait a minute, since this level isn’t as dangerous as I imagined, maybe I can take the initiative to counterattack?”
“Senior Beast Ear also said that a truly outstanding Beast Tamer has to have the ability to face extraordinary creatures bravely.”
Shi Yu was stunned. A certain suicidal soul hidden in his body that was paired with archaeology suddenly woke up.
At this moment, he recalled the opportunity for him to step into the archeological field.
In fact, the first time Shi Yu came into contact with archeology on Earth came from an animated film.
“Dragon Adventures”!
The story tells how archeologists, martial arts expert Jackie Chan, explore various mysteries around the world.
At that time, Shi Yu, who was young, was haunted by his “eighth-grader syndrome”. He felt that Cheng Long was very handsome and even had a copycat career.
Not only did he study archeology, but he also frequently danced and touched his feet, wanting to restore Jackie Chan’s difficult movements.
In the end, Shi Yu got into the ambulance.
This made him understand that the cartoons were all fake.
However, a person’s dream would never end. When he grew up, Shi Yu studied many other skills.
He knew a little of all kinds of combat skills and fighting styles, but only a little. It was this experience that made Shi Yu die a little later.
In short, Earth couldn’t fulfill its dreams for various reasons. Now, an opportunity had come.
Now that he also had a magic-like ability and his physique had improved, it immediately made Shi Yu’s courage increase greatly. With a ruthless gaze, he withdrew from the ethereal state and kicked the skeleton soldier in front of him who was waving his swords around. He immediately kicked it over and the bone sword fell to the ground.
Shi Yu picked up the bone sword and waved it nervously, aiming at the remaining nine ferocious beasts.
He was going to let himself go!
“Feels okay?” This might be his first step to becoming a super Earthling!

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - Iron-eating Beast Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Iron-eating Beast Ruins
With a sword in hand, Shi Yu immediately felt heroic.
He felt that this was the correct way to transmigrate. Wasn’t being a swordsman more handsome than being a Beast Tamer?
In the outside world, following Shi Yu’s sudden action, the administrator, the Beast-eared Lady Bai Xi, and the Panda King, Eleven, were all stunned.
“Huh? Σ (° △ °lll)”
Eleven looked at the image in confusion.
It was thinking, “Shi Yu, what are you doing? Shi Yu, calm down!”
You’re not cut out for that!
“Looks like he understood.”
After a moment of silence, Bai Xi said, “A true Beast Tamer must have the courage to face transcendent creatures on their own.”
“Although I’ve already expected him to get beaten up next, this will undoubtedly become a very precious experience for him…”
As the human and panda expressed their views, Shi Yu’s figure had already been swallowed by a group of ferocious beasts. There was only a bone sword left on the spot…
…
“Oww!”
“It hurts.”
Let some other earthling become a swordsman. In the future, he would add points at the back and watch his pets fight!
Soon, Shi Yu was beaten out.
When Yu came out, the beast-eared woman, Bai Xi, was looking at him with a faint smile.
“Sob.” Eleven covered its face and asked Shi Yu if he needed it to help take revenge.
Just now, Shi Yu couldn’t be cool for even three seconds. He was directly beaten up by a group of ferocious beasts and could not get up. He even relied on his etherealization to escape.
“I haven’t seen such a brave youth in a long time.”
The manager, Granny, also had a smile on her face. All the negative emotions from losing the game had disappeared, and she was in a very good mood.
From this, it could be seen that Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer who was good at bringing joy to others.
“I feel like I almost had it.” Shi Yu looked disappointed.
The main reason was that there were too many enemies. He had died before he could even use the sword skill he had learned on Earth…
Although there was no harm, the slight pain was still present. Shi Yu felt indescribable pain.
Sigh, when would he be as skilled as Uncle Jackie Chan…
Bai Xi said, “There’s no need to worry. The most basic levels here are also prepared for Beast Tamers above the professional level.”
“It’s very normal that you can’t react. If you’re not ethereal, with the physique of a Beast Tamer intern and not relying on pets, it’s actually a miracle that you can last for a few seconds.”
Shi Yu :”…”
In other words, he was just challenging a fight above his level?
Why didn’t she say so earlier? If she had said so earlier, he would have changed his method of challenge and gone straight to the end!
Falseization+supplements, he could directly endure until the energy of this training facility dried up!
Of course, this was just bragging…
Then, just as Bai Xi was about to say something, her phone suddenly rang.
She took out her cell phone and answered the call. Then, she immediately nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll be there in a while.”
After hanging up, she looked at Shi Yu apologetically and said, “I suddenly have something on. I’ll show you around another day.”
“My suggestion is that you use the training facilities here to practice your etherealization first.”
“After you become proficient in etherealization, partial etherialization, and instant etherealization can be done. In that state, you can use other Beast Taming Talents to command, summon, and retract your pets. It’s faster and more convenient than hiding in the ruins when you encounter danger.”
“In a Legendary Beast Tamer-level battle, Beast Tamers are basically in an ethereal state the whole time. Otherwise, Beast Tamers won’t be able to enter a battle of that level at all.”
“You have the Ruins Bead and can experience this power in advance. You won’t be at a disadvantage if you practice earlier. It’s considered a foundation for you to become a legendary Beast Tamer in the future!”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “Then, Senior Bai, you go do your errand first.”
This etherealization ability indeed needed to be trained. It was completely a life-saving skill.
“Well, that’s it then. By the way, for the other training facilities, if you’re doing this to increase the strength of your pet, I think you can put it aside for the time being. Anyway, you have the Ruins Bead. The training efficiency of the pet in other training facilities might not be as good as in the mystic realm space of the ruins.”
“The level of the training facilities with obvious effects is too low for you to enter. Those without obvious effects are inferior to the Ruins Bead… It’s a waste of time to go.”
Bai Xi clapped her hands and said, “But it all depends on your wishes. Well, I’ll leave first. I’ll contact you later to take you to the archeology department.”
With that said, Bai Xi entrusted Shi Yu to the manager, the granny, and left in a hurry.
“Little Bai Xi is the vice president of the battle club at Ancient Capital University. She’s preparing for the National League recently, so she might be a little busy.” The administrator, Granny, looked at White Xi’s departing figure and explained with a smile.
“How is it? Do you want to continue challenging?”
The granny didn’t ask about Shi Yu’s identity either, directly treating him as an ordinary student from Ancient Capital University.
“No, Granny, I plan to go back and study it carefully.”
“I’ll come another day. Thank you, Granny.” Shi Yu looked at the administrator, Granny, and said.
If this granny could be an administrator in such a place, she was probably at least a master-level Beast Tamer.
“Alright, then you guys should leave quickly. I’m going to continue playing games,” the granny said.
Shi Yu, Eleven:???
Why did Shi Yu suddenly feel that Ancient Capital University had no future…
…
Then, Shi Yu left the training facility with a stunned expression.
After coming out, Shi Yu shook his head and sighed.
“I feel like I have something to do.” He took out the time-limited trial card Bai Xi gave him and felt depressed.
During the half-month time limit, he could use that training facility to train his phantom transformation.
It would be a waste not to.
He should use it. He had to go and get beaten by transcendent creatures every day. It was so complicated.
“Forget it. Only by suffering can I be above others!” Shi Yu gritted his teeth and decided to fight it out.
Although he could also train his Etherialization in private, it definitely wouldn’t be as effective as the training in that urgent but safe environment.
“Wuu!”
On Shi Yu’s shoulder, Eleven felt that it made sense. Only by suffering could one be superior!
Eleven: o(一〈一+)o So, when can Shi Yu let it go back to training?
Shi Yu only trained hard himself, but he didn’t let Eleven work hard too. It was too evil of him!
Shi Yu :”…”
What was this competition?
It seemed like Eleven would never experience the joy of lazing around in this lifetime.
“It’s already noon.”
At the same time, Shi Yu glanced at the time and touched his stomach. He decided to have a meal and take a nap.
It was too tiring to etherealize.
After eating some supplements and waking up, he would decide where to go in the afternoon.
He had troubled himself this morning.
…
In the hotel.
After Shi Yu was full and allowed Eleven and the Green Silkworm to fulfill their wishes and enter the ruins to undergo special training, he started to hug his pillow and prepare to sleep.
However, it was as if the heavens didn’t want Shi Yu to rest well. The loud and clear electric sound immediately made Shi Yu get up.
“Who is it!”
Not many people knew his phone number.
Apart from the delivery men, there were only the three rich ladies, Hall Master Lin, and President Feng.
Good heavens, now that he thought about it, the proportion of rich women in his contact list seemed a little high…
Shi Yu looked at the caller ID guiltily and surprisingly discovered that it was actually Hall Master Lin.
“Eh…”
“Hall Master Lin?” Shi Yu picked up the phone.
On the other side, Hall Master Lin was silent for a moment before saying, “I heard you went to the ancient capital?”
Shi Yu: “Yes.”
Before he went to the ancient capital, he communicated with the members of the dojo and President Feng.
As for Hall Master Lin, when he set off, he seemed to still be on the snow mountain expedition.
“By the way, you’ve been to the snowy mountain recently, right? How’s the situation over there?”
“They’re just a group of wild beasts. They’re not worth mentioning. Commander Wang Meng and I have already cleared the periphery of the snow mountain. The situation is already within control,” Lin Hongnian said. “I heard that you cracked that trial ruin?”
“After I came out, Old Feng had already told me everything.”
Back then, he did suggest that Shi Yu could go there to train, but he completely didn’t expect Shi Yu to be able to break through the sixth level and grow so quickly.
Eleven had just started learning the Thunder Palm when he decided to go to the snow mountain for the expedition…
However, after he came out of the snowy mountain, he heard ridiculous information from President Feng.
A combination skill of expert level Thunder Palm and expert level Hardening?
A little metal-eating beast that mastered expert-level deterrence?
The Iron Eater suspected to have awakened an ancient bloodline after coming out of the sacred lake?
The sixth level of the ruins was the Ice Dragon Phantom? Shi Yu even defeated it?
After hearing this, Lin Hongnian suspected that he was still in the snow mountain and hadn’t come out. Some snow maiden in the snow mountain had cast an illusion on him.
In short, President Feng’s story was ridiculous.
It was as if he had been out for several years.
However, this was not important. After all, Shi Yu was introduced by Lu Qingyi, a genius who had reached the master level in his early twenties.
With Lu Qingyi’s help, it was normal for Shi Yu to be a little ridiculous.
Lin Hongnian was most concerned about the evolution holy spring and the ancient bloodline of the iron-eating beast.
He originally wanted to look for Shi Yu personally to ask, but Shi Yu was no longer in Ping Cheng, so he could only give Shi Yu a call.
“I heard that your Iron-eating Beast gained something from the Evolution Sacred Spring. It seems to have awakened some ancient bloodline?” Lin Hongnian asked with a heavy tone.
“Can you tell me about it?”
On the other end of the line, Shi Yu fell silent for a moment before saying, “I think that should be an ancient bloodline. It might be what the iron-eating beasts looked like thousands or even tens of thousands of years ago.”
“Actually, the form isn’t much different from now. It’s like an Iron-eating Beast wearing a set of armor, but it doesn’t feel like it’s as simple as a transcendent Level Hardening skill.”
The transcendent Level Hardening symbol was that the Hardening Material could be released to form weapons and equipment. In addition, it could also attach the Hardening Material to other objects.
At the moment, only Master Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast in Icefield City had reached this proficiency.
Logically speaking, one could create an armor suit with Perfect Level Hardening. However, the feeling that his bloodline awakening gave Eleven at that time was not as simple as Hardening. It was indeed a completely new life form.
“Battle armor…” Lin Hongnian fell into deep thought.
“It’s possible to form battle armor with transcendent hardening, but if you don’t think so… Then is it possible that transcendent hardening is one of the evolution conditions for the iron-eating beast?” Hall Master Lin guessed.
“It means that using transcendent Level Hardening to form a similar weapon and then stabilizing this form in a certain way… Is the evolution method of the iron-eating beast?” Shi Yu said. “Isn’t it a little too perfunctory…”
If that was the case, even if the evolved Hardening skill could still be added to armor and become double Hardening, it didn’t feel like there was any future.
A commander rank was the limit, in this scenario.
“It’s just a guess.” Lin Hongnian also felt that it was too simple. He couldn’t help but laugh and leave it at that.
“However, in short, it’s an experimental direction.”
“By the way, did any other changes happen after your Iron-eating Beast awakened its ancient bloodline?”
“Apart from having a better physique and slower growth, there are no other changes.”
Ordinary iron-eating beasts that had reached level nine of awakening should be a little taller than Eleven, but Eleven was a little short.
However, compared to the ancient bloodline, Shi Yu felt that it should be because the evolution holy spring had strengthened Eleven’s life force.
“I see…” Lin Hongnian was silent. Unfortunately, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had only awakened a weak ancient bloodline. If only it had evolved directly…
This way, he might be able to study the evolution path of the iron-eating beasts more clearly.
At this moment, Hall Master Lin said again, “You’re going to the Ancient Capital this time, probably to take a look at the Ancient Capital University, right?”
“Yes.”
“When are you free? I’ll get Xiu Zhu to look for you. She’s also at Ancient Capital University.”
“Huh??” Shi Yu was stunned and did not react.
“Xiu Zhu is a student from the Ancient University’s Feeding Department. He’s also been over there for the past month. You’ll be interested in the research project she’s researching, for sure.”
“What?”
“A ruin related to the iron-eating beasts was discovered in the ancient capital. Currently, students from the Archaeology Department of the Ancient Capital University are researching it.”
“Because the main research topic of hers is the Iron-eating Beast, she was invited by the teacher to be a consultant.”
“At first, I didn’t pay attention to this news. After all, it’s just a ruin related to the iron-eating beasts. But after hearing that the iron-eating beasts have ancient bloodlines, my thoughts changed. Perhaps the ancient iron-eating beasts really are special.”
“I think you need to go.”
Iron-eating beast ruins had appeared in the ancient capital, and there were suspected to be traces of ancient iron-eating beasts.
Initially, Lin Hongnian didn’t mind, but after Shi Yu discovered that the iron-eating beast’s evolution path was ancient, the ancient iron-eating beast information immediately had value for reference.
In addition, Shi Yu had cracked the Ping Cheng Ruins and was related to the archeological world’s new star, Lu Qingyi. Moreover, his Iron-eating Beast had awakened its ancient bloodline. Therefore, no matter how he looked at it, Hall Master Lin felt that Shi Yu had to investigate this Iron-eating Beast Ruin.
“Are you free to go? I can get Xiu Zhu to pick you up over there.”
“It’s a pity that I still have something to do. Otherwise, I would definitely have gone along.”
Lin Hongnian’s mood was good. This was the first time he felt so close to discovering the evolution of the Iron-Eating Beast!
The dream of this father and daughter was to unearth the possibility of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.
Everyone in Ping Cheng knew this, and so did Shi Yu.
“It shouldn’t be a problem.” Shi Yu nodded with a surprised expression.
The evolution direction of the iron-eating beast? He was also confused. Now that a ruin related to the iron-eating beast had appeared, it was indeed worth looking at. Moreover, it happened to be in the ancient capital. How could he miss it?
“You just said that the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University is in charge of this ruin?” Shi Yu had a strange expression.
If he also entered the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University, would these people be considered future seniors?
Lin Hongnian said, “Well, they should be considered juniors of Xiu Zhu. After all, it’s just a small ruin related to the Iron Eater and not a ruin space. Not many people take it seriously.”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “By the way, Senior Lin also participated in the vocation assessment at the Ancient Capital Association, right? Hall Master Lin, how were her results at that time?”
Only after coming to Ancient Capital University did Shi Yu realize how intense the competition here was.
Senior Panda was able to pass the vocation assessment here at the age of 18 and was even accepted by Ancient Capital University. It felt very strong.
“Her?” Hall Master Lin said, “When she participated in the vocation assessment, the Iron-eating Beast was just a beginner transcendent. It mastered the combination skill of proficient level Thunder Palm and expert level Hardening.”
“Apart from that, there’s also another transcendent creature with pretty good strength contracted.”
“However, there’s no point in using her as a reference. She participated in the assessment a few years ago. The difficulty of the vocation assessment is increasing every year.”
“But don’t worry. You’re stronger than her. The vocation assessment isn’t a big problem for you.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Why did he feel that he was the real son of Hall Master Lin? When it came to Lin Xiuzhu, Hall Master Lin only treated him like this, not his daughter. When it came to him, he clearly didn’t have a transcendent pet, but this mister directly appointed him stronger than Lin Xiuzhu.
He felt like Panda Senior would cry when she heard this…

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - Ancient Inscription
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Ancient Inscription
“Achoo!”
In the mountains outside the suburbs of Ancient Capital.
A woman in a black and white exploration suit subconsciously sneezed and shook her head hard. She kept feeling that someone was talking about her behind her back!
“Sister Xiuzhu, did you catch a cold?”
“We’re enough here. Why don’t you go and rest for a while?”
Not far from the woman, a short-haired woman in a brown archeological suit said beside a stone wall of a ruin.
“Why would I? I’m fine skiing in my hometown’s snow mountain. No problem,” Lin Xiuzhu replied with a smile.
“That’s true.”
The short-haired woman patted her head. Everyone was a professional Beast Tamer now. Although it was a little cold here, it shouldn’t affect them at all.
This was the ruins of the iron-eating beast.
Currently, there were a total of eight archeological teams investigating this ruin.
There were five men and three women. Seven of them were students from the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University. As for Lin Xiuzhu, she was a researcher of the Iron-eating Beast and had been invited here to assist in the investigation.
Everyone had already investigated this ruin for a period of time. The collection and sorting of some ancient tools, stone carvings, and other ancient artifacts had already been completed, but there was still a lot of special information at the scene that couldn’t be deciphered.
The ultimate goal of archeology was to restore the true history of that time. At the moment, these people clearly had yet to investigate the meaning behind this ruin.
Lin Xiuzhu looked at the archeological student who was investigating and fishing at the same time and sighed.
The only known information was that this was the ruins of a tribe that worshiped iron-eating beasts in the ancient times. There was nothing here at all.
Initially, she thought that she could find new discoveries related to the iron-eating beasts. It seemed that she was overthinking…
“Pops?”
Just as Lin Xiuzhu felt helpless, her cell phone suddenly rang.
After seeing the contact, her expression relaxed.
Dad came back from the snow mountain?
Hmph, this old man must have called immediately when he realized that she was still not at home because he missed her too much!
“Hello…”
Lin Xiuzhu left the site and picked up the phone. Lin Hongnian’s voice immediately came from the other side.
“Xiu Zhu, are you still investigating the iron-eating beast ruins with those juniors?”
“Yeah.”
“How’s the progress?”
“There’s no substantial progress, but I heard that the teacher from the archeology department will come to guide the scene in two days. There might be a breakthrough.”
“Father, aren’t you not very concerned about this ruin? Why are you suddenly asking about this?” Lin Xiuzhu curled his lips.
Back then, when her teacher informed her that the Iron-eating Beast Ruins had appeared in the ancient capital and invited her to assist in the research, Lin Hongnian was unhappy.
What was there to research about a broken ruin? Living in the past, it was better to train pets and pursue new breakthroughs.
The ancient people’s understanding of iron-eating beasts might not necessarily be stronger than that of modern Beast Tamers.
“Hehehe…” Lin Hongnian let out an awkward laugh. However, how could he have known that the Iron-eating Beasts actually had the so-called ancient bloodline? There were already traces of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution in ancient times. This was really a slap in the face.
“The situation is different. Xiu Zhu, Shi Yu is also in the Ancient Capital now. I’ve already contacted him. Next, contact him again and get him to assist you in investigating this ruin.”
“Ah, why?” Lin Xiuzhu was stunned. Shi Yu?
What did Shi Yu have to do with this Iron-eating Beast Ruin?
“During the time that you weren’t in Ping Cheng, Shi Yu had already cracked the ruin that appeared in Ping Cheng. Because of some opportunities, his Iron-eating Beast even awakened an ancient bloodline through the evolution holy spring in Icefield City and captured the traces of evolution.”
“This is also why I suddenly value the iron-eating beast ruins you mentioned previously. In short, if you haven’t made any progress, perhaps you can invite Shi Yu to give it a try.”
“What!!!”
As Lin Hongnian finished speaking, Lin Xiuzhu couldn’t help but shout.
This shout immediately made the others in the archeological team look at them in confusion.
What’s wrong with Senior Panda?
Could it be that they had not investigated anything new for too long, causing Senior Panda to completely collapse?
“Yes, I understand. I’ll contact him now!”
After Lin Hongnian explained it clearly, Lin Xiuzhu’s eyes flickered, and her whole body glowed with vitality again.
After hanging up, she looked at the juniors who were trying their best to slack off and said,
“Everyone, there’s new progress.”
“I just received information from my father that the iron-eating beasts had an evolution form in ancient times. Next, we might be able to investigate in this direction!!”
“He hired someone to assist us in our research. He can rush over later.”
“Really?!” When Lin Xiuzhu finished speaking, the group of archeology students were stunned, and then they revealed looks of joy.
They naturally knew who Lin Xiuzhu’s father was. After all, he was a slightly famous master-level Beast Tamer.
Since it was information from Hall Master Lin, there must be some basis.
“Senior, when is the expert you mentioned arriving? Do you need us to meet him?”
Everyone was looking forward to it. Although this was just a small ruin and didn’t seem to have any important information, if they could decipher the ancient evolution form of a pet, it would be a pretty good harvest. They estimated that they could earn a lot of credits.
“Wait a minute, I’ll give him a call.”
“Plus, I’m not sure if he is an expert anymore…”
…
After speaking to Hall Master Lin, Shi Yu was no longer sleepy.
He couldn’t fall asleep at all, thinking about the so-called ancient Iron-eating Beast ruins.
A moment later, he received a call from Lin Xiuzhu.
“No need. Tell me the address. I’ll take a taxi there.”
Shi Yu could not help but find it funny when he heard the anticipation, nervousness, and anxiety in her voice.
He immediately imagined the helpless image of Panda senior standing outside the ruins.
“Alright, I’ll remember the address.”
Shi Yu quickly confirmed the address of the ancient Iron-eating Beast Ruins with Lin Xiuzhu and started packing.
At the same time, he didn’t forget the most important thing…
“Eleven!”
Shi Yu chuckled and pulled Eleven out of the space.
Eleven: o(≧口≦)o
It seemed to say, “What now?”
“Uh, how should I put it? Dig… no, look at the ruins of your ancestors? Together?!”
Eleven:???
Eleven was stunned before being tricked by Shi Yu.
The ruins weren’t that far away.
In less than two hours, Shi Yu arrived outside the mountain range of the suburbs of Ancient Capital.
After Shi Yu arrived at his destination, the group of students from Ancient Capital University had already come to welcome Shi Yu under Lin Xiuzhu’s lead at the entrance of the mountain.
“He’s here!”
As Lin Xiuzhu saw Shi Yu’s figure, she was pleasantly surprised. The group of archeology students also sized up Shi Yu.
Just now, they had already gotten a rough understanding of Shi Yu from Lin Xiuzhu.
He was from the same hometown as Lin Xiuzhu. He had an Iron-eating Beast that had awakened an ancient bloodline. He had also participated in the cracking of ruins!
However, he was a young Beast Tamer and not an expert.
This kind of information basically meant that they could only see what valuable information Shi Yu could provide next. The investigation work still had to be handed to them.
“Sorry to have kept you waiting.” Shi Yu took a few steps and came in front of the group.
At the same time, he sized up the others other than Senior Panda and immediately felt a sense of closeness.
Good lord, this group of people exuded a sense of peers from their spiritual aura. They didn’t have any vitality at all. They felt very old.
“No, no,” the students from Ancient Capital University said.
“It’s been hard on you,” said the panda senior. Then, she was quickly stunned.
Eleven, who suddenly noticed the hopeless expression on Shi Yu’s shoulder, was stunned.
“This…???”
“Wuu!” Eleven greeted Big Sister Xiu Zhu.
“Eleven???” Lin Xiuzhu was shocked. What happened? Why did Eleven become so small!!
“Eh, that’s an Iron-eating Beast?”
The others also looked at the little Iron-eating Beast on Shi Yu’s shoulder and couldn’t help but be slightly stunned.
This…
It didn’t look like a cub, but a doll. What was going on?
“It’s nothing. I taught it the multiplication skill. At the moment, it’s just shrunken,” Shi Yu said.
“Iron-eating beasts can learn multiplication?” As Shi Yu spoke, the other archeologists were immediately surprised.
Recently, because they were researching the iron-eating beast ruins, they naturally did a lot of homework on the iron-eating beasts.
Apart from some basic information about the iron-eating beasts, they also understood all the skills of other races that Iron-eating beasts could learn.
For example, the Iron-eating Beasts of Bamboo Stone Dojo were famous for being able to learn “Thunder Palm” and “Cannon Fist”.
For example, a master’s Iron-eating Beast was famous for being able to learn “Metal Shock”. This was a metal-element sound wave skill that could make the body make metal noises at all times.
Apart from that, there were other unorthodox cultivation methods.
In short, their investigation of the iron-eating beasts should be considered comprehensive, but this was the first time they had heard of an iron-eating beast that could multiply.
“Is it because you’ve awakened an ancient bloodline??” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
“That’s indeed a possibility. The size of ancient iron-eating beasts is much larger than now.” Shi Yu nodded.
Eleven closed its eyes and fell into deep thought. Didn’t Shi Yu teach it how to multiply it with his cheat hand?
However, Shi Yu didn’t let it talk nonsense about this, so Eleven obediently shut up and pretended not to know anything.
The panda was playing dumb.
“Can you take me to see the ruins first?” Shi Yu asked.
“Alright.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded. The others also nodded.
Then, everyone started to walk towards the ruins of the mountain.
During this process, Shi Yu kept asking them about the ruins.
“Has the era of the ruins been confirmed?”
“About 4400 to 4,500 years ago,” said an archeologist.
Shi Yu nodded. This time was very delicate. It was one of the more serious periods in the history of this world.
“The main target of the current investigation is?”
“There’s a batch of artificial products, but they’re basically daily necessities.”
“Apart from that, I also found a relatively well-preserved metal fragment. After the initial complete appearance, it’s suspected to be a battle armor fragment from ancient battles.”
“The ones that carry the most information are the murals on the stone walls of the ruins and some strange symbols. However, these symbols aren’t like any of the ancient words known to date. They don’t match the popular words about 4,500 years ago at all. By the way, there are similar symbols on that metal piece.”
When the other party finished speaking, Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He said with a slightly expectant expression.
“Please bring me to see that armor fragment first.”
“Ah, alright.”
A few of them looked at Shi Yu who had just arrived strangely. This little brother was rather comfortable with them? He seemed to be even more interested in the Iron-Eating Beast Ruins than them!
Soon, Shi Yu followed them to the archeological camp established outside the ruins.
As they entered the tent, Shi Yu saw that the armor fragment they were talking about was actually a palm-sized metal piece.
In the glass container, the metal piece was lying quietly.
There was indeed a strange symbol on the metal piece.
“This symbol…”
Under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu stared intently at the symbol.
Then, as if he had triggered some memory, huge waves rose in his heart.
Holy shit.
Shi Yu was shocked and immediately dumbfounded. He had completely recalled it.
Because he had seen this symbol before.
On Earth, the same symbol was recorded in the unpopular Mythical system that he and his teacher studied!

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - Archeology Ruined My Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Archeology Ruined My Life
The moment he saw this special symbol, Shi Yu made many connections. His feelings were especially complicated.
At this moment, he even started to suspect that his transmigration was not an accident.
However, what made Shi Yu feel the most complicated was not these messy things.
Instead, it was the fact that regardless of his previous life or current life, he didn’t know what this symbol represented…
What a scam!
Shi Yu thought to himself that this was such a trap. If this symbol could be changed to Chinese, English, and Japanese, this would definitely be a fatal blow. Unfortunately, it wasn’t.
Therefore, at this moment, Shi Yu did not feel any nostalgia or familiarity, and was not touched in the slightest.
In addition, it was still unknown whether this symbol originated from Earth or this world.
Shi Yu tried to use his telepathy [Voice of History] talent to try and see if he could discover anything else.
Unfortunately, the opportunity didn’t come.
“Did you find anything?”
Lin Xiuzhu asked when he saw Shi Yu staring at the metal piece in a daze.
“Yes.”
Shi Yu looked away and said the explosive news.
“This might be a fragment of an ancient iron-eating beast.”
“What?” Everyone was confused.
Fragments of ancient iron-eating beasts? What did that mean?
They looked at Shi Yu in confusion, unable to understand how the armor fragment was related to the Iron-eating Beast.
“Because the evolved form of the iron-eating beast might be wearing such a layer of armor.”
“No, it’s not a layer of armor, but the two are one,” Shi Yu said.
He definitely couldn’t say that he had seen this symbol. Even if he did, he didn’t know what the symbol meant at all. It was meaningless.
However, apart from this discovery, Shi Yu also discovered something else. That was the color material of the metal piece. It felt like it was similar to the evolution traces in the iron-eating beast bloodline.
“Are you serious?” Lin Xiuzhu looked at Shi Yu with a stunned expression.
“The iron-eating beast evolved into a battle armor??”
“That should be the case…” Shi Yu looked at the archeology students and said,” Has the composition of this metal piece been tested? ”
“Not yet…” An archeology student said,” This might need to be used in the school’s laboratory, and the detection is relatively troublesome. It will take a long time. ”
This alloy that contained extraordinary metal resources was far more difficult to detect than the ordinary alloys on Earth. At the moment, research had yet to reach this stage.
“It’s alright. Next, please test its specific composition.”
“If the metal element contained in it can be detected, it might be an important part of solving the mystery of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.”
Shi Yu looked at the metal piece. Perhaps the Iron-eating Beast needed to eat similar metal materials to complete its evolution?
This metal piece was a huge discovery.
“Little Lin, contact the school.” Lin Xiuzhu looked at the short-haired girl in a brown archeological suit.
“Yes.” Little Lin nodded.
Lin Xiuzhu quickly understood Shi Yu’s meaning. After all, she was also an expert in iron-eating beasts.
“You want to use the composition of this metal piece to deduce the evolution materials of the iron-eating beast?” she asked.
“Yes, but it shouldn’t be that simple.” Shi Yu nodded.
“I don’t think it can complete evolution just by eating… I’m not sure what that symbol means.”
At this moment, when he heard the word “eat”, Eleven woke up in a daze and looked at the metal piece in the glass container with bright eyes.
“Huh?”
Food?
“No!” Shi Yu denied.
“Please take me to see other ancient artifacts and the ruins outside,” Shi Yu continued.
“Oh, oh, I’ll bring you there,” the archeologist who explained the basic information of the ruins to Shi Yu at the start said.
In the blink of an eye, after Shi Yu issued a mission to everyone, he rushed to the next location.
In the tent.
The other archeology students looked at the metal piece in the glass container and fell into deep thought.
Wait a minute, why did it feel like they were being led away by the new arrival, Shi Yu?
Shouldn’t it be Shi Yu who provided the information so that they could continue their investigation?
Why did it feel like Shi Yu was more concerned than them!
“I’ll contact the school first,” Little Lin said. Forget it, forget it. Let’s do it according to what Ji Yu said first. The metal piece was suspected to be a part of the iron-eating beast’s evolution form. It was indeed a bold guess that they had never imagined before.
…..
This iron-eating beast ruin was actually an underground ruin, and its integrity was not very high.
Shi Yu could only do a live investigation. However, it was more convenient that these people had already restored and organized some information.
“There are only pictures of ordinary iron-eating beasts in the murals, but no images of iron-eating beasts in battle armor??”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned after flipping through the information that had been organized.
Why?
Shi Yu decided not to think about the information that he could not confirm for the time being.
Then, he started to browse the special symbols recorded in those ruins.
Including the symbols on the metal piece, there were only nine special symbols added together.
However, because of the large number of repetitions, it looked a little more.
Six of the nine symbols looked familiar. He had definitely seen them on Earth.
As for the other three, they were a little unfamiliar, but from the style, these nine symbols were definitely a combination.
If that metal piece was really a part of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution, was there any special meaning for such a symbol to be engraved and branded on the armor?
“Senior…”
Shi Yu studied it deeply and even kept trying to use his talent to see if he could see any scenes in his head.
However, he didn’t see the scene. Instead, he vaguely saw the panda senior.
Lin Xiuzhu had come to Shi Yu’s side at some point in time.
“I didn’t expect you to care so much about this ruin.” Lin Xiuzhu looked at the focused Shi Yu and couldn’t help but smile.
Previously, everyone thought that Shi Yu was here to provide information. However, who knew that after Shi Yu arrived, he was even more enthusiastic in researching ruins than these archeology students.
“Do you also want to understand the evolution path of the iron-eating beast?” asked the panda senior.
