“I…” Shi Yu said,” Sort of. ”
In fact, he didn’t have much of an obsession with the iron-eating beast’s evolution. The reason why he was so concerned now was purely because he was curious.
He was curious about what this ruin represented and why there were symbols similar to those in a certain mythical system on Earth.
If he didn’t figure this out, Shi Yu felt that he wouldn’t be able to sleep well.
“Senior, you also want to know, right?” Shi Yu asked. One was Hall Master Lin Hongnian, while the other was Lin Xiuzhu. He felt that there was no one in Ping Cheng who wanted to know the evolution path of the iron-eating beast more than the two of them.
Lin Xiuzhu had a conflicted expression.
“Indeed, but after hearing you say that the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution might be after wearing battle armor, I…”
“I feel that if that’s the case, I won’t be able to sleep on the panda bed in the future… It’s a pity.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Good heavens, he was actually conflicted about the same reason as her!
Was this his soul mate or something?!
As expected, different pandas, same usage.
“Wuu!” Eleven let out a protest on Shi Yu’s thigh.
It had been hours since it last trained. It felt uncomfortable all over.
It had slept for several hours consecutively to accumulate physical strength, and now it urgently needed high-intensity training to release it.
No, it would be best if it was a battle!
“What’s wrong? Eleven can’t help but want to train again?” Lin Xiuzhu smiled. She knew Eleven very well.
Eleven: QAQ
“I actually came over to say that it’s getting late. Thanks to the news you brought, everyone has a new research direction. They want to invite you to have a meal together,” Lin Xiuzhu said.
Eat?
“Uh.” Shi Yu glanced at the time. It seemed to be getting late.
He clearly felt that it was time for dinner again after lunch.
“Of course…” Shi Yu rubbed his stomach.
Well, he couldn’t continue researching even if he was hungry. Food was more important.
Then, Shi Yu stopped thinking and touched Eleven at the same time. “Let’s go for a meal. After eating, I’ll let you train.”
In fact, he had wanted to let Eleven train for a long time, but this was the ruins of an Iron-eating Beast after all. He felt that if he carried Eleven with him, there might be a magical buff.
But now, it seemed that Eleven, this mascot, was a little weak in that aspect…
Eleven: (σ`?д?)σ “Then I’ll accompany you for a while more.”
Outside, when Shi Yu followed Lin Xiuzhu out, the other seven people were already waiting.
Everyone prepared to eat at the hotel at the foot of the mountain. As for this place, they would leave it to the pets to watch over.
If contracting a pet was not for the convenience of slacking off, it would be meaningless.
…
Dinner gathering was a very good way to communicate. Initially, Shi Yu wasn’t very familiar with everyone, but once he arrived at the dining table, he immediately communicated.
“What, you plan to apply to the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University in the future?”
As everyone chatted, they talked about Shi Yu. Then, everyone finally understood why Shi Yu could be so focused in the afternoon.
So he was a future classmate, a junior with a clear goal.
“This faculty is a huge pit. Archeology ruins one’s life. Have you heard of it?”
Zheng Yingjie, the archeologist who often took the initiative to answer Shi Yu’s questions, said with a look of grief. He was the leader of this archeological team.
The other archeology students also nodded. Lin Xiuzhu wanted to laugh but didn’t dare to.
“Ah? So tragic?”
“If you don’t like it, why did you apply for this department…”
Shi Yu drank a mouthful of soup to calm himself down. He wanted to hear the suggestion of these seniors.
Lin Yu’er, who had the same surname as Panda, said, “Probably wasn’t in my right mind?”
In fact, although the ultimate goal of archeology was to restore the truth of history, how many young people had such high thoughts?
Archeology was popular in this world because there were many secrets hidden in the ancient ruins, and even opportunities from the Mythical Era.
Because some lucky people obtained opportunities from these ruins and quickly rose, this industry immediately attracted many people who thought they were children of destiny.
There were very few people who really wanted to restore history to the truth.
Most people entered this industry hoping to get some benefits from the ancient ruins.
In addition, the Archeology Department was indeed the trump card specialization of Ancient Capital University. Its resource allocation was even higher than the Combat Department, so many people immediately applied for it on impulse.
However, after learning this specialization, they realized how difficult it was. How could ruins with opportunities be so easy to find?
Most of the time, they could only stare at the pile of antiques in a daze and learn some skills and knowledge that were useless in battle…
Because of this, although there were a lot of applicants to the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University every year, the number of subsequent transfers to specializations was also very large…
“The Feeding Department is actually very good. It’s also very relaxed and comfortable. The Medical Care Department is also not bad. There are many young sisters. Although it’s a little tiring for the Combat Department and we have to train every day, strength is the capital of the Beast Tamer. In the future, if we can represent the school to participate in the national competition, that would be considered to have made it big. After all, it’s a competition that’s the focus of everyone in the country… No matter what, it’s better than the archeology department that deals with antiques and ancient tombs,” a fat student sighed.
The others also expressed their views separately, indicating that they regretted applying to the Archeology Department.
For these few people to successfully enter the ace specialization of Ancient Capital University, they must be very talented. Every single one of them was probably a professional Beast Tamer who became a Beast Tamer before 20 years old. However, it was just such a bunch of geniuses. At this moment, there was only regret in their hearts, extreme regret!
When Shi Yu heard that, he was immediately stunned. Good heavens, they were all guys who were unhappy with their profession.
Were archeology departments really that lousy?
“But in my experience…” Lin Xiuzhu said silently,” This state of yours is too common. Actually, the students from the Combat, Feed, Research, and Medical Departments who applied also feel that their specializations are not good…”
To put it bluntly, in essence, it was just liking the new and hating the old.
Lin Xiuzhu cursed in his heart. If you guys had been more serious when investigating the ruins, the research progress wouldn’t have been so slow!
During the investigation of the ruins, this group of people had to spend half the time lazing around and training their pets. Their professionalism was not very good!
Lin Xiuzhu felt that if she was a teacher, she would definitely let them fail the subject.
“In any case, if I’m given another chance, I’ll definitely choose the right battle department!” Zheng Yingjie sighed and said, “Let’s see if there’s a chance to change specializations in the future.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Archeology was a tough profession.
If he didn’t like it at all, it was normal for him to not be able to hold on.
“But I feel that if we find something from this ruins investigation, maybe we can stay in the Archeology Department?” A long-faced senior analyzed.
“Let’s follow Junior Brother Shi Yu’s train of thought first. Perhaps we might really gain something,” said Lin Yu’er.
Zheng Yingjie nodded. “If we can really cooperate with Senior Lin to research the evolution of the Iron-Eating Beast, I feel that our university career is stable. We can even use this for our graduation research.”
Listening to the discussion of the crowd, Shi Yu immediately overturned his views on the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University.
He named the archeological team led by Zheng Yingjie “Archeological Seven Elites”.
“In short, I have to thank Junior Shi Yu this time. Haha.” Zheng Yingjie smiled and said, “When you come to Ancient Capital University in the future, we’ll look after you.”
Without the evolutionary information provided by Shi Yu, it was really difficult for them to carry out subsequent research.
“Thank you…” Shi Yu felt that it was unreliable.
He felt that although this group of people was the cream of the crop in dozens of second-tier cities around Ancient Capital, super geniuses,
But in Ancient Capital University, each of them would probably be a classic bad=grades student…
He felt that there was no future for him to cozy up to them after school, so he might as well cozy up to the beast-eared girl.
It was obvious that the vice president of the battle club was an influential figure in school.
“Junior, when do you plan to apply for the next year of the Ancient Capital University?” the chubby senior asked.
“I heard from Senior Lin that that Iron-eating Beast is your initial pet, but I think its growth level hasn’t reached transcendent?”
“No, I plan to participate in the vocation assessment this year.”
“There are still four months. It should be on time. Although its growth level is slightly low, its combat power is alright,” Shi Yu explained.
The fat senior was stunned. “You’re confident, pretty good! Speaking of which, what’s the difference between an Iron-eating Beast that has awakened an ancient bloodline and an ordinary Iron-eating Beast? The difference is only in the multiplication skill??”
“I’m a hundred million points curious. How about it? Do you want to have a friendly spar after dinner? I also have a new pet that hasn’t reached the transcendent level here. At the same time, let us understand the information of iron-eating beasts with ancient bloodlines. This way, we can also write more information in our homework…”
“Huh.” Fatty’s words stunned the surrounding archeology students. Oh right, this fatty was smart. He knew not to let go of any possible information for his university homework.
Shi Yu’s Little-Eating Iron Beast that had awakened an ancient bloodline was the entry point for the subsequent research of this ruin. It was definitely not wrong to want to understand it.
“Battle?” Lin Xiuzhu curled his lips and said, “Why do I feel that you want to bully your junior?”
A new pet cultivated by a professional Beast Tamer and a trainee Beast Tamer’s pet. Although they were at the same level, the cultivation level would definitely be completely different!
The fat senior had an innocent expression and said, “No, I purely want to perfect my homework. If my homework doesn’t meet the requirements, I’m going to fail this year… I’ll also guide my junior. The vocation assessment is very difficult now. I’ve been through this before.”
“Huh?” Before Shi Yu could say anything, Eleven suddenly stuck its head out of Shi Yu’s pocket.
It sensed the aura of battle.
Shi Yu looked down and was immediately speechless.
“It’s fine, it’s fine.” Shi Yu could only say, “My Iron-eating Beast has also slept for the whole day. I just want to move around. It’s not a problem to spar with senior later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - The Beginning of the Iron-eating Beasts Increase in Value
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: The Beginning of the Iron-eating Beast’s Increase in Value
“Look, even Junior doesn’t have any objections!”
The fat senior’s name was Wang Le, and he was also an unlucky fellow who had accidentally entered the archeology department.
After choosing this faculty, he realized that he didn’t like it at all.
Beast Tamers from other faculties only needed to train their pets. They also had to learn various archeological knowledge and use various instruments. It was simply troublesome.
He never thought that he would have to face the threat of failing his subjects after entering university… He originally thought that it would be heaven after entering university, but who knew that it was the beginning of pain.
“There seems to be a battlefield on the way here,” Wang Le said.
A big city was a big city. Even if it was just the suburbs, battlefields were still everywhere.
“Wu wu wu.”
At this moment, Eleven had already climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder in anticipation and looked at Senior Wang Le.
“Then let’s fight.”
When the other seniors saw that the cute little Iron-eating Beast was restless, they also smiled and cheered on. They wanted to see what was so extraordinary about the Iron-eating Beast that had awakened an ancient bloodline.
At the side, Lin Xiuzhu was speechless.
Forget it, since Shi Yu has agreed, it was fine as long as they were happy.
Since Shi Yu could conquer the ruins of Ping Cheng, his strength should not be weak… He wouldn’t lose too badly.
It was obvious that the panda senior still didn’t know the difficulty of the next few stages in the Ping Cheng Ruins. Otherwise, she definitely wouldn’t be worried about Shi Yu…
…
At this moment, everyone was almost done eating. After dinner, it was time to relax.
Because they had a target, everyone started to head towards the battlefield.
“Wang Le, I think you should let your junior not use his Beast Taming Talent during the battle later,” Zheng Yingjie said.
Apart from the difference in pet cultivation, the greatest difference in battle power between high-level and low-level Beast Tamers was the development of Beast Taming Talent.
It wasn’t impossible for a high-level Beast Tamer who had the talent to strengthen and develop a perfect Beast Tamer to use his talent to increase the battle power of an Awakening Stage pet by several times.
Fatty Wang Le had clearly been a professional Beast Tamer for a while. His development and use of his Beast Taming Talent was definitely not something a newbie like Shi Yu could compare to.
“It’s alright, it’s alright,” Shi Yu said. “It’s fine as long as it’s a normal battle. My Iron-eating Beast’s strength isn’t weak.”
“Senior, if you underestimate us, be careful.”
Shi Yu had no intention of taking advantage of the situation. Firstly, he believed that Eleven wouldn’t lose to a pet of the same level. Secondly, he didn’t think it was necessary. After all, it wasn’t an important battle. Even if he lost, he would treat it as increasing his horizons and accumulating experience.
Be careful?
At that moment, when he heard Shi Yu’s words, Wang chuckled.
How was that possible? If he could fail in a battle with a newbie, he would directly retire on the spot.
The other seniors also smiled, thinking that Shi Yu clearly still didn’t know the difference between a high-level Beast Tamer and a low-level Beast Tamer.
“Don’t worry, I know what to do,” Wang Le said.
In a short while, the nine of them arrived at the nearby battlefield. There were really quite a lot of people here.
However, judging from their age, most of them were high school students. They had already entered the holidays, and many Beast Tamers liked to pile up on the battlefield to kill time and train themselves.
The renting of the battlefield area was very smooth. The venue also sent a judge. Although Wang Le and the others felt that there was no need to use any judge, this was an inevitable process.
“It’s actually a top student from Ancient Capital University. Why is he here to battle?” At this moment, the judge was still puzzled. Logically speaking, even he himself couldn’t defeat a student from Ancient Capital University. This judge was really feeling some pressure.
“Don’t worry, Brother. With us watching, there won’t be a problem. We’ll just borrow the venue,” said the head of the Archeological Seven Elites, Little Zheng.
Apart from Shi Yu, the nine of them were all professional Beast Tamers. Moreover, they weren’t ordinary beginner-level Beast Tamers. A battle in the Awakening Stage was completely trivial.
“Then I’ll leave it to you.” The judge smiled awkwardly.
At this moment, after renting the venue, the main owner, Wang Yue, and Shi Yu, arrived at the two sides of the venue. The others were watching from the periphery and even prepared to record the battle process. After all, these were precious homework materials.
The judge was in the middle. He looked at Wang Yue and Shi Yu on both sides. After moistening his throat, he said, “The rule is 1VS1 Singles Battle.”
“Then, please send out your pets at the same time. Listen to my command and start the battle!”
As the judge finished speaking, Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, jumped down eagerly. It had never stayed in the Beast Taming Space, so it saved the summoning segment.
After clumsily walking onto the arena, Eleven’s heart surged. It could finally exercise…
“Rock Rhino!”
It saved Shi Yu a lot of trouble. As for Senior Wang Le, he still had to summon it.
“Roar!!!!”
As the wind howled, the countless light dots in front of Senior Wang Le instantly connected into a huge summoning array that looked like a star map.
A shocked roar came from the array at the same time, attracting the attention of passers-by.
“White Summoning Diagram, Intermediate Beast Tamer!” At this moment, passers-by were immediately attracted by the situation here and were shocked.
Professional Beast Tamers were divided into primary, intermediate, and advanced levels. Just like the transparent texture of the summoning array that the Beast Tamer connected to the Beast Taming Space, the Beast Tamer’s summoning array was also divided into different colors: gray, white, and green.
Therefore, when passers-by saw the color texture of the summoning array on Wang Le’s side, they immediately deduced that the level of his Beast Taming Space was at least level three, and it could also be an intermediate-level Beast Tamer!
Rock Rhino!
As for the pet Wang Le sent, it was also very strong.
It was brown all over, like a giant rhinoceros standing on two feet. It was more than two meters tall. Be it its body, limbs, or huge tail, it looked strong and powerful. Its ferocious expression coupled with its rock-like body made it look very menacing.
< Name > Rock Rhino
[Attributes]: Earth
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
[Race Skill]: Flying Rock (Low-level), Rock Transformation (Low-level), Earth Entanglement (Mid-level), Rock Explosion (Mid-level), Earth Collapsing (High-level)
The moment the Rock Rhino appeared, the hearts of these Beast Trainers shook.
A super pet of a middle-rank commander species!
This Beast Tamer was so rich!
“Junior, my Rock Rhino’s current growth level is Level 10 Awakening,” Wang Le said from behind the Rock Rhino.
“My Iron-eating Beast is also about to awaken level ten.”
On Shi Yu’s side, Eleven was already standing in the arena. However, because it was still in a shrunken state, the passers-by didn’t notice it for a while.
Only when they carefully observed did the passers-by discover that there was indeed such a small Iron-eating Beast sitting opposite the Rock Rhinoceros.
“Why is that Iron-eating Beast so small… a cub?”
Iron-eating Beast, mid-level transcendent race… The race was a major level lower than the Rock Rhinoceros.
At this moment, although the passers-by discovered that Wang Le’s level was very high, it seemed that both parties were training their new pets at the moment. The pets they sent had yet to reach the transcendent level.
Moreover, the state of this Iron-eating Beast was really a little strange. Because it was too small, it was a sharp contrast to the giant rock giant rhinoceros opposite.
This caused many Beast Trainers who passed by to have no idea what the situation of the battle was or what they wanted to do.
Even the judge on the battlefield didn’t know what exactly these people were doing here.
However, they would know very soon. The judge started the battle!
“Junior, you guys attack first!” Senior Wang Le said politely.
“Then, Senior, we’ll do our best.” Shi Yu was not polite.
The Rock Rhinoceros of the middle-level commander species had at least mastered a high-level skill. Coupled with the command of an intermediate-level Beast Tamer like Wang Le, its strength was definitely not weak. They couldn’t be sloppy on their side.
[Eleven, multiplication, full battle power!]
Shi Yu immediately commanded.
At this moment, the passers-by and other seniors, including Senior Wang Le and the Rock Rhinoceros, were still looking at the little Iron-eating Beast with a smile, not realizing the seriousness of the problem at all.
However, in the next second.
“Wuu!!!!”
As Eleven let out a battle cry, its body continued to expand, expand, and expand. Under the surrounding ripples, it became a huge beast nearly ten meters tall in the blink of an eye!!
The Iron-eating Beast, which was as tall as a three-story building, looked at the Rock Rhinoceros in front of it with a deep gaze. Its long black and white hair fluttered without wind, and its entire body seemed to contain explosive power.
This change stunned the senior archeologist.
“Gulp.”
On the other side, the Rock Rhino felt the shadow and gulped.
The other passers-by were also stunned, not knowing what had suddenly happened.
What was going on? It… it became bigger?
“Do you have to be so fierce?” Wang Le was suddenly stunned!
F*ck! Why did it become so big!
He knew that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had mastered multiplication, but the skill of multiplication was actually very particular.
It was equivalent to a combination skill of shrinking and enlarging. There were two development directions.
One was to pursue shrinking it to recover physical fitness, and the other was to pursue enlarging it to increase battle power!
Pets would also consume different energy according to the different development directions.
Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast could shrink so much before it reached the transcendent level. Wang Le originally thought that Shi Yu and the others would first develop a shrinking form, so that it would be easier for their daily training.
As for the giant form, the physical fitness of a pet in the Awakening Stage could not support that kind of training consumption at all. Generally, trainee Beast Tamers would choose to develop it in the future.
After all, this was a high-level skill. How could it be so easy to get both?
However, who knew that when it came to Shi Yu, shrinking and expanding were delayed at all. They actually developed to an extremely high level.
This didn’t make sense. Multiplication was a high-level skill! Wang Le’s face darkened. Even his Rock Rhino hadn’t had the time to develop the proficiency of a high-level skill.
Could Shi Yu and his panda use it well??
“Eleven, harden!”
Shi Yu continued to give the order. In the next moment, the huge Eleven palm slammed towards the Rock Rhinoceros.
“Rock Transformation, Rock Explosion!”
Wang Le’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately gave the order.
On the field, the Rock Rhino’s entire body was instantly covered in rock material. At the same time, it waved its stone palm covered in rock material and resisted Eleven’s huge palm.
Rock Transformation was similar to hardening, but it was an earth-type skill. This Rock Rhino had clearly developed this skill to expert level!
As for Rock Explosion.
[Rock Explosion]: Intermediate skill, Creating Explosion Rock, using the destructive power of the rock explosion to deal huge damage to the enemy!
On Wang Le’s side, he chose the combination skill of Rock Transformation and Rock Explosion to face this combination skill of Giant Transformation and Hardening!
Bang!!!
However, the power of the two was completely different. The moment the eleven palms made contact with the Rock Explosion of the Rock Rhinoceros, a violent explosion was triggered from the point of contact. Then, accompanied by a wave of smoke, the Rock Rhinoceros was directly sent flying a few meters by Eleven!
Their strength was on a completely different level!
This was also normal. After all, although the Rock Rhino was strong, its strength and physical strength were far inferior to the ice dragons suspected to be overlords. Eleven could even fight against ice dragons of the same level, let alone a pet of a commander race.
“Damn, is Wang Le going to fail?”
At this moment, seeing that Wang Le’s Rock Rhinoceros was sent flying by the Iron-eating Beast in a single exchange, Zheng Yingjie and the others widened their eyes.
How did this Iron-eating Beast develop its multiplication skill to such a high-level and perfect level!
Could this be the talent of the ancient bloodline Iron-eating Beast?
“Probably not…”
Everyone continued to watch. The Rock Rhinoceros’s defense was indeed powerful. At this moment, it could actually continue to stand up. Under Wang Le’s nervous orders, countless flying rocks condensed around it, and more than ten rock cannons that were like cannonballs smashed towards the huge Eleven!
With Eleven’s size, even if it had super vision, it couldn’t dodge at this moment.
However, there was no need to dodge. The advantage of Perfect Level Hardening immediately appeared. The Hardening Material flowed on Eleven’s huge body at a high speed. Whichever part of Eleven’s body the Flying Rock hit, the body part would immediately harden and undergo perfect resistance.
Bang! Bang! Bang! A few flying rocks shattered when they touched Eleven’s body, but Eleven was still unscathed.
Eleven used its super vision to determine the landing point of the attack and completed the resistance of the attack with the smallest consumption. At the same time, during the resistance, it also launched the next round of attacks under Shi Yu’s command.
“Thunder Palm!” Shi Yu ordered.
As soon as he finished speaking, Eleven’s hardening substance flowed and superimposed on the huge palm. With a sizzling sound, the black substance of the huge palm and the blue-white dazzling lightning formed a very dazzling combination skill.
“Perfect Level Hardening, what the f*ck???”
At this moment, after discovering the abnormality, Wang Le was completely stunned. He didn’t understand why an Iron-eating Beast had such a high proficiency skill.
It wasn’t just him. Lin Xiuzhu was also at a loss.
Because only she knew how old Eleven was… a year old, and a perfect level racial skill?
What a joke!
What had Shi Yu and the others experienced during the month when she wasn’t in Ping Cheng?
At the same time, the most terrifying thing was that Eleven had also completed the combination skill with Perfect Level Hardening as the core. This scene made Wang Le subconsciously use his Beast Taming Talent.
If he didn’t use it now, he would be destroyed!
In fact, at this moment, Wang Le even wanted the Rock Rhinoceros to use high-level skills to fight the enemy. However, the reality was that high-level skills usually awakened very late. Moreover, with the physical fitness of pets in the Awakening Stage, it was impossible to support the training of high-level skills. Therefore, they had yet to start practicing the skill called Landslide!
“F*ck.” Wang Le gritted his teeth and used his maximum Earth Strengthening talent to help the Rock Rhinoceros strengthen its strength.
Countless earth elements surged around him, transforming into a brown light that connected him to the Rock Rhinoceros.
Boom!
Under the shocking fluctuations, the Rock Rhinoceros’s aura rose steadily, and sand and rocks filled the surroundings.
The next moment, the rock transformation skill that was comparable to or even exceeded perfect hardening instantly covered the Rock Rhinoceros’s entire body. Moreover, with a roar, the Rock Rhinoceros continued to use Rock Explosion to fight the enemy.
However, facing Eleven, who could tear apart dragons of the same level with its bare hands in its current state… Even if Wang Le used his Beast Taming Talent, the Rock Rhino still couldn’t seem to withstand this powerful attack.
“Roar!!!”
Under the struggling roar of the Rock Rhinoceros, even if its own attributes were very resistant to lightning, its body was still instantly flattened the moment it came into contact with Eleven. The ground under its feet almost instantly cracked. Accompanied by a huge explosion, the dazzling power of lightning covered the Rock Rhinoceros’s entire body, turning its whole body black!
Thump.
In the next second, the Rock Rhino’s entire body fell numbly onto the shattered arena, losing its ability to fight!
Victory and defeat had been decided!
No one expected that the battle between a middle-level transcendent iron-eating beast and a middle-level commander rank rock giant rhinoceros would actually be such a one-sided situation.
Shi Yu had an innocent expression. He had already said not to look down on the iron-eating beast. They should have been more serious from the start and gone all out.
As the Rock Rhino fell to the ground, Wang Le was stunned.
The expressions of the other archeology students also changed a hundred million points.
The passerby and judge were even more shocked. This was a f*cking Iron-eating Beast?
What was going on in this battle? Why couldn’t he understand the accompanying moves??
Just now, Wang Le seemed to have used his Beast Taming Talent? Even so, he was still smashed by this Iron-eating Beast?
Holy shit.
Everyone looked at the little Iron-eating Beast that had shrunk back again like it was leaking air and had a satisfied expression. They were confused.
The senior from the archeology department was speechless. This was an Iron-eating Beast that had awakened its ancient bloodline??
It was too strong.
Was it too late to contract an Iron-eating Beast to nurture it now???
If they could awaken his ancient bloodline too, he would be rich!
How was this like a pet of a transcendent race? Even a monarch’s pet was only so-so!
“Wang Le seems to be stunned on the spot.”
“I knew that he would fail. He lost to a Beast Tamer intern. He probably has to give us a large sum of hush money. His intestines must be green with regret now. He regrets why he went for a fight…”
“Senior Lin, do you still sell your Iron-Eating Beasts at the dojo?”
The panda senior watched and listened in silence. Why was this outcome different from what she had expected…
Although she didn’t know what had happened, she felt that her Iron-eating Beast’s price was about to increase.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - The Benefits of Privilege
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: The Benefits of Privilege
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The battle ended. Before Wang Le could react, his surroundings were already noisy.
A group of passers-by pointed at the smaller iron-eating beast!
What was going on!
They felt that they had seen a shocking scene just now, but when they recovered, they no longer knew how to explain the unscientific battle process just now.
Everyone looked at the battlefield and cursed in their hearts This was caused by the aftermath of a battle between awakened pets?
They would believe it if it was said to be a transcendent battle!
“Junior, what’s wrong with your little Iron-Eating Beast!”
Opposite Shi Yu, the fat on Wang Le’s face twitched. He looked like he was about to cry, and he had a faint smile on his face. He looked especially “happy”.
“Senior, I told you not to look down on it… I’ve spent at least ten million’s worth of resources on it.”
What else could Shi Yu say? He hoped that saying this would make Senior Wang Le feel a little better.
He was right. The supplements alone cost more than a million points.
A resource like the evolution holy spring would cost more than seven digits, right?
If one considered that the cost-effective ratio of supplements to points was higher than those rare cultivation resources, it was not wrong for Shi Yu to say that he had smashed eight digits on the little Iron Eating Beast.
Even if an ordinary Beast Tamer really threw so much money, they might not necessarily be able to throw out such an Iron-eating Beast.
Of course, no one would do that. With this amount, they could even buy a commander-type pet cub with potential and outstanding talent.
Therefore, although Eleven’s strength was ridiculous, it was indeed created by combining the three elements of paywall, cheating, and hard work.
“Ten…”
Wang Le was speechless. What else could he say? He could only say that Shi Yu was rich, even richer than him!
Spending ten millions worth of resources on a pet of a middle-level transcendent race was either money or true love!
No, an Iron-eating Beast that had awakened an ancient bloodline was probably not as simple as a mid-level transcendent anymore.
“What the f*ck…”
Senior Wang Le silently withdrew the Rock Rhinoceros and looked around. He said in a low voice, “I lost, I admit defeat. Let’s go!”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and nodded. The two of them quickly left the battlefield.
Lin Xiuzhu and the other seniors were silent for a moment before following the two of them out.
After the nine of them gathered together, before anyone could say anything, Wang Le immediately said, “Cough, I lost. Junior has something special. Looks like Junior has passed the vocation assessment steadily this year.”
The others smiled and looked at him. So?
You’ve failed.
Everyone also saw Wang Le’s distress. Although they wanted to laugh, they considered his feelings and changed the topic in a friendly manner.
“Junior, your little Iron-eating Beast is a little ridiculous… It raised its racial skills to perfect level during the Awakening Stage. Is this also due to the ancient bloodline?”
Zheng Yingjie sighed with emotion. “I’m really curious about its battle power after entering the transcendent level. It will definitely experience a qualitative change.”
“Actually, it’s thanks to its own efforts.”
Shi Yu turned his head to look at Eleven on his shoulder and praised Eleven.
“Sob!” Eleven nodded seriously.
Eleven’s current strength was all thanks to its own hard work!
Cough… It would slowly repay the little effort Shi Yu had put in.
“Damn it, the more I think about it, the more ridiculous it seems.”
At this moment, no one mentioned Wang Le, but Wang Le himself couldn’t hold it in anymore. He said, “I’ve decided to study this ruin well and try to develop the evolution of the iron-eating beasts.”
“A little Iron-Eating Beast that has only awakened its evolution bloodline is already so strong. If it really still has an evolution form, wouldn’t it be a high-level commander race? It’s even possible for it to be at the monarch level.”
“If we really develop it, we’ll be famous!”
Everyone nodded when they heard him. Their motivation to explore the iron-eating beast ruins was completely aroused.
“Senior Lin, let’s study it together. Lead me.”
Lin Yu’er knew that Lin Xiuzhu was a researcher who studied the evolution of iron-eating beasts, and she couldn’t help but want to cozy up to him.
“Alright…”
Lin Xiuzhu saw that the seven people who had been lazing around previously suddenly had motivation, and didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
However, she was also very confused in her heart. She looked at the calm Shi Yu and Shi Yu’s shoulder, where Eleven was acting dumb like usual, and felt that something was wrong.
She kept feeling that the strong one was not the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution form, but the combination of Shi Yu and Eleven. They definitely had some secret.
“Cough, I’ll go with you guys too,” Shi Yu said to the archeological seven heroes.
At the same time, he felt a little guilty.
If they really developed the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast and realized that it couldn’t defeat Eleven in its basic form, it would be awkward.
Eleven was so strong not because it had awakened an ancient bloodline.
The benefit of it awakening its ancient bloodline was actually just a doubling of its physical fitness. This was also the standard ability of the Evolution Holy Spring. There were no changes in other aspects…
Multiplication, Hardening, Thunder Palm, Super Vision… Be it the skill or the proficiency, they were all added together.
“Sure, we will definitely warmly welcome Junior Shi Yu to come and be our advisor.”
Zheng Yingjie smiled. Although this didn’t follow the rules, it wasn’t a big problem.
Finding someone to do homework on behalf of them… No, to put it nicely, wasn’t it too common for students to ask questions that they didn’t know how to answer?
“But it seems to be late. Do you plan to stay here or go back first?” Lin Xiuzhu asked Shi Yu.
“Let me see.” Shi Yu took out his cell phone and looked at the time. It seemed to be getting late.
It was definitely not suitable to continue investigating today.
Shi Yu was silent for a moment. He suddenly felt that it wasn’t easy.
He undoubtedly wanted to investigate deeper into this ruin, but there was still a half a month’s time-limited training card at Ancient Capital University. He didn’t have to let down the beast-eared girl, but the two places were a little far away. It was almost two hours…
“Let me see the situation tomorrow. I’ll go and return to the hotel now,” Shi Yu said.
…
That night, Shi Yu took a taxi back to the city. Along the way, Shi Yu thought about it and finally decided to take all of them. He would go from both ends.
In the morning, he would go to the Ancient Capital University to use the training card to train his etherealization abilities. In the afternoon, he would go to the iron-eating beast ruins in the suburbs to do research.
The road in the middle was indeed a little far, but if he took a taxi, he could totally meditate and cultivate in the car. It didn’t seem like he would lose much time by going all in. It was just that the taxi fare was a little too much, but he had money, so it was fine.
“It’s decided.”
With the plan of running both ways, Shi Yu decided not to check out. After returning, he took a hot shower and slept happily on the hotel bed.
As for Eleven, it returned to the ruins bead and continued training.
Wang Le was very shocked at how Eleven could multiply, harden, and connect the Thunder Palm so proficiently. This coordination ability was unbelievable on a pet at the Awakening Stage. The reason was all because of this.
With absolute sleep, as long as Shi Yu didn’t stop him, Eleven would dare to eat and train for more than 20 hours. The training content was all a combination of multiplication, hardening, and thunder palm plus super vision. In addition, the basic proficiency of these skills wasn’t low, so how could Eleven not connect smoothly?
In fact, Eleven hadn’t even used its full strength yet. If it used deterrence to control its opponent in battle, the Stone Rhino probably wouldn’t even have a chance to fight back.
Even if it wasn’t insta-killed by deterrence, the short hesitation was enough to defeat it in ten seconds. It wouldn’t give the Rock Rhino any chance to use a skill.
Just like when he fought against the Ice Dragon Phantom.
The next day, Shi Yu woke up very early.
After washing up a little, he didn’t disturb Eleven and the Green Silkworm in the ruins pearl. After eating breakfast, he headed to the training facility of the Beast Tamers at Ancient Capital University.
“Granny, you’re playing games again…”
This time, Shi Yu entered by using his time limit card. After entering, he realized that the familiar granny was still playing games. He couldn’t help but be a little speechless.
But then again, this place was quite cold and cheerless. Didn’t other teachers and seniors bring their juniors here to experience it?
Shi Yu thought about it carefully. Compared to other training facilities, the cost-effective ratio of coming here to experience it seemed to be quite low. After all, not everyone had Ruins Beads like him.
“Oh, it’s that little classmate from yesterday.” The granny soon stopped playing and noticed Shi Yu.
Then she continued, “It’s still the same level as yesterday. I’ll help you activate it. You can go by yourself.”
“Thank you, Granny.” Shi Yu thanked her.
This time, after a day of thinking, Shi Yu was no longer delusional enough to challenge pets alone.
His goal was much lower. He decided that as long as he could survive until the end without getting injured.
After changing targets, the training this time was very targeted. Moreover, Shi Yu specially decided to activate the supplements today to practice a few more times…
About noon, the beast-eared girl also arrived. After she entered the training facility, she walked to the granny and said, “Granny, is Shi Yu here today?”
“He’s inside. Eh, it’s been almost two hours, but he’s still here??” The granny didn’t even raise her head and just glanced at the time to express her surprise.
Sigh, I was too obsessed with playing games. I didn’t realize that this little classmate was so hardworking!
“Is that so?” White Brook was surprised. What a coincidence.
She had just finished her work. She had originally planned to call Shi Yu, but because it was on the way, she directly came over to take a look.
He didn’t expect that Shi Yu was really here.
Moreover, two hours??
Not bad, he was talented and hardworking. No wonder Senior Lu admired him.
“Then I’ll wait.”
White Brook nodded and guarded the second floor.
About three minutes later, Shi Yu walked out of the training room with a weak expression. No, he was beaten out.
For the whole morning, he still couldn’t withstand the group fight of ten ferocious beasts. It simply made his lungs explode.
Persisting for nearly three minutes was his current limit.
Shi Yu was not satisfied. He hoped that he could last five minutes within half a month.
No, it would be best if it was more than ten minutes.
With his rich experience in etherialization, only then could he ensure that nothing happened when he encountered danger in the future. Only then could he be at ease and court death.
“He’s out?”
Senior White Brook leaned against the wall and followed Shi Yu downstairs. She turned her head to him.
“Uh, senior, why are you here?”
At this moment, Shi Yu also noticed White Brook and looked at her in surprise.
“I just came by to take a look. I didn’t expect you to be here too. I heard from the granny that you’ve been here for two hours?” White Brook’s expression was strange.
“How did you do it?”
Logically speaking, Shi Yu’s physique wouldn’t last for long.
“Oh, I relied on this.”
Shi Yu took out the three-piece set of Divine Beans, Honeydew Water, and Ginseng Root from the Ruins Bead and said, “I probably have a supplement absorption physique or something, so I recover very well after every practice. It’s alright to practice a little more.”
White Brook:???
She looked at the supplement in Shi Yu’s hand in confusion.
So after returning yesterday, did Shi Yu go to prepare supplements?
Or could it be that these supplements were brought with him in the first place?
“You’ve worked hard…”
White Brook was silent for a moment. He didn’t know what to say, so he could only nod and acknowledge Shi Yu.
Usually, Beast Tamers would only use some supplements when they were extremely weak after a big battle.
Under normal circumstances, they would recover naturally through meditation and rest. Firstly, it was healthier. Secondly, high-level supplements were not cheap. With this money, it was better to buy resources for pets. The cost-effective ratio was higher.
Shi Yu really dared to spend money on himself.
However, come to think of it, what was the “easy to absorb supplements” physique?
White Brook was puzzled. She had heard of elemental affinity physiques, undead affinity physiques, plant affinity physiques, but she had never heard of the ‘supplements absorption’ physique.
She had seen it all now.
“Are you free this afternoon? I’ll take you to the archeology department to take a look.” Senior White couldn’t figure it out, so she decided not to think about it.
“Yes.”
Shi Yu nodded. Then, he suddenly thought of something and said, “By the way, Senior, I heard that an Iron-eating Beast ruin appeared in the ancient capital. At the moment, it seems that the Archeology Department of the Ancient Capital University is in charge.”
“Do you know which teacher is in charge? I want to investigate this ruin too.”
“Iron-eating Beast ruins?” White Brook was completely unaware.
This was also normal. It was related to the Iron-eating Beast and had been dug up underground. It was destined that this ruin wouldn’t receive much attention. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been handed over to a group of students to investigate and research.
“I don’t know, but I can go and ask,” White Brook said.
“Why, is this ruin very important? Eh, I almost forgot, your initial pet is an Iron-eating Beast…”
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “Not only that, I feel that the investigation priority of this ruin is a little low. The hidden historical value isn’t as simple as it looks.”
In his opinion, the most important information hidden in this ruin was not the evolution of the iron-eating beast, but the meaning of the nine special symbols.
After all, this was a special symbol that crossed two worlds.
Even if this ruin was really very ordinary, the history behind it was definitely not ordinary.
The archeology department of Ancient Capital University had completely underestimated the true value of this ruin.
Shi Yu was very certain about this.
Shi Yu hoped that Ancient Capital University would take this ruin seriously. It would be best to give some support and cooperation, such as detecting the composition of the metal piece. It would be best if the priority was higher.
He had heard from the Archeological Seven Elites that the laboratory positions of the Archeological Department were very tight. The ruins of investigation and research had priority. Things like the Iron Eater ruins were not in a hurry.
“Is that so?” White Brook nodded and said, “Then I’ll bring you to ask in the afternoon. You’re a reserve member of Bureau 11, right? When the time comes, you can just talk to the people over there. It’s more useful than my words.”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned. The beast-eared girl knew everything, but she actually knew about the Ruins Bead and Bureau 11. It looked like she and Senior Lu were very good friends.
Moreover, the beast-eared girl herself was probably not simple either. She might even have a legendary Beast Tamer senior? Otherwise, she wouldn’t be carrying a spatial storage device with her.
…
In the afternoon.
White Brook brought Shi Yu to the southern campus. Unlike the northern campus, this was the headquarters of the archeology department. There were more libraries, museums, and laboratories than training facilities.
“We have to ask who’s in charge of that Iron-eating Beast Ruins, right?”
“Let’s go directly to the dean…”
The beast-eared girl had a clear goal. If she wanted to ask, she would ask the person in charge.
“Ah, this.”
Big Sister White Brook walked in front while Shi Yu followed behind her. He felt that she had a very strong aura.
Soon, White Brook brought Shi Yu to a building. At the same time, he said to Shi Yu, “I wonder if he’s around, but during the opening day, the leaders should be pretty packed.”
“Let’s take a look first. If they’re not around, we can ask other teachers.”
As she muttered, she brought Shi Yu to the Dean’s office and knocked on the door.
Shi Yu and White Brook’s luck was pretty good. After knocking twice, a “please come in” voice came from inside.
White Brook smiled and nodded at Shi Yu. Then, he pushed open the door and entered.
Director Li from the Archeological Department looked like a kind, middle-aged, big-bellied man. At this moment, he seemed to be working. He was a little different from the Archeological Department Director Shi Yu had imagined…
When he saw someone enter at this moment, he couldn’t help but raise his head and cast a puzzled gaze.
However, as he saw White Brook, he immediately smiled.
“President Bai, why is it you? Aren’t you training today?”
“Director Li, I’m not the one looking for you. I brought someone here too.” White Brook looked at Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu also walked forward and greeted the other party. “Hello, Director Li.”
“Hello friend, you are?” Director Li looked confused.
“My name is Shi Yu. I’m planning to apply for the Ancient Capital University’s Archeology Department this year,” Shi Yu said.
“I see, welcome, welcome!!” Chief Physician Li laughed and immediately understood. So it was White Brook who brought her relative or friend over to greet him in advance.
“Director Li is a big boss. You have to remember him!” White Brook said with a smile.
“He was brought to Ancient Capital University by your Dr. Lu after much effort.”
“Huh?” Director Li was stunned.
“Dr…. Dr. Lu Qingyi??”
“Yes.” White Brook nodded.
The way Director Li looked at Shi Yu changed instantly.
The people White Brook brought and the people Lu Qingyi invited to apply for Ancient Capital University were two different concepts!
The former would make him someone he needed to only show friendliness to, while the latter meant a lot.
After all, Dr. Lu Qingyi was a big boss who could rank in the top 20 of the Dong Huang in terms of contribution to the country. She was the pride of Ancient Capital University.
Even some legendary Beast Tamers were very respectful to Dr. Lu Qingyi. None of the members of Bureau 11 were simple.
“Student Shi Yu, what’s your relationship with Dr. Lu?” Director Li asked curiously.
Shi Yu said, “There’s no special relationship. Uh, I suppose you could say she led me through the door to the archeology world?”
If it was this world, it was indeed so. Shi Yu had originally wanted to develop steadily, but in the end, Lu Qingyi came straight to his door and used 10 million to smash him back into the archeological world. Shi Yu remembered this “favor”. It was a good memory.
“Oh?” Director Li’s interest was aroused.
At this moment, Shi Yu also wanted to get to the point quickly. He said, “Director Li, did you discover a ruin related to iron-eating beasts in the ancient capital? At the moment, it seems like our archeology department is in charge?”
“Iron-eating Beast?” Director Li thought for a moment and nodded. “There is indeed such a new ruin. At the moment, it seems to have been handed over to the students to investigate and research. What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu said, “I feel that this ruin isn’t as simple as it looks, so I want to take over and investigate. I also want to cooperate with Ancient Capital University to study it. I wonder if it’s possible…”
He started communicating with Director Li according to what White Brook taught him.
“Huh? You’re taking over?” Director Li was stunned, not understanding what it meant for a moment.
“This is my identification.” Shi Yu took out a small notebook from his pocket and handed it to Director Li.
Director Li took it blankly and flipped to the first page. At the top was the profile picture of his handsome face.
Below was Shi Yu’s role as a reserve member of the Homeland Ruins Strategic Investigation and Backup Security Bureau.
At this moment, as he saw this certificate and the last seal, Director Li was stunned.
He immediately became excited, and his breathing became rapid. He felt like he couldn’t breathe.
His face was flushed red. Beside him, White Brook saw his appearance and thought it was funny.
Even though Bureau 11 was a reserve member, its status was very high. In terms of archeology, its power was at least on the same level as the Archeological Association and the Nine Elite Universities.
It was no wonder that Director Li was so excited.
Although the trump card of Ancient Capital University was the Archeology Department, in recent years, there had indeed been no new results worth mentioning in the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University. It was time to urgently need fresh blood, especially people with true archeological talent.
Shi Yu’s arrival was simply timely!
To be absorbed by Bureau 11, there was no need to say anything about Shi Yu’s talent. He was almost guaranteed to be a new star in the archeological world in the future.
At this moment, Director Li finally understood why Lu Qingyi would become the guide of this young man in front of him and let him enter Ancient Capital University to study. This was simply giving treasures to the Archeological Department of Ancient Capital University!
“Student Shi Yu, you… really gave me a fright…” Director Li held Shi Yu’s identification documents and finally calmed down before laughing.
Great, after next year, their archeology department would take off again!
“You’re saying that the iron-eating beast ruin isn’t as simple as it looks? I understand. Next, you’ll be in charge of the development and investigation of this ruin. Ancient Capital University will also cooperate fully.” Director Li believed in Shi Yu’s judgment. In this aspect, Shi Yu was also a professional.
“Uh, thank you.”
Shi Yu was stunned before falling silent. Was this the feeling of being a privileged dog? It felt a little good…
Wait a minute, after such a series of actions, wouldn’t Senior Panda and the archeological Seven Elites be very stunned? After all, he had suddenly become their in-charge.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - Listening to the Voice of History Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Listening to the Voice of History Again
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Then, Shi Yu and Director Li chatted a little more.
After getting his contact information, he bade farewell.
After all, both Director Li and the beast-eared girl should be very busy, so Shi Yu didn’t want to disturb them.
“Senior, thank you.”
After leaving the office building, Shi Yu thanked White Brook.
“No problem.”
White Brook stretched.
As expected of the beast-eared girl who could tear apart pets with her bare hands. Even her stretching looked very powerful. Shi Yu secretly took a look.
“Then do you still need me to show you around?” White Brook asked.
“There’s no need. Next, I want to mainly investigate this iron-eating beast ruin. It won’t be too late to explore the other facilities after I enter the school,” Shi Yu said.
After chatting with the archeological Seven Elites, Shi Yu realized that the archeological methods of the two worlds were really different.
After all, this was a world with transcendent power. He might really have to learn from the beginning, just like what Lu Qingyi said.
The Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University was a good entry point.
“Eh, alright. In that case, contact me if you have any questions.” White Brook nodded.
…
After Shi Yu and White Brook left, Director Li began to search for information related to the Iron-eating Beast Ruins. Then, he found the supervisor in charge of the ruins.
“Director Li, you were looking for me?”
The mentor of the Archeological Seven Elites came to the director’s room in confusion.
“Little Ding, your students are in charge of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins, right?” Director Li said with a smile.
“Yes.” Mentor Ding nodded.
“Next, the investigation priority of this Iron-eating Beast Ruins will be raised to the highest. I’ve arranged for another person in charge here. When the time comes, you have to cooperate with me fully.”
“Huh?” Mentor Ding was confused.
Wasn’t it just a small ruin of a tribe that worshiped iron-eating beasts? Could it be that there were new discoveries?
“Which supervisor is it?”
“Not a mentor. A reserve member of Bureau 11 introduced by Dr. Lu Qingyi. A young man. You just have to keep it in mind.”
“He should have made contact with your group of students now. He seems to have discovered a deeper value to this ruin.”
When Director Li finished speaking, Mentor Ding’s pupils constricted. Bureau 11?
“Yes.” He hurriedly nodded.
…
At the iron-eating beast ruins.
On a new day, Senior Panda and the archeological seven elites were very motivated.
They had already devoted themselves to researching for the whole morning. Just the relevant information they flipped through was more than 100,000 words.
This was an unimaginable motivation for the archeological seven elites who had been skiving previously.
It couldn’t be helped. The potential Eleven displayed was too strong.
It gave the illusion that as long as the iron-eating beast evolved, it would be invincible.
In the Beast Taming Domain, it was very impressive if one could develop the evolution method of a pet.
For example, those researchers who had researched different evolution paths for the Green Silkworm had already gained fame and fortune, walking to the peak of their lives.
Although the iron-eating beast wasn’t as popular as the green worm, it wasn’t bad either.
If they could figure out the evolution of the iron-eating beasts through archeological research, not only would they be rewarded by the school, but they would also be heavily rewarded on their resume.
At this moment, Zheng Yingjie was comparing the similarities between ruins and other ruins from 4500 years ago.
A phone call made him stop what he was doing.
“Mentor Ding?”
“What, the person in charge of the project is going to be changed?”
After saying a few words on the other end of the phone, Zheng Yingjie was stunned.
His conversation immediately attracted the attention of the others.
Change in person-in-charge?
The archeology seniors were stunned. No way!
At the moment, the person in charge of this ruin was their supervisor.
They had a good relationship with their mentor, and Mentor Ding even promised to assist in the investigation in two days.
This sudden change in person-in-charge definitely didn’t make it convenient for them, after all, they were already familiar with this mentor.
“I know the new person-in-charge?”
“He’s already come into contact with us? Who?”
Zheng Yingjie looked confused. Then, his expression suddenly changed drastically. He was stunned!
“This…”
After hearing the name of the new in-charge, Zheng Yingjie was confused.
A moment later, Zheng Yingjie hung up.
Lin Xiuzhu and the other six elites surrounded him and asked what was going on.
“What change in person-in-charge? What’s going on?” Wang Le said.
“Will it affect the research route we’ve already confirmed?” Lin Yu’er asked.
Zheng Yingjie was still confused. “Probably not.”
“Because…”
“Mentor Ding said that the in-charge of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins is Shi Yu. You didn’t hear wrongly. It’s that Junior Shi Yu from yesterday.”
“What??”
After Zheng Yingjie finished speaking, he wasn’t the only one who was stunned. Everyone else was.
Wang Le stuttered, “Wh-what’s going on?”
The others were also very stunned. He was just a junior who had yet to enroll in school. Why did he suddenly become the person in charge of the Archeological Department of Ancient Capital University?!
This leap was a little too big!
“Senior Lin?” Zheng Yingjie looked at Lin Xiuzhu.
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu also had a puzzled expression and felt that he seemed to have heard wrongly.
“Who exactly is this Junior Shi Yu?” they asked.
In Lin Xiuzhu’s words, Shi Yu was introduced by Hall Master Lin and was from the same hometown as Lin Xiuzhu.
It was such an ordinary identity and background, how did it suddenly become related to Ancient Capital University?
He was in charge of an homework project and was at least at the level of a university teacher.
“You’re asking me but, who should I ask?” Lin Xiuzhu crossed his arms and couldn’t figure it out.
Shi Yu’s identity was indeed very strange. At the start, she also felt that Shi Yu was very ordinary.
But for some baffling reason, Shi Yu was nurtured as a personal disciple by his father…
This was before Eleven awakened its ancient bloodline.
There were so many iron-eating beasts, but why did Eleven have to awaken an ancient bloodline?
This was also the reason why Lin Xiuzhu felt that Shi Yu was extraordinary. It wasn’t that the ancient bloodline had formed Shi Yu and Eleven, but because it was Shi Yu that Eleven could awaken the ancient bloodline.
“He should come over later. When the time comes, I’ll personally ask him what’s going on…”
Shi Yu was indeed on his way to the Iron-Eating Beast Ruins.
During the car ride, Shi Yu was in a daze as he meditated.
So slow…
In the future, it looked like he had to contract a flying pet that was proficient in speed.
However, even if he didn’t contract it, he could still rely on bugs to transform.
The skill, Illusionary Phantom, was simply an all-purpose tool skill. Worms also seemed to be all-purpose tool pets. In the future, everything could change.
For example, if it transformed into a frost dragon, it could also fly.
Of course, although the frost dragon could fly, it wasn’t known for its speed. Moreover, being a Dragon Knight in a city was too ostentatious.
It was easy to be shot down as an unknown flying object.
In addition, the ability of the substantialized phantom was definitely a little inferior to the main body.
At least, at the moment, the ice dragons formed by the bugs could not even defeat pets of the same level of growth as high-level transcendent races, let alone real frost dragons of overlord races.
…
Soon, Shi Yu arrived at the iron-eating beast ruins.
When Yu came over, he realized that Senior Panda and the archeological seven elites were looking at him strangely.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
“Junior, what’s going on? Why have you suddenly become the main person in charge of this ruin…” Zheng Yingjie smiled bitterly, very confused.
“I felt that there wasn’t enough attention on this ruin, so I contacted your Director Li through a friend.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Huh?”
The few of them looked at Shi Yu in confusion. What friend was so powerful?
He could actually directly use his connections with Director Li.
“In short, this is a good thing,” Shi Yu said. “Next, the school will probably cooperate with us to investigate this ruin. The composition analysis of the metal piece might be completed in two to three days.”
The few of them looked at each other.
“Alright…” Seeing that Shi Yu didn’t intend to talk about it in detail, everyone tactfully stopped asking.
However, at this moment, they didn’t dare to treat Shi Yu as an ordinary junior.
This was clearly a super relation in Ancient Capital University!
After he entered university, it was still uncertain who would look after whom.
“Does my father know this friend you’re talking about?”
After everyone dispersed to work, Lin Xiuzhu leaned beside Shi Yu and asked softly.
She remembered that her father had also said that Shi Yu was entrusted by an acquaintance to study at Bamboo Stone Dojo.
“I think so,” Shi Yu said. This friend had two interpretations. One was Senior Lu, while the other was the beast-eared senior. As for the former, Lin Hongnian definitely knew her.
“I see.” The panda senior nodded and smiled. “Alright, I didn’t expect you to become the person in charge of this project after a day.”
Shi Yu grinned. “It’s our duty to revive the glory of the iron-eating beasts.”
“Speaking of which, if we really develop the evolution of the iron-eating beasts, will the price of the iron-eating beasts in the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base increase?”
Lin Xiuzhu was stunned. He did not expect Shi Yu to have thought of this either.
Generally speaking, if a pet was discovered to have a new evolution, or if a certain Beast Tamer used a certain type of pet to kill in major competitions, it would affect the price of this pet to a certain extent.
“According to the market demand, it’s really possible…”
She fell into deep thought. So, should she let her father catch more wild iron-eating beasts in the wild to enrich the number of iron-eating beasts in the breeding base?
Lin Xiuzhu felt that if the iron-eating beasts in the breeding base were to be bred normally, the supply would be insufficient. Sigh, why couldn’t the iron-eating beasts be willing to make babies on their own? She blushed slightly.
…
Although he had become the in-charge of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins, Shi Yu was still like a junior most of the time.
He had many things to consult with the Archeological Seven Elites.
These people looked like bad students, but it wasn’t like they didn’t have any real talent. After all, they had been studying in university for a while.
In contrast, the knowledge accumulated by Shi Yu’s previous life seemed to be of little use here. There were still many new things to learn.
After confirming the research direction, everyone began to study it step by step.
About two days later, Mentor Ding arrived at the Iron-eating Beast Ruins.
For the past two days, he had been assisting in analyzing the elemental composition of the metal sheet at the school. Now that he had worked overtime, he finally had a result.
“Nice to meet you, Student Shi Yu.”
Mentor Ding was a middle-aged man in his thirties. He was gentle and elegant, and his expression was kind.
This was the first time he and Shi Yu had met, but both parties had long heard of each other.
“Hello, Mentor Ding.”
Shi Yu and Mentor Ding shook hands.
“Mentor Ding.”
The seven archeological elites were also very excited that their mentor had come.
This meant that there was some progress in this research.
“After two days of analysis, we can already confirm that this metal piece is mainly composed of six types of metal elements.”
Tutor Ding took the information and communicated with everyone.
“Among the six metal minerals, there are two level-five metal resources, three level-six metal resources, and one level-seven metal resource.”
Various cultivation resources could be divided into ten levels.
For example, pets in the Awakening Stage usually corresponded to level 1 resources.
Resources above level five were basically mainstream resources used by master-level Beast Tamers and even legendary Beast Tamers.
This alloy piece contained the composition of six high-level metal resources. It made everyone excited but also within expectations.
They were excited because if this metal piece was really a part of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution form, then the species level of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution form might not be low. After all, it had used so many high-level metal resources.
It was within expectations because Eleven was already so strong even before evolution. It was natural for it to be unstoppable after evolution.
Mentor Ding took out the information on every metal resource and said,
“Among them, they are respectively level-five metal mineral resources, Golden Jade, and Green Heart Sand.”
“Level-six metal mineral resources, Mysterious Purple Copper Mine, Heavenly Silver Iron, Blue Gray Pure Gold.”
“Level-seven metal mineral resource, meteor iron.”
“Thank you for your hard work,” Shi Yu said.
“Not at all.” Mentor Ding laughed and said, “Next, are you planning to study these resources?”
“These resources are expensive. If there’s no accurate experimental research route, it might cost a lot of money.”
“But the school has some reserves for these resources. We can still afford a certain amount for now. We have to buy more.”
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu and the Archeological Seven Elites were stunned. Indeed, there were too many high-level resources. Ordinary people couldn’t afford to experiment at all!
If they really wanted to study it in depth, the research funds would probably reach hundreds of millions.
“There’s no need for the experiment. Let’s start with the nature of these materials,” Shi Yu said.
After confirming the composition of the metal piece, he also understood that it might be very difficult to spend money to study the evolution of the iron-eating beast.
It was better not to test it blindly without a concrete plan. Shi Yu did not want to waste tens of millions or hundreds of millions of yuan.
Usually, when researchers studied the evolution of pets, they would first summarize the feasible theories, analyze the success rate, and then conduct experiments. Very few people directly fed and tested the materials blindly. Money wasn’t obtained from thin air.
“Alright.” Mentor Ding nodded and said, “If you need anything, just tell me.”
…
Next, Shi Yu and the others had an additional research mission.
It was to study the nature of the six metal minerals and analyze the different combinations of reactions between them in theory.
This homework that was focused on research was not Shi Yu’s main focus for the time being. He handed it to Lin Xiuzhu and the others to do.
What he was most concerned about was what the nine special symbols represented.
Shi Yu checked a lot of information about that era and realized that this symbol only appeared on the iron-eating beast ruins. There were too few clues…
With insufficient clues, Shi Yu could only place all his hopes on his special talent.
“Lu Qingyi said that the activation of the talent of ‘listening to the Voice of History’ requires a certain opportunity.”
“The deeper the user’s contact with that historical environment, the deeper the exploration, the deeper the obsession, and the deeper the understanding, the easier it is to listen to the voice of history.”
It was precisely because of this that Shi Yu stared at the metal piece every day and even carried Eleven to look at the murals.
It looked a little silly, but they all hoped to establish a connection between themselves and this ruin.
Just like that, half a month had passed since Shi Yu arrived at the ancient capital.
He went to practice phantom transformation in the morning and came here in the afternoon to investigate. Time passed quickly.
For the past half a month, Shi Yu had mainly been meditating on his own. He didn’t give Eleven and the Green Silkworm any additional points. They were all training on their own.
“Wuu.” Eleven didn’t even care if he added points.
In the past half a month, it had been training especially hard. This was because Shi Yu had stopped increasing its points, giving it a chance to catch its breath. It could finally make the best use of its time to repay the debt.
However, what confused Eleven was why Shi Yu always carried it to look at murals and metal pieces every day!
Shi Yu had no choice. He didn’t plan on treating it as a mascot!
He hoped that he could hear the voice of history through the connection between Eleven and the iron-eating beast ruins.
However, after half a month, there still didn’t seem to be any substantial effect?
Even Eleven advised Shi Yu to give up.
“Wu wu!!!”
What lousy evolution form? It was fine even if it didn’t want it. Even so, it could still become the strongest!
Eleven laid on Shi Yu’s shoulder and squirmed for a moment. Then, she stood up and climbed onto Shi Yu’s head. It said confidently.
“As long as I’m sincere, it’ll work! Be good!” Shi Yu educated him. It made sense, but shouldn’t this panda show some respect and save some face for its ancestors!
Crack!
However, just as Eleven finished speaking, a small crack appeared in the stone wall in front of Shi Yu and the others, scaring Eleven and Shi Yu.
“Damn, what’s going on?” Shi Yu took a step back with a shocked expression.
It cracked?
Why did this situation feel so familiar?
“Sob.” Eleven spoke carefully on Shi Yu’s shoulder. Did it say something wrong?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He suddenly felt that his heart was beating abnormally and his mind was in a daze.
In short, he seemed to have sensed it.
He was gradually resonating with this ruin.
“No, that’s right. Perhaps this ruin is special, so we have to use agitation.”
Shi Yu took a deep breath and said to the ruins through telepathy, “The Iron-eating Beast’s evolution is only so-so.”
Crack, the crack deepened a little.
“It probably isn’t a powerful evolution form. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been lost.”
Boom!
After saying this, the stone wall of the ruins trembled slightly and dust fell. Shi Yu’s brain rumbled.
He seemed to have entered the special state when he explored the ruins and saw a historical image.
Shi Yu was stunned…
“F*ck, I think I’ve found a new way to listen to the Voice of History? I thought that it would work only if I was sincere? Why didn’t you follow the routine, stupid wall!”

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - Evolution of the Iron-eating Beast Armor
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Evolution of the Iron-eating Beast Armor
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu was speechless.
He paid his respects obediently and sincerely for half a month. In his heart, he kept repeating, “It’s our duty to restore the Iron-eating Beast’s glory”. The ruins did not react at all.
On the contrary, after slightly denying the iron-eating beast’s evolution, the ‘spirit’ in the ruins immediately couldn’t sit still.
What was going on?
It was not as easy to talk to as the stone statue in Ping Cheng.
Perhaps the ‘spirits’ born from different ruins, ruins, and ancient artifacts had different personalities?
If he had known this would happen, he would have shouted on the first day he came here, “The Iron-eating Beast doesn’t have any evolution form at all. Come and convince me!”
…
This time, the historical scene Shi Yu saw was still very short.
He saw a tribe filled with fire furnaces.
In the tribe, there was a group of muscular men with bare arms.
They were just like blacksmiths, using batch after batch of rare metals that Shi Yu found familiar.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The sound of iron striking constantly entered Shi Yu’s ears.
Then, the alloy battle armor was worn by a group of iron-eating beasts.
After the Iron-eating Beasts put on their armor, they seemed to be using Perfect Level Hardening. They released Hardening Material to wrap the armor, causing the armor to completely become one with them.
There were many types of armor. Some iron-eating beasts wore perfect armor, while others only had huge alloy claws equipped on their arms. There were even iron-eating beasts who picked up shields. They had different appearances, but they all used Perfect Level Hardening to connect themselves to the armor.
During this process, as they fused with the armor, their aura seemed to have been raised astonishingly, and their bodies kept growing under a wave of light.
A moment later, hundreds of Iron-eating Beasts wearing various battle armor appeared on the screen. They were arranged in an orderly manner, and it was extremely shocking. This group of Iron-eating Beasts was like a well-trained army preparing to go out to battle.
At the end of the scene, the iron-eating beasts used their hardened claws to inscribe special symbols on the armor. At this moment, their bodies flickered with light again…
The scene stopped.
…
In reality.
Eleven looked at the silent Shi Yu and did not understand what was going on.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s mood was very complicated.
He didn’t know what to say to express his current mood.
No wonder Bureau 11 directly absorbed him into the organization without a word when it encountered a Beast Tamer with the talent to listen to the Voice of History.
This ability was indeed a little buggy.
While other archeologists were still exploring the mysteries of ancient times, archeologists with this talent directly pried into history like watching a movie. If this wasn’t cheating, what was?
“So those metals aren’t for eating?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
It was actually to build an alloy battle armor and equip the Iron-eating Beast, then use the Perfect Level Hardening connection.
Don’t tell him that this was the evolution method of the iron-eating beasts.
In the scene, Shi Yu also saw the materials needed to forge the alloy battle armor.
From the looks of it, it felt like the metal that they had found.
If that was the case, the iron-eating beast’s evolution method was easier than Shi Yu imagined.
However, it was still unknown if modern forging and processing technology could turn those metal minerals into alloy battle armors like in ancient times.
Then, what should this evolution method be called?
Armor evolution?
It wasn’t like there weren’t any armed evolution in existing pets.
The evolution method of artificial mechanical lives was mostly armed evolution.
However, there was still a little difference between the two.
“Wait, that’s not the point!”
He only saw the evolution method of the iron-eating beast, but Shi Yu kept feeling that he had not seen the full picture of history.
This group of Iron-eating Beasts wore battle armor and completed their evolution. What were they going to do? War?
What did the different symbols they carved on their bodies mean?
Why was there such a symbol on Earth?
In the end, Shi Yu felt that he knew something, but he didn’t completely know…
Forget it… He decided to start researching the evolution of the iron-eating beast first.
…
“What happened?”
As Shi Yu listened to the Voice of History, the stone wall seemed to have exhausted its “life” as many cracks appeared.
The “boom” just now also directly attracted Senior Panda and the archeological seven elites.
After they came over, they immediately saw the cracked stone wall and Shi Yu, who had his back to them.
Ahhhhhhhhh!!!!
Everyone: w (?Д?) w???
So, what happened!!!
“Wuu.”
Before Shi Yu could turn around, Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, turned around first and revealed an innocent expression.
If it said that they only hit the stone wall twice and the stone wall exploded, would they believe it??
“Damn, what’s going on?”
The stone wall exploded, and the brains of Zheng Yingjie and the others also exploded.
Although the iron-eating beast ruins weren’t very important before, it was their basic responsibility to keep this ancient item intact. But now… something big had happened.
They looked at Shi Yu, who was slowly turning around. Could it be that Shi Yu couldn’t figure out anything even after half a month? He finally broke down and smashed the stone wall?
“Don’t panic.”
At this moment, Shi Yu turned around and looked at the panicked crowd. He comforted them.
Calm down.
“I got something.” Under everyone’s stunned expressions, Shi Yu chuckled.
“I think I know what the evolution method of the iron-eating beasts is.”
“What?!!”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, everyone was more shocked than seeing the stone wall crack. They widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
Was this for real?
“Yes, let’s go out first,” Shi Yu said.
Then, everyone arrived outside in the wide space.
They looked at Shi Yu with anticipation and excitement.
So, what exactly had Shi Yu discovered?
“The six metal components detected by that metal piece are indeed the key to the evolution of the iron-eating beast.”
“What we guessed most previously was to let the iron-eating beasts eat these metals. Actually, the actual situation is similar.”
“The iron-eating beast’s evolution method should be to make these six metal minerals into alloy battle armors, then equip the iron-eating beast with them. Finally, let the iron-eating beast use the transcendent level racial skill Hardening to perfectly wrap and integrate the power of the armor.”
“The iron-eating beasts’ hardening substance and this alloy should produce a special reaction that can assist them in increasing their level of life.”
The few of them were clearly stunned.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “What’s the principle?”
Shi Yu: “Why does that matter?”
“Then how are you sure?”
“Uh…” Shi Yu was stunned.” Instinct? ”
Everyone was stunned. They felt that Shi Yu didn’t say anything.
To put it bluntly, it was still a guess. On the basis of their previous guesses, there was another one.
“Can those six metals really be made into alloys?” Zheng Yingjie was at a loss.
“We’ve been researching and analyzing their nature these days. There’s nothing in common.”
Lin Yu’er said, “In the end, this method still requires transcendent hardening…”
Everyone looked at Lin Xiuzhu.
Among the known Iron-eating Beast Tamers, there were really not many Iron-eating Beasts who had mastered transcendent Level Hardening.
Back then, Lin Xiuzhu had said that her father, who was also Hall Master Lin Hongnian, had trained the Iron-eating Beast for 21 years before training this skill to transcendent.
As for Lin Xiuzhu, she started growing up with her Iron-eating Beast when she was 10 years old.
Although there was no contract at that time, he had started to cultivate feelings with the Iron-eating Beast since young and then underwent initial training to familiarize himself with it.
