In the end, ten years later, today, her Iron-eating Beast’s hardening skill was established under her father’s training experience. It was only at the perfect level, and it was far from reaching the transcendent level proficiency.
If one of the evolution conditions of the iron-eating beasts was really hardening at full proficiency, then this condition seemed to be a little difficult to achieve.
The Green Silkworm’s worm silk reaching proficient level was enough for it to evolve, but the Iron-eating Beasts actually required full-level racial skills… It was simply a scam.
Moreover, the evolution materials of the iron-eating beasts were basically rare metals above level five. The price of using these metals to forge a set of armor was obvious.
It could be said that even if the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast was publicized, there seemed to be very few Beast Tamers who could fulfill this evolution condition.
Everyone’s stomach hurt. Was Shi Yu’s deduction reliable?
“Well, why don’t you just believe me?”
Shi Yu actually wanted to experiment too.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have evolution materials, and he didn’t know how to turn these materials into alloys. There were technical difficulties.
In addition, Eleven’s skill proficiency hadn’t reached the standard yet.
Moreover, he had yet to decide whether he should let Eleven evolve. In the future, he would feel that it was very strange to have an iron lump on his shoulder, and it was also very heavy. Sooner or later, he would get a shoulder disease.
“Even if it’s true, where are we going to try forging alloy battle armor? Where are we going to find Iron-eating Beast experiments with transcendent proficiency…” Zheng Yingjie said with a headache.
Although there was a concrete experimental route, it still sounded like a huge project with hundreds of millions of research funds…
“It’s alright. It’s a good thing that we can find a breakthrough.”
The panda senior thought for a moment and looked at Shi Yu. “I believe you. Do you want to study it? Our Bamboo Stone Dojo will bear the cost of the evolution materials. Iron-eating beasts with transcendent Level Proficiency can also use my father’s Iron-eating Beast as a guinea pig.”
Shi Yu:…
Everyone called her a filial daughter.
Senior Panda was a good father.
“It’s mainly because at the moment, only my father’s Iron-eating Beast fulfills the conditions. In order to study the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast, he has invested a lot of money. This time, it sounds more reliable than his previous mess.” The panda senior shook her head.
“If he knew, he would definitely be willing. He might even take the initiative to come and cooperate.”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment before saying, “Then I’ll ask if Ancient Capital University can provide some technical help.”
“In terms of forging alloy battle armor, there should be someone more professional at the university.”
Shi Yu and the panda senior looked at each other and nodded. They immediately agreed.
Shi Yu contacted the Ancient Capital University to seek technical help.
Senior Panda contacted her father to experiment as a lab rat.
Whether the Iron-eating Beast race could soar into the sky and raise their prices depended on this wave.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - The Iron Eater Has Really Evolved
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: The Iron Eater Has Really Evolved
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
Hall Master Lin Hongnian was meditating in the martial arts hall.
Suddenly, a call interrupted his cultivation.
“Xiu Zhu?”
Seeing the caller, Lin Hongnian was slightly stunned.
For the past half a month, he had taken the initiative to call Lin Xiuzhu every day to ask about the investigation progress of the iron-eating beast ruins.
And the news they received was not very good. There was no progress.
Today, his daughter actually took the initiative to call. Did she gain anything?
Lin Hongnian picked up the call with a nervous heart.
On the other side, he was pleasantly surprised.
“Dad, Shi Yu has confirmed the iron-eating beast’s evolution method, but he requires the iron-eating beast to master transcendent Level Hardening. Do you want to give it a try?”
Whoosh!
Hall Master Lin suddenly got up and widened his eyes.
“Really?”
He asked with anticipation.
“Yes, but the experimental fee for evolution materials might be a “bit” expensive.”
“Can you bear to?” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
Level-five resources matched ordinary master-level Beast Tamers.
Level-six resources matched top-notch masters.
Level-seven resources matched legendary Beast Tamers.
The evolution materials of the Iron-eating Beasts included two types of level five, three types of level six, and one level seven resource. The price could be easily imagined.
Moreover, as the first batch of people to try, if something went wrong midway, the experimental fee would definitely be considerable.
“There’s nothing to be reluctant about. Money is just for spending.”
“In any case, this little savings of ours will all be your dowry in the future. At most, the dowry will be gone. Xiu Zhu, you have to rely on yourself in the future.” Hall Master Lin was quite honest.
Panda:???
He was right. After all, Lin Xiuzhu was an only child…
“It doesn’t matter!” After a moment of silence, the panda senior said.
She didn’t need these things either. The evolution of the iron-eating beast was important!
Bamboo Stone Dojo and Iron Bamboo Breeding Base were both businesses of Lin Xiuzhu’s family.
Apart from that, they also had the ownership of two energy crystal mines.
As for some additional food-related industries they were part of, they were supplementary. They were purely icing on the cake.
Although Hall Master Lin was only an ordinary master-level Beast Tamer, he was far richer than other Beast Tamers of the same level. He could be said to be the richest person in Ping Cheng.
After all, their family had been running the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base for several generations, and they had wealth.
But because of this, he had an unusual obsession with the iron-eating beast.
If it were an ordinary master-level Beast Tamer, they would have long eliminated the Iron-eating Beast from the team.
But Lin Hongnian’s family was different. Instead, they invested a large amount of cultivation resources on the iron-eating beast.
Generally speaking, race level determined the upper and lower limit of growth.
For example, if a creature’s species level was at the transcendent rank, with sufficient nutrition and good growth, it really wasn’t difficult for it to fully reach the transcendent level. It was just a matter of time.
However, when the growth level exceeded his race level, it was very difficult to continue growing. The growth difficulty would gradually increase.
At that time, the resources needed to be invested in training would increase by several times. It was much more expensive than the cost of training high-level pets.
However, under such restrictions, Lin Hongnian actually cultivated the iron-eating beast of a middle-level transcendent race to nearly the level of a monarch.
If it weren’t for the racial restrictions, Lin Hongnian would even be willing to spend a lot of money to smash the iron-eating beast to the level of a monarch.
After all, a pet that grew to the level of a monarch was the standard for a normal master-level Beast Tamer.
Before deciding on a feasible plan, Hall Master Lin had already dared to smash so many resources on the iron-eating beast. Now that he had a concrete plan, he naturally dared to invest even more resources.
“That’s good. I’ll go to the ancient capital now!”
At the moment, nothing was more important than the Iron Eater’s evolution.
…
In the suburbs of Ancient Capital, at the ruins of Iron-eating Beasts.
After informing her father, she fell into deep thought.
“How is it?”
On Shi Yu and Panda’s side, they completed the interrogation at almost the same time.
“Director Li said that Ancient Capital University will provide us with some technical support.”
“We will invite experts to help us forge alloy battle armor,” Shi Yu said.
Those metal ores were all high-level resources with very strange attributes. It was not easy to forge alloys.
At least, students like Shi Yu and the others definitely couldn’t operate it alone.
“My father also said he would rush over immediately.”
“In that case, as long as the evolution method is correct, it’s basically stable?” Zheng Yingjie asked.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu.
Therefore, after speaking for a long time, it still depended on whether the evolution method was reliable.
“Don’t worry, history won’t deceive people.”
Shi Yu was rather confident.
However, if the ruins dared to deceive him, he would definitely come here and say strange things for a month before leaving.
He would get revenge.
“It’s getting late. Let’s go eat,” Shi Yu said as he touched his stomach.
Everyone: “Seconded!”
…
That day, Hall Master Lin arrived at the ancient capital.
It was unknown if he used the master-level privilege to jump in line or flew over with his flying pet.
After everyone arrived, Shi Yu, Senior Panda, the Archeological Seven Elites, Mentor Ding, Director Li, and Hall Master Lin gathered in one of the lecture rooms of Ancient Capital University.
Apart from them, there was also an expert invited by Director Li at the scene. He was a Mechanic.
For a powerful Mechanic, being proficient in materials science and forging was also a basic skill. For example, those mechanical life pets were all created by them.
For them, as long as they had the materials, it wasn’t difficult to create a Gundam with their bare hands.
High-level Mechanics were elite talents even rarer than Dragon Tamers. Usually, the rarity of a Mechanic was at least one level higher than a Beast Tamer who specialized in other pets.
“This is Dean Hao, the dean of our Ancient Capital University’s Mechanical College, a top-level Mechanic.”
Director Li introduced them very politely.
“Nice to meet you, Dean Hao!”
Hall Master Lin was flattered. He didn’t expect that the research on the iron-eating beast’s evolution this time would actually be made into such a big scene by Shi Yu, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others.
One was the dean of the Archeology Department of the Ancient Capital University, the other the dean of the Ancient Capital University’s Mechanical College. Even if all the presidents of the associations in Icefield City were added together, they wouldn’t be as impressive as the two of them.
“Master Lin, you’re welcome.”
Dean Hao was in his thirties, but he didn’t look old. He smiled and looked at everyone, especially at Shi Yu, who was sitting with Lin Xiuzhu, the Archeological Seven Elites, and the others.
He knew that this group of people had gathered here because of Shi Yu.
He came because of Shi Yu’s identity.
When Dean Hao heard that this project was led by a small member of Bureau 11 who would join Ancient Capital University in the future, he immediately decided to help without a word.
Although at his level, everyone was equal even when facing official members of Bureau 11, this didn’t stop him from doing this small member a favor.
Besides, Director Li had also asked him for help. It was common for the departments of Ancient Capital University to cooperate with each other, so there was no need to refuse.
Everyone quickly got to the point.
“If you have that metal piece as a reference, it’s not very difficult to forge these six materials into alloy equipment.”
“If it goes smoothly, it should be completed in three days.”
“But the wisdom of the ancients is really impressive. After all, even if they use modern technology, it’s not easy to complete such a process.”
Dean Hao immediately reassured everyone.
Anything that an ancient blacksmith could do, they, the modern Mechanics, could do too!
“The problem now is what kind of equipment Master Lin plans to create.”
Everyone looked at Shi Yu and Hall Master Lin. After all, according to the information provided by Shi Yu, the evolution of the iron-eating beast had no requirements for the style of the armor.
Even a pair of sharp claws and a shield could assist the Iron-eating Beast in its evolution.
However, according to the way a normal person thought, they would definitely feel that the more materials they used, the greater the potential after evolution.
In fact, they would even feel that the rarer and higher the level of the materials used, the greater the potential of evolution.
The latter was clearly unreliable. Many pets needed specific materials to evolve. A slight difference might lead to failure.
The same food provided completely different nutrition to humans, animals, and plants. Compatibility and needs were the most important.
There had been countless cases of evolution failures due to the random filling of high-level materials in evolution experiments.
Now that he had confirmed the evolution materials, trying to innovate would be wasting his effort.
However, the current situation was that the types of evolution materials didn’t need to change, but the number of evolution materials seemed to be able to change. The point of quantitative change causing a qualitative change seemed to be feasible.
Shi Yu had already told Hall Master Lin about this.
Regardless of the scale of the battle armor, it could assist in evolution. Everything depended on Hall Master Lin’s choice.
Hall Master Lin said, “Then let’s be fully armed. From top to bottom, head, body, limbs, and claws, we’ll be fully armed.”
He decided to play it big.
After all, the amount of evolution materials might affect the Iron-eating Beast’s potential after evolution.
“In this way, judging from the already confirmed alloy ratio, there are a lot of materials used.” After thinking carefully, Dean Hao estimated a value and said it.
A minimum of nine digits might require evolution materials worth hundreds of millions.
When such a huge amount was said, Shi Yu, Senior Panda, and the seven archeological heroes felt their hearts bleed.
If the evolution failed, would it all go down the drain?
“Why don’t we try a claw?” Shi Yu rubbed his nose. This way, even if we fail, we won’t lose much.
Lin Hongnian: “Then can it still wear new equipment after evolution?”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned and felt that it was impossible.
“That’s it!” Hall Master Lin also gathered his courage. He felt that the family business passed down by his ancestor would probably be completely squandered by him and Lin Xiuzhu to study the evolution of the iron-eating beasts.
However, in order to restore the Iron-eating Beast’s glory, everything was worth it.
Moreover, even if he failed, the alloy battle armor he forged could still be used.
Even if it couldn’t be an evolution tool, it could just wear it like that. It was equivalent to buying a shirt for the iron-eating beast.
Judging from the material of this metal piece, after the Iron-eating Beast wore it, it felt that there was no problem resisting the monarch-level creature skills.
He convinced himself that it wouldn’t be a loss.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt the craziness of the father and daughter and couldn’t help but turn around to look at Eleven on his shoulder.
Good heavens, he was still lamenting the price of the green worm’s evolution materials.
In the end, Eleven’s isn’t cheap either!
Eleven: Sob.
…
Next, with the help of the Mechanical College to forge armor, Shi Yu and the others temporarily placed their focus on researching the evolution of the iron-eating beast.
Not to mention the original team, even Director Li and Mentor Ding came to the scene of the iron-eating beast ruins to investigate again.
The reason was very simple, because the evolution materials of the iron-eating beasts were expensive enough!
Generally speaking, the evolution materials of this level had to be at least at the level of a monarch, right?
If it was successful, this news would appear.
“The Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University had discovered the “method for Iron-eating Beasts to evolve into a monarch race” through archeology. This was undoubtedly big news. Director Li and Mentor Ding had to pay attention.”
“I feel that it’s at least at the low-level monarch level.”
“It’s even possible for it to be at the middle class monarch level.”
“I’ve long felt that the race potential of the Iron-eating Beasts is low. After all, their basic qualities aren’t bad either. Now, it seems that they’re just like the Green Silkworm. They both need to train their race’s prerequisite skills to a certain extent before they can completely unearth their race’s potential through the evolution opportunity.”
Everyone discussed.
Lin Hongnian even smiled the whole time, as if the iron-eating beast had successfully evolved.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “Perhaps it’s the racial potential determined by the number of evolution materials used. For example, if it’s only armed with sharp claws, its species rank might only be commander rank after evolution, but if it’s fully armed, it might be able to reach monarch rank.”
Her point of view was approved by Hall Master Lin. That had to be the case. Otherwise, wouldn’t their money be wasted?
“Shiyu, what do you think?” Hall Master Lin smiled at Shi Yu.
“I think it’s at least the Mythical level,” said Shi Yu.
Everyone: “?”
Eleven:??
Shi Yu: “I’m just kidding.”
Everyone:…
Shi Yu smiled.
However, although it was a joke, was it really a joke?
It had been discovered that there was some connection between this ruin and Earth myth.
In that case, was it possible that the saying that the Iron-eating Beast was Chi You’s mount?
The evolution of the Iron-eating Beasts was almost evolved using various weapons and armor.
Shi Yu felt that this evolution method somewhat matched Chi You’s title of “Armament Master”.
At the same time, it was also recorded in the history of Earth that Chi You was the first to do this. The tribe that forged armor for the iron-eating beasts was also very good at forging alloys.
Therefore, if the two histories were really related, he felt that it wasn’t too much for the Iron-eating Beast to have Mythical potential.
Of course, this potential was definitely not triggered by just a single evolution.
“I actually have another question.”
Shi Yu immediately said.
“That is, what the special inscription on the metal plate means.”
“Could it be a medium to activate a certain skill, or even a requirement for second-stage evolution?” Shi Yu asked.
In the scene he saw, after the iron-eating beasts carved special inscriptions on their bodies, their postures felt like they had undergone a second stage evolution.
It was really hard not to be suspicious.
“This kind of inscription is indeed strange. It’s the first time I’ve seen it, but it’s more likely to be the exclusive symbol of their own tribe,” Director Li said as he looked at the symbol on the mural.
“If a symbol can allow a pet to awaken its skills and evolve again, it’s a little unscientific.”
“Well, it has to be like what Student Shi Yu said. Unless it’s traces are carved with some rare resource, only then can it be possible.” Mentor Ding also judged. “But there are no other components of energy detected on the metal piece.”
It was either other resources or its own claws!
It had to be said that if Shi Yu had not seen the operation of the iron-eating beasts, he would have also thought that what Director Li and Mentor Ding said was scientific.
It was very normal for a tribe to have their own symbol.
Instead, it was unscientific to rely on drawing on oneself to evolve.
“It’s not ugly anyway. When the time comes, if the Iron-eating Beast can really evolve, let it try carving one too. It’ll be a memento,” Lin Hongnian stared at the stone wall and said casually.
Everyone smiled. That was fine too.
They would treat it as thanks that this ruin provided an evolution method.
“The path became wider.” Shi Yu was stunned.
…
Time flew.
In just a day, the Mechanical College had made an alloy battle armor according to Hall Master Lin’s request.
This speed was something Shi Yu and the others did not expect.
Therefore, three days was still a conservative estimate.
Everyone was pleasantly surprised.
It seemed that it was always right to set a few more days to complete an executive task.
It could be a surprise if it was completed in advance.
If the creator didn’t want to rush it, they could take things slow as well.
“How is it, haha!”
In a huge display room of the Mechanical College in Ancient Capital University, an exquisite set of armor was hung on the wall.
The material of the battle armor was more like bronze, its color deeper than bronze, and it was darker than dark green. No, it was more suitable to describe it with dark green.
If one didn’t look carefully, it was actually a black armor.
“Perfect, it feels like the material is exactly the same as that metal piece,” the Archeological Seven Elites exclaimed.
Director Li and Mentor Ding also looked at the armor with interest.
The panda senior’s beautiful eyes even flowed with anticipation as she imagined the scene of the Iron-eating Beast wearing this armor.
Although the panda bed was gone, she felt that it would be very handsome in battle?
“Do you want to experiment with the evolution method you guys are talking about now?” Dean Hao laughed.
He had personally made this armor.
He also wanted to see how this armor could evolve the Iron-eating Beast.
“Hall Master Lin.” Shi Yu looked at Hall Master Lin Hongnian.
At this moment, Lin Hongnian was more nervous than anyone.
Of course, Shi Yu was definitely very nervous too. He asked Eleven on his shoulder telepathically, “How is it? Do you feel handsome?”
“Uncle Lin is using his Iron-eating Beast as an experiment for your future development path.”
“Sob.” Eleven bit its hand and looked at the armor. It kept feeling that eating it was better than wearing…
“Foodie!”
Shi Yu was speechless. “Aren’t you afraid of breaking your teeth!?”
“Let the Iron-eating Beast wear armor and then use the transcendent Level Hardening Fusion Armor, right?” Under everyone’s gaze, Hall Master Lin took a deep breath and nodded. “Then let’s give it a try.”
Then, he started to summon his Iron-eating Beast.
Hu hu hu ~ ~
In the transparent blue circular summoning array, an extremely strong iron-eating beast with a serious expression walked out.
“Wuu!!!”
After it came out, it immediately greeted the big shots present according to the Beast Tamer’s instructions.
Everyone looked at the Iron-eating Beast that had been cultivated to the limit of its species and nodded.
As expected of an iron-eating beast cultivation expert. Ordinary Beast Tamers probably couldn’t nurture this iron-eating beast.
“Put it on yourself.”
Lin Hongnian ordered the Iron-eating Beast. At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast also looked at the battle armor hanging on the wall, and its heart tightened for some reason.
Lin Hongnian had long taught the iron-eating beast how to evolve.
Therefore, at this moment, when it saw this fitting battle armor, the Iron-eating Beast didn’t hesitate much. It directly draped it over itself according to the Beast Tamer’s orders.
Under the sound of metal colliding, the Iron-eating Beast put on its armor and was fully armed. It originally looked very impressive, but now, it looked even more impressive.
“It looks a little like the rune battle bear in World of Warcraft?” Shi Yu looked at it and muttered in his heart. However, the bear in the armor had changed to a panda.
“Wuu!!!”
At this moment, under everyone’s gaze, Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast continued to follow the operation step by step.
After putting on the battle armor, it began to use Transcendent Level Hardening.
Buzz!
In an instant, the hardening substance covered all the armor. This was one of the signs of transcendent hardening. Apply it and apply the hardening substance to other objects.
After this operation, the color of the armor became even darker.
Right on the heels of that, the Iron-eating Beast started the next step. It used the second property of the transcendentX Level Hardening and released it. That was, it released the Hardening Material to fill the gap between itself and the armor, allowing the armor to completely merge with itself through Hardening!
After this operation, in the eyes of everyone, the Iron-eating Beast seemed to have really become one with the armor. Both parties were incomparably coordinated!
At this moment, an exciting scene appeared.
“Wuu!!!”
The Iron-eating Beast was first stunned. Then, its body began to emit a powerful aura!
Everyone took a step back and looked at it in shock.
Following that, the iron-eating beast’s body began to suffuse a white light, undergoing growth and transformation. It could also be said to have broken through!
No, while it was growing and transforming, it was still evolving!!
“Wuu!!!!” With a roar, the Iron-eating Beast’s body kept growing and enlarging under the cover of the light. In the blink of an eye, even its previous battle armor became nearly three meters tall!!
The light faded, and the three-meter-tall Iron-eating Beast appeared in front of everyone. The unscientific thing was that not only did the Iron-eating Beast become bigger, but its armor also became bigger in proportion!
“Success???!”
Everyone looked at the iron-eating beast with shocked expressions.
Especially Dean Hao, Dean Li, Mentor Ding, and the others, they all sensed the current state of the iron-eating beast!
It had broken through to the monarch level!
It was very difficult for a pet of an extraordinary race to break through to the level of a monarch. Right now, the greatest possibility for it to break through so smoothly was that the iron-eating beast had successfully completed its evolution. The increase in race level led to the increase in growth level!
The power just now was… the deterrence skill that was awakening!
Everyone looked at Hall Master Lin. At this moment, only Hall Master Lin Hongnian, who was contracted with the iron-eating beast, could understand its state the best.
“It really evolved…”
“Monarch level!”
Lin Hongnian was stunned for a long time. Then, he was overjoyed. He wished he could kiss Shi Yu, who had provided him with the evolution method!
“Not only did it evolve, it also broke through. Apart from awakening deterrence, it also awakened three new skills!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - Iron-eating Beasts Second Stage Evolution Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Iron-eating Beast’s Second Stage Evolution Method
“What skill?!”
As Lin Hongnian spoke, everyone was stunned and then quickly asked.
Good lord.
Apart from the deterrence skill that would definitely be awakened when its growth level reached the monarch level, it had actually awakened three new skills in one go. It seemed that the evolution this time had improved the Iron-eating Beast’s race by a lot!
The key now was the level of these three new racial skills.
After a pet evolved, one of the most direct ways to determine the pet’s new potential was to see if its newly awakened racial skills were strong!
“I…”
As he received the feedback from the iron-eating beast, Lin Hongnian was so excited that he couldn’t say anything.
“Three new skills, one mid-level, one high-level, and one super!”
Things were taking off!
“Stop beating around the bush! Tell me!” Lin Xiuzhu couldn’t help but glare at her father.
“Intermediate-level skill is Giant Transformation!”
Skill: Giant Transformation
Skill Level: Intermediate
< Introduction > It’s a special ability. It can expand the body. Under the enlarged state, the energy consumption will increase and the strength will increase.
Everyone: “?”
Shi Yu: “?”
This mid-level skill was actually not bad. Lin Hongnian was very satisfied at the start.
However, as he saw the strange expressions of everyone, he suddenly realized that something was wrong.
He looked at the shrunken Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder and fell into deep thought.
Eleven: Sob (???)?
“Wait!!”
Lin Hongnian suddenly said, “Why can Iron-eating Beasts who have awakened their ancient evolution bloodlines learn the multiplication of the high-level version of Giant Transformation, while Iron-eating Beasts who have truly evolved can only awaken Giant Transformation??”
He discovered the blind spot.
Everyone also looked at Shi Yu and Eleven, causing Shi Yu to fall into deep thought.
Amazing…
Senior Panda and the others had been imagining the ancient evolution form. In the end, the Iron-eating Beast really awakened a similar skill?
What was this evolution up to, going so half hearted with the giant skill?
“Perhaps Eleven’s talent is better? Hall Master Lin, you can bring the Iron-eating Beast to soak in the holy spring when you have time,” Shi Yu suggested.
If the Ancient Life Tree let him.
Lin Hongnian was silent.
“What about high-level and super-level skills???” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
Lin Hongnian no longer thought about the trouble of enlarging and multiplying. He took a deep breath and said, “High-level skill, Impregnable, of the metal element. Super-level skill, Inner Power, of the metal element!”
Skill: Impregnable
Skill Level: Advanced
[Introduction]: A metal-type skill. The user is protected by the metal-type power, increasing resistance to all types of skills.
This was a hardening upper-level skill.
Hardening usually only had a relatively good resistance to physical attacks, but Impregnable was different. Along with various elemental attacks, control skills, and skills targeting the spirit and soul, it had an extremely high resistance effect.
It could be said that it was a comprehensive skill that increased the Iron-eating Beast’s ability to take hits.
Skill: inner Power
[Skill Level]: Super Level
< Introduction > It’s a metal-type skill. It can enter a reserved state and assess the source of its power. It can accumulate power that exceeds its own limit and won’t affect its own state. Under the sharp state, it can multiply the power accumulated and increase its attack power by several times, but it will pose a certain burden to the body.
“Holy shit.”
After Hall Master Lin finished speaking, Dean Hao, Dean Li, and Mentor Ding were still alright, but Qi Yingjie was immediately shocked.
“He actually awakened the skill of Inner Power?” Zheng Yingjie opened his mouth wide.
This skill could be said to be a divine skill of the metal element.
Firstly, this skill could maximize the improvement of the pet’s physical fitness!
Ordinary pets would be full after eating one energy crystal and wouldn’t be able to eat anymore. But after mastering the skill of converging sharpness, it was completely no problem for pets to eat ten or a hundred energy crystals.
In addition, the pets would not be unable to digest it, nor would they waste the power of the energy crystal. Instead, they would store this energy steadily in their bodies.
In battle, be it mobilizing this stored power slowly or erupting in one go, it could be done.
This was the most classic battle skill. Not only could it allow pets to have hidden physical fitness that far exceeded creatures of the same level, but it could also give pets the power to fight above their level!
“Hardening, Giant Transformation, Impregnable, Inner Power…”
“After the Iron-eating Beast evolved, it was simply a super battle beast born for battle, no, for war,” Dean Hao sighed. Director Li and Mentor Ding agreed deeply.
At this moment, the Archeological Seven Elites rubbed their hands in envy.
Senior Panda was also a little excited. Her body trembled continuously.
Awakening a super skill after evolution meant that the current iron-eating beast’s racial potential level was definitely above the monarch level.
Could her Iron-eating Beast become so strong in the future?
“Wuu!!!” Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast was also very excited. It felt that endless power was bursting out of its body!
It glanced at Eleven, wanting to feel the envy of its own kind…
“Sob.” However, Eleven shook his head.
It just had three more skills. Eleven had nothing but skills! He had too much!
Iron-eating Beast:…
At this moment, the happiest person was Lin Hongnian himself.
“Inner Power.”
He smiled and looked at the iron-eating beast.
The Iron Eater nodded.
Then, under everyone’s gaze, it returned to its previous appearance before evolution.
The armor on his body disappeared, and its body size returned to normal.
This was the reserved effect of a transcendent skill’s ability to restrain its edge, which was to put away its own edge.
“Can one return to their pre-evolution state?!”
Shi Yu had been silent all this while, but at that moment, he was suddenly stunned. His eyes widened.
“Yeah, this is the magical thing about this super skill.” Director Li chuckled.
“It’s simply a divine skill to “pretend to be a pig to eat a tiger”. Speaking of which, if it’s used in combination with the shrinking of your Iron-eating Beast, will it have any miraculous effect?”
After being stunned, Shi Yu’s emotions finally fluctuated.
Damn, this restrained state could actually devolve?
Was it that good?
“Great!” At the same time, Lin Xiuzhu could not help but shout.
In this way, wouldn’t the Iron-eating Beast have two forms??
In the future, she seemed to be able to let the iron-eating beast evolve without any worries.
Only, it was a pity that the Iron-Eating Beast would only expand after evolution and not shrink. She was very hungry for Eleven’s multiplication skill.
“Looks like we don’t have any worries anymore…”
Shi Yu also had the same thought as Lin Xiuzhu.
At this moment, even if it evolved, there was still the Panda Accessory and the Panda Bed!
It was indeed a divine skill!
Shi Yu hinted at Eleven on his shoulder. He felt that he still had to spend money and add points…
Eleven: Sob.
At this moment, everyone looked at Hall Master Lin’s iron-eating beast with mixed emotions.
Perhaps this was the first iron-eating beast to evolve in this era?
Lin Hongnian Hall Master was about to be famous. Shi Yu, who had discovered the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution path, was also going to be famous!
Everyone was filled with emotions, but at this moment, Shi Yu suddenly thought of something and felt that the matter wasn’t over.
“Wait!”
Shi Yu suddenly looked at Hall Master Lin and said, “Do you want to try carving a special symbol on a metal-eating beast?”
“I still feel that the inscription symbol is the key to the iron-eating beast’s transformation again, and not as simple as the tribal mark.”
Stunned, Hall Master Lin nodded and chose to believe Shi Yu.
“But how should I carve it?”
Shi Yu suggested, “Hardened claws.”
When everyone saw that Shi Yu was so determined, they couldn’t help but raise their spirits again.
Could it be that there was something special about that symbol?
“Then let’s try it according to Shi Yu.”
Now that the evolution method Shi Yu had confirmed had been proven, trusting Shi Yu again didn’t seem to be a big deal.
Director Hao brought over a metal piece.
The Iron-eating Beast also returned to its huge armed form.
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast looked at the special symbol on the metal piece and then looked at its armor, falling into deep thought.
Were they really going to carve this thing?
“Let’s give it a try.” Lin Hongnian laughed and said indifferently. Whether it was successful or not, carving it was nothing.
“Wuu!!”
The Iron-eating Beast nodded and hardened its claws. As if copying it, it followed the special symbols on the metal plate and started to carve symbols on the armor…
Screech!
However, in the next second, an unexpected scene appeared.
The iron-eating beast’s sharp claws, which had been enhanced by Transcendent Level Hardening, actually couldn’t leave any marks on the armor at all!
One had to know that the current armor had not been hardened and strengthened.
“It’s that hard?” Director Li was slightly shocked.
This defense…
Without using any skills, its body’s strength had exceeded transcendent?
Was it going to compete with a giant dragon in physical fitness?
Screech!
“Wuu!!”
The iron-eating beast’s expression changed. It tried again, but it still couldn’t carve it at all.
“Looks like I have to carve it with something harder.” Dean Hao fell into deep thought.
While everyone was shocked by the defensive power of the iron-eating beast’s armor, only the iron-eating beast, Lin Hongnian, and Shi Yu’s expressions were wrong.
“No, that’s not right.” Lin Hongnian’s expression was solemn.
“No, the strength of the Transcendent Level Hardened Claw is clearly above the armor.”
“The Iron-eating Beast said that there seemed to be a repulsive force between its claws and armor, preventing it from leaving a mark on the armor!”
“What?”
As soon as Hall Master Lin finished speaking, everyone was stunned.
What was this, a self-protection mechanism?
“Could it be that this inscription really has some mysterious magic power?”
Previously, everyone thought that the special symbol didn’t have any special meaning. Now, as they discovered this strange phenomenon, anyone who wasn’t a fool could sense that something was wrong.
This was not a matter of whether the claws were hard enough.
Instead, why would there be a rejection reaction between the hardened claws and the armor?
Everyone frowned. Could it be that Shi Yu was right?
What was so special about that inscription?
Otherwise, if it was just a simple inscription, why couldn’t the Iron-eating Beast engrave it!
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
That shouldn’t be the case.
In the historical video he saw, that group of Iron-eating Beasts had used their super hard claws to carve inscriptions on their armor. There was definitely no mistake!
The iron-eating beasts’ drawing movements were like flowing water. No matter how one looked at it, it didn’t look like there was any obstruction.
At that moment, Shi Yu kept feeling that he had not noticed the key points. What was wrong… Slowly, as Shi Yu looked at Master Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast, he was stunned.
Skill: Hardening
Status: Can be taught
Just like facing the transcendent-level worm silk of the Green silkworm, even though Master Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast had mastered transcendent-level racial skills, the skill index still showed that it could be taught!
After being stunned for a moment, Shi Yu said soberly, “Speaking of which, could it be that the proficiency of hardening isn’t enough?”
“Is there any higher proficiency above Transcendent Level Hardening…”
“I feel that the breakthrough in racial skills again and the qualitative change might be the key to the Iron-eating Beast’s transformation again! Perhaps, when the time comes, the inscription won’t have any rejection reaction.”
This time, Shi Yu’s train of thought immediately opened up. He had a feeling that something was wrong and that his deduction was definitely correct!
It might be the key to the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution!
Monarch level was just the starting point!
The future was really legendary!
When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone’s expressions were odd.
Dean Hao explained, “Entry, proficient, expert, perfect, and transcendent. Although the names of each level are different in various eras, the ability of the pet seems to be these five levels from the beginning to the end. Perfection represents the peak of skill. Transcendence means that it has broken through the original upper limit of the skill.”
“As for higher levels, there’s no such thing. There hasn’t been any record of it since ancient times… nor have any Beast Tamer pets reached that level.”
“This isn’t realistic. Why don’t we try carving with other tools?”
The corners of Lin Hongnian’s mouth twitched. He didn’t know if he should believe Shi Yu.
At this point, why didn’t he say that the Iron-eating Beast could evolve again after eating Venus, then?
Even if it was true, it was impossible to achieve.
Using such an unscientific evolutionary condition to entice him to have expectations for the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast’s form, wasn’t this taking his life, making him and the Iron-eating Beast train non-stop for the next 24 hours?
As everyone refuted the unscientific, Shi Yu fell silent.
He still stubbornly believed that his deduction was right.
Moreover, was it very difficult to reach transcendent in the first place?

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - Name of Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Name of Evolution
“I should use other tools to see if I can carve it.”
Dean Hao and the others were interested.
He had originally thought that the Iron-eating Beast’s first evolution was the end. From the looks of it, it was really as Shi Yu had said. There were still other secrets hidden on the Iron-eating Beast!
“I can help.”
A small summoning array appeared in Dean Hao’s palm.
He reached out and pulled out a tool in the shape of a sword hilt. Then, a pale yellow laser suddenly appeared on the hilt.
< Name > Laser Sword
[Attributes]: Machinery, Light
[Race Level]: High-level commander
[Introduction]: Artificial Light Sword Lifeform.
“Damn, so handsome.”
Seeing Dean Hao with the laser sword in hand, Zheng Yingjie and the other boys widened their eyes and drooled.
Was this not more amazing than the beast-eared girl?
As expected of a top-notch Mechanic, he really knew how to play. He actually contracted a lightsaber.
Shi Yu glanced sideways. Good heavens, there was actually such a mechanical life form.
He was quite curious now. If Beast Tamers had a combination talent and contracted a laser sword, would they need other pets?
How envious.
“Do we use this?” Seeing that Dean Hao took the initiative to help, Hall Master Lin nodded.
“Alright, please.”
The Iron Eater looked at the laser sword in confusion.??
It felt alright to make a move by itself, but wasn’t it a little too much to use a sword!
“Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.” Dean Hao laughed.
“Wuu…” The newly evolved iron-eating beast was still a little nervous, but it still nodded in pain.
Then, with a flash of sword light, the laser sword left a scar on the iron-eating beast’s armor without any resistance.
The scar was the special symbol on the metal piece.
This time, neither the Iron-eating Beast nor the laser sword felt any obstacles during the carving process.
But similarly, after carving the symbol, the Iron-eating Beast didn’t change at all.
This made everyone fall into deep thought.
Therefore, the current suspicious point was indeed the rejection reaction between hardening and the armor.
Then, Hall Master Lin instructed the Iron-eating Beast to make a few more attempts.
No matter what, the outcome was still the same.
“From the looks of it, the symbol shouldn’t be as simple as the battle emblem and symbol of the tribe.”
“If you just want to carve a battle emblem, you can totally carve it through other things like Dean Hao.”
“And according to my investigation, this special symbol should have been carved by the iron-eating beast with its hardened claws.”
“Since it’s so difficult for iron-eating beasts to carve marks on themselves, why do they still insist on carving such symbols on their bodies?”
Shi Yu crossed his arms. He still wanted to know what these symbols represented.
“Wuu!!!” Hall Master Lin’s Iron-eating Beast also suffered from obsessive-compulsive disorder.
It tried its best to leave marks on its body, but it couldn’t do it.
Hall Master Lin was also conflicted. What was going on?
Originally, the evolution of the Iron-eating Beasts and the awakening of new racial skills was double the joy.
Why did such a question that couldn’t be verified appear again? It made him feel very uncomfortable.
Shi Yu’s words triggered everyone’s discussion.
“No matter how I look at it, this is another new problem…” Director Li fell into deep thought.
Discovering an evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast through the metal piece seemed to be just the tip of the iceberg of this ruin.
What to explore next was the secret of the iron-eating beast’s evolution and the secret of the inscription.
No wonder Shi Yu said that this ruin was not simple.
The evolution of the iron-eating beasts into a monarch race was actually just the starting point of research?
The corners of Lin Hongnian’s mouth twitched. “Don’t tell me it’s really like what Shi Yu said, a racial skill with proficiency above transcendent?”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s definitely impossible to confirm this at the moment, but we can’t eliminate the possibility.”
“The iron-eating beast has just evolved, so it must have a lot of secrets. If I want to be completely sure, I must explore it step by step.”
“Why don’t we form a metal-eating beast research team and study it together?”
Shi Yu suggested that he study the route of proficiency above transcendent himself. The other possibilities were left to Senior Panda and Hall Master Lin to explore.
The division of labor was clear!
It was very normal for a new pet race to appear with a large amount of unknown information.
At the moment, the thousands of creatures known to human Beast Tamers were also researched and researched by predecessors.
Now that the iron-eating beast had just evolved, it was not strange for it to have unsolved mysteries.
If it were Shi Yu himself, he definitely wouldn’t have the energy to explore completely, but in this aspect, Hall Master Lin should be very energetic. After all, this was his true passion.
Mentor Ding said, “Sure, count me in? Actually, we’re already very lucky.”
“At least, it discovered an exploration route just after it evolved.”
Chief Li also said, “I’m also quite curious.”
“Does Hall Master Lin want to cooperate with Ancient Capital University to study the evolution of the iron-eating beasts?”
“You’re welcome.”
Hall Master Lin said, “I should be the one thanking all of you for your help.”
Dean Hao laughed and said, “Count me in too.”
In a few words, the few master-level Beast Tamers confirmed that they wanted to explore the secret of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.
Senior Panda and the archeological Seven Elites were beside him and couldn’t say a word.
Their seniority was too low, so they felt that they couldn’t be of much help.
“Forget it, why don’t we put the inscription matter aside first? We’ll study it in the future. This shouldn’t be something that can be explored in a day or two. Speaking of which, shouldn’t the iron-eating beasts have a new race name after evolution?”
“This is the most important thing now…”
Usually, when pets completed their racial evolution, it was a tradition to change the name of a new species.
Although the Iron-eating Beast could still recover to its original form with its skills after evolution, it was already a little unsuitable to call it an Iron-eating Beast.
“If we want to announce the new evolution form, we do need a new name.” Dean Hao nodded.
Hall Master Lin looked at Shi Yu and said, “How about handing this naming right to Shi Yu?”
Although his Iron-eating Beast was the first to complete its evolution, Shi Yu seemed to be the most suitable person to name it after its evolution.
After all, this time, it was the evolution method provided by Shi Yu.
“Me??” Shi Yu was stunned.
Although there was a saying that good names would make a person become great… His naming skill was horrible.
Was he really going to let him do this?
“What do you think?” At the mention of naming, the panda senior was interested.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “Armored Iron-eating Beast? Armed Iron-eating Beast? Amor Iron-eating Beast? Mega Iron-eating Beast? Primordial Return to Iron-eating Beast?”
Everyone :”…”
Hall Master Lin: “Let’s think about it together.”
Everyone nodded in unison.
Master Lin’s Iron-eating Beast and Eleven also nodded.
For the future reputation of the Iron-eating Beast race, it was better not to give this difficult task to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was helpless. Damn, he might as well call them giant pandas or Panda Kings. Apart from being a little out of character, everything else was fine.
“How about the gold-eating beast? After all, the price to evolve once is not small.”
Only then did Hall Master Lin feel some pain.
He seemed to have paid a lot of money this time. This name was very artistic.
“It’s not nice.”
Lin Xiuzhu was the first to object. Besides, wasn’t that her dowry?
“Iron-Swallowing Beast?”
“Iron-eating Monarch?”
“Iron giant beast?”
“…”
Everyone offered their names, but the more they discussed, the more ridiculous it became.
Only then did Shi Yu realize that he wasn’t the only one who had horrible naming skills.
These names didn’t sound as good as his.
“Forget it, I’ll do it.”
At this moment, after careful consideration, Shi Yu had another suggestion.
“After the Iron-eating Beast evolved, its appearance changed from its previous gluttonous and lazy appearance. Then, it must change to a name that suits its temperament. How about battle beast? Battle beasts that are specially born for war and battle. Then, add a prefix to the front of battle beas.”
“We found nine special symbols in this ruin. Perhaps it’s related to the iron-eating beasts. In addition, the alloy color of the alloy they used for evolution is dark, and the word ‘Li’ means black. Why don’t we call it ‘Nine Li Battle Beast’?”
Nine Li Battle Beast?
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, everyone was stunned. To be honest, they felt that the aura matched with the iron-eating beast in armor.
“Although it’s a little forced, it sounds pretty good?” Master Lin nodded.
It was better than the Armored Iron-eating Beast Shi Yu had mentioned previously…
“…” Shi Yu smiled. This was not direct, but had great meaning!
Nine Li was the tribe of Infantry Master Chi You. Legend had it that the Iron-eating Beast was Chi You’s mount. The Iron-eating Beast to evolve into a Nine Li battle beast. It was purely to commemorate the myths on Earth.
In addition, it was equivalent to hoping that the iron-eating beasts in this world really had mythical potential.
“If you can’t think of anything better, let’s do this.” Senior Panda stroked her chin and pondered. Wasn’t there a cute name?
“Not yet, pending, pending.”
Everyone discussed for a while and felt that the name of the Nine Li War Beast was feasible. However, there was no hurry to name it at the moment. That was after the evolution was announced. The subsequent publicizing process, just the procedures alone, would probably take at least a few months.
In this world, Beast Tamers had two choices regarding the evolution method.
One was to treat the evolution method as his own and pass it down in the way of family and master and disciple, not publicizing it.
Generally, this kind of evolution method was explored personally.
One was to directly publicize the evolution method to the country and apply for a patent to become an honorary evolution planner of this evolution path in exchange for fame and benefits.
90% of Beast Tamers who had mastered evolutionary knowledge chose the former, and a small number of Beast Tamers chose the latter.
Most of the people who chose the latter had a monopoly on certain evolution resources or pets. There were greater benefits to be had.
Or, that person was an expert who got paid by the country.
Whether it was Bureau 11 or Ancient Capital University, they were clearly national institutions. The discovery of the iron-eating beast’s evolution was the result of everyone’s hard work. It had to be announced.
At that time, once the iron-eating beast evolution paper was published, regardless of whether it was Shi Yu, Hall Master Lin, or Ancient Capital University, they could obtain huge fame and benefits.
Especially Shi Yu, who had confirmed the evolution method. At his age, he would probably instantly become a new star in the archeological research world.
“Looks like I have to stay in the ancient capital for a while…” Hall Master Lin sighed.
The process of applying for the evolution patent was very complicated. They would probably be busy next.
“I’ll leave this matter to everyone.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I don’t have any experience, so I won’t interfere. I’ll leave the study of the iron-eating beast’s evolution to everyone first.”
Everyone: “?”
Aren’t you the person in charge of this project?
What was the meaning of this? Was he going to let go of his responsibility?
“There are still three months before the vocation assessment. I haven’t even reached the passing line for registration. I plan to cultivate seriously for a period of time…”
“Otherwise, I feel like I’ll have to wait until next year.”
Shi Yu gave a reason, but most of it was because he wanted to go back and explore the proficiency above transcendent himself.
This was a huge project, and also a relatively important research route… He needed to have sufficient time to recuperate. In addition, he needed to meditate to increase his Beast Taming level, so he couldn’t find the time to study the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution with everyone.
It was more suitable for him to wait for the ready-made research results and gains.
“Uh, vocational assessment?”
Director Li and the others were stunned. They had almost forgotten that Shi Yu was still a Beast Tamer intern.
“It’s alright. Your own development is the most important.” Hall Master Lin nodded.
Shi Yu’s Little Iron Eating Beast was still very, very far away from evolution. It was indeed not important for it to upgrade itself by investing so much energy into researching evolution forms so early. He should do the research first.
Hall Master Lin felt that when Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast reached the evolution criteria, he should be able to help Shi Yu plan the most perfect evolution method.
He had to thank Shi Yu for successfully evolving the iron-eating beast. The best way to thank him was to help Shi Yu perfect the evolution path and provide him with convenience in the future.
“The vocation assessment happens once a year. Missing it will indeed have a greater impact.”
“Moreover, if I take the normal admission route, my professional identity is also necessary…”
After Shi Yu confirmed that he wanted to be a boss who left everything to others and concentrate on preparing for the vocation assessment, no one had any objections. They even agreed very much.
Everyone’s attention was quickly attracted by what happened next.
“Dean Hao, is there a suitable battlefield here? I want to see the current strength of the Iron-eating Beast,” Hall Master Lin said with anticipation.
Dean Hao laughed and expressed his understanding. “Of course.”
“You’re not the only one. We want to see it too. Let’s go.”
…
In the mechanical school, Dean Hao activated the technologically advanced steel arena to use on the battlefield for Hall Master Lin.
At this moment, apart from the Iron-eating Beasts present, Hall Master Lin summoned his nominal trump card that helped him become a master-level Beast Tamer, a pet that had grown into a monarch-level pet, the Diamond Ape King.
“Monkey, the Iron-eating Beast has finally evolved.”
“Come, test its strength.”
“Wait, it’s not a battle. Don’t move first. Try its attack power first.”
The Diamond Ape King: “?”
On the battlefield, the huge Golden-Furred Ape King fell into deep thought.
It looked at the impressive and domineering armed Iron-eating Beast in front of it. It immediately understood that this day had come.
Their feelings for each other had faded.
His Tamer was going to change his trump card.
New things were always better than old things.

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - Shi Yus Breakthrough and Contracting Buggy
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Shi Yu’s Breakthrough and Contracting Buggy
18th September.
Half a month had passed since Shi Yu arrived at the Ancient Capital.
In this time, Shi Yu had gained a lot.
Although the strength of the two pets did not clearly improve, he had gained quite a lot.
Firstly, he had learned the ability to turn ethereal.
With the help of the beast-eared senior and the internet addict granny, he could now jump around among a group of low-level pets for a few minutes. Things were going well.
This ability was very useful to Shi Yu!
Secondly, by exploring the ruins of the iron-eating beasts, he had discovered the evolutionary form of the iron-eating beasts and enriched Eleven’s future path along with his own.
At the same time, Shi Yu began to take this world’s legends and history seriously.
What was the connection between this place and Earth?
“Putting aside the pause in the transformation, the Impregnable skill is much more comprehensive than the hardening ability… Most importantly, the two techniques have different principles and can be overlaid! It’s simply making the iron-eating beast harden even more.”
“However, the strongest skill is still the Inner Power skill. Among the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, every attribute has its own special nature. The nature of metal is heavy, murderous, restrained, sharp, and so on.”
“The ability to restrain one’s sharpness using Inner Power perfectly contains two special properties. It’s completely a core technique of the metal element. As expected of a super level technique.”
On the plane, Shi Yu recalled the battle between Master Lin Hongnian’s Diamond Ape King and the iron-eating beast, and his heart surged.
The Iron-eating Beast had just evolved and broken through. It wasn’t familiar with its skills yet, so it was definitely not a match for the veteran monarch-level creature, the Diamond Ape King.
Normally speaking, that was the case, but through the super skill of Inner Power, Master Lin Hongnian only provided some metal-element energy crystals. After the iron-eating beast accumulated enough energy, the battle situation was almost reversed in an instant.
The Diamond Ape King was actually directly suppressed by the Iron-eating Beast’s sharp outburst!
“This skill is suitable for rich Beast Tamers.”
Shi Yu looked at the blue sky and white clouds outside the window. He felt that he couldn’t afford to play around with this skill at the moment.
Inner Power. It was nothing more than the crooked words “paywalls”.
There was nothing wrong with paying money for a metal-element super skill.
“Sigh.”
As he sighed, Little Eleven and the Green Silkworm also looked out the window.
At this moment, they were all released by Shi Yu to sense the feeling of flying.
Thinking that the two pets had never taken a plane, Shi Yu simply let them come out and experience it too.
At the moment, they were on the way back to Icefield City.
Although the ancient capital was good, Shi Yu really couldn’t stretch out outside and couldn’t cultivate in peace. As expected, he still liked to stay home and cultivate.
It was more comfortable to lie at home during recuperation.
Therefore, after handing the research on the iron-eating beast’s evolution to Master Lin Hongnian and the others, he slipped back first.
Shi Yu had originally planned to stay in the Ancient Capital for half a month, but it was about time now. If he stayed there to fool around, he would definitely miss his vocation assessment.
As for the research on the evolution of the iron-eating beasts, it was not urgent, because it was useless to be anxious… After he maximized Eleven’s hardening, he would study it together.
“Wuu.”
“Ji!”
At this moment, Eleven and the Green Silkworm were discussing something fiercely.
About “flying”.
Although the green worm was an insect, it would definitely fly after transforming into a butterfly or a moth.
Even now, it could fly with its phantom ability.
However, in the face of the insect’s question, the stronger leader, Eleven, fell into deep thought.
How could it fly?
Metal Wings? Electric magnetic levitation? No way…
Maybe one day it would learn a flying skill…
…
That day, Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng.
Because he had left for more than half a month, he definitely had to clean up the villa when he came back to stay this time.
Shi Yu handed this difficult task to Eleven and the bugs to train their life abilities.
Pets that were only good at battle weren’t good enough. Pets had to develop in all aspects. It would be best if they could wash, cook, and earn money to support the family.
As for himself, he made a call and reserved Eleven’s food from the Bamboo Stone Dojo.
“Hall Master Lin seems to have paid a lot of money this time. Can Bamboo Stone Dojo still afford to feed so many people?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. However, the problem didn’t seem big?
Soon, the price of the iron-eating beasts would increase, especially the iron-eating beasts in the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base!
After all, Hall Master Lin’s iron-eating beast was the first iron-eating beast to evolve. Could the iron-eating beasts sold or found elsewhere compare to the iron-eating beasts raised by Hall Master Lin’s family?
Although the real difference might not be much, sometimes, the brand effect was just so unreasonable.
Assuming that the price of the iron-eating beasts increased from the original hundreds of thousands to one million, the eight hundred-plus iron-eating beasts in the Iron Bamboo Feeding Base would be eight hundred million. In addition, they could also sell some accompanying food or even secret manuals for iron-eating beasts. Their assets would probably exceed ten digits.
“How nice…”
When Shi Yu recalled how good Senior Panda was at controlling the family and even wanted to sell him the panda costume, he immediately felt that the Iron Bamboo Feeding Base would definitely make a killing.
As expected, he was the only one who was poor.
Shi Yu thought about his little vault silently. The 10,000,000 yuan that Senior Lu had given him, together with the 1,000,000 yuan that the Ping Cheng Association had given him, was a total of 11,000,000 yuan. Now, there was less than 6,000,000 yuan left.
In addition, in the aspect of supplements, as he added some points to Eleven and the Green Silkworm, together with the consumption of practicing etherealization for the past half a month, there was almost none left.
Shi Yu immediately felt that he was being too extravagant.
In the past two months, he had actually eaten four million yuan just by eating supplements.
The other million was to buy the Space Crystal Fruit for the worm to increase its spatial compatibility.
In just a few months, whoosh, five million was gone.
This was even under the circumstances that Bamboo Stone Dojo had always provided Eleven with food.
Shi Yu felt that at this rate, unless he married into the Bamboo Stone Dojo, the remaining money might not be enough for him to spend…
“There’s no hurry. The ice-element energy crystal in the ruins bead is dispensable. It can be exchanged for other resources.”
“But it still doesn’t feel enough. Looks like in the end, I still have to sell the worm silk?”
Shi Yu turned his attention to the worm again. The spatial-type super worm silk could definitely be sold for a good price.
After all, it was the only one in the world. It wasn’t excessive for one to cost tens of thousands, right?
Shi Yu looked at the insect that was cleaning the fallen leaves.
Buggy shuddered and turned around.
Shi Yu: (??????)??
Green Silkworm: 〒▽〒?
…
If necessary, he would definitely have to sacrifice Buggy.
But now, it wasn’t very urgent.
Shi Yu felt that he wouldn’t be using supplements for the time being.
Seeing his funds decrease, Shi Yu became smarter.
He planned to use the Space Crystal to cultivate first and raise the level of the Beast Taming Space to level two. Then, he would add points to Eleven and Buggy.
After the Beast Taming Space level rose to level two, his physical fitness would increase noticeably and take a qualitative leap.
Unlike the previous quantitative change, this time, it was a qualitative change.
It was roughly equivalent to breaking through to the transcendent level during the Awakening Stage!
At that time, the cooldown time after the addition of points should be significantly reduced. He could probably save a lot of supplements.
At the same time, after his Beast Tamer level increased, he could also contract the worm. Moreover, the page number of the skill index could finally increase again.
Therefore, after weighing the pros and cons, Shi Yu decided to prioritize increasing his level.
This time, whether it was to save money, to take the vocation assessment, to contract Buggy, or to update the skill index, he had to step down and meditate!
With a goal, everything was easy.
“Eleven, next, you should mainly train your coordination ability, which is the continuous superposition of combination skills.”
“Buggy, on the other hand, you continue to train the speed of Building Dreams. You’re too slow to activate the illusion.”
After the two pets cleaned the room, they ran over to accept the mission from him.
It was still the same training content as before, but the two pets were very enthusiastic. They howled and ran to train.
This couldn’t help but make Shi Yu sigh with emotion. Having Eleven taking a leading role was quite comforting for his Beast Tamer’s heart.
After simply arranging the training content for Eleven and the Green Silkworm, Shi Yu also started cultivating from tonight onwards.
Normal people would take at least a year to upgrade the Beast Taming Space from level one to level two, even if it was just a single element.
If he wanted to contract a second pet like Shi Yu and create a good growth space for the pet, he would have to consider the size and environment of the Beast Taming Space. It was not enough to increase the strength of the space alone.
This way, the amount of energy needed to be invested was even greater. Even if it was a person with extremely outstanding beast taming talent, it was impossible to achieve it in three months or so.
Fortunately, Shi Yu had enough Ethereal Stones to support his accelerated cultivation for a long time. This way, it became a possibility.
In fact, among the 10,000,000 initial funds provided by Lu Qingyi, not only was there a portion for Shi Yu to take out to train pets, but also a portion for Shi Yu to purchase his own cultivation resources. This way, Shi Yu could very well catch up to this batch of vocation assessments.
But Lu Qingyi would never have thought that in the end, this batch of money would all be used by Shi Yu to buy supplements…
Next, Shi Yu began to cultivate silently. Occasionally, he would even pick up the questions for the vocation assessment over the years and start to answer them.
Apart from meditation, he, the Green Silkworm, and Eleven had to do two sets of papers every day. After all, this was also a level that couldn’t be avoided in the professional assessment.
It wasn’t just to deal with the assessment. There was definitely no harm in accumulating more knowledge. Although he still felt that it was more comfortable to slack off, apart from courting death, Shi Yu still had the self-control he needed in other aspects.
Just like that, in the blink of an eye, a month passed.
During this period, apart from Lin Xiuzhu and the others needing some information from Shi Yu, Shi Yu was surprisingly not disturbed by other things. His cultivation was especially smooth.
A month after Shi Yu cultivated and meditated with the Ethereal Spirit Stone, half of his transparent Beast Taming Space barrier began to turn gray under his meditation enhancement.
This meant that the strength of his Beast Taming Space had already touched the threshold of level two!
Shi Yu was overjoyed and continued to cultivate in peace.
At the same time, in addition to the spatial strength, he began to take into account the scale and environment of the Beast Taming Space.
During Shi Yu’s cultivation process, Eleven’s growth level also successfully reached level ten. In terms of growth level, it finally caught up to Buggy.
However, whether it was Eleven or Worm, it was not so easy to break through to the transcendent level.
Buggy was limited by race.
Eleven, on the other hand, was restricted by the level of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space.
Therefore, in order to let Eleven grow to the transcendent level without any restrictions, Shi Yu had to quickly increase the level of the Beast Taming Space.
November 28.
It had been more than two months since Shi Yu began meditating and cultivating.
After more than two months, Shi Yu really wanted to curse!
It was too difficult!
It was so easy to raise the level of the pet, and all he had to do was add some points. Why was it so boring and tiring for his own leveling up?
This was even under the situation where he didn’t randomly add points to make himself fall into a weakened state. He wholeheartedly devoted himself to meditation cultivation!
If he added more points, it would probably be slower.
“Although it’s a little painful, I finally made it…”
In the room, Shi Yu sat on the bed and observed the changes in the Beast Taming Space while meditating.
With a large number of Ethereal Spirit Stones, Shi Yu finally succeeded in using two months to raise his Beast Taming Space level to level two.
The strength of the spatial crystal wall in the Beast Taming Space had reached level two. When the color turned gray, it meant that Shi Yu could already contract and control extraordinary pets normally.
The size of the space also increased, meaning that Shi Yu could contract a second pet.
At this moment, the growth environment of the pets in the space was more perfect. This meant that extraordinary pets could also get a good growth acceleration inside.
Shi Yu opened his eyes, got out of bed, and stretched his body. At the same time, he felt that his current physique had completely exceeded the scope of an ordinary person.
“Hahahaha, damn you!!!”
This time, Shi Yu was like a prisoner who had been cooped up in prison for a long time. He was immediately released and his mind relaxed greatly.
“Eleven, Buggy!”
Shi Yu laughed and shouted for the two pets who had been self-reliant for the past two months.
“Huh?”
“Ji!”
Eleven and Buggy came out in confusion and then looked at the crazy Shi Yu in confusion.
~ (TロT)σ What was wrong now…
After cultivating for so long, had he finally gone crazy?
For the past two months, Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy had been cultivating hard.
However, in the eyes of Eleven and Buggy, it was clearly abnormal for Shi Yu to work so hard.
After all, lazing around was Shi Yu’s style.
However, these days, it was rare for Shi Yu to not slack off. It kept giving them a bad feeling.
From the looks of it… it had finally happened…
“…”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched as he looked at Eleven and Buggy, who were letting their imagination run wild.
“I finally broke through.”
He chuckled and said, “Do you know what this means?”
“Huh?”
“Ji!”
The two pets were stunned. A breakthrough?
Eleven clumsily took two steps forward and sensed carefully before being shocked.
As it had a contract with Shi Yu, it immediately sensed Shi Yu’s change after sensing him carefully.
Eleven:!!!
After being stunned for a moment, it stood on the spot and raised its arms in surprise.
“Wuuu ~”
Shi Yu had finally broken through!!
It immediately circled around Shi Yu like a child and cheered.
Its Beast Tamer had finally grown up. He had finally grown through hard work!!
Tears!!
Eleven felt a sense of accomplishment after witnessing the growth of a human who only knew how to laze around.
After the surprise, Eleven was stunned again. It kept feeling that its relationship with Shi Yu was a little different… It stood on the spot in a daze and recalled its relationship with Shi Yu…
“Ji, Ji??” The green worm’s reaction was slower.
However, it soon widened its eyes, revealing its starry eyes.
Shi Yu had broken through. Did that mean that it could also be contracted by Shi Yu like Eleven??
“Yeah.” Shi Yu smiled.
“I can finally officially contract it…” He sighed.
It was not easy for them to coexist peacefully for so long without contracting a worm that they had been raising for months.
Without a contract, throwing millions of yuan at wild pets… Probably not many Beast Tamers would dare to do it like Shi Yu.
In the end, telepathy was forever a god skill.
“Cut the crap. Come on.” At this moment, Shi Yu closed his eyes and muttered in meditation.
He was already familiar with Buggy, so there was no need to be polite. Come in!
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Beast Taming Space in his brain.
It was a world with a gray crystal wall and clouds inside.
Hu hu ~ ~
As Shi Yu communicated with the Beast Taming Space, a breeze blew outside. The curtains were blown up.
Countless light spots flickered in front of Shi Yu. Two circular formations that looked like star maps appeared above the green worm!
In the next second, countless weak light spots flowed out of the formation and wrapped around the green worm, as if they wanted to cover it!
“Ji!”
The Green Silkworm let out a cry. As the two parties had gotten used to each other, it very naturally accepted the contract. Its entire body was directly enveloped by white light before gradually turning into fluorescent light, disappearing from the outside world and entering the Beast Taming Space!
The second pet, the Green Silkworm, had successfully contracted!
< Name > Green Silkworm
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Transcendent), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Illusory Phantom (Expert)
Shi Yu opened his eyes in joy.
He felt that his physique had improved again. At the same time, the greatest change was the skill index. As he contracted his second pet, the Green silkworm, like when he contracted Eleven, five new blank pages were immediately added!
“Wu!!!”
At this moment, as Shi Yu contracted the Green silkworm, Eleven also sensed some changes beside it.
Not only Shi Yu, but Eleven also had more contact with the Green Silkworm.
After all, they were under the same Beast Tamer. After this, although Eleven and the Green Silkworm’s communication wasn’t as easy as Shi Yu’s telepathy, it wasn’t as difficult as before.
Beast Tamers were also the bonds between different pets.
“Ji!”
After the contract was completed, the green worm was summoned by Shi Yu again.
“Stop training tonight. Everyone, take a day off.”
“No, two days!”
Shi Yu chuckled as he looked at Eleven and the Green Silkworm. They immediately became salty again, causing the two pets to reveal disappointed expressions. The training had only lasted for two months!
“What do you guys know? It’s time to work overtime soon!”
“It’s only right to rest for two days.”
The two pets were stunned. Adding points? Was it coming again!!
Shi Yu nodded. It had not been easy to reach this stage.
There was still a month left until the vocation assessment. Next, it was time to work extra hard.
Firstly, Eleven had to prioritize increasing the hardening of its racial skills so that it could break through to the transcendent level with the help of its racial skills.
As for the Green Silkworm’s Worm Silk, it was still the best skill at the upper limit of the experimental skill proficiency.
At this moment, Shi Yu only had one question. If it continued to upgrade the Green silkworm’s worm silk, was there any hope of it breaking through to the transcendent level with the form of the Green silkworm??
Transcendent-level Green silkworm, this didn’t seem to have been cultivated by Beast Tamers…
The Green Silkworm was classified as a low-level transcendent race, which meant that there was hope of breaking through to the transcendent level in this state. However, no Beast Tamer was so bored as to do this.
Because it required too much time, the life span of the Green Silkworm was insufficient. If it wanted to do it, it had to spend a large amount of resources. That kind of cost-effective ratio was not high, so it was better to directly evolve during the Awakening Stage to save trouble. Someone must have verified this before, so they came to a unified conclusion.
Shi Yu had a strange expression. He felt that the chances of the Green Silkworm evolving in a month weren’t high. Instead, it relied on the worm silk to increase its points. The chances of it breaking through to the transcendent level were not small.
Therefore, if he summoned a transcendent Green Silkworm in the vocation assessment, and it was a transcendent Green Silkworm with pretty good strength, would his opponent’s values be shattered? No matter what, he couldn’t just use only Eleven in the vocation assessment.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - Elevens First Profundity
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Eleven’s First Profundity
Following that, Shi Yu did not stay idle.
He tested his physique after breaking through.
Naturally, it was an experiment with Buggy.
Worm silk, teaching!
Pa!
“Ji!”
A white light flashed.
Cooldown Time: 4 hours
“Oh.”
Looking at the cooldown time, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up and he threw Buggy aside.
He only needed a four hour cooldown time after teaching worm silk?
Then the cooldowns of skills at other levels would probably be reduced by about four hours?
“Not bad.”
Shi Yu thought to himself.
The further a Beast Tamer advanced, the more obvious the improvement in their physique.
He had just leveled up a little, and he got a four hour reduction in cooldown time. Not bad.
He estimated that if he broke through one or two more times, he would be able to teach a levelless skill like the Worm Silk without any pressure.
Sigh, as expected, being an insect-catching youth was more suitable for him. This fellow had many development directions, though it would probably give him eye bags for the exhaustion.
“Uh…”
After the experiment was completed, Shi Yu began to calculate the cost of the other skills.
If he wanted to make hardening become transcendent level, this cool down time reduction added up to nearly 200 hours. This was equivalent to saving nearly 200,000!
However, the cost of maxing out the skill was still quite a lot. He needed about 800,000 yuan to buy eight beans…
Although it was luxurious, he couldn’t save this money. The hardening level was also used to quickly increase Eleven’s growth level and help it break through to the transcendent level.
Shi Yu felt that there was still thunder palm he had to match.
Right now, the Thunder Palm’s level was at the proficiency level. After reaching the perfect level, it could harden into Thunder Armor profundities. At this time, Eleven’s battle power would experience a qualitative leap.
Perhaps, at that time, even if it didn’t multiply itself, it could still fight evenly with the Ice Dragon Phantom at the same level.
And if he wanted to upgrade the Thunder Palm to Perfect Level, he would probably need less than five divine beans…
Together, thirteen beans, 1.3 million!
After some calculations, although Shi Yu’s heart was bleeding slightly, it was still within the range he could withstand at the moment.
Krypton!
…
The next day.
Shi Yu and the delivery guy completed a deal tacitly.
Shi Yu directly bought 30 Divine Beans and some supplementary supplements. He only had 2.5 million left in his little savings.
“I wonder how long these can last…”
“Sigh, I’ll sell the ice crystal someday.”
The quality of the more than 1,000 ice-element energy crystals in the ruins was pretty good.
The first-level market price was 5k yuan each, and the second-level was 20,000 yuan each. It was not a problem to sell them for more than 10 million yuan.
With this amount of resources as support, Shi Yu could still be at ease and increase his points before the vocation assessment.
“Where’s Eleven, Eleven!”
After carrying a box of divine beans into the villa, Shi Yu started to call Eleven.
“Huh?”
In the villa, Eleven carefully peeked out and looked at the box of supplements in Shi Yu’s hand.
“Wuu!”
A moment later, it revealed a determined expression as if it was prepared to die and ran to Shi Yu’s side.
Come on!
Become stronger!
It was already mentally prepared!
It also wanted to see where Shi Yu’s limit was after breaking through!
“Ji!” On the window sill, Buggy nodded secretly.
As expected of a leader.
How much effort would it take to repay such a huge box of supplements?
Even so, the leader could still challenge resolutely. This determination was worth learning!
“Do you plan to increase the Thunder Palm first, or do you plan to increase the hardening first?”
Looking at the coy Eleven, Shi Yu asked with a smile.
“Of course, I’ll definitely upgrade all of them in the end.”
“However, different choices can allow you to experience different things in advance.”
