The expressions of the cousins froze and completely collapsed. They felt that they were dreaming!
“You lost. The Green Silkworm’s worm silk has already pierced into the tree spirit’s body. Now, it can start destroying the tree spirit’s body from the inside with a thought.”
At the same time, Shi Yu spoke directly. Because the other party had held back at the start, he also let Buggy hold back a little. After all, there was still an assessment in a few days. It would be bad if the tree spirit was injured too badly.
It was just a meal. It was better to be friendly.
“Ah…” At this moment, just as Tong Yu had said, the tree spirit on the ground didn’t dare to move at all. Although it still had the strength to fight, it could clearly feel that there was a fatal killing weapon flowing in its body.
There was another special quality to the max-level worm silk. Even after leaving the Green silkworm’s body, it could still be controlled by the Green silkworm for a long time. At this moment, these transparent worm silk were like little worms, constantly waiting for their master’s attack orders in the tree spirit’s body.
This move was very difficult to defend against. As long as one was stabbed in any part of the body by the silkworm’s thread, it was equivalent to being sentenced to death by Shi Yu.
With the transparent nature of the skill, it was not much of a problem to say that Worm was the strongest killer of the extraordinary race.
“I…” At this moment, Zhao Rui’s expression was unable to accept it. This was because he had received the tree spirit’s feedback and knew that Shi Yu wasn’t lying!
Because of this, his values were almost shattered and he couldn’t understand at all.
Green silkworm… Green silkworm was using the worm silk to suppress the transcendent-level tree spirit??
Was this what his cousin meant by “this wave is stable”?
Stable his ass, liar, refund!
But clearly, even his cousin didn’t expect this situation at this time.
Including the waiter, the three of them were extremely shocked. In the end, Zhao Rui’s voice was almost hoarse. He said with a trembling voice, “Transcendent-level Green silkworm, transcendent-level silkworm silk?”
“You know your stuff.” Shi Yu nodded. “Not bad.”
F*ck! What was not bad! This didn’t make sense!
As Shi Yu confirmed it, Zhao Rui and the others did not feel the slightest joy of being enlightened. Instead, they felt that it was even more ridiculous!!
Was there really a f*cking person who cultivated the Green silkworm to the transcendent level?? And even trained the worm silk to the transcendent level??
This guy had a problem—
The three of them were shocked to the extreme. Fortunately, no one here noticed. Otherwise, this place would only be more sensational. Putting aside whether the Green Silkworm could reach the transcendent level, just based on the fact that it had mastered the transcendent level worm silk, it could be determined that this Green Silkworm almost had the potential of a monarch race after evolution!!
This had already been proven!
The cousins were dumbfounded. They couldn’t understand why such a candidate had appeared. This kind of pet, this kind of proficiency, was completely impossible to understand!
“Ah!!!” The tree spirit reminded its Beast Tamer to stop wasting time. Quickly admit defeat. Its body was so itchy and in pain.
It swore never to fight with bugs again. It was countered this time…
“I…” Zhao Rui’s face was in a mess. It could be imagined that he was also a genius from a certain place, an influential figure. He wasn’t necessarily worse than the group of people who competed with Shi Yu for the Evolution Sacred Spring back then. However, it was such a genius who had already seen the dangers of society before participating in the vocation assessment.
In the boundless world, there were all kinds of Beast Tamers and pets.
Zhao Rui was forced to admit defeat because the life and death of the tree spirit was indeed in Shi Yu’s hands.
As soon as he finished speaking, his heart skipped a beat.
Cousin, this really isn’t my fault. You should be able to understand… It was clear that there’s something wrong with this Beast Tamer and pet!
“Heh heh…” Shi Yu chuckled. Although the opponent was weak and the battle between the bugs would definitely not be enjoyable, it was good as long as it was free…
“Ji…”
At this moment, Buggy was indeed a little dissatisfied. It swept a glance at the crowd with stunned faces and silently turned around. There wasn’t a single person who could fight, and it actually didn’t even force out its dream form. It was boring. If the opponent in the vocation assessment was only at this level, it felt that it could destroy everything without his leader stepping up?

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - Im Too Excellent
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: I’m Too Excellent
After showing off, Shi Yu left in satisfaction.
At that moment, Buggy was very excited. He felt that one battle wasn’t enough, and even wanted to fight a second one.
“Why don’t we have another meal tonight?”
Shi Yu had some crooked ideas, but soon, he was very disappointed in this restaurant.
Because the event rules said that each person was limited to one event… Damn it.
In any case, the restaurant guys couldn’t lose out either, and they even f*cking limited it… This is very lacking in trust. Where’s the most basic trust between people?
“Alright, go back to the bead and fight Eleven,” Shi Yu said to Buggy on his shoulder.
Buggy’s face fell.
Did it say it wanted to fight?
It wanted to torture noobs!
What kind of battle experience was there to fight with leader?
At the moment, the strength of the worm was very good. After the worm silk was raised to the maximum level, the effect was simply a qualitative change. Just the worm silk alone could make it kill a large number of extraordinary creatures of the same level.
If it used those two proficient high-level skills, at the same level of growth, it wouldn’t be impossible for it to battle commander species creatures!
Therefore, it was not a random claim that Buggy could kill most geniuses in second-tier cities.
“Usually, geniuses will be left for Buggy, while monster geniuses are left for Eleven. It’s been arranged,” Shi Yu analyzed.
…
In the afternoon, Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to return to the research institute.
As he couldn’t think of where to go for the time being, he simply found an empty place and entered the ruins bead to do the papers.
At the last minute, he had to sharpen his weapons, his skills. Even if it wasn’t fast, it was light. If he could suppress one more thing, it would be another.
After Shi Yu entered the ruins space, there were no traces left in the outside world. But, the disadvantage was that if Shi Yu wanted to go out, he could only go out on the spot.
When they went out later, would there be anyone around? It would be more difficult to deal with, but it wasn’t a big problem. They could release the bug to scout the situation first. No one could see it.
In the ruins bead, after Shi Yu and Buggy entered, Buggy started to report the good news of their victory just now to Eleven.
“Wuu?” “Ji!” “Wuu!” “Ji!”
Eleven’s blood boiled, and Shi Yu’s face darkened. Good lord, it was just a crushing battle, but it made Buggy describe it as a world-shaking battle.
The worm silk was like a vast white ocean. During the battle, there were gunshots and saber shadows, and the drums and horns sounded together. It was a rather spectacular sight. The worm opened its mouth and kept talking.
The enemy wasn’t simple either. With a clap of its hands, the tree realm descended, but unfortunately, it was destroyed by it with irresistible force!
Shi Yu rolled his eyes.
Who had it learned this ability from?
Oh, Shi Yu knew. Cell phone.
In order to allow Eleven and Buggy to develop completely, Shi Yu taught Eleven and Buggy simple literacy. Eleven was still alright. There weren’t many changes. It did the questions sincerely, but Buggy liked to hug its old cell phone and browse this and that all day… Especially the fantasy advertisements that popped up on the webpage. It was very easy to immerse itself in them.
None of that mattered. What made Shi Yu speechless was that Eleven actually listened attentively. It believed it!!
Sh*t, with this intelligence, why did it feel like the world was going to be overtaken by bugs very soon? Cell phones even had the ability to develop intelligence?
“This can’t go on. Buggy even knows to learn idioms to brag. Eleven just likes to do stupid stuff like take a selfie with the cell phone and completely won’t use it in the right place.”
“Looks like I have to let Eleven come into contact with cell phones more. Maybe it can become smarter.”
After Shi Yu took out “Three Years Simulation for the Five Job Examination”, he called Eleven and Buggy over.
Eleven and Buggy stood in front of Shi Yu obediently.
Because they knew that as long as they dared to disobey Shi Yu, they would suffer.
When other Beast Tamers threatened their pets, the punishment would be doubled and they would not be allowed to eat. Now, Shi Yu had a new trick.
Eleven was still happy if it was punishment training. Buggy’s training was to sleep, so it was not a threat.
Punishing three meals would affect the development of the pet. Shi Yu felt that it was a huge loss.
Therefore, Shi Yu understood.
In the future, the punishment measure would be to do the papers.
This method was very useful. Both Eleven and Buggy hated doing papers and didn’t like it very much.
But the key was that this wasn’t useless. For example, Buggy was already familiar with memorizing the attribute list and counters.
There was also Eleven, who could already recognize the names of thousands of pets.
This made the Beast Tamer feel relieved. Only Shi Yu could increase his points and not care about the amount of pet training. Otherwise, which proper Beast Tamer would let their pet do questions all day long? The time for pet training and rest was not enough.
“Don’t do the papers today. I’ll give you some homework on Initiating Intelligence.”
Shi Yu smiled at Eleven and Buggy.
“Huh?” “Ji?”
Eleven and Buggy were very happy to hear that they didn’t have to do the papers anymore.
However, what the hell was this little homework for initiating intelligence? Did Shi Yu think they were stupid?
The two pets looked at Shi Yu with intelligence.
Eleven, Buggy…
“Buggy, your homework is very simple. You have more than ten worm silk usage skills now, right?”
“Use your idiom talent more and give each skill a high, short, and appropriate skill name. When the time comes, I can give commands.”
Buggy was stunned and then pleasantly surprised. This homework was alright, it didn’t reject it!
“Eleven, you…”
Eleven had to be heavily arranged!
“From today onwards, you will learn acting skills. You have to familiarize yourself with ‘The Self-Cultivation of an Actor’. Don’t you like to take photos? Next, when facing the camera, you have to learn to control your gaze, expression, and every move! It’s best if your acting skills reach the point where outsiders can’t see through your true thoughts.”
“From today onwards, you will learn acting skills. You have to familiarize yourself with ‘The Self-Cultivation of an Actor’. Don’t you like to take photos? Next, when facing the camera, you have to learn to control your gaze, expression, and every move! It’s best if your acting skills reach the point where outsiders can’t see through your true thoughts.”
Eleven:???
Shi Yu chuckled. A pet with high acting skills would definitely not be too stupid. This was also very training in intelligence. Most importantly, after Eleven learned the skill of Inner Power in the future, it would need to use acting skills.
Under the restrained state of the skill, the basic requirement was to shrink all power and make oneself ordinary. However, this was only the foundation. How was just restrained power enough? Hiding one’s form, expression, and emotions was the true success of restraint.
This was a test of acting skills…
“You have to remember that from today onwards, you are a small iron-eating beast cub that is a few months old and 30 to 40 centimeters tall!” Shi Yu looked at Eleven, scaring Eleven into shrinking to Shi Yu’s designated size.
It understood… In essence, it was to hide their trump cards and use them one by one at the critical moment.
Let the enemy see where their limit was at a glance, but never see where their real limit was .jpg.
“You can do it!”
After arranging the homework for Eleven and Buggy, Shi Yu was satisfied and started doing the questions himself.
…
The next day.
Outside the examination venue of the Lotus Lake Arena, there was a sea of people.
Even if Shi Yu slept on the ground outside the examination hall and had eleven alarm clocks, he could only line up after waking up.
Good heavens, he was already sleeping not far from the examination hall, but there was actually someone earlier than him?
Don’t you all need to sleep!?
“F*ck.”
Just as Shi Yu was marveling at the enthusiasm of these people, a vulgar voice suddenly came from the side.
“Eh.” Shi Yu turned around and was immediately delighted.
Weren’t they the Beast Tamer Brothers from yesterday?
“Morning, you guys are also in this examination hall.”
“Morning…” The straight hair cousin’s name was Zhao Rui, the cousin who lost to Shi Yu. The cousin who had previously invited Shi Yu to battle and despised Shi Yu for being too weak was called Ding Yao. When the two of them saw Shi Yu, they felt that the early morning was not a good sign.
After all, the meal yesterday was basically a guaranteed 60,000 yuan for free. In the end, when they encountered Shi Yu, not only were they dealt a blow, but they also spent 30,000 yuan each. If they had known, they wouldn’t have gone to eat there yesterday…
“Don’t worry, today is the basic test. You guys will be fine,” Shi Yu comforted.
The two of them were speechless. Of course they knew that it was fine with them.
The so-called basic test was for Beast Tamers to enter the designated location and summon their own pet.
Through the color of the Beast Tamer’s summoning array, the examiner could determine whether the Beast Tamer’s level had reached the standard.
Then, there would be a corresponding machine to test the pet’s energy. The pet’s energy level would reach the transcendent level qualified.
These were all the old assessments over the years. There was nothing new.
“Your Green Silkworm… aren’t you going to have it evolve?” Although they felt that Shi Yu wasn’t human, the brothers were very curious about him.
The transcendent-level Green silkworm even mastered the transcendent level worm silk!
Has this ever been achieved by a Beast Tamer?
Currently, in Dong Huang, the only Green silkworm that had mastered the transcendent of the worm silk had already evolved into the monarch species Ice Phoenix Moth. However, this one had not reached the transcendent level in the form of the Green silkworm.
The two of them had been discussing it the whole night yesterday, but they still didn’t understand where this Shi Yu came from. Where did this big boss come from? Where did this second-generation heir come from?
If he didn’t have a legendary Beast Tamer father, how could he have such a green worm?
“There’s no hurry,” Shi Yu said. Wasn’t he still unprepared?
Buggy wasn’t anxious yet. By the time it went all out, the world would tremble!
What the f*ck was this person saying, there was no hurry? Bringing a transcendent-level Green Silkworm to attack people randomly was ridiculous!
Zhao Rui: “Holy shit, I’ve already imagined the shocked expressions of the surrounding examiners and candidates when you send your pet out later and the machine detects that it meets the transcendent standard.”
The examiner would definitely be dumbfounded by the transcendent-level Green Silkworm!
“This…” Shi Yu was stunned. Speaking of which, during the test later, he only needed to test the level of one pet.
Which one should he send?
If he remembered correctly, the examination machine seemed to be able to detect the specific energy level. It would be specific to the level. It was very advanced.
From a certain point of view, it might be similar to the Battle Detector in Dragon Ball.
Of course, it was only to test the amount of energy in the body. This was only one of the criteria to determine the strength of a pet. In a real battle, the accompanying skills, skill level, and proficiency were also very important.
Shi Yu was conflicted. Buggy and Eleven seemed to be pretty ruthless. The former’s race was too shocking, while the latter, because the foundation laid down was too strong, after the transcendent transformation, the total energy in its body seemed to have reached a very terrifying level… Even if one didn’t consider the skill proficiency, it would definitely be a wonder among transcendent pets.
Well, it was indeed too outstanding.
Shi Yu had no intention of hiding his abilities, nor was there a need to. After all, the assessment would show his strength sooner or later. He was conflicted about whether he could measure both of them at the same time. He wanted to know the specific energy values of Eleven and Buggy. His lousy cell phone could only detect big levels and could not accurately detect detailed energy conditions. As expected, he still had to change his cell phone!

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - The Job Examination Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: The Job Examination Begins
Union calendar, January 1, 178, 7 a.m.
In Dong Huang, Ancient Capital City’s examination venue of the Lotus Lake Arena, the door was finally opened. The candidates rushed in noisily.
The scene was bustling with activity. Most of the people present were young, and there were also some middle-aged men who came to give it a try for their academic degrees and dreams.
“Ah…” At that moment, the buzz cut cousin looked at Shi Yu who had left and felt an itch in his heart.
It was such a fucking pity.
They were not in the same examination venue as Shi Yu. They might not be able to see the scene of Shi Yu’s green worm showing off and shocking the examiners.
He kept feeling that he had lost 100 million yuan.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the venue displayed on the admission ticket and walked along with the crowd and signs.
“This feeling is really similar to the college entrance examination…”
“Unfortunately, apart from the written test, we came prepared this time!”
Shi Yu chuckled.
Lotus Lake Arena, exam venue No. 10.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived.
To be honest, he felt that something was wrong, because it wasn’t Arena 11. This was a little interesting. The lucky number was gone just like that?
…
The basic test was tested together at many examination venues. Only in this way could the candidates guarantee that they would finish the test in the shortest time possible.
In the morning, there was the field basic test, and in the afternoon, there was the indoor written test. The assessment efficiency was very high.
In a short day, he could complete two assessments. Moreover, the contents of the written test were all judged by the machine, and the results could be announced the next day.
On the day the results were announced, the candidate rested for a day. Then, it was the third assessment!
At this moment, Shi Yu and the other 79 candidates were standing around the No. 10 examination venue, surrounding the blockade of a huge testing table.
This detector wasn’t built directly here, but it was transported here. It was very similar to a boxing ring, but it was bigger. It was less than a meter tall, but it was ten meters in length and width. It was an energy detector, and its precision was very high.
Standing on it, one could not only detect the pet’s energy data, but also the pet’s race, height, weight, physical development, and age.
At the moment, three tables were placed inside the blockade facing the testing table. Behind the table, two men and one woman were controlling the computer alone. The two of them were reading the information with calm expressions.
“Yet another vocation assessment.” The female examiner looked up at the candidates who had almost arrived outside the blockade and sighed.
Every year, there were people who were happy and people who were sad. I wonder if people will take things too hard this year…
“I’m a little curious about the quality of the candidates this year.”
“Needless to say, it will definitely get better each year.”
The other two male examiners chuckled.
They were all professional Beast Tamers of the Beast Tamer Association in Ancient Capital. Every year, the basic-level examiners were randomly transferred from professional Beast Tamers.
Although it was only a few days, the treatment was very good.
At this moment, seeing that it was about time, the middle-aged female examiner in a professional black skirt stood up and opened the blockade, saying, “Alright, quieten down.”
She looked at everyone with a dignified gaze.
“I’m the main examiner for your basic test, Zhuang Ping. Next, I’ll be in charge of your basic test. This test is very simple. When you hear your name later, you just have to go to the testing table and summon your own pet.”
“There’s no ranking for this basic test. You’ll pass if you cross the line. But the pets you summon might affect the questions of your wilderness assessment according to their race and attributes. So, if you have many pets, think about which one you should summon first.”
“The third assessment is the Wilderness Trial. I believe you have already understood it. At that time, you will be thrown into a wilderness area. Then, you will be asked to survive there for a period of time. During the survival period, I will arrange some assessment missions for each of you, either to hunt a certain ferocious beast or to take some resources.”
“The mission arranged will, to a certain extent, counter the pets you send for testing next. Do you understand?”
The 80 prospective Beast Tamers below the stage listened quietly and nodded in unison.
He understood.
For example, if he sent a fire-element Moon Flame Beast to participate in the basic test now, in the third stage, the mission would let the candidate deal with water-elemental ferocious beasts and adopt water-elemental resources.
He was always making things difficult for others.
Although it was difficult, the Beast Tamer Association didn’t hide this rule. They directly reminded the candidate on the surface.
Most candidates had contracted two pets. If both pets reached the transcendent level, in a sense, this also gave the candidates the right to choose the mission type in the third assessment.
The candidates could completely use this rule to make their third assessment easier.
After all, they could counter one pet, but could they restrain both?
Of course, for candidates who contracted one pet or only had one pet that had reached the transcendent level, the rules were not very friendly…
…
“Time’s up. Then, we’ll start the basic test. The candidate whose name is mentioned, do as I said before. Move faster.”
As soon as the examiner Zhuang Ping finished speaking, a male examiner holding a register cleared his throat and called out by name, “Examination number 1439, He Yu.”
The first candidate whose name was read was a girl in a ponytail who wasn’t even 20 years old. When she heard her name, her heart skipped a beat. She raised her hand nervously and shouted, “I’m here!”
“Go up and test.” Zhuang Ping also held a register and nodded.
She looked at the information in her hand. On it was recorded the photo, name, age, gender, and identity of this girl named He Yu…
Under the full attention of the audience, the first candidate, He Yu, jogged up to the testing table. The moment she stepped on the testing table, the glass-like venue immediately lit up, scaring the little girl.
But soon, she stabilized her emotions and carefully looked at the examiner.
“You can directly summon your pet after going up,” Zhuang Ping said.
“Alright.” The girl nodded and took a deep breath. In the next second, not far in front of her, a huge gray array that was flickering with countless light spots like a star map appeared in mid-air.
Right on the heels of that, a water-like ripple appeared on the surface of the formation. A cute little creature in a standing posture, light blue body, clear blue eyes, purple eyes, and appearance similar to a flying Momonga floated out of the summoning array!
< Name > Super Flying Mouse
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Psychic Wave, Clone, Barrier
It was a relatively rare spiritual pet!
As everyone looked at the super flying rat, the next moment, the monitoring station’s automatic voice broadcasted the test situation.
“Race name, super flying rat.”
“Race level, high-level transcendent level.”
“Level of growth, transcendent level.”
“Energy value, 599 points.”
After the voice broadcast was completed, the girl, He Yu, blushed and clenched her fist excitedly. Good, not bad!
Below, a small number of people had blank expressions. Most of them nodded secretly. Obviously, not everyone knew what this value represented.
At this moment, the examiner in front of the computer also received other more detailed data of the super flying rat. Then, he seriously uploaded it. The examiner who called out its name began to record the paper information.
As for the examiner, Zhuang Ping, she added,
“Energy value represents the amount of energy in the pet’s body. The energy in the body of a pet in the Awakening Stage is basically within 100 points. As for the transcendent level standard this time, it’s 500 points. This value largely determines whether the pet can use high-level skills and whether it can use skills multiple times. You can use it as a reference to determine the strength of your pet.”
After the pet’s growth level reached the transcendent level, it did not undergo the many awakening transformations like during the Awakening Stage. Its strength would not undergo a qualitative change at a certain point. Instead, it had to slowly accumulate.
This was because pets of this level had already passed the stage of rapid growth. Their racial skills had basically been awakened.
Next, there was only this big level in the entire transcendent level. There was no small level division.
As for the next growth and transformation of the pet, that would have to wait until the commander level.
At this time, the pet’s strength would undergo a relatively large qualitative change. The pet could even release energy, solidify, and condense energy crystals themselves!!
In the wild, some commander rank creatures relied on this method to nurture their clansmen. The difference in strength between a group with a commander rank creature and a group without a commander rank creature was very obvious!
…
“Examination number 1440, Jin Fei.”
…
“Race name, Shadow Leopard.”
“Race level, high-level transcendent.”
“Level of growth, transcendent level.”
“Energy value, 761 points.”
…
“Examination number 1441, Ji Yuan.”
…
“Race name, Wind Gathering Vine.”
“Race level, medium transcendent.”
“Level of growth, transcendent level.”
“Energy value, 524 points.”
…
Then, candidates were called names one after another and went on stage to test.
However, the testing segment was basically very ordinary. There were no explosive points.
Until…
“Examination number 1461, Bear Star.”
“Race name, Thunder Lion.”
“Race level, low class commander.”
“Level of growth, transcendent level.”
“Energy value, 1214 points.”
At this moment, the calm atmosphere of the basic testing segment was directly broken.
“Holy shit, it went over 1,000???”
“F*ck, it’s twice as much as my Earth Crystal Butterfly…”
“It’s ridiculous. The commander races are awesome…”
Everyone looked at the young man on the testing table and the golden lightning lion beside him, and they were all shocked.
Low class commander species, Thunder Lion!
This energy value almost completely destroyed the pets of the previous examinees!
“Roar…” On the examination table, the Thunder Lion growled and enjoyed the feeling of being watched with the Beast Tamer.
The Beast Tamer named Xiong Xing had a calm expression but was abnormally satisfied in his heart.
He, the center of attention!
“Not bad.” The three examiners nodded silently in the face of the first candidate who broke through a thousand, but they didn’t say much.
At the transcendent level, the battle power of the pet was actually the pet’s race, skills, and self-training situation.
Through daily training, pets could slowly increase their upper limit of energy and increase their skill proficiency. In battle, this was the competition.
Among them, high-level pets definitely had natural advantages. Their upper limit of physical fitness was naturally higher than low-level pets. This couldn’t be helped.
It was normal for pets with high races to have high energy levels.
But this didn’t mean anything.
As long as the energy difference between extraordinary creatures wasn’t too great, this difference could be made up for.
If the skill proficiency of high-level pets was not high, they could not actually use their energy advantage.
On the contrary, if a low-level pet trained one skill and combination skill to a very proficient level and could instantly explode with all its energy, it wouldn’t be much weaker.
Although the pet’s energy level reflected the pet’s strength to a certain extent, the key was still the performance of the skill that specificized energy.
These three examiners were all high-level Beast Tamers, so they naturally wouldn’t be as shocked as the candidates.
What a joke. They were just a group of trainee vocation candidates. Even if they didn’t need to test their pets, it was within their judgment. This was experience!
At this moment, Shi Yu watched silently among the candidates.
It seemed like it was going to be his turn soon?
He wondered how much Eleven’s specific energy level could reach…
Although its race wasn’t high, none of the candidates who had summoned middle-level Transcendent pets had an energy value above 700, Eleven was clearly not ordinary…
Not only had the evolution holy spring improved his physical fitness once, but the feedback brought by the hardening of the transcendent-level racial skill and the feedback brought by a bunch of external racial skills could increase the upper limit of his energy…
He was very curious.
“Examination number 1464, Shi Yu.”
As Shi Yu thought about it, it was indeed his turn.
At this moment, the first candidate to break through a thousand had just appeared. The surrounding candidates were still in a state of agitation.
It felt insipid, as if all the limelight had been suppressed.
F*ck, he had contracted a commander species creature at this stage. He was rich and willful.
Next, Shi Yu went on stage.
The male candidate was still alright. He only took a silent look at Shi Yu and lost interest.
Shi Yu, who was wearing an Iron-eating Beast short-sleeved shirt, was too ordinary. It was obvious that he wasn’t very impressive.
“The pet’s an Iron-eating beast, right?”
Otherwise, which normal boy would wear an Iron-eating Beast short-sleeved shirt!
At this moment, the female candidates were evaluating Shi Yu’s looks in their hearts.
“There’s finally a more handsome candidate.”
Just like that, Shi Yu boarded the testing table under the gazes of the candidates and three examiners around venue 10.
“Summon your pet,” the examiner Zhuang Ping said.
On the examination table, Shi Yu nodded. In the end, he decided to summon Eleven.
The transcendent-level worm was too ridiculous. It was better not to agitate everyone. Low profile, low profile.
“Eleven.”
Shi Yu communicated with Eleven, who had been waiting for a long time in the Beast Taming Space.
In the next moment, a gray summoning array appeared on the ground in front of him.
Under the lingering light, Eleven, who was more than a meter tall, appeared in the arena.
The one-meter-tall Little Iron Eating Beast clearly hadn’t reached adulthood yet. Its gaze was firm as it stood on the field with its fat stall. Its soft black and white hair fluttered with the breeze. From the bottom angle, it was very perfect.
“It’s indeed an Iron-eating Beast…”
However, although it was perfect, the race of the iron-eating beasts completely hit the predictions of the other candidates.
The hint of Shi Yu’s clothes was too obvious!
Next, the middle-level iron-eating beasts wouldn’t have much energy even if they reached the transcendent level.
About 550?
The candidates made their judgment.
Forget about candidates, even the three examiners, out of boredom, also estimated after taking a glance.
At this moment.
The monitoring station automatically broadcasted Eleven’s energy situation…
“Race name, Iron-eating Beast.”
“Race level, medium transcendent.”
“Level of growth, transcendent level.”
“Energy value, 3186 points.”
Energy Points, 3186 points!!
At this moment, the entire place suddenly fell silent.
Everyone’s pupils dilated slightly. Of the two male examiners in charge of recording, one’s hand was still on the keyboard, while the other’s pen stabbed heavily on the paper with rich expressions.
It looked like love.
…
There were only gasps around.
3186??
Was he sure it wasn’t 586? Not 1186? Instead, 3186?!
This number was a little ridiculous!
For a moment, everyone present couldn’t think straight.
The sound of the detection counter echoed in everyone’s ears, and their mouths were slightly open.
How was that possible!
What went wrong!
One had to know that the energy value of a pet that was commander level just now was only 1214!
How could a middle-level Iron-eating Beast have this number?
At this moment, the three examiners were even more shocked than the candidates.
This was because they knew that normally speaking, the upper limit of the energy level of a transcendent commander race was only 3,000 points…
The value of this iron-eating beast was completely not something a creature of a medium-level transcendent race should have!
On the contrary, even if it was a young monarch species, after breaking through to the transcendent level, it had to go through a certain amount of training to reach it!
In short, how was this value possible—this was too unscientific!
The two male examiners paused for a second.
The examiner, Zhuang Ping, looked at the calm Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast on the testing table in disbelief.
They… weren’t surprised at all??
Could it be that he had already expected this value?
The main examiner was silent, unable to understand.
“Age, not even two years old?”
At the same time, a male examiner was flabbergasted as he looked at the other detailed data on the iron-eating beast on the computer. He was shocked again.
F*ck, did it have to be so ridiculous? Even if it had started raining in the womb, it couldn’t be that fast, right? Moreover, it was an Iron-eating Beast famous for its laziness!
At this moment, after the sudden silence in venue 10, there was no sign of recovery.
Around the testing table, regardless of whether they had tested it or not, all of them widened their eyes.
Especially that Beast Tamer of the Thunder Lion, he was a little dizzy and felt a little stunned.
With this comparison, why did it feel that the Thunder Lion was weak?
Was this really an Iron-eating Beast? And not a young monarch wearing an Iron-eating Beast coat?
“Is it done?”
On the testing stage, Shi Yu asked.
Eleven was indeed still fierce…
“It… It’s done.” Below, the main examiner, Zhuang Ping, took a deep breath and tried to memorize Shi Yu’s appearance.
At the same time, she judged in her heart that after Shi Yu’s basic test information was transmitted, he would probably receive a lot of attention.
This was also the goal of the first test. It was to allow the Beast Tamer Association to pay attention to candidates with potential in advance!
At this moment, she didn’t think that the machine was broken or that Shi Yu and the others had cheated, because it was absolutely impossible for there to be a problem with this machine. Even if the pet used enhancement skills, even if the pet used shrinking skills, even if the pet’s condition was poor, this machine could perfectly detect the real situation of the pet.
This was specially made for the vocation assessment and had been modified by countless Mechanics… Therefore, this value was probably real.
Moreover, judging from the calm looks of Shi Yu and his pet, it could be seen that this value was probably the true energy value of this Iron-eating Beast!
This was clearly an Iron-eating Beast with a mid-level transcendent race, but it was comparable to a monarch-level pet cub!!
Ridiculous!!!
If it wasn’t a racial mutation, then this Beast Tamer named Shi Yu would definitely have invested an astronomical amount of resources into this Iron-eating Beast to strengthen its potential!!
This was the only possibility.
Although that was the case, the three high-level Beast Tamer examiners still couldn’t calm down for a long time. They weren’t as calm and collected as before at all, because this had indeed broken their understanding.
Even Lin Hongnian, a master-level Beast Tamer who specialized in Iron-eating Beasts, had always felt that Shi Yu’s Little Iron-eating Beast was ridiculous… Let alone these guys. Even after his Iron-eating Beast had evolved, he still felt that it was lacking compared to Eleven…
“Come back, Eleven.” At the moment, Shi Yu roughly understood Eleven’s energy situation.
It was lower than he had imagined.
But it was alright.
After all, its true strength was the skills with high proficiency.
In terms of battle power, the other pets might not necessarily perform better than Eleven.
“Wuu!”
Eleven nodded and returned to the Beast Taming Space. At the same time, Shi Yu walked down.
As expected, after testing Eleven’s energy level, Shi Yu began to be curious about Buggy again…
After returning to the research institute, he would ask if there were such machines in Ancient Capital University. He felt that there should be!
“This is your information card. Please go to the designated location in the afternoon to do the written test. Your assessment information should also be refreshed after the assessment official website.”
After Shi Yu came down, the male examiner in charge of recording the data gave him the subsequent assessment information card. At the same time, he raised his head curiously and sized up Shi Yu.
Icefield City, Ping Cheng? This was the birth point of Shi Yu according to the information. It was a little familiar, as there were indeed iron-eating beasts there…
In short, he had to pay attention to this monster candidate in the future.
“Thank you.” Shi Yu took the assessment information card. After taking a look, he put it in his pocket and walked out of the blockade.
The moment he returned to the assessment crowd, the dozens of candidates around him immediately became noisy!
“Holy shit, brother, what’s wrong with your Iron-eating Beast!!”
“3186, it’s fake, right?”
“Brother, can I get your contact information?”
“Can I touch your Iron-eating Beast?”
Even the candidate who had led the Thunder Lion race earlier didn’t receive such treatment from Shi Yu. Shi Yu’s scalp immediately turned numb. Then, he looked at the red-faced bespectacled woman who wanted to touch the iron-eating beast. His vigilance was raised to the limit.
This person didn’t have any replication talent, did she? He couldn’t let her touch him!
“Silence!!!”
At this moment, the chief examiner, Zhuang Ping, had a dark expression on her face. “Noise is prohibited here. Violating the rules will be seen as giving up the assessment. All communication is to stop now. The assessment will continue.”
The candidates smiled in embarrassment after the organizer spoke. Then, the next candidate went on stage to take the test.
In fact, he could leave directly after the test.
However, most of the people still stayed behind to see how the others’ test results were out of curiosity.
At this moment, Shi Yu sensed everyone’s gaze on him and fell silent. Although he also wanted to continue looking… he felt that it wasn’t suitable to stay here for long.
Why not retreat first?
…
Shi Yu withdrew and left without anyone knowing.
Not long after he left, two short-haired youths rushed to the venue of the tenth exam.
They raised their heads and searched for something in the crowd, but they didn’t find anything.
The buzz cut cousin poked a candidate casually.
The candidate turned around in confusion.
The buzz cut cousin whispered, “Brother, did an extraordinary-level Green Silkworm appear here previously?”
“Are you surprised? Are you surprised?!” the straight hair cousin whispered.
The candidate was stunned. Damn it, idiots, where did these two idiots come from?
“Are you crazy? Your Green Silkworm can reach the transcendent level?”
He turned around in bad luck. He hadn’t finished the test yet, so he didn’t have time to deal with idiots.
“Why are you cursing?” The straight hair cousin was immediately displeased when he heard that.
He had been beaten by a worm, so why couldn’t the Green Silkworm be at the transcendent level?
Not only could it be transcendent, it could also be very strong. Its energy level had to be at least 666, it couldn’t be any lower.
At this moment, they were confused. The cousins looked at each other and felt that it was a little strange. It was strange. Shi Yu should be at this venue.
It was fine if they didn’t find Shi Yu, but why didn’t the surrounding candidates hear of him?
The smart cousin asked another person.
This time, they chose a girl who looked easy to talk to. The buzz cut cousin said, “Beauty, did you have a candidate named Shi Yu here previously?”
The girl turned around and was slightly stunned. “You’re talking about that Iron-eating Beast…”
“Yes, yes, yes. It’s that Beast Tamer wearing the Iron-eating Beast’s short sleeve!” The cousins said excitedly. They had asked the right person.
“Is he done testing?”
The girl looked around and said, “The test is over. Do you know him?”
“Sort of…”
“Then do you have the contact information of that handsome guy?? He left too quickly…”
“So powerful. How did he nurture that Iron-eating Beast that can only be worth more than 3,000…” The candidate could not forget.
Eh?
The short-hair brother was stunned. What the hell? What Iron-eating Beast with more than 3,000 energy points?
“What are you talking about?” they asked.
“Don’t you guys know that Shi Yu? I’m talking about his Iron-eating Beast.”
The cousins’ hearts skipped a beat. They kept feeling that something was wrong.
“Isn’t the pet he’s training a Green Silkworm? transcendent-level, Green Silkworm, didn’t you see it?”
The female candidate: “???”
“An Iron-eating Beast with 3,000 energy points, but where did the Green Silkworm come from!” She rolled her eyes at the two of them and said, “Do the two of you have his contact information?”
Ding Yao and Zhao Rui smiled awkwardly and retreated. Damn, something seemed wrong.
Where was their huge transcendent-level green worm?!!!
Didn’t they say that the Green Silkworm shocked everyone!
However, what the f*ck was with an Iron-eating Beast with more than 3,000 energy points? The two of them had blank expressions.
…
At noon.
After leaving the lotus lake examination venue, Shi Yu found a random place to make do with a bowl of beef ramen.
The basic test had just ended, and no one came to disturb him.
However, for example, Senior Lu, Senior Beast Ear, Senior Panda, Hall Master Lin Hongnian, and the archeological seven elites had sent him a message yesterday to wish him success.
Fortunately, it wasn’t completely orphan treatment…
“Wu—” After eating and drinking his fill, Shi Yu fell into deep thought about life.
The written test, the written test, it was finally coming!
Shi Yu became slightly nervous.
“Why don’t… I take a look at a few more questions?” In the small room, the air conditioner was blowing. Shi Yu felt that it was quite comfortable. He felt that it didn’t matter even if he waited here until the afternoon… He took out “Five Year Examination Mock Questions” and casually looked at a question.
[The Greenback Eagle has an extremely fast flying speed, and it has pretty good performance in battle and reconnaissance. How fast can a Greenback Eagle, which has grown to the transcendent level and has mastered a proficient level Wind Wing skill, reach?]
“…Simple, I know this question, choose C.”

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - Wuji Airlines Tactic
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Wuji Airlines Tactic
Following that, Shi Yu attacked for another afternoon.
In the afternoon, he started to carry his beloved little school bag and headed to the examination hall.
In the Beast Taming Space, Eleven rubbed its fists.
Buggy transformed into a classic head scarf with “fighting!” printed on it, and decided to go big.
Because Shi Yu had said that if it couldn’t pass the written test this year, it shouldn’t do anything else for the next year.
They’d do a year’s paper together and wait for next year’s assessment.
“Wu…”” Ji…” This scared Eleven and Buggy.
If they had known that Shi Yu was so ruthless, they would have worked hard no matter what!
…
The written test started at 2 pm. It lasted for a total of 150 minutes and could be handed in early.
When Shi Yu arrived outside the examination room, the candidates who had already arrived immediately looked at Shi Yu. Their gazes were like electric torches that nearly blinded Shi Yu.
That gaze seemed to be saying, big boss, please guide me!
Shi Yu :”…”
It was still that group of people from venue 10 in the morning.
Even the examiners were the same trio.
However, why were they looking at him… If it was the third assessment of the wilderness trial, he might still be able to destroy other candidates indiscriminately, but this written test really couldn’t be destroyed easily. It couldn’t be…
He couldn’t even guarantee passing himself. If anyone wanted to cheat, please don’t look at his answers. Otherwise, he would be screwed.
“Everyone, go in. Sit according to the seat number.”
Shi Yu arrived at the right time. At this moment, the examiner, Zhuang Ping, stood outside the door and spoke to the candidates waiting outside.
Shi Yu directly entered the examination room.
“This place is pretty big.”
The examination room was modified to the battle room, so it was not a problem to store a hundred people. After Shi Yu found his seat, he looked at the mechanical life in charge of monitoring the ceiling and fell into deep thought. He also had a headache.
This feeling was so familiar.
It felt like he had returned to his high school days… It couldn’t be said to be a beautiful memory. It was better to let him bring Eleven and Buggy to challenge another dragon cub.
“If an ancient Legendary Beast Tamer with relatively little information encountered a modern genius Legendary Beast Tamer, whose chances of victory are higher?” When Shi Yu took out a pen, he was more curious about this question.
How much could this pet knowledge increase the strength of a Beast Tamer?
After mastering it, there would definitely be improvements to Beast Tamers, but it was more worth pondering about how much it was after quantifying it.
Moreover, was there something special about the ancient Beast Taming Civilization…
Generally speaking, no matter what civilization it was, it was basically getting more and more developed.
However, the history of this world was a little strange. There was a Mythical Era that came into contact with the world’s Origins and laws.
The Mythical creatures of that era were active. These Mythical creatures mastered the power of various laws, so they were undoubtedly the strongest.
There were also countless gaps in the totem era and the Beast Taming Era, hiding many secrets. For example, the tribe that had mastered the two evolution methods of the Iron-eating Beast looked ridiculously strong.
If only there were pets that could travel through time and take him to the ancient times…
“Let’s start handing out the papers now. Everyone, check if there are any problems with the papers first before filling in the information.”
Just as Shi Yu was letting his imagination run wild, the examination time arrived. The three examiners started to distribute the papers.
The first thing Shi Yu did when he got the paper was not to fill in the information, but to look at the questions!
He could ignore the political and historical questions that gave him points for the time being. It mainly depended on the big questions about common pets…
“As expected, there’s questions about the Green Silkworm. This wave is stable!”
“No one knows the Green Silkworm better than me…”
…
The various vocation assessment venues in Ancient Capital had already entered a quiet written assessment segment.
At this moment, in a conference room of the Beast Tamer Association in Ancient Capital, nine master-level Beast Tamers sat down one after another.
They were the examiners of the subsequent two assessments.
The first two tests of the vocation assessment were to screen a batch of candidates who did not meet the basic requirements. The real assessment actually started from the third level.
“According to the association’s requirements, we have a mission next. It’s to combine the results of the first and third stages to choose 16 key candidates. At that time, there will be special arrangements for them during the final ranking battle.”
Among the nine master-level Beast Tamers, the only middle-aged man who enjoyed the title of top-level Beast Tamer was also the overall in-charge of the professional assessment in Ancient Capital, Master Qu Jie.
“At the moment, the basic test information of the various venues has been gathered. Everyone, let’s analyze it together.”
After saying that, he pressed the remote control. The big screen in the meeting room displayed 50 names, pet names, and some numbers.
“This is ranked according to the energy values detected in the basic test from high to low.”
“We’ll choose the 16 key seed candidates from here.”
After Master Qu Jie finished speaking, the master examiners nodded and looked at the screen.
Then, the first information stunned them.
Yin Zhengfan.
Beast Taming Space level, level two.
Test pet, low-level monarch species, transcendent-level Zonyan Rock Beast.
Energy Points, 3991 points.
“Yin Legend’s son really participated in this assessment???”
In the seat, a bald master exclaimed.
“Looks like it. He contracted a monarch species pet at the age of 12. Ridiculous!”
When the masters saw this surname, this unscientific pet race, and this unscientific energy value, they were immediately stunned.
Legend Yin had really invested a lot in this son of his!
He had successfully contracted a monarch’s species pet before becoming a professional Beast Tamer. It seemed that this little kid, Yin Zhengfan, had perfectly inherited his father’s Beast Taming Space strengthening talent!
“This little guy is indeed impressive.” Master Qu Jie nodded. It was said that apart from Ancient Capital University, the other eight top universities had long contacted Legend Yin, hoping that his son would go to their place to study and further his studies.
After the vocation assessment, the nine great academies would definitely have to spend a lot of money to fight for this little Yin Zhengfan…
This Yin Zhengfan’s talent was indeed terrifying. He was also very curious how the outside world would react if the first place of this year’s assessment was taken down by a 12-year-old teenager.
In short, when faced with this information, apart from feeling that it was ridiculous, the examiners couldn’t think of any other description. Of the 16 key seed candidates, there had to be a place for Yin Legend’s son.
<ol start=”2″>
Zhang Qianyi
Beast Taming Space level, level three.
Test pet, high-level commander species, transcendent-level Thunder Cloud Sprite.
Energy Points, 3567.
Many examiners recognized the second name.
This girl was a genius from a small city. Even her parents weren’t Beast Tamers.
However, she had awakened an extremely powerful Beast Taming Talent, Elemental Coordination.
The abnormality of this talent was that it could ignore the intersection of energy and assist pets to make powerful combination skills of different elements and different attributes.
For example, the combination skill of lightning and fire, the combination skill of light and darkness. Not only would there be no problems, but it could also form an effect that was greater than when used alone!
This was actually her second time participating in the vocation assessment. When she first came to the Ancient Capital to participate in the vocation assessment, she did not pass.
However, with this stage, a top-notch master with similar talent took a fancy to her talent and accepted her as a disciple to nurture.
In one year, it seemed that not only had she made a breakthrough in the level of the Beast Taming Space from last year, she had even contracted a stronger pet.
Without a doubt, this candidate was also someone who needed to be paid attention to. In fact, she had already reached the standard of an intermediate Beast Tamer.
Professional Beast Tamers were divided into three titles, primary, intermediate, and advanced.
The criteria for primary and intermediate level was actually in the level and battle experience of the Beast Taming Space. The pets were basically still at the transcendent level.
Only high-level titles required Beast Tamers to have a pet that had grown to commander rank.
<ol start=”3″>
Miao Dongdong
Beast Taming Space level, level two.
Test pet, high-level transcendent species, transcendent-level parasite.
Energy Points, 3294.
The candidates this year had indeed surprised these master examiners too much.
“This person… What’s going on?”
“This Miao Xiaodong, he’s a worm master, or a Gu Master.”
“This parasitic Gu parasitizes the Emerald Tree Python of a low-level monarch race,” Master Qu Jie said.
Insect Masters and Gu Masters were actually the same as Dragon Tamers, Mechanics, Plant Control Masters, Spirit Mediums, and Elementalists. They were all known as branches of Beast Tamers.
However, Gu Masters were too small in number, not even one in ten thousand Beast Tamers could be found. The requirements for beast taming talent and cultivation methods were extremely high, basically all inherited through families.
High-level transcendent race, parasitic Gu. This Gu worm was not powerful, but at the same time it was also very powerful.
It could parasitize the corpses of other dead pets and occupy their bodies with nests, similar to possession.
Right now, Miao Xiaodong, who was ranked third in the basic test energy level, had obtained this result by controlling a dead monarch species pet cub.
The masters nodded and started guessing Miao Dongdong’s background.
Dong Huang only had so few Gu Masters, and there were even fewer powerful Gu Masters. Who knew where he came from…
<ol start=”4″>
Shi Yu
Beast Taming Space level, level two.
Test pet, medium transcendent species, Iron-eating Beast.
Energy Points, 3186.
The master examiners:???
“This… What’s going on?”
They could understand the first three.
One was because of his Beast Taming Talent, which allowed him to contract a monarch’s pet in advance.
One was because she had made a comeback and his level was higher.
One was because of the speciality of the bug master, but what was the fourth place… and who was he?
“He…” As the overall in-charge of this vocation assessment, Qu Jie obtained more information than the examiners.
He narrowed his eyes and looked at Shi Yu’s profile picture.
“He’s an internally determined candidate in the archeology department of Ancient Capital University. It’s said that a few months ago, he just cracked an ancient ruin and discovered the evolution method of the iron-eating beast. This news hasn’t spread yet. The iron-eating beast has the potential of a monarch after its evolution. His iron-eating beast seems to have awakened part of its evolution bloodline. It’s also very unusual.”
“And I heard that apart from the ancient ruins of the Iron-eating Beast, he also cracked a trial-type ruin in his hometown. He’s a genius in the archeology world.”
The archeologists were shocked. So that was the case.
These archeologists were not simple either. After all, there were simply countless opportunities in those ancient ruins.
This Shi Yu was also worth paying attention to. He wasn’t much worse than the people in front.
<ol start=”5″>
Yu Shu
Beast Taming Space level, level two.
Test pet, high-level commander species, Nether Bone Young Dragon.
Energy Points, 2999.
Everyone was no stranger to this candidate.
The parents of this candidate were both top-notch Beast Tamers in the ancient capital. He had perfectly inherited his parents’ talent and had pretty good attainments in Dragon Taming and Spirit Control.
The Nether Bone Young Dragon was a race formed by the skeleton of a dragon after its death. It wasn’t considered a legitimate dragon, and unless it evolved, it had always been in the form of a young dragon, so its race level was relatively low.
But even so, it was very powerful compared to ordinary candidates.
If the examiners didn’t remember wrongly, this Yu Shu even contracted a dragon soul of a commander race. After the bone dragon and dragon soul fused, they weren’t necessarily inferior to monarch-rank pets. The dragon bones and dragon souls already had most of the power of dragons.
He explained, “The selection of the key seed candidates requires not only the results of the basic test, but also the other pet of the candidate and their own Beast Taming Talent.”
“After all, the results of a pet don’t mean anything at the moment.”
“Understood!” The examiners nodded.
This vocation assessment… was going to be interesting. At least, none of the Beast Tamers in the top five of the basic assessment were easy to deal with.
…
At the same time, in the examination hall, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
If they were in the wild and their pets were infected by the poison of the Floating Poison Spider, what should they do?
Eleven’s high-speed healing didn’t seem to be useful. It only fixed ordinary injuries.
I wonder if it’s useful to add points to a higher level? If I can’t reach transcendent, I should at least have some antidote effect at the maximum level, right?
Shi Yu’s thoughts flew.
However, clearly, this was definitely not the correct answer… The correct answer was to let the Beast Tamer think of a way through the other natural resources in the wild.
What plants in the surroundings could cure this poison…
“The two of you….” Shi Yu’s face darkened.
Eleven, Buggy: “Damn it, why must I be infected with this kind of poison? Can’t I just kill the other party before I get infected?”
At the moment, Shi Yu had already answered most of the papers.
His answer was pretty smooth, but there were still some questions that Shi Yu couldn’t think of no matter how hard he tried.
But from the looks of it, this was the only way. He had to pass!
…
150 minutes passed quickly.
There were a bunch of people who handed in their papers in advance, but without Shi Yu, they waited until the end.
After putting away the papers, Shi Yu instinctively wanted to do something…
For example, exchanging answers with classmates.
However, he didn’t seem to know anyone at all.
“Forget it, the results will be out tomorrow. There should be an answer online later, right?”
“Just go and get the right answer.”
Following the crowd, Shi Yu quickly left the Lotus Lake examination venue. He didn’t give the lady in the same examination hall a chance to get his cell phone number. Then, he sighed.
He finally made it through the most difficult stage. If it went smoothly, he should be able to participate in the third assessment the day after tomorrow. At that time, it would be simple.
Shi Yu, who had experience training in the wild on Mt. Tian Mang, was very confident in the third assessment. No matter how the examiners countered Eleven, he felt that he could still kill them randomly.
Iron-eating Beast Research Institute.
Because the next assessment was the day after tomorrow, Shi Yu definitely had to return.
In the research institute, the panda senior clearly knew that Shi Yu was coming back after the exam in the afternoon. However, she looked at the unhappy Shi Yu and immediately understood. Did he fail?
“Try harder next year?” she asked cautiously.
“Not at all.” Shi Yu’s face darkened. Although he had answered many questions wrongly. he definitely passed the threshold.
He had already checked the answers on his phone in the taxi just now.
The problem was very big, but not very big either. It felt neither high nor low.
“Then why are you looking so miserable?” The panda senior was amused.
Shi Yu: “I got the wrong question for a question. I lost five points for nothing…”
He put on a painful face.
The panda senior smiled and said, “Don’t think too much. It’s fine as long as you pass the written test. You have to have a high Beast Taming level, a strong pet, and good grades for the written test. How can there be such a superman? Most people just pass the written test.”
“Oh, oh, oh, junior is back!!”
As Senior Panda consoled Shi Yu, the archeological seven elites had just returned from god knows where. Their eyes lit up when they saw Shi Yu.
“Junior Shi Yu, we heard that your Iron-eating Beast’s energy level has reached more than 3,000 points!!”
“Impressive.”
“This wave is off. There’s definitely hope for the top ten!!”
Shi Yu was stunned. “You guys are pretty well-informed.”
Zheng Yingjie laughed and said, “After all, there are so many people watching the basic test. There are one or two ridiculous values that spread very quickly.”
“Do you remember that Yu Shu we talked about before, and Yin Chuan’s son?”
“That Yu Shu’s Nether Bone Young Dragon seems to be almost three thousand. Your Iron-eating Beast is impressive, even stronger than dragons of the same level!”
Everyone expected Eleven’s strength. After all, Perfect Level Hardening, expert Level multiplication, expert Level Thunder Palm, and even having awakened an evolutionary bloodline. What a joke! He couldn’t be weak!
However, although they had expected it, this data that was comparable to a young monarch pet still surprised them a little.
It had yet to evolve. If it were to evolve, what would happen?
Shi Yu didn’t mind this. After all, Eleven had even beaten the Frost Dragon Phantom.
He was more curious about the twelve-year-old child.
“The twelve-year-old really participated in the assessment?”
Lin Yu’er said, “Not only did he participate, his basic test results are still the highest at the moment. He seems to have contracted a young king of a monarch race, his energy level is almost 4,000.”
“I heard he’s a handsome little boy. I wonder if I’ll have the chance to be his senior. Sigh, my girlish heart.”
“Ew.”
The other six elites looked at her in disdain.
“Is that so?” Shi Yu was stunned as his heart skipped a beat.
Monarch cub?
Damn, there really was one.
His energy level was so much higher than Eleven…
He probably also mastered a super skill, but he didn’t know how his skill proficiency was, including other skills.
“I feel that if I want to get first place, it won’t be so stable.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
However, if the other party had the Beast Taming Space strengthening talent, Shi Yu would not suffer much in battle.
Unlike Beast Tamers with enhanced talent, who could increase their pets in battle.
After all, those people could forcefully turn a proficient level skill into an expert level skill. It was troublesome.
“Where’s Hall Master Lin?” Shi Yu asked Senior Panda.
“He had something to do back in Ping Cheng. What’s wrong?” said the panda senior.
“No…” Shi Yu nodded. That was fine.
He had been conflicted about whether to replicate the impregnable skill. After all, there were only five pages in the skill index.
Compared to replicating this skill first, he actually wanted to hold back and see if there was a chance to encounter other rare skills first. After all, this skill wouldn’t run away or anything.He could replicate it sooner or later.
Moreover, to be honest, the impregnable skill didn’t help Eleven much at the moment.
Unless it was above expert level, though there would definitely be no time and energy. There was no need.
In Eleven’s current state, it was pretty good. In the future, under the circumstances that he had mastered a profound skill, it was not impossible for him to give it a try.
“Since Junior Shi Yu has already finished his exam and is resting tomorrow, why don’t we go out for a meal tonight?” Senior Wang Le suggested.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “I’m fine with anything.”
…
On the first day of the vocation assessment, there was a commotion in Ancient Capital.
Almost everyone on the local forums was discussing this batch of vocation assessments.
Those few with higher basic testing energy values were naturally the focus of discussion.
Of course, apart from those who discussed the local assessment situation, there were also those who discussed the assessment situation in other cities.
After all, the level of beast taming in Ancient Capital City was not very high among the nine first-level cities.
For example, in the capital where the Beast Tamer Association’s headquarters was located, the second-generation heirs gathered would only be even more ridiculous.
However, this had nothing to do with Shi Yu anymore. Shi Yu had already had a good meal before returning to sleep to rest. He fell asleep.
The next day.
After Shi Yu opened his eyes, the first thing he did was to take out his cell phone and open the scoring website.
After inputting the name and exam number, the page refreshed, and Shi Yu’s heart stopped.
Name: Shi Yu
Examination: GD 1464
Results: 250
It was nearly 10 points higher than the estimated score. In a situation where the full score was 300 points, this result was very standard. After all, the vocation assessment had a very high requirement for the written test. Passing was not calculated according to 60%.
However…
Shi Yu was speechless. Why did this result feel a little mocking?
“Heh.”
Forget it, just cross the line. He was happy today.
With a smile, Shi Yu directly entered the ruins space. He found the panda and the chirping worm to announce the good news.
However, just as he arrived, Shi Yu was even more speechless.
“What are you guys doing???”
On the other side, Eleven and Buggy seemed to have developed something on their cell phones. Buggy directly transformed into a pair of metal wings and installed them on both sides of Eleven’s body, connected by transcendent Level Hardening.
At this moment, Eleven was flying at a low altitude with a serious expression.
He couldn’t fly steadily at all.
“Wuu.”
“Ji!”
What was it doing? Climbing into the sky!
Eleven decided to try the training method of falling from a height of 10,000 meters. It was for the thrill.
At that time, its whole body would harden, and it would be thrown down from a height of ten thousand meters by the worm to hit the enemy with gravity acceleration. It was a super skill after all, right?
Previously, when they heard Shi Yu say that he might study the dual combat strategy in the future, Eleven and Buggy did not stay idle either and conceptualized it.
This was the Wuji Sky Strategy they had developed!
It could be used for training and battle. Perfect!
“You guys are really smart…” Shi Yu looked at the few huge pits on the ground as his eyelids twitched. Can you control your strategy well and guarantee that it won’t hit your Beast Tamer? Oh, he could just be etherealized, so it’s fine.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - Wilderness Survival Trial
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Wilderness Survival Trial
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Soaring Sky Strategy, to think you could think of that!
“If you could achieve zero off-target quantity and ensure that you could hit the target directly, with very high accuracy, that would be alright.”
With the acceleration of gravity, it looked like a high-speed kinetic weapon. But the problem was that even with the support of super vision, Eleven couldn’t do it.
After all, it couldn’t control itself during the fall.
“But Eleven and Buggy have indeed become smarter!”
“They all know how to study battle tactics.”
It had to be said that the upper limit of this battle tactic was pretty high. If Buggy could bring Eleven into the world and throw him down, its power would be comparable to a meteorite hitting the ground.
The premise was that Eleven wouldn’t die during the process and after hitting the ground. This was a little difficult.
“Wuu!”
“Ji!”
After being pulled out, Eleven sat obediently on the stool while Buggy lay on its head.
The two of them had looks of anticipation. Shi Yu had passed the written test. Even if they didn’t contribute much, they had worked hard, right?
What rewards would there be…
“I’ll reward you with a large amount of resources.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Eleven and Buggy’s eyes lit up.
What did it mean? Speak in detail.
“After that, I’ll give you three days to bring you to a place filled with a large amount of rare resources. At that time, you can pick whatever you want. It’s all yours.”
Shi Yu’s expression was calm and very heroic.
However, Eleven and Buggy felt that something was wrong.
“Wuu.”
“Ji.”
Eleven and Buggy discussed for a while before opening their cell phones and casually pressed a few buttons.
Then, a video started playing.
In the video, a woman in a professional suit was broadcasting the news.
“After a day of strict assessment, the current number of people passing the first two stages of the professional assessment in Ancient Capital is 6440.”
“These 6,440 people will be carrying out the most important assessment in the vocation assessment tomorrow. It’s also the assessment that determines whether they can become professional Beast Tamers, which is the field survival assessment.”
“At that time, they will be thrown into the huge trial island with 100,000 transcendent-level ferocious beasts and live for three days. In this dangerous place, there are all ferocious beasts that are extremely threatening to humans. But at the same time, it’s said that resources are everywhere here. There are a large number of rare resources from level one to three, and the resources are ten times richer than in similar dangerous places.”
“According to the assessment situation in the past years, during the wilderness survival trial, apart from completing the corresponding assessment missions, the resources obtained by the candidates during the assessment are all personal.”
“Of course, these resources are definitely protected by a large number of ferocious beasts… Therefore, I can imagine that this wilderness survival trial will be a test where risks and opportunities coexist.”
Eleven and Buggy looked at Shi Yu after watching the video.
It meant that in the third assessment, not only did they have to complete the corresponding assessment mission, they also had to be fighters for a few days and work hard to collect resources?
Pa!
Shi Yu smacked his forehead. Damn, why are the two of you looking for news yourselves?
“That’s about it.”
Shi Yu crossed his arms and said stubbornly, “We have the Ruins Bead, so you know what I mean.”
“This Island of Trials is similar to Mt. Tian Mang. It was specially prepared by the Beast Tamer Association in Ancient Capital for the vocation assessment. There are many low-level resources inside, and there are no commander-level ferocious beasts. It’s the best place for us to showcase our abilities.”
“As long as you have spare energy, our efficiency in obtaining resources will definitely be dozens of times faster than other Beast Tamers.”
Every year, in the Wilderness Survival Trial segment of the vocation assessment, a bunch of candidates and pets would die. But similarly, those who survived could also obtain pretty good growth from this treasure land.
These resources were part of the benefits that the candidates might get while letting the candidates take the risk of the assessment.
However, it was also because of these resources that the training island used as the assessment venue in Ancient Capital City this year was filled with transcendent-level ferocious beasts. These ferocious beasts that were artificially raised were the trial stones prepared for the candidates by the Beast Tamer Association in Ancient Capital City!
Eleven and Buggy looked at each other.
“Do a big one?” Shi Yu asked.
“Wuu!!!” “Ji!!!”
Eleven raised its arms and Buggy jumped down.
Charge, charge, charge!
For the sake of money! With more money, he could buy more supplements and level them up!
Eleven naturally didn’t care about the Wilderness Survival Trial, let alone Buggy. They all had the skill Absolute Sleep, so it wasn’t a problem for them to crazily plunder resources for nearly three days and three nights.
“Charge.” The three of them obtained consensus.
Eleven and Buggy’s eyes lit up like hungry bears and hungry bugs.
For ordinary candidates, the third stage was actually very difficult. They had no time to consider obtaining resources.
However, Shi Yu and the others were different. Those assessment missions were definitely convenient for them.
Before noon, Shi Yu’s application interface refreshed the gathering time for tomorrow and his assessment mission.
Eleven and Buggy came over.
Shi Yu was also very curious about what mission the Beast Tamer Association would use to target the Iron-eating Beast race.
After taking a look, Shi Yu was immediately amused.
Mission 1: Hunting a transcendent-level Gale Sparrow.
Mission 2: Hunting a transcendent-level Deception Flower.
Mission 3: Collect a water lotus.
They really did know how to counter Eleven.
The Blazing Wind Sparrow was a wind-element ferocious beast of a mid-level transcendent race. It mastered the wind wings and flew extremely fast.
It was undoubtedly very difficult to let an iron-eating beast that couldn’t fly and only had close combat abilities hunt the Gale Sparrow.
Moreover, it was in a dangerous place like the Island of Trials where ferocious beasts were everywhere. The Wind Sparrows there were probably very vigilant. If they encountered a strong enemy, they would run away immediately. The hunting difficulty would definitely be higher.
The Deception Flower was a Piranha Flower that could create illusions. It liked to disguise itself into various forms and hypnotize its prey before eating it.
This was a ferocious plant that was good at mental attacks. Generally speaking, it was impossible to deal with an Iron-eating Beast that only hardened.
As for the water lotus, it was a level-two resource that only grew in the water. It was also not easy to obtain for the iron-eating beasts.
Both missions were chosen to counter ordinary iron-eating beasts.
Unfortunately, Eleven was not an ordinary Iron-eating Beast, but the Panda King.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, these missions were not difficult at all.
Their primary goal was indeed to take advantage of this assessment to collect more resources and enrich their little vault.
“Every candidate who participates in the Wilderness Survival Trial will have three assessment missions. Two of them need to be completed in the field survival for three days.”
“The difficulty is about the same.”
Although Shi Yu felt that he could complete it, if it were an ordinary candidate with an iron-eating beast, he would definitely fail.
Unless, this candidate’s other pet countered these three missions.
For example, if an Iron-eating Beast Tamer and a second pet were super flying rats, the three missions would be directly given to them for free. The Psychic Wave limited the flight of the Fierce Wind Sparrow, and the Psychic class countered the illusion of the Deception Flower. Clone skills could be used to obtain resources, which was not a perfect pass.
Of course, this kind of situation was still a minority.
Most candidates, even if they had two extraordinary pets, they basically had one attribute.
After all, a Beast Tamer with a metal-element talent couldn’t contract a fire-element pet.
Therefore, this was also the reason why very few people passed the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital each year.
Pass the conditions of the Wilderness Survival Trial. First, survive three days on the Island of Trials. Second, complete any two assessment missions in three days.
The one who completed it would officially become a professional Beast Tamer.
As for those who did not complete it, it was not impossible. After all, there were various coincidences in the assessment process. Not all candidates might be able to quickly find the hunting target.
During the survival process in the wild, the candidate would receive one point for every hunt of an extraordinary-level ferocious beast, regardless of the type of ferocious beast. After three days, the Beast Tamer who did not complete the assessment mission would be ranked according to the points. At that time, the Beast Tamer in the top 5% of the points could similarly become a professional Beast Tamer, just like the candidate who completed the mission.
Every year, among the nearly ten thousand candidates in Ancient Capital City, only a few hundred people could become professional Beast Tamers.
The inner volume was several times that of other second-tier cities, such as the vocation assessment in Icefield City.
As for the final ranking battle, it was actually an additional addition. The nature of the battle was similar to a competition. It was to give the candidates who passed the third round a specific strength ranking. At that time, there would be a lot of spectators.
This could also better let the major schools and businesses understand the true appearance of this batch of professional newbies.
“Gather at the second airport in Ancient Capital tomorrow at 7 a.m.??”
After Shi Yu confirmed the gathering point and time for tomorrow, he decided to do the same thing again.
The distance was still not close. Why not just spend the night there today?
The reason why they gave the candidates a day off was not to let the candidates rest, but to let the candidates quickly prepare resources according to their assessment missions and formulate a plan. However, Shi Yu did not have to do any preparations, so he looked especially relaxed…
…
“They’re all here.”
When Shi Yu went out, the archeological seven elites were playing with the iron-eating beast cubs transported from the Iron Bamboo Breeding Base.
When they saw Shi Yu come out, they immediately asked, “Has the assessment mission come out? What is it?”
“Gale Sparrow, Deception Flower, a small mission,” Shi Yu said casually.
The seven archeological elites nodded and didn’t say anything. After all, they were all candidates who had passed a certain vocation assessment.
He knew that this kind of targeted assessment mission could counter ordinary pets, but it couldn’t restrain Shi Yu’s little iron-eating beast that was comparable to a young monarch.
Shi Yu would definitely pass this round easily. Even if he didn’t take the assessment mission route, taking out the Little Iron Eating Beast to multiply it would not be difficult at all. He could just choose to wipe out the transcendent beasts and get points.
However, what made the seven archeological elites more worried was that when they asked Shi Yu when his second pet was, he said it was a green worm.
A green worm that had yet to evolve!
This was very awkward. Wouldn’t that mean that Shi Yu would have to fight with just one pet against multiple throughout the entire process? Including the ranking battle later…
“What are you doing?”
At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu coming out with a backpack, Zheng Yingjie asked curiously, “Don’t tell me you’re planning to find a place to stay near the next examination venue?”
“That’s my plan.” Shi Yu chuckled.
