“Good heavens.” No one expected Shi Yu to be addicted to sleeping in the examination hall. He was really unwilling to get up early at all.
This habit… If he was pulled into war, wouldn’t she run to the entrance of the enemy camp to sleep at night?
Speaking of which, there was a big problem with Shi Yu’s lifestyle!
It was almost noon and he had just come out. It was the same previously. If he didn’t see anyone in the morning, what was Shi Yu doing at night?
Stay up late to meditate?
Shi Yu had no choice. He needed to sleep more when he was growing…
“Do you need me to give you a lift?” said Lin Yu’er.
Shi Yu: “It’s alright, it’s alright. I’ll go over myself.”
As he wasn’t as familiar with the archeological seven elites as he was with Senior Panda, he didn’t trouble her.
Speaking of which, where did Senior Panda go this morning?
However, it wasn’t important. After chatting with Qi Yingjie, Shi Yu left the research institute coolly.
At the same time, Hanging Eleven crawled out of Shi Yu’s pocket. The Green Silkworm unzipped the backpack and revealed its head.
Next was the Wilderness Survival Trial. Shi Yu decided to let them protect him from now on. Only then would Shi Yu feel safe.
Shi Yu felt that it was not enough just to turn into ethereal!
“I forgot to ask Hall Master Lin. How strong can a Beast Tamer’s battle power be when combined with the Iron-eating Beast’s transcendent Level Hardening?”
As soon as Shi Yu went out, he fell into deep thought. If Eleven hardened its whole body, could Shi Yu one-punch an ordinary transcendent-level ferocious beast?
Although he had been beaten up badly the last time, Shi Yu still had a martial arts dream…
…
At the second airport of Ancient Capital City.
The area here was relatively small compared to the first airport, and it was rarely open usually. After it was open, the flying purpose was all for business flights.
For example, the Ancient Capital University wanted to send a batch of students to the capital to exchange and learn. Or, a certain unit of the Beast Tamer Troops in the Ancient Capital wanted to go to a certain place to carry out a mission. At this time, the second airport would be opened.
When Shi Yu arrived, it was noon. The airport was still sealed off. He took a casual look and started looking for food.
In the restaurant’s private room, Shi Yu also contacted Hall Master Lin.
“It’s Shi Yu. Did the assessment go smoothly?”
“Isn’t it time for the third assessment?”
On the other side, Hall Master Lin’s laughter came.
“Yes, thanks to you, the third round will definitely be fine,” Shi Yu said.
The hardest part of the Wilderness Survival Trial was that the pets could not replenish their physical fitness in time. However, the vocation assessment was very humane. It did not exclude the wealth of the Beast Tamer from their strength. It allowed the Beast Tamer to bring a large amount of supplements, nutritional supplements, medicine, and even the most effective energy crystals to recover energy.
Naturally, people like Shi Yu had prepared a pile.
Among them, the energy crystals provided by Hall Master Lin when he contacted the dojo before he left Ping Cheng. It was enough for Eleven to use for a month.
“I actually wanted to ask you how the Iron-eating Beast should cooperate with the Beast Tamer after mastering transcendent Level Hardening.”
“Just apply the hardened substance to the Beast Tamer through contact? There won’t be any danger, right?”
Shi Yu was waiting for an answer, but there was silence on the other side.
“Hello? Is the signal bad?”
“Strange… Hello?”
Lin Hongnian: Son of a b*tch.
He was thinking about why Shi Yu was asking this.
Lin Hongnian said, “Don’t tell me that Eleven’s hardening proficiency has already reached transcendent…”
Don’t joke around!
It had only been half a year since the contract was made! Moreover, Eleven hadn’t even mastered Hardening when the contract was made!
“Yeah, would you believe me if I said so?” Shi Yu smiled.
“Like hell I believe you.” Master Lin Hongnian shook his head.
“This ability can indeed be used on Beast Tamers, and it won’t have any impact on Beast Tamers, but the premise is contact. If Beast Tamers and Iron-eating Beast don’t maintain contact, the hardened substance will automatically disappear, so the tactical meaning isn’t very big. Generally speaking, only when Beast Tamers face powerful long-range attacks and can’t dodge, and when the Iron-eating Beast is beside them, will they let the Iron-eating Beast assist in increasing their defense.”
“In short, it’s useless. Compared to entrusting my life-saving hope to this skill, it’s better to nurture a pet that’s more agile and can create shields now.” Master Lin Hongnian gave him a suggestion. “Iron-eating Beasts are not suitable for a close combat bodyguard at all.”
Transcendent Level Hardening. It wasn’t fun at all! Master Lin was deeply touched. In all aspects.
“Alright.” Shi Yu was just asking to clear his confusion.
He couldn’t maintain Armament Haki in the human body for a long time to become Iron Man…
It was boring.
Low-level skills, useless! He’d spent so much on them, too.
Wait… There seemed to be a max level to look forward to?
“I have nothing else to do. Then I won’t disturb you anymore.” After Shi Yu spoke to Master Lin, both parties hung up.
Soon, Shi Yu left the restaurant, found a hidden corner, and disappeared from the world.
He wanted to tear the test papers and relax. He wanted to prepare for the Wilderness Survival Trial tomorrow. However, one thing was for sure. The contents of the paper indeed recorded a lot of field survival knowledge. If he mastered all of it, the survival ability of a genius Beast Tamer in the wild would definitely be stronger than that of a bad student.
It was better not to tear it up. Let Eleven and Buggy revise again. Although they could crush the whole test with their strength, who knew what might happen?
…
January 3.
Time passed quickly.
In the blink of an eye, it was the day of the Wilderness Survival Trial.
More than 6,000 candidates gathered outside the second airport. Not far away, there were many onlookers.
In addition, the media of the Ancient Capital Television Station searched for the more famous candidates crazily, wanting to interview them.
However, there were too many people and it was too difficult to find.
For candidates like Yin Zhengfan, Zhang Qianyi, Miao Dongdong, Shi Yu, and Yu Shu who had made a little name for themselves on the basic test, the media reporters couldn’t catch them at all. They could only watch helplessly.
In the end, they could only choose to casually find a few candidates with passable looks to interview and get a feel for it, hoping they would accidentally share their missions in the test.
7 a.m.
The blockade line of the second airport opened. Under the guidance of the soldiers of the Beast Tamer Troops, the candidates entered in batches. Then, according to the line drawn in advance in the airport, they stood in a huge formation.
When there were more people, everyone appeared to have no presence. Shi Yu stood in the crowd and, like everyone else, silently waited for the assessment committee’s arrangements.
Soon, under the guidance of the examiners and soldiers who were maintaining order at the scene, the more than 6,000 candidates boarded six huge aircraft in batches.
“Damn, a single one can hold thousands of people. I wonder what race level it is. It has to be at least a high-level commander.”
A candidate immediately exclaimed after coming up.
But soon, he received some disdainful looks from the candidates.
Look at this naive look.
“There’s an answer…” Shi Yu smiled after sitting up.
He didn’t know who was stronger between the ancient Beast Tamers and the modern Beast Tamers.
However, he knew that modern Beast Tamers must be more comfortable than ancient times. The experience was brought about by mechanical lives with various technological crystals.
Computers, cell phones, cars, and planes. There wasn’t such a thing in ancient times, right?
In terms of talent, those Mechanics might not be inferior to the Beast Tamers who had mastered special cultivation methods in the ancient times.
In fact, these technological crystal mechanical lives could even break through the atmosphere and carry people to the moon.
In comparison, even in the Mythical Era, not every Mythical creature could break through the restraints of the planet, right?
And now, a special modification, a mythical mechanical life form, could do it. It could even completely become a taboo weapon of a country, deterring wild overlord creatures and other countries from afar.
“Sigh…”
The flying transport was divided into three levels, similar to a plane. Clearly, it was also a mechanical life form. After Shi Yu came up, he casually sat in a seat. Beside him sat a nervous-looking boy.
He kept sighing, causing Shi Yu to feel a little depressed.
Since he was already here, he should be happier.
“What are you sighing for?” Although Shi Yu didn’t know him, he decided to enlighten him with the mentality of helping others.
“N-nervous,” the boy said.
“I heard that the venue of the assessment is quite dangerous…”
“It’s indeed quite dangerous…”
“Right, my Frigid Tree basic test only has 1,300 points of energy. I wonder if it can work,” the boy said humbly.
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu turned his head and no longer meddled in other people’s business.
This kid just wanted to show off his results, right?
1300 points, low class commander species Frost Tree. Did he not think he would wreck everything in the wild? What are you nervous about!
The candidates with more than 500 energy points had yet to say anything so depressing.
“What about you?” He hurriedly asked about Shi Yu’s basic results, confirming Shi Yu’s guess even more.
“Guess,” Shi Yu said with a grin.
“Zi…”
“Zi…”
“Can you hear me?”
At this moment, a deep and hoarse voice came from inside the aircraft.
It was the sound of a machine. The person who spoke shouldn’t be on the aircraft.
“I’m the overall in-charge of this vocation assessment.”
“Firstly, congratulations on successfully passing the first two levels.”
“However, the third round is the key to the vocation assessment. I don’t know if you guys are prepared, but it’s too late to regret now.”
“Next, you will all be sent to the Island of Trials to undergo a three-day survival assessment. You are very lucky. At the moment, there are a large number of rare resources on the island, almost everywhere. There are even rare spatial and dragon-type resources. You have many opportunities to use these resources to complete a self-reinforcing.”
“What I want to remind you right now is that the vocation assessment encourages competition. If two candidates discover a resource at the same time, as long as it doesn’t hurt the Beast Tamer’s life, you can compete for the right to belong through any method. Whether it’s a battle or an equal distribution, it’s up to you.”
“Of course, these are just additional benefits for participating in the vocation assessment. The most important thing for you is to complete your assessment mission and survive.”
“During the assessment process, please also prioritize your own safety. If you encounter danger, you can seek help from other candidates or give up the assessment. Although the assessment encourages competition, it also encourages mutual assistance. However, please remember that regardless of whether it’s hunting ferocious beasts or completing missions, you are only allowed to complete them alone with your own strength. The team results are useless. The assessment committee will watch you at any time.”
An unfamiliar voice echoed in the ears of the candidates through the aircraft for a long time.
Not only did it encourage candidates to help each other when in danger, but it also encouraged competition when resources were encountered?
Shi Yu touched his chin. He wasn’t concerned about this, but he had heard that there were spatial resources?
This was too beautiful.
After all, an ordinary spatial-type resource like the Space Crystal Fruit was also 500,000 yuan each.
Space-element resources were basically not worth less than a six-digit number. In other words, there were several divine beans. He had to work hard.
Apart from competing for a higher ranking during the ranking battle, he couldn’t let go of the resources everywhere at the moment. Even if he didn’t take them, they would have to be enjoyed by the ferocious beasts on the island. It would be a waste not to take them.
“We’re about to reach our destination in three minutes…”
In the aircraft, as the candidates were thinking silently over the words of the in-charge, another voice came from the aircraft.
At this moment, the flying device had already begun to fly. The Island of Trials was outside Ancient Capital City. It wasn’t very far. With the extreme speed of this flying device, it could indeed reach in a few minutes.
It didn’t even shake. Just as everyone was in a daze, an electronic voice came from the aircraft.
“Destination has arrived… Please follow the guide and head to the aircraft exit in an orderly manner…”
A moment later.
Outside Ancient Capital City, above a huge island that was as big as a city, countless black dots landed!
Six huge flying transports floated above the blue sky. Figures walked out of the flying transports one after another and slowly landed at different spots on the Island of Trials!
It was not a parachute jump, but faint blue fluorescent light spread over every candidate.
Psychic power!
If one observed carefully, they would discover that higher up in the sky, in the white sea of clouds, a huge eye more than a hundred meters wide was open, silently looking down.
The eye was shining with a blue light.
It was using its mental strength to throw every candidate from the sky to the designated assessment location.
Name: Eye of the Sky
[Attributes]: Machinery, Spirit
[Race Level]: Medium Monarch
[Race Skill]: Psychic, Heavenly Eye, Deterrence???
< Introduction > It’s an artificial mechanical life. It has analytical abilities and powerful Psychokinesis that exceed supercomputers.
Although the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital City was strict and the most intense in the inner scroll, at the same time, the resources invested in a vocation assessment organized by a first-level city was not what those second-level cities could compare to. This was also why the competition for the assessment in a first-level city was so intense, and there were still many people who came to challenge it.
His entire body was enveloped by Psychic power. As Shi Yu slowly descended from the sky, he raised his head and looked at the huge eye in the sky.
“It’s too high, I can’t touch it.”
“But forget it. The super skill Heaven’s Eye isn’t very useful. It can’t be upgraded too, so it’s definitely far inferior to the highest level super vision cost ratio.”
…
The original name of the island of trials didn’t matter anymore. After it was chosen by the Beast Tamer Association as the wilderness survival assessment venue for the vocation assessment, the name of this place had always been this.
The island was very large, and there were more than 100,000 ferocious beasts everywhere. However, the scale and strength of the ferocious beasts had always been under the control of the Beast Tamer Association. After all, as a vocation assessment location, there shouldn’t be commander-level creatures.
At this moment, on the trial island, in the mountain range, in the snow mountain, under the volcano, in the forest, by the forest… In various environments, there were already candidates who had been thrown into positions closer to their hunting targets.
As the island was huge, the candidates would not encounter it easily in the short term.
Twilight Forest.
Shi Yu should have landed at this place. At this moment, in the dark forest, Shi Yu wanted to curse.
Couldn’t they send him to a prettier point? The seaside at the edge of the island was pretty good!
“Wu!!”
“Ji!!!”
Eleven climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder, and the Green Silkworm climbed onto Shi Yu’s right shoulder. Alright, alright, let’s go!!
“Let’s leave this place first,” Shi Yu said. Regardless of whether there were Wind Sparrows or Deception Flowers nearby, this place was not likable.
It was better to slip away first. The assessment mission depended on fate. If they encountered it, they would hunt. If they didn’t encounter it, then forget it. In any case, the points from the ferocious beasts they encountered when they gathered other resources were probably enough for them to advance.
“Wuu!!” Eleven nodded heavily. Then, he suddenly turned around and looked behind a thick tree. With a buzz, the leaves fell.
In the next second, a one-meter-tall mantis with sharp double blades, a hunter in the forest, and a huge saber that was preparing to ambush Shi Yu and the others fell.
< Name > Great Blade Mantis
[Attributes]: Insect
[Race Level]: Medium transcendent
[Race Skill]: Slash
They had agreed that there were transcendent-level ferocious beasts everywhere, but this one seemed to have only awakened level ten. It was meaningless, it didn’t even have points.
However, expert level deterrence was very useful.
“Ji—” At this moment, Buggy was just about to pull the prey over with the worm silk when Shi Yu stretched out his hand to stop him.
“Let’s go.”
This thing wasn’t worth anything, nor was it like a ginseng baby. After fainting, those babies could still be hugged and nibbled.
However, there was definitely no such thing as a cute pet like Baby Ginseng in such a place. On this training island, there were all wild beasts, ferocious beasts, and ferocious beasts with strong attack tendencies!
After turning around, Shi Yu looked at the sky again. Speaking of which, could that Eye of Heavenly Silk accurately record the points of more than 6,000 candidates?
If it was comparable to the analytical ability of a supercomputer… Perhaps it could.
…
“Eh, resources are really everywhere.”
At this moment, before leaving the forest, Shi Yu discovered an unripe level-two dark-element resource, Darklight Grass.
To be precise, Eleven discovered it. Its super vision could see the energy flow and avoid the meaningless battle just now. It was very convenient to find resources!
“Wu!” However, after Eleven’s reminder, Shi Yu was in no hurry to attack. This was because not only was there an extraordinary-level ferocious beast nearby, there seemed to be other Beast Tamers spying on this resource.
“Hiss…”
Perhaps it sensed that a life form had entered its territory. In the forest, the ferocious beast that regarded the Darklight Grass as its own couldn’t sit still anymore. A huge python covered in dark patterns slowly crawled around the Darklight Grass, its snake eyes observing its surroundings.
This was a dark-element transcendent-level snake-type ferocious beast. Its battle power was definitely not low.. Seeing this, the Beast Tamer on the other side immediately had the intention to retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - Panda Knight Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Panda Knight Attack
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the silent forest, a huge python nearly seven to eight meters long with obvious dark patterns was entrenched around the darklight grass. It stared at its surroundings cautiously. Its expression was fierce to the extreme, but its heart was in a panic.
It had already sensed the enemy’s aura, but precisely because it sensed the enemy’s unusual deterrence, it didn’t dare to act rashly.
Not far from the dark screen grass, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others stood behind a huge tree. On the other side, a lone candidate was standing behind another huge tree. There was also a blue centipede with multiple feet wrapped around his body.
The Mad Flow Centipede was a water-type pet of a high-level transcendent race. The Dark Ring Poison Python was also a ferocious beast of a high-level transcendent race, and it was a rare dark-type and poison-type ferocious beast. This Beast Tamer was clearly afraid, because the Dark Ring Poison Python was not to be trifled with at first glance.
If he didn’t settle it properly, he couldn’t go back alive anymore. His parents would not be pleased about that…
“Are you going?”
At this moment, the sudden sentence shocked the Dark Ring Poison Python and this candidate.
There were others?
This candidate clearly didn’t notice Shi Yu and the others.
This was the power of the Perfect Level super vision. The energy vision trait of Perfect Level super vision could directly let Eleven capture the energy fluctuations in a large area. For example, Eleven could almost directly judge the exact amount of energy in the bodies of the Mad Flow Centipede and the Dark Ring Poison Python.
Its judgment was that its opponent was not very strong, only one-fifth of its strength.
“Do you have any Dark Ringed Poison Python or Darklight Grass for your missions? If you do, you go first. After you go out, just add me as a friend and give me a red packet,” Shi Yu said with a yawn.
“I’m not, I didn’t. I was just passing by, passing by!”
The candidate opposite was speechless. Should he say that he was a good person or a money-grubber?!
However, he gave up on this resource and this ferocious beast. This guy could fight whoever he wanted.
If he had the time, wouldn’t it be nice to go and find those low-level transcendent bug-type transcendent ferocious beasts?
Shi Yu and this candidate started communicating through the air.
Dark Ring Poison Python:???
These people weren’t very polite?
Although it couldn’t understand, why did it feel like it had been mocked!
The Dark Ring Poison Python’s eyes turned red. Son of a b*tch, It couldn’t take it anymore. It suddenly stretched out its body and opened its huge mouth, wanting to eat the unripe Darklight Grass and escape. It didn’t even wait for it to mature. Now that there are people eyeing it covetously, it would be a gain if it ate it. It was a snake, after all. In short, no one else can get it…
“Holy shit.”
The series of actions of the Dark Ring Poison Python clearly stunned the candidate on the other side and his Mad Flow Centipede.
It ate it just like that? Not waiting for it to mature?
Shi Yu was also somewhat silent. F*ck, what the heck was with this snake?
You’re a ferocious beast that caused the deaths of thousands of people every year, is your temper so weak? Shouldn’t you kill us and then silently guard your food until it ripens? What kind of snake just eats it?
However, Shi Yu and the others clearly wouldn’t give the snake this chance.
Boom!!!
Just as the Dark Ring Poison Python was about to directly eat the underripe Darklight Grass, an invisible wave instantly spread from afar!
This was the terrifying aura the Dark Ring Poison Python had sensed previously. Previously, it was still very faint, but at this moment, it clearly sensed that the aura was surprisingly terrifying and strong!
Buzz!
At this moment, the Dark Ring Poison Python’s movements directly stopped. Its mind was in a daze and even a little dizzy. In order to save physical strength, Eleven didn’t use all its strength. In the next second, Buggy did a follow up move. A transparent thread shot out and wrapped around the Dark Ring Poison Python’s poisonous body. In the next second, the worm silk caved in and dark red blood splattered. The Dark Ring Poison Python’s body was directly divided into two and it was dismembered on the spot!
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Eleven and Buggy looked serious. They felt that their cooperation was not very smooth.
However, everything happened very quickly. This made the other candidate who was observing in the dark suddenly widen his eyes and take a step back with a hoarse voice. His Mad Flow Centipede also felt a chill in its heart at this moment and trembled all over. Because in their eyes, it was as if nothing had happened at all. The Dark Ring Poison Python directly died, and the scene was abnormally scary.
The sudden change shocked them so much that their hearts skipped a beat. They ignored everything and turned to leave, as if Shi Yu and the others, who had yet to show themselves, were even more terrifying than this Dark-Ringed Poison Python.
“Uncooked Darklight Grass. Its value isn’t high. If there’s no mission, it’s useless for ordinary people to harvest it. The energy will quickly disappear. However, if it’s transplanted into the ruins, there’s still hope of saving it… After it ripens, it can still be sold for tens of thousands. It’s alright.”
“Eh, why did he leave directly?” Shi Yu looked up and shook his head. He slowly walked to the vicinity of the spoils of war and began to clean the battlefield to collect valuable resources.
…
As Shi Yu gained something, the assessment had only started for less than an hour, but pets had already died and candidates had already left the assessment. In the sky above the Island of Trials, in the huge aircraft, many examiners were expressionless as they watched the rapid changes in the data.
They were still too young. It seemed that some candidates still came to participate in the vocation assessment without adequate preparations.
With this kind of strength and quality, they might as well obediently find an ordinary job to support them in their old age. Why did they have to take things so hard and step into the profession door? Did they think that it was just a normal game, a battle of rules?
“When can the Eye of Heaven synchronize the data?” The person in charge of the vocation assessment, Master Qu Jie, asked.
“It’s being loaded,” the technician replied.
“You’re talking nonsense.”
The other examiners smiled and looked at the screen that connected to the Eye of Heaven silently. On it, the assessment data of every candidate was updated in real time.
At the moment, in the highest record, there were already candidates that have hunted five transcendent-level ferocious beasts.
It was the little girl who had mastered the talent of elemental coordination.
This talent was indeed violent. In terms of output ability, she might be the most outstanding candidate this year.
…
At the moment, Shi Yu was still trying to walk out of the Twilight Forest.
He had a panda on one shoulder and a worm on the other. He walked step by step.
After walking for a long time, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Why?
He was a Beast Tamer, why did he have to walk himself?
“Eleven.”
“Huh?”
Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, revealed a lost look.
Moreover, it had a bad feeling.
“Come down and get bigger. Then, get on all fours.”
Eleven:???
What for?
Eleven felt uneasy and didn’t dare to go down.
“I’ve carried you for so long. It’s time for you to carry me, right? If we continue like this, the first one to run out of stamina might be me, the Beast Tamer.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Hurry, hurry, hurry. Moreover, I think I’ve found the correct way to use transcendent Level Hardening!”
The pandas in this world, also known as the iron-eating beasts, were different. Unlike on Earth, they were used to walking on two legs, but it wasn’t like they didn’t walk on all fours. At this moment, Shi Yu’s intention was very clear. He wanted Eleven to be his mount for the time being. He wanted to ride the iron-eating beasts like how he rode a horse.
Iron-eating beasts could also be mounts! He should have known that he had actually been an Iron-eating Beast’s mount for so long. This shouldn’t have happened.
Moreover, when he rode the Iron-eating Beast, he would always be in contact. Didn’t the conditions for Beast Tamers to harden the whole time be fulfilled?
Shi Yu carried the messy Eleven down and looked at it seriously.
“Sob!!” Eleven looked conflicted. What about fighting? Why don’t we let Buggy become a dragon and carry us?
Buggy:???
What did it have to do with it? The Beast Tamer clearly wanted to be a Panda Knight, not a Dragon Knight!
Shi Yu said, “I feel that you still have to do it. The insect skills consume too much physical strength. If you do it, the consumption will be like a drop in the ocean. It’s not even 1% of the usual training volume. It won’t affect anything.”
“Just carry me while doing reconnaissance, and using deterrence.”
“The average level of the ferocious beasts on this Island of Trials is not high. It’s not interesting. The enemy can just be left to Buggy. It’s just nice to train it.”
“Ji!” Buggy expressed that it could. This island was the first step in its rise. As the Green Silkworm at the bottom of the food chain in the transcendent world, it was determined to defeat those top-notch predators and nurture its deterrence.
Eleven: Wuu. (艹皿艹)
“Sob.” Seeing that Shi Yu and Buggy were on the same side, Eleven cried. As it cried, she multiplied into a size that could carry Shi Yu.
It was miserable. The Panda King had directly become a mount. Eleven couldn’t say it out loud, but forget it, who knew that its Beast Tamer could come up with this?
“Actually, Go even bigger. Then, I think I can sit on your shoulder… Forget it, that would be too wasteful of energy.” Shi Yu patted the iron-eating beast under him, feeling very pleased.
As for Buggy, it came to Eleven’s head.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven turned around and asked if they could start moving.
“We still have to wait.” Shi Yu looked at the surrounding trees and instructed Buggy, “Cut down a tree and cut a suitable wooden saber for me.”
Buggy was confused.
He was going to start again?
It was doubtful, but it still did as instructed.
Soon, a suitable wooden saber appeared in Shi Yu’s hand. Seeing this, Shi Yu couldn’t help but chuckle and say, “Eleven, harden!”
Buzz!
At that moment, Shi Yu seemed to be wearing invisible armor. At the same time, the wooden saber in his hand had become countless times harder.
Shi Yu cockily made Eleven take two steps forward. He directly swung his saber at the tree beside him. In the next moment, the huge tree split into two and fell.
“I’m invincible. This wave will definitely not fail..”

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - Three Space Skills
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Three Space Skills
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Eleven’s hardening, Eleven’s deterrence, his own etherealization, and the support of Buggy.
Even if he went to PK a transcendent creature, with four layers of protection, Shi Yu had no idea how he got injured.
The soul of courting death burned fiercely.
As a simple person, his joy was actually very simple.
As long as there was excitement, it would be enough.
“Charge!”
“Wuu!”
Shi Yu turned into a Panda Knight and let Eleven sprint out of the forest.
It had to be said that with Eleven opening the way, their speed had increased ridiculously.
Moreover, as Eleven ran, it was extremely domineering, and no ferocious beast dared to stop them.
However, this was clearly not what Shi Yu wanted. Under his special request, they took the initiative to find a ferocious beast.
On the ground, there were fallen leaves everywhere. Shi Yu rode on the iron-eating beast and looked at the Gale Sparrow foraging in front of him.
Oh, wasn’t this the assessment mission target?
What a coincidence.
This transcendent-level Gale Sparrow had just swallowed an Awakening-level Red-Crowned Snake into its stomach when it immediately welcomed unexpected guests like Shi Yu.
“Jiu!!!!!!!”
The Gale Sparrow, which was covered in brown feathers, clearly didn’t realize the severity of the problem, because Eleven had retracted its passive deterrence.
At this moment, it only had eyes for the fat caterpillar on Eleven’s head.
Slurp. Slurp.
It had just finished eating a Red-Crowned Snake, and the one-meter-tall Wind Sparrow was still not satisfied. Its gaze was sharp and greedy, and the DNA engraved in its blood directly moved.
It hadn’t been easy.
It completely didn’t expect to see such a fat worm on this island.
Buggy: ˋ_ˊ, bastard bird!
“Ji!!!!” Buggy let out a hiss, its whole body trembling slightly, wanting to personally teach its natural enemy a lesson.
Damn bird! It had endured a long time of suffering for this!
“Don’t panic, leave it to me.”
However, Shi Yu said confidently.
Don’t worry, Buggy, since I’ve contracted you, your Beast Tamer will protect you well!
He could capture a mere Gale Sparrow easily.
Buggy turned to look at Shi Yu with a dark expression. Can you do it?
“Wuu.”
Under Shi Yu, Eleven said weakly. Even if it didn’t trust Shi Yu, couldn’t it trust its transcendent Hardening?
Since Shi Yu was willing to play, why not cooperate with the Beast Tamer.
“Ji…” The leader had already said so. What else could Buggy do?
As the man and two pets interacted, the Gale Sparrow felt like it had been insulted, just like the Dark Stripe Poison Python from before. This was too much!
“Jiu!!!!”
It let out a loud cry again. The surrounding leaves vibrated, and green energy waves spread on its wings.
The Gale Sparrow was a medium-sized wind-element bird-type pet. It was a medium-level transcendent species. It had racial skills such as Wind Wings, Whirlwind Drill, and Wind Feather.
Wind Wings was a speed raising skill, while Whirlwind Drill formed a small whirlwind on the sharp long beak with extremely strong penetration power!
At this moment, the Gale Sparrow’s Wind Wings and Whirlwind Drill were activated at the same time. It suddenly attacked the Green silkworm on Eleven’s head from the sky, planning to chop up and eat its prey first!
“If you use the long-range skill Wind Feather, I might be a little afraid of you.”
“Unfortunately, you used the wrong skill.”
On the iron-eating beast, Shi Yu looked at the green light that flashed before his eyes. He raised his wooden saber with a calm expression.
In the next second, Eleven’s deterrence erupted. The Gale Sparrow suddenly stopped in midair. At the same time, Shi Yu, whose whole body and weapon had hardened, swung his wooden saber!
Profundity: Great shock!
At this moment, it was as if Shi Yu’s saber had swung out, displaying an extremely powerful aura that shocked the Tempest Bird. The Tempest Bird had no place to dodge, and it was directly smashed to the ground like a meteor in mid-air!!
Bang!!!
Shi Yu’s transcendent physique, in combination with Eleven’s transcendent Hardening, was surprisingly effective!
“Damn it!”
With a swing of the saber, the Blazing Wind Sparrow naturally wouldn’t lose its ability to fight because of this. Buggy attacked in time, and at this moment, Shi Yu fell into deep thought with an indignant expression.
“Next time, can any of you record this for me?” Shi Yu felt that such a handsome moment should be preserved.
Eleven, Worm:???
“Wu!” Eleven’s watery eyes widened. Which jerk said that giving battle recordings was meaningless just a while ago?!
Why was it that when it came to him, it wasn’t like that anymore!!!
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “Did I say anything like that? Damn, at most, I’ll record it for you during the ranking battle.”
“I’ll hire a professional cameraman to record it for you, alright!?”
Just like that, Shi Yu completed an assessment mission. For some reason, the Eye of Heaven that was in charge of recording paused for a moment.
…
After satisfying Shi Yu’s Swordmaster Addiction, Shi Yu and the others finally placed their focus on traveling and gathering rare resources.
It took about an hour before Shi Yu and the others came out of the dark and humid forest.
Outside the forest, there seemed to be a valley.
Eleven climbed onto a higher rock and looked around. Then, it suddenly looked at the sky and cried out.
“Ji ji!!!”
“Ji!!”
Apart from Eleven, Buggy suddenly became excited too. He spat out a worm silk and sensed something with it.
Shi Yu also heard their conversation.
Eleven: “I sensed a strong energy wave nearby. Moreover, the energy wave is very similar to the bug’s skill wave!”
Buggy: “Yeah, that’s right, it’s spatial fluctuations!”
Both of them looked at the blurry sky in the distance.
“You mean, a spatial creature is fighting?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned and patted Eleven without another word.
Then what are you waiting for!!!
To the venue!
In the next second, Eleven leaped down from the mountain rock.
Shi Yu: “Damn, slow down.”
…
In the valley.
Where Shi Yu and the others were headed.
A handsome young man about 1.5 meters tall, with a lean figure and fair skin, stood calmly on the ground.
Not far from him, a white butterfly creature with huge transparent wings was fighting nine transcendent creatures alone.
The nine transcendent creatures were all killing bees of low-level transcendent races.
Although they were only low-level transcendent races, these nine Killer Bees had reached transcendent level on a rare occasion. At this moment, they were staring at the enemy in front of them crazily with their dark red eyes. The spikes on the tail of their stomachs were ready!
However…
Even if any professional Beast Tamer or intermediate-level Beast Tamer encountered these nine transcendent-level Killer Bees, they would still feel a headache and fear. At this moment, facing this huge white transparent butterfly, they felt as if it didn’t even care.
Every time they stabbed the butterfly with their tails, they either went straight through the butterfly’s body, as if they had stabbed air. That, or the butterfly teleported to other places, making them hit nothing.
The nine Killer Bees weren’t stupid. They also wanted to directly attack the humans in the distance, but the nine of them seemed to be restricted in a certain space and couldn’t leave this area at all. Every time they flew far, it was like hitting a transparent wall. It was very aggrieving.
After playing around for a while, the patience of the nine Killer Bees had already been worn down to the limit.
At this moment, the teenager slowly said, “Let’s finish them. Someone’s here.”
In the sealed space, the transparent butterfly nodded gently when it heard its master’s command. In the next moment, the space in the domain where the nine Killer Bees were located seemed to tremble, and spiderweb-like cracks appeared. Then, strong vibration waves gathered inside. Almost instantly, the nine Killer Bees exploded and died…
Bang!!!!
On a rock somewhere, Shi Yu’s heart surged when he saw this shocking scene!
“This age… is that Yin Zhengfan?”
“It’s just f*cking ridiculous. Apart from the Zonyan Rock Beast that contracted a low-level monarch race, there’s actually a spatial pet??”
[Name]: Spatial Crystal Butterfly
[Attributes]: Space
[Race Level]: High-level commander
[Race Skill]: Instant Transmission (Advanced spatial skill, can be used for short-distance space jumps).
Concealment (High-level spatial skill, can hide the body in an alternate space to avoid damage)
Space Shackles (Advanced spatial skill, can create a certain range of sealing space, and can cause spatial oscillations in this range to cause damage).
It’s one of the strongest commander races. Although it doesn’t have any super skills, it’s comparable to a monarch species creature.
At this moment, information about this creature appeared in Shi Yu’s mind.
Slowly, his gaze flickered.
He had previously asked the Archeological Seven Elites if there were any students who cultivated spatial pets in Ancient Capital University. The answer he got was very disappointing. There wasn’t even one in the huge Ancient Capital University. It was obvious how rare spatial pets were.
However, right now, three high-level spatial skills appeared in front of Shi Yu.
And every one of them had extremely high tactical value!
Teleportation, the most powerful life-saving skill of traveling!
Concealment was similar to Shi Yu’s etherealization. It was also a life-saving skill!
Space Seal, Strong Control and Output Skill, invincible!
What was this? Heaven’s love?
At the same time, Yin Zhengfan, who had finished the battle below, raised his head and looked at Shi Yu. The young man looked handsome and elegant, but there were other qualities in his gaze that others couldn’t see.
Shi Yu met his gaze and fell into deep thought.
“I have to find a way to replicate it! Otherwise, I won’t be able to sleep tonight..”

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - Evolution Countdown
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Evolution Countdown
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
“May I help you?”
The candidate of the Spatial Crystal Butterfly looked up in Shi Yu’s direction.
Then, there was a slight silence.
Because the appearance of the person was a little strange, no, very strange.
On the mountaintop, Shi Yu and Buggy were riding the Iron-eating Beast. Shi Yu even held a wooden sword. This shape made the twelve-year-old boy a little confused, but he felt that it was awesome.
So handsome…
“Hello.”
Shi Yu patted Eleven and smiled as if he was a good person.
During the process of coming down, he looked at Yin Zhengfan, who had straight hair like a girl’s head. He was clearly a boy, but he was even more delicate than a girl. His smile was even wider.
He looked like a polite and obedient child. Perhaps stealing the butterfly’s skills would go smoothly?
“Wuu.” Soon, Eleven carried Shi Yu down.
Shi Yu and Eleven were alright, but Buggy looked at the Spatial Crystal Butterfly flying back to the young man in admiration.
So powerful.
And so handsome.
What would it look like after it evolved?
“Are you Yin Zhengfan?”
“The candidate who’s first in the basic test.” After Shi Yu got down, he got down from Eleven and looked at the other party.
In the face of Shi Yu and the others’ questions, Yin Zhengfan’s expression did not change. He nodded and said, “It’s me.”
“As expected, it’s you! You can participate in the vocation assessment at the age of 12. Impressive. I was still playing with mud at your age,” Shi Yu first said what the other party might like to hear.
“Thank you. I actually have a lot to learn.” Yin Zhengfan.
“By the way, my name is Shi Yu…”
“Hello.” Yin Zhengfan nodded, thinking that Shi Yu definitely had something to do.
“Well, I heard you contracted a pet of a monarch’s race. I didn’t expect you to have a Spatial Crystal Butterfly…” Shi Yu looked at the Spatial Crystal Butterfly and asked curiously,” Can I ask you a question? “
“When the Crystal Butterfly evolved, what did it use to break out of the cocoon?”
“Did it rely on Concealment to directly ignore the cocoon and come out, or did it rely on Instant Transmission to directly teleport out, or should I say, space shackles?”
“There’s no other meaning. As you can see, I’ve also contracted a Green Silkworm and want to nurture it in the direction of the spatial system, so I’m more curious.” Shi Yu revealed a bright and warm smile.
Yin Zhengfan looked at the bugs on Eleven’s head.
Want to nurture it in the direction of space?
Shi Yu had an evolution plan?
If there was, why would he ask such a question?
However, Yin Zhengfan still answered, “Relying on spatial shackles.”
The cocoon could be seen as a sealed space. The Spatial Crystal Butterfly spreading its wings inside caused spatial fluctuations. Whether it could shatter the cocoon determined whether it could evolve perfectly.
And Concealment and Instant Transmission were racial skills that could only be awakened after breaking through the cocoon.
“Is there anything else?” After a simple explanation, Yin Zhengfan, who didn’t look like a young genius, asked again.
“There’s one more.” Shi Yu hurriedly said, “I heard that the Instant Transmission skill can also carry people. Can you let me and my Green Silkworm experience it? Of course, it’s not a wasted experience. We will pay you.”
“Because I want it to evolve into a spatial system, we’re more curious about the experience of spatial movement skills.”
Instant Transmission could carry people and move together, but without reaching transcendent level Instant Transmission, it could only teleport with the carrier!
Shi Yu wanted to use this method to come into contact with the Spatial Crystal Butterfly.
Yin Zhengfan showed a troubled expression.
“Carrying someone in Instant Transmission should consume a lot of physical energy, right? I can use this as a reward.” Shi Yu took out an Ethereal Stone.
The Beast Taming Spatial Strengthening Talent was a money-sucking business. It urgently lacked spatial-type resources. Shi Yu knew this. A piece of Ethereal Stone for a Teleportation Experience Card. This was a very good deal, right!
“Ethereal Spirit Stone…” As expected, Yin Zhengfan’s gaze was attracted by the Ethereal Spirit Stone.
It was indeed as Shi Yu had imagined. This talent to increase the level of space was very difficult. Cultivation resources like the Ethereal Spirit Stone were almost necessary.
Yin Zhengfan completely didn’t expect that Shi Yu would take out an Ethereal Stone worth millions as a reward for one experience. From the looks of it, he was very sincere…
However, Yin Zhengfan’s next words made Shi Yu’s heart skip a beat.
“I don’t want to.”
Shi Yu: “?”
This damn child, didn’t he know to feel sorry for his legendary father? He can’t always let his father provide cultivation resources. It’s time to learn to earn it himself!
“This is too expensive.”
“I don’t want your Ethereal Stone. I can let the Spatial Crystal Butterfly give you a taste of Instant Transmission, but I have a condition.” Yin Zhengfan looked at the iron-eating beast beside Shi Yu.
“I’ve also heard of you guys. Shi Yu, Iron-eating Beast, basic test energy level 3186. Can you let it fight my Spatial Crystal Butterfly?”
Compared to the Ethereal Spirit Stone, Yin Zhengfan was more interested in the combination of Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast.
The reason why he came to participate in the vocation assessment at this age was to train himself. Because if he waited until he was a little older, the vocation assessment would be completely free of pressure for him.
His goal was to surpass his father and climb to the highest level, so he wasn’t prepared to let go of any opportunity to improve himself. He might not necessarily have a chance to encounter Shi Yu in the next ranking battle, so it was better to challenge a candidate with pretty good strength now.
“Let the Spatial Crystal Butterfly fight my Iron-eating Beast?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned. “That’s simple.”
“Alright,” Yin Zhengfan said gently.
But soon, Yin Zhengfan fell silent and had a worry.
If they fought now and defeated Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast, would it affect Shi Yu’s subsequent assessment?
He didn’t mind. After all, no matter how the Spatial Crystal Butterfly was exhausted, there was still a pet of a monarch species. However, apart from an Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu seemed to only have one Green silkworm with combat power close to zero.
“The battle will be in three days. When the assessment is about to end, I’ll wait for you here,” Yin Zhengfan said after thinking about it.
Three days later?
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded again. After a few seconds, he deduced what the other party was thinking.
Good child.
This Yin Zhengfan seemed to have decided to postpone the battle in order to not affect his assessment.
Shi Yu recalled how he had fought with his friends for the TV remote control at the orphanage when he was 12 years old. He felt that it was completely incomparable. A good upbringing was really important.
“Then three days later.”
Although he felt that the battle now wouldn’t affect anything, Shi Yu still nodded in agreement.
At that moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, Yin Zhengfan nodded. His Spatial Crystal Butterfly immediately waved its transparent water-like wings and slowly flew towards Shi Yu.
“Buggy,” Shi Yu called out to Buggy, who immediately climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder with a “Ji, Ji, Ji”.
Apart from secretly learning skills, Shi Yu indeed had the intention of letting Buggy experience spatial movement skills in advance.
Perhaps it could increase the affinity of Buggy and the spatial element.
At the same time, Eleven was stunned.
“What about me?”
These guys went to experience Instant Transmission, what about Eleven?!
“Wuu!!” Eleven immediately shrunk back to a size smaller than a worm. It pulled Shi Yu’s pants and climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder.
It planned to experience it together.
This scene stunned Yin Zhengfan across from him.
Multiplication?
An iron-eating beast that could multiply?
Yin Zhengfan fell into deep thought. Forget it, a transcendent-level Iron-eating Beast with more than 3100 energy points was already very unscientific in itself, so it was fine if it could multiply.
As expected, just as his father said, the world was very big. There were all kinds of Beast Tamers and pets.
And if he wanted to become the strongest Beast Tamer, he had to meet different people and beasts one by one and defeat them!
Yin Zhengfan gradually revealed an imperceptible solemn gaze.
“Then, I’ll be troubling you.”
At this moment, on the other side, Shi Yu stretched out his hand, indicating for the Spatial Crystal Butterfly to come into contact with his hand. At the same time, he activated his telepathy and said to the Spatial Crystal Butterfly.
“Mimi??”
Shi Yu could also communicate with it. Clearly, this Spatial Crystal Butterfly did not expect this. It nodded slightly and responded politely like its owner, landing in Shi Yu’s hand.
It was difficult to imagine that such a Spatial Crystal Butterfly had instantly killed nine ferocious and fatal killing bees just now.
At this moment, the Spatial Crystal Butterfly landed. Shi Yu activated the skill index at the same time.
[Confirm recording]
Skill: Teleport
Skill: Concealment
Skill: Space Shackles
Status: Can be taught
Shi Yu copied three high-level spatial skills in one go, and there were only two more skill slots left.
At the same time, he turned to look at Buggy on his shoulder.
All of them could be taught.
This was related to the Buggy’s full-level spatial-element Worm Silk and the fact that it had already mastered the spatial skill, Phantom Illusion.
It could now be considered a halfway spatial Green Silkworm.
In comparison, Eleven didn’t have any spatial talent at the moment. Apart from its main metal attribute, its thunder attribute talent was pretty good. After all, it quickly comprehended the Thunder Palm.
After the replication was completed, Shi Yu looked fine on the surface, but his heart had already bloomed like a flower.
Alright, there were four spatial skills. At the same time, the spatial shackles and illusions could be used to break out of the cocoon. The preparation of the skills before the evolution of the worm was almost completed.
Of course, like deterrence and multiplication, he could also teach it to Buggy in the future. It was also a pretty good way to use deterrence points to increase the bugs’ mental attributes.
After these skill points reached proficiency level and above, it would be best if the Perfect level guaranteed that they could break out of the cocoon 100%. Next, Shi Yu only needed to prepare the corresponding spiritual and spatial evolution materials before he could let Buggy try to evolve.
Because their evolution method was relatively unique, there was no need to consider a specific evolution ingredient formula for the DIY evolution path at all. They just needed to find rare materials with corresponding attributes.
At the moment, Shi Yu had already made plans.
He had obtained a pretty good ranking in the vocation assessment. After entering the Ancient Capital University, if there were resources reward, he planned to use the Ancient Capital University as a platform to find spatial evolution materials.
As for Eleven’s evolution materials, Shi Yu felt that after the Iron-eating Beast Evolution Theory was announced, as a Beast Tamer who had discovered the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution method, it shouldn’t be difficult for him to obtain them. He might even be able to get a very large convenience and discount!
At the thought of this, Shi Yu immediately felt that the two pets under him had the potential to become overlords of their species.
Evolution was just around the corner.
…
At the same time, on the professional assessment committee’s side, the nine examiners finally had the video data synchronized with the Eye of Heaven.
Due to the huge amount of calculations, they had to update the assessment mission progress in real time and calculate the points of more than 6,000 candidates. They wanted to rescue the candidates at the first moment after they decided to give up the assessment. Only now did the Eye of Heaven upload some video information to the examiners.
At this moment, the nine examiners had also waited for a long time. After all, they still had to combine this assessment to choose 16 key seed candidates.
How to let these candidates perfectly display their strength and potential in the ranking battle was something they needed to consider in the future.
At the current assessment mission progress, no candidate had completed two missions. However, in terms of points, there were already candidates with 16 points. It was equivalent to hunting 16 transcendent creatures.
“It’s Yin Zhengfan…”
The examiners watched the replay data of Yin Zhengfan’s video. Then, they saw the process of Yin Zhengfan bringing the Spatial Crystal Butterfly to instantly kill transcendent-level creatures, including the scene of the Spatial Crystal Butterfly 1VS9 instantly killing nine transcendent-level Killer Bees.
All the examiners’ gazes were stunned, feeling that it was ridiculous. They didn’t expect that Yin Zhengfan actually had a Quasi Monarch Race’s Spatial Crystal Butterfly!
He felt that there were very few candidates who could face his Zonyan Rock Beast and the Spatial Crystal Butterfly at the same time…
“If Legend Yin’s son really takes first place in the end, there’s nothing bad about it,” the master examiners said after a moment of silence. In any case, they were all Ancient Capital people. It was the age that might agitate the other candidates…
Then, they watched the replay of Zhang Qianyi’s battle video, which was currently second in points.
In the video, a black cloud followed beside a woman. The black thundercloud blew gently, and a high-level skill, Storm, and another high-level skill, Thundercloud Lightning, formed a combination skill that was several meters in size. It directly killed the five transcendent Rock Wolves in front of them.
In terms of the visual impact and real damage caused by skills, this one was better. High-level skills with different attributes were actually casually combined. This combination skill was probably the highest among this batch of candidates.
Whether it was Yin Zhengfan or Zhang Qianyi, the current situation was all easily crushing the ferocious beasts they encountered.
All the examiners nodded and gave high recognition.
Then, they began to look at the current performance of the candidates one by one according to the results of the first basic test. Although the performance of the third candidate, Miao Dongdong, was inferior to the first two, he had a parasitic Gu that parasitized the Emerald Tree Python. Similarly, no matter what transcendent-level ferocious beast they encountered, they would end it with an instant kill.
Overall, their performance was indeed worthy of their basic test results.
Then, as the examiners looked at Shi Yu’s current video data, they fell silent collectively.
The first transcendent creature Shi Yu hunted was the Dark Poison Python.
In the scene that the examiners could see, Shi Yu was leisurely leaning against a tree. On his shoulder was a super small Iron-Eating Beast and a Green Silkworm…
“Why is that Iron-eating Beast so small? It doesn’t match the basic test data at all.”
“Multiplication, I heard that one of the racial skills of the Iron-eating Beast in its evolution form is Multiplication. Could it be that Shi Yu, this little Iron-eating Beast, has comprehended Multiplication?”
“It’s possible…”
“But what’s with that green worm…”
Everyone looked at the video again.
In the video, the Dark Poison Python in front of Shi Yu and the others wanted to swallow the Darklight Grass in one bite. At this moment, the Dark Poison Python was stunned. Then, its body exploded into pieces…
It was extremely sudden!
“What’s going on!!”
The examiners were stunned. Because during the broadcast just now, they didn’t see Shi Yu and the others attack at all!
The Dark Poison Python directly died for no reason!
The examiner, Master Qu Jie, had an extremely serious expression. As he chose to replay it, he said, “Look carefully.”
The video was continuously paused. The scene before and after the Dark-striped Poison Python was insta-killed was fixed on Eleven and Buggy’s expressions and movements.
At a certain moment, Eleven’s pupils suddenly constricted, and its expression was extremely dignified. A nearly corporeal spiritual wave that was difficult to see swept over.
The worm didn’t seem to make a move, but its mouth clearly had a standard silk spitting action. However, the worm silk that it spat out was transparent.
Everyone looked back and realized that Shi Yu and the others had indeed made a move… However, the process of making a move shocked the examiners.
“That’s… deterrence?”
The examiners’ expressions were incomparably shocked. They didn’t expect that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast would actually awaken its deterrence in advance. However, this was still alright. What shocked them the most was that the Dark Stripe Poison Python was actually killed by the green worm’s silk!
“transparent worm silk, even if it’s a perfect-grade worm silk, it won’t have any obvious properties… It’s all invisible.” The head of the assessment, Master Qu Jie, watched the video in silence.
Through his words, everyone analyzed the implied meaning.
Transcendent level Worm Silk…????
How was this possible?
The masters were shocked, even more so than when they saw the spatial crystal butterfly.
In Dong Huang, the second silkworm that had grasped the transcendent level of Worm Silk had appeared?
“Not only that,” Master Qu Xie said in an incomprehensible tone. “Even if it’s a transcendent insect thread or an awakened-level Green Sponge Insect, it’s definitely impossible for them to instantly dismember the Dark Pattern Poison Python with the insect thread.”
“Although the Dark Pattern Poison Python is not a transcendent creature known for its defense, it is still a high-level race. Moreover, its growth level is at the supernatural level. This Green Sponge Insect… The growth level of this Green Silk Worm has probably been nurtured to the transcendent level by that participant!”
As soon as he finished speaking, the meeting room fell silent.
They looked at Shi Yu and the green worm in the video and felt like they had seen an unscientific pair of weirdos.
“Ridiculous.”
“He’s the same as Yin Zhengfan. Not only is his first pet ridiculous, but his other pet is also ridiculous!”
The examiners hurriedly looked at Shi Yu’s next video information. Compared to those head candidates, Shi Yu’s hunting points didn’t seem to be much, but he had completed one assessment mission. They quickly opened it to see Shi Yu’s further performance.
Then…
He saw the scene of a Beast Tamer riding a panda and holding a wooden sword, slashing down the Gale Sparrow with a sword.
His posture and expression made him look like a master who had been immersed in the way of the sword for decades. However, it was a little strange.
Perhaps because the Eye of Heaven had lived for a long time, it even playfully stuck a thumbnail at the side, as if it was giving this scene a thumbs up. This was the first time that the Eye of Heaven, which usually only edited simple videos, had done something like this. That was enough proof of how surprising this whole thing was.
All the teachers :?▽??
This… this… what the hell was this!!!
Why did the scene change so quickly!
There was something wrong with this candidate called Shi Yu…
…
At the moment, ordinary candidates were struggling to survive. They tried their best to choose some weak transcendent creatures to hunt.
A slightly stronger candidate faced the danger calmly and searched for his assessment mission target.
The candidate at the head, on the other hand, arrived at the Island of Trials and went through it as if he were just taking a stroll in his garden.
Apart from that, there were also some candidates with clear goals.
For example, Yu Shu, who had a young Nether Bone Dragon and a dragon soul, seemed to be looking for something.
“I heard that there’s a Dragon-type resource, Dragon Soul Grass, on the Island of Trials. I wonder if it’s true. Where exactly is it…” Yu Shu rode the bone dragon and wandered around with a conflicted expression.
Dragon Soul Grass was a third-level dragon-type and spiritual-type resource, but its value was comparable to other fifth-level resources. This was because it was born from bathing in dragon might. It could allow the deterrence effect of ordinary creatures to be close to that of dragon might. It was also a rare resource that could allow creatures before the monarch level to have a chance to awaken deterrence skills in advance.
This resource was still very attractive to Yu Shu, who was half a Dragon Tamer.
Therefore, at the moment, not every candidate’s goal was missions and points. For example, Shi Yu had completely forgotten about that at this moment and was excitedly experiencing Instant Transmission with Eleven and Buggy.
“Impressive.”
“So handsome.”
“Exciting.”
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy kept praising the Spatial Crystal Butterfly that brought them into a flicker.
Due to telepathy, the Spatial Crystal Butterfly could clearly feel the praise of outsiders, and it couldn’t help but maintain a good mood.
“Telepathy talent?” When Yin Zhengfan saw that Shi Yu was playing so happily with his Spatial Crystal Butterfly, he immediately felt that something was strange. He kept feeling like he had missed something… Perhaps it was an illusion..

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - Correct Usage of the Skill Index
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Correct Usage of the Skill Index
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Happy times were always very short.
As Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu both wanted to continue the assessment, after Shi Yu and the others experienced Instant Transmission, the two of them bid farewell to each other.
He also agreed to return here to battle before the assessment ended to determine the winner.
“Three days later…”
Shi Yu watched Yin Zhengfan and the Space Crystal Butterfly leave and smiled. He quite liked this child.
Not only was he polite, but he was also easy to talk to. His pets were also rare and their skills were high-level. He really wanted to make friends with more of his pets.
“How do you feel?”
Shi Yu asked Eleven and Buggy, “Do you want to learn?”
“Ji!” “Wuu…”
Buggy’s eyes lit up, finding it very interesting.
In the blink of an eye, it teleported to a very far place. How magical!
It was just that it was a little carsick during the teleportation process.
It wondered if it would be better when it was the one doing it.
Compared to Buggy’s yearning for new skills, Eleven was relatively calm.
As a skill master, Eleven was analyzing the disadvantages of Instant Transmission.
After all, Eleven had heard that the child wanted the Space Crystal Butterfly to fight it.
Therefore, it had to seriously analyze its opponent’s abilities.
Due to its attributes, this Space Crystal Butterfly’s strength was still very ridiculous.
Even for some low-level monarch races, the outcome of a battle between ordinary transcendent-level creatures with super-level skills versus this butterfly was still unknown.
This was because of the attributes. Among the major attributes, space was the king, and time was the supreme. It and Buggy often saw this saying on the Internet.
From this, it could be seen that the space element was very powerful!
If he wanted to fight this Space Crystal Butterfly, the battle strategy that Eleven could think of was to counter speed with speed!
Although the Space Crystal Butterfly’s teleportation speed was very fast, its natural flying speed and reaction speed might not necessarily be stronger than it.
No matter how fast Instant Transmission was, it still required time to activate. Moreover, this move was not an attack skill, so it also required time for the reaction time when the Space Crystal Butterfly attacked.
Eleven felt that it was enough as long as he could use this period of time to instantly kill the Space Crystal Butterfly with the super high-speed increase brought about by the Perfect Level Thunder Palm.
Moreover, it had a deterrence skill that could limit the reaction speed of the Crystal Butterfly.
“Your analysis is pretty good.”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “The proficiency of the Space Crystal Butterfly’s Instant Transmission, Concealment, and Space Shackles shouldn’t be very high.”
“In terms of skill proficiency, you have a huge advantage. In terms of energy, you should also have discovered it just now, right?”
Eleven nodded heavily. According to its super vision, the total energy of that Space Crystal Butterfly might not even be two-thirds of its total. Therefore, if it was a battle of attrition, Eleven had a higher chance of winning.
Shi Yu and Eleven analyzed the flaws of the three spatial skills one by one.
“Ji…”
Buggy looked bitter. Stop analyzing.
They were such cool skills but after the analysis, why did it suddenly feel like it wasn’t amazing?
It made Buggy have the illusion that even if it learned it, he still couldn’t defeat Eleven.
“Haha.”
Shi Yu smiled. It was not a big problem, not a big problem. The upper limit of these three skills was still higher than the skills Eleven had mastered at the moment.
Analyzing the battle chances of Eleven and the Space Crystal Butterfly was completely based on Eleven’s high skill proficiency.
As long as one of the skills of the Space Crystal Butterfly reached expert level, the pressure on Eleven would be much greater.
Regarding this, he needed to be careful. However, Shi Yu judged that the other party’s skill proficiency shouldn’t be high.
After all, Yin Zhengfan and the Space Crystal Butterfly were not that old. Moreover, skill proficiency was a skill that was more complicated the higher the level, and the harder it was to increase skill proficiency.
A low-level skill could be mastered after a pet trained hard for a year.
However, for a high-level skill to reach expert level, the amount of training needed was several times that of a low-level skill.
This was also why the consumption of points when Shi Yu raised high-level skills was much higher than low-level skills.
For example, for super skills, perhaps a monarch’s pet might not even be able to upgrade from entry-level to proficient level after years of hard work.
The difficulty of raising the proficiency of high-level skills was too high. This also gave some low-level pets a chance to defeat strong enemies by using combination skills and profundities formed by low-level skills…
“If you learn Instant Transmission and we upgrade it to transcendent level, Eleven won’t be able to defeat you even if he dies of exhaustion,” Shi Yu said to Buggy.
Buggy was again in unexpected ecstasy.
“Wuu!”
Eleven pouted.
Tsk.
Stupid worm. It actually placed its hope of defeating it on the additional points. It had no ambition. It looked like it had been completely corroded.
When the Worm’s Instant Transmission reached the maximum level, Eleven firmly believed that it would have definitely mastered a skill that could shatter space and would be also maxed out by the Beast Tamer!
Everybody knew how to get points!
Everyone stood on the same adding point line. They competed in hard work. In this aspect, Eleven was no weaker than a beast.
…
Then, Shi Yu took the wooden sword and rode Eleven to start a new adventure.
There were indeed many transcendent creatures here. Before long, they encountered another transcendent-level ferocious beast, a water-element Mad Python.
Shi Yu was speechless. Why were there so many snakes?
And they were all pythons!
Weren’t there any snake spirits like Medusa or Little White and Little Qing?
That would be more exciting to chop…
“…”
At this moment, the dark-blue giant python was circling by the rock. It stared at Shi Yu and the others in cold blood and decided if it wanted to eat more later.
It was mainly because it had never eaten such a strange creature before and didn’t know if it was delicious.
“There seems to be a lake ahead.”
After discovering the water-elemental ferocious beast, Shi Yu seemed to feel that the air had become much more humid. He immediately made a judgment.
He was familiar with the Mad Python. It had the Race Skill Maddening and Torrent Tail. Back when he was training at Mt. Tian Mang, there seemed to be a small Boss called Mad Python. At that time, Shi Yu even had the thought of replicating Mad Python. Madness, hardening, multiplying sounded fierce, but this was the first time he really encountered a Mad Python.
Having a water-type ferocious beast meant that there was a water source…
He had a mission, and that was to obtain water-element resources. Therefore, it was very normal for there to be lakes and rivers near the landing point.
“Hiss…”
Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy still chose to ignore the Mad Python and think about other things. This made the Mad Python extremely silent and had the urge to go crazy.
Just as Mad Python was thinking, Shi Yu suddenly looked at it.
“Have you ever been slashed at the speed of light?”
Mad Python: ???
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he slowly raised the saber.
In the next second, Perfect Thunder Palm, Transcendent Level Hardening, Expert Level Deterrence, Perfect Level Super Sight activated at the same time!
Lightning wrapped around its four limbs as it erupted with a terrifying speed. Following that, Eleven and Shi Yu’s figures flashed like a bolt of lightning and instantly arrived beside the Mad Python. When the Mad Python reacted, the wooden sword had already stabbed into its head and beheaded it.
Crack…
“Profundity, Thunder Flash…”
Shi Yu’s voice slowly fell. His body and hands were trembling. After all, his speed was too fast. If Eleven hadn’t used hardening to stabilize him and used his super vision to accurately stab the wooden sword into the Mad Python’s body, Shi Yu would have been sent flying like a worm.
In the distance, Buggy crawled up in confusion. He looked at the cool Beast Tamer and the extremely cooperative leader in front of him and felt depressed.
Couldn’t they bring it along?
It could use the ability of illusions to add special effects! It wasn’t completely useless!
At this moment, the Mad Python did not know what had happened at all. In the sky, The Eye of Heaven was shocked for the second time after observing more than 6,000 candidates.
As a monarch-level pet, it could naturally tell that the reason Shi Yu could successfully posture was all because his pet was assisting. But, were these guys doing a movie?? This was a vocation assessment!! How could you guys do this!
It saw that other candidates were working hard to use their Beast Taming Talent to strengthen their pets and let their pets hunt.
Shi Yu… He let his pets assist him crazily while he killed the enemy… How could he do this?
The Eye of Heaven was silent. It couldn’t take this. It had to edit it seriously and shock all the examiners.
…
Before long, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the edge of a lake.
This lake looked calm, but Shi Yu felt that there was killing intent hidden. Transcendent creatures were probably underwater.
However, they still had to make a fuss over the lake.
That was because there were a few Water Lotuses on the lake’s surface.
The water lotus was in the center of the lake, very far from the shore.
In this situation, it was really difficult to collect them without water-element and flying-type pets…
They were really bullying Beast Tamers who only cultivated Iron-eating Beasts.
“But I have two cards. How can you target me?”
Shi Yu chuckled. He didn’t expect that he would complete the so-called assessment mission in less than half a day.
What did it mean to be fully prepared? What did it mean to be crushed by strength…
“Buggy, worm silk, go and get the water lotus.”
Looking at the water lotus hundreds of meters away, Shi Yu instructed the worm on his shoulder.
“Ji…” Buggy understood and spat out a long transparent worm silk, flying away.
Very quickly, with a whoosh, the water surface was sliced open. A water lotus was plucked by the worm and quickly swept back!
There were no obstacles during this process.
Only when the water lotus was swept to Shi Yu’s side did the lake suddenly tremble.
Boom!
The water surface seemed to have exploded, and an extraordinary high-level elemental creature, the Wildflow Fairy, suddenly crawled out of the lake in the form of a waterspout!
In addition, all over the lake, dragon carps of low-level transcendent races and praying rain frogs of medium-level transcendent races also appeared. They were basically at the awakening level.
Shi Yu looked at the changes in the lake and the water lotus beside him. He was basically certain that the boss of this lake was this Mad Flow Fairy.
[Name]: Mad Flow Fairy
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Mad Flow, Water Wall, Purification
The Mad Flow Fairy was a rather strange elemental creature.
It liked water very much. Many floods and torrential rain were caused by it organizing a large number of water-type creatures. Its habit was to turn all land into water.
In comparison, the Dragon Carp and Rain Suppliant Frog that appeared were relatively harmless creatures. To be able to survive in such a place… It must be because of the protection of the Wildflow Fairy.
Mad Flow Fairies that had the cleansing skill were still very popular with other water-type creatures because they could cleanse water sources and increase the quality of the water source. Therefore, they were also called Cleansing Water Fairies.
Resources like water lotuses were actually mainly used to cleanse the water quality. Therefore, when Shi Yu took one away, the creatures in the lake immediately couldn’t stay any longer.
“Boom…”
Under the roar of the Mad Flow Fairy, dozens of water-type creatures popped their heads out, full of intimidation.
“Wuu!!!!”
On the land, Eleven raised its head and roared at the creatures that appeared in the lake, showing some deterrence.
In the next moment, all the water-type creatures, including the Mad Flow Fairy, sank into the water and immediately slipped away. They seemed to be saying that it was fine, that they should just take it. The water quality here was already good enough, it didn’t matter.
In nature, it was also so realistic. The fist was the law.
“Eleven, is there any way for me to split open the lake with a sword?”
Eleven: ( ?口 ?)!!
This guy was really pushing things!
“Ji!!” Buggy hurriedly said. It had a way, it had a way.
Shi Yu just had to pretend to swing his sword. It could use the transparent worm silk to simulate sword aura while tearing open the lake. In this way, it looked like Shi Yu had cut open the lake. Then, Eleven used deterrence to make all the creatures in the water faint in the lake that was split open. It was a great success in battle…
As a Panda Knight, it was normal for him to use deterrence sword aura.
Eleven: Σ (° △ ° | | |) Hello, Worm Director.
“It’s indeed a method, but it’s too much of a waste of energy. Forget it.” Shi Yu smiled. He was just kidding. He looked at the lake again. He didn’t expect to see the Rain Suppliant Frog and Dragon Carp here.
[Name]: Rain Suppliant Frog
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Medium transcendent
[Race Skill]: Qi Yu (High Level Water Skill), Water Arrow (Low Level Water Skill)
This Qi Yu was a good skill. It was a rare ability that could change the weather.
If it was a rainy day, the performance of the water-type pet could receive a good increase. It was equivalent to another kind of water-element talent!
However, Shi Yu did not mind too much. After all, there was no suitable weather based pet in his team.
However, this Dragon Carp was very interesting.
Dragon Carp
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Low-level transcendent
[Race Skill]: Leaping Dragon Gate (No Level Water Skill)
Like the Green Silkworm, this Dragon Carp was a weakling in the pet world.
At the same time, it was also one of the few creatures that could rely on increasing their racial skill proficiency to evolve naturally, just like the green worm.
However, its evolution difficulty was much higher than the green worm, so its status was also much lower than the green worm.
It was said that as long as the Dragon Carp trained the Water Slapping skill, which looked like a salted fish turning over, to perfection level proficiency, it could evolve into a dragon attribute and become a sub-dragon.
This Leaping Dragon Door sounded very cool, but actually, just like the Worm Silk, it was a useless skill that could be trained to perfection. At most, it would cause a small impact wave.
But it was this useless skill that could increase the dragon carp’s race potential.
At this moment, when he saw the Dragon Carp, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Speaking of which, although these levelless skills were trash, they didn’t seem to be completely useless.
He felt that maybe he could look for it in the future and see if there were any suitable levelless skills to teach Eleven and Worm?
After all, teaching levelless skills was too easy. It didn’t take much physical strength and time to quickly reach the maximum level. Then, it would turn something rotten into something magical. After that, after reaching the maximum level, it could also be deleted, leaving empty pages of the skill index. Compared to that, who knew how long it would take to delete the Inner Power and plant control in the skill index. Shi Yu felt that even if he became a Legendary Beast Tamer, these two super skills would probably still be lying in the index.
From a certain point of view, this might be the correct usage of the skill index’s deletion function?
…
A day later.
Shi Yu had already ridden Eleven and swept the surroundings of the landing point.
During this period, he also encountered many candidates, but the assessment did not allow teaming up, so they did not have much interaction.
However, when they saw Shi Yu riding the iron-eating beast, the candidate they encountered was still very shocked.
This was the first time he knew that Iron-eating Beasts could be used like this, but he didn’t know what use it had… Iron-eating Beasts weren’t mount races either?
Save energy for travel? Clearly, they didn’t have the chance to experience Shi Yu’s hardening swordplay.
Currently, those who saw Shi Yu take action had all died. The beasts, naturally.
…
“There are level-three resources again???”
“Wu!!!”
In just a day, Shi Yu and the others had gathered many rare resources.
Because the assessment mission had been completed, Shi Yu did not care about the number of ferocious beasts he hunted. He focused on finding valuable resources and ferocious beasts. His goal was clear.
Their efficiency in gathering resources was still very high. Thanks to Eleven’s perfect super vision, they could judge the strength of the energy wave from afar and use this method to determine which direction and corner had rare resources. They could find one at a time.
“Wu wu wu!!”
However, Eleven seemed especially serious this time.
In addition, it felt his hair stand on end.
This was the first time.
“Ji.” Even Buggy felt a sense of familiarity, let alone Eleven.
“Wu!!!”
In the end, the two pets widened their eyes and were completely certain…
It seemed to be dragon might!
There was the aura of a dragon!
“A dragon-type creature, or… a dragon-type resource?” Shi Yu was also stunned.
…
On the stone path, Little Iron Eater Eleven ran with Shi Yu agilely with its short legs.
It became more and more familiar with being a mount.
At this moment, it was pleasantly surprised. It was the dragon’s might!
Dragon Might was actually a deterrence skill.
However, it could only be called Dragon Might if it was used by the dragon race.
