Because the quality of the dragon race far exceeded other creatures in all aspects, it also caused the performance of the dragon’s might to far exceed the deterrence of other monarch-level creatures.
After all, purebred dragons were natural kings. None of their race levels were lower than monarch-level.
Eleven had experienced the dragon’s might of the Ice Dragon Phantom before and it was indeed very unusual. Therefore, it was very excited this time and felt that it could fight with the dragon again.
As for Shi Yu, he felt that it was dreaming. How could there be a giant dragon in such a godforsaken place?
Soon, Shi Yu and the others arrived outside a valley.
Not only was there no candidate around this valley, but there was also no wild creature. It seemed that all of them had been scared away by the dragon’s might.
At this moment, just as they approached the valley, Eleven, Shi Yu, and Buggy felt a very strong pressure. If it weren’t for Eleven using deterrence already, Shi Yu and Buggy might not have been able to withstand it.
“Close.”
Shi Yu’s gaze froze. He ordered Eleven to approach the valley to see what was going on.
However, just as they took a step forward, a brown lizard-like figure appeared.
“Roar…”
This brown giant lizard that was as rough as a rock stepped on the gravel and issued a warning with a dignified gaze. Then, a strong deterrence wave shot out. It was actually a deterrence skill, but from the deterrence level, it was only entry-level. It was really no match for Eleven.
But even so, Shi Yu and the others were still very surprised.
Because this was a wild ferocious beast.
Apart from his pets, Shi Yu had only seen one pet that had awakened deterrence skills before it reached the level of a monarch.
That was the Ice Wolf King from the breeding base of Icefield City.
Moreover, Shi Yu felt that the deterrence of this lizard was not as simple as ordinary deterrence. It even had a hint of dragon might!
[Name]: Earth Rock Lizard
[Attributes]: Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
The Rock Lizard was a commander evolutionary branch of the Rockback Lizard and the Rockback Lizard, a transcendent species. It was a transitioning stage for dragon-element evolution. Although it wasn’t even a subspecies dragon yet, it already possessed some dragon-element characteristics.
At this moment, seeing such a creature with dragon might, Shi Yu was indescribably surprised.
Good lord.
Talent?
Monarch potential?
If not for the fact that the assessment rules did not allow them to take away and contract the ferocious beasts here, Shi Yu really wanted to capture them alive and pack them up.
However, he also understood the association’s concerns.
It was basically impossible for a ferocious beast that had grown to the transcendent level in the wild to be tamed by a Beast Tamer. Its wild and ferocious nature was too strong, and it could only be forced to contract. But in that case, as the ferocious beast grew, there would be a risk of backlash against the Beast Tamer in the future. Not many Beast Tamers would contract with the risk of backlash, no matter how talented the pet’s potential was.
In comparison, weren’t the obedient pets cultivated by the breeding bases good?
Capturing and contracting high-level ferocious beasts was too risky. The mainstream views in the Beast Tamer domain also suggested that Beast Tamers contract those pet cubs and nurture them from young. This was beneficial to establishing restraints.
Of course, the truth was not absolute. It wasn’t like there weren’t Beast Tamers who specialized in capturing mature wild beasts. However, the mortality rate was several times higher than other Beast Tamers.
At this moment, because Shi Yu and the others were not afraid of deterrence at all, and because Eleven had always displayed an even stronger and scarier deterrence that was almost corporeal, the extraordinary Rock Lizard’s eyes were filled with apprehension.
“Is this Earth Dragon Lizard talented, or is there some rare resource inside?”
Shi Yu looked at the nervous appearance of the Rock Lizard and looked deep into the valley.
“Roar—!!”
At this moment, another valiant dragon’s roar came from the distance, stunning Shi Yu and the others.
A moment later, a black spot appeared in the sky. A young bone dragon about two meters in size with a small Tamer on it flew over.
“Damn, after flying for half an island, I finally found this place.” This Beast Tamer was extremely surprised.
“Uh.” However, as the young Nether Bone Dragon flapping its bone wings was about to land, this candidate suddenly discovered the Earth Dragon Lizard and Shi Yu, who were facing each other below.
His expression changed as he observed carefully again.
Then, after discovering that the situation below was still normal, he relaxed inwardly. Good, looks like the Dragon Soul Grass hadn’t been obtained first.
“Roar—!!”
It was clearly a bone dragon, but it could actually make noise.
The Nether Bone Young Dragon landed. Its Beast Tamer Yu Shu started to size up the Earth Dragon Lizard that was releasing its dragon might, and the Panda King Eleven, who was also using deterrence to suppress the other party.
At this moment, his relaxed mood immediately tensed up again. His heart skipped a beat and stopped.
Damn it, there was still something wrong!
Where did this Earth Dragon Lizard come from? Could it be that all the Dragon Soul Grass had been eaten?
Moreover, what the hell was this Beast Tamer riding an iron-eating beast that could use deterrence??
“Roar…” The green eyes of the Nether Bone Young Dragon flashed, reminding its Beast Tamer that the Iron-eating Beast was not to be trifled with. Its aura was very terrifying.
Yu Shu’s expression changed. He realized that the good mood he had when he found the rumored Dragon Valley disappeared with a bang. Moreover, he kept feeling that this mission of his wouldn’t be very smooth.
“Nether Bone Young Dragon, you’re Yu Shu?” At this moment, Shi Yu turned around to observe the person’s bone dragon pet and asked curiously.
In just two days, he actually saw the two popular candidates mentioned by Seven Elites consecutively. His luck was pretty good.
“You’re Shi Yu?” After Yu Shu got down from the young Nether Bone Dragon, he looked silently at Shi Yu, who was riding an Iron-eating Beast and holding a wooden sword. A moment later, he also determined Shi Yu’s identity.
There were only a few people who scored high on the basic test. Everyone knew the other party’s test pet, so it was naturally easy to guess its identity.
Originally, Yu Shu was very unconvinced that the ability of a mere Iron-eating Beast was above his Nether Bone Young Dragon, but now, after discovering that this Iron-eating Beast actually knew how to use deterrence, he only felt that it was ridiculous.
Damn, where did this monster come from? His Nether Bone Young Dragon was a high class commander species, and it was even a dragon type. Yet… It was still a little short of awakening deterrence. What was wrong with Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast!
“Well, from the looks of it, you deliberately came here?” Shi Yu asked.
Yu Shu’s expression darkened. This was none of his business.
Although he thought this way, he still nodded. After all, this kind of thing couldn’t be hidden at all.
“There are the dragon-eating resources I need inside, but it looks like we discovered it at the same time. How is it? How do you plan to compete?” He looked at Shi Yu with interest. Although this iron-eating beast didn’t look weak, after his Nether Bone Young Dragon and dragon soul fused, its battle power was comparable to an extraordinary pet of a monarch race!
If it was according to the standard resource competition method, Shi Yu would not be his match.
He wasn’t even afraid of Yin Zhengfan’s beast. In short, he was determined to get the Dragon Soul Grass. The main reason was that this thing was very rare even in the outside world. It was very difficult to buy. Although there were high-level substitutes, the high level resources were too high for his pet. Instead, the level of this Dragon Soul Grass was just right.
The lizard: ???
Get lost, that belonged to it!
It looked at the iron-eating beast and the bone dragon more fearfully. It kept feeling that both parties were coveting the Dragon Soul Grass in the valley.
“There’s indeed a treasure…” Shi Yu was stunned and found it interesting. He had a premonition that this resource was not simple.
Perhaps this trial island wasn’t all a pile of trash and low-level resources…
“Ji ji ji—” Before Shi Yu could make a decision, the bug became excited. Why not let it deal with this bone dragon and that dragon lizard? It felt that there would be dragon-element resources inside, and it wanted to fight for them itself.
Shi Yu: “You’re not his match either… Unless…”
It wasn’t that he looked down on Buggy. Even if the Buggy’s battle power was fully released, it would only be a transcendent pet comparable to low-level commander races…
It was barely enough to deal with this lizard, let alone the bone dragon.
Insect: [(? ??`?)*?equipment, equipment…]
What the worm meant was that expert level Illusory Phantom could use external items to increase the quality of the Illusory Phantom. Low class commander races weren’t its full battle power at all.. With so many ice-element energy crystals and that Ice Dragon Whiskers, just like during training, if it was used… It could transform into an Ice Dragon and crush this dragon lizard and bone dragon without any pressure!!

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - Ice Dragon Bug VS Soul attached Bone Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Ice Dragon Bug VS Soul attached Bone Dragon
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“How do you plan to compete?”
At this moment, after hearing Buggy’s petition, Shi Yu smiled.
So this worm was thinking about wearing equipment.
It couldn’t defeat the enemy naked, but couldn’t it defeat it with a+20 golden legendary equipment?
Indeed, the abnormality of an expert level phantom was that it could strengthen the phantom with external things.
If he didn’t include this ability, it would be a little unfair to say that the battle power of the bugs was only at the level of transcendent-level ferocious beasts of low-level commander races.
It had already been added to the expert level, why should it be used as a proficiency level!
However, Shi Yu’s expression was strange.
Buggy was ruthless.
If he didn’t remember wrongly, Buggy must have caught a cold when it used the ice-element energy crystal and the Ice Dragon Whiskers to train previously. It had been sleeping with a blanket for days and directly rejected the cold.
Ice-element energy crystals were alright… But the Ice Dragon Whiskers that the Clam used, even if it wasn’t a level-seven resource for a overlord creature, it had to be close, right?
As a Green Silkworm, wearing such equipment would naturally be a huge burden.
Of course, the burden was great, and the gains were also great.
Although the combat power of the transformed ice dragon was very poor in terms of skills and could only use some basic ice-type moves, the physical fitness of the dragon race was undoubtedly powerful. It was very resistant to attacks.
Just like the Ice Dragon Phantom Eleven encountered, its physical quality was ridiculous, and its control over elemental energy was also ridiculous.
It was equivalent to an overlord race cub without any super or high-level skills, only having the strength of the body.
This was already very strong. Just based on this point, it felt that it could go head-on against ordinary monarch species creatures. After all, a real ice dragon was an overlord race. Squashing a commander species creature of the same level was as easy as squashing a worm.
In this case, Buggy indeed had the capital to interfere in the competition of the vocation assessment.
Previously, the Ice Dragon Whiskers and ice-element energy crystals were both external forces. In addition, the burden of using the bugs was relatively high. Shi Yu did not count them in the battle power Buggy. Now, since Buggy wanted to try again, it wasn’t impossible to try…
“How else can we compete? Both parties compete with all their might.”
“If you’re afraid of affecting the assessment, you might as well give up.” Yu Shu chuckled, hoping that Shi Yu would back off.
He had no intention of fighting one-on-one. After all, his strength was in team battles with pets.
“2 vs 2?”
“Alright, but shouldn’t we deal with this Earth Dragon Lizard first and see what’s inside?” Shi Yu said.
“It…” Yu Shu shook his head and glanced at the Rock Lizard, not paying much attention.
It was just a low-level commander species Earth Dragon Lizard. Even if it had awakened its deterrence, in terms of battle power, it might only be comparable to the Thunder Lion Shi Yu encountered during the basic test. Its energy level was about 1,000.
For a genius like Yu Shu, who had a single bone dragon that was close to 3,000 energy points, this Earth Dragon Lizard was also a ferocious beast that could be insta-killed.
“One point, I’ll take it.”
Yu Shu didn’t ask for Shi Yu’s opinion and directly let his pet attack.
In the vocation assessment, no matter the level of the ferocious beast’s race, as long as it grew to the transcendent level, hunting was 1 point. Therefore, it was really tiring and not pleasing to hunt a powerful ferocious beast like the Earth Dragon Lizard, but that was for ordinary candidates.
Yu Shu’s eyes were filled with arrogance. He was very disdainful of this creature associated with the word “dragon” but not dragon type.
“Roar…”
At this moment, the Rock Lizard’s heart skipped a beat as it suddenly realized that something was wrong.
Right now, it didn’t seem like it was a good time to watch this show??
It subconsciously wanted to burrow into the ground and return to the valley first. At this moment, Yu Shu’s Nether Bone Dragon flew up. At the same time, a green soul flame appeared in its skeleton body, forming a dragon shape that wrapped around the body of the Nether Bone Dragon!
At this moment, the aura of the young Nether Bone Dragon became extremely terrifying. Even without the dragon’s might, the Earth Rock Lizard could feel the spiritual pressure of a dragon-type creature!
[Name]: Nether Bone Young Dragon
[Attributes]: Undead, Dragon
[Race Level]: High-level commander
[Race Skill]: Dragon Claw (Intermediate Dragon-type Skill), Dragon Breath (Advanced Dragon-type Skill), Corpse Strengthening (Advanced Undead-type Skill), Bone Reassembling (Advanced Undead-type Skill)
[Name]: Dragon Soul (Incomplete)
[Attributes]: Undead, Dragon
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
[Race Skill]: Possession (Advanced undead skill), Soul Flame (Advanced undead skill)
The two pets of the commander species completed the fusion almost instantly through the possession skill!!
In the sky, the young Nether Bone Dragon covered in green soul flames suddenly condensed a black flame breath!!
A powerful combination skill with the properties of dragon, undead, and fire blasted out!!
Hu hu!!!
Blazing dragon breath flames attacked.
Below, the Earth Dragon Lizard roared as sand and rocks gathered around it.
In the face of the attack, it instantly swept up the high-level skill Rock Sand Storm to resist.
The rock sand that filled the sky twisted into a force that collided with the dragon flames.
However, this Soul Fire Dragon Breath formed by the dragon soul possessing the young Nether Bone Dragon instantly penetrated the rock sand storm with a bang. Under the shocked expression of the Earth Rock Lizard, it turned into raging flames and got swept into the flames!
“Roar…”
The miserable cry of the Earth Dragon Lizard came from the dark green Inferno.
The battle power of both parties was not on the same level at all.
“Are you still planning to compete?” Yu Shu smiled.
He had the pride that most Dragon Tamers had and was extremely confident in his own strength.
Not far away, Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy watched this scene in silence.
It was fancy.
Wasn’t it just insta-killing a lizard?
“Sob.” Eleven curled its lips. If it wasn’t to save energy and use supervision to find more resources, one deterrence from it could directly knock this lizard out.
All along, when they were traveling, the passive deterrence that Eleven displayed was at entry-level.
Such a deterrence wave was enough to deter the enemy’s battle intent.
As for proficient-level deterrence, it could already cause mental damage and directly stun the enemy.
As for the expert level deterrence that Eleven mastered, also known as the king’s aura, the huge aura could stun hundreds of enemies and condense into a wave that crushed the enemy. It was a deterrence that could resist the dragon’s might of the Ice Dragon Phantom.
It was very difficult for any opponent whose mental willpower was inferior to Eleven’s, even if they were also at the transcendent level. After all, this was an expert high-level mental skill.
At the transcendent level, how many pets could train high-level skills to the expert level? The proficient level was the limit.
However, although Eleven felt that its opponent was being fancy, it glanced at Buggy. “Can you do it?”
“Ji!!!” Buggy was very unhappy because it was looked down on.
Wait and see!!
Buggy also understood that with added points and hard work, it definitely couldn’t surpass the leader.
Then, it could only rely on wearing divine clothes.
With the enhancement of his divine armor, he could slay dragons like bugs!
“Sob.” Eleven shook his head.
It didn’t matter. It was a 2VS2 anyway, so it could try again if it didn’t work.
At this moment, Yu Shu was waiting for Shi Yu’s answer.
However, Shi Yu was not frightened as he had imagined.
“Of course I’ll be competing, but I’ll go and see what’s inside first.” Shi Yu smiled.
This guy was trying to scare him? Too young.
However, although he was young, Shi Yu casually glanced at the young Nether Bone Dragon. Its four skills were alright, but the possession skill of the dragon soul looked awesome.
This was a skill similar to the Fusion Beast Taming Talent.
Beast Tamers with the Fusion Beast Taming Talent could take the initiative to choose to fuse with different pets.
As for undead-type soul pets with the possession skill, they could also choose to possess different pets, or even Beast Tamers.
This was also a very mainstream life-saving skill among Spirit Mediums.
Shi Yu heard that there seemed to be a Legendary Spirit Medium in the ancient capital who specialized in developing the possession skill.
He contracted a heroic spirit with explosive battle power. After the heroic spirit possessed him, this Spirit Medium was said to be able to suppress overlord creatures alone.
In short, this was also a good skill. Unfortunately, Eleven and Buggy definitely couldn’t learn it, or else he would be even more handsome!
“What else could be inside? Dragon Soul Grass.”
Yu Shu glanced at the familiar Rock Lizard with strange patterns on the ground and shook his head. After patting the bone dragon beside him, he followed Shi Yu, who was riding the iron-eating beast, into the valley.
…
In the valley, three plants that looked like green wings swayed at the core.
The plant emitted strong spiritual waves that were like dragon might.
Seeing these three stalks of grass, Yu Shu was overjoyed.
There were actually three stalks.
“The Rock Lizard relied on the deterrence of these.” At this moment, Shi Yu and the others stared at the Dragon Soul Grass and revealed curious expressions.
Shi Yu had clearly memorized a large amount of resources, but he still couldn’t find any information on this resource in his mind.
It seemed like it was a super rare resource.
“Do you know what this is?” Shi Yu asked.
“…” Yu Shu was speechless. After all this time, he didn’t even know what it was and he wanted to fight with him?
“Dragon Soul Grass, level-three dragon-element and spiritual-element resources. Its value is comparable to resources above ordinary level five,” Yu Shu replied.
“Only when a purebred dragon dies in a place where the lingering dragon might doesn’t disperse can such a plant be formed.”
“That Earth Dragon Lizard should have used the pressure of the Dragon Soul Grass to train its mental strength during its growth stage and awakened its deterrence on its own. Its talent seems pretty good.”
Yu Shu was relieved. Fortunately, it wasn’t eaten directly!
The Dragon Soul Grass couldn’t be eaten directly, or else there would be a huge risk of mental breakdown. It needed to be used with other materials. As long as the ferocious beast wasn’t stupid, it could sense the danger of the Dragon Soul Grass. This lizard was very smart, and it only used its pressure to train its spiritual power.
As for why Yu Shu knew so much, it was very simple. It was because his mother had participated in the development mission of the Island of Trials before and personally hunted several subspecies dragons in this place that could breed Dragon Soul Grass.
Now, there were no more alternative dragons. All the high-level ferocious beasts had been eliminated, leaving only creatures like the Earth Dragon Lizard that might evolve into dragons.
“Is that so?”
At this moment, when Shi Yu heard Yu Shu say this, he knew the use of the Dragon Soul Grass without thinking.
Sure.
Mental resources? It felt like they could be used as evolution materials for Buggy!
It could even make deterrence have the nature of a dragon?
Wouldn’t it be better to use deterrence after transforming into an ice dragon?
The completion level of the Ice Dragon Phantom increased again.
Shi Yu and Buggy’s eyes lit up. They felt that they couldn’t miss such a rare resource.
“Alright, I’ve satisfied your curiosity, right?” Yu Shu smiled and said confidently. “By the way, don’t tell me that your second pet is a green worm waiting to evolve.”
The reason why he wasn’t afraid to compete with Shi Yu for the Dragon Soul Grass was firstly because his Possession Double Strike battle tactic was invincible at the same level, and secondly, Shi Yu didn’t seem to be very smart. He rode an Iron-eating Beast, held a wooden sword, and even contracted a Green Silkworm to participate in the vocation assessment… What the heck?
Nether Bone Young Dragon, Dragon Soul VS Iron-eating Beast, Green Silkworm, how could they lose?
Yu Shu didn’t know how to lose!
It was also because Shi Yu was also a genius that he felt that he could befriend him. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have said so much to Shi Yu.
Although everyone was competing, there was no need to damage the harmony. He wanted Shi Yu to admit defeat wholeheartedly.
“It’s really my second pet.”
Shi Yu smiled. Not only was his other pet a Green Silkworm, but he even planned to let it fight one against two first…
“Then you’re finished. Do you plan to let the Iron-eating Beast fight one against two?”
“No.”
Yu Shu and Shi Yu’s gazes became even more serious. Both parties were determined to get the Dragon Soul Grass.
In that case, they could only compete according to the traditional competition method.
The two of them walked to a relatively empty place. Yu Shu was dressed in black. As he often flew, he even wore a red windproof cloak. He looked very strong.
Under his instructions, the bone dragon that was possessed by the dragon soul waved its bone wings and slowly flew up. In mid-air, it looked at Shi Yu and the others with its empty green fire eyes.
On Shi Yu’s side, Buggy quickly crawled into Shi Yu’s hand.
Shi Yu dug into his pocket and took out a level-two ice-element energy crystal from the ruin pearl. He fed it to Buggy and let Buggy put it in its mouth.
As for the Ice Dragon Whiskers, it had already been tied to its body by the transparent insect silk!
After the armor was completed, Buggy’s gaze was serious. It bent his body and jumped down!
Worm Leap!
The worm successfully landed opposite the Soul attached and stared at it with battle intent.
At this moment, on the other side, the serious-looking Yu Shu and the Soul attached Bone Dragon paused for a moment.
What was the meaning of this?
Looking at the indifferent Shi Yu, the Iron-eating Beast, and the green silkworm that jumped out, they were speechless.
Please, please don’t tell him that Shi Yu wanted the Green Silkworm to fight his Soul attached Bone Dragon!!
“Are you serious?” Yu Shu looked up at Shi Yu, but wondered what did Shi Yu feed the green worm…
“I’m serious.” Shi Yu said calmly, “You’re considered half a Dragon Tamer, right? I forgot to tell you, actually, I’m the same.”
Yu Shu: “?”
Before Yu Shu could react, Buggy on the ground had already closed its eyes slightly.
Hu hu hu!!!!
At this moment, cold air started to emit from Buggy’s body.
After entering the transcendent level, and after the Phantom Illusion Skill was activated to expert level+4, its spiritual power level combined with Absolute Sleep could already instantly create dream images.
However, this was actually still built up by Buggy’s own efforts. If Shi Yu could replicate a skill related to controlling dreams for it, the quality of the illusions projected by it should be stronger. For example, in terms of details, perhaps it could really know how many hairs a cat in a dream had.
The skill, Phantom Illusion, was actually equivalent to providing a core. As long as the user constantly assembled other skills to increase the quality of the phantom, its upper limit was very high.
At this moment, Yu Shu still didn’t know what had happened. The Soul attached Bone Dragon also felt a little confused, but in the next moment, the atmosphere had already started to change. The sky suddenly darkened, as if blue snow clouds were condensing.
In an instant, hail and snow started to fall. The snow mixed with strong winds formed a snowstorm. Countless snowstorms appeared. At that moment, the figure of the worm was already difficult to see clearly under the snowstorm.
Originally, Yu Shu was still in the mood to quietly watch what Shi Yu was up to. However, in the next moment, he and the Soul attached Bone Dragon’s widened their eyes almost at the same time, revealing an expression of disbelief.
Because, at this moment, under the condensation of the snow, the spot where the insect was just now was forming a huge monster, a frost dragon!!
Yu Shu and the Soul attached Bone Dragon looked at the three-meter-tall dragon creature in front of them, their mouths agape.
The strong body of the frost dragon in front of him seemed to be made of frost. Its color was ice-blue and deep, representing extreme cold.
Not only its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, and its pair of wings were also all strong and powerful. Its scales revealed coldness, and there was wind and snow lingering around it, it was extremely domineering.
“Hou!!!!!!”
The ice dragon that the worm had just projected roared and flapped its wings.
During the roar, its deep eyes glanced at its opponent. The few ice-blue beards fluttered with the wind, causing the Soul attached Bone Dragon to subconsciously take a step back. It felt like its bloodline was being suppressed.
The frost dragon in front of him, which was even larger and more like a purebred dragon, directly stunned the Soul attached Bone Dragon.
What was going on, what happened…
“Impossible!!!” Yu Shu shouted, staring at the frost dragon in shock.
This kind of creature, this kind of creature, could a quasi-class Beast Tamer even summon it? Even if it was a legendary Dragon Tamer, there were only a few who could tame the frost dragon!
This was not a real frost dragon at all. Yu Shu’s gaze turned solemn as he looked at the disappearing green worm in confusion. “It’s… that green worm?”
“That’s not a Green silkworm. It’s a pet that can transform. Just now, it only turned into a Green silkworm, but now, it turned into a frost dragon.” Shi Yu chuckled, and Yu Shu started to curse in his heart.
Damn, never heard of it!!!
Was this how you lie?
Was it appropriate to let a powerful pet transform into a green worm to trick people??
Moreover, he looked at the frost dragon and swallowed his saliva. This was why he said he was half a Dragon Tamer?
Yu Shu’s expression turned solemn. In short, he didn’t believe it.
The Frost Dragon was an overlord of the dragon race. How could it be changed just like that by a quasi professional Beast Tamer’s pet?
It was just for show. He would immediately expose the true form of the ice dragon.
“Hou!!!!!!”
Facing the Ice Dragon Phantom in front of it, the Soul attached Bone Dragon didn’t sense that it was illusory at all. It knew that this wasn’t an illusion, but a physical illusion. Under the Beast Tamer’s command, the Soul attached Flame Dragon Breath condensed in its restless mouth and attacked!!
Boom!!!
A thick black flame pillar half a meter in diameter suddenly swept towards the Ice Dragon Phantom. The dragon breath flame that could burn the body and soul had completely annihilated the lizard. However, facing this Flame Dragon Breath, the Ice Dragon Phantom was not afraid at all and similarly spat out a breath!
It was just a very simple cold breath condensed from ice-element energy!
However, even the cold breath seemed to really be spat out by the frost dragon. It carried a strong dragon might like a flying ice dragon. Its power was incomparably huge, completely incomparable to the cold breath of those low-level ice-element creatures!
With a crack, the Soul Fire Dragon Breath and the cold breath collided. The result was that the cold breath instantly suppressed the dragon breath and showed signs of freezing this breath.
Seeing the dragon breath that instantly froze and was pressed back, Yu Shu’s pupils constricted. Soul fluctuations surged around his body. As a Beast Tamer with a Soul Strengthening Talent, he could strengthen the power of the undead. With a boom, Yu Shu and the Bone Dragon resonated!!
Huge soul fluctuations appeared on the bodies of the two at the same time. The Soul attached Bone Dragon’s Soul Fire Dragon Breath’s flames were even more vigorous at this moment, and its power was instantly equal to the Ice Breath. Between the two breaths, intense dust and smoke instantly swept up, and the airflow spread to both sides…
“Strengthen, Claw Attack—”
“Roar!!”
In the smoke, the figure of the Soul attached Bone Dragon suddenly flew out. After activating the Corpse Strengthening skill, the bones on its body increased exponentially, as if it was wearing bone armor, and its whole body was incomparably heavy!
At this moment, it held the Soul Dragon Claw in both hands and crossed it towards the Ice Dragon Phantom!
In the face of the attack, the Ice Dragon Phantom stood still and looked over coldly.
Excessive movements would only consume more energy. It only needed to rely on its powerful strength to ignore and crush all attacks!
With a bang, the Ice Dragon Phantom took the attack head-on. Fine cracks appeared on its dragon scales. At the same time, a terrifying cold aura erupted from the Ice Dragon’s broken body, freezing the curse energy and directly freezing its entire body along the claws of the Soul attached Bone Dragon.
Click.
The strengthened dragon bone was frozen and shattered, but under the repair of the skeleton recombination skill, the Soul attached dragon quickly recovered to its original state. However, in the next instant, the huge ice dragon turned around and swiped its claw. Before the Soul attached dragon could react, its entire body was ruthlessly smashed by the Ice Dragon Phantom’s Ice Splitting Claw again and flew a few meters away…
“Roar…”
During this process, the Nether Bone Young Dragon and the dragon soul were forced to separate. It let out a painful cry and the Ice Dragon Worm heavily injured the two pets in one hit.
“Roar!!!” The Ice Dragon Phantom still stood on the spot like an overlord, looking down at them and letting out a high cry.
Yu Shu widened his eyes.
“Impossible, impossible, impossible.”
He looked at the completely crushed Soul attached Bone Dragon in one round of confrontation with a shocked expression.
How was that possible!
The physical fitness of this ice dragon was actually comparable to that of the overlord race’s ice dragon!!!
Just based on its physical fitness, it completely crushed his Soul attached Bone Dragon. In fact, apart from the basic skills Ice Breath and Ice Rending Claw, it didn’t use any other skills!!
This didn’t make sense. How could there be such a ridiculous transformation skill? He had never heard of it!!
“Do you still want to fight? I think there’s actually no need,” Shi Yu said.
If this continued, the Nether Bone Young Dragon and the dragon soul would definitely be heavily injured. Similarly, Buggy would have to rely on the Ice Dragon Whiskers to transform into such a powerful ice dragon, and his mental state would suffer a heavy blow. In the exchange just now, even if there was an expert level Absolute Sleep that constantly recovered physical strength at a high speed, it had already consumed more than half of Buggy’s strength.
The recovery speed was far lower than the consumption speed.
If this continued, it would be meaningless because Eleven had yet to make a move. Even if Buggy’s physical fitness was insufficient, the outcome of this battle was obvious.
“Wuu—” Shi Yu sat down, and Eleven showed a friendly expression to Yu Shu and the others.
Instantly, Yu Shu’s face turned green and white. Son of a b*tch, what was wrong with this Shi Yu!!
What kind of pet could turn into a damn dragon? Damn it!!!
“Roar…” The bone dragon and dragon soul advised the Beast Tamer not to fight anymore.
Son of a b*tch, they might not be a match for this guy!
At this moment, Yu Shu was completely numb. The bone dragon and dragon soul stared cautiously at the ice dragon opposite them. As for him, he looked solemnly at the iron-eating beast with 3186 energy points and the calm Shi Yu. He immediately deduced that he might really not be able to compete with this fellow. To think that he was so confident at the start…
Damn it, that wasn’t a green worm at all!!!
Yu Shu had a deep grudge.
Whether the ice dragon in front of him was real or fake, its battle power was definitely not inferior to the purebred dragons of the low-level monarch race!
Dragon Soul Grass…
“You win.” Yu Shu’s expression darkened.
It was just Dragon Soul Grass. He didn’t want a mere low-level resource.
Yu Shu didn’t want to end the assessment early because of the three Dragon Soul Grass. If he continued fighting, his bone dragon and dragon soul would definitely lose their ability to fight. At that time, he would have difficulty moving in the next two days.
“I admit defeat. You guys are good. See you in the ranking battle. Also, remember not to use the Dragon Soul Grass directly.”
Yu Shu summoned his two pets and turned to leave.
He didn’t want to stay here anymore.
“You’re leaving already? Be careful ~” Shi Yu waved his hand. This person was as easygoing as Yin Zhengfan. He was a good person.
He was just not as strong as Yin Zhengfan.
At the same time, on the ground, the ice dragon phantom gradually disappeared, and the green worm lay on the ground trembling.
Buggy: “Achoo!”
“Achoo…”
Hopefully it didn’t catch a cold…
“Ji…” Although it felt cold all over, Buggy was especially excited at this moment. This was because these three stalks of Dragon Soul Grass were obtained by itself!
It quickly crawled to the edge of the Dragon Soul Grass and sensed the dragon might. At this moment, the insect’s pupils constricted. It didn’t eat the Dragon Soul Grass at all, but a powerful spiritual pressure suddenly erupted from its body!!
Boom!!!
It had automatically awakened its deterrence skill.
In the distance, Yu Shu, who had not walked far, turned around slightly.. He looked at the intimidating Green Silkworm King and was stunned on the spot…

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - King of the Green Silkworms
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: King of the Green Silkworms
“What’s going on???”
Initially, Shi Yu was smiling as he watched the Green Silkworm run to the Dragon Soul Grass, but suddenly, he was shocked.
He looked at the bug that emitted spiritual deterrence and was stunned on the spot.
Deterrence?
What the f*ck, Buggy awakened its deterrence skill on its own??
It must be kidding!
Shi Yu did not react for a moment and felt that it was a little unscientific.
A long time ago, after he saw that he could teach the Green Silkworm deterrence through the skill index, he sighed with emotion. “Who cultivated a Green Silkworm that could have deterrence?”
At that time, no matter how much Shi Yu thought about it, he definitely didn’t expect that a Green silkworm would actually awaken its deterrence on its own…
It was ridiculous!!!
Deterrence, a spiritual skill, was a symbol of “aptitude of a king”…
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu gradually calmed down.
Calm down, calm down. It was all because he cultivated it well.
Although it didn’t seem scientific this time, it wasn’t that unscientific either.
His worm had already strengthened its mental strength through the proficient level Absolute Sleep and Illusory Phantom, two high-level mental-type skills. It was also often used by Eleven as a deterrence training target. Its mental strength was definitely not weak.
Moreover, its own racial skill had even been maxed out. It had grown to become Transcendent with the body of a Green Silkworm. To say that it was the king of the Green Silkworm Race was already looking down on it.
It should be the god of the silkworm worm race!
Thinking about it this way, even a Snow Wolf King and a Ground Rock Lizard could awaken their deterrence before the monarch level. After his bug defeated a dragon type, it wasn’t that difficult to accept that it could awaken its king aptitude.
Shi Yu quickly analyzed the cause and effect, but while he could figure it out, Yu Shu and his two pets were completely breaking down.
He, the dragon soul, and the bone dragon looked at the Green Silkworm King around the Dragon Soul Grass in a daze. They felt its increasingly strong spirit and could not understand at all.
“Holy shit,” Yu Shu cursed.
Therefore, what exactly was Shi Yu’s pet? What was it!!
Also, why did it awaken deterrence before it even ate the Dragon Soul Grass!
Yu Shu would not be jealous of any pet that had a chance to awaken after eating the Dragon Soul Grass. However, when he saw the Earth Dragon Lizard and then this pet that seemed to be a Green Silkworm that could transform, and saw that they had mastered deterrence, he immediately felt that the Dragon Soul Grass was becoming more and more precious like a hundred lemons.
“Let’s go, what are you looking at?”
It was just a deterrence skill. A skill that any pet could awaken sooner or later was just so-so.
Looking at the stunned bone dragon and dragon soul, Yu Shu’s face darkened again. He quickened his pace and left. The bone dragon and dragon soul looked at each other and quickly followed the Beast Tamer.
The Green Silkworm was so scary. Didn’t Beast Tamers say that the dragon family was the strongest?
…
Shi Yu and Eleven came to Buggy’s side and looked at the pleasantly surprised Buggy with strange expressions.
“Good heavens.” Now, Shi Yu could only sigh.
Apart from racial skills, Eleven had learned Thunder Palm on his own, and Buggy had learned deterrence on its own. Shi Yu was really curious about what their next skill would be without the skill index.
Shi Yu estimated that it might have to happen after they evolved.
After they evolved, they would definitely awaken new racial skills.
Shi Yu guessed that the skills Eleven could awaken were definitely the high-level Inner Power and Impregnable.
As for Buggy, Shi Yu couldn’t analyze what new racial skills it could awaken after evolution.
Didn’t this mean that there would be one each for the transcendent-level skills of the spiritual and spatial attributes?
However, if two or more transcendent skills were awakened, the insect evolved form’s race level should be judged as overlord. This was a little against common sense.
Because the current research on evolution in the Beast Tamer domain was already very clear. There were three laws for biological evolution.
First, the racial level might remain unchanged after biological evolution, and the evolutionary increase in the racial level wouldn’t be able to cross three major levels.
<ol start=”2″>
Each creature has multiple evolution possibilities.
Third, evolution not only changes the form of creatures, but also their species, attributes, and gender.
These were all very easy to understand. For example, if the evolution of Buggy followed the current research pattern, the highest level of its evolution might be a high-level monarch race that was comparable to an overlord race.
If one wanted to become an overlord race, they had to rely on the second law to carry out the second stage.
Eleven might be the same. This had already been confirmed in the previous evolution experiment. Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast’s perfection-level racial skill+hundreds of millions of evolution materials had only raised the Iron-eating Beast’s race level to middle class monarch.
As for that Ice Phoenix Moth that had reached the perfection stage of the worm silk and used phoenix related materials to evolve, it was only a low-level monarch race. It all matched this pattern.
Shi Yu was curious about this now. Could his Buggy with a max-level Worm Silk break this rule? However, he felt that it still depended on the evolution materials…
As for the third law, it was easier to understand. Changing forms was inevitable, and evolution to change species often occurred. For example, during the process of Dragon Carp to Dragon, from living body to undead, the species were considered directly changed. On the other hand, there were very few cases of gender change, and it only appeared on a small number of creatures.
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Then, Eleven and Buggy started to exchange deterrence insights.
Great.
Apart from Absolute Sleep, they had a second similar skill.
Speaking of which, was there any way for the two of them to combine this skill and make their aura merge together to become stronger and intimidate others?
The two pets started to conceptualize the second combination skill after the Soaring Sky Strategy, to bully others.
“What the heck are these two even talking about…” Shi Yu looked at the Dragon Soul Grass with a dark expression. That Yu Shu seemed to have said not to eat the Dragon Soul Grass directly?
It meant that he needed to eat it with other spiritual plant resources.
Many spiritual plants were like this, especially some strong or poisonous plants. They needed to be matched with other spiritual plants to neutralize the effects.
Shi Yu decided to investigate it when he returned. Then, he began to transplant the Dragon Soul Grass into the ruins bead.
At the same time.
On the assessment committee’s side, due to the help of the Eye of Heaven, everyone exploded again…
…
After a day of screening, these nine examiners had already preliminary confirmed the candidates for the 16 key seeded candidates.
In the next ranking battle, these 16 people wouldn’t collide too early. The collision between them would be the key to the entire ranking battle.
Apart from that, these 16 people would also be the cards of this batch of vocation assessments in the Ancient Capital. They were to edit some of their dazzling performance in the field survival assessment this time and then announce it to the public before and after the ranking assessment.
This way, the Beast Tamers of other cities could see the spiritual appearance of the candidates of the Ancient Capital!
The difficult task of editing was naturally handed to the Eye of Heaven.
This Eye of Heaven had been in charge of the vocation assessment in the ancient capital for several years. It was very familiar with the business and did not make any mistakes.
The examiners trusted it.
However…
When they saw the initial version of the video announced by the Eye of Heaven, they were instantly stunned.
When they saw the initial version of the video announced by the Eye of Heaven, they were instantly stunned.
The twelve-year-old handsome young man, Yin Zhengfan, controlled the Space Crystal Butterfly to gracefully defeat one enemy after another. There was no problem with this scene. The space element was incomparably mysterious, absolutely eye-catching.
He who controlled countless dead ferocious beast corpses with his Gu worms, the strange insect master Miao Dongdong. He had roamed the island of trials with a small beast tide. His performance was also very imposing, and this special beast taming occupation would also be a highlight.
Yu Shu, who rode the Soul-Armored Bone Dragon and traversed the sky of the Island of Trials, could not be found to be in the least bit odd. Every battle revealed the posturing aura of a Dragon Tamer.
These were all talents.
But the problem was, why was it that when it came to Shi Yu, it was all images of him riding the iron-eating beast and fighting using himself??
Profundity, great shock!
Profundity: Thunder Flash!
Profundity: Infinite Convergence!
In the scene, Shi Yu swung his sword, and dozens of wooden swords flew out like a storm, filling the sky. The sword force was like a net, peerlessly fierce, and spectacular. It directly surrounded the dozen or so Killer Bees that had gathered together. In the corner, Buggy used transparent worm silk to control the wooden swords that filled the sky. It was very awesome.
Worm Silk secret skill, Sword Control!
The examiners were stunned. This was a f*cking professional Beast Tamer assessment?
Are they sure it wasn’t the admission test of the Ancient Capital Film Academy?
The examiners opened their mouths wide in shock.
They were confused for a long time before reacting.
This video was too deceptive.
Moreover, the editing of the Eye of Heaven was also very tricky and advanced. It diluted the pet and strengthened Shi Yu’s performance. It was very compatible with Shi Yu’s posturing.
It was only because they were experienced that they could tell how these sword techniques were used.
The group of examiners could tell that this wasn’t because Shi Yu himself was ridiculously strong. Shi Yu didn’t have any powerful talent similar to the Fusion Talent to allow him to fight. It was purely because the Iron-eating Beast had actually mastered transcendent Level Hardening, Perfect Level Thunder Palm, and even an impressive deterrence skill. The Green Silkworm was also very ridiculous. It had mastered Transcendent Level Transparency Worm Silk. It was only with the cooperation of the two pets that Shi Yu completed this series of dazzling operations.
Are all the candidates in Ping Cheng District of your Icefield City so good at performing?
Speaking of which, the skill proficiency of Hardening, Thunder Palm, and Worm Silk was too ridiculous.
Although it was only levelless, low, and mid-level skills, the group of examiners was still a little shocked.
They dared to conclude that Shi Yu was definitely one of the most monstrous candidates in this batch of vocation assessments! Unfortunately, the Green Silkworm had yet to evolve. Otherwise, it would be another powerful competitor for first place!
“Do we really have to publicize these images as clips of the promotional vocation assessment in Ancient Capital?” A master said in silence.
Didn’t this Shi Yu have any normal training battle scenes? Oh, wait, there seemed to be one, and only one. It was the Dark-striped Poison Python that Shi Yu had first encountered… It was mainly because at that time, Shi Yu had yet to show off his world…
“It’s not a big problem, not a big problem. This is the initial version. Let’s see if there are better materials later…” Master Qu Jie said.
“Wait, there seems to be a battle between prospective seeded candidates.”
Because the Eye of Heaven’s Will focused on some key candidates, when important candidates met and competed, this group of examiners was the first to know.
The Eye of Heaven raised a short battle video.
“Who is it?”
In the video, Shi Yu and Yu Shu entered a valley together.
Shi Yu and Yu Shu?
The group of master-level examiners was slightly stunned and rather surprised.
He didn’t expect that the two people ranked in the top five of this assessment would bump into each other.
They didn’t know what the outcome would be.
However, when they saw this valley, the master examiners immediately understood. So it was to compete for the Dragon Soul Grass.
The Dragon Soul Grass was one of the most valuable resources on the Island of Trials this time. It looked like their luck was pretty good.
“Who will win?”
“But no matter the outcome, I hope the two didn’t have a conflict.”
The examiners really couldn’t say for the time being.
Because he still didn’t know how Yu Shu and Shi Yu planned to compete for the Dragon Soul Grass.
Soon, they received an answer. They saw that Yu Shu directly sent out the Soul-Armored Bone Dragon.
2VS2?
Just as they made this judgment, the expressions of all the master examiners froze.
“Roar…” In the video, a dragon roar sounded.
Their stunned expressions were almost at the same time as Yu Shu in the image.
On Shi Yu’s side, the Iron-eating Beast was indifferent. The Green Silkworm directly leaped down, and instantly, its entire body was covered in snow and wind, transforming into a powerful frost dragon!!
In the video, the Soul attached Bone Dragon and the Ice Dragon started a fierce collision. In a short round, the Ice Dragon relied on its strong physique to send the Bone Dragon flying with a claw!!
Crack!!
During the process of flying backward, the bone dragon repaired its damaged body in pain.
The power of the slap was so great that it directly shattered the skeleton’s strengthened body!!
A moment later, Yu Shu and the Soul attached Bone Dragon left with ugly expressions. They directly gave up the competition!
The frost dragon turned back into the green worm.
At this moment, the conference room was extremely silent.
The masters and examiners watched the video replay in confusion!
“Impossible.”
“This… What’s going on?!?!”
“You must be kidding.”
“Where did that frost dragon come from?!”
Perhaps because he was worried that the masters and examiners didn’t understand what had happened and didn’t understand some unorthodox skills, at this moment, the Eye of Heaven loaded the skill information of “Illusionary Phantom” and attached it to the end of the video.
Advanced Spirit and spatial dual-element skills, Phantom Illusion.
A powerful skill comparable to a super skill.
It was controlled by a green worm?
The master examiners were slightly stunned.
Now, they knew what was going on with the frost dragon, but not completely.
Another incomprehensible genius.
“I remember that there’s an Ice Dragon Ruins in Icefield City, right?”
“This Shi Yu has cracked the ruins space that appeared in Icefield City and his pet can transform into an ice dragon. Could it be an opportunity obtained from the ruins space? Are the two ruins related?” A master guessed.
“I can’t tell… But it’s very likely.”
“In short, don’t think about it if you can’t understand it. Whether it’s the Green Silkworm or other pets, we just have to organize the assessment well.” Master Qu Jie lit a cigarette.
“He came from a third-level city. He cracked the ruins space and studied the evolution method of the Iron-Eating Beasts through the ruins. He has two pets with ridiculous strength. In addition, he was reserved by the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University in advance… He will only enter the vision of certain organizations earlier than we do.”
“We were wrong. That’s not an ordinary green worm at all. The type is still pending.”
The master examiners nodded. Shi Yu’s identity information was very ordinary, but his experience was very ridiculous. There was only one possibility for this outcome: Shi Yu had been selected by a powerful Beast Tamer to be trained, or he had joined a special organization.
When the masters contacted Shi Yu’s identity as an archeologist, they immediately thought of that place, but it was difficult to confirm.
Although a master-level Beast Tamer could become the president of an association in any third-level city, they could only be considered a middle-level force in the Beast Tamer domain. An organization like Bureau 11 was a high-level force that was equivalent to a legendary-level Beast Tamer. Not every master knew these mysterious institutions very well.
“Damn, did we miss something? He can use a pet to fight against two alone and easily defeat Yu Shu?”
What if the Iron-eating Beast was added?
The expressions of the examiners changed, and they suddenly felt that the final ranking of the vocation assessment this time was blurred again. Perhaps the quality of the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital City this time wouldn’t be lower than those super cities.
…
On the island of Trials.
Shi Yu, who had obtained the Dragon Soul Grass, was very satisfied.
“Before we set off, someone seemed to have said that there are not only dragon-type resources on the island, but also spatial-type resources. Where are they…”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was addicted to collecting rare resources, started to think about spatial resources.
“Eleven, it’s up to you to find spatial resources.”
Shi Yu placed his hopes on Eleven, who had perfect super vision.
“If you can find it, I’ll spend a lot of money to buy you a set of your favorite training equipment.”
This might be a threat to other pets, but for Eleven, it was a temptation.
However, at this moment, Eleven rubbed its head crazily and showed a difficult expression.
The detestable Beast Tamer was troubling it again.
Although its super vision could detect energy fluctuations in a few hundred meters, this island was too big. It was impossible for them to search all of it in three days without eating, drinking, or sleeping. Wasn’t this searching for a needle in a haystack?
“But we still have to work hard to find it. It’s all worth it.”
“Ji ji, Ji.” Buggy nodded heavily.
At the same time, Buggy looked at the Beast Tamer.
When would he arrange for it to have super vision?
This skill was good.
After reaching the perfect level, not only could one see the enemy’s approximate strength, but they could also use it to search for treasures.
Most importantly, after its eyesight was enhanced, the Beast Tamer no longer had to worry about it playing short-sighted on the cell phone.
“We’ll talk about it when we have time.” Shi Yu touched his liver.
At this moment, after hearing Buggy’s words, Shi Yu suddenly felt a headache.
This guy also wanted super vision…
It felt that there was nothing wrong with teaching standard abilities such as super vision, absolute sleep, and deterrence to any pet.
However, there were only two pets now, and Shi Yu felt that he couldn’t take it anymore. In the future, if there were more pets, he might not be able to increase points.
However, the most infuriating thing was that the method of increasing the page count of the skill index encouraged him to contract more pets.
Every time Shi Yu contracted a pet, the skill index would increase by five blank pages. This page number was based on the number of pets, and not the level of the Beast Taming Space. It was very annoying to his body.
However, as a loving Beast Tamer, Shi Yu didn’t dislike it.
On the contrary, he was very conflicted right now. When the time came, would the third one be a plant-type pet, or an undead-type pet that could be contracted? Or a mechanical-type pet with very high technology? He was quite envious now.
“Let’s go, continue searching for treasures with me!”
Shi Yu called Eleven and Buggy.
“Sob!” Life was not easy. Eleven sighed and felt that it was meaningless to just carry Shi Yu.
If only Shi Yu and Buggy had focused on being heavier. This way, it could at least have the effect of weight training.
“Wuu!” After loading Shi Yu and Buggy, Eleven turned around.
They lacked a friend who knew gravity skills.
Eleven suggested to Shi Yu.
“Are you short of friends? You need someone that provides you with tools for training!”
Gravity training method? Did this panda want to become a Super Saiyan Bear?
…
In the blink of an eye, it was the last day of the wilderness survival trial.
Time passed pretty quickly.
Especially for someone like Shi Yu who searched for resources all over the island.
Actually, it wasn’t a full search of the island. In the end, Shi Yu only wandered around the circular area of the landing point.
Of course, as a result, he forgot about spatial resources.
He didn’t even find many level-three resources that were slightly more valuable.
Level-one and level-two trash, however, was something he had found. A peal.
Putting aside the Dragon Soul Grass, its value was barely seven digits.
It was mainly because of the agreement with Yin Zhengfan.
He promised Yin Zhengfan to fight his Space Crystal Butterfly before the assessment ended.
If he went too far, Shi Yu was afraid that he wouldn’t be able to make it back in time and then leave the little kid hanging.
He could offer spatial resources, but leaving someone hanging was not a good behavior.
After all, Yin Zhengfan was more valuable to Shi Yu than spatial resources.
“There are still two hours until the end of the assessment…”
Shi Yu looked at the time and rushed towards the valley that he had originally agreed on.
In these three days, he didn’t count how many ferocious beasts he had hunted. However, he had completed all three of the assessment missions along the way, so he definitely had a professional license now.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived at his destination.
Yin Zhengfan arrived earlier than Shi Yu. When Shi Yu arrived, this child was sitting quietly on a huge beast and using a furry tool to massage the Space Crystal Butterfly.
The Space Crystal Butterfly looked like it was enjoying itself. Usually, only Beast Tamers from the Medical and Feeding departments would master the massage method to relax and clear the energy circulation of different pets. It didn’t expect Yin Zhengfan to be an all-round genius.
“Sob.” “Ji!” Eleven and Buggy turned to look at Shi Yu. When could Shi Yu also massage them?
Shi Yu: “???”
He knew the basics, but he had to add points and massage now? Did it not treat him as a human? Shi Yu suddenly felt that he had worked too hard. The children were self-disciplined and hardworking, but they didn’t know how to be filial to the Beast Tamer.
“There’s no need to ask any questions for the time being after we go back. You have to arrange for housekeeping skills, nursing skills, and culinary skills. In the future, after adding some points, I’ll be counting on you guys to take care of me.”
Shi Yu felt that he should just be an emotionless tool.
Eleven, Buggy: (っ╥╯_╰╥c)??
This was what it meant to shoot oneself in the foot? They shouldn’t have said all that.
Below.
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan turned around with the Space Crystal Butterfly and also discovered Shi Yu who was rushing over from afar. Following that, his Zonyan Rock Beast turned around.
It was a huge rock creature about four meters tall that looked like a two-legged dinosaur. Most of its body was covered in sharp chestnut rocks, and it had strong limbs and tail.
The most classic feature was that there was a ring of mane rocks as sharp as a scarf around its neck. Although these mane rocks were also chestnut now, Shi Yu knew that the most terrifying power of the Zonyan Rock Beast was stored inside. The power of lava. Therefore, the Zonyan Rock Beast was also known as the Little Lava Beast, mainly because the name was already officially taken by another monster…
[Name]: Zonyan Rock Beast
[Attributes]: Earth, Fire
[Race Level]: Low Level Monarch
[Race Skill]: Rock Transformation, Earth Collapse, Rock Sealing, Mountain Collapsing, Rock Roar Cannon, Lava Explosion

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - End of the Survival Trial
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: End of the Survival Trial
Two low-level skills, one mid-level skill, two high-level skills, and one super-level skill…
The Zonyan Rock Beast had a lot of racial skills, and the three highest-level skills were all powerful attack skills.
This was a classic example of a brute.
It looked powerful, and it was indeed powerful when fighting, but it had no replication value at all. The surprise was insufficient.
After all, strong support and swift damage was more of his speed. Shi Yu believed that piling strengthening skills and support skills was the way to go.
For example, Eleven, Hardening was an enhancement skill, while Multiplication was also an enhancement skill. Inner Power was still an enhancement skill. When the time came, wouldn’t all three enhancement skills be a big move?
In comparison, he couldn’t let Eleven learn Lava Explosion, right?
This didn’t match Eleven’s current moves either.
However, although that was the case, Shi Yu still smiled when he saw them.
Beast Tamers had three elements: Beast Tamer level, Beast Tamer talent, and knowledge base.
His own knowledge base included the special, efficient training method for the skills in the secret manuals, and the special cultivation method for pets that included evolution methods.
There were so many pets of the low-level monarch species, but Yin Zhengfan just had to choose a big idiot. He most likely had mastered some cultivation method that was suitable for the Zonyan Rock Beast.
Perhaps there was a super rare racial skill.
This was a treasure boy. He couldn’t be looked at with common sense.
“You guys are here.”
Seeing that Shi Yu and the others had come, Yin Zhengfan was somewhat pleasantly surprised. He jumped down from the rock hand of the Zonyan Rock Beast.
“Sorry to have kept you waiting…”
“This is the Zonyan Rock Beast? Impressive…”
Shi Yu looked at the tall Zonyan Rock Beast and compared it. He felt that his Iron-eating Beast was better. After all, this thing couldn’t do anything other than fight. However, perhaps it was very efficient to send it to mine?
“It’s alright.” Yin Zhengfan also took a look at the Zonyan Rock Beast resting with its eyes narrowed and smiled, leaving it at that.
“Are you ready?”
“Do you guys want to rest?”
He looked at the iron-eating beast that Shi Yu had squeezed into a mount and asked Shi Yu and the others.
Although Yin Zhengfan had been looking forward to this battle for a long time, he didn’t mind waiting a little longer.
“There’s no need.” Shi Yu glanced at the time. It wasn’t far from the end of the assessment. It was better to start as soon as possible.
“I think it can’t wait to fight a space-type opponent too.” Shi Yu patted Eleven beside him.
“Wuu.” Eleven smiled foolishly, revealing battle intent!
Because he had never fought a space-type opponent, Eleven was really a little curious. Its training was not good enough!
…
As the assessment approached the end, the nine master examiners gathered together.
Apart from that, an unexpected guest arrived in the huge mechanical cruiser in the sky above the Island of Trials.
A middle-aged man who looked as stable as a mountain and seemed to be born with the aura of a king arrived.
“Yin Legend…” Master Qu Jie and the others looked at this man and smiled helplessly.
Why was this person here?
“Don’t worry about me.” Yin Zhongrong was expressionless.
How could they not mind?
The nine master examiners muttered in their hearts.
However, even if this didn’t follow the rules, no one dared to say anything.
After all, everyone knew Yin Zhongrong’s legendary personality. He didn’t care about rules in the first place. This Yin Legend whose strength could be ranked among the legendary Beast Tamers only pursued the pinnacle of the Beast Tamer domain. This was what he valued the most.
Apart from that, he cared the most about this son of his. Yin Zhongrong only had a son at the age of 50. He regarded Yin Zhengfan, the child who had inherited his Beast Taming Talent, very highly, and his control of his son was relatively strong. Now, he was most likely here for Yin Zhengfan.
He sat in the cruiser and brewed a cup of tea himself. Then, he said, “Eye of Heaven, I want to see what Yin Zhengfan is doing at the moment.”
The Eye of Heaven paused.
Even the nine master examiners couldn’t order the Eye of Heaven. They could only wait for it to update its data and upload the situation of the candidates.
But at this moment, as Yin Zhongrong finished speaking, the Eye of Heaven immediately obediently grabbed the image according to his orders.
It couldn’t be helped. This was a big boss after all. Even its Beast Tamer was very respectful to Yin Legend. To be precise, it had been beaten up by Yin Legend before, so it was more afraid of this dignified uncle.
“The assessment is almost over. He should be packing his spoils of war now,” said a master.
“How’s his performance these few days?” Yin Zhongrong asked.
Master Qu Jie said, “He completed the three assessment missions perfectly and ranked fourth. It’s mainly because he has been training the Space Crystal Butterfly from the beginning to the end and hasn’t sent the Zonyan Rock Beast to battle.”
Now that the assessment mission was completed, these candidates naturally did not care how many transcendent-level ferocious beasts they had hunted.
The ones who should care were those candidates who had not completed the assessment mission and could only rely on their points ranking to decide whether they could become professional Beast Tamers.
What really concerned these candidates like Yin Legend’s son was the final ranking battle.
“I understand.” Yin Zhongrong closed his eyes slightly and opened them. At this moment, the Eye of Heavenly Silk had already transferred Yin Zhengfan’s current state.
As a new image appeared on the center screen of the cruiser, Yin Zhongrong and all the examiners looked over.
The examiners were stunned.
That was because in the video, Yin Zhengfan was ordering the Space Crystal Butterfly to face Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast! It was as if he was preparing to fight!
Holy shit!
The Masters were shocked. What was going on? Why did these two meet?
“Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu are competing for resources…? No, the surroundings aren’t resource points,” an examiner said in surprise.
“Who is this person?” Yin Zhongrong looked at the scene and asked.
He knew his son’s personality well. Like him, he basically wouldn’t fight opponents he wasn’t interested in.
Master Qu Jie said, “His name is Shi Yu. His basic test results are fourth in this assessment. He’s a genius archeologist.”
archeologist…
Yin Zhongrong looked at the screen quietly.
“Then his strength should be pretty good, right?”
Facing this question, the masters and archeologists looked at each other, not knowing how to answer.
Not only was it not bad, if Yin Zhengfan only planned to use the Crystal Butterfly to fight with that Iron-eating Beast, he would definitely fail!!
He should probably be using the Zonyan Rock Beast!
Maybe they should stop watching…
“Yes… Yes, it’s not bad, and it’s very unscientific. It’s that Iron-eating Beast that got fourth place in the first assessment…”
Iron-eating beast?
Yin Zhongrong was incomparably surprised. However, he still didn’t think that Yin Zhengfan would lose. After all, the racial difference between the Space Crystal Butterfly and the Iron-eating Beast was too big.
…
In the scene, Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu had already started fighting.
The Space Crystal Butterfly VS Iron-eating Beast!
“Mi ~”
The Space Crystal Butterfly, which had a white body and transparent wings that were as huge as water, slowly flew to an empty place.
Yin Zhengfan walked near it, his eyes shining.
His Space Crystal Butterfly had just evolved and needed training. He hoped that Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast in front of him would be pretty good opponents.
“They won’t be weak. We have to be serious!”
Yin Zhengfan thought.
After all, Shi Yu and the others were ranked fourth in the test.
In front of Yin Zhengfan, Eleven stretched its body for a long time. Its gaze was serious as it looked at the Space Crystal Butterfly opposite her.
Shi Yu, on the other hand, observed carefully from afar.
Apart from this pair of pets and a pair of Beast Tamers, the Zonyan Rock Beast not far away, and the Green Silkworm on Shi Yu’s shoulder were also spectators. They sized up the battlefield. Among them, the Green Silkworm was very curious about how much pressure Big Sister Butterfly, who had mastered spatial skills, could give to the leader.
“Ji…”
Buggy let out a low cry. On the other side, a trace of a fierce aura flowed out of Yin Zhengfan’s calm expression. Compared to normal days, he looked like a completely different person in battle.
“Then we’ll go ahead and attack first.”
Yin Zhengfan waved a hand, and the Space Crystal Butterfly’s flying height increased slightly with a “Mi ~”. During this period, its wings flapped, and three crescent-shaped green lights flew out!
Low-level wind-element skill, Wind Blade!
Apart from the three spatial-type racial skills, it also learned the Wind Crystal Butterfly’s racial skills through other methods!
The skill was instantly activated, and the green light condensed. It was an expert level wind blade!
Right now, Yin Zhengfan clearly wanted to use this move to test the iron-eating beast.
“Wuu!!!” On the other hand, Eleven’s battle intent was high.
The wind blade attacked, causing the surrounding airflow to surge crazily. The sound of the wind blade tearing through the air was strong, as if it could cut through metal. Under the strong wind pressure, Eleven, who was standing not far from the Space Crystal Butterfly, trembled quickly, but Eleven’s expression was very determined.
Especially its eyes. When he focused its mind, they were especially bright, as if it had seen another world.
Intermediate spiritual skill, perfect level super vision!
Under the activation of its super vision, the destructive power of the wind blade was clear. Its speed was also infinitely slow in its eyes.
Bang!!!
Eleven hardened its palm and suddenly pinched a wind blade that was coming at it. Immediately, a strong wind surged, and the seemingly ordinary move stopped the blade. However, after Eleven squeezed it, its body instantly cleverly dodged the other two wind blades that were also coming at it, causing the wind blades to miss and almost brush past its body.
“Is it a coincidence, or…”
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan’s pupils constricted.
Not only did he realize that the iron-eating beast had crushed an expert level wind blade, but it was also unscathed.
He also discovered that it actually dodged two of the pincer attacks accurately, neutralizing their testing with almost the least consumption!
This Hardening Proficiency was at least at Perfect Level!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s expression was calm. If Yin Zhengfan wanted to train the Space Crystal Butterfly, it would be meaningless to directly let Eleven unleash his full battle power. He also had the mentality of training Eleven. He didn’t let it throw out all its strength, but planned to win with skill.
In this way, this battle would not be meaningless. It could have training effects on both pets!!
“Battle awareness is not bad.”
At the same time, a round of confrontation made Yin Legend see how extraordinary the iron-eating beast was.
He nodded. Perfect racial skill?
And that exaggerated reaction speed, for the iron-eating beast race, was indeed as those examiners said. It was a little unscientific.
At that moment, when they saw Yin Legend nod calmly, the masters smiled bitterly. This was the beginning of illogical things!
In the scene, Yin Zhengfan and the Space Crystal Butterfly quickly launched a second round of attacks!
“Spatial shackles!”
The wind blades couldn’t affect Eleven, so Yin Zhengfan wasn’t in a hurry.
After all, his original intention was to use the speed of the wind blades to interfere with the iron-eating beast.
The instant cast attribute of the wind blade, together with its extreme speed, was very suitable for harassing opponents before the Space Crystal Butterfly chanted high-level skills.
As expected, while Eleven was fighting the wind blade, the Space Crystal Butterfly accumulated power for three seconds and directly created a spatial domain, locking Eleven inside.
Buzz!
At this moment, Eleven suddenly felt the air flow faster. Suddenly, the surroundings were extremely oppressive.
He felt like he was in another space.
Through its perfect super vision, Eleven could still vaguely see the energy flow of the surrounding space. This move was very strange. As a spatial-type move, it couldn’t be sure if it could forcefully break through the shackles through the combination skill of Hardening and Thunder Palm.
However, there was actually no need to break it at all. This was because the spatial shackles couldn’t directly cause damage. If the Space Crystal Butterfly wanted to deal damage through this move, it had to cause the spatial domain to tremble. Then, it could use the spatial shattering spatial wave to deal damage to the enemy!!
“Mi!!”
As the Space Crystal Butterfly flapped its wings, the space that shackled Eleven started to shake. transparent spider web-like cracks began to appear around it. In the next moment, transparent waves spread towards Eleven!
“Even if it can block with Perfect Level Hardening, it should be greatly affected.”
Yin Zhengfan’s expression was serious. Even if his Zonyan Rock Beast relied on its expert level Rock Transformation and the physique of a monarch race to take this move head-on. It would also be injured.
As for this Iron-eating Beast…
Just as Yin Zhengfan made the judgment, a scene that made him very quiet happened to Eleven.
“Wuu!!”
After the shock wave was formed, Eleven’s expression was serious. The ground under its feet immediately turned black as if it had turned into metal. Then, the black hardening substance was like liquid metal, instantly forming a half-sphere hardening barrier that completely isolated it from the outside world!
Perfect Level Hardening, Release of Hardened Material!
The huge hardening substance didn’t come into contact with Eleven and formed layer after layer of hardening barriers around its body. The shock wave came with a bang, and cracks quickly appeared on the hardening barrier. The solid hemisphere almost shattered, but before the shock wave could continue to pass in, the continuous hardening substance quickly repaired the hemisphere’s barrier and completely dissolved the shock wave. At this moment, Yin Zhengfan’s expression changed drastically.
“How could this be…”
It wasn’t Perfect Level Hardening, but… Transcendent Level!
In the scene, an incomprehensible expression appeared on Yin Zhengfan’s young face.
He completely didn’t expect Shi Yu and the others to actually still have such a trump card.
Seeing this exchange, Yin Legend also showed a serious expression and said, “Transcendent Level Hardening… He’s just a newbie?”
The level of transcendence represented the peak of skill. Even if there were special training methods, cultivation methods, or even if it was a low-level skill, there was no reason for it to appear in the vocation assessment and in such a young person.
“Yes.” The masters actually felt that it was alright, because the 12-year-old Yin Zhengfan was clearly more ridiculous.
When Yin Zhengfan turned 18, who knew if he would already be a young master.
Crack!!!
In the scene, the spatial shackles shattered, and the hardened substance flowed back and disappeared. The Little Iron Eating Beast appeared again.
At this moment, the hardening substance flowed into Eleven’s palm and formed a metal ball the size of a ping pong ball. Eleven squeezed hard, and his super vision locked onto the slightly confused Space Crystal Butterfly not far away and threw it!!
Boom!!!
The hardening ball smashed towards the Space Crystal Butterfly like a cannonball. With Eleven’s power, although it wasn’t as fast as the previous wind blades, it wasn’t slow at all.
“Mi!”
The black meteor smashed over, scaring the Space Crystal Butterfly into immediately disappearing. The hardening ball directly passed through the body of the Space Crystal Butterfly and smashed towards the mountain behind. With a bang, a shattering hole was directly smashed out of the mountain, and countless shattered rocks fell.
The huge sound entered Yin Zhengfan’s heart, making him suddenly raise his head and look at Shi Yu opposite him.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already made a checkmate.
Yin Zhengfan also sensed this.
“I underestimated them…” He understood this, and his heart became extremely heavy. However, he did not plan to give up just like that.
Yin Legend and the examiners watching from the back also sensed this.
The Space Crystal Butterfly’s spatial shackles could not break through the absolute defense of transcendent level.
This meant that the Space Crystal Butterfly couldn’t hurt the Iron-Eating Beast.
And although the Iron-eating Beast also seemed to be unable to cause any damage to the Space Crystal Butterfly, which had Space Concealment and Instant Transmission.
However, these two skills had a very big disadvantage.
In the hidden state, the Space Crystal Butterfly couldn’t use other skills, and the consumption of Instant Transmission was too high.
Could it be that it was going to become a battle of attrition between the Space Crystal Butterfly and the Iron-eating Beast?
A battle of attrition was definitely not a good choice for the Space Crystal Butterfly.
Sweat dripped from Yin Zhengfan’s forehead as he sensed the extremely strong pressure from his opponent.
“Is he going to lose?” Yin Legend held the cup tightly and continued to stare at the screen.
At this moment, apart from the Eye of Heaven, no one knew that the Space Crystal Butterfly was facing the combination of Transcendent Level Hardening and Perfect Level super vision!
In a sense, this was also a profundity!
In the video, the battle between the two continued.
Under the lock-on of the perfect level super vision, the Space Crystal Butterfly had just retreated from its hidden state for half a second…
Bang!
Eleven threw out the hardened substance that had condensed into a ball with one hand and forced the Space Crystal Butterfly to teleport in a hurry…
In the next second, just as the figure of the Space Crystal Butterfly appeared after it teleported, another black meteor attacked. The Space Crystal Butterfly was forced to enter the hidden state to dodge again!
In the arena, Eleven, who was facing the Space Crystal Butterfly, was slightly calm. It was suppressing his opponent the whole time.
The Space Crystal Butterfly needed three seconds to cast the spatial shackle that posed a threat to it. During this period, it was enough to counterattack.
It only relied on Hardening and supervision skills.
Shi Yu’s expression remained unchanged. So, could the Space Crystal Butterfly force Eleven to use its third skill?
“Ji…” The green worm cried as if it had seen its future.
On the other side, Yin Zhengfan stared fixedly at the changing situation, his brain continuously seeking ways to break out of the situation.
However, he could only sense the pressure from Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast growing stronger.
Under the reconnaissance and locking of perfect-grade super vision, even if the Space Crystal Butterfly had the spatial element, it seemed to have plunged it into an endless abyss.
The more he struggled, the deeper he sank. He couldn’t escape from the huge hand high above.
This wasn’t a suppression of attributes, nor was it a suppression of strength, but a suppression of skills. It relied on the high proficiency of the skill to look down on the opponent.
The Space Crystal Butterfly, which had just evolved and wasn’t proficient in its skills yet, was like a child compared to the little Metal-eating Beast that had trained its skills to the peak.
“This candidate…”
Upon seeing this, Yin Legend felt that there was no need to continue watching.
