He said, “Eye of Heaven, in addition to hardening, that Iron-eating Beast probably also used a skill that can lock onto the enemy.”
It answered Yin Legend Zhongrong through the form of the subtitles.
Mid-level spiritual skill, super vision.
Although it wasn’t as good as its Heavenly Eye, it was still a pretty good skill.
Most importantly, the super vision development of this Iron-eating Beast was ridiculously high.
…
A few minutes later.
The Space Crystal Butterfly finally couldn’t hold on anymore. It couldn’t withstand the pressure and its physical fitness was exhausted.
Shi Yu and Eleven didn’t continue attacking because Eleven had always been in control of how much energy the Space Crystal Butterfly had left.
“I lost.”
After the feedback from the Space Crystal Butterfly that it was unable to fight, Yin Zhengfan admitted defeat immediately.
He looked confused and indignant.
Anguish and torture.
This battle was what he felt.
Apart from the first time the Space Crystal Butterfly attacked the Iron-eating Beast, it was suppressed by the Iron-eating Beast the whole time.
This feeling made Yin Zhengfan almost unable to breathe.
After the battle, he was already drenched in sweat.
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “Perhaps the situation will change if the Skill Proficiency of the Crystal Butterfly is higher.”
He was telling the truth.
However, it made Yin Zhengfan feel like this was the first time he had seen Shi Yu, who was having a friendly chat with him before.
Yin Zhengfan no longer had the smile from before.
He could chat and laugh with people his age who were weaker than him.
But facing his peers who were stronger than him, his heart immediately became extremely heavy.
He was a person with unparalleled self-esteem. His goal was to get first place in this assessment. Although this was not an official battle, at this moment, Yin Zhengfan still had to admit that Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast in front of him were very strong.
“Roar…” The Zonyan Rock Beast looked at the tired Space Crystal Butterfly and the lost Beast Tamer and got up slightly. Its four-meter-tall body stood like a small mountain.
It was asking if it wanted to fight.
It looked at the tiny Eleven. If it were it, it wouldn’t dodge those skills at all. Its defense was dozens of times stronger than the Space Crystal Butterfly. Even if it took the hardening attacks head-on, it wouldn’t suffer serious injuries. It could defeat all opponents with brute force.
“Huh?” Eleven also looked up at the big guy.
Were they going to continue?
“Ji!” Seeing the big Zonyan Rock Beast get up, the spectating Worm sighed with emotion that Big Sister Space Crystal Butterfly couldn’t force the leader to use its full strength, and advised the Zonyan Rock Beast not to court a rebuff.
Did it think this was the full battle power of a leader?
“No need.” Yin Zhengfan waved his hand to indicate that the battle had ended.
With that said, he revealed a determined expression and looked at Shi Yu and the others.
“Although I lost this time, I’ll definitely win the ranking battle.”
“When the time comes, it’ll be a 2VS2.” Shi Yu looked at the Zonyan Rock Beast and the Space Crystal Butterfly. He didn’t know what kind of sparks would result from the cooperation of these two pets.
“Yes, at that time, I definitely won’t lose,” Yin Zhengfan clenched his fists and affirmed.
He didn’t regret challenging Shi Yu, but regretted why he had underestimated his opponent. He didn’t manage to make his pet go all out in the first battle.
He lost…
“Alright, let’s fight again when the time comes.” At that moment, Shi Yu sensed Yin Zhengfan’s tone and looked at his expression, feeling a little panicked.
Damn.
He was still smiling amiably just now, why was he so serious now?
It couldn’t be that he was too young and couldn’t take it, right? Now, the feeling Yin Zhengfan gave Shi Yu was like he could cry at any moment, making Shi Yu regret fighting this battle a little.
“The assessment is about to end. We can finally leave this damn place.” Shi Yu took a look at the time and quickly changed the topic.
…
Yin Zhengfan lost.
In the mechanical airship in the sky, the master examiners still had the Eye of Heaven’s Will. They completely didn’t expect that Yin Legend had just come to see his son and would encounter such an explosive scene.
They secretly stared at Yin Legend who was silently watching the scene and didn’t say anything.
Until he himself spoke.
“Can I see this Shi Yu’s trial performance?”
Yin Legend didn’t look very emotional. Although Yin Zhengfan lost, he didn’t mind. After all, it was only a 1VS1. Moreover, it was also good to let the young Yin Zhengfan have some setbacks.
Under his protection, Yin Zhengfan was destined to not have the same growth experience as him back then. Moreover, the era was different now. The chaos and factional struggles both domestically and abroad had already temporarily calmed down. In his opinion, this kind of competition between peers within ten years of each other was very suitable for Yin Zhengfan to grow up.
“Ah, this…” At this moment, as Yin Sheng finished speaking, the master examiners were a little at a loss.
Yin Legend, oh Yin Legend, it was best not to look.
However, this was not under the jurisdiction of the examiners. Upon hearing Yin Chuan’s words, the Eye of Heaven immediately broadcasted its carefully edited Time Trial section, covering the current scene.
Yin Chuan, who had a serious expression, looked at the image again, wanting to see the hidden ability of this candidate who had made his son suffer a setback once.
Then, in the video, a young man riding a panda, holding a wooden sword, and wearing a happy expression slowly appeared. The intense scene of him cutting from the forest to the lake, from the lake to the valley.
Yin Legend couldn’t calm down for a long time.
“Looks like the training missions assigned to Zheng Fan are still too few.”
…
Before long, the three-day survival assessment finally ended.
After the time was up, the Eye of Heaven started its old job.
It teleported the candidates on the island back to the flying transport in the sky.
At this moment, the thousands of small black dots wrapped in blue light began to rise into the sky.
Under the cover of Psychic power, some candidates were laughing crazily, and some candidates looked like they had lost their parents.
Shi Yu was in a pretty good mood. After all, he had gained a lot this time.
Three spatial skills! Three Dragon Soul Grass! Buggy even awakened deterrence!
There was also the scrap resource of a pearl that could be exchanged for many divine beans!
Of course, if Shi Yu was in a good mood, there would be people who were in a bad mood because of him.
For example, Yu Shu, who had missed the Dragon Soul Grass, did not look happy at all after the assessment. He felt that he was unlucky to have met a monster in this assessment.
There was also the stronger Yin Zhengfan. It was fine before he fought with Shi Yu, the two of them could still communicate happily. After the battle… Shi Yu felt that his little friend Yin Zhengfan had directly missed out on their friendship.
Son of a b*tch, battle was so pointless. Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh.
How could he replicate skills in the future…
“Forget it, forget it. I won’t think too much. Next, I can finally sleep soundly!”
Before long, Shi Yu was teleported to an aircraft. However, what confused Shi Yu was that it didn’t seem to be the one he was sitting in at the start?
Apart from Shi Yu, there were fifteen other people, including Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan. They were the 16 key candidates chosen this time!
At this moment, after meeting Shi Yu again, Yu Shu’s expression darkened…

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - Ancient Capital University Resource Bank
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Ancient Capital University Resource Bank
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the huge airship space, the sixteen people stood on the ground and observed each other.
Among them, Shi Yu had only seen Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan previously.
Shi Yu didn’t know the others.
However, judging from the cleanliness of their clothes and their full spirits, they were definitely the best in this assessment.
Those who could ensure such a state in the field survival for three days were definitely very strong.
Among the sixteen people present, there were twelve men and four women. The ratio was about the same as the male and female participants in the vocation assessment. Shi Yu’s gaze took note of the four girls. After all, who would look at rough men…
Although that was the case, apart from Shi Yu looking at the girls, most of the candidates were still observing Yin Zhengfan, who was only 12 years old. After all, this age was too exaggerated.
“As expected, their strength and looks are on par.” The four female candidates gave Shi Yu a strange feeling. Apart from their looks, they were all pretty good. Perhaps it was due to cultural differences, but the Beast Tamers in this world wore fancy clothes.
For example, among the four girls, one of them was wearing a similar qipao but more like a magician’s robe. The other was wearing a black leather shirt that only covered a small portion of his body, and the other was wearing clothes that looked like ancient wuxia clothes… What the hell?
It was the same on the men’s side. There were also many abnormalities. It was still alright for Yu Shu, who was wearing a black trench coat and a windproof cloak to act cool. Shi Yu even saw a fool wearing metal plate armor. Wasn’t he tired from the weight?
“There aren’t many normal Beast Tamers like me anymore.”
Shi Yu looked at his white panda short-sleeved shirt and black pants and immediately felt that he was more affable to the people. On the other hand, these guys looked like they had come out of a cartoon.
“Or are these guys’ clothes made of special materials that can be used to increase attributes?”
The clothes in this world were also very particular. For example, the worm silk of the Green Silkworm could be used in the field of clothing to create clothes with many special effects. However, Shi Yu didn’t even have enough money to eat and drink, so he didn’t pay much attention to some brands with equipment.
His clothes seemed to be a gift from Bamboo Stone Dojo…
“Firstly, congratulations on passing this vocation assessment and officially becoming a professional Beast Tamer. You have stepped into the door of the vocation field.”
When the 16 people wondered why they had appeared here, a middle-aged examiner in a formal suit walked out of the cabin door and smiled at the crowd.
“Hello, I’m the overall in-charge of this vocation assessment, Qu Xie.”
Master Qu Jie?
Everyone immediately recognized this person from his name. Qu Jie, a top-level professional Beast Tamer.
Only when one’s Beast Taming Space reached level six would they have the chance to enjoy this top-notch master honor.
It was still alright if the Beast Taming Space was from level one to three. As long as the Beast Tamer worked hard, he could accumulate it with time.
However, after the Beast Taming Space reached level three, it was not so easy to improve. Talent, cultivation resources, and feedback from the upgrade of his pet could not fall behind.
Therefore, the level-six Beast Taming Space was already a very high level.
After that, it would be a Legendary-level person that could control overlord-level creatures.
“Master Qu Jie.” A portion of the candidates greeted. A portion of the candidates didn’t say anything and continued waiting for Qu Jie to speak.
Master Qu Jie smiled and said, “Among you, probably no one plans to give up the fourth ranking competition, right?”
“No.” Everyone shook their heads. Although they were already professional Beast Tamers after passing the third round, they all knew that the fourth round’s ranking assessment was the most important.
This final assessment could determine their ranking in abilities among the new batch of professional Beast Tamers. It could decide their fate in the future!
“If not, then congratulations to the sixteen of you again for becoming key seed candidates for this year’s assessment. According to your performance in the Wilderness Survival Trials, you have an additional point policy. You can skip the assessment ranking segment and directly enter the final ranking elimination battle.”
“A total of 784 Beast Tamers passed the third assessment this time. It can also be said that you’re internally confirmed to be in the top 32. You don’t have to compete with most of the candidates anymore.”
Master Qu Jie smiled. This was preferential treatment for these 16 people, and also a form of protection for the other candidates.
Upon hearing that, Yu Shu, Miao Dongdong, and the others nodded. There was no surprise.
They were sufficiently confident in their strength. If they participated in the assessment ranking segment, facing ordinary candidates, it was tantamount to a massacre. It was also good to directly start the competition from the top 32.
The 16 of them observed each other again and understood that the people around them were their real competitors.
“Alright, in the next three days, you guys can relax and rest. You can come and watch the subsequent assessment if you want, or you can choose not to come. Apart from that, there’s also one more thing. The battle scenes of the sixteen of you in the field survival assessment will be edited as a promotional video for this Ancient Capital vocation assessment. This is also a proof that you can become key seeded candidates. There’s no problem, right?”
“No,” the strangely dressed crowd said calmly. Instead, they were looking forward to this opportunity to appear on TV.
What was this crap…!
Shi Yu also subconsciously said that there was no problem since everyone did, but his heart skipped a beat when he suddenly realized that Master Qu Jie was looking at him strangely.
Holy shit, wait, what did he just say?
Promotional video??
“…” Shi Yu recalled what he had done in the wilderness survival trial and his expression immediately darkened.
No way?
Just now, Shi Yu had even said that these guys in strange clothes were stupid. Now, he realized that he was the stupid one.
Shi Yu wanted to say something but hesitated. At this moment, Master Qu Jie hurriedly coughed dryly and said, “In that case, sit down. You should be able to reach the second airport in a minute. Just remember to pay attention to the assessment information later.”
With that, he quickly turned and left…
He couldn’t give Shi Yu a chance to refuse. It turned out that Beast Tamers could still play around with so much skill. When Shi Yu became a legendary Beast Tamer in the future, this promotional video would be the dark history of his youth. As the main examiner of this batch, he might be able to gain some fame with this… Pfft.
…
Not long after Master Qu Jie left, the airship shook. It looked like he had arrived at his destination. His speed was very fast.
The sixteen key seeded candidates were not very familiar with each other. There was no conversation during the entire process.
Shi Yu wanted to go to Yu Shu’s side and ask him how to use the Dragon Soul Grass, but when he thought about how this would agitate Yu Shu and also lose the friendship of this future great Dragon Tamer like losing Yin Zhengfan, he decided to forget it.
He would talk about it after returning to school.
After arriving at the destination, everyone quietly got off the cruiser. However, at this moment, the second airport was noisy. After all, thousands of candidates had arrived and landed here at the same time.
At the moment, most of the candidates still didn’t know the situation of their assessment results. Those candidates who completed the assessment mission were alright, but those who couldn’t complete the assessment mission and planned to bet on their points ranking were still very nervous.
“I’ll leave first.” After Shi Yu came down, he smiled and waved at Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan.
The other thirteen candidates glanced at Shi Yu slightly. Yu Shu turned his head unhappily and ignored Shi Yu. As for Yin Zhengfan, after a moment of silence, he said politely, “I’ll see you in the ranking battle.”
Shi Yu nodded and didn’t stay long. He immediately left because someone was picking him up… He opened his cell phone and saw a message.
There was also a picture attached to the message. The picture showed Senior Panda’s location. Just like the last time he came to Ancient Capital, after Shi Yu completed the Wilderness Survival Trial, Senior Panda replaced the archeological Seven Elites to fetch Shi Yu.
“Where is it…”
Shi Yu walked out of the airport almost immediately. However, because of this, before the car could be found, he was stopped by a two-man reporter team who was waiting for him.
It was a man and a woman. The man wore a blue hat and carried a huge camera as he attacked Shi Yu. The reporter lady held a red microphone warmly and asked, “Hello, handsome. We are reporters from Phoenix TV Station. May I ask…”
“The assessment is very smooth. I think it’s not difficult. I’m very confident in the upcoming ranking battle. Thank you for your blessings and I wish you success in your work.” Shi Yu didn’t wait for the reporter lady to finish asking. He didn’t want to waste time on the interview. Under the confused expressions of the two, he quickly passed them and the crowd.
The reporter was speechless.
You’ve already answered it, what else do I have to ask?
“So uncooperative. To think I even chose the most handsome one for the interview,” she said indignantly.
“Delete this part… it’s useless.”
…
“Beep… Beep…”
“Over here!!”
After Shi Yu passed through the crowd, he finally discovered the panda senior who had her window open and was waving at him.
Shi Yu smiled and quickly walked over. He opened the car door and sat down in relief.
“Phew—” After getting into the car, Shi Yu felt the cold wind and the fragrance drifting in the car. He immediately felt relieved.
It was still more comfortable to sit in a car. As expected of human intelligence. It was more comfortable than a panda mount, though Eleven was more unique.
Eleven in the Taming space:???
“How is it?” At this moment, in the driver’s seat, Panda Sister was wearing large black sunglasses. She smiled and asked.
“The research institute has prepared a celebration dinner for you. Don’t say that you failed the exam.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “How could that be? Moreover, I seem to have become some key seed candidate. I can directly enter the top 32 without participating in the complicated competitions before the ranking battle.”
“Really??” The panda senior was slightly surprised. “This means that your performance in the comprehensive evaluation of the assessment committee is ranked in the top 16! Not bad!”
Although Shi Yu’s basic test results were very good, the second pet was a Green silkworm after all. Everyone was quite worried at first.
From the looks of it, Eleven was very impressive this time?!
Little did the panda senior know that the MVP for this battle was Shi Yu himself… Eleven and Buggy were support teams.
After the car started, the panda senior asked questions as she drove.
Shi Yu also asked.
“Any progress recently?”
It referred to research related to the evolution of iron-eating beasts.
The panda senior said, “It’s basically done, so we have to quickly confirm the name of the iron-eating beast’s evolution form. Also… Master Guo gave us his training cultivation manual.”
Currently, there were a total of three Iron-eating Beasts in the country that had completed their evolution. Master Guo was one of them.
He was talented. He had once developed a skill training manual that quickly increased the proficiency of the Iron-eating Beast. Because of this, his Iron-eating Beast’s hardening skill had reached transcendent.
At that moment, he gave this secret manual to the research institute. Senior Panda and the archeological seven elites in the Iron-eating Beast Institution were preparing to combine this training secret manual to study the method to quickly increase the Iron-eating Beast’s hardening proficiency.
After all, if it were to train normally, it would be very difficult for the Iron-eating Beast to train hardening to expert level in a year. It would also be very difficult for it to reach transcendent level in 20 years, causing the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution threshold to be too high.
Therefore, the training method to increase proficiency had to be studied in detail in the future. This could indirectly increase the status and value of the iron-eating beasts.
“Oh, oh.” Shi Yu didn’t mind. It was an efficient training method to increase proficiency. He wasn’t interested. It couldn’t be faster than his points method anyway.
However, the tribe represented by the iron-eating beast ruins should have similar training methods. Otherwise, it was difficult to imagine that dozens to hundreds of iron-eating beasts would simultaneously have racial skills above transcendent.
Well… In short, he still couldn’t help with this research. He could only cheer on Senior Panda and the others.
On the other hand, when he was free, he could use the skill index to study the training method to quickly increase various skill proficiency in reverse. As for now… he wasn’t free, leveling up was more important.
“By the way, you just said that the harvest was not small?” the panda senior asked curiously.
“Yes, I obtained some rare resources. By the way, Senior, is there anywhere suitable to sell things?” Shi Yu recalled the messy pile of low-level resources in the ruins pearl and the ice-element energy crystal. He decided to find a place to pack and sell them.
As for the Ethereal Spirit Stone, he definitely had to keep it first. After all, using this thing to assist in cultivation was quite fast. Just like supplements, it was also an indispensable resource.
“Let me think…”
“Why don’t you try contacting Chief Li?”
Senior Panda suggested, “If you’re a student of Ancient Capital University, you can actually participate in training activities frequently. The resources obtained by secondary school students during training activities are purchased at a slightly higher price than the market price. In addition, the school also buys resources obtained by students from other channels according to the market price. You can exchange it for money and credits.”
“Then, similarly, students can also use credits below the market price to exchange for various resources. In short, it’s very cost-effective. Although you’re not a student of Ancient Capital University, if it’s you, I feel that you can definitely use connections to get a taste.”
When Lin Xiuzhu thought of how Shi Yu could become the in-charge of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins, she immediately knew in her heart that he definitely had an indescribable relationship with Ancient Capital University! Then he should directly sell it to the university!
“Is that so? I’ll ask later.”
Shi Yu nodded. Famous schools were still better. They would try their best to let students take advantage of them. No wonder it was said that schools were the best place for Beast Tamers to grow up. The association’s education fees were several trillion yuan a year, and this was also the reason why the major schools in Dong Huang dared to continuously give students benefits.
Soon, Sister Panda brought Shi Yu back to the research institute.
It couldn’t be more coincidental that at this moment, the archeological seven elites were cautiously welcoming their Mentor Ding and Director Li.
The two of them also knew the future of their archeology specialization. Shi Yu, the hope of their archeology specialization, had just passed the vocation assessment today and immediately came to greet them.
“Director Li, Mentor Ding?” Shi Yu was surprised. Alright, it saved him the trouble of looking for them. He just had to ask them here.
“Student Shiyu, the assessment went smoothly, right?” The slightly plump Director Li said with a smile, his face filled with joy.
“It went smoothly.” Shi Yu smiled.
After the three of them finished exchanging pleasantries, the Seven Elites politely invited them to stay for dinner. When Director Li and Mentor Ding saw that the food was sumptuous, better than the canteen, they directly took it seriously.
This… The archeological Seven Elites were very confused. They ordered a table of high-level take-out and even invited a famous chef to cook. With this, in addition to the teachers coming over to eat and drink, the amount of food they could eat instantly decreased again. They were teary-eyed. They just didn’t know how many exam points they could get with one meal…
In the research institute, Shi Yu began to ask about what Senior Panda had said.
“Of course.” When Director Li heard that, he immediately laughed. Such a small matter was not worth mentioning.
“Looks like you’ve really gained a lot. Well, I’ll tell the resource bank later. You can go directly to exchange it then.”
“Thank you, Director Li,” Shi Yu thanked.
Then, Shi Yu asked curiously,
“By the way, what’s the highest level of resources in our school’s resource bank? Are there any resources with spatial attributes?”
The website that Granny Lu gave him was actually not very rich in resources. It was just a shopping website that some professional Beast Tamers often used. It had a very good reputation, was very fast in logistics, and was very safe. In terms of resources, it might not be as rich as the Ancient Capital University. For example, the website was often short on Ethereal Stones.
Shi Yu searched for insect evolution materials and was not very satisfied.
“There’s everything you need. Even if it’s a time department resource, it’s not like we haven’t had it before.” Chief Physician Li smiled and said, “As for the level of the resource, it’s at most level seven.”
“Well, the types of resources in the school’s resource bank can be seen from the school’s official website. You can borrow their account to take a look.” Director Li pointed at the group of foodies.
At the dining table, some archeological elites stuffed themselves with food. Using the name of the celebration banquet, they ordered many delicacies that they normally couldn’t bear to eat, such as 100,000 pots of lobster with weak dragon blood. They had to eat more.
“Use my account. Although I’ve graduated, I think I can still enter,” Lin Xiuzhu said after picking up a steamed bun.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
Following that, Shi Yu ate while looking forward to it. He hoped that there were suitable evolution materials in the Ancient Capital University’s resource bank.
School started in February at Ancient Capital University. At that time, he would be a new student of Ancient Capital University. If the vocation assessment ranking was high and really gave a large sum of credits, then maybe next month, he could let Buggy try to turn into a cocoon!!!
…
After dinner, Director Li and Mentor Ding left.
During the lunch break, everyone went back. Shi Yu got Sister Panda’s account and ran to the room to study it.
After Shi Yu entered the resources interface of the Ancient Capital University’s official website, he immediately searched for the resources he needed.
Screening Search: [Space] [Spirit]
Order: [Level Descending Order]
Shi Yu rubbed his hands in anticipation.
At the next moment, the page was updated.
[Name]: Nine-Tailed Illusion Fox Heart
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Level]: Level-seven resource
[Main Use Introduction]: The heart crystal of a quasi overlord-level creature, the Nine-Tailed Illusion Fox. The Nine-Tailed Illusion Fox is good at illusions. Its heart crystal is mainly used to strengthen the talent in pet illusions… (Click on all of them)
[Exchange Price]: 15,000 credits
[Remaining Number]: 1
[Name]: Tears of the Void
[Attributes]: Space
< Level > Level 6 Resources
[Main Use Introduction]: The eye of the Worm of Void that lives in spatial cracks. It’s used to increase the affinity of the pet space… (Click it all)
[Exchange Price]: 18,000 credits
[Remaining Number]: 2
Shi Yu was silent.
Alright, the resources were indeed rich and the quality was also strong, but damn, it was so expensive. Based on the ratio of credits and money, it was over 100 million!!
“But it doesn’t seem to be very compatible with its cultivation path of illusions. The level isn’t important, the compatibility is the most important. In any case, Buggy can’t completely absorb such high-level evolution material. It’s a waste. Let’s look at other things.”
The growth level and resource level of the pet were actually corresponding, representing the absorption effect. It didn’t necessarily mean that the higher the evolution ingredient level, the better. It would overflow with a lot of energy or burst the pet, so compatibility was the most important. Shi Yu comforted himself mentally.
[Level-seven Spirit Gem], [Space Splitting Grass], [Dream Fruit], [Mirror Stone]…
Next, Shi Yu started picking them one by one. Damn it, damn it. The more he picked, the angrier he got. He wanted all of them, but he didn’t have money.
…
In the afternoon, under the guidance of the panda senior, Shi Yu arrived at the resources bank of Ancient Capital University. He planned to sell the resources first before thinking of buying anything. He smiled in anticipation.
Director Li had already contacted him, and Shi Yu did not delay. After all, there were many resources in the ruins that were unsuitable for prolonged storage. It was better to take action as soon as possible.
On the clean streets of the school, Senior Panda walked in front with Shi Yu beside her. Suddenly, Senior Panda seemed to have thought of something and exhorted, “Shi Yu, be polite later.”
“Oh, the teacher in charge of the resource bank is very strong?” Shi Yu could not help but be curious when he saw Sister Panda reminding him.
Senior Panda crossed her arms and frowned. “Indeed very strong.”
“Top-notch master?”
“It’s higher than that.”
“Legendary-level?” Shi Yu stopped in his tracks. No way.
How many treasures were there in the resource warehouse of Ancient Capital University that a legendary Beast Tamer had to watch over?
But even if they didn’t have those treasures, would anyone dare to rob them?
It was not a big deal for a legendary Beast Tamer to be a principal. But it was too generous to manage a warehouse…
“Not really.”
The panda senior smiled and said, “It’s an overlord.”

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - Buggys Dragon Aura
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Buggy’s Dragon Aura
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
What?
Overlord level?
Shi Yu: “???”
Shi Yu suspected that he had heard wrong.
This didn’t seem to be the level system of a Beast Tamer…
It was for a transcendent creature!
Awakening, transcendent, commander, monarch, overlord, guardian, myth. There were seven major growth stages for transcendent creatures. The overlord was at the fifth stage!
“He’s not human?” Shi Yu fainted.
“Yes.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded. “Teacher Yao is a gem cat.”
Shi Yu: “???”
“Is it the gem cat I know?”
< Name > Gem Cat
[Attributes]: None
[Race Level]: Low-level transcendent
[Race Skill]: Gem Eye (Levelless Skill)
[Introduction]: A cat-type transcendent creature that can complete evolution through various Cat’s Eye Gems.
Weren’t gem cats a low-level transcendent race?
If Shi Yu’s impression wasn’t wrong, according to the current records, the gem cat with the highest racial level was only a high-level commander race. It wasn’t as powerful as Buggy.
How did this pet grow to the overlord level!
“Which legendary Beast Tamer’s pet is it…” Shi Yu asked curiously.
“Not a pet,” Lin Xiuzhu said, “but an ownerless overlord creature.”
Shi Yu: “???”
As she walked, she introduced it to Shi Yu.
“This started more than 100 years ago.”
The suggestion started with the Mythical Era…
“At that time, the seven human countries formed an alliance.”
“In order to show their friendliness, the countries gave each other some special pets of their own countries.”
“That’s when the gem cat was introduced into the country from other countries.”
“At that time, Ancient Capital University had just been established. Because the principal liked cats very much, she raised dozens of cat-type pets on the school campus. This was considered a special scenery for Ancient Capital University at that time.”
“The students can see all kinds of cat pets on the lawn and in the corners casually.”
“Teacher Ying was one of the gem cats at that time. It was also the oldest gem cat.”
“It seems that the students and teachers at that time liked this gem cat very much, so they wanted to collect a good quality Cat’s Eye Gem and give it to it to help it evolve.”
“But no one expected that this gem cat is very special. It can’t complete evolution through the Cat’s Eye Gem.”
“Although it can’t evolve, this gem cat likes gemstones very much. It has no intention of returning the gift it has gotten. Every year on its birthday, it will receive a Cat’s Eye Gem as a gift.”
“Ten years later, it obtained a Cat’s Eye Gem necklace… It became the richest transcendent creature in Ancient Capital University.”
“Then?” Shi Yu was at a loss. That worked?
The panda senior had a strange expression. “Then, the turning point came. A hundred years ago, a mystic realm of the totem era appeared. The disaster of the undead erupted in the ancient capital. The ancient capital University was the first to bear the brunt of it and was swept into the disaster.”
“Many students and pets were in danger. At this moment, this gem cat, which was like a stray cat, completed its evolution through more than ten Cat’s Eye Gems. It obtained more than ten high-level skills of different attributes and even super-level skills, leading some students to complete the counterattack…”
“From then on, it became the guardian of Ancient Capital University. It stayed for a hundred years and sent away batch after batch of students and teachers. To this day, it’s said that its growth level has already reached the overlord level.”
“???” Shi Yu was stunned on the spot.
It was ridiculous!
Are you sure this growth experience is an ordinary gem cat and not a mythical creature cub?
Lin Xiuzhu shrugged and said, “When I first heard this story from my senior, I was at a loss for a long time… But everyone says so, so maybe it’s true.”
“Although it has never had a Beast Tamer, it is indeed a guardian of Ancient Capital University. It has been living on the campus since the school was built a hundred years ago.”
“At that time, it was the wealthiest transcendent creature in Ancient Capital University. It’s the same now, because it’s managing the resource warehouse here… It received the salary of a guardian for decades and bought a warehouse of gem collections…”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. It was better not to know where to start complaining.
A gem cat that had grown into an overlord?
For pets like the Gem Cat, as long as they had the rare resource “Cat’s Eye Gem”, they could obtain different racial skills according to the type of gem and complete evolution.
But one thing could be proven. A gem cat could only complete evolution through one Cat’s Eye Gem in its lifetime. But this one from the Ancient Capital University, it completed evolution through more than ten pieces at once? It obtained more than ten racial skills?
This didn’t make sense!
This talent… was too strange.
“In short, when the time comes, don’t treat it as a stray gem cat to play with and tease. Be more respectful, more respectful,” Lin Xiuzhu warned.
“Understood!” Shi Yu nodded heavily. What was the point of petting cats? He was petting pandas…
Wait, wait!
“You just said that this overlord-level gem cat has more than ten high-level skills with different attributes, and even super-level skills?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Yes.” Senior Panda nodded.
“If I can’t touch it, can I greet it by shaking its paw…”
Lin Xiuzhu: “?”
“I’m just kidding. What abilities does it have? Did it get them from the Cat’s Eye Gem?”
“I’m not sure either… I only know that it can clone itself, use psychic abilities, and Teleport.” The panda senior shook her head.
“I see…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He had never seen an overlord-level creature before. More than ten high-level skills sounded very replicating…
If it could use Psychic and Teleport, it meant that this Teacher Ying had spiritual and spatial talents??
However, this was not what Shi Yu was most concerned about.
What caught Shi Yu’s attention the most was the words “different attributes”. It was its racial skill as a gem cat, the levelless Gem Eye!
Skill: Eye of the Gem
[Level]: None
[Introduction]: The racial skill of the gem cat can allow the eye to evolve and become a special structure that can absorb the power of the cat’s eye gem. It’s a rare special racial skill without any concept of proficiency.
Gem Cats evolved through this skill, similar to Green Silkworm and Dragon Carp.
They could absorb the power of the Cat’s Eye Gem through the Eye of the Gem and obtain skills of different attributes.
However, the difference was that the Eye of the Gem skill could not increase proficiency. There was no concept of proficiency, and it could only fuse one gem.
Therefore, there was a limit to the gem cat’s evolutionary potential. No matter how good the quality of the cat’s eye gem was, they couldn’t absorb it perfectly. The gem cat evolution form of the highest race recorded was only a high-level commander.
However, the gem cat from Ancient Capital University was definitely super…
At this moment, Shi Yu was curious. Was this gem cat’s Eye of Gem skill relatively special, causing it to mutate?
For example, it could increase proficiency and absorb more mutations such as the power of the Cat’s Eye Gem.
But even if it wasn’t a mutation, if he replicated the skill Gem Eye, could he teach his pet and increase its proficiency?
Shi Yu was more curious.
This was the same as the Worm Silk and the Leaping Dragon Gate. It was a skill that could change the pet’s talent in attributes. Moreover, it had no attributes, which meant that the compatibility could satisfy most pets.
If Eleven learned the Eye of the Gem and absorbed the power of a Time-Element Cat’s Eye Gem, even if it couldn’t complete its evolution like the Gem Cat, as long as it perfectly absorbed the power of the gem through this skill, it would be equivalent to it obtaining a time talent. It would be like the perfect level of worm silk that could change attributes.
In other words, this was a basic skill that could change a pet’s compatibility with different attributes… Shi Yu was wary.
In the future, if there were any skills that he really wanted to teach Eleven and the bugs but didn’t have enough compatibility, he might be able to use this method to change their corresponding talent.
…
Soon, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the resource warehouse.
The Ancient Capital University’s Resource Chamber was just like a tall neighborhood. It was huge.
At the entrance, there was a small house that looked like a security room. Inside, a big, soft, doll-like, white cat with a V-shaped head and smooth fur was hugging a pillow to sleep.
After sensing that someone was coming, it patted the bed with its fluffy tail and slowly opened its eyes, revealing eyes that were like blue gems in the sky. Then, it slowly got up and shook its body, stretching the hair on its neck that was like a “scarf”.
“Wu ~ ~” It yawned and jumped onto the window sill. At this moment, Shi Yu and the others happened to walk over.
“Teacher Ying!” Sister Panda greeted with a smile.
“Hello ~” The white gem cat continued to nap lazily and spoke in human language. Its voice was like a mature mature mature mature woman with a lazy voice.
“Are you a new student?” The big white cat glanced at Shi Yu, who was carefully observing itself behind Lin Xiuzhu, and asked.
School had yet to start at this time. During the holidays, there were basically no new students. However, Shi Yu had already greeted the Archeological Department in advance and came through the back door. It didn’t matter.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Then you guys go in.” It took a sip of water and continued to turn around and return to the bed.
“I’ve already informed my clone.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Lin Xiuzhu immediately pulled Shi Yu into the place to collect resources.
“Are all of these managed by its avatars?” Shi Yu asked.
“No, but it’s a holiday now. The other teachers are on leave, so it’s the only one here.”
Then, under Lin Xiuzhu’s lead, Shi Yu and the others saw another cat that was identical to the gem cat just now.
Clone skill…
This was also a high-level skill. It was a little similar to an illusion, but it could only create its own clone.
At entry level, one could only create phantom clones.
At the proficiency level, he could create a physical energy clone, and he could have the same skill as his main body, which was his attribute weakness.
After this skill’s proficiency was high enough, its tactical value was actually very high. However, at the moment, Shi Yu temporarily didn’t have any need for this.
“What do you want to sell?” The big white cat stood in the courtyard and signaled for Shi Yu to take out what he wanted to sell.
“These…” Shi Yu touched the ruins bead on his neck. In the next second, countless resources were placed in the courtyard.
The mountain-like pile of resources and ice-element energy crystals made the gem cat’s expression darken.
It glanced at the ruin bead on Shi Yu’s neck and felt its head hurt. This new student was not simple.
There was actually spatial equipment.
However, why were they all trash resources, and there were so many of them!!
“Meow!!!”
The original Ying was making an annoyed sound too.
The other employees weren’t around either. It had to do the calculations itself and categorize and collect them!!
“Hee.” At this moment, when she saw the headache on Ying’s clone, the panda senior smiled imperceptibly.
Before setting off, she had also inquired about it. Didn’t Shi Yu want to sell resources? Why did he come out empty-handed?
Immediately after, Shi Yu showed her the Ruins Bead, making Lin Xiuzhu fall silent for a long time.
Then, Lin Xiuzhu asked Shi Yu how many resources he had to sell. When Shi Yu mentioned hundreds of types, Lin Xiuzhu had already expected the situation in front of him.
This cat preferred simple transactions. For example, if Shi Yu sold a Nine-tailed Fox Heart, it would definitely trade happily. However, it had always been blind to low-level and large numbers of trash resources because it was too troublesome to recover and the work was too cumbersome.
“Wait for me.” Its face fell.
Soon after.
The pile of low-level resources that Shi Yu took out was estimated.
The resources collected by Shi Yu from the Island of Trials, excluding the Dragon Soul Grass, were worth about 1,200,000.
As for energy crystals, due to their pretty good quality, they were worth about 25 million.
In total, there were more than 26 million worth of resources. Shi Yu sold them all in one go.
From then on, the only valuable resources left were the Ice Dragon Whisker, Dragon Soul Grass, and Ethereal Spirit Stone.
26,000,0000!
Shi Yu was overjoyed. 260 divine beans! Even if it was a high-level skill, it could be used nearly 200 times!!
What did this mean?!
It represented three high-level skills!!
Initially, Shi Yu only had two million yuan in savings and was about to become poor. However, after this, he became rich immediately and gained some freedom.
Of course, if he wanted to finish all of them, Shi Yu estimated that it would be difficult to do without at least a year or so. Constitution and money were the greatest enemies that limited his points.
“I’ve taken away the resources. Your money will be in the account in two hours.”
“Alright, you can leave now,” the big white cat said with a headache after sending the reclaimed resources to different places.
“Wait, Teacher Ying, I still want to buy three sets of Moonlight Powder,” Shi Yu said.
Moonlight Powder, a level-three spiritual-type resource, was used to neutralize and match the Dragon Soul Grass. Shi Yu had already investigated it clearly. Wasn’t this perfect for Buggy?
At that time, it would master the deterrence skill with the nature of the dragon’s might. Its current frost dragon phantom would be even more completed.
As for the evolution materials for Eleven and Worm, Shi Yu was really helpless at the moment. He would wait for the vocation assessment and the reward for discovering the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution to be transferred to the account.
“Buy resources?”
“That’s the job of the other clone. You guys go and find it.” When the big white cat heard that, it immediately waved its paw lazily and started chasing people away.
Shi Yu and Lin Xiuzhu: “???”
Are its clones still divided into each other???
…
Next, after spending more than 200,000 to buy three bottles of Moonlight Powder, Shi Yu and Lin Xiuzhu left the resource area.
“Senior, thank you for leading the way.”
After coming out, Shi Yu thanked her.
After recognizing the way this time, he could come by himself next time.
“No problem.”
Lin Xiuzhu smiled and said, “Spatial equipment, more than 20 million yuan. Most of it was obtained from the ruins in Ping Cheng, right? You’re a little rich now.”
When he thought of how Shi Yu wanted to borrow money to buy the iron-eating beast cub half a year ago, Lin Xiuzhu felt that it was unreal.
This growth speed and earnings speed was too unscientific!
“20,000,000 isn’t enough to buy Eleven a pair of evolution claws.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly.
Lin Xiuzhu covered his mouth and smiled. “I think the evolved form of the Iron-eating Beast should still be called the Gold-Eating Beast.”
Shi Yu smiled. This naming style was too much. After Buggy evolved, would it be called the Gold Swallowing Butterfly?
Iron-eating Beast Research Institute.
After walking around the resource bank, Shi Yu and the others returned.
Just as he returned, Shi Yu discovered a message on his cell phone.
The results of the survival assessment in the vocation assessment were out.
Although Shi Yu had already known the results in advance, most of the candidates only officially knew now.
However, at this moment, among the more than 6,000 candidates in various places in Ancient Capital City, only 700 were in a good mood, while the remaining thousands wore painful masks.
They had fallen off the rankings… They would have to wait another year.
Apart from the results, they were also informed of the subsequent assessment procedures.
The final ranking battle would be held in the Ancient Capital Arena in the Beast Tamer Association of Ancient Capital City tomorrow.
At that time, relevant personnel from major media, universities, and businesses would come to watch the battle.
Among them, the audience had all adopted an internal invitation system. No passers-by could come to the venue to watch this rule just by buying tickets, so only a few relevant institutions could see the ranking competition.
Most unrelated people could only wait for the official announcement of the assessment rankings and subsequent news editing. They couldn’t see the details of the battle.
But even so, there were still thousands of spectators present.
This was because the candidates participating in the vocation assessment also had special benefits. They could be relevant personnel and watch the subsequent assessment. If the candidates who fell off the rankings also went to watch the assessment, the number of spectators would immediately increase.
“Want to watch the battle?”
Shi Yu stared at the electronic invitation on his cell phone and shook his head.
Forget it, it didn’t mean much.
“The next ranking battle will continue for three days. The top 16 of the 700 plus candidates will be decided, and then the final ranking battle with the 16 seeded candidates…”
“In other words, I have three days to prepare.”
After Shi Yu returned to the room, he thought about it. Compared to watching the battle, it was better to prepare for battle.
For example, he could use these three days to help Buggy absorb the Dragon Soul Grass and then assist it in raising its deterrence to the proficient level. That was the extent of the damage.
He should just add a high-level skill as soon as possible. It shouldn’t affect his condition, right…
…
In the ruins pearl.
At this moment, after selling all the resources, the place became much quieter. Only Eleven and the food of the bugs were left.
At that moment, the two pets were practicing Soaring Sky and bullying tactics.
They planned to use the combination of the two tactics.
This Wuji Airlines tactic’s greatest flaw was that its accuracy wasn’t enough, and its opponent would easily be able to dodge.
In that case, as long as they used deterrence together during the fall to deter the enemy from moving, wouldn’t that be fine?
This was inspired by the profundity of Shi Yu’s swordplay!
Precision Strike! This wave was invincible!
“Stop for a moment.”
Looking at the huge pit on the ground, Shi Yu looked at the Eleven and Buggy with a dark expression and patted his forehead.
“Wuu!” “Ji!!”
Seeing that the Beast Tamer had come in, the two pets quickly came over and begged Shi Yu to prepare a match for them to use their dual battle tactics.
It wasn’t that they felt that the joint attack strategy was very powerful, but that they wanted to take a picture together.
There was no point in taking many pictures together in a one-on-one battle, but using a joint attack strategy of “Wuji Airlines” and “Bullying” could show their tacit understanding!
“Alright, as long as you guys are happy,” Shi Yu said indifferently. At the same time, his heart ached for the opponent of this tactical experimental subject for a second.
This strategy was very dumb, but the pets that used this strategy was very strong, so it would cause the opponent to be very desperate.
But as long as Eleven and Buggy were happy, this was not a problem.
“But Buggy, is your deterrence still a bit weak?”
Buggy:???
What a big truth.
Eleven nodded silently. It was indeed a little lousy.
It felt like it was the one doing all the deterrence, like Buggy wasn’t doing much.
“Ji!” Buggy looked at the leader with tears in its eyes.
What happened to being a bully together?
In the end, it wasn’t using force to suppress others, but its own teammate?
Shi Yu and Eleven nodded. Wasn’t that what it meant now?
“Ji—” Seeing that the Beast Tamer and the leader said this, Buggy shed tears. Didn’t it just learn it a while ago…
What could it do?
“Hehe, then let’s take advantage of the time and improve.”
With that said, Shi Yu smiled and took out the golden Moonlight Powder and the preserved Dragon Soul Grass.
“Ji! Ji!”
The worm that was originally feeling aggrieved immediately lit up when it saw the Dragon Soul Grass.
It was the Dragon Might Grass!
Can it use it now?
“Yes.”
“Let’s try the effect first, but it might be very difficult for you to control the deterrence during the process. Eleven, you have to suppress its deterrence later to prevent the worm from losing its mind and going berserk.”
Buggy shook its head. No, no, no.
Please believe in its willpower!
“It’s not a matter of willpower or not. This is a level-three resource. The energy intensity is very high, and it’s almost level four…” Shi Yu found clear water to soak the Moonlight Powder. Soon, the bowl of clear water turned pale yellow.
“Wuu!” Eleven patted its chest. Teach it.
Even if it was the might of a True Dragon, it couldn’t stir up any waves in front of it.
“There.”
Next, Shi Yu followed the instructions he had found and let Buggy drink the Moonlight Water.
After the worm gulped it down, Shi Yu handed it a Dragon Soul Grass.
“Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh.” After taking the Dragon Soul Grass, Buggy quickly ate it.
Then, they widened his eyes and waited for a reaction.
“( ?皿 ?メ)!!!!” A moment later, Buggy’s brain was stunned.
It suddenly felt a violent force surging in its body.
It showed a painful expression. A huge mental wave erupted from its body, forming a substantial spiritual deterrence. It was clearly a silkworm, but its deterrence wave seemed to have turned into an azure dragon at that moment.
“Roar!!!”
Due to the huge power contained in the Dragon Soul Grass, the deterrence effect of the Dragon Soul Grass at this moment combined with the spiritual deterrence of Buggy itself… Started forming an even stronger pseudo dragon’s might. Intense energy kept leaking.
Fortunately, Eleven was standing beside Buggy at this moment, letting the monarch aura wrap around Buggy’s aura so that its aura wouldn’t affect Shi Yu.
“(? _ ?) Ji!!!” Buggy cried. It was indeed a little out of control.
Now, Buggy felt that its deterrence was like a wild horse that had escaped its restraints and was running continuously.
“Steady, steady, the effect of the Moonlight Grass hasn’t taken effect yet.”
Shi Yu comforted it. After a moment, the moonlight water that the worm had drunk at the start finally had a special effect. The spiritual fluctuations of the Dragon Might and the worm began to slowly fuse.
At this moment, Buggy’s expression eased.
After another two minutes, Buggy finally controlled his aura. It opened its eyes in confusion and unknowingly broke out in sweat.
“How do you feel?”
Shi Yu asked, “Is there anything uncomfortable about this?”
“Ji.” Buggy shook its head.
Then, it looked up in despair at Eleven, who was releasing its king’s aura, which was also an expert level deterrence. It kept feeling that even after it was strengthened, its deterrence still broke at Eleven’s deterrence in an instant.
Eleven’s deterrence just now was like a big hand covering it, preventing it from really going berserk…
“Ji!!!” The bug released its deterrence again.
Boom!!!
The invisible spiritual deterrence hit Eleven’s almost physical king’s aura like a drop of water sinking into the ocean.
Worm: Σ (° △ ° | |)
“〈( ?) ?)〈Wuu.” Eleven took a look at the Dragon Soul Grass and Buggy and shook its head silently. As expected, it wasn’t as powerful as the point upgrade power of a Beast Tamer!
What dragon might? It was all fluff.
Skill proficiency was the way to go!
Buggy :”…”
Buggy was silent, finally realizing this.
Why wasn’t this dragon might as powerful as he imagined?
“Ji! (Shi Yu, increase points!)” In the next moment, Buggy pushed aside the Dragon Soul Grass and Moonlight Powder and looked at the Beast Tamer in anticipation.
Forget it, It should choose to believe in Beast Tamers.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Who asked you to use deterrence to compete with Eleven? The nature of the Dragon Might is to better perfect the Ice Dragon Phantom…”
Shi Yu’s face darkened, but he still took out the divine bean and stretched out his hand to increase points. He planned to increase the deterrence of the worm to the proficient level first.
Then, he would let Buggy use the remaining two portions of Dragon Soul Grass…
A moment later.
[Skill]: Deterrence / False Dragon Might (Proficient)
After adding the points, Shi Yu sat beside it weakly, holding a thermos.
Damn it.
The high-level skill was too damaging. It was still alright now, but he definitely couldn’t increase it randomly before the competition, or else even with supplements, he wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
Shi Yu didn’t want Eleven to really push him onto the stage in a wheelchair.
This definitely didn’t match the style of the edited survival trial. It affected one’s character profile.
He had to take one path to the end. As long as he wasn’t embarrassed, everything was fine.
“Ji!!!” This time, after deterrence reached the proficiency level, Buggy released deterrence again!
Boom!!!
This time, it was no longer an invisible deterrence. The green spiritual wave hit Eleven’s almost physical king’s aura domain like a green dragon. Then, it was like a drop of water that sank into the sea again without any ripples.
Worm: Σ (° △ ° | |)
Eleven: (ーー ?)
There was still a level difference.
Shi Yu speechlessly looked at the bug that wanted to use deterrence to defeat Eleven. Although it couldn’t defeat Eleven, the ice dragon that was formed from this proficient pseudo-dragon might shouldn’t be too weak even if it didn’t use the Ice Dragon Whiskers.
Most importantly, he felt that he could really use this silkworm as a dragon now.
At that time, he would directly make Buggy become an ice dragon during the summoning process. Then, it would release dragon might when it came out. He felt that even if it was a commander rank creature, it would be scared away if it wasn’t careful.
“Alright, the dual deterrence has been achieved. I hope the next opponent won’t faint and lose the courage to attack.” At this moment, looking at the deterrence confrontation between Worm and Eleven, Shi Yu looked forward to the next ranking battle and felt that he was a little closer to first place.
Target: Honor (Rewards)!

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - The Video Came Out and Shi Yu Ran
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: The Video Came Out and Shi Yu Ran
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In order to face the ranking battle in three days, Shi Yu made the final sprint…
In fact, it was just increasing the frequency and recuperating.
As for the 31 opponents he might face next, Shi Yu chose the most brutal way to understand them.
That was the gossip information that passed the assessment forum.
The assessment arrangements were too tight, and there was not much time for each candidate to investigate potential opponents and prepare. It was already not bad to know the opponent’s pet race, Beast Taming Talent, and pet skills in advance.
For example, long-term preparations to learn targeted skills and nurture targeted new pets wouldn’t appear in the vocation assessment.
Perhaps only a world-class competition was worth the effort of a player to snipe someone.
Shi Yu felt that his skill index was a very good sniper rifle. If he was really determined to target a certain Beast Tamer, he felt that he was invincible. For example, if he faced a Beast Tamer who was proficient in fire-element skills, he would arrange a fire escape skill for each pet. How would the other party play?
However, even for Shi Yu, who had the skill index, the investment was relatively large. Ordinary people really couldn’t afford to do this.
Apart from Shi Yu, the other candidates were also making various preparations with the countdown of three days.
…
In a study in a villa area in Ancient Capital, Yin Zhengfan lowered his head to face his father. He didn’t dare to look into his father’s eyes and waited for criticism.
“Do you know where you lost?”
After returning, Yin Chuanqi asked Yin Zhengfan about all his experiences in the survival assessment. Yin Zhengfan didn’t hide anything and reported everything, including how he lost to Shi Yu before the assessment ended.
This was his only loss in this assessment. Actually, it couldn’t be considered a loss. After all, it didn’t affect the assessment. However, for Yin Zhengfan, it was still a little difficult to accept. This was because both Yin Legend and himself had very high expectations.
Legend Yin Zhongrong wrote calmly. On the other hand, Yin Zhengfan had a stubborn expression and said…
“Using the Sky Crystal Butterfly to challenge the opponent’s trump card, I underestimated the opponent’s strength. But I don’t think I’ve lost completely. The goal of this battle is to train the Sky Crystal Butterfly in the first place. I won’t lose in the next ranking battle.”
Yin Chuan said, “What if I say that when you guys fought, he hadn’t even used half of his strength.”
The Perfect Level Thunder Palm displayed in the video, the unknown level deterrence… When fighting Yin Zhengfan, Shi Yu used neither. Moreover, that transcendent-level Green silkworm with transcendent worm silk was also very powerful.
These were all things Yin Chuanshi knew, but Yin Zhengfan didn’t.
Yin Zhengfan’s expression changed, but he quickly said, “I’ll still win.”
Yin Legendary nodded and said, “Let me tell you one last piece of information. Shi Yu only became a Beast Tamer half a year ago. The time he contracted the Iron-eating Beast is less than half a year. While it could be said you two are in the same age range. It seems like he took a huge advantage of his age. But the one who really took advantage was you, who started cultivating and nurturing pets since you were young. The reason why I asked you to participate in the vocation assessment now is not because of age, but because of cultivation time. Only then will there be a meaning in competing with others on the same stage.”
“Alright, go and prepare. If you can defeat him this time, I’ll give you a gift.”
Yin Chuanqi waved his hand, indicating for Yin Zhengfan to go down and cultivate.
On the other side, Yin Zhengfan was suddenly at a loss. How was this possible?
Didn’t that mean that the time he spent cultivating the Sky Crystal Butterfly was far, far longer than the time Shi Yu spent cultivating the Iron-eating Beast?
It wasn’t the unequal battle he imagined. Instead, judging from the cultivation time, Shi Yu had been at a disadvantage the whole time?
How was it possible for that Iron-eating Beast to…
“Who is he…”
“You can go now.”
Yin Zhengfan left in disappointment. Yin Legend looked at the five words he had written.
Bureau 11, Shi Yu.
After watching the battle on the cruiser, he was also deeply curious about Shi Yu. Then, he investigated.
This investigation shocked him.
He had an ordinary identity and background, but he had such ridiculous strength. So he was related to this organization.
Recalling the few Monster Beast Tamers in Bureau 11, Legend Yin shook his head.
“To be able to listen to the Voice of History and spy on history, this talent is not necessarily worse than the Beast Taming Space’s strengthening talent, or even better. Whether it’s that Green Silkworm or the Iron-eating Beast, it looks like they obtained quite a lot of benefits from the ancient ruins.”
Yin Legendary was originally worried that no opponent of the same age could pressure Yin Zhengfan in the vocation assessment, but from the looks of it, there was no need to worry. For a long time to come, Yin Zhengfan would have sufficient growth motivation.
There had never been a lack of geniuses in this world, but only those who could stand out from the many talented people had a chance of charging into the highest domain.
…
On the other side, Yu Shu was also being educated by a middle-aged woman who was sitting on the sofa, smoking a cigarette holder and had her hair permed.
“How did I give birth to a stupid son like you? How could someone else snatch that Dragon Soul Grass?”
In the face of his mother’s disdainful expression, Yu Shu’s face darkened. “A frost dragon, do you know what a frost dragon is?”
“It doesn’t matter if it was transformed or not. It’s just like the real thing.”
“What Frost Dragon?” Yu Shu’s mother was also a top-notch Dragon Tamer, so she naturally didn’t believe in such nonsense.
Even if her son was exaggerating, she was still indifferent.
“That’s the Illusory Phantom skill. At least at the proficient level. It’s a transformation completed with the help of high-level resources. It’s at least a level-six resource. Can you be more careful in the future before the battle?” Yu Shu’s mother rolled her eyes.
He was actually so silly as to let others wear divine clothes and trick him.
“Illusion? How do you know?” Yu Shu asked in surprise.
“Don’t worry about that.”
“I…” Yu Shu’s heart skipped a beat. Expert Level Illusionary Phantom? That skill that could strengthen the battle power of the illusion with the help of external forces?
What the f*ck! His expression darkened, and he had the urge to slap himself. So Shi Yu couldn’t afford to go against him! He actually needed external help!
It was one thing to borrow it as a support item, but it was actually a resource at least level-six! Shameless!
It wasn’t that he couldn’t afford equipment of this level for pets. It was just that due to the restrictions of the rules, he didn’t care.
“Just you wait…” Yu Shu said, feeling stifled. The ranking battle’s assessment only allowed pets and Beast Tamers to bring equipment below level three. When the time came, Shi Yu couldn’t smile anymore.
This rule was also the reason why Shi Yu did not place his hopes on Buggy’s Ice Dragon Phantom.
“Why do I feel that you still can’t defeat it?” Yu Shu’s mother sighed. Even if the other party was restricted by the rules during the competition and couldn’t send out Buggy, she heard that the strength of that iron-eating beast seemed to be even more ridiculous.
Her silly son didn’t seem very smart… In short, there were too many monster candidates this year. She didn’t expect Yu Shu to get first place. It was fine as long as he got into the top five.
…
It wasn’t just those who had interacted with Shi Yu. Those seeded candidates who had never interacted with Shi Yu and believed that they could break through from more than 700 candidates to the final ranking battle were all investigating the information of potential opponents.
In the blink of an eye, a day later.
In the Ancient Capital City, in the Beast Tamer Association building complex, in the Ancient Capital Arena.
More than 700 candidates stood neatly in the venue.
The surrounding audience seats were filled with thousands of candidates who had already been eliminated.
Apart from that, the recruitment personnel of the major corporations, the instructors of the admissions office of the nine major universities, the officers of the Beast Taming Troops, and the major media were all gathered at various places in the venue.
These 700+new professional Beast Tamers could be said to be the most outstanding batch of new Beast Tamers in Ancient Capital and dozens of second-tier cities around.
Next, they would be paid attention to by the various large institutions in the ranking battle segment. After that, they would encounter the crazy struggles of the various large factions. This was the pinnacle of their lives.
Under the light of the cameras, Master Qu Jie stood on the stage with a smile and looked at this batch of new professional Beast Tamers.
“Congratulations to everyone present for officially becoming professional Beast Tamers. Our examiners have witnessed your performance in the field survival trial. No one can doubt your excellence. I hope you can never slack off in the future and start a new glory in the Beast Tamer domain.”
“A total of 784 Beast Tamers have passed this vocation assessment. Next, you will undergo the final ranking battle. This assessment will also determine your strength ranking among the newly promoted Beast Tamers!”
“By the way, among these 784 people, a total of 16 seeded candidates won’t participate in the assessment ranking segment, so the 768 candidates present will first carry out the ranking competition, and after the top 16 are determined, you will carry out the final ranking battle with them.”
As soon as Master Qu Jie finished speaking, the 768 newly promoted Beast Tamers present immediately started discussing.
Although there were strong seeded candidates in every vocation assessment, most candidates would think that on what basis weren’t they chosen to be these sixteen candidates?
Whether there was a conspiracy or not, whether or not it would be unfair… Many people still had this thought.
“It’s about to begin.” Many people stared at Master Qu Jie.
However, as a seed candidate, while there was preferential treatment to not participate in the preliminaries, they had to bear a certain amount of pressure. For example, the pressure of his abilities being directly exposed in public.
On the high platform, Master Qu Jie said, “Before the ranking battle officially begins, the Ancient Capital Beast Tamer Association’s official website has updated the exciting episode of the candidates for the survival assessment segment of this batch. The main characters of the video are the seeded candidates chosen this time. Before the assessment, everyone can admire the elegance of this batch of candidates.”
“Next, the big screen at the arena will also play it on repeat.”
Whoosh!!
After Master Qu Jie said that, the people from the various domains, as well as the new professional Beast Tamers who were about to participate in the ranking battle, were suddenly more engaged.
Everyone waited for a long time. Weren’t they waiting for the assessment situation of the seeded candidates in the survival assessment segment?
The outside world couldn’t pay attention to the assessment situation in real time like the examiners. This was the only way to understand the examinee’s bearing in the third assessment.
“I want to see how powerful the seeded candidates are…”
“Ridiculous. I contracted a pet of a middle-level commander species. I’m actually not a seed candidate even though I got fifteenth for the first test?”
The new professional Beast Tamers were all in different moods.
Then, more than 700 new professional Beast Tamers dispersed on the spot and waited for the ranking assessment to officially start in half an hour.
At this moment, no one went to rest. After a few scattered people went to pee, they immediately ran back and stared at the big screen in the venue.
Why was it that others were seeded candidates but not him? It could be determined in this exciting event.
…
At the training ground of the battle club at Ancient Capital University.
The students from the other departments had already gone on holiday, but the batch of students with top battle power who specialized in battle between the battle club and the school team of Ancient Capital University was still preparing for the national competition. With their opponent being the geniuses of the other eight top educational institutions, they didn’t dare to relax for a moment.
However, there was still some time to rest.
“Eh!!”
“The promotional video for this year’s Ancient Capital vocation assessment has been updated. Do you want to see it?” A boy who was resting with a towel around his neck suddenly shouted at everyone.
“Perhaps our future juniors will be inside.”
On the training ground, White Brook, who was the vice president, exited her beast-eared girl form and turned to look at the member.
“The promotional video of the vocation assessment…” She recalled Shi Yu, who Senior Lu had introduced to her. That guy’s performance was indeed not bad. He was fourth in the basic test. He would probably be edited into the promotional video this time.
White Brook’s interest was piqued. She planned to see Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast’s performance in the wilderness survival assessment segment.
…
At the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute, when Shi Yu was still lying in bed and resting, Jiu Yingjie exploded. He gathered around and shouted for Senior Panda.
“The promotional video for the Ancient Capital vocation assessment has increased. Shi Yu is a seeded candidate, right? He must have been cut in. Everyone, come and see.”
“Where’s Shi Yu?”
“I think he’s lazing in bed again.”
“Forget about Shi Yu, come quickly.”
…
In Ping Cheng, Bamboo Stone Dojo, including Master Lin Hongnian, all the disciples of the dojo had also discovered the news. It was no secret that Shi Yu had run to the ancient capital to participate in the vocation assessment, so they naturally had to pay attention.
Not only them, but also President Feng of the Beast Tamer Association in Ping Cheng. As his secretary massaged his shoulders, he smiled and stared at the computer screen, intending to see Shi Yu’s dazzling performance. After all, Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer in Ping Cheng.
At this moment, the exciting collection of survival trials released by the Beast Tamer Association in Ancient Capital City could be said to have instantly attracted the attention of countless people.
In less than two minutes, the number of viewers online had exceeded six digits, and the number was still rising.
At the start of the video, when the screen was still dark, passionate background music sounded.
As a promotional video, accompaniment was a very important part. Even before they saw the video, the Beast Tamers watching the video felt their blood boil.
Boom!!
With a loud bang, an image appeared.
The first thing that entered his eyes was a woman in a black silk qipao with a slit. She held a book in her left hand and flipped through the pages with her right hand as she walked. At this moment, the ground in front of him shattered. A ten-meter long Ground Legged Centipede that looked like steel and had a ferocious face crawled out of the ground. This was an extraordinary creature of a low-level commander race. It loved to eat humans the most and was a demon in the eyes of many Beast Tamers.
After the Earth Legged Centipede appeared, the woman raised her head and glanced at it slightly. In the next moment, a dazzling light descended. With a boom, a bolt of lightning descended from the sky. The terrifying lightning pillar was like a heavenly punishment. It instantly penetrated the Earth Legged Centipede’s body and scorched its entire body. At the same time, a huge pit ten meters in diameter appeared where the lightning landed.
The woman gently put down the book, and a black cloud flew to her side. The two of them walked towards the scorched Earth Legged Centipede step by step.
“This person is the second in the basic test, Zhang Qianyi with the elemental coordination talent. That’s a high class commander species Thunder Cloud Sprite!!”
At that moment, seeing this scene, in the Ancient Capital Arena, the thousands of meters candidates looked at the destructive power caused by the lightning in silence and felt guilty. They felt that even if their pets went up, they would also be instantly killed!
“The power of the lightning is so strong… and the control is also strong…”
The video had only just begun, but it had already used an explosive scene and a beautiful young lady to attract the attention of the viewers. The video immediately made many people fall into it. As Zhang Qian approached the Ground Legged Centipede, the scene lit up and changed. The music’s tempo became faster, and directly appeared in the Sky Battlefield. Yu Shu rode the Soul-Attribute Bone Dragon and easily dueled more than ten transcendent-level Tempest Sparrows in the air.
“Roar!!!!”
In the video, the Soul-Armored Bone Dragon let out a dragon roar. The terrifying Soul-Armored Dragon Breath suppressed the storm that filled the sky and swallowed many Tempest Sparrows in an instant. Then, the scene shattered. A huge rock giant was locked in a spatial domain. After the scene shattered to the point where the space shattered and turned, the huge rock giant’s body directly shattered into pieces. A light butterfly flew up from the broken rock and onto the young man’s shoulder.
The scene kept changing. Next, it gradually played the exciting performance of each seeded candidate, making the spectators involuntarily hold their breaths as they watched the promotional video seriously.
One by one, they watched the video. Every frame gave these new professional Beast Tamers and candidates who had fallen off the rankings a strong feeling. The seeded candidates were so strong.
Moreover, this batch of seeded candidates had a very diverse development style. There was even a Gu Master who controlled a beast tide. He specialized in defense against the anti-injury black Tortoises that could kill ferocious beasts with just a beating. Animals, plants, elements, undead, no matter what type of pet they were. These seeded candidates were incomparably calm on the island of training as if they were strolling in their own backyard.
“Damn, so awesome.”
“We’re actually from the same batch?”
“Monsters, this group of people.”
“It’s right not to let them participate in the preliminaries… I don’t want to bump into them.”
Many newly-promoted professional Beast Tamers stared at the scene in the video with their mouths agape. Why was it that they had worked so hard to survive on the Island of Trials and carefully searched for hunting targets, but these people could kill indiscriminately in the same place??
However, one way or another, the promotional video was indeed very shocking. As the background music became faster and faster, everyone was about to realize that the most exciting moment was coming.
“Here it comes..!”
Countless people shouted in their hearts. Then, the background music reached the most exciting moment. The video suddenly changed…
A figure riding an Iron-eating Beast, holding a wooden sword, and a green worm hanging from its shoulder appeared.
“What’s this…”
This scene stunned many people.
Why did it suddenly become like this?
A glitch?
Everyone was extremely confused. Some people also recognized Shi Yu.
However, even they were stunned when they saw Shi Yu’s attire.
Then, what stunned them and everyone else came.
On the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu’s expression was indifferent. He raised the wooden sword with both hands and swung it down!
“Boom!” Instantly, the air vibrated, as if a translucent crescent sword qi (insect silk) was formed. A path was directly cut open in the forest in front of them. In the next second, more than ten stone baboons walked out and looked at Shi Yu with reddened eyes.
“F*ck, what the hell!!!”
This attack stunned many new professional Beast Tamers.
Facing the Stone Baboon group in front of him, the candidate, Shi Yu, was still indifferent.
Facing the attacking group of baboons, the iron-eating beast took a step forward. At that moment, Shi Yu raised his wooden sword again and faced the stone baboon that was charging over with its stone claws.
At the same time that they attacked, Shi Yu also attacked.
Profundity, great shock!
At that moment, the group of baboons that flew over seemed to have encountered a great horror. They revealed looks of horror, and their movements were several times slower. Shi Yu swung his sword, and instantly, an extraordinary-level stone baboon’s body caved in as it flew more than ten meters away!
Just like that, the Iron-eating Beast slowly walked forward. One, two, every time Shi Yu swung his sword, a Stone Baboon would be sent flying like a flying meteor.
Even if some stone baboons immediately turned their bodies to stone to resist, they were still shattered by a single slash. They were no match for the other party.
In a short moment, the stone baboons fled. The candidate, Shi Yu, leisurely entered the forest.
During this process, the wooden sword didn’t show any changes. Shi Yu’s movements were extremely coordinated, as if it was a group of baboons that he had killed himself.
The people watching the video opened their mouths wide, unable to react.
The video… continued. It was impossible for every candidate to only have one exciting performance. There were sixteen seeded candidates, and each of them had three or four exciting episodes. The video kept playing. After a slight silence, the video returned to normal. However, not long after, at the most exciting moment, another scene of Shi Yu riding an Iron-eating Beast appeared…
Profundity: Thunder Flash!
Lightning flashed on Shi Yu’s body and sword. His figure teleported and his sword pierced through the Mad Python.
Profundity: Infinite Convergence!
Shi Yu threw out a wooden sword. The scene changed, and dozens of wooden swords instantly appeared in the sky. They obeyed Shi Yu’s command to cut down the bees.
It was like a shooting star, killing everything in the endless path it carved.
Shi Yu was riding a panda and holding a wooden sword, and he was indifferent to life and death and would fight any beast he saw.
When the video was completely broadcasted, everyone had already been brainwashed and had completely forgotten the exciting performance of the other seeded candidates. The only thing left in their minds was the scene of Shi Yu riding the iron-eating beast and slashing with demonic nature. The scene was completely unlike that of a beast tamer.
Did something strange happen…
