The seeded candidates who were also watching the video had dark expressions, especially Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan. Their values were the most broken. They kept feeling that the Shi Yu they knew was different from the one in the video…
Ping Cheng, Bamboo Stone Dojo.
At this moment, the values of the apprentices who contracted the iron-eating beast shattered. They didn’t understand what was going on.
What happened to the exciting performance of the iron-eating beast?
Lin Hongnian was silent. His balls hurt.
After President Feng of the association finished watching the video, his body stiffened. Even his secretary couldn’t massage him anymore.
Lu Qingyi, who was somewhere, took a deep breath. She put away the cell phone and rubbed her eyes.
At Ancient Capital University, the beast-eared senior who had once taught Shi Yu life-saving skills was left in endless confusion.
Looking at Shi Yu’s impressive performance in the video, Senior Panda and Jiu Yingjie were also stunned!
This was Shi Yu?
That was Eleven?
Excuse me, what were they doing?
What the hell was this? Why was it different from what they imagined!!
“Holy shit.”
As the video played on repeat, the entire Ancient Capital Arena no longer had the atmosphere of the assessment. Everyone recalled the video just now in confusion. Gosh, sounds rose and fell, mainly because there were a total of 16 seeded candidates. Everyone only saw the scene when Shi Yu appeared. They couldn’t understand it at all!
Oh, divine beasts in heaven… Who could explain what happened to them?
A special Beast Taming Talent similar to the Fusion Talent? Or was that wooden sword also a pet?
Why were the other candidates using their pets to kill the enemy? This candidate could kill everyone himself…
“How did he become like this…” Among the newly-promoted Beast Tamers, Bai Qi, Xu Jingyin, and the others, who were also from Icefield City and had once competed with Shi Yu for the Evolution Sacred Spring, also knew Shi Yu. However, they were stunned because they knew him.
It was fine if the difference in strength was increasing, but why was the difference in style also increasing?!
Similarly, the cousins who had lost to Shi Yu in the battle restaurant and even the passers-by on the plane who had fought Shi Yufan were all shocked.
“That’s not a Beast Taming Talent at all, and the wooden sword is not a pet at all…”
“It’s that green worm that looks like it’s lazing around and the iron-eating beast that’s its mount…” Just like how the master examiners could tell the truth, there were also some experienced master-level Beast Tamers present who could tell the truth at a glance. Their faces couldn’t help but darken.
What kind of weird candidate was this!!!
Often, the truth wouldn’t be hidden for long. In a short period of time, the video comments area had already been flooded. A group of big bosses analyzed the key points of the hidden technology of this video.
[Damn, this candidate is ridiculous!]
[That Iron-eating Beast has mastered Transcendent Level Hardening, so it can apply the Hardening Material to Beast Tamers and wooden swords, making the Beast Tamer’s physique and wooden sword’s attack power enough to injure transcendent-level ferocious beasts!!]
[There’s even a perfect-level Thunder Palm. This is a move that can release powerful speed!!]
[Not only that, but that Iron-eating Beast probably also mastered the deterrence skill. The expression of fear produced by those ferocious beasts when facing attacks is too similar to the effect of the deterrence skill!]
[Is this a f*cking Iron-eating Beast?]
[The most ridiculous is that green worm. I took a screenshot. There’s one scene where it’s definitely silk spitting, but I can’t see the worm silk. Holy shit, transparent worm silk, do you know what it represents? It’s a worm silk with an invisible nature! It’s another transcendent skill! Ridiculous, that sword aura is actually a worm silk, and the one controlling the wooden sword to slash randomly is also a worm silk! Holy shit, worm silk can even be played like this…]
[Big bosses, slow down…]
At this moment, because of Shi Yu, everyone analyzed the technical content in Shi Yu’s battle images. This analysis not only shocked the candidates, but even some masters and top-notch masters fell into deep disbelief.
Although apart from deterrence, he used skills without levels, skills that were at low-level, and mid-level… This skill proficiency was too exaggerated.
Moreover, it appeared on weak species pets like the Iron-eating Beast and the Green silkworm. How did he do that?
The most shocking thing was that although the pets were clearly so strong, why was it that the battle scenes of this Beast Tamer were all him playing cool?
Was the destruction of conscience behind all this, the fall of pets, or the distortion of human nature?
Even before the ranking battle began, the major media outlets in Ancient Capital City had already captured the hot topic and published news.
“Master Level Analysis! The scary truth hidden in Iron-eating Beast Knight Shi Yu’s battle skills!”
‘I’ll take you into the inner world of Iron Eater Knight Shi Yu!’
“Shocking! Iron-eating Beasts and Green Silkworms can actually be used like this!”
“The collective action of the various major film academies! Several film hegemon corporations looking for one person! What exactly is the reason behind all of this? Let’s lead everyone to understand.”
At this moment, countless people were watching Shi Yu’s video with strange expressions. After hearing the masters analyze the technical content of Shi Yu’s battle and watching the video again, many candidates had a new feeling.
So powerful.
It could actually assist a weak human Beast Tamer to instantly kill transcendent-level ferocious beasts. Its support was so strong.
However, what confused people the most was why Shi Yu could be so calm and not show any embarrassment!!!
At this moment, it could be said that Shi Yu was completely famous.
Many people were looking forward to Shi Yu’s performance in the final ranking battle.
At that time, would Shi Yu still fight using his own body?
Although the process was a little bumpy, after the big bosses’ analysis, everyone suddenly realized that this Shi Yu was an even more ridiculous monster hidden among the candidates!!
At this moment, Shi Yu was still sleeping soundly.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In his sleep, Shi Yu only opened his eyes in a daze when he heard someone knocking on the door.
“Who is it?”
“Open the door.” Outside, the stifled laughter and discussion of Senior Panda and the others sounded. “Quickly open the door.”
“What, what’s wrong??” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Junior Shi Yu, impressive. You’re famous. I’m certain that even if the evolution of iron-eating beasts won’t skyrocket the value of Iron-eating beasts, the Iron-eating Beast Knight definitely can!” Zheng Yingjie laughed wildly.
“???” Shi Yu immediately woke up. His heart skipped a beat. He quickly picked up his cell phone and had a bad feeling.
A moment later, Shi Yu swiped the promotional video of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment and a pile of comments below the video.
After taking a look, his temperature suddenly rose, and his vision turned dark. However, he quickly stabilized himself.
“Where is he?” Lin Xiuzhu was still knocking on the door.
As for Shi Yu, he silently rolled up the blanket and kept rolling around on the bed. F*ck, this day had finally come. If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have messed up.
“Don’t look for me. See you after the vocation assessment.”
A moment later, Shi Yu found a cap and a pair of sunglasses. He entered the ethereal state and directly passed through the wall to leave. He chose to run. He couldn’t meet anyone he knew. When the commotion stopped and everyone calmed down, he would return…
…

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - The Final Ranking Battle Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: The Final Ranking Battle Begins
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Although he said that he didn’t care, Shi Yu still felt a little sad when he saw his exciting videos.
“At that time… Why didn’t I prepare more?”
Until now, Shi Yu still stubbornly believed that their cooperation was pretty cool.
Sword kinesis, wasn’t this more handsome than beast taming?
But the problem was that his clothes and behavior didn’t match at all.
He was riding a panda and wearing a panda short-sleeved shirt. He was using a wooden sword to fight the enemy, so he looked a little strange.
What Shi Yu wanted the most now was not to delete the video, but to regret not wearing some strange clothes back then.
If he were like other candidates and wore some strange clothes, the contrast might not be so high now.
“Learn from this lesson. Be careful next time.”
Shi Yu turned off his cell phone and found an empty place to enter the ruins.
At that moment, he only wanted to enter a weakened state through adding points to numb his brain. Then, he wanted to hold on until the competition began..
He had agreed not to add points, but Shi Yu didn’t want to go anywhere now.
…
Ancient Capital Arena.
Although the exciting episode of the survival assessment just now was very interesting and worth analyzing, the most important thing now was still the assessment.
As the assessment time arrived, battles had already begun everywhere in the venue.
For a time, the sounds of battle in the huge venue shook the sky and earth, and the roars of pets were endless.
“Roar!!!!”
“Wuu!!!”
In any arena, extraordinary creatures with outstanding races could be seen fighting each other.
At the various rings, examiners stood solemnly at the side. Among these new vocations, only a few could control the battle situation well. Most of the time, the examiners and judges had to judge the winner.
“Excuse me, can I interview you?”
After an examinee left the assessment area, they were immediately pestered by the media.
The various media outlets began to look for candidates for interviews.
Only a reporter team walked pessimistically among the audience, looking for something.
“No, no. Looks like Shi Yu didn’t come.”
After the survival trial ended, the female reporter and the cameraman who interviewed Shi Yu were abnormally regretful.
She remembered how she said to “delete this part”. The female reporter wanted to slap herself.
How could they know that the random passerby they found would be the super hot topic examinee in the future…
“Ahhh—”
It was not only them. At this moment, many financial groups and even other top-level institutions were searching for Shi Yu.
Although Shi Yu had already decided to enter the Ancient Capital University’s Department of Archeology, they had to at least try to get him.
These were adults, after all. If they couldn’t get Shi Yu, that meant one thing… Their offer wasn’t good enough.
Currently, the 16 seeded examinees were the main targets of the various large factions.
Of course, the remaining 700 or so examinees were also not to be missed.
On the first day, the ranking assessment was carried out in full swing.
In a remote corner not far from the arena, in the ruins bead, Shi Yu silently added points to recuperate.
The next day, the ranking battle reached its most intense moment.
Shi Yu was still lying flat and resting.
On the third day, excluding the seeded candidates, the top 16 of the ranking battle were announced.
Shi Yu finished increasing his points and the recuperation ended.
He was like a wuxia cultivator in isolation from the outside world. He would occasionally go out to eat and look at the progress of the ranking battle on his cell phone. As for his own news, Shi Yu didn’t click on it at all.
“Alright…”
Shi Yu browsed through the information on the candidates who advanced as well as the seeded candidates.
There were a total of 32 people. There seemed to be 30 people who had commander-rank pets?
Only he and a Gu Master named Miao Dongdong had transcendent pets.
However, although Miao Dongdong’s pet was of a transcendent race, it parasitized the corpse of a monarch species creature. It was also a cheat.
After seriously reading the current known information, Shi Yu began his final preparations.
After three days, Eleven didn’t change much, but the changes in Buggy weren’t small.
Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Worm Silk (MAX), Absolute Sleep (expert), Illusory Phantom (expert+4), Deterrence / False Dragon Might (proficient), Super Sight (proficient), High Speed Healing (proficient)
Shi Yu also taught it super vision and high-speed healing.
High-speed healing and supervision were both intermediate-level skills. With supplements, the pressure to teach wasn’t high unlike high-level skills.
During the ranking battle, due to the restriction of the rules, Buggy couldn’t use the Ice Dragon Whiskers. It could only use a level-three ice-element energy crystal that Shi Yu had bought. However, using this and transforming into an Ice Dragon wouldn’t be able to unleash much strength.
It was probably only within the medium range of the commander race.
This way, even with Eleven protecting it, if it encountered any accident… Buggy would be in great danger. After all, its physical fitness was really weak.
Therefore, for the sake of the worm’s safety, Shi Yu arranged for it to have super vision and high-speed healing skills. He even specially upgraded them to the proficiency level. After all, entry-level skills definitely had many flaws and weaknesses, so they were easy to counter.
With more skills, Shi Yu felt much more at ease.
…
Until August 10.
Shi Yu only appeared at the most critical moment of the professional assessment ranking battle.
This time, he changed into a black and red battle suit, even wearing a black cap and black sunglasses. His aura changed drastically.
Now that he was a celebrity, in order to not be harassed by the reporters, he should pretend…
“Uh, you are…”
In the examination candidates’ passageway outside the arena, the security personnel looked at Shi Yu with a stunned expression. Why was he dressed so strictly?
“…” Shi Yu took off his sunglasses slightly, took out his candidate certificate, and showed it to the other party.
The security personnel immediately widened his eyes as if he had seen his idol.
“You’re Shi Yu…”
“My eight-year-old daughter likes your performance! Please do your best for the assessment.”
“I’m curious. Are you still going to fight today’s assessment yourself?”
Shi Yu: “???”
Shi Yu: “???”
Today was the last day of the ranking battle assessment.
According to the rules, the top 32 contestants today were to have their ranking completely determined!
There were several battles in a row without any rest.
After a battle every day, they would have to rest for a day or two. This was showbiz.
There was no need for such a performer in the professional field. Though, what was needed was an elite Beast Tamer with strong resistance abilities. Without stamina and energy eight times a day, it was as if one had kidney deficiency and would not be suitable to be a professional Beast Tamer.
After all, if another disaster really happened in the future, professional Beast Tamers would face high pressure. No ferocious beasts would give the enemy sufficient time to rest.
However, in order to be relatively fair, after every battle, professional medical staff would still provide supplements, medicine, and treatment services, helping examinees and pets recover to their peak state as much as possible.
“Have you seen Shiyu?”
In the arena, Zheng Yingjie, the head of the seven archeological elites, asked.
Although the viewing spots for the vocation assessment were an internal invitation system, they originally did not have the right to come, but they treated Director Li to a meal, after all…
In any case, the arena was very large, so they successfully joined the student recruitment team of Ancient Capital University.
This meal wasn’t for nothing…
“I understand. It’s social death. If it were me, I would definitely escape from Planet Blue overnight and go to the Moon to live.” Lin Yu’er smiled secretly.
She really wanted to know how Shi Yu had suddenly escaped from the research institute… He was too good at it!
“He said he’s already here.”
Senior Panda looked at the message on her cell phone and said, “He should be in the prep room.”
“As long as he’s still alive. I thought Junior had taken his own life.” Qi Yingjie and the others nodded.
It was not a big problem if he could still participate in the final assessment.
As the saying went, youth was wasted if you didn’t do stupid things. Everyone had gone through this before, so they understood.
With that said, everyone looked at the surrounding audience and discovered many important figures.
Although the ranking battle of the vocation assessment was essentially a competition, the current atmosphere was not like that of a regular competition.
There were no VIP guests or commentators, only candidates and examiners participating in the battle.
Regardless of the identity, background, or strength of the audience, they would find a place to watch the battle themselves.
Be it the student recruitment instructors of the nine academies, the representatives of the five major consortiums, or the officers of the Beast Tamer Corps… The members of many factions were all sitting obediently in their seats, watching the big screen in the main venue.
Among the people from the nine great academies, the audience from Ancient Capital University who came to the scene was the most important.
After all, Ancient Capital City was the home ground of Ancient Capital University. Most of the Beast Tamers who came to Ancient Capital City to participate in the vocation assessment would also choose Ancient Capital University or related businesses.
Therefore, the recruitment instructors from the other colleges were purely here to gather information and see if they could find an opportunity to scout people.
On the seats of the Ancient Capital University, the Dean of the admissions office, Lu Dongsheng, and a group of student recruitment mentors were all here. Apart from the regular customers of the vocation assessment, Dean Li of the Archeology Department, Teacher Ding, and a group of members led by the beast-eared girl White Brook also came to join in the fun.
Lu Dongsheng looked at the group helplessly. He knew very well why they had come.
“Haha, Student Shiyu was internally decided by our Archeology Department. Dean Lu, you don’t have to help other departments to dig people up. I know you have a good relationship with Old He from the Battle Department,” Director Li said with a smile.
The corners of Lu Dongsheng’s mouth twitched. He had indeed asked him to help recruit Shi Yu to the Battle faculty if he had the chance, although the chances were indeed not high.
Shi Yu’s archeological discovery of the evolution of the iron-eating beast was no secret to some leaders in Ancient Capital University.
“I know, I know.”
Dean Lu smiled and shook his head. He didn’t intend to trouble himself on this matter. The mission of their enrollment was not to serve a certain department and target a certain person, but all of them. They wanted to try to invite the 700 new professional Beast Tamers to study at Ancient Capital University.
Only if the students were outstanding enough could these top educational institutions obtain more education funds, then become more comprehensive and stronger, and finally attract more outstanding Beast Tamers. This was a positive cycle, and they couldn’t fall behind any year.
“Big Sister, is it really good to slack off to watch the assessment?”
On the Ancient Capital University side, apart from the Archeological Seven Elites and the others, some people from the battle club had also come.
Faced with the other members’ questions, White Brook rolled her eyes and said, “Who asked you to come along? When we go back, our training will be super doubled.”
Everyone: “?”
“I have to think of a way to trick Shi Yu into joining the battle club.” White Brook looked at the screen again. That day, after White Brook saw Shi Yu’s video performance, she was silent for a long time.
As expected of someone she had taught. Her battle style had been deeply imparted to him, and he was a malleable talent.
White Brook had the urge to drag Shi Yu to various places to compete after he entered school.
In any case, how could there be so many ruins for Shi Yu to explore during his university days? It was better to nurture his strength first and follow them to compete.
Well, only by nurturing Shi Yu’s battle power could Shi Yu be a better tool for Senior Lu. There was nothing wrong with that.
Apart from these people, there were also many important family members of the examination candidates.
For example, Yu Shu’s mother, the top-notch Dragon Tamer, was quietly smoking in the corridor, waiting for the assessment to begin.
There was also Legend Yin, who was very concerned about his son, standing calmly on the high platform of the venue with an old friend, looking down quietly.
Every candidate had a separate prep room.
At this moment, Shi Yu had experienced many difficulties and finally arrived at the prep room. He felt exhausted.
It was too difficult.
The pains that he had taken to come all this way… It was one thing to be wary of passers-by and the media, but why did the assessment staff also climax when they saw him?
He even said, “You’re the idol of my eight-year-old daughter. My daughter thinks you’re very handsome.” He directly forced Shi Yu to comprehend the Earth Escape skill, almost using his toes to dig out an escape path.
Shi Yu sighed slightly and looked at the supplements, medicine, and nutritional supplements filling the prep room. Then, he shook his head and finally looked at the most critical small television.
The opponent matching in the assessment had not been updated…
The other 31 candidates were probably waiting outside, looking at the big screen outside. However, Shi Yu was out of place. In order to avoid trouble, he hid in the prep room and waited.
…
8 a.m.
In the main venue, as the assessment time approached, the main examiner, Master Qu Jie, appeared again.
After he appeared, the assessment was about to begin. The thousands of spectators present looked at the big screen in the venue.
At this moment, the screen was playing the exciting battle episode of the 16 candidates who advanced in the previous ranking battle.
These 16 people were also very outstanding, not much inferior to the seeded candidates.
Those who couldn’t be chosen as seeded candidates might lack some luck, such as luck that was heavily edited by the Heavenly Eye…
After three days of screening, 752 candidates had already obtained the approximate ranking of their vocation assessment.
Today was the last day of the assessment. Among the 768 candidates at the start, the 16 candidates who had broken through the tight circle would fight the 16 seeded candidates at the start of the ranking battle.
The rules were mainly based on the elimination system. The winner would advance, and the loser would carry out the subsequent ranking competition.
At the moment, as the final cycle of the battle album ended, the scene on the screen immediately changed. 32 names appeared and constantly rolled and combined.
“According to tradition, the advancement candidates and the seeded candidates should face each other first.”
At the candidate area, Yu Shu leaned against the wall with his arms crossed and curled his lips. It didn’t matter to him. He only wanted to hit Shi Yu now.
“Huh?”
Just as Yu Shu finished thinking about it, a name suddenly appeared on the big screen, accompanied by a half-body photo.
Shi Yu!
Two big words appeared in everyone’s vision.
“It’s him?”
After discovering that the first candidate today was actually Shi Yu, everyone revealed excited expressions.
The effect of the opening assessment was explosive!
Furthermore, under Shi Yu’s square name, everyone was immediately amused when the photo of him riding a panda appeared.
“F*ck.” In the prep room, Shi Yu looked at his profile picture and his face darkened.
When would this end?
They arranged for him to be first and even used this as a profile picture. Shi Yu refused to believe that they weren’t plotting something.
However, it was indeed what everyone hoped for.
“Holy shit, it’s an Iron-eating Beast Knight.”
Towards Shi Yu, the thousands of spectators present were not unfamiliar.
The candidates who had been eliminated in the survival trial and the candidates who had completed their rankings looked at Shi Yu’s profile with complicated feelings.
After analysis, Shi Yu was indeed strong… But it was still a little painful to be weaker than such a guy.
In this day and age, not only were honest people bullied, ordinary people also had no future?
“Shi Yu…”
Now, with the appearance of Shi Yu’s name, the eyes of the remaining 31 candidates flickered. They wanted to meet Shi Yu, but they also didn’t want to meet this fellow too early.
But before they could think about it carefully, Shi Yu’s opponent’s name immediately rose up as well.
One of the 16 candidates for advancement, Han Dong.
Upon seeing this name, everyone immediately recalled his information.
Beast Taming Space level, level two.
Beast Taming Talent, Frost Strengthening.
Pet beast, low class commander species Frost Tree, high class transcendent species Ice Elemental Sprite.
In the basic test, the Frost Tree’s energy level was 1,300.
“…” At this moment, this candidate named Han Dong was standing at a corner of the venue in silence, staring at the big screen.
Speaking of which, he and Shi Yu also knew each other. On the plane to the destination of the survival assessment, the two of them were neighbors.
Now that he was facing Shi Yu, he had a strange feeling.
“Next, please head to the home ground. The assessment battle will officially begin in five minutes.” Below the venue, Master Qu Jie’s very penetrating voice sounded in the arena.
Next was the battle of the best 32 people in this batch’s vocation assessment. The judge would be personally held by him, a top-notch master. Not only did he have to ensure that the Beast Tamer was not injured, but he also had to ensure that their pets could be safe and sound.
…
“This Han Dong… the trump card is probably that high-level transcendent Ice Elemental Sprite.”
Some of the audience present began to review the battle video from before.
In the video, a frost tree stood on the arena with dozens of ice-element sprites surrounding it. The scene was abnormally spectacular.
Opposite them were opponents who had already become incomplete ice sculptures.
Although the species level of that Frost Tree was higher, that Ice Elemental Sprite was his initial pet and trump card!
The other party probably used some ice type spirit item on the Ice Elemental Sprite to let it learn the “elementalization” ability that only elemental creatures could master after commander rank. However, because of the item, it could do so before commander rank.
Elemental creatures with the ability to elementalize could be greatly immune to some attacks. At the same time, they could have better control of their own attributes. This was a very impressive talent of elemental creatures.
On the home ground, Han Dong, who was wearing a blue battle suit, had already arrived. After greeting the main examiner, Judge Qu Jie, he stood quietly at the side and waited.
“Where’s Shiyu?”
After Han Dong appeared, Shi Yu didn’t appear for a long time. The audience began to feel puzzled.
They looked at the candidate passage, wondering if Shi Yu would come out on the iron-eating beast later.
But clearly, they were thinking too much.
A moment later, a handsome young man in a black and red battle suit with clean black short hair and a calm expression walked slowly to the arena. There was nothing strange about him.
The thousands of spectators felt that it was very normal.
But because it was too normal, it didn’t match his previous style, so they felt that it was even more abnormal.
Handsome, who are you?
What about Shi Yu, who was riding an Iron-eating Beast?
Shi Yu walked to the assessment venue like a quiet pretty boy. After nodding slightly at the judge and opponent, he also quietly waited for the assessment to begin.
His whole body tensed up, and his expression was stable and expressionless. He tried his best to not say a word and not let others find any flaws.
“Cough.”
Master Qu Jie and Han Dong looked at Shi Yu, who had suddenly returned to normal with strange expressions and seemed to have no reaction to what had happened previously, and felt strange.
Not only them, but everyone from Ancient Capital University and the audience also looked at Shi Yu in silence.
What was wrong with this guy?!
“Where’s your sword?”
On the other side, Han Dong couldn’t help but ask.
He really hoped that Shi Yu would still act cool this time.
Because in that case, the pets needed to be more careful to protect Shi Yu.
With Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer, as the target, no matter how strong Shi Yu was, as long as the judge determined that Shi Yu was in danger, victory would be his.
In a normal battle, he really didn’t have much confidence. No matter how low the level of Shi Yu’s two pets was, their skill proficiency was terrifyingly high.
He was convinced that low and intermediate skills with high proficiency wouldn’t affect them.
After all, the Iron-eating Beast and the Green silkworm didn’t seem to be able to cooperate. Moreover, Shi Yu himself had the gift of telepathy, so he couldn’t suddenly increase the battle power of his pet.
But his Frost Tree and Ice Elemental Sprite were different. In addition, with his talent increase, it might not be impossible to fight.
“…” At this moment, Shi Yu wanted to say that he didn’t need to use his sword to deal with him, but these words were something an eighth grader would say. He was afraid that he would be recorded and made into an emoji again.
“Beep!!” After a moment of silence, Master Qu Jie whistled, and Han Dong’s expression became serious.
At 8: 10 a.m., the first round of the assessment officially began.
“Beep!!!” Master Qu Jie blew the whistle to open the battle beginning again. In an instant, Han Dong’s expression became even more serious. He also knew Shi Yu’s terrifying strength. The moment the battle started, the ice elemental energy around him surged, instantly activating his frost strengthening talent!
Hu hu hu!!!
Right on the heels of that, under the condensation of the snow and wind, a creature that was three to four meters tall and looked like a pine tree, but its body was as white as frost. The tree crown was fluffy like a blue ice cloud as it took root in the frozen area and appeared outside.
In addition, inside the Frost Tree, a lump of ice-blue crystalline creature that looked like a nine-pointed star floated. The Ice Elemental Sprite also revealed its figure.
Frost Tree
[Attributes]: Ice
Skills: Cold Breath, Blizzard, Snowfall, Ice Block
[Name]: Ice Elemental Sprite
[Attributes]: Ice
Skill: Snow Concealment, Clone, Self-Explosion, Ice Ray, Elementalization
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
The moment the two pets of the Han Dong appeared, the Ice Elemental Sprite, which was like a frost nine-pointed star, immediately elementalized and condensed into dozens of clones that densely circled around the frozen tree and merged into the snow. It was impossible to tell which was the real body.
On the opposite side of the Han Dong, on Shi Yu’s side, the summoning array appeared. A one-meter-tall Little Iron Eating Beast stood on the field, and a green worm lay on the head of the Iron Eating Beast. The two pets stared at the ice and snow in front of them, their expressions as calm as Shi Yu’s.
“Who can win?”
In the audience, an examinee who had lost to Han Dong looked at the venue intently.
Because he had fought Han Dong before, he knew very well how terrifying this fellow was.
There was no solution.
That Frost Tree, which seemed to have a higher racial level, was actually the charger of the Ice Elemental Sprite. As long as the Frost Tree kept creating snow and wind, the Ice Elemental Sprite that could elementalize could always have an almost immortal physique. Together with the clones and self-destruction, it made the clones charge at the opponent like a suicide squad. It was simply disgusting.
With the slowing and freezing effect of the frost, it was a nightmare for melee pets.
“Isn’t it obvious?” Another candidate sitting beside this candidate muttered.
“What do you mean?”
“Transcendent Level Hardening, Perfect Level Thunder Palm… Isn’t this a crushing proficiency? Also, you don’t really think that the proficiency of their other skills will be low, right? You don’t think that the deterrence skills displayed in the video can only deter the enemy but not cause any damage, right?” Bai Qi looked at him and said.
If not for cooperating with Shiyu’s posturing, the mental deterrence that appeared in the video would probably be enough to instantly kill all opponents!
Bai Qi, who came from Icefield City and had competed with Shi Yu for the Evolution Sacred Spring, whose initial pet, Wings of Wind, was instantly killed by Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast’s monarch aura, looked at the arena with a mocking gaze.
With the charger’s support, a large number of clones self-destructing tactics that could allow unlimited revival?
It was alright to deal with ordinary candidates, but against a monster like Shi Yu…
On the venue.
The candidates had just summoned their pets.
Facing the powerful combination of the Frost Tree and the Ice Elemental Sprite, Shi Yu was still expressionless. Eleven and Buggy were also extremely calm.
In the next moment, Eleven raised its head slightly and looked at the Ice Elemental Sprite and the tall Frost Tree. Buggy closed its eyes slightly and yawned.
This seemingly ordinary action suddenly caused the ice and snow around the Frost Tree and the Ice Elemental Fairy to change shape!
Wu wu wu wu!! The cold wind that was still howling just now seemed to be whimpering at this moment. It was extremely chaotic!
Boom!!!
In an instant, a huge mental deterrence spread from the Little Iron Eater and the Green silkworm. At this moment, a huge frost dragon phantom seemed to have formed behind them!!
“Hou!!!!!!”
Buggy directly conjured the dragon’s might of the frost dragon. The terrifying spiritual deterrence wave was almost physical. On the dragon’s might, there was an even more terrifying spiritual deterrence, like a roaring tsunami, covering the sky and covering the earth around the dragon’s might, pushing it towards the ice and snow ahead…
Buzz!
In the next second, two fused spiritual deterrence suddenly swept across the Frost Tree and nearly a hundred Ice Elemental Sprites. Then, with a bang, the venue shuddered from the thunderclap. Countless Ice Elemental Sprite clones exploded. The snow and wind triggered by the appearance of the Frost Tree and Ice Elemental Sprite almost instantly returned to calmness, and the venue was instantly peaceful.
Shi Yu raised his head slightly and looked at the extremely weak Frost Tree, which was unable to move anymore, and the remaining Ice Elemental Sprite that fell weakly onto the tree. He knew that the victory and defeat had been decided.
He took another look at Han Dong with an explosive expression and finally looked at Master Qu Jie, who was slightly agape.
“Can I go now?” Shi Yu asked.
The aura of an expert level deterrence!
Coupled with the frost dragon’s dragon might!
This kind of ice-type creature was not a match at all.
After a moment of silence, Master Qu Jie looked at the speechless Han Dong and nodded.
“Shi Yu advanced in the first round of the assessment!”
As soon as he finished speaking, Eleven and Buggy’s figures disappeared on the field. They were summoned back to the Beast Taming Space by Shi Yu. Then, Shi Yu’s expression was calm as he slowly left the field under the shocked expressions of thousands of people.
It was completely different from what everyone imagined the Panda Knight to be.
At this moment, everyone suddenly recalled the battle just now and couldn’t help but show shocked expressions.
Sixteen elite Beast Tamers who had advanced from more than 700 new professional Beast Tamers… He couldn’t even last one round against one of the seeded candidates, Shi Yu, and were insta-killed?
“King’s aura?”
“That’s… Dragon Might?! How is that possible!!”
At this moment, the venue erupted.
“He… He… He…” The Archeological Seven Elites pointed at Shi Yu in a daze. Expert-level deterrence, dragon’s might? What was going on?
“Calm down.” Sister Panda learned about it earlier than everyone else. Eleven was expert level in deterrence, and Eleven had mastered it before the transcendent level. As for Dragon’s Might… Shi Yu had told her about the use of the Moonlight Powder.
After all, only a small number of people knew about the aura of a monarch. At this moment, as Shi Yu displayed this godly skill of demolishing weaklings, many master-level figures fell silent again. The members of the Battle Club from Ancient Capital University were almost collectively shocked. There were also 30 other candidates whose pupils constricted.
Among them, only a small portion of the seeded candidates quickly recovered their calm after being shocked by the expert-level deterrence. Obviously, they had ways to resist. It was just Han Dong, so of course he was insta-killed.
At this moment, in the noisy venue, Shi Yu’s footsteps were even faster.. From this match, he had to quickly correct the stereotypes these people had of him… With the image of Panda Knight gone, he wanted to take the Newcomer King persona in the ancient capital!

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - Wuji Airlines Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Wuji Airlines Is Here
“It’s so difficult…”
In the candidate passage, Shi Yu could not hold it in anymore after arriving.
It was too difficult to pretend to be aloof!
He still liked to chat with his opponent before the battle and communicate with them. After the battle, he would shake hands with his opponent’s pet to show his friendliness.
Pretending to be cold and aloof didn’t fit the overpowered character setting.
In the passage, Shi Yu rubbed his face with both hands.
He was too tense. He should relax first.
“Shi Yu…”
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded. Shi Yu’s face immediately tensed up again.
He looked beside him mechanically and turned around with a calm expression. “What’s the matter?”
It was a tall and sturdy middle-aged woman in a floral dress. Shi Yu saw the examiner’s sign on her chest and understood her identity.
“I’m one of the examiners of this vocation assessment and also a medical staff member of this ranking battle.”
The auntie grinned and looked at Shi Yu in appreciation.
“Follow me, I’ll take you to the treatment.”
She was also one of the nine master examiners this time. She had been paying attention to Shi Yu since the third assessment.
It was rare to see such a beautiful young man who was not restrained by trifles and had changes in personality. This reminded her of her first love.
“…Thank you, but no need for now.”
“My pet didn’t suffer any injuries or consumption in this battle. It just needs to recover with the nutritional supplements in the prep room.”
Shi Yu sensed the enthusiasm of the master examiner and immediately said that he would definitely do it next time.
“I see.” The medical examiner was rather regretful.
It seemed like it. Shi Yu was not injured at all in this battle.
“Don’t you need to look for that Han Dong?” Shi Yu asked.
“That makes sense.” The examiner was stunned, then nodded and said, “Then I’ll wait here for him to come.”
Shi Yu :”…”
In this day and age, the people who should be taken care of the most were taken seriously.
Why?
However, at this moment, Shi Yu kept feeling that he had missed an opportunity to encounter a rare healing ability…
But it didn’t matter. It was still enough to injure Eleven in the next battle.
Eleven in the Beast Taming Space:???
…
Inside the venue.
The audience was still in shock.
Regarding the strength of the seeded candidates, the info might be limited to video.
But Han Dong and the other advanced candidates were ruthless people who killed their way out of more than 700 candidates under everyone’s eyes.
Then, such a big boss was insta-killed in a single move. Were Shi Yu and the others monsters?
“How can an extraordinary Iron-eating Beast master deterrence? And it’s an expert-level deterrence…”
“Isn’t the most ridiculous thing that should be that green worm? Dragon might, dragon might!”
“Moreover, judging from its aura, that green worm’s growth level has also reached a transcendent level!”
“This doesn’t make sense. How can a Green Silkworm be like this? I would even believe it if it was a young Green Dragon.”
“But one thing is for sure, it’s really similar. Maybe it’s really a dragon cub… Could it be a hybrid pet of the insect and dragon family?”
“Bullshit, there’s reproductive difficulty between the bug and dragon types, alright?”
The audience was very noisy.
The Iron-eating Beast that had mastered the aura of a monarch, the transcendent-level Green silkworm that had mastered the dragon might… At this moment, the thousands of candidates in the venue were all numb.
Even some master-level Beast Tamers couldn’t understand.
“F*ck.” In the crowd, Yu Shu’s eyes were red. Shi Yu really gave the Dragon Soul Grass to the Green Silkworm to use?
A proficient level dragon’s might… Three days, heavens!
His expression darkened. Even if Shi Yu didn’t have any high-level props, he still didn’t know how to resist the dragon might and king’s aura.
“Mom should be at the scene! I have to find her quickly to get a piece of mental equipment…”
This time, the new skills Shi Yu displayed in the video stunned most of the audience.
Yin Zhengfan and the others were a little silent, including big shots like Master Qu Jie. However, the assessment still had to continue. Being expert level in deterrence wasn’t impossible.
At this moment, the second round of the assessment connected seamlessly.
Everyone looked at the target of the second assessment.
Seed candidate Fang Ji vs advanced candidate Li Hanfei.
According to the updated rankings, Shi Yu should be fighting the winner among them next.
…
In the prep room.
Shi Yu summoned Eleven and Buggy and let them eat the nutritional supplements in the room to replenish their energy.
Eleven and Buggy each carried a bag of “snacks” and stared at the small television as intently as Shi Yu.
From here, one could also see the battle situation on the home ground. It was a live broadcast.
Although it wasn’t as clear as the real world, they could make do.
“Wuu!!!” “Ji!!”
As they gobbled the snacks, Eleven waved excitedly.
When it saw the television, it wondered if it had not recorded their performance just now.
Buggy looked forward to it too.
Also, now that they had used up power to bully others, could they arrange for the next battle to showcase Wuji Airlines?
“I don’t know.”
Shi Yu was also bored and ate the low-level supplements in the prep room like candy as if it was the most normal thing to do.
It was obvious how bottomless Shi Yu’s physique was.
“I asked… Senior Lin Xiuzhu to help. I wonder if she helped you guys film it.”
It was too ridiculous for him to take the photo. He had taken the wooden sword in the survival assessment, and if he brought a camera to the arena… He guaranteed that he would make the headlines again.
“Wu!!” “Ji!!!” Hearing that someone was in charge of filming, Eleven and Buggy relaxed.
However, in the next second, they looked at Shi Yu.
(???????) What about Wuji Airlines?
They looked at the venue. It was open-air, and the sky was blue.
This was also to give some flying pets enough space to play.
But now, it seemed that Eleven and Buggy were very satisfied.
“This strategy…” Shi Yu looked at the small television.
“It’s not impossible.”
On the screen.
A two-meter-tall, ferocious-looking, and huge red Tortoise was standing in the arena.
There was also an illusory snake floating around it.
[Name]: Anti-Injury Black Tortoise
[Attributes]: Earth, Fire
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
Skill: Thorn Fire Armor, Explosion Shield, Earth Chain, Earth Protection, Berserk
< Name > Illusory Serpent
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
Skill: Spiritual Fang, Spiritual Protection, Phantom, Spiritual Wave
Obviously, from the perspective of the pet race, this candidate was very shameless.
The Anti-injury Black Tortoise was a rare species that didn’t have active attack skills. It could only activate Enrage when it was bleeding and obtain powerful attack power.
However, although it didn’t have the ability to take the initiative to attack, its Thorny Flame Armor and Explosion Shield skills were all disgusting. Not only could it increase its defense, but as long as the opponent attacked it in close combat, it would reflect part of the attack back and deal stronger damage to the attacker.
On the other hand, in the face of the various defensive and recovery skills of the black tortoise that were far superior to the attack, the opponent also had to consider whether it could break through the defense and which party had more stamina and faster recovery speed.
After all, the Earth Chain was a skill that allowed the damage reflection technique to connect to the ground and use the power of the earth to recover its physical strength. The Earth Protection was similar to Impregnable, and it was a very comprehensive skill that increased defense…
Therefore, at the same level, very few pets could defeat the black Tortoises and injure them. Therefore, in nature, these pets had no natural enemies at all.
As for the illusory snake, it was relatively weak. However, it could attach itself to the Tortoise shell to attack the enemy. Under normal circumstances, it was impossible to catch it.
These two pets were the pets of the seeded candidate Fang Ji. At the moment, his opponent, the other advanced candidate, Li Hanfei, was extremely disgusted.
Her Mighty Strength Golden Armor Bug and the Fei Luo Vine that specialized in control skills couldn’t do anything to the black tortoise.
“Looks like this Fang Ji is going to win.”
Shi Yu couldn’t help but shake his head when he saw that the girl named Li Hanfei couldn’t break through its defense the whole time. Then, she was slowly destroyed by the anti-injury skill and the illusory snake hiding in the shell.
He couldn’t blame this candidate named Fang Ji for having a disgusting battle style. He walked the defensive consumption route, after all.
This kind of tactic was actually the easiest to crack. Just have an even higher defense and power.
Of course, it was easy to say, but most pets couldn’t do it…
Actually, there was another way to crack it.
In the end, this girl called Li Hanfei could no longer tolerate it. She directly took out a dagger and took the initiative to attack Fang Ji personally under the cover of the Vine, planning to directly control the Beast Tamer.
If one could directly attack the Beast Tamer… After all, the Beast Tamer himself could also participate in the battle. This was allowed by the rules.
However, in the previous ranking battles, very few Beast Tamers were used to doing this. Their mentalities clearly hadn’t changed completely.
This girl was one of the few Beast Tamers who took the initiative to do this. Unfortunately, the moment she approached Fang Ji, she was stopped by an invisible barrier.
The Earth Protection that injured the black tortoise could be used on all life forms standing on the ground, including the Beast Tamer himself.
After losing the first attack, Li Hanfei, who had entered the battlefield, was instantly entangled by the illusory snake flying over. She was so scared that Li Hanfei’s face turned pale.
“I admit defeat.” She didn’t want to fight anymore.
“Thank you for letting me win,” Fang Ji said to the pretty girl in front of him with a smile.
The illusory snake didn’t continue attacking.
Killing someone was against the rules. He didn’t have the habit of ruthlessly destroying a pretty flower.
“If we also attack Beast Tamers, I reckon that our next opponent will probably have to find some mental equipment at the last minute.”
Seeing this battle, Shi Yu chuckled.
Otherwise, even if the pets could defend against the deterrence, those Beast Tamers themselves would probably find it difficult to resist.
Of course, even if he knocked out the Beast Tamer himself, it wasn’t the end.
At most, it would make it impossible for Beast Tamers to use their talent to power up their pets. If the pets in the outside world weren’t dealt with, it still wouldn’t be the end of the battle.
After all, some pets that had established bonds with Beast Tamers knew who their enemies were.
Therefore, very few candidates in the assessment took the risk to attack the Beast Tamer themselves. They would win if they directly defeated their pets.
“Why don’t I use this guy to test the Ji Changkong battle strategy?” Shi Yu said.
The other party had Earth Protection and Spirit Shield skills that could be stacked to defend against Deterrence. The chances of insta-killing it were not high, at most it could cause a certain amount of Spirit damage. Since it couldn’t be instakilled, it was better to change tactics.
“Wu!!” “Ji!!!” Eleven and Buggy’s eyes lit up. They felt that it was alright!
“Eleven, prepare to be injured. We’ll receive master-level treatment later. Don’t heal all your injuries in one go after the battle.”
Eleven:???
So, its high-speed healing was just a decoration?
Eleven was angry.
…
In the outside world, the battle between the seeded candidates and the advanced candidates was especially intense.
However, the battles made the candidates discover a ridiculous fact.
One, two, three…
After seven or eight consecutive matches, there was still no candidate who could defeat the seeded candidates.
In the seventh round, the Spell Goddess Zhang Qian sent out a pet, the Thunder Cloud Sprite. Just like Shi Yu, a bolt of lightning directly completed the insta-kill operation.
In the eighth battle, Yu Shu’s Soul-Armored Bone Dragon also used a Soul Fire Dragon Breath to sweep the two pets out of the arena in one go.
When it came to Yin Zhengfan, the Zonyan Rock Beast he summoned didn’t even move. The Space Crystal Butterfly instantly killed the advanced candidate’s pet with a spatial shackle.
They were on completely different levels.
After the sixteen battles ended, all sixteen candidates who advanced were eliminated!
The thousands of candidates in the audience fell silent almost instantly.
“The candidates who advanced actually all lost…”
Many shocked voices came from the audience.
However, some people felt that it was only natural.
“It’s the same as our batch.” Zheng Yingjie smiled.
“The situation in our batch was the same.” The panda senior smiled.
As expected, these seeded candidates were still something.
This also indirectly illustrated the eyesight of these master-level examiners and the Eye of Heaven’s Will.
You couldn’t be chosen as a seeded candidate, not because you weren’t outstanding enough, but because you weren’t the best!
Unless some candidates deliberately hid their abilities, it was very difficult to fail the segment of the seeded candidates under the gaze of the Eye of Heaven’s Will.
After all, even the Phantom illusions of Buggy and Eleven’s almost passive supervision could be analyzed. The strength of these candidates was as clear to the Eye of Heaven. The skill Heavenly Eye was much stronger than perfect super vision.
…
Time flew.
The 16 battles in the first round only took slightly more than an hour, and on average, less than five minutes each.
This was still because some seeded candidates were taking their time.
Seed candidates like Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan defeat their opponents in less than a minute.
“The second round is about to begin!”
As the first round of the assessment ended, the audience was filled with anticipation.
What did this mean?
This meant that it was Shi Yu’s turn again.
Everyone wanted to see if Shi Yu was still as normal as before.
Shi Yu’s name appeared on the battle map.
This time, Shi Yu appeared very quickly.
When the candidate named Fang Ji went down from the other side, Shi Yu also came out of the passage that connected to the prep room.
The two of them stepped onto the arena at the same time. Fang Ji’s expression was serious and a little nervous.
The defense power of the Anti-Tang technique… could it defend against Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast’s skill?
Fang Ji started to do analysis.
“Even if his Iron-eating Beast’s skill proficiency is ridiculous, it’s still a pet of a middle-level transcendent race.”
“Even if the Anti-Injury Black Tortoise doesn’t use any skills, it might not be a problem to stand and let the Iron-eating Beast use hardening below expert level on it.
“Besides, it’s not like the Anti-Injury Black Tortoise doesn’t have skills. The Thorn Fire Armor and the Explosion Shield are both Intermediate-level skills that it has trained to the proficient level. In addition to the Earth Protection… and its elemental resistance strengthening talent, they might not necessarily be able to break through the defense…” Fang Ji analyzed in his heart.
His analysis made him believe it himself.
The difference wasn’t that big.
However, although that was the case, Fang Ji still felt some pressure when he saw Shi Yu walk across him expressionlessly.
Considering that the rules allowed them to directly attack the Beast Tamer himself, he didn’t dare to analyze it too fully. His Beast Taming Talent might not necessarily be activated. This depended on whether Shi Yu would attack him directly like that girl, and whether his two pets could help him block the deterrence!
“Beep!!!”
After seeing that the two candidates were ready, Master Qu Jie took a deep look at Shi Yu and blew the whistle again.
There was no chance. Fang Ji had no hope for this battle.
Perhaps the professional-level candidates didn’t understand.
But these master-level Beast Tamers were very understanding.
In the survival trial, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast used the profundity combination skill of Hardening and Thunder Palm!
Just this alone could easily penetrate the defense of the black tortoise.
Now, the only thing worth being curious about was the Iron-eating Beast’s own defense.
Because even if the Iron-eating Beast could injure the black tortoise, it would also have to bear a huge backlash.
This was what was strongest about the Black Tortoise the most.
“Roar!!!”
The whistle blew, and Fang Ji and Shi Yu summoned their pets at the same time.
On Fang Ji’s side, there was a red black giant Tortoise and a gray, transparent, and illusory snake.
On Shi Yu’s side, it was naturally still the simple-looking Eleven and the green worm on its head.
Now, no one dared to underestimate the combination of the Little Iron Eating Beast and the Green Silkworm.
This batch of candidates was too unscientific. Shi Yu’s two pets had really broken everyone’s understanding. They didn’t understand how they were cultivated.
At the start of the battle, both parties were in a stalemate. No one attacked first.
At this moment, an unexpected scene occurred.
“Wu!!”
“Ji!!”
Staring at the cautious Tortoise in front and the shameless snake hiding in the shell, Eleven and Buggy denounced together.
“Wu!!”
“Ji!!”
“Damn, so that’s how Iron-eating Beasts make noises. So cute.”
Many spectators were stunned. They looked at the fat Iron-eating Beast. It was difficult to imagine that such a cute pet could instantly kill an opponent of a commander race with one deterrence.
“The cry of the green worm is also interesting.” Some candidates couldn’t help but smile when they saw the green worm.
“Who said it wasn’t a green worm? Its cry was exactly the same as the green worm.”
Although he didn’t know if this was really a green silkworm, it immediately looked like a green worm. Its cry was also a green worm, so he called it a green worm.
However, how was Shi Yu going to fight this battle?
Many people stared at the arena, wanting to see how Shi Yu would crack this Tortoise shell.
“Aren’t you attacking?”
Fang Ji smiled.
Shi Yu remained silent and looked at Eleven and Buggy.
In the next second, Buggy closed their eyes slightly.
In the instant that Buggy closed its eyes, just like in the first round, something ridiculous happened on the field again.
Everyone realized that every time this green worm closed its eyes, nothing good would happen.
For the first time, as it closed its eyes, a dragon phantom hit the arena to release dragon’s might.
At this moment, the second time it closed its eyes, a pile of white light spots suddenly condensed and materialized on both sides of the Little Iron Eating Beast.
In the blink of an eye.
The Little Iron Eating Beast formed a pair of white wings.
Fang Ji was stunned.
Then, under everyone’s stunned expressions, a metal-eating beast actually swayed its wings on its back and flew up.
“Wu!!”
“Ji!!”
Eleven and Buggy were extremely excited.
“Holy shit.”
“This doesn’t make sense.”
“What’s going on?”
Many candidates looked at the Little Iron Eating Beast that kept rising into the sky and were extremely confused.
Fang Ji opened his mouth slightly. After being stunned, he was a little confused.
What was he doing?
Air battle?
However, his Anti-Injury Tortoise and the Illusory Snake were not pets that took the initiative to attack. Was there any point in fighting in the air?
They looked cautiously at the little metal-eating beast that was flying higher and higher.
One second, two seconds, three seconds… After more than ten seconds, the Little Iron Eating Beast disappeared.
Fang Ji: “?”
“Roar?” “Hiss…” The black tortoise and the illusory fish couldn’t help but stick their heads out to take a look.
Then, confusion.
What was the meaning of this?
“Letting your pet leave your side, do you want to leave the stage first?”
Fang Ji did not want to know what Shi Yu meant anymore. After he reacted, he realized that there was not a single pet protecting Shi Yu. He immediately gave the order.
He made the illusory snake attack Shi Yu directly, just like the previous one.
Although Shi Yu had no effect on the battle, and had only a talent in telepathy, the current problem was that Fang Ji really didn’t know what to do without attacking Shi Yu!
At the same time, he also wanted to force Shi Yu’s two pets to appear by attacking Shi Yu.
“Hiss!!”
Following the Beast Tamer’s command, the illusory snake was just about to attack when the sky seemed to collapse.
A terrifying mental pressure suddenly pressed down, scaring the illusory snake into quickly entering the defensive state. The black Tortoise was also instantly shocked. At the critical moment, its four skills were activated, using the Earth Protection to wrap itself and the illusory snake.
With the Earth Protection and the Spirit Protection, no matter how terrifying the deterrence aura descending from the sky was, under the continuous ripples and the difficult resistance that almost shattered the defense, the two pets finally didn’t suffer too much mental damage. It was just that their bodies were shocked until they couldn’t move and were a little soft.
Similarly, it included Fang Ji himself.
Since he wanted to attack him, Shi Yu did not stand still.
Some of Eleven’s deterrence directly pressed onto him. Even if Fang Ji had protection to increase his mental resistance, his brain instantly became dizzy and he almost fainted.
This was enough. The current Fang Ji could not use the elemental resistance talent at all.
“You dare to attack me without buying any mental defense equipment?” Shi Yu thought.
At this moment, everyone discovered that the Little Iron Eating Beast’s figure appeared in the sky again.
But at this moment, the way it appeared shocked everyone.
Where were your wings, your wings? And the green worm??
In the sky, a one-meter-long little Iron-Eating Beast the size of a metal lump directly gave up its wings at an unknown height and jumped down with its super vision.
At the same time, through deterrence, the enemy could not move and was locked on accurately!!!
The black dot grew bigger and bigger.
Fang Ji raised his head with difficulty.
Then, his eyes widened.
Eleven’s falling speed was still very fast. At this moment, Eleven’s speed might even exceed the explosive acceleration brought by the Perfect Level Thunder Palm!!
“Holy shit, what’s this? He jumped down?”
At this moment, everyone was shocked. They didn’t expect the Green Silkworm to fly into the sky with the Iron-eating Beast just to jump down.
However, at this moment, sensing the hardening Iron-eating Beast that fell like a black meteor, everyone understood the destructive power of its jump.
At this moment, the black tortoise and Fang Ji had no time to react.
It popped its head out of the shell and looked at the illusory snake that had fallen but was unable to move due to the deterrence. It immediately let out a pig-like cry.
Sensing the fear of the illusory snake, although it had its defenses, the tortoise was also stunned to the extreme.
It had been attacked by different enemies for so many years, but it had never seen such an attack pattern.
Boom!
Soon.
In an instant, the Little Iron Eating Beast that fell from the sky directly smashed into the Anti-Injuring Black Tortoise. The transcendent Level Hardening and the Tortoise’s Anti-Injury Defense Skill made contact, and dazzling light immediately blossomed between the two…
Crack…
A terrifying shock wave spread out. With the Tortoise as the center, the arena immediately cracked open. With a bang, a huge hole several meters in diameter formed. The Little Iron Eating Beast and Tortoise were instantly buried in dust and gravel!!
The commotion was as if a demolition team had gone berserk.
Thump.
At this moment, the earth protection that protected the black tortoise and the deterrence of the iron-eating beast disappeared from Fang Ji’s body at the same time.
His eyes widened. Because his legs were still weak, he sat on the ground in shock.
He quietly looked at the collapsed arena in front of him.
A moment later, Eleven, who had mostly recovered and only had a little injury, crawled out excitedly from the smoke.
“Wuu!!”
Although the fall hurt so much, it felt so good. Smashing people was much better than simply hitting the ground during training.
Right now, seeing that the little Iron-Eating Beast had crawled out unscathed while his own pets were still in the smoke, Fang Ji was dumbfounded. He sensed that both pets had fainted from the heavy injuries!
At this moment, all the masters fell silent.
Especially Master Qu Jie, whose mind had been raised to the extreme. His mouth was slightly agape as he looked at the messy venue. He was a little confused.
He was certain that all the Masters had guessed that Shi Yu would use the Thunder Armor Profundity Art to break through its defense and injure the Black Tortoise.
However, what the hell was with using gravity to accelerate and directly hardening it!!!
This was a battle tactic that a normal Beast Tamer could think of???
Moreover, the most ridiculous thing was that with such a huge impact, even if there was hardening protection, it had to at least respect the anti-injury skill of the black tortoise!
Everyone looked at the lively and jumping Little Iron Eating Beast and felt their stomach hurt. They didn’t understand. Was this a f*cking Iron Eater?
“Wuu!”
At this moment, the Little Iron Eating Beast raised its head.
Everyone also looked up and saw the Green Silkworm slowly falling from the sky.
“Ji!”
It was indeed slow. Because it used the worm silk to make a parachute in the sky, it fell much slower than Eleven.
The huge parachute was formed by white and transparent worm silk. It was easy to engrave words in this way. On it, the worm put up the words “Wuji Airlines”.
Seeing the engraved parachute, Fang Ji’s mentality collapsed.
What the hell was Wuji Airlines??
F*ck, you call this a battle tactic???
At this moment, the audience in the venue was collectively in a mess. The Panda senior who was in charge of taking photos also trembled. Junior Shi Yu wanted him to record this?
“As expected, he’s still abnormal.”
This thought appeared in everyone’s minds.
As for Shi Yu, when he saw the engraved parachute of the worm, his eyelids twitched and he was stunned.
“Damn.” He didn’t know there was such a segment. Who asked you to mess around? This strategy was already ridiculous enough, and you even announced the name?
Isn’t this harming my reputation as a Beast Tamer! What if others think that I came up with this idea!

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - You’re A Gu Master?
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: You’re A Gu Master?
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“…”
Shi Yu looked at the engraved worm silk parachute and felt ten thousand iron-eating beasts rolling across his heart.
Could we discuss this in advance next time…
Why didn’t it transform into a wing like usual and weave a parachute instead?
“Shi Yu wins!”
Shi Yu was stunned. After Master Qu Jie announced the results, he finally couldn’t tolerate it anymore and directly put it and Eleven back into the Beast Taming Space.
Then, he turned and left, leaving the silent crowd behind.
It ended just like that?
Looking at the venue destroyed, everyone was speechless.
And now, Fang Ji had completely lost his dream.
He didn’t know if it was because of deterrence or because of Buggy’s frivolous actions, but his brain was buzzing.
“I’m just a Beast Tamer.”
Fang Ji didn’t understand why he had to take this blow that didn’t match his age.
“Unbelievable…”
A moment later, some master-level Beast Tamers in the audience also made comments.
At the spectator area of Ancient Capital University.
Dean Lu of the admissions office grinned and said, “What seems like a simple strategy is completely not simple…”
“Yeah.” Archeology Department Director Li nodded.
“At that height, it can accurately lock onto the enemy… This seemingly ordinary attack contains something extraordinary…”
“How many trump cards are they hiding?”
Wuji Airlines’ super vision and deterrence were indispensable.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a battle tactic, but suicide.
“Moreover, that little Metal-eating Beast at the end only looked to be slightly injured…”
Director Li couldn’t understand. This kind of physique, are you sure it’s an Iron-eating Beast and not an Iron-eating Beast that had evolved?
Director Li had personally seen the evolution of the iron-eating beast that was comparable to a dragon’s physique.
However, that was the result of spending hundreds of millions.
As for Shi Yu, it was clearly just an ordinary Iron-eating Beast!
But soon, Director Li’s expression turned cold.
Holy shit, this Iron-eating Beast seemed to have also mastered transcendent Level Hardening. Don’t tell him that at the moment, this Iron-eating Beast was in a reserved state and had already completed its evolution!
If that was the case, why would the other candidates fight!
“I want to know more about that green worm.”
“Is that really a green worm?” Dean Lu had a strange expression.
He had never seen such a green silkworm…
He could accept transcendent-level worm silk and transcendent-level length.
However, the initial dragon might and the ability to create wings could no longer be explained by ordinary green worms.
“Haha…” Chief Physician Li laughed. Who the f*ck am I supposed to ask?
The Green Silkworm could learn skills other than worm silk? He had never even heard of it.
After all, the Green Silkworm was known as a pet that could not learn other skills before evolution.
However….
Things weren’t that absolute either.
This was for ordinary green worms.
If the green worm had some other bloodline, it might not be able to be defined as an ordinary green worm.
“Could it be a genetic skill?”
On the high ground of the arena, the white-bearded old man standing beside Legend Yin touched his beard.
“It should be,” Legend Yin said slowly.
Perhaps this was a special green worm that had broken through the racial restrictions and inherited new racial skills.
Otherwise, even these top-notch masters and even legendary Beast Tamers couldn’t think of a better explanation.
That’s right. How could a genius like Shi Yu contract an ordinary green worm?
…
In the examination candidates’ passageway.
Shi Yu summoned Eleven again.
He took a look at Eleven’s injuries and immediately slapped his forehead.
Good lord, why were you almost healed?
How could it receive treatment like this?
“Wuu!”
Eleven felt wronged.
Because it had the transcendent Hardening defense, no matter how strong the impact was or how many opponents injured it, it wasn’t heavily injured in the first place.
Then, if it used a high-speed healing to heal itself a little, wouldn’t the injuries be almost nonexistent…
“Gulp ~” But one way or another, this attack consumed a lot of energy. Eleven rubbed its stomach and expressed that it was hungry.
“…” Shi Yu rubbed Eleven’s panda head.
Sigh, it was also a problem for pets to be too outstanding.
Such an outstanding pet, which outstanding Beast Tamer cultivated it?
“Then let’s go look for food.”
“No, I better go to the medical room to take a look first. No matter how small the injury is, it’s still an injury.”
Then, Shi Yu made a decision.
Let’s see if we can encounter rare healing skills and recovery skills!
At the same time, he summoned Buggy that had yet to recover from their excitement and threw them at Eleven.
“Wuu!”
“Ji!”
Seeing Buggy come out, Eleven looked excited and matched its secret signal.
The parachute was really well made. If only the name of the Beast Tamer could be written on it. The words Wuji represented the two of them, but not their Tamer.
“Ji…!” Buggy expressed that he would try it next time and carve a pill symbol.
“There’s no need.”
“Next round, listen to my command.”
Shi Yu was afraid that the two pets would do it again, so he said with a dark face.
…
In the medical room of the Ancient Capital Arena.
At this moment, the examiner auntie was leaning against a chair in the room, watching a small television as she waited for the next injury number to enter.
She yawned, looking bored.
It was such a waste for a master-level Beast Tamer like her to be on duty in such a small battle.
But these newly-promoted professional Beast Tamers to be the future of Ancient Capital City.
A knock.
“Come in.”
“Sorry to disturb you.”
After Shi Yu brought Eleven and Buggy in, he immediately saw the examiner auntie sitting on the chair.
At this moment, she was looking at Shi Yu excitedly.
“You guys are pretty fierce.”
“Fighting head-on against the Anti-Injury Black Tortoise, it must have suffered a very serious injury this time.”
She felt that Eleven was forcefully holding on. It must be a pile of internal injuries.
“Oh ~” As the examiner auntie got up, a lying deer-shaped pet beside the seat also got up and let out a happy cry.
This deer wasn’t tall, and it had an earthen yellow body. It was very ordinary, but its antlers were like split green branches. No, to be precise, they were branches.
True Branch Horned Deer
[Attributes]: Wood
[Race Level]: High-level commander
In addition, on the table, there was a pet that was dozens of centimeters long. It looked like a big white radish and had features like a child. A pet with green radish leaves on its head swayed up.
Ginseng Baby
[Attributes]: Wood
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
At this moment, Shi Yu only saw the two pets and immediately felt that his body was very full.
The whiskers of a ginseng baby and the antlers of a real antler were all very nutritious…
At the side, sensing the Beast Tamer’s thoughts, Eleven subconsciously observed the energy in the two pets with its supervision and opened its mouth slightly.
This ginseng baby’s energy level was at least five times higher than its own, and the energy purity was even more flawless.
As for that deer, Eleven felt that the energy in its body was dozens of times more than his own. It was ridiculously terrifying.
“Sob…” Eleven carefully tugged at the corners of Shi Yu’s clothes.
“Don’t, don’t, we can’t win.”
Wait for it to work hard for a few more years.
“I know, I know.” Shi Yu slapped Eleven’s bear paw away.
Good lord.
It should be a commander rank Ginseng Baby and a monarch rank True Branch Horned Deer.
Both pets had broken through the restrictions of their race level, just like Master Lin’s Iron-eating Beast.
At this moment, the True Branch Horned Deer looked at Eleven and Buggy before turning to look at the Beast Tamer.
Something was wrong with them.
“Huh?”
The middle-aged lady was confused. Then, after hearing Lu’s explanation, she immediately stared at Shi Yu and Eleven in disbelief.
“Your Iron-eating Beast has mastered the High Speed Healing Skill?”
“It treated itself just now?”
Because the True Branch Horned Deer told her that the Iron-eating Beast didn’t have many injuries, and its body had signs of self-healing.
The examiner’s auntie widened her eyes and cursed in her heart. In the end, it didn’t look like it wasn’t injured, but was it really fine?
She originally thought that the accompanying move of this Iron-eating Beast was already ridiculous.
Upon closer inspection, it actually discovered that it had wood-element healing skills??
This was unscientific!
“Uh…” Shi Yu was stunned. How could it tell? He said,” Yes, but this skill consumes too much energy. It hasn’t been completely treated. “
It meant that you guys should heal it a bit.
The examiner auntie was silent for a moment before looking at the True Branch Horned Deer.
In the next second, the True Branch Ant nodded.
The branch-like antlers emitted a green halo. The halo kept expanding, and the domain enveloped Eleven and the worm.
Then, the injuries on Eleven instantly disappeared.
Perfect-grade High Speed Healing!
In addition to the healing speed, faster effects, and better effects, it could also become a multi-body healing skill.
At this moment, the examiner auntie turned around and took out a box of nutrient solution from the drawer.
“This is an energy nutrient solution produced by liquefying energy crystals. The effect of replenishing energy is slightly worse than energy crystals, but the absorption efficiency is faster. The pet can completely digest in a few minutes.”
“You should still have several battles ahead. Bring them all to your prep room. The effects are much better than the nutritional supplements there.”
“Thank you…” Shi Yu took the nutritional fluid and felt at a loss. That was it?
Shi Yu recognized the skill that healed Eleven. It was also super fast healing.
It was just that its proficiency was a little high.
However, it didn’t matter if its proficiency was high. Shi Yu wanted to see rare healing skills and recovery skills.
It was just an intermediate-level skill…
Could she show off a little?
After Shi Yu took the nutritional fluid, he looked at the big white radish sitting on the table, shaking its legs. He was curious about its skills.
The third pet, why not raise a white radish too? It looked pretty tender.
He could also produce supplements himself. Unfortunately, its race level was a little low, and its battle power was not high.
“What are you still looking at? You can’t bear to leave?” The middle-aged lady chuckled.
“You don’t need this thing. Baby Ginseng is for those Beast Tamers with enhanced talent to replenish their physical fitness and energy. You have a telepathy talent. On the battlefield, you’re just a cheerleader who’s watching the show. You don’t need it.”
Shi Yu :”…”
There was no need to be so direct.
Who did his telepathy talent offend?
“I’m just a little curious about the cultivation method of this non-battle pet,” Shi Yu said.
The examiner’s auntie smiled and said, “It’s not bad to be curious. After you enter university, you will have a lot of knowledge in this area. A large number of crystals of wisdom from the Beast Tamer seniors are collected there, and it’s much more profound than the public information on the Internet. You can go and understand it when the time comes. However, the knowledge on pet cultivation is too big. Even in a single field, a Beast Tamer can’t possibly finish exploring it even if they spend their whole life. Remember to differentiate between the main and secondary aspects. It’s good to find your own positioning.”
“Animals, plants, elements, machines, undead… There are also such magical Gu worms. Each of them is a profound domain. This is also the reason why Beast Tamers are born into so many professions.”
The middle-aged lady looked at the assessment that was starting again.
Now, it was the battle between the Gu Master Miao Dongdong and another seeded candidate, Lin Kai.
Shi Yu and the examiner auntie placed their attention on this little Gu Master with brown curly hair.
The opponent’s battle style was very strange.
Although he only had the second-level Beast Taming Space, he had three pets.
Shadow Gu, parasitic Gu, and the corpse of the Emerald Tree Python.
Among them, the parasitic Gu and the Jade Tree Python’s corpse could be seen as one, and were stored in the Beast Taming Space.
This pet combination was the magical thing about Gu Masters.
In fact, before the final ranking battle, Miao Dongdong’s Beast Taming Talent and his other pet, the Shadow Gu, were very mysterious, and no one had known about it.
However, as the assessment progressed to this point, the mysterious veil on his second pet and Beast Taming Talent had been lifted.
“For example, this little kid. Because of his’ symbiosis’ talent, not only can he rely on his own flesh and blood to nurture various Gu worms, he can also let them parasitize the body and display extraordinary strength.”
“Perhaps only this group of people can understand the miraculousness of the path of Gu worms. Outsiders will never be able to get started.”
On the screen.
The parasitic Gu controlled the Emerald Tree Python to fight the two pets at the same time.
Although the level of the Emerald Tree Python was not low, it was not its main body after all. The upper limit had been set. It seemed a little difficult to face the two pets carefully cultivated by the seed candidates.
However, at this moment, Miao Dongdong himself strangely controlled the shadow and assisted the Emerald Tree Python to control the other party’s Beast Tamer for an instant, interrupting the use of the other party’s Beast Taming Talent and seizing victory.
This was his first pet, the high-level transcendent Shadow Gu. Because of the “symbiosis” talent, it had always been fed by Miao Dongdong with flesh and blood to survive in Miao Dongdong’s body. The advantage was that Miao Dongdong’s physical fitness could be enhanced to the limit, far exceeding Beast Tamers of the same level and comparable to pets.
In addition, his life and mental connection with the Shadow Gu would be even stronger. Because their life forces were shared, he also obtained the ability to control the shadow, like how he could control his hands and feet, and control the Shadow Gu.
The coexistence talent of this Gu Master, the sharing talent of the shared skill, and the fusion talent of the fused pet had the same effect.
“Gu worms… are too strange.” Shi Yu looked at the scene and shook his head in disgust.
The essence of Gu worms was worms.
He couldn’t imagine the feeling of the insect parasitizing his body…
“Is that so? According to the advancement rules, the next battle seems to be between you guys.” The examiner’s auntie was full of smiles as she said, “I wonder which of you will come over to get treated first.”
Shi Yu :”…”
“Then I’ll go prepare for the next assessment first,” said Shi Yu.
“Go on, prepare well.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu was speechless. He planned to leave with Eleven and Buggy.
Before leaving, he didn’t forget to take a look at the big, watery radish.
He was curious about its whiskers and if it were better than divine beans.
