At the same time, he was considering the cost-effective ratio of contracting a pet that could produce supplements on its own.
“Sigh.” In fact, it couldn’t save much money in the end. After all, under the situation of conservation of energy, what he replenished would have to be consumed by the pets. The consumption of the pets would have to be replenished with various nutritional supplements. Moreover, the cost of cultivating a pet was not small. It was better to buy supplements directly.
Or, it would be good to learn from Miao Xiaodong and contract a pet that could strengthen his physique.
“Sorry to disturb you.”
Just as Shi Yu was about to leave, Fang Ji rushed over.
When he realized that Shi Yu and the others were also here, his expression immediately changed.
He had just calmed down outside for a while, but now, his mind was blank again.
“Wuu!” “Ji!!”
Eleven and Buggy greeted Fang Ji and asked for their evaluation of the Airlines strategy.
However, Fang Ji couldn’t understand. He only felt annoyed when he heard Eleven and Buggy chirping.
Damn it, these pets and the Tamer were nothing normal.
Under Fang Ji’s disdainful gaze, Shi Yu left the infirmary with Eleven and Buggy smiling.
Although his reputation had been affected, Shi Yu immediately had a bad taste when he saw his opponent in such a miserable state. He found it interesting. Buggy’s handling of the situation had indeed almost made him laugh.
It even caused Shiyu to want to prank him more.
If he remembered correctly, one of the names of the various techniques that the worm had given its worm silk was called the Parasite Thread. It meant that it could use the worm silk to control someone like a puppet. Therefore, could it use the full-level worm silk to pull the parasite out of the body of the Emerald Tree Python and let the worm control the Emerald Tree Python?
Becoming a pseudo Gu Master to directly snatch a pet in front of Miao Dongdong? Although he didn’t know about Gu worms, a full-level worm-type skill, Worm Silk, was just that magical.
“Eh, isn’t this too crazy? In this case, what’s the difference between Buggy and the enemy…”
Buggy:???

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - Going Crazy Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Going Crazy Again
A moment later, Shi Yu returned to the prep room.
When he thought of interesting tactics, he couldn’t help but want to experiment on its feasibility.
“This strategy looks very normal.”
Only by defeating his opponent in the domain the opponent was most proficient in could he showcase his strength.
?ω? If he won through technique, would this battle power show that he was intelligent?
Shi Yu pulled Eleven and Buggy over.
“When you face Miao Xiaodong in the next round, you guys will do this, then that, and finally this, understand?”
Eleven and Buggy nodded blankly. They understood, but not completely.
However, wasn’t his name Miao Dongdong?
“That’s not important.” Shi Yu stuffed the nutritional fluid in front of them.
Seeing the Happy Water, Eleven and Buggy’s expressions lit up.
“Wuuu ~”
“Ji ji ji ~”
There was no need to consider battles for the time being. It was better to recover the physical strength that he had consumed previously.
Eleven held up the Happy Water and gulped it down, while the worm used the worm silk as a straw…
As for Shi Yu, he looked at the small television and paid attention to the subsequent battle.
Next, he only paid attention to the battles of the winners.
As expected, the ones who advanced were still those few people.
As for the advancement battle of the Losers Group that had lost once, he was not interested. The chances of both parties encountering each other were not high.
…
Time flew again.
When Eleven and the others had already patched up, it was time for Shi Yu to fight again.
Eleven and Buggy blushed. They had eaten too many supplements.
The energy in their body was in a very full state…
Shi Yu’s mouth was slightly agape. Even if it was your first time drinking the nutritional fluid made of energy crystals, you didn’t have to eat so much, right?
These guys were even weaker at this than their Tamer?!
However, this wasn’t a big problem. They just needed to consume a little more energy.
Buggy closed its eyes and projected two Ice Dragon Babies to slap it. Then, they immediately recovered.
Eleven, on the other hand, used transcendent Level Hardening to create a trophy and wished them the championship in advance!
“Sigh…”
Seeing that the two pets were so abnormal, Shi Yu reflected deeply…
…
In the venue.
The audience looked at the name and profile picture on the big screen with strange expressions.
This was the third round of the assessment.
Iron-eating Beast Knight, tactical genius Shi Yu vs the mysterious Gu Master Miao Dongdong.
They wondered what kind of sparks would fly between the two parties in this assessment battle.
“Although this Shi Yu isn’t stable enough, his strength is really not bad. He has a lot of potential. Unfortunately, he seems to have been reserved by Ancient Capital University.
The teachers from the student recruitment offices of the other colleges who came from afar thought that it was a pity.
The next time they met, they might be competitors.
There were many conflicts between the nine academies due to the allocation of educational resources every year.
However, some financial groups felt that Shi Yu was quite interesting.
Even if Shi Yu entered Ancient Capital University, it actually didn’t prevent them from cooperating with Shi Yu.
If Shi Yu became the top scorer of the Ancient Capital assessment this year, they would directly get Shi Yu to endorse an artificial mechanical light sword pet and shoot an advertisement. The effect wouldn’t be any better for those hot-blooded young men.
In the arena.
Miao Dongdong, who was wearing a cotton shirt, had already walked up. After coming up, he let out a long sigh.
Opposite him, Shi Yu also stepped onto the arena as usual.
After coming up, Shi Yu kept staring at the ground before looking at Master Qu Jie.
Not bad!
Eleven clearly created a huge hole. After being repaired by Master Qu Jie’s earth-element pet, there were no signs of battle at all.
No wonder the construction companies outside all contracted workers with earth, metal, and wood pets.
“This kid…”
“…” Master Qu Jie looked at Shi Yu, who had ill intentions towards the arena and himself, in silence.
He hoped that Shi Yu could battle normally next. How was he supposed to judge his playstyle?
“Beep, beep, beep…”
The two candidates arrived at the venue. After making preparations, Master Qu Jie quickly announced the start of the battle. After all, it was almost lunch time and everyone was hungry.
As for the outcome of this battle… Many masters still thought highly of Shi Yu.
Now, in the eyes of these master-level Beast Tamers, the only ones who had any hope of defeating Shi Yu were Yin Zhengfan, who really had the pet of a monarch, and Zhang Qianyi, who had the talent for violent battles.
As for Miao Dongdong… His Emerald Tree Python was a corpse. It could only be considered half a monarch’s pet.
In the arena, as Master Qu Jie announced the start of the battle, a lightning storm flashed across Miao Dongdong’s brain again, and his mind worked crazily.
“Our advantage is that the monarch shell of the Emerald Tree Python is an excellent protection. It lives in the body of the Tree Python, and the parasitic Gu can largely be immune to mental attacks… And since the Shadow Gu is in symbiosis with me, our mental fusion can also be immune to mental attacks to a certain extent.”
This way, half of Shi Yu’s trump card, expert level deterrence, was wasted.
Miao Dongdong, who had brown curly hair, stood opposite Shi Yu. He took a deep breath and felt the pressure for the first time because he wasn’t facing a normal Beast Tamer.
Although with the advantage of a Gu Master, they could reduce the impact of Shi Yu’s proficient level deterrence skill to the minimum, his transcendent level hardening, perfect level thunder palm, and that strange green silkworm still worried him.
“Let’s fight!” At this point, Miao Dongdong couldn’t think too much. He looked at Shi Yu sternly.
Hu hu hu!!!
In the arena, strong winds rose up. The two of them summoned their pets at the same time.
After Shi Yu quietly summoned the Iron-Eating Beast and the Green silkworm, a huge summoning array appeared on Miao Dongdong’s side.
“Roar!!!”
A shocked roar immediately came from the array.
A green python nearly ten meters long suddenly appeared from the formation. It stood as tall as a tall building and looked down at Eleven and the bug with its green eyes in shock.
This was the magic of Gu Masters and parasitic Gu. It was hard to imagine that such a “living” Emerald Tree Python was actually a corpse with another owner controlling it.
“This is the first time I’m fighting a Gu Master…” Shi Yu looked at his opponent and thought to himself.
< Name > Parasitic Gu
[Attributes]: Worm
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Parasitic (High-level bug-type skill. It can infiltrate the target’s body and control the target. In the parasitic state, it can inherit the opponent’s racial skill and have the ability to heal the target’s injuries. It can also use the parasitic shell as a protective umbrella, immune to most attacks.)
This skill was very strong, but there was also a limit. It could only parasitize animals. At the same time, after the Host was parasitized, it lost her growth ability.
“Roar!!!”
In the arena, the giant python roared. Miao Dongdong stood not far from the giant python and recovered his previous calm expression.
On the other side, Eleven and Buggy were expressionless. They even felt that the other party was quite fierce.
However, although it was fierce, pandas were even fiercer!
“(‘ ? ￥) Howl!!” The little metal-eating beast’s eyes widened. You dare to be arrogant again?
Boom!!
As it howled, an extremely huge invisible wave of air erupted from Eleven’s body!
It stared at the Emerald Tree Python and Miao Dongdong. At this moment, the air in the arena began to hum and vibrate. The almost material deterrence wave turned into a violent wind that swept across the arena.
“It’s here…”
At this moment, the Emerald Tree Python’s body suddenly froze. The shadow under Miao Dongdong’s feet disappeared instantly and fused with his body. A strange black tattoo appeared on Miao Dongdong’s body.
Buzz!
As the mental storm swept past, Miao Dongdong gritted his teeth and felt dizzy. He subconsciously clenched his fists and smiled.
Similarly, the Emerald Tree Python quickly shook its head, its gaze gradually becoming clear, and it roared.
“Roar!!!”
“That’s all?!”
Facing the terrifying deterrence wave, Miao Dongdong was covered in sweat, but he quickly stabilized and recovered. The parasitic Gu in the Emerald Tree Python’s body was clearly protected by the protective umbrella of the monarch’s shell, almost able to withstand this terrifying mental impact.
“Next, it’s our turn to fight back.”
Miao Dongdong raised his hand, and countless shadows appeared out of thin air, about to condense into a ball. It was surprisingly one of the abilities of the Shadow Gu, the Shadow Ball.
At this moment, the body of the Emerald Tree Python swayed slightly and made an attack pose, revealing its fangs.
This was the first opponent Shi Yu and the others had encountered to face Eleven’s deterrence. Although he was affected, he could still continue attacking.
As expected, when facing a slightly stronger opponent, deterrence was immediately not as omnipotent.
“He resisted it!!”
“Miao Dongdong is awesome.”
“You’re the first one to make the Iron Eater Knight fail.”
As Miao Dongdong and the others resisted the deterrence, waves of voices immediately erupted from the spectator area.
Many people’s eyes lit up. They felt that this battle would be very exciting.
Those master-level Beast Tamers also revealed looks of admiration towards Miao Dongdong.
The Shadow Gu and Parasitic Gu were only two transcendent species of Gu worms, but they could be developed to such an extent by Miao Dongdong. He and Shi Yu were simply the two great inspirational candidates for this assessment.
However, at this moment, only a small number of people realized the severity of the problem.
“What are you guys causing a ruckus about… Do you have any eyesight at all? That’s just a deterrence. The Silkworm God hasn’t made a move yet.” In the spectator area, a pair of cousins stared at the Worm that started to close its eyes and felt that things weren’t that simple.
This deterrence didn’t look like it wanted to instantly kill the opponent… Instead, it wanted to attract attention!
As expected, soon, someone noticed the worm with its eyes closed.
This had already become the sign of Buggy’s anger.
“Look.”
“On the head of the Emerald Tree Python!”
At this moment, everyone was shocked to discover that the green worm was still lying on the iron-eating beast’s shoulder.
However, another identical Green silkworm appeared on the head of the Emerald Tree Python!
It was just like how the first assessment conjured dragon might and the second assessment conjured wings. This time, the green worm showed its own projection!
“What?”
At this moment, sensing the change, the Emerald Tree Python and Miao Dongdong were stunned.
“Roar!!!”
The Emerald Tree Python was still opening its mouth foolishly. In the next moment, the Green Silkworm on its head bent its body and flipped its body 360 degrees. Like a diving trick, it jumped into the Emerald Tree Tree Python’s mouth.
This scene stunned everyone.
“Holy shit.”
Everyone was stunned.
“(⊙ ? ⊙) Uh…” The Emerald Tree Python also felt that something was wrong.
Miao Dongdong: d(?д??)? What the hell!
Miao Dongdong was momentarily stunned, not knowing what it meant.
Attacking from the inside of the tree python?
But the Tree Python’s poisonous stomach liquid skill could even corrode metal!
Suicide?
Just as Miao Dongdong didn’t understand, the next moment, the Emerald Tree Python suddenly widened its eyes and made a vomiting gesture, then showed an even more painful expression…
“Roar!!”
Its body started to twitch crazily.
Inside the Emerald Tree Python.
Swoosh!
The Green Silkworm Phantom erupted with countless worm silk, making the worm silk stab into the body of the Emerald Tree Python like the hair of a lion.
Gulp ~
The stomach liquid that surged up encountered the worm silk and constantly corroded the silk, but the strong corrosive effect actually couldn’t affect the levelless worm silk at all.
On the contrary, the silk were like small life forms with their own consciousness, launching fierce attacks on the Emerald Tree Python in its body!
Full level worm silk was definitely a product that no one could understand, even if it was a legendary Beast Tamer.
The effect of the silk that was derived from the full-level worm silk was something that even a transcendent worm silk didn’t have, and it was something that only Shi Yu’s worm could master!
At this moment, no one knew what was going on.
They only knew that Shi Yu seemed to be planning to attack from the inside of the tree python, and it seemed to have taken effect.
“Despicable city people.”
Miao Dongdong, who came from the countryside, immediately recalled the warnings of his granny in the tribe. His eyes reddened.
Sensing the parasitic Gu’s cry for help, he couldn’t take it anymore. He quickly looked at Eleven and the green worm, and a shadow instantly appeared under his feet and stretched!
He wanted to use another skill of the Shadow Gu, Shadow Control, to lock the little Iron-Eating Beast in place. At the same time, the shadow ball in his hand had already been condensed and he suddenly threw it at the green worm.
Although he didn’t know what was going on, it wasn’t wrong to target the Green Silkworm…
Swoosh!
The shadow ball smashed at Eleven and Buggy like a black meteor, but Eleven didn’t even have the intention to move.
Shi Yu: “Emerald Tree Python, block the attack!”
On the other hand, as a Beast Tamer, Shi Yu issued commands to his pet.
At this moment, the huge Emerald Tree Python suddenly pressed down on the shadow created by the Shadow Gu. At the same time, it used its huge body to block the shadow ball!
Miao Dongdong was speechless.
Everyone: “?”
Boom!!!
The Shadow Ball hit the Emerald Tree Python’s body, and the Emerald Tree Python’s eyes shone with a dark light. Its huge body only had a little scratch on it, and the injury was extremely light. This was the power of the physique of a monarch. Even without using any moves, it could still have an extremely strong pressure.
Everyone opened their mouths slightly.
It was strong, but something was wrong…
Why, why did this Emerald Tree Python listen to Shi Yu’s orders and help the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm resist the damage!!
“Could it be the legendary parasitic worm??”
“No, impossible!” Miao Dongdong was stunned.
What was happening?
At this moment, in a small room inside the Emerald Tree Python, whose main body was only a high-level transcendent race and didn’t have any other impressive skills… The parasitic Gu looked at the active insect silk surrounding it. Would it dare to move?
The only stomach liquid skill that could attack the invader in its body was useless against this worm silk. Would it dare to move??
“Ji!!!” The insect silk made an excited sound.
“Ji!!!” The parasite Gu screamed like a chicken.
Don’t come over—
What the hell was this!!
Was it a parasite or was the green worm a parasite!!
Why was this guy’s insect silk able to invade and control the tree python’s movements as if it had its own consciousness!!
This didn’t make sense!! The parasitic worm shouted at the Beast Tamer telepathically. This didn’t make sense…
Miao Dong Dong :”?△?”
Miao Dongdong was stunned.
In the outside world, everyone was stunned.
Including the master-level Beast Tamers, none of them knew what was going on when they saw the Emerald Tree Python helping the Little Iron Eating Beast block the attack.
In the arena, after helping the Little Iron Eating Beast block the attack, the Emerald Tree Python slowly stretched its body and approached the Little Iron Eating Beast and the others.
Then, under everyone’s incredulous gaze, the little Iron-Eating Beast brought the Green Silkworm and climbed onto the huge body of the Emerald Tree Python, transforming into a python riding panda
Pa!
After riding the tree python, Eleven’s transcendent Level Hardening was activated and immediately wrapped the tree python with powerful armor!
Compared to the parasitic skill of the parasitic Gu, Buggy’s parasitic silk was still lacking in many ways. For example, it could only control its movements but couldn’t inherit the moves. Therefore, if it wanted to have stronger output, it could only rely on Eleven’s hardening.
“Wu!!”
“Ji!!”
When everything was completed, the tree python and Eleven looked at the tiny, helpless, pitiful, and confused Miao Dongdong in hostility.
Miao Dongdong subconsciously took a step back with a blank expression.
“This is impossible, impossible.”
“How is this possible…”
“What exactly have you done…”
Shi Yu looked at the little Gu Master opposite him whose expression was starting to look strange.
His mental fortitude wasn’t good.
“It’s nothing. I just let the Green Silkworm hijack your parasitic Gu into a worm hostage.”
“Therefore, the one controlling the Emerald Tree Python vest is the Green Silkworm.”
“Don’t worry, I’ll return it to you after the battle.”
Damn, worm.
At this moment, looking at the change in the venue, Master Qu Jie was confused again. As a judge, his professionalism didn’t seem to be enough. He didn’t know what had happened.
He kept feeling that Shi Yu was talking nonsense, but he couldn’t refute it.
Everyone’s mouths opened slightly as they looked at the change in the arena. What the f*ck was going on?
The battle was going in an unscientific and abnormal direction again! What kind of nonsense skills were Shi Yu’s pets using?!
Miao Dongdong: (PД`q.)… Ah!
At this moment, Miao Dongdong took another step back and widened his eyes.
He was the most confused.
Human… human language?
Who was the Gu master here?!
He looked at the green python that was approaching him and was a little stunned.
Parasitic Gu and the Emerald Tree Python were his trump cards. The Shadow Gu was to protect his own body. Now that his trump card had turned against him, how could he fight?
Many candidates also looked at the helpless Miao Dongdong in silence.
A perfectly fine genius… Why did he become like this when he encountered Shi Yu?
In a certain place, the expressions of Yu Shu, Fang Ji, and the others darkened. Oh my, oh my, this time, another candidate would go crazy. This Shi Yu was definitely abnormal!!
They advised him not to participate in other competitions in the future!!! He was deliberately messing with other people’s mentalities!!

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - Real Richness
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Real Richness
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Efditor:
Atlas Studios
In the third round of assessment, Shi Yu advanced without any surprise.
But at the same time, another youth lost his dream.
Until he was rolled into a wrapping by his Emerald Tree Python, then flung onto the wall and slid down, the miserable Miao Dongdong still didn’t understand, didn’t understand!
Why could the green worm snatch away the parasitic Gu’s right to live with the green tree python?
Someone explain to him!
Even he, a Gu Master, couldn’t understand, let alone the other Beast Tamers.
“Hmm…”
Towards this battle, many master-level Beast Tamers could only grunt in silence. With their experience, they couldn’t explain this development.
Help!
What was wrong with this newcomer?
Could it be that the beast taming method of the new era was developing so quickly? There was a generation gap between them?
It didn’t seem like it, because the surrounding young candidates were also extremely silent, feeling that it was ridiculous!
For example, Yu Shu, Zhang Qianyi, Yin Zhengfan, and the others who might encounter Shi Yu next… None of them wanted to say anything!
This indeed meant that there was something wrong with Shi Yu.
“Not bad.”
“Yes, not bad.”
Even Yin Chuanqi and his cousin, who were at a certain place, only commented in silence, not wishing to look deeper.
It was meaningless to guess. Let the guy be himself!
At the spectator area of Ancient Capital University.
“Say, after he enters school, his archeology direction is alright. But in terms of battle, will there be any teacher to teach him the battle direction?”
Dean Lu asked Director Li.
Director Li :”…”
Forget about being a wonder in battle, our teachers can only teach limited archeology.
The archeology of people from Bureau 11 was disgusting! It was like they were watching the history channel!
“Bro, this is too showy.” At the same time, the archeological seven elites looked at the arena and sighed.
“No, it’s not that he is too outstanding, but the worm is too outstanding. I originally thought that Junior Shi Yu’s second pet was the Green Silkworm and was just a burden. Now it seems that I’m still too young and don’t understand the world of cheaters.”
“I, Zheng Yingjie, am willing to call it the strongest Green Silkworm!” Zheng Yingjie said. “The Worm God is reborn!”
Although they did not know what was going on, everyone could tell that the Green Silkworm had seized control of the parasite over the Emerald Tree Python.
Good heavens, it was just a green worm. Not only could it release dragon might as a giant dragon, but it could also use itself as a wing to drop nuclear bombs. Now, it could even use it as a parasite to snatch pets in front of people. Impressive.
“Senior Lin, you’ve always known that Junior Shi Yu is so awesome, right?” Lin Yu’er, a girl from the seven elites, asked Senior Panda.
Lin Xiuzhu, who was holding a camera :”…”
She felt that it was actually very normal before Shi Yu contracted a pet… Including Pet Eleven, it was also very normal and encouraging.
In the end, why did everything become like this, including the beast tamer himself and his pets? Lin Xiuzhu didn’t know why.
“This is too showy.” On the battle club’s side, the members of the Ancient Capital University team exclaimed.
During their vocation assessment, if Shi Yu had shown off half his power, he would at least have become a vice president now. Unlike now, where they had to train bitterly under the president’s gaze.
“Shut up.” The beast-eared girl stared at the cell phone wholeheartedly.
No matter how strong Shi Yu was, he didn’t attract her this time.
Because she was chatting with her goddess.
Lu Qingyi: “I’m outside the Ancient Capital Arena.”
White Brook: “Senior, I’ll go pick you up!”
Lu Qingyi: “No need, I’ll look for you later.”
White Brook: “Alright.”
White Brook looked at the chat record and exhaled slightly. She could see Senior Lu again. Great!
Although Lu Qingyi seemed to have come to look for Shi Yu…
Damn it, even though I was the one who talked to her first…
…
After the battle ended, Shi Yu returned happily.
It felt good to experience the feeling of stealing a pet?
Unfortunately, this was immoral. Only this time, just this once.
But it did prove the power of the worm’s parasitic silk.
Apart from that, its insect silk could actually sew up wounds. Apart from not being able to let the target maintain their bodily functions and inherit their racial skills, it was really similar to the parasitic skill of the parasite.
It was like the full-level worm silk had simulated other insect-type skills. Although it was a simple version, it felt a little like it was on track, as if it had come into contact with the insect-type “rules”.
It meant that when a certain skill reached the pinnacle, it would come into contact with “Dao” if it advanced further. That was how the laws of the world worked.
“Since there are no records in history, why don’t I give it a name? In the future, it’ll be called ‘Dao Proficiency’.” Shi Yu stretched.
Skill: Worm Silk (Dao Proficiency)
Perhaps it was because the level of the Worm Silk skill was too low, and it could only be called progressing into the Dao. If it were a transcendent skill with max level points, it might really be able to touch the power that only Mythical creatures like Origins and Rules could master.
As for the divine skills mastered by Mythical creatures, they were abilities that could directly mobilize laws and Origins. Shi Yu really wondered if the skill index could replicate this ability.
Forget it, don’t think too far ahead…
“The next round seems to be the battle between Yu Shu and that Zhang Qianyi?”
Shi Yu touched his chin and returned to the prep room, planning to take a good look.
He estimated that this boy, Yu Shu, might not necessarily win.
Even he didn’t have much confidence in facing that Zhang Qianyi. If he wanted to win, he would have to go all out.
The opponent’s talent was too terrifying for the pet’s battle power bonus.
A moment later, Shi Yu returned to the prep room. However, just as he opened the door, he was immediately stunned.
In the room, a woman with fair skin and short brown hair that glowed slightly was sitting on the sofa looking at her cell phone in a white shirt, a black uniform short skirt, and a white coat. Her long white legs were casually crossed.
After discovering that someone had entered, she used the back of her hand to adjust her glasses slightly. She looked over and sighed silently.
“Senior… Senior Lu?” Shi Yu was at a loss. He didn’t understand why Lu Qingyi would suddenly appear here.
“…” Lu Qingyi didn’t know where to start.
She wanted to cry.
She didn’t understand why Shi Yu, who was still very normal in Ping Cheng, had become like this.
After watching the editing of Shi Yu’s survival assessment three days ago, she had insomnia for the entire night.
She felt a little regretful that she didn’t personally guide Shi Yu and instead handed him to the similarly abnormal White Brook.
In her opinion, Shi Yu, who was riding an iron-eating beast and fighting personally, was even more ridiculous than White Brook. White Brook liked to fight herself, and her personality was crazy because of her fusion talent. However, Shi Yu was an archeologist with a telepathy talent, so why was he joining in the fun!!
If such a habit suddenly flared up during exploration of various ruins and mystic realms, it was very easy to court death!!
Lu Qingyi sighed slightly and rubbed her temples. “Long time no see.”
“Senior, long time no see!” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up, feeling that something good would happen.
After all, this person was the richest woman. Even the panda senior was a little inferior.
He hurriedly poured some water and handed it to Lu Qingyi.
“What’s this?”
“Sorry, I took the wrong one. This is the Happy Water of the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm.”
Lu Qingyi :”…”
“Your survival assessment and that so-called Wuji Airlines…” Lu Qingyi took out her cell phone. On it was a screenshot of Shi Yu’s various performances that White Brook had given her.
Lu Qingyi pushed out her cell phone and showed it to Shi Yu, looking at him playfully.
He was already so old, but he was still like a child.
Shi Yu blushed.
“…”
Good lord.
She even snitched on him?
Shi Yu looked at the picture of himself riding a panda and thought to himself, Sister Beast Ears, I’ll remember this.
“Cough, if I say that this was all Eleven and Buggy’s idea, would you believe me?” Shi Yu pushed the blame.
He was indeed framed.
Lu Qingyi was stunned.
Who was he kidding?
An Iron-eating Beast and Green Silkworm could think of using gravity to accelerate? They could think of using worm silk to advertise?
She didn’t believe that no one had instigated it.
“Forget it…”
Although she was also very concerned about this matter, it was Shi Yu’s own business after all. As long as Shi Yu was happy.
When she returned, teaching White Brook a lesson was the most important. The root of the problem was definitely here. White Brook must have led Shi Yu astray.
“Let me tell you a piece of good news. The approval of the iron-eating beast evolution plan has been passed.”
Lu Qingyi smiled and looked at Shi Yu.
Actually, she had been paying attention to this matter for a long time.
She was very pleased that Shi Yu could crack a new ruin in a short period of time after deciphering the ruin that he had awakened in Ping Cheng.
From the ruins of the Iron-Eating Beast, Shi Yu discovered the evolution method of the Iron-Eating Beast King’s potential and gave new research ideas. With these, it could actually prove Shi Yu’s talent. Shi Yu already had the qualifications to become an official member of Bureau 11.
Unfortunately, the assessment mission given to Shi Yu was to crack the Ice Dragon Ruins. Therefore, even if Shi Yu had other achievements now, he still had to wait a while.
“He passed? When?”
Shi Yu was stunned. He thought it would be the end of the month. So soon?
“Just this morning. If nothing goes wrong, the news of the iron-eating beast’s evolution can be announced on the Internet today.” Lu Qingyi tapped her finger on the table and said, “At the same time, your name should be able to spread throughout the country.”
Shi Yu:!!!
Shi Yu’s heart surged. However, was he the kind of person who cared about his reputation?
He wanted to know how much the reward for discovering the evolution of the iron-eating beast was!!
As the discoverer of the iron-eating beast’s evolution method and one of the practitioners, and even the appointed chief iron-eating beast evolution planner, he was too poor!!!
If it weren’t for the sake of raising Eleven and Worm, he definitely wouldn’t care about the bonus. After all, his dream was to be a handsome man who didn’t pursue fame and fortune. This was purely forced by life.
“That’s not the most important thing.” Lu Qingyi continued to smile.
“The most important thing is that I’ve read the evolution thesis you wrote. In it, it says that the Iron-eating Beast might still have a second stage evolution, right?”
“Yes.”
“Then… let go and study it.”
“As a reward for discovering the iron-eating beast’s evolution method, I’ve helped you apply for a billion yuan worth of evolution materials through Bureau 11’s channels. You can use it to buy the materials needed for your iron-eating beast’s evolution. Of course, it can only be used to study the iron-eating beast’s evolution.”
“Compared to other rewards, you definitely need this more.”
Lu Qingyi also knew that Shi Yu was poor. Lin Hongnian had spent hundreds of millions on the evolution of his Iron-eating Beast. She felt that Shi Yu’s demand would definitely be greater.
1 billion!
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly.
“Really???”
“Of course,” Lu Qingyi said.
Shi Yu’s discovery was worth this value.
“1 billion…”
Even if Eleven multiplied its size, it could still equip a full set of armor!!!
His heart started to beat faster. He knew that something good must have happened since Lu Qingyi came.
This was too big!
Previously, when he sold resources, he couldn’t be considered rich at all. This time, he was!
“Alright.” Shi Yu’s expression was serious as he said, “The Iron-eating Beast’s potential is difficult to estimate. This money can indeed solve the urgent problem. Let’s carry out other experiments. I’ll use it well.”
Since the country provided this sum of money, he was confident that he could develop an iron-eating beast’s overlord race evolution path and provide a national-level pet to the Eastern Brilliance Ancient Nation!
Lu Qingyi crossed her arms and nodded.
At this moment, Lu Qingyi suddenly remembered the evolution method of the Goddess of Light Butterfly she had given Shi Yu.
“Your green worm… shouldn’t be planning to evolve into a Goddess of Light Butterfly, right?”
She had a helpless expression. If she remembered correctly, when she first saw that worm, that green worm was still very ordinary!
No, to be precise, including the Iron-eating Beast, they were also very ordinary.
But now, this bug seemed to have more tricks than the Iron-Eating Beast?
“Yes, I obtained some small gains in the ruins. The Green Silkworm obtained the inheritance left behind by an overlord-level Fantasy Clam,” said Shi Yu.
“Fierce Beast Phantom, Dream Clam, Illusion Phantom…” Lu Qingyi nodded.
This was the advantage of being an archeologist.
In exploring ancient ruins, one could always obtain unexpected opportunities from time to time.
A green worm had changed its fate just like that.
There was also Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast. Lu Qingyi estimated that it had also obtained quite a lot through the ruins.
This was in line with its current achievements.
However, Lu Qingyi didn’t want to ask too much about this. This was a secret that belonged to Shi Yu himself. Moreover, she was indeed not interested. Her gains in the ruins were much more than Shi Yu’s when she was young.
She had even come into contact with some Mythical opportunities.
Lu Qingyi thought of something again. It seemed that she had yet to tell Shi Yu about the Eleven Bureau assessment and the plant pet Shi Yu had mentioned to her!
“After you become a professional Beast Tamer, do you plan to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins?”
Shi Yu looked at the small television as he replied, “I should go exploring before school starts. I hope I can crack it successfully at once.”
Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “If you successfully crack it, you will be an official member of Bureau 11. As an official member of Bureau 11, we will usually distribute two items uniformly.”
“Item?” This was the first time Shi Yu had heard of it. He couldn’t help but look at Lu Qingyi.
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “One is a technological product, equivalent to a universal illustrated handbook.”
“It can directly detect the information of all creatures from transcendent races to Mythical races recorded at the moment, as well as information on skills and resources. The level of access is very high.”
“In addition, it can also detect the specific growth level of the pet. The upper limit is the guardian level. It’s also a very good battle power detector.”
“At the same time, there are also all the maps of Dong Huang’s inside, including the distribution of some dangerous areas, mystic realms, and ruins. There are detailed records. Of course, they can also be used as communication devices.”
“This index can be customized. What style do you want? You can use me as a reference. The index I have is a cell phone model, and it’s equipped with a pair of glasses that can connect to the index data. This is more convenient.” She pointed at her glasses.
“Well… Actually, contact lenses can also be done, but I was more used to wearing glasses when I was young.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
After becoming a Beast Tamer, one’s physique would increase at the same time. Unless he was injured, there would basically be no short-sightedness.
Lu Qingyi said that she was used to wearing glasses when she was young… This proved that it was before she became a Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu sighed. It looked like she had been a genius since he was young…
But then again, this index sounded very fragrant.
It was completely a super encyclopedia.
He felt that there was no need to change his cell phone. This was enough. It was just that… It sounded a little corrosive. If he had this, wouldn’t it mean that he wasn’t allowed to memorize books seriously?
“Then I’ll also use the cell phone model. Then, I want a matching contact lens,” Shi Yu said.
“Then, do you plan to install an intelligent life form in this index? Or do you just want a program?” Lu Qingyi asked. “It’s probably the difference between a mechanical life form and an ordinary machine..”

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - Expanding Benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Expanding Benefits
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
In that case, what would he want?
Wasn’t it better to directly ask for the design of the beautiful cyborg?
However, he didn’t dare to say this, nor did he dare to mention it.
He was afraid that after he said it, even his cell phone shell would disappear.
“What’s the difference?” Shi Yu asked.
Lu Qingyi replied, “Apart from the fact that one is purely a program and the other has its own consciousness, there’s no difference in function.”
“Of course… Don’t expect to use it as a battle-type mechanical life form. The growth potential of such a mechanical life form is close to zero.”
“At most, I’ll be your personal assistant.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
She was looking down on him!
As long as it was a pet, even if it was a cell phone, he could add points to become a nuclear bomb!
Uh, through upgrading points…
“Then, why don’t we do a program?” Shi Yu thought to himself.
Eleven and Buggy didn’t have enough money. If another gold eater came, he couldn’t afford it!
Even if he wanted to add points, wouldn’t it be better for him to find a mechanical pet with more comprehensive abilities and a higher racial level in the future?
Starting from a low-level race would cost too much and consume too much energy.
At that time, if he added some points and bonded with it… He would be wanting to upgrade its configuration, and the evolution materials would cost hundreds of millions. Where would he find them…
The one billion yuan that Senior Lu sent was barely enough for Eleven to evolve, and it couldn’t become multiplied by too much. Otherwise, it would definitely be hopeless to be fully armed.
“Alright.”
Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “But there’s no hurry to make a decision. You can consider it slowly.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
Then, Lu Qingyi stretched and said,
“You actually already have the second tool that will be distributed. It’s the ruin bead on your neck.”
“However, the quality distributed by Bureau 11 is better. It’s a relic left behind by famous legendary Beast Tamers in history. It’s relatively well preserved, unlike this defective product. Your spatial strength has an upper limit and is unstable. Letting extraordinary creatures enter is already the limit.”
A new ruin bead?
Shi Yu was stunned. “Are these two items standard for members of Bureau 11…”
“To be precise, it’s the standard for official members.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
Both of them could greatly increase the safety of archeologists.
In the country, only Bureau 11 had this foundation.
“It’s the same as this, no, even better than this?” Shi Yu touched the ruins bead on his chest and was a little shocked.
“Of course…”
“However, this ruin pearl is a clue tool to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins. It’s still worth a little. Perhaps it’s the key to open the Ice Dragon Ruins.”
“When the time comes, let’s see how it’s related to the Ice Dragon Ruins.”
Shi Yu nodded. At the same time, he sighed slightly.
“I’m a little glad to have joined Division 11 now…”
How generous!
10,000,000 starting funds… Now he felt that it wasn’t even a drop in the ocean!
Lu Qingyi smiled. Would she lie to Shi Yu?
The status of an official member of Bureau 11 was even higher than that of a legendary Beast Tamer. It was not a simple thing.
And the value that a person with the talent to listen to the Voice of History could create was not what a legendary Beast Tamer could compare to.
The discoveries in those mythical ruins could almost be described as priceless treasures. It was the path to becoming a god.
“But these can only be distributed after you become an official member. Now you have the motivation, right?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu’s heart surged.
After the vocation assessment ended, he immediately decided that he would want to go to the snow mountain and pulled Old Feng, Old Lin, and the others to crack the Ice Dragon Ruins!
No, it wasn’t safe yet. It would be best to gather all the masters from all districts and counties in Icefield City to form a team.
If there was another legendary Tamer, Shi Yu felt that it would be even more stable.
He fell into deep thought again. Speaking of which…
Ice Dragon Ruins was also a huge ruin space.
However, no one had been able to find a way to open it until now.
Of course, this was also related to the low potential value and lack of attention in the Ice Dragon Ruins. It was very easy to ignore. After all, apart from the Ice Dragon Ruins, there were many Mythical Ruins in the country that had not been conquered.
Shi Yu was a little curious. After the Ice Dragon Ruins was cracked, was there a similar ruin pearl? Also, could there really be an Ice Dragon inside…
“Then here’s the last thing!”
Lu Qingyi heaved a sigh of relief. She felt so tired.
She was clearly preparing to nurture Shi Yu into an assistant, but why did he feel like she was Shi Yu’s assistant tool person instead? Was it an illusion?
Investment, everything was still investment now!
“It’s about plant-type pets,” Lu Qingyi said.
“I wonder if you’re still interested. I’ve already chosen a few targets for the plant-type pets you mentioned to me before. When your vocation assessment is over, I can take you to take a look.”
“Therefore, when the time comes, don’t be in a hurry to leave the Ancient Capital.”
He still had to see with his own eyes to determine if the contract was compatible with him.
Sometimes, race levels were very confusing.
The few plant pets she chose for Shi Yu were all types that were useful for archeology and had diversified development directions.
Shi Yu was stunned. She remembered!
Seeing Senior Lu’s expression, he felt that she had prepared another big gift for him.
“No problem…” Shi Yu agreed with a glint in his eyes.
Looking at Lu Qingyi was like looking at a goddess. One billion evolution materials, super illustrated handbook, high-level ruins space, news about plant pets…
These pieces of information made Shi Yu feel that the vocation assessment was boring and he wanted to end it quickly!
“I’m done talking.” Lu Qingyi glanced at the time, then at the small television. “Then you continue preparing for the assessment.”
“I’ll go find White Brook.” If they continued chatting, she was afraid that Shi Yu wouldn’t be in the mood to take the assessment.
At the moment, the assessment was still more important to Shi Yu. The better the assessment results, the better it was for his future development.
“Alright.” Shi Yu looked at the small television. At this moment, the battle between Yu Shu and Zhang Qianyi was already at the climax.
…
Ancient Capital Arena.
A black cloud Thundercloud Sprite with golden lightning flashing floated in the sky.
Inside it were two strange Little Spirits.
One was a Wind Sprite the size of a water bottle, similar to a small green tornado, and the other was a Fire Sprite similar to a flame. They were both elemental creatures of medium-level transcendent races. They were Zhang Qianyi’s first and second pets.
Although the race level was not high, they had also learned high-level skills outside their race. The current battle power was also extraordinary.
Boom!!!
At this moment, Yu Shu fell into a huge disadvantage.
Under the Thunderclap Skill of the Thundercloud Sprite, the battle intent of the undead-type Soul Dragon was greatly affected, including Yu Shu’s mentality.
Skill: Thunder
Skill Level: Advanced
< Introduction > With the power of thunder, it can intimidate the enemy and make them afraid.
Thunder rumbled continuously in the sky, the sound shocking the heart.
This was a thunder-type skill called Thunder Deterrence, Yu Shu clenched the silver necklace on his chest tightly. He was very glad that his mother had asked for level-three mental defense equipment at the last minute.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t even be able to show his talent in this battle.
But now, even if he activated his talent, the situation was still pushing him back step by step. The girl opposite was too violent.
With a wave of her hand, a bolt of lightning descended from the sky. A storm swept past, and it was simply unsolvable.
“This girl is so strong… Is she really from an ordinary family? How can she have such a talent?”
At the spectator area of Ancient Capital University, Qi Yingjie and the others looked at Zhang Qianyi standing on the ground and spoke one after another.
It was fine if she faced other contestants previously, but Yu Shu was an internally determined genius in the battle department of Ancient Capital University!
His parents were both top students who had graduated from Ancient Capital University. Now, they were already top-notch Beast Tamers!
Even so, Yu Shu’s Soul-Armored Bone Dragon was still retreating under the attack of the other party’s three elemental sprites.
Drip, drip, drip…
In the arena, the Thunder Cloud Sprite summoned the rain clouds, causing the entire arena to enter a rain state. Under the rain, its lightning was even more violent!
In addition, under the combination of Zhang Qianyi’s Elemental Coordination Talent, the Thunder Cloud Sprite’s high-level skill Lightning and the Wind Sprite’s high-level skill Storm directly formed a dual-element combination skill Lightning Storm in this weather.
A strong wind swept with the lightning and crushed towards Yu Shu’s Soul-Armored Bone Dragon in an even more violent manner.
This lightning and storm were both proficient proficiency levels, and it wasn’t even expert level. Moreover, it was used by two different pets. In theory, it was definitely impossible to fuse them, but at this moment, it had indeed successfully fused together, forming an exponentially greater power.
“Roar!!!”
The lightning storm swept over, and thick dark green flames appeared on the opposite side. The Soul-Armored Bone Dragon could still resist it with the Soul Fire Dragon Breath.
However, in the next moment, Zhang Qianyi’s expression froze, and she got the Fire Sprite to join the battle. As soon as the super three-element combination skills formed by the high-level proficiency skills Lightning, Storm, and Fire Vortex were formed, the Soul-Armored Dragon’s Soul Flame Dragon Breath was instantly obliterated!
Metal, green, and red storms blew over. In an instant, the bone dragon was swallowed.
The strengthened bones began to suffer the stimulation of violent lightning and flames. The recombination speed was far slower than the enemy’s destruction speed. The powerful destructive power immediately caused the bone dragon to wail.
As the Beast Tamer of the Soul attached Bone Dragon, Yu Shu felt his heart trembling at this moment!
“F*ck, how unreasonable!!!” On the other side, Yu Shu was about to explode in anger.
Girl, this combination skill of yours was f*cking unscientific.
Wind, thunder, and high-level fire skills were completely unrelated. The proficiency was not high either, and you could just combine them?!
This elemental coordination talent was too unreasonable.
Facing this Elementalist with outstanding looks and her three elemental sprites, Yu Shu and the Soul attached Bone Dragon were directly defeated a moment later!
This was also the first time Zhang Qianyi had all three pets attack and use three high-level combination skills.
“…Zhang Qianyi advances in victory.” At the side, Master Qu Jie looked at the unwilling Yu Shu and the slightly tired Zhang Qianyi and announced the results.
In terms of Beast Taming Talent strength, Zhang Qianyi’s Elemental Coordination Talent was indeed stronger. At the moment, it was alright. When her pet touched on seven or eight attributes and its level was a little higher, the super combination skill formed would be incomparably sick.
In comparison, although Yu Shu’s Soul Strengthening talent was also extremely rare, it was still slightly inferior.
Of course, in the end of this battle, although the Soul-Armored Bone Dragon was heavily injured in the aspect of pets… Zhang Qianyi, who supported the combination skill of the three elemental sprites, still consumed more energy.
At this moment, her face was pale, looking like she had consumed too much energy. Obviously, it was not easy to support pets to use three combination skills.
“Thank you for the fight,” Zhang Qian said to Yu Shu.
On the other hand, Yu Shu was very unhappy.
“Unfortunately, I can’t bump into Shiyu.”
Among the two, the winner would encounter Shi Yu. It was clearly not him now.
“Shi Yu…” Zhang Qian was slightly stunned. Obviously, she didn’t expect that Yu Shu would care about this after losing to her.
“Well, although you defeated me, I don’t think you can defeat him,” Yu Shu said.
Zhang Qianyi: “?”
The pressure Shi Yu gave Yu Shu was much greater than this Zhang Qianyi. Even if that bug couldn’t use high-level props to transform into an ice dragon, he still felt that Shi Yu hid many trump cards.
Shi Yu was his greatest goal in this assessment! Although the other party had defeated him, only he, Yu Shu, could defeat Shi Yu!
“This idiot.” Somewhere in the audience, Yu Shu’s irritable mother saw her son talking to the bright girl opposite after the competition and immediately cursed.
It’s none of your business whether Shi Yu is impressive or not. How are you going to find a girlfriend like this?
“Your son is really a straightforward man…” Just as Yu Shu’s mother was extremely irritable, her cigarette was extinguished, and her lungs were about to explode from anger, an old woman walked over and smiled.
“…” Yu Shu’s mother looked over and said, “You’ve taken in a good disciple. This Zhang Qianyi’s use of talent is very good.”
The old woman nodded and said, “Yes, it’s a pity that her physique is lacking and she can’t use your talent multiple times. If only she were a boy.”
“Girls are better.” Yu Shu’s mother’s face darkened.
At this moment, when they heard Yu Shu’s conversation with Zhang Qian, the venue let out a cry.
This Yu Shu had a very high evaluation of Shi Yu.
The two of them were both popular seeded candidates. Could it be that the two of them knew and had contact?
…
“This unlucky child, why is he drawing attention to him?”
In the prep room, after Lu Qingyi left, Shi Yu ate potato chips. Eleven and Buggy had Happy Water and watched the small television together.
Seeing that Yu Shu did not forget to draw attention for him even after losing, Shi Yu immediately felt that there was a huge grudge and hatred. Wasn’t it just stealing three stalks of Dragon Soul Grass?
However, that girl called Zhang Qianyi… her output was so high.
Shi Yu looked at Eleven, and Eleven quietly licked the happy nutrient solution.
“Your Thunder Palm+Hardening Thunder Armor profundity seem to be a little difficult to resist that.”
“Wuu!” Eleven nodded.
After all, it was one against three, and the other party had the enhancement of her Beast Taming Talent.
“But if we add multiplication, it should be okay. Then, with your rich experience of being beaten and your recovery ability, our chances of winning are still very high,” Shi Yu analyzed.
Although the other party’s move was strong, after that girl used it once, it looked like she would become weak.
“Ji ji ji.” Buggy said to not forget about it.
“You…?” Shi Yu looked at Buggy and said, “Next, be it the Thunder Flame Storm or the Lava Explosion of Yin Zhengfan’s Mane Rock Beast, are you sure you want to go deeper into the battle?”
“Ji…” The green worm was stunned. It looked at its weak body and fell into deep thought.
It imagined the scene of himself being minced into pieces in the Thunder Flame Storm.
It imagined himself being burned into a worm’s ashes in the lava eruption…
Buggy shuddered.
Alright, then it would assist at the edge.
It would be a cheerleader!
After showing off so much, it was time to give up his position as the leader.
“Gulp! Gulp!” Eleven finished the Happy Water in one go and placed the bottle on the table with a confident expression.
“Wuu!!”
It raised its hands high. No problem!
“We have to fight the next two battles well…” Shi Yu’s expression was also serious.
Not only did he have to let Eleven be the main force, but he also had to win beautifully.
It was time to announce the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast.. He had to win first place with the Iron-eating Beast no matter what.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - Splitting Thunder
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Splitting Thunder
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After the third round of assessment, it was a short break.
Whether it was the audience or the candidates, they could find something to eat.
Shi Yu stared at the small television quietly. There was still the last match.
Yin Zhengfan vs Ji Ke.
Ji Ke was that seeded candidate in strange clothes that looked like ancient wuxia clothes.
Her strength was not bad either. The two pets walked the technical path. For example, her Water Blade Mantis used the Water Slash skill as the core to create a fancy saber art. Unfortunately, it encountered Yin Zhengfan.
With a deterrence from Yin Zhengfan’s Zonyan Rock Beast and a spatial shackle from the Sky Crystal Butterfly, he directly took away her two pets’ winning chances.
Yin Zhengfan’s Zonyan Rock Beast also mastered deterrence, but when Yin Zhengfan showed it, no one was surprised.
In the matches earlier, there was a Green Silkworm that could master the dragon’s might. Mid-level transcendent iron-eating beasts could master deterrence. The Zonyan Rock Beast was a pet of a monarch race. It was too scientific to awaken its king’s aptitude.
“Although the technical stream is good, you have to have the ability to support it.”
After watching the battle, Shi Yu only had this feeling. Under the same battle power, it was indeed quite outstanding, but when it came to experts, it was immediately weak.
Letting Eleven use the Continuous Thunder Palm to execute a set of gorgeous and fancy palm skills was far inferior to directly multiplying it and using the Thunder Palm at full strength. It was simple and convenient.
“That lump of Thundercloud Sprite has Thunder deterrence, and this Zonyan Rock Beast has deterrence. It’s not easy.”
Eleven and Buggy ate quietly, not wanting to hear Beast Tamers’ troubles.
Being difficult meant that the enemy couldn’t be insta-killed. That was indeed difficult.
“Fortunately, Yin Zhengfan didn’t contract too many pets…”
Shi Yu got up and stretched his body. Yin Zhengfan had the Beast Taming Space strengthening talent. In theory, he could contract four pets now. However, because he had been a Beast Tamer for too short a time, he couldn’t nurture them. Currently, he only contracted two.
If he completed the contract, the pressure on Shi Yu and the others would increase.
“I’ll go order a box lunch,” Shi Yu said to Eleven and Buggy.
Although he had eaten a bunch of snacks and supplements in the house, he still had to make do with lunch.
“( ? ▽ ?) ~ □ ) Wu!” “Ji!!” Eleven and Buggy raised their glasses to send him off.
…
Ancient Capital Arena.
After the third round of assessment ended, there were immediately only a few scattered people left.
During lunch break, regardless of whether it was the contestants or the audience, they had to eat.
This time, Shi Yu held the lunch box and sat quietly on the high platform. With fewer people, he looked down at the venue from the perspective of the audience and other candidates.
From this angle, he must be very handsome.
“It’s faded…” Shi Yu finished the last mouthful of lunch. Then, just as he was about to get up and return to wait for the battle to begin in the afternoon, his cell phone suddenly rang.
It was from Senior Panda.
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu took the phone.
“Where are you? The assessment passed!”
She was talking to the Iron-eating iron beast evolution details.
“Just now, my father and Director Li received the news!”
On the other end of the phone was Lin Xiuzhu’s excited voice.
Shi Yu smiled. Although he already knew, he still said, “Really?”
“Well, look at the time. It will be announced on the Dong Huang Network at 13: 00 PM!”
Dong Huang network, the official media of the country and the most formal information website.
Shi Yu glanced at the time. It was currently 12: 30. In other words, half an hour later?
At the same time, it was also the time for the first round of the afternoon assessment to begin.
Against Zhang Qianyi.
“I’m looking forward to it…”
Shi Yu looked at the time.
“Then I have to show off a little. After the battle, I’ll advertise on the spot…”
There were so many big shots present. Perhaps he could pull in some investment.
Now, Shi Yu and Panda’s Bamboo Stone Dojo and Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base were in a win-win situation.
Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base, cultivated Iron-eating Beasts.
Bamboo Stone Dojo, teaching the method to nurture iron-eating beasts.
The other industries of Panda’s senior sister grew Iron-eating Beast related food resources.
He was the chief evolution planner of the Iron-eating Beasts, the spokesperson of the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base in Ping Cheng.
He could completely arrange the Beast Tamers who wanted to nurture iron-eating beasts clearly.
Previously, Hall Master Lin had begged Shi Yu to join their family business almost every day.
As the chief evolution planner of the iron-eating beasts, Shi Yu was almost the spokesperson of any iron-eating beast breeding base. Any place with his face on it would become the orthodox symbol.
Behind him represented huge benefits. Hall Master Lin, who had spent hundreds of millions on the iron-eating beast’s evolution, was counting on Shi Yu to save his life.
As for Shi Yu, in the face of Hall Master Lin’s passionate request… Did he have a choice?
“So the current situation is that the richer Senior Panda’s family is, the richer I am.”
“Forget about everything else, I’ll definitely have Eleven’s food in the future.”
Shi Yu sighed. This time, he shouldn’t be considered a pretty boy of rich ladies, right?
He had also played a huge role.
However, in that case, he had to think of a way to let Ping Cheng’s breeding base… No, let the economy of Ping Cheng rise.
After all, the business of Lin Xiuzhu’s family had always been closely related to the economy of Ping Cheng, and it was half country-based and personal-based.
Speaking of which, if he could crack the Ice Dragon Ruins, he would be able to obtain the index and new high-level ruins space.
He just didn’t know what use the ruin bead in his hand had when breaking through the ruins and whether it could be preserved after the battle.
If it could be preserved, its best use had already appeared.
Through this ruin bead, the largest iron-eating beast breeding base in Ping Cheng, the village of giant pandas in Dong Huang, the planting a large number of iron-eating beasts related spiritual plants… In the future, as the iron-eating beasts became monarch races and overlord races, Icefield City might be able to become a first-level city with this.
Many cities really developed under the light of unique pets.
After returning, he had to discuss it with Old Feng and Old Lin to make the greatest use of the ruin beads.
The premise was that when he cracked the Ice Dragon Ruins, this Ruins Bead would not be destroyed—God bless. He also wondered, after the Ice Dragon Ruins space was broken, would there be new ruins…
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He suddenly understood why Bureau 11 had so many ruin beads to distribute.
…
January 10th.
In the afternoon.
The Ancient Capital Arena became lively again.
Many candidates and spectators returned to the arena after lunch to watch the afternoon assessment.
“Although I didn’t pass this year’s assessment, I’ve learned something new. They’re both transcendent pets, but other people’s pets can actually be so strong. Damn it.” In the audience, a candidate complained.
“You’re alright. I’ve already grown three years of experience. My Beast Taming Space has already reached level three, and I can’t even pass the third survival assessment…”
“Brother, it’s alright. We’ll work hard together in the next assessment.”
“Let’s give it a try!”
Various discussions came from all over the venue. The most discussed voices were the advancement battles of the next four semifinals.
Iron-eating Beast Knight, tactical genius, Master Player Shi Yu vs Elementalist Zhang Qianyi, who had the higher chance of winning?
“This time, Shi Yu should be punished, right?!”
Many people thought so.
It wasn’t that Shi Yu attracted a lot of hatred, but he was really a little out of place. Many Beast Tamers were secretly unhappy that they weren’t as good as this guy…
Could it be that acting like an eighth grader with eight grade syndrome was the correct way to become a powerful Beast Tamer? They didn’t believe it! Unless Shi Yu could get first place, only then would they reluctantly follow the trend.
“Zhang Qianyi’s Beast Taming Talent is stronger. Compared to Shi Yu’s telepathy Talent, she’s clearly better. However, how did Shi Yu’s talent manage to train his pet to be so strong…”
“In terms of pets, Zhang Qianyi’s Beast Taming Space has reached level three. Forget about the strength of the pets, the number of them already won. Moreover, Zhang Qianyi can perfectly coordinate their strength into one. This is another advantage.”
The ordinary candidates analyzed, and the Masters also analyzed. This battle… was difficult to say.
Although Zhang Qianyi had hope of defeating Shi Yu, Shi Yu also had a very high chance of defeating Zhang Qianyi.
In the promotional video, the iron-eating beast’s Thunder Palm and the profound skill of hardening were edited.
As for this profundity, because the opponent was too weak in the video, the duration it could be maintained was too short. It was only for an instant, so the power displayed was not obvious.
Now, the only thing that these masters were puzzled about was how Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast’s coordination was. Could it really control the profundities and to what extent?
This might be the most important deciding point of this battle.
Because, no matter how strong Zhang Qianyi’s combination skill was, it was only in the category of combination skills. It was something professional Beast Tamers played with.
As for profundities, they were in another field. They were the unique skills of masters.
“Beep—” After the big screen displayed Shi Yu and Zhang Qianyi’s avatars, Master Qu Jie whistled and signaled for the two candidates to go on stage.
He couldn’t see his expression, but he was very curious about what Shi Yu would do this time.
Zhang Qianyi was a very orthodox battle-type Beast Tamer. Facing a beautiful girl, Shi Yu couldn’t possibly destroy her, right?
It was a normal battle! Leave a good impression on the girl! Don’t copy the Yu Shu style from the previous round!
Master Qu Jie didn’t know why he was worried about the young people.
A moment later, Shi Yu walked out of the candidate passage.
He was still so handsome and cool.
“Junior Shi Yu, charge!!!”
At the spectator area of Ancient Capital University, the seven archeological elites cheered for Shi Yu.
If the top scorer this year could become a new student in the Archeology Department, the Archeology Department would definitely be very in a comfortable state for the next year!
Shi Yu represented their future!
After Shi Yu walked onto the stage, opposite him, Zhang Qianyi also stepped onto the stage at the same time.
There seemed to be more voices calling out to her.
The girls might not necessarily cheer for Shi Yu, but the male candidates would definitely cheer for Zhang Qianyi. As Shi Yu stood in the arena, he only felt that the world was cruel.
“That’s… the sword hilt?”
“You brought a sword?”
After coming up, when Zhang Qian observed Shi Yu and saw something similar to the hilt of a light sword at his waist, she was immediately stunned.
Could it be…
Could it be that Shi Yu’s battle with her this time would be as crazy as the survival trial?
Wasn’t he afraid of being struck by lightning if he went on stage!?
She couldn’t guarantee Shi Yu’s safety.
“Holy shit, Shi Yu seems to have brought a sword.”
“What do you mean? Is he going to overcome the lightning tribulation with the sword?”
Many spectators also realized that Shi Yu carried a prop with him and could not help but be surprised.
“No.” Shi Yu said, “This is only an umbrella. Your Thunder Cloud Sprite’s rain area is too large. I don’t want to become a drenched chicken like Yu Shu.”
Zhang Qianyi: “?”
Master Qu Jie:???
The audience, including Yu Shu:???
“Beep—” Master Qu Jie’s expression darkened. He immediately blew the whistle, indicating for the competition to begin.
Stop chatting, stop chatting, hurry up and fight!
This is a professional assessment, not a chatting stage!
The whistle sounded. Both Zhang Qianyi and Shi Yu immediately summoned their pets.
Zhang Qianyi’s summoning array appeared in the sky, while Shi Yu’s summoning array appeared on the ground.
The figures of the Thunder Cloud Sprite, Fire Sprite, and Wind Sprite, as well as the Little Iron-Eating Beast and Green Silkworm, appeared on the arena in an instant!
Boom!!!
The moment it appeared, the thundercloud Sprite that looked like a black thundercloud activated its thunder skill. Electricity surged inside!
A deafening sound immediately spread throughout the venue, making many candidates cover their ears, their hearts trembling.
However, the main targets of this sound were still the little Iron-Eating Beast standing in the arena and the green worm on its head!
At this moment, with a boom, rain clouds immediately appeared on the field. The rain clouds condensed almost instantly. Raindrops fell, and the sky was pitch-black. The thunder was deafening.
“Wuu!” “Ji!!!” Seeing that the other party actually took the initiative to attack and used a deterrence skill, the dual deterrence of Eleven and Buggy suddenly erupted!!
Although the energy value of the Thunder Cloud Sprite was above Eleven, Eleven’s deterrence proficiency was higher, and he had the support of Buggy!
Boom!
The substantialized aura was intimidating, making the raindrops distort and disappear in mid-air. At this moment, the deterrence collision of the three sprites on the field and even the candidates outside the field could clearly feel… that it was abnormally scary!
With a bang, it was as if the air was colliding with each other. The entire arena was wrapped in two huge auras. As the auras collided, lightning flashed and thunder rumbled in the sky. However, an instant after the collision, the deterrence power of the Thunder Deterrence was quickly suppressed. Zhang Qianyi’s expression didn’t change. She didn’t expect that the Thunder Cloud Sprite’s deterrence could defeat the deterrence of the Little Iron Eating Beast. As long as it could withstand it, it would be considered a victory.
Her killer moves were still not used yet!
Boom!!!
After the thunderclap, along with the rain, a thick thunderbolt accompanied the thunderclap as it rumbled down.
With the double strengthening of storm and deterrence, the power of this high-level thunder skill, had reached its maximum. At this moment, the several-meter-thick thunder pillar descended. Eleven showed an excited expression, making Buggy’s eyes widen as it hurriedly jumped away from Eleven…
“Lightning Blade,” said Shi Yu, who was holding an umbrella at the edge of the arena.
“Wuu!!”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s command, Eleven roared. A strong blue and white electric current began to appear in its palms. At the same time, the lightning began to spread throughout its body and invade it.
Zizi!!!
Under the lightning, its mouth and eyes seemed to be filled with lightning.
In the next moment, all the hair on its body stood up. Its Perfect-level supervision was also activated. It formed a profundity with the Thunder Palm and looked at the lightning in the sky. Its body seemed to have turned into a bolt of lightning itself!!
Then, in this berserk state, Eleven took a deep breath and finally stepped hard.
Crack!
A crack appeared in the arena.
The Little Iron Eating Beast’s figure disappeared on the spot!
The audience’s breathing tightened.
What was it doing?
After a moment, all the candidates looked at the sky. Their hearts trembled violently, and they revealed expressions of disbelief.
Everything happened in the blink of an eye. In mid-air, the high-level skill lightning that the Thunder Cloud Sprite released, which looked like a lightning pillar, was actually divided into two at this moment. It was as if it was sliced apart by the sharpest weapon… And the energy dispersed stopped in mid-air!
Everyone saw that the one who sliced and tore apart the lightning was the little Iron-Eating Beast that leaped up with all its might. At this moment, the blue and white lightning on its hands formed a sharp contrast to the golden lightning summoned by the Thundercloud Sprite. Many people widened their mouths in shock. This, this could also be done??
The lightning was so fast, how did this little Metal-eating Beast cut through the lightning so accurately and quickly!!!
Monster!
Zhang Qianyi and the Thunder Cloud Sprite’s expressions changed almost at the same time.
“Is this the power of the perfect-level Thunder Palm…”
The candidates looked at the little Metal-eating Beast that had fallen onto the charred ground again with high battle intent, and their hearts trembled.
Fuck.
Previously, it had always been Buggy showing off. Now that they saw the little Iron-Eating Beast attack, it immediately gave the candidates an illusion that it was a lifetime ago.
“Apart from the Perfect Level Thunder Palm, there’s also the Perfect Level super vision,” Legendary Yin said quietly. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so easy for this Iron-eating Beast to capture the movement of the lightning and the weak points of energy so easily and successfully cut it open.
This move couldn’t simply be considered a perfect-level Thunder Palm anymore. Instead, it was a profundity formed by perfect-level Thunder Palm and supervision. It was a profound skill that could allow the Little Iron Eating Beast to perfectly control the lightning stimulation!
“Senior, is this the Thunder Palm of your Bamboo Stone Dojo? Impressive!!!” The seven archeological elites in the audience seats of Ancient Capital University said.
The panda senior was silent. She kept feeling that Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast’s Thunder Palm had never been so smooth…

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - The Evolution of the Iron-eating Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: The Evolution of the Iron-eating Beast
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The audience was getting noisy.
Even those master-level Beast Tamers were shocked to see the little Iron-Eating Beast cutting through the lightning so easily!
“After all, this Iron-eating Beast seems to be Shi Yu’s trump card…”
Everyone looked at Buggy, who had crawled to the edge of the arena to watch the commotion, and suddenly remembered that it was the second pet.
“What about this move?”
In the arena, the girl frowned. She was very dissatisfied with the Thunder Cloud Sprite being used as a foil for the Little Iron Eating Beast’s posturing.
She held her hands in front of her, her palms facing each other. Green and gold energy fluctuations immediately appeared between her hands.
“Wuwuwu ~ ~!!!”
In the sky, as Zhang Qianyi used the Elemental Coordination Talent, there was a strange connection between the Thunder Cloud Sprite and the Wind Sprite, as if their minds were also connected.
Zhang Qianyi could use two high-level combination skills multiple times, but using three high-level combination skills once was her current limit.
The lightning couldn’t affect Shi Yu and the others. Zhang Qianyi immediately activated his second most powerful combination skill, Thunder Storm!
It was also called Thunder Cloud Storm!
Boom!!!
Thunder rumbled.
“Yi, Yi, Yi, Yi, Yi…” In the sky, the Thunder Cloud Sprite and the Wind Sprite laughed wildly. The Fire Sprite distanced itself from them in disdain. Then, their bodies quickly turned around. In an instant, a powerful black thundercloud storm formed!
This tornado-like storm had black thunder clouds sweeping inside. Electricity flashed inside, containing a terrifying power of thunder!
Seeing the formation of this super combination skill, many candidates swallowed their saliva.
“How violent…”
In the next second!
The black thundercloud tornado was like a black thunder dragon as it swept towards Eleven, who had just finished showing off.
Thunder Cloud Storm!
“Ji!!” At the edge of the arena, the bug cheered for Eleven. This move was indeed strong. Unless it used the Ice Dragon Whiskers to transform into an ice dragon, it definitely wouldn’t be able to withstand it. Therefore, it was left to the leader!!
However, even Yu Shu’s Soul-Armored Bone Dragon’s Soul Fire Dragon Breath could resist this move, so Eleven was even less concerned.
“Wuu!!!” This time, Eleven also went all out. His whole body hardened, and a metallic texture filled his whole body. At the same time, he activated the Perfect Level Thunder Palm. This time, he chose to use the profundity of the Transcendent Level Hardening and Perfect Level Thunder Palm!
At this moment, it looked like it was wearing lightning armor!
“It’s here…”
Realizing that the Little Iron Eating Beast had entered this special state, many master-level Beast Tamers stood up one after another, wanting to see if it could control this arcane skill. If it could, then Shi Yu and the others were too monstrous. They had just become professional Beast Tamers, but they had already mastered the master-level profundities. They could no longer be described as geniuses.
“Wuu!!!” In the face of the Thunder Cloud Storm, Eleven roared and made a charging action under the state of the Thunder Armor!
Thunder Armor Profundity: a serious attack!
Buzz!!
When Eleven gathered strength, the air seemed to be trembling, and the surrounding lightning shot out intensely.
Crack!
The ground under its feet was also trembling continuously, and cracks spread continuously.
Boom!!
The thundercloud storm that came from the sky was almost instantaneous. Eleven, who felt that it had accumulated strength to the limit, looked up. Its black eyes seemed to have turned into blue lightning that contained peerless battle intent.
At this moment, the Thundercloud Sprite and the other elemental sprites were in the sky and had also released a powerful move… But suddenly, they had a bad feeling.
As the little Iron-eating Beast on the field moved, their bad premonition grew stronger.
Bang!!!
Eleven finally moved.
Under the full power of the Thunder Armor’s profundity, the ground under Eleven’s feet shattered again. The powerful reaction force helped Eleven accelerate and rush out. At this moment, its speed could be described as godly. At this moment, under the enhancement of Hardening and the Thunder Palm, its speed and strength reached their maximum!
Eleven leaped up and directly hit the descending Thunder Cloud Storm!
Eleven, who was a meter tall, was much smaller than the thick Thunder Cloud Storm. However, when Eleven’s thunder palm made contact with the Thunder Cloud Storm, a terrifying power wave erupted from its body and directly changed the form of the Thunder Cloud Storm!
The tornado-like Thunder Cloud Storm was hit by this terrifying palm until it was like a bent bow, and it changed shape with a bang. In the next moment, between the Perfect Lightning Armor’s profundity and the Thunder Cloud Storm, a huge storm swept up, directly tearing apart the floor with cracks. Under the dazzling light and energy explosion, the entire arena was lit up!!
Boom!!!!
In an instant, the Thunder Cloud Storm directly disappeared in mid-air, as if it had been scattered by a punch. Under the sweep of the energy tide, the terrifying storm suddenly blasted towards the sky, forcing the Thunder Cloud Sprite and the other elemental creatures to rise into the sky with frightened expressions.
At the same time, the Little Iron Eating Beast was also blown down by the reaction force of the energy explosion.
However, when the scene on the arena was clear, everyone could see that the little Iron-Eating Beast was standing there unscathed, as if the combination skill just now was only so-so.
Zhang Qianyi, the Thunder Cloud Sprite, and the other pets had extremely serious expressions.
Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others had especially solemn expressions.
“What the f*ck…” In the venue, everyone looked at the little Iron-eating Beast that was unscathed and opened their mouths slightly.
The Thunder Cloud Storm was gone just like that?
It was no problem to resist the Thunder Cloud Storm, and Yu Shu’s Soul-Armored Bone Dragon had also done it. However, the problem was that regardless of whether it was the Thunder Cloud Sprite and Wind Sprite that used the Thunder Cloud Storm or the Soul-Armored Bone Dragon that used the Soul Fire Dragon Breath, they weren’t alone! They were a two pet combo!!
Moreover, the combination skills had been enhanced by the Beast Tamer’s talent enhancement!!
In such a situation, it was very normal for their big moves to be evenly matched.
But now, everyone looked at the Green silkworm that was cheerleading at the edge of the arena. No matter how they looked at it, it looked like a little Iron-Eating Beast. They directly defeated the joint attack of Zhang Qianyi, the Thunder Cloud Sprite, and the Wind Sprite without any effort…
1VS3?
This was too sick! This didn’t make sense!
“The power of this move isn’t enough. What about the three-element combination skill that you used to instantly kill Yu Shu?” Shi Yu asked.
It was as if facing two combination skills was very unsatisfying.
Yu Shu: “F*ck.”
In the spectator area, Yu Shu’s expression darkened. How was he insta-killed? He clearly lasted for a few seconds.
However, was Shi Yu serious? That three-element combination skill was not something that an extraordinary pet could withstand.
“…” Zhang Qianyi ignored Shi Yu. In the next moment, she clasped her hands together. Three-colored starlight seemed to flicker in her palm, and an elemental rain descended from the sky.
Whoosh!!
Wind blades and electric arcs intertwined, water and wind blades entangled, and electric arcs fused with water.
Dozens of small dual-element combination skills descended from the sky, completely suppressing the enemy!!
