Seeing the skill that fell like a small meteor shower in the sky, many candidates opened their mouths slightly.
“Show them more of your power,” Shi Yu said slightly. “Eleven.”
“Wuu!!!” On the ground, Eleven howled loudly. With a wave of its small right arm, the hardening substance was released. A hardening black umbrella was formed and raised up by Eleven. Its movements couldn’t be said to be very similar to Shi Yu, who was holding an umbrella beside the arena. It could only be said to be completely the same!
“Ji!” Buggy quickly crawled back to Eleven’s shoulder to avoid being affected.
Boom!!!
The three types of meteor shower suddenly made the already low visibility venue even worse. In the face of this move, Eleven used transcendent Level Hardening to easily block it.
“Thunder chain!!!”
Zhang Qian shouted, and lightning flashed from the Thunder Cloud Sprite in the sky again. The arena filled with water and electricity suddenly produced a chain lightning that sealed the entire arena and quickly spread close to Eleven and the bug.
Intermediate Lightning Control Skill, Thunder Chain!
At this moment, the entire venue became impossible to stay in.
This was a control skill with a strong paralysis effect. It wouldn’t cause any damage, but it would numb the whole body, causing lightning restraints and affecting mobility. Even pets of the thunder family couldn’t escape.
Eleven’s Hardening and High Speed Healing couldn’t defend against this move, and its thunder resistance wasn’t enough to be immune to this skill. It could only dodge.
“It’s useless.” As the sky stopped raining, Shi Yu put away the umbrella.
The lightning chain flowed crazily in the arena. Under everyone’s gaze, white light condensed on the Little Iron Eating Beast’s back again, and a pair of wings appeared, slowly flying it up.
Everyone was stunned. They quickly looked at the Green Silkworm on its shoulder which had indeed closed its eyes again.
“The Insect God is making a move. The Phantom Illusion is here.”
“Beautiful dodge.”
At this moment, when they saw the worm starting to support the Iron-Eating Beast, many candidates revealed excited expressions.
Half a day had passed. In this Internet era, according to the insane performance of the green worm, literally everyone knew about its playstyles.
Although they didn’t know why a Green Silkworm could master illusions, in short, the Worm God was awesome.
Swoosh!!!
As it had practiced it many times, Buggy’s movements were relatively agile as he flew with Eleven.
However, the lightning chain on the ground also rose into the sky at the same time, turning into a lightning snake that chain in the sky, trying to catch up to Eleven and Buggy.
Zizi!!!
In fact, after leaving the water stain on the ground, the current lightning chain was much easier to deal with. Eleven could completely use the lightning palm to cut it open, and the worm could also cut it with the worm silk. However, as everyone looked at the little Iron-Eating Beast and the worm chased up by the lightning chain, their gazes flickered and suddenly felt that something was wrong.
It seemed like Zhang Qianyi didn’t want to control his opponent at all. She purely wanted to force him to move.
“Thunder Flame Storm!”
Three colors flashed in Zhang Qian’s palm again. Her expression was firm. Since Shi Yu wanted her to use the three combination skills, she would use them well.
Her teacher had said that even commander-level creatures would be injured if they resisted this move.
She was extremely confident in this move!
Boom!!!
In the sky, the Thunder Cloud Sprite, Fire Sprite, and Wind Sprite locked onto the flying Little Iron-Eating Beast and Green Silkworm.
She wanted to see how they could dodge this in the sky!
Although they flew pretty well, the combination of the bug and Eleven was actually full of flaws in the eyes of the pets that could really fly.
“Damn, this woman is so ruthless,” Yu Shu said as he looked at the venue.
Even if that Iron-eating Beast could withstand it, the worm was in danger!!!
It wouldn’t directly evaporate, right?
“!” At this moment, the judge, Master Qu Jie, narrowed his eyes. He was already prepared to control the situation at any time.
After judging this move, even if the worm had hardening defense, it would be very difficult to resist. After all, the basic attributes weren’t enough.
However, for Beast Tamers with rich battle experience, it was not impossible. At this moment, they could directly summon their pets back and then summon them again.
The Beast Taming Space was a perfect transit station!
In the wild, by taking back some pets from battle in time, they could largely avoid fatal injuries.
Of course, the premise was to take back the pet. The safety of the Beast Tamer himself had always been guaranteed.
Shi Yu could totally do that, but in a normal competition, recalling pets was generally regarded as giving up the right to fight for the pet to avoid danger.
Countless masters looked at Shi Yu.
However, at this moment, everyone realized that Shi Yu was not flustered at all.
He even crossed his arms and looked at the sky calmly.
It was as if Eleven and Buggy flying into the sky wasn’t forced by the opponent at all, but because they wanted to do it in the first place.
Under the lockdown of the Thunder Cloud, Fire, and Wind Sprites, Eleven and the bug flew higher and higher, quickly surpassing the height of the three elemental elves.
“F*ck, don’t tell me they still want to play Wuji Airlines?”
“These elemental elves aren’t living targets like Fang Ji’s elves.”
Fang Ji: “Are you crazy?”
Many spectators realized that Shi Yu seemed to be showing signs of wanting to play the Airlines battle tactic again.
Could it be that he was going to add the Thunder Palm this time?
A palm that descended from the sky in the state of the Thunder Armor?
There was no point. At this height, it might not necessarily be able to match the explosive speed brought by the Thunder Palm. Its power wouldn’t increase much. Moreover, the position was too awkward.
Most people didn’t know what Shi Yu wanted to do. Only those who were familiar with Shi Yu at the spectator area of the Ancient Capital University suddenly remembered something.
“Holy shit.” They looked at Eleven, who was facing the three elemental elves who had condensed Thunder Flame Storm in the sky, and suddenly remembered something.
Boom!!
At this moment, under Zhang Qianyi’s weak expression, the Thunder Flame Storm condensed with a bang. The golden, green, and red-colored storm intertwined with each other swept into the sky in a very violent manner, targeting the Iron Eater.
Yu Shu’s Soul attached Bone Dragon was directly insta-killed under this move!
The terrifying destructive power could be clearly sensed by the audience from very far away.
“Can he block it??”
“No, can he dodge it?”
Everyone stared at the sky, but in the next moment, their expressions gradually became strange.
That was because in the sky, facing the rolling thunderstorm, the little Iron-eating Beast let out an excited howl again!
Its eyes were filled with battle intent.
“F*ck, he’s crazy.”
All the candidates saw the Little Iron Eating Beast’s wings suddenly disappear. Then, wings appeared on both sides of the worm. The worm opened its eyes and continued to fly into the sky with horror in its eyes, as if it wanted to fly away, leaving the Little Iron Eating Beast without wings to face the Thunder Flame Storm alone!
It was going to fight head-on? Or in the sky?
Just as everyone was at a loss, they suddenly opened their mouths wide.
They saw an extremely shocking scene.
In the face of the Thunder Flame Storm, the one-meter-tall Eleven fell and hit the Thunder Flame Storm with a palm.
The process was very much like a mayfly shaking a tree. However, suddenly, Eleven’s black hard palm increased dozens of times under everyone’s stunned and unbelievable expressions!!
Boom!!!
In an instant, a huge black palm with a diameter of more than ten meters covered the sky with a bang. On the black palm, there was an intense and violent terrifying blue lightning. This time, compared to the palm, the Thunder Flame Storm became a lot smaller!!
It was expert level in one of the uses of multiplication, partial multiplication!
“How is this possible…” The shocking change made Zhang Qianyi widen his eyes.
In the next second, a huge hardening Thunder Palm that was more than ten meters wide directly hit Thunder Flame Storm!!
“Bang!!” With a bang, the Thunder Flame Storm that originally made Zhang Qianyi extremely confident was actually instantly distorted by the slap when it touched the huge lightning palm that fell down. Along with a terrifying explosion, it dissipated with a bang!
Then, the three types of energy fluctuations quickly wrapped around the Thunder Palm, but it was quickly swallowed by the violent lightning power contained on it, unable to break through the hardened defense layer!!
The huge palm was still falling. In mid-air, looking at the black shadow that fell, the Thunder Cloud Sprite, Fire Sprite, and Wind Sprite also widened their eyes and widened their mouths. But at this moment, facing the huge palm, they also felt a strong deterrence at the same time. This deterrence almost made them unable to react at the first moment. They couldn’t escape the area where the huge palm landed!
Boom!!!
The huge palm “gently” swatted down, pressing down the three elemental elves and continuing to fall towards the arena. In a short moment, it was as if the sky was collapsing. As the huge palm fell, the entire arena suffered the most tragic destruction from the start of this match!!
With a crack, the entire center of the arena was directly flattened!!
A huge palm print was imprinted in the center of the arena!!
At this moment, the palm that destroyed the arena actually had a small tail. It was surprisingly a much smaller bear cat…
“Wuu!!!” The little bear cat let out a fierce roar.
How was it!!!
It named this move…
Before Eleven could finish naming it, the huge palm quickly shrank like a leak. Even shrinking was the size of Eleven’s main body. After all, this move consumed too much energy. When Eleven shrunk to about ten centimeters, it could breathe calmly.
“Wuwu…” The hanging-sized Little Iron Eating Beast climbed onto the gravel and looked at the three elemental elves who fainted in the rubble, as well as the bug that jumped down from the sky again.
This time, Buggy didn’t do the job of advertising the skill name, but Eleven expressed his poor judgment!
Add the name of my combination skill!
The small Iron-eating Beast, the Green silkworm, and the three unconscious Elemental Elves…
There was also the smiling Shi Yu and the stunned Zhang Qianyi, forming the final battle scene.
Silence.
In the entire Ancient Capital Arena, there was an unprecedented silence.
Yin Zhengfan, Yu Shu, and the other seeded candidates and candidates who had already been eliminated looked at the venue in shock.
Not to mention them, countless master-level Beast Tamers were opening their mouths wide at this moment, feeling that it was ridiculous!
“How is this possible!!” Zhang Qianyi’s teacher, an old woman, said in shock.
Beside her, Yu Shu’s mother was also stunned.
This was… multiplication???
Transcendent Level Hardening+Perfect Level Thunder Palm+Expert Level Hardening?
Another high-level skill above proficiency level?!
This is a mid-level transcendent iron-eating beast?? Are you sure you’re here to participate in the vocation assessment and not the master assessment?
Countless candidates’ mindsets exploded. Isn’t this Iron-eating Beast a little too ridiculous! May I ask, where is it for sale?
“It’s indeed multiplication…” Only the Archeological Seven Elites swallowed their saliva and had an expression of ‘as expected’.
Senior Panda and the others’ hearts were thumping. They were extremely excited when they saw the little Iron-eating Beast’s performance.
So powerful…
At this moment, the one who was most shocked was still Shi Yu’s opponent, Zhang Qianyi. She opened her mouth slightly and wanted to say something, but she was already so tired that she couldn’t say anything.
She stared at Shi Yu with a pale expression, as if she wanted to see through him.
Even Master Qu Jie had mixed feelings.
“Are you trying to ask why the iron-eating beasts of medium-level transcendent races are so strong? Moreover, they can multiply?” Shi Yu looked at Zhang Qianyi.
Zhang Qian was stunned.
“Actually, it’s very simple. My Iron-eating Beast has awakened its ancient bloodline and is in a state close to evolution.”
Shi Yu chuckled.
“Evolution??”
The moment Shi Yu spoke, the entire venue froze. Iron-eating beasts could evolve?
Why had they never heard of it?
Many young candidates showed blank expressions.
“Iron-eating beasts… can indeed still evolve.” Master Qu Jie took a deep look at Shi Yu and announced the assessment results.
“Shi Yu advanced successfully in the fourth round of the assessment.”
“Those who want to understand the evolution of the iron-eating beast can go to the Dong Huang Network to check the information.”
As the person in charge of the assessment who had been paying attention to every seeded candidate, Master Qu Jie knew more.
When Master Qu Jie finished speaking, many candidates were stunned. Then, they subconsciously took out their cell phones and searched Dong Huang Net.
Just as they entered the page, the headline was a piece of news that stunned them.
‘The potential evolution of the Iron-eating Beast Monarch is born! Discovered by Archeologist Shi Yu!’

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - Fame Across the Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Fame Across the Nation
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Iron-eating Beast King’s potential evolution?
Discoverer, archeologist, Shi Yu?
“Holy shit.”
Many candidates widened their eyes and browsed the news.
They suspected that they had not seen clearly.
Even some master-level Beast Tamers were very shocked at this time.
“Iron-eating Beast, mid-level transcendent race. Race skill is low-level hardening.”
“In ancient times, this pet had an ancient evolution form. It’s currently named ‘Nine Li War Beast’.”
“Archeologist Shi Yu, through deciphering the ruins of the Iron-eating Beast in the ancient capital, successfully found the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast.”
“Moreover, in September last year, Master Lin Hongnian, owner of the Bamboo Stone Dojo of the United Ancient Capital University, confirmed the feasibility of the evolution method. The first Nine Li War Beast in the modern era was born, and its race level was judged as mid-level monarch!!”
As they extracted the main content of the news and read, the expressions of the candidates became stunned.
They had a ridiculous thought.
Firstly, they were shocked that the species level of the Iron-eating Beast was actually so high after its evolution.
Second, they were shocked that the archeologist mentioned in the news was actually Shi Yu, who was nearly their age or even younger than them. He looked very much like an eight grader previously!
“After the iron-eating beast evolved… is it that powerful?!”
A monarch race was a super race that might evolve out of millions of creatures. They had the “king aptitude” that stood above the transcendent.
Even in the entire Blue Planet, there weren’t many creatures with monarch races. All of them were favored by the heavens and had extremely high positions in nature, at the top of the food chain.
Until now, the beast pet of the monarch race had always been the best pet pursued by all Beast Tamers. It almost represented the highest race that Beast Tamers might contract under normal circumstances.
As for strategic overlord-level pets, at the moment, no country had a stable breeding channel. For legendary Beast Tamers, they were also hard to come by.
Therefore, the discovery of another monarch species pet was definitely super big news for the Beast Tamer domain!
The monarch race meant that as long as the growth situation was good, the growth level would definitely reach the monarch level. The chances of breaking through the racial limit and becoming an overlord were also many times higher than the pets of transcendent and commander races.
If the iron-eating beast’s evolutionary species level was that of a middle-level monarch, this meant that even among monarch species pets, the iron-eating beast’s evolutionary potential and battle power were very good for battle.
In comparison, although iron-eating beasts were rare, they weren’t very precious pets. However, someone had actually discovered an evolution path from a middle-level transcendent race to a middle-level monarch race. This evolution path almost crossed two levels. Everyone immediately knew what this meant.
The Iron-eating Beast was going to be awesome.
Shi Yu was going to be awesome.
No, they were already very impressive.
Everyone looked at the king-like Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast below and was speechless.
They finally understood why the combination of the unknown Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast was so powerful.
Ten years ago, Dr. Zuo Jiangyun discovered the evolution conditions of the low-level monarch race, the Ice Phoenix Moth. She shocked the entire academic world and received both fame and fortune. She had been talked about enthusiastically until today.
Actually, most people could accept this. After all, Dr. Zuo Jiangyun had been very famous before.
But now, a Beast Tamer who had yet to pass the vocation assessment had discovered a monarch race evolution method of pets. This was even more ridiculous news.
“I see…” In the spectator area, Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu and the Little Iron Eating Beast with a complicated gaze. He understood what his father meant by” there’s always someone better “.
Through Shi Yu’s achievements, he understood why Shi Yu was so strong.
Yu Shu and the others also opened their mouths slightly. It was difficult to imagine that the main praise for this news would be Shi Yu in the arena below.
“F*ck.”
This feeling was like being a student, using his parents’ money, but others had already bought a car and a house with his talent. Comparisons were odious.
Relying on a telepathy talent to defeat a group of second-generation heirs, Shi Yu made everyone realize what a true genius was.
All of this might have come from Shi Yu’s unique cultivation method for pets through archeology!
Hiss, an Iron-eating Beast that had only awakened a portion of its evolution bloodline was already so strong. What if it completely evolved?
At this moment, many candidates were envious collectively. They had the urge to contract an iron-eating beast.
After all, after evolution, it would be a pet of the monarch race. If cultivated well, it would basically be 100% able to help them enter the master realm!
…
At this moment, not only was the professional assessment venue in Ancient Capital shaken.
Instead, the entire archeological world had different degrees of impact.
Apart from the Archeology Department of the Ancient Capital University, the archeology students and mentors of the other eight top universities saw the news immediately.
Divine Capital.
One of the nine great first-tier cities of Dong Huang.
If it was said that the ancient capital was famous because it was the capital of many ancient dynasties, then the Divine Capital was famous because there were the most Mystical ruins here. It was a super metropolis with a very rich mythical atmosphere. Some guardian-level creatures lived inside to protect the Dong Huang Continent.
Just like Ancient Capital University, the archeology department of Divine Capital University was also famous in Dong Huang.
At this moment, the archeology department of Divine Capital University was in an uproar. Many students were cursing.
In the class groups of various grades, one could see the mentors expressing their disappointment at their failure to meet their expectations.
[Students, you have to work hard!!!]
Many archeology students’ faces darkened. What was the use of their hard work? The professional accomplishments of their own mentors weren’t as great as this Shi Yu.
Many archeology students had a question. What was the background of this Shi Yu?
Archeology was a subject that consumed a lot of experience. At the same time, many ruins with great value were accompanied by a large amount of danger. The requirements for strength were also very high. Why hadn’t they heard of this guy before?
“Union Ancient Capital University…”
Some people also discovered the key point. After all, the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University was famous. From the looks of it, it was really impressive.
This news also indirectly promoted the Archeology Department of Ancient Capital University.
Apart from that, Master Lin Hongnian from Ping Cheng Bamboo Stone Dojo also received extensive attention.
At this moment, Icefield City.
In the many districts and counties under Icefield City, apart from Ping Cheng, some master-level Beast Tamers from the other districts and counties browsed the news in disbelief.
They knew Lin Hongnian.
He was the richest man in Ping Cheng and one of the master-level Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng. His strength was not bad.
It was actually his Iron-eating Beast that completed the first evolution?
Middle class monarch race?
Pets that had this race would be nurtured seriously in the future. Not to mention Ping Cheng, after that, Master Lin Hongnian’s battle power would definitely become the top even in the entire Icefield City.
But the most important thing was… Shi Yu!
Shi Yu had become somewhat famous in Icefield City.
Back then, it was President Feng of Ping Cheng who led Shi Yu to beat up the geniuses chosen from their district counties until they were speechless.
Then, it was also him who cracked the Ping Cheng ruins!
In the end, not only did he crack the ruins of Ping Cheng, but he also unknowingly went to the ancient capital and cracked an iron-eating beast ruin on the way?
“Holy shit.” The masters stared at the news with blank expressions.
After all, this Shi Yu was only an 18-year-old Beast Trainer.
This experience was too surreal.
“Hahahaha…”
Many Beast Tamers who knew Shi Yu in various parts of Ping Cheng had actually already received the news of Master Lin Hongnian’s Iron-eating Beast evolution. For example, President Feng, the apprentices of the dojo, and Commander He. At this moment, when they saw the news again, they revealed excited expressions.
Although they didn’t know what was going on, Ping Cheng must have become popular too.
Following the official media’s announcement, the other major media outlets also crazily revolved the news of the birth of the iron-eating beast. Many comments below the websites were all asking where there were iron-eating beasts.
“Although I’ve used up most of the assets left behind by our ancestors to buy evolution materials, from the looks of it, this is the right step…” Master Lin Hongnian looked at the news and kept sighing.
Dr. Lu Qingyi coming to send Shi Yu over was not her asking Bamboo Stone Dojo to take care of Shi Yu. From the looks of it, it was clearly sending a god like Shi Yu to take care of Bamboo Stone Dojo!
Not only did he fulfill his wish and let the Iron-eating Beast successfully evolve, but his family’s business might also soar into the sky with this.
At this moment, a group of archeological big shots, including Lu Qingyi, were also watching the news quietly.
The rise of a new star in the archeological world was definitely a good thing for the entire Nation.
Discovering the evolution of a pet monarch was considered a huge achievement. Some archeologists couldn’t find such a valuable discovery even if they studied it their whole lives. They just didn’t know if this would be the starting point of Shi Yu or the end point.
“Who exactly is Shi Yu?”
At the same time, this question quickly appeared in the relevant comments section. After all, the news of the iron-eating beast’s evolution was more about introducing the iron-eating beast. There was not much information about Shi Yu.
However, it was not a big secret who Shi Yu was. After all… the Iron-eating Beast Knight’s meme had unknowingly spread throughout the entire Ancient Capital.
“I think I know of a Shi Yu too. He’s a candidate for the Ancient Capital vocation assessment. He also contracted an Iron-eating Beast. Holy shit, it can’t be the same person, right? Quick, look at the Ancient Capital Association’s official website. There should be a video of him on it. Expect something really crazy!
Ancient Capital Arena.
Many candidates basked themselves in the online questions about who Shi Yu was.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had just finished advertising, completely did not realize the seriousness of the problem.
Shi Yu, the Iron-eating Beast, and the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base… It was time to become popular, but the way to become popular might be a little different from what he imagined…
“This feeling is really good. This time, the “genius archeologist” will probably replace the Iron-eating Beast Knight as my greatest label.”
“As expected of me, I’m so outstanding in everything I do.”
At this moment, Shi Yu stood in the center of the venue. He felt the shocked gazes of everyone and felt a little emotional.
However, Eleven seemed to be even more excited than Shi Yu. After defeating its opponent, it raised its head and put its hands on its hips. It was so awesome.
Unfortunately, Little Eleven, who was only about ten centimeters tall, didn’t receive much attention. Buggy couldn’t help but chuckle beside it.
It felt that the shock it would cause after its evolution would definitely be stronger than that of its leader!
On the other hand, after Zhang Qian put away her pets, she silently watched the news on her cell phone.
So, was the multiplication skill caused by the awakening of the evolution bloodline?
Deterrence was also because of evolution itself! Therefore, awakening a king’s aptitude wasn’t that strange.
“I lost.”
The pet’s species level was lower than hers, their numbers were fewer than hers, and his beast taming talent was inferior to her. In such a situation, she still lost. Zhang Qianyi could only admit that her skills were inferior.
With that, she turned and left.
In the spectator area, seeing the genius student she had accepted stop here, Zhang Qianyi’s teacher sighed slightly. It couldn’t be helped, the opponent was too monstrous.
After his opponent left, Shi Yu also turned around and left. He walked towards the prep room with genius steps, planning to prepare for the final battle.
There should still be little Yin Zhengfan left.
He had to study battle tactics carefully.
The other party probably didn’t know that the transparent worm silk of the Green Silkworm could capture ethereal targets, right?
Perhaps he could use this point to catch them off guard!
If it went smoothly, the bug could fight against the Spatial Crystal Butterfly. As for the monarch species’ Zonyan Rock Beast, it would depend on whether Eleven could defeat it.
As Shi Yu thought about it, he kept feeling that he had forgotten something.
“Wuu!!!” “Ji!!!”
In the arena, Eleven and Buggy looked at Shi Yu, who turned and left calmly, with stunned expressions.
You forgot your pets!!!
Take us back before you leave!
The two pets quickly caught up to Shi Yu.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who suddenly stopped in his tracks. He only recalled his pet halfway through before thinking about all that stuff.
…
In the prep room.
Shi Yu sighed.
After returning, Eleven and Buggy immediately hugged the nutritional fluid and started drinking crazily.
Eleven, in particular, had consumed a lot of energy this time. If it didn’t replenish his energy quickly, the next battle would be difficult.
Fortunately, the absorption effect of the nutritional fluid was pretty good. Eleven had shrunk and could recover faster with Absolute Sleep, so it shouldn’t be a problem to recover to his peak state before the next battle.
As for whether it would tire out in battle, these were the most difficult factors to overcome in a continuous battle. They didn’t exist for Eleven. After all, it could stay up late to undergo high-intensity training. There was no such thing as fatigue in the dictionary.
“Holy shit.”
While Eleven and Buggy were resting, Shi Yu, who was also browsing the news of the Iron-Eating Beast’s evolution, suddenly cursed.
His face was pale, his hand trembling.
F*ck, why was the video of the survival assessment that was only circulated in the professional forums and media in Ancient Capital previously edited? This time, there were news media all over the country reposting it!!
Shi Yu saw many comments below.
[Is this the archeologist Shi Yu who discovered the evolution of the iron-eating beast? I feel that it’s a little different from what I imagined.]
[Survival assessment! Why does it seem so fun?]
[So iron-eating beasts are used as mounts? Then is the Nine Li War Beast also a mount? Please explain.]
[So, is the Iron-eating Beast a battle beast or a support-type pet? I’m confused after watching the video.]
[The Iron-Eating Beast Evolution Discovery is actually so young and a vocation candidate?!! Who has the latest news of the Ancient Capital Assessment?!]
[I’m an examinee, I’m an examinee. The Iron-eating Beast is awesome, and Shi Yu is awesome. He can defeat high-level commander-level racial pets without evolving. He’s definitely invincible after evolving.]
[F*ck, really? Is it too late to buy one before the price increases?]
Shi Yu :”…”
He silently turned off his phone, wondering if these people had paid attention to the wrong point.
However, he didn’t feel that they had paid attention wrongly… He couldn’t help but feel a little depressed.
“Damn it.”
“Senior Panda, transfer the money!”

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - Before the Decisive Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Before the Decisive Battle
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
On the same day.
The commotion caused by the iron-eating beast’s evolution was still brewing.
Shi Yu also realized that those who watched the commotion and liked it were basically young people.
And these people often forgot about the incident the fastest. It seemed like everyone was asking where to buy the Iron-Eating Beasts and whether the price would increase. Though, there probably weren’t many who would really do it in the end.
“When you care about whether the Iron-eating Beast will increase in price, it means that you have no fate with evolution…”
Shi Yu analyzed silently.
“But I have to say. The evolution materials of iron-eating beasts are indeed not cheap.”
“Among all the known evolution paths of monarchs, the conditions are also very harsh.”
“After all, level-seven meteor iron is needed, and it comes from outer space. It’s a rare resource that can’t be replenished. The number is really limited, and it’s not just for the evolution of the iron-eating beasts.”
“In other words, the more people who nurture iron-eating beasts, the higher the price of the resource…”
Shi Yu was silent. Indeed, it was more suitable to call it a Gold-Eating Beast!
However…
He believed that when he researched the iron-eating beast’s overlord race evolution method, these people would not regret it!
At that time, the national treasure would definitely continue to increase in price and become a national-level strategic pet. Every Beast Tamer who cultivated iron-eating beasts would probably be taken extra care of.
Therefore, the most important thing now was to use the Iron-Eating Beast to get first place in the assessment.
After all, judging from the direction of the Internet comments, many people were paying attention to the Ancient Capital vocation assessment now. They wanted to know if he could take first place this time.
“Wuu.”
“Ji.”
After Eleven and Buggy finished eating and drinking, they also opened their cell phones. After looking at the post about the vocation assessment for a while, they were slightly stunned.
In the forum, a group of spectators who did not know the truth were asking about the situation.
The professional candidates who participated in this batch expressed their views on the iron-eating beasts.
Even the Iron-eating Beast that had awakened part of the evolution bloodline could crush the Thundercloud Sprites of the high-level commander races. One against three, the true Iron-eating Beast’s evolution form was definitely impressive. Please don’t worry about investing in it.
“Ji!” Buggy raised its head. Was this considered false advertising?
The leader had indeed awakened the Ancient Evolution Bloodline, but the benefits it brought were only seeing the evolution form and multiplying its physical fitness. It wasn’t as ridiculous as what was said here. If it were a real Iron-eating Beast evolving its form, it would probably be very difficult to do so.
“Sob.” Eleven showed a proud expression. After all, not every iron-eating beast was like Eleven.
“This…” Shi Yu looked at the cell phone shared by the two pets.
They inputted together: “Low, low, low expectations, you people. It’s not a problem to crush a dragon.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Fortunately, because their cell phone numbers weren’t tied, their identities as bystanders were restricted from commenting.
Otherwise, Eleven and Buggy would be the greatest false promotion!
Don’t they themselves know that they couldn’t crush a real dragon?!
…
“Looks like your son is fighting this Shi Yu.”
On the high platform of the Ancient Capital Arena, a white-bearded elder who had been watching the battle with Legend Yin in a corner smiled and said.
“Who do you think will win?” Yin Shi looked at the venue below expressionlessly.
“Well…” The old man pondered for a moment and said,” That Iron-eating Beast’s multiplied attack can be considered to be doing its full power. ”
“Its skill proficiency is very high, and it has mastered many skills, but its basic racial quality is inferior to your son’s Zonyan Rock Beast. Under normal circumstances, these two pets should be 50-50.”
“The key might be in the tactical arrangements, as well as the Sky Crystal Butterfly and the green silkworm with an unknown bloodline.”
At the mention of a pet with a special bloodline, this involuntarily reminded the two of a graduate from an Ancient Capital University, Lu Qingyi.
As an archeologist of Bureau 11, Lu Qingyi’s pets were even more ridiculous. Each of them had a special bloodline.
The Wind Demon Lion, which had the bloodline of the guardian-level creature, the Green Spirit Wind Bird, which had awakened the bloodline of the Phoenix, and the Mermaid Princess, who had the bloodline of the Dragon… These were all related to the gains of the other party’s archeological expeditions.
“Although it looks like the Green Silkworm is inferior to the Sky Crystal Butterfly, I keep feeling that Shi Yu will win,” the old man said with a chuckle.
“Is that so…” Legend Yin muttered.
“Hahaha, no matter who wins or loses, I’m very happy.” The old man’s identity was that of the principal of Ancient Capital University. Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu were both internally determined to enter Ancient Capital University. He would be happy to see who was outstanding!
Legend Yin said, “With Zheng Fan’s strong personality, if he loses, he might not necessarily enter the same university as Shi Yu. With my understanding of him, he should choose a place where the competition is more intense and can help him grow faster.”
The old principal of the Ancient Capital University:???
They were all from the Ancient Capital, could you not joke around?
Then should he be hoping that Shi Yu would lose?
He couldn’t help but look at Yin Zhengfan, who was preparing below.
Currently, Yin Zhengfan was fighting another seeded candidate whose Beast Taming Space had reached level three and whose basic test ranking was also in the top eight.
It was the armor-wearing idiot that Shi Yu had seen after the survival assessment ended.
To be honest, Shi Yu felt that he was much more “eighth grade” than him. Just his clothes were too silly!
However, the other candidates looked like it was only natural. They even envied the armor man’s clothes. This made Shi Yu very confused.
“The Chongyuan Group’s new third-level armor. Rich people. With this, they wouldn’t die from resisting an extraordinary-level pet’s attack, right?”
The special equipment worn by Beast Tamers was made of extraordinary creatures. The founder of the Chongyuan Group had said that transcendent beings were to be used to deal with transcendent beings, with the help of the nature of some special materials. In addition, as long as one side was alive, the other side wouldn’t directly die even if they were on the verge of death. Some special equipment indeed had the capital to allow Beast Tamers to face extraordinary attacks without dying.
Shi Yu :”…”
This was the benefit of being a big brand. Even if the design was second-rate, as long as it had brand effects and practical uses, a bunch of people would accept it.
Therefore, he, Shi Yu, was flashy without substance?
The armored man was a rich Beast Tamer.
Its three pets were relatively similar to Yu Shu’s style. The pets could be combined.
Because he had three pets, even if Yu Shu’s basic test energy was a little higher, everyone still thought that he was slightly stronger than Yu Shu.
These three pets were respectively a high-level transcendent species, Undead-type, and Ghost Horse.
Mid-level commander race, Undead type, Skeleton General.
Mid-level commander race, metal and undead, Sword Ghost.
In addition, he was compared to Shi Yu because this Sword Ghost Beast pet could actually be used by Beast Tamers.
But it just so happened that this armored man, Wang Ling, made the general abandon its skeleton horse, abandon its bone sword, and change them into a Specter horse and Sword Ghost.
Look, this was what a normal Beast Tamer was. He armed his pets with everything. In comparison, Shi Yu formed a sharp contrast with him.
On the battlefield, the fully armed skeleton rider was facing off against the Zonyan Rock Beast and the Sky Crystal Butterfly.
Perhaps it was due to Shi Yu’s provocation, but for the first time, Yin Zhengfan didn’t let the Sky Crystal Butterfly finish its opponent. Instead, he let the Zonyan Rock Beast show off its abilities and used its second skill other than deterrence.
Super Skill, Lava Explosion…
“Roar!!!” The huge rock creature, which was more than four meters tall and looked like a two-legged dinosaur, smashed its fist over after deterrence. During the process of its fist smashing over, its arm directly turned into a huge lava fist made of lava. In the face of this terrifying fist, the expression of the armored man Wang Ling and the skeleton rider was solemn to the extreme.
At this moment, the Specter Horse used the Group Support Skill Charging Horn to increase the team’s speed and strength.
The Skeleton General used the high-level skill, Commander’s Sword. The more teammates it had, the more focused its willpower was, and the stronger the skill.
As for the Sword Ghost, it erupted with a dark light, summoning the Phantom Demon in the hidden sword and increasing its destructive power.
With the combination of the three skills and Wang Ling’s Soul Strengthening talent, the impact of this attack reached its maximum. The entire venue suddenly became quiet.
However…
The next moment, the venue erupted, because the moment the Zonyan Rock Beast’s Lava Fist made contact with the commander’s sword of the skeleton sword riders, it was like a volcano eruption, spewing out countless terrifying magma that instantly swallowed the three pets and sent them flying!!
“Impossible.” Seeing this scene, the armored man, Wang Ling, widened his eyes.
Everyone’s mouths opened slightly, shocked by the power of this terrifying lava eruption.
“That’s all?” Seeing this scene, Yu Shu revealed a disdainful expression. In fact, he knew Wang Ling. The elders on both sides were good friends. After all, the circle of Spirit Mediums in the ancient capital was only this big, so Yu Shu had grown up competing with Wang Ling since he was young. At this moment, he saw Wang Ling lose and shook his head in pity.
“The skills of the three pets are completely uncoordinated. 1+1+1 can’t even be equaled to 3. It’s far worse than Zhang Qianyi’s three pets. This guy’s supposed to be stronger than me?”
“The outcome was indeed Yin Zhengfan vs Shi Yu.”
At this moment, the masters were analyzing the lava eruption in their hearts.
From the looks of its power, it wasn’t as simple as just mastering it. Even if it didn’t reach proficient level, it wasn’t just at entry level.
It should have been trained and strengthened through the rare volcano resource for a long time!
The Lava Explosion that was known for its destructive power as a super skill, coupled with the powerful physique of the Zonyan Rock Beast, directly defeated the opponent unreasonably!
At this moment, after Yin Zhengfan defeated his opponent and spoke politely to him, he looked around and searched for Shi Yu, but unfortunately, he couldn’t find him.
“Wu!” At this moment, Shi Yu was naturally watching the small television silently. Beside him, Eleven and Buggy widened their eyes when they saw the lava eruption. Why was its power so strong? Even as a super skill, it didn’t make sense!
“Don’t worry,” Shi Yu said from the side. “Super-level skills can mobilize much more energy than low-level, mid-level, and high-level skills. It probably didn’t feel good for it either.”
Shi Yu’s gaze was on the screen. Multiplication+Thunder Palm+Hardening. He was confident that Eleven could perfectly suppress this attack, but Eleven’s physical fitness wasn’t that much of an advantage compared to this Mane Rock Beast.
In addition, the Zonyan Rock Beast was a monarch race, and its racial foundation was much higher than the opponents he had encountered previously. In other words, it was more resistant to attacks. Thinking about it, it was really a little difficult.
“In this battle, not only do you have to be stronger than its endurance, you also have to make up for its shortcomings.” Shi Yu quickly made strategic arrangements.
“Come here and discuss this!!”
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Eleven and Buggy looked at each other. Shi Yu rarely personally arranged battle strategies for them, and when he did, it was either because he wanted to do something or because he valued his opponent very much. They didn’t know which one it was this time.
…
In the venue.
The advancement battle between the losers was underway.
Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan were resting silently.
At this moment, Zhang Qianyi vs Wang Ling, Yu Shu vs Miao Dongdong. These battles were also very interesting.
However, the audience was especially anxious now. They only wanted to see the battle between Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan.
“Tell me, which one is more monstrous, Yin Zhengfan or Shi Yu?”
“One is ridiculously young and strong, while the other… Uh, alright, I don’t know how to describe Shi Yu.”
There was a flurry of discussion in the venue.
Those who were paying attention to Shi Yu also clenched their fists. For example, Senior Panda. She had a headache, and she felt even more nervous than Shi Yu himself.
She didn’t mind the potential promotion value Shi Yu brought to the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base after winning the championship. Instead, she purely wanted to see the scene of the little Iron-eating Beast that no one had chosen to realize its dream and defeat all the strong enemies!
“Senior, senior, who do you think will win?”
At the same uninhabited spectating area, the beast-eared girl stood beside Lu Qingyi in admiration and asked.
“Anything is fine,” Lu Qingyi said.
She hoped that Shi Yu could win, but it didn’t matter if he lost. After all, the opponent wasn’t weak either. It was already very unexpected for Shi Yu to reach this stage.
In Lu’s opinion, this was just the beginning.
After the assessment, the Little Iron Eating Beast could directly help the Little Iron Eating Beast complete the evolution of its monarch race with a billion yuan worth of evolution materials. With its current foundation, it could definitely be almost invincible at the transcendent level. It wasn’t impossible to spar with dragons from overlord races of the same level of growth. After all, it had many skills and a high proficiency.
Therefore, Lu Qingyi regarded this battle with both importance and impassiveness. The vocation assessment was only the door to the Beast Tamer domain. Only after that would it truly begin.
Wasn’t this very obvious? Compared to Yin Zhengfan’s two pets, Shi Yu’s two pets had greater potential and could evolve at any time!
“Final assessment, Shi Yu, VS, Yin Zhengfan!”
The audience had no idea how long they had waited. Master Qu Jie, who was in charge of presiding over the assessment, was actually also waiting for this battle.
He took a deep breath and looked at the arena.
He hoped that it wouldn’t be destroyed too badly this time.
He wanted to strengthen the arena so much!
However, that was not friendly to the earth-element pets. For example, the Earth Mouse might struggle during the digging process. Therefore, Master Qu Jie could only repair with tears in his eyes again and again.
The level of the battle determined the level of the venue materials, but the problem was that there was a group of bastards who had displayed the ability to fight above their level. They were usually the group of people that the judge had the greatest headache over.
“Beep—”
Master Qu Jie blew the whistle. Under the excited gaze of everyone, Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan slowly walked up the arena from both sides.
As he walked onto the arena, Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu with a glint in his eyes. Clearly, he had been waiting for this battle for a long time.
As for Shi Yu, he could only smile in response to the child’s persistence. At the same time, he thought to himself,
“Don’t blame me for being ruthless…”

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - Shi Yus Strongest Tactics
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Shi Yu’s Strongest Tactics
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Come on.”
“Yes.”
The two of them nodded at each other.
Seeing that the two of them were prepared tacitly, Master Qu Jie revealed a strange expression.
Hehe.
During the survival assessment, this Yin Zhengfan accidentally lost to that Iron-eating Beast with the Sky Crystal Butterfly once. He definitely wanted to win it back now.
It would depend on the performance of the two parties in this battle.
“Beep!!!”
With Master Qu Jie’s command, the venue immediately changed.
“Roar!!!!”
“Wuu!!! Ji!!”
Before the pets appeared, three roars came from the summoning array on the field.
At the same time, a shocking might erupted from inside!
With a boom, the three auras seemed to make space collide, wrapping the entire arena in the impact of this aura!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The aura continued to squeeze until four pets appeared!
The green worm stood on the head of the iron-eating beast and looked at its opponent domineeringly. Both parties were using their power to bully others!!
At this moment, as expected, the ordinary deterrence emitted by the Zonyan Rock Beast was quickly suppressed by the two pets that were bullying it.
A terrifying aura swept over, making even the monarchs’ Zonyan Rock Beast reveal a serious expression.
As its mind was dizzy, he could only barely resist with its deterrence. Its battle intent was greatly affected.
As for the Sky Crystal Butterfly protected by its aura, it was empty and revealed an apologetic expression.
“Mi ~” Sorry, I lost face.
As the only pet that didn’t know how to deter, the pressure on the Sky Crystal Butterfly was huge.
It glared at Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy. Everyone was clearly having a good time back then, couldn’t they leave them some “face”? Maybe not make them look so bad?
The battle tempo was very fast.
Before the battle and after the battle, Shi Yu was very willing to make friends with his opponent’s pet, but in the battle, he only wanted to win with all his might!
“Sorry, this is all to promote the Iron-eating Beast,” Shi Yu thought.
He could only unseal Eleven and Buggy’s strongest battle strategy!
This tactic was very dirty, disgusting, and violent. Shi Yu originally didn’t want to use it.
He couldn’t bear to use it against a 12-year-old child.
“Wuu!!!”
At this moment, on the venue!
Seeing that he couldn’t instantly kill his opponent, Eleven showed a fierce expression. “Wuu!!!!” With a cry, its body began to expand!
As the ripples around its body vibrated, in the blink of an eye, it became a huge beast nearly ten meters tall!!
The Iron-eating Beast, which was as tall as a three-story building, looked at the Zonyan Rock Beast in front of it fiercely. Its long black and white hair fluttered without wind, and its whole body contained explosive power.
“Holy shit.”
Although they were already prepared for the multiplication of this little Iron-eating Beast’s mastery, seeing it so fierce at this moment, many spectators still subconsciously swallowed their saliva.
“Mi!!!”
At this moment, the Sky Crystal Butterfly opposite was extremely shocked.
Because its spatial shackles could not quickly wrap such a large iron-eating beast.
Moreover, it had fought with the Iron-eating Beast before and knew this guy’s defense. It could completely ignore its spatial oscillation damage!
What was going on!
The Sky Crystal Butterfly quickly searched for the figure of the Green silkworm, planning to pick on the soft target.
It also understood that the Zonyan Rock Beast and the monster Iron-eating Beast were the main combatants on the battlefield.
As for it, it just had to deal with that silly and cute green worm.
However, it was soon dumbfounded.
This was because during the process of the little Iron-Eating Beast enlargement and its hair growing, the tiny Green silkworm went straight into the fur to god knows where and couldn’t be found.
“Roar!!!”
“Wuu!!”
At this moment, the giant transformation was completed. Eleven directly hardened his palm and used the Thunder Palm at the same time. A huge black metal fist wrapped in lightning crushed towards the Zonyan Rock Beast!!
“Earth Collapse!!!”
In the face of the iron-eating beast’s violent attack at the start, Yin Zhengfan frowned and quickly issued an order.
The next moment, the ground under the feet of the giant Eleven collapsed, directly causing its body to sway. Its strength was partially affected, and its strength weakened!
However, due to its huge body, it couldn’t be buried at all. It still continued to attack the Zonyan Rock Beast!!
“Teleport!!”
Seeing that the Earth Entanglement could only restrain the opponent slightly, Yin Zhengfan didn’t choose to let the Zonyan Rock Beast go all out. The Sky Crystal Butterfly directly teleported and disappeared with the Zonyan Rock Beast!
However, in the next second, just as the Zonyan Rock Beast and the Sky Crystal Butterfly appeared again, Eleven seemed to be able to detect them from 360 degrees without any blind spots. After adjusting its body, its Thunder Palm directly smashed towards the opponent that had just appeared!
“What a perfect battle awareness!!”
Seeing this scene, some master-level Beast Tamers couldn’t help but sigh.
It was too ridiculous for it to be so agile in its giant form!
“Rock Transformation, Lava Explosion!”
Seeing that the Iron-Eating Beast was so fierce, Yin Zhengfan’s pupils constricted. The speed of his brain was almost faster than the Zonyan Rock Beast, and his heart rate accelerated to the limit.
“Roar!!!”
This time, there was nowhere to run. The Zonyan Rock Beast roared in anger, but it didn’t want to run either.
In the face of the incoming thunder palm, it also punched out. Its arm turned into a huge lava fist. During the process of the magma wrapping around it, the fist size was actually not inferior to Eleven’s Giant Thunder Palm. Its power was similarly vast!
Boom!!
The huge Hardened Thunder Palm directly collided with the lava eruption!
In the spectator area, the armored man, Wang Ling, had a serious expression. In the next second, he took a deep breath.
At the same time, most of the spectators present also took a deep breath!
Boom!!!
Eleven struck out with its palm, and the moment the two fists collided, the Zonyan Rock Beast’s expression was filled with shock. It was shocked by the other party’s strength, and its body seemed to have suffered a huge impact. The ground under its feet directly shattered, and its huge feet kept moving backward on the shattered arena!!
Moreover, its body kept trembling. The other party’s lightning penetration was so strong that even if it was an earth-element creature, it could clearly feel the excellent resistance effect!
In the interweaving of lightning and magma, the collision of the two pets was very scary. Even the Sky Crystal Butterfly could not interfere and could only hide in the air to avoid the aftermath!
At this moment, anyone with eyes could tell that the Zonyan Rock Beast had lost a lot in terms of strength!!
After the first hit, the Iron-eating Beast roared and followed up with a victory attack. It immediately retracted its arm and threw a second attack!
Boom!!!
The Zonyan Rock Beast was forced to use Lava Explosion again. Once the battle started, it directly evolved into two pets attacking each other with big moves, making all the spectators’ gazes extremely serious!
“Roar!!!”
Under the collision, the Zonyan Rock Beast was once again knocked back by Eleven. It completely relied on the Stone Sealing Skill to prevent itself from being knocked over and resisted with difficulty!
However, many cracks had already appeared on its body. In fact, the Zonyan Rock Beast was also fighting back. During the Lava Fist eruption, the Rock Roar Cannon in its mouth directly hit Eleven!
In this situation, Eleven couldn’t dodge at all, but there was no need to dodge. The hardened substance quickly flowed and instantly covered the area that was attacked. It chose to resist this attack!!
Then, Eleven retracted its arm and threw a third Thunder Palm.
Upon seeing this scene, all the master-level Beast Tamers couldn’t help but say, “This is too fierce.”
F*ck, who exactly was a monarch creature here?
Boom!!
The third Thunder Palm smashed out, and this time, the Zonyan Rock Beast was finally unable to resist. No matter how strong the Lava Explosion was, it was only an entry-level super skill. In the face of a combination skill like Transcendent Level Hardening+Perfect Level Thunder Palm+Expert Multiplication, it could only be suppressed!
“Roar!!!”
After the attack, the Zonyan Rock Beast was directly knocked over and its body shattered even more. It was obvious that it was heavily injured. Although the Rock Roar Cannon hit Eleven the moment it was knocked over, it was useless.
Hardening and high-speed healing only consumed Eleven’s physical strength!
“F*ck, this is an Iron-eating Beast?”
At that moment, everyone was stunned when they saw this scene.
They suspected that this iron-eating beast was the real monarch race.
After all, the huge Iron-eating Beast clearly had the aura of a monarch.
Three strikes directly knocked over the Zonyan Rock Beast!
However…
At this moment, the audience quickly discovered that after the Zonyan Rock Beast was smashed apart, it did not directly lose its combat ability with the strong physique of the monarch race.
Its basic physical fitness, vitality, defense, and recovery power were several times stronger than Eleven. This was an undeniable racial advantage.
Although the Zonyan Rock Beast had flipped over, judging from its panting, it was clearly trying its best to adjust and recover!
In fact, it even wanted to stand up and continue fighting.
On the contrary, after three consecutive full-strength attacks, the huge Iron-eating Beast, which didn’t look injured at all, actually showed an extremely tired expression. It quickly shrank to more than ten centimeters like a leak, and “fainted”.
“What the f*ck?”
The huge reversal stunned everyone.
In the end, it was the Iron-eating Beast that looked so ferocious that had overdrawn its strength and lost its ability to fight?
“No!!” At this moment, Yin Zhengfan’s expression was solemn to the extreme.
In theory, the Sky Crystal Butterfly and the Green silkworm couldn’t interfere during the collision just now.
The Sky Crystal Butterfly had always been in a concealed state. Then, what about the Green Silkworm?
Moreover, by shrinking its body, the pet’s physical recovery speed would increase…
It was far from over. The outcome could only be decided after the Iron-eating Beast was fatally injured!
“Sky Crystal Butterfly, Wind Blade!!!”
“Attack the Iron-eating Beast!”
While the Zonyan Rock Beast was panting and recovering, Yin Zhengfan quickly ordered the Sky Crystal Butterfly.
“Mi!!!”
“Mi!!!”
The Sky Crystal Butterfly looked at the fallen Zonyan Rock Beast and Iron-eating Beast with a trembling heart. It was finally its turn?
However, it had the same doubts as the Beast Tamer.
Everyone had the same question.
Where was the Green Silkworm?
In the end, it evolved into a battle between the Space Crystal Butterfly and the Green Silkworm. Many people had guessed this before, so what about the Green Silkworm?
“Jihehehehe!!!”
As if in response to people’s guesses, the Green Silkworm turned away from the invisible silk coat and directly appeared beside the little Iron Eating Beast.
The invisibility skill was very successful!
It was finally its turn to appear!!!
“It’s the Worm God—It’s the Invisible Worm Silk!”
Everyone was delighted to see Buggy.
However, they were a little conflicted. They didn’t know how Buggy planned to deal with the Sky Crystal Butterfly.
No matter how heaven-defying the bloodline of a low-level transcendent Green Silkworm was, it was still very lacking compared to the high-level Space Crystal Butterfly of a rare spatial-type commander species. The outcome of a perfect evolution without evolving could be imagined.
They had no idea how Buggy was going to protect Eleven.
Everyone thought so.
However, at the next moment, a shocking scene occurred.
The little Iron-Eating Beast, which was supposed to “pass out”, opened its eyes with difficulty and raised its head trembling. With its last strength, it condensed a hardening substance and handed it to the worm.
Buggy took it with a sorrowful expression. “Ji!”
“Leave the rest to me. Don’t worry and go,” it seemed to say.
Everyone: “?”
Then, Buggy’s expression froze and it closed his eyes.
Using the hardening substance as a medium, it began to summon the huge Iron-eating Beast phantom illusion!!!
Boom!!!
The weather changed.
The huge Iron-eating Beast that the Zonyan Rock Beast had used all its strength to put down just now appeared in the arena again. At the same time, a geren silkworm phantom stood on its shoulder!
Expert Level Illusory Phantom, full power burst!
“Roar!!!” The huge Iron-eating Beast phantom let out a roar, and its deterrence was released. Its whole body hardened matter and condensed!!
Everyone was stunned at this moment. They looked at the Green Silkworm guarding the little Iron-Eating Beast with its eyes closed in shock and looked at the huge Iron-Eating Beast Phantom in shock.
“Holy shit.”
Illusionary?
Holy shit, it could be used like this?
4VS2?
Not only was the audience stunned, Yin Zhengfan was also stunned when he saw the huge iron-eating beast that appeared again and looked exactly the same as the iron-eating beast just now.
Only Shi Yu calmly pushed up his nonexistent glasses to act cool.
Since he wanted to promote the Iron-eating Beast, it was obvious that this head-on effect was the best!
Phantom illusions could also be used for publicity!
Buggy could even become an Ice Dragon. It lived with Eleven every day, fought and trained with the living Eleven every day. There was no reason for it to understand Eleven less than an Ice Dragon!
It was far more proficient in projecting Eleven than the Ice Dragon!
Moreover, with the foundation guarantee of the hardened substance provided by Eleven, the projection was also extremely powerful!
The size could be directly changed by the silkworm through multiplication. The Hardening skill was perfectly inherited through a hardening substance medium. Skills such as deterrence, super vision, and absolute sleep were all common between Eleven and the Worm. The silkworm’s Projection of Eleven was much more compatible than the Ice Dragon.
It was just that Buggy thought that the imposter couldn’t defeat Eleven’s main body, so it hadn’t used it before!
But now…
In order to promote the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu planned to let his opponent experience the joy of being crushed by the two Iron-eating Beasts.
“Buggy, kill the Sky Crystal Butterfly!!!”
“Wuu!!!”
The huge Iron-eating Beast’s phantom hardened and flowed, spreading out to form a huge badminton racket in its hand. Then, the Green Silkworm Phantom quickly spat silk at the racket, forming a net, stunning everyone.
Holy shit, what the hell was this?
Badminton racket?
Theoretically, the Butterfly with the Hiding Skill was invincible. Fighting it with this? Were they sure?!
“Mi!!!” The Sky Crystal Butterfly’s eyes widened and it was a little confused.
Only Yin Zhengfan’s expression suddenly changed.
“Teleport, dodge!!”
Boom!!
The huge Iron-eating Beast Phantom held the badminton racket in both hands and directly swept a strong wind towards the Space Crystal Butterfly. The first thought of the Space Crystal Butterfly was that it was hidden, but after hearing the Beast Tamer’s command, it still chose to teleport!
However, just like when the Iron-eating Beast fought the Zonyan Rock Beast, this huge Iron-eating Beast phantom’s reaction speed was also very ridiculous. It was as if it was the main body. Its body turned smoothly, and the ball racket continued to swing at the Space Crystal Butterfly that appeared, instantaneously!!!
“Mi!!!” This time, the Space Crystal Butterfly, which couldn’t maintain Instant Transmission, could only be forced to go into hiding.
At this moment, there was a boom.
The Sky Crystal Butterfly, still hidden, made contact with the net. At this moment, the Sky Crystal Butterfly’s eyes widened.
Then, it felt a huge force coming from the Internet!
With a hum, the insect silk net directly broke through the hidden Space Crystal Butterfly!
The huge Iron-eating Beast phantom hit the “ball” and crushed the crispy butterfly to the ground with a bang!!
Boom!!!
Although the Sky Crystal Butterfly was mysterious, its defense was still the defense of the bug type.
With just one hit, the Sky Crystal Butterfly directly fainted in the huge pit on the arena!
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan was stunned on the spot and couldn’t understand.
Two Iron-eating Beasts, how the hell was he supposed to fight this?!
Everyone fell silent.
He opened his mouth and looked at the Green Silkworm that beat down the Sky Crystal Butterfly.
He understood that the worm silk could break through concealment.
Low-level transcendent Green Silkworm VS high-level commander species Space Crystal Butterfly.
The silkworm made a complete victory…
Then, the most ridiculous thing was that there was another reversal.
The huge commotion made the Zonyan Rock Beast climb up with difficulty. It finally recovered some physical strength and decided to launch another lava eruption!!
After completing this series of smooth attacks, the huge Iron-eating Beast Phantom and the Green Silkworm Phantom disappeared directly. The Green Silkworm, which had its eyes closed, opened them while panting. Then, it closed its eyes and entered absolute sleep to recover.
Just like Eleven just now, its stamina was exhausted.
It would be fine if this ended.
The most ridiculous thing was that at this moment, True Eleven, who had shrunken its state and fallen asleep beside it, had quickly recovered some physical strength. It stretched and crawled up.
At the same time, it continued to expand and expand.
It returned to its nearly ten-meter posture and looked at the giant beast that was also crawling up.
Eleven: “Wuu!”
Zonyan Rock Beast:???
It looked at the Iron-eating Beast that was not injured at all and was even more energetic than itself. It opened its mouth wide.
What the f*ck!
This was the recovery ability that a middle-level transcendent pet could have?
Everyone looked at the arena with their mouths agape.
The seven archeological elites and the elites of the Battle Club from Ancient Capital University widened their eyes.
Are you sure it just fought?
Lu Qingyi, White Brook, Lin Xiuzhu, and the other three seniors fell silent. They realized that they didn’t recognize the iron-eating beast.
“This battle tactic is called the Infinite Cycle Real and Fake Iron-eating Beast Wheel battle tactic!”
Shi Yu thought to himself that he could perfectly use all the accompanying moves of the two pets!
While Shi Yu was lamenting about his talent, Eleven, now gigantic, struck out with its palm again and sent the Zonyan Rock Beast sprawling under its despairing expression.
Mid-level transcendent Iron-eating Beast vs Low-level monarch Zonyan Rock Beast… Iron-eating Beast wins!
At this moment, the entire place fell silent.
No one expected Shi Yu to easily win the final battle through such a heaven-defying strategy.
Yin Zhengfan stood on the spot with a blank expression, losing his train of thought.
He didn’t know what a battle between beasts was.
Countless candidates opened their mouths wide. Those seeded candidates and advanced candidates even felt fear towards Shi Yu directly.
Zhang Qianyi, Yu Shu, and the others were stunned. They thought about how long they could resist this tactic…
This guy’s strategies were very powerful, but why was it so ridiculous every time? It didn’t make sense, it wasn’t scientific. It made one’s brain buzz!
Two multiplied Iron-eating beasts, that was f*cking ridiculous!
“F*ck.” Even Master Qu Jie couldn’t help but say in his heart. This was too disgusting. His heart ached as he looked at Yin Zhengfan, who had a blank expression.
Perhaps it wasn’t that Iron-eating Beast that had mastered sleep-type recovery skills. The other party’s accompanying moves were too dirty.
According to his understanding, the evolution of the iron-eating beast wasn’t so ridiculous!
In the future, don’t f*cking fight with him anymore!
At this moment, the master-level Beast Tamers also fell silent collectively.
Yin Chuan looked at his absent-minded son and couldn’t help but shake his head under the gaze of the old man beside him.
“That Shi Yu…”
“I’ve finally understood the battle tactics.”
His face darkened. He didn’t know if it was good or bad for his son to meet a strong opponent like Shi Yu…
“He… Heh…” The old principal of Ancient Capital University laughed dryly and looked at the venue with a twitch of the corners of his mouth.
He was a little worried that Yin Zhengfan would really run to a different school in the end…
However, although the process of this vocation assessment was a little bumpy, it was finally almost over.
The strongest newcomer in the professional field of Ancient Capital, Shi Yu?
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was standing on the ground, felt his heart burn. Why wasn’t it over yet? He couldn’t wait to choose the third pet with the rich lady! Speaking of which, the Iron-eating Beast would definitely see an increase in the price this time!

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - The Plant Pet Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: The Plant Pet Is Here
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
January 10th.
In the afternoon.
At this time, many people were actually waiting for the subsequent progress of the professional assessment in Ancient Capital.
It was mainly because the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu, was currently using the Iron-eating Beast to participate in the Ancient Capital vocation assessment. Moreover, his performance seemed to be very ridiculous, and it was very difficult for others to not pay attention.
The people who couldn’t watch the tournament didn’t wait for long. Those media outlets qualified to enter the professional examination hall directly released big news!
‘Vocation Assessment: Archeologist vs Legendary Son, Iron-eating Beast Suppresses Monarch, The Birth of the Strongest Newcomer in the Ancient Capital!’
On this day, the news of the vocation assessment in the nine first-level cities occupied the top of the trending search. The news of the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital paired with the evolution of the iron-eating beast was the most eye-catching.
As the Iron-eating Beasts discovered their evolution form, Shi Yu really used the Iron-eating Beast that had awakened its evolution bloodlines to defeat the monarch species pets that had yet to evolve. The Internet immediately exploded, and the Beast Tamers who were paying attention to this matter commented one after another.
“Damn, he really got first place, but I heard his opponent is a 12-year-old child. What’s going on?”
“You call the legendary son of the Zonyan Rock Beast and the Sky Crystal Butterfly a child? However, compared to Shi Yu, Little Angel Yin Zhengfan is indeed a little like a child… He still doesn’t understand the dangers of adults!”
“In that case, the Iron-eating Beast’s potential is really very strong?? Damn it, I should have chosen the Iron-eating Beast as my initial pet, but it’s not too late now!”
“This Shi Yu is too strong.”
As the incident fermented, as well as the revelations of people in the know, other information about Shi Yu was dug out.
High school in Icefield City… A student of the Feeding Department?? He had even interned at the breeding base in Icefield City?
Some voices from Icefield City said that they were classmates with Shi Yu, but they didn’t know much about Shi Yu himself because Shi Yu rarely interacted with others. He was a quiet and reclusive genius.
These people had posted their graduation photos and their credibility was very high. Because of this, the Internet was in a mess.
A quiet and reclusive genius? Everyone looked at the editing of the survival assessment again and felt that something was definitely wrong.
Learning how to feed pets? Everyone looked at the big archeologist title on the official media and became even more confused.
Now, this archeologist from the Feeding Department had become the newbie king of the Beast Tamer assessment in the ancient capital. His battle power was off the charts?
Shi Yu’s personal identity and pet experience were similarly ridiculous.
All over Icefield City, Chen Kai and Cheng Gong, the former combat units, watched the follow-up news in silence.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s reputation could be said to have risen to a new height. Although he was only a professional newbie and would definitely be forgotten slowly as the hot topic disappeared, Shi Yu was also the first to enjoy such attention after just becoming a professional Beast Tamer.
“Iron-eating Beast, buy it!”
“Too late, too late. The Iron-eating Beasts definitely can’t be affordable anymore now. Is anyone going to team up with me to catch a Green Silkworm? The Green Silkworm is also very impressive. The most important thing is that it doesn’t need money. If I catch a Green Silkworm with a hidden mysterious power, I will earn big.”
His words woke up the people from their dreams. Many Beast Tamers who were conflicted about whether they could afford the Iron-eating Beasts locked their gazes on the green silkworms that were everywhere.
The number of insect youths in the Nation increased at this moment.
…
After the battle ended, and after Master Qu Jie announced the results, Shi Yu started to take Eleven and Buggy to replenish their physical fitness.
Before this battle, there would definitely have been many spectators who thought that he wouldn’t fight the Iron-Eating Beast head-on with the Zonyan Rock Beast, because such an Iron-Eating Beast with a disadvantageous physique might not necessarily be able to gain an advantage.
Of course, this was everyone’s analysis on the basis of not knowing about expert level high-speed healing and absolute sleep.
Shi Yu thought that perhaps its physical fitness and basic qualities couldn’t compare, but in terms of explosive damage and physical endurance and resistance to damage, Eleven, who had mastered the profundity of absolute sleep, high-speed healing, and shrinking… Was really not afraid of anyone.
Hardening, multiplication, super vision, Absolute Sleep, Thunder Palm, Deterrence, High Speed Healing… Eleven could be said to be indispensable in this battle. It was the same for Buggy. Every skill was very important.
“I’ve pretty much used all my trump cards. Some powerful Beast Tamers should be able to analyze Eleven and the others’ accompanying moves after this, right?”
Shi Yu looked at the crazily eating Eleven and Buggy and thought to himself. With this strength, the next qualitative change should be after he contracted his third pet or after Eleven and Buggy evolved.
But now, he wasn’t weak either.
Professional Beast Tamers were divided into primary-level, intermediate-level, and advanced-level. Now, in the primary-level and intermediate-level domains, he should be able to kill indiscriminately.
In these two stages, the difference in the strength of the Beast Tamer was not big. The difference was only in the level of the Beast Taming Space. The growth level of the pet was basically transcendent, and only high-level professional Beast Tamers had the ability to nurture the pet to commander rank.
According to what he knew, the female beast-eared senior and the main members of the Ancient Capital University’s battle club were all high-level Beast Tamers.
This was also Shi Yu’s goal during his university days: to become a high level expert.
At that time, he would have enough strength to do whatever he wanted.
At this moment, although Shi Yu wasn’t very tired, he still lay on the sofa and looked at Eleven and Buggy, who were replenishing their energy, with a little melancholy.
“Huh?” “Ji?”
Eleven and Buggy couldn’t help but be puzzled when they saw that Shi Yu was unhappy after getting first place.
“Eat your food,” Shi Yu said.
After getting first place and becoming a professional Beast Tamer, he was about to obtain a large amount of resources. It should have been a happy thing…
However, at the thought of adding nearly 200 Hardening points to help Eleven maximize the Hardening and prepare for evolution, Shi Yu felt a headache. This wasn’t a levelless skill…
Moreover, he also had to help Buggy break through the spatial shackles, Instant Transmission, and Concealment points. Then, he had to level up the phantom and spatial shackles to the point where it could break out of the cocoon and evolve…
It was another difficult task.
Thinking about it this way, perhaps the ten days of the vocation assessment was the easiest time for him.
“I love exams and competitions.”
…
“Junior Shi Yu is awesome!!”
“Impressive.”
The vocation assessment was not over.
For example, Yin Zhengfan would definitely have to battle Zhang Qianyi, who had defeated the armored man. However, Senior Panda, the Archeological Seven Elites, and the others didn’t watch the subsequent matches. They all ran over to Yu Yu’s prep room.
They started to congratulate Shi Yu.
These few people completely didn’t expect that Shi Yu could really take first place in the Ancient Capital vocation assessment.
A few of them didn’t even dare to think about it previously.
“Impressive!” The panda senior holding the camera looked at Eleven and Buggy eating and said excitedly.
“Haha…” Shi Yu sat on the sofa. He remembered that he not only had to take care of Eleven and Buggy, but he also had to give his third pet some extra points. He smiled rather gloomily.
Amazing, right? He exchanged his body for it.
Have you all experienced the life of lying in bed and taking medicine all day long?
“Junior Shi Yu, what plans do you have next? School starts in February. There are still 20 days left. You can relax well. How about we bring you to tour the ancient capital?” Zheng Yingjie suggested.
During this period of time, everyone was busy researching the iron-eating beast evolution. Shi Yu was also busy preparing for the vocation assessment.
Now, with the announcement of the iron-eating beast’s evolution form, the research could temporarily come to an end. There was no need to rush into deeper research. After all, this was a long-term job.
Shi Yu had also become the top scholar in the Ancient Capital assessment. No matter how one looked at it, he should relax for a while.
“We can indeed have them lead you to understand the ancient capital. It’s very big here,” Senior Panda suggested with a nod.
“Senior, you might as well not return to Ping Cheng,” Lin Yu’er said.
“No…” The panda senior smiled. She had been in the Ancient Capital for nearly half a year. Next, it was time to return to Ping Cheng to take a look. Moreover, the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base definitely needed her more than ever.
“I guess I have other things to do too.” Shi Yu smiled and declined.
“I want to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins in Ice Dragon City. This ruin is a chain mission like the one I cracked previously. I’m afraid that I won’t have time after school starts.”
Archeological Seven Elites:???
Damn, he was going to crack the ruins again?
The Ice Dragon Ruins?
They had studied archeology for so long, but they had never cracked a ruin.
And Shi Yu had already targeted the third one?
He wasn’t human…
“Ice Dragon Ruins??” The panda senior frowned and looked at Shi Yu.
“You’re just a professional Beast Tamer. Why would you go to that kind of place?”
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. That place was even larger than the entire Icefield City. The environment was extremely harsh. There were a lot of transcendent-level ferocious beasts, and there were also a lot of ferocious beast communities with commander-level creatures. There was even an ice-element monarch. Master-level Beast Tamers weren’t suited to go deep alone. Shi Yu was only a professional Beast Tamer.
“Don’t worry, safety won’t be a problem. If I don’t have a few masters as bodyguards, I won’t go.” Shi Yu was still very experienced.
If it weren’t for the fact that Yin Zhengfan didn’t want to talk to him now, Shi Yu even wanted to beg him to let his father help…
Eh, wait a minute. Yu Shu’s mother was a Dragon Tamer, right? He wondered if she was interested in the Ice Dragon Ruins… A top-notch Dragon Tamer. This wasn’t for show. Fighting ordinary monarch-level creatures was like hitting a younger brother. She could stroll on the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain alone.
But… Yu Shu didn’t seem to like him either?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He clearly wanted to make more friends!
“Even if you say that…” Senior Panda was still a little worried.” Forget it, forget it. Remember to call my dad. “
She was worried about other masters’ protection, but she could guarantee that Lin Hongnian would definitely not want anything to happen to Shi Yu.
“Alright, I’ll take this call.” Shi Yu smiled. At the same time, he sensed the vibration of his cell phone and took it out.
He looked at the stunner and immediately took a deep breath.
Good, it was Senior Lu.
She called him to the rooftop of the venue to talk about plant pets.
Was she taking him to choose a plant pet?
The third pet was finally coming.
Although the level of the Beast Taming Space was not yet at level three, it was alright to understand it beforehand.
The main reason was that he had a premonition that the pet Senior Lu chose for him must be very rare. If he missed this opportunity, this pet wouldn’t exist anymore.
“I’ll go out for a while,” Shi Yu said to everyone.
Everyone nodded.
“Eleven, Buggy, eat here yourselves.” Shi Yu then said, “By the way, the thing you want is with Senior Lin.”
“Huh?” “Ji!”
Eleven and Buggy suddenly stopped and looked at the panda senior who was holding the camera. They suddenly remembered that there was such a thing.
Next, it was time to admire their heroic bearing.
