They got first place, as expected of them!
“Wu!” “Ji!” Eleven and Buggy quickly ran to Lin Xiuzhu’s legs and looked at her camera.
Lin Xiuzhu smiled. “Don’t worry… I’ll give the videos to you.”
…
On a certain rooftop of the venue.
At the moment, only Lu Qingyi and White Brook were here.
They chatted with each other and discussed Shi Yu.
When Shi Yu came over, the two of them turned around and looked at him.
“Senior Lu, Senior Brook.”
Shi Yu smiled and greeted the two rich girls.
“Shiyu, do you want to join the battle club and the school team after school? I’ll take you to the National League when the time comes,” White Brook invited with a smile.
When she first saw Shi Yu, she didn’t feel anything, but after looking at Shi Yu’s vocation assessment, she realized that Shi Yu’s potential was really strong.
In fact, that Iron-eating Beast and Green Silkworm didn’t even need to learn other skills or increase their skill proficiency. As long as their growth level reached commander rank, Shi Yu would definitely be able to perform well in the National League. After all, there were very few Beast Tamers who could master the profundities in the National League.
If she considered the fact that the iron-eating beast and the green worm could still evolve, she felt that Shi Yu could help Ancient Capital University win a national championship that Ancient Capital University had never won.
“This…” Shi Yu felt tired. Did he have to participate in collective training or something?
“The rewards are very good. Young cubs of monarch species, super-level skill manuals, high-level resources, opportunities to enter mystic realms…” White Brook sighed.” Most importantly, the school’s rewards will only be more than the prizes of the competition. “
Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. “It didn’t matter if the reward was there or not. It was mainly because he wanted to win honor for the school”? He liked this kind of safe competition very much.
Lu Qingyi rubbed her temples and said, “Let’s not talk about things so far away first.”
With that said, she smiled and looked at Shi Yu. “I previously told you that I would take you to choose a plant pet after the assessment.”
“Actually, I’ve already helped you choose seven types. I was afraid that you would be distracted just now, so I didn’t tell you.”
“They come from different places and their states are also different. You should understand them first and choose further. I’ll bring you to take a look personally another day.”
“Let me help you analyze it,” White Brook also said with a smile. She loved to choose pets the most and also liked to help others choose.
“Which seven??” Shi Yu became excited.
Lu Qingyi said,
“Middle class monarch race, wood and dragon types, Dragon Blood Willow.
Low-level monarch race, wood-element, Tree of Life.
Low-level monarch race, wood and spirit dual-element, Blue Spider Lily
Low-level monarch race, wood-element, Mutated Ginseng Baby.
High class commander species, wood type, undead type, Wood Spirit.
Among the high class commander species, the spiritual type Seven Star Four Leaf Clover, with a time talent.
High class commander species, dual elements of spirit and space, Scarecrow Magician.. “

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - Classic Seven Choices
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Classic Seven Choices
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu: Aba Aba Aba Aba…
As soon as the names of Lu Qingyi’s seven pets were mentioned, Shi Yu immediately felt conflicted!
How could he choose!
He didn’t expect that there were actually four monarch races.
Just randomly picking one would make 99.99% of the plant based Tamers green with envy.
“Sigh.”
Beside him, White Brook shook her head.
Shi Yu might not know how rich this woman he’d gotten the favor of was.
A young monarch pet suitable for contracting was something that could only be chanced upon by luck for ordinary master-level Beast Tamers.
But for Lu Qingyi, who had the identity of Division 11 and knew many legendary Beast Tamers, finding it wasn’t a difficult task.
In short, Shi Yu was really lucky to have such a blissful list!
“Some pets might not meet your initial requirements. I’ll explain them to you one by one. You choose,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded obediently.
“The Dragon Blood Willow is the evolved form of the Blood-sucking Willow after it absorbed dragon blood.”
“It’s a special breed cultivated by a top-level master of plant pets who doesn’t like dragons very much. It grows by absorbing dragon blood.”
“At the same time, the tree sap it releases can be bathed in ordinary plants. It can create spiritual plants that dragons like. This is the bait they set up to hunt dragons.”
“This master nurtures a Dragon Blood Willow every few years to give it to someone. This one should currently be at the transcendent level, close to the commander level, in a new life state, and has just evolved.”
“It has the greatest battle potential among the seven pets. It has mastered the super-rank racial skill, ‘Divine Willow’. It’s a war machine that can fight against monarchs and dragons. It’s very resistant to dragons and is a pet that can greatly increase the combat power of Beast Tamers.”
Lu Qingyi smiled.
“This is good, its battle power is very strong.” The beast-eared girl had clearly seen the battle of the Dragon Blood Willow.
That blood-red willow branch could directly penetrate the dragon’s scales. It was very violent!
“Then there’s the Tree of Life. You’re not unfamiliar with it, right?” Lu Qingyi asked. “Isn’t there a monarch level Ancient Tree of Life in Icefield City?”
Shi Yu nodded.
The Ancient Tree of Life was the evolution form of the Tree of Life.
The Tree of Life was also a descendant of the Ancient Tree of Life.
Apart from the first batch of Trees of Life that were born for unknown reasons, most of the origin of the Tree of Life’s saplings were chosen to sacrifice themselves to become a seed after the Ancient Tree of Life’s vitality was exhausted.
“This Tree of Life sapling was born after the death of an Ancient Tree of Life. Its current growth level has just reached the transcendent level.”
“The Tree of Life is a classic healing-type pet. Its own life force is very strong. It has the power to revive some ordinary plants. It can also have very powerful effects when used to treat humans and other life forms. It has mastered the transcendent race skill, ‘Life Gift’.”
“After the contract, it can greatly increase the vitality of Beast Tamers, and it can increase the lifespan of Beast Tamers by several years.”
She explained the benefits of contracting the Tree of Life.
When Shi Yu heard that, he was immediately tempted.
Because he currently had the control of a super skill.
The gift of life, paired with plant control… It would become both a war machine and the strongest gardener.
Just imagine, the immortal and indestructible sea of trees descending…
Compared to the Dragon Blood Willow, the Tree of Life and the Ancient Tree of Life were not pets that were good at fighting. The main classification was still treatment-type pets. However, the reason why the Ancient Tree of Life in Icefield City could become the guardian of Icefield City was that in addition to the racial skill Life Gift, it had also learned the wood-element super skill Plant Control during its long life.
If he chose this, Shi Yu could use that Auntie Ancient Tree’s growth template to nurture this little Tree of Life.
Second, the benefits that contracting the Tree of Life brought to Beast Tamers were also not what other ordinary plant pets had.
The growth and evolution of pets would give the Beast Tamer some power.
The power ratio of the feedback was actually mainly based on the types of pets.
For example, the Iron-eating Beast’s growth gave Shi Yu more basic physical strength.
If it was a spiritual pet, the power it gave Shi Yu after growing up would be that it had more spiritual power.
As for after contracting the Tree of Life, the feedback would definitely be that there was more life force. Therefore, Beast Tamers who contracted healing-type pets generally had higher lifespans.
“This is also very good.” The beast-eared girl nodded.
The Tree of Life, the most reliable partner!
It could fight, it could be a gardener, it could heal, it was perfect!
“The Blue Spider Lily is active in a dangerous place. I’ve gone to investigate before. This is a relatively dangerous plant that has the ability to create illusions, and is extremely resistant to undead creatures. It also has the skill of a transcendent-level illusion-type species, Blue Purgatory.”
“Contracting this is relatively dangerous, but its illusion ability is very reliable. The most important thing is that its seeds can parasitize a Beast Tamer’s body, giving the Beast Tamer the ability to maintain his form even if his soul leaves the body. After contracting it, even if the body accidentally dies, his consciousness can still be maintained in the form of a soul for a period of time. Not bad, very suitable for high-risk workers.”
“Indeed.” The beast-eared girl nodded. As expected of Senior Lu.
Shi Yu :”…”
Damn, that sounded scary.
How was it not bad?
“Then there’s the Mutated Ginseng Baby,” Senior Lu said.
“How did Baby Ginseng reach the monarch race?” Shi Yu asked.
Isn’t this a supplement for transcendent races!?
After hearing this name, he was very concerned.
“Mutated…” Lu Qingyi.
Shi Yu :”…”
“This is a special pet that a senior from Bureau 11 accidentally discovered in the forbidden area recently.”
“It was originally an ordinary ginseng baby. In a place like the dangerous Lost World forbidden zone, its fate was basically to become food for other ferocious beasts.”
“But forbidden areas represent danger, and also opportunities.”
“In that place, it accidentally ate an ownerless level-eight resource, Life Fruit, and survived with a very small chance. Its body mutated and it awakened a transcendent-level wood-element skill, ‘Source of Life’.”
“Its current form is still that of a ginseng baby, but its life force, physical strength, energy value, and race potential have all undergone huge changes. It can be said to have undergone a different evolution.”
“According to the comprehensive judgment of that senior from Bureau 11, its race level should currently be judged to be a low-level monarch. No, it might be even higher, but it’s only so low considering that Baby Ginseng’s race has almost no combat power.”
There were a total of three types of plant-type transcendent creatures.
The battle type mostly evolved from meat-eating plants like the venus flytrap.
For healing types, they had less battle power, but powerful self sustaining capabilities.
The supplement type was the kind of creature that was a nourishing plant before it evolved. Its combat power was the weakest of the three types, and it was also the favorite of other ferocious beasts. Often, the nutritional value of this kind of supplement-type plant pet was the highest.
Baby Ginseng was a classic supplement-type pet. Its battle power was not high, but it could create nourishing supplements for Beast Tamers and other pets to eat. Therefore, there were many places with baby Ginseng farms.
“This mutated ginseng baby has a life force comparable to the sapling of the Tree of Life. Its energy level is also very high, not inferior to the cubs of other monarch species. Its own nourishing effect is also very good. Moreover, it has the source of life, a transcendent skill that can recover life force and physical strength at a high speed. It can quickly produce high-quality supplements at the smallest cost. Its recovery power is strong, and it’s very suitable for those Beast Tamers who have a huge consumption of strengthening talent and physical fitness.”
“If you contract this pet, it’s actually equivalent to giving up your combat power and strengthening your life-saving ability. Although you don’t have an enhanced Beast Taming Talent and don’t need to use physical strength, it can greatly increase the time you use the Ruins Bead to Etherealize. When you reach the Legendary level, you can use your Beast Taming Space for that, and the effect will be even more obvious.”
Shi Yu was momentarily stunned.
The source of life? A super-level recovery-type skill? The minimum cost was to produce high-quality supplements infinitely?
If he contracted a supplement-type plant pet, the feedback from the pet’s upgrade would be physical recovery ability…
Shi Yu was tempted again. F*ck, at the moment, the Dragon Blood Willow and the Paramita Flower were alright, but the Ancient Tree of Life and the Ginseng Baby were both what he needed.
Although the former couldn’t directly produce supplements, as long as there were seeds, the gift of life could quickly mature high-quality supplements with the control of the plants.
The latter was a super supplement in itself, and it also had the ability to produce at a high speed. Most importantly, after contracting the ginseng baby, its physical recovery ability would undergo a qualitative change, which was very compatible with the skill index.
“This is also good,” the beast-eared girl suggested.
Shi Yu: “?”
What kind of advice was this?
Obviously she thought everyone was good!
Senior Lu continued to introduce the remaining three.
The rest had no super skills, nor were they of a monarch race, but they were relatively special pets.
“The wood spirit is a plant spirit born from the evolution of an entire forest. It’s similar to the concept of the soul of a mountain and the spirit of a lake. It can possess ordinary plants and accelerate the growth of this plant, helping it evolve into a spiritual plant and giving it combat ability. As it grows, it can control the entire forest. When the types, quality, and number of plants it possess reach a certain limit, there’s a possibility of it evolving into the monarch’s species pet, the monarch of the forest. It can also awaken plant control skills.”
“This is also very good,” the beast-eared girl praised. Senior Lu is awesome. She actually found so many rare plant pets.
Shi Yu :”…”
It was indeed very good. It could also create an army of supplements. Most importantly, it could form an army of plants according to its own thoughts.
Contracting one was equivalent to contracting a group.
“The Seven Star Four Leaf Clover is a very special plant pet. Its skills are all inclined to the defensive type. It has defensive skills that can withstand various types of attacks. Moreover, due to its small size, it can perfectly cooperate with Beast Tamers and protect Beast Tamers.”
“Apart from that, it also has the mental-type skill of sensing danger that contains a little time element. It can help Beast Tamers turn misfortune into blessings, so it’s also known as the lucky grass. This is very suitable for some unlucky people who like to court death.”
Lu Qingyi referred to those fellow archeologists who had died.
Shi Yu gulped and was tempted again. Time, time, he had finally encountered his first time-type skill!
He wanted this!!
“I want this!” The beast-eared girl also said.
Shi Yu: “?”
“As for the Scarecrow Magician, it is a rare spatial pet that has the miraculous ability of ‘Scarecrow Substitute’. If the enemy attacks the owner of the Scarecrow Magician, it’s very likely that the damage will be transferred to the Scarecrow Substitute created by the Scarecrow Magician. Or perhaps, the enemy’s target from the beginning to the end is the Scarecrow Substitute.”
“This is also a pet that can increase the survival ability of the Beast Tamer.”
This time, before the beast-eared girl could say anything, Shi Yu said, “Do you want this too?”
White Brook shook her head. “It’s too ugly, it’s so gloomy.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Then, have you considered it?” Lu Qingyi smiled at Shi Yu.
Apart from the blue spider lily that she had to capture personally, these pets were all from different places. She needed to rely on connections to buy, exchange, or ask for them. She just didn’t know which one Shi Yu liked more.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
According to his preferences, he first eliminated the Dragon Blood Willow, the Blue Spider Lily, and the Scarecrow Magician.
He didn’t lack pure battle-type pets.
The Lily sounded dangerous to obtain and contract. Forget it.
The life-saving ability bestowed by the Scarecrow Magician wasn’t that needed. At the moment, the ruins bead was actually enough.
Most importantly, Buggy was about to have a space element. Another extra space element was not very attractive to him.
As for the tree of life, the mutated ginseng baby, the wood spirit, and the seven-star four-leaf clover…
Shi Yu once again eliminated the clover and its premonition danger skill. He wanted to see if he could replicate it later. Forget about the contract. He was such an outstanding boy, so his luck wouldn’t be bad.
Then, he rejected Forest Spirit again, mainly because the cultivation period was too long. Moreover, this kind of DIY-type pet needed a bunch of high-level spiritual plant underlings at a glance. Training one was equivalent to cultivating a group. The cost was huge. He didn’t have money anymore! Moreover, the plant control skill awakened after evolution was too boring.
In other words, whoever he taught plant control to would already be the monarch of the forest anyway. There was no need to deliberately pursue this.
In the end… there was still the tree of life and the mutated ginseng baby to choose from.
Shi Yu thought about the advantage of the Tree of Life. Firstly, there was still the evolution of a high-level monarch race. Although the conditions were unknown, there was indeed a possibility of evolution.
Secondly, the Tree of Life was very suitable to be a gardener. With the control of the plants, it could grow various spiritual plants in the ruins bead, not limited to supplements.
However, the disadvantage was that it needed to be cultivated for a period of time. At the moment, the level of the Tree of Life’s sapling was too low, and the level of the gardener’s potential wasn’t high. He couldn’t teach plant control either. Perhaps within a year or two, he wouldn’t be able to experience the joy of quickly producing high-quality spiritual plants. He might not even be able to be self-sufficient, let alone earn money through this.
The advantage of the Mutated Ginseng Baby was that after contracting, it could immediately reflect the speed of physical recovery. With the excellent effect of the skill index, it could provide him with a pretty good points upgrading experience in the short term.
In addition, even without the contract, it could also quickly produce high-quality supplements for the current Shi Yu to use. It could help Shi Yu save a lot of money.
If there was a disadvantage, it was that it had no battle power at all. It was a mutated species, and its future development path was unknown.
“Senior, do you have any suggestions?”
Shi Yu looked at Lu Qingyi.
“I suggest… the sapling of the tree of life, the mutated ginseng baby, the wood spirit, and the seven-star four-leaf clover.”
Lu Qingyi smiled. “The word “lucky grass” isn’t called lucky for nothing.”
“Forest Spirit can be used together with the ruins space. There are many cultivation paths. It can be used to fight, heal, and recover.”
“From the current potential, the highest level can be raised to a high-level monarch. Although the evolution conditions are very harsh, there’s at least a way to find it.”
“However, from your own perspective, I still advise you to contract the mutated ginseng baby the most.”
“As a monarch pet, it’s definitely easier to contract than the other monarch races.”
“Besides, don’t forget that your Iron-eating Beast and Green Silkworm still have to evolve.”
Shi Yu nodded…
“After they evolve, their racial levels might all reach the level of monarchs, and your Beast Taming Space is only at level two. Even if they evolve, they will bring huge feedback to your Beast Taming Space, and huge feedback to you. In theory, it will still be very difficult for you to bear, even if the Beast Taming Space reaches level three.”
“Moreover, during the period when the Green Silkworm is in the form of a cocoon, it’s the stage where it relies on the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space the most. If a pet in the form of a cocoon is raised in the outside world, it won’t be absorbing the nutrients provided by the cocoon and the Beast Tamer themselves. It’s very easy to affect the contract between the two parties. And if it sleeps in the Beast Taming Space, with its current potential… it might be uncomfortable for you.”
“At that time, the Beast Taming Space won’t be able to withstand their growth speed and insufficient nutrition. Your condition will be greatly affected. However, if you contract the ginseng baby, there won’t be this effect. The recovery ability it brings you can largely share this burden. In the future, as the number of pets you contract increases, the value of the ginseng baby will increase.”
“In short, although you have the bead that can replace your Beast Taming Space, I suggest you don’t do this in the long term. After all, the Beast Taming Space is the best place to maintain the bonds between Beast Tamers and pets.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Would it? Eleven and Buggy seemed to have been outside longer than he had in the Beast Taming Space, but their relationship was very good!
However, the best habitat of the cocoon was the Beast Taming Space of the Beast Tamer himself. This was indeed correct, as various academic papers had proven.
Since Senior Lu said so, it seemed like Baby Ginseng was indeed more useful.
“Then I’ll choose the mutated ginseng baby.” Shi Yu finally made a decision.
The life force of the Mutated Ginseng Baby was not inferior to the Tree of Life. As long as he replicated the gift of life, the effect would be the same. At that time, he would teach it the plant control skill. It could also do what the Tree of Life could do. It was not a problem for it to have weak combat power!
Furthermore, it could completely digest a level-eight resource and transform itself into the number one mutated ginseng baby. This ginseng baby was also very unscientific. Although its future potential was unknown, it didn’t necessarily mean that it was weak. It might mean that its talent was ridiculously good. Shi Yu kept analyzing.
However, at that time, the combat power of a supplementary ginseng baby would be off the charts… That would be f*cking hard to explain and unscientific. It was even more ridiculous than Buggy. The ingredient, fighting people…
“You chose it? Actually, you can choose two or three to see for yourself if it’s suitable before deciding,” Lu Qingyi said.
Shi Yu was stunned. Was this a chance for him to replicate the skill first…

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - A Ginseng Baby With A Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: A Ginseng Baby With A Dream
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, Shi Yu indeed wanted to copy the skills of the other six pets and teach them to Baby Ginseng.
He couldn’t take all the pets, but couldn’t he take the skills? He was a human-type skill teaching machine!
But soon, his heart trembled.
There was really no other way.
Currently, there were 15 pages of the skill index.
Apart from the worm silk, the skills mastered by Eleven and Worm had already occupied 13 pages!
In other words, there were only two empty pages.
Even if he wanted to replicate the skills, there was no place left!!!
Unless the Beast Taming Space reached level three and he contracted the ginseng baby, which would increase the page count.
However, it might be a few months later when the Beast Taming Space reached level three…
During this period, the value of any skills recorded in these two empty seats was not high.
Life Gift, super level. If he couldn’t teach it, it would be useless at the moment.
Divine Willow… was he going to let Baby Ginseng use the roots of the ginseng to poke the giant dragon? The problem was that this was also a super level skill, so he couldn’t teach it.
The baby ginseng might not necessarily be compatible with Blue Purgatory. Buggy had a chance to learn it, but it was still a super skill.
Then, there was a slightly valuable straw substitution skill. At the moment, it was not very urgent to be using etherealization either.
The only thing he was a little reluctant to do was the “danger sense” skill…
At max level, could he predict the future?
It sounded delicious. What if it could be used to buy lottery tickets?
However, this thing felt like a passive skill. Even if he met the Seven Star Luck Grass, he might not necessarily be able to replicate it…
In other words, even if he could replicate it, he wouldn’t be able to use it in the short term. It would only occupy a slot.
It was far inferior to copying the racial skills brought by the ginseng baby to help him upgrade points, all so that he could recover its physical cost more quickly.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The page number restriction of the skill index didn’t allow him to go all over the place. It only allowed him to calculate carefully.
“At the moment… I’m more interested in baby ginseng and four-leaf clover.”
He could go to Icefield City in the future to look for Auntie Tree of Life with the Life Gift skill. This didn’t matter.
However, time-type skills were a little difficult to think about.
Lu Qingyi was slightly surprised. “These two pets happen to be the easiest to come into contact with.”
Shi Yu: “Huh?”
“The mutated ginseng baby is currently in the ancient capital.”
“And the Seven Star Four Leaf Grass is the school beau of Ancient Capital University. It’s in the garden of Ancient Capital University.”
Shi Yu: “?”
This Seven Star Four Leaf Grass was actually the same as him, within the Ancient Capital University?
Fate.
However, it was a pity that it was about to miss the opportunity to increase its points. It looked like the lucky grass wasn’t that lucky.
It was fine not to choose the fake lucky grass, in case it backfired in the future…
“Seven-star Four Leaf Clover… is it in Ancient Capital University?”
“Yes, but there aren’t many four-leaf clovers cultivated in Ancient Capital University either. They’re usually only used to reward outstanding students.”
“After all, although premonition danger hasn’t been classified into the time department, there’s still a time element. It’s very rare.”
The beast-eared girl said. This kind of life-saving divine pet was what many Beast Tamers pursued.
Shi Yu was stunned. Then there was no hurry.
The Ancient Tree of Life and the Four-Leaf Grass… He would have plenty of time to encounter them in the future. He would think about replicating skills when he had extra space!
“In that case, Senior Sister, let me take a look at Baby Ginseng first.”
“Alright.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
“I think the Baby Ginseng will be very happy to see you.”
“Why?” Shi Yu was curious.
“Grandma Li of Bureau 11 raised these supplementary pet beasts most likely to make soup. If we were to take it, it would be lucky to escape.”
What the heck?!
Was such a rare pet used to make soup???
Shi Yu’s expression darkened. What kind of devil was this senior from Bureau 11?
…
In the end, Shi Yu decided to meet the mutated ginseng baby first.
He and Senior Lu had agreed to visit this senior from Bureau 11 tomorrow.
As for later… there was still business.
Shi Yu rushed back to the venue.
When the ranking assessment ended, Shi Yu received a license.
He was relieved to have his license.
Professional Beast Tamer license!
The dark red booklet symbolized his identity as a professional Beast Tamer. Shi Yu finally obtained it.
Apart from Bureau 11 documents, Shi Yu also had a second useful certificate.
With this, he would have a certain discount when using planes and other transportation in the future.
He would also be qualified to apply for certain danger areas.
In addition, for Beast Tamers with professional licenses, the Beast Tamer Association would also provide some guaranteed funds every month to reduce the pressure on Beast Tamers to train their pets.
Initially, this was what Shi Yu was most concerned about. He planned to rely on this to repay the loan, but from the looks of it, this bit of money was nothing.
The greatest use of the professional Beast Tamer license… No, the greatest use of the whole assessment, for him, was the number of cultivation resources he could obtain after entering the Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu held his license and opened the certificate. On it was his handsome profile picture.
“They’ve edited this picture before, right?”
Zheng Yingjie looked over and said.
“Indeed.”
“They’ve even taken away my natural and erudite aura.” Shi Yu shook his head.
Who edited this photo? Couldn’t they not photoshop it without permission.
They had to apologize to the fangirls in this country.
When Shi Yu was surfing on the Internet with his cell phone, he realized that he had female fans. From the looks of it, although the Iron-eating Beast Knight’s actions were second-rate, looks were always the first concern.
Senior Panda and Qi Yingjie :”…”
As expected of you, Iron-eating Beast Knight.
“Try to get an intermediate certificate as soon as possible,” the panda senior said to prevent Shi Yu from continuing to be narcissistic.
“Yes, try to quickly upgrade the certificate. This is just the starting point.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled.
Advancing to the intermediate title still required an assessment.
But at that time, the assessment would be relatively simple.
It wouldn’t be as grand as the vocation assessment. Instead, professional Beast Tamers could participate in the assessment at any time.
It required the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space to reach level three.
At the same time, it required the Beast Tamer to have the ability to last five minutes in the hands of a commander-level pet.
Regardless of whether a Beast Tamer contracted one, two, or three pets, or sent out a few pets, as long as they could fight a commander-level creature for five minutes without any external help, it would be considered to have reached the requirement to advance to an intermediate-level Beast Tamer. At that time, the benefits would increase.
This goal was not very far from Shi Yu.
It was relatively easy to cultivate the first three levels of the Beast Taming Space. In addition, he had a pile of Ethereal Stones to support his cultivation. In about a few months, he could level up.
On the same day, the vocation assessment ended.
While the other candidates were being contacted by various factions, Shi Yu, who had already internally decided to enter Ancient Capital University, ran to have a meal with Senior Panda and the others to celebrate.
It had been tough on him for the past ten days.
In order to welcome the next higher difficulty point upgrading, he had to reward himself these two days!
…
At the same time.
Somewhere in Ancient Capital City.
In a ruin space filled with plants.
A ginseng baby was sitting on a branch swing, thinking about ginseng life.
Baby Ginseng looked like a ginseng. There was a ginseng flower on its head. It had crystal clear big eyes, an exquisite mouth, and small hands. It was very cute, about 20 centimeters tall.
All along, Baby Ginsengs had always given people a lively, energetic, honest, and cute image…
But this baby ginseng was always frowning and worried when it swung the swing.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng looked up.
Thinking back to its miserable life.
It was born in an extremely dangerous and resource-rich forbidden area outside the Dong Huang Nation, a place that belonged to ferocious beasts.
Baby Ginseng itself was a “resource” produced by this treasure land, for other beasts.
Fortunately, after it was born, the ginseng baby was lousy, so it lived on because of its low nutritional value.
High-level ferocious beasts were everywhere. An Awakening-level ginseng baby was not enough to fill the gap between the teeth.
Most ferocious beasts knew to fatten up first before eating, so Awakening-level supplements were generally safe.
This ginseng baby didn’t know whether to be glad that it was too weak or troubled that it was too weak.
After understanding its situation, Baby Ginseng had been living cautiously. However, its luck was really off the charts.
For some reason, it encountered a level-eight spiritual fruit, Life Fruit, that even overlord-level creatures coveted. There were no ferocious beasts guarding it.
The Fruit of Life emitted a rich aroma, and the Baby Ginseng couldn’t help but eat it.
Normally speaking, after this… the Baby Ginseng would definitely die from overeating.
However, its luck exploded again. Under its extremely uncomfortable state, its body mutated. It didn’t know how long it slept. During this process, it completed its evolution.
After it woke up, it could clearly sense that it had become much stronger and had immediately stepped into the transcendent domain.
It was overjoyed, but before long, it encountered an extraordinary-level ferocious beast that stared at it eagerly.
Baby Ginseng’s heart skipped a beat. The joy of becoming stronger was gone. It only felt that it was going to die.
A supplement-type pet had too much energy in such a dangerous place. In fact, it was better to be weaker.
What made Baby Ginseng the most uncomfortable was that although it had become stronger and awakened a few new skills, it still didn’t have any offensive skills.
The Mutated Ginseng Baby still retained the characteristic of a supplement-type plant pet that had almost no combat power. Under such circumstances, it directly cried in the face of the transcendent ferocious beast that was eyeing it covetously.
However, after the mutation, the nourishing effect of the ginseng baby was indeed much more ridiculous.
After being tortured by the transcendent-level ferocious beast, Baby Ginseng directly made a final struggle and used the nourishing “Sweet Aura” skill, then…
The transcendent-level ferocious beast, due to the intense sweetness, fainted. It fell down with a nosebleed, and Baby Ginseng escaped.
In the next few days, when facing low-level ferocious beasts that weren’t that strong, it used this method to escape. There were also a few times when danger surrounded it. The other party had just bitten it and directly fainted from bleeding from all seven apertures, losing the ability to fight.
Baby Ginseng’s profundity: I’ll nourish you to death!
However, this situation didn’t last long before it encountered a monarch-level ferocious beast.
This time, the sweeter Baby Ginseng was, the more excited it was…
Baby Ginseng was helpless..
Then, it was captured by the other party.
However, Baby Ginseng didn’t expect that this ferocious beast was the pet of a human Beast Tamer.
After being caught, the human Beast Tamer directly placed it in the ruins space.
After arriving at this plant ocean that was completely different from the restricted area of the Lost World and was like a paradise, filled with replenishing pets of the same type, Baby Ginseng was stunned.
Then, it cried again.
It felt like he had come to heaven.
This place looked much safer than the outside world.
However, before it could be happy for long, the pile of supplementary pets raised here told it the truth.
This was an old witch’s spare ingredient storage. They had to provide supplements to the old witch every day, or else they would be made into soup.
Baby Ginseng’s heart skipped a beat again.
Then, every time it was grabbed by the old witch to cut and study, it would be so scared that it would be made into soup.
It was too difficult.
Due to the birthplace of the Lost World’s forbidden area, it had seen too many passing monarch-level creatures. Baby Ginseng looked at the other supplementary pets in the ruins space who were peacefully accepting the current situation and felt a sense of melancholy.
Why were they all at ease, they were backup ingredients!
If possible, it didn’t want to be a ginseng baby or a backup ingredient.
It wanted to be a king of ferocious beasts with extremely strong strength that could decide its own fate.. The super fierce kind.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - The Third Pet
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: The Third Pet
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The next day.
Morning.
The weather was good.
It was a good day to act cool.
Shi Yu stood outside the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute and looked at the sky. He took a deep breath.
But today, forget it.
As he was going to visit a senior from Bureau 11, he had to be more obedient.
“You two, take it easy. You can rest for two days.”
Before leaving, Shi Yu thought to himself.
Just as the vocation assessment ended, Eleven and Buggy started another round of special training in the ruins space. They were too diligent.
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Eleven and Buggy said that there was no problem.
If they worked hard now, they would be able to enjoy extra points without feeling guilty in a few days!
They already had a premonition that a new storm would begin when Shi Yu was free.
Moreover, didn’t he go out today to forage for supplements?
It was a complete sign of increasing points…
“It’s not foraging for supplements…!”
“It’s to find a new companion for you.”
“Although the meaning is similar?”
…
After the vocation assessment ended, the candidates went home and discussed business.
After a night of celebration, Shi Yu had recovered to his optimal state after eating and drinking well.
Using the cell phone’s navigation, Shi Yu happily arrived at the arranged meeting place with Senior Lu.
Ancient Capital City Museum of Ancient Life Petrification.
This museum was built 47 years ago, and it covered an area of 30,000 square meters. The museum displayed biological fossils from the totem era to the Beast Taming Era, such as various dinosaurs, Sword Fang Beasts, Abyss Rhinos, Sea Space Giant Kun, and various other ancient biological fossils.
“Senior Li is here. She’s the curator here. She likes to study the fossils of extinct pets and use this to study the history of various eras.”
“She has heard the voices of many biological fossils and used this to discover many secrets, restoring many historical gaps.”
While Shi Yu was waiting, Lu Qingyi appeared behind him and spoke.
After Shi Yu saw Lu Qingyi, he said, “So Li Lianping is a senior from Bureau 11??”
来之前,他自然调查过博物馆资料.
The tickets to this paleozoic fossil museum weren’t expensive either. Ordinary people could come and visit as they pleased, but the curator was actually a senior from Bureau 11. Shi Yu really didn’t expect this.
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
“This was established by Senior Li when she was young. She established this fossil museum because she actually wanted more people to understand the history of the past. She also built fossil museums in several other first-level cities, but most of the time, she won’t stay in the same place. These places are just temporary footholds for her to explore various locations.”
As Lu Qingyi spoke, the glass door of the museum opened automatically. A short old woman with silver hair and a single ponytail walked out slowly in a white research coat.
She stood at a high point and looked at Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu who were chatting. Her gaze flickered.
She looked at this reserve member of Bureau 11 carefully and observed Shi Yu, who had caused a stir in the archeological world because of the archeological discovery of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.
“Looks like Qingyi takes very good care of this new member.”
“But of course. After all, she’s the only one in Bureau 11 who’s about her age.”
Li Lianping, the senior of Bureau 11, walked out.
Lu Qingyi’s method of finding plant pets was very crude.
She directly inquired on social media, and then a bunch of acquaintances with channels contacted her.
Li Lianping happened to catch a mutated ginseng baby at that time. After asking Lu Qingyi for its use, she said that she could take it.
“It’s Senior Li.” At this moment, Lu Qingyi also saw Senior Li.
The next moment, Shi Yu quickly looked in the old lady’s direction.
Shi Yu looked at the old woman who had her hands behind her back, whose white coat fluttered without wind. Her expression was calm, and his heart skipped a beat. This Senior Li looked so strict…
…
In a room in the museum.
This senior from Bureau 11 made hot tea.
After the three of them sat down, Shi Yu looked at the old senior up close and realized that her aura had gradually faded.
Now, she looked like an old lady next door, looking at Lu Qingyi and him kindly.
“Shi Yu, right?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded obediently.
“Qingyi has already mentioned you to me a few times.”
Lu Qingyi was silent beside him.
Really?
But did a group of seniors like her take the initiative to ask her for this information back then?
Senior Li Lianping clearly had other things to ask.
“How many times have you entered a ‘listening’ state?” she asked Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was stunned and immediately said, “It should be four times.”
Stone statue 2, ruins 1, ruins 1…
“Four times in half a year.” Li Lianping nodded.
This Shi Yu was a good seedling.
No wonder he could break through two ruins in a short half a year. His talent was very good.
“What do you think is the most important thing to listen to the voice of history?”
She took a sip of bitter tea and looked at Shi Yu again.
“Curiosity, and… desire for the truth of history,” Shi Yu said without hesitation.
Although he didn’t hesitate, he still felt a little hesitant.
Because sometimes, his curiosity was strong enough, and the ruins didn’t appear.
On the other hand, when he offended the ruins, the ruins directly appeared.
This was an unimaginable path. Perhaps in the future, if he encountered an unsolvable situation, he could give it a try…
“Your desire for the truth?” Li Lianping nodded again.
She was already satisfied that Shi Yu, who had not undergone systematic learning, could say this.
She continued, “Qingyi has already told me that your third pet needs a plant-type pet, right?”
“I believe my ginseng baby has already introduced it to you.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Apart from not having battle potential, the Mutated Ginseng Baby is indeed the best choice. It’s not very useful to me. In that case, take it away.”
“Thank you!”
“But there’s something I have to remind you of.”
“This mutated ginseng baby has some problems because it’s a mutant.”
“But maybe it matches your personality.”
“…” Shi Yu’s expression was odd.
He felt that this development was a little familiar…
Also, why were problem pets always compatible with him???
“Let me show you.” With that said, Senior Li stood up.
Lu Qingyi also quickly stood up. When Shi Yu saw this, he immediately stood up.
In the next second, Shi Yu’s brain buzzed as he appeared in a huge plant garden.
The fragrance of various plants instantly entered Shi Yu’s nose.
He breathed in the fresh air and immediately felt more energetic.
“This is the ruins space. This place is where I use to specially grow some nutritious medicine. That ginseng baby is here.” Grandma Li put her hands behind her back again and looked at a tree branch swing.
The place where she appeared with Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi was right beside Baby Ginseng.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi saw this little fellow in the form of an ordinary ginseng baby at a glance.
However, there was indeed a problem with this little guy.
He saw that it was holding a broken branch and waving it around.
“Yiya!!!”
“Yiya!!!”
His expression was solemn and serious, like a swordsman who was training hard.
Seeing this, the nearby Hundred Flower Queen Bee, Sky Devouring Dragon Frog, Worm Grass, Lingzhi Monster, and other supplements shook their heads.
This new baby ginseng was probably a fool.
Look at that group of spiritual peaches playing hide-and-seek. They had the awareness of being supplements, of being kids.
It was just a ginseng baby, what did it want to achieve?
“Hua!”
The supplements watched with interest as Baby Ginseng trained its battle skills. In the next second, they suddenly dispersed because the old witch had come.
Baby Ginseng, who was focused on honing his combat skills, was the last to notice.
As the shadow approached, its movements stiffened. It slowly turned its head and looked up at the tall old witch, Shi Yu, and Lu Qingyi.
Then, it revealed a pitiful look.
Ginseng Baby: QAQ
“Yi…” Could it be that today was another day of research?
Forget it, just cut it. It had good recovery abilities anyway, so it could recover no matter how much it cut.
“It’s indeed very similar to you.” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were both weak chickens, but they had the experience of pretending to be swordsmen. They were a perfect match.
She roughly knew what Senior Li meant when he said that there was something wrong with this mutated ginseng baby.
This ginseng baby probably still didn’t understand where its talent was. It didn’t have the awareness to be a supplement-type pet at all.
Shi Yu :”…”
Good lord.
Shi Yu exclaimed.
He felt that something was familiar. As expected, it was another problem pet. It was even more unconventional than Eleven and Buggy.
“It’s exactly as you see. You have to train it well in the future,” said Senior Li.
If a supplement didn’t train those recovery skills and healing skills properly and ran to train battle skills, wasn’t this being negligent?
This was different from Eleven. Eleven worked hard to train because of its poor talent, while this ginseng baby was clearly ridiculously talented, but it didn’t develop in the right direction.
Shi Yu’s expression was strange. An iron-eating beast that wanted to become stronger, so it was extremely self-disciplined, a green worm that wanted to become stronger every day in its daydreams, and a baby ginseng that had battle dreams and wanted to become stronger… They were very compatible! It looked like the third one was indeed this Ginseng. It should be able to integrate into this big family very soon.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng looked carefully at the old witch, the new little witch, and the little demon.
How was it going to be dealt with today?
“I like it very much,” Shi Yu said. “I feel that it will indeed be very compatible with me.”
Senior Li nodded. Since Shi Yu himself felt that there was no problem, there was no problem.
She looked at the mutated ginseng baby and said telepathically, “Then from today onwards, you should follow him. In the future, he will become your Beast Tamer.”
Baby Ginseng was stunned.
It wasn’t getting cut today, but sold?
Baby Ginseng:???
Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu, who was smiling at him. It was at a loss and panicked a little.
Who was this? It kept feeling that Shi Yu’s gaze at it was plotting something.
Just like those transcendent creatures that wanted to eat it…
No!!!
It would rather continue to stay here and be sliced up for research.
“However, your Beast Taming Space doesn’t seem to have reached level three yet. Are you preparing to raise it in the ruins space first? Or are you going to leave it with me first and contract it after you level up?”
“Although this ginseng baby doesn’t have any offensive skills, it’s not without combat power. Before contracting, you still have to be careful when touching it.”
“Its recovery skill has so much energy that it can completely burst a creature. In terms of effect, it’s similar to a Beast Tamer eating a divine bean. That’s not a supplement, but poison.” Senior Li looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s expression turned serious. There was such an amazing thing like that?
At that time, he would like to compete with Baby Ginseng. Would it nourish faster, or would he, Shi Yu, be faster at draining his energy through upgrading points?
“Let’s bond for a while. I believe I can get along with it.”
Shi Yu said.
The three of them were talking normally, so Baby Ginseng naturally didn’t understand.
Only when it was being specifically spoken to it would it use its telepathy ability.
Shi Yu squatted down and looked at Baby Ginseng. He said telepathically,
“How about coming with me? I’ll help you develop your battle talent. Who said Baby Ginsengs can’t fight?”
Leave with him as a Ginseng Baby.
Ten years later, it would be the Heaven Ascension Emperor.
Baby Ginseng was stunned. It gulped, but it still looked at Shi Yu warily.
It felt that Shi Yu was a liar.
However, Shi Yu’s words made Baby Ginseng very concerned.
This ginseng baby was not very old, and its mind was that of a child. It was at the stage where it believed everything others said.
“Yi…”
Really??
Shi Yu said in all seriousness, “You don’t have any resistance against me. Why would I lie to you? Isn’t it easy to harm you? Is there a need to lie?”
Ginseng Baby: ?_?
Damn it, Baby Ginseng’s defense was broken.
Its weak heart was shattered by Shi Yu.
“But although you’re very weak now, I guarantee that your battle power will have a qualitative leap in half a year. Do you want to believe me?”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand, wanting to let Baby Ginseng climb onto his palm.
At the side, Senior Li and Lu Qingyi saw Shi Yu squat down and communicate telepathically with the baby ginseng. Although they didn’t know what they were talking about, they were quietly waiting for the results.
This was the advantage of being a Beast Tamer with the gift of telepathy.
Before contracting, one could communicate with their pets on a deeper level. The success rate of contracting was the highest of all talents.
“Yi!”
Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought.
It pondered over Shi Yu’s words.
It seemed like it really had no choice.
Most importantly, if it was disobedient, it would become soup.
Baby Ginseng was helpless..
Then, it would reluctantly believe it.
It would believe this human for once, for the battle dream!
“Yi!!”
Baby Ginseng rubbed its tears and climbed onto Shi Yu’s palm with a determined expression. Then, Shi Yu smiled and stood up to take a closer look.
Seeing this, Senior Li and Lu Qingyi revealed surprised expressions.
Was he able to make Baby Ginseng let down its guard so quickly? It looked like Shi Yu was quite talented.
“Eh, it’s a little fragrant.”
After raising the ginseng baby, Shi Yu sensed the fragrance of the baby and could not help but comment.
“Don’t smell it. Even if it’s just an ordinary body fragrance, you’ll feel dizzy,” Senior Li quickly said from the side.
After all, it was a ginseng baby of a monarch race. Even if it wasn’t a sweet scent skill and was just an ordinary body scent, a Beast Tamer at Shi Yu’s level would feel like he was drunk if he took a deep breath.
However, Shi Yu had already taken a deep breath.
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked at Senior Li and said, “It’s alright. I have a body that absorbs supplements easily. It’s just an ordinary fragrance. It won’t affect me.”
His expression was normal, looking completely unaffected. The physique of humans couldn’t be compared to each other. He had once eaten divine beans as candy in an extremely weak situation.
Senior Li and Lu Qingyi were speechless.
“Yi…” At this moment, Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu, who was constantly breathing deeply, and panicked again.
It still felt that this human was up to no good!!! Could this guy really let it leave the status of being a supplement and become a battle member?? Trust him??

chapters.title: Chapter 136  Baby Ginseng's Sect Brother Position
chapters.content:
Chapter 136  Baby Ginseng's Sect Brother Position
Then, Senior Li began to tell Shi Yu about the specialness of the ginseng baby.
< Name > Mutated Ginseng Baby
[Attributes]: Wood
[Race Level]: Low Class Monarch
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Sweet Aura (Low-level wood-element skill, releasing a refreshing fragrance. The fragrance has the effect of easing fatigue).
Slow Healing (Low-level wood-element skill, can slowly heal one's injuries)
Earth Chain (Intermediate earth-type skill, self-linking to the ground, using the power of the ground to recover physical strength)
Nutrition (Intermediate wood-element skill, can condense one's strength into nutrients suitable for absorbing).
Source of Life (transcendent-level wood-element skill, transforming the body into a source of life, can greatly increase the level of life, and accelerate the injuries and physical recovery speed).
This mutated ginseng baby had three more skills than normal ginseng babies.
They were the Earth Chain, nutrients, and source of life…
Ordinary ginseng babies, as extraordinary creatures, only had two skills: Sweet Fragrance and Slow Healing.
Sweetness could only be used on others.
In addition, the sweet aura couldn't be preserved, and its form was unstable. Every time it was released, too much would be wasted, and the effect was ordinary. Therefore, generally speaking, the breeding base of breeding ginseng babies basically ignored this skill.
In addition, the sweet aura couldn't be preserved, and its form was unstable. Every time it was released, too much would be wasted, and the effect was ordinary. Therefore, generally speaking, the breeding base of breeding ginseng babies basically ignored this skill.
On the other hand, some hotels and entertainment venues liked to place some plant pets that could release sweetness.
The best-selling part of the ginseng babies was still the parts cut from their bodies. This could be preserved for a long time and had high nutritional value.
This was how Shi Yu usually ate the roots of the ginseng baby.
Therefore, the Ginseng Baby Breeding Base basically only cultivated their slow healing skills.
This skill was a low-level version of high speed healing. It could slowly heal one's injuries, but it couldn't heal others.
Therefore, the cuts slowly healed. The world of Ginseng Babies being hurt came into existence.
As for Earth Chain and Nutrition, they were actually skills that could only be awakened after a baby ginseng evolved.
The former could use the power of the land to recover its physical state. Coupled with slow healing, it could allow the sliced baby ginseng to recover faster.
As for the ginseng baby that had learned nutrition, it meant that it didn't need to be sliced.
This was because Baby Ginseng could use this skill to directly condense the nutrients with nourishing effects in its body. Moreover, the nourishing effect was better and the preservation time was longer.
As for the source of life, it was the foundation of the power of this mutated ginseng baby.
This was the same as the Gem Cat's Eye. It was a passive skill to modify the body. Learning this was equivalent to indirectly increasing the level of one's life.
This ginseng baby could immediately break off its branch and be reborn after being bitten by a transcendent beast in the Lost World's forbidden zone. It could rely on its own nourishing effect to make the transcendent beast faint. This skill was the most important.
Its sweet aura, slow healing, Earth Chain, nutritional supplements, and other skills were all ridiculously effective under the enhancement of the source of life.
After Shi Yu realized all the skills of this mutated ginseng baby, he almost laughed out loud.
It was too miserable.
There was really no attack skill.
They were all skills born to become supplements.
"Let's go out," said Senior Li after a while.
"Alright." Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi nodded.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was getting more and more nervous. It listened to the three of them talk about itself, but it couldn't understand. It could only take the initiative to imagine things in a bad direction…
In short, it had to be obedient… Otherwise, it would be made into soup!
…
In the museum.
Shi Yu put the ginseng baby on his shoulder. He felt that it was much more useful than Eleven.
The bodily fragrance that emitted from time to time made Shi Yu's condition very good.
In the future, he didn't have to carry Eleven to sleep anymore. He should carry Baby Ginseng instead.
No, the panda bed didn't seem to conflict with the ginseng baby.
At this moment, Shi Yu was in a pretty good mood, while Baby Ginseng still had a depressed expression.
It didn't know if the final outcome of him choosing to follow this human Beast Tamer was good or bad…
"You guys are really compatible…"
Although Lu Qingyi didn't know what the hell was with the "physique to easily absorb supplements", seeing Shi Yu interact with such a nutritious pet without being affected, just this point alone was not something that ordinary professional Beast Tamers could do.
"No, no…" Shi Yu smiled.
This was considered a praise, right?
Perhaps, it was like praising his son and father for looking alike, or for a married couple to look alike?
"Heh heh…" Senior Li looked at Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng and smiled.
This way, Shi Yu could freely use his etherealization ability in the future.
Contracting this ginseng baby was a huge guarantee for Shi Yu's personal safety.
There were very few Beast Tamers who had the talent to listen to the Voice of History. She didn't want anything to happen to Shi Yu either.
"Then, I'll leave this ginseng baby in your care," Senior Li said with a nod.
This ginseng baby was considered rare and special.
Even if a master-level Beast Tamer saw it, their eyes would turn envious.
But she was already past that stage.
Only an overlord species pet could move her heart.
The supplements of low-level monarch races were just soup for her…
She just didn't know what kind of sparks this special little guy could spark with Shi Yu, a newbie from Bureau 11 in the future.
"Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it."
Shi Yu said to Senior Li, "Grandma Li is generous!"
Senior Li smiled. "Alright, I won't stay long either. It's time for lunch. Go back."
…
Soon after, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi left the museum.
Senior Li rejected the invitation for the three of them to eat together.
"Senior, thank you."
After coming out of the museum, Shi Yu started to thank Lu Qingyi again.
Lu Qingyi shook her head. "You're planning to return to Ping Cheng next, right?"
"Yes." Shi Yu nodded.
"When are you preparing to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins? I'll go with you," Lu Qingyi said.
In fact, she had also explored the Ice Dragon Ruins a few times, but she didn't gain anything.
This time, Shi Yu had obtained the key item. She wanted to take a look with Shi Yu.
"Senior, you're coming too??"
Shi Yu was stunned. Although he didn't know Lu Qingyi's exact strength, it shouldn't be lower than master level.
"You don't want me to?" She smiled.
"No, of course you're welcome," Shi Yu said.
"I haven't confirmed the exact time, but I should go take a look soon."
"Alright, then tell me two days in advance," Lu Qingyi said.
"Alright."
Because Senior Li didn't come, Lu Qingyi didn't plan to eat lunch either. She said, "In that case, I'll leave first. You can slowly cultivate your feelings with Baby Ginseng first. Remember to look after your pets. Don't let them accidentally eat Baby Ginseng."
Baby Ginseng:???
Although it didn't know what the two humans were talking about, it felt like it had been shot again.
"No, no, no."
Shi Yu didn't know whether to laugh or cry. Eleven and Buggy couldn't even wait to worship such a nutritious pet like Baby Ginseng.
If they directly ate the ginseng baby. How could the ginseng baby nourish the Beast Tamer's body so that he could give them the pleasure of upgrading points?
Throughout the entire process, Baby Ginseng listened to the two humans' weird language blankly from Shi Yu's shoulder and did not dare to interrupt.
Only when Lu Qingyi also left, leaving only Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng, did Shi Yu speak to it.
"I'll place you in a ruin space later."
"That's the same place you were at before. Your two future companions are also there. They're also my pets."
"You go in first. You guys get to know each other. I'll go in later too."
"Yi?" Baby Ginseng's eyes widened.
Companions?
It was more worried about whether it would be bullied.
…
Then, Shi Yu sent Baby Ginseng into the ruins.
As for himself, he started to take a taxi and prepared to return to the research institute.
He and Senior Panda had booked a flight back to Icefield City tomorrow, so they had to stay in the Ancient Capital for another day.
At this moment, in the ruins.
Baby Ginseng directly entered the ruins and appeared beside Eleven and Buggy.
At that moment, Eleven and Buggy had just finished training and were resting.
Eleven was about ten centimeters long, and it was definitely sleeping. Buggy was also sleeping and resting.
However, as Baby Ginseng entered, the two pets immediately opened their eyes.
The three pets immediately stared at each other.
A Historical Meeting.
"Yi?"
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was stunned.
It didn't expect that Shi Yuzhi's companions would actually look so weak!
They looked even weaker than the other supplements in the garden.
Look at this little iron-eating beast. It wasn't even as tall as its shoulder.
Look at this little green worm. Wasn't its status even lower than supplements?!
Baby Ginseng took a deep breath. Its initial worry disappeared immediately, and it felt that it was safe again.
It originally didn't have much confidence, but it suddenly felt that becoming Shi Yu's pet seemed to be pretty good.
Perhaps its position in the team would be very high.
After all, it was a ginseng baby that walked out of a dangerous place like the forbidden zone!
It had to be confident!
It was actually very strong.
Were so many transcendent-level ferocious beasts that were defeated by it fake? No, it happened!
It was indeed different from the others. It still had some talent!
"Wuu!!!" "Ji!!!"
Eleven and Buggy, who saw Baby Ginseng, were also very excited, their eyes shining.
Not bad!
It smelled very nutritious!
The renewable supplement Shi Yu found was really good!
They all greeted Baby Ginseng.
It meant that our future happiness depended on you!
Of course, as Shi Yu had yet to contract with the ginseng baby, it was very difficult for Eleven, Buggy, and the ginseng baby to communicate normally.
This problem also stumped Eleven and Buggy.
However, these three pets were all gesture masters.
With the language barrier, they directly used body language.
A moment later, Eleven and Buggy "understood" Baby Ginseng's meaning.
"Yiyi, Yiyi, Yiyi!" Baby Ginseng swung its fists and legs, meaning that it would be the boss here in the future.
As long as Eleven and the bugs were obedient, it could reward them with sweet air and nutrients to smell and eat. It was very helpful for their growth.
Look at your little arms and legs. In the forbidden zone, any monarch-level creature that passed by would scare you to death with a little bit of deterrence!
Baby ginseng was clearly knowledgeable.
Coming from a place like the restricted area was also the foundation for it to have such awareness.
However, Eleven and Buggy couldn't understand, so they didn't.
They understood it as the supplement telling them it didn't feel safe with them, and that it hoped to see their strength.
Eleven and Buggy looked at each other to show their understanding and nodded seriously.
This made Baby Ginseng happy. It didn't expect the situation to change so quickly.
However.
In the next second, under Baby Ginseng's shocked gaze, the little panda that was originally not even the size of its shoulder became more than ten meters tall. Its monarch aura leaked out as lightning flashed and thunder rumbled all over its body. It threw a punch into the distance.
"Wuu!!!!" Eleven created a super huge pit with a bang, causing the ground to tremble, making Baby Ginseng almost unable to stand steadily. Although the terrifying deterrence didn't attack Baby Ginseng, it immediately made Baby Ginseng feel the same terrifying aura as those forbidden zone kings!
"Roar!!!!"
On Buggy's side, it was similarly ridiculous. In the blink of an eye, it turned into a frost dragon that wasn't inferior to the size of Giant Eleven. It also emitted a terrifying dragon might, and strong snowstorms lingered around it!
The aura was similarly terrifying.
Then, Eleven looked at the tiny baby ginseng with its blue eyes that contained lightning. The giant dragon formed by the worm also lowered its head slightly.
"Wuu!!!" "Hou!!!"
They expressed to the ginseng baby that there was no need to be afraid after joining the team. With them protecting it. it just needed to provide Shi Yu with nutrients at ease.
Baby Ginseng:〒▽〒?!!
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was trembling in fear, and its gaze gradually exploded!!
It immediately understood. It wasn't the position of the boss in the team at all, but the position of the younger brother in the team. These guys actually knew how to transform. It couldn't compete with them!

chapters.title: Chapter 137  Best Partner
chapters.content:
Chapter 137  Best Partner
In the face of the giant Eleven and the Ice Dragon Buggy, Baby Ginseng became depressed and understood that it was useless.
In a place like the forbidden zone, it was trash.
In the old witch's botanical garden, it was trash.
Now that it had come to a new environment, it was still trash.
"Yi!!!"
Baby Ginseng sat on the ground and started thinking about ginseng life again.
The more it thought about it, the more annoyed it became. As it thought about it, it fainted from anger and fell down with its head tilted.
Eleven, Worm:!!!
"Wuu!" "Ji!"
Baby Ginseng suddenly fainted, scaring Eleven and Buggy, who were showing off their strength.
The two of them quickly recovered and ran to baby ginseng.
What… happened?
Their deterrence didn't touch the ginseng baby!!!
Eleven hurriedly checked and realized that Baby Ginseng's breathing was very even. It should have fallen asleep due to excessive mental pressure.
"Ji!"
Buggy was scared. It was good that he didn't die.
"Wuu!"
Eleven nodded and wiped its forehead nervously.
This ginseng baby was too weak.
"Huh?"
But soon, Eleven was stunned.
It used its super vision to observe Baby Ginseng. Eleven was surprised to discover that this guy's energy value… seemed to be even greater than its own.
Its energy value was so huge that it was even higher than that Zonyan Rock Beast. It was a bit exaggerated.
So, was it weak or strong…
…
When Baby Ginseng woke up, Shi Yu was already in the ruins space.
"You're awake!"
Shi Yu sat cross-legged in front of Baby Ginseng and waved at it.
Eleven and Buggy stood on both sides of Shi Yu like guardians.
Baby Ginseng, who woke up, immediately widened its eyes when it saw Eleven and Buggy.
"Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi!!!"
Ginseng Baby: I don't want to be the boss anymore, I'm still a baby!
"Uh…" Shi Yu was stunned.
He looked at Eleven and Buggy. What exactly were they talking about???
"Wuu?" "Ji?"
Eleven and Buggy looked innocent. There was nothing at all.
"Forget it. In any case, Baby Ginseng, welcome to the team!" Shi Yu said to Baby Ginseng again.
"In the future, the four of us must get along harmoniously!"
"But I have to correct you."
"You're already five years old."
"And Eleven isn't even two years old. Buggy isn't even one year old yet. They're the babies."
Shi Yu said in all seriousness. Baby Ginseng was a baby, but in this team, it wasn't entirely a baby.
Eleven and Buggy also nodded seriously. Big Brother Ginseng, you have to take good care of them in the future.
Baby Ginseng:(◐ o ◑)?
Baby Ginseng looked at Eleven and Buggy, who had just become ten-meter-tall monsters and dragons, and its mouth fell open.
Was this a year old???
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Baby Ginseng started to hammer its skull with its fist, unable to accept reality.
It felt like he wasn't awake yet.
Eleven, Buggy, Shi Yu:…
This ginseng baby indeed looked very problematic.
A moment later, Baby Ginseng cried: o(╥_╥)o
It kept feeling that everything that happened around it was strange.
"Yi…"
At this moment, Baby Ginseng raised its head nervously.
It asked Shi Yu if what he said was true.
Could it really become very strong?
Seeing how unscientific Eleven and Buggy were, it felt like it could believe Shi Yu.
It also wanted to become as strange as this ten-centimeter panda and worm.
"It's no big deal…"
Shi Yu smiled as he looked at Baby Ginseng and thought about whether he should fulfill his promise now so that Baby Ginseng could believe in his abilities.
As long as Baby Ginseng acknowledged him, even if there was no contract, Baby Ginseng would be obedient.
He looked at the thirteen skills in the skill index.
Skills with offensive abilities, Hardening, insufficient compatibility. Plant control, its physique was too weak for him to teach. Spatial shackles, illusory illusions, and thunder palm similarly didn't have enough compatibility…
It was a little difficult…
However, it could be taught to multiplication.
This multiplication…
Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng with a strange expression.
A multiplied ginseng baby?
Even though multiplication was also a strengthening-type offensive skill, why did it feel like after installing it on Baby Ginseng, it became a supplement strengthening skill?
No, deterrence could also be taught.
A king of ginseng babies that could have deterrence was probably as ridiculous as a king of green worms that could deter.
After choosing the two skills, Shi Yu chose multiply.
He smiled and looked at Baby Ginseng. "Eleven, multiply."
At the side, Eleven didn't understand, but it still nodded obediently and immediately multiplied in size.
One meter, two meters, three meters, four meters… Three meters, two meters, one meter. One moment, it enlarged, and the next moment, it shrunk, displaying the multiplication skill.
This made Baby Ginseng's mouth open slightly. It was this skill! What a ridiculous skill!!!
Thinking of the ten-meter-tall Eleven just now, it immediately swallowed its saliva.
This was one year old?
The kings in the forbidden zone weren't that big, right?!
"This is a multiplication skill. It can make the body huge. During the process of enlarging, the body's strength will increase by a lot."
"Think about it, if you had such a huge body, how much would your strength increase? If your strength increases, won't your battle power increase?" Shi Yu analyzed.
Eleven and Buggy looked at each other. They didn't know if the increase in battle power had increased.
"Yi?"
Baby Ginseng was indeed thinking according to Shi Yu's train of thought. It imagined itself, which was ten meters tall, and felt excited.
Baby Ginseng wiped its saliva: (✪▽✪)
Could it learn that?
"Under normal circumstances, a baby ginseng definitely can't learn multiplication."
"However, it's your fault you met a powerful Beast Tamer." Shi Yu touched his forehead and laughed out loud. "Index, increase points!"
As Shi Yu chose to teach multiplication, his right hand suffused a white halo.
At this moment, seeing this familiar scene, Eleven and Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng, knowing that he was going to give Baby Ginseng points this time.
[No pet can resist the temptation of extra points.]
If there were, then just add more points to convince it.
Eleven and Buggy had already expected the scene of Baby Ginseng immediately being convinced.
This temptation was much more useful than any contract.
At that moment, Baby Ginseng was still a little confused.
But before it could be at a loss for too long, Shi Yu's voice sounded.
As Shi Yu placed the hand on its head, Baby Ginseng's brain immediately buzzed.
The white light that represented the multiplication skill experience flowed into the ginseng baby's body. Its body immediately awakened the various uses of the multiplication skill.
At that moment, Baby Ginseng's expression was extremely blank.
But before it could be at a loss for too long, Shi Yu's voice sounded.
"Baby Ginseng, sweetness, sweet aura skill…! Quick!!"
Baby Ginseng:???
It couldn't react for a moment.
"Yi?"
Sweet?
No way, its sweetness could even make transcendent ferocious beasts faint.
Shi Yu wasn't a bad guy. Baby Ginseng didn't want to hurt him with his sweetness.
"Sweet aura, hurry!"
Shi Yu looked at the hundred-hour cooldown with sunken eyes.
At this moment, he couldn't bear to use supplements and wanted to try Baby Ginseng's skill.
"Wuu!!" "Ji!!" Eleven and Buggy also urged the tonic baby.
It's your turn, emergency ingredient! Use it!
"Yi!!!"
Baby Ginseng sensed that something was wrong and sensed the seriousness of Shi Yu, Eleven, and the worm. It was so scared that Baby Ginseng immediately released a sweet aura from its ginseng flower.
In an instant, a faint transparent gas immediately spread around.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and was immediately shocked.
Because the cooldown time was decreasing hour by hour every second, and it was decreasing faster and faster.
Holy shit, the effect was so strong. It completely defeated the Queen Bee Happy Water.
Wait a minute, this level could make a transcendent-level ferocious beast faint?
"Baby Ginseng, use more strength! Didn't you eat lunch?"
What was this situation??
Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu who was sucking the sweet air crazily and didn't understand what was going on. It immediately released the sweet aura that could relieve fatigue with all its might.
At the side, Eleven and Buggy, who had just finished training, also took a puff. Then, they surprisingly felt pretty good.
The fatigue from the overload training seemed to have been swept away instantly.
In the blink of an eye, the sweet aura released by the baby ginseng was instantly absorbed by Shi Yu and the others. The baby ginseng immediately took a step back.
At this moment, Shi Yu was so high that he exploded. This was because the sweetness of the mutated ginseng baby was really strong.
In a short moment, the cooldown time for him directly became less than eight hours. After sucking a few mouthfuls of sweet air, the effect was actually better than eating a divine bean!
As expected of a monarch species ginseng baby. As expected of a ginseng baby with an energy level higher than Eleven.
The normal type of sweet aura of perfect proficiency was only so-so.
The advantage of an ordinary ginseng baby was that its vitality and energy were strong, comparable to commander-level creatures, so it was very nutritious. And with the support of this source of life skill, the mutated ginseng baby's advantage in this aspect was even more outstanding!
If Shi Yu, who had the skill index, was a very exhausted target, then this ginseng baby was a very nutritious object.
An exhausted Tamer and an over nutritious pet. Best partners!
"As expected of you."
"How is it? Have you learned multiplication?"
At that moment, Baby Ginseng just reacted, but it was still a little shocked.
First, it was shocked that his all-out sweet aura had actually been directly sucked dry by the three in front of it. Then, the other party was completely fine. Then, it was shocked that after Shi Yu sucked in the sweet aura, he still looked extremely weak and unsatisfied.
Baby Ginseng felt its worldview shattering.
"ಥ_ಥ…" Even as a supplement, it was still trash? Why was the Beast Tamer sucking harder and harder?
In the end, Baby Ginseng was shocked once again. It seemed to have really mastered the multiplication Shi Yu had mentioned.
Baby Ginseng was stunned. It blankly chose to use multiplication.
At the next moment, its size kept increasing.
At the same time, Baby Ginseng could clearly sense that its strength had doubled.
The price was that the speed of energy loss in his body became slightly faster.
"Yi!!!" Baby Ginseng widened its eyes. It… could actually learn multiplication??
Feeling its powerful strength, Baby Ginseng had the feeling that it could crush rocks.
This human didn't lie. He could really make it stronger!!!
"Yi!!!"
Baby Ginseng let out a loud cry as it looked at Shi Yu with hopeful eyes.
It was as if it had found the meaning of being a ginseng.
However, Shi Yu's next words made Baby Geng's heart skip a beat.
"Do you want to become stronger?"
"Do you understand the meaning of life? Do you want to really… live?"
"In the future, be good and release sweet gas and create nutrients. You will have attack skills, battle power, and everything."
"There's no conflict between being a combatant and a support healer at the same time, right??"
Shi Yu's eyes lit up. When he saw that Baby Ginseng didn't look affected after releasing the sweet gas once, he immediately understood that the team was about to take off.
Maximum Level Hardening, high-level skill… As long as he had his hands, after he contracted this baby ginseng, maybe increasing hardening above maximum level wasn't a dream.
Well, after returning to Ping Cheng, he would first use the sweetness to increase hardening.
At that moment, Eleven and Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng with hopeful eyes.
The future depended on it!
"…" In the face of the three burning gazes, Baby Ginseng's expression stiffened and it trembled.
When it recalled how Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy looked like they were unsatisfied after sucking in the sweetness, it felt that he had accidentally entered a wolf's den. This battle Ginseng dream didn't seem to be that easy to achieve…
The price it had to pay might be more painful than imagined…
Ginseng Baby: ๑ _ ๑, it seemed like it could be a combatant, but it still couldn't get rid of its status as a supplement.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already started to consider another problem.
Speaking of which, should he give the new baby ginseng a name?

chapters.title: Chapter 138  Additional Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 138  Additional Plan
January 11, Monday.
Yesterday, Shi Yu obtained a ginseng baby and tried out the powerful nourishing ability of the mutated ginseng baby for the first time!
He felt that he no longer needed to buy supplements in the future.
With the sweet aura, the nutrients, earth chain, and source of life, Baby Ginseng could completely replenish the consumption of the extra points.
Of course, Shi Yu also knew that it was all thanks to the level-eight spiritual fruit, the Fruit of Life.
That thing could sell for at least 1 billion, so thinking about it carefully, if he changed the Fruit of Life into supplements, it would be at least 10,000 divine beans…
Apart from the time factor, this quantity of supplements was at least equivalent to nearly 30 full-level high-level skills.
As expected, the nourishing ability of the ginseng baby didn't come out of thin air.
At the moment.
In order to communicate normally, Eleven and Buggy had already started to drag Baby Ginseng away to learn a "second language".
As for Shi Yu, he had already packed his luggage and prepared to return to Ping Cheng with Senior Panda.
The sky was clear, and not a single white cloud could be seen in the blue sky.
In the First Airport of Ancient Capital, a plane slowly set off. Shi Yu sat in his seat and leaned against it, feeling a little depressed.
"What's wrong? In a bad mood?"
Seeing Shi Yu in this state, the panda senior sitting beside Shi Yu turned her head and asked.
Logically speaking… Shi Yu should be very energetic after the vocation assessment.
Now, all the major media outlets on the Internet were praising Shi Yu. If it were other young people, they would have long been feeling smug.
"I'm indeed a useless namer…" Shi Yu slumped helplessly.
He thought about it all night but still couldn't think of a new nickname for Baby Ginseng.
He couldn't possibly do it like Buggy, half-heartedly calling it Ginny or Baby, right?
"Name… name??" Senior Panda was stunned.
After some thought, the panda senior said, "Lil' Ginseng?"
Shi Yu had almost forgotten that Panda's naming skill was also useless.
"If there's a ginseng baby as a pet, what's a good nickname?"
Shi Yu asked.
After some thought, the panda senior said, "Lil' Ginseng?"
Shi Yu had almost forgotten that Panda's naming skill was also useless.
"It sounds a little stupid and not generous enough."
Future Ginseng Baby was a super supplement that could sweep away monarchs and overlords.
Panda:???
It was just a supplement pet. What kind of name did this guy want?
"What about the names you eliminated? What are they?" asked the panda senior.
"Grand Ginseng Emperor…" Shi Yu looked out the window.
Panda:???
Impressive, but was this really the name of the baby ginseng?
Indeed, one couldn't expect Shi Yu to come up with a good name.
"Why was it eliminated?" However, the panda senior asked curiously.
