Shi Yu turned his head slightly. What other reason could there be? It was because Buggy felt that the name was too pretentious, cooler than its own, and protested.
If he had known earlier, he would have given Buggy a proper name. Now, it was even being petty about nicknames. Wasn't this making things difficult for him, a Beast Tamer?
"…"
Icefield City.
As a second-tier city of the vast Dong Huang nation, it was located at the border of the country. An even larger ice dragon snow mountain separated it from the heavy seas.
On Blue Planet, compared to land, the ocean was also larger. There were countless ferocious beasts in the deep sea, and it was a forbidden zone that humans had yet to explore.
Even a monarch-level mechanical life form couldn't guarantee that it could safely send humans from one side of the sea to the other.
Shi Yu sat by the window and looked at the approaching icy plain. The humming of the plane sounded in his ears.
"This flight is about to reach the Icefield Airport…"
A moment later.
A group of people rushed out of the arrival hall.
Just as Shi Yu and Senior Panda came down, Hall Master Lin appeared.
He smiled at the two of them and picked them up.
A biological daughter and a junior who was even closer to him than a close friend. He had to come personally.
"Uncle Lin, how's the situation at the breeding base?"
After getting into the car, Shi Yu asked. He wanted to know very much about the impact of the Iron-Eating Beast Breeding Base on the announcement of the Iron-Eating Beast's evolution form and his own victory in the Ancient Capital's assessment!
After all, he had shares now!
"There were hundreds of reservation calls overnight." Hall Master Lin, who was driving, sighed with emotion.
His daughter's dowry was here again.
Shi Yu was stunned. So crazy?
However, the crazier they paid for it, the harder it would be to sell it later.
Shi Yu had already imagined a group of people excitedly buying the Iron-eating Beast, and then realizing the Iron-eating Beast would only eat and sleep.
"Uncle Lin, the promotion and introduction has to be honest…"
"I understand." Lin Hongnian looked helpless.
How could he not understand?
In the past two days, there had been a bunch of master-level Beast Tamers who had contacted him. In order to let the other party understand that the Iron-eating Beast wasn't that perfect, he was about to become the number one anti-fan of the Iron-eating Beast.
However, it didn't work!
He listed the shortcomings of the iron-eating beasts one by one. Even if he made something up, he couldn't resist the buyer's enthusiasm.
Who could he reason with?
Perhaps the iron-eating beast deserved to explode after being ignored for so long.
Senior Panda shook her head helplessly, "Speaking of which…"
She looked at Shi Yu. "When do you plan to let Eleven evolve?"
"Didn't you say before that the reward for discovering the evolution of the iron-eating beast is almost enough to pay for the evolution materials?"
Hall Master Lin, who was in the driver's seat, took a deep breath.
It was fine if Lin Xiuzhu didn't mention it, but once she did, he felt speechless sorrow.
She had cultivated the Iron-eating Beast for most of her life before the Iron-eating Beast had mastered transcendent Level Hardening. As for Shi Yu, half a year?
Moreover, Shi Yu was only 18 years old, but he was already worth more than 100 million yuan. An Iron-eating Beast that was about to have a monarch title was simply a dreamy start.
As expected of a genius from Bureau 11!
At this moment, Hall Master Lin had long known Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi's true identities and relationships.
President Feng, Director Li, and the others all knew, so Shi Yu had no reason to hide it from Hall Master Lin.
In the ruins of Ping Cheng, Lu Qingyi showing up, Shi Yu rising up… Everything could be connected.
This was also what made Hall Master Lin feel the most emotional. Comparisons were odious. Perhaps, as a member of Bureau 11, Shi Yu could really lead the iron-eating beasts further. He could even walk out of the country and let the Beast Tamers of the other six countries feel the strength of the unique pet of Dong Huang!
This was his greatest dream in his life.
"There's no hurry."
"I'm not ready yet," Shi Yu said with a smile.
Apart from the fact that the hardening hadn't reached the maximum level yet…
He also had to increase his Tamer level.
Also, he had not thought of the design of the evolution equipment.
For example, armed claws or bracers?
Or, could it be that, like Squirtle? It had two cannon muzzles that could be used to release long-range electromagnetic cannons…
He even had to consider whether he needed wings and shields. Who knew how many strange shapes Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy could have imagined together.
This also meant that they had yet to finalize the appearance of the evolution equipment.
At the moment, the one closest to Shi Yu's prerequisites might be full-strength hardening.
He was filled with endless anticipation. He was curious about the different properties of max-level hardening.
"During evolution… You have to call me." The panda senior waved her fist.
She had a premonition that Eleven's evolution would definitely be very unusual.
"Me too."
Lin Hongnian spoke in a low voice, also quite concerned.
Shi Yu had previously said that the Iron-eating Beast might have a second stage evolution. In terms of which Iron-eating Beast, and which Beast Tamer, that this evolution was most likely to appear on… Perhaps it could only be Eleven and Shi Yu.
During evolution, he definitely couldn't count Elder Lin in… He could even sponsor some evolution materials.
"Dad, drive properly." Sister Panda looked at Hall Master Lin.
"Oh right, Dad."
"This time, Shi Yu plans to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins. At that time, can you go with him?"
Lin Hongnian had experienced many expeditions to the snow mountain. With him around, the panda senior could rest assured about Shi Yu.
"Huh?"
"You plan to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins??" Hall Master Lin immediately looked at Shi Yu in the rearview mirror and said seriously.
"Yes, I've already obtained some clues. Perhaps… I can gain something," Shi Yu said.
Hall Master Lin was silent for a moment before saying, "Let me think. If it's you, wearing a cold-proof suit, it shouldn't be a problem to enter the snow mountain."
"The path to the Ice Dragon Ruins is relatively safe. Many archeological teams have established it. If there's a need, I can go with you. But even so, it's best to find more Beast Tamers with you."
If he were alone, Hall Master Lin could guarantee that he would be safe and sound. He could even stay in the snow mountain for a few months, but with Shi Yu around, he didn't dare to guarantee all of Shi Yu's safety.
In a place like the wild, there were too many unexpected factors. The more people, the better.
"Of course," Shi Yu said. "I'll be sufficiently prepared."
…
"Then there's no problem. Call me if you need anything." Lin Hongnian smiled. Then, his mood became strange.
Rumor had it that the Snow Mountain Beast Tide was related to the Ice Dragon Ruins. Could it be true?
If it was true, cracking the ruins and solving the beast tide from the source would have a far-reaching impact on Icefield City.
…
After a few hours from Gudu to Ping Cheng, Shi Yu finally arrived home.
After Hall Master Lin sent Shi Yu to the villa area, he left with Lin Xiuzhu.
After watching the two of them leave, Shi Yu turned to look at the villa area and took a deep breath.
He was finally back!!!
Shi Yu took a few steps forward and returned to the training villa.
As soon as he arrived at the courtyard, he shook out Eleven, Worm, and Baby Ginseng from the ruins space.
"Wuu?" "Ji?" "Yi?"
The three pets looked around. Eleven and Buggy were surprised, while Baby Ginseng was confused.
They were home.
Shi Yu walked forward and patted Eleven on the shoulder. "I'll leave the cleaning to you."
With that, he turned and left to get ice cream from the fridge.
Eleven was silent for a moment before squatting down to pat Buggy on the shoulder.
"Wu wu, wu!"
With that said, it turned and left, following behind Shi Yu to eat ice pops.
In the next second, Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng and fell into deep thought.
Damn it, the language barrier was blocking this…
In less than half an hour, Buggy had cleaned up the entire villa, leaving not a trace of dust behind.
It slept directly. Materializing dozens of Green Silkworms to clean with worm silk was just that efficient.
At the same time, this was also a lesson. Buggy pulled Baby Ginseng to the side to learn from it the whole time. After all, such a difficult task in the future would belong to Baby Ginseng.
"Yi…" Baby Ginseng was extremely bitter.
This green worm was indeed a monster. In the blink of an eye, it had actually become dozens in number…
If it had this ability… Well, it still seemed useless. It would only attract more predators and make them more excited.
After the house was cleaned up, Shi Yu also took a shower. After changing his clothes, he started to call Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng over.
He started to increase their points!
Shi Yu first looked at Baby Ginseng.
[Skill]: Sweet Aura (Perfect), Slow Healing (transcendent), Earth Chain (Proficient), Nutrition (expert), Source of Life (Initiate), Multiplication (Initiate)
Yesterday, Shi Yu had pretty much judged the skill proficiency of the ginseng baby.
Apart from the source of life, multiplication, which were both at entry-level proficiency, the proficiency of the other skills of the baby ginseng was not low.
For example, the skill Slow Healing. Due to the physique of the source of life, its effect was directly comparable to that of a transcendent level skill. It could even easily regrow broken limbs, and it was even more ferocious than a master level healing skill.
As for skills like Sweet Aura and Nutrition, most of the proficiency levels only affected nourishing effects and preservation time. These skills were not low leveled due to the mutation of the baby ginseng, but they had not reached the level of proficiency qualitative change.
For example, Sweet Aura. Only at the transcendent level could it undergo a qualitative change. At that time, it would be able to condense the fragrance into preserved liquid perfume and solid spice. It would also be able to control the speed and strength of the fragrance's diffusion, from uncontrollable to manageable.
As for the Nutrition Skill, as long as it was below Perfect Level, there were no special features. The proficiency level only affected quality and shelf life. Only when it reached transcendent Level would it be unique.
That meant that the storage time limit was nearly unlimited. Moreover, as the storage time increased, it would absorb external energy and have richer nutrition. Thousand-year-old ginseng roots and ten thousand-year-old ginseng roots came from this.
"At the moment, the nourishing effects of the sweet gas and nutritional supplements are more than enough to restore skills below high level. He didn't have to worry about these two skills for the time being."
"As for slow healing, it can be upgraded to high-speed healing. This isn't urgent. After all, it has learned nutrition. Unless it goes to battle, it won't be injured."
"I can't afford to upgrade Source of life, so it looks like Earth Chain is the only thing worth upgrading at the moment."
Earth Chain could allow the ginseng baby to freeload energy from an earth vein and provide supplements limitlessly. At this moment, its recovery speed appeared to be very important. It was best to teach it absolute sleep and accelerate its recovery speed.
Source of Life+Earth Chain+Absolute Sleep… Good, good.
Therefore, the current priority should be to ensure the endurance of the baby ginseng.
Then, it was Eleven and Buggy's skills next!
Eleven's hardening needed to be maxed as well, while for Buggy, he had to ensure that the spatial shackles and phantom illusions could easily break through the full-level worm silk cocoon with 100% ease… In this way, after school started, he could start preparing for the evolution of Eleven and Buggy.
"Come on!" Shi Yu seemed to have made a huge decision. He looked at the three pets with a tragic expression.
Eleven and Buggy also had tragic expressions, as if they had made a lot of determination to accept the challenge of their hearts being corroded.
Only Baby Ginseng was still confused. Why were you all so serious… Suddenly, it had a bad feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Their Limits
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Their Limits
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the ruins.
Shi Yu pulled Eleven, Worm, and Baby Ginseng in.
It was actually quite difficult to save money and turn a ginseng baby into a “perpetual motion” ginseng.
He had to increase the proficiency of the Earth Chain Skill as much as possible.
Apart from that, the perpetual motion aspect was also very particular.
At least it wouldn’t work in the training villa.
Earth Chain looked very impressive, but it was actually very useless.
Its requirements for the environment were very harsh.
For example, on the ocean, this skill was directly crippled.
For example, on the cement road, the low stamina Ginseng Baby might not necessarily be able to recover Shi Yu’s full physical fitness even after a month if it tried using Earth Chain..
Spending a month was far inferior to eating an energy crystal to recover faster.
Only in wild areas with abundant natural energy, fertile land, and rich resources… Or training grounds and battlefields with qualified energy standards would these skills be relatively easier to use.
For example, human cities were places with relatively thin natural energy.
However, although it was thin, the huge power of the land was enough compared to an extraordinary ginseng baby.
What prevented the Ginseng Baby from recovering was also the problem of absorption efficiency.
The energy in the city was thin to begin with, and the absorption effect was inferior to that in the wild. In addition, the skill proficiency was not high, and the absorption efficiency was poor. Therefore, it was really possible that a situation where one could take root for a month, and still not recover their physical fitness to the fullest, would happen.
This was also the reason why Shi Yu wanted to prioritize raising the level of Earth Chain.
Perhaps, only by leveling up to the level near Dao proficiency could Baby Ginseng ignore the environmental factors and absorb natural energy to recover its physical fitness faster.
Controlling natural powers was actually an ability that only guardians and Mythical creatures began to come into contact with and control.
Skills such as Earth Chain and Absolute Sleep could only be considered to have touched the surface. Therefore, the restrictions were huge and the effects were poor.
In fact, the best way was for Shi Yu and the others to directly settle in the wild. This way, the effect of this skill would be the best.
However, Shi Yu thought about it. The growth speed of Eleven and Buggy was not bad in the ruins space either. It was definitely related to training in the ruins space.
Be it the ownerless Beast Taming Space or the ownerless ruins, they could draw strength from nature at different speeds and convert it into various nutrients that were easy to absorb. This was also why pets grew faster in the ruins space and Beast Taming Space.
If it took root there, it could also relieve the problem of the consumption of the ginseng baby being greater than its recovery. Most importantly, it would save Shi Yu and the others the trouble of going into the wild. Moreover, even if it was in the wild, as long as it was close to the city, the natural energy was not especially abundant. Unless Shi Yu went to Baby Ginseng’s hometown, outside the country… But that kind of place was even more dangerous than the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. He didn’t want that…
“Baby Ginseng, let me see your limit!”
“Earth Chain, Sweet Aura!”
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Baby Ginseng, let us see your limit!
Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng seriously.
Ginseng Baby: ╰ (*° ▽ °*) ╯
Baby Ginseng’s heart skipped a beat. As expected…
It had said that it had a bad premonition. Now, it seemed that the premonition had come true.
It was going to be sucked dry…
Ginseng Baby wanted to cry.
“Hurry up.”
“The more sweetness you release, the stronger you will become.”
“Don’t you want to evolve from Baby Ginseng to a towering emperor?”
“Yi!!!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng widened its eyes. A sweet aura suddenly spread from the ginseng flower.
“Let the sweetness wrap around me.”
Shi Yu’s words made Baby Ginseng immediately take a step back. Shi Yu was definitely the most terrifying creature it had ever seen.
The more one inhaled the sweetness, the weaker they became. It was ridiculous to rush to inhale the sweetness.
It wondered if… he could satisfy Shi Yu this time.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng gulped and controlled the sweet aura to surround Shi Yu.
In the next second, Shi Yu took a deep breath and a white halo suddenly appeared on his right hand.
And it hit Baby Ginseng.
Earth Chain, teach!
Previously, he had already replicated the Earth Chain skill.
And now, it was the other way around.
At this moment, the baby ginseng that was releasing the sweet aura was immediately at a loss.
In its mind, its understanding of the Earth Chain Skill immediately deepened.
The connection between it and the ground immediately felt a little deeper.
Then, Shi Yu’s hand did not stop.
At the moment, Baby Ginseng’s greatest power, sweet aura, could directly restore nearly 200 hours of cooldown time.
It had only taken 40 hours’ worth since he started teaching the Intermediate Skill Earth Chain. In short, in order to not waste the sweet aura, he couldn’t stop teaching!
Pa!
In less than half a minute, Shi Yu felt that it was alright again, and his hand hit Baby Ginseng for the second time.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng felt that its understanding of the earth chain had undergone a qualitative change.
[Skill]: Earth Chain (Expert)
This was not the end. Every few moments, Shi Yu would continue to pat it.
In just two minutes, Baby Ginseng was stunned on the spot.
It didn’t understand why he suddenly became stronger after the Beast Tamer patted him.
Baby Ginseng:(? o ?)
This was… a human Beast Tamer?
“The sweetness can’t stop.” Just as Baby Ginseng was in a daze, Shi Yu’s voice sounded.
Baby Ginseng saw that the all-powerful sweet aura it had released had actually been completely absorbed by Shi Yu. It couldn’t help but widen its eyes.
Ah, this…
“Baby Ginseng, is this your limit?”
Shi Yu asked.
Baby Ginseng was stunned. Of course, this wasn’t its limit. A low-level skill like Sweet Aura… Even if it was released at the greatest power, it could still be released many times!
This was what it was like for high energy creatures.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng immediately continued to release its sweetness.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s hand hit Baby Ginseng again.
Heavens!
Baby Ginseng felt that its skill proficiency had never improved so quickly.
The last time his proficiency increased was when it accidentally ate the Fruit of Life…
Shi Yu = Fruit of Life?
A moment later, Baby Ginseng seemed to have understood something.
Could a Beast Tamer turn the energy around and make it stronger after absorbing its sweet aura?
Could this be the reason why Shi Yu said it could become powerful?
Realizing this, Baby Ginseng’s expression gradually became serious.
He should have said so earlier…
It looked at Shi Yu, who was absorbing the sweet aura and constantly condensing light in its palm to slap itself.
Then, a strong desire to compete appeared.
“Beast Tamer, let me see where your limit is!!!” It thought.
Don’t stop!
“Let’s see who will have the last laugh!” It thought.
“Yi!!!!” Baby Ginseng changed to full power mode. The ginseng flower went berserk like a propeller, continuously releasing all its power and sweetness to wrap around Shi Yu.
“Damn, it’s so pungent…”
At that moment, even if the sweetness was very strong and smelled good, Shi Yu’s face instantly darkened.
Baby Ginseng was over it?
At the side, Eleven and Buggy looked gratified. This ginseng had potential!
As long as he knew that it was a good thing to have points added, it wasn’t stupid!
At this moment, Shi Yu was absorbing the sweet aura while teaching the skill.
His body kept changing between exhaustion and peak recovery.
This process also made his body undergo intense tempering.
Under the protection of the skill index, Shi Yu’s physical fitness was also increasing crazily.
Although time after time, Shi Yu still felt an unavoidable load on his body and mind, right now, Shi Yu felt as high as the ginseng baby.
If it were anyone else, they definitely wouldn’t be able to absorb the effects of the supplements so quickly.
After absorbing too many supplements, the body would definitely produce a greater burden.
However, under the protection of the second talent of the skill index, Shi Yu really didn’t lie to his seniors. He had the “Supplement Absorption” talent.
Not only would the burden produced be reduced to the minimum, but it could also strengthen the body!
He had never felt that his physical fitness had become so obvious and so fast.
When he was a Beast Tamer intern, even if he taught skills with the index frequently, the improvement effect was only so-so…
A moment later, Shi Yu understood.
Previously, when his physique was still in the category of ordinary people, there was a certain upper limit. Even if the skill index gave him multiple feedback, he couldn’t escape the category of ordinary people. No matter how ordinary physiques were trained, he was still “human”.
However, after his Beast Taming Space upgraded to level two and his own physique became transcendent, the upper limit of his body strength instantly increased by a lot.
The difference between a powerful transcendent and a weak transcendent was even greater than the difference in physical fitness between a strong ordinary person and an ordinary person.
However, as the space increased, the power that the skill index could provide was even greater.
“Yi!!!”
After a long time, because Shi Yu had the protection and feedback of the skill index, and Baby Ginseng focused on only consuming it… In a short period of time, Baby Ginseng cried and realized that its physical fitness was almost insufficient to support the release of the sweet aura.
At Shi Yu’s absorbing speed, even with the support of its source of life skill, it couldn’t withstand it.
The Beast Tamer in front of it was like a black hole. It was extremely scary, squeezing it dry…
Baby Ginseng shuddered.
Ginseng Baby: ?_?
Was this… Its limit..?
It didn’t expect that as the legendary mutated ginseng baby, it would actually lose to a human…
“That’s why you need Earth Chain.”
Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng who was still standing on the ground and could not help but say in a speechless manner.
After saying that, Baby Ginseng was stunned for a moment before it reacted.
Eh, it almost forgot…
The next moment, its two tender calves were instantly filled with light. It seemed to penetrate the ground and become one with the ground.
At this moment, the nearly perfect level Earth Chain, in addition to the two recovery measures of source of life and the ruins… It all instantly increased Baby Ginseng’s energy recovery speed.
Baby Ginseng was delighted. It seemed… to work!
After Earth Chain’s level increased, although it couldn’t maintain the crazy consumption of the sweet aura, the energy loss immediately became less exaggerated.
“Continue!” Shi Yu chuckled with a serious expression.
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
At the side, Eleven and Buggy even forgot to train. They rubbed their hands the whole time and looked at the combination.
So fierce!
Baby Ginseng was so fierce!
The Tamer was so fierce!
So, when would it be their turn?!!!
Baby Ginseng’s crazy increase in points almost made them cry.
Who could resist such temptation!
…
At the same time.
Ancient Capital City.
The old principal of Ancient Capital University stayed at Legend Yin’sX house aggrievedly.
“Little Yin, that’s not what we said before.”
“Didn’t we agree to let Zhengfan enter Ancient Capital University to study?”
“Why did you change your mind just like that?”
Legend Yin had a calm expression and turned hostile.
“I never promised you.”
“What I said previously was that it’s all up to Zhengfan to decide.”
“At that time, his attitude was that it didn’t matter. He could go anywhere.”
“And now, he wants to go to the capital.” Legend Yin shook his head, as if he was powerless and couldn’t interfere.
Just as he had expected, after losing to Shi Yu, Yin Zhengfan kept quiet for a long time.
He also made a decision. He would leave his hometown, the Ancient Capital, and compete for a more brutal, more talented, and comprehensive strength. He would leave for the Imperial Capital University, which was currently the number one university in the country, to further his studies in the battle department.
In comparison, the resources facilities of Ancient Capital University and the combat specialization were barely in the top five in the country’s universities…
If he got the title of top scholar, along with the right to be willful at such a young age… Yin Zhengfan naturally didn’t mind.
However, after losing to Shi Yu, he didn’t want to make a random choice. He wanted to catch up to Shi Yu and his father with faster footsteps.
Imperial Capital University was more suitable for him than Ancient Capital University.
“I…” The old principal of the Ancient Capital University cried in his heart. What the f*ck was going on?
He dared to guarantee that this was definitely not Yin Zhengfan’s decision alone. Yin Zhongrong was definitely more inclined to let his child grow on bigger stages like Imperial City and Demon City.
“As a local of the Ancient Capital, he had to study at the Ancient Capital University”? There was indeed no such thing.
The principal of Ancient Capital University also knew that places like Imperial University and Demon University were more suitable for Yin Zhengfan.
But… it was still a pity.
At the same time…
Yu Shu, Zhang Qianyi, Wang Ling, Miao Dongdong, and the others had pretty much made their choice as to where they would go to further their studies in the future.
“Don’t worry, Mom. I’ll definitely surpass that guy within a year.”
Yu Shu promised his mother, the Dragon Tamer. Then, she rolled her eyes.
“Is that so?”
“Of course.” Yu Shu was unconvinced.
The advantages of Spirit Medium and Dragon Tamers depended on development.
After entering university, he would be able to enter the best training venues in the ancient capital that were suitable for Spirit Mediums to train their undead pets. Shi Yu’s telepathy talent would only be greater and greater than his.
On the other side…
Zhang Qianyi’s master, an old granny who also had the talent to control beasts, Shu Shu, said calmly to this grassroots girl.
“It’s just a secondary vocational assessment. You don’t have to worry about the number. The real stage is after university.”
“Your talent has greater potential than all of them.”
This was because he didn’t want the girl to be hit by the fact that she hadn’t gotten the best results even though it was a retest.
“Yes,” Zhang Qianyi said quietly.
Because she came from an ordinary family, she was stronger than others.
At this moment, she made up her mind. After college, she had to work hard to surpass Shi Yu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others. Moreover, she had to maintain the advantage of crushing Yu Shu.
The vocation assessment ended.
Each candidate had their own destination, and every Beast Tamer Association also concluded their business.
In this year’s vocation assessment, the average quality of the candidates had improved again compared to last year.
This was the embodiment of the prosperous development of the Beast Tamer domain.
According to tradition, this batch of candidates would undergo a qualitative change within a year with the support of more resources, be it after entering a business or university, under an even more intense competition environment. They would all be promoted to Intermediate Beast Tamers.
However, at this moment… There was actually an unreasonable candidate who had secretly undergone another qualitative change before school started and before he could enjoy the resources of the university…
“Baby Ginseng, let me see your limit!”
“Yi!! (Shi Yu, let me see your limit too!)”
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
“Baby Ginseng, Beast Tamer, let us see where your limits are!” The two thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Explosive Strength of All Members
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Explosive Strength of All Members
It felt good to continuously upgrade points.
Shi Yu was immediately immersed in the joy of adding points.
Several days had passed since Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng from the ancient capital.
For the past few days, Shi Yu had been living in seclusion.
It couldn’t be helped. It was too exciting to use Ginseng Baby to add points.
Be it the sweetness or the various nutritional supplements produced by the ginseng baby, they were all better than the supplements bought. The burden on the body was smaller.
He could also make himself stronger, and he could also make his pets stronger to gain a sense of accomplishment. If he didn’t take advantage of this, would he still be human?!
However, Shi Yu did not forget the main goal.
After calculating the time, he made an appointment with Senior Lu, Hall Master Lin, President Feng, and Commander He, these master-level Beast Tamers. He decided to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins together in a week.
Initially, Shi Yu wanted to call a few more.
In the end, Lu Qingyi said two sentences to Shi Yu.
“It’s only the Ice Dragon Ruins… There’s no need to mobilize so many people…”
“Besides, according to my rich archeological experience, the more people exploring a ruin, the easier it is to fail.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Alright, alright!
Since the big boss of the archeological world had spoken, Shi Yu chose to believe it.
Then, he continued to increase points.
…
About ten days after Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng.
Shi Yu upgraded all three pets.
During this process, Shi Yu felt that his physical fitness had reached another limit.
Because the feedback effect of the skill index gradually decreased.
After testing his grip, he silently discovered that his current physical fitness might not be inferior to those high-level Beast Tamers who had reached level four in the Beast Taming Space.
This change left Shi Yu at a loss for a long time.
He was really a human battle beast.
More specifically, he could already fight some awakened-level pets of extraordinary races with his bare hands.
If the opponent was an adult Iron-eating Beast that had awakened to level ten, Shi Yu would definitely win if he fought with it without using any skills.
This was only the upper limit of the physical fitness level in the second-level Beast Taming Space.
If the Beast Taming Space reached level six, seven, and eight and reached the upper limit of this level of physical fitness, Shi Yu didn’t dare to imagine if he could really become a human-shaped ferocious beast and a super Earthling under the feedback of the skill index…
The improvement in physical fitness also brought about a benefit.
That was, Shi Yu’s meditation efficiency had become especially efficient.
Originally, he judged that it might take a few months to raise the level of the Beast Taming Space to level three…
But now, with the enhancement of his super physique, he felt that with the full meditation of the Ethereal Stone, this speed could be greatly improved.
But these were not the most important things.
Most importantly, in the past ten days, under Shi Yu’s crazy points, each of the three pets’ strength had undergone a huge change.
Shi Yu sat in the study and leaned against the old chair. He looked at the pet data book he had recorded in Chinese.
< Name > Ginseng Baby
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Fragrance (Perfect), High Speed Healing (Perfect), Nutrition (Expert), Earth Chain (Transcendent), Origin of Life (Initiate), Multiplication (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert)
In the end, Shi Yu reached transcendent in the Earth Chain skill, upgraded Absolute Sleep to expert level, and got Multiplication to expert level.
In this way, the Earth Chain+the source of life+shrinking+absolute sleep, together with the ruins space… This could roughly equalize the consumption of Shi Yu and the others’ points. It would be enough to only absorb natural power. There was no need to buy additional energy crystals to help Baby Ginseng recover its physical fitness.
Of course, as a Beast Tamer who had a ginseng baby, even if he could really borrow the power of nature to completely freeload, Shi Yu wouldn’t squeeze the ginseng baby like this.
Shi Yu did not give the baby ginseng any less energy crystals and nutritional supplements.
Even if it didn’t need these things to replenish his energy, it was good to have a taste. Shi Yu had the mentality that pets had to be doted over. He gave everything to Eleven to Worm, even if Baby Ginseng hadn’t officially contracted with him. Shi Yu had already treated all three pets equally.
Each day, Baby Ginseng still had a lot of entertainment time.
But even so, it didn’t miss helping Shi Yu level up the pets.
Currently, Baby Ginseng could completely supply the consumption of skills below super level.
Super skills… At the moment, it still looked far away.
In addition to multiplication and absolute sleep, Shi Yu also taught Baby Ginseng high-speed healing skills.
Due to the slow healing and source of life, the ginseng baby had just learned to heal at a high speed, and the effect was comparable to perfection.
Compared to slow healing, the effect of Perfect Level High Speed Healing was much greater. Most importantly, Baby Ginseng now had the ability to heal others.
Perfect level High Speed Healing also gave Baby Ginseng the ability to form a combination skill with this move. Coupled with the nutritional supplement skill, Baby Ginseng could not only create high-level supplements, but it could also create high-level medicine for injuries. It could be considered to have completely changed its profession to a support nurse. The positioning of it in the team… was a support, after all.
After all, at the moment, Baby Ginseng should have the highest proficiency level in the team.
Although its dream was to become a combatant… After ten days, its combat power didn’t increase much. The effect of multiplication was different on Eleven compared to the baby ginseng…
Shi Yu planned to think of a way later to find a wood-element attack skill for it. He could teach it when the time came.
However, although Baby Ginseng’s battle power didn’t increase much because of its race, Eleven and Worm, who had witnessed the limits of Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu, had completely taken off in the past ten days.
< Name > Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Dao Proficiency), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Illusory Phantom (Perfect), Deterrence (Expert), Super Sight (Expert), High Speed Healing (Proficient), Spatial Shackles (Expert), Instant Transmission (Expert), Concealment (Expert)
For Buggy, Shi Yu increased the phantom illusion to perfect level.
Perfect-level illusionary illusions focused on the word “solid”.
It could make the illusion even more realistic. If Buggy transformed into a frost dragon, even Eleven’s perfect super vision wouldn’t be able to see through it. Moreover, it would be able to clearly feel the lively life force of the ice dragon. The illusion had reached the point of making it look real.
Of course, this also meant that the quality of the phantom had been raised to a higher level, and the power it could display was stronger.
Shi Yu had also taught Worm three spatial skills.
At this moment, Phantom Illusion skill alone could already easily break through the full-level worm silk, but the spatial shackle was still a little lacking. Shi Yu prepared to upgrade this high-level skill to at least perfect level before evolution.
But at the moment, the thing most worth mentioning was that it wasn’t so easy for Eleven to defeat Buggy. It would take a lot of effort, and it would have to use all his trump cards. Even so, there was a risk of losing.
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Hardening (Dao Proficiency), Thunder Palm (Transcendent), High Speed Healing (Expert), Super Sight (Perfect), Deterrence (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Multiplication (Expert)
This was mainly because relatively speaking, Eleven’s skills improved less. He only had time to increase the proficiency of Hardening and Thunder Palm.
In the past, it was Buggy who was envious of Eleven’s pile of skills. Now, it was Eleven who was envious of Buggy’s pile of skills.
After Thunder Palm reached transcendent, Eleven had a stronger lightning control ability. It could even turn the Thunder Palm into a Wave Palm, condense the lightning into an energy body, and release the Thunder Palm, or transform the Thunder Palm into various forms.
This was a small surprise, giving Eleven more long-range attacks.
However, after teaching Eleven’s Thunder Palm to transcendent, Shi Yu discovered a big problem.
That was, when this skill reached the level of transcendent, the skill index showed that it could not be taught anymore.
At the same time, the deletion symbol appeared on the Thunder Palm page, indicating that Shi Yu could delete the Thunder Palm at any time.
This made Shi Yu a little silent. This was because the skill index seemed to only be able to increase points in the species skills of pets to the level of Dao Proficiency.
For non-racial skills, reaching transcendent was the maximum level.
Shi Yu’s mood was complicated.
Fortunately, this way, the conditions for deleting certain skills were much lower. He could replicate more rare skills.
What was annoying was that some super useful skills outside the race could not be activated to the highest level. Next, the pet could only rely on itself to train.
Therefore, although he had replicated Earth Chain, Hardening and Thunder Palm had become skills that could be deleted at any time on Shi Yu’s side. He could empty two new skill slots at any time.
As for max level hardening…
Compared to transcendent Level Hardening, apart from the increase in hardness, there was an additional property.
Growth.
The reason why Hardening was evaluated as a low-level skill was that no matter what the Iron-eating Beast’s food was, the nature of Hardening Material was always like that. Apart from becoming a little harder and having a better resistance to physical attacks, it had no special characteristics and didn’t have much growth.
However, after reaching the maximum level, Hardening became like the transcendent Worm Silk. It could directly change the nature of the Hardening Material according to the difference in eating food.
For example, if Eleven ate a large amount of Electric Mines, its hardening substance would become more like a magnet. In the hardening state, its control over thunder skills and thunder talent would increase greatly.
If it ate a large amount of lightweight rocks next, it could freely control its weight in the hardened state, be it light or heavy.
It was also the reason why it was a little difficult for Eleven to fight Buggy at the moment.
Because it hadn’t grown up yet.
In addition, Eleven had yet to successfully coordinate the super electromagnetic cannon, the ultimate combination of max Hardening and transcendent Level Thunder Palm.
Buggy, who had the addition of three spatial skills and a perfect high level skill, was now able to fight Eleven 40:60 because of that. If the bug’s race was a little higher and it had more physical fitness, and if it weren’t a weak green worm, Eleven might fail.
Shi Yu stared at the data card. Baby Ginseng still lacked a wood-element attack skill. He had to choose a suitable one. The skills of Buggy were more or less enough. After filling it up, he just had to wait for it to evolve and awaken new racial skills. He still had to add points to racial skills. After all, the upper limit was high. As for Eleven, there were a little fewer offensive skills, but there was no hurry. After all, it was like Buggy. It could be arranged to evolve soon after school started.
“Why do I feel that if the Beast Taming Space’s level increases smoothly, in addition to the evolution of Eleven and Buggy… I can defeat seniors like Sister Beast Ear in my first year.” Shi Yu’s expression was strange.
Too small, the mindset was too small. Ancient Capital University wasn’t impressive in the battle department either. He would set a small goal of sweeping through the battle department of Imperial Capital University before his second year.
At that time, he would go to the principal to ask for money. When he was paid for his accomplishments, that would be the start of his legend!
This baby ginseng was really his lucky star.
“Hello!!!”
“There’s a package for you!!!”
Just as Shi Yu was fantasizing, a familiar voice came from the outside.
Shi Yu hurriedly jogged. When he passed by the courtyard, Baby Ginseng, who was taking care of the plants in the villa, poked its head out and followed curiously.
“We will meet again.”
“I haven’t delivered it to you in a long time.”
Outside the training villa.
Shi Yu’s old friend, a young man who rode the Wings of the Wind to deliver goods everywhere, looked at Shi Yu with a smile after delivering a metal pile of mineral resources.
He was a little puzzled. Why didn’t Shi Yu buy supplements this time…
Then, he saw Baby Ginseng beside Shi Yu’s leg…
The courier was speechless.
“Yeah, long time no see.” Shi Yu put the goods away with a smile. At the same time, he was very puzzled. Didn’t the other party know his new identity? From the looks of it, the reputation of a genius archeologist wasn’t enough…
The two of them completed another tacit transaction.
This time, Shi Yu bought a level-four thunder-element mineral resource, the Flat Thunder Stone.
It cost about 5,000,000 yuan. He didn’t buy much, just a box.
After all, he only had tens of millions of yuan now.
This also made Shi Yu a little depressed. Although the money for the additional supplements was saved, the other resources weren’t f*cking cheap either.
The reason why he bought this was to test this so-called growth rate of max-level hardening.
“Yi ~” At this moment, Baby Ginseng looked at the big box in front of it and was extremely curious.
What was this?
Shi Yu smiled and opened the box. It was filled with a pile of sealed dark blue electric stones.
“This is food prepared for Eleven.”
Baby Ginseng:!!!
“Yi!!” In Baby Ginseng’s opinion, Eleven and Buggy were very strange.
One ate iron rocks, alright… But the other ate plants. Damn it.
It was different. Ginseng babies loved to eat dirt and drink all kinds of nutritional drinks.
Baby Ginseng felt that it was very normal.
“Let’s go back.”
Shi Yu chuckled. He picked up the big box filled with metal minerals and walked back with the ginseng baby.
This Flat Thunder Stone’s nature was stable.
The stone had super high control over the lightning energy inside.
Many thunder-element pets used this resource to increase their control over the lightning energy.
When Shi Yu chose the resources, he locked onto the Flat Thunder Stone at a glance.
After all, Eleven wasn’t a thunder-type pet. Even if its Thunder Palm had reached perfection and its Hardening had reached the maximum level, as expected, the electromagnetic cannon that Shi Yu imagined was still lacking.
It was impossible to reconcile the relationship between hardening and the electromagnetic field.
To put it bluntly, Eleven’s control over the metal element was strong enough, but it was still lacking when it came to the thunder element.
Therefore, Shi Yu thought of the Flat Thunder Stone and wanted to see if the full-strength hardening could absorb the stone’s nature.
If it could, Eleven would basically have a second attribute under Hardening: Lightning.
At that time, both the profundities of the Thunder Armor and the Electromagnetic Cannon would undergo qualitative changes.
In short, he would use the Flat Thunder Rock excessively first… When he had money in the future, he would buy higher-level and stronger metal resources to change the nature of the hardening substance!
…
Boom!!!
Boom!!
In the ruins.
When Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng arrived, Big Eleven and the Ice Dragon Buggy were engaged in a crazy battle of flashy moves.
“Cough.”
Shi Yu coughed dryly and immediately made Eleven and Buggy stop.
At that moment, Eleven’s eyes lit up when it saw the huge box in Shi Yu’s hand.
“Wuu!!!”
It quickly became smaller and ran over while the worm recovered and crawled over.
At this moment, when Buggy crawled, it raised its head and chest.
It felt that the gap between it and its leader was gradually shrinking. It was very excited.
“Huh?”
After Eleven ran over, it pointed at the Flat Thunder Stone in the box and asked if it was for it.
Shi Yu smiled and nodded. The next moment, Eleven rubbed its hands and stuffed a piece into its mouth.
Great.
It could finally test the nature of maximum hardening.
“This is a fourth-level resource… In theory, it’s for commander-level creatures to use. Take it easy.”
Shi Yu reminded.
“Ow, ow.” Eleven hurriedly nodded, but it was not a big deal. This was because in the ruins space, coupled with absolute sleep, its absorption of nutrition was very good. There would be no indigestion.
Crack. Crack. Eleven ate a piece after a few bites.
Then, its eyes shone.
Delicious!
It simply ate in its hardened state.
Crack.
Eleven ate very happily. After all, the battle had just ended and it was time to replenish its nutrition.
As it ate, something unexpected happened.
A dark blue lightning suddenly flowed across Eleven’s hardened body. However, Eleven didn’t feel anything unusual and continued eating.
“Yi…”” Ji…” Baby Ginseng and Worm looked at the Flat Thunder Stone. Was this thing… really that delicious?
After eating about three pieces, Eleven gradually felt that the nature of its hardened substance was slowly changing. It raised its head slightly and looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu nodded and looked at Buggy.
“Let’s give it a try.”
“Buggy, try using the spatial shackles to seal Eleven.”
“Ji!!”
Buggy didn’t understand, but it nodded.
The next moment, a three-dimensional spatial barrier the size of a room appeared around Eleven.
Expert level spatial shackles!
This was even stronger than the spatial shackles of the Sky Crystal Butterfly. In the previous battle, it was quite troublesome for Eleven to break it.
Using this move, Buggy and the ice dragon phantom disgusted him many times.
As for now…
Looking at the transparent spatial wall in front of him, the one-meter-tall Eleven had a serious expression. it slowly raised its fat arm and aimed its palm in front of it.
Then, a black ball condensed outside its palm.
At this moment, Buggy and Ginseng Baby were still very calm.
But the next moment.
Crack!
A shocking electric arc appeared on Eleven’s hardened arm and wrapped around it, making a violent sound!
Then, Eleven’s entire arm shone, and powerful electric currents suddenly spread around the black ball floating in front of his palm. This change made the expressions of Buggy and Baby Ginseng change slightly.
What they didn’t know was that… the magnetic field that formed quickly with the lightning palm’s high-voltage electric current was giving the hardening ball an acceleration! This acceleration was even greater than the power of Eleven!
Boom!!!
Finally, the electromagnetic cannon that Eleven had tried many times but couldn’t complete was finally fired for the first time.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven shouted excitedly during the launch.
Boom!!!
At the same time, it was like a thunderclap exploded in the hearts of the bugs and ginseng babies.
Buggy and Baby Ginseng widened their eyes and only saw a blue light streak across. With a bang, space seemed to shatter and the spatial shackles made by Buggy instantly started collapsing with a flash of lightning!!
In the next moment, the lightning was still accelerating. In the blink of an eye, the light landed in the distance, and a terrifying loud bang was suddenly transmitted along with the fading light. In the next moment, there was even a strong wind that blew over from afar accompanied by this loud bang, completely blowing the spatial fragments away!
“Ji!!!!”
Buggy: ヾ(;?;Д;?;)ノ?
Seeing the fragile collapse of the spatial shackles, Buggy’s eyes immediately widened. Holy shit.
What happened!
Baby Ginseng was also stunned. It didn’t understand what was going on and almost got blown away.
At this moment, Eleven stood on the spot and returned to its normal state. Its black and white hair fluttered with the strong wind. It was at first confused, but then it looked at its palm in surprise.
“Wuuu!!!”
Success!!
It also saw Shi Yu’s smile.
The second profundity!! Electromagnetic Cannon!!
“Wuu! (Buggy, come fight!)” Eleven looked at Buggy with fighting spirit.
Buggy:???
“Ji!!!! Are you sure I won’t die if that thing hits me?!!” Buggy thought..

chapters.title: Chapter 141  Ice Dragon Snow Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 141  Ice Dragon Snow Mountain
The power of the electromagnetic cannon was even stronger than the profundities of the Thunder Armor.
This was because the Thunder Armor profundity required it to cover the hardened substance all over the body and form a protective layer. It was mainly defense and speed.
On the other hand, the Electromagnetic Cannon compressed the power of the metal element and the thunder element into a hardening-created ball and accelerated the launch to detonate. The result was destruction with both power and speed!
At this moment, after witnessing the power of the electromagnetic cannon, Buggy swallowed its saliva. It felt that the ice dragon it transformed into might not be able to withstand a single blow and would be blown up instantly!
What the hell?!
Eleven: 〈( ̄) ̄)〈
"Wuu!"
Come on, come on!
Avoiding battle was bad behavior.
"You've challenged me so many times in the past two days, but I've never rejected you!" Eleven thought.
"Don't be in a hurry to fight."
Seeing Eleven excitedly initiate a battle with Worm, Shi Yu hurriedly said, "Let's perfect the technique first."
Shi Yu had saved Buggy's life, making Buggy turn around with lingering fear.
Buggy suspected that Eleven was holding a grudge.
In the past two days, it had relied on the advantage of having many skills to challenge Eleven continuously and even fought back and forth. It might have annoyed Eleven…
"Huh?" Eleven looked at Shi Yu.
"Wuu!"
Eleven nodded obediently.
Alright, then they would fight another day.
Training, training!
Full Level Hardening was the same as full Level Worm Silk. As Eleven's control over this skill had reached an insane level, Hardening also extended many high-level usage methods worth training.
For example, after the hardening substance left the body, the duration was longer.
After Eleven made contact with Shi Yu and applied a layer of hardening armor on him, even if the two parties separated, Shi Yu's hardening armor would not immediately disappear. Instead, it would be maintained for a period of time according to Eleven's consumption.
In other words, even if Shi Yu didn't ride Eleven, as long as he armed himself with a layer of hardening in advance… it wouldn't be a problem for him to fight an ordinary transcendent-level ferocious beast alone.
This greatly enhanced Shi Yu's life-saving abilities and opportunities to show off.
Apart from that, it was only natural for Eleven to create hardening balls with the nature of metal just now.
With Eleven's current proficiency in hardening, it could even control this hardening ball that had left its body. It spun at a high speed, allowing the hardening ball to turn into an even stronger tearing force!
This was also why even though Buggy had learned a bunch of proficient expert level spatial skills and even perfect high-level dual-element skills, it still couldn't defeat Eleven.
Of course, the greater reason was that Eleven had upgraded its racial skill. Its racial skill proficiency had increased, leading to Eleven's growth. Its physical fitness might not be inferior to the overlord race's dragons at this moment.
"Thunder Palm, Hardening, and supervision, these three skills can't be separated."
"Next, try to integrate your supervision. This way, you can lock onto the target more accurately and let the electromagnetic cannon hit 100%."
"Your current profundity can only be considered an electromagnetic cannon. When the time comes, it will be a super electromagnetic cannon," Shi Yu sutured.
Well, a certain unscientific super electromagnetic cannon.
The hardening ball, which had compressed a huge amount of metal-element energy and thunder-element energy, was locked onto by super vision and shot out with electromagnetic acceleration. The final power might be able to heavily injure a commander-level creature…
Now, Eleven was getting closer and closer to being invincible in its level range.
Unfortunately, there were no longer any young divine beast cubs in this world that could be compared to it.
As for Buggy, even if it did not use the Ice Dragon Whiskers, it would not lose to some cubs of monarch races who had mastered super-level skills. It was also not bad.
As for the baby ginseng, the future was bright.
"Wuuu!!!"
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven raised its hand excitedly. Train!
The next goal was the super electromagnetic cannon!
On the other hand, Buggy and Baby Ginseng had looks of envy.
Attack-type combination profundity
Although Buggy had a bunch of skills, right now, there weren't any profundity skills that had real combat value.
This was also one of the reasons why it couldn't defeat Eleven.
As for the Ginseng Baby, its combination skill was purely to make the effect of its supplement better…
"Ji!" Buggy looked up at the sky and sighed.
Ahhh, after the hardening and absorption of the special property, the leader became stronger again. It couldn't fight anymore, and the gap widened again.
Damn it.
It looked at Baby Ginseng and wondered if it could defeat its leader by teaming up with it.
There was another reason why it lost to Eleven. It was restricted by the Green Silkworm Race and had too little physical strength.
For a species like the Green Silkworm, the physique of bears like the Iron-Eating Beast was too much.
But with the support of the ginseng baby, the disadvantages of physical fitness would directly disappear, and even become an advantage…
"Yi?" Baby Ginseng looked at Buggy innocently. What's wrong?
At this moment, Buggy was thinking.
He and his leader were the "Wuji Airlines" combination, so teaming up with Baby Ginseng would be very impressive…
After Buggy let out a cry, it instantly fell silent.
"Yiji" combination…
…
After handing the Flat Thunder Rocks to Eleven and arranging training missions for them, Shi Yu began to quietly meditate and strive to level up as soon as possible.
He stopped adding points because tomorrow was the day to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins.
This time, there were four master-level Beast Tamers protecting him.
Apart from the main mission, Shi Yu also wanted to see if he could encounter a side mission.
He wanted to fight a few commander-level ferocious beasts on the way.
To look at the difference in battle power between Eleven, Buggy, and a commander-level ferocious beast.
If it was the difference in energy, Eleven and Buggy definitely hadn't surpassed it.
Even if it was a commander-level ferocious beast of a low-level transcendent race, after reaching the commander level, its energy value would be at least five digits, exceeding ten thousand.
Back then, when Eleven participated in the vocation assessment, its energy level was only slightly more than three thousand.
At the moment, although Eleven felt that its energy level had at least doubled, it should still be much weaker than a commander-level creature.
However, energy points did not represent battle power.
Eleven, who had mastered a bunch of profundities… Even if its energy value was inferior, its use of energy was good. It should still have the ability to fight a commander-level creature.
Generally speaking, the energy level of transcendent cubs of overlord races was above 6,000.
Currently, after Eleven used his supervision to make a rough judgment, its energy value should be above 7,000 when compared to the test.
If it encountered that Zonyan Rock Beast again, it could defeat it with a single punch.
The energy value of Buggy was more than 3,000.
As for the energy value of the ginseng baby, Eleven judged it to be around 7,000 with his super vision.
This was purely because the Ginseng Baby race had a lot of HP and MP, low attack, low defense, and low speed.
Instead, when a pet reached the commander level during its growth stage, its energy level would definitely reach 10,000 and it would have magical abilities such as creating energy crystals.
From the transcendent level to the commander level, it was a process of growth, development, and awakening. It was commonly known as "minor evolution". It directly erupted the heritage and foundation of the pets. Some pets at the transcendent level might have an energy value of 3,000, but after breaking through to the commander level, it might directly increase by four or five times.
At this moment, Shi Yu was very curious about how much energy these three pets could gain after they grew to commander rank.
It didn't mean that a pet was commander level just because it had over ten thousand energy points.
Instead, when a pet reached the commander level during its growth stage, its energy level would definitely reach 10,000 and it would have magical abilities such as creating energy crystals.
From the transcendent level to the commander level, it was a process of growth, development, and awakening. It was commonly known as "minor evolution". It directly erupted the heritage and foundation of the pets. Some pets at the transcendent level might have an energy value of 3,000, but after breaking through to the commander level, it might directly increase by four or five times.
Similarly, after Eleven, Buggy, and Ginseng Baby broke through to the commander rank, with their current energy points as the foundation, their energy points would also increase explosively.
To put it bluntly, the growth level was a process that relied on external nutrition, battle training, accumulation, and specific opportunities to constantly increase the strength of the body, vitality, and energy intensity, approaching and breaking through the limits of the race.
Therefore, during this process, the higher the species level, the easier it was to increase. There would be no bottlenecks. As for transcendent species like Eleven and Worm, although their energy levels and skill proficiency were off the charts, due to the limitations of their race, it was still relatively difficult to break through. They needed to accumulate more time.
Only by reaching a certain point could they successfully break through.
According to Shi Yu's understanding, Lin Hongnian's Iron-eating Beast had been stuck at the transcendent level for ten years.
The opportunity for a breakthrough was a wild battle. The iron-eating beast was on the verge of death, its life hanging by a thread. It purely relied on the contract to not die directly.
After that, the Iron-eating Beast underwent a month of treatment. Using its extreme near death as an opportunity, it successfully broke through its species limit and grew to commander rank.
At that time, the energy, combat power, and racial skill proficiency of that Iron-eating Beast definitely weren't as high as the current Eleven. Therefore, this so-called opportunity made Shi Yu very conflicted.
But it didn't matter if there was no opportunity. With Eleven's current state, it wasn't impossible for him to break through when the conditions were right.
If it really didn't work, the so-called bottleneck would disappear after evolution.
It was also because of the evolution that Hall Master Lin's Iron-eating Beast broke through to the monarch level.
"Generally speaking, only a level-four Beast Taming Space can control commander-level pets and provide the nutrients they need to grow."
"I feel that before Eleven breaks through and evolves, my Beast Taming Space might not necessarily reach level four."
This was also what made Shi Yu conflicted.
"Forget it, it's alright. In any case, even if the Beast Taming Space doesn't have the binding power, Eleven can't break free from the contract. Moreover, as long as the absolute sleep level is high, their own absorption efficiency of nutrition will increase. The second and third-level Beast Taming Space can still maintain their training and growth."
Shi Yu planned to buy nutritional supplements, also known as a way to bypass paywalls, to increase the proficiency of the Absolute Sleep skill, which was similar to the effect of the Beast Taming Space. It was to reduce the pet's need for the Beast Taming Space level.
This way, after school started, he could immediately arrange for Eleven and Worm to evolve. Shi Yu was an impatient person and did not plan to wait for the Beast Taming Space to increase to level four. Why would he wait?! Level three was already not bad!
"Meditate!"
…
The next morning.
After Shi Yu finished eating breakfast, he called Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng out.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already put on the level-five cold-proof coat provided by the Ping Cheng Association.
The core material of this blue cold-proof suit was made from the monarch race's ice-element ferocious beast, Snow Night Demon, supplemented with various cold-resistant insect silk. It had very good resistance to cold. With Shi Yu's current physique, wearing this would allow him to withstand the coldest place on the snow mountain.
"Come here."
After putting on the cold clothes and bringing the props, Shi Yu summoned his three pets.
"Wuu! (Exploration! Battle! Battle!)"
"Ji! (Ice Dragon! Ice Dragon!)"
"Yi! (Can we not go? I'm afraid of the cold.)"
Eleven climbed onto Shi Yu's left shoulder, while Buggy climbed onto Shi Yu's right shoulder. Baby Ginseng crawled into Shi Yu's pocket with a forced expression.
"Let's go!"
With three pets with him, this sense of security made Shi Yu sigh.
When he came out, a car had already stopped at the entrance of the villa area. Shi Yu took a look at the car number and directly opened the door to get in.
The driver's seat was occupied by President Feng's beautiful female secretary.
Shi Yu was slightly silent. This ten-thousand-year-old bachelor, Old Feng… Didn't he look for a wife? Why was he always inseparable from his beautiful female secretary?
How could that be?
In the front passenger seat was President Feng. In the back seat, apart from Shi Yu who had just come up, Hall Master Lin was in the car already.
"Uncle Feng, Uncle Lin."
After getting into the car, Shi Yu greeted each of them.
President Feng and Hall Master Lin smiled and said, "Shi Yu, you look pretty energetic today."
In the past few days when Shi Yu had been living in seclusion, President Feng and Hall Master Lin had come to the villa to visit.
At that time, Shi Yu was in the midst of his refreshment period, so his complexion was naturally not very good.
As for now, how could he not look good after resting for a day…
"I'm good, I'm good…" Shi Yu smiled.
"Well… Where's Dr. Lu?" Lin Hongnian looked at Shi Yu and asked.
"Yeah, where's Dr. Lu?" President Feng also said in anticipation.
At that moment, they naturally knew that Lu Qingyi would follow them to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins.
Lu Qingyi was one of the few archeological big shots who was willing to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins. The Masters in Icefield City were very familiar with her. At the moment, Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu were jointly exploring the Ice Dragon Ruins. President Feng and the others had very high expectations.
"Senior Lu said she will directly arrive outside the snow mountain. Let's go over first," said Shi Yu.
"Alright! Old He and the others are also stationed by the snow mountain. Then drive. Let's go and find them." President Feng nodded and said to his secretary.
Right on the heels of that, this car that was carrying two master-level Beast Tamers and a newbie professional Beast Tamer drove directly to Ice Dragon Snow Mountain!
At the edge of the snow mountain.
A bunch of Beast Tamers who breathed cold air would enter the snow mountain from time to time and come out of the snow mountain, entering the camp outside the city wall.
Against the background of the white snow mountain, the living environment of the soldiers stationed outside the nearby city wall appeared especially arduous.
These soldiers of the Beast Tamer Corps had to clean up the ferocious beasts that came to the edge of the snow mountain every day and were in charge of reconnaissance and patrolling.
On the high wall, Lu Qingyi, who was wearing a white research suit, stared at the soldiers training below as if she was recalling something. Beside her was a huge Green Spirit Wind Bird that looked like a blue Phoenix!
"Have we arrived?" After a long time, Lu Qingyi shifted her gaze and looked at Shi Yu, Lin Hongnian, President Feng, and the vice regiment commander of the Beast Tamer Corps who came out of the car.
"Let's go over too." Lu Qingyi patted the Azure Spirit Wind Bird.
…
"Uh."
Below.
This was the first time Wang Meng, the commander of the Beast Tamer Corps in Ping Cheng, had seen Shi Yu.
Although he had already heard that there was an Ancient Capital Scholar in Ping Cheng and felt that Shi Yu was very impressive, Shi Yu's image was really difficult for him to understand.
The small iron-eating beast, green worm, baby ginseng combination… no matter how one looked at it, he didn't look like a top scholar.
"Little brother Shi Yu, awesome!!!" It was the first time the rough-looking Commander He Biao had seen Shi Yu since the last time he cracked the Ping Cheng ruins. When he saw Shi Yu, he immediately cursed. "F*ck, awesome, really awesome…"
This Beast Tamer who had grown up in the army no longer knew how to describe Shi Yu's achievements during this period of time.
"Not really, not really…" Shi Yu was embarrassed.
"The hope of the country." Commander Wang Meng praised. Then, he looked at President Feng, Hall Master Lin, and the others with a serious expression.
"According to the previous plan, I'll continue to guard the city wall. Commander He and everyone, let's head to the Ice Dragon Ruins."
"However, the Beast Tamer Corps in the city next door discovered today that there might be some abnormalities in the snow mountain."
"A monarch-level ferocious beast seems to have appeared in the path of the Ice Dragon Ruins. Everyone, be careful!"

chapters.title: Chapter 142  Baby Ginseng's Attack Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 142  Baby Ginseng's Attack Skill
"Monarch-level ferocious beast?!"
After Commander Wang Meng finished speaking, President Feng and Hall Master Lin were stunned.
Damn.
There were only about a dozen monarch-level ferocious beasts in the entire Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. Was it such a coincidence?
However, President Feng and Hall Master Lin weren't afraid.
"It's alright, it's just a monarch-level. It's fine if we didn't encounter it, but if we did…"
President Feng chuckled.
He had a monarch-level battle power, Deputy Commander He Biao had a monarch-level battle power, Lin Hongnian had two monarch-level battle powers, and Dr. Lu Qingyi, whose strength was similarly powerful… This monarch-level ferocious beast would also be sending itself to death if it came.
At that time, all the high-level materials in its body would be completely stripped.
Apart from Shi Yu holding them back and needing to be protected. Anyone in this team wasn't afraid of monarch-level ferocious beasts.
"What race?"
Shi Yu asked curiously.
He wasn't worried about the threat of a monarch-level ferocious beast at all. Did that beast think that all his bodyguards were hired for nothing?
He didn't care about the threat of this level of ferocious beast. Instead, he cared about the race of this level of ferocious beast.
It was purely an occupational disease.
What if the other party had some rare skill?
Generally speaking, at the monarch level, there were at least ten accompanying skills on it. It was guaranteed that it would have one super skill and one high-level skill!
If there were really rare skills, Shi Yu might even look forward to an encounter.
"I'm not sure."
"The exploration team retreated immediately after sensing the monarch-level deterrence from afar."
"However, through a rough investigation, it's suspected to be a plant-type creature," Commander Wang Meng said.
Shi Yu: "?"
"Plants?"
Holy shit.
Shi Yu's eyes lit up.
Plants, really?
Generally speaking, although plant-type pets might not necessarily have wood power, apart from a few exceptions, 95% of them still had wood power. Moreover, even if they weren't their default element, most of them would have secondary wood power skills!
Shi Yu's heart immediately stirred as he looked at Baby Ginseng.
Baby Ginseng: 0.0
He wondered if there were any skills suitable for baby ginseng…
"Plant type?" President Feng said, "It should be a new monarch."
Ten years ago, after the beast tide, Icefield City was the first to react.
After reacting, Icefield City, along with the master-level Beast Tamers from the surrounding second-level cities, directly formed a team and tackled the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, initiating a counterattack.
That half a year-long expedition directly killed most of the Snow Mountain Monarchs.
Of course, the snow mountain was too big after all, and the environment was not suitable for human Beast Tamers to stay for long. Facing some ferocious beasts that were good at hiding in the snow, human Beast Tamers didn't have the energy to fight guerrilla battles with them at all, so there were a bunch of fish that escaped the net.
If President Feng didn't remember wrongly, these remaining monarchs didn't include plant monarchs.
Therefore, it was very likely that this was a new monarch-level ferocious beast that had broken through recently.
"That's a possibility," Commander Wang Meng said.
"Let's look for it on the way. It doesn't matter if it's a monarch or not. It's mainly to help Ping Cheng eliminate a potential danger," Shi Yu said.
President Feng, Commander He, and Hall Master Lin:???
They looked at the blushing and rather excited Shi Yu and cursed in their hearts. Are all young people so crazy?
They were there to explore the Ice Dragon Ruins, not to clear the ferocious beasts in the snow mountain.
It would have been fine if only Shi Yu was like this… But when the four masters saw this, the panda and bug on Shi Yu's left and right shoulders also had curious expressions about this monarch level monster…
Monarch-level didn't mean a monarch-level race.
One represented the growth realm, and the other represented the potential level. It was the difference between a complete adult and a growing child.
Eleven and Buggy had never seen a monarch-level battle with their own eyes.
"Yi…" Perhaps only Shi Yu's baby ginseng had a bitter look on its face. It had some idea in its heart and understood how terrifying monarch-level ferocious beasts were.
Although it had a battle dream and felt that Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy were very friendly, Baby Ginseng kept feeling that the three of them would cause fatal trouble sooner or later…
Before the few masters could educate Shi Yu on what a Beast Tamer should do in the wild, a black spot suddenly appeared in the sky.
Accompanied by a light cry.
Their gazes were attracted by the black dot in the sky. A moment later, a breeze lingered around, and an elegant and beautiful green Phoenix flapped its wings and landed.
On its body was a beautiful woman wearing a special battle-type research suit.
"Dr. Lu!" The four masters greeted him when they saw him.
Not only because of Lu Qingyi's status in the archeological world, but also because of her strength.
During her university days, Lu Qingyi had already reached the master level. Unlike Beast Tamers like them, whose potential had almost been exhausted, she had a chance of becoming a legend in the future.
"Hello, everyone." Lu Qingyi looked at everyone and nodded.
"When do we leave?" she asked immediately.
The few of them looked at each other. Everyone was here, they could set off at any time!
"Then, everyone, please be careful!" Commander Wang Meng said to everyone. Since it was his duty, he could only continue to guard here. He couldn't go with everyone.
"Old Wang, stay here and wait for our good news." He Biao laughed.
After saying that…
President Feng, Master Lin, and Commander He summoned their flying pets.
President Feng and Commander He's pets were both ice-element Ice Feather Birds. They were huge birds with wings like ice crystals.
[Name]: Ice Feather Bird
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
As for Master Lin, because he had a metal-element strengthening talent, his flying pet was an Ironback Dragon Eagle with weak dragon blood.
< Name > Ironback Dragon Eagle
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Not only were the three flying pets commander races, their growth levels had also reached commander rank.
Only Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu were out of place.
[Name]: Green Spirit Wind Bird
[Race Level]: Low Class Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Lu Qingyi was too strong. Not only was her Green Phoenix a monarch species, but its growth level had also reached the monarch level and it even possessed the Phoenix Bloodline. At this moment, just standing there, it made the other three flying pets feel the suppression from that bloodline.
As for Shi Yu, although he wasn't strong, he couldn't lose face. After nodding, snow lingered around him. Buggy closed its eyes and directly transformed into a frost dragon that was large enough to carry humans.
"Roar!!!" Snow and wind appeared around the three-meter-long Ice Dragon. Under its roar, the Masters were a little speechless.
Damn it.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who was riding the giant dragon with an expressionless face. He managed to act cool again.
Phantom Illusion was an amazing skill.
Using the weakest strength, he showed off its strongest moves.
Of course, there was a price to pay for acting cool. The other masters' pets did not consume much physical strength to carry people, and their flying speed was still fast, but for Shi Yu… he could only let the Green Silkworm exhaust itself a little.
No, it was the Green Silkworm and Ginseng Baby who would be feeling tired later…
"Let's go," Lu Qingyi said. "Before we reach the Blizzard Domain, let's accelerate."
"Alright." The masters nodded.
To go to the Ice Dragon Ruins, they would pass by a snowstorm area. The natural environment in that sky was harsh. Flying pets could not fly high and could only travel at a low altitude.
But before that, the few of them could completely rely on their flying pets to travel quickly.
The wind cut through the air.
The five of them rode on the flying pets. Under the gaze of Commander Wang Meng and the soldiers on duty who didn't understand what was going on, they widened their eyes and swallowed their saliva. Then, they suddenly erupted with high speed and flew towards the interior of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
A group of flying pets looked domineering.
"Chirp ~!!!"
During this process, Lu Qingyi's Azure Spirit Wind Bird directly erupted with a monarch aura, which was also an expert-level deterrence, protecting everyone and preventing some blind flying ferocious beasts or ferocious beasts below from suddenly attacking.
Hoi
In an instant, Shi Yu and the others entered the snow mountain range.
As they went deeper, the cold wind gradually pierced into their bones.
However, Shi Yu felt that it was alright. With the protection of the cold-proof suit, Eleven's face hardened into thick skin. Did it just want to show off?
Soon, Shi Yu and the others flew to the so-called Blizzard Domain and were forced to stop.
This place was already considered to be deep into the snow mountain. The sky in front was gray. Fierce ice crystals accompanied by a storm circled in the sky, as if separating the sky from the ground and splitting the sky into pieces.
Legend had it that this harsh natural environment was caused by the war between the human tribes of Ice Dragon in Icefield City.
This was a change in the world that only occurred in the battle between overlords.
An Awakening-level creature belonged to the growth stage. Its energy was loose like smoke, and its unique point was that it had many growth stages.
Transcendent-level creatures had already broken free from their mortal bodies. Their energy was as dense as water, and their skills could already cause greater destruction.
A commander level creature's energy was flawless like crystal. It had the ability to create energy crystals, and with this, it was a powerful race.
Monarch level creatures, on the other hand, had their spirit and will materialize into aura. 100% of them had awakened their deterrence and could intimidate others. Top-level monarch-level creatures could even affect the real world with their mood.
As for overlord-level creatures, they had just come into contact with natural power. The aftershocks of their battles could almost permanently change the natural environment of an area.
Some historians judged that the entire ice and snow environment in Icefield City might have been caused by the Little Ice Age triggered by the frost dragons. The snow mountains of the ice dragons with harsh natural environments were most likely affected by the battle of the ice dragons.
Everyone was a master-level Beast Tamer and didn't have the ability to resist the power of nature. After arriving in this area, they landed obediently. Compared to the sky, although the environment of the icy plain below was also harsh, the intensity of the snowstorm was countless times weaker. It was relatively easy to overcome.
"Next, we have to fly for at least an hour to leave the snowstorm area."
"How do you feel?"
After coming down, Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
Even if he was wearing a level-five cold-proof suit, with Shi Yu's professional physique, it would definitely be a little difficult.
"The air is so fresh." Shi Yu sighed. The cold air felt so good.
On Earth, Shi Yu preferred winter over summer.
Everyone: "?"
"Hahahaha, good boy, your health is pretty good," Commander He Biao laughed.
"Looks weak, but he's actually not?" Master Lin and President Feng said to themselves. They revealed envious looks. It was good to be young, unlike them, who were old…
"…Let's continue on our way," Lu Qingyi said.
Just because they landed didn't mean that they couldn't fly anymore, but simply because they chose to fly at a low altitude.
If it were other low-level Beast Tamers, the downside of flying at a low altitude was that they were more likely to encounter ferocious beasts.
However, Shi Yu's team had a monarch-level pet to deter them as they traveled. On the way, they basically didn't encounter any dumb ferocious beasts.
After all, those who felt threatened and didn't run were either strong or stupid.
At this moment, as they flew, Eleven looked at Lu Qingyi aggrievedly.
Its gaze was like that of a resentful little wife, making Lu Qingyi shiver all over.
Even the bug with its eyes closed made the Ice Dragon Phantom look at Lu Qingyi with resentment…
"What's wrong with your two pets? Why are they staring at me?" Lu Qingyi's face was speechless.
What kind of gaze was that?
