"Uh," Lu Qingyi said. The other masters immediately realized that Eleven, who was on Shi Yu's shoulder, was looking at Lu Qingyi pitifully, as if Lu Qingyi had snatched its bamboo shoots.
"Cough."
Shi Yu said, "Because Eleven and Buggy have been looking forward to exploring the snow mountain for a long time. They still want to encounter a few commander-level ferocious beasts and have a good fight… Now, because of the deterrence… Not to mention commander-level creatures, they can't even see any creatures."
"Sob!" Eleven nodded. This exploration was so lonely.
The Green Phoenix :"…"
Then I'll leave?
"But this is pretty good, pretty good," Shi Yu said.
Business was more important! They could fight anytime!
"Good lord."
The few masters exclaimed and looked at Eleven. This Iron-eating Beast was indeed abnormal.
It was one thing not to feel sleepy in such a cold place, but it actually wanted to fight? Moreover, it wanted to fight a commander-level ferocious beast?
Even if it was field training, it didn't have this kind of training method… This young Iron-eating Beast hadn't experienced the brutal beating in the wild, right?!
"It's not impossible." Lu Qingyi glanced at Eleven and said slowly.
It was rare for so many master-level Beast Tamers to accompany Shi Yu. It was also a good choice to take this opportunity to train Shi Yu.
After all, such an opportunity was too rare.
As soon as she finished speaking, the phoenix quickly put away its might.
"Wu!!" Eleven looked at Lu Qingyi excitedly. Good woman! I acknowledge you!
Hall Master Lin, President Feng, Commander He, and the other masters also smiled.
They did whatever they wanted.
Indeed, without the deterrence of the phoenix, the five people immediately discovered a pile of ferocious beasts in this harsh environment's icy plain.
"Aowu ~ ~ ~ ~"
"Aowu ~ ~ ~ ~"
As they approached the edge of the mountain, a voice that made one's heart tremble sounded. Accompanied by wolf howls, a group of giant wolves stood on the icy plain, staring at Shi Yu and the others with blue eyes. They even bared their fangs and emitted a cold aura.
There were a total of 20 to 30 snow wolves.
In the lead was an even larger wolf king nearly four meters long. Its expression was even more ferocious.
A commander rank snow wolf and dozens of transcendent rank snow wolves. This was a pack of snow wolves foraging!
In the past, this group of snow wolves would have long charged forward when they saw their prey.
But now, staring at the group in front of them, the snow wolves didn't have the urge to hunt. They only had the thought of quickly avoiding them.
It couldn't be helped. Even without deterrence, the combination of the Green Phoenix, Ice Feather Bird, and Ironback Dragon Eagle also gave them too much pressure.
Besides, there was also a frost dragon that looked like it wasn't to be trifled with… Many snow wolves looked at Shi Yu and the ice dragon worm with fear.
At the moment, the snow wolf leader did not give the order to retreat immediately because of his ego.
"They're here." Upon discovering the wolf pack, the masters looked at Shi Yu.
It was his turn to perform before they ran.
None of the masters believed that the transcendent-level snow wolf could pose a threat to Eleven. After all, Shi Yu had killed indiscriminately in the survival trial.
But the problem was that commander rank snow wolf.
A ferocious beast that could break through the limits of its race and become the leader of a race in a natural environment was definitely not simple. It had definitely experienced countless life and death situations and had huge opportunities to obtain its current strength.
"You guys have probably never fought a commander-level ferocious beast, right?"
Master Lin Hongnian said, "Commander-level snow wolf… In theory, its energy level is more than four times that of your Iron-eating Beast."
Master Lin used the energy value during the assessment as the standard.
With such a huge energy difference, even if the proficiency of Eleven's skills was ridiculously high, it wasn't that easy to fight.
At that time, with Eleven's Lightning Armor profundity, the Snow Wolf Leader might be able to slap back with an Ice Rending Claw.
"Don't be afraid. Go. See how powerful a commander-level ferocious beast is."
He Biao said, "With us here, don't worry and let the iron-eating beast go."
"Alright."
Shi Yu nodded. In the next moment, Eleven jumped down excitedly. Then, it kept enlarging and became more than a meter tall as it walked towards the snow wolves.
"Wuu!! (I'm here!)" Eleven stepped forward.
"Roar!!!! ~!" With the lead of the snow wolves, the snow wolves bared their teeth and growled, warning this seemingly weak little metal-eating beast.
They clearly didn't want to fight directly.
"These snow wolves… don't seem to have much battle intent," President Feng said with a chuckle.
"Mm." Lu Qingyi activated her glasses index silently. A dense pile of numbers appeared in front of her glasses and started to observe the situation of that snow wolf commander.
1… 33… 2… 9…
Energy Points… 13329!
It had an additional 10,000 energy points than the Little Iron Eating Beast!
Lu Qingyi was curious about how far Shi Yu's Iron-eating Beast could fight with its skill proficiency in the face of such a huge difference. She originally thought so, but in the next second, Lu Qingyi's expression changed.
That was because she had also accidentally detected Eleven's energy level.
The numbers on it made her doubt life.
It wasn't the 3,000+points during the vocation assessment.
Instead, it was displayed at this moment, "7596"!
How was that possible!
Lu Qingyi's expression was incredulous, and she even suspected that the index was broken.
However, the other snow wolves had less than a thousand energy points, so it was very normal for them to remind Lu Qingyi that the index wasn't broken.
She took a deep breath and quickly looked at the Green silkworm. Its energy level was 3045…
It was similarly ridiculous!!
"…" What exactly had Shi Yu experienced these ten days…
At this moment, Lu Qingyi's expression had already changed slightly. The other three Masters were still laughing and joking, planning to see Shi Yu, this newly advanced genius Beast Tamer, suffer a loss. The gap between transcendent and commander rank… was still very huge.
So big…
Everyone was stunned. They saw that the snow wolf had no intention of fighting. Eleven simply stopped and stretched out its short and fat arm, aiming its palm at the snow wolf commander.
Eh?
What was this?
The few of them knew Shi Yu's Iron-eating Beast's battle style. Among them, there was no opening move to aim your palm at the enemy!
"Wuu!" At this moment, Eleven's super vision had already locked onto the snow wolf commander perfectly.
Buzz!
The next moment, its entire arm hardened into metal.
Crack!
Right on the heels of that, a strong electric arc appeared on Eleven's hardened arm and wrapped around it, producing a violent sound and shooting out dazzling electric light!
The black hardening substance and the blue lightning intertwined, making Eleven's entire arm look extremely beautiful.
"Old Lin, what are they doing?"
President Feng and Commander He asked Lin Hongnian, the Iron-eating Beast Master.
Lin Hongnian: "The combination of Hardening and Thunder Palm… But, I don't know this starting posture."
Under normal circumstances, shouldn't it harden the whole body and then use the Thunder Palm to stimulate the cell activity in the whole body to bring about a super explosive speed, piercing through the enemy in one hit?
What do you mean by standing here and pointing your palm at the enemy?
Master Lin Hongnian was confused.
The next moment, the three masters were stunned again.
As Eleven's entire arm shone, a black ball wrapped in strong blue lightning suddenly condensed in its palm!
Transcendent Hardening, Release of Hardened Material!
However, the three of them still didn't understand what Shi Yu and Eleven wanted to do.
"…What's this???"
In the next second, Lin Hongnian's expression suddenly changed. That was because the black ball wrapped in lightning actually started to spin irregularly at an extremely fast speed. The lightning lingered around, as if it had formed a small lightning typhoon, emitting strong hissing sounds!
Lin Hongnian was stunned. After releasing the hardened substance, it could still spin like a windmill?
Boom!!
On the other hand, although the Snow Wolf Commander was completely focused the entire time, when the blue light beam blasted over, it only felt that its vision couldn't keep up with the speed of this attack at all. Its body trembled to the extreme!
Then, a scene that made the three Masters widen their eyes and reveal shocked expressions appeared. As Little Eleven's gaze focused, the ball that was wrapped in lightning and rotating crazily turned into a blazing blue light beam with a bang. It shot out suddenly. The speed of the light beam was extremely fast, and its destructive power was extreme. Its sound of breaking through the air was like the roar of thunder, shocking everyone.
On the other hand, although the Snow Wolf Commander was completely focused the entire time, when the blue light beam blasted over, it only felt that its vision couldn't keep up with the speed of this attack at all. Its body trembled to the extreme!
"Wuu!!!!!"
When it reacted, it felt as if its entire body was about to be penetrated and ripped apart. Accompanied by a wave of intense pain, the Snow Wolf commander let out an intense and miserable howl!!
Right on the heels of that, it was sent flying more than ten meters away by the light beam it came into contact with. It directly hit the middle of the mountain and instantly shattered the mountain!
At that instant, the entire wolf pack looked at the commander who flew backward and was shocked in their hearts. Their ferocious expressions turned to explosive as they fled like birds startled by the twang of a bow. In the mountain, the heavily injured Snow Wolf commander sensed the huge injuries on his body and ignored the fact that the injuries were still bleeding. Its heart was filled with extreme horror as it directly sealed the injuries. It also turned around and ran with its pack in a panic!
Damn, a monster.
"Aowu!!!!"
In an instant, the wolf pack disappeared without a trace, leaving Eleven, who was staring at his palm in a daze and feeling confident.
And a few master-level Beast Tamers with their mouths wide open and blank expressions.
"It ran away just like that?" On the Ice Dragon, Shi Yu muttered to himself. Why couldn't it fight back?
This was commander rank?
Or was the snow wolf race too weak?
Perhaps a pet like the Zonyan Rock Beast would only have reference value after it reached the commander rank.
"Um…" Shi Yu looked at everyone.
Everyone, including Lu Qingyi, looked at him as if they had seen a ghost.
Shi Yu felt a little embarrassed again.
"Although this snow wolf's growth level is pretty high, its race is too weak. We have to find someone average…" he suggested.
"Holy shit." Commander He widened his eyes.
President Feng was at a loss for words.
Lin Hongnian: Aba Aba Aba Aba…
Hall Master Lin's expression was stunned. This, what the f*ck was this!!!
You Iron-eating Beast! Something was wrong!!
During the vocation assessment, it was already very unscientific. Now, what is this? Tell them, what was this?
Why did the hardened substance turn and fly out with a whoosh, producing such a huge destructive force?
Do tell! Do tell!!
Hall Master Lin: w(゚Д゚)w
"The increase in strength of your pet…" Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and looked at Shi Yu.
Wasn't it a little ridiculous?
Could it be that this Iron-eating Beast had also obtained some divine level bloodline, just like her pet?
"What's this?!!!" Even if Hall Master Lin was a very serious person, at this moment, he couldn't help but cry out loud. Why did he feel that his Nine Li War Beast wasn't as cool as his Little Iron Eating Beast…
Shi Yu: "The profundity skill of Hardening and Thunder Palm, Electromagnetic Cannon… Uh, I think there's a skill in the Mechanic class called Electromagnetic Cannon. I can change the profundity name later."
It was time for the difficult naming segment again… It was not easy to name stuff. Shi Yu sighed.
Hardening and Thunder Palm profundities?
Hall Master Lin was stunned. You call this a combination of low-level skills and mid-level skills?
Commander He and President Feng didn't understand either. They hadn't seen Hall Master Lin's Iron-eating Beast have such a ridiculous profundity skill before!
"Wait a minute." Lu Qingyi suddenly interrupted everyone and looked into the distance with the Green Phoenix.
"It seems like a heavyweight was attracted over because of the commotion…"
"Monarch-level creature…"
Holy shit.
As soon as Lu Qingyi finished speaking, the masters were shocked. Before they set off, Commander Wang Meng had just reminded them… They had really encountered it??
The few of them instantly became serious and entered battle mode.
Beside him, Shi Yu's expression also lit up. "A monarch-level creature really appeared? I like it!"
Everyone: "?"
"Holy shit, don't tell me you want to practice this?" Commander He shouted.
This boy… Something was wrong!
Commander He was very afraid that Shi Yu's Green silkworm could directly instakill this monarch-level ferocious beast with some worm silk later. At that time, he was sure that he would definitely find an ice brick to kill himself and leave Planet Blue.
Shi Yu was stunned and said, "No, no… I definitely can't defeat this. Please, I just like to observe monarch-level creatures. I heard that they are covered in high-level materials. I also like (to touch) them…"
Everyone :"…"
Little money-grubber!
However, it was true that monarchs were covered in treasures…
After killing a monarch-level creature, it would be enough to directly become a millionaire.
This was also why high-level Beast Tamers were all very rich.
Although the cost of cultivating pets was huge, their ability to earn money was also difficult to catch up to in other professions.
Of course, all benefits coexisted with risks.
Sometimes, it was hard to say who was the hunted one.
"Let's go take a look."
Sensing the fluctuations of a monarch-level ferocious beast, Lu Qingyi said.
The few pets she had contracted at the moment were all at the monarch level. Naturally, she wasn't afraid of such wild monarchs.
Unless the Ice Dragon in history books revived. That one would give her a headache.
After nodding at each other, they flew low and headed in the direction Lu Qingyi pointed.
At this moment, in the snowstorm, there was a creature about four to five meters tall. It looked like a pine tree, but its body was as white as frost. The tree crown was fluffy like a blue ice cloud, and the creature with fruits growing on it was walking with a branch.
In mid-air, everyone saw this creature from afar.
[Name]: Ancient Frost Tree
[Attributes]: Ice
[Race Level]: Low Class Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]: Cold Breath, Blizzard, Snowfall, Ice Block, Ice Mist, Snow Collapse, Energy Fruit, Snowfield
"It's the Ancient Frost Tree… Son of a b*tch."
Upon seeing this plant monarch, Shi Yu's heart turned cold.
This was because this thing was the evolution form of the Frost Tree. Its attributes were ice-element. Although it was a plant, it didn't have wood-element!
Its super skills were also ice-element. Although it was also very powerful, it was useless against Shi Yu.
"The Ancient Frost Tree… is indeed a new monarch. Looks like it evolved from the Frost Tree for some special reason," President Feng said.
Shi Yu had originally started to sigh and feel that his luck was bad, but suddenly, he also saw the blue fruit hanging in the Ice Clouds of the Ancient Frost Tree and recalled something.
"Well, it only has more fruits and walking abilities than the Frost Tree. It's usually really difficult to recognize," Lin Hongnian said.
Shi Yu had originally started to sigh and feel that his luck was bad, but suddenly, he also saw the blue fruit hanging in the Ice Clouds of the Ancient Frost Tree and recalled something.
"By the way, is that fruit a wood-element skill?" Shi Yu asked.
He admitted that his foundation wasn't strong enough and needed Division 11's index to save him.
"Yes, a high-level wood-element skill, Energy Fruit," Lu Qingyi said.
"I remember that this skill should theoretically be considered multi-element. But it's mainly wood-element," Commander He Biao said.
"Yes, in essence, it's to create a fruit with wood-element life force, but the inside of the fruit can be filled with different energy types. The upper limit is very high, and compared to a fruit, it's more like a bomb!"
"The Ancient Frost Tree likes to make its prey think that this kind of fruit is an edible spiritual fruit. When the prey eats the fruit, the fruit will detonate in their bodies and freeze the prey. At that time, the Ancient Frost Tree will become a hunter," Lu Qingyi introduced.
It was another plant that relied on its body to lure its prey…
At this moment, Shi Yu narrowed his eyes slightly as he listened to everyone's conversation.
He thought about whether this skill was suitable for his Ginseng Baby.
It sounded very similar to nutritional skills, but nutrition was used to create real spiritual fruits, while this energy fruit was used to create explosive fruits… It could also be said to be a time bomb…
The Ancient Frost Tree could use this to lure the enemy. In theory, the ginseng baby seemed to be suitable for this too?
At that time, directly combining nutrients, energy fruits, and sweet aura into a skill would definitely be more attractive than the energy fruits directly created by the Ancient Frost Tree. Even if a monarch-level ferocious beast saw it, it would probably not be able to resist swallowing it directly… It was even more impossible for it to imagine that the nutrients created by the Ginseng Baby could still explode.
Before learning how to control plants and land in the tree world, it was a very good overkill and camouflage skill… Even after learning how to control plants, creating a forest filled with explosive fruits seemed to be very fierce. It was very suitable for baby ginseng's attack skill.
Art was explosive!
"I want this skill."

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - Ice Dragon Daddy, Im Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Ice Dragon Daddy, I’m Here
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu and the others stared at the ancient tree from afar.
At this moment, the Frost Ancient Tree suddenly stopped.
After taking root in the ground, its life aura had completely disappeared.
Only the Energy Fruits hanging on its body emitted the aura that attracted the ice-type beasts.
It gave people the feeling that it was a high-level spirit fruit that would be greatly nourishing.
“It stopped?” Commander He Biao was surprised to see this.
“Did it discover us?” President Feng pondered. “I don’t think so.”
This plant-type monarch was actually very silly.
Other than a small number of special plants, plants like frozen ancient trees had poor reconnaissance and mobility.
This was also the reason why the plant kings in the snow mountain were the first to be cleaned up by humans.
They couldn’t even run fast if they were warned to. How useless.
The other monarch-level ferocious beasts did not need to be very powerful when facing the human expeditions. They just needed to run faster than the Frost Ancient Tree.
In fact, the Frost Ancient Tree liked to occupy a territory the most and wait for its prey to come knocking on its door.
Its disguise ability was not bad. At the very least, its current disguise was enough to deceive inexperienced wild beasts.
However, it was still a little young when facing experienced Beast Tamers like Shi Yu.
At this moment, the Frost Ancient Tree did not realize the seriousness of the problem.
The Energy Fruit swayed like an old sly fox who was about to seduce his prey.
“It doesn’t seem very smart,” said Hall Master Lin.
It were still walking just now, but now it was already pretending? Was he insulting their intelligence?
“It’s good that it’s not smart…”
“The core of the Ancient Frost Tree is a sixth-level ice-type resource. It’s worth 10 million…” President Feng said.
Should they just take care of it and reap the benefits?
This new monarch was actually very troublesome.
Those monarchs who had lived for a long time were all afraid of humans. They hid in the deepest part of the snow mountain and didn’t dare to come out.
And this kind of new monarchs that just went through a breakthrough was usually the most likely to run around and was more threatening.
“Then let’s attack together,” Master Lin Hongnian, who was riding the Ironback Dragon Eagle, said.
A battle between monarchs was no small matter. A group fight was the safest method.
“Our pets are both ice-element pets. It has a super. It’s not easy for us to fight,” Commander He Biao said.
“Let’s use deterrence to support Old Lin,” President Feng said.
“Sure.” Lin Hongnian nodded and felt that it would work.
This support was also very necessary. With the continuous deterrence of two monarch-level pets, it could reduce the battle power of the Frost Ancient Tree by 20%.
“Then I’ll leave it to you guys. I’ll protect Shi Yu.”
Lu Qingyi spoke and decided to stay by Shi Yu’s side to protect him.
With the four monarch-level pets of the three masters, it was not a problem for them to gang up and beat up a Frost Ancient Tree. Lu Qingyi could not be bothered to attack.
Most importantly, if she interfered, it would be difficult to split the Frost Core in the end. It was better to let President Feng and the other Beast Tamers of Ping Cheng split it themselves.
“Alright, thank you, Dr. Lu,” Master Lin Hongnian said. With Lu Qingyi protecting Shi Yu, they were also very relieved.
“Uh…” Shi Yu sat on the Ice Dragon Buggy and scratched his cheek.
Did they need to protect him? He had turned etherealization.
Forget it, if these guys said so… Shi Yu moved closer to Lu Qingyi.
…
At this moment, riding on their respective flying pets, the three masters started to summon their monarch-level pets.
President Feng summoned a monarch rank Frost Moon Ice Wolf. This was the Snow Wolf’s high class commander species evolution form.
Commander He summoned a monarch rank snow monster. This was a monster that looked like an ape. Its species was also high class commander rank.
On the other hand, Hall Master Lin summoned the monarch-level Nine Li Battle Beast and the Diamond Ape King.
From the pets, one could tell the strength of Lin Hongnian, the richest man in Ping Cheng.
President Feng and Commander He’s monarch rank pets were both high class commander rank. They relied on accumulation to break through the racial limit to become monarchs.
As for Lin Hongnian’s Diamond Ape King and Nine Li Battle Beast, one was a low-level monarch race, while the other was a mid-level monarch race. They were all very rich.
The difference in battle power between the two parties was actually very obvious.
Generally speaking, battle power was determined by growth level and race level.
It was basically impossible for commander-type pets to have super skills, so Hall Master Lin’s two pets would definitely be stronger.
Shi Yu secretly glanced at Senior Lu.
As the president of an association in a third-level city, President Feng didn’t have any king species pets. Yet, Lu Qingyi could casually find several monarch species pets for him to choose from. She was simply rich!
“Look carefully.” Lu Qingyi looked at the Frost Ancient Tree and said to Shi Yu.
At that moment, under the command of the three Masters, the Frost Moon Ice Wolf, the Blizzard Monster, the Diamond Ape King, and the Nine Li War Beast looked at each other and walked towards the Cold Frost Ancient Tree with proud footsteps.
How could the F4 of Ping Cheng lose to a mere ancient frozen tree!
They didn’t know how to lose, but at this moment, the frozen ancient tree that was rooted in wait for its prey suddenly panicked.
A bean-sized ice crystal dripped from its forehead. The Ancient Frost Tree sensed that something was wrong.
It felt that it had not attracted prey, but a group of big shots.
“Wu!!!!”
A moment later, the Ancient Frost Tree felt that it couldn’t stay silent anymore. It immediately let out a violent roar, and its deterrence erupted!!
Boom!!!
A threatening aura that was almost corporeal erupted from the Ancient Frost Tree like a snowstorm.
“Roar!!!!”
The Ancient Frost Tree erupted with overwhelming deterrence. On the other side, the Ping Cheng F4 didn’t show any weakness either. It displayed an even more classic bullying tactic.
Boom!!
Four similarly earth-shattering auras erupted and pressed down on the Ancient Frost Tree.
At this moment, the five auras collided. The wind and clouds in the sky immediately changed color, and countless falling ice crystals were obliterated into nothingness.
The violent wind was all swept back, and the icy plain shook as if an earthquake and an avalanche were about to happen. The gray sky that was covered in snowstorms looked like it was about to be torn apart, directly splitting into two like a natural chasm.
Swoosh!
In an instant, violent ice wind spread in all directions due to the collision of aura.
“Scree ~”
On Shi Yu’s side, the Green Phoenix directly erected the high-level wind-elemental protective skill, “Wind Protection”, to form a domain that isolated everything, allowing Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu to watch the show quietly.
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
Seeing the aura of the five monarchs colliding, Eleven and Buggy shouted excitedly.
This wave, this was what was really called “bullying others”!
Look at the special effects…
Eleven and Buggy gestured and learned.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng stuck its head out. So, when could it learn that?
It also wanted to bully others…
“It’s so powerful. This proficiency probably isn’t low…” Shi Yu looked at the scene in front of him and gulped.
Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Why, what’s wrong?”
“The deterrence proficiency of those five monarchs is only at the proficient level.”
She glanced at Shi Yu, Eleven, and Buggy.
These guys should have some self-awareness, alright?
Honestly…
“This is the proficiency level??” Shi Yu was stunned.
Lu Qingyi said, “Their deterrence power is strong and can affect the outside world purely because their own levels are high, and there are many forces colliding.”
“Your Iron-eating Beast is the ridiculous one…”
At the Awakening level, he had mastered the aura of a monarch that could cover a large area and instantly kill hundreds of ferocious beasts…
“Uh…” Shi Yu was stunned. He had thought that the deterrence of these pets had reached the perfect level.
He was thinking too much.
The Perfect Level Deterrence Mark could intimidate everything. It could change the weather with its thoughts. For example, if the sky was raining or snowing, a single glance could make the rain and snow stop. Or, it could make the rain and snow descend and affect the real world’s weather!
Although it wasn’t as effective as true weather skills, it was enough to show the domineering aura of a monarch.
Right now, the deterrence collision of these few monarchs only looked like it, but it wasn’t at that level yet.
In addition, Perfect Level Deterrence also had the effect of causing physical destruction. Not only could it destroy the mind, but it could also destroy the body.
Then, the monarch aura could not only destroy, but also become a buff. It could increase the battle will of its teammates on a large scale.
As for the transcendent Level Deterrence, it was even more powerful. It could wrap the Deterrence effect around other skills and items, allowing any skill to have the Deterrence effect and create mental equipment!
Shi Yu even heard that higher deterrence levels could change the bloodline of pets.
Even if it was an transcendent pet, after mastering super high-level deterrence, its descendants could directly have the potential of a monarch and awaken deterrence when they were young!
In short, this was a very common late game skill, but it was also a super useful skill.
Now, facing the deterrence of the four monarch-level pets, the Ancient Frost Tree’s mentality collapsed.
It wasn’t afraid of any one of these four alone, especially the Frost Moon Ice Wolf and the Blizzard Monster. They didn’t look very strong, but with four coming at once, who could withstand them?
“Wu!”
The Ancient Frost Tree did not last long. It was instantly crushed back, and its battle intent was severely affected.
It had the intention to retreat. The roots turned into legs. As it retreated, a tsunami-like snowstorm condensed!
The snowstorm swept up a large number of energy fruits and blew in the direction of Ping Cheng’s F4.
The Ancient Frost Tree kept throwing energy bombs into the snowstorm, hoping to block the enemy’s path with this.
“Boom!!”
An the Energy Fruit exploded in the snowstorm, the explosive ice power instantly increased the power of the snowstorm by a level.
In an instant, the snowstorm was vast and covered an area of more than a hundred meters. It instantly covered all the environment in front of it. Faced with this high-level skill, Lin Hongnian’s Nine Li Battle Beast walked out.
“Roar!!!”
The giant panda roared and its physique increased exponentially, turning into a height of more than four meters.
Moreover, the appearance of the armed armor instantly changed from a restrained state to a sharp state.
Super skill, inner Power!
Intermediate-level skill, Giant Transformation!
Intermediate-level skill, Cannon Fist!
Boom!!
Two augmentation skills and an attack skill. The Nine Li War Beast threw a punch out of thin air. A dazzling red light erupted from its fist. With the enhancement of the multiplication and Inner Power, the power of the Nine Li War Beast’s cannon punch was increased by an unknown number of times. At this moment, it was like a scorching cannon fire.
At this moment, its armor turned red, and the energy in its body rose steadily. Red energy spewed out and enveloped its entire body!!
A shocking change occurred. Accompanied by the hot wind swept by the Fire Cannon Fist, a red hole instantly appeared in the huge snowstorm that covered more than a hundred meters. It quickly melted and detonated the surrounding snow and fruits!!
Bang!!!
After the shocking explosion, the hot wind was still sweeping towards the Ancient Frost Tree, making the Ancient Frost Tree’s gaze burned to the extreme.
“It’s hard to teach it at the moment… I have to let Eleven evolve quickly.” Shi Yu was too thirsty for this skill.
Under the enhancement of this Inner Power skill, a mere non-metal cannon skill could be enhanced to such a ridiculous degree, let alone other skills.
Master Lin coveted the Super Electromagnetic Cannon, but so did Shi Yu covet a super skill…
At that moment, in order to counterattack, the Ancient Frost Tree immediately activated its super skill, Ice World.
The ice power of the thousand-meter icy plain suddenly formed a huge ice and snow domain with the heaven and earth as the boundary, enveloping the frozen ancient tree!
Boom!
Invisible waves erupted from the Ancient Frost Tree. Time seemed to have stopped in the domain. The hot and huge fist wind was instantly frozen in midair, turning into ice slag!
Skill: Ice World
< Introduction > A domain formed by freezing the land and freezing the sky. It gathers the natural power of thousands of kilometers. The person inside the domain is a king, and he has the absolute right to control the natural power of ice and snow.
When this move was used, together with the Frozen Ancient Tree’s Ice Sealing Skill, the hot wind created by the Nine Li Battle Beast was instantly frozen in midair!
In addition, the thousand-meter icy plain environment became even more harsh. The extreme cold made the Ancient Frost Tree recover its state again. It looked coldly at the Frost Moon Ice Wolves and Blizzard Monsters that were deterring and suppressing it!
“Roar!!!”
In this situation, the power of the Frost Moon Ice Wolf and the Blizzard Monster, which were both ice-element creatures, was severely suppressed. They could only roar from afar and use deterrence support. At this moment, the Nine Li War Beast had already entered the Thunder Armor State. The Diamond Ape King also used the super skill Giant Body. Its muscles multiplied, and it turned into a violent gorilla that charged towards the Frost Ancient Tree.
As expected of the strongest battle power in Ping Cheng.
For example, President Feng and Regiment Commander He had to send all their pets out to cooperate when dealing with a monarch-level ferocious beast alone and use their Beast Taming Talent. But for Lin Hongnian, both trump cards had the ability to fight the Frost Ancient Tree alone.
Boom!
Under the pincer attack of the Nine Li War Beast and the Diamond Ape King, the Ancient Frost Tree immediately summoned a super blizzard to wrap itself in the ice and snow domain. The crazily spinning snowstorm had a powerful protective effect, as if it could freeze and expel everything.
However… it was still useless.
The Nine Li Battle Beast was like a bolt of lightning that relied on its body to withstand the power of the snowstorm. Its Inner Power erupted, and it directly used the Thunder Palm to penetrate the snowstorm and break through an entrance. The Diamond Ape King was even more domineering. After the Nine Li Battle Beast helped to break through the snowstorm, with a roar, it cooperated with the Giant Body and used the high-level metal-element skill, Giant Arm Beat, to swing at the core of the Frost Ancient Tree in hopes of knocking the Cold Core out.
The wind and snow roared, and the ferocious beasts roared. The battle had reached the most critical moment.
Behind it, the Nine Li War Beast and the Diamond Ape King bore the frostbite and launched a crazy combo on the Ancient Frost Tree!
The entire icy plain suffered intense destruction at this moment. If the battle of the kings was in Ping Cheng, a large area would probably turn into ruins.
“The iron-eating beast’s evolution form is indeed impressive,” Lu Qingyi said at the side.
As expected of a race that required hundreds of millions of evolution materials. This strength was worth this investment.
Shi Yu said, “It’s impressive, but it’s just a monarch-level Frost Ancient Tree. It’s a pity, a pity…”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched as he looked at the frozen ancient tree that was being beaten up by the Nine Li Battle Beast and the Diamond Ape King.
Why was he so ruthless?
He glanced at President Feng and Commander He, who had ice-element talent enhancement.
Neither of them showed any intention of contracting it.
It seemed that the two of them were relatively traditional Beast Tamers and weren’t willing to take a huge risk to directly contract a wild monarch that had grown up.
“The battle is almost over. Let’s go over too,” Lu Qingyi said.
…
[Confirm recording]
Skill: Energy Fruit
Skill Level: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a wood-element skill. An energy fruit created with wood-element life force can be filled with various attributes. Within a certain range, the creator can detonate the fruit at any time and cause various effects.
Status: Can be taught
A moment later.
Under the roars of several ferocious beasts, the Ancient Frost Tree fell to the ground.
Everyone immediately surrounded it. The Frost Moon Ice Wolf and the Blizzard Monster also rushed over with drooling.
This plant-type monarch was full of treasures.
It really was nutritious. Why would a wolf drool at a fruit otherwise?
Shi Yu also came over. He casually touched the remains of the dead Frost Tree and glanced at the traumatized baby ginseng.
I’ll teach you when I get back!
Ginseng Baby: Yi…
Baby Ginseng was still immersed in the battle. Humans were too scary.
Such a huge monarch was annihilated just like that.
On the other hand, Eleven and Buggy looked curiously at the Ice Wolves and other pets surrounding the Ancient Frost Tree, eating the broken leaves… Could this thing be eaten?
President Feng and Commander He looked at the dead Frost Ancient Tree and looked at Lin Hongnian with mixed emotions.
“Old Lin, as expected of you.”
Originally, as a relatively backward suburb, master-level Beast Tamers were relatively weak. But now, with Lin Hongnian, Ping Cheng’s overall strength could also be ranked among the top in Icefield City.
“Howl ~” “Roar ~” The Frost Moon Ice Wolf and the Blizzard Monster also greeted Big Brother Nine Li Battle Beast.
As a monarch-level creature, it was so strong!
They were blessed.
Those broken materials were also a rare delicacy for them.
“Wuu!!” The Nine Li Battle Beast expressed that it was all the power of his daughter’s dowry.
“Hehe, you guys take the materials.” Lin Hongnian said to President Feng and Commander He, “I’ll apply the medicine for them first.”
At that moment, the Nine Li Battle Beast and the Diamond Ape King’s bodies were covered in frost injuries. They resisted the snowstorm’s attack, and it was obvious that they had also suffered considerable damage. An injury of this level was not even something that ordinary healing skills could treat.
It was also because they had the physical strength of monarchs that they appeared harmless. If it were any other commander rank creature, its body would have already been completely frozen to death.
Master Lin used the frostbite medicine that he had prepared in advance and started to apply it to the Nine Li War Beast and the Diamond Ape King.
As for Shi Yu, he was considering whether to replicate other skills. In the end, he chose to give up.
Although there were still super skills, he couldn’t teach them at the moment. It was a waste of time to replicate them.
Besides, he didn’t have a pet that specialized in ice.
The worm could only be considered half ice element. It wasn’t worth it to occupy the skill column for an ice element skill.
After all, the Ice Dragon Phantom was just excessive. There was no need to be too obsessed with perfecting it. The upper limit was only the overlord race. Perhaps, after the worm evolved, it would be.
Shi Yu admitted that he was being arrogant.
They didn’t even fancy overlord races anymore.
If he wanted Buggy to invest a lot of energy to cosplay, he would have to invest a lot of energy to perfect it. How could a mere dragon do that? At the very least, he would need a Mythical-level divine dragon.
“Hahaha…”
As he thought about it, Shi Yu could not help but laugh.
This smile immediately attracted a few gazes like they were looking at a fool.
Lu Qingyi stood beside the Frost Ancient Tree with her arms crossed and observed this monarch. The other three masters and pets were actively dissecting the materials. When they saw Shi Yu standing on the spot and smiling, they couldn’t help but cast puzzled gazes.
Shi Yu :”…”
“I’m a little excited to see the Nine Li War Beast so strong.” Shi Yu looked up into the sky.
“Let’s continue on our way.” Lu Qingyi glanced at the time and said. To her, encountering a monarch-level creature was just a small interlude. The most important thing was still the subsequent Ice Dragon Ruins.
“Alright!!” President Feng and the others dissected it more diligently. As for these materials, they would divide them carefully when they returned!
…
An hour later.
The five of them left the snowstorm area.
Perhaps because of the battle just now, even if the Green Phoenix did not release its deterrence during the flight, there was not a single ferocious beast on the road.
This made Buggy very depressed.
After the leader finished fighting, it wanted to fight too.
But it was fine if he didn’t fight… After flying for the whole way, Buggy felt that it was going to die of exhaustion.
Fortunately, it had the ginseng baby and Absolute Sleep to support it. Otherwise, it definitely wouldn’t be able to keep up with the other pets’ speed.
“Ji!!”
Finally out of the snowstorm area, Buggy gasped.
“Sob.” Eleven looked at it in disappointment. What a good training opportunity, and it was actually complaining about being tired.
It still had to improve his thinking and awareness.
Eleven still wanted Shi Yu to ride it and race with these flying pets, but unfortunately, Shi Yu didn’t want to. He felt uncomfortable.
Buggy: QAQ, I was wrong.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng chuckled.
Outside the snowstorm area, the sky instantly recovered.
The white snow mountain and the blue sky appeared extremely beautiful.
This also meant that they were about to reach the Ice Dragon Ruins.
The Ice Dragon Ruins was located at the top of a snow-capped mountain.
It was a semi-developed ruins area.
It looked like a blockade building made of countless impermeable ice stones.
From time to time, dragon might would be emitted from inside and outside the building. This also resulted in no creatures daring to come into contact with this place other than humans. Even monarch-level creatures were in the same situation.
“This is the place.”
In the sky above the Ice Dragon Ruins, with Lu Qingyi as the lead, everyone slowly descended outside the ice stone building complex.
In the past, many researchers and archaeologists had come here to study. Unfortunately, the huge building complex didn’t reveal any useful information.
The entire ruin looked like an ordinary building without any secrets.
However, the dragon might that leaked out from time to time told everyone that everything was not that simple.
“This is only the surface. The real Ice Dragon Ruins is an independent ruin space inside the hidden surface.”
“But up until now, no one has been able to find a way to open the ruins space.” After landing, Lu Qingyi looked at the entire building complex and said.
“Little Brother Shi Yu, what do you plan to do?” He Biao looked at Shi Yu, who had come down from Ice Dragon.
Master Lin Hongnian and President Feng also wanted to see what plans the genius archaeologist, Shi Yu, who had cracked that trial-type ruin, had.
At this moment, after arriving at the Ice Dragon Ruins, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“This is a tool I obtained from the ruins of the trial.” Shi Yu took out the Ice Dragon’s whisker and threw it to the ice dragon formed by the worm.
Then, he said to it, “Try it first. Take this and call ‘Ice Dragon Daddy, I’m here. Mommy misses you!”
Lu Qingyi: “?”
The Masters: “?”
Buggy:??
Was this how you do archaeology?
“In the face of this ruin without any hints, I can only take an unusual path…”
Shi Yu was serious. The change in the iron-eating beast ruins had opened a frivolous path for him.
Shi Yu looked at Buggy. At this moment, Buggy was stunned as it held the whiskers of the ice dragon and roared according to Shi Yu’s instructions.
“Roar!!! (Ice Dragon Daddy, I’m here. Mommy misses you!!)”
Moreover, it released the Ice Dragon Might to verify his identity.
Boom!
Suddenly, the buildings of the Ice Dragon Ruins that had not changed for thousands of years trembled slightly…
In the Ice Dragon Ruins space, the frost dragon on the seal slowly opened its eyes. It sensed the bloodline connection and revealed a blank expression.
It was a female. Where did this fellow child come from? It must have ben mistaken… However, what was with this bloodline connection?!

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - Origin of Dong Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Origin of Dong Huang
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Boom!
“F*ck!”
As Buggy finished shouting, the ruins started to tremble. Commander He widened his eyes and pointed at the shaking ruins, losing his ability to speak.
What the f*ck!
Did it really react?
This f*cking worked?
President Feng and Hall Master Lin also had strange expressions and shock.
As for Lu Qingyi, she looked at the Ice Dragon Buggy. Apart from silence, there was only more silence.
“It must be because of that Ice Dragon’s whiskers.”
Lu Qingyi kept comforting herself.
That Ice Dragon Whisker was the key to the ruins.
It had to be.
At this moment, as the Ice Dragon Ruins shook, Shi Yu revealed a pleasantly surprised expression.
“It really moved?”
But soon, his expression tightened.
Holy shit.
If he really baited out a response, didn’t that mean that there was really an ice dragon inside?
The few masters also quickly thought of this possibility and couldn’t help but freeze.
At this moment.
“Roar!!!!”
A terrifying dragon roar suddenly came from the sky, causing the expressions of everyone present to change.
“Ji!!!”
Buggy’s eyes widened. It was almost scared to death.
It really made a dragon daddy come out!
The dragon roar didn’t hurt, but it seemed to contain a deterrence that made one’s heart tremble.
Apart from Lu Qingyi, everyone present was a little pale.
A moment later.
Everyone’s expression was a little stunned.
Because this dragon roar… clearly conveyed some meaning.
[I’m a female! I’ve never done it before, so where did this child come from!]
[However, what’s with this bloodline connection? Where did you guys get it?]
Everyone was shocked to the extreme.
Ice Dragon Ruins… Not only was there an Ice Dragon…
And it was a living, conscious ice dragon that could talk!!!
This wasn’t the first time the Ice Dragon Ruins released dragon might.
But having dragon might not mean that there were living creatures inside.
Spirit plants like Dragon Soul Grass or transcendent-level deterrence might be preserved.
But a dragon’s roar, a dragon’s roar that could answer questions, definitely meant that there was a living dragon!
“I, let’s go.” Old Feng’s eyelids twitched.
A frost dragon that had lived for two thousand years was at least an overlord!
Moreover, as a dragon, it was definitely the overlord with the highest battle power.
Even if the few of them added up, it wouldn’t be enough.
Unless a titled legendary Beast Tamer came.
There was indeed something wrong with this ruin…
“I feel that it means no harm.”
Shi Yu said, “Perhaps, history isn’t like legends.”
At least, the stone statue had said time and time again that the legend passed down from the icy plain was wrong.
Perhaps Ice Dragon was a good dragon?
Its answer was quite down-to-earth and friendly.
“It’s alright, try talking to it,” Lu Qingyi stood at the side and said.
It was as if she had the confidence to face the dragon overlord without fear.
Shi Yu glanced at Lu Qingyi…
He didn’t believe that Lu Qingyi was a Titled Legendary-level big boss. Even if it was an ordinary Legendary or top-notch master, it was a little exaggerated.
However, it seemed that this rich lady had a lot of backup plans.
That made sense. As an archaeological big shot who often explored Mythical ruins, how could she not have a few trump cards?
[Sorry, my pet is playful. It was just kidding.]
[It’s not your child, but we have an Ice Dragon whisker. Excuse me, is this yours?]
[The bloodline connection might be from this.]
Shi Yu used telepathy at the ruins.
In the ruins space.
The frost dragon on the seal was slightly stunned and fell into deep memories.
Ice Dragon’s Whiskers…
It seemed to have indeed given away a single strand of dragon whisker as a keepsake.
It had been two thousand years. Someone had finally brought the whisker here.
“Roar!!!!”
The frost dragon roared. In an instant, a huge door appeared in the outside world, in the buildings of the ruins.
It was a passage that connected to the ruins!
Upon seeing this scene, the expressions of Shi Yu and the others changed again.
[You guys, come in.]
The frost dragon sent a telepathic message.
When purebred dragons reached the monarch level, they would awaken their telepathy abilities.
Some spiritual-type creatures also had the aptitude to awaken telepathy. This talent was not exclusive to humans.
Their telepathy reached everyone’s hearts, and everyone hesitated.
“You guys wait outside, I’ll go in,” Lu Qingyi said to everyone.
“I’ll go with you,” Shi Yu said.
Lu Qingyi glanced at Shi Yu and said, “Then don’t leave even one meter away from my side.”
The three masters looked at each other. Are you archeologists crazy?
How could they enter?
It wanted you to go in, so you went in?
They collectively cowered. They kept feeling that it wouldn’t be so easy to come out of the Ice Dragon Ruins space after entering.
“No… I’ll go in too,” Master Lin Hongnian said.
He had promised his daughter to protect Shi Yu well. Although he felt that his battle power was useless at the moment, he couldn’t let Shi Yu and Dr. Lu take the risk themselves.
“Then we’ll follow in too.” Commander He and President Feng’s eyelids twitched.
Lu Qingyi glanced at the three Masters. Seeing their uneasy looks, she couldn’t help but feel speechless. Then, she looked at Shi Yu.
Now, Shi Yu looked curious, expectant, and excited.
She didn’t know if she should praise Shi Yu for being brave…
“It doesn’t matter. Just remember to stay one meter close to me.” Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and stepped forward.
Shi Yu and the others hurriedly followed behind her.
A moment later.
Space changed, and the stars changed. Shi Yu and the others appeared in a completely frozen world where time seemed to have stopped.
The extreme cold was several times colder than the deepest part of the snow mountain.
“Gulp.”
As soon as they entered, the five of them saw a huge monster at least ten meters tall lying on a huge ice and snow altar.
The creature in front of them had a strong body made of ice rocks. The color was ice-blue and dark purple. It looked cold to the bone.
Its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, as well as its pair of wings, were all made of ice and stone. Its scales revealed coldness and snow lingered.
“Roar!!!!” The Ice Dragon, who was lying on the altar, glanced at everyone and roared. Instantly, snow and wind condensed.
During the roar, Ice Dragon glanced over with its deep eyes. Its little ice-blue beard fluttered in the wind, looking majestic.
It was identical… It was identical to the ice dragon that Shi Yu had seen in the ruins of the trial!
At this moment, Ice Dragon glanced at the insect that had transformed into a frost dragon. It felt the Ice Dragon’s whisker in its hand and fell silent.
A worm?
This skill… was so familiar.
“Ji…!!” Being stared at by the frost dragon, Buggy cried. This was all its Beast Tamer’s mission. Don’t look at it.
The pressure that the real Ice Dragon gave Buggy was too strong.
It wasn’t the only one. The three masters’ pets, Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, and Baby Ginseng, who was in his pocket, all had nervous expressions.
Only Lu Qingyi’s Green Phoenix could still maintain its calm at this time.
[Are you here to complete the contract?]
Ice Dragon raised its head and spoke to everyone.
Contract…
What contract…
Shi Yu and the others were confused. They felt that they weren’t on the same wavelength as Ice Dragon.
“Wh-what contract?”
Shi Yu asked carefully before filling it in with his info.
“There’s a historical legend outside. It says that the human tribe living in Icefield City once fought with an ice dragon and sealed the ice dragon on the snow mountain. However, some people say that this historical legend is wrong. We came here to explore the real history.”
Ice Dragon raised its huge claws slightly. What was going on? It was sealed? Why didn’t it know?
“I obtained this Ice Dragon whisker from a Dream Shell in another ruin space. It was it who told me that the historical legends of the icy plain were wrong. As for what this contract is… we don’t know.”
The frost dragon listened quietly. When it heard the name Dream Shell, it recalled something.
“I see. Looks like no one remembers the contract anymore.”
“The Dong Huang Dynasty and the Icefield Tribe didn’t manage to survive that calamity.” The ice dragon sighed.
It conveyed a message that everyone present was rather concerned about.
“Sister Ice Dragon, I feel that the outside world has misunderstood you. Why exactly are you here, and… do you know the reason why Beast Tides often happen in the snow mountains? Can you tell us so that I can explain to the outsiders when I go out?” Shi Yu said.
The moment he spoke, this scumbag’s true colors were revealed.
Lu Qingyi and the others looked at him silently, especially Buggy.
Good lord, he called it daddy just now, but now he called it sister?
Pa!
The ice dragon hit the altar with its claw and showed a dissatisfied expression. It was dissatisfied that the Icefield people outside had actually forgotten its existence.
“I am the battle beast of the Ice Dragon General, Mu Huiyin, under the command of the Emperor Shi of the Dong Huang Dynasty. I’m here to suppress the Ice River Totem!”
“You guys say that I’m sealed here?”
Did they want it to fly away directly and release this Ice River Totem?
As soon as Ice Dragon finished speaking, the expressions of the five people present changed again.
Emperor Shi?
Totem?
Was it kidding?
The Ice Dragon Ruins that they thought were at most overlord-level actually involved such a deep thing?
Emperor Shi… That was the title of the first ruler of Dong Huang.
As for totems, they were known in ancient times. In modern times, they would be guardian-level!
More than two thousand years ago, a Beast Tamer with Time Strengthening talent rose and stepped into the legendary domain. He issued a God Annihilation Decree and destroyed countless totem clans. He threw them into pitfalls, sealed them, and expelled them. He ended the era of totem rule that lasted for tens of thousands of years and established the Dong Huang Dynasty. He was known as the Time Emperor. He was also one of the legendary Beast Tamers closest to the Mythical Domain in human history.
This was the beginning of the rise of the Eastern people, and also the birth of Dong Huang.
“You’re saying that there’s a totem under the altar?” Lu Qingyi’s expression was solemn.
The totem era was not a very good era for humans.
Although there were very few kind totems that were willing to protect humans, most of them raised humans as food.
Even after humans developed the Beast Taming Space Talent and entered the mid-stage of the totem era, this phenomenon still did not change.
At that time, humans had become the growth nutrition of many transcendent creatures. Many powerful totems used the excuse of protecting humans to make humans use the Beast Taming Space to help them nurture their clansmen.
In this era, it was common for Beast Tamers to be forced to contract pets that exceeded the limit of the Beast Taming Space. Their lifespans were average below 30 years old, and they would die from being drained dry by their pets.
At that time, countless powerful totems competed for the territory of Blue Planet. All races lived together. Humans were very low and small, just servants who did odd jobs for many totems.
Of course, it was precisely because of this kind of contempt that they didn’t treat humans as competitors. The thousands of races gave humans a chance to grow.
At the end of the totem era, in the east, the Shi Emperor rose and issued the God Annihilation Decree. He gathered some Beast Tamers who had escaped the control of the totems and launched a counterattack against the totems.
From then on, the totem era in the East ended and entered the Beast Taming Era. In the country, humans were supreme, and only pets became slaves.. This history was still clearly recorded, and everyone was not unfamiliar with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - The Truth About the History of Icefield
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: The Truth About the History of Icefield
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“It’s just a totem that died in an attempt to be reborn.”
“By the way, are you humans of Dong Huang?”
Faced with this question, Ice Dragon breathed out cold air.
“Yes, we’re all from Dong Huang…”
“But, rebirth?”
President Feng frowned. He had a bad feeling.
Damn it.
Rather than having a totem revived, it would be better to let the ice dragon go berserk on them.
The threat between the two was on a completely different level.
“Well, the Ice River Giant is an elemental creature. After reaching the totem level, it’s almost immortal.”
It slowly looked at everyone.
It thought that everyone was here to complete the agreement.
Boring…
But it was also good. It could continue to absorb energy.
Every time the Ice River Giant wanted to revive, it would absorb its energy. After two thousand years, the Ice Dragon felt that it was almost at the totem level.
It was awesome.
It felt that it could suppress the Ice River Giant for thousands of years.
“Sister, tell me in detail,” Shi Yu said.
Ice Dragon said, “Call me Grandma.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Everyone: “?”
Damn, why didn’t these dragons follow human social rules?
“Grandma Ice Dragon, tell me in detail…” Shi Yu said.
“Then I’ll tell you.”
It was rare for an outsider to bring a keepsake over, after all. Ice Dragon yawned.
“Probably thousands of years ago. I don’t know how long ago.”
“An Ice River Totem was born in this icy plain.”
“This fellow is very greedy. He wants to expand his territory and enter the sea area.”
“Therefore, it began to use the excuse of protecting humans to let human Beast Tamers help it nurture its clansmen, the Frost Stone Giants.”
“This is also the origin of the Icefield Tribe. Under the rule of the Ice River Totem, the Icefield Human Tribe and the Stone Giant Tribe have marched into the ocean many times. The war lasted for a long time.”
“In this war, the entire stone giant race and humans were severely squeezed dry. In the end, the human Beast Tamers and Frost Stone Giants wanted to resist and didn’t want to fight the sea anymore.”
“Later on, just as you humans were rising, the Ice River Totem was directly killed in a large scale battle.”
“However, the Ice River Giant is an elemental creature, and it’s extremely difficult to die.”
“In a few decades, the Ice River Giant that was killed will be reborn due to the rich ice elemental power.”
“My Beast Tamer, Mu Huiyin, was the strongest expert of the Icefield Tribe at that time. He was also one of the generals under Emperor Shi and was named General Ice Dragon.”
“Her lifespan is coming to an end, so she might as well directly modify the Beast Taming Space into a sealed space, permanently sealing the Ice River Totem here, cutting off the opportunity for the Ice River Totem to revive.”
“As for me, as her partner, I assisted in suppression and became the guardian of this place.”
Ice Dragon glanced over.
“How did you guys turn this story into that mess about me being sealed here?”
“Misunderstanding, misunderstanding.” President Feng and the others looked embarrassed.
“Then, what is the agreement about rthe token that you mentioned?”
“Back then, Mu Huiyin and I agreed to assist in suppressing the Ice River Totem.”
“The agreement is that when I break through to the totem level and have the strength to completely destroy the Ice River Totem, I can resolve the hidden danger and leave.
Apart from that, when the Icefield Humans in the outside world have the strength to resist the Ice River Totem, there will also be people who will come with a keepsake and cooperate with me to completely destroy the Ice River Totem. “
“So, just now, I thought that a Beast Tamer more powerful than Mu Huiyin appeared from the Icefield Tribe with a keepsake.” Ice Dragon looked at everyone.
“Looks like I’m overthinking.”
President Feng blushed.
In the current Icefield City, there wasn’t even a legendary Beast Tamer, let alone a Mythical Beast Tamer… It was difficult to fight against overlords, let alone totems.
“But it’s also within my expectations.” Ice Dragon lay down again. “After that great calamity, I’m afraid that the Icefield humans don’t have any records of the Ice River Totem anymore.”
Initially, it didn’t expect to rely on humans.
“Senior Ice Dragon, the disaster you mentioned just now means…” Lu Qingyi asked with a serious expression.
The first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty established by Emperor Shi was destroyed for unknown reasons. This was also a question that modern historians had yet to explore.
Although Dong Huang Scripture was rebuilt by someone else, this reason had always been an unsolved mystery.
“I don’t know. It might be war.”
Ice Dragon didn’t mind. “At that time, I was sleeping here. When I woke up, the world outside seemed to have changed.”
“Alright, I’ve helped you solve your confusion now. You guys can leave.”
Ice Dragon looked at Buggy.
The blue dragon whisker instantly flew from its hand to the Ice Dragon.
It directly took back its Ice Dragon Whisker.
It was afraid that someone would use this to pretend to be its descendant in the future.
After waking up, it suddenly had an additional worm descendant. Who could stand this?
“Ji!!”
After the Ice Dragon casually took away the Ice Dragon Whiskers, Buggy’s eyes widened. Shi Yu’s heart was also bleeding.
Holy shit.
At least level seven or eight… This top-notch ice and dragon dual-element resource was directly taken away??
The problem was that Shi Yu didn’t dare to ask for it back.
“Since we brought a keepsake over, then… Do you need us to cooperate with you to completely destroy the Ice River Totem?”
Lu Qingyi wasn’t in a hurry to leave, but said to the Ice Dragon.
“Eh.” Ice Dragon was just about to close its eyes when it suddenly opened them and looked at Lu Qingyi.
“In this way, you can also leave here and be completely free, right?” Lu Qingyi said.
Ice Dragon was in a strange mood. The problem was, It didn’t want to leave.
It could still sleep every day here and absorb the power of the Ice River Totem to quickly become stronger. It liked this place very much.
Otherwise, why do you think Mu Huiyin made me stay?
“You think you can kill the Ice River Totem?”
On the surface, Ice Dragon looked at Shi Yu and the others in disdain.
It felt that his breath could freeze everyone and their pets here.
If it really let the Ice River Totem be revived, it would be trouble. That guy would be even fiercer than it.
Monarchs, overlords, guardians (totems), and myths. Among them, totems were also called quasi-mythical by Beast Tamers.
At that time, in the entire Dong Huang Dynasty, only Emperor Shi alone could kill totem-level creatures. Those generals given titles by Shi Di could at most barely resist the totems.
It didn’t believe that Lu Qingyi and the others could do it.
“A mere totem.”
“We can’t, but the humans now can. They can take out the power to destroy totems at any time,” Lu Qingyi said calmly.
President Feng, Master Lin, and Commander He’s hearts trembled.
“Mere totem”..?
However, from the perspective of the entire human race, this was indeed true.
“A mere totem?” The frost dragon widened its eyes.
Were all the Beast Tamers of the later era so fond of bragging?
“If the Ice River Totem really revives, I can apply for a forbidden weapon. The high temperature triggered by hundreds of millions of energy points is enough to instantly kill the Ice-type totem with its attributes.”
Lu Qingyi said.
Compared to ancient times, the reason why modern human societies were relatively peaceful was because the overall strength of humans had increased by more than a little.
A Legendary-level Beast Tamer who could defeat overlord-level creatures…
A top legend who could resist totems and was given a title by the Beast Tamer Association…
There were also Beast Tamers who could kill totems. The number of Beast Tamers in modern times definitely exceeded that of ancient times.
Not to mention that there was also a super forbidden weapon whose attack range covered half of the blue planet and had the power of a guardian. With this, it was enough to make those overlords and totems not dare to enter the human countries on a large scale. They could only stir in a small area of the border battlefield.
“Roar…”
Seeing how serious Lu Qingyi was, Grandma Ice Dragon’s body stiffened.
It felt like this group of people wasn’t lying to him?
These human Beast Tamers who came with a keepsake really had the ability to destroy totems?
“Forget it… I won’t trouble you guys. I’ll continue to suppress it here.”
Ice Dragon yawned and said, “There’s no better place to stay than here.”
“When I’m tired of suppressing it, I’ll ask for your help.”
Everyone looked at each other. Good heavens, it was a shut in dragon.
Although that was the case, after everyone learned that a totem was sealed here, they definitely wouldn’t be able to sleep well when they returned.
Perhaps the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain would be strictly monitored by the Dong Huang Nation for 24 hours.
“That beast tide…” He Biao said.
“The beast tide was also caused by the Ice River Giant. It’s revenge on the Icefield humans and the clansmen who betrayed it,” Ice Dragon said.
This time, everyone’s confusion was completely cleared.
So, Ice Dragon was taking the blame for the Ice River Totem the whole time?
“In that case, we’ll bid farewell first,” Lu Qingyi said.
Since this Ice Dragon didn’t have any thoughts for the time being, they would talk about it later.
Moreover, they weren’t qualified to negotiate with this Ice Dragon.
Since they knew the situation here, it was easy. Later on, there would be higher-level Beast Tamers coming.
“Wait,” Ice Dragon suddenly said and looked at everyone.
“You won’t use that forbidden weapon to blast the snow mountain when you go back, right?” Ice Dragon was suspicious.
In theory, these people were far too different from the group of Icefield humans it had promised to protect.
It didn’t know what the other party was thinking.
Everyone was stunned.
No, no, of course not!
“No…” Lu Qingyi was speechless.
“That’s good. I’ve shed blood for the human race, and I’ve done meritorious service for the human race. I can be considered your guardian dragon. I was sealed by the Time Emperor, so you guys have to show some respect.” Ice Dragon was still worried. “Actually, it’s not impossible to think about completely destroy the Ice River Totem now. We have to take our time to consider this.”
Ice Dragon thought about it. It had slept long enough. After finishing the Ice River Totem, it would be good to go home and take a look.
“How about this?” It glanced at everyone, especially Shi Yu, who came in with the Ice Dragon Whisker.
“I’ll return the keepsake to you.” Ice Dragon blew back the Ice Dragon Whiskers as if nothing had happened.
“Well, the energy in that one is almost exhausted. Give you one more.”
It blew another one at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu took two Ice Dragon Whiskers with a stunned expression.
However, what stunned it the most was that the second Ice Dragon Whisk was filled with vitality and even contained faint dragon might!
“The second one has my Dragon Might. With this, the ferocious beasts on the snow mountain won’t attack you.”
After Ice Dragon finished speaking, Shi Yu was still in a daze.
Because…
Skill: Skyfrost Cold Energy
[Skill Level]: Super Level
It’s a dual skill of ice and time. It’s a special type of ice power. After mastering it, you can transform your ice power into Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that can freeze time.
[Do you want to record?]
Ever since he entered the ruins space, Shi Yu had always felt that the time flow here was a little strange.
Holy shit, what the hell was this skill?
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, the frost dragon didn’t have this skill at all. How come the frost dragon even had a time-type skill? This wasn’t scientific.
However, the ice dragon in front of him was indeed different from other frost dragons. Shi Yu was silent for a moment, wondering if it had something to do with that Emperor Shi.
Previously, when he learned about this history, he was very excited. He thought that it was an emperor with the same surname as him. Perhaps there was another fate.
Later on, after careful investigation, he realized that the other party was called Emperor Shi (Time) purely because he had time-element talent.. His surname was not Shi at all, and this made Shi Yu happy for nothing!

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - Officially Becoming a member of Bureau 11
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Officially Becoming a member of Bureau 11
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Roar!!! (Farewell!!!)”
After bribing Shi Yu and the others with two Ice Dragon Whiskers, Ice Dragon was relieved and let them leave.
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
After the group left the ruins space, they were stunned.
They kept feeling that this little female dragon, no, the old female dragon was a little strange.
“Let’s go first.”
At this moment, everyone’s emotions were very complicated.
They didn’t expect that the Ice Dragon Ruins didn’t seal the Ice Dragon overlord, but instead a totem-level creature thousands of years ago.
“Let’s go, let’s go. We’ll talk when we get back.”
Everyone took another look at the Ice Dragon Ruins and left directly.
They flew out of the snow mountain.
“Good lord, this is impressive.”
During this process, on the Ice Feather Bird, Commander He Biao suddenly became talkative.
This was too scary, there was too much information.
Moreover, the ancestor of their Icefield Human Race was actually the Ice Dragon General under Emperor Shi…
“I knew it. I’m a bit of a general myself, after all.”
“General my ass. Mister regiment commander. What should we do next?” President Feng rebuked.
“We definitely have to find an opportunity to completely eliminate the hidden danger,” Hall Master Lin said.
Since it concerned a totem, he definitely couldn’t place everything on that little female dragon.
After all, it had been separated from the Beast Tamer for more than a thousand years. Humans also didn’t know what it was thinking.
“Leave this to me.”
“When I return, I’ll immediately contact Bureau 11.”
On the Green Phoenix, Lu Qingyi spoke.
Indeed, Ping Cheng and even Icefield City did not have the ability to solve their own problems now.
They had to rely on the power of the country.
“Then I’ll leave it to you,” President Feng said.
At the moment, he could only report the news.
“Speaking of which, that ice dragon feels very strong.” Commander He Biao looked at the two ice dragon whiskers in Shi Yu’s hand.
“Dragon might, transcendent level deterrence…”
“And I remember that even an overlord-level dragon can only live for a thousand years.”
“It’s been here for at least two thousand years…”
Shi Yu looked up slightly.
Indeed, this ice dragon was ridiculously strong.
The proficiency of Dragon Might was so high.
“It’s very normal. After all, it’s a battle beast of an ancient general,” Lu Qingyi said. “Moreover, that shouldn’t be considered an ordinary ice dragon.”
“From its appearance, I can tell that there’s a big difference between it and ordinary ice dragons.”
“The ice dragons are a middle-level overlord race. As for this ice dragon, I feel that its race has reached a high-level overlord.”
“It should be thanks to the reward from Emperor Shi.”
“According to the ancient books, after the era of totems ended, Emperor Shi obtained many treasures and rewarded them to his generals to help them increase their strength. Perhaps that ice dragon mutated and evolved because of this.”
“As for lifespan, don’t you feel that the flow of time in the ruins is a little different from the outside world?” she asked.
Apart from Shi Yu, the others were stunned.
“If I’m not wrong, that ruin space should be filled with Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.”
“This is a super skill with both ice and time elements. It can slow down the flow of time within a certain range. When trained to perfection, it can even freeze time. It’s one of the strongest super skills since ancient times.”
“I’m afraid that only Emperor Shi’s subordinates can master such a powerful time skill.” Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and said.
“That ice dragon, as the representative battle beast of the Ice Dragon General… Although it hasn’t reached the totem level, its battle power is definitely close to or even enough to fight against the totem.”
“Heavenly Frost Cold Energy…?”
This was clearly the first time the three Masters had heard of this skill.
Beside them, Shi Yu felt good that he was in the know.
Mere Heavenly Frost Cold Energy…
Was it very impressive?
I’ve already replicated it!
Although he couldn’t teach it yet and didn’t have anyone to teach it to,
But in the future… Shi Yu had already imagined the scene of his pet using the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy to cool him down in the summer!
“This skill sounds so ridiculous. Ice Dragon relied on this ability to gain eternal life?” He Biao clicked his tongue.
“Staying in the Ice Dragon Ruins for two days, will only one day pass in the outside world? Then, this is a cultivation Holy Land.”
“Perhaps. There are similar time faculty training venues in Imperial Capital University,” Lu Qingyi said.
Time… had always been the strongest attribute.
When such an attribute landed on a dragon, it would be even more invincible.
“When can you guys tear a giant dragon apart?”
As he listened, Shi Yu looked at the three babies on him.
After seeing the Ice Dragon, Eleven, who had always wanted to tear a dragon apart, was very quiet.
Buggy was also very obedient as if it had seen its grandmother.
Baby Ginseng was even more afraid that Ice Dragon would eat it.
Shi Yu felt that he had given them deterrence for nothing. They had to show some dominance!
Eleven and Buggy looked helpless. It wasn’t impossible to tear a dragon apart.
The premise was that Shi Yu had to increase points!
Now, they felt that they were the ones who had been torn apart.
Ginseng Baby had the same thought. As long as he added enough points, it could do it too.
A moment later.
The five of them flew back to the city wall outside the snow mountain.
“President Feng, Regiment Commander He,” Lu Qingyi said to the two of them.
“Alright.” The two of them immediately understood that during this period of time, Ping Cheng, no, the entire icy plain had to strengthen their protective awareness.
After leaving the snow mountain, the two of them immediately went to their posts to give the news.
Lin Hongnian also separated from Shi Yu and the others for the time being.
Only Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were left behind. They looked at the snow mountain in the distance.
“Senior, is the assessment for Division 11 completed like this?”
Shi Yu asked. The ruins had been cracked, but not completely.
If he cracked it all, it would be a big deal. Now that he had asked for the truth, it should be over.
“It’s enough.”
Lu Qingyi said, “Leave the rest to Bureau 11 to handle. As for you, prepare to start school. University life is very beautiful.”
“By the way, give me the first Ice Dragon whisker. As for the last one the Ice Dragon gave you, you can take it with you first. It’s surrounded by deterrence from an overlord. It might have some special use in the future.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu handed the Ice Dragon Whisk to her.
“I have something for you too.”
After putting away the dragon whisker, something appeared in Lu Qingyi’s hand.
It was a black bracelet.
“What’s this?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“The function of the ruin ring is similar to the ruin bead.”
“The predecessor of this ruin ring is a top-notch legend’s Beast Taming Space. This is a tool assigned to you as an official member of Bureau 11. I’ve told you before.”
“There’s an index prepared for you inside, as well as a certificate for an official member of Bureau 11.”
“From today onwards, you’re an official member of Bureau 11.”
Lu Qingyi had long prepared everything, but she didn’t expect that she could pass it to Shi Yu so quickly.
Shi Yu looked at the ruin ring and instantly felt that he was about to take off.
Then, Lu Qingyi added something that made Shi Yu even more excited.
“By the way, the index also contains a special meditation method.”
“This is a meditation method improved by the founder of Bureau 11. Only official members of Bureau 11 can learn it. Beast Tamers need to meditate in the ruins space. The efficiency of meditation is several times higher than normal meditation. Remember to use this meditation to learn. Your Beast Taming Space level should be able to increase a little faster.”
You should have said so earlier!
Shi Yu felt that this was what he needed!
Shi Yu took the ruin ring and said with anticipation, “This meditation method can also use resources such as the Space Spirit Stone to assist in cultivation.”
“Of course.” Lu Qingyi said, “As long as there are enough resources, maybe you can reach level three in the Beast Taming Space before school starts.”
“It’s easier before level three. And it’s harder after level three. However, after graduation, if you have enough resources and enough cultivation time, you might be able to reach level six in the Beast Taming Space.”
“Senior, what level was the Beast Taming Space when you graduated from university?”
“Level five,” Lu Qingyi said.
“She reached the master level in university?” Shi Yu thought to himself. As expected of someone who also cheated.
“Yes, I was still weak at that time. There were relatively few ruins that I could explore, so it wasn’t the time for my strength to rise…”
Human language?
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. Becoming a master after graduating from university, this was still called not reaching the explosive stage of strength?
Shi Yu quickly fell into deep thought. Speaking of which, Senior Lu was from Ancient Capital University, right?
“Senior, have you participated in the National League? The one that Senior White Brook mentioned…”
Even with Lu Qingyi, Ancient Capital University had never gotten first place?
“I was pulled by the principal to participate once, but I lost to a monster from the Imperial Capital University.”
Lu Qingyi said helplessly, “Why do you have to mention that? Hurry up and go back. I have to do business too.”
“You don’t have to worry about the Ice Dragon Ruins.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu still wanted to trouble himself. He didn’t have the strength to trouble himself.
If he wanted to think about the Ice Dragon Ruins, he might as well think about how to avenge his senior and sweep through Imperial Capital University. This was more realistic.
…
After leaving the snow mountain and separating from the others, Shi Yu went straight home.
Just as Lu Qingyi said, whatever happened after that was none of his business.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already satisfied his curiosity. It was very comfortable, but he wasn’t completely satisfied.
Now, he wanted to know how the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty was destroyed when the Shi Emperor was so impressive and had so many experts under him.
The capital of the Dong Huang Dynasty was the ancient capital. He felt that after school started, he might be able to take a look at the relevant ruins.
As for now, the most important task was to move.
After getting the new ruins space, Shi Yu took a look and immediately understood the difference between the two ruins.
The size of the ruin ring was almost several times that of the ruin pearl.
The amount of energy inside, the strength of the space, and the speed at which it absorbed energy from the outside world were completely incomparable to the ruins.
“Wuu wuu!!” “Ji ji ji!!” “Yiya yiya!!”
Compared to the environment of the ruins pearl, the three pets also clearly liked the ring space with more energy.
After Shi Yu threw them in, the three of them immediately got high.
Upon seeing this, Shi Yu was enlightened.
“Alright, Ruin Bead, you’re useless.”
“Be good and stay in Ping Cheng to become the breeding base for giant pandas.”
In the training villa, Shi Yu immediately started moving things.
The most important items, the Space Spirit Stone and the Ice Dragon Whisker, were all moved to the ruin ring by Shi Yu. In an instant, the ruin bead was completely desolate.
Initially, Shi Yu wanted to immediately inform Old Lin and Old Feng to come and collect it, but considering that they were definitely busy dealing with the Ice Dragon Ruins, he wasn’t in a hurry. He would talk about it later.
At the same time, Shi Yu looked at the Eleven Bureau’s official identification documents and the box containing the index.
