Shi Yu didn’t care about documents. He didn’t want to see his handsome face anymore. He was tired of it.
He opened the box and took out the cell phone model index.
It was a very ordinary-looking silver-white cell phone. There were also two invisible lenses in the box.
This mirror shard could make Shi Yu feel like he was looking at a virtual reality video. He instantly knew the information about all the pets and spiritual plants in front of him, as if he was using an omniscient hack.
In addition, through this, he could also control the growth of the pet’s energy at any time and place.
Shi Yu did not wear the lens first. Instead, he chose to turn the index on. He picked up the index and pressed the switch. The screen slowly lit up.
The next moment, Shi Yu revealed an unhappy expression.
A pleasant female voice came from the index…
[Archeological Type 1111 intelligent index [unnamed] is at your service. Please enter the opening password.]
“F*ck, why is he naming things again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - Its My Turn to Cheat
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: It’s My Turn to Cheat
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu held the cell phone index and fell into deep thought.
He had specially asked for a non-machinery life form to avoid some unnecessary trouble.
However, he had forgotten that even ordinary cell phones might have artificial intelligence and virtual assistant programs!
The problem was, why wasn’t it pre-named already?
“What does 1111 mean?”
Shi Yu’s expression darkened.
“Must it be named…”
“Then I’ll call you ‘index’.” Shi Yu dug his ears and said perfunctorily, “In the future, I’ll rely on you for information that I don’t know.”
After inputting the opening password, Shi Yu named the virtual assistant.
[Name successful.]
[Archeological 1111 intelligent index [index] is at your service.]
Shi Yu smiled. This virtual female voice was pretty nice.
Index girl.
Without thinking too much, he searched for Eleven, Worm, and Ginseng Baby.
These three…
Shi Yu was silent. The three of them were grimacing as they looked at the Ice Dragon Whisker he had put away.
“Wuu!!!”
“Ji!!”
Eleven and Buggy widened their eyes and sweated as they came into contact with the deterrence of the Ice Dragon Whiskers.
They used the pressure of the dragon’s might to train.
“Yi!”
Baby Ginseng wanted to try, but it didn’t dare to.
Shi Yu came to their side and looked at them speechlessly.
“Catalog, test energy value.”
Shi Yu had already put on the invisible lens. As he gave the order, some numbers immediately appeared in front of his eyes.
Floating on Eleven was “7596”.
Floating on Buggy was 3046.
Floating on top of Baby Ginseng was 7408.
“Buggy,,,” Shi Yu muttered to himself.
It wasn’t even half as high as Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
No wonder it was panting while flying. It was short and weak.
“Ji?” Buggy turned around with an expression of ‘I’m very sorry for being a worm’.
It was just a green worm, why was Shi Yu making things so difficult for it?
“Alright, we can see your specific energy points now.” Shi Yu smiled and said to the three pets,
“Eleven, you’re 7596. Highest. Baby Ginseng, you’re 7408. Buggy, you’re 3046, currently at the bottom.”
Eleven and Baby Ginseng also turned around.
“Wuu!” Eleven acted as if it was only natural.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng was surprised that it was so much taller than Buggy.
But soon, its face fell.
With high energy levels, what was the point of not having offensive skills?
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu with anticipation.
Teach it deterrence first!
“It’s not impossible,” Shi Yu said. “There’s no hurry. I’ll teach another one first.”
“ヽ(??▽?)ノ”
Really?
“Eleven, Buggy, play by yourselves.”
“I’ll go modify the ginseng baby. I’ll let it fight with you guys later.”
On this trip to the snow mountain, Shi Yu copied two skills.
One was an Energy Fruit, the other was Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
Among them, the Energy Fruit was the attack skill that had to be taught to the baby ginseng.
As Eleven and Buggy looked at each other, Shi Yu pulled Baby Ginseng away.
A moment later.
Baby Ginseng prepared the sweet aura and looked at Shi Yu excitedly.
“Yi…”
What skill was it?
It was extremely curious.
“You’ve actually seen it before.” Shi Yu smiled.
Then, he reached out and pressed on Baby Ginseng’s head.
“Energy Fruit, teaching.”
“After learning this move, you have to remember one thing.”
“The art of battle is explosions!”
As the light flowed in, Shi Yu breathed in the sweetness before heaving a sigh of relief.
At this moment…
In the ruins, Baby Ginseng was completely stunned.
It was as if a cook, no, ingredient, suddenly had a pile of explosives battle experience.
The relevant usage method of the Energy Fruit was instantly mastered by Baby Ginseng.
[Skill]: Energy Fruit (Initiate)
“Yi…” After Baby Ginseng recovered, it looked at Shi Yu in a daze.
“Try it?” Shi Yu said.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng expressed its understanding, and its expression immediately became serious.
Buzz!!!
It directly multiplied into a height higher than Shi Yu, like a super big white carrot.
After becoming bigger, it lowered its head to look at Shi Yu before extending its short hand.
In the next moment, countless light spots lingered on its short palm as it quickly condensed a white fruit with green leaves. It looked like ginseng or a radish.
The fruit emitted a faint fragrance and was very tempting. However, compared to Baby Ginseng’s sweet aura, it was clearly worlds apart.
“Yi!!” After creating the Energy Fruit, Baby Ginseng was abnormally excited.
It directly pulled at the leaf and assisted it a few times, throwing it out like a stone.
Although Baby Ginseng’s strength wasn’t great, the fruit still quickly reached the sky 100 meters away. At this moment, with a thought from Baby Ginseng, “Boom!” The fruit immediately changed in the distant sky!
The white fruit first flashed with a dazzling white light, then a loud bang was instantly heard. Then, like a super explosive, the white light kept expanding.
The moment Baby Ginseng’s will detonated the fruit, a huge energy rushed out of the fruit. With a world-shaking bang, the rolling energy tide rose into the sky like a sandstorm.
The white smoke rolled up with a bang and swept up energy fluctuations. It was like enchanting white roses that instantly bloomed in the sky.
The strong wind could be clearly sensed even from 100 meters away.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng was stunned.
Was this the destruction caused by it??
Was this the destructive power of a baby ginseng’s skill?
It didn’t make sense anymore.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng had the urge to cry. It had finally mastered a lethal skill!!!
Shi Yu had his hands behind his back beside it, looking profound.
“In the future, if you encounter bad people who want to eat you, don’t resist first.”
“Be good and create an energy fruit for it. When it’s placed in its mouth, you’ll directly detonate it!”
“However, if you want to deceive the world, you have to train the Energy Fruit well first and integrate the appearance of the sweetness and nutrients inside, understand?”
“High-level hunters often appear in the form of prey…”
Ginseng Baby: (? _ ?)
Although it felt that it didn’t match its aura of a towering emperor sweeping through the world, the Beast Tamer probably knew what he was doing.
“Hurry up and show Eleven and Buggy your new skills.”
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng was excited. Yay, yay, yay!! It liked Shi Yu the most.
After saying that, it immediately shrunk to its normal state and ran towards Eleven and Buggy.
Looking at this fellow, Shi Yu touched his chin. He felt that the Ginseng Baby was just like the Frost Ancient Tree. It couldn’t run fast…
“Under the Earth Chain state, it’s even harder to move.”
“In the future, Baby Ginseng is destined to be like other plant-type pets. It’s destined to stand still.”
“Looks like I have to find a skill to increase its defense…”
“Well, in terms of attack power, Baby Ginseng is temporarily good enough, but this skill isn’t very agile. I still have to modify it.”
The Energy Fruit was a high-level skill. Although Baby Ginseng had only mastered the entry-level Energy Fruit, its power was still very strong when combined with its more than 7,000 energy points.
It was even possible for a fruit to break through Little Yin’s Zonyan Rock Beast.
As for the brittle skin of the Sky Crystal Butterfly, as long as it was hit, it could only be insta-killed.
This was actually just the initial state of the Energy Fruit.
The entry-level energy fruit was only able to detonate the wood-element life force that was injected.
After the proficiency level, one could add another attribute power, just like the Ancient Frost Tree.
For example, the Ancient Frost Tree had added ice power to disguise the Energy Fruit as an ice-element spiritual fruit. In addition to the power of the energy explosion, the Energy Fruit that exploded like this also had some freezing effects.
Baby Ginseng was temporarily at a disadvantage because it didn’t master any other attack power… However, Shi Yu had the skill index, so it wasn’t a problem after this.
Then, for proficient, perfection, and every major increase in proficiency, the Energy Fruit could be injected with an additional power that could be disguised as a top-grade spiritual fruit with multiple elements. In a sense, the Energy Fruit was similar to Zhang Qianyi’s Elemental Coordination Talent, but there was a certain upper limit. It was a super limited version.
…
On the other side, after finally learning the attack skill, Baby Ginseng ran over excitedly to show off to Eleven and Buggy.
Just now, Eleven and Buggy also sensed the blast.
At this moment, when the baby ginseng came over, they couldn’t help but let it demonstrate again.
“Yi! (Alright!)”
Then, Baby Ginseng demonstrated.
A white rose bloomed in the sky again.
“Yi!!”
Baby Ginseng looked pleased.
Eleven and Buggy, on the other hand, showed an expression that was only so-so.
When Shi Yu came over…
Baby Ginseng seemed to have experienced something devastating as it sat on the spot and cried.
Eleven and Buggy looked innocent.
Eleven expressed that it only hardened its whole body and crushed an Energy Fruit.
On the other hand, Buggy expressed that it had entered into a concealed state and casually let the baby ginseng blow fruits up a few times.
They didn’t do anything overboard at all.
“Isn’t that too much?”
“…” Shi Yu was speechless.
How many times did the two of you upgrade points? How many times did Baby Ginseng add points? Was it appropriate to bully it like this?
Don’t blame him if Baby Ginseng wouldn’t work hard the next time he upgraded points for them…
Ginseng Baby: QAQ I’ll remember this.
“Alright, I’ll talk about the next plan.”
After Shi Yu came over, he directly got to the point.
“There are still nearly ten days until school starts. Next, I’ll try my best to meditate with new meditation techniques and the Ethereal Stone to see how the effect is.”
“It’s best if I can raise the Beast Taming Space to level three before school starts. At that time, I can contract a ginseng baby.”
Baby Ginseng blinked.
After the contract, it didn’t have to guess what Eleven and the insect’s cries meant.
“But we shouldn’t be in Ping Cheng for the next ten days.”
“I plan to pack up and leave for the ancient capital immediately.”
“At that time, firstly, I’ll ask Dean Hao to help build the equipment for you to be evolved into, and secondly, it’s time to collect credits to exchange for your evolution materials.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Well, and after the contract, Baby Ginseng, I’ll take you to challenge other pets to fulfill your battle dream.”
Shi Yu’s words made the eyes of the three pets light up.
“Wu!!” “Ji!!!” “Yi!!!”
…
After making the decision, Shi Yu began to meditate and cultivate as he prepared.
During this period, he asked the school to help him prepare a billion yuan worth of Iron-eating Beast evolution materials.
In addition, he also left a message for President Feng and Hall Master Lin to take over the ruins pearl and discuss the Iron Eater Village plan.
“Damn, so fast.”
As for Shi Yu, he established his connection within the new ruin space through the ruin ring and slowly tried the special meditation technique that Senior Lu had given him.
The new meditation technique wasn’t difficult. He only made some modifications to the original foundation.
To be specific, it could be described using a gaming example: In the past, it was as if he was always one of his small accounts fighting monsters to level up, but now, he was using his main account. By using both accounts, he could raise his alternate account to level up and fight monsters to collect experience, and the efficiency of leveling up would directly double!
The ruins left behind by the Legendary big boss were big accounts, while his own ruins were small accounts.
Now, Shi Yu knew why Eleven and the others liked to train in the ruins space.
“At this rate, I might really be able to raise the Beast Taming Space to level three in ten days…”
Shi Yu picked up an Ethereal Stone and said silently. Strong physique+special meditation technique+spatial resources… This was an upgrade acceleration hack!

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - Returning to the Ancient Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Returning to the Ancient Capital
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
When his meditation speed increased and he could make the Beast Taming Space have changes every second, Shi Yu felt that he had fallen in love with the feeling of meditation.
As long as he worked hard for a few days, his strength would immediately take a qualitative leap. It was completely different from the feeling of needing to bitterly cultivate and meditate for a year and a half to gain something.
The former could make one unable to sleep all night, while the latter would only make one want to work hard more and more.
However, after Shi Yu’s meditation speed increased, the energy consumption of the Ethereal Stone increased faster when he used the Ethereal Spirit Stone to assist in his cultivation.
At this rate, he didn’t know if these Ethereal Stones could last until he reached level four in the Beast Taming Space.
“How am I going to do this…”
Shi Yu didn’t care about the consumption of the Ethereal Stone. Compared to the evolution materials, the current consumption of the Ethereal Stone was nothing.
At this moment, as he strengthened the Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu studied the foundation of all Beast Tamers.
When the Beast Taming Space reached level seven, it was said that the Beast Taming Space would undergo a qualitative change, producing some special abilities.
For example, the “etherealization” mastered by Shi Yu was one of the standard abilities used by legendary Beast Tamers with the help of the Beast Taming Space.
These abilities were not awakened by oneself, but developed by generations of Beast Tamers.
For example, the method of separating the Beast Taming Space from the body and transforming it into a mystic realm space and sealing space was developed by the Beast Tamers themselves.
Therefore, there were actually many secrets hidden in the Beast Taming Space. To a curious person like Shi Yu, he also wanted to research special abilities to play with.
“I don’t have high expectations. I just hope that you can mature a little more by yourself. It’s fine even if you’re slower. Don’t keep making me meditate. I can still take it now, but when my level is higher… No one wants to do this all day…” Shi Yu advised his Beast Taming Space.
He, Shi Yu, had to study this ability and benefit all the Beast Tamers.
…
“Aiyo, Brother Shi Yu, you’re really my lucky star!!”
After busying himself with the matters regarding the Ice Dragon Ruins, President Feng hurriedly pulled Lin Hongnian along to visit Shi Yu.
When he learned that Shi Yu had directly assigned the ruins pearl to Ping Cheng through his identity as Division 11, President Feng immediately teared up.
It was good to have someone close in his city. If it was handed to the Archeological Association, how could it be distributed so quickly?
He didn’t dote on Shi Yu for nothing.
President Feng, who was in a suit and leather shoes, rubbed his hands excitedly. He felt that he wasn’t far from being promoted. Once Ping Cheng developed, would he still have to worry about not being able to advance? Once he advanced, would he still have to worry about not being able to raise his Beast Taming level?
“Old Lin, I think Shi Yu’s suggestion is pretty good. How about we work together to turn Ping Cheng into a village of iron-eating beasts?”
“With a mystic realm as the foundation, it will be very effective in two to three years. At that time, Ping Cheng’s economic development level might not reach the standard of a second-level city, but there’s still hope for them to survive in Icefield City.”
Hall Master Lin, who was pulled over by President Feng, was very realistic. “I don’t want to talk about dreams with you. I only want to talk about money now. After the benefits are distributed, everything can be discussed.”
Many parties in Ping Cheng would definitely be able to cooperate and win. However, the problem now was that everyone wanted the most benefits.
President Feng’s expression fell. “Old Lin, you’ve changed. You’re no longer the man who gave up everything for the Iron-eating Beast.”
Lin Hongnian: “Then you don’t know how much the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast costs. I don’t have the money for my daughter’s evolution materials yet, nor do I have the money for my wife’s Iron-eating Beast evolution materials… My future grandchildren…”
“I’m doing this for Ping Cheng! Have you forgotten how we protected Ping Cheng during the beast tide back then? Don’t you want Ping Cheng to become better?”
“It doesn’t matter if Ping Cheng is good or not. They’re all ingrates. Even if we nurture talents, we can’t keep them in the district. The extra resources might as well be given to Old Wang, Old He, and the rest of the strengthening clans.” Hall Master Lin was very open-minded.
“Then it’s settled. When the time comes, the bulk of the money will be used to strengthen the Beast Taming Troops. It’s not bad to increase our military strength.” President Feng and Hall Master Lin spoke one after another, making Shi Yu, who was drinking tea beside them, speechless.
“Uncle Feng, Uncle Lin, maybe you guys should go back to discuss that…” Shi Yu wanted to see them out.
They could distribute them however he wanted. Shi Yu wanted to rely on his shares in the breeding base to give Eleven some food.
“We all agree that we should get an Iron-eating Beast Knight statue as a scenic spot. What do you think?” The two of them looked at Shi Yu. After Shi Yu became a legendary Beast Tamer, this would be a holy land…
Shi Yu: “?”
“I’ll sue you for violating my portrait rights.”
“There’s an endorsement fee.” Old Feng said, “A lot.”
Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched. “Not even if it’s a lot. This concerns my reputation…”
A moment later.
Shi Yu sent the two away with a righteous expression.
After sending them away, Shi Yu was worried. He kept feeling that the two of them were unreliable.
The one who he felt was the most reliable was still Senior Panda. Shi Yu heard that she directly contacted her maternal grandmother’s clothing factory before the release of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolutionary paper and mass produced various panda clothes…
It was fine if she couldn’t afford the Iron-eating Beast. There were also the Iron-eating Beast toys and the Iron-eating Beast clothing here to sell. Senior Panda was really an understanding person.
“It’s a long road to turn the Iron-eating Beast into Dong Huang’s national treasure pet.”
First, he would build an Iron-eating Beast Village and make Ping Cheng a big tourist city. This was the first step. Then, he would increase the upper limit of the individual achievement of a certain Iron-eating Beast. This mission belonged to Eleven, and this was the second step. As for the third step, it was to let all Iron-eating Beasts have the evolution path of an overlord race…
Letting the Iron-eating Beast become a new national treasure was also an insignificant wish of Shi Yu, a transmigrator from the Heaven Dao. Apart from wanting to know all the broken history, he didn’t have any big dreams. He could only use these boring nurturing goals to fill his empty heart.
…
Two days later.
Shi Yu, who was still in Ping Cheng previously, had returned to the ancient capital.
This time, he wasn’t prepared to go back in the short term.
After returning to the ancient capital, Shi Yu first found Director Li.
In the department head’s room, Director Li handed a student card to Shi Yu with a smile.
“Student Shi Yu, guess how many credits there are?”
“5,000?”
Shi Yu and Chief Physician Li were pretty close now. They did not treat him as outsiders. They sat down and chatted with him.
When new students entered the school, the school would allocate basic credits.
Using credits, students could exchange for various resources in the school’s resource bank or open training facilities.
At that time, Senior Panda and the others had told Shi Yu that if the first place in the vocation assessment entered Ancient Capital University, he would be able to get at least tens of millions of resources.
The ratio of credits in Ancient Capital University was about 10,000 for one credit.
Therefore, Shi Yu estimated that 5,000 credits could be exchanged for 50 million resources in the resource bank.
This resource… could slightly solve the pressing problems.
“Too few!” Chief Li’s face was squeezed into a pile.
“8,000?”
“No!”
“A total of 10,000 yuan.” Chief Li said, “Are you surprised? Are you surprised?”
“Apart from the credits allocated for the professional assessment, you also have a scholarship when you jointly discovered the evolution of the iron-eating beast in the archeology of the Ancient Capital University.”
Shi Yu: “Oh.”
Director Li: “?”
“Why don’t you look happy at all?”
Shi Yu said, “Yes, I’m very happy.”
He was happy, but not completely. The Nine-tailed Fox Heart in the resource warehouse was worth 15,000 credits, and the Tears of the Void was worth 18,000 credits, but he still couldn’t afford it.
Including the 10,000 credits, the assets he could use to prepare the insect evolution materials should be close to 130 million…
It was still not enough. He felt that he had to raise at least 300 million to meet the requirements of the insect’s evolution materials.
One was a spiritual-type, while the other was a spatial-type.
However, the problem wasn’t very big. Putting aside whether the worm needed resources of this level, Shi Yu had already found a way out if resources of this level were suitable for it to absorb.
He had heard that the rich overlord of the Resource Chamber, the Gem Cat, was very rich. Moreover, it liked to collect strange things. The price was very high. Shi Yu planned to sell a bunch of worm silk when the time came. He really couldn’t afford so many pets. Now, as expected, he still had to use pet labor.
Director Li: “Sigh, you young people… don’t have any concept of money anymore.”
“When I was in college, my dad gave me 10 million yuan for my living expenses. I was so happy for a long time.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Damn rich second-generation heir.
School had yet to officially start, and the new students from all over the world had yet to arrive at school. With the help of his connections, Shi Yu obtained the student card in advance and the key to his dormitory.
Although the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute was not small, each student’s individual dormitory was not bad…
The size and luxuriousness were basically not inferior to Shi Yu’s training villa in Ping Cheng. It could be said that the school had specially prepared a training villa for each student. This was also to facilitate the students’ interaction with their pets.
The reason why the total area of Ancient Capital University was not inferior to the area of a city in Ping Cheng was this.
With a new place to stay, Shi Yu decided not to squeeze into the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute. He directly moved all the things from Ping Cheng here, planning to treat this place as his new home.
“Huh?”
“Ji?”
“Yi?”
As he walked through the maze-like Ancient Capital University dormitory area, Shi Yu finally found his super dormitory after a long time. He pulled Eleven, Worm, and Ginseng Baby out of the ruins with a sense of relief.
There was also a pile of daily necessities moved from Ping Cheng. They were also thrown out of the ruins space.
“Alright, it’s your turn to work. I have to meditate to build a home for you. I’ll take care of everyone, while you take care of the family.”
Eleven, Worm, Ginseng Baby :”…”
Eleven looked at Buggy. This time, Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng. Although their language was different previously, after its hard work, Baby Ginseng could roughly understand what it and Eleven meant.
“Ji! (Don’t forget to make your new home fragrant with sweet aura.)” Buggy gestured as he used his worm silk to make an emoticon for Baby Ginseng.
“Wuuu!! (All the best, this is also a part of cultivation!)” Eleven encouraged. Everyone had gone through this before.
Ginseng Baby: “QAQ, I’ll remember this”, it thought.
Therefore, when a new teammate joined the team, it could order others around.
At the same time, in the dormitory, Shi Yu had just pulled open the curtains. Before he could sit down and rest, his cell phone suddenly rang. He took a look and saw that it was Dean Hao of the Mechanical Academy. It was this person who had completed the evolution equipment of Hall Master Lin and the other three Iron-eating Beast Tamers.
Shi Yu picked up the call, and Director Hao’s voice immediately came from the other side.
“Shiyu, the mineral materials have all been prepared. Next, it’s up to your design requirements. Do you have any ideas?”
“Yes, yes, I just prepared it yesterday.. I’ll send you the design plan now,” Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - Contracting Ginseng Baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Contracting Ginseng Baby
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As school approached, Shi Yu and Eleven discussed the appearance of the evolution equipment overnight.
In the end, they unanimously decided not to use fancy wings, shields, and other equipment.
In fact, the most important reason was that apart from having strong defense and high hardness, the evolution armor had no other special properties.
Even if he got a pair of wings, it would be flashy without substance. It wouldn’t be of any help. It wouldn’t really be able to fly like a bird.
This might also be the reason why in the historical video Shi Yu had seen, the iron-eating beasts’ armor only protected their weaknesses.
“Sigh, in the end, I’m still poor. The materials are limited.” After Shi Yu sent the evolution blueprint to Dean Hao, he felt a sense of sorrow.
In the end, it wasn’t that they didn’t want to be fancy, but the funds didn’t allow it.
Otherwise, wouldn’t it be cool to set up two cannon barrels to release super electromagnetic cannons? It looked like he could only use hardening substances to simulate it later.
In fact, there was another important reason. It was because Eleven’s battle style was too fancy.
Eleven didn’t like to fight with weapons and shields. Instead, it liked to fight in close combat with fists. Compared to the super electromagnetic cannon, it preferred the profundities of Thunder Armor.
Considering Eleven’s battle style, perhaps it was more suitable for a full-body armor.
In the end, Shi Yu combined the armor structure of Master Lin and the others’ Iron-eating Beasts, as well as the image of the Runic Battle Bear, Battle Tyrannosaurus, Mechanical Bull, Mecha Super Dream, and Iron Man in his mind. He tried his best to design an evolution equipment that matched its battle style.
However, Shi Yu still hoped that there would be some leftover materials that could be used as weapons for super-electromagnetic cannons for Eleven.
At the moment, Eleven was of the metal element. However, due to the growth potential of the Maximum Level Hardening, Shi Yu planned to shape its second attribute in the future, thunder element.
Let it cultivate the Electromagnetic Force, one of the four basic powers of the universe. This was very suitable for the metal element. When the time came, it would be invincible if Eleven could replicate a super-level thunder skill like “Heavenly Frost Cold” that could modify the power of lightning.
“Dean Hao, how long will it take to complete this set of equipment?” After a while, Shi Yu returned a call to Dean Hao.
The other side pondered for a moment and estimated. “I’ll try to finish it for you before school starts, but do you really plan to multiply the iron-eating beast and have it wear huge armor…”
“Yes.”
Dean Hao thought that young people these days were really rich. This was the cost of one billion evolution materials.
Perhaps after evolution, the iron-eating beasts would become a high-level monarch race, approaching the level of overlords!
“I’ll inform you when the time comes,” Dean Hao said.
With such a large amount of materials, it would take him a lot of effort to create armor even with the support of a mechanical life form.
“Thank you very much.” Shi Yu kept thanking him. He might be able to see Eleven evolve before school started.
Shi Yu looked forward to it a little.
Training… The most important thing now was still training.
After entrusting the matter of the evolution equipment to Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu began to meditate wholeheartedly again.
About five days later.
Under the strengthening of his meditation, more than half of Shi Yu’s gray Beast Taming Space Barrier began to turn white.
This meant that the strength of his Beast Taming Space had already touched the threshold of level three!
Shi Yu was in a good mood and continued to cultivate in peace.
Two days later.
Shi Yu cultivated in seclusion for a week in the dormitory of Ancient Capital University.
On this day, he slowly opened his eyes and took a deep breath. He didn’t expect everything to go so smoothly.
With multiple buffs, his meditation efficiency was almost ten times higher!
“It’s finally upgraded.”
Shi Yu was extremely excited when he sensed the huge increase in his physique again.
The Beast Taming Space was level three!
This meant that his upper limit of physique had increased again. With the additional points later, it probably meant that his physique would soon be comparable to a transcendent ferocious beast!
Apart from that, he could finally contract the ginseng baby.
After the contract, his physical recovery speed would be directly improved by the ginseng baby. It would be easier and more efficient!!
The combination of the two was a very important transformation for him. It also meant that he could already afford Eleven and Worm evolution!
“Where’s Baby Ginseng?” Shi Yu looked for Baby Ginseng in the ruins space through the ruin ring on his wrist.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was still practicing the Energy Fruit skill.
Under its training and Shi Yu’s additional points, it could already control the amount of energy fruits well. It could create large and small bombs at will, so that it wouldn’t accidentally blow itself and its opponent up in the arena.
During the week of Shi Yu’s meditation, because of the presence of the baby ginseng, his mental state was better, so he added a few more points.
< Name > Ginseng Baby
[Skill]: Sweet Air (Transcendent), High Speed Healing (Perfect), Nutrition (Expert), Earth Chain (Transcendent), Source of Life (Initiate), Multiplication (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Energy Fruit (Proficient)
He had brought Baby Ginseng’s sweet aura to perfection, and the Energy Fruit to proficient.
After that, Baby Ginseng’s energy directly exceeded Eleven!
The racial skill at the level of “Dao Proficiency” was still quite a big increase in energy.
If he also raised a certain species skill point of the Ginseng Baby to the level of “Dao Proficiency”, Shi Yu really suspected that its energy value would directly break through 10,000 and reach the commander rank standard.
At the moment, the transcendent-grade sweet gas did not increase Shi Yu’s recovery effect much, but it could be manufactured into perfume and spices to sell for money. Shi Yu even wanted to maximize the selling price of the nutrients so that the whole family could work together to buy evolution materials for Buggy.
“Yi??”
At this moment, Baby Ginseng, who was burying fruit landmines and trying out various ways to use the Energy Fruit, saw Shi Yu enter and stood up curiously.
“Dig them all out.” Shi Yu’s face was speechless. “Don’t casually plant land mines at home.”
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng patted its chest. Don’t worry, even if he stepped on it, it wouldn’t explode. This was a time bomb.
“Even so, dig it out!”
Ginseng Baby: QAQ Yes.
After Baby Ginseng finished handling all the Energy Fruits, Shi Yu sighed slightly.
It was so difficult to take care of the baby. A Beast Tamer might die from carelessness.
He took a look at the skill index. Transcendent skills still couldn’t be taught. He couldn’t help but sigh even more. He would look again when his physique was maxed out.
At the next moment.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng’s gazes met.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and said, “Are you ready?”
“Yiya?? (What for?)” Baby Ginseng was stunned.
“What else could it be? A contract!”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Beast Taming Space in his brain.
It was a world with a white crystal wall and a sea of clouds inside.
Hu hu ~ ~
As Shi Yu communicated with the Beast Taming Space, countless light dots flickered in front of him. A white array that looked like a star map appeared above the baby ginseng!
“Wuuu!!!” “Ji ji ji!!”
At the same time, Eleven and Buggy rushed over from the distance of the ruins excitedly.
As Shi Yu’s contracted pets, they had long sensed Shi Yu’s breakthrough.
Shi Yu could obtain considerable benefits from their growth. Similarly, when Shi Yu broke through, their growth upper limit could also be increased!
“Wuu!! (Don’t resist.)”
“Ji! (Cheering)”.
As they were familiar with the process of the contract, Eleven and Buggy immediately reminded the confused baby ginseng after running over.
“Just relax.” Shi Yu smiled.
Next, like Eleven and Buggy, pleased to meet your acquaintance.
In the next second, countless weak light spots flowed out of the formation and wrapped around Baby Ginseng, about to cover it!
“Yi! (Come on!)”
After understanding it roughly, Baby Ginseng called out with a determined expression.
After being contracted, there was no need to worry about the risk of being made into soup.
It very naturally accepted the contract. Its entire body was directly enveloped by white light before gradually turning into fluorescent light, disappearing from the outside world and entering Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space!
The third pet, Baby Ginseng, was successfully contracted!
Shi Yu happily looked at the ginseng baby in the space. He had already sensed its feedback to his physique after contracting the ginseng baby.
However, the most important thing was that there were five more blank pages in the skill index!
Now, it was a total of 20 pages!
Apart from the deleted Worm Silk, Hardening, and Thunder Palm, there were 15 recorded skills.
They were: Deterrence, High Speed Healing, Supervision, Absolute Sleep, Multiplication, Plant Control, Illusion, Inner Power, Instant Transmission, Space Shackles, Concealment, Earth Chain, Sweet Air, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, and Energy Fruit.
Also, five blank pages were ready and he could replicate new skills at any time.
“Come out.” Next, Shi Yu summoned the ginseng baby that he had just contracted from the Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, for the three pets, Baby Ginseng, Eleven, and Worm could also understand each other’s language through telepathy.
The ginseng baby that had just come out of the Beast Taming Space was still not used to it.
“Yi?”
“Wuu!” “Ji!”
“Yi!!”
After the three pets communicated, they were instantly very excited.
Shi Yu also smiled. At the same time, he felt that he could start a new round of point upgrades.
“But it’s been a week. I’ve already leveled up while I’m at it. Isn’t the armor done by Dean Hao yet?” Shi Yu suddenly remembered Eleven’s evolution equipment.
“Director Hao should be quite busy recently, let’s wait a little longer.”
It had been three days since he left the academy, and many new students had already come to the ancient capital.
As the dean of the Mechanical College, Dean Hao must be very busy. Shi Yu thought for a moment and took out his student card. He decided to replicate a new skill for Baby Ginseng first.
Next, it was time to do high-intensity points again. He took a fancy to a recovery and attack skill, which was very suitable for baby ginseng.
At the same time, it could also fill in the defects of the wood attribute energy fruit.
Many pets raised in the plant garden of Ancient Capital University knew this skill. Shi Yu felt that he could replicate it after walking around.
This ability was the storage beam of a light-type skill that was very compatible with plant-type pets.
Skill: Energy Storage Beam
Skill Level: Intermediate
< Introduction > It’s a light element skill. It can store light in the body and transform light into physical strength or light.
Shi Yu planned to teach this skill to the ginseng baby as well.
Firstly, he could have an additional recovery method that would allow him to move eternally and freeload more of his natural strength. Secondly, he could also have an additional attack skill.
This was another practical skill that could be used both ways. However, in terms of attack, it might be a little useless.
For non-elemental pets, because light energy was not easy to accumulate, it also needed time to change. It would take about ten seconds to charge up and attack once. The combat value was low, and like the Earth Chain, it relied on the environment.
Even if it was trained to the perfect level, under the sun, the accumulated energy beam attack needed to be converted for a few seconds. It was very slow.
However, this was not a problem for Shi Yu. If the proficiency had reached transcendent. Was there a need to be afraid that it could not shoot beams instantly?
“After learning it, will Baby Ginseng have more flash bombs other than ordinary bombs…”

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - Shi Yu in the Plant Garden
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Shi Yu in the Plant Garden
Many training facilities existed in Ancient Capital University, including a mystic realm space.
In these training facilities, the training efficiency of the pets could be greatly improved.
The last time Shi Yu came to Ancient Capital University, he had only experienced the battle tower to train the Beast Tamer’s life-saving abilities.
This time, he was prepared to go to a plant garden in a holy land of plant pets in Ancient Capital University.
“Let’s go out for a while.”
“Maybe I can take you to a fight.”
After making the decision to steal a skill, Shi Yu exited the ruins space and said to the baby ginseng who was staring at him with a fruit on the table in front of him.
“Yi? (Battle?)”
Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up.
In short, it had been looking forward to the day where Shi Yu brought it to challenge other pets for a long time.
It was purely because the two teammates were too strong, so up until now, Baby Ginseng had not made a correct assessment of its battle power.
In short, it had been looking forward to the day Shi Yu brought it to challenge other pets for a long time.
“That’s right.”
“Go to the Beast Taming Space to sleep for a while and recover. I’ll call you later.”
Under Baby Ginseng’s expectant expression, Shi Yu recalled it to the Beast Taming Space.
He had just contracted a ginseng baby. Shi Yu was still willing to let it rest more in his Beast Taming Space to sharpen its feelings.
After that, Shi Yu took his school student card and went out.
…
“By the way, I wonder what the effect will be if I go to the Internet Addicted Granny now.”
As he walked in the direction of the plant garden, Shi Yu muttered.
He was still very vengeful.
At that time, he wanted to use the bone sword to PK the energy pet in the Battle Tower but he only got beaten up by the group. But now, Shi Yu, who had an extremely strong physique, felt that he could take revenge…
He was no longer the man who only knew how to dodge. Well, he would go to the plant garden to try first before going to the battle tower.
“Hey, look, doesn’t that person look like the Iron-eating Beast Knight…”
As Shi Yu walked, he suddenly heard people talking about him.
He turned his head slightly and saw two girls carrying a bag of daily necessities talking with their heads lowered.
Unfortunately, after Shi Yu’s physique was strengthened, his vision and hearing had also been enhanced. He could hear them.
“Kind of. That Iron-eating Beast Knight is an archeologist. He should have entered our school.”
“Is it him in person? He’s much more handsome than in the video. He’s so silly in the video. I remember my stomach hurting from laughing.”
“Heh…” Shi Yu couldn’t help but walk faster. Stupid humans.
He didn’t feel like a new student, but a senior returning to school. His name actually spread so quickly…
“It’s troublesome when people become famous.” Shi Yu took out a black and white baseball cap from the ruins space and put it on himself, trying to not be recognized. If he could still be recognized, he might be forced to wear a mask.
…
Ancient Capital University was too big. It took Shi Yu a lot of effort to reach the plant garden from his dormitory.
In fact, although the plant garden had the word ‘garden’, its area was quite ridiculous.
According to the school’s official website, the area shouldn’t be inferior to Mt. Tian Mang that he had gone to in Ping Cheng. It was much larger than the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base of Lin Xiuzhu’s family.
This was actually also a mountain, but the entire plant garden mountain was clearly divided into several areas.
There were areas with richer water-element resources, areas with more abundant earth energy, and areas with richer natural wood and sun power. These were all modified, suitable for the habitation of various plant pets.
It could be said that using Earth Chain and Energy Storage Beams here could directly maximize the effect.
“We’re here.”
The entrance of the plant garden was separated by a white building. Shi Yu looked around and saw that the surroundings were cold and quiet. He didn’t care too much and directly entered.
As soon as he entered, Shi Yu smelled a fragrance. He immediately determined that it was a sweet aura skill.
However, it was only at the proficient level. It was nothing much. He didn’t even feel it when he smelled it.
“Hello…” After Shi Yu entered, in the hall of the building, a girl in a white dress who was trimming flowers stopped what she was doing and looked over in surprise.
Apart from her, the building looked like a huge office. There was also a group of young people sitting in front of computers. They took a look over and saw that someone was already handling Shi Yu, so they continued working.
“Hello,” Shi Yu greeted when he saw the senior.
“What business do you have?” she asked with a smile.
Shi Yu felt strange, but thankfully, he had done enough homework before he came.
There were three main possibilities for students to come to the plant garden.
Come and raise pets.
The environment of the plant garden was very suitable for the growth of plant-type pets. If the pets were more obedient, it would be no problem for the students to let the pets stay here for some time. It could have a good effect. Moreover, during this period, there were also students and teachers from the Feeding Department who were part-time workers who would help take care of the pets and provide food, nutritional supplements, and medical care.
<ol start=”2″>
Contract a new pet.
The plant garden also had the function of the Feeding Base. There were a large number of plant-type pet cubs of commander races. Their growth levels were basically at the Awakening level. These pets could be contracted and were suitable for Beast Tamers to contract, but students needed to use a certain amount of credits to exchange for the contract qualifications.
Like what Senior Lu said, the Seven Star Four Leaf Clover lived in a certain place in the plant garden.
<ol start=”3″>
Battle experience.
There were also a large number of transcendent creatures that had already grown up in the plant garden. There were even commander rank and monarch rank creatures living inside to guard the plant garden. For some students who wanted to increase their battle experience with plant-type pets, the plant garden also provided battle experience.
At the same time, the pets raised by some students could also be considered opponents.
Therefore, there were many opportunities for battle here.
“Battle,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright, come over and register.” The part-time senior signaled for Shi Yu to follow him.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded. He felt that the environment here was pretty good.
At least no one cared about him, and this senior didn’t look like she knew him.
As expected of the Feeding Department, they didn’t pay attention to the results of the vocation assessment at all.
Perhaps compared to the professional Beast Tamer assessment, this group of people were more concerned about the professional Feeder assessment.
Next, Shi Yu followed his senior to a machine to swipe his card and register. Releasing pets and contracting new pets required credits, while battle training was completely free. However, every student had a certain number of times per month. This was also to prevent the plant garden from being overloaded and unable to function normally.
“Eh, level 178? You’re a new student?” The senior looked at the message in surprise after Shi Yu swiped his card.
Level 178 archeology student, Shi Yu…
At this time, it wasn’t time for school yet?
But soon, she was relieved. If it was a new student with some connections, it wasn’t rare for him to enter the school early and live here.
“Yes.”
“Oh, it’s a junior.” Realizing that it was a new student, the senior who was working part-time was much more polite. She smiled and said, “Do you plan to go in and take a look yourself, or do you plan to specify pets to fight?”
In this botanical garden, there were many elite pets almost invincible at the same race level. Students who wanted to fight and train could even specify some pets in the plant garden to fight. Of course, they could also go in and randomly try their luck.
“I’ll go in and take a look myself.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Alright, you have to be careful. Most of the pets in the plant garden are raised here by seniors. They’re very fierce,” the senior reminded.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
That was exactly what he wanted. He felt that the wild ones were too weak.
“Can you go in yourself?” As Shi Yu was a new student, the part-time senior asked.
“No problem.” Shi Yu took the compass from his senior’s hand and reassured her.
This compass could guide Shi Yu into the battle area of the plant garden and help him find the way and leave. Apart from that, it could also be used with the software navigation on the Ancient Capital University’s official website, but it was not as convenient and accurate.
…
After registering, Shi Yu entered the plant garden.
As Shi Yu entered, a senior in front of the computer stretched with difficulty. He didn’t expect that he had to work before school started.
In order to ensure the stability of the plant garden and prevent any conflicts between the pets that had been raised, there were surveillance cameras everywhere in the plant garden. His job was to discover unstable factors. Among them, students who came here to battle and train could also be considered unstable factors. They needed to be paid attention to.
He looked at the screen. At this moment, Shi Yu had already entered the battle area with the compass.
In the battle area, there were basically no ferocious beasts below the transcendent level. They were all very brave and good at battle. Soon, the senior was stunned.
This was because just as he entered, Shi Yu encountered a transcendent-level Violent Wood Lizard.
It was a half-meter-long lizard made of wood matter. Although it looked like an animal, it was indeed a plant life form. It was essentially of a wood element.
“A Wild Violent Wood Lizard…” The senior’s expression was relatively calm. However, what made him uneasy was that in the scene, Shi Yu saw this Violent Wood Lizard and had no intention of summoning his pet??
In the scene, Shi Yu and the Violent Wood Lizard looked at each other…
“Its battle power is only 5… No, its energy level is only 599? Trash…” Shi Yu looked at the energy level of the Violent Wood Lizard in front of him through the Invisibility Mirror Image and sighed. This was too weak.
A pet of this level was weak enough for Baby Ginseng to make it faint with just a sweet aura. There was no meaning in fighting.
“Hello, do you want to fight? You can fight with me, but we have three rules. You’re not allowed to use skills.”
However, Shi Yu still issued a challenge to the Violent Wood Lizard through telepathy.
Baby Ginseng:???
Didn’t you say you wanted me to fight???
The Violent Wood Lizard was also stunned.??
It had lived here for a while, but it had never seen such a strange request.
The name of the Violent Wood Lizard sounded very irritable, but in fact, they were also very good gardeners. Poop was the best fertilizer, so these lizards were kept in the plant garden.
But even so, it didn’t mean that the Violent Wood Lizard didn’t have any battle power.
“Heh!!! (You said it, don’t regret it.)” After a moment of silence, the Violent Wood Lizard chose to satisfy Shi Yu’s wish.
It leaped over and pounced at Shi Yu. It had no intention of hurting Shi Yu. If it dared to hurt a human, it would have to become dinner for the monarchs and commanders of the plant garden tonight. It only wanted to pounce on Shi Yu and let him see how powerful it was.
However…
Just as the Violent Wood Lizard pounced at Shi Yu, it felt its stomach suffer an incomparable blow before it could even come into contact with him. With a boom, it was sent flying and hit a tree in the distance.
On the spot, Shi Yu moved his slightly sore fist and looked at the Violent Wood Lizard.
“Again!” Shi Yu said.
As expected of him, his physique was really not much inferior to a transcendent-level ferocious beast. He could actually still gain the upper hand against a creature that did not specialize in physiques like the Violent Wood Lizard??
If he reached the current upper limit of the level, he might be able to fight transcendent creatures who used skills!
At this moment, after it was sent flying. The Violent Wood Lizard stood up in a daze and stared at the human in front of it, revealing an expression as if it had seen a ghost.
Although this punch didn’t cause it much injury, it still hurt. It thought about it. It couldn’t take on this battle. It was too aggrieved.
“Heh!!! (Fight my ass, I’m not allowed to hurt you, and you’re also so strong, are you even human?)” The Violent Wood Lizard cursed angrily and turned to leave, even pulling a pile of shit on the spot to show its disdain.
In the botanical garden, it didn’t matter how the pets fought. As long as they didn’t die, it was fine. However, Beast Tamers definitely couldn’t be injured. This was the rule.
Shi Yu :”…”
Seeing the Raging Wood Lizard leave, Shi Yu was silent. In the hall of the plant garden building, the senior who was staring at the surveillance was also shocked.
“Holy shit.”
What the hell was this student? Which specialization was he from? Why was he here? Did he come to train himself or his pets? Just go to the battle tower if he wanted to train himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - Stealing the Energy Storage Beam
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Stealing the Energy Storage Beam
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the plant garden, in the battle area…
Shi Yu continued walking. In his Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng was crying.
“Don’t be anxious.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ll bring you to find powerful pets.”
This time, with “index” the index, Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to use Eleven’s super vision.
He directly activated the energy detection function of the index.
In front of his vision, he immediately detected dense energy waves in a large area.
“Energy level 790, trash.”
“Energy value: 1093, boring.”
“Energy value 2195, are there no powerful pets here?”
“Uh, 15843? What the heck is a commander rank even doing here?”
“Eh, I got it. 3033, it’ll be you.” After staying on the spot for a moment, Shi Yu locked onto a pet with an energy fluctuation of about 3033. He planned to bring Baby Ginseng to challenge it.
This value might be a transcendent pet of the monarch race.
Of course, it could also be a commander-type pet that was cultivated better.
Shi Yu pondered for a moment and summoned Baby Ginseng on the spot.
The next moment, the white summoning array appeared in midair. Baby Ginseng fell out and was grabbed by Shi Yu’s hand and placed on his shoulder.
“Yiya!!!”
After sitting in Eleven’s seat, Baby Ginseng was very excited. It moved its little hand forward and let Shi Yu charge forward.
Today was its first battle as a towering emperor. It had to find a worthy opponent.
“Let’s go.”
Shi Yu chuckled. Today, Eleven and Buggy were resting. It was Baby Ginseng’s turn to show off!
It was mainly because if Eleven and Buggy came out, it wouldn’t be as simple as just fighting transcendent creatures.
…
As Shi Yu did not do normal things, this senior who was watching the surveillance cameras directly targeted him.
Regarding Shi Yu sending the Violent Wood Lizard flying with a punch, he first held a wait-and-see attitude. After all, there were too many strange Beast Taming Talents or pet skills.
Soon, as Shi Yu chose to summon his pet, the senior gradually felt that Shi Yu was normal.
“White Formation, Intermediate Beast Tamer.”
“The pet is…”
“Baby Ginseng???”
However, he only felt that Shi Yu was normal for a few seconds. Soon, Shi Yu ignored him again and directly summoned Baby Ginseng over his shoulder in the battle area. The senior didn’t know what to say.
If all of this could still be explained by Shi Yu punching and needing the baby ginseng to replenish his physical strength, then the next scene completely made this senior feel that Shi Yu was really abnormal!
He saw Shi Yu run to the territory of a pet of a battle type…
Moreover, he made Baby Ginseng jump down from his body and confront the pet in front of him.
“F*ck, what’s wrong with this person?”
“Don’t tell me he plans to let Baby Ginseng battle Giant Sunflower!!”
…
“Energy level: 3033…”
After circling around and finding his target, Shi Yu looked at the pet in front of him.
It was a flower-type pet standing on two feet. It was half a meter tall.
It had a green ball root-like body and legs, and a huge golden flower on its head. The flower even emitted a faint light.
At this moment, the huge flower narrowed its eyes. As for its mouth, it grew in the flower. It was a very strange creature.
This creature with a mouth above its eyes looked at the guy who intruded into its territory in surprise.
At this moment, all its information was displayed in front of Shi Yu.
< Name > Giant Sunflower
[Attributes]: Light
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
[Race Skill]: Flower Dance, Flash, Sun Force, Light Ray, Energy Storage Beam, Sunset
“We’re pretty lucky.”
Shi Yu was overjoyed.
This luck… He came to the plant garden to find pets that had “energy storage beam”.
According to his investigation, there were about five common wild plant pets that could store energy beams in the plant garden. He needed to find them slowly.
And Giant Sunflower just happened to be not among these five types, it could only be said that the heavens were watching over him, directly saving him a lot of time to search.
“Do you want to fight?” Shi Yu invited Giant Sunflower.
If it were other Beast Tamers who weren’t talented in telepathy, they might have directly started fighting.
As for Shi Yu, he was still used to chatting with it first.
This Giant Sunflower should be the pet of a certain senior. Otherwise, it would not have been cultivated to such a high energy level.
“F*ck…”
At this moment, Giant Sunflower heard Shi Yu’s telepathy and was stunned for a moment before nodding.
It didn’t matter. It had come to the battle area to fight. Otherwise, wouldn’t it be better to sleep in the Sunlight area?
However…
Giant Sunflower looked at the excited baby ginseng that jumped down from Shi Yu’s body, looked at the baby ginseng that was showing battle intent towards him, and suddenly felt at a loss.
Was he serious??
The battle didn’t matter, but the opponent…
It wasn’t like it didn’t know what a baby ginseng was!
Let Baby Ginseng fight it???
Giant Sunflower directly showed a disdainful expression, feeling that Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were fools.
“Yi!! (I’ll attack first!)”
Seeing that Giant Sunflower did not have any battle intent, Baby Ginseng already condensed a small ginseng in its hand.
Under Shi Yu’s instructions, it specially condensed a small one, afraid that the power would be too great and kill the other party.
After all, the energy value of the baby ginseng was more than twice that of the Giant Sunflower. The skills it used were also high-level skills with great lethality…
With its height of more than ten centimeters, one could imagine how small the small ginseng it made was. Just like that, the small ginseng flew directly towards the stunned Giant Sunflower under the throw of the baby ginseng.
“F*ck…”
From this small fruit, Giant Sunflower only sensed fragrance, the kind that could relieve fatigue.
It called out, feeling that it was awesome despite not understanding it.
So, the other party wasn’t here to fight, but to feed it? This wasn’t a zoo either!
At this moment, the senior who was watching the surveillance video was stunned. This skill was so familiar.
It didn’t seem like something a ginseng baby could learn. Instead, it was a skill of the evolution form of a ginseng baby, nutrition!
Shi Yu and the others were indeed here to feed…
The fruit fell beside Giant Sunflower’s feet, but Giant Sunflower still ignored it.
Like its senior, it felt that Baby Ginseng was here to be funny.
But to be honest, this fruit smelled pretty good and was very tempting, making Giant Sunflower swallow its saliva.
Heh, it was no worse than the nutrients it had eaten before.
There was even a unique charm to it.
“F*ck!! (Then I won’t hold back!)”
Giant Sunflower looked at the fruit, seemingly wanting to eat it.
At that moment, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng fell silent.
Although they had once imagined this strategy…
Shi Yu really didn’t expect that a pet with a Beast Tamer would be so silly to believe it and really plan to eat it.
Was this because it was in a plant garden, so it didn’t think it would be dangerous?
But they had clearly agreed to fight just now!
“Let’s give it a lesson.”
Seeing that Giant Sunflower did not have any sense of crisis, Shi Yu was really helpless.
“Whatever. Destroy!”
In any case, this Giant Sunflower had been in an energy storing state when it walked just now, he could just replicate the skill later. Shi Yu causally ordered.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng nodded obediently and looked at the Giant Sunflower.
It quickly detonated it, afraid that Giant Sunflower would eat it.
Although it was only a small amount of energy, if it exploded after being eaten, this Giant Sunflower would not be able to withstand it.
It was better to detonate it outside.
Baby Ginseng thought benevolently.
Boom!!!
The moment Baby Ginseng’s will detonated the fruit, a huge amount of energy rushed out of the fruit. With a loud bang, a surging energy tide spewed out. At this moment, the eyes of the Giant Sunflower, which was still drooling, widened. It felt that its vision was instantly covered by white light, and it was instantly swallowed by countless energy. A powerful force was crazily washing over its body!
“F*ck!!” Its eyes exploded. In the light, it felt its body quickly break apart. The intense pain made its consciousness almost faint.
Giant Sunflower roared unwillingly. It never expected that the nutrients thrown by Baby Ginseng would actually explode.
Damn it, a sinister enemy.
Carrying soaring resentment, Giant Sunflower directly fainted in the huge pit on the spot like a withered flower, losing the ability to fight.
Only rolling white smoke was left with it.
At this moment.
At the battle department academy of Ancient Capital University, a bespectacled boy suddenly looked out the window.
“What happened?”
Sensing that the Giant Sunflower he was raising had instantly lost its ability to fight, he showed a confused expression, directly packing up and heading to the plant garden.
“Did Little Flower challenge some powerful pet again? Being insta-killed… That’s ridiculous. I have to go take a look.”
In the botanical garden.
On this side, the Feeding Department senior who was staring at the surveillance also lost his ability to think like the Giant Sunflower, staring at the screen blankly.
“F*ck!” As the Energy Fruit exploded, he shouted with an incredulous expression.
“Supplement, the supplement exploded, f*king instakilled the Giant Sunflower.”
His shout made everyone look at him in confusion, as if they were looking at a fool.
“Li He, what are you doing?” A girl frowned and looked at him.
“Team Leader, Baby Ginseng… Baby Ginseng… The nutritional substance exploded. This isn’t scientific…”
Everyone: “?”
At the same time, Shi Yu brought Baby Ginseng to the side of the Giant Sunflower and shook his head.
“Baby ginseng, treatment.”
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng obediently stretched out its small hand and released a high-speed healing wave.
The super skill, Origin of Life, coupled with the perfect level healing speed, directly made the injuries of Giant Sunflower recover visibly.
During this process, Shi Yu patted the body of the Giant Sunflower with a worried expression, as if he was educating his child.
“Silly child, didn’t your Beast Tamer tell you not to underestimate any enemy?”
“With your personality, you’ll suffer sooner or later. Today, I’ll give you a lesson. The next time you encounter any opponent, you have to give it your all. Next time, no one will be so kind as to treat you.”
[Recording success]
Skill: Energy Storage Beam
Skill Level: Intermediate
< Introduction > It’s a light element skill. It can store light in the body and transform light into physical strength or light.
During the treatment, Giant Sunflower opened its eyes in a daze. It looked at Baby Ginseng, who was treating it with its small hand, and felt that it was still sleeping.
What happened just now… Who am I, where am I, what is this baby ginseng? Where was its Beast Tamer!

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - Baby Ginseng Wants to Evolve Too
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Baby Ginseng Wants to Evolve Too
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“This silly flower…”
Seeing that Giant Sunflower still did not look very smart after its injuries gradually recovered, Shi Yu patted his hands and walked away from it.
“Yi!”
At the same time, the ginseng baby quickly moved away from it. It was said that stupidity was contagious.
“F*ck…”
Giant Sunflower swayed and gradually remembered what was going on.
It had been blown up by nutrients!
When it thought of this, its lungs exploded with anger. It looked at Shi Yu and the others in anger.
“F*ck…”
However, at this moment, Giant Sunflower suddenly recalled what its teacher had said in its ear just now and could not help but be stunned.
It seemed to make sense.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng had said that they were going to battle. It had underestimated its opponent and thought nothing of it…
So, that wasn’t a nutrient for it, but an attack?
Giant Sunflower could not help but be stunned. The idiot was actually himself, not the opponent. They weren’t sneaky at all…
It was momentarily unable to accept reality.
“You’ve recovered, right? Do you want to continue fighting?”
Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng’s unhappy expression and could not help but ask the suspicious Giant Sunflower.
“F*ck!!!” Giant Sunflower suddenly looked over and nodded crazily.
Of course! It wanted revenge!!!
…
In the hall of the plant garden building.
As they saw that the Learning who injured the Giant Sunflower had grown up…
However, in the image, Giant Sunflower had already been healed.
“There’s clearly nothing here,” everyone said.
“Yes, but after Baby Ginseng injured the Giant Sunflower, it was healed…”
“Wait, it doesn’t make sense again! Isn’t slow healing only able to heal oneself… That’s… high-speed healing?”
The feed department senior was stunned.
At that moment, before everyone could understand what he said in detail, Baby Ginseng and Giant Sunflower started fighting again.
Then, this senior wasn’t the only one whose eyes exploded. In an instant, everyone’s expressions were stunned.
In the video, the Ginseng Baby directly connected to the ground and turned into “Earth Ginseng Baby”.
Like a war fortress, it threw out the “nutrients” in its hand as if they were free, forming a “Gunfire Suppression”!
And facing these nutrients, the Giant Sunflower acted like it was facing a great enemy. It immediately released light from the Sunflower, hoping to detonate them in mid-air.
However… It was useless.
This time, it wasn’t a small amount of energy fruits, but the full version.
Before the Giant Sunflower exploded, Baby Ginseng still detonated them itself!
With a boom, white roses bloomed in midair!
A terrifying energy impact instantly spread to the side of the Giant Sunflower, instantly devouring the energy storage beam, scaring the Giant Sunflower into hurriedly pulling open the light screen!
Unfortunately, in the face of the explosion wave, the light screen also shattered instantly. The energy wave blew the Giant Sunflower away with a bang!
It was ridiculously powerful!
This attack did not cause much damage to Giant Sunflower’s body, but it caused incomparable damage to Giant Sunflower’s heart!
“F*ck!!!” It looked at the ginseng baby as it created two large radishes in horror.
“F*ck!!” Is this a ginseng baby?
Holy shit, why does it have so much stamina? It can condense a bomb of this level just like that? And there were several of them at once?
At this moment, Giant Sunflower understood that its strength was not on the same level as the other party at all.
Without looking back, it turned and left, not wanting to be injured by the explosion.
This action… left Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng confused on the spot.
It ran away again?
“Are all the pets in this plant garden so challengeless?”
It was fine if it was just a weak Violent Wood Lizard, but why was this very strong Giant Sunflower the same!
“So be it.” After a moment, Shi Yu shook his head.
In any case, he had obtained the key skill.
As for Giant Sunflower’s other skills, Shi Yu did not fancy them either.
Although its light skills were also very rare, they were not suitable for Ginseng Baby.
Apart from the storage beam, Shi Yu felt that there was another light-element skill suitable for Baby Ginseng. It might be the combination of fire and light.
This was a type of weather skill, similar to Praying Rain. It could form a continuous skill with the storage beam. It was just that he didn’t know if Baby Ginseng could learn this skill.
Shi Yu actually lacked a weather skill. A domain skill that was extremely suitable and could increase the strength of the entire team.
However, because the attributes and battle styles of Eleven, Worm, Ginseng Baby were too different, it wasn’t easy to find a weather skill, area skill, and domain skill that could help all three of them at the same time.
Shi Yu looked at the ginseng baby that was holding the Energy Fruit. It didn’t know whether to throw it or not.
“See? I told you, you’re strong.”
Currently, there was a Ginseng Baby with more than 8,000 energy points with a proficient high-level skill Energy Fruit. Not to mention this Giant Sunflower, even Yin Zhengfan’s Zonyan Rock Beast would be unable to defend!
It was only because Eleven’s max level Hardening was too abnormal and Worm’s spatial skill was so shameless that Baby Ginseng thought it was useless.
“You’re not really weak. You’re just weak in the team.”
“(?_?)… Yi…” Baby Ginseng felt that Shi Yu was horrible at consolations.
The confidence it had just regained was instantly destroyed.
After a moment of silence, it ran back to Shi Yu’s shoulder and asked an important question.
“Yi!”
Eleven and the worm seemed to be preparing to evolve. They were already very powerful. If they evolved, would their strength become even more ridiculous?
This way, wouldn’t its junior position in the team become more and more solid?
Baby Ginseng didn’t want to be an emergency supplement for the rest of its life. It also wanted to be the main force and trump card of the team!
“Isn’t that for sure?”
Shi Yu muttered.
After all, in essence, although Eleven and Buggy’s battle power was off the charts, it was all due to their skills. Their races were instead a burden.
Although their race had received some enhancements because they had learned a bunch of external skills, there wasn’t too much of a difference between them and the original race.
If Eleven didn’t use skills and fought with an Ice Dragon cub, it would probably be knocked out with a slap.
As for Buggy… after evolution, their race would completely change. It would definitely be reborn.
“Yiya!!”
Baby Ginseng expressed its anticipation that it could also evolve.
“This…” Shi Yu said,” In theory, yes. ”
“Yi? (theory?)”
“Actually, it’s quite difficult.”
Ginseng Baby:〒▽〒
“Don’t you know? When you were at Grandma Li’s place, she had already tested if you could evolve…”
“The result of the experiment is that the evolution method of a normal ginseng baby is useless to you.”
Baby Ginseng:!!!
After saying that, Baby Ginseng was dumbfounded. It really didn’t know that the old witch had performed an evolution experiment on it.
Shi Yu continued walking with Baby Ginseng.
The evolution form of [Ginseng Baby] was [Ginseng Fruit Tree].
This evolution form made Shi Yu feel like complaining.
It gave him the feeling that humans would evolve into ginseng fruit trees.
The species itself had completely changed. It was as ridiculous as a carp evolving into a dragon.
In fact, the ginseng baby wasn’t a ginseng, and the ginseng fruit tree wasn’t a ginseng fruit tree either. These weren’t the same things.
But in short, even though the ginseng baby could evolve into a middle class commander race’s ginseng fruit tree, it still couldn’t escape the fate of the supplements.
Compared to the sweet and slowly healing ginseng baby, the ginseng fruit tree only had two racial skills, Earth Chain and Nutrition. It still didn’t have any offensive skills.
In combination, the current situation was very clear. The mutated ginseng baby was already much more impressive than the ginseng fruit tree. This evolution path no longer applied to it. This Grandma Li had already studied it.
The racial skills that the ginseng fruit tree knew, Earth Chain and Nutrition, had long become the racial skills of the mutated ginseng baby. It would even have an additional source of life skill.
The evidence was that after Shi Yu had leveled the Earth Chain Point into transcendent, it still wouldn’t have reached the maximum level.
Therefore, mutated ginseng babies and ordinary ginseng babies could no longer be considered the same race.
This was also why Grandma Li judged the mutated ginseng baby as a low-level monarch race.
The evolution path of a normal Beast Tamer’s Ginseng Baby was: Ginseng Baby → Ginseng Fruit Tree → Unknown.
As for Shi Yu’s Ginseng Baby, it evolved through the mutation of the Fruit of Life. It was a new evolution chain: Ginseng Baby → Mutated Ginseng Baby → Unknown.
“Don’t be too pessimistic.”
Shi Yu smiled when he saw Baby Ginseng’s desperate look.
“More than a hundred years ago, a Beast Tamer with the talent of ‘evolution’ among humans has already proven that all creatures have the possibility of infinite evolution, all the way to the Mythical Race.”
“So, you must still have an evolution path, but it’s just unknown at the moment.”
“After Eleven and Buggy finish studying evolution, we’ll consider your evolution path together.”
Shi Yu comforted the ginseng baby considerately.
Although his skill index was not as clear as his evolution talent, if he studied it carefully, he might be able to open up an exclusive evolution path. After all, there were many evolutionary skills. He should give it a try.
If he pressed the evolution skills of other plant-type pets onto Baby Ginseng, maybe it could also evolve.
“Yi…!” Baby Ginseng’s eyes regained its luster.
Really?
“You can choose not to believe me, but you can’t not believe that evolution big boss.” Shi Yu pushed the blame and said, “If you can’t evolve, go and scold him.”
Baby Ginseng:???
“I’m just kidding.” Shi Yu chuckled. However, he also felt that what the evolution big boss said made sense.
Any creature had the potential to evolve into a Mythical race as long as they found the right method.
However, it was awkward that the evolution big boss himself couldn’t cultivate a Mythical race or Mythical pet.
It was said that the Beast Tamer had evolved all the pets he contracted into a high-level overlord race before the age of 30, and their strength had all been cultivated to the totem level.
It was also because of this that he was known as one of the legendary Beast Tamers closest to the Mythical Domain, just like the ancient legend Beast Tamers like Emperor Shi.
Unfortunately, although he had created the view that pets could evolve infinitely, before he could evolve into a Mythical species or Mythical pet, this person disappeared. There were also different opinions about his whereabouts.
Some said that he had encountered an accident while exploring the Mythical Ruins in order to pursue the Mythical domain.
Some said that he left the Blue Planet and went to the Moon to look for evolution materials before getting lost in the starry sky…
There were all kinds of strange theories.
In any case, this Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, who had left a lot of marks in the field of evolution, never appeared again.
“Perhaps he transmigrated..” Shi Yu predicted in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - Light-Clearing Cannon
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Light-Clearing Cannon
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Next, Shi Yu prepared to continue bringing Baby Ginseng to challenge other pets.
This Giant Sunflower was clearly too weak. He had to at least find an opponent that could injure Baby Ginseng.
“Yi!!”
However, at this moment, after thinking about ginseng life, Baby Ginseng had a new idea.
“What?”
“Yi! (Why don’t we stop fighting and go back?)”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng felt that it was better to go back and study evolution than to fight these weak pets to find a sense of existence.
Evolution was the way to go!
Since Shi Yu wasn’t free for the time being, it wanted to transform into a researcher ginseng first. It would use Buggy and Eleven’s cell phones to search for information and think about it.
It heard that the evolution path of Buggy was thought up by itself. It had to learn it too!
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng stunned Shi Yu.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Up to you.” In any case, he had already achieved his goal.
…
Shi Yu started to walk back.
At this moment, the seniors had already exploded.
Baby Ginseng’s battle power crushed the Giant Sunflower, and also directly shattered their world view!
“This is definitely not nutrition.”
“What skill is that…”
“No matter what skill it is, a ginseng baby is too…”
“Ah Yun, you were the one who registered him just now, right? What’s his background?” Everyone looked at the white-dressed girl who received Shi Yu.
At this moment, the girl called Ah Yun was also very confused.
“He… he’s a new student from the level 178 Archaeology Department. His name is Shi Yu.”
Everyone was stunned. A new student?
You call a person who directly tortured the elite pet raised by the seniors of the Combat faculty a new student?
“Shi Yu??” A girl in casual clothes frowned. She kept feeling that she had heard this name before.
Although it was the Feeding faculty and not mainly pursued battle power, it didn’t mean that everyone didn’t pay attention to the professional Beast Tamer assessment.
“The first place in this year’s professional assessment in Ancient Capital, Shi Yu?” She thought of something.
“It’s him.” Then, she quickly took a look at Shi Yu’s handsome appearance in the video and confirmed it completely.
“Team Leader, he’s first in this year’s vocation assessment?” The other feed department seniors were slightly stunned.
“Damn, no wonder he’s so awesome.”
This girl, who everyone called team leader, was slightly silent.
“Ridiculous…” After a moment, she felt that it was very ridiculous. She said,” If I remember correctly, during the vocation assessment, he only had two pets. Where did this ginseng baby come from? Moreover, in half a month… This battle power…”
Damn, this was as unscientific as that green worm!!
How exactly was it cultivated!?
Everyone was stunned again. Then, they took out their phones or used their computers to search for information on the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital this year.
After all, he was a man who had been on the trending list for half a day. There was still a lot of news about Shi Yu on the Internet…
When Yu left the botanical garden, he felt that the atmosphere in the hall just now was pretty good. It was abnormally strange.
Everyone looked at him strangely.
Shi Yu immediately realized something.
“It’s really unscientific for Baby Ginseng to have battle power. I must contract a handsome, cool, and seemingly powerful fourth pet. This way, after adding some points and strengthening myself, it will look more scientific!”
…
Shi Yu left the garden indifferently.
Outside the hall, he walked past a senior who looked to be in a hurry to enter the hall. He calmly walked towards the dormitory.
During this period, Baby Ginseng could not wait to enter the ruins space and run to ask Buggy for its cell phone to fill in its own aspiration form to submit to Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu felt that it was too early for Baby Ginseng to think about this.
Improving racial skills could effectively accelerate the growth of pets. This was an advantage that racial external skills did not have.
It was because of this that Eleven and Buggy could grow so quickly in just half a year, ignoring the impact of age and time on their growth levels to a certain extent.
Eleven and the worm were in a hurry to evolve because they only had one racial skill.
Moreover, it had already been fully stretched, causing them to be about to encounter a growth bottleneck.
If they wanted to grow to commander rank, they needed a certain opportunity. It was even harder to quickly grow to monarch rank.
Therefore, if Shi Yu wanted the two pets to continue growing at a high speed, he had to choose to let them evolve.
This way, the high-value nutritional supplements and food they ate daily could also be perfectly absorbed. They wouldn’t have to waste a lot of nutrition due to race bottlenecks in the future.
However, there was actually no need to rush for the time being on Baby Ginseng’s side.
It had a total of five racial skills, and even a transcendent skill. As long as it was maxed out, Baby Ginseng’s growth level would definitely break through to commander rank and monarch rank.
There was no bottleneck. It was fundamentally different from Eleven and the bug.
