“Even the standards of high-level Beast Tamers are almost fulfilled.”
Shi Yu had an innocent expression. “Then we won’t take the assessment?”
Master Qu Jie was silent.
“Forget it, I’m already here.”
He looked at Dean Hao and the others who were smiling in the audience, and his expression darkened. He finally knew why the busy Dean Hao had come to watch the show. It turned out that there was a big show to watch.
Did he want to see Shi Yu beat up the examiner?
Impossible!
Not only did he want to give him an intermediate-level license, he also wanted to fight the examiner!
How could an examiner, such a sacred profession, be beaten up by an examiner?
“Fight!”
He wanted to see how powerful Shi Yu was now.
In the blink of an eye, Master Qu Jie did not talk about virtue. With a boom, dark red flames erupted from the Bull-headed Beast King’s body!!
“Roar!!!” The Bull-headed Beast King roared, raised its battle axe, and swung down!!
Bang!!!
The huge ax burned with flames, and the surrounding heat waves began to sway. The destructive flames directly made the arena red and crack.
The transcendent Exploding Flame Axe attack directly changed the terrain, causing the venue to start shooting flames. He even condensed a terrifying flaming axe shadow and released its energy!
Hu ~ Hu ~
In the arena, a Flaming Axe attack that could easily hack a steel building in a range of several meters attacked.
“Master Qu Jie is too shameless…” In the spectator area, examiner Liu Jie spoke up. A mid-level assessment, and he was using the transcendent skill of his pet?
Even if the opponent was also a commander rank, it was a little bullying…
However, just as she finished speaking, her mouth opened slightly. She saw that the restrained Eleven opposite her suddenly erupted with lightning.
Buzz…
At the same time, Eleven made a posture of gathering strength to punch. The violent lightning power formed countless arcs on its body. It was now like a violent lightning machine!
In an instant, Eleven punched.
Buzz…
At this moment, Master Qu Jie and the Bull-headed Beast King’s expressions froze.
They sensed a huge threat from Eleven’s palm that was filled with electric light!
“Eleven, Hardening Thunder Palm,” Shi Yu said.
Boom!!!
As the lightning accumulated in Eleven’s body erupted, electromagnetic wave patterns instantly appeared around it and gathered into a fist. The terrifying fist power swept up a huge fist wind like an electromagnetic storm.
The Thunder Palm’s energy was released and blasted towards the Flame Axe. Then, it instantly swallowed all the flames. During this process, it directly lifted up most of the cracked floor and crushed it. Then, it swept the gravel and swallowed the Ox-Headed Beast King!
Even if it was in a restrained state, its energy value was not what the Ox-Headed Beast King with sealed power could compare to.
Bang!!!
In an instant, smoke and lightning lingered around the Bull-headed Beast King’s body, and it was sent flying by the aftermath of the thunder palm’s explosion!
At the Transcendent level, he released the Thunder Palm! Under the coordination of the thunder nature of the hardened state, he even borrowed the power of the accumulating lightning!
Examiner Liu Jie’s eyes widened as she watched helplessly as the Ox-Headed Beast King was sent flying by Little Eleven, who hadn’t moved at all… Monster? Moreover, this was still in a restrained state, right??

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - Strength in the Nine Li Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Strength in the Nine Li Form
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Bang!!!
The Ox-Headed Beast King was sent flying.
“You guys…”
After this attack, Master Qu Jie’s expression changed.
It quickly looked at the ox-headed beast king in the smoke, whose body was partially charred. It used its ax to stab the ground.
If he remembered correctly, after the Iron-eating Beast evolved, it mastered the super skill to restrain its sharpness.
Shi Yu’s Little Iron Eating Beast was clearly in a restrained state!!
The Ox-Headed Beast King of a monarch race was suppressed before this panda even erupted with power??
“This power, what’s going on…” At the spectator area, Liu Jie was similarly confused.
“The reason is very simple. It’s because it’s strong enough.”
Dean Hao said calmly. A billion worth of evolution materials, even in the Iron-eating Beast state, would more or less receive some increase.
“Just now, It didn’t use the additional lightning as a source of stamina. It only used the strength naturally stored in its body.”
Dean Hao said, “Even so, can he still have such strength in its reserved state?”
He began to be curious about Eleven’s strength.
Beside them, the panda and its daughter were also looking forward to it.
The stronger the iron-eating beast, the happier they were.
After all, Shi Yu and Eleven were ambassadors of the Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base…
“In that case…”
In the arena, Master Qu Jie was numb. He felt that it was troublesome. He took a deep breath and gave the next order.
Since ordinary skills were not enough, he would combine the profundities!
“Roar!!!” In the next second, the Bull-headed Beast King stomped on the ground again.
Profound: Red Lotus Explosion
Boom!!!
Its entire body was filled with flames again, as if it had turned into a flaming tank.
Under the profundity combination skill of the Ox-Headed Beast King’s Raging Flame Charge and Horn of Fire, the flames it turned into seemed to have become a fire red lotus with a huge horn. It charged at Little Eleven with very terrifying power and energy.
“This…” Liu Jie was stunned again.
Hey, hey, hey, Master Qu Jie, this is an intermediate Beast Tamer assessment, not a master assessment!
“Wuu!!!”
The profundities didn’t matter either. In the face of this terrifying attack, Eleven still had a calm expression. After letting out a roar, it directly turned into a size similar to the Bull-headed Beast King in a restrained state!
Moreover, its whole body hardened, and it smashed towards the bull-headed beast king’s huge horn without dodging!!
It was a super combination skill that was proficient in level multiplication+Dao Proficiency!
Bang!!!
In an instant, under the collision of the Bull-headed Beast King and Eleven, explosive flames surrounded their bodies!
Boom ~ Boom ~ Boom ~ Boom ~
Accompanied by the roar of the flames and the explosion of heat waves, this huge confrontation stunned Liu Jie, who was watching the battle. You call this an intermediate assessment?
If that was all, it would have been fine. In the next second, the huge flames changed shape, as if forming a fire tornado, and then disappeared. In the flames, with a roar, the huge Bull-headed Beast King was pulled by Eleven’s horns, raised, and thrown out!!
Bang!!!
The Ox-Headed Beast King, which had used the combination profound meaning to collide, was directly blocked by Giant Eleven. It was thrown out and hit the ground!
Examiner Liu Jie’s expression was already stunned. She dared to confirm that if one of them was her, she would have been insta-killed!
No wonder Director Hao looked down on her…
“Roar!!!”
At that moment, the Ox-headed beast king that was thrown out by the horns exploded in anger.
Why was the strength and defense on the other side so ridiculous?
“Damn it.” As the Ox-Headed Beast King crawled up, Master Qu Jie panicked.
Although the Ox-Headed Beast King had sealed its power, this little Iron-eating Beast was too difficult to deal with.
If he didn’t show some real ability, he would probably fail.
“Roar!!!”
After being suppressed one after another, the Ox-Headed Beast King was filled with anger, and flames of war filled its eyes.
“Roar!!!”
This time, fiery cracks appeared all over its body, as if the ground had been split open by the flames. At the same time, an even larger illusory image of the Demonic Ox Flame appeared behind it.
Skill: Thorn Fire Armor
[Introduction]: Intermediate fire-element skill. Clad in armor of flames that looks like thorns. When the enemy attacks you, the flames will erupt with a stronger power to attack the enemy.
Skill: Flame Battle Soul
< Introduction > It’s a transcendent fire-element skill. Summon the Flame Battle Soul and fight together. During the existence of the Flame Battle Soul, it can increase the user’s strength, defense, speed, fire power, battle will, injury recovery speed, and can be a substitute to help the user be immune to one fatal attack.
Boom!!!
After using some proficient level Thorny Flame Armor and Bathing Flame Soul, under the enhancement of the battle soul, the Ox-Headed Beast King was like an incomparably violent giant fire beast. Its huge body could barely capture the explosive speed with Eleven’s perfect super vision. It came in front of Eleven amidst the trembling ground and swung its ax.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven entered the Thunder Armor state under the enlarged state and took this axe head-on. However, even if it was full-strength Hardening+Perfect Level Thunder Palm+Mastery Level multiplication, it could only be suppressed by this violent attack.
Eleven first felt the huge power of the Ox-Headed Beast King, and its feet collapsed. Then, it felt the second rebound of the Thorny Flame Armor from the ax after it hit the ax!!
This Ox-Headed Beast King had actually trained the Thorny Flame Armor to the point where it could be enchanted into the battle axe, although the battle axe was originally one with the Ox-Headed Beast King.
Boom ~ Boom ~
“Wuu!!” Under the double strength, the restrained Eleven’s energy value was much higher than his opponent, but it was still knocked over with a bang in terms of strength. Like a leaking panda balloon, it was smashed back to its one-meter state and flew onto the arena!
Bang!!!
Eleven fell into the pit.
“Finally…” Examiner Liu Jie felt that it was hard for Master Qu.
“Phew.” After finally suppressing Shi Yu and the others, Master Qu Jie felt that he had regained some face.
However, before he could calm down for a moment, Eleven, who was opposite him, let out a cry of dissatisfaction.
After recovering quickly with the help of the high-speed healing, it got up.
White evolution light shot out of his body.
At this moment, for some reason, Master Qu Jie and the Ox-headed Beast King’s hearts trembled.
Boom!!!
Under the light, a terrifying deterrence erupted from Eleven.
At the same time, with the light, Eleven’s body gradually enlarged to nearly ten meters.
A moment later, Eleven’s Nine Li Battle Beast form appeared in front of the Ox-Headed Beast King.
The huge armor of black and white covered its entire body in hardened armor. Its blue eyes were as domineering as lightning. At this moment, lightning was really entangling in the metal armor. In an instant, an incomparable pressure enveloped the Ox-Headed Beast King.
Even before the strength seal, as a real monarch-level pet, it couldn’t help but swallow its saliva when facing Eleven in this form.
“This is… its evolved form?”
Master Qu Jie also gulped.
“Again.”
“Wuu!!! (Again!!)”
Shi Yu and Eleven spoke at the same time. At the same time, with a boom, Eleven’s super skill was activated for the first time after it evolved into a sharp state.
The overload of lightning that had been accumulated in its stamina source directly filled its entire body, making it look like a tall Thunder God. It was incomparably domineering. The power of this lightning bolt completely exceeded the thunder palm just now!
Boom!!!
The shocking energy explosion stunned Liu Jie, who was in the audience, again. She originally thought that Master Qu Jie was finally going to turn the situation around, but she realized that things weren’t that simple…
Congratulations, Master Qu Jie, for baiting the opponent’s “sealed” state.
At the side, the panda father and daughter and Dean Hao revealed excited looks. This power was such a waste of talent if not used against dragons!
Multiplication+Energy Storage Lightning+Lightning Palm+Inner Power…
Nearly 100,000 energy points against the Ox-Headed Beast King that was sealed with about 10,000 energy points. At this moment, the difference could no longer be made up with skill. This was absolute power. No one could stop a difference of ten times.
“Roar!!!!”
At this moment, sensing a huge threat, the Ox-Headed Beast King roared and activated the proficient level of the flames of war. The battle soul floating behind it directly attached to its body and fused into its body. At this moment, the Ox-Headed Beast King’s muscles increased exponentially and its body enlarged. Its gaze shot out flames as it swung out another Flaming Axe!!
Boom!!!
The air vibrated!
However!
This Bursting Flame Axe Strike, which should have been earth-shaking and could casually send Eleven flying with one strike just now, hit Eleven’s hardened armor… With a bang, it actually didn’t leave any marks on Eleven’s body!!
Instead, the huge impact made the Ox-Headed Beast King’s whole body go numb, and it took a few steps back!!
There was no way to break through the defense!
The Ox-Headed Beast King revealed a shocked expression, its hand trembling so much that it couldn’t even hold the battle axe properly.
“This body strength, how is it possible…” Master Qu Jie also said with a shocked expression.
It was no wonder that Master Qu Jie was shocked. After evolving, Eleven’s body strength was comparable to that of the overlord race’s dragons. In addition to hardening, there was a difference in energy. As long as the Ox-headed Beast King remained in this state, even if it attacked with all its might, it would still be giving Eleven a mere massage!
“Wuu!!!!” After evolution, even though the expression under the armor was very fierce, Eleven still smiled foolishly. It was its turn.
Boom!!
Eleven, in its giant form, directly threw a simple palm.
It was a simple palm, but it contained monstrous power.
Buzz—
The Thunder God’s palm that descended from the sky made the expression of the Bull-headed Beast King, who was holding a battle axe, change.
Stupid Beast Tamer.
What kind of assessment did they call him out for?
Intermediate assessment?
And sealed his power for this?
What kind of assessment was this?!
Give back the Ox-headed Beast King’s power!
Otherwise, it would turn from a bull-headed beast king into a battle-axe steak!!
“Hou!!!” The Ox-Headed Beast King let out a roar!!
Master Qu Jie was also shocked by the might contained in this attack.
This was called a commander rank?
Without nearly 100,000 energy points, he definitely couldn’t release such a powerful skill!
“For you!”
At this moment, Master Qu Jie was forced to unseal a portion of the Ox-Headed Beast King’s power, restoring it to a level close to 100,000 energy points. This level was still considered a “commander-level” standard, but compared to the 10,000 just now, one was the lower limit, and the other was almost the upper limit.
If he was forced to let the Ox-Headed Beast King recover its monarch-level battle power during the assessment, then he wouldn’t need to be an examiner anymore. He could just retire!!
This was his final stubbornness.
Boom!!!
An almost tenfold aura erupted from the Bull-headed Beast King.
“Old Qu can’t handle it,” Dean Hao shouted.
“It’s been unsealed…” Liu Jie’s intern examiner was also a little confused. Was this an intermediate examination?
The examinee forced the examiner to release the seal and used the strength of almost the upper limit of the commander rank to deal with it?
It had already exceeded the level!!!
She admitted that she had underestimated Junior Shi Yu a little previously.
This guy was a pervert!
The top scholar of the ancient capital? Even if the top scholar of the imperial capital and demon capital were added together, they probably wouldn’t be enough for him to fight!
At least, as a high-level Beast Tamer, Liu Jie felt that she was inferior to Shi Yu in a one-on-one battle.
Ten times the energy was unsealed.
The Ox-Headed Beast King erupted.
It felt that it could do it again.
However.
“Roar!!!” Even though the Bull-headed Beast King had recovered to an even stronger state, Master Qu Jie and the others still underestimated this attack.
The lightning power contained in this palm wasn’t as simple as Eleven’s limit.
It had long surpassed the extreme destructive power of Eleven Hardening and Thunder Palm!!
This was thanks to the huge amount of electricity that accumulated energy lightning and converged sharpness that helped Eleven accumulate power that exceeded his own limits!!
This was part of the power of the monarch-level Purple Electric Mecha!
The effect of Inner Power was to accumulate a huge amount of energy that exceeded the limits of the body and then multiply it out!!
However, the process would cause huge side-effect damage to oneself.
At this moment, the electricity that should have caused a huge load on his body, under the coordination of Eleven’s hardening “Thunder”, fused into the Thunder Palm at the smallest cost and was released by Eleven!!
“Wuu!!” Eleven felt the terrifying lightning power as if it wanted to tear apart the hardened substance, armor, and palm. The huge pain made Eleven both excited and afraid.
As long as it wasn’t afraid of pain, it could release powerful skills that exceeded the limits of its body?
It liked this Inner Power too much.
Later on, Shi Yu had to maximize the high-speed healing… It could use this skill as self-destruction!
Bang!!!
The thunder palm hit the huge axe of the Ox-Headed Beast King below, whose eyes were bulging. But in the next moment, the Ox-Headed Beast King’s expression almost exploded.
He sensed an unbearable terrifying power descend.
“Boom!!!” The ground under the ox-headed beast king’s feet directly cracked, as if it was about to collapse and drown it.
“Roar!!” The Ox-Headed Beast King’s gaze exploded. Wait, this power… Something’s wrong! Is this f*cking commander rank?
Beast Tamer, help! This bit of sealed energy wasn’t enough to sh*t!
Master Qu Jie was also stunned. He didn’t expect that despite unsealing so much power, the Ox-Headed Beast King was still suppressed by this attack!!
“Huge Transformation and Inner Power are both skills with high consumption and high damage superimposing attack power. Even if the opponent’s level is relatively high, he might not necessarily be able to withstand a round of explosive power,” Master Lin Hongnian explained excitedly.
This was the Iron-eating Beast, this was the Nine Li Battle Beast!!
Every skill was born to increase strength beyond the limit!
Compared to the average enhancement of the Flame Bath Battle Soul, not only was it not damaged, but it also had a protective super skill. The reserved sharpness was even more extreme!
It gave up everything in exchange for an attack power that exceeded the limit. In fact, during this process, it would even heavily injure the user. In the direction of the attack, almost no super skill could compare to the extreme Inner Power!
The name of a battle beast was well-deserved.
“Roar!!!” The Ox-Headed Beast King resisted with all its might.
When the lightning palm made contact with it, violent lightning surged out. At the same time that the Ox-Headed Beast King was tortured, it also exploded Eleven’s hardened substance and armor. Fortunately, these things were already completely one with Eleven. They could be recovered with high-speed healing. If they were like the Mechanic class, they would have to spend money to repair them after breaking through. Shi Yu would cry to death.
Bang!!!
In an instant, the ground collapsed. The venue rumbled, lightning flashed, and sporadic electric arcs and fire snakes flew in all directions. As for the Ox-Headed Beast King, it was about to lose control and was smashed into the ground, revealing a tragic expression.
Son of a b*tch, what a scam of a Beast Tamer. He won’t play assessment battles with this guy anymore.
Who exactly was the one being tested?
It was just about to continue cursing when it suddenly realized that it had disappeared from the outside world and returned to the Beast Taming Space.
Eleven hit nothing but air and shattered the arena.
In the outside world.
Master Qu Jie had an idea. After putting away his pet, he had a calm expression and said calmly, “Not bad, five minutes have passed. Congratulations on passing the assessment. You’re the most outstanding candidate I’ve tested. Not only have you resisted for so long, you almost forced out more power from the Ox-Headed Beast King. Your future is very promising.”
Boom.
After the palm missed, Eleven looked at Master Qu Jie in confusion. Are you a sore loser? Let it out, it can still fight!
“Uh.” Shi Yu was also stunned.
In the distance, Dean Hao and the panda father and daughter had strange expressions.
What did you say?
He had already forced it out!!
When Eleven was still in a restrained state, his battle standard had already far exceeded the intermediate assessment!
Which examiner would use transcendent skills, combination profundities, or even super-level skills to test candidates?
Moreover… They looked at the corner of the arena, where each of Shi Yu’s two other pets were just staring there, revealing a confused expression. Moreover, only one of Shi Yu’s three pets appeared…
The three of them looked at Liu Jie, the intern examiner beside them.
Liu Jie:?_?It’s too dangerous to be an examiner. Perhaps what she needed to do was to be as thick-skinned as Master Qu Jie?
Shi Yu and Eleven were too strong…
“…” At this moment, although Master Qu Jie’s expression was calm and stubborn, his heart was already trembling. F*ck, what was wrong with this Shi Yu? Were both he and these pet monsters? The vocation assessment was already ridiculous… But now…
Even among the high-level Beast Tamers, he was probably in the first tier.
As other pets break through, they might be able to touch the threshold of the “quasi-master level” very soon. They could barely fight against real monarch-level pets.
Now, Qu Jie felt a little regretful for appearing personally. If he had known earlier, he would have thrown the assessment mission to someone else. Guidance battle… Guidance his a*s. He couldn’t control the situation on his side the whole time. Guidance his a*s.
Right now, he only wanted Shi Yu to take the intermediate-level license and leave quickly. He wanted to go back and comfort his and his pet’s injured hearts.
“Then… I passed?” Shi Yu asked.
Qu Jie’s face darkened. “Yes.”
You passed. Go already, you monsters!
I wonder how your cohort’s candidates will feel when they see this assessment… He heard that in order to catch up to Shi Yu, Yin Zhengfan seemed to have gone to some Capital University?

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - Baby Ginseng Breaks Through Too
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Baby Ginseng Breaks Through Too
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu successfully obtained an intermediate-level license.
It was a pity that his Beast Taming Space was not Level 4 yet. Otherwise, he could have gotten his high-level license as well.
However, in terms of battle power, Shi Yu was not inferior to a high-level Beast Tamer at all.
Only the best among the high-level Beast Tamers, which were also the quasi-master-level Beast Tamers who could fight against monarch-level creatures, had the strength to defeat Shi Yu.
Usually, such people were the core force even in the school teams of the nine major schools.
At the moment, although Eleven was very strong, it was still much, much weaker than those monarch-level pets with energy values that could easily exceed millions.
Even if he relied on Inner Power to erupt, it was very difficult to resist.
After all, it couldn’t enjoy the enhancement of the Beast Tamer’s talent, nor could it have a combination skill like Yu Shu’s pet.
Shi Yu didn’t mind. After all, Eleven had just evolved and broken through. There were a lot of racial skills to be learned.
Slowly, it was only a matter of time before his battle power reached the pseudo monarch level.
“Hahahaha.”
After passing the assessment, Master Qu Jie did not stay long at all. He directly sent everyone out.
Outside, when he thought of Master Qu Jie’s dark face, Dean Hao smiled very happily.
As expected of a pet that completed its evolution with his help. It was indeed strong!!!
Apart from the Flame Battle Soul, none of Master Qu Jie’s Bull-headed Beast King skills were lower than perfect proficiency.
Even so, Eleven still suppressed him very badly at the same level.
Dean Hao already had a premonition that Shi Yu would become a very impressive Beast Tamer in the future.
Eleven would also become a guardian-like pet that stood tall in Dong Huang.
As the person who made all of this happen, Dean Hao felt a sense of accomplishment.
After all, he was also a teacher. He enjoyed the feeling of nurturing people into talents.
“Uncle Lin, Senior Sister, you guys are satisfied now, right?”
Shi Yu looked at Master Lin Hongnian and Senior Panda.
The two of them rushed over to see Eleven’s strength after evolution. There shouldn’t be any regrets now, right?
“Haha, of course I’m satisfied.” Lin Hongnian smiled.
“By the way, my daughter’s Iron-eating Beast doesn’t seem to have a spouse yet. Shi Yu, take a look. Can your Eleven and her Flower pair up?”
He felt that Eleven’s bloodline was too impressive. It would be a pity if he didn’t make a little Iron-Eating Beast.
Shi Yu, Lin Xiuzhu:???
Dean Hao also had a strange expression. This Hall Master Lin was really amazing.
But that made sense… If Eleven had a cub, its talent potential would probably be off the charts.
There should be a bunch of Beast Tamers willing to pay hundreds of millions to apply for raising. After all, their parents’ potential and talent were too strong.
“This…” Shi Yu was embarrassed.” Eleven is still a little young, right? He’s only two. “
Lin Xiuzhu also had a helpless expression. Her Iron-eating Beast was already 11 or 10 years older.
Although age wasn’t an issue?
“I’m just saying.” Hall Master Lin chuckled.
It couldn’t be rushed… Eleven was indeed a little young.
Then, everyone sat in Dean Hao’s car in satisfaction.
Their destination was not the school, but the restaurant.
In order to celebrate Eleven’s evolution, Shi Yu had to treat everyone to a big meal no matter what.
After lunch.
The panda father and daughter didn’t plan to stay long in the ancient capital. After all, there were still a lot of things to settle in Ping Cheng.
After satisfying their curiosity, the father and daughter went back.
In the end, only Dean Hao drove Shi Yu back to school.
In the car.
Dean Hao couldn’t help but ask again, “Shiyu, do you really not have any intention of upgrading that index to a mechanical life form?”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. “No, really.”
“But I’m actually quite interested in mechanical suits.”
“It’s not impossible if the index can become a part of a battleship and mecha.”
Dean Hao smiled. “Mechanical lives like mechas have higher requirements for Beast Tamers.”
Apart from orthodox Mechanics, even if some Beast Tamers wanted to contract mechanical lives, they would only choose simple machines like laser swords and electromagnetic guns.
Ordinary Beast Tamers really couldn’t control the life of a mecha, nor did they know how to upgrade and maintain it.
“Ah, this…” Shi Yu felt that it was a pity.
“By the way, after I start school, can I choose a Mechanic course?”
Dean Hao laughed and said, “No problem, no problem, but every department is a big field of study. Are you sure you can learn it?”
Shi Yu said, “No problem. I’m not going deep. I just want to have a rough understanding.”
One way or another, Shi Yu really wanted Dean Hao’s Gundam. Oh, wait, mecha.
When there was a chance in the future, he would definitely make one.
He wanted to understand Mechanical Life and Mechanic skills well. After all, he had the skill index. Perhaps he could find another way to become a Mechanic.
It was fine if he did not understand the upgrade of his mechanical suit. When he looked at the Purple Electric mechanical suit, he saw that some of the skills recorded in the skill index could also be taught to mechanical lives!
In short, Mechas were still a man’s romance!
…
After arriving at school, Shi Yu returned to his dormitory.
At this moment, Eleven had just recovered.
Although the attack just now was strong, it directly crippled its right palm. The various parts of its body also suffered huge injuries from overloading the lightning.
Even if Eleven used high-speed healing, it couldn’t recover immediately. It lacked energy.
Fortunately, Shi Yu and the others still had the invincible Ginseng Baby.
Under the knock-off Fruits of Life that Baby Ginseng quickly created, Eleven quickly became lively.
However, it was a pity that the lightning energy from the Purple Electric Mecha in its body was all gone.
In the source of physical strength in a restrained state, there was no longer any energy.
In this way, even if it evolved again, it wouldn’t be able to erupt with the super strong state it had just now.
If he still wanted to have that state, he could only spend money.
Using metal-element energy crystals and thunder-element energy crystals, he could increase the upper limit of his energy through the spending limit.
“Although Inner Power is powerful and one of the most powerful super skills, the drawbacks are also very obvious… It costs money.”
“Fortunately, Eleven has awakened the ability of storage lightning. This way, even if it’s lightning in nature, it can still be absorbed and stored as energy. This is very cheap.”
“It seems that in the future, on rainy days and thunderstorm days, Eleven will have to fly into the sky and be struck by lightning. It’s impossible to feed energy crystals. It’s fine if it’s just one or two battles, but it definitely won’t be able to withstand it for a long time.”
The only pity was that in nature, there were relatively few metal-element natural environments, unlike lightning environments.
Now that he thought about it, Shi Yu felt that his secondary attributes were really on the right path.
Thunder types were too easy to absorb from nature for free, and the natural thunderstorm energy was not small!
It perfectly matched Inner Power.
But if it were time and space, where would they go to replenish their energy quickly and exceed the limit? Even Eleven’s own metal power wasn’t as easy to accumulate as thunder power.
…
“Wuuu!!!”
In the ruins, Eleven was floating with a smug look on its face, showing off its power to the bugs and ginseng babies.
“Ji!!” “Yi!!”
Buggy and Ginseng Baby were both envious and proud.
That was all?
After they evolved, they would definitely be stronger.
Also, who was the one who despised evolution at the start? Why was it so excited after evolution?
Buggy and Baby Ginseng despised it.
“Sob.” Eleven slowly landed. It was going to train hard. It had taken too many shortcuts to evolve. It was time to make up for it.
When Eleven decided to go for training, Shi Yu happened to enter.
After he entered, the three pets immediately looked at Shi Yu.
“Eleven, go train yourself. You have nothing to do for the next month.”
Eleven: QAQ
“Ji!!” “Yi!!!” Buggy and Baby Ginseng agreed with both hands.
Eleven was too strong. Let’s strengthen Buggy and ginseng babies!
“Sob.” Eleven clenched its fist in excitement. It didn’t matter. It was very strong and hardworking now. It was invincible. It didn’t matter if it didn’t get to add more points.
With that, it ran off to train.
There was even a very excited smile on its face.
Evolution was so good.
It, Panda King Eleven, was really invincible this time.
It looked forward to the next evolution!
Shi Yu smiled and looked at Eleven, who was still running away like a child.
He planned to let Eleven, who had just evolved, settle down and adapt to the next two states.
In addition, he should take advantage of this time to upgrade Buggy.
This was really quite urgent.
After all, the lifespan of a worm wasn’t comparable to that of a baby ginseng or Eleven.
Shi Yu planned to let Buggy evolve in the near future.
“Buggy, I’m preparing to arrange your evolution next,” Shi Yu said. Buggy was overjoyed.
“So, I’m going to give Baby Ginseng more points.”
Buggy:???
Baby Ginseng was overjoyed. What was going on?
But it liked it.
“The money for the evolution materials isn’t enough for the time being. Next, Buggy, you create more Worm Silk. I’ll increase the sweetness and nutritional skills of the Ginseng Baby. Let’s sell Worm Silk, spices, and nutritional supplements to earn it!!”
Buggy was ecstatic again. That works too.
Baby Ginseng cried crazily. So it was adding points to sell supplements.
“Calm down, calm down. When Buggy’s evolution is over, it’s your turn. You have to follow the order of entry.”
“Now, add the skill level. When the time comes, sell more money. You also have money for your evolution materials.” Shi Yu patted the Radish Baby.
Upon hearing this, Baby Ginseng nodded determinedly. So be it. It was all for a better future!!
“Hu…”
At this moment, looking at the two pets, Shi Yu planned to test the limits of his contracted ginseng baby.
After the Beast Taming Space upgraded, the upper limit of his physique and physique increased. After contracting the Ginseng Baby, his physical recovery speed increased again. After Eleven evolved and broke through, it brought great benefits to Shi Yu.
The current Shi Yu was in his best state.
Two days.
He gave himself two days.
School would start in three days. He wanted to upload the skill points of Baby Ginseng and Worm in two days. Then, he would sell the products of their “Dao Proficiency-level skills to the rich lady gem cat who liked to collect rare treasures in Ancient Capital University to exchange for a small sum of money to buy evolution materials.
If it went smoothly, perhaps when school started, Buggy could turn into a cocoon.
Moreover, its physique could also reach another limit.
“Come on.” Shi Yu’s expression was determined.
…
Currently, the sweetness of the ginseng baby was at perfection, and the nutritional content was at expert level.
Shi Yu felt that he could still take the exhaustion of one low-level skill and one mid-level skill.
Then, the green worm spat out the worm silk into a pile of boxes in pain and joy.
As for Shi Yu, he held the ginseng baby and increased his points crazily.
With every point added, Shi Yu’s physique improved after recovering from the sweet smell.
At the same time, the skill proficiency of the baby ginseng and its energy level could also increase.
Initially, Shi Yu thought that everything would go smoothly.
However, an accident still happened.
Shi Yu was stunned when he upgraded the sweetness aura of the ginseng baby from “transcendent” to “full”.
Beep… Beep… Beep…
The energy value of the ginseng baby reached 9999…
Then, a white light filled its body. It directly underwent a growth transformation.
Its aura kept rising, and its energy kept erupting. Shi Yu’s detector could clearly see that its energy value was jumping crazily.
Obviously, Baby Ginseng’s growth level went from transcendent to commander rank.. Just like Eleven, it broke through!

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - Depressed Buggy
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Depressed Buggy
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Eleven had evolved to raise its growth limit, thereby successfully breaking through to commander rank.
As for Baby Ginseng, its race level was very high to begin with, and it didn’t have any bottlenecks. Now, it had broken through its growth level through the increase in its race skills and under the lead of the skills.
Buzz!!!
After Baby Ginseng broke through, an alluring energy wave surged into the sky and spread across the ruins.
Somewhere, Buggy and Eleven sensed the change in energy and couldn’t help but swallow.
The breakthrough of supplements was like the appearance of a treasure. Not many pets could resist its allure.
“Holy shit, another one broke through.”
Shi Yu was shocked.
How could he bear this? He was only a middle-level Beast Tamer, and he already had two commander-level pets?
He would be drained dry!
Wait a minute, the ginseng baby was a supplement. That was fine.
Eleven and Buggy, who rushed over after hearing the change, were also stunned.
Eleven was alright, but Buggy was in tears!!!
It had already sensed the huge energy wave from the baby ginseng.
This guy… this guy… This guy’s energy level was probably more than 20 times his!!
Now, even if he had a spatial skill, he definitely wouldn’t be able to defeat Baby Ginseng.
Baby Ginseng could exhaust it to death.
“Ji!!!!”
Buggy didn’t expect to be reduced to the bottom of the team.
“Yi…” At this moment, Baby Ginseng was still a little confused.
Sensing that the energy in its body had undergone a qualitative change and become incomparably large, it could even solidify its energy at any time to form energy crystals. The ginseng baby was stunned.
It…
A breakthrough?
“You broke through.” Shi Yu looked at the energy detected on the index and took a deep breath.
Energy: 77,663
Although this energy level had yet to reach the 80,000 standard of the “overlord race” commander rank, it was already relatively high among the “monarch race” commander rank, approaching the limit of the overlord race.
Baby Ginseng was indeed a pet race that specialized in vitality and energy.
Considering that his baby ginseng also knew attack skills, Shi Yu could only say that the invincible towering emperor had finally taken the first step towards invincibility.
“Ji…” Buggy looked at Shi Yu with teary eyes and asked about Baby Ginseng’s energy level.
Shi Yu had a strange expression. “Don’t think too much. Baby Ginseng has eaten the Fruit of Life. This is a level-eight resource. It’s worth one billion at the least. It’s even more expensive than one billion’s worth of evolution materials.”
“Ji…”
Tell it the number. It could take it!
“77,663…”
“It’s more than 20 times yours, right?”
It was unknown if it fainted from exhaustion or from fright because it had vomited too much silk, but it directly entered an absolute sleep state…
Buggy collapsed.
“Wuu!!” Eleven, who was beside him, revealed a surprised expression and looked at Baby Ginseng, who had an equally surprised expression.
“Wuu!!! (Fight!!)”
Eleven wanted to taste a commander-level Energy Fruit Bomb.
“Yi… (Sure!)” Baby Ginseng was also inflated. It felt that it wasn’t much worse than Eleven.
Now it was Buggy at the bottom! Great!
It wanted to protect its number two spot and challenge the number one spot!
It completely didn’t realize that the skills with high proficiency were all supplement skills. Even transcendent skills were supplement skills.
Eleven, on the other hand, had skills that purely increased battle power.
In addition, judging from the energy level alone, Eleven was playing unfairly. Eleven’s body strength, which was comparable to a giant dragon, was definitely not something a plant baby ginseng could crack.
“Fight my butt. Come, we’ll continue increasing points. Next, it’s time to add nutrients. Perhaps after this is maxed out, your energy level can exceed Eleven.” Shi Yu didn’t want it to waste meaningless time.
In this battle, both parties would probably have to rest for a long time…
Baby Ginseng:!!!
Continue to increase points!
“Wuu! (boring)”
Eleven crossed its arms. It only knew how to add points. Forget it, it was invincible. You guys could do whatever you want.
However, at this moment, Eleven more or less had a sense of crisis and decided to train harder!
At this moment, Buggy was still lying down…
…
Before continuing to increase the points, Shi Yu and the others first figured out the effect of the max-level sweetness.
Compared to the sweetness before the Perfect level, the sweet aura at the transcendent level was in more forms.
Before perfection, sweetness aura was just a sweet aura. There was nothing new.
After reaching perfection, the sweetness could be condensed into spices and perfumes by Baby Ginseng, and it could also limit the speed at which their fragrances spread.
It could be made into a sachet or something. When worn on a normal day, the effect was very good.
Shi Yu had prepared dozens of them. It was very practical to change one every day.
As for the change in the sweetness after reaching the maximum level, Shi Yu was very surprised.
Firstly, the effect was better. In fact, apart from reducing fatigue, it could also provide the effect of calming the mind.
This was very helpful in increasing Shi Yu’s meditation efficiency, preventing him from being distracted and distracted all the time.
Apart from the fact that the effect was better, the special property of the increase in the max-level sweet aura was relatively special. Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng didn’t know what to say…
Maximum-level sweet aura, its nature was change and simulation.
In an instant, Baby Ginseng mastered the change in scent in hundreds of millions. It could simulate the scent of the sweet scent into the aura of any spiritual plant or spiritual fruit, greatly increasing the temptation of the sweet scent.
“It doesn’t look like it’s useful… But it seems to be more convenient to form a pretty good deception effect with nutrition.”
“In the future, I can let Baby Ginseng release a pile of sweet aura to attract the dragon race in the wild. The dragon itself will come running over… The hunting skill is similar to the talent of the Dragon Blood Willow, but the range of attraction is more comprehensive!”
“Moreover, it’s easier to sell it for money…”
The scent that pets liked was different between each other. The current baby ginseng could be said to be able to satisfy all customers’ needs… Shi Yu’s expression was odd. This change was not bad.
In the future, he could do different things every day and inhale different flavors of sweetness.
This also greatly reduced his rejection of sweetness.
Speaking of which… What kind of spiritual plants did the gem cat like the most? Firstly, excluding the fish scent grass…
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng didn’t linger on this for too long. They continued to increase their points.
It was similar to Shi Yu’s plan.
Two days after they started adding points, Baby Ginseng’s nutritional supplement skill also went from “expert level” to “Dao Proficiency”.
It was very smooth. Initially, Shi Yu thought that he would have to give Baby Ginseng some recovery items. Just shrinking, Absolute Sleep, the storage beam, and the Earth Chain might not necessarily be able to catch up to the consumption, but once it broke through, its energy immediately became rich.
The amount of supplements that could be provided with thousands of energy points at that time was completely different from the amount of supplements that could be provided with tens of thousands of energy points now.
The process of nutritional supplements from proficiency to perfect proficiency didn’t have any special changes, which affected their quality and shelf life.
However, after reaching transcendent level proficiency, the nutrition produced by the ginseng baby was upgraded to “growable supplements”.
It could absorb the power of the outside world over time and enrich itself, even breaking through the limit. The longer it was kept, the higher the nutritional value.
This was a divine skill, but Shi Yu felt that it was a pity that the growth speed was limited. He had to collect it for ten, hundred, or even a thousand years to have an obvious increase.
Shi Yu couldn’t wait that long. Unless, he could transmigrate back to hundreds of millions of years ago. When the time came, he would bury some supplements for himself. When he returned and dug them out, he would directly become an Undying God of Medicine. That would be awesome.
At that time, when the divine medicine was used again, forget about transcending skills, even divine-level skills would be randomly selected.
After the nutritional supplement skill reached “Dao Proficiency”, apart from the better quality and faster absorption of nutrition from the outside world, the additional property surprised Shi Yu.
The nutritional supplements produced by the ginseng baby, according to the power it provided, were none other than to help the foodie treat, recover energy, and provide growth nutrition.
And now, after the nutritional proficiency “Dao Proficiency”, according to the feedback of the baby ginseng, the nutrients were affected by the “Fruit of Life” and its corresponding skill “Source of Life”, which it ate. It seemed to have an additional effect that could increase the pet’s life force and level of life!
In other words, having more could increase one’s lifespan, then increase the potential of the pet race and increase the effect of evolution aptitude!
The specific effect was similar to the evolution holy spring that Eleven had entered. However, due to the restriction on the current baby ginseng’s strength, the increase in effect was definitely not as powerful as the evolution holy spring under the care of the Ancient Life Tree King!
But this was undoubtedly… also a very impressive effect. After Baby Ginseng became a Mythical creature, its skill was an evolution specialist. One bit of nutrient could directly allow other low-rank pets to complete evolution!
“Holy shit.”
Shi Yu sat on the bed in a daze and looked at the crying baby ginseng opposite him.
“This ability is so awesome, why are you crying?”
Generally speaking, this kind of nutritional supplement that increased vitality and changed the potential of his race would become worse and worse as he used it multiple times. But even so, Shi Yu felt that he was invincible. With Baby Ginseng around, wouldn’t he be able to live for a long time?
Even if it was Buggy, if it ate nutrients now, it might not be a problem to live for another two years.
Moreover, this effect could also be increased over time.
Now, Shi Yu really had the urge to transmigrate back to the ancient times to bury treasures for himself.
“Yi…”
Baby Ginseng cried. It was powerful, but it felt that only transcendent-level, commander-level, and monarch-level ferocious beasts coveted it. But now, it felt that even overlord-level and totem-level ferocious beasts might want to eat it!
After all, compared to the nutritional supplements produced by the Nutritional Skill, its own body was the best nutritional supplement. The effects of nutritional supplements could also be eaten by it, and it would be better.
Shi Yu :”…”
“It’s not a big problem, not a big problem. Now that you’ve almost added all your supplement skills, you can increase your attack skills with all your might… At that time, when you’re stronger, no one can eat you!”
“Sob.” Baby Ginseng still didn’t feel safe, but Shi Yu was right. It needed to quickly change its profession to a battle ginseng to feel safer.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Why are you “crying” like Eleven? I’m hitting one crying monster after another. You’re supposed to be happy after all these upgrades… You’re really getting to be like Eleven…” Shi Yu thought.
< Name > Ginseng Baby
[Attributes]: Wood
[Race Level]: Low Class Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Skill]: Sweet Air (Dao Proficiency), Slow Healing (transcendent), High Speed Healing (Perfect), Nutrition (Dao Proficiency), Earth Chain (transcendent), Origin of Life (Initiate), Multiplication (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Energy Fruit (Proficient), Energy Storage Beam (Expert)
Energy Points: 90001
At this moment, Shi Yu thought about Baby Ginseng’s attributes and fell into deep thought.
Its five racial skills, sweetness, slow healing, nutrition, Earth Chain, source of life… Apart from super skills, it had already been upgraded enough.
And its growth level had also reached commander rank.
Due to the fact that its racial skills had been raised too high and its foundation was too terrifying, although the baby ginseng was judged by Grandma Li as a low-level monarch race in the beginning, its current supplement effect was probably not inferior to the supplements of those overlord races at all.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng’s energy level had already overtaken Eleven… to 90,000 points.
It was almost half of the minimum energy requirement of monarch level’s “two hundred thousand energy points”.
Transcendent races at the monarch level were usually around 200,000. Commander races at the monarch level were usually around 500,000. Monarch races at the monarch level were usually around 1,000,000.
Shi Yu felt that with the energy supplement of Baby Ginseng, perhaps there was hope for Eleven to give the weakest monarch-level pets a little bit of trouble?
However, the problem was that there were really too few people who relied on extraordinary races to reach the monarch level. There were very few. Generally, those who could reach the monarch level had at least a commander race, so it was still a long way to go.
In fact, Shi Yu felt that it would take a long time for Baby Ginseng and Eleven to become monarchs.
Judging from their situation, if they maxed out the skills of low, mid, and high-level races, they might not necessarily reach the level of monarchs.
It probably still depended on the development of super skills…
However… Even if Shi Yu’s physique had reached its limit again and wasn’t inferior to any master-level Beast Tamer’s physique, it still hadn’t reached the condition to teach super skills. This made Shi Yu feel very uncomfortable.
However, when he thought of the power of transcendent skills such as plant control, Inner Power, and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, he endured it. Shi Yu estimated that if these transcendent skills reached perfection and advanced into the path, they might really be able to come into contact with domains at the level of “law” and “origin”.
“Alright, it’s finally over.”
“Baby Ginseng, make the best perfume, spices, and nutrition fruits. I’ll rest for a while. Later, we’ll take the goods to exchange for Buggy’s evolution materials… If we don’t go and exchange now, it’ll be so depressing.”
Shi Yu lay on the bed. He was tired and weak.
“And Buggy, tidy up your worm silk too. It’s messy and can’t be sold.”
“Yi! (Copy!)” Baby Ginseng looked at Buggy.
Buggy was silent.
“Ji!” Buggy was also lying on the worm silk.
How could it not be depressed? Now, the leader had more than 80,000 energy points, the baby ginseng was 90,000, and it…
Three thousand!!! Three thousand!!! Only three thousand!! Did they know how it spent its day in depression!!
When would it evolve? It should quickly change races. It didn’t want to be a Green Silkworm anymore. This race was too lousy.. It had never seen a race that was even worse than a Green Silkworm. It was even worse than a Radish Baby!

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - Exchange for Evolution Materials
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Exchange for Evolution Materials
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the resource warehouse of Ancient Capital University.
In order to prepare the evolution materials for Buggy, Shi Yu came again!
This time, he came prepared.
Apart from the huge sum of 130 million yuan, there were also three large boxes of supreme-grade worm silk, ten supreme-grade spiritual fruits, and five supreme-grade fragrance bags.
For the time being, Shi Yu only had time to prepare this. He just didn’t know how much the latter could be sold for…
“The best news now is that the nutrition produced by the ginseng baby can increase its race’s potential and change its evolution aptitude!”
On the way, Shi Yu was in a good mood.
Although it was impossible for the Ginseng Baby’s nutrition to upgrade Eleven due to the limitation of the nutritional level and its own racial potential and evolution aptitude, it was more than enough to increase the potential of the Green Silkworm, which was only low-level transcendent at the moment.
It could be said that among the evolution materials of the worm, a large number of baby ginseng nutrients were locked.
This thing that could increase one’s lifespan and increase one’s racial potential was too suitable for the Green silkworm with an extremely short lifespan and huge potential.
Shi Yu did not have to worry about his evolution potential for the time being. Therefore, next, he only needed to find suitable spiritual and spatial resources for the worm to stabilize its evolutionary attributes.
His current goal… was to spend 300 million yuan.
There was no need to compare the value of the evolution materials with Eleven. This was really not decided by the amount of money, but by the compatibility.
Moreover, there was basically only one way for the green worm to use evolution materials.
Eat.
If the level of the evolution materials was too high and there were too many of them, the Green silkworms would explode. After all, the body of the Green silkworm was too weak.
Therefore, generally speaking, after the Green Silkworm finished eating the evolution materials, it would immediately use its racial talent to form a cocoon, transferring the huge amount of nutrients and energy that it couldn’t absorb onto the cocoon, and slowly absorb it, letting this energy change its body and complete its evolution.
Ordinary green silk bugs could only use level three and four evolution materials.
However, Shi Yu’s goal was to lock onto higher-level materials. This was also because the level of the worm silk was high enough and its growth level was high enough. It could absorb more energy and nutrition.
If it were another green worm, it would be very difficult to replicate such a magnificent feat.
“There are quite a lot of people today…”
Unlike the previous time, there were many people near the resource warehouse.
After all, school was about to start soon. Whether it was the new students or the older students, they had already come to school.
At this time period, the end of the first semester, was the time when the resource bank was the most lively.
At the entrance of the resource bank, in the small house that looked like a security room, Shi Yu took a few looks and couldn’t find the overlord-level gem cat.
However, a female teacher was sitting at the reception desk lazily, yawning as she helped the students register.
After Shi Yu saw that there were no students around the female teacher, he quickly registered and went straight to the Appraiser Building.
This was the place where students sold various rare materials to exchange for credits.
After arriving, his gaze swept across the dazzling and spacious hall.
It was a coincidence. When Shi Yu arrived, it was cold and quiet. A bespectacled teacher with sparse hair received Shi Yu directly.
Behind the appraisal table, the bespectacled teacher smiled at Shi Yu, who was wearing a mask and hat.
This child was really hiding his face. Why did it feel like he had won the lottery?
No, it even looked like the bad guy in the TV series who sold stolen goods…
“Hello. I’m exchanging materials.”
“What type? Take it out.”
He looked at the backpack Shi Yu was carrying.
“The first is this.”
Shi Yu took out the worm silk sample from his backpack.
As for the more boxes of worm silk, they were in the ruins.
At this moment, on the appraisal platform, in an exquisite jade box, a layer of transparent insect silk was neatly placed.
After the worm silk reached the maximum level, its color could be white, its texture could be transparent, and it could be completely invisible. All of this depended on its mood. As for its nature, it wouldn’t change.
“Transparent silk…”
“Transcendent level?!” The appraiser saw the materials in the box and asked, “What kind of pet is it?”
The Green Silkworm wasn’t the only species that knew worm silk skills. This teacher hadn’t realized the seriousness of the problem.
“Green Silkworm.”
The teacher was speechless.
What the hell?
That low-level transcendent race with a pitiful short lifespan?
“Teacher, it’s a king of green worms that has awakened a special bloodline and mastered deterrence. It has reached the transcendent level.”
“In its life, it has absorbed rare spatial resources such as the Space Crystal Fruit and the Space Spirit Flower, which are worth one billion, and shaped the worm silk into a supreme-grade spatial worm silk that exceeds perfection.”
“And these are the few high-quality threads that it took a long time to condense. Each of them contains extremely special power, is strong, and has strange effects. Not only can it break skills such as air defense concealment, but it can also break the illusionary ability of a legendary Beast Tamer at will.”
“Even if it’s a quasi-monarch species that evolved, it can’t even survive one move from its insect silk.”
Shi Yu’s tone was deep as he explained in detail.
“Rare in the world, unique!”
“Huh?” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the teacher opposite was stunned.
Was this guy really not kidding?
Special bloodline, transcendent-level Green silkworm? A spatial worm silk formed from a billion worth of spatial resources?
Bullshit!
The teacher was about to refute, but suddenly, Shi Yu took off his mask and hat.
When he saw Shi Yu’s face, the teacher cursed in his heart.
He suddenly felt that it might be true.
This was because he knew Shi Yu. He also knew Shi Yu’s Green Silkworm.
The vocation assessment had not even been a month. This teacher from Ancient Capital University naturally knew that there was a magical Green Silkworm in the first place of this year’s Ancient Capital vocation assessment.
Just now… he didn’t expect it!
“Student Shi Yu…” The appraiser cried. Holy shit, what he said was true.
It was clearly real, so why did he have a ridiculous feeling just now?
Speaking of which, it turned out that such a worm silk was cultivated with one billion resources.
No wonder it was so strong. So that was the reason.
He believed it…
“Teacher, how much can it be estimated?”
Shi Yu said, “You should know how powerful the worm silk of this Green Silkworm is.”
“It can simulate sword aura from afar, go deep, and snatch the parasitic Gu from within a controlled puppet corpse. It can even do advertisements. It’s invincible.”
Shi Yu had to brag.
Because the growth level of the Green Silkworm was too low. Even if its worm silk proficiency exploded, the worm silk it made was not a high-level resource. It could only be said to be a super rare resource.
“This…” The appraiser’s forehead was covered in sweat. He was also someone with an “appraisal index”. He was confirming the value of the worm silk through the appraising glasses index.
To be honest, it was very difficult to estimate the value of this rare super resource.
“How much do you have?”
As the appraisal teacher was analyzing, on the side of the appraisal table, a big white cat that was as soft as a doll, big, and had a V-shaped head and smooth fur jumped up from somewhere and walked towards the worm silk.
Its fluffy tail swayed. After walking to the worm silk, its sky-blue gem eyes stared straight at the box of worm silk. Good stuff!!
Although the material level was a little low, and according to the energy level, it was only level three, it had never seen a worm silk of such quality!!
If the worm silk was also divided into racial levels…
Then, the worm silk Shi Yu took out was comparable to a mythical race in its eyes!!
The evaluation of resources depended on the energy level, not the rarity, but the energy level did not represent the final value.
The value of resources was determined by energy, nutritional level, function, and rarity.
This was also why some low-level spatial materials and dragon-element materials were more expensive than high-level resources.
As for the worm silk, it was almost equivalent to a level-three spatial resource, but the powerful thing was that its rarity was peerless!
Now, looking at this box of level-three worm silk, the gem cat was tempted.
The level didn’t matter. It was mainly rare and had extremely high collection value!
“Teacher Yao.” The white gem cat appeared, and the appraiser and Shi Yu greeted it.
The guardian of Ancient Capital University, the overlord-level gem cat that had lived for more than a hundred years was here!
“How much do you want?” Shi Yu kicked the question back.
He could make as much as he wanted.
“You have a lot?” The overlord gem cat screen recalled Shi Yu. Wasn’t this the boy with the ruins space from before?
Its ears twitched, and the hair on its neck that looked like a “scarf” stretched out. “Follow me, we’ll talk inside.”
“Alright!” Shi Yu was excited.
Initially, he had come to the resource bank with the intention of looking for this person. Now, he didn’t expect that the other party would take the initiative to come to him.
Under the teacher’s confused expression, Shi Yu followed the gem cat without any reluctance.
“Good heavens…” The appraiser looked at their backs and muttered.
The materials for sale had caught the attention of the overlord cat?
This time, Shi Yu should be rich!
This billionaire gem cat cost much more than the school!
…
In the Appraiser Hall.
Facing the gem cat, which he didn’t know whether it was its clone or its main body, Shi Yu took out the three large boxes of worm silk that Buggy had spent a lot of effort to condense.
This kind of resource-level exquisite worm silk was even more tiring than manufacturing it in battle. It couldn’t be vomited out just like that. In two days, Buggy ate a pile of nutrients provided by the ginseng baby to create this much.
“Meow…” Seeing this worm silk, the overlord gem cat was stunned.
It was as if it could see a drained Green Silkworm through the worm silk.
(Buggy: I really don’t have any left…)
“Any more?”
“The worm silk is gone for the time being, but there are other materials I plan to exchange with.”
Shi Yu also took out the spiritual fruit made by the ginseng baby to combine the sweet aura with the nutrients.
This spiritual fruit used the full-level sweet aura and nutritional supplements skill. It was a combination of the two.
As for the smell, because it was originally prepared for this overlord gem cat with a goal, Shi Yu and the others chose the gem cat race’s favorite “gem mint” spiritual plant as the main scent and integrated the other three flavors that the gem cat liked, allowing their characteristics to be perfectly preserved.
This was a delicious spiritual fruit with a very high-level aura.
Of course, the attraction effect of the sweet aura was definitely many times stronger than the aura of the original plant!
Shi Yu placed a green fruit on the table. Initially, Shi Yu only wanted to give it what it liked and sell it for more money… However, the sudden change stunned Shi Yu.
Boom!!!
A huge aura erupted from the gem cat. Shi Yu took a step back in confusion. He saw the gem cat’s eyes brighten. After smelling the aura, it looked at the fruit in surprise!!
“Meow!!!! (Yay!!! It’s delicious!!)” The overlord’s gem cat paw immediately pressed on the green fruit. Its gaze was excited, and saliva flowed down the corners of its mouth.
“This, this is…” It asked Shi Yu.
“A special nutritional substance.”
Shi Yu didn’t expect the other party to have such a big reaction. He felt that he had underestimated the attraction of the super nutritional fruits created by the ginseng baby…
Although according to energy classification, this was only a level-four resource, it seemed that the special effect of the full-level sweet aura and full-level nutritional supplements was enough to increase its temptation by several levels to specific people!
“It can increase the pet’s life force, change its evolution aptitude, relieve fatigue, and let the consumer enter a state of meditation and calmness.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the gem cat did not hear much.
“It’s edible?”
“It’s edible…”
“How much is there? I want this too.”
The gem cat patted the fruit. Although it felt that the nutritional value inside couldn’t increase it at all, it was so fragrant. With such a nutritional-level spiritual fruit coupled with this taste, it almost couldn’t help but swallow it directly.
“Wait, where did you get this?” It looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “My pet.”
“Meow!!!” The overlord gem cat exploded. You’re telling me you can produce this thing??
“Teacher, if you like it, I’ll send you one every month,” Shi Yu said generously.
Gem Cat:???
One?
Did this guy think it was a stray cat? It’s a gem cat!
“…How about 30 a month?” If it could eat such fruits every day, the gem cat felt that its cat life had reached its peak.
30?
Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched.
It wasn’t easy for Baby Ginseng to create this either…
“Of course, I won’t freeload.”
“Are you in a hurry to get credits by exchanging these?” The cat licked its claws gracefully like a lady.
“Pets just happen to need an evolution ingredient.”
The gem cat said, “I understand. I’ve collected a lot of materials in my private warehouse. There are all levels 1 to 8. You can also take any materials from the school’s resource bank in the future. I’ll reimburse you. In the future, you’ll send me some of these spiritual fruits every month. How about that?”
“Of course, take whatever you lack. Don’t take away all the high-level materials in one go, or it’ll be difficult to explain to the school. Moreover, my little vault is less than ten billion.”
The gem cat looked at the green fruit and told itself that money was just a worldly possession. Cats valued food above all.
At this moment, Shi Yu was stunned.
That worked too???
He originally only wanted to sell some resources, exchange some money and credits, and then buy evolution materials…
Now, the gem cat told him that it could choose any materials from the school’s resource warehouse and the overlord gem cat’s private warehouse. It would reimburse it?
He only had to provide this kind of spiritual fruit every month?
Shi Yu was at a loss. He calculated this transaction in his heart and once again felt that he had underestimated the attraction of the spiritual fruits created by the full-level sweet aura and full-level nutritional combination skill to specific pets.
In addition, this transaction was definitely worth it. This was because although it required a lot of physical strength to create such an attractive-level spiritual fruit, it could freeload energy from nature. In addition, if all the resources could be reimbursed, Shi Yu could immediately replenish the energy consumed by the ginseng baby with enough energy crystals.
Therefore, this was basically a free deal.
“How is it?!” Seeing that Shi Yu was silent, the gem cat asked again.
“No problem.” With that said, Shi Yu hurriedly took out the remaining nine spiritual fruits, afraid that the gem cat would regret it.
Seeing the ten spiritual fruits, the gem cat’s eyes lit up.
“You’re not bad. You’re the most promising student I’ve seen in more than a hundred years. In the future, I’ll protect you at Ancient Capital University.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Seemed like he had a big shot to protect him now.
Also, this was a cat. Although it was female, it shouldn’t be considered a rich woman like the others…
However, this gem cat was really too much… Was this a cat or a dragon…
“Crack.” At this moment, the gem cat had already used its mental strength to control a green fruit to float in front of it. It took a bite and chewed it patiently. Its face was filled with happiness and a little regret. Unfortunately, it was too strong now. If it had eaten this kind of spiritual fruit before the monarch level, it would have been even happier.
“~ ~” After eating a spiritual fruit in a few bites, the gem cat was a little intoxicated. After it savored it again, it confirmed that it wasn’t wrong. This spiritual fruit was indeed delicious, even more delicious than the level-seven and level-eight resources it had eaten.
It could almost be said to be the most perfect food it had ever eaten.
“Choose it yourself. The list in the black folder is the materials from the school’s resource bank. The white folder contains the materials I collected.” The gem cat summoned a laptop out of thin air and flew in front of Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu trembled slightly. He didn’t expect everything to go so smoothly.
It meant that not only did he not have to spend the pile of credits in the card, but he could also directly take away a pile of evolution materials?
“Buggy, if you don’t evolve into a quasi overlord race, you’ll be letting Baby Ginseng and me down…”

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - Spiritual Space Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Spiritual Space Dragon
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“How do I assemble it…”
Shi Yu opened the two folders that the gem cat had mentioned.
In the resource warehouse of Ancient Capital University, the best spiritual-type resource was the Nine-Tailed Illusion Fox Heart.
The best spatial resource was the Tears of the Void.
Unfortunately, neither of them was suitable for Buggy.
One was the heart of a nine-tailed fox, while the other was the eye of a Void Worm. Both were difficult to absorb, and the compatibility was not high.
From ancient times until now, the evolution materials used to evolve the Green Silkworm were basically plants.
If it were other things, it wasn’t impossible, but the absorption effect was definitely not the best.
This was like the Iron-eating Beast’s digestive system. It was clearly easier to digest metal minerals, but if the Beast Tamer just had to feed it rock minerals. There would definitely be a problem…
“I have to have the Dream Fruit.”
After taking a few looks, Shi Yu locked onto a plant resource in the Ancient Capital University’s resource bank. He had long decided on this.
[Name]: Dream Fruit
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Level]: Level 7
[Main Use Introduction]: The fruit of the Illusion Tree blooms every 30 years and bears fruit every 30 years. It will only mature in another 30 years and can only be eaten in 100 years. The Illusion Tree is the king of the Illusion Domain and can pull its prey into the Dream World. In the Dream World, it can create illusions identical to the hypnotized person and let them fight the hypnotized person. Its fruit can greatly increase the resistance and proficiency of the eater towards illusion skills.
[Exchange Price]: 11,000 credits
“You.” Shi Yu marked it.
Although this fruit wasn’t as rare as the Nine-Tailed Illusion Fox Heart and was mass-produced, it was still a plant and was more compatible with Buggy.
In addition, the ability of the Illusion Tree was too fragrant.
If Buggy inherited a similar ability, together with the phantom illusion skill, it could more perfectly materialize dream illusions.
At that time, not only could it fight enemies in the dream, but it could also perfectly summon the dream phantom to reality.
Unfortunately, this plant creature was the same as the Dream Shell. There were only a handful of them in the world. Shi Yu had no place to go and steal and replicate skills.
“100 million…” Shi Yu calculated in his heart.
Just one fruit was worth hundreds of millions.
Resources above level-seven were basically not worth less than 100 million. He was already mentally prepared.
There was only one Illusion Fruit in the inventory, so he decided on one for the time being.
Next, Shi Yu searched for spatial resources.
In the resource bank of Ancient Capital University, there were actually not many spatial resources of higher levels and plants. After careful consideration, Shi Yu chose the root of the hollow tree.
[Name]: Grotto Tree Root
[Attributes]: Space
[Attributes]: Space
[Main Use Introduction]: The root of the Grotto-Heaven Tree. The Grotto-Heaven Tree is a spiritual plant that contains spatial power. Its body is an independent small world that can store anything except life…
This was also a resource that could increase spatial talent.
Apart from that, the grotto-heaven tree roots could also expand the size of the Beast Taming Space. Humans could also use it, so its value was even higher than the Dream Fruit. Unfortunately, it couldn’t increase the strength and environment of the Beast Taming Space. Otherwise, Shi Yu would want to eat it himself.
“You’re done?”
Shi Yu hesitated for a long time on the resource table.
At this moment, the gem cat couldn’t help but eat three fruits.
After eating, it asked Shi Yu.
“Not yet, not yet…”
He knew that he had to choose more. Otherwise, it would become a losing deal.
Shi Yu looked at the gem cat’s private warehouse and was shocked.
The value of resources was not much inferior to the resource warehouse of Ancient Capital University.
However, what was speechless was that the resources it collected were almost all pearls, gems, and strange stones…
[Name]: Soul Pearl
[Attributes]: Undead
[Level]: Level-eight resource
< Introduction > It’s a pearl that seals the soul of Undead at overlord rank.
Good lord, did the gem cat obtain this item by itself?
[Name]: Holy Light Gem
[Attributes]: Light
[Level]: Level-seven resource
[Introduction]: The core crystal of the elemental life form, the Holy Tree.
The dazzling resources stunned Shi Yu for a moment.
However, because more than 90% of the resources here were gems, pearls, and strange stones… This was very unsuitable.
Buggy couldn’t really absorb those.
“By the way, this gem cat likes gemstones so much. Why does it want to collect worm silk?”
“Does it want to roll it into a ball to play?” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
Also, Shi Yu wanted to know if the gem cat counted these fixed assets when it mentioned its assets.
Next, Shi Yu looked for a long time but couldn’t find any evolution materials suitable for Buggy.
Just as he was thinking that the Illusionary Dream Fruit and the Grotto-Heaven Tree’s roots were almost good enough, and that Buggy wouldn’t be able to absorb anything more, a resource attracted Shi Yu’s attention.
[Name]: Dragon Ball
[Attributes]: Dragon
[Level]: Level 4
[Introduction]: The intrinsic Dragon Ball of the unknown dragon race. Because it has been too long, its energy has been lost. It has no effect of changing its race, but it can effectively increase the pet’s racial potential and evolution aptitude, making its physique comparable to that of the dragon race.
Dragon Ball!
This was something only purebred dragons had, and it was also the most precious thing of dragon creatures. In addition, it was also one of the rarest resources!
After any creature absorbed the complete Dragon Ball, it had a chance to obtain the dragon race bloodline and make its physique comparable to a dragon!
For subspecies dragons, swallowing a dragon ball was one of the few opportunities for them to evolve into purebred dragons.
Shi Yu was really happy to discover the Dragon Ball.
Because the body of the bug type was too weak, the dragon ball could effectively change this weakness!
The Green Silkworm’s body was very weak, and it was the same even if it evolved into a butterfly. Take Yin Zhengfan’s Space Crystal Butterfly for example. Although its race level was very high, that was purely judged because its racial skills were strong.
In terms of energy value and vitality, it was inferior to the commander race’s ginseng fruit tree. In terms of physical strength, it might even be inferior to wild iron-eating beasts that had yet to evolve. It was a classic example of a high attack with weak defense.
However, if he used the dragon ball, he could completely change this situation effectively.
One of the uses of the Dragon Ball was to make the physique and life force of the absorber become incomparably strong, comparable to the dragons!
The rarity of the Dragon Ball far exceeded resources like the dragon scale or even the reverse scale. It even exceeded spatial resources of the same level. Only time resources could suppress the Dragon Ball.
The only pity was that this dragon ball was a defective product. Its energy level had fallen to level four, and it no longer had much of the original effect of the dragon ball. It could only increase the physique.
“But it’s just right. If the level is too high, it couldn’t be absorbed by Buggy anyway. Even now, it might be a little difficult.”
Shi Yu browsed through it again and looked at the gem cat.
“Excuse me, can I have these four resources?”
Shi Yu looked at the gem cat who was eating the fourth fruit. He labeled the three resources “Dream Fruit”, “Grotto-Heaven Tree Root”, and “Dragon Ball”. Apart from that, there was also a pretty high-level “level-seven wood-element energy crystal”.
The last resource was to charge the ginseng baby.
Without this, it was very difficult to pay this overlord gem cat…
“Uh…” The gem cat looked over.
When it saw the Illusion Fruit, the Grotto-Heaven Tree Root, both level-seven wood-element energy crystal, it nodded indifferently.
When it saw the “dragon ball”, it pondered for a moment and froze.
Because it liked this blue dreamy dragon ball very much.
Moreover, it had yet to figure out which dragon this blue dragon ball belonged to, and its curiosity had yet to be satisfied…
“Forget it, curiosity kills the cat. Spirit fruits are better.”
Although it liked it very much, after thinking about it, the spiritual fruit was indeed better.
“Take it, take it, take it all.” It waved its claws.
However, it was too much for Shi Yu to take away resources worth 500 million at once.
It had to find a way to squeeze it back. It couldn’t lose out.
“Thank you.”
Shi Yu smiled and moved away. He didn’t plan to take more this time. He would stop when he was satisfied.
He planned to come back the next time Baby Ginseng wanted to evolve.
When it was time for evolution of low-level monarch races, there would definitely be more evolution materials needed.
However, at that time, the gem cat probably wouldn’t refuse.
After all, if Baby Ginseng evolved, the spiritual fruits it made would be even more delicious…
“I’ll get my clone to get the goods for you. Remember to send a new spiritual fruit on the first of next month. By the way, what’s the name of this fruit?” the gem cat said.
Wasn’t the first day of the next month the day after tomorrow? Shi Yu was stunned.
Fortunately, he had the foresight to take an additional energy crystal. Otherwise, the ginseng baby would die!
“There’s no name yet. Let me think. Why don’t we call it the Gem Fruit?” Shi Yu said.
The profundity of Sweet Aura+Nutrition, Gem Fruit.
It meant that every single one of them was as precious as a gem and could bring huge wealth to the Beast Tamer. Perfect. He was really a genius at naming things.
Shi Yu was already considering whether he should use the gem fruit to bribe the little female dragon in the snow mountain.
As a dragon that had lived for more than two thousand years, it should have a lot of collections.
This cat had only lived for a hundred years, but it was already so rich. That dragon was the one who had helped Emperor Shi conquer the world. No matter what… its wealth couldn’t be underestimated.
“Gem Fruit.” When the gem cat heard that, it immediately felt that Shi Yu was very smart. It ordered its clone to quickly go and get the resources.
At this moment, the clones in the resource warehouse felt that their main body was being too ridiculous.
It ate the good stuff while they worked. They would remember this…
“Meow—”
…
…
Half an hour later.
In the student dormitory.
Shi Yu returned excitedly.
Illusionary Dream Fruit, Grotto-Heaven Tree Root, Dragon Ball… The day the worm evolved was today!
If it were an ordinary Beast Tamer, they definitely wouldn’t dare to be so crazy.
The Beast Taming Space was only level three, but it had already contracted two commander-level pets. It also had to support an evolution body in the form of a cocoon. It would wait to be drained dry.
However, Shi Yu, whose physique exceeded that of a master-level Beast Tamer and who had contracted a supplement pet that had mastered two perfect supplement skills, was very arrogant.
“Is this considered half a Beast Taming Space strengthening talent?”
After Shi Yu returned, he entered the ruins space smugly.
At this moment.
In the ruins space.
Eleven was practicing flying. Because of the foundation of the Thunder Palm and the special hardening nature, it had only evolved for a short while, but it had already become very proficient in electromagnetic levitation.
