As for Baby Ginseng, it entered a shrunken state. It rooted itself and absorbed light energy, recovering its energy with difficulty.
Shi Yu and those fruits had squeezed it dry.
As for Buggy…
It was a classic scene. Buggy was sleeping.
It was unknown if it was training or daydreaming.
Yesterday, Buggy daydreamed for the whole day. It dreamed that it had evolved, but unfortunately, it was fake.
In the words of Buggy, it was accumulating evolution experience in the dream in advance. When it really evolved, it would be much smoother.
“Where’s Buggy?”
“I bought the evolution materials back.”
Shi Yu left the ten gem fruits and three boxes of worm silk for the gem cat and brought back a pile of evolution materials.
“Ji…” As if it had heard Shi Yu’s thoughts, Buggy woke up from its sleep and teleported to Shi Yu’s side.
Moreover, it looked at Shi Yu with anticipation.
Evolution materials?
Wherever it was.W
“Wuu.”
In the distant sky, Eleven realized that Shi Yu had returned. It also flew over with an electromagnetic levitation, planning to watch the commotion.
As for Baby Ginseng, as the current second in the team, it wanted to observe the situation of the worm. If the worm’s evolution exceeded it, that would be uncomfortable.
“Ji!!! (Evolution! Evolution! Evolution!)”
When Eleven and Baby Ginseng rushed over, they saw Buggy shouting excitedly.
However…
“Although I’ve bought the materials, you can’t evolve yet,” Shi Yu said.
Buggy:???
Baby Ginseng was amused. Buggy was so miserable.
“You have to eat the nutritional fruits that the ginseng baby created to increase your racial potential and evolution aptitude first. After eating them until they lose their effectiveness, then we can let you evolve. This way, the evolution effect will definitely be better.”
“During this period, I also want to upgrade your spatial shackles skill to Perfect Level. At that time, with the two perfect high-level skills, spatial shackles and phantom illusions, you will be able to break out of the cocoon easier. It will be more stable.”
“Baby Ginseng, I’ll leave it to you.”
Baby Ginseng:???
“Ji.” Buggy was amused. Sure, sure, no hurry.
Baby Ginseng:???
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng frowned. It really didn’t have a single drop of energy left.
Shi Yu chuckled and took out a level-seven wood-element energy crystal. “It’s not a big problem. I even exchanged for this. Even if you grow and break through to the monarch level, the energy inside won’t be so easy to absorb.”
“With this, not only can you recover your energy at a high speed at any time, your growth speed will also be much faster.”
Shi Yu had no choice. If he didn’t exchange for this and just relied on the energy recovered from its natural strength for free, Baby Ginseng might not necessarily be able to support him, Eleven, Buggy, and the Gem Cat at the same time…
He still had to spend money!
“Yi—”
At that moment, when it saw the level-seven wood-element energy crystal, the ginseng baby was stunned. It sensed the huge wood-element life force inside. It swallowed its saliva and nodded.
He should have said so earlier.
This was the most attractive resource for it apart from the Fruit of Life.
With this, there would be plenty of nutritional supplements and sweetness.
Then, Shi Yu took out the Illusion Fruit, the Grotto-Heaven Tree’s roots, and the Dragon Ball and informed the Green Silkworm of the effect.
Spirit, space, dragon… It just happened to satisfy all the requirements of Buggy.
Buggy’s eyes lit up. It couldn’t wait anymore. However, before absorbing these cocoons, it would increase its evolution potential in advance through the nutrition of the ginseng baby!
“Ji!! (Baby Ginseng, let me see your limit!!)” It looked at the baby ginseng holding the wood-element energy crystal and urged crazily. Quick! Quick! Quick!

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - Buggy Evolved Too
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Buggy Evolved Too
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
A day later.
[Name]: Green Silkworm
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Dao Proficiency), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Illusory Phantom (Perfect), Deterrence (Proficient), Super Sight (Expert), High Speed Healing (Proficient), Space Shackles (Perfect), Instant Transmission (Expert), Concealment (Expert)
[Energy Points]: 4399
After spending a day, the Green Silkworm with an energy value of more than 3,000 previously underwent a complete transformation under the modification of Shi Yu and the ginseng baby.
Although it was still lousy.
Even if Shi Yu raised Buggy’s high-level spatial skill to Perfect Level, even if Baby Ginseng created nine full-level nutritional fruits to change Buggy’s evolution aptitude… Buggy’s energy value still couldn’t double.
It only increased by a third.
At this moment, after continuously absorbing nine nutritional fruits that could increase his racial potential, change his evolution aptitude, and increase his lifespan, this fruit had gradually lost its effect on the worm.
It looked like no matter how much it improved, it was very difficult for the worm to match an overlord race with the ‘Green Silkworm Body’.
“It’s alright, it’s alright…”
Shi Yu was still relatively calm.
The Green Silkworm was the weakest pet race in the first place. Even the Dragon Carp, which was a weakling in the pet world, was stronger than it. Shi Yu was already very satisfied that it could have its current energy level.
In addition, the most special thing about the Green Silkworm was that its racial potential was huge.
Very few pets could increase more than the Green Silkworm after evolution.
The weakness before evolution was only for the rise after evolution.
This was related to the green worm’s special evolution method.
The other pets evolved in an instant.
The evolution materials they used were rarely used perfectly.
It was either hidden in the body or lost, but it was definitely not the strongest state where it had perfectly absorbed the power of the evolution materials.
The evolution of the Green Silkworm Race was an exception.
They first turned into cocoons and then fell into a deep sleep. They experienced the baptism of the evolution power for at least a month and almost perfectly absorbed the power of the evolution materials before completing the evolution.
In the cocoon state, the Green Silkworm’s absorption rate of nutrition for evolution materials was also among the best among all pets.
Therefore, after the worm evolved, it would definitely be reborn to the greatest extent. Shi Yu looked forward to the day when the worm woke up from its slumber and broke out of its cocoon to become a butterfly.
“Ji…”
After feeling that it had reached another “bottleneck” state, Buggy ran over pitifully.
It could eat evolution materials to turn into a cocoon.
It couldn’t wait anymore.
“Then let’s begin.”
Shi Yu had also worked hard for the whole day, but he was surprisingly energetic at the moment.
Just now, he had also eaten a weakened version of the nutritional fruit created by the ginseng baby. Now, he felt like he had returned to his childhood and was extremely energetic.
Perhaps he had accidentally increased his lifespan by a year and a half just now…
Beautiful.
“Ji!!!”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s command, Buggy’s eyes filled with tears. It looked to both sides and suggested that Shi Yu call Baby Ginseng and the leader over.
Let them see its heroic bearing after its worm evolution.
Shi Yu :”…”
What’s the hurry?
During the evolution process, Buggy would be inside the cocoon, and it would sleep for a month. How could it be that fast?
Considering that Buggy used high-level evolution materials, it might be more than a month.
“Alright.” Shi Yu looked at Buggy’s excited expression and shook his head. He called Eleven and Baby Ginseng over to record it.
In the blink of an eye, everyone gathered.
These two guys arrived faster than Shi Yu imagined. Clearly, they also paid a lot of attention to Buggy’s evolution.
“Wuu!! (Coming, coming.)” Eleven came over with its cell phone.
Don’t worry about evolution, it will seriously take a video of it!
“Yi—(After eating so many of my nutrition fruits, it can’t be weak)” Baby Ginseng cried.
“Ji!!”
Faced with the encouragement of its two companions, the Green Silkworm’s expression was firm.
Then, it looked at the white Illusion Fruit, the brown grotto-heaven tree roots, and the blue Dragon Ball.
Buggy didn’t hesitate. It first ate the Dream Fruit in one go and quickly swallowed the grotto-heaven tree root.
In the end, it swallowed the glass bead-sized Dragon Ball into its stomach in one go.
During this process, Buggy felt a terrifying power slowly flowing out of the evolution materials it ate…
If it were other pets, even if it was a commander-level pet with a very strong physique that swallowed so many high-level materials, it would definitely explode at this moment.
However, due to the Green Silkworm’s special racial talent, “Cocoon Evolution”, this energy did not explode the worm immediately. Instead, it quickly flowed into the infinite worm silk in the worm’s body!!
“Ji!!”
At this moment, the worm looked up. White worm silk surged into the sky like angry waves.
The endless threads were dense and crisscrossed, covering the sky and sun. In an instant, they turned into a white sea of clouds in the sky.
Such a strange scene shocked Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
How much would this sell for!
Ordinary green worm evolution definitely didn’t have such a big scene.
Shi Yu had already expected the special scene that might occur when Buggy evolved.
However, he still underestimated everything.
At this moment, not only did Buggy spit out an incomparably huge worm silk, but the ground its body touched was also affected by an unknown effect, turning into a white line like a huge wave. The sky, the ground, and at this moment, Buggy, seemed to be in a world of white silk!
On the ground was a sea formed by lines with surging waves.
In the sky, there was a white sea of clouds that constantly surged and covered the sky.
Shi Yu had really never heard of such a shocking cocoon transformation.
In the next second, something unexpected happened.
After spitting out an unparalleled amount of worm silk, the worm finally began to form a cocoon.
Countless threads that approached its body began to quickly wrap around its body.
At the moment it was about to form the cocoon, Buggy looked at Shi Yu, Eleven, and Baby Ginseng. Whether it was a month or two, it had to wait for it…
When it thought about how it was going to turn into a cocoon and sleep for a long time, Buggy actually felt a little reluctant.
However, at the moment, the evolution path had already opened, and the transformation of the cocoon was already an irreversible fact.
Hu hu ~ ~
The worm silk wrapped the Green Silkworm bit by bit. Soon, it became a white cocoon lying motionless on the ground wrapped in white silk…
In the next moment.
The endless worm silk in the sky and ground began to transform into a white stream of light that surged into the cocoon with the cocoon as the core, as if the world had become light at this moment.
“Sob.” Why did Eleven feel that the scene of Buggy’s evolution was even more spectacular than its own?
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng looked at everything in a daze, very envious.
It already had a premonition that when the worm evolved and returned, it would definitely become the strongest.
A few seconds later.
The ruins were completely calm.
The worm silk that filled the sky had already disappeared.
There was only an oval cocoon the size of half an arm left.
This meant that even after breaking out of the cocoon and becoming a butterfly, the worm wouldn’t be very large.
It was still… concentrated with essence?
“It’s over…”
At that moment, as he looked at the sleeping cocoon, Shi Yu took a deep breath. He had already sensed that the worm had completely fallen asleep and was quietly waiting for evolution.
He just didn’t know how long it would take for it to break out of the cocoon.
At this moment, Shi Yu had a very strange feeling.
This feeling was like… he was an old father waiting for his pregnant wife for ten months?
He looked at Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
He wanted to ask if they felt this way.
But at this moment, he suddenly saw Eleven and Baby Ginseng’s eyes widen.
“Wuu!”
“Yi!”
They pointed at the cocoon and shouted, “Oh no, Buggy is dead!”
“Uh.” Shi Yu hurriedly looked at Buggy. Buggy didn’t die, so where did this corpse come from!
However, at this moment, there was indeed a change in its body.
Boom!!!!
The cocoon that was originally lying quietly on the ground suddenly erupted with soaring evolution light.
The scale of the white light was completely not inferior to the previous worm silk sea.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu’s mind went blank.
This…
Evolution light?
Damn…
After the green worm evolved, didn’t it have to experience at least a month of sleep to perfectly absorb the evolution power?
How could it be so fast…
It wasn’t just the evolution light. Just like when Eleven evolved, Buggy was still experiencing a breakthrough!!
The growth level also seemed to want to go from transcendent to commander rank!
In the index in front of Shi Yu, the energy value of the worm was jumping crazily!
“Gulp.”
Shi Yu gulped and was stunned. He didn’t expect so many changes to happen to the evolution of Buggy.
It didn’t make sense. Even if it had Absolute Sleep, it didn’t make sense for it to absorb the power of the evolution materials so quickly, right?
This was unscientific!
However…
“What form will it take?”
Shi Yu was certain that after Buggy evolved, it would definitely not be any known butterfly, moth, bee, or worm, but a new form, an evolution form that had never appeared.
This was the power of the DIY evolution path.
The white evolution light was extremely dazzling. Soon, it slowly retracted and condensed on the cocoon.
The evolved form of the worm slowly appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
At this moment, Eleven was silent.
Baby Ginseng was silent.
Shi Yu fell silent.
“Huh?”
“Yi?”
“Huh???”
Three stunned voices sounded.
Shi Yu raised his hand and pointed at the “Worm Evolution” in front of him with a stunned expression.
Because at this moment, the worm was still in the form of a cocoon, but compared to the completely sealed sleeping worm cocoon form just now, there were two more small holes. Buggy’s big eyes were observing everything outside…
Green Silkworm’s evolution… Green Silkworm’s cocoon?
“…” Buggy couldn’t make a sound at this moment, but Shi Yu and the others understood what it meant.
Just now, for some reason, the worm might have been affected by Absolute Sleep, Phantom Illusion, and other skills. After it turned into a cocoon and fell asleep, it could still retain its thoughts and not completely lose consciousness…
In the dream, it had just had the thought of looking outside when… its body… couldn’t help but evolve.
It evolved into a cocoon with eyes.
Moreover, it had awakened a new racial skill.
It could also feel that its evolution power had yet to completely disappear. It could still complete another evolution after sleeping for a period of time and completely absorbing the evolution power.
Buggy was confused by the changes in its body.
It had evolved, but not completely.
Shi Yu :”…”
F*ck.
What was this…
The Green Silkworm had this evolution form?
What should he call it now?
Green worm cocoon?
Ridiculous!
It felt that this form was even more terrible than the green worm form.
However, the current growth level and energy value of the Green Silkworm cocoon told Shi Yu how powerful the Green Silkworm cocoon was…
[Name]: Green Silkworm’s cocoon
[Race Level]:???
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Energy Points]: 23333
It had already exceeded the standard of commander-level pets. It had 20,000 energy points.
In other words, the current cocoon was very likely a special form of a bug type commander species?!
“Commander rank cocoon? This is ridiculous. This doesn’t make sense.”
Shi Yu didn’t know what to say.
The form of the cocoon was used for sleep and to absorb power, waiting for the worm to evolve.
But this bug first turned into a cocoon form and even broke through the growth level. It even awakened a new racial skill??
The new racial skill awakened by Buggy was the low-level spiritual skill, Psychic.
[Name]: Psychic
< Level > Low
< Introduction > It’s a spiritual skill. It can materialize spiritual power and form Psychokinesis that’s as agile as your hands and feet.
In the cocoon state, Buggy’s previous racial skill, Worm Silk, was temporarily sealed.
However, as if to compensate for it, it automatically awakened its Psychic skill and replaced the worm silk as its limbs…
Although the level of Psychic was low, it was definitely one of the best skills to use…
“Wuu…”” Yi…”
At this moment, Eleven and Baby Ginseng didn’t understand, but they were shocked.
Shi Yu didn’t understand either, but he was also quite shocked.
“Therefore, the current situation is that you can wake up now or continue sleeping.”
“After absorbing all the evolution power, you can still easily carry out the next stage of evolution,” Shi Yu said.
“Ji!!” Buggy nodded excitedly. That was what it meant.
It even felt that it could fight now!
The worm silk was sealed, but the other skills weren’t!
Commander species, commander rank cocoon, invincible!
Great!!
It looked at Shi Yu and the others, reminding them of something important.
Speaking of which, if it turned into a cocoon and became commander rank first, would there be a chance for its next evolution to directly evolve into an overlord race?
The evolution law couldn’t cross the level of the three major races at once, but the problem was that it wasn’t a transcendent race now, but a commander race!!
In theory, the upper limit race if it continued to evolve was an overlord, not a high-level monarch!
When Buggy finished speaking, Shi Yu and the others were stunned. An unimaginable path…
“You’re really a genius… This evolution… This evolution is worth it.” Shi Yu’s expression was strange. It seemed to be true. If the cocoon was also a brand new race, it wasn’t impossible for the worm to evolve two consecutive times and become an overlord race.
At that time, wouldn’t it be a huge gain to have super racial skills in both psychic and spatial realms?
“Yi…” At the side, Baby Ginseng’s face instantly fell. Overlord race… What was going on? Wouldn’t it be at the bottom again?
Was its evolutionary fruit so powerful… It wanted to eat it too now!

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - School Starts
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: School Starts
After evolution, Buggy was very excited.
Because it felt that this evolution had yet to consume the power of any evolution materials.
It was purely because of its accumulation of natural evolution.
It was very curious now how powerful it could become after it completely absorbed the evolution power.
Even if it couldn’t reach the overlord race, it should be able to catch up to the Leader.
At the same time, it was even more curious about how strong it was now.
The energy value increased several times in an instant. Although it was not as high as the leader and the ginseng baby, battle did not depend on energy levels alone!
The use rate of energy points depended on the level and proficiency of the skill. Its skill level and proficiency were not lower than that of a leader or a ginseng baby.
In other words, under the same level, at a certain time, it wouldn’t be much weaker than the leader and the ginseng baby.
Only after a long time, when the battle evolved into a battle of attrition, would its disadvantage of having less energy appear.
Of course, having a lot of energy also gave some pets the capital to squander. For example, Eleven… relied on its energy to superimpose several skills to form profundities and attack as if it was a basic attack. Who could withstand that?
“Ji ~”
A moment later, Buggy said to Eleven telepathically, “If Baby Ginseng doesn’t want to fight, I’ll fight you!”
As it spoke, it even wrapped his entire body with blue Psychic power and flew up!
Eleven had the Electric Magnetic Floating skill, and now it had the Psychic power to float. Who couldn’t fly!
Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng:??
“Fight my butt.”
“Hurry up and go to sleep.”
Shi Yu glared at Buggy.
Although it had evolved and was in a completely new form, the cocoon had to sleep obediently.
Did it still want to evolve successfully?
What if a “miscarriage” happened?
“Wuu!” Eleven also advised Buggy not to fight, at least not with it. It was afraid that it would accidentally help Buggy break out of its cocoon.
At that time, it would be a Thousand Sin Bear.
Buggy: (? _ ?)
Didn’t they agree not to act cool during evolution?
Why did it change when it came to it?
“Absorb the evolution power well first. When you’re about to evolve, you can fight. At that time, you’ll evolve on the spot and show off big time,” Shi Yu advised, wanting Buggy to give up its current battle plans.
This cocoon form was like a little wife who had been pregnant for ten months. Although its battle power was not weak, it was better to be careful.
“Your current mission is to quickly absorb the evolution power and then absorb more nutrition from the outside world.”
Shi Yu said, “I’ll increase your absolute sleep skill points in the future. This way, your digestion and absorption of nutrition will increase. You might be able to break out of the cocoon earlier. Sleep in peace.”
“Also, a new racial skill, Psychic… I’ll also try to make it reach the maximum level before you evolve. Perhaps there will be an unexpected effect during evolution.”
After Baby Ginseng’s sweet aura, nutritional supplements, and other skills were maxed out, there were many more skill index slots. Shi Yu could relax and replicate Psychic power.
Now, he also had a difficult task, which was to lay a better foundation for the cocoon as much as possible!
Then the rank after evolution would at least be monarch and maybe overlord!
“!!!” Buggy was excited. It didn’t expect this cocoon form was still viable for adding points.
“Alright, alright, come back and sleep.”
Shi Yu didn’t plan to let Buggy wander outside for too long. He directly put it back into the Beast Taming Space.
However, just as he retracted it, Shi Yu suddenly felt a little tired.
It was unknown if it was because he was tired from worrying about his three pets or because contracting three commander-level pets was a little overload.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu smelled the sachet in his pocket and instantly revived. He looked at Eleven and Baby Ginseng, who were looking at each other.
“Eleven, stop training and rest.”
“Baby Ginseng, you… Although it’s very cruel, please prepare the gem cat’s food for the next month and do it well. After all, your future evolution materials might still have to rely on it…”
“° ° (? ?)” Ginseng Baby understood.
They were sucking up to the cat.
At the same time, Eleven rubbed its head.
Stop training? Take a break?
Impossible!
Baby Ginseng had a training mission, and Buggy was also evolving and becoming stronger. Don’t even think about tricking it into staying where it was.
Rest was impossible!
“Wuuu, wuu, wuu, wuu ~” Eleven revealed an intelligent gaze and jumped away to train.
Shi Yu :”…”
This child had been smart since it was young.
It had perfectly inherited the outstanding character of a Beast Tamer who was hardworking and unwilling to fall behind.
“You guys arrange the time yourselves. Work and rest are both important.”
Shi Yu was tired and planned to go back to sleep and think about it quietly until school started tomorrow.
The past few days before school started had exhausted him.
Not only had two of the three pets evolved, three of them had even reached commander rank!
His current strength…
At the moment, Shi Yu’s strongest strategy should be to let Baby Ginseng create nutrients and let Eleven eat a bunch in one go.
This way, Eleven could accumulate a huge amount of energy in its restrained state. In the end, after reaching the limit, it would directly explode into a sharp edge using Inner Power. Who among the commander ranks could compare to it!
Then, the burden produced by the eruption could still be treated… It was invincible.
After Buggy turned into a butterfly, the combination of the three pets would be even more invincible.
With such strength, he could still be ranked at the top even in the big schools of the ancient capital.
“Fortunately, I didn’t go into the battle department. Otherwise, I would have graduated before school started.”
“Senior Lu is right. There’s really no future for the battle department.”
After school started, Shi Yu planned to distribute the time.
3: 3: 4.
30% of his free time was used to increase points and nurture bugs first.
30% of his free time was used to study. After all, Lu Qingyi had sent him to Ancient Capital University to let him learn some professional knowledge. He couldn’t always rely on his voice of history talent and archeological books.
Apart from the history and archeological knowledge of this world, Shi Yu was also quite interested in knowledge like machinery and feeding.
In this way, time was a little tight. However, he had at least four years to go to university. If he learned slowly, it wouldn’t be very urgent.
Most of the time, Shi Yu planned to use it to cultivate and meditate. After all, the level of the Beast Taming Space was the foundation of the Beast Tamer.
After knowing that the full skills of the index could be deleted, Shi Yu was no longer so obsessed with contracting new pets and adding new index pages. However, he was still a little obsessed with super skills.
The increase in the Beast Taming Space meant that the upper limit of his physique had increased… Shi Yu also wanted to teach super skills earlier.
Whether he could teach super skills… was definitely an important dividing line!
When the day came that he could teach super skills, perhaps his level could leave the scope of the younger generation and quickly advance to the older generation.
Just like when those legendary figures were young.
Emperor Shi had carried the burden and duty of driving out the totems and unified Dong Huang in his twenties, becoming the strongest under the Mythical stage. He was almost an evolutionary talent big boss who had reached the Legendary stage before the age of 30. He had one foot in the Mythical Domain. Shi Yu felt that he should use him as his goal. Only then would he be worthy of the cheat-level talent, the skill index.
“Skill index, skill index, hurry up and make me invincible. When the time comes, I can go overseas or even the totem area to party.”
Especially the totem area…
Even the big shots of Bureau 11 didn’t dare to explore the ruins there.
After all, it was the territory of the totem creatures. However, the more dangerous this place was, the more it attracted Shi Yu…
Shi Yu knew that this was an illness. He had to change it.
…
The next day.
January 31.
Shi Yu woke up early and opened his electronic guide letter.
School had theoretically started today.
Although class had yet to officially begin, they would meet the class mentor today. The students would also meet.
Perhaps, the new students of various specializations and even the entire school would gather to listen to the school leader’s speech… At the thought of this, Shi Yu’s expression darkened.
The universities in this world… The school wouldn’t have any crazy opening ceremonies, right?
With a very nervous mood, in order to hide his handsome aura, Shi Yu deliberately didn’t wear a panda costume. He only wore a simple blue casual suit.
Then, he arrived at a certain classroom for the class meeting at the specified time.
When Shi Yu entered, there were already more than 20 people in the class. The mentor had yet to arrive. As Shi Yu entered, the entire class suddenly fell silent.
Dead silence.
Some people widened their eyes and watched as Shi Yu slowly walked to the back row and sat casually in a seat beside the window.
“What’s wrong? Who is he?”
A boy asked his deskmate beside him, wanting to know why the atmosphere in the class suddenly changed so quickly.
“Brother, you’re not from the Ancient Capital, right? You don’t often watch the news or surf on the Internet, right…” The person beside him was the one who had passed this year’s Ancient Capital vocation assessment. He said with a serious expression.
“He’s Shi Yu, a super big boss.”
The new students of Ancient Capital University were mainly recruited from a bunch of messy assessments like the professional Beast Tamer assessment, professional Feeder assessment, professional medical assessment, and so on. The source of life was basically the candidates who passed the assessment in the nine first-level cities. It wasn’t that there were no candidates who passed the assessment in the second-level cities, but the requirements were very high.
Therefore, there were really a lot of people who didn’t know Shi Yu…
However, among the 20 plus people present, there were still many who passed this year’s Ancient Capital vocation assessment.
They had all seen Shi Yu take first place with their own eyes. How could they not recognize Shi Yu after changing his clothes?!
“This guy is actually my classmate?”
Many boys and girls in the class felt strange…
They were paying attention to Shi Yu, and Shi Yu casually glanced at them. It had been a long time since he sat in the classroom and listened to class with the little kids. He still missed this feeling.
“No one I know.” Shi Yu glanced at everyone and shook his head.
Why didn’t the school leader assign his opponents in the vocation assessment to this class to relieve his boredom?
No…
He knew someone here.
Two Spirit Mediums entered. Shi Yu recognized them.
“Wang Ling, Xu Jingyin, that should be the name, right?” Shi Yu raised his head slightly and looked at a boy in gray casual clothes and a girl in a black dress who entered the classroom.
He couldn’t remember it clearly, but this Wang Ling should be the armored man in the Ancient Capital vocation assessment. He had contracted a Skeleton General, Ghost Horse, and Sword Ghost. He liked the combination battle strategy of the “Skeleton Sword Knight”. He was that unlucky guy who was smashed into pieces by Yin Zhengfan’s Zonyan Rock Beast’s Lava Explosion!
As for that Xu Jingyin, she seemed to be from Icefield City just like him. Back then, when they were competing for the Evolution Holy Spring, Shi Yu was the second to fight her. His impression of her was that the other party had contracted a Nether Cat and was very weak. Back then, she was still a Beast Tamer intern. This person… had also come to Ancient Capital University?
“Perhaps the Evolution Holy Spring also brought considerable benefits to others at that time. In addition, during the probationary stage, no one has developed the Beast Taming Talent. Perhaps she also has an extremely special Beast Taming Talent…”
As Shi Yu analyzed in his heart, the two of them walked in his direction.
Then, they accidentally saw Shi Yu.
At this moment, their expressions couldn’t help but change.
Shi Yu?
Shi Yu looked up with a smile. He wasn’t a bad person. Did they have to be so exaggerated as to “change their expressions”?
“You know each other?” Shi Yu looked at the two of them walking together and asked curiously.
“She’s my cousin.” Wang Ling looked at Shi Yu and said, “I didn’t expect us to be in the same class. However, there are only three classes for the archeology Department new students. It’s not very surprising.”
“…” Xu Jingyin looked at Shi Yu speechlessly. Back then, when Shi Yu announced that his Iron-eating Beast had an ancient evolution bloodline, the ones who were most depressed were definitely the group of people who competed with Shi Yu for the Evolution Holy Spring in Icefield City.
In their opinion, Shi Yu had definitely obtained the benefits from the Evolution Holy Spring.
Everyone was clearly soaked in it… Why did it have to be Shi Yu who earned it?
“Oh, oh, cousins. Not bad. I’ll leave the next four years in your care!” Shi Yu said amiably.
Wang Ling and Xu Jingyin:???
Us? Take care of you? Human language?

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - Martyrs Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Martyr’s Ruins
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The two of them guessed what Shi Yu’s so-called “care” meant.
At this moment, a dry cough was heard.
“Cough.”
“Students, please sit down first.”
The class guide who had entered the classroom had already walked to the podium.
This voice was a little familiar.
Shi Yu’s gaze passed the two Spirit Mediums and looked over. Then, he was stunned.
Isn’t this Old Ding!?
He was the mentor of the archeological Seven Elites, one of the members of the archeological Research Group at that time!
Well, Mentor Ding was a member, and Shi Yu was in charge…
Shi Yu had a strange expression.
Bah, this was very strange.
“I’m your counselor for the next four years. Ding Jie, just call me Teacher Ding.”
The male teacher smiled at the students who had already sat down.
“Next, we’ll have a ‘short’ class meeting to distribute textbooks, school cards, and talk about the plans for the next half semester.”
Then, Mentor Ding said a bunch of nonsense.
It was only until the class committee’s election that the class atmosphere became restless.
It was good to be a class committee member. Although one would do more work, they got extra credits, and the credits in the school here were all real money. It was more suitable to describe it with points. They could be exchanged for cultivation resources!
Moreover, its value couldn’t be compared to the priority right of the lousy scholarship in his previous life.
“Is there anyone who recommends themselves?” During this period, Mentor Ding’s gaze looked at Shi Yu either intentionally or unintentionally, but Shi Yu dodged and shook his head…
It was meaningless. Being a lousy class committee member was a waste of time. For ordinary students, this might be a very good way out. They could get closer to teachers, expand their connections, and obtain some resources in advance. But for those really capable students, it was a waste of their lives.
Shi Yu had understood this in his previous life.
Shi Yu was pretending not to notice the whole time, and Mentor Ding had no choice either. In the end, the armored man, Wang Ling, took the class monitor position away. The other class cadres also separated the other positions and placed it on different students.
“There’s no hurry to collect the textbooks. I’ll talk to everyone about the subsequent plans.”
Mentor Ding finally started talking about business.
He looked at everyone with a smile.
“You won’t be taking professional lessons so soon. Before that, you might have to undergo military training in three to five days.”
“The school will arrange for you to live for a week with the Beast Tamer Corps stationed outside Ancient Capital City.”
“Of course, this process isn’t for you to undergo any arduous training or battle, but for you to experience history and get close to history!”
“You guys chose the archeology Department because you’re more curious about Dong Huang’s history, right?”
“As the capital of many dynasties, the ancient capital has a large number of ancient dynasty ruins and ruins. The earliest can be traced back to the era of the Shi Emperor. These ruins are all guarded by the Beast Tamer Corps in various places.”
“Letting you guys go there to live for a week is actually more like a trip. It’s considered letting you guys experience it. Of course, during the process, there will definitely be plenty of training, training, and receiving knowledge. You have to be prepared.”
Whoosh!
As soon as Mentor Ding finished speaking, the eyes of the 33 students in the class, including Shi Yu, lit up.
“Ancient Dynasty ruins…” Shi Yu’s DNA moved.
Although it wasn’t impossible for him to go alone, with his identity as Bureau 11, he could go and take a look at any ruin, he was still following the big wave. It felt safer and it had more atmosphere.
“Teacher Ding, have you confirmed the location? What era’s ruins are they?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask.
Mentor Ding looked at Shi Yu and smiled. “I’ve long confirmed it.”
“It’s a ruin from the era of Emperor Shi, the era of Dong Huang’s founding. No, to be precise, it’s a ruin space!”
“It’s a ruin from the era of Emperor Shi, the era of Dong Huang’s founding. No, to be precise, it’s a ruin space!”
All the students perked up.
“This ruined space is very magical. I believe you will definitely broaden your horizons. If you’re lucky enough, you might even be able to obtain some benefits from it, or even…”
Benefits?
“Hero??!!!” In the class, Wang Ling and Xu Jingyin suddenly thought of something, and the other Spirit Mediums in the class said in disbelief. Could it be that place?
“Is it the heroic spirit ruins?” they asked.
“Yes, that’s the place.”
“Perhaps some students don’t know. Let me introduce them to everyone.”
“This is a ruin that hasn’t been completely explored. It’s said that the Dong Huang Dynasty built it to record some heroes with outstanding achievements at that time. From ordinary soldiers, battle beasts, and even weapons with merits to legendary generals and heroic figures who formed the legends of the later generations, they were imprinted in this ruin space in a magical manner.”
“It records the heroic figures of every level in the early stages of our human rise. Emperor Shi himself even modified this ruin through his own time power. I hope the future generations can forever remember these heroes’ contributions to Dong Huang.”
“And this ruin has been preserved until now, and it has even developed a mysterious power.”
“Those heroes, war beasts, weapons, mountains, rivers, plants, legions, and marks that have become targets of faith have become heroic spirits drifting in the long river of history over a long period of time. The archeological world unanimously believes that it was Emperor Shi who used his own power to let them survive in another form to this day.”
“Although they don’t have their previous memories and are new lives, their strength and potential are still present.”
“And the other special thing about this ruin is that if someone enters the ruin and has suitable aptitude, there’s even a chance to summon a certain heroic spirit from the long river of history and become an undead-type pet in the form of a ‘guardian spirit’ to protect the Beast Tamer himself!”
“In the past hundred years, there have been many Beast Tamers who have received the recognition of heroic spirits in our human race. At the moment, there’s a legendary Beast Tamer in our ancient capital who has obtained the recognition of the ‘battle soul’. This is the conceptual heroic spirit formed by a certain invincible army of Emperor Shi due to their faith. It’s peerless in battle.”
Fu Jing!
Everyone knew which legend Mentor Ding was talking about.
Since entering the Alliance calendar, although there had never been a legendary Beast Tamer in Ancient Capital City, there were still many famous legendary Beast Tamers.
For example, Legend Yin and Legend Fu were both representatives of Ancient Capital City.
Moreover, unlike a Beast Tamer like Legend Yin who relied on his impressive Beast Taming Talent to rise, the turning point of Legend Fu’s life was that he obtained the recognition of the Battle Soul!
As an ordinary soldier of the Beast Tamer Corps, Legend Fu, who couldn’t even afford a decent pet but had a lot of ambition, was a classic rags to riches story.
Perhaps it was because of his personal charm or other reasons, but he obtained the recognition of the battle soul of the army under Emperor Shi from the heroic spirit ruins. This battle soul with an extremely high growth rate directly made him soar into the sky and grow into a legend all the way, becoming a big boss in the military world.
With Mentor Ding as an example, everyone instantly understood.
As soon as he finished speaking, all the students present were immediately filled with endless anticipation for this heroic spirit ruin.
They were even more curious about every big and small figure who had left merits during the Time Emperor Era. They were curious if they could obtain the recognition of these heroic spirits!
“Alright, there will be more specific notice later. The military training activity of the Martyr’s Ruins is jointly carried out by the archeology Department and the Battle Department. Everyone, just know in advance and prepare.”
“Next, class monitor, organize it. Everyone, go and get the textbooks.” Mentor Ding looked at the armored man, Wang Ling.
“After retrieving the textbook, you can go back today.”
“Yes!” Wang Ling nodded.
…
This class was very strange. Because the ratio of men and women was severely imbalanced, there were 24 boys and only 9 girls.
Then, under Mentor Ding’s lead, everyone went to the next room to carry books. What shocked Shi Yu was that there were a total of 32 textbooks for the first semester of the archeology specialization alone, and they were all pretty thick…
This page count was too much.
However, although there were many textbooks, everyone was a Beast Tamer. It was quite easy to move them.
Even if it was a girl, she could lift dozens of books with one hand. All of them were transcendent humans. There were no delicate female students who couldn’t even twist the bottle cap. This couldn’t help but make Shi Yu sigh at the valiance of the people on the blue planet.
When distributing the textbooks, many students chatted together and even flipped through the textbooks.
“Look at this book. It records the three generals and the three great armies under Emperor Shi. Perhaps we can summon some heroic spirit from it when the time comes.” Someone found a history book and smiled.
“Legend Fu seems to have obtained the recognition of one of the Beast Tamer Corps’ battle souls!”
After his reminder, everyone quickly flipped open the book.
The three generals under Emperor Shi were all Titled Legendary-level Beast Tamers. There were even countless experts in the army under them. This book recorded hundreds of Beast Tamers and pets that could be called heroes.
From their birth to their pets to their achievements, there were certain records.
“The three generals?” Shi Yu also flipped through it.
“General Bai Lin, Heavenly Formation General, Sea Suppression General…”
Upon seeing this, Shi Yu smiled.
“What are you laughing at?” Beside Shi Yu, Wang Ling, who had been secretly observing Shi Yu, looked at the monster that had been keeping a low profile just now.
According to what he knew, his childhood friend and strong opponent, Yu Shu, was extremely angry at this Shi Yu. It was one thing for Shi Yu to be strong, but in other aspects, Wang Ling also wanted to investigate.
“It’s nothing. It’s just that it looks like the history of that time hasn’t been completely recorded.” Shi Yu slowly put down the book.
“What do you mean???” Wang Ling was stunned.
After Emperor Shi opened the Beast Taming Era, compared to the Mythical Era and the Totem Era, the lost history was actually relatively small. However, from the looks of it, it still hadn’t been completely recorded. However, this was also normal. Even if it was a previous life without transcendent power, the amount of history that had been passed down is still incomplete. Whether it was real or fake is still a big problem.
“What I want to say is that as everyone knows, there are five of the Four Heavenly Kings, so there should be at least four of the three generals,” Shi Yu said.
Wang Ling: “?”
What was this confusing riddle?
“Are you going to tell me or not?” The corners of Wang Ling’s mouth twitched.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “That’s what I meant just now. I mean, apart from these three generals, there should be another general under Emperor Shi. However, from the looks of it, she hasn’t been recorded.”
Ice Dragon General, Mu Huiyin!
Due to special reasons, the Heroic Spirit Ruins had yet to be completely explored. He didn’t know if she was recorded inside.
Shi Yu looked out the window and in the direction of Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in Icefield City.
That ice dragon also have said that its Beast Tamer, the Ice Dragon General, was also a general under Emperor Shi. However, there were no records in this book.
She had clearly sacrificed herself to help the Country suppress the totems, but her merits had not been recorded… He wondered how the Ice Dragon General Mu Huiyin and the Frost Dragon felt.
“I want to discuss with the Ice Dragon to help the Ice Dragon General verify her name! It doesn’t matter if I get a dragon whisker, or scale, or whatever, the main thing is to restore history!”
However, compared to this, Shi Yu wanted to know more. If he entered that heroic spirit ruins, what kind of heroic spirit could he resonate with… Or could it be that without that one in ten thousand aptitude, he couldn’t summon anything in the first place…

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - Beginning of Club Recruitment
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Beginning of Club Recruitment
Apart from the three generals, there was another general that had not been recorded?
Shi Yu’s words stunned Wang Ling.
He didn’t think that Shi Yu was talking nonsense.
There was no need for Shi Yu to lie.
However, how did Shi Yu know?
“Are you serious?” Wang Ling asked.
Shi Yu patted the book and said, “It should be announced in a while.”
He didn’t know how the conversation between Bureau 11 and Ice Dragon was going.
Now, Lu Qingyi was in charge of this matter.
He could ask later.
If he really planned to destroy the Ice River Totem, he also wanted to take a look.
He just didn’t know if the mechanical guardians that had forbidden weapons could be touched by him.
Shi Yu estimated that there was no chance. From the looks of it, his plan to let his future mechanical pets be able to use nuclear bombs had failed!
“Stop chatting.”
Just as Shi Yu and Wang Ling were chatting, Xu Jingyin walked over and interrupted their conversation.
“Uh.” Wang Ling was stunned. Although his curiosity had yet to be satisfied, judging from Shi Yu’s expression, he didn’t seem to want to talk about it in detail.
Business was more important… Continue moving the books!
However, before leaving, Wang Ling suddenly said to Shi Yu, “Will you go to the battle club’s recruitment tomorrow?”
At the beginning of school every year, the various clubs of Ancient Capital University would face the entire school to recruit new students.
Among them, the most popular battle club was definitely among them.
If other clubs had interests and hobbies, then battle clubs were purely about strength.
The club adopted a ranking system, and there were resources to be divided.
Within a year, various internal competitions of various sizes would be carried out in the club. When the National League was about to begin, the head students of the club would also form a school team and fight the National League.
After the National League ended, a new school year began. Some members graduated, and the clubs would be new from the older students who weren’t strong enough to enter the clubs before. They wanted to see if anyone had any opportunities and improved their strength during this period.
Basically, the threshold to enter the battle club was to be a high-level Beast Tamer and commander-level pet.
Only those older students with the strength to accumulate could reach this condition.
However, in recent years, because the school had increased the favoritism of the resources of the battle club, and because of new policies, even those new students who only had transcendent pets could receive the training of the club in advance as long as they had the potential.
Wang Ling wanted to know if Shi Yu was interested in becoming a reserve member of the club.
Although Shi Yu had entered the archeology Department, everyone knew Shi Yu’s strength clearly.
If Shi Yu planned to enter the battle club, he would definitely receive huge resources.
“Me? I should go take a look,” Shi Yu said.
If he didn’t go, the beast-eared girl would come knocking on his door.
The Ancient Capital University of the National League lost again this year. It didn’t even enter the top five in overall grades, making the beast-eared girl explode.
Also… This year was her last year in school. She wanted to do well because the original president graduated and she became the president.
In this situation, Shi Yu was embarrassed to not join in the enthusiastic invitation of the beast-eared girl.
“You’re going too ?…” After Shi Yu answered, Wang Ling muttered and left.
Sigh, Shi Yu was also going…
This guy would definitely steal the limelight again. Damn it.
As the two of them walked away, Shi Yu smiled.
A moment later, he waved his hand and the books disappeared.
In the ruins space, Eleven and Baby Ginseng watched as a huge pile of books piled in front of them.
Seeing these books, Baby Ginseng was still a little confused, but Eleven suddenly trembled.
“Wu!” It looked panicked.
Eleven was not afraid of anything, but it was afraid that Shi Yu would let them learn mathematics and physics.
Although these weren’t the same subject, Eleven felt that it was similar.
“Yiya,” Baby Ginseng asked. What was this?
“Wuu!” Eleven thought for a moment and said, “Wuu wu wu. (After mastering all the secret manuals to become stronger, one will be invincible.)”
“Yi?!!” Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up.
Then, it was a little nervous.
Then could it take a look?
“Wuu!” Eleven expressed that Baby Ginseng could look around as it pleased. It was best to memorize everything.
With that said, the lightning sparked around it and it took off and left this troublesome place.
…
On the day of school, apart from the class meeting, there were no other meaningless meetings. Fortunately.
After putting away the books, he returned.
After returning, Shi Yu had originally planned to study the textbooks first.
However, after entering the ruins space, he realized that Baby Ginseng was staring at a book with a worried expression. It was studying for him, so he turned around and slept, planning to rest more.
“Ha ~” After yawning, Shi Yu slept and accompanied the green worm’s cocoon.
He sunk into his dreams, there was no concept of time. It was even a phone call that woke Shi Yu up.
“Hello, hello, hello ~”
“The club is recruiting new members today, remember to come ~”
“Also… remember to perform well later!”
White Brook knew Shi Yu’s background and potential. Although she also wanted to directly distribute most of the resources to Shi Yu, she still had to be fair in the position of president.
“Alright,” Shi Yu replied in a daze when he heard the beast-eared girl’s voice.
Eh? Wait, today?
Shi Yu was stunned and hurriedly looked at the time.
7: 32…
Holy shit, he had slept for more than ten hours.
It broke the record.
Shi Yu immediately became energetic. Apart from being a little hungry.
“Eleven and the others actually didn’t wake me…” Shi Yu rubbed his temples.
The club recruitment event began at 8: 30 pm. Shi Yu planned to find something to eat before going over…
After tidying up a little, Shi Yu left the house in high spirits.
…
Ancient Capital University, the northern campus, one of the exclusive training grounds for the battle club.
This place was huge. In the center was a huge venue. The seats from low to high were almost surrounded.
At this moment, it was already extremely lively here.
There were freshmen and seniors from the first to fourth years of university. There were students from all grades.
Archeology, Battle, Medical… There were also specializations.
Shi Yu walked in the noisy training ground and immediately saw the beast-eared girl on the platform.
Although she was small, White Brook, who stood there with a rare expression, had a very strong aura. A moment later, she sat in the main seat of the platform. On her left and right were seven or eight members of the battle club of the same age, both male and female.
“Senior White Brook is so brave.”
“Did you see the National League this year? She fought with a monarch-level pet and resisted the opponent’s skill. She’s so cool.”
In the audience, some new students looked at the platform and discussed.
“What’s the use of being cool… Didn’t Ancient Capital University still not produce any results this year? The other team members are too lousy.”
“Fortunately, Senior White Brook and her pet advanced before the competition. Otherwise, with the president at the master level, the results of Ancient Capital University would probably be even worse.” An inappropriate voice came from the side.
A guy sitting lazily in a chair and wearing a cloak said casually.
“You… who are you?” The surrounding new students looked at him.
“Don’t you even know me?” Yu Shu was helpless. “Forget it, it doesn’t matter. Anyway, the battle club of Ancient Capital University is too much. I hope that after I join, my teammates will be more awesome.”
Because his parents were students from Ancient Capital University, Yu Shu had long been internally decided by Ancient Capital University. He even planned to join the battle club of Ancient Capital University and restore the glory of Ancient Capital University!
Perhaps not in the short term, but if he was given two to three years, Yu Shu believed that he would definitely do better than these seniors.
“Little Yu, you’re so cocky now.” As Yu Shu was posturing, a palm landed on his shoulder.
Then, a person sat beside him.
As this person sat down, Yu Shu frowned and turned around. Then, his expression darkened.
“Shi Yu??”
Shi Yu sat down with a smile. He didn’t expect to meet someone he knew. Alright.
The first to call out Shi Yu’s name was not Yu Shu, but the surrounding students.
Obviously… The reputation of Shi Yu, the first place in the assessment, was much greater than Yu Shu, who couldn’t enter the top three.
“Holy shit, Shi Yu is here too.”
After discovering that Shi Yu had also arrived at the recruitment venue, many students around them began to stir and discuss.
However, everyone was young after all. Shi Yu was not an idol-level positive figure, so no one came over.
“What are you doing?” Yu Shu looked at Shi Yu. His Beast Taming Space was still a little short of breaking through to level three. It was a little early to take revenge on Shi Yu now, but after the military training ended and he obtained the recognition of the impressive heroic spirit, he was confident that he could surpass Shi Yu.
The Heroic Spirit Ruins was also the reason why Yu Shu, a Spirit Medium, stayed in Ancient Capital University.
According to tradition, almost 100% of talented Spirit Mediums like him could obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit. In fact, after obtaining multiple recognition, the heroic spirit could be chosen by him. However, the strength was not certain.
“Join the club? What else?” Shi Yu smiled.
“Tsk.” Yu Shu curled his lips.
What was a telepathy talent doing in the battle club? He should go archeology obediently.
Even the legendary figure of Ancient Capital University, Senior Lu, couldn’t use her telepathy talent to defeat those Beast Tamers with battle-type talent… Shi Yu definitely couldn’t.
Between high-level Beast Tamers and master-levels, there was a common title. Quasi-master-level Beast Tamers referred to Beast Tamers who could control commander-level pets and fight monarch-level creatures.
This was also the strength of the second tier contestants in the National League.
Generally speaking, the difference in strength between commander rank and monarch rank pets was difficult to cross even with the racial advantage.
Beasts alone did not have the ability to fight above their level, but with the increase of the battle-type Beast Taming Talent, there was a chance of doing it!
Because of these precedents, Yu Shu felt that Beast Tamers with battle-type talent would definitely widen the gap between them and non-combat-type Beast Tamers over time!
He looked at Shi Yu with pity… Unfortunately, such a good opponent was destined to be “surpassed” by him in the future.
“F*ck…” Shi Yu also looked at Yu Shu like he was looking at a fool. He was speechless.
He had to give him a lesson later. This Yu Shu had clearly not been beaten up enough!
At the same time.
On the stage.
White Brook picked up the microphone and directly spoke. As her voice sounded, the training ground immediately fell silent.
“I’m the current president of the battle club, White Brook.”
“Welcome, students who want to join the battle club.”
“There are limited social resources and limited venues. A small selection will be carried out next.”
“Today’s selection is divided into two rounds. After passing the first one, you can become an official member of the battle club. After passing the other one, they can become a reserve member of the battle club and even the school team. In short, one will face the older students and the other will face the new students.”
“Let me briefly explain the rules of the first selection. Next, the battle society will send out different Beast Tamers to guard the arena. The rules are 3VS3 solo. They will send their pets first. Those who want to join the club can go on stage and challenge them themselves.”
“As long as you can defeat two pets of the battle club’s guardian, you’ll pass the assessment.”
3VS3. The representatives of the battle club members and candidates who wanted to join the club could at most send three pets.
However, soloing meant that the three pets couldn’t be released at the same time. It wasn’t a team battle, but a 1VS1 battle.
At the level of high-level Beast Tamers, theoretically speaking, Beast Tamers could send out four pets at the same time, but the burden of commanding four pets at the same time was very high for Beast Tamers. Therefore, in battles that were not related to life and death battles, usually, Beast Tamers would choose rules that were relatively friendly and enjoyable for Beast Tamers.
For example, a 3VS3 solo battle was a very mainstream competition rule. That was, choose three out of all the pets he contracted and send them out to battle the opponent one by one. Whichever side all three pets lost their battle ability, or the Beast Tamer himself used his talent to exhaust his physical fitness, would be judged as a loser.
“Then, in order to save time, let’s start now.”
As White Brook finished speaking, someone had already walked onto the arena.
He was tall and strong, wearing clothes that looked like a basketball suit. He had messy hair, narrowed eyes, and a smile, looking very friendly.
After boarding the arena, he took the initiative to summon it.
“Jiu!!!!”
In the green summoning array, flames rose. A huge bird with red feathers and flowing flames flew into the sky and let out a cry…
“Hong Xiao, high-level Beast Tamer, commander-level Flame Three-Headed Bird.”
The member of the battle club smiled and introduced himself.
Seeing him, many seniors who wanted to go on stage hesitated.
Because this person was not weak. As a Beast Tamer with fire-element strengthening talent, his output was clearly very violent.
In the battle club, there were still a few Beast Tamers with non-combat-type talent. Most of the older students who wanted to join the club wanted to wait for the weaker “examiner”.
[Name]: Flame Three-Headed Bird
[Attributes]: Fire, Wind
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Race Skill]: Flame Assault, Flame Breath, Wind Drill, Wind Pressure, Sea of Fire
[Energy Points]: 33976
A fire-element pet with extraordinary strength!
Shi Yu nodded after seeing the pet data through Bureau 11’s index.
If the Beast Tamer’s fire strengthening talent was added, it was indeed a nightmarish strength for new students.
“Aren’t you going?” Seeing that no one was going up for the time being, Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel bored. He asked Yu Shu, why didn’t the students register in advance for this recruitment activity to arrange the assessment order? In a club, it seems like there weren’t any logistics members in the battle club?
“What the hell?” Seeing that Shi Yu was asking him, Yu Shu’s expression darkened. The assessment for the new students was at the back, what was the hurry? This was prepared for the older students!
“No one’s going up…”
“Then I’ll go.” Shi Yu didn’t expect the assessment for the new students to be ranked at the end. In order to not waste time, he directly got up and slowly walked to the arena. In any case, he was entering the battle club. There was no difference between an official member and a reserve member.
Fire-element pets were perfect for Baby Ginseng to practice!

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - Baby Ginseng’s Might
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Baby Ginseng’s Might
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Then I’ll go.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Yu Shu was first at a loss before saying, “Huh?”
As Shi Yu walked away, Yu Shu reacted from his daze.
What was Shi Yu going to do?
What did Shi Yu say he was going to do?
Wait, did he hear wrong?
This fellow… was going to challenge that Hong Xiao?
“Holy shit, is this guy crazy? Is he stupid?” Yu Shu stood up. He was stunned by Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already walked down.
They arrived at the border between the venue and the audience.
There was also a group of battle club members sitting here. They were registered for challengers who wanted to enter the club.
Coincidentally, when Shi Yu came down, three other senior students also came down.
Shi Yu couldn’t help but be speechless. They didn’t have to register and queue here, right?
“Register here if you want to take the entry assessment ~”
“One by one.”
“Do all four of you want to try?”
A tall girl with long hair waved a pen and said.
She looked at the four people who had walked over at about the same time.
The three older students were all familiar faces. Among the four students of the Combat Department, only Shi Yu was a new student. However, Shi Yu, this new student, seemed to be a familiar face to the few members of the battle club responsible for registering…
After carefully identifying it, they looked at Shi Yu in front of them in a daze.
“F*ck.” A member of the battle club was stunned.
When the three older students saw the reaction of the elites of the battle club, they also looked at Shi Yu.
Moreover, he also felt that the handsome Shi Yu was a little familiar.
“Are you Junior Shi Yu??”
The tall girl in charge of registering stared at Shi Yu with her beautiful eyes.
In the battle club, White Brook respected Shi Yu very much. She believed that in the next few national competitions, the new blood of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu, would change their losing streak.
Regarding this, White Brook even brought some members to watch the vocation assessment.
The members of the battle club naturally knew Shi Yu.
However, it was precisely because of this that it was very strange… Shi Yu was clearly a new student!
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Junior Shi Yu, you’re too early? The assessment for the new students is behind ~” the senior said.
“No, I’m here to participate in the assessment of an official member,” Shi Yu said.
Everyone: “?”
To participate in the official member assessment, one had to at least have commander-level battle power!
If they remembered correctly, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space level was only level two. Even if he broke through after the vocation assessment, he was only level three!
It was completely different from the official assessment.
“Are you serious??” The battle club sister confirmed again.
“I’m not kidding, senior. I already have commander-level battle power.” Shi Yu smiled.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the nearby battle club senior was a little stunned.
Her head was dizzy.
Wait… Half a month ago, Shi Yu, who had just passed the vocation assessment at the second level of the Beast Taming Space, already had commander-level battle power?
He did look like he was kidding!
“Your guys…” At this moment, on the platform, White Brook also discovered the abnormality in the registration office.
In the arena, Hong Xiao also looked over.
They had all discovered Shi Yu’s figure, but they weren’t sure what was going on.
“Are you serious? I’ll register for you, then you go.” After realizing that she was dragging the progress, the tall senior immediately registered for Shi Yu. Although she had yet to figure out what was going on, Shi Yu could do whatever he wanted…
“Thank you, then I’ll go…” Shi Yu thanked, leaving the three older students beside him a little stunned.
It seemed like they had arrived a couple steps earlier, right? Damn it, Shi Yu gotta go first!
…
Shi Yu completed the registration and really stepped onto the arena.
At this moment, the members of the battle club and the new and old students who had all focused on the registration area were stunned.
Looking at Shi Yu’s familiar face, everyone rubbed their eyes.
“Why did he go up?!?!”
On the platform, the beast-eared girl nearly collapsed the table under the gaze of her companions, scaring them.
White Brook was at a loss. What was wrong with Shi Yu…
At the same time, in the audience.
Zhang Qianyi, the Gu Master Miao Dongdong, Han Dong, who had also entered Ancient Capital University’s Elemental Coordination Talent, were staring. Han Dong, who had been insta-killed by Shi Yu during the vocation assessment, as well as Shi Yu’s classmates, Wang Ling, Xu Jingyin, and the others, all looked at Shi Yu, who had stepped onto the arena, in confusion.
No, what was this guy doing up there…!
“He’s crazy,” Yu Shu sat back down and said.
“Senior Hong, hello ~” After Shi Yu came up, he looked at the Beast Tamer of the Flame Three-Headed Bird and greeted him.
Hong Xiao was stunned. He looked at the register and saw the tall senior make an “OK” gesture at him, meaning that, yes, Shi Yu was the first challenger to enter the club.
She was leaving it to him.
F*ck… Hong Xiao didn’t understand why a new student like Shi Yu would come up now. However, at this point, he nodded and said, “Junior, send your pet out. It’s a 3VS3 solo.”
Shi Yu nodded.
In the next second, a white summoning array appeared in the arena.
Moreover, ripples came from the index. A pet figure was about to appear!
“White array, level-three space… He broke through.”
Before the pet appeared, many candidates of the same batch as Shi Yu were stunned when they saw this scene!
Shi Yu, who had the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm, was already so strong. Now, who knew what new pet Shi Yu had contracted… What changes had his strength made…
However, the problem was that even the level-three Beast Taming Space… didn’t meet the standard of the battle club!
“Yi…!!!”
However, as the pets Shi Yu sent out appeared, the level of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space was no longer the point of discussion.
At this moment, everyone’s gaze was focused on Baby White Radish in the arena. No, Baby Ginseng!
“Huh…?”
“Jiu!!!!?”
Not to mention the audience, even in the arena, the pets of Shi Yu and the others, the Three-Headed Flame Bird that wasn’t a human, were a little confused. What did it mean?
Its opponent was this thing?
Are you sure this is a battle and not an additional meal?
Burning a ginseng baby… This was too cruel.
It looked at its Beast Tamer.
At this moment, Hong Xiao was very silent.
He wasn’t the only one who was silent. Everyone was.
Was the wood-element ginseng baby serious about fighting the fire-element three-headed bird??
Not only was it a battle of attributes… but it was also a battle of races. Shi Yu was definitely crazy! Everyone stared at the arena with widened eyes.
The most silent was still White Brook on the platform. Her expression was solemn. This ginseng baby…
A mutated ginseng baby of a low-level monarch race!
As one of the people present when Lu Qingyi recommended pets to Shi Yu, White Brook was the only one who knew the origin and extraordinary aspects of this ginseng baby.
However, even so, she still couldn’t understand it at this moment. No matter how high the level of the mutated ginseng baby was… it was still a supplement.
Just because its race level crushed the Flame Three-Headed Bird didn’t mean that its battle power would be higher.
“Baby Ginseng… What is this Iron-eating Beast Knight trying to do? I don’t understand.” In the audience, a battle faculty senior student spoke in confusion.
“Baby Ginseng doesn’t have any battle power. So what if it’s a commander rank? It’s still useless even if it evolves into a ginseng fruit tree.”
Beside him, a battle department senior who had also come to participate in the assessment had a messy gaze.
Baby Ginseng… Baby Ginseng didn’t have any battle power?
A long time ago, he also thought so, and so did his Giant SunFlower…
Until a new student brought a ginseng baby and blew up his Giant SunFlower.
After watching the surveillance video somewhere, he couldn’t calm down for a long time. He silently forgot this memory and picked up the Giant Sun Flower from that heartbreaking plant garden…
And now, the familiar figure of a Beast Tamer and pet in the surveillance video appeared again…
Giant Sunflowers Beast Tamer’s voice was dry and hoarse.
Damn.
It was them!
He looked at his companion. The problem was that this ginseng baby had battle power, and its battle power was so high that it didn’t make sense!!
“Why can’t Baby Ginseng have battle power? Of course it can! This Baby Ginseng’s battle power is definitely off the charts. It’ll bet on an energy crystal!” He gave up thinking and looked at his companion beside him. He planned to not be the only one injured.
“???” His companion.
“You’re here to distribute benefits? So be it, don’t regret it!”
The audience was bustling with activity. In a certain corner, Yu Shu looked at Shi Yu like he was a fool. Although Shi Yu was stronger than him now, he wasn’t as smart as him. Meanwhile, after a short silence, although the plot was a little wrong, the assessment still had to be taken. Senior Hong Xiao chose to let Shi Yu attack first.
“Junior, you attack first.”
He was afraid that if he attacked first, Baby Ginseng wouldn’t have anything else.
It was still a backup plan.
In the arena, Shi Yu had one hand in his pocket as he looked at the sky. Baby Ginseng, who was standing on the ground with its calves, also looked up at the sky and at the Three-headed Flame Bird that seemed to have fused with the hot sun.
“Jiu ~!!!!”
The flames on the Flame Three-Headed Bird’s body swept up. Although it wasn’t a move, the flames on its body seemed to have wrapped it into a fireball. Ordinary wood-element attacks probably couldn’t get close to its body!
This was attribute suppression!
Moreover, did Baby Ginseng have any attack skills?
“Yiya ~ (So hot ~)” Baby Ginseng looked at the sky and muttered to itself.
Moreover, under the gazes of everyone, he stretched out a finger-like palm and pointed at the three-headed flame bird in the sky.
“Baby Ginseng, Light Clearing Cannon,” Shi Yu said.
Clearing Light Cannon?
What the f*ck?
Shi Yu deliberately didn’t use telepathy. After hearing this, Hong Xiao and the others were stunned.
Baby Ginseng had this skill?
Moreover, the name of this skill sounded a little fierce. It felt like a super skill!
Boom!
After Shi Yu gave the order, everyone was attracted by the light that appeared on the arena.
Because Hong Xiao chose to let Shi Yu attack first, it gave Baby Ginseng time to accumulate light energy.
Although its storage beam was only at the expert level and its proficiency wasn’t very high, the energy value of the ginseng baby was currently as high as 90000!
It was three times closer to the Three-headed Flame Bird in front of him!!
Under the guidance of such a huge amount of energy, the formation speed and scale of the light beam transformed from the energy fusion in its body was not as slow and small as imagined.
A few seconds later, a ball of light the size of a marble and containing terrifying power appeared in front of Baby Ginseng’s fingertip.
Buzz ~ Buzz ~ Buzz ~
The dazzling light and surging energy suddenly made the Three-headed Flame Bird in the sky feel that something was wrong.
Hong Xiao’s expression also changed.
“Something’s wrong.”
“Let’s increase the distance and use Flame Assault to accelerate!”
As he didn’t know what was going on, Hong Xiao quickly gave the order.
In an instant, the flames on the three-headed bird’s body became even stronger. It used an acceleration attack skill and burned the power in its body!
However, it was already too late. The white light ball at Baby Ginseng’s fingertip had already spewed out.
The light ball extended and turned into a dazzling light pillar. It shot out of Baby Ginseng’s fingertip like a flash from the sun.
At this moment, the airflow around the arena was dyed white. Because the power of the storage beam was too strong, it had already caused the air to tremble!
Boom!!!
Under the lingering of the hurricane, the terrifying white pillar of light turned into a white shock wave. Its speed completely exceeded the Three-Headed Bird’s Flame Assault and reaction speed, directly devouring the Three-Headed Flame Bird, whose pupils constricted, and pushing it into the distant sky!!
An incomparably thick beam of light pierced into the sky at an extremely terrifying speed. The flames on the Flame Three-Headed Bird were instantly extinguished. Its gaze gradually became absent-minded as it was pushed by the power of the beam until it was covered in injuries!
“Screech—” In the sky, the cry of the three-headed flaming bird came.
At this moment, everyone only felt a flash of light. In the next moment, the three-headed bird’s body that was riddled with holes from the beam of light appeared in front of everyone. Only the ridiculously strong beam of light continued to penetrate the sky…
Because he underestimated the enemy, this battle club leader didn’t even have the time to activate his talent, and the Flame Three-Headed Bird didn’t know what happened either. Its eyes turned white and it fell from the sky with a white smoke…
It was a huge tragedy.
Bang!!!
A moment later, the Flame Three-Headed Bird fell heavily to the ground. At this moment, the entire place was dead silent.
From Hong Xiao to Yu Shu, Miao Dongdong, Han Dong, and the other new students who were watching the commotion at the same time as Shi Yu, their gazes gradually exploded. Their mouths were agape, and their hearts almost stopped.
Especially Yu Shu. His mind went blank as he looked at the calm Shi Yu in the arena.
This Yu Shu suddenly lost the ability to think.
He almost blacked out, unable to accept the reality in front of him.
“Aba Aba Aba Aba…” Yu Shu.
At the same time, in the arena, Hong Xiao widened his eyes as he looked at the fallen Flame Three-Headed Bird.
“How, how is this possible!!!”
Who could tell him what was going on!!
Everyone, including the members of the battle club, looked at the baby ginseng that retracted its arm in shock.
What was that just now? How was it possible? That powerful skill… That powerful light-element skill… They had only seen it on White Brook’s Six-tailed Light Fox previously… No, Baby Ginseng’s move might even be stronger than a Six-tailed Light Fox of the same level!!
Was this a f*cking supplementary pet with the lowest battle power?
At this moment, all the new students who knew Shi Yu stood up and looked at the arena in disbelief.
A ginseng baby that could instantly kill an elite commander rank battle pet of the battle club?
Moreover, was it wood-element versus fire-element?
“This doesn’t make sense!”
“Yi…” In the face of everyone’s shock, Baby Ginseng enjoyed it very much. It endured the excitement in its heart and tried its best to make itself as” proficient “as Shi Yu at looking calm. From today onwards, the Ginseng towering emperor would stand tall on the ground, dictate the ages, and be invincible.. Mortals, let’s celebrate and be shocked!

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - Giving You A Chance Is Useless
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Giving You A Chance Is Useless
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
This was impossible, this was impossible, this was impossible!
Shi Yu was the first to go on stage. After insta-killing his opponent in one round, countless people muttered this sentence.
Zhang Qianyi and the others from Shi Yu’s batch looked at this commander rank “ginseng baby” in disbelief.
He couldn’t understand why a ginseng baby not only had combat power, but was also so ferocious.
The feeling that the beam just now gave everyone was that it was almost a crushing level of destructive power!
“It feels like an energy storage beam skill…”
Someone muttered, “Baby Ginseng can master the storage beam?”
“Bullshit storage beam, how can a storage beam have this power? Didn’t you hear him? This is a Light Clearing Cannon. It should be a special super skill that only a certain baby ginseng race can master… It’s just that I’ve never heard of it before.”
What a powerful Light Clearing Cannon. Countless people had learned something new.
“Is this the Beast Tamer of a big city?”
Why didn’t these pets follow the routine!
The Gu Master Miao Dongdong sat in the audience in confusion. This didn’t make sense. Where did Shi Yu get these pets that had mastered strange skills!
“There might be a top-notch skill teacher behind this Shi Yu,” a girl wearing a headband beside Miao Dongdong said.
“Skill teacher?” Miao Dongdong turned around.
“It’s very similar to the elders of our tribe. They have mastered many skill manuals. It’s a branch profession of the Feeder. The most powerful skill teacher in Dong Huang had managed to make one of their pets master a hundred skills,” the girl in the lead handkerchief said.
“A hundred?!” Miao Dongdong widened his eyes. This was a person?
“Her comprehensive ability strengthening talent can make it easier for pets to learn external skills of the race. There are also a few skill teachers in Ancient Capital University. Although they can’t reach that level, they all have their own secret manuals. You can save up some credits. When the time comes, ask them to help pets awaken deterrence in advance or learn other skills,” the girl in the lead handkerchief instructed.
“Forget it… I haven’t understood my pet race skill yet.” Miao Dongdong was speechless.
Everyone looked at the venue again.
Commander-level ginseng baby.
At this moment, everyone understood why Shi Yu could have commander-level battle power in advance.
As a supplement-type pet, even if the level was higher, the baby ginseng could feed the Beast Tamer’s physical recovery speed. In addition, it could provide supplements at all times. It was much easier for the Beast Tamer to withstand it than to withstand battle pets of the same level.
If that was the case, it could be understood. This was considered a kind of sneaky escape method, but not every Beast Tamer was willing to do this. Apart from Medical-type Beast Tamers, very few Beast Tamers were willing to nurture supplement-type pets.
Everyone completely didn’t expect that Shi Yu, the top scholar of the ancient capital, would actually choose a ginseng baby instead of a high-level battle pet… Shi Yu didn’t have any strengthening talent either. In theory, telepathy was one of the talents that didn’t consume physical strength the most. A supplement-type pet was completely meaningless to Shi Yu.
However, no one could say that this choice was bad, because this ginseng baby’s battle power was indeed a little stronger.
“Not bad!!!”
In the training ground, Hong Xiao was the most embarrassed.
Right now, he only wanted to find a hole to hide in.
Heavens, Hong Xiao, what exactly have you done?
He actually let a new student torture him in public!
Senior Hong Xiao’s face flushed red as he retracted the Flame Three-Headed Bird.
“Junior, next, I’ll send out stronger pets and use my Beast Taming Talent.”
His heart trembled, hoping to regain his composure in the next battle.
Hong Xiao admitted that he had been careless just now.
This mistake shouldn’t have been made.
He already had a premonition that he would definitely be scolded by the president when he returned later!
