It didn’t matter if their strength was inferior, but losing because they underestimated the enemy was a huge taboo in the battle club!
“President, this Shi Yu…” On the platform, the other students of the battle club looked at White Brook.
White Brook shook her head. She didn’t really understand, but it seemed that this ginseng baby was more abnormal than she imagined!
As expected of a pet recommended by Senior Lu!
As expected of a genius supplement that ate the Fruit of Life and didn’t explode but instead evolved!
She didn’t expect that there was actually a talent to master attack skills. Shi Yu had picked up a treasure.
“Remember, Hong Xiao underestimated the enemy. When he comes back, his training volume will double. Flame Three-Headed Bird, obeyed the Beast Tamer’s wrong command and underestimated the enemy. Without its own judgment, it will increase by one level. The training volume will be super doubled.” White Brook patted the table and said,
“Although Shi Yu has a lot of potential, he’s only a new student after all. There’s still one round. Give Hong Xiao another chance! This time, it’s only a light punishment!”
“If this is the performance of the members of the battle club… What will the other new students think?”
The members of the battle club beside him didn’t dare to say a word. They looked at Hong Xiao sympathetically. All the best. There’s still one more chance. This time, give it a try… Seeing Hong Xiao lose so badly, they also felt ashamed.
At the same time.
On the venue.
After Hong Xiao toughed out the embarrassment, he summoned another pet.
“Roar!!!!”
The moment this pet appeared, a dazzling red light shot out of the arena, and a shocking hot wind spread on the ground. At this moment, the temperature of the entire arena seemed to have increased a lot!!
In the loud roar, Hong Xiao sent out a red dinosaur-type creature!
Its scarlet skin was like the combination of a lizard and a dinosaur. It had huge wings, a strong body, and a thick tail. This was a subspecies of dragon species with a weak dragon bloodline. It was a high class commander rank species, the Flame Dragon Lizard!
“Roar!!!” The nearly three-meter-tall Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard swung its thick red tail and stared at Baby Ginseng with its fiery red eyes.
“The Flame Dragon Lizard… he didn’t summon his monarch level trump card.”
Seeing that Hong Xiao’s second pet was still not his trump card, many students were stunned.
As one of the famous people in the school, many students were not unfamiliar with Hong Xiao’s configuration.
He had a pet of a low-level monarch race. That was the trump card!
But soon, they were relieved. This was only a recruitment assessment. Using an ace was too harsh.
Even if this Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard wasn’t Hong Xiao’s trump card, its strength was enough to be ranked second in his team!
[Energy Points]: 41,168
Beep… Beep… Beep…
[Energy Points]: 56,167
The energy value of this Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard quickly appeared in front of Shi Yu!
Although it was only a high class commander species, because it was a rare subspecies dragon species, its energy level was terrifyingly high, comparable to some low class monarch species with relatively weak energy points!
What was even more ridiculous was that in front of Shi Yu, the energy value of the Flame Dragon Lizard suddenly increased fiercely, quickly reaching 50,0006!
It increased by a whole 105,000!
It wasn’t a move that relied on external forces to erupt with stronger power, but…
Shi Yu looked at Hong Xiao and saw that red light had already spread around Senior Hong Xiao. His entire body was already wrapped in a red arc, and even his gaze was suffused with a faint fiery red. The Flame Strengthening Talent from the Beast Tamer was directly used on the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard at this moment!
It increased the quality of the Flame Dragon Lizard’s flame power, indirectly increasing the amount.
It made its strength increase by a full level!
Apart from the fact that it might not have super skills, its various qualities were already not inferior to low-level monarch species pets!
Boom!
The crazy heat wave made Baby Ginseng take a step back and reveal a serious expression.
If one were to say that the flaming three-headed bird just now was no threat to it…
Then this Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard, which had been strengthened by the Beast Tamer, was already qualified to heavily injure it!
Facing the other party’s fire-element moves, even if Baby Ginseng had the source of life and healing skills, if it was hit, it would definitely not feel good. After all, the attribute restraint more or less existed.
“Strengthening Talent…” Shi Yu took a deep breath when he saw Senior Hong Xiao and the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard erupting with all their might.
The reason why Beast Tamers’ pets were stronger than wild ferocious beasts was partly because of careful cultivation, system, and science. On the other hand, it was because of the various talents of Beast Tamers.
The Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard was only a mere high class commander species. Under the enhancement of the Beast Tamer, its various qualities at the moment weren’t much weaker than low class monarch races.
For people like Hong Xiao, their Beast Taming Talent development should be relatively poor.
After all, he was really young.
It was also by relying on various Beast Taming Talents that Beast Tamers could fight higher-level pets. Those titles of quasi-master, top-notch master, and top-notch legend actually valued the talent development of Beast Tamers more than pets.
The increase of a Beast Tamer was the key to determining whether a pet could fight above its level!
“Roar!!!”
Because it had learned from its teammate’s mistakes, the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard was very cautious at this moment. After it slowly took off, its gaze was always fixed on Baby Ginseng, waiting for the Beast Tamer’s command.
At this moment, seeing the extremely calm Baby Ginseng reveal a serious expression, Hong took a step back and smiled.
He felt that he could do it again.
The only lesson humans learned from history was that humans didn’t learn anything from history.
“Junior, you guys should attack first.”
Hong Xiao planned to take revenge.
However, for safety’s sake, glittering scale-like structures had already appeared on the smooth skin of the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard!
Fire and Dragon Dual Attack Skill, Fire Dragon Scale!
It was the favorite of alternative dragons!
At this moment, the defense of the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard was comparable to the Three-headed Flame Bird.
Clearing Light Cannon, come on!
At this moment, seeing that Hong Xiao “didn’t underestimate the enemy” and was fully armed, many people nodded at the members of the battle club.
Yu Shu, the half Dragon Tamer, sensed the huge aura of the dragon lizard and recovered from the shock of Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu… This guy…”
“No matter how ridiculous and unscientific this ginseng baby is, it should end here.”
“After all, this is an assessment for older students. Why would a new student like him join in the fun…”
“Moreover, he probably only has one commander, Ginseng Baby. This fellow got lucky. He definitely won’t have it anymore.” Yu Shu kept convincing himself. After all, the Ginseng Baby was only a supplement!
At the same time, on the venue.
“Alright.” Shi Yu slowly raised his head.
He quickly analyzed it.
And gave Baby Ginseng an attack command.
“Sweet aura.”
Buzz!
Shi Yu gave the order. Baby Ginseng brewed for a second. In the next moment, a huge pink gas bloomed from its ginseng flower!
If the previous Light Clearing Cannon had confused many spectators, then now, the audience didn’t understand Shi Yu’s intention!
Sweet aura?
Wasn’t this a supplement-type skill to relieve fatigue?
Releasing this thing… was to relieve someone’s fatigue?
His?
Yu Shu and the other candidates from Shi Yu’s batch widened their eyes. They kept feeling that things weren’t that simple.
Now, Baby Ginseng was like a supplement, but would everything be that simple?
“This isn’t ordinary sweetness…”
A moment later, everyone suddenly realized that there was something wrong with this sweetness!
The problem was the spreading speed!
This didn’t look like a wood-element sweet aura skill at all. Instead, it looked like a combination of light and wind!!
The moment the sweet aura was released, it rumbled. In the blink of an eye, the sweet aura spread and actually covered the entire arena and sky!
The Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard also stopped for a moment in the blink of an eye. It realized that the sweet aura had already lingered around and was even absorbed into its body!
The smell spread at a ridiculous speed. It might even be faster than the attack speed of the beam just now!
After the sweet aura reached transcendent proficiency, Baby Ginseng could casually control the speed at which the sweet aura spread. Now, the sweet aura at the Dao Proficiency level spreads at an even more ridiculous speed.
“What’s with the sweet aura?” White Brook and the others frowned.
Under their gazes, the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard directly inhaled a large amount of sweetness!
“Don’t breathe!!!”
Seeing the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard’s nose wrinkle, Hong Xiao’s eyes widened. He was not stupid, nor did he think that Shi Yu was a fool to take the initiative to help the enemy relieve their fatigue.
There was definitely something wrong with this sweet aura. He didn’t plan to let the Flame Dragon Lizard absorb it with him, but before he could order it, the sweet aura entered the Flame Dragon Lizard’s body at lightning speed!
“Roar!!”
The Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard blinked innocently. It was too much.
Moreover, it was just a little sweet. What did it matter? It didn’t feel threatened at all. It even felt that the power in its body was even more active…
Buzz!
The Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard was still acting as if nothing had happened. However, in the next second, its wings suddenly stopped, and its eyes gradually turned red and chaotic. At this moment, Hong Xiao even felt that the mental connection between him and the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard had been instantly broken by the chaotic and violent emotions produced by the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard!
Hong Xiao’s pupils were constricted.
As expected, something was wrong.
Everyone discovered the abnormality of the Flame Dragon Lizard.
“What’s going on…”
Everyone was confused. Wasn’t this ordinary sweetness?
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng… What special strategy were they up to again?
“After inhaling that sweet aura, it will indeed relieve fatigue and the effect is very good. However, if the pet’s state is already very full, it will produce a certain amount of excitement due to its special scent, falling into chaos…”
Shi Yu chuckled.
Apart from using the sweet aura of Dao Proficiency to simulate tempting auras, it could also be used to simulate some dangerous auras, such as the hypnotic aura, the stink, and the special scent that made life forms confused!
While letting Baby Ginseng take the plants like the gem mint to learn how to simulate the aura, Shi Yu also found many other plants.
One of them was called the “Flower of Chaos”. It was a ferocious plant that relied on its aura to cause chaos in the energy of living creatures.
Now, with the abnormality of the Flame Dragon Lizard, everyone was stunned.
Damn.
It was indeed not a proper supplement pet.
Who dared to inhale this sweet aura?
Are you sure this is sweet gas, not poisonous gas?
Hong Xiao was also stunned. What was going on?
Idiot dragon, I already said not to inhale randomly. The other party put rat poison in the candy!
After Shi Yu finished explaining, Baby Ginseng had already thrown several Energy Fruits into the sky.
The Energy Fruit was thrown very high.
Moreover, it emitted an extremely tempting fragrance.
“Holy shit, what’s this?”
“It looks… like nutrition.”
“The racial skill of the ginseng fruit tree… is also a supplement skill.”
“Do you believe it? I don’t believe it… It’s probably not a poisonous fruit…” The audience was smart.
It had already realized that this was definitely not a proper ginseng baby.
However, although everyone realized it, the confused dragon lizard didn’t.
After the Flame Dragon Lizard in the chaotic state smelled it, it was like a hungry dog that had seen someone throwing bones. It drooled without any ability to think!
“Roar!!” It roared loudly, flapped its wings, and charged at the few fruits.
“Idiot, come back!!!” Seeing Baby Ginseng throw out the “nutritional supplements” right after spreading “sweet aura”, how could Hong Xiao still dare to let his pet come into contact with it? However, at this moment, under the extreme chaos, the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard completely ignored the Beast Tamer, making Hong Xiao howl in anger.
“Wake up, don’t eat.” Hong Xiao was going crazy.
As he shouted, he saw that the Flame Dragon Lizard was about to touch the Energy Fruit.
He wanted to take back the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard and change his pet, but it was already too late. The moment the Exploding Flame Dragon Lizard approached, these few fruits were already filled with white light.
With a thought from Baby Ginseng, with a boom, the fruit immediately changed in the sky!
The fruit first flashed with a dazzling white light, then a loud bang was instantly heard. Then, like an explosive, the light kept expanding and instantly swallowed the Flame Dragon Lizard!!
Everyone’s expressions froze again.
Hong Xiao’s gaze nearly exploded.
F*ck…
It could even f*cking explode?
This… this might as well be a poisonous fruit.
That was more scientific. When it was supplemented to the extreme, it would be poisonous. They accepted it!
However, the explosion was f*cking ridiculous!!!
“Holy shit, this power…” Someone covered his eyes.
At this moment, huge energy rushed out of the consecutive fruits. With a world-shaking bang, the rolling energy tide rose into the sky like an earth-shattering sandstorm, squeezing each other and overlapping!
The white smoke that was swept up with a bang swept up energy fluctuations. It was like enchanting white roses blooming in the sky, or like dazzling suns releasing strong light.
The strong wind could be clearly felt by every audience in the venue.
After the white light, countless people widened their eyes and looked at the dragon lizard in the “nutritional supplements” that exploded with a bang, their expressions stunned again.
Boom!!!
Under Hong Xiao’s confused expression, the Flame Dragon Lizard was smashed by the huge energy impact in the sky and fell rapidly. With a loud bang, its broken body appeared in the huge gravel pit that was born on the ground with a loud bang.
The energy level of the attack just now was several times that of the energy storage beam.
It directly tore apart the dragon scale of the Flame Dragon Lizard and heavily injured it.
The shocking change made the scene silent again.
“You guys…” Senior Hong Xiao’s hand trembled slightly, and he had yet to recover.
Sweet aura, nutrients?
Hahahaha, supplement pet, so good.
“Freak!” Zhang Qian, Miao Dongdong, and the others’ pupils constricted. They looked at the motionless ginseng baby rooted in the ground and found it even more difficult to understand!
“That ginseng baby, baby…” Yu Shu stuttered. Mom, what was going on!!!
His gaze was empty. The alternative dragon species was killed by two supplement skills?
Although he already knew that the ginseng baby was very strong in the first round, after Hong Xiao used his strengthening talent and sent out a stronger pet, the ability displayed by this ginseng baby was even more ridiculous!
This time, Yu Shu completely collapsed. His values were shattered.
Was Shi Yu still human?
The previous iron-eating beasts and green worm were already unscientific.
The new trump card was even more unscientific!
Sweet gas and nutrients could be used to attack?
On the platform, many members of the battle club watched this outcome with twitching mouths.
In the arena, the dragon lizard slowly crawled up with a blank expression. Although it didn’t lose its battle power, it didn’t look like it could continue fighting.
“Senior, do you want to continue?” Shi Yu’s voice sounded like a demon’s whisper in the ears of the stunned Hong Xiao.
His heart stopped. He wanted to send a monarch species pet to take revenge…
However, at this moment, a low voice came from the platform.
White Brook’s mouth opened and closed. Finally, after a long period of silence, she said, “Hong Xiao, come back here.”
“Shi Yu passed the assessment. Next.”
At this moment, many members of the battle club looked at the crying Hong Xiao and felt uncomfortable. Little Hong, oh Little Hong, the president gave you a chance. You guys didn’t treasure it…
However, one way or another, this Junior Shi Yu… No wonder the president thought so highly of him. They looked at Baby Ginseng, who had a calm expression and looked rather strong. They were speechless. That baby ginseng should be Shi Yu’s current trump card. This strength was indeed not inferior to ordinary battle club members.. They were only in their first year!

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - Beast Ear Ladys Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Beast Ear Lady’s Hope
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Is it over?”
Upon hearing the beast-eared girl’s words, Shi Yu planned to stop fighting.
Shi Yu originally thought that he would still need Eleven for the battle club’s assessment, but he didn’t expect it to be resolved with Baby Ginseng.
It was mainly because the senior was too kind. The first round gave him enough time to store energy, and the second round gave him enough time to compress the sweet aura and release it…
Baby Ginseng was overjoyed. Defeating two powerful enemies in a row made it feel proud in front of so many people!
It, the battle ginseng, was invincible!
Supplements would never be a slave!
No one would dare to drool at it!
“Yi!!!”
Baby Ginseng’s roar, which was just about to expand, was stopped when it was immediately retracted by Shi Yu.
“Then, Senior, I’ll go down first.”
Shi Yu said to the confused Senior Hong Xiao.
“I # @% @.” Hong Xiao didn’t know what to say.
“Junior Shi Yu, please register at the platform too. The assessment will continue.”
At this moment, White Brook’s voice sounded from the platform.
Shi Yu was stunned before nodding and walking towards the platform.
At this moment, as they watched Shi Yu leave, the candidates who were in the same batch as Shi Yu had dazed expressions.
Shi Yu… had directly become an official member of the battle club?
And they still had to wait for the assessment of the reserve members?
Damn it!
However…
“This guy is so strong.”
“Where did this ginseng baby come from?”
“Is it a mutant contracted from some ruin?”
Countless people had mixed feelings. It was no longer a secret that Shi Yu had cracked the two major ruins.
And ruins were equivalent to other hidden spots and ancient inheritances.
It was said that Shi Yu’s Green Silkworm and Iron-eating Beast had obtained benefits from the ruins he had cracked.
The green worm obtained the illusion ability in the Ping Cheng ruins, awakened a special bloodline, and broke the racial restrictions of the green worm.
The Iron-eating Beast had obtained the inheritance cultivated by the ancient Iron-eating Beast and had unlimited potential. There was still a possibility of going further.
Then what about this ginseng baby?
Don’t tell them that Shi Yu accidentally cracked a ruin again and made the supplement-type pet take charge!
“Sister, I want to learn archeology.” Miao Dongdong looked at the girl beside him.
The girl frowned. “Our Gu Master lineage should just be thrown away then?”
Miao Dongdong :”…”
At this moment, countless battle faculty students recalled what the trump card specialization of Ancient Capital University was.
They were restless and had the thought of changing their major.
They felt that the battle specialization… had no future.
…
“You guys continue hosting.”
On the platform, as Shi Yu came over, White Brook threw the recruitment mission to the other members and pulled Shi Yu, who had just arrived, to the back.
Backstage, she observed Shi Yu from left to right, as if she wanted to see through him.
“Senior, you’re so strong…”
Shi Yu sweated. He felt that his physique, that didn’t lose to any master-level Beast Tamer… was actually not as strong as the petite beast-eared senior.
She had yet to transform.
“Beast Tamers with Fusion Talent generally have higher physiques,” White Brook said.
“I know, I know,” Shi Yu said. “When trained to the extreme, it should be like Emperor Wu. Even if it doesn’t fuse, you can still tear apart ferocious beasts with your bare hands, right?”
“Yes.” White Brook nodded and said, “Emperor Wu is the common goal of all Beast Tamers with our Fusion Talent.”
Emperor Wu, another legendary Beast Tamer after Emperor Shi.
After the Dong Huang Dynasty established by Emperor Shi collapsed for unknown reasons, many expelled totem creatures returned. The Dong Huang Continent continued to be in war for many years, and the people everywhere were plunged into misery and suffering.
However, heroes always appeared in troubled times. At this moment, a Beast Tamer with Fusion Talent completed the unification of Dong Huang Dynasty again, expelled the totems, and established the second generation of Dong Huang Dynasty.
Legend had it that when he cultivated his physical body to the extreme, he became the human with the strongest physique. He completely relied on a pair of fists to defeat a group of totem-level creatures.
With such a legendary figure, the Beast Tamer with the combination talent naturally became a goal for people like White Brook.
Shi Yu was also very curious. Was the Fusion Talent giving that Emperor more physical strength, or was the skill index giving Shi Yu more physical strength?
“Stop talking about me. What’s wrong with you?”
White Brook originally planned to let Shi Yu become a reserve member first. Who knew that Shi Yu would give her such a big shock?
“What’s going on? You mean Baby Ginseng?”
“As expected of a pet recommended by Senior Lu. Its potential is really too great.” Shi Yu praised. “This mutated ginseng baby has unlimited potential. Perhaps, it can break the racial restrictions of supplement-type plant pets and become an all-rounder!”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, White Brook had a look of agreement and worship in her eyes. “As expected of Senior Lu.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Damn, bootlicking!
“Cough.” White Brook coughed dryly and said, “Then your current strength…”
It had only been half a month since the vocation assessment ended. She originally thought that even if Shi Yu’s strength had improved, it wouldn’t be so fast.
But after just now, she suddenly couldn’t be sure.
She wanted to ask Shi Yu personally.
“You saw the battle power of the Mutated Ginseng Baby just now. It has already reached commander rank. Its current battle power should be comparable to a monarch race commander rank pet.”
White Brook’s eyes turned solemn.
Was Shi Yu’s evaluation of this ginseng baby so high?
It had to be known that whether there were super skills or not was a huge dividing line for pets.
“The Green Silkworm has already turned into a cocoon. After completing its evolution, I estimate that it won’t be weaker than the ginseng baby, nor will it be inferior to the monarch race.”
[Ginseng Baby:???]
“The Iron-eating Beast has already evolved and also broken through to commander rank. Its species rank is close to the overlord race.”
“It’s my trump card now.”
[Ginseng Baby: QAQ]
“Fortunately, I contracted the ginseng baby. Otherwise, it might be a little difficult for them to evolve.”
[Ginseng Baby: Uncool! When will I evolve!]
“That’s about it. I passed the Intermediate Beast Tamer assessment two days ago.”
“Unfortunately, the level of the Beast Taming Space isn’t high enough. Otherwise, I should be able to take down the high-level license along the way.”
When Shi Yu saw White Brook ask, he simply told her.
It wasn’t any valuable information, because Shi Yu felt that this information would probably be overturned a month later…
“…” At this moment, White Brook was already speechless. She looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
The growth trajectory of everything was extremely reasonable. In her opinion, it was inevitable that the Green Silkworm and the Iron-eating Beast would evolve.
However, White Brook didn’t expect Shi Yu’s execution ability to be so high. Moreover, after completing all of this, Shi Yu’s strength would change so drastically.
In that case, that ginseng baby was actually the last pet in Shi Yu’s team??
“You… you… you…” White Brook fell into deep thought.
She looked at Shi Yu again and felt that at this rate, in less than a year, Shi Yu’s strength in the battle club would be at the top?
This year, could Shi Yu fight in the National League? A first-year student participating in the National League?
She didn’t choose the wrong person!
White Brook’s mood brightened.
“In short, welcome to the club. I won’t give you the specific benefits of being a member.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Don’t worry, it means that you can use the school’s training facilities as you wish. The club will reimburse you and give you the greatest amount of resources.”
“The training facilities in the school can all be very useful to the growth of the pet. Some of the facilities require a huge amount of energy to be activated. It’s more expensive than providing food and nutrition to the pet. This is the greatest spending place for every student in the school.”
“Your mission is to not have any worries. Use these training facilities as soon as possible to cooperate with your ruins space and support your pets to become stronger,” White Brook said.
“When it’s almost the holidays, I’ll take you to see the world. Moreover, at the end of this year, you should also participate in the National League. The results don’t matter. It’s mainly to train for a year first, and then see if your strength has reached the standard to take over the club.”
“I don’t believe that you can’t take even one national championship in four years of university.” White Brook shouted.
In her opinion, Shi Yu’s starting point was even more perfect than Senior Lu.
At least, before Lu Qingyi graduated from university, she had never cracked any major ruins or obtained any substantial benefits from them.
However, Shi Yu was different. He had started to show his talent at the rookie stage.
Every ruin he cracked had a huge increase in his strength.
This was a crushing advantage for young people in their twenties.
“Is it that urgent?” Shi Yu scratched his face and said.
However, the club benefits were alright.
Ancient Capital University had a charging room for thunder-element pets. It seemed that Eleven would have a place to freeload in the future. He could use this Inner Power often.
“Of course. Every step is slow. It’s always right to quickly increase your strength,” White Brook said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. He didn’t know if he could match a master-level Beast Tamer in a year.
In his opinion, if he wanted to participate, he should get first place. Otherwise, he might as well not participate.
“Where are we going during the holidays?” Shi Yu asked.
“The exchange match,” White Brook said. “In order to warm up the National League, there will be a certain amount of communication between schools at various times in a year. It’s our turn vs Imperial Capital University this year. When the time comes, I’ll take you to the Imperial Capital to take a look.”
When White Brook finished speaking, Shi Yu’s expression froze.
Holy shit.
He kept shouting about sweeping through Imperial Capital University and Imperial Capital University… Was this retribution?
He was just casually thinking about that…
“Don’t worry. Usually, in such an exchange match, master-level students won’t take action.” White Brook patted Shi Yu’s shoulder and said, “I won’t talk to you anymore. The recruitment assessment still has to continue.”
Shi Yu: “…Then I’ll go back first.”
“Aren’t you going to continue watching?”
“No.” Shi Yu shook his head and said, “I still have a bunch of things to do over there.”
“Besides, we still have to go to the heroic spirit ruins to train in two days. I have to prepare in advance.”
“Heroic Spirit Ruins?” White Brook thought of something and said, “The one with Emperor Shi?”
“Yes.”
“I’ve also been there. Unfortunately, the heroic spirit that responded to me doesn’t match my aesthetic taste. Although it’s a big disappointment, I let it go back again.” White Brook sighed and said, “And I don’t want to fuse with the undead either. It’s strange. How good is a furry pet, right?”
Shi Yu :”…”
You are indeed obsessed with looks.
However, it was true that White Tiger Mother, Fox Tail Lady, and Cat-eared Lady did indeed sound a little Yang Realm compared to “half human, half ghost” and “female ghost”.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - The Evolution Method of Baby Ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: The Evolution Method of Baby Ginseng
“Then has Senior Lu been to the Heroic Ruins?”
Shi Yu asked again.
White Brook said, “I remember that she should have been there, but she wasn’t interested in contracting an undead. She only went to investigate the ruins, but unfortunately, she couldn’t find out what she wanted to know in the end.”
“Investigation?”
“Does she want to know the reason for the destruction of the Dong Huang Dynasty established by Emperor Shi?” Shi Yu recalled the question Senior Lu asked the little female dragon.
“It seems to be that!” White Brook nodded.
It was indeed that.
Why would the Dong Huang Dynasty suddenly encounter a huge calamity and be on the verge of destruction in an extremely short period of time? Then, the totem creatures that were expelled from the country made a comeback and divided the resources of the Dong Huang Continent again. These had always been the ten unsolved mysteries of the Dong Huang archeological world.
In theory, although Emperor Shi was old at that time, he still presided over the Dong Huang Ancient Country. His battle power was peerless, and there were countless successors. There was no reason for the Dong Huang Ancient Country to be destroyed so quickly, causing the Dong Huang Land to fall into war again coveted by the totems.
If it weren’t for the appearance of a person with talent not inferior to Emperor Shi, Dong Huang might have returned to the totem era and driven history backward.
What exactly happened at that time had always been one of the questions modern archeologists wanted to figure out. It was understandable that Senior Lu couldn’t forget it. Not to mention her, even a transmigrator like Shi Yu wanted to find out.
…
A moment later, Shi Yu left the recruitment venue.
After returning, he first started to read the information.
“The ten unsolved mysteries of the Dong Huang archeology world…”
Of the ten unsolved mysteries, five were related to the ancient Dong Huang Dynasty.
In the history of Dong Huang, a total of five peak dynasties had appeared.
Their common achievement was to end the totem war.
When a dynasty walked to its lowest point, it would definitely be coveted by the totem creatures again. At this moment, war often happened.
A true era of peace did not exist in the Dong Huang Ancient Country. Humans had never eliminated the threat posed by the totem creatures.
Of course, the other countries were even worse. Even now, some of the seven countries were in a state of war.
In comparison, the Dong Huang Ancient Country was considered lucky. In every era, an outstanding legendary Beast Tamer appeared.
After Emperor Shi was Emperor Wu, and after Emperor Wu was the empress. Legends of Beast Tamers with extreme talent ended the war time and time again until the modern era.
Among them, Emperor Shi was the beginning of the Beast Taming Era in the east.
The direction of the dynasty he established had an extremely important status in history.
“Since it’s ranked among the ten unsolved mysteries, it must be a mystery that many archeologists can’t solve.” Shi Yu was worried. Unlike the Ice Dragon Ruins that Bureau 11’s big boss didn’t fancy, this mystery should have been explored by many big bosses of Bureau 11.
However, they still got nothing. It wasn’t easy.
It was better not to think too much. He decided to first go to the Heroic Ruins to see if he could encounter interesting heroes. It was better not to think about the school period for the time being. Right now, accumulation was the priority!
After suppressing his curiosity, Shi Yu turned around and planned to add points and meditate.
The operation began according to the time allocation ratio of 4: 3.
Shi Yu meditated first.
The sweet aura that calmed the mind, the ruins meditation technique, and the super physique made Shi Yu use every minute and second efficiently.
Then, he added points.
After meditation, he added points, saving himself the trouble of wasting his meditation efficiency.
Shi Yu summoned the sleeping Buggy and didn’t wake it up. He just started adding points like this.
One of Buggy’s racial skills, Psychic. Under Shi Yu’s teaching, its proficiency quickly increased.
Moreover, Shi Yu would occasionally light up Buggy’s absolute sleep skill.
“Ji…” In the dream, Buggy slept very comfortably and was unwilling to wake up.
Under the baptism of the power of evolution, it had already evolved countless times in its dreams.
Among them, there were dreams and nightmares.
Sweet dreams where it evolved into beautiful butterflies, while nightmares evolved into ugly mosquitoes and beetles…
Shi Yu didn’t mind what it evolved into. Its appearance was all superficial. With Buggy’s potential, it would be extremely powerful no matter what it evolved into.
It now had an additional evolution form. Its racial potential had already exceeded its own race by too much. Shi Yu no longer had any extravagant hopes. Well, of course, it was best not to evolve into strange things.
Shi Yu devoted most of his energy to Buggy, but he didn’t ignore Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
In the ruins space, Shi Yu built a huge house for each pet.
Eleven’s house was filled with various metal minerals from level one to level six. There were hundreds of types.
These were all its snacks. Apart from being snacks, Shi Yu and Eleven were also studying whether the inscription was related to the hardening nature of different metal minerals.
Because he had relied on the gem cat, Shi Yu’s resources immediately became much richer, directly improving the lives of his pets.
If Eleven’s was a house of metal minerals, then Baby Ginseng’s was a house of spiritual plants with various unique smells.
Although its max-level sweet aura could change the smell, if it wanted to match perfectly, it still had to let the ginseng baby come into contact with it in practice. After all, although it had hundreds of millions of smells in its inventory, it didn’t know their specific effects and how to arrange them at the moment.
For example, the sweet scent that could make the opponent fall into a confused state was a scent that needed to be developed.
In the huge room, the research ginseng was wearing a mini white coat. It held spiritual plants and smelled them, frowning.
“Yi…”
Shi Yu meditated and added points in one go. His state was a little light-headed.
Because school had yet to start, there was naturally no need to study.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu still had a pile of other things to study.
At the moment, the evolution path of the ginseng baby was one of the most important research topics Shi Yu needed to study.
He wanted to find some evolutionary skills to teach the ginseng baby and help it find the path of evolution!
“Eye of the Gem and Carp Leaping Dragon Gate are both evolution-type skills.”
“However, none of them match wood-element ginseng babies.”
Shi Yu lay on the bed and flipped through the cell phone index.
Group message: “Mentor Ding: Students, we’ll set off for military training in three days!”
Flip.
Shi Yu directly skipped over a bunch of evolution skills and useless information and eliminated the search target to the wood-element range.
He planned to find it from the wood element first. If he couldn’t find it from the wood element, he would expand it to other elements.
Shi Yu immediately discovered the racial skill of the “forest spirit”.
This pet happened to be one of the plant pets recommended by Senior Lu back then.
Moreover, Forest Spirit was also one of the few pets that could evolve naturally with their racial skills after reaching the requirements. There was no strict evolution ingredient rule similar to the Green Silkworm.
The wood spirit was a plant spirit born from the evolution of an entire forest. It could possess ordinary plants and accelerate the growth of one plant, helping it evolve into a spiritual plant and giving it battle abilities.
As it grew, it could control the entire forest. When the types, quality, and number of plants it possessed reached a certain limit, there was a chance of it evolving into the monarch species pet, the monarch of the forest.
Its racial skill was the “Possession Growth” of the wood and undead elements…
“In other words, if Baby Ginseng can learn this move, and at that time, find a high-level spiritual plant and graft it onto it… Can it fuse and evolve?” Shi Yu was speechless. It was too difficult to execute and imagine.
It felt a little unreliable.
He searched for other evolution skills.
Then, he found the wood-element “lush” skill.
There were a total of two pets with rich mastery, but they were not plant-type pets, but animals.
They were all high-level transcendent races.
One was a sprouting deer with tender branches on its head, and the other was a tree species turtle with seed grass growing on its back.
Both creatures were grass-eating wood-element creatures. One’s favorite food was plant-type branches, and the other’s favorite food was seed-type.
And their lush skill could subtly accumulate evolutionary heritage according to the nutritional content they ate.
When their racial skills reached a certain level of proficiency and they had also accumulated enough evolutionary heritage, they would complete their evolution by using “specific evolution materials” and using lush growth to activate their evolutionary heritage.
The Sprout Deer would evolve into a True Branch Horned Deer of a high class commander species.
Tree species turtles would evolve into tree world turtles of middle-level monarch races.
Although the evolution skills used by the two different pets were the same, the evolution materials were different, and the racial potential after that was different…
“Lush. I feel that Baby Ginseng can give it a try. After all, it has characteristics similar to that of a deer and little turtle… Isn’t there also a ginseng flower on its head? Moreover, it’s a plant itself… But it doesn’t seem to have the habit of eating plants.”
Shi Yu continued looking and discovered another wood-element racial skill, “Mutated Body”.
This skill was different again. Until now, only one plant pet, “Mutated Tree”, had mastered it.
This plant was very ancient. It was because of this racial skill that it had survived countless years ago.
The plant genes that had the skills of mutants were very unstable. It was very easy to evolve into a form that adapted to the current environment because of the differences in the surrounding environment.
Even if they were infected by light pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, and atmospheric pollution, they wouldn’t be easily extinct. Instead, they would mutate into breeds that were suitable for the current environment.
However, it wasn’t accurate to say that the mutation was evolution.
This was because after the mutation type creatures evolved, their race level might not change, or they might increase, but they might also decrease. They were mutated purely to adapt to the living environment, and the instability was extremely high. In addition, because the mutation skill might not have any concept of proficiency, or it was extremely difficult to increase, the mutant tree basically didn’t exceed the monarch race.
But generally speaking, in the face of harsh environments, the strange trees mutated and evolved towards higher races. This way, they could better resist the harsh environment of the outside world.
“Uh…”
“Mutants…”
“This skill is easier to understand. After all, Baby Ginseng mutated. It means that after Baby Ginseng masters the mutation, I only need to throw it into magma, glaciers, and radiation areas. As long as it doesn’t die, it can mutate and evolve on its own…”
“Lava Ginseng Baby, Glacier Ginseng Baby, Radiation Mutated Ginseng Baby…”
[Ginseng Baby:???]

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - Arriving at the Heroic Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Arriving at the Heroic Ruins
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu meditated, added points, and conceptualized the evolution of the ginseng baby.
In the blink of an eye, three days later.
More than 600 new students from the Combat Department and the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University were about to head to the vicinity of the Heroic Ruins for military training.
During this period, Shi Yu thought for a long time and still felt that the skill “mutation” was more suitable for baby ginseng.
Because their baby ginseng was a mutated race.
It was absolutely impossible for an ordinary ginseng baby to be fine eating a level-eight Fruit of Life at the Awakening level.
But his baby ginseng had done it and even underwent a mutation evolution. Perhaps this meant that his baby ginseng’s adaptability was very strong!
Now, in addition to the source of life that almost made it immortal, it might really be able to complete mutation evolution through some extreme environments.
Shi Yu had also thought of the so-called extreme environment.
He planned to create and simulate it himself.
There were mainly three aspects: soil, light source, and water.
He planned to find some super high-level mutant soil, mutant water, and special light to combine the mutant skills and assist the mutation of the baby ginseng.
Among them, Shi Yu’s idea for these mutants was that it was best if they could cause huge pressure on the growth of plants, but also provide a positive boost.
In short, Shi Yu planned to reference the method of the first mutation evolution of the ginseng baby before letting it undergo a mutation evolution.
Of course, it wasn’t impossible to add more external conditions during this process. For example, giving Baby Ginseng another high-level spiritual fruit.
With the help of more comprehensive and higher-level overload resources, the ginseng baby would mutate towards a stronger race!
Before that, Shi Yu would also try his best to increase the skill point of the “mutant” skill.
Through this skill, perhaps as the special environment Shi Yu and the ginseng baby came into contact with became more and more harsh, it could directly solve all the evolution problems of the ginseng baby. It could allow it to mutate and evolve all the way to a Mythical race!
Plant Baby Ginseng on the moon and mutate into Baby Moon Ginseng.
Falling onto Jupiter, Baby Jupiter…
Throw it into the sun, Undead Ginseng Baby…
As for the “lush” skill, Shi Yu felt that the chances of evolution were not high, but if there was a chance, it was not impossible to replicate it.
Lush was actually a classic gardener skill. It was a low-level wood-element skill that could allow plants to flourish and increase the power of the wood-element skill. Some specific pets could indeed evolve through this skill and suitable evolution materials, but Shi Yu was not confident about Baby Ginseng.
Baby Ginseng was already a monarch race. It was a little unrealistic to rely on a low-level non-racial skill to complete its evolution. At that time, it would probably still need the so-called specific materials. It was really difficult to experiment, so it was better to mutate and evolve.
Compared to entrusting his hopes to lush, Shi Yu might as well look forward to a super skill, plant control.
This skill included the ability of most wood-element skills. Not only could it control the growth of plants, but it could also increase the quality of plants. Perhaps, when Shi Yu gave this skill to Baby Ginseng and upgraded it to “transcendent”, it could use this skill to help increase its quality and complete evolution again. It looked like it was much higher than the upper limit of the lush skill.
And the problem now was… the Mutant Tree was not easy to find.
Shi Yu had already paid attention to the relevant information. He hoped that he could replicate the mutation skill before he finished using up most of the baby ginseng’s racial skill points.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already started to get on the school bus to the Heroic Ruins.
…
“Are you all used to staying in school these few days?”
Stopping in the armored school bus in the school, Shi Yu’s students were already in position.
Mentor Ding stood in the front row and smiled at the students.
School didn’t start early before the end of the military training because it was to give the new students time to walk around the school, understand the school, and adapt to the school.
“I’m used to it!”
“Ancient Capital University’s number one!”
“The training facilities are too awesome, but they’re a little expensive.”
In the car, the students were very active.
A few socially awesome students shouted at the top of their lungs.
After all, Ancient Capital University was a top-notch institute that had cultivated countless master-level Beast Tamers and even legendary Beast Tamers. The internal training facilities could naturally satisfy the requirements of these new professional Beast Tamers.
“Well, not bad.” Mentor Ding smiled and said, “When we reach the location, remember to listen to the class monitor’s command. If you have any problems, you can also look for Student Shi Yu. Don’t cause trouble.”
As soon as Mentor Ding finished speaking, many people’s gazes turned to Shi Yu, who was sitting in the front row with his eyes closed, and Wang Ling, who was sitting uncomfortably beside him.
Wang Ling was the class monitor, so it was only right to look for him if there were any problems. As for Shi Yu… because he was too strong, Mentor Ding was especially relieved. Be it in the archeological field or strength, Shi Yu was much better than his peers.
However, it was also because of this that Wang Ling felt a headache. Why was he assigned to the same class as Shi Yu? At this moment, his ambition to surpass Shi Yu a few days ago had been halved after watching Shi Yu participate in the battle club assessment.
The stimulation he received was not much smaller than Yu Shu…
Originally, they wanted to rely on the Heroic Ruins to achieve a reversal, but now, Wang Ling, Yu Shu, and the others were feeling a little weak…
…
Soon.
A bunch of school buses started to set off from various places in Ancient Capital University.
The Heroic Ruins was located in a protected area at the edge of Ancient Capital City. With the Beast Tamer Corps guarding it, it was considered a relatively safe ruin. There had been no danger for the past two thousand years, only giving future generations opportunities.
The distance wasn’t very far. Two hours was enough.
During the process, it was alright at the start, but suddenly, Wang Ling, who was sitting beside Shi Yu, was a little nervous.
Something was wrong!
He glanced at the meditating Shi Yu and inexplicably felt that the smell on Shi Yu’s body was a little good. He even wanted to smell more, making him call himself a pervert.
“What’s your smell…” A moment later, Wang Ling couldn’t help but ask. Was it shower gel, shampoo, or some brand of perfume?
Shi Yu could clearly rely on his looks and talent to make a living, so why did he have to be such a fancy foil?
Although it smelled really good.
Shi Yu opened his eyes and looked at him.
Without saying a word, he took out a sachet that was constantly emitting a sweet aura and swayed in front of Wang Ling.
“A sachet made of sweet gas above transcendent can relieve fatigue, replenish physical fitness, and increase the efficiency of meditation.”
“How is that possible? It’s not like I haven’t used it before. How can it have so many effects? Where did you buy it from?” Wang Ling didn’t believe it.
Moreover, the taste was very special.
“You’ve never used it before. This is something we made ourselves. Do you need it? The friendship price of a classmate is 3 million yuan each. It can be used for about a month. I suggest packing a year for you to surpass Yu Shu. It definitely won’t be a problem.” Shi Yu smiled and looked at him.
“I can be so strong because of it.”
Wang Ling was stunned.
Extortion! It was f*cking expensive!
The price was almost close to the level-five resources used by monarch-level creatures.
With this money, wouldn’t it be better for him to buy Ethereal Stones and other supplements?
“Stop lying to me!”
“In addition, to correct you, I’m stronger than Yu Shu to begin with,” Wang Ling said. “I don’t need this thing.”
“Alright then.” Shi Yu returned the sachet. You’re not confident about being given opportunities? He wasn’t lying.
As a strengthening talent, Wang Ling was also very weak. This sachet was definitely a supreme-grade divine weapon for strengthening talent Beast Tamers.
Not only could it assist the Beast Tamer in meditation, but it could also be used to relieve the fatigue after the Beast Tamer used his Beast Taming Talent to help his pet train. The cost-effective ratio exceeded other supplements. 3 million was really a friendly price.
…
After discovering the nature of Shi Yu’s “black business”, Shi Yu and Wang Ling were speechless.
“Everyone, pay attention to maintaining order.”
Soon, everyone arrived at their destination.
After arriving at the location, Mentor Ding appeared out of nowhere again.
The students in Shi Yu’s car and the dozen or so other cars nearby got off neatly under the guidance of their respective mentors.
“What a high city wall…”
After getting out of the car, the students could immediately see the wall dozens of meters tall in the distance.
In fact, every city close to the wild had city walls. For example, Ping Cheng had tall city walls that could withstand the ferocious beasts in the snow mountains. The materials of these city walls were special, and even ferocious beasts would find it difficult to break through.
Seeing the city wall, everyone clearly realized that this should be the edge of the ancient capital.
It was also where the Beast Tamer Troops were stationed in Ancient Capital City and the ruins of the Martyrs.
“A new student from Ancient Capital University is here.”
“They’re all good seedlings. I really want to pull them into the camp to train.”
“Unfortunately, there are very few talented Beast Tamers who are willing to come to the Beast Tamer Troops now.”
“What do you know? The country is pursuing comprehensive talents now. How can they all come to the camp?”
When the students arrived, not far away, a group of Beast Tamers in camouflage battle suits looked at them and communicated with each other.
“Stop chatting. Go receive the school leaders of Ancient Capital University,” said a leading officer.
On the way, the in-charge of Ancient Capital University, Director Li of the archeology Department and the Combat Department, Director He, walked towards the group of army Beast Tamers with a smile.
“Old Xu, long time no see.”
“It’s been a while.”
When the students went to the assigned accommodations to place the daily necessities, Director Li and Dean He of Ancient Capital University found the Old Xu they were talking about.
“Yeah.” The officer in the camouflage battle suit, Xu Kai, smiled and said, “How’s the quality of the students this time?”
“Of course it’s good. Let’s strive for ten people to obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit!” Dean He of the Combat Department chuckled.
There were many Spirit Mediums in his department, the chances were very high!
Unfortunately, Wang Ling and Shi Yu were intercepted by the archeology Department. He glanced at Director Li, who was also smiling.
“Looks like it’s pretty good.” The officer, Xu Kai, nodded.
Then, the mentors of the various classes and the instructors of the ruins protected area also met.
Soon, the students who found their temporary residence and placed their daily necessities came out.
Under the guidance of the mentors, the more than 600 students who had come to the Heroic Ruins for military training were quickly organized.
Shi Yu didn’t have to think in the crowd to know that it was time for the so-called speech segment again.
On the wide ground, the students stood neatly. Xu Kai, Director Li, and Director He smiled and said a few words before walking to the conspicuous high platform.
At this moment, when they saw this dark-skinned, muscular officer with a little beard go on stage and reveal a serious gaze, the students below began to discuss softly.
“That’s one of the top masters of the ancient capital, Xu Kai, an expert of the Beast Tamer Corps.”
“He has a super battle record of leading teams and fighting the overlord undead for half a day!”
“It’s said that he’s also a Beast Tamer recognized by powerful ancient spirits.”
Below, these new students from Ancient Capital University were also knowledgeable people. After all, apart from some who came from humble origins, most of them were still second-generation heirs. They were not unfamiliar with the experts in the Beast Taming Domain of Ancient Capital.
“Hello, I’m one of the in-charge of your military training, Xu Kai.”
Xu Kai’s gaze flowed through the crowd and said, “You’re all proud sons of heaven, elites from top universities. I’m very honored to be your instructor. This time, I’ll be together with your Dean Li and Dean He to show you the deeds of those ancient heroes!”
Not far from Xu Kai, Director Li from the archeology Department and Dean He from the Battle Department smiled and nodded.
The purpose of this military training was extraordinary. It was mainly to let these students who lived in relatively peaceful times know who brought them this hard-won life.
Apart from the Beast Tamers who were still guarding the edge of the city and the border of the country, there were also ancient heroes who should be grateful for the liberation of humans from the totems.
It could be said that the goal of this military training was to nurture the national identity of the young Beast Tamers.
If he taught people and ended up teaching a bunch of villains, it would be a waste.
With countless external enemies, no one could guarantee how long the stable situation could last.
After all, the ancient Dong Huang Dynasty was also incomparably glorious in the past, crushing the totem clans until they couldn’t breathe. There were even dynasties who organized their armies to kill their way to the totem area.
But it still couldn’t escape the law of the dynasty’s decline, because in comparison, the lifespan of humans was too short. The alien races couldn’t be defeated, and who could guarantee that the current peace would last forever? Now, the small-scale conflict at the border had never stopped.
In this situation, it was very necessary to let these elite Beast Tamers who weren’t from the military path understand the history of Dong Huang from the past to the present. They had a certain amount of hot-bloodedness.
This Master Xu Kai was also an expert in speech. In just a few words, he mobilized the national honor of many young students present, making many people’s blood boil. They even wanted to immediately drop out of school and join the army to fight the foreign races in the border battlefield and the totem area.
“In order to protect the future, the great Emperor Shi imprinted the traces of countless heroes of the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty in the heroic ruins in front.”
“All humans of Dong Huang have hope of obtaining the recognition of the heroic spirits and activating their deeds!”
“In the subsequent thousand years of turmoil in the Dong Huang Dynasty, many heroes rose up and launched a counterattack with the recognition of the heroic ruins here.”
“And up to now, all the heroic spirits in the heroic spirit ruins have yet to be unlocked, waiting for the inheritors of the future.”
“In other words, if you have enough determination, faith, and aptitude, those ancient heroes might walk out of the long river of history and assist you in the form of undead spirits. They will continue to protect Dong Huang in another form!”
“In the past seven days of military training, apart from visiting the ruins in the ruins and understanding the deeds of every hero, you can also take the initiative to try to communicate with the ancient spirits that have not been summoned.”
After spending more than an hour explaining the things to take note of, the student group dispersed.
Unlike what Shi Yu had imagined, the military training here was very different from the so-called military training in his previous life.
There were no strict requirements for discipline, and no special instructors were sent to manage a class, giving the students a relatively free space.
It was indeed as Mentor Ding said. They seemed to be here for a holiday.
Those instructors’ subsequent duties were more like guides introducing the ruins.
He hoped that through the protected area of the ruins, he could let the students understand history and nurture their sense of national identity. He could really obtain some substantial thinking growth from this military training.
There were also some elite students who might obtain strength growth from the heroic spirit ruins.
In comparison, using some military-style training methods to train this group of elites who had passed the vocation assessment was really meaningless and unnecessary. It wouldn’t have any huge effect at all.
Which one of them wasn’t an elite of the same level? If they were pulled out alone, even instructors might not necessarily be able to defeat this group of students at the same level.
After the meeting ended.
The various classes gathered together again.
Wang Ling looked at the 32 students in front of him and took a deep breath. “Everyone heard that, right?”
“The most valuable thing about this military training is to obtain the recognition of ancient heroic spirits!”
“In seven days, everyone can try countless times. In addition, as the class monitor, I can teach everyone a small skill to communicate with the heroic spirit and increase everyone’s success rate of communicating with the heroic spirit.”
As the class monitor, Wang Ling was still very responsible. The moment he spoke, the students in the class below immediately became restless and looked at him.
Even Shi Yu looked at him. What little skill was this? Why didn’t the beast-eared girl remind him?
“Class monitor, you’re awesome. What little skills?” The other students also started to ask anxiously.
“Really? I heard that the success rate of the candidates communicating with the spirits during the military training in the Heroic Ruins over the years is only about 1%. In other words, among the six hundred of us, maybe only six will succeed…”
This probability was neither high nor low, but for most ordinary students, it was still a little despairing.
“In short, if I can successfully communicate, I’ll treat the whole class to a meal,” someone said.
Wang Ling looked at the excited students and chuckled. “Don’t be anxious, don’t be anxious. Listen to me…”
“This little skill is that it works if you’re sincere…”
Shi Yu :”…”
Everyone: “…Let’s change our class monitor?”
It felt like he was talking nonsense.
Everyone knew that sincerity worked.
Could it be that he had to communicate with the heroic spirit from the perspective of the totems?
That way, even if it could be summoned, it probably wouldn’t be recognition, but manifestation to kill.
“There’s still more,” Wang Ling added.
“You’ve all seen the textbooks, right?”
“There are countless heroic deeds recorded on it. The power of these heroes must have been branded in the heroic spirit ruins.”
“Generally speaking, the stronger your faith in a certain person, the more familiar you are with his deeds, the greater your hope of obtaining its recognition.”
“Therefore, this week, if the first communication fails, don’t be discouraged. You can try to revise more heroic deeds and communicate with them with a sincere heart.”
“In addition, you have to be devoted. Don’t think that you can obtain the recognition of many heroic spirits. Just go for one person.”
“Also, do a good investigation. Many heroic spirits have already been summoned. At this time, no matter how much you understand them, it’s useless. It’s impossible for them to appear again.”
Wang Ling explained many small skills that he knew. This time, he even sounded like he was talking sense. The students nodded.
“Shiyu, do you have any suggestions?”
At this moment, a pretty girl in the class looked at Shi Yu, who was lazing around, with shining eyes.
Shi Yu was known as a new star in the archeology world and a famous figure among the new students. She also wanted to hear Shi Yu’s suggestion very much.
As soon as she finished speaking, the group of fans in the class immediately looked at Shi Yu.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was at a loss. Suggestion?
Shi Yu thought for a moment and said, “Then I’ll give you my opinion.”
“It’s said that Emperor Shi imprinted the power and deeds of all those with merits in the ruins of the heroic spirit in a special way.”
“One goal is to hope that the future generations will encounter a disaster. Their strength and faith can still be replicated in another form to protect Dong Huang.”
“And the other goal is to hope that their merits can be preserved in one more way.”
“This is also why when someone summons heroic spirits, not only will their power reappear, but their deeds will also appear.”
“There shouldn’t be anything missing from the records of Emperor Shi, but the later generations should have many incomplete records of the things that happened at that time. Because of this, if we can summon a hero that hasn’t been recorded in history, its deeds will appear. It should be a very valuable archeological discovery.”
“Therefore, maybe we can communicate with the ruins from the perspective of an archeologist…”
“Explore the unknown and restore the truth of history.”
In theory, in this special place modified by Emperor Shi, even without the gift of telepathy, the ruins could still appear!
However, after Shi Yu finished speaking, he suddenly felt that he had said a bunch of nonsense. This was too abstract. It was far inferior to Wang Ling’s little skills.
However, Wang Ling nodded at this moment and looked enlightened.
“Shi Yu is right. My little skill is actually more suitable for students of the Combat Department. Our current identities are students of the archeology Department. If we want to achieve something in this field, compared to obtaining the recognition of a powerful heroic spirit, it’s more valuable to explore things that have not been recorded in history or have ambiguous information that can’t be judged in history.”
“The heroic spirits of the heroic spirit ruins have yet to be completely unlocked. Many archeologists have come here to investigate mostly because they want to explore unknown deeds and not obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit.”
“Indeed. Senior Lu Qingyi has investigated the ruins of the Heroic Spirit many times and rejected the Heroic Spirit’s ownership just to investigate some truth.” Shi Yu nodded.
“We understand!” When Shi Yu and Wang Ling finished speaking, the students from the archeology Department (1) class looked enlightened.
Although they didn’t know what had happened, after Shi Yu and Wang Ling said this, they suddenly felt stable. They felt like their conception and understanding had been unlocked.
It was really good to have a big boss and a good class monitor to guide him.
Shi Yu :”…”
Did they really understand?
As everyone was talking, suddenly, a white light shot into the sky from afar, instantly attracting everyone’s attention.
Not far away, an instructor widened his eyes and said, “Who is it? Are you students so efficient? Someone ran to the altar so quickly and successfully communicated with the heroic spirit?”
Many mentors also revealed shocked expressions.
“Which class?”
“It’s the battle department (3) class. After they were disbanded, they were brought to the Heroic Ruins by class monitor Yu Shu…”
At this moment, no matter if it was the teachers, students, or instructors, they couldn’t sit still anymore.. They all ran towards the Heroic Ruins to see what the battle department (3) class was doing over there.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - Summoning the Spirit
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Summoning the Spirit
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Damn.”
“Someone beat me to it.”
After arriving at an unfamiliar place, most of the students were still a little restrained.
Without the guidance of mentors and instructors, no one dared to wander around for a moment.
They only communicated in a small area and waited for lunch.
But at this moment, a class ran to the Heroic Spirit Ruins on its own and even successfully summoned the Heroic Spirit, shocking everyone.
“Battle Department (3) class, Yu Shu?”
“Meow.”
“It must be Yu Shu who summoned the heroic spirit!”
At the archeology Department (1) class, Wang Ling was stunned when he heard the discussion in the distance.
Why was Yu Shu so fast?
He had just arrived here not long ago, why did he run over?
Was he in a hurry to reincarnate?
“Are we going too?”
“Of course.”
“There are only so many heroic spirits in the ruins. There won’t be a single one after summoning one. Let’s go and see who the Battle Department’s people have summoned.”
The archeology Department (1) class also quickly followed the crowd to the Heroic Ruins.
…
The Heroic Ruins was a modified special ruin.
It couldn’t move, be entered, or be damaged.
It was an altar with the outside world.
This altar couldn’t be destroyed either. Moving, even the attack of the totem creature couldn’t hurt it at all.
When humans stood on the altar, they had a chance to communicate with the ruins space and summon heroic spirits.
At this moment.
The huge altar connected to the heroic spirit ruins was heavily sealed.
This place had always been heavily guarded, and it was not allowed to enter easily.
However, during the military training of the students of Ancient Capital University, the students could freely go through the blockade line and onto the altar to try to communicate with the heroic spirit.
The battle department (3) class was the first class to come here.
At this moment, a young man stood on the altar in a daze and surprise. He felt the white light around him and was at a loss.
Did it really succeed?
He had actually obtained the recognition of a certain heroic spirit?
The young man was very happy.
Not far from him, the surrounding soldiers revealed envious expressions.
The other students in the Combat Department (3) class also had looks of envy. In the crowd, Yu Shu chuckled and said, “Impressive.”
“Brother Tao, heh~”
The first to take the initiative to ascend the altar and try to summon the heroic spirit was not Yu Shu.
It was a Spirit Medium that Ancient Capital University had dug out from Shen Du City, Tao Yi.
In the vocation assessment of the Divine Capital, he was ranked at the front and was also a Beast Tamer with very good strength.
However, at this moment, only a few people paid attention to Tao Yi.
More people looked at the altar shining with white light and the sky above the altar that had turned into chaos.
They wanted to see what kind of heroic spirit he had summoned.
At this moment, the sky above the altar was blurry and light was chaotic. It was like an illusory scene.
“It looks like a mirage…” Someone muttered.
After the white light shone, the heroic spirit didn’t appear immediately.
Instead, it was this mirage-like chaotic area that began to reach the soul. In a form similar to telepathy, with words, it replicated this heroic spirit’s achievements!
Apart from that, a heroic man in armor and holding a bow appeared in the sky.
The man’s face was blurry, but his figure was tall and imposing.
[Sky Formation Army, Divine Shooting Camp, Lu Zhizhou]
Soon, his name appeared.
Everyone present immediately knew his identity.
Not only was it because the heroic spirit ruins had teleported his name to everyone’s hearts, but also because Lu Zhizhou’s deeds had been recorded in detail. Everyone was familiar with it.
“It’s actually Lu Zhizhou.”
“It’s him…?”
Tao Yi was a little afraid. He felt that he didn’t deserve his recognition.
[Lu Zhizhou, a Beast Tamer from the Heaven Array Army of the three legions under Emperor Shi…]
[At the end of the first totem battle, the battle of Sky Island Pass began. The Divine Shooting Camp was ordered to guard Sky Island Pass and stop the attack of the Feather Demon Empire.]
[At this moment, the difference in the strength of both parties is huge. Our supply is insufficient, and the battle is urgent. Lu Zhizhou, a member of the Divine Shooting Camp, took the initiative to activate the special array symbol left behind by the Heavenly Formation General. At the cost of burning all his and the five battle pets’ lives, he shot out the Resplendent Arrow, igniting the determination of all the members of the Divine Shooting Camp.]
[For two days and two nights, the Divine Shooting Camp waited for reinforcements at the cost of the remaining three and countless sacrifices. They blocked the attack of the Feather Demon Empire and completed the defense mission.]
Then, the heroic spirit ruins even showed Lu Zhizhou’s life experience. He died at the age of 33. From the time he became a Beast Tamer at the age of 17, he had responded to the battle of the totems and fought for 16 years.
His talent was ordinary, and even when he died, he was only a master-level Beast Tamer in today’s time.
As an ordinary member of the Divine Shooting Camp, he could face overlord-level creatures and resist at the cost of his life.
After everyone understood Lu Zhizhou’s merits, the traces of his strength and the heroic spirit formed by the power of faith finally appeared.
A white bow wrapped in a white cyclone appeared in the sky under the convergence of light. This was Lu Zhizhou’s heroic spirit embodiment.
However, after the heroic spirit of the bow appeared, it wasn’t over yet. The heroic spirit of the bow gathered strength in the sky, and its light was dazzling. It aimed at Tao Yi, making Tao Yi take a deep breath.
“After the heroic spirit appears, it might directly recognize its master, or it might choose to test the Beast Tamer who summoned it. If the summoner can’t pass the test, the heroic spirit will disappear on its own.” A large number of people had already gathered outside the altar.
More than 600 students had already arrived.
The mentors of the various classes, the instructors here, as well as the top masters of the Xu, Li, and various other classes also stared at the altar, and were planning to see if this student could pass the test.
“It’s actually not Yu Shu, but Tao Yi. He’s not bad either. His father is a martyr… Perhaps he was influenced by him since he was young.” Dean He looked ahead with mixed emotions.
In short, he was happy that their students from the Combat Department could obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit!
“It’s not Yu Shu. I don’t know him.” At the archeology Department (1) class, after everyone saw the situation in front of them, they started discussing.
“Lu Zhizhou, I’ve seen his story in the textbook…”
“He should be a master-level Beast Tamer. His trump card battle pet is the ‘Falling Feather Bow’.”
“I didn’t expect his heroic spirit form to also be a bow and arrow…”
In this world, mountains, rivers, and plants could all evolve. Books, swords, and swords could also nurture spirits. However, for some reason, after a historical break, weapons became unable to nurture spirits and complete evolution. Instead, in the modern era, mechanical weapons replaced these.
Beep…
[Discover information]
At the same time, below, Shi Yu, who had arrived, activated the index.
Unfortunately, there was no information.
This was the first time Shi Yu had seen “unknown” on Bureau 11’s index.
He originally wanted to see the racial level and growth level of this bow spirit.
However, it seemed that this bow and arrow spirit had yet to completely transform into an undead life form before it completely acknowledged the student in front of it.
Amazing!
How exactly did Emperor Shi manage to imprint the power traces of so many people and things here and make them become heroic spirits in the future? Shi Yu was extremely curious.
How great was this power?
“Come on!!!” At this moment, this student named Tao Yi from the battle department also steeled his heart and was incomparably excited. He planned to accept Lu Zhizhou’s heroic spirit’s test.
He summoned his pet and planned to withstand the attack with all his might!
Outside the altar.
Wang Ling said, “If this Tao Yi can pass the test, he will soar into the sky…”
“Lu Zhizhou was a master-level Beast Tamer when he was alive. With the support of the power of the Time Emperor and the power of faith in the future, his heroic spirit won’t be lower than the potential of a low-level monarch.”
“The upper limit of growth is very high!”
At this moment, Tao Yi, who was looking at the test from various places, started discussing it.
“Do we judge the race level by the strength of the heroic spirit when it was alive?” Someone from the archeology Department (1) class asked Wang Ling.
Wang Ling, a Spirit Medium, clearly knew more about this kind of undead ruins.
“It depends on strength and merits,” Wang Ling said. “It’s also related to the power of faith.”
“At that time, what level would the heroic spirits of the three generals under the emperor be?” Shi Yu also stood beside Wang Ling and asked as he looked at the altar.
Wang Ling said in front of the whole class,
“Under Emperor Shi, the three generals are equivalent to our modern ‘Titled Legends’. They are experts who can fight against totem-level creatures. Their heroic spirits must have the potential of overlords, and it’s very likely that they are a high-level overlord race.”
“Bai Lin, Tian Zhen, and Zhen Hai, the three great generals, also have one deputy general each. They are also equivalent to the legendary Beast Tamers of our later generations. Among these three deputy generals, someone has been summoned. Their heroic spirits’ growth potential is not inferior to low-level overlords.”
“Apart from the three great armies, there are also ten ordinary legendary generals under the command of Emperor Shi. Their heroic spirits have potential levels that aren’t inferior to overlord races.”
“Also, the peerless Iron Blood Hundred Battles Generals, the souls of these generals, have potential levels are all high-level monarch races.”
“As for warriors like Lu Zhizhou, who were master-level when they were alive and had huge merits, their heroic spirit potential levels won’t be lower than monarch races.”
“It’s because of this that the heroic spirit ruins are a treasure left behind by Emperor Shi for the future generations. It’s the foundation to ensure the eternal survival of Dong Huang! Emperor Shi is awesome!”
Wang Ling blushed as he spoke. His requirements weren’t high either. As long as he could obtain the recognition of one of the hundred battle generals under Emperor Shi, he would have no regrets in his life.
Boom!!!!
At this moment, Tao Yi had already endured the dazzling attack of the bow spirit.
In the huge energy shock wave, endless light flickered.
As the light faded, Tao Yi and his pet’s miserable appearance appeared on the altar.
At this moment, Tao Yi looked at the bow spirit in the sky weakly and smiled. He had endured it.
“The heroic spirits are all tested according to the strength of the Beast Tamer who summoned it. They won’t be too difficult…” A knowledgeable person looked at the scene on the altar and nodded.
At this moment, on the altar, the light of the bow spirit dimmed, turning into a white object similar to a “seed” that landed in the student’s palm.
“Hahahaha, congratulations, congratulations!!”
At this moment, when everyone looked at this student enviously, the person in charge of the military training, Xu Kai, laughed and said,
“You’re called Tao Yi, right? Congratulations on obtaining the recognition of Senior Lu Zhizhou’s heroic spirit. You have to inherit his will well!!”
“Yes!!” Tao Yi’s expression was excited as he held the heroic soul seed.
At this moment, although he had yet to contract it, he could clearly feel the connection between him and the soul seed.
“Well done.” Dean He of the Combat Department also looked at Tao Yi in praise.
A moment later.
The laughing Xu Kai walked to his side and patted him on the shoulder. Then, he said to the more than 600 students present,
“Everyone, see this? This is the heroic spirit test I was talking about just now!”
“In the next seven days, all of you have the chance to ascend the altar and try to obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit!”
“Student Tao Yi, go down and rest. You’ve done very well,” Xu Kai said as he supported Tao Yi.
At this moment, outside the altar, the students immediately became lively.
The topic discussed by the archeology Department (1) class was discussed again in each class.
After learning that Tao Yi seemed to have obtained the recognition of a low-level monarch race heroic spirit, the students were even more envious and looked at the altar eagerly.
However, for a moment, many students were quite afraid.
After all, there were too many people here. Moreover, one person had just obtained recognition. If they went up now and didn’t obtain recognition, how awkward would it be?
“It’s my turn next, right?”
At this moment, Yu Shu, who had brought Tao Yi over, smiled and looked at the altar.
Tao Yi’s strength and talent were inferior to his. If he could obtain the recognition of the ruins, he definitely could too!
With that, Yu Shu wanted to walk towards the altar.
At the same time, another person walked towards the altar.
“Shi Yu…” In the archeology Department (1) class, everyone, including Wang Ling, was originally hesitating.
However, the curious Shi Yu couldn’t wait at all. He couldn’t help it.
After witnessing the wonders of the heroic spirit ruins, he didn’t have the mood to watch anymore. He couldn’t wait to immediately go up and try to see which ancient heroic spirit he could summon.
Yu Shu and Shi Yu, these two social buffs, were directly stuck in front of the blockade at the same time.
It fell into the eyes of all the mentors, instructors, and students.
Outside the blockade, the corners of Yu Shu’s mouth twitched as he looked at Shi Yu beside him. His stomach hurt.
“What are you doing?” he asked.
“To the altar,” Shi Yu said.
Yu Shu :”…”
I f*cking knew you were going to the altar, but why did you come with me!
“Why don’t you go first?” Shi Yu saw that Yu Shu looked like he wanted to eat him up and said helplessly.
“No, you first!” Yu Shu turned around speechlessly. No, he wanted to see what Shi Yu could summon first.
Only then could he be confident when he boarded.
With that, Yu Shu returned to the class and remained silent.
At this moment, all their gazes landed on Shi Yu.
“Uh.” Director Li looked at Shi Yu. He didn’t expect that Shi Yu, the big boss of Bureau 11 hidden among the new students, would be so curious about the Heroic Ruins so quickly.
But that was normal… The attraction of the Heroic Ruins to all Beast Tamers was terrifying.
“Next… can I go up?” Shi Yu asked the instructor who sealed the altar.
The instructors glanced at Xu Kai.
Xu Kai nodded.
Soon, the blockade was opened. Shi Yu boarded the altar under everyone’s gaze.
