Soon, the blockade was let in. Shi Yu boarded the altar under everyone’s gaze.
The other students also discussed.
“It’s Shi Yu…”
“He’s here again.”
“On the day of the club assessment… he was too monstrous.”
“I wonder if he can obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit…”
“Generally speaking, the more you come into contact with undead, the easier it is to obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit. This is also why the chances of a Spirit Medium obtaining the recognition of the heroic spirit are higher. Shi Yu’s three pets don’t have one undead element. It shouldn’t be that easy…”
“But he has the gift of telepathy. It’s hard to say if he can communicate with everything…”
Not only the students, but the examiners and teachers also looked at Shi Yu solemnly.
Although not everyone knew the identity of a member of Bureau 11 Shi Yu, they knew the identity of the top scholar in the assessment in Ancient Capital.
He also knew that Shi Yu was a new star in the archeology world.
They were also very concerned about Shi Yu’s performance in the Heroic Ruins.
“Actually, no matter what kind of heroic spirit’s recognition I can obtain, as long as I can resonate with it, I’ll be rich…”
Many people discussed below, because the heroic spirits that appeared in the heroic spirit ruins were rarely lower than monarch races.
Even if the predecessor of the heroic spirit was only an ordinary soldier, the symbol of an army had long been sublimated to the extreme under the erosion of the power of the Time Emperor and history, becoming extraordinary.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already ascended the altar.
Standing on the altar, he felt very strange.
However, after more than ten seconds, there was still no reaction from the ruins.
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu shouted at the ruins through telepathy twice, but there was still no response.
“Well, do you need any specific actions or language to communicate with the heroic spirit…” Shi Yu looked down at everyone shyly.
Everyone :”…”
Yu Shu looked at Shi Yu speechlessly and shouted, “There’s no need. Just close your eyes and meditate. Don’t worry, it usually takes about one minute.”
Shi Yu nodded. So that was the case.
He began to wait quietly.
Moreover, after his heart settled down, his heart was sincere, and his heart was sincere… Seniors in the ruins, come out!
Miss General Ice Dragon, your Ice Dragon misses you and dragged me to bring you a message!
“A minute.”
A moment later, Shi Yu looked up.
The one minute law really worked.
In an instant, endless light appeared from the altar, and the light shot into the sky. Everyone widened their eyes.
Boom!!!
Below, Tao Yi, who had just gone down, widened his eyes.
All the students widened their eyes.
The phenomenon of Tao Yi summoning a heroic spirit… appeared again!!
“There’s a reaction!”
“Shi Yu and a certain heroic spirit have resonated!”
“I knew it.” Director Li’s eyes lit up.
As a member of Bureau 11, how could Shi Yu not be able to summon a spirit?
The only problem now was which heroic spirit Shi Yu had summoned and which one he had resonated with.
“Could it be a warrior spirit with the potential level of a high-level monarch among the hundred battle generals!” Director Li looked forward to it.
“This guy…” Yu Shu, Wang Ling, and the others didn’t expect Shi Yu to really be able to summon it successfully. Their hearts skipped a beat as they looked at the sky, wanting to know the story of the heroic spirit Shi Yu had summoned.
The students, teachers, instructors, and everyone looked up at the sky.
Soon, in the chaotic area that was like a mirage, the image of a valiant woman in armor with long hair but an unclear appearance appeared.
Although their faces couldn’t be seen clearly, everyone could feel her aura that far exceeded that of a man, the demeanor of a leader, and the aura that shocked the top masters present.
“A female general???” Everyone revealed shocked expressions when they saw the English phantom Shi Yu had summoned.
If it was said that he was only shocked at the start, then next, all the pores on his body seemed to have exploded, and his eyes nearly popped out.
[Ice Dragon General Mu Huiyin, Titled General under Emperor Shi, the strongest general under Emperor Shi, a heroine among women!]
[Mu Huiyin has never married in her life. She dedicated her life to the Dong Huang Ancient Country. In the battle of the totems, she resisted five totem attacks with a single soldier posture, killed 39 overlords, and destroyed countless monarchs…]
As the merits of the heroic spirit phantom appeared bit by bit, everyone was shocked to the extreme. They looked at Shi Yu, who was squinting on the altar, in shock!!
How was this possible?!
Who was this?!
Ice Dragon General?!
The strongest general under Emperor Shi?!
Why had they never heard of it…
After blocking five totem attacks, killing 39 overlords, and destroying countless monarchs… This battle result was completely not inferior to the other three generals!!
Damn, Shi Yu, are you still human???
How did he do it???
At the same time, on the altar.
“It’s not Emperor Shi’s Spirit…” Shi Yu looked at the phantom.. The Ice Dragon General was also very good. It was just nice to rectify the reputation of the Ice Dragon General!

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - Ice Dragon General
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Ice Dragon General
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Ancient Capital, ruins protected area, Heroic Ruins, above the summoning altar.
At this moment, as a peerless and extraordinary figure appeared from the heroic spirit ruins, everyone around the altar suddenly fell silent.
He looked at the figure quietly.
And her contribution introduction.
Wang Ling, Yu Shu, and the others had dry voices.
Damn, how was this possible?
It was off the charts!
“This…”
Director Li, Dean He, Instructor Xu, and the others were also stunned.
A legendary general that had never been recorded in history?
The strongest individual general under Emperor Shi??
Everyone felt as if their hearts had been squeezed.
From the merits introduction, this seemed to be the second strongest battle power of the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty!
Unbelievable!
Why wasn’t such a person recorded in the history books?
Also, if everything that was happening in front of him was real… Then this should be the strongest heroic spirit that had appeared in the ruins of the heroic spirit.
How did Shi Yu summon such an existence…
This boy was really a monster.
“The fourth general…” In the crowd, Wang Ling suddenly recalled what Shi Yu had said to him in class. His brain suddenly buzzed.
[Shi Yu: As everyone knows, there are four of the three generals. There’s nothing wrong with that, right?]
“Holy shit.” Wang Ling was shocked.
He felt that he and Shi Yu were not playing the same game.
So Shi Yu already knew what he could summon before coming here?
Specified summoning?
Cheating!
No wonder Shi Yu said that he wanted to communicate with the ruins from an archeological perspective…
“Wait, wait.”
“It’s not fair?”
After the phantom of the Ice Dragon General appeared, everyone held their breaths and focused on waiting for the Heroic Ruins to introduce Mu Huiyin’s life.
For example, Lu Zhizhou just now, apart from his merits, the ruins also recorded almost all of his life from his birth to his death in the form of a brief introduction.
Although Lu Zhizhou’s story was also recorded in the history books, the more detailed records in the heroic spirit ruins were undoubtedly another confirmation and supplement to history.
Compared to Lu Zhizhou, Mu Huiyin was undoubtedly more mysterious now. Her achievements were even more shocking!
Everyone wanted to know everything about this mysterious general.
“Why not?”
“Why isn’t it showing anymore?”
Everyone waited.
However, a moment later, everyone was stunned.
Apart from the name and huge merits, there didn’t seem to be any more detailed information about Mu Huiyin in the Heroic Ruins.
It seemed that not only in history, but even the time emperor who built the heroic spirit ruins didn’t have much information about her!
“Why…” Shi Yu stared at the phantom and was very confused.
It was fine if there were no records in history.
Why weren’t there any records of the heroic spirit ruins?
As a national hero of that era, there was no reason for this treatment.
There must be some unknown information hidden among them!
Why didn’t the frost dragon say so at that time!
Just as everyone didn’t know what was going on, something unexpected happened.
“Impossible…”
“What’s going on…”
Looking at the sky above the altar, some students suddenly spoke in shock.
Shi Yu’s gaze suddenly constricted.
At this moment, Mu Huiyin’s figure seemed to have walked out of the heroic spirit ruins, gradually revealing her clear face.
After all, for thousands of years, the appearance and figure of the heroic spirits summoned from the ruins were almost unclear.
But when it came to the Ice Dragon General… it completely changed.
In the next moment, everyone was stunned by the Ice Dragon General in front of them.
She had a beautiful face and was peerlessly handsome. She was wearing armor and a longsword. She had red hair and red eyes. Outside her phantom body that was like a soul, she was wrapped in spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun. Her aura was peerless!
It really was like an ancient general descending into this world!
What was even more unbelievable was that everyone could clearly see Mu Huiyin’s gaze sweeping across everyone.
This made everyone open their mouths in disbelief.
Then, the spirit body that landed on the altar locked onto Shi Yu and spoke slowly.
“How many years is it now?”
Her voice sounded, shocking everyone.
Holy shit!
Holy shit!
As the spiritual body that appeared from the heroic spirit ruins spoke, everyone present widened their eyes again. How was this possible!!
Weren’t the heroic spirits summoned from the heroic spirit ruins brand new life forms without any memories?!
What was going on!!!
The spirit… spoke??
Shi Yu was also slightly shocked.
This didn’t make sense!
According to his understanding, the heroic spirits here couldn’t possibly have consciousness.
What had he awakened…
“2300 years after Emperor Shi established the Dong Huang Dynasty.”
Shi Yu endured his shock and looked at the heroic spirit he had accidentally summoned.
Mu Huiyin’s expression was emotionless.
“Is the dynasty still around?”
“The dynasty established by Emperor Shi has already died, but later on, someone rebuilt it again and repeated it until now.”
Shi Yu replied.
“Why was it destroyed?”
Mu Huiyin asked.
“I don’t know,” Shi Yu answered and asked, “You don’t know either?”
Mu Huiyin shook her head.
“Including me, all the spiritual bodies here are traces of power preserved by Emperor Shi through the power of time. I don’t know what happened in the late stages of the dynasty.”
“I’m just a trace of Mu Huiyin’s power. Perhaps she experienced everything herself, but I’ve always been here.”
She was an exception. She was the only spiritual body here that preserved part of its consciousness, and the only heroic spirit whose life had not been recorded.
After Mu Huiyin finished speaking, Director Li and the other archeological faculty mentors trembled slightly.
As expected.
There were many theories in the archeology world about how Emperor Shi modified the heroic spirit ruins!
Among them, some said that it was Emperor Shi who buried all the heroic souls here.
Some also said that Emperor Shi had copied a portion of their power at a certain node through the power of time, preserved it, and branded it here. Then, the traces of power settled over time and became heroic spirits under the baptism of the power of faith.
From the looks of it, it was indeed the latter.
The true bodies and souls of those heroes had either been destroyed or buried somewhere.
As for the undead born in the ruins of the heroic spirit, they were the same as the sword spirits and book spirits evolved from the elemental life forms evolved from the elements. They were completely new transcendent undead born from the combination of traces of power and faith.
Because of this, there were no memories of the predecessor. Because of this, there were various forms. Because of this, the forms of power were almost the same…
Emperor Shi’s method shocked the Beast Tamers present again.
This was equivalent to creating a new undead race.
His methods were not much weaker than Mechanics who could create mechanical lives in the modern era.
Time element… was indeed mysterious and powerful.
At this moment, when he heard Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit’s answer, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Didn’t she know anything?
From the looks of it, this heroic spirit didn’t know about the subsequent suppression of the Ice River Totem by Mu Huiyin and the frost dragon?
After all, this ruin had been established quite early. Mu Huiyin should still be young at that time.
“Why… are there no records of you here or in the outside world?”
Shi Yu asked Mu Huiyin’s spirit.
He had a new guess.
Standing on the altar of the heroic spirit ruins, Shi Yu wanted to understand two things.
He wanted to know why Emperor Shi died and why the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty was destroyed.
Second, it was why the Ice Dragon General was not recorded in history.
Mu Huiyin’s spirit body didn’t answer.
However, when Shi Yu looked at the characteristics of the Ice Dragon General, he deduced, “You didn’t get Emperor Shi to record your story?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Mu Huiyin looked at him.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu.
“Did that dragon tell you?”
“I guessed so.”
How could there be no record of a top legend whose battle power was off the charts and whose battle merits were off the charts? It was most likely that someone had deliberately erased her traces.
“Then continue to guess why I erased my traces.” There was no change in Mu Huiyin’s expression.
She and Shi Yu looked at each other.
At this moment, all the instructors, mentors, and students present were numb. They had no idea what was going on in front of them.
The situation was terrifying.
Even Instructor Xu and the others were trembling.
Damn, the fourth general under Emperor Shi… who knew it’d be this exciting? Also, this student named Shi Yu, he was so brave.
On the altar, Shi Yu looked straight at the Ice Dragon General.
The difference between Mu Huiyin and the image in his mind was very big.
He originally thought that the Ice Dragon General came from the Icefield Tribe, contracted the Ice Dragon, and titled the Ice Dragon. It would be a Beast Tamer with the talent of ice-element Beast Taming, but… from the fluctuations of her strength, her strength was fire-element!
This didn’t make sense!
The power of the Ice Dragon General, the owner of the Ice Dragon, had talent that leaned towards fire? Moreover, her hair color and eye color…
“You… aren’t a purebred human?” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
In that unstable period, a top expert had always fought alone. Apart from being ridiculously strong and no one could cooperate with her, there was another possibility. It was very difficult for her to integrate into the group, or rather, she didn’t want to integrate into the group.
In addition, if there was a reason why someone didn’t want their identity to be recorded, there was a possibility that even she hated her identity.
Shi Yu looked at the various characteristics of the Ice Dragon General. Her image gradually overlapped with the image of another character in history. He judged that she wasn’t a purebred human, but a hybrid of a human and another race!
At this moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, the Ice Dragon General still didn’t say anything. Instead, the 600 plus students present suddenly opened their mouths wide with shock.
Holy shit.
What was Shi Yu saying…
They looked at the heroic spirit of the Ice Dragon General in disbelief.
At this moment, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit looked at the humans present with a calm expression. “You don’t seem to dislike this identity.”
She didn’t deny Shi Yu’s speculation.
Moreover, she discovered that when the people of later generations heard this, their reaction was very different from the humans of her era.
Those who were not of the same race would definitely have different hearts. This was the common concept of that era.
But now, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit strangely discovered that many young humans were looking at her with stars in their eyes, as if they worshiped and were curious… Their thoughts were especially open.
Unbelievable…
“Of course not,” Shi Yu said. “After all, you’re the hero of Dong Huang.”
“That’s really a good era,” Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit said.
In her era, even if she became a human hero in the end, she still couldn’t be trusted.
Mu Huiyin, who had had enough of being ostracized and suspected, finally chose to dilute her existence.
It was even to the extent that because of this, she didn’t marry in her lifetime and completely severed this bloodline.
Because of this bloodline, she went through a lot of pain and could only contract powerful ice-type pets to cool down her strength.
The mixed blood gave her talent and potential, as well as many difficulties.
She didn’t want such a bloodline to be passed down to future generations.
Apart from this heroic spirit ruin, there should be very few places with her name.
“Is there anyone similar to me in history?” Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit asked.
Shi Yu nodded.
“There was a Great Empress in the future, just like you. She wasn’t a pure human, but she ended the totem war that lasted for decades and united the Dong Huang Land again, becoming a legendary Beast Tamer like Emperor Shi.”
Empress!
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, most of the people present revealed looks of admiration. After all, this was also a great legendary figure who had liberated the Dong Huang Human Race from the hands of the totems.
In history, there were indeed many hybrids like Mu Huiyin. Their birth was a tragedy. In ancient times, they were indeed excluded. Only when the empress appeared out of nowhere did this situation change.
At this moment, when she heard Shi Yu’s words, Mu Huiyin’s expression was in a daze.
“I see. I’m inferior to her,” Mu Huiyin was relieved.
However, combined with the information that the Dong Huang Dynasty had been destroyed and the Dong Huang land had fallen into totem war again, she couldn’t help but shake her head.
In her opinion, the destruction of the Dong Huang Dynasty was not something difficult to accept. Instead, she had long expected it.
Emperor Shi’s ambition was too big.
After expelling the totem, he was not satisfied.
He also wanted to live forever and become a legend, immortal forever.
He even locked his sights onto the sleeping Mythical creature.
If he succeeded, he would soar into the sky. If he failed, he would disappear.
Although he didn’t know what path Emperor Shi chose later, from the looks of it, the outcome wasn’t very good.
This caused Dong Huang to encounter a huge calamity and fall into war again.
Fortunately… it looked like the humans in the future had survived.
After saying that, she looked at Shi Yu.
“Since you’ve awakened me, let’s see if you have the right to inherit my power.”
More than two thousand years ago, in order to leave some power for the later generations, Emperor Shi used a certain super level time and undead dual-element skill that had been developed to the extreme to imprint the traces of the power of many heroes in the Dong Huang Dynasty, letting them rely on the power of time to grow into heroic spirits.
At that time, Mu Huiyin had also preserved a portion of her power and had now evolved into an undead life form.
She looked at the sword beside her.
To be precise, the traces of her power had evolved into sword spirits.
A sword spirit of the fire element and the undead element.
Perhaps it was also related to her liking to use the sword. She had sealed her talent bloodline power inside.
This was an extremely violent sword spirit. She originally didn’t want it to be born, because probably very few Beast Tamers could control it. However, Shi Yu had awakened her with the aura of the ice dragon. At that moment, she could only try to test Shi Yu and see if he had the qualifications to control it.
“After passing my test, I’ll give you the Strength Soul Seed. You can hatch and contract it yourself.”
The appearance of Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit shocked everyone present.
No one had expected that there was still a Titled Great General with extraordinary battle power under Emperor Shi’s command who wasn’t a purebred human.
He looked at Shi Yu in envy. Shi Yu… was about to obtain a young undead spirit of a suspected overlord race?!
“What test?” Shi Yu looked up with great interest.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - Sword Spirit Possession
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Sword Spirit Possession
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“What test?”
When Shi Yu asked, everyone present gulped.
It would probably be very difficult to completely obtain the recognition of this heroic spirit whose predecessor’s battle power was comparable to a totem.
Could Shi Yu pass the so-called test?
“Two.”
Mu Huiyin’s spirit spoke.
“The first condition depends on whether you can withstand the possession of a sword spirit below the same level. This is a test of your body, heart, and will.”
“Second path, control the sword spirit and defeat me.”
As soon as he finished speaking, most of the people watching felt their hearts beat faster.
Putting aside what the first test was, how was the second test possible?
Although the current heroic spirit was only a trace of power, it still had to be considered just who it was that left this power.
Moreover, in the long river of time, these traces of power did not weaken because of time. Instead, they gradually became stronger!
The test… was to fight an ancient general that was comparable to a totem?
Moreover, he had to win?
Even if it was a battle of the same level, this was also a fantasy, right?
At this moment, Mu Huiyin, who had red hair and red eyes, pulled out her sword. Her sword floated quietly in the sky.
Just like the Ice Dragon General, this sword was also in a spiritual body posture. It was wrapped in fire spiritual aura that was like the sun, dazzling.
The body of this sword was red, showing patterns, as well as Yang flames. The flames around it were oppressive, and two words were carved: Red Sparrow.
A moment later, the longsword fell into the altar and was inserted into it. It wasn’t really inserted, but in the form of a spiritual body, as if it had fused. Half of the sword’s body fused into the altar, leaving only half the sword and the hilt.
“Sword… Is this the final form of the Strength Soul Seed?” Shi Yu looked at the Sword Spirit.
His gaze trembled.
Just now, he was just very interested, very interested.
Now, seeing this sword, it was the universe’s invincible super, super, and special interest.
Sword Spirit!
It was a sword!!!
This was more handsome than an archer. Shi Yu had already begun to imagine himself riding an Iron-eating Beast and then being possessed by a sword spirit, killing one small totem at a time.
“Yes, and no.”
Mu Huiyin said, “The Strength Soul will indeed transform into the form of a sword spirit in the end, but what it looks like in the end depends on the person who hatches it.”
“The Red Sparrow is just my sword, it’s a weapon I use to seal the power of my talent bloodline. In the end, it and I will completely disappear and integrate into the soul seed to become a new sword spirit.”
“Do you want to take the test?”
Mu Huiyin said, “Let me remind you in advance that there will be life and death danger.”
“The sword spirit is evolved from the traces of my power. Even if it’s only at the transcendent level, it needs the body and soul of a Beast Tamer above fifth-grade to withstand its power.”
“In order to suppress my own strength, I was forced to contract many ice-element battle beasts and become the Ice Dragon General you name me as.”
“This is a sword spirit with extremely violent power. Ordinary Beast Tamers can’t control it.”
When Mu Huiyin finished speaking, everyone present was speechless.
F*ck…
How strong were they?
Other contracted pets were all to better use their talent.
But this person did it to suppress her strength!
In addition, even if the sword spirit was at the transcendent level, it needed the physical and soul strength of a Beast Tamer above fifth-grade to control it?
In ancient times, the Dong Huang Dynasty had undergone a period of grading for the Beast Tamer level.
There were nine grades in total. Ninth grades was equivalent to a Beast Tamer intern. The initial level of the eighth-level vocation, the intermediate level of the seventh-level vocation, and the advanced level of the sixth-level vocation. As for the fifth-level, it was naturally the current master level!
In theory, if one wanted to control a transcendent-level pet, one just had to be a primary-level Beast Tamer. The second level of the Beast Taming Space was enough.
However, this sword spirit needed a level-five Beast Taming Space?
After everyone judged, there was only one possibility. Using the easier way to understand it now, it was that the racial level of the sword spirit was ridiculously high!
At the very least, there had to be a high-level overlord race, or even higher. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have such strict requirements for Beast Tamers.
“I’ve controlled its power to the transcendent level.”
“If you can pick it up with your own strength, the first test will be considered to be a pass.”
“If you can’t take the current one, you definitely won’t be able to control the new one in the future.”
Ice Dragon General’s expression was calm as she explained the truth.
“Shi Yu, why don’t we forget it?” At this moment, Director Li frowned at the Sword Spirit in the crowd.
“That sword spirit’s energy is very violent and strong. The load it brings might already be close to the level of a monarch. This is not suitable for ordinary Beast Tamers to contract at all.”
“Your Beast Taming Space is only level three, right? Your own safety is more important,” Dean He said.
They also hoped that Shi Yu could obtain the recognition of the sword spirit. This was a huge gain for Ancient Capital University and even for Dong Huang.
However, as top-notch masters, they could clearly sense the horror of the power of this sword spirit.
“Even if I want to pick it up, I’ll probably have to withstand a certain amount of pressure.” After Instructor Xu sensed it, his gaze was solemn. This was only a transcendent-level sword spirit.
It could be said that even if an ordinary master-level mentor went up now, they might not necessarily be able to withstand the power of the sword spirit.
The three top-notch masters persuaded.
However, many students realized that Shi Yu was still staring at the sword spirit seriously.
“Forget it, I know you’re very impressive, but don’t try random things like this.” Among the students, Yu Shu actually spoke too.
Although he was envious and jealous of Shi Yu, as a Spirit Medium, he knew the drawbacks of the undead element very well.
Especially the drawbacks of undead-type pets that could be possessed.
Most necromancers relied on devouring the life, soul, spirit, and physical growth of the Beast Tamer. Under the possession state, although it could increase the combat power of the Beast Tamer, the requirements for the Beast Tamer’s physique were ridiculously high, and the consumption was even greater than the Beast Tamer’s talent.
Shi Yu clearly had no experience in the school of necromancy, so he didn’t know the danger.
Shi Yu really couldn’t withstand a heroic spirit that was number one below Emperor Shi.
Moreover, there had never been a situation of going easy on the test of the heroic spirit ruins.
“Thank you for the reminder.”
“However, I still want to try.” Shi Yu looked at the sword spirit. Was the requirement for the strength of the body and the strength of the soul very high?
Shi Yu stepped forward and walked to the sword spirit.
At this moment, everyone held their breaths. They saw Shi Yu directly place his right hand on the sword hilt.
If it were any other request, Shi Yu might still be afraid.
However, his physical strength and soul strength, the feedback of his two lifetimes and the skill index, had reached the limit of his physical body at every stage. He was not weak at all.
Although he was only an intermediate Beast Tamer now, his physical strength had long reached the level of a top-notch master.
Boom!!!
The sun-like fire spiritual energy wrapped around the sword hilt directly wrapped around Shi Yu’s palm.
Although the sword spirit was only a spirit body, Shi Yu still touched it directly.
At that moment, Shi Yu felt as if he had plunged his hand into the sun. It was extremely hot. The heat instantly invaded his entire body, causing Shi Yu to be instantly covered in sweat. His entire body seemed to be drenched in sweat.
As Shi Yu touched the sword spirit, the sword spirit’s power was also released. With a boom, a huge heat wave erupted from the sword spirit. With a hum, a terrifying hot wind surged in all directions!
“What—”
Almost instantly, the students surrounding the altar felt dizzy as if they had suffered a heat stroke. At this moment, the entire altar and the surrounding ground were scorched by the sun. The thick air seemed to have frozen. The terrifying heat pressure made the students present unable to breathe and feel powerless to move.
“Quickly retreat!!!”
The master-level mentors present also didn’t expect the power emitted by the sword spirit to be so terrifying. They almost made this group of students faint from the heat. At this moment, beads of sweat also flowed down their heads. They hurriedly organized the students and retreated.
“So hot.”
“It’s impossible for fire-type elemental life forms to have this temperature, right?”
Many students felt troubled.
This temperature… transcendent? It was ridiculous.
However, what was even more ridiculous was everything on the altar. After recovering, everyone looked at the altar in disbelief.
At this moment, the sword spirit was like a sun wrapped around its blade, as if it could instantly turn all external objects into dust. The current altar was like a scorching hell. Even if a master-level Beast Tamer relied on himself, it would probably be very difficult to last long. That was the place with the highest temperature, like the core of the sun.
As the sword spirit erupted with power and they felt that this wasn’t a heroic spirit that ordinary Beast Tamers could control… Director Li, Director He, Instructor Feng, and the others regretted not stopping Shi Yu. How was this a transcendent-level sword spirit…
In theory, the burden produced by this sword spirit was probably something that only a top-notch master could withstand. However, as the blurry figure in the heat wave on the altar appeared, all the teachers and students who retreated widened their eyes.
Due to the core of the heat wave and the area with the highest temperature, Shi Yu’s hand was still firmly holding the sword spirit’s hilt.
At that moment, Shi Yu’s sweat had already evaporated. The fire spiritual energy that was like the sun wrapped around his entire body, as if it was burning his physical fitness, making him feel like he was in the hottest sea of fire.
Buzz!
As Shi Yu exerted strength, the sword spirit inserted on the altar loosened slightly.
Everyone revealed incredulous expressions.
How was that possible!
Not only did Shi Yu persist, but he also really made the sword spirit loosen up?
Was he really a human?
Mu Huiyin, who was also on the altar, didn’t show any expression, but she was already surprised that Shi Yu could do this.
Were the Beast Tamers of the later generations actually so trained?
When Shi Yu meditated on the altar to summon her, she could clearly sense Shi Yu’s realm. In her era, even if it was a Beast Tamer with special talent, it was definitely impossible for their training to reach Shi Yu’s level.
Even a hybrid like her might not necessarily be better than Shi Yu at the same level.
General Ice Dragon looked around the altar again and looked at the group of children who were bitterly persisting and seemed to have lost consciousness. She then looked at Shi Yu, who was in the center of the altar.
It seemed that this young Beast Tamer was extraordinary to be able to obtain the recognition of that dragon.
Like a humanoid ferocious beast, a huge power was hidden in its seemingly weak body.
“Damn, is he alright?”
“How exactly did he last?” Among the students, Yu Shu, Wang Ling, and the others didn’t expect that they had also suffered an undeserved calamity outside the altar. Sensing the power of the fire sword spirit’s eruption, they felt like their bodies were about to explode.
That Ice Dragon General didn’t lie… It was completely difficult to imagine what it would feel like if this power appeared in a person’s body. No wonder she had to rely on the power of an ice-type pet to suppress it.
However, at this moment, what made the students who resisted with difficulty but were unwilling to leave the heat… Was the unacceptable fact that Shi Yu, who was of similar level to them, was actually in the center of the heat wave at this moment, still slowly pulling out the sword spirit! Wasn’t this guy afraid of the heat?
What kind of monster was he!
On the altar, the sword spirit was slowly pulled out.
During this period, Shi Yu’s hair color and pupils were faintly visible. Coupled with the flames around him, he had almost turned from a Super Earthling to a Super Saiyan God. During this process, the power of the sword spirit was still gradually increasing, but Shi Yu also gradually began to adapt to the power of the fire sword spirit from a passive situation.
“Come out!” Shi Yu used all the strength in his body. His face was distorted to the extreme by the heat wave, and he was still forcefully pulling the sword spirit. Suddenly, with a boom, an even hotter orange flame erupted from the sword spirit. The fire was like a blazing sun. At this moment, the endless heat seemed to have been summoned by the fire overlord and gathered in the sword spirit again!
Hu hu hu ~
On the altar, amidst the dazzling flames, Shi Yu, who was pulling out his sword with both hands, suddenly felt relaxed. After the light flashed, the Sword Spirit’s entire body was directly revealed in Shi Yu’s vision!
With the sword spirit in hand, Shi Yu’s entire body was still wrapped in the sun-like fire spiritual energy. Under the state of the sword spirit’s possession, his hair, eyes, and body temporarily turned into a color similar to Mu Huiyin.
At this moment, time seemed to have stopped.
The students opened their mouths slightly and looked at the scene on the altar in disbelief.
Shi Yu, who had red eyes and was covered in flames, gave them the feeling that their hearts were trembling.
This was Shi Yu?
“Ridiculous.” Yu Shu widened his eyes and took a step back.
Damn, it was really pulled out?
This guy was indeed not human.
“He…”
“He’s indeed a monster!” Miao Dongdong also widened his eyes.
“It’s been pulled out?”
At this moment, the masters also felt that it was very unbelievable.
Seeing the flames submit and change in attitude in front of them, everyone swallowed their saliva crazily.
“It feels pretty good.”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at his hands in confusion, as well as the sword spirit in his hand.
Success?
This power…
At this moment, Shi Yu felt that his blood had turned into flames. Although the burden was huge, it had infinite power. Perhaps he could instantly one shot Baby Ginseng with this.
[Ginseng Baby:???]
No, maybe it could even burn space and instantly kill Buggy.
[Buggy:???]
Under the deep breaths of everyone present, Shi Yu’s gaze moved and looked at Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit.
Was this the form of a sword spirit’s possession? It was indeed powerful.
Although it was very draining, Shi Yu could clearly feel that it had given him some other enhancements, but he didn’t have time to explore it now.
“This… I should be considered to have completed the first test?” Shi Yu said, waiting for Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit’s response.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - Shi Yu vs Mu Huiyin
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Shi Yu vs Mu Huiyin
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Yes.”
She didn’t say much.
Instead, she continued, “Then… let’s begin the second test…”
As Mu Huiyin finished speaking, the students who were immersed in shock suddenly woke up.
They almost forgot that there were two tests. Everything wasn’t over yet!
After saying that, everyone suddenly realized that a chill had risen.
A snowstorm suddenly appeared out of thin air on the ridiculously hot altar!
Under the snowstorm, a huge dragon’s body slowly condensed…
“Roar!!!” A huge monster more than ten meters tall appeared.
The strong body of the creature in front of him was made of ice rocks. The color was ice-blue and dark purple, looking cold to the bone.
Not only its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, as well as its pair of wings, were all made of ice and stone. Its scales revealed coldness, and snow condensed!
Frost Dragon!!!
Upon seeing this fellow, Shi Yu was clearly stunned.
The surrounding students were also shocked.
What was going on… How did she summon it!
“F*ck, it’s an ice dragon again. Shi Yu can summon the Ice Dragon General. Could it be related to the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in Icefield City?” Yu Shu recalled that Shi Yu’s worm could also summon an ice dragon and couldn’t help but analyze.
The more he analyzed, the darker his expression became.
He suspected that there was a conspiracy behind this. He suspected that Shi Yu was here to make fun of him and that he wasn’t using a proper summoning channel!
At this moment, as the huge frost dragon appeared, the beautiful and peerless Mu Huiyin Spirit in armor slowly walked towards the frost dragon.
At this moment, this ice dragon phantom appeared and crawled down. It stretched out its huge claws, as if it was giving Mu Huiyin a staircase to climb its body.
Mu Huiyin walked up to the ice dragon’s body step by step. During this process, the hilt of her sword ignited with sun-like flames again, and a new sword spirit appeared.
A moment later, the Ice Dragon General stood on the Ice Dragon’s body and stared at Shi Yu, who was also holding a sword spirit.
“Mutated Frost Dragon, high-level overlord race, commander rank.”
“Defeat us.”
“Use the sword in your hand.”
“I’ll give you three chances to adapt.”
As Mu Huiyin finished speaking, even the top-notch masters’ voices were a little hoarse.
If it was said that everyone was still a little confused and feeling strange about the title of Ice Dragon General just now, then now, looking at Mu Huiyin standing on the body of the Ice Dragon, everyone only felt a strong pressure.
Defeat them?
From the looks of it, it was more than ten times harder than the first test.
This ice dragon was clearly a super ferocious beast that could casually help Mu Huiyin hunt overlords in ancient times!!
It was actually still a commander rank!!
Even with the support of the sword spirit, Shi Yu, an intermediate-level Beast Tamer, basically had no chance of winning.
In the face of Mu Huiyin in her current state, even if it was a master-level Beast Tamer, they wouldn’t dare to say that they could steadily defeat her. After all, her name was too famous. The strongest general under the Emperor Shi during the era of the Dong Huang Dynasty… In other words, she was the guardian of a country now!
At this moment, under the gaze of the Ice Dragon General, Shi Yu, who was holding a sword spirit, suddenly received two skill information.
It was a message from the sword spirit that possessed him.
Skill: Light Flame Sword
[Level]: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a fire-element skill. It needs to be used in the possession state. Focus the fire power on the sword and condense it into a Light Flame Sword with an extremely high temperature. It can instantly burn everything without a trace.
Skill: Interlocking Sword
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a fire-element skill. By concentrating the power of fire on the sword, it can absorb and integrate the power of the outside world. The more conflict this power has with the power of fire, the greater the increase in the power of the sword.
After receiving the skill information transmitted by the sword spirit, Shi Yu subconsciously condensed the so-called Light Flame Sword.
In the next moment, the sword spirit became extremely violent again.
Endless flames gathered on the sword, not only on the sword body, but also on Shi Yu’s body!
It was as if it was wrapped in the sun, and flames covered its body and blade. At this moment, Shi Yu felt that his arm was extremely heavy, as if it was extremely difficult to control a sword spirit. He couldn’t control it at all!
Sensing that the power of fire was about to burst him, Shi Yu lost control and aimed at the ice dragon. He could only release this power!
Boom!!!
Countless people looked at the altar and felt that the light in front of them was instantly snatched away. The world seemed to have fallen into darkness.
At this moment, everyone felt a fatal threat, as if they would fall into the abyss in the next second.
Then, with overflowing killing intent, a white light appeared. A sword light that seemed to have broken through the darkness streaked across, turning into a terrifying fire sword aura. When everyone reacted, they were already covered in sweat again.
At the same time, the sword light shooting out of the sword spirit in Shi Yu’s hand swept up an extremely huge pressure and flew towards Ice Dragon and Mu Huiyin.
“This power…”
At this moment, everyone’s hearts seemed to have been squeezed. They suspected the level of the sword spirit at this moment. Was this really the power a transcendent-level sword spirit could display with a Beast Tamer?
Even killing a commander-level ferocious beast with one strike didn’t seem impossible.
Sword spirits of high-level overlord races… People didn’t have any specific concept of this.
However, just as everyone was looking at the Flame Sword in shock, their expressions stopped in the next second.
On the frost dragon, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit slowly unsheathed its sword with a calm expression. In the next moment, it was as if a wind pressure suddenly rose, transforming into an invisible hand that crushed the sword light Shi Yu had swung out. A huge power erupted in the sky, and a terrifying power surged down like a meteor shower.
Although the scene was huge, but…
“It was resisted just like that?”
Countless people opened their mouths wide and looked at the Ice Dragon General.
“I’ll give you two more chances,” Mu Huiyin said to Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s palm was already injured from the burn and was trembling slightly.
However, as a ruthless person who injured himself and went to the infirmary in order to steal a skill, Shi Yu could still tolerate it!
“A mistake…”
Shi Yu raised his head and looked at Mu Huiyin on the ice dragon. He pinched his right hand with his left hand to stop it from trembling.
“This test allows the summoning of battle pets, right?” After realizing Mu Huiyin’s intention, Shi Yu confirmed.
“Yes.” Mu Huiyin nodded.
“Then there’s no problem.” After getting an answer, Shi Yu no longer hesitated and summoned the array.
Hu hu ~ ~
A white summoning array appeared. A little Iron-eating Beast about a meter tall opened its eyes from the summoning array. It first looked up at the huge frost dragon, and then at Shi Yu, who was possessed by the sword spirit.
“Sob. (You dyed your hair and even brought contact lenses.)” Eleven looked at Shi Yu.
Could he also dye its white parts black so that it wouldn’t look dirty after the training battle?
Shi Yu :”…”
There was a battle!
Without the white hair, it wouldn’t be the national treasure panda anymore!
“Wuu!”
There was a battle!
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Eleven looked at the frost dragon and Mu Huiyin, who was holding a sword spirit.
In the next moment, it felt a strong pressure.
Its whole body couldn’t help but tense up.
There was a chance to tear apart a dragon again?
But why was it an Ice Dragon again!
At this moment, Shi Yu placed his hand on it and said, “Relax.”
“This time, you’re the support.”
Eleven was stunned and then showed an aggrieved expression.
“Huh?”
“Yes, Knight form.”
Eleven was stunned.
Again…
However, it couldn’t refuse the Beast Tamer’s orders.
It could only obediently transform into its mount form under Shi Yu’s command, allowing Shi Yu to ride on it.
At this moment, Mu Huiyin fell silent.
Was Shi Yu imitating her?
However…
Looking at Shi Yu riding the iron-eating beast with the sword spirit in hand, the scene was completely incompatible. Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit was at a loss for words.
But clearly, Shi Yu wasn’t trying to imitate her.
Shi Yu and the others had long tried this posture.
After the vocation assessment, the Iron-eating Beast Knight reappeared!
“Holy shit, Shi Yu plans to fight the Ice Dragon General on this thing?”
“It’s very ridiculous.”
“Don’t underestimate the Iron-eating Beast. Have you forgotten this Iron-eating Beast’s performance in the vocation assessment…”
“The vocation assessment is a vocation assessment… The opponent is a high-level overlord race, a commander-level ice dragon… the trump card battle beast of the Ice Dragon General!”
Everyone looked at the altar and had no idea what Shi Yu was thinking.
However, it seemed like Shi Yu had no other choice.
However, if they didn’t remember wrongly, Shi Yu should have a commander-level ginseng baby…
“This Iron-eating Beast has also reached commander rank.”
At this moment, a master-level Beast Tamer with talent in detecting looked at the venue and said.
The mentor’s gaze was solemn. “Moreover, the energy level isn’t low.”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone stopped talking.
However, there were still a few students who felt that it was a little ridiculous.
“F*ck, not only has the supplement baby reached the commander rank, but its main battle pet has also reached the commander rank?” Yu Shu and the others were stunned.
Was Shi Yu still an intermediate Beast Tamer?
Yin Zhengfan didn’t cheat like you!
Don’t tell them that the worm was also commander level!
“This is very normal. Don’t forget Shi Yu’s physique…” After a moment of silence, Dean He said.
After this, everyone realized for the first time that Shi Yu’s physique was even stronger than a master-level Beast Tamer.
This was very sick. Even Beast Tamers with Fusion Talent weren’t this monstrous.
With such a powerful physique, contracting a high-level pet in advance would indeed be sustainable
“Monster…” In the crowd, Zhang Qianyi and the others said in a low voice.
Then…
Under everyone’s gaze, the little Iron-eating Beast under Shi Yu kept growing and enlarging. In the blink of an eye, it reached more than ten meters in length. Although there was still a difference in size from the frost dragon, the two huge creatures on the altar looked to be of the same level.
As this scene occurred, everyone couldn’t help but be speechless.
Shi Yu stood on the huge Iron-eating Beast and faced Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit. This scene was really difficult for these young people to digest.
“Iron-eating Beast Knight vs Ice Dragon General…”
“I feel that something is wrong, but I also feel that there’s no problem…”
At this moment, on the huge altar…
The altar seemed to have become an arena.
On the ice dragon, Mu Huiyin, who was holding a fire sword spirit, stood at the side.
On the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu, who was holding a fire sword spirit, stood to the side.
The two parties faced each other. A moment later, Shi Yu took a deep breath.
“Eleven, harden.”
It was impossible to defeat the Ice Dragon General in front of him with the Flame Sword.
The Light Flame Sword was just a transition skill for him to adapt to the sword spirit.
What Mu Huiyin really wanted to do was not a battle of victory or defeat, but a guidance battle. It was to see if he could master the skill “Interlocking Sword ”!
At this moment, Shi Yu gradually understood why Mu Huiyin, who had a fire talent and contracted an ice-element pet, could also become a super expert that could fight against totems.
This Interlocking Sword was the key!
Although it was a fire-element skill, and although the user had to concentrate the fire power on the sword body, it could absorb and integrate the power of the outside world. Moreover, the more the power that conflicted with the fire power, the greater the increase in the power of the sword.
Frost and fire were definitely conflicting forces.
In other words, the Interlocking Sword could allow these two powers to combine and unleash power greater than two?
“Fire counters gold. These two powers should also be considered to counter each other.”
At that moment, Shi Yu stood on Eleven. His entire body was armed and hardened, and his physique increased a little.
It was even easier to withstand the possession of the sword spirit.
Moreover, the hardening power even covered the illusory sword spirit. The huge power of metal and fire intertwined within the sword and increased each other. This was the second time Shi Yu tried to control the sword spirit!
At this moment, sensing the change in Shi Yu, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit revealed special emotions for the first time.
This Beast Tamer’s ability to accept things was pretty fast.
In an instant.
Shi Yu felt that his burden had reached its limit.
Buzz!!!
Above the fire sword spirit, golden flames spread this time!!
Countless people looked at this scene and still didn’t know what had happened. They only saw Shi Yu lift the sword spirit for the second time and slowly land in the direction of Ice Dragon and Mu Huiyin!
Boom!!!
The next moment, the golden flames turned into a terrifying shock wave that seemed to have formed a huge domain that enveloped half the altar. Like a tsunami, it crashed towards Mu Huiyin in the direction of the ice dragon!
At this moment, everyone’s expressions changed drastically. They felt a terrifying power fluctuation erupt. It was several times the power of the previous attack. Moreover, the violent wind swept by the energy tide almost made them unable to stand steadily on the spot.
“Wuu!!!”
The Interlocking Sword’s pressure was released, and Eleven howled. It was very unhappy that it couldn’t fight personally. Where did this sword spirit come from? It had completely stolen Shi Yu’s soul. In the future, it would call him “Party Pooper”.
On the other side.
Seeing this sword pressure, Mu Huiyin raised her hand again. She didn’t use the long condensation like Shi Yu and the others. In an instant, a sword pressure formed by white and cold flames erupted from the opposite side with a bang. In an instant, it squeezed together with the crisscrossing sword Shi Yu released!
Boom!!!
Two huge shock waves directly formed a confrontation, compression, and collision situation in mid-air!
At this moment, a strong wind continued to blow. The two huge beasts and the Beast Tamer in the center of the battlefield could still be unscathed, but the students standing not far from the altar couldn’t hold on anymore at this moment. Their faces seemed to be going bald from the strong wind.
“Damn it, Shi Yu, you’re indeed a monster. In the future, I’ll be a dog compared to you.” When Yu Shu spoke, he drank a large mouthful of wind. His lips were blown backward by the wind, but his gaze was still fixed on the collision on the altar.
This power… probably reached the threshold of a quasi monarch.
What was going on!
Crack!
Everyone looked at the sword pressure collision on the arena in shock. A moment later, on Shi Yu’s side, the sword pressure domain gradually froze. The huge ice flames were actually about to freeze the golden flames on Shi Yu’s side into pieces.
Crack…
The fluctuations of the ice flames were still spreading, causing Shi Yu’s expression to change slightly.
“Teacher…” Many students looked at the master-level teacher.
At this moment, the group of mentors also had a serious expression. “Although I don’t know what move this sword pressure is, it seems to be created by the joint efforts of Beast Tamers, pets, and sword spirits.”
“Shi Yu’s obvious disadvantage.”
The students no longer cared what skill this heaven-defying sword pressure was. They looked at the subsequent situation on the altar.
At this moment, Shi Yu fell into a dilemma.
He was wondering if he should let Eleven enter the Inner Power sharp state. In that case, he should be able to exceed the limit of the enhanced Interlocking Sword, but…
Crack…
At this moment, even though his body was protected by hardening, a portion of Shi Yu’s skin, such as his fingers, still cracked and bled.
His body had already reached its limit.
If a stronger power erupted, as a Beast Tamer, he would definitely be heavily injured.
“What are you afraid of?”
A moment later, sensing that the sword pressure domain was about to collapse, Shi Yu gritted his teeth and made a decision.
Wasn’t it just a little more load?
The Iron-eating Beast Knight would never admit defeat!
“Eleven, Blade Explosion!!”
“Baby Ginseng, remember to save me! I believe you!”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven hesitated and continued to listen. Didn’t he believe in eleven?
Don’t worry, it would control its strength well!
As Eleven roared, Shi Yu looked opposite with his sword in hand.
Mu Huiyin also looked at Shi Yu with her sword. Compared to Shi Yu’s struggle, she appeared very calm.
From the beginning to the end, she had only used strength that was slightly higher than Shi Yu’s to test him.
At the moment, Shi Yu had already performed very well, but he still didn’t meet her requirements.
Although it couldn’t be said to be weak, Shi Yu never erupted with the sharpness of his sword. His attack was too stable, and his potential had yet to be completely stimulated.
Born in that chaotic era, she had higher requirements for successors and pursued stable successors too much. It was very difficult for her to reach the peak. It was not what she wanted.
Mu Huiyin increased her strength again, trying to make Shi Yu give up or force out more of Shi Yu’s potential.
At the next moment.
Under Mu Huiyin’s gaze, the huge Iron-eating Beast under Shi Yu suddenly raised its head and roared at them.
Boom!!!
At this moment, under the frown of Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit, the Iron-eating Beast’s entire body erupted with the light of evolution!!
Accompanied by the light, Eleven’s body continued to increase. In an instant, it became closer and closer to the frost dragon. Most of the students were stunned and didn’t know what happened. In the next moment, as the light disappeared, Eleven’s sharp form appeared in front of everyone!!
The huge armor of black and white covered his entire body. The blue eyes under the armor were like lightning, and domineering blue lightning was still flowing between the metal armor. At the same time, the huge lightning power accumulated in the charging room in Eleven’s body. The huge amount of lightning that far exceeded its own limit was operating crazily!!
“Wuu!!!” Eleven looked at the frost dragon.
The power of lightning started to flow along the hardened substance to the sword spirit.
After Eleven’s own body passed through Shi Yu’s body, the violent power of lightning made Shi Yu’s body almost collapse. Even if Shi Yu’s body was hardened, giving him resistance to lightning… Even if his physique had been strengthened by the Sword Spirit… He could clearly feel the pressure his body was under after exceeding the load!
But… all of this was a necessary process to exchange for stronger power!
Boom!!!
An even larger power of lightning replaced the power of metal and the power of fire to wrap around each other. It was also the most violent power. An even more magical energy reaction appeared between the lightning and fire. The flames on Shi Yu and the sword spirit suddenly increased in size and spread more than ten meters high.
In an instant, flames filled the sky and lightning filled the air, causing blue electricity to linger on Shi Yu and Eleven’s bodies. Dark red flames flowed. At this moment, all the Beast Tamers revealed shocked expressions as they looked at the Iron-eating Beast and Shi Yu, who had suddenly changed.
“That, that, that’s…” Yu Shu’s mouth trembled and his eyes widened.
Wang Ling, Han Dong, Miao Dongdong, and the others were stimulated again!
“Iron-eating Beast Evolution!”
“Nine Li Battle Beast! Inner Power!” Director Li said.
“Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast has completed its evolution!”
At this moment, all the Beast Tamers had participated in the Ancient Capital vocation assessment, and they were people who had a very clear understanding of the Iron-eating Beast Nine Li Battle Beast’s evolution chain. When they saw the change in Eleven in front of them, they suddenly opened their mouths wide.
Holy shit, Shi Yu, how much stronger did you become after the vocation assessment? How many new trump cards did you add!
Were they really candidates from the same batch?!
Boom!!!
After the sharpness erupted, Eleven, as its new name suggested, became more like a battle beast. It, who was covered in armor, and Shi Yu, who was fully armed, became more and more like a real warrior at this moment. On the battle beast, Shi Yu felt that his muscles were about to explode. He couldn’t help but squeeze the sword hilt tightly again.
Seeing this scene and sensing the power close to the frost dragon that the Nine Li Battle Beast instantly erupted with, Mu Huiyin revealed a shocked expression.
Bang!!!
At this moment, the Golden Flame Sword that was frozen by the ice flames completely collapsed. The Ice Flame Sword that filled the sky pressed down, but in the blink of an eye, an even larger Thunder Flame Sword pressed down on Shi Yu!!
In an instant, the power situation instantly reversed. The terrifying Thunder Flame Sword pressed down and swallowed the power of the other party at lightning speed, devouring the frost dragon and Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit.
Facing this attack, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit didn’t attack again, allowing the Thunder Flame Sword to swallow their illusions.
“Forget it, let’s stop here. If this continues, their bodies won’t be able to withstand it anymore.” Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit gave up resisting, looking forward to how far the young Beast Tamer in this peaceful era would grow after experiencing the baptism of war one day.
“Roar!!!” Under the pressure of the Thunder Flame Sword, the blurry figure of the ice dragon roared.
Time seemed to have frozen. Under everyone’s shocked expressions, the illusory figures of the ice dragon and Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit were instantly swallowed!
It was as if it had never appeared from the beginning to the end. At this moment, the sword spirit that had possessed Shi Yu directly disappeared. Shi Yu also returned to his normal appearance. Instead, under the condensation of countless light sources, a red ball of light appeared in the sky.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu on the huge Nine Li Battle Beast in a daze, as well as the red soul seed in the sky.
The ball of light slowly landed in Shi Yu’s palm.
At this moment, in Shi Yu’s blurred vision and consciousness, he felt it was more like a divine bean…
“Things are about to change,” Instructor Feng said with a serious expression.
The pets of high-level overlord races were existences with enough resources that could definitely grow to the peak of the overlord level.
Moreover, this was the heroic spirit of the Ice Dragon General that could resist totems.
In other words, the upper limit of this heroic spirit’s growth was very likely totem level!! That was the guardian level!!
The level of a guardian was the peak battle power of various countries. If a heroic spirit with the level of guardian recognized him as its master, this would definitely cause a huge wave internationally!

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - Birth of the Little Sword Spirit
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Birth of the Little Sword Spirit
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Outside the heroic spirit ruins, there was silence.
Under the shocked gazes of the students, Eleven slowly shrank from the size of the huge beast and returned to its restrained form.
At this moment, looking at the change in Eleven, Yu Shu and the others had mixed feelings.
He originally thought that Shi Yu’s performance during the club assessment was his limit.
He originally thought that his trump card was temporarily replaced by Baby Ginseng…
However, he didn’t expect that Shi Yu participated in the club assessment for fun.
The trump card was never sent out from the start to the end.
Just a new pet alone shattered their values.
“I won’t compete anymore, alright?” Yu Shu thought.
From the start of the survival trial, after countless blows, Yu Shu completely gave in.
Even with the talent advantage, he didn’t know how to compete.
The sword spirit of a high-level overlord race!
This almost meant that Shi Yu would definitely become a legend.
This fellow’s luck was simply explosive to have obtained the recognition of the Ice Dragon General’s spirit.
However, Yu Shu couldn’t feel jealous at this moment because even if he was given a chance, he didn’t seem to be able to pass the test Shi Yu just experienced.
Not only was Shi Yu’s pet ridiculously strong, but he was also ridiculously strong.
In fact, Yu Shu even suspected that Shi Yu had planned it himself when Shi Yu summoned the heroic spirit of the Ice Dragon General.
Everyone heard their conversation. Both parties clearly knew their common pet, Ice Dragon.
“Shi Yu!” “Shi Yu!”
When everyone reacted, they saw that on the altar, an Iron-eating Beast was still on all fours.
As for Shi Yu, he wasn’t riding it anymore. Instead, he hung on Eleven’s back like a bow-shaped pendant and closed his eyes. In any case, he didn’t look sober.
“Yi!!”
On the iron-eating beast, apart from Shi Yu, there was also a ginseng baby diagnosing Shi Yu’s situation.
A moment later, Baby Ginseng came to the conclusion that Shi Yu was too weak and had fallen asleep.
It condensed a nutrient tentacle and pried open Shi Yu’s mouth. After letting him eat it first, it felt that it was enough.
As for Shi Yu’s injuries, they were already healed by the Iron-eating Beast and the ginseng baby with high-speed healing a moment ago. It was as if nothing happened.
“What’s wrong with him!”
At this moment, Director Li and the others ran up the altar in a panic. They looked at the fallen Shi Yu and trembled violently. If something were to happen to Shi Yu…
“Wuu, zz ~”
Eleven closed its eyes and pretended to snore. It was trying to tell this group of people Shi Yu’s situation through the acting method.
He was sleeping.
Everyone :”…”
“The soul seed has already integrated into his body, right?” Dean He looked at Shi Yu.
“It should be.” Examiner Feng nodded.
“I wonder when it will hatch.”
The heroic soul seed was a very magical thing. Apart from the people it recognized as its master, outsiders could not hatch or contract it at all.
It was basically equivalent to binding a certain Beast Tamer after forming.
It would integrate into the Beast Tamer’s body and wait to hatch. After hatching, even if it didn’t contract, it would protect the Beast Tamer like a guardian spirit.
Therefore, the heroic spirit was very different from other pets. It was very difficult to covet it. Even if outsiders obtained it and didn’t obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit, both parties would still be rejected.
Just now, everyone clearly saw General Mu Huiyin’s spirit and sword spirit transform into light and condense into a soul seed before landing in Shi Yu’s hand.
This meant that the Ice Dragon General had already acknowledged Shi Yu.
“Director Li, take them to rest.”
“Next, we have to seal the heroic spirit altar here. We still have something to do.”
Instructor Feng looked at the crowd below.
“Yeah.” Dean He nodded. He had to let everyone present sign the confidentiality agreement today.
He couldn’t expose the fact that Shi Yu had obtained Mu Huiyin’s spirit.
Mu Huiyin was the number one person under Emperor Shi of the Dong Huang Dynasty back then. She must have participated in the first totem battle.
This person was indeed a person with a blood feud with the totem race.
Perhaps there were still many totem clans who had enmity with Mu Huiyin who had survived until now.
If Mu Huiyin’s battle results were real, the hatred brought by her name would definitely not be small.
The revenge of the totem clans on the descendants of the war heroes had never stopped.
In Dong Huang, no one could be sure if there were any spies planted by the totem clans hidden.
At least, Dong Huang definitely had spies planted among the humans in the totem area. Then, there would definitely be spies from the totem clans in the country.
Before Shi Yu completely grew up, it was better to seal the news about Mu Huiyin to avoid unnecessary trouble.
Shi Yu had contracted an ordinary sword spirit. Where did this Ice Dragon General come from? That didn’t happen. They didn’t know anything!
He didn’t know anything!
“Block the news first.” Director Li nodded. The rest would be left to Bureau 11 to handle.
Shi Yu… As expected, none of the members of Bureau 11 were easy to deal with.
He had just arrived at the Heroic Ruins and already caused such a big commotion. He wondered if the old principal would faint from fright after informing him…
…
Shi Yu had a very long dream.
In his dream, Shi Yu seemed to have dreamed that he had become a red sparrow. Then, after being burned by the flames, he transformed into a phoenix after rebirth.
“Hu…”
A long time later, Shi Yu suddenly woke up.
He quickly got up from the bed and looked around.
It was an infirmary with a pretty good environment…
At the side, Eleven and Baby Ginseng were looking at their cell phones…
After discovering that Shi Yu had woken up, they quickly turned their heads.
“Wuuu!!” Eleven waved its hand excitedly.
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng was also very excited. They had discovered Buggy’s daydreaming diary.
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu reached out and looked at his palm.
In the next moment, a red light ball, which was the soul seed of the Sword Spirit, slowly floated up from Shi Yu’s palm.
Looking at the soul seed, Shi Yu fell silent for a moment.
During the final attack, his consciousness and vision were almost blurred, but he could still see that in the end, General Mu Huiyin also integrated into it.
So, Mu Huiyin’s spirit had disappeared just like that?
At that time, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit had indeed said that it would completely disappear in the end, transforming into a soul seed and forming a new undead life form.
However, at this point, Shi Yu suddenly felt a little regretful.
“Mu Huiyin’s main body died after suppressing the Ice River Totem. Now, her heroic spirit has also become a soul seed.”
“What a pity.”
Shi Yu still had many things he wanted to ask the Ice Dragon General. Compared to the soul seed, he wanted to know more about the early days of the Dong Huang Dynasty from the other party, especially about Emperor Shi.
However, there was something else that made Shi Yu very concerned.
That was Mu Huiyin’s bloodline and identity.
She was half human, but what was the other half?
From the start until now, Shi Yu had caught two points.
One, the sun.
The feeling that the sword spirit’s flames gave him was very similar to Sun fire.
2. Phoenix.
If the dream just now was related to this soul seed…
Mu Huiyin seemed to be intentionally or unintentionally forcing him to use the power of the sword spirit to exceed the load to fight.
After the battle, after Shi Yu recovered, he could clearly sense that he didn’t have much of a negative impact.
On the contrary, his current state in various aspects was stronger than before the Sword Spirit possessed him.
The flames just now seemed to have revived him.
After the physical body experienced immense pain, a more perfect body was born.
The strength of physique, spirit, soul, and even the Beast Taming Space was almost an all-round increase.
“Sun, Phoenix?” Shi Yu was at a loss.
He was even more curious about Mu Huiyin’s identity now.
How did such a ridiculous bloodline, which was close to a myth, come to be born in humans?
Shi Yu couldn’t help but be curious. This was because the empress who established the third peak of the Dong Huang Dynasty seemed to also have the bloodline of the Phoenix and was of mixed blood.
It could still be a coincidence the first time, but there had been two such mixed bloods in history, and they had both become big shots. The probability of it being a coincidence was much lower.
“From the looks of it, I have to ask the little female dragon in detail,” Shi Yu muttered.
Perhaps it could know something…
In addition, Shi Yu had a new discovery.
After the heroic spirit turned into a soul seed, it seemed to have been recognized as a special life form.
Shi Yu’s index could already see its information.
[Name]: Soul Seed
[Attributes]: Undead, Fire
[Race Level]:???
[Level of Growth]: Unawakened
Energy Points: 100
Good lord, Shi Yu was speechless. What should he say?
He felt that it was even more ridiculous than the Green Silkworm’s cocoon.
This was equivalent to being detected before the young spirit was born. It was still an egg!
Moreover, its energy level was not low. It completely defeated a normal green worm at level ten.
“Wuu!” “Yi!”
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu was staring at the soul seed, Eleven and Baby Ginseng also looked at the soul seed and asked.
Was this light ball the big sister from before?
“Uh.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “Sort of, but not all.”
However, regardless of whether it was true or not, the little sword spirit at that time should be a female, right?
Eleven, Buggy, Ginseng Baby… Shi Yu felt that it was indeed time for a female pet to come beside him. It was balanced now.
Shi Yu looked at the light ball and sensed his current state.
He pondered for a moment and planned to awaken the soul seed now.
He also knew the speciality of heroic spirits. Their loyalty was very high. Even without a contract, both parties could communicate telepathically.
The premise was that the Beast Tamer used his own strength to hatch it.
Shi Yu held the ball of light and slowly fell into a meditative state.
However, just as Shi Yu entered meditation and wanted to hatch the soul seed, he was immediately interrupted by the awakened worm!
“What are you doing…” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say in disdain when he saw that Buggy wasn’t sleeping well. It was supposed to be waiting for evolution but it wanted to run out to watch the commotion.
“I know, I know. Just this once.”
Unable to stand Buggy’s pestering, Shi Yu summoned the cocoon-like Buggy.
After coming out, Buggy immediately looked over excitedly. Was a new teammate going to join the team?
And it was a little baby that had yet to hatch?
It was sleeping just now and didn’t know anything. It was still shocked awake because Shi Yu was injured and unconscious.
It had almost evolved to save Shi Yu.
After learning from Eleven and Baby Ginseng that Shi Yu was alright, it finally calmed down.
“Sob.” Eleven told Buggy not to be happy too early.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng also told Buggy not to be happy too early.
A fire-element teammate suspected to be a high-level overlord race. Would they be able to defeat it after adding points??
Baby Ginseng looked worried. Fire-element, and a high-level overlord.
Baby Ginseng would burn to death!
“!!!” Buggy was also shocked. It looked at the soul seed. Seriously?
As a worm, it was also afraid of fire.
Among the three pets, even Eleven couldn’t maintain a very stable mentality.
This was because Eleven could sense that Shi Yu liked the little sword spirit very much. Eleven imagined it for a moment before its expression gradually became solemn.
It felt that the Iron-eating Beast Knight would be a common thing now!
In the future, it would probably have to go from the main force to the support of the charger.
All its power would be absorbed by Shi Yu…
“Shut up.” Shi Yu looked at the soul seed floating in his palm and glared at the three pets.
The worries of the three pets were completely unnecessary in the short term.
Just now, he had already sensed that under the state of the Sword Spirit Possession, the burden on the Beast Tamer was very high.
The sword pressure from just now looked powerful… But in fact, the sword spirit’s growth level at that time was the transcendent level.
This was ridiculous.
If the sword spirit grew to commander rank, Shi Yu felt that he would probably be drained dry before he could even swing his sword.
Therefore, as a proper Beast Tamer, he had to control the growth level of the sword spirit and not possess it randomly.
Iron-eating Beast Knight? Not him. He didn’t want to die. In any case, he wasn’t interested.
It would be best… if the sword spirit was always one level lower than Eleven and the others. This way, he could guarantee that he wouldn’t be suddenly drained dry one day after holding the sword.
No matter how strong Shi Yu’s physique was or how powerful Baby Ginseng was, Shi Yu was very certain that in his current state, he definitely couldn’t contract and control a high-level overlord race commander-level sword spirit.
Shi Yu felt relieved.
He closed his eyes again and entered a meditative state.
He tried to communicate with the soul seed through his mind.
In the darkness, he searched for the wisp of fire.
One second… two seconds… three seconds…
In the outside world, the three pets stared at Shi Yu, who was hatching the soul seed in his palm.
After several minutes, Shi Yu finally established a certain connection with the soul seed.
At the same time, under Shi Yu’s continuous efforts, the light on the bead-sized red light ball became even more dazzling.
Its form also slowly changed under the light.
Eleven and the other pets still stared at the soul seed that was gradually changing its form. They held their breaths and didn’t dare to make a sound, afraid that they would disturb Shi Yu and the soul seed.
At this moment, although Shi Yu’s eyes were closed, he could also feel the changes in the soul seed in the dark vision.
But a moment later.
Shi Yu opened his eyes in confusion and looked at the little undead in front of him.
At this moment, there was no longer any soul seed in front of Shi Yu.
In its place was an illusory figure with a dark red hilt. The sword was a red “Little Sword Spirit”.
Its overall form was similar to Mu Huiyin’s “Red Sparrow” sword, but perhaps because it was young, it didn’t have that many markings.
It was indeed a sword spirit, but…
Shi Yu looked at the sword spirit in front of him that was the size of a fruit knife and the size of a dagger and fell silent.
No way, even a sword spirit had to grow up slowly???
“Mi ~ ~?”
“Mi ~ ~?”
“Why ‘mi’? But that’s not important…”
Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit and was completely certain. A new sword spirit was like a new baby, young like a piece of white paper. In addition, it was very different from the sword spirit he had just taken earlier. It clearly had its own consciousness.
In addition, perhaps because of some connection, although Shi Yu had yet to contract the little sword spirit, he could clearly sense its situation with the index, just like how he sensed Eleven and the others.
[Name]: Unknown Sword Spirit (Unnamed)
[Attributes]: Undead, Fire
[Race Level]:???
[Level of Growth]: Level 1 Awakening
[Race Skill]: Soul Slash (High-level undead skill, Soul Star, can release Soul Slash, doubling the damage to undead creatures)
Possession (Advanced Undead-type skill)
Light Flame Sword (Advanced Fire-element skill)
Interlocking Sword (super fire-element skill)
Sun Flame (transcendent fire-element skill, Flame containing Sun Power)
Spirit Release (transcendent undead-type skill, Spirit Body with this skill, has the second, third, and fourth forms after liberation)
[Energy Points]: 500
Sensing the little sword spirit’s feedback, Shi Yu’s breathing became a little heavy. This was too strong!!
It had only awakened one level. Its battle power could probably break ordinary transcendent pets!
Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit in surprise and joy.
“Mi ~ ~” At this moment, the little sword spirit had already stuck to Shi Yu’s arm.
“Mi ~ ~” The little sword spirit communicated with Shi Yu like a spoiled child.
It wanted to eat a popsicle.. It was so hot.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - Horrible Namer
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Horrible Namer
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Wu…”
Sitting on the bed, Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.
Eat a popsicle?
Little guy… Are you serious?
Shi Yu had never heard of a fire-element pet having the thought of eating a popsicle.
“You don’t make sense.”
“Is it really alright to eat that kind of thing?”
Would it get diarrhea…
Alright, the sword spirit didn’t have these messy questions.
At this moment, the little sword spirit was leaning against Shi Yu’s arm.
Because it was a spirit body, the feeling was very different from normal weapons.
If the flames had a physical body, Shi Yu felt as if he had touched a soft flame.
It was like water, soft but hot…
After coming into contact with it, he also wanted to have ice cream to cool down.
“Mi…” The little sword spirit begged.
Shi Yu was helpless.
“Ice… No… How about this?”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and an ice-element energy crystal appeared.
“Mi ~!!”
As Shi Yu took out the ice-element energy crystal, the little sword spirit let out a long cry as if it was very surprised.
He instantly ignored Shi Yu and immediately ran to the ice-element energy crystal that released cold air. It stuck to itself.
Although it was sticking to itself, Shi Yu, who was speechless, felt that it was more like it was sharpening a knife!
A fire-element sword, using ice to sharpen the blade… What the heck was this?
Was it practicing how to harm ice-type pets?
Swoosh!
As if it felt that this wasn’t cool enough, the little sword spirit’s sword immediately turned illusory. It passed through the energy crystal and wrapped itself in the sword.
“Mi!” The little sword spirit nodded in satisfaction.
At this moment, after discovering that the little sword spirit was a problematic child, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were stunned.
Then, Buggy looked at Shi Yu.
That… wasn’t that the energy crystal left for it to transform into an ice dragon??
It felt that… the energy crystal was melting little by little!!! It was purely wasteful!!!
Shi Yu turned around. Was there a problem?
Buggy: QAQ
No problem, as long as you guys are happy.
It suspected that Shi Yu’s had a new favorite now!
But forget it. In any case, he had Ice Dragon Whiskers, so it was fine if he didn’t get the energy crystal.
“Looks like he has perfectly inherited General Mu Huiyin’s characteristics.”
Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit flying happily wrapped in the energy crystal and smiled.
Alright… Shi Yu could clearly sense that the little sword spirit was not afraid of heat, but rather hated high temperatures. Instead, it liked cold things very much.
Wasn’t this similar to the Ice Dragon General? She also specialized in contracting ice-type pets to suppress her fire talent.
Well… as long as the little sword spirit was happy.
Shi Yu observed the little sword spirit that was stuck to the ice-element energy crystal.
As expected of an overlord race!
Shi Yu could clearly sense the huge power contained in the little sword spirit’s body.
Even if this power was cooled down a little by the ice-element energy crystal, it was definitely not something any Beast Tamer trainee could adapt to.
Was this really an awakened pet?
Compared to the Green Silkworm that could be beaten up by a human with one hand, it was simply heaven and earth.
