Race levels indeed enhanced strength.
Now, Shi Yu estimated that only intermediate Beast Tamers could normally control awakened-level little sword spirits.
As the little sword spirit’s growth level increased, its existence, be it contracting, possessing, or fighting, would bring greater pressure to the Beast Tamer.
When it grew to the transcendent level, it would probably need a master-level Beast Tamer to control it.
Then what about commanders and monarchs?
It wouldn’t require a Legendary-level physique, right?
The conditions for the use of the little sword spirit were indeed very harsh. If the Beast Tamer didn’t meet the corresponding requirements and used it forcefully, he would probably be sucked dry, drained, and his body and mind would burn up.
“Fortunately, my physique far exceeds that of a Beast Tamer of the same level.” Shi Yu was glad.
Otherwise, he would probably have to learn from General Mu Huiyin and contract an ice-type pet to suppress the sword spirit’s power.
However, if there really came a day when his physique couldn’t keep up with the little sword spirit’s growth speed, this might be a way.
Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit playing alone and searched for its racial skills again.
The undead of an overlord race… Another big spendthrift.
Six racial skills, three high-level and three super-level. Although Shi Yu felt that it was powerful, he was a little dizzy.
There was really no low-level skill.
In the future, he’d probably be constantly tired from adding points.
Although that was the case, the little sword spirit’s skills were really strong.
High-level undead skill, Soul Slash.
Soul Star, the Undead skill. The little sword spirit had the aptitude to become an undead traitor at a glance.
However, it was indeed a good skill. Be it an ordinary life form or a spirit body, this move could cause huge damage and was impossible to guard against. After all, very few creatures mastered the skill to defend against souls.
High-level undead skill, Possession.
Needless to say, this was also a divine skill that superimposed its power on other life forms.
However, possession also required a certain compatibility.
For example, it was basically impossible for the little sword spirit to possess baby ginseng and the worm.
According to research, Beast Tamers were actually the best targets to possess.
Although Beast Tamers were weak, human physiques were the most inclusive. If both parties had a contract, they could enter a special resonance state.
After the Beast Tamer contracted with an undead that mastered the possession skill, they became partners who could stimulate the potential of both parties the most. They were even stronger than pets that had been possessed.
For example, if the little sword spirit directly possessed Eleven. Eleven using the Interlocking Sword was far inferior to the sword spirit possessing Shi Yu. If Eleven transmitted its strength to Shi Yu who was using the sword skill together, that would be much more powerful.
Therefore, many Spirit Mediums treated the undead that could possess them as their life-saving skill. Of course, it was only a life-saving skill. After possessing a human, the consumption and burden was really huge. This was also why even if Yu Shu’s dragon soul pet mastered possession, Yu Shu didn’t dare to go into battle himself and let the dragon soul possess the bone dragon.
Compared to the Fusion Beast Taming Talent, the disadvantage of the possession skill was that it consumed a lot of energy and was easy to overload.
Advanced fire-element skill, Light Flame Sword.
Shi Yu had used this skill before. It was a standard fire-element sword-type skill. Its characteristic was that the sword light was extremely fast, like a flash that could instantly destroy the enemy.
Super level fire-element skill, Interlocking Sword.
This super skill felt a little like Zhang Qianyi’s elemental coordination talent in the vocation assessment, but also like the energy fruit of the ginseng baby, but it was different.
Although Baby Ginseng’s Energy Fruit could contain two powers, the higher the compatibility between the two powers, the greater the power it could display.
Although the Elemental Coordination Talent could coordinate the power of different attributes, it was the same. Coordinating elements with high compatibility was easier for Beast Tamers. Coordinating the power that countered each other would also consume a lot of Beast Tamers.
However, the Interlocking Sword was different. The more compatible the two powers fused, the more ordinary the power. The more conflicting the two powers fused, the greater the power.
Fire borrowed the power of the wind, after all. This was a very common elemental combination skill, but it couldn’t be done with the Interlocking Sword. When the wind and fire combined, it was inferior to the combination of the two powers that were incompatible, like fire and water.
This should be a skill that perfectly matched Great General Mu Huiyin.
After all, she had an incomparable fire talent, and her pets were all ice-element pets, which happened to counter her.
However, this move also had a disadvantage. The user himself had to withstand the super burden brought by the intersecting power. This was comparable to Eleven’s restrained sharpness of Inner Power. They both used unconventional methods and paid a price in exchange for incomparably violent power.
This was also the reason why Mu Huiyin wanted to test Shi Yu first. If Shi Yu couldn’t control the power of a sword spirit of the same level, even if Shi Yu directly obtained a sword spirit, to Shi Yu, the sword spirit would ultimately become something that harmed Shi Yu, just like the burden her physique placed on herself.
Sun Flame.
This was a super fire-element skill that contained the power of the sun. It was considered a type of different Fire skill. Its power was extremely strong, and it could also be enhanced by the power of the sun. At the same time, this move… seemed to be the nemesis of the undead element. To undead, what they feared the most was the sun.
The little sword spirit was walking further and further on the path of a traitor of the undead department…
As for Spirit Release, it was the skill that surprised Shi Yu the most.
Second, third, and fourth forms after Spirit Release? What would they look like… Shi Yu was very curious.
Unfortunately, the little sword spirit couldn’t even reach the beginning at the moment.
The entry-level Spirit Release only provided one effect: It could allow the little sword spirit to increase the proficiency level of this skill by burning the soul of the enemy and killing the enemy.
This move required continuous devouring of souls to increase the skill level in order to free the second, third, and fourth forms. It was a very clear skill to increase the skill level. In a sense, it was to fight monsters and level up.
“Six high-level racial skills. This is too useless for Beast Tamers and Ginseng Babies.” Shi Yu sighed again.
However, this Spirit Release skill could allow him to take a breather.
He could level up by fighting monsters. Shi Yu liked this kind of crude method of leveling up.
There was nothing else in the ancient capital, but there were many undead.
Shi Yu already had a premonition that the consumption of teaching a super skill could directly cripple him.
He was very happy about this skill that increased proficiency in a very clear way.
“It’s better not to give it more points before contracting the little sword spirit. Let it grow naturally.” Shi Yu thought for a moment and made a decision.
Letting the little sword spirit have a good childhood was the right way. It was not in a hurry to grow up at all.
He could still barely withstand the high levels of Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng. As for the little sword spirit, Shi Yu, who had experienced its power, felt that he really couldn’t hold on in his current state.
But then again, if he also taught the little sword spirit healing and recovery skills and let it possess him, would his burden be lighter? This should have the same effect as contracting an ice-element pet to suppress the power of fire…
Shi Yu touched his chin and looked at the little sword spirit.
“By the way, I have to give you a name.”
Shi Yu said to the little sword spirit.
“Mi?”
The little sword spirit wrapped in the energy crystal seemed to be drunk as it staggered towards Shi Yu.
“It’s just a name. I can’t keep calling you Little Sword Spirit, right? Just like them. Let me introduce you first. This is Eleven, this is Buggy, and this is Baby Ginseng. You have to get along well in the future.” Shi Yu introduced the three emperors in the team to the Little Sword Spirit.
“Wuu!” “!!” “Yi!!” The three emperors had also observed the newborn little sword spirit for a long time.
As soon as the little sword spirit was born, she was immediately appointed the Big Sister in the team.
Fire directly countered metal, worm, and wood. What kind of suffering was this?
“Mi ~” The little sword spirit shook. It still didn’t know who was who.
It only knew that it had a very deep connection with Shi Yu. Shi Yu was its mother!
Whatever Shi Yu said, it would do!
“How about calling you Little Red?” Shi Yu said.
The little sword spirit was speechless.
It took back its words.
The little sword spirit shook its head crazily. Perhaps it had retained General Mu Huiyin’s aesthetic sense, but it felt that this name was too lousy.
“Then…?”
“Mi!” The little sword spirit looked at Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng for help.
At this moment, the three pets showed helpless expressions.
From their names, haven’t you discovered the level of naming their Beast Tamer had?
Eleven’s name was the number of the Feeding Base.
Buggy was simply a word.
Baby Ginseng might as well be a race name. Occasionally, it would be called the towering emperor outside the team.
“Wuu.” “!” “Yi!”
Eleven and the others looked regretful. Why don’t we teach you how to read? Then, it could name itself.
“Mi…” The little sword spirit fell into deep thought. It wasn’t impossible.
Shi Yu: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - Senior Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Senior Is Here
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As he felt that Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng would prevent him from establishing his authority in front of the little sword spirit, Shi Yu directly called them back into the space.
These three guys were too ridiculous.
Were their names not nice?
He trembled.
It was clearly very appropriate.
After Shi Yu summoned them away, he looked at the little sword spirit again.
At this moment, the little sword spirit was a little nervous, afraid that Shi Yu would give it another name.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Forget it, adapt to the outside world first.” Shi Yu held his forehead.
“Mi ~” The little sword spirit turned around happily. Its gaze… No, its light was pointed at the fridge.
At the same time.
“You’re already awake?”
A voice suddenly came from outside the door.
When Shi Yu heard a familiar voice, he immediately looked over.
“Senior?”
The person was wearing a black T-shirt and brown shorts. A white research suit was draped over her shoulders, and her long legs were wrapped in black silk. It was Lu Qingyi.
“Why are you here?”
Shi Yu was rather surprised and immediately got out of bed to welcome her.
“You caused such a big thing. How can the police not send someone?” Lu Qingyi was helpless.
She looked at the red little sword spirit that had just entered the fridge. After a moment of silence, she asked,
“It’s probably a heroic spirit formed by General Mu Huiyin’s power.”
“After receiving the news that General Mu Huiyin’s spirit was summoned by you, I rushed over from Icefield City directly.”
“Uh.” Shi Yu nodded. “Wait, how long did I sleep?”
Shi Yu glanced at the time of the electronic clock.
Then, his expression darkened.
Holy shit, another day?
Although there were no injuries and his physical fitness had gradually recovered to its peak, Shi Yu still slept for a long time afterward…
“Then it’s alright.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek. He had never slept so much in his previous life.
“Senior, you’re here because…?”
“There’s nothing especially big. It’s just that the matter of you obtaining Mu Huiyin’s spirit is very important. Come and take a look,” Lu Qingyi said.
“I didn’t expect that what that ice dragon said was actually true. There really is a figure like General Mu Huiyin. This can be considered a very lucky coincidence,” Lu Qingyi sighed.
Shi Yu and Mu Huiyin were both considered people of Icefield City. Shi Yu had also cracked many ruins in Icefield. It wasn’t difficult for people to accept that he had summoned the spirit of General Mu Huiyin.
“Yeah, I didn’t expect that either.”
“By the way, how’s the handling of the Ice River Totem?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s alright.”
“Ice Dragon already has the intention to cooperate with humans to completely destroy the Ice River Totem. If it learns that you have obtained the recognition of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit, our relationship should be able to improve further.”
“However, activating a forbidden weapon is very important. Even Bureau 11 doesn’t have the right to decide directly. It might take a while to decide,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Is that so…”
“You just said that General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit has a huge impact?” Shi Yu asked.
“Is there anything I can do?”
“Just cooperate and block the news. The news that you obtained the recognition of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit has already been sealed. At that time, all the Beast Tamers present had already signed a confidentiality agreement. You should treat it as an ordinary sword spirit for the time being to avoid unnecessary trouble.”
Lu Qingyi looked at the little sword spirit that flew out of the fridge timidly, shining and seemingly very excited.
It was difficult to imagine that this was the heroic spirit of Great General Mu Huiyin, who had repelled countless totems. It had degenerated too cutely…
“Ah, is it that serious?”
Shi Yu extended his hand and the little sword spirit landed on him.
Shi Yu still wanted to announce General Mu Huiyin’s deeds.
In any case, this was also an impressive archeological discovery. If the secret was not announced, he could not share the curiosity that it had obtained. Wasn’t this too lonely?
“Of course, although it’s relatively safe in the country, you probably don’t want to be targeted by those foreign races who have a blood feud with General Mu Huiyin, right?” Lu Qingyi smiled.
“At that time, the totems that were destroyed represented only a small portion of the world’s powers. There are still many factions with strength at the level of totems, still active today…”
“They are still eyeing the human domain covetously. If they know that you have the spirit of a great general, you won’t have it easy. Or do you want to lose your freedom and live under the surveillance of bodyguards 24 hours a day?”
Shi Yu was speechless. Lu Qingyi continued, “But I still found you a bodyguard.”
“Who?”
“You should know. You’re a student of Ancient Capital University now. You’ll also be living there for four years. Your best bodyguard is naturally the Teacher Ying,” Lu Qingyi said with a smile.
“Rich cat?” Shi Yu was stunned.
Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu strangely. What was this title??
“Cough, cough, cough, gem cat.” Shi Yu was embarrassed and excited…
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi didn’t think too much and nodded.
“Don’t worry, with it protecting you in Ancient Capital City, nothing will happen.”
Shi Yu was at a loss whether to laugh or cry. Even without this, that gem cat seemed to have said that it would protect him in the future.
After all, at the moment, Shi Yu seemed to be the largest snack supplier for the gem cat.
“Senior, are you familiar with it?”
“Of course. On its birthday, I gave it a level-eight gem that was discovered in the ruins.” Lu Qingyi said, “Then, Teacher Ying brought me to clear several ruins. We used to be partners for a period of time. We were comrades!”
Shi Yu :”…”
They did sound like buddies.
If someone gave him a gem worth more than a billion, he could immediately become sworn brothers with them.
The conversation between the two parties changed and returned to General Mu Huiyin.
“Speaking of which…” Lu Qingyi asked,” I heard that the Ice Dragon General is of mixed blood? ”
“Yes, I feel that it’s related to the Phoenix race,” Shi Yu said.
Lu Qingyi was stunned and said, “Then wouldn’t it be the same as the empress?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Yes.”
Rumor had it that the empress had the Phoenix bloodline. The nine pets she contracted were all members of the Phoenix Race.
The Fire Phoenix, Ice Phoenix, and the other nine Phoenix Clans crossed the nine major attributes, and their strength all reached the totem level. For a time, they also pushed the empress to the position of quasi-mythical Beast Tamer.
When the female emperor ascended, there were even phoenixes dancing together.
In the future, archeologists believed that the empress might be a human emperor supported by the Phoenix Race and that her position was achieved through improper means.
But it couldn’t be denied that when the empress was in power, it was the most stable and fertile period in the Dong Huang Dynasty. At that time, the Dong Huang Dynasty was so strong that no totem clans dared to invade it.
With the citizens living in peace, no one cared about the background of the empress who had ended the war of totems.
Moreover, the Phoenix Race had always been close to humans since the totem era. They were good totems and often brought auspicious signs to humans. In comparison, humans accepted the Phoenix Race.
However, whether the empress led the Phoenix Race, or whether the Phoenix Race supported the empress… It had always been an endless debate.
“Senior, I remember that you’ve explored ruins related to the Phoenix race, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“What are your thoughts?”
Lu Qingyi shook her head. “I’m not sure, but there’s indeed a saying that the Phoenix Race deliberately nurtured humans and supported hybrid life.”
The dragons and phoenixes could be traced back to the Mythical Era at the earliest. The ancestors of both parties were the strongest batch of Mythical creatures. Unfortunately, after the Mythical Era ended, the descendants of the phoenixes didn’t do as well as the dragons.
The dragon bloodlines were spread across various species. The phoenix race had always pursued the purity of their bloodline through hybrid evolution, but it was precisely because of this that their race became smaller and smaller, and their atavism wasn’t as fast as hybrid evolution.
In the end, the Phoenix Race also started to learn from the Dragon Race and develop. Therefore, an archeologist speculated that the human race was one of the Phoenix Race’s goals.
It seemed that various signs indicated that the Phoenix Clan’s plan had reached its peak during the Great Empress period.
Unfortunately, there was no evidence.
In addition, as the dynasty established by the Great Empress collapsed due to the internal strife of the Phoenix Race, the Phoenix Race disappeared from the sight of humans again. This made the mystery even greater.
During the era of the empress dynasty, the Phoenix Race’s internal strife was also one of the ten greatest mysteries in the archeological world of Dong Huang.
“If you’re interested, you can investigate it yourself in the future,” Lu Qingyi said. “Actually, some time ago, when you mentioned plant pets to me, I was investigating this matter.”
Shi Yu looked up. “The undead battlefield outside the ancient capital?”
“I remember… is it because of the Phoenix race?”
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
“A totem-level undead Dark Phoenix is sealed below. It’s suspected to be the one who experienced the internal strife of the Phoenix Race. Unfortunately, apart from that seal, we humans don’t have any way to effectively defeat it at the moment, so we can only continue to let it be sealed like this.”
It wasn’t that Ancient Capital didn’t want the surroundings to become more normal.
Unfortunately, due to the existence of the Undying Dark Phoenix, it couldn’t do it at all.
There were plagues and curses everywhere. It was a paradise for the undead. If they didn’t solve the key factor of the Undying Dark Phoenix, they could only let it be.
It was because of the existence of that Undying Dark Phoenix that the ancient capital became the current undead capital, producing undead-type pets.
“Let’s talk about it after I reach the Legendary stage.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly.
This wasn’t like the Ice Dragon or even the Ice River Totem.
For example, the ice-element Ice River Totem belonged to transcendent creatures with relatively conventional abilities despite being strong. Humans could destroy it with fire-element forbidden weapons.
However, if it was a top-notch totem-level creature like the Undying Nether Phoenix, a dark dual-element creature, and one with a phoenix bloodline… No one was confident of completely annihilating it.
“But the Undead Battlefield is a good place…” Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit and said,” There are more undead there. Perhaps it’s very suitable for its growth. It needs to burn other souls to free its other forms. ”
Shi Yu was a little curious about the little sword spirit’s other forms.
Actually, it was more because he had heard that there were many ancient ruins there…
“It shouldn’t be dangerous there, right?”
“How can it not be dangerous?” Lu Qingyi was speechless. “It’s even more dangerous than the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. But if you bring Teacher Ying along to travel, there won’t be much danger.”
“I understand, I understand.” Shi Yu nodded. He was good at sucking up to others.
Unfortunately, the rich cat’s wasn’t a big enough deal. After all, if it could hold down that phoenix and let the little sword spirit directly kill it, its Spirit Dispelling proficiency would probably directly reach perfect level and above…

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - Chi Tong
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chi Tong
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After Lu Qingyi arrived, Shi Yu wasn’t sleepy anymore.
Shi Yu chatted with her about many things regarding the Phoenix race.
Lu Qingyi still had a lot of research on this race.
After all, her Green Spirit Wind Bird was the phoenix bloodline obtained in an archeological ruin.
“Mi…”
However, as the two of them chatted, they almost ignored the real protagonist of this encounter.
The little sword spirit listened to the two of them talk about Dong Huang for thousands of years with a blank expression. Her head hurt.
Little Sword Spirit:(╥╯^╰╥).
In order to attract their attention, the little sword spirit condensed flames on the sword and used the flames to form a crying expression.
Unhappy!
“Mi ~!!”
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit.
“Are you hungry?”
Shi Yu realized that the little sword spirit was really talented. How long had it been since it was born? It could already use the power of fire as an emoticon.
Not only was he stronger than Buggy, but he was also smarter than Buggy.
“Mimi!!!” The little sword spirit nodded crazily.
It threw away the ice-element energy crystal. Although it was quite comfortable to carry this thing, it felt a little hungry after carrying it for a long time.
“Alright.” Shi Yu understood. After all, the little sword spirit had just been born and was an overlord race. It was time to replenish a large amount of nutrition.
“Uh, fruit to eat…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The little sword spirit had mastered the Sun Flame. If Baby Ginseng could create a nutritional fruit by absorbing light, theoretically speaking… Well, it seemed unlikely. There was still a huge difference between sunlight and Sun Flame.
“Mi?” The little sword spirit landed in Shi Yu’s hand. What was that?
“You should give it the soul crystal.” Lu Qingyi helped the little sword spirit refuse this food.
Was it appropriate to feed a undead fruits?
Even if it was really nutritious, it was no different from giving the green worm rare metals.
It couldn’t absorb much at all!
“For undead creatures at the Awakening Stage, the Soul Crystal is the most perfect food. Even fire-element creatures can delay the cultivation and develop it after it reaches the transcendent level.”
“That’s true, but I’m not prepared. “Senior, do you have it?” Shi Yu said.
“I don’t have any undead pets. Go and ask Master Feng. The Beast Tamer Troops definitely have stock.”
“Or… Do you want me to bring you along to hunt personally? I just want to see its ability.” Senior Lu looked at the little sword spirit with interest.
“Outside the city wall?” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
Soul crystals were the same as fire-element energy crystals, thunder-element energy crystals, and water-element energy crystals. They were all pure energy crystals.
However, natural elemental energy crystals like fire, lightning, and water were born in nature in the form of mineral veins or condensed by creatures above commander rank.
As for the soul crystal, its birth method was different. It only appeared in the bodies of undead creatures and was considered the core of the other party.
Therefore, the competition between undead creatures was also the greatest. All the races could form a food chain.
The Undead Battlefield was known to have tens of millions of undead. The Beast Tamer Troops were stationed nearby and would regularly sweep it. Resources like soul crystals couldn’t be lacking.
Even if the Beast Tamer went hunting himself, as long as he had the strength, he could obtain the Soul Crystal like picking up a rock.
“Didn’t you say that this little sword spirit has mastered the Spirit Release skill?”
“Yes.”
“From entry-level proficiency to proficiency level, the requirement to reach proficiency level requires devouring ten thousand transcendent-level undead and a commander-level undead.”
“The process of obtaining the soul crystal can also increase its Spirit Release skill. It’s killing two birds with one stone. In the future, you can come to the undead battlefield to train more,” Lu suggested.
Not only could it increase the skill proficiency, but it also obtained a large amount of reserve food!
“Then let’s go take a look?”
Shi Yu was also tempted. It was mainly because Senior Lu was bringing him. Even if he went to the Undead Battlefield, it should be very safe.
In addition, Lu Qingyi was right. This was the advancement requirement for the Spirit Release skill.
To release the second form, it needed to devour 10,000 transcendent-level undead and a commander-level undead.
Unlocking the third form required devouring a thousand commander-level undead and a monarch-level undead.
To liberate the fourth form, one needed to devour 100 monarch-level undead and one overlord-level undead.
It corresponded to proficiency, mastery, and perfection.
The Spirit Release skill was not exclusive to the little sword spirit. Apart from it, there were still some undead who had mastered the Spirit Release skill.
This kind of undead had a unified characteristic, which was that their race was too strong and their strength was too strong. They needed to seal part of their strength and unlock them one by one. Otherwise, excessive strength would interfere with their growth, causing their strength to go berserk.
At the moment, there was only a perfect proficiency record for this skill. He had never heard of a higher fifth form. Probably no pet had reached it. According to the previous conditions, someone deduced that it probably needed to devour ten overlord undead and a totem-level undead.
The former was still alright. It was too difficult to kill a totem-level undead.
This difficulty was not something that could be achieved under normal circumstances.
“Let’s go.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
“Let’s go.” Shi Yu pulled the little sword spirit over and said, “I’ll take you to a big meal.”
Because it was a spirit body, the texture of the little sword spirit’s body was not like a real sword. Its body could even bend and make various arcs. Shi Yu could also lengthen its sword body like rubber mud, as if he was pinching its face.
This was very cute. Otherwise, if it was a metal-element sword, Shi Yu would really be afraid of cutting off his hand when interacting with it.
“Mi!!”
…
“Dr. Lu, Shi Yu?”
When Shi Yu and the others came out, the instructors and mentors outside were immediately shocked when they saw them.
Shi Yu woke up.
“Shi Yu, how’s your situation?” Director Li asked in concern.
“You guys…”
Director Li, Director He, and Instructor Feng had been waiting outside. At this moment, when they saw Lu Qingyi bringing Shi Yu out and looking like she was about to leave, they couldn’t help but ask.
“There’s nothing serious,” Shi Yu said. “Thank you for your concern.”
The three top-notch masters had also heard from the doctor and the doctor that Shi Yu was alright, but he had slept for a day regardless. It was very difficult for them not to think too much.
“I’ll take them to the edge of the undead battlefield to take a walk. I’ll be back later,” Lu Qingyi said.
Shi Yu nodded. The little sword spirit that came out of Shi Yu’s pocket also popped its head.
“The soul seed hatched? It’s indeed a sword spirit!”
The three of them were stunned, and then they had bitter expressions.
What!
To the Undead Battlefield?
His superior had given the order not to let anything happen to Shi Yu. Now they were letting him go to the Undead Battlefield to cause trouble. Was it alright for him to take a walk?
“It’s alright,” Lu Qingyi confirmed.
“Alright, alright.” Instructor Feng was in a difficult position. Lu Qingyi had more power, after all. Moreover, Lu Qingyi’s strength was stronger than the three of them.
A top-notch master!
Lu Qingyi was currently one of the few master-level Beast Tamers who were close to the legendary level under the age of 30 in Dong Huang. In addition, although they were both top-notch masters, there was still a difference in strength.
After all, the threshold of resisting overlord-level creatures was too broad. It was possible for them to resist commander-level races and overlords, but it was also possible to resist monarch-level races and overlords. It was also possible to resist for a few minutes under the overlord’s bitter attacks. Or, it was possible to fight back.
Lu Qingyi, whose many pets had quasi mythical bloodlines, was clearly the batch with the highest battle power.
…
A moment later.
Outside the ancient capital.
Dark clouds lingered, and above the gloomy plain battlefield, a gentle starlight appeared.
A huge bird with a sky-blue body and beautiful blue feathers, bright colors, and a light body slowly appeared.
Its wings were as green as the sky and suffused with a gentle light. It wrapped the two figures on it and dispersed all the Yin energy.
Before long, the Green Spirit Wind Bird slowly descended.
Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu got down from it together.
Because the Plain Battlefield was filled with plagues and curses, for convenience’s sake, Lu Qingyi simply let Shi Yu ride with her on a pet.
Shi Yu shouldn’t have any experience training in such a place, but Lu Qingyi had come here many times for archeology. Whether it was her Green Spirit Wind Bird or the Wind Demon Lion with an evil suppressing bloodline, they all had the ability to dispel plagues and curses.
“Pfft…” Shi Yu stopped breathing as he stood on the black ground and looked at the bones and ghost flames on the ground.
What kind of lousy place was this?
“You’ll get used to it.” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu and smiled faintly.
“…Alright,” Shi Yu replied with difficulty.
The problem was that it was very difficult to get used to.
Shi Yu was considered bold. He had even slept beside a tomb. However, the environment here was really very oppressive. Apart from the pressure on his vision, there were also various negative energies suppressing his mind and heart.
“Mi!!!”
Shi Yu was depressed, but at this moment, the little sword spirit flew up excitedly.
Its entire body burned with flames!
Its battle intent increased.
In its opinion, the atmosphere here was very suitable for a big battle.
“Although it looks timid, it seems to be very brave.”
Seeing the little sword spirit like this, Lu Qingyi couldn’t help but smile.
“After all, it’s the spirit of Grand General Mu Huiyin. That person completely rose up in the war. Just the overlords she had killed alone are in the dozens, and the number of monarchs that have been destroyed is countless.” Shi Yu felt that since the little sword spirit had inherited the characteristics of Mu Huiyin’s liking for ice pastes, it probably had also inherited some battle will.
Beep…
The location where the two of them landed was not bad. There were many undead creatures nearby.
Just now, because of the aura of the Green Spirit Wind Bird, many undead immediately pretended to be dead and hid. But as the Green Spirit Wind Bird landed and put away its aura, many undead immediately became restless.
Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi both had indexes. Under the energy display of their indexes, they quickly locked onto a skeleton pile about 300 meters away.
In the skeleton pile, after a whoosh, a specter with burning ghost flames, facial features, and a terrifying face floated up like a red lantern.
[Name]: Lantern Monster
[Attributes]: Undead
[Race Level]: Medium transcendent
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Race Skill]: Ghost Flame
[Introduction]: It was originally a symbol of happiness, light, vitality, perfection, and wealth. It turned into an undead because of the war.
Energy Points: 555
“It’s a lantern monster.”
Lu Qingyi spoke and turned to look at Shi Yu and the little sword spirit. “It’s up to you.”
At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at the little sword spirit.
However, before he could give the order, the little sword spirit immediately turned into a red light. Before the lantern monster knew what was going on, it pierced a hole in the middle with one hit!
With a boom, the lantern monster immediately exploded. Flames surged out from inside, and ghost flames filled the air!
Then, an even stronger, hotter, and more dazzling flame covered the ghost fire and swallowed it in an instant.
In the explosion, a broken soul crystal fell. At the same time, a flame flew from the lantern monster to the little sword spirit’s side and fused into its body.
At this moment, the little sword spirit’s aura strengthened a little, and it cried out in joy.
“Mi ~!!”
After saying that, it looked at the Soul Crystal that the lantern monster had exploded.
It wasn’t in a hurry to get it. Instead, it looked at Shi Yu like it was asking for credit, hoping to receive Shi Yu’s praise.
“…Not bad, but don’t attack rashly next time. What if the opponent is very strong?” After being stunned, Shi Yu said to the little sword spirit,
“Remember to listen to my command. I’ll let you attack again. Of course, if you face danger, you can counterattack yourself.”
The little sword spirit was just born and had only awakened one level, while the lantern monster was at the transcendent level. It was a whole level higher than it.
The little sword spirit was reckless, making Shi Yu very embarrassed.
“Mi ~!!” It was unknown if the little sword spirit understood.
At the side, Lu Qingyi nodded slightly and said, “High-level skill Soul Slash, instantly killing the lantern monster. That was the Spirit Release just now, right? After burning the killed lantern monster, it can break it down into special spiritual power to increase skill proficiency.”
“It’s just a little useless soul crystal.” She looked at the fallen soul crystal again.
The soul crystal that should have been fine now looked broken.
They couldn’t sell it for a good price anymore. They could only let the little sword spirit settle it itself.
Unlike other energy crystals, it was not easy to get a high-quality soul crystal. It was very challenging for Beast Tamers to hunt undead.
“It’s already not bad.” Shi Yu went to pick up the soul crystal. The little sword spirit flew over and quickly burned the soul crystal to death, devouring its soul power.
“Mi ~” The little sword spirit stuck to Shi Yu in satisfaction.
However, it still felt hungry… It looked around again.
“Don’t worry ~ There are many undead here,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Senior, it shouldn’t be a problem for the little sword spirit to be judged as a high-level overlord, right?”
“Well, three high-level skills, three super skills, in addition to this energy value that’s comparable to transcendent level, and the attack just now… There’s no doubt that it’s a high-level overlord race.”
Lu Qingyi gave it a very high evaluation.
Generally speaking, with two transcendent race skills, the creature could be considered a low level overlord.
Three super-level skills was the baseline for middle level overlords.
Four super racial skills made up the skills of the high-level overlord race.
However, this was ignoring the other qualities of the pet and looking at the evaluation criteria of the skill alone.
Although the little sword spirit only had three transcendent racial skills, this ridiculous energy value was enough for it to be called a high-level overlord race.
“Impressive ~” Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit.
At this moment, Lu Qingyi thought again and said, “Perhaps, it’s not just that. The Spirit Release skill is very special. It can’t be regarded as an ordinary super skill.”
“What do you mean?”
“Because the method to increase the proficiency of the Spirit Dissection is relatively clear.”
“The growth level is divided into seven stages. After the overlord level, it’s the totem level. Of course, there are many ways to call this level. Some people like to call totem level, some like to call humans at that level a guardian, and some people like to call this level quasi-mythical. It means that this is a level close to the Mythical Domain.”
“Do you know the requirement for overlord-level creatures to advance to the totem level?” Lu Qingyi asked Shi Yu.
Shi Yu shook his head.
“There are actually many ways to get to the totem level. Among them, one method is to train the transcendent racial skills to the ‘transcendent level’ after your growth level reaches the overlord level standard. At this time, transcendent racial skills will once again lead the growth of your pet to another level, which is the totem level we’re talking about.”
“You can understand that most totem-level creatures have mastered a transcendent skill.”
“General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit has mastered the Spirit Release skill. The Spirit Release skill is the most explicit skill to increase proficiency. As long as there are enough resources, it’s not too much to say that it has totem potential, which makes it a quasi-mythical race. After all, very few pets have such a clear path to advance.”
“Mi!” The little sword spirit was so awesome.
“The criteria for advancing to the totem level is for the transcendent racial skill to reach the transcendent level?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “But there are also differences between totems.”
“For example, a totem that has trained a super ability to perfection can only be considered an ordinary totem.”
“And some totems have already raised two, three, or even four superpowers to that level. They have new nicknames, just like how the Undying Dark Phoenix under this undead battlefield is a top-notch totem.”
“Under the influence of its power, even an ordinary red lantern that symbolized happiness could be turned into undead…”
“It’s off topic. So, as long as its growth is smooth, your little sword spirit might also have a chance to advance to the totem level,” Lu Qingyi said. “You understand what to do, right?”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded. Senior Lu meant for them to develop steadily.
Stable development, and not to be reckless!
“Then… let’s continue hunting with it,” Lu Qingyi said. However, she suddenly thought of something and looked at Shi Yu and the little sword spirit with interest.
A faint smile appeared.
“By the way, I seem to have also heard that after the Sword Spirit possesses you, you will become a red-haired and red eyed person, a Chi Tong?”
“I heard from Director Li that it’s also very elegant, no, divine. How about transforming for me?”
“If it’s pretty, I’ll also consider contracting a possessed undead.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Could it be that the purpose of her contract with the undead was to dye her hair and get free contact lenses?
“Wait,” Shi Yu said. “Senior, you just said Chi Tong?”
Lu Qingyi was stunned and nodded. “What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu looked at the little sword spirit and said, “Smile.”
The little sword spirit was at a loss, but it still followed Ji Yu’s request and used the flames to condense into a smile on the sword.
Its fiery red eyes were very lovable.
“Yes, I’ll call you Chi Tong. After all, after you possess me, your power turns me into a red-haired Chi Tong. It’s a symbol of our commonality. How about that?” Shi Yu asked the little sword spirit.
“Mi!!” The little sword spirit was stunned and nodded happily.. Alright, alright, it was better than Little Red and Little Mi.

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - Shi Yu and Emperor Shi looking at each other
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Shi Yu and Emperor Shi looking at each other
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu directly named the child on the spot.
Lu Qingyi was rather speechless. She thought that Shi Yu wanted to do something.
This Beast Tamer was too big-hearted. He actually got inspiration from daily conversation to find the name of his pet…
“Then I should also have half the credit for naming it,” Lu Qingyi said at the side.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was speechless. If she said so…
“No other requests ~ Hurry up and transform,” Lu Qingyi said.
“It’s only at the Awakening level now. Even if it possessed you, you shouldn’t feel any pressure, right?”
Shi Yu was vexed. He really wanted to see it.
That was true, but… he had already sworn not to be an Iron-eating Beast Knight. It was a little addictive.
It wasn’t a good habit.
Forget it, this was the last time. Next time, definitely not.
“Alright then…” Shi Yu nodded and looked at the little sword spirit.”…Chi Tong, possess me. ”
“Mi?!”
The little sword spirit was stunned for a moment. After understanding what it meant, it immediately flew in front of Shi Yu and circled around him. After pausing for a moment, it slowly fused into Shi Yu’s heart.
At the same time, Shi Yu closed his eyes.
This was the first time he was possessed by the little sword spirit. The test didn’t count.
The proficiency of the possession should be quite high, and the proficiency of the other skills shouldn’t be low either. However, his little sword spirit was clearly only at the entry level at the moment. It was a new student and very unfamiliar.
Therefore, the two parties might take a longer time to bond.
Lu Qingyi watched carefully.
One second… two seconds… Three seconds later, a cyclone began to swirl under Shi Yu’s feet, blowing dust.
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu’s body began to turn blurry and hot. Red flames slowly erupted and lingered around him.
Buzz…
The fire threads slowly became dense. At this moment, Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes. After opening them, his gaze seemed to contain flames as it gradually changed in the direction of Chi Tong’s burning eyes.
However, perhaps because both parties had yet to contract, the little sword spirit was not very proficient in using Possession either. The fusion process between the two parties was still a little difficult. Shi Yu’s pupils kept changing between his black pupils and Chi Tong’s burning eyes.
Apart from that, his hair color also flashed between black and red, constantly changing.
After a few seconds, the two parties finally matched.
With a boom, countless fire threads condensed. A fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun transformed into flames that wrapped around Shi Yu’s entire body. At this moment, Shi Yu’s entire body seemed to have become thinner but more powerful!!
Moreover, at this moment, his hair had completely turned bright red, and his eyes were the same as before. His skin also became even fairer under the illumination of the fire spiritual energy!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s aura had completely changed. He no longer looked like a human. The emotions in his eyes had faded a lot, and his voice had become much more ethereal. He stretched out his hand. In the next moment, an adult version of the Chi Tong Sword Spirit appeared in his hand like a flaming sword.
“Senior, it’s done.” Shi Yu looked at Lu Qingyi and saw that she was full of praise as she kept nodding.
“Very good, it looks much more reliable than White Brook’s Fusion Talent.”
Compared to White Brook, who had become a beast-eared girl, Lu Qingyi felt that Shi Yu’s special effects were a little more handsome.
She had decided. The next pet would be an undead with a possession skill!
Moreover, the race level couldn’t be low. At least, it had to be an overlord race.
It wasn’t that she had never seen undead who possessed humans before, but the humans never changed much after the bond.
Perhaps it was related to the power of the undead. Those undead were too weak, causing the special effects to be a little low.
Unlike Shi Yu, whose pet simply changed the aura of the Beast Tamer.
Were there any relatively cute undead creatures with high racial levels?
Lu Qingyi fell into deep thought.
“Alright, alright!” Lu Qingyi hurriedly said while in deep thought.
“Alright.” Shi Yu exited the Sword Spirit Possession state. The flames on his body disappeared, and his hair and eyes returned to normal. The Sword Spirit in his hand also slowly degenerated into a young spirit form that looked like a fruit knife at the start.
“Hu…” Shi Yu sighed. Although the little sword spirit was only at the Awakening level, its consumption was not small.
“We can continue now, right?”
“Let’s go.” Lu Qingyi smiled, satisfied.
After her curiosity was satisfied, Lu Qingyi began to seriously bring Shi Yu to fight monsters.
However, to put it bluntly, it was purely to bring Shi Yu to familiarize himself with the environment at the edge of the Undead Battlefield.
After learning that the little sword spirit had mastered the Spirit Release skill, Lu Qingyi knew that the Undead Battlefield was the best training place for Shi Yu and the little sword spirit.
The ten million undead here could satisfy the advancement requirements of most of the little sword spirits.
There were even totem-level undead!
As long as someone was able to kill it.
Soon, Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu walked together. They brought the little sword spirit to hunt more than ten undead.
It was all hunted by the little sword spirit.
They let it fight above its level!
Its growth level had also broken through to level two of Awakening.
[Name]: Sword Spirit Chi Tong
[Attributes]: Undead, Fire
[Race Level]: High-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Level 2 Awakening
[Race Skill]: Soul Slaying (Initiate), Possession (Initiate), Light Flame Sword (Initiate), Interlocking Sword (Initiate), Sun Flame (Initiate), Spirit Dissection (Initiate)
After the little sword spirit grew up, Lu Qingyi saw it.
“I was wrong. It’s killing three birds with one stone. Bringing it here to hunt undead can increase the proficiency of the Spirit Release, and it can also solve the food problem. Its racial skills will increase. After absorbing nutrition from the food, it will also increase its growth level…” Lu Qingyi smiled and said,” This is a good place, right? ”
At the side, Shi Yu, who was watching the little sword spirit burn the soul crystal, felt helpless. It was a good place, but a good place…
However, in the villa, enjoying the air conditioner and inhaling fragrance was pretty good too.
However, one thing was for sure. If there was a big boss leading the team, it wasn’t impossible for them to be at the Undead Battlefield.
“Yes.” Shi Yu agreed.
“By the way, Little Chi Tong, are you full?” he quickly asked Little Chi Tong.
At this moment, Lu Qingyi glanced at the time.
“Continue, or go back?”
“I think so too. Otherwise, Director Li and the others would be anxious,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Little guy, are you full?” She also asked Little Chi Tong telepathically.
The little sword spirit: “Mi ~!!”
The little sword spirit nodded. Anything was fine.
It had a satisfied expression. Of course, it wasn’t really enough, but it was enough.
When Shi Yu saw the little sword spirit eating, he smiled and said, “Then let’s go back first.”
Lu Qingyi nodded. A moment later, she summoned the Green Spirit Wind Bird.
They went back through the same transport.
On the Green Spirit Wind Bird, although the Wind Bird’s flying speed was very fast, because it was wind-element, it formed a perfect wind domain. Inside, Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu couldn’t feel any wind pressure.
The two of them weren’t far apart. As they flew, Lu Qingyi turned her head slightly and glanced at Shi Yu, who was staring ahead. She raised her arm and patted his shoulder.
“Did the iron-eating beast give you your physique?” she suddenly asked.
After rushing over from the icy plain, Lu Qingyi heard a lot from Director Li and the others. There was also something about Shi Yu’s physique.
If Shi Yu didn’t have a physique that wasn’t inferior to any master, it would probably be very difficult for him to control an extraordinary sword spirit normally and obtain the recognition of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit.
“Indeed, Eleven gave me a portion of it. As for the other portion, there was another opportunity. Why?” Shi Yu was curious.
After Eleven upgraded and evolved, the strength of the physique that it gave Shi Yu was not low either. To say that his current physique was all enhanced by points of feedback, that was not entirely true.
“Didn’t you tell me previously what you saw at the iron-eating beast ruins?”
“Hundreds of Iron-eating Beasts have mastered the hardening of their proficiency above transcendent, and then completed the evolution through this skill, right?” Lu Qingyi said.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Aren’t you curious? The corresponding period of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins is the Wu Emperor period,” Lu Qingyi said.
Shi Yu continued to nod. This was actually the point that made Shi Yu most conflicted. He felt that the Iron-eating Beast should be even further away in time. It was best to involve Huang Emperor and Chi You. Only then would it be explosive.
However, on careful thought, it was basically impossible. In the Mythical systems of the Huang Emperor and Chi You, Mythical creatures were frequent visitors, and during the Mythical Era in this world, humans had yet to be born.
The truth was that the history of the iron-eating beast ruins was only two thousand years.
This was the ruins of the Wu Emperor Era, still after Emperor Shi.
“At that time, such ruins might belong to a special army of Emperor Wu,” Lu Qingyi said.
“That’s indeed a possibility.” Shi Yu didn’t deny it.
The Wu Dynasty was one of the few dynasties in history with relatively clear reasons for its destruction.
Emperor Wu was too warlike. For example, after Emperor Shi and the empress unified the dynasty, they didn’t continue to launch external wars. However, Emperor Wu was a war fanatic. After banishing the totems, he had been chasing after it and frequently brought his troops to fight with the totem clans in the totem area.
He went deep into the danger ground many times, hoping to completely destroy the enemy totem.
For decades, the totems were suffocated.
However, perhaps because of the years of war, the humans also felt the pressure.
Before the totems died, there was already a conflict among the humans.
It was said that the injuries of a late-stage Wu Emperor were very difficult to treat. He needed to rest regularly. The people around the Emperor were familiar with this. For unknown reasons, they betrayed him one day and joined forces with the totem clans to rebel against the Wu Emperor. A peak dynasty was destroyed.
Then, the information about Emperor Wu was also deleted and changed by the usurper, who maliciously smeared it.
“In the history of humans, Wu Emperor is a Beast Tamer who has tempered his body to the extreme. All its battle pets are pets known for their physical bodies. If the Iron-eating Beast army is the secret army of Emperor Wu, and if the potential of the Iron-eating Beast is so strong, could it be possible that Wu Emperor himself contracted the Iron-eating Beast to evolve?”
Lu Qingyi asked, “Apart from the feedback increase of the Fusion Talent on the physical body of a Emperor Wu, the feedback of its pets should also be the most important thing for the incomparably strong physical body his.”
Shi Yu was stunned and said, “Now that you mention it, that’s indeed a possibility. After all, just one evolution is enough for the Iron-eating Beast’s physique to match that of a giant dragon.”
“Eleven is now a quasi overlord race… It’s because its physique isn’t inferior to any overlord race…”
“Right, according to President Feng, aren’t you guys doing something about the Iron-eating Beast Village? If the archeology team discovers that the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution form is a battle pet of Emperor Wu, the value of the Iron-eating Beast will probably increase,” Lu Qingyi said confidently.
Shi Yu first smiled before immediately feeling sad.
“Stop, I have a headache now.”
“Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress… This is impossible!!!”
Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Emperor Kong, evolution talent big boss, and Mechanical Giant, who could also be said to be one of the first ancestors of the Mechanic class…
There were seven legendary Beast Tamers in the history of Dong Huang. Shi Yu didn’t expect that he would be related to three in a short period of time that needed to be investigated!
This woman dug a big hole for him.
Lu Qingyi smiled. “Life goes on.”
…
A moment later, the two of them returned to the protected area of the ruins.
In the protected area, Instructor Feng, Dean He, Director Li, and the others were still waiting.
“Ah, you guys are finally back.”
Finally, they had returned!
Seeing that Lu Qingyi had returned with Shi Yu, the three of them were relieved and wiped their sweat.
“I already said it’ll be fine.” Lu Qingyi was helpless.
At the edge of the Undead Battlefield, Shi Yu’s little sword spirit alone could sweep through it. What could happen?
It was fine, unless the Undying Dark Phoenix broke out of the seal…
“I’m just worried about you guys,” Director Li said with a laugh.
“Well, is Dr. Lu staying here today? I’ll get someone to prepare a room for you.” Instructor Feng looked at Lu Qingyi.
“No, thank you. I’ll leave later,” Lu Qingyi said.
With that said, she looked at Shi Yu and said, “Do you still plan to continue the military training?”
“It’s better to return to school with me directly.”
Shi Yu thought for a moment and said, “I still want to stay here for a longer time. When the time comes, I’ll go back with the other students.”
“By the way, Director Li, I remember that one person in the Heroic Ruins can summon multiple heroes, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Uh.” Director Li was stunned. He smiled bitterly and said, “That’s indeed the case. You still plan to summon one??”
Shi Yu shook his head continuously. “No, no, I was just asking casually. I don’t have this intention anymore…”
Even if he summoned another great general spirit, he wasn’t interested anymore. Having a little sword spirit was enough.
He really couldn’t afford more.
“I just want to stay longer and understand history more,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright.” Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “I hope you can gain something.”
She had also stayed here for a long time back then, but unfortunately, her gains were not much. It was not as much as Shi Yu’s gains from staying here for a day.
Comparisons were pointless. Shi Yu’s talent was better than she imagined.
“I hope so…” Shi Yu also hoped that there was. He looked at Director Li again and said,” Director Li, did anyone still receive the recognition of a heroic spirit? ”
“The Martyr’s Altar hasn’t been unsealed. After you came down, no one has gone up yet. Everyone’s busy signing a confidentiality contract.” Director Li chuckled and said, “Now that you’re awake, it’s time to unseal that place again.”
Shi Yu nodded.
Then, Shi Yu answered the three top-notch masters’ questions about the little sword spirit again. He started to return to the proper training.
After Senior Lu exhorted information from Shi Yu, she left directly and ran to Ancient Capital University to settle things.
At this moment, the heroic spirit ruins finally began to be unsealed.
The students were stifled.
Seeing Tao Yi and Shi Yu summon awesome heroic spirits consecutively, no one wasn’t envious.
Among them, the heroic spirit summoned by Shi Yu made them sign some confidentiality contract. Although this group of students was a little confused, they could feel Shi Yu’s awesomeness.
Now, after the seal of the heroic spirit ruins was lifted, hundreds of students immediately swarmed towards the ruins.
They hoped to recreate Shi Yu’s glory on the altar. At the very least, it would be good to have an archer like Tao Yi.
…
“Damn it, I was a step too slow…”
After learning from the instructors and mentors that the ruins had been unsealed, countless students ran over.
However, there were definitely fast and slow students among the hundreds.
It was impossible for more people to go up the altar together, so they could only queue.
People like Yu Shu and Wang Ling, who felt that they could summon heroic spirits but couldn’t get in the front line, could only worry.
The scene of the altar was lively all of a sudden.
Even though it was almost evening, this place was still extremely lively.
“How lively.” Shi Yu packed up. After changing his clothes, he also wore a hat and came to the scene to watch the commotion.
At this moment, looking at the students putting on painful masks on the altar, he couldn’t help but smile.
At that moment, everyone’s attention was focused on a person on the altar. Shi Yu had changed his clothes and was wearing a hat and mask. As he walked in the crowd, no one noticed him.
“This disguise talent…”
Just as Shi Yu felt that his disguise talent was invincible, a palm suddenly landed on Shi Yu.
“You… are awake??” Wang Ling and Yu Shu were together, looking at Shi Yu in a daze.
Shi Yu took back his words.
“Yo!” Seeing this pair of good friends, Shi Yu waved and greeted them.
“Good evening.”
Good my ass!
Wang Ling and Yu Shu looked at Shi Yu with complicated expressions.
He wanted to ask Shi Yu about General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit, but unfortunately, due to the contract, he couldn’t say it.
“Shi Yu, do you think that manual is real?” Wang Ling said.
“What manual?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“I have to communicate with the spirits with the intention of ‘archeology’.” Wang Ling and the other students from the archeology Department (1) class had long treated Shi Yu’s words as a mystic manual. They remembered it in their hearts and waited for the moment when they went up to summon it.
Yu Shu also heard about it and felt that it could be tried.
“Uh…” Shi Yu was speechless.
This thing… how should he put it?
Shi Yu looked in the direction of the altar. It was completely difficult to say. It all depended on luck.
For example, now, he was going to the ruins with the intention of archeology. He wanted to know more about Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin. Was it useful? Was it useful? He didn’t care!!
“…” Just as Shi Yu was about to tell the two of them that money could change one’s life, his brain suddenly trembled.
His eyes were confused and his mind was a little dazed.
Everything around him seemed to have fallen silent.
Shi Yu’s mind seemed to be isolated from the outside world.
Just now, with the mood to try it out, Shi Yu used telepathy to communicate with the ruins again.
However, to Shi Yu’s surprise…
He felt it again.
This time, a scene appeared in front of Shi Yu’s eyes again. It was a very vague scene. Although it was vague, he felt like he was in that world.
In the scene, there were two backs.
One of them was a domineering middle-aged man who stood with his hands behind his back. Shi Yu couldn’t see or recognize him.
However, Shi Yu could vaguely see the image of Ice Dragon General Mu Huiyin in the blurry figure behind him.
“Are you leaving?” The man’s dignified voice sounded.
“I plan to return to the icy plain and guard there. A snow mountain is not enough to isolate the huge ocean empire,” the woman said. “Leave the border of the dynasty to me, but remember to erase my information.”
“It’s a pity. I still want you to continue fighting with me.”
“I’m not interested in the Mythical domain, much less longevity. It’s best you don’t immerse yourself in it. This is the most critical moment of the dynasty.”
“We’re already close. How can we not take a look? Don’t worry, I’ll leave enough backup before exploring. This heroic spirit ruin is one of them. With it around, even without me in the future, humans can still have the power to resist the totems.”
“Your bloodline is relatively special. I’ll use my strongest power to preserve the traces of your power. At that time, your heroic spirit can transform into an unparalleled general to intimidate the totem!”
The woman began to remain silent, and the man also began to remain silent.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who seemed to be in an alternate space, had already gone numb.
His heart was shocked to the extreme, as if he had heard a huge secret!
Then, what made Shi Yu’s heart nearly explode was that in the blurry historical scene, the man standing with his hands behind his back seemed to have sensed something. He suddenly turned his head slightly and turned around. His dark pupils seemed to have passed through the river of time and completed eye contact with Shi Yu.
“Who’s there?”
Crack!
The scene stopped. The world Shi Yu saw shattered completely. He was so shocked that he broke out in cold sweat.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, why are you in a daze? What do you want to say?” Beside Shi Yu, Yu Shu and Wang Ling looked at Shi Yu, whose expression had changed drastically, in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - Mysterious Crystal
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Mysterious Crystal
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“I wasn’t in a daze. I cracked,” Shi Yu muttered.
This time, after hearing the Voice of History, he was shocked that the ruins didn’t crack!
That was… Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin?
Was it the conversation between the two when the heroic spirit ruins were built?
But why did Emperor Shi suddenly turn his head as if he had discovered his spying!
Shi Yu was shocked when his gaze landed on him.
“You cracked?” Yu Shu and Wang Ling were at a loss.
Shi Yu looked at the two of them and then at the heroic spirit ruins.
After waiting for a few seconds, he realized that the Emperor Shi had not crossed the River of Time to catch him. There was no Emperor Shi Spirit appearing either. Even the other heroic spirits in the ruins didn’t move. Shi Yu said to Yu Shu and Liu Qiyue,
“The waters here are too deep and the implications are too big. I’m not playing anymore. All the best.”
After Shi Yu warned the two of them, he felt a little weak and wanted to go back and lie down.
At this moment, Yu Shu and Wang Ling were stunned again.
“What do you mean?”
Yu Shu said as he watched Shi Yu leave.
He looked at Wang Ling.
Wang Ling said, “Didn’t you hear what he said? I just want to say that I understand everything. It’s very difficult for me to explain the parts that I don’t understand. Try it yourself carefully.”
Yu Shu: What the f*ck???
…
Not long after he left, Shi Yu returned.
His mind was a little confused now. He wanted to calm down. The ruins were too noisy.
Shi Yu began to recall the situation from the beginning.
To trigger the Voice of History, Shi Yu had many experiences. There was nothing to say about this.
From the conversation between the man and the woman in the “video”, their identities were undoubtedly Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin.
The heroic spirit ruins were established after the battle of the totems. At that time, the war had already ended, and the Dong Huang Dynasty had completed its unification and walked on the right track. It was the start of the Eastern Beast Taming Era.
After the dynasty got on track, Mu Huiyin seemed to have chosen to return to her hometown. Her goal was to guard the dynasty’s border.
This was not difficult for Shi Yu to understand. Icefield City had a special geographical location that was adjacent to the ocean.
During the totem era, the Ice River Totem had led its clansmen to fight the totems in the sea many times to snatch resources.
After the Beast Taming Era, while the land totems were fighting humans, the sea totems had taken advantage of the situation many times.
However, humans couldn’t do much about ocean creatures either. It was as shameless as hiding in an alternate space.
It was only when the Dragon Emperor reached an agreement with the underwater dragon race that the sea posed less of a threat to humans, now that the Dragon Palace City dragon race was an ally of the Dong Huang Dynasty.
“Judging from the conversation, after expelling the totem, Emperor Shi didn’t seem to have given up on fighting, but the target doesn’t seem to be the totem.”
“According to the records, at that time, Emperor Shi was incomparably powerful. He led the Dong Huang Dynasty and was completely capable of continuing to destroy the fleeing totems like Emperor Wu, but he didn’t choose to do so… Instead, he looked at a higher domain.”
“From what the Ice Dragon General said, the Mythical Domain… Immortality… At that time, Emperor Shi was pursuing these??” Shi Yu sat on the bed and frowned.
Why did every emperor want to be immortal and become a legend?
However, it seemed normal. After reaching that level… there wasn’t much to pursue other than this.
Shi Yu was still young and had no feelings for these things. He wasn’t sure if he wanted to just die or become immortal after he grew old.
“In that case, the destruction of the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty is very likely because Emperor Shi challenged the Mythical Domain. They even really managed to find the long lost Mythical Creature, causing the Dong Huang Dynasty to encounter an unknown calamity?”
This was a very surprising secret, but not that surprising. Legend had it that when Beast Tamers pursued the Mythical Domain, this was very normal. Perhaps every Beast Tamer who had reached that level had done this, including the legendary Beast Tamers that weren’t limited to the Dong Huang Ancient Country. The legends of the other countries must have also pursued the Mythical Domain.
Even those totemic foreign races were chasing to advance to the Mythical stage.
Emperor Shi pursued the Mythical Domain, and the Dong Huang Dynasty might have perished because of Mythical creatures. Even a high school student might be able to guess this guess, but in the absence of evidence, guesses were forever guesses. They couldn’t become true history.
But now, as Shi Yu saw the historical video, this guess became even clearer. Emperor Shi was indeed preparing something. In fact, at that time, Emperor Shi had already found a target and knew that he might fail! Therefore, he had left behind the so-called backup plans he mentioned.
However, compared to this, what confused Shi Yu the most was still the Emperor’s reaction at that time…
Wasn’t the image of history recorded by the “historical spirit” that was naturally produced? In theory, when he looked at the historical image, it should only be equivalent to looking at a recorded video. Why could the person in the video still sense who was looking at him? This time, the elemental wall had broken.
Or could it be that there were parallel universes of the past, present, and future? The Ancient Emperor of that time could sense that someone was spying on him in the future because he had mastered the power of time?
Or could it be that there were also Shi Di’s spirits in the ruins?
“Do you know anything?”
Shi Yu asked the little sword spirit that crawled out of his chest.
“Mi?” The little sword spirit was at a loss.
“Ah…” Shi Yu was helpless. This was no longer the Ice Dragon General.
“Forget it, rest well tonight. We’ll start investigating tomorrow,” Shi Yu said.
Although he said that the ruins were magical and that the waters were too deep and the implications were too great, Shi Yu still had to continue investigating.
He belonged to the type of person who would be more obedient when encountering strange phenomena, but after calming down and analyzing it carefully, he felt that the more he took a step back, the angrier he was.
“I’m a Beast Tamer recognized by the heroic spirit of Grand General Mu Huiyin. The Ice Dragon that has made great contributions to the Dong Huang Dynasty even asked me to call it Grandma, what’s there to be afraid of?! Even if Emperor Shi is still alive, we’re all family…”
After Shi Yu figured it out, he meditated and rested.
In the past few days, he had clearly just strengthened the Beast Taming Space to level three, but Eleven had evolved and broken through, Baby Ginseng had broken through, Buggy had evolved and broken through… He was also possessed by the Sword Spirit. Shi Yu felt that before he even cultivated much, the Beast Taming Space seemed to have improved a lot…
Although it couldn’t be said that he could reach level four immediately, he felt that it shouldn’t be a problem in another two to three months.
Compared to the feedback of the pet, the feeling it gave Shi Yu was more like his space was too small. The pet had broken through consecutively and accidentally enlarged it. Otherwise, it would feel uncomfortable staying here.
While he was cultivating, Shi Yu didn’t forget to let Little Chi Tong, Eleven, and Baby Ginseng improve their relationship.
“Little Chi Tong, go play with Eleven and Baby Ginseng in the ruins.”
“Use your Sun Flame to help them train their fire resistance. Well, just burn them.”
Shi Yu realized that Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy were all a little weak in his team.
The fire-element team was really superior.
“Mi ~!!” The little sword spirit was confused, but its attitude was very serious.
“Wuu!!!” A moment later, in the ruins space, Eleven was extremely excited. As long as its new teammate trained with it, everyone would be good friends!
As for Baby Ginseng, it wore a painful face. How was this training its fire resistance? It was clearly training its healing ability… Compared to Eleven, it was clearly weaker in fire. Even if its level was very high, it couldn’t be said to be unscathed after resisting the little sword spirit’s super-level fire, because it was a plant.
Among the three weak guys in Shi Yu’s team, only the worm in the Beast Taming Space escaped because it was in a delicate phase…
…
That night, Shi Yu heard a lot of commotion.
Light appeared outside the window, as if someone had obtained the recognition of the heroic spirit.
After casually taking out his cell phone to look at the group message, he realized that it was only an ordinary heroic spirit, so Shi Yu didn’t pay attention.
Until the next morning.
Shi Yu arrived at the place yesterday.
There were still many people here today. After all, it was already very late when the ruins were unsealed yesterday.
There was no time for many people to try summoning it.
“Can’t I?”
Near the Heroic Spirit Ruins, Shi Yu tried to find the feeling he had yesterday. Unfortunately, he couldn’t enter that strange feeling again.
Shi Yu naturally didn’t believe it.
The ruins altar didn’t crack. In theory, it should still be able to enter a listening state.
If it was like the stone statue of Ping Cheng or the stone wall of the Iron-eating Beast Ruins, it would have directly cracked. Shi Yu wouldn’t have to go through so much trouble. After all, the dead were to be respected, but the problem was that it hadn’t cracked yet.
“Have breakfast and read some books first, I guess.”
Shi Yu turned and left…
He decided to spend the remaining five days of the military training with this ruin.
As for any more time than that, he really couldn’t afford to waste much. After all, he still had a pile of pets to raise.
Throughout different times in the day, Shi Yu secretly came to the ruins altar many times.
When others summoned their spirits, he was chatting with the altar in the corner.
When others accepted their tests, he held a memorial for Emperor Shi in the corner.
When others happily obtained their soul seed, Shi Yu was depressed. He really hoped that he could answer Shi Di’s “who’s there”.
In fact, because he missed Emperor Shi, Shi Yu even specially found Director Li and Instructor Feng to apply to ascend the altar again when no one was around.
What if there really was an Emperor Spirit inside?
“Didn’t you say you weren’t going?”
“And why do you need to be alone when you do it?”
Director Li and Instructor Feng looked at Shi Yu and were stunned.
“I originally didn’t plan to go up, but I made another discovery. This is part of an important archeological plan.”
“In order to avoid making a big commotion again, it’s better to choose a time when no one is around.”
“If we have to do the confidentiality agreement again, you guys will be in trouble.”
Shi Yu coughed dryly and explained.
“Yes.” Director Li and Instructor Feng looked at each other and nodded.
With Bureau 11’s identity, this request was not difficult.
They deliberately found an empty night to avoid the awkward situation if Mu Huiyin’s spirit appeared again.
In short, although they were quite stunned at first, Director Li and Instructor Feng immediately became excited after thinking about it.
Oh shit!
Shi Yu was going to make another big discovery!
Looking at Shi Yu’s confident expression…
This time, was it the Heavenly Formation Great General, the Sea Suppression Great General, or the heroic spirit of Great General Bai Lin?
Late at night.
With only Shi Yu, Director Li, and Instructor Feng around, Shi Yu ascended the altar again.
Seeing Shi Yu ascend the altar, the two masters revealed looks of anticipation.
However, this time…
Shi Yu stood in a military posture on the altar for an hour.
Forget about the Emperor Shi’s Spirit, no other heroic spirits appeared this time.
On the altar.
Shi Yu’s expression was blank .”…”
The scene was awkward.
This also made Director Li and the others have strange expressions.
Although he didn’t know why Shi Yu suddenly wanted to ascend the altar, theoretically speaking, Shi Yu had already obtained the recognition of General Mu Huiyin. With Shi Yu’s aptitude, it wasn’t difficult for him to obtain the recognition of other heroic spirits.
It wasn’t like it had never happened for a talented Beast Tamer to receive the recognition of multiple heroic spirits.
For example, Lu Qingyi at that time summoned seven or eight heroic spirits at once.
As for Shi Yu… it was quite strange. He had clearly summoned the heroic spirit of the Ice Dragon General, but after that, not a single heroic spirit responded.
A moment later, Shi Yu came down.
He even muttered to himself,
“I didn’t expect General Mu Huiyin to be so unpopular with her comrades. The ancients are really biased against mixed blood.” After Shi Yu came down, he pushed the blame for the lack of heroic spirits onto the little sword spirit.
Director Li and Instructor Feng: (⊙_⊙) So that’s how it is?
…
For the next few days, Shi Yu still did not give up.
Occasionally, he would meditate and give his pet some extra points, but the most important energy was still spent on looking.
The protected area of the ruins had amassed a large collection of antiques, artifacts, and historical information from the Emperor Shi era. Shi Yu planned to finish reading them in the next few days.
As he learned about history, he chatted with the altar.
Therefore, another famous scene appeared in the next few days. The other students were working hard to summon their spirits. Shi Yu was reading. The other students followed the instructors and mentors to the edge of the Specter Battlefield to train. Shi Yu was reading.
Over the past few days, the students of Ancient Capital University have gained a lot.
The ones with the greatest gains were a batch of Beast Tamers who had obtained the recognition of the spirits, including Shi Yu, Yu Shu, and Wang Ling.
After the ruins were unsealed, ten more people obtained the recognition of the heroic spirit after Shi Yu.
However, although they were ambitious and hoped to receive the same treatment as Shi Yu and the recognition of the Great General, reality was reality. The subsequent ten people were only acknowledged by ordinary heroic spirits like Tao Yi.
This was considered not bad. After all, those who could be left behind by Emperor Shi had extraordinary strength. When they were alive, they were basically master-level Beast Tamers, the elite forces of the Dong Huang Dynasty. Their heroic spirits were basically all monarch races. This was already a very huge increase for this group of students.
If nothing unexpected happened, in a year or two, they would definitely become elites of the battle club and candidates for the school team. They had a chance of competing in the National League!
“F*ck.” In the protected area, in a library, Shi Yu sat in a corner. After reading 116 books, he felt extremely sad. The little sword spirit stuck its head out and followed beside Shi Yu. It fought with him to monopolize the cool air of the air conditioner, making Shi Yu, who couldn’t find any useful information, even more depressed.
“It’s almost 1 PM.”
“The military training will end tomorrow.”
“If I had known earlier, I wouldn’t have named you Chi Tong. If you were called Red Hair, the ruins might have given us more face…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The little sword spirit was confused. The Beast Tamer was saying strange silly things again.
“Let’s try again.” Shi Yu saw that the sky was dark and knew that it was time for him to take action.
After 12 o’clock, the Heroic Ruins would be sealed. There was basically no one left, but Shi Yu had the privilege to enter himself.
Two days ago, Director Li and Instructor Feng even specially followed, hoping to see a surprise. However, after that, only Shi Yu himself went to chat in the middle of the night.
In the dark night, under the moonlight.
Shi Yu walked on the altar again and looked at the ruins under the moonlight.
“Why aren’t you saying anything… I’m leaving tomorrow. I won’t be back if I leave.”
Ruins :”…”
“I’m really leaving.”
Shi Yu repeated “I’m leaving” more than ten times.
Shi Yu was angry. He was already so humble.
Unfortunately, he didn’t dare to use reverse psychology on a Hero Ruins and a ruin built by Shi Di. He was afraid that Shi Di would wake from his corpse and kill him.
2: 30 a.m.
Shi Yu fell into complete despair. He planned to come again when he was free in the future.
However, at this moment, something unexpected happened. The ruin that didn’t react even after he said “I’m leaving” hundreds of times changed after he really turned around.
A diamond-shaped crystal appeared with a faint light and slowly landed in Shi Yu’s hand.
Shi Yu’s expression changed slightly. This ruin indeed had a “spirit”.
However, what was this thing? It didn’t look like a soul seed nor a resource… What was this…

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - Space-time Key
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Space-time Key
With the crystal in hand, Shi Yu asked for a long time what the ruins were.
But the ruins didn’t want to talk to him.
Shi Yu was speechless.
One start review!
“Sigh.”
So be it.
After a day, Shi Yu was also tired.
“Ha ~” After yawning, he put the crystal in his pocket and went back to sleep.
…
…
Outside the heroic spirit ruins, there were still a few soldiers on night duty.
The commotion that the crystal made just now was not big. They didn’t even know what happened inside.
Seeing Shi Yu come out so late today, they couldn’t help but ask.
“As usual.”
Shi Yu chuckled and brushed it off.
