Even if there were gains, he couldn’t say it casually.
He saw Emperor Shi, and Emperor Shi also saw him. Then, for the first time, something other than a soul seed was shook out of the heroic spirit ruins. This was a big deal!
Even if he wanted to share it, he had to share it with the right person… It was impossible for these soldiers to know about the crystal.
As Shi Yu walked, he took out his cell phone and took a photo of the crystal.
Shi Yu: “Senior, help me see what this is.”
He used the chat software and took a photo for Lu Qingyi.
Lu Qingyi: “?”
Lu Qingyi: “…Why aren’t you asleep yet?”
Somewhere, Lu Qingyi glanced at the time and typed out “…”.
Shi Yu: “You’re not sleeping either…”
A proper Beast Tamer would sleep before three in the morning.
Lu Qingyi: “Crystal? Use the index to take a look.”
Shi Yu: “I’m definitely asking you because I can’t detect it.”
Lu Qingyi: “Even the index can’t detect what it is… You’re asking me…? Where did you pick it up…”
Shi Yu: “It’s nothing. The listening talent accidentally overheard the conversation between Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin. Then, I chatted more with the ruins, so it shook this out for me.”
Lu Qingyi: [Surprisedcat.jpg]
A minute later…
Shi Yu: “Where are you??”
Lu Qingyi: “On the way… Wait for me. I’ll be there in 20 minutes. Wait until I’m there.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu glanced at the moon and looked at the time. Waiting for you??
What time was it? He still wanted to sleep even if she didn’t sleep.
“I miscalculated…”
Shi Yu was confused when he put down the cell phone.
He should have sent Senior Lu a photo after waking up tomorrow.
…
In less than 20 minutes, Lu Qingyi really came here.
In order to cooperate with Shi Yu’s research, Director Li and the others found a single dormitory for Shi Yu.
Lu Qingyi arrived in a hurry and didn’t disturb the others.
“Where’s the crystal?”
The moment Senior Lu arrived, she grabbed Shi Yu’s shoulders and shook him.
She sounded nervous and excited.
“Cough, don’t be excited. It’s over there.” Shi Yu pointed at the table.
Lu Qingyi:!!!
She showed a pained expression. This was such an important thing, was it just like a cup?
“What you said just now, was it true?”
“How could I lie about this?”
Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and looked at Shi Yu with a complicated expression.
Freak!
His listening talent was activated too often.
“Blue, rhombus, crystal. I think I know what this is.” She sighed.
Along the way, she recalled Shi Yu’s words and finally realized something..
“You know??” Shi Yu was shocked.
She should have said so earlier.
Shi Yu was immediately not sleepy.
“I’ve only heard of word descriptions, but because no concrete substance has been passed down, it’s very normal that the index can’t detect it.” Lu Qingyi looked at the hexagon crystal.
“This is the ‘key’.”
“Key??” Shi Yu was at a loss. He picked up the crystal. What could this thing open?
“The key to space and time!” Lu Qingyi added.
“You should have heard of it, right? Although the earliest origin of archeology might not be Emperor Shi, he was the first person to systematically organize this subject.”
“Therefore, Emperor Shi is also known as the ancestor of archeology.”
Shi Yu was stunned. That was indeed the case…
“The entire Blue Planet has a history of billions of years, and the Beast Taming Era is only more than 2000 years. Before that, the historical gaps were even more serious. There were many Mythical ruins and totem ruins. Emperor Shi was the first person in the records to classify the ruins and organize personnel to establish an organization to explore many ruins systems.”
“However, some ruins are difficult to crack even for Emperor Shi.”
“According to the records, in order to open some ruins, he used the spatial power of time to tailor-make a ‘Space-time Key’ to forcefully open the door of the ruins.”
“It’s said that this kind of ‘Space-time Key’ consumes a lot of the power of the Time Emperor. The Time Emperor didn’t create many of them in his life, so he only left behind some simple words and records, but there was no real item for us to look at.”
“Well… Only those ‘Mythical Ruins’ can block Emperor Shi outside and require him to spend a lot of effort to create the key.” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
“This!!”
Shi Yu almost lost his grip on the crystal.
“It means that this crystal is a key that can 100% open a certain mythical ruin?”
Shi Yu immediately felt that this thing was a Pandora’s box. He felt cold all over and immediately put it back on the table.
“Well…” Lu Qingyi had a serious expression.” It must be. The ruins space we’re in contact with now are all left behind by legendary Beast Tamers. However, apart from this type of ruins space, there’s also that kind of naturally formed alternate spaces or special spaces created by Mythical creatures themselves. It might be their habitat or their treasure vault, but no matter what, it’s not something outsiders can easily enter, even for legendary Beast Tamers. ”
“And the ‘Space-time Key’ created by the Time Emperor, who is proficient in controlling spatial power, seems to be a tool that can forcefully open the corresponding space.”
“You’re too lucky.” Lu Qingyi looked excited.
“What’s so lucky about that…”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “Perhaps Emperor Shi destroyed the Dong Huang Dynasty because he explored these Mythical Ruins.”
Shi Yu thought about it carefully. When he chatted with the ruins, the most they talked about seemed to be where Emperor Shi went in the end.
Damn it, the more Shi Yu thought about it, the more he felt that the Mythical Ruins corresponding to this ruin crystal were the culprits behind the death of Emperor Shi, as well as the great calamity of the Dong Huang Dynasty.
Although he wanted to know what kind of ruins it was, his rationality stopped Shi Yu.
He shouldn’t court death. If he guessed correctly, there was a ferocious divine beast that could instantly kill Shi Di living inside. If he woke it up, he wouldn’t be the only one who would die. Perhaps the entire country would be buried with him. They would enter the next totem war.
“Tell me in detail.” Lu Qingyi asked Shi Yu.
“This…” Shi Yu told Lu Qingyi about the conversation between Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin, as well as his guesses.
A moment later, Lu Qingyi’s expression also became serious. She felt that this ruin crystal was not something good.
She was very similar to Shi Yu. Beast Tamers with the gift of listening preferred to court death, but this Space-time Key clearly led to disaster…
“Actually, we can guess in a good direction…” Lu Qingyi said after a moment of silence.
“Stop.” Shi Yu persuaded his senior and said, “Even if it’s a 99% chance that Emperor Shi had conquered this Mythical Ruins and left us a bunch of treasures inside, we should still hold on to the worst 1%… After all, we can’t afford to bet.”
Lu Qingyi smiled. “That’s true. Moreover, we don’t even know which ruins correspond to this space-time key.”
“There are only a few Mythical ruins in the country, but there are still many Mythical ruins in the totem area…”
Shi Yu nodded and said,
“Senior, please keep this a secret.”
“As for the crystal, leave it with me for the time being.”
“Uh.” Lu Qingyi was stunned.
Shi Yu touched his nose. He was a little selfish. He was afraid that after handing it over, the big shots of Bureau 11 would not be able to help but team up to explore. They wouldn’t bring him along for sure, but they were also afraid that this Mythical Ruins would really bring about some disaster. Of course, with such a thing, it would be a lie if Shi Yu said he wasn’t curious.
If possible, he hoped to explore with everyone after he became stronger.
Legendary Beast Tamers only had totem-level pets.
And he already knew the standard to advance to the totem level. A transcendent-level skill!
As long as he could teach super skills, theoretically speaking, he had hope of stepping into the legendary domain and standing on the same level as those super experts in history.
In fact, what if he maxed out his super skill points?
Divine-level skills represented origin, rules, and laws. They were abilities that only divine beasts could master.
As for the transcendent level, it was the level closest to a Mythical skill. If the transcendent skill point reached the “Dao Proficiency” level, could it compare to a divine skill, or rather, upgrade it into a divine skill and let the pet step into the Mythical level?
Shi Yu felt that he could look forward to it. Therefore, he wanted to wait until he developed to that point. At the very least, he had to be not inferior to Empress Shi before trying to open this demonic box.
“No problem,” Lu Qingyi said. “It was originally given to you by the heroic spirit ruins.”
“If it’s placed elsewhere, there might be unknown hidden dangers.”
“However, since you’ve already let me know about this…” Lu Qingyi stared at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “I understand.”
He had already dug a hole for Senior Lu. If he didn’t satisfy her curiosity, she would probably die of depression.
Digging a hole without filling it was a bad habit.
…
The next morning, Lu Qingyi left.
Shi Yu was glad that he had asked her. She immediately satisfied his curiosity.
Otherwise, not knowing the use of the ruins crystal would probably be more uncomfortable than being prevented from exploring the Mythical Ruins.
When Shi Yu woke up the next morning, he took a deep breath.
Although he didn’t sleep for long last night, it seemed like he could return to school to sleep next. Today’s military training would be over. This military training was ridiculous, to be honest. First, he summoned a general, then he was glared at by Emperor Shi, and then he obtained the key to a Mythical Ruins. His experience was too exciting.
Who else had that!
In the next half of the morning, it was the farewell meeting between the instructors and the students. There were also talks. Shi Yu didn’t pay much attention to it because apart from Master Feng, he didn’t seem to know any instructors.
And the thing that Shi Yu had the deepest impression of Master Feng was that he had provided Little Chi Tong’s food for the past few days…
When the students were packing, Shi Yu, who had spatial equipment, was already waiting to leave.
“You’re welcome to come and play next time. Eat your fill.” Outside, Instructor Feng went to Shi Yu’s side. Damn it, the future guardian level pet of Dong Huang had eaten his food when it was a baby. If word of this got out, it would be so amazing.
“Ah, alright, no problem,” Shi Yu said with an embarrassed smile. He still had to bring Little Chi Tong here to farm experience later. He would definitely come to visit more.
“Did Dr. Lu come over again last night?” The two top masters, Director Li and Dean He, were naturally with Instructor Feng the whole time. After all, the three of them were the in-charge of this military training.
“About three in the morning, she directly rode the Green Spirit Wind Bird over.” Dean He blinked. He looked at Shi Yu with a strange expression and said, “Could it be that something happened in the ruins yesterday?”
Instructor Feng also looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Could they handle the truth?
“Why? Why are you asking?” Director Li coughed and said, “Don’t ask too much about Bureau 11. This is all confidential. Do you still want to sign more contracts?”
Instructor Feng and Dean He waved their hands in embarrassment. How could they?
The three of them stopped asking about Shi Yu.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Forget it, I’ll wait in the car first.”
He went back the same way he got here. Shi Yu boarded the armored school bus.
A moment later, the other students who had packed their things also got into the car.
After a student came up, he passed by Shi Yu and fell silent. He glanced at Shi Yu in awe and walked back.
Another student came up. As he passed by, he took a deep breath and glanced at Shi Yu in admiration before walking back.
Xu Jingyin, Wang Ling, and Shi Yu’s classmates had complicated views on Shi Yu after this.
In this military training, Shi Yu was the greatest winner. He actually contracted the heroic spirit of the Ice Dragon General.
A high-level overlord race!
The most uncomfortable thing was that because of the contract, they couldn’t discuss it yet. They could only worship Shi Yu with their eyes.
If nothing unexpected happened, these more than 600 new students, the new students from the archeology and Battle Department, would become a cool group in Ancient Capital University in the future.
In the future, when they encountered other students’ evaluations in Ancient Capital University, they could stand on a high ground and say disdainfully…
“You don’t understand Shi Yu at all. He’s not that simple, but I can’t give you the specifics. I can only say that I know what I know, but I can’t say much about what I don’t understand either. Don’t ask me what’s going on. The confidentiality involved is too great. Saying it won’t benefit either of us. Just pretend you don’t know. As for the rest, I can only say that the waters here are very deep…”
When Shi Yu thought of this scene, he couldn’t help but smile in the car.
It was difficult for these people to cooperate with him and keep it a secret…
“Well…” When Shi Yu smiled, Wang Ling, the class monitor, was still sitting beside Shi Yu, looking at him. This time, he said carefully,” Are you still selling that sachet of yours? ”
He thought for a moment. Perhaps Shi Yu really didn’t lie to him. This sachet was really something. In any case, Shi Yu’s was definitely something good…
“Uh.” Shi Yu glanced at him and said, “It’s too late… There’s no more stock.”
Wang Ling: “?”
Shi Yu was helpless. He had contracted another energy-consuming big shot.. How could he have any extra sachet to sell to him? He didn’t have enough to absorb!

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - Senior Pandas New Discovery
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Senior Panda’s New Discovery
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the student dormitory of Ancient Capital University.
At noon, Shi Yu returned to the campus.
After returning, Shi Yu took a cold shower and ate an ice popsicle. He lay on the bed in satisfaction.
“Wuu.”
Eleven also hugged a basin of milk fragrance ice cream and ate it with relish.
This was an ice cream frozen from the basin milk made of the female Iron-eating Beast’s mother’s milk. It was produced by Senior Panda’s family, and the Iron-eating Beast agreed to eat it.
“Yiya ~ Burp ~”
As for Baby Ginseng, it gulped down some iced soda.
If what Eleven ate was still a little nutritious, then what it drank was purely junk food water.
However, in the words of the ginseng baby, it was already very nutritious. As for water, it just had to drink whatever it got happily.
Along the way, Shi Yu and the others were affected by Little Chi Tong and yearned for something cold.
Unfortunately, Buggy didn’t have a mouth, so it could only continue sleeping.
“Mi ~”
After arriving at a new environment, Little Chi Tong undoubtedly crawled into the fridge again and even hugged its ice-element energy crystal.
Shi Yu didn’t mind the risk of the fridge being burned. He yawned and looked at the classes after school officially started the day after tomorrow.
As he watched, a video call frame suddenly popped up on his cell phone.
“Eh.”
Shi Yu glanced at the ID and realized that it was Senior Panda. He directly swiped to answer.
A moment later, Lin Xiuzhu’s face appeared on the screen.
Her face was very close to his, and she looked very excited. Her gaze revealed joy.
“Big, big, big discovery!”
Lin Xiuzhu went straight to the point and said, “There are two pieces of good news. Which one do you want to hear?”
Shi Yu blinked.
“Let’s hear the second best one first.”
Lin Xiuzhu smiled and said, “I’ve already researched a way to let the Iron-eating Beast steadily awaken the ‘Giant Transformation’ skill before evolution.”
“Really??” Shi Yu was pleasantly surprised.
“Well, the resources used are relatively expensive, but compared to evolution materials, it’s alright.”
After confirming how much the evolution materials determined the potential of the Iron-eating Beast after evolution, Lin Xiuzhu had been researching ways to let the Iron-eating Beast awaken its giant transformation before evolution.
If it could be researched, it was a relatively important increase in the Iron-eating Beast race’s potential.
This meant that as long as one had money, every Iron-eating Beast had a chance of reaching a high-level monarch race.
“Impressive, impressive,” Shi Yu praised.
Master Lin Hongnian had developed a skill manual that allowed the Iron-eating Beast to learn Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist.
Now, Lin Xiuzhu had researched the secret manual for the Iron-eating Beast’s awakening skill.
This father and daughter’s research of the Iron-eating Beast was indeed very talented.
The Iron-eating Beast’s price increased for sure. Was he just waiting to collect the money?
“Wait, there’s better news than this?” Shi Yu suddenly realized.
“Hehe.” Lin Xiuzhu’s expression was smug. “I also found a way to let the Iron-eating Beast quickly increase its’ hardening ‘proficiency.”
“In the breeding base, a young Iron-eating Beast used this method to reach expert level in just a week.”
If Shi Yu was only slightly surprised when Senior Panda said that she had developed the awakening method of Giant Transformation, then he would be very shocked now.
“How did you do it?” Shi Yu was stunned. Senior Panda was too strong.
The four years in the Feeding Department and Research Department weren’t wasted.
If they really found a way to quickly increase their hardening proficiency, the Iron-eating Beast could evolve in batches.
At that time, the Iron-eating Beast’s status would rise again!
Shi Yu originally planned to study it himself when he was free, but firstly, he wasn’t free. Secondly, he had more important missions at the moment, such as exploring the second stage evolution of the iron-eating beast.
However, in the blink of an eye, Senior Panda had researched it?
“Do you remember that in the research paper on the evolution of the iron-eating beasts, it mentioned that the hardening substance of the Nine Li Battle Beast is a little different from the hardening substance of the iron-eating beasts?”
Shi Yu nodded.
“That’s the key.”
“The hardening of the Nine Li Battle Beast has a ‘nourishing’ effect on the hardening of ordinary Iron-eating Beasts.”
“With the special features of transcendent Level Hardening such as release, flow, and application, the Nine Li Battle Beast can use its Hardening Material to nurture the little Iron-eating Beast’s strength.”
“Under nurturing, as long as the hardening energy circulates around the little Iron-eating Beast’s body, the amount of hardening of the little Iron-eating Beast and its control over hardening can increase quickly.”
“I’ve already used my father’s Nine Li Battle Beast to experiment. Its hardening, and even the perfect level hardening of my Iron-eating Beast, has a strengthening effect.”
“In other words, as long as one Nine Li War Beast puts all its energy into constantly strengthening and hardening another Iron-eating Beast, then the speed of the hardening of that Iron-eating Beast will, in theory, be very fast. Furthermore, the upper limit of the increase can be very high, depending on the hardening level of the Nine Li War Beast!”
Shi Yu: “!!!”
“This is indeed a super big discovery…” He looked stunned and said to the screen.
What was the difference between this and the body tempering in martial arts novels!
Hardening could be played this way?
No wonder there were so many Iron-eating Beasts who had mastered high-level hardening in the stone wall images.
As long as there was a big shot to level up, a high proficiency hardening Iron-eating Beast Army could indeed be nurtured with some time!
“Is there anything I can do?” Shi Yu asked.
“Didn’t the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute at the university still raise three Iron-eating Beast cubs?”
“Zheng Yingjie and the others are taking care of it.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
Lin Xiuzhu: “Can you test them again and see if Eleven can help them increase their hardening levels?”
“That’s easy.” Shi Yu nodded. He would try even without Lin Xiuzhu saying so.
If even transcendent Hardening could help the iron-eating beast strengthen the hardening substance, what about his Eleven’s max-level Hardening?
He felt that the Iron-eating Beast Army he saw must also have at least one Nine Li Battle Beast that had mastered max-level hardness.
“Please.”
“Then I’ll go now. If it’s alright, Senior, come to Ancient Capital again when you’re free. I’ll get Eleven to help you increase your pet’s hardening proficiency.” said Shi Yu.
“Alright.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled.
…
“Eleven!!”
Eleven had just finished its basin of milk ice cream and was about to do the training for falling at an altitude of 10,000 meters. It was stopped by Shi Yu.
“??!” Eleven scratched its head.
What was wrong?
“Stop training for now. Come with me to do an experiment and see if you have the potential to raise a child.”
“Huh?” Eleven was confused.
It was only two years old, and it was a baby.
“Let’s go and get you a student card. When the time comes, you can go to the gravity room, charging room, competitive tower, and other training facilities.”
“!!!” Eleven’s eyes lit up.
“Awww!!” It cheered.
Eleven liked the training facilities of the Ancient Capital University that it saw a few days ago.
For example, in the gravity room, one could freely adjust the gravity in the room. Five times the gravity, ten times the gravity, and twenty times the gravity. Eleven had only done weight training in the past. When had it ever experienced such a high-end training method like the gravity training room maintained by mechanical life?
Unfortunately, because Shiyu wasn’t free, he temporarily took Eleven only to the charging room of the Gudu University.
Now, when he heard that Shi Yu was going to give it a student card, so that it could go to various training facilities in the future, Eleven was extremely excited.
That’s right!
It was already a mature pet and could already use its own card to train.
Following that, Shi Yu began to set off for the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute.
Because he was worried about leaving little Chi Tong alone at home, he conveniently pulled the sleeping little sword spirit up from the ice cream pile.
Hardening could lead to hardening…
Along the way, Shi Yu first found it magical, but then found it understandable.
From the various historical traces, the iron-eating beasts should be a very large-scale army type of battle style.
They were closely connected, and it was obvious from the skill “impregnable”.
Although Shi Yu had yet to add some “impregnable” points to Eleven, he already knew the characteristics of this skill.
This metal-element skill described that it was protected by the metal-elemental power, increasing its overall resistance. Elemental, physical, mental, and soul damage was all included in the skill’s resistance.
This was undoubtedly a very strong skill, but if that was all, wasn’t calling it “Metal Protection” more appropriate than “impregnable”?
The reason why the ancients named this skill impregnable was very simple. It was because after reaching proficiency, it would become a resonance skill.
There was nothing special about using Impregnable. However, if another pet beside it also used Impregnable, then the solid skills of both sides would resonate. Although it couldn’t achieve the exaggerated effect of overlapping effects, it would strengthen each other.
Furthermore, the resonance effect and number of resonances would also increase with the proficiency of the skill.
Just think about it, if there was an army of 100, 1,000, and 10,000 pets that mastered all the impregnable skills, and when they fought, 10,000 impregnable forces would strengthen each other, how terrifying would the effect be? Although this was only a high-level skill, the tactical value was not inferior to any super skill!
This was a skill that had an even more impressive effect the more people used it. It was specially made for war, and it was an army skill. Together with the Inner Power skill, giantization, and hardening, it could easily create an invincible army.
In ancient times, the solid city wall and the heavily guarded moat was the standard. It was undoubtedly very appropriate to compare the army of pets who had mastered those skills to these standard defenses.
“It’s a pity that I only plan on nurturing one Iron-eating Beast. My impregnable skill is useless.”
He couldn’t nurture an iron-eating beast army just because of a skill, right? As he thought about it, Shi Yu sighed.
This was a single-target high-level skill, group type super skill… Only group battles could maximize the effect.
“Unless…” Shi Yu thought for a moment. It was not impossible.. Firstly, he could let Buggy materialize a bunch of teammates who knew how to use impregnable. Secondly, he could casually teach Eleven a suitable avatar skill to create a second Eleven…

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - Beast Tamer Eleven Comes Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Beast Tamer Eleven Comes Up
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Iron-eating Beast Research Institute.
This research institute that was opened to study the evolution of iron-eating beasts was actually half abandoned at the moment.
The evolution of the Iron-eating Beast had been announced. Although there were still a few other research projects, Senior Panda had brought most of the research materials back to Ping Cheng for research.
Currently, there were only three young Iron-eating Beasts left as mascots. They were the witness of the friendship between Senior Panda and the university!
The age of the three little iron-eating beasts was about the same as when Shi Yu had carried Eleven away. They were just one year old.
They were all petite and cute.
Currently, the seven archaeological heroes were taking turns to take care of them.
When Shi Yu arrived, no one was there. There was only a Moon Silver Wolf looking at the research institute. It was Zheng Yingjie’s pet.
“Roar!!!” When the Moon Silver Wolf realized that it was the person in charge of the research institute, Shi Yu, it turned a blind eye and continued sleeping.
Shi Yu ignored it and headed straight for the backyard amusement park of the three little iron-eating beasts.
“Zzzz ~”
As expected, the three little iron-eating beasts that had just finished lunch were piled together, sleeping in their nests.
“Hmm.” Eleven stuck her head out of Shiyu’s pocket.
What a lazy atmosphere!
“This is a normal iron-eating beast.”
“You guys aren’t supposed to train all day.” Shi Yu felt that it was very normal.
Eleven in Shiyu pocket:???
So I’m abnormal!
“It’s not that you’re abnormal, but it’s only right to strike a balance between work and rest.” Shi Yu coughed dryly. If not for the fact that he had the ginseng baby and Absolute Sleep and Minimization skills, Eleven would have long been crippled for training so desperately.
“Hmm??” Eleven was furious. It had worked so hard just to make Shi Yu the strongest Beast Tamer. Only then would it live up to its reputation of being acknowledged and nurtured by Shi Yu.
“Hmm!” Eleven firmly believed that no matter what, its determination would not change!
It trained hard and worked hard to have the strength to help Shi Yu deal with various situations. It would help Shi Yu become the most powerful Beast Tamer and make Shi Yu not regret choosing him!
Perhaps it was because Shi Yu and the others had arrived, but the three young Iron Beasts opened their eyes in a daze.
“Wu…”” Wu…” “Wu…”
They let out cries one after another and looked at Shi Yu and Eleven with watery eyes.
Shi Yu and Eleven had lived here for a long time, so they were naturally familiar with the three Iron-eating Beast cubs. Although they weren’t as familiar as the Panda Senior, they had fed them a few times.
Upon seeing them, Shi Yu smiled, as if he had seen the Eleven when he was young.
“Do you want to become stronger?”
When Shi Yu arrived, he immediately spoke with telepathy like a charlatan.
“Hmm! (Want to become stronger!)”
Eleven jumped down and looked at her three brothers and sisters.
On the way, Shi Yu had already told Eleven about the hardening support training method and the purpose of his visit.
“Huh?” “Huh?” “Huh?”
The three Iron-eating Beast cubs had confused expressions. Become stronger? What was that?
Now, there were people feeding them every day, eating, drinking, sleeping, playing when they woke up. What was the point of getting stronger? They loved their current life.
Eleven: ╥_╥
“Roar! Roar! Roar!” Eleven looked at Shi Yu. Was this appropriate?
It was because of this that the Iron-eating Beast Clan was looked down upon!
Remove their benefits! Iron-eating beasts had to be reared!
Three cubs of the small iron-eating beast: (っ`- ?c)マ
Bad Bear! Leave!
Shi Yu :”…”
“Calm down… I don’t think one generation can change that.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Alright, quickly bless them.”
“Roar!” Eleven looked at the three little iron-eating beasts resentfully and jumped down from Shi Yu’s shoulder. Its body slowly became larger, and then it walked over and grabbed a baby iron-eating beast with one hand, with another in its mouth.
A moment later, Eleven began to impart skills to them with Hardening. The Level 11 Hardening quickly flowed through the three little iron beasts and circulated once.
At this moment, the three little iron-eating beasts were still in a daze. They felt a slow flow through their bodies.
But a few minutes later, after Eleven used the hardening substance to temper their bodies a few times, the Iron-eating Beast cubs could clearly sense a qualitative increase in their physiques!
There was even a small iron-eating beast that suddenly emitted the Light of Awakening. It leveled up and reached Level 4!
Without thinking, it was obvious that it was the improvement of hardening proficiency that led to growth.
“As expected of the Maximum Level Hardening. It’s much better than the Perfect Level Hardening described by Senior.” Shi Yu was stunned.
At the same time.
The three little iron-eating beasts, who originally didn’t care much about becoming stronger, cried out in surprise when they discovered that their strength had increased so easily.
“Wu wu wu!!!” What was this?
Eleven looked calm. “Oh! (It’s called adding points.)”
The little iron-eating beast didn’t understand what it meant, but after a moment of silence, it uniformly roared, “Roar! (Big boss, add more!)”
Eleven:???
Eleven was about to lecture them and realized that this was her catchphrase. It went silent.
In the end, it all came back to adding points.
Beside him, Shi Yu smiled and said, “Have fun. I’ll call Senior and get you a card on the way. I’ll be back later.”
“Roar!!” A moment later, Eleven told Shiyu to rest assured. If it wanted to correct the thoughts of these three children. Why didn’t they at least have the awareness of a bug!
With that said, it began to emit the Panda King’s deterrence.
One of the effects of deterrence could make his clansmen worship, revere, and follow it.
Shi Yu was about to leave when he was made speechless by Eleven’s deterrence and almost fell!
Good lord!
It was just for you to use them as an experiment. Why was it thinking of teaching them the “hard training” mental mentality?
…
“The effect was right.”
“It’s indeed possible.”
“Is that so? Haha.”
“Mm, let me know when you get back.”
As Shi Yu walked towards the battle club, he called Lin Xiuzhu.
After knowing that Shiyu had also succeeded, Lin Xiuzhu was very happy.
Her father had developed the Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist manuals. Shi Yu had found the iron-eating beast’s evolution method, and she had finally made some contributions to reviving the iron-eating beast’s glory.
Lin Xiuzhu had been researching iron-eating beasts for the past four years.
Ping City.
“Shiyu succeeded too?” Lin Hongnian asked his daughter.
“Yes.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled and nodded.
“He also asked me to go to the ancient capital and planned to use this method to let Eleven help my iron-eating beast increase its hardness.”
“Dad, I think the day when Little He Hua masters Perfect Level Hardening won’t be far away. Remember to prepare the evolution materials. Our family should at least have a high-level sovereign race.”
In this world, an overlord species pet was a potential strategic weapon. No country had a stable breeding channel for overlord species pets. Today, an advanced king species was super powerful for a Beast Tamer.
“What? He wants you to go to the ancient capital? How about I go with you?” Uncle Lin Hongnian was shocked.
Eleven’s Hardening level was definitely high, at least higher than his Nine Li Battle Beast. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to use that super electromagnetic cannon and leave no marks on the armor.
“I also want to let Eleven help my battle beast…”
Lin Xiuzhu shook her head and said, “No, according to the data, the hardening substance of the Nine Li War Beast only has an enhancement effect on the hardening substance of the Iron-eating Beasts, and it doesn’t react to the form after evolution… Of course, if you don’t believe me, you can try it, but please believe my data!”
…
What a sin!
Lin Hongnian regretted being the first person to try evolution. Firstly, he didn’t use enough materials during the evolution. Secondly, he missed the opportunity to get carried to increase the hardness!
…
At the Gu Du University battle club.
Before Shi Yu came, he had asked the Beast-eared Lady about the student card.
Apart from the school, the combat club was also qualified to apply for some training cards. Shi Yu’s goal this time was to get two for Eleven and the others.
Anyway, all expenses would be reimbursed to the battle club. It would be a waste not to.
“I heard that you brought back a sword spirit that can possess you in the Martyr’s Ruins?”
When Shi Yu arrived, White Brook handed him the two training cards that Shi Yu wanted and said with a very interested expression.
Due to the confidentiality contract, she had only heard that Shi Yu had contracted a sword spirit. As for the source, she wasn’t too sure.
“That’s right, thank you.” Shi Yu took the training card and smiled.
“How’s your combat strength after possession? Do you want to fight me?”
“Possession VS fusion.” White Brook licked her lips, tempted.
Shi Yu was indeed a junior that she thought highly of. His battle style was getting more and more liked by her.
A real man should fight himself. What was the point of hiding behind a pet?
“This…” Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said,” Forget it, it’s only Level 2. ”
Although the little sword spirit was very strong, the difference in levels was too great. White Brook was a fierce woman who could smash a sovereign-level pet after fusing with it in the National Competition. Shiyu still didn’t want to be pressed down and ravaged by her.
“Hurry up and nurture it. Give it more resources and the school will reimburse you,” White Brook said.
“Alright.” Although Shi Yu said that, he chose to ignore it in his heart.
“Because the heroic spirits were very strong when they were alive, their growth speed is still very fast as long as the resources are in place.”
“Mm. If your sword spirit can reach the commander level during the holidays, you can also contract it. Apart from taking you to the capital to take a look, I can also take you to participate in another competition.” White Brook sat down, leaned back in her chair, and stretched.
“What match?” Shi Yu asked casually.
“Specifically, an unorthodox match for us Beast Tamers who are going to fight. Martial Arts Conference. During the Wu Emperor era, it was quite popular.” White Brook smiled and said, “However, the rewards are very ordinary. They are all some body tempering methods. There are sword skills, martial skills, and some strong nutritional supplements passed down from ancient times. You shouldn’t be interested.”
Shi Yu’s hand trembled as he said casually, “Yeah, let’s talk about it again. Let’s prepare for the Imperial Capital University exchange event that you mentioned first.”
“All the best, work hard.” The beast-eared girl cheered for Shiyu. Charge, towards the future of the battle club!
…
In just a day, after Shi Yu obtained something from the three rich girls, he returned to the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute, both physically and mentally exhausted.
This time, when Yu returned, he silently discovered that less than an hour had passed, and the three Iron-eating Beast cubs were already training in the backyard with hard work. Eleven was even encouraging them!!
Eleven suddenly realized that bringing the little guys who had gone astray back to the right path was even more satisfying and fulfilling than training him to become stronger.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Eleven, don’t force them. They’re still children.”
“Chirp!” “Chirp!” “Chirp!” Before Eleven could say anything, the three Iron-eating Beast cubs who were training for sprinting shouted solemnly.
It wasn’t the leader’s fault. It was their sudden realization.
Youths needed to shed blood and not stagnate. This was the meaning of life!
Shi Yu: “?”
You’re only a damn one year old. What youth? Be good and drink milk!
Eleven: (.?ˇ?ˇ?)”Where’s the student card, I want to show them around!”

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - The Strange Phenomenon of the Ancient Capital University
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: The Strange Phenomenon of the Ancient Capital University
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Could a pet use the training card to get a room?
In theory, there was such a precedent in the Ancient Capital University…
After the university built various training facilities, the guardian overlord Gem Meow often went to inspect on its own.
To put it bluntly, they treated the training facility as an amusement park.
However, this was only an exception. Most pets still retained more of their wildness even after being contracted by the Beast Tamer.
It was easy to cause trouble after leaving the Beast Tamer. Besides, very few pets knew the rules of human society well.
Of course, it didn’t mean that pets couldn’t understand the things of human society. In fact, it mainly depended on whether the Beast Tamer was willing to nurture pets in this aspect. If only pets were trained in combat power, it was impossible to rely on it to be a bystander…
For example, Shiyu was actually quite comprehensive in terms of pet training…
Gudu University, one of the training facilities, the gravity room.
“Where did these four little iron-eating beasts come from…”
The school term had just ended. The gravity room hall was filled with students, hoping to test the results of their training during the holiday.
Just as most of the students were waiting with their heads lowered, the four iron-eating beasts swaggered in.
Instantly, it attracted everyone’s attention.
The shrunk Little Eleven, who was more than a meter tall, led the three cute baby iron-eating beasts to the registration office.
“Roar.” After entering the registration hall, Eleven looked around and raised the training card in its hand!
One room!
Seeing the training card in the little iron-eating beast’s hand, everyone was stunned.
What was going on?
“Where’s your Beast Tamer?”
A sweet-looking girl walked over to Eleven and the others and bent down to ask. At the same time, she looked out of the door in confusion.
In the end, she didn’t discover anything.
“Oh, sob, sob.” Eleven waved its card and explained.
“You’re the Beast Tamer yourself? The three iron-eating beasts behind are the targets you’re training? You brought them here to see the world?” The female employee was dumbfounded.
Hearing her words, the other Beast Tamers in the hall were dumbfounded.
“Mm!!” Eleven handed the training card to the staff.
Speed, speed, speed, speed!!
Time was money!!!
“Ah, this.” The staff took the training card.
Forget it, I’ll know what happened after I swipe the card.
The staff took the card in silence, took two steps, and stuck it to the buffet registration machine.
Ding… Ding… Ding…
Information immediately appeared on the machine.
The Special Training Card for the Battle Club, its owner, and… the Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, a member of the Battle Club?
The staff:???
Eleven widened its eyes in curiosity and tiptoed. So that was how it was used. Got it! It could do it itself next time!
At the same time.
In the student dormitory.
After telling Eleven to send the little iron-eating beasts back to the research institute after playing, Shi Yu returned first.
However, he had just returned when he received a call from the school’s training facility.
“Student Shi Yu?” A woman’s voice sounded from the other side.
“I’m a staff member of the gravity room…”
“I wanted to confirm with you…”
Then, the staff told Shi Yu what she had seen.
“Ah, that’s right… Under my training, this child Eleven has been self-disciplined since it was young. I can already do those things on my own at her age. I think it should be able to go to the training facility by itself.”
The staff: “Ah, that’s very reasonable.”
A moment later, the staff understood the situation. Shi Yu, who had explained everything clearly, hung up.
“Gravity room…” Shi Yu nodded. Not bad.
The gravity environment was a very good place to counter electromagnetic levitation. It could very well train Eleven’s electromagnetic control!
…
That day, a strange urban legend spread in the university. An iron-eating beast called itself a Beast Tamer and soaked in the gravity room with three little iron-eating beasts for the entire afternoon…
At this moment, Shiyu, who was good at teaching, sat on the bed and added some points to Buggy.
Baby Ginseng was working hard at the side.
As for the little sword spirit, it was sleeping soundly in the ruins.
When he returned, Shi Yu specially passed by the resource warehouse and exchanged for more soul crystals and ice-elemental energy crystals.
The former was food for Little Chi Tong, and the latter was to build a big ice bed for him.
From the moment he returned at noon, Little Chi Tong had been sleeping. He was not very lively, so Shi Yu could understand. After all, he was a child and needed to sleep to rest and grow.
These few days, Little Chi Tong spent most of his time sleeping, so Shi Yu was very relaxed.
When he was taking care of the baby, the baby slept. It was the most relaxing time for the Beast Tamer. Shi Yu could also take the time to do other things. Therefore, he deliberately didn’t teach Chi Tong Absolute Sleep too soon, afraid that it would only sleep for an hour a day and be energetic for the remaining 23 hours…
At this moment, Shi Yu was still adding Psychic skills to Worm.
This newly awakened racial skill had to be maxed out before evolution.
Skill: Psychic (Perfect+188)
“Soon, soon.”
After more than ten days, it was finally almost done. Shi Yu’s eyes were filled with tears.
“Ji!!” Buggy was also very teary-eyed, and it cheered on the Beast Tamer and Baby Ginseng through telepathy.
Although the level of Psychic was not high, it was practical.
Elementary-level Psychic. The user could only materialize his mental strength and make a crude attack like Psychic Charge.
At the proficiency level, the user could already carefully control Psychic power. Using Psychic control to replace the hands and feet, taking a cup of water to drink, controlling a pen to write, and doing some slow flying were all fine.
Expert-level mental strength, the user could do some complicated things, such as using mental strength to control many objects at the same time or creating a mental barrier to defend.
As for Perfect Level Psychic power, it was even more perfect in terms of precision. It could be used to control elements, such as controlling the water element to form a water wall, controlling the sand to form a sand sculpture, and squeezing the air to form an air cannon.
Now, apart from these, the most valuable new usage method that had been activated was the Psychic domain.
Even if he expanded his psychic power to envelop a large area, the user could easily sense all changes in the area. This was better than low proficiency super vision.
Of course, as his proficiency increased, the power of the Willpower that the user could condense each time would definitely increase. This was also very important.
Sometimes, the changes in “technique” might just be supplemental.
If not for these skills, the user would only use simple psychic attacks. As long as its mental strength was strong enough, it could also destroy a planet with a single blow, countering all fancy moves.
Just like an awakened-level pet, even if it mastered max-level Psychic power, it would only be crushed when facing a monarch-level pet that mastered elementary Psychic power.
Skill: Psychic (Dao Proficiency)
Following that, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng continued nodding hard.
A moment later, the sounds of liberation came from the dormitory.
After adding points, Shi Yu collapsed and lay on the bed like a salted fish.
“Yi…” Beside him, Baby Ginseng also wiped its sweat.
Only Buggy in the form of a cocoon closed its eyes and released its psychic power, quietly experiencing the changes that a max-level psychic power had.
Without waiting for Shi Yu to ask, Buggy told him the proficiency changes that it could sense now.
It felt that its control of thought power had increased, and it could also capture the elemental particles better. Apart from that, the time it could continuously release Psychic power was almost limitless. It was very difficult to be interrupted by external factors until its mental strength was exhausted, but as to how to use it, it felt that it still needed to experiment.
Shi Yu stood up and said, “It’s even higher. Then, let’s use psychic power to control the weather, modify memories, control thoughts, and think up creations to affect reality.”
Buggy’s eyes widened.
That made sense.
“Lie down first. Study it after you evolve. Don’t waste too much energy. Also… since your endurance is almost limitless, try to see how high your current Psychic domain can extend. When you can envelop a meteorite outside the atmosphere with your Psychic power and pull it down, that’ll be impressive…”
Using mental power to cause a tsunami, cause an earthquake, control the weather, change memories, and control thoughts were all common in movies. However, in real life, very few pets could do it to such a ridiculous level. The ones in front were alright, but the later ones were harder.
For example, controlling the weather, pulling down meteorites, changing memories, and controlling thoughts were all ideal situations. The requirements on proficiency were too high.
Furthermore, wasn’t it good to use weather skills instead of going to control the weather? Wasn’t it good to use hypnosis instead of changing memories? Psychic power was judged as low-level because it was too basic.
Although its function was very strong and malleable, development was difficult. In comparison, the effects of many high-level skills could replace it and complete the corresponding mission at an easier price.
However, this didn’t mean that Psychic power couldn’t do it. Shi Yu had thrown a few difficult missions for Worm in the future.
Among them, Shi Yu looked forward to pulling down the meteorite the most…
Of course, with the current Buggy’s commander level strength, it would probably be a hundred million points too difficult to complete. Even if the Psychic proficiency was high, without the level of a totem, it didn’t seem easy.
“Ji!!!” Buggy excitedly sent a mental message. Alright.
It was very happy now.
It felt that max-level Psychic power was much higher than the max level of Leader. It was much more powerful.
From the current upper limit, that was indeed the case. The powerful thing about max-level hardness was that Eleven could actually create various divine weapons through hardness.
Max-grade hardness could already be maintained for a long time after leaving Eleven’s body. In other words, as long as Eleven’s strength was strong enough in theory, it could completely create an extremely strong battle armor and divine weapon that could maintain it for ten, a hundred, a thousand, or even ten thousand years.
No wonder it was Lord Chi You’s mount…
If this was the only effect, it definitely couldn’t compare to Psychic power.
However, one of the characteristics of max-level hardness was that its growth potential also gave it unlimited possibilities. So as to which skill was powerful, it still depended on the subsequent development of the two pets.
“If a max-level low-level skill is so powerful, then wouldn’t a max-level super skill really be comparable to a divine skill…”
Shi Yu lay down again.
As for Buggy, although Shi Yu had told it to lie down, it was too excited to sleep.
Buggy was showing off to Baby Ginseng again. Perfect Psychic power. Impressive, right?
Wasn’t this better than maxed sweet gas and maxed nutritional blood?
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng pouted. What was the big deal? It was the one who helped.
“Yi! (Impressive, but your Ice Dragon Whisker is gone. I just saw Chi Tong carry it away as a pillow.)” Baby Ginseng stabbed Buggy.
Buggy:??!!
…
The next morning.
Shi Yu got out of bed feeling refreshed.
The little sword spirit was still sleeping on the ice pile. Buggy was also sleeping in the Imperial Beast Space. Even Baby Ginseng and Eleven were definitely sleeping, leaving Shi Yu slightly stunned.
He was the first to get up today?
Forget about the other three, even Eleven was sleeping.
Was the training in the gravity room that tiring yesterday?
Yesterday afternoon, Eleven trained for half a day in a restrained state under high gravity.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. As he used electromagnetic levitation to resist the gravity flight, he still had to use his body and super vision to resist the energy bullets released by the gravity machine. He also had to heal himself. The pressure was indeed not small.
Sleep, sleep.
“Yi…” When Shi Yu woke up, Baby Ginseng was the second to wake up in a daze.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng rubbed its eyes. Although Shiyu didn’t have class today, it had class.
Baby Ginseng looked for its student card.
Shi Yu applied for two student cards from the battle club. One was for Eleven, and the other was for Baby Ginseng.
Eleven’s was used to activate various training facilities.
Those for baby ginseng was going to be used to listen to various high-end classes.
The 100 million smell changes contained in the max-level sweet gas allowed Baby Ginseng to enter the door of botany and smell science.
Some scents could make the Overlord Gem Meow lose its resistance and become obsessed. Some scents could make dragons fall into madness and enter a berserk state. These various magical knowledge made Baby Ginseng very emotional.
Compared to Eleven and Buggy, who had a headache over the test knowledge, Baby Ginseng, who had benefited from this, discovered the use of knowledge in battle.
Under Eleven’s persuasion, it turned out that it didn’t hate reading!
Eleven was right. Looking at this thing, he might really become stronger. This was the secret manual to become stronger!
After careful consideration, Baby Ginseng made a huge decision.
Since its training intensity couldn’t exceed Eleven, its evolution frequency couldn’t exceed Insect, and its racial potential couldn’t compare to the little sword spirit who had just joined the team, it didn’t fight to the death. It had found its own ginseng maxim.
Knowledge changed fate!
It wanted to take a different approach and temporarily change its class from Battle Ginseng to University Ginseng, and even evolve into Research Ginseng and PhD Ginseng.
“Do you really not need me to bring you to class…” Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng suspiciously.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng shook its head frantically. If Eleven could go alone, so could it. It was no longer a child.
It already knew human language, so it had no problem listening to the class.
“I’m afraid that you’ll be picked up by some pet on the way…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
Σ(°△ °|||) Baby Ginseng was shocked.
“I’m just scaring you. You can go by yourself. I’ve asked the Gem Cat avatar to look after you in secret. Remember to pay the reward to it yourself.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Baby Ginseng heaved a sigh of relief and expressed that there was no problem!
A moment later, Baby Ginseng went out with a small backpack, leaving Shi Yu in deep thought.
Damn, his pets were getting more and more strange.
Fortunately, Buggy and Little Chi Tong weren’t messing around yet…
Shi Yu sighed and ran to wash up. After washing up, a group chat message suddenly popped up on his phone, attracting Shi Yu’s attention. It was the class group.
Wang Ling: “Big news!! Our archeology department obtained a complete fossil of the ancient Tyrant Dragon from god knows where. This is an extinct overlord-level beast. I heard that they’re going to use this to give us our first lesson!!”
A classmate: “F*ck, what the hell. I just f*cking saw a ginseng baby carrying a backpack passing by the entrance of the cafeteria.”
Wang Ling: [?]
Shi Yu :”…”

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - Ancient Tyrant Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Ancient Tyrant Dragon
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
On that day, many people saw a strange phenomenon.
A ginseng baby carried a small backpack and walked towards the school’s classroom like a primary school student.
In the classroom, a pale-haired Master Feeder pointed at the top-grade spirit ginseng baby in the back seat in confusion.
So this was a student, not a lesson material?
How did it swipe the card in!
“Let it go.” At the window, an elegant big white cat licked its claws and sent a mental message to this mentor.
Education was important.
And ginsengs needed education too.
“What the hell.”
As for the students, they looked at Baby Ginseng, who was holding a notebook and pen with a more serious expression than them. They completely lost their ability to think.
There were actually precedents for pet classes. However, most of the pets were mechanical in order to support research, record, and take pictures as computers, phones, and instruments. However, it was definitely the first time that a ginseng baby came to his class as a student and not as an experimental material.
…
Wang Ling: “Oh my god, Baby Ginseng is taking class.”
Everyone: “?”
Weren’t you still paying attention to the Tyrant Dragon just now?
Wang Ling: “Is it your ginseng baby? Is it? I heard it’s very similar to yours. What’s wrong? @ Shiyu”
Shi Yu’s ginseng baby was considered half a tonic. After all, it had passed the battle club assessment with such violent methods.
It had only been a few days, and everyone still had a deep impression of it. Some people who had seen the battle quickly realized that the two ginseng babies were super similar. They were so arrogant and didn’t have the awareness that supplements usually had.
Shi Yu: “Seems like it.”
Everyone: “F*ck, it’s really you.”
They had only heard of letting pets live and fight in various places. They had never heard of letting pets go to classes.
Even if there was, it would definitely not be a ginseng baby.
Even if it was a ginseng baby, there would definitely be a Beast Tamer accompanying it. Was it appropriate to let it go alone?
Wang Ling: [There’s something wrong with you. I just checked the forum and heard that there was an iron-eating beast who claimed to be a Beast Tamer yesterday. It brought three small iron-eating beasts and soaked in the gravity room for an entire afternoon. Where did so many iron-eating beasts come from? Don’t tell me it’s yours??]
Ever since the evolution of the iron-eating beasts was announced, the students also knew that there was a metal-eating beast research institute here in the Ancient Capital University. They knew that it raised a few iron-eating beasts, and the person in charge of this research institute was Shiyu.
Shi Yu: “Shi Yu: Seems like it.”
Wang Ling: “Don’t copy your ID too if you’re going to copy paste the reply!”
Shi Yu: “Bye, I’m going to study.”
Shi Yu switched off his phone. Since his pets were so hardworking, it was time for him to work hard.
He would meditate today.
He wanted to raise the Beast Control Space to level 4 as soon as possible so that he could welcome a new physique breakthrough.
At that time, the contract, the King’s Envoy, and the Possession of Little Chi Tong would all be fine.
Shi Yu chose today’s mission. A moment later, Eleven and the others woke up. Of course, Buggy was still sleeping and absorbing the evolutionary materials.
Although it had only been a few days, because it had absolute sleep, the speed at which it absorbed the evolutionary power was still very fast.
Even though the level of the evolutionary material was very high, if nothing went wrong, it should be able to complete its evolution within this month.
“Hmm!” After packing up and greeting Shi Yu, Eleven left with her training card.
He had yet to successfully clear the Gravity Machine, so he had to work hard today.
As for the little sword spirit, the mission that Shiyu gave it was to play. In order to match its previous life, Shiyu found some ancient war movies and television dramas to let Little Chi Tong lie on the ice and watch.
Hmm, these were all things that he, Eleven, and Buggy had seen. Apart from the fact that there were a lot of dead people and pets, there was no problem with the scale. Children could see it. It could be considered an elementary education.
“This is the correct way to become a Beast Tamer!”
Realizing that there was not a single pet beside him and that everyone was working hard, Shi Yu sighed and continued meditating.
Without the interference of his pets and with the sachet left behind by Baby Ginseng, Shi Yu’s current meditation efficiency was very high. It was also very easy for him to immerse himself in it. It was very rare for him to be interrupted from meditation from time to time because of his daze like before.
…
The next day.
The new archeology students who had returned from their military training were finally about to have their first lesson.
Because Shi Yu had meditated for a day yesterday, his mental state was especially good today.
First, he went to the cafeteria to get a cup of nutritious soy milk and a meat bun. Then, he walked towards the classroom in satisfaction.
“Shit, shit, shit.”
When Shi Yu arrived, the classroom was filled with screams.
The reason why these students were so excited at this moment was because of the news that Wang Ling had revealed yesterday: Tyrant Dragon fossil!
The moment Shi Yu entered the classroom, he saw a huge fossil skeleton that was about 15 meters long!
Although it had become a fossil, the skeleton still emitted a faint deterrence, indicating its former status as the overlord of the land.
“F*ck, Shiyu is here.” As Shiyu entered, someone suddenly shouted.
“Are you sick?” Shi Yu was speechless. Why were they always saying “F*ck” and “F*ck”? And why was he treated the same way as the Tyrant Dragon and had to be called “F*ck”?
At this moment, it was the fourth time that the students looked at Shi Yu strangely.
The first time was when school reopened. Due to the results of Shi Yu’s vocation assessment. The second time was when they went to the ruins. Due to the results of Shi Yu’s battle club assessment. The third time… was when they returned. It was because of the commotion caused by Shi Yu in the Heroic Ruins… This time, it was because of the Beast Tamer Iron-eating Beast Legend and the university’s ginseng legend that was circulating in the Ancient Capital University.
So this was how pets were trained?
Let the pet apply for cards and start house training by itself. Let the pet learn the feeding knowledge by itself. Brilliant.
It directly made up for the Beastmaster’s lack of energy. It allowed the Beastmaster to take time to meditate and also allowed the Beastmaster to exercise his body when he had the time. After learning it, he could also arrange a pet like this another day!
“Student Shiyu, good morning.” On the podium, an old man with white hair smiled when he saw Shiyu.
“I’m your fossil teacher.”
“Hello, Professor Zhao.” Shi Yu knew this person. He had previously known the tutors and professors of the various classes in the archeology department.
This was one of the masters who studied the fossil domain. Although he couldn’t compare to Grandma Li of Division 11, he was still a rather experienced figure. There was no other way. These people from Division 11 were too good at this.
Fake archeologist: Study historical knowledge seriously, accumulate foundation, carefully examine ruins, and use modern technology to study in detail.
Real archeologists: Watch history as a documentary, talk about the past and the present, and listen to secrets.
“Hello.” Professor Zhao smiled. He was still unfamiliar with the names of the other students in the class, but he knew the name of the new star in the archeological field, Shiyu very well.
“Go sit,” the professor said.
“Alright.”
Following that, Shi Yu randomly found a seat and sat down. The other students also entered the classroom one after another. As expected, they were stunned by the huge fossil.
Just as Shi Yu was observing the fossil, the bell for class rang.
Professor Zhao stood in front of the fossil and first introduced himself to the students with a smile. Then, he said, “The first lesson was originally planned to explain the history of the class to everyone, as well as the teaching outline for this semester. It’s not time to come into contact with the real fossil.”
“You’re very lucky to have encountered a special situation.”
Below the stage, the eyes of many students flashed. Ancient Capital University was indeed the strongest archeology department. It was awesome. The first lesson showed the new students such a complete ancient overlord fossil. Which school could do that?
This fossil… It couldn’t be bought without at least billions, right? Many students guessed.
“As you can see, this is the fossil of a Tyrant Dragon.”
“The Tyrant Dragons are ancient creatures that lived more than 60 million years ago. According to existing research, they are earth-elemental and are the peak products of the alternative dragons. Their race level is as high as a middle-level overlord, and their species is huge. They were the fully deserving overlords of that era.”
“They have the powerful bodies of all dragon-type pets and are extremely strong. They control brute force, Barren Body, Earth Domain, Overlord Aura, and many other powerful skills.”
“In this lesson, I’ll explain in detail to everyone through this fossil research what help humans can provide in understanding the history of pets, the history of Blue Planet, and the changes in the ecological environment.”
“However, before that, let me ask you a small question. Does anyone know how we measured the history of biological fossils and even some ancient objects?”
This question was relatively simple. Everyone present could say one or two methods.
“Elemental particle measuring technology.”
“Time Light Detection Technique!”
Most of them used technology machines, but there were also special skills.
“Meditation Detection Spell!” Class President Wang Ling said.
“That’s right!” When the students finished speaking, Professor Zhao nodded and said, “Most of the methods used in the detection era were all various archeological skills developed by the Mechanic class after they were established.”
“And before that, the most common way for ancient people to determine the era of ancient artifacts is the meditation detection method. This is a special meditation technique developed by the Time Emperor. It can capture the traces of time on ancient artifacts in a state of meditation and determine the approximate era of ancient artifacts from numbers.”
“However, apart from Beast Tamers with talent in the time department, this method will inevitably produce a certain error when used by others. The precision is inferior to the various technological and archeological skills of the modern era.”
“However, in certain situations, we can only rely on the Cogitation Detection Method. Therefore, this is also the basic skill that you need to master in the next four years. Next, before the formal lesson, let’s play a small game. I’ll guide you into this special Cogitation state. You each judge how long this Tyrant Dragon fossil had lasted with specific numbers.
Professor Zhao smiled and said, “Now, receive the meditation stone from me according to the student number. This meditation stone can assist you in entering a special meditation state before you can independently use the meditation detection method.”
Most of the students were excited.
Shi Yu also received a black meditation stone the size of a pebble.
Although he had previously learned this technique from various sources, he had never officially used it. He was just waiting for the school to teach him.
Soon, everyone received the meditation stone and entered a meditative state according to Professor Zhao’s request.
A moment later, the vision of all the students who had entered a meditative state turned incomparably dark. Under the guidance of the meditation stone, it was very different from the usual meditation state of strengthening the Imperial Beast Space.
However, although it was dark in front of their eyes, it was not completely empty. At this moment, everyone discovered in surprise that they could still capture the figure of the Tyrant Dragon fossil at the corresponding position in the darkness!
However, it was a little different from what they had seen previously. At this moment, the Tyrant Dragon’s skeleton was covered in traces of time that were even smaller than sesame seeds. The entire fossil was wrapped!
“An item that exists for more than a hundred years has a corresponding mark of time. By counting the number of marks of time, you can determine the year of the item. Carefully meditate, carefully observe, and carefully judge.”
“Later, I’ll tell you the exact year of the fossil and see which of you has the smallest error in judgment.”
Professor Zhao chuckled. This wasn’t supposed to be his lesson, but it was a general skill. It didn’t matter if he let the students understand it in advance.
“How the f*ck do I count?” In the Cogitation state, although the students could adjust their vision, pull their vision closer, and clearly enter the traces of time, the densely packed traces of time that were even smaller than sesame seeds made everyone’s scalps tingle. The requirement on mental strength was too high. Without mental strength, it was impossible to capture the traces of time and count them clearly.
“F*ck, my trypophobia is acting up again. I’m not suitable for archeology…”
The students had a headache.
Of course, there were also people with extraordinary talent. For example, Shiyu had already begun trying to detect it because his mental strength was strong enough.
Constitution was a person’s foundation. People with good constitutions wouldn’t have weak mental strength and soul power. Besides, Shi Yu had taught so many mental skills to his pets. The feedback from the advancement of his pets more or less allowed his mental strength to exceed that of other Beast Tamers of the same level.
“Interesting.” Soon, Shi Yu was going at it.
However, before he could get excited for long, a change happened.
Shi Yu’s brain buzzed. With a “Ji” sound, light gradually appeared in the darkness in front of him.
At that time, when Yu opened his eyes, he was shocked to discover that the Tyrant Dragon covered by the traces of time just now had already revealed its true appearance.
Furthermore, not only that, the surroundings quickly changed, turning into a plant area that Shi Yu was completely unfamiliar with.
“Roar!!!!” At this moment, the Tyrant Dragon stuck its head out and stared at Shi Yu with a fierce gaze. It opened its bloody mouth and roared. The fierce wind instantly made Shi Yu’s scalp tingle.
Boom!!!
The Tyrant Dragon swept its tail at him, causing Shi Yu’s eyes to explode. He felt a powerful pressure and was just about to etherealize when he subconsciously turned his head. However, he failed and was struck by the tail. However, when he turned his head, Shi Yu saw… the Green Silkworm Cocoon on his shoulder that was similarly shocked…
Bang!
As if in a nightmare, Shi Yu was instantly killed by the Tyrant Dragon. Then, he was suddenly jolted awake in the classroom outside. He was interrupted from his meditation and broke out in a cold sweat.
“Just now…” Sitting in his seat, Shi Yu’s breathing sped up. What was that?!!
Listening to history?
No, definitely not.
It was different from any other time he had listened to the sound of history. Furthermore, at that time, it gave Shi Yu a very special feeling. He wasn’t like a bystander, but had personally stood in front of the Tyrant Dragon. It felt even more real than when he was discovered by the emperor. It wasn’t right to say that it was real. The feeling he gave Shi Yu was more like he had been awoken from a nightmare.
“Buggy?” Shi Yu suddenly sensed that Buggy had woken up in the Taming Space.
At this moment, Buggy was also extremely confused. Because just now, it had seen the same thing as Shiyu.
“What did you do just now?” Shi Yu calmed down and asked.
If he wasn’t wrong, Buggy was here too. This also indirectly meant that it was definitely not a historical talent…
Buggy was innocent. It didn’t do anything. It just suddenly woke up and tried to use its psychic power to sense the situation in the outside world. Then, that was it.
“Ji…” Although he didn’t know what happened, Buggy’s shy spirit started to communicate.
The feeling it had described was that it had accidentally entered someone else’s dream.
Furthermore, the owner of this dream wasn’t a normal life form…
In the outside world, when he heard this, Shi Yu looked up at the Tyrant Dragon fossil that had died 60 million years ago and fell into deep thought.
Ridiculous! Don’t tell him that he and Worm had entered a fossil dream

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - The Butterfly Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: The Butterfly Meeting
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Or did you awaken some special ability?”
After the anomaly, Shi Yu was in no mood to attend class.
He was thinking about the Tyrant Dragon. The Tyrant Dragon, the Tyrant Dragon…
Shi Yu felt that the anomaly might be related to Buggy.
Otherwise, why would Buggy have appeared beside him at that time?
Furthermore, the various abilities of the insects happened to be related to dreams!
There was definitely a connection!
“Let’s try again.”
Shi Yu called out to Buggy.
Buggy nodded crazily.
Damn it. Although he didn’t know what happened just now, that dinosaur felt so strong.
It didn’t take many looks and he sensed its power.
Otherwise, if it materialized, it would be another good fighter, not inferior to the Frost Dragon.
At that time, wouldn’t he become a great dragon tamer, with the Frost Dragon and the Tyrant Dragon, take off?!
Then, Shi Yu entered a meditation state again.
Then, like in the beginning, he tried to sense the year of the Tyrant Dragon fossil.
In the Beastmaster Space, Buggy also tried to sense the outside world through psychic power.
It was the same as before.
Furthermore, the target was very clear. It tried to sense the Tyrant Dragon fossil that Shi Yu was also sensing.
Instantly, their perceptions were in sync.
A hint of light appeared in Shi Yu’s dark eyes again.
However, things didn’t go as smoothly as before.
There was a feeling that it was indeed feasible, but it was still lacking something.
It was like listening to history. It depended on luck.
Grass just grew randomly on the street, but flowers, even if you took the energy to tend to them, might not necessarily grow.
“I hate it…”
Moments later, Shi Yu and Worm gave up struggling.
Because the accident succeeded just now, there was no reaction, but when they took the initiative to try, Buggy expended a lot of energy.
In order not to affect Buggy’s condition, Shi Yu quickly stopped.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu opened his eyes again and muttered to himself, “There’s definitely a problem.”
“The meditation technique developed by Emperor Shi is not that simple. It’s not just used to detect years.”
“There might be other uses when combined with the abilities of pets, and they mainly rely on the strength of pets.”
“I made another big discovery.”
…
After class, Shi Yu returned to the dormitory.
He sighed, feeling like he was surrounded by pits.
Besides, they were all pits that he couldn’t explore in his current state.
Without the strength, he didn’t dare to go use the crystal left behind by Emperor Shi.
The mystery of the bloodline of the Ice Dragon General and the Great Empress couldn’t be exposed to the Phoenix Race.
Now, he had discovered the specialness of the meditation technique left behind by the Time Emperor, and it was restricted because of Buggy’s state, making it impossible to explore deeper.
“Just kill me.” Shi Yu lay on the bed.
Then, he turned around and searched for information through the channels of Bureau 11.
In the end, he shook his head.
“I don’t want to do my homework anymore. I want to cheat.”
Shi Yu chose to ask the big shot directly!
He was still a student, so it was embarrassing to ask a teacher.
Like the crystal, he didn’t believe that no one knew what was going on.
There were so many capable people in Bureau 11. Maybe some big shot knew what was going on.
A moment later, Li Lianping from the Eleventh Bureau picked up Shi Yu’s call.
This was the most authoritative archaeologist and researcher in the fossil field in the entire Dong Huang Continent.
“Shiyu?”
“Did something happen to that ginseng baby?”
Shi Yu said, “No, Senior Li, I want to ask you some questions about the fossil domain.”
“Oh? Are you starting to be interested in the fossil domain?”
Senior Li chuckled. Archaeology was also divided into different branches.
There were archaeologists who were focused on investigating myths, archaeologists who liked to investigate totems, archaeologists who studied ancient dynasties, and archaeologists who studied extinct biological fossils. When he heard that Shi Yu was interested in fossils, Senior Li laughed.
She suddenly felt that there was a successor…
“Ask away.”
“Senior Li, is it possible for a fossil to still be alive? Could there be remnants of its dream? Is there any special use for the special meditation technique left behind by the Time Emperor?”
A moment later, Li Lianping’s laughter came from the other side. “It’s impossible for fossils to live. Of course, it’s not impossible to eliminate the possibility that one day, it will revive and evolve into an undead or an elemental life form.”
“On that day, perhaps the entire fossil research field, even the entire archaeology world and the Beastmaster world, will be in an uproar.”
“Although it can’t compare to the birth of a mechanical life, it’s still a super big discovery.”
“Your other question is right… A fossil does have a chance of surviving as a dream. Did you pry into the dream of a fossil and accidentally dream back to ancient times?” Senior Li asked with a smile.
“Alright.” Upon hearing his tone, Shi Yu understood that she understood.
“It’s more troublesome to explain in detail. This is actually a manifestation of the traces of time. Another form of Spirit that will only appear on the remains of powerful ancient creatures.”
“What’s known at the moment is the specific method to peek at the fossil dream realm. It’s a meditation technique developed by the Time Emperor. In addition to the support of the pets who have mastered the transcendent Dream skill, the Beast Tamer and the pet’s perception have to be combined. Only then will there be a chance to peek at the ancient fossil dream realm.”
“And the probability of this is even lower than hearing and seeing the shadow of history. Although I’ve cultivated a dream stealing Beast, I’m usually too lazy to use this ability. On the other hand, some dream masters abroad are very proficient in this. After all, there are very few people in their country. You can’t find many beast tamers with the listening talent. You can only rely on other methods to do archaeology.”
“Dream Stealing Skill?” Shi Yu asked.
Skill: Thieving Dream
[Level]: Advanced
Introduction: A spirit-type skill. It can enter the dreams of other life forms and pry into their secrets. It can also replicate their dream illusions and create its own dream world.
“That’s right. Speaking of which, you actually have a pet that knows the Dream Steal skill? And its level is so high?” Senior Li suddenly discovered the issue.
There were less than three people in the entire Dong Huang Continent who had mastered the Godly Thief Dream skill… This skill was too difficult to master.
“No…”
Shi Yu was stunned. There was really a way to enter the fossil dream world, but the problem was that Buggy didn’t know this skill!
“No?” Senior Li was confused.
“It’s my Green Silkworm. It helps me enter that state, but it’s in the form of a cocoon now. Besides, it doesn’t have any dream stealing skills. Wait, I used the Illusion Fruit in the evolutionary materials I gave it!”
“The Illusion Tree has mastered the Dream Steal skill. Is this a sign that the Green Silkworm will also awaken the Dream Steal skill…?”
Shi Yu suddenly thought of something.
Name: Dream Tree
Introduction: The Illusion Tree is the king of the Illusionary Dream Domain. It can pull prey into the Dream World. In the Dream World, it can create illusions identical to the hypnotized person, allowing them to fight the hypnotized person.
Senior Li was silent. That was indeed a possibility. However, why didn’t his Green worm not master the Dream Stealing skill, and it could do something that even a pet that mastered it would find difficult to do?
Unscientific.
Also, you just said that your worm is a cocoon. Shouldn’t it be sleeping? Why can it help you enter a dream?
Sleepwalking?
There were too many points to complain about. For a moment, Senior Li didn’t know where to start.
At this moment, before Senior Li could say a word, Shi Yu was already high.
Awesome, Buggy.
If he awakened the dream stealing skill, that would be awesome.
Wasn’t this the reason why he used the Illusion Fruit back then?
Insects used virtual illusions to summon powerful pets. The hardest part was that they didn’t know enough about this creature and didn’t have enough compatibility, which led to the pitiful combat power of the summoned phantom.
Even with the dragon whisker, it was impossible to almost perfectly replicate the ice dragon.
However, the Dream Steal skill could allow a pet to enter the dreams of other life forms and pry into the secrets of their skills, almost perfectly replicating their abilities.
Because the Illusion Tree had mastered this skill, it could pull its prey into the Dream World and summon the other party’s Illusion Replica to let the other party attack it.
This was already very impressive, but if Buggy mastered it, it could be even more powerful. This was because the Illusion Tree could only control the enemy’s dream mirage in the dream realm, but Buggy could summon it to reality through the phantom illusion skill!
Dream Steal+Illusion. This was an invincible combination skill.
In other words, as long as the level of these two skills were high enough in the future, it could even let the Tyrant Dragon almost perfectly reappear in the world?
It was even to the extent that if a divine beast was willing to let Buggy enter his dream, Buggy could let even divine beasts appear!
Impressive.
As expected of the Worm of Daydreaming.
“After evolution, you must help me awaken the Dream Stealing Skill. Only then will I live up to my reputation as the Illusion Fruit.” He thought to Buggy.
