According to unscientific experiments, 0.4 meters was the best condition for its current training efficiency and restraint.
This state was purely cute.
Handsome value -10, cuteness+10.
“Mm!”
With the electromagnetic levitation in hand, Eleven didn’t have to worry about movement difficulties.
When he returned, Eleven flew to the fridge and took out a bottle of bamboo juice.
After drinking it, it smiled in satisfaction.
“Ha…”
Beside Eleven, Baby Ginseng, who was also about 0.4 meters tall, was also holding a bottle of frozen soda.
After taking a sip, it revealed a refreshed expression.
Nothing could be happier than drinking a cold drink after training and learning!
“Meeting, meeting, meeting!!!”
After Eleven and Baby Ginseng were done, Shi Yu’s voice suddenly sounded in the huge student villa.
The two pets were stunned. They immediately obeyed the summon and ran over.
Moments later, four pets surrounded Shiyu, who was sitting on the bed.
Eleven hugged the bamboo juice.
Baby Ginseng hugged its soda.
Little Chi Tong hugged the ice.
Buggy lay on the bed like a patient.
They looked up at Shi Yu. What was it?!
“It’s nothing. I’ve decided to leave for Divine Capital in three days. Prepare yourselves.”
“Eleven, change your training plan.”
“Baby Ginseng, go and apply for leave too.” Shi Yu pointed at the calendar.
“Roar!” Eleven agreed!
It could train anywhere!
However, before leaving, it had to leave enough training missions for the three little iron-eating beasts. This was the most important thing.
“Yi!!”
Baby Ginseng also said that there was no problem. It had already finished its preparatory lessons for this semester, so it wasn’t a big problem to miss a few.
“That’s good.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“Then I’ll talk about something else.”
“You’ve improved quite a lot in the past three months, right?”
Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng revealed unquestionable expressions.
With the nutritional supplements of the ginseng baby and Shi Yu’s physique improving, the efficiency of time and space would increase exponentially.
These three months had made Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy beautiful.
For example, Eleven and Baby Ginseng had already reached the battle power level of a “quasi monarch”.
Their energy level had reached more than 100,000, and both had mastered a high-level profundity. They could probably exchange a few moves with ordinary monarch level battle power alone and wouldn’t be defeated too quickly.
Ordinary Monarchs referred to the weakest Monarchs with an energy value below 1,000,000 and ones that hadn’t mastered super skills or high-level profundities.
Of course, Eleven and Baby Ginseng were not sure how far they could fight. After all, they had never really fought.
“Ji…” On Buggy’s side, it muttered to himself.
Although it was in its cocoon form and didn’t have high combat power, it should be able to surpass Eleven and the Ginseng Baby after evolution, right?
Its energy value had increased by more than 10,000 compared to when it first turned into a cocoon!
40,000!
If it were to triple after evolution, it wouldn’t be inferior to Eleven and the ginseng baby.
After three months of accumulation, Buggy believed that it wouldn’t be weak after evolution.
Buggy had finished absorbing the evolutionary power two months ago and could break out of the cocoon at any time.
However, in order to wait for the so-called Butterfly Meeting, Shi Yu and the others forcefully endured for nearly three months.
This was also the reason why Buggy was so calm now.
Its Dao heart had been tempered steadily.
In the cocoon state, apart from the evolutionary nutrition that came with it, the efficiency of the insects absorbing nutrition from the outside world was not high.
Apart from adding points.
The additional points of the skill index could perfectly transform the power of Time and Ginseng Baby into skill proficiency, increasing the evolutionary foundation of Buggy.
Therefore, in order to let Buggy evolve with a super invincible foundation, Shi Yu’s main target for these three months was Buggy.
Although he had added Eleven and Baby Ginseng many times, Buggy was undoubtedly the most favored during this period.
Even if the impact of non-racial skills on attributes was inferior to race skills, it still depended on how far Shiyu had added.
Now that he was covered in level skills, Buggy was still very willing to believe that it would be invincible very quickly after evolution.
Eleven was confident because of the high intensity training.
Baby Ginseng was confident because it had studied a few secret trump cards that could suppress Eleven and Buggy through knowledge.
As for Buggy, it was confident because it was about to complete the strongest evolution.
The three pets were full of confidence.
However, although they were very confident in their strength, they actually didn’t know much about their teammates’ strength.
In these three months, the three pets had almost no chance to communicate and fight.
Buggy was nourishing its body, and Baby Ginseng was researching secret weapons. Eleven was using the training facilities of the Ancient Capital University to train.
Whoever had the best enhancement effect… If they didn’t spar, even Shi Yu couldn’t analyze it 100% correctly.
“Seeing how confident you are… How about this…”
“Remember the ‘team internal competition’ I mentioned previously?” Shi Yu grinned.
Eleven, Bug, and Baby Ginseng looked up at the same time with serious expressions.
Could it be…
“When we return from Divine Capital and Buggy evolves, let’s hold an internal team competition…”
“At that time, I’ll give you a rank for your combat strength.”
“Let me think. Since it’s a competition, there must be a reward.”
“I wonder when I can teach super skills…”
“The reward for the first meeting will be this. The winner will be rewarded with a super skill. How about that?” Shi Yu smiled faintly.
“At that time, the type of skill will be an attack skill. As for a support skill or whatever, you can choose for yourself.”
“This is the benefit of the strongest.”
“Ying!” “Ji!” “Yi!” Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng’s eyes turned red.
Super skill!
Up until now, only Eleven had mastered the ability to hold back, while Baby Ginseng had only mastered the source of life.
These two super skills were undoubtedly their current core abilities.
Although the proficiency was only at the beginner level, the power of super skills made all their tactics revolve around those skills.
Eleven’s explosive strength that exceeded the limit, Baby Ginseng’s powerful self-healing and supplement effects, were all because of super skills.
They naturally knew that super skills were good stuff.
And Buggy without a super skill… Although it felt that it could also awaken after evolution, it wouldn’t complain about too many super skills.
The reward of a super skill made the three pets excited.
This was the effect that Shi Yu wanted.
Buggy glanced at Eleven and the ginseng baby, calculating how far it had to evolve to defeat them.
The leader of the team had been sitting on the throne for too long. It was time for this empire to change hands.
“Yi…”
Baby Ginseng pushed its glasses. The team meeting, the chance to test his learning results, was finally here.
it didn’t know if the anti-Eleven Energy Fruits and Anti-Buggy Energy Fruits it had secretly studied would be effective.
“Wuu…”
Eleven was originally quite excited and planned to use an interesting skill, but suddenly, its body trembled.
It felt an unknown gaze.
Eleven quickly turned around and saw Baby Ginseng whistling as if nothing had happened. Buggy was also lying quietly without any ambition.
Eleven fell into deep thought and rubbed its head.
At this moment, only Little Chi Tong was confused.
“Mi ~”
Team internal competition, super skills. What were those? Could they be eaten?
With three super skills, it had always been like a bystander when Shi Yu spoke.
“Are you participating?” Shi Yu smiled at his daughter.
[Name]: Sword Spirit (Chi Tong)
Attributes: Spirit, Fire
Race Level: High-Level Overlord
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
[Skill]: Soul Slaying (Initiate), Possession (Initiate), Light Flame Sword (Initiate), Interlocking Sword (Initiate), Sun Flame (Initiate), Spirit Dissection (Initiate)
Energy: 2000
For the past three months, Shi Yu had never let Little Chi Tong train.
Although he didn’t receive any additional points or do any training and only ate normally every day, Little Chi Tong was also about to break through to the transcendent level. Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh at the power of a high-level overlord race.
Moreover, its energy level could already break commander races…
So strong…
However, compared to the battle power of Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy, it was definitely still much weaker.
It was the same even if it broke through to the transcendent level… Unless, if it possessed him, his battle power would increase. It was equivalent to the combined power of Shi Yu and the Sword Spirit.
“Mi ~!!!”
After Shi Yu spoke, Little Chi Tong’s eyes lit up (its sword light flickered).
It also sounded very interesting. Then it would participate and take a look.
Buggy and Ginseng Baby: “!!!”
Although they didn’t know what had happened, it seemed that no matter what happened, they wouldn’t be at the bottom?
They looked at Shi Yu. Were they really going to let it participate?
“Well… it’s not impossible.”
After some thought, Shi Yu said, “Then, when the time comes, you can possess me. We’ll participate in the battle together!”
In this case, he had to study it carefully. At the very least, he had to quickly nurture Little Chi Tong to transcendent and near commander rank.
The possession skill had to be increased too.
At that time, he would probably break through to the high-level Beast Tamer level and contract Little Chi Tong.
With the upper limit of his physique at that time, it shouldn’t be any pressure to control the transcendent sword spirit of the overlord race.
This decision was also because Shi Yu suddenly recalled what the beast-eared girl said about the martial arts conference.
It sounded very interesting. At this kind of meeting, if the Beast Tamer personally fought, he shouldn’t be regarded as an anomaly, right?!
It didn’t matter if the reward was there or not. It was mainly because Shi Yu’s hands were itchy.
He had finally contracted a biological daughter sword spirit. It was a pity to spoil it as a mascot!
Let’s fight together!
“Mi ~!!!” Little Chi Tong let out a happy voice and immediately ran over to stick to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s words made Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Eleven, and the other pets fall silent.
What!! Shi Yu wanted to participate too?!
What the hell?
If they beat up the Beast Tamer together, would there still be super skills?

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - Third Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Third Breakthrough
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After Shi Yu revealed the subsequent trip to Divine Capital and the team’s internal meeting plans, every pet was excited.
Eleven and Baby Ginseng worked even harder for new super skills.
Buggy’s daydreaming became more and more serious.
Only the little sword spirit was still lying in the ice without any worries and watching cartoons.
Little Chi Tong: “Beautiful Swordsman” is so beautiful!
Just like Shi Yu, he could transform.
Moreover, he could change instantly!
The little sword spirit thought about it. What could it do? After possessing Shi Yu, could it also change him?
At this moment, Shi Yu also made the final sprint.
Meditation!
He was about to strengthen the Beast Taming Space to level four. He needed one or two days.
This was also why Shi Yu decided to leave in three days.
Only when his level reached the standard would there be no accidents where Buggy evolution was too fierce while the Beast Tamer was too weak, unable to stimulate all its potential.
After all, after the worm evolved this time, it was very likely to be at the overlord race’s commander level. Shi Yu relied on the current level-three Beast Taming Space and the level of an intermediate Beast Tamer to maintain the contract. It was very difficult.
But if he advanced to a high-level Beast Tamer, it would be much better.
…
Two days later.
The color of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space Crystal Wall completely turned green.
Colorless, gray, white, green, blue, purple… Green corresponded to the fourth level of the Beast Tamer, advanced Beast Tamer.
Under normal circumstances, he could perfectly control commander rank pets!
If he took another step forward, he would be a master-level Beast Tamer.
This was another challenge.
During the process of strengthening spatial levels, there were different levels for Beast Tamers from level three to four, from level four to five, from level six to level seven. The difficulty was very high.
Because the difference between level four and level three was whether it could control commander-level pets.
The difference between level five and level four was whether it could control monarch-level pets.
Level-seven… was the overlord level pets.
Shi Yu used a total of three months to go from level three to level four under the enhancement of the five buffs from the ruins meditation technique, Calming Heart Concentration Sachets, Ethereal Spirit Stone, super physique, pet breakthrough, and evolution feedback!
This time was very fast, but also very slow.
Compared to other Beast Tamers, it was naturally very fast, but with Shi Yu having so many buffs, it seemed very slow.
Although Shi Yu had too many things to do and didn’t spend most of his energy on meditation…
However, if he continued with this efficiency, Shi Yu thought for a moment. It would probably be even harder to break through to the master level.
It was at least five times the current time, which was… fifteen months?
“Monarchs and commander ranks are completely on different levels. With Eleven and the others’ races, after breaking through, their energy values will be in the millions. Even with the ginseng baby, no matter how strong my physique is, if I’m restricted by the contract, Eleven and the others probably won’t be able to break through to the monarch rank before I become a master.”
If he forcefully broke through, it wouldn’t be as simple as Shi Yu being squeezed dry. Instead, the contract would automatically break. The Beast Taming Space would shatter and fall. Shi Yu would suffer a backlash and suffer a huge blow to his vitality. It was serious and might even endanger his life.
Shi Yu’s expression darkened when he thought of that situation.
“My speed is still too slow.”
“Looks like I have to increase the proportion of meditation time. In addition, the Ethereal Spirit Stone should be exchanged for other high-level spatial resources.”
For example, the root of the Grotto-Heaven Tree, one of the evolution materials of the worm, could strengthen the Beast Taming Space. However, it was worth hundreds of millions. Ordinary people really couldn’t afford to use it.
However, if he couldn’t afford it, Shi Yu had to buy some.
If he continued to increase points and meditate like this, Shi Yu felt that he would be the first Beast Tamer to suddenly die because he cultivated his pet too well.
This was too tragic.
“Wu…” After breaking through, Shi Yu looked at the spatial environment and clenched his fist. He was sure that his upper limit of physique had been broken again and he could continue to increase the strength of his physique through the additional points. This was very comfortable.
Apart from that, he could also contract Little Chi Tong now…
…
Little Chi Tong was still watching the cartoon. Shi Yu had appeared behind it without anyone noticing.
Buzz…
The little sword spirit quickly turned around.
Chi Tong: “!!!”
What was wrong!
It wasn’t addicted, there was no need for curfew!
In order to let Little Chi Tong sleep enough, Shi Yu gave it limited time to watch cartoons every day.
“Not this.” Shi Yu smiled and activated the fourth contract slot.
A breeze blew, and the curtains fluttered. The contract halo appeared beside the little sword spirit.
“Mi?” Little Chi Tong was stunned before quickly reacting.
It condensed a surprised expression with flames.
Shi Yu had broken through?
“Yes.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Sorry, I made you wait three months.”
“Mi!” The little sword spirit entered the halo without hesitation.
Under the envelopment of the contract halo, Little Chi Tong quickly turned into light dots and was contracted by Shi Yu to enter the Beast Taming Space.
At the same time.
In the charging room of Ancient Capital University, Eleven, who was holding the charging cable, looked up slightly.
In the plant garden, the ginseng baby, who was gathering anti-buggy materials, also raised its head and looked into the distance.
In the dormitory, Buggy woke up from its sleep.
They all looked in Shi Yu’s direction.
Eleven and Baby Ginseng smiled slightly, while Buggy’s eyes flickered with joy.
Not only had Shi Yu broken through, Little Chi Tong had also officially been contracted!
At this moment, among Shi Yu’s pets, only Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy had a mental connection. Now, there was another little sword spirit.
If the Beast Tamer didn’t forcefully distort the will of the beasts, then the feelings between the different pets contracted by the Beast Tamer were more like siblings.
Life and life would develop new emotions because of the Beast Tamer bond.
“My soul power has increased.”
At this moment, just as he finished contracting Chi Tong, Shi Yu felt his soul power suddenly increase.
And it was still being nourished!
As a pet of the undead family, the most direct feedback Chi Tong could give to Beast Tamers was the increase in soul power!
Shi Yu smiled. This way, it was easier to possess him.
The condition for the possession of the undead was that the physique and soul power of the Beast Tamer reached the standard!
“Eh, you broke through too?”
After the surprise, Shi Yu was suddenly stunned. He sensed that Little Chi Tong was undergoing some changes in the Beast Taming Space.
He quickly summoned Little Chi Tong.
At this moment, compared to the size of the fruit knife at the Awakening level, Little Chi Tong had already grown to the size of a short sword the length of an arm.
Although there were no flames on the dark red sword hilt and the fiery red sword body, the soul was burning hot wherever his gaze landed.
“Mi ~” Little Chi Tong let out a happy cry.
After receiving the nourishment of the Beast Taming Space, it almost reached the transcendent level from the awakening level without any bottlenecks.
[Name]: Sword Spirit (Chi Tong)
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Energy Points]: 10,000
“10,000…” Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he saw the change in Little Chi Tong.
As expected of a high-level overlord race’s sword spirit, the race closest to myth.
It had just reached the transcendent level and had yet to be strengthened with racial skills, but its energy level had already reached the lowest standard of a commander rank!
Perhaps after Little Chi Tong reached commander rank, he really had hope of using it to chase after Eleven, Buggy, and Ginseng Baby?
At the same time, Buggy, who had just entered to congratulate them, suddenly stiffened.
It saw Shi Yu smiling foolishly at the ceiling in the room. It revealed a frightened expression and quickly retreated.
It was better to continue sleeping. Shi Yu, who had just broken through, looked a little abnormal.
…
“Speaking of which, there should be five new pages in the skill index.”
A moment later, Shi Yu returned to his senses.
In the past three months, he had emptied many pages.
Now that he had five new pages, he immediately felt the pressure decrease.
“By the way, let’s see if we can teach super skills now.”
Shi Yu suddenly thought of something and quickly opened the skill index.
Shi Yu had already opened the skill index thousands of times, but during this meditation, Shi Yu suddenly realized that something was wrong.
In the space in his mind, an even darker rhombus pattern appeared on the black stone index book skin compared to before.
“What the hell?”
The skill index… changed with his breakthrough?!!
Shi Yu was stunned. It was common knowledge that the Beast Taming Talent would strengthen as the Beast Tamer’s level increased.
For example, Fu Dian’s White Thunder Talent might only be equivalent to an entry-level super skill in his current state, but as his strength increased, the subsequent development of his talent might have an effect equivalent to a proficient, expert, or even perfect super skill!
Similarly, those strengthening talents would also be more effective as the Beast Tamer level increased.
Shi Yu originally thought that the embodiment of the upgrade of the skill index was to increase the page count, but at this moment, as he flipped to the first page, he immediately realized his mistake!
In the pitch-black Sea of Consciousness, the black index floated there. Shi Yu revealed a shocked expression.
The skill index… had upgraded a function!
Skill: Deterrence
[Skill Level]
[Introduction]
[Status]
Apart from the basic information, there was a new column on the skill index.
It was not the occasional [Cooldown Time], but the [Teaching Method]!!
[General Teaching Method]: After absorbing the spiritual power of a creature of the spiritual royal family (a race with deterrence as a racial skill), one can break through the growth level under the deterrence of an expert level and above. There is a chance of awakening the deterrence skill. The awakening probability depends on the compatibility of the pet talent, pet race, and pet race with this skill.
Looking at the so-called “universal teaching method”, Shi Yu was stunned.
He quickly flipped through a few pages. Be it multiplication, impregnable, or Energy Fruit, apart from the super skills Plant Control, Inner Power, and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, under every low, mid, and high-level skill that had been recorded, a [Universal Teaching Method] appeared!!
Shi Yu naturally understood what this was…
The index was updated. Even without the special power of the index, some pets could learn the “universal skills”!!
Shi Yu rubbed his eyes.
“This is… Is this for me to change my profession to a skill teacher???”
Skill teachers and evolution planners were both branches of Feeders.
For example, the evolution plan of the Goddess of Light Butterfly that Lu Qingyi gave Shi Yu back then was created by an evolution planner.
As for skill teachers, they were naturally the professions that taught other pets to learn skills and increase skill proficiency.
These two professions… were both known as the Beast Tamer deputy positions that earned the most money and had the highest status.
At this moment, as he looked at the new function of the index, Shi Yu, who had graduated from the Feeding Department, fell into deep thought.
He kept feeling that his identity as a graduate of the Feeding Department would be even more solid.
The new version of the skill index had been updated. He couldn’t not use it, right? It was also good to sell some skill manuals to earn extra money.
“Archeologists who don’t want to be feeders aren’t good Beast Tamers?”

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - Divine Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Divine Capital
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The new function of the skill index undoubtedly gave Shi Yu a surprise.
But not long after, Shi Yu sighed.
Because…
Skill: Inner Power
[Status]: Cannot be taught. The energy required for teaching is insufficient.
“Holy shit.” Shi Yu was stunned.
He still couldn’t teach super skills.
However, the information on the [Status] column changed!
Logically speaking, if there were no goals, it should show that there were no teaching targets for the time being.
Only when he wanted to teach pets would it show that he couldn’t teach them.
But this time, it directly showed that it couldn’t be taught.
It even marked the reason.
“After the index was upgraded, more than one function was updated.”
“It’s even more humane. Damn it.”
This made Shi Yu confirm again that it was his physical fitness problem that he couldn’t teach super skills.
“Ridiculous…”
Shi Yu stared at the Inner Power, plant control, and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy for a long time before shaking his head.
His current physique should be comparable to a top-notch master who had never paid attention to physical training.
If he trained to the upper limit, he might be comparable to a legendary Beast Tamer who had never paid attention to training.
Even so, wasn’t it enough?
“Is there a possibility that my body can do it but my energy isn’t enough? I need to level up again just like this time to teach super skills?”
Shi Yu guessed that he and the index were both trash. They didn’t have enough energy.
“In that case…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“I feel that before I can teach super skills, I can even max out all the low, intermediate, and high-level skills of the four pets.”
It would take at least a year for him to break through again.
In a year, no matter how lazy they were, the pets’ skills should be full.
“Sigh…”
“Baby Ginseng, it’s time to come back.”
After some thought, Shi Yu transmitted his telepathy in the distance.
Life wasn’t easy, so how could he relieve his worries?
He could only numb himself with points.
“Before we leave, let’s upgrade Chi Tong’s possession skill to expert level and see the training effect.”
Shi Yu then looked at Little Chi Tong, who was crying at the melting ice.
Because of its own breakthrough… The low-level ice-element crystal couldn’t withstand its temperature anymore…
“Mi!!!” It was unhappy! Why was there a melting reaction!
At the same time.
Although it was very far away, Shi Yu’s thoughts still reached Baby Ginseng.
This was an ability that other talents of Beast Tamers couldn’t have.
Ordinary talented Beast Tamers let their pets grow. The two parties were very far apart. Unless the pets lost consciousness, were on the verge of death, died, or broke through, it was very difficult for Beast Tamers to sense the situation of the pets.
But for Beast Tamers with the telepathy talent, their telepathy talent could strengthen the mental connection between contracts and make the perception of both parties stronger.
In other words, in the future, when Shi Yu reached the legendary level, even if the pet was separated from him by a country, they might still be able to sense each other’s state. But if it were other talents, even if there was a contract, it would be no different from losing contact.
Around this characteristic, the pets of many Beast Tamers with talent in telepathy in ancient times had been cultivated into assassins who scouted secrets. Even if they died during the process, they could transmit important information to Beast Tamers far away in time.
In the plant garden, after receiving Shi Yu’s message, Baby Ginseng tidied up the anti-buggy plant in its bag. It was actually a spiritual plant that countered the bug type. It turned around domineeringly.
Home!
That night, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong had a good meal to celebrate Shi Yu’s breakthrough and Little Chi Tong officially joining the team.
That night, Buggy was very happy, because it could go to Divine Capital tomorrow.
Little Chi Tong was also very excited, because this was the first time it had come into contact with additional points!
Shi Yu spent some effort to upgrade its “possession” skill to expert level after three times.
There weren’t many changes, but its spiritual physical fitness was more compatible with the target he was possessing and it could unleash greater strength.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect Little Chi Tong to also like the feeling of having its points added. He felt that it found it as comfortable as sleeping ice.
“Mi ~” Little Chi Tong kept flying around Shi Yu and sticking to him. Why didn’t he continue?
It hoped to use the cute tactic and continue to be upgraded by Shi Yu.
As expected, for pets, being upgraded points was like eating rice to eat nutrition. It was fascinating.
No pet could escape the temptation of points, even if it was a high-level overlord race.
“No,” Shi Yu said mercilessly. It was just a test of the training effect. He had to get up early tomorrow and couldn’t continue.
Little Chi Tong cried. It was gone?
“Yes, that’s all.” Shi Yu felt sleepy and looked worried.
If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have added points to Little Chi Tong.
The first time was indeed relatively fresh, unlike Eleven, Buggy, and Ginseng Baby who could restrain themselves now.
Chi Tong wanted to say something but hesitated.
“…You also want to see where my limit is?” Shi Yu stopped it.
“I’ll definitely do it next time!” With that, he fell asleep.
Little Chi Tong fell into deep thought. Hmph…
…
The next morning.
At the first airport of Ancient Capital City.
Shi Yu arrived in a black and red battle suit.
In his pocket, there was also a red cloak. Because it was hot, Shi Yu didn’t wear it.
This was the Flame Demon Armor he had specially bought. It was a level-six fire-element equipment. It cost him 15 million to match a top-level monarch.
The reason why he bought this was that this equipment could effectively increase the Beast Tamer’s resistance to fire. If he wore this to withstand the possession of the little sword spirit, it could reduce the burden on Shi Yu’s body.
Even if it wasn’t a fire-element attack, the Flame Demon Armor could also provide pretty good protection.
The level-six Fire Demon Armor Set and a level-seven Ice Dragon Whisker, dual-element resource, were Shi Yu’s more precious resources at the moment.
Of course, the crystal ring of the ruins of Bureau 11 was also a very precious resource, or even more expensive, but their value didn’t have a very good level evaluation standard.
[The flight to Divine Capital is about to take off…]
In the crowd, Shi Yu yawned and boarded a high class commander rank plane.
Because of the Butterfly Meeting, there seemed to be a lot of people going to the capital recently.
In Ancient Capital University, many students skipped classes and planned to watch the commotion.
Some Beast Tamers who had contracted the Green Silkworm and had special evolution plans planned to participate in the Butterfly Meeting. Shi Yu wasn’t the only one with this intention.
“Eh?”
On the plane, Shi Yu had just found his seat when he looked at the guy beside him in surprise.
In the seat beside him, a student in a cotton shirt also widened his eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
“Little Gu Master, what a coincidence.” Shi Yu said.
“You’re the little Gu Master. Please call me Gu Master!” Miao Dongdong retorted.
“You’re going to Divine Capital too?” Then, he said,
This person was surprisingly the little Gu Master who had contracted the Shadow Gu and the Parasitic Gu. He had been destroyed by Shi Yu and Buggy during the vocation assessment and was now a battle-type student at Ancient Capital University.
“Of course. This is a flight to Divine Capital. You can’t leave me alone halfway, right?” Shi Yu smiled.
Miao Dongdong was silent for a moment before saying, “Don’t tell me you’re going to participate in the Butterfly Meeting.”
“I haven’t seen your green worm in a long time. Has it turned into a cocoon?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “You too?”
Miao Dongdong’s balls hurt. Shi Yu’s Nine Li Battle Beast, Baby Ginseng, and Grand General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit were already ridiculous. When that Green Silkworm completed its evolution, it would probably be able to reach the monarch race no matter what. At that time, wouldn’t Shi Yu’s battle power be even more ridiculous?
It was a transcendent-level worm silk!
How could there be such a monstrous Beast Tamer!
“Sigh.” Miao Dongdong sighed and said,
“I broke through and contracted a Green Silkworm sent by my clan. I plan to use the method of my clan to evolve it into a ‘Golden Wings Gu’.” He told Shi Yu his goal for this trip.
Golden Wings Gu, a high class commander species, a dual-element pet of the Wasp-type Metal and Worm type.
Shi Yu smiled. “It’s a Gu worm again. When the time comes, everyone will turn into butterflies. Wouldn’t it be awkward for a Gu Bee to come out of your cocoon?”
“Which evolution path is your Green Silkworm?” Miao Dongdong curled his lips and asked.
The Butterfly meeting was just a general name. It wasn’t like they all turned into butterflies.
“Well, if I say I don’t know either, would you believe me?” Shi Yu said.
Miao Dongdong:???
“You don’t know either?”
“What do you mean?”
Shi Yu smiled. “On the surface, I don’t use any of the known evolution plans to give it. I plan to take a gamble.”
“Creating an evolution plan?”
Miao Dongdong widened his eyes. Holy shit, how dare you?
Using such a green worm with terrifying potential as a bet?
If he messed it up, wouldn’t his heart hurt?!!
Regardless of whether Shi Yu’s heart ached or not, Miao Dongdong’s heart ached when he thought of the risk of that crazy Green Silkworm failing in its evolution.
What a waste.
“Yes.”
Shi Yu coughed dryly. In the end, he was also a little panicked. He didn’t know what Buggy could evolve into.
He had asked Buggy, but Buggy didn’t know either. This was very uncomfortable.
“So, am I not here for this Butterfly Goddess? I hope its blessings can increase the success rate.”
Shi Yu thought to himself. Increase the chances of Buggy evolving to an overlord race in one go.
The two racial skills that had advanced into Dao Proficiency, the mysterious Dragon Ball, the Grotto-Heaven Tree Root, and the Illusion Fruit, were a large number of max-level nutrition Fruits that increased the potential of evolution. When added together, their value exceeded Eleven’s evolution foundation. Shi Yu felt that it was no different from failing if it didn’t evolve into an overlord race.
Hopefully, everything went smoothly…
After all, he didn’t have the evolution talent of Big Boss Lin Feng to allow a Green Silkworm to evolve five times. After the worm evolved this time, it would welcome a third evolution again. Who knew when it would happen? It was naturally best to get it done in one go.
“Then I wish you success,” Miao Dongdong muttered.
…
“Divine Capital, one of the birthplaces of the Dong Huang Civilization. The mountains and rivers in the country are intertwined, and the terrain is complicated. There are a large number of mountain ranges surrounding it, and many guardians reside here. The mythical atmosphere is rich…”
On the plane, the tourists listened to the broadcast introduction of their destination and dozed off.
Because almost every tourist who planned to go to Divine Capital knew this information.
At the moment, the greatest guardian of the Dong Huang Continent was sleeping in the capital. This was actually related to the evolution big boss, Lin Feng. He was from the capital, and the guardian he cultivated, including the Butterfly God, naturally lived in the capital.
“We’re almost there.”
The plane passed through layers of clouds and mist. The journey was calm. Miao Dongdong took off his eye mask and looked out the window.
As for Shi Yu, he was seizing all the time to meditate and strive to break through to master as soon as possible.
Only by becoming a master could he have the ability to protect himself in various dangerous places in the country. After all, there were almost no wild hostile overlord-level creatures in the country. Monarch-level ferocious beasts were the greatest bosses.
As for going overseas to have fun, that would have to start from legendary.
“Have we arrived?” Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes.
At this moment, Miao Dongdong said, “By the way, have you booked a hotel? I have a brother who studied at Divine Capital University who helped me reserve their school’s hotel. Why don’t I get him to help you book one too?”
“At that time, we can still visit Divine Capital University.”
Shi Yu said, “Thank you, but there’s no need. I still have to deal with some things next. Let’s meet at the Butterfly meeting in three days.”
“Oh…” Miao Dongdong was stunned and nodded.
…
At the first airport of Divine Capital City.
After the plane landed, Shi Yu put on his mask and left.
If he was free, perhaps he would go to Divine Capital University with Miao Dongdong to… take a look. However, apart from the Butterfly Meeting, Shi Yu could also complete another thing on his way to Divine Capital. He just had to make do with his residence and ruins.
His other target was a high-level wood-element skill: Mutant.
There was an abnormal tree in the capital!
This was the evolution opportunity for the ginseng baby.
Although the Mutant Tree was ancient and had strong adaptability, it was not a native species of Dong Huang. Instead, it was a unique pet from the seven neighboring islands. The common type had already become all kinds of mutants, and it wasn’t even limited to the form of a tree.
But in Dong Huang, there weren’t many. About a hundred years ago, in order to study various evolution forms, the evolution talent big boss, Lin Feng, brought in a batch of pets from the seven islands. In order to not let it mutate into dangerous invading species, its number had been controlled in a certain range, in a specific area.
This should be a species imported from the same period as the gem cat and the slime.
In the ancient capital, there was no Mutant Tree. However, in the pile of information Shi Yu had investigated, there happened to be an organization that had a mutant tree.
After leaving the airport, Shi Yu casually took a taxi and arrived near the Mechanical Tree Club.
The so-called clubs were usually places where Beast Tamers supported by various large financial groups moved.
In Dong Huang, the power of the top five financial groups could not be underestimated. Their financial resources were extraordinary, and they monopolized most resources. They were forces with the ability to nurture legendary-level forces. The heads of the five major financial groups were also almost all top-notch experts in the country. Some financial groups even had connections with the legendary Beast Tamers.
Any one of them had a rich heritage that could crush a top-level institute alone. Moreover, they had a system similar to that of schools and regiments to nurture Beast Tamers, which were also the major clubs.
Through signing contracts with Beast Tamers with potential, they could compete internally and explore various dangerous areas through competition. The resources inside would be tilted.
The school system, club system, and army system were generally the normal promotion path for ordinary Beast Tamers. Apart from that, there were also a small number of Beast Tamers with overly heaven-defying aptitudes who would enter some secret departments in advance to be nurtured. For example, Shi Yu was such a person. Compared to the dispensable school system, his identity as Bureau 11 was more important.
“It’s here, right?” Shi Yu looked at the dazzling huge stadium in front of him and planned to go in to take a look.
Opening the door, Shi Yu had just entered when he saw an armed mutant tree standing in the middle of the hall.
Shi Yu was silent.
[Name]: Mutant Tree (Mutated Type: Mechanical Tree)
[Attributes]: Wood, Machinery (Mutated)
Although he had already obtained some information, Shi Yu still found it magical.
Mutation was a rare skill that could transform normal life forms into Mechanical lifeforms.
However, his was just a ginseng baby. Forget it, its secondary attributes should still choose earth or light.. The mechanical ginseng baby didn’t sound very reliable, he might as well directly contract a nuclear bomb baby.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - Ancient Objects and Machines
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Ancient Objects and Machines
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu directly entered the Mechanical Tree Club.
The club was an open facility that provided various services, including accepting missions, accepting event endorsements, and substituting competitions. Anyone could come.
When Shi Yu entered, the mechanical tree in the hall swept its gaze over.
At the far counter, a woman in casual clothes, about thirty years old, also looked away from the computer.
At this moment, Shi Yu was still wearing a black and red battle suit. There was even a red sword-shaped pendant around his neck. He looked impressive and handsome.
That pendant was actually Little Chi Tong.
As a spirit body, Little Chi Tong’s form was not so fixed, just like a ghost.
Even without mastering multiplication, shrinking and deforming was not difficult.
It could even pass through walls.
Of course, this kind of shrinking definitely didn’t have the skill effect of accelerating the recovery of physical fitness. It was purely convenient.
Little Chi Tong still liked to stick to Shi Yu like this. He was much more reliable and intimate than Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng.
This made Shi Yu realize that choosing a pet indeed had to start from the choosing the egg!
After entering, Shi Yu looked at the mechanical tree.
He smiled brightly and walked towards the mechanical tree step by step.
Shi Yu was just about to greet the mechanical tree through telepathy, but the next moment, the mechanical tree’s expression suddenly changed.
The mechanical mutant tree had always been close to the door in the hall.
As the signature pet of this club, it stood here and worked as a hostess, security guard, cleaner, air freshener, gardener, and many other professions.
At that moment, when it saw Shi Yu and sensed the aura of the little sword spirit hanging on Shi Yu’s neck, it suddenly glared at him and activated its security attributes.
The huge tree in mechanical armor trembled slightly and roared.
“There!!!! (Not good, the challenger is here!!!)” Its voice was strong and entered Shi Yu’s ears.
Shi Yu stopped in his tracks and was stunned on the spot.
Shi Yu: “?”
What the f*ck?
He came in with such a kind and sunny smile. How was he a challenger?
There was something wrong with this tree’s intelligence.
The side effects of the mutant skill?
His baby ginseng was pretty smart. It couldn’t become stupid after mutating.
“From the club next door?”
At the same time, at the counter, the woman who was playing with the computer and wearing a casual shirt stopped what she was doing and walked over. She stood beside the mechanical tree and observed Shi Yu.
“The club next door?” Shi Yu knew that she had misunderstood.
“You’ve got the wrong person.”
“Isn’t that so?” The woman was stunned and looked at the mechanical tree.
The mechanical tree widened its big eyes that were like light bulbs and pointed at the little sword spirit hanging on Shi Yu’s neck with a vine.
Judging from the aura, it was.
At this moment, Little Chi Tong woke up from its sleep. Who was so loud!
Meng Qing looked at the trembling little sword spirit and sighed .”…”
“Then I should have recognized the wrong person.” She looked at Shi Yu’s age and indeed didn’t look like the person next door.
“Since you say it’s not, then you’re not. Perhaps the mechanical tree made a mistake.”
“Sorry, I didn’t receive you well.”
The mechanical tree scratched its head. Mistaken?
“It’s fine,” Shi Yu said casually. “But what’s the club next door…”
Meng Qing said, “The other club is called the Antique Store Club. The pets they contract are basically antique artifact spirits preserved from ancient times. Here, it’s similar to your little sword spirit. Perhaps because of this, you were misunderstood by the mechanical tree.”
“The relationship between our two clubs has always been bad. It’s common to challenge each other. Sorry for embarrassing you.”
“I see. It’s alright, it’s a small matter.” Shi Yu smiled and didn’t mind.
However, he added in his heart…
This industry was really messy.
No… It seemed to be chaotic everywhere. Schools competed with schools, cities competed with cities, financial groups competed with financial groups. Then, it was quite normal for clubs to not like each other.
“So what do you want? Registration?”
“By the way, I’m the boss of this club, Meng Qing.”
The owner of the Mechanical Tree Club, Meng Qing, guessed when she saw that Shi Yu was young.
Shi Yu looked to be around 20 years old. He didn’t look like he was here to discuss business. Then, was he most likely here to register for the club’s newbie selection?
But… he had contracted a sword spirit. He should go to the group of conservative guys next door.
The Mechanical Tree Club, which mainly used modern Mechanics, was a wrong option for him…
“Registration? No.” Shi Yu shook his head.
Speaking of which, this big sister was the boss of this club?
So she was a rich woman!
Shi Yu thought that it was a hall girl who received guests. His eyesight was poor…
He said, “Hello, Boss Meng. I’m a feeder. I’ve been researching mutation evolution recently. I heard that the Mechanical Tree Club has a stable channel to nurture alternate trees, so I wanted to visit.”
Shi Yu looked at the mechanical tree beside him and felt helpless.
Replicating mutants was actually relatively troublesome.
He had experimented before.
This kind of almost passive physique skill could only be replicated after it took effect with his own eyes.
In other words, he had to personally see the mutated tree use mutations to evolve before he could successfully touch and replicate it.
Now, if he directly touched this strange tree, he couldn’t replicate anything.
When he was bored, he had tried it on other pets such as gem cats and even baby ginseng.
Therefore, if he wanted to replicate this passive physique skill, he had to find an opportunity.
“Feeder?” Meng Qing looked at Shi Yu suspiciously.
Really?
She didn’t believe it.
Shi Yu was too young. At this age, even if he was a Feeder, he would only be a trainee. There weren’t many professions.
“Do you have a certificate? If you’re a professional feeder, I can show you around,” Meng Qing said.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned. He didn’t have this thing.
The only certificate he had regarding the Feeder was the graduation certificate of the number one high school in Icefield City…
This thing could only be used as a certificate for a trainee Feeder.
“The Feeder is my secondary position. Is my university student pass alright?” Shi Yu asked quietly.
“You’re from Divine Capital University?” Meng Qing showed an interested expression.
“No, I’m from Ancient Capital University.” Shi Yu showed his student ID to Boss Meng.
“Ancient Capital?”
“Shi Yu… Ancient Capital University’s archeology Department.”
Staring at the student ID, Meng Qing was stunned. It wasn’t from Divine Capital University. The ancient capital was so far away, so why were the students there coming to Divine Capital?
“Ancient Capital is not bad either. So it’s a university student from a top-level institute.” Meng Qing nodded.
In this world, the Beast Tamers of the nine major universities were still very well represented.
This planet’s people entered society after graduating from high school. High school was equivalent to a university on Earth. There were various specializations, and a few years in advance, students chose their future direction.
On the other hand, the Beast Tamer University only had nine institutions, which was the nine major universities. The admission conditions were very high, and those who could enter the university were all elites.
For example, when an archeology student from Ancient Capital University heard this identity, he could subconsciously think that this student was one of the best in a professional assessment in a first-level city. He was a super genius. Otherwise, it would be very difficult for him to enter the trump card specialization of Ancient Capital University.
Generally speaking, such a person had a high chance of becoming a master-level Beast Tamer in the future.
As a person who had been in society for many years, Meng Qing was still willing to communicate more with such a genius with potential.
Meng Qing said, “But you’re from the archeology Department. Why did you choose to study the Feeding Department? Is university life so relaxed?”
She had never gone to university because it was meaningless. Her family still had a club to inherit, so she entered society early to train.
“An outstanding Beast Tamer has to know a little about everything.” These were Shi Yu’s sincere words.
“That’s true.” Meng Qing nodded.
Because Shi Yu was a university student, she chatted with him patiently.
What if Shi Yu was interested in joining the club after graduation?
Each financial group supported dozens of clubs, and each club was very internal.
The professional league and master league between the Beast Tamers in the clubs were even more intense than the national competition between university students.
The National League, the professional league of the clubs, and the Master League were about the largest scale competitions in the country.
As for the internal military exercises organized by the Beast Tamer Corps, these were usually not publicized.
In short, universities cultivated comprehensive talents. In the future, they had to move to various fields with strong freedom.
The club cultivated celebrity Beast Tamers, which was part of the business operation and national spiritual needs. It was the key to attract most ordinary people to become Beast Tamers and understand Beast Tamers. It was also a main industry to develop the country’s economy.
And the army naturally cultivated battle-type Beast Tamers.
In Meng Qing’s eyes, a genius from a famous school like Shi Yu was a resource.
After all, after graduating from university, it was still up to the Beast Tamer to decide what vocation to choose.
“Well…” At this moment, Meng Qing agreed to Shi Yu’s request to visit the Mechanical Tree Club.
However, after looking at Shi Yu for a while, she suddenly felt that something was wrong.
“Wait, classmate, why do you look so familiar?”
The boss of this club looked at Shi Yu’s face and fell into deep thought.
Had she seen this face somewhere?
“Uh, maybe I have a more common face?”
Shi Yu felt guilty. Good lord, could it be that the other party had also heard of the Iron-eating Beast Knight?
They were several cities away.
Moreover, he had only been on the trending list for half a day. Most importantly, the Beast Tamer of the club shouldn’t be so free to pay attention to these things, right?
“No, I’ve definitely seen it somewhere before.” The young female boss began to think carefully.
She usually liked to eat melons and watch dramas. Apart from supervising the training of the Beast Tamer signed by the club, she had nothing else to do. She was usually very free, but she still came into contact with more news.
“You…” The female boss stared at Shi Yu.
“Ancient Capital, Ancient Capital University, you’re the top scholar of that Ancient Capital City vocation assessment this year??”
A moment later, she thought of something and widened her eyes.
To be honest, she didn’t even remember the names of the professional assessment top scorers in Divine Capital, Imperial Capital, and even Demon Capital. This was because this group of people didn’t have much to do with the Mechanical Tree Club. They would definitely directly bid for the nine major universities or be poached by the financial groups.
However, only the top scorer of the vocation assessment in the ancient capital had made too much news a few months ago. It gave people a deeper impression!
A new star in the archeology world, a genius archeologist who discovered the evolution of the iron-eating beast, and an iron-eating beast knight… When these few topics were put together, it was even more memorable than a solo assessment top scorer.
Shi Yu :”…”
She really did know.
“It’s me…” He didn’t expect that after a few months, someone would really remember him. However, this also indirectly meant that his publicity effect was pretty good?
Senior Panda, pay for the sponsorship!
“It’s really you…” Meng Qing was stunned and suddenly didn’t know what to say.
“What do you want to see? I can show you.”
Even if Shi Yu had nothing to do with the Mechanical Tree Club in the future, she had to get to know such a genius with super potential.
After working hard in society for so long, she understood the importance of connections.
“Well…”
“Excuse me, are there any mutant trees waiting to evolve in the club now?”
“I want to observe the evolution of the mutated tree,” Shi Yu asked.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Meng Qing was stunned.
This was not a simple tour!
Although it wasn’t a big deal or private matter… It had to be said that Shi Yu came at a very coincidental time.
“Is there a problem? I can pay a certain amount of the observation fee,” Shi Yu said.
“No need.” Meng Qing’s expression relaxed. “There are two newbies’ mutant trees that are going to undergo modification mutations in two days. I can show you around then.”
“Thank you very much,” Shi Yu thanked.
“You’re welcome!” The female boss patted Shi Yu’s shoulder and smiled. “I knew it couldn’t be a common face. Student Shi Yu, you’re so handsome. I only took a look at the picture on the news and completely remembered it.”
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment.
She had gone so far. Her little mouth was like honey.
Boss Meng smiled and said, “The modified machinery can only be delivered from the headquarters in two days. Why don’t I take you around the club today?”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I’m still very curious about the operation of the club.”
Boss Meng smiled and said, “Alright, let me introduce you. Although our Mechanical Tree Club isn’t qualified to participate in the Master League, we’re also a popular team in the professional league. Overall, our strength is still very good.”
Meng Qing and Shi Yu introduced themselves. “I’ll take you to the training area of the official members first.”
…
The Mechanical Tree Club was very large. After all, it had a complete business chain. The various facilities were much better than Master Lin Hongnian’s dojo.
Meng Qing brought Shi Yu to the training ground first.
At the moment, there were six Beast Tamers and six mechanical mutant trees practicing in the training ground.
From the current training mission, it seemed to be resistance training.
The mechanical modified mutant tree still retained the characteristics of most tree-type life forms that were inconvenient to move. It was like a fixed cannon battery, and it had a high requirement for standing still to take a beating.
“They’re official members of the club. Every one of them is a high-level Beast Tamer.” Boss Meng and Shi Yu stood on the high platform and looked down.
The six official members she mentioned were all between 25 and 30 years old. There were four men and two women. They were very young and looked pretty.
This was very normal. After all, the club was to create a celebrity Beast Tamer. They had to take on various endorsements and sponsored partnerships. They also used their youth as a selling point.
“Are the main members of the club all mechanical trees?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes.” Boss Meng nodded.
It was indeed as she had said. The Mechanical Tree Club, which had a stable cultivation route of the mutant tree and used the Mechanical Tree of the high-level commander race as the tactical core, had pretty good competitiveness in professional competitions where there were no master-level Beast Tamers or monarch-level pets.
“Student Shi Yu, are you interested in the mutant tree and the mechanical pets?” Meng Qing asked. “If you come to our side to sign the contract, we can give you a mutant tree and a modification machine with high commander potential for free.”
“Sorry to disturb you,” Shi Yu said.
Although she was sweet-tongued, it was impossible for her to trick him into working.
Shi Yu smiled helplessly. “At the moment, school is more important.”
He belonged to an official organization, and his future development path couldn’t be matched with the financial groups and club systems.
However, it wasn’t like there was no connection between the financial groups and the officials. After all, many factions in the association were also supported by the financial groups.
And the founder of the Century Financial Group, which specialized in technological products behind the mechanical tree, was said to be the disciple of the legendary Beast Tamer who founded the Mechanic Department of Dong Huang.
At the moment, this legendary mechanical giant was very likely the only legendary Beast Tamer still alive in Dong Huang. After all, according to normal age length, he wouldn’t die.
However, in the past decade, it was also true that there had been no news of this person. Many of the subsequent top-notch mechanical lives were also developed by new talents in the mechanical field.
Could it be that this person has also disappeared like Lin Feng the legend? Or is he in seclusion to challenge the Mythical stage? Shi Yu muttered.
The power of a guardian-level forbidden weapon exceeded nuclear weapons. As for a Mythical-level technological weapon, a Planet-level one?
At Shi Yu’s level, he couldn’t come into contact with this at all.
“I understand. Learning is more important.” Boss Meng smiled. She was just asking casually. She didn’t expect Shi Yu to really come.
With the status of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution planner, directly cooperating with the various large financial groups or the official associations was much more promising than joining a small club.
A moment later, the training below seemed to have ended. Those club members discovered their boss standing on it. One of them couldn’t help but shout, “Boss, do you have any instructions?”
“Eh, is there a newbie?” A female teammate looked at Shi Yu beside Meng Qing curiously.
“This isn’t a newbie.” Meng Qing smiled. The clubs usually recruited Beast Tamers who failed their vocation assessments or didn’t enter ideal schools and weren’t willing to start over again for a year. Even the best clubs couldn’t recruit a top scholar like Shi Yu.
“Let me introduce you. This is the top scholar of this year’s Ancient Capital vocation assessment.”
“Discoverer of the iron-eating beast’s evolution form, archeologist of the Ancient Capital University’s archeology Department, Shi Yu.”
With that said, she walked down with Shi Yu.
As soon as Meng Qing finished speaking, there was silence below. Five people had shocked and confused expressions. Another male member suddenly thought of something and said, “That Shi Yu?”
“Who is it?” the female teammate beside him asked.
“This… how should I put it? You just have to know that it’s a very famous top scorer in the vocation assessment.” The person beside her didn’t know how to explain…
A moment later, Meng Qing and Shi Yu came down. The few of them bumped into each other. Boss Meng continued to introduce.
“Student Shi Yu came to our place to take a look at the Mechanical mutant tree. I’ll take him around.”
“Oh, oh, welcome.”
“Hello, Student Shi Yu.” The six team members greeted when they heard their boss’s introduction.
But soon, their attention was attracted by the Sword Spirit pendant on Shi Yu’s neck.
“Sword spirit??” The male member who recognized Shi Yu looked at the pendant and said in surprise, “Your third pet contracted a sword spirit…”
“Oh right, my name is Lei Liang. I’ve seen your… video?”
Little Chi Tong tilted its sword head. Video, what video?
“Sort of.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “But it’s not the third one. It’s the fourth one.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was stunned again.
Wasn’t Shi Yu the top scorer of the assessment this year? He was already… a high-level Beast Tamer so quickly??
Meng Qing was also stunned. This… was the main standard of their club in their first year?
Monster!
“Wasn’t it only beginner level four months ago…” Lei Liang was at a loss.
“You don’t understand the world of geniuses,” a female team member beside him said.
“I heard that this kind of artifact spirit pet is more popular in the ancient capital. Is that true?” She then asked curiously.
Shi Yu: “It’s not that popular, but there are indeed more Spirit Mediums in the ancient capital.”
“So, isn’t Mechanics not very popular in the ancient capital?” she continued to ask.
“No, it’s also a lot.”
When Boss Meng saw that everyone was talking about the sword spirit, she smiled and explained how the mechanical tree had mistaken Shi Yu as the challenger of the club next door.
The club members couldn’t help but smile in embarrassment.
Shi Yu heard it again and couldn’t help but look at Little Chi Tong. He asked curiously, “I feel that everyone is very concerned about this type of pet. Is it because of the club next door?”
Boss Meng smiled and said, “Perhaps there’s such a reason. We’re old enemies with our neighbor. It can still be traced back to my father’s generation. He and the owner of the club next door were originally good friends. They both liked antiques and sword-type pets and were good friends who pursued them similarly. But later, because the Mechanic class rose, my father went to change to the Mechanic class. The two of them also had a conflict and went their separate ways.”
“Ancient vs modern?” Shi Yu asked. This question didn’t seem to be limited to these two clubs.
After the modern era, antiques and swords could no longer produce spirits. There was only a batch of weapons preserved from ancient times, or the spirit bodies of those weapons.
Compared to this, the Mechanic class was a new life that had replaced these antiques.
In the modern era, very few Beast Tamers were willing to contract a sword, a bow, and armor like the ancient Beast Tamers. From the cost-effective ratio, they were completely destroyed by the Mechanics with greater potential now.
The former was rare, expensive, and had low potential. The latter was a new attribute, relatively popular, and had a high growth rate.
In the eyes of most people, an ancient sword spirit was much weaker than a mechanical light sword.
It could be said that the rise of the Mechanic class indirectly accelerated the decline of the ancient sword-type pets. The two had never been very friendly.
“That seems to be the case.” Meng Qing nodded.
“Speaking of which, are archeologists all ancient fighters?”
Lei Liang saw that Shi Yu had contracted a sword spirit. In addition to his identity as an archeologist, he subconsciously guessed.
The Ancient Battle Sect was like the ancient Beast Tamers. Beast Tamers who contracted armor, swords, and used pets like zither, chess, calligraphy, and painting to fight. Generally speaking, they were known as opposing modern Mechanics. Now, only a small number of inheritors had fallen. The main reason was that such life forms no longer existed in the natural world.
“Cut it out.” Meng Qing glared at Lei Liang. She suddenly felt that if they continued chatting like this, everyone would start arguing about this topic of new vs old.
“Probably not.” Shi Yu didn’t mind much. He said, “Actually, it’s the same in my opinion.”
“There’s no difference in strength between pets. The strength that can be displayed is completely dependent on his Beast Tamer.” Be it animals, elements, undead, antique swords, or mechanical lives, under the same race level, in Shi Yu’s opinion, their potential was about the same. They wouldn’t be inferior even if he added all the points.
“Maybe I’ll choose the Mechanic class next.”
Shi Yu’s idea was to have one pet of all types.
Animals, plants, undead, machines, elements… It wasn’t a collection hobby. It was purely because Shi Yu felt that their respective abilities were irreplaceable.
For example, right now, Shi Yu basically didn’t have the ability to fight in the sea. On Blue Planet, the ocean also occupied most of the territory. The ocean was a forbidden area for humans from ancient times to now. Even those legendary Beast Tamers couldn’t conquer the ocean.
Many powerful sea beasts lived in the deep sea, and they had incomparably rich resources. There were also many underwater ruins. The Dragon Emperor had once said that if the sea creatures attacked the land one day, no human country could stop them.
It was also because the resources on land were not suitable for sea beasts that the two had always been harmonious.
However, if Shi Yu wanted to explore the ocean, he had to contract a water-type pet, preferably an elemental-type pet.
“Mi! ~” Little Chi Tong bumped into Shi Yu. Although that was the case, couldn’t he at least praise it!
It was all the same, he said?
It had also understood mechanical lives before. It was just a hubigge robot, after all. It would kill one with one strike!
“Be good ~” Shi Yu comforted Little Chi Tong. You can’t cut it. Don’t you like electric ice boxes too? That’s the prototype of a mechanical life form!
Little Chi Tong: “!!”
Little Chi Tong was stunned. So that was the case. That Mechanic class was pretty good.
“For example, my Chi Tong is very strong,” Shi Yu added with a smile.
Chi Tong… was this sword spirit’s name?
Everyone looked at the little sword spirit again.
“That makes sense, but if the next one is a Mechanic, are you really not considering the Mechanical mutant tree?” Boss Meng still couldn’t forget about it. “If you have any needs, you can look for me. I still know many Mechanical Masters from the financial groups.”
The Century Financial Group mainly focused on technological products, and there were many Mechanics inside. Currently, the mechanical modification equipment of the Mechanical Tree Club was provided by the Century Financial Group.
“Alright, I won’t be polite then if I need anything.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Come, come, come, take a look at our club’s Mechanical Mutant Tree.” Meng Qing thought of Shi Yu’s business here. She looked at the six mechanical trees standing on the scene and introduced them.
Shi Yu looked over.
“They were undergoing resistance training just now, right?”
“Yeah.” Meng Qing nodded.
“That was a strengthening skill just now, right?” Shi Yu asked.
[Race Skill]: Mutant, Tri-Colored Bullet, Giant Arm, Lock, Strengthening, Giant Tree Cannon
Recalling the skill of the Mechanical mutant tree, Shi Yu pondered slightly.
Hardening was a mid-level skill that contained both earth and wood power.
The effect was to harden the wood-element skill or plant life, fuse the power of the earth and wood-element, and make the plant as hard as the Earth Stone, turning it into a hardening plant.
It was considered a defensive skill, but it was both offensive and defensive. It was similar to hardening.
To be honest, this skill was a racial skill evolved by very few plants in harsh environments.
Shi Yu had always wanted to find a defensive skill for Baby Ginseng. The most common and conventional skill was the wood shield skill, but because it was too conventional, Shi Yu was not too satisfied.
He wanted skills that were rare and more functional. This way, it would be easier to form profundities with other skills. It wouldn’t be eliminated so quickly.
For example, the wooden shield would be completely replaced by plant control in the future, but strengthening was a skill that could be used with plant control.
Just thinking about it, if the future ginseng baby summoning a huge wooden shield to protect itself… If it was just an ordinary plant wooden shield, the opponent would directly burn it with a ball of flames of the same level. But if it was a hardened wooden shield, it would contain some earth-element nature. It wasn’t that countered then, increasing the power of the plant greatly.
Such a skill was relatively difficult to master, but Shi Yu didn’t care.
Apart from the mutation, Shi Yu pondered for a moment after seeing the strengthening skill and was a little tempted. He had never seen this skill in the ancient big plant garden.
Now that Baby Ginseng had mastered the full-level “Dao Proficiency” Earth Chain, it used Earth Power very well and was very compatible with this skill. After learning it, even if Shi Yu didn’t add points, Baby Ginseng would probably be able to master it quickly or even perfect it in a short period of time.
If it learned this, it would really be invincible.
“Yes,” the few of them answered.
“Can I come into contact and take a look?” Shi Yu asked.
Meng Qing smiled and said, “Of course, do what you want. They’re very docile.”
Shi Yu came to the side of a mechanical tree and touched its hardening bark. “It’s been cultivated very well. One of my pets has also mastered hardening, but it’s still a little inferior to their hardening at the moment.”
[Recording success]
Everyone smiled. They had specially cultivated secret manuals for the various skills of the mechanical tree. Their whole family relied on the mechanical tree to earn money, so naturally, they had some strengths.
The hardening mastered by Shi Yu’s pet might only be at expert level at the moment, but these mechanical trees had already been trained to perfect level!
“It’s not very intuitive to rely on the touch. You can use your pet to attack it. There’s no need to be polite. Let them be trained.” Lei Liang smiled and said, “You can let that little sword spirit try. Their defense is still very strong.”
The mechanical trees:???
Human language?
When Shi Yu heard that, he was slightly stunned. Then, he smiled and said, “There’s no need.”
Little Chi Tong was only at the transcendent level. It was meaningless. Ordinary attacks were probably useless. If he used his full strength… Shi Yu was afraid that the other party wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
No matter how strong it was, it was still the same as hardening. It mainly defended matter, but Little Chi Tong mainly attacked the soul.
Even if there was a major level difference, Shi Yu was afraid that Little Chi Tong would hurt the hearts of these big guys with less than 40,000 energy points.
As a high-level overlord race, Little Chi Tong’s talent was very high. For example, although its Soul Slash, Sun Flame, and even the Interlocking Sword Skill were only at entry level, it could easily be combined and used. Flame, soul attack… Blood Suppression Mechanical Tree.
“I mainly want to observe, record, and study the difference before and after the mutation of the mutant tree,” Shi Yu said.
“No problem.” Meng Qing chuckled. “I’ll definitely let you see it in two days.”
Next, the Mechanical Tree Club warmly welcomed Shi Yu, the genius archeologist. However, Shi Yu didn’t stay long. After all, he still had to train. Seeing that there was no chance to replicate the mutation today, Shi Yu and Boss Meng exchanged numbers and quickly took the initiative to leave.
…
After leaving the Mechanical Tree Club, Shi Yu let out a long sigh.
He thought for a moment. He didn’t seem to have signed up for the Butterfly Meeting!
The Butterfly Meeting was held in the Divine Feather Mountain Range of the Divine Capital. It was in the wilderness, and not everyone could go.
The Butterfly Valley was separated from the city by a maze-like forest. At least professional Beast Tamers could pass normally. If trainee Beast Tamers wanted to enter, they had to find bodyguards.
In addition, the area of the Butterfly Transformation Valley was limited. The officials had to confirm whether the Beast Tamers who went there were sincere in helping their pets evolve or just going to watch the show. The latter didn’t have a strong background, so it probably wasn’t easy to go in and watch.
Generally speaking, every Beast Tamer who went to the Divine Feather Mountain Range and the Butterfly Meeting had to register in advance and record their identities.
This was also to prevent some lawless people from entering the mountain range. After all, in that chaotic place, most of the cocoons might not be by the owner’s side. The cocoons didn’t have any battle power, so if it wasn’t strictly controlled, it was very likely that the poachers or hunters would have an opportunity to take advantage of it. Even more so, if it angered the guardian, it would be even more serious.
“I’ll register first. Don’t wait until the last day to line up.” Shi Yu thought for a moment and quickly made a decision.
The process of registering and participating in the Butterfly Meeting was also very simple. He just had to take out his identification documents to register and show the officials the cocoon he had contracted.
When Shi Yu arrived at the Hundred Butterfly Town that led to the Divine Feather Mountain Range in the Divine Capital, he realized that there were only a few hundred Beast Tamers queuing here to register. It was possible that a large portion of them had already registered in advance, or it was possible that they had yet to reach the Divine Capital.
The Butterfly Transformation Valley could accommodate 100,000 people and 100,000 cocoons. Although the threshold of the Butterfly Transformation Assembly wasn’t high and there was a chance to see the guardian, there didn’t seem to be that many Beast Tamers participating in the Butterfly Transformation Assembly.
This was because most people didn’t have the Green Silkworm evolution plan. Even if a Green Silkworm cocoon that normally evolved into a Wind Crystal Butterfly obtained benefits in the Butterfly Transformation Conference, it would at most be comparable to a middle-level transcendent race. It didn’t mean much. In the end, the Butterfly Transformation Conference was still a stage prepared for those Beast Tamers who had supreme-grade evolution plans.
For example, those Beast Tamers who had mastered the high-level commander race evolution plan might be able to use the Butterfly Meeting to let their pet race’s potential be comparable to monarchs or even monarch races.
Therefore, most of the evolution positions might still be used by the officials themselves. They could cultivate a certain type of butterfly through the butterfly god.
“It’s my turn.” A moment later, Shi Yu moved.
This was a place where ten rooms in the hall lined up to register. Shi Yu didn’t wait long. About 40 minutes later, it was his turn.
When Shi Yu entered the hall, the person in charge of registering was a young lady. This time, the other party looked more like a service staff, unlike Boss Meng just now. As a boss, he actually sat in the hall and played with the computer to receive guests…
“Hello, please give me your Beast Tamer license.” The registration lady smiled sweetly and said to Shi Yu.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and handed his intermediate Beast Tamer license to the other party.
Speaking of which, shouldn’t he find Master Qu Jie to apply for a high-level license when he returned?
Would he still be the examiner?
Master Qu Jie’s sealing talent was pretty good…
“Please verify it.”
“Name, Shi Yu, age, 19 years, level, intermediate-level Beast Tamer, household register, Ping Cheng District of Icefield City, assessment venue, Ancient Capital Beast Tamer Association.” The registration lady routinely registered.
In theory, this age and level were very strong. But in the past few days, the registered young lady had seen too many geniuses from the nine major universities who came to participate in the Butterfly Meeting and was already numb.
“No problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Next, please summon the pets you want to participate in the Butterfly Meeting. They must be in a contracted state, and they can only be the cocoons of the Green Silkworm.” The registration lady said again, “We also have to help the pet’s physical examination register. I’ll also check the health state of the cocoon for you. It’s free ~ Professional Beast Tamer benefits ~”
The Green Silkworm wasn’t the only insect that could turn into a cocoon. However, the Green Silkworm was the most common insect-type in the world. At the same time, the Butterfly God was also a Green Silkworm in the beginning, so the Butterfly Meeting could only be attended by the Green Silkworm cocoon.
Shi Yu raised his head slightly and looked at the registration lady.
It was not a problem to summon the worm, but the other party wouldn’t deny it after seeing the cocoon, right?
After all, his Green Silkworm cocoon was still a little different from ordinary Green Silkworm cocoons.
“Hm?” The registration lady glanced at Shi Yu.
“Well…” Shi Yu summoned it. A spatial ripple appeared in front of him, and a white and green flash array appeared on the summoning platform. In the next second, a cocoon wrapped in white silk appeared in front of the register lady.
High-level Beast Tamer?
The registration lady was stunned. She realized that Shi Yu’s summoning level didn’t match the information… Did he not go for the assessment yet?
If it was a high-level Beast Tamer, 19 years old would be a little scary.
She was in charge of registering so many people, and few were as monstrous as Shi Yu.
“The color is very poor…” Seeing the Green Silkworm cocoon, the registration lady was about to be polite, but her gaze was suddenly stunned.
That was because there was a small hole in this white cocoon. The big eyes in the hole were blinking and observing her.
To be precise, it was two eyes, but at the moment, Buggy was sideways. A moment later, Buggy turned and looked at the register lady with both big eyes.
“Holy shit.” The registration lady was stunned.
Her mouth opened slightly. This, what the hell was this!!!
At this moment, she had almost forgotten all the service etiquette.
Beep… Beep… Beep…
At the same time, the energy value of the current worm was displayed under the summoning platform in charge of the physical examination.
This was a device similar to a machine that tested energy values in the vocation assessment.
Energy Points: 388,69
At this moment, when she saw the number, the registration lady’s heart trembled again. She couldn’t help but widen her eyes and take a step back.
What??
Was she seeing things?!!
Shouldn’t the cocoons of the Green Silkworm be at level ten of awakening, with an energy value no more than 100??
You…
308,000 was already close to the standard of a monarch species… commander rank!
No, this wasn’t the cocoon of a green worm at all, right? The registration lady couldn’t help but look at Shi Yu!
“This… This isn’t a Green Silkworm cocoon at all!”
Buggy: “?”
Then who was it? Couldn’t she be more polite?
“This is the Green Silkworm cocoon,” Shi Yu said. “It’s genuine.”
The register lady shook her head crazily. She didn’t believe it.
She pointed at the wide-eyed cocoon and the more than 30,000 energy points below. You call this a Green Silkworm cocoon?
At the Butterfly Meeting, other people’s cocoons would sleep and wait for the Butterfly Goddess to bless them and turn them into butterflies. Only your cocoon would open its eyes wide and wander around. Could you call this a cocoon of a Green Silkworm?
Shi Yu smiled and said helplessly, “It’s true. My Green Silkworm is relatively special, so it’s also relatively special after it transformed into a cocoon. It’s considered a new form. I’ve already written half of the thesis… I can publish it after it replenishes the other half after it transforms into a butterfly.”
Miss Registration: “?”
She couldn’t understand.
This cocoon didn’t look scientific at all.
A Green Silkworm cocoon that was close to the potential of a monarch?
What the hell?
“I… I have to inform our in-charge. I can’t make the decision,” she said.
She didn’t know if she should let Shi Yu and Buggy, this pair of anomalies, inside.
She still didn’t believe that this was the Green Silkworm cocoon.
“Alright.” If Shi Yu didn’t remember wrongly, the person in charge of the Butterfly Meeting should be a legendary Beast Tamer.
A legend that specialized in insect-type butterfly-type creatures.
At that time, the entire Butterfly Meeting would be presided over by her. She would also be in charge of communicating with the Butterfly God in the association.
At the same time, in a garden in Hundred Butterfly Town, a beautiful woman in her forties received a call.
“What’s wrong? Is there a problem with the registration of the Butterfly Meeting?”
“Legend Hua, yes, when it was registered, a Beast Tamer with a very strange green worm cocoon appeared…”
“How strange is it?” The legendary Beast Tamer surnamed Hua smiled and said, “Different color?”
