Under the lingering phoenix cry and snow, what broke out of the cocoon seemed to be a phoenix instead of a butterfly. However, it had only used some phoenix materials, and it was only a phase of evolution. It was definitely far from the point where it could transcend species and change races.
It was similar to the method of breaking out of the cocoon of the Ice Crystal Butterfly and the Ice Crystal Phoenix Butterfly. Soon, its cocoon was also frozen into ice before shattering. With the crack and the incomparable evolution light, a huge Ice Phoenix Moth about three to four meters tall appeared in everyone’s vision!
It had a blue body and wings that were like phoenix feathers. Its figure was incomparably cold and proud. It was born along with the crystalline snow and wind and instantly became the focus of the entire world. Even the Butterfly God acknowledged the potential of the Ice Phoenix Moth.
The limelight of the other evolution forms was all suppressed by it.
At this moment, in theory, there were no other cocoons.
But in fact, it wasn’t that there wasn’t a cocoon anymore.
On the silver ground, the worm glanced at the Ice Phoenix Moth and continued to absorb the last bit of Feather Energy. Because it was very conscious, its absorption efficiency was much faster than other cocoons. Moreover, it had been searching for places with abundant energy. The energy it absorbed at this moment was countless times more than other pets.
The butterfly god wasn’t helping it specifically, so Buggy could only work hard on its own.
After the Ice Phoenix Moth completed its evolution, Buggy finally felt that its body had reached saturation. This time, it had completely unearthed its evolution potential.
“Evolve,” Shi Yu thought when he saw this.
His attention, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others were one of the few that weren’t attracted by the Ice Phoenix Moth.
It had been watching Buggy the whole time, waiting for it to complete its final accumulation!
“Ji!” Buggy transmitted telepathy and slowly closed its eyes. At this moment, it completely activated all its strength!
At this moment, everyone was still immersed in the beauty and power of the Ice Phoenix Moth.
But at the next moment, something unexpected happened.
Boom!!!!
In an instant, a huge aura erupted from the last Green Silkworm cocoon on the ground.
It forced everyone to pay attention to it.
An incomparable aura shot into the sky, accompanied by a huge deterrence, shocking everyone.
Why was there still a Green Silkworm that had yet to evolve? Moreover, this might, what was going on…
“It’s that insect cocoon with eyes that had been running around previously.” At that moment, everyone was stunned. They looked at the cocoon that had acted extremely unscientific just now in confusion.
At this moment, its behavior was even more unscientific.
Under everyone’s gaze, the cocoon slowly rose into the sky with a blue light and flew higher.
It flew up.
“Holy shit.”
Many people were stunned, and then they looked at the ground and the sky. So, the Ice Phoenix Moth wasn’t the last to evolve?
That insect cocoon that could run with its eyes open had yet to evolve?
Was it about to evolve too?
“What exactly is this…” Legend Hua took a deep breath and looked at the Butterfly God.
However, at this moment, the butterfly god’s mood was not calm either.
It felt like this little guy flew into the sky with the goal of absorbing more of its power…
Ridiculous.
Moreover, it had expected every evolution form of the more than 100,000 cocoons present. However, to be honest, it couldn’t understand why this one would evolve.
“What’s going on?” The Ice Phoenix Moth’s Beast Tamer frowned.
“Senior Sister Xia, that cocoon is a little strange…” A student from Demon Capital University said to the talented girl of Demon Capital University, Xia Qingwei.
Xia Qingwei was silent as she sensed the message sent by the Ice Phoenix Moth.
At this moment, although the worm was still evolving, the Ice Phoenix Moth that had already completed its evolution was actually also shocked by the huge might emitted by the worm, giving rise to a feeling of wanting to submit.
The feeling described by the Ice Phoenix Moth made her feel that it was incomprehensible.
In fact, although the Ten Thousand Butterfly Dance was beautiful in front of them, the highest they could reach was only at the transcendent level. At this moment, as a commander rank worm with perfect level deterrence, even if it didn’t evolve, its strength would definitely crush every pet present.
Boom!
Under countless gazes, the strange cocoon in everyone’s eyes began to evolve.
Its entire body emitted an evolutionary light that shot into the sky like its aura. At this moment, everyone’s eyes suddenly widened, revealing an incredulous shocked expression, because…
“Heavens, heavens, the sky, the sky split open!!”
Looking at the silver sky that had cracked because of a spatial crack and the shattered space, everyone’s mouths widened. What exactly happened? Why, why did the evolution of this cocoon crack the silver sky created by the butterfly god??
Divine Feather Butterfly:!!!
Not only were the people shocked, the butterfly god suddenly felt that something was wrong.
Impossible. With this commander rank cocoon, even if it reached the monarch rank, it would definitely not be able to cause such a huge change.
What evolution materials had it absorbed?
At this moment, the Divine Feather Butterfly suddenly felt a trace of dragon might on the evolution cocoon.
It was even purer, stronger, and denser than the Phoenix might on the Ice Phoenix Moth just now!
This cocoon, the evolution ingredient, had absorbed dragon-type power?
Moreover, it seemed to be the power left behind by the dragon race above it at a very high bloodline level!
Crack!! Crack!! Crack!!!
In the light of evolution, Buggy’s deterrence completely erupted.
The tens of thousands of evolution butterflies present couldn’t help but dance for the evolution of the worm.
The deterrence power of a perfect-level deterrence against its own race, and it was a deterrence that crossed a large level. Even if Buggy didn’t have this thought, these evolution butterflies couldn’t help but look at the mutation of the cocoon in the sky in admiration and dance to express their congratulations.
Even the Ice Phoenix Moth lowered its stance slightly at this moment and left the spotlight for this mysterious cocoon.
“Ten thousand butterflies dancing together, the birth of an overlord.”
In the crowd, many experienced masters and even Legend Huas took a deep breath when they saw this scene and revealed shocked expressions.
That cocoon was going to evolve into an overlord race?
Apart from the legend of Hua Xiajin, everyone felt that it was impossible, because this violated the evolution law set by Senior Lin Feng!
How could a Green Silkworm skip two large stages of evolution to become an overlord race!
This didn’t make sense!
But the scene in front of them, the scene of ten thousand butterflies dancing together to celebrate, couldn’t help but make them confused.
“Impossible.” The Beast Tamers, led by Xia Qingwei, who had evolved into butterflies with monarch potential, looked at the scene in front of them in disbelief. They looked at their sincere pets in disbelief and felt that the scene in front of them was ridiculous.
They were all super geniuses, so how could they accept this situation?
It would be fine if it was the butterfly god, but what was wrong with this cocoon!
The evolution light was still fermenting, and the changes were also continuing to upgrade. At this moment, not only was the sky splitting, but the surroundings of the cocoon were also filled with dense spatial cracks. It was difficult to imagine that this was the power that a green worm could awaken after evolution.
At this moment, countless information started to feedback to Shi Yu from Buggy.
Skill: Thieving Dream
[Level]: Advanced
Introduction: A spirit-type skill. It can enter the dreams of other life forms and pry into their secrets. It can also replicate their dream illusions and create its own dream world.
…
Skill: Space Pocket
[Level]: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a spatial skill. Opening the inner space can be used for storage.
…
Buggy began to awaken new racial skills one after another. Shi Yu’s expression gradually became happy.
Thieving Dream, it was here!
Spatial pocket? It came from the root of the grotto-heaven tree, right?
Would it conflict with the ruin ring?
It was completely impossible. It could allow the worm to store huge energy crystals in its body. Top-notch resources like the Ice Dragon Whiskers could allow the worm to have the most perfect ability to materialize illusions at any time and anywhere. It was simply made for it!
It was equivalent to opening a pile of equipment for Buggy to wear infinitely!
Beside Shi Yu, Miao Dongdong had always been suspicious of this strange cocoon. At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu smile, he trembled. Damn it.
The evolution awakening continued.
Soon, Shi Yu received the feedback of the first super skill.
Skill: Imagination Domain
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a spiritual and spatial skill that overlaps the dream and illusion worlds with reality. In the Imagination Domain, the user grasps the power of imagination. All factors, including environment, space, change, and so on, will change because of the user’s will. Moreover, in the Imagination Domain, the user’s mental strength will undergo a qualitative change.
Shi Yu:!!!!
“Good job!”
He really wanted to praise Buggy for being awesome. This super skill… This super skill was simply the perfect upper level of illusions. This was simply a god-like ability, and it even perfectly included various weather skills and venue skills.
And this was still not the end.
“Roar!!!!”
At this moment, a dragon might bloomed in the sky. It wasn’t from the cocoon, but from the Worm’s evolution. The Imagination Domain unconsciously spread to the outside world. At this moment, the sky was already dark. Dark clouds lingered. Under the influence of its deterrence and the power of Imagination, rain fell from the sky.
Everyone watched the weather change in shock.
Even Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong couldn’t help but look at Buggy. Why did Buggy evolve into a monster?
At this moment, in the sky, in the dark clouds, a phantom figure was vaguely visible, gradually forming a dragon phantom.
Shi Yu was stunned because this wasn’t the ice dragon that Buggy had once transformed into, but an unknown dragon.
At this moment, even Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer, was a little stunned. But soon, he thought of the mysterious dragon ball that the worm had absorbed.
Could it be that it was the owner of the Dragon Ball
The phantom in the sky was a huge dragon-shaped body covered in blue and white dragon scales, a huge Eastern dragon.
It kept floating and circling in the sky, the scales on its body shining, dazzling the spectators. Under their gazes, it was as if they were pulled into another world.
Countless people sensed the huge dragon might and terrifying magic power of this divine dragon and couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
What the hell was this evolution phenomenon!!!
Was this still the evolution of the Green Silkworm?
What the heck!
“Roar!!!”
A moment later, with a roar from the divine dragon, the evolution light of the insect cocoon was released to the limit. It was incomparable and huge. Seeing this, the divine dragon phantom immediately flew into the light, as if it had become nutrients for evolution and fused into it.
The scaled claws pierced through the nine heavens, the coiling beast tied itself to the clouds.
As the divine dragon integrated, the information of the last super skill appeared in Shi Yu’s mind.
Skill: Dragon of Imagination
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a combination of spiritual, spatial, and dragon skills. Through the power of imagination, it can transform its physique into the body of a divine dragon. It has true attributes, physique, energy, life force, and dragon might that are comparable to dragons. It’s an ability to compare and surpass dragons.
When trained to perfection, it could evolve into a dragon and break through the limit of the skill. It would surpass the dragon race and reach the extreme, walking out of its own path.
This was… a super evolution skill!
At this moment, Shi Yu was completely stunned. He didn’t expect Buggy to be so powerful. He had never heard of this skill.
Boom!!!
Just as Shi Yu was feeling extremely pleasantly surprised, Buggy’s main body finally broke out of the cocoon.
Its huge body was not inferior to the Ice Phoenix Moth from before. It reached three to four meters and was a huge butterfly. After evolution, the worm had a blue and white body like the divine dragon just now, and its figure was like a dream.
It was large and gorgeous, with a shining metal-like blue luster and a white luster. It was extremely beautiful. The entire surface of its wings was like white waves surging on a blue sea. Its color and patterns were very spectacular, completely exceeding any previous evolution form.
On the surface of the huge wing, it was even more like a string of beautiful white halos embedded in the blue sky. It was extremely gorgeous and had an elegant figure. When it spread its wings, it was like a peacock spreading its tail, but its incomparably huge body also seemed to contain the powerful magic power of a divine dragon, shocking everyone.
Boom!!!!
After the worm evolved, its aura erupted again. The Butterfly God was shocked. All the Beast Tamers looked at everything in disbelief. In front of Shi Yu, the worm’s current energy level was jumping crazily.
[Energy Points]: 141112
There were still the four newly awakened racial skills. Before they had been upgraded, there were an additional 100,000 energy points than before. It had already exceeded the energy value of Eleven and the ginseng baby. It was a proper overlord race, and it was definitely not as simple as a low-level overlord race.
Spirit, space, and dragon… Such powerful three attributes combined…
Buggy’s current battle power was definitely not weak.
“I’ll call you the Butterfly of Imagination,” Shi Yu looked at the huge evolution body and muttered to himself.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong looked at the worm in a daze and felt that it was alright!
Beside him, Miao Dongdong looked at Shi Yu with an explosive gaze. His arm and fingers trembled as he pointed at Shi Yu.
At this moment, the nearly 100,000 Beast Tamers present were all crazy. They looked at this huge butterfly and lost the ability to think.
This, what was this?!
What race was this butterfly from?
Who, who was its Beast Tamer???
Countless people looked at the Butterfly of Imagination in confusion.
At this moment, Legend Hua was also extremely shocked. She looked at the Imagination Butterfly and swallowed her saliva. She felt that this guy’s potential completely exceeded her Myriad Flower Butterfly Fairy King.
And this was still before he accepted the butterfly god’s gift. There was definitely no surprise. Shi Yu and the others were the real protagonists in this Butterfly Meeting!
“Follow me.” At this moment, the Butterfly Meeting had completely ended. The guardian-level Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly, which could also be said to be at the totem level, looked at Buggy and Legend Hua in silence. Its gaze even crossed the sea of people and landed on Shi Yu, instantly locking onto the Beast Tamer of the Imaginary Butterfly.
It transmitted telepathy.
It made Shi Yu, the Butterfly of Imagination, and the others leave with it.
At this moment, Shi Yu patted Miao Dongdong’s shoulder, raised his finger in front of him, and shushed him.
“I’ll leave first. Don’t sell my information. I’ll finish writing the thesis first.” Shi Yu didn’t want to be disturbed unprepared.
Then, he smiled and slowly disappeared. Buggy instantly teleported to him, leaving behind a stunned Miao Dongdong.
He regretted following Shi Yu. This fellow didn’t want to be human!!!
At this moment, the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly turned into a silver breeze again and led the way for Shi Yu and the others.
As Shi Yu appeared on the Butterfly of Imagination, everyone saw this mysterious Beast Tamer in a black and red battle suit. Unfortunately, they couldn’t see his appearance.
Xia Qingwei and the others were shocked. They clenched their fists. Who exactly was this person?
That pet, that pet, could anyone nurture it?
An overlord race!
Moreover, it was definitely not just a low-level overlord.
He actually broke the evolution law set by Legend Ln Feng?
At this moment, countless people were shocked. A huge commotion arose in the sea of people.
“The Butterfly Meeting has ended. Everyone, leave in an orderly manner,” Hua Xiajin said before looking in the direction of Shi Yu and the others.
The figures of the Butterfly of Imagination, Shi Yu, and the others slowly disappeared from everyone’s vision with the silver wind. When she recalled that the Butterfly God had even called her, Legend Hua couldn’t help but calm his churning heart and follow.
At this moment, Shi Yu was smiling very happily as he sat on Buggy. Eleven and Baby Ginseng were also jumping around.
“Wu ~” Buggy’s light voice sounded, thanking Shi Yu, Eleven, and Baby Ginseng.
At this moment, when they heard the cry of the worm, Eleven and Baby Ginseng looked at each other.
Oh shit, it was over.
Wuji Airlines and the Yiji combination. Pa, gone!
Buggy:???
It had already evolved, so who would still do that!
Shi Yu smiled. After discovering that there weren’t many changes to Buggy’s evolution, he was in a very good mood. Speaking of which, shouldn’t he arrange for Buggy to learn multiplication? This was too big, and it wasn’t easy to keep it in his pocket.
“How do you feel?” Shi Yu asked Buggy.
Buggy’s eyes flickered. The image of itself being patted off the tree by the leader, then turned into a cocoon and broke out of the cocoon appeared in its mind.. It nodded heavily. It was very strong now, and it already had invincible strength!

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - Gift of the Butterfly God
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Gift of the Butterfly God
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After the Butterfly Meeting ended, the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly turned into a silver whirlwind and flew into the unknown.
Shi Yu and the others followed behind, still unable to calm down.
Although the Butterfly Meeting had ended and the worm had evolved perfectly, the Butterfly God seemed to have additional gifts for the evolution with the greatest potential.
This was very exciting.
At the moment, Buggy had two super skills and was already the reserve of a low-level overlord race.
Because its spatial attribute was strong, it could still be raised by another level, just like Yin Zhengfan’s Space Crystal Butterfly.
Therefore, Buggy was the foundation of a middle-level overlord race.
Then, considering that the Space Domain and the Dragon of Imagination, one was a super powerful dual-element skill, and the other was an evolution skill with an extremely high growth rate and all-element augmentation skill, Shi Yu could no longer easily determine the species level of the worm.
What could be confirmed was that even if the worm couldn’t reach a high-level overlord race or quasi Mythical race at the moment, it would definitely be able to reach it when its Dragon of Imagination skill reached the perfect level. This was because at that time, it would usher in a new round of transformation!
“I feel that it’s about the same as a middle-level overlord. It’s still a little lacking compared to Little Chi Tong,” Shi Yu analyzed in his heart.
Just as Buggy said, it was invincible.
Even if they faced Chi Tong at the same level in the future, their race wouldn’t be at much of a disadvantage.
With this foundation, Shi Yu and the others were looking forward to the butterfly god’s gift again.
What could it be? Could it increase Buggy’s racial potential a little more?
A moment later.
Shi Yu and the others arrived deep in the mountain range.
On the path to the depths of the mountain range, a silver storm formed a barrier, making it a mysterious forbidden area.
However, at this moment, the storm barrier had already automatically opened a hole, as if it was inviting Shi Yu and the others to enter.
“Let’s go in. This is the habitat of the butterfly god.”
Legend Hua Xiajin also followed Shi Yu and the others from behind. At this moment, she spoke beside Shi Yu.
“Legend Hua!” Shi Yu said.
“You guys… aren’t bad.” Legend Hua smiled, still very shocked.
Was this the random evolution Shi Yu mentioned?
The spatial cracks that filled the sky tore apart the silver sky. The evolution light that shot into the sky danced with the ten thousand butterflies. There were even divine dragon phantoms that swept the wind and clouds into the cocoon…
She would even believe it if he told her that this was a prearranged movie worth hundreds of millions! Random your head!
Forgive her for being direct, but this Butterfly Meeting was, after all, a public meeting. If nothing unexpected happened, the news of Shi Yu’s pet would quickly shock the country and inherit the hot topic discussion of the Butterfly Meeting. It would even let the hot topic level increase!
This news was definitely more explosive than the so-called vocation assessment, the so-called popularity of the iron-eating beast’s evolution.
The vocation assessment was held once a year. There was nothing new about it. In a year, there were already nine top scorers in first-level cities. Everyone would only watch it for fun at a certain time period. Even if there were any famous infractions, they would quickly forget it. As for the evolution of the iron-eating beasts, the value was in the category of monarch races. It was worth being shocked, but it wasn’t very exaggerated.
This was because in the hands of institutions, financial groups, and even some top-notch masters, the evolution form of monarch races was not rare. Many monarch races had stable breeding, cultivation, and evolution channels.
However, overlord races were different.
At the moment, even at the national level, no country had a stable and continuous cultivation channel for overlord race life.
Even if it was an artificial mechanical life, if it involved the overlord race or overlord level, it would also need some super rare resources that could not be replenished or could not be replenished in the short term. Moreover, the creation of life depended on luck very much. It required the power of the country and the support of many legendary Mechanics.
In this context, the significance of the overlord race was especially great. For a country, the birth of the life of every overlord race was the possibility of increasing a legendary battle power in the future. Or it could be said that a legendary battle power was almost reserved.
This was a big matter that could make the entire country tremble. After all, the number of legends in Dong Huang, including the ones guarding the country, the defense line of the totem area, and the legends guarding the public areas jointly protected by many countries, had never exceeded 50.
From this, one could tell how much of a stir a Beast Tamer and pet with legendary potential and overlord potential could cause.
This was also the reason why Shi Yu immediately sealed the news after contracting the heroic spirits of high-level overlord races. It was because it was really important.
However, who would have thought that the overlord species pet would be like a wholesale one when it came to Shi Yu? Another one…
“Haha, my luck is pretty good,” Shi Yu said with a shy smile.
“Wu ~” Buggy also said shyly.
Speaking of which, Buggy felt that if it weren’t for the butterfly god’s feather energy, even if it had a chance of becoming an overlord race, it wouldn’t have been so smooth. It still had to thank the butterfly god.
“In short, congratulations. If nothing goes wrong, the next blessings of the Butterfly God can make your…”
“The Butterfly of Imagination,” Shi Yu said. “Its new species’ name.”
Legend Hua smiled and said, “The race that can allow the Butterfly of Imagination to reach a higher level!”
“I never said that. Hua Xiajin, don’t talk nonsense.” At this moment, the two of them had already entered the depths. As they were talking, the butterfly god’s telepathy interrupted their conversation. It was the same voice as before, like a normal voice.
Legend Hua:???
Generally speaking, these totem-level creatures that had lived for a hundred years and even some overlord-level creatures had pretty much mastered telepathy. Some even learned to speak human language.
However, the butterfly god’s telepathy stunned Shi Yu and Legend Hua.
Legend Hua: What?
She had just finished talking, and got interrupted.
In the center of the silver storm, Shi Yu and the others had already arrived. When they landed, the silver whirlwind transformed back into the figure of the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly. This time, compared to the hundred-meter-tall behemoth from before, it was much smaller.
Shi Yu knew that the Butterfly God had once evolved into an elemental butterfly and also evolved into a Phoenix Vein Butterfly. It had experienced a total of five stages of evolution before it could become what it was today. The accumulation of five stages of evolution had allowed it to awaken five different racial skills and obtain a super strong potential. It even inherited the elementalization ability of the elemental butterfly and could freely transform into a silver whirlwind to form a new body.
In a sense, Lin Feng’s legendary evolution talent could also help pets master many skills.
“Wh-what do you mean?”
However, those weren’t the main points they were concerned about. Shi Yu and Buggy looked at the butterfly god nervously.
Couldn’t increase race potential?
It never said that?
Well, it indeed didn’t say… But, in theory, shouldn’t this be the case? What was it denying?
“I didn’t expect it to evolve into an overlord race in an instant. My gift can only increase the chances of an overlord race evolving into an overlord without increasing their life force. It’s useless to this butterfly,” the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly said confidently and very frankly.
Legend Hua:…
Shi Yu, Buggy:…
Eleven and the other pets looked at each other and mourned for Buggy in their hearts.
Strength was also a mistake…
“Butterfly God…” Shi Yu was about to cry. Buggy’s heart turned cold. Was it wrong to be too awesome after evolution?
Legend Hua was a little at a loss. This… She suddenly felt that it was reasonable, but at the same time, it didn’t make sense. The reasonable thing was the limit of the Butterfly God’s ability, while the unreasonable thing was that Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination actually made the Butterfly God helpless…
“I called you here to ask you what happened to the divine dragon phantom just now,” the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly said.
The butterfly god could tell that the worm didn’t break the evolution rules its master had concluded. It could tell that the cocoon was already in an overly evolved form.
It had seen too many strange evolution forms around its master, so it wasn’t too shocked. However, that divine dragon phantom really made it curious.
Legend Hua also looked at Shi Yu. Yes.
She also wanted to know what was going on.
At this moment, Shi Yu was stunned. “Among its evolution materials, there’s a level-four Dragon Ball Could it be related to that…”
Dragon Ball
It was not out of the expectations of the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly and Legend Hua.
“A level-four Dragon Ball” However, the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly was still puzzled.
“It’s level four, but it’s not level four at the start. It’s because the dragon ball has been too long ago, and its energy has already disappeared naturally. Its original level can no longer be judged, and even the owner of the dragon ball can’t judge…”
This was a dragon ball that the gem cat had obtained when it was looting an alternate realm in the undead battlefield. Its origin was unknown and incomparably mysterious.
Back then, it didn’t even blink when Shi Yu wanted to take high-level spatial resources, but it only hesitated for a long time before gritting its teeth and giving it to Shi Yu to exchange for the gem fruit.
From the looks of it, this dragon ball was indeed a good thing. The owner’s identity was also incomparable.
What Shi Yu had seen just now was a classic Eastern Dragon Phantom. Moreover, from the looks of it, Shi Yu actually couldn’t determine what race it was. It looked like it was another super expert that had been lost in history.
“The owner of that dragon ball has a very high bloodline level.”
“It’s even above high-level overlord races. The limit is close to a Mythical race, or it can be said to be a quasi Mythical race. This bloodline can already be said to be a divine dragon.”
“I’ve only seen this bloodline level on the Black Dragon King beside Master.” The Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly’s tone was nostalgic.
Legendary Hua looked at Shi Yu and was not calm. The dragon ball of a divine dragon?
Ridiculous.
Where did Shi Yu get it and how did he end up feeding it to a Green Silkworm?
She didn’t understand.
“Divine Dragon…” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
“It’s this situation. Because of this Dragon Ball its potential has become too high. The gift I originally prepared is already meaningless to it, but since I have already agreed to the gift, I won’t go back on my word.”
A breeze blew over from a distance. Under the sweeping of the silver whirlwind, a palm-sized, sea-blue scale was swept out of its secret treasure vault.
The scales emitted a dragon might and were filled with pressure.
“This is…”
“The dragon scale of one of my companions is also a friendly keepsake of the underwater Dragon Palace City. There’s nothing else for you guys. This is for you. It’s one of the headquarters of the Eastern Dragon Race in Dragon Palace City. Perhaps you can go there to unearth more of its bloodline mysteries and better break through its limits.”
The butterfly god gave up. Since it couldn’t complete the gift, it simply sent Shi Yu to its companions.
“Sea Dragon Scale…” Seeing this scale, Legend Hua was stunned.
Legend had it that Lin Feng had once cultivated a Green Silkworm that eventually evolved into the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly. He had also cultivated a Dragon Carp, which evolved into a sea dragon and married into the Dragon Palace City.
It was indeed as Butterfly God had said. This was an important keepsake that led to Dragon Palace City.
This dragon scale looked like it had been collecting dust for a long time, but the energy and dragon might were still vigorous. It was probably not lower than level seven.
This was also good!
“Thank you.” Shi Yu’s expression changed quickly.
“Buggy, hurry up and thank the butterfly god.” It looked very much like a parent who was helping his child collect his New Year’s red packet money.
“Wu!” Buggy also quickly thanked the Butterfly God and put the dragon scale in its spatial pocket.
With this, could it also conjure a powerful sea dragon?
Just like when he used the Ice Dragon Whiskers.
At this moment, Shi Yu was very satisfied.
With the Dragon of Imagination skill, it was indeed not that important whether Buggy improved its race level or not.
However, the token of friendship that led to Dragon Palace City was too precious. Tyrant Dragons were everywhere there, and the totem dragons also had several absolute ocean overlord powers.
It was because the Dragon Emperor had befriended the underwater Dragon Palace City that Dong Huang could develop the strength of the navy and have absolute authority over the sea.
“Then that’s it. You guys can leave.” After holding the Butterfly Meeting, the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly was sleepy again. It didn’t have any intention of keeping Shi Yu and the others longer, and it wasn’t any more curious about Buggy.
“Hua Xiajin, I’ve completed the Butterfly Meeting according to our agreement. Don’t forget your responsibility.”
“Alright.” Hua Xiajin sighed.
“We won’t forget.”
Shi Yu looked at Legend Hua. Was there any other agreement between humans and the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly?
Hua Xiajin remained silent. Even if it was very strong, as a pet that had been raised by someone since it was a Green Silkworm, the request of the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly was actually very simple. After being alone for a hundred years, it only wanted to find its Beast Tamer. Up until now, the entire Dong Huang had never given up on searching for the missing Lin Feng legend. This was also one of the connections between the guardians left behind by Dong Huang and Lin Feng.
…
At the same time, in the outside world.
Just as Xia Jinqi had expected, it had already caused a huge commotion.
On the Internet, at the Butterfly Meeting, the birth of the overlord race, the mysterious butterfly species. This hot search immediately suppressed all the news and rushed to the top of the hot search.
However, although the evolution process and dreamy figure of the Butterfly of Imagination were described in words to be extremely shocking, the information about this evolution body and its Beast Tamer was still unknown.
At that moment, only a small number of people could know the full story of the incident through the information left behind by Legend Hua.
In the capital, at the headquarters of the Beast Tamer Association of Dong Huang, a few important figures received the information and slowly scanned it. After discovering that everything came from Bureau 11, they didn’t pay attention.
As for the ordinary Beast Tamers who didn’t understand these things, they were extremely shocked.
The Butterfly Meeting… produced a creature of an overlord race?
Demon Capital.
In the Dark Club, Heavenly King Zou browsed the trending list that had been pushed down and was slightly stunned.
At the Insect Research Institute of the Demon Capital University, Dr. Zuo Jiangyun, who had received the news from her daughter and researched the evolution method of the Ice Phoenix Moth, pondered for a moment and called Hua Xiajin Legend. Unfortunately, no one picked up for the time being.
In Bureau 11, all the members also obtained relevant information soon.
After knowing about this newbie, he created another big news.
Li Lianping, who had recommended Shi Yu to participate in the Butterfly Meeting, was immediately stunned. Even if she recommended Shi Yu to participate in the Butterfly Meeting, she didn’t let Shi Yu film a movie. The evolution phenomenon spreading on the Internet was like the birth of a Mythical creature. Good heavens, it was ridiculous.
“Well…” In a certain place, Lu Qingyi looked at the news and didn’t know what to say. Logically speaking, she just wanted Shi Yu to study well in Ancient Capital University first. The first half of the first semester of university wasn’t over, but he had already gotten two overlord race pets. What was going on?
She kept feeling that Shi Yu wouldn’t be too calm over the next period of time…
At this moment, the entire country was boiling as they pursued more information about the mysterious evolution butterfly. Among the many people who knew, only Miao Dongdong was mixed in the crowd and trembling.
“Is Shi Yu a huge event maker?” He was confused.
…
At this moment, the protagonist of this incident, Shi Yu, had already been brought back by Hua Xiajin.
Shi Yu temporarily ignored the huge reaction caused by this incident. After he returned, he temporarily stayed in Hundred Butterfly Town. The first thing he did was to return to the ruins space and help Buggy learn the multiplication skill in one go. He also raised the skill proficiency to expert level.
After everything was completed, the 0.3-meter Eleven, the Ginseng Baby, and the smaller Little Chi Tong looked at Buggy that had also become 0.3 meters and nodded.
As it kept shrinking, soon, Buggy’s size became about the same as before. This made it easier for it to interact with Shi Yu, Eleven, and the ginseng baby.
“Wu ~ ~” Buggy, with watery blue compound eyes and a pair of dazzling blue wings, landed in Shi Yu’s slightly raised hand in a blue butterfly pose and asked in anticipation.
When… was the team meeting? It couldn’t wait anymore.
[Name]: Butterfly of Imagination
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space
[Race Level]: Medium overlord
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Moreover, a pile of high-level skills, two abnormal super skills, 140,000 energy points, and two level-seven dragon-element equipment, how could it lose?
Eleven and Baby Ginseng’s expressions changed.
Good heavens, after just evolving, Buggy’s ambition was almost impossible to hide.
“What’s the hurry?” Shi Yu was quite calm. Buggy was too strong. Even if he let Little Chi Tong possess him, he would probably only be tortured. This version was not balanced at all. Why not let him strengthen Little Chi Tong first?
He had just broken through and was no longer that weak Beast Tamer who could not withstand the wind and could not be possessed.
“You should adapt to your new ability first. I still have to organize your information. Let’s settle the evolution storm first,” Shi Yu confirmed.
Buggy was stunned. Pa, the joy was gone.
It looked at Eleven and asked the leader if it wanted to warm up first.
“Wuu!” Eleven turned around directly. It clearly sensed Buggy’s strength at this moment. There was no hurry. It would wait until Shi Yu organized the team’s internal meeting. It didn’t want Buggy to know its background too early. Moreover, it had to take advantage of this period of time to work harder.
Eleven didn’t fight battles that it wasn’t confident in. If hard training wasn’t to defeat the opponent, it would be meaningless.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng also turned its head. Although the worm didn’t look at it, Baby Ginseng felt that the Anti-Buggy’s Energy Fruit didn’t seem to be very qualified… It had to continue studying the Anti- Butterfly Energy Fruit.
“Wu!”
Seeing that Eleven and Baby Ginseng were scared by him, Buggy waved its wings indifferently and was excited. Great!
It didn’t matter!
It didn’t matter when. With its current strength, it would definitely be first place no matter when Shi Yu organized the team meeting!
Even if Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong were given a few months, could they still surpass the Butterfly of Imagination?
Impossible! It didn’t know how to lose at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - Buggys Haki
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Buggy’s Haki
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
[Name]: Butterfly of Imagination
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space
[Race Level]: Medium overlord
As for more detailed information, such as evolution materials, prerequisites for evolution, and even skill data, it was impossible to publicize.
It would be fine if it was only a new pet of the transcendent and commander races, but the information of the overlord races was already strategic information. It was impossible to casually publicize it.
Therefore, after watching for a long time, apart from the name, attributes, and race of the Butterfly of Imagination, everyone still didn’t know anything.
However, just this information was enough to shock everyone.
The higher the racial level, the greater the difference between each small level.
For example, although there were three racial levels between low-level and high-level monarchs, they only had one super skill.
The difference was only the racial difference in physique, vitality, and energy values.
However, the difference between the few levels of the overlord race was huge. There were often multiple super skills between each level, and the advantage was very big.
It had to be known that the race level of the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly was only a high-level overlord, and the Butterfly of Imagination had actually reached the middle-level overlord level. The entire country was incomparably shocked. This was simply an unreachable race level.
Generally speaking, the higher the race level, the easier it was to enter the guardian level. Mid-level overlord races were already very powerful.
Not to mention ordinary Beast Tamers, even the officials of the association were secretly shocked when they updated the information. As expected of Bureau 11, it caused a huge commotion again.
However, in fact, the big shots of Bureau 11 were also very confused, because this was all caused by Shi Yu himself.
To be precise, apart from the information about the Butterfly of Imagination, there were also two new pieces of information about the previous form of the Butterfly of Imagination.
[Name]: Green Worm cocoon
[Attributes]: Worm
[Race Level]:???
Back then, during the Butterfly Transformation Conference, the cocoon that could move and fly gave people a lot of shock.
This was clearly a new race. As the information of the cocoon spread on the Internet, people were completely numb and their values shattered.
Now, more and more people were curious about who the Beast Tamer of the Green Worm cocoon and the Butterfly of Imagination was.
Of course, although Shi Yu had revealed very little information at that time, it still aroused the imagination of some spectators.
For example, the Mechanical Tree Club.
The boss, Meng Qing, had gone through many trials. Now, they finally have some information of value.
According to the people present, the Beast Tamer who rode the Butterfly of Imagination at that time was very handsome in a red and black battle suit and a red cloak.
This description stunned Meng Qing for a long time.
It instantly reminded her of Shi Yu, who had come to Divine Capital from the ancient capital and had been a guest at her club for the past two days with an unscientific green worm.
She hesitated many times and wanted to ask Shi Yu, but it felt difficult to ask about such news.
In addition, in Ancient Capital University, Yu Shu, Wang Ling, and the others were silent for a long time when they saw such an unscientific cocoon and the information on the Imaginary Butterfly.
Although it didn’t feel very likely, they all had the same feeling that it couldn’t be that monster, Shi Yu. If it really was… they didn’t want to live anymore. How could they be classmates?!
At the same time, in Hundred Butterfly Town, at the location, in Hua Xiajin’s legendary private courtyard.
“What are your plans next?”
Hua Xiajin, who had been in charge of picking up Shi Yu, asked.
Shi Yu had given her too many surprises in the past few days.
Unfortunately, the birth of a new overlord race was still impossible to replicate.
Shi Yu had already made it clear, and Hua Xiajin was also clear. It was impossible to find a second copy of the inheritance of the Dream Shell and the mysterious dragon ball alone.
However, Shi Yu seemed to think that he could study the evolution of the green cocoon?
“It’s time to return to the ancient capital. I’ll continue to study the evolution method of the green cocoon,” Shi Yu said.
“Have you thought about it? Is there anything I can do with Dr. Zuo Jiangyun’s help?” Legend Hua asked.
She was the most powerful Beast Tamer in the country who specialized in the Worm Department, and Dr. Zuo Jiangyun was the chief researcher who specialized in the evolution of the Worm Department.
She had contracted a bug-type overlord of an overlord race. The other party had studied the evolution of the Green Silkworm into a low-level monarch race and the evolution path of a high-level monarch. It could be said that they were both authoritative representatives of the Dong Huang Insect Domain.
If Shi Yu had any needs, they could be of great help. To a certain extent, they were the people in charge of various competitions, research, and projects in the country’s bug domain.
“There’s really one,” Shi Yu said. “I want a batch of Green Silkworms with proficiency in worm silk to perfection, as well as some evolution materials.”
Because the research Shi Yu planned to do was not private, he decided to directly apply for experimental materials. Moreover, in order to pursue popularization, he definitely had to abandon the skill index and abandon adding points. At most, he would reference the general teaching steps of the index.
“Alright, no problem.”
Legendary Hua nodded. It was a small matter. As long as he could develop the form of the Green Silkworm cocoon, even if this Green Silkworm cocoon couldn’t reach the commander race like Shi Yu’s cocoon, it would still be a low-level transcendent race. It would definitely be a big discovery.
Because Lin Feng legend had also concluded that evolution would definitely be accompanied by new racial skills.
This was very meaningful to the evolution potential of any Green Silkworm after breaking out of its cocoon.
“Actually, there’s one more thing, but I have to seek your opinion,” Legend Hua said in the end.
“What is it?” Shi Yu was surprised.
“Although they don’t know who you are or who the Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination is, Dr. Zuo Jiangyun’s daughter, who is also the Beast Tamer of the Ice Phoenix Moth at the Butterfly Meeting, wants to meet you and challenge the Butterfly of Imagination with the Ice Phoenix Moth. Perhaps, it’s also Dr. Zuo’s intention?” Legend Hua touched her chin and analyzed curiously.
“The Beast Tamer of the Ice Phoenix Moth?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“That Ice Phoenix Moth is only transcendent. There’s no meaning to it, right?”
Legend Hua smiled and said, “Don’t look down on that girl. She’s a genius of the Demon Capital’s large school team. Her father is a legend, her mother is a top-notch doctorate, and she’s only a step away from becoming a master. Moreover, her talent is relatively special. Not long after the Butterfly Transformation Conference ended, the Ice Phoenix Moth was already strengthened to commander rank by her.”
“Of course… There’s definitely a huge gap between her and your Butterfly of Imagination, but if she didn’t see it for herself, I reckon she won’t give up. After all, I heard that she came for the first place in the Butterfly Meeting this time.”
“Let’s meet them. It’s also good to let them know the strength of the butterfly.”
They? Shi Yu scratched his cheek. She had a grudge with Dr. Zuo?
“Alright, I can do both. I can see you before I leave,” Shi Yu said.
…
cDivine Capital.
In a hotel, Xia Qingwei, who was wearing a blue dress, picked up the phone.
“Mom, is there any news? Who exactly is the Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination?”
A voice came from the other side of the phone. “The other party has already agreed. You just have to find your Aunt Hua.”
“As for his identity…”
“Ancient Capital University, first-year student of the archaeology department. Shi Yu, he’s the top scorer in the vocation assessment who discovered the evolution of the iron-eating beast’s monarch race a few months ago. You should still have an impression of his green worm, right?”
The Ice Phoenix Moth’s Beast Tamer was stunned for a moment and said, “It’s him? The other party is… a Beast Tamer who just passed the vocation assessment? However, if it’s that Green Silkworm…”
“Don’t judge a person by their age and appearance.” The other party smiled and said, “Alright, go find your Aunt Hua first. Tell me the final results.”
Xia Qingwei hung up silently and fell into deep thought.
A moment later, she arrived at Hundred Flower Town and found her mother’s good friend, Flower Xiajin Legend.
“Aunt Hua.” Xia Qingwei stood outside the courtyard and looked at the noble lady in a butterfly-patterned cheongsam walking over. She greeted slightly, “Mother asked me to greet you on her behalf.”
“Qingwei.”
“You’re looking for Shi Yu, right?” Legend Hua smiled.
“Well, he’s the Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination, right?”
Xia Qingwei knew that the Butterfly Meeting was presided over by Legend Hua, and she also knew that Legend Hua and her mother were good friends. Through this relationship, she finally knew who the owner of the Imaginary Butterfly was in advance.
“Yeah, but have you decided to see the strength of that butterfly?”
“Its strength might exceed your understanding a little.”
“It’s alright.” Xia Qingwei nodded and didn’t mind. It wasn’t like she had never come into contact with pets of overlord races. She was already mentally prepared.
“Do you know where he is?”
“He’s currently in my courtyard,” said Legend Hua.
Before Shi Yu left Divine Capital, she would definitely be responsible for Shi Yu’s safety.
Shi Yu didn’t want to hide the fact that he was the Beast Tamer of the Imagination Butterfly, but he also didn’t have the intention to publicize it. He planned to develop normally in the short term. In the future, when it was time to send the Imagination Butterfly to battle, he would send the Imagination Butterfly to battle. Everything would go according to nature.
However, Shi Yu estimated that the full battle of the Butterfly of Imagination would probably be reserved until the battle exchange with Imperial Capital University in a while. Just the thought of it was exciting…
“I’ll take you to see him.”
At this moment, in the courtyard, Shi Yu was drinking flower tea in satisfaction.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Little Chi Tong, and the others were playing in the huge garden.
The garden of the Legend Hua was very large, even larger than the field of a university. There were all kinds of flowers, spiritual plants, and wild butterflies and plant sprites living here freely, helping to take care of the garden.
In fact, Shi Yu had even replicated another wood-element skill from a gardener plant.
Skill: Lush
[Level]: Low-level
< Introduction > It’s a wood-element skill that can allow plants to grow.
This was another evolution skill that Shi Yu had selected apart from mutants.
However, this evolution skill was only useful for specific pets. Similar to hardening and worm silk, it was probably useless for ginseng babies. Even if it was useful, it definitely needed other evolution materials. At most, it could increase the evolution foundation.
Regardless of whether it was useful or not, it was just a low-level skill. It was very easy to maximize it. Shi Yu planned to find an opportunity to teach it to the ginseng baby. He would let it master the full-level lush skill first before deleting it.
Because this skill was also the gardener skill that Shi Yu had been thinking about for a long time.
Using this skill could increase the growth speed of plants. After the proficiency was high, it could even increase the power of plant-type skills, the growth speed of plant-type pets, or summon plants from the soil out of thin air.
The ability of this skill was actually severely covered by the control of the super skill plant.
However, super skills were far in the future. It was not difficult to maximize low-level skills now. Shi Yu planned to teach Baby Ginseng this foundation first. This way, it might be easier to master plant control in the future.
Moreover, during evolution, there would be a stronger foundation.
In addition, this skill that could simply control plants could cooperate with strengthening when the time came. It could also allow Baby Ginseng to have more offensive means before it mastered plant control. For example, at that time, using the combination skill of these two skills, it could completely create a hard wooden shield to protect itself. There was basically no problem.
“The new skill is enough. I’ll leave the remaining skill column to Little Chi Tong.” Shi Yu yawned.
The reason why Shi Yu copied it so casually was because he had added five new skill bars after contracting Chi Tong, and after filling and deleting some of the skills of Eleven, Buggy, and Ginseng Baby, there were a lot of empty skill bars.
In the courtyard, Shi Yu held his cell phone. After busying himself with the evolution of the worm, he had been paying attention to the news of the mutated environment of the ginseng baby.
As for Little Chi Tong’s, there was no need to worry at all. It had mastered the transformation evolution skill, Spirit Release. It would be enough to practice this. It was estimated that after the skill level reached transcendent, it would welcome a new transformation evolution, corresponding to a quasi-mythical race.
As for Eleven’s inscription, there was no use in being anxious. In the past three months, Shi Yu had even returned to the Iron-eating Beast Ruins many times, but he didn’t find anything new. However, when he recalled the content of his conversation with Senior Lu and guessed that Emperor Wu might have contracted an Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu planned to find the ruins of Emperor Wu to see if there was any relevant information.
He had already locked onto the location of the ruins. It was a ruin that had been cracked. It was a place where Martial Emperors built to train their subordinates. Now, it was still a cultivation Holy Land. Coincidentally, that place was the venue of the martial arts conference that the beast-eared girl had invited him to participate in.
“Shi Yu.”
As Shi Yu was thinking about the subsequent plans, Legend Hua came from afar. Shi Yu looked up and saw a girl with a unique aura beside her. At a glance, she looked like a daughter from a rich family. He immediately understood that this was the daughter of Dr. Zuo that Legend Hua mentioned.
“Aunt Hua.” Shi Yu stood up slightly, while Eleven and the others continued picking the nectar to eat.
If it weren’t for the sake of eating, they wouldn’t have stayed outside for too long.
“This is Xia Qingwei…” Legend Hua introduced the two of them again with a smile.
Shi Yu and the other party also nodded briefly and greeted each other.
In just a moment, Xia Qingwei’s gaze was attracted by the blue butterfly in the garden that was following a bunch of pets to pick flower honey.
“Butterfly of Imagination?”
Although it was much smaller, its extraordinary gorgeous posture still left a deep impression on her.
“Yes.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Miss Xia, you came this time to experience its strength, right?”
“Yes.” Xia Qingwei nodded and said, “Can I?”
“You can, but as a worm-type pet, if its growth level hasn’t reached the monarch level, it’ll probably be very difficult to fight it normally…”
Xia Qingyi was stunned. Then, she shook her head and frowned. “Please don’t underestimate us.”
“I’m not looking down on you…” Before Shi Yu could say anything, Legend Hua said,” Qingwei, summon your pet and you’ll know. ”
Xia Qingwei glanced at the Butterfly of Imagination and didn’t understand what the two of them meant.
However, she still directly summoned the Ice Phoenix Moth.
In the next moment, a large moth-type creature with wings that looked like frost phoenix wings appeared behind Xia Qingwei and slowly flew up.
Monarch species, commander rank, Ice Phoenix Moth!
The moment the Ice Phoenix Moth appeared, it looked at the Butterfly of Imagination. At this moment, the Butterfly of Imagination that the worm had evolved into also looked over in a shrunken state.
Both parties looked at each other.
It was as if an Ice Aurora had collided at this moment.
Boom!!!
The moment the Ice Phoenix Moth and the Butterfly of Imagination looked at each other, the Ice Phoenix Moth seemed to have entered a world of ice and snow. On the other side was an Ice Phoenix Divine Dragon. Under the terrifying dragon might, its vision was covered by the huge divine dragon body that exceeded ten thousand meters in a single exchange. It saw a dragon claw that covered the sky slapping towards it. Unparalleled cold air erupted, instantly freezing and shattering its spirit!
The Ice Phoenix Moth’s brain stiffened, as if it had experienced the fear of death in an instant. Its heart was in a state of despair, and its entire body trembled slightly. The ice crystals around its body seemed to have been affected by something, instantly disappearing and turning into nothingness. Its battle will fell to the extreme!
At the same time, the feelings of the pet’s perception were also transmitted to the Beast Tamer himself. Xia Qingwei, who originally wanted to see the power of the Imaginary Butterfly, had a sudden change in expression. Her heart started to pound violently, as if she was quickly falling into a bottomless ice abyss. Her whole body was quickly enveloped by darkness and coldness.
In a short encounter between the two pets, the Ice Phoenix Moth’s mind trembled, and it felt like it couldn’t defeat the other party, or even attack.
The terrifying pressure of the Butterfly of Imagination made it unable to breathe. Just like during the Butterfly Meeting, it couldn’t be at the same height as the other party.
This was Buggy’s domineering aura!
Unknowingly, in just a few seconds, cold sweat broke out all over Xia Qingwei’s body. Her limbs were a little stiff, and her breathing became rapid. Clearly, she was too deeply affected by the pet’s fear.
“Do you understand?” Shi Yu continued, “My Butterfly of Imagination has mastered the Perfect Level Deterrence Skill. Even if the opponent isn’t an insect, it’s very difficult to have the courage to fight it. Moreover… your Ice Phoenix Moth is also an insect-type pet.”
“Only a monarch-level butterfly with a qualitative change in mental strength and a deterrence skill can fight it normally.”
Xia Qingwei’s expression was pale.
Legend Hua glanced at her. As expected, this girl didn’t realize that at the Butterfly Transformation Conference, the Green Silkworm cocoon split the sky and triggered all the origins of the spatial cracks because of the perfect level of deterrence that was comparable to the might of a dragon that could cause physical destruction in reality…
To be honest, even for her, only one pet had mastered such a level of deterrence.
It was impossible for anyone to defeat Shi Yu in the domain of a high-level Beast Tamer.
Worms didn’t have the deterrence skill in the first place, and they didn’t even have the right to stand in front of Shi Yu and the others.
The current Shi Yu was already invincible below master and monarch.
In fact, Shi Yu had long known that this would be the outcome. The current Buggy, a middle-level overlord race, was actually only at the surface level. After all, it also had full-level Psychic power, full-level Illusory Phantom, full-level spatial shackles… Even if it didn’t use super skills, it was still a complete crushing advantage for pets of the same level.
It could be said that Buggy’s current actual battle power was also that of a pseudo monarch. In fact, it wasn’t the kind to resist. If it could carry level-seven equipment like Dragon Whiskers and Dragon Scales, it even had a chance of defeating some weaker commander ranks of monarch races. Only monarch-level pets with more than a million energy points could make Buggy lose!
“I…” Because the worm didn’t have any real explosive deterrence, Xia Qingwei quickly calmed down. However, her expression was still filled with disbelief. As she looked at Shi Yu, at the blue butterfly that continued to pick flowers with the Little Iron Eating Beast, the Little Ginseng Baby, and the Little Sword Spirit, huge waves rose in her heart.
How was this possible…
Perfect level deterrence?
Was the guy a monster?!
In Xia Qingwei’s eyes, Shi Yu immediately became a mysterious and incomprehensible monster.
“I, I understand.” Xia Qingwei breathed heavily.
Then, Legendary Hua warmly welcomed Xia Qingwei and left her to drink tea. However, because the pet didn’t even have the courage to attack in front of Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination, she also shut herself down with the pet and didn’t talk. The battle couldn’t continue. The silent Xia Qingwei didn’t stay for long either. She bid farewell to Legendary Hua Xiajin and planned to return to Demon Capital.
After Xia Qingwei left, Legend Hua smiled at Shi Yu and the others.
“I thought you guys would play down the strength… Qingwei will probably suffer a huge blow.”
As expected of a member of Bureau 11, Legend Hua thought to himself. He couldn’t be regarded as a normal person his age at all. In fact, in Bureau 11, Shi Yu’s potential at the same time could also be ranked first. It could be said that it was no problem for him to be the Beast Tamer with the greatest potential in Bureau 11. His talent potential was even above that of Lu Qingyi.
Shi Yu was also very helpless. He said, “How can we act like this?”
It was still the fault of the high deterrence skill. This was only a perfect high-level deterrence. If it was a transcendent-level deterrence, it would probably be even more impossible to fight. At that time, the deterrence would probably wrap around a rice grain and rely on a rice grain to scare a bunch of low-level pets to death.
Shi Yu had already thought about it.
When the time came, Eleven would condense a pile of hardening weapons and equipment, wrap them around deterrence, and then let Baby Ginseng create a pile of nutrient fruits to store them. Finally, it would let Buggy seal it with the spatial shackles and materialize a dragon phantom as a guardian. In this way, the “Shiyu Ruins” would be completed. Then, he just needed to die and have some future fateful person discover his ruins.
“No, Qingwei is a very strong girl. After she goes back, she will definitely choose to train harder. By the way, you’re still a university student, so she should choose to fight you in the National League again. Unfortunately, she didn’t inherit her father’s talent. Otherwise, she should have more achievements in battle.”
Shi Yu had almost forgotten that she was the daughter of a legend.
Good heavens, he had already beaten up three legendary children.
Yin Zhengfan, that… Rongguang kid, and Xia Qingwei.
Well, he couldn’t continue like this. Shi Yu was afraid that it would create an alliance of worried fathers that would affect the stability of the world.
…
The next day.
At Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu returned to his base camp from the Divine Capital.
Just as he returned, Ancient Capital University was in chaos.
Miao Dongdong returned before Shi Yu, but he didn’t say anything about Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu’s matter could not be hidden from those who were interested.
The beast-eared girl White Brook, who had obtained the news from Lu Qingyi, as well as the old principal of Ancient Capital University and the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University, Meow, ran over to stop Shi Yu.
White Brook looked like she thought they’d win the national league for sure.
Overlord Gem Cat: Dragon Ball (Cry) Dragon Ball (Cry) My Dragon Ball (Cry)! It was actually the Dragon Ball!
The old principal of Ancient Capital University: Don’t run around in the future. Be good and stay in school. It won’t be good if you bump your head outside!!
Shi Yu didn’t see these people yet, but as soon as he stepped into the school gate, he sensed an ominous feeling that made his scalp tingle. He couldn’t help but stay at the school gate.
“I keep feeling that it will be very troublesome next time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - Second Level of Beauty
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Second Level of Beauty
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the entrance of Ancient Capital University.
Just as he returned, Shi Yu had an ominous feeling.
He stuffed his hands in his pockets and pondered for a moment before saying,
“Buggy, Teleport.”
“Send me back to the dormitory first.”
“Huh?”
Buggy appeared from its concealed state and appeared beside Shi Yu.
After his Instant Transmission proficiency was maxed, Shi Yu became lazier and lazier!
Shi Yu had no choice because it was indeed useful.
“Please.” Shi Yu smiled.
With Buggy’s current strength, it was completely no problem for him to teleport anywhere in the campus of Ancient Capital University.
How much time did this save?
Buggy was equivalent to pretty much half a time element bug.
Well… In the future, when Eleven went to the training facility and Baby Ginseng went to class, it would probably be inevitable for Buggy to fetch them.
Buggy naturally thought of what Shi Yu thought.
It couldn’t help but show a desperate expression. Its mentality had collapsed, but it still had to do the work.
Just as they were about to use their mental power to envelop Shi Yu and teleport him back to the dormitory, a cat quickly showed up.
“Meow!”
Before Shi Yu and the others could react, white light suddenly flashed in front of them. A huge white cat appeared out of thin air and landed gently. Then, it looked at Shi Yu and the others eagerly.
This gem cat’s Instant Transmission proficiency… was probably not low.
Shi Yu and Buggy’s mouths twitched when they saw the gem cat suddenly appear to welcome them.
“That Dragon Ball is actually the dragon ball of a divine dragon?” The gem cat was still eagerly waiting.
It was as if it had accidentally lost something precious.
Shi Yu: “That’s what the Butterfly God said. It should be right… But I still don’t know what race it is.”
“Wu ~” The Worm of Imagination thanked the rich lady meow and the big boss for the evolution materials.
The reason why Buggy could have this day was because of Big Boss Gem Cat.
It would remember this favor. In the future, it would definitely make Baby Ginseng repay ten times over.
“Ah, the Dragon Ball” The gem cat was lost.
“This…” Shi Yu said,” Well, are the gem fruits still enough? Why don’t I get Baby Ginseng to send 500 more someday? ”
On Shi Yu’s side, he still chose to betray the ginseng baby.
500?
The gem cat’s eyes widened.
A dragon ball actually made Shi Yu feel so guilty?
“Meow!”
The gem cat put away its aggrieved expression. It was waiting for this.
It patted the ground, indicating that it was fine.
It didn’t matter if it was a dragon ball or not. There were really not enough gem fruits.
However, creating this thing was very tiring. Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng could only rely on themselves.
“Alright, then you have to spend more effort. This isn’t a small project… The quality can’t be reduced!”
The gem cat started to worry, afraid that Baby Ginseng wouldn’t be able to take it.
It looked at Shi Yu and asked, “Is there still energy in that wood-element energy crystal?”
Shi Yu took a wood-element energy crystal he got from the gem cat. It was almost equivalent to a baby ginseng’s charger.
It was very difficult for it to create a high-quality nutrition fruit. After all, it was a top-notch spiritual fruit that could increase evolution potential and vitality. It was even more tiring than fighting. Without a Charging Treasure, it was impossible to maintain perfectly with recovery skills.
“It’s almost gone.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“It won’t cut corners. However, it’s indeed a little difficult for it to create nutritional fruits now. It’ll probably take a long time to hand in 500. However, if Baby Ginseng can also evolve like the worm, it might be much easier. We already have an idea now, we’re just short of evolution materials.”
Shi Yu was practically wagging his tail.
High level mind games.
Gem Cat:???
Did this kid think it was stupid?
After circling around for so long, he was here to obtain new evolution materials?
“Meow.”
The gem cat fell into deep thought. However, it wasn’t impossible.
The level of the ginseng baby was too low. Even if the quality of the gem fruits it created was very high, the amount was not enough, and it was not satisfying.
For it, it was equivalent to saying that a food was very delicious, but it could only eat one mouthful and was not full at all.
“Then go take a look when you have time.” It rubbed its dizzy head.
Nurturing a chef was also for the sake of a better future.
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and looked away. It wasn’t that he was selling out ginseng baby, but it was already a mature pet. It was time for it to work and earn evolution materials.
…
He could go to the Gem Cat’s warehouse and the Ancient Capital University’s Resource Chamber to choose resources later!
Shi Yu was very excited. Buggy was happy for Baby Ginseng, and Baby Ginseng was in pain and also happy.
Previously, Shi Yu had only paid attention to the insect evolution materials and not much else.
He had to take a closer look this time.
Before that, Shi Yu continued what he had just done and made Buggy teleport itself into the dormitory.
After returning, he immediately lay on the sofa.
However, before Shi Yu could sit up, there was a knock on the dormitory door.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Buggy, open the door.”
Opening the door with mental strength was easier than letting Eleven and Baby Ginseng open the door.
Including doing housework, it was also very convenient. Buggy controlled multiple cleaning tools at the same time with Psychic power. It was very efficient.
Now, Buggy was already the strongest in the team, fully deserving of the number one spot in life.
Buggy cried: (╥╯^╰╥)
After returning this time, Buggy kept feeling that Shi Yu didn’t love it that much anymore.
It wasn’t like when it was in its cocoon state, carefully protecting it.
Instead, it instructed it more than Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
Logically speaking, shouldn’t Shi Yu feed it now that it had become stronger?
As expected, there was no such thing as love for no reason. It was time to slowly repay the pleasure he received when he was in the cocoon.
“Wu…” Looking at Baby Ginseng, who was eating a basin of milk ice cream, drinking an ice soda, and Little Chi Tong, who was holding an ice cube, Buggy, who was just about to drink fruit juice, could only put down the fruit juice and use its psychic power to open the door.
There were two people outside.
One was the president of the battle club, Beast-eared Lady White Brook.
One was the old principal of Ancient Capital University who had been living in the background.
“Grandpa Feng, why are you here too?” White Brook ran over to find Shi Yu. When she encountered the old principal, she was very surprised.
“Can’t I come?” The old principal chuckled and touched his white beard.
“You can, you can.” White Brook gently hammered her head and smiled.
“Are you looking for Shi Yu for something? Why don’t I leave first and come find him later?”
“It’s alright, I’ll leave after chatting a little. It’s nothing serious. Let’s go in together.”
As the two of them spoke, the door opened directly.
But when the two of them looked, no one was at the door at all. The door seemed to have opened automatically.
“Please come in!!” However, a high shout quickly came from inside.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already gotten down from the sofa. He put on his shoes and walked over to welcome them.
When Shi Yu saw the two people at the door, he was stunned.
White Brook… The other was the old principal of Ancient Capital University?
Shi Yu was not surprised that Senior White Brook had come. This was common, but why did this legendary old principal of Ancient Capital University suddenly come?
“Senior Brook, Principal Feng.”
“Buggy, wash fruits and make tea.”
Shi Yu quickly welcomed the two of them.
A moment later, the three of them sat down. Shi Yu asked, “Principal Feng, Senior Brook… May I help you?”
White Brook waved her hand and smiled. “I’m fine.”
Shi Yu looked at Principal Feng.
Principal Feng laughed and said, “It’s not a big deal either. I just keep hearing Qingyi mention you. In addition to the incident at the Butterfly Meeting, I finally couldn’t help but come over to meet you.”
As the old principal finished speaking, Buggy had already controlled the tea and juice to fly over. Eleven also carried a few bottles of milk, while Baby Ginseng raised two bottles of soda and sent them over.
It prepared a bit of everything since it didn’t know what they liked.
“Is this the Butterfly of Imagination? It’s much prettier than in the photos,” White Brook said with envy.
Girls still liked pretty things.
Unfortunately, the butterfly’s body was too weak. White Brook preferred fist to fist, and she didn’t like to be a mage or assassin through the Fusion Talent.
“It’s indeed a very beautiful race.” Principal Feng nodded.
“But because of this, Shi Yu, you have to be careful outside.”
The old principal looked at Shi Yu. The Sword Spirit of a high-level overlord race and the Medium-level overlord race, the Butterfly of Imagination. Moreover, Beast Tamers and pets were still very weak. In such a situation, even their own people would probably have some crooked thoughts.
Just the identity of Bureau 11 was not enough to deter some crazy people who could even throw their lives away.
“I understand. I’ll take note.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Even I’m envious. The overlord race… others will definitely be even more envious.” White Brook looked on helplessly. The pets of her highest race were only quasi overlord races.
It was her six-tailed Light Fox. It had already evolved into a nine-tailed Light Fox and replaced the previous White Tiger pet, becoming her current highest priority fusion target.
The Nine-tailed Race, such a powerful pet, was still a little inferior to the overlord race. Shi Yu was simply too lucky to have contracted an overlord race.
“Haha, thankfully, the country is still very stable now. If it weren’t for more than ten years ago, when such big news was made, it would probably be very difficult to have peace.” The old principal of Ancient Capital University laughed.
“More than ten years ago?”
Shi Yu had actually always felt that Dong Huang’s culture was pretty good. This was too rare for a high-level martial arts fantasy world.
“Well, more than ten years ago, Dong Huang wasn’t so stable. There were many protective umbrellas of various foreign tribes, underground organizations, and evil forces. At that time, if any Beast Tamer without a background was very lucky to contract a special mutated pet, the greatest possibility for him to wait was that the contract was forced to be broken and the pet was taken away. Then, the Beast Tamer himself mysteriously disappeared…”
“The current stability is the result of a long period of blacklisting and eradicating evil.” Principal Feng didn’t have any taboo and told Shi Yu about the situation before Dong Huang.
“I know this,” White Brook said. “I even heard from my grandfather that there was a legendary Beast Tamer in the totem area. It was because his pet was stolen when he was young and he was framed instead. Then, his family was destroyed. In the end, only he was lucky enough to escape to the totem area. In the end, he became Dong Huang’s enemy… Although justice came later and that financial group was uprooted, he still didn’t choose to return.”
“Sigh, there was indeed such a thing.” Principal Feng sighed. Because of this kind of thing, Dong Huang lost a genius with legendary potential for nothing. This kind of financial group was really detestable. They couldn’t forcefully buy it, so they framed it and destroyed others’ futures and their whole family. At that time, the law wasn’t perfect either. In the end, it created a huge enemy for Dong Huang.
“I’ll be careful.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. They were really scaring him. He just wanted to happily train a pet and happily crack a ruin. He mustn’t encounter such a bad thing.
“Therefore, before becoming a master-level Beast Tamer, it’s better not to run around. Even if it’s a ruin that might be dangerous, don’t go for the time being. Stay in the school first.” Principal Feng smiled.
Shi Yu’s current potential was too great. He had to protect it well.
“No, Senior Bai even called me to participate in the exchange activity in the capital, to participate in the martial arts conference, to participate in the national competition, to…”
White Brook: “?”
Principal Feng looked at White Brook.
“Cough, it’s not a big problem in such a formal public competition,” Principal Feng said. “It’s mainly to not go to dangerous places. Without enough bodyguards and strength, don’t think about some unsolved ruins.”
“Don’t repeat my mistake at such a young age.”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. The past?
Beside him, Senior White Brook’s expression changed slightly. She clearly knew something.
Principal Feng chuckled and said, “You still don’t know, right? I’m also a member of that place.”
Shi Yu did not react for a moment.
“Bureau 11?” Shi Yu said in surprise a moment later.
“Yes.” The old principal chuckled.
Shi Yu was very shocked. “Why didn’t Senior Lu tell me…”
Speaking of which, he was still confused about the members of Bureau 11. He had to ask Senior Lu about it someday.
“Haha, I didn’t ask her to say it.”
“I haven’t used that identity for a long time. I left the archeology field very early, so at the moment, it’s just Bureau 11.”
“Back then, I was also an archeologist and a legendary Beast Tamer. I contracted an overlord-level pet. However, during an exploration of the ruins, I encountered danger. The overlord battle pet died, and my vitality was greatly injured. Since then, after losing a close friend who grew up with me, I withdrew from the archeological field. Sometimes, exploring the unknown is important, but other things are also important.”
With the death of the overlord-level battle pet, and him not in the mood to cultivate, the old principal of Ancient Capital University became a false legend who had a level-seven Beast Taming Space but no overlord-level battle power. In the country, there were many figures like the old principal of Ancient Capital University, but this was the first time Shi Yu knew about Principal Feng’s past.
“This… I understand.” Shi Yu understood. Principal Feng hoped that he wouldn’t be like him before he was strong enough. If anything really happened, it would be too late to regret it.
Shi Yu imagined that if Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets had an accident because of him because he wanted to explore the ruins, he would probably be like Principal Feng and not want to come into contact with these things anymore.
White Brook poked Shi Yu and said, “I’ll tell you secretly. Grandpa Feng is still Senior Lu’s grandfather.”
Shi Yu:!!!!
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and looked at the smiling Principal Feng. He was shocked. He didn’t expect there to be such a relationship.
He became much more reserved.
“You little girl, this is no longer a secret, but a conspiracy,” Principal Feng said.
“Hehe.” White Brook smiled.
“Are you also a special telepathy talent?” Shi Yu asked Principal Feng. He vaguely remembered that Senior Lu had said that Eleven, including him, had this talent.
“Yes.” Principal Feng nodded and said, “But after that accident, this talent was never activated again, but it doesn’t matter. Bureau 11 is full of bad things. I’m currently working in the first and eighth bureaus. My retirement days are much more comfortable than back then.”
Shi Yu: “?”
First round? Eighth round?
“One person can join three departments?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned. What the hell?
Didn’t the members of Division 13 represent special talents in thirteen different domains?
Principal Feng chuckled and said, “There’s nothing wrong with that. In the eighth one, I’m in charge of domestic education. I’m in charge of digging, guiding, and teaching geniuses with potential. I’m in charge of archeological education now, so why not? At least, under my lead, Ancient Capital University became the number one archaeological Department in the country. I also raised Qingyi. You were discovered by Qingyi, and I dug you up.”
“Who said a person can’t get several salaries at the same time?”
“…” Shi Yu was actually speechless for a moment.
So casual?
He suddenly understood why Senior Lu had never explored any dangerous ruins before graduation from university. With such a stable grandfather, before she had master-level strength, even Principal Feng was worried about her exploring dangerous ruins.
“Then when I develop any special feed results, can I join another Bureau?”
Shi Yu muttered. The evolution method of the iron-eating beast overlord race, the evolution method of the green cocoon, and a bunch of skill teaching manuals. It shouldn’t be wrong to say that he was a special talent in the feeding field, right?
