The Thirteen Bureau of Dong Huang should be spread across many fields such as feed, medical care, education, business, intelligence, strategy. The Feeding Department definitely had them.
“Research feeding?!! Archeology is the foundation of Ancient Capital University!” The old principal of Ancient Capital University widened his eyes. It was fine if it was just supplementary battle research, but Shi Yu wanted to research about feeding?
How could a person have so much energy?
What was Shi Yu thinking? He had the amazing talent to listen to history, and he didn’t specialize in archeology and instead went to study feeding?
It was impossible to develop any results.
The Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University was the same as the Battle Department. They were both more lousy.
“I understand, I understand.” Shi Yu didn’t lower himself to the old principal’s level. However, he had a cheat, so he’d secretly do it anyway.
“The third bureau of the Feeding Domain is boring. It’s worse than Bureau 11. Don’t think too much,” Principal Feng said.
“Principal Feng, what’s the overall combat power of the Beast Tamers of Bureau 11 in Division 13?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask when he finally met someone who understood.
“Third.” Without needing Principal Feng to answer, White Brook beside him rushed to answer. “As everyone knows, the Beast Tamers of the archaeology Department… have very fierce battle power.”
“There are two more who are stronger than the Beast Tamers of Bureau 11?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Well…” Principal Feng thought carefully. Indeed, as White Brook said, there were only two people whose combined battle power could steadily suppress Bureau 11.
“If Bureau 11 can be ranked third, the second should be the fourth bureau. The first should be the first bureau.”
“The members of the fourth are all made up of the most talented Mechanics. The overlord-level battleships in the country were all created by them, and they’re in charge of many other cutting-edge technologies.”
“The fourth is indeed very strong, and their strongest point is that they can quickly create some legendary Beast Tamers for Dong Huang. There are many Beast Tamers in the country whose Beast Taming Space has reached level seven, but they can’t nurture overlord-level pets. In battle, if everyone is militarized, everyone will be assigned an overlord-level mechanical life…”
Principal Feng had a playful expression. In the past ten years, most of Dong Huang’s funds had been invested in the development of mechanical technology. Now, it was difficult for him to determine how many overlord-level mechanical lives were hidden in Dong Huang. The number announced by the Strategic Bureau to the other races definitely couldn’t be taken seriously, but without a doubt, the fourth could steadily suppress Bureau 11. They were the true defense force.
“The overall battle power in the first bureau is still above the fourth bureau?? Wait, Principal Feng, you just said that you’re still in the first bureau?” Shi Yu suddenly discovered a blind spot!
Shi Yu really couldn’t imagine what department was stronger than the mechanics.
Could it be a department formed by the Titled Legends in the country?
No, then Principal Feng didn’t have the right to enter.
Moreover, if he remembered correctly, the 13 divisions didn’t include the battle department. They were all departments in special domains. Beast Taming battles were mainstream, while Division 13 was considered a branch domain.
“The first round is more secretive. There are fewer people who know about it than those who know about Bureau 11.”
Principal Feng touched his beard and said, “A batch of Beast Tamers with the greatest talent in making friends has gathered in this bureau!”
Shi Yu: “?”
“You have to know that there are many guardian-level creatures close to humans sleeping in the country. Although no one contracted them, they must have chosen to stay in Dong Huang because of some ‘bonds’. There is a group of people who can communicate with them and ask them to attack. In the first bureau, a group of special people gathered. To a certain extent, they can communicate with the guardians and ask them to attack when the country is in danger.”
“They might be legends, ordinary people, or descendants of ancient heroes… It’s all possible.”
“Now, do you know why the overall battle power in the first round is the strongest? Because the guardians of Dong Huang’s land are also included. If Dong Huang and the totem clans fight again, they will also be the absolute main force.”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and felt that it was unreasonable, but he couldn’t refute it. This bureau, this bureau… was f*cking ridiculous.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was the strongest?
It wasn’t appropriate to call it diplomacy. Internal contact…?
PY Bureau?
If he could make friends with a guardian and cozy up to the guardian, he could enter the first bureau?
For a moment, Shi Yu wanted to curse, but he couldn’t.
Damn, he couldn’t communicate with the butterfly god at all previously and make friends.
Because the surprise brought by the Butterfly of Imagination and the scale for the Dragon Palace City was too big, even the worm-element nutrient fruit that Baby Ginseng studied didn’t cross their mind. They could’ve given it to the Butterfly God. It was mainly because the Butterfly God chased people away too quickly.
It was not a big problem… Dragon Palace City, they had Dragon Palace City!
However, would Dragon Palace City be in danger? Shi Yu was momentarily conflicted.
“Alright…” After a moment of silence, Shi Yu glanced at Senior White Brook.
How does she know so much? Which bureau were her parents from?
Considering that White Brook could have such a good relationship with Senior Lu and even had a ruin space with her, he estimated that Senior White Brook’s family background was definitely very terrifying.
“Let’s end the conversation here today.” Principal Feng laughed and said, “I’ve finished what I needed to say. I should leave too. The two of you can continue chatting.”
“Aren’t you staying a little longer?” Shi Yu asked.
Principal Feng shook his head and said, “No… Uh, wait, I think I really forgot something.”
He looked at Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy, who were standing in a row in front of the wall and listening to their conversation, and fell into deep thought.
“I’ve only heard that your transformation is very magical and that you have the strength of the Butterfly of Imagination. I’m a little curious about the strength of the Nine Li Battle Beast. I want to see your current strength. Do you have a chance?”
“I also came here to spar with Junior Shi Yu. Sword Spirit! Butterfly of Imagination!” White Brook’s eyes lit up. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “How about I Possess the Nine-Tailed Fox and fight you?”
Shi Yu: “?”
Her Nine-tailed Fox’s energy level is more than ten times that of Buggy… What fight would that be?
“If you possess a commander-level pet. I’ll fight you,” Shi Yu said.
White Brook: “???”
Principal Feng laughed and suddenly thought of something. “Is your Beast Taming Space already level four?”
Shi Yu was stunned. “How do you know?”
“I sensed it, it’s just experience. But you probably haven’t undergone the high-level Beast Tamer assessment yet, right? High-level Beast Tamers require Beast Tamers to have commander-level battle power. Why don’t I call Master Qu Jie from the association to battle you with the sealing power? I’ll take it as an advancement assessment.”
“Good idea.” White Brook nodded.
“…” Shi Yu’s expression was strange.. It was very strange, especially strange. It was Master Qu Jie again?

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - Shi Yus Dragon Army
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Shi Yu’s Dragon Army
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Master Qu Jie…
Shi Yu didn’t know what to say.
Last time, when Eleven had just finished evolving, Dean Hao contacted Master Qu Jie and helped him carry out the Intermediate Beast Tamer assessment. The audience was the panda father and daughter.
This time, after Buggy finished evolving, Principal Feng seemed to also want to contact Master Qu Jie to help him carry out the high-level Beast Tamer assessment?
Seriously…
“It’s not impossible.”
Shi Yu said, “I indeed haven’t carried out the high-level assessment.”
Although Master Qu Jie didn’t seem very happy the last time, he was in this line of work. Shi Yu and the others were also taking care of him.
“Haha, alright then. I’ll contact Qu Jie now.”
Principal Feng took out his cell phone and immediately dialed.
…
At the assessment venue of the Beast Tamer Association of Ancient Capital.
The in-charge, Master Qu Jie, unexpectedly received a call again.
“Principal Feng, what’s the matter?”
Principal Feng’s level was much higher than Dean Hao’s.
Although he had already retired, he was also a legendary figure in the ancient capital back then. He was a senior.
“Haha, Master Qu, I have a student here who plans to undergo the high-level Beast Tamer assessment. Are you free?”
“Of course. Come, I’ll take the assessment personally…”
Master Qu Jie still thought that it was something big.
Sigh, was that all?
Simple!
Principal Feng called him personally. Which student was so impressive?
Eh?
He frowned and realized that things weren’t simple.
However, he felt that he was overthinking.
“Principal Feng, may I ask, which student is it?”
“You know this person. He’s the top scholar of our batch’s vocation assessment, Shi Yu.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Master Qu Jie was stunned on the spot.
Holy shit.
Shi Yu?
Why did this kid increase two levels in four months?
Even if he kept taking medicine, it couldn’t be that fierce, right?
“Then I’ll hang up first. We’ll go over now,” Principal Feng said.
“Ah…” Master Qu Jie was just about to say something when the other party had already gotten up.
…
A moment later, the Beast Tamer Association.
The corners of Master Qu Jie’s mouth twitched as he stood outside to welcome Shi Yu and the others.
He looked at Principal Feng and the president of the Battle Club of Ancient Capital University, White Brook, who came together and immediately understood. They didn’t come with good intentions.
The last time he came, it was also a big battle.
Why was there such a big scene for a serious person to come to the assessment?
“Principal Feng, Student White Brook, Student Shi Yu.”
Master Qu Jie looked at the three of them with a stomach ache.
“Master Qu Jie, long time no see,” the few of them greeted.
Master Qu Jie was silent for a moment before saying, “Actually, I was the one who gave Student Shi Yu the assessment last time.”
Principal Feng and White Brook were stunned. They looked at Shi Yu. There was such a thing?
They wouldn’t have paid attention to Shi Yu’s intermediate assessment either. They really didn’t know.
“Student Shi Yu performed very well last time.”
“Although the intermediate assessment only requires the pet to last a few minutes in the hands of a commander-level battle power, with Student Shi Yu’s strength at that time, defeating ordinary commander-level battle power was not a problem.”
“So I’ve considered it. There’s no need for the high-level assessment. I’ve already prepared the high-level certificate.” Master Qu Jie took out his identification.
The three of them:???
“This is against the rules…” White Brook said.
“Rules are all set by humans. As long as the standard is met, formalism is the most unnecessary,” Master Qu Jie explained.
“That’s true.” Principal Feng nodded.
Master Qu Jie chuckled. The old senior was still reasonable.
Principal Feng said, “Then don’t follow the rules. But since you’re already here, seal the pet’s energy level to 200,000. Fight Shi Yu with the lowest monarch-level standard. It’s just nice to test his current strength.”
Master Qu Jie was stunned.
Fight?
“This…” White Brook was also stunned.
Therefore, was it a high-level Beast Tamer assessment or a master-level assessment?
“200,000, for real?”
Master Qu Jie was stunned.
However, after careful consideration, if it was 200,000, he could beat Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s abnormal Nine Li Battle Beast only had less than 100,000 energy points three months ago.
Even if Shi Yu broke through, his pet definitely couldn’t break through with him.
If that Nine Li Battle Beast surpassed Shi Yu by another level and reached the monarch level, he definitely wouldn’t believe it.
No matter how good the physique of a high-level Beast Tamer was, it was impossible for them to control a monarch-level pet. The strength of the pet became greater the further it went. It was also because of this that the higher the level of the Beast Tamer, the harder it was to increase.
Therefore, the greatest possibility was that the Nine Li War Beast still had about 100,000 energy points.
Two times the energy difference!
Even if Shi Yu’s Nine Li Battle Beast’s skill proficiency was very high, that was fine. This was because his pet skill proficiency was not low either. He couldn’t widen the gap much. This time, as long as he arranged his battle tactics appropriately…
“It’s not impossible, right?” Master Qu Jie nodded.
“But 200,000 is indeed a little high. 4VS1. Shi Yu can send four pets. Master Qu Jie, you have one. This is according to the standard,” Principal Feng thought again and added.
He wanted to see the strength of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit possessing Shi Yu and Shi Yu’s new pet, the Butterfly of Imagination. 1VS1 was definitely not enough.
“Sure.” Master Qu Jie felt that there was no problem. This was more reasonable. Otherwise, it would be a little bullying.
“Student Shi Yu, your pets are all commander rank, right?” Just in case, Master Qu Jie asked.
“Three commander ranks and one transcendent,” Shi Yu said.
“Oh, oh, not bad. You’ve improved very quickly.” Master Qu Jie smiled. It looked like he was overthinking.
…
After confirming that it was a different form of assessment, the few of them arrived at the specialized examination hall.
As he walked, Master Qu Jie communicated with the Ox-Headed Beast King telepathically.
“Old Bull, come to the assessment. This time, your chance to show off your might is here!”
“It’s still that Shi Yu, but this time, you have a 200,000 energy limit!”
“You definitely won’t fail this time. It’s a battle to wash away your humiliation.”
Ox-Headed Beast King:?
“Roar!!!”
In the examination hall, Master Qu Jie summoned his pet as he walked.
In the arena, a dark red flame formed, and the phantom of a huge bull-headed monster nearly four meters tall appeared.
“It’s still the Ox-Headed Beast King?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he saw his opponent.
They were old friends.
“Roar!!” However, the Ox-Headed Beast King looked at Shi Yu with a rather unfriendly expression.
Hehe, your Grandpa Cow had 200,000 energy points this time!
It could relax a little and fight. Who else was there?
In front of Shi Yu, the energy value of the Ox-Headed Beast King had indeed been sealed by Master Qu Jie to “200001”.
“Summon your pets,” Master Qu Jie said with a smile.
“Alright.”
Shi Yu took a deep breath and started to summon his pet.
Hu hu hu ~
As Shi Yu began to summon his pet, a breeze blew.
The summoning array turned into a spatial ripple. A huge butterfly more than three meters tall with a body mainly blue and white came out. With watery blue compound eyes and a pair of gorgeous blue wings, whose wings were covered in bright white patterns, it slowly flew out of the spatial ripple.
After the Butterfly of Imagination appeared, it quietly stared at its opponent. As the overlord butterfly, its aura involuntarily emitted, its aura extremely intimidating!
Boom!
The overlord aura swept past, making Master Qu Jie’s hair and the tuft of red hair of the Ox-Headed Beast King sway slightly.
At this moment, when he saw the Butterfly of Imagination, Master Qu Jie was first stunned. Then, after careful observation, his pupils constricted slightly.
He opened his mouth wide and suddenly raised his hand. He pointed opposite and trembled slightly.
The powerful aura of the Butterfly of Imagination caused the baby ginseng on the ground beside it and the little sword spirit floating in the air to not be noticed at all. The limelight was all snatched away by the worm.
“This is!!”
Upon seeing this butterfly, Master Qu Jie opened his mouth wide and looked at Shi Yu in shock. He looked at Principal Feng in the audience.
F*ck!
Wasn’t this the newly announced overlord species pet, the Butterfly of Imagination?!
Damn, why was it here!
Master Qu Jie was stunned.
“That Imagination Butterfly in the Butterfly Meeting is your pet?!!”
Master Qu Jie looked at Shi Yu in shock.
In fact, not many Beast Tamers knew that the Butterfly of Imagination was Shi Yu’s pet at the moment. At the moment, only some core members of the associations related to this incident knew.
A legendary Beast Tamer might be able to find out if he wanted to investigate, but even a top-notch master like Master Qu Jie wouldn’t know the truth so easily if he didn’t have channels.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu smiled.
Master Qu Jie looked at Shi Yu’s lineup in confusion. Indeed, during the last assessment, only Baby Ginseng and the green silkworm, who were eating melons and were unable to interfere in the battle, were left. As for that green silkworm… it had already evolved into the butterfly of imagination in front of him?
Holy shit.
Master Qu Jie was stunned. Mid-level overlord race, commander-level Butterfly of Imagination?
He suddenly felt that the battle this time was not that stable.
After all, even that exaggerated Nine Li War Beast had yet to reach the overlord race!
And his Ox-Headed Beast King was only a low-level monarch race, much lower than the Butterfly of Imagination!
What a scam.
Also, he quickly looked at the little sword spirit. This was a sword-type undead?
The sword spirit was a large-type pet. If a new race didn’t form on a large scale, its race level would be difficult to determine. Master Qu Jie fell silent.
On his side, there was completely insufficient information!
“Where’s your Iron-eating Beast?” Master Qu Jie asked again. He felt troubled. Beside him, the Ox-Headed Beast King’s face also fell. It had a bad feeling.
His Beast Tamer didn’t seem to be reliable…
Shi Yu said, “Here.”
Little Eleven crawled out of Shi Yu’s pocket and onto his shoulder.
“Alright…” Seeing that Shi Yu’s four pets were all here, a drop of sweat appeared on Master Qu Jie’s forehead. He suddenly regretted taking this assessment.
Who knew that Shi Yu would have another overlord pet!
However, it wasn’t a big problem…
He believed in the Ox-Headed Beast King.
Butterfly-type pets had a classic lack of defense, which meant that their vitality was not high, their stamina was low, and their energy levels were low. The Ox-Headed Beast King still had an advantage.
In other words, apart from the number advantage of super skills and the spatial advantage, this butterfly was not as powerful as that Nine Li War Beast…
“You guys attack first.”
Master Qu Jie said seriously.
At the same time, he and the Ox-Headed Beast King focused.
“Master Qu Jie, because I haven’t really sent them to a real fight together, you have to trouble yourself a little.”
Shi Yu didn’t know if he could defeat an opponent with 200,000 energy points and a high skill proficiency, but whether he could defeat him or not, Master Qu Jie had to adapt to the situation.
In theory, it was still the first time everyone fought side by side after Little Chi Tong broke through, after his own breakthrough, and after his possession was also increased!
“Then let me see your strength.” Master Qu Jie expressed that there was no problem. “Don’t have any worries.”
Three commander ranks and one transcendent rank. He believed that he could still deal with it, but it might be troublesome…
Shi Yu stood in the arena and immediately said, “Then I’ll start!”
Spatial shackles!!
He directly let Buggy use the transcendent high-level spatial skill, spatial shackles!
Stunning the enemy before the team battle was the foundation!
Boom!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the gaze of the Butterfly Insect in the sky flashed slightly. Almost instantly, an incomparable pressure appeared around the Ox-Headed Beast King, making its expression change drastically. Master Qu Jie’s expression also changed drastically.
Because the Butterfly of Imagination was too fast, so fast that even if they had experienced hundreds of battles, they almost couldn’t react.
A transcendent-level spatial skill… was almost equivalent to instant cast.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, red flames erupted from the Ox-Headed Beast King’s body. With a roar, it raised its battle ax and directly slashed across the sky.
The huge ax burned with flames, and the surrounding heat wave began to sway. A transcendent Flaming Ax attack directly turned into a shock wave and flew towards the Butterfly of Imagination. At this moment, Master Qu Jie and the Ox-Headed Beast King realized what skill the Butterfly of Imagination had used just now.
Spatial shackles!!
Bang!
The Ox-Headed Beast King’s Flaming Ax phantom didn’t fly far before exploding into thin air, as if it had come into contact with some invisible wall.
At this moment, the full appearance of the spatial shackles gradually became clear after being attacked. A transparent huge semicircular domain directly enveloped the Ox-Headed Beast King and sealed it.
The spatial domain constantly produced ripples, but even though it suffered a huge impact, it quickly recovered its calm and was actually fine.
A transcendent mid-level skill was used by a pet that had reached the lowest standard of the monarch level. It actually… couldn’t break the spatial shackles of a commander-level pet!
“How is that possible!” Master Qu Jie immediately widened his eyes.
“Roar!”
The Ox-Headed Beast King also stopped thinking.
“This spatial shackle…”
Principal Feng and White Brook’s pupils also constricted.
This spatial strength was a little ridiculous…
Although the current Ox-Headed Beast King was only at the standard of the transcendent monarch race, it had at least reached the threshold of the monarch level. Moreover, it had mastered a transcendent intermediate-level skill. Its energy efficiency was definitely not low. That 200,000 energy points, combined with the transcendent intermediate-level skill, was an absolute crush for commander-level pets.
However, the Butterfly of Imagination was so easily stunning?
“Unbelievable, much stronger than I imagined,” Principal Feng muttered. A middle-level overlord race could have this strength?
No, it wasn’t that the middle-level overlord race was very strong, but that this Butterfly of Imagination was very strong!!
At the moment, only Shi Yu knew what was going on. After all… Buggy used a transcendent high-level skill. Moreover, it was a powerful spatial skill. Moreover, its energy value was less than 60,000 lower than the other party. The difference was far from that big.
It wasn’t that the other party couldn’t break through the spatial shackles, but it probably had to use super skills or combination skills. However, Shi Yu clearly wouldn’t wait for the other party to directly break through the spatial shackles!
He didn’t let the worm cause spatial fluctuations any further to attack. Instead, he chose to let it strengthen the strength of the shackles. He took a deep breath and planned to charge the attacker!
“Flame Bath Battle Soul, Raging Flame Charge, Horn of Fire!”
On the other side, Master Qu Jie gritted his teeth and smiled. He decided not to let this little monster, Shi Yu, underestimate him.
In any case, Shi Yu had already touched most of his baseline the last time. In that case, he would fight with all his might.
The proficient level Flame Bath Battle Soul increased all-round attributes. The transcendent level Flame Charge increased explosive power, the transcendent level Flame Horn penetrated space, and with the absolute advantage of 200,000 energy points as the foundation…
Boom!
The Ox-Headed Beast King exploded as its muscles increased.
It charged at the spatial shackles.
However, at this moment, Master Qu Jie accidentally observed the other side and Shi Yu’s actions…
He couldn’t help but be stunned.
On the other side, under the breeze, Shi Yu’s red cloak fluttered in the wind.
He stretched out his hand, and a large amount of black matter appeared out of thin air. Soon, a black sword condensed in Shi Yu’s hand.
At the same time that Shi Yu swung it gently, Little Chi Tong quickly turned into a red light beside him and merged into Shi Yu’s body to possess him!
At the same time, Eleven, who was standing on Shi Yu’s shoulder, evolved in a posture of about 0.3 meters. It entered the sharp mode and erupted with hardening and lightning power armor all over Shi Yu’s body.
Buzz!
In the next moment, the hardening sword in Shi Yu’s hand was black and red, as if it had just come out of a furnace with lightning lingering around it.
Space seemed to tremble, and the air buzzed.
Shi Yu’s body began to turn blurry and hot. Slowly, the color of Shi Yu’s eyes and hair turned fiery red.
With a boom, countless fire threads condensed. A fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun turned into flames that wrapped around Shi Yu’s entire body!
“Master Qu Jie, you’re very familiar with this state, right? I’ve also done this in the vocation assessment…”
“But now, the equipment has been upgraded…”
Gulp.
Seeing Shi Yu’s change, Master Qu Jie was stunned again. He suddenly realized that something was wrong, and his gaze exploded.
What was this? What was this? A familiar yet unfamiliar style!
At this moment, the Ox-Headed Beast King, which had suddenly attacked the spatial shackles, also suddenly felt that something was wrong. It sensed a terrifying hot aura that was much stronger than the Butterfly of Imagination from Shi Yu’s body. As a fire-element pet, it was very sensitive…
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu ka ka ka!!”
As for White Brook, she was excited.
Principal Feng’s eyes lit up.
This was the Sword Spirit Possession Mode?
In the arena, Buggy sensed Shi Yu’s state and nodded secretly.
It was confident in dealing with Eleven, Shi Yu, and Little Chi Tong alone. However, when Eleven, Shi Yu, and Little Chi Tong combined their strength, the power that erupted was too much even if it went all out.
The Iron-eating Beast Knight combination was too strong.
No, this couldn’t be exclusive to leader. Someday, it would have to materialize an ice dragon and let Shi Yu become a Dragon Knight. This was the correct way for Little Chi Tong’s opening.
Because of this battle, Principal Feng and Senior Bai wanted to see the Butterfly of Imagination and Little Chi Tong attack at the same time. Therefore, Shi Yu could only choose this strategy.
Buggy played support, while he dealt damage!
“Master Qu Jie, we’re making a move.”
Shi Yu slowly raised his black and red longsword and swung it at the Ox-Headed Beast King that had already collided with the spatial shackles.
At this moment, the Ox-Headed Beast King, which had profundities added to its body, shattered the spatial shackles in an instant. However, the moment the spatial shackles shattered, the strong spatial vibration effect directly made it dizzy for an instant.
Buggy was too strong now. Even a support skill had a huge impact on the enemy.
However, what made Master Qu Jie and the Ox-Headed Beast King’s eyes explode was not the Worm’s spatial shackles, but Shi Yu’s sword.
Swoosh!
An incomparably dazzling red light that looked like it was rolling in the thunder clouds quickly shot out.
Boom!
The sword light intertwined with lightning and flames that were about five to six meters tall was like the flickering light of an explosive star, instantly covering everyone’s vision.
With an incomparably terrifying aura and a shocking aura, it rushed over.
The sword light shattered the ground and was incomparably violent. This was an explosive skill with a nearly legendary physique. Under the full-strength hardening armor, it bore the explosive power of multiple skills such as the super skill Interlocking Sword and the super skill Inner Power.
The power of the three parties had a special reaction at this moment. A huge air wave shook the sky and earth. In the air wave, even though Buggy had become so much stronger, it was still shocked. As for Baby Ginseng, it was almost blown away and directly exploded from fright. Fortunately, it stabilized its body with the Earth Chain in time.
As for Principal Feng and White Brook, they were completely stunned. This was because this attack seemed to be enough to break through a stronger monarch!
Not to mention a transcendent race with 200,000 energy points at the monarch level, even a commander race with 500,000 energy points at the monarch level would probably be extremely serious when facing this attack, not daring to take it head-on with their bodies.
The entire examination hall was trembling. On the other side, the Ox-Headed Beast King sensed the suffocating sword aura and its expression changed drastically.
This was an attack that a commander-level opponent could use?
“F*ck.” At that moment, Master Qu Jie was also shocked.
They were shocked by Shi Yu’s transformation and his attack.
It should have been a familiar style, but why was the style of the Iron-eating Beast Knight so different from the vocation assessment!!
This time, it wasn’t the sword light special effect…
And it was… a real sword light! A five or six-meter-long one!!
What exactly had Shi Yu experienced?
The light of the blue lightning and the red flames swallowed the Ox-Headed Beast King almost instantly. Only the Ox-Headed Beast King’s final mental roar was left in Master Qu Jie’s heart.
Stupid Beast Tamer!
It won’t believe him again!
In the future, if the intermediate assessment didn’t allow it a cap of 500,000 energy, and the advanced assessment didn’t allow it more than 1,000,000 energy, it wouldn’t even come out!
Boom!!!
Soon, the Ox-Headed Beast King fell silent. A second ago, it was still fighting against the terrifying interlocking sword that divided the examination hall into two. The next second, the energy leaking from its entire body was instantly obliterated. The battle soul was almost instantly destroyed. It stretched out its limbs weakly and cried out in pain amidst the terrifying wave.
At this moment, Master Qu Jie even forgot to return the power of the Ox-Headed Beast King. It was one thing to bear grudges, but it was another to shock Shi Yu’s explosive power.
“You just became a vocation four months ago. Four months later, you already have the battle power to threaten monarchs.”
Moreover, this was still the strength that the Butterfly of Imagination and the Nine Li Battle Beast had yet to fully erupt!
In the entire battle, apart from creating enough time for Shi Yu and the others to accumulate strength and temporarily control the Ox-Headed Beast King, what else did the Butterfly do? Nothing! As for the Nine Li Battle Beast, it didn’t even release its full strength. It was still in a shrunken state!
Master Qu Jie was extremely shocked.
Four months, professional to master!
This growth speed was simply unimaginable in this era that was not in chaos.
“This, this, this, this…” In the audience, Senior White Brook was also completely stunned. Although she had repeatedly overestimated Shi Yu’s strength, Shi Yu’s performance now made her really not know what to say.
“Isn’t that sword spirit only at the transcendent level??”
Principal Feng looked at her. Although he was also shocked, at least he knew the true potential of that sword spirit. Although it was at the transcendent level, it was the heroic spirit of a high-level overlord race… But even so, wasn’t its strength too terrifying? The huge power was far more shocking than what Lu Qingyi and he had described.
After one slash, the examination hall became ruins!
The only ginseng baby that didn’t participate the entire time condensed a nutrient fruit with tears and ran to give it to Shi Yu. It wanted to become stronger, stronger, stronger!!
He didn’t want to be a medical ginseng anymore!
At this moment, Shi Yu had already recovered his black hair and eyes. He took the nutritional fruit and ate it in one bite.
The reason why Eleven wanted to transmit lightning in the form of a shrunken Nine Li Battle Beast was very simple. If Eleven enlarged to dozens of meters and erupted with lightning, forming an intertwining sword with his strength, he wouldn’t be able to withstand it either.
It would also be the same as in the Heroic Spirit Ruins. It wouldn’t be worth it to be unconscious for a day. Therefore, when Eleven transmitted the lightning, it was best to stop while it was ahead. It was standard for it to reach Shi Yu’s physical limit. Any more and Shi Yu would have to lie down.
“Sorry, its power is a little stronger than I imagined.”
“Master Qu Jie… can you continue…”
Shi Yu looked at the Ox-Headed Beast King, which was still standing strong on the ground in front of him, but was covered in smoke, injuries, and a confused gaze. It spat out black gas and spoke timidly.
Master Qu Jie:???
He was just about to scold Shi Yu and the others for being too abnormal, but when he considered that Principal Feng was also beside him, he couldn’t help but almost cry.
“Why don’t I prepare a master-level license for you too? After you break through in the Beast Taming Space, come and get your master’s license directly. Forget the assessment.”
Stop looking for him!
Principal Feng, White Brook, and Shi Yu were speechless.
This… was against the rules.
…
Next, Shi Yu successfully obtained a high-level license.
Under Master Qu Jie’s curse in his heart, they left the assessment office.
However, although he was cursing in his heart, Master Qu Jie fell into deep thought as he watched Shi Yu and the others leave.
“What a ridiculous little monster.”
“The ridiculous Nine Li Battle Beast, the ridiculous Butterfly of Imagination, and the most ridiculous is… that sword spirit.” Master Qu Jie’s gaze was distant.
Was that the normal power that could erupt from the possession of a transcendent-level sword spirit?
Impossible!
The race level of that sword spirit… Master Qu Jie suspected that it wasn’t even lower than the Butterfly of Imagination!
… If nothing unexpected happened, another legend would appear in the ancient capital in the future.
Yin Legend’s son went to Imperial Capital University in order to surpass Shi Yu. He didn’t know if it was right or wrong…
“I definitely won’t give him the assessment next time. I’m tired,” Master Qu Jie cursed.
After giving Shi Yu two assessments, the small boat that he and the Ox-Headed Beast King had a friendship could be overturned just like that.
“Roar!!!” The Ox-Headed Beast King’s cursing roar also came from Master Qu Jie’s Beast Taming Space.
At the same time.
On the way back to Ancient Capital University, there was silence.
Shi Yu saw that Principal Feng and the beast-eared girl were staring at him and said uncomfortably, “What’s wrong…”
“Nothing, haha.” Principal Feng laughed.
Interesting. The newbie Lu Qingyi discovered was indeed interesting. Now, he was more and more curious about how far Shi Yu could go in the future.
Could it be possible to become the next titled legend of the Dong Huang Ancient Country?
The first titled legendary in Bureau 11?!
Although the battle power of the members of Bureau 11 was generally very high, and there were also Legendary-level Beast Tamers in the Bureau, the telepathy talent was, after all, a telepathy talent. It was really not easy to let a group of overlord-level pets fight against a totem level without the strengthening talent. No matter how high the proficiency of these pets’ skills, how high their race level, or how strong their bloodline was… So what?
There were also a few totems and guardians that weren’t overlord races. There were also a few totems and guardians that didn’t have super strong bloodlines. Their skill proficiency, needless to say, could look down on most overlords just by transcendent-level skills.
“I’m looking forward to the exchange with Imperial Capital University more and more.”
White Brook placed her arm on Shi Yu and said with a smile, “Your strength is too surprising to me. It’s a pity if you don’t do anything during this event. Let me tell you, the mentor of the Beast Tamer from the Imperial Capital University who defeated Senior Lu back then is still in charge of the clubs and school teams in the Imperial Capital University. With your current strength, you’re completely invincible below the master level. No matter what, you have to show off to them.”
Shi Yu: “I’ll fight for it…”
“In half a month, don’t forget!” White Brook suddenly thought of something. Although the Butterfly of Imagination was strong, she didn’t seem to have seen its two super skills. Master Qu Jie was too weak…
Shi Yu chuckled. He couldn’t forget. At this moment, Shi Yu’s phone suddenly rang.
Shi Yu was immediately stunned when he saw it.
After he glanced at Principal Feng, he said, “It’s Senior Li. I’ll take the call.”
“That old woman, Li Lianping?” Principal Feng nodded.
“Hurry up and answer it. She must have something good to tell you. She’s the richest woman in Bureau 11.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu hurriedly picked up the call. This was the first time he had spoken to Senior Li since the last time.
Previously, he wanted to tell the other party about the evolution of the worm, but he couldn’t get through to the other party. He only sent a message.
“Shi Yu.” Senior Li’s laughter came from the other side of the phone.
“Senior Li, I couldn’t get through to you on the phone previously. Did you see that message?”
“I saw it. As expected, it awakened the dream stealing skill.”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu nodded. Buggy’s few skills matched it.
Senior Li said, “It’s not a big deal to call you back this time. It’s mainly because of this dream theft and your previous experience.”
“Since you’ve had the opportunity to enter the Tyrant Dragon fossil dream previously, are you interested in studying it in detail? I feel that with the Illusory Phantom and the Imagination Domain, together with the Thieving Dream and researching the Transformation Stone, there might be some magical results…”
Shi Yu was stunned. “You mean…”
“I have an Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth here. Its energy level is very high, and it also contains a fossil dream. If you’re interested, I’ll give it to you to study or the fossils of other ancient creatures. If you’re interested in studying it, you can tell me what I have here.”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and looked at Principal Feng.
They weren’t lying.
Although Senior Li was old, she was really rich.
The moment he heard the Tyrant Dragon’s teeth, Shi Yu imagined a scene.
In the Imagination Butterfly’s Imagination Domain, there were sea dragons in the ocean that caused tsunamis. In the sky, there were ice dragons that froze the sky.. On the ground, there were Tyrant Dragons roaring. On the sea, on the land, Buggy… No, he had gathered a Dragon Army just like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - Moonlight Ginseng Baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Moonlight Ginseng Baby
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu chatted with Senior Li and felt that he couldn’t disappoint the old woman.
He couldn’t help but say, “I’m interested. I’ve loved researching ancient creatures and ancient fossils since I was young.”
With the phone in hand, Shi Yu was extremely sincere.
Archeology involved classifications. Among them, Shi Yu also had preferences.
He wasn’t very interested in development changes such as clothes, buildings, money, and art.
However, he was still very interested in the paleontological fossil research Senior Li mentioned.
In fact, there was also an “Tyrant Dragon” on Earth, and it was a creature with absolute strength. Its battle power was completely above tigers or lions.
On this blue planet where everything could evolve, the “lions and tigers” could constantly evolve into various commander races, monarch races, and overlord races. Shi Yu was still very curious about the information on the evolution of the Tyrant Dragon.
Of course, what Shi Yu liked to study the most was definitely still those ethereal Mythical histories. Unfortunately, Mythical Ruins were also the most dangerous and forbidden archeological types in the archeological domain of Planet Blue. Without some strength, it was really difficult to get started.
“Alright, I’ll get the people over there to prepare and send the fossil to your school.” Grandma Li smiled in relief.
Such a good young man actually liked fossils.
Shi Yu had already been delayed by this little girl, Lu Qingyi. Research on fossils was the right path!
“Qingyi, you’re still too young. You can’t control Shi Yu. Why don’t you let him try the fossil first?” She muttered to herself.
“Sorry to trouble you,” Shi Yu said.
“I keep feeling that he’s fighting for something.” Beside him, White Brook fell silent when she saw Shi Yu expressing his love for something.
Rich woman…
“Haha.” Principal Feng laughed. Studying fossils was pretty good. As long as it wasn’t excavating fossils in various dangerous places and had already been excavated, it was still quite safe. It was very suitable for a restless university student like Shi Yu.
…
A moment later, Shi Yu and the others returned to Ancient Capital University.
It was getting late. Principal Feng, White Brook, and Shi Yu bid each other farewell.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s face was filled with a smile. This was because Senior Li had said that the Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth was at the Ancient Capital fossil museum. He would get someone to send it to him later.
“Go back to the dormitory and wait for Stone…”
“Eh, forget it. Let’s go to the gem cat to take a look first.”
Shi Yu thought for a moment and looked at Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong.
“It’s your turn, Buggy.”
Transport Butterfly: “…”
A moment later, Shi Yu and the others were teleported to the resource warehouse of Ancient Capital University by Buggy.
He appeared outside the gem cat door without even registering.
As Shi Yu and the others appeared, the changes in mental waves and spatial fluctuations naturally couldn’t be hidden from the gem cat.
It opened its eyes slightly, and its cat hair exploded.
Although it had promised to sponsor the evolution materials for the ginseng baby when Shi Yu had just returned…
However, a day had yet to pass when Shi Yu charged over. This was too fast.
It had yet to delete the public info on its favorite gemstones to hide it from him.
“Good afternoon.”
When Shi Yu greeted outside, Baby Ginseng, Eleven, Little Chi Tong, and Buggy were already standing on the window sill, knocking on the glass.
In the room, the gem cat sighed and let Shi Yu and the others in.
Soon, Shi Yu and the others sat in front of the computer, their faces shining. They gathered around and picked up the materials.
At the side, the gem cat was nervous.
“Baby Ginseng is already a low-level monarch race, so evolution materials have to be at least level-seven materials,” Shi Yu muttered to himself.
The gem cat’s heart skipped a beat.
That being said…
It kept feeling that it was going to lose many treasures again.
“Yes…”
Next, Shi Yu and the others picked. However, the evolution materials of the ginseng baby were really difficult to obtain.
He needed to find resources that were stimulating to wood-element plants in order to produce the mutation power. Those ordinary resources, such as wood-element energy crystals, were impossible.
Shi Yu and the others picked for a long time from the Gem Cat Private Treasure Vault and the Ancient Capital University’s resource bank, but they didn’t find anything suitable.
“Huh?” However, hard work paid off. Shi Yu discovered a special resource in the messy folder of the gem cat.
“This…”
Shi Yu opened the resource information.
[Name]: Moonlight Gem
[Attributes]: Light
[Level]: Level 7
[Introduction]: A gem containing moonlight essence. Moonlight radiation might cause some animals and plants to mutate.
“Teacher Cat, this, this, this…”
Although there was very little introduction, Shi Yu was immediately certain that this was one of the things he was looking for.
“Meow!!!”
However, just as Shi Yu discovered this, the gem cat widened its eyes and said, “This… is dangerous.”
“It’s indeed very dangerous… If I remember correctly, the mixed-blood werewolves in the West relied on this mutation to evolve, right?”
“There’s also a race that once appeared on the seven islands that relied on the moonlight essence to mutate from monkeys to gorillas. They all relied on it.”
The gem cat nodded crazily.
“These are all examples. If you’re not careful, you’ll lose your mind during the mutation evolution process. Although relying on the moonlight essence can indeed increase your battle power more than ten times, it’s too dangerous. It has a very strong stimulation power for plants and animals. At the moment, only a few races can withstand its stimulation power.”
“But aren’t the races that can withstand it the top overlords of nature? Or even totems,” Shi Yu said.
“Moreover, I remember that after humans first boarded the moon with mechanical lives, they also successfully cultivated mutated spiritual plants on the moon. The effect of the spiritual plants improved greatly. Later on, after Dong Huang ascended the moon, we also successfully verified this saying.”
Shi Yu looked at the silent cat.
Dong Huang was the second country to develop Mechanics. The first country had long used Mechanical Life to break through the restrictions of the blue planet and reach the Moon. They even discovered Mythical Ruins on the Moon. Shi Yu remembered all of this.
Unfortunately, the conditions for moon landing were too harsh. It was even harder than killing a totem. Later on, after thinking that the moon didn’t have much exploration value, very few countries were willing to try moon landing.
When Shi Yu was searching for special environments previously, he had considered the Moon, but he definitely gave up after thinking about it… Finding the Moonlight Gem here was purely an accident.
“Perhaps Baby Ginseng can use it too,” Shi Yu said.
Since a pet had already overcome the Moonlight Radiation and completed the mutation evolution, if he raised the mutation skill of the baby ginseng to “transcendent”, there was no reason for the baby ginseng to not be able to withstand the power of the mutation as well.
Ginseng Baby’s Moonlight Evolution, Chang’e(the Lady of the Moon) Baby?
Baby Ginseng nodded crazily.
“Wu…” The gem cat trembled slightly and put it aside dangerously. The key was that it liked this Moonlight Gem very much.
Although it wasn’t very useful anymore, but…
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng looked at the gem cat with tears in its eyes, promising to make moonlight flavored gem fruits in the future.
It was named Moonlight Gem Fruit.
No matter how beautiful the Moonlight Gem was, it couldn’t be used. However, the Moonlight Gem Fruit could be eaten!
Gem Cat: “Meow! (Deal)”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Can you tell me what a moonlight flavored gem fruit is?” Shi Yu felt that he almost couldn’t understand their communication.
“Hurry up and choose,” the gem cat urged. “Forget about those useless things.”
“No, after looking around, there’s only one mutated material suitable for the ginseng baby,” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat heaved a sigh of relief.. Stopped the damage in time… Alright.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - Buggy’s Life Path
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Buggy’s Life Path
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The gem cat was in a better mood.
“Don’t want the others, right?” it asked.
“No,” Shi Yu said.
“By the way, is there any place that can produce a relatively positive mutation stimulation power for plants?” Shi Yu asked. “Special soil and special water are fine.”
“Most importantly, where there’s no danger. Baby Ginseng and I can go.”
“Meow?” The gem cat pondered for a moment.
It couldn’t think of anything.
It was mainly because Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng had too many requirements.
There was naturally a pile of ordinary places, but for a ginseng baby to use it, it naturally had to be a special wonderland with energy levels above level seven. Only then would the ginseng baby have a chance to mutate into an overlord race.
However, such places were very rare in the country… With restrictions, there were even fewer.
“I’ll look and think about it later. I’ll tell you when I find it.” The gem cat waved its paw. “Is there anything else?”
“I’ll get my clone to get you the gem first.”
“No hurry, no hurry,” Shi Yu said. “Let’s leave it here first. We’ll come and get it when Baby Ginseng is about to evolve.”
Shi Yu had to prepare more of Baby Ginseng’s evolution materials no matter what. Just one Moonlight Gem was definitely not enough.
Using just one ingredient was already letting down a max-level mutation skill, although the mutation skill had yet to be taught to the ginseng baby, not even lush or strengthening was taught yet.
But it was definitely not wrong to prepare more materials.
If he couldn’t absorb too much, he wouldn’t need it when the time came, but he definitely couldn’t absorb too little either.
After all, who knew when the next evolution would be? This time, it naturally had to be done in one go.
“There’s nothing else, but can you accompany me to the Undead Battlefield in a month?” Shi Yu suddenly said with a smile.
Eh?
The gem cat looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu looked at Little Chi Tong and said, “It has the Spirit Release skill. It needs to burn 10,000 transcendent-level undead to advance. We plan to liberate its next form later. We still lack a bodyguard.”
The gem cat said, “Oh, oh, no problem. The Undead Battlefield. Hmph, it’s just a place I once rampaged in.”
“As long as that Undying Dark Phoenix doesn’t appear, as long as no dangerous ruins suddenly appear, even if an Undead King suddenly upgrades into overlord, I can protect you all.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Please, stop talking.
…
After making an appointment with a Moonlight Gem at the gem cat’s place, Shi Yu and the others returned satisfied.
Apart from that, he also made an appointment for the trip in a month.
At that time, the school should be on holiday. It would take time to increase Little Chi Tong’s strength. It would also be convenient for him to participate in the martial arts conference and explore the ruins of the Martial Emperor.
With the gem cat leading the way to level up, if he was lucky, not to mention ten thousand transcendent-level undead, he might even be able to kill a thousand commander-level undead along the way and raise Little Chi Tong’s Spirit Release to expert level.
It made Little Chi Tong the first ace lady in the team to master an expert level super skill.
As for the perfect level, there was definitely no hope. Even with the gem cat leading the team, 100 monarchs weren’t that easy.
In the near future, he definitely wouldn’t be free. Apart from the fossils that were coming later, the Green Silkworm Experiment from Hua Xiajin’s legend would also be sent over one after another. He had to work for a period of time.
“So fast?”
Just as Shi Yu arrived at the dormitory, he received a call from the Ancient Capital’s fossil museum.
“Are you Student Shi Yu? I’m Liu Xingqun, deputy director of the Ancient Capital fossil museum.”
“Hello.”
Shi Yu was excited. He looked at Buggy, who had just sent them back from the resource bank.
It meant that there was no need to rest. It was time to get the fossils.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong waved at the worm. Have a safe trip.
They didn’t follow and reduced the pressure on Buggy.
Buggy:…
It suspected that this was the reason why Shi Yu taught it Instant Transmission.
“Wuo~ ~”
Then, Buggy tiredly brought Shi Yu around.
When they returned, they had a transparent container with a huge tooth in it.
This was the Tyrant Dragon Tooth that Senior Li Lianping had given them to study.
This tooth was preserved very well. It was said that it was sealed underground and not much energy leaked out. There was actually a level-seven energy wave. It was very unbelievable.
Buggy looked at it with shining eyes.
At this moment, Buggy was very excited.
Including this, there were three dragon-element equipment. Even if its Normal State couldn’t defeat Eleven, would it not be able to defeat Eleven with the equipment?
“Are you very happy?” Shi Yu looked at Buggy.
Buggy nodded crazily.
“You’re happy too early. The Ice Dragon’s Whiskers, Sea Dragon’s Scales, Tyrant Dragon’s Fang… They’re all mine, not yours!”
Buggy: Σ (° △ ° | |)
Buggy was shocked, its compound eyes filled with tears. Was there a need to be like this with their relationship?
It already belonged to him, what’s wrong with letting it use the equipment…
“It’s not good to rely on external forces too much.”
“After all, it’s an external force. Moreover, don’t you think that if you really want to get equipment, you can earn money and buy equipment yourself. Only then will you feel at ease.”
Shi Yu educated him. It actually relied its hopes on three dragons mere overlord races. Where was its ambition?
You’re already an overlord race. Even if you want to bring equipment, you have to find legendary materials and mythical materials.
At the dining table, on the seat, the ginseng baby holding a soda popped its head out and deeply agreed that it would only feel more at ease if it earned its own money to buy evolution materials.
Buggy was momentarily at a loss.
Could it be that it still had to continue selling the worm silk?
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Thinking too small, Buggy.”
“Your phantom is already at the transcendent level. What if you create a phantom that contains the power of your attack to seal in a certain piece of equipment and sell this guardian talisman?”
“If you train the spatial pocket skill to an extremely high level, who says you can’t open an alternate space outside your body? It’s suitable to combine worm silk and weave real spatial bag equipment to sell, no?”
“Isn’t this more profitable than selling a single worm silk?”
Buggy:!!!!!
Baby Ginseng:!!
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong stuck their heads out from different places.
Good heavens, Baby Ginseng was a food wholesaler, and Buggy had become an equipment wholesaler?
Eleven, who was passing by, pondered for a moment. Did it have any ability to earn money? He didn’t seem to have any…
If it had one, it perhaps could also use Hardening to condense weapons and equipment and sell them.
However, it felt that it was much lower than Buggy’s spatial equipment and Phantom equipment.
Little Chi Tong also thought for a moment before giving up. This was because for the time being, it only thought about how it could handle the “cremation” business.
It could allow the dead to return to the void without any pressure. After all, its soul would have been burned.
“Wu ~”
On the other side, Buggy thought for a moment and its eyes lit up. It felt that it could. When it earned money, it would buy a bunch of recovery items to store in the spatial bag. It wanted to see if Eleven’s reserved edge stored more energy or its spatial bag stored more energy!
It, Buggy, only wanted to earn money now!
As long as it worked hard enough, it wasn’t impossible for it to buy items that could surpass these three dragon-element equipment!
Shi Yu smiled when he saw that Buggy had understood.
His pets were all big spenders. He had to slowly nurture their ability to earn money.
What was the greatest reason for those quasi legendary Beast Tamers who had reached level seven in the Beast Taming Space but didn’t have overlord-level pets?
In the end, they still lacked money.
Although money wasn’t omnipotent, with money, wouldn’t it be easy to get an overlord-level pet?
“Wu!” Buggy suddenly said excitedly.
In fact, there was a more profitable method.
Shi Yu: “Huh??”
Buggy looked at the fossil. Stop wasting time. Quick, come and study the fossil. If we can revive ancient creatures, we have everything we want.
What if he could completely turn illusions into reality and let ancient times descend into the modern world? He would be rich by selling the Tyrant Dragon Baby.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Go away.. With that strength, isn’t it good to go to the totem area to hunt monsters and earn money? Why sell the Tyrant Dragon Baby?”

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - Birth of the Green Worm cocoon
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Birth of the Green Worm cocoon
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In Shi Yu’s dormitory at Ancient Capital University.
In the ruin ring on Shi Yu’s wrist.
Shi Yu and Buggy crawled in with the Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth fossil.
As for Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong, Shi Yu let them play by themselves.
Next, he and Buggy had to do business!
After entering, Shi Yu placed the fossil on a stone table and sat down.
Buggy stared at the tooth fossil beside him, its eyes shining.
“Let’s do it again.”
“Find the feeling you had back in that fossil lesson,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!” Buggy nodded obediently.
It wanted to make up for its failure to observe the Tyrant Dragon properly last time!
“Let’s begin.” Shi Yu closed his eyes and entered a meditative state.
According to Senior Li Lianping’s explanation, there was a chance of entering the biological fossil dream realm with the special meditation technique for archeology left behind by Emperor Shi and the transcendent dream stealing skill.
Previously, before Buggy even learned Thieving Dream, Shi Yu and the others had successfully entered once. However, it was only once. The subsequent attempts had all failed.
But this time, Buggy finally learned the skill. Perhaps it could succeed?
After Shi Yu meditated, Buggy landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder in a small form.
In the darkness, Shi Yu quickly sensed the approximate outline, shape, and the clear traces of time on the Tyrant Dragon fossil.
Without the support of the meditation stone, Shi Yu quickly learned the special meditation method for that lesson in three months. This was also the greatest gain he had gained in the three months of school.
“Wu ~”
After discovering that Shi Yu had entered a state, Buggy tried to synchronize with Shi Yu’s perception. Apart from his Psychic Perception, it also used the dream stealing skill to try to enter the dream of the fossil. However, after a minute, Shi Yu and Buggy still didn’t succeed.
The light in front of him grew brighter, but it didn’t feel it was working.
A moment later, Shi Yu and Buggy gave up.
“Wu!!!” Buggy widened its eyes and flew up.
Shi Yu, increase points!
The requirement asked for a transcendent-level dream thief, but it was only at entry-level. It definitely can’t.
Shi Yu also opened his eyes and said, “Transcendent. That’s for others.”
“You have the maximum level of Psychic power. Your spiritual power has already been tempered to an unimaginable level. The requirements are definitely much lower than other pets. Otherwise, it would have been impossible to succeed previously.”
“There’s no need to add points first. Use the Imagination Domain. In the Imagination Domain, your spiritual power will undergo a qualitative change again. Perhaps there will be new changes.”
“If it’s still not enough, I will try adding more points until the skill advances!” Shi Yu refused to believe it.
There were a bunch of backup plans. He had to succeed!
“Wu…”
Buggy landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder regretfully. It couldn’t increase points anymore…
Buggy sighed and used its newly awakened super skill, Imagination Domain, according to Shi Yu’s request.
In the next moment, Shi Yu and the others seemed to have fallen into another world.
Everything around him turned blue. The sky that emitted a blue aura, the ground that was covered in a blue aura, and even a dazzling blue and white sun.
This was not because Shi Yu and the others were in an illusion or a dream, nor did they really come to another world. Instead, Buggy’s dream world materialized and overlapped with this space, changing everything and forming a domain.
The size of the Imagination Domain depended on the strength of the worm. In the Imagination Domain, there was no need for the worm to enter the dream world to construct illusions. Instead, it only needed a thought to instantly descend the life and items it imagined into this world.
It was really a Creation God-like skill. In terms of potential, it should still be above top-grade super skills like Inner Power.
“Wu ~” Buggy’s expression became serious. It could only maintain this Imagination Domain for less than a minute. It had to do that as soon as possible.
At this moment, Buggy’s entire body was filled with a blue and white light, like a holy spirit. Its powerful spiritual power had undergone a qualitative change again. Buggy’s body actually couldn’t bear it anymore and involuntarily leaked out, forming a strong pressure.
“Alright, let’s do it again as soon as possible.” Shi Yu closed his eyes again and entered a meditative state.
Buggy also sensed at the same time again. The outline of the Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth fossil appeared in their vision at the same time.
In the darkness, the fossil flickered with light. Shi Yu and Buggy’s vision kept shrinking, as if they were walking themselves, walking towards the world behind the light.
As they approached, Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel nervous.
It was going to succeed this time?
The qualitative change caused by the Imagination Domain on the spiritual power of the worm, together with the speciality of the full-level Psychic power, made the worm’s dream stealing skill display the effect of an entry-level proficiency.
Boom.
In a daze, the light in front of Shi Yu and the others disappeared. They landed on a dry land that stretched as far as the eye could see. On the ground, the Tyrant Dragon, which was more than fifteen meters long and about six meters tall, looked at the group of outsiders with its bloody mouth and roared.
“Roar!!!!”
A blazing wind passed through Shi Yu.
“Heh.” Shi Yu was unmoved by the roar. If he knew it was a dream, why would he be afraid of him?
The last time, he was shocked because he didn’t know what was going on.
“Wu ~” Beside Shi Yu, the Imagination Butterfly Worm also entered the Tyrant Dragon fossil dream with Shi Yu again.
Buggy wasn’t as cowardly as last time.
The man and pet looked at the Tyrant Dragon and revealed excited expressions.
In the next second, in the dream world, the Tyrant Dragon swept its tail over, sweeping up a terrifying aura.
Seeing this, the worm slowly flew up. As it flapped its wings, this dream world suddenly shattered, and cracks quickly appeared like glass where it had been hit. The Tyrant Dragon’s figure quickly froze in the crack. In the end, the worm even landed on the head of this Tyrant Dragon.
Crack!
The dream world shattered. Shi Yu and Buggy opened their eyes and their gazes landed on this field of imagination again.
“Have you replicated it?” Shi Yu asked Buggy.
Buggy nodded quickly.
“Wu!!” Moreover, it showed a confident expression.
In the next second, with a thought, the entire Imagination Domain immediately changed. It changed from the previous blue world to an ancient appearance.
The ground had become the dry and cracked ground in the dream just now. The sky was blue and extremely deep. On the ground, an incomparably huge Tyrant Dragon phantom slowly formed in front of Shi Yu and the others.
“Roar!!!!”
After the Tyrant Dragon phantom appeared, its gaze was still fierce and emitted strong deterrence. However, its behavior was completely different from the previous dream world. After it came into existence, it directly crawled forward like a subject kneeling to the monarch and letting the Imaginary Butterfly control it.
Buggy looked up proudly.
What was a top-notch Dragon Tamer?
“It’s exactly the same.” At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Tyrant Dragon Phantom in front of him and took a deep breath. He had already sensed the powerful aura emanating from its body. He felt that this phantom could tear apart most commander-level ferocious beasts with a single claw!
Through the Dream Stealing Skill, Buggy directly replicated the information of the Tyrant Dragon left in the fossil dream realm. Moreover, through the Imagination Domain and the Illusory Phantom, it completed the materialization in reality!
The ancient tyrant had descended into the world again!
“Roar!!!” The Tyrant Dragon raised its head and looked disdainfully at the sky and the ground.
As an ancient overlord, it had a strong body and perfect earth affinity. It was undoubtedly a ferocious beast.
“Wu ~ ~” However, at this moment, Buggy felt that it was a pity that the Tyrant Dragon Phantom it conjured only had racial skills below super level, not super skills.
“It’s very normal. Your dream stealing skill level is too low. If you want to replicate even my super skill on the illusion, you have to at least have perfect proficiency.”
“It’s already very good. You simply used illusions to materialize an ice dragon, and for that one… Forget about all skills below super level… There were only two ice-element basic skills.”
“Wu ~”
At this moment, Shi Yu took out his cell phone and began to take photos of the Tyrant Dragon Phantom from various angles, recording the data.
Phantom Illusion+Imagination Domain+Dream Stealing. This was definitely the most realistic physical Tyrant Dragon in this era.
Even those top-notch dream stealers would probably find it difficult to gather these three skills and combine them. At most, they would see ancient creatures in their dreams and not perfectly materialize them in reality!
A huge discovery!
At the moment, the strength of this Tyrant Dragon was secondary. The main thing was its research value.
“Unfortunately.”
Buggy felt that it was a pity, but so did Shi Yu. He placed his hand on the Tyrant Dragon’s rough body. Unfortunately, Buggy’s ability only made it look like a real life form. It couldn’t be a real life form yet.
Otherwise, his skill index might be able to use this method to replicate the abilities of ancient creatures.
But not now. If the level of the Imagination domain was high, so maybe it could be done?
Or, he could help Buggy replicate some skills that gave life.
Perhaps it could really advance to a master of creation!
Shi Yu did not expect a similar skill for a moment, but there was indeed a Beast Taming Talent that could give life and help dead creatures awaken.
The few predecessors who established the Mechanic class were similar Beast Taming Talents.
They could help some Mountain River Plants awaken their intelligence and let them complete their initial awakening.
This talent was named “Awakening”.
Dong Huang’s mechanical legend was actually not directly Mechanic at the start.
It was only changed after he entered the Legendary stage. At the start, he was only an ordinary Beast Tamer.
Only when he used his talent to create the first virtual data life form and made it a mechanical beast did Dong Huang’s mechanical domain gradually take shape.
Since he had such a Beast Taming Talent, Shi Yu felt that perhaps he should have such a skill, but it was not easy to find.
But taking a step back, if he could find it and let the ancient creatures revive in the modern world, it might really be possible for him and Buggy.
Stones, plants, and water could all evolve into life forms, so why couldn’t the dream illusion do the same? It wasn’t like there weren’t dream creatures in this world.
Shi Yu filmed and recorded. A moment later, Buggy cried out.
After being stunned, Shi Yu smiled and said, “Alright, alright.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Buggy immediately dispersed the Imagination Domain. It wasn’t difficult to materialize the Tyrant Dragon Phantom, but for it, maintaining the Imagination Domain was a little difficult.
The Imagination Domain disappeared, and the surrounding environment returned to the initial environment of the ruins. Shi Yu smiled and said, “Well done. Let’s stop here today. I’ll upgrade your dream stealing skill another day.”
Buggy flew around happily.
“But although the completion level of the Tyrant Dragon Phantom just now is not bad, the surrounding environment completion level is not very high. Next, I’ll give you a small training mission.”
“Huh???” Buggy was stunned.
Shi Yu said, “The sunny environment and the thunderstorm environment. You choose one of these two environments to practice. When the time comes, cooperate with Eleven or Baby Ginseng to use it. As for the Tyrant Dragon Phantom, Ice Dragon Phantom, and Sea Dragon Phantom, just treat it as entertainment.”
“Wu…”
Whether it was the Tyrant Dragon, the Ice Dragon, or the Sea Dragon, they were all overlord races. On the other hand, Buggy itself was also an overlord race. There was completely no need to materialize their battles. It was better to materialize oneself in the field of imagination. This way, the completion level of the phantom would be higher.
Of course, if Buggy carried those three level-seven equipment and conjured the three-headed dragon, its battle power would definitely be stronger. However, Buggy could grow after all, and those three equipment were only level-seven. Now, perhaps Buggy could increase a lot of its battle power with them, but sooner or later, the equipment would be eliminated. Everything still depended on itself.
Therefore, compared to materializing a dragon, it was better to practice how to materialize various extreme weather environments, venue environments, such as the Lava Space, Thunderstorm Space, Sun Space, Super Gravity Space, and so on to fight with teammates.
“Wu!!” Buggy felt aggrieved. Was the Dragon Tamer, Buggy, gone?
For a creature like the Green Silkworm, controlling a dragon was a very great accomplishment.
“Not really. If you really want to become a Dragon Tamer, the divine dragon phantom formed by the dragon ball on the day you evolved is your best choice. After all, it’s the power that has already been integrated into your bloodline. Moreover, you still have the skill Dragon of Imagination.”
“When the time comes, the combination of the Dragon of Imagination and the Domain of Imagination will definitely be stronger than the Tyrant Dragon, Ice Dragon, and Sea Dragon,” Shi Yu said.
At the moment, Buggy’s strongest mode should be to enter the Dragon of Imagination state first to obtain the dragon attributes, physique, energy, and health points. Then, it would activate the Imagination Domain and dominate everything.
Next, it would definitely train around these two skills.
Moreover, the proficiency of Buggy’s Dragon of Imagination and the Domain of Imagination wasn’t low now, and it was even close to the proficiency level. This was all thanks to the skill Phantom Illusion. After all, the three skills had a certain connection to some extent. They were all used as the “super power of imagination”.
“Wu ~!!” Buggy expressed agreement…
“All the best, practice. Let’s go to Imperial Capital University to communicate later. You’re the main force. When the time comes, I hope you can combine the Dragon of Imagination and the power of the Imagination Domain well.” Shi Yu smiled.
Buggy nodded heavily. No problem!
At this moment, after confirming that he and Buggy could really study the fossil domain, Shi Yu was also full of motivation.
His motivation wasn’t actually an ancient creature like the Tyrant Dragon, but the recovery of a divine beast. He hoped to obtain some materials from the Mythical Era to materialize Mythical creatures.
In this world, there were Mythical materials. They were ranked at the tenth level and were also called divine-level resources. Their value was in the form of ten billion trillion yuan, and even if one had money, they might not necessarily be able to buy them.
In his previous life, Shi Yu was first a Mythical Scholar, followed by an archeologist. The attraction of Mythical creatures to him was the greatest.
“Buggy’s dream stealing skill must be max level.”
“But before that, I should take care of Baby Ginseng first.” Shi Yu realized that Baby Ginseng’s battle power had already been pulled apart too much. He decided to teach Baby Ginseng the lush and hardening skills replicated in Divine Capital this time.
…
Three days later.
Shi Yu was breastfeeding Baby Ginseng.
[Name]: Ginseng Baby
[Attributes]: Wood
[Race Level]: Low-level Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Skill]: Sweet Aura (Dao Proficiency), Slow Healing (Dao Proficiency), High Speed Healing (transcendent), Nutrition (Dao Proficiency), Earth Chain (Dao Proficiency), Source of Life (Initiate), Multiplication (Perfect), Absolute Sleep (Perfect), Energy Fruit (Perfect), Energy Storage Beam (transcendent), Multiplication (Transcendent), Strengthening (Perfect)
Energy Points: 102955
Three days after returning, Shi Yu directly upgraded Baby Ginseng’s lush and hardening skills to an extremely high level. As for its other skills, most of them had been upgraded in the past three months. Apart from the “super skill” Source of Life, Baby Ginseng’s other four racial skills had long been maxed out. Baby Ginseng had also fallen into a bottleneck period. This was also why Shi Yu began to consider its evolution path.
“Yiya. (Continue.)”
On the bed, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng looked at each other. Baby Ginseng was becoming stronger, and so was Shi Yu during the teaching process.
After breaking through to the high-level, the upper limit of Shi Yu’s physique was raised again, but he had yet to reach the upper limit. Now, his physique was already close to that of an ordinary legendary Beast Tamer. It was easy for him to resist the skills of transcendent-level ferocious beasts. Shi Yu estimated that his current upper limit of physique should be at the legendary level, but it should take him a few more days to reach it.
After reaching the upper limit of his physique this time, even if Little Chi Tong broke through to commander rank, Shi Yu should be able to perfectly withstand its possession.
“Wait,” Shi Yu said to Baby Ginseng.
He took out his vibrating cell phone and took a few looks before smiling. “We’ll continue later. The Green Silkworm army is here. Let’s go and pick them up first.”
Baby Ginseng:??!!
Under Baby Ginseng’s confused expression, Buggy was called over. Through Buggy’s Instant Transmission, they went out to take a walk again. This time, Shi Yu even brought back 51 cages.
The cages were filled with Green Silkworms!
There were 51 in total.
They had all reached level ten of Awakening.
Moreover, their Worm Silk Proficiency was classified into 40 expert levels, 10 perfect levels, and 1 transcendent level!
These Green Silkworms were all experimental bodies carefully cultivated by the researchers of the Demon Capital Worm Department.
Apart from that, Legend Hua also sent Shi Yu a pile of cultivation resources. They were all applications according to the common teaching methods for Psychic, Absolute Sleep, Super Sight, and other skills on the skill index.
“Ji!!” “Ji!!!” “Ji!!”
After Shi Yu brought the 51 green worms back to the dormitory, the dormitory immediately started chattering.
Little Eleven, Little Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy were all shocked by the 51 green worms.
Why were there so many?
Although they knew that Shi Yu was going to carry out evolution experiments, this was too much.
At this moment, these Green Silkworms widened their eyes. They seemed to be very brave. After all, their parents were definitely creatures of very high levels. In addition, they had been carefully raised by researchers since they were young. This was the main reason why they weren’t so afraid of others. Compared to the timid Buggy at the start, they were indeed very different.
“Wuu! (Looks much stronger than the worm at the start)” Eleven said.
Buggy:???
“Wu!!” Buggy glanced at the group of Green Silkworms and revealed a faint deterrence. The group of Green Silkworms immediately became obedient and stopped chattering, looking at Buggy in awe.
However, the worm quickly received Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong’s disdainful gazes.
Bullying a little worm was nothing.
Buggy: QAQ
Even if it wanted to bully those two, they wouldn’t fight it.
Shi Yu stopped their discussion and said, “Alright, there’s something new to do next. Baby Ginseng, according to the evolution ingredient formula we researched previously, let’s first classify and assemble those materials.”
“Yi!!” The knowledgeable ginseng baby in the team was a piece of cake.
If Shi Yu wanted to study the evolution method of the green cocoon, it naturally couldn’t do without the evolution plan.
In the past few days since arriving in the Ancient Capital, he and Baby Ginseng had summarized the 20 evolutionary materials combination plans according to the materials for common teaching methods such as Psychic, Absolute Sleep, and Super Sight.
Shi Yu planned to let these Green Silkworms try it one by one. Practice. This was also the only method that could effectively determine the feasibility of the Green Silkworm’s evolution plan. The evolution of life couldn’t be simulated by machines.
“Do you know what you’re going to experience next?” Shi Yu asked the group of green worms.
“Ji?” “Ji?” “Ji?” The green worms widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
Shi Yu :”…”
As expected, the Green Silkworm was still stupid and didn’t seem to have a high IQ.
That group of researchers was also impressive. They could pile their skill proficiency to perfect and transcendent levels in a short period of time.
Shi Yu looked at the Green Silkworm that had mastered the transcendent worm silk. He could already clearly sense that its life was less than a month away. If it didn’t turn into a cocoon soon, it would die.
This was also reminded by Legend Hua.
“Let one of them eat the evolution materials and try to turn into a cocoon,” Shi Yu said to Buggy.
There were ten evolution plans that could immediately turn into a cocoon.
There were ten types that could only turn into cocoons after changing their diet for a period of time.
“Yi!!” At this moment, Baby Ginseng had already quickly classified the evolution materials. Buggy turned around and used Instant Transmission to teleport ten Green Silkworms out.
After coming out, the green worms were extremely confused. However, with the deterrence guidance of the worm, it was quite easy for Shi Yu to command them.
“Cooperate well. If you succeed, you can change your fate. If evolution fails, I can also guarantee that you can live longer than ordinary green worms. There won’t be any pain.”
The group of Green Silkworms still didn’t understand what Shi Yu said, but they could perfectly carry out the instructions of the worm. They immediately ran to nibble on the evolution materials brought out by the ginseng baby happily. There were so many high-level materials that they didn’t often eat even when they were at the research institute. They wolfed it down, making the Green Silkworm in the cage look envious.
“Ji!” “Ji!” “Ji!”
They also wanted to eat it!
A moment later, the ten different sets of evolution materials were eaten by the ten Green Silkworms who had mastered the expert level worm silk. They each burped and their bodies enlarged. They were already so full that they couldn’t even crawl.
“Buggy, let them turn into cocoons,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!!” Buggy expressed its understanding. At the same time, under Buggy’s instructions, the ten Green Silkworms spat silk and wrapped themselves, as if it was instinct.
Among the ten awakened-level Green Silkworms, the proficiency of the worm silk was only at expert level, and the level of the materials used was not high. The cocoon transformation scene was naturally ordinary, completely not as shocking as when the worm evolved.
The worm silk wrapped the ten Green Silkworms bit by bit. The remaining Green Silkworms watched the commotion, while Eleven and Baby Ginseng recorded the whole process with the video device.
