Soon, the ten Green Silkworms wrapped themselves with worm silk. After forming the cocoon, they began to sleep to absorb the power of the evolution materials. At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but frown when he saw that everything was calm.
Although he didn’t know if they would still evolve into Wind Crystal Butterflies or other species after breaking out of their cocoons, or if they would fail to turn into cocoons, at this moment, he was certain that none of them had evolved into a green cocoon…
“You guys can’t?” Shi Yu looked at the ten Green Silkworm cocoons. Just as he was about to get Buggy and Baby Ginseng to arrange the other ten evolution plans, something unexpected happened.
In Shi Yu and the others’ vision, not long after the cocoon of one of the Green Silkworms turned into a cocoon, white light suddenly lingered around its body. That was… the light of evolution!
Just like Buggy, after this green worm turned into a cocoon, not long after, the light of evolution and awakening surrounded its body again!
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng widened their eyes and watched carefully.
A moment later, the full appearance of the green silkworm cocoon surrounded by evolution light appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
It was still in the form of a cocoon, but similar to the worm, it also had two eyes. Moreover, it was blinking and had consciousness!
Moreover, faint spiritual waves spread out from his body!
After being stunned, the index for Bureau 11 in front of him changed.
[Name]: Green Worm cocoon
[Attributes]: Worm
[Race Level]:???
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Race Skill]: Psychic
Energy Points: 250
Shi Yu was completely stunned. Luck?
No…
It was a miracle of ten consecutive draws!
Initially, Shi Yu thought that it would be a difficult battle to study the form of the green worm cocoon, but he didn’t expect that the first round of experiment would be successful. Not only did this green worm evolve into the green worm cocoon, but it also broke through its growth level and reached the transcendent level. It even awakened a new skill, Psychic power!
Apart from the fact that its energy level was a little low, which could be said to be a disgrace to the transcendent level, it had yet to reach half of the normal transcendent standard. It was completely similar to the evolution pattern of the worm at that time.
“Baby Ginseng, which evolution plan did this green worm use and what materials were used?” Shi Yu hurriedly turned to look at Baby Ginseng.
Skill index, the most useful thing in the world!
At the same time, Shi Yu’s cell phone suddenly vibrated. Shi Yu took a look and saw that it was actually Legend Hua. The other party had pulled him into a small group chat.
In the group chat, there were only three people. One was Shi Yu, the other was Legend Hua, and the last was Dr. Zuo, who had researched the Ice Phoenix Moth.
Legend Hua: “Shiyu, you’ve received the experimental subjects and materials, right? If you need any help, you can directly look for me and Dr. Zuo.”
Dr. Zuo: “Yes.”
Shi Yu looked at the group chat in silence.
He raised his cell phone and took a photo of the green cocoon before sending it over.
[Click here to send]
“Well, I casually picked ten and tried it just now. I think I’ve already found a way to let the Green Silkworm evolve into a Green Silkworm cocoon. It’s just that the energy level is a little low. It’s a hundred million times worse than my Green Silkworm race. It might still be a transcendent race.”
After Shi Yu sent it, the short silence in the group almost made Shi Yu think that his cell phone was stuck.
But a moment later, although there were only three people in the group chat, the news erupted like a flood.
Legend Hua:??
Dr. Zuo: “?”
Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo’s screens were filled with question marks…

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - Im Not Interested in Research
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: I’m Not Interested in Research
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the insect research institute in Shanghai.
A beautiful woman in a research suit looked at the photo on the cell phone in a daze, wondering if her eyes were broken.
Wait…
Didn’t they just transport the Green Silkworm today?!
That was it?
How could it be so fast!
“Are you sure you’re not kidding???” Legend Hua asked.
A moment later, Shi Yu sent some more information about the green cocoon.
“The racial level should still be low-level transcendent. What I can roughly confirm now is that the birth of the green worm cocoon is related to the two skills Absolute Sleep and super vision.”
Shi Yu looked at the evolution plan list concluded by Baby Ginseng and fell into deep thought.
The evolution materials used by this green cocoon included universal teaching materials for absolute sleep and super vision.
There were no teaching materials for Psychic power.
So, why did it awaken its psychic power?
This skill point was so crooked that it instantly confused Shi Yu.
As long as he awakened more super vision or absolute sleep, Shi Yu wouldn’t be so puzzled.
“Why don’t I try again? What if it’s just a coincidence?” Shi Yu replied.
“Try it slowly. I’m heading to the ancient capital now,” Dr. Zuo Jiangyun typed.
“I’ll go too,” said Legend Hua.
The two of them originally thought that even if Shi Yu could achieve results, it would be a long time later.
However, Shi Yu had just received the goods and confirmed that the green cocoon could be replicated. Was this reasonable?
Moreover, they looked at the background of the photo. This was… the living room?
How could Shi Yu be so casual!
But no matter what the process was, this result was enough for them to let go of everything and take it seriously.
Although they couldn’t tell what was so impressive about this green cocoon that could only be worth 250, what if other evolution materials were added to this foundation?
For example, among the evolution materials of the Ice Phoenix Moth, could it allow the Ice Phoenix Moth to also master psychic power?
Psychic power was an all-purpose skill that could be matched with almost any element. Although it was a low-level skill, if it was learned, it could effectively increase the tactical diversity of the pet.
Although it was more likely that the evolution had failed due to the conflict of materials, what if there was an evolution form that could perfectly adapt to the green cocoon race?
At that time, would a new evolution form be born?
Shi Yu could be considered to have made a start. He had laid down a foundation for the birth of various new evolution forms for the Green Silkworm, just like how Shi Yu had developed the Butterfly of Imagination himself.
“Ah, Aunt Hua, Dr. Zuo, are you both coming?” Shi Yu was stunned. Forget it, so be it.
He would throw the research to others. This way, he wouldn’t have to squeeze out the ginseng baby and the worm. He could also go and do other things.
…
Ever since Xia Qingwei lost to Shi Yu, she had been in isolation for two days. Then, she had been quietly studying at the bug research institute.
In fact, the Ice Phoenix Moth had another evolution. It was developed six years later by Dr. Zuo after researching the evolution plan of the Green Silkworm to the Ice Phoenix Moth. It could reach high-level monarch races, but the conditions were very harsh.
There were requirements for every growth stage of the Ice Phoenix Moth. The cultivator needed to be sufficiently patient.
“Don’t always stay in the research institute.” Dr. Zuo walked into the laboratory and looked at his focused daughter.
“I want the Ice Phoenix Moth to evolve one more time,” she said.
Dr. Zuo felt a headache. If she had known that her daughter would go and challenge that Butterfly of Imagination and become a shut in all of a sudden, she wouldn’t have encouraged her to go.
He originally thought that he could obtain some combat information, but in the end, just a glance from the other party made Xia Qingwei and the Ice Phoenix Moth lose their battle will.
Was the strength of that butterfly really that terrifying?
This made Dr. Zuo even more eager to study the Green Worm cocoon.
“Even if you repeat my research, it’s very difficult for the Ice Phoenix Moth to defeat its opponent by race,” Dr. Zuo said.
Xia Qingwei was stunned. She sighed and lay on the table. Was there no other way to defeat the Butterfly of Imagination?
“The reason why that Butterfly of Imagination is powerful might be because the Green Silkworm Cocoon is a transition race. If you want to defeat it, you have to understand it first. Come with me to the ancient capital.”
“To the ancient capital?” Xia Qingwei was confused.
“That Shi Yu has already confirmed the replication ability of the Green Silkworm cocoon race. He has just cultivated a second Green Silkworm cocoon.”
“What!” Xia Qingwei suddenly got up and said, “Really?”
“Why would I lie to you? If it really proves that it can be replicated, in the next ten years, the research direction of the country’s worm-element field might all revolve around the ‘Green Worm cocoon’. Even if you want to study it, you have to follow the trend of the new era, right?” Dr. Zuo said.
At least, in her research system, no Green Silkworm could evolve into an overlord race.
However, in the green cocoon system, there was already an Imagination Butterfly.
It was better to explore new areas than to let his daughter repeat her research.
…
At Ancient Capital University, Principal Feng received a call from Legend Hua.
Because of Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination, the two of them had been in contact many times recently.
“Legend Hua, what’s the matter?”
“Senior Feng, sorry to disturb you. Do you know that Shi Yu is studying the Green Silkworm cocoon?”
Principal Feng: “???”
“It’s fine if you didn’t mention it, but… If you mention it now, I’m going to nag at you, Hua Xiajin. Were you the one who bewitched Shi Yu to study some green worm cocoon and get involved in the feeding field?”
When Principal Feng thought of how Shi Yu was very interested in Feeding and even wanted to enter the third bureau of Feeding Specialization, he felt a headache.
“What are you thinking by letting a genius from Bureau 11 study the Green Silkworm cocoon? Do you think it’s so easy to replicate an overlord species pet?” Principal Feng said. “How much effort would this take? He doesn’t have the time.”
“Even if he does have results for the Green Silkworm cocoon, I wonder how much effort it will take.”
On the other side, Legend Hua was silent.
Principal Feng was also silent. In his opinion, the birth of the Green Silkworm cocoon and the birth of the Imaginary Butterfly were all accidents. They were fortuitous encounters during Shi Yu’s archeology, and they could not be replicated very well. In Bureau 11, almost every member had some relatively special pets that could not be replicated very well.
For example, where could he find a second Wind Demon Lion with the bloodline of the Evil Suppressing Lion?
If Lu Qingyi went to study how to mass produce the Wind Demon Lion with the bloodline of the Evil Suppressing Lion, wouldn’t it be useless?
“But the problem is that he didn’t spend much effort and completed the research in less than a few minutes.”
Principal Feng: “Even so, it’s… Huh?”
“Huh? What did you say?”
Principal Feng was stunned and stood rooted to the ground.
“Just now, Shi Yu cultivated a second green worm cocoon.”
“Senior Feng, the Green Silkworm has always been a very important part of ensuring the development of the middle and lower levels of the Beast Taming Domain. This discovery now is very important.”
“Now, Dr. Zuo and I both plan to go over. Look, can you cooperate with Ancient Capital University and help build a Green Silkworm cocoon research institute like the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute?” Legend Hua smiled and said, “We can work in Ancient Capital University.”
“This is an opportunity for Ancient Capital University’s Feeding and Research Department to be comparable to the archeology Department. It’s also because Student Shi Yu’s identity is special. Otherwise, he would have probably been poached to Demon Capital University by Dr. Zuo long ago.”
Principal Feng: “…I’m a little confused.”
The old man scratched his head as he pushed open the door and walked towards Shi Yu’s dormitory.
Holy shit, Shi Yu had really researched something?
As he walked, Principal Feng widened his eyes.
A moment later, he arrived in front of Shi Yu’s dormitory.
Shi Yu opened the door and looked at Grandpa Feng, confused.
“Principal Feng, why are you here?”
Principal Feng didn’t look at Shi Yu, but behind him.
At this moment, the eleven green cocoons were following behind Shi Yu eagerly. They widened their eyes and looked at him.
Principal Feng:???
“What… what’s this?”
“Green Worm cocoon…” Shi Yu said,” I just confirmed it. It’s really replicable. Unbelievable. If the evolution materials are used correctly, almost 100% can evolve to the cocoon race. ”
“I wonder if it can successfully break out of the cocoon… But it shouldn’t be a big problem, because the cocoon state is also eligible for training skills.” Shi Yu sighed.
“Principal Feng, do you think I can enter the third bureau with this research result?” Shi Yu asked.
When he first joined Bureau 11, his initial funds were 10,000,000. After becoming an official member, he even obtained many benefits such as the ruin ring, index, and meditation technique. Even the billion yuan that Eleven had evolved into was equivalent to what Bureau 11 provided. He thought for a moment. It was impossible for the third bureau of the specialization in the Feeding Domain to have fewer benefits than Bureau 11.
It didn’t matter to him if he got another position. It was the same whether he was in one or two bureaus. It was always beneficial to get to know more seniors.
Principal Feng:???
He still wanted to work in multiple departments part-time?
Principal Feng regretted telling Shi Yu that he worked in three departments part-time.
“This, this might not be enough.”
The corners of Principal Feng’s mouth twitched. “If you want to enter that kind of place, even if you have researched a stable high-level monarch race cultivation method, you’re still not qualified. There are even fewer members in the third bureau than in Bureau 11. All of them are monsters. I’ll just tell you about one person casually.”
“She’s the top skill teacher of Dong Huang. She has the teaching manuals of three super skills with extremely high universal attributes. Moreover, her talent can assist in teaching. She once spent three years assisting a titled legend and cultivated an invincible overlord who had mastered six super skills.”
“In other words, to reach a certain condition, they are a group of people who have the hope of nurturing pets with overlord potential.”
“The third bureau isn’t as simple as you think.”
“Of course, the cost of using their abnormal talent is also very high. In contrast, although our listening talent isn’t easy to activate, fortunately, there won’t be any major side effects.”
“It depends on whether you can enter Bureau 13 of Dong Huang using your Beast Taming Talent. It’s very difficult to rely on results alone unless the results are very huge. You better not think about it.”
“Can’t I…” Shi Yu laughed. Forget it, let’s talk about it in the future.
“So you’re here for…” Shi Yu looked at the anxious Principal Feng.
Principal Feng :”…”
“You’re interested in researching feeding?” he asked.
Principal Feng thought with a stomachache.
Firstly, it was indeed as Legend Hua had said. This was a pretty big discovery.
If any subsequent research results were produced, Ancient Capital University would not only be able to use the archeology Department…
But from then on, the Feeding Department would also be the top in the country.
Moreover, the research of the Green Silkworm cocoon was indeed a study that could promote development in the Beast Taming Domain of the entire country. It wasn’t an unprofessional thing.
Even if he studied archeology for a long time, this result might not necessarily be valuable.
Principal Feng raised his head slightly. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to have such talent.
He thought for a long time and decided to support it.
In any case, Shi Yu was still young. It was not a big deal for the school to build a research institute and let Shi Yu work part-time in the Feeding Department for two years.
Firstly, it could increase the feeding research foundation of Ancient Capital University. Secondly, it could also allow Shi Yu to develop in school in peace. As long as Shi Yu didn’t go to any dangerous place to wander, he could do anything. Moreover, this was also a serious matter.
The more Principal Feng thought about it, the more he felt that it was feasible.
“I’ve decided to establish a Green Silkworm Cocoon Research Institute and let you lead the research. Are you surprised?” After thinking it through, Principal Feng smiled.
It was as if he had already seen Shi Yu’s excited expression.
And he himself also imagined the future of the double ace specialization in Ancient Capital University.
“Huh?” Shi Yu shook his head in confusion and said, “I’m… not very interested in the research of the Green Silkworm cocoon.”
Principal Feng:???
“Then what’s going on!” He pointed at the green cocoons.
Shi Yu said, “Accident… coincidence? Don’t worry, after confirming the feasibility of the green worm cocoon, my mission will be over. Dr. Zuo and Legend Huaary seem to be coming over. When the time comes, I’ll hand the information to you. You guys can study it. I only want to get fossils now, preferably Mythical Creature fossils.”
Even if he studied the Green Silkworm cocoon thoroughly, it was only so for Shi Yu.
But if it was researching fossils, it was different.
This involved the power of imagination, the recovery of ancient creatures, and the recovery of divine beasts. This was the most attractive thing to a Mythical Scholar like Shi Yu.
Principal Feng:???
“Fossil… Fossils…” Principal Feng was speechless. What was there to study about that thing? Old Li had studied it all her life, but wasn’t it just that? Wasn’t it better to study the green cocoon?
He had completely forgotten that he had previously felt that it was not bad to let Shi Yu study fossils in peace.
“Forget it, let’s talk in detail when Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua arrive.” Principal Feng’s teeth hurt. He couldn’t force Shi Yu’s thoughts, but for some reason, he suddenly felt very tired.
…
That day, Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo arrived at Ancient Capital University.
For people of their level, traveling across cities was still very fast.
Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua were similar in age. One of them was still wearing a research suit, while the other was still wearing the butterfly-patterned cheongsam. However, the difference between the two was that one had a daughter who was already in university, while the other was still single for ten thousand years.
“There’s a sad story hidden in this.” The old principal of Ancient Capital University, who knew the inside story, received Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, and the others at the same time.
“Uh, this is?” The old principal of Ancient Capital University was surprised to see the girl behind Dr. Zuo.
“Hello, Principal Feng. My name is Xia Qingwei. I came with my mother this time.” Xia Qing could only greet Principal Feng politely, but she observed Shi Yu, who was scratching his head beside him.
“Qingwei is my assistant.” Dr. Zuo smiled.
“Welcome.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Why don’t everyone take a look at the green cocoons first?”
“Of the 51 Green Silkworms, 20 have already completed their evolution. Among them, 11 are just Green Silkworm cocoons.”
Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua looked at each other. Could it really be replicated?
Soon, the few of them arrived at Shi Yu’s dormitory courtyard.
At this moment, the cocoons of the nine ordinary cocoons were sleeping in the corner, while the eleven who had evolved into cocoons were staring at each other and smelling the fragrance of the flowers in the courtyard.
It was so magical. Why could they smell fragrance without noses?
“Unbelievable.”
“Unbelievable.”
After entering, Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua looked at the eleven green cocoons and were extremely excited.
It was as if they had seen a newly opened door to the highest domain of the worm family.
It had been a long time since there had been any major research results in the bug domain.
“Student Shi Yu, you’re indeed a genius.” Dr. Zuo praised with all his might. “If Qingwei was half as outstanding as you, I wouldn’t have to spend so much effort.”
Xia Qingwei: “?”
You called me over just to say this?
Legend Hua smiled and said, “Principal Feng, have you considered it? Dr. Zuo and I are voluntarily taking our positions at Ancient Capital University this time.”
“Student Shi Yu, Dr. Zuo and I will assist you in researching the Green Silkworm cocoon in the future. How about that?”
There was only one research institute left.
Of course, with their identities, it was very simple for them to set up a research institute themselves, but it was not easy to abduct Shi Yu. After all, Shi Yu was a genius cultivated by Bureau 11 and was studying at Ancient Capital University. They had to consider the ideas of the principal first.
Principal Feng smiled awkwardly and said, “The problem is that this kid, Shi Yu, said that he suddenly lost interest in the research of the Green Silkworm cocoon.”
“The research institute still has to be built, but Shi Yu doesn’t seem to plan on researching it himself.”
Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, Xia Qingwei:???
The three of them looked at Shi Yu.
What?
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. He didn’t study the Green Silkworm cocoon for himself in the first place. He purely wanted to see if he could produce results in passing. In the beginning, he didn’t plan to study it for a long time. Now that he had started, he felt that it was enough.
To Shi Yu, investing too much energy was not cost-effective.
“I don’t have enough energy and professional knowledge, so I won’t cause trouble,” Shi Yu said self-awarely.
How could he start his own research? It would feel good to wait for the results.
“You mean casually researching the Green Silkworm cocoon is called insufficient professional knowledge?” The corners of Dr. Zuo’s mouth twitched. This young man was crazy.
“You… you’re not researching anymore?” Xia Qingwei was completely stunned.
Even if she was still young, she knew how important this research result was.
Shi Yu had given up on research just like that?
She suddenly couldn’t understand the difference between her and Shi Yu.
Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua didn’t know what to say.
“Understandable.” After a moment of silence, Legend Hua looked at Shi Yu and said, “But it’s a rare research result. Then, do you think you should use this result to participate in the Feeding Conference in a week?”
“In their state, they should be able to evolve in three to seven days. They can use the ruins space or their talent to accelerate. They can catch up.” Dr. Zuo looked at the group of cocoons and then at Shi Yu. “Do you want to participate?”
“Uh, what’s that?” Shi Yu said.
“During the annual Feeding Results Exhibition held by the Feeder Association, the participating members are basically Feeders from all walks of life. Through the selection of the most valuable Feeding Results, the Feeder Association will reward the researchers to a certain extent and also provide some support to the research project.”
“The Green Silkworm cocoon should be a very good research result. If its form after transforming into a butterfly has more potential, it might have a chance to win the championship. It can even use this opportunity to publicize the Green Silkworm cocoon and obtain a large amount of investment,” Dr. Zuo said.
There was such a conference?
Shi Yu was stunned. “Then the prize this time is…”
Dr. Zuo: “The soil of time, a special earth-element and time-element dual-element resource. It contains the power of time and can cause some spiritual plants to mutate. It’s a research material that many feeders who study spiritual plants dream of. This isn’t the main thing. The main thing is that this stage is the best place to show the results of the feeding. It can show the greatest value of a research result.”
“It can be more widely spread than published papers. If it’s widely recognized, it’s very important for us to study the Green Silkworm cocoon next.”
Shi Yu probed, “A time and earth-element dual-element resource that can mutate plants?”
“Huh?” Dr. Zuo nodded.
Shi Yu wiped his hands and said with a serious expression, “When do we start researching the Green Silkworm cocoon? Can we develop greater results in seven days? I’m already prepared.”
Everyone: “?”
Weren’t you not interested just now???

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - Birth of a New Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Birth of a New Race
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Time soil!
Initially, Shi Yu was not interested in the subsequent research of the green cocoon…
But speaking of this, he wasn’t tired.
With the mention of the Feeding Results Exhibition and the soil of time, Shi Yu’s research motivation immediately rose.
Special soil that could stimulate the mutation of spiritual plants?
It even had high-end and impressive time power?
Wasn’t this specially made for Baby Ginseng!
Shi Yu had never heard of this resource before. It looked like it was also a super rare resource. After all, it concerned the time attribute.
Moreover, as the reward for a national-level meeting, the value and level definitely wouldn’t be low.
Moonlight Gem+Time Soil+Ginseng Baby =???
Shi Yu was immediately curious.
No, just these two resources were not enough. The more the better!
But no matter what, he definitely wanted this soil of time.
“This soil of time sounds a little useful to me…” Shi Yu said.
Everyone :”…”
Principal Feng: “Just for this?”
His position was so uncertain!
Shi Yu: “Then does our Ancient Capital University have similar resources? If there are, it doesn’t matter if we participate or not.”
“Uh.” Principal Feng was stunned.
“No.” His face darkened.
Dual-element resources of this level were mostly unique. It was very difficult to find similar ones.
This soil of time was most likely taken out from the third bureau.
Bureau 11 could produce resources of the same value, but it definitely wasn’t earth and time.
No matter how one looked at it, this was a reward prepared for the feeder. Only the third bureau had it.
“The soil of time. And you still say that you’re not interested in feeding research?” Legend Hua was speechless.
Shi Yu said, “…It’s not for research.”
He couldn’t say that it was used as a random mutation material for Baby Ginseng, right?
Not only could the Green Silkworm be a gambler! Even Baby Ginseng could do it too!
Shi Yu realized that he quite liked this random evolution plan, but it was a little expensive.
“Then, it looks like we’re going to participate in this conference?” Dr. Zuo pondered slightly.
In fact, she was also prepared to participate in this meeting, but at the moment, she gave up and planned to support Shi Yu with all her might.
Because Shi Yu’s feed results had a chance to crush everyone. It was very meaningful.
“We only have seven days to prepare.”
“Although the Green Silkworm cocoon is a pretty good feed research result, the Green Silkworm cocoon alone isn’t enough.”
“At least we have to confirm the value of its evolution form. As for whether there are other breakthroughs in seven days, it depends on luck.”
“The only thing we can confirm now is that the cultivation cost of the Green Silkworm cocoon isn’t high, right?” She looked at Shi Yu.
Because the cultivation materials Shi Yu and they wanted were relatively common low-level materials.
Shi Yu said, “The market price of the evolution materials alone is hundreds of thousands. If these materials are cultivated and produced on a large scale in the future, the cost can be controlled to a very low level. If it’s about 100,000, most ordinary families should be able to bear it.”
Xia Qingwei was stunned. “So cheap??”
Dr. Zuo smiled and said, “If we can control the cultivation cost of the Beast Tamer to less than 100,000 yuan, obtaining a pet that has mastered Psychic power is already a huge impact. Psychic pets generally have very high potential.”
“If it’s controlled at around 1 million, obtaining a pet that was commander race and could master Psychic power is a huge innovation in the Beast Taming Domain.”
“Therefore, there’s a high chance that this feeding outcome will come first in the Feeding Results Show.”
“We have to hurry…”
“With you and Qingwei, there’s no problem. It’s just that you have to work hard.” Legend Hua smiled and said to Shi Yu,
“Dr. Zuo and Qing Wei’s talents can accelerate or slow the growth of their pets. It’s similar to the accelerated growth effect of the Beast Taming Space, but it’s not limited to the pets they contract, and the effect is stronger. Their talents are very suitable for research on insect-type life forms.”
“In other words, they can quickly let the cocoon digest the evolution power like the butterfly god and complete the evolution. However, this talent consumes a little physical strength. The supplements during this period probably can’t be neglected.”
Shi Yu was stunned.
“That’s easy. I’ll provide the supplements.”
Baby Ginseng, for the sake of evolution materials, as long as it didn’t die, it would provide mountains of supplements!
Dr. Zuo and Xia Qingwei :”…”
Dr. Zuo: “In that case, let’s find a place now. I want to see the form of the green cocoon after evolution.”
“Then…” Shi Yu looked at Principal Feng. So, what about the research institute?
For the soil of time, Shi Yu risked it all.
During this period, Baby Ginseng didn’t do anything else. It obediently created supplements and nutritional fruits to increase its evolution potential. It could work hard to let Dr. Zuo and Xia Qingwei open the cocoon for seven days and seven nights in a row.
“The research institute definitely needs some time to prepare…” Principal Feng said.
“Then let’s go to the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute first. In any case, the infrastructure there is relatively complete, and it’s currently in an idle state,” Shi Yu said.
The few of them nodded and had no objections.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s not close. I’ll bring everyone over.”
He called out, and a beautiful butterfly figure appeared. Seeing this, everyone was slightly stunned.
“Use Instant Transmission,” Shi Yu explained. “This is faster.”
“Wu ~” Buggy gently flapped its wings, aggrieved. It directly changed from a private car to a bus?
“The Butterfly of Imagination!” The moment Buggy appeared, Dr. Zuo and Xia Qingwei’s expressions immediately changed.
Dr. Zuo looked excited. To be honest, compared to studying the Green Silkworm cocoon, she wanted to study the Butterfly of Imagination more. However, it was really difficult for her to say such an unreasonable request.
In comparison, Xia Qingwei looked at the haggard Buggy and was a little at a loss. She didn’t understand why the Imagination Butterfly, which had previously been impressive and domineering, who had made them lose their battle will with a glance, looked so haggard now.
It was a monster to its enemies, but in the team, it was like a mascot!
“Alright, let’s go.” Shi Yu was also quite anxious.
As the few of them observed, Buggy’s Psychic power had already wrapped around the 51 Green Silkworms and Green Silkworm cocoons present and was about to teleport.
“Everyone, please let its psychic power wrap around you,” Shi Yu said.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the few of them hurriedly nodded. Their bodies were wrapped in blue light as they instantly disappeared from the spot.
…
Iron-eating Beast Research Institute.
At the training ground.
The three little Iron-eating Beasts were entertaining themselves and training.
They were extremely aggrieved because after Leader Eleven returned from the capital, it didn’t take much care of them. It said that they had graduated and could already train on their own.
This was purely because Buggy had become so strong all of a sudden, making Eleven feel a sense of danger. It worked even harder to run to undergo devil training and didn’t have much time to take care of babies anymore.
“What’s this…”
On the training ground, Shi Yu and the others gradually appeared.
After arriving here, Legend Hua looked at the three little Iron-eating Beasts who were using hardened iron fists to hit stakes and sprinting to do physical training on the training ground. She fell into deep thought.
This was the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute?
Research on how to make the Iron-eating Beast more diligent?
When the few of them arrived, the three little Iron-eating Beasts immediately looked over. After discovering that it wasn’t the leader, but the leader’s master, they couldn’t help but show expectant expressions.
“You guys play by yourselves.” However, Shi Yu’s words made the three little Iron-eating Beasts extremely disappointed.
“Wu wu wu… (Continue, continue.)”
Shi Yu :”…”
Eleven’s mental seal was still impressive.
Not only Legend Hua, but Principal Feng, Dr. Zuo, and Xia Qingwei also had strange expressions.
Among them, Principal Feng was still alright. After all, he had already heard of the Iron-eating Beast legend of Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu: “Cough, ignore them. Let’s get down to business first.”
“Yes.” Dr. Zuo nodded.
The so-called business was naturally Dr. Zuo using his growth talent to help the green cocoon quickly absorb the evolution power and break out of the cocoon as soon as possible.
This training ground was quite wide, so the few of them decided to experiment here.
Dr. Zuo walked forward and looked at the 11 green cocoons. Her gaze locked onto one and he gently picked it up with both hands.
The green cocoon didn’t struggle either. After all, it was cultivated by the research institute. Its personality was relatively docile and cowardly.
Under everyone’s gaze, Dr. Zuo’s hands flickered slightly with fluorescent light. A huge amount of energy was injected into the green cocoon. At this moment, the green cocoon was stunned before it subconsciously closed its eyes.
In less than a minute, Dr. Zuo put down the green cocoon slightly and said, “It’s done. It can try to break out of the cocoon with its mind power to evolve at any time. The evolution power has been completely absorbed.”
“Eh, I’m old. I’m really tired. You’ll be the one assisting in the next cocoon,” Dr. Zuo said.
“Huh?”
Xia Qingyi was stunned and looked at her mother.
Wait, she was tired just like that?
When she was experimenting previously, she clearly didn’t even pant when assisting the evolution of dozens of Green Silkworms in one go. Now, she was tired from just one?
Xia Qingwei suddenly felt that she had been brought here to be a tool for the evolution accelerator.
“It’s alright, I have enough supplements.”
“Baby Ginseng.” When Shi Yu saw this, he felt that he couldn’t let others work for nothing, so he summoned Baby Ginseng.
Baby Ginseng was also smart. After coming out, it immediately condensed a cigarette-shaped nutritional supplement with its nutritional and sweet aura skill.
“Yi!!” It ran over to Dr. Zuo, wanting to hand it to her.
As the saying went, a young woman with a cigarette was like a fairy descending into the mortal world. This was taught to it by Grandma Li’s supplementary pets. They said that Grandma Li loved smoking supplements the most back then. Every time she finished, her temper would temporarily improve.
“Yi…”
“Uh.” Dr. Zuo looked at the ginseng baby Shi Yu suddenly summoned and handed her a cigarette. She was stunned.
“Baby Ginseng!” Shi Yu’s stomach hurt. Who the hell taught you that!
Sensing Shi Yu’s reprimand, Baby Ginseng immediately shuddered. It ravaged the cigarette in its hand a few times, rubbed it into a cherry-like nutritional substance, and handed it over again.
“Nutrition?” Dr. Zuo smiled and took the nutritional substance. She smiled and said, “Thank you, little guy.”
Speaking of which, Shi Yu actually contracted a ginseng baby with him??
“Apart from nutritional supplements, it might also be an Energy Fruit Cherry Bomb.” Beside him, Principal Feng pondered. He had heard of the battle between Baby Ginseng and the battle club.
Dr. Zuo just took the cherry and almost threw it out.
“It’s a nutritional supplement, and it’s a combination skill of sweet aura and nutritional supplements. The fruit wraps around the sweet aura, so there’s no need to eat it. Just putting it close to your nose and smelling it can relieve a lot of fatigue,” Shi Yu said helplessly.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng made another one and handed it to Xia Qingwei.
Baby Ginseng had a sincere expression. Good luck, auntie in a research suit and big sister who had been beaten by Buggy. Its evolution materials will depend on your explosive research.
Let it see where their limits are!
“Uh, thank you.”
Xia Qingwei also recognized Baby Ginseng. Wasn’t this one of the little pets that plucked flower honey with Buggy in the garden back then?
Apart from it, there was also a little Iron-eating Beast and little fire sword spirit. They should be Shi Yu’s pets…
At this moment, after Dr. Zuo took a deep breath, she had already placed the cherry nutrient provided by the ginseng baby on the tip of her nose and smelled it.
“Wu…”
In the next moment, she immediately felt refreshed. The fatigue from rushing from Demon Capital to the ancient capital disappeared like smoke. It was as if she had just woken up in the morning and come to an extremely fresh place to breathe in the scent of nature.
The relief in his body made Dr. Zuo look shocked.
“This…” Dr. Zuo took away the nutritional supplements and put aside the upper limit of the effect first. Just this quality that completely relaxed the mind, body, and mind as if it was one with nature was too rare.
“Its nutritional and sweet aura level should be very high, right?”
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “And it’s a mutated race. It has a super skill that enhances the effect of recovery-type skills.”
“As expected, it’s not an ordinary ginseng baby!” Xia Qingwei thought to herself.
She knew that a genius like Shi Yu wouldn’t contract any ordinary pet.
“Looks like Li Lianping gave you a good pet.” Principal Feng looked at Dr. Zuo’s surprised expression and clicked his tongue in wonder.
A moment later, out of curiosity, Xia Qingwei also smelled the nutrient. In the next second, her expression was red, and her whole body was so numb that she almost wanted to moan. She hurriedly took this thing away.
For ordinary Beast Tamers, the supplement of the ginseng baby was indeed a little strong.
There weren’t many Beast Tamers like Shi Yu who ate nutrients as if they were fruits without a change in expression.
“It can evolve now, right?”
After Shi Yu got Baby Ginseng to distribute the nutrients, he looked at the green cocoon that had already been successfully accelerated and opened its eyes again.
At this moment, the green cocoon’s expression was confused as it stayed on the spot at a loss.
“Yes.” Dr. Zuo nodded.
“In that case, Green Worm cocoon, try to break out of the cocoon.” Shi Yu said to the cocoon, “Do you know what to do?”
“Wu ~ ~” Buggy also instructed.
When the green cocoon heard the command, its body immediately swayed. Its eyes emitted a dark light. It activated its Psychic power and tried to break free from the cocoon’s restraints from the inside to completely release its potential.
“Ji!!!” At this moment, the green insect cocoon actually let out a rare sound.
Then, with a hum, an evolution light erupted from its body.
Everyone held their breaths.
Under the lingering light of evolution, the cocoon underwent a huge change. With a boom, under the pressure of Psychic power, the cocoon directly exploded, turning into white silk that flew in all directions.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu’s heart ached. He recalled the cocoon that had been obliterated into nothingness by the spiritual and spatial powers when the worm evolved…
He originally wanted it to be fertilizer for the ginseng baby, but in the end, there was nothing. When these guys evolved, couldn’t they be a little gentler and take it off bit by bit like taking off their clothes??
It was ridiculous to tear it open directly. Why was it in such a hurry to reincarnate?
“It evolved!”
Although the green cocoon had exploded, the white light inside was still as before, gradually forming a new figure. Xia Qingyi exclaimed.
At the same time, the energy value of the Invisibility index in front of Shi Yu quickly changed.
[Name]:???
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]:???
Energy Points: 571
“Its energy level is 571, more than double. It can be said to be quite high for butterflies,” Shi Yu said in surprise.
“Moreover, the information is unknown. It’s a new race!”
As soon as he finished speaking, the light dissipated. A butterfly that was less than the size of a palm and was completely crystalline and white appeared in front of everyone with bright spots on its wings.
“What (ni) ~” This newly born butterfly immediately cried out softly.
“It’s indeed a new race.” The eyes of the worm-element expert, Legend Hua, and Dr. Zuo lit up when they saw this butterfly.
At this moment, under Buggy’s instructions, this new butterfly flew up and displayed its newly awakened racial skills for everyone.
Its crystal wings flapped, and a large amount of shining crystal powder quickly appeared. Soon, the crystal powder was attacked by a wave of Psychic power and blew forward fiercely!
After completing all of this, this evolution form fell from the sky and fell to the ground to sleep.
Everyone :”…”
After a moment of silence, Dr. Zuo said, “If I’m not wrong, what happened just now was a low-level spiritual skill, Psychic, mid-level spiritual skill, Psychic Powder, high-level spiritual skill, Absolute Sleep.”
“Transcendent level. Not long after breaking through and evolution, it has 571 energy points. Moreover, it has three spiritual skills. Without a doubt, this is a high-level transcendent race.”
“The cost of 100,000 yuan, a high-level transcendent race, and a rare spiritual element. The strategic value of the Green Silkworm cocoon is going to be infinitely expanded.” The more she spoke, the more excited she became.
Psychic fan.
After touching the Spiritual Crystal Powder, it would produce one of the effects of spiritual poison, mental paralysis, and spiritual sleep. It was very powerful.
Not only were they important materials for medicine, but their tactical value was also very high.
Absolute Sleep was even more so. If it wasn’t useful, Shi Yu wouldn’t have taught this skill to every pet.
This was simply a training divine skill that could greatly reduce the burden of cultivation.
In the evolution laws concluded by Lin Feng’s legend, although evolution didn’t increase race level 100%, it awakened new racial skills 100%. Now, two mysterious butterflies that had awakened new racial skills directly surprised Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, and Xia Qingwei.
Generally speaking, when the Green Silkworm evolved normally, it would only have one more wind blade skill.
But now, spending hundreds of thousands more for three more spiritual skills was simply unimaginable.
“So strong?” Shi Yu also looked at the butterfly blankly.
This outcome exceeded his imagination.
He originally thought that it would be a middle-level transcendent race, but he didn’t expect that it actually directly reached a high-level transcendent race!
If that was the case, the cost-effective ratio of this butterfly was definitely super high for most Beast Tamers.
After all, the Green Silkworm was not expensive, and the evolution materials were very cheap.
The greatest difficulty and regret might be that even if the worm silk was only cultivated to expert level, it was not a simple thing for ordinary Beast Tamers.
Also, the lifespan of transcendent butterfly-type creatures wouldn’t be too long. If they couldn’t break through the racial limit, they might only be able to accompany Beast Tamers for ten years. Compared to Iron-eating Beasts that had decades of lifespan, they were also much inferior.
But this was enough. The value of a high-level transcendent pet for ten years completely exceeded the cost of this investment. It was a very good initial pet that could quickly help Beast Tamers enter the Beast Taming Domain.
Sometimes, it wasn’t that many people didn’t have abilities or talent. What they lacked was a stepping stone, and the evolution of the green cocoon was the best stepping stone!
“A very outstanding race,” Dr. Zuo said. “Although it can’t increase high-end battle power, it can greatly reduce the threshold for ordinary people to become Beast Tamers.”
“Compared to the Wind Crystal Butterfly that the usual Green Silkworm evolved into naturally… This pet’s growth potential is very huge.”
“The all-purpose basic skill, Psychic Power, has been developed appropriately. It can satisfy all needs. Not only is the Psychic Powder very tactical, but it can also be collected and sold to subsidize Beast Tamers. Absolute Sleep can accelerate the growth of pets and increase the efficiency of training. It can allow the worm-element sprites with fast battle power to form battle power faster. This is simply the most suitable pet race for low-level Beast Tamers.”
Although Legend Hua, Principal Feng, and the others had previously realized that the potential of the Green Silkworm cocoon would be very large, the potential of the new race born from the two consecutive evolution of the Green Silkworm still shocked them.
“Principal Feng, I knew it. The Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University is about to take off.” Legend Hua looked at Principal Feng with the same smile as Dr. Zuo.
Principal Feng grinned. “What do you mean take off? It’s mainly to contribute to the Beast Taming Domain of Dong Huang. Ancient Capital University will cooperate fully in the subsequent research!”
“Shi Yu, well done!”
Xia Qingwei also looked at Shi Yu and was completely convinced.
“This isn’t the end.”
“This is only the result of the evolution materials of the expert level worm silk and the green worm cocoon. What if it’s the perfect level worm silk, the transcendent level worm silk?”
“Is it possible to give birth to a new pet of a commander race, or even a monarch race? If other materials are added, is it possible to give birth to a butterfly with two attributes!” Dr. Zuo said. “The experiment is far from over. The rare Feeding Conference has to be shown more results.”
“Qingwei, let’s speed up the experiment together.”
“I understand.” Xia Qingwei heaved a sigh of relief when she saw that her mother didn’t choose to squeeze her dry. However, at the same time, she was very excited. It was tiring to participate in such a major research.
“Then I’ll have to trouble everyone.” Shi Yu was also very satisfied. Was the soil of time stable?
“By the way, the name of this pet…” Dr. Zuo said.
Legend Hua: “Shi Yu, you name it.”
Shi Yu casually said, “Name whatever you want. I think it should be called the Crystal Thought Butterfly. Let’s form a family with the Wind Crystal Butterfly, the Flame Crystal Butterfly, and the Dark Crystal Butterfly.”
“So casual…”
…
Then, the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute was temporarily changed to the Green Silkworm Cocoon Research Institute. Everyone studied it excitedly.
As for the old principal of Ancient Capital University, he hurriedly went to help Shi Yu register for the Feeding Conference in the name of Ancient Capital University.
The Feeding Conference was the big event of the third bureau. The large-scale exhibition hosted by the Feeding Association was a very important stage. Several large financial groups and nine major universities would participate, and it was also a relatively important opportunity. Principal Feng was overjoyed. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to be quite so reliable.
“Hehe.” Principal Feng walked happily.
“Ah, Grandpa Feng.” The beast-eared girl, White Brook, accidentally bumped into him.
Seeing that Principal Feng was so happy, she smiled and said, “What’s good?”
“Yes, you will know later. Where are you going?” Principal Feng chuckled and said, keeping it a secret.
“Go find Shi Yu and talk to him about the exchange activity with Imperial Capital University. We plan to set off to Imperial Capital next week,” White Brook said.
Principal Feng’s face fell and he said, “No, no, no, what exchange activity? Don’t let him be distracted by this kind of thing.”
White Brook:???
Principal Feng thought to himself that Shi Yu would also go to the capital in a week, but not to participate in any exchange activity, but to participate in the Feeding Conference!
If there was a conflict in time, the Feeding Conference was more important!
…
At the same time, in the capital, at the headquarters of the Feeder Association.
For the upcoming Feeding Conference, this place also became busy.
Not only here, but in Imperial Capital University, the new and senior students of Imperial Capital University’s battle club also increased their training in order to welcome the upcoming battle club exchange with Ancient Capital University.
They were neither arrogant nor impatient. No matter who the opponent was, they had to deal with it seriously. This was the social training of Imperial Capital University’s battle club. Even if the opponent was the weak Ancient Capital University, they were still seriously preparing for battle as usual.
However, social training was social training. They did it on the surface, but in the heart, not everyone valued it that much.
It had only been half a year since the end of the National League, so how could they not know the strength that the Ancient Capital University had?
“Zhengfan, the training is over. Aren’t you leaving?” A beautiful two pony-tailed woman shouted at the young man in the arena.
Yin Zhengfan, a reserve newcomer of the battle club at Imperial Capital University. Because he was very young, he could be considered the most cared for member here.
Most importantly, Yin Zhengfan himself was also very hardworking. This made others have no choice but to admire this child.
“Senior, I still want to train a little longer,” Yin Zhengfan said.
“Don’t tire yourself out.” The battle society sister shook her head and left first. Everyone knew why Yin Zhengfan was working so hard. Was it because of the battle club exchange with Ancient Capital University?
If they weren’t wrong, Yin Zhengfan should be very concerned about a Beast Tamer of the same period in Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu, this year’s top scholar in the Ancient Capital assessment, the only one who defeated Yin Zhengfan.
However, Shi Yu was only a new student after all. He might not necessarily participate in this exchange. In fact, it was said that the other party was from the archaeology Department. It was even uncertain if he had joined the battle club of Ancient Capital University. Yin Zhengfan had worked so hard to prepare for battle, so he might not even have seen the person in the end.
“But if Shi Yu really comes, he’ll definitely be shocked by the change in Zhengfan’s strength.”
“The growth atmosphere of the two schools is completely heaven and earth.”
The senior left the venue with a smile.. Even in the Imperial Capital University where monsters gathered, Yin Zhengfan, who had fought hard enough, was considered one of the best among the new students. Perhaps she should help Yin Zhengfan investigate Shi Yu’s current situation?

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - Undying Pond
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Undying Pond
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
A week later.
Ancient Capital, Ancient Capital University.
In the student dormitory, Shi Yu and the others were packing their luggage.
This trip to the capital would take at least a week. He had to be prepared.
“Wuu!”
At this moment, Eleven pushed open the door. It was crackling all over and had clearly just returned from the charging room.
It was normal for it to be filled with electricity before leaving.
“Wu…”
“Wu…”
It wasn’t interested in the Feeding Conference, but it was interested in the exchange activity with Imperial Capital University.
Shi Yu had been unwilling to organize the team’s internal meeting for a long time. It shouldn’t be a problem for them to attack outsiders, right?
In the past seven days, Buggy had already mastered the two super skills, the Space Domain and the Dragon of Imagination.
In Shi Yu’s team, the only one who was more concerned about the Feeding Conference was Baby Ginseng. After all, it concerned its evolution materials.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng wiped its sweat and finished preparing a basket of gem fruits. This was something to show respect to the overlord cat before leaving.
Moonlight Gem, soil of time… One was related to the moon, and the other was related to time. Baby Ginseng felt that it was about to be invincible in the team. During this period, it had to be good and ensure that its evolution was smooth.
The most carefree person was Chi Tong. It wasn’t interested in the battle exchange or the Feeding Conference. It only wanted to go to the Undead Battlefield with Shi Yu to kill the spirits after these two events ended.
“Are you leaving?”
As Shi Yu and the others were preparing in the room, a whirlwind lingered above the sofa. With a flash of light, the gem cat’s figure appeared on the sofa and it was licking its claws as it looked at Shi Yu.
“Yes, we’ll set off in a while.” Shi Yu patted his luggage.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng shouted for the gem cat and pointed at the fruit basket behind it.
“Good baby.” The gem cat’s glass-like eyes lit up.
Teacher Cat, I didn’t dote on you for nothing!
“By the way, Teacher Ying, it’s been more than ten days,” Shi Yu asked. “Is there any news of the mutated environment?”
Previously, when he went to the resource bank to choose resources, Shi Yu also asked about the mutated environment.
The gem cat had lived for more than a hundred years. In theory, it should be very knowledgeable.
But from the looks of it, there was no outcome?
Shi Yu chose to ask Legend Hua or Principal Feng and the others later.
“Ah, this.”
The gem cat had already walked to the side of the ginseng baby. With a pat of its paw, the fruit basket had already been teleported to god knows where.
It turned around and said slowly with a hesitant expression,
“I only thought of one thing, that it might be a little dangerous.”
“Where?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yi?!” Baby Ginseng was also stunned.
Danger?
Baby Ginseng was least afraid of danger.
Born in a place where monarchs roamed everywhere in the forbidden zone, it had seen all kinds of danger.
As for the danger that the mutation environment posed to it… Baby Ginseng didn’t care even more.
It was a ruthless ginseng that had successfully eaten a level-eight resource and survived when it was young.
In order to become stronger, it even wanted to eat a few mouthfuls to increase its evolution foundation before evolution, but it didn’t know if it was useful…
“A place in the Undead Battlefield.”
The gem cat recalled and said, “Perhaps, probably, it still exists.”
“Compared to a blessed land, that place is more like a dangerous place.”
“Dangerous place…?”
“Well, the land of death is called the Undying Pond. It contains incomparable death power. Even if monarch-level creatures come into contact with it, they might be corroded by the death power. It’s one of the seven dangerous places in the undead battlefield.”
“A large number of undead have come into contact with the lake water before, and their souls were instantly corroded by the power of death.”
“Uh…” Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng’s expressions stiffened.
A pool filled with the power of death?
Shi Yu glanced at the ginseng baby. The ginseng baby was wood-element. It would definitely major in life force in the future. It didn’t match.
“This pool can mutate plant pets??” Shi Yu asked.
The gem cat nodded and said, “Of course. Firstly, you have to understand how it was born.”
“The Undying Pond was formed after the death of an overlord who mainly cultivated the power of death. Because that overlord was too strong, it caused the environment to change.”
“Change the environment…” Shi Yu nodded.
The symbol of a monarch-level creature was awakening deterrence.
As for the symbol of an overlord-level creature, it was the initial mastery of special powers such as the power of nature. It could use natural power to increase the power of the skill, and the aftermath of the power could almost permanently change the environment of a place.
This was also why the legends in Icefield City said that the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain was formed after the frost dragon arrived.
However, the power of death didn’t belong to one type of natural power. Instead, like life force, mental strength, and soul power, it belonged to a special power. If natural power was to cultivate external forces, then the power of death and life were to train one’s own strength.
The difference between the two was that different environments might have different effects on the strength of overlord creatures.
An overlord race that majored in natural power and was a water-type creature, for example… In the sea, borrowing the power of the endless sea might not necessarily be impossible for it to resist fire-element totem-level creatures.
At the overlord level, the concept of energy value was even less of a reference for the pet’s strength, because no one knew how much the pet had trained in the power of nature. After all, no matter how strong its own strength was, it was rare for it to fight against the power of nature.
The factors of the venue had a very huge impact on the strength of overlord-level creatures.
Therefore, generally speaking, overlords in the wild had their own fixed territories. If they fought in their own territories, their battle power would increase greatly.
If it went to an area that was disadvantageous, its battle power would decrease.
This was also the reason why the ocean had always been a forbidden area that humans couldn’t enter.
After all, a simple tsunami triggered by the sea overlord was enough to make most Beast Tamers suffer.
Compared to overlords who cultivated the power of nature, pets who cultivated special powers like life force and death power that belonged to them didn’t really care about the environment they fought in. If it excluded external forces, its own qualities were also stronger than pets who cultivated natural power at the same level. However, these special powers were even harder to cultivate compared to natural power.
For example, Baby Ginseng’s Earth Chain and Energy Storage Beam were actually prototypes of controlling natural power, and its source of life skill was a skill to train its own life force.
Naturally, it was not like there were no pets that trained natural powers themselves. However, the effort invested and the requirements for their race would definitely be greater. In most cases, it was the super skills of the pets that determined the subsequent development.
If it couldn’t awaken a new super skill, Baby Ginseng would definitely mainly train its life force in the future. After all, it had the super ability of the source of life, and like Earth Chain, even if it was trained to the maximum level, it was only a mid-level skill after all. The potential to cultivate the natural power of the earth was definitely far inferior to developing life force.
“That overlord dual cultivated death power and water power, so it led to the change in the environment. The pool water also contains rich death power, which will erode life forms. But if the pet that comes into contact with the pool water has talent related to death power, or if its life force is strong enough to withstand the death power, it can understand the true meaning of death.” The gem cat symbolically licked its claws and continued,
“You humans previously had a legendary Beast Tamer who contracted an Ancient Tree of Life who wanted to cleanse this dangerous place. After all, if such a place is left in the wild, although ordinary undead wouldn’t dare to come into contact with it, if there are undead who obtain benefits from it, it will give it the opportunity to break through to the overlord level.”
“However, during the process of cleansing the Undying Pond, the Beast Tamer’s Ancient Tree of Life accidentally comprehended the power of death during the battle between the life force and the power of death. It mutated and evolved into the first case of Dong Huang, the Ancient Tree of Life and Death of a middle-level overlord race. At the same time, it controlled the two special powers of life and death.”
“After that, he gave up on the cleansing pond and chose to seal this place with others. He relied on this method to avoid wild undead contact. After all, there are too few environments in the country that purely contain the power of death. This kind of place is very rare. It’s a pity to completely cleanse it.”
Baby Ginseng listened with interest.
Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong listened with interest.
Buggy couldn’t help but sigh. This nonsense sounded even more high-end than its evolution materials.
Eleven, on the other hand, was puzzled. It kept feeling that it was the most normal one in the team.
Shi Yu was also slightly stunned.
“Really, the Ancient Tree of Life and Death?”
Aunt Tree of Life could also evolve?
The Tree of Life… The Ancient Tree of Life… The Ancient Tree of Life and Death… Should “Dead Ancient Tree” be the next one?
“It’s real. I participated in the crusade against that overlord and even participated in the sealing of the Undying Pond.”
The gem cat raised its head proudly, although at that time, it wasn’t that strong. Instead of saying that it participated in the crusade of that overlord, it was more like it participated in the crusade of that overlord’s subordinates.
[A special environment that might cause plants with strong vitality to mutate and control the power of death?]
Shi Yu memorized it secretly. To be honest, this power was not in Shi Yu’s plans at all in the beginning.
His original plan was to let the wood-element ginseng baby increase its earth-element and light-element talent more. This way, he could borrow the power of nature to freeload and create as many supplements as possible.
However, the weak power of time attached to the soil and the Undying Pond mentioned by the gem cat immediately made Shi Yu conflicted.
His plans couldn’t keep up with changes?
Although he didn’t know what changes Baby Ginseng could make after learning the power of death, it sounded so powerful. Shi Yu decided to consider it carefully before making plans.
“Why don’t you take me there to take a look when we go to the Undead Battlefield?” Shi Yu asked softly.
“Sure ~” The gem cat yawned. If it were the initial Undying Pond, it definitely wouldn’t have brought Shi Yu over. However, the current Undying Pond’s power had already been mostly purified, and its power was relatively weaker. With it, an overlord, protecting it, there wouldn’t be any danger.
“Thank you!” Shi Yu smiled and moved away. Beside him, Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought.
This mutated environment sounded much more dangerous than the Moonlight Gem and the soil of time.
Was it reliable?
Moonlight Gem+Time Soil+Undying Pool+Ginseng Baby =??
The strange mutation route increased again.
…
At the Ancient Capital Airport.
Shi Yu, who had been chatting with the gem cat for a long time, almost forgot about the serious matter. If it weren’t for the calls from Legend Hua and the others, he would still be imagining the evolution path.
After hurriedly putting away their luggage, Shi Yu got Buggy to teleport them to the school’s mechanical school.
“Coming, coming.”
When Shi Yu saw that Principal Feng, Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, Student Xia, and even Dean Hao were waiting here, he smiled and said.
On this trip to the capital, no one planned to take the airport plane.
Instead, they planned to directly let Dean Hao of the Mechanical College use its monarch race, the monarch-level Mysterious Meteorite to receive them. This was a mechanical life form that was not inferior to the Purple Electric Mecha.
This speed was undoubtedly faster…
“Shi Yu, not bad,” Dean Hao said in admiration the moment they met.
What a little monster.
Dean Hao, who had just helped Shi Yu complete the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast a few months ago, originally thought that Shi Yu would use the Nine Li Battle Beast to quickly rise in university. Who would have expected that not long after, Shi Yu would run to Divine Capital to evolve the Imagination Butterfly of a middle-level overlord race himself?
He also received the joint support of Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, and Principal Feng to launch an incomparably huge research project in Ancient Capital University.
“Dean Hao, you’ve worked hard.” Shi Yu laughed.
“What hard work? It’s a pleasure to be able to contribute to Ancient Capital University.” Dean Hao chuckled.
Everyone :”…”
Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, Xia Qingwei: Was this the school culture of Ancient Capital University?
“Let’s go,” Principal Feng said with a smile.
The few of them immediately boarded the Mystic Meteorite.
Driving this thing could let them sweep through the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and the Undead Battlefield. Not many monarch-level creatures were willing to provoke it. Using it as a transportation tool, the few of them could be said to be quite comfortable.
However, it was a pity that the Mystic Meteorite was not big. It could only carry the few of them at most. Otherwise, Principal Feng might even have planned to pull White Brook and the other members of the battle club who had gone to Imperial Capital University to communicate together.
Now, he could only let White Brook and the others take the plane to the airport.
“This is your first time going to the capital, right?”
After getting on the plane, Principal Feng asked Shi Yu.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“The first time you’re going, and soon you’re going to be famous all over the country. Are you nervous?” Dr. Zuo smiled.
After researching the Crystal Butterfly, they really had a new breakthrough.
It was a huge breakthrough.
If it was only the green worm cocoon, they still had doubts about first place in the Feeding Conference.
But now, in the eyes of Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, and the others, the first place in the Feeding Conference would definitely be Shi Yu’s.
“Shi Yu is still very low-profile. If he wanted to, his name would have already spread throughout the country when he was in Divine Capital.” Legend Hua smiled.
After she finished speaking, Principal Feng and Dean Hao had strange expressions.
Shi Yu kept a low profile?
He was thinking too much!
Did a person with the title of Iron-eating Beast Knight look like a Beast Tamer who could keep a low profile?
They suspected that Shi Yu was most likely studying the Butterfly Knight and was holding it in!
Shi Yu :”…”
“Cough, I’ve been looking forward to the capital for a long time.” Shi Yu coughed dryly.
He looked ahead.
In the capital, in the current capital and political center of Dong Huang, there were the most number of legendary Beast Tamers, as well as the top educational institutions with the strongest comprehensive strength…
The headquarters of the Beast Tamer Association, the headquarters of the Feeder Association, and many other important associations were established here. It was a place with a relatively rich Beast Tamer atmosphere.
Two hundred years ago, a totem battle that swept through the world began. For the time being, only a piece of pure land was left in the capital.
This totem battle lasted for decades. It was an important opportunity for the seven countries to form an alliance. At that time, the representatives of the seven countries officially confirmed the alliance in the capital of Dong Huang. After the totem battle ended, Dong Huang built the Beast Tamer Association headquarters here.
From then on, this place also replaced the other capitals in history and became the center of a new country.
In addition, the economic development level here was also very high, so the overall number of Beast Tamers was also one of the best in the nine first-level cities. Someone had said that the nine major universities were divided into two tiers. One tier was a top-level institute led by the Imperial Capital and the Demon Capital University, and the other was a regular top-level institute.
“I should be able to make it in time for the exchange…” Shi Yu thought to himself. He wondered what the beast-eared girl and the others were doing now. Touring?
Three days later was the exchange between the two schools. At that time, the Feeding Conference would probably be over…
At the same time, at Imperial Capital University.
As the exchange between the two schools approached, a student from the Imperial Capital University, a senior who had always taken good care of Yin Zhengfan, chose to ask about Shi Yu out of curiosity.
Because at this time, the exchange team members of Ancient Capital University should have been confirmed. Generally speaking, this kind of exchange activity was usually brought by the president and his old members. After all, they couldn’t avoid battle, but if there were new students with extreme potential, it was very likely to bring them here to broaden their horizons and train.
She opened her contact list and locked onto a name. This person was a relative of hers. Because of her family address and because her talent wasn’t especially outstanding, she chose Ancient Capital University.
“Cousin?” A puzzled and nervous voice came from the other side of the phone.
On the other end of the phone, in Ancient Capital University, Hong Xiao was stunned and a little nervous. His genius cousin rarely contacted him apart from family gatherings. Why was it… so sudden this time?
“Hong Xiao, did you come to the exchange team from Ancient Capital University this time?”
“How am I qualified to go with my strength?” Hong Xiao smiled bitterly.
Hong Xiao’s cousin had an expected speechless expression… She was disappointed.
“I have something to ask you.”
“Is there a student named Shi Yu in your school?”
“Why are you asking about him?” Hong Xiao’s expression darkened.
He recalled the fear of being dominated by Shi Yu’s ginseng baby during the battle assessment.
“I’m curious. Has he joined your battle club?”
“Yes, he joined.”
“Oh? How’s his strength?”
Hong Xiao: “…What are you doing?”
“I’m just asking if he joined the exchange team this time.”
Hong Xiao’s face was extremely dark. How could he not have joined? When the Beast-eared Lady President lectured them, she used Shi Yu as an example all day!
She always said obscure words like “I’m going to bring Shi Yu to sweep through Imperial Capital University”. This meant he was definitely in the exchange team.
“He should be there too.”
“What about strength?”
“I…” Hong smiled and said,” Why are you paying attention to a ‘new student’? ”
“I asked for it for a friend.”
Hong Xiao was silent and said, “This isn’t too good, right? Although it’s not any ‘important’ or ‘confidential’ information, I’m still from the battle club of Ancient Capital University. Cousin, you want me to sell information?”
“Pfft, is that necessary? Alright, I won’t ask anymore. I’m hanging up. It’s enough to know that he’s here too.”
“Eh, wait.” Hong Xiao hesitated for a moment and felt that it wasn’t good to say nothing. After all, they were relatives.
“What else do you want to say?”
Hong Xiao took a deep breath and recalled the battle where Shi Yu’s Nine Li Battle Beast crushed the Thunder Ray Beast. He brewed his emotions and advised, “Listen to me. Don’t fight him!”
“That kid is not human, son of a b*tch.”
“Remember, don’t fight him.”
“???”
In a classroom of Imperial Capital University, Tang Yun looked confused. Just at this moment, a teacher knocked on the door.
“I’m hanging up!” she said and looked at the teacher.
It was a female mentor in a research suit who came in. She looked at Tang Yun helplessly and said, “You just came back from training again.”
“You’re a student of the Feeding Department, and your talent is also in the Feeding Department. Why don’t you focus on your own specialization instead of going to the battle club to join in the fun all day long?”
Tang Yun chuckled and said, “Feeding and battle are the same.”
“Teacher Xie, what’s the matter?”
“Let me remind you of the things to take note of at the Feeding Conference tomorrow. Don’t mess up the rare opportunity to study.”
Tang Yun patted her chest and promised, “Don’t worry, I have applied for leave for the training at the battle club. I will cooperate with you, Mentor.”
Before that, she would first tell Zhengfan that Shi Yu had also come. Then, she would prepare for the Feeding Conference in peace!

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - The Eve of the Feeding Conference
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: The Eve of the Feeding Conference
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
That day, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the capital.
There were 33 teams for the Feeding Conference this time, not many.
The threshold of this meeting was relatively high.
Only the Feeding Association’s recognized feeding institutions, such as the nine major universities’ Feeding Department, the Feeding Research Team of well-known businesses, or the Feeding Team established by some famous Feeding Masters were qualified to register.
For example, although Ancient Capital University wasn’t famous for the Feeding Department, it was still a top-notch educational institution. It definitely signed up successfully without any pressure.
But if an unknown individual feeder wanted to show off the results of the feeding, the procedures would be complicated.
He would have to apply to the Feeding Association a month in advance. The judge, after feeling that after the feed results reached the standard, would decide that he could display the feed results with these top-level feed institutions and compete for the top resources provided by the third bureau.
This was also to screen some casual research enthusiasts. If there was no threshold for participation, the value of this Feeding Conference would be too low. Perhaps someone would develop a new type of dog food and eagerly come to participate.
At this moment, in an office in the Feeding Association building, the current president of the Feeding Association and a member of the third bureau, a man in a gray suit yawned and took the display list sent by his assistant.
The Feeding Conference was a competition organized by the third bureau. The reason for doing this competition was also very simple. Although the elites of the Feeding World were all in the third bureau, the intelligence of individuals was undoubtedly small compared to the intelligence of groups. By taking out rewards and letting some individuals and collectively display the results of the feeding research, it could also provide some ideas in their research direction.
Almost every year, the third bureau would start a certain amount of cooperation with some feed institutions through the Feeding Conference. Both parties would benefit from each other and promote the active development of Dong Huang’s feeding domain.
“There aren’t any new results this year.” He roughly glanced at the list.
New nutritional drinks?
Mixed spiritual plants?
Mutated tree fruit?
High-rank pet fertility medicine?
There was also the new evolution form of the Green Silkworm…
Although these feed results were definitely innovative and had good effects, in terms of type, they were still the same. They were still in a fixed field. No one created a new research direction.
Although it was not bad to study the existing domain in depth… The third bureau was actually to see the emergence of new domains.
“President, look, the participating team of Ancient Capital University…” The male assistant said,” It’s very strange. ”
“Eh?” The president of the Feeding Association, Ye Hui, first took a look at the results of the Feeding Research at Ancient Capital University… The Green Silkworm had a new evolution form?
There was nothing new…
However, as he saw the members’ configuration of the research team, his expression changed slightly.
The person-in-charge: Shi Yu.
Members: Hua Xiajin, Zuo Xiaoei, Xia Qingwei.
“This is…”
Hua Xiajin, Zuo Xiao’e, he was familiar with these two names.
Hua Xiajin was a legendary Beast Tamer. Although not all Beast Tamers knew his name, he was definitely not unfamiliar with someone of his status.
As for Dr. Zuo Xiao’e, there was even less of a need to say. She was a famous doctor in the Feeding World. She specialized in the research of the Worm Department and had studied the evolution form of a large number of Green Silkworms. She was at the highest level of a monarch race!
The problem was that Legend Hua was a legendary Beast Tamer in Divine Capital. Dr. Zuo was a professor at Demon Capital University. Why did they all go to Ancient Capital University!
He knew why his assistant wanted him to watch this team. The configuration was too strange. The in-charge… Shi Yu, who was this? He kept feeling that he had heard of it somewhere.
Ye Hui stared at it carefully for a while and contacted the research results of this feeding. A moment later, he was suddenly stunned.
That newcomer from Bureau 11 who had a pet that evolved into a middle-level overlord race, the Butterfly of Imagination, and cultivated a strange green cocoon pet?
“Sure, this kid, I see.” He thought for a moment and immediately understood.
This newcomer from Bureau 11 could actually let a legendary Beast Tamer and a famous doctor assist in research. Ridiculous, why didn’t such a genius newcomer appear in the third bureau? Speaking of which, why didn’t the other party do his archeology since that was his field? Now that he had entered the Feeding World, President Ye Hui fell into deep thought.
“By the way, adjust their display order forward.”
“I’m a little curious. What did they create on that foundation…”
…
“We’re finally here.”
On the other side, in the huge hotel prepared by the Feeding Association for the 33 exhibition teams, Shi Yu came to his room exhausted and fell onto the bed.
Although he had been riding a fighter aircraft the whole way, it was quite tiring. Shi Yu finally understood why Dean Hao’s Secret Meteorite had so many seats. It was because this mechanical life form could actually be driven using the energy of many people. Dean Hao jokingly let Shi Yu try it. After Shi Yu really tried, he was directly drained out of a lot of energy.
Dean Hao said that at the moment, many large mechanical lives in the country were like this. Although they were mainly made up of one Beast Tamer, they could be strengthened by multiple people. This was the main development direction of mechanical lives at the moment, and it could maximize the gathering of the power of some idle Beast Tamers.
If another war really happened, they wouldn’t be able to count on Beast Tamers below the Legendary level to change the situation. It would be pretty good if they could protect themselves.
But if there was a kind of overlord-level mechanical life form that could gather the power of thousands of low-level Beast Tamers and condense their power into one, that low-level Beast Tamer would also have the ability to change the battle.
When ten thousand Beast Tamers with thunder-element strengthening talent strengthened a battleship together and fired a huge thunder-element cannon, the power would definitely be stronger than a Beast Tamer strengthening alone.
The malleability of mechanical lives was also the reason why various countries developed it.
“I’ve also flown a fighter plane before… Although I didn’t get to shoot the cannon on the way…”
Just as Shi Yu was thinking about what his mechanical life pet would be like, there was a knock on the door.
“Shi Yu.” Xia Qingwei’s voice sounded along with the thumps.
