“Little Xia, what’s wrong?” Shi Yu stretched and opened the door. He looked at the research assistant in a blue dress.
“Are you going to eat? My mom asked me to call you.” Xia Qingwei was annoyed. She was a little famous in Demon Capital University, an influential figure in the Demon University team. When she arrived at Ancient Capital University, she was directly reduced to Little Xia. The key was that Xia Qingwei couldn’t have a temper, because regardless of strength or feeding, she was crushed by Shi Yu.
“The hotel has a buffet. You can eat all three meals there.”
“Did Auntie Zuo and the others go?” Shi Yu asked.
“My mom and Aunt Hua said they were going to see a friend. It’s just the two of us.”
“I’m not hungry. You go,” Shi Yu said.
Xia Qingwei: “?”
Shi Yu had already eaten the nutrient fruit of the ginseng baby. He was no longer hungry, but the after-effect was a little strong. He only wanted to lie down and sleep now.
“Alright.” Xia Qingwei didn’t invite him anymore. She said, “If you’re hungry, go yourself. Remember to stay on the tenth floor.”
“Alright, thank you.” After Shi Yu sent Xia Qingwei away, he prepared to rest well and welcome the exhibition tomorrow. He first took out the research suit gifted by Principal Feng and planned to change his Fire Demon coat into this next.
This research suit should be the same as Senior Lu’s. According to Principal Feng, it was made of the top-notch level-six material. It was very expensive and had multiple effects such as spiritual and soul strengthening.
After preparing the clothes, Shi Yu yawned and took a last look at the situation in the ruins space.
Eleven was practicing the combination skill with the Giant Transformation skill as the core.
After Shi Yu pointed Eleven’s Giant Transformation to “Dao Proficiency”, apart from turning Eleven into a hundred-meter-tall beast, the greatest change was that it had the special ability of Giant Transformation.
It was roughly reflected that if Eleven released the Thunder Palm, it could completely erupt with more power at the standard of enlarging. With its one-meter body, it could slap a huge Thunder Palm 100 meters in diameter away from itself and crush the enemy, allowing the skill to exceed the original upper limit.
Shi Yu named it: Giant Transformation Skill.
Compared to releasing a skill after the transformation, the difference was that the energy consumption was much smaller, but the power was not much different.
Not only did it retain the flexibility of the small body, but it also obtained the explosive power of the enlarged body.
Compared to the hardworking Eleven, Little Chi Tong was very comfortable. It lay on the ice pile and roasted the yam nutritional supplements that Baby Ginseng had prepared for it. It looked at Buggy and Baby Ginseng, who were researching new combination tactics, freely.
“Wu!” Buggy and Baby Ginseng argued.
It believed that it should seal the enemy in the spatial shackles and then use Instant Transmission to transfer the large number of explosive energy fruits created by Baby Ginseng into the sealed space. Finally, they would detonate the spatial and energy fruits at the same time. Only then would the power be sufficient. It could be said to be “Invincible Wuji”, the strongest strategy!
“Yi!” However, Baby Ginseng felt that this was too cruel and too utilitarian. It wasn’t suitable for ordinary battles. Apart from Eleven, there shouldn’t be any opponent who could withstand it. It was better to use some handsome tactics.
For example, the “Yiji Array Enemy Bombardment Tactic”. They directly flew into the sky and threw the Energy Fruit Bombs to bombard it.
Shi Yu could tell that Baby Ginseng was doing this on purpose. It wanted to fly. Otherwise, both Eleven and it could match a bunch of dirty tactics with the all-purpose support worm. It seemed like it was the only one in the team who couldn’t fly…
“Sleep…” Shi Yu no longer worried about his pets and collapsed.
…
The next morning.
Shi Yu put on his research suit. Although it was unnecessary, it was better to wear normal and formal clothes on this occasion.
“How was your rest?” Early in the morning, after Shi Yu, Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, and the others met, they were asked.
“It’s alright.” Shi Yu smiled. Now, he belonged to the category of people who could sleep soundly anywhere.
“That’s good. Let’s go have breakfast first and go over as soon as possible. The meet starts at 8. We’re the second show. We have to prepare in advance,” said Legend Hua.
The few of them chatted as they headed to the hotel’s buffet level. Apart from Shi Yu and the others, many of the other members of the Feeding Team were also eating here.
After Shi Yu arrived, he casually took a cup of milk and a plate of pastries. He was actually still not very hungry… Baby Ginseng’s nutritional supplements were getting stronger and stronger.
With the plate in hand, Shi Yu found a place to sit.
“Cough, cough, cough.” However, he had not sat for long when the simple milk and pastry nearly choked Shi Yu. This was because he suddenly saw a young man with an eye on his forehead walk past him and was suddenly shocked.
Shi Yu looked over in a daze. At this moment, Xia Qingwei had just finished preparing breakfast. She took a look and said, “It’s a three-eyed hybrid.”
“Hybrid,” Shi Yu whispered.
“Yes, it’s a hybrid with a bloodline that’s inclined towards humans.” Xia Qingwei nodded and said, “The humans of the three-eyed race can also open up the Beast Taming Space and become Beast Tamers. However, their Beast Taming Talent is uniform. It’s that third eye. Its effect is similar to the Heavenly Eye. It’s a high-level skill with super vision. It’s a special reconnaissance talent. It’s said that there’s also a way to see through the pet’s potential.”
“Sigh ~” This was the first time Shi Yu had seen a living hybrid.
In person, at least.
There were actually two types of mixed blood.
One was a human who mainly had the bloodline of other creatures. Such a human could still open up the Beast Taming Space, such as General Mu Huiyin, the empress, and the three-eyed human just now.
The other type was the bloodline of transcendent creatures that had a small portion of human blood.
They were called human-type pets compared to creatures that didn’t have human bloodlines but looked similar to humans.
These types of creatures did not have the Beast Taming Space, but they had various skills, so they could be contracted by the Beast Tamer as pets. It was considered a side door pet classification that was different from elements, plants, undead, and machinery.
According to what Shi Yu knew, the mermaids in the sea, the Dragon Palace City Dragon Girl, the werewolves, vampires, and even the legendary angels in the west were all humanoid creatures that could be contracted as pets. He just didn’t know if these claims were true.
The mermaids were alright. Senior Lu seemed to have contracted a mermaid princess to explore the underwater ruins. As for the others, especially things like angels, it was really difficult to determine if they were real or fake.
“Eat quickly,” Xia Qingwei said. Shi Yu immediately stuffed all the pastries into his mouth.
If he remembered correctly, there seemed to be a bureau in Division 13 that was specially set up for the hybrids?
From his conversation with Principal Feng, he learned that the overall battle power didn’t seem to be weak.
…
When Yu and the others arrived at the venue, a group of people had already gathered here.
However, unlike the battle competitions of the National League, the people who came to the Feeding Conference were all industry insiders. They invited some powerful Beast Tamers and Feeders, and not just anyone could buy a ticket to come in and watch.
Therefore, in the entire venue, including the audience, there might not be more than two thousand people. It was less people than a single high school that had a parent day event.
On the Ancient Capital University seats, Principal Feng, Dean Hao, and the others had long been sitting and waiting. Some experts and professors from the Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University also came.
Initially, apart from the evolution of the iron-eating beasts, Ancient Capital University didn’t have any outstanding research results this year. The research of the Green Silkworm Cocoon could be said to be a timely help for Ancient Capital University. Otherwise, the Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University this year would definitely be at the bottom again, or they would give up competing.
“Let’s go over.”
“Qingwei, cooperate with Shi Yu later. Don’t be nervous.” As Shi Yu and the others walked towards their seats, Dr. Zuo said to Xia Qingwei.
“I understand,” Xia Qingwei said with a nod.
There were more people in the National League than this, so she wasn’t nervous. What was there to be nervous about?
Although that was the case… Xia Qingwei was still a little nervous. As a student of Demon Capital University, was it reasonable for her to support the students of Ancient Capital University in participating in the conference… She glanced at the seats of the Demon University and felt a little guilty.
Beside her, Legend Hua had a smile on her face. Over the past few days, Dr. Zuo had been squeezing Xia Qingwei dry. However, anyone with eyes could tell that she was helping Xia Qingwei. Even if she only contributed a little during the process, it would be very helpful for her future development.
“We’re the second… Then which feeding team is the first to showcase?” Shi Yu asked as soon as he sat down.
As the leader of the Feeding Team of Ancient Capital University… After he came here yesterday, he slept directly until night…
“I remember it’s… Imperial Capital University?” Legend Hua thought for a moment and said, “Well, it should be Imperial Capital University.”
“Their Feeding Department seems to be pretty strong…”
“But there’s definitely no one who can compete with us this time.”
Imperial Capital and Demon Capital were schools without any shortcomings. Apart from the battle specialization, their other specializations were also strong.
“Imperial Capital?”
Shi Yu was stunned. What a coincidence.. He still had to go to Imperial Capital University to have a battle exchange later. He didn’t expect to see the feeding results of Imperial Capital University before that…

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - Results of Changing the Industry
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Results of Changing the Industry
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Imperial Capital, National Exhibition Center.
There were more and more people in the venue.
Before eight in the morning, every area was almost full.
At the same time, three people also entered the judging table, attracting a lot of attention.
“It’s President Ye Hui…”
“Dr. Lu Qi…”
“And Dr. Tian Xiu…”
“What a luxurious judging lineup. They’re already starting to get nervous.”
There were discussions below.
At this moment, a middle-aged man in a suit and holding a microphone walked to the center of the venue.
With a smile on his face, he first coughed dryly to attract everyone’s attention. Then, a loud voice sounded.
“Hello, friends from all walks of life. Welcome to the scene of the Feeding Conference.”
“I’m the host of this Feeding Conference, Deng Lin.”
The short-haired middle-aged man attracted everyone’s attention through his voice.
Deng Lin was also a famous Feeder. Unlike those Feeders with special Beast Taming Talents, he relied on a solid foundation to reach this stage over time.
After joining the Feeding Association, he became the representative of the Feeding Association to explain various feed results to the public. Everyone was familiar with him.
At a certain seat, Shi Yu and the others also looked over.
“Before the exhibition starts, please allow me to introduce the three judges of this Feeding Results Show.”
“They are respectively the president of the Feeding Association, Master Ye Hui!”
“Welcome, everyone.” On the judging table, the gray-dressed man sitting in the middle smiled.
Applause immediately sounded from below.
President Ye Hui was also considered a legendary figure. He had sat in this position at a young age. Of course, this was also related to his heaven-defying cultivation-type Beast Taming Talent. It had been unearthed and cultivated in the third bureau a long time ago.
“Imperial Capital University, PhD in Chemistry, Dr. Lu Qi!”
“Hello.” On the judging table, on President Ye Hui’s left, an old man smiled.
Below, the feed team at the Imperial Capital University seats applauded fiercely!
This doctorate in chemistry from the Imperial Capital University had researched 27 evolution plans for pets. There were evolution races that were transcendent to monarchs. There were even evolution types of two low-level overlord races!
Apart from the overlord race, everything else had a certain degree of replication. Moreover, these pets’ attributes were not limited to the worm-element. His position in the academic world was much higher than Dr. Zuo’s, and he was a senior figure of Dr. Zuo’s.
“I wonder what Dr. Lu Qi thinks of the green cocoon.” Beside Shi Yu, Dr. Zuo had an amused expression.
For the soil of time, Shi Yu had made ample preparations this time… Even she was shocked by the contents of the display.
“Talent Group, Chief Feeding Doctor, Tian Xiu!”
The last person was the old man on President Ye Hui’s right. He was a PhD representative of a financial group that mainly produced commercial products with the results of its operations.
“I’m very happy to be the judge of this Feeding Conference.”
She smiled and said, “Her experience is also very legendary. Most of the feed products she developed are suitable for the basics, and it can be said to be widely praised among Beast Tamers.”
Almost all the pets of Beast Tamers from Dong Huang had tried the nutritional supplements she had developed.
Many exhibition teams had no objections to the three of them being the judges of this Feeding Conference.
The judging method of this Feeding Conference was also very simple. Each judge had 10 points of authority and a total of 30 points. The three judges would evaluate the applicability of the feed results, their high potential, and many other aspects.
If the results of a feed were very strong, strong to the point of explosion, but the cost would be hundreds of millions, and it was very difficult to replicate. The range of applications was limited, so the overall score wouldn’t be very high.
Unless this product could be like those totem-level forbidden weapons that could greatly increase the battle power of a country. At that time, whatever else could be ignored. Just the height alone was enough to crush the results of other teams.
The judging criteria of this conference was to see the overall impact of the feed results on the Beast Taming Domain!
“Sorry for making everyone wait.”
After the host, Deng Lin, explained a bunch of assessment rules and the original intention of the Feeding Conference, as well as his expectations for the future of the Feeding Domain, he finally got to the point. He looked at the big screen at the venue with a smile.
“I believe everyone has been looking forward to it for a long time. Then, let’s invite the first show team.”
“They’re from the Feeding Department of Imperial Capital University, the tree-fruit research team led by Professor Fang Lin. The content they’re going to show this time is the ‘new breed of tree fruits’!”
Swoosh!
The title of the first display team appeared on the big screen in the center of the venue.
In addition, the configuration of the entire research team appeared on the screen.
Team person-in-charge: Professor of the Feeding Department of Imperial University, Fang Lin.
Members: Tang Yun, Jiang Tong, Guo Mingrui, and Du Yan, students of the Feeding Department of the Imperial Capital University.
When the team configuration was out, the audience was shocked.
He didn’t expect that the strongest feed result of Imperial Capital University this year was developed by a professor and a group of students.
“I’m looking forward to it.”
“The results of Imperial Capital University have been very strong in the past years. This year will definitely not be bad.”
As the first display team confirmed, everyone started discussing.
The feeding power of Imperial Capital University was pretty good. Everyone was curious about the major research results of Imperial Capital University this year.
Soon, the female professor of Imperial Capital University, Fang Lin, walked on stage.
“Hello, everyone. I’m Fang Lin, a professor of the Feeding Department of the Imperial Capital University. Cultivating new spiritual plants and spiritual fruits has always been an eternal research topic in the Feeding World. And the result of the fostering we brought this time is a new tree fruit cultivated using a special planting method, the ‘Luminous Fruit’.”
In the venue, the three judges watched quietly. Below, the many exhibition teams also watched quietly.
New product resources…
Shi Yu nodded slightly.
There was no hurry. When he taught Baby Ginseng plant control skills and upgraded it to Perfect Level, he could almost easily mutate the plants. There were as many new spiritual plants as he wanted. He could be a gambler every day!
Then, under the control of the female professor of Imperial Capital University, Fang Lin, the screen changed and a yellow-green fruit picture appeared.
She continued, “Generally speaking, tree fruits are usually used as one ingredient for certain evolution plans, skill teaching plans, and nutritional supplements. It requires other materials to maximize the effect. Only a small number of spiritual plants and spiritual fruits can bring huge improvements to pets and Beast Tamers on their own.”
“The Luminous Fruit is a tree fruit species with astonishing effects alone. It can directly help a pet awaken an intermediate skill. As long as the pet matches this skill, the awakening rate will be above 99%.”
Everyone was slightly surprised.
Because up to here, it didn’t sound new.
Although the effect of this fruit was very strong and could make many low-level Beast Tamers envious, this was the National Feeding Conference. Just this kind of result was not enough to show the power of Imperial Capital University, unless…
Unless this mid-level skill was very important.
Under Fang Lin’s instructions, her four students went on stage.
Behind the four students, each followed a pet. The four pets were of different races. One was a Lightning Rat, one was a Nightlight Cat, one was an Icefield Hound, and the other was a Thorny Beast.
Shi Yu took a look. Good lord, was he going to film “Tom and Jerry”?
“These are the four pets we applied to the Feeding Association. Everyone should be familiar with their skills. These four pets also only have racial skills, but next… they’re about to awaken new skills!”
Among the four students, the girl named Tang Yun took out the tree fruits on display and fed them to the pets.
After feeding them, Tang Yun looked excited. Alright, little guys, let’s stun everyone!
A few seconds later.
Unsurprisingly, all four pets flickered with the Light of Awakening. This was the sign that they were awakening to master new skills!
At the same time, under everyone’s silent gaze, the pets suddenly opened their mouths!
“Hou!!!!!!!!”
The pets of the four races, which were completely different, actually let out the same roar that did not match their race at the same time. Moreover, the sound was incomparably loud, ringing through the entire venue, causing the ground to tremble slightly and causing dust to be stirred!
“This is…” Everyone was slightly stunned. Then, some feeders revealed shocked expressions.
On the judging table, the three judges were stunned and immediately determined what skill it was.
“Could it be a battle roar skill?” President Ye Hui said in surprise.
On the display table, Professor Fang Lin smiled and said, “It’s the spiritual medium-level skill War Roar. Everyone is definitely familiar with the use of this skill.”
“This is a skill that can rely on the roar to increase your battle will, obtain mental resistance and a temporary increase in strength, and affect the enemy’s will. After the proficiency is high, you can still upgrade it to a group resonance skill!”
“Its greatest use is to allow commander-level pets to have the power to fight against the deterrence of monarch-level creatures and not directly faint!”
As soon as Professor Fang Lin finished speaking, everyone exclaimed. They immediately understood the strategic value of this skill.
This was not prepared for ordinary Beast Tamers.
This was prepared for the Beast Tamer Troops!
On the battlefield, why was it difficult for pets below the monarch level to change the battle situation?
Because monarch-level creatures relied on deterrence to have the initial capital to ignore the number of weak enemies, it was very difficult to defeat them with numbers.
In the face of the deterrence of monarch-level creatures, even commander-level pets would instantly lose their will to fight.
However, if the pet learned the Battle Roar, there would be no problem.
If an army was allocated with the Battle Roar and upgraded to a group skill, even a group of commander-level pets would have the possibility of surrounding and killing monarch-level creatures. And facing opponents of the same level, they would also have an incomparably huge advantage!
If the Luminous Fruit only helped the pet awaken an ordinary mid-level skill like the Thunder Palm, it would basically have no effect on Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain. But if it was a tree fruit with a stable awakening battle roar skill, the meaning would be different.
“A very rare research result,” Dr. Tian Xiu praised.
“Yes.” Dr. Lu Qi smiled. Obviously, he had known about this result.
“This tree fruit…” On Shi Yu’s side, Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo also revealed shocked expressions.
The battle roar skill was different from other skills. Because of the speciality of its group resonance, the effect of it exceeded high-level skills for specific people. This research result could be said to have a very different meaning.
“Does it depend on the roar to deal damage?” Shi Yu was also slightly stunned. This skill was not bad. It was very suitable for low-level army battles. Think about it, a group of battle beasts that had mastered the impregnable resonance skill. They would roar and charge at the same time, increasing their battle intent and strength. That felt good…
However, this skill still had some restrictions.
The effect was only obvious for those below the monarch level. The same effect was perfectly covered by deterrence. Although deterrence wasn’t a resonance skill, after a high proficiency level, it was a group skill. It could overlap, be used to bully others with its power, and deterrence with high proficiency could completely increase the battle will of an entire army. The effect would only be stronger than the battle roar.
Although that was the case, it didn’t affect anything. After all, there were only a few Beast Tamers who had mastered the deterrence skill in the entire Beast Taming Domain. Moreover, if the deterrence and battle roar were used together. Although the strength of the effects were similar and the mutual increase was limited, it wasn’t like there was no increase at all.
This was… a very valuable research result!
Now, the value of the battle roar had been confirmed. It was completely incomparable to mid-level skills like Cannon Fist and Thunder Palm. The entire army being armed with the Thunder Palm was useless. However, the significance of the full armed battle roar was huge. Next, it would depend on the difficulty of nurturing the Gem Fruit.
From any perspective, if the Clear Gem Fruit was popularized in the army, the impact would definitely not be low, but if the cultivation cost of one was a lot of money, that wouldn’t be too good.
“Professor Fang Lin, what about the cultivation cost of the Clear Gem Fruit?” President Ye Hui asked.
Professor Fang Lin said, “The cultivation of the Clear Gem Fruit requires special fertilizer and the support of plant-type pets to grow normally. If we cultivate them in batches, the cultivation cost of one fruit is about 100,000 yuan each.”
With that said, she flipped to the page and showed everyone the cost composition of nurturing the Green Glowing Fruit.
100,000…
After Professor Fang Lin finished speaking, the three judges fell into deep thought.
This price was very conflicted. It wasn’t to the extent where it couldn’t be used in the army, but if it was to be popularized, it wasn’t that easy.
Dong Huang’s annual military expenses of more than trillion seemed to be a lot, but just the food of the soldiers’ pets alone had spent most of it. The remaining funds that could be used for the pets’ skills, equipment, medicine, and training facilities were spread out. There wasn’t much left.
With that money, it was enough to create many monarch and overlord-level mechanical lives.
However, this cost-effective ratio was definitely higher than armed mental equipment, so most importantly, it had potential again.
After all, the cultivation cost could be optimized. If he could find a cultivation plan that reduced the cost to half or a quarter, the strategic value of the Gem Fruit would be even greater.
“At the moment, we already have three cost optimization plans, but due to the funds, we can’t completely implement them,” Professor Fang Lin said.
This was also the goal of many individual feeding teams. They wanted research funds! They wanted to jointly do research with the third bureau!
The feeding team of Imperial Capital University was still showing off, explaining their subsequent research ideas, making everyone and the three judges nod to themselves.
At the moment, the Luminous Fruit already had the potential to increase the battle power of the Dong Huang Beast Tamer Corps overall. This feeding result was undoubtedly a huge success. It was worth the third bureau and even the military’s follow-up research.
During the evaluation process, Ye Hui, Lu Sheng, and Tian Xiu all gave extremely high affirmations.
“28.5 points.”
Ten minutes later, after a serious discussion by the jury, the new Tree Seed Fruit displayed by Imperial Capital University was extremely recognized.
Seeing this score, on the display table, Mentor Fang Lin smiled. The four students on the ground also had flushed faces and were very excited.
“Yay!!”
Their hard work for the past six months was not in vain.
At the Feeding Conference last year, there were only six feed results with scores exceeding 28 points. There was only one that exceeded 28.5 points, and the highest was only 29 points. This evaluation was undoubtedly very large.
“28.5 points?”
“Another genius Feeder appeared in Imperial Capital University. I’ve never heard of Professor Fang Lin before, but I’ve completely remembered her this time. I wonder if I saw the day when the Beast Tamer Troops were all armed with the Battle Roar.”
“Those few students also have boundless prospects. Perhaps they will be recruited by the military after graduation.”
“The first one is already so explosive.”
After the presentation of the Imperial Capital University’s Feeding Team, the research teams that were going afterwards were a little embarrassed.
Most of the feed results in these display teams were still not replicable or popularizing.
For example, when Dr. Zuo researched the Ice Phoenix Moth back then, although it increased her reputation greatly, it was only limited to this.
After all, regardless of whether it was ordinary people or high-end battle power, they rarely spent the effort to nurture a Green Silkworm that had mastered transcendent worm silk.
In addition, ice-element phoenix materials were also very expensive.
Even if the Ice Phoenix Moth’s breeding results were very impressive, Dr. Zuo’s evaluation for the Feeding Conference back then would only be ranked seventh.
Moreover, this ranking was largely not for the Ice Phoenix Moth.
It was because Dr. Zuo had proven that the Green Silkworm might directly evolve into a monarch race.
After all, the Ice Phoenix Moth was the first case. The Green Silkworm had become a classic example of a monarch race as the first evolution, providing many research ideas to other researchers.
Therefore, the popularization and potential displayed by the Imperial Capital University could increase the overall battle power of the Beast Tamer Troops. For the subsequent Feeding Team, it was simply a fatal blow, making them feel immense pressure.
“Thank you, Professor Fang Lin, for the Feeding Team of Imperial University. Thank you for your research results.”
Host Deng Lin went on stage and sighed. “Thank you for the evaluation brought by the three judges.”
On the judging table, the three judges smiled. They still had to thank the feeding team of Imperial Capital University.
They didn’t expect the first feed result this year to be so meaningful.
Then, the conference carried out a short five-minute break.
On the Imperial Capital University’s side, everyone was excited.
Tang Yun and the other students surrounded Professor Fang Lin and chattered excitedly.
“Although Feeders rarely go to the battlefield themselves, their existence, and the medical care department as well, can provide huge help to the soldiers at the front line. This is also a kind of battle.” Fang Lin said with a smile and glanced at Tang Yun.
It meant that battle and feeding were indeed not separated, but there was no need to cultivate both. After all, a person’s energy was limited, and she didn’t have the battle-type Beast Taming Talent. Why didn’t she just obediently follow her, her mentor, to specialize in feeding? She could still increase the battle power of the soldiers at the back.
“I understand. Speaking of which, which team is the next display team?” Tang Yun changed the topic quickly.
“I think it’s Ancient Capital University,” a student named Du Yan said.
“Ancient Capital University?” Tang Yun was stunned.
Similar to Shi Yu before, she had the same idea. As the only member of the battle club of the Imperial Capital University present, she knew that the next two schools had battle exchanges. Was she going to compete with them in the Feeding Department in advance?
“What about their research results?” Tang Yun asked.
Professor Fang Lin: “It looks like a new evolution form of the Green Silkworm?”
“They don’t seem to have a team that specializes in the research of the Green Silkworm, right?” the student Jiang Tong said. If he remembered correctly, Ancient Capital University’s main breeding research was in the undead department. Why did they come to study the Green Silkworm?
“Maybe they discovered a new form by accident.” Tang Yun smiled and didn’t care much.
A few new evolution forms would appear every year for the Green Silkworm, and they would be bet by the feeders, but there was nothing new.
Either its proficiency in the worm silk was too high, or the evolution ingredient was too dark. After all, the two concerned the potential of the Green Silkworm. After researching for decades, the Wind Crystal Butterfly that the Green Silkworm naturally evolved into was the most intimate.
At the same time, the other exhibition teams also discussed Ancient Capital University.
Compared to Imperial Capital University, the Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University was not famous.
Apart from a small number of people, probably not many people were looking forward to the results of Ancient Capital University’s feeding. After all, in the past years, the overall score of Ancient Capital University was never in the top ten.
Soon, the break segment ended, and the host, Deng Lin, went on stage.
“After a short break, let’s invite the second exhibition team.”
“It’s from Ancient Capital University. The research team of the Green Silkworm Evolution Feeding Group, led by Student Shi Yu of the Archeology Department, is going to showcase the ‘Green Silkworm New Evolution Form’!”
Swoosh!
When Deng Lin finished speaking, everyone was stunned for a moment.
“Huh?”
“Wait, did I hear wrongly?”
“Although I know that the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University is very impressive, isn’t this the Feeding Conference… Why isn’t it the Feeding Department leading the team, but the archeology Department?”
“Is that the problem? Why aren’t the professors leading the team, but… the student?”
As the host finished speaking, the crowd instantly exclaimed.
A moment later, someone suddenly felt that the name Shi Yu was a little familiar.
For example, Tang Yun of the Imperial Capital University was first shocked at how the Ancient Capital University spent so much effort to let the archeology Department participate in the Feeding Conference. Then, she was slightly stunned by the name Shi Yu.
Archeology Department, Shi Yu…
Was it that Shi Yu Yin Zhengfan cared about? The Shi Yu she had asked her cousin about previously?
While many people were stunned, the contents of the display team of Ancient Capital University appeared on the big screen in the center of the venue. In addition, the members of the entire research team appeared on the screen.
At this moment, the crowd was stunned again. They were extremely stunned.
Team In-charge: Ancient Capital University archeology Department student, Shi Yu.
Members: Dr. Zuo Jiangyun, director of the Demon Capital Insect Department, Feeder Xia Qingwei, Legendary Beast Tamer Hua Xiajin…
Everyone: “?”
Imperial Capital University: ???
Demon Capital University: ???
Good lord…
Imperial Capital University had a professor with four students. On Ancient Capital University’s side, not only was the archeology student leading the team, but they also had a famous doctorate and a legendary Beast Tamer?
What the hell was going on?
Which one of them wasn’t a big boss in the insect domain?
Why? They were members, and the person in charge was a student?
At this moment, apart from a few people who knew, most of them were confused.
On the side of Imperial Capital University, Tang Yun was extremely confused. So, was it the Shi Yu she knew?
Looking over with endless confusion… As a young man in a white research suit calmly walked onto the stage, she was even more confused.
It was definitely that Iron-eating Beast Knight. It was him.
This didn’t make sense!
Why was it him?
The archeology Department didn’t do archeology, but came to study feeding?
Wasn’t Shi Yu very strong in battle too? If he wanted to dual cultivate, it would be battle. Why was he here to study feeding?
At Demon Capital University, some of the attendees felt their balls hurt when they saw the names of Dr. Zuo Jiangyun and Xia Qingwei.
However, the changes in the audience couldn’t affect Shi Yu, who was on the stage.
He looked at the entire venue and the judging table.
“Hello, everyone. I’m a student from Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu. Because of the speciality of the Green Silkworm, the evolution form of the Green Silkworm has also been a research topic that will never change in the Feeding World. And the result of the feeding we brought this time is the ‘new evolution form of the Green Silkworm’. However, this evolution form might be a little different from the evolution form everyone knows.”
Shi Yu smiled.
As soon as he finished speaking, the crowd was in an uproar. Good lord, what was Ancient Capital University doing?
“I’ll get to the point then.” Shi Yu wasn’t a professional feeder. He only wanted to show the results quickly and create big news!
“Next, please look at our research results.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Xia Qingwei, who was also wearing a research suit, went on stage.
“That guy… seems to be Dr. Zuo Jiangyun’s daughter, a member of the Demon Capital University team, the one from the Feeding Department like me…” At the Imperial Capital University, Tang Yun saw Xia Qingwei and her memories were evoked. She looked at the Ancient Capital University team in confusion.
Like her, Professor Fang Lin and many others couldn’t understand.
At this moment, a green worm followed Xia Qingwei onto the stage.
Looking at this green worm, everyone wanted to see what the Ancient Capital University was up to.
“This is a level-ten Awakening Green Silkworm with an expert level proficiency in worm silk. Its skill proficiency is at a stage that most Beast Tamers can reach,” Shi Yu said slowly.
“According to the statistics, the Green Silkworm is the pet race that the Beast Tamers have contracted the most. This has to do with its huge number and evolution potential.”
“Therefore, studying the evolution form of the Green Silkworm has become the mainstream topic in the Dong Huang Feeding World. Many feeders have taken a fancy to the two special characteristics of the Green Silkworm and hope to find a powerful evolution form suitable for the masses.”
“However, because its racial skills are too difficult to increase and its race is weak, it requires many high-level materials to improve its talent. Therefore, there has been no amazing result in this research route.”
“But now, we’ve finally found it. The evolution threshold is extremely low, but the evolution path of the races is very powerful!”
“Its birth will rewrite the layout of Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain!”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, many Beast Tamers widened their eyes.
What was he saying!
Everyone originally thought that Ancient Capital University had only accidentally discovered a new evolution model.
However, as Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone suddenly realized that Shi Yu’s description was extremely grand.
The evolution threshold that was suitable for the masses was extremely low, but it led to the evolved form of a very powerful Green Silkworm?
The Feeding World had studied it for decades but had yet to find a suitable evolution plan. Now, Shi Yu said that he had researched it?
“How is that possible?” On the display team of Imperial Capital University, a few students looked at Shi Yu in a daze.
Did he know what he was talking about?
If this was developed, the strategic value would probably be above the Battle Roar Fruit.
Apart from the audience, the three judges narrowed their eyes.
“Now, please bear witness to its evolution.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Xia Qingwei brought the Green Silkworm to the booth the next moment.
“Ji!”
After arriving at the exhibition stage and being watched by so many people, the green worm wasn’t nervous. It spat out the worm silk skillfully and started to turn into a cocoon!
Soon, an ordinary cocoon transformation was completed.
Everyone looked at the Green Silkworm cocoon on the display table and was a little confused. However, a moment later, everyone’s eyes widened.
That was because, without any external stimulation, the Green Silkworm that had just turned into a cocoon was suddenly filled with evolution light!
“Wait!”
“After the Green Silkworm turns into a cocoon, doesn’t it have to sleep for at least a few days and absorb the evolution power before breaking out of the cocoon to evolve?”
“Dr. Zuo’s Beast Taming Talent seems to be able to accelerate the growth of pets, including pets in the cocoon state…”
“The problem is that Dr. Zuo didn’t go on stage. The little girl up there didn’t touch this cocoon either!”
Seeing the suddenly evolved Green Silkworm cocoon, many people were stunned.
Everyone looked at the booth carefully.
At this moment, the evolution light lingering on the green worm’s cocoon had already disappeared.
The green worm’s new evolution form appeared in front of everyone.
At this moment, everyone’s expressions froze. This was because after the Green Silkworm’s cocoon evolved, after evolution… it seemed to have evolved into…
No matter how they looked at it, this thing was still a cocoon.
In the beginning, it might have been because of the distance, but in the next moment, as the green cocoon turned around and opened its huge eyes, the feeders present widened their eyes.
This wasn’t the end. After opening his eyes, Xia Qingwei directly took out a prop and raised it beside the green cocoon.
Then…
With a boom, the Green Silk cocoon was filled with Psychic waves. It used the Psychic impact to instantly penetrate the prop Xia Qingwei raised. Seeing this scene, many people suddenly stood up.
“Holy shit, the Green Silkworm’s cocoon woke up? No… it became a spirit? No, it, it woke up?”
“Moreover, this is… Psychic power??”
Many feeders revealed shocked expressions. Shi Yu slowly said, “This is one of the results of our feeding. It let the Green Silkworm evolve into the Green Silkworm cocoon and awaken new racial skills, Psychic power.”
Many people’s mouths opened slightly. Green Worm cocoon???
That worked?
It was indeed different from the evolution everyone imagined. No wonder Shi Yu said that it might go against everyone’s understanding!
Others evolved into butterflies, but what the hell was this cocoon?!
“Wait… Green Worm cocoon?!”
“I remember now. Previously, didn’t the officials announce a new Green Silkworm race called Green Silkworm cocoon!”
Some of the Beast Tamers present suddenly thought of something and spoke abruptly. They even thought of the Butterfly Meeting!
At this moment, Shi Yu continued, “The Green Silkworm cocoon is a transition race before the Green Silkworm turned into a butterfly. This race can effectively increase the potential heritage of the Green Silkworm after its evolution.”
“This is the key to the entire study.”
“However, this evolution won’t end here. Although it has evolved once and broken through to the transcendent level, the green cocoon can still continue to evolve like an ordinary cocoon!”
In order to respond to everyone, Xia Qingwei activated her growth talent and placed her hand on the green cocoon. A moment later, the green cocoon welcomed a second stage evolution again. A green silkworm suddenly evolved twice in front of everyone, making everyone a little confused.
Under the dazzling light of evolution, the cocoon underwent a huge change. With a boom, under the pressure of Psychic power, the cocoon directly exploded, turning into white silk that flew in all directions.
At the same time, a palm-sized butterfly with bright spots on its wings appeared in front of everyone. It broke out of the cocoon!
“What ~” The butterfly danced in the sky, and the spiritual powder around it scattered. Its posture was gorgeous. Its new appearance made many people open their mouths slightly.
At the same time.
On the screen, information about this butterfly appeared.
[Name]: Crystal Butterfly
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Worm Silk, Psychic, Psychic Powder, Absolute Sleep
Energy Points: 574
[Evolution Materials Cost]: 100,000
At this moment, when they saw the information on this new species of butterfly, many Beast Tamers were stunned and widened their eyes.
Even Professor Fang Lin from Imperial Capital University was stunned.
100,000?
Were they seeing things?
“If I want the Green Silkworm to evolve into the Green Silkworm cocoon and then into the Crystal Thought Butterfly, the cost of evolution materials is about 100,000 yuan.”
“The requirement for the worm silk is only at expert level.”
“It can be exchanged for a pet of a high-level transcendent spiritual type. This pet grasps the all-purpose skill Psychic, a spiritual powder with extremely high tactical value and high medical value, and absolute sleep that greatly reduces the cost of cultivation.”
“They have three spiritual skills: low, medium, and high.”
Shi Yu’s voice echoed in everyone’s ears, shocking many.
It was really 100,000 yuan?
Was it 100,000 yuan?
Initially, they had thought that the battle roar would be shocking enough, but now, the 100,000 yuan Psychic Crystal Butterfly stunned them all at once. Unlike the battle roar that could only be used in war, the cost-effective ratio of the Psychic Crystal Butterfly was too high. Not only could Psychic power be used in battle, but it could also have a huge impact in many fields such as medicine. Apart from the extremely high tactical value, Psychic Powder was also a resource urgently needed in the medical field. Many anesthesia jobs needed Psychic Powder.
As for Absolute Sleep, there was even less to say. At the very least, the Beast Tamer’s cost of cultivating the Crystal Butterfly had been halved, and the cultivation period had doubled. No wonder Shi Yu said that the evolution form he discovered was incomparably powerful.
Although it was just a high-level transcendent race, this was a racial form prepared for the public. Skill matching skills were the most important. Psychic power could be used to attack, defend, or even accelerate oneself. Psychic powder could also be sold for money, and Absolute Sleep could accelerate the cultivation cycle to reduce the burden of cultivation… In addition, this super low evolution threshold…
If there had been an evolution form like the Crystal Butterfly back then, Shi Yu wouldn’t have to loan hundreds of thousands of yuan to buy the Iron-eating Beast. He could have raised the Green Silkworm and bought the evolution materials to fly faster.
At this moment, as the information of the Crystal Thought Butterfly was announced, many people took a deep breath and looked at the young man.
[But now, we’ve finally found it. The evolution threshold is extremely low, but the evolution path of the races is very powerful!]
[Its birth will rewrite the layout of Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain!]
What Shi Yu said just now was all true.
If the purpose of the battle roar was to strengthen the existing Beast Tamer Troops…
Then, the birth of the Green Silkworm cocoon and the Crystal Thought Butterfly could make all of Dong Huang’s citizens soldiers. Ten years later, everyone could be Beast Tamers!
After all, the number of Green Silkworms… was even more than humans.
Moreover, the battle roar could also be matched with the Crystal Butterfly!
At this moment, everyone at Imperial Capital University was shocked.
Was this still the Ancient Capital University that was useless apart from the archeology Department?
This was a discovery that could change the structure of Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain better than the Battle Roar Fruit!
At this moment, many feeders were numb. First was Imperial Capital University, then Ancient Capital University. How were the people behind them supposed to go on stage now?
At Ancient Capital University, Principal Feng laughed out loud. Were they shocked? However, did they think that was it?
Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo also smiled.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the judging table.
On the judging table, the three top-notch feed masters also fell into a thought storm.
If the cultivation cost Shi Yu gave was real, then this time, it was really an incomparable big discovery.
Although it wasn’t an innovation field, it was a huge innovation in the current situation!
“This result… I can give you full marks!”
Although he was a doctorate from the Imperial Capital University, at this moment, Dr. Lu Qi was completely stunned. The so-called racial levels of the Green Silkworm Cocoon and the Crystal Thought Butterfly were simply far inferior to the evolution form he had developed. However, at this moment, Dr. Lu Qi understood that his feeding results were nothing compared to this.
This was what one should pursue after entering chemistry. It made the most common pet evolve into the pet with the lowest threshold!
He didn’t take the best pet and spend a lot of money to evolve into a stronger pet!
He looked at Shi Yu. Could a student develop such a result??
No wonder Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua were willing to support him.
However, he kept feeling that there was something he hadn’t sensed.
Dr. Tian Xiu, who was beside him, was also confused for a moment because of this huge achievement. There was actually someone who really relied on the Green Silkworm’s evolution to solve the greatest problem of ordinary people becoming professional Beast Tamers?
At this moment, Shi Yu said, “Thank you, Dr. Lu, but my display isn’t over.”
“This evolution only shows popularization and applicability.”
“It’s far from the potential. The Crystal Thought Butterfly is just the form that a silkworm with expert worm silk proficiency evolves into. What if the worm silk is at the perfect level of proficiency, or even the transcendent level of proficiency?”
At this moment, everyone was stunned again.
In the next moment, the two green cocoons were teleported to the display table by an unknown force.
It was still the green worm cocoon with big eyes!
Shi Yu said, “Next, everyone, please take a closer look.”
“The one on the left is the green cocoon with the perfect proficiency worm silk.”
“The one on the right is the green cocoon with transcendent proficiency worm silk.”
“Now, they are about to evolve one by one.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Xia Qingwei, the insect obstetric Feeder, took a deep breath. She sucked in the sachet hanging from her neck and pressed her hands on the body of the green cocoon. Her growth talent was activated!!
In less than a minute, the length of the two green cocoons that had almost grown up increased again!
The next moment, the green cocoon with the Perfect Level Worm Silk on the left erupted with evolution light!

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - Shi Yus Dream
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Shi Yu’s Dream
It evolved again!
Under everyone’s shocked expressions, with a boom, a white butterfly that was not much different from the previous Crystal Thought Butterfly broke out of the cocoon! Its white compound eyes became even larger, and the energy fluctuations all over its body became even stronger!
From the aura, it was much stronger than the previous one!
“This is…!”
On the big screen, the information on this evolution form was displayed.
[Name]: White-Eyed Butterfly
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Race Skill]: Worm Silk, Psychic, Psychic Powder, Absolute Sleep, Super Sight
[Energy Points]: 1001
[Evolution Materials Cost]: 100,000
Everyone looked at the information and opened their mouths slightly again.
Looking at the unchanged “evolution materials cost” and “race level”, they opened their mouths and widened their eyes.
“As everyone has seen, the Green Silkworm will evolve into another kind of butterfly of a low class commander species by using the same evolution material under the silk of a perfect level proficiency worm.”
“The energy level has become even greater, and it has even awakened a new reconnaissance skill, super vision. I won’t explain much here.”
At this moment, let alone the Beast Tamers below, even the three judges were slightly shocked.
The evolution ingredient hadn’t changed. It was just that the worm silk proficiency had increased by one level, and it had evolved into a low class commander race?
The increase in evolution potential in the form of the green worm cocoon was much greater than they imagined! Unbelievable!
At this moment, the members on the display at Imperial Capital University were completely speechless. However, everyone realized that the matter didn’t seem to be over.
At this moment, the green cocoon on Xia Qingwei’s right also started to emit evolution light!
Everyone held their breaths and looked over.
In an instant, the cocoon also exploded with light, but the battle array was even greater.
The strong spiritual torrent seemed to have formed a storm around the cocoon. The air rumbled, as if it was undergoing a strong vibration. Ring after ring of spiritual fluctuations like waves came from the cocoon!
With a boom, under the lingering light of evolution, a huge butterfly half a meter in size rose and flew into the sky, humming softly.
“Nn ~”
It had a white body, an even larger white compound eye, and huge light green wings. On its wings, there were white star-like spots. The spots flickered and were very dazzling.
Sensing the spiritual deterrence emitted by this butterfly, many people looked at the screen nervously. As expected, new content appeared.
[Name]: White Star Butterfly
[Attributes]: Spirit
[Race Level]: Low-level Monarch
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Race Skill]: Worm Silk, Psychic, Psychic Powder, Absolute Sleep, Super Sight, Psychic Shock (Super Level)
[Energy Points]: 2989
[Evolution Materials Cost]: 100,000
At this moment, the entire place was incomparably quiet. There were only rapid breaths and low cries of disbelief.
How was this possible?
They… weren’t seeing things, right?
Low-level monarch race???
This was not the key. The key was… the cost of the evolution materials!!
100,000!
It was still 100,000!!!
How was this possible!!!
The three judges also revealed shocked expressions.
Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “As everyone has seen, with the same evolution materials, the green cocoon will evolve into the White Star Butterfly of a low-level monarch race. Well, I named all three of them.”
“Now, everyone should know the effect of the Green Silkworm cocoon, this transition race, on the increase in the Green Silkworm’s potential, right?”
“In addition, because it’s conscious, the success rate of breaking out of the cocoon is very high… Up until now, from our research, it’s still 100 %…”
Everyone didn’t know what to say. They stood there numbly.
Although the possibility of the transcendent-level worm silk evolving into a monarch race had been verified by Dr. Zuo, that was using phoenix materials.
Right now, just 100,000 yuan of cheap materials had allowed it to evolve into a low-level monarch race?!
The form of the green worm cocoon = Phoenix Race materials?
White-Eyed Butterfly, White Star Butterfly!
This was the subsequent research results of Shi Yu and the others!
Although they had failed to join other materials to try and evolve them into a special green cocoon, the green cocoon that increased the proficiency of the worm silk gave them a huge surprise!
This directly proved the unparalleled potential of the green cocoon race.
It directly showed that this evolution plan was not only suitable for low-level Beast Tamers, but also for mid-level and upper-level Beast Tamers!
Was it difficult to reach perfection?
Of course it was difficult.
If one wanted to nurture it, the Beast Taming Space and high-level ruins of a legendary Beast Tamer were the premise.
Then, there had to be a green worm with extremely outstanding potential, one in a million.
In the end, it was possible to create a green worm that had mastered the proficient worm silk with the help of a skill teacher.
For ordinary people, it was extremely difficult.
But for the country, it was not difficult to put these conditions together. As long as there was cultivation value, large-scale feeding was simple!
In other words, at this moment, Shi Yu and the others had developed a very, very low evolution threshold, but it was extremely stable. It was the evolution channel of monarchs!
Although the lifespan of the White Star Butterfly was much lesser than other monarch races as a bug type, it was at least a monarch race!
Shi Yu continued to add, “Although I haven’t researched it yet, there should be some connection between the Crystal Thought Butterfly, White-Eyed Butterfly, and White Star Flash Butterfly. Perhaps the Crystal Thought Butterfly can still evolve into the White-Eyed Butterfly, and the White-Eyed Butterfly can also evolve into the White Star Flash Butterfly…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the entire venue shook again.
Indeed.
It was completely possible.
After all, this was evolved from the same evolution materials.
If that was the case, didn’t that mean that there was a certain possibility of a basic-level Beast Tamer growing into a master??
At that moment, all the feeders looked at Shi Yu with burning gazes.
It could already imagine how high this young man would stand in the Feeding World in the future.
Some feeders in the third bureau might not be famous in history, but Shi Yu definitely would be!
This was the result of feeding the country and the people!
“Is this a genius?”
Dr. Tian Xiu muttered.
Freak.
“A student like this should come to the capital to study the Feeding Department. I’m willing to teach him all my knowledge!”
Dr. Lu Qi widened his eyes and was so jealous that his teeth fell out. Damn, the Feeding Department of the Trash Ancient Capital University was worthy of such a student?
Was it appropriate to let a student carry the school?
He had already imagined how explosive the Feeding Department of Ancient Capital University would be next.
He was afraid that it would become a prestigious institute of the domestic Feeding Department.
“This kid…” Among the three judges present, only Ye Hui knew Shi Yu’s identity as Division 11. He took a deep breath. Damn it, damn it. He had originally had huge expectations for Shi Yu and the others’ feed results. Now, this outcome almost satisfied him to death.
Should it be said that Shi Yu was lucky or talented? If it was the latter, he really had great talent. Even if Shi Yu didn’t have special cultivation-type Beast Taming Talent, it was worth pulling Shi Yu to the third bureau to further his studies.
He believed that the other big bosses in the bureau wouldn’t reject such a cute newbie.
On the way to Imperial Capital University, the few members on display were completely speechless. In the end, Professor Fang Lin said, “It’s too ridiculous. Is this result really coming from a student? Is he really from the archeology Department?”
“…” Tang Yun didn’t know what to say next. She didn’t expect that the candidate Yin Zhengfan cared about was so ruthless.
Expert in battle, archeology, and Feeding?
“Professor, didn’t you say that a person’s energy is limited?” She looked at the professor.
Professor Fang: “You call that a person?”
Tang Yun was speechless.
Tang Yun had nothing to say. She looked at Shi Yu.
Originally, Imperial Capital University had gotten a 28.5 score. They should be happy now, but…
Forget it, they should be happy. After all, this feeding result could make huge contributions to Dong Huang.
But then again…
“He’s actually been studying the evolution of the Green Silkworm? In other words, he should have fallen behind in battle, right?”
“…Not only did Zhengfan contract another high-level monarch species pet, but he also used the Beast Taming Space to strengthen his talent, making the pet’s growth level ignore his own level and have a breakthrough. This talent gap shouldn’t be able to be closed, right…”
Although she was unwilling, she was still willing to believe what the professor said. There was a limit to a person’s energy.
It was impossible for Shi Yu to not miss anything while doing this crazy thing, right?
However, at this moment, just as everyone’s minds were numb, Shi Yu, this bastard, spoke again.
He said, “Next, I’ll show everyone the height of the green cocoon. Of course, I guess you could call it its potential.”
Everyone: “?”
Tang Yun:???
More??
He had already displayed the transcendent proficiency worm silk, what else was there?!
“Whether it’s the Crystal Butterfly, White-Eyed Butterfly, or the White Star Flash Butterfly, the evolution materials have never changed. However, what if other evolution materials are added?” Shi Yu chuckled.
He continued, “Although only one case has been researched so far, and it’s not replicable, this case should be able to confirm that apart from these three races, there’s also the possibility of the green cocoon evolving into another race!”
“Moreover, in theory, the more evolution materials there are, the greater the potential…”
Boom!!!
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the scene shook again. Everyone looked at Shi Yu.
Holy shit.
This kid was serious. Was he still not done?
“However, the Green Silkworm cocoon indeed has the possibility of evolving into other races. Have you all forgotten!!”
“Half a month ago, Divine Capital, Butterfly Meeting!!”
“Who still remembers the news at that time? It was after that incident that the form of the green worm cocoon was announced! Although there hasn’t been detailed racial information and there’s only one name, at that time… there was already a green worm cocoon.”
“The entire Butterfly Meeting is still presided over by Legend Hua.”
“Dr. Zuo’s daughter, Xia Qingwei, who is also the little girl on the display table, even evolved an Ice Phoenix Moth in that meeting.”
“But the limelight of that meeting was all taken by a strange cocoon…”
At this moment, someone couldn’t help but say.
Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, Xia Qingwei, the Green Silkworm Cocoon, and all the hot topics related to the Butterfly Meeting were here.
They were all in this feed team.
Now, no matter how slow their reactions were, some people had already guessed something.
At that time, the only unknown information was who the owner of the green cocoon was.
Coupled with the configuration of this feed team, it seemed that the truth would be revealed soon.
On the display table, Shi Yu smiled at the informant. At this moment, another message appeared on the screen.
[Green Silkworm Overlord Race Evolution]
[Name]: Butterfly of Imagination
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space
[Race Level]: Medium overlord
As soon as the information was out, everyone was shocked.
They looked at Shi Yu in disbelief. Could it be…
At the same time, an extremely huge spatial ripple appeared in the sky behind Shi Yu.
A terrifying mental wave spread from it and turned into a blue airflow.
In the spatial ripples, a huge butterfly about three to four meters in size slowly appeared with a strong pressure.
It had an incomparably huge pair of wings. The entire surface of the wings was like white waves surging on the blue sea. The color and patterns were very spectacular, like a piece of art!
At this moment, a string of beautiful white halos embedded at the edge of the huge butterfly’s blue sky-like wing shone. It was very dazzling and gorgeous, and there was even a strong pressure from an overlord race sweeping in all directions. The moment it appeared, the three little butterflies that had evolved just now lingered around it like its subjects and danced.
At this moment, it really shocked most people speechless. At least half of the 2,000 people in the audience suddenly stood up and looked at this butterfly in disbelief.
A… butterfly?
The overlord butterfly born in the Butterfly Meeting half a month ago?
They looked at Shi Yu and recalled the information about the Green Worm cocoon and the entire Feeding Team. Their voices were hoarse and they couldn’t say a word.
So… the Butterfly of Imagination, the Beast Tamer of an overlord species pet… was the Shi Yu in front of him?? And not some legend?
How was that possible!
As if to confirm people’s guess, the Butterfly of Imagination slowly shrank and landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
This scene made the eyes of Tang Yun, a member of the Imperial Capital University battle club, explode…
That huge mental power just now… was definitely… definitely commander rank!
Overlord race, commander rank! How was this possible!
The opponent Yin Zhengfan had always wanted to defeat was this guy?
Overlord race???
In the entire Imperial Capital’s big school team, only the captain had an overlord race pet. How was this Shi Yu owning one!!
A middle-level overlord race… This huge racial advantage made Tang Yun understand that if the race level didn’t meet the standard, no pet in the commander rank would be a match for this butterfly!
Tang Yun opened her mouth slightly and felt a little nervous.
[Listen to me, don’t, fight him!]
[That kid is not human!]
[Remember, don’t fight him.]
Thinking of her cousin’s reminder, Tang Yun suddenly understood what it meant. She couldn’t help but stand up, scaring the professor beside her.
“Professor, he is indeed not human.” Tang Yun muttered.
Zhengfan should maybe stop fighting this year? She was afraid his mentality would collapse. In any case, she had already collapsed.
“…”
“…I know,” Professor Fang said.
Everyone looked at the arena again. They never expected the truth to be like this… It wasn’t scientific, but it was reasonable. With this, everyone immediately knew what was going on with this luxurious configuration.
Damn, it was Dr. Zuo and Legend Hua who came to cozy up to Shi Yu? Forget it, it still didn’t make sense!
“I’m done showing,” Shi Yu said.
On the exhibition stage, Xia Qingwei took a deep breath and pretended to be calm. He felt that Shiyu had overdone it this time. Below, Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, Principal Feng, and the others knew why Shiyu was so ruthless… Who would have thought that everything today came from him wanting a bottle of some soil of time?
No one else would have expected this.
“I understand…”
On the judging table, President Ye Hui also took a deep breath.
“Green Worm cocoon, Thought Crystal Butterfly, White-Eyed Butterfly, White Star Flash Butterfly, Imagination Butterfly…”
“You have perfectly proven the limitless potential of the green worm cocoon form.”
“Impressive.”
He looked at the two Feeding Masters on the left and right, as if he felt that there was no need to discuss at all.
If not for the fact that the highest score was only 30 points.
They even wanted to give him a higher score!
Unsurprisingly, under the stunned expressions of everyone, Shi Yu’s team obtained a perfect score of 30 points!
This was the first time in nearly three years that a full score had appeared in the Feeding Conference!
At this moment, when he saw full marks, Shi Yu smiled. Alright, the soil of time is his!
When the others saw Shi Yu’s smile, they felt their hair stand on end. They felt that this young man was too sick. He had developed such a terrifying outcome and even contracted an overlord race pet. Was he trying to defy the heavens?
If they were totems, they would definitely shout, “This child can’t be left alive!”
Therefore, was there any suspense in the first place in this meeting?
Everyone was silent. They felt that the next participants were going to be fighting for second place.
The conference had just begun, and there was no suspense in the outcome.
Before long, all the students from Imperial Capital University, who had just obtained good results, sat down like salted fish.
If nothing went wrong, from here to the capital, the country would be shocked again.
After the evaluation ended, President Ye Hui’s love for talent appeared. He smiled at Shi Yu and said, “Let me ask you something off-topic.”
“How did you come about studying the evolution of the Green Silkworm?”
Xia Qing’s weak eyes lit up.
She knew this question, the soil of time!
At the booth, Shi Yu said seriously, “I graduated from the Feeding Department in high school. I’ve been very passionate about Feeding research since I was young.”
“After graduation, I even studied the internship experience of the Green Silkworm for three months.”
“Becoming a Beast Tamer and an archeologist is something that will happen later. My greatest dream is to be a legendary Feeder.”
Principal Feng, Legend Hua, Doctor Zuo, Xia Qingwei:???
Tang Yun:???
Everyone: “?”
What high school’s Feeding Department could nurture such a monster!
[The principal of Shi Yu’s high school in Icefield City, and the person in charge of the breeding base in Icefield City: “???”]
“Very good.” The eyes of the third member, Ye Hui, lit up.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to have such an experience.
Wasn’t this a natural feeder?
Why did Bureau 11 intercept it?
Damn it!
Logically speaking, the telepathy talent was first a cultivation talent, followed by an archeological talent!
He thought for a moment. Shi Yu was clearly more suitable for the third bureau.
They wanted this person for the third bureau!

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - An Appointment Battle From Yin Zhengfan
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: An Appointment Battle From Yin Zhengfan
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
A moment later, Shi Yu went down.
With his full marks, he went down.
Xia Qingwei, the Crystal Thought Butterfly, the White-Eyed Butterfly, and the White Star Butterfly followed behind silently.
After Shi Yu went down for a long time, the audience was still in shock and had yet to recover.
Various discussions about the results of Ancient Capital University’s feed kept coming. People expressed their complicated feelings to each other.
On the display team of Imperial Capital University, student Du Yan muttered, “Is this research result really so smooth?”
The evolution forms of transcendent races to overlord races were displayed one by one. Please be a human.
Guo Mingrui, a student from the same team, said, “My girlfriend has always wanted a butterfly-type pet… I think this White Star Butterfly is pretty good.”
“It’s just that transcendent-level worm silk isn’t easy to deal with…”
A Green Silkworm with transcendent worm silk was even rarer than a cub of a monarch species.
The lifespan of the Green Silkworm for one or two years did not give the Feeder many opportunities to nurture it at all.
Next, they could only see if the country would take out a high-level ruins space and invite a professional teaching team to train the Green Silkworms together.
If it could form a Feeding Chain, then they still had a chance to do this.
However, the price probably wouldn’t be cheap either. Even if a Green Silkworm cub that had mastered the transcendent worm silk was cheaper than a monarch species cub in the future, it wouldn’t be cheap.
After all, there was a chance to nurture it with various top-notch cultivation methods for more than a year. Even Dr. Zuo’s research institute didn’t nurture more than five in a year.
The venue fee for the high-level ruins cultivation space, the manual fee for the skill teacher, and the nutrition fee for the Green Silkworm…
Ignoring everything else, just the basic annual salary of a skill teacher of this level couldn’t be less than a million.
This was still not prepared for low-level Beast Tamers. The Crystal Thought Butterfly was.
Moreover, if it became commonplace, such a Green Silkworm would definitely not be sold, but armed with the Beast Tamer Troops first.
“Why don’t we do a White-Eyed Butterfly first? What if we study it and develop a way to evolve into a White Star Butterfly?” Jiang Tong from Imperial Capital University suggested.
They had already defected. One was thinking about other people’s pets, and the other was thinking about other people’s research content.
Professor Fang Lin’s mouth twitched.
This was already flat-out admitting defeat, although they had indeed lost.
Guo Mingrui: “Not really… She definitely won’t want the White-Eyed Butterfly.”
“Low-level commander races aren’t that low. If I can’t figure out anything, at most, I’ll break the contract in the future and switch.”
“That’s not the problem.” Guo Mingrui turned around and said, “The name of the White-Eyed Butterfly is too ugly. My girlfriend definitely can’t accept it…”
Everyone :”…”
At this moment, everyone in the Feeding Conference venue was discussing the green worm cocoon and Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already returned to his seat.
“Next, Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain is about to open a new chapter.”
After Shi Yu sat down, Dr. Zuo smiled and said, “If nothing goes wrong, the Beast Tamer Association, the Beast Tamer Troops, the third bureau, and the Feeding Association will definitely invest in establishing a huge Green Silkworm Breeding Base.”
“When the time comes…”
Shi Yu exclaimed and said, “It shouldn’t be my problem anymore, right? You guys can do it.”
Everyone: “?”
Xia Qingwei said, “Don’t you want to become a legendary Feeder?”
This was definitely a national level project!
Shi Yu: “That’s a dream. It’s something to talk about. I have a lot of dreams, such as legendary Mechanic, legendary Dragon Tamer… But the energy of humans is limited.”
Everyone: “?”
Shi Yu looked serious and felt that what he said made sense.
He only wanted to increase his strength quickly.
In this world, one’s own strength was the foundation of everything.
Only with strength could he do all kinds of things he wanted to do.
With his current strength and horizons, his transmigration, the connection between Earth and Blue Planet, the myth of the Beast Taming Era… It was all filled with various mysteries.
But what if he was a legendary Beast Tamer, or even a mythical Beast Tamer?
At that time, most of the fog in front of him would disperse on its own.
At that time, the Mythical Ruins, Totem Ruins, restricted areas, and Moon Palace Ruins were all like a backyard. He could go as he pleased, unlike now, when he held the key to the Mythical Ruins left behind by the Shi Emperor but didn’t dare to look for it.
“You still think you’re human?”
Doctor Zuo, Legend Hua felt his teeth hurt.
Moreover, this guy wanted to be a Legendary Mechanic?
It was fine if he wanted to be a legendary feeder or archeologist, the threshold was not high.
However, being a Mechanic was not easy. The threshold was higher than any class.
Contracting a mechanical pet was different from becoming a Mechanic.
Only Beast Tamers who cultivated and upgraded their mechanical pets could be considered Mechanics.
The kind that spent money to find people to upgrade mechanical lives was not recognized as orthodox.
“Cough, which team is the next display team?” Shi Yu asked.
He quickly changed the topic.
“Some research institute that studies breeding,” Dr. Zuo sighed.
At the moment.
The Feeding Conference was still ongoing.
The third team to go on stage was actually the three-eyed human team Shi Yu had seen at the buffet restaurant.
The other party wasn’t from a business or school, but a famous biological feed research institute.
And their products were “high-level pet fertility medicine”…
As the name suggested, it was a medicine that increased the pregnancy and reproduction rate of pets above commander races.
Of course, it was definitely effective with transcendent races that were relatively difficult to breed.
The Iron-eating Beast would be overjoyed.
This was also a relatively mainstream research content.
The higher the species level, the harder it was to reproduce.
For example, overlord races were basically single handedly passed down. They could only give birth to one child in their lifetime, and it still depended on luck.
Moreover, some overlord races were too special. They were the only race in the world, and they were also reproductive apart from other similar races, so it was possible that they would directly become extinct.
This was also why no country had a stable channel for overlord race breeding.
They could only rely on luck to occasionally evolve into a few overlord races that couldn’t be replicated.
“Birth support medicine…”
“It’s indeed a good study…”
However, Shi Yu thought about his Eleven. It shouldn’t be a problem. He probably didn’t need it.
Although the breeding of the Iron-eating Beasts was relatively difficult, it was definitely relatively stable. Otherwise, the ancient times wouldn’t have bothered with the Nine Li Battle Beast Corps.
Moreover, Shi Yu felt that his Eleven was a steel bear. Love would only affect its training speed.
Although Eleven didn’t have to worry, Buggy… Buggy..?!
Ah, Buggy!!!
What had he evolved into? It felt a little dangerous.
There was no other Butterfly of Imagination…
Could it reproduce normally with other butterflies?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
[Buggy: ???]
As for plant-type pets like Baby Ginseng, it was actually alright.
Plant-type pets could reproduce by themselves.
However, in most cases, breeding descendants would cause one to die or decrease in level. Their strength would decrease greatly, such as the Tree of Life. Only after death could new seeds be born.
As for undead and elemental pets, the difficulty of breeding was the highest. Therefore, such pets were very rare in nature. To date, feeders had yet to solve the mystery of the birth and breeding of undead and elemental pets.
As for mechanical pets, they were even more unsolvable. They weren’t capable of breeding their own descendants.
“Forget it, why should I worry about them? It’s as if I’m talking like Beast Tamers are prone to having children when their levels are high.”
Shi Yu listened to the effect of the pregnancy supplement with interest.
The products of this biological feed research team had been modified on the original fertility medicine. There was a higher chance for the pet to inherit the talent potential of its parents. However, following that, a pile of dense experimental data made Shi Yu’s head hurt.
At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly received a message.
White Brook: “Is the Feeding Conference going smoothly?”
[We plan to visit the various training facilities of Imperial Capital University first. The battle exchange will be in two days. You can participate in the conference in peace. When the time comes, we’ll rely on you here.]
“Wu…”
He was going to take a look today?
Shi Yu looked around and glanced at the message before thinking.
The first place of the Feeding Conference should be stable. There was no point in continuing to watch here. After all, these guys only announced the results and didn’t showcase any secrets. It was useless to watch it. It was better to do something else.
He heard that Imperial Capital University had time and space related training venues?
Didn’t that mean that there should still be time-element pets?
The foundation of Imperial Capital University far exceeded that of Ancient Capital University. It should have.
It was worth worshiping.
“Aunt Hua, Aunt Zuo, I have something to do. I’m leaving first. Call me if there’s anything,” Shi Yu said to Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo.
“What are you doing?” Legend Hua asked in confusion.
“Senior Bai asked me to look for her after presenting.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “I don’t know what it is either…”
“That little girl with the Fusion Talent?” Legend Hua came to a realization and nodded. “She’s also in the capital.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu said simply and left.
“This child…” Dr. Zuo shook her head.
As she watched Shi Yu leave, Dr. Zuo looked at Xia Qingwei, who was watching the competition, and sighed.
At the same time, at the Imperial Capital University’s display team.
Tang Yun also felt that it was boring here.
She recalled what Hong Xiao had said to her.
Shi Yu should also be in the Ancient Capital University exchange team this time.
If that was the case, Yin Zhengfan would definitely be able to come into contact with Shi Yu next.
They could definitely meet at the exchange event in two days…
To Yin Zhengfan, after working hard for so long, this was originally a very good opportunity to defeat a strong opponent…
However, if he worked hard and couldn’t defeat the target he wanted to catch up to, that would be a little impactful.
“Compared to letting Zhengfan know after the battle, why don’t… tell him about the situation here first.”
“Yes.”
Tang Yun decided to go back to school at noon today and talk to Yin Zhengfan about everything here.
At the same time, she would also tell her teammates in the battle club to take this new student seriously.
He felt that Shi Yu would definitely be a variable in the exchange between the two schools.
Generally, in this kind of activity, with a master-level student and monarch-level pet wouldn’t be published. The commotion was too big.
It was basically for ordinary members to communicate with each other, which was to say, high-level Beast Tamers.
At this level, everyone had a commander rank pet.
It was nothing in the first place.
However, how could a Beast Tamer with a middle-level overlord race and a commander-level pet suddenly appear in Ancient Capital University?
At this species level, his energy might have reached 100,000. Ordinary monarch species and commander ranks were only half of what he had. There was no way to fight at all.
Shi Yu undoubtedly had the strength of a quasi-master.
Even in the Imperial Capital University’s battle club, there weren’t many who could defeat Shi Yu. There were only a few.
At least, she, an ordinary member of the battle club, had no confidence.
