Because she had come into contact with overlord races, she knew very well that overlord races and monarch races were already two different domains. Under the same level, there was no way to do a comparison between a tiger and a cat.
She probably could only rely on the quasi masters in the school team.
Although they didn’t have any overlord species pets, they had many monarch species pets in their hands. They also had various abnormal battle-type talent. Moreover, every pet could take charge alone.
In comparison, she didn’t believe that Shi Yu’s other pets were also so strong, reaching the overlord race.
“Four months ago, he was clearly a junior Beast Tamer like Zheng Fan.”
“How did you become a high-level Beast Tamer with a commander-level pet in just four months…”
Four months. High-level Beast Tamer and an overlord race pet. This was already ridiculous enough. She didn’t believe that there was anything more ridiculous.
She sighed and decided to immediately slip away after the morning segment ended and return to the battle club.
At this moment… Shi Yu had already slipped away and headed straight for Imperial Capital University.
…
At Imperial Capital University.
Just like Ancient Capital University, it was like a school city.
Such a huge school, apart from some teaching areas and training areas, other places were allowed for visitation.
As for the teaching area and training area, they would probably have to wait for the opening day or use connections before they could visit.
However, if it was an exchange team from other top universities coming to exchange and learn, there would basically be no problem.
At that moment, not long after arriving at the capital, White Brook brought the elites of the Ancient Capital University’s battle club to the Imperial Capital University, planning to visit their school first.
“I came here once four years ago. It’s changed so much now. It’s completely different from what I remember.” In the team of 18 led by White Brook, a tall girl with long hair looked at the huge and tall school gate of Imperial Capital University’s South District.
The vice president, Xu Ze, chuckled. “Don’t talk about the school. The various facilities in Imperial Capital University are upgraded every year. What you’re seeing now is already several updates from four years ago.”
“Holy shit.” Upon hearing the vice president’s words, the other dozen or so people were jealous.
“President, how often does our school’s training facilities change?” They looked at President White Brook.
“After we entered school, the training facilities have not changed.”
White Brook frowned and said, “The training facilities aren’t broken yet. Why would we start updating? Can you handle the current training facilities without pressure?”
“If you want new facilities, you can get first place in the National League. Ancient Capital University can also update every year.”
She said, “If it was Teacher He, he would definitely say so. You also know that our Ancient Capital University is poorer than the Imperial Capital University. If you want good facilities, you can only rely on yourself to fight for them.”
Everyone cried. It was too real.
Although, even if they were given the same school resources, they didn’t have the confidence to defeat the students of Imperial Capital University.
The resources in the school were equal. If the talent and family background were inferior, it would be a waste.
“Sigh ~” Everyone sighed. Just as everyone from Ancient Capital University was about to go to the school gate to register and exchange learning information, White Brook’s phone rang.
White Brook saw the caller and curiously picked up the phone.
“How are things on your side?” she asked.
“I’m done. Where are you? I’ll go find you,” Shi Yu asked.
He also wanted to visit the training facilities and even replicate a time skill. What if the ginseng baby had a chance to learn it after using the Time Soil to evolve?
White Brook :”…”
So fast?
Didn’t the Feeding Conference last two days?
“We’re at the south school gate, we haven’t entered…”
“Wait for me,” Shi Yu said.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, both parties hung up. White Brook looked at the many members and shrugged. “Let’s register first and wait for Shi Yu at the door. He’ll come over later.”
“Oh, oh, oh ~?” Everyone was stunned. Was Little Monster Shi Yu coming too?
They had all seen Shi Yu vs Fu Andi and had been brainwashed by White Brook for a long time. Now, they were looking forward to Shi Yu, a new student, sweeping through Imperial Capital University.
White Brook smiled. Everyone continued to head to the registration office of Imperial Capital University. But at this time, on the campus, a 12 or 13-year-old youth was walking towards them.
Yin Zhengfan, who was preparing to go out for a meal, was stunned when he saw this group of people.
He met White Brook’s gaze.
Yin Zhengfan had visited Ancient Capital University before, so he naturally knew the president of the Ancient Capital University’s battle club.
And the people from the battle club of Ancient Capital University also knew this legendary Yin’s genius son.
“Yin Zhengfan?” White Brook was slightly surprised to see this child.
“Senior White Brook…” Yin Zhengfan was stunned for a moment before quickly saying politely. The exchange battle would begin in two days. He didn’t expect Ancient Capital University to come now.
But soon, he looked at the team of Ancient Capital University.
When he saw faces and didn’t discover Shi Yu among them, his expression changed slightly.
“Well, Senior White Brook, didn’t Shi Yu join the battle club? Or did he not come this time…”
Yin Zhengfan felt that Shi Yu was so strong. Even if he chose another specialization, there was no reason for him to give up fighting.
Battle power was the foundation of a Beast Tamer, and the battle club, school team, and National League were definitely the best place to train college students as Beast Tamers.
“Are you talking about Shi Yu?” White Brook asked.
“He’s here too, but it’ll take a while.”
“Really?” Yin Zhengfan’s eyes suddenly lit up, and countless battle intent surged in his heart. Shi Yu definitely couldn’t imagine how much progress he had made during this period.
Immediately, Yin Zhengfan wasn’t hungry anymore and decided to wait for Shi Yu here.
“Excuse me, can I wait for him with you? I want to fight a Beast Taming battle with Shi Yu!” As a reserve member of the battle club, he was only an audience member for the exchange two days later, so it didn’t matter if he waited for that day. If possible, he wanted to fight Shi Yu now.
“Uh.” As soon as Yin Zhengfan finished speaking, many students from Ancient Capital University had strange expressions.
There had long been rumors that Legend Yin’s son… had come to Imperial Capital University alone to study because he had lost to Shi Yu in the vocation assessment and was only a runner-up.
As expected, the rumors were true.
However… Why did it feel that this would be an inspirational but sad story?

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - Chi Tong Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chi Tong Battle
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Outside the capital’s main school.
The students of Ancient Capital University looked at Yin Zhengfan silently.
The atmosphere made Yin Zhengfan feel that something was wrong.
White Brook said, “Challenge Shi Yu?”
“I don’t think so.”
Although she had brought Shi Yu here to sweep through Imperial Capital University…
Generally speaking, Yin Zhengfan was also a member of Imperial Capital University.
However, it was too cruel to start with a child.
Although Yin Zhengfan was a genius, with his age placed here, winning was meaningless.
“Shi Yu has become very strong now…”
The elders in White Brook’s family also knew Yin Legend. She felt that there was no need to let Yin Zhengfan get burned.
Therefore, she tried to persuade her with a smile.
“Has he become very strong?”
When Yin Zhengfan heard that, he looked like he had expected it.
It was abnormal for a person like Shi Yu to stop.
He was already prepared that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had already evolved into the Nine Li Battle Beast of a monarch race.
He was already prepared for Shi Yu’s Green Silkworm to evolve into a pseudo monarch race that was not inferior to the Space Crystal Butterfly.
But even so, he was not afraid at all.
He was no longer the Yin Zhengfan from four months ago.
Just as Yin Zhengrong said, with the Beast Taming Space strengthening talent, the more resources there were, the stronger it was.
Compared to the vocation assessment, Yin Zhengfan had already started to develop the power of his talent.
After university, his Beast Taming Space broke through to level three and he became an intermediate Beast Tamer.
Originally, the upper limit of a normal intermediate-level Beast Tamer’s contracted pet was three. The upper limit of his pets’ growth level was also transcendent.
However, due to Yin Zhengfan’s Beast Taming Space strengthening talent, the upper limit of his current contracted pet had reached six, twice that of a Beast Tamer of the same level!
The upper limit of his pets’ growth level was not as simple as transcendent level, but commander level.
This was the power of the Beast Taming Space’s strengthening talent.
Now, Yin Zhengfan had already contracted four pets, and two of them had even broken through to the commander rank.
This change in strength made Yin Zhengfan’s confidence increase greatly.
Not only was his strength one of the best among the new students of Imperial Capital University, but he could also fight against some older students.
Even the team leader of the Imperial Capital University, the powerful man who had led Imperial Capital University to win the national championship, praised his progress and hard work, as well as acknowledged his current strength. Yin Zhengfan felt that the current Shi Yu was definitely not his match.
Because the current Shi Yu definitely couldn’t have a commander rank pet.
“It’s alright, because I’ve become stronger too.”
Yin Zhengfan looked at White Brook seriously and revealed a confident expression.
He was already a little glad to have come to Imperial Capital University.
Because after coming here, he realized that there were even geniuses stronger than Shi Yu.
This atmosphere was spurring his growth at all times.
Ancient Capital University, ranked sixth in the National League, was completely different from the first ranked Imperial Capital University in terms of battle strength.
“Uh.”
“Why aren’t you listening?”
At this moment, everyone from Ancient Capital University didn’t know what to say.
After all, they couldn’t expose Shi Yu’s information to the enemy school now, right?
“What are you doing? Why are you all gathered here?”
At this moment, a voice sounded.
Shi Yu’s arrival was faster than everyone imagined.
At this moment, Shi Yu arrived at Imperial Capital University without even changing his research clothes.
Shi Yu’s voice sounded, and everyone turned to look at him.
Yin Zhengfan also looked over.
After he saw Shi Yu, Shi Yu’s gaze also landed on Yin Zhengfan.
“Shi Yu…” Yin Zhengfan opened his mouth slightly.
“Uh, Yin Zhengfan?” Shi Yu discovered Yin Zhengfan from the crowd and immediately revealed a shocked expression.
“Why are you here?”
White Brook: “He’s waiting for you.”
“Waiting for me?”
“Yes, yes.” The seniors of Ancient Capital University nodded.
“Why are you waiting for me?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Shi Yu, can you fight me?”
“I heard from Senior White Brook that you’ve become much stronger.”
“And I’m no longer the same me as before.”
“I’m really happy to see you in the exchange team of Ancient Capital University.”
Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu with a burning gaze and said, “Actually, ever since the vocation assessment ended, I’ve been thinking about when I can surpass you. For this, I came to Imperial Capital University to study. I hope to use the pressure here to grow quickly.”
“Now, I think I already have the strength to surpass you.”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and looked at Yin Zhengfan.
“Can I?” Yin Zhengfan said in anticipation, afraid that Shi Yu would refuse.
“Imperial Capital University has a special battlefield,” he said. “Please.”
“Are you sure? You definitely can’t defeat me.” Shi Yu was speechless.
“It’s only been four months, and you want to surpass me?”
“I’m serious,” Yin Zhengfan said. “I’m also very surprised that I can improve so much in four months.”
“Are you willing to fight and see? Don’t tell me you’re afraid?” Because Yin Zhengfan, being a little cutie, was too anxious… He actually used reverse psychology.
“This… Alright then,” Shi Yu couldn’t withstand Yin Zhengfan’s yearning gaze and replied helplessly.
Sigh, children had a strong desire to win.
Forget it, it was fine even if they fought.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, no matter how much Yin Zhengfan improved, it was impossible for him to be stronger than his current self.
Otherwise, Eleven, Buggy, and the others could find a random Slime and kill themselves.
Shi Yu would also kill himself from the guilt of letting down the resources he had used.
Alright, then he wanted to see how much Yin Zhengfan had improved during this period.
“Ah, do you want to fight?”
“Fight now?”
As Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan spoke, the students from Ancient Capital University were shocked.
It wasn’t the time for the exchange between the two schools yet.
Although Yin Zhengfan didn’t seem to be an official member of the battle club at Imperial Capital University… There was no need to care about this, was it really alright for Shi Yu to make a move now?
“It’s alright, it’s a simple exchange.” Shi Yu didn’t plan on sending the main force.
“Then I’ll bring you to the battlefield.” Yin Zhengfan couldn’t wait.
“Follow me.” With that, he wanted to lead the way.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and followed behind Yin Zhengfan.
The other students of Ancient Capital University looked at each other.
Damn.
It was over.
Another teenager was going to lose his dream.
They could still remember the collapsed expression of that glorious Beast Tamer from Rongguang.
“Cough, let’s go take a look too.”
“Let’s go together.”
“Watch?? We haven’t registered at the school yet. Come with me after registering. Let them go over first,” White Brook said angrily.
…
At the third battle hall of Imperial Capital University.
It was still very lively around noon.
Shi Yu followed Yin Zhengfan over.
After arriving, Shi Yu was immediately stunned.
Damn it, not only was this university’s battlefield hall more luxurious than Ancient Capital University, but it also looked more luxurious than the venues for the Ancient Capital vocation assessment and vocation promotion assessment!
After entering the venue, the huge venue was divided into several areas. Each area had a huge screen.
On the screen, the names, levels, and current progress of the pets on both sides appeared to be very high-level.
“Over here,” Yin Zhengfan said to Shi Yu.
At this moment, about six to seven of the twenty venues in the venue were being used, but there were quite a lot of onlookers.
Yin Zhengfan brought Shi Yu to an empty venue. During this process, Shi Yu and the others bumped into a young man.
“Yo, isn’t this Zhengfan?” The hedgehog-headed young man saw Yin Zhengfan and greeted with a smile.
“Senior Zhang,” Yin Zhengfan said in surprise.
“A fight?” Senior Zhang said with a smile. He looked at Shi Yu, who was wearing a white coat behind Yin Zhengfan…
He didn’t know him…
“This is?”
Were they students from the Feeding Department, Research Department, or Medical Department?
He subconsciously treated Shi Yu as a student from Imperial Capital University. It was Yin Zhengfan who pulled him in for the battle.
“Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu.” Shi Yu smiled and introduced himself. “I came with the Ancient Capital University exchange team this time.”
After he introduced himself, Senior Zhang was stunned.
Holy shit.
Ancient Capital University’s exchange team?
Why did he come here to fight Yin Zhengfan?
What was going on? What was going on?
“We’re friends. I invited him to battle,” Yin Zhengfan said.
“This is Senior Zhang Yiming from the Battle Club of Imperial Capital University.” With that said, he introduced him to Shi Yu.
“Hello, Senior Zhang,” Shi Yu said with a smile. From the battle club of Imperial Capital University?
An opponent in two days?
“Hello.” Zhang Yiming was stunned and nodded. He kept feeling that the name Shi Yu was a little familiar.
He thought about it carefully and his expression changed slightly.
Because a little genius Yin Zhengfan came, the members of the battle club of Imperial Capital University had some understanding of the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital.
Among them, many students still had some impression of Shi Yu, who had defeated Yin Zhengfan and was bestowed the title of Iron-eating Beast Knight and discovered the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast.
After Senior Zhang Yiming recalled for a moment, he said in surprise, “You’re the top scholar of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment this year, Shi Yu?”
After asking, he quickly looked at Yin Zhengfan.
“That’s right, it’s me.” Shi Yu nodded.
Yin Zhengfan nodded too.
In an instant, Zhang Yiming’s expression was rich. Good lord.
It was no secret that Yin Zhengfan had lost to Shi Yu before. Tang Yun knew, and so did Zhang Yiming. Seeing Yin Zhengfan suddenly dragging Shi Yu to Imperial Capital University to fight in the battlefield hall, he instantly imagined countless scenes of love and murder.
He had just thought that Shi Yu was the main force of the Ancient Capital University’s exchange team. It turned out that he was a new student from Ancient Capital University who had come to broaden his horizons.
Interesting…
“I’ll be your judge. How about that?”
Out of curiosity about the Iron-eating Beast Knight, Zhang Yiming recommended himself.
He was very curious about what kind of Beast Tamer had defeated the little genius of Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan.
He was even more curious about the strength of the new students brought by the Ancient Capital University’s exchange team. Was it comparable to the reserve members of the Imperial Capital University team?
“Really? Then thank you, Senior,” Yin Zhengfan said.
This saved him the trouble of looking for other judges.
“It’s no big deal. Junior Zhengfan, Student Shi Yu, come on.” Zhang Yiming chuckled and casually looked at the arena beside him. “Let’s go to venue 11.”
Shi Yu :”…”
“No problem.” Yin Zhengfan nodded.
Imperial Capital University, battlefield hall 3, venue 11.
After stepping onto the arena, Zhang Yiming licked his lips and continued to climb onto the judge’s platform. He sat on it and activated the battle facilities.
The next moment, the big screen in front of the battlefield lit up. He said to Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu below, “What are the rules?”
Shi Yu looked at Yin Zhengfan and said, “You decide.”
Yin Zhengfan thought for a moment and said, “Well, have you advanced to intermediate Beast Tamer?”
Shi Yu smiled. “What do you think?”
“I advanced to an intermediate Beast Tamer three months ago.” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu advanced once more half a month ago…
Yin Zhengfan showed an “as expected” expression and said, “Then you should also have contracted a third pet.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“How about a 3VS3 solo?” Yin Zhengfan asked.
“Sure.” Shi Yu nodded again.
Zhang Yiming heard the rest of the words. 3VS3 solo. Alright, the settings were completed.
At this moment, looking at Shi Yu, Yin Zhengfan took a deep breath and said, “Then I’ll go to the red side.”
With that, he walked towards the red safety area of the huge arena.
Shi Yu took a look and walked towards the blue safe area behind.
A moment later, Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan stood on both sides of the arena.
At the same time, the commotion here also gradually attracted the surrounding students of the Imperial Capital University, making them look over.
“Eh, isn’t that Yin Legend’s son?”
“The youngest member of the battle club, Yin Zhengfan.”
“He’s here to fight.”
Yin Zhengfan was also a famous figure in Imperial Capital University. As they discovered that he had come here to battle, many Beast Tamers in the battlefield hall were attracted.
“Who’s fighting Yin Zhengfan?”
“I don’t know, but that person on the judge’s seat is Senior Zhang from the battle club?”
Amidst the commotion, many people came over.
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu had already summoned their pets under Zhang Yiming’s instructions.
Hu hu hu ~ ~
As the two of them activated the Beast Taming Space, a strong wind rose, and countless light spots flickered on the arena.
The light dots quickly connected into a trajectory, forming a huge circular array that looked like a star map.
On Yin Zhengfan’s side, there was a pure white summoning array. On the array, a huge lizard-like creature made of yellow sand, three meters tall, covered in black patterns, appeared. It looked like a two-legged creature. Sand ropes made of yellow sand surrounded it, and its pitch-black sunken eyes were filled with ferocity.
“Roar!!” The giant beast roared.
At this moment, the screen on the battlefield, under the red team lineup, had already displayed the pet’s profile picture and information.
[Race Name]: Desert Lord
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Energy Points]: 5940
Seeing this pet, many people exclaimed.
Although the information displayed on the battle screen was very simple, everyone knew what kind of creature it was.
Element!
High-level monarch race!
The monarch of the desert!
It was an absolutely powerful top-grade pet in the earth element.
Yin Zhengfan was young, and as an intermediate Beast Tamer, he had contracted such a top-notch pet. Countless people were envious.
“I remember that Junior Yin’s trump card pet is the Zonyan Rock Beast.”
“Another monarch pet?”
“It’s good to be rich.”
“What’s the opponent’s pet?”
Seeing Yin Zhengfan’s pet, everyone started to pay attention to Shi Yu.
As the attention arrived, soon, everyone’s gazes changed in unison, including Zhang Yiming, Yin Zhengfan, and everyone around the venue.
Especially Yin Zhengfan and Zhang Yiming, they looked at Shi Yu’s summoning array in disbelief.
It was a summoning array filled with a faint green light. It floated in the air like that. Seeing the color of this summoning array, Yin Zhengfan’s eyes widened in confusion.
Colorless, gray, white, green, blue, purple… The green summoning pattern was ranked fourth, corresponding to… high-level Beast Tamer…
Looking at the summoning array that was one level higher than his own level and sensing the powerful energy fluctuations coming from inside, Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
“Aren’t you an intermediate Beast Tamer…”
“I became an intermediate Beast Tamer three months ago. Half a month ago, I accidentally broke through to advanced again.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Yin Zhengfan: “?”
Zhang Yiming: “?”
“How is that possible?” Yin Zhengfan shook his head suddenly.
Although his Beast Taming Space was more difficult to cultivate than the Beast Taming Space of ordinary Beast Tamers, it didn’t make sense for Shi Yu to exceed his level in the same cultivation time.
After all, more than 99% of university graduates, including students from Imperial Capital University, were only high-level Beast Tamers when they graduated.
In an instant, Yin Zhengfan’s heart was in chaos. He couldn’t understand Shi Yu’s improvement speed.
“What are you…” Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu.
He realized that Shi Yu was still so sick. It didn’t make sense!
However, he didn’t give up.
Although he was only an intermediate Beast Tamer, due to his special talent, he also had commander-level pets like high-level Beast Tamers. It was just that he didn’t directly send them out!
At most, he would change pets now!
“Don’t worry, I also summoned an transcendent pet,” Shi Yu said when he saw Yin Zhengfan’s angry expression.
This boy really didn’t even know his own situation and came to challenge blindly.
“You sent out a transcendent? Not a commander rank?” Yin Zhengfan was stunned.
At this moment, a red light flashed from the inside of Shi Yu’s summoning array. In the next moment, a red sword spirit wrapped in red flames flew out.
Little Chi Tong was overjoyed. After all, this was the first time Shi Yu had called it out to battle a Beast Tamer.
Boom!
The moment it appeared, the desert monarch opposite instantly felt a burning heat sweep over.
Moreover, the Sword Spirit itself was like a terrifying heat source, spreading strong heat waves like a continuous volcano eruption.
In an instant, Yin Zhengfan and the desert monarch’s expressions changed. They sensed the terrifying power of their opponent head-on.
“Roar!!!”
The desert monarch roared. It felt that the power on the other side was at least twice its own.
Yin Zhengfan’s gaze was extremely solemn. “You… call this transcendent?”
However, at this moment, Chi Tong’s level was really displayed on the battle screen.
[Race Name]: Sword Spirit (No detailed classification information for now)
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
[Energy Points]: 11808
Well… although the total energy of the little sword spirit was high, its quality had yet to reach the commander rank standard, so such a strange value appeared in front of him.
“Look at the battle screen if you don’t believe me,” Shi Yu said.
Everyone looked over.
Transcendent… Energy Points… 11808…
Yin Zhengfan: “?”
Everyone: w(?Д?)w
Damn, what the f*ck?
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan revealed an incredulous expression again.
At the judge’s seat, Senior Zhang Yiming from the Battle Club of Imperial Capital University was also shocked, his gaze incredulous.
“What the hell?”
Shi Yu, this new student’s Beast Taming level, had reached level four. This already shocked him greatly and made him unable to understand.
At this moment, the pet Shi Yu summoned made him lose his ability to think.
Transcendent-level… more than 10,000 energy points?
Was he joking around?! 10,000, this was the standard for commander ranks of transcendent races!!
This guy was trying to say that this transcendent pet has reached the energy value of a commander-level pet??

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - Fan Fan Who Doubted Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Fan Fan Who Doubted Life
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan and everyone felt that it was extremely ridiculous.
“Is the machine malfunctioning?”
Zhang Yiming quickly checked the machine in front of him.
The battle facilities of Imperial Capital University were all high-tech and had their own energy detection function. However, as long as it was an instrument, there would be a malfunction. At this moment, Zhang Yiming suspected that the machine was malfunctioning. Otherwise, how could this value be possible?
Either the growth level displayed a mistake, or it should be commander rank, or the energy level displayed a mistake. It should be just in the thousands.
“This, what’s going on!!”
At this moment, not only Yin Zhengfan and Zhang Yiming, but the students from the Imperial Capital University below also looked at the little sword spirit’s growth level and energy level in a daze.
BUG?
Even if it was an ordinary overlord race at the transcendent level, its energy value would only be 6,000. This sword spirit was more than 10,000. How could that be!
This was a Mythical race?
“Wait a minute, I’ll check the machine,” he said.
However, after checking for a long time, Zhang Yiming still didn’t find any problems with the machine.
At this moment, facing Shi Yu and the sword spirit, Yin Zhengfan was actually a little flustered for a moment. He didn’t understand what was going on.
He should have had the absolute advantage, but the sudden high-level Beast Tamer and the unbelievable 10,000 energy points transcendent-level sword spirit directly couldn’t sit right with Yin Zhengfan.
“Stop checking. This machine isn’t malfunctioning. It’s the same as my index value. It’s very precise.”
“It’s just that my pet race’s potential is too strong…”
Shi Yu stopped Senior Zhang. Senior Zhang was stunned. Everyone was stunned.
Human language?
Yin Zhengfan stood uneasily.
It was definitely not human language!
“Aren’t you going to do it? Or do you plan to change pets?” Shi Yu said.
Little Chi Tong was already the weakest pet in his team.
It belonged to the kind of little guy who couldn’t even last one round against the other three.
Of course, this was because it was only at the transcendent level, and its skill proficiency was not high.
However, if Shi Yu, who had the current legendary physique, fused with the transcendent-level little sword spirit, he could still barely resist Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others who didn’t go full rampage on him.
“I’ll fight!” Yin Zhengfan gritted his teeth.
“Sand, Absolute Erosion!”
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Yin Zhengfan revealed an indignant expression and immediately issued an order.
He wouldn’t admit defeat!
Absolute Corrosion, earth-element super skill!
Creating a huge sandstorm, making it swallow enemies like a tsunami. The corrosive power contained in the sandstorm could erode all powers, having the terrifying effect of drying up energy, solidifying things and turning them to sand.
When developed to the extreme, it could instantly turn a town into a desert.
Boom!!!
At the moment, although the desert monarch had only mastered entry-level Absolute Corrosion, it already had powerful strength.
“Roar!!!” The three-meter-tall desert monarch roared, and the yellow sand on its body vibrated. In an instant, a huge sand sea that was six to seven meters tall surged behind it, and like a tsunami, it swallowed the little fire sword spirit floating in the air less than a meter away.
“It’s… the great earth-element skill, Absolute Corrosion!”
Everyone looked at the venue. It was huge right from the start. Looks like the ridiculous data of the sword spirit opposite made Yin Zhengfan feel immense pressure.
“Mi ~”
At this moment, Little Chi Tong was still very excited and had yet to recover.
“Be serious. Sun Flame, Light Flame Sword.”
Shi Yu said.
“Mi ~!”
Little Chi Tong expressed his understanding and turned to the huge sand sea that surged over. Endless flames gathered on the sword.
At this moment, the terrifying power fluctuations made the sand sea slightly deform, making the expressions of the desert monarch and Yin Zhengfan on the other side solemn.
No matter what the machine’s status was, this huge energy was definitely real.
Buzz…
As Shi Yu gave the order, Chi Tong looked like it was wrapped in sun flames. Flames covered the blade and the tip of the sword.
Super skill, Sun Flame!
It was a type of special flame!
An extremely powerful Sun Flame.
Using Yang Flame to cast the high-level skill, Light Flame Sword, instantly made Little Chi Tong explode with powerful strength.
Boom!!!
Countless people who were looking at the venue felt that the light in front of them was instantly snatched away, and the world seemed to have fallen into darkness.
At this moment, the desert monarch felt it the most. It felt a strong threat, and its body seemed to have fallen into darkness.
But in the next moment, killing intent overflowed.
A terrifying Sun Fireball fell from the sky. It was a sword light. A Yang Flame Sword flash that seemed to have broken through the darkness streaked across, turning into a terrifying fire sword aura that tore apart the sand sea.
When everyone reacted, the huge absolute erosion had already stopped in front of Little Chi Tong. A huge hole had already appeared in the sand that was flowing like a tsunami. Moreover, the entire sand sea was instantly wrapped in orange flames and disappeared in the blink of an eye!
At this moment, behind the sand sea, behind the huge hole, a painful roar instantly erupted.
“Roar!!!” The desert monarch looked at the sword scar that had appeared on its body at some point in time. It lowered its head to look at the sword scar that was filled with strong flames and howled in pain. In an instant, its entire body erupted, and yellow sand fell from its body!
“Roar!!!”
As if it was sand roasted by the sun, the temperature of the desert monarch’s body instantly rose to the limit, making it feel so painful that it wanted to die. Its consciousness gradually fainted.
A moment later, it finally couldn’t take it anymore and collapsed.
Boom!!!
The high-level monarch race, transcendent-level desert monarch, was directly killed by Chi Tong’s sword.
As the desert monarch fell to the ground, Yin Zhengfan didn’t react at all.
Speed was the special thing about the Light Flame Sword.
With Sun Flame as the power source, it was absolute speed.
At this moment, the desert monarch fell to the ground. Yin Zhengfan was stunned, and his mind suddenly froze. He took a step back.
Everyone opened their mouths wide and looked at everything in confusion.
“Wait…”
“What happened?”
“In an instant…”
Everyone was shocked.
He recalled what Shi Yu had said just now.
At this moment, no one suspected that it was a transcendent race, commander rank.
Such a skill was undoubtedly a super skill.
So, it was really a high-level race, transcendent level?
This couldn’t be the sword spirit of a f*cking overlord race, right? Moreover, it was the kind with a ridiculously high race, not even a low-level overlord.
Otherwise, it was impossible for it to have 10,000 energy points at the transcendent level!!
“Super skill, monarch… no, overlord race?”
“How is that possible? Overlords aren’t common. Quasi overlord?”
At this moment, everything shocked everyone. Judge Zhang Yiming was stunned.
He looked at the absent-minded Yin Zhengfan and thought to himself that this was bad.
“Mi ~!” Only Little Chi Tong cheered happily.
“Ah, I’m late.”
At this moment, nearly 20 people rushed over from the side of the venue. They looked at the fallen desert monarch and the little sword spirit that was already floating in the air. They were first stunned before looking at the battle screen.
Among these 20 people, White Brook revealed a helpless expression. So it did happen.
At this moment, in the judge’s seat, Zhang Yiming’s expression changed when he saw White Brook and the others. He suddenly felt that something was wrong.
Holy shit, why were all the members from Ancient Capital University here?
He couldn’t figure out what was going on.
The other students from the Imperial Capital University also looked at this group of people who had suddenly come.
In an instant, the atmosphere of the battlefield hall was especially heavy.
In the arena, Shi Yu looked at the stunned Yin Zhengfan and said, “Little Fanfan, I knew you couldn’t defeat me.”
On the other side, Yin Zhengfan was silent.
After recovering from his daze, he looked at the info. Transcendent level. The number of 10,000 energy points was very incomprehensible.
Why… Why was this happening? He didn’t understand!
“Who said so?” A moment later, Yin Zhengfan looked at Shi Yu with firm eyes.
Light lingered on the ground as he directly recalled the desert monarch.
“I’ll definitely win.”
“It’s not over yet. Don’t forget, I have the Beast Taming Space strengthening talent.”
With that, Yin Zhengfan forcefully forgot everything and started to summon new pets. He planned to not think about those unscientific things first and fight with all his might!
“Roar!!!”
In order to answer Yin Zhengfan’s heart, in the next moment, a four-meter-tall rock creature that looked like a two-legged dinosaur appeared and let out a roar filled with battle intent!!
Most of its body was covered in sharp chestnut rocks. It had strong limbs and a tail!
On its neck was a ring of sharp rock that looked like a scarf.!!
It was Yin Zhengfan’s Zonyan Rock Beast.
At the same time, on the battle screen, the desert monarch’s profile picture dimmed, revealing new information.
[Race Name]: Zonyan Rock Beast
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Energy Points]: 50,113
“Roar!!!” The moment the Zonyan Rock Beast appeared, lava began to flow out of the Zonyan Rock on its neck, releasing a scorching aura that was even greater than the energy on the little sword spirit.
It looked at Little Chi Tong and Shi Yu with an unfriendly expression.
When enemies met, their eyes were especially red.
Yin Zhengfan took a deep breath and looked at Shi Yu, temporarily ignoring the unscientific sword spirit.
This sword spirit… Even if it was ridiculous, no matter what, it was only at the transcendent level. It was only ten thousand energy points.
Then, as long as he sent out a commander rank pet.
“It’s not over yet. Change your commander rank pet.”
“You’re a high-level Beast Tamer. You should have a commander-level pet, right?”
Yin Zhengfan took a deep breath and realized that this sword spirit couldn’t change anything.
It would be fine as long as he defeated Shi Yu’s commander rank pet.
“Kid, you’re really stubborn.” Shi Yu thought to himself and looked at Little Chi Tong. The other party’s Zonyan Rock Beast… Chi Tong had possessed him and he felt like could fight.
And the chances of winning were not low.
However, considering that the red-haired Chi Tong’s posture was too high-profile, and that he didn’t know if the rules here allowed Beast Tamers to go on stage, he sighed…
“Alright.” According to Yin Zhengfan’s request, Shi Yu began to retract Chi Tong and summon a new pet.
“Mi???? (This is it…)”
As Shi Yu’s voice fell, Little Chi Tong’s figure began to disappear from the ground. At the same time, a new array appeared.
In the next moment, a small pet less than 0.3 meters walked out of the green array.
“Yiya.”
When this pet appeared and sensed the hot aura of the arena, it frowned and snorted before looking at its opponent.
Where was the opponent?
Baby Ginseng raised its gaze.
“Yiya, Yiya, Yi!” It was extremely domineering.
It was so domineering that the entire place became extremely quiet.
Everyone: “?”
Yin Zhengfan and the Zonyan Rock Beast’s expressions changed.
Zhang Yiming’s expression also changed.
Baby Ginseng?
What a joke!
Using a ginseng baby to fight a Zonyan Rock Beast?
Was he crazy?
“It’s also very strong,” Shi Yu explained again when he realized Yin Zhengfan’s incomprehensible gaze.
“Holy shit.”
Only the people from Ancient Capital University and the others knew the strength of this ginseng baby. However, even they were completely stunned when they looked at the huge battle screen.
Soon, others also saw the information displayed on the huge screen.
[Race Name]: Ginseng Baby
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Energy Points]: 10,3006…
100,000!
The huge number stunned everyone.
Including the seniors from Ancient Capital University. They knew that this ginseng baby was very strong, but… they didn’t expect it to be so ridiculously strong.
Even an overlord race, commander rank, didn’t have this energy value!!!
“Impossible.”
“This is definitely impossible!!”
The judge, Zhang Yiming, stood up and looked at the machine in confusion. So, the machine was definitely broken. It was indeed broken.
“100,000?”
“1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6… Damn, it’s a six-digit number.”
“What’s going on?”
“Is this scientific?”
“Quasi monarch-level ginseng baby??”
In the arena, Yin Zhengfan was confused. He also took a look at the battle screen. With this look, his gaze instantly became absent-minded again.
It felt that it was even more unscientific than seeing the transcendent sword spirit with 10,000 energy points just now.
Baby Ginseng, wasn’t it a transcendent race?
Wasn’t the energy value of a transcendent race and commander rank less than 20,000?
Even if the ginseng baby race was more energetic, but… but…
Yin Zhengfan stared at the battle screen blankly and suddenly shook his head, rubbing his eyes.
The Zonyan Rock Beast also turned around and counted the energy level. Then, it was stunned on the spot halfway through.
This little guy in front of him had twice its energy?
“Stop looking. Its energy value is indeed 100,000,” Shi Yu said.
“100,000?” Yin Zhengfan asked with a panting tone.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng nodded. It was average, third in the team.
100,000?!
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan looked at the little ginseng baby and at the big Zonyan Rock Beast. Compared to their race level, his mind was in a mess. He started to doubt his life and couldn’t understand until his worldview started to collapse… He knew very well what he had done these four months, but what exactly had happened to Shi Yu these four months!!
…
At the same time.
Tang Yun, a member of the Imperial Capital University team, successfully slipped out of the venue.
Her face was red and she was a little nervous.
Professor Fang Lin was too difficult to deal with. She had to coax and coax for a long time before she successfully escaped.
Next, it was time to do business.
Go to school and pass the information!
“Alright, I’ve successfully escaped. Now, I’ll go to the battle club to find Zhengfan and tell him about Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination!”
“We can’t fight him. That butterfly is too scary.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - Good News and Bad News
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Good News and Bad News
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the battlefield hall of Imperial Capital University.
At this moment, the crowd was extremely restless.
A ginseng baby with 100,000 energy points…
Energy was equivalent to the mana bar of a skill in the game.
It determined the power of a single skill and the number of times it could be released.
Under normal circumstances, it was bound to the race level and growth level.
The level corresponded to the energy. This was scientific common sense.
Generally speaking, pets of overlord races only had an average of eight to 100,000 energy points at the commander level.
A little less meant that this pet was not cultivated well. Its growth and skill training were not very good.
Higher meant that this pet was outstanding.
The top students of Imperial Capital University could understand.
However, they couldn’t understand why a ginseng baby that was clearly a transcendent race could have energy values that surpassed overlord races at the commander rank.
Although it could strengthen energy points by training oneself and raising skills, it wasn’t that there were no channels to increase energy. It wasn’t a fixed value. It wasn’t that it couldn’t break the racial restrictions, but…
But it was precisely because of this that everyone was shocked. What kind of cultivation and tragic training did this ginseng baby undergo to have such an energy value?
It had cultivated his racial skills to perfection?
Three meals a day using heavenly treasures?
Even so, it still didn’t make sense.
“This… is this the main point?”
“The point is that the race of the ginseng baby doesn’t seem to have any offensive skills.”
“Moreover, the difficulty of learning offensive skills for supplement-type pets is 100 times higher than for battle pets. It’s almost impossible for them to be proficient…”
“Under such circumstances, Yin Zhengfan’s opponent still chose to send this ginseng baby. Don’t tell me that this ginseng baby also has battle power.”
After being shocked by the energy situation of this ginseng baby, suddenly, many Imperial Capital University students discovered a blind spot.
Baby Ginseng was a supplement-type pet.
No matter how much energy there was, it couldn’t be converted into battle power. Instead, it could only be converted into a nourishing recovery effect!
However, Shi Yu still sent Baby Ginseng. They suddenly felt that things were starting to develop in a strange direction.
“Hehe.”
Listening to everyone’s discussion, the members of Ancient Capital University gave them a “you guys know very well” look.
Right, what was even more unscientific was yet to come!
In the arena, Yin Zhengfan’s expression was solemn to the extreme at this moment, his heart thumping.
He had also thought of what the others had thought.
However, before seeing the truth, everyone wanted to not believe him.
“I don’t believe you,” he said stubbornly.
Even if he had already realized something, it still chose to fight.
“Roar!!”
Under Yin Zhengfan’s command, the Zonyan Rock Beast’s mouth condensed a brown rock glow. It was ready to attack!!
“Buzz!” A thick brown pillar of light shot out, and countless flying rocks swept towards Baby Ginseng opposite!
High-level earth-element skill, Rock Roar Cannon!
This attack was powerful. From the scale, it seemed like the aftermath alone could devour the ginseng baby.
“Yi.” But on the other hand, Baby Ginseng didn’t mind when it saw this move.
It didn’t even have the intention to dodge.
Boom!
For a moment, rocks flew and wild winds surged!
The Rock Roar Cannon directly hit Baby Ginseng. In an instant, a terrifying energy explosion stunned everyone.
Although there were no problems with the venue because of the high-level material, the violent storm and rocks still swallowed Baby Ginseng’s tiny figure in an instant.
“Holy shit.”
This scene made everyone a little confused.
The members of Ancient Capital University were actually equally confused.
From what they knew, this ginseng baby had mastered the “Energy Fruit”, a nutrient that could explode, and the light-element unique skill, “Light Clearing Cannon”. These were all powerful skills.
However, why didn’t Baby Ginseng choose to counterattack but to take the other party’s skill head-on!
Only Yin Zhengfan and the Zonyan Rock Beast’s hearts skipped a beat.
Yin Zhengfan knew Shi Yu very well. He felt that… things were definitely not that simple.
“The smoke is so big, it can’t be uninjured, right…” A bespectacled male student said,” After all… there’s the law in anime where there’s smoke without injury…”
At this moment, everyone looked at the venue in a daze. Then, their eyes nearly popped out.
As the smoke from the Rock Roar Cannon dissipated, Baby Ginseng was still standing there, looking as if nothing had happened.
It was really not injured at all!
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan’s expression was almost dark to the extreme. The Zonyan Rock Beast also couldn’t believe it.
“Roar!!!”
“Yiya.”
Baby Ginseng was rooted in the ground, and its brown hardening power covered its entire body, as if it was wearing Earth armor. Its expression was calm.
Strengthening, a skill that combined plant power and earth power, could make the plant body hard as a rock.
Shi Yu had long upgraded this move to perfection. When it was activated, it was equivalent to temporarily turning Baby Ginseng into an earth-element creature. It had an extremely strong defense.
If that was all, it would be fine. In addition, Baby Ginseng’s racial skill, Earth Chain, was at the “Dao Proficiency” level. It could also instantly mobilize the earth power dozens of meters deep underground for itself…
This already involved the initial use of nature’s power.
Its current hardened weapon was much more resistant to attacks than Eleven’s hardened weapon.
At the moment, it was impossible for the Zonyan Rock Beast’s Rock Roar Cannon to break through the defense energy double that of his, and it was even relying on the natural power of the earth.
And the most despairing thing was that even if the Zonyan Rock Beast broke through its defense, it was still a superficial wound for Baby Ginseng.
Because after its slow healing and high-speed healing were maxed out, together with the source of life of the super skill, Baby Ginseng almost had the ability to instantly regrow broken limbs.
Baby Ginseng usually studied the anti-eleven Energy Bomb Fruit and the Anti-Buggy Energy Bomb Fruit. Once it accidentally blew up its arms and legs, its body could recover easily.
This incomparable defense and incomparable recovery power had already become a small monster in Shi Yu’s team.
After the next move, Baby Ginseng looked at the Zonyan Rock Beast.
It was time for it to counterattack.
Then, Baby Ginseng simply stretched out its palm.
In the next moment, a brown seed condensed in its palm.
Nutrition!
After integrating its earth and wood power into the nutrients, the ginseng baby took root in the ground and activated “lushness” and “solidification”.
In the blink of an eye, Baby Ginseng’s palm that was holding the seed directly emitted light, and thick tree branches filled the sky!
The tree branches seemed to have formed a sea of trees that instantly swallowed the huge Zonyan Rock Beast.
“What is this!!!”
Yin Zhengfan was shocked, and everyone’s expressions changed. They couldn’t understand this skill at all. This skill scared the Zonyan Rock Beast into hurriedly resisting.
“Roar!!!”
In an instant, scorching magma erupted from the Zonyan Rock Beast’s body, turning into countless fireballs that smashed into the sea of trees.
Boom!!!
The sea of trees attacked, but unfortunately, when the lava eruption that should have been extremely terrifying touched the sea of trees, it was like the water of a tap rushing to the stone surface, not leaving much impact.
The sea of trees directly resisted the magma and tied up the huge Zonyan Rock Beast. There was still surging magma flowing on it, but it couldn’t burn these solid tree branches.
Nutrition+Earth Chain+Improvement+Multiplication. All four skills were above transcendent. The other two were Dao Proficiency. The profundities formed by these skills were completely incomparable to the entry-level Lava Explosion of the Zonyan Rock Beast.
“Profundity, Burial of the Tree Sea.”
Shi Yu said. It was not the profundity formed by the four skills, but five. The moment the Zonyan Rock Beast was bound by the indestructible tree branches, small energy fruits began to be born on the pile of tree branches. These energy fruits that were born from absorbing the power of the tree sea were the final unique skill.
After they exploded, everything would be buried.
“Roar!!!!”
At this moment, the Zonyan Rock Beast struggled crazily from the tree branches all over its body. It felt as if it was bound by steel bars, and it watched helplessly as the tree branches bore fruits with strong threat.
The energy emitted by these fruits made the Zonyan Rock Beast panic.
In the blink of an eye, the grape-sized Energy Fruits flickered, as if it was about to bloom.
At this moment, the Zonyan Rock Beast’s gaze exploded to the extreme. Yin Zhengfan’s expression also changed drastically until he heard Shi Yu’s voice.
“Retract your pet.”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s voice, Yin Zhengfan suddenly woke up and hurriedly retracted his Zonyan Rock Beast.
At the same time, the profundity released by Baby Ginseng’s palm, the Burial of the Tree, completely erupted at this moment…
With a bang, a terrifying energy swept through the entire place.
Cracks started to spread on the ground like broken glass.
The arena rumbled. The energy shield protecting the arena also appeared like rolling seawater at this moment. Countless dazzling white lights shone on the entire arena. The violent airflow fiercely stimulated Yin Zhengfan’s nerves, making his heart pound.
Boom!
A moment later, everyone’s ears buzzed.
The power of the Burial of Trees directly made Senior Zhang Yiming, who was the judge, stand up. He looked at the situation in the arena and felt his heart bleed.
A strong wind swept past, and the Zonyan Rock Beast was no longer in the arena. Only Baby Ginseng was still standing there.
At this moment, Yin Zhengfan’s expression was already completely stunned.
“How can this be…”
He instantly understood the insurmountable gap between him and Shi Yu.
He had a confused expression, unable to understand why the difference between him and Shi Yu had become greater and greater after four months of hard work.
That attack just now…
Yin Zhengfan’s body trembled.
If all of them hit the Zonyan Rock Beast, there was no doubt that the Zonyan Rock Beast would instantly be heavily injured and suffer damage stronger than the desert monarch… Because of that, Shi Yu reminded him to retract his pet.
And his sharp instincts also made Yin Zhengfan choose to listen to advice.
Next, there was only one Space Crystal Butterfly left… However, at this moment, Yin Zhengfan was completely not confident that he could defeat this ginseng baby with the Space Crystal Butterfly.
The strength of this ginseng baby directly penetrated his understanding.
Including Imperial Capital University and Ancient Capital University, all the students opened their mouths wide as they watched everything.
They couldn’t understand it. They couldn’t understand it at all.
This was a f*cking ginseng baby???
What was that just now!
Ridiculous!! Baby Ginseng’s palm directly drilled out of a large forest. The trees could ignore the magma and even explode??
“Ancient Capital University, what do you mean?”
At this moment, Zhang Yiming, who was in the judge’s seat, was stunned when he saw all of this. Shi Yu’s strength was too ridiculous. Even he wasn’t his match.
At this moment, after seeing the Ancient Capital University exchange team led by White Brook appear, Zhang Yiming directly felt that they had come with ill intentions.
Could it be that from today onwards, Ancient Capital University was going to challenge them?
How dare they?
“What do we mean? We registered. We’re here to visit the school today.”
White Brook looked over. Because of her white tiger pet, her voice was especially deterring. It had the deterrence effect of being the king of all beasts, immediately making Zhang Yiming speechless.
Ancient Capital University?
At the same time, the surrounding Imperial Capital University students finally understood the identity of this group of people who had suddenly arrived.
In an instant, their expressions turned hostile.
On the venue.
Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan looked at each other.
Yin Zhengfan’s arm and clenched fist trembled slightly. He looked at Shi Yu and was silent for a long time before saying indignantly, “I… I admit defeat.”
He didn’t know how to continue fighting. If not for Shi Yu’s reminder just now, the Zonyan Rock Beast would definitely have been heavily injured. He had already lost completely.
“Don’t be so serious. Victory and defeat is common in war,” Shi Yu immediately said when he saw Yin Zhengfan’s face fall again.
“A loss is a loss.” Yin Zhengfan couldn’t accept it. He had clearly come to Imperial Capital University to broaden his horizons and seen many geniuses who should have been stronger than Shi Yu, so why… He didn’t understand where he was lacking.
It turned out that it was true that Shi Yu said that he couldn’t defeat him now.
“Thank you for fighting me. I won’t be so reckless next time. Well, I’ll leave first.” Yin Zhengfan bowed at Shi Yu. His anxious mood of wanting to fight Shi Yu at the start had completely turned cold at this moment.
As he had yet to eat lunch, Yin Zhengfan was even more dizzy. After saying that, he turned around weakly and wanted to leave.
This scene stunned Senior Zhang Yiming, who was watching from the judge’s seat, and also made White Brook and the others secretly shake their heads. Sigh, that was why they said not to fight Shi Yu. Damn it, their group of alumni didn’t know why this university ginseng who often attended classes was so strong.
Damn it, could it be that the overlord cat had given Baby Ginseng special treatment?!
The students of Ancient Capital University were suddenly shocked. After all, someone often saw Baby Ginseng and the overlord cat of Ancient Capital University appear together.
“Alright.” Shi Yu pondered for a moment. Seeing Yin Zhengfan leave, he also shook his head and took back the excited baby ginseng. He helplessly got off the stage and came to White Brook and the others.
He had a premonition… that Yin Zhengfan wouldn’t give up so easily. After knowing his strength, the salted fish eyes of Yu Shu and the others didn’t appear on Zhengfan. Shi Yu felt that Yin Zhengfan didn’t seem to have admitted defeat yet.
“It’s over just like that? I haven’t announced the results yet. Can you guys respect the judge a little?” At this moment, the most stunned person was Senior Zhang Yiming. He stood in the judge’s seat in a daze and suddenly looked at Shi Yu.
Seeing Shi Yu and White Brook meet up, Zhang Yiming was at a loss. The corners of his mouth twitched as he took out his cell phone and planned to ask for help. He felt that he couldn’t hold on alone here.
Ancient Capital University definitely didn’t have good intentions.
On the other side, Yin Zhengfan pushed through the crowd and wanted to go to the lounge to lie down for a while. At this moment, his cell phone rang.
Yin Zhengfan looked at Tang Yun’s name on the screen with dim eyes and chose to answer.
“Senior, what’s the matter?”
“Zhengfan, where are you? Have you eaten? Why don’t we go together at noon?”
“I… don’t have an appetite.” Yin Zhengfan was silent.
“But I have very important news to tell you in person.”
Yin Zhengfan :”…”
“Why aren’t you saying anything?? Alright, alright, it’s the same over the phone. That Shi Yu seems to have really come to Imperial Capital University.”
“I… I already know.”
“What, you know?”
At the door of Imperial Capital University, Tang Yun was stunned. “That’s fine too, but, um, there’s something else I need to tell you.”
“That Shi Yu is much stronger than during the vocation assessment. I saw his pet, I feel that…” Tang Yun didn’t know how to describe it.
She was thinking of a way to let Yin Zhengfan understand that he might not be able to defeat Shi Yu now.
“Senior, there’s no need to say anymore.”
“…Well, I’ve already fought Shi Yu.” Yin Zhengfan’s tone was low as he said, “I’m sorry, I was reckless this time. I didn’t recognize the difference and challenged blindly. I… lost, I lost very badly.”
Just as they entered Imperial Capital University, Tang Yun was stunned when she heard the weak voice on the other side of the phone. Her mouth fell open.
“Wh, when did this happen?”
“Just now.”
Tang Yun’s heart skipped a beat. She looked in the direction of the Feeding Conference in disbelief. Shi Yu wasn’t there??
Why, why did he suddenly come to Imperial Capital University and even finish fighting Yin Zhengfan??
This didn’t make sense.
Wasn’t the exchange event two days later? She clearly came after the competition ended in the morning.
What exactly happened…
“Senior, don’t worry. I can take the blow.”
Although Yin Zhengfan’s expression was a little dim, he didn’t despair. This was because he had indeed seen many more monstrous geniuses in Imperial Capital University.
For example, the current captain of the big school in the capital was a complete monster.
Because of his family’s influence, he could write online gaming hack codes at the age of 12.
After awakening the Beast Taming Talent at the age of 13, he directly created a virtual life and used it to invade the school’s Internet, the Internet of nearby companies, and the Internet system of the Beast Tamer Association… It shocked the entire association.
This was because he had the same “Awakening” talent as the Mechanic ancestor. He could upgrade the Internet data program to a virtual life form and create mechanical creatures.
As expected, this person was secretly cultivated by the association. He only appeared again a few years later and started university life.
Yin Zhengfan was extremely respectful towards this captain of the Imperial Capital’s big school. This was because even his father, Legend Yin, admired this genius very much.
Although he only had one pet, that pet was created, assembled, and upgraded by him. It was a mechanical life form made of virtual data from an overlord race.
Facing this super genius known to have the ability to participate in the development process of an overlord-level mechanical life, the future legendary Mechanic, and even this year’s national champion, Yin Zhengfan had long understood the vastness of the outside world.
After witnessing such a genius at Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan felt that his horizons had been broadened a lot. He even set this captain as a distant goal. It was the next goal to surpass after defeating Shi Yu.
Therefore, at this moment, even after witnessing the incomparable difference between him and Shi Yu, Yin Zhengfan didn’t lose heart.
In the end, it was still because he didn’t work hard enough. There was clearly a training place with a crueler environment. Yin Zhengfan clenched his fists. He wanted to enter the time mystic realm of Imperial University to train…
If he could overcome the environment there, perhaps, no, he could definitely narrow the gap between him and Shi Yu and the others.
“Zhengfan…” Tang Yun didn’t know what to say.
Although Yin Zhengfan lost, it seemed that he didn’t suffer too much damage and instead converted the loss into motivation?
Tang Yun was relieved at once. She added, “Well, it can’t be helped. That Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination is a middle-level overlord race. It has too many advantages. It’s normal that you can’t defeat it now, but I believe that you can surpass it soon…”
“…”
“Zhengfan? Say something.”
At Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan held the phone in a daze, his expression gradually becoming confused.
“Wh-what butterfly?” he asked.
At this moment, both parties’ hearts skipped a beat.
The good news was that Yin Zhengfan didn’t encounter the abnormal Butterfly of Imagination.
The bad news was that Yin Zhengfan lost before touching the Butterfly of Imagination.
…
At the battlefield hall of Imperial Capital University.
Due to the heavy atmosphere inside, White Brook was afraid that she would fight with the students of Imperial Capital University, so she immediately left with Shi Yu and the others.
At this moment, everyone looked at Shi Yu as if they were looking at a monster.
“I feel that Imperial Capital University won’t let us off. The venue is cracked.”
“Cough.” Shi Yu looked at the sky and said, “The weather is pretty good.”
“Are we going to visit Imperial Capital University next?”
“I heard from Senior Lu that Imperial Capital University has a time department facility. Is that true?”
“I’m not sure…” Many seniors of Ancient Capital University shook their heads.
White Brook glanced at Shi Yu and said, “It’s true.”
“The Time Mystic Realm was left behind by the first principal of the Imperial Capital University. Ten days inside is equivalent to one day outside. It can quickly increase battle power.”
“However, you can forget about visiting this place. The environment inside is very harsh. You have to wear a lot of high-level equipment to offset the erosion of the power of time. Even students from Imperial Capital University aren’t allowed to enter casually, let alone us.”
The first principal of the Imperial Capital University rose during the last totem war. Like Emperor Shi, he also had time strengthening talent. However, his growth experience was not as legendary as Emperor Shi. In the end, he only became a legendary Beast Tamer and did not contract many time-element pets.
This time mystic realm was a place where he used his Beast Taming Space to modify humans to cultivate battle power at a high speed before he died.
Unfortunately, although the idea was good, the final result had many drawbacks. Because the effect of time erosion was too serious, very few pets could adapt to the environment inside.
In addition, only Beast Tamers and pets below the legendary and overlord level could enter, so the Time Mystic Realm was actually very useless in Imperial Capital University.
“Ah, you’re not giving it a tour?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“There’s such a mystic realm?!” The other members of the battle club were tempted.
Holy shit.
Looking at it this way… Ancient Capital University was so weak.
“Of course not,” White Brook said. “But the guardian of the Time Mystic Realm, a time-type pet left behind by the first principal of the Imperial Capital University, likes to interact with people very much. We can go and take a look.”
“Is it the legendary owl that likes to tell fortunes and predict the future?” Xu Ze, the vice president, asked.
“That’s the one. The time-element monarch race, the Future Prediction Owl. That owl has mastered the super skill, Future Prediction, but because it’s too difficult to train, its Future Prediction effect is very poor… Not only can’t it predict things that exceed its strength, but it can only predict them once every ten times. It’s said that its favorite is to tell fortunes for the students of the Imperial Capital University who pass by.”
“Fortune-telling?? Future Prediction??” Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he heard the beast-eared girl.
Good heavens, Future Prediction Owl? What kind of race was this? Its race name was too simple and clear. Which genius named it?
“Are you interested?” White Brook looked at everyone, especially Shi Yu.
“Although it might not be very accurate, it’s quite interesting.”
“Of course, before the prophecy, it will ruthlessly charge according to the target…” White Brook chuckled.” So those without money can forget about it. ”
Many people’s faces darkened. As expected, fortune-tellers were all black-hearted.
“Let’s go take a look.” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. It didn’t matter if it was a fortune-teller or not.. It wasn’t like it could predict which ruin he would die in in the future. He just wanted to be friends with the prophecy owl!

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - Future Prediction
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Future Prediction
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In Imperial Capital University, Teacher Shen, the instructor of the battle club, calmly took out his cell phone.
When the exchange team of Ancient Capital University finished registering and entered the school to take a look, he had actually already received the news.
But he didn’t mind.
This was because this kind of exchange activity had always been between students.
Therefore, there were no teachers at Ancient Capital University. There were no teachers opposite, so he naturally couldn’t be bothered to receive them.
After hearing the news, he only informed the students of his club.
If there were students who were willing to receive them, they would go. It didn’t matter if no one let the Ancient Capital University team visit it themselves. After all, it was the exchange match day of the two school battle clubs two days later.
Only at that time did he have the interest to take a look.
Teacher Shen: “The battle club exchange team from Ancient Capital University has come to visit the school. If you guys are willing to be guides, go ahead.”
He casually mentioned it. After all, the person who came was a guest. Although the school was in a competitive relationship, there was no deep hatred. Many students were still willing to do this.
Even though they weren’t from the same school, they were still students together.
It wasn’t like there hadn’t been cases of top-notch students from Imperial Capital University leading other schools’ juniors to visit schools. Perhaps there would be sparks of love between them. It wasn’t like there had never been cases of students from different schools falling in love and walking into the sour and smelly hall of love.
Zhang Yiming: “Not good! Ancient Capital University is here to challenge us! Junior Zhengfan is so sad now…”
Teacher Shen: “?”
Yin Zhengfan: [???]
Tang Yun: […]
Teacher Shen: “What’s going on?”
Somewhere in Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan felt a little stifled when he saw Senior Zhang Yiming directly selling the news of his defeat.
Although everyone would know sooner or later, it had just ended not long ago. Couldn’t they let him have a good meal first?
Reserve member Yin Zhengfan: “…I’ll say it myself. I… just encountered an exchange member from Ancient Capital University. For certain reasons, I issued a challenge and lost to him.”
Many of the diving seniors didn’t mind because it was very normal for Yin Zhengfan, a new student, to lose when he encountered the other party.
However, Yin Zhengfan’s next words made these people unable to hold it in anymore.
[The other party has a ginseng baby with more than 100,000 energy points. My Zonyan Rock Beast… was insta-killed by the other party…]
Everyone: [?]
Teacher Shen: [???]
Teacher Shen: “A ginseng baby with an energy value above 100,000?? Zhengfan? Are you confused?”
Zhang Yiming: “It’s absolutely true. I was the judge at that time… At the scene, that ginseng baby was so strange and strong. I feel that apart from the captain and the two vice teams, the rest of us will feel a lot of pressure when we face that ginseng baby. The other party doesn’t come with good intentions. Should we be careful during the competition…”
The captain and two vice-captains of the Imperial Capital University’s team were both master-level Beast Tamers with monarch-level pets. The three of them didn’t care about this exchange at all, because apart from the beast-eared girl, there was no one else worth their effort in Ancient Capital University.
The real competition stage for these masters was the National League. This kind of exchange activity was trained by everyone below the level of master. Therefore, after Zhang Yiming said that apart from these three masters, no one else was safe from the students of Ancient Capital University who defeated Yin Zhengfan, the group instantly became restless.
Jin Wei, a member of the battle club: “Who is it? Who cultivated a ginseng baby in Ancient Capital University? Why don’t I remember such a person?? I still feel that something’s wrong. Baby Ginseng?”
Yin Zhengfan: “Shi Yu… is a new student from Ancient Capital University. He and I are candidates for the same vocation assessment. However, he’s already a high-level Beast Tamer now. Baby Ginseng is also a commander rank, a commander rank with 100,000 energy points…”
Everyone was shocked and suddenly felt that this name was a little familiar.
[The Iron-eating Beast Knight who discovered the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast?]
Someone thought of something.
Wait, it was him? How was this possible? Wasn’t this growth speed too ridiculous?
In four months, from a low-level Beast Tamer to a high-level Beast Tamer, it had a ginseng baby with 100,000 energy points?
Yin Zhengfan had already relied on his talent to have commander rank battle power in four months. What was wrong with this Shi Yu?
Everyone was completely stunned. They didn’t expect that the expert from Ancient Capital University that Yin Zhengfan and Zhang Yiming mentioned was a new student. Although this new student was very famous, as the son of a legend, Yin Zhengfan was also quite famous as a genius Beast Tamer at the age of 13. He was famous too!
What made many members of Imperial Capital University think that it was ridiculous was Zhang Yiming and Yin Zhengfan’s high evaluation of him. What did they see and experience?
Teacher Shen: “Don’t stay in the slumps for too long. Train as usual in the afternoon.”
At this moment, looking at the chat record, Teacher Shen from the Imperial Capital University was first surprised that a super genius had appeared in the Ancient Capital University. He was shocked by such a high-energy battle ginseng. Then, she said without much thought, because no matter how strong a genius was, it couldn’t be stronger than the Imperial Capital University.
Just the captain of the Imperial Capital University’s team, Qiu Miao, alone was enough to suppress his peers. A battle ginseng with 100,000 energy points sounded very ridiculous, but Teacher Shen thought about it. Apart from the three captains, the few quasi-master-level students in the team, with the explosive power of their Beast Taming Talent, it wasn’t difficult to deal with them. As a teacher, there was no need to pay too much attention. He just let the students handle it themselves.
Obviously, he didn’t know Shi Yu’s identity at all…
Yin Zhengfan: “There’s… another news.”
Another piece of news?
Tang Yun: “Let me tell you! That ginseng baby might not be Shi Yu’s trump card. I just finished the morning Feeding Conference with Professor Fang… You might not believe me, but Shi Yu, who I mentioned just now, also participated.”
Everyone: “?”
What was going on?
[I won’t explain the feed results first. You’ll know when you watch the news later. The key is that at the Feeding Conference, Shi Yu showed his pet!!]
[That pet, that pet, do you remember the Butterfly Meeting in Divine Capital? At the Butterfly Meeting, a middle-level overlord race’s Butterfly of Imagination appeared. The Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination was Shi Yu, a middle-level overlord race, commander rank… Spatial-type, Butterfly of Imagination! It’s actually a new student’s pet…]
The Butterfly of Imagination, Shi Yu’s pet?
In an instant, the group fell silent.
Even Teacher Shen behind him was stunned, revealing an incredulous expression.
In this world, there would always be some life forms that would become unique races due to special opportunities. Such races were all powerful overlords, divine pets pursued by Beast Tamers, and symbolic pets that could become legendary Beast Tamers.
The Butterfly of Imagination was such a unique super rare pet. When most of the people from the battle club at the Imperial Capital University saw that news, they were incomparably yearning. However, when they learned that such a creature was only a pet of a student of the same age, or even younger than themselves, they were instantly speechless.
“…”
Teacher Shen originally didn’t care about this exchange, but at this moment, his expression changed slightly. Wait a minute, what kind of monster came to Ancient Capital University this time? A student contracted an overlord species pet… In the hundred years of history of the nine major universities, there were only a few…!
“Who is this Shi Yu?” At this moment, this thought appeared in everyone’s minds.
At the same time, Shi Yu and the others had already been brought to one of the most remote places in Imperial Capital University by the beast-eared girl.
“This is near the mystic realm of time? No one’s watching over it???”
On the stone forest path, a group of people from Ancient Capital University climbed the stone mountain and were very curious about the surrounding environment.
“No. After all, without the permission of the school committee of the Imperial Capital University, even legendary Beast Tamers can’t find the entrance to the mystic realm of time. There’s no need to look after it at all. Moreover, the owl we’re looking for now is an overlord-level pet. Although I heard that the prophecy isn’t very reliable, it still has strength. With it watching, there’s no problem. If there’s someone coming, it’s not like it would be protecting the mystic realm, but more like it’d be accepting the guests.”
Just as White Brook finished speaking, two people walked out of the stone forest. From their age, they seemed to be students from Imperial Capital University. When the two students saw Shi Yu and the others, they were slightly stunned before ignoring them. They continued walking down and chatting.
“It’s over. Even Lord owl said that my confession will fail. I think it’s better not to…”
“Don’t be afraid. What if it was wrong? Isn’t it common for it to predict wrong things? You have a chance!”
“Come on, there’s definitely the accuracy if it’s such a small matter…”
The two students spoke one after another, walking further and further away under the stunned expressions of White Brook, Shi Yu, and the other Ancient Capital University members.
Vice President Li Ze said in confusion, “Does it predict love matters??”
After a moment of silence, White Brook said, “This isn’t the most ridiculous thing. The most ridiculous thing is that it’s said that it once calculated for a Beast Tamer that the Beast Tamer’s best partner is its pet.”
Everyone :”…”
Everyone was originally looking forward to this time-element Prediction Owl, but why did they suddenly feel that it was still mostly a scam? After all, if they accepted the money, even if it didn’t use super skills and was just randomly giving a result… No one could say anything. They didn’t know if it was true or false.
A success rate of 9 to 1, could it be that it had been scamming money like this all along?
The dozen or so people continued to walk speechlessly. Soon, they arrived at the legendary habitat of the Prediction Owl.
It was a temple in the stone forest, making the atmosphere of a charlatan very strong.
There was a dark blue owl with a time hexagram pattern on the light-colored feathers on its abdomen. It narrowed its eyes and listened to the students in front of it.
Two students had just returned, and there were still seven to eight students lining up here. This owl’s business was pretty good…
“If nothing goes wrong, your pet can give birth in a year.” It still narrowed its eyes, but its beak moved as it said to a female student in front of it.
It could talk!!
In Shi Yu and the others’ ears, the voice looked like a sharp old witch in her fifties or sixties.
This reassuring voice was scary.
The girl: “???”
“Lord owl, I’m begging you to predict where the opportunity for its evolution is. I didn’t ask you to predict when it will give birth.” She pointed at the half-tall yellow bear beside her feet, which was an earth-element desolate bear, and broke down.
The owl straightened its feathers and said helplessly, “I only saw this scene. Perhaps there’s a connection? Since fate has been decided, it’s up to you now.”
The girl received the prophecy and had a crying expression. The students beside her looked like they were watching a show.
This owl’s prophecy was so ridiculous, but strangely, it had really used an extremely ridiculous prophecy to let some Beast Tamers see the correct future. After decades, no one knew if this guy was reliable or not.
Because of its premonition, many students from the Imperial Capital University changed their fate in advance.
It was also because of its premonition that many people took the wrong path. After a long time, they finally understood and turned around while crying.
Fortunately, this owl charged relatively low fees for students of the Imperial Capital University. It was also a pet of a legendary Beast Tamer, so the students were still willing to come to it to predict the future. What if they hit the jackpot? What if?
They wanted to see the results with a verification mindset!
“Perhaps the son would evolve?” Her friend guessed.
Wild Bear :”…”
“Eh, many people are here. Do you want me to read your future?” The Future Prediction Owl narrowed its eyes and raised its head to look at the students of Ancient Capital University standing neatly in a row behind.
“Just taking a look…”
“…” Many students of Ancient Capital University still felt that it was a little unreliable.
However, there were also people who felt that it was quite interesting. For example, Xu Ze, the deputy president of the Ancient Capital University, asked, “Well, how much does it cost to predict the future?”
He wanted to know where the opportunity for his pet to break through to the master level was. From the current progress, it felt like it was far in the future.
The owl turned around and said, “You’re not students of the Imperial Capital University, right? A level-five energy crystal for payment.”
“Level-five energy crystal, it’s all about money…” Xu Ze was directly angry. Stealing money? But considering that the creature in front of him was an overlord-level creature, he said cowardly, “After thinking about the price, I decided to forget it. My fate hasn’t been decided. I have to fight for it myself. ”
He would never squander millions of yuan on an inaccurate and unknown prophecy.
Ridiculous.
So expensive!
The other students of Ancient Capital University also had this thought.
Everyone suddenly felt that this guy might be even richer than the gem cat. It was definitely a black businessman.
“Who is it?” As the two conversed, the students from the Imperial Capital University present looked at the dozen or so people who had suddenly appeared. They revealed puzzled expressions. They weren’t students from the Imperial Capital University?
Where did it come from?
