“Then if it’s a student from Imperial Capital University, how much is it every time?” A senior from the club with long hair asked.
The Owl: “It’s either free or infinitely big.”
“Listening to you is like listening to a sentence,” the long-haired senior said.
Obviously, this owl didn’t plan to let people outside Imperial Capital University predict the future.
In an instant, the students of the Ancient Capital University looked at each other. A level-five energy crystal was equivalent to a monarch-level resource. There was only White Brook, a master, present. Apart from her, probably no one else could take out so much money.
It was too ridiculous.
“Don’t look at me. I’ve already calculated it once when I was young. No.” White Brook shrugged.
As for what it was, she blushed. Although it wasn’t accurate now, in the future… she hoped to hit the jackpot!
Eh?
The owl shook its head. ‘Who are you?’
Forget it, I forgot.
It said, “It’s understandable if there’s an occasional mistake.”
Everyone :”…”
“There aren’t any level-five energy crystals. Is it okay if it’s a rare level-four resource?” At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly spoke from the crowd.
“What? Level-four resource?” The owl was just about to say that he had slashed the price too much, but it was suddenly stunned.
No one saw what was going on when Shi Yu suddenly took out a fruit.
When everyone showed confused expressions, the owl fell silent.
It looked at Shi Yu’s bracelet.
This guy brought a ruin space?
In addition, this fruit…
[If it’s not wrong, this is a fruit that contains a weak power of time. I haven’t seen a spiritual fruit of this quality in a long time. Although the energy level is a little weak, the life force inside is incomparably pure. It seems to be able to increase the potential of creatures below the commander race… Next time, after throwing it to the ruins of time to undergo the baptism of the power of time, its level might be able to grow to a very, very high level.] The owl looked at this nutrient fruit and was extremely surprised.
What a future spirit fruit! It was a species he had never seen before!
The owl showed an interested expression and said, “Deal.”
“I’ll predict it for you once!”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “Five times. Although this fruit is only at level four, its value definitely exceeds a level-five energy crystal. It’s raw at first, but it’s worth is definitely above level five. I still have a pile of this kind of spiritual fruit over there. Perhaps I’ll come here to have my fortune told next time.”
This was a top-notch nutritional fruit condensed by Baby Ginseng at the cost of exceeding the limit of its strength. It could change the pet’s evolution potential and increase the effect through the power of time. It was definitely not something ordinary level-four resources could compare to. It was too crazy to only give a prophecy once.
“Five times?!!” The owl had never seen anyone so black-hearted. They thought that time-element super skills were like cabbages…
However, at this moment, the owl vaguely sensed that the Shi Yu in front of it was very special. It was as if he was someone favored by time. A weak but pure power of time lingered around him. Generally speaking, if it wasn’t a time-type talent, then it would definitely become like this because he often came into contact with the power of time.
Who was this guy?
Where did this come from?
It thought for a moment. In addition to the ruins space and this special spiritual fruit, the Prediction Owl nodded and realized that Shi Yu’s identity was not ordinary. In that case, it said, “So be it. I’ll give it to you.”
Before Shi Yu could react, the nutrient fruit in his hand disappeared. It was controlled by Psychic to fly out of his palm and into the room behind the owl.
At this moment, everyone looked at everything in a daze.
What, what, what? What happened? What did Shi Yu take out? Why did the Foresight Eagle agree to do it five times?
However, although they didn’t know what it was, judging from the owl’s reaction, Shi Yu had definitely taken out something extremely rare and valuable.
“Boss, you’re so silly!!” The seniors of Ancient Capital University looked at Shi Yu. Even the surrounding students of Imperial Capital University looked at Shi Yu as if they were looking at a spoiled kid.
“Hu! Hu!” The little desolate bear that was given a bad prediction also looked at Shi Yu with a pained expression.
If he didn’t want the money, he could give it to it.
“Alright, what do you want to predict?” The owl flapped its wings with a Buddhist expression.
From various signs, the premonition could specify a direction.
“I want to predict the future for myself and my four pets. Do mine first.”
Shi Yu said, “Actually, I’m an archeologist. I’m more curious. In the future, which ruin will I be in when I encounter a life-and-death crisis?”
Although it was said that this premonition was to become familiar with the owl so that he could replicate skills later, it wasn’t like Shi Yu didn’t want to know certain things.
For example, if he really started to return to his old profession and become obsessed with ruins, there would definitely be a day when he would encounter danger. How could he not be prepared? If he could know in advance which ruins would bring him danger, then he would…
It was impossible not to go. At most, he would wait until he developed a little more before going.
Well, he would wait until Eleven and the others reached the Mythical stage before going in. He would directly smash the main door.
“Archeologist?” The Prediction Owl revealed an interested expression, as if it knew what was going on with the power of time on Shi Yu’s body…
It was even more concerned about the prophecy that it was about to give to Shi Yu.
It only had one super skill, Future Prediction. However, its proficiency was only at the expert level.
Ordinary overlord-level creatures usually had super skills basically at the perfect level, but this owl had lived for less than a hundred years, and its growth level had already broken through the racial limit. Yet, the super skill was actually only at the expert level. It was really unscientific, but this also indirectly explained the difficulty of the Future Prediction skill.
In fact, for some future fragments related to its battles in the future, the Prediction Owl could easily predict them and use this to easily dodge the enemy’s attack. It could fight with the opponent from an omniscient point of view, like a player. However, it was impossible to increase proficiency with the Prediction Future skill only because it was related to itself.
Moreover, just predicting the future for a short period of time was not the future it wanted to see.
It wanted to have the feeling of seeing through the fate of all creatures. Therefore, in order to train this skill, it stayed in Imperial Capital University for 100 years and calculated countless lives for others. Unfortunately, the skill was still far from perfect.
However, what made the Prediction Owl happy was that every time it predicted the right future and that future did happen, it would obtain an uncertain skill proficiency. Although it wasn’t much, it was better than nothing. Moreover, it could earn extra money. It wasn’t a loss.
“Yes.”
“Alright, I’ll give you a prophecy…”
The time hexagram on the owl’s chest glowed slightly. Everyone looked at it and Shi Yu.
This guy was still getting scammed!!
Good lord, this was the prophecy?
The ruins were definitely dangerous. Why would he explore ruins with so much money?
If he had money to see the future crisis, he might as well spend money to change his fate!!
“Eh…”
As the owl asked in confusion, everyone looked like it was as expected. Look, it was a scam.
At this moment, sensing the traces of Shi Yu in front of him, the Prediction Eagle’s expression became more and more strange.
In fact, predicting the future of others was like drawing a lottery. Even if it had a fixed direction, its skill proficiency might still be crooked. This also led to some extremely ridiculous results being predicted.
Some of these crooked results were correct, while others were completely crooked. This was because there were endless possibilities in the future. However, this time, the owl had planned to give Shi Yu a good premonition, but it didn’t expect that it had a feeling that it was going to be crooked from the start.
“So vague.”
“Forget it, I’ll just take a look around.”
The owl was immediately immersed in a dark world and began to see blurry scenes. It had prophesied to many Beast Tamers, and some people had even become legends. Yet, their futures never felt so vague.
Soon, the owl captured the ruins and crisis related scenes according to its “prayer.”
Countless images flashed past. Some collapsed, some couldn’t be seen clearly, but some were quickly seen by the owl.
Finally, under the full concentration of the owl, it saw Shi Yu’s figure and saw him coming out of a blurry ruins space.
In the next moment, the ruins collapsed, and a beam of light shot into the sky.
In the incomparably dark future scene, the Prediction Owl saw pairs of eyes opening one after another. There were dozens of eyes. The owners of the eyes emitted a terrifying aura. The aura of every creature was more than ten times that of it. It was extremely terrifying, and its gaze locked onto the light and Shi Yu!
A moment later.
“Ah!!!” The Prediction Owl, whose voice was like that of an old witch, suddenly opened its eyes. Its whole body exploded, and its narrowed eyes opened directly, looking extremely panicked.
“Why, what’s wrong…”
Shi Yu was shocked when he saw the Prediction Owl suddenly jump.
The others were also shocked by the owl’s actions.
“You, you, you, you…” At this moment, the premonition owl was shocked and delighted as it looked at Shi Yu in shock.
“What’s the result?” Many people stared at the owl and Shi Yu.
The Future Cat said with a trembling voice, “What… Why are you being targeted by more than ten totem creatures when you explore this ruin??”
“F*ck!!” It directly cursed.
It had never seen so many totems when it participated in the last totem battle with the first-generation principal of the Imperial Capital University!
“What the hell?” As soon as the owl finished speaking, everyone was shocked.
White Brook and the others opened their small mouths.
Shi Yu himself was even stunned on the spot. He was stunned. Holy shit, what the hell? Seriously?
“This… This… As expected, it’s crooked again.” At this moment, the corners of the girl’s mouth twitched. “Lord Owl, aren’t you only able to predict things that don’t exceed your strength? How can there be more than ten totems…”
“It’s still a matter if there were that many totems in the totem area around Dong Huang…”
“Ah, this.” The owl was also at a loss. So, was its skill about to improve, or was it ridiculously crooked this time?
It looked at Shi Yu and said, “No matter what, why don’t you rather believe it? Child, it’s better not to explore the ruins. Why do I feel that you want to trigger the next totem battle…”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth also twitched. “So, which ruin is it?”
“I didn’t see clearly.”
“Which totems?”
“They should all have eyes. There are red, orange, yellow, green, green, blue, purple.”
“Can I ask you for compensation for mental damage…” Shi Yu cursed in his heart. He was a little regretful for predicting it. What was going on?
“Huh?” The Prediction Owl tilted its head and pretended to be stupid.
At this moment, everyone stared at Shi Yu, not knowing what to say. Therefore, was it crooked or not? It should be crooked.
“I…”
“Next, next.” At this moment, the Prediction Owl felt that its strength had improved. It urged Shi Yu.
Forget about the totems and ruins first. What was the next prediction?
Well… it also felt that it was crooked. How could there be such a future?
Let’s see if the next one was reliable.
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu had countless complaints in his heart. He couldn’t deal with this owl anymore. He was even more determined to never leave the country before he reached the legendary level. He would rather believe it!
“Let me think…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He wasn’t allowed to put it aside first. He couldn’t waste the opportunity.
Eleven… Why not give Eleven a premonition of its inscription?
What could Buggy, Ginseng Baby, and Chi Tong ask for…

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - Each More Ridiculous Than The Next
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Each More Ridiculous Than The Next
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“What’s your next prediction?”
Now, the owl was looking forward to it.
It had been a long time since it had predicted anything related to totems.
The last time it predicted it was when its Beast Tamer was still alive.
It had only predicted it when his talent was strengthened by time.
Now, it had actually predicted it again. It didn’t care if it was ridiculously crooked, but at least it had predicted it.
This could be considered a breakthrough.
Therefore, the Prediction Owl judged that its Future Prediction should have improved unconsciously.
Let’s see the effect of the next premonition…
“Let me see.”
Under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu emitted a faint light in front of him. A small green array appeared in midair.
In the next moment, a mini Iron-eating Beast, a mini sword spirit, a mini butterfly, and a mini ginseng baby quickly fell from it.
“Wuu!”
The Little Iron-eating Beast flashed with lightning and landed steadily with the electromagnetic levitation.
“Mi!” “Wu!” The mini sword spirit and butterfly flew elegantly.
Only Baby Ginseng fell to the ground with a bang and patted the dust on its body with a calm expression, as if nothing had happened.
“It’s their future,” Shi Yu said.
After the four little pets were summoned by Shi Yu, the Prediction Owl was stunned.
“Good heavens, the entire celebrity formation.” The students of Ancient Capital University took a deep breath. Many people felt that the butterfly was a little familiar… They knew that Shi Yu had a Green Silkworm, so that Green Silkworm had evolved? What race was this?
At this time, in this team, only White Brook knew about the Butterfly of Imagination.
“Uh.” When the students from Imperial Capital University saw this group of little pets, they were puzzled. Why were they all so small?
They looked at Shi Yu. Wasn’t Shi Yu a high-level Beast Tamer? Why did his pets look like babies?
The types of pets were also messy. Iron-eating beast, unknown little butterfly, ginseng baby, sword spirit?
It was not systematic.
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!”
Ignoring the surrounding environment, the four of them started chattering. What should they ask for?
“Let’s give it a prediction first. I want to know… where its next evolution opportunity is.”
In other words, where was the opportunity to carve the inscription?
Shi Yu bent down and picked up the little Iron-eating Beast. He said to the owl, depriving Eleven of its right to choose the Future Prediction.
“Wuu!!” Eleven danced around. Don’t pull it!
However, predict the next evolution?
It wasn’t impossible.
“Evolution again. You Beast Tamers like to take shortcuts.”
The corners of the owl’s mouth curled up. “But let me say this first. The future has endless possibilities. If in the future you guys can’t come into contact with the opportunity to evolve at all, then the things that you can predict might still be wrong. It’s very wrong.”
“I can only predict what you might achieve in the future.”
“Don’t come to me after you fail after trying.”
Thinking that its premonition had misled many people, and the owl felt guilty.
They had agreed in advance that they understood the risks.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
In any case, he would definitely continue to investigate the secret of the iron-eating beast. In the future, he would definitely be able to obtain some information, and now, through using the owl, he might be able to learn something in advance…
It was a more targeted investigation.
This time, it couldn’t be crooked.
He hoped that this fellow would be more reliable this time. The previous prophecy felt that it was completely unreliable. No, there was something reliable amidst the unreliability, making Shi Yu a little afraid.
“Coming, coming!” The owl closed its eyes again.
Eleven tilted its head and everyone looked at it carefully.
At this moment, the owl activated the super skill Future Prediction again, and the time hexagram on its body flickered.
“This…”
However, a moment later, what made the Prediction Owl feel that it was unscientific was that Eleven’s future scene was just as vague as its Beast Tamer’s.
Some further futures were like darkness, impossible to see clearly.
However, there was another force that successfully made the owl see some images. Only then did the owl sigh in relief. As expected, its strength had improved again, although it didn’t know what was going on…
Soon, the blurry scene became a little clearer, but it was also limited.
The Prediction Owl saw the blurred outline of the little Iron-eating Beast in front of it.
It was a hundred meters tall, and its figure was difficult to see clearly. Its entire body emitted terrifying dark magic power, like a new Demon God.
Opposite it was also a terrifying creature, like a demon god. Its dark aura was even higher than the Iron-eating Beast. It was definitely a top-notch totem. Although it was only a premonition, the owl instantly made a judgment and was shocked.
The battle intent of both parties had accumulated to the limit.
Boom!!!
The aura of both parties erupted, shaking the Prediction Owl’s body. It suddenly left the future scene and flapped its wings in anger again, its eyes wide open as it woke up.
How was that possible!
“Damn you, damn you!” It kept repeating like a parrot.
Everyone: “?”
Holy shit.
What was it again?
Why was it so shocked again?
What did it see this time?
“Wuu!!” Eleven shouted. Say it, it could take it.
“There’s a result?” Shi Yu gulped and asked.
The Future Cat’s eyelids twitched and it looked over. “It, it…”
It looked at the little Iron-eating Beast and said in disbelief, “Its evolution opportunity is dark-element power?”
“And why is its evolution related to another top-notch totem! It seems to be fighting! Why is it another totem!!” The Prediction Owl cursed.
What exactly was going on today?
Its pupils constricted. The Iron-eating Beast in front of it had totem aptitude?
Shi Yu: “?”
Everyone: “?”
Holy shit!
They collectively looked at the little Iron-eating Beast.
Eleven: “Huh?”
Eleven was confused. Dark element? Wasn’t it metal and thunder element?
Shi Yu was also at a loss. What?
Not an inscription, but a dark element? Or was the inscription related to the dark element?
“You said it’s also related to another top-notch totem… What is it?” Shi Yu asked.
The owl looked at Shi Yu and said, “I’m not sure, but the number of dark-element totem creatures is pitifully small. There aren’t many options…”
“Isn’t the evolution form of the Iron-eating Beast the Nine Li Battle Beast? It’s indeed crooked again.” At this moment, the Beast Tamer of the Barren Bear seemed to be very angry and continued to undermine the situation. She had spent so much money to predict that her pet would give birth and evolve a year later. What was going on…
After the prophecy ended, she confirmed again that the owl’s prophecy was not reliable at all. If she had known, she wouldn’t have listened to her classmate’s recommendation and come to the prophecy.
Each one was more unreliable than the other.
The students of Ancient Capital University glanced at her. Didn’t she know that the person in front of her was the discoverer of the Nine Li War Beast?
Perhaps this owl had predicted the evolution form of the Nine Li War Beast!
However, of course, they didn’t think that the prophecy was right either, because it was too ridiculous.
Even if Dong Huang was powerful now, it was unwilling to take the initiative to provoke a top-notch totem.
“…” At this moment, the Prediction Owl was speechless because it also felt that it was unreliable.
Ever since the end of the last totem battle, totems were already legendary creatures and rarely appeared. Even totems that were close to humans, such as the Butterfly God, only woke up once every few years or more. Outsiders couldn’t come into contact with those totems in the totem area.
Now, it had prophesied twice in a row, and both were related to totems. No matter how one looked at it, it was very ridiculous.
Most importantly, the Prediction Owl felt that its two predictions didn’t consume much power, just like the consumption of conventional predictions.
If it was related to the totem, it was definitely impossible for the consumption to not change. Therefore, it was also a little guilty. It felt that it had most likely made a wrong prediction. It was so crooked that it was kind of embarrassing. It had predicted a fake thing that was impossible.
“Dark element… Dark element… totem…”
However, to the owl’s surprise, Shi Yu himself fell into deep thought as if he really believed it.
[The evolution of the Nine Li Battle Beast, or should I say, the inscription might be related to the dark element?]
Shi Yu was momentarily at a loss, but more than that, he felt relaxed.
Although he didn’t know if it was correct, he seemed to be able to investigate in this direction.
Although light and darkness couldn’t compare to time and space, it was also the top attribute in this world.
The Kingdom of Glory in the West believed in light power and used light as a holy symbol.
As for dark power, in the ancient times of various countries, it was called magic power. It was not magic power, but the power of a demon god.
Therefore, dark-element creatures were occasionally called magical beasts, monsters, and dark creatures. Dark-element totems and Mythical creatures were also called Demon Gods.
Their strength could be seen from this unique name.
“Strange, too strange.”
At this moment, the Prediction Owl felt that today was too strange.
Did it bump into a totem nest? Why did it predict so many totem levels?
There was always a bad feeling.
It looked at the little butterfly, the little ginseng baby, and the little sword spirit and fell into deep thought.
“Well, do you still want to continue predicting? I feel that my condition today isn’t very good. Why don’t we talk about it another day? I’ll remember the number of times first?” it said.
“It’s alright, continue.” Shi Yu recovered and grinned.
Who said that he couldn’t do this a second time?
There was still time in the future. Shi Yu was only here to meet this owl.
After confirming that the Future Prediction Cat had been doing business here, Shi Yu didn’t plan to replicate the Future Prediction skill now.
This was because replicating it also occupied the same space as plant control, restrained sharpness, and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. It could only be seen but not used.
Having already learned this lesson three times, Shi Yu would not make any mistakes and waste his skill column.
In any case, the Prediction Owl had always been here. He could come back when he was lacking in the future.
He looked at Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong.
“Do you want to see your future?” Shi Yu didn’t have anything urgent to know about them.
Evolution?
This was already a predetermined fate. There was no need to ask.
Buggy’s evolution skill was Dragon of Imagination, Baby Ginseng’s evolution skill was mutation, and Chi Tong’s transformation evolution skill was probably Spirit Release. This was very clear.
Compared to the mystery of inscription, these had a concrete path.
In that case, Shi Yu handed the premonition opportunity to them.
“Wu!!” Buggy was the first to fly out.
“Wu?!”
It wanted to ask if its race could still get married and have children in the future?
Buggy was a little panicked now that Shi Yu had imagined the scene of him dying alone at the Feeding Conference.
It also liked those big sisters who were as beautiful as it!
Shi Yu :”…”
“Ah.” The Prediction Owl was stunned and a little teary-eyed. The thing it wanted to predict this time looked relatively normal.
“What does it want to predict?” Beast-eared Lady White Brook asked.
“This… It wants to calculate its future partner and the situation of its descendants…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
However, in general, although Buggy was only a year old, it had already spent most of its life when it was a green worm. It wasn’t impossible for it to awaken this idea in advance.
“Eh…”
“This…”
Shi Yu’s prophecy completely exceeded everyone’s expectations.
The owl closed its eyes in relief, but its face quickly fell.
It was the same.
In the blurry scene, it opened its mouth slightly in shock.
It saw a huge butterfly and a dragon-shaped body laughing happily. Their bodies were covered in shadows and censored. Among them, the aura emitted by the dragon-shaped body shocked the owl again.
Damn.
Another totem??
The owl felt like it lost a hundred years of its life.
“F*ck!” It opened its eyes and exploded. A wood-element pollution-type sound wave skill was released.
Holy shit.
Everyone was shocked along with the owl.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - Invitation to the Third Round
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Invitation to the Third Round
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Buggy was momentarily stunned in the air. At this moment, the bottle-sized Buggy had a bad feeling.
“You, you, you…” It looked at the little butterfly in front of it and didn’t understand. It carefully sensed its power, but…
As expected, its predictions were wrong again?
“What did you predict?!” Beast-eared Lady White Brook quickly asked. She knew this butterfly race.
If it could give birth, it might be another larva with overlord potential.
The Prediction Owl’s expression darkened. “I don’t see the situation of its descendants, but, but its future partner might be a totem-level dragon creature??”
“Why is it a totem again!” It cursed.
When it was a military advisor in the totem battle, it didn’t predict totems so frequently.
Today was too unscientific.
As soon as it finished speaking, everyone present was speechless.
Buggy’s expression immediately collapsed.
“Wu!!” What was going on?
Although it felt that the power of dragons was strong, it was very sure that its aesthetic taste was still the aesthetic of bugs.
Shi Yu was also stunned on the spot.
Damn…
Even if Buggy thought that dragons were very strong, it didn’ have to have such a big appetite, right?
Was it trying to give his descendants dragon blood?
“Wu!!!” Buggy looked at Shi Yu with tears in its eyes. This was definitely not accurate.
It definitely couldn’t be like this.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said telepathically, “It’s also possible that you created a partner for yourself. When the power of imagination reaches the maximum level, you might really be able to do it. Self breeding or something…”
“It’s not like there haven’t been cases of self-interest in the natural world.”
Buggy:???
Then it would also be a butterfly, not a dragon!
At this moment, everyone, including Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the little sword spirit, looked at the worm with especially strange expressions.
Buggy shuddered.
Totem-level dragon, Buggy also learned to rely on rich women?
Due to Buggy’s strong retort, Shi Yu and the others coughed dryly and chose to believe Buggy. That was most likely wrong again.
As for the students of Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University, they directly treated it as a joke from the start.
The Dragon Totem was f*cking ridiculous. The owl had indeed drunk too much today.
Even if it was a dragon-type… it was impossible for it to be with such a small butterfly, let alone a totem-level dragon-type!
“Yi ~!!”
After Buggy ended, Baby Ginseng quickly spoke according to the order of entry.
Should it be its turn?
“Yi!!”
Baby Ginseng looked at the owl with shining eyes.
This guy’s prophecy was very high-end. It was actually related to totems.
Even in the forbidden zone that it was born in, the strongest creature was only an overlord.
It desperately wanted to know its future.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng asked.
“It wanted to know… how strong it will become after it evolves?”
When Shi Yu heard Baby Ginseng’s question, he was immediately tempted. He also wanted to know.
“After Baby Ginseng evolves… How strong can the ginseng fruit tree be?” A few students from the Imperial Capital University muttered in their hearts.
On the other hand, the students of Ancient Capital University had a serious expression. This wasn’t an ordinary ginseng baby.
“This…” The Prediction Owl wiped its sweat and took a deep breath.
The ginseng baby in front of him didn’t look simple either. It didn’t treat it as an ordinary ginseng baby.
Even from so far away, it could sense that this guy was very nutritious.
After this guy evolved… The owl had a bad feeling.
It closed its eyes and started to predict. A moment later, it exploded again and couldn’t hold on anymore.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng showed a serious expression. As expected, it was very strong, right? It even scared the overlord-level owl!
After it evolved, it would definitely be invincible.
“Ah!”
“Why are you being chased by a bunch of overlords and totems in the future!!! In the end, you were even thrown into the mouth of a totem!” The Prediction Owl wiped its saliva.
Baby Ginseng:???
Ginseng Baby: Σ (° △ ° | | |)
Eleven, Buggy, Little Chi Tong: (⊙?⊙)
It was… thrown into its mouth by a totem-level creature?
Everyone: “?”
Holy shit, what the hell was this?
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was sweating profusely. It took a step back and its expression exploded. It was a little panicked.
“Yi!!”
It wanted to know how strong it would be after evolution, not how attractive to totems it’d be!
Baby Ginseng cried crazily. Why did it sound like the situation after evolution hadn’t changed at all?
“Cough.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched and his face fell. Was this for real?
Ahem, this, he felt that it might be true…
Baby Ginseng was already ridiculously supplemented. If it evolved into an overlord race supplement, it might really be able to attract totems.
Shi Yu immediately felt that the future of his team was a little rugged.
In the future, when he went out to explore ruins, he didn’t even have to take the initiative to provoke the enemy. As long as he pulled Baby Ginseng out and slipped around, he could probably attract many ferocious beasts, overlords to totems.
Baby Ginseng was some high class bait…
The bad news was that if he was in danger in the future, he would become the enemy of all beasts. The good news was that he couldn’t die from weakness in the future. He could only die from being too healthy.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu. Evolution… wax a little dangerous. From the materials they have gathered so far, there shouldn’t be any materials for strengthening and nourishing effects, right? They had to specialize in battle!
Why not add a poison element to it? This way, no one would dare to use it.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Do you want to poison me?”
“Don’t worry.” Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng seriously. Combatization was a must, but the nourishing effect couldn’t be reduced. After all, he was also counting on Baby Ginseng to extend its life. It was impossible for the poison element since it was too dangerous.
“Eleven and the others will protect you.”
Eleven and the other beasts nodded crazily. The first target to protect in the team was Shi Yu, and the second was Baby Ginseng!
Ginseng Baby: “…”
“Today, as expected…” At this moment, the owl was a little dizzy.
It felt that Shi Yu and the others were too strange.
The Beast Tamer was stared at by more than ten totems with hostility.
The Iron-eating Beast turned into a Demon God and faced a top-notch totem.
A butterfly and a totem-level dragon having some good times.
A ginseng baby was chased and nibbled by a group of powerful totems.
No matter how it thought about it, it was too ridiculous!
It looked at the last little sword spirit that looked very obedient.
As for it…
“Mi…” Little Chi Tong’s expression was blank.
To be honest, it didn’t know what it wanted to predict.
It looked at the silent Shi Yu, hoping that Shi Yu could make the decision for it.
“Don’t make things difficult for Lord owl, why don’t we…”
At this moment, although the Beast Tamer of the Wild Bear felt that the owl was very unreliable, she was a little worried when she saw the expression on its face.
Could it be that Lord Owl was really not in a good state today and was sick?
Although she had never heard of it in reality, she had seen it in novels. Predicting the future and looking at fate meant suffering a backlash.
Could it be… retribution?
“No, I don’t believe it.” At this moment, the Prediction Owl’s expression was stubborn. It wanted to find out if it was Shi Yu and the others’ problem or its own.
“Tell me, what do you want to predict?” It looked at Little Chi Tong again.
“Mi! (Speak, what do you want to predict!)” Little Chi Tong turned to look at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu thought for a moment and looked at the Prediction Owl.
“Its bloodline is very extraordinary. In the future… is it possible to solve the mystery of its bloodline?”
Rather than thinking of it as asking for Little Chi Tong, it was more like asking for General Mu Huiyin. After all, Little Chi Tong was formed by Mu Huiyin’s bloodline power.
“Let me see.” The owl was stunned and closed its eyes again.
The mystery of its bloodline?
This was reliable.
The owl was gradually familiar with giving Shi Yu and the others predictions. It didn’t care if it was blurred or not as it quickly searched for key information.
Suddenly, a place filled with plague and curses appeared in front of it.
The Prediction Cat was overjoyed.
“My Future Prediction skill has indeed improved. It’s no longer blurred, no longer blurred. Ahaha, isn’t this the undead battlefield of the ancient capital?” It spoke in surprise.
Previously, it was all mosaic quality, but now, it was finally high-definition.
“The Undead Battlefield, in the country. This time, it’s a safe place.”
Just as it finished thinking, a sword light descended from the sky and cut open the place where the Undying Dark Phoenix was sealed…
A terrifying creature gradually revived with the Phoenix Cry and Nether Flames. The expression of the owl gradually changed from joy to collapse…
A ferocious top-notch totem sealed in Dong Huang was directly released.
In the real world, the owl suddenly opened its eyes. They were filled with blood vessels as it looked at Little Chi Tong, its wings flapping…
“What did you predict?” Shi Yu was filled with curiosity.
“Any clues?”
Prediction Owl:???
“Get lost, I didn’t foresee anything. Go, go!”
Shi Yu and Little Chi Tong:???
Everyone: “?”
Damn, this owl was completely broken.
“By the way, don’t go to the undead battlefield in the ancient capital. Let me tell you, there’s a life-and-death crisis for you there…” Its expression was serious as it returned to its witch mood and muttered.
Shi Yu and Little Chi Tong: “?”
He understood. The clue was in the undead battlefield.
Shi Yu’s mind surged as he became more and more hungry for the Future Prediction skill.
This was simply comparable to a cheat that listened to the Voice of History.
One was to look for clues ahead, while the other was to look for clues behind them.
He liked it. He had to teach it to his pet in the future. After all, it was too expensive to spend money to predict the future!
The owl looked at everyone and said, “There are special benefits today. Who wants to make another prophecy? I’ll let you guys freeload this time.”
The predictions were too strange. The verification had yet to end. Whether it was Shi Yu’s problem or its own problem, it had to be compared to confirm.
It looked at everyone.
In an instant, everyone’s expressions changed.
Holy shit, a free chance?
Although it wasn’t accurate, it was for free.
“I’ll do it!” “Me, me, me, me.” “Lord owl, look at mine.”
“Well, calculate for me again!” Even Senior White Brook was suddenly excited. She wanted to calculate her marriage fate with her senior again.
In an instant, the members of Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University fought over each other.
Shi Yu was immediately stunned. What was going on? They could still freeload?
Shi Yu was just about to say something when his cell phone suddenly rang.
Sensing the commotion around him, he was speechless. He stepped back slightly and took out his cell phone to look at this unknown number.
“Hello, who’s this?”
A hearty laugh came from the other side.
“Student Shi Yu, do you remember me?”
“I’m… Ye Hui.”
Shi Yu was stunned. The president of the Feeding Association, the senior of the third bureau, Master Ye Hui?
“I wanted to talk to you after the morning meeting, but I realized that you had already left.”
“I can only find you in this way.”
“What’s the matter?” Shi Yu asked.
“Well.”
“I heard about your love for Feeding. I’ve discussed with some seniors and want to invite you to join the third bureau. I wonder if you have this intention…”
Shi Yu revealed a look of joy. As expected… he was made to be a Feeder!
“But I’m already a member of Bureau 11…”
“The divisions aren’t independent of each other. For example, Senior Feng of Ancient Capital University has his position in all three departments at the same time. In essence, we serve Dong Huang together, there’s no difference between us.”
“It’s just that after joining multiple departments, the responsibility on your shoulders has become even greater. This is what you should consider.”
“Of course, the benefits of the third bureau are also not bad. It definitely far exceeds Bureau 11, haha. We might not have many ruins here, but we have a lot of rare materials, such as the soil of time, or the meteor iron for your Iron-eating Beast. We still took it from the third bureau.”
Shi Yu had a serious expression. There was no other way. The greater the ability, the greater the responsibility. It looked like for the future of Dong Huang, he had to go for the third bureau.
“Where are you? Let’s… talk?”

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - Three Benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Three Benefits
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“The prophecy was clearly very normal this time!!!”
Imperial Capital University, Prophecy Temple.
After predicting the third prophecy, it suddenly freshened up.
It felt that the predictions were very normal.
No messy scenes appeared.
No messy totem creatures appeared.
Therefore, it wasn’t the one with the problem! It was the Beast Tamer just now!
As expected, that Beast Tamer was too strange.
“Where is he?” It looked around and searched for Shi Yu.
“Where is he?” It looked at the beast-eared girl, White Brook, who had come with Shi Yu.
At this time, White Brook was in a daydream.
Realizing that the Future Cat was calling for her, she said in a daze, “I think… he had an emergency and had to leave first.”
Prediction Owl:???
…
At the National Exhibition Center.
How could Shi Yu know that the third bureau would be so quick?
In less than half a day, they actually started to invite him to join the third bureau. The efficiency was much higher than Bureau 11.
With a noble heart that had greater ability and greater responsibility, he came with a nervous mood.
When Yu arrived, President Ye Hui was drinking tea with Principal Feng in the conference room.
“He’s here.”
When they saw Shi Yu push the door open and enter, the two of them smiled.
But no matter how one looked at it, Principal Feng’s smile was a little twitchy.
Shi Yu seemed to be wondering if he could join another bureau if he developed any special feeding results.
Principal Feng: “Research what research! How can a person have so much energy! Moreover, the threshold to enter the third bureau is very high!”
Thinking of his conversation with Shi Yu, he felt a sense of loss. Had the era changed?
This didn’t make sense at all.
“President Ye, Principal Feng.”
After Shi Yu entered, he sat down.
President Ye smiled and said, “How is it? Have you thought about it along the way?”
“It’s not bad to join the third bureau. Archeology and feeding aren’t separated. It’s not impossible to use archeological things to nurture pets.” Principal Feng shook his head helplessly.
He found an excuse to accept reality.
Didn’t the Nine Li Battle Beast come to existence just like that?
“Yes,” Shi Yu said.
To be honest, he was hungry for the resources of the third bureau!
However, the skill index had updated the skill teaching method. With this talent as a guarantee, Shi Yu could still join the third bureau with a clear conscience. It couldn’t be considered a freeloader’s resource.
“Hahaha, good. If nothing goes wrong, the Green Silkworm Cocoon’s breeding base should become a national priority. You can’t run away as the in-charge.” Ye Hui smiled.
In terms of bug-type research, there were only Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, and the others in the country. Shi Yu was already familiar with them and had received the Butterfly God’s Blessing. He had also cultivated the bug-type life form of an overlord race. The Green Worm cocoon was also developed by Shi Yu. If he wanted to continue researching the Green Worm cocoon, he definitely couldn’t miss Shi Yu.
“Uh…”
However, Shi Yu’s expression didn’t look right.
Shi Yu realized that others always liked to arrange things that they were no longer interested in.
He was a man who didn’t end well.
“He’s probably not interested,” Principal Feng muttered beside him.
Ye Hui: “?”
What did it mean?
Shi Yu took a sip of tea and said, “Well, the Green Silkworm cocoon was accidentally developed by me. I won’t add to the trouble next. Actually, I have a new research direction for feeding. I think this is much more important than the research of the Green Silkworm cocoon.”
President Ye was stunned.
Principal Feng fell into deep thought.
“What is it?” the two of them asked in unison.
Shi Yu smiled. “Of course it’s a stable breeding channel for overlord races. It can also be said to be ‘Iron-eating Beast’s second stage evolution plan’ and ‘Nine Li Battle Beast evolution method’. To be honest, I already have some clues.”
The two of them opened their mouths slightly.
President Ye was just about to say, “What is more important than the research of the Green Silkworm cocoon?”
But now, he suddenly couldn’t say anything.
A stable breeding channel for overlords was important, but was it reliable?
“I saw you mention it in the paper, but hasn’t there been any progress?”
In fact, Principal Feng didn’t have much expectations for this kind of thing from the start.
A stable breeding channel for overlords was too unrealistic.
Even the funds assigned by Bureau 11 to Shi Yu to study the evolution form of the Nine Li War Beast were actually mainly to help Shi Yu buy evolution materials. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to really develop anything.
Shi Yu said, “Isn’t this a new way to think about the combination of archeology and Feeding… Most importantly, I just went to Imperial Capital University and encountered the Prediction Owl… It gave me predictions once and gave me some new ideas.”
Prediction Owl?
The two of them revealed slightly surprised expressions.
Could that thing be trusted?
Ever since the death of the Beast Tamer of the owl, without the enhancement of his talent, it had never predicted anything nutritious.
“Is it reliable?” The corners of Principal Feng’s mouth twitched.
“I think it’s pretty reliable.”
Shi Yu nodded. If Eleven obtained the dark element in the future, combined with the history of this world, and became a Demon God after stepping into the totem, wouldn’t that match? This was because it was rumored that Chi You was also called an ancient Demon God.
In addition, it was suspected that Emperor Wu had also established the Iron-eating Beast Corps. This was also the main investigation direction. Legend had it that Emperor Wu’s army had reached the hometown of the totems, and it was said that Beast Tamers at that time were the fiercest in history.
Not only was Emperor Wu’s personal battle power fierce, but his army was also very fierce. If it was an army of pets of ordinary monarch races, it would probably be very difficult for them to be this powerful. But if it was an Iron-eating Beast army that was proficient in army skills and led by the overlord race’s Demon God Panda, it might not be so.
In the owl’s prophecy, Eleven would face off with a dark-element totem when it obtained the form of a demon god. Could this totem be related to Emperor Wu? Was it an enemy or a friend?
Some totems that had lived since ancient times might know more secrets of history and the secrets of the Nine Li Battle Beast. However, that batch of totems shouldn’t be within the borders of Dong Huang.
Shi Yu thought about it. Wasn’t investigating this better than studying the stimulation of the Green Silkworm cocoon quietly?
At that time, the combination of archeology and Feeding would really kill two birds with one stone.
“Uh.” President Ye scratched his nose. Why did he feel that it was unreliable?
Perhaps at that time, even if Shi Yu evolved his pet into an overlord race, it would still be impossible to replicate.
However, like Bureau 11, there was no such thing as a forced recruitment in the third bureau. He shook his head and said, “The identification for the third bureau will be given to you along with the reward for this Feeding Conference. How about that?”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded slightly.
After that, he looked at President Ye Hui.
So… what were the benefits?
“By the way.” Sensing Shi Yu’s burning gaze, President Ye Hui coughed dryly.
He said, “Generally speaking, the third bureau will give the new member three benefits.”
“Firstly, it’s the documents. As a member of the third bureau, you can contact and purchase materials and pets that ordinary Beast Tamers can’t come into contact with.”
“In the outside world, level 7 and 8 resources are the top, but in the national resource bank, there are higher-level materials, such as level 9 legendary resources and level 10 mythical resources. If there’s a legitimate reason to use them, the members of the third bureau have the right to use them first.”
“After all, no matter how rare the resources are, only suitable feeders can maximize their value.”
Ye Hui looked at Shi Yu’s shining eyes and smiled.
Shi Yu: “Mythical resources?”
Instantly, Shi Yu was extremely tempted.
He wanted to ask if there were any materials for Mythical creatures.
After all, through the power of imagination and dreams of Buggy, there was a chance to reproduce the power of totems and myths.
However, he also knew that he was purely thinking about the unreasonable..
Unless he combined the power of imagination with dreams to open up a new research idea in a new feeding field, it would definitely not be that easy to apply for legendary and Mythical materials.
It was mainly because his current feeding research results were completely different from applying for these resources.
“Yes.” President Ye Hui smiled.
The third bureau was definitely one of the richest departments in Division 13. Almost every member had a legendary resource.
If Shi Yu also wanted to apply for it, it would depend on his subsequent contribution.
“Second, it’s something you already have.”
“I have it?” Shi Yu was stunned. “The ruins space?”
“Ahem, no, there’s no ruins in the third bureau.” President Ye Hui revealed an awkward expression and said, “The index. Bureau 11 should have assigned it to you, right?”
“If it’s a new member who joined the third bureau, they will actually also be assigned a feeding index. In terms of functionality, the difference between the two isn’t too big. It’s just some knowledge bias problems.”
“When you’re free, I can update the index for you and open up some feeding knowledge.”
“For example, the cultivation methods of various pets, the evolution plans of hundreds of pets, the teaching methods of thousands of skills… Where to produce rare resources and the activity range of rare pets? The knowledge recorded by these associations can be checked in the index.”
“Moreover, as long as it doesn’t exceed a certain limit, you can also transfer this knowledge to others, so you call it the Feeding Index.”
“Of course, I can also help you upgrade the index to a mechanical life form in the third bureau. If a Feeder doesn’t have his own Feeding Team, it’s actually pretty good to have a research-type mechanical life form as a partner. I think your archeological index still seems to be an ordinary machine.”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
There were hundreds of evolution plans for pets.
Thousands of skill teaching methods?
And it could be freely used or even given?
Shi Yu recalled the rich lady, Senior Lu, who had taken out the three Green Silkworm evolution plans for him to choose.
In the future… would he be even richer than her?
As the saying went, knowledge was money.
The feeding index in the third bureau felt even better than the archeological index in Bureau 11.
The archeological index recorded various ruins locations and information both domestically and abroad. This was a huge pit. Although the benefits of cracking the ruins might be huge, the risks were also huge.
However, the knowledge recorded in the index was pure money.
However, the ruins space was still the impressive one. This was probably the core power of Bureau 11.
“I’m envious.” Beside him, Principal Feng listened to the benefits of the third bureau and showed an envious expression.
Looking at Shi Yu, he seemed to see his young self.
If it weren’t for the fact that the benefits of the 13 divisions of Dong Huang were really good, he wouldn’t be working in three departments at the same time.
The first, third, fourth, and eleventh departments all had better benefits.
“The third benefit is very easy to understand.”
“Every Feeder who joins the third bureau actually has a unique Feeding Talent.”
“They either have cultivation-type talent, reconnaissance-type talent, or research-type talent. In short, everyone’s talent is very special.”
“And in the third bureau, there are many resources with unknown effects but huge potential value.”
“Beast Tamers with these top-level Feeding Research Talents are actually the batch of people who have the greatest hope of researching and developing the true value of these resources.”
“Therefore, every member who joins the third bureau has the chance to choose a research subject suitable for their talent. For example, if a Feeder with a natural talent joins the third bureau, he can apply for a rare level-eight or even level-nine spiritual plant to nurture and study it, digging out its secrets.”
“For example, if Dr. Zuo joined the third bureau and she has a growth talent, she could totally apply for a special pet with huge potential but slow growth for her to nurture.”
“For you…” President Ye Hui smiled at Shi Yu…
“You have the gift of telepathy, and you have a lot of room for growth. In fact, I suggest you apply for a pet with huge potential to train.”
The main reason was that Shi Yu’s talent was only suitable for this. He couldn’t let Shi Yu study spiritual plants, right?
“It means that you can distribute a high-level pet?” Shi Yu asked.
“That’s about what I mean.”
“And the ones assigned are usually unique, or very rare, endangered species pets.. Only such pets are worth the effort of the members in the third bureau.”

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - Water Pet in the Dragon Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Water Pet in the Dragon Palace
Shi Yu understood.
So the third bureau made him an endangered species conservation worker?
How was this distributing high-level pets?
They were clearly looking for a top-notch nanny for an endangered species.
After all, if they let the parents grow with them, they might not necessarily have a better growth effect than if they were with the top feeders in the third bureau.
“You’re now a high-level Beast Tamer. In the future, you can at least contract three or four more pets. It’ll be the same.X” Ye Hui suggested. “The racial levels of these endangered species protected in the third bureau are still pretty high.”
“Most importantly, it’s rare. Moreover, the Bureau will provide cultivation resources. It should be very suitable for you.”
“Indeed, pet training is the most suitable for you at the moment.” Principal Feng nodded.
His own strength was the foundation.
Shi Yu was still in the development stage. What he lacked the most was strength. It was naturally better to have more high-level pets with high potential.
In any case, as a member of Bureau 11 and 3, it was impossible for Shi Yu not to be cultivated.
If Shi Yu couldn’t nurture a pet, few people could.
Two top-notch jobs!
“Do you have any preferences for pets you like? There are still some high-level monarch species pets in an endangered protected state in the country. There are even some pets with potential enough to be considered a quasi overlord race,” President Ye Hui said.
“Are there no overlord races?” Shi Yu looked up innocently.
He realized that he had become arrogant. He didn’t even fancy monarch races anymore. Non overlord races weren’t enough.
President Ye Hui :”…”
Principal Feng :”…”
The corners of President Ye Hui’s mouth twitched. “Don’t think that just because you have an overlord species pet that overlord species pets are common.”
“Generally speaking, if some overlord species pets in the country successfully give birth to cubs, the owner and parents of this overlord cub will allow it to be handed over to the top battle-type Beast Tamers. The top cultivation-type Beast Tamers will form a huge team to nurture it.”
“It will give them the best environment to grow and quickly form battle power.”
“Your situation is the rarest.”
“There’s a chance for overlord species pets to break through to the totem level. It’s impossible for them to be handed over to a person to be cultivated so easily,” Ye Hui explained.
Principal Feng scratched his ears beside him. That was indeed the case, but the problem was that Shi Yu already had two overlord species pets. One was a middle-level overlord, and the other was a high-level overlord. It was ridiculous because it wasn’t as simple as a low-level overlord.
“Therefore, a quasi overlord race is almost the limit,” Ye Hui said. “In fact, if cultivated properly, there’s a high chance that their growth level can break through the racial limit and enter the overlord level. It’s already very good.”
“Oh.” Shi Yu nodded. So that was the case.
However, the quasi overlord race still felt lacking.
“You’re just greedy.”
“However, hehehe, actually, it’s not impossible to contract an overlord species pet again.”
Suddenly, Principal Feng chuckled.
Shi Yu and President Ye Hui looked at Principal Feng.
“However, it definitely won’t be as simple as obtaining it unconditionally.”
“You mean…” President Ye was stunned.
“Have you forgotten the cooperation project for the first and third bureaus?” he said.
“In the totem era, most humans are vessels for the growth of the totem subjects. In fact, in the Beast Taming Era, this pattern still exists in the countries where humans are dominant.” He looked at Shi Yu and explained to him.
“The lifespan of pets is far greater than that of humans, so some totem level guardians who are close to humans are still willing to give their heirs to outstanding humans to raise. It’s similar to a ‘marriage’. Through this method, the bond between the two parties can be extended. At the same time, it can also allow the descendants to have a higher chance of breaking through the racial limit.”
“However, the selection of Beast Tamers for their descendants is very strict. They have to go through many tests. Many guardians who were on good terms with them in the first bureau have descendants of overlord races and monarch races. They relied on this method to integrate into human society.”
“In the first and third bureaus, we reached an agreement to help some guardians take care of the cubs. After all, some guardians prefer to have cultivation-type Beast Tamers nurture their descendants in their place than handing their descendants to battle-type Beast Tamers. Therefore, the members of the third bureau are very popular with some guardian forces.”
Ye Hui said, “You’re saying that you want to give a trial spot to Shi Yu in the third bureau…”
“Not bad.”
Principal Feng looked at Shi Yu and said, “You know Dragon Palace City, right? That place has been friendly with humans since ancient times. It’s an ocean faction that has stood on the side of humans in the totem battles many times. It’s the guardian of the Sea Realm in Dong Huang.”
“Dragon Palace City has had a contract with humans since ancient times. It will hand over some citizens of Dragon Palace City to human Beast Tamers to raise.”
“Over there, as long as you’re outstanding enough, it’s not impossible to contract an overlord cub.”
“Under the command of Dragon Palace City, there are various dragons, mermaids, sea snakes, and water-element life forms. Many overlord factions are attached to that side. It can be said that there are endless opportunities.” Principal Feng sighed. “Qingyi’s mermaid princess was contracted by the factions under Dragon Palace City.”
“The Dragon Palace banquet that happens once every five years is about to begin in a few months. At that time, many human factions will bring gifts and visit. You can understand it as taking the ‘betrothal gift’ to ‘propose a marriage’. If both parties are satisfied, it’s not impossible to snatch back a young overlord.”
“If you’re interested, you can get the third bureau to prepare more ‘betrothal gifts’ that the dragon race likes. The chances are very high. Didn’t you say that the butterfly god gave you a sea dragon keepsake? It’s a witness of your friendship with Dragon Palace City!” Principal Feng said.
“The legendary Sea Dragon of Lin Feng is currently one of the most powerful dragons in Dragon Palace City. With this keepsake, if you go there, the treatment you receive will definitely not be what ordinary Beast Tamers can enjoy.”
Ye Hui was shocked. “What, Shi Yu still has the keepsake of Dragon Palace City?”
Principal Feng nodded. “Yes, if it weren’t for this, I wouldn’t have suggested for Shi Yu to go to Dragon Palace City. After all, the requirements for Beast Tamers there are too high. I’m afraid they won’t take a fancy to a telepathy talent. Even if he can listen to the Voice of History, it’s very difficult for him to obtain the cubs of overlord races. But if he has the relationship of the Butterfly God and the Sea Dragon, Shi Yu might have a chance to obtain the cultivation rights of overlord races!”
The two of them looked at Shi Yu.
That was good.
Were they confident of getting a young overlord?
Shi Yu :”…”
“The potential of the young of the overlord race in Dragon Palace City is actually secondary. More importantly, it isas the connection between the two parties.”
“It represents the friendship between the Beast Tamer and Dragon Palace City.”
“As a huge force in the ocean, Dragon Palace City’s status in the ocean is unshakable. Many ferocious sea beasts, sea demons, and sea monsters are unwilling to provoke Dragon Palace City. They are the overlords of the ocean. If you contract the descendants of an important member of Dragon Palace City, in a sense, you will have an ocean pass. Basically, no sea beast dares to stop you from walking in the ocean.”
“Now you know why Qingyi contracted a mermaid princess. The merfolk also belong to the Dragon Palace City. This way, even if she leaves Dong Huang, she will have great safety in the dangerous sea area. It will be very convenient to explore the ocean ruins, and she might even be protected by the Dragon Palace City.”
Shi Yu: “!!!”
“It doesn’t matter that much if I have this force backing me up. It’s mainly because I happen to lack a water-type pet.”
“When will the Dragon Palace banquet begin? Will I go alone or will someone bring me?” he asked.
Initially, he thought that the fifth pet could only be a mechanical pet, but now that he heard this, water-type pets were not bad either??
After all, he would have to travel abroad in the future.
It was not a loss to cozy up to Dragon Palace City in advance.
Just as Principal Feng had said, with the third bureau, the eleventh round, and the Butterfly God Token, it seemed like it wasn’t difficult for him to cozy up to an overlord race in Dragon Palace City.
Perhaps he could even cozy up to a certain totem level and successfully join the first round…
Moreover, it just so happened that Buggy also had matters regarding the dragon pearl to ask in Dragon Palace City.
It looked like he had to go to Dragon Palace City.
[Wait! Could it be that this time is where Buggy and a certain dragon would mingle together?] Shi Yu was shocked.
“You’re interested?” Principal Feng chuckled.
“A little,” Shi Yu said.
Principal Feng looked at Ye Hui.
President Ye Hui pondered and said, “If that’s the case, I’ll definitely support Shi Yu fully in the third bureau.”
Principal Feng looked at Shi Yu and said, “At that time, the ‘Tyrannical Sea Legend’ will lead the team to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet. The specifics will probably be known close to the banquet time.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend… Shi Yu recognized it. This was one of the Titled Legends of Dong Huang. It had one of the highest battle powers in Dong Huang, an existence that could fight against totems. The weaker totems were even unwilling to fight him, afraid of his trump card pet. After all, he was known for the strongest water-type pet in Dong Huang.
His trump card pet was a mutated Leviathan.
It was a combination of space and water.
Its race level was a quasi-mythical race, about the same as Little Chi Tong.
Its body was a small world that could devour everything.
A Leviathan at the start depended on devouring.
It was even said that in battle, this Tyrannical Sea Legend could let the Giant Leviathan temporarily devour him and his other pets to obtain the power to suppress ordinary totems.
With this person leading the team… there was no need to worry about safety.
What kind of pets could he encounter in the ocean… Shi Yu looked forward to it.
Dragon Palace City was a large faction in the ocean.
It didn’t mean that there were only dragons in Dragon Palace City.
Apart from the eastern purebred dragons, there were also humanoid pets like the Dragoness and the Mermaid. There were also countless sea beasts like whales, sharks, turtles, and dolphins attached to them. There were also a bunch of strange ocean elemental creatures. For a moment, Shi Yu’s heart felt tempted.
“By the way, if nothing goes wrong, the news that you’re the Beast Tamer of the Imagination Butterfly at this time will probably spread throughout the country.” President Ye Hui suddenly looked at Shi Yu.
…
On this day.
The Feeding Conference was held in the capital.
The discussion about the Feeding Conference on the Internet was pretty popular.
However, it was a competition that was not publicized. There was still a difference between a public and exciting competition like the National League.
Therefore, although the discussion about the Feeding Conference wasn’t low, it didn’t enter the top three on the Internet.
At the moment, the first place on the trending list was firmly occupied by the current number one person in the club system, the top-notch Beast Tamer Master, Heavenly King Zou of the Dark Club.
Not long ago, when he announced the news of his secret relationship, not only did it not reduce his popularity, but it also increased the discussion about him.
What the onlookers didn’t expect was that not long after the official announcement of the relationship, the two of them announced the engagement time again. In an instant, this news was pushed to first place by the onlookers.
“As expected of me. Ah Zou, after all, am I not everyone’s idol?” Somewhere, Heavenly King Zou looked at the number one topic on the trending list and patted his shoulder with emotion. It had been too difficult for him to go from a poor country boy to a superstar that everyone was paying attention to. However, he liked the feeling of being paid attention to by everyone.
However, before he could sigh for long, with a bang, the number one trending topic was pushed down.
Then, Heavenly King Zou looked at the news of “Shocking! So the Beast Tamer of the Imaginary Butterfly was him!” and fell into deep thought.
He opened the news and what appeared in his eyes was an ancient photo of an Iron-eating Beast holding a wooden sword…
Mid-level overlord race, Butterfly Beast Tamer of Imagination, Iron-eating Beast Knight, Shi Yu!
The Beast Tamer who made the entire country pay attention to the Butterfly of Imagination at that time was actually a freshman.
In an instant, the entire country was shocked.
Heavenly King Zou was directly stunned. He couldn’t believe that this kind of guy had snatched the trending topic of himself and his girlfriend twice.
“The world is degenerating!”
Ancient Capital.
Ancient Capital University.
“Holy shit.”
“Holy shit.”
Rough voices rose and fell from various professional areas.
Wang Ling from the archaeology Department, Yu Shu from the Battle Department, and the others looked at the new headlines in shock. They were so shocked that their mucus flowed out.
They widened their eyes and looked at the news in disbelief. They felt that they were blind.
The culprit behind the huge commotion in Divine Capital was Shi Yu??
Was this science?! He already had the spirit of General Mu Huiyin. Why, why was his luck still so good? He actually evolved a butterfly of an overlord race!
“Why are you so uneasy?” Seeing that the matter had finally been exposed, the little Gu Master Miao Dongdong, who had been holding this matter in his heart, let out a sigh of relief and looked at the students in the class who showed shocked expressions with their cell phones in disdain.
That was it? He was the first to know!
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
“Daughter, something bad happened!!!”
Lin Hongnian held his cell phone in shock and ran to Lin Xiuzhu, who was feeding the iron-eating beast.
“What’s wrong?”
The panda senior put down the basin milk and the panda cub and looked at her father and the cell phone in his hand.
“Look at it yourself.” He opened the news page about Shi Yu and handed the cell phone to Lin Xiuzhu.
Lin Xiuzhu took the cell phone and looked at it.
As she watched, Lin Xiuzhu fell into silence, her mouth agape.
Damn it, why didn’t Shi Yu tell her in advance?
Whoosh!
Lin Xiuzhu stood up and turned to leave.
“Where are you going?” Hall Master Lin asked.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “A new set meal for Iron-eating Beasts. Bucket of Green Silkworms..”

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - The Sixth Prophecy
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: The Sixth Prophecy
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Butterfly of Imagination, Shi Yu!
Shi Yu’s name spread throughout the country again.
If it was said that the results of researching the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast and obtaining first place in the Ancient Capital vocation assessment could not make some people remember Shi Yu firmly, then this time, Shi Yu was completely popular.
As long as it was cultivated properly, an overlord race beast could definitely grow to the overlord level.
In other words, as long as Shi Yu didn’t interfere, he would definitely be a legendary Beast Tamer in the future!
In the country, there weren’t many Legendary Beast Tamers. Every Beast Tamer with the potential to step into the Legendary level received a lot of attention.
A genius youth like Yin Zhengfan, even if his father was a legendary Beast Tamer, was not qualified to be recognized as having legendary aptitude.
Those acknowledged were all people like Lu Qingyi, Heavenly King Zou, and the current team leader of Imperial Capital University, Gao Xuan. They were the younger generation recognized as legendary.
These people basically had overlord pets with extraordinary potential.
And now, there was another one.
Although he had yet to grow up and reach the master level like the other batch of people, there was no doubt that he had cultivated pets of overlord races. In the eyes of everyone, Shi Yu had already found the path to the legendary domain.
However, at this moment, the ones who were the most emotional were still some Beast Trainers in Ping Cheng.
For example, Qiao Liang, the doctor who often sold supplements to Shi Yu, or Beast Tamer Chen Kai, who killed the Ice-Armored Beast in the first battle. They watched the news and cried silently. Why, why couldn’t they be as sick as Shi Yu even though they had already eaten the supplements and become immune to them?
They felt that they had been cheated. F*ck, refund!
…
“This is ridiculous.”
The team from Ancient Capital University and the members of the battle club from Imperial Capital University also saw the news at different times.
On Ancient Capital University’s side, apart from White Brook, the others didn’t know that the little blue butterfly was actually the Imagination Butterfly at all. They couldn’t help but be shocked.
The members of the Imperial Capital University worked hard because of Shi Yu. They were afraid that they would fail in two days, so they didn’t dare to mess with the Ancient Capital University exchange team in advance.
Imperial Capital University’s battle club instructor also stopped underestimating the enemy. This Shi Yu was still worth taking seriously. He couldn’t help but guide the skills of the club members when dealing with spiritual and spatial pets.
He also pulled up the video of the little sword spirit vs the desert monarch, the ginseng baby vs the Zonyan Rock Beast, and showed it to everyone repeatedly and analyzed it.
However, as they watched, everyone fell silent. They felt that the sword spirit was very unscientific. They suspected that it was also an overlord species pet. The corners of Teacher Shen’s mouth also twitched. Fortunately, this sword spirit was only at the transcendent level.
Also, this ginseng baby was even more unscientific. Earth Chain+Strengthening Hard Rock Roar Cannon, Nutrition Fruit+Multiplication+Energy Fruit fused into a tree sea and exploded. This, this was a f*cking supplement ginseng baby?
As many members of the Imperial Capital University’s battle club analyzed Shi Yu’s baby ginseng, Yin Zhengfan felt aggrieved, but he didn’t say anything. Anyone who lost in a video that was publicly rewatched dozens of times wouldn’t be in a very good mood.
Yin Zhengfan: QAQ
He only hoped that his sacrifice would be a little helpful to the battle club in Imperial Capital University…
In short, Imperial Capital University was facing a great enemy.
Although it was only an exchange event, they were national champions. Naturally, they weren’t willing to be beaten up by a small Ancient Capital University.
…
“Senior, I’ve been a little busy these last two days. I’ll look for you on the day of the exchange event.”
At this moment, Shi Yu rejected White Brook’s call invitation to a meal.
White Brook: “Aww…”
At that moment, the members of the Battle Club of Ancient Capital University wanted to worship the Butterfly of Imagination again and hate their previous blindness.
However, Shi Yu was currently busy trying to become a glorious member of the third bureau. How could he have the time to care about social gatherings?
Shi Yu was indeed quite busy.
First, he helped the index install a data chip and updated some feeding knowledge.
Just reading the new knowledge with Baby Ginseng and the others took a lot of time.
After all, some evolution plans and skill teaching plans couldn’t be found when they were needed, right? It was also convenient to memorize them in advance.
Then, he discussed the matters of the Green Silk cocoon breeding base with Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, and the others and the Feeding Association.
As for the Feeding Conference, Shi Yu did not pay attention the whole time.
Could it be that a feeding team could develop a mythical racial evolution plan to insta-kill their presentation? It was definitely impossible.
In the end, nothing unexpected happened. The Feeding Team of Ancient Capital University easily won the championship of this Feeding Conference.
The next day, President Ye Hui brought the third set of documents to Shi Yu with a smile.
“Ah, this.”
In the room, after handing the soil to Shi Yu, Ye Hui immediately saw Shi Yu’s face turn bitter.
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t even have the mood to look at his handsome profile picture in the third bureau of identification documents.
He held the thumb-sized thick glass bottle in front of him and looked at the Time soil inside that wasn’t as much as the sand one would find in clams when at a seafood restaurant. He fell into deep thought.
“Uncle Ye, no way. Is this all the soil of time?”
“The soil actually has to be counted grain by grain, isn’t it a little…”
Shi Yu originally thought that the soil of time was at least a mound that the ginseng baby could take root in.
From the looks of it, it wasn’t even enough to support Baby Ginseng.
“Uh.” Seeing Shi Yu’s dissatisfied expression, Ye Hui said, “How much more do you want? Don’t look at how small it is, it’s a level-seven resource. The earth power inside is very abundant.”
“And it’s a resource that contains weak time power. It’s worth a lot.”
“This small bottle is at least ten times more valuable than ordinary level-seven resources. Its price is comparable to a level-eight resource.”
Shi Yu:…
“We’re already family, so it’s alright to give a little more, right?”
“…” President Ye Hui.
No wonder Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, and Senior Feng said that the soil of time should be directly given to Shi Yu.
It looked like Shi Yu had been eyeing this thing for a long time.
“It’s mainly because the soil of time is a scarce resource that can’t be replenished. These are the only ones left. Why do you want this… Tell me about it… There might be other alternative resources.”
Shi Yu said, “I’m studying the mutation evolution of the ginseng baby now. I need some resources that contain strong mutation power.”
“Actually, it’s mainly because it likes the time element, but there don’t seem to be any suitable resources like the soil of time.”
After obtaining the feed index, Shi Yu had also searched for relevant time-element resources through the feed index.
Unfortunately, none of them were suitable for ginseng babies.
Even for the third bureau, time-element resources were also extremely precious. It could be seen from the soil of time.
“Mutated evolution?” President Ye Hui was stunned.
Then, he shook his head.
It looked like Shi Yu really liked Feeding.
There were a bunch of messy research directions.
How could it not be good!
“However, I feel that maybe we can use the power of the time mystic realm to replace it,” Shi Yu suddenly said.
“Uncle Ye, if I remember correctly, you’re one of the vice presidents of Imperial Capital University, right? Do you have a chance… to send me in?”
Ye Hui had graduated from Imperial Capital University and was now the vice-chancellor of Imperial Capital University. This was something Shi Yu had not expected.
This made him feel embarrassed to communicate with the battle club at Imperial Capital University.
However, Shi Yu felt that the other party definitely wouldn’t mind the fun between juniors.
“Time mystic realm…” Ye Hui was slightly stunned.
“This place is not a good cultivation place.”
“That’s the effect I want,” Shi Yu said.
Time Mystic Realm… He had heard that the environment here was very harsh. Shi Yu felt that perhaps he could let Baby Ginseng try absorbing the power of time here and mutate it to use it with the soil of time.
“Besides, don’t I still have to go to Dragon Palace City to contract a new pet in a few months?”
“If I can use the time mystic realm to quickly grow into a master-level Beast Tamer, it’ll be convenient to contract it. Otherwise, I’ll still be a high-level Beast Tamer. That would be awkward. I might miss many good opportunities.”
President Ye Hui shook his head and said, “How should I put it? The environment in the Time Mystic Realm is not suitable for meditation. It’s only suitable to train the mental state and resistance of Beast Tamers and pets. It’s an incomplete cultivation mystic realm. I don’t recommend you to go there. Even geniuses from Imperial Capital University rarely go there.”
“You don’t have to worry about the Beast Taming level. In order to ensure that you successfully contract a pet in Dragon Palace City, we will prepare high-level spatial resources for you in the third bureau to help you upgrade your Beast Taming level.”
“As for the time mystic realm, although it’s not impossible for you to enter, you can at most spend three days in the outside world, which is 30 days in the inner world. Beyond this number, the danger is too great. Even if it’s a master-level Beast Tamer, it’s very easy to get lost in the illusion of the time mystic realm and lose reason from the corrosion of the time power.”
“In short, we definitely can’t stay inside for more than a month.”
“I see. Alright, no problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
“I won’t stay longer than three days.”
“But not now. It might be a while.”
Now, he had yet to teach the baby ginseng the skill.
It might take a while to maximize this skill to perfection.
In addition, it was best to maximize Baby Ginseng’s other skills before evolution, so Shi Yu estimated that it might take a month.
“Sure. Are you free now?” President Ye Hui asked.
“Yes, I’m free before 2,” Shi Yu said.
Well, he was going to visit the battle club at Imperial Capital University after two…
President Ye Hui smiled and said, “Then I’ll bring you to the guardian of the Time Mystic Realm to familiarize yourself first. At that time, it’ll be in charge of opening the Time Mystic Realm for you and watching over you.”
“Prediction Owl??” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Yes, didn’t you already find it to make a prophecy?”
Shi Yu had a strange expression.
…
Imperial Capital University, Prophecy Temple.
There was a sign outside saying, “Today’s rest day, don’t be noisy or else you will bear the consequences.”
He didn’t know where the owl had run to.
After Ye Hui and Shi Yu arrived, they looked at the cold surroundings and fell silent.
Ignoring the sign, President Ye Hui, who was wearing a gray formal suit, walked to the temple. He coughed dryly and knocked on the wall with his finger.
“Ah!”
“Which bastard?”
A moment later, an owl flew out and looked at Ye Hui in a daze.
“Little Yezi, what are you doing? Why are you here?” It was still the witch voice.
Little Yezi?
Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
What kind of nickname was this?
“Lord owl, I have something to talk to you about. This child might enter the Time Mystic Realm for 1 to 3 days in the future. I need you to take care of the entry procedures. I’ll prepare them for you to see when the time comes,” Ye Hui said with a smile.
“Huh??” It looked at Shi Yu and immediately widened its eyes.
“It’s you!!”
It spoke in shock.
“Lord owl, hello… We meet again. How are you?” Shi Yu greeted.
“I’m not good!!” it said.
Ye Hui:…?
“Little Yezi, there’s something wrong with this fellow. I give it foresight, and strange things keep appearing, such as totems,” the owl said in fear.
“Gave him five prophecies. All five are related to the totems.”
Ye Hui: “Totem??”
“Yes, yes, I also predicted the location of the Undying Nether Phoenix’s seal, broken with a single slash. Investigate him strictly, investigate them strictly!”
“How can I open the mystic realm for them without worry?”
Shi Yu: “?”
Ye Hui:…
Holy shit.
Ye Hui suddenly looked at Shi Yu. Slash the Undying Dark Phoenix’s sealed location with one swing?
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and felt that this wasn’t very fair… He looked at President Ye Hui and said, “Uncle Ye, do I look like such a person who’s courting death? It must be that Lord owl’s prophecy was wrong.”
Without absolute strength, how could he mess with the Dark Phoenix!
