Ye Hui fell into deep thought. It looked like it.
One look and he knew this guy wasn’t honest.
If he was an honest young man, would he put aside a national-level project and not research it and think about other things?
However, how was it possible for Shi Yu to slash open the Undying Nether Phoenix’s seal location with a sword? The owl must have made a mistake…
However, the five prophecies were all related to totems?
Although the prediction of the owl was unreliable, this sounded a little too ridiculous.
Ye Hui looked at the owl and Shi Yu suspiciously and said, “Why don’t we predict it again?”
“I just want to know what his fifth pet will be.”
“Alright!!” The owl glanced at Shi Yu and closed its eyes again. The hexagram in front of its chest emitted light.
A moment later, its consciousness entered the deep sea. In front of its vision, it was pitch-black and blurry, and there were continuous bubbling sounds.
Boom!
A moment later, an undercurrent surged in the deep sea and emitted a terrifying pressure at the totem level, forcing the stunned owl to wake up. It said with a tone as if it was as expected, “Look, it’s another totem. His fifth pet is a water-element totem.”
“He’s abnormal!”
Ye Hui: “Shiyu, I’m sorry. Lord owl is sometimes mentally unsound. You mustn’t believe the previous premonition.”
He didn’t want the genius shared by Bureau 11 and the third bureau to go astray because of this nonsense prediction.
Shi Yu: “Uh… I understand.”
This time, Shi Yu completely believed it. This fellow was unreliable. From the looks of it, he couldn’t believe all the previous predictions.
The owl was speechless.
It was just about to refute, but something like a Beast Tamer’s fifth pet being a totem creature was a little unscientific and went against its understanding.
Could it really be its fault?
The owl fell into deep thought. Damn, this Shi Yu was born to jinx it.
…
A moment later, Ye Hui and Shi Yu left, leaving behind a messy owl.
It still didn’t understand why Shi Yu’s predictions were so strange.
It was very heartbroken!
At this moment, after Shi Yu and President Ye Hui separated, he suddenly received a call.
“Shi Yu, where are you? We’ve already arrived at the territory of the Imperial Capital University’s battle club.. You’re the only one left,” White Brook shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - The Might of an Ancient Overlord
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: The Might of an Ancient Overlord
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the battle club venue of Imperial Capital University.
At this moment, there was already a sea of people here.
Hundreds of students were gathered in the hall, and it was extraordinarily lively. There were even teachers from the battle department secretly observing.
Obviously, they were all here to see their elites fight the exchange team of Ancient Capital University.
“Cheer up!”
“Whoever screws up today, the training volume is super doubled!”
In the player area of Ancient Capital University, White Brook’s daily lecture continued.
“Alright ~”
The members of Ancient Capital University were weak.
Sigh, they really didn’t want to fight, because they couldn’t win either.
They only wanted to see Shi Yu fight.
Although they looked forward to Shi Yu, they didn’t look forward to themselves at all…
“Sigh…” White Brook also sighed.
It couldn’t be helped. The difference that could be seen at a glance easily made it impossible for one to have the courage to challenge it.
However, at this moment, many elites of the battle club on the side of Imperial Capital University also had doubts, because a monster had appeared in Ancient Capital University.
They didn’t take the others seriously, but Shi Yu… They had to take him seriously.
Not only them, but the ordinary Imperial Capital students who came to watch the battle also had complicated feelings. They were actually here for Shi Yu.
“Is Shi Yu really going to be here?”
“I came over after watching the news. Can I see the butterfly of imagination of the overlord race?”
“A pet of an overlord race… Can we handle the members of the battle club?”
As the words “overlord race” were too intimidating, many students of the Imperial Capital University started to worry for their members.
“It’s alright, it’s alright. Shi Yu has the gift of telepathy. An overlord race is no different from a monarch race in his hands. Don’t be afraid.”
“I’m not concerned about the Butterfly of Imagination. I heard that he has a ginseng baby that knows how to fight. Is that true? I’m here for this.” A student from the Feeding Department who had contracted a ginseng baby came to visit, wanting to see Shi Yu’s ginseng baby.
“I’m also not interested in butterflies. I don’t want to see the Imaginary Butterfly. I want to see the Iron-eating Beast Knight.”
The venue was very lively. As they listened to the discussion, some students from Imperial Capital University even wondered who was the home team.
This Shi Yu was too scary. He was completely infamous… In short, he was very popular.
…
“Hello, everyone. I’m the host of the Inter-school Competition between Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University today, Cui Ying.”
2 PM.
As time approached, on a platform in the venue, a girl with a sweet voice spoke into the microphone on the table.
As soon as she spoke, the voices in the venue fell. Everyone’s gazes were attracted to her.
“This exchange activity is jointly organized by the Battle Club of Ancient Capital University and the Battle Club of Imperial Capital University. It’s designed to promote the friendship between the two parties and increase the level of the Beast Tamer battle between the two schools. Friendship is first, and competition is second.”
“Next, I’ll explain the rules of the competition to everyone.”
Swoosh!
The big screen in the venue lit up.
Then, 60 names appeared.
“The form of this exchange activity is mainly a challenge. The battle club of Ancient Capital University is the challenger, and the battle club of Imperial Capital University is the challenger.”
“The name list on the screen records the names of the members of the Imperial Capital University’s battle club and their ranking in the club. They are the main members of the battle against Ancient Capital University.”
“Members of Ancient Capital University can choose any one of them to challenge. If they win, they can continue to challenge higher ranking members. At 6: 30, the exchange event ends ~ The exchange event doesn’t care about winning or losing, but in the end, the battle results of both parties will be displayed ~”
There was no hard way to let Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University decide the winner. It was purely a free challenge by the students of Ancient Capital University. This was the response plan of Imperial Capital University to foreign exchange activities in recent years.
They placed themselves in a very high position to wait for the challenge, but the final battle result would clearly show the difference between the two parties.
At this moment, everyone looked at the big screen.
The first name on the big screen was Tang Yu, a high-level Beast Tamer. He was ranked fourth in the battle club of Imperial Capital University.
As for the top three, they were naturally the three master-level Beast Tamers of Imperial Capital University. They didn’t participate in the exchange, just like White Brook.
The second name was Fan Qi, a high-level Beast Tamer, ranked fifth in the Imperial Capital University battle club…
Until the last one, all of them were high-level Beast Tamers. Clearly, they were all official members of the Imperial Capital University’s battle club.
“Hey, White Brook, it’s time. Who wants to go first?”
As the name list appeared, on the opposite side of the arena, a single-tailed woman in a black short-sleeved shirt stretched. She was one of the vice teams of the Imperial Capital University, a master-level Beast Tamer. She was not among the participants of this exchange activity.
Hearing this woman’s voice, White Brook frowned and looked at the people behind her.
“There’s no need to wait for Shi Yu. Which of you wants to challenge first?”
“Uh…” When White Brook finished speaking, everyone from Ancient Capital University was a little afraid.
Although they were all elites ranked in the top 20 of the battle club in Ancient Capital University, the difference between the two schools was big. It would probably be difficult for them to defeat those ranked around 30 and 40 in Imperial Capital University.
This difference was also the reason why Imperial Capital University let the enemy team choose who they wanted to battle.
After all, if they were too ruthless, how could other schools be willing to participate in the future? This was bad for the reputation of Imperial Capital University.
“I’ll do it.” At this moment, seeing that everyone was hesitating, Xu Ze, the vice president of Ancient Capital University, suddenly spoke.
He looked at a name on the big screen and said, “I lost to the other party in the National League last time. It’s been so long now. I want to see if the gap has narrowed.”
As the second combat power of Ancient Capital University on the surface, he clearly didn’t plan to challenge the members ranked at the bottom of Imperial Capital University.
“Alright, all the best!”
White Brook saw someone come out and heaved a sigh of relief.
Although the outcome of Xu Ze’s challenge was unknown, White Brook was actually very willing to be a little brave towards the members of the battle club.
If Xu Ze, as the vice president of the battle club of Ancient Capital University, challenged someone ranked at the bottom of Imperial Capital University instead, she would also look down on him.
Not only did she look down on it, even if he won, it would probably attract the sighs of the Imperial Capital University.
“Ancient Capital University’s Xu Ze challenged Imperial Capital University’s Liang Yan.”
Xu Ze walked onto the arena and looked at a name on the big screen under everyone’s gaze.
Liang Yan, high-level Beast Tamer, ranked eighth in the Imperial Capital University’s battle club.
“Liang Yan, the other party wants to challenge you!”
At this moment, at Imperial Capital University, a group of sitting members suddenly looked at a short boy with strange expressions.
“Liang Yan, does he know that one of your pets has evolved?”
“You changed your new pet. The other party shouldn’t know about this, right?”
“I definitely don’t know. I’ve never taken it out to compete.” Liang Yan’s expression was playful.
“I remember now. Did you eliminate Xu Ze in the last National League?” someone asked.
“I think so…” The boy named Liang Yan stood up in surprise and said,” It’s him. I was wondering why someone would challenge me. So he’s here to take revenge…”
“You scared me. I thought it was Shi Yu.” He patted his heart.
As one of the top eight Beast Tamers in the Imperial Capital University’s society and a quasi-master-level Beast Tamer, he was actually very strong. He was so strong that even the second-in-command of Ancient Capital University couldn’t defeat him. However, it just so happened that they had approved of him as a master. Teacher Shen sternly reminded them that if they were challenged by Shi Yu, they definitely couldn’t lose.
After all, if even they lost, wouldn’t the others in Imperial Capital University be killed by Shi Yu’s Imaginary Butterfly?
It was fine if the members ranked at the bottom lost. It wouldn’t affect the morale of the members of the battle club at Imperial Capital University, but if the members of the school team ranked in the top 10 lost, they would be finished. If word got out, his salary as a teacher would probably be deducted…
At this moment, compared to the unknown Shi Yu, Liang Yan didn’t care about the defeated Xu Ze at all.
“I’ll go.” Liang Yan chuckled and walked down.
In an instant, everyone’s gazes focused on Xu Ze and Liang Yan.
One of the two was the vice-captain of the Ancient Capital University’s team, and the other was the elite of the school team ranked at the front of the Imperial Capital University. The battle that had just started was not the low-level battle everyone imagined. Instead, it was a collision of strong and strong.
“It’s Senior Liang…”
On Imperial Capital University’s side, Yin Zhengfan was sitting in a corner. His gaze kept searching for Shi Yu’s figure at Ancient Capital University, but unfortunately, he couldn’t find him.
What was going on?
Apart from him, Tang Yun, Zhang Yiming, the other members of the battle club of the Imperial Capital University, the two vice-captains who were present, and Teacher Shen who was observing in the dark didn’t see Shi Yu either. They couldn’t help but wonder if Shi Yu didn’t come…
Forget it, let’s pay attention to the battle between these two first.
On the arena, both parties had already arrived at the battle area.
Xu Ze’s expression was more serious than Liang Yan.
It wasn’t that Xu Ze didn’t want to choose a pushover before challenging this guy, but the key was that Imperial Capital University didn’t have many pushovers. Fighting others first would definitely consume a lot of energy, so it was better to directly challenge this Liang Yan.
If he won, he would take off. If he lost… Then he would go back and train twice as much.
From the situation of the previous National League… In theory, the difference between them wasn’t very big.
“You’re the challenger, you set the rules.”
At the venue, Imperial Capital University’s Liang Yan spoke.
“2VS2 double,” Xu Ze said very directly.
“Alright!” Liang Yan smiled and nodded.
The two of them looked in the direction of the platform. The girl in charge of presiding over this exchange immediately said, “In the first round, Xu Ze from Ancient Capital University vs Liang Yan from Imperial Capital University!”
“Battle rules, 2VS2 double!”
“Now, please send out your pets.”
As soon as the host finished speaking, both parties immediately entered battle mode.
A summoning array appeared in front of Xu Ze, and a white skeleton giant rose.
Middle class monarch race, skeleton monarch!
At the same time, a white book appeared in Xu Ze’s hand. He held it in his hand.
The high-level monarch race, the Flame Book Spirit, was a dual-element undead and fire-type pet. It was obtained by Xu Ze from the Heroic Spirit Ruins.
After getting the book, white flames seemed to appear in Xu Ze’s eyes. White flames floated around him, and white flames wrapped around the skeleton monarch.
Flame Bone Monarch!
Now that he had strengthened them in succession, the two pets seemed to have fused into the commander-level battle power of a quasi overlord race.
“Same old.” On the other side, Liang Yan smiled faintly. Two pets appeared in front of him.
“Roar!!!”
A “dragon” roar sounded.
A huge monster that was pitch-black, ten meters long, and looked like a dragon with three heads appeared!
A Dark Three-Headed Python with partial dragon bloodline!
High-level monarch race, dark element, dragon bloodline!
At this moment, when he saw the Dark Three-Headed Python, Xu Ze’s expression immediately changed. On Ancient Capital University’s side, everyone also revealed solemn expressions.
“Your pet evolved?” Xu Ze asked seriously.
“Yeah, it evolved a week ago,” Liang Yan said confidently.
Apart from the Three-Headed Python of Darkness, dense black ants also appeared in the arena. The darkness dyed the ground black, and most of them walked on the python.
Group pet, middle-level monarch species, Dark Travel Ants. The group was one individual, the individual was the group, and all Dark Ants were split from the ant king.
Seeing this pet, Xu Ze’s expression changed again. What the hell!
It’s only been four months, why did he change all the configurations!
Before he could ask, Liang Yan said himself, “One evolved, another commander species pet was eliminated, and a new pet was chosen as replacement, the Dark Travel Ant.”
“Senior Liang Yan is awesome.”
Seeing that Liang Yan’s Double-Headed Evil Python had evolved into a Dark Three-Headed Python and contracted a new monarch species pet, many Imperial Capital University students were first stunned and then pleasantly surprised.
It wasn’t too much to say that the Dark Three-Headed Python, which had dark and dragon bloodlines, was a quasi overlord race.
Coupled with this new pet, it was insane.
“It’s over.” On Ancient Capital University’s side, the corners of everyone’s mouths twitched.
He felt that Xu Ze was in danger…
White Brook also revealed a serious expression.
“Am I late?”
At the same time, a voice sounded out. A figure sat beside White Brook and looked at the arena.
Shi Yu?
Seeing Shi Yu arrive, the eyes of many Ancient Capital University members lit up.
White Brook glanced at Shi Yu beside her and said, “We’re a few minutes late. I’m afraid Xu Ze will fail.”
“Is the other party very strong?”
“Very strong, an official member of the Imperial Capital University team. Xu Ze lost to him previously. Now that the other party’s pet has evolved, I’m afraid the difference between the two parties will increase further.”
Shi Yu looked at the arena. To be precise, he looked at the Dark Travel Ant.
This pet was very special. It was considered a support-type pet. The creatures that were stuck to it would immediately lose their vision and their bodies would be corroded by dark energy. The energy would quickly disappear.
In addition, the Dark Travel Ant could also use the Dark Transformation skill on living creatures, allowing them to enter a similar violent comprehensive battle power increase state. As the saying went, dark power made one three times stronger.
In short, the Dark Travel Ants had many support functions, and they could even heal wounds. Most importantly, if you didn’t find their core, they would be almost immortal, and it would be useless no matter how many ordinary Dark Ants they destroyed.
In addition, during the process of eliminating ordinary dark ants, the dead ants would also turn into the power of the dark and continue to erode the other party’s energy.
“It’s very effective against the Book Spirit of Flame,” Shi Yu muttered.
As soon as he finished speaking, the battle below had already begun.
Dark Transformation was a super skill that could be used on oneself or others. At this moment, the Dark Travel Ant used Dark Transformation on the Dark Three-Headed Python!
“Roar!”
In an instant, the already very powerful Three-Headed Python’s strength, speed, and energy increased greatly, turning into a black shadow that attacked the skeleton monarch.
The skeleton monarch threw a bone fist, but during the collision with the other party’s trident tail, the bones shattered almost instantly!
Crack!
The flames swayed. Under the corrosion of the dark power, the skeleton monarch was forced to retreat.
“Uh!!!”
It cried out in pain, making the students of Imperial Capital University especially excited.
“Liang Yan!”
“Senior Liang Yan!!”
The qualities of the dark three-headed python far exceeded that of the Flame Skeleton Monarch in all aspects.
The existence of the Dark Travel Ant also completely countered the flames of the Flame Book Spirit. The flames that were originally meant to transform into armor that could both attack and defend, but when it encountered the Dark Ant, it directly became inner fire.
The Dark Ant charged into the flames desperately. After burning a Dark Ant to death, the skeleton monarch would be corroded by the strong dark power. In addition, the dark three-headed python was extremely strong and ferocious. In the blink of an eye, the skeleton monarch was smashed into pieces by the snake tail.
In less than three minutes, Xu Ze lost, causing the hearts of the members of Ancient Capital University to stop.
Bang!
The beast-eared girl, White Brook, who didn’t have a fusion going on, was so angry that she directly smashed the chair handle with a punch.
“Remember, pay him back later.”
Everyone :”…”
Seeing the serious expressions of the members of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu scratched his cheek.
“Maybe I’ll go for the next round?”
Although the other party’s strength was not bad, it wasn’t ridiculously strong either. It was only comparable to that Fu Andi.
“I’ll leave it to you!”
Before White Brook could say anything, the other members of the battle club spoke.
“So strong…”
At the same time, on Imperial Capital University’s side, they sighed with emotion at Liang Yan’s strength.
The second-in-command of Ancient Capital University was directly crushed by their eighth place. What was there to say?!
“As expected.” A square-faced man stood on a high platform and said expressionlessly, one of the vice teams of the Imperial Capital University.
“It’s just that Liang Yan changes his pets too frequently. The pets who can’t evolve have been thrown away by him. This isn’t good, right?” another vice-captain of the Imperial Capital University, a single-tailed girl in a black short shirt, said.
“As long as we can win,” the square-faced man said.
“That’s not true. This way, it’s very easy to encounter the pet’s backlash one day.” A middle-aged man walked out.
“Moreover, if those predecessors were also like Liang Yan, those guardians of Dong Huang now might have long become enemies after the death of the Beast Tamer. How could they protect Dong Huang like now?”
“Teacher Shen,” the two vice-captains of Imperial Capital University immediately said when they saw this person.
“Let’s watch the exchange.” He looked back at the venue.
Xu Ze lost the battle. He retreated to the player area a little worried.
At the Imperial Capital University, there was a cheer.
As the winner, Liang Yan casually ate a divine bean to replenish the consumption of his dark-element strengthening talent just now and smiled.
However, soon, his expression changed.
Because as Xu Ze returned, a young man in a red battle suit walked over.
“Shi Yu…”
Xu Ze was slightly stunned when he saw Shi Yu.
“I’ll go next,” Shi Yu said.
“If you want to challenge the top 10, be careful. The opponents are also freaks.” Xu Ze’s expression darkened.
At this moment, as Shi Yu appeared, the venue fell silent.
Many people’s expressions became especially serious, and Yin Zhengfan even stood up directly.
“He’s finally here.”
“It’s that Shi Yu.” The important figures at Imperial Capital University, Teacher Shen and the two vice teams, also had serious expressions. Did Ancient Capital University let Shi Yu go on stage so early?
“It’s the Iron-eating Beast Knight.”
“Shi Yu?!”
“He’s the Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination? A boy? It’s really Shi Yu!”
As Shi Yu appeared, the discussion speed exceeded Xu Ze.
After all, as a student of the Imperial Capital University, there was no need to pay attention to who the vice president of the Battle Club was.
In other words, he was equivalent to an ordinary member of the school team of Imperial Capital University.
However, Shi Yu was different. This was a man who had snatched Heavenly King Zou’s trending topic…
“Let me see…” After Shi Yu went on stage, he looked at the big screen and muttered to himself,” It’s better to start challenging from the top…”
On the other side, Liang Yan was stunned.
Although he was nervous when he saw Shi Yu, what did Shi Yu mean?
Ignore him?
“You guys haven’t defeated me yet.” His face also darkened as he said to Shi Yu opposite him.
“You’re an opponent chosen by Senior Xu Ze. I didn’t choose you.” Shi Yu was rather serious.
“I want to challenge the first three names…”
Liang Yan: “?”
“Shouldn’t the new one take revenge for the previous one who lost?” He explained the normal process.
Why didn’t he follow the routine!
Shi Yu was stunned. “It makes sense, it makes sense, but this isn’t an arena battle. Besides, you’ve already fought one battle, so your condition isn’t optimal.”
Liang Yanshen took a deep breath and said, “Don’t worry, I contracted a Heart of Darkness. With its Dark Revival, the state of the three-headed dragon python and the Dark Travel Ant hasn’t fallen much.”
“Sure.” Shi Yu looked at him.
“Are you sure you’ve recovered?”
“Yes,” Liang Yan confirmed.
Although he didn’t want to fight Shi Yu either, if this situation continued, he couldn’t explain it to his seniors and juniors. It would look like he was afraid of Shi Yu.
From a different perspective… If he defeated Shi Yu… his reputation might even exceed the two vice teams!
“Holy shit, Senior Liang Yan plans to 1v2.”
“Who can win between him and Shi Yu?”
“I’m not sure…”
“But looking at how Senior Liang Yan didn’t spend much effort to defeat Xu Ze, maybe…”
Many members of the Imperial Capital University looked at the venue.
The members of Ancient Capital University also looked at the venue solemnly.
Regarding Shi Yu’s strength, even Teacher Shen and the two vice-captains of Imperial Capital University could not determine it.
But through this battle, they should be able to determine something…
At this moment, facing Liang Yan, who had just defeated Xu Ze, Shi Yu slowly walked forward and summoned his pet.
Boom!
As his cloak fluttered, a huge summoning array appeared behind him. It was majestic and spectacular.
A terrifying mental wave spread from it and turned into a blue aura.
In the spatial ripples, a huge butterfly about three to four meters in size slowly appeared with a strong pressure.
It had an incomparably huge pair of wings. The entire surface of the wings was like white waves surging on the blue sea. Its color and patterns were abnormally beautiful.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, after discovering that a new opponent had appeared, the Dark Three-Headed Python in the arena revealed a ferocious expression.
On its body, countless dark ants crawled faster.
“Shi Yu…”
At Ancient Capital University, everyone became nervous.
“The Butterfly of Imagination…” Liang Yan’s expression was also excited and solemn. Just as he wanted to test how strong the life force of this overlord race was, a change occurred.
As the Butterfly of Imagination appeared, the entire arena underwent a huge change. The stone arena turned into a brown land, filled with an ancient aura.
The dry ground was incomparably deep. On the ground, an incomparably huge Tyrant Dragon slowly formed.
Seeing this scene, everyone opened their mouths wide.
“Tyr… Tyr… Tyrant… Tyrant Dragon?!!!”
“This…”
In the next moment, an even more shocking scene appeared.
“Roar!!!!”
After the Tyrant Dragon formed, its gaze was fierce and it emitted a strong dragon might. A brown aura erupted from its entire body!
Boom!!!
In an instant, with a cracking sound, the dry ground shattered even more, quickly turning into fragments like broken glass.
A tangible wave bloomed from the Tyrant Dragon.
Accompanied by the revival of the ancient tyrant, the ground began to rumble. The substantialized deterrence wave passed through the three-headed python and the dark ants like a storm, filling their eyes with fear. Their bodies actually involuntarily showed dry wounds under the deterrence.
Bang!
In the next moment, all the ordinary dark ants exploded and died. Under the deterrence, the Dark Three-Headed Python, which had the bloodline of the dragon race, even suffered an unimaginable injury in an instant. Its mind and body were severely injured, and its cracked body spat out black blood. It directly fainted and fell to the ground.
Transcendent Illusion+Perfect Dragon Might+Perfect Imagination Domain…
It stuck to the Tyrant Dragon figure taken from the Tyrant Dragon fossil.
In the true sense, it allowed the dignity of the ancient tyrant to descend into the world again.
At this moment, the Butterfly of Imagination was still floating in the sky. It didn’t move from the beginning to the end. Only the Tyrant Dragon was still looking down at Liang Yan, whose gaze had exploded.
“How… How…” He stuttered as he looked at everything. He felt the two pets that had lost consciousness. He sensed the other party’s strength and his heart was also heavily injured!
He… was insta-killed by deterrence?
Wasn’t this… the skill used for fodder?
“Holy shit.”
On Ancient Capital University’s side, everyone, including White Brook and Xu Ze, opened their mouths wide and couldn’t react at all.
Wait, what happened?
“You’re still human?!” Xu Ze, the vice president of Ancient Capital University, cursed. He was directly shocked. Shi Yu… This… This…
He had just said that the other party was a monster when Shi Yu insta-killed him?
On Imperial Capital University’s side, it was almost instantly silent. Yin Zhengfan’s little face was flushed red, and his gaze was filled with shock.
On the other side, the battle club instructor and the two vice teams who looked down on the whole situation were shocked.
Everyone was waiting for the Butterfly of Imagination to showcase its strength.
However, as the Butterfly of Imagination revealed its strength, everyone lost their ability to think.
Because what they saw was not as simple as the strength of a middle-level overlord race or commander rank.
Which commander-level pet, even an overlord race, could train high-level skills to transcendent? And even form profundities with the perfect dragon might?
Race had never been the strongest aspect of Shi Yu’s pets. What was really unscientific about them were the terrifying low-level skills with high proficiency.
At the same time… Shi Yu was thinking… It seemed like he didn’t have to summon a second pet? The other party couldn’t really take this fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - Valiant Battle Style
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Valiant Battle Style
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In just one round, the elite ranked eighth in the battle club of Imperial Capital University was insta-killed.
In just one round, the elite ranked eighth in the battle club of Imperial Capital University was insta-killed.
However, such a genius actually didn’t manage to withstand a single move from Shi Yu…
If the opponent he encountered was White Brook, it would be fine if it was the master-level Beast Tamer of the various university prefectures who were the trump cards. With the difference in level, it was very normal to be insta-killed.
However, what he encountered was a new student, a new student from Ancient Capital University.
Although everyone was already mentally prepared for this new student to be very monstrous, no matter how mentally prepared they were, it couldn’t change the fact that Shi Yu was only a junior Beast Tamer four months ago!
“Holy shit, it exploded!”
“President, no wonder you trust Shi Yu so much. This is simply too much.”
“This Imagination Butterfly… is so strong. Is this the overlord race?”
On the side of Ancient Capital University, everyone’s eyes were stunned as they muttered to themselves. Their mood instantly climaxed.
Only Xu Ze was restless and his heart was in a mess.
In other words, Shi Yu could also easily insta-kill him now?
“Silence.”
White Brook said in a deep voice.
However, she was the most excited.
Although she had long known that the Butterfly of Imagination was very strong, this was the first time she had seen it officially show its might.
She was also very excited.
She knew the outcome of this battle from the start.
After all, in the previous high-level Beast Tamer assessment, although Buggy only played support, it had already displayed its power.
If it could even trap the Ox-Headed Beast King with the lowest energy level of 200,000 monarchs, there was no need to talk about its strength.
In White Brook’s eyes, it was very normal for the Butterfly of Imagination to defeat these two pets.
However, a deterrence insta-killed them, clean and efficient. It was really Shi Yu.
“Senior Xu Ze is kind of weak.”
On the other side, after Shi Yu finished fighting, he muttered in his heart.
In terms of pet quality, Xu Ze and Liang Yan were actually on par. The pet’s energy level was less than 80,000.
However, Xu Ze’s development of the Beast Taming Talent was far inferior to this Liang Yan.
If Xu Ze could increase the energy strength of the undead pet by 20,000 through Soul Strengthening…
In that case, this Liang Yan could almost increase it by more than 30,000. It directly made the pets with less than 80,000 energy points reach more than 100,000.
This was the difference between Beast Tamers.
In a sense, this was also the advantage of a battle party like Liang Yan, who frequently changed pets.
This was because Xu Ze might have spent most of his energy on training pets, and this Liang Yan probably relied on updating pets to increase the quality of his pets and had more time to develop his talent.
Unfortunately, his pet’s strength was still a little lacking. In the face of Buggy’s 140,000 energy points, it couldn’t resist at all.
Moreover, when Buggy was in the domain of imagination, its mental strength would also undergo a qualitative change. It was like being strengthened by the mental strength talent. The quality of the mental strength would increase, and the power that could be displayed by mental skills would also increase… The difference was too big, so the opponent was even more unable to stop it.
“Senior Liang Yan, you lost.”
Shi Yu smiled and looked at the speechless senior in front of him.
“Next, I want to challenge Senior Tang Yu.” With that, he looked at the first name on the big screen.
High-level Beast Tamer, Tang Yu, ranked fourth in the battle club.
This person was the strongest person in the battle club of Imperial Capital University apart from the three masters…
“He still wants to continue fighting…”
“Of course, that battle just now probably didn’t take much effort…”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the venue immediately erupted.
At this moment, many students from Imperial Capital University had heavy expressions.
Although Shi Yu was indeed very strong, wouldn’t they be embarrassed if they directly let Shi Yutong challenge the Imperial Capital University bosses?
The eighth place of the school was insta-killed by him, and now he was challenging the fourth place?
“Can Senior Tang Yu punish this guy?”
“It’s hard to say, but Senior Tang Yu definitely can’t insta-kill Senior Liang…”
“I…” Liang Yan still wanted to say something, but at this moment, he didn’t know what to say at all. He was completely autistic.
He retracted his pet with a trembling heart and confirmed that the Shi Yu in front of him was definitely a monster. Even Tang Yu might not be his match!
In Imperial Capital University, a young man in a black casual suit was sitting on a chair. He narrowed his eyes and leaned forward to stare at the arena that had been restored. It had been filled with cracks due to deterrence and he fell into deep thought.
Perfect deterrence…
The opponent was very strong, ridiculously strong.
“Tang Yu… the other party wants to challenge you,” behind Tang Yu, Zhang Yiming, who had been the judge for Yin Zhengfan and Shi Yu, spoke.
“Yes.” Tang Yu was expressionless.
He was feeling very complicated now because he wasn’t confident either. He could only say that he was giving it a try.
As for the students in the Imperial Capital University ranking between Tang Yu and Liang Yan, they heaved a sigh of relief. Damn, fortunately, they weren’t chosen. Otherwise… they would die if they tried.
At this moment, apart from Liang Yan, the others didn’t have the confidence to withstand such a ridiculous deterrence.
Behind Tang Yu, Tang Yun, Yin Zhengfan, and the others looked conflicted, especially Yin Zhengfan… He realized that this Imagination Butterfly seemed to be far stronger than that ginseng baby. The pressure made him feel suffocated.
However, this was also normal. The unlucky ginseng baby was one of the three main forces in Shi Yu’s team. Until now, it still couldn’t fly… and it wasn’t a pet that wasn’t taught deterrence by Shi Yu.
There was no so-called pressure at all… It was purely a supplement.
“Senior Tang Yu, be careful.”
Seeing Tang Yu get up, Yin Zhengfan said shyly… and received Tang Yu’s nod.
“Can Tang Yu do it? Teacher Shen, I feel that the strategy you guys came up with at the start doesn’t seem to be very useful…”
On the high platform, the vice team leaders of Imperial Capital University, a man and a woman, fell silent and looked at their instructor.
Teacher Shen couldn’t say anything either. After all, at the start, he only thought that the butterfly’s energy level was at most a hundred thousand, but now… it was not like that at all.
Because the difference in growth between the two parties was too big, it was impossible to rely on skills to reverse the situation now. Shi Yu had already formed an absolute suppression in strength.
“Tang Yu… should be the one who can resist the perfect deterrence the most steadily.”
“But whether he can defeat the other party depends on whether Shi Yu can crack his talent.”
As Teacher Shen finished speaking, the young man named Tang Yu had already walked down.
“I accept your challenge,” Tang Yu said after stepping onto the arena.
He was the fourth seat of the Imperial Capital University, an elite whose strength was only inferior to the three master students. His reputation in the school was also incomparably huge.
Even White Brook fell into deep thought when she saw Tang Yu.
Why didn’t this kid, Shi Yu, fight them one by one? He wanted to fight the greatest boss right from the start. Although the chances of him winning weren’t small, she kept feeling that it was lacking.
They should let Imperial Capital University continue to have the fear of being ruled!
“Tang Yu…”
“I think Senior Tang can do it.”
“Of course. Among those at the same level, I’ve never seen a Beast Tamer who can defeat Senior Tang Yu. Before the vice-captain broke through, he couldn’t defeat him either.”
As Tang Yu appeared, the confidence of the students from the Imperial Capital University increased.
His confidence was all due to Tang Yu’s special talent!
This was an extremely powerful talent.
He could apply an invincible absorption shield of the same level to themselves and their pets. The shield could be immune to all skills, ineffective against attacks, and turned into energy to integrate into the shield to maintain the existence of the shield.
In other words, only pure physical attacks could cause damage to Tang Yu’s pet.
Any skill with energy added would be immunized and absorbed.
Although there were still ways to crack it, how many races could unleash powerful strength without skills and just their bodies?
It had to be a pure physical attack. Even with a skill like Hardening, the Hardening Material would be absorbed by the shield.
For most people, this was already an extremely unsolvable Beast Taming Talent.
“You decide the rules,” Tang Yu said to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “A no-rules battle.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Tang Yu’s expression changed.
An irregular battle meant that there was no limit to the number of pets and no limit to the number of props they carried. The Beast Tamer himself could also join the battle. At the same time, he could also attack the Beast Tamer himself.
“Alright.”
Although this kind of battle was rare, it was for at least someone who had passed the vocation assessment. Tang Yu was not unfamiliar with it and quickly accepted it.
Moreover, his talent was clearly more suitable for irregular battles than Shi Yu’s telepathy.
At this moment, the Tyrant Dragon and the Imagination Domain had already disappeared, leaving the Butterfly of Imagination floating in front of Shi Yu.
Tang Yu narrowed his eyes and summoned his four pets.
“Roar!!!” “Wu ~!!” “Meow ~!” “Hu!!”
In the blink of an eye, four pets appeared.
The Ghost Rock Giant with a dark brown body.
It was a bird-shaped pet made of wind elements, the Wind King Swallow.
A Dark Night Six-tailed Demon Cat with six tails and a dark form.
There was also the Thunder Cloud Sprite King that was circling in the sky like a dark cloud and covered in lightning.
Four pets appeared, and a powerful aura erupted from their bodies. They were looking at the Butterfly of Imagination with hostility.
They were all elemental pets.
With Tang Yu’s talent, it was not difficult to determine the intention of this contract.
Because elemental pets could elementalize and were immune to physical attacks!
In addition to the Beast Tamer’s absorption talent, it could be immune to skills. With complementation, this combination could be said to be an absolute defense.
The moment the four pets appeared, the Imagination Butterfly in the sky tested them.
Boom!!!
A strong deterrence wave erupted from the Butterfly of Imagination.
As the deterrence went berserk, the air began to hum and vibrate.
The substantialized deterrence wave tore through the arena again, causing countless large and small cracks to instantly appear like a thousand cuts.
Buzz!
A terrifying deterrence wave directly spread out and swept past the four pets. But at the same time, transparent energy shields flickered on their bodies. When the deterrence wave touched the shield, it was like a drop of water falling into the ocean. It only shocked the slightest ripple and did not affect the four pets at all.
Shi Yu crossed his arms and revealed a surprised expression.
“Wu…” Buggy also showed a surprised expression. It felt that even its other attack skills would find it very difficult to break through that absorption shield.
The shield had a special immune nature. Unless the worm erupted with a million-level energy, all the attacks would be absorbed by the shield.
This was also why Tang Yu’s pet was not very strong, but he could firmly occupy the fourth seat of Imperial Capital University.
The Beast Taming Talent was too strong. For example, Liang Yan from before couldn’t break through their absorption shield at all. The most terrifying thing was that the consumption of this shield on the Beast Tamer was also very small. It was maintained by absorbing the power of the outside world.
“Senior Tang Yu is awesome!!”
At this moment, as Tang Yu’s four pets easily disintegrated the perfect deterrence of the Butterfly of Imagination, everyone from the Imperial Capital University immediately cheered. On the high platform, Teacher Shen and the others also nodded secretly.
If he wanted to defeat Tang Yu, he could only send pets that were good at physical strength to find opportunities. However, the opponent was an elemental creature, and opportunities were not that easy to find.
Or, he could fight Tang Yu himself and make his talent fail.
But now, in the face of perfect deterrence, even Tang Yu’s expression did not change under the protection of the absorption shield. It was not so easy to defeat him under the protection of the four pets and the shield.
“The Butterfly of Imagination alone can’t defeat us. Send out your other pets. You should have an Iron-eating Beast, right? Perhaps it should be the Nine Li Battle Beast now,” Tang Yu said.
Seeing that Shi Yu had yet to send his next pet, he curled his lips. Did Shi Yu think that he could defeat all his pets just like Liang Yan by relying on an Imagination Butterfly?
“There’s no need for it to attack yet.”
Shi Yu smiled slightly, making Tang Yu opposite him sneer.
In the next moment, the Wind King, Yan Storm, wrapped around it, and the Dark Night Six-tailed Demon Cat turned into a shadow and attacked.
The Ghost Rock Giant and the Thunder Cloud Sprite King accumulated big moves behind Tang Yu. They were attack pets and had the mission to protect Tang Yu.
At this moment, the Wind King Yan and the Dark Night Six-Tailed Demon Cat’s speed was almost like a flash. They were extremely fast, and they didn’t attack the Butterfly of Imagination, but Shi Yu.
Since Shi Yu had chosen an irregular battle, he couldn’t blame him for using a less troublesome method.
Any energy attack would be instantly immune to the absorption shield. Could it be that the Butterfly of Imagination alone could protect Shi Yu?
However.
“You’re too confident in the absorption shield.”
“Don’t forget, it’s a spatial element.”
As Shi Yu spoke, four Psychic clusters appeared in front of the Butterfly. They were teleported into the four pets by transcendent Instant Transmission, ignoring the shield.
Although the Wind King Swallow and the Dark Night Six Tailed Demon Cat were very fast, due to their high proficiency in skills, the attack speed of the Imagination Butterfly was even faster than them.
In the blink of an eye, the Wind King Yan, the Dark Night Six Tailed Demon Cat, the Ghost Rock Giant, and the Thunder Cloud Sprite King’s movements froze. The elemental core was directly pinched by the mental power.
As the Psychic team suddenly appeared in their bodies and exploded, their bodies instantly became blurry!
The absorption shield was only wrapped around their bodies, but there were no protective measures in their bodies!
“Roar!!!” “Chirp ~!!” “Meow ~!” “Hu!!”
They didn’t have the ability to harden their bodies internally and externally like Eleven. In the face of the transcendent-level Instant Transmission skill of the Imagination Butterfly, their bodies, which had no resistance at all, were directly injured!
Boom!
In an instant, their bodies exploded like they had self-destructed.
Under the incredulous expressions of everyone, under the protection of the invincible absorption shield and elementalization known as Absolute Defense, Tang Yu’s four pets were directly injured to the state where they became elemental cores and lost their bodies.
Under the sky full of fireworks, only four elemental cores landed on the ground.
This was the final self-protection state of the elemental creatures.
However, this didn’t mean that they had lost their ability to fight, because in the blink of an eye, they started to recover their bodies, elements gathered, and recombined their bodies.
On the other side, Tang Yu was stunned at the change.
If it weren’t for the fact that Beast Tamers were too weak, Tang Yu would have already been defeated because Shi Yu would use it on him as well.
Through this move, not to mention a high-level Beast Tamer like him, even a top-notch master could be successfully assassinated by Shi Yu and the others without being prepared in an irregular battle.
Only legendary Beast Tamers who had mastered various magical abilities could escape everything.
“What happened? How is this possible!” Just as Tang Yu’s four pets lost their figures.
Shi Yu’s figure also disappeared on the spot.
It appeared behind Tang Yu.
Sensing the cold wind behind him, Tang Yu’s pores almost instantly stood up. In the next moment, a hand directly hit his neck, making his eyes widen and his consciousness almost faint.
Behind Tang Yu, Shi Yu’s red cloak fluttered. His hand saber stopped in mid-air. He looked at Tang Yu, who was bending slightly in front of him, and said, “Beast Tamers also know physical attacks.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Tang Yu fainted. The absorption shields on his body and the four pets were also removed almost instantly. Buggy used its psychic power to control the elemental creatures that had recovered their bodies and completely knocked them out.
At this moment, only Shi Yu was left standing quietly in the arena, while Tang Yu and his four pets were all unconscious.
In such a style of battle, everyone’s eyes widened in an instant. They were stunned speechless and felt a chill down their spines.
“This…” Yin Zhengfan’s eyes were about to pop out. He looked at all of this in disbelief and started to doubt his rightness to come to Imperial Capital University.
This time, Shi Yu was even more ridiculous. He easily defeated the fourth seat of the Imperial Capital University, a genius with extremely abnormal talent, in a 1VS4.
At this moment, all the members of the battle club of Imperial Capital University opened their mouths slightly. They stood up in disbelief and looked at the venue.
On the Ancient Capital University’s side, everyone’s faces were flushed as they looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
Holy shit.
What happened just now?
The four pets lost their mobility in an instant?
Moreover, Shi Yu had personally teleported behind his opponent. The action of insta-killing his opponent with a hand blade was too familiar.
“How is that possible? Is he really just a teenager?”
At this moment, Teacher Shen’s expression changed. The two vice teams beside him also had serious expressions.
Transcendent-level Instant Transmission?
And this battle thought process… no matter how one looked at it, it looked like those Beast Tamers who were proficient in life and death battles!
“I’ll leave it to you.”
After defeating another opponent, under Shi Yu’s instructions, Buggy teleported them back to the audience seats of Imperial Capital University. Next, they would leave it to their own people.
At this moment, as Shi Yu easily defeated the fourth seat of the Imperial Capital University, the venue was extremely silent.
Monster… How the f*ck were they supposed to fight this!!!
They felt that if they played with a lunatic like Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer would die if he wasn’t careful!
“Impressive!!”
Although they didn’t know what was going on, when they saw Shi Yu kill the fourth seat of the Imperial Capital University so cleanly, Ancient Capital University’s side was extremely excited.
“Perfect!!!” White Brook muttered, stunned.
Then, no matter how the other teammates lost, their morale was finally high.
“Shi Yu, well done!”
She was just about to say that, but in the arena, Shi Yu didn’t seem to be satisfied. This was because for Shi Yu, there was indeed no meaning in the level of high-level Beast Tamers…
He looked at the high platform and at the three people who had been secretly observing.
He said something that shocked all the Beast Tamers.
“Next, can I challenge the vice-captain of Imperial Capital University?” Shi Yu spoke and directly challenged the master-level Beast Tamer who had a monarch-level pet. The entire venue was silent, and everyone opened their mouths wide.
Including White Brook, Yin Zhengfan, and Teacher Shen, everyone lost their ability to think. This wasn’t the script for the exchange event! What was he doing!

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - The Point of Sweeping Through Imperial University
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: The Point of Sweeping Through Imperial University
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After Shi Yu said that he wanted to challenge the vice-captain of Imperial Capital University, the entire place immediately fell silent.
The members of Imperial Capital University looked over in disbelief.
What???
White Brook and the others were also stunned, wondering if they had heard wrong.
On the high platform, the expressions of the two vice-captains of Imperial Capital University instantly collapsed. They also didn’t understand.
“This guy…” Beside him, Teacher Shen muttered.
What was Shi Yu trying to do?
“Hey, hey, hey.” On the other side, White Brook immediately panicked.
Her excited heart sank.
Shi Yu, Shi Yu!!!
The two vice captains of Imperial Capital University had monarch-level pets!
Moreover, they were all high-level races.
Its energy level was above 1 million!
Don’t you know the difference between a professional Beast Tamer and a master Beast Tamer?!
White Brook had no idea why Shi Yu, who had been timid when facing her challenge, was suddenly so fierce.
Don’t take it too hard!
The venue was still silent.
The students of Imperial Capital University had complicated expressions.
The two elites of the school were crushed by Shi Yu in succession. Many students from the Imperial Capital University were still in a very aggrieved state, but now, Shi Yu almost broke them down.
What kind of idiotic statement was this?
A high-level Beast Tamer challenging a master-level Beast Tamer?
Was he crazy, or did he have enough confidence?
Everyone thought about it carefully. Indeed, from the beginning to the end, even when dealing with the fourth seat of the Imperial Capital University, Shi Yu was still at the level of crushing his opponent. His strength had not been completely displayed.
Even his pets didn’t show up…
What was Shi Yu planning?
“I…” At this moment, the one who was most confused was definitely Yin Zhengfan.
He looked confused.
Too much.
Shi Yu was too much.
In order to surpass Shi Yu, he went to Imperial Capital University from afar and became a reserve member of Imperial Capital University’s battle club.
It was already a very impressive achievement for a 13-year-old young freshman to enter the battle club where experts were gathered.
The reserve members of the club, the official members of the battle club, the elites of the elite school team in the battle club, and the master-level vice-captain.
Imperial Capital University’s promotion system for the battle club was extremely clear. Yin Zhengfan originally thought that he had done very well, but this time, Shi Yu gave him a lesson.
There was no need to challenge the official members of the battle club at all.
The elite of the school team took only a single move.
Challenging a master at a higher level was the start of the highlight.
“This bastard.”
“I’ve never seen such an arrogant person.” Bai Wenjie, one of the vice-captains of the Battle Club of the Imperial Capital University, stood on the high platform and looked down intently. He was angry.
It was already a slap in the face that Shi Yu, a new student from Ancient Capital University, managed to crush two elites of the Imperial Capital University team.
However, they couldn’t say anything. After all, everything was in the exchange rules.
However, he didn’t expect the challenge to end up on him.
The moment Shi Yu spoke, his mind went blank.
“Too arrogant!” Beside Bai Wenjie, the other single-tailed female vice-captain of Imperial Capital University also had a sullen expression. She said, “Bai Wenjie, go and teach him a lesson.”
“Show him.”
“Alright! No, why is it me and not you? You’re also a vice-captain.” Bai Wenjie looked at the other party.
“You’re stronger and more stable than me. Is there a problem?” she asked with a frown.
“No problem, no problem,” Bai Wenjie said in a low voice. It was just that he kept feeling that something was wrong.
More stable?
Jiang Ran felt that there was an unstable factor in their master-level vice-captain fighting Shi Yu??
When Bai Wenjie suddenly snapped back to reality, he had already walked down unknowingly. Under the gaze of hundreds of people, he walked down expressionlessly.
At this moment, the scene was silent again.
They were shocked. Under Shi Yu’s invitation, someone really stood forward.
“It’s… It’s Captain Bai!”
Seeing this man come down, the members of the battle club exclaimed.
In Imperial Capital University, the main team went missing all year round. It only appeared in the National League and some relatively important occasions. Usually, it was the two masters, Bai Wenjie and Jiang Ran, who managed the club.
The strength of each of them was not inferior to the leader level figure of Ancient Capital University, White Brook.
After Bai Wenjie came down, he looked at Shi Yu calmly.
“Bai Wenjie, vice-captain of the Imperial Capital University’s team.”
“Although this doesn’t follow the rules, I accept your challenge.”
“You mean you want to challenge our commander rank pets, right?”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone present revealed enlightened expressions.
They almost forgot.
Even if it was a master-level Beast Tamer, not every pet was at the monarch level.
It was already not bad to have one.
Two was already very strong.
Most master-level Beast Tamers’ pets, apart from trump cards, were still commander-level.
Initially, everyone was still wondering why Shi Yu was so unwise as to challenge a master-level Beast Tamer, but if he only wanted to challenge the other party’s second tier pet, that was understandable.
But even so, a master-level Beast Tamer’s commander-level pet couldn’t be compared to a professional Beast Tamer’s commander-level pet.
Because the development of a master-level Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Talent would definitely be stronger.
It wasn’t difficult to use the strengthening talent to increase the pet’s energy level by 100,000 at once.
If a pet with 50,000 energy points was controlled by a high-level Beast Tamer with enhanced talent, its battle power might only increase by one-fifth or two.
But if it was controlled by a master, its battle power might even increase by two or three times.
After Bai Wenjie came down, he thought carefully. This was the only factor that could make Jiang Ran feel it was unstable.
If Shi Yu wanted to challenge their commander-level pet, with the abnormality of this Imagination Butterfly… Even they might have to deal with it carefully. After all, the spatial element was too strange.
However, Bai Wenjie felt that Jiang Ran was still too cowardly. Even in a commander battle, with their Beast Taming Talent, it was definitely not what Shi Yu could resist.
He could directly raise the energy of a commander-level pet with 100,000 energy points to 200,000 or 300,000. How could he lose?
“You’re worried about this?” On the high platform, Teacher Shen asked Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran nodded and said, “What if the other party has some trump card that can defeat the opponent with more than 100,000 energy… Bai Wenjie’s energy qualitative change talent is more stable.”
Her expression was serious. The elites of the school team had already lost. If the two master-level deputy teams also lost, Imperial Capital University would definitely become a clown in this exchange match.
After all, they were the first in the country last year!
Although their average strength was inferior to that of Demon Capital last year and couldn’t be considered top-notch, and they had relied on the main team to turn the tide, it still couldn’t be denied that the power of Imperial Capital University far exceeded that of Ancient Capital University.
If the national champion team lost to a new student from Ancient Capital University, the students of Imperial Capital University would definitely lose face in the next year.
At that time, it would probably be difficult for Imperial Capital University to even recruit students. All the geniuses would run to Demon and Ancient Capital.
“No, what I want to challenge is a monarch-level pet.” At this moment, while everyone was waiting for Shi Yu’s answer, Shi Yu said rather seriously, giving everyone a fright.
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone revealed stunned expressions again.
Even Bo Wenjie, Jiang Ran, Teacher Shen, and the others’ minds went blank again.
Yin Zhengfan and the others widened their eyes.
Why didn’t this guy follow the routine again!!
“You want to challenge a monarch?”
Bai Wenjie was stunned and laughed in anger. Did Shi Yu know what this concept was??
Did he know???
Ten times the energy difference!
“Yes…” Shi Yu nodded heavily.
“So, Senior, do you want to accept the challenge?”
“Alright.” Bai Wenjie smiled, somewhat unable to understand, but he still said, “You decide the rules.”
“Of course, even if it’s a 4VS1, I don’t mind.” He was extremely calm.
He was unwilling to bully Shi Yu.
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “No, 1VS1 is fine.”
He looked at the butterfly in the air and said, “My pet is still this.”
“1VS1 irregular battle,” Shi Yu said.
On the other hand, Bai Wenjie’s expression was heavy. It was unknown what he was thinking.
At that moment, there was no doubt that the entire place fell into an uproar.
The progress of the exchange was completely unexpected.
Now, it had actually evolved into Ancient Capital University’s new student vs Imperial Capital University’s number two?
Moreover, everyone originally thought that Shi Yu had a new trump card.
But now, it seemed that the pet sent out was still this Imagination Butterfly!
Even the members of Ancient Capital University could not understand Shi Yu’s intention at this moment.
At this moment, only Buggy was very excited.
Charge!
This was the first time it displayed its divine might after evolution.
It floated in the air like an overlord. It didn’t have the slightest fear of challenging someone above its level and looked down on the other party.
“Heh…”
On the other side, Bai Wenjie chuckled. Suddenly, a huge blue summoning array appeared opposite Shi Yu and the others.
“Wu!!!!”
A terrifying roar came from the summoning array.
In the next moment, a huge beast that was five meters tall and covered in white jade slowly appeared.
It had dry skin that lingered with cold air, long fangs and a huge nose, and a cold gaze.
“Wu!!!!” The moment it appeared, the venue under its feet was instantly frozen. A terrifying coldness instantly enveloped the entire hall.
[Name]: Ice River Mammoth
[Race Level]: High Class Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Energy Points]: 1250487
The moment the giant elephant appeared, many people compared the strength of the two pets. At this moment, the outcome seemed to be fixed.
Shi Yu looked at the energy value of the Ice River Mammoth and sighed with emotion at the huge difference between commander rank and monarch rank.
Ten times the energy of the Butterfly of Imagination…
“What’s Shi Yu thinking?”
“Ten times the difference.”
Everyone looked at the level information on the battle screen and felt suffocated.
When Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan fought, there was an energy detection device. Naturally, there were also such devices in the battle club.
This was also why many members of the battle club did not dare to face Shi Yu at that time.
An ideal overlord with 140,000 energy points was ridiculous.
It was almost close to the 200,000 standard for transcendent races at the level of monarchs.
But now…
[Name]: Imagination Butterfly
[Energy Points]: 144,215
[Name]: Ice River Mammoth
[Energy Points]: 1250487
In the face of the terrifying strength of a monarch race and monarch level, what was the point of the butterfly fighting?
“Is it possible that Shi Yu didn’t want to win from the start? He felt that it was a little mean to destroy the two of us. He wanted to deliberately lose to show his friendliness, but he wasn’t too embarrassed to lose to a high-level Beast Tamer, so he chose the vice-captain?”
“After all, even if he loses to a Master, there’s nothing to be ashamed of.”
A big genius guessed.
Everyone couldn’t help but look at him as if he was a fool.
How was that possible?
At this moment, looking at the huge difference between the two pets, Bai Wenjie also smiled.
He smiled and shook his head, still not very understanding.
He felt that the scene of Shi Yu and Liang Yan’s battle was about to repeat itself.
Perhaps the Ice River Mammoth could instantly kill the Butterfly with its deterrence alone.
This was the crushing effect of level.
No matter how great the potential of the overlord race was, the overlord race that had yet to mature was still weak.
Facing the Ice River Mammoth that had already grown to nearly complete stage, there was no chance of winning.
“Then I’ll let you see the difference between monarch rank and commander rank.”
He didn’t even plan to use his talent. That was too much of a bully.
Bai Wenjie spoke calmly. The moment his words fell, the Ice River Mammoth let out a long roar again!
“Wu!!!!!!”
As it spoke, a terrifying monarch aura immediately erupted!
Expert deterrence, monarch aura!!
Although the deterrence proficiency of the Ice River Mammoth was inferior to the Butterfly of Imagination, its growth level was high.
With the support of a huge amount of spiritual energy, even if the Butterfly of Imagination mastered transcendent deterrence, it would be useless.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the almost corporeal monarch aura seemed to be mixed with the power of frost, causing the entire arena to instantly freeze. At this moment, the terrifying coldness could be clearly sensed even by the Beast Tamers elsewhere in the venue.
A huge aura that was like a snowstorm instantly attacked the Butterfly of Imagination.
At this moment, everyone changed their positions and thought about it. They stood from the perspective of Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination, but they didn’t know how to resist at all.
But…
Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination’s expressions were still calm.
This calmness made Yin Zhengfan, Jiang Ran, Teacher Shen, and the others unable to understand. It also made White Brook and the others confused.
At this moment, everyone’s attention was attracted by the venue.
No one realized that the energy value information of the Butterfly of Imagination quietly changed on the big screen that displayed the details of the battle.
Beep… Beep… Beep…
In a short instant, the energy value of the Imagination Butterfly, which was still “140,000” just now, began to increase crazily.
“Buggy, Dragon Might.”
Shi Yu had already given the order in his heart.
The moment the deterrence from the other side attacked, the entire venue seemed to have been pulled into another world.
Everything around him turned blue. The sky that emitted a blue aura, the ground that was covered in a blue aura, and even a dazzling blue-white sun and countless clouds.
Super skill, Imagination Domain, instantly activated!
In the field of imagination, Buggy glanced at the other party and also released its full body’s deterrence. Invisible blue waves surrounded its body!
“Roar!!!”
This time, it was still not the sound of a butterfly, but a dragon roar.
It was similar to the dragon roar when the Tyrant Dragon revived back then, but in terms of aura, it was even more terrifying.
Blue dragon might instantly blossomed from Buggy’s body and turned into a tsunami-like wave that attacked the other party.
At the next moment, everyone was stunned.
Boom!
The two auras directly collided midway and actually instantly squeezed together. Countless blue electric arcs began to shoot out in mid-air. The invisible wave directly divided the frozen arena like sword aura again!
Crack!!
It wasn’t as simple as splitting apart. In an instant, apart from the safe area where the two Beast Tamers stood, the battle area directly rumbled like a sign of collapse under the pressure of the two auras!
At this moment, the entire venue seemed to be wrapped in two terrifying auras. The huge auras fought each other. This scene made everyone completely confused. The Ice River Mammoth and Bai Wenjie directly revealed stunned expressions.
How was this possible? How could the deterrence on the other side resist a monarch-level deterrence??
“Roar!!!!”
However, it was not as simple as just resisting.
As time passed, the deterrence of the Ice River Mammoth almost showed signs of being suppressed.
“Roar!!!”
Then, an even more ridiculous scene appeared.
At this moment, the surrounding space cracked, and countless spatial cracks filled the sky.
In the clouds in the sky, a phantom figure appeared and gradually formed a divine dragon body.
It was a huge dragon-shaped body covered in blue and white dragon scales, a huge Eastern dragon.
It kept floating and circling in the sky, the scales on its body shining, dazzling the spectators.
Under its gaze, the entire arena seemed to be trembling.
Only then did everyone realize that the deterrence that was mainly used to resist the Ice River Mammoth wasn’t released by the Butterfly of Imagination, but by this divine dragon!
“What, what’s that?!!”
Such a shocking change instantly attracted everyone’s attention.
It made them reveal shocked and shocked expressions.
Countless people sensed the huge dragon might and terrifying magic power of this divine dragon and couldn’t help but be stunned for a moment.
“It’s a divine dragon. I remember the news saying that when Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination evolved, a divine dragon phenomenon also appeared!”
“What exactly is this…”
At this moment, everyone looked at everything in confusion.
Only Shi Yu and Buggy knew what was going on.
Phantom Illusion+Dragon of Imagination+Imagination Domain+Dragon Might!
No…
Most importantly, Dream Stealing+Space Pouch!
As the worm floated in the air like an overlord, in the spatial pocket in its body, the level-seven resources, the Ice Dragon Whiskers, the Tyrant Dragon Fang, and the Sea Dragon Scales, which had the power of a real overlord-level dragon, were also floating quietly in the alternate space!
At that moment, their dragon power flowed continuously into the unknown land and fused into those illusory illusions.
The most domineering thing about transcendent-level phantom illusions was that they could use the power of the equipment to strengthen the phantom.
And if it were just three level-seven resources and illusions, Buggy actually couldn’t do this either.
However, the moment the Dragon of Imagination activated, Buggy instantly obtained the dragon-element attribute, as well as the physique, vitality, spiritual power, soul power, and potential of the divine dragon!
Its dragon-element affinity, the dragon-element affinity of the phantom… instantly increased to the extreme.
The upper limit of the body and phantom also instantly reached an extremely high level.
The burden of the external force on his body and the illusion was unimaginably huge.
The skill Dragon of Imagination instantly made Buggy perfect for dragon-type resources.
The power of the three dragon-element resources was almost perfectly inherited by the worm, allowing it to temporarily reach another peak!
“Roar!!!”
Under everyone’s stunned gaze, a moment later, with a roar from the divine dragon, the incomparably huge divine dragon phantom flew towards Buggy.
Boom!!!
The huge divine dragon phantom directly wrapped around the outside of Buggy. Compared to the huge divine dragon that was dozens of meters in the sky, the body of Buggy was equivalent to an eye on the head of the divine dragon.
At this moment, as the divine dragon phantom and the Imagination Butterfly fused, the aura of the bug in the divine dragon vest reached the limit. In an instant, the terrifying dragon might directly suppressed the mammoth might, and the venue quickly collapsed at this moment!!
A suffocating dragon might swept over, causing the Ice River Mammoth’s pupils to instantly shrink. It was momentarily stunned!
It was also at this moment that Shi Yu ordered Buggy to launch the final attack.
“Profundity.”
“The finishing touch…”
“Roar!!!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, Buggy at the spot where the divine dragon’s eye was seemed to have become the brain of the divine dragon phantom, controlling the divine dragon’s body to keep circling!
In the blink of an eye, the divine dragon’s body substantialized, as if it had become a real divine dragon. It was incomparably huge and divine. Terrifying blue dragon flames wrapped around its body, and the light became stronger and stronger. In the blink of an eye, its strength and speed suddenly erupted. Under the drive of Psychic power, its huge body shot straight towards the Ice River Mammoth!
Boom!!!
When the Ice River Mammoth recovered from its momentary daze, it only felt a blue light flash in front of its eyes. Then, its pupils constricted even more. Under the incomparable super profundity, it felt its entire body being torn apart, and finally, its consciousness became completely blurred!
“Roar!!!”
This divine dragon seemed to be swimming between reality and illusion. It directly passed through the Ice River Mammoth’s body, and its body passed through to the front of Bai Wenjie, whose gaze was almost exploding. Only then did it fly into the sky with fangs and claws, staring down domineeringly.
Boom!!!
Under its gaze, the Ice River Mammoth that was penetrated by the divine dragon phantom directly had a huge energy explosion on its body, completely drowning it in the collapsed arena!
At this moment, everyone opened their mouths wide and looked at everything in disbelief.
Their expressions were shocked, stunned, and in disbelief.
Their values were almost shattered.
At this moment, someone finally realized that something was wrong. Yin Zhengfan, Tang Yun, Jiang Ran, Teacher Shen, White Brook, and the others all saw the change in the energy level of the Butterfly on the screen!
[Name]: Imagination Butterfly
[Energy Points]:1691111
With the support of the extreme power of imagination, with the help of the three tools, the power of the Imagination Butterfly instantly reached the level of a monarch, and it was at the level of a monarch with super high abilities. At this moment, everyone looked at the ridiculously high value and was even more confused… After all, they couldn’t see the three top-notch dragon-element resources in the spatial pocket of the worm.
All of this had completely become an extremely strange and unscientific supernatural phenomenon in the eyes of everyone.
On the high platform.
Teacher Shen’s gaze was about to explode because even he, a top-notch master, didn’t know what had just happened.
It broke through to the monarch level at the last minute?
Impossible!
Another vice-captain of the Imperial Capital University, Jiang Ran, looked at all of this with a stunned expression. Instant… Instant… Instant kill again??
In the smoke, the fallen Ice River Mammoth gradually appeared in front of everyone.
Everyone was shocked in their hearts, and Bai Wenjie’s mind was even blank.
He didn’t want to reflect on why he didn’t use his Beast Taming Talent immediately. Right now, he only wanted to faint with the Ice River Mammoth and leave this unfriendly world.
He was stunned on the ground, his breathing stopped, and his heart beat wildly.
“Looks like I won.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the huge divine dragon disappeared, as did Buggy. To be precise, it had become too small. At this moment, it was impossible to detect.
After showing off, the weakened Buggy used high-speed healing to heal the damage caused by forcefully accepting the power of a level-seven equipment. At the same time, it flew towards Shi Yu and slowly landed on his shoulder. It couldn’t even bear to use Instant Transmission at this moment.
“Zhengfan!”
At this moment, although Bai Wenjie did not faint, there were already others who fainted.
“Zhengfan, what’s wrong?”
In the audience seats of Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan watched this battle in shock the whole time. His heart rate might even be faster than Bai Wenjie himself. As the Ice River Mammoth was insta-killed, his cognitive vision completely shattered, as if he had suffered a heat stroke and collapsed. He instantly felt a little dizzy, and on the verge of collapse, he stuck his head between his thighs with sweat all over his face and panted heavily.
Now, be it teachers or students, or members of Imperial Capital University or Ancient Capital University, they were all panting as they watched everything.
At this moment, Shi Yu still didn’t seem to be satisfied.
To be precise, he wasn’t the one who was unhappy.
Instead, a serious protest came from Eleven in the Beast Taming Space!
“Wu wu wu.”
If Buggy was done showing off, what about Eleven?!
If it couldn’t defeat a monarch rank but completely crushed a commander rank, it was meaningless. How could Shi Yu do this? How could he let Buggy become like this!
“It’s not impossible to continue. The 3VS3 Iron-eating Beast Knight can request to fight.”
Shi Yu looked at the high platform of the venue and at the stunned Imperial Capital University battle club instructor and another female vice-captain.
His gaze directly shocked Jiang Ran.
Fortunately, at this moment, a heavenly voice sounded.
“Shi… Shi Yu… come back.”
“It’s enough.”
On the side of Ancient Capital University, White Brook said with a nervous expression. She was afraid, she was really afraid. This script had seriously deviated from the original plan. Her brain was buzzing. Friendship was first, friendship was first!!
Now, she also knew why Shi Yu didn’t fight with her. He was afraid of hurting her since she used her own body to fight…
Senior Lu, what kind of monster have you brought back!!
“Is it done?” Shi Yu turned around in surprise.
“Senior, didn’t you say that you want me to sweep through Imperial Capital University?”
“Have some limits, of course!” White Brook suddenly stood up and was also shocked. How could Shi Yu directly say such a thing?
However, a moment later, she realized that Shi Yu was using telepathy, so she heaved a sigh of relief.
“You should rest.”
Shi Yu: “Alright then.”
Eleven:????
It charged so much spicy electricity, so much spicy electricity that it didn’t dare to waste at all. It charged for nothing??
Shi Yu also felt that it was alright, because although the Iron-eating Beast Knight strategy could also display the power of a monarch, it was too tiring for a Beast Tamer.
[Don’t worry, this isn’t the only place you can fight.] Shi Yu recovered his smile. Then, he said to the confused senior in front of him who was at a loss, “Senior, thank you for the fight.”
“Let the battle end here…”
“We can’t let the other seniors of Ancient Capital University wait too long.”
Most importantly, there was no more arena.
Moreover, there was a time limit for the exchange. Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided that he should slip away.
Bai Wenjie was just about to say something, but he didn’t spit out normal words. “Aba…”
Therefore, Shi Yu could only turn around and leave himself. He turned around coolly, causing Teacher Shen’s expression to darken on the stage. Her brain felt dizzy, and she was also a little weak like Yin Zhengfan.
At this moment, no one dared to stop Shi Yu from turning around. Even the other vice-captain of Imperial Capital University was holding the railing fiercely, but she didn’t move.
Because at this moment, even if she rushed up to fight Shi Yu, even if she won, it would be meaningless.
He had defeated the famous elites of Imperial Capital University one after another. As a new student of Ancient Capital University, it was not too much to say that he had successfully swept through Imperial Capital University.
Because Shi Yu was only a high-level Beast Tamer.
As Shi Yu returned to his seat at Ancient Capital University, the entire venue was still silent.
Monster! Monster!
As many people muttered, Shi Yu blinked at the other stunned seniors of Ancient Capital University in embarrassment.
“Well, I’m sorry. Why do I feel that the Beast Tamers of Imperial Capital University will release their anger on you next? You guys have to be careful. Don’t get crippled.”
“But don’t worry, my ginseng baby is very powerful. It can heal you.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of the seniors from Ancient Capital University, who had originally been excited and overjoyed to the extreme, and had even started to fantasize about the results of the National League, suddenly changed.
F*ck!
Shi Yu’s words directly extinguished the hot blood in their hearts. They had forgotten that they still had to fight the elites of Imperial Capital University next.
They didn’t have Shi Yu’s strength!
They maintained a blank expression as they looked at the geniuses from Imperial Capital University who had aggrieved expressions and couldn’t say a word. Their hearts skipped a beat.
Tears immediately flowed down their faces.
So it wasn’t just Imperial Capital University that was damaged!! Shi Yu, why did you come back down? Wasn’t he just harming them!!

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the seat of Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu chuckled.
White Brook also smiled.
Only the other members of Ancient Capital University had dark expressions.
“Don’t waste time. Challenge according to the team’s ranking.”
“If you lose, you lose. What’s there to be afraid of?”
White Brook lectured.
She didn’t expect Ancient Capital University to win this exchange event.
The source of university students in the Ancient Capital was inferior to the Imperial Capital University, and the educational resources of the schools were inferior to the Imperial Capital University. If the overall strength of the Imperial Capital University was weaker than the Ancient Capital University, the school would not be far from collapse.
