Although Shi Yu had swept through Imperial Capital University, the overall strength of Ancient Capital University’s battle club was still relatively low.
It was already pretty good to gain an advantage through Shi Yu.
Were the subsequent battles still important? It was not important at all!
The only goal was to let the other students of Ancient Capital University realize the difference between them and Imperial Capital University. They would accept the beating and urge them to improve!
Soon, an unlucky person was pushed out. At this silent turning point, he went on stage and continued to challenge Imperial Capital University.
He looked nervous.
It was also at this moment that he encountered the gazes of the students from the Imperial Capital University who were like ferocious wolves staring at a little sheep…
…
At the same time.
White Brook observed the situation as she approached Shi Yu.
“Tell me, what happened just now.”
White Brook’s mood still didn’t calm down.
She knew that Shi Yu had the strength of a quasi-master. With the possession of the sword spirit and the fusion of the iron-eating beast’s power, he could unleash the attack of a monarch.
However, Shi Yu had also said that the burden on his body was relatively large. Moreover, from the performance during the advanced assessment, the power was completely inferior to the “finishing touch” just now.
Even she probably couldn’t withstand that attack easily.
Without a doubt, with the Butterfly of Imagination in that state and Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast Knight battle strategy, Shi Yu already had the strength of a master.
“An irregular battle with no rules… My Imagination Butterfly borrowed some external power.”
“The price to use that attack is not small.”
Shi Yu said telepathically.
“External force?”
“Illusionary Phantom… Item?”
White Brook quickly thought of the fact that the phantom illusion skill with high proficiency could borrow the power of items.
However, she was puzzled again because she didn’t see the Butterfly of Imagination carrying any tools.
“Inner space?”
White Brook’s head moved very quickly. After all, she also had the ruins space. She quickly guessed that the Butterfly of Imagination might have storage space skills.
White Brook’s expression couldn’t help but change.
Damn!
What a dirty accompanying move. If Shi Yu didn’t say anything, even in a competition with restrictions on props, the judge might not necessarily be able to tell.
“Heh.” Shi Yu grinned. This move was indeed cheating.
Ice Dragon Whisker, Sea Dragon Scale, and Tyrant Dragon Fang were all level-seven resources that contained the power of overlords.
Even if Buggy only borrowed a small portion of its power, it still temporarily obtained monarch-level battle power.
As for the price, that was to use a little of the power of these three resources. Not a bit. Moreover, Buggy could only release an explosive attack and didn’t have the ability to continue fighting.
If not for these three tools, Buggy would definitely not have been able to defeat the other party. It was more likely that it would be stunned by the deterrence just like the opponent thought.
The situation at that time was equivalent to a child facing a ferocious tiger. Buggy was a child, and the enemy was a ferocious tiger.
But it didn’t make sense. This child held a sniper rifle and even mastered the Firearm Proficiency skill.
The outcome was no surprise. No matter how strong the ferocious tiger’s battle power was, it couldn’t be stronger than a child with equipment.
However, this wasn’t considered cheating, because if these three resources were given to other pets other than Buggy, they couldn’t borrow the power of the three resources at all.
It couldn’t even use one-thousandth of the power of the three resources.
It was only when the bugs combined the powers of “Phantom Illusion”, “Imagination Domain”, and “Dragon of Imagination” that they successfully mobilized their power.
These three skills were equivalent to letting Buggy have the “Dragon-element Proficiency” skill. It was its exclusive ability.
Dragon-element weapon master, Buggy!
“What a pity, what a pity.” Seeing that Shi Yu had admitted to it, White Brook revealed a pitying expression.
Ahhh!
Although she didn’t know what level of props Shi Yu had armed the Butterfly with, the National League prohibited the use of props that exceeded one’s level, and only one was allowed to be carried.
Didn’t that mean that Shi Yu couldn’t use this move in the national competition?
However, even if it could be used, Shi Yu was only a “One-Punch Man”. He couldn’t do it after one shot.
White Brook looked at Shi Yu bitterly.
Shi Yu had just given her hope of fighting alongside her in the master domain of the National League, but now, she felt cheated.
“You…”
“Can you reach the master level before the National League?” After asking this, White Brook felt that her question was ridiculous.
However, Shi Yu began to think seriously.
“Perhaps…”
After all, if he wanted to participate in the Dragon Palace City banquet, he would definitely do his best to help him become a master in the third bureau.
“Perhaps… You can???!”
White Brook was suddenly stunned.
“Yes.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “However, even if I become a master, I don’t have the confidence to defeat that Gao Xuan from Imperial Capital University.”
The captain of the Imperial Capital University’s team, Gao Xuan, was known as a Beast Tamer who was almost guaranteed to become a legend, just like Lu Qingyi, Heavenly King Zou, and the others.
After arriving at Imperial Capital University, Shi Yu learned more about this person.
The other party was a genius Mechanic in the fourth round, and his strength far exceeded his peers.
He had almost reached the pinnacle of master level.
He didn’t know if the other party was here today. In addition, the reason why he challenged the vice-captain of Imperial Capital University and didn’t challenge the other party’s captain was because Shi Yu knew that he definitely couldn’t defeat the other party now.
“That guy… is also a cheat like you.” White Brook thought of that captain from Imperial Capital University, and her expression darkened.
This person was also the only person she was unwilling to face in the National League.
It was even more overboard than Shi Yu. He used overlord race machinery himself!
She had heard from her elders that the members of the fourth round practically nurtured this Gao Xuan like a treasure.
The other party’s treatment was better than Shi Yu’s in Bureau 11. After all, machines were the mainstream in the current human countries, the main force to fight against totems.
“It’s alright, you’re still young. In any case, he can only participate in one batch.” White Brook quickly felt that Shi Yu could do it.
…
At Imperial Capital University.
After returning, Bai Wenjie directly left the scene and didn’t have the face to stay any longer.
If he could fight again, he would definitely use his Beast Taming Talent from the start. At that time, with the help of the skill, it was definitely impossible for the Ice River Mammoth to not be able to withstand a single blow.
However, there was no point for regret in this world. After he left, Teacher Shen from Imperial Capital University no longer had the mood to continue watching the next battle.
He sat in the chair in silence, thinking about what had just happened.
After thinking about it, he more or less thought of what White Brook thought.
“Illusionary Phantom… Inner space… high-level tool?” Teacher Shen was slightly stunned.
Was this the reason why Shi Yu chose to fight irregularly?
But even so, it couldn’t be denied that the second-in-command of their Imperial Capital University had lost to a new student from Ancient Capital University.
Most importantly, he was insta-killed because he underestimated his opponent.
He immediately expected better from him. He felt that if this was the totem war era, these students wouldn’t be able to live past three chapters.
On the other hand, Shi Yu was most likely like a fish in water.
Moreover, Teacher Shen looked in the direction of the battle club. He actually didn’t know who could take over Gao Xuan’s position and carry the banner of Imperial Capital University after he graduated.
“I’ve told Gao Xuan about what happened just now,” beside Teacher Shen, she said to the other vice-captain of the battle club, Jiang Ran.
“What did he say?” Teacher Shen was stunned.
“He said he doesn’t want to care about the club, but he will participate in the last National League.”
“Yes.” Teacher Shen nodded and sighed.
With Gao Xuan around, the champion of this year’s national competition would probably still be from Imperial Capital University.
But after Gao Xuan graduated, there would be Demon Capital University in the front, and then there would be the monster new student from Ancient Capital University eyeing them covetously. For a moment, Teacher Shen was conflicted about which student he should nurture next.
He had a teaching talent that could steadily help Imperial Capital University nurture geniuses, but sometimes, extreme individuals were often more important than groups.
On the other side, in a research institute.
A young man put down his cell phone with a calm expression and returned his gaze to the mechanical beast in front of him.
This was a tall mechanical beast in the form of a silver-white dragonman. At this moment, it was among the dense mechanical equipment. Its entire body was connected by various wires, as if it was undergoing modification.
The moment he saw this mechanical beast, a row of data appeared on the monocle in front of the young man.
[Name]: Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast
[Attributes]: Machinery, Dragon
[Race Level]: Medium overlord
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Energy Points]:4000001
“Energy upgrade successful.”
“Next is weapon optimization.”
Seeing that the energy value of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast had already reached twice the standard of an overlord pet of the same level, he nodded silently. In the blink of an eye, he forgot the news just now and continued to busy himself with the modification in his hand without paying any attention.
In his opinion, what happened in university wasn’t worth his attention at all.
If it weren’t for the fact that the group in the fourth round insisted that he come to university to experience life and force him to interact more with his peers, he wouldn’t have bothered to come to university.
He only had one goal now.
Transforming the Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast into a top-notch mechanical beast of a high-level overlord race.
As for the methods the seniors in the fourth round used to forcefully encourage him, it was also very simple.
The prizes for this year’s National League champion would be provided by the fourth round.
The prize was some top-notch materials for modifying mechanical lives!
In Gao Xuan’s opinion, after obtaining these materials, his Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast would definitely become a high-level overlord race.
This was the main motivation for him to participate in the National League.
“But why does the name Shi Yu sound so familiar?”
“The genius newbie from Bureau 11 that Teacher mentioned?”
As Gao Xuan muttered to himself, he continued to be obsessed with mechanical modification. An archaeologist was completely unrelated to a Mechanic like him.
…
Without a doubt, Shi Yu had traumatized Imperial Capital University.
Even if the next challenger from Ancient Capital University wasn’t strong, the students from Imperial Capital University were especially serious at the start of the match.
They released all battle power as soon as they came up, and their Beast Taming Talent was directly maxed out. They started with the super skill, and the moves were connected continuously, not daring to be sloppy at all.
They didn’t give the other students of Ancient Capital University a chance to catch their breath at all.
It made the seniors of Ancient Capital University suffer indescribably.
Soon, the students of Imperial Capital University discovered that the other students of Ancient Capital University were all trash. None of them could fight.
Soon, most of the students from Ancient Capital University lost.
“I can’t watch anymore.”
After watching a few matches, Shi Yu couldn’t help but leave the scene, leaving White Brook alone to sulk.
White Brook was furious. Why did the students of Imperial Capital University reflect so quickly!
After Shi Yu slipped away, he was free and called Principal Feng.
He was still in Imperial Capital University.
In an elegant room, Principal Feng was catching up with the principal of the Imperial Capital University, an old woman.
“I wonder what kind of dog shit luck you guys have.”
“It’s one thing to have picked up a genius with a listening talent, but he actually has such a high talent in the feeding field.”
“Just now, Ye Hui called me and said that he wanted your Shi Yu to use Imperial Capital University’s Time Mystic Realm.”
The old woman took a sip of tea and sighed.
Principal Feng: “Hahaha, thanks to Qingyi!”
“When Qingyi said that she had found a genius, I didn’t mind at first, but from the looks of it… Hahahaha.”
“And I reckon that after a period of time, his battle talent can also be displayed.”
“By the way, he seems to have gone to communicate with your Imperial Capital University’s battle club. Let’s see the results later.”
When Principal Feng was in front of Shi Yu and the others, he was very serious. However, when he came to his old friend from the Education Bureau, he couldn’t help but laugh.
“Old Feng, you’re arrogant.” The old lady opposite Principal Feng chuckled.
The upper limit of the Beast Tamer battle power of Bureau 11 was known.
The strengthening talent of a master-level Beast Tamer with good talent development could easily increase the pet’s energy by hundreds of thousands. The strengthening talent of a legendary Beast Tamer could easily increase the pet’s energy by millions. How could a Beast Tamer with this telepathy talent compare?
Since ancient times, it wasn’t that there weren’t people whose telepathy talent had reached the Legendary level, but there wasn’t anyone who had reached the titled Legendary level!
“Why not… Ah.”
“I’ll take this call first.”
Principal Feng said.
He glanced at the caller and was instantly amused.
“Shi Yu, didn’t you go to the exchange with White Brook and the others? Why are you calling now?”
“Ah, I’m done fighting.”
“I mainly want to ask you when we can return to the ancient capital.”
Shi Yu walked on the road to Imperial Capital University and asked more concernedly.
He was still waiting to go back and enter seclusion to increase the points for Baby Ginseng.
Apart from that, Little Chi Tong’s level could also be raised.
With his current legendary physique, it was easy for him to withstand Little Chi Tong breaking through to commander rank. It shouldn’t be difficult for him to withstand the commander rank Little Chi Tong’s possession. As long as he didn’t mess around with the Sword of Interlocking with Eleven, it shouldn’t be a problem.
Moreover, up until now, he had yet to reach the upper limit of his physique after a new breakthrough.
“So fast?”
Principal Feng was stunned, but they were almost done discussing things here.
Legend Hua, Dr. Zuo, President Ye, and the four of them cultivated around the green cocoon and had already reached a certain strategic cooperation.
“If you’re anxious, you can go back tonight. But how’s the battle over there? Why are you so fast?”
Principal Feng glanced at the old principal of the Imperial Capital University opposite.
“Not bad… I’m not sure about the subsequent situation. I defeated the eighth, fourth, and the monarch-level pet of the vice captain in one hit. Then, I came out.”
“Principal Feng, isn’t this giving Ancient Capital University some good rep! But though this is what I should do, I paid a huge price for it, although…”
Shi Yu was just about to take credit and ask for a level-seven resource from the new dragon-element when Principal Feng shouted.
“What, what did you say?!” Principal Feng suspected that he had heard wrong.
Shi Yu instantly killed the monarch-level pet of the Imperial Capital University’s vice captain?
“…”
A moment later, Principal Feng hung up with a strange expression and looked at the old principal of the Imperial Capital University.
“I’m indeed arrogant. There seems to be an accident during the exchange event. You can ask your Teacher Shen.”
“Though, it’s better if you ask yourself.” Principal Feng’s expression was calm as he took a sip of tea.
The principal of the Imperial Capital University:??
She frowned, not understanding what was wrong with this old thing.
However, she still sent a message to Teacher Shen to let him report the exchange between the students of the two schools.
Originally, she wouldn’t ask or care about such things.
However… looking at Principal Feng’s strange expression, she had a bad feeling.
A moment later, as Teacher Shen’s heart skipped a beat at the venue, the old principal of Imperial Capital University received a message filled with blood and tears.
[It’s not our student’s fault. That Shi Yu is a little monster, just like Gao Xuan back then.]
Could a normal person think of a high-level Beast Tamer’s commander-level pet suddenly erupting with ten times the strength and instakilling a monarch-level pet?
Under normal circumstances, this was completely unscientific!
[…]
As she read the message word by word, the eyelids of the old principal of the Imperial Capital University twitched a few times, and her face darkened.
“Heheh,” Principal Feng said.
“Get lost.” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University directly pressed the exit button with a furious expression. What the hell? How could a master student from the Imperial Capital University be insta-killed by a new student from the Ancient Capital University? What did it mean? Were they trying to bully her? Even TV dramas didn’t dare to do it like this!
“Huh?” Principal Feng was amused.
“Shi Yu can use the Time Mystic Realm, but your Ancient Capital University is paying.” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University hit the table in embarrassment.
Principal Feng:???
This was agreed by the Vice President Ye! Old woman, what a sore loser she was!

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - Sword Forging Master Shi Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Sword Forging Master Shi Yu
That night, the communication activity between Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University ended “perfectly.”
Both parties were pretty satisfied.
The students of Imperial Capital University were severely stimulated.
The students of Ancient Capital University were also severely stimulated.
It was all because of one person.
…
Just as Principal Feng said, Shi Yu and the others started to return to the ancient capital that night.
“Beautiful.”
On Dean Hao’s Mystic Meteorite, Shi Yu was lying happily.
This trip to the capital was really not in vain.
First, he got first place in the Feeding Conference, making him gain both fame and fortune.
Although the Butterfly of Imagination had announced its name, the strategic value of the Green Worm cocoon had yet to be announced. There was no hurry.
Most importantly, he successfully joined the third bureau.
He had obtained the Time Sand, the cultivation index, and the opportunity to head to Dragon Palace City to obtain the cub of an overlord race!
Apart from that, he could also go to the time mystic realm of Imperial University to take a look.
Also… the predictions the owl had given him also benefited Shi Yu.
In short, he didn’t come for nothing!
Moreover, after returning to the ancient capital, the benefits would definitely be great.
After all, he was representing Ancient Capital University to participate in the Feeding Conference this time. It was impossible for Ancient Capital University to not show their support.
And sweeping through Imperial Capital University was another great achievement.
“Dean Hao.”
“Ah.” Dean Hao, who was flying the plane, was stunned. He said, “What’s wrong, genius?”
“Does our Mechanical College have the ability to create mechanical pets of overlord races?”
“Pfft.” Dean Hao almost crashed.
At this age, Principal Feng, who had been too agitated these few days and was tired both physically and mentally, suddenly woke up.
What was going on?
Why was it an overlord mechanical pet?
“What are you thinking? How is that possible!” Dean Hao’s face darkened.
If he could create overlord race pets, even if he could join the process of creating overlord race machinery, would he still be the dean of Ancient Capital University?
Principal Feng:…
“I’m just asking.”
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “I saw the video of the last National League and saw that Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast from the Imperial Capital University was pretty impressive…”
“It can still fly, can still fuse, and can even split. Its energy far exceeds pets of the same level. In battle, it’s also an instant kill…”
Principal Feng :”…”
“I thought you didn’t like mechanical pets?”
Principal Feng suspected that Shi Yu was like someone eating with his mouth, guarding the bowl, taking more with his chopsticks while thinking about the pot, thinking still about tomorrow. In a few months, there would be a chance to go to Dragon Palace City to contract a water-element overlord cub. Why was he thinking about his mechanical pet again?
Moreover, he remembered that… Shi Yu didn’t like mechanical pets.
He had rejected the upgrade of the index to a mechanical life twice in a row, the archaeological index once, and the cultivation index once.
“Really??” Shi Yu was stunned.
Machinery was a man’s romance, how could he not like it?
“Then why don’t you upgrade the index to a mechanical life form?” Dean Hao had also wanted to help Shi Yu upgrade before, but he was rejected by Shi Yu.
“This… What can a cell phone index do?” Shi Yu said. “I want a battle-type one.”
Shi Yu believed that if he upgraded his cell phone to a mechanical pet, he would definitely not be able to resist adding points.
Although it wasn’t impossible to become a battle machine with the support of points, it was still too troublesome.
He could directly add some sound wave skills and release the Nuclear Explosion Divine Melody to the opponent during the battle?
It was too exaggerated!
It was not as handsome as those mechas and battleships.
The index would just be a guide obediently.
“Battle-type…” The corners of Dean Hao’s mouth twitched.
Battle-type mechanical lives were good, but maintenance was expensive.
“As long as the materials are in place and time is given, our Mechanical College still has a chance to create a monarch race mechanical life form,” Dean Hao said.
“Oh, let’s talk about it later,” Shi Yu said with little interest.
It wasn’t an overlord race…
Principal Feng and Dean Hao:???
What’s with your perfunctory tone? You don’t like monarch race machinery anymore?
…
At around 10 PM, Shi Yu returned to Ancient Capital University.
After returning, he immediately went to the dormitory to rest.
“Wuu!” Eleven gloomily took out a bottle of bamboo milk from the fridge.
It also brought a bottle of soda and ice water for Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong.
“Yi!”
“Mi!”
In the end, it still couldn’t fight! Eleven cried.
How good would it be to have an opponent with the “Shield Absorption” talent?
It would just turn into a giant panda and do a slap attack without any special moves. Even dragons would get knocked out!
If it couldn’t hit the elemtalized pets?
Then it would hit the Beast Tamer!
It depended on whether these elemental pets were elementalized to avoid damage or to protect Beast Tamers.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu and Buggy didn’t give it this chance.
“Wu…” Buggy used its mental strength to take out a bottle of fruit juice and comfort the leader.
In the future, it would serve the leader in this kind of dirty work and tiring work!
The stronger it was, the greater the responsibility. It was willing to charge for the entire team!
“Wuu!” Eleven was angry.
It bit the bottle and crossed its arms around its chest with a serious expression. No, it wanted to charge too.
Leave the weaker guys to Eleven!
When there were stronger opponents, such as the hostile totem in the prophecy, Eleven would hand it to Buggy to charge into the battle.
Buggy:???
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng thought of the many totems in the prophecy and shuddered.
It thought that these two could charge all they wanted.
It needed to develop for a while…
Baby Ginseng, who didn’t have deterrence skills, was more obedient.
“Mi?” Little Chi Tong quickly turned the ice water into boiling water. After being satisfied, it turned to look at everyone.
At this moment, Shi Yu was already lying on the sofa with his head buried in the pillow.
“Stop fighting…”
“There are still chances to fight next. There are both strong and weak ones.”
“Buggy, go find Teacher Ying and ask him when he’s free to bring us to the Undead Battlefield. It’s just to take a look at the Undying Pond.”
“This time, I plan to let it take us along to kill at least ten thousand transcendent-level undead, a thousand commander-level undead, and even monarch-level undead!”
“How does it sound, training in the Undead Battlefield?” Shi Yu stuck his head out.
He planned to take the time to upgrade Little Chi Tong’s “Spirit Release” skill to expert level.
This was a super skill, but it was abnormally simple to upgrade to expert level.
It actually only needed to kill ten thousand transcendent-level undead, one thousand and one commander-level undead, and one monarch-level undead.
With the lead of an overlord, was there anything easier?
Much easier than adding points to super skills.
Perhaps Little Chi Tong would soon be the first child in the team to have an expert level super skill.
As for proficient level super skills, in fact, Buggy’s Imagination Domain and Dragon of Imagination were already almost proficient level. Even if they didn’t reach it, they were definitely infinitely close.
However, there were no relevant records regarding the skills of Imagination Domain and the Dragon of Imagination. It was as if it had appeared for the first time, and Shi Yu couldn’t judge.
However, with the foundation of the transcendent level Illusory Phantom, Buggy’s imagination level definitely couldn’t be low.
Therefore, although they had yet to officially fight in the current team, even if they didn’t bring any equipment, Shi Yu felt that Buggy’s battle power should still have the absolute advantage.
Although Eleven’s explosive power was even higher than Buggy, the problem was that it only erupted once or twice. Buggy had Instant Transmission and etherealization, so it was still relatively difficult to hit it after Eleven erupted. If Buggy chose to fight a guerrilla battle, Eleven probably wouldn’t be able to do anything.
Therefore, Shi Yu planned to focus on increasing Eleven and Baby Ginseng’s battle power.
As for Little Chi Tong, it didn’t need to rely on points. It just needed to farm monsters.
At that time, it could definitely directly advance to commander rank with an expert level super skill.
Apart from that, Chi Tong could also release two new forms. Shi Yu was filled with anticipation.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, liberating a new form was no different from evolution. Although it was an evolution that didn’t change the race level at a small scale, it was still worth looking forward to.
“Wuu…”
“Wu…”
“Yi…”
“Mi?!!”
When they heard that they were going to the undead battlefield to train, apart from Little Chi Tong, the other three lost interest.
It was gloomy and not fun… Although there was an evolution location there, Baby Ginseng was also more nervous about the situation in the Undying Pond. It didn’t know if it was reliable.
“Objection overruled. Buggy, go quickly.”
After Shi Yu got Buggy to run to deliver his message, he continued lying down.
“Wuu~” Buggy teleported and disappeared from the room.
A few seconds later, Buggy teleported back.
It looked at Baby Ginseng and brought Shi Yu and the others a piece of news.
[Gem Cat: Prepare enough food. You can set off at any time. You can stay over there.]
Baby Ginseng:???
“Yi!!!” Didn’t it prepare a box of gem fruits before going to the capital!
…
…
The next day.
His cell phone rang, and Shi Yu woke up feeling refreshed.
“Ha ~”
After yawning, Shi Yu took a look. It wasn’t an alarm, but a call from the beast-eared girl.
“…” Shi Yu remembered. He had returned with Principal Feng and the others first, but the beast-eared girl and the others seemed to still be in the capital.
No one planned to give them a ride.
“Hello, Senior.” Shi Yu picked up the call.
“Hey, hey, hey, have you returned to the ancient capital?”
“Yeah.”
“We still have to stay in the Imperial capital for a period of time. I forgot to tell you previously. Are you sure you want to participate in the martial arts conference?”
The beast-eared girl’s concerned voice came from the other side.
The martial arts conference…
Shi Yu was stunned. What White Brook had mentioned previously was not a battle between pets, but a battle between Beast Tamers.
He was tempted at that time. Firstly, it was for some of the skill prizes in the competition. He had heard that there would be many skills that could perfectly cooperate with Beast Tamers and pets.
Secondly…
The most important thing was that the martial arts conference was held in a ruins space left behind by a Martial Emperor. Shi Yu wanted to take a look at the Martial Emperor ruins and take the ancient test.
“It’s already confirmed. I’ll participate.”
“Very good, very stable!” White Brook said. “I won’t say anything else. Your Sword Spirit Possession state is definitely very strong in the martial arts conference. I just remembered something.”
“The martial arts conference is allowed to carry weapons and equipment.”
“Some Beast Tamers’ weapons and equipment are pets, but people without similar pets can also bring normal equipment.”
“Weapons for battle and protective armor are all allowed to be worn when the time comes. If we want to achieve good results, it feels best to get one. There’s no need for it to be high-level, but if others have it, we can’t not have it, right!”
“Equipment…” Shi Yu was stunned. In fact, the Flame Demon Amor he was wearing was already a pretty good equipment. It could perfectly adapt to his possession state and offset the burning effect. It was a level-six equipment, equivalent to a top-notch monarch. It was worth more than ten million.
If it leveled up again, it would be a level-seven equipment, which was the level of the Ice Dragon Whiskers…
At this moment, Yu couldn’t afford it!
After all, the Ice Dragon Whiskers was a material close to the totem level of the Ice Dragon. It contained its power and wrapped around its transcendent dragon might. It was impossible for Shi Yu to bear to buy equipment of the same level.
“I understand.” Shi Yu decided to be more balanced. Archeology was the priority, and competition was the support. This kind of competition didn’t restrict the level of the participants. At that time, there would probably be masters, such as masters who had mastered the Fusion Talent. Shi Yu didn’t have any thoughts about first place when there were people like the beast-eared girl.
“Alright.” After informing Shi Yu, White Brook hung up happily.
At the same time, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The Fire Demon Armor was not bad… There was no need to upgrade it.
However, if he was allowed to bring equipment, why didn’t he personally create some weapons and equipment??
Shi Yu suddenly got up.
It wasn’t like he hadn’t done this before.
During the second fight, he made Eleven condense a hardened sword!
However, this longsword was temporarily condensed. It was not impressive at all.
But what if Eleven condensed a sword seriously and armed the hardening substance with high-level materials as the sword body!
Apart from that, Buggy’s transcendent level phantom image could condense a dragon soul and seal it in the sword. As power, it could be unsealed at any time.
The illusion it created was the same as hardening matter. It could already leave the main body for a long time. As an artifact spirit, it wasn’t impossible.
At that time, with Little Chi Tong possessing him and him holding the divine sword, his battle power would increase again.
Most importantly, the cheapness of DIY suited him better!
Also… If he could perfect Eleven’s deterrence point before the competition and let Eleven wrap the deterrence around the sword, he would have mental equipment.
“I’m really smart.”
“It’s time to get myself a set of equipment. After that, I’ll go to the Undead Battlefield and test my strength with the undead!”
Swordforger Master Shi Yu was born.
He felt that after casting the divine sword and possessing the sword spirit, he could fight a monarch-level undead!

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - Divine Artifact, Ice Dragon Blade
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Divine Artifact, Ice Dragon Blade
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
After returning to Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu became busy again.
Dong Huang’s university started in February and was on holiday in mid-June.
After more than a month of leave, school started in August and went on a break in mid-December.
It was already June. Shi Yu and the others had already finished their classes. There was only the final exam left.
The other students began to revise before the exam, afraid that they would fail. As for Shi Yu, he began to add points and forge his sword.
Shi Yu didn’t care about the exam results at all.
It wasn’t that he had perfectly mastered all the classes, but it was that he hadn’t learned any of them from the start… It was too late to work hard now.
He only learned knowledge that he was interested in and thought was useful, such as the special meditation technique left behind by Shi Di. Some nutritious lessons were directly ignored by Shi Yu.
As for whether he would fail his classes. It was a meaningless worry.
He was a representative student of Ancient Capital University, the image of Ancient Capital University, and the focus of public promotion. Would the teachers dare to make him unhappy?
At that time, if the genius archaeologist who cracked a certain ruin and discovered the Green Silkworm cocoon, Shi Yu, the Feeder, failed in three or four subjects… Ancient Capital University would also be embarrassed to publicize it.
Now, it was all about the ways of the world.
As long as he caused enough news, the exam pressure wouldn’t be able to catch up to him.
Of course, if other students dared to do this, there would definitely be an accident.
As Shi Yu began to cultivate in seclusion, news about Shi Yu was still fermenting in the outside world.
As the identity of the Beast Tamer of the Imaginary Butterfly was exposed along with the end of the Feeding Conference, the contents of the Feeding Conference were quickly announced.
Among them, what attracted the attention of the entire country’s Beast Tamers was the national-level strategic mission confirmed by the Feeding Conference.
The evolution path of the green cocoon developed by Ancient Capital University would be the main support project for the next decade.
The cultivation routes from transcendent races to monarch races were announced, and the country was undoubtedly shocked again.
Because the data clearly showed that the feed results are replicable and universal.
Those Beast Tamers who had attended school knew the potential value of this project the best. They couldn’t help but be shocked, as if they could see Dong Huang, who would become even stronger in the future.
As the main researcher of this Feeding Program, Shi Yu’s name once again swept through the country, allowing people to further understand this super genius with an overlord race pet in Ancient Capital University.
For a moment, Shi Yu’s limelight even exceeded the previous national champion, Gao Xuan, the Heavenly King Beast Tamer of the Master League, Zou Yun, and the others.
On the Internet, discussions regarding Shi Yu kept coming.
Some said that the results of this feeding could change Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain to a certain extent in the future.
Some also felt that, judging from the current research of the Crystal Thought Butterfly system, it was not suitable for all Beast Tamers at all. After all, everyone had different talents. Was it suitable for a Beast Tamer with fire-element strengthening talent to contract a spiritual-type Crystal Thought Butterfly? Before researching the evolution of the corresponding attributes, this project could only be said to be promising in the future.
Just as this group of people made a comment, they were directly spat back by various Beast Tamers with Beast Taming Talents.
Did these guys become a Beast Tamer? Did they earn their own money?
There were people who couldn’t even afford a pet! Now that a high-level pet is in front of them, they’d take it instead of complaining about attributes!
Moreover, the stamina of a Beast Tamer was limited. Even if they contracted several pets with corresponding attributes, could they strengthen all pets at the same time in battle?
Having an omnipotent spiritual pet as a support was simply the dream of all low-level Beast Tamers.
Perhaps in the eyes of Beast Tamers with pretty good conditions, Shi Yu’s fostering results had little to do with them, but in the eyes of those Beast Tamers who were just short of a knock on the door and had similar encounters with Shi Yu back then, Shi Yu was simply a second parent. It directly showed them the hope of becoming a professional Beast Tamer.
It was enough to have the Crystal Thought Butterfly as an initial pet. As long as he became a Beast Tamer and a professional Beast Tamer, he could choose any work to earn money. At that time, it wouldn’t be too much pressure to contract a pet that was more suitable for him.
In an instant, Shi Yu obtained the title of “Friend of the Commoners”.
At this time, the students of Imperial Capital University had the most complicated feelings. They originally thought that the news of Shi Yu sweeping through Imperial Capital University would be exposed by Ancient Capital University and attract attention, but Shi Yu had snatched his own trending topic. This was very exciting. In the Green Silkworm craze, no one cared about the things between the students.
The major feeding institutions smelled a business opportunity and began to nurture large numbers of Green Silkworms.
Some low-level Beast Tamers also captured the Green Silkworms in advance and prepared themselves.
There was also a group of people who established the Shiyu Divine Sect and called themselves believers. They were the first batch of Beast Tamers who went to be insect hunters after seeing Shi Yu’s Green Silkworm’s astonishing performance in the vocation assessment. Now that they realized that the Green Silkworm was becoming more and more popular, they simply praised their own intelligence.
Believe in Shi Yu and gain eternal life!
They would have a great future if they followed Shi Yu. They would contract whatever Shi Yu contracted. It was definitely not wrong.
It wasn’t like Shi Yu didn’t know about the changes in the outside world. Many news media outlets wanted to interview Shi Yu, but Shi Yu was really busy. In the next week, after Shi Yu decided to create a defensive weapon himself, he was abnormally busy.
How busy was he?
The top-notch spatial resource that Bureau 11 and the third bureau had sent to Shi Yu had a function similar to the Ethereal Spirit Stone. Shi Yu had no time to use treasures that could increase the level of the Beast Taming Space.
With this resource, Shi Yu had the guarantee of becoming a master-level Beast Tamer in a few
months.
However, at the moment, he was obsessed with adding points to Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
If Baby Ginseng could evolve, the feedback it would bring would definitely be more than cultivation. He had to do this first!
A week later.
Eleven’s deterrence skill had been taught to transcendent by Shi Yu, and Baby Ginseng had also learned mutation.
“Wu Wu Wu, wu wu wu.”
Shi Yu sat cross-legged on the bed while Eleven sat on Shi Yu’s thigh. As the level of the deterrence skill increased, Eleven’s eyes lit up with confidence.
“Wuu!!”
It was as if its entire body was wrapped in the aura of an overlord. Although it was only a potato-sized ball now, the domineering aura of a king couldn’t be hidden no matter what. Baby Ginseng, who was watching by the side, drooled. It was envious…
[Race Name]: Iron-eating Beast (Nine Li Battle Beast)
[Race Attributes]: Metal, Thunder
[Race Level]: High-level monarch (Quasi overlord)
[Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Race Skill]: Hardening (Dao Proficiency), Giant Transformation (Dao Proficiency), Electric Magnetic Floating (Dao Proficiency), Energy Storage Lightning (transcendent), Impregnable (Perfect), Inner Power (Initial)
[Taught Skill): Thunder Palm (transcendent), High Speed Healing (Perfect), Super Sight (Perfect), Deterrence (transcendent), Absolute Sleep (Perfect), Multiplication (Shrinking: Perfect. Enlarging: Dao Proficiency)
[Energy Points]: 11111
As the first deterrence skill in the team to reach perfection, Eleven was very confident.
It felt that the world belonged to it. The four seas were all under its command.
“Wuu!!” The Panda King rolled and roared. It rolled to the side of the pillow and enchanted the deterrence on the pillow.
In the next moment, a very intimidating pillow was born… If someone used this to fight a pillow battle, the champion would definitely be him.
“Yi…” Beside him, Baby Ginseng was starving.
Deterrence…
Eleven’s deterrence was already transcendent, and Buggy’s was also perfect. Moreover, it was dragon might. Only it…
Only it and Chi Tong didn’t pose a threat…
However, in Shi Yu’s words, if a supplement had deterrence, how was he to fish and bait other monsters?
Shi Yu was still hoping to use the ginseng baby to gather monsters in the undead battlefield in the future. After all, it was too slow to find one death spirit after another. It was better to let the ginseng baby stand there and release the sweet aura to let the undead take the initiative to gather. It would be best if it could attract monarch-level undead!
“Not bad.”
Now, as Eleven could wrap deterrence around external objects and even skills, Shi Yu smiled and revealed an excited expression.
He picked Eleven up and planned to get Buggy to make weapons together.
A moment later, in the dormitory courtyard.
Shi Yu and the four members of the team surrounded a stone table.
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong had serious expressions.
“Come, firstly, the Heart of the Sword is the whisker of the Ice Dragon!”
Shi Yu took out the Ice Dragon Whiskers and placed it on the table.
“Mi-!!” Chi Tong was very satisfied, as if its DNA had moved!!
Great, Ice Dragon Blade!
“Artifact spirit, use illusions!”
“Wu!!” Buggy was also long prepared. In an instant, the surrounding world turned blue. It activated the Imagination Domain and entered the Dragon State of Imagination. Although it was the body of a butterfly, it instantly obtained the comprehensive attributes of a divine dragon. Under the enhancement of this state, with the help of phantom illusions, the Ice Dragon Whiskers on the table slowly floated up.
With it as the core, a mini ice dragon phantom that was identical to the Ice Dragon Aunty on the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain condensed.
The expression of this ice dragon phantom turned from blank to agile. It was given an order by Buggy to serve Shi Yu as its master. All its power was mobilized by Shi Yu to protect Shi Yu from harm. In the next moment, after the dragon roar of the ice dragon phantom, it slowly changed shape and wrapped around the ice dragon’s whiskers, turning into a longsword phantom.
Shi Yu said, “Next is the first level of the sword. Baby Ginseng, go!”
“Yi!!” Shi Yu shouted. Baby Ginseng activated its Dao Proficiency Nutrition, Slow Healing, and Sweet Aura. Through the way it touched it, it wrapped the Ice Dragon Blade illusion in front of it in a layer of wood!
This was food for the Ice Dragon Phantom!
Nutrition could ensure the continuous absorption of natural life force from the outside world.
As for the Maximum Level Slow Healing, what was even more impressive than the Perfect Level High Speed Healing was that the plants that could be made by the ginseng baby had strong vitality. They could slowly heal themselves if they suffered any damage.
In other words, the wooden sword wrapped in the phantom of the Ice Dragon Blade was an endless supply of Sword Soul maintenance products that could automatically absorb the power of the outside world and automatically repair damage. As for the sweetness, it was an embellishment!
It could make a sword smell good.
After completing it, a wooden sword flowing with cold air appeared on the table.
“Next is the second sword body. Eleven, go!”
Under Shi Yu’s command, Eleven howled and condensed the hardening substance with all its might. A layer of hard black substance was wrapped around the wooden sword.
Hardening Bind, Sword Armor!
A moment later, a black sword replaced the wooden sword and appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Because the source of the sword’s power was the level-seven resource, the Ice Dragon Whiskers, the sword was still emitting cold air and extremely cold.
This was the effect he wanted. When the time came, it could cool the heat brought by Chi Tong’s possession.
The Ice Dragon General would revive in the Alliance again, but this time, it wouldn’t be Mu Huiyin, but him, Shi Yu!
“It’s the last step, Deterrence Entanglement.” Shi Yu smiled.
Soon, it was the last step of the forging. Eleven started to use the transcendent level deterrence that it had just mastered to wrap the deterrence power around its hardening substance!
Bang!
During the process of binding, dark blue lightning seemed to shoot out around the sword.
The dragon might of the Ice Dragon Whiskers, the dragon might of the Ice Dragon Phantom, and the deterrence that Eleven had wrapped around it. Under the three deterrence layers, the Ice Dragon Blade became the top-notch spiritual weapon. With this in hand, as long as it wasn’t a monarch-level deterrence, it couldn’t affect Shi Yu at all.
It could even be said that this sword alone could make monarch-level creatures wary.
Buzz!!
A moment later, as the Ice Dragon Blade hummed, and as Buggy communicated with the Ice Dragon Phantom inside to lead the Ice Dragon Blade, in an instant, the Ice Dragon Blade was frozen with a layer of blue frost. Apart from the black hilt, the entire sword body had already become ice-blue. The blade emitted a white light, making the sword’s appearance even better.
“Oh!”
Shi Yu looked at the Ice Dragon Blade in front of him, and his eyes lit up to the extreme.
“As expected of us.”
“Wu, wu, wu, wu!!”
“Wuu, wuu!”
“Yiya!!”
“Mi!!”
The four pets nodded.
Look, a level-seven divine sword had been directly forged by them.
If this sword was auctioned, who knew how much it could be sold for…
Shi Yu felt that with this in hand, even if he didn’t do possession with Chi Tong, ordinary commander rank pets wouldn’t be his match!!
As for after possession, the power of the Ice Dragon Flame Dragon, the Ice Dragon General, appeared again!
After everything was completed, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong also stared at the Ice Dragon Blade, curious about how powerful this divine sword that Shi Yu had instructed them to create was.
At this moment, Shi Yu slowly picked up the Ice Dragon Blade. At the moment of contact, he felt that he could almost perfectly mobilize the power of the sword.
After all, this sword was forged with the power of the three pets he contracted. If he, a Beast Tamer, couldn’t control it, no one could.
“Not bad…” Shi Yu shook his hand. The Ice Dragon Blade disappeared, and it was clearly sent to the ruins space.
The next moment, Shi Yu turned around and walked into the empty area. He stopped after taking a few steps and looked at a huge rock in front of him.
A shimmering spatial ripple appeared in front of his chest. Shi Yu stretched out his hand and directly reached into the ruins space. He slowly pulled it out in the air. In the next moment, with an astonishing cold aura, a blue divine sword was slowly pulled out of the alternate space and appeared in Shi Yu’s hand.
During this process, the ground around Shi Yu froze. Then, a strong deterrence sliced the frost into pieces, causing thin snow to circle around Shi Yu.
Under the dancing snow, Shi Yu raised the Ice Dragon Blade high.
“Basic attack!”
After Shi Yu finished reciting the name of the move, a terrifying frost sword aura wrapped around deterrence and directly crushed towards the huge rock, freezing it instantly. Then, with a boom, it turned into ice shards that flew into the sky.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu narrowed his eyes.
“I can do it!!!”
With this, he was confident of getting results in the martial arts conference!
“…” Eleven and the other four pets shook their heads. They looked at Shi Yu like a child who had yet to grow up.

chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chi Tong’s New Form
Translator: Atlas Studios | Editor: Atlas Studios
The next day.
Under the lead of a cat, the man, panda, butterfly, radish, and sword spirit left
Ancient Capital University.
Destination, Undead Battlefield.
The Undead Battlefield was a very dangerous place. Generally speaking, it was
definitely forbidden to be entered
If he wanted to enter, he had to go through the approval of relevant
departments such as the Beast Tamer Association and get the pass.
However, if they weren’t really short on money, most Beast Tamers wouldn’t
be so bored as to come here.
After all, there were plagues and curses everywhere inside. Even if they wanted
to fight monsters and earn money, this wasn’t the best choice.
Although the soul crystals dropped by the undead inside were very popular in
the ancient capital, they had to have the strength to pick them up.
At the moment, in the ancient capital, apart from the Beast Tamer Troops who
wanted to sweep the Undead Battlefield regularly, very few Beast ‘Tamers were
willing to come here to collect resources.
The Beast Tamer Association, the Beast Tamer Troops, and the Ancient Capital
University were all qualified to approve the Beast Tamer’s entry into the
Specter Battlefield. There were also some special departments that could enter
directly without the approval, such as members of Bureau 11.
Shi Yu naturally didn’t use Bureau 11’s identity to enter this time. Instead, he
used the training documents from Ancient Capital University and the gem cat.
The Beast Tamer Troops of Ancient Capital.
One of the in-charge, Xu Kai, who was a top-notch master, was handling
documents.
At this moment, a report came from the lower level.
“Reporting to Commander, a Beast Tamer witha special identity just entered
the Undead Battlefield. I think it’s necessary to report to you.”
Then, Xu Kai said, “Who is it?
“Shi. Shi Yu!”
The person who let shi Yu and the others pass this time happened to know Shi
Yu’s secret.
They were also present when Shi Yu obtained the recognition of General Mu
Huiyin.
It was also the batch of soldiers who had signed a contract to keep the secret.
“Oh, Shi..” Xu Kai suddenly got up.
“He went in himself?
Holy shit, shi Yu was a key protected target. He would definitely become a
legendary potential stock in the future. He couldn’t go to such a dangerous
place alone.
In the eyes of outsiders, the most impressive thing about Shi Yu was the
Butterfly of Imagination and the discovery of the Green Worm cocoon.
However, the small group of them kanew best that Shi Yu’s greatest potential
was that he had obtained the recognition of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit!
Who was Mu Huiyin? A fierce person who could even defeat totems. Ordinary
overlords were nothing in front of her.
“No, the guardian gem cat of Ancient Capital University brought it along”
“Emmm
Gem cat?
Xu Kai pondered for a moment. That was fine. That gem cat was older than his
grandmother. When his grandfather was still a soldier, that cat often went to
the Undead Battlefield to earn extra money. It was even more familiar with the
Undead Battlefield than their Beast Tamer Troops
However, he didn’t know if Ancient Capital University knew about this. After
thinking about it, Xu Kai still took the initiative to inform the principal.
Undead Battlefield.
A Psychic-controlled blanket floated in the low sky.
A big white cat was lying on it leisurely.
It seemed to be a clean freak and was unwilling to step on the ground of the
Undead Battlefield.
Shi Yu followed behind. Panda on his left shoulder, butterfly on his right
shoulder, baby ginseng in his pocket, and the little sword spirit on his chest.
With every step he took, the surrounding ominous aura seemed to be pushed
away.
At the moment, with the current level of plague and curse, shi Yu didn’t need
to wear anything else. Even if he didn’t wear the Flame Demon Armor, he could
rely on the aura of the little sword spirit to isolate it. After all, it was the
nemesis of undead. It burned the Sun Fire that undead were most afraid of.
Compared to when it was just borm, although it didn’t train much, it could
instinctively use its own abilities better.
“That’s all?
Not long after entering the Undead Battlefield, Shi Yu used the Ice Dragon
Blade to hack a bunch of Awakening-level skeleton soldiers.
It was purely a clash of blades.
The lce Dragon Blade collided with the skeleton soldier’s bone sword. The bone
Sword was immediately sliced apart like tofu, very weak.
This reminded Shi Yu of himself in the Ancient Capital University’s battle
training room, holding the bone sword and being crushed by his sparring
partner’s pet.
Lord, times have changed!
Pa!
Shi Yu casually killed another lanterm monster.
Shi Yu felt that he could defeat an opponent of this level with his bare hands
even if it was an transcendent-level one.
“Mi! Mi
Seeing howhappy Shi Yu was cutting enemies himself, Chi Tong was extremely
sad. It could only follow behind and pick up the soul crystals.
As it pícked it up, it burned it.
“An opponent of this level doesn’t need fusion tactics.”
Shi Yu comforted Little Chi Tong.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy immediately looked at him in disdain.
Nonsense, this guy just wanted to play by himself!
“Are you done playing, meow? The gem cat turned around and looked at Shi Yu
speechlessly.
He wanted to bully the skeleton soldiers by the roadside? That’s too much.
Killing them didn’t increase the Sword Spirit’s Spirit Release skill in the
slightest!
At the very least, only transcendent-level undead had the devouring value.
“I kind of want to try swinging this.” Shi Yu scratched his head in
embarrassment before inserting the lce Dragon Blade into the ruins space.
Eleven, Bugey, and Baby Ginseng showed expressions of “He clearly hasn’t had
enough fun”.
Then, let’s hurry.”
Shi Yu had gotten the big boss gem cat to lead the team this time firstly to see
the Undying Pond and secondly, to quickly farm Chi Tong’s skill experience.
With Shi Yu and the others themselves, it was not so easy to kill tens of
thousands of undead ina short period of time.
But with the overlord-level gem cat leading the team, it was easy.
“It should have been like this long ago -” The gem cat’s eyes shone. With an
Instant Transmission, it continued to bring Shi Yu and the others deeper.
In the blink of an eye, they arrived at a hilly area. At this moment, Shi Yu and
the others were floating in the air under the control of the gem cat’s Psychic
power. Because below, the continuous low hills were filled with cracks and
spider silk, like an abyss, filled with terrifying black aura. It didn’t look like
something ordinary pets and humans could come into contact with at all.
“This is the territory of the ‘Specter Spider, a group of undead pets. They
reproduce quickly and are one of the most common undead races in the
Undead Battlefield. Let’s farm this first and help the Beast Tamer Corps share
the pressure,” the gem cat suggested.
“Ill do it.”
“I can kill it all in an instant.” It revealed a ferocious gaze.
This was a dangerous place on the path to the Undying Pond.
A large number of Specter Spiders lived in the crack. The gem cat felt that it
was very suitable to increase its Spirit Release skill.
“Ah, this.. Let’s see Little Chi Tong’s devouring efficiency first,” Shi Yu said.
At this moment, his index had already opened, and it densely displayed the
positions of hundreds to thousands of undead living in the crack cave.
There were indeed a lot of them.
However, although there were many, it was indeed not difficult for the gem cat
to clean up. The problem was that Little Chi Tong’s devouring speed might not
necessarily be able to keep up with it if it was directly killed in one go.
If he couldn’t digest it and the soul aura dissipated, it would be too wasteful.
“Hmph, meaningless worry. Forget it, you guys can try.” The gem cat lay down.
“Well, there’s no need for Psychic power,” Shi Yu said to the gem cat.
The next moment, BugEY Conjureda soft sofa. The sofa floated in the air. Shi
Yu sat on it and looked down calmly.
“Lie here. It’s even softer here,” Shi Yu said.
“Lie here. It’s even softer here,” Shi Yu said.
These guys were really talented!
“Wuu.” Eleven took a look. In terms of tool pets, Eleven was willing to call
Buggy the strongest.
If it were Eleven, although it could also let Shi Yu sit in the air, it would
definitely be sitting on the electric magnetic levitation steel hardening sofa. It
was impossible for it to be as enjoyable as one made by Buggy.
Buggy: Wuu-
Too flattering
It was all thanks to Shi Yu’s nurturing
“Yil” At this moment, Baby Ginseng also started working. It stood on the sofa
and looked down before jumping down
Bang!
The next moment, Baby Ginseng landed on the ground itself. Like a smoke
bomb, it continued to release a large amount of sweet aura, and it organized
and orderly surged into the crack.
Sha! Sha! Sha!
Before long, ghost spiders came out of the crack. These ghost spiders were not
big, and each of them was only the size of a bowl, but their strength was not
weak. They were all transcendent-level. No wonder the gem cat brought them
here.
[Name]: Phantom Spider
LAttributes]: Undead, Poison
[Race Level]: Medium transcendent
[Race Skill: Spider Silk, Absorption, Soul Thorn
<Introduction> It likes to absorb the life force of humans and other pets the
most. The special spider thom has a fatal virus
Soon, more than ten Specter Spiders appeared. Their eyes were filled with dark
light. They felt the aura of the Soul Fruit on Baby Ginseng’s body and their
saliva slipped out of their mouths.
Sha! Sha! Sha!
In the next moment, the many Specter Spiders crawled crazily and attacked
Baby Ginseng together. Their mouths were wide open. It was time to eat!
“Tch.”
Seeing this, Baby Ginseng glanced at them in disdain and directly condensed a
peach wood sword made of solar energy and wood-element power.
With the peach wood sword in hand, the Daoist ginseng was just about to show
off its might and let them see the supplement that could attack people, but in
the next moment, the peach wood sword was snatched away by Little Chi
Tong, who flew over. Little Chi Tong directly possessed the peach wood sword,
and its battle power increased greatly.
Boom!!
In the sky, the flaming peach wood sword spun around, and the transparent
sword aura that filled the sky directly descended like a sword dance.
High-level skill, Soul Slash!
Under the llusion Sword Dance, almost in an instant, the Specter Spiders
surrounding it died. Their bodies were divided into two and stopped in midair.
Right on the heels of that, the body of the Specter Spider turned into
nothingnes. Soul crystals fell out of its body one after another. At the same
time, an even purer soul aura turned into a flame and floated towards Little Chi
Tong. Seeing this, Little Chi Tong revealed an excited expression. Its whole
body was filled with flames, and it directly swallowed more than ten
transcendent soul auras in one go.
After swallowing the soul aura, Little Chi Tong floated around.
“Mi! (Tl protect Baby Ginseng y
Below, Baby Ginseng was fuming. Protection?! This guy was like Shi Yu, it just
wanted to have fun itself
Pets really took after their beast tamers!
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng had just finished complaining when it suddenly looked at a
crack.
Boom!
An even larger Ghost Spider, about half the size of a person. It was more like
the evolution form of a Ghost Spider. It was more suitable for the appearance
of the Ghost Demon Spider.
[Name]: Ghost Demon Spider
[Attributes]: Undead, Poison
[Race Level]: Mid-level commander
Sha, Sha.”
After this Specter Demonic Spider discovered that its citizens’ spiritual
fluctuations had all disappeared, it immediately ran out in anger. This was a
commander rank undead. Its energy fluctuations were dozens of times larger
than those Specter Spiders.
It had originally come out full of anger, but when it saw Baby Ginseng, its face
immediately turned into that of a fool. After being stunned, it completely lost
its mind. It was like a mad dog that had seen meat after a month of hunger. Its
body bared its fangs and brandished its claws, charging at Baby Ginseng like an
alien.
“Eat, eat!” It opened its mouth and shouted.
“Yil Baby Ginseng crossed its arms and didn’t plan to fight with Chi Tong
anymore. As expected, before the Specter Demonic Spider could rush over,
Little Chi Tong, who had attached himself to Baby Ginseng’s peach wood
sword, directly slashed down with an interlocking sword.
Fire and wood were also conflicting powers. In an instant, a hot and fierce
Sword pressure turned into a wave that attacked like a tsunami, shocking the
Specter Demonic Spider that was charging at Baby Ginseng. When it recovered
and resisted, the fire sword pressure had already crushed its body.
Boom!
Even if its energy level was twice as high as Little Chi Tong’s, in front of its
super strength and Baby Ginseng’s peach wood sword, the Specter Demonic
Spider still burned to death without any resistance.
“Sha!!
In the flames, the painful voice of the Specter Demon Spider sounded. Little
Chi Tong was like an emotionless killing machine, excitedly swallowing the
soul aura of the guy it killed.
“Mi!!” Chi Tong swallowed another commander-level soul aura without any
pressure. It wanted more and urged Baby Ginseng to gather more monsters
faster.
Ginseng Baby: YoH
The team of a ginseng and a sword spirit seemed to like the feeling of law
enforcement.
Baby Ginseng liked to see the guy who wanted to eat it get killed, while Chi
Tong liked to kill spirits, it was a passion engraved in its soul.
“It seems.. its endurance is pretty good?”
Shi Yu touched his chin and sensed the changes in Chi Tong.
It swallowed more than ten transcendent soul auras in one go, together with a
commander-level soul aura, without any adverse effects.
“I told you. Ill just kill all the undead in one go. It’ll save time -I” The gem cat
also lay on the sofa and looked down.
“It might be difficult for other pets to withstand the level of the super skills
being forcefully raised, but it’s different.”
“Its predecessor is so powerful. Even if it changed its form of existence and
started over, its mental strength will naturally be extremely strong. It won’t be
affected by those soul auras,” the gem cat licked its claws and said lazily.
“Ive seen another undead who has mastered the Spirit Release. The method to
increase its Spirit Release might be worth learning for you.”
“Really? Shi Yu scratched his cheek.
“Well, in that case.” The gem cat looked down. In the next moment, its pupils
emitted a light that was like a sapphire. Its huge Psychic perception domain
instantly enveloped an area ten thousand meters away. Then, it suddenly
raised its head.
Swoosh!
Thousands of transcendent Phantom Spiders and many commander-level
Phantom Demon Spiders were directly pulled out of the cave by the Gem Cat’s
Psychic+Instant ‘Transmission.
A moment later, in the sky in front of Shi Yu and the others in this hilly area,
dense and black undead spiders were floating. They were all controlled by
Psychic power and had panicked expressions, not knowing what had happened.
“Wu!!
“Wuu!
Seeing this, Eleven and Buggy’s eyes lit up as they looked at the gem cat in
admiration.
So strong!
As expected of a super big boss with an energy value of tens of millions.
Below, Baby Ginseng and the little sword spirit also suddenly looked at the
Specter Spider hanging in the sky, momentarily at a loss.
Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched as he watched all of this. Was this cat going to wipe
out the entire family?
“Meow!” The light in the gem cat’s eyes dimmed. The Specter Spiders that filled
the sky were directly crushed by the Psychic power. With a boom, the Specter
Spiders exploded like fireworks one after another, and a sky full of soul aura
directly appeared.
Little Chi Tong was immediately extremely excited. He immediately activated
its absorption with all his might. In the next moment, its body was like a
flaming black hole, emitting endless gravity, attracting the soul aura that filled
the sky.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
The soul aura that filled the sky gathered crazily towards Chi Tong. As Chi
Tong absorbed it, its aura rose steadily. Baby Ginseng, Eleven, and Buggy were
stunned. They felt that its increase was even more ferocious than Shi Yu’s
points.
Was this the efficiency of a big boss leading a team to kill monsters and level
up:??
Soon, just as the gem cat said, Little Chi Tong still swallowed these soul auras
without any pressure. Moreover, perhaps because it had reached the standard,
after devouring it, the short sword-sized Little Chi Tong directly grew to a
normal length.
A red light flashed across the sword. It seemed to have grown from a young girl
to an older sister, and its aura was even greater.
However, this didn’t seem to be the end. After growing up.
A white light suddenly spread from Chi Tong, who had just finished devouring
the soul aura. This light was like the light of evolution.
Boom!
The white light interweaved with the huge flames that surged inside, causing
Chi Tong’s energy wave to increase again.
In the blink of an eye, Chi Tong’s energy level increased to nearly 20,0oo.
It still seemed to be transcendent, but its energy level was close to commander
rank.
Hu hu hu
Under the entanglement of the flames that filled the sky, a voice that stunned
Shi Yu and the others came from the inside of the flames.
Jiu
The voice was timid.
“Eh!!
“Wu?? “Yi?? “Wuu??
Under the stunned gazes of Shi Yu and the others, a small bird spirit the size of
a sparrow, covered in beautiful and smooth red flaming feathers, flew out of
the flames to replace the sword spirit.
Upon seeing this red bird spirit, Shi Yu instantly recalled the name of General
Mu Huiyin’s accompanying sword. Moreover, he could clearly sense what was
going on from Chi Tong.
The form of this bird spirit was the second form after Chi Tong’s Spirit Release.
At the proficient level of the Spirit Dissection, one could liberate the form of
the bird spirit. In the form of the bird spirit, one could obtaina physique that
absorbed the power of the sun to recover their physical fitness at a high speed.
Moreover, this physique could be inherited by the Beast Tamer through
possession.
At the same time, in this state, the Beast Tamer obtained the ability to fly.
“In that case, I can also recover my physical fitness with photosynthesis?” Shi
Yu was stunned.
Wasn’t this a form specially born to increase points!
At that time, the sword spirit would take over his body and fight, while the bird
spirit would take over the body to recuperate.
He could directly let Buggy materialize the sun. Under the dual-charge
treasure of Buggy and Ginseng Baby, the efficiency of points increase increased
in a straight line again
“No, the key is, who else can’t fly!”
Baby Ginseng: “?
“It turned into a bird?” At the side, the gem cat saw Little Chi Tong’s change
and shook its head. The Spirit Release skill was really strange. It didn’t know
what form it could release at the expert level. If nothing unexpected happened,
it wouldn’t be difficult for Shi Yu and the others to upgrade spirit release to the
expert level.
However, he definitely had to go deeper into the undead battlefield. Only then
would there be enough high-quality undead.
At the same time, the moment Little Chi Tong released the bird spirit form, at
the core of the Undead Battlefield, in the deepest underground.. A sealed
undead sensed the aura of its own race and slowly opened its eyes.

chapters.content:

Outside the Ancient Capital, the Undead Battlefield.
At the bottom of the deep and dark cave.
A creature that looked like a dark phoenix with black feathers covering its

This bloodline.”

It was overjoyed and chirped.
Great
It had a mouth.
In the future, it could eat the ice directly.

“Sigh

Bird spirit..

Or some armor spirit.

At this moment, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the gem cat’s gazes were all
attracted.
In the next moment, Shi Yu’s body began to turn blurry and hot. Red arcs of

Boom..
As energy surged, shi Yu turned into the form with red hair and eyes ina
moment.
Countless fire threads condensed, and a fierce spiritual aura that was like the

“From the looks of it, it’s no different from when the sword spirit possessed me

“But.”
Shi Yu tooka deep breath and his body slowly floated in the air.
Without wings, it was as if the body was not restrained by the gravity and could
