Under the envelopment of the flames, Shi Yu exerted strength all over his body
and instantly turned into a flame. He flew thousands of meters away at an
extremely fast speed!
Looking at Shi Yu’s disappearing figure, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng
smacked their lips.
Great, Shi Yu was becoming less and less human.
Moments later, Shi Yu turned around and flew back with extreme ease
The flying speed was extremely fast, and the flames were the accelerator of
ilight!
“It’s time to learm the Flying Sword Art.” Shi Yu clicked his tongue in wonder.
“But I feel that the sword techniques are still more handsome”
Shi Yu glanced at Baby Ginseng.
Alright, this time, he could fly too.
Well, Baby Ginseng was indeed a little miserable. He would teach it some skills
to counter flying opponents someday.
For example, earth-type skills, gravity?
Ginseng Baby: QAQ
It was too much.
This state looks very strong”
This was the first time the gem cat had seen the state of the Sword Spirit
Possession. It couldn’t help but showa praising expression.
Although Little Chi Tong was only at the transcendent level, after possessing
Shi Yu, the power produced by the resonance between the two parties far
exceeded that of ordinary commander ranks.
“Yeah.”
Shi Yu was also very satisfied with his current state.
At this moment, apart from his flying ability, he also sensed something
different.
Because of the bird spirit’s special physique, Shi Yu felt that his recovery ability
had increased again in this state.
The burden on him was much smaller.
In addition, his control over the power of possession had also become better.
It seemed.. that it could freely adjust its current power.
As Shi Yu tried it, the fire spiritual energy on his body slowly weakened and
gradually dissipated. Soon, there were no longer any energy fluctuations on Shi
Yu’s body. However, he was still red-haired and had red eyes. Moreover, he was
floating in the sky.
At this moment, Shi Yu was like an ordinary person with dyed hair and
beautiful eyes. He didn’t look as battle ready as before, but in fact, this was also
an illusion. It was just that Shi Yu had restrained his strength.
“I originally thought that only by perfecting or transcendent the possession
skill could I do this, but from the looks of it, the bird spirit’s possession state is
much gentler than the sword spirit’s.”
Shi Yu floated in the air and stretched out his hand. A fire sword spirit
condensed in his hand. Although it was possessed by a bird spirit, Chi Tong’s
two forms could be switched freely, so the current Shi Yu still had very strong
battle power.
In addition, if he didn’t fight, he felt that it shouldn’t be a problem for him to
maintain this state for a day.
In short, the functionality of possession had become stronger.
Fly one more round!”
Shi Yu seemed to be dissatisfied.
On the sofa.
The gem cat, Eleven, BugEy, and Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu, who couldn’t
bear to come down and was still flying around in the sky like a fly, and fell into
deep thought.
“Hey!!
The gem cat shouted helplessly and said, “Are you done playing?”
This was the second time it shouted.
It wasn’t the first time it had brought its students to the Undead Battlefield to
train, but in the past hundred years, Shi Yu was definitely the one who made
the cat most worried.
It was too easy to become obsessed with his own world..
“Ah ha.”
“Alright.”
In the sky, Shi Yu was pulled back by the gem cat’s mental strength.
He scratched his head in embarrasSment and slowly flew to their side.
“Well, let’s continue?
After Shi Yu laughed, his eyes lit up.
He was looking forward to Little Chi Tong’s next form.
At this rate, the Spirit Release would probably be at the expert level soon and
free the next form.
At that time, would there be any new changes to the possession skill
“Be more careful.” The gem cat shook its head and said, “You still have the final
exam in three days. We can’t stay here for too long.”
“Let’s go directly to the Undying Pond now. After I temporarily unseal that
place, the temptation enmitted by the Undying Pond should be greater than
Baby Ginseng. At that time, it should be able to attract many monarch-level
undead.”
It can definitely increase faster by directly killing a monarch-level undead”
The gem cat’s gaze was fierce. It was super fierce.
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. He was still worried that Little Chi Tong’s
appetite was too small and couldn’t take it.
However, the gem cat was eager to try.
What bad intentions did the cat have?
Instant Transmission was a good skill for traveling.
The Gem Cat’s Instant Transmission was even better than Buggy’s. Shi Yu and
the others flashed into a new place.
Without much time, or even sensing the situation outside, they arrived near
the Undying Pond.
The Undying Pond was located in a valley. Its surroundings were sealed by
transcendent spatial shackles. At first, it was set up by an overlord-level
spatial pet
There were no overlord-level undead in the Undead Battlefield at all, nor were
there undead who were proficient in spatial power. Therefore, this seal was
foolproof. It wouldn’t let wild undead accidentally obtain benefits from the
Undying Pond.
After that, the spatial seal was strengthened and strengthened several times.
This mission was done by the Beast Tamers native to the ancient capital.
The overlord gem cat that had mastered spatial skills was naturally among
them.
Therefore, it also contributed to this seal. It wasn’t bragging that it could bring
Shi Yu to the Undying Pond to take a look
“This is the place.”
In the sky above the Undying Pond, Shi Yu and the others appeared.
The gem cat looked down and said.
In the sky, through the transparent seal, they could clearly see the black pool
inside the seal.
Although he couldn’t see clearly what was going on inside the pool, from the
black ground near the pool and the spatial seal that had been corroded, this
was definitely not a good place,
“Yi-”
In Shi Yu’s pocket, Baby Ginseng’s expression was blurred.
Ginseng Baby: “(+-+)
It looked at the black pool and felt that it was very dangerous..
Baby Ginseng tugged at Shi Yu’s clothes.
Otherwise, our Moon Gem, Time Soil, and Time Mystic Realm would make do.
Forget about the Undying Pond.
If anything happened, who would create supplements in the future?
“True.” Shi Yu agreed abnormally quickly.
In any case, he was most concerned about the power ot time. The power ot
death didn’t matter.
Just like when he gave Buggy the opportunity to apply for a choice, Shi Yu also
gave Baby Ginseng enough choice.
Moreover, there were too many mutations. Shi Yu was also worried that Baby
Ginseng wouldn’t be able to take it.
He was just here to take a look.
“Yi??
Seeing that Shi Yu agreed so quickly, Baby Ginseng’s face turned bitter again.
Looking at the Undying Pond, it felt that it was a pity to miss it.
Ah, so conflicted.
“Yi!!
However, after thinking for a few seconds, Baby Ginseng decided to give it a
Iy.
It looked at Eleven and Buggy, who were watching the commotion on Shi Yu’s
shoulder.
It really didn’t have the confidence to become stronger than them with just the
Moon Gem, the soil of time, and the mystic realm of time.
The thought of being chased and nibbled by a bunch of totems in the owl’s
premonition made Baby Ginseng shiver.
Instead of being helpless at that time, it was better to give it a try now!
It had a transcendent mutated body, so there was no reason for it to be afraid!
Could this Undying Pond be stronger than the Fruit of Life
It could successfully eata level-eight resource mutation when it was at the
Awakening level. Now that it hada transcendent-level mutation, soaking in
the Undying Pond was not a problem.
After comforting itself and boosting his courage, Baby Ginseng made up its
mind to give it a try.
“Don’t be afraid, it’s just the Undying Pond”
The gem cat said indifferently.
It had mastered dozens of skills. Although it had only mastered a few
convenient ones, it was still easy for it to ensure that Shi Yu and the others
weren’t affected by the Undying Pond with its overlord-level protective power.
Baby Ginseng: Really?!
Keally!
The gem cat was confident.
“However..” Although it was confident that it could protect Shi Yu and the
others, did Shi Yu and the others plan to rely on the Undying Pond to let Baby
Ginseng mutate and evolve? Was it reliable?
The gem cat revealed a thoughtful expression. In the past hundred years, there
was only one successful case of the Ancient Tree of Life and Death.
“Why do I feel that you guys aren’t very reliable
It said suspiciously.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry” Shi Yu smiled and tricked it. “Don’t forget that Baby
Ginseng is a super genius who successfully mutated a level-eight resource at
the Awakening level. Its mutation level is naturally transcendent. No mutation
environment can stop it.”
The gem cat stared at him.
Soon, the gem cat opened a door on the seal of the Undying Pond. Under the
gem cat’s lead, shi Yu and the others easily arrived at the edge of the pool.
Before entering, the gem cat addeda layer of protection to Shi Yu and the
others, including Baby Ginseng.
This could ensure that Shi Yu and the others were not corroded by the death
power of the Undying Pond.
At this moment, as he approached the Undying Pond, shi Yu took a deep
breath.
He felt that transcendent-level mutants should still be trustworthy.
After all, it was a high-level skill. After all, he had triggered it to perfection
After matching the worm’s phantom illusion, the phantom image could even
borrow the power of a level-seven resource for itself. It shouldn’t be a problem
for Baby Ginseng’s mutation to successfully absorb the power of death.
Shi Yu said, “It can reduce the protective power on Baby Ginseng a little.”
“Alright.”
The gem cat nodded. At the same time, Baby Ginseng approached the pool
nervously.
As the gem cat reduced its protective power, Baby Ginseng immediately felt a
wave of death power invading its body, scaring it and immediately making it
take a step back
“Meow!” Seeing Baby Ginseng retreat, the gem cat quickly applied its protective
power on it
“Although your life force is very strong, your growth level is a little low,
meow.
The gem cat said, “Come, Ill help you cleanse the power of death again.”
It was’t impossible to replicate the miracle of the Ancient Tree of Life, but the
growth level of the ginseng baby seemed to be too low. Its life force wasn’t
enough to resist the death power here. This was the difficulty.
‘No.
“Yi”
Just as the gem cat finished speakingS, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng’s expressions
suddenly turned serious.
“Teacher Ying, please cancel the protective power.”
“Yi! (Cancel!)”
At this moment, Baby Ginseng sensed the situation in its body in shock.
After the death power corroded its body, its body seemed to have activated
immunity, directly storing the death power in a place that couldn’t affect its
body.
Skill: Mutant
< Introduction > It’s a wood-element skill. It can collect the power of mutation
through external stimulation. Whether it can perfectly absorb the power of
mutation to complete the racial mutation depends on the skill level and growth
level.
Skill Proficiency: Transcendent
In just an instant, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng determined that a
transcendent-level mutation perfectly countered the power of death here!
In other words, it was not impossible to use the power of death as a mutation.
“Yi!! (Mere death power, Teacher Ying, you’re looking downm on me.)” Baby
Ginseng suddenly became bold.
Let the gem cat continue to revoke its protective power.
“Yi (There’s a new life in death, a new dawn in despair. The power of death.. I’ll
conquer it for sure!)” Baby Ginseng shouted.
Eleven, Bugey:
Damn, it was sick again.
The gem cat:??
???
The gem cat was stunned, not understanding what had happened.
However, when it saw Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng suddenly so determined, it was
stunned for a moment before retracting a little of its protective power.
Baby Ginseng continued to take a small step forward without fear and sat
beside the pool. With a nervous expression, it placed its little feet deep ?nto the
Undying Pond.
In the next moment, endless death power surged into Baby Ginseng’s body.
“vi! (That’s all.)”
Baby Ginseng swelled up. It looked at the Undying Pond like it was soaking its
feet in water.
It felt that its body could still withstand it, could still withstand it..
Soon, Baby Ginseng hada strange feeling.
Although it didn’t feel that it had reached its limit, the death power
accumulated in its body had already given the ginseng baby a feeling. At the
moment, it could let this death power stimulate its body to mutate. Although
the direction of the mutation couldn’t be confirmed, it could indeed mutate.
Baby Ginseng’s expression was serious as it rejected the temptation.
It wanted to get it done in one go and mutate together ith various mutated
powers. Just the Undying Pond was not enough, not enough to make it
stronger.
“Yi! (Bam! Mutated Fruit!”
A moment later, in order to give the mutant enough space, in order to squeeze
as much energy from the Undying Pond as possible, Baby Ginseng had an idea.
“Yil” As Baby Ginseng endured the power of the Undying Pond, it eliminated
the mutated power it had absorbed from its body and condensed it in the
outside world, forming a mutated fruit containing the power of death.
Dao Proficiency Nutrition+transcendent mutant = Mutated Evolution Fruit!
It planned to eat it after its final evolution!
“Meow, meow, meow???* Seeing Baby Ginseng soaking its feet in the Undying
Pond, the gem cat was already shocked. After all, Baby Ginseng was only at the
commander rank.
Now, as it saw Baby Ginseng directly condense the power of the Undying Pond
into a Death Spirit Fruit, its eyes widened
How, how did it do it!
That worked?
It looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was also slightly stunned.
I already said that its mutation talent is very good. It’s not unscientific to
condense the mutation power into a mutation fruit.”
Shi Yu scratched his cheek. Mutated evolution fruit..
He felt that this thing should be quite precious.
After all, no matter what creature ate it, it could allow the other party to
undergo random mutation evolution like a gambler.
Of course, if the other party couldn’t adapt to the power of mutation, there was
probably a risk of the mutation failing and dying But in any case, it was also a
rare evolution resource
The money-making ability of the ginseng baby upgraded again with the
transcendent-level mutation.
Continue like this and create more mutated fruits.”
“We can’t use it all ourselves. It’s not bad to sell it.”
Shi Yu suggested.
Baby Ginseng’s expression was serious. Understood!
“How dare you! The gem cat glared.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng shuddered.
They almost forgot that this was the gem cat’s territory.
“Meow.” The gem cat licked its claws.
Just remember to give me half.”
It had eaten many delicious spiritual fruits that contained life force, but it had
really never tried spiritual fruits that contained death power.
It still believed in Baby Ginseng’s culinary skills.
It didn’t dare to drink the Undying Pond, but it wanted to try the spiritual fruit!
Yi-” Baby Ginseng covered its face.
It wasn’t that it didn’t want to give it to her.
Was it sure it won’t die immediately after eating it?
No matter how it thought about it, the Death Spirit Fruit was ike poison..
Only mutants dared to absorb it.
“It’s alright.” The gem cat yawned and said, “I have poisonous and death-type
moves. Don’t worry.”
“Poisonproof meow.”
As a mutated pet, the gem cat felt that Shi Yu and the others had
underestimated it.
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were speechless.
Strange cat!
“No..” Shi Yu was just about to say that there was no problem when the gem cat
suddenly exploded.
Its expression suddenly changed. It quickly looked around and sensed
countless huge auras approaching
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu had yet to notice the change in the gem cat when he
suddenly asked with a serious expression.
“Impossible.
At this moment, the gem cat was silent.
It didn’t understand. “The Undying Pond has just opened. It’s impossible for it
to attract the attention of so many undead so quickly.”
“Now, there are a large number of undead. One… wo.. thre… four… Just the
monarch-level undead might not be less than ten. They are approaching here
quickly.” The gem cat looked at Shi Yu.
Holy shit, more than ten undead monarchs?
Shi Yu revealed a shocked expression. “Then isn’t he an expert soon in Spirit
Release?
Eleven, BugEy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong were all shocked.
He was still thinking about Spirit Release? Damn, they have to run! There were

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - Gathering of the Undead Monarchs
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Gathering of the Undead Monarchs
Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
Upon hearing that there were more than ten monarchs, Eleven, Buggy, Baby
Ginseng, and the others… Had the first thought for everyone to quickly slip
away.
As for Shi Yu, he was thinking about expert level Spirit Release.
As for the gem cat, it was thinking about what was going on.
“Could it be the Death Spirit Fruit?”
The gem cat looked at the Death Spirit Fruit that Baby Ginseng had condensed
into the power of the Undying Pond through mutations and nutrients.
This Death Spirit Fruit should be considered a pseudo level-seven resource.
It wasn’t a friendly level-seven resource, but a level-seven ferocious plant.
Through the combination of Baby Ginseng, the Undying Pond becoming a
mutated evolution fruit that contained the power of life and death was indeed
extraordinary.
Perhaps this was the main factor that attracted these undead monarchs?
Was it really that tempting?
Because it wasn’t an undead, the gem cat really couldn’t feel it in its place.
Seeing the gem cat look at him, although Baby Ginseng was very afraid of the
undead Monarchs, it didn’t dare to stop.
It wanted to create as many mutated fruits as possible. It couldn’t waste them…
“What should we do?” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat.
“It’s not a big problem.” The gem cat raised its head and said, “It’s fine if it’s not
an overlord. If a monarch comes, I’ll kill one.’
The gem cat showed a fierce expression.
“It’s all money.”
“There are so many high-level soul crystals. Perhaps they can be sold for 100
million again.”
Shi Yu said, “As expected of you.”
“I have no choice.” The gem cat licked its claws and said, “It’s too difficult to
master transcendent-level skills. The training is so tiring and bitter. I just want
to fish and break through. I have to save money to buy legendary resources.”
“When you’re rich in the future, don’t forget me.”
It didn’t matter to the cat who brought Shi Yu to farm, but it refused to train
ten thousand times to let it increase its strength in life and death.
Shi Yu was at a loss whether to laugh or cry.
How could this cat be so lazy?
One way for an overlord to advance to the totem level was for the transcendent
racial skill to reach the transcendent level. Apart from that, there was another
way, which was to use strengthening level-nine legendary resources that
matched the racial attributes to strengthen oneself.
The former could break through to the totem level 100%, while relying on
resources, there was less than a tenth of a chance to break through to the
totem level.
The gem cat chose to spend money to break through!
However, this path was also a long one..
“You guys continue, I’ll repair the spatial seal first.”
With that said, its gem eyes lit up.
The huge hole in the spatial seal was sealed again.
“Wu!!!” Buggy expressed that it was familiar with this move. Wasn’t this
courting disaster?
Baby Ginseng’s face fell, and the speed at which it condensed the mutated fruit
slowed down a little.
“Wu!” Eleven glared at Buggy. This was clearly making them impregnable!
Baby Ginseng’s expression improved, and its efficiency returned to normal.
Eleven was indeed knowledgeable.
Boom!
As the gem cat repaired the seal, Shi Yu could also sense the terrifying aura
coming from all directions.
Boom!
The entire Undead Battlefield seemed to be covered in dark clouds, and the
ground trembled.
“Coming.”
The gem cat narrowed its eyes. Come on, come on.
It wanted the soul crystal to sell for money, and Shi Yu and the others wanted
the soul aura to evolve. This was a reasonable distribution!
As soon as the gem cat finished speaking, the first undead monarch that
arrived near the Undying Pond appeared.
It flew in the air. It was huge and had a body that looked like a Western dragon.
Its entire body was made of bones, and its interior was filled with a green
light. It was surprisingly the bone dragon of a quasi overlord race.
At the same time, a human-shaped skeleton wrapped in a black rag and
holding a bone staff slowly walked over in the air. It looked inside the spatial
seal. This time, it was the Black Spirit Great Daoist Master of a high -level
monarch race.
On the ground, there was also a Death Knight riding a skeleton war horse and
holding a bone sword. The ground was also torn apart. The huge Dark
Centipede King dragged its body that was dozens of meters long and stared at
Shi Yu like a tall building.
Bone Dragon King, Black Spirit Great Daoist Master, Death Knight, Dark Death
Centipede King, Soul Devouring Spider Queen, Ice Spirit Lady, Thousand Eyed
Tree, Phoenix Fire, Undying Demon Cat, Nine-Tailed Spirit Fox…
They were all famous undead in the undead battlefield!
Because of the threat of the Undead Battlefield, the association would regularly
clean up the undead.
However, even after cleaning up, there were still many undead monarchs.
These undead monarchs were all outstanding among their peers. They were
abnormally cunning and difficult to deal with. If they wanted to hide, some
could even hide in alternate spaces. Even legendary Beast Tamers would find it
difficult to find their traces.
At this moment, as the most terrifying batch of undead monarchs in the
undead battlefield appeared, the gem cat’s eyes lit up.
“I’ve searched so hard for you guys previously.”
“You guys actually delivered yourselves to my door this time.”
Damn it.
It suddenly remembered something.
The Beast Tamer Association of the ancient capital had always wanted these
undead monarchs.
After killing them, it could still get another bounty.
At this moment, as more than ten undead monarchs appeared, a huge
commander-level undead army followed closely behind. Seeing this scene,
Baby Ginseng’s legs went weak as it created mutated fruits…
Shi Yu’s breathing also froze.
All of them were at the monarch level. Generally speaking, the monarch level
cultivated by the master-level elite students of the Imperial Capital and Demon
Capital University were still in the development stage. Their energy value
didn’t exceed 1.5 million, but the ones in front of them were basically close to 2
million. There were even a few that exceeded this number and reached the
normal energy standard of the overlord race!
The skill proficiency was probably very high. After all, they had lived for god
knows how long. It wasn’t something that the monarchs cultivated by the
students could compare to.
“That’s all.”
The sky darkened as he sensed the oppressive atmosphere. Although he was
protected by the spatial seal, Shi Yu still couldn’t help but hide behind the gem
cat. Wait… Something was wrong. It seemed like there were undead monarchs
everyvvhere?
Shi Yu’s expression darkened.
At this moment, he suddenly realized that there was something wrong with the
gem cat’s state.
“Shi Yu…
“It seems, something’s wrong.”
At this moment, the gem cat’s eyes were filled with seriousness. Just now, it
sensed a large number of monarch undead coming over, but now, after sensing
the state of these undead monarchs at a close distance, it suddenly discovered
a big problem.
“What’s wrong?
“Didn’t you realize that the reason why they didn’t attack wasn’t because of the
spatial seal, but because… their current state is in a controlled state??” The gem
cat’s gaze was solemn to the extreme. It put away its contempt just now and
had a bad feeling.
It couldn’t be that unlucky, right…
What could control these undead monarchs at the same time…
Its words directly shocked Shi Yu and the others.
“If only a new Undying overlord was born in the Undead Battlefield and united
them, that would be nothing, but if it’s…” The gem cat suddenly thought of the
Undying Dark Phoenix underground. If it was related to it, then the problem
was huge!
In an instant, the gem cat seemed to be facing a great enemy. Just as the
deterrence was about to disperse, a scene that shocked the cat and Shi Yu
occurred.
Countless undead monarchs made a submissive posture and aimed at Shi Yu,
who was in a possession state.
Gem Cat, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong: Meow, meow, meow?
Shocking Shi Yu for a hundred years… What was going on!

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - Awakening of the Phoenix Bloodline
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Awakening of the Phoenix Bloodline
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Undead monarchs submitted.
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others were completely speechless.
‘The gem cat was also stunned on the spot.
They looked at the many Undead Monarchs who had submitted and the similarly shocked Shi Yu in a daze.
What the hell.
‘The gem cat had thought of many possibilities, but it never expected that the Undead Monarch would submit to Shi Yu after coming together.
“You, you, you…”
‘The gem cat waved its claws around and stared at Shi Yu, imagining things.
Could it be.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “I’ll lay my cards on the table.”
‘The gem cat shuddered.
“Tve laid my cards on the table. I don’t know what’s going on either!”
The gem cat :”…”
At this moment, Shi Yu felt guilty to be subjugated by a bunch of undead.
A bunch of criminals ran over to call him boss. Anyone would be stunned.
“Meow.”
The gem cat’s gaze flickered.
‘The gem cat, who had originally wanted to attack, didn’t know what to do now.
So what exactly was going on?
Only Baby Ginseng didn’t move and continued to draw the energy of the Undying Pond.
Soon, soon.
At this moment, among many undead monarchs, a ball of three-colored flames that looked like a phoenix suddenly changed.
< Name > Phoenix Fire
[Attributes]: Undead, Fire
[Race Level]: High Class Monarch
< Introduction > It’s a spirit formed by the Phoenix’s flames.
Under its transformation, it gradually turned into a beautiful woman in a black dress with a noble aura.
It frowned and muttered to itself. Then, it looked at Shi Yu and the others.
“This body… I’m not used to it.”
“But it can barely be used for speaking.”
After the aura of the Phoenix Fire changed, the dark aura spread, as if some other creature had seized control of its body.
After it appeared, the other undead monarchs crawled even deeper, their gazes even more afraid.
Sensing the change in the Phoenix Fire, the gem cat’s expression suddenly changed drastically.
Because this aura was too similar to the aura of the Undying Dark Phoenix sealed under the Undead Battlefield.
“Undying Dark Phoenix?” The gem cat spoke in surprise and broke out in cold sweat.
Although it sensed that the other party still had the strength of a monarch, its mind was taut to the extreme at this moment.
It was already 120% focused and prepared to escape with Shi Yu at any time.
“Eh?” The humanoid woman formed by the Phoenix Fire looked at the gem cat in surprise and said, “You recognize it?”
‘Wu Wu!
As the Undying Dark Phoenix finished speaking, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others were immediately stunned. Tears flickered.
Damn, gem cat, you jinx.
Who was the one who said that as long as the Undying Dark Phoenix didn’t break the seal, the Undead Battlefield was very safe?
In the end, it really broke… How?
Monarchs could be dealt with easily, and overlords weren’t too much either, but totems, how could they deal with this!
‘The gem cat’s expression was also a little bad. It felt that Shi Yu was a disaster-bringer. It really gave the cat a headache.
This guy was clearly here for Shi Yu.
Being stared at by the human form of the Undying Dark Phoenix, Shi Yu and the others didn’t dare to act rashly, even if the other party’s human form was very beautiful.
“Long time no see.”
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix ignored the gem cat and looked at Shi Yu seriously.
“My daughter.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Everyone:
“Meow?”
“Huh?” “Huh?” “vi?”
“Huh?”
As the Undying Dark Phoenix finished speaking, it was as if it had thrown a nuclear bomb at the scene.
The heavy atmosphere was instantly destroyed.
Everyone present was stunned.
The gem cat, Eleven, Buggy, and even Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu in shock.
Holy shit.
What was going on?
Daughter?
Shi Yu was also a little stunned, but he quickly reacted.
‘The other party wasn’t talking about him at all.
“Chi Tong?” Shi Yu asked in confusion.
“Jiu?”
In the next moment, Little Chi Tong left Shi Yu and flew out in the form of a bird spirit.
Shi Yu quickly recovered his black hair and eyes.
‘As expected, the Undying Dark Phoenix and the group of undead monarchs looked at Chi Tong.
‘The daughter the Undying Dark Phoenix mentioned was Chi Tong!
At this moment, when it saw Chi Tong, the Undying Dark Phoenix directly smiled.
“although the form is a little strange, it seems to have really been preserved.”
“But from the looks of it, she seems to have completely forgotten her identity.”
“Stop pretending…”
At this moment, the gem cat narrowed its eyes. Psychic power had already enveloped all the undead monarchs.
It had already calmed down.
Although the development of the plot was a little strange, it didn’t forget the identity of this group of undead monarchs.
‘They were all participants in the undead siege and were proper ferocious spirits.
‘As the source of the Ancient Capital’s Undead Battlefield, how could the Undying Dark Phoenix be Little Chi Tong’s mother? This was very ridiculous, alright?
All kinds of records showed that the Undying Dark Phoenix was a big boss-level ferocious spirit that had triggered multiple undead disasters.
It could tell that the Undying Dark Phoenix’s consciousness had only temporarily taken over the body of the Phoenix Fire. Its strength was still at the monarch level, and its main body was probably still sealed and not worth mentioning.
It could also be crushed.
Boom!!!
‘The Gem Cat’s deterrence erupted, but in the next moment, Shi Yu hurriedly said, “Wait, wait.”
Because he suddenly recalled the prophecy of the owl.
He had asked the owl about Chi Tong’s bloodline.
‘The other party predicted the scene of Chi Tong splitting open the Undying Dark Phoenix’s seal.
Holy shit, it couldn’t really be related, right?
“There’s something you should know…”
Shi Yu instantly conveyed what had happened in the capital to the gem cat through telepathy, stunning it.
Meow, meow, meow?
‘The gem cat widened its eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
No matter how it looked at it, this looked like a scam, but this guy was saying that it might be true?
Could that owl be trusted?
shi Yu:”…”
Did the bad reputation of the Prediction Owl spread to the gem cat?
At this moment, things were extremely strange.
For a moment, Shi Yu didn’t know what to do.
“Do you have any evidence?”
He could only look at the Undying Dark Phoenix and ask.
In the face of this question, the beautiful woman in human form formed by the Undying Dark Phoenix’s Phoenix Fire still smiled.
“Not only you, even I’m very surprised.”
“You need evidence. Coincidentally, I also need to verify its bloodline power.”
‘There was too much information, making the gem cat, Shi Yu, and the others a little stunned.
Before Shi Yu and the others could react, black flames burned in the Undying Dark Phoenix’s eyes.
In the next moment, the bodies of the dozen or so undead monarchs and commander-level undead present were lit up by black flames, and they suddenly let out painful wails.
Bone Dragon King, Black Spirit Great Daoist Master, Death Knight, Dark Death Centipede King, Soul Devouring Spider Queen, Ice Spirit Lady, Thousand Eyed Tree, Nine-Tailed Spirit Fox… One undead monarch after another lost their lives almost instantly.
“Oooh—”
In the blink of an eye, these undead monarchs that wreaked havoc in the undead battlefield were killed by the black flames in unison and turned into dust.
Seeing this scene, the expressions of Shi Yu and the others changed, revealing looks of disbelief.
What was it doing?
Summoning a bunch of undead just to kill them?
“aren’t they your subordinates?” Shi Yu immediately asked.
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix: “It’s just undead born from the plague and curse that’s around me. They can’t be considered subordinates, just a group of ferocious spirits.”
“It’s their fortune to be able to become nutrients.”
This person had no right to call them ferocious spirits!!!
Shi Yu and the others wanted to complain.
‘The gem cat’s expression was also filled with confusion, but in the next moment, it seemed to understand the other party’s intention.
Boom!
After these undead were killed, soul aura surged into the sky and filled the entire sky.
Then, countless soul auras floated into the space.
It actually directly penetrated the spatial seal and wrapped around Little Chi Tong.
“Jiu??”
Little Chi Tong was stunned. It sensed the tempting aura of the soul aura and wanted to eat it very much, but it was at a loss.
Shi Yu had taught it not to attack and eat without orders.
At this moment, the Undying Dark Phoenix said,
“Aren’t you guys hunting undead to help it free its strength?”
“Tl help you.”
“If you don’t absorb it soon, it’ll be wasted.”
“After unsealing its power, its bloodline will awaken and become a phoenix spirit. This is the best evidence.”
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t know what to do, so he looked at the gem cat.
‘The gem cat’s expression was serious. “There’s nothing wrong with the soul aura…”
Shi Yu nodded. “Chi Tong.”
“Jiu!!” After obtaining the Beast Tamer’s permission, Little Chi Tong’s eyes lit up. He activated the Spirit Release and absorbed the soul aura wrapped around him.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, Little Chi Tong’s body emitted the light of the sun. Its body seemed to have turned into a fire vortex, erupting with a huge gravity, absorbing the soul aura that filled the sky into his body.
The flames obliterated the soul aura and turned into nutrients for its own growth.
During this process, Little Chi Tong’s aura gradually strengthened.
Amoment later, its body erupted with a soaring fire light. Its growth level directly broke through to commander rank.
Red flames, gray soul aura, and white advanced light intertwined. Soon, the soul aura produced by the deaths of many undead was completely absorbed by Little Chi Tong.
At this moment, its body underwent another huge change!
In the center of the flames, an orange-red light slowly burned.
“Jiu!!!”
With a high cry, all the flames began to retract inward. The flames swept up with a shocking phoenix might, and the orange flames that shot into the sky instantly filled the sky.
At this moment, not only did a huge flame shoot into the sky, but a loud phoenix cry also erupted.
‘The dazzling flames cut through the dark clouds like a sun, almost illuminating the entire Undying Pond. Soon, as the evolution flames gradually faded, a huge figure appeared.
Ahuge fiery red bird flew in the flames in mid-air. Its dazzling orange-red tail feathers were long. It had a perfect body shape, a crown-like feather crown on its head, dazzling feathers, shining wings, colorful appearance, and pleasant cry. All of them displayed the majesty of the king of birds.
It was the new form released after Chi Tong’s Spirit Release reached expert level, the Phoenix Spirit mentioned by the Undying Dark Phoenix.
Seeing this scene, the Undying Dark Phoenix showed an “as expected” expression.
At this moment, as the phoenix spirit appeared, the index data in front of Shi Yu also began to change crazily.
[Energy Points]: 140089
After liberating its new form and breaking through to commander rank, Little Chi Tong’s energy attribute immediately matched the Butterfly of Imagination.
‘The huge deterrence stunned Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets.
Damn.
They looked at the wind spirit in the sky and were extremely shocked. This was Little Chi Tong??
Why did the energy wave suddenly become so terrifying?
Buggy immediately cried. It felt that the time for the Shi Yu tournament would come soon.
This wave was an epic strengthening of Chi Tong? No! It was an Epic Strengthening of Shi Yu!
At this moment, what concerned Shi Yu the most was not the new form released after Little Chi Tong’s Spirit Release reached the expert level, but that it had brought some new abilities during the breakthrough and liberation process.
[Race Name]: Spirit: Chi Tong
[Race Attributes]: Undead, Fire
{Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
{Level of Growth]: Commander Level
{Race Skill]: Advanced: Light Flame Sword (Proficient), Possession (Expert), Soul Slaying (Proficient), Deterrence (Initial-level Phoenix Might, has a strong commanding and deterrence effect on birds and undead)
Super level: Sun Flame (Initiate), Spirit Release (Expert), Interlocking Sword (Initiate)
After breaking through, Little Chi Tong awakened deterrence, and it was a deterrence unique to the Phoenix Race that was not inferior to dragon might. It could command hundreds of birds.
Apart from that, the Phoenix Spirit had the flames of regeneration. As long as it didn’t die, all the damage it suffered with the target it possessed could be healed through the flames of regeneration. The healing effect depended on the level of the Spirit Release.
If the bird spirit form gave Chi Tong the racial ability to recover its physical strength with the power of the sun, then the phoenix spirit form gave it the special ability to recover from its injuries with the power of the sun!

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - Undying Dark Phoenix Enraged
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Undying Dark Phoenix Enraged
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“As expected of my bloodline.”
It looked at Little Chi Tong quietly and smiled warmly.
At this moment, seeing that Chi Tong had really become a phoenix, the corners of the gem cat’s mouth twitched crazily.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets were also extremely shocked. So, was it really Chi Tong’s mother?
“What evidence is this?”
Shi Yu’s eyelids twitched. This only meant that Chi Tong had the Phoenix bloodline. He had known from the start.
However, he had successfully advanced his soul aura for free. It was really fragrant.
After those undead monarchs submitted, Shi Yu almost thought that he couldn’t cut them anymore. Now that he had successfully absorbed them, it was very comfortable.
Speaking of which, if the Undying Dark Phoenix was really related to Chi Tong, wouldn’t it be impossible for it to be able to kill the Dark Phoenix and advance in the future?
“ju”
Just as everyone’s expressions were extremely silent, only Little Chi Tong was unmoved.
It turned from an extremely gorgeous phoenix spirit form to a small bird spirit form. After eating until it was full, it quietly landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder and didn’t think much of it from the start.
It didn’t care so much. It only recognized Shi Yu.
It only had one relative, Shi Yu.
This was the speciality of a heroic spirit. Once it recognized its master, it would never betray it.
“Jiu?”
At this moment, although he had already believed a little of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s words because of the owl’s prophecy, Shi Yu suddenly calmed down as Chi Tong landed on his shoulder.
Because even if everything was real, so what? Even General Mu Huiyin seemed to have never acknowledged her bloodline.
Instead, she hated her bloodline very much.
Shi Yu slowly raised his head. After taking the soul aura, he said stubbornly, “This doesn’t prove anything at all. Your strength is completely different.”
“Its power is pure Sun Flame. Even in its undead form, its power hasn’t changed.”
“and you have plague and curses on you. It’s pure dark power.”
“What’s your goal?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Little Chi Tong leaned closer to Shi Yu, causing the Undying Dark Phoenix to frown and reveal a displeased expression.
But soon, it was relieved.
“Since you don’t believe me, I’ll reveal more information.”
A dark light flashed in the Undying Dark Phoenix’s eyes.
“In ancient times, humans were divided into pure-blood humans and mixed-blood humans. The mixed-blood humans were a group of humans who had obtained the bloodline of the different races. They had a common characteristic, which was that their talent potential was outstanding, and they even
surpassed the pure-blood humans. Their talent was the forte of the two races.”
“Among them, the most typical is humans and dragons.”
“More than two thousand years ago, the development of the Phoenix Race fell into a certain bottleneck. A voice appeared in the Phoenix Race, giving the power of the bloodline to some humans with suitable physiques and relying on humans with the Phoenix bloodline to break this bottleneck.”
“However, because the growth of hybrids requires too many resources and the Phoenix Race has many members who pursue the purity of their bloodline, two factions have been divided in the race.”
“One side supports the hybrid human plan, and the other is determined to oppose humans sharing the resources of the Phoenix Race.”
“Among them, it was born at that time. I gave it the Phoenix bloodline, and it’s my real daughter.”
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Little Chi Tong and smiled. With this look, Little Chi Tong’s bloodline power surged and actually resonated a little.
“Unfortunately, not long after the hybrid plan started, the two factions had a conflict due to resources. There was internal strife among the Phoenix Race, and many hybrids were eliminated by the pureblood. At that time, in order to ensure its safety, I hid her in the human world.”
“When the internal strife of the Phoenix Race ended, I went to look for it. It had already disappeared and was suspected to be dead… Now that it can revive in its undead form, it’s really beyond my expectations. It’s surprising.”
Shi Yu fell silent on the spot.
It seemed… matching?
That initial hybrid was General Mu Huiyin.
As for why the bloodline disappeared, it was because a portion of the bloodline power was separated from Mu Huiyin after she grew up and became the current Little Chi Tong.
“Don’t believe it easily.” Seeing Shi Yu’s expression change slightly, the gem cat beside him reminded Shi Yu.
‘There was something wrong with this guy. It had to believe its instincts as a female cat.
“I know…” Shi Yu still had many questions.
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix was a top-notch totem of the undead and dark elements, while Mu Huiyin and Little Chi Tong both had phoenix bloodlines that had the power of the sun.
The strength system was completely unrelated.
The Undying Dark Phoenix said, “As for the power system, it’s because I’ve fallen once. Our predecessor was the race closest to the divine level in the Phoenix Race, the Sun God Phoenix. After an accidental death, I revived in the world as the Undying Dark Phoenix.”
“This is my second body. Just like how it became an undead, I also became an undead.”
“Accidental death? According to what I know, the Undying Dark Phoenix was the one who experienced the internal strife of the Phoenix Race during the era of the empress dynasty.”
“Because the power was too evil, it was sealed here by the empress.”
Shi Yu stared at the Undying Dark Phoenix intently. Becoming an undead still couldn’t explain the power attribute.
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix smiled. “The empress you’re talking about…”
“It means my other daughter, its sister.”
Shi Yu, the Gem Cat, and the pets:???
Chi Tong:??
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix said, “After the first internal strife of the Phoenix Race, the power of the hybrid sect gained the upper hand. The hybrid plan was activated again and obtained unprecedented success. Its sister grew into the human empress at that time. However, at this moment, the few
purebloods colluded with the foreign races and launched internal strife again. I was poisoned and cursed to become what I am now.”
“In the cursed state, because I couldn’t control my power, because I would subconsciously release plagues and curses to accelerate the birth of undead, I took the initiative to ask the empress you mentioned to seal me. I planned to accept purification after she resolved the internal strife and totems.”
“But unfortunately, I couldn’t wait for her to successfully resolve the internal strife. The Phoenix Race was also on the verge of destruction due to the internal strife and external enemies. The world was in chaos, and she also disappeared.”
“Then in the future, in order to suppress the curse, I slept here.”
“This time, I only woke up for a short period of time because I sensed a similar bloodline power. I could only talk to you through my consciousness possessing the undead.”
‘The gem cat opened its mouth wide.
Although it reminded Shi Yu not to believe it easily, it didn’t expect that the story could develop in an even more ridiculous direction.
The human empress had become this little sword spirit’s sister?
Damn it, the Undying Dark Phoenix was full of nonsense.
Shi Yu’s expression was also very confused.
Shi Yu said, “So, what’s your goal?”
“Tm just meeting my bloodline, plus…”
“Lwant you to release me from the seal. Her seal can only be unsealed by the Sun God Fire, which is also the transcendent Sun Flame you mentioned. At the moment, it’s the only one with this bloodline aptitude.”
The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Chi Tong.
Upon hearing that it wanted to break the seal, Shi Yu wanted to refuse on the spot.
Even if what the Undying Dark Phoenix said was true, it couldn’t be unsealed casually.
The Undying Dark Phoenix had also said that it had the plague and curse. It was the source of all the undead in the Undead Battlefield. Its power would go berserk at all times. In this situation, who dared to unseal it?
However, when they heard the Undying Dark Phoenix say that only transcendent-level super skills could unseal it, Shi Yu and the others were stunned again.
What did the other party mean? Did it want them to unseal it in the future?
‘The current Little Chi Tong didn’t have that strength.
The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and Chi Tong. “No matter what, it was born because of me.”
“You’re currently in a contract with it. I don’t reject this relationship. It’s naturally best if you’re willing to help it grow.”
“When its Sun Flame reaches a certain level, not only can it break my seal, but it can also cleanse the curse and plague on my body. I hope you can return here after you grow up.”
“Of course, from the looks of it, it doesn’t seem to acknowledge me as a mother. But it doesn’t matter. Whether you accept it or not, I’ll help you grow quickly. No matter what, she’s my daughter, my bloodline.”
“Tonce opened a mystic realm. A large amount of resources I collected are stored there. Apart from legendary-level resources, there’s also a divine-level resource that can be used for your growth and easily help you break through to the totem level. Only people with the power of my bloodline can
successfully open that mystic realm. From now on, all the treasures there are yours.”
“Tl tell you the location of that mystic realm.”
At this moment, when it heard the Undying Dark Phoenix’s words, the gem cat’s eyes lit up.
Divine-level resources.
Shi Yu’s eyes also lit up. “Mom!”
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix:??
The gem cat:??
Eleven, Buggy, Ginseng Baby:???
Chi Tong: “?”
Shi Yu said, “…I was just kidding. Continue.”
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix nodded and released flames to weave a huge map in the sky. The style of this map looked to be from Emperor Shi’s era, but Shi Yu was knowledgeable and recognized it.
At this moment, when he saw the coordinates, Shi Yu thought carefully and was stunned.
‘This was no longer within Dong Huang. From the looks of it, it didn’t seem to be the totem area either.
From the current geographical location, the mystic realm opened by the Undying Dark Phoenix was located in the seven neighboring islands, one of the seven islands.
Among the seven countries, Dong Huang, Rongguang, the seven islands, Shen Feng, Ming Hua, Tingxiang, and Xue Yuan, the seven islands were the closest to Dong Huang.
“After approaching that place, due to the connection of the bloodline power, you will naturally sense the entrance of the mystic realm.”
The beautiful woman that the Undying Dark Phoenix turned into smiled and said, “Not only that, I also know many Phoenix Race mystic realms and Kingdom mystic realms of the Empress Dynasty. These are all resources prepared for us to lead to the divine path, but the opening method isn’t that simple.
After you rescue me, I’ll bring you to search. From the current situation, there aren’t many members of the Phoenix Race left. The hope of reviving the Phoenix Race can only be relied on us.”
Shi Yu and the gem cat nodded crazily. Alright, Mom.
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix was tired. It didn’t seem to be useful for her to play the family card. Material benefits were the way to go.
It didn’t know if it could deceive this group of people in front of it.X
However, regardless of whether it could deceive them or not, it was already a good thing that its consciousness had awakened this time.
After all the instructions were completed, the expression of the human figure that the Phoenix had turned into changed slightly.
“That’s all I want to say. Because of this awakening, my strength might go berserk for a period of time. A large amount of plague and curse power will leak out and affect the outside world. Many new undead will be born in the Undead Battlefield, and many undead will advance. It’s best if you leave here
now.”
“And in advance, prepare to face the undead riot.”
With that said, black mist lingered around its body. A large amount of energy swelled in its body, as if it was about to self-destruct. Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu and the gem cat were stunned on the spot.
“Holy shit.”
Did it have to be so sudden?
“Run.” At this moment, the gem cat also sensed the huge energy rolling in the earth vein. Its expression couldn’t help but change. Ignoring whether Baby Ginseng had finished absorbing the energy of the Undying Pond, it directly enveloped Shi Yu and the others with its mental strength and used Instant
Transmission to leave quickly.
Boom!!!
Shi Yu and the others had just teleported away when the Phoenix Fire self-destructed. A large amount of plagues, viruses, and curses surged out of its body. The ground here directly cracked, emitting a rich black light that constantly spread out.
Sensing the plague and curse power coming from behind, the gem cat kept accelerating with a stunned expression.
Damn, what was going on today?
If it had known, he wouldn’t have come to the Undead Battlefield with Shi Yu.
ahhh, slow down.”
‘As the gem cat’s escape speed was too fast, Shi Yu immediately couldn’t take it and felt a little carsick.
“Can you not run faster? It’s the power of a totem-level curse!!”
“Also, do you believe its words?”
“Believe my ass,” Shi Yu said directly.
‘The Undying Dark Phoenix was Chi Tong and the empress’s mother?
No matter how he thought about it, something was wrong.
This phoenix didn’t look like a good person at all. It wasn’t as friendly as Sister Ice Dragon at all.
In short, it was all because the prophecy of the owl had disturbed his judgment.
“Then do you want to go to the mystic realm it mentioned?”
‘The gem cat asked the most important question.
Shi Yu:”…”
The gem cat :”…”
Damn, what was going on?
At the same time.
The Beast Tamer Troops guarding the edge of the ancient capital, Master Xu Kai, was talking to Principal Feng.
Principal Feng; “This kid, why is he so disobedient? And the gem cat, it actually brought him to such a dangerous place.”
Xu Kai laughed and said, “As expected, you didn’t know, but the problem shouldn’t be big, The Undead Battlefield is completely like a backyard to Lord Gem Cat. There shouldn’t be any problem with them.”
Principal Feng: “I know…”
As the two of them chatted, a few figures suddenly appeared in Master Xu Kai’s office.
Master Xu Kai, who was holding the phone, looked at this group of travel-worn guys in a daze.
“Shi Yu? Why are you back?”
Shi Yu said, “Instructor Xu, stop chatting. There’s a big problem. The Undying Dark Phoenix’s consciousness has awakened, and its power is leaking. A new wave of undead attacks is about to happen in the Undead Battlefield. Hurry up and prepare.”
Xu Kai and Principal Fen
The two exploded.
Damn it, Shi Yu!

chapters.title: Chapter 234
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Sin
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the edge of the Undead Battlefield.
In the Beast Tamer Troops.
Master Xu Kai’s mind was a little blank when he saw Shi Yu and the others suddenly appear.
“Ha… Ha… Ha…”
His gaze swept across Shi Yu, the gem cat, and Eleven.
“Shi Yu, what are you talking about?”
“Uncle Xu, you can’t stop scaring me. Our Dong Huang is only on April Fool’s Day.”
‘The gem cat was impatient. “Who’s scaring you? It’s true. His mother… No, the Undying Dark Phoenix woke up.”
“although the seal hasn’t been broken, the explosive power should be real. There might be a large number of undead rioting later, or even attacking the city. I wonder if a new undead overlord will be born. In short, you have to quickly prepare. In addition, call a legend over. I’ll also guard here.”
Xu Kai’s expression gradually froze.
Upon hearing the gem cat say so, he immediately understood that Shi Yu wasn’t lying.
Shit, shit, shit.
So what the hell was going on? What exactly were they doing at the Undead Battlefield!
What a sin!
Who let them in? Ten thousand push-ups as punishment!
“Shi Yu, answer the call!!!”
At this moment, a shout came from the phone on the table.
‘When Shi Yu heard that, he thought, Isn’t this the principal?
It had been a few days since they last met, so why did his temper become worse?
“Come back quickly, go back to school!!”
Shi Yu walked over and picked up the phone. Principal Feng’s roar immediately came from the other side.
Principal Feng’s tone was urgent, making Shi Yu close his eyes. The gem cat beside him was also a little guilty.
“principal Feng is right. Hurry back to school now. Leave this to us. Report the details to Principal Feng.”
At this moment, Master Xu Kai no longer cared about anything, He ran to ring the highest alarm.
Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu was caught by Principal Feng halfway.
After catching Shi Yu in his dormitory, Principal Feng was overjoyed.
“Tell me, what’s going on?”
Shi Yu sat on the sofa obediently. Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng sat beside him, while Little Chi Tong, in the form of a bird spirit, landed on the back of the sofa.
Shi Yu had a bitter expression. “It’s really not my fault.”
“Teacher Ying and I just went to the Undead Battlefield to help Chi Tong level up its Spirit Release. Then, we went to the Undying Pond to take a look.”
Principal Feng looked at Chi Tong and realized that Chi Tong was already in bird spirit form. It had broken through to commander rank. He nodded.
Apart from that, Shi Yu indeed had no other reason to go to the Undead Battlefield.
“So what’s going on with the Undying Dark Phoenix?”
“Did it suddenly wake up, or was it because of you?” Principal Feng’s expression was serious as he asked the most important question.
If it was an accident, then Shi Yu and the others who discovered this matter could be considered to have done something.
If Shi Yu and the others had caused some trouble and awakened the Undying Dark Phoenix, they should obediently write a self-reflection letter!
The location of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s seal was one of the eight forbidden areas of Dong Huang, Even members of Bureau 11 couldn’t casually approach it.
“Tt was all an accident.” Shi Yu’s expression became excited. “It was just a big discovery, an archeological big discovery.”
“We successfully spoke to the Undying Dark Phoenix.”
Whoosh!
Principal Feng stood up in fright and widened his eyes. Huh?
“Tt realized that it had possessed a phoenix fire and didn’t break through the seal itself.”
“He said that he woke up because he sensed the phoenix bloodline awakened after the Scarlet Eye Spirit Dissection.”
Principal Feng; “…S0, it’s really your fault?!”
“No.”
“Tt said that it’s the mother of Chi Tong and the empress. The bloodlines of General Mu Huiyin and the empress all came from it.”
“In addition, it said that it was voluntarily sealed into the Undead Battlefield because of some accidents. It’s a good phoenix. It wants us to rescue, cleanse, and unseal it after gathering enough strength because it is its mother.”
“Tt even told us a secret realm point that collects legends and divine-level resources. After saying that, it went berserk. Can you understand?”
Principal Feng: @
Damn it.
Wait, he was a little confused.
“This… If it’s true, it would be an archeological discovery of the century.”
“If it’s fake… fake… In any case, we’re also victims this time,” Shi Yu analyzed. “We can’t take the blame.”
Eleven and the others nodded. Chi Tong was also very innocent. It had a mother for no reason and didn’t feel anything, What was going on?
Principal Feng: “What nonsense are you talking about? From the start, from the moment you entered the Undead Battlefield, be careful and tell me word for word. Tell me every detail.
The old principal’s wrinkles trembled, and his heart was not calm.
“Alright.” Next, Shi Yu explained in detail again. Principal Feng had known about Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit and her identity previously. There was no need for Shi Yu to explain, so Shi Yu only explained his experience with the gem cat in detail again. Principal Feng quickly understood.
Although he understood Shi Yu’s words, Shi Yu and the others’ experience still made his stomach hurt and his head hurt.
Holy shit.
The empress was Mu Huiyin’s younger sister, and their mother was the Undying Dark Phoenix?
This was something Principal Feng didn’t even dare to imagine when he was young when exploring the mystery of the Phoenix Race.
“You’re experienced and knowledgeable, old man. Look… this is a lie..? Or is it truth.”
Principal Feng’s expression was stunned.
Who could tell?
The internal strife of the Phoenix Race during the era of the empress dynasty was another historical break. It was one of the ten unsolved mysteries of Dong Huang. Now that the Undying Dark Phoenix had said it, it was completely the same thing. Whether it was true or false, there was no evidence to
confirm it.
“Whether it’s real or fake, it should be mixed with lies in the truth. Even if it’s all true, we can’t be sure if it’s real or fake now. We can only listen to it as a lie and maintain a certain level of vigilance.”
Shi Yu: “After listening to you…”
“Tm enlightened.”
“Stop talking nonsense.” Principal Feng had a headache, but his heart was a little strange.
Regardless of whether it was true or false, the Undying Dark Phoenix’s awakening meant that there was a certain breakthrough in this unsolved mystery.
Principal Feng was also a member of Bureau 11, When he heard such explosive news that it involved the empress’s mother, he was also very uneasy.
“Leave the Undead Battlefield to the Legends of the television, the Ancient Capital, and Bureau 11 to deal with. Next, you stay in school obediently and prepare for the exam. Don’t go anywhere, do you hear me?”
“As for the Undying Dark Phoenix, it doesn’t have much to do with the current you. Whether it’s the mystic realm it’s talking about, or saving its mother, don’t have unrealistic thoughts.”
Principal Feng still thought very highly of Shi Yu. Shi Yu was also an orphan. He directly regarded Shi Yu as his junior and still didn’t want Shi Yu to court death.
“Tunderstand. Without enough strength, I definitely won’t mess around.”
Principal Feng: “?”
So he was still thinking about it??
After obtaining the information from Shi Yu, Principal Feng quickly rushed to the Undead Battlefield.
The big shots of the Beast Tamer Troops also obtained some information from the gem cat.
As Principal Feng left, only Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others were left in the room.
“Well…”
At this moment, the few of them looked at each other in confusion.
What was going on?
“There shouldn’t be any problems over there, right?” Shi Yu looked in the direction of the Undead Battlefield.
There wasn’t even an overlord level in the Undead Battlefield. Even if a new undead overlord was born because of this mutation, it couldn’t stir up any waves.
‘As long as there was a legend, everything would be settled.
Ancient Capital City was a first-level city after all. There were several legends presiding inside, and countless forbidden weapons that could attack totems were hidden. Unless the Undying Dark Phoenix came out itself, it wouldn’t be a threat to the city.
The ones who were really threatening Dong Huang were creatures from abroad.
The reason why Dong Huang didn’t completely destroy these ferocious beasts and ferocious spirits in the country was purely to protect the ecology. Their existence had always been within control.
With this in mind, Shi Yu no longer cared about the Undead Battlefield. As a high-level Beast Tamer, it was useless to care. After all, he might not necessarily be able to defeat a monarch-level undead alone.
“By the way, how much have you absorbed from the Undying Pond?” Shi Yu asked Baby Ginseng, concerned about his own problem.
He was in a hurry just now and didn’t notice at all. Now, the Undying Pond would probably be gone.
“yi.” Baby Ginseng stretched out its finger. Green light flashed, and a nine condensed on the wooden strip.
Fortunately, fortunately. When the Undying Dark Phoenix was telling a story, it listened and didn’t stop condensing the Mutated Fruit.
It speculated that 90% of the Undying Pond’s power had already been absorbed by it. It wasn’t a loss.
“Wu ~” At this moment, Buggy also pulled open the space and threw out the Death Spirit Fruit condensed by Baby Ginseng.
There were about 13 black fruits lying flat on the table.
“132 So many.”
‘When Shi Yu saw so many mutated fruits, he was slightly stunned and had a happy expression.
This time the ginseng baby wasn’t far from evolution.
Time Soil+Death Spirit Fruit+Time Mystic Realm+Moon Gem. Oh, invincible.
Eh, wait.
Since max-level mutants could condense the power of mutation out of their bodies, at that time, was it possible to condense the Time Fruit in the Time Mystic Realm of Imperial Capital University??
This was much more valuable than the Death Fruit.
Shi Yu had a bold idea.
“yi!” At this moment, Baby Ginseng’s expression was especially smug.
After evolution, it was really a towering emperor.
Although the process was a little complicated, it had to learn the power of death
Even so… Soon, Baby Ginseng saw Little Chi Tong and couldn’t help but have a bitter expression.
Evolution was evolution, but it was ultimately wood-element.
There was a sword spirit with the bloodline of the Sun God Phoenix here, and it was a high-level overlord race. In the absence of a skill proficiency that exceeded expert level, its energy value was almost close to Buggy who had a pile of almost full level skills. When Shi Yu started to nurture Chi Tong, Baby
Ginseng felt that even if it evolved, it wouldn’t be able to get the throne in the team.
Buggy’s skills were so abnormal, it was unknown if it could defeat it.
Baby Ginseng looked at Eleven and looked at it eagerly.
It seemed that after evolution, the only thing that could be surpassed was the leader?
At least the skills of a leader… were traceable.
Eleven:???
“Huh?” Eleven pointed at itself.
Baby Ginseng shook its head repeatedly.
Eleven was angry. Damn it, it wasn’t like it couldn’t evolve anymore!
wu ~”
At the side, Buggy narrowed its eyes in exhaustion. It was too much, too much, almost rolling the leader to the bottom.
“Mil!” Little Chi Tong flew away aloof from worldly affairs. It took out a cup of ice water and drank it with a straw.
Shi Yu was still sitting on the sofa and sighing. He had yet to recover from the Undead Battlefield.
“Undying Dark Phoenix…”
Forget it, he should listen to Principal Feng and stop thinking about it. It was impossible for him to go to this Undead Battlefield again.
In the future, he would prepare to increase Little Chi Tong’s Spirit Release with additional points.
As for the mystic realm that the other party mentioned, Shi Yu was helpless.
That mystic realm was on the seven islands. Before he had legendary strength, even with the big boss gem cat leading him, it would probably be very difficult for him to cross the national border.
Even if there was a chance to enter, this mystic realm might not necessarily be a good place. As long as the Undying Dark Phoenix was lying, this place might be a trap.
“Let’s pretend that we don’t have this mother first. Let’s wait for the big shots of Bureau 11 to investigate carefully.”
Shi Yu said to Little Chi Tong.
This time, the Undying Dark Phoenix had revealed so much information. Regardless of whether it was true or false, the other archeological big shots of Bureau 11 would probably have a certain amount of gains. It was better to wait for the results.
“Mi…” Chi Tong, who had melted an ice cube, was very speechless. It had yet to call Shi Yu ‘mom’, so why was Shi Yu calling that thing ‘mom’?
Could he be a little more stable.
Next, Shi Yu began to revise quietly and prepare for the final exam.
“Regarding the fact that I acknowledged a top-notch totem as my mother and caused the undead to attack the city but still have to prepare for the final exam” was no longer something worth Shi Yu’s time.
“What a sin.”
As Shi Yu sighed, he paid attention to the news of the Undead Battlefield.
In the blink of an eye, a week later.
Fortunately, there were indeed no major problems. All the signs of undead attacking the city seemed to have been directly killed by the big shots in the ancient capital.
“No new undead overlord was born this time. Only more than ten irrational undead monarchs were born, but they were all killed by Legend Yin.”
“However, a large number of plagues and curses continue to cover the core area of the Undead Battlefield. New high-level undead might appear in the short term, so there’s still a need to continue paying attention to the Undead Battlefield.”
Not long after, Principal Feng brought back news, but his greatest concern was: “How did you do?”
He was concerned about Shi Yu’s learning problems.
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment and said, “The useful subjects will definitely get full marks.”
Principal Feng: “?”
“What do you mean useless subjects?”
“Well, it’s just some architecture stuff, fashion, food history, and so on. There’s also thought classes, various archeological related laws…”
Shi Yu also had limited energy. It was impossible for him to learn every subject. These were all prepared for ordinary archeologists. He just needed to cause trouble.
Principal Feng’s expression darkened. “I called Qingyi back. You’re not allowed to run around during this holiday. Be good and learn from Qingyi. Bureau 11 will help you deal with the Undying Dark Phoenix. Don’t cause any more trouble next.”
“Now, I don’t even want you to go to Dragon Palace City. If you cause trouble there, it’s even more troublesome than releasing the Undying Dark Phoenix…”
“Uh… Then…”
Shi Yu was just about to say what to do about the martial arts conference, but seeing Principal Feng like this, he immediately stopped talking. Well, let the beast-eared girl have a headache about it.
However, the results of this exam would probably give the principal a headache.
Although it was said that he was preparing for the exam, it was more like preparing for the martial arts conference. Shi Yu placed more energy on Little Chi Tong.
He started to add points to it.
He ignored the other skills and maxed out the possession.
Skill: Possession (Dao Proficiency)
After this skill reached the maximum level, Little Chi Tong didn’t change much, but after it possessed Shi Yu, the power Shi Yu could display was even stronger.
Until it reached the perfect level, the strength of the possession state continued to increase.
After reaching the transcendent level, the possession effect changed slightly, from strength to skill.
At this moment, after Shi Yu entered the possession state, the burden on his body was smaller. In addition, under the possession state, Shi Yu could even transform into the form of a sword spirit, the form of a bird spirit, and the form of a phoenix spirit body. This was very magical.
It didn’t seem like it had possessed him. Using reverse possession to describe it was more suitable. In this state, the battle power of the two parties was the same as ordinary possession. There were no changes, but at this moment, Shi Yu’s human aura would completely disappear. Shi Yu thought for a long,
time and only thought of this move that could be used to disguise himself as an undead and infiltrate the non-human area. There were other uses for it.
As for the Dao Proficiency level possession, the effect was still relatively strong. Shi Yu felt that in this state, Little Chi Tong, who had possessed him, could use its power to subtly strengthen his physique. At the same time, under the possession state, Shi Yu would temporarily obtain the Phoenix
bloodline.
Now, after Shi Yu broke through, as he added points to Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, his physique had already reached the upper limit. If he wanted to obtain a new upper limit, according to the previous situation, he probably had to break through to the master level. However, the max-level
possession had managed to slowly increase Shi Yu’s physique, which had reached the upper limit. Shi Yu was shocked and pleasantly surprised by this change.
He was happy that his physique was getting stronger and stronger. This was naturally a good thing.
The shocking thing was that Shi Yu might really obtain the Phoenix bloodline and become a hybrid one day. If that was the case, he might really have to call the Dark Phoenix “Mommy’.
Perhaps even that Bureau 12, which was specially set up for hybrids, had to invite him in.
“In short, don’t cause too much trouble next…”
Principal Feng looked at Shi Yu tiredly. He originally thought that Lu Qingyi was already quite noisy, but he didn’t expect Shi Yu to be even more noisy.
“Don’t worry.”
Shi Yu said rather seriously, “I swear that nothing will happen next.”
The martial arts conference and the ruins of Emperor Wu didn’t look like a place where something could happen. Even if there was, it would definitely be a good thing!

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - Wu Ling City
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Wu Ling City
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
It was already snowing heavily in the ancient capital in June.
Some of the students from Ancient Capital University went home and went out to train. Some also chose to stay in school to study.
Shi Yu yawned and returned to the room to eat porridge after playing a Taichi fan on the snow outside the dormitory.
After transmigrating for so long, he was already used to the weather in this world.
It was completely changeable. The ancient capital was still alright. There were even some places where it was permanently hot and cold.
“It’s delicious.”
Shi Yu said in satisfaction as he held the white rice porridge.
yal”
Baby Ginseng, who was wearing a napkin and eating dirt with a spoon, was full of confidence.
Forget about Buggy’s culinary skills, the quality of the raw materials it provided was definitely top-notch. It would definitely be delicious.
Now, be it Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, or Chi Tong’s food materials, they were all provided by Baby Ginseng.
Shi Yu bought the corresponding ingredient seed. Baby Ginseng used the upgraded nutritional supplements, lush, and sweet aura to modify and accelerate ripening, The nutritional value and taste of the plants it created were many times better than the food outside.
owe”
Buggy felt that its culinary skills were still more important.
In order to let Shi Yu, who was going out to archeology in the future, eat hot food, it took a lot of effort to materialize the entire automatic kitchen.
Although it was an ancient non-machinery operation, it was precisely because of this that it was delicious. Laborer Buggy was the most glorious.
Little Chi Tong landed on the table and quietly ate the Ice Fire Fried Rice made of the combination of the ice rice and the fire rice. There were also a few soul crystals as embellishments, looking very much like the meat in the fried rice. This was specially customized for its taste by Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng.
“Wuu! (I’m full!)” On the other side, Eleven put down the basin and shouted thanks for the hospitality. Then, it eagerly prepared to run to charge itself. It was just for fun to eat. If it wanted to truly feel free, It still had to go to Ancient Capital University.
In the past few months, the frequency and use of Eleven’s charging even exceeded some teachers’ monarch-level thunder pets.
“Wa wu wu?”
However, just as Eleven was about to go to the charging room, it bumped into two uninvited guests at the door.
Two voices were communicating outside the door. From time to time, pleasant laughter that belonged to young women could be heard. Eleven looked up and realized that it was two rich women.
Lu Qingyi, who was wearing a black T-shirt and brown shorts, a white research suit, and black silk pants.
As well as White Brook, who was wearing a white outdoor combat suit and black combat shorts.
The two of them chatted as they walked to Shi Yu’s dormitory door.
“Eh, it’s Eleven.” At this moment, White Brook noticed the little Iron-eating Beast looking up at them around 0.3 meters from the dormitory door.
“Long time no see.” Lu Qingyi also smiled and greeted Eleven.
“Wuuu!!” Eleven waved its arms up and down to welcome them.
“Where’s your Shi Yu?” White Brook asked.
“Wu wu wu…!” Eleven pointed at the room, It was recuperating,
“Wuu! (Follow me!)” With that said, lightning shot out of its fingertip. An electric arc led to the door, helped the two of them open the door, and prepared to lead the way.
In the room.
Shi Yu was filled with sleepiness.
He had indeed not slept well these few days.
Little Chi Tong was about to squeeze it dry.
It was not easy for his physique to explode. Shi Yu, who had not added any points to Little Chi Tong, finally placed his focus on it.
Apart from the possession skill, the other three high-level skills, Light Flame Sword, Soul Slash, and Deterrence, were also raised to the standard of all proficiency and perfection first. This was to prepare for the approaching martial arts conference.
As for the second one, it was Baby Ginseng.
Its racial skills were still alright. Apart from the super skill source of life, they had already been maxed out. However, the taught skills still had the four skills of Strengthening, Energy Fruit, Multiplication, and Absolute Sleep at the perfect level. They had yet to be maxed out.
Shi Yu planned to wait until it was all maxed out before going to the time mystic realm of Imperial Capital University to give Baby Ginseng the final mutation evolution.
Of course, apart from these skills, Baby Ginseng still didn’t have the common skills in Shi Yu’s team, Deterrence and Super Sight. Neither. Among them, Shi Yu felt that the priority of the super Sight skill should be raised to the highest. He had to prioritize Baby Ginseng.
Because of the transcendent level super vision, there was a chance for the user to see the situation related to himself in the next 0.5 seconds!
Just from the effect, it was very useless. It was so useless that it couldn’t be any more useless. If he could see the scene one second later, it wouldn’t be so useless.
0.5 seconds was purely pointless. He had just seen it and before he could react, the time had passed. Moreover, there was a luck based factor as well… The extent of the scam far exceeded the owl’s Future Prediction.
Although that was the case, it couldn’t be denied that transcendent-level super vision had already touched on the surface of the time domain. Since Baby Ginseng planned to go to the Time Mystic Realm, it wasn’t a bad idea to build a foundation for this move. Regardless of what it could do, it wasn’t
troublesome to add some mid-level skills anyway. It would be fine as long as it leveled up.
“Uh.” At this moment, Shi Yu finished his breakfast and was just about to lie on the sofa and “meditate” to cultivate when suddenly, Eleven brought Lu Qingyi and White Brook in, making Shi Yu get up suddenly.
“Senior… Senior?” Shi Yu looked at the two of them in surprise and said, “Why are you here?”
“What do you think?” Lu Qingyi’s expression was filled with helplessness. In her impression, it seemed to have been yesterday when she brought Shi Yu and Little Chi Tong to the Undead Battlefield. Not long after, why did Shi Yu cause such a big commotion here in the blink of an eye?
She was directly called over by the old master to strictly watch over Shi Yu and tutor him.
However, Lu Qingyi was still willing, It was mainly because Chi Tong was the daughter of the Undying Dark Phoenix. The news of the empress’s sister was too explosive. Regardless of whether it was true or false, it directly made Lu Qingyi unable to sit still. She wished she could immediately come and
discuss with Shi Yu for three days and three nights.
She even regretted it a little. If only she had followed the gem cat and Shi Yu to the Undead Battlefield and successfully talked to the Undying Dark Phoenix… She was so envious of the gem cat!
“Eh….” White Brook was shorter than Lu Qingyi. She stuck to Lu Qingyi’s side and breathed in the fragrance on the senior’s body. She secretly gave Shi Yu a thumbs up. As expected of you.
White Brook’s family wasn’t simple either. She clearly knew about the changes in the Undead Battlefield.
“An accident, an accident…” Shi Yu smiled awkwardly and said,” Eleven, make tea.”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven ran to make tea.
“Where’s Chi Tong?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“Chi Tong…” Shi Yu took a look and said,” It just went to the space to sleep. ”
Baby Ginseng was doing a daily tending the vegetable garden in the space. Buggy, who had just finished washing the dishes, was currently helping Baby Ginseng create favorable conditions. Through the power of imagination, all kinds of weather and fertile soil were produced.
As for Chi Tong, it still looked like a child. It slept after eating and would probably wake up later.
“Ah… Then let’s sleep first,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Senior, how’s the situation on your side?” Shi Yu asked Lu Qingyi.
Lu Qingyi was also a busy person. She had been running around the country to increase the strength of herself and her pet and strive to become a legend as soon as possible.
‘When they separated the last time, Shi Yu remembered that Lu Qingyi said that she was undergoing special training with the Evil Suppressing Lion.
“The harvest is not bad. The Wind Demon Lion’s bloodline level has already matched that of an overlord race. After another evolution, its potential should be completely stimulated.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
The Evil Suppressing Lion was one of the guardians of the Dong Huang Continent, a quasi-mythical race. It was extremely evil and lived in the area where ancient demons were in chaos. Although Lu Qingyi’s Wind Demon Lion’s race level was only commander rank, because it had received the Evil
Suppression Force inheritance of the Evil Suppressing Lion, its potential was not much inferior to that of an overlord race.
After Shi Yu heard that, he immediately sighed. He didn’t know if Principal Feng, the totem guardian of the first bureau’s member, was the tamer of an Evil Suppressing Lion.
