Regardless, he didn’t want to join the fun. He was afraid that the Evil Suppressing Lion would suppress him. Shi Yu felt that he
wasn’t a good person.
“Let’s talk about business first,” Lu Qingyi said. “White Brook pulled me over this time.”
“Hehe.” White Brook touched her head and acted like a little girl in front of Lu Qingyi.
“I begged Senior for a long time this time…”
“Uh.” Shi Yu quickly reacted.
He had been taught by Principal Feng not to run around. He took advantage of the holidays and obediently studied more with Lu Qingyi.
As for White Brook, she wanted to drag Shi Yu to participate in the martial arts conference, so she had to leave the school and run around.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and kicked the question to the beast-eared girl. From the looks of it, White Brook planned to attack Lu Qingyi!
“Senior Lu has already agreed to let us participate in the martial arts conference. She’ll watch us go together.” White Brook clenched her fists in victory.
Lu Qingyi was silent. “That’s true…”
Shi Yu’s expression was serious. “Don’t worry, I definitely won’t cause trouble this time.”
At this moment… Eleven obediently placed the tea on the table and looked at Shi Yu with its big eyes.
Really? It didn’t believe it.
“The ruins of Emperor Wu… it’s not one of those dangerous places,” Shi Yu said.
“Well, indeed, I’ve been there too,” Lu Qingyi said. “The archeological atmosphere there is rich, and there’s indeed not much of a problem. It’s not as dangerous as the Undead Battlefield. Moreover, White Brook also grew up in the Emperor Wu Ruins since she was young.”
“Yes, yes.” White Brook nodded.
“The location of the martial arts conference is like my backyard. There won’t be any danger.” White Brook was very confident.
Shi Yu :”…”
Emperor Wu Ruins was her backyard?
“By the way, when my parents learned that you were going to participate in the martial arts conference, they also wanted to invite you to my house to play. After we reach Wuling City, let’s stay at my house,” White Brook suggested.
“Uh, your house is…” Shi Yu asked.
“My parents are businessmen. They’ve also heard of you,” White Brook said. “They’ve long wanted to meet you.”
“The entire White Brook family has the Fusion Talent, and it’s also one of the organizers of the martial arts conference. It protects the Emperor Wu Ruins.” Beside him, Lu Qingyi added, “Have you heard of the Wu Ling Bai family?”
“.” Shi Yu was silent.
He really… didn’t know.
“Wu Ling Bai family is a martial arts family with a very long history. The entire family is mainly composed of Beast Tamers themselves in battle. The family involves archeology, business, medical care, education, nutritional supplements, and many other industries. It’s a very large Beast Tamer family.” Lu
Qingyi smiled and introduced.
“Uncle and Aunt operate a company that specializes in selling Beast Tamers’ body tools and nutritional supplements. The body-forging facilities of Ancient Capital University are all provided by Uncle and Aunt’s company. In addition, White Brook’s second grandfather is a retired legendary Beast Tamer
senior, so White Brook is considered the little princess of the Bai family.”
“It’s far inferior to Senior.” White Brook pounced on the food like a hungry tiger and pounced on Lu Qingyi. She wanted to hug her, but she was directly pushed away by a hand.
Shi Yu:… They really didn’t treat him as an outsider.
However, this was the first time Shi Yu had learned of the situation in White Brook’s family. As expected, she was another rich woman!!
A family that involved many domains sounded very rich.
“So when are we leaving??” Shi Yu asked.
Lu Qingyi, White Brook, and Shi Yu looked at each other.
“There’s no time to lose,” White Brook suggested. “Let’s go today? Principal Feng doesn’t seem to be around today.”
‘Wu Ling City.
Ina second-level city.
This was considered a very developed second-level city. It was a second-level city at the top. Its development was much better than Icefield City.
Martial arts were popular in Wu Ling City. Compared to the Beast Tamers elsewhere, the local Beast Tamers paid more attention to training their bodies. Even if it wasn’t their battle-type Beast Taming Talent, they had to train their bodies well.
The reason was also very simple. It was related to history. According to historical records, Emperor Wu was from Wu Ling City and rose up from here. Therefore, in the subsequent dynasties, this area advocated the style of martial arts.
‘Wu Ling Airport.
The two girls with extraordinary auras and a handsome young man wearing sunglasses beside them attracted everyone’s attention.
Even if handsome men and beautiful women were very common on this blue planet where most people were transcendent life forms, the three of them were still very conspicuous. Especially White Brook, she attracted the gaze of many people that far exceeded Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu.
Many people swallowed their saliva when they saw White Brook’s figure. It wasn’t that she was very voluptuous, but that she was very coordinated. She clearly looked quite strong, and it was obvious that she was a combat expert, but her physique was surprisingly perfect, perfectly balanced at the optimal
point. This was the figure most people in Wuling City envied.
In comparison, the older sister-like Lu Qingyi was clearly not a battle-type Beast Tamer. As for the fiery red Shi Yu, although he was handsome, he didn’t look very strong. He looked weak, like a freeloader
Fortunately, Shi Yu didn’t know what the other party was thinking. Otherwise, he would definitely protest seriously.
He was the one with the strongest physique among the few of them. It was completely no problem for him to punch a transcendent-level beast. As for his figure, although it didn’t have any muscles and might be very ordinary, it definitely revealed valiance in ordinaryness. Training a body of muscles
could only attract men.
“Let’s go to my house directly.”
After coming out of the airport, White Brook directly suggested.
“It’s still early. Why don’t we go shopping?” Lu Qingyi said.
White Brook immediately agreed and said, “Alright, alright. I know a new perfume store. The owner is a master-level botanist who specializes in flower-type pets. The products are all specially made by her. Do you want to take a look?”
“alright.”
shi Yu:”…”
Perfume?
Shi Yu had plenty of that to offer! He could have as many as he wanted, and they were all top-notch quality. Was there a need to buy them?
” Shi Yu suddenly recalled that after Baby Ginseng’s sweet aura rose to the maximum, it had never been given to Senior Lu and the others. Girls should like this thing, right? It was a sin to let Baby Ginseng serve the gem cat… Ina while, he would let Baby Ginseng create an exclusive perfume and send a
bunch to Senior Lu and Senior Panda.
“shi Yu, what about you?” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
To
Shi Yu took a look at White Brook’s expectant gaze and decided not to be a third wheel. He said, “You guys shop. I just checked with my cell phone. There seems to be an antique street nearby. I’ll go take a look over there.”
“Eh….” White Brook said,” Alright, then go quickly. But don’t buy random things. There are so many conmen over there. They specialize in deceiving foreign tourists who don’t know anything. How can there be so many treasures to sell? ”
Lu Qingyi said, “Don’t worry, he’s a veteran of that world.”
Shi Yu :”…”

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - Listening to History Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Listening to History Again
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
‘Wu Ling City was prosperous, so naturally there was a pile of antique swords and armor.
In ancient times, zither, chess, calligraphy, paintings, and antique swords could nurture spirits and transform into pets.
As for now, perhaps only ruins preserved from ancient times like the Heroic Spirit Ruins could be able to find similar spirit bodies.
Perhaps there were no antique sword-type pets sold in Wu Ling City, but there were many broken swords, broken armor, or antiques that had once had spirits here.
Apart from these, there were also some modern equipment that imitated ancient weapons, similar to Shi Yu’s Ice Dragon Blade. These equipment were surprisingly popular here. After all, in Wu Ling City, Beast Tamers without much equipment to add to their bodies, they would be completely embarrassed
to go out and fight others.
In order to not disturb Senior Lu and the beast-eared girl’s happy shopping time, Shi Yu chose to shop alone. He directly followed the navigation and arrived at the popular antique street in Wu Ling City.
“Little brother, little brother.”
Just as Shi Yu entered the street, he was stopped by an uncle who was setting up a stall.
“Look at my jar?”
“None of them are empty.”
Shi Yu: “?”
The last time someone said that, it was an owl.
Shi Yu looked over and saw that the middle-aged man in a brown coat was smiling as he pointed at the dozens of jars of various sizes placed on the stall. The big ones were the size of a water tank, and the small ones were the size of a can
“If you draw, you’ll definitely get an antique. ten thousand for one draw, ninety thousand eight ten draws. It’s one free extra draw.”
“90,000, 80 draws?” Shi Yu asked.
“You mean 98,000 for ten draws!”
Shi Yu said, “Do you think I’m stupid?”
‘The middle-aged man said, “Sigh, from what you’re saying, you’re not a local, right? You go and ask other stalls about our jars. There was once a customer who opened an antique chessboard from our jars.”
“He originally wanted to just collect some items. Guess what? There’s actually a chess soul sleeping in this chessboard!”
“You have to know that these antiques can no longer give birth to spirits in the moder era, so those are ancient spirits that buyers earned with their lives. If these ancient spirits are in a slumber stage, these antiques will be like ordinary items, so who can guarantee that ten thousand yuan won’t get you
an overlord race ancient spirit?” The uncle patted his leg in excitement.
“Chess soul?” Shi Yu said, “Really?”
“It’s true,” the middle-aged man said. “Under the guidance of the chess soul, that person has already become the number one expert chess player in Wu Ling City. Everyone knows that it’s the chess soul that opened the jar.”
Shi Yu: “Sorry to disturb you.”
Shi Yu tumed and left.
Although ten thousand yuan was nothing, he wouldn’t be so bored as to buy an antique jar.
Most importantly, through the jar, he couldn’t judge the era of antiques with special meditation techniques at all. This liar was very sinister!
The beast-eared girl was right. There were indeed no good people on this antique street.
Then, Shi Yu slowly strolled around the antique street. There were no especially big shops here. They were all stalls or small shops. They looked very unreliable.
However, it was too absolute. As the data in front of Shi Yu’s eyes jumped, he also discovered a big black dog lying on the ground in a certain store. It was a commander-level pet. The store owner looked like a friendly old man. A Beast Tamer who could raise a commander-level pet shouldn’t be a liar,
right?
Shi Yu entered the store.
Amoment later, Shi Yu left the store.
“Liar.”
Shi Yu entered the store and walked around before coming out directly. Alright, he understood why the other party could afford to raise a commander-level pet. Black, his heart was really black.
He stood on the spot and closed his eyes to meditate for a round. He actually didn’t sense anything that had a history of more than a hundred years, they were all young items.
So dogs were used to chase away people who knew how to sense these things.
“It’s boring.”
After strolling for more than ten minutes, Shi Yu suddenly understood before he reached a tenth of the street’s length.
‘As expected, he didn’t have the legendary protagonist plot armor. He couldn’t even shop on the street and find treasures.
Shi Yu turned around and focused on the stone mirror. At this moment, Shi Yu’s vision kept shrinking, and his gaze seemed to fall into the world of the stone mirror.
History appeared vaguely.
In Shi Yu’s vision, he saw a child who might not be more than ten years old with a goatee.
She held the stone mirror and aimed at the rocks and trees by the roadside, shining it randomly.
Under the illumination of the stone mirror, a surprising scene occurred.
Anything reflected in the mirror changed.
The stone evolved into an elemental life form and turned into a fist floating in the air.
‘The tree opened its eyes, obtained its feet, and became a tree spirit tree demon.
The scene was extremely unbelievable.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu cursed in his heart. Then, the scene stopped. Shi Yu’s vision was pulled back to reality.
At this moment, Shi Yu was slightly shocked. He looked at the stone mirror solemnly.
Wait, wait?!
This stone mirror.
This stone mirror could allow ordinary objects and ordinary life forms to evolve and awaken as transcendent life forms?!
An ability similar to “Awakening Talent”??
Awakening Talent, a very abnormal Beast Taming Talent. It could allow ordinary rocks, lakes, and mountains on the roadside to evolve into transcendent life forms and evolve into life.
Although this talent didn’t have strong battle power, it could create pets in batches. From the Emperor Dynasty to the modern era, the rulers of every era would promote this talent as a Beast Tamer. There was no other reason, because as they developed the Beast Taming Talent, they could steadily
produce high-quality pets.
Although it might be very difficult for overlord races, monarch races could still be done at a certain price.
An undeveloped awakening talent might only be able to awaken a stone into a fist stone of a low-level transcendent race, but the developed awakening talent could even awaken a mountain peak into a rock giant of a monarch race.
They were the creators of pets.
As long as the awakened target met the aptitude, they could accelerate the process of the other party evolving into a transcendent life form and increase their potential.
The beginning of this talent was the modern era.
A Beast Tamer from the Divine Wind Nation “Shen Feng” used his “Awakening Talent” to open up the Mechanical Life Era. A Beast Tamer from Dong Huang followed closely behind. The concept of Mechanics quickly became popular in the world. In the last Totem War, Mechanics played a crucial role in the
war.
According to what Shi Yu knew, Gao Xuan from Imperial Capital University seemed to have an awakening talent. His mechanical pet was created according to his own ideas with the help of the big shots in the fourth bureau.
‘And now, Shi Yu rubbed his eyes. He had seen something.
This was… an item with the effect of awakening talent?
At this moment, another group of people had already surrounded this stall. However, these people took a look at the price and directly shook their heads and left.
Behind the stall, the young man sitting on the wooden stool pinched his pants. His legs were already numb from sitting, but he still stared straight at the stone mirror.
He didn’t believe that the treasures passed down from generation to generation in his family were only ordinary items. As long as he waited… someone who knew the value would definitely appear.
“You…”
Just as the young man’s heart was in a mess, a black shadow appeared in his vision.
He looked up and saw a tall young man wearing a dark red trench coat and cloak. He wasn’t much older than him.
“What’s your name?” Shi Yu asked.
“An Chang,” he said directly in the face of Shi Yu’s question.
“Is it true?”
‘An Chang nodded heavily.
“Tl buy this stone mirror,” Shi Yu said directly and said the main point.
At this moment, Shi Yu was also very nervous. Although he knew that this stone mirror was a treasure in the past, it was still uncertain what the current situation was.
If this thing had already lost its function, Shi Yu would suffer a huge loss.. However, on the other hand, if he found the method to use it, he would make a killing!

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - It’s Time to Do Gundam
chapters.content:
237  It's Time to Do Gundam
"You're saying… you want to buy it??"
As Shi Yu appeared, the young man, An Chang, was stunned. Then, he was instantly pleasantly surprised.
"Really???" He was suddenly a little excited.
This money was not a small amount.
Not only was An Chang stunned, but the other passers-by were also stunned. Someone really bought this thing?
With this money, why couldn't he buy a house and a luxury car… What family was he from?
"Yeah, can I transfer the money?"
Shi Yu had already taken out his cell phone. The young man opposite him hurriedly waved his hand and said, "Well, can, can we go to the bank to transact?"
"I don't have a cell phone."
Shi Yu :"…"
It was troublesome.
"…Then let's go," Shi Yu said after a moment of silence.
Forget it, he couldn't let Buggy materialize a box of cash for him, right?
That would be too much.
"Alright."
An Chang, seeing that Shi Yu indeed wanted to buy it, couldn't help but be overjoyed. He immediately got up and wanted to clean up the stall, but he seemed to have forgotten that his legs were about to go numb. When he got up, he fell and fell forward.
An Chang: Σ (° △ ° | |)
"…" Shi Yu.
"It's not a big problem." He quickly supported him with his hand and patted his clothes.
A moment later, under the stunned gazes of passers-by, the young man setting up the stall left with Shi Yu. For a moment, passers-by couldn't tell if the young man setting up the stall was a liar or if Shi Yu was a liar.
…
Shi Yu and An Chang left Antique Street.
As the two of them walked to Wu Ling Bank, An Chang observed Shi Yu carefully from behind.
It was mainly because Shi Yu was too young. Could five million be taken out so easily?
"Do you know the origin of that stone mirror?"
Shi Yu walked in front and asked without looking back.
"I don't know… But according to my family, it's a very precious treasure, but the usage… was lost in the flames of war." He asked Shi Yu, "Do you know what it is?"
"I know, but I don't know," Shi Yu said.
An Chang: "?"
"It's indeed a treasure, but I'm not sure if it can be used or how."
"Then are you still buying?" he asked nervously.
He only wanted to know if the stone mirror could be sold.
"I'll buy," Shi Yu said. Five million wasn't a lot. Buggy, Baby Ginseng… they could easily earn it.
What really made Shi Yu feel that it might be a loss was that he knew the use of this stone mirror in advance.
At that time, if he bought it and couldn't use it, would he lose five million yuan? No! He would lose a divine weapon! He would lose billions.
He was an old capitalist. If he couldn't earn, he would lose.
"Thank you," An Chang hurriedly said.
"Excuse me, what's wrong with your mother?"
After chatting with the other party for a while, Shi Yu sensed the other party's mental fluctuations. In addition to the value of this stone mirror, he already believed that what was written on the other party's wooden board was real.
"Life force loss…" An Chang said after a moment of silence.
"Your mother is a Beast Tamer?"
Shi Yu stopped and looked at him.
That made sense. With such a family heirloom, it would be strange if there were no Beast Tamers at home.
Life loss was a very common disease among Beast Tamers. It wasn't accurate to say that it was a disease, but it was more like an injury.
This phenomenon usually occurred after many Beast Tamers died.
If the Beast Tamer was in perfect condition when the pet died, it would be basically not a big problem.
But if the Beast Tamer's state was extremely poor at that time, and the pet died, the contract would backfire on the Beast Tamer himself, causing the Beast Tamer to lose his life force.
Similarly, this phenomenon also applied. When a Beast Tamer died, their pets would also be affected.
Generally speaking, many Beast Tamers would rather die directly than enter a state of life loss. This injury was a bottomless pit. It was impossible to treat with ordinary healing skills. If they wanted to treat it, they could only smash a bunch of medicine to replenish their vitality in order to improve and repair the physique of Beast Tamers. In short, the chances of treating it were very small and expensive.
"Yes…"
An Chang didn't say much and just nodded simply.
When Shi Yu saw this, he didn't ask further because he had already reached the bank.
This An Chang was quite careful and meticulous. He knew that 5 million was not a small sum and had even drawn up the contract in advance. Shi Yu took a casual look and completed the transaction with him in the bank.
"Thank you."
After the transaction was completed, An Chang was very excited. He bowed hard at Shi Yu. This money was completely timely for his family.
"It's just a normal transaction," Shi Yu said casually with the stone mirror.
"By the way, this is for you." Shi Yu took out a white fruit the size of a grape from his' pocket 'and handed it to him.
"Uh…"
An Chang looked at this unknown fruit in confusion.
"Perhaps it can treat life loss. I don't know if it's useful. You can show it to the doctor. If it's useless, give it to the pet," Shi Yu said.
Those were Eleven and Buggy's snacks. Shi Yu had just taken out a max-level nutritional fruit from the ruins space. It contained the power of life and could increase the pet's life level and evolution potential. In theory, it could also be used by humans. It was a super high quality life medicine. It couldn't be judged simply by the energy level.
"This…" An Chang was stunned on the spot.
"Hurry up."
"Alright." An Chang bowed at Shi Yu again, eager to leave. After Shi Yu nodded, the other party left.
On the contract, Shi Yu's name and phone were mentioned. He planned to thank Shi Yu in the future. The hospital had urged him too much. Now that he had finally gotten the money, he had to hand it over as soon as possible. Only then would there be subsequent medicine.
Just as An Chang left the bank, Shi Yu took the stone mirror and left the bank too, planning to give it a try.
A moment later, he came to a park beside him and sat beside a flower bed.
Shi Yu fiddled with the stone mirror and fell into deep thought.
So, how exactly was it used?
Shi Yu meditated for a while and took out an energy crystal to feed it to the stone mirror, but there was no reaction.
He even tried to activate the legendary power contained in the ruins space to use the stone mirror.
However, it was still useless.
"Can you hear me?"
"How are you used?"
Shi Yu communicated with the mirror telepathically.
Logically speaking, if he could communicate once, as long as the stone mirror didn't crack, there was hope of communicating a second time.
However, after Shi Yu shouted for a while, Shi Jing still didn't react.
This involuntarily made Shi Yu's expression darken.
Could it be that he had to be like back then when he was "touched by the heroic spirit ruins" and chat for a few days and nights before the stone mirror could be touched?
If that was the case, that would be great. However, if there was still no reaction after a few months of chatting, the loss would be more than a few billion, and it would also be a heavy waste of his time.
Shi Yu had calculated it clearly.
"Think about it carefully…"
Sitting on the stone platform, Shi Yu looked at the stone mirror in his hand, at the flowers and green caterpillars in the flower bed, and started thinking.
Suddenly, he was slightly stunned. For some reason, he aimed the stone mirror at a crawling green caterpillar.
According to the voice and tone he heard when listening to the Voice of History, he said,
"Change!"
"Change!"
Swoosh!
The next moment, the ancient stone mirror emitted a faint light that directly shone on the caterpillar.
Shi Yu and the caterpillar were stunned at the same time.
11:39
Shi Yu realized that his physical fitness was being extracted by the stone mirror. It had roughly extracted the amount of skills needed to teach a low-level skill in the skill index.
On the other side, after the caterpillar was shone on, it stopped crawling. Under the light, its entire body directly evolved from an ordinary caterpillar into a transcendent creature, the Green Silkworm.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly.
Holy shit??
So simple?
Just like the awakening talent… the energy cost was the physical strength of a Beast Tamer?
However… it needed to have voice control??
Which refiner genius created this mirror?
Seeing the caterpillar in front of him complete its awakening and become a level-one transcendent life form, Shi Yu instantly stared at it.
"Ji!!" The green worm was shocked.
"Change!"
"Change!"
Shi Yu raised the stone mirror again and aimed at the Green Silkworm.
Under the light, the green worm was shocked.
However, this time, the Green Silkworm didn't change at all, and the stone mirror didn't take Shi Yu's physical fitness anymore.
As expected, the stone mirror was the same as the awakening talent. It could only awaken things that weren't transcendent life forms to evolve into transcendent life forms, but it couldn't let them transform again.
"Ji!!" After being played by Shi Yu consecutively, the Green Silkworm was so scared that it hurriedly crawled into the flower and ran away without a trace, leaving Shi Yu silent on the spot.
This thing…
Shi Yu stared at the stone mirror. He felt that this thing should have been made by a big boss who had awakened his talent during a totem period.
Just like General Mu Huiyin, he extracted his Beast Taming power. The creator of the stone mirror was also a legend.
"This is not a loss."
Soon, Shi Yu confirmed that he would make a big earning.
Although this thing couldn't directly increase strength, its value was ridiculous.
If that An Chang knew the use and sold it to the association and the financial group, the other party would buy it for tens of billions. Not to mention treating the loss of life, the entire hospital could even be gifted to him.
"Let's go take a look at him later."
A stable tool to create cubs of monarch species.
With this, he could be like a Beast Tamer with awakened talent, wholesale high-level pets.
Of course, it wasn't a zero price.
When activated, it would consume the physical strength of the Beast Tamer. It would probably be the same as the awakening talent. The greater the potential of the awakened target, the greater the consumption of the body.
Helping a caterpillar evolve into a green worm had consumed some of Shi Yu's physical strength. If he awakened a mountain, Shi Yu estimated that the physical strength consumed would not be small.
In addition, not everything could evolve through awakening talent. Awakening evolution also required a certain aptitude.
In the historical records, there were also Beast Tamers with awakened talent who wanted to evolve their snot into transcendent life forms. They wanted to evolve their shit into a shit monster to fight against enemies and disgust them, but they directly ended in failure.
This was considered very crude. There were also records that Beast Tamers with awakened talent wanted to evolve the meteorites falling from the sky into life forms, wanted to evolve high-level resources into life forms, wanted to evolve the ferocious beasts from the ancient era into transcendent life forms, and let the ancient creatures revive… but they all ended in failure.
Perhaps it wasn't that these things didn't have the aptitude for evolution, but that the ability to awaken talent was limited. It could only evolve specific batches of beasts, plants, and elements.
It was precisely because of the limitation of the awakening talent that the awakening talent only became a powerful talent in the top ten, when someone in the modern era discovered a Mechanic that could awaken steadily.
"I wonder if this Awakening Mirror can be effective against ancient biological fossils…"
"What about the phantom illusion that uses the ancient biological fossil as the core? Can it reverse the phantom and awaken it into life… If it can, this is considered cloning, right?"
"Wait, don't be happy too early. After all, this is an inanimate object. It can't grow as a Beast Tamer grows like an awakened talent. What if there's an upper limit that's just a toy and can only awaken transcendent races?" Shi Yu calmed down.
At that time, forget about the fossil life forms, the commander race would be inaccessible.
"However, even if it can only awaken transcendent races, it's not useless."
At this moment, with history as an example, Shi Yu held the stone mirror and suddenly felt that the best use of this thing might be to use it in the mechanical domain.
The greatest characteristic of Mechanics was that they could fuse and arm themselves to evolve. They could rely on upgrading the mechanical beasts' parts to make their mechanical pets stronger. They didn't have to do it in one go, so it wouldn't consume too much physical strength for Beast Tamers at once.
It wasn't impossible to upgrade and assemble a monarch race machine with ten thousand transcendent race parts.
Up until now, there had been no record of Beast Tamers who had awakened their overlord race pets directly. However, Mechanics could awaken different parts through awakening their talent and upgrade and assemble overlord race machinery. This was the most impressive thing about Mechanics.
Shi Yu could not sit still anymore and imagined it.
"With the ancient fossil and phantom illusion as the core energy source, what about equipping it with the mechanical life shell? Mechanical Tyrant Dragon Beast? Mechanic class, ancient species? Is this considered opening a new mechanical beast faction?"
"Now, does this mean that he even has the capital to join the fourth bureau?"
Shi Yu slapped his thigh. He would fight anyone who said that the archeology Department had no future. Who else could join the Mechanical Bureau with archeology!
No matter what the upper limit of this stone mirror was, awakening a transcendent race was definitely not a problem.
For Mechanics, this was enough.
At that time, with additional points, it might not be impossible to create powerful mechanical lives.
He had decided. Next, he would collect various mechanical materials and create a Gundam like creating the Ice Dragon Blade!! He wanted to change departments and study in the Mechanic class!
"Change, change!"
"Mommy, look, there's a fool…"
"…"

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - A Tragic End for the People of Wu Ling
chapters.content:
Chapter 238 A Tragic End for the People of Wu Ling
Wu Ling City Hospital.
In an office, Director Yao, who was in charge of the recovery of the Beast Tamer’s major injuries, was handling the documents in his hand.
On his office table, a white dandelion lay in the flower pot and yawned.
This was a plant-type pet that was good at healing.
At this moment, there was a knock on the door. Director Yao looked up and said, “Please come?in.”
The door was pushed open. A teenager about fifteen or sixteen years old said at the door, “Director Yao.”
“It’s An Chang, come in quickly.” Director Yao smiled and said, “Didn’t you have class today?” “It’s better for you to go to school in peace now. Don’t keep coming here. The hospital plans to organize another donation. Don’t worry about your mother’s next treatment.” “Well, Director Yao, I got the money.” After An Chang entered, he said more excitedly, “It’s exactly five million. I remember you previously said that the treatment chances of a medicine are above 90%, right?”
“Uh.” Director Yao was slightly stunned. “Where did you get the money?”
They were all too clear about the conditions of the An Chang family. Although it was alright in the past, An Chang’s parents, who had become vegetative because of an accident, couldn’t afford much treatment now.
“Don’t tell me you sold the pet your father left you?” Director Yao was shocked and said.
“No, I found an antique at home and successfully sold it,” An Chang said. “Director Yao, with the medicine, my mom can recover, right?”
Director Yao nodded in surprise. He was still a little stunned. What antique could be sold for five million yuan? Why didn’t he hear An Chang mention it before?
“Well… When can we start the treatment? I can pay the fee at any time,” An Chang said anxiously.
“Miao??”
At this moment, the white dandelion that was napping at Director Yao’s desk suddenly froze. It floated up from the flower pot and looked at An Chang in surprise. To be precise, it looked at his pocket.
“Mu?!!”
The dandelion suddenly shouted and flew in front of An Chang, scaring him.
“Why, what’s wrong?”
“Uh.” At this moment, Director Yao was also a little confused by White Pu Ying’s actions. But soon, White Pu Ying transferred her perception to Director Yao.
“Mu!!” The white dandelion was very serious.
In his pocket, there was a very high-level resource! Very high! “Is there… anything in your pocket?” Director Yao asked.
As soon as he finished speaking, An Chang was stunned and quickly took out a white fruit.
At this moment, when it saw this white fruit, the white dandelion directly exploded, and its saliva flowed out of its mouth.
It even hallucinated in front of its eyes and saw a cute ginseng baby waving at it.
Love, love.
“Mu!!”
It quickly turned around and told its Beast Tamer that it felt that this thing… could increase its life level and let it complete its evolution!
“What?!” Director Yao was stunned and was directly shocked. This white dandelion was his new medical pet. He also knew the evolution conditions. It was definitely not something a random fruit could help evolve casually. However, the white dandelion was telling him now that it sensed that this fruit could allow it to complete its evolution?
What quality resource could make the white dandelion have such a reaction…
“Yes, by the way, Doctor Yao, this fruit…” An Chang said,” The person who bought my antiques gave it to me. He said that it might treat life loss and wanted me to show it to you.
He handed the nutritional fruit to Director Yao.
At this moment, Director Yao took the nutritional fruit and White Dandelion landed on his shoulder. Both parties sensed it and their expressions immediately became serious.
“Although this fruit is a level-four resource, the purity of the life force is very high and very rare. It might be more suitable to treat life loss than that five million Life Potion… Its value is very high.”
He had been a doctor for so many years, but he had never seen this fruit. The rarest thing was that this fruit could actually help pets evolve?
“Really??” An Chang was stunned.
It was worth more than five million yuan??
“But after all, there’s no precedent for using it. The hospital definitely won’t use this fruit with unknown information as a medicine. This fruit… No, who was the person who gave you the fruit? Do you know his identity?”
Director Yao said, “The value of this fruit is above five million yuan. Who exactly did you encounter…”
“I don’t know… But he’s not much older than me.” An Chang was extremely confused. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to casually give him such a precious thing.
Director Yao’s expression was serious. Was he a second-generation heir or a rich second-generation heir?
Such a person liked to collect strange things. In addition, he was generous. “Keep this fruit well. My suggestion is to still use the Life Potion to treat it. You can go to a professional feeding agency to appraise this fruit and give it to your pet to eat or sell to our hospital.” Director Yao handed the fruit to An Chang
Beside him, White Dandelion’s face was filled with tears. Could it eat it?
“If possible, I’ll call the Dean over later. At that time, please show us this fruit again.”
“Also, can you still contact the person who gave you the fruit?” Director Yao looked at the confused An Chang and said. He wanted to ask if there were any more of these fruits. If there were, Wu Ling Hospital would definitely be willing to buy a large amount of these fruits.
“I have his number…” An Chang said.
“By the way, his name is?”
“Shi Yu.” An Chang remembered Shi Yu’s name and phone very clearly along the way.
Wu Ling City.
Shi Yu had already come out of the park. He had tested it with the Tyrant Dragon fossil just now. Unfortunately, this stone mirror was really not powerful. It couldn’t give life at all.
Forget about the Tyrant Dragon fossil, he couldn’t even awaken a high-level energy crystal into an elemental life form.
It really could only awaken transcendent races?
Damn, no wonder in the historical scene, it was a child playing with it.
Perhaps it was really a toy prepared by some big boss for a child.
This way, if he wanted to use this stone mirror well, he had to choose the Mechanic class. After all, only the Mechanic class could rely on assembling and upgrading to create mechanical lives of high races.
As Shi Yu was mumbling, his cell phone suddenly rang. When Shi Yu saw that it was an unknown number, he was conflicted between answering and ignoring the two options.
A moment later.
“Who is it?”
“Are you Mr. Shi Yu? I’m the director of Wu Ling City Hospital, Yao Jie. Do you know a child named An Chang?”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. “What’s wrong?”
“Did you give him a special fruit?” “Our hospital wants to buy a large amount of this fruit. I wonder if you have the intention to talk about it… If it can be used in medical treatment, this fruit is definitely a top-notch divine medicine.”
Shi Yu patted his chest, scaring him. He thought that something had happened to the patient after eating the nutritional fruit. If he could eat it as a candy, others might not necessarily be able to. It was precisely because of this that he got An Chang to get a nutritional fruit for the doctor to see first.
From the looks of it, the hospital had found him after discovering the value of the nutritional fruit?
The max-level nutritional fruit was indeed extraordinary… Firstly, the nutritional fruit was condensed by the ginseng baby into its own nutrition.
It had also been modified by skills such as the level-eight Fruit of Life, the source of life of a super skill, the Dao Proficiency Sweet Aura, and Slow Healing. In addition to the nutritional multiplication of the Dao Proficiency Fruit, the fruit condensed could be said to heal someone to death. Its not the most amazing medicine, but it could indeed be considered a medical divine medicine.
At least, no matter how serious the injuries caused by Buggy and Eleven’s training were, a fruit could instantly recover to its original state. A hole in its body could slowly recover, and it could also subtly change its physique. It was dozens of times better than their own high-speed healing.
“Not interested.” Shi Yu rejected directly.
Although the nutritional fruit of the ginseng baby could indeed save many people, how could the ginseng baby have the energy to create in large quantities? Moreover, after it flowed into the market, it would definitely be exclusive to high-level people. The injuries and illnesses of rich people could be cured no matter what. The reason why the illness of poor people couldn’t be cured was purely because they didn’t have money. It had nothing to do with medicine, and it wasn’t very meaningful to cooperate with Wu Ling Hospital.
When Baby Ginseng developed a commoner divine medicine with a high cost-effective ratio one day, it would be better to directly cooperate with the Medical Bureau of Division 13. At that time, he could join another bureau…
[Ginseng Baby:…]
“Ah…” When he heard Shi Yu’s rejection, Director Yao was stunned. Opposite him, an old man in a white coat stared.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s voice sounded again.
“By the way, can that An Chang’s mother be cured? Does he have enough money?”
Shi Yu recalled the most important thing. He felt a little apologetic to have obtained a divine weapon from the other party. Ignoring everything else, at least the money for treatment couldn’t be insufficient.
“There shouldn’t be a problem.”
“Should??” Shi Yu asked. “It means, not 100%?”
“Is there a treatment plan for 100% recovery?”
“Forget it, Wu Ling City Hospital, right? I’ll go take a look now.” Shi Yu glanced at the time. It was still early, and the two seniors probably weren’t done shopping.
At the same time, after Shi Yu hung up, in an office in Wu Ling City’s hospital, Director Yao, the president of Wu Ling City’s hospital, and the other doctors looked at the nutritional fruits in the container on the table and fell into deep thought.
“Is the other party really called Shi Yu?” Dean Bai confirmed with Director Yao again.
“Yeah, Dean, what’s wrong?” Director Yao asked.
“This name is a little familiar,” a female chief doctor said.
“Shi Yu, a student from Ancient Capital University, the top scholar of Ancient Capital University’s vocation assessment this year. Of course, these titles are nothing.” Dean Bai shook his head and said,
“Most importantly, Shi Yu won first place in this year’s Imperial Capital Feeding Conference. He brought the Feeding Team of Ancient Capital University, including the legend Hua Xiajin and Dr. Zuo Jiangyun, and researched the evolution plan of the Green Silkworm cocoon that affected the Beast Taming Domain. He himself is also the Beast Tamer of the overlord species’ Butterfly of Imagination… He was evaluated by the media as an outstanding youth of the year… Could it be him?”
As Dean Bai finished speaking, the doctors in the room widened their eyes.
“Of course, I can’t be sure if it’s the real person, or maybe it’s just a different name?”
A moment later, at Wu Ling City Hospital.
Shi Yu followed the agreed address and teleported over.
In the room, Dean Bai, Director Yao, and some other doctors were communicating around the nutritional fruits on the table.
At this moment, Shi Yu arrived under the lead of a young nurse.
After they knocked and entered, the young nurse said,
“Dean Bai, Mr. Shi Yu is here.”
In the room, six doctors in white coats looked over.
Five of the doctors looked at Shi Yu in surprise.
Among the few of them, the older Dean Bai looked at Shi Yu and compared it with his memories again. His expression changed in shock.
“Student Shi Yu, so it’s really you. Hello.”
He quickly walked forward, his expression turning surprised and pleasantly surprised. He ran over warmly to shake Shi Yu’s hand. “Hello, hello. I’m the dean of Wu Ling City’s hospital, Bai He.”
“Hello.” Shi Yu was slightly stunned. So enthusiastic?
After seeing Shi Yu, Dean Bai, who had been feeling that there was something wrong with the name Shi Yu since just now, was completely certain. He introduced him to Director Yao and the others. “Let me introduce you.”
“This is Student Shi Yu, a top student from Ancient Capital University. He’s first in this year’s Imperial Capital Feeding Conference.” Dean Bai had a smile on his face. Under the shocked expressions of the chief physicians, he said, “I didn’t expect the owner of this fruit to be Student Shi Yu. I didn’t expect…”
It was really Shi Yu himself!
Although Shi Yu was still a student, to be able to let a legendary Beast Tamer and a famous professor act as his assistant… To be evaluated as having legendary talent, how could he be an ordinary person?
Many doctors and even Dean Bai showed polite and respectful expressions.
At this moment, Shi Yu discovered the nutritional fruit on the table.
Seeing this, Director Yao immediately said, “Little Chang entrusted us to appraise it. Student Shi Yu, you just said that you came for An Chang?”
At this moment, after confirming Shi Yu’s identity, everyone stopped mentioning the nutritional fruit. No matter where Shi Yu obtained it, with Shi Yu’s identity, he wouldn’t choose a city hospital in a second-level city even if he wanted to do a collaboration. They knew their position. “Yes, can I understand his situation?”
The doctors looked at each other. Director Yao said, “Let me explain.”
“This child An Chang… His parents are both fishermen and Beast Tamers. His family conditions were originally not bad, but during a trip to catch fish, his parents encountered a mutated and evolved sea beast. That sea beast was very strong and fierce. The two of them were no match for it. In the end, although they barely escaped, in order to protect them, their pets basically died. In addition, they both had Fusion Talent and also fought. After escaping, their condition wasn’t very good. After a wave of drowning and drifting, they finally became like this…”
“That was a year ago. An Chang’s father failed his treatment and passed away. His mother’s condition is relatively better, but she needs continuous treatment. In the past year, the treatment fees for the two of them have almost spent all the savings in An Chang’s family.”
“This child is also miserable. He lost his parents when he was only in his teens, and he doesn’t have any other family members…” Dean Bai sighed.
Shi Yu :”…”
It was indeed very tragic.
His father had Fusion Talent?
It had the same talent as the beast-eared girl…
However, although the beast-eared girl was powerful, it didn’t mean that this talent was strong. In the eyes of some people, this talent was inferior to an ordinary strengthening talent.
Unless there was a mine at home to ensure that the Beast Tamer’s physique was too strong, the Fusion Talent was still very deceptive.
Beast Tamers with Fusion Talent couldn’t avoid their own battles if they wanted to perfectly unleash their talent. And once it involved their own battles, the chances of their bodies having problems were too high. The pets could still barely rely on their outstanding racial advantages to withstand some serious injuries, but human Beast Tamers…
The beast-eared girl’s family was rich and it was a traditional martial arts family. She had trained her physique since she was young and far exceeded her peers. Only then could she let her be bold enough to tear apart a monarch-level pet with her bare hands. If it were other Fusion Talent Beast Tamers with trash physiques, their own battles would be purely suicidal. Even with the enhancement of the pet fusion, the chances of their bodies having problems were still very high.
In addition, the fishermen were in a dangerous industry. An Chang’s parents should have been mentally prepared for this situation long ago.
In the end, it was still because the Fusion Talent was a scam. This was also why many Beast Tamers with the Fusion Talent went to do irregular jobs. At least, the danger was small and the money was high. Now, it was too difficult to be a proper Beast Tamer.
“Like I said on the phone, how much do you need to press the 100% cure? I’ll pay,” Shi Yu said.
He planned to help the other party pay all the treatment fees.
Dean Bai: “Money? No need. This child, An Chang, is honest and filial. After his parents were hospitalized, it was really not easy for him to work and study alone. Now that it has come to this, our hospital has already planned to pay to treat his mother.”
“100% is good,” Dean Bai said confidently.
Shi Yu: “?”
Why didn’t Shi Yu believe that the hospital was so kind?
The doctors smiled in embarrassment. They weren’t that kind in the first place. At most, everyone would donate and sponsor them. After all, the price of the medicine wasn’t cheap. If it was like this for every injured patient, the hospital wouldn’t be able to continue operating. When the time came, the problem would be even greater, but now… Shi Yu was here. They had to be good until the end. They couldn’t really let Shi Yu pay, right?
Special people had to be treated specially.
“No, I have to pay,” Shi Yu said.
Otherwise, he would burn his hands with guilt using this stone mirror.
If it was the rich lady’s thing, he would take it and treat himself as a freeloader. In any case, he had been living off the country since he was young in his previous life and was used to it.
Unfortunately, it wasn’t a rich lady this time, but a poor guy. He didn’t feel at ease doing it and felt awkward.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - Evolution Planner Shi Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 239 Evolution Planner Shi Yu
A moment later, after Shi Yu negotiated with the courtyard, everyone went to find An Chang. “An Chang.” “Come out for a while.”
In a ward, An Chang was lying on the bed accompanying his unconscious mother. He had been running around for the whole day and was already exhausted and very tired. At this moment, when he heard someone call him, An Chang woke up in a daze and walked out of the ward.
As soon as he came out, he saw Dean Bai, Director Yao, and Shi Yu beside them. At that moment, when he saw Shi Yu again, An Chang was extremely excited. He didn’t know what to say. The help one received at the most desperate moment was the most direct to the heart. Shi Yu’s five million plus the nutritional fruit worth more than five million could directly allow his mother to undergo a treatment plan with a 100% healing rate. An Chang didn’t know how to thank him, so he directly wanted to kneel down and thank Shi Yu.
“What are you doing? Your legs are numb again?”
Shi Yu was agile and grabbed him with one hand like he was picking up a chicken.
An Chang:…
“I…”
“Well, An Chang, your mother’s healing surgery can begin later. Mr. Shi Yu is willing to bear the full cost,” Dean Bai said with a smile.
An Chang was even more at a loss. “Don’t be excited, it’s only right. The antique you sold to me is a treasure. I’ve already found a way to use it. To be precise, I’m still the one benefitting the most,” Shi Yu said.
An Chang shook his head and stubbornly wanted to kneel down to thank Shi Yu. In the next moment, Shi Yu picked him up along with his shirt.
An Chang :”…” He felt that his parents weren’t as strong as Shi Yu in their combined state.
When he was young, An Chang, who was often educated by his parents in the state of being possessed by ferocious beasts, knew his parents’ strength very well. Dean Bai and Director Yao :”…” “Little Chang, Mr. Shi Yu definitely doesn’t need thanks in this way. Your mother will definitely be fine, so next, the key is for you to go to school well. When the time comes, you can get into a good university so that you can repay Mr. Shi Yu better,” Director Yao said beside him.
“This is for you. Let your dragon carp eat this. It can increase your evolution potential. At that time, that Dragon Carp’s potential will be even greater after it transforms into a dragon. The pet your father left for you is still very good.” Director Yao returned the nutritional fruit to An Chang Beside him, Shi Yu said in surprise, “Dragon Carp?” “Your pet is a Dragon Carp.” “A dragon carp that can transform into a dragon… The classic “leaping through the dragon gate”?” Shi Yu put down the confused An Chang. Beside him, An Chang nodded in confusion. This Dragon Carp was also one of his family’s heirlooms. He had been raising it since his grandfather’s generation and had raised it for decades before it reached transcendent. It was an initial pet prepared for him by his family and had deep feelings for him.
“I see…” Shi Yu nodded.
The Dragon Carp was the same as the Green Silkworm. The Green Silkworm could rely on the worm silk cocoon to evolve, while the Dragon Carp could rely on the levelless water-element skill to “leap over the Dragon Gate” and evolve into a high class commander species’ pseudo dragon “Fish Dragon”. The difference was that the evolution of the Green Silkworm cocoon didn’t have a high requirement for the proficiency of the worm silk, but the Dragon Carp could only evolve after reaching transcendent. Moreover, Dragon Gate was also harder to train than the worm silk. One had to climb the waterfall and reverse the flow to increase proficiency. The only advantage of a Dragon Carp compared to a Green Silkworm was its lifespan. This thing could even live for decades in the sewage. It wasn’t impossible to nurture it and live for 100 years. Under its long lifespan, some Dragon Carp with aptitude, willpower, and good luck still had the possibility of transforming into a dragon, but there were definitely not as many Green Silkworms that became Butterflies.
“When do you plan to let the Dragon Carp evolve?” Shi Yu asked.
“This…” An Chang said,” I don’t know.”
He originally planned to do it earlier, but because something like this happened to his family, he really didn’t have the money to raise another high class commander species’ dragon-element tycoon. Therefore, he kept the Dragon Carp in its initial state. “Are you planning to evolve into a fish dragon?”
“Yes.”
“You also have the Fusion Talent, right? Do you want me to help you?” Shi Yu chuckled. “I know a special evolution method.” The cultivation index in front of Shi Yu opened. [Dragon Carp’s Special Evolution Method): After the Dragon Carp’s Dragon Leaping Gate reaches transcendent, consume more than 100 g of Dragon Bone Powder and carry level five to six water and dragon dual-element resources to use for the Dragon Leaping Gate. There is a chance of special evolution. This was a special evolution plan for the Dragon Carp recorded in the third bureau’s cultivation index.
Dragon Bone Powder was a common medicinal ingredient. It wasn’t expensive, and the hospital had it. As for level-five water and dragon-element dragon-element props… Shi Yu could now get Buggy to imitate the scales of a sea dragon to make one. It was as simple as crushing a clay figurine. At this moment, as Shi Yu spoke, An Chang was stunned again. Dean Bai and the others beside him were also shocked.
Holy shit.
As expected of a big boss who could develop the Green Silkworm cocoon to become an overlord race. He gave the evolution plan just like that. Those evolution planners helped people plan an evolution. It was basically a sky-high price. How could Shi Yu be so generous? “No, this is too much,” An Chang said nervously. “I really don’t know how to repay you this
way.”
“You mean you want it, right?” Shi Yu could tell that the other party still wanted to. “No, your skin is too thin. You should say “Yes! I can only become stronger with stronger pets. Then I can repay you better in the future.” Shi Yu sighed. As expected of himself. He actually said similar things to Senior Lu without blushing back then. An Chang :”…” Dean Bai and Director Yao :”…” “Dean Bai, is there a relatively empty place here?”
“Yes…”
“Where’s the medicinal ingredient, Dragon Bone Powder?”
“Yes, we have it.” “That’s enough.” Shi Yu clapped his hands and said, “Then let’s prepare?” If he helped this An Chang plan the evolution of his pet, Shi Yu felt that he could go back and find Senior Lu.
At this moment, An Chang felt like he was in a dream. He felt that his dark life had suddenly become bright. Shi Yu was the guide who pulled him from darkness to light. At the hospital of Wu Ling City, in the backyard of a deserted recovery training ground. Dean Bai brought Shi Yu and An Chang here.
Soon, Director Yao also rushed over with a bag of Dragon Bone Powder. Seeing that, Shi Yu saw that the materials were all gathered and said to An Chang, “Summon your pet.” “Alright…” An Chang nodded and summoned the formation.
The next moment, a nearly one-meter-long dragon carp appeared in the colorless array. Judging from the physique, it wasn’t young anymore. “Chi -” “Chi “
The red and yellow dragon carp fluttered on the ground. “Li (water) -” “Li (water) ~” “Well, Bubbles, please bear with it… This is part of evolution.”
Beside him, An Chang said carefully. Shi Yu :”…”
Good thing he wasn’t the only one who was bad at naming
However, this part was not part of evolution.
At this moment, Dean Bai and Director Yao said, “Well, let’s leave first.” Usually, when evolution planners helped pets plan their evolution, they were unwilling to let others see it. “It’s alright, it’ll be done soon.” Shi Yu said indifferently. After saying that, a shocking scene suddenly happened. In midair, a stream of water suddenly appeared. Then, the stream of water grew bigger and bigger. At first, there was a whoosh, and then the water curtain attacked them like a violent wind and huge waves, ringing through the sky and covering the blue sky. Only the waterfall was left chanting in the world. A huge waterfall and lake appeared out of thin air in front of the three of them, making Dean Bai and Director Yao’s eyes widen. When An Chang, who was beside them, saw this miracle, he was so shocked that he couldn’t say anything. “Chi -” “Chi ~”
Only the Dragon Carp’s excited water gradually leaped into the Lake of Imagination and looked up at the waterfall.
At this moment, a small blue butterfly landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder without anyone noticing. “You can let it eat the Dragon Bone Powder.” Shi Yu said. “Oh, oh.” At this moment, An Chang had already accepted everything and listened to Shi Yu’s arrangements. He had already thought it through. Shi Yu was right. It was good to let the Dragon Carp evolve now. Only by becoming a very strong Beast Tamer could he repay Shi Yu’s kindness better!
He scattered the bag of Dragon Bone Powder handed over by Director Yao in the water. Soon, the Dragon Carp swam over and swallowed it all.
“Throw that fruit in too, but don’t let it eat it first,” Shi Yu said.
Upon hearing that, An Chang also threw the nutritional fruits in his pocket into the lake. The dragon carp was first stunned, then it looked at the nutritional fruit eagerly.
In the next moment, the dragon carp’s expression changed drastically as it sensed the suppression from its bloodline. “Roar!!!”
Waves splashed, and a huge roar sounded, making everyone look at the waterfall.
At this moment, in the waterfall, a faint dragon-shaped phantom condensed. A sea dragon king more than ten meters long with a yellow belly and a blue back shuttled through the waterfall in an illusory manner. With a boom, this sea dragon showed its dragon might and directly crawled out, dragging its long body to circle the sky, looking at the dragon carp below with a dignified gaze. “Sea… Sea… Sea Dragon King.” Seeing this pet, An Chang was extremely shocked. Overlord race, Sea Dragon King..! Beside him, Dean Bai and Director Yao opened their mouths wide as they watched this magical scene.
“Roar!!!”
Under their gaze, the Sea Dragon King glanced down indifferently. Its figure turned from corporeal to ethereal again and directly flew down. Its huge body entered the nutritional fruit with a bang, directly dyeing the white nutritional fruit’s surface with rings of blue patterns. Baby Ginseng and Buggy jointly created the Dragon Transformation Fruit!
“Alright, you can eat now.” “After eating, let’s do the Dragon Leaping Gate.” Shi Yu spoke calmly. After letting Buggy modify the nutritional fruit with the power of imagination, he watched with interest. At this moment, although he was extremely shocked, An Chang still quickly followed Shi Yu’s instructions and let the dragon carp eat the nutritional fruits.
At that moment, looking at the nutritional fruit that the Sea Dragon King had just crawled into, the Dragon Carp was extremely afraid. However, the tempting aura emitted by the nutritional fruit made it swim over again. The dragon carp’s eyes widened. After pondering for a moment, it directly swallowed the fruit. In the next moment, with a boom, a divine dragon seemed to open its eyes in its body. Under this huge motivation, it quickly swam to the front of the waterfall and carefully observed that magnificent style. After its gaze gradually became determined, it directly leaped up with the Leaping Dragon Gate skill. The huge waterfall that Buggy imagined was majestic and spectacular. Water splashed down rapidly, like ten thousand wild horses galloping and roaring. Under this pressure, the Dragon Carp’s Dragon Leaping Gate directly activated the evolution potential in its body, causing its entire body to bloom with dazzling white light. “This…”
Dean Bai and Director Yao muttered. They couldn’t understand it. Even if they saw it with their own eyes, they couldn’t understand it at all. The Butterfly of Imagination could be used like this? The two of them looked at the pet on Shi Yu’s shoulder. In the next moment, they were attracted by the Dragon Carp again. “Roar!!!” During the process of climbing the waterfall in the opposite direction, An Chang’s dragon carp’s figure gradually changed under the white light. It gradually lengthened into a five to six-meter long dragon-shaped body, and its roar became more and more deafening. It had red pupils and a fierce and domineering expression. After evolution, it directly broke through the waterfall and leaped into the sky. This was definitely not a low-level alternative dragon fish that looked like a fish. At this moment, as they looked at this strong dark-blue dragon-shaped body, Dean Bai and Director Yao widened their eyes. This… This… This… At the side, after receiving the feedback from the dragon carp’s evolution, An Chang was immediately stunned on the spot. Shi Yu also looked at everything in surprise. The index in front of him displayed the information after the dragon carp evolved. It wasn’t a new race, but an existing race. < Name > Sea Dragon [Attributes]: Water, Dragon
[Race Level): Low-level Monarch
[Level of Growth]: Level 10 Awakening [Race Skill]: Leaping Dragon Gate, Water Dragon Bullet, Dragon Tail, Madness, Water Dragon Scroll (Super Level) “Roar!!!” The sea dragon fell into the water and looked at its Beast Tamer quietly. It also looked at Shi Yu and the butterfly on Shi Yu’s shoulder gratefully.
A dragon carp was a creature in a pond… Now it turned into a dragon the moment it encountered Buggy!
“Wu ~” Buggy nodded calmly. Not bad, not bad, he had 30% of its handsomeness.
“You’re a Beast Tamer intern. Under the restriction of your level, it suppressed the opportunity to break through. It’s still at the Awakening level now, but its evolution this time can bring you quite a lot of benefits. For example, the increase in the Beast Taming Space, the increase in physique, and your combination talent. Your physique is stronger than that of ordinary Beast Tamers. In addition, your bond is alright. Eat more supplements. It’s not a big problem for you to bear the growth of a low-level monarch race. It’s good to be a little weak.” “By the way, this is a sea dragon. You should know it, right?” Shi Yu asked the stunned An Chang. “I… I know…” He was already stunned.
Monarch… monarch race?
It was born so easily?? Moreover, it was a powerful dragon-type… He looked at Shi Yu… Who exactly was Shi Yu? At this moment, Shi Yu’s cell phone suddenly rang. Shi Yu took a look and saw that it was White Brook. He immediately understood that it was time to leave. He smiled and said, “I have something urgent to do. I’ll leave first. Call me if you have any questions.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, the waterfall and lake in the courtyard disappeared. The sea dragon fell to the ground. Under the shocked gazes of Dean Bai and the others, Shi Yu teleported and disappeared. After Shi Yu left, everyone, especially An Chang, couldn’t calm down for a long time. “He’s… the most awesome evolution planner I’ve ever seen,” Dean Bai muttered beside him. “As expected of a fierce person who developed such results. I can’t understand it at all, but it’s so impressive. It feels as simple as drinking water,” Director Yao said. Listening to Dean Bai and Director Yao’s discussion, An Chang swallowed his saliva and looked at them. He asked, “Dean Bai, Director Yao…”
“I know. You want to ask him who he is, right?” Director Yao said. An Chang nodded heavily.
Apart from his name and phone number, he didn’t know Shi Yu’s identity at all. He had no direction to repay Shi Yu in the future. Although he didn’t know what was going on, now that he had the Sea Dragon, he was confident of becoming a master-level Beast Tamer and repay these debts. “His name is Shi Yu. He’s a top student from Ancient Capital University. He’s the top scholar of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment this year and a genius archeologist,” Dean Bai sighed. A genius. When An Chang heard that Shi Yu was the top scholar of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment, he was immediately in admiration. The top scholar of the vocation in a first-level city… was definitely worth a lot. However, why did these titles feel like they were nothing compared to the monarch species dragon-type creatures Shi Yu casually planned just now? “Apart from that, he also discovered the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast’s monarch race, the Nine Li Battle Beast.”
“He also studied the Green Silkworm Green Silkworm cocoon evolution system at the Imperial Capital Feeding Conference and established the unprecedented extremely cost-effective Green Silkworm evolution chain. The research results crushed the Feeding Team of the five major financial groups and the eight major universities and easily led Ancient Capital University to win the championship of the Feeding Conference. During this period, even the legendary Beast Tamer Hua Xiajin and the famous Feeding professor Zuo Jiangyun voluntarily became his assistants.” “The evolution chain of the Green Silkworm cocoon contains the unlimited evolution possibility of transcendent to overlord races. It’s said by the Feeding Association to be the best feeding result in the past ten years that can change the structure of Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain. He even relied on this evolution chain to nurture the Butterfly of Imagination, the pet on his shoulder just now… This also made him known as the ‘future legendary Beast Tamer’.” “In short, he’s a very impressive person…” Dean Bai repeated Shi Yu’s honors and was very shocked himself. This was a person? At the side, listening to this ridiculous experience, An Chang was already completely stunned. “Haha, perhaps all of this is indeed a piece of cake for him. There’s no need for you to take it to heart. Even if he’s a master Beast Tamer, perhaps it’s nothing to his current achievements,” Dean Bai said. Not everyone could repay Shi Yu. It was too difficult. “This…” An Chang was stunned. “If a master Beast Tamer can’t, then a legendary Beast Tamer,” he said firmly. Moreover, he still had a family heirloom in the warehouse at home that his father had told him not to lose, sell, or damage. Now that the situation was already like this, he felt that it was fine to find it and give it to Shi Yu in the future. His home was almost gone, so why would he still want a family heirloom? As an archeologist, Shi Yu should like this kind of thing very much. In any case, he didn’t know its use if he left it in their hands. It was better to give it to people who knew how to use it. “Legendary…” Dean Bai smiled and said,” It’s very good to have ambition. Speaking of which, Little Chang, since you don’t have to worry about your mother’s illness now, you also contracted a dragon-type pet of a monarch race. You also want to become stronger. How about I recommend a place for you?” “You should have heard of the Bai Family Dojo. Beast Tamers who specialize in accepting Fusion Talents can let you learn for free before you become a professional Beast Tamer. How about that? Otherwise, it won’t be easy for you to take care of the sea dragon with your current self.”
Wu Ling’s Bai family monopolized many industries such as dojos, medicine, banks, and food in Wu Ling City. What Shi Yu didn’t notice just now was that Dean Bai was also considered a relative of White Brook.
At this moment, seeing a good seedling, Dean Bai suddenly gathered talents for his family. Although it was impossible to become a legend, it shouldn’t be difficult for this An Chang to become a master.
“You’re so fast.”
Outside the largest commercial street of Wu Ling. Just as she hung up with Shi Yu, White Brook realized that Shi Yu had appeared in front of her and Lu Qingyi in the blink of an eye.
“Instant Transmission, low-level,” Shi Yu said.
Lu Qingyi and White Brook were speechless. They glanced at the haggard Buggy and mourned.
Was Buggy lucky or unlucky to have a Beast Tamer like him? “How was your trip?” The beast-eared girl smiled and asked, “Did you find a treasure? You shouldn’t have been cheated, right?? Do you need Senior Lu to appraise it for you?” Shi Yu touched his nose and said, “It’s alright. The harvest was not small. Not only did it help a confused young man fulfill his dream, but I also used five million yuan to buy a legendary tool from the totem era. I reckon I can sell it for tens of billions.” Lu Qingyi and White Brook: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - The Identity of the Stone Mirror’s Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 240 The Identity of the Stone Mirror’s Master
Using five million to conveniently get a tool from the totem era… He could sell it for tens of billions?
The atmosphere became weird. Lu Qingyi and White Brook looked at Shi Yu with question marks in their eyes. Human language? They suspected that Shi Yu was bragging, but they felt that he wasn’t. After all, Shi Yu had also done many ridiculous things in the past. The two of them didn’t find it strange anymore.
There was silence… “Let’s go to my house first.” After White Brook hesitated, she said, “Just now, my parents called me and said that dinner will be ready soon.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “It’s not convenient to talk here either.”
Lu Qingyi and White Brook were silent again. This guy was serious…
“Then let Buggy bring us over. Senior, you’ll guide us?” Shi Yu touched his head and laughed.
Buggy…. “Alright.” White Brook agreed.
Under White Brook’s navigation, Buggy quickly brought the three of them to half the city area and arrived at White Brook’s house.
Although the Bai family was a large family, White Brook’s family lived independently. The family of three lived in a large manor. “So luxurious…”
Outside the manor, after White Brook confirmed that there was no problem with the destination Buggy had arrived at, Shi Yu said in confusion.
This area felt more than ten times larger than the Ping Cheng villa President Feng had given him?
A family of three? Then, Shi Yu saw a huge kennel nearly 100 square meters in front of the manor. It was probably prepared for a certain pet. Shi Yu :”…” Then it was fine. His brain quickly analyzed. Senior Panda’s family was the richest family in Ping Cheng. Ping Cheng was an ordinary suburb of Icefield City, a second-level city… As for Wu Ling City, it was ranked at the top of the development rankings in the second-level city. The Bai family was the richest family in Wu Ling… He understood.
Super rich woman.
After White Brook arrived at her door, she stretched.
When she heard Shi Yu’s words, she smiled and said, “It’s alright, Senior Lu’s house is more luxurious.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Lu Qingyi’s expression was calm. “Is that so?”
Shi Yu muttered in his heart that it was quite possible…
Although the title of the richest man in Wu Ling was already very impressive, Lu Qingyi’s grandfather was the principal of Ancient Capital University. He worked in three top departments part-time and even had a relationship with the guardian. He was once a legendary Beast Tamer. Lu Qingyi herself was also a genius of Bureau 11. Her family situation would probably be scarier…
Compared to the beast-eared girl, Senior Lu was no longer a rich second-generation heir. Just her identity alone was already an absolute rich first-generation super rich woman. Shi Yu didn’t want to work hard anymore. “Can’t always freeload. I’m the one who’s richer now.” However, after analyzing it, Shi Yu quickly abandoned the thought of reaping benefits without sowing. He could already be self-sufficient, and he was no longer the poor guy who wanted to sell worm silk to become rich!
Ignoring everything else, just the price of the stone mirror he had just obtained was difficult to estimate. Of course, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t sell it.
“Miss, you’re back.”
After Shi Yu and the others arrived at the entrance of the manor, a servant quickly appeared inside. “Wu ~” At this moment, Buggy lay weakly on Shi Yu’s shoulder and asked if it could go back and rest. [Go, go, go!] Shi Yu said. Buggy still couldn’t do it. It had only done this little work today and it was already tired. And this was just running traffic in a city. In the future, if he needed to use teleportation to travel from the ancient capital to Ping Cheng, wouldn’t Buggy be even weaker? Or, he could teleport from Dong Huang to other countries. Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Well… this might be a little difficult for Buggy. Even if Buggy reached the overlord level, it probably couldn’t. If he wanted it to be more convenient, it looked like he still had to have his mechanical pet.
The beast-eared girl had said that her parents walked the business path in the family. They were businessmen and were in charge of the family’s business. However, when Shi Yu saw the other party, he realized that he had imagined their image wrongly. They didn’t look like an entrepreneur or businessman at all. Instead, they looked more like a fighter than White Brook.
Father Bai was nearly two meters tall and had a tall and sturdy figure. The white suit he was wearing couldn’t hide his muscles at all. Mother Bai was also 1.8 meters tall. She was tall and had a single ponytail that only battle workers had.
This made Shi Yu wonder what was wrong with Senior White Brook’s petite figure. “Qingyi is here.” “Long time no see.” After the few of them entered the manor, Father Bai and Mother Bai happened to come out to welcome them. When they saw the three of them, they immediately smiled. “This must be Shi Yu. We often hear Little Xi mention you. Welcome, welcome. Don’t be too polite. Treat this place as your home.” “Uncle Bai, Aunt Bai.” Lu Qingyi smiled. “Uncle, Auntie, hello, sorry to disturb you,” Shi Yu also greeted. After the two of them greeted each other, they handed the gifts they had prepared in advance to Father Bai and Mother Bai. It was rare for them to visit, so they couldn’t come empty-handed. Next, under the hospitality of his parents, Shi Yu and the others enjoyed a big meal. The servants kept taking out hot delicacies from the kitchen.
Shi Yu could tell that although it looked like a family of three, there were many servants and chefs in the entire manor. There were also a lot of people who took care of the plants and ornamental pets in the manor. This made Shi Yu sigh again how good it was to be rich. He even had the thought of raising some ornamental pets other than contracted pets to show off his love. Many Beast Tamers with a telepathy talent had a second pet that they didn’t contract. This was very normal! This was the correct way to use the telepathy talent.
“I heard from Xiaoxi that the three of you are going to participate in the martial arts conference this time?”
At the dining table, Nanny Bai asked Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi curiously. “Huh?! Huh?”
Shi Yu, who had just finished drinking a mouthful of fruit juice, saw that the conversation had changed from Father Bai and Mother Bai praising his various archeological and Feeding achievements to talking about the martial arts conference. Just as he answered, he suddenly felt that something was wrong. “Senior Lu is also participating??” Shi Yu looked at Lu Qingyi in surprise. “Of course.” Beside him, White Brook snorted. Otherwise, how did Shi Yu think she convinced Lu Qingyi?
It was because Senior Lu wanted to participate
too.
“I’ve also contracted an undead who has mastered the possession skill recently.” Lu Qingyi smiled. “Ah…” Shi Yu was stunned. She really contracted it? Back then, Lu Qingyi realized that Shi Yu’s possession state was pretty good. She said that she would try contracting a similar undead if she had the chance. Shi Yu originally thought that it was a joke, but he didn’t expect that after a few months, Senior Lu really contracted one… “What undead?” Shi Yu asked. “It’s a secret. You’ll know at the martial arts conference.”
Lu Qingyi’s tone suddenly became a little nervous. After she contracted this undead… After possessing it, it looked good… But… the style of change was a little special. She felt that she couldn’t control it a little.
“Haha, Qingyi is much more reserved than when she was young.” Father Bai couldn’t help but say, “She’s completely different from when she was young.” “Yes.” Mother Bai also smiled.
The one who agreed the most was White Brook. When she was young, she and Senior Lu had played house. The two of them were originally lovey dovey friends, but when they grew up, Lu Qingyi just drifted away. It was too much. At this moment, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. It was fine if Senior White Brook participated, but there were probably many master-level Beast Tamers in the martial arts conference. Why was Senior Lu, a top-notch master, also participating? Oh shit, the competition ranking would be for number two now.
After dinner.
White Brook brought Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi to the residence prepared for them. On the way, Shi Yu also started to talk about what happened on Antique Street. When the two of them heard about selling an antique to save a mother, about how Shi Yu successfully listened to the Voice of History… They were confused Lu Qingyi found it very difficult to accept. “You, you heard the Voice of History again??” This was clearly something that depended on luck and opportunities. Why did it… happen so frequently on Shi Yu! “What kind of luck is this?” White Brook was also stunned.
She had heard from her grandfather that entrusting something with a major historical process and extremely historical value might not necessarily produce a “historical spirit”, but an ancient item that produced a “historical spirit” would definitely have gone through a major historical process or have extreme historical value.
Shi Yu had heard history, which meant that he had indeed encountered a precious antique.
“What is it? What did you see? What’s the origin of it?” Lu Qingyi couldn’t help but ask. “I don’t know its origin, but… I saw its function.” Shi Yu smiled and casually took out a stone mirror. Then, he asked the beast-eared girl, “Can I use the plants here?”
He casually pointed at a beautiful flower by the roadside.
“Sure, they’re just decorations,” White Brook said.
This was a level-one resource, the Heart-Clearing Flower. The fragrance of the flower could make one feel comfortable. Apart from that, it was beautiful.
At this moment, Shi Yu held the stone mirror and aimed at the blue Heart-Clearing Flower. He muttered to himself,
[Change!) [Change!) Previously, Shi Yu had discovered that thinking of saying those words could also be used with stone mirrors. Out of consideration for his image, Shi Yu chose mental spells. At this moment, under his experiment, the stone mirror directly released a white light that shone on the Heart-Clearing Flower. Then, a scene that shocked Lu Qingyi and White Brook occurred.
After the Heart-Clearing Flower that was planted in the soil was enveloped by the light, its body gradually enlarged in the light, and its life aura multiplied. Then, from an unconscious spiritual plant to an Awakening-level flower demon! “Ning.” The Heart-Clearing Flower Demon glanced at the three of them and pulled out its feet in confusion. It wanted to leave, but after thinking about it, it stuck itself back in and released a little sweetness. As if nothing had happened. “Ning! Ning!”
Lu Qingyi and White Brook:!!! “The function of this stone mirror is similar to the ‘Awakening Talent’. I feel that it’s a family heirloom left behind by a legendary big boss of the totem era who had an ‘Awakening Talent’. It might also be a toy?” “Although it wasn’t very useful in ancient times, with the Mechanic class now, this thing is worth tens of billions. It’s not too much, right?” Shi Yu smiled and said. After a legendary Beast Tamer died, they could inherit the Beast Taming Space. Some more powerful legendary Beast Tamers also had the ability to combine their Beast Taming Talent and modify the Beast Taming Space.
