For example, that was how the Time Ruins of the Imperial Capital University came about. Shi Yu felt that this stone mirror was similar, but he didn’t know why it didn’t have spatial effects. Perhaps it was just a part of the ruins space?
“A tool that can awaken life???” At this moment, as Shi Yu finished showing it, White Brook’s eyes widened completely. Her eyes gradually turned into two lemons.
Just as Shi Yu had said, today, with the modern Mechanic class, this thing was definitely a top-notch divine weapon. White Brook, who had seen Gao Xuan’s overlord race machinery, knew very well the value of this thing. “Ahhh.” She cried out in pain and said, “Why, why am I not a telepathy talent? Why can’t I pick up treasures? You archeologists are cheating.” “Shi Yu-assemble a mechanical pet for me someday, alright!” White Brook couldn’t wait to hug Shi Yu. It wasn’t that her Fusion Talent couldn’t fuse with machines. It was also possible to transform into a puppet. “Don’t come over…” Shi Yu hurriedly stopped White Brook. Men and women shouldn’t touch each other.
What she loved was the stone mirror, the overlord machinery! Not him!
Beside White Brook, Lu Qingyi smiled bitterly. Could she not compare Shi Yu with the other archeologists? Even the other members of Bureau 11 didn’t listen to the voice of history as often as Shi Yu!
Moreover, Shi Yu’s luck… Lu Qingyi’s stomach hurt. However, she could still accept it. This thing was indeed very valuable, but in her eyes, what made her even more envious was actually the key to the Mythical Ruins left behind by Emperor Shi with huge risks. After that stimulation, this was nothing. After all, this one’s upper limit was an overlord machinery and the other was a Mythical creature. “You just said that this stone mirror is an antique from the totem era 6,000 to 7,000 years ago?” Lu Qingyi suddenly asked. “Yes.”
“When you used it just now, did you use telepathy to chant a strange spell?” Shi Yu :”…” Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and looked at Senior Lu, suspecting that her telepathy could read minds. How did she know?
“Looking at your expression, it’s a yes.” Lu Qingyi was stunned. “If it was in that period, then perhaps I know the origin of this thing.” After Lu Qingyi pondered, her expression suddenly became serious.
“You know its origin?” Shi Yu was stunned.
He only knew the use of the stone mirror by listening to history. He was confused about the origin of the stone mirror. How did Senior Lu know?
“As expected of Senior Lu!” White Brook said. Shi Yu :”…” Alright, Shi Yu didn’t deny Lu Qingyi’s power. Lu Qingyi was also the one who helped him determine the origin and usage of the Space-time Key left behind by Emperor Shi. In terms of historical knowledge, Lu Qingyi was indeed stronger. “Have you heard of the ‘Yue Maiden’?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“Who is that?” White Brook was at a loss.
“A certain figure from the totem era?”
Shi Yu asked. “Yes, he’s indeed a figure from the totem era.” Lu Qingyi nodded. “What about her?” Shi Yu said. “The stone mirror is hers?”
Currently, the history textbooks of Dong Huang only taught the history of the Beast Taming Era.
Just the Beast Taming Era for more than two thousand years had ten important historical gaps. As for older years of the totem era hundreds of millions of years ago, the records were even fewer.
Even through Bureau 11’s channels, Shi Yu didn’t know much.
In that era, humans still lived in the form of totem clans, and the Beast Taming System had yet to be perfected. Although there might have been many Legendary Beast Tamers, or even titled legendary Beast Tamers, in the absence of a great unification of language, ability system, and tribal factions, the current humans had almost no channels to understand that era.
The reason why the later generations understood the few dynasties of the Beast Taming Era more clearly was that the language was unified by Emperor Shi, and the Beast Taming System was organized and divided into nine grades by the Emperor Shi Dynasty. Of course, although the modern era didn’t know much about the totem era, it was certain that a large number of humans were definitely active in the totem era. Moreover, humans were born very early and had existed for a very long time. When and who was the first to develop the Beast Taming Ability was still a mystery. “I don’t know much either. I only know her name and ability. This stone mirror might be the work of a ‘Yue Maiden’.” “But if it is, it’s definitely not formed by her Beast Taming Talent.” “Not only this stone mirror, but this Yue Maiden has many other works that have been passed down. They played a big role in the Beast Taming Era.” Shi Yu and White Brook cast curious gazes. Lu Qingyi said, “The Yue Maiden is a human Beast Tamer from the totem era. Her Beast Taming Talent is’ Plunder’.”
“She can extract the ability of transcendent creatures and give it to undead, transforming it into a precious artifact. She can also extract the Beast Taming Talent of other human Beast Tamers and give it to undead to form a precious artifact. It’s an ability feared by both humans and transcendent creatures.” “Although it’s been very long, a few works of the ‘Yue Maiden’ have still been passed down. They were obtained and used by ancient archeologists. The precious artifacts she created have a unified characteristic, which is that they need to use some strange passwords to activate them. Although she should have created many precious artifacts, the passwords should be the most important reason why these works of hers have been lost…”
Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu and said, “So, you should have heard the command to use this stone mirror, right?” “Yes…” Shi Yu nodded undeniably, but he was shocked by something else. “It can draw the Beast Taming Talent of other Beast Tamers??” White Brook was also shocked.
“There’s such a talent??” White Brook couldn’t help but ask.
This was too sick. It sounded creepy. Lu Qingyi said, “Probably, but in history, only the Yue Maiden has this talent. And what’s certain is that if this talent is exposed, no matter which era it is, it will probably be rejected. It’s normal that you haven’t heard of it.”
Shi Yu felt guilty. This talent was too much, too wicked!
His replication talent was only replication, after all, and it was only targeted at transcendent creatures. It didn’t snatch the ability. This plundering talent actually extracted the ability directly and was even effective on humans… Wasn’t this just too much?
After Shi Yu heard that, he was instantly extremely afraid of this “Yue Maiden”. He felt that the stone mirror in his hand was a little hot. However, considering that this Yue girl was an ancient from thousands of years ago and that Imperial Capital was thousands of years younger than her, Shi Yu endured it. It was mainly because Shi Jing couldn’t bear to lose it…
“At the moment, in Dong Huang, there might not be more than five Yue Maiden Treasures preserved until now, including yours…” Lu Qingyi said.” In short, we’re still very lucky.” “This might be an important opportunity for you to explore the totem era in the future.” Shi Yu: “I’m tired…”
There were a bunch of problems in the Beast Taming Era alone. The totem era was too difficult to deal with.
Very few archeologists in the archeological world of Dong Huang nowadays focused on the totem era. The exploration was basically the Beast Taming Era and the farther Mythical Era. As for the totem era, it was too messy. The exploration was difficult and wasn’t worth much. “I’m tired too, but I’m not tired anymore.” Lu Qingyi suddenly said, “Let’s go to Shi Yu’s residence directly. I want to discuss with him.” White Brook:??? “What!” White Brook was shocked. It was late at night. It wasn’t appropriate for a man and a woman to be alone!
“We still have to go to the martial arts ruins registration meeting tomorrow. Everyone… rest early,” she suggested.

Chapter 241: The Registration Crisis of the Martial Arts Conference
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The night passed quickly.
The next day.
Shi Yu was woken up early in the morning.
He originally wanted to sleep in more. The big bed in the rich lady’s house was more comfortable than his own, but he couldn’t stand White Brook dragging him and Lu Qingyi to register for the martial arts conference.
2
The registration for the martial arts conference was today, which was the last day. The competition would officially begin the day after tomorrow, so if they didn’t register today, they were basically not qualified to participate.
Although one of the organizers of the martial arts conference was the Wuling Bai Family, White Brook didn’t plan to use special privileges to register.
“Let’s go!”
After breakfast, White Brook said with full vitality.
“Can we set a successful segment today?”
Lu Qingyi held the promotional poster of the martial arts conference and pondered.
The martial arts conference was a competition without levels and age restrictions.
From Beast Trainers to Mythical Beast Tamers, they could participate.
Because of this, many people signed up.
Out of consideration for the effect of the competition, the competition authorities allowed the contestants to use the training facilities of Emperor Wu Ruins to determine their strength once after the registration martial arts conference.
The top 32 contestants whose strength was ranked could directly enter the main competition without participating in the preliminaries.
Of course, the contestants could also choose not to choose their strength, but that would have to slowly fight from the preliminaries.
1
For example, White Brook, Lu Qingyi, and Shi Yu definitely had to determine their strength. Fighting from the preliminaries was too tormenting.
“probably.”
“In short, we’ll do it as soon as possible.”
“Where’s Buggy?” White Brook asked.
[Buggy:… Wu wu wu!]
“Coming, coming.” Beside him, Shi Yu rubbed his eyes and released Buggy.
The dreamy Butterfly of Tools appeared in front of the three of them.3
Instant Transmission, activate!
‘Wu Ling City, Emperor Wu Ruins.
This was located in the center of Wu Ling City, one of Dong Huang’s famous historical sites.
The outside of the ruins was formed by nine stone pillars. The stone pillars were incomparably tall, reaching into the sky. They were connected to a fixed ruin space. This place was similar to the Heroic Spirit Ruins, and the area was fixed and couldn’t recognize a master.
There were nine different facilities in the ruins space. The facilities were all cultivation venues built to train the body.
According to the archeological discovery, this ruin was a training ground created by Emperor Wu to train his subordinates.
At the moment, the Dong Huang Association had already mastered the method to enter and exit these training facilities freely.
This martial arts conference would be held in Emperor Wu Ruins. During the martial arts conference, be it inside or outside Emperor Wu Ruins, it would temporarily be opened to the public.
As long as one bought tickets, regardless of whether it was contestants or tourists, they were qualified to enter the ruins space.
“The tickets are ten thousand yuan each, ten thousand yuan each.”
When he arrived near the destination, Shi Yu discovered a strange thing.
Many Beast Tamers outside the nine pillars were stunned. Because if they wanted to register, they had to enter the ruins space. And if they wanted to enter the ruins space, they had to buy tickets. The tickets were 10,000 yuan each.
Similarly, tourists who wanted to enter and visit and spectators who planned to watch the competition had to buy tickets.
“No wonder there are no restrictions on registration age and level. The tickets are expensive.”
Some people became depressed outside. This was a classic example of not looking at the rules before coming.
“Humph, young people. They’re not even willing to invest. If they miss this opportunity, they’ll have to wait another year.” After White Brook obtained three tickets, she saw a group of people conflicted outside and couldn’t help but laugh in her heart.
Every year, she would see a group of tourists who couldn’t bear to buy tickets.
Since they were already here, they had to go even if they borrowed the money.
“That’s too…” Shi Yu also muttered.
The ticket price was simply too cheap, alright?
One should definitely borrow money just for the ticket.
Of course, it was targeted at Beast Tamers who wanted to become stronger. Those who weren’t Beast Tamers were different.
It was secondary to buy a ticket and be able to enter to watch the competition. Most importantly, the lowest level of the predecessor of the ruins space was the level-seven Beast Taming Space. It was the Beast Taming Space of a legendary Beast Tamer. After a pet grew up inside for a day, its growth
experience was countless times greater than in the outside world.
Even if they couldn’t use the training facilities inside, even if they only brought their pets to sleep inside, there were a bunch of benefits.
If they found an empty space to train, the pet’s efficiency would be even more obvious.
The cost-effective ratio was definitely more than 10,000 yuan to buy nutritional supplements for the pet. It was not a loss for the Beast Tamer to buy a ticket.
Because Shi Yu had the ruins space, he naturally knew the benefits of the ruins space.
He also saw that Wu Ling City was using this ruins space and the martial arts conference to develop the tourism industry in Wu Ling City.
Back then, if the ruins of Emperor Wu had not been discovered by White Brook’s second grandfather, the Bai family and Wu Ling City might not have been as glorious as they were now.
This was also why Ping Cheng cared so much about the ruins space back then. After Ping Cheng’s Iron-eating Beast Feeding Space was completed, the benefits that the Village of Panda could bring to Ping Cheng would definitely allow Ping Cheng to soar into the sky, even if it couldn’t compare to this
martial arts conference.
“Let’s go in,” Lu Qingyi said.
Soon, a magical scene appeared.
A group of people saw the two beauties, Lu Qingyi and White Brook, walk through the security check and enter the teleportation area. They entered the ruins space and directly ran to buy tickets in pain.
If these two were also contestants and they could see their competition, then this ticket… was worth it.
In the ruins space.
The environment was identical to the outside world. It was still nine huge stone pillars that reached the sky. The world was one color, like a yellow primeval world.
However, compared to the empty outside world, several buildings had already been built in the center of the nine pillars in the ruins space.
As for outside the nine pillars, it was an even wider ruins space. The different cultivation facilities in the ruins of Emperor Wu were distributed there.
After entering the ruins space, Shi Yu and the others discovered a very different point. That was that there were many more Beast Tamers in strange clothes and strange looks here than in the outside world.
Shi Yu took a casual look and saw several strange people. The characteristics of the animals, plants, and even elements were very obvious.
There was a big man with bull horns, a strong figure, and a huge axe on his back. The characteristics of his head were obvious. He was clearly a Minotaur.
An uncle held a cigarette in his mouth. His feet, hands, and hair all turned into smoke as he floated around. He looked like a smoke man.
1
There were also girls wearing grass dresses with fairy wings. Flowers bloomed on their heads like flower fairies.
As for beast-eared girls like White Brook, there were even more. There were rabbit girls, cat-eared girls, and fox-tailed girls.
“Your eyes, your eyes.” After entering, White Brook realized that Shi Yu’s eyes were staring and his body wasn’t even moving, He immediately froze on the spot and couldn’t help but knock Shi Yu.
“Cough, there are so many Fusion Talents here,” Shi Yu said.
Animals, plants, and elemental pets were all fusion targets. Unfortunately, he had yet to see a car girl or a battleship girl, but there was a mechanical old granny with two cannons on her shoulder and a sniper rifle on her arm… She was also here to participate at this age?
Moreover, this appearance, was it cosplaying a gunner hag or Squirtle
1
“The most common talent among the participants of the martial arts conference is the Fusion Talent. In addition, the proportion of the Fusion Talent among the Beast Tamers in Wu Ling City is also very high. How is it? It’s very interesting, right?”
“They’re actually training the proficiency of their Fusion Talent. Maintaining it like this every day tiring, but the benefits are greater.” White Brook said.1
Shi Yu nodded. The last time he saw such a ridiculous scene was when he went to the exhibition with his classmates in high school.
“Wau…” Beside White Brook and Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi was also observing her surroundings. After discovering that the appearances of the Beast Tamers here were also especially ridiculous, she couldn’t help but sigh in relief. In comparison, her and Shi Yu’s transformation should be relatively normal.
“Please pay attentio
“Beast Tamers who want to participate in the martial arts conference and have yet to register, please register in the hall 3 and 4. The other halls have already been suspended.”
“In addition, contestants who have signed up and plan to determine their strength, please take your card number and head to the trial location from the 6th passage! I repeat
“Please take note…”
“Let’s go.”
As the loudspeaker repeated, White Brook called Shi Yu. Then, she pulled Lu Qingyi’s little hand and walked happily in the direction of Hall 3.
Lu Qingyi was helpless, but it was just holding hands. Forget it
1
Why was White Brook still like a kid?
“Eh.” When Shi Yu saw this, he was also very helpless. He had really become a third wheel.
What a tough life.
When he thought about how he would be beaten up if he encountered the two of them at the start of the competition and probably couldn’t defeat them, Shi Yu felt stifled.
This martial arts conference might be the most aggrieved competition he had participated in.
Although it was impossible for a Legendary-level contestant to participate, it seemed that there were still quite a lot of master-level contestants.
1
“archeology first, competition second.”
Shi Yu quickly followed the two of them. At the same time, his gaze had already started to observe his surroundings. He didn’t know where to start from.
{Ruins, ruins, can you hear me?]
[Is there anything you want to tell me?]
C.]
As Shi Yu walked, he chatted with the nine pillars. However, clearly, this approach was wrong. It was impossible for there to be a response.
At the registration hall.
‘There was a long line inside the building. There were probably dozens of people.
Shi Yu and the others quickly lined up. At this moment, as the three of them stood quietly, someone finally discovered the abnormality in Shi Yu’s group of three.
“Hey, Honey, look. Isn’t that the captain of the Ancient Capital’s big school team, White Tiger Mother, Nine-Tailed Mother White Brook? Damn, if it wasn’t a fusion state, I almost didn’t recognize it.”
“What did you say?? Do you want to live anymore?”
1
“I, what’s wrong? Look, it’s the genius Beast Tamer of our Wu Ling City, the granddaughter of Old Master Bai, Legend Bai.”
As the leading figure of the younger generation in Wuling City and the representative of the Beast Tamer of Ancient Capital University, one of the nine major universities, she was actually quite popular after tearing apart a monarch-level pet in the National League last year and shocking the entire venue.
After arriving at the ruins of Emperor Wu and lining up obediently, someone quickly recognized her.
“It’s really Miss White Brook. She also came to participate.”
“Lremember she came last year, right? And she successfully reached the top 32 with the level of a high-level Beast Tamer. She broke through to master this year. I wonder what results she can get.”
The surrounding people immediately began to discuss White Brook. Even the people in the queue looked over when they heard the name White Brook.
In the team, White Brook sighed. She knew this would be the outcome.
“Well… Well…”
At this moment, a high school student with a backpack ran over excitedly with a pen and book.
‘When everyone saw this, they immediately understood.
He wanted an autograph? He had prepared everything, but wasn’t it better to take a photo at this time?
“Sorry…” Seeing this, White Brook instinctively wanted to refuse, because once this thing started, there would be no end to it.
But who knew that this high school student ran to Lu Qingyi excitedly and asked, “Excuse me, are you Dr. Lu Qingyi? I’m your fan. I like your ‘Mythical Restricted Region’ and ‘Ancient Paramita’ very much. May I… have your autograph?”
White Brook :”…”
Lu Qingyi, who was behind White Brook, was slightly stunned. She looked at the high school student who ran over to ask for her autograph.
At this moment, everyone suddenly discovered that the person ranked behind White Brook seemed to be even more extraordinary.
Lu Qingyi?
“Doctor of archeology from Ancient Capital University, the most talented student of Ancient Capital University in nearly ten years, the current vice president of the Dong Huang Archeology Association… One of the young Beast Tamers closest to the legendary domain, Lu Qingyi?!”
“It seems to be her…”
As this high school student pointed out Lu Qingyi’s identity, the surrounding passers-by were even more shocked. Lu Qingyi’s honor and identity were much more dazzling than White Brook. In terms of level, Lu Qingyi was even above Heavenly King Zou, who could easily reach the number one trending
topic on the Internet.
It was only because Lu Qingyi was relatively low-profile that her reputation didn’t show. However, Lu Qingyi’s archeological achievements over the years were also quite impressive, not to mention that she was a goddess with legendary aptitude. As someone mentioned her name, many people
immediately recalled this figure.
“Dr. Lu also came to participate in the martial arts conference? Heavens, unbelievable, unbelievable!!!”
Many people were shocked. At this moment, another butterfly lady with butterfly wings ran over from the front more excitedly. She held her cell phone and seemed to be taking a photo this time. Seeing this, White Brook stopped breathing, She saw that this girl directly passed her and ran to Shi Yu
behind Lu Qingyi.
“Are you Senior Shi Yu? Well, I’m from the Feeding Department of Demon Capital University. I also specialize in the Worm Department and specialize in butterfly research. I’m Senior Xia’s junior. I’ve seen the results of your Feeding. You… you’re too impressive. Can you take a photo with me? Please.”
White Brook :”…”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. So feeding results could also attract fans? He thought that he only had supporters among the commoners.
So there were also geniuses from the Feeding World who were convinced by their talent?
1
“Of course,” Shi Yu said with a smile. As expected of him.
At this moment, as this Butterfly Lady exposed the truth, everyone had already forgotten what White Brook was. They were slow to notice that an even more impressive figure stood behind Lu Qingyi.
If it was before Shi Yu appeared, it was completely no problem to say that Lu Qingyi was the most talented student in the past ten years of Ancient Capital University. However, as the research results that could change the structure of the Beast Taming Domain appeared, the honor of being the most
talented student of Ancient Capital University should directly change hands.
Compared to Lu Qingyi, Shi Yu’s name had become even more popular in the past month.
“Shi Yu… Could it be that Beast Tamer of the Butterfly of Imagination?”
“The father of the Green Silkworm cocoon, the man who mercilessly blew up Heavenly King Zou’s trending topic twice.”
3
“He’s so young, he’s so handsome, I love him so much.”
“He’s also here to participate in the martial arts conference? Holy shit
“What’s going on with this martial arts conference? Did the three of them come together? Good heavens, the ancient all-star formation?!”
1
At this moment, Hall 3 exploded. Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu were directly surrounded, as if they were celebrities.
Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu :”…”
White Brook: QAQ.
Then, the order was finally stabilized under the efforts of the security personnel.
After Shi Yu and the other two finished registering with difficulty, they received the queue number from the staff girl who stared at them with starry eyes. Then, Buggy used Instant Transmission to escape the scene.
“Where is he?”
“Chase after him.”
The hall was noisy again. Then, most people gave up queuing at the same time and ran to the trial location where strength was determined. They could register at any time today, but if they missed the process of the three people’s strength positioning, they’d miss out big time.
“Does Dr. Lu have a pet of the combat system?”
“I don’t know.”
“Where’s Big Boss Shi Yu?”
“I know this. He’s an Iron-eating Beast Knight. He can ride an Iron-eating Beast to harden his entire body and weapons! He’s insane!”
6th Pillar Passage.
Each of them held a queue number. Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook’s figures directly appeared on the road. After coming out, they all heaved a sigh of relief. It was really too difficult.
“Tm No. 109,” White Brook said.
“Tm 110.” Lu Qingyi.
“L…” Shi Yu looked at his number 111 and was very calm.
3
Alright, he was single, so his luck wouldn’t be bad.
“Let’s go, let’s go,” White Brook said. “Contestants below high-level Beast Tamers rarely participate in the strength positioning, so this is actually very fast. There’s no need to queue much. I reckon that we can do it quickly when we get there.”
Shi Yu pinched the account card. “I suddenly feel that it’s not bad for me to start directly from the preliminaries. I wonder how many master contestants there are this year. If there are more than 32…”
“Last year, 30 Beast Tamers above the master level participated. I don’t know the situation this year, but I feel that we can definitely give it a try. Under the master level, you’re definitely first,” White Brook said.
“That’s true, but if I succeed and directly enter the main competition, and encounter a master-level Beast Tamer in the first round of the main competition, wouldn’t that be… the end?” Shi Yu’s balls hurt. He had said that this competition was a scam. Although Chi Tong was very powerful now and his
physique wasn’t inferior to these masters who specialized in refining bodies, he was still a major level away.
Of course, Shi Yu also had a trump card, the Ice Dragon Blade. This level-seven weapon was still powerful. It was not a problem for him to fight above his level with Chi Tong, but it was a little costly to the beast tamer and the dragon whisker.
“It’s not good to keep blowing up the news. Although this competition is fought by the Beast Tamers themselves, it’s very safe. At that time, White Brook’s second grandfather will probably come to watch the battle. Just treat it as training yourself,” Lu Qingyi suggested.
“Alright.” Shi Yu liked to listen to Senior Lu.
Sigh, so what if the dragon whisker energy was gone? In any case, the Ice Dragon was still on the snow mountain. If Little Chi Tong went to ask for more dragon whiskers, it was impossible for Sister Ice Dragon to not give it to him..

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - White Brook and Lu Qingyi’s Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: White Brook and Lu Qingyi’s Transformation
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the ruins of Emperor Wu.
‘Wei Lin Platform, one of the nine major training facilities.
Wei Lin Platform was an incomparably huge square arena. In the center of the arena was a tall and thick rock pillar.
At this moment, there was a sea of people near Wei Lin Platform.
They focused their attention on the middle-aged man standing in the arena.
At that moment, the huge rock pillar on the arena continued to emit invisible waves.
Under the cover of this transparent wave, the air on the entire arena kept buzzing and trembling.
This wave seemed to carry an indescribably huge pressure, making the middle-aged man in the arena go through unbearable pain. He was almost unable to breathe.
Moreover, from time to time, this wave would squeeze towards the middle-aged man’s body like an invisible tide and storm, like an invisible hand that wanted to crush his body.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Under the intense collision sound, the brown scales covering this burly man’s body had already shattered like dry soil. A long lizard tail on his buttocks was even hanging listlessly on the ground.
At this moment, the burly man was half-squatting. He clenched his fists tightly, and the muscles on his body bulged. His expression was ferocious, and his eyes were filled with blood vessels. His body had already reached its limit.
“Pfft…”
Amoment later, he directly spat out a mouthful of blood and lay on the arena with his head raised in a daze. At the same time, the deterrence emitted by the rock pillar immediately disappeared.
“25.28 seconds.”
After the big man fell to the ground, on a high platform opposite the arena, two middle-aged men in white battle clothes sat and recorded.
At the same time, as the deterrence of the rock pillar disappeared, the Lizardman middle-aged man opened his eyes with difficulty, crawled up, and walked down the arena in a daze.
At the same time, he muttered, “It’s too difficult… too difficult.”
If he wasn’t wrong, he was only in the top 200.
“Number 86, Yuan Shuo.”
After the big man went down, the staff in charge of recording the results shouted the name of the next contestant who accepted the testing.
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others, who had just arrived, revealed surprised expressions.
Number 86?
“Alright, I told you this was fast. It probably won’t take half an hour to reach us,” White Brook said excitedly.
Their number 110 was very close to number 86. According to the calculations, it was less than a minute for each person.
“So what should we eat at noon?” Lu Qingyi said.
The registration and testing segment was faster than she imagined. It looked like she could still make it for lunch.
“T want to eat dragon liver and phoenix marrow. I haven’t eaten for a month. Yesterday, my mom actually didn’t prepare anything,” White Brook said greedily.
Shi Yu
He seemed to have heard something incredible.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. As the name suggested, the dragon liver and phoenix marrow were organs with some dragon and phoenix bloodline creatures. Of course, most of them were races with very weak bloodlines…
Ordinary people couldn’t digest the ones with purer bloodlines in the first place, but even if it was food with weak bloodlines, it was still very nourishing. The price would go up to millions every meal…
He couldn’t bear to use this to nourish his body. Looking at this beast-eared girl… she probably had to eat one or two times a month?
However.. it seemed to be normal. A Beast Tamer with a Fusion Talent like her had to train her body, meditate, and nurture pets. It was very difficult to distribute energy. Using top-notch food resources like the dragon liver and phoenix marrow to strengthen her body was the fastest way.
Although Shi Yu had trained his physique to the extreme at every level, Shi Yu estimated that the beast-eared girl was about the same. Even if she didn’t train to the extreme at every level, she wasn’t far off. After all, it was a paywall battle strategy, and there were also pets and talent enhancements.
“Alright, let’s go to the Dragon Phoenix Pavilion,” Lu Qingyi said with a nod.
Alright.” White Brook agreed.
Soon, the new Beast Tamer named Yuan Shuo accepted the test. He lasted for about 24 seconds before he couldn’t take it and retreated.
‘When Shi Yu saw this, he looked at the stone pillar wrapped in deterrence.
“Do you think this deterrence will only be as simple as transcendent?” he asked.
It continued to wrap around for 2000 years without dispersing, With a stable autonomous operation rule, no matter how one looked at it, it wasn’t as simple as transcendent.
“The proficiency is definitely above transcendent. As for whether it has reached a new domain, it’s no longer important. There are no clear divisions in history, which also means that that domain is not something that ordinary Beast Tamers can reach.” Lu Qingyi looked over.
‘Just like the Mythical stage, such a level doesn’t mean much even if it’s divided.”
White Brook said, ‘Don’t ignore the growth level. Emperor Wu’s pets are all at the totem level. Who knows what power he used to build this ruin?”
“But I’m quite curious how many seconds I can last now. The last competition I could do 28.59 seconds. This time, I can definitely last more than 30 seconds, but as for how close to 40 seconds… It’s hard to say.”
“As long as I can last more than 30 seconds, there’s a chance to directly enter the main competition, right?” Shi Yu said.
The training mechanism of the Wei Lin Platform was actually very simple.
The rock pillar in the arena was wrapped by deterrence above transcendent level. This deterrence had its own rules of operation. As long as a life form stepped onto the arena, the rock pillar would continue to release deterrence, and the deterrence power would increase over time.
Because it was a deterrence above transcendent proficiency, the deterrence here was substantialized. It could cause dual mental and physical damage. It tested the will of the Beast Tamer and the physique of the Beast Tamer.
Generally speaking, below ten seconds corresponded to awakened-level power, ten to twenty seconds corresponded to transcendent-level power, twenty to thirty seconds corresponded to commander-level power, and as for above thirty seconds, it corresponded to monarch-level power.
The longer the Beast Tamer lasted in the arena, the stronger he was. When the Beast Tamer reached the limit, if he couldn’t break through, the rock pillar would restrain its power very accurately and wouldn’t cause too much damage to the Beast Tamer.
Of course, Beast Tamers could also choose to use various abilities, including equipment to resist deterrence. It was not against the rules.
However, very few people were so brave in this segment. This was because the upper limit of the rock pillar’s deterrence was very high, and the equipment was not protected by the mechanism. In the end, the equipment would definitely be damaged, and basically no one would do that.
Moreover, if he relied on equipment to enter the main competition, he would become a clown if he didn’t have the strength. Beast Tamers who could afford equipment of that level were also famous figures. Naturally, they wouldn’t do this. After all, the rewards of the martial arts conference were only so-so.
Even if it was a champion reward, it might not necessarily be as expensive as high-level spiritual equipment.
Therefore, Shi Yu did not plan to use the Ice Dragon Blade that wrapped around the overlord-level Dragon Might this time. If the dragon might and rock pillar deterrence started a fight, he would be in the middle. It would be a battle between gods and he’d be destroyed.
If the Ice Dragon Blade was destroyed by the rock pillar, it would be even more unlucky.
“30 seconds, about the same,” White Brook replied.
Just as she finished speaking, a few voices suddenly came from outside the crowd.
“Where’s Miss White Brook?”
“Where’s Dr. Lu?”
“Where’s Boss Shi Yu?”
Obviously, the group of people in the registration hall followed. Seeing this, the expressions of Shi Yu and the other two in the crowd darkened.
At this moment, there were more tourists and contestants watching around the Wei Lin Platform than in the hall. They were naturally not unfamiliar with these three names. The outcome was that in a few seconds, Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook became the focus of attention again.
It wasn’t that there were no master-level Beast Tamers present, but that ordinary master-level contestants were nothing in front of the three of them.
“What’s this?”
In the chaos, at this moment, even the two martial artists who were in charge of recording the results revealed shocked expressions.
They quickly glanced at the updated name list sent by the hall.
109. White Brook…
Oh shit.
“Little White Brook is here. I didn’t see her two days ago. I thought she wouldn’t participate in the competition this year,” a recording warrior said.
“How is that possible? She broke through to master this year, so she definitely has to give it a try. Perhaps she’s aiming for first place. As Old Master Bai’s granddaughter, the pride of our Bai family definitely has to get first place in the conference.”
“However…”
Soon, they discovered something wrong.
Chapter 110: Lu Qingyi?
That Dr. Lu?
And 11, Shi Yu…
“Wait, Shi Yu, is that Shi Yu from Ancient Capital University?”
The two of them were both members of the Bai family, master-level Beast Tamers. This time, they were in charge of the competition. When they saw their kin, they were naturally very friendly. However, as they saw the two names behind White Brook, they were stunned.
They suddenly looked at Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu, who were surrounded in the crowd.
“It’s true.”
Amoment later, they couldn’t help but frown and shout from above, “Noise is prohibited here. Don’t disturb others!”
With the two of them shouting, it was finally a little quieter. At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh at how fame was such a good thing. Just by standing there, a bunch of beast-eared girls and beast-eared boys casually came to add him as a friend…
Of course, in order to maintain his image, Shi Yu didn’t dare to give his contact info to any of them. Otherwise, there would really be no end to it.
Time passed little by little.
Following the initial Lizard Man, more than ten people went up one after another. However, none of them were master-level Beast Tamers. They basically lasted for more than 20 seconds before stopping, Such competitors were only here to join in the fun. There was basically no chance for them to directly
advance to the main competition as seeded candidates.
The tourists weren’t satisfied with the short and powerless resistance process of these people. Of course, most of them didn’t want to see the results of the contestants. There was a group of old men who were purely waiting for the beast-eared girls to resist the deterrence and then sweat and tremble.
In the end, he saw it, but it was only ten or twenty seconds before she got off the stage again. It was too short, and they weren’t satisfied yet.
Until…
“Number 109, White Brook.”
After the last contestant came down, the two Bai family members on the high platform spoke with anticipation.
‘Then, it was White Brook’s turn.
White Brook was a master-level Beast Tamer, and her pet had also reached the monarch level. Her performance was definitely different from the previous contestants.
“It’s my turn.”
“Then I’ll go.”
In the crowd, White Brook, who was wearing a pair of black shorts and a white sports short-sleeved shirt, stretched. Then, she moved her body and said to Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu beside her.
“All the best.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
“Senior, you can do it,” Shi Yu also said.
White Brook chuckled. Under everyone’s gaze, she directly walked onto the arena.
After she boarded the arena, she didn’t stop walking. At the same time, she looked up at the rock pillar.
Soon, the rock pillar flickered and directly emitted a deterrence wave. A weak deterrence wave quickly rushed at the beast-eared girl!!
However, in the current level of deterrence, White Brook’s expression didn’t change at all. She didn’t even use the fusion state. She stood on the ground in her normal state and quietly looked at the rock pillar.
One second, two seconds, three seconds… Nine seconds, ten seconds, eleven seconds…
White Brook was enveloped by a transparent deterrence aura. Her breathing was still uniform as she stood in the arena without any reaction.
“Holy shit.”
At this moment, the tourists and contestants held their breaths.
In the blink of an eye, White Brook lasted for more than 20 seconds. At this time, she still maintained her normal state. Only her clothes and hair swayed slightly under the deterrence.
Seeing this, the contestants who had just left the stage couldn’t help but widen their eyes and watch everything.
“Damn.”
“She can last more than 20 seconds with just her body?”
“A humanoid ferocious beast with a physique comparable to a commander-level transcendent creature??”
“The two masters didn’t even do something like that this morning!”
Now, for White Brook to do this, it had already shown that even if she didn’t use her Beast Taming Talent and didn’t fuse with her pet, she could still fight a commander-level ferocious beast with her own fist. She was a proper humanoid ferocious beast and had already trained her physique to superman
level.
“As expected of Senior Bai,” Shi Yu said from below.
“Your physique shouldn’t be weaker than hers, right?” Lu Qingyi curled her lips. She could still understand White Brook, but Shi Yu was the freak. To be able to withstand the possession of a high-level overlord race’s transcendent sword spirit at the intermediate level, this physique was even more ridiculous.
‘It’s okay, it’s okay.” Shi Yu laughed. A moment later, 25 seconds had passed. In the arena, White Brook finally frowned slightly. She slowly raised her hand and didn’t see any signs of summoning, but in the next moment, under the lingering light, the characteristics of beastification appeared on her body.
Boom!!!
At the same time, an aura erupted from White Brook’s body, immediately crushing the deterrence released by the rock pillar. As the air rumbled, White Brook’s new image appeared in front of everyone.
At this moment, White Brook’s short black hair had completely tuned into flowing white hair. Her eyes had also tuned blue, and there were two more things that looked like fox ears.
Most importantly, at this moment, nine smooth and long white tails grew out from behind her. The dazzling nine tails looked noble and elegant, and there was a golden color at the end. After they all danced, they were even larger than White Brook herself, directly becoming the best background for her
figure.
Boom!
After transforming into a nine-tailed fox figure, White Brook was much more at ease.
“The Nine-tailed Light Fox.. She has fused with the Nine-tailed Light Fox.” At this moment, seeing White Brook’s change, someone couldn’t help but say excitedly.
Combined with the quasi overlord race’s Nine-tailed Light Fox, together with White Brook’s terrifying physique, it directly erupted with a powerful deterrence, easily facing the baptism of the rock pillar deterrence!
At that moment, Shi Yu looked at the 1,750,000 energy points that the beast-eared girl had erupted with and sighed. ‘Actually, I still think the White Tiger state is more handsome.”
“although that little white tiger is White Brook’s main pet, it currently has one less evolution level than Nine Tails. It might take a while to become her trump card again,” Lu Qingyi said with a smile.
After transforming into a nine-tailed fox, White Brook calmly faced the deterrence. In the blink of an eye, she resisted for 30 seconds. After 30 seconds, the rock pillar deterrence suddenly increased exponentially. A light screen lingered around White Brook’s body, and the deterrence continued to erupt.
Under the collision of the strength of the two parties, thunder seemed to sound in the air.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
At this moment, every minute and second was incomparably long and shocking. However, the rock pillar was ultimately designed to test people. Its strength was endless and there was no upper limit. In the blink of an eye, White Brook’s expression became more and more solemn. However, she didn’t look as.
miserable as the previous contestant. With a crack, the light screen on White Brook’s body directly shattered. The deterrence she erupted with was also crushed by the deterrence of the rock pillar. She even grunted and took a step back, her brain rumbling!
Almost instantly, White Brook felt as if her body was about to fall apart. The bestialization characteristic also disappeared. However, her powerful willpower prevented her from falling under the deterrence. She only stood in the arena ina daze.
“About 34 seconds? Well, fine.” White Brook closed her eyes.
Buzz.
After determining that White Brook had lost the ability to resist, the deterrence of the rock pillar disappeared. A few seconds later, White Brook’s breathing gradually became uniform. She slowly opened her eyes and looked in the direction of the high platform.
“34.36 seconds, very impressive.”
“It’s the current third highest score.”
On the high platform, the two members in charge of recording the results smiled and spoke excitedly.
“34 seconds?!”
At this moment, when they heard this, everyone below the stage was also in a daze.
The difference in the level of a monarch was actually very large. A powerful monarch might have ten times the strength of a weak monarch. If it could last for 35 seconds, it could already be said to be a middle-level strength among monarchs. White Brook was only in her early twenties, but she already had
such strength. In the eyes of everyone, she was already very strong.
After all, it had only been a year since White Brook broke through to the master level. With her age, it was very normal for her pet cultivation speed to be inferior to those old masters.
“Not bad,” White Brook said softly in the arena. Then, she smiled and got off. At this moment, she was very weak. After coming down, under everyone’s admiring expressions, she returned to Lu Qingyi, Shi Yu, and the others. At this moment, Shi Yu had already handed the nutritional fruits he had prepared to
White Brook.
“There.”
“Thank you.” After taking Shi Yu’s supplements, White Brook didn’t try to be polite. Then, she ignored her image and started eating. A moment later, she directly revived with full health. Her face even had a little redness. It was obvious that she had overdone it.
White Brook subconsciously cried out.
Her face was red. “Just give me a low-level one next time…”
Shi Yu scratched his cheek. “I still have to specially create low-level ones. It’s troublesome..”
“Well.”
“It’s my turn next..” At this moment, Lu Qingyi was a little nervous.
It wasn’t that she was nervous about her results, but that if so many people saw her nervous possession state, she would die.
After all, she wasn’t as proficient as White Brook and Shi Yu.
“You can do it, Senior Lu!!!” White Brook said. “You clearly look better than me after transforming.”
“Compared to the hair quality of Nine Tails and White Tiger, although they’re both white, I prefer your kind!!”
[Nine-Tailed, White Tiger:??]
“So what exactly is it? You’ve been hiding it from me for the whole day.’ Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
White hair too?
Shi Yu couldn’t think of what undead it was.
Could it be… a snow maiden?
Something was wrong. That was the unique undead of the seven islands. There were very few in Dong Huang, but it wasn’t impossible…
“Number 109, Lu Qingyi.” At this moment, a voice came from the high platform.
Shi Yu didn’t plan to ask anymore. He would see it later anyway.
After being called, Lu Qingyi took a deep breath, put away the glasses-shaped index, and placed it in the space. Then, she walked towards the arena step by step.
Today, Lu Qingyi was wearing a white shirt and still black shorts. Her long legs were wrapped in black silk. The process of her slowly walking onto the arena attracted more attention and anticipation than White Brook.
“Dr. Lu… Dr. Luisa telepathy talent, so she should have used a pet’s skill to strengthen herself.”
“Is it a strengthening skill or a possession skill??”
Everyone was very curious. Below, Shi Yu was also very curious.
Strengthening skills were actually like the hardening of iron-eating beasts.
The martial arts conference supported battle tactics like transcendent hardening and binding Beast Tamers. As long as the Iron-eating Beast didn’t fight personally, that was fine. However, this relationship was a little awkward in the martial arts conference. The Iron-eating Beast added a layer of hardening
to the Beast Tamer, and the Beast Tamer went to fight. The pet watched. The relationship between the Beast Tamer and the pet was a little reversed no matter how one looked at it.
“Let’s begin.”
Soon, Lu Qingyi boarded the arena. She also looked at the rock pillar. At the same time, like in the previous battle, the rock pillar started to release its deterrence from weak to strong again.
To everyone’s surprise, Lu Qingyi was the same as White Brook. She actually didn’t activate her ability from the start, but relied on her normal state to resist the deterrence.
One second… two seconds… ten seconds… nineteen seconds…
Everyone’s expressions gradually twitched. Twenty seconds later, not only did the passers-by widen their eyes, but even Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He didn’t expect Senior Lu who had a telepathy talent to train her physique to this extent.
As expected of a rich woman…
“Damm,” Shi Yu said.
“Senior Lu’s Beast Taming Space is already level six. It’s normal for her physique to be strong,” White Brook said.
About 25 seconds later, Lu Qingyi took a deep breath and finally closed her eyes slightly. She started to communicate with the Undead Possession.
In the next moment, a white light that was like a star surrounded her. Under the cover of the white light, her hair slowly turned silver from the color of tea…
“It can’t be the White Bone Spirit, right?” Shi Yu was suddenly shocked.
“What? No,” White Brook said angrily. ‘Unfortunately, it’s not Dong Huang’s unique undead.”
At this moment, Shi Yu continued to look. Following that, his expression became more and more shocked. Not only him, but all the Beast Tamers present revealed incredulous expressions. This was because the effect of Lu Qingyi’s transformation was too dazzling, The white starlight not only dyed her hair
silver-white, but also combined with the power of the wind element to condense a white robe behind Lu Qingyi. In an instant, under the flickering light, Lu Qingyi’s entire body emitted a noble, elegant aura, and her appearance became much more beautiful.
‘When the rich natural power of the wind element lingered, Lu Qingyi’s ears also became long and sharp ears. Shi Yu’s expression immediately became strange.
In the next moment, Lu Qingyi opened her eyes. Her light purple eyes that were filled with intelligence were staring at Shi Yu. Her gentle facial features were both mature and agile. Under the lingering breeze, her entire body emitted the charm of nature. She was extremely beautiful, like a goddess of nature.
She raised her hand gently and didn’t use deterrence at all. The wind pressure counterattacked and instantly swallowed the power emitted by the rock pillar, quietly resisting the rock pillar pressure.
“This is..” At this moment, everyone’s eyes widened when they saw Lu Qingyi become like a goddess, regardless of gender.
“So beautiful.”
“This is… possession?”
“But what creature is it?”
Countless people were stunned.
“Elf… Elf race???” At this moment, everyone was still in a daze. They were shocked by Lu Qingyi’s change in the arena and were in deep confusion. Shi Yu quickly judged Senior Lu’s characteristics and looked at White Brook in disbelief.
“How is it? Surprised?” White Brook smiled.
“Why is there an elven race in Dong Huang?” Shi Yu said. Elves actually had many concepts. In Dong Huang, elves sometimes referred to elemental elves, sometimes referred to some monsters, and sometimes used to describe the characteristics of some pets. However, the concept of the elven race was not in
Dong Huang. They were a group of human-type transcendent creatures, mainly located in the distant countries.
In Ting Xiang, there were many humanoid transcendent creatures, such as the elves, giants, and dwarfs. In theory, it was different from the transcendent system on Dong Huang’s side…
Moreover, the elves weren’t undead at all.
“This isn’t strange. When the dragons in the west were massacred by the legendary Dragon Hunters more than two thousand years ago, didn’t they also escape to various parts of the world? There was even a large group that came to Dong Huang to take refuge.”
“Who said the elves can’t cross the sea to come to Dong Huang?”
“You’re an archeologist. You should know better than me.”
Facing White Brook’s words, Shi Yu was speechless.
“Senior Lu told me that this elf also came to Dong Huang to take refuge. Then, for some reason, she turned into an undead and sealed herself. In short, Senior Lu discovered it in an archeological ruin.” White Brook looked straight at the beautiful Senior Lu, her saliva almost flowing out.
“Damn.” Shi Yu also looked over in envy. Damn it, the elves!!!
And it could do possession!
Little Chi Tong didn’t seem so good anymore.
[chi Tong:???]
Why wasnt he as lucky as Senior Lu to encounter a foreign species…
Eh, that’s not right either. The Ice Dragon Aunt seemed to have also taken refuge from abroad. Before that, there were no creatures like dragons on Dong Huang’s side at all. They were all pseudo dragons with dragon blood. As for the pure-blooded dragons, they were all like the owners of the worm’s dragon
ball.
“Let me see the energy value.”
Shi Yu couldn’t help but use the index to detect it again. Senior Lu’s current energy state immediately appeared in front of his eyes…
3.37 million!
After the sprite possessed her, the common energy of the two was as high as 3,3700,000 energy points, completely suffocating Shi Yu.
This energy value made him suspect that this sprite was also an overlord race.
If it wasn’t an overlord race, it was definitely because this sprite was at the age of an old granny. It had trained all kinds of racial skills to the maximum level and its strength had even been perfectly inherited by the undead state. Otherwise, no matter how one looked at it, this energy was very ridiculous.
“Damn, I can still fight with the power of the dragon whiskers when I encounter the beast -eared girl.. If I encounter Senior Lu, won’t I be smashed…”

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - ron-eating Beast Knight Thunder Flame Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Iron-eating Beast Knight Thunder Flame Form
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu realized that Senior Lu seemed to like wind-element pets a lot.
The Wind Demon Lion was wind-element, and the Green Spirit Wind Bird was wind- element. Now, this elf undead was also wind-element.
There were already three wind-element creatures.
It would be fine if Senior Lu had a wind-element strengthening talent, but the key was that she had a telepathy talent. Normal people basically wouldn’t do this.
‘Was wind really that attractive?
Shi Yu’s gaze stopped on Senior Lu.
Under the illumination of the star jade condensed from the wind elements, the wind condensed into a white robe, and her clothes all turned white, shining.
According to Shi Yu’s impression, apart from a small number of special races, such as blood elves, most of the elves in Ting Xiang were natural pets with extremely outstanding elemental talent.
At the moment, the wind element power was Lu Qingyi’s best weapon. She relied on the reverse whirlwind to easily resist the power of the rock pillar.
“30 seconds.”
Soon, 30 seconds had passed since Lu Qingyi went on stage. Below, White Brook silently counted.
On the high platform, the two recorders also swallowed their saliva and looked at the violent scene in front of them.
31… 32… 33… 34.
Lu Qingyi easily exceeded White Brook’s results.
“Is this Dr. Lu?”
The passers-by had only heard of Lu Qingyi’s famous name and knew that she was known as the younger generation most likely to become a legend, but they had never seen Lu Qingyi’s strength with their own eyes.
But now, as she displayed strength that exceeded anyone before, even the master-level contestants, it directly convinced everyone.
At this moment, Lu Qingyi seemed to be wrapped in a huge wind domain. The semicircular wind domain and the earth-brown pressure condensed by the rock pillar squeezed together. The scene was extremely spectacular.
Boom!!!
Under the collision of the wind domain and the deterrence domain, brown electric arcs shot out in the sky, indicating that the strength levels of both parties were at an extremely high level. However, the Platform was set up by Emperor Wu after all, and it didn’t give anyone a chance to slack off.
Even if Lu Qingyi, who was possessed by an elf, had a storm-like power in her body at this moment… As time passed, she frowned in the face of the increasingly ridiculous deterrence power.
Boom!!!
‘The wind pressure raised by Lu Qingyi began to be pushed back. The domain wrapped around Lu Qingyi gradually shrank. In the next moment, a light purple miniature summoning array appeared in her hand. A seed fell from it and fused into her palm.
In the blink of an eye, the patterns in her light purple pupils changed slightly, forming a complicated flower pattern.
“It’s Senior Lu’s Imperial Concubine Flower..”
“The flower seeds of the Imperial Concubine Flower can be integrated into the Beast Tamer’s body to increase the Beast Tamer’s mental strength.”
Below, White Brook said to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu, who was hugging his arm, discovered that the “new race” energy value with Senior Lu as the main body had indeed made a breakthrough.
Boom!
At this moment, Lu Qingyi’s aura increased again. She also emitted a strong deterrence and fused into the wind pressure. Unfortunately, this action only allowed her to last two more seconds. Soon, the deterrence swept up violently again.
Amoment later, a few seconds had passed. Even if Lu Qingyi had already worked very hard, the wind domain still directly collapsed. The violent deterrence directly crushed her body.
“Sigh.” After discovering that she couldn’t withstand the power of the rock pillar either, Lu Qingyi was very helpless. At this moment, everyone held their breaths, wanting to see how Lu Qingyi struggled and resisted against the final deterrence, but…
Ascene that stunned everyone happened directly. An even stronger deterrence attacked. Lu Qingyi directly disappeared and appeared outside the arena ina flash.
‘The deterrence lost its target and was stunned on the spot.
Everyone: *?”
Lu Qingyi: “It’s about the limit, I’ll stop.”
If she continued to resist, she would be as miserable as White Brook. In any case, her results would definitely enter the main competition. Lu Qingyi wasn’t interested in showing her limit in front of so many people.
With that said, she slowly walked towards the stunned Shi Yu and White Brook. At the same time, the elements of the elves on her slowly disappeared and returned to normal. She smiled.
“Holy shit.”
“She went down just like that?”
“She went down himself?”
Seeing Lu Qingyi’s operation, the audience was directly stunned. This worked?
Compared to the outcome of the others, they didn’t think that this was Lu Qingyi’s limit. Even if she struggled, she could still struggle for extra seconds.
However, Lu Qingyi didn’t seem to have this intention.
Everyone looked at the two recorders.
At this moment, their expressions were also a little painful. Holy shit, this was the first time someone played like this in the strength verification segment of the martial arts conference and took the initiative to leave.
She could instantly retreat under that pressure… This was obviously not her limit!
But the key was…
“Time, 37.21 seconds.”
Everyone fell silent.
At that moment, Lu Qingyi’s results were directly first among all the contestants who had already participated in the certification.
Even if he was already in his forties, he still wanted to call Lu Qingyi big boss at this moment.
‘Was this the capricious capital of a big boss?
With this result, if she persisted for another second and made herself look miserable, resulting in her wasting a supplement to heal… It was indeed not very meaningful.
“37 seconds… Compared, three seconds more than me!”
‘As the other passers-by were stunned, White Brook directly looked at Lu Qingyi with tears in her eyes.
“When you break through to my level, you’ll definitely do better than me,” Lu Qingyi said with a smile.
She mainly took advantage of her level. In terms of physical fitness under the same level, she was definitely inferior to White Brook.
“Well, do you want supplements?” Shi Yu felt that Senior Lu shouldn’t need them.
“You should keep it for yourself later.”
After the short conversation between Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi, although they were very shocked by Lu Qingyi’s results and were very surprised by the uninvited guest of this martial arts conference, the strength certification segment still had to continue as soon as possible. The two recorders on the high
platform could only continue,
“Number 111, Shi Yu.”
At this moment, everyone was still immersed in Lu Qingyi’s performance and had yet to recover. They whispered about Lu Qingyi’s possession performance just now. However, as Shi Yu was about to go on stage, they were stunned. They stopped discussing and looked at Shi Yu together.
As for Shi Yu, after taking a deep breath, he also walked towards the arena nervously.
Compared to Senior Lu and White Brook, who knew that they would definitely be able to enter the main competition, he was speechless.
One of the two was a top-notch master, while the other was an ordinary master. Shi Yu, a high-level Beast Tamer, trembled.
His goal wasn’t high. He just had to get close to Senior White Brook.
He just didn’t know if he could reach his limit…
Unlike Lu Qingyi, he planned to see where his limit was.
Shi Yu was very interested in these training facilities. After all, he still had to do archeology next. He wanted to establish a deeper connection with these facilities as much as possible and explore more of their power.
However, all of this depended on whether Eleven and Chi Tong’s Iron-eating Beast Knight combination was impressive.
Soon, Shi Yu boarded the arena.
“Tl do it too!”
After stepping onto the arena, Shi Yu’s mind was active as he looked in the direction of the rock pillar.
Boom!
In the next moment, an invisible pressure enveloped Shi Yu.
Standing in the arena, Shi Yu didn’t do anything. He was actually like White Brook and Lu Qingyi previously, relying on his body and spirit to resist the pressure!
This scene stunned the surrounding Beast Tamers. Ten seconds was actually very fast. When they reacted, more than ten seconds had already passed in the arena. The transparent deterrence wave had already turned into a storm that wrapped around Shi Yu, but Shi Yu still didn’t move at all.
Seeing this scene, everyone’s mouths opened slightly…
As they were stunned, another few seconds passed. In the blink of an eye, 20 seconds passed. The pressure also reached the commander rank strength standard.
Now, it was almost equivalent to a commander-level ferocious beast that had mastered deterrence above transcendent. It was continuously releasing its pressure at Shi Yu!
At the same time, the power of this ferocious beast was still increasing continuously!
“Tknew it!”
Below, White Brook pouted. She looked at the expressionless Shi Yu and really wanted to know how Shi Yu trained his body.
‘When other high-level Beast Tamers’ pets faced such a level of deterrence, they would instantly lose their will to fight.
Shi Yu was good. He didn’t use the power of his pet at all and actually relied on his physique to withstand it.
21 seconds, 22 seconds, 23 seconds…
“Holy shit.”
Everyone’s expressions gradually froze. They felt that it was getting more and more ridiculous.
Forget about the first two. White Brook came from a martial arts family and had a combination talent. She was also a master, so it was normal for her physique to be strong. As for Lu Qingyi, her Beast Taming level was higher, which meant that her physique had a higher lower limit. They were all Beast
Tamers who had contracted monarch-level pets. If they could withstand the deterrence of a commander-level pet, everyone would accept it, but, but…
Shi Yu was definitely not at the master level!
Moreover, Shi Yu definitely didn’t bring any mental equipment. They looked at the simple Shi Yu in the panda shirt and didn’t see any equipment reaction from him at all. It was completely Shi Yu himself resisting the pressure with his body!
“This, how is this possible!!!”
Many people widened their eyes, wondering if they had counted the wrong number.
Soon, the time Shi Yu lasted was about the same as White Brook and Lu Qingyi. This meant that Shi Yu’s physique was not inferior to White Brook and Lu Qingyi, who were one or two levels higher than him.
Seeing this, White Brook and Lu Qingyi’s eyelids twitched.
“This guy.”
Only they themselves knew how much it had cost to train their physiques to this extent, to the point where they far exceeded Beast Tamers of the same level. But now, this physique actually appeared on a high-level Beast Tamer, making them involuntarily doubt life.
“It’s about time.”
At the same time, Shi Yu gradually felt the pressure and felt his mind starting to hurt. He felt his body starting to hurt, so he stopped persisting and directly summoned his pet.
‘The green summoning array representing a high-level Beast Tamer appeared in midair. In the next moment, a “Wuu” sound was heard.
Soon, a small Iron-eating Beast fell from the midair array into Shi Yu’s hand. Shi Yu pinched the Iron-eating Beast and immediately obtained a huge amount of power.
“Wu wu wu.”
You’re not a screaming chicken, stop crying!
“Sob.”
During this process, everyone could clearly notice a slight change in Shi Yu’s skin. It was as if an invisible armor wrapped around Shi Yu’s body, causing his body to emit a metallic luster.
Not only that, in the hardening layer, a transparent deterrence wave wrapped around Shi Yu’s body, forming a second armor that wrapped and protected Shi Yu!
“It’s the Hardening of the Iron-eating Beast! Transcendent Level Hardening Release, Entanglement!”
Many people present had heard of the famous name of Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast Knight. At this moment, when they saw the little Iron-eating Beast adding its strength to Shi Yu, their expressions immediately became intense.
“It’s here, it’s coming.”
“But… the posture seems a little wrong.”
Sit on it!
Iron-eating Beast Knight!
‘What was the use of pinching such a small Iron-eating Beast!
At this moment, with Eleven’s hardening, Shi Yu’s physical strength increased again. It was easy for him to resist the commander-level deterrence.
In the blink of an eye, the deterrence level reached the critical value of commander rank and monarch rank, reaching 30s.
At that moment, the audience was very numb.
Although 30 seconds represented the peak of the commander rank, this result was also very ridiculous for a high-level Beast Tamer like Shi Yu, with Shi Yu’s monster-like personal physique as a foundation, they could still accept this fact.
They only wanted to know if Shi Yu could break through the limit of 30 seconds!
At this moment.
‘As 30 seconds arrived, even with the full-strength hardening and deterrence entanglement, Shi Yu felt the pressure again. A huge pressure attacked, and time seemed to have stopped. Every second began to feel like a year to Shi Yu.
“30 seconds.”
As he arrived at 30 seconds, Shi Yu knew that the most critical moment had arrived. Whether he could last another second was very important.
At this moment, many people also stopped breathing. They knew that the next turning point was very important.
They looked at the rock pillar. In an instant, the venue was blurred. It was covered by a substantial brown pressure, as if the sky had collapsed. An even more terrifying pressure directly covered Shi Yu.
Unlike the fused White Brook, which released deterrence resistance and the possessed Lu Qingyi using wind pressure to resist deterrence, Shi Yu, who relied on hardening entanglement to resist the pressure, looked very small.
A powerful monarch-level pressure attacked, making everyone’s hearts freeze. They didn’t know if Shi Yu could still persist.
However, at this moment…
‘As the weakest monarch-level pressure descended, Shi Yu also began to display new strength. His sudden eruption shocked everyone.
Boom!!!
A huge aura erupted from Shi Yu’s body. The skill, Possession, was very special. It could be directly activated by a pet in the Beast Taming Space. Now, with Chi Tong, a high-level overlord race whose energy level had already exceeded that of Buggy, possessing Shi Yu’s aura… He erupted like a volcano. A
shocking flame lingered in Shi Yu’s eyes.
A dazzling aura shot into the sky and headed for the pressure!
“After possession, 500,000 energy points.”
At this moment, Lu Qingyi had already put on her glasses again. Under the display of the index, she muttered about the new battle power after Chi Tong’s max-level possession and Shi Yu’s powerful physique overlapped.
It directly reached the standard of a commander race’s monarch level.
“What!” Beside him, White Brook was slightly shocked. However, when she thought of Shi Yu’s physique and Chi Tong’s race, she was relieved. In any case, Shi Yu’s Buggy was even more ridiculous.
As the pressure descended, Shi Yu entered the possession state. Under the blooming of his strength, the aura that surged into the sky reached more than ten meters high. It instantly suppressed the power of the pressure back, making the pressure domain totter!
“This…”
Everyone widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
At this moment, in the flames, Shi Yu’s entire body was wrapped in fiery red flames. His hair color was instantly dyed red, and his pupils tuned into Chi Tong. The fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun flickered and shone. At this moment, Shi Yu’s entire body seemed to have become thinner
but more powerful, as if he had entered the domain of gods.
Such a change instantly made the surrounding Beast Tamers speechless. For a short period of time, they could only stare blankly at everything.
“31 seconds.”
Next, every second was a race against time. At the most critical moment, Shi Yu’s Spirit continued to erupt during his counting process. At this moment, after helping Eleven resist the monarch-level pressure, the restrained Eleven also joined the battlefield. It directly jumped down and its body slowly
enlarged.
“Roar!!!”
Shi Yu resisted the pressure in front. Behind him, Eleven instantly turned from a small Iron-eating Beast about 0.3 meters into a huge beast more than ten meters tall. All of this happened in half a second. In the fire spiritual energy, Shi Yu raised his head slightly and his body floated up. At the same time,
Eleven, who had become a huge beast, stretched out his arm and stretched out a huge palm for Shi Yuluo to hold in his palm.
“It might be difficult to do this in battle, but now..”
“32 seconds!”
Boom!
‘The pressure strengthened further. Shi Yu, who was in the possession state, felt a huge pressure again. He felt that his and Little Chi Tong’s strength couldn’t withstand it, but at this moment, the light of evolution shone on Eleven.
Ascene that made everyone’s eyes widen happened again. Under the white evolution light, the Little Iron-eating Beast’s body expanded further. In the blink of an eye, it reached a huge height of 50 to 60 meters, about the size of the rock pillar. Its huge size was shocking.
“This…”
At this moment, Shi Yu was still standing on the palm filled with the light of evolution, resisting the deterrence with his and Chi Tong’s Yang flames. In the next moment, Eleven’s full appearance after evolution appeared. A huge beast with blue eyes that were 50 to 60 meters tall and covered in black and
silver armor was looking at the rock pillar disdainfully.
At this moment, as the evolution light dissipated, what replaced the white light was the powerful lightning that erupted from the Nine Li Battle Beast’s body. The blue and white lightning instantly turned into Thunder God Armor and wrapped around Eleven’s body. Moreover, it flowed towards Shi Yu, who
was standing in its palm!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s expression was calm. He raised his arm and a flaming sword condensed in his hand before slowly descending.
With a loud bang, the fire spiritual energy on Shi Yu’s body instantly fused with the lightning. At this moment, there was blue lightning lingering on Shi Yu’s body, and orange and red Yang flames flowing. Under the interweaving of the two intertwining powers, Shi Yu’s aura increased further!
With the Interlocking Sword as the core, the sword pressure that fused the power of lightning and the power of yang instantly displayed power that exceeded the limit.
Boom!!!
Inan instant, the Thunder Flame Sword Suppression domain that bloomed in front of Shi Yu, the huge power of thunder flames that surged into the sky, and the pressure condensed into an earth-brown color from the rock pillar pressed against each other. The shocking collision sounds lingered in the air,
making everyone look at Shi Yu in the huge beast’s palm in a daze.
Many people knew that Shi Yu was an Iron-eating Beast Knight.
However, the impression of Shi Yu riding a giant panda and holding a wooden sword still lingered.
Now, under the support of the huge beast that was dozens of meters tall, the power that erupted from Shi Yu’s body directly stimulated everyone’s values.
“Energy value, 1.5 million.”
At this moment, even Lu Qingyi, this proud daughter of heaven, narrowed her eyes. Under the fusion of the Interlocking Sword, the power of lightning and Yang flames after the eruption of the Eleven Maximum Level Giant Transformation directly displayed an effect of one plus one equaling to more than
two, forming a ridiculously high level power of thunder flames, causing the energy on Shi Yu’s body to undergo a qualitative change!!
“33 seconds!”
Shi Yu ignored the serious injuries his body gradually suffered from the tearing of the lightning flames and spoke excitedly. This pressure was inferior to Mu Huiyin’s test. It could be endured. He looked straight at the rock pillar and felt that reaching White Brook might be difficult, but wasn’t it impossible to
get close?
Boom!
In this second, the collision of the two forces had also reached a ridiculous level. The audience was stunned, and the recorder glanced at the time in disbelief.
At this moment, every second was worth thinking about seriously. Golden flames filled the sky, and under the flickering of lightning, the power of thunder flames that erupted from Shi Yu’s body directly intertwined with the pressure released by the rock pillar to produce black lightning!
Boom, the rock pillar vibrated!
The violent collision was even more exaggerated than Lu Qingyi’s time.
However, no one noticed that a special program was surprisingly activated in the huge rock pillar in the arena.
It was as if Shi Yu, who was challenging deterrence in the arena, had accidentally reached a hidden condition.
At this moment, Shi Yu was willing to call the Iron-eating Beast Knight Thunder Flame Form the strongest battle tactic!
“That’s all? Next…”
Just as Shi Yu wanted to challenge the 34th second, just as everyone was looking at Shi Yu’s dazzling performance on the Nine Li Battle Beast’s palm in disbelief, something unexpected happened!
Boom!
Crack.
In the huge arena, the rock pillar suddenly cracked with a crack.
At the same time, the deterrence of the rock pillar was restrained crazily, and the vibration of the rock pillar was even more obvious. Cracks kept appearing on it, suddenly stunning everyone present and making them reveal blank expressions.
“Holy shit!” Shi Yu was also shocked when he saw this change.
‘The mighty and domineering Eleven and him shuddered and instantly withered in fear, not knowing what had suddenly happened.
‘The surrounding Beast Tamers and the two masters who recorded the results instantly opened their mouths wide.
Holy shit.
‘What happened?
Rock… The rock pillar cracked?
Even if Shi Yu was very fierce, it couldn’t be…
Below, White Brook was originally shocked by Shi Yu’s performance. However, as the change occurred, she was suddenly stunned. She didn’t know what had happened.
Only Lu Qingyi spoke very calmly at the side. “You go and explain to Principal Feng yourself. You’re the one who brought Shi Yu to participate in the martial arts conference. The one in charge of guarding Emperor Wu Ruins… is also your Bai family. I don’t know anything.”
White Brook:???
She looked at the stunned Shi Yu and the stone pillar that had started to shatter on the arena. Although she didn’t know what had happened, she instantly put on the painful mask. Shi Yu… Shi Yu…
‘Thinking of Principal Feng’s instructions to let Shi Yu stay in school obediently, White Brook originally felt that he was making a big fuss, but now, she instantly understood. What a painful realization…
“Ah!!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - Speculation of the Crack of the Rock
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Speculation of the Crack of the Rock Pillar
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The stone pillar cracked.
Although the surface area of the crack was not large, it was indeed cracked.
Cracks that looked like spiderwebs appeared dozens of meters tall in the rock pillar filled with historical traces.
Then, with a crack, the crack completely shattered. A large amount of rocks fell, and a huge hole appeared in the rock pillar as if a hole had appeared in its stomach.
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu, who was in the arena, was completely stunned.
He looked miserable with an innocent expression.
‘Eleven, this.. this shouldn’t be our fault, right??”
‘Chi Tong, say something!”
“Do you… know what’s going on?”
The crack of the rock pillar was too sudden, catching Shi Yu completely off guard.
Although Shi Yu had once chatted with a few ruins, such as Ping Cheng ruins and the Iron-eating Beast ruins, those were not accidents.
The historical spirit was not a life form. It was in a superimposed state of existence and nonexistence. Its state was very unstable. When someone listened to it, if the thing that carried it was very weak, it was very common for the carrier to crack because of the changes in the historical spirit.
Shi Yu had heard from Senior Lu that the members of Bureau 11 had the experience of looking at the cracked ruins. Although it wasnt often, it happened.
If it were because he had heard the history spirit causing the rock pillar to crack, Shi Yu would definitely not be so stunned.
Although that would damage Emperor Wu Ruins, it also meant that he could immediately review some of the history locked in Emperor Wu Ruins.
This would be a major archeological discovery.
Until now, although the Dong Huang Association had figured out how to enter and exit Emperor Wu Ruins, figured out the use of the nine training facilities inside, and knew that it might be a training ground built by Emperor Wu for his subordinates… No one knew which army it was built for, what its
purpose was, etc.
This information might not be important, but it might be. Perhaps the true historical value of the ruins was not as simple as the nine training facilities that people currently saw.
Therefore, if it was because he had listened to the ruins that had cracked in secret history, Shi Yu would still be at ease. However, the problem was that he didn’t feel anything and was just accepting the test… In the end, the rock pillar cracked.
‘What was this surprise?
Eleven: (Wu wu wu wu]
Chi Tong: [Jil
The two of them also expressed their innocence.
