At this moment, the withered Eleven was like a deflated ball that kept shrinking. Shi Yu didn’t remove his possession state. If he dared to do so at this moment, the damage caused by the release of the Interlocking Sword Pressure could instantly make him fall.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had been possessed by the Phoenix Spirit, was relying on Little Chi Tong’s proficient level Spirit Release’s Flame of Regeneration to quickly recover his physical fitness and injuries. This was the greatest confidence Shi Yu had now that he dared to use the power of a monarch at
the commander rank without fear of backlash.
As long as he healed enough, he wasn’t afraid of getting injured.
“Well.”
At this moment, a portion of the rock pillar cracked, but there was no subsequent reaction. After a moment of silence, Shi Yu looked at everyone.
Everyone was speechless…
Shi Yu:”..”
He looked at the two masters who were known to be strong.
“This rock pillar… seems to have been around for too long. It’s getting very old.”
Shi Yu said shyly.
Even the facilities built by legendary Beast Tamers were 2000 years old. It was normal for them to be a little damaged.
The two of them were speechless.
They looked very devastated.
‘What were these words! Their eyes widened even more than the iron-eating beast’s dark circles. Their mucus flowed out unstoppably, and their bodies trembled.
They didn’t know if the rock pillar had aged or not. They only knew that they definitely couldn’t avoid being criticized.
What a tough life.
What happened!!
“From the looks of it, he didn’t seem to have heard the Voice of History. In that state, he doesn’t have the energy to communicate with the rock pillar. The rock pillar is cracked, most likely for other reasons.”
Lu Qingyi showed an interesting expression.
As expected of this guy, just causing things to happen.
“Senior, stop being sarcastic. What should we do? What should we do? My second grandfather will probably charge in later.”
“feel that Shi Yu is right. We probably caught up to the aging of the rock pillar. We can’t take the blame for this.”
At this moment, White Brook hugged her head, her face filled with despair.
At this moment, in the silent scene, the two masters in charge of presiding over the strength verification reacted and suddenly stood up.
‘Certification stop, seal the entire venue. Everyone, stay where you are!”
‘Wu Ling City.
In the Bai family.
Ina garden-style courtyard.
A thin old man with a gray goatee was sitting leisurely on a wooden chair and sunbathing.
A thin old man with a gray goatee was sitting leisurely on a wooden chair and sunbathing.
“Dad, bad news. Something happened at the Emperor Wu Ruins. A portion of the rock pillar at the Linwei Stage cracked, and a huge hole appeared in the middle.”
Bang.
The former legendary Beast Tamer, Old Master Bai, who had already retired and was enjoying his later years, suddenly charged backward…
“What did you say???”
Ancient Capital.
Principal Feng also received a call.
“Grandpa Feng, it’s me.”
Hearing White Brook’s timid voice, Principal Feng smiled.
“Xiaoxi, what’s the matter?”
“Grandpa Feng, there’s something I want to tell you. Don’t be excited when you hear it.”
“Damn, what can I be excited about?” Principal Feng had actually already guessed what White Brook wanted to say.
White Brook said, “Me, Senior Lu, Shi Yu, we came to Wuling City to participate in the martial arts conference.”
Principal Feng showed an unsurprised expression and said, “I knew you guys wouldn’t be able to stay. Just go, go. Come back earlier.”
Sigh, with Lu Qingyi watching, he was still more at ease.
“But the problem is… something happened.”
“When Shi Yu resisted the rock pillar pressure of the Wei Lin Platform… the rock pillar cracked… A huge hole was made.”
Principal Feng: “?”
Principal Feng: “?”
“What did you say???”
Ina room in the Beast Tamer Association in Wu Ling City, Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, White Brook, and the two Master Bai who were present at that time sat obediently in their seats.
On the other side was an old man and a middle-aged man in a formal suit.
One of the two was White Brook’s second grandfather, the legendary Beast Tamer Bai Ming. The other was White Brook’s uncle, the president of the Beast Tamer Association in Wu Ling City.
The few of them had already exchanged greetings and had already gotten to the point.
This incident could be said to be serious or not serious. After all, there was no direct evidence that the shattering of the rock pillar was related to Shi Yu. Moreover, even if it was related, it was a small matter. After all, the ownership of Emperor Wu Ruins was frankly still national, and Shi Yu was a member of
Bureau 11 and 3. Even if the entire Emperor Wu Ruins collapsed, Shi Yu would be fine. However, the most important thing now was to find the reason for the shattering of the rock pillar.
‘Ive already verified it just now. The Wei Lin Platform seems to be stuck. It lost the ability to release deterrence. The deterrence wrapped around it shouldn’t have dissipated yet. However, due to a certain program error, it doesn’t follow the rules anymore,” Master Bai Feng, who was in charge of recording the
time results, said with a miserable expression.
“However, the other facilities aren’t affected.”
Was this result good or bad…
“Qingyi, and Shi Yu. Is it really not because of your abilities?” Old Master Bai Ming had a bitter expression. The ruins had shattered. He suspected that this group of archeologists had caused this.
After discovering Emperor Wu Ruins, the Bai family had protected Emperor Wu Ruins for so many years. Wu Ling City relied on Emperor Wu Ruins to become a super big city ranked in the top 15 in the country. The Beast Tamer Troops in the city were only inferior to the nine first-level cities because of
Emperor Wu Ruins. Over the years, Emperor Wu Ruins had always been stable. Why was something broken this time?
Although only one training facility was destroyed, Bai Ming still felt the pinch. After all, the Linwei Stage was the best among the nine training facilities. Beast Tamers of any level could use it.
“Grandpa Bai, don’t worry. Perhaps it’s really because the rock pillar has aged. It’s a coincidence.” Lu Qingyi smiled bitterly. “After all, it’s almost 2000.”
White Brook nodded crazily.
This was the most perfect explanation.
However.
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was leaning on the sofa, had been in deep thought the entire time.
“Of course, it can’t be ruled out that it’s really related to me,” he said.
“But, it’s definitely for other reasons. I suddenly had a guess just now.”
Shi Yu’s words attracted the attention of everyone present.
Lu Qingyi and White Brook couldn’t help but be stunned when they saw Shi Yu taking the initiative to take the blame for them.
At this moment, Shi Yu said, “I once cracked a ruin in the ancient capital, the Iron-eating Beast Ruins.”
“The history of the construction of that ruin should be about 4,500 years ago now. It was built in the totem era, but there are a large number of human traces inside, including some antiques. Those are from 2000 years ago. It happens to correspond to the era of Emperor Wu, so this ruin should have been
developed once during the Emperor Wu Dynasty.”
“At that time, I saw the shadow of history in the ruins. A group of people cultivated the Nine Li Battle Beast Corps in batches. It was at that time that I discovered the iron-eating beast evolution method. Now, what I can’t determine is whether the shadow of history at that time recorded the scene of the totem
era or the era of Emperor Wu Dynasty.”
“If we use the hypothetical method.. If the scene recorded at that time was the time of Emperor Wu, then at that time, the faction that could have such a powerful battle beast army was probably the second generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty, the army under Emperor Wu.”
“In the historical scene, I clearly saw the potential of the Iron-eating Beast. Such a pet might even have been contracted by Emperor Wu. After all, there’s not much information about him passed down. The pets that can be confirmed to be his, like “Zhong Xuan’, are few.”
“In short, in order to investigate if it’s possible for Emperor Wu to contract an Iron-eating Beast and if the Wu Emperor Dynasty has an Iron-eating Beast Corps, I came to participate in the martial arts conference. I plan to mainly investigate the ruins of Emperor Wu.”
‘Just now, I made a hypothesis. If this Emperor Wu Ruins is a training ground built by Emperor Wu for a certain army under his command, and this army happens to be the Iron-eating Beast Army. Could the appearance of me and the Iron-eating Beast have activated some mechanism?”
“The nine major training facilities don’t seem to be purely training facilities, though they also have the nature of training facilities. They might also be built to choose elite soldiers. If a certain soldier’s performance on the Wei Lin Platform is outstanding and obtains the recognition of the training facilities,
theoretically speaking, the ruins can also trigger the reward mechanism.”
“Could it be that the ruins mistakenly treated Eleven and me as soldiers who contracted an Iron-eating Beast in the Iron-eating Beast Corps and coincidentally triggered the reaction of the ruins? Although… there doesn’t seem to be any rewards, it’s also possible that the ruins have been put on hold for too
long.”
Shi Yu analyzed and summarized the incident. This deduction stunned Lu Qingyi, White Brook, and Legend Bai.
“And maybe this nine-pillar reward represents the nine inscriptions?” Shi Yu looked at Lu Qingyi. He realized that he was obsessed over the number 9, attaching it to everything.
However, this explanation made Lu Qingyi and White Brook, who knew the nine inscriptions, feel that it didn’t seem to be unreasonable.
Under the premise that the trial facilities established in the ruins had a reward mechanism, if a soldier performed well, would it trigger the changes in the ruins and give rewards?
In theory, this was completely possible.
And Legend Bai also knew the situation at that time.
As a high-level Beast Tamer, Shi Yu displayed strength that exceeded ordinary monarch-level pets. He lasted for more than 33 seconds. Although this battle result had never appeared, it was definitely very terrifying.
In such a situation, even without the Iron-eating Beast factor, it was possible for Shi Yu to be recognized as an outstanding challenger by the trial facilities.
Everyone’s expressions changed slightly. So Shi Yu’s guess was reliable?
“So I feel that I might have to study the rock pillar of the Wei Lin Platform,” Shi Yu said.
He didn’t push the blame. It was mainly because his own deduction had convinced him that this rock pillar had a lot of research value. What if he discovered a way to carve an inscription nearby? Although there was no reward for the rock pillar, maybe the reward was that one could carve an inscription
nearby. In short, he urgently wanted to try it now.
“This.” Legend Bai was stunned.
At the mention of archeology, Lu Qingyi’’s eyes gradually lit up.
“feel that we can give it a try. After all, according to what you said previously, the Nine Li Battle Beast with the inscription might be an overlord race. If we can discover something here, the historical value of Emperor Wu Ruins will be truly excavated.”
“Right?” After obtaining Senior Lu’s recognition, Shi Yu’s motivation immediately came out.
The two of them were enthusiastic. Legend Bai was stunned. They still wanted to continue researching? Was it really fine? The martial arts conference had to continue. If any more problems appeared, the economic loss of Wu Ling City would be huge.
At the same time, not long after the stone pillar shattered…
In the space of the Emperor Wu Ruins, within a deep space, a huge monster that no one had discovered slowly opened its eyes and woke up from its sleep.
It was a hundred meters tall and had a brown tortoise-shaped body. Its shell was like dry cracked ground, filled with injuries.
If someone familiar with the history of the Imperial Court of Emperor Wus saw it, they would definitely be able to tell that this was one of the few pets recorded by Emperor Wus.. It was a quasi-mythical race, “Zhong Xuan’ with the bloodline of a divine turtle!

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - Another Trick
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Another Trick
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the ruins of Emperor Wu.
Wei Lin Platform, one of the nine major training facilities.
At the moment, a group of people was studying the rock pillar.
Apart from Shi Yu and the others, even Principal Feng came.
Initially, he had wanted to come over to settle things, but after coming here, he immediately fell silent after hearing Shi Yu’s words.
“Research, I have to study it.”
This might be a major archeological discovery.
“Then let’s study it. What can I do? I’m also very desperate.” White Brook’s second grandfather was very helpless.
Now that the rock pillar was broken, if there were other archeological discoveries, it would still be worth it.
If what Ji Yu said was the case, Emperor Wu Ruins might be the training ground of the Iron-eating Beast Army. The nine pillar training facility might represent the opportunity for the iron-eating beasts to ascend to an overlord race. Then, this was a stable cultivation channel for overlord races!
Its value even exceeded the discovery of the green cocoon.
It far exceeded the current value of Emperor Wu Ruins!
With the idea that no matter how bad it was, there couldn’t be a worse situation, Shi Yu successfully obtained the research rights to the rock pillar.
As for the other eight training facilities, Old Master Bai Ming didn’t dare to let Shi Yu try them easily. At least, he couldn’t let Shi Yu cause any trouble before the martial arts conference ended.
In order to prepare for the martial arts conference, Wu Ling City had made a lot of preparations. Now, they only wanted the martial arts conference to end normally. This wasn’t too much, right?
For the sake of time, letting Shi Yu come into contact with the rock pillar again was already the limit.
“How exactly?”
Beside the rock pillar, Shi Yu and Eleven sat on the ground with conflicted expressions.
There was no way to successfully carve inscriptions here.
Could they be overthinking?
For some strange ritual feelings, Shi Yu even flew up and embedded Eleven in the huge hole in the rock pillar to let it carve inscriptions, but it was still unsuccessful.
Even Principal Feng and Bai Ming, two former legends, didn’t discover anything after studying the rock pillar.
For the next few days, Shi Yu studied it. During this period, he used various methods to try and carve inscriptions, but he didn’t succeed.
After consecutive failures, he even had a bold idea.
“This is a relatively special earth-element pure crystal. It’s not a metal resource at all. Are you sure the Iron-eating Beast can eat it?”
Lu Qingyi and White Brook acted as Shi Yu’s assistants beside him these two days and asked.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven cried, It didn’t want to eat dirt.
This stone pillar fragment didn’t look like something delicious no matter how one looked at it. It wasn’t a ginseng baby.
“Tm just kidding, just kidding.” Shi Yu’s head hurt.
“Could it be a mistake?”
He couldn’t carve it or communicate with the spirit of the ruins. It was very uncomfortable.
“Do you think it’s possible that a total of nine cracks are needed to meet the triggering conditions of the reward mechanism? The current progress is only one out of nine. We still need to reach the same conditions in the other eight training facilities…”
Shi Yu guessed quietly.
It was just like how it was useless to have one dragon ball, they had to gather seven!
Perhaps by shattering the nine stone pillars, he could summon the reward!
White Brook:???
Lu Qingyi had a headache. “The key is that a few training facilities aren’t for high-level Beast Tamers to use at all. Only master-level Beast Tamers can activate them. Moreover, are you sure?”
“What if all nine training facilities are destroyed and there’s nothing…”
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. Wasn’t this a guess?
“Idon’t think we can figure anything out here. Why don’t we go to other usable training facilities after the martial arts conference?” White Brook suggested. “The preliminaries are almost over. Let’s finish the main competition first.”
“Uh, martial arts conference.”
Shi Yu was stunned. There seemed to be such a thing.
“The preliminaries are almost over? Aren’t there a lot of people? I thought it would still be a few days.”
In the past few days of studying the rock pillar, the preliminaries of the martial arts conference had already begun. As for Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook, because they had passed the strength certification, they automatically obtained the opportunity to advance to the main competition.
“Of course it’s almost over,” White Brook said. “We can finish today.”
“Alright, why don’t we go for a meal first?” Shi Yu suggested.
The two of them nodded.
Then, the three of them began to leave. After leaving the rock pillar, Shi Yu was actually a little guilty.
He suddenly felt that his deduction was a little unreliable.
This was because some of the facilities in the ruins of Emperor Wu were built with the special mineral rock pillar. Previously, these buildings were intact and couldn’t be tested for its composition. But this time, after Lu Qingyi helped Shi Yu examine the composition of the shattered rock pillar, she
discovered that it was only a special earth-element energy crystal.
It didn’t even contain a little metal element.
This was a little far from the inference, because if it was a training field built for the Iron-eating Beast Army, wouldn’t it be better to use metal-element materials? Could it be that he was afraid that the Iron-eating Beast would eat the training field during the training process?
The composition of the rock pillar made Shi Yu feel that this was the training ground of a certain earth-clement pet army, not the Iron-eating Beast Training Ground.
In short, it was too difficult. He wanted to go for a meal and participate in a martial arts conference to relieve the pressure.
After Shi Yu and the others left, in the depths of the ruins, the awakened Divine Turtle Zhong Xuan slowly opened its red eyes again.
In the past few days, everything that happened in Emperor Wu Ruins had fallen into its eyes.
It sighed deeply in its heart. It didn’t expect that just recuperating after the battle took two thousand years. When it woke up again, everything had changed.
Its former comrades had probably died long ago. In the tragic battle, it was one of the few that barely survived with racial advantages.
It didn’t wake up today because its injuries had healed. From the beginning to the end, it had relied on sleeping to prevent its injuries from worsening. This time, it woke up because its injuries had worsened to the extreme. It estimated that it was its final final moments before death. It wasn’t far from the
end of its lifespan, or even in these few days.
“But I didn’t expect that someone could break the record here.”
Zhong Xuan looked at Shi Yu and the others who had left the ruins from the sky’s perspective. Then, his gaze landed on the nine pillars of the ruins and he thought of a very important thing.
Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, it was the next day.
In order to participate in the martial arts conference, Shi Yu temporarily gave up studying the rock pillar and rested for the whole day to adjust his mood.
This made Shi Yu arrive at the battle arena of Emperor Wu Ruins in a relatively good mood the next day.
Over the past few decades, the ruins of Emperor Wu had long been developed by Wu Ling City into a large building garden that integrated tourist attractions and training competitions. The venue of this martial arts conference was a venue in Emperor Wu Ruins.
“Eh, I can finally move around.”
“Twonder who will be chosen. Please don’t let it be Senior Lu.”
At the drawing venue of the main competition.
Among Shi Yu and the others, White Brook was nervous.
If he was unlucky enough to draw Lu Qingyi in the first round and not those high-level Beast Tamers, his luck would be too bad.
In the lottery segment, at this moment, including those who had passed the strength verification and those who had passed the preliminaries, a total of 64 contestants were waiting for the lottery.
Seeing the combination of White Brook, Lu Qingyi, and Shi Yu, the other contestants, be it masters or high-level Beast Tamers, all cast different gazes.
However, more people’s gazes landed on Shi Yu, making him feel uncomfortable.
“He’s that Shi Yu who destroyed the rock pillar that certified his strength, right?”
“Good lord, good lord.”
Shi Yu’s arrival attracted the attention of many in the audience.
Now that a few days had passed, the rock pillar was still sealed and not repaired. The news that the rock pillar had broken when Shi Yu went up to receive the certification had already spread everywhere.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s battle results were also spread everywhere.
33 seconds. Even a master-level Beast Tamer wasn’t that capable of lasting.
Even a master-level Beast Tamer with Fusion Talent who contracted a monarch-level pet might not necessarily be able to last 33 seconds.
But Shi Yu did.
Although he didn’t know why the rock pillar was broken, it was very difficult not to pay attention to him.
“The people from Bureau 11 are really troublesome.”
At the same time, on the platform, Old Master Bai Ming, who was the special guest of the main competition, was still looking at Shi Yu with a headache.
Beside him, two middle-aged men who were also members of the Bai family were smiling bitterly.
Among these two people, one was the president of the Beast Tamer Association in Wuling City, and the other was the commander of the Beast Tamer Troops in Wuling City, White Brook’s uncle. The two of them were also special guests of this martial arts conference. They had both obtained first place in
the martial arts conference. Now, they were top-notch masters. But no matter how high their identities were, how could they be happy?
If there was anyone who felt the most heartache when the rock pillar was destroyed, it would definitely be them.
This rock pillar was broken, and the subsequent training problems were very serious. Then, if they wanted to maintain the previous regiment’s training efficiency, they had to invest other resources. That would turn into an economic problem in Wu Ling City
“It’s still easier to organize competitions and train. Developing ruins is tiring and not pleasing.”
“Fortunately, no new abnormalities have appeared in the past few days…”
President Bai still smiled bitterly.
Soon, the time for drawing lots arrived. The 64 contestants present stepped forward to draw lots, and the tens of thousands of spectators present watched intently.
This time, just the tickets alone were sold for hundreds of millions of yuan in Wu Ling City. This was also why the martial arts conference had to be held normally no matter what. Fortunately, the rock pillar was broken, and there was no problem with the Emperor Wu Ruins. Otherwise, just the ticket
money would have to be lost a lot.
“Tm number 12??”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at his number in surprise.
This luck
“Wow, number one.”
White Brook looked at Shi Yu’s number and was very envious.
It was the easiest to finish the first round. Next, he could watch the others compete in peace.
“Tm number 29, very far behind,” Lu Qingyi said.
Swoosh.
As the three of them were discussing, Shi Yu suddenly felt a hostile gaze from afar.
He pinched the number and looked over. He saw a middle-aged man nearly two meters tall looking at him unhappily.
Shi Yu :”…”
As everyone finished drawing their lots, the member of the Bai family, Master Bai Feng, who was in charge of the martial arts conference, walked onto the stage and said, “The drawing of lots is completed. According to the statistics, the first match is between contestant Shi Yu and contestant Chen Yu.”
“The other contestants, please wait at the player area.”
Compared to the battlefield hall of Imperial Capital University, the venue facilities here were relatively simple. Even the battle list was written on the huge blackboard by pets for people to see.
The first battle was Shi Yu vs Chen Yu.
Seeing these two names, many people were stunned.
Because the name Chen Yu was not unfamiliar to most people. He had participated in the martial arts conference last year and even obtained good results in the top 32. He was a master-level Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu… had encountered a master.
Although Shi Yu had displayed monarch-level strength during the test, according to everyone’s understanding, that kind of condition should be very difficult to achieve here.
In the official segment of the martial arts conference, which was a race against time, the opponent wouldnt easily let Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast become so powerful.
In order to resist the pressure, Eleven had used the full-level Giant Transformation and Inner Power to give Shi Yu such a huge power.
But in this environment, it was almost impossible for the Iron-eating Beast to expand to 5 to 60 meters. The venue was not that big.
On the platform, Legend Bai touched his goatee and said, “Who’s that person?”
“Chen Yu, 37 years old. He’s from the suburbs of Wu Ling City. He’s a master-level Beast Tamer. He has the Fusion Talent and has a monarch-level pet, the Dragon Blood Turtle. After fusing, his defense is astonishing. He mainly cultivates defensive moves. In the preliminaries, he’s known as the Pure
Imperial ceiling. No one can break through his defense.”
“However, it’s said that his personality is not very good due to the influence of his pet. His family runs a bar. When he was a student, he was a thorny hoodlum with a very bad temper. He liked to fight a lot. If it weren’t for the fact that his family has a strong relationship, he might not necessarily be able to
be a Beast Tamer.”
“He directly entered the main competition last year… But this year, because his registration wasn’t timely, he was stuck on the last day. Because the rock pillar was broken, the remaining people, including him, could only start fighting directly from the preliminaries,” President Bai explained beside him.
“Oh, oh.” Old Master Bai was amused. In other words, this person had been inconvenienced by Shi Yu?
He could have entered the main competition directly with the certification, but because the rock pillar was broken, he had to participate in the preliminaries for a few more days??
Great.
Soon, only Shi Yu and Chen Yu were left. Shi Yu realized that this person was the big man who had looked at him with hostility just now. He couldn’t help but be puzzled. The competition was second, and friendship was first. Why was there such deep hatred?
“The atmosphere seems very heavy.”
“Speaking of which, why did Master Chen Yu start fighting from the preliminaries this year? Didn’t he directly guarantee admission to the main competition last year?”
“Iknow, because the rock pillar broke after Shi Yu. The people behind can’t be verified at all. I’m dying of laughter.”
“Pfft, that’s really a sad thing.”
The battle had yet to begin, and many people realized that Master Chen Yu had been inconvenienced by Shi Yu before. They couldnt help but look forward to the battle between them in advance.
Chen Yu still had strength. Although he was a new master of Wu Ling in the past two years, after the Dragon Tortoise fused, the shocking defense and life force of the middle-level monarch race’s Dragon Blood Tortoise gave him very strong battle ability.
The agile mobility of the human body coupled with the defense of the Dragon Turtle could be said to be making up for each other’s shortcomings.
In the arena, Master Chen Yu stared at Shi Yu. All the muscles in his body protruded as he said to Shi Yu, “Shi Yu, right? I don’t care how talented you are. I won’t show mercy. If you feel that you can’t take it anymore later, admit defeat quickly.”
If it were anyone else, Chen Yu would have long cursed. Considering Shi Yu’s special identity, he was still considered rational now. However, because Shi Yu had made it so that he fought for three more days in the preliminaries, this really made Chen Yu unhappy.
Generally speaking, he wouldn’t give anyone who made him unhappy a good impression. As for whether he would be ostracized by the system because he offended someone, he expressed that he had never been part of the system. In any case, he was the only one at home now. He didn’t have to worry
about food and drink, so he just had to do whatever he wanted.
“Wu…” In the face of Chen Yu’s words, Shi Yu said,” I will, but I still hope that Big Brother will show mercy. I’m only a high-level Beast Tamer.”
“Why don’t you send a commander-level pet to fight me?”
Chen Yu: ”
“What the f*ck do you want!!!” Chen Yu was furious. Why did he feel like he had punched cotton after insulting Shi Yu? He felt like he had made himself even angrier.
How hateful.
In the contestant area, many contestants revealed happy expressions when they saw that Chen Yu and Shi Yu were full of gunpowder. Lu Qingyi and White Brook were no exception. There were not many masters with such violent tempers. It looked much more interesting than a friendly battle.
“Can we begin?” Chen Yu looked at the judge, Bai Feng, beside him.
Then, the judge, Bai Feng, gave the order to begin.
“Wau!!!”
Without any nonsense, Chen Yu’s entire body was covered in the red tortoise shell in an instant. At the same time, because Chi Tong’s possession level was higher, Shi Yu’s possession speed was even faster.
In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu turned into the form of a red-haired Chi Tong, A sun-like fire spiritual aura erupted from his body, and a flaming sword appeared in Shi Yu’s hand.
Seeing this scene, many people were stunned. After all, only a small number of people had seen Shi Yu challenge the pressure of the rock pillar. Now, most people were seeing Shi Yu in the state of the Sword Spirit Possession for the first time.
“It’s said that it’s a sword spirit, a fire-element sword spirit.”
Many people in the audience muttered.
The Dragon Blood Turtle was a dragon-element subspecies. There was no attribute restraint relationship between the two parties. He didn’t know what the outcome of this battle would be.
However, from Chen Yu’s perspective, he didn’t think that a master-level Beast Tamer like him would be successfully challenged by a high-level Beast Tamer.
However, Chen Yu realized that his opponent’s attack speed was really fast.
Boom!!!
The moment both parties transformed, Chen Yu felt that the light in front of him was instantly snatched away, and the world seemed to have fallen into darkness.
At this moment, Chen Yu felt a wave of heat attack.
With a bang, a huge red sword light cut through the darkness on the other side, turning into a terrifying fire sword aura. It tore through the air and landed in front of Chen Yu.
“Light Flame Sword.”
On the other side, Shi Yu’s Flame Demon Armor and red cloak fluttered. He held his sword in one hand and slashed down with the sword aura. Because it was a battle above his level, he didn’t dare to be sloppy. He directly focused on seizing every opportunity to deal with it.
However.
The Yang Flame Sword that had fused with the power of the transcendent Yang Flame made Chen Yu, who was opposite him, extremely disdainful. He directly clawed at the air. With a boom, his fist seemed to have turned into a dragon’s claw, instantly sweeping up terrifying blood-colored energy and
scattering this sword aura.
High-level skill, Dragon Blood Claw!
On the other side, Chen Yu faced the scattered flames and smiled. “I say, although your strength is not bad, this attack is just ticklish?”
“Tl give you a chance. Ride your Iron-eating Beast and do it again.”
“Don’t blame me for not giving you a chance.”
“But a mere Iron-eating Beast… Haha.”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
This guy was getting too cocky.
Did he really think Shi Yu needed him to show mercy?
“Uncle, you’re very arrogant.”
Initially, he didn’t want to use that so early, but… Forget it, forget it, end it as soon as possible. He really didn’t have the mood to train himself now.
In the next moment, Shi Yu walked forward. Step by step, he stunned Chen Yu opposite him.
“Have you heard of the Ice Fire Dragon?”
Shi Yu said directly.
Then, a shimmering spatial ripple appeared in front of Shi Yu’s chest.
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and directly reached into the ruins space. He slowly pulled it out in the air. Then, shocking cold air surged. A blue divine sword was slowly pulled out of the alternate space and appeared in Shi Yu’s hand.
During this process, the flames and cold air around Shi Yu’s body lingered, transforming into the power of ice flames that filled the sky.
At the same time, a terrifying dragon roar emitted from the sword.
“Roar!!!”
The terrifying dragon roar instantly shocked the minds of everyone present, making them temporarily absent-minded. As for Chen Yu, who was opposite Shi Yu, he was even more absent-minded. He was directly stunned by the dragon might and was suppressed by the bloodline.
At the same time, Shi Yu slowly rose into the sky.
Soon, when Chen Yu returned to his senses, his pupils suddenly constricted. He realized that Shi Yu’s posture had completely changed. At this moment, a terrifying ice dragon phantom was born under Shi Yu and became his mount.
The huge frost dragon’s body seemed to be made of ice and stone. The color was ice-blue and dark purple, representing extreme cold.
It wasn’t just its body. Its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, as well as its pair of wings, were all made of ice and stone. Its scales revealed coldness, and snow lingered, forming a sharp contrast to Shi Yu in his fire form.
The Ice Dragon roared and flapped its wings.
At this moment, Little Chi Tong was also cheering, inexplicably liking to cooperate with the Ice Dragon Phantom.
Everything was ready. Shi Yu raised the Ice Dragon Blade high.
Swoosh!!!
An extremely dazzling sword aura, about ten meters tall and interweaving in blue and red, was like a rolling snowstorm. It was like an erupting volcano, directly sweeping the dragon might towards Chen Yu and crushing him with a suffocating deterrence. In terms of strength, it was not inferior to the
Thunder Flame Sword pressure Shi Yu slashed out on the arena!!
Boom!!!
The Ice Flame Dragon Sword crushed the arena, directly making Chen Yu’s pupils shrink. He felt that the threat far exceeded the previous Light Flame Sword, but while he wanted to dodge at this moment, he was already stunned by the dragon might and had nowhere to run.
The sword light of ice and fire attacked, directly sweeping up a huge dust mist and devouring Chen Yu in one go. The shocking aftermath instantly turned into a violent wind that blew Shi Yu’s red hair.
On the ice dragon, the red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu held the Ice Dragon Blade with a calm expression.
“Sorry, I don’t need an Iron-eating Beast to break through the defense of a little turtle.”
“The Iron-eating Beast is too strong. Even I’m afraid of using it.”
“A mere turtle.”
Shi Yu said calmly.
At this moment, all the contestants and spectators were shocked and shocked.
Holy shit.
‘What happened?
On the platform, Legend Bai and the other two were stunned.
“Level-seven weapon, a level-seven weapon that contains a dragon soul?”
At this moment, the smoke dispersed. Chen Yu, whose entire body was broken and corroded by ice and fire, stood on the ground. He was covered in injuries. His expression was stunned, and he was just as shocked as the audience. No one expected Shi Yu to turn around and take out a weapon of
ridiculously high level.
This was like two parties fighting bare-handed, with one side suddenly taking out a rocket cannon.
Outside the arena, White Brook opened her mouth wide and recalled the reminder that she had asked Shi Yu to prepare the equipment, but.
Where did Shi Yu get this sword from??
Just as everyone watched this battle in shock, Shi Yu raised the Ice Dragon Blade again and planned to end the opponent and take victory, something unexpected happened!
[Bullshit!!!]
[An Iron-eating Beast is the one that’s “mere”! A tortoise is definitely stronger than an Iron-eating Beast. It’s purely this guy got lucky!]
Ahuge roar suddenly spread across the entire sky of Emperor Wu Ruins, stunning everyone.
Shi Yu’s movements also froze immediately. He was stunned.
At this moment, the sudden change made Legend Bai explode. He immediately looked around in shock, not understanding what had happened.
‘Then, an even more strange scene appeared. A pair of huge red eyes appeared in the sky.
Under the gaze of the two eyes.
In the entire Emperor Wu Ruins, apart from Shi Yu, everyone’s bodies began to suffuse white light. They were actually teleported out of Emperor Wu Ruins one by one, leaving Shi Yu alone in the empty Emperor Wu Ruins to face this unbelievable scene.
“Holy shit.” Just as he finished showing off, Shi Yu immediately couldn’t hold it in anymore and revealed a crying expression.
What the f*ck, what the f*ck, what the f*ck happened again!!!
Senior Lu, Senior Bai, Grandpa Bai, Grandpa Feng, save me…!
At the same time, outside the ruins of Emperor Wu, more than ten thousand people instantly appeared in Wu Ling City and looked around in confusion.
Legend Bai stood on a certain place in a daze. Then, under their gaze, the nine external rock pillars in Wu Ling City cracked uniformly.
There was a crack.
Seeing this scene, Lu Qingyi, White Brook, Legend Bai, and the tens of thousands of spectators who were teleported out were all stunned. Huh?

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - Quasi Divine Beast Chong Xuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Quasi Divine Beast Chong Xuan
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Outside the ruins, the crowd was chaotic.
Everyone was stunned when they were suddenly teleported out of the competition.
In this situation, the higher the strength and status of the person, the more confused they were.
However, they had to quickly calm down and take charge of the situation.
“Dad.”
White Brook glanced at Legend Bai Ming.
Legend Bai’s expression was solemn.
“Damn it.” He directly cursed and looked at the sky in shock.
The big red eyes were gone.
But the pressure just now.
It was definitely a totem-level creature!!
Good lord.
In an instant, Legend Bai broke out in cold sweat.
There was also a hidden totem-level creature in the ruins of Emperor Wu??
This kind of thing.
The ruins of Emperor Wu had been developed for decades, but no one had discovered it.
“T’ve lost contact with the interior of the ruins.”
At this moment, Commander Bai, who was gently touching the rock pillar, said quickly with an ugly expression.
President Bai’s expression was also extremely ugly. This family felt that it was ridiculous.
Everyone recalled the situation just now.
Shi Yu was fighting Chen Yu. Before the outcome of the battle was decided, the ruins space suddenly trembled, and a huge pair of red eyes appeared in the sky.
They clearly heard a sentence.
It was a terrifying voice that cursed the Iron-eating Beast. The meaning was as if it was saying that the turtle was the best in the world and was very unhappy with the battle between Shi Yu and Chen Yu.
Then, there was nothing. Everyone was teleported out.
In the outside world, White Brook and Lu Qingyi looked at each other.
The two of them searched for Shi Yu, but unfortunately, they couldn’t find him.
Suddenly, the two of them had a bad feeling. They had pretty speechless expressions.
“Senior, I was wrong. I really messed up, really…”
Now, White Brook understood Principal Feng’s mood.
The top-notch totem in the Undead Battlefield was stimulated because Shi Yu had awakened it.
All the Beast Tamers in the ancient capital were shocked.
Now, when this stimulation appeared near her home, White Brook discovered that her previous comprehensions weren’t painful enough.
This time, it was really painful!
No matter how one looked at it, the scene just now looked like Shi Yu had offended a totem.
Very good, not only was the ruin broken, but a totem had also appeared. White Brook felt that she had encountered a big problem.
“Don’t be nervous first.” Lu Qingyi took a deep breath.
Based on her rich experience of courting death, things had yet to reach the worst state.
She had already informed Principal Feng to prepare to find a titled legend to take a look at the situation.
“Perhaps it’s not necessarily a hostile totem,” she said.
One possibility for the totem in Emperor Wu Space was that it was a totem suppressed by the nine pillars. Another was that it was the pet of Emperor Wu.
As long as it wasn’t the former, there was still room for reversal.
All of this was unbelievable and ridiculous, but at the moment, the first thing to do was definitely to manage the crowd.
Legend Bai said, “Maintain order first, evacuate the people to a safe place, and count the number of people.”
He quickly said, “President Bai and Commander Bai will also quickly carry out this matter.”
‘As for Legend Bai, he guarded outside the ruins to prevent any changes.
If there really was a totem-level creature, and it was an enemy, the entire Wu Ling City would probably instantly become ruins.
Level-two cities didn’t have the ability to resist totems.
As an old man, resisting an overlord-level creature was the limit. Totem creatures had to be dealt with by Titled Legends.
Soon, under the management of the Beast Tamer Troops, order was maintained.
Moreover, it didn’t take long for President Bai and the others to confirm something.
“We can confirm that everyone in the ruins space was teleported out, except for Shi Yu…”
“Apart from Shi Yu…”
As soon as this result was out, the faces of Legend Bai and the others in the outside world darkened almost instantly. They had a subtle headache.
“What a sin!
He wouldn’t believe that this matter had nothing to do with Shi Yu!
At this moment, the one whose mood had changed the most was definitely Shi Yu.
In the empty ruins of Emperor Wu, Shi Yu didn’t know how to face the huge pair of eyes in the sky.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy all came out of the Beast Taming Space at the same time and looked at the huge red eye nervously like Shi Yu.
oa
No matter how slow Shi Yu was, he knew that he was in trouble.
Fortunately, the red eyes that appeared in the sky didn’t seem to want to hurt him.
“Forget it, why should I be petty with you?”
A heavy voice sounded, and the world spun. Shi Yu felt his vision blur. Then, he appeared in a brown desolate world.
After arriving, Shi Yu’s pupils constricted further as he saw the appearance of the owner of the huge red eye.
This was the largest creature Shi Yu had ever seen.
Its body was as tall as a mountain, and its body length was estimated to be more than a hundred meters. It was even larger than Eleven in the superlative height state.
It was a tortoise-type creature. Its entire body was earth brown, and the color of the ground was extremely close. Its shell seemed to be carrying a mountain, but the most shocking thing was the terrifying black injuries on its body, making it look incomparably violent.
In front of Shi Yu, the archeological index changed crazily.
{Name}: Zhong Xuan
[Attributes]: Earth
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
{Level of Growth]: Totem Level
[Race Skill]:???
[Energy Points]:??
< Introduction > It’s one of the legendary four battle pets of Emperor Wu. It can control gravity.
“Gulp.”
When he saw the information on the archeological index, Shi Yu gulped several times.
Heavy… Zhong Xuan?!
“You’re… Zhong Xuan???”
Shi Yu said in shock.
This, this, this.
During the Emperor Wu era, only a portion of information about Emperor Wu was passed down.
People only knew that he had dragon, bird, tortoise, and tiger pets that often fused together. The information about other pets had been lost in history and couldn’t be studied. Among them, Emperor Wu’s turtle pet was Zhong Xuan.
An existence that had evolved to a nearly Mythical race and whose strength had even reached the totem level could be called a quasi-divine beast.
“Huh??? It’s me.”
Although two thousand years had already passed, Zhong Xuan was still very satisfied that his name could be passed down.
‘At the same time, Shi Yu’s expression suddenly became serious.
“You’re right. A mere Iron-eating Beast definitely can’t compare to the Turtle Race known as the Immortal Spirit Luck Beast. I only said that because I was angry that my opponent actually cultivated the Turtle Race to be so weak.”
“My dream is to obtain the recognition of a powerful Turtle Clan!”
Eleven:???
“Wu wu wu??”
What was wrong with the Iron-eating Beast? The Iron-eating Beast was clearly stronger than a turtle.
wu ~”
yi”
Buggy and Baby Ginseng advised Eleven to keep a low profile.
It was strong, but looking at the overall race, the Iron-eating Beast was indeed inferior to the Turtle Race, who had produced divine beasts.
“Of course.”
Seeing Shi Yu admit defeat, Zhong Xuan’s gaze flickered.
At least this brat was smart.
However, when he said this, Zhong Xuan was actually a little guilty.
It pondered for a moment and looked at Shi Yu and Eleven.
“although the Iron-eating Beast is ordinary, you guys are not bad. It’s also considered one of the best Iron-eating Beasts.”
“It’s just that you, a Beast Tamer, don’t seem to know how to nurture it very well. You haven’t developed its bloodline potential at all. If you don’t take the key step, why are you so anxious to carve the inscription?”
Shi Yu:
Eleven: Wu?
Now, Shi Yu’s mood had finally calmed down.
After learning that there was actually Emperor Wu pet in the ruins, although he was very shocked and shocked, at least Zhong Xuan at the moment was friendly.
But then, Zhong Xuan’s words stunned Shi Yu and the others.
“Bloodline potential?” Shi Yu said in confusion. Did Eleven have any special bloodlines?
Zhong Xuan glanced at Eleven and said, “Forget it. It’s been so long. It’s normal that you don’t know. Did something happen when it was born?”
“It has the royal bloodline of the Iron-eating Beasts. It’s one in ten thousand and belongs to a special atavism situation. However, if its parents aren’t strong enough, it might cause it to fail in awakening its bloodline at birth. From the looks of it, it should have failed in awakening its bloodline. To be able
to survive under such circumstances, its luck is very good.”
Shi Yu and the others: (° A*| |||)
Shi Yu was a little confused.
Iron-eating beasts and so-called royal clans?
Bloodline awakening failed?
So, what Zhong Xuan meant was that Eleven’s weak body when she was young was the fault of her bloodline awakening failing?
Eleven: Wu wu wu?
In front of a monster like Chong Xuan, it didn’t dare to show its aura as the Panda King.
However, Zhong Xuan’s words made Eleven fall into deep thought.
It was really the Panda King?
“You mean that Eleven is from the royal family of the iron-eating beasts? Moreover, is there a way to awaken its bloodline again?” Shi Yu asked.
Zhong Xuan: “Of course.”
“Compared to ordinary iron-eating beasts, the royal families of iron-eating beasts can automatically awaken deterrence not long after they are born. They no longer need to reach the monarch level to awaken. Deterrence will also become their racial skill.”
“Apart from that, the royal family of the iron-eating beasts are warlike, have strong willpower, astonishing appetite, and very tenacious vitality. They also have special racial talent, which is not what ordinary iron-eating beasts can compare to.”
“How is it? Do you want it to awaken its royal bloodline?”
Shi Yu was instantly excited.
Holy shit.
Deterrence turned into a racial skill?
Although the skill of deterrence could be automatically awakened when a pet reached the monarch level, it was not the racial skill of every pet.
Only the special royals of the pet races had racial skill deterrence. The unified characteristic of them was that they could automatically awaken deterrence at the Awakening level without waiting for the monarch level.
Deterrence was indeed useful. Shi Yu had already maxed out Eleven’s Deterrence. Unfortunately, the skill index could no longer be upgraded, which meant that the current Deterrence was not Eleven’s racial skill at all.
But according to Zhong Xuan, if Eleven became the royal family of the iron-eating beasts, then deterrence might be converted into a racial skill and raised to the level of Dao Proficiency?
“Can I?” Shi Yu realized that this Senior Turtle was surprisingly friendly.
‘As expected of an auspicious beast.
This turn of events was simply auspicious.
“Bullshit, why should I help you?” Zhong Xuan said.
Shi Yu, Eleven:
Shi Yu’s fist, which was holding the Ice Dragon Blade, hardened. How hateful.
He took back what he said just now.. This Chong Xuan had the same nasty personality as the owner of the Dragon Blood Turtle

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - Opportunity for Eleven and Two Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Opportunity for Eleven and Two Evolution
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy looked at Zhong Xuan in silence.
Even now, they still didn’t know why this huge tortoise left them behind.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu asked the question he was most concerned about.
“Senior Chong Xuan, do you know so much about iron-eating beasts because Senior Emperor Wu also contracted an iron-eating beast?”
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, that Iron-eating Beast must have beaten this huge turtle up. Otherwise, it was impossible for Zhong Xuan to have such a huge grudge against the Iron-eating Beast.
Next, Shi Yu originally thought that Zhong Xuan would show a very unhappy expression, but it didn’t expect that Zhong Xuan would make a reversal.
“Yeah, I raised that Iron-eating Beast.”
“Tm its teacher, so I naturally know it very well.”
Zhong Xuan said calmly.
At that time, Emperor Wu was already a legendary expert whose name shook the lands. The human race was the strongest, and they even carried the banner of expelling the totems and rebuilding the Dong Huang Dynasty.
Another hero of the human race appeared. Many people naturally responded in that chaotic world.
One of the responding factions obtained an important position by Emperor Wu because it discovered and cracked the Iron-eating Beast Ruins of the totem era and found the iron-eating beast’s overlord race evolution method.
They led the Iron-eating Beast army to join under Emperor Wu. Then, because Emperor Wu took a fancy to the Iron-eating Beast’s potential, he also chose to nurture one himself.
Initially, all the pets in the Emperor Wu team didn’t care about the new little Iron-eating Beast. But in the end, no one expected that this little Iron-eating Beast would show astonishing potential along the way and obtain the most love from Emperor Wu. It immediately became Emperor Wu’s strongest
pet, making the group of seniors extremely depressed.
Zhong Xuan was actually half a teacher of the Emperor Iron-eating Beast. He often used gravity to train the Iron-eating Beast, but in the end, the difference in strength between the two parties was so huge that it could only be suppressed by the Iron-eating Beast. How could Zhong Xuan not be
depressed?
What made it most depressed was that in the end, not only did it have to train Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, but it was also sent by Emperor Wu to build training ruins for the Iron-eating Beast army to train.
It was a tool turtle.
However, it definitely didn’t want to tell Shi Yu this.
It was enough for Shi Yu to know that it was the teacher of the Emperor’s Iron-eating Beast.
“Then you left me behind… Is there anything I can do?”
2
Shi Yu said carefully.
To hell with the royal bloodline or not. He only wanted to know when he could go out.
Now, he estimated that the people outside, such as Senior White Brook, would definitely explode.
“Why don’t you also be Eleven’s teacher?”
“After it becomes stronger, it will be filial to you.”
Shi Yu thought that he had to cozy up to this beast even if he didn’t go out.
If he could buddy up with Emperor Wu’s pet, he might be able to become the first bureau chief tomorrow.
At the same time, all the secrets of the Emperor Wu Dynasty would disappear.
“Oh???” Zhong Xuan was stunned.
But soon, it snorted.
“Forget about being a teacher, but I do plan to give you some ‘benefits’.”
“Oh, no, I plan to invest in you guys.”
Zhong Xuan opened his huge mouth and grinned. He looked at Shi Yu and the others with ill intentions.
“Benefits, investment??”
Shi Yu was stunned. Like hell he’d believe this guy.
It didn’t even tell him the method to awaken the Iron-eating Beast King bloodline. Would it give him other benefits?
“You guys have been looking for a way to let it carve that kind of inscription outside, right?”
Zhong Xuan lowered its head and looked at Shi Yu and Eleven.
“Lhave to say, your investigation direction is not wrong. However, your luck is a little bad.”
“Wh-what do you mean?”
Shi Yu looked up at Zhong Xuan.
“Good news and bad news.”
“The good news is that this is indeed a training ground built for the Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
“And I built it.”
“You’ve been trying carving inscriptions, but you can’t. It’s mainly because you didn’t eat the corresponding metal minerals!!”1
“Every inscription requires the consumption of the corresponding special metal mineral to allow the Iron-eating Beast to awaken new racial skills and complete the small stage of evolution.”
“Your judgment is right. These nine training facilities indeed have a reward mechanism. It was set up to choose the outstanding soldiers in the Iron-eating Beast Army. Back then, I stored nine special metal ores that could be used to inscribe inscriptions in the nine stone pillars. Moreover, they were all
top-notch evolution metals. As long as the Beast Tamers and Iron-eating Beasts in the Iron-eating Beast Army reach the trial standard I set, they will trigger the reward and obtain the opportunity to evolve and become stronger.”
Shi Yu and Eleven’s eyes lit up.
Buggy and Baby Ginseng were shocked.
Could it be.
Leader’s epic strengthening?
“The bad news is that the reward from the place where you topped the record has long been taken away by a general back then. It’s already empty inside. There’s nothing left. Are you surprised? Are you surprised?”
Zhong Xuan laughed.
“..” Their fists hardened. Shi Yu and Eleven’s fists hardened. If it weren’t for the fact that they couldn’t defeat it, they really wanted to give it a lesson.
“But you don’t have to be too sad.”
Zhong Xuan looked at Shi Yu and Eleven. Although it didn’t say it, it actually felt that Shi Yu and Eleven were quite ridiculous.
For example, although Shi Yu’s physical strength was inferior to Emperor Wu when he was at the same level, Shi Yu was definitely ranked second among the pure-blooded human Beast Tamers it had seen.
There was also that commander rank Iron-eating Beast. Its strength was even stronger than the emperor’s when it was at the commander rank.
This combination really shocked Zhong Xuan, as if it had seen a second Emperor Wu. Unfortunately, Shi Yu didn’t have the Fusion Talent.
However, Shi Yu, who was possessed by the sword spirit, wasn’t bad either. He couldn’t see through this sword spirit at the, but he only felt that the other party’s race level wasn’t inferior to his. From the looks of it, Shi Yu’s future achievements were definitely shocking. Perhaps he could approach
Emperor Wu.
“Although the special ore used to carve inscriptions at the Wei Lin Platform has been taken away, there are actually four other ores left in this ruin.”
“It corresponds to the super racial skills of the four types of metal, wood, metal, lightning, metal, and darkness. Among them, the first three types of metals can only allow it to evolve a little and increase its life level. However, the Golden Dark Ore can allow it to complete the strongest evolution after a
higher growth level and reach the quasi Mythical race level.”
1
“Do you want it?” Its red eyes stared at Shi Yu and the others.
“There’s no need to challenge the facility. I can directly take it out for you.”
Time seemed to have stopped. Shi Yu was silent for a moment before looking up and saying,
“There should be a price.”
Zhong Xuan said, “Of course, I can give you the right to choose. Whether you want it or not is up to you.”
“You saw my injuries, right?”
Shi Yu and the others nodded.
“at that time, we experienced a huge battle.”
“Emperor Wu you’re talking about, which is my Beast Tamer, and his group of battle beasts, all died in that battle. Only I used my racial talent to escape.”
“But even if I successfully escaped, I also suffered an incurable injury.”
Shi Yu’s expression gradually became serious.
So Emperor Wu really died in battle?
He and the few battle beasts had all died in battle, leaving only one Chong Xuan pet alive… 1
“Do you know who our enemy at that time, the enemy who posed the greatest threat to Dong Huang, was?”
It raised its head and asked.
Shi Yu shook his head. That history had been edited too severely. He couldn’t be sure at all.
“Ten thousand years ago, in the totem era, a meteorite fell from the sky and landed on the blue planet. A meteor the size of a city fell on the blue planet and evolved into a life form during the fall. After it evolved into a life form, its talent was terrifying. Soon, it had the strength of a totem level and slept in
the east.”
“ive thousand years ago, it woke up and turned into a Demon God. Its personality was extremely fierce and it began to devour creatures indiscriminately. It mainly relied on humans to evolve. The totem factions attacked one after another. At that time, its strength was outstanding even among the many
totems in the east. However, in the end, it was still jointly killed. But at its level, it was already very difficult to die. In less than three thousand years, it revived with the power of the meteorite again.”
“Two thousand years ago, it woke up again. At this moment, its strength had already reached an extremely exaggerated level. This time, it became even more intelligent. It no longer swallowed creatures indiscriminately and began to try to unify the totem power in the east.”
“I’s not too much to say that this fellow was the king of totems at that time, and its name was ‘Yun An’, known as Meteorite!”
“The injuries on Emperor Wu that even Mythical resources can’t heal, as well as my injuries that can’t be healed no matter what, originate from it. It has already stepped into the Mythical Domain and stands at the top of the totem. It can be said to be a demigod. In addition, its power comes from outer
space, so it’s extremely special. Being injured by it is a permanent injury. It can be said to be the most difficult existence.”
“Yun An? It wasn’t killed by Emperor Wu?”
Shi Yu had indeed heard the name of this totem, but according to historical records, wasn’t this totem that was a threat to the Imperial Court at that time already killed by Emperor Wu?
“At that time, Emperor Wu forced it back, but it couldn’t kill him. Yun An also knew that we weren’t to be trifled with, so he temporarily retreated and planned to use his long lifespan as a metal-element elemental body to kill Emperor Wu.”
“This is indeed a good method, so Emperor Wu chose to fight to the end. He knew that if he didn’t completely kill Yun An, the moment he grew old, the Dong Huang Dynasty he established again would instantly collapse.”
“Unfortunately, it seems that many people don’t understand his intention of successive battles and are only content with enjoying the current peace. Heh heh.” Zhong Xuan revealed a mocking expression, feeling indignant for Emperor Wu.
“After the final battle happened, both of us perished together. However, I know that Yun An’s death was only an illusion. It must have slept in a certain place and waited to be revived, just like five thousand years ago,” Zhong Xuan said affirmatively.
3
Shi Yu suddenly had a bad feeling.
“Senior Chong Xuan, you won’t say that if I accept these four special ores, I have to shoulder the great responsibility of suppressing and killing Yun An again, right…” He revealed a bitter expression.
3
The few legendary Beast Tamers of Dong Huang were all ridiculously strong. For example, the empress had contracted nine totem-level phoenixes. If Emperor Wu wanted to come, it wasn’t much different. He probably had many totem-level pets.
Even so, they were still taken down by Yun An. This fellow sounded very troublesome. His strength probably couldn’t even be compared to a top-notch totem like the Dark Phoenix.
The condition for advancing to a totem was for the transcendent racial skill to reach perfection. This was only an ordinary totem.
As for top-notch totems like the Undying Dark Phoenix, many super racial skills had reached perfection.
As for the demigod mentioned by Zhong Xuan… Shi Yu thought about the difference between transcendent proficiency and proficiency in Dao Proficiency and felt a headache.
He needed 64 instances of adding points to reach transcendent, but 256 to reach Dao Proficiency. The difference during this period was four times. In other words, the difference in strength between totems could be very large.
This Yun An was known as a half-god by Chong Xuan. Perhaps a super skill had reached the maximum level, or perhaps it was close to the maximum level.
“You’re wrong. It’s not that you need to fight Yun An to obtain these ores, but if you use these ores, you will definitely be targeted by Yun An.” Zhong Xuan revealed a strange smile and said.
“Yun An is a life form formed by a meteorite that contains metal matter. It’s a dark and metal-element half-god. The metal ore that the Iron-eating Beast needs to devour in the next stage of its great evolution is its body. Guess, after you use a portion of its body to complete the evolution, what will the
outcome be if it revives again?”
“You have to know that the Iron-eating Beast of Emperor Wu became incomparably powerful because it swallowed a large amount of the fragments of Yun An’s body. If you repeat the path of Emperor Wu, do you think Yun An will let himself be treated as food and the life of his enemy?”
“So, what I mean is that if you have the awareness of being targeted by a demigod standing at the top of the totems, then it’s fine for me to directly give you these metal ores.”
“If you have the ability in the future, you can help us take revenge. If you don’t have the ability and are eventually killed by Yun An, don’t blame me. After all, it’s your choice.”
As soon as Zhong Xuan finished speaking, the scene fell silent.
Eleven grabbed Shi Yu’s clothes tightly and was a little stunned.
Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng were all shocked.
Holy shit, the second stage evolution ingredient of the Iron-eating Beast, a special metal, was a part of Yun An’s body?
Damn, the dark totem that related the evolution of Eleven that the owl predicted was related to… Could it be Yun An?! In that case, Yun An really wasn’t dead??

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - Eleven, who had evolved into a high-level overlord
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Eleven, who had evolved into a high-level overlord
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Hmph, hmph.
The old turtle, Zhong Xuan, looked at Shi Yu and the others silently, waiting for their choice.
In its opinion, Shi Yu’s talent wasn’t bad. In the future, he might be a threat to Yun An.
Even if it couldn’t pose a threat, it was good to disgust Yun An.
In short, as long as Shi Yu wanted to nurture the Iron-eating Beast, he would definitely fight Yun An in the future.
And it was an enemy with Yun An. The enemy of the enemy was its friend. This was the reason why it wanted to invest in Shi Yu.
The path of evolution was placed in front of Shi Yu and the others. He wondered if Shi Yu and the others had the guts to walk it.
“Just now, didn’t Senior Chong Xuan say that Yun An was as big as a huge city?”
Shi Yu and the others stood together and carefully started the team meeting.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Little Chi Tong, who had possessed Shi Yu, nodded.
“No wonder Senior Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast Army can evolve into a second stage. As long as a piece of Yun An’s skin is removed, it can probably support many Nine Li Battle Beasts carving inscriptions…”
“In addition, it’s an elemental life form and a demigod. It’s probably not very difficult to regenerate. It’s a renewable resource.”
“In other words, the stable evolution channel of the overlord race… has been found?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“If the country knows, will it organize a mechanical army to attack the totem area?”
“Capture Yun An and raise him.”
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and Chi Tong were all very serious. It wasn’t impossible.
Although the current Dong Huang and the totem area were peaceful and were only going through small-scale conflicts, that was because there were no benefits to be found through war.
If there were huge benefits, it was possible for the totem area to start a war with Dong Huang or Dong Huang to start a war with a certain totem.
The Dong Huang Ancient Country was actually alright. In recent years, it had been at a stable development stage. It maintained the attitude that if the enemy didn’t attack it, it wouldn’t attack the enemy.
But some countries actually often had conflicts with the totem area.
For example, Shen Feng that had been established for the shortest time and only had 200 years in history. It was the first to develop a Mechanic class and become a country with technology.
Because they lacked native resources, even until now, it often fought with the totem area and plundered resources everywhere. It was in the war stage all year round. However, it wasn’t an all-out war, so it couldn’t affect the situation of the world.
If Dong Huang understood the threat of Yun An and the benefits it could bring by killing Yun An, then even if Shi Yu didn’t care about it, Dong Huang would probably miss it.
1
Although Shi Yu didn’t have any confidence in facing Yun An in the short term with his strength, he was still quite confident in Dong Huang.
The advantage of Mechanics in war was too great.
The last totem war, because of the birth of the Mechanic class, was the easiest battle for humans to win in thousands of years.
With the advantage of the number one country in the Mechanic class, even the Shen Feng Nation dared to chase after the totems now.
In this situation, Shi Yu felt that he could give it a try. So what if he provoked a demigod in order to evolve? As long as there were benefits, he believed that Dong Huang could become his greatest nanny and protect him well.
He chose to continue living off of nannies.
Moreover, whether Yun An revived or not was still another matter.
If it still needed a hundred thousand years to revive, it would probably still be in a weakened state. It wasn’t as strong as he imagined, so he had plenty of time to develop.
“Senior Chong Xuan, we’ve decided.”
“Evolution metal, amazing! Totem half-god, useless!”
“By the way, do you know where Yun An might be revived and resting?”
After Shi Yu and the others discussed carefully, they looked at Chong Xuan.
Perhaps after the mechanical army pressed over, he wouldn’t even have to ask Yun An for the evolution materials later himself. The Dong Huang army would directly pack them up and bring them back.
Zhong Xuan: “?
It was decided so easily and happily??
Shouldn’t he consider it carefully when facing a monster like a half-god totem?
“Have you really decided??”
Zhong Xuan looked at Shi Yu and the others.
“Te decided.”
“Alright.” Zhong Xuan snorted and laughed. Forget it, it was useless to keep the four metal resources in the ruins anyway. It couldn’t bring it along with it even if it died. It was a pretty good way to deal with it now that it could be given to Shi Yu.
Unfortunately, it probably couldn’t see the day Shi Yu and Yun An faced each other in the future.
“You guys wait!!”
It roared, and even space vibrated.
The next moment, boom, boom. In the ruins, the stone pillars of one of the four training facilities cracked.
Then, four fist-sized special metal ores flew out.
White light covered these metal ores. As Zhong Xuan controlled these metal ores to come to this space with his identity as the master of the ruins, four metal pieces of different colors instantly fell in front of Shi Yu!
There was a piece that was completely blue. The lightning was violent, and the metallic luster and lightning intertwined.
A dark green stone was filled with life.
It was pure white and transparent, with a faint white halo.
The last piece was a black prismatic metal that gradually turned white. It looked like the most ordinary of the few, but on careful observation, it contained strong dark magic power.
“For you.” After Zhong Xuan took out four metal ores, he said,
“But I’ll say this in advance, because these four pieces are the best among the corresponding metals. The Heavenly Thunder Stone, Life Gold, and Divine Space Iron are still alright, but with your Iron-eating Beast’s aptitude, you can definitely digest them.”
“However, it’s best to wait for this meteorite fragment to grow to the monarch level. No, it’s best if it’s at the overlord level before devouring and evolving. The first three metals only let it complete a small evolution. Although it will increase its race level and awaken new super racial skills, it won’t let it
obtain new attributes, and its own form won’t change.”
“However, the Meteorite Fragment will change it greatly. At that time, it will evolve into a new race. It will obtain dark attributes and transform into a devil god. The requirement for its own strength is very high. Otherwise, it’s very likely to lose its mind due to the corrosion of the dark power.”
Zhong Xuan saw Shi Yu looking at him and asked, “Is there anything you want to ask?”
“No…”
1
“Well, can it try to evolve now?”
Shi Yu said in anticipation.
Speaking of which, he finally knew what materials the Iron-eating Beast needed to carve the inscription.
It wasn’t easy!
Heavenly Thunder Stone, Life Gold Jade, Divine Space Iron, these metal ores were recorded in his index. They were all rare level-eight materials.
Moreover, it was one of the rarer ones. It belonged to the type that might not necessarily be found even if one knew the name. It was even rarer than the Fruit of Life that the ginseng baby ate.
No wonder he made Eleven eat so many different metals and tried to carve inscriptions but failed. It was because he was poor that he didn’t experiment on top-notch metals.
“Sure.” Zhong Xuan clicked his tongue and said, “Eat those three first and carve the corresponding inscription. I reckon that at that time, its race should be able to be called a high-level overlord race.”
“T’ll tell you what the other five pieces of metal are. At that time, if you can find the corresponding metal, your Iron-eating Beast’s strength will be passable.”
At the side, Buggy and Baby Ginseng couldn’t listen anymore.
Damn.
If one inscription corresponded to a super skill, then at that time, it would be nine super skills. In addition to the original one, it would be ten super racial skills!!
Wasn’t this invincible?
Buggy and Baby Ginseng were stunned.
However, Shi Yu and the others paused. “It… makes sense??”
“Ten super racial skills…”
Zhong Xuan curled its lips and said, “What’s the use of skills? Even if there are 100 super racial skills, they’re still only quasi Mythical races. Without divine skills, they’re still ants.”
“Back then, it also had ten super racial skills that were ridiculously strong, but in the end, even if we added all of us together, we could only fight evenly with Yun An.”
“Little brat, let me remind you. Remember this well. When you train all your super racial skills to perfection, don’t practice all of them anymore. Just specialize in developing the most convenient super racial skill.”
“When a transcendent racial skill reaches a certain proficiency, it can advance to the totem level.”
“And to develop a certain transcendent racial skill to the extreme and combine it with your own race to develop your own divine skill… This is the key to breaking through all restrictions and becoming a Mythical! Don’t be greedy. Essence is the foundation.”
1
“It’s because Yun An has mastered the prototype of a divine skill and developed an ability to the extreme that he can suppress us. If he wants to pursue a higher domain, it’s enough to find a direction. Every super skill is the prototype of a divine skill. Even those real Mythical creatures only have one divine
skill. Quality over quantity, remember this!”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he heard Zhong Xuan’s guidance.
This was the first time he had heard of the need to advance to the Mythical stage.
Developing super racial skills to the extreme and combining them with their own race to develop their own divine skills was the requirement to advance to the Mythical stage??
oye
As expected!
For experts like Emperor Wu, skills with transcendent proficiency were not the end point at all. In fact, what they pursued were transcendent racial skills with Dao Proficiency!
“Have you understood?” Zhong Xuan asked.
“Yes, yes, I have.”
“Then eat it quickly,” Zhong Xuan said calmly. The last time it helped the iron-eating beast evolve was a long time ago. What nostalgia.
“Huh?” At this moment, Eleven was stunned. It suddenly realized that this seemed to be its opportunity.
Its eyes immediately lit up.
Seeing this, Buggy and Baby Ginseng directly tensed up in envy.
Buggy suddenly felt a sense of crisis.
‘Wait a minute, did Big Boss Chong Xuan say that the leader could reach a high-level overlord race after eating these?!
Baby Ginseng cried. It thought that it would be the next one to evolve in the team. It was clearly supposed to be
Eleven ran to a metal ore excitedly.
It had long turned from a child who didn’t know how to evolve into an evolution obsessed freak.
“Wu?” It asked Zhong Xuan and Shi Yu if it could eat it.
“Let’s give it a try.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Wuu!!!”
With that said, Eleven roared and directly entered the sharp state, evolving into the form of the Nine Li Battle Beast.
At the same time, when he saw the silver-white Nine Li Battle Beast, Zhong Xuan narrowed his eyes.
It said, “This is the best proof that it’s an Iron-eating Beast King. Although its bloodline didn’t awaken successfully, the characteristics of the royal family are very obvious.”
“After the Iron-eating Beast King’s racial skill hardening is developed to the extreme, if you also master other attributes with extremely high proficiency at the same time, and if the hardening substance in your body has the corresponding attributes… you can obtain a second attribute during evolution.”
“You guys are pretty lucky.”
Shi Yu was stunned. This was the first time he had received an official explanation why Eleven had lightning after evolution. It was different from other Nine Li Battle Beasts.
Eleven was even more confident. As expected of the Panda King!
“alright, quickly evolve,” Zhong Xuan said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and looked at Eleven.
“Wuu!!” In the next moment, Eleven swallowed the Heavenly Thunder Stone in one go.
Boom!!!
Then, lightning wreaked havoc on Eleven’s silver-white armor, and shocking lightning shot out of its eyes.
Under its guidance, Eleven quickly carved the corresponding inscription.
Screech.
Eleven hardened the sharp claws of its right hand and started to slowly scratch its body.
Then, under the nervous gazes of Shi Yu, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, white light began to linger on Eleven’s body!
At this moment, Eleven was very excited because this time, the rejection reaction did not appear!
“Wuu!!”
Eleven roared and its body was completely wrapped in white light. At the same time, the index in front of Shi Yu quickly displayed Eleven’s growth changes.
(Energy Points]: 133156
“Holy shit.” Shi Yu cursed in his heart. It increased by more than 20,000 all of a sudden?
‘What shocked Shi Yu even more was that as the white light dissipated, Eleven’s full appearance appeared in front of them.
Just as Zhong Xuan had said, Eleven’s form didn’t change at all. Even the traces of the previous inscription had disappeared. However, Beetle, Baby Ginseng, and Shi Yu could clearly feel that it was stronger.
At this moment, terrifying lightning lingered on Eleven’s body. As it slowly raised its arm, its expression was slightly stunned.
Sensing his newly awakened racial skill, Eleven was suddenly shocked and delighted.
At the same time, Shi Yu also instantly learned the information of this new skill through the mental connection between the Beast Tamer and his pet!
Skill: Lightning Rod
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It can transform oneself and external objects into the Lightning-Attracting Needle. When you transform yourself into a Lightning-Attracting Needle through hardening substances, you can obtain the lightning resistance and cause the heavenly lightning in the natural world to attack all
substances around you. By touching and giving hardening substances to transform the enemy into the Lightning-Attracting Needle, you can let the enemy be attacked by the heavenly lightning in the natural world.
At this moment, sensing this skill, Shi Yu directly took a deep breath.
Although the name was a little low and didn’t look impressive, the effect was so strong. It was completely the super upper level of a high-level skill Thunder. It was a skill that could perfectly mobilize the natural power of lightning!
What did this skill mean when combined with Eleven’s storage lightning and Inner Power?
It was a walking divine lightning attraction. No one could get close to it. It could fight in the thunderstorm and become stronger and stronger!!
Apart from that, it could actually transform the enemy into a lightning rod by giving hardening substances… The enemy didn’t have lightning resistance. In other words, if anyone was touched by Eleven in battle, the lightning in nature would continuously attack them. It was never-ending, directly
turning the enemy into a lightning-eating physique.
Also, through this skill, it could completely create a holy land for thunderstorm cultivation. Or, if this skill was enchanted into equipment, it would be a thunder-element divine weapon!
No matter how Shi Yu analyzed it, he realized that this skill was extremely strong.
Obviously, Eleven also thought so. It couldn’t help but cry out in excitement.
“Wuuu!!” It didn’t have to go to the charging room of Ancient Capital University in the future. The charging there was slow. In the future, it could just summon lightning in school and attack itself!
“yi?” “Wu?” Seeing Eleven and Shi Yu so excited, Buggy and Baby Ginseng swallowed their saliva. What happened?!
“Continue.” Zhong Xuan was the calmest. There were still two more.
Upon hearing that, Eleven continued to eat the Divine Space Iron.
The same procedures, the same steps.
Eleven completed a small stage of evolution again.
If one were to say that the attack just now had completely raised its race level to low-level overlord.
Now, its race level had leaped to middle-level overlord.
Energy Points: 154325
Moreover, its energy level became the first in the team overnight, surpassing Little Chi Tong and Buggy!
At the same time, new racial skills were accompanying it.
Skill: Space Quake
[Attributes]: Metal, Space
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It can temporarily give the spatial attribute of metal-element matter. The metal-element substance that is given the spatial attribute has a vibration nature.
