It can cause spatial vibration. With the power of vibration, it can shatter the ground, make the atmosphere tremble, make the sea
crack, make the sky sway, and cause huge tsunamis, huge earthquakes, and even spatial cracks to attack the enemy in another space.3
After awakening this skill, Eleven was overjoyed.
Not only was it a counter to Buggy, but it was also a move that could be used to create weapons!
Shi Yu instantly shared his ability with Buggy.
2
Buggy:
This was a move that could counter the etherealization ability of the invincible Concealment of a legendary Beast Tamer.
Buggy originally relied on Concealment to be invincible in the battle with Eleven, but now, its expression suddenly collapsed and revealed a desperate expression.
Nol!!!
“Wuuu!!”
At this moment, Panda King Eleven was extremely excited.
However, this wasn’t the end.
The final Golden Jade of Life.
This was a metal that could allow Eleven to awaken super racial skills with both metal and wood attributes!!
It was the same step again. Eleven completed the evolution without changing its form.
Moreover, the newly awakened skill stunned Eleven and Shi Yu.
Initially, Shi Yu thought that it would be another move that could create weapons and equipment, but.
Skill: Soldier Bean
[Attributes]: Metal, Wood
[Level]: Super level
{ntroduction]: Spread the golden beans and form an immortal army. The inheritance of the army’s individual abilities will increase with the increase in skill proficiency!
Shi Yu was stunned for a moment. He instantly imagined the scene of a group of little iron-eating beasts fighting and using impregnable together.
Holy shit, clone skill??
Moreover, it was a clone skill named after the army.
Shi Yu had been searching for the metal-eating Iron-eating Beast’s skill that was more compatible with the metal element than the spiritual-type clone. Unfortunately, he had never found it. He didn’t expect that the clone skill would be awakened by Eleven in the form of a racial skill.
At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly felt that he had no regrets.
?< Name > Nine Li Battle Beast (Three Inscriptions)
{Race Level]: Metal, Thunder
[Race Level]: High-level overlord
{Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Race Skill]:
Low-level: Hardening (Dao Proficiency), Electric Magnetic Floating (Dao Proficiency)
Intermediate: Giant Transformation (Dao Proficiency), Energy Storage Lightning (transcendent)
Advanced: Impregnable (Perfect)

[Professor Skill]:
Intermediate: High Speed Healing (Perfect), Super Sight (Perfect), Thunder Palm (transcendent)
Advanced: Absolute Sleep (Perfect), Multiplication (Shrinking: Perfect; Giant Transformation: Dao Proficiency), Deterrence (transcendent)
Energy Points: 175001
Inan instant, Eleven’s strength reached an unimaginable level.
At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu and Eleven’s shocked expressions, Zhong Xuan laughed out loud.
“How is it? Very strong, right?”
“Tl also tell you the awakening method of the Iron-eating Beast King bloodline later. In my opinion, that racial talent isn’t inferior to ordinary super skills.”
“Wuuu!!!” Eleven’s eyes lit up. It realized that it had become like Shi Yu and wanted to rely on a stronger power.
It felt good!
“The racial talent is…?” Shi Yu asked.
Individual pets all had their own special abilities. It wasn’t a skill, but the nature of their bodies. For example, the racial talent of birds was flight.
Fish could survive underwater.
Baby Ginseng was also a supplement.
These talents might be useful or they might not be.
“Actually, it’s nothing. It’s just that it can allow the Iron-eating Beast to increase its physique more efficiently after recovering from its near-death state. In short, it can increase the benefits of life and death battles and life and death training.”
3
‘As soon as he finished speaking, Eleven’s gaze gradually became sharp. Buggy and Baby Ginseng were shocked.
At the same time, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The Iron-eating Beast was too strong. He should strengthen Baby Ginseng… Damn, something was wrong. If they do that, the Iron-eating Beast would be even stronger…

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - Locked in the Black Room
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Locked in the Black Room
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Coach, I want to learn this!!!”
Every time it recovered from near death, it could increase his physique more efficiently?
Wasn’t this made for Eleven!
It really dared to risk its life in daily training!
At this moment, Shi Yu really began to believe that Eleven had the Panda King bloodline.
Normal Iron-eating Beasts had this will?
Perhaps Eleven couldn’t be so ferocious. Apart from its experience, the weak Panda King bloodline had also affected it.
It was indeed not unreasonable for it to be able to gain something from the Evolution Holy Spring.
“Coach? Forget it, I’ll think about it.”
Zhong Xuan muttered. Why did it awaken its royal bloodline?
This awakening method was developed by the tribe that led the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
Although it had also understood it, it really couldn’t remember it clearly. It had to try remembering.
“Let me think…”
Five minutes passed.
Zhong Xuan was still thinking.
‘Asa result, the Panda King Eleven couldn’t help but experiment.
Amoment later, ten silly little Iron-eating Beasts were created. At the same time, Eleven looked weak.
“Wuu!” “Wuu!” “Wuu!”
The ten little Iron-eating Beasts looked at Eleven and chirped in the sky. Eleven was silent.
“Wuul”” It glared at the Little Iron-eating Beast Corps.
Why did it feel that this skill wasn’t that strong?
Every little Iron-eating Beast was in the form of an ordinary Iron-eating Beast.
Moreover, it had only inherited Eleven’s racial skills below super level.
For example, Hardening, Giant Transformation, Electric Magnetic Floating, Energy Storage Lightning, Impregnable
High-speed healing, super vision, and thunder palm were all not inherited.
Moreover, the proficiency of the racial skills he inherited was only at the expert level.
The only thing that comforted Eleven was that the energy value of each little Iron-eating Beast was ridiculously high, reaching more than 40,000.
Each one was comparable to a monarch race or commander rank ferocious beast.
Ten together was equivalent to a monarch species commander rank battle beast team.
However, condensing them directly consumed Eleven’s physical fitness.
Eleven’s hundreds of thousands of energy points were instantly emptied.
Although the total value of these ten little Iron-eating Beasts had always reached more than 400,000, more than Eleven, it was very useless.
1
Eleven felt that if they attacked together, they might not necessarily have more battle power than him fighting personally.
With this energy consumption, wouldn’t its 100-meter Thunder Palm be much more god-killing?
Then, Eleven began to extract the energy in the source of its physical strength and gradually recovered from its weakened state. It became energetic again.
“Wu wu wu.”
Eleven looked at Shi Yu. What a super skill. It felt that it wasn’t as powerful as other super skills.
“How is it useless? It’s strong enough to explode, alright?” Shi Yu said after a moment of silence.
This was the entry-level bean army.
This might be Eleven’s strongest super skill.
Since it was said to be an army, when the skill proficiency was high in the future, it would definitely be able to condense more, such as a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand.
Moreover, the ability inheritance would increase with the proficiency of condensing beans into soldiers.
If one day, they could unlock the inheritance of the Nine Li form and the super racial skill, every soldier individual would have the accompanying move of storage lightning, Inner Power, and Lightning Rod. This was an invincible Thunderstorm Army.
‘Their own energy points could be ignored. They just had to rely on the power of the heavenly lightning!
‘With the endless lightning energy and the giant transformation, it was simply a monster army.
Moreover, if they could inherit higher skill proficiency in the future, the strength of each army individual was even more terrifying.
It was even to the extent that if one day, the bean army could unlock the teaching skills outside their race, that would be even more invincible.
Shi Yu could replicate a bunch of similar impregnable army resonance skills for Eleven to learn.
At that time, low-level skills could also display the effect of super-level skills!
One man became an army!!
Perhaps from the looks of it, this move was useless for Eleven and couldn’t be helpful in battle. However, after its proficiency increased and it unlocked a higher inheritance, it would be so good to directly have an army pressing down on the enemy.
Although Eleven didn’t react, Shi Yu instantly understood the strategic value of bean soldiers. No wonder Emperor Wu wanted to nurture the Iron-eating Beast Corps. This was simply promising in the future.
“Wuu?”
Eleven pondered. Really?
“Fortunately, my memory is good. I remembered it!”
At this moment, Zhong Xuan suddenly said.
It sighed. “By the way, you should know the method to quickly increase the hardening level, right?”
He thought for five minutes before realizing… It couldn’t be said that his memory was good
Shi Yu and the others looked at Chong Xuan.
“It’s relying on high-level hardening to nurture low-level hardening, right?”
“That’s right!”
Zhong Xuan nodded and said, “This is actually the easiest place for the iron-eating beast army to take shape.”
“Actually, the method to awaken a royal bloodline is similar. It also depends on nurturing.”
“Huh??”
Shi Yu was stunned. “Iron-eating beasts that rely on other royal bloodlines??”
“No, it’s to nurture and nourish the Iron-eating Beast’s bloodline through Beast Tamers. However, the method is relatively special, and specific nourishing skills are needed.”
“Then… Then can I learn it?” Shi Yu suddenly had a bad feeling.
“You? You definitely can’t. Only Beast Tamers with the metal-element strengthening talent can nourish the Iron-eating Beast’s bloodline through their talent. It’s considered a special cultivation technique that belongs to metal-element Beast Tamers against metal-element creatures. Heh, it was
developed by the first general under Emperor Wu at that time.”
Shi Yu’s expression immediately collapsed. Holy shit, heartless.
It meant that it was a special meditation technique similar to the one created by Emperor Shi, a special use of the Beast Taming Talent?
“Then can I look for other metal-element Beast Tamers to help?” Shi Yu asked again.
“This can be done. At that time, in the iron-eating beast army, there were specialized metal-element Feeders in charge of nurturing the iron-eating beasts,” Zhong Xuan said.
“However, this is a slow job. Although the level requirement for Beast Tamers isn’t high, the time cost is very high.”
Upon hearing Zhong Xuan’s words, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.
That was good. He was really afraid that it had to be the beast tamer himself. If he could find someone to help, he could directly find Senior Panda. Their family had metal-element talent.
It just so happened that Eleven still needed to help Senior Panda’s Iron-eating Beast increase its hardening level. It was completely fine to squeeze Senior Panda dry. After all, Eleven was raised by Senior Panda since young.1
Suddenly, Shi Yu felt that something was wrong.
‘The number one general under Emperor Wu should be the expert of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe, or the Beast Tamer who had contracted the Iron-eating Beast.
From the looks of it, the information on this titled legendary warrior was not passed down either.
Could it be that the iron-eating beasts were too strong at that time? After Emperor Wu Dynasty was destroyed, the totems almost wiped out the iron-eating beasts?
In order to prevent the appearance of a powerful Iron-eating Beast, they directly combined powers with the traitor of the human race and rewrote the history of that time, deleting a large amount of information about the Iron-eating Beast.
This also explained why there weren’t many iron-eating beasts in the modem era, and the racial heritage was almost severed.
“Speaking of which, my Iron-eating Beast has a royal bloodline. Does this mean that its ancestor has a very powerful Iron-eating Beast?” Shi Yu suddenly asked.
1
Zhong Xuan nodded.
“Not bad.”
“So, how did you guys meet?”
Eleven scratched its head and looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu said, “I bought it with a loan from the Feeding Base… I’m wondering if the owner of that Feeding Base is the descendant of the Feeders who specialize in nurturing iron-eating beasts for Emperor Wu…”
Senior Panda’s family seemed to have started to nurture iron-eating beasts since their ancestors. The ancestor’s teaching was to definitely pass down the iron-eating beasts. Only then did Senior Panda’s family’s obsession with iron-eating beasts become stronger.
If the Iron-eating Beast race really suffered a fatal blow after the destruction of Emperor Wu Dynasty, then a small group of people might completely bring part of the Iron-eating Beast bloodline to live in seclusion and pass down their ancestral teachings.
After a long development and the changes of several dynasties, it was not impossible to become the current Lin family of Ping Cheng.
Zhong Xuan fell into deep thought. Shi Yu’s words seemed to have triggered some of its memories, recalling the scene of it nurturing the Iron-eating Beast Corps with a group of feeders.
It sighed. Those people had definitely passed away, but their descendants might have really survived.
“It’s not impossible. If I could see them, I might be able to sense if they were the descendants of that group of acquaintances.” Zhong Xuan shook his head.
“Sure, T’l bring Senior Chong Xuan to take a look when I’m free!” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up and he started playing the emotional card.
If Senior Panda and her family were really the descendants of this friend of Zhong Xuan’s, wouldn’t their relationship be even more perfect?
After bringing Big Boss Zhong Xuan to Ping Cheng, with its rich experience in nurturing Iron-eating Beasts, the Iron-eating Beast Cultivation Base would take off directly.
At that time, the Iron-eating Beast Feeding Base in Ping Cheng would nurture Iron-eating Beasts, the Battle Emperor Ruins would train Iron-eating Beasts, and in addition, the evolution channel of the overlord race would be discovered. This wave was to recreate the strongest army in history.
Although there was not much information passed down from Emperor Wu, Emperor Wu’s army was the strongest apart from the modern mechanical army. This was recognized by archeologists.
“Not interested.”
Zhong Xuan snorted. Most importantly, it couldn’t go out in its current state. It said, “Alright, I’m starting to talk about the method to nurture the iron-eating beast bloodline. This method is also useful for other metal-element pets. It can purify their bloodlines. Remember this well.”
“Yes!!”
Shi Yu hurriedly dealt with the business.
Half an hour later, after cursing and lecturing, Zhong Xuan finally taught Shi Yu, that idiot, to understand.
Apart from that, he also told Shi Yu the information about the other five rare metals. These were all very rare level-eight resources.
Shi Yu leamed so slowly purely because Shi Yu didn’t have any metal-element talent. He couldn’t practice while learning. He could only remember the details of all the theories in the index. Only then could he teach it to Senior Panda.
After everything was completed, Shi Yu put away the fragments of Yun An.
Shi Yu planned to wait until Eleven reached the overlord level before devouring this evolution. Since even Zhong Xuan said that there was a risk for Eleven to devour this at the moment, he would do it steadily. Or, he would let Eleven learn a dual-element ordinary skill of the metal and dark elements in
advance to lay the foundation.
Wasn’t this what the skill index was for?
“yi.” Zhong Xuan finished speaking tiredly. Baby Ginseng helped. It had been condensing nutritional fruits with earth-element energy and rich life energy at the side. When Zhong Xuan glanced over, it saw Baby Ginseng handing it over with eyes filled with stars.
It meant to give it to Senior.
“yi! (This, delicious, it can also heal injuries!)”
“on”
Chong Xuan looked at the ginseng baby. Compared to the Butterfly of Imagination, Chi Tong, and Eleven, this ginseng baby previously didn’t have much of a presence in its eyes, but now, it realized that the ginseng baby was still pretty obedient.
“Then let’s try it.”
Zhong Xuan had indeed not eaten for a long time. It opened its mouth slightly, and the pile of nutrients that Baby Ginseng had desperately condensed was directly sucked up by the gravity in its mouth.
This was the super skill Gravity Control above transcendent proficiency. It could control the strength and direction of gravity at will, including gravity, horizontal gravity, gravity-free, anti-gravity, pressure, pull, repulsive force, gravity
Back then, Zhong Xuan relied on this move to pull down many meteors from the sky for the Iron-eating Beast Army.
Click.
Compared to the volume of Zhong Xuan, the nutritional fruit of the ginseng baby was too small, and the nutritional content it contained was too little. After Zhong Xuan finished eating, it shook its head in disinterest and recalled the nutritional supplements of a certain teammate. That was the delicious
one.
“The quality is not bad, but your strength is too weak, and the level of the food is not enough. It needs to be improved, right?” After Zhong Xuan smacked his lips, he said indifferently, “But for your strength, it’s already not bad. I can tell that you will definitely be amazing in the future.”
As soon as it finished speaking, Baby Ginseng’s expression froze instantly, and it revealed a crying expression.
wyill!”
It looked at Zhong Xuan’s indifferent expression and its unresponsive injuries and couldn’t help but feel defeated.
“Senior Chong Xuan.
Seeing that Baby Ginseng had failed, Shi Yu went on stage again and tried his turn. Shi Yu looked at Zhong Xuan’s injuries and said, “Is Yun An’s injuries really incurable? Why don’t you come with me to take a look later? There are many medical methods now.
Zhong Xuan yawned and said, “It’s too late, or else why do you think Yun An can fight us evenly? It’s because of this incurable injury. At that time, it was only a light injury. We couldn’t even treat it with transcendent-level healing skills that had reached transcendent. We couldn’t even treat it with divine
medicine. Now, my injuries are already beyond cure. My injuries have already worsened to every corner of my body, and my life has been corroded. Even if Ican treat it, my lifespan has already been corroded to the last point. The meaning of treatment is not big anymore.”
“In short, I don’t have many days left to live.”
“Just remember this is the most troublesome ability of Yun An. Don’t worry about me. I’ve already lived enough. Back then, they shouldn’t have sent me out in the end. It would be so much easier for everyone to die together. Damn it, if there’s a world of the dead, I’ll definitely scold them.”
Shi Yu, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others instantly fell silent.
Chong Xuan was about to die?!
“Senior Chong Xuan…”
‘Whether they liked it or not… This big turtle had given them so many things after all. Although its personality was a little harsh, Shi Yu and the others really didn’t want to see Chong Xuan die like this.
“Is what you said… true?”
“Why would I lie to you”
“The premise is to stay obediently without making any big moves. If there’s a battle, I might immediately die,” Zhong Xuan said unhappily.
“Ican’t be bothered to talk to you anymore. I’ve already explained everything. If you didn’t wake me up, I might have been able to live in a deep sleep for decades. In short, I’m going to sleep now. Don’t disturb me anymore. If you wake me up again, I really should die.”
“Wait…” Shi Yu still had too much to ask, but after hearing what Zhong Xuan said, he was really embarrassed to disturb it.
“Is there really no other way to extend your life?”
“Don’t panic, woman. Who said I would definitely die?” Zhong Xuan said.
1
Shi Yu and the others:
Holy shit, you said it yourself.
“The continuation of the bloodline means that I’m immortal. Next, I’ll use my racial talent to reincarnate. A few hundred years later, I might have obtained a new life in the form of an egg. This is the only method that I’ve found to resist the injuries of Yun An after researching for thousands of years in the
dream.”
“Twonder if I can awaken the memories of this life. I wonder if it’s considered giving birth or if it’s just rebirth. This is the most difficult thing.”
Zhong Xuan fell into deep thought. But no matter what, it was better than having its bloodline severed.
“Forget it. In short, when my next life is born, you’ll probably be buried already. How miserable. This is the only disadvantage for you humans. Your lives are short.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets looked at Shi Yu eagerly. It could still reincarnate
The higher the species level, the harder it was to reproduce. Was the way to reproduce for Zhong Xuan simply rebuilding itself?
“Then…”
“What else is it? Yun An’s location? How would I know!”
“No,” Shi Yu said.
“In that case, leave quickly. Oh, wait, you still can’t leave.”
Shi Yu:
“Wh-what do you mean?”
“Because I’m the owner of this ruins space. Under the influence of my state, this ruin is very unstable now. Even if there’s a way to treat me outside, I won’t go out now. The problem now is that my condition is getting worse and worse. You don’t seem to be able to go out either. The ruins space has lost its
connection to the outside world.”
“ah???” Shi Yu and the others were stunned.
Damn, damn, damn, stop scaring him!
“Don’t panic. After I die, the space of the ruins should stabilize. At that time, you can enter and leave through the old method. Well… you can use this ruin as you wish. Those damaged facilities will recover by themselves over time. Don’t worry about that. I’m not sure how long it will take. In short, I think
you humans still have a lot of storage places in the ruins. It’s enough for you to eat.”
Zhong Xuan said indifferently, but it made Shi Yu and the others have a bitter expression.
The ruins of Emperor Wu had been developed by humans before. It was indeed correct to have a large resource warehouse to store food resources. Even if there weren’t any here, Shi Yu had his own ruins space. However, when he thought about how long he would be locked here for, his stomach hurt.
“There’s no way to contact the outside world…”
“Of course not. Let’s wait. Don’t worry, it won’t be long.”
“There’s nothing else this time, right?” Shi Yu could tell that Zhong Xuan’s tone was starting to get impatient.
Just as Shi Yu was about to make his final request and shake hands before leaving, Shi Yu and the others flashed with white light and were teleported back to the martial arts conference venue of the ruins of Emperor Wu.
At this moment, standing in the deserted ruins of Emperor Wu, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng looked at everything in confusion.
They were the only ones who couldn’t leave the empty ruins. No one else could enter either.
The only person who could chat was Zhong Xuan. He had already fallen asleep in the deep exclusive space of the ruins and was not far from death. It started to try to restore itself by using its next life. This… What was going on?
“Baby Ginseng, you’re so annoying. You actually can’t treat Senior Zhong Xuan.”
Baby Ginseng:
An injury that even a level-ten resource divine medicine couldn’t treat, wasn’t this making things difficult for it?
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng quickly discovered the blind spot. From the looks of it, Yun An was so scary. Was Eleven really going to fight it?
Shi Yu was silent. Whether that day came or not, he had to think of a way to develop the strongest healing ability on Baby Ginseng.
Otherwise, if he encountered similar enemies in the future, he would be the one suffering.
“Sob.” Eleven pondered for a moment and expressed that it was not a big problem.
It suddenly felt that Bean Bears were not bad either.
‘As long as it let the bean bears fight, there was no problem of him being injured.
At that time, it would be fine to let Buggy’s phantom assist and hide its main body.
“Sob.” Eleven seemed to have seen the light. It could fight this final boss, but not using its own body!
“Stop thinking so far ahead. What we should consider now is… how long we have to stay here before we can go out.” Shi Yu’s face darkened.
Help!
There was no internet here!

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - Shi Yu, who had stepped into the Master Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Shi Yu, who had stepped into the Master Domain
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed since the mutation of Emperor Wu Ruins.
In three days, there was still no connection between the outside world and the ruins of Emperor Wu.
In this situation, the martial arts conference was definitely unable to be successfully held.
“What a sin.”
“Tm so silly, really.”
Principal Feng’s head was about to explode. He had the same problem as White Brook.
At the side, Legend Bai smiled bitterly.
Son of a b*tch!
When archeologists stepped into this industry, they should have been mentally prepared.
Exploring the ruins was the most dangerous thing. Anything could happen.
“Don’t worry, since that totem teleported us out, it means that it shouldn’t have any ill intentions. Now, we just have to wait. Apart from that, there’s no other especially good method.”
“Sigh.” Principal Feng nodded.
In order to not cause too much panic, the news of the Battle Emperor Ruins had to be sealed.
At that time, there were many Beast Tamers in the ruins of Emperor Wu. Many people didn’t know that Shi Yu didn’t come out, so for a period of time, only a few people were worried about Shi Yu.
For example, White Brook, who had called Shi Yu to participate in the martial arts conference, felt ten thousand regrets in her heart. If she had known earlier, she wouldn’t have invited Shi Yu no matter what.
Apart from that, under Lu Qingyi’s invitation, the members of Bureau 11 also put down what they were doing and collectively came to Wu Ling City to study Emperor Wu Ruins and try to see if there were any other ways to enter.
In just half a month, almost all the members of Bureau 11 came to Wu Ling City.
There were also various spatial specialists who arrived at Bureau 11’s invitation.
Unfortunately, the ruins space was an extremely profound thing. If there were no tools to control the entire ruins, then its traces of existence were something that even legendary Beast Tamers couldn’t confirm. Even legends like Emperor Shi and Emperor Kong didn’t dare to say that they could crack all
the ruins.
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
‘As he had agreed with Shi Yu to help the Iron-eating Beast increase its hardening level during the holidays, Lin Xiuzhu originally wanted to contact Shi Yu, but she realized that she couldn’t contact him no matter what.
“What’s wrong?” Seeing that his daughter had not gone to the ancient capital for a long time, Lin Hongnian asked.
“Ancient Capital University said… Shi Yu has important ruins exploration work. He might not be able to contact the outside world for the time being.” Lin Xiuzhu’s expression was blank.
She kept feeling that something was wrong, but she couldn’t say what was wrong.
The change in the ruins of Emperor Wu could be said to have made Wu Ling City into a mess.
Usually, the Beast Tamer Troops in Wu Ling City were basically training with Emperor Wu Ruins. Now that such a thing had happened, the management of Wu Ling City had a headache.
The most terrifying thing was… This situation lasted for more than two months, but there was still no activity from the Emperor Wu Ruins.
There was still no news from Shi Yu.
72 days later, in Wu Ling City, Lu Qingyi, who had stayed in Wu Ling City the longest as Bureau 11, and had not stopped studying the ruins of the Emperor Wu for almost a day, sighed and was a little absent-minded.
‘What exactly happened inside?
Why was there no movement for two whole months?
So was there any danger inside
At the same time, in Emperor Wu Ruins.
At this moment, Shi Yu was the most troubled.
For the past two months, it had been so boring that his scalp went numb.
As there was really no feasible way to get out, Shi Yu could only wait.
Who knew that after waiting for more than two months, there was still no result?
“What a sin.”
“Didn’t you say you would die in a few days? It’s been two months.”
“Don’t tell me that for one day ina turtle’s life, it equals one year of a human’s life…”
In his ruins space, after Shi Yu finished complaining daily, he continued to close his eyes and meditate.
In the past two months, because there was no other interference, his cultivation efficiency was especially fast.
After all, apart from adding points and meditation, he didn’t have the mood to do anything else.
With the help of the level-six spatial cultivation resource Space Crystal gifted by the third bureau, he was almost close to the master level.
It was probably just a short period of time before he broke through.
Apart from that, the changes to Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong were also very huge.
How should he put it.
Apart from super skills that couldn’t be added, all the low, intermediate, and high-level skills that the four of them could learn and add were filled by Shi Yu during this period.
For example, Shi Yu had maxed out every pet with high-speed healing, super vision, absolute sleep, multiplication, and deterrence.
Including Baby Ginseng, they had all learned transcendent level deterrence. From this, one could tell how much Shi Yu’s balls hurt during this period of time.
Apart from that, their racial skills naturally didn’t fall behind.
Eleven’s storage lightning, impregnable, Buggy’s spatial bag, Dream Stealing, Chi Tong’s Light Flame Sword, and Soul Slash had also been added to the maximum level, one level higher than transcendent teaching skills. They were all at the level of Dao Proficiency.
Now, in the commander rank state, Eleven had nearly 200,000 energy points, and its energy value was far ahead.
Chi Tong, who had 180,000 energy points, followed closely behind. Although it was known as a quasi-mythical race, that was because Spirit Release easily increased proficiency and had greater potential. In terms of overall attributes if they were at the same level, it was really inferior to Eleven, who had
swallowed a bunch of high-level resources.
As for Buggy, it was a little tragic. Although its energy value above 170,000 was not low, the difference was still a little obvious compared to the other two monsters. After all, it was a worm-type creature, and its energy value did not have the advantage.
After using the Domain of Imagination and the Dragon of Imagination, its energy quality would increase, but the problem was that Eleven also had the Inner Power and Chi Tong had the Possession. These were skills that could increase the quality of its energy.
Because of this, Shi Yu originally wanted to hold a Shiyu Meeting in the ruins of Emperor Wu to relieve his boredom, but he was directly persuaded by Buggy and Baby Ginseng.
No, no, no, no!
Buggy, who originally wanted to participate in the Shiyu Meeting the most, immediately panicked.
It felt that it still needed to work hard.
As for Baby Ginseng, it wanted to cry the most. It wanted to evolve and evolve, but the gem cat had the Death Spirit Fruit, the soil of time… They weren’t even holding a moonlight gem nor were they in a special time space. Although it wanted to evolve, it had to hold back.
This also resulted in its energy level being at the bottom of the team.
As a ginseng baby with energy as a racial advantage, although its energy value couldn’t be said to be low, it was indeed not high compared to the other three.
As Baby Ginseng insisted on carrying out a fair team competition after it evolved, Shi Yu had no choice but to push the team internal competition time again.
It was mainly because he wasn’t confident of defeating Eleven himself
Aweek later.
As cracks appeared on the Space Crystal in Shi Yu’s hand, his aura began to climb steadily.
With the use of hundreds of millions worth of super rare spatial cultivation resources, with the advantage of the ruins meditation technique and physique, he only used two months to increase his Beast Taming level to level five.
Shi Yu looked down and realized that his Beast Taming Space Barrier had completely turned blue after its level increased!
This meant that from today onwards, he, Shi Yu, was a master-level Beast Tamer.
Not only could the contracted pet reach the level of a monarch, but it had also obtained the fifth contract slot.
‘The moment Shi Yu broke through, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong all sensed it in various places in the ruins space. They instantly felt that their bottlenecks seemed to have been touched.
At this moment, all of Shi Yu’s pets sensed the opportunity to break through to the monarch level.
“wauu!!!”
“Wu wu wu ~”
“viva.”
“Mimil!”
In the blink of an eye, the four little guys arrived beside Shi Yu from different places.
Little Eleven, who was about 0.3 meters tall, looked up at Shi Yu excitedly.
Now, with the special effect of transcendent shrinking, even if it maintained shrinking, its strength wouldn’t decrease much compared to its normal state.
At the same time, it could also have the advantage of quickly recovering in a shrunken state. Of course, if it wanted to erupt with greater strength, it definitely had to rely on enlargement.
It was the same for Buggy. It landed on Shi Yu in a shrunken form that was less than the size of a palm. Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong also ran over and flew over shakily.
“Tbroke through.” Shi Yu looked at them and smiled.
“How do you feel?”
“wal!”
With Eleven as the lead, the four pets expressed that they could break through in the next few days!
“As expected, it happened naturally.”
Shi Yu was very excited.
‘There were going to be four monarch-level pets soon. This way, he could be considered top-notch among master-level Beast Tamers.
After all, a master like Master Lin Hongnian only had two monarch-level pets.
And he had four, and their racial levels were not low. This was probably something rarely achieved by a master.
Even if he faced those strengthening Beast Tamers who could strengthen their pets to millions of energy points, Shi Yu would not be afraid with the racial advantage of Eleven and the others.
Now, Shi Yu finally knew why people loved to contract pets with high racial levels. As long as the time was right, breakthroughs were basically inevitable. There were no bottlenecks.
Thinking about it, it was normal. After all, apart from super racial skills, Eleven and the others had all their racial skills at the maximum level. Breaking through to the monarch level was probably as simple as drinking water. Their foundation was too good.
However, it was probably a little difficult to break through to the overlord level.
According to Shi Yu’s understanding, there were two ways to break through to the overlord level. The first was to rely on legendary resources to strengthen the level-nine resource when the foundation reached the standard.
One was that all the racial skills it had, including super racial skills, had to have been trained to above perfect proficiency. This way, under the lead of racial skills, he could break through to the overlord level naturally.
After breaking through like this, it was stronger than relying on resources to break through.
At the thought of this, Shi Yu suddenly reacted and quickly opened the skill index.
After this breakthrough, his physique had improved again. Could he add some super skills?
Shi Yu quickly flipped open the skill index. He realized that in other places, the skill index had not changed much, but in the teaching of super skills, the skill index really was different.
Skill: Plant Control
Status: Can be taught
Shi Yu was looking at Baby Ginseng.
Upon seeing the words “can be taught’, Shi Yu was instantly overjoyed.
The joy of a Beast Tamer was just that plain and simple.
But at the next moment, his heart fell to the bottom.
Because there were still a few bars under [Status].
[Teaching success rate]: Very low
[Teaching Risk]: Extremely high
[Note]: The teaching of super skills will not only consume the Beast Tamer’s physical fitness and energy, but also the Beast Tamer’s life force. It’s extremely dangerous.
[Note]: Pets have to have a firm willpower to absorb the experience of super skills. Their strong hearts and conditions don’t meet the requirements. There’s a risk of becoming a slave of strength and losing your mind, causing the teaching to fail!
“Holy shit.” Shi Yu glanced at Chi Tong again.
Skill: Interlocking Sword
Status: Can be taught
[Teaching success rate]: Very low
He looked at Buggy.
Skill: Imagination Domain
Status: Can be taught
[Teaching success rate]: Very low
In the end, he looked at Eleven.
Skill: Inner Power
Status: Can be taught
[Teaching success rate]: Low
In an instant, Shi Yu’s expression darkened to the extreme.
Apart from Eleven, the success rate of the other three guys’ super skills was actually extremely low??
“wu?” “wou? Mi?”
The four little guys didn’t understand why Shi Yu’s expression suddenly changed so much.
Shouldn’t he be happy that he had broken through?
yi!!!” Baby Ginseng asked Shi Yu. Did he want a nutritional fruit?
“Tm not in the mood to eat anymore!” Shi Yu stood up and deliberately said with a sullen expression, “Apart from Eleven… Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, you guys should work hard.”
The pets:???
Shi Yu’s mood was completely up and down.
Even if he saw that teaching super skills consumed life force, he didn’t think much of it. It wasn’t like the nutritional fruit of the ginseng baby didn’t have the effect of replenishing life force. At most, he could replenish himself more and become weaker for a few days.
However, learning super skills also started to have requirements for pets. This was something Shi Yu didn’t expect.
Moreover, none of his four pets reached the standard. In an instant, Shi Yu felt responsible.
A firm willpower and a strong heart… Although he didn’t know what the conditions were for adding some super skill pets, it was obvious that they were far from enough.
Even Eleven didn’t meet the requirements. This made Shi Yu find it very difficult to believe.
This way, wouldn’t adding points in the future be like drawing a card? If he taught ten times, there was only one chance of getting results??
Who could withstand this!! He had to spend his life!!
The best way to change this situation was to increase the willpower of the pets and let them have strong hearts. After calming down, Shi Yu suddenly realized that the restrictions of super skills weren’t entirely bad.
Even Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were relatively hardworking, but their journey was still too smooth. Their growth speed was ridiculously fast.
This way, there was almost no training of the mind.
The so-called experts should have strong hearts. Otherwise, their hearts that had power but didn’t support their strength would be like that of Yun An five thousand years ago, reduced to a slave of power and fell into a chaotic state. They wouldn’t have any rationality and started to destroy everything.
Shi Yu definitely didn’t want to see this situation.
Therefore, after analyzing it for a while, Shi Yu sighed… At the moment, it was still impossible to increase the points of super skills.
“When the teaching success rate becomes medium… No, after it becomes high, I’ll teach super skills.”
“From the current situation, even Eleven will probably have to be tempered for a long time.”
Shi Yu still knew Eleven and the others very well. Although Eleven was hardworking and had strong willpower to do any arduous training, it basically didn’t have the fearless heart to challenge the strong.
Compared to those predecessors who protected their hearts and faced the totems fearlessly, Eleven was the same as its Beast Tamer. It only knew to bully the weak and fear the strong, and it liked to fight the babies. It was clearly much weaker. Eleven still had to train.
As for Buggy and Baby Ginseng, they were even a little inferior to Eleven.
As for Little Chi Tong, if it were its predecessor, General Mu Huiyin, it would definitely have an incomparably powerful will and heart even in the history of humans. However, Little Chi Tong was a completely new baby, equivalent to a child who had just been born. These qualities clearly couldn’t be
inherited and needed to be taught.
“wu?” “Wuu?” “Yi?” “Mi?”
The four pets looked at Shi Yu eagerly. What did he mean?
“In short, you guys aren’t in a hurry to break through. Next, I’ll develop a new special training plan for you guys. This training is the priority.”
“Wa…” Wuu…” “Yi…” Mi…” The four guys were a little nervous. They suddenly had a bad feeling.
Even Eleven, who wasn’t afraid of training, suddenly felt a chill down its spine when it looked at Shi Yu. It kept feeling that Shi Yu was up to no good.
[After all, if they become too strong after breaking through, I won’t be able to find a suitable training environment… Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
“Alright, let’s go out and take a look at the ruins today.”
Amoment later, Shi Yu brought the four little guys to the Nine Pillars.
Sensing the situation here, Shi Yu sighed again.
Not yet!
No way, no way, no way… Did he have to reach legendary level before he could leave this place?!
This was just… Even if the food resources here were quite sufficient, he was still thinking about the next water-element pet in Dragon Palace City, and also about the evolution of the ginseng baby.
Just as Shi Yu was beginning to feel depressed, the spatial ripples around the nine pillars suddenly changed slightly.
Buzz
Shi Yu, who was standing in the teleportation area, suddenly sensed the connection between Emperor Wu Ruins and the outside world.
At this moment, his depression was instantly swept away.
Damn, he could finally go out!! This was double happiness!!

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - Machinery Reaching God’s Forbidden Zone
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Machinery Reaching God’s Forbidden Zone
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the ruins of Emperor Wu in downtown Wu Ling.
A long blockade line established by the Beast Tamer Troops wrapped the place tightly.
After all, there might be a totem inside.
Although it didn’t look like an enemy totem, what if? If it came out, it would be troublesome.
“T’ve never felt so stifled in my life.”
White Brook’s uncle, Commander White, looked at the blockade and kept sighing.
At the moment, although Dong Huang’s forbidden weapon had already locked onto Emperor Wu Ruins, if it fought with the totem in this geographical location, humanity would purely be harming itself.
The totems in the totem area and the totems in the human countries were two completely different levels of threat to a country. After all, no country wanted to throw forbidden weapons in areas with good economic development in their country.
“Commander… Commander Bai.”
“There’s a reaction from the ruins!
During Commander Bai’s daily patrol, suddenly, a soldier’s voice attracted him, making him widen his eyes.
“What did you say?!!”
A moment later, under the gaze of hundreds of Beast Tamer Troops, the figure of four pets slowly appeared in the nine pillar teleportation area with a white flash.
At this moment, when they saw this figure, all the soldiers were stunned. They immediately cried. Wasn’t this the Shi Yu they had been searching for nearly three months?
It looked like this disaster kid didn’t die!
It was a good thing.
This meant that the totems inside weren’t hostile.
“Shi Yu!!!” After discovering that Shi Yu had come out, Commander Bai arrived at the blockade and watched him from outside the teleportation area.
“Well…” Just as he came out, Shi Yu immediately understood what was going on when he saw the array.
He couldn’t help but show an embarrassed expression. “Well, thank you for your hard work…”
“The totem inside…” This was what Commander Bai was most concerned about.
After a slight silence, Shi Yu said, “Probably… probably dead.”
In the past two months, he had never successfully contacted Zhong Xuan again. When he came out, he also wanted to tell Zhong Xuan, but he didn’t receive a response.
According to Zhong Xuan itself, it had probably used its racial talent to be reborn.
“Fuck, you destroyed the totem?” Commander Bai was shocked.
Everyon
Shi Yu: “?”
What was going on?
Many soldiers looked at their commander and were speechless. They had already said not to keep fusing with pig-type pets.
Shi Yu’s face darkened. “How is that possible?”
Next, Shi Yu received the strictest care.
Soon, Legend Bai, President Bai, White Brook, Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi, who had been staying in Wu Ling City for the past two months, arrived.
When they saw that Shi Yu had come out unscathed, they were immediately pleasantly surprised.
“It’s good that you’re alright.” Principal Feng laughed.
“Yay, you didn’t lose an arm or a leg.” White Brook punched.
Lu Qingyi smiled and didn’t say anything.
Looking at Legend Bai, Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook in front of him, Shi Yu was silent.
Seeing so many people concerned about him, he was a little nervous.
He had probably caused quite a stir in the past three months of his disappearance. He had already expected it inside.
In order not to let everyone discuss him, Shi Yu could only quickly change the topic and say, “I’m fine, but I have something important to say.”
“Imade a big discovery inside. An archeological discovery.”
Soon, all the relevant people gathered.
Inaroom, Shi Yu, Legend Bai, Principal Feng, and Bai Lu sat together.
Seeing how serious Shi Yu was with that complicated expression, the few of them were also taking this seriously. They temporarily shifted their attention from Shi Yu to what Shi Yu was about to say.
“Things are a little complicated
“The reason why the ruins of Emperor Wu changed, the reason why you were teleported out, and I was left behind is because a totem lives in the depths of the ruins space, and the true identity of this totem…”
“It’s Emperor Wu’s pet, Zhong Xuan.”
Shi Yu spoke slowly. As soon as he finished speaking, the pupils of Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and the others constricted.
“Holy shit.” Legend Bai was directly stunned.
“Zhong… Zhong Xuan… The legendary totem that has the bloodline of a divine turtle?”
“Wait, I remember that you cursed a turtle at that time. Was it because of this that you were left behind?”
Shi Yu :”…”
“How is that possible?”
Shi Yu quickly explained, “Actually, my guess that day was right. The Emperor Wu Ruins was indeed a training ground built by Emperor Wu to train the Iron-eating Beast Corps. Moreover, it was built by Chong Xuan.”
“The secret of the Iron-eating Beast’s second stage evolution is indeed stored inside.”
“Because Eleven and I performed too well on the Wei Lin Platform, we directly triggered the reward mechanism of the trial facility. Zhong Xuan was also awakened because of this.”
Everyone was a little stunned.
Especially Legend Bai, President Bai, and the others.
The few of them widened their eyes. Holy shit, Shi Yu was really right??
This luck was too damn good.
“Then?” White Brook couldn’t help but ask.
“T’ve come into contact with Zhong Xuan and also understood some lost history.”
“For example, the Wu Emperor Dynasty has a powerful iron-eating beast army.”
“For example, Emperor Wu himself also contracted a powerful Iron-eating Beast.”
“For example, Emperor Wu died from a battle with a demigod-level totem.”
“For example, the method for the iron-eating beasts to truly evolve into overlord races!”
Every word Shi Yu said shocked everyone. The entire Bai family was a fan of Emperor Wu, and as archeologists, Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi naturally cared about this very much. They couldn’t help but hold their breaths and listen to Shi Yu quietly.
“In short, because I was too outstanding, Zhong Xuan couldn’t help but pull me and help my Eleven complete the evolution.”
“Unfortunately, there aren’t many evolution materials stored inside… My Iron-eating Beast only evolved to a high-level overlord race with the help of Zhong Xuan. It doesn’t even have half the potential after complete evolution.”
Everyone:
‘They weren’t the ones with a problem. This Shi Yu was the one with a problem.
Damn it, was he using human language?
High-level overlord was looked down upon now?
President Bai and White Brook’s eyes turned red.
He had a pet of an overlord race that was already praised as legendary. Now that Shi Yu had a pile of them, was it appropriate?
Apity..?
Principal Feng said, “You stayed inside for two months just to evolve…? Then, what about Zhong Xuan??”
Shi Yu said, “No, the evolution wasn’t meant to be so focused on… The key is that Senior Chong Xuan is heavily injured and isn’t far from death. This time, it was purely shattered because we accidentally woke it up… It’s also the owner of the ruins, and it’s closely related to the stability of the ruins. If we’re
not wrong, it should have fallen now. After that, the ruins space slowly stabilized, and we were able to come out…”
Everyon
“Zhong Xuan died??” Legend Bai was stunned, and his eyes exploded. Holy shit, how could it die?
Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and the others opened their mouths slightly. They wanted to say something, but they didn’t know what to say.
Shi Yu said, “Of course, it’s also possible that it didn’t die. It said that it still has hope of rebirth, but it needs hundreds of years…”
Their expressions changed again.
Was it any different from being dead?
Then, Shi Yu told the other party in greater detail about Emperor Wu, Chong Xuan, and Yun An.
‘When they heard that Emperor Wu Imperial Dynasty relied on the overlord race, the Iron-eating Beast Corps, to go against the half-god Yun An, everyone was momentarily at a loss.
“The greatest gain this time should be the iron-eating beast’s overlord race evolution plan,” Shi Yu said seriously.
“Among them, the most important evolution materials are the meteorite fragments.”
“Although other rare level-eight metals can also achieve the effect of evolution, I’ve checked. Those metals aren’t renewable resources. They have already disappeared from the historical stage, and the birth conditions are incomparably difficult. There are very few of them. In comparison, the meteorite
fragment might be the only stable evolution channel.”
Meteorite Fragment
Principal Feng frowned and fell into deep thought.
“In other words, Emperor Wu pretty much took Yun An down with him, but Yun An might not necessarily be dead completely…” President Bai was solemn.
“I’s because it fought with Yun An that Emperor Wu could use the fragments of its body to steadily nurture the Iron-eating Beast’s second stage evolution form…”
“Well, actually… Zhong Xuan also gave me a piece of Yun An’s fragment, but the problem is that it said that if I used this thing, I would definitely be targeted by Yun An. That…” Shi Yu said,” So you understand, right?”
Legend Bai, Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook’s expressions gradually became rich.
This was guaranteed loneliness!!!
Ordinary totems, top-notch totems, half-gods… Half-gods were existences that stood at the top of totems. To find trouble with them?
Even if the stable evolution channel of the overlord race was important, the price to obtain it was a little too high.
“Actually, the most important thing is that Yun An might not necessarily be in uts peak state now. After all, to revive it probably requires a huge amount of energy. If it still exists, it must recover its strength somewhere. Perhaps it doesn’t even have the strength of an ordinary totem now. This is the most
important thing.”
“and to make a correction, perhaps it’s not a stable overlord race evolution plan, but a quasi-mythical race evolution plan. This is because it’s said that the more meteorite fragments used, the greater the evolution potential…”
Everyone:
“In short, let’s put aside our plans for Yun An first. If I use Yun An’s fragment… If it attacks, I should be fine, right?” Shi Yu asked quietly. “Can I use it?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone fell silent again.
Legend Bai had a headache. “You brought back impressive news.”
Archeologists were indeed all busybodies. Their Wuling City had used this ruin for decades and it was all fine, but Shi Yu had come with a bunch of trouble.
“If Yun An comes to Dong Huang because of this, things won’t be so complicated. Then it’s probably not far from becoming a renewable resource,” Principal Feng said.
White Brook said, “In other words, it’s very difficult to take the initiative to choose if you want to provoke a creature suspected to be a demigod because of a stable overlord race channel. You have to consider the gains and losses.”
“On the contrary, if it takes the initiative to attack, there’s no need to be conflicted?”
Legend Bai said, “That’s roughly what it means. This is the difference between taking the initiative to fight and being forced to fight back.”
“The act of initiating a battle with a totem area’s totem requires at least the approval of most of the legends and higher-ups in the country. Our Dong Huang main battle faction is actually still very small.”
“Moreover, if we can destroy Yun An for resources today, it might be thought that we might also attack the other totems tomorrow. It won’t be good if the totems also form an alliance.”
“The number of forbidden machines we use to deter totems is limited after all. If a large-scale battle breaks out, it will be disadvantageous for us.”
“In that case, law enforcement is the best choice?” White Brook asked.
Lu Qingyi: “… The premise is that Yun An really runs over here foolishly, but it’s impossible no matter how I think about it.”
At this moment, as he listened to everyone’s discussion, Shi Yu felt relieved.
Legend Bai said, “In my opinion, we can investigate Yun An’s information first.”
“After all, we’re the ones taking the initiative now.”
“If it hasn’t recovered yet, it’ll be easier to bombard it directly. In any case, the next totem battle will happen sooner or later. The benefits of being able to settle one of our forces in advance are definitely greater than the disadvantages.”
White Brook said eagerly, “I suddenly feel a little sorry for Emperor Wu… Speaking of which, how many forbidden weapons would it take to defeat Yun An?”
‘The opponent that Emperor Wu could only defeat with all his might was countered by the modern Mechanic class.
After all, the forbidden mechanical weapons and mechanical army of Dong Huang Totem only had one attack skill to deter the totems.
Self-destruct.
‘An incurable injury?
There was no intention to get injured in the first place.
Only this extreme battle strategy could make the totems tremble in fear.
Legend Bai said, “Sigh, although Emperor Wu is strong, the era has changed.”
“As for how much needs to be used, it’s hard to say.”
“Although the divine-level forbidden weapon that that person developed can kill demigods, the problem is that there are limited numbers. The cost of creating it is too high, so it’s impossible to easily activate it.”
“Back then, it was because the divine forbidden machinery killed three foreign demigods that the totem battle in the world quickly ended. However, we have to be especially careful when using this thing. If we use it all, we won’t have any weapons to threaten the totem creatures.”
“Machines can reach the forbidden power level of Gods, but the premise is that our firepower is strong enough.”
Not only could divine forbidden-type forbidden machines lock down space and lock onto enemies, but they were also suitable for various extreme environments such as the ocean and space. Moreover, they had a strong destructive effect on the soul and mind, not something ordinary forbidden weapons
could compare to.
This was Dong Huang’s final trump card.
“We definitely can’t use a divine forbidden-level mechanical life form easily. If Yun An hasn’t recovered to his full strength and we can rely on ordinary forbidden weapons to solve it… Even if we need ten ordinary forbidden weapons, such a resource exchange is worth it. After all, the cost of creating
ordinary forbidden weapons isn’t that high. The only difficulty is that we need a legendary Beast Tamer to activate them.”
“But for a big matter of this level, everything will definitely depend on that person’s decision.”
“Ah…” White Brook was slightly stunned.
This was the first time Shi Yu had heard these important figures discuss the mechanical legend.
He said, “Will this matter alarm that person?”
Principal Feng glanced at Shi Yu and shook his head. “Let’s make the decision first.”
“That person no longer exists in the form of a human. After gathering resources in the country and creating a large number of forbidden machines, in order to prevent accidents from happening, he has already modified himself into a Mechanical Heart and turned into a consciousness to supervise all
special types and forbidden machines.”
“Under normal circumstances, he’s sleeping. He can’t be awakened easily.”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned before nodding.
“Then I’ll leave it to you…” After explaining the situation in Emperor Wu Ruins, Shi Yu knew that he couldn’t interfere anymore.
It was up to the association to decide what to do next. He only needed to develop slowly now.
Perhaps, before the decision was made, he would already be a legend?
“By the way.” At this moment, Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
“Oh?” Shi Yu turned around.
“Recently, something big happened that’s related to you.”
“The Ice Dragon on the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, the battle beast of General Mu Huiyin, broke through to the totem level not long ago and became an Ice Dragon Totem.”
“Ithas already made a decision to cooperate with humans to completely destroy the Ice River Totem.”
Shi Yu: “?
“What?!”
Shi Yu widened his eyes and looked at Senior Lu.
“Aunt Ice Dragon advanced to totem level??”
Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “Yes…”
“After only talking once last time, it directly went to sleep and cultivated. When it woke up, it broke through to the totem… By the way, it said it wanted to see you. To be precise, it wanted to see your sword spirit.”
Principal Feng and the others had strange expressions.
Good heavens, he had contracted the heroic spirit of its master. It was time to meet it.
However, wasn’t Shi Yu’s experience a little too rich?
In just a year, the Ice Dragon, Zhong Xuan, Undying Dark Phoenix… He was related to a bunch of totems!
At this moment, Shi Yu was silent.
This.
Initially, he was still feeling regretful that he couldn’t cozy up to Senior Zhong Xuan, but… Aunt Ice Dragon actually advanced to totem?
So awesome?
Then, couldn’t he directly rely on Little Chi Tong’s background to become Aunt Ice Dragon’s associate and become its spokesperson to enter the first bureau? That would be living up to the name of his goddess!
“Let’s put the matter of Yun An aside first. You guys can slowly work it out. I, a little master, won’t interfere. When can I return to Ping Cheng?” Shi Yu said.
Everyone :”…”
Principal Feng said angrily, “Let’s settle the matter here first. I beg you, don’t mess around anymore, although this time… it wasn’t a loss!”
Legend Bai cried at the side. It was not a loss for the archeological discovery, but the economic loss of Wu Ling City this time directly went up to one billion.
Fortunately, the Emperor Ruins was alright!
“Wait.”
rincipal Feng suddenly discovered the blind spot.
“You’re a master?”
Shi Yu said, “Well, thanks to the Space Crystal Stone President Ye gave me, I’ve been holding it in for two months. I even successfully broke through to the master level, but my pet hasn’t broken through to the monarch level yet.”
Everyon
Holy shit, these two months have been especially fulfilling.
“Wait, wait, wait, wait. The most important thing is how strong your Eleven has become!! Hurry up and tell me,” White Brook couldn’t help but say.
‘The news she received today was too explosive.
Emperor Wu had an Iron-eating Beast??
Then she had to contract one too!!!
An overlord race.
‘Was money a problem??
No!
“Very strong. In short, it’s not a loss to nurture iron-eating beasts. Senior, there are still three little iron-eating beasts with very good aptitude at Ancient Capital University. Look and choose one for yourself and Senior Lu. Believe me, it’s definitely not a loss!!”
White Brook and Lu Qingyi looked at each other. In any case, White Brook was very tempted.
But words were useless.
Legend Bai, Principal Feng, and the others looked at each other.
“Speaking of which, after discussing for so long, shouldn’t we confirm the strength and potential of the iron-eating beasts of the overlord race first?”
This was the most important thing that determined the decision of the upper echelons of Dong Huang.
“This…” Shi Yu nodded and said,” Sure. ”
“Should I directly show it or use it to fight? I think… it should still be pretty strong at the moment. Although it’s only at the commander rank, it shouldn’t be a problem to defeat ordinary monarch ranks.”
Legend Bai, Principal Feng, and the others had strange expressions. Good lord, look at this arrogant speech.
At this moment, President Bai, who had been unable to interject, suggested, “Haha, then I feel that you can completely take a master-level assessment while you’re at it. I happen to have a friend who’s on a business trip to Wuling City. He has a sealing talent, so he should be able to test the various skill
limits of your Iron-eating Beast very well. This way, the data you guys obtain will be more accurate.”
“Eh, wait, you guys definitely know him too. He’s Master Qu Jie from the ancient capital.”
Principal Feng, Shi Yu, and White Brook:
Again.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - Third Time’s the Charm
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Third Time’s the Charm
Translator:
?Atlas Studios
Editor:
?Atlas Studios
Master Qu Jie…
Upon hearing this name, Shi Yu felt an inexplicable sense of closeness.
Was this what it meant to meet an old friend in his hometown? It wasn’t only Shi Yu. Principal Feng and the beast-eared girl, who had accompanied Shi Yu to participate in the high-level assessment, were also very emotional.
Oh shit, didn’t this save trouble?
Didn’t Master Qu Jie say that he would prepare Shi Yu’s master license first?
He could get his license immediately after this fight. Not bad. “Can I… Then I’ll have to trouble Master Qu Jie.”
Shi Yu looked at President Bai in embarrassment.
President Bai laughed and said, “It’s alright. We’re old friends. This small
matter is nothing.”
Wu Ling City. Just as he finished eating with the masters from the assessment office of the Wu Ling Association, Master Qu Jie returned to the hotel in a relatively good mood.
At this moment, his phone rang. “Old Bai? Has everything been settled? Why did you suddenly leave?”
After picking up the call, Master Qu Jie asked.
Because they had sealed the news, he clearly didn’t know that White Brook’s uncle had suddenly left the gathering because of Shi Yu. “Haha, soon, soon. Old Qu, are you done eating over there?”
“I’m done.”

Legend Bai and Principal Feng suddenly got up, their eyes red. At this moment, they had a premonition that Dong Huang would be shocked by the Nine Li Battle Beast next. If the Beast Tamers knew that the Iron-eating Beast could evolve into this thing, they would probably have to petition everyone to suppress a certain half-god and take revenge for Emperor Wu.. Yun An was in danger!!

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - The Temptation of Ping Cheng
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: The Temptation of Ping Cheng
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After the attack, the Ox-Headed Beast King fell heroically.
As for the Panda King, it fell as expected, and it was injured even more heavily than the Ox-Headed Beast King.
There was silence.
Now, everyone wanted to know. This Iron-eating Beast’s commander rank was already so strong. If it broke through to the monarch rank, what would happen?
“F*ck.”
“Are you trying to test it? You want to kill me and the old bull.”
After reacting, Master Qu Jie cursed in his heart.
How much hatred, how much hatred.
Pretty soon this panda would become one of those self-destruct mechanical pets!
‘Was there a need to be so desperate to test these moves?
Just as Master Qu Jie felt that things had exceeded his expectations and he felt a little dizzy, perhaps the test didn’t have to continue.
The medical ginseng quickly ran to the venue and fed the dying Panda King something. The Panda King immediately crawled up energetically.
“Wuu!!!”
Eleven raised its arm and roared.
‘Well done, medical ginseng.
Master Qu Jie :”…”
The Ox-Headed Beast King also seemed to have this treatment.
A moment later, it was also quickly fed the mysterious fruit by the medical ginseng. The two pets recovered their initial state.
Master Qu Jie :”…”
Looking at Eleven rubbing its fists, it seemed like it wanted to continue.
Qu Jie, Ox-Headed Beast King:??
“Should I… change a pet?”
Master Qu Jie’s face was almost black as he gritted his teeth.
What a tough life.
In the next test, he wanted to change to the strongest one. He couldn’t let Shi Yu defeat him every time.
“wu?”
Eleven and Shi Yu were stunned.
‘The Ox-Headed Beast King: “Roar!!! (F*ck, stupid Beast Tamer, why change? That fruit was very delicious just now, let me fight again!)”
As long as it wasn’t killed, it would tolerate it.
Master Qu Jie:???
Huh?!
‘Then, Master Qu Jie accompanied Shi Yu and the others through the remaining tests in a daze.
Where was the strength of the three inscriptions Nine Li Battle Beast?
‘The strong thing was that apart from the Inner Power of the core, the other skills were all free skills.
Forming beans into soldiers could be created for oneself or for others to use. It was equivalent to letting others master “Bean Soldiers”.
For Space Quake, as long as it was willing to help others enchant their weapon, any pet would have a spatial weapon that could easily attack spatial enemies.
‘There was even less of a need to talk about the Lightning Rod. It could tum itself or the enemy into a mobile Heavenly Thunder attraction.
It could be said that nurturing one was equivalent to nurturing a barracks filled with firepower!
In addition to the compatibility between the skills Shi Yu displayed and the Iron-eating Beast, it was very difficult for everyone to not agree with the Nine Li Battle Beast’s strength and potential.
Most importantly, Eleven was too strong.
A bunch of skills were maxed out by Shi Yu.
Therefore, when combined, the ability to fight above its level was even more shocking.
“Second Grandpa, I want to nurture this!!”
The more White Brook looked at it, the more she liked it.
After she broke through to the master level, she had yet to contract a new pet.
Now, she had found the right one.
“It’s strong, but it’s expensive…” Beside him, President Bai’s scalp went numb.
Three level-eight rare metals, wasn’t this guaranteed to be five billion?
No matter how strong the iron-eating beast was, their Bai family couldn’t afford to let White Brook create it like this.
A llevel-eight metal was already painful.
Thinking about it this way, Shi Yu, who had freeloaded so many evolution materials in the ruins, had profited greatly.
“It’s indeed expensive…” Old Master Bai was just about to agree and immediately stopped.
“It’s better to see Yun An’s information first.”
An Iron-eating Beast like Shi Yu’s was restricted by evolution materials. It should be very difficult to nurture.
On the other hand, they could look forward to the Iron-eating Beast getting through the strongest evolution of the meteorite fragment.
“Eh!” At this moment, Principal Feng was already at a loss for words. The current Shi Yu could no longer be said to be a potential legend.
Perhaps when he grew up in the future, he would have the chance to challenge the various titles that had been passed down in Dong Huang since ancient times.
“Do you want to contract an Iron-eating Beast too?”
The old man looked at Lu Qingyi.
Lu Qingyi was silent. “…It’d be a long time from now.”
She had just contracted a local sprite, so there was no extra contract slot.
If she wanted to contract it, she had to wait until after legend.
She didn’t know how long it would take to break through to Legend
In short, everyone had already subconsciously thought of Yun An.
Without a doubt, it was definitely not a problem for Shi Yu to successfully obtain the master’s license. Even if he didn’t have a monarch-level pet, the strength he displayed was no longer inferior to any master.
Master Qu Jie would agree.
“Hahahaha.” After a long time, the test was completed. Legend Bai, Principal Feng, and the others came down and laughed.
Alright, alright.
‘The Iron-eating Beast was really strong. Not bad, not bad.
“Damn, how can there be such a ridiculous pet?”
‘As someone who had experienced it personally, Master Qu Jie widened his eyes. He also felt that the Iron-eating Beast was ridiculously strong, but as the one being beaten, he wasn’t as happy as the others.
“After all, this is the strongest battle beast that even Emperor Wu had to spend a lot of effort to nurture as a trump card. It’s been hard on you this time, Master Qu.”
‘As everyone communicated during the subsequent testing segment, Master Qu Jie also understood how Shi Yu and the others’ subsequent abilities came about.
After Shi Yu’s archeology discovered the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast King’s race, it freaking discovered the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast overlord race. Moreover, it also discovered that the Iron-eating Beast was Emperor Wu’s strongest pet. Master Qu Jie once again felt that the
archeological system was abnormal.
“It’s… It’s alright…”
After being thanked, Master Qu Jie’s face darkened. He looked at Shi Yu and the others, as well as his ox, who was smugly holding the reward from the ginseng baby.
Only Master Qu Jie was traumatized!
“But next time, if you want to look for me about this kind of thing, please tell me in advance and let me be mentally prepared,” he said as an old man. As a person who was almost old, he couldn’t afford to be stimulated.
“Sure, sure,” President Bai said with a smile. Wasn’t this just an accident, after all.
“I’s been hard on you, Master Qu,” Shi Yu also said. “T’ll look to you for the next top-notch assessment.”
Master Qu Ji
He widened his eyes and said, “Why are you still looking for me? The Ancient Capital Association doesn’t have the function of a top-notch assessment. Be good and go to the headquarters.”
“There’s still the legendary assessment and title assessment in the future. Go where you want.”
An!
suddenly, Master Qu Jie felt liberated.
Yes, the upper limit of the Ancient Capital Association’s assessment was only at the master level.
Next, even if Shi Yu wanted to break through ten thousand times and break through to the Mythical stage, it was definitely impossible for him to be related to Shi Yu anymore. Alright.
“Is that so? It’s alright, it’s alright. I just feel that I might need your help next.” Shi Yu felt that Master Qu Jie’s sealing talent was really useful.
Perhaps next, he could let the other party seal Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng to the transcendent level or even the Awakening level for a period of time.
This way, he could train Eleven and the others better.
In short, he planned to return to the ancient capital to visit Master Qu Jie.
At the same time, Master Qu Jie felt an ominous feeling.
He kept feeling that there was nothing good about being targeted by Shi Yu.
What a tough life.
Then, everyone invited Master Qu Jie, who had been busy for half a day, to have dinner together.
It was difficult to refuse such hospitality, so Master Qu Jie could only agree.
However, Master Qu Jie still had to go to the hotel to pack his things. Shi Yu and the others walked towards the Bai family first.
This test could be said to have satisfied many expectations.
Along the way, everyone was overjoyed.
The Iron-eating Beast was too strong, and Shi Yu was too strong
Legend Bai suddenly thought:
“Perhaps we have to develop and use the ruins specifically. Shouldn’t our family nurture some Iron-eating Beasts first?”
“Whether it evolves or not is another matter, but the initial purpose should be to nurture a batch of outstanding talents first, right?”
President Bai agreed very much. “Yeah, why don’t we also transform the Beast Tamer Troops in Wu Ling City into the Iron-eating Beast Corps?”
In just a few years, wouldn’t Wu Ling City become the tenth first-level city?
Listening to the father and son’s discussion, White Brook couldn’t help but say, “Do you want to do it? I’ll do the discussions?”
“Huh?”
White Brook: “At the moment, there are basically not many wild Iron-eating beasts in the country. Several Iron-eating Beast Breeding bases have already been purchased by Master Lin’s family in Icefield City. Now, Ping Cheng Breeding Base is the largest Iron-eating Beast Breeding Base in Dong Huang, I
think we can perhaps talk about cooperation. After all, the Emperor Wu Ruins is actually built specially to nurture Iron-eating beasts.”
“Hall Master Lin’s family?” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu.
Principal Feng also looked at Shi Yu. Everyone knew that this was most likely related to Shi Yu.
“Alright.” Legend Bai and President Bai didn’t realize that White Brook’s reaction was so fast.
They had to talk.
Moreover, they had to go wherever White Brook went. The whole family had to go.
Shi Yu :”…”
Why did he feel that next, even the richest man in Icefield City might not be able to stop Senior Panda’s family?
This early investment was simply too much.
What a strong alliance.
“Then, I’ll return to Ping Cheng with you next. How about that?” The beast-eared girl followed Shi Yu.
“Well, it’s not impossible.”
Shi Yu couldn’t imagine what it would be like if the beast-eared girl joined forces with Senior Panda’s family.
If the archeological discovery of Emperor Wu’s first battle beast was announced, probably all the Beast Tamers in Wu Ling City, no, all of Dong Huang’s Fusion Talent would be high.
The price of the Iron-eating Beast increased again.
No, it was not accurate. At the moment, the number of iron-eating beasts was still small. Perhaps next, the iron-eating beasts would be controlled by the association. After all, the overlord potential was already a strategic requirement related to the development of the country. An overlord species pet that
stabilized the evolution path could often lead to the birth of a new legend.
With the country behind them, the development of Senior Panda’s family, who specialized in raising iron-eating beasts, might be better, more long-term, and more stable.
“Sigh, as expected of me…”
In front of a group of big shots, Shi Yu couldn’t help but act cool again.
“Tl go too,” Lu Qingyi also said at the side. “We still have to settle Ice Dragon’s matter.”
“Let’s put the Iron-eating Beast aside for now. You should go and see the Ice Dragon quickly.”
The Ice Dragon called Shi Yu by name. It would be bad if the other party became impatient.
‘The matter of the Iron-eating Beast had to be taken slowly. It couldn’t be rushed. The Ice Dragon Totem was the key now.
“Yeah, then I might have to go too,” Principal Feng said with a headache.
He looked at Shi Yu with a faint gaze. At the moment, the relationship between this ice dragon and Dong Huang was not considered stable.
The new totem didn’t have any hostile tendencies at the moment. It definitely had to be befriended and tied to the country.
This kind of thing usually required a specific candidate to establish a friendship with it. It was a little unreliable to rely on benefits to maintain it.
There had to be restraints and benefits!
1
At the moment, in Dong Huang, perhaps only Shi Yu was suitable to chill with Ice Dragon.
‘As a member of the first bureau, this mission had long been assigned to Principal Feng.
He needed to guide Shi Yu to obtain the recognition of the Ice Dragon and maintain a good friendship between the two parties.
Upon thinking of this, Principal Feng felt stifled. Damn, if it succeeded, would Shi Yu, this kid, also have to work part-time in three departments?
He wasn’t even 20 years old yet!
Shi Yu directly saw Principal Feng’s resentful gaze.
Shi Yu:”…”
“I understand, I understand.” Shi Yu was suddenly shocked. Yes, he had almost forgotten about Mother Dragon.
He had yet to take a look at the matter of inviting Yun An back to prison in the country. Whether he could find Yun An was still another matter. The key now was how to cozy up to the Ice Dragon Totem.
“Eh.” When they heard that Shi Yu was about to make friends with the Ice Dragon Totem again, the three from the Bai family couldn’t help but be at a loss.
Amaster of management indeed
How could a master-level Beast Tamer talk to different totems continuously?
“Two… No, three… Be careful.”
Principal Feng sighed. How much trouble had Shi Yu caused in such a short period of time?
They had to watch the Undying Dark Phoenix closely.
On the Iron-eating Beast and Yun An’s side, it was another big matter that many higher-ups had to decide together.
They had to pay special attention to the Ice Dragon Totem.
He was already at the age of retirement, so he still had to do these things. Principal Feng didn’t expect this.
Next, everyone’s destination was very clear.
Apart from reporting the incident at the Emperor Wu Ruins, the Bai family wanted to go to Ping Cheng to discuss cooperation with the Lin family.
Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi needed to cooperate with Shi Yu to complete the relationship aspect with the Ice Dragon Totem.
Ping Cheng, this small place, immediately became the focus of many parties
That day, no matter how far the matter progressed, the tenth bureau of Dong Huang, the Intelligence Bureau, had already activated some of the elite undercover members in the totem area at the first moment and started to investigate information related to Yun An.
‘There was indeed nothing good about Master Qu Jie meeting Shi Yu. The guy was a complete disaster.
In one of the eleven totem districts in the east, in the Fox God Totem District, in a town with an ancient appearance… The elite member of the tenth bureau, Qu Ling, who had a special sealing talent, received an investigation mission from the country.
She was wearing an ancient cotton shirt and carrying a white fox. She walked on this street that was no different from the ancient times of Dong Huang, It was also filled with people.
The greatest difference between this place and the ancient towns of Dong Huang was that special fox-type creatures were worshiped in various places.
In the center of the town stood a huge fox god totem, accepting incense offerings.
“Yun An…” This person was the daughter who had inherited Master Qu Jie’s special sealing talent.
Every time an important investigation mission was issued, these members were in the most danger.
On the other side, in Dong Huang, a day later, Shi Yu and the others also came directly from Wu Ling City to the icy plain, Ping Cheng!

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - Ice Dragon Mommy
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Ice Dragon Mommy
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
Today, the Ping Cheng Association was especially grand.
‘The reason was very simple. A big shot was coming.
In this tiny place where the highest level of Beast Tamers was only at the master level, the arrival of two legends was definitely an extremely sensational matter.
At the Ping Cheng Association.
