President Feng, Hall Master Lin, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others had long received the news in advance.
“Sigh, sigh.”
At this moment, Hall Master Lin was extremely regretful.
“Why did this kid, Shi Yu, discover the evolution method of the iron-eating beast overlord race?”
“So be it. Why wasn’t I there when it evolved? I hate it.”
“Enough, enough…” Lin Xiuzhu asked his father to speak less.
You almost died laughing at that time, so what are you being grumpy for now.
Initially, after Shi Yu disappeared for three months, Senior Panda thought that something had happened to Shi Yu.
But who would have thought that as soon as Shi Yu had news, he would bring back an even more explosive piece of information.
He had discovered the stable overlord race evolution plan of the iron-eating beasts!
This news directly made the Lin father and daughter dizzy.
Through the communication equipment, Senior Panda had already learned about what had happened in the Battle Emperor Ruins from Shi Yu. She had even arranged for the Battle Emperor Set meal and all they were waiting for now was just to start selling pandas.
‘Why was she so hardworking?
It was all because she had learned from Shi Yu that the second stage evolution of the Iron-eating Beast was still extremely expensive.
“Lwonder how the Wu Ling Bai family is going to negotiate with our Ping Cheng this time.”
Old Feng was more worried. After all, the size of Ping Cheng was too different from Wu Ling’s Bai family.
‘One was a small county city that didn’t even have a top-notch master, and the other was a large family that had produced legends and mastered the ruins of Emperor Wu.
“Don’t panic.” Hall Master Lin was relatively calm. “Shi Yu still has shares in the breeding base. He definitely doesn’t want to lose out.”
This cooperation definitely had to be centered around Shi Yu.
“President, he’s here.”
A moment later, the Wu Lingtian Group arrived at the Ping Cheng Association, the Bai Family’s Legend Bai, the Wu Ling Association’s President Bai, and the girl White Brook. They were all here.
Apart from that, there was also the old principal of Ancient Capital University and Lu Qingyi. However, surprisingly, Shi Yu didn’t follow.
“Welcome, welcome…”
Seeing such a big scene, President Feng was a little nervous.
President Feng, Hall Master Lin, and Senior Panda immediately welcomed the guests.
However, at this moment, after the panda senior’s gaze searched for Shi Yu fruitlessly, she couldn’t help but look at her genius junior, White Brook, and Lu Qingyi, who was also in the same batch as her but was known as the proud daughter of heaven in Ancient Capital University. These two.
Lu Qingyi and White Brook were also surprised to discover that… Why was this girl’s clothes so similar to the panda jacket Shi Yu used to wear?
At the same time.
Shi Yu had already separated from everyone. He was not interested in this kind of cooperation. He only wanted to find Grandma Ice Dragon now.
“I want to talk to Ice Dragon alone first. It’s not good to have too many people.”
With this saying, Shi Yu headed to the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain alone.
As for Shi Yu’s safety… To be honest, everyone was no longer very worried.
The Ice Dragon Snow Mountain only had monarch-level ferocious beasts, and they were distributed loosely. With Shi Yu’s current strength, it was not a problem for him to escape from any one of them.
The etherealization ability of the ruin ring and Buggy’s Concealment and Instant Transmission were not decorations.
Most importantly, Shi Yu still brought bodyguards this time.
“It’s not here yet?”
A certain gem cat lay lazily on the flying carpet and said to the red-haired Chi Tong flying in the sky beside it.
“Soon, soon.”
Shi Yu sighed.
The day after he came out of the ruins of Emperor Wu, this cat ran to Wu Ling City.
In the three months since Shi Yu disappeared, this guy was definitely the one who suffered the most.
After finishing the gem fruits and realizing that it couldn’t find Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu, the gem cat immediately exploded.
After three months, he had lost a lot of weight.
This time, Shi Yu had finally appeared. No matter what, it had to stay beside Baby Ginseng and harvest a few more boxes of gem fruits before leaving.
A wave of cold passed through the white snow mountain and blue sky.
Shi Yu and the others landed at the top of a snow mountain, in an ice and snow ruin.
“Sob.”
Eleven lay on Shi Yu tiredly. It was really not easy to muster up strength in such a cold place.
Baby Ginseng also hid in its pocket and rubbed its hands to warm up. It tried its best to stick to Shi Yu, who was in a possessed state.
Buggy flew up from Shi Yu’s shoulder and looked at the Ice Dragon Ruins where its mommy, the Ice Dragon, lived. It sighed.
The last time Shi Yu threw it over to “acknowledge it as its mother’, it was still a green worm. Now that it had evolved, it wondered if Ice Dragon still recognized it.
“Is this the place?” The gem cat also jumped down from the flying carpet and stared at the Ice Dragon Ruins.
It had heard that Western dragons liked to collect treasures very much, and this ice dragon had survived from the Time Emperor era and conquered mountains. Its battle results were much better than sweeping through an undead battlefield. Then, in theory… Could this ice dragon have a pile of rare
gems?
“This is the place.”
Shi Yu spat out some fire and looked at Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng. “I feel that we should come to Ice Dragon Snow Mountain to train later. The harsh environment here is quite suitable for you.”
“Wuu!!” Although Eleven still liked to train in normal places, it wasn’t unacceptable.
On the other hand, Buggy and Baby Ginseng had bitter expressions. They still felt that training in the ruins was more fragrant.
Boom!!!
This time, with the arrival of Shi Yu and the others, the ruins trembled without even knocking.
“Roar!!!”
A terrifying dragon roar suddenly came from the world. This dragon roar directly stunned the gem cat beside it.
So strong.
Damn it, it didn’t know when it could enter the totem level.
It was too difficult to save money!
[You guys are finally here!]
In the ruins space, the ice dragon slowly opened its eyes. After Lu Qingyi told it that Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit had appeared, it had been waiting for Shi Yu to bring the sword spirit over.
But it had waited too long.
“Come in quickly,” Ice Dragon said eagerly.
Space changed, and the stars changed. In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu and the others appeared in a completely frozen world. Time seemed to have stopped.
The extreme cold was several times colder outside.
The moment they entered, Shi Yu and the others directly saw the frost dragon lying on the seal staring at them.
< Name > Frost Dragon (Special)
[Attributes]: Ice, Dragon
[Race Level]
[Level of Growth]: Totem Level
[Energy Points]:??
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Ice Dragon. The index showed the same reaction as if it had seen Chong Xuan.
As the other party’s energy value exceeded the upper limit of the index of 100 million, it directly couldn’t be detected.
As for race level… Ordinary ice dragons were middle-level overlords, but this ice dragon had clearly mutated and evolved. It was estimated that at the very least, it was a high-level overlord race.
“Huh?”
At this moment, after seeing Shi Yu and the others again, Ice Dragon’s full attention was attracted by the red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu.
‘As max-level possession would allow Shi Yu to temporarily obtain the power of the bloodline, Ice Dragon immediately sensed Mu Huiyin’s aura on Shi Yu.
It couldn’t help but be silent.
“Can you… split up first?” Ice Dragon raised its eyebrows.
“alright… Hahaha.”
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu decisively removed his possession from Chi Tong.
In the next moment, a small phoenix made of orange and red flames appeared in midair.
“Jiu…” After coming out, Chi Tong looked at the ice dragon staring at it nervously. However, it instinctively felt a sense of closeness from the ice dragon. It was ice cold and wanted to stick to him.
At that moment, as Chi Tong appeared, the Ice Dragon’s gaze became even more serious.
It stared at it carefully and seriously.
“Hahahahahaha!!!”
However, who knew that in a moment, Ice Dragon laughed like it had gone crazy? It laughed especially crazily.
“It’s indeed her bloodline.”
F*ck… Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the others were shocked. Why was he suddenly smiling so crazily?
It didn’t look like the touched and happy laughter one would expect from a pet that saw its tamer after a long time… It was more like
“Jiu…” Little Chi Tong was also shocked. It subconsciously wanted to hide back in Shi Yu’s body, but he realized that i**tte had already been locked onto by the ice dragon.
Ice Dragon stretched out its huge claws and pulled the shocked Little Chi Tong to its side. It said arrogantly, “In the past, you asked me to call you Mom, but now I’ve decided. I want to acknowledge you as my goddaughter. That’s what you get for bullying me in the past. Haha, do you have any
objections??”
With that said, it looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu, the Gem Cat, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng:??
Holy shit, what the hell?
What a chaotic scene!
Buggy: “Then who am I???”
Chi Tong: QAQ???
“ah, this.” Shi Yu was stunned. Wait, wait, something was wrong with this script.
Shouldn’t Ice Dragon be crying and acknowledging Chi Tong as its master, deciding to follow it again in this life and go through fire and water?
Why did it directly drag it over to be Chi Tong’s mother with a vengeance?
“Jiu!!! (Save me!!)” Being hugged by the ice dragon, Chi Tong turned around and begged Shi Yu for help.
shi Yu:”…”
Shi Yu wanted to say something but hesitated. He wanted to say something, but seeing that Ice Dragon didn’t seem to have much ill intentions, he could only remain silent.
{calm down, calm down. It’s pretty good to acknowledge it as your mother. If you acknowledge her, it’ll save me the trouble. How good is it to have a mother? You no longer have to be afraid of wind and rain, and you have someone to shoulder everything.]
[chi Tong:???]
“Meow…” At this moment, the gem cat couldn’t react.
Shi Yu bit the bullet and said, “Long time no see. But, this… What does this mean?”
Ice Dragon didn’t mind at all. “What’s wrong with that? It’s not actually my master anyway. I’m happy. Why, can’t I? Do you lose out on anything? Do you?”
“Come and be my daughter!” it said to Chi Tong.
“Jiu!!! (No.)” Little Chi Tong immediately turned into the form of a little sword spirit, then shrank to the extreme, becoming the size of a rice grain, and escaped from the huge claw.
“Tsk.” Seeing Little Chi Tong escape, Ice Dragon was stunned and showed a bored expression.
In the past, if it did this to Mu Huiyin, it would definitely be beaten up and stepped on. That feeling made Ice Dragon miss it, but unfortunately, there was nothing now.
1
Forget it, forget it.
It looked at Shi Yu and the others with a burning gaze, especially Shi Yu. “Train it well. If you anger it, I won’t let you off.”
Shi Yu took the little sword spirit and nodded heavily. “Of course, it’s like my biological daughter. I’ll definitely take good care of it…”
Chi Tong agreed.
Ice Dragon: “Get lost, stop taking advantage of me.”
Shi Yu:”…”
After a moment of silence, Ice Dragon sighed.
“In short, this way, I can leave without any regrets.” It was very satisfied.
He didn’t expect to see the bloodline of its Beast Tamer before deciding to leave Dong Huang.
“Wait, wait.” At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly looked at Ice Dragon.
He didn’t forget the most important mission of this trip.
According to the clues provided by Senior Lu, Ice Dragon was thinking to leave Dong Huang.
If possible, the association naturally hoped that the Ice Dragon would stay in Dong Huang and become the guardian of this place.
“are you leaving Dong Huang?” Shi Yu asked.
Ice Dragon looked down and said, “Didn’t I say? After stepping into the totem and solving the ice river totem problem, I want to go home and take a look.”
“Two thousand years have passed. Although things have definitely changed, it’s still the place where I was born and grew up…”
It looked towards the west nostalgically.
“Emperor Shi died, and that Dragon Hunter must have died too. It’ll definitely be fine when we return.”
Listening to Ice Dragon’s muttering, Shi Yu was stunned. As expected, Ice Dragon Aunt had also escaped because of the Western Dragon Hunter.
More than two thousand years ago, a legendary Beast Tamer was also born in the West, known as the Dragon Hunter.
His hometown had been destroyed by the dragons since he was a child, and he had become very hostile to the dragons. In order to take revenge, he grew up all the way to become a legendary Beast Tamer and launched the Dragon Slaying Battle that shocked the West, slaughtering the Western dragons
until they fled or died. Although in the end, the Dragon Hunter was jointly killed by the totems of the dragons, the dragons suffered heavy injuries.
At that time, the fleeing dragons also began to spread their branches everywhere.
“Well, we should go home and take a look, but do you still plan to come back?” Shi Yu asked.
Ice Dragon said, “What?”
“What if Chi Tong misses you…”
Ice Dragon looked at Chi Tong. That made sense.
“Is it possible?” But it quickly reacted.
This guy didn’t even want to call it mom, and now they’re claiming it would miss it?
“What’s the point of coming back? There’s nothing worth it here. You just want to keep me in Dong Huang as a fighter, don’t you? You want to deceive me? No way.”
Shi Yu :”…”
“In short, don’t think about it. After that, I plan to go to the legendary Dragon Palace City to take a look. I heard that food and accommodation are guaranteed there, and dragons from all over the world are welcome to join. I came to the east with the intention of seeking refuge in Dragon Palace City. Who
knew that I would be captured by Mu Huiyin midway?”
“But it’s not too late now. With my current strength, it shouldn’t be a problem for me to be a queen, right? Most importantly, I heard that it’s very friendly to the totems that join, and will also share the final secret to the Dragon God Domain…”
The Ice dragon chuckled and said, “It’s better to go there than to join your Dong Huang. Everyone there is a dragon, so it’s definitely more comfortable staying there than here.”
Totem-level battle powerhouses were a guest everywhere.
Even for a giant ocean faction like Dragon Palace City that had several totems, if a new totem joined, it would also have a huge impact on that place. Ice Dragon didn’t have any ambition after all, and planned to rely on a giant faction to live in peace.
With its strength, it was indeed not a big problem for it to be worshiped by Dragon Palace City and call the totems in Dragon Palace City brothers and sisters.
“Ah.” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Ah what?”
Shi Yu: “… The problem is that Dragon Palace City is also a part of Dong Huang.”
The frost dragon: “?
“Dragon Palace City experienced an upheaval a thousand years ago and changed their Dragon God once. The current Dragon Palace City Dragon God is a good friend of the legendary Beast Tamer Dragon Emperor after Emperor Shi. They once fought side by side… Apart from that, the Sea Dragon King of
Dragon Palace City is also a battle beast of the legendary Beast Tamer Lin Feng from Dong Huang. His strength reached the totem level a hundred years ago. Also… most of the totems in Dragon Palace City are more or less related to Dong Huang.”
“Now, Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City are super reliable allies.”
According to what Shi Yu knew, the individual members of the first bureau could enter that bureau because they were connected to Dragon Palace City
Ice Dragon:??
Holy shit, there was such a thing?
The ice dragon was a little stunned for a moment. During the Emperor Shi era, Dragon Palace City and the Dong Huang Human Race still had no connection.
“Well, my relationship with the Sea Dragon King is very strong. There’s also its scale keepsake. Ill visit Dragon Palace City soon. Why don’t I introduce you? When the time comes, we’ll go together.”
Shi Yu didn’t care if Ice Dragon joined Dragon Palace City or not. In fact, it was even better if it joined. His connections would be stronger.
“Ah…” The frost dragon was stunned again.
“You brat, something’s wrong, Tell me, do you need something from me?” Ice Dragon realized that something was wrong.
Shi Yu was silent.
Speaking of which, you might not believe me. Apart from you, Chi Tong has another mother. However, that mother seems to have ill intentions and might cause Chi Tong harm. If you can stay in Dong Huang, I can be more at ease. At least Chi Tong won’t be bullied anymore
“Can you bear to… let your daughter be snatched away by others?”
“It really needs a reliable guardian now.”
“After all, that Undying Dark Phoenix looks so fierce and powerful.. We can’t defeat it at all…”

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - Overlord Will
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Overlord Will
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu used a lot of time to explain the Undying Dark Phoenix to Ice Dragon.
After hearing it, the Ice Dragon was shocked.
The mystery of its Beast Tamer’s bloodline that she had never figured out in her life had finally been solved?
General Mu Huiyin had been tortured by the power of her bloodline since she was young and had to contract an ice-type pet to suppress her bloodline.
But even so, every time she used her ability, Mu Huiyin would still be tortured.
In order to help its master overcome the power of the bloodline and find out the mystery of the bloodline, Ice Dragon and the other pets worked hard for a long time.
In the end, although Mu Huiyin successfully separated a portion of the violent bloodline power and stored it in the heroic spirit ruins, they still didn’t understand where Mu Huiyin’s bloodline power came from until her death.
“Phoenix Race.”
“Sun God Phoenix, Undying Dark Phoenix.”
The frost dragon muttered to itself. Holy shit, General Mu Huiyin’s mother was sealed in that place called the Undead Battlefield??
If it had known, it wouldn’t have been in such a hurry to acknowledge this daughter. Who would have thought that the other party’s biological mother was still alive?
Moreover, it was the highest race of the Phoenix Race.
According to Shi Yu’s description, although that Undying Dark Phoenix claimed to be Chi Tong’s biological mother, it did look like there was a risk factor.
No one knew if its words were true.
Unlike the Ice Dragon, whose existence and identity were recognized by the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin in the heroic spirit ruins.
Ice Dragon’s gaze kept lingering on Chi Tong and Shi Yu. It wanted to say something but hesitated.
Helping Beast Tamers solve the mystery of their bloodlines was also the wish of all Mu Huiyin’s ice-type pets at that time.
1
Unexpectedly… only after two thousand years, after Mu Huiyin passed away, did a hint of a clue finally appear in the mystery.
However, the Ice Dragon Heart was very tired at the moment. It kept feeling that this matter was very troublesome.1
Damn it, why did Shi Yu suddenly say this?
“What’s the strength of that Undying Dark Phoenix?”
“Top-notch totem, right?”
Ice Dragon said, “I think it’s fine if we don’t want this biological mother. It’s too dangerous. Don’t care about it. Don’t go to that battlefield. Just do your own thing well.”
After all, Little Chi Tong wasn’t Mu Huiyin herself. Ice Dragon really didn’t want to interfere too much.
“Yes, that’s what we’ll do.”
The frost dragon quickly cleared its relationship. Its intuition told it that Mu Huiyin’s bloodline was definitely involved in many troubles and disputes. In short, it involved the Phoenix Race, which was even more chaotic than the dragon race. It didn’t want to look for trouble.
No matter what conspiracy was going on inside, it had nothing to do with it!
“Ah…” Seeing the frost dragon immediately turn away, Shi Yu was silent. This dragon was smart!
“It’s fine if the Undying Dark Phoenix is good, but what if it has other plans for it?” Shi Yu asked.
The frost dragon: “I just broke through to the totem level, how can I win!”
“It’s different. It’s been sealed for so long. It’s very weak. You have a time element. You’re very strong.”
“Even if you say so…”
“Mil!! (Mom!!)” Under Shi Yu’s comman4, Little Chi Tong directly shouted.
“Mother Dragon—!!” Shi Yu also shouted.1
The frost dragon was speechless.
Damn it!!
Looking at Shi Yu, who was looking at it with tears in its eyes and its master’s spirit that had been led astray by Shi Yu, the frost dragon was immediately stunned.
‘Why was its mouth so annoying? Why was it randomly calling it mom?!
“Mil!”
“Dragon…”
“Stop shouting. I know!” The frost dragon felt a headache.
It immediately regretted it. This was clearly a battle between two mothers. One of them would definitely die.
“But I’m warning you, I’m not your fighter. Unless you’re in danger, otherwise, I definitely won’t interfere in your business.”
The contract had been broken, so it had no reason to suffer with this bloodline anymore!
“I want to go to Dragon Palace City. I want to be the Dragon King. I want to have my own faction. I’m not a fighter!!” the frost dragon shouted.
“Sure, sure… That’s already very good for us, what you said. Dragon Palace City, right? I understand. I’ll lead the way for you when the time comes!!” Shi Yu’s expression was immediately filled with joy when he saw that Ice Dragon still recognized its Beast Tamer bloodline reincarnation.
Sigh!!!
He just didn’t know if the Undying Dark Phoenix was good or bad. He kept feeling that the Undying Dark Phoenix wasn’t very reliable. Otherwise, if Chi Tong had two totem mothers, how good would that be?
It meant that he had two totem relatives, after all.
He could be completely arrogant in Dong Huang then.
However, the outcome now was not bad. The frost dragon wanted to join Dragon Palace City, and it was also still staying in Dong Huang.
Moreover, that meant he had an even greater backer. It was equivalent to Chi Tong and Dragon Palace City becoming relatives.
In addition, if he introduced Ice Dragon’s mother to Dragon Palace City, Dragon Palace City would definitely cry and thank him for sending a totem to join. Perhaps they would even give the genius Dragon Palace City’s Dragon Lady to him to nurture. This way, everyone would be happy, everyone would be
satisfied, and they would be even closer.
“..” Shi Yu fell into his imagination.
Ice Dragon, Gem Cat, Eleven, and the other pets were silent.
“Meow.” The gem cat poked Shi Yu. How could he be distracted in such a cold place?
‘The gem cat ignored Shi Yu and finally looked at the frost dragon.
As for the frost dragon, when it saw the gem cat releasing a friendly signal at it, it couldn’t help but be stunned. It looked at this strange cat that seemed to be very strong.
“You, do you like gemstones?” The gem cat went straight to the point.
“Who doesn’t like that?” The frost dragon was stunned.
“Very good, then we’re good friends too!”
“Huh?”
Where did this little cat come from?
Then, the gem cat and the ice dragon started a protracted discussion about the gems, leaving Shi Yu and the others stunned.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and Chi Tong simply looked at the surrounding environment.
Baby Ginseng was in the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy and surprisingly discovered that this was also an extremely extreme environment. It could actually absorb the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy to condense a mutated fruit. It couldn’t help but secretly increase its strength, preparing to earn a sum.
“Take the time element, but not the ice element.”
Shi Yu’s suggestion made Baby Ginseng nod repeatedly. It understood.
But clearly, the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was still mainly ice-element power. It was very difficult for Baby Ginseng to condense a mutated fruit.
At the same time, Shi Yu sized up the gem cat and the frost dragon.
He first looked at the frost dragon.
This huge dragon that had fought with General Mu Huiyin in the past… was judged by the skill index to have a “medium” success rate for teaching super skills.
Then, he looked at the gem cat.
The gem cat surprisingly had the aptitude to learn the Imagination Domain. It was judged by the skill index that the success rate of teaching super skills was also “medium”.
Neither of these two pets had the “high” and “extremely high” evaluation that Shi Yu imagined.
After all, one of them was a thousand-year-old dragon that had participated in the totem battle and was already at the totem level, while the other was a hundred-year-old cat that had participated in the undead natural disaster. They were overlord-level creatures.
Even for them, their willpower and hearts couldn’t withstand the additional points of super skills 100%?
Logically speaking, even if it was the experiences of a life-and-death crisis, they should have experienced it several times.
To be precise, among all the pets Shi Yu had seen after breaking through to master, the success rate of super skills teaching had yet to exceed “medium”.
In fact, most of Lu Qingyi and Senior White Brook’s pets’ success rates for super skills displayed in the index were also “extremely low’ and “low’.
There were very few pets like Eleven whose teaching success rate was “low’.
This discovery made Shi Yu understand that it wasn’t his pet being unreliable, but that the skill index had especially strict requirements for the points added to super skills. It had extremely high requirements for the pet’s willpower and heart.
“Alright, is there anything else?”
After discussing a business with the gem cat, the frost dragon was happy.
It didn’t expect this cat to know so much.
It suspected that this cat was a dragon.
“Then let’s arrange a time to go to Dragon Palace City together? The Dragon Palace City banquet will be in a while. It’s a good time to visit,” Shi Yu said.
“No problem.” Ice Dragon beamed.
“I want to go too.” The gem cat was also eager to try.
“Go, you can go either way,” Shi Yu said. With a bodyguard taking the initiative to follow, it would be a waste not to. This way, even without the “Tyrannical Sea Legend”, Legend Ba Hai, leading the way, he would be very safe there.
“Alright, it’s settled then.” The Ice Dragon sighed. Next, it wanted to continue squeezing out the ice-element power that it had absorbed from the Ice River Totem to revive the gathered ice-clement power. When it was almost done absorbing it, it would directly get humans to throw a forbidden weapon to
completely change this environment and kill the Ice River Totem.
Reliable!
From today onwards, it would bid farewell to the snow mountain and start a new life from scratch in Dragon Palace City!
“But how long will it take?” Ice Dragon asked.
“Less than a month,” Shi Yu replied.
During this period of time, he had to hurry to the capital to help Baby Ginseng evolve.
“Well, then it’s about time.” Ice Dragon nodded.
They chatted again. A moment later, Ice Dragon sent Shi Yu and the others out.
After leaving, Shi Yu was amused.
Although the negotiation this time lowered the seniority level from grandma to mom, overall, he successfully associated himself with the Ice Dragon.
“Heh heh…” On the way back, Shi Yu was especially excited.
At this moment, he had entered the state of the Sword Spirit Possession again, releasing flames to fly in the snowstorm.
At the side, the gem cat was still on the flying carpet, squinting and yawning.
“Wait.” Soon, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the snowstorm area of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. Just as the gem cat was about to bring Shi Yu and the others to teleport, Shi Yu suddenly called for a stop.
“What?” The gem cat saw Shi Yu staring at Blizzard and sizing it up.
“Let’s see how the intensity of the snowstorm here is.” Shi Yu looked at the snowstorm in the sky. Previously, when he, Hall Master Lin, and the other masters came over, their group had to go down obediently and slowly cross this area. Even Senior Lu couldn’t resist the power of nature.
Eleven and the others were even smaller compared to the snow environment here.
Even totem-level creatures relied on the power of nature to strengthen themselves and attack the enemy. From this, one could tell how huge the potential of nature’s power was.
Shi Yu had thought about it. He wanted to nurture the pet’s will and heart, overcome life and death, overcome fear, overcome despair, overcome fatigue, overcome pain, establish a firm goal in his heart, and experience the baptism of time. They couldn’t do all of that at the same time, but the pet’s will and
heart was doable.
Perhaps he could train one or two qualities here.
“Let’s confirm the training venue. This place might be used to train the willpower of the ginseng baby.”
In an extremely cold environment, it was very suitable to consume all its physical strength to break through the limit. With a tired body, it could withstand the pain brought by the snow and wind to train himself.
Apart from Eleven, Shi Yu felt that the other three pets couldn’t withstand it.
Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, Buggy :”…”
The gem cat raised its eyebrows. “Can I report you for abusing pets? Isn’t this self-mutilating?”
Shi Yu said, “I’m doing it too.”
He couldn’t add points to super skills, and his heart itched. Now, if he could tolerate it for a while, they would all immediately reach the totem level.
“That’s not the problem!” The gem cat muttered and said, “What’s the use of training will or whatever? They’re all overlord races. In the future, if they practice their skills and use resources, they can break through to the overlord level when the conditions are right. You still want to give them willpower to
train an overlord’s will?”
“What’s the problem then?”
Shi Yu suddenly looked at the gem cat.
‘The gem cat was stunned. Seeing the anxious gazes from Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, it suddenly covered its mouth and realized that it had said something wrong.
“No, no.”
“Tell me the problem.”
“Ten… fruits! Let Baby Ginseng make it tonight.”
Baby Ginseng:??
“alright then.” The gem cat immediately spread its claws and smiled. “When ordinary overlord race creatures break through from the monarch level to the overlord level, they can easily break through the bottleneck by training their racial skills or using high-level resources to strengthen themselves.”
“But for low-level creatures, especially those creatures without super racial skills, and even some creatures with super racial skills, it’s very difficult for them to break through to the overlord level. It’s the same even if they have legendary-level resources to strengthen themselves. It’s very difficult. This is
the restriction of the race, and it can’t be changed.”
“However, there is always a way. As long as they constantly experience life and death to temper their strong willpower and hearts, there’s a chance to condense a very loyal ability, ‘Overlord Will’, to assist them in breaking through to the overlord level. Generally speaking, this is the best way for low-level
pets to reach the overlord level. Of course, it’s the most difficult way. For high-level pets, there’s no need to be so tired. They just have to lie flat and grow naturally.”
Shi Yu was stunned. “Is this overlord’s will powerful? Do you have it
The gem cat waved its paw and said, “Well… It’s not a matter of whether it’s powerful or not, but it’s very rare. However, even if low-level creatures have the will of an overlord and are restricted by their race, they definitely can’t defeat high-level creatures, even if they are mentally strong.”
“But under the same level and race, having the will of an overlord is indeed much more powerful. Because in various extreme environments, they can easily erupt with extremely unscientific power that exceeds their understanding, so this ability is very ideal.”
“Like in those anime, the beasts with this overlord will can “overcome their limits” and turn the fight. Occasionally, they will kill their opponents before they die, occasionally break through on the spot, and occasionally exceed their limit to fight above their level. Do you understand?”
“As for me, I don’t need this kind of thing. It wasn’t easy for me to mutate into an overlord race. Next, let resources and money corrode my heart.” The gem cat licked its claws.
“It’s too pointless to suffer when your race is high.”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong.
The four pets had a bad feeling.
“Oh no, I evolved your race too high too early.”
“But it’s not a big problem. Why don’t you also try to condense that overlord will?”
This way, the additional points for super skills should be fine, right?!
“Wu!!” Eleven rolled into its pocket and felt that there was no problem. It thought that it could challenge it.. It looked at its other three companions… Together!!

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - Change in the Ruins Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Change in the Ruins Space
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Ping Cheng.
Shi Yu returned to the small villa that he had not returned to for a while.
In fact, if possible, he felt that living in the ruins space was pretty good.
At this moment, the ruins space had long been built into a huge home by Shi Yu and the others.
Eleven’s Bean Bear Troops Training Ground, Baby Ginseng’s Fruit Research Institute, Buggy’s Equipment Research Institute… and Shi Yu’s residence far away from these places. There was everything here.
Apart from that, there was also the farming area, resource room, canteen, and Chi Tong’s favorite leisure area.
Living in the ruins space was fine, but it was easy to be isolated from the world and become a shut in. After all, unless he took the initiative to leave, it was very difficult to quickly contact the outside world.
Most importantly, there was no Internet.
After returning to the villa, Shi Yu found a place for the gem cat to stay and called Principal Feng.
“Oh, Shi Yu?” Principal Feng’s voice came from the other side.
“Principal Feng, we’ve already seen the Ice Dragon.”
Somewhere, Principal Feng, who was representing Ancient Capital University in discussing the cooperation with the Ping Cheng Association, raised his eyebrows. How fast?
‘Wu Ling’s Bai family wanted to ride the Iron-eating Beast’s rise, so Ancient Capital University naturally also wanted to take a ride.
If the Iron-eating Beast became popular in the future, Ancient Capital University would become the only institute that could distribute the Iron-eating Beasts to outstanding students and help the Iron-eating Beast Tamer plan the evolution method. Then, what would Imperial Capital and Demon Capital
University do?
The temptation of a pet cub with overlord potential was definitely greater than everything.
“How is it? How did Ice Dragon react when it saw General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit?” Principal Feng asked quickly.
“Not bad, they’re as close as mother and daughter,” Shi Yu said.
Principal Feng smiled and looked away. Alright, alright.
Although he knew that Ice Dragon and Mu Huiyin’s relationship wasn’t bad, he didn’t expect it to be so good!
It looked like General Mu Huiyin was also a binding Beast Tamer. She actually raised her pet as a daughter. Not bad, not bad.
The reason why Dong Huang became stronger and stronger in the future was not only because its development was getting better and better, but also because a group of predecessors had left behind pets who voluntarily protected Dong Huang.
Compared to humans, the lifespan of some pets was still very long. For example, plant life forms, elemental life forms, dragons, and undead. As long as they absorbed enough resources that could ensure their growth, they could live for a long time. If it really didn’t work, they could still choose to sleep
and become secret guardians.
Just the benefits brought by this point was enough for the association to strongly promote the bond between Beast Tamers and pets.
“Then what did the Ice Dragon say? What plans does it have for the future?” Principal Feng asked.
“Thanks to the threat of the Undying Dark Phoenix, the Ice Dragon is willing to stay near Dong Huang as the guardian of Little Chi Tong and protect it from growing up. After all, it’s also afraid that the Undying Dark Phoenix will hurt its daughter. It still looks like one will definitely be injured if the two
mothers fight…”
“Huh???” Principal Feng suddenly sensed that something was wrong.
Wait, wait?
Who was whose mother?
“Principal Feng, can I enter the first bureau?”
After being stunned, before he could react, the corners of his mouth twitched. “We’ll talk about it later. It’s inconvenient over the phone, why don’t you come over too, or we’ll find you later.”
If he really associated with the Ice Dragon, Shi Yu could only be considered a reserve member of the first bureau.
After all, it was impossible to say how close the two parties were at the moment.
It wasn’t that easy to become an official member of the first bureau. At least, he had to fight alongside the guardian once and solve the crisis of Dong Huang before he could officially enter the sect.
Only in this way could it be proven that the Beast Tamer and the guardian had a certain bond. It could be said that there were basically no Beast Tamers who relied on tricks or intimidation tactics to get a beast to fight for them in the first bureau. They were all Beast Tamers who had a good relationship
with the guardian to the point where they could request their help.
After informing Principal Feng, Shi Yu was busy with his own things. After dealing with Ice Dragon, there was nothing important left.
Oh, wait, he still had to find time to teach the metal-element nurturing method to Senior Panda and get her to help Eleven awaken its Panda King bloodline.
At that time, Shi Yu could see the effect of Eleven’s deterrence skill.
A transcendent deterrence could even wrap around external objects for a long time. Shi Yu wanted to know how powerful a deterrence at the Dao Proficiency level was.
“Ying, I’ll go to the ruins space to take a look first. Call me if there’s anything.”
Shi Yu abandoned the gem cat into the villa and prepared a room for it. After leaving enough gem fruits, Shi Yu set up a temporary spatial teleportation passage in the ruins and said.
“Huh??” The gem cat let out a lazy cry. It felt that Shi Yu was becoming more and more impolite. He actually didn’t even call it teacher.
To think that it had even taught Shi Yu knowledge about the overlord’s will. Oh, Shi Yu used resources to exchange for it. That was fine.
Acrunch sounded. The gem cat took another bite of the gem fruit and watched Tom and Jerry calmly on the sofa.
In the ruins space.
Shi Yu gathered the four pets and looked at them seriously.
“About the overlord’s will…”
“Gulp.” Apart from Eleven… Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong swallowed their saliva.
They were actually not afraid of injury and training. After all, they had instant recovery and healing methods.
However, the problem was that Shi Yu’s description was too terrifying.
It required one to be exhausted and not have the strength to use skills and drag one’s injuries to face a situation where life and death exceeded the limit. This… wasn’t this making things difficult for the pet?
If they were careless, they might really die.
“If possible, I actually don’t want to force you to train this either.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
These little guys, including Baby Ginseng, were still in the child stage.
As for the overlord will, it was a product condensed by low-level pets to exceed the limits of their race and break through the racial bottleneck. During the training between life and death, their will and mind were trained to the extreme.
‘There was indeed no need for them to suffer now. It was good to grow up happily.
From the fact that Shi Yu had never heard of the overlords will before, he could tell that this thing was very difficult to condense. It was basically not common.
But the problem was that it had to be trained. If not, there would be no super skills.
Shi Yu estimated that the success rate of pets with overlord willpower to absorb super skills would definitely be above “high”.
As for what this thing was, Shi Yu found a way to understand it.
For example, if they encountered a totem, and if Baby Ginseng didn’t have the overlor￠’s will, it would definitely be so scared that it would pee and obediently offer up its whiskers and nutrients to save its life.
However, if Baby Ginseng had the overlord will, although it might still die after being touched by the totem, even if it was already dead, it still couldn’t accept it. Even if it died, it couldn’t accept it. Before dying, it wanted to use its whiskers to slap the other party. Perhaps, with the help of the overlord will,
it could even break through on the spot and kill the other party.
Inacertain situation, it was a very important ability.
He looked at Eleven and the others and said, “According to Teacher Ying, although your race level is enough for you to successfully grow to the overlord level, what about the totem level and the Mythical level?”
“You don’t have a Mythical race, so you can’t rely on natural growth to break through to the Mythical stage. Don’t you want to become a unique Mythical creature?”
“The overlord’s will might not be much help for you to break through to the overlord level, but since it can allow low-level creatures to break through bottlenecks and reach a higher level, it might also be the greatest help for you to break through to the Mythical level in the future.”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong blinked.
It was too far, too far. The big pancake was too far away. They had yet to reach the monarch level. It didn’t feel realistic at all.
“Forget it, I’ll lay my cards on the table with you guys. There’s a problem with adding points. Although my physique is now enough to withstand the additional points of super skills, the side that receives the additional points, which is you guys, can’t absorb the experience of super skills without enough
willpower.”
“At best, your body will collapse, at worst, you will go berserk. It’s very dangerous. After all, the experience contained in super skills is not something low-level skills can compare to. It has already involved some rules.”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong’s expressions changed. No wonder Shi Yu had never added any super skills!
“So you guys understand, right? The premise of adding points for super skills is the overlord’s will. If you can’t train the overlord’s will, you basically won’t be able to enjoy additional points in the future. In another way, as long as you have the overlord’s will, you’re basically guaranteed to be at the totem
level. Oh, no, the half-god level, which is the level of Yun An and the king of totems.”
“This current hard work is for the future.”
Their expressions gradually became solemn.
“But you’re still young, so I won’t force you. If you’re interested, practice. If not, there’s no hurry. Take your time. After all, even if you all have the overlord’s will, I can’t add more points for all of you. There has to be a queue. Whoever can train the overlord’s will first will definitely have to add more
points…”
suddenly, they all felt a sense of danger.
“Before that, let me think… Should I directly go to the wild to contract a wild pet that has already formed and mastered the overlor￠’s will…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“Before you master the overlord’s will, I’ll give it some super skills…”
Great, this seemed to be a good idea?
He would directly contract a pet that had already undergone life and death training in nature and had a high success rate of adding points to super skills!
He just didn’t know if such a pet would follow humans. If it was disdainful towards adding points for free, that would be awkward.
“Wu wu wu!
At this moment, Eleven’s expression gradually became serious. It cried out, “No, no, no.”
It was definitely training its overlord will!
For the sake of increasing the points of super skills, charge!
Wasn’t it just tougher training? It wasn’t afraid!
“Wul!”
Buggy followed closely behind. The additional points of a super skill had the prerequisite was the overlord’s will? He should have said so earlier!
At most, it would experience the suffering during the Green Silkworm period again.
It would give it his all.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng was also envious. If it became the first pet in the team to learn the overlord’s will, it would be the first to enjoy adding points to super skills. Then, its advantage would be like a snowball effect, rolling bigger and bigger
“Mi.” Chi Tong looked around. Seeing that everyone was so moved, it also flapped its wings. Then… Then it would also work hard.
“Very good!!!”
After saying a bunch of things, none of that was as persuasive as saying that the overlord’s will was the premise for the additional points of super skills, Shi Yu was in tears. Ice Dragon had been corroded down by the comfortable environment, while the gem cat had been corroded down by money. Their
hearts had been corroded by the points.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. If their current efforts weren’t for the sake of making it easier in the future, it would be meaningless.
After Shi Yu finished painting the rewards for the pets, the four little guys were eager to try.
However, they were quickly at a loss, not knowing what to do.
The greatest problem now was actually still because they were too strong. As their points had been added very comprehensively, they had Absolute Sleep that could quickly recover their physical strength, high-speed healing that could quickly heal injuries. The strength of a powerful monarch could allow
them to face most of the danger. Apart from some special environments, the training environment in the ruins didn’t seem to be enough for them to train.
“There’s no hurry now.” Shi Yu looked at the four little guys standing on the spot, not knowing how to train. “In a few days, we’ll go to the time mystic realm at Imperial Capital University.”
“Theard that the environment there is harsh. Life forms with weak willpower, lack of concentration, and unstable hearts will not be able to withstand the baptism of time power. In other words, that place is a very good place to train your willpower and heart. When Baby Ginseng goes there to evolve ina
few days, you guys can find a way there first.”
“yil!” Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up. Evolution!
“Before that, compared to hoping to quickly train your overlord will, it’s better to spend time training super skills yourself first. Although super skills are harder to increase proficiency than low, mid, and high-level skills, with your foundation, proficiency should still be able to be reached quickly with
hard work,” Shi Yu touched his chin and analyzed.
Initial level to Expert level… Even if one didn’t directly add points, it wasn’t impossible.
“For example, Eleven, because you have lightning, electromagnetic levitation, and storage lightning trained to the extreme, your Lightning Rod skill is far more than just a regular entry level. It should be at the proficient level now.”
“Also, Buggy, your Imagination Domain and Dragon of Imagination are also almost proficient under the influence of phantom illusion.”
“Baby Ginseng, with your slow healing and high-speed healing proficiency increasing greatly, your proficiency level should have been driven away from the initial level.”
Super skills could increase the proficiency of low-level skills. In other words, low-level skills could definitely increase the proficiency of super skills. However, the range would definitely be much smaller, because super skills were harder to master the further one went, but without a doubt, it was still
effective!
Therefore, Shi Yu was also considering whether he should teach more low-level skills with high compatibility before they could be taught super skills so as to increase the level of super skills! Accumulation!
“In short, Eleven, you should mainly practice four super skills first. Your four super skills can be practiced at the same time. The efficiency won’t be low.”
“After you use bean soldier to summon 10 Bean Bears, you will first enchant the spatial abilities to the Bears and then use Thunder Rod to enchant them and yourself with the Thunder Rod to attract a thunderstorm. Then, you will let them use the Space Quake to resist the thunderstorm. If nothing goes
wrong, the thunderstorm will instantly destroy them. Of course, you will definitely be fine. The thunderstorm will be absorbed into your source of strength and used to train your Inner Power. This way, the four skills will be circulated…”
Eleven wanted to cry. Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong also wanted to cry.
‘What level of training method could this capitalist think of?
Bean, bean, bear…!
“Buggy, your training is also very simple. Practicing more of the “Finishing Touch: profundity is equivalent to training two super skills at the same time,” Shi Yu said. “If you have spare energy, you can use Psychic and Deterrence too.”
The ultimate profundity of the Finishing Touch was the strongest attack profundity of Buggy, which combined skills such as the Imagination Domain and the Dragon of Imagination.
If it wanted to use it, he had to first set up the Imagination Domain. This way, Buggy’s mental strength would undergo a qualitative change, and its strength would increase greatly. In this situation, using the Dragon of Imagination to obtain the dragon attribute and increase the dragon-element affinity
would greatly increase its physique. Then, it would fuse with the Illusory Phantom and the Imagination Domain and create the Divine Dragon Phantom in the Domain. Its main body could perfectly fuse the Divine Dragon Phantom to launch a fatal attack on the enemy.
This move could use Psychic power to accelerate the speed of the divine dragon and use Dragon Might to wrap around illusions. If it used the high-level dragon-element equipment in the spatial pocket, the power would be even higher, so high that even Eleven would find it difficult to withstand it.
Therefore, Buggy with equipment and Buggy without equipment were two completely different races.
“Wuu wu wu.” Buggy nodded.
“Baby Ginseng, you… source of life… You just have to treat yourself after hurting yourself.”
Baby Ginseng:??
“It means that it’s better to wait for evolution. There are too few super skills now.”
Ginseng Baby: QAQ
It was easy for Chi Tong. He just had to hand the Ice Dragon Blade to it for safekeeping. Chi Tong could use the ice power through the possession of the Ice Dragon Blade. At this moment, the Ice Dragon Phantom in the Ice Dragon Blade would use the frost power to cooperate with Chi Tong’s Sun Flame
and use the Interlocking Sword. This could also be considered to have trained the Sun Flame and the Interlocking Sword.
The use of the Interlocking Sword would cause damage to the body and was extremely draining. The Flame of Rebirth in the Spirit Release Phoenix Spirit state, the Flame of Recovery, solved these and could be considered training.
“Use the Ice Dragon Blade and the Heavenly Thunder Slash to practice in turns,” Shi Yu said to Chi Tong.
In fact, apart from the Ice Dragon Blade and the Battle Emperor Ruins, Shi Yu and the others had also forged other equipment in the past three months.
Among them, the Heavenly Thunder Slash was the second longsword created by Shi Yu and the others after the Ice Dragon Blade.
If the Ice Dragon Blade was an ice-element weapon, then the Heavenly Thunder Slash was naturally a thunder-element weapon.
It still used a forging method similar to the Ice Dragon Blade, but the core of the Ice Dragon Whiskers was changed to the hardening substance that Eleven gave the lightning-eating characteristic.
Inside the Heavenly Thunder Slash, Eleven’s phantom, created by Buggy, was sleeping, controlling the lightning switch.
In short, when Chi Tong possessed the Heavenly Thunder Slash, it could trigger the power of the Heavenly Thunder and cooperate with it to use the Thunder Flame Interlocking Sword to suppress it.
Unfortunately, Eleven’s Space Quake proficiency was too low, and its nature was not enough to last. It could not create spatial weapons, but the Ice Dragon Blade and Heavenly Thunder Slash were enough.
Relying on the metal element, the Ice Flame Interlocking Sword, and the Thunder Flame Interlocking Sword, the destructive power was already large enough. The interlocking attributes were also perfect. Just these two profundities were enough for Chi Tong to train in a short period of time.
“Go.”
After coaxing the four little guys away, Shi Yu stretched and thought for a moment before strolling in the ruins space.
He realized that there seemed to be no more resources here. All of them had been consumed in the ruins of Emperor Wu. He might need to replenish some.
Now, there were only the spiritual plants and spiritual fruits in the farm area ginseng baby had grown for the entire team.
There were high-level spiritual fruits that replenished nutrition for Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong, as well as delicious spiritual fruits that purely satisfied their appetite.
These could barely maintain daily consumption and output using the lush skill of the ginseng baby. However, apart from that, Shi Yu also planned to replenish some metal resources for Eleven, some water and earth resources for the ginseng baby, and soul crystals for Chi Tong. As for Buggy, well, it could
really just eat fruits. It wasn’t that Shi Yu couldn’t bear to buy other things.
After confirming the nutritional resources needed to be replenished, Shi Yu went to the equipment research institute.
Apart from forging the Heavenly Thunder Slash, there was actually much more equipment during this period.
For example, the spatial equipment “storage bag” created by the fusion of the worm silk and the full-level spatial pocket.
After Buggy’s spatial pocket reached the maximum level, it had the ability to temporarily open up an alternate space separate from its body. With this ability, Shi Yu and the others developed storage equipment.
Unfortunately, due to the restriction of Buggy’s strength, the storage bag’s ability could not be maintained for long. Shi Yu estimated that if he wanted to commercialize the storage bag, the shelf life of this equipment would have to be more than a year. Perhaps after Buggy’s monarch level, it would have
the ability to do it.
And when it reached the totem level, it might also have the ability to open up a mystic realm.
Apart from the Heavenly Thunder Slash, storage bag, and equipment research institute, there was actually a pile of messy things. These levels were relatively low, and the shelf life was not long. If Buggy’s research institute was a pile of perfume and sachets, then this place was a pile of talismans and jade
pendants wrapped in deterrence and containing illusions. They were all experimental toys for Eleven and Buggy.
If this was only a small experiment, then the Equipment Research Institute beside the equipment research institute was a big project.
There were the Awakening Mirror and the Tyrant Dragon fossil preserved here. Apart from that, although there were no mechanical parts, there was a pile of little Tyrant Dragon Phantoms running around in the backyard like chickens.
After Buggy’s dream stealing reached the maximum level, the effect of its ability was even stronger. Even the super skills mastered by the Tyrant Dragon in the Tyrant Dragon fossil dream could be replicated and given to the Tyrant Dragon Phantoms.
In other words, apart from not being a real life form, the Tyrant Dragon phantom it created now had time restrictions and no growth. The racial abilities and skills it had mastered were already no different from that of the Tyrant Dragon.
Now, surrounding these illusions, Shi Yu and the others were studying how to revive these illusions in the true sense of the word. For example, they had tried using the Awakening Mirror directly, or using Baby Ginseng’s Life Nutrition Fruit. Unfortunately, they couldn’t. Therefore, in the end, it looked like
they had to return to the Mechanic class.
The greatest disadvantage of phantom illusions was that they needed energy to maintain and had no growth rate. If they could rely on the mechanical shell to maintain it, they could solve the problem of survival. If they could integrate into mechanical lives, the problem of growth would also be solved.
The ancient mechanical lives that had mastered ancient skills could be born because of this!
In the ruins of Emperor Wu, Shi Yu was restricted by the materials and couldn’t carry out subsequent research. However, after coming out this time, Shi Yu planned to let this work go on track.
Firstly, it was to buy a batch of basic mechanical materials!
He still wanted to enter the fourth bureau with the research of the ancient mechanical lives
After walking around the ruins space again, Shi Yu realized that he still had a lot of missions. However, at the moment, the most important thing was definitely still the evolution of the ginseng baby. Shi Yu stepped into the resource room to take a look.
The Moonlight Gem sent by the gem cat, the soil of the time prize of the Feeding Conference, the 13 Death Mutation Fruits condensed by Baby Ginseng itself, and the time mutation fruit that it had gotten for free from the Ice Dragon Ruins were almost all the materials Baby Ginseng had prepared for
evolution.
“Life and death, sun, moon, and time are all high-level things. It’s probably the foundation of a middle-level overlord race…” Shi Yu was filled with anticipation..

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - Returning to the Imperial Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 257 Returning to the Imperial Capital
After spending half a day arranging the materials list, Shi Yu glanced at the pets who were training according to his plans and left the ruins space happily.
Outside, after an unknown period of time, the gem cat had already changed the television program from Tom and Jerry to Digimon.
The cat lay on the soft sofa, eating delicious fruits and watching the television leisurely…
It was the life Shi Yu yearned for.
After solving the mystery of the disappearance of the myth and his transmigration and contracting a divine beast to watch over the family, he had to return to this beautiful life.
“Why are you out again?” The gem cat took another bite of the gem fruit. It was living purely for food.
“Internet connection.”
“Well, I plan to go to Imperial Capital University in two days to help Baby Ginseng evolve in the Time Mystic Realm. Do you want to go?”
“Ha -” The gem cat yawned and said with sleepy eyes, “Go? In my opinion…”
“Let’s take advantage of this evolution to directly let it break through to the monarch level. Stop suppressing it…”
The gem cat had a premonition that after Baby Ginseng evolved and broke through, the gem fruits it created would definitely be more delicious.
However, it was ridiculous for Shi Yu to keep letting the four pets hold their levels down together. The other Beast Tamers who couldn’t nurture monarchs would cry when they saw this.
Was he trying to train that overlord willpower??
The gem cat couldn’t imagine a ginseng baby with an overlord’s will. However, after thinking about it carefully, it felt pretty good that a pet with an overlord’s will had to be its chef?
“No, it’s still early.” Shi Yu rejected.
In any case, the four pets could break through at any time. What was the hurry? After they broke through to the monarch level, each of them would have millions of energy points. At that time, the training cost would be immeasurable.
At least, Shi Yu didn’t think that they could still train freely in the ruins space after breaking through to the monarch level. Although the ruins space gifted by Bureau 11 was not low-level, it definitely couldn’t withstand the four powerful monarchs training crazily inside. They would definitely make a mess inside.
At least they could train inside now that his level was low. When he broke through, there would really be no training venues in school or city.
LILY.
Why were there basically no master-level students in the school? Why didn’t master-level students continue to study higher?
It was because the school’s training facilities were no longer enough to support the effective training of masters and monarchs.
If masters and monarchs wanted to enter a level higher, they could only go to various places in the wild to train, such as the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and the Undead Battlefield.
Then, Shi Yu lay on his big bed and started to shop online.
He directly ordered an expensive thing and placed the address in the Beast Tamer Association, in case he wasn’t at home. It was impossible for him to buy it himself. He could only buy it online.
After completing all of this, Shi Yu’s phone rang. It was from Senior Panda. Shi Yu directly picked up.
“We plan to have dinner with Principal Feng, Legend Bai, and the others. You should come over too.”
“Alright, where’s the address?” After chatting with Senior Panda for a while, Shi Yu realized that it was getting late. He couldn’t help but stretch lazily.
After chatting with Senior Panda for a while, Shi Yu realized that it was getting late. He couldn’t help but stretch lazily.
At this time, a strong alliance was indeed a good choice. The Iron-eating Beast Feeding Base in Ping Cheng provided the Iron-eating Beast cubs, Emperor Wu Ruins in Wu Ling City provided the training venue, and Ancient Capital University… provided high-quality buyers. As a scientific research organization, they studied the evolution, skills, and system cultivation methods of the Iron-eating Beasts. At the same time, they connected the officials and planned to kill Yun An. “Where’s Buggy? Stop training and C… Oh, wait, Teacher Ying, please teleport me.”
Ying: “?”
“Let’s go eat,” Shi Yu said. The gem cat got up. This was more like it.
In the high-end restaurant specially used by the Ping Cheng Association to receive guests, Shi Yu was the last to arrive.
When he arrived, Master Lin and President Feng were chatting with Principal Feng, Legend Bai, and the other big shots with a smile.
As for Lin Xiuzhu, Lu Qingyi, and White Brook, the three of them were chatting happily on the other side. When he saw this scene, Shi Yu immediately fell silent. This was because he realized that Senior Lu and Senior Bai were also wearing the same panda coat as Lin Xiuzhu and also similar panda accessories. Shi Yu :”…”
“You’re here.” Principal Feng immediately smiled when he saw Shi Yu and the gem cat teleport over.
“Yeah!” After Shi Yu nodded, he still looked at the three seniors, wanting to know what was going on. “How is it? The souvenir Senior Lin gave us when we were shopping at the breeding base isn’t bad, right?” White Brook asked.
Lin Xiuzhu smiled and nodded.
Shi Yu: “Not bad…”
“Eh, is this a gem cat? Shi Yu, when did you contract a gem cat?” At the same time, Elder Feng of Ping Cheng looked at the gem cat around Shi Yu in surprise and said, “This cat is really handsome…”
“Uhh.” Shi Yu raised his brows. Old Feng… This president didn’t know what he was doing… “Let me introduce you. This is the guardian overlord of our Ancient Capital University. He’s the gem cat screen teacher who saved many teachers and students from Ancient Capital University in the undead disaster a hundred years ago.” Principal Feng immediately introduced with a smile.
After being introduced, the gem cat looked at President Feng. President Feng was immediately stunned, and his eyes nearly popped out. He kept cursing in his heart. This gem cat was an overlord-level creature??
It was the same level as the ice dragon on the snow mountain before it broke through??
After all, there wasn’t a single overlord-level creature in the entire Icefield City who could befriend humans. The ones they were friends with were usually somewhere around legend…
“Sorry!!” President Feng immediately bowed crazily to the Gem Cat. Seeing this, Hall Master Lin, who was beside him, laughed. This president wasn’t good enough. His eye power was weak.
Unlike him, who had long known that such a powerful creature was hidden in Ancient Capital University through his daughter who studied at Ancient Capital University.
“Sigh -” The gem cat continued to yawn and said, “When is dinner?”
“Almost,” President Feng immediately said and treated this lady like an ancestor.
Soon, everyone sat down and waited for dinner. They also communicated about the cooperation. Although everyone had almost finished discussing, they definitely had to seek the opinion of Shi Yu, the Iron-eating Beast spokesperson.
“We plan to establish an iron-eating beast army experimentally and train each other.”
“Uh.”
Shi Yu listened and said, “You want to build an Iron-eating Beast Army?”
Legend Bai smiled and said, “Yeah, let’s recruit 100 Iron-eating Beasts with outstanding aptitude first. We’ll learn from Emperor Wu and create an invincible Iron-eating Beast Army.”
“We plan to let Hall Master Lin be the commander and White Brook as the deputy commander. Student Lin will be the feeder. Among them, the Soldier Fusion Talent and the Metal-element Strengthening Talent will number about four to five. Then, they will be supplemented with some Beast Tamers with special talent to join the army and be nurtured with the resources of the special elite troops in the Beast Tamer Troops.”
“As for the members, they must mobilize the elites from the Beast Tamer Troops. How is it? Is it worth it?”
“Huh? Hall Master Lin is the commander?” Shi Yu immediately felt that it was unreliable.
He looked at Hall Master Lin. Although Hall Master Lin had a monarch race, the Nine Li Battle Beast, Hall Master Lin was already old…
If something happened… he would twist his waist or something. Hall Master Lin: “?” “What, what? I feel that I can still fight for 20 years.” Hall Master Lin was overjoyed.
Shi Yu, this kid, looked like he thought he was getting old. Perhaps he didn’t know what it meant to be old but strong!
Initially, he didn’t have much hot-bloodedness, but the Iron-eating Beast’s quasi Mythical Race Evolution Plan, the invincible Iron-eating Beast Army, this pile of temptations really made him unable to stay idle in little Ping Cheng anymore. Although he didn’t have much potential anymore, he had experience. It was still feasible to bring new recruits and an Iron-eating Beast Corps that resounded through Dong Huang.
“Sigh.” Looking at the high-spirited Master Lin, White Brook shook her head secretly. It was too difficult for her.
What she was more worried about was whether her family would delay her from going to archeology with Senior Lu after arranging this mission for her.
“But I’m just a deputy commander, right? Can I go archeology with Senior Lu occasionally?” White Brook asked. “In any case, it’s for the Iron-eating Beast Corps…”
“No!!” Legend Bai’s eyes widened. “Don’t you know your own abilities?”
“Ugh -“White Brook revealed a disdainful expression.
Shi Yu looked at Senior Lu.
“As for me, I’m suddenly a little interested in the totem era when Yun An first woke up. Next, I plan to investigate the information of the creator of the iron-eating beast ruins,” Lu Qingyi smiled and said to Shi Yu.
Yun An descended ten thousand years ago and wreaked havoc in the east five thousand years ago. The ruins of the Iron-eating Beast in the ancient capital were established about 4,500 years ago after Yun An was first destroyed.
It could be said that the Nine Inscription Evolution Method, the method that relied on eating fragments of Yun An, was not developed by the generation of Emperor Wu. Emperor Wu and the others only inherited the research results of their predecessors.
For people who had really researched the first and second stages of the Iron-eating Beast’s evolution, in the totem era, this was clearly another extremely secretive break in history. Next, Lu Qingyi planned to investigate deeper
“This is good.” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. He felt that everyone could form a team. He was also interested!
“Apart from that, those few rare metals are also very scarce at the moment. They all belong to resources that have been plucked since ancient times. If you want to obtain some, you probably can only work from ancient ruins and ancient mystic realms,” Lu Qingyi added.
“Meow ~” At the side, the gem cat ate silently. It understood that tomb robbing wasn’t its cup of tea.
“There’s no hurry.” Shi Yu nodded. He didn’t know when the association would be able to send the other four rare metals and let Eleven add new super skills. He would probably have to wait.
“But doesn’t Senior Lin still have to take care of the farm? Can you spare some energy?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yeah.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled.
“So I’m a little worried that I can’t take on this big responsibility…”
Compared to White Brook and Lu Qingyi, she seemed to… not have much talent.
“Haha, don’t be afraid.” Principal Feng smiled and looked at this outstanding graduate from Ancient Capital University who was about Lu Qingyi’s age. “It’s just a reserve army in the short term.”
This army was purely established to welcome the large number of meteorite fragments that might be obtained in the future. If they couldn’t obtain the meteorite fragments, they couldn’t be considered an important army. Even the evolution materials of the Nine Li Battle Beast weren’t worth investing in.
However, if he could obtain a large number of meteorite fragments, then the entire process of the first and second evolution would have to be arranged for this army. In the end, this time period was to give White Brook and Lin Xiuzhu gain experience.
With this, it was hard to say if they would become a legend.. But they would definitely become a top-notch master in the future.
“Then I’ll teach Hall Master Lin and Senior Lin the metal-element nurturing method Senior Chong Xuan gave me as soon as possible,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll also see if I can find more Iron-eating Beast Kings.”
“Oh right, let’s help Eleven awaken his royal bloodline first.”
Shi Yu had naturally told everyone about what Zhong Xuan had said back then. The Iron-eating Beast King’s words had refreshed everyone’s understanding of the Iron-eating Beast… No wonder Shi Yu’s Eleven was so abnormal. It turned out that it had a royal bloodline.
“When are you teaching?” the panda senior asked eagerly.
She also wanted to help Eleven awaken its royal bloodline quickly to see the changes after Eleven.
Senior Panda hoped to learn this skill well and help more. “Tonight…” Shi Yu suddenly felt that something was wrong.” I definitely can’t tonight. It’s too late. Tomorrow.”
“By the way…”
“I didn’t say it on the phone previously. It’s Ice Dragon. It seems to have the intention to join Dragon Palace City.” Shi Yu looked at Principal Feng. As Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was stunned. The topic quickly changed from the Iron-eating Beast to the Ice Dragon Totem. Everyone was a little caught off guard, and this news…
“The Ice Dragon Totem is going to rely on Dragon Palace City??” Principal Feng was slightly shocked.
Shi Yu had previously said on the phone that Ice Dragon was willing to stay “nearby” in Dong Huang. It was really nearby.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “This shouldn’t be a problem, right? I promised Ice Dragon to go with it in a few days. Isn’t Dragon Palace City coincidentally holding a Dragon Palace banquet?” “Well…” Principal Feng fell into deep thought. “Yeah…” “I see. If it’s willing to stay in Dong Huang, indeed, that place is one of the few places that attract it,” Principal Feng said with a nod.
“This way, Dragon Palace City will have a new totem.” Lu Qingyi sighed slightly beside him.
“As expected of the greatest totem power in the Eastern Sea Region. Its attraction to the dragons is indeed very fatal.” Legend Bai also sighed.
“That’s not a problem. Our Dong Huang definitely can’t produce resources that can attract Ice Dragon better than the Dragon God Ruins in Dragon Palace City,” Principal Feng said. “As long as they’re allies.”
The Dragon God Ruins was a Mythical trial ruin. Legend had it that the Dragon Palace City was a faction left behind by a Mythical divine dragon, and this ruin was established to choose the Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God.
There were endless treasures and opportunities there.
For millions of years, although every dragon-type creature that could obtain recognition in the Dragon God Ruins couldn’t become mythical, they undoubtedly became the totem king of the demigod level and led Dragon Palace City.
The most beloved thing was that Dragon Palace City had a rule. Any totem dragon who sincerely joined Dragon Palace City could enter the Dragon God Ruins and obtain a large number of treasures. Although some of them would belong to Dragon Palace City, the remaining portion would belong to the dragon. There might even be Mythical resources.
With this, Dragon Palace City attracted countless dragon-type creatures to join.
Currently, Dragon Palace City had a demigod-level totem king. Under the totem king were seven dragon-element totems. If the new ice dragon was included, there were a total of nine totems.
Generally speaking, any creature that could break through to the totem level was extremely arrogant. With their strength, they could completely build their own divine kingdom and collect faith. It was still very rare for multiple totems to gather in one faction.
For example, the eleven totem districts that surrounded the Dong Huang Ancient Country, the Heavenly Fox Nation, and the Divine Tree Nation, only had one totem commanding everything. It was completely different from a super faction like Dragon Palace City, where there was a totem king commanding many totems.
“Wait!!!”
“Didn’t you say that Ice Dragon would follow you to Dragon Palace City?” Principal Feng was suddenly stunned.
“Yeah.”
“…This.” Suddenly, Principal Feng’s expression became more and more expectant.
“Good lord, things are getting interesting.” “If the Ice Dragon wants to join Dragon Palace City and you travel with it, the invisible benefits will probably be huge.”
The Dragon Palace Banquet was a huge event held once every five years by the royal family of Dragon Palace City. It would invite all the factions under the commander of Dragon Palace City and humans to participate.
Among them, the human delegation was basically aiming to obtain the recognition of high-level pets. However, after so many years of cooperation, the transcendent creatures of Dragon Palace City were not stupid. They would choose the best humans to entrust their descendants to.
At that time, Shi Yu would definitely not be the only human young talent to visit Dragon Palace City. There would be a bunch of them accompanying Shi Yu.
These people were considered competitors.
In short, if one wanted to obtain an overlord cub, they had to showcase their abilities.
When others tried their best to display their talent, strength, and potential in order to obtain the recognition of the various overlord factions in Dragon Palace City and send a banquet congratulatory gift to show their financial resources and sincerity… Shi Yu would just directly call the Ice Dragon Totem out and call it Mom. He would also be the one who sent Dragon Mom into Dragon Palace City. Wasn’t this greater than talent, potential, and sincerity?
When out in the world, nothing was better than having a good background…
Ice Dragon Totem, plus the Sea Dragon King’s friendship token…
Generally speaking, there was only one totem presiding over the Dragon Palace banquet every year. However, this time, the addition of a new totem would probably attract a bunch of totems and even the Dragon God, increasing the atmosphere of this Dragon Palace banquet to the highest. At that time, as long as Shi Yu and the Ice Dragon were a little closer and exchanged a few words with the Sea Dragon King, Shi Yu could choose any of the overlord heirs.
Perhaps, in order to befriend the Ice Dragon Totem, it was even possible for him to have a totem’s child!
After all, the resources in the Dragon God Ruins were endless, and the dragon-element totem was the only existence that could continuously take out resources from the Dragon God Ruins. As a huge mutual benefit, it was very normal to maintain friendships and exchange resources. The addition of the dragon-element totem would not only not reduce the resources in the Dragon Palace City, but it would also increase. This was the reason why the Dragon Palace City had never declined and had many totems.
“Looks like the new overlord race is guaranteed, and it’s the kind you can choose casually,” Principal Feng thought.
As expected, no matter what talent one had, having powerful backers was always better.
“I think so too,” Shi Yu thought.
The Ice Dragon would join Dragon Palace City. Chi Tong and the Ice Dragon was as close as a mother and daughter, and Chi Tong and Shi Yu was as close as a father and daughter. In other words, it was also a member of Dragon Palace City. This way, Dragon Palace City couldn’t treat it badly, right?!
Principal Feng and Shi Yu. One of them was already in the first bureau, while the other was trying to get into the first bureau. The surrounding people were silent as they watched these two talk about getting backers…
Did they go off topic? Didn’t they agree to discuss the Iron-eating Beast?
Two days later, in the capital.
After Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng for a short period of time, he used some time to teach the Metal-element Cultivation Method to Senior Panda. She also tried to help Eleven massage. However, just as Chong Xuan said, it definitely wouldn’t be effective in the short term, and took time.
Apart from that, Ice Dragon was still plundering the power of the Ice River Totem at the end. After Shi Yu realized that there was nothing to do, he decisively left Ping Cheng and came to the capital again.
Imperial Capital University, Prophecy Temple.
There was another sign outside saying, “Today’s an off-day. Don’t be noisy, or bear the consequences.”
The Prediction Owl was gone…
After Shi Yu arrived, he looked at the cold surroundings and was a little silent. Fortunately, the gem cat that came with him seemed to be as familiar with the place as President Ye Hui.
Boom!!!
The gem cat directly rushed over with Psychic power and blew up the Prediction Owl that was sleeping in the temple!
“Ah! Which bastard? Eh, so it’s you, bad cat.”
After the owl flew out, it looked at Shi Yu and the gem cat in a daze. It didn’t understand why the pair had suddenly come to visit it.
“Lord owl, good afternoon. Didn’t you say last time that you were going to enter the Time Ruins to help Baby Ginseng mutate and evolve with the power of time…”
“We’re here this time.” Shi Yu chuckled and pointed at the baby ginseng in his pocket.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng was extremely excited. “Wu…” The owl pondered. It was for real.
This unreliable evolution method was indeed thought up by someone as unreliable as Shi Yu.
“Long time no see!! You tricked me last time. Help me predict for free this time. It’s not too much to predict what that guy can evolve into.” The gem cat wanted a spoiler in advance. It stared at the Prediction Owl.
When the owl saw this situation, it had a bitter expression. Why did they all want to freeload?
“Forget it, forget it. Let’s do it for free. However, you have to inform Little Yezi if you enter the Time Ruins…”
With that said, it began to enter a prediction state and made an evolution prophecy for Baby Ginseng. A moment later, in the white mist, the Prediction Owl saw a figure similar to Baby Ginseng
Then, it opened its eyes in silence and looked at the expectant Baby Ginseng.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng had actually already acknowledged the owl. Through the Undying Dark Phoenix and Yun An, it felt that the owl’s prophecy was 80% correct even if it wasn’t 100% correct. This fellow might be able to predict what it would evolve into!
However…
