“Unfortunately, you seem to have failed in your mutation?? Your appearance hasn’t changed much…” the owl said regretfully. It knew that Shi Yu coming here was unreliable… Baby Ginseng:?? “Yi!!!?” The towering emperor was furious. Did this owl make a good prophecy!? Why did it have to be this time? It wasn’t related to the totem!

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - Baby Ginseng’s Invincible Evolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 258 Baby Ginseng’s Invincible Evolution
When Shi Yu arrived at Imperial Capital University, the old principal of Imperial Capital University and the vice-chancellor, Ye Hui, received the news immediately.
Because Shi Yu was brought on by the president of the Feeding Association, Ye Hui, the mission of watching Shi Yu enter the Time Mystic Realm naturally fell on his head. When Ye Hui arrived at the Prophecy Temple, he saw Shi Yu, the owl, and the others arguing about something
“The prophecy is reversed, you guys, this means it’ll succeed,” a certain cat said in all seriousness.
If the prophecy failed, it must have evolved successfully.
“Nonsense!!”
The prophecy was only about something happening today. The target of the prophecy wasn’t very strong either. The owl didn’t believe that the prophecy could be wrong this time. This time, it was clearly much more reliable than the previous totem-related predictions. < Introduction > It can condense a time mark and record its own state. It can reverse time, reverse life and death, recover injuries, or revive itself after being injured and dying. Shi Yu: “????”
Holy shit.
Shi Yu widened his eyes. Baby Ginseng had only awakened three skills during this evolution. Among them, there were only two super skills. However, as the last super skill awakened, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng instantly fell silent. What kind of awesome skill was this???
He just said that self-destruction was a forbidden skill, but now… even the revival skill was available??
Although Baby Ginseng sensed that the condensation and use of the time mark was very limited,… At this moment, Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong’s figures were immediately reflected in Baby Ginseng’s hexagram eyes. It felt that first place wasn’t that far off. At this moment, he silently analyzed Baby Ginseng’s current situation. Shi Yu felt that among the names, perhaps the one that matched its current state the most was that… [Race Name]: Undying Ginseng
[Race Attributes]: Wood, Time
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical) [Level of Growth]: Commander Level [Race Skill]:
Low-level: Sweet Aura (Dao Proficiency), Slow Healing (Dao Proficiency) Intermediate: Earth Chain (Dao Proficiency), Nutrition (Dao Proficiency) Advanced: Time Fruit (Initiate) Super level: Source of Life (Proficient), Time Mark (Initiate), Moon Explosion (Initiate) (Taught Skill] Low-level: Multiplication (Transcendent) Intermediate: High Speed Healing (transcendent), Strengthening (transcendent), Energy Storage Beam (transcendent), Super Sight (transcendent)
Advanced: Absolute Sleep (transcendent), Multiplication (transcendent), Energy Fruit (transcendent), Mutant (transcendent), Deterrence (transcendent) [Energy Points]: 220061 This time, not only did Baby Ginseng have the strongest time element, but its energy advantage also erupted perfectly! Although there weren’t many super skills and judging from the number of skills alone, it was only middle-level overlord race. Together with attributes, energy, and other qualities, the race was definitely above high-level overlords! “Undying Ginseng… Undying Ginseng Baby, revival skill… I didn’t expect… It’s the combination of the power of death and the power of time?” Shi Yu immediately shared the state of Baby Ginseng to Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong.
A moment later, the three pets were stunned.
After seeing Baby Ginseng’s terrifying energy value, the three pets were shocked. Especially after seeing the Undying Seal, Eleven, Buggy, and the others widened their eyes suddenly. “Wu!!!” “Wu!!!”
Eleven and Buggy danced around. What a joke. This, what kind of skill was this! Was this guy simply too frustrated from not being the strongest? It could even reverse death?? “Yi ~” Seeing that Eleven and Buggy were so excited, Baby Ginseng put its hands behind its back with a calm expression. Well, it wasn’t that strong or anything. Although it could achieve the combination skill of self-destruction and revival, the restrictions were still pretty big. For example… Before Baby Ginseng could finish showing off, suddenly, a suction force came from the white vortex in the sky. Shi Yu and the others were immediately stunned. What was going on! They had only stayed in the Time Mystic Realm for a day.
In the outside world, as the commotion became smaller, the owl gradually recovered its connection to the Time Mystic Realm. After that, it had no choice but to quickly pull Shi Yu and the others out of the mystic realm, afraid that something bad would happen again, such as the time ruin being blown up.
Then, under the gaze of countless people, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong appeared in the white ruins with a white light.
At this moment, as Shi Yu came out of the Time Mystic Realm, time seemed to have stopped. Many Imperial Capital University students stared at Shi Yu in silence. The expressions of the students from the Imperial Capital University who had been beaten up by Shi Yu, especially Yin Zhengfan, froze almost instantly. Wait a minute, why, why was it Shi Yu?? At that moment, Shi Yu suddenly realized that something was wrong. He also looked silently at the crazy-looking owl, the gem cat that had a helpless expression, and the thousands of teachers, students, and pets surrounding him… After that, his heart skipped a beat. What… happened?
Why, they were all here. Didn’t they have school??
“You guys… came to see my ginseng baby evolve?”

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - Time-type Undying Ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 259 Time-type Undying Ginseng
In the Time Forest, outside the Time Ruins.
After Shi Yu was pulled out by the owl, hundreds of teachers, students, and pets looked at Shi Yu in silence. They mainly looked at the ginseng baby beside its pants. [If I tell you, a ginseng baby inside is evolving, would you believe me?]
[Are you guys here to see my baby ginseng evolve?]
Everyone looked at the fragrance phenomenon of the ginseng baby that condensed in the sky and the ginseng baby that was teleported out by the owl. The words of the owl and Shi Yu echoed in their ears.
So… everything just now was really caused by the evolution of a ginseng baby?
What a joke!
How could Baby Ginseng’s evolution be so big!!!
To directly turn all the pets in the school into hungry dogs, what level of supplement was that!
However, that wasn’t the most important thing. Most importantly, this ginseng baby seemed to be Shi Yu’s?
In the crowd, Yin Zhengfan widened his eyes and recognized this exaggerated ginseng baby. Wasn’t this the battle ginseng that insta-killed its Zonyan Rock Beast!
Why were Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng in the Time Ruins of Imperial Capital University??
After all, he originally wanted to apply to enter the Time Ruins to surpass Shi Yu. He was the one who first…
“Wait, isn’t that still a ginseng baby? Has it evolved?”
“Look at its eyes, its eyes have become completely different from other ginseng babies. The time hexagram pattern on Lord Owl’s body also appeared in its pupils… What is this.”
“Even if Baby Ginseng evolves, shouldn’t it be a ginseng fruit tree?”
In an instant, everyone started discussing.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng had already restrained most of its strength. But even so, the enchanting aura of a supplement with quasi Mythical potential still couldn’t be restrained. Many pets still looked at it in a daze, wishing they could lick it a few times. If it weren’t for the overlord owl blocking in front, they wouldn’t have been able to control themselves.
“Yi! (Don’t be perverted)” Baby Ginseng frowned.
“Wuu!!!” After Baby Ginseng finished speaking, the Prediction Owl circling in the sky spoke.
It shouted crazily, “Unrelated people, leave my territory immediately. Now that you’ve seriously violated the school rules, I’ll give you five minutes. Leave quickly!!”
At this moment, the Prediction Owl naturally discovered the astonishing change in Baby Ginseng’s body. However, the current scene was really not easy to investigate. It planned to blast away this batch of spectators first.
Although the owl’s battle power was not high among overlord-level creatures, its seniority in Imperial Capital University was still ridiculously high. After all, it was a pet left behind by the first principal.
“…” Many teachers, students, and pets were incomparably silent. At this moment, in the crowd, the old principal of the Imperial Capital University also took a deep breath and said after the owl, “Everyone, leave.”
“Don’t gather here. Go do whatever you need to do.”
“You guys should leave first. I’ll explain later.” She looked at the three guardian overlords of Imperial Capital University who had been attracted by the commotion.
“Roar!!”
Among the hundred beasts, there was a huge green-winged giant tiger, an elemental life form that looked like a stone giant, and an ancient tree with a thousand hands. When they heard this, they took a look at Baby Ginseng and turned to leave.
As the old principal of the Imperial Capital University spoke, no matter how reluctant they were to leave the scene, these teachers, students, and pets could only reluctantly turn and leave.
However, many students, especially the students from the battle club, looked at Shi Yu and the others deeply with complicated gazes when they turned around to leave.
“I keep feeling that he’s stronger again…”
“That ginseng baby seems to have become even more ridiculous…”
“Damn it, what exactly is going on?”
One person left, then two people, followed by a group. A moment later, this ruin was sealed, and only a few people were left at the scene.
What was left was the old principal of Imperial Capital University, President Ye, the Prediction Owl, the Gem Cat Screen, and Shi Yu and the others.
At this moment, looking at the old principal of the Imperial Capital University, the worried President Ye, the depressed owl, and the gem cat that was watching the commotion with anticipation, Shi Yu felt a headache.
He quickly glanced at the phenomenon in the sky again and took a deep breath. “An accident, purely an accident.” “Like hell I believe you!!!” The owl shouted. At this moment, it had already sensed the situation inside the Time Ruins.
It shouted, “The time power inside is much less all of a sudden. I wonder how long it will take to recover!! What exactly have you guys done to the mystic realm? If it’s just that ordinary evolution and training can’t be rejected by the mystic realm!!” President Ye hurriedly smiled and said, “It’s already much better than what I imagined at the start. At least the ruins didn’t explode, right? In any case, no one uses it usually. Let it slowly recover first. The key problem now is…”
He looked at Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng and said, “You guys… evolved successfully??”
The owl was also stunned. It looked at Baby Ginseng. You guys… evolved successfully?
Could it really evolve successfully with such a strange collection of evolution ingredients?
The Time Ruins really had evolution effects???
“It has exceeded 200,000 energy. The power of time lingering outside its body is suppressing the power to break through…” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University still looked at Baby Ginseng in silence, her gaze scrutinizing Shi Yu.
The old lady also didn’t understand what had happened to this ginseng baby. She didn’t understand what Shi Yu and the others had done.
“Yes, I barely succeeded,” Shi Yu said in embarrassment. “A new mutated race, Undying Ginseng, wood, and time. Its racial level is estimated to be above a high-level overlord…”
Everyone: “?”
“Otherwise… Otherwise, there wouldn’t be such a big commotion, right?” As Shi Yu finished speaking, the voices of the old principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University were extremely hoarse. The monarch species owl beside them widened its eyes. As for the gem cat, it was shocked and delighted
Holy shit, above high-level overlord?
What a joke!
Moreover, it really mutated into a time element type??
“Damn, can that material really succeed? Who are you kidding?” The owl shouted in shock.
The time element of a high-level overlord race, who was he kidding!
Even its master didn’t contract a time-type pet of this race. It wasn’t even an overlord race. It was the most impressive thing!
In the end, the time ruin left behind created a high-level time overlord race? It didn’t believe it!!
Apart from Emperor Shi, the Prediction Owl didn’t believe that anyone could nurture such a pet!
“The materials might not be the main thing. It’s mainly because my Baby Ginseng’s talent is unique… It has a mutated physique.” Shi Yu smiled shyly.
To be able to mutate successfully, the mutation environment was actually secondary. It was mainly because the transcendent mutation suppressed all detrimental factors and perfectly turned the power of mutation into the potential of the ginseng baby.
If it were other pets… Even if it was a mutant tree that also mastered mutations, restricted by the skill level, such a mutation was definitely courting death.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone still didn’t react.
They still felt that it was a little unbelievable.
The spatial pets of overlord races were already quite powerful. Time-type… was unimaginable. Why could Emperor Shi end the totem era? Wasn’t it because of his heaven-defying time-element talent?
From the method of building the heroic spirit ruins, one could tell that the power of Emperor Shi was something that subsequent emperors like Emperor Wu and the empress could not reach.
Even Emperor Kong, who had once successfully established an intercontinental spatial teleportation array that crossed the ocean, felt that he was inferior to Emperor Shi and said that Emperor Shi was the true emperor of time.
“Then, after the mutation succeeded, what changes did Baby Ginseng have?” President Ye Hui hurriedly asked.
Without a doubt, the Undying Ginseng was a brand new race. For a Feeder like Ye Hui, Baby Ginseng was currently as attractive to it as the Mythical Ruins to Shi Yu. It wanted to explore it very much.
Shi Yu smiled bitterly. “You guys saw it too… That just now… should mean that the nourishing effect is better, right?”
“Its energy value is almost two to three times that of pets of high-level overlord races of the same level…”
“Now, it should be considered a high-quality super supplement with legendary potential. In the future, when it grows up, it will definitely be a divine medicine…”
Baby Ginseng’s face also fell. What was he talking about this, talk about its battle power!
“Apart from that, it also awakened three new skills. Among them, there are two time-element skills, one high-level, and one super-level…”
“Well, the high-level time skill is a dual-element wood and time skill. It’s called the Time Fruit. Its effect is… It can allow the user to temporarily use the power of time to obtain the full strength of their youth or the strength after growth.”
“The general effect is that it can make a baby temporarily become a big man, and an old man temporarily become a strong man?”
Everyone: “?”
Holy shit.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the pupils of the old principal and President Ye Hui of the Imperial Capital University constricted. The Prediction Owl and the Gem Cat were also stunned.
What kind of sick skill was this?
“Have you guys heard of a legend? The army of the Imperial Dynasty of Emperor Shi is the only army in history that won’t weaken because of age…”
“Although there are no records, I suspect that one of Emperor Shi’s pets most likely mastered this move.”
“Shi, Shi, Emperor Shi?” President Ye said subconsciously.
“Yes.” Shi Yu also suddenly made the connection later.
Unfortunately, there were very few records… Perhaps he could ask Ice Dragon later.
Just thinking about it, if those old generals who were old and unable to increase their pets could use a Time Fruit to return to their peak… It was invincible.
“So this is high-level? High-level?” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
He called this a high-level skill?
Shi Yu waved his hand and said, “It’s indeed high-level. Of course, my ginseng baby definitely can’t compare to Emperor Shi’s pet at the moment.”
[Ginseng Baby: Get to the important part!)
“It’s limited by its strength. Now, apart from using it himself, its Time Fruit can only be effective against pets of low levels. In other words, its Time Fruit can only be effective against pets below the transcendent level…”
“Moreover, the maintenance time probably won’t exceed a minute. After returning to its peak state, it’s also considered overdrafting the user’s strength. The burden on the user is huge… It’s probably going to lie down later… Although, it’s already worth it.” After Baby Ginseng sensed it carefully, it indeed discovered the current limitations of the Time Fruit.
However, this wasn’t a problem. As long as the skill wasn’t super, Shi Yu could immediately arrange for it to be maxed out.
At that time, forget about taking effect on pets of the same level, it might even have a weak effect on pets one level higher than Baby Ginseng!
Because Emperor Shi had the time element to strengthen his talent… Perhaps he couldn’t reach the level of Emperor Shi’s pet, but it was probably not a problem to get close.
“You also know that time-element skills are not easy to practice. It’s so difficult to increase proficiency…” Shi Yu said.” Moreover, the consumption of condensing one such fruit is comparable to using ordinary super skills several times. It’s not that impressive.”
At the side, the owl nodded deeply. Indeed, time-type skills were too difficult to train.
“That’s also…” President Ye Hui and the old principal of Imperial Capital University still felt that it was very strong.
For a pet of the racial level like Baby Ginseng, when its strength rose in the future, it probably wouldn’t be a problem to live for hundreds or thousands of years. With this skill, after it grew up in the future, it could completely rely on the power of one hit KO’s to pull up Dong Huang’s battle power level. They still said that this was a f*cking high-level?
“Speaking of which, are there any pets for me to do experiments nearby…” Shi Yu suddenly muttered. The pile of pets just now seemed to have been chased away by the owl.
“I’ll do it!!” At the side, the gem cat was eager to try. Its entire body emitted blue light. In the next moment, a brown earth-element creature the size of an arm was teleported over by the gem cat.
“Heh!!!” The wild Rockback Lizard, which lived in the mountain area of Imperial Capital University and was in charge of polishing rocks, was shocked.
It looked at the surrounding environment and the phenomenon that was gradually disappearing in the sky, extremely shocked.
To be honest, it had also sensed the changes here just now and even wanted to come over. However, because it was too excited, it had just gone out and planned to leave when it was thrown on the spot tens of thousands of meters away.
“Then let’s give it a try?” President Ye said in anticipation.
“You feeders are really wasteful… But it’s alright,” the old principal of Imperial Capital University said.
Even if the level of the Time Fruit was very low, it sounded very expensive.
It was too extravagant to experiment with a wild transcendent creature directly. However, the research of feeders seemed to be like this.
“Baby Ginseng.” Shi Yu immediately nodded at Baby Ginseng
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was also impatient. Under the gaze of Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong, it tried its best to condense the Time Fruit.
It was similar to the process of condensing energy fruits and nutritional supplements, but the consumption was greater than both.
When Baby Ginseng stretched out its hands to condense the Time Fruit, its six-pointed star pupils spun crazily. Light emitted from its hand, and the power of time constantly wrapped around it. Its physical fitness was also being crazily extracted.
In a short period of time, half of Baby Ginseng’s physical fitness was taken away. Only then did a time fruit with the lowest quality successfully condense.
“Yi!!!”
After a white light flashed, a small white fruit like a pineapple appeared in Baby Ginseng’s hand. It held the fruit and panted with difficulty…
After the Time Fruit was condensed, Baby Ginseng threw it to the Rockback Lizard beside it. Under the gaze of a group of big shots, the Rockback Lizard swallowed its saliva…
Eat!
After all, this thing was still pretty fragrant. It shouldn’t have been poisoned.
Click.
The Rockback Lizard wolfed it down. “Heh!!!” After eating, the Rockback Lizard suddenly froze on the spot.
In the next moment, its energy suddenly began to increase steadily.
Everyone instantly focused.
Boom!
Then, under the explosive increase in energy, the Rockback Lizard’s entire body was actually filled with evolution and breakthrough light!
This was…
This change suddenly shocked the old principal, President Ye Hui, the Prediction Owl, and the gem cat.
After swallowing the Time Fruit, the Rockback Lizard, which had less than a hundred energy points, actually evolved and broke through. In a short moment, its body grew several times, and its body became comparable to a lion or tiger, growing into a new race!! At this moment, the index data in front of Shi Yu changed crazily.
This was the previous data.
< Name > Rockback Lizard
[Race Level]: Mid-level transcendent
(Level of Growth): Level 10 Awakening
Energy Points: 77
“Roar!!!” A moment later, the evolution light dissipated, and a huge lizard appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Its huge body, black patterns, and characteristics that looked like dinosaurs were the appearance of the Rockback Lizard after it ate the Time Fruit.
In Shi Yu’s index, the data had become like this.
< Name > Earth Rock Lizard
[Race Level): Low-level Commander
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Energy Points: 22318
The old principal and President Ye Hui of the Imperial Capital University clearly had similar detection methods. Beside them, the Prediction Owl and the Gem Cat could also clearly determine the changes of the Rockback Lizard. At this moment, as they clearly saw the changes after the Rockback Lizard ate the Time Fruit, they opened their mouths wide. Damn it.
Wasn’t the effect of this Time Fruit a little heaven-defying?
It directly made the Rockback Lizard evolve? It even broke through two levels in a row? Its energy level increased by hundreds of times??
“This…”
“This works too?”
“Is this a time skill?”
At this moment, the most shocked was still the Rockback Lizard. It felt its powerful strength and was directly stunned.
However, in less than ten seconds, its expression suddenly changed. Its entire body flashed, and its body kept shrinking as if it had breathed out. It returned to its Rockback Lizard form.
At the same time, it lay on the ground with a weak expression, its limbs and tail twitching.
“It has some potential, but it’s limited… It can’t maintain peak battle power for long…” Shi Yu was silent.
Seeing this, Baby Ginseng was just about to heal the Rockback Lizard, but the Time Fruit seemed to have some additional power. The Rockback Lizard that fell flashed with evolution light again. In the next moment, because it had experienced its peak strength, it seemed to have broken through the racial limit and actually evolved again.
A moment later, a brown lizard creature that was different from the Rockback Lizard and the Earth Rock Lizard appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
< Name > Earth Rock Lizard
(Race Level]: High Transcendent
(Level of Growth]: transcendent
Energy Points: 588
However, it was still so weak.
At that moment, everyone was stunned when they saw this change. “What the?!!!” Then, President Ye Hui was stunned. “It’s one thing to directly let an awakened pet obtain commander rank power, but it actually lets it complete a temporary evolution!! A temporary evolution!!”
Not only was this Time Fruit a peak battle power experience card, but it also let the pet experience stronger strength for once, thereby confirming the best shortcut to its own path!!
After the power of time lost its effect, the Rockback Lizard directly relied on its previous understanding to increase its strength and even completed an evolution!
After all, this was only the entry-level Time Fruit that had just awakened.
In an instant, the two of them and the two overlords looked at Baby Ginseng in amazement. Eleven and the others also looked at Baby Ginseng in admiration.
As expected, it was still better at cheating. “Yi!!” Seeing this, Baby Ginseng revealed a smug expression. Shi Yu also took a deep breath. It was alright. The effect was better than he had expected. As expected of an invincible time-type skill. How powerful would it be to have the skill advancement??
Just the entry-level Time Fruit alone made Shi Yu feel that it was much more expensive than the full-level Nutrition Fruit.
Although the Maximum-level Nutrition Fruit could rely on the power of time to strengthen the effect, increase the evolution potential, and increase life force, this Time Fruit directly let the pet experience the power after evolution. Rockback Lizard+Time Fruit = Earth Rock Lizard… This reminded Shi Yu of the classic combination of a card game. “Time Magician “+” Baby Dragon” = “Thousand Year Dragon”!
This fruit was too suitable for pets with great potential but needed to grow for a long time, such as dragons!
Initially, Shi Yu didn’t know what gifts he would bring to Dragon Palace City apart from the frost dragon. He estimated that Dragon Palace City wouldn’t fancy the Nutrition Fruit either, but now, when he saw the Time Fruit, he immediately understood. Max-level Time Fruit!
It could definitely make a group of dragon babies go crazy. “This is the way pets in the growth stage obtain mature strength…”
“It should still be able to be used in reverse. For example, letting an old Earth Dragon Lizard with weak battle power temporarily recover to its prime,” Shi Yu said.
The old principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University naturally understood. They couldn’t help but suffocate.
“…C-condense another one,” the old principal of Imperial Capital University said to Baby Ginseng
“Yi?” Baby Ginseng was stunned. After Shi Yu nodded, it still did as he said. In the next moment, it took root in the ground and absorbed the light energy. At the same time, it condensed the Time Fruit.
Soon, Baby Ginseng’s physical strength was drained. However, with the Earth Chain, Energy Storage Beam, and Absolute Sleep recovery measures, its recovery speed was still alright.
A moment later, another time fruit appeared.
Baby Ginseng was handed to the old principal. Did he still need to experiment?
“Yes…”
After Baby Ginseng condensed the Time Fruit, the old principal of the Imperial Capital University looked at the Time Fruit and hesitated.
He stretched out one hand as if he was fighting a mental battle.
“Forget it, forget it. There’s no need.” She touched her wrinkled face and blushed. “It’s just that small duration. It’s meaningless…” Shi Yu, President Ye, and the pets :”…”
They immediately understood the thoughts of the old principal of Imperial Capital University. Just now, she definitely wanted to use the Time Fruit to return to the era of when she was a fair and beautiful young woman!
Returning to being young was indeed a fatal temptation for women.
“Not bad, in short, not bad. Student Shi Yu, from now on, Imperial Capital University will be your second home.” After the old principal of the Imperial Capital University saw Baby Ginseng’s ability, she immediately changed her previously calm expression and said brightly, “I look forward to the day Baby Ginseng becomes stronger. This skill is good. You have to practice it quickly and increase your level!!”
In that case, if she asked Shi Yu for a few more Time Fruits, she could occasionally become younger. Which rich woman didn’t want to become beautiful?
President Ye and the owl:???
“Ah, this.” Shi Yu also reacted.
Holy shit.
This skill’s real use was not to increase battle power, but a trump card against an old rich woman?? Baby Ginseng was also stunned. Under the influence of the Beast Tamer, it quickly reacted to how lethal this move was to the old rich lady.
“Alright, alright,” Shi Yu hurriedly nodded. “Very good.” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University instantly found Shi Yu much more pleasing to the eye. She even wanted to snatch him from Old Feng.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng looked at the time fruit in its hand and fell into deep thought.
Beside it, Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong were eager to try.
They wanted to eat it!
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng glared at them.
This thing was only useful for those below commander rank.
“Wu Wu Wu.” Eleven waved its hand. It’s alright. It could create transcendent-level bean bear experiments.
It wanted to see if it could evolve the Bean Bear into the Nine Li form.
“Yiya!” Baby Ginseng shook its head crazily, thinking that this was more wasteful…
“Eat it yourself and see. Isn’t the Time Fruit effective in ignoring your own level?” Shi Yu said.
“Yi?!” Baby Ginseng smiled happily when it heard that. Yes.
With that said, it wanted to swallow it in one go. “Wait, wait!!!”
Seeing this, Ye Hui and the old principal of the Imperial Capital University were shocked and hurriedly stopped Baby Ginseng.
“Don’t eat it. It can break through to the monarch level at any time now. After eating the Time Fruit, I’m afraid it can directly obtain the monarch level power. Just now, its evolution released such a huge reaction. If it breaks through now, are you sure it won’t alarm the pets in the entire city??” President Ye hurriedly stopped it.
At that time, it was possible for Baby Ginseng’s energy level to increase by ten or 20 times.
The commotion was definitely greater!
Doing it the second time was too much!
“Yi! (You can ask Teacher Ying to seal the space.)” Baby Ginseng looked at the gem cat and still wanted to eat it.
However, in the next second, Baby Ginseng saw the gem cat wipe its saliva and shake its head.
“I advise you not to mess around. I’m afraid that I’ll accidentally eat you after you break through.” The gem cat’s gaze was faint, scaring Baby Ginseng
“Yi???”
“Yeah.” The Prediction Owl’s gaze was also faint. “Time-element monarch-level supplement… Perhaps, after eating you, my Future Prediction can directly reach Perfect Level.”
“(A) Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng was shocked and hurriedly threw the hot potato, the Time Fruit, into Eleven’s hand.
“Sob.” Eleven was pleased.
“I’m just kidding. However, after you break through to the overlord level, remember to give me more of this Time Fruit.” The Prediction Owl also remembered the Time Fruit. After all, maybe it could also rely on this to break through?
At this moment, because the shock brought by the Time Fruit was too great, the old principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University even forgot about the discussion!
They hurriedly asked, “Speaking of which, what’s the super skill!!”
If a high-level time skill was already so impressive, then super… how terrifying would it be??
“There are two super skills. One is the wood and light element Moon Explosion, and the other is still a wood and time skill, Time Mark.”
“Moon Explosion… It’s probably the ability to make the internal energy of the corporeal wood-element skill expand several times before exploding with Moonlight Radiation.”
“If Baby Ginseng’s main body uses this skill to self-destruct, with its current 220,000 energy points, it should be able to instantly expand to more than 2 million energy points, and then produce a violent big explosion…”
Shi Yu guessed. Beside him, Baby Ginseng nodded. Explosion was art!
“This, the Moonlight Gem really worked?!”
At the side, the gem cat was stunned. The Moonlight Radiation was clearly due to the Moonlight Gem.
Obviously, this was a powerful attack-type skill.
The destructive power of a single skill could even exceed the combination of a bunch of explosive skills when Eleven fought Grandpa Bull.
At the side, the corners of everyone’s mouths twitched. As a supplementary ginseng baby, it was ridiculous for him to have comprehended such a skill.
“This skill…”
It was really difficult to evaluate for the old principal and President Ye.
However, it was still acceptable.
Although the self-destruction power of the Moon Explosion sounded much stronger than traditional self-destruction, it definitely couldn’t be used. As for other uses, they were only so-so compared to heaven-defying time skills. In comparison, it seemed obvious that these two skills have the wrong level classification.
However, skill levels were often determined by the skill upper limit. Something as big as the moon could borrow the power of a celestial body to cause a huge explosion was indeed a little extraordinary.
When trained to the extreme, its power might be comparable to the explosion of a small planet.
“Yiya!!!” Baby Ginseng shouted. Should it also experiment with Moon Explosion?
It liked this month too much.
With its current strength, self-destruction should be enough to kill those monarch-level pets with millions of energy points.
If it directly self-destructed after breaking through to the monarch level, wouldn’t it be invincible at the monarch level and heavily injure overlord-level creatures?
“It wants to test the power of the Moon Explosion, especially the self-destruction,” Shi Yu translated, making the eyelids of the people beside him twitch.
Wait, wait, these guys were drunk on evolution.
“Try the power of the self-destruction??” The old principal and Ye Hui wondered if they had heard correctly.
Their expressions darkened. Courting death?
“What do you mean? Won’t he die if he self-destructs…” President Ye said.” Don’t tell me he won’t die. Self-destruction with an energy increase of ten times… is even more ridiculous than the self-destruct skills of those Mechanics.”
“Of course it will die, and it will die without leaving any dregs. However, don’t forget its race name, Undying Ginseng…” Shi Yu said.
ZEveryone was stunned.
Shi Yu said, “Baby Ginseng’s last super skill of wood and time is formed by combining the power of death. It can condense a time mark, also known as the Undying Mark, and record its own state. Then, after it’s injured and unnatural death, it can reverse time and life and death with the time mark to recover from its injuries or revive itself.”
“Therefore, in theory, it can be combined into a continuous skill of self-destruction and revival…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the scene suddenly fell silent.
The old principal, President Ye, the owl, and the gem cat widened their eyes. What did he say?
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng looked at everyone and was eager to give it a try. It wanted to try! It wanted to find an opponent and experiment! Its awakening skill happened to come with a time mark!
If not, it would feel uncomfortable.
The old principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University looked at Baby Ginseng, who was eager to self-destruct, and revealed ridiculous expressions. They reacted for a long time before shouting, “What did you
say??!”
“This skill?? This skill exists???”
They directly lost their ability to think. “Damn, damn, damn.” After the Prediction Owl was stunned, its eyes turned red. They were both time-element skills, so why was Baby Ginseng’s skill so awesome?
The teacher on the screen beside him was also a little confused. Holy shit, what the hell was this skill?
Who the heck designed this skill? “Infinite self-destruction and revival??” President Ye was stunned.
“Are you sure you’re not kidding?” This was a f*cking supplement? Not a special forbidden weapon? Suddenly, the Prediction Owl was shocked and remembered the scene it had predicted about the ginseng baby. A group of totems chased after the ginseng baby and placed it in their mouths…
If at that time, Baby Ginseng already had the strength of an overlord. The totems were in danger.
Initially, when the owl first saw this scene, it felt that Baby Ginseng was ridiculously miserable. But from the looks of it, it suddenly felt that if this premonition was real, the ones who were miserable were those totems.
They f*cking ate a nuclear bomb baby!
A nuclear bomb baby that could revive!
With the Moon Explosion and the Time Mark, it suspected that Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were going to fish out and hunt totems!
Baby Ginseng: Tired of running. Destroy! “It’s not that simple…” Seeing the four of them imagine with blank gazes, Shi Yu hurriedly waved his hand and smiled bitterly. “At the moment, only one Time Mark can be found in Baby Ginseng’s body. Moreover, after using one, Baby Ginseng needs to invest all its energy and spend a long time to condense the next one. The restriction is very big.”
“Although I don’t know what changes will happen when the skill proficiency is high, now, it still costs a lot to self-destruct once. The cooldown time will probably be a few months.”
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng expressed that it was alright, it was alright.
This skill was completely promising in the future. When it trained its overlord will and let Shi Yu maximize this skill, at that time, what if there were multiple time marks in its body? Wouldn’t it be close to infinitely self-destructing?
At that time, there would be no need for Dong Huang’s mechanical army to suppress Yun An. They could just request for the Undying Ginseng First, eat a Time Fruit and become the strongest state. Then, use Moon Explosion to self-destruct and revive!
This wave was invincible!
It could completely dictate the ages alone and suppress a half-god. “This…”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the old principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University didn’t feel that the restriction was very big at all. Bastard, when Baby Ginseng grew to an overlord, Shi Yu would have a forbidden weapon that could be reborn. This was… heaven-defying!!
The two of them looked at each other. The Prediction Owl and the Gem Cat also looked at each other. No wonder Shi Yu called it the Undying Ginseng. No wonder Shi Yu said that it was a quasi-mythical race. This strength and potential…
“In short, you’re forbidden from using this move in Imperial Capital University.” The eyelids of the old principal of Imperial Capital University twitched.
Suddenly, she was a little worried about the National League of Imperial Capital University this year.
After Baby Ginseng broke through to the monarch level, could Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast withstand the self-destruction?
He definitely couldn’t withstand it, alright?
Even after Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast fused into the driving state, their energy level didn’t exceed ten million. However, the self-destruction of the monarch-level ginseng baby’s energy level definitely exceeded ten million.
“And this move, don’t use it in ordinary battles. It really can kill pets…”
It wasn’t Baby Ginseng that would die, but the opponent.
“I won’t use it, of course…” Shi Yu scratched his head and laughed. No, no, he definitely couldn’t use it casually.
Upon hearing that, Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong heaved a sigh of relief.
It would be best if it was banned in the team competition too!
Although Baby Ginseng could only use it once, Eleven, Buggy, and the others didn’t dare to bet on themselves!
Its teammates would die!
It was recommended to seal this forbidden
move!
At this moment, President Ye looked at Shi Yu silently.
This boy… had already grown to this extent in a short period of time?
“How many overlord species pets do you have?” Ye Hui couldn’t help but ask.
“Four… I guess.” Shi Yu glanced at the four little ones and said, “After we go to Dragon Palace City, there might be five.”
“Didn’t Lord Owl predict that I could contract a totem in Dragon Palace City? Now, I’m more and more convinced of its prophecy.” Shi Yu looked at the owl piously.
Everyone: …
Owl: …
Little Chi Tong’s sword unsealed the Dark Phoenix. After all, that place was really related to Chi Tong’s bloodline. Eleven’s battle against the demon god was probably also accurate. That demon god was Yun An. Now, the prophecy of Baby Ginseng being chased and eaten by a bunch of totems didn’t seem that difficult to understand. Shi Yu even had the thought of going fishing for totems in the future…
From the looks of it, perhaps he could really contract a totem on his trip to Dragon Palace City?
To be able to reach the totem level, it was definitely an overlord race.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t expect the other party to really be a water-element totem. His strength definitely couldn’t contract a totem level growth, but what if it was a reincarnated totem like Chong Xuan?
It was also possible that the owl had predicted that his fifth pet would be at the totem level after it grew up…
However, the water element was definitely stable. After all, Shi Yu’s first choice now was water-element and elemental creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - Let’s Have a Baby Cup
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Let’s Have a Baby Cup
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, Shi Yu had finished explaining everything,
It was impossible not to give an explanation for causing such a big commotion in other people’s territory.
However, it was also because Baby Ginseng was hardworking and the Time Fruit had enough potential that the current principal and the Prediction Owl of Imperial Capital University found Shi Yu pleasing to the eye.
Therefore, in Shi Yu’s opinion, perhaps the high-level skill, Time Fruit, was the strongest!
It was even more useful than super skills like Moon Explosion, Source of Life, and Time Mark. It was more suitable for public relations!
After all, no matter how powerful the time mark was, no one else could use it.
Of course, feeding the ginseng baby to a beast so it could get stronger, and then reviving it was a way to use it for someone’s sake… This kind of cruel method was indeed feasible… But it was too inhumane!
Moreover, the time mark was too difficult to condense.
He needed Baby Ginseng to invest all its energy and do nothing to concentrate on condensing this for a long time. For a person like Shi Yu who lacked ginseng babies, he couldn’t leave Baby Ginseng’s side for even a moment… If Baby Ginseng wanted to go into seclusion to condense the Time Mark for a
few months, the increase in the team’s strength would probably have to be suspended on the spot.
Therefore, it was better to wait to add points to the Time Mark in the future and see if there would be any changes when the level was high.
If he condensed time imprints now, the cost-effective ratio would be too low!
He just didn’t know if the time mark could develop a way to record other people’s states after its level was high.
Emperor Shi’s heroic spirit ruins… seemed to have used a similar ability.
“Well…”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the Time Ruins in silence and said, “Well, speaking of which, can we continue to use the Time Mystic Realm?”
The originally smiling owl’s expression suddenly fell.
“This isn’t a question of whether I want to let you use it or not. It’s that the mystic realm doesn’t want to let you use it anymore.”
Shi Yu: QAQ?
“When Baby Ginseng evolved… it indeed resonated with the mystic realm and absorbed more time power…” Shi Yu said in embarrassment.
“In any case, your goal has been achieved, so stop using it! Moreover, the mystic realm is unstable now,” the owl advised.
Not only did the mystic realm didn’t want to be used, the owl also didn’t want to let it be used!
2
What a joke. If it still dared to after witnessing Shi Yu’s power, people would think it hated the mystic realm.
If Yi Yu and the others wanted to try to die inside and self-destruct, what would happen?
At that time, Baby Ginseng could still be revived. The mystic realm would be shattered!
“Wu wu?”
“Wuu?”
“Mi??”
After hearing that they couldn’t use the time mystic realm to train their overlord will, the other three little ones were suddenly shocked.
What?
It couldn’t be used anymore?
“Cough.” The owl shook its head and said, “There’s no other way.”
Previously, the Time Ruins were restricted to legendary and overlord levels.
Now, it wanted to add another restriction, banning a certain ginseng baby and Shi Yu.
Although it would miss Baby Ginseng, it definitely couldn’t let Shi Yu come into contact with the ruins… The people from Bureau 11 were too scary.
“Ah…” Upon hearing that, Shi Yu looked worried. He had only stayed in the Time Mystic Realm for a day. Only two hours had passed in the outside world.
If he had known that the Time Ruins was so sensitive, he would have let Baby Ginseng evolve before leaving.
“wu?”
“Wuu?”
Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong looked at Baby Ginseng. It was too much!
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng took a step back aggrievedly. This couldn’t be helped. It couldn’t control it either.
‘At most… it would compensate everyone with a pile of time fruits later.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the four little guys in silence.
Forget it… Compared to the Time Ruins, Overlord Will, and some super skills, he wanted to maximize the Time Fruit to see the effect!
This was the most important!
“Then there’s no need.”
He looked at the similarly silent principal and President Ye of the Imperial Capital University and couldn’t help but say obediently, “Wait, everyone, don’t be in a hurry to leave. Baby Ginseng, you’ve disturbed everyone for so long. Hurry up and create some local specialties for the seniors.”
Baby Ginseng:
Although he knew that Principal Zhao and President Ye might not necessarily lack the nutritional fruits of the ginseng baby, Shi Yu still got Baby Ginseng to prepare a batch of local specialties, including some for the Prediction Owl.
Of course, there was definitely some for the gem cat. It had been eyeing the gem fruit after Baby Ginseng evolved from the start.
It was not very interested in the Time Fruit, but it simply loved the Gem Fruit.
After Baby Ginseng evolved, the quality of the gem fruit increased as expected, with a very big increase.
If the previous gem fruit was only in the category of level-four resources, then it could already exceed most level-five spiritual fruits now.
Next, although he couldn’t enter the Time Ruins, Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry. He directly stayed in the capital.
To be precise, he found a corner in the capital and entered the ruins space to stay.
The gem cat went to freeload with the Prediction Owl, while Principal Zhao and President Ye went to calm the commotion. It was the same as the situation in the Heroic Ruins. Although everyone knew that Baby Ginseng’s evolution was very powerful, the specific news definitely couldn’t be revealed.
Baby Ginseng’s ability was too buggy. If it was leaked, it would be much more serious than the Butterfly of Imagination, even more serious than Chi Tong.
They had sealed off Chi Tong’s news only because they were worried that a large number of enemies of General Mu Huiyin in the totem area would pay attention to Shi Yu. This was only a small group of people, but Baby Ginseng’s information could make Shi Yu an enemy throughout the world.
Probably no totem wanted a quasi-mythical pet that could self-destruct and revive… ever to grow up.
This accompanying move directly represented that as long as Baby Ginseng had the strength of an overlord, it had the capital to threaten the totems.
In addition to the nourishing effect of the ginseng baby, not to mention foreign enemies, even humans might not necessarily be able to treat them calmly.
Shi Yu had enough titles and was already eye-catching enough. They couldn’t give Shi Yu any more aggro debuffs.
Shi Yu naturally knew this.
Therefore, for him, increasing his strength was the most important at the moment.
First was the Time Fruit.
He started to hide in the ruins space with his four pets and crazily added points to the Time Fruit.
yi! (Shi Yu, increase points!)”
“Ican’t take it anymore… Baby Ginseng, heal me!”
yi! (Shi Yu, increase points!)”
“Heal me!”
After Shi Yu broke through to the master level, the upper limit of his physique was unlocked again.
At this moment, it was difficult for him to determine the level of his physique, but he estimated that after reaching the upper limit again, apart from Beast Tamers with Beast Taming Talents that enhanced their physiques, as well as mixed-blood humans, even among Legendary-levels, there should be
very few Beast Tamers with physiques above his.
The benefits this powerful physique brought to Shi Yu, apart from being able to add points at will, was that he could better withstand Little Chi Tong’s possession.
Unfortunately, the changes brought to the Beast Tamer by the increase in physique were still singular. It couldn’t be compared to the various magical abilities brought by the increase in the Beast Taming Space.
The various magical effects of the legendary Beast Taming Space had already been developed. In comparison, the legendary physique was a little boring. No wonder Beast Tamers studied the Beast Taming Space and rarely studied improving physiques.
“Finally…”
After an unknown period of time.
In the ruins space, Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng happily. Baby Ginseng also looked at Shi Yu excitedly.
This kind of upgrade session that filled up high-level skills in one go was a challenge for Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu.
As he was very anxious to know what the higher-level effect of the Time Fruit was, Shi Yu couldn’t even be bothered to sleep.
“Tt exploded!!”
At this moment, Shi Yu maxed out Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit. After adding it to the Dao Proficiency, he only wanted to shout that he had exploded!!
From entry to perfection, there was nothing to say. It only reduced the energy consumption of the Time Fruit created by the ginseng baby, increased the little effect of the Time Fruit, and reduced the side effects.
The specific ability was still not much different from when it was at the entry level. It could only be effective against creatures at a lower level than ginseng babies.
However, as the Time Fruit reached transcendent, the effect directly increased. Just as Shi Yu thought, the time power of the Time Fruit was already huge. It could also be effective on pets of the same level as Baby Ginseng. Baby Ginseng could also freely control the strength of the Time Fruit it created.
In other words, Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong could also temporarily obtain stronger battle power by eating the Time Fruit.
This was not the end. After adding 64 points, it was far from the end. When the Time Fruit was added to 256 points by Shi Yu and reached the level of Dao Proficiency, the Time Fruit was already strong enough. A creature one level higher than Baby Ginseng, which was a monarch-level creature, could also
be slightly affected/
Of course, this was not the strongest increase. The strongest increase was that the Time Fruit was no longer limited to positive gains.
The time fruit created by Baby Ginseng could be controlled by it more freely.
It could directly create a fruit and let the target who ate it return to their infant state temporarily, causing their battle power to fall to rock bottom.
It could also directly create a fruit and turn the target that ate it into an old beast, barely breathing.
The only pity was that the change was still temporary.
However, this was enough. At this moment, the best way to use the Time Fruit for Shi Yu was no longer to use it to increase battle power.
“yi!!!” After being filled with the Time Fruit, Baby Ginseng’s energy value naturally increased again, approaching 240,000. It was very terrifying, more than 30,000 higher than Eleven.
With such strength, Baby Ginseng naturally couldn’t wait to organize the team competition.
It couldn’t take it anymore!!!
Even if it didn’t have to self-destruct, with everyone at the commander rank, it would directly give itself a Time Fruit to temporarily obtain the battle power of a monarch. It would have millions of energy points. Even if Eleven exceeded the limit and erupted, even if Buggy had equipment, even if Chi Tong
possessed Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng felt that it had a huge chance of winning.
“Competition, competition, you only know competition,” Shi Yu educated. “Is becoming strong only for the sake of competing with each other?”
Baby Ginseng:??
“Besides, to be honest, your strength isn’t very stable.”
“Think about it, do you have any way to break through the concealment of the Buggy?”
“I’s not a problem for Buggy’s main body to hide in the alternate space for half a day. Your light energy is high, and you don’t have spatial skills. Even if you self-destruct, you can’t blast its main body.”
yi!!!” Baby Ginseng shook its head crazily. No, it had studied the Anti-Buggy Energy Fruit. With the seed of the spatial-element Spirit Fruit, it could grow into a fruit bomb and use the enhancement of the Moon Explosion to completely blast Buggy!
It was already prepared.
The spatial seed that attacked the worm could grow into a spatial bomb under its control.
It also prepared the Eleven counter fruit, fire-element spiritual fruit seed. At that time, it could also combine the power of the sun. This was an anti-eleven energy fruit bomb.
In fact, it had even prepared the anti Shiyu’s Hypnosis Fruit Bomb. In order not to hurt Shi Yu and Little Chi Tong, it was very considerate, so Shi Yu didn’t have to be afraid of being injured at all.
Shi Yu: “?
This guy was still arguing?
“No, the spiritual fruit seed is an external object, not something you made yourself. It’s considered equipment. You definitely can’t bring it with you in the team competition, just like how Buggy can’t bring dragon-type resources.”
Baby Ginseng:??
But didn’t Little Chi Tong also use equipment
“It’s not impossible to organize and bring equipment… It’s mainly because you guys are too strong. It’s easy to hurt the other party in a battle. It’s too painful. Alright, why don’t we do this…”
Shi Yu called Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong over.
“Let me tell you a piece of good news. Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit has the ability to turn you back into infants. This is simply an ability stronger than Master Qu Jie’s sealing talent!”
“At that time, forget about the low energy value, you’ll probably be able to degenerate into a baby form. The skill proficiency will probably be gone. Is there a better form to train the overlord’s will than this? In the baby form, resist the pressure.”
“In my opinion, the team internal competition should also be a baby cup. You guys fight in your baby form. To be fair, I won’t possess Little Chi Tong anymore. I’ll directly fight you with my physical body.”
The pets: ???
Human language?

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - Shi Yu Who Didn’t Treat Others As People
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Shi Yu Who Didn’t Treat Others As People
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit was maxed out, Shi Yu’s team was much more lively.
With the Time Fruit, it could indeed temporarily turn Eleven and the others into babies.
Unfortunately, as he used it, Shi Yu increasingly understood why the Time Fruit was only at the high level.
Even after the skill was maxed out, the restriction was still huge.
For example, the Time Fruit that Baby Ginseng condensed with all its might couldn’t push Eleven and the others back to their baby form for too long. As long as Eleven and the others wanted to break free, they could recover in a few seconds.
It was estimated that for opponents whose strength exceeded Baby Ginseng’s, the time it could affect them was even shorter!
Although victory could be decided in this instant, it was still lacking in training.
However, there were more solutions than difficulties.
Baby Ginseng could swallow a Time Fruit and directly obtain the power of a monarch at the last minute!
Then, with millions of energy points, it quickly condensed four Time Fruits with stronger effects. The cheating was successful!
The fruits this time were not something Eleven and the others could withstand
This was only an additional usage method of the Time Fruit. Shi Yu and the others studied it for a long time and realized that the most impressive effect of the Time Fruit was indeed still to increase battle power.
Through the power of time, a pet could obtain the power after growth!
Of course, this usage method was not purely dependent on the quality of the Time Fruit.
It also depended on the pet’s own potential.
In short, if a pet with weak potential ate the same Time Fruit, it might not even have any effect. It was no different from eating a fruit. There would be no change in its body.
However, if a pet with strong potential ate it, the peak strength obtained after the power of time stimulated its potential would definitely be unimaginable.
It could be said that this Time Fruit was a talent potential detector!
The higher the species level and the lower the growth level, the better the effect.
It was considered a reaction agent that temporarily converted racial potential into strength!
For example, like that Iron-eating Beast of Hall Master Lin… When it was at the commander rank, even if it ate the Time Fruit, it couldn’t change. This was because its potential had reached its limit, and it was at its peak.
However, if Eleven ate it, it would be completely different.
Although Eleven was already at the peak of the commander rank, it was clearly in the stage where it could break through to the monarch rank at any time. Moreover, it was a high-level overlord race, which meant that it could successfully grow and definitely reach the overlord level.
Its potential was naturally needless to say. After Eleven ate the Time Fruit and the Time Fruit stimulated its potential, the effect would definitely be incomparable to ordinary pets.
Although it was restricted by the quality level of the Time Fruit, and it was impossible for Eleven to obtain too exaggerated strength and directly reach the Mythical level, there was still a 100% monarch level.
Including Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, their potential was ridiculously high. The Time Fruit perfectly matched them!
A moment later, Baby Ginseng neatly arranged the new Time Fruits.
Eleven, Buggy, and the others looked at each other.
“Eat!!”
“wa!” “Wal”
Eleven and Buggy ate it with determined expressions.
Because this new Time Fruit was condensed from a monarch-level ginseng baby, its effect on the commander-level Eleven and the others was much better.
In the blink of an eye, Eleven and Buggy, who had eaten the fruit, reacted.
Their expressions changed.
Under the effect of the Time Fruit, their energy was quickly sealed, and various skills and skill experience disappeared from their bodies like they were sealed.
Ina short moment, Eleven’s aura weakened greatly and it was pushed back to the Awakening level. Its energy value was less than 100, and its skill was only hardening, Its skill proficiency was still not high.
Little Eleven looked at its hands in confusion. Although it had always been in the posture of a panda baby, now… it felt that its strength was also at the baby level.
As for Buggy, it was also very ridiculous. Its entire body directly flickered with white light, spreading the light of degeneration. It was forced back to the Green Silkworm form from the form of the Butterfly of Imagination, and only the worm silk and psychic strength were left.
“Jil!” Buggy was shocked.
This time, even if they tried their best to break free, they couldn’t recover immediately.
“Heh…”
Upon seeing this, Shi Yu instantly knew that the Baby Cup was still feasible.
“Perhaps I can directly let the four pets break through to the monarch level? There’s a Time Fruit to suppress their strength…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought, but soon, he shook his head.
“Yi…” Because beside him, Baby Ginseng instantly became extremely weak.
The haggard Ginseng Baby shrank, took root, sucked nutrients dry, and slept in one go. Its bodies also withered. Clearly, they had consumed a lot of energy.
Shi Yu gave up on the consumption and directly gave up. It was too expensive to raise high-level pets. Now, there was really no environment for the monarch-level ginseng baby to freeload on natural strength. It was better to stay at the commander level first. At least, the energy in the ruins space was
temporarily enough for the current baby ginseng to circulate. If it went any higher, the ruins would become a desert.
“Let’s do this first.”
Shi Yu stared at Baby Panda and Baby Buggy, then looked at Little Chi Tong beside him and chuckled.
A moment later, a touching scene appeared in the ruins space.
Baby Ginseng was taking root like a corpse at the side, sunbathing and sleeping. Chi Tong, on the other hand, was acting as an instructor at the last minute. It used its transcendent phoenix might to control its strength and suppress the Eleven and Buggy. They were only at the Awakening level, and were
very weak with less than 100 value points.
“jill
Shi Yu still remembered that when Buggy first faced Eleven’s deterrence, it fainted from fright.
And now, it had indeed grown. Although it was still in the Green Silkworm state, it actually resisted Chi Tong’s deterrence that could cause physical, mental, and soul pressure for a few seconds before fainting.
Not bad.
“waul!!”
As for Eleven, he was indeed the strongest in the team with the highest success rate in teaching super skills.
Even after losing its strength and being in its baby form, it still held its deterrence with both hands and resisted the pressure with extraordinary willpower. However, from the looks of it, it would be very difficult to last long.
Seeing this, Shi Yu nodded in satisfaction. If it were before, it would have been very difficult to find a place to train Eleven and Buggy with such pressure. It would have to be at least at the level of Emperor Wu Ruins. Now, it could be anywhere.
It was also very difficult to let them experience various dangerous environments. They had to search the world, go to the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, and go to the Undead Battlefield. But now, it was easy to obtain. They could also achieve similar cultivation effects at any place at any time!
“Thave a bold idea. I’ll let Buggy create its own phantom first. Then, I’l let the phantom imagine an illusionary environment of magma, deep sea, snow, lightning, and super gravity. I’ll materialize this environment and temporarily fix it in the ruins space. The strength doesn’t have to be too high.
Transcendent power will do. Then, I’ll let Baby Ginseng return you and Buggy’s main body to the Awakening level and let the phantom be the trainer. In any case, the phantom can exist after leaving the main body. This way, there are controllable ferocious natural environments everywhere.”
“Jump down from a height of ten thousand meters in the super gravity environment to experience despair and train your will.”
“Jump into the magma at the Awakening level and fall into the deep sea to experience pain and temper your will.”
“Exhaust your physical fitness in the form of a baby and travel through the snowstorm to experience difficult fatigue and temper your willpower.”
“Facing the lightning in the sky, facing deterrence that exceeds your own strength countless times, to experience the fear brought by nature and the fear of powerful enemies to temper your will.”
“A small ruin space, all ready to go. How is it? As expected of me.”
“Your goal is to face fatigue, despair, fear, and pain with a calm heart!”
“Also, life and death, life and death. When the time comes, let the Buggy Phantom pull you into the Tyrant Dragon’s dream to train. Go to that ancient dream world where the strong prey on the weak to train life and death. It’s safer this way. As long as you’re in your baby form and the level of the dream is
high enough, you won’t realize that you’re dreaming, With the profundities of Buggy, the feeling is the same as real!”
“Feel the pain, experience the pain, accept the pain, understand the pain… I think the overlord will can manifest soon!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven finally couldn’t hold on anymore and fainted.
Little Chi Tong was shocked. Be a human!
Soon after, Shi Yu left the capital.
The gem cat left with him.
After eating and drinking with the Prediction Owl in the capital for a few days, the gem cat seemed to have become fatter.
However, Shi Yu didn’t dare to say or ask anything.
He had achieved his goal in coming to the capital this time. There was nothing worth staying here anymore. As for when he would come again, he didn’t know.
“What are your plans next?”
After taking a plane back to Icefield City and teleporting back to Ping Cheng, the gem cat asked.
“Eat, sleep, fight beans. Wait for the Dragon Palace banquet to begin.”
Shi Yu stretched.
“Who’s Beans?”
“The Bean Bear created by Eleven is currently my battle sparring partner. One way or another, the Bean Bear can’t defeat me without skills.”
Eleven and the others were training hard. Shi Yu definitely couldn’t stay idle either. It was Shi Yu’s daily life to spar with the Bean Bear and occasionally go to the extreme environment experience that Buggy imagined.
“As expected of me. Drinking tea at the mouth of the volcano, meditating under the lightning, doing radio gymnastics in the snow. Who else could?”
The gem cat :”…”
“Forget it, I won’t be returning to Ancient Capital University either. I’ll wait to travel with you to Dragon Palace City.” The gem cat yawned and teleported Shi Yu back home.
Compared to its job at Ancient Capital University, it felt that it was more interesting to go to Dragon Palace City with Shi Yu next.
During the banquet period of Dragon Palace City, there were many delicious things. This was much better than the delicacies of Imperial Capital University it tried when it followed the Prediction Ow! to eat and drink.
After all, it was a delicacy used by the Dragon Palace City’s royal family to entertain other overlord factions and even totems. It was naturally not bad.
‘As for why the gem cat knew so much, it was because it had already gone to eat and drink with Lu Qingyi once five years ago. That time, it was acting as Lu Qingyi’s bodyguard. Even earlier, it wasn’t like it hadn’t gone with other Ancient Capital University students.
In short, Old Bai bribed this cat with food.
And this time, it looked like it was going to be Shi Yu’s bodyguard.
Powerful gem cat, flowing Ancient Capital University student.
“Then do you want to bring any gifts?” Shi Yu asked.
The gem cat continued to yawn and said, “I’ll follow you. You can just give me a gift. In any case, apart from eating, I don’t want any treasures in Dragon Palace City.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Its goal was already obvious
Shi Yu had been exhausted the past few days. After returning, he took a shower and lay on the bed.
In the few days that he had been in the capital, Legend Bai, Principal Feng, and the others had already left Ping Cheng.
Therefore, Shi Yu was the only one left.
However, it was said that after the Ice Dragon completely left the snow mountain, Senior Lu and the others would come again. At that time, a big boss from the fourth bureau would cooperate to completely destroy the Ice River Totem and cut off the possibility of it reviving in the future.
While waiting for this big event and the start of the Dragon Palace banquet, Shi Yu had nothing to do. Apart from supervising the training of the four pets and honing his willpower, he meditated himself.
After reaching the master level, the difficulty of meditation multiplied again. If it was said that from initiate to master, one could reach it by piling time and resources, then the help of time and resources from master to legend was not that great.
It was time to rely on talent and pet feedback.
As the richest man in Ping Cheng, Lin Hongnian was stuck at the master level for decades. From this, one could tell how difficult it was after the master level.
Of course, it was also related to Hall Master Lin’s prodigal spending all his money on the Iron-eating Beast with no future.
In short, after the master level, the talent of the Beast Tamer was even more important. For example, Shi Yu’s physique was different from other Beast Tamers, so his meditation efficiency was pretty good. This was talent. Apart from that, the strengthening, evolution, and breakthrough of the pet was
also especially important to the master level’s advancement.
If the five pets contracted by a master-level Beast Tamer were all commander-level, it would be as difficult as ascending to the heavens for him to break through to a top-notch master.
However, if the five pets broke through to the monarch level one after another and gave the Beast Tamer huge positive feedback, the chances of the Beast Tamer breaking through to the top master level would be even higher.
This was also one of the reasons why high-level pets were expensive. In the later stages, if Beast Tamers wanted to become stronger faster, they had to rely on their pets to fight for some glory. Neither party could drag the other down.
Contracting an overlord species pet often gave a chance to become a new legendary Beast Tamer. It was not a random thing.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At this moment, Shi Yu was meditating in the ruins space, but he was suddenly shaken out by the gem cat.
“What’s wrong, what’s wrong? Is Senior Panda here?” Shi Yu asked. In the past few days, Senior Panda had come to massage Eleven every day to awaken the royal bloodline!
“I’s not a sister, it’s that old man.” The gem cat was also bored. “Phone.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Shi Yu picked it up. It was Principal Feng.
“The time to go to Dragon Palace City has been confirmed. In a month, the Tyrannical Sea Legend will bring you along. We’ll set off from the Binhai City next to your Icefield City.”
Shi Yu nodded.
Binhai City was also a second-level city, a city close to the sea. In fact, Icefield City was also a city close to the sea. Unfortunately, the area adjacent to the two was directly isolated and sealed by the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
A snow mountain not only prevented the people of Icefield City from seeing the sea, but also prevented the creatures of the sea from crossing the cold area to land.
“Alright, got it. Ice Dragon should be in time too. We’ll go together then. However, apart from me, who else is going with us” Shi Yu asked curiously.
He definitely wasn’t the only one going to Dragon Palace City… Shi Yu had long known.
Principal Feng laughed and said, “The final list hasn’t been confirmed, but there are ten confirmed now. Someone really got lucky with you.”
“on??”
The geniuses who could go to Dragon Palace City were all elites of Dong Huang. The Dong Huang Association naturally felt embarrassed to bring the Beast Tamer from Tai La to Dragon Palace City to visit. Therefore, the Dong Huang Association controlled the visiting list of Dragon Palace banquets every
five years especially strictly.
The younger generation accompanying them not only had to be Beast Tamers with extraordinary growth potential under the age of 30, but also Beast Tamers with enough connections to the dragons. Only in this way could both parties be satisfied and have a good outcome.
For example, Shi Yu’s spot was actually obtained from the channels of the third bureau and Bureau 11.
“Little White Brook will also go with you this time. The discovery of the Emperor Wu Ruins this time means that the Bai family isn’t far from rising. This kind of good thing of going to Dragon Palace City can naturally be easily obtained. Although she wants to contract the Iron-eating Beast, the evolution
of the Iron-eating Beast hasn’t even begun. There’s no harm in going to Dragon Palace City to take a look first. What if there’s a suitable partner? The Iron-eating Beast can be cultivated outside first. It’s not too late to contract it after becoming a top-notch master,” Principal Feng said.
“Senior Bai!” Shi Yu was stunned. Someone familiar was going, that was good.
“There’s also Dr. Zuo’s daughter, that girl, Xia Qingwei. Because of the exhibition of the Green Silkworm cocoon, along with the support of her legendary father and her doctor’s mother, and because she herself has a growth talent… It helps the slow growth of the dragon race. She also obtained the
opportunity to go to Dragon Palace City.”
Principal Feng could confirm that these two people could actually steadily obtain spots. It was really thanks to Shi Yu that the Iron-eating Beast’s second stage evolution and the Green Silkworm cocoon really had a huge impact.
“There are really many familiar faces…” Shi Yu said.
“Not only that, Yu Shu from the same batch as you. His mother also spent a lot of effort to help him get a spot. This is also someone you know. If I’m not wrong, Yin Legend should have also gotten a spot for Yin Zhengfan.”
Shi Yu: “?”
It was fine if it was Yin Zhengfan, this child was indeed a genius. But what the hell was Yu Shu? Although his mom was a top-notch Dragon Tamer, an existence only inferior to a legendary Dragon Tamer, didn’t Yu Shu inherit his father’s Soul Strengthening Talent? Was there a chance for him to go to
Dragon Palace City??
“You should know these people. You shouldn’t be familiar with the other five, but there are a few powerful figures among them, such as Little Zou from the Dark Club in Demon Capital. His strength isn’t inferior to Qingyi.”
Little Zou… Shi Yu was stunned. That Heavenly King Zou?
“Apart from that, there are also a few others. Some are from the Elemental Family, some from the Dragon Tamer Family, some from the Mechanical Family, and some are of the dragon race. You’ll know when you see them. You’re all geniuses of Dong Huang, so it’s not a bad thing to get to know each
other.”
Principal Feng and Shi Yu chatted for a while. In the end, Shi Yu hung up in a daze.. There were many people, but why did it sound like there was no pressure competing with these people for the young overlord of Dragon Palace City

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - The Strongest Beast Tamer in Icefield City
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: The Strongest Beast Tamer in Icefield City
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At Shi Yu’s house.
The gem cat was still watching the television leisurely.
This time, the television program changed from Digimon to a Card Captor Sakura.
At the side, Lin Xiuzhu was sitting cross-legged on the carpet.
On her legs was a panda the size of a cat [Eleven].
She kept rubbing Eleven’s body with her hands, and the golden light in her hands continued to flow into Eleven’s body.
Metal-element strengthening talent!
Metal-element nurturing method!
It was created by a general of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe under the command of Emperor Wu. It was used to stimulate and purify the Iron-eating Beast’s bloodline, and it could efficiently strengthen the power of metal-type pets.
“”Wuu.”
Eleven lay on Lin Xiuzhu’s thigh in enjoyment, making Shi Yu, who was beside him, sigh.
No wonder in his previous life, so many people wanted to become pandas, cats, and dogs, shouting obscure words like “humans are inferior to cats” and “humans are inferior to dogs”. So it was true. There were really people who lived worse than pets!
“Let’s rest and have some tea.”
Shi Yu squeezed the juice of the spiritual fruit made by Baby Ginseng and made tea before bringing it to Senior Panda and the gem cat.
“Thank you.”
Lin Xiuzhu smiled and patted Eleven’s head before drinking fruit tea with it.
‘The gem cat’s cup was teleported in front of it.
Shi Yu also picked up a cup and gulped it down.
At the same time, Shi Yu glanced at Eleven.
He discovered that during the activation of the royal bloodline, Eleven’s energy increase speed was not inferior to him adding points of racial skills.
After its bloodline power was purified, its physical strength increased, and naturally, its energy value increased.
“I wonder how long it will take to nurture it to activate the bloodline… But from the looks of it, it doesn’t seem to be a bad thing to nurture it for a long time?”
Shi Yu analyzed in his heart.
“Oh, right.” Lin Xiuzhu put down the teacup and glanced at Shi Yu.
“Isn’t it still the holidays? Aren’t you going to class?”
“Uh.” Shi Yu choked. Why did he mention class for no reason?
It was quite unlucky. During the period when Shi Yu was trapped in the Emperor Wu Ruins, more than half of the semester passed.
If he went back to class now, it would also be the end of the semester. Why would he go back? To fail the exam?
Since he had already skipped class, he would carry it out to the end.
“Tm not going. In any case, apart from a few classes in my first year, the rest are basically useless to me,” Shi Yu said.
In his previous life, he selectively learnt only what he wanted. What he came into contact with had always been mythical history regarded by his peers as unscientific and frivolous things.
Compared to Earth, which viewed myths as ethereal things, there were too many archeologists here. The history of the Mythical Era was the domain that all archeologists and even Beast Tamers wanted to explore the most.
“ah, forget it. As long as you’re happy,” said the panda senior.
“Tch.” The gem cat finished drinking the fruit juice and was sure that Shi Yu was very happy.
Who would be willing to go to work and attend classes if they could slack off?
According to its many years of experience, those who dared to brazenly skip classes in Ancient Capital University would most likely become big bosses in the future.
Did a powerful archeologist become strong through studying?
No!
Through courting death!
“Stop talking about me. That Beast Tamer Troops… The Iron-eating Beast Army Plan. How’s the progress?” Shi Yu changed the topic.
Initially, the subsequent people wanted Shi Yu to be in charge of this plan to strengthen Shi Yu’s foundation in the military. This would also be beneficial to Shi Yu in the future, but he directly rejected them.
Aplan that had yet to take shape… If they couldn’t find Yun An, this plan would be equivalent to wasting time. It would be a waste of time to take responsibility.
“Ah, it might still be a while… I guess we’ll start after the matters at the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain are settled,” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“That’s soon. What are Uncle Lin and the others doing recently? Clearing the snow mountain?”
“Yes.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded. “We need to deepen the development of a large area of resources, then drive and settle a group of transcendent creatures, but I wonder how their progress is.”
Now, the Ice Dragon had advanced to the totem level. As a dragon that had received the reward of the Time Emperor and had time-type skills, even at the peak of the Ice River Totem, it would probably be very difficult for it to defeat the Ice Dragon.
However, as an ice-element totem, even if the Ice River Totem was at its last breath and extremely weak, and had yet to successfully revive, it was very difficult for the ice dragon to completely kill it.
If they wanted to completely eliminate the possibility of the Ice River Totem reviving, they had to permanently change the environment around the Ice Dragon Ruins. Only then would the Ice River Totem be slowly destroyed.
Apart from totems of other attributes, only mechanical weapons could do this.
‘The Dong Huang Association decided to send a member of the fourth bureau to carry a small forbidden weapon and permanently transform the Ice Dragon Ruins of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain into a flaming area. Before doing this, the resources and transcendent creatures in the surrounding area
definitely had to be reaped and dealt with.
