At the moment, the Beast Tamer Troops in Ping Cheng were carrying out this mission.
“Then I’ll go over to take a look in the afternoon and get some air,” Shi Yu said.
“Huh? You’re going to the snow mountain?”
“Yes, I want to climb over the snow mountain and take a look at the place close to the sea.”
Shi Yu realized that apart from Buggy being better at materializing snowstorms and thunderstorms in Imagination, its ability in materializing deep seas and volcanoes was relatively crude.
It was mainly because of its knowledge.
Buggy had gone to the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and personally crossed the snowstorm. It had also seen the thunderstorm Eleven attracted and could even use Eleven’s Lightning Rod as a materialization equipment. It was naturally not a problem to simulate these.
However, as it had never come into contact with the deep sea and had only come into contact with lakes and waterfalls, it was still relatively troublesome to create the deep sea.
Moreover, Buggy had never come into contact with many pets living in the ocean. It couldn’t even create sparring partners that were more interesting and from the deep sea. Eleven and the others were almost tired of fighting the Dragon Carp to evolve every day.
In addition, as he was going to Dragon Palace City soon, Shi Yu wanted to let Eleven and the others come into contact with the sea as soon as possible so that they wouldn’t show their fear when the time came. At least Baby Ginseng didn’t know how to swim. Shi Yu remembered that.
It was fine if it couldn’t fly, but it couldn’t swim either. It was too much.
“This… is a little dangerous.” Senior Panda was stunned.
“It’s not dangerous, not dangerous. I’ll drag Teacher Cat along,” Shi Yu said.
“Oh right.”
The gem cat:??
Did it even say yes?
After carrying out the devil training method for two days, Shi Yu’s four pets were much more energetic. However, Shi Yu felt that it was a pity that the teaching success rate still didn’t change much. It looked like the training of willpower was a long way off.
wal! “Wout!!!” “vil! vi
After lunch, when they heard that they were going to see the sea, the four pets cheered.
Eleven was celebrating, Its idea was that the Deep Sea Training Grounds could be even more realistic and cruel soon. Great, it was one step closer to the overlord’s will.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong were cheering. They could finally take half a day off.
However, soon, when they thought that they were going to replicate the training ground this time, they couldn’t help but cry again.
“This time, we’ll fly over together and test our training results.”
“Chi Tong and I will fuse. Eleven, you use the Electric Magnetic Floating. Buggy, you fly yourself. Baby Ginseng, you… You sit on the flying carpet with Teacher Ying. It will deliberately reduce the defense facilities to let you experience the snowstorm.”
Ginseng Baby: QAQ
It wanted to learn plant control quickly.
At that time, it could transform its battle aura… No, its energy into wings and condense equipment like the Leaf Wings.
Although the transcendent Multiplication Skill had a slight function of plant control, the changes were still much smaller than super skills.
Baby Ginseng had specially learned in class that when plant control was mastered to a high proficiency, it could even awaken ordinary plants into transcendent life like the Awakening Talent and the Awakening Mirror.
Baby Ginseng was looking forward to it!
In the moming, after Senior Panda finished massaging Eleven, Shi Yu and the others started to set off for the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in the afternoon.
Shi Yu and the others couldn’t be bothered to follow the procedures. They directly passed through the city wall through Instant Transmission.
Soon, a few figures appeared in the sky of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
Red-haired, Chi Tong, and Shi Yu, who was wearing the Flame Demon Armor, flew at the front.
Beside him, Eleven’s body was filled with weak white lightning as it flew to Shi Yu’s left.
As for Buggy, it flapped its wings and flew to Shi Yu’s right with the snowstorm on its weak body.
Although Buggy could rely on the Dragon of Imagination to obtain a physique comparable to a divine dragon, its physical strength in its normal state was actually still that of a worm.
It was very weak and basically couldn’t withstand two moves. It couldn’t compare to Eleven, so there was no harm in training. After all, the higher the basic attributes, the better the effect after being strengthened by the skill.
Behind Shi Yu and the others, the gem cat lay on the Psychic Flying Carpet and dozed off to supervise Baby Ginseng. The group quickly entered the snowstorm area.
“Wait
However, as they flew, Shi Yu suddenly shouted, making everyone stop.
Now, Chi Tong had also been taught super vision, absolute sleep, multiplication, and other skills by Shi Yu.
Under its possession, Shi Yu could naturally obtain some enhancements in skills. With his super vision, Shi Yu quickly discovered that there was a camp stationed in the snowstorm area in front.
From the markings, it seemed to be the Beast Tamer Troops of Ping Cheng.
“What a coincidence.” Shi Yu was surprised. Then, he said, “Let’s go over and greet him.”
“Wuu ~”
Eleven and the others nodded. The gem cat naturally didn’t mind. At the same time, it said, “They seem to be in trouble.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
Soon, Shi Yu landed.
He had discovered the Beast Tamer Troops, but the Beast Tamer Troops didn’t discover him immediately. The detection effect of transcendent super vision was still strong. Although it wasn’t as powerful as the super-level Heavenly Eye that supervised the vocation assessment, it wasn’t bad either.
Shi Yu and the others landed. Shi Yu exited his possession form, Little Chi Tong turned into the Little Red Sparrow’s spiritual body and landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder. It used his beak to tend to its red soul feather.
“Who is it!”
As Shi Yu and the others approached, the soldiers patrolling nearby reacted. A few young men in blue camouflage clothes immediately led a few snow wolves to surround them!
However, when they saw Shi Yu’s appearance and the few pets beside him, they were quickly stunned.
“Tm Shi Yu. Are Commander Wang Meng and Commander He Biao around?” Shi Yu asked.
“Professor Shi Yu?!” The soldiers were stunned. After confirming Shi Yu’s identity, they immediately stood at attention and saluted. With surprise and respect in their eyes, they said, “Professor Shi Yu. Commander Wang, Commander He are all here!”
At that moment, Shi Yu, who had cracked the Ice Dragon Ruins, was a popular person in Icefield City. The soldiers of the Beast Tamer Troops who were basically stationed near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain had all seen Shi Yu’s photo.
Perhaps they didn’t know about Shi Yu’s other deeds, but just the fact that he had discovered the truth of the history of Icefield City was enough to make Shi Yu famous in the Icefield.
At that moment, although Shi Yu was still a student, this group of soldiers used the title of professor to express their respect for Shi Yu’s identity.
Soon, the boorish Commander Wang Meng, Commander He Biao, and Master Lin came over. Shi Yu quite admired Master Lin. As the richest man in Ping Cheng, theoretically speaking, it was enough for him to just rest at home. However, every time the Beast Tamer Troops had important missions, he
would rush to the front line. He was also considered a ruthless person. Not only did he love the pandas, but he also loved Ping Cheng.
“shi Yu? Why are you here?” Hall Master Lin was surprised when he saw Shi Yu.
“Holy shit, isn’t this Brother Shi Yu?” The uncultured Deputy Commander He Biao said. He had been cursing since the Ping Cheng ruins.
“Uh.” Commander Wang Meng’s attention was on the gem cat on the flying carpet behind Shi Yu. After many years of life and death experience, he vaguely felt that this cat that looked like it was raising a noble was a little scary.
“Came out for some air and train,” Shi Yu said.
Everyone :”…”
Especially those soldiers of the Beast Tamer Troops. The corners of their mouths twitched. Coming to such a dangerous place to train alone was ridiculous.
“Uncle Lin, did you encounter any difficulties?” Shi Yu asked.
Lin Hongnian, Wang Meng, and Commander He Biao looked at each other.
Then, he looked at Shi Yu and said, “How do you know… I did encounter a little trouble.”
“How can I help?” Shi Yu asked.
“This…” Hall Master Lin was just about to say that Shi Yu couldn’t help much, but suddenly, he saw the gem cat in surprise.
After thinking about it, he still explained, “We’re currently sweeping the resources in the designated area and chasing away the ferocious beasts. It was originally quite smooth, but a level-seven resource was accidentally born in an area. Earth Mystic Ice.”
“Level-seven resource??” Shi Yu was stunned.
‘What kind of dog shit luck was this in Ping Cheng? The price of a level-seven resource was rarely lower than 100 million. It was a resource that was very useful for overlord-level pets. Meeting a level-seven resource in a place like the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain was simply like picking up money for
nothing.
“I’s a good thing, What’s wrong?” Shi Yu pressed.
“I’s a good thing…” Hall Master Lin smiled bitterly and said,” But the problem is that we weren’t the first to discover it. There were four powerful monarch-level ferocious beasts in the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. They also discovered the Earth Mystic Ice long ago and died guarding that side. They should
have reached some kind of agreement and absorbed it together. As long as we get close, that side will be extremely hostile, and the deterrence will wrap around the snowstorm. ”
“Although we also have four monarch-level pets here, but…” Lin Hongnian secretly glanced at Wang and Commander He.
It was clear as day.
Commander Wang Meng and Commander He: !!
“Those four monarch-level ferocious beasts are all relatively powerful ferocious beasts in the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. They are all monarch races. If we fight, there will definitely be some injuries. Our military strength isn’t very strong, so we’re making plans to return to Ping Cheng and contact the city
to send reinforcements.”
Commander Wang Meng and Commander He Biao were actually relatively ordinary masters. There was only one monarch-level pet.
It might not necessarily be a monarch race.
When faced with such a situation, there was really a little pressure.
However, a level-seven resource definitely couldn’t be let go.
If Ping Cheng couldn’t handle it, he would let the Icefield Association handle it.
“Tsee. That’s easy. Leave it to me,” Shi Yu said indifferently. “Is it over there?”
He looked to the south where the aura he had sensed was the strongest.
“Huh?”
Commander Wang Meng and Commander He Biao were stunned and couldn’t react.
Instead, Hall Master Lin looked at the gem cat with a thieving gaze and said, “Can you, Lord Ying? You take the majority of the gains!!”
“By the way, this is the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University, Teacher Ying who once participated in the Ancient Capital’s Undead Disaster 100 years ago. It’s the guardian of Ancient Capital University and is very strong.”
Hall Master Lin hurriedly introduced it to the two commanders, telling them to be more tactful and cozy up to him.
Although the army had the priority to deal with and explore the resources discovered by the Beast Tamer Troops first, in this situation, if the gem cat was willing to help, it was completely fine to let it take the majority.
“This!” Commander Wang and Commander He were shocked.
Holy shit.
They widened their eyes and looked at the gem cat on the flying carpet.
Overlord level?!
“Twant to.” The gem cat licked its claws. It was just four monarch-level ferocious beasts, so it naturally didn’t care much. It didn’t even blink when it encountered more than ten monarch-level undead in the Undead Battlefield, let alone now.
However, while others couldn’t hear Shi Yu’s tone, how could it not?
Shi Yu clearly wanted to do it himself.
How could Shi Yu, who had monarch-level battle power now, hand such a good thing to it??
No more love.
Shi Yu was no longer the guy who cowered when he encountered monarch-level ferocious beasts.
“It’s in that direction, right? If you can’t handle it, T’ll back you up?” The gem cat asked Shi Yu.
No matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat. It still had to save money to buy resources to break through to the totem level
Shi Yu chuckled and the cat’s face fell.
Everyone:
“Let’s go take a look. Commander Wang, Commander He, Uncle Lin, want to go over together?”
“Ah.” The three of them naturally had to go over.
In a moment, Buggy’s Psychic Domain wrapped around everyone and used Group Teleport, leaving behind a group of stunned soldiers.
In the snowstorm area of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, in a huge ice and snow cave that connected to the underground, four monarch-level ferocious beasts surrounded a huge nail-shaped ice that connected the ground to the top of the cave, absorbing the energy of the ice.
Blue Sea Ruins:?
A moment later, deterrence erupted from their bodies. The four ferocious beasts revealed ferocious gazes and looked outside the cave.
Originally… it was already bad enough that they couldn’t enjoy the resource alone. Now that humans came to disturb them one after another, the four ferocious beasts no longer had a good temper.
If it weren’t for the fact that they were afraid of Hall Master Lin and the others’ monarch-level pets, they would have long attacked and not just released a deterrence warning.
“Roar!
Outside the cave, Shi Yu and the others were teleported over. At the same time, four ferocious snow beasts appeared from the cave.
It looked like a reindeer, an ice-blue Iceberg Ridge Beast with two homs like white snow mountains.
There was also the Frost Snow King, who was tall like a snowman and a snow monster, covered in white ice and snow and had narrowed blood-colored eyes.
There was one that had a light blue body, a white-spotted body that looked like a snow leopard, and a pair of eye-catching ice wings. It was the White Winged Sky Lord.
There was also a cloud-type creature that lingered in the air. It looked like a white snow cloud and a tornado, the Ice Curtain Cloud.
The four ferocious beasts were all monarch races and monarchs. The moment they appeared, Shi Yu’s index jumped crazily, showing that their energy levels were not lower than 1.5 million.
Generally speaking, the energy value of a monarch race at the monarch level was about 1 million according to the normal state.
As for the lowest energy value of an overlord race, the monarch level, it was about two million.
Of course, this referred to the lower limit and the normal situation where they had never trained much. As for wanting to gain more strength, they had to rely on themselves, either to increase their racial skills or to use various rare resources.
Shi Yu heard that the guardian monarch of Icefield City, that Aunt Ancient Tree of Life, had a fortuitous encounter. Its energy even exceeded five million. As just a monarch race, it crushed all the overlord races.
These four wild ferocious beasts could survive a few snow mountain sweeps. Their abilities were clearly not weak. No wonder Hall Master Lin and the others were also very afraid.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, the White Winged Sky Lord was the first to roar, staring at Hall Master Lin and the others who had arrived again with a ruthless gaze.
A substantial deterrence directly erupted. It was actually a perfect deterrence.
Under the deterrence, the snow and wind were crushed. The sky was white. The snow clouds seemed to have missed a big hole, and the snow was like a knife. Just from its deterrence, it could be seen that its length was above the pets of Hall Master Lin and the others.
“Holy shit.”
Seeing that this White Wings Sky Lord was so unstable and the deterrence power was even stronger than before, Old He directly cursed. They had yet to start fighting.
With that said, he looked at the gem cat, wanting to see the overlord-level big boss attack.
However, they realized that Shi Yu really seemed to want to do it himself.
“Didn’t you eat lunch? Such weak deterrence…” Shi Yu asked.
Blue Sea Ruins:?
As the deterrence came, Shi Yu was the quickest. Ripples appeared in front of him.
Then, shocking cold air spewed out. A blue divine sword slowly appeared from the alternate space. Shi Yu directly raised his hand and held it in his hand.
“Roar!
A terrifying dragon roar emitted from the sword, as well as a terrifying dragon might that swept out. The powerful ice and snow dragon might instantly collided with the deterrence of the White Winged Sky Lord and squeezed. The terrifying dragon might attacked, making the pupils of the four pets
opposite instantly shrink.
Crack!
The two deterrence forces shattered in mid-air. The four pets showed wary expressions and didn’t continue to release deterrence.
The source of deterrence in the Ice Dragon Blade was the level-seven dragon whisker that the Ice Dragon had given Shi Yu that allowed him to walk around casually in the snow mountain with the Ice Dragon Might. At this moment, the four Ice Snow Monarchs that often sensed the dragon might emitted
from the Ice Dragon Ruins realized they were facing dragon might. How could they not be afraid? After all, they had all grown up trembling under the dragon might.
Not only them, but Commander Wang, Commander He, and Hall Master Lin also widened their eyes. Holy shit, what was this?
It didn’t look like a pet… But.
Looking at the Ice Snow Divine Sword in Shi Yu’s hand that emitted dragon might, after the three old men were shocked, their gazes lit up in unison as they understood.
This was an extremely high-level spiritual equipment!! It was at least level-seven!!
Otherwise, it was impossible for it to resist a monarch-level deterrence so easily!
[Rich guy!]
Commander Wang and Commander He were immediately shocked.
Even Hall Master Lin licked his lips. Shi Yu was really generous. Investing in money to nurture pets and investing in money to buy and build inanimate equipment without growth… Normal people would choose the former.
“The Earth Mystic Ice is fated to be mine. Do you want to leave yourselves, or do you want me to send you away?” With both hands holding the sword, Shi Yu stabbed the Ice Dragon Blade into the ground. Shi Yu placed his hands on the sword hilt and looked at the four monarch-level ferocious beasts
quietly.
“Roar!!!”
“Roar!!!”
Shi Yu was telepathic, so the four ferocious beasts naturally understood its words. They couldn’t help but reveal unfriendly gazes.
Impossible!!!
If it were ordinary times, they might have walked around Shi Yu, but the ice inside was a huge opportunity for their strength to increase. Not only could it strengthen their ice-clement power, but there might also be a chance to transform their ice-element energy into ice to obtain new super skills. How
could they give up!
“Don’t let them go. These four guys participated in the beast tide ten years ago,” Lin Hongnian shouted.
Shi Yu was stunned and immediately said, “I understand. They can’t escape and will get themselves killed.”
“Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, distribute the opponents and end the battle quickly,” Shi Yu said from the side.
Commander Wang, Commander He, and Hall Master Lin:??
The three masters were stunned when they heard Shi Yu’s words.
“Wuu!” In the next moment, Eleven slowly walked forward.
“Wu ~” Buggy also nodded and flew forward.
“Yi ~” Baby Ginseng was the same. It jumped down from the flying carpet with an invincible expression and posed coquettishly, its sweetness spreading.
“Screech ~” Chi Tong flew up from Shi Yu’s shoulder without hesitation.
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain F4:??
The four ferocious beasts looked at the little Iron-eating Beast, Butterfly, Baby Ginseng, and Little Red Sparrow that walked out with confused expressions.
Even with their wild nature, they could sense that the strength of these four guys was pitifully weak. They couldn’t compare to them and were far inferior to the Ice Dragon Blade in Shi Yu’s hand.
However, although the power didn’t pose a threat, in the next moment, the four ferocious beasts noticed Baby Ginseng. Their gazes couldn’t help but slowly become serious, and the more they looked, the more serious they became. Until saliva subconsciously flowed out of the corners of their mouths.
This.
“Roar!!!” The Snow Wings Sky Lord was the smartest. As the cells all over its body trembled, it widened its eyes and roared.
Impossible!!
Why was this ginseng baby.
Inan instant, its brain exploded, and its thoughts changed. It analyzed a huge matter that would affect its life!
It didn’t need the black ice… but this ginseng baby… It had to eat it!
“Roar!!!” The Frost Monster’s blood-colored eyes also opened, and it subconsciously swallowed its saliva.
“Roar ~!!!” The Iceberg beast was in a riot. It instantly felt that the ice inside was no longer fragrant.
Even the elemental creature, Ice Curtain Cloud, was very shocked. For some reason, it suddenly felt that this ginseng baby was more attractive to it than the elemental resource, Earth Mystic Ice.
‘The Ice Curtain Cloud that was supposed to snow started to rain like drool.
In an instant, the four monarch -level ferocious beasts seemed to have lost their minds.
In the next moment, the four pets on Shi Yu’s side also obeyed Shi Yu’s command and started to take medicine.
Buggy directly took out the Time Fruit x4 from the spatial pocket and instantly teleported them in front of Eleven and the others.
Awhite Time Fruit the size of a peanut appeared in Eleven’s hand. Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng had also received a similar sized one, and Buggy had left itself the smallest one.
In the next moment, the four of them ate the Time Fruit together.
“Uh…”
At the same time, the four ferocious beasts pounced over crazily.
All of them headed towards Baby Ginseng. At this moment, the attraction on Baby Ginseng’s body had reached the extreme. Even the four ferocious beasts couldn’t bear to use their skills, afraid that Baby Ginseng’s delicate body would be broken and it wouldn’t be delicious anymore!
Now, they only wanted to swallow it in one bite.
The four monarch-level ferocious beasts had never thought that they would be so delicate and gentle when it came to a resource.
“Roar!”
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, the expressions of the three masters in Ping Cheng changed. However, in the next moment, what made their expressions change was that incomparably huge and shocking violent auras erupted from Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, exploding like volcanoes!
“Boom!” Although Eleven still maintained its Iron-eating Beast form, its body instantly surged with power that seemed to have been compressed to the extreme. Then, it suddenly exploded. Lightning wrapped around its body, making it look like a thunder god.
“Wuu!!!”
Eleven roared and opened its eyes. Lightning seemed to shoot out of its mouth and eyes.
Zi Zi Zi Zi Zi!!!
Its figure directly disappeared from the spot, leaving a charred pit. When it appeared again, it had already appeared above the two-meter-tall Iceberg Ridge Beast.
At this moment, the Iceberg Ridge Beast was stepping on the ice and snow to attack, but in the next moment, its pupils suddenly constricted, and its gaze was shocked to the extreme. Just as it was about to turn around and look up, a huge impact had already descended!
Time seemed to have frozen. At this moment, Eleven’s speed made the Iceberg Ridge Beast unable to react at all. Eleven, who had its hands clenched into fists, directly gave the monarch a Thunder God Hammer from top to bottom with the power of lightning!
Boom!!!
Under the attack, the snow under the feet of the Iceberg Spine instantly disappeared. A huge hole more than ten meters in diameter appeared with a bang. As the Iceberg Spine’s body fell apart, it was like a blue stream of light that was hammered into the underground abyss!
On the other side, the Frost Snow King’s gaze was also instantly filled with extreme horror. The place it was standing at was also above the huge hole. However, it was floating in the sky at this moment. Its entire body was controlled by a wave of Psychic power, and its body was filled with a blue Psychic
power that was like a chaotic stream.
The Frost Snow King kept struggling, and its body kept deforming, Its begging gaze met the Imagination Butterfly opposite it, but in the next moment, Buggy directly strengthened its Psychic power. With a bang, the Frost Snow King’s entire body was instantly crushed by the Psychic power, turning into
snow and wind that scattered in all directions.
In mid-air, the White Wing Sky Lord, who was flying with its wings spread, almost instantly calmed down. How could it still be obsessed with the ginseng baby in front of it? At this moment, its body was warned to the extreme. It only wanted to escape now. However, although it was the fastest of the
four ferocious beasts, when it reacted, it was still too late. A golden pillar of light had already penetrated its head.
Beneath the hole in its head was the incomprehensible gaze of the White Wings Sky Lord. In its vision, the ginseng baby that emitted a fragrance had six-pointed stars spinning in its pupils. It was pointing at it with its finger, and there were still the afterimages of light in the air.
The most miserable was the Ice Curtain Cloud. Opposite it, the sparrow-sized Chi Tong only casually flapped its wings. Then, with a whoosh, dazzling orange-red light spread. The sun in the sky shone to the extreme. A huge solar wind storm was formed by the energy released by Chi Tong’s body, and
then it tumed into a heat wave that attacked the Ice Curtain Cloud.
Even if the Ice Curtain Cloud instantly raised its strength to the extreme, when the power of ice and snow touched the Sun Flame, the ice and snow still instantly tumed into a pool of snow water. Almost instantly, the Ice Curtain Cloud disappeared from the world.
They wanted to end the battle quickly. Ina short exchange, the four powerful monarch-level ferocious beasts all lost their life characteristics, leaving Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong behind to watch the aftermath of the battle.
At this moment, the gem cat was alright, but Lin Hongnian, Commander Wang Meng, Commander He Biao, and the others behind Shi Yu opened their mouths to the extreme. Their eyes wanted to pop out as they looked at everything in disbelief.
“Tt could have been easier, but he had to go through so much trouble,” the gem cat muttered.
Just now, Shi Yu’s four pets had used the Time Fruit and obtained some of the power after breaking through.
Although he didn’t know how much all their strength was after breaking through, after using the Time Fruit to stimulate their strength just now, each of them had more than 3 million energy points. The ginseng baby with the best effect of absorbing the Time Fruit even reached nearly 4 million. It was
ridiculously high, and the one with the lowest strength was more than twice the monarch in front of it.
In addition, their skill proficiency didn’t have any shortcomings. In an instant, this scene that shattered the values of the three masters of Ping Cheng appeared. The three masters of Ping Cheng stuttered as they looked at all of this, instantly losing their ability to speak!
{Not bad.]
[However, it’s not the limit.]
Shi Yu looked at all of this and nodded. After all, this was the result of Baby Ginseng controlling the strength of the Time Fruit, and it wasn’t the Time Fruit that it condensed with all its might! Shi Yu naturally knew Eleven and the others’ potential.
If Baby Ginseng transformed itself into a Time Fruit and let Eleven and the others eat it, Eleven and the others would probably instantly obtain overlord-level battle power and crush everything. It wouldn’t be as simple as a simple monarch level.
Unfortunately, Baby Ginseng was too weak at the moment. The level of the Time Fruit was limited. The greater the increase in the level of the pet, the greater the price. The price of using the commander level to stimulate all its potential to enter the overlord level was that Baby Ginseng had to completely
sacrifice itself. Eleven and the others would also die after this.
Shi Yu definitely couldn’t accept this. Baby Ginseng could revive, but Eleven and the others couldn’t.
But even so, Shi Yu, who had this trump card, could currently be called a top-notch master!
The so-called top-notch master was the Beast Tamer at level 5 and 6 of the Beast Taming Space. His battle power could temporarily fight against overlord-level creatures!
It was at the level of Senior Lu, Zou Tianwang, and the others.
At the moment, although the price of Shi Yu resisting the overlord was a little high, it had to be known that Eleven and the others had yet to really enter the monarch level. If they waited until their growth level really stepped into the monarch level before eating the Time Fruit to stimulate their potential
and temporarily obtain the power to resist the overlord, the price might not be as terrifying as death.
The will of an overlord, the level of a monarch… At the moment, he still lacked the will of an overlord. As long as he fulfilled these conditions, Shi Yu had enough strength to wander around. He could go to the ruins that he didn’t dare to explore previously.
“This, this, this, this…” At the moment, the three masters of Ping Cheng had yet to react. Lin Hongnian was extremely shocked. He didn’t understand why Shi Yu, who was still a Beast Tamer intern a year ago, had his strength increase at such a godly speed.
“Shi Yu, you…”
“Uh.” Shi Yu scratched his head and said, “Sort of a cheat.”
“Maybe I’d be banned if this were a game.”
The three masters:???
‘The three masters looked over. In the next moment, the Iron-eating Beast, the Imagination Butterfly, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong that had flaunted their might just now directly withered. They fell to the ground and fainted.
‘The Four Holy Beasts: “Zzz ~”
Of course, Shi Yu knew that this was the side effect of the Time Fruit. However, because Eleven and the others could break through to the monarch level at any time, they were only suppressing their levels at the moment. This side effect of jumping levels was almost equivalent to none. As long as they
slept for a few minutes and healed at a high speed, they could eliminate the side effect.
The three masters opened their mouths slightly. They couldn’t understand.
Shi Yu smiled and didn’t explain too much. The Time Fruit wasn’t very useful to the three masters, so he didn’t sell it. They didn’t have overlord race pets, nor did they have young monarch race pets. They were also at the peak of their prime. No matter how strong the Time Fruit was, it was useless to
them. Its current use was even inferior to a nutrient.
This skill, when used on the user, was best used on a high potential pet like Shi Yu, who had a bunch of overlord potential.
“Let’s go in and take a look at the Earth Mystic Ice,” Shi Yu said. At the same time, the four pets in Absolute Sleep were taken back by Shi Yu to rest in the Beast Taming Space. He planned to let them out in ten minutes.
“Ah… Alright.” Facing Shi Yu, the three masters were a little stunned, especially Commander Wang Meng and Commander He. Previously, Shi Yu only had a high status, but now, with Shi Yu’s battle power, he could completely rank in the top five in Icefield City, alright?
There weren’t many top-notch masters in the entire Icefield City, but Shi Yu’s strength was definitely above all the ordinary masters in Icefield City. Which ordinary master-level Beast Tamer in Icefield City dared to say that they could instantly kill four monarch-level ferocious beasts?
Perhaps before long, Shi Yu would become the strongest in Icefield City. The three of them were silent… They were curious about how the Beast Tamers in the historical legends were compared to Shi Yu. In any case, they felt that those ordinary legends were inferior to Shi Yu!
On the opposite side of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, in the endless sea.
Deep Sea Dragon Palace City.
Ina dazzling hall, a huge green divine dragon roared inside, its anger causing the endless sea to tremble.
“Lord Sea Dragon King, calm down, calm down, calm down…”
A thousand-year-old turtle was sweating heavily, advising this lord not to be angry.
“Calm down my ass. I told you to look after that guy. Where’s the dragon??”
“The Dragon Palace banquet is about to begin. The sea beasts in the surrounding sea are all heading to Dragon Palace City. What does it mean by sneaking out at this time??”
“With its trouble-maker physique, there will definitely be a problem. An unlucky person will definitely be beaten up by it again!”
“Ah, this… Lord Sea Dragon King, please calm down. It’s all my fault. The crown prince is just playful. Perhaps, he’ll come back later. We’ve already sent troops to search.”
‘The Sea Dragon King was still angry. Although all sea beasts above the monarch level in the huge sea area knew its child, and that idiot wouldn’t really encounter danger, it was still angry.
“Scram and get it back quickly.”
On the other side, a white divine dragon flew towards the distant land and snow mountain with smiles of joy. Since it was restricted all the time in the seax, it would come to land.. It hoped that the extraordinary creatures on land would be able to take more hits from it and not let it return disappointed.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - Dragon Palace City’s Third Prince
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Dragon Palace City’s Third Prince
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Is this Earth Mystic Ice?”
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, Underground Ice Cave.
As Shi Yu and the others finished off the four monarchs, the group arrived at the birthplace of the Earth Ice.
The Earth Mystic Ice was quietly inserted between the ground and the roof of the cave, emitting a strong cold air.
The faint cold light was terrifying, The ice surface was like a mirror that could reflect everyone’s appearance.
“Yes, Earth Mystic Ice, a strengthening resource.”
“Tt can increase the energy intensity of the ice-element monarch. There’s a chance for the ice-element monarch to awaken the super skill ‘Earth Mystic Ice’.”
Looking at the nail-shaped ice pillar in front of them, Commander He Biao and Commander Wang Meng almost drooled.
Their pets were all ice-element… After absorbing this, their battle power would also increase explosively. It was no wonder that the group of ice-element monarchs were unwilling to give in.
If they could awaken another super skill, that would be even more impressive.
Although super skills awakened by these resources could only be considered taught skills and couldn’t lead to their own growth like racial skills, who would dislike having more super skills?
This kind of simple strengthening-type resource was very rare, and the price was relatively expensive. After Shi Yu saw it, he analyzed how much this could be sold for.
“It looks pretty good,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu had actually never used such a high-level strengthening resource.
The high energy values of his pets were all brought about by the increase in racial skills, not enhanced by resources.
The classic example of relying on resources to strengthen energy was the monarch of the Ancient Tree of Life that protected the evolution holy spring in Icefield City. Its five million energy points were obtained because it was nourished by the evolution holy spring earth vein for decades.
This was a paywall strategy.
It was the same principle as the gem cat wanting to rely on level-nine strengthening-type resources to break through to the totem level and not wanting to rely on skills to break through. No matter which path it was, it could bring about a breakthrough in strength.
“Yes, yes, it’s just not easy to take it away…” Commander Wang Meng said.
The Earth Mystic Ice was a natural treasure that needed to be connected to the icy plain to maintain its form. If it was taken away and there were no suitable preservation devices, the energy would quickly leak out. It was a semi-fixed resource. At the moment, the Beast Tamer Troops definitely didn’t
prepare any storage instruments.
“Don’t you have a suitable preservation device?” Shi Yu said when he saw everyone hesitate.
“Who can predict such a thing in advance? There are, but not so big,” Hall Master Lin said.
“Eh, right, don’t you have a ruins space? That place should be able to store it, right? Why don’t we put it there first? We can save the trouble of going back to get the equipment. It would be bad if other monarchs were attracted during this period. Moreover, we have a bunch of other missions to do…”
Hall Master Lin’s suggestion made Commander Wang and Commander He nod. When Shi Yu heard that, he thought it was alright. He said, “Alright then.”
Then, the few of them got busy. A moment later, Shi Yu moved the entire Earth Mystic Ice into the iceberg area of the ruins space. After that, everyone divided into two paths. Shi Yu and the others chose to continue to the beach, while the Beast Tamer Troops chose to continue sweeping the resources
around the Ice Dragon Ruins.
“Wow, selling it is another large sum of money. You’ve earned a lot.” After the three masters left, the gem cat said, “Unfortunately, you don’t have an ice-type pet. Otherwise, this Earth Mystic Ice would still be a very good strengthening resource.”
“Ican’t use it, I can’t use it…” Shi Yu immediately said.
Shi Yu felt that it was a loss to use strengthening-type resources to strengthen the pet’s energy strength.
He felt that it was far inferior to buying evolution materials to bet on evolution and transform resources into the racial potential of pets.
At that time, he would have potential and strength!
Strengthening-type resources were equivalent to strengthening strength on the original race of the pet. And evolution-type resources, if used appropriately, directly increased the upper limit of the pet’s potential and strength. Shi Yu would rather invest resources in evolution materials.
Then, he could increase the pet’s strength by adding some skills. This was the most cost-effective ratio for him.
“What do you mean, “you can’t’?!” The cat didn’t like hearing this.
It said, “When are we going to commercialize the Time Fruit? It’s fine if the Nutrition Fruit is commercialized, too. There’s also Eleven’s weapon and Buggy’s equipment. Why don’t we build a company? If you’re not free, I’ll be in charge of managing it. Just stir-fry a few goods occasionally. There’s no need
to make them in large batches. Things are more precious when they’re rare.”
“When the time comes, we’ll split the profits!!! You’ll be a big boss, I’ll just have a sip of soup. How about that! It’s mainly because I can help you expand the pet market.”
“know a bunch of guys like the Prediction Owl. They’re rich too. They’re all idiots.”
The gem cat said in anticipation. It really felt that Shi Yu’s pets were pretty good at making money. It would be a pity if it didn’t operate it.
After Shi Yu became a legendary Beast Tamer, these would be brand resources!!
“What are you planning…”
“Save up money. Just treat it as preparations in advance for Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others to break through to the overlord level!” the gem cat said.
“But didn’t they say that overlords who rely on resources to strengthen themselves are relatively weak? We should obediently train super racial skills…”
The gem cat:??
“You’re no longer children. Why can’t you have both?”
“Relying on super skills to break through to an overlord… compared to relying on super skills and legendary resources to break through to an overlord. Which one do you think is stronger?”
“The weak overlord level is beaten up by the monarch level. The strong overlord level can fight against the totem level one or two. You won’t lose out, child.”
“We can’t lose at the starting line.”
As the gem cat spoke, it was convinced. Shi Yu’s face darkened.
Hey, hey, hey, this cat was persuading people to spend money
Legendary-level resources were all worth ten billion. Who could afford to use this?
Resources below level eight were actually still popular in the country, but level-nine strengthening resources were relatively high-end. Sometimes, even if one had money, they couldn’t buy suitable ones, so they were called legendary resources.
It could 100% let a monarch-level pet with a good foundation enter the overlord level. Moreover, it had a very strong strengthening effect on overlord-level pets. There was a nearly one in ten chance for overlord-level pets to enter the totem level. This was what the gem cat saved up to pursue.
If Eleven and the others needed a legendary resource to break through to the overlord level, this would definitely be a pit.
“Besides… Why do I feel that it’s faster to earn money by exploring ruins? For example, there are Mythical resources in the ruins mentioned by the Undying Dark Phoenix… Aren’t those Legendary resources everywhere? When are we going to explore?”
The gem cat’s face fell.
It wanted to too, but didn’t this sound dangerous?
Exploring ruins wasn’t as fast as being a capitalist earning money.
“Let’s find a bigger big boss to cozy up to before exploring. I think Sister Ice Dragon is pretty good,” the gem cat said.
“Very good, when the time comes, invite it to go with you and let your stepmother see if the treasure vault left behind by your biological mother has treasures or a trap!”
Soon, Shi Yu and the others finally crossed the layers of snow mountains and arrived near the sea.
Although it was said to be close to the sea, the sea surface here was still frozen. Shi Yu and the others walked very, very far before finally arriving at the shattered ice area and seeing the blue sea.
“waul!!”
At this moment, Eleven and the others had long recovered through Absolute Sleep. Seeing the endless sea, Eleven and the others were in a very good mood.
It was also the first time Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong had seen the sea. Their eyes lit up.
“We’re finally here.”
“Let’s take a break and practice before starting the training mission ~” Shi Yu stretched. He was tired from flying and wanted to slack off for a while.
“Tremember a sport I haven’t done in a long time.”
Swim? Or skating?
A moment later.
Shi Yu sat on the chair conjured by Buggy and held the sword weapon, Ice Dragon Blade. A worm silk was tied in front of him, and the bottom of the worm silk had a nutritional fruit used as bait to fish.
“Wu?” “Wuu?” “Yi?” “Mi?”
‘When the pets saw that Shi Yu was talking about fishing, they immediately showed helpless expressions.
“As an outstanding pet trainer, fishing is a necessary skill.”
“Lonce saw a cartoon where a little girl easily used a fishing pole to fish up a water-type divine beast.”
1
“Although we might not be able to do it, it’s not bad to catch a few Sea Kings to spar with you. After all, you seriously lack sea battle experience…”
“In short, I’ll fish, you guys settle the fish.”
Those who could be attracted by the nutritional fruits… shouldn’t be small fish.
“want something cooked,” at this moment, the gem cat playing with its cell phone on the flying carpet said.
“Sure, sure. We’ll look at the gains. Let’s eat seafood tonight.”
In the ocean.
As the nutritional fruit fell, a large number of fish, from the Awakening level to the transcendent level, approached crazily. However, Shi Yu’s bait was clearly screened.
The weak fish was not fit to approach the bait at all. It directly fainted from touching the seawater soaked in the nutritional fruit.
2
From this, it could be seen that Baby Ginseng’s bath water might also be very valuable.
1
Baby Ginseng could probably be dipped in water to make special tea.
Awakening level beasts couldn’t do it, and transcendent level beasts couldn’t. Shi Yu’s target group was above commander rank, preferably monarch rank.
However, judging from the commotion, there didn’t seem to be any powerful sea beasts nearby.
At this moment, as he was fishing, Shi Yu yawned. He saw Eleven and the others staring at each other and said, “Why don’t you guys… Huh?”
Shi Yu was just about to say something when his expression suddenly changed.
At the side, Buggy was also stunned.
A few seconds ago, a white divine dragon nearly ten meters long was swimming carefully at the bottom of the sea, as if it was dodging something.
‘The White Azure Dragon heaved a sigh of relief. It didn’t expect that Dragon Palace City would actually send soldiers to pursue it. It could only be forced to hide in the deep sea. At this moment, as it was getting closer and closer to the land, the White Azure Dragon’s gaze flickered.
In the blink of an eye, its nose twitched and it revealed a shocked expression.
“It smells so good, even better than those spiritual fruits in Dragon Palace City.”
With that said, it accelerated and locked onto a white fruit in the ocean with a glance, thinking that a heavenly treasure had appeared.
“My luck is so good! It’s right to come out!”
It was overjoyed as it rushed forward. Just as it was about to approach the white fruit, in the next moment, the worm silk tied to the white fruit seemed to have become a spirit. It extended automatically and its speed was extremely fast. In an instant, it tied the white divine dragon that was close to the
white fruit!
“Roar?!”
Seeing this, the White Azure Dragon was stunned. It struggled with all its might, but to its surprise, it discovered that the thread was surprisingly tough. With its strength, it actually couldn’t break free directly.
In the next moment, the White Azure Dragon felt a huge force coming, and its body was involuntarily pulled towards the sea.
splash!!!
As water splashed everywhere, on the ice, Shi Yu, who was quickly putting away the worm silk, looked at the huge white divine dragon that he had thrown into the sky with a bang. His mouth instantly opened wide.
“Damn, what’s this?”
“wu?” “Wuu?” “Yi?” “Mi?”
At the side, Eleven and the others also looked at the huge monster Shi Yu had fished up in surprise.
Even the gem cat with the cell phone couldn’t help but be stunned.
Damn, this seafood was too strong.
It was very nutritious.
However, why did this guy look so familiar?
“Roar!!!”
After being fished out of the sea, the long transcendent creature was finally angry. The surrounding wind elements gathered, and the worm silk that was difficult to break with brute force just now instantly broke. At this moment, it waved its body and looked at Shi Yu and the others below in anger. It
finally understood what was going on.
It was the dignified Third Prince of Dragon Palace City, the only son of the Sea Dragon King, but it was actually… fished up like a fish by a human Beast Tamer?
This was too much!
At the same time.
The index of Bureau 11 and 3 in front of Shi Yu also displayed the information on this transcendent creature.
[Name]: White Azure Dragon
[Attributes]: Dragon, Wind
[Race Level]: High-level overlord
{Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Energy Points: 166,132
< Introduction > Dragon Palace City’s proud son, Third Prince, son of the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King. The only race that has mastered the Wind Summoning Art. Don’t offend them!!
At that moment, when he saw this information, Shi Yu was directly stunned.
It wasn’t because this dragon’s race level was very high, nor was it because its energy value was very high. It was purely because of the other party’s identity, as well as the “Do not make offend” marked on the third and eleventh bureau indexes.
1
Then here was the problem. He had caught the other party like a fish. Was it considered an enmity?
“Roar!!!” Seeing the confused expressions of Shi Yu and the others, the White Azure Dragon was even more furious. The perfect-level dragon might directly erupted, and the substantialized dragon might covered the sky and pressed down on Shi Yu and the others.
However, in the next moment… the White Azure Dragon’s expression changed.
This was because as the Little Iron-eating Beast, Little Butterfly, Baby Ginseng, and Little Red Sparrow beside Shi Yu looked up at it, four forces that shocked the sky and the sea instantly spread. In an instant, four shocking cracks appeared in the sky. The sea even kept rolling, and cracks appeared!
The terrifying four deterrence storms, each of which was stronger than the dragon might of the White Dragon. At this moment, lightning shot out of Eleven’s eyes. Its deterrence was as intimidating as thunder.
Buggy’s purer transcendent dragon might erupted. Chi Tong’s phoenix might was displayed, making the White Azure Dragon’s dragon might seem like stardust competing with the bright moon.
In the blink of an eye, the deterrence of the White Azure Dragon was suppressed by the bullying strategy. Moreover, four strong deterrence wrapped around the White Azure Dragon, making its mind tremble. It could only circle on the spot and be shocked until its entire body stiffened.
Ina short exchange, the White Azure Dragon’s heart turned cold. It looked at the four little pets in front of it in shock. Transcendent Deterrence… How was this possible.
‘The White Azure Dragon, who had never left the Ocean Dragon Palace City, was directly stunned.
Were the humans and transcendent creatures on land actually so terrifying?
Even in Dragon Palace City, only the top Dragon Palace overlords had mastered transcendent deterrence.
Its pupils constricted as it looked at Shi Yu solemnly. It was just about to shout, “My father is the Sea Dragon King!”
However, Shi Yu spoke faster.
“Well, would you believe me if I said it was a misunderstanding?” At this moment, Shi Yu touched his chin and looked at the white dragon in the sky, who didn’t dare to act rashly.
White Azure Dragon:
“Are you Xiaobai?”
“Lheard the adults in the family mention you.”
“I didn’t expect you to grow so big in the blink of an eye.”
White Azure Dragon: “?”
Shi Yu revealed a reminiscing expression and took out the Sea Dragon King’s scale. “You don’t know me, but I know you. You weren’t born when your father sent this scale out.”
‘The White Azure Dragon was stunned. It opened its mouth and looked at the Sea Dragon King scale in Shi Yu’s hand. It was immediately stunned. Holy shit, this aura… was really its father’s scale. This, this, this, this, what was going on??
In an instant, the White Dragon was stunned as it looked at Shi Yu and the others in shock.
“Senior, you are…”
It transmitted its telepathy. As expected of a totem heir, a commander rank had mastered telepathy.
Inan instant, Eleven, the others, and the gem cat were also stunned.
“We’re like family, like family. Come, sit, sit.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Why did you come out of Dragon Palace City?”
At this moment, when the White Azure Dragon saw that the other party was a big boss who knew its father, it was immediately nervous to the extreme. It almost thought that Shi Yu had been sent by its father to capture it. It said nervously, “I came out for a breather and train.”
Shi Yu:”…”
“Isn’t there a Dragon Palace banquet in Dragon Palace City recently?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes, yes.” The White Azure Dragon nodded.
“You ran away?” Shi Yu asked because he could sense the White Azure Dragon’s nervous heart through telepathy.
White Azure Dragon :”…”
“Tm really bored. Is it appropriate to lock a wind-element divine dragon like me in the sea?” The white dragon had a bitter expression.
“Wu?” “Wau?” “Yi?” “Mi?”
Eleven and the others pointed and discussed. It was indeed ridiculous.
At least it had to be locked in a snowstorm.
“Is it because of that?” Shi Yu gradually took the initiative.
“Ah, no, it’s mainly because my father wants me to find a Beast Tamer for me to follow, but I don’t want to be a human pet… I want freedom!!” It had a bitter expression and said, “The human Beast Tamers I saw previously are all trash. It’s impossible for me to follow them! Uh, of course, I didn’t mean
you, Senior. Please don’t tell my father about me, alright?”
Shi Yu:”…”
Good lord, Shi Yu was speechless.
Was this the cub of the overlord race in Dragon Palace City?
But when he glanced at the success rate of the White Azure Dragon’s super skill teaching
Extremely low.
Excuse me
This guy was also fodder
It didn’t even have the will of an overlord, and it dared to be a totem’s son?
“No, no, no.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “There’s indeed no rule that says you have to follow humans.”
“Right!” The White Azure Dragon seemed to have found a confidant. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to understand it so well.
Why did it have to lock itself in the small space of a human Beast Tamer and suffer and train every day?
“My father has its own obsession and insisted that I complete its wish for it. Damn it,” the White Azure Dragon said unhappily. “It even said that only by following a human Beast Tamer will there be a chance of stepping into the Mythical Domain…”
Buggy and the others gradually understood all of this. The father of this White Azure Dragon was the Sea Dragon King evolved from the Dragon Carp pet that Lin Feng casually cultivated with evolution talent, the dragon totem that married into the Dragon Palace City!
Shi Yu: “… Haha, your father must also be thinking about your future. Come, come, come, let me ask you. How many overlord heirs will participate in the Dragon Palace banquet this time? Do you know? Of course, the ones who are still in their infancy.”
The white dragon was stunned. It didn’t understand why Shi Yu was asking this. It looked at Shi Yu suspiciously.
However, it still recalled carefully.
“They would probably all participate.”
“At the moment, the heir of the overlord in Dragon Palace City…”
“The baby of the Sponge Overlord? And the brother of the Octopus Overlord of the Ten Thousand Claw Octopus. Oh, and the child of the overlord of Neptune, that silly starfish.”
“Oh, there’s also Little Sister Tiger Whale and that idiot Wyrm Shark.”
“By the way, after the Second Princess of Mermaid Island left with a human, the Mermaid Queen seemed to be pregnant again. I wonder if she was born. She’s really impressive. That auntie is simply the birth vanguard of Dragon Palace City…”
“Apart from them… there seems to be General Yaksha’s daughter, Sister Sea Yaksha?”
The White Azure Dragon tried its best to remember. After thinking for a long time, it only remembered less than ten overlord heirs that it was more familiar with.
At this moment, after hearing the White Azure Dragon’s description, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Sponge Baby? Little Brother Octopus? Stupid Starfish? What the hell? This was an overlord’s son? This was Dragon Palace City?
“What race is the tiger whale sister you’re talking about?”
“And the shark is?”
“Speaking of which, did that mermaid princess leave with someone named Lu Qingyi? Also speaking of which, is the mermaid queen’s child definitely a mermaid princess?”
“Do you have a photo of that Sea Yaksha sister you mentioned?”1
“Oh, wait, I want to ask if any totem big shots in your Dragon Palace City are about to reincarnate.” Shi Yu wanted to ask a lot. He even asked about the unreliable and reliable prophecy of the owl.
White Azure Dragon:??
What exactly did he want?

Chapter 264: Human Big Boss Shi Yu
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
‘The upright Shi Yu started chatting with the Third Prince in all seriousness.
He had a wide range of information.
Not only were they limited to the sons of totems and heirs of overlords, but he also had to ask about some descendants of monarchs, commander descendants, and even the shrimps and crabs in Dragon Palace City.
At the moment, as the skill index upgraded, he could teach super skills. Moreover, there were restrictions. High-rank pets were no longer Shi Yu’s goal.
Though, if it was a Mythical race with their own divine skills, it could still be discussed.
Otherwise, in Shi Yu’s eyes, a pet of an overlord race was far less attractive to him than a pet that had mastered the overlord’s will.
After all, as long as he could teach super skills, that was simply a totem straight away.
From the situation of this White Azure Dragon, although these totem children’s battle power was definitely at the top among their peers, and their energy levels were actually not inferior to Eleven and the others, who had basically maxed out their racial skills, it was obvious that they were rich sons of
rich parents.
The other heirs of overlords were probably similar. They couldn’t be brought along.
If possible, Shi Yu didn’t even mind going to the million prawn soldiers in Dragon Palace City to choose and give them a visual assessment of their aptitude.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, water-type pets with overlord’s will should be pretty easy to find in the ocean.
In short, it didn’t necessarily have to use the heir of the overlord to make friends with Dragon Palace City. When the time came, the ice dragon would become the Ice Dragon King of Dragon Palace City. Was there a better backer than this?
At that time, Chi Tong would also be the daughter of the totem in Dragon Palace City!
“The situation of the Dragon Palace City army… I’m not too sure…”
However, in the face of Shi Yu’s question, the white dragon said shyly.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Aren’t you the son of the Sea Dragon King?”
“Doesn’t your father have his own faction?”
“aren’t you the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City?”
“How can you not know!”
“This won’t do…”
“You don’t even know the situation of the ocean army talent in Dragon Palace City. How can you sweep away the children of other Dragon Kings in the future and inherit Dragon Palace City?”
“You’re not young anymore. It’s time to learn to form cliques and recruit talents.”
Shi Yu expected better from him. It was fine if its strength wasn’t enough, it was fine if his potential wasn’t enough. It couldn’t even be a second-generation heir competently? What a loser!
The White Azure Dragon was shocked. “Don’t talk nonsense! I’m not! I’m not interested in the status of the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City!”
At this moment, in the eyes of the White Azure Dragon, Shi Yu was very similar to those treacherous officials who encouraged it to fight for power.
Shi Yu also felt that this White Dragon was useless and didn’t pursue it.
“wu…”
Next, Shi Yu originally wanted to take a step back and ask more about the other situations in Dragon Palace City, but at this moment, the originally calm sea suddenly moved.
A huge vortex formed, and an extremely terrifying pressure gradually came from the deep sea.
‘The originally normal sky darkened.
This sudden change made the gem cat beside him reveal a serious expression. It even shocked the White Azure Dragon and made it swallow its saliva crazily.
“Not good!!!”
It shouted and its body immediately danced. It wanted to fly towards the land, but it was too late.
In the next second, with a boom, a huge waterspout rose out of thin air, connecting the deep sea to the sky like a water pillar.
Among them, a deep cry that was like the cry of a whale sounded.
‘Whoosh—
Right on the heels of that, the waterspout dispersed from the inside. A huge creature more than 20 meters long wrapped around the water and quietly charged into the sky.
Its back was black, its abdomen was grayish-white, and it had a sharp back fin. After it charged into the sky, the violent sea flow instantly returned to calm, but the White Azure Dragon’s heart instantly couldn’t calm down.
[Race Name]: Sky Penetrating Whale
[Race Attributes]: Water, Dragon
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
{Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 87,120,000
{Introduction]: The overlord of the whale group in the Dragon Palace City. It can trigger tornadoes and tsunamis to easily drown a city at will. Don’t offend it!
“F*ck…”
As such a thing appeared, Shi Yu’s heart stopped.
Its energy level was 30 million higher than the gem cat. It was ridiculous.
[This, this guy is so strong, his energy level is even higher than yours by 30 million… He should be here to find this little white dragon, right?] He quickly asked the gem cat.
‘The gem cat’s expression was calm, telling Shi Yu not to panic.
‘They were already overlords. Energy value was not the only standard to judge strength.
Although this big guy’s energy level was terrifyingly high and its cultivation of the natural power was not weak, as long as its gem cat wanted to escape, even if it brought Shi Yu along, the other party might not necessarily be able to catch up.
“Uncle Hei Ge…” Seeing the appearance of this overlord whale, the white dragon almost squeezed out tears and was once again at a stage where it didn’t dare to move.
‘The White Azure Dragon’s eyes were filled with tears.
Did it have to be so exaggerated? Didn’t it just run away from home for a while? Did it have to mobilize this person to catch him??
A moment later, the Sky Penetrating Whale’s huge body enveloped the sky, and its deep gaze slowly lowered to watch.
“Come back with me.” The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the White Dragon and said, “Don’t make your father angry.”
“L..”‘ The White Azure Dragon was extremely unwilling.
It looked at Shi Yu and the others for help.
At the same time, the Sky Penetrating Whale’s gaze landed on Shi Yu and the others.
With just a glance, Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng immediately trembled.
‘When looking at the Sky Penetrating Whale, it was as if they had fallen into the deep sea. It felt difficult to breathe, as if the heart was being squeezed.
This Sky Penetrating Whale had also mastered transcendent deterrence and integrated its dignity into every move. A breath and a gaze were wrapped in weak deterrence, making it difficult for the weak to look at it directly.
Eleven and the others gritted their teeth. What were they looking at!
In the back, the gem cat also yawned and said, “Isn’t this General Whale?”
“Huh?”
The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the gem cat that looked at it easily and was silent for a moment. “It’s you…?”
‘The gem cat had also been to Dragon Palace City many times. It was naturally not unfamiliar with the overlord of Dragon Palace City.
Although Dragon Palace City had many totems and more overlords, to Dragon Palace City, overlords were also rare guests.
“Since your family has come, go back.” Shi Yu sold the White Azure Dragon in the blink of an eye and said, “Don’t run around next time. Study well.”
Be able to answer questions next time.
White Azure Dragon:??
‘The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at Shi Yu and the others in silence, feeling a little confused. At this moment, Shi Yu took out the Sea Dragon King’s scale again and introduced himself. “General Whale, hello. I’m the friend of the Sea Dragon King’s good friend, the Butterfly God…”
“Dong Huang Ruins Strategic Investigation and Backup Security Bureau…”
“Also a member of the National Feeding Research and Rare Resource Protection Bureau, Shi Yu.”
Transcendent Whale: (?.?)1
At the side, the White Dragon revealed a confused and amazed gaze!
“This…” The Sky Penetrating Whale quickly reacted and understood that the two bureaus of Dong Huang. However, what it was more concerned about was.
‘When it saw the Sea Dragon King scale Shi Yu took out, the Sky Penetrating Whale fell silent.
Holy shit, this was?
‘The scale of the Sea Dragon King’s friendship?
It remembered that it didn’t give out many pieces.
“Uncle Hei Ge, this is Father’s good friend, Senior Shi Yu,” the white dragon assisted.
Shi Yu:”…”
Children shouldn’t talk nonsense. They weren’t friends yet.
The Sky Penetrating Whale was stunned, but it really couldn’t remember a figure like Shi Yu.
“Hello, Sir Shi Yu.” A moment later, combined with the gem cat and the Sea Dragon King’s scales, the Sky Penetrating Whale felt that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be lying. It couldn’t help but say, “Sorry for being presumptuous. May I ask why you’re here…”
“It’s nothing. I was just walking around and fished. I bumped into the Third Prince.”
“I see.” The Sky Penetrating Whale glanced ahead. Indeed, it was almost at the human domain.
It immediately said, “I hope His Highness didn’t bring you any trouble.”
“It’s not troublesome.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “In that case, quickly bring the Third Prince back. Eh, can you pass by later and help me bring a message to Senior Sea Dragon King?”
“Huh?” The Sky Penetrating Whale was stunned. “Of course.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s not a big deal. Please tell Senior Sea Dragon King that I’ll be visiting Dragon Palace City in a few days. At that time, a relative friend of mine might join Dragon Palace City.”
“Relative friend?” The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the little cat beside it. Could it be.
This cat didn’t have enough fun eating fish in Dragon Palace City the last time. Did it decide to jump ship and join Dragon Palace City this time?
Dragon Palace City had yet to have a precedent of accepting cats
This wasn’t water or dragon. Could it be added?
However, if an overlord-level creature joined Dragon Palace City, it indeed needed the recognition of a totem.
“It’s not it,” Shi Yu said.
“No?”
“Well, it’s a dragon friend of mine. It comes from the West. Its race is a frost dragon, but it’s a little different from ordinary frost dragons.”
“Oh??”
“It once participated in the first totem battle and fought alongside the Time Emperor!”
The Sky Penetrating Whale widened its eyes. The white dragon beside it was also stunned.
“Because Emperor Shi personally bestowed time-element abilities, it’s a little special.”
“Its strength is still not bad. It once suppressed the totem at the overlord level. Now, it has also stepped into the totem level.”
“Now, it wants to find a place to retire, so it wants to join Dragon Palace City… It just happens that I might visit Dragon Palace City next. When the time comes, I should bring it along.”
1
Shi Yu smiled.
“What!!”
Transcendent Whale: d(O20a)
A totem-level dragon??
Moreover, it had participated in the first totem battle with Emperor Shi?
Didn’t that mean that it was an old monster who had lived for more than 2000 years??
After all, the current Dragon God of Dragon Palace City had only risen during the Dragon Emperor Era. Its growth was less than a thousand years ago.
As for the Sea Dragon King, it was less than 200 years ago.
“Ah?” Beside him, the White Azure Dragon also looked at Shi Yu in shock.
So Shi Yu was really a big boss!!!
It originally thought that Shi Yu was only familiar with its father, but it didn’t expect, it didn’t expect.
So scary!!!
He was actually related to totem-level creatures during the Emperor Shi era!
‘The Third Prince didn’t expect to encounter such a big boss just by going out.
It secretly glanced at the confused Eleven and the others and immediately understood.
This big boss was definitely nurturing a new pet. Big Boss Shi Yu’s true main force was unfathomable.
Otherwise, it was impossible for him to casually bring an overlord-level gem cat and casually make friends with totem-level Butterfly God and a giant dragon!
“What you said… is true?” The Sky Penetrating Whale was very shocked.
It had naturally heard of Emperor Shi.
‘That was the first emperor of the Dong Huang, who was on good terms with Dragon Palace City. The ancient emperor of the Dong Huang was even closer to a myth than the Dragon Gods of Dragon Palace City.
‘The fourth legendary Emperor of the Dong Huang, who had the best relationship with Dragon Palace City, was also far inferior to Emperor Shi in historical evaluations.
“Of course, please pass this news to Lord Sea Dragon King,” Shi Yu said.
“Lunderstand.” The Sky Penetrating Whale nodded. It didn’t expect that it would receive such big news after coming out to catch a brat that had run away from home. This news was very important!
‘There were also factions within Dragon Palace City. The various factions were also competitors. Among them, it belonged to the Sea Dragon King’s faction. If the new totem-level dragon was first contacted and befriended by the Sea Dragon King, the hidden benefits would be immeasurable.
“I don’t want to go back!!!”
“Let me experience human society with Big Boss Shi Yu!!”
At this moment, the Third Prince shouted.
“No!” The Sky Penetrating Whale suppressed the White Azure Dragon and said to Shi Yu, “Then, I’ll send this news back as soon as possible. Don’t worry, Sir Shi Yu!”
After the Sky Penetrating Whale captured the Third Prince, Shi Yu sat back down with a sigh.
As he thought, going to Dragon Palace City with Zou Tianwang, Yu Shu, and the others was not difficult at all.
At that time, the other juniors would still be carefully observing Dragon Palace City. He was afraid that he would directly become a guest of the Sea Dragon King. How was he to compete?
“You’re telling the truth.”
“But why does it seem a little different from what I understand?”
‘The gem cat was silent.
“The charm of language, the charm of language…”
Shi Yu laughed. Beside him, Buggy and the others started chattering again.
Was that… a water type Iron-eating Beast?
It was as black and white as Eleven..
