chapters.content:
Chapter 265 Fourth Game, Gao Xuan
A week later.
In the sea area near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
In the past few days, Shi Yu had come almost every day and had already understood the water element here.
Whether it was Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, or Chi Tong, they could move freely underwater.
Of course, if Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong fought underwater, their battle power would be less than 10%. This couldn’t be helped.
On the other hand, Buggy could be arrogant by transforming into a water-type pet.
As for Eleven, its battle method was even simpler. It directly modified itself into a Thunder Rod and jumped into the sea.
Then.
Blue Sea Ruins:?
Heavenly Thunder Fried Fish.
Apart from that, Shi Yu had not been idle these few days.
One time, after the gem cat finished using the clone skill, he found an opportunity… to replicate the clone skill.
This was a high-level skill, similar to multiplication. It was a special skill, but to be honest, it was a little inclined towards the spiritual element. When the proficiency was low, it needed to control the clone through spiritual power and needed to multitask. In the past few days, Shi Yu had taken the time to give the clone skill to Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong Shi Yu’s goal was to let every pet become an army!!!
Although Eleven had the bean soldier skill, and the upper limit of this skill was higher than the clone, the problem was that it couldn’t be taught yet.
Shi Yu taught Eleven this skill with the idea that his clone might lead to an increase in level of bean soldier. As for Buggy, it had illusions that were already better than cloning. Shi Yu didn’t teach it.
For example, the clone skill could only inherit entry-level super skills after it reached the transcendent level. However, Buggy’s Imagination Domain and Illusory Phantom combined with the full-level dream stealing… Not to mention the entry-level super skill, that phantom could even inherit the perfect super skill in the future. He could even create other pet clones and use other people’s super skills. This upper limit was something the clone skill couldn’t compare to. In fact, Shi Yu mainly wanted to teach Baby Ginseng and Chi Tong.
Initially, Shi Yu’s idea was that when Baby Ginseng learned plant control, it would also bring its own wood clone. The upper limit was similarly higher than ordinary clones, but Shi Yu couldn’t wait for the same problem. Now that Baby Ginseng had learned how to clone, it could let its clone self-destruct. Although its power was definitely not as strong as its main body’s self-destruction, its practicality was undoubtedly stronger. At that time, among monarchs, with this trump card, Shi Yu would quickly be invincible.
Moreover, in the future, the wooden clone that the plant controlled could also inherit the proficiency of the clone. In short, it wasn’t a loss.
At the moment, Shi Yu had already prioritized raising Baby Ginseng’s clone to the perfect level. Unfortunately, the current clone couldn’t inherit super skills yet. Even high-level skills could only be inherited to the expert level, but Shi Yu knew that it was enough to reach the transcendent level. Although it could still only inherit entry-level super skills, it was definitely enough for now.
As for why he taught Chi Tong the clone skill…
Shi Yu planned to develop more handsome combination sword moves. After all, Little Chi Tong (himself) had relatively few skills.
For example, the Infinite Converging Sword, the God Slaying Sword Formation, the Extreme Ghost Sword Art (Storm Form), and so on. They could be used after learning them. “Extreme Ghost Sword Art, Storm Stance!”
In the ruins space, a huge circular sword formation dozens of meters in diameter appeared under Shi Yu’s feet.
In the sword formation, he threw the red light sword in his hand up. In an instant, the sword spirit turned into 24 swords. 12 of them floated in the air, and the other 12 stabbed into the ground and fused into the sword formation. Boom!!!
In the next moment, the sword formation on the ground instantly erupted with a Sun Flame Vortex, forming a fire sword domain. It emitted a powerful suction, as if it wanted to devour all enemies. The 12 floating swords in the sky activated the Light Flame Sword and turned into sword lights that filled the sky. Like Phantom Sword Dance and Hundred Phoenixes crying together, they launched a fierce attack inside the sword formation.
Pa! Pa! Pa!
A moment later, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng’s cries and clapping came from the side.
“Wuuu -“
“Wu ~2”
“Yii! Yii!” Baby Ginseng shouted. So handsome.
“Actually, there’s still room for improvement.”
Shi Yu revealed a hearty smile and said, “When we create dozens of weapons like the Ice Dragon Blade and the Heavenly Thunder Slash, we’ll let Chi Tong’s clone possess a bunch of divine swords. Then, we’ll use the power of intersection. When the ten thousand swords intersect, the power should be even stronger!!”
“I’ve already thought of the profundity name. It’s called…”
“Mi…” Little Chi Tong removed its possession state and looked at Shi Yu while panting.
Impressive, impressive, handsome, but… So tired!
“It’s better to be tired.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “The profundity name is…”
Boom!!! Shi Yu was interrupted again.
In the outside world, the gem cat suddenly shook the door of the ruins and shouted for Shi Yu and the others.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He immediately came out and saw the gem cat pointing into the distance.
That was the direction of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
The sky was gray. The snowstorm became incomparably huge. The entire snow mountain was enveloped in a snow tornado.
“Roar!!!!”
In the snowstorm, dragon roars came from time to time. Under the gathering of countless snowstorms, it seemed to have condensed into a frost dragon hundreds of meters tall that roared in the sky, swearing the return of an invincible existence.
“This is…”
Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu was stunned. “Ice Dragon finally left the ruins.”
“Yeah, are we going over?” the gem cat said.
“Of course.” Shi Yu nodded. This time, the gem cat used Instant Transmission and teleported with Shi Yu in the direction of the Ice Dragon Ruins.
A moment later. Shi Yu and the others arrived at the Ice Dragon Ruins. At this moment, in the sky, the frost dragon was looking at the huge snow mountain in the snowstorm and couldn’t help but sigh.
“Has it already become like this in 2500?”
“Compared to back then, there’s so much less icy environments…”
“It might have been sucked dry by you guys,” a voice said.
IIII
The frost dragon looked at the arriving Shi Yu and said, “You’re here.”
“Long time no see, Mother Dragon. Have you drained the Ice River Totem dry?” Shi Yu smiled.
“Hmph, even if we ignore it, it won’t be able to revive successfully in less than a hundred years,” the frost dragon said. “This time, it’s completely drained.”
“As expected of me.” With that said, it looked at the Ice Dragon Ruins.
After a boom, the huge ruin instantly shattered. Ice Dragon picked up a red bracelet and put it on its huge claw. After the Ice Dragon Ruins collapsed, the snow and wind dispersed, and the snow mountain collapsed, falling continuously into the ice abyss underground.
Boom.
In the loud bang, the Ice Dragon said, “I’ll take away the sealed space. Since you humans can solve it yourself, I’ll leave the rest to you. I won’t worry anymore. The Ice River Totem has imprinted itself in this area. As long as there’s the power of the ice element around, it still has a chance to revive. Do you understand?”
Shi Yu nodded. It was said that the entire Icefield City was a city of ice and snow a long time ago. Now, only the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain was left. From the looks of it, it was because the Ice River Totem needed energy to revive and so it started slowly absorbing it.
But now, this revival energy had probably been wasted by Ice Dragon. If the Ice River Totem was conscious, it would probably curse.
It was very similar to logging into a game. Just as the progress bar was about 99%, the Internet card suddenly fell back to 1% for the unlucky players. “Speaking of which… Did Great General Mu Huiyin leave any family heirlooms in that sealed space?” Shi Yu suddenly looked at Ice Dragon.
The dragon tensed.
“What are you doing? She said that after I leave, these are all mine. Why, do you want to snatch them??”
Ice Dragon’s nostrils emitted cold air as it looked at Shi Yu unkindly. In order to inherit these inheritances, it had protected this place for thousands of years. Others could forget about touching it!
“I was just asking, there’s no snatching!” Shi Yu laughed. Who dared to snatch it?
Even if Dong Huang specified that all the ruins belonged to the country, it still had to depend on who had the ruins. To dare snatch from the Ice Dragon Totem, wasn’t this courting death?
All rules were established on strength.
Attacking the weak with heavy fists and being subservient to the strong. This was a law that would never change no matter where.
“However,” Ice Dragon suddenly pondered and said, “As for Chi Tong, there’s something I can give him.”
Shi Yu: “!!!”
“Chi Tong, hurry up and greet Mother Long!” The fire sword spirit was pulled out by Shi Yu in a daze as it looked at the frost dragon innocently.
“Mi…”
“Hehe.” The frost dragon looked at the timid fire sword spirit and had a bad sense of humor. “This is for you.” With that said, a set of equipment was pulled out of General Mu Huiyin’s ruins space by the frost dragon.
It was a silver female armor.
It looked simple, but it was filled with history.
Seeing this armor, the fire sword spirit instantly felt a sense of closeness that came from its bloodline. As for Shi Yu, he was slightly stunned because his third index instantly detected the material of this armor! < Name > Gemini Silver
[Attributes]: Space
< Introduction > It’s a legendary resource. It contains strong power of the sun and moon. It’s a metal mineral that can perfectly coordinate the power of the intersection.
Status: Broken
“This is Mu Huiyin’s favorite battle armor when she was alive. Although the artifact spirit has already left, the battle armor is already broken, and the internal power has dried up, the characteristics of the Coordination Strength should have been preserved a bit. I’ll give it to you,” the frost dragon said generously. “Mi!! (Thank you!)” Little Chi Tong flew up happily and received the Gemini Silver Armor.
However, after comparing the design and size, it glanced at Shi Yu and shook its head regretfully. It was too small for the armor. “Thank you!!” Shi Yu was also full of smiles. Holy shit, the legendary armor!! Gemini Silver, this was a level-nine resource, a legendary resource!! Although it was broken now, a starving camel was still bigger than a horse.
Previously, Buggy’s broken dragon ball was only level four, but wasn’t it still powerful? The reason was that its quality was high enough to explode.
The Frost Dragon was generous!
As for how to use it, Shi Yu instantly thought of
it.
At that time, he would directly let Chi Tong possess the armor. As for who would wear it… He would directly let Buggy create a humanoid version of Sister Ice Dragon or the frost version of General Mu Huiyin!
The two of them could maximize the power of the equipment!
Shi Yu named it: Profundity: Ice Dragon General Descends!
“Good sister, is there anything else you don’t need?” At this moment, the gem cat beside her couldn’t sit still anymore. Seeing that the Ice Dragon casually threw a broken level-nine legendary resource, it immediately looked forward to it.
For example, Sun Gem and Phoenix Gem.
It was also possible to exchange items. Everyone had agreed previously. The frost dragon: “No! Nothing! Mu Huiyin is very poor. She didn’t leave me anything at all! Stop thinking about it!”
Shi Yu and the gem cat stayed silent…
“By the way, Dragon Mom, let’s go to Dragon Palace City in a few days. I bumped into the son of the Dragon Palace City’s totem Sea Dragon King and the overlord general of Dragon Palace City a few days ago. I told them about you. They’re very happy. When the time comes, they’ll welcome you with the most solemn ceremony.” “I didn’t forget about you.”
Shi Yu did not forget to take credit.
The frost dragon was stunned and nodded in satisfaction.
“Not bad. I’ll go with you then, en?”
Just as it finished speaking, it looked into the distance.
Shi Yu also looked in another direction.
A silver-white flying ship that was more than ten meters long and looked like a flying dragon passed through the snow and wind and quickly flew over from afar. Seeing this strange thing that emitted dragon might, the frost dragon immediately narrowed its eyes. What the hell was this?
Shi Yu also looked over.
The index immediately displayed information on this thing.
[Name]: Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast (Flying Dragon Ship Form)
[Attributes]: Machinery, Dragon
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
(Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 7.5 million < Introduction > The only mechanical race created for Mechanic Gao Xuan. “Gao Xuan?” After being slightly stunned, Shi Yu immediately recalled. Wasn’t this name the legendary captain of the school team from Imperial Capital University, the previous national champion, the genius Mechanic from the fourth round?
Together with Senior Lu, Zou Tianwang, and the others, they were known as young geniuses with legendary aptitudes. “I’ve seen it all now.” This was the first time the frost dragon had seen a mechanical life form. It couldn’t help but be very curious.
A moment later, the flying ship arrived above the Ice Dragon Ruins. A few figures were teleported down from the flying ship.
A figure appeared beside Shi Yu. Shi Yu took a look. President Feng, Master Lin, Commander He, Commander Wang, even Principal Feng and Senior Lu were there!
“Shi Yu, Teacher Ying,” Senior Lu said when she saw that Shi Yu and the gem cat were also here.
“Senior Lu, this is…”
Lu Qingyi said, “I didn’t expect it to be such a coincidence. We just returned to Ping Cheng when Senior Ice Dragon came out. This is the Mechanical Master sent by the fourth bureau to assist us in completely annihilating the Ice River Totem, Gao Xuan.”
Shi Yu looked over and saw that after teleporting Principal Feng and the others down, the silver-white flying dragon battleship in the sky began to transform. Like a Transformer, it gradually turned into a huge mechanical beast and mecha in the form of a dragonman!!
A moment later, the chest of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was opened. A black-haired young man in a fusion state with the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast walked out. On the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s one hand, the two parties landed on the ground. At this moment, Shi Yu looked over again. The energy value of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast had already fallen to 4 million. He couldn’t help but analyze in his heart. It looked like the level of this mechanical beast’s loading and fusion skill was very high. Moreover, this Gao Xuan most likely had a big secret. He could actually increase the mechanical beast’s energy by so much.
However, wasn’t this Gao Xuan also a master? Shi Yu originally thought that a legend would be sent to assist in the fourth bureau, but he didn’t expect it to be someone his age.
After Gao Xuan landed, he silently glanced at Shi Yu and the gem cat. After nodding, he looked at Ice Dragon. “Hello, Senior Ice Dragon.” “Wait, you humans only sent such a little brat to assist in destroying the Ice River Totem??” The frost dragon looked at Gao Xuan in surprise.
This guy looked to be the same age as Shi Yu!
Moreover, although this mechanical dragonman looked strange, the frost dragon didn’t feel that it was very strong! Were humans tricking it? Gao Xuan said, “Senior Ice Dragon, to be precise, it’s a forbidden weapon we’re carrying.” “That’s a small, weakened forbidden weapon, but it can stir the power of nature and grow on its own by absorbing the power of the sun. When it falls, it will stir the power of the sun to permanently change the environment of an area and form a sea of fire. Because the flames produced during its explosion are similar to that of a rose, it’s also known as the ‘Rose of the Sun’.”
“With the Rose of the Sun, it can easily and permanently change the environment of the Ice Dragon Ruins, completely cutting off the possibility of the Ice River Totem reviving.” “Please believe in its power. Now, it’s already an era of machinery.”
“Yes, yes.” Principal Feng and the others smiled.
“I originally wanted to activate a normal forbidden weapon, but because you advanced to a totem, you absorbed all the power of the Ice River Totem. According to my analysis, the Sun Rose should be enough,” Lu Qingyi said with a nod. President Feng and the others nodded crazily. In this way, the impact on the surrounding cities could be reduced to the lowest.
Ice Dragon was stunned and looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was also stunned.
He fell into deep thought and was thinking about other things. So, could the members of the fourth bureau carry nuclear bombs with them??
This was too much. If this Gao Xuan couldn’t defeat him in the National League and brought a small forbidden weapon, how could he play! Oh, Baby Ginseng wasn’t bad either. Then it was fine. He hoped that the National League wouldn’t become a self-destruction competition…

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - Rewards of the National League
chapters.content:
Chapter 266 Rewards of the National League
“Alright, alright.”
“Then I’ll leave it to you.”
“Hurry up, let me see the power of that forbidden weapon.”
The Ice Dragon saw that everyone was so confident and so it said casually.
“No problem.”
“However, I might need some time to prepare,” Gao Xuan said.
With that said, he looked at Principal Feng, President Feng, and the others.
At the same time, his gaze also stopped on Shi Yu, who had swept across Imperial Capital University while he wasn’t around. To be precise, it landed behind Shi Yu and tried to look at Chi Tong’s silver armor.
[Race Name): Sword Spirit (No detailed classification information for now)
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Energy Points: 180,000
Seeing this little sword spirit, Gao Xuan understood why Imperial Capital University’s battle society had been swept away.
This was the first time he had seen a commander-level pet with so much energy.
Little Chi Tong’s energy value was indeed terrifying. After all, as the heir of the two dragon totems, the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City who grew up eating delicacies in Dragon Palace City with its energy value at the commander level… was only 160,000.
Those ordinary overlord races had even lower energy values at the commander rank. Most of them were less than 100,000. In Gao Xuan’s opinion, after this sword spirit broke through to the monarch level, its energy level could at least increase by 20 times… This was still normal. In addition, undead could also fuse with Beast Tamers like mechanical beasts… That was even higher. [If this sword spirit breaks through to the monarch level, it might pose a threat to the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. In order to be more stable as the champion of the National League, it looks like it’s necessary to strengthen the fire resistance system.] Gao Xuan analyzed in his heart.
The main reason was that this National League was too important to him. He had to consider all unstable factors!
At the same time.
Principal Feng laughed and said, “There’s no hurry, President Feng. Please confirm the surrounding situation again.”
“Little Gao, go and prepare yours.”
“Alright, Senior Feng.” After Gao Xuan finished speaking, he directly entered the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body and flew into the sky.
After Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast flew into the sky, Shi Yu spoke from below.
“By the way, aren’t forbidden weapons only activated by legendary Beast Tamers?”.
“Why is there a small weakened version? What do you mean?” Principal Feng glanced at Shi Yu and said, “Well… It was also developed from mechanical legends… But it’s said that only Beast Tamers with awakened talent can use it. It’s considered an exclusive trump card. Under normal circumstances, it’s enough to deal a heavy blow to an overlord.”
“However, the restrictions are very large and are very easy to counter. Don’t look at how this forbidden weapon can heavily injure an overlord, it’s completely helpless against skills like Concealment of spatial pets. Therefore, it can only be used in specific circumstances.” “Uh,” Shi Yu said.
“Mechanics really have many tricks…”
“Don’t worry, the National League definitely won’t let us use forbidden weapons, even if it’s small,” Lu Qingyi said with a smile. “Are you confident of sniping this Gao Xuan?” she continued.
Shi Yu was stunned. He suspected that Senior Lu was holding a grudge.
Because when Senior Lu participated in the National League, she was defeated by a genius from a certain Imperial Capital University.
Although that person wasn’t Gao Xuan and it was said that he joined the tenth bureau later, this Gao Xuan was also from Imperial Capital University. “Shi Yu definitely can.”
“No problem.”
Although President Feng, Master Lin, and the others didn’t know if it would work, they were definitely closer to Shi Yu.
The National League was still the more important competition among the young Beast Tamers. Not only did it decide the education fees the association assigned to the nine major schools, but the hometown of the contestants who produced results would definitely receive a large amount of benefits.
President Feng, Master Lin, and the others were still waiting for Shi Yu to go to the National League to promote the Iron-eating Beast again.
Now, Shi Yu was the hope of the entire village.
Principal Feng coughed dryly and said, “But according to the news, the situation in this year’s National League is a little special. Gao Xuan will probably risk his life to win the championship.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu was stunned.
Senior Lu said, “Because the prizes for this year’s National League seem to be provided by the fourth bureau. It’s more luxurious than previous years, and it’s a batch of top mechanical resources.”
“Although in the eyes of ordinary Beast Tamers, these resources are very ordinary, in the eyes of Mechanics, those materials are all ‘supreme-grade materials’. They can modify the machinery of overlord races.”
“It can be said that the fourth bureau almost confirmed that the champion of this National League was Gao Xuan, so they were so generous to encourage Gao Xuan.”
“Of course, I feel that this reward can also motivate you…” Lu Qingyi smiled. After Shi Yu told her and White Brook about Shi Yu obtaining the Awakening Mirror, they had yet to tell anyone.
The Awakening Mirror… could also be used for mechanical materials. Shi Yu would definitely remember it.
Shi Yu was shocked. “Top-notch mechanical materials??” Shi Yu instantly felt that the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain was so hot. His body was burning!
“Uh.” Beside him, Principal Feng was a little confused when he saw Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi talking about something he didn’t know…
Why, Shi Yu also wanted mechanical materials??
Yes, it seemed like… Shi Yu seemed to want a mechanical beast. Previously, he even asked Dean Hao if Ancient Capital University could create overlord race machinery.
Of course, the answer was definitely no.
“If you can obtain this batch of rewards and then complete them yourself, you might be able to find a legendary Mechanic to help you create an overlord race machinery,” Principal Feng said.
If it were in the past, he definitely wouldn’t have encouraged Shi Yu like this.
After all, the resources that Gao Xuan had invested in the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast were probably more than ten billion.
Mechanics were even more rich!
Such a Gao Xuan was simply invincible among his peers.
Considering this, he would definitely make Shi Yu study obediently and archeology obediently. The battle level of Ancient Capital University still couldn’t compare to those top universities.
But now, the situation was special. The era had changed… Principal Feng knew that not only had Shi Yu broken through to the master level himself, but he also had “a bunch” of overlord pets.
As long as these pets broke through to the monarch level before the National League, they might be able to fight Gao Xuan.
Although Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was specially modified and strengthened with many resources, and while its energy far exceeded other overlord races, he only had one pet, while Shi Yu had a bunch!
Even if Shi Yu’s paywall was limited, if he couldn’t fight one-on-one, couldn’t he fight in a group?
“I understand.” Shi Yu was also motivated.
However, he didn’t want to find other legendary Mechanics to help build the overlord potential machinery, but… wanted to build it himself!
Mechanic Ancient Beast!!
“Well, what are the specific attributes of the materials??” Shi Yu asked curiously.
Principal Feng thought carefully and said, “It’s hard to say, but from the gains and research results of the previous fourth bureau…” “The prize they’ll use… It’s either wind or ice.” “I feel that the possibility of wind is higher.” “In the future, after Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast steps into the overlord level, choosing to use wind-element natural power as energy is a very good choice. After all, wind power is almost everywhere.”
At the side, Lu Qingyi agreed. Compared to the operation of firepower and electricity, the machinery of wind power was also pretty good. Its adaptability was stronger.
Wind-element machinery?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. What ancient creatures were there? Wind-element?
“Sigh, it’s been more than 2000 years, but the competition between you humans is still so intense…” Beside it, the frost dragon muttered.
Good lord, the guy was already helping them destroy the Ice River Totem, but they actually wanted his mechanical materials!
Bad person!
However, it was willing to vote for Shi Yu. What a joke. Shi Yu had contracted the heroic spirit of its Beast Tamer!!
As long as Chi Tong broke through and its heroic spirit possessed him, how could anyone among his peers defeat Shi Yu!!
“At most, just self-destruct! If you can’t use forbidden weapons, Moon Explosion will definitely work.” Beside him, the gem cat also muttered.
Shi Yu had to become the national champion, so the materials produced by Shi Yu in the future would be easier to sell!
However, it shouldn’t be good to destroy other people’s mechanical beasts…
Union calendar, November 178
It had been more than a year and a half since Shi Yu transmigrated to this world.
Ping Cheng, First Middle School.
A bespectacled teacher was teaching a batch of students in the field.
His surname was Wang. At this moment, he was saying proudly, “A year ago, a small-scale ferocious beast gathering happened in the direction of the snow mountain.”
“At that time, your teacher, I, had once explained the legendary Icefield history to a few students under a stone statue around this anomaly.”
“Among those people are your seniors, Chen Kai, your seniors, Zhuang Yue, and the others…”
“Of course, there are also others. One of the students is very interested in this history. Under the serious guidance of your teacher, I, he walked on an archeological path. That’s right, this person is the top scholar of the previous Ancient Capital vocation assessment, Shi Yu! The pride of our Ping Cheng!”
“After that, he didn’t disappoint my expectations and directly cracked the Ice Dragon Ruins.”
“It’s all thanks to him. Today, our Icefield City can finally completely resolve the hidden danger of the beast tide brought by the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain for more than 2000 years. We finally have an explanation for the Beast Tamers and citizens who died in the beast tide 11 years ago.”
Below, many students looked at Teacher Wang with stars in their eyes and said, “Teacher, can you call Senior Shi Yu to give us a lesson?” Teacher Wang : “…”
Basically… impossible. He had only met Shi Yu once and said a few more words. He wiped his sweat and said, “Shi Yu is very busy. Don’t worry about him. Why don’t you work hard to improve yourselves and go to Ancient Capital University to get to know Shi Yu yourself? The men can be brothers, and the women can be his girlfriend. I heard that he’s still single.”
“Alright, the countdown is about to begin. Wait to see the beautiful scenery on the ice dragon snow mountain!”
At this moment, the entertainment activities everywhere in Ping Cheng had temporarily stopped. Countless Beast Tamers stared in the direction of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. The first Beast Tamer that Shi Yu defeated was Chen Kai, an outstanding student, was there. There was the pharmacy physician who had sold supplements to Shi Yu many times, and also President Feng’s nephew, who was a master candidate…
The presidents of the associations and many masters of the other eight districts and counties in Icefield City also arrived near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and stared at the highest snow mountain built with the Ice Dragon Ruins.
A long time later…
As the alarm sounded, many people in Ping Cheng District saw the sky suddenly turn red. The clouds on the horizon were red, as if they were on fire.
The sky was dyed red by the gathering of the power of the sun, as if there was a volcano erupting below, dazzling.
In an instant, many people felt the temperature around them suddenly increase. In the next moment, they heard a boom, and dazzling golden light blossomed in the direction of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in the distance.
Right on the heels of that, the golden light kept expanding. With a world-shaking bang, the rolling energy tide rose into the sky like a volcano eruption, blooming in the sky in a huge pattern that could be seen clearly in several cities around the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain
The pattern was like a dazzling red rose. The moment it bloomed in the sky, the energy it erupted with quickly swept through the entire Ice Dragon Ruins. Moreover, the heat wave spread out and melted countless amounts of ice and snow…
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
In a short moment, this place had already become the Ice Fire Mountain. The periphery was still filled with a huge snowstorm, but the core area of the Ice River Totem seal had already become a sea of fire.
The snow mountain turned into a flaming mountain that connected to the sun, isolating the ice and snow energy of the outside world. It directly created a strange scene of ice and fire coexisting
In the distance, in the sky, a flying dragon airship was flying side by side with a frost dragon.
“Holy shit.”
Seeing this scene, the frost dragon kept cursing in its heart as it looked at the flying dragon warship in disbelief.
Because the thing that easily rewrote the snow mountain environment just now was launched by this big guy that was far from even overlord level.
However, the power of this attack made the frost dragon feel that it was troublesome if they were to fight before it broke through!
Even when Emperor Shi was at the master level, he couldn’t use such a powerful skill!
“Holy shit, holy shit, what’s going on? Isn’t he just a master like you?” The frost dragon said telepathically to Shi Yu in shock.
“How can you defeat this!!”
“I feel that the power of that thing’s explosion is even stronger than the power in Mu Huiyin’s body.”
“Little Chi Tong will be blown up!”
“Moreover, this move is actually continuously attracting the power of the sun… I’m afraid that in a few decades, the entire snow mountain will completely disappear and become a volcano!”
Shi Yu :”…”
He gave a speechless look to the Ice Dragon.
“Didn’t you listen carefully just now? This thing is a one-time use, and the preparation time is very long. The use restrictions are also large. Most importantly, it’s definitely forbidden in the competition.”
He wondered if the power of self-destruction could catch up to this after Baby Ginseng reached the monarch level… Shi Yu felt that it was a little difficult.
After all, the Sun Rose could directly trigger the power of the sun, while Baby Ginseng only relied on the power of the moonlight. As for the moonlight, it also came from the sun, and its level was lower.
Eh… Since the moonlight came from the sun, he wondered if Baby Ginseng’s Moon Explosion level could directly trigger the power of the sun to coexist with the power of the moon!
“Ah, right.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Ice Dragon reacted.
Then, it looked at the sea of fire in front of it in shock.
However, it was still impressive.
In the first totem battle, the lowest threshold of Emperor Shi’s elite army was also at the master level.
If those masters could display such power, then the first totem battle wouldn’t have taken so
long.
They would have expelled the totems and overlords into the barren area in minutes.
Ice Dragon had finally learned something after seeing Shi Yu and the others brag about forbidden weapons for so long.
This was only a small forbidden weapon used by masters.
Then, how strong would a normal forbidden weapon used by a legend be?
Ice Dragon shuddered. What strange things had humans developed?
It really wanted to let Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin take a look. Unfortunately… there was no chance…
“Mission completed.”
After rewriting the geographical environment of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in one hit, Gao Xuan walked out of the nutritional cabin calmly.
But he wasn’t handsome for more than three seconds.
Then, his arm trembled as he took out supplement pills and medicine from his pocket and popped them. It looked like he had consumed a lot of energy.
Shi Yu :”…”
Damn, even a Mechanic had to take supplements.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - Spring of Baby Ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 267 Spring of Baby Ginseng
As the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain completely turned into the Ice Fire Snow Mountain, the beast tide incident that had troubled Icefield City for thousands of years was finally resolved from the source.
Gao Xuan didn’t choose to stay longer in Icefield City.
After completing his mission, he bade farewell and left.
For him, choosing to stay and wait for the gratitude of the various higher-ups in Icefield City was not worth sacrificing his return to the research institute to upgrade his machinery.
Next, Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and the others didn’t choose to stay longer in Ping Cheng. Only the locals of Icefield City were left behind to keep themselves busy.
As for the frost dragon, it naturally followed Shi Yu.
However, before going to Dragon Palace City, Ice Dragon had something very important to do.
This was also what Ice Dragon requested.
It wanted to know the history of the outside world in the two thousand years it had been sleeping and suppressing the Ice River Totem.
Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and the Sun Rose they shot really shocked the ice dragon.
It urgently wanted to know how much change had happened in the outside world.
In the end, this science mission was snatched away by the gem cat.
It was mainly to increase the relationship between the sisters, and it had nothing to do with anything else.
With a huge pile of books and a pile of historical movies, the gem cat and Ice Dragon entered the Mu Huiyin ruins brought by Ice Dragon and started the drama pursuit of the two house girls.
In the Ice Dragon Ruins.
Ice Dragon’s shocked voice came from time to time.
“Holy shit, this Wu Emperor is something. He actually developed the Fusion Talent to this extent?”
“Others can only fuse with one pet at a time, but he can fuse with many?”
“So many advantages of different races have been inherited by one person, how did it lose to that Yun An?”
“You’re saying that this empress is Mu Huiyin’s younger sister?”
“Oh my god, a hybrid can also become the ruler of Dong Huang?”
“Nine totem-level Phoenix Race pets, impressive. What, the Phoenix Race died?”
“Holy shit, this Dragon Emperor actually overthrew the previous Dragon God of Dragon Palace City with the new Dragon God?”
“What, he just has an ordinary strengthening talent?”
“But its luck is heaven-defying. It fell off the cliff when it was young and obtained the recognition of the Dragon Race’s Mythical Ruins? It’s fake, right!”
“Impressive. This Space Emperor is so impressive. It actually established a spatial teleportation array that covered the entire planet!”
“Even Emperor Shi couldn’t!”
“This Lin Feng became a legendary Beast Tamer at the age of 26?”
“Damn, he obtained the blessings of the World Tree of Initiation? I’ve heard of it. Isn’t that the embodiment of the planet’s will?”
“It actually came into contact with humans?”
“Was the Mechanic class invented by this big boss called Shen Yuan?”
“Ah, no? What, that country with the Condor as the totem? They separated from the totem and established their country with machinery?”
“Hurry, hurry, hurry, find more. Don’t just talk about Dong Huang’s history. I also want to see the history of other places… For example, that damn Dragon Hunter…”
…
In the outside world.
Shi Yu was still meditating leisurely, accompanying Eleven and the others in training.
He had already understood the history that the gem cat was telling the Ice Dragon. He couldn’t be bothered to revise it with them again.
The things recorded in this textbook were too shallow. It barely covered much of his own country, let alone others.
If there was a chance, Shi Yu wanted to blow up the ruins of other countries and explore it himself.
However, training pets was still more important at the moment. After a period of time.
To be honest, the effect of controlling strength to undergo various extreme training was indeed pretty good. It had only been less than half a month.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong’s will had all been tempered to the second stage.
Shi Yu divided the pet’s will into five stages according to the success rate of teaching super skills displayed in the index.
The first stage was that the success rate of teaching was “extremely low”. The second stage was that the success rate was “low”.
Third and fourth naturally corresponded to “medium” and “high”.
en
In short, although they were still very far from the overlord’s will, Shi Yu was still relatively satisfied that they could be effective so quickly.
However, although he was satisfied, Shi Yu still felt a little anxious.
At this moment, Shi Yu was quietly waiting for the Dragon Palace banquet. After the Dragon Palace banquet, followed by the National League, he felt that the time was quite tight.
It had only been more than a month since the National League.
In such a short period of time, Shi Yu did not even have 1% hope that the four pets would master the overlord will.
Initially, Shi Yu wanted them to master the overlord will before breaking through to the monarch level.
However, if they didn’t break through to the monarch level, they definitely couldn’t fight the National League, and there would be no mechanical materials. Therefore, Shi Yu was currently struggling internally, wondering if he should let one guy break through first. “I wonder if Eleven’s super skill teaching success rate can reach ‘medium’ in a month. If it can, let it break through first.”
As for the new pet that he would contract in Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu didn’t have much anticipation. He didn’t think that it could form battle power in the short term.
Because he estimated that he wouldn’t directly contract a monarch-level pet.
Now, his favorite pet was a pet with a low growth level, a high race level, and best if it had the will of an overlord. It was best if it had a cooler appearance.
As he thought about it, Shi Yu felt that something was wrong. Why was this contracted pet so similar to finding a partner? It had to be young and had a good background.
He wanted the other party to work hard and look good…
Usually, there were such high requirements… His own situation was very worrying.
Shi Yu :”…”
However, Shi Yu felt that he should be qualified to talk about conditions.
“Shi Yu…”
“Yes.”
In the room, Shi Yu was drinking ice tea in disappointment and was resting for a short period of time. Suddenly, a familiar voice came from the outside.
A moment later, President Feng of the Ping Cheng Association came to visit Shi Yu with a smile.
“Uncle Feng, what’s wrong?” In the living room, after receiving the other party in, Shi Yu also brought him a cup of fruit tea and asked him what was wrong.
“Good thing!” President Feng smiled.
“What good thing?” Shi Yu was amused.
“Now, the safety hazards of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain have been completely eliminated.”
“As the big contributor to cracking the Ice Dragon Ruins, what do you think is a good thing?”
“Actually, we started discussing it very early. After the joint discussion of the presidents of the nine associations in our Icefield City, we decided to give you some rewards!”
“Although it might not be worth much to you, it’s still my intention. You know that our Icefield City isn’t very rich.”
President Feng smiled bitterly.
In the end, it was still too late. If he had expressed it earlier, Shi Yu might have been able to use it. However, who would have expected that in just a few months, Shi Yu’s realm had left the level-two city?
Now, as the genius with the greatest potential in the third and eleventh bureau, and even the reserve member of the first bureau, Shi Yu might not necessarily lack anything.
However, Icefield City couldn’t say nothing.
After all, it was rare for a super genius to appear in Icefield City. Even if Shi Yu didn’t develop and settle in Icefield City in the future, he had to leave a good impression on Shi Yu.
“Please go ahead.” Shi Yu didn’t refuse anyone and didn’t say any typical polite words.
Under normal circumstances, it was the other party who would feel bad if he rejected the offer.
resoul
“Actually, the main thing is a resource. I won’t talk about the other honors and bonuses in detail.” President Feng smiled and said,
“Do you still remember the Evolution Holy Spring I brought you to back then?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“The guardian Ancient Tree Monarch over there is relatively special. Generally speaking, the Ancient Tree of Life race only has one super skill, ‘Life Gift’.”
Shi Yu continued to nod.
“However, because of some fortuitous encounters, the guardian monarch of our Icefield City, the Ancient Tree of Life, also mastered an additional super skill, Plant Control!”
“This actually originates from a wood-element level-eight resource, the Seed of Nature. The Seed of Nature is a very special resource, and it’s also a strengthening-type resource. It can increase the affinity between plant-type life forms that absorb its power and natural power.”
“The Ancient Tree King of Life awakened an additional plant control skill because it absorbed the Nature Seed. At the same time, its own strength has become much stronger than other pets of its own race. In addition, it has always been protecting the Evolution Holy Spring. Its battle power should be considered strong among monarchs.”
“As for the Seed of Nature, it’s actually a renewable resource. As long as it’s placed in a place with rich natural power, it will emit energy again after dozens to hundreds of years… Therefore, this resource has always been preserved in Icefield City. Although it hasn’t recovered to the level of a level-eight resource, the advantage is that it can be reborn!”
“To put it simply, in the city, I’ve decided to give this Nature Seed to you as a reward. This is a quasi-eight-level resource. It can almost 100% allow plant-type creatures with good talent potential to awaken super skill plant control and increase their understanding of natural power.”
“This is also the most valuable resource in Icefield City. I hope you don’t mind.”
“Our Icefield City definitely doesn’t have those legendary resources,” President Feng said with a smile.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned and exclaimed in his heart.
This was the first super skill he copied, and he still was unable to teach it and was troubling over it. Now support had come all of a sudden?
Although Shi Yu wanted to say that there was no need, he was just doing his duty, but… it was too much! He was giving him a level-eight resource!
“No, no, don’t worry about it! Icefield City will always be my home. Ping Cheng too.”
The second day. The Nature Seed was sent by President Feng.
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others’ cultivation was just about over.
Shi Yu had just perfected Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong’s clone skills.
The Seed of Nature came at the right time. It could be used for Baby Ginseng’s next stage of training. “Yi, Yi! (Shi Yu, Shi Yu, this is… Could this be…)”
In the ruins space, Baby Ginseng widened its green eyes and looked at the green seed in Shi Yu’s hand eagerly.
It couldn’t help but drool. “Yi! (Nature Seed!)”
Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up.
Having studied the Feeding Department, it knew a lot of high-level resources. It could tell at a glance what was in Shi Yu’s hand.
“Yeah.”
Shi Yu smiled and weighed the seed in his hand. “Do you want it?”
“Yi!!!”
Baby Ginseng drooled and nodded crazily. Shi Yu was speechless.
“Then I’ll give it to you.”
“However, after learning plant control, it will probably be easier to create nutritional supplements, Time Fruits, and other resources. You have to work hard for the gift to Dragon Palace City this time.”
“If the quality level isn’t good, we’ll make up for it with numbers.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he threw the Nature Seed to Baby Ginseng. When Baby Ginseng heard Shi Yu’s words, its body stiffened, but it still happily took the Nature Seed.
It nodded heavily with a pleasantly surprised expression. Its hands emitted a green natural light as it held the seed in midair.
“Yi… Yi… Yi… Yi… Yi…!”
Holding the Nature Seed, Baby Ginseng cried out excitedly. It immediately tried to absorb the power on the spot.
Buzz!
The next moment, the power of nature bloomed.
Green light instantly lingered around Baby Ginseng’s body, and boundless vitality instantly erupted from its body.
Its aura flowed out and quickly changed the environment here.
Shi Yu and the others were currently in a very ordinary barren land. There were no plants, but at this moment, endless vitality immediately spread from the soil.
Almost instantly, as far as the eye could see, the ground turned into a verdant green. The tender green grass stretched all the way, covering all the soil in sight. A seed, combined with the power of the ginseng baby, contained natural plant energy that was comparable to a forest filled with life!
A moment later, with a boom, the ground cracked. Under the lingering green light, many trees quickly grew out of the ground. The trees seemed to have been uprooted, forming a forest in an instant.
Countless dazzling green fruits bloomed from the trees. Bright flowers emitted fragrance as they bloomed. Baby Ginseng clones separated from the tree trunks to reveal their figures… Skill: Plant Control
(Skill Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a wood-element skill. It has the absolute right to control natural plants. It can control plants, control the growth of plants, and increase the quality of plants. It is the king of plants.
Unsurprisingly, because Baby Ginseng had a huge amount of life force and basic moves like transcendent lushness, it awakened and mastered plant control the moment it came into contact with the Nature Seed! Be it nutritional supplements, energy fruits, time fruits, fragrance, or clones, at this moment, they could rely on the plants to be born in the dense sea of trees it instantly created!
“Yi! (Amazing!)”
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was immersed in the power of nature and was extremely excited.
As expected of it…
At that moment.
The shocking change in the power of nature naturally attracted the attention of Eleven, Buggy, and Little Chi Tong, who were training elsewhere.
Soon, they rushed over at a very fast speed. Then, they saw the baby ginseng in the sea of trees that looked like a natural god and instantly fell into deep thought.
“Wuu?”
“Wu?”
“Mi?”
Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong quickly looked at Shi Yu, suspecting that Shi Yu had given Baby Ginseng special treatment.
Otherwise, why would Baby Ginseng suddenly become stronger?
It had clearly just strengthened ridiculously through evolution, and now this was very exaggerated.
“Ah, this.”
Shi Yu revealed an innocent expression. It wasn’t his fault. It was purely because Icefield City didn’t give them the resources.
Icefield City would have to take the blame for this.
At the same time, Baby Ginseng, who was standing in the sea of trees and controlling countless plants, opened its eyes.

Chapter 268 Birth of a King
Half a month later.
The date approached the Dragon Palace banquet.
At this moment, in Dong Huang, the list of people who were going to Dragon Palace City to communicate this year was finally confirmed. There were a total of 12 people in the younger generation.
They were all young talents under the age of 30 in Dong Huang Among them, there were even some Beast Tamers whose spatial levels had reached level five and six.
For example, White Brook, Shi Yu, Zou Tianwang…
“Then I’ll see you in Binhai City the day after tomorrow.”
Ping Cheng In the villa, Shi Yu was holding his cell phone and talking to the beast-eared girl.
The two of them were going to Dragon Palace City. When the time came, they naturally had to meet in Binhai City.
This time, there was a big boss leading the team in Binhai City. Otherwise, Shi Yu and the others alone weren’t qualified to step foot into the ocean. “Alright, Eh, why do I hear a woman’s voice? Who’s crying?”
On the other side of the phone, White Brook just nodded when her ears suddenly twitched. Was a girl with Shi Yu?
“…It’s Senior Lin. She’s activating Eleven’s bloodline.”
“It’s been almost a month. I wonder when it can be activated.” Shi Yu sighed.
Although Zhong Xuan said that it might take a while, this was also too long.
In the past few days, Eleven had raised Senior Lin’s Iron-eating Beast’s hardening level to perfection, but its bloodline had yet to be activated!
Shi Yu was already considering if it was because Senior Panda was too lousy…
It was time to find a stepmother for Eleven.
“I see. Continue, I’m hanging up.” After White Brook said a few words, she hung up. On Ping Cheng, Shi Yu had just hung up when he suddenly heard a bang.
“Wuu!!!”
Another woman exclaimed.
Shi Yu was stunned. He quickly ran to the other side of the wall and saw the panda senior looking at Eleven in shock.
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu looked at the messy room, the broken floor and ceiling, and the panda senior that seemed to have been sent flying. He was immediately stunned.
But soon, Shi Yu understood.
He looked at Eleven, who was in the center of the chaotic area and was subconsciously emitting deterrence. He was immediately stunned.
“It awakened!!” Lin Xiuzhu shouted in surprise.
It had definitely awakened!
Lin Xiuzhu had a feeling that good things came after suffering.
It was too difficult.
“I think so. Senior, you’re not injured, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“I’m fine, look at Eleven!”
“Alright.”
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at Eleven again.
In the index, Eleven’s energy level was slowly increasing. As expected, the awakening of his bloodline could also increase his energy level.
After nearly a month of training and nurturing, Eleven’s energy level had already exceeded 200,000.
Although it was inferior to a ginseng baby, it had successfully broken the traditional understanding limit.
“Wuu…”
In the room, Little Eleven lowered its head and stood on the floor as if it was unconscious.
Under its deterrence, cracks instantly appeared on the floor and ceiling.
Shi Yu and Lin Xiuzhu quietly watched Eleven. A moment later, the deterrence on Eleven gradually retracted and wrapped around its body, as if forming transparent flames.
“Eleven.”
Shi Yu called out. Eleven slowly raised its head and revealed its aggrieved big eyes. “Wuu.”
It looked at the surrounding environment and the deterrence on its body disappeared. It looked at Lin Xiuzhu and Shi Yu apologetically and immediately covered its mouth with tears to apologize. It didn’t look like it had just awakened and become the Panda King.
This, this, this…
It didn’t know why, but just now, it felt the deterrence power in its body spreading out uncontrollably.
“It’s alright, it’s alright ~” Lin Xiuzhu and Shi Yu said in unison. After saying that, they carefully observed Eleven’s changes.
“Is this considered awakening a royal bloodline?” Lin Xiuzhu slowly got up, crossed his arms, and asked curiously. He did feel that Eleven was different, but he couldn’t put his finger on it.
“It’s already awakened.”
Shi Yu couldn’t help but smile. He walked in front of Eleven, grabbed the back of its nape, and pulled it up.
Under the scan of the skill index, Shi Yu could already see the strongest evidence of Eleven awakening the royal bloodline!
Skill: Deterrence
Status: Can be taught
Originally, because of the racial restrictions, transcendent was the upper limit of Eleven’s deterrence level, but now, it was directly broken!
This was the advantage of having a royal bloodline!
Not only could deterrence be awakened at the Awakening level, but it could also turn deterrence into a racial skill, driving the growth level!
The upper limit of the deterrence skill proficiency would naturally be raised to the Dao Proficiency.
“There we go!!”
In the blink of an eye.
Shi Yu, who was in a good mood, suddenly made another shocking discovery. He couldn’t help but feel even happier.
Skill: Inner Power
Status: Can be taught
(Teaching success rate): Medium
It was unknown if it was the effect of the training during this period or the effect of Eleven awakening the royal bloodline this time. Its super skill teaching success rate directly reached medium!
It once again exceeded Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong by a large level.
It had reached the stage of willpower of the frost dragon and the gem cat.
Shi Yu recalled the race ability of the Iron-eating Beast King…
ca
According to Zhong Xuan, it could allow the Iron-eating Beast to increase its physique and physical fitness more efficiently after recovering from its near-death state. In short, it could increase the benefits of life-and-death battles and life-and-death training.
It seemed that… the overlord’s will also needed to be tempered in life and death?
In other words, the racial talent of the Iron-eating Beast King would increase the mastery of the overlord’s will?
Shi Yu took a deep breath and felt that he had discovered something extraordinary. He was also thinking if he should let Eleven know about this…
He was afraid that Eleven would take it too hard…
In short, the success rate of super skill teaching was medium.
This was also the highest level of willpower that Shi Yu had seen at the moment.
As for pets with “high” success rates for super skills, Shi Yu had never seen one with overlord’s will.
Of course, it was also possible that he had seen it before, but he didn’t use the skill index to judge.
For example, at that time, Shi Yu didn’t notice if its will stage was high or medium.
It was mainly because in the index, there were no super skills that could be used to detect the will of water-type pets.
This also reminded Shi Yu that before going to Dragon Palace City, he had to replicate a water-element super skill first. Otherwise, if he encountered water-type pets and used Eleven and the others’ super skills to test them, it would directly show that he couldn’t teach them, not the success rate of teaching
In that case, there was no way to find pets with overlord will at all.
He already had a target to steal from. It was the Tyrannical Sea Legend who was about to lead these young people to Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu had already asked around. At that time, they would ride the Tyrant Sea Legend’s water-type pet into the sea. At that time, there would be plenty of opportunities to touch powerful water-type overlords. There would definitely be people who could choose water-type skills.
“Then, isn’t Eleven very strong now?”
Seeing Shi Yu holding Eleven and smiling foolishly, Lin Xiuzhu asked in anticipation.
“Not yet.”
Eleven: Wu?
Wasn’t it strong?
Why did it feel that it was strong now?
“But when it breaks through to the monarch level, it will definitely be very strong.”
“I’ve decided to let Eleven break through to the monarch level tomorrow.”
Lin Xiuzhu: “Huh???”
Lin Xiuzhu’s beautiful eyes widened. “Aren’t you going to practice what overlord’s will you’re talking about?”
“You finally have a conscience?”
After coming to the Yu Family for so long, Lin Xiuzhu naturally knew how Shi Yu was training his pets recently. However, she only thought that Shi Yu was purely training his pet’s will. She didn’t know that super skills could just be added as points.
But no matter what, Shi Yu’s training method made Lin Xiuzhu whimper.
Eleven was still a child.
Using the deep sea pressure to strengthen its willpower, soaking in magma to train its willpower, falling from a height of 10,000 meters to train its willpower… It was too cruel. Although she didn’t understand… why Eleven was happy.
Eleven: Wu wu wu??
On the other side, when it heard that Shi Yu could let it break through, Eleven’s eyes flashed. Really?
Could it really break through?
Shi Yu had already made them suppress their breakthrough power for a month. Even the ginseng baby with an energy value exceeding 200,000 was holding it in. Eleven didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually plan to let it break through first.
Suddenly.
Eleven widened its eyes.
“Wuu!”
It waved its arms excitedly.
Could it be that it had already mastered the overlord’s will???
Roar, roar, roar.
Hahahaha, as expected of it.
Panda King Eleven let out an excited roar!
“Not yet.”
Shi Yu mercilessly threw Eleven down, leaving Eleven sitting on the ground in confusion.
“However, I think the overlord will is too far away. That’s the rare ability needed for monarchs to break through to the overlord level. It’s a little unrealistic for you to master it at the commander level. It might waste a lot of time.”
“Most importantly, you guys haven’t broken through for a long time. My meditation efficiency has been too low recently.”
“Therefore, I’ve decided that after your willpower reaches a certain standard, you can break through to the monarch level.” “Overlord’s Will… Continue training after the monarch level.”
Shi Yu set this standard at the medium success rate of super skills teaching.
Even the gem cat, who had participated in the Undead War, and the old witch, who had participated in the totem battle like the frost dragon, didn’t have the will to be an overlord. Shi Yu thought about it carefully and felt that Eleven and the others would probably be in trouble in the short term.
In that case, he felt that medium will was enough.
The overlord could wait until it reached the monarch level before grinding it.
It might still be lacking to rely on this kind of simulation training.
In any case, he already planned to explore a few more domestic ruins to play with after the National League. At that time, he shouldn’t lack natural environments for Eleven and the others to train in.
At the moment, the National League and meditation speed were more important. “Wuuu!!”
Eleven didn’t care what Shi Yu thought. It was already very happy that it could break through to the monarch level. “Tomorrow? What time?” Lin Xiuzhu asked.
“I’ll call my father over too. How about letting the two monarch-level Nine Li Battle Beast fight?” she suggested.
“Uh.” Shi Yu smiled awkwardly.
Senior Panda, stop scamming…
Had she not seen what Master Qu Jie and the Ox-Headed Beast King were like?
Shi Yu quickly said, “Forget about the battle. It’s just a breakthrough. Do you want to see it
too?”
“Of course!” Lin Xiuzhu rubbed her temples and said, “I massaged for a month with my own hands. I’m so tired. No matter what, you have to let me see the results.”
“Forget about dad, I’ll come myself.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled. As for why tomorrow and not today…
He planned to maximize Eleven’s deterrence skill before letting it break through.
With the most perfect Panda King deterrence, it would break through to the monarch level.
It would take another day to achieve this.
“By the way, Senior, don’t rush your Iron-eating Beast to evolve first. The hardening level can still be raised,” Shi Yu reminded.
“We’ll continue after we return from Dragon Palace City.” “Alright.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded.
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu no longer worried about the money for the evolution materials. Apart from the fact that the breeding base was growing bigger and bigger, and because she was now the exclusive feeder of the Iron-eating Beast Corps, the evolution materials of the Iron-eating Beasts could definitely be reimbursed from the military expenses.
