Chapter 269 Tyrannical Sea Legend and his Leviathan
Binhai City was located at the border of Dong Huang, just like Icefield City, at the sea. The weather here was suitable, the environment was beautiful, and the four seasons were distinct. In Dong Huang, it had the reputation of being a land of the sea, and a large number of water-element Beast Tamers had gathered. “Compared to Icefield City, the climate in Bin Hai City is much more likable. However, why do I keep feeling that this sentence has been said before…”
As Bin Hai City was just next door, it wasn’t very far. This time, Shi Yu didn’t take any transport and directly squeezed Buggy through the wilderness.
It was mainly to train Buggy.
Transcendent Instant Transmission was not the upper limit of proficiency. It was just the upper limit of the skill index. As long as one used more abilities, even if there was a bottleneck, it didn’t mean that one’s experience wouldn’t increase. At most, it was harder to increase than racial skills. Regarding the “divine skill” Instant Transmission, Shi Yu was naturally prepared to use Buggy as a core skill. It had nothing to do with laziness.. As for whether there would be danger if he casually traversed the wild like this, naturally not, because the Ice Dragon Ruins Ring he carried had a totem-level Ice Dragon and an overlord-level gem cat…
This lineup could start a war with some weaker totem tribes.
Of course, even without them, as Eleven broke through to the monarch level, there were rarely any wild environments in Dong Huang that could threaten Shi Yu.
In Dong Huang, there were basically no hostile overlord-level ferocious beasts. Such ferocious beasts were all killed and expelled, leaving only overlord-level creatures like the gem cat and the owl that were close to humans. Among the others, the highest was at the monarch level. Under such circumstances, as long as Shi Yu, who had already become a master, didn’t go to the dangerous place where the Undying Dark Phoenix was sealed, he would basically be able to do whatever he wanted in the country. After becoming a master, he would have the battle power of a monarch. Even if he had the qualifications to enter various regions in the country, he would be able to protect himself. After becoming a legend and possessing overlord-level battle power, he would have the right to protect himself even if he left the country and crossed the totem area! After all, as long as they were careful and didn’t take the initiative to find trouble with the totem country, the totems in the general totem area wouldn’t run out themselves. Most of the totems were still in a sleeping state like the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly. The strongest people there on the surface were usually overlord-level ferocious beasts. For example, the forbidden area where Baby Ginseng was born was the territory of an overlord-level creature.
“The appointment is at 8 a.m…. There’s still an hour. I’ll call and ask if Senior Bai is here.”
After arriving at Bin Hai City, Shi Yu walked on the street and spoke to the pile of pets he was armed with.
As usual, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng had all shrunk to the extreme. They were worn all over Shi Yu’s body like a pendant. If one didn’t look carefully, they wouldn’t have realized that Shi Yu had been carrying four pets beside him. Now, the most powerful thing was that after the four pets mastered transcendent shrinking, their shrunken strength was no different from their normal state. In this case, they were simply good at sneak attacks. It might be a little lacking to deal with powerful transcendent creatures, but if they wanted to ambush a Beast Tamer who was also a human, as long as the other party didn’t react immediately, the chances of success were very high.
Although he couldn’t use it in the country, Shi Yu knew that he would definitely enter the totem area in the future. There were also many human experts in the totem area. They believed in the totems and were enemies with Dong Huang. Many times, they were even more troublesome than ferocious beasts. In short, it would definitely be useful to deal with them when the time came. “Senior, where are you?” “Eh, another half an hour?” “Alright, then I’ll go to my destination first.”
As Shi Yu walked, he spoke to Senior Bai. At this moment, he suddenly realized that the street in front was extremely noisy… Somewhere, a group of students in school uniforms who were preparing to go to school gathered together. Not only were there students, but there were also various passers-by surrounding an area. “Wu Wu Wu.” Eleven and the others stuck their heads out and asked what was wrong. “Let me see.” Shi Yu jumped gently onto a tree and looked over quietly before falling into deep thought. In the crowd, an extremely handsome young man in a black trench coat who had reached 99% of Shi Yu’s own handsomeness was signing autographs for a group of people with a smile.
“Zou Tianwang, you’re my fan!!! Ah, no, I’m your fan!!”
“Zou Tianwang, give me your autograph. Your fiancée won’t be angry, right -“. “Zou Tianwang, what brings you to Binhai City? Could it be… that you’re here for your honeymoon in advance?” Shi Yu :”…”
This was very ridiculous! How could there be such a high-profile person? Damn it, he was even more high-profile than
him.
“It’s not anything important. Let’s go.” Then, he arranged for Buggy to teleport away from this place with him.
Binhai City, Binhai Training Hall. A famous training hall.
Although the sect master here was only a quasi legend, he was the personal disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend. As for who the Tyrannical Sea Legend was, he was one of the few titled experts in Dong Huang. He was a top-notch legend who could fight against totems. The people heading to Dragon Palace City gathered at the Bin Hai Training Ground today at the request of the Tyrant Sea Legend. When Shi Yu came to this Binhai Training Ground… How should he put it… He originally thought that it would be a simple and elegant place. After all, it was named as a training hall, but in the end, from the outside, it looked like a huge aquarium. There was also a glass door that automatically spun outside. It was very modern. “Times have changed.” Shi Yu shook his head and directly entered the room according to the circling rhythm of the automatic door. Just as he entered, he was immediately attracted by the pets in the water wall on both sides of the
hall.
The walls of the Binhai Training Hall were all connected to a huge fish tank. Inside was a small ecological environment created by someone. Many identical small animals swam inside. They were relatively similar to baby fish and gold fish, but their bodies were blue. [Name]: Blue Salamander
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Low-level transcendent
[Level of Growth]: Level 2 Awakening
[Race Skill]: Bubbles
< Introduction > It looks like a race that can’t be helped, but it might contain astonishing potential.
Shi Yu :”….”
Well… There was nothing wrong with that. Under normal circumstances, the blue salamander was mud, and its strength was limited compared to the green worm and the dragon carp. However, the Green Silkworm could transform into a butterfly, the Dragon Carp could transform into a dragon, and the Blue Salamander had a chance to change its fate. It could also evolve. Among them, the most famous example was the Fusion of the Tyrannical Sea Legendary Fish. He directly cultivated the Blue Salamander into a mutated Leviathan that was as high as a quasi Mythical race. Although it was at the overlord level, under the command of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, it could match and defeat totems. Of course, this was only an exception. Apart from the gathering of the Tyrannical Sea Legendary Fish, no one could nurture the Blue Salamander to this height. It was another irreplicable example. Compared to the green worm and dragon carp, this mud was even harder to nurture!
The Green Silkworm had the worm silk, while the Dragon Carp had an evolution skill like the Leaping Dragon Gate, but the Blue Salamander had nothing. It was just a trashy bubble skill… It was difficult for it to be a gambler.
“Hello!!”
As Shi Yu observed the blue salamander, a woman in a blue Daoist robe welcomed him. She smiled and asked, “Excuse me, is this Mr. Shi Yu?”
“I am.” Shi Yu turned to look at him. “Hello, I’m a teacher from the training hall, Chenyu. The sect master has instructed me to lead you to the private room.” “Thank you,” Shi Yu said. Then, Miss Chen Yu began to lead Shi Yu to a quiet room specially used to receive distinguished guests in the Dao field.
This room was not only used to receive Shi Yu alone. The 12 youths who were about to head to the Dragon Palace banquet were all invited to stay here. At this moment, there were already seven people in the room. The disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, a young man who was nearly 30 years old and looked elegant, was speaking to the other six as the host.
“I won’t go this time. I went with Master at the last Dragon Palace banquet. My Great Dragon King Squid was contracted at that time, haha.” “In short, I hope you can also get the pets you like.”
“At that time, there should be a lot of overlord-level sea beasts. Don’t be nervous. When it’s time to showcase your strength and talent in various activities, just perform normally. You’re all geniuses, so there’s no problem.” Dong dong dong. In the room, everyone was listening to the disciple of the Tyrant Sea Legend. He already had a level-seven space, and he was just short of the experience of Zheng Hai, who was judged as a legendary Beast Tamer by an overlord-level creature.
This person was also one of the genius Beast Tamers praised to be destined to become a legend in the country. He was also the second Beast Tamer to nurture the Blue Salamander into the mixed Race after the Tyrant Sea Legend. Although it wasn’t a mutated Leviathan like the Tyrant Sea Legend and hadn’t reached that height, and its race was much worse, it was still commendable.
Because of this, he was taken in by the Tyrannical Sea Legend as a disciple and carefully cultivated. Now, the difference between his ace pet and the overlord level was probably the proficiency of a super skill. “Please come in.” As someone knocked, Zheng Hai looked over. The other six people in the room also looked over. The door was pushed open and Chen Yu entered the room with Shi Yu.
“Sect Master Zheng, Mr. Shi Yu has also arrived.”
After Chen Yu said that, the gaze in the room instantly landed on Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s gaze also observed the room.
Among the seven people, apart from Zheng Hai, Shi Yu knew two of the other six. One was Dr. Zuo’s daughter, the talented student of Demon Capital University, Xia Qingwei. The other was Yin Legend’s genius son, Yin Zhengfan.
At this moment, Xia Qingwei was still alright, but when Yin Zhengfan saw Shi Yu come, he immediately fell silent. [At that time, what exactly happened in the Time Ruins?] Yin Zhengfan still couldn’t forget it. Shi Yu was more unfamiliar with the other four.
There was a muscular man more than two meters tall who didn’t look like a normal person… Shi Yu thought that was probably that guy with dragon blood. When he saw that it wasn’t a Dragon Princess but the Dragonman man, Shi Yu’s mood immediately became a little complicated. Apart from that, there was also a woman with blue wavy hair. She looked pretty cool and wore pretty cool clothes…
The last two people were a young man with a crew cut, wearing a white shirt and glasses. He looked ordinary. The other person had short hair, was dressed in black, and had a very fierce appearance. He looked even fiercer than the muscular man with the mixed blood of a human and a dragon, as if he had just come out of prison and came with deterrence.
“Hello, everyone.” Shi Yu smiled when he saw everyone.
“Mr. Shi Yu… Welcome,” Zheng Hai said with a smile.
Although he was a disciple of the Tyrant Sea Legend and a famous quasi legend, Zheng Hai didn’t dare to be arrogant when he saw Shi Yu. After all, although this person wasn’t even 20 years old, he was a real super genius who had researched a major project like the Green Silkworm cocoon to benefit the country and the people. “Sect Master Zheng,” Shi Yu greeted. Zheng Hai smiled again and immediately introduced them to each other. Needless to say, Shi Yu finally knew the identities of Xia Qingwei and Yin Zhengfan. The muscular man was indeed a hybrid. His name was Long Rui. He had graduated from Demon Capital University and was a master-level Beast Tamer. “Hello, I’ve heard so much about you.” He grinned. The blue-haired woman came from an elemental family and graduated from a top-notch university in the Spirit Capital known as the Elemental Capital. She was a master-level elementalist.
“Junior Shi Yu, I’ve finally seen him in person. I feel he’s much more handsome than in the photo.” She blinked at Shi Yu. “Hello, Senior.” Shi Yu’s smile widened, making Xia Qingwei purse her lips. The bespectacled young man graduated from Star Capital University, known as the capital of technology. He was a master-level Mechanic.
“Hello,” he pushed his glasses and greeted simply.
The last person was from the Dragon Tamer Family and graduated from the Imperial Capital University. He was called Yun Fei and was a master-level Dragon Tamer. He was more arrogant and only nodded.
The few of them had one common characteristic: they came from first-level cities and were from famous families. Shi Yu didn’t know their identities, but these few people were very familiar with Shi Yu. It couldn’t be helped, Shi Yu was too famous… “Where were we just now…” After everyone introduced themselves, they didn’t talk in detail. After all, they had just met. At this moment, Zheng Hai started to think again. However, as time approached, the subsequent people came very quickly. There was already no time for him to talk nonsense.
In the next moment, there was another knock on the door. A cloaked youth about Shi Yu’s age entered the room. “I’m Yu Shu.” The future “Dragon King Yu Shu” directly entered the room. When he saw the figures of Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan in the room, his expression immediately darkened.
He kept feeling that this trip to the Dragon Palace was a little depressing… He had already told his mother that he wasn’t coming. He wasn’t coming anymore. Damn it.
Yo.
Shi Yu smiled at Yu Shu.
Speaking of which, Ancient Capital University was really impressive this time. There were actually three people who went to Dragon Palace City, and they were all students… If it weren’t for the fact that Yin Zhengfan had escaped to Imperial Capital University, they might have been able to gather four! “There are so many people already.” Soon, the beast-eared girl, White Brook, also arrived. After she arrived at the scene, she clearly knew more people than Shi Yu. For example, those masters were old opponents of Ancient Capital University. They had all “fought a bloody battle” with Ancient Capital University in the National League.
White Brook smiled and sat beside Shi Yu.
Then, two more people arrived together. Both of them were wearing navy battle suits. It looked like they were geniuses in the Beast Tamer Troops. Everyone knew the least about their deeds.
“Am I late?” In the end, Zou Tianwang Yun also arrived with a smile. This person’s strength was not necessarily weaker than Sect Master Zheng Hai. Perhaps he was the strongest among the group. Seeing Zou Tianwang, the national celebrity Beast Tamer, arrive, the Binhai Training Hall became more and more lively. “Yes, you’re late. Why do I see you signing autographs for the students by the roadside?” White Brook directly insulted Zou Tianwang. “Haha, I have no choice… I don’t want to be so popular either.” Zou Tianwang scratched his head. Shi Yu :”…”
After Zou Tianwang arrived, his gaze also landed on Shi Yu at the same time. The corners of his mouth twitched without a trace.
Just like Yu Shu, he had a bad feeling about this trip to the Dragon Palace. “In that case… everyone is here.” Seeing that, Sect Master Zheng Hai smiled and looked at everyone. “It’s about time. Then I’ll bring everyone to find Master now, right?”
At the Binhai Training Hall. At the core of this place, there was a special room that looked like a swimming hall. However, the pool here was directly connected to the sea.
At this moment, in the room, there was a middle-aged man who looked to be about 5 to 60 years old, had dark skin, messy hair, and a rugged build. He had his hands behind his back and was quietly looking at the surface of the pool. “Master!”
As movement came from the surroundings, he slowly looked over and saw Zheng Hai bringing 12 young talents who were about to set off for Dragon Palace City to come here. “Master, everyone is here.” Zheng Hai said respectfully to the Tyrannical Sea Legend. “I understand.” The Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded and looked at the people behind Zheng Hai. “Tyrannical Sea Legend.” Everyone greeted. In the face of everyone’s greeting, he swept his gaze across everyone and said, “Hello, your elders have already told you the rules for participating in the Dragon Palace banquet in Dragon Palace City, right?” Everyone nodded, except for Shi Yu. Eh? What rules?
Did Principal Feng and President Ye tell him? Forget it, it wasn’t a big problem… At this moment, the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s gaze stopped on Shi Yu for a few seconds. An existence like him had actually surpassed departments like Bureau 13. After all, he was a Beast Tamer who had defeated totems. Even the strongest bureau, the first bureau’s members… Was nothing in the eyes of the Tyrannical Sea Legend. As for Shi Yu, who had a bunch of titles, he was still a junior in his eyes. However, at this moment, Legend Sea Tyrant observed Shi Yu for a long time. He asked, “Is it here?” Obviously, the Tyrannical Sea Legend had learned about the frost dragon in advance. “Yes, but now… he might be sleeping,” Shi Yu said.
The Frost Dragon and the Gem Cat had worked hard for almost half a month. They had not slept for half a month and had pretty much chewed up the history both domestically and abroad. Next, in order to go to Dragon Palace City in their best state, Ice Dragon and the others chose to sleep for a while and let him call them when they reached Dragon Palace City. “I see.” The conversation between him and Shi Yu confused everyone except White Brook. They didn’t know what they were communicating about. It? Who… A moment later, Tyrannical Sea Legend looked at the pool and said, “Then let’s go. We’ll talk about the rest on the way.” As soon as he finished speaking, with a boom, a huge deep sea vortex slowly appeared in the pool in front of them. The inside of the vortex was pitch-black. Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned. The Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “This vortex is the mouth of my pet. You guys jump into its stomach. It will bring us to the Deep Sea Dragon Palace City.” Everyone: w (A) w?? Huh?
On the ground, Shi Yu was also stunned. However, he was more concerned about the detection reaction of the index to the pet that had yet to appear!
< Name > Mutated Leviathan
[Attributes]: Water, Space [Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical) [Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 9,9110,000 < Introduction > It’s the battle pet representing the Tyrannical Sea Legend! Shi Yu was stunned. Good lord… They were both overlord races, but this guy had nearly 50 million energy points higher than the gem cat. He was even more impressive than the Dragon Palace City Whale General. It was probably about to enter the totem level. “Not moving?” Seeing that everyone was still not jumping into the sea, the Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “Then let me do it.” “Just don’t vomit in it.”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone’s expressions suddenly changed. They felt a huge devouring force coming from the deep sea vortex. Almost instantly, Shi Yu and the others felt their bodies turn blurry, as if they had been forcefully teleported by a spatial skill. They appeared in another alternate space! “My pet’s body is equivalent to a small world and a mystic realm. You don’t have to worry. This is its racial skill.”
The surroundings were still pitch-black. Then, light slowly recovered. At the same time, the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s voice sounded in everyone’s ears.
At this moment, darkness turned to light. The others looked around in surprise, but Shi Yu was the most silent.
Because…
Skill: Infinite Devour
[Attributes]: Water, Space (Level]: Super level < Introduction > It’s a devouring-type evolution skill. It can open up a devouring space and increase its race level by devouring and digesting everything. It can complete unlimited evolution! [Copy this skill?] Holy shit, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was really showing off his Leviathan at the start. Its evolution depended on devouring.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - Shocking Little Friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 270 Shocking Little Friends
The Mutated Giant Leviathan’s body was like a water-element world.
Flying birds made of water flew in the sky, blue frogs made of water leaped on the land, and fish made of water wandered in the water. Apart from that, there were countless water elemental creatures living freely here.
Apart from Shi Yu, the others were looking around in surprise.
Soon, these young people understood why there were so many elemental creatures in the Giant Leviathan.
It was said that in battle, the Tyrannical Sea Legend could let the Giant Leviathan temporarily devour him and his other pets to increase its battle power and obtain the power to suppress the totem.
In other words, all the elemental creatures living in the Giant Leviathan’s body might be the backup power of the Giant Leviathan? “This space is much higher than Buggy’s spatial bag. As expected of a super skill.” Standing on the ground, Shi Yu thought to himself.
Buggy’s spatial pocket didn’t have the ability to store living creatures. In comparison, this devouring space could not only absorb living creatures, but it could also transform them into its own power… It was a little similar to Buggy’s equipment?
Eh?
Damn.
Shi Yu suddenly fell silent. He felt like he had entered a dangerous place.
[Replication success]
Forget it, this skill was his now anyway.
Now he had the water-type super skill to test the water-type pet’s will in Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu only had one evaluation for this skill. It was powerful!
No wonder the Tyrannical Sea Legend could grow to the point where it could fight against totems. This Infinite Devour probably played a crucial role.
Shi Yu felt that as long as a pet with this skill grew smoothly, it might be able to grow into a Mythical race.
He estimated that the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s Giant Leviathan was stuck in a quasi Mythical race. It was probably limited by the proficiency of the devouring skill and couldn’t digest legendary and Mythical resources. Or perhaps its digestion speed was too slow. Otherwise, it should be able to evolve infinitely.
“Hey, hey, hey, look.”
In the Giant Leviathan Space, White Brook patted the shoulder of the stunned Shi Yu.
She pointed forward.
At this moment, in the air of this space, a huge water screen condensed out of thin air. The water screen was like glass, allowing everyone to clearly see the environment in the deep sea outside.
“This is…”
In Shi Yu and the others’ vision, a new world appeared. In the dark blue underwater world, piles of colorful fish quickly swam past, as if they were dodging some huge monster. The emerald green water grass creatures at the edge of their vision cowered in a corner and trembled.
Gulp.
Countless bubbles appeared. The Giant Leviathan was still diving into the deep sea. With the protection of the overlord-level Giant Leviathan, there was no doubt that no sea beast would come looking for trouble.
“It will take about an hour for us to reach Dragon Palace City.”
Legend Sea Tyrant appeared behind everyone, still with his hands behind his back, his gray hair flying around.
“During this period, you guys communicate yourselves.”
As soon as Legend Ba Hai finished speaking, he turned and left again. No one knew where he went. Seeing this, everyone immediately started chattering.
The fierce-faced man from the Dragon Tamer Family, Yun Shu, looked at Yu Shu. “You’re just an intermediate Beast Tamer. Why are you here too?”
The two of them were both descendants of famous Dragon Tamers. Their circle was very small, so they naturally knew each other. “Aren’t you just a few years older than me? I’ll definitely become a master before graduation. What are you so proud of?” The corners of Yu Shu’s mouth twitched.
In the face of geniuses like Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan who weren’t older than him, he could only admit defeat. However, he was very unhappy with these people who pretended to be strong just because they were a few years older and had meditated for a few more years. Of course… Yu Shu didn’t deny that this fellow’s reverse scale talent was more suitable for contracting a dragon than him.
“I’m doing this for your own good. You’re so weak now, how can a dragon acknowledge you?” Yun He chuckled.
“There’s no need to trouble yourself,” Yu Shu said. He naturally had the capital to obtain the recognition of the dragon race this time.
Others relied on their talent potential, but couldn’t he rely on resources? Yu Shu tightened his backpack. At that time, when he took out the dragon-element evolution resources his father had prepared, he might have pets following him.
“Haha, everyone has a chance. By the way, it’s rare for us to go to Dragon Palace City together. Why don’t we share the type of pet we like?” At this moment, Zou Tianwang said with a smile in the crowd.
Seeing that everyone was doing their own thing, he couldn’t help but want to unify the topic and get closer to everyone. “For example, me. You also know that I have a dark-element strengthening talent. This time, I’m here for a certain race. I heard that the Black Flood Dragon overlord of Dragon Palace City has given birth to a son. I wonder if there’s a chance to obtain its recognition and be entrusted with a descendant.”
Zou Yun smiled and revealed his intention, not afraid that anyone would compete with him.
After saying that, he looked at everyone.
The muscular dragonman chuckled and said, “I’m not here specifically for a certain race.”
The blue-haired girl said, “That’s true. Your talent can purify the bloodline of dragon-type creatures, as long as it’s dragon-type.”
The muscular dragonman looked at the blue-haired girl and said, “Fang Lan, you must still have contracted a race that’s good at controlling the weather.”
“This is more compatible with your talent, right?”
“You guessed right. You’re not allowed to guess anymore next time,” Fang Lan said and looked at Shi Yu.
She smiled. Among these people, she was the most curious about Shi Yu. She said, “Junior Shi Yu, what about you? Is it alright to say?”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s alright. I have the gift of telepathy, and I don’t have any special talent. I prefer a pet I can get along with. As long as we get along and have eye contact, transcendent races are fine.” Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan: “?”
Everyone: “?”
They didn’t believe him. How could he have such a low request?
He just didn’t want to say it.
However… Shi Yu’s telepathy talent was indeed a little difficult to deal with.
After all, this wasn’t a battle-type talent.
The mechanical man from Star Capital University said, “I actually prefer one that I can get along with too. Recently, I’ve been researching biological mechanical modification. If any Dragon Palace City cub is also interested in the Mechanic class and is willing to become an experimental body personally and become stronger together, I don’t have any requirements for the race.”
Everyone: “?”
F*ck, another dangerous guy.
Biological mechanical modification… was a school of thought in the Mechanic class.
Among the Mechanics, there were pure mechanical creatures, such as Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. There were also those who transformed other life forms into mechanical beasts.
For example, equip a monkey with mechanical armor and install a cannon to evolve the creature into an Iron Gorilla Beast. This was biological mechanical modification.
However, because this school of thought was too risky and experimental accidents often occurred, it was relatively small.
This mechanical man actually targeted the citizens of Dragon Palace City… Would it really not destroy the friendship of the alliance? Would there really be pets like him who liked machinery… “Oh?” In the crowd, Shi Yu looked at the mechanical man and felt that he could chat when he was free.
This was because the ancient species machinery he wanted to create was also close to biological modification. However, the other party used creatures, while Shi Yu used illusions.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, with the illusion as the core, it should be able to have the common merits of both the pure Mechanical and biological modification sects.
The advantage of the biological modification faction was that there was a chance for the mechanical beast to inherit the Host’s abilities, but Beast Tamers couldn’t fuse with it at all.
As for the pure Mechanical Faction, it relied on the diversity of mechanical functions. For example, Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast could freely switch between the mecha and the flying ship form, and the Beast Tamer could carry it. With the illusion as the core, there was a possibility of inheriting the ability of ancient creatures, but because of the phantom’s ethereal nature, it could not be constrained by the form of ancient creatures. This was a virtue. For example, in Shi Yu’s opinion, he could completely create a fighter aircraft with the Wind God Winged Dragon template or a Gundam with the Tyrant Dragon template. This was the advantage of the Ancient Phantom Plant. It could combine the merits of the two factions!
According to what Shi Yu knew, the most powerful Mechanic in Ancient Capital University, Dean Hao, was a pure Mechanic. Therefore, he might still need some knowledge of the biological modification faction to assist him in completing ancient machinery.
He wondered how the background of this mechanical man from Star Capital University was…
“What about the two beauties?” Zou Yun asked Xia Qingwei and White Brook.
Xia Qingwei: “It doesn’t matter. It’s best if it’s a worm.”
Everyone :”…”
White Brook covered her forehead and said, “I have the Fusion Talent, so I definitely have to be handsome. The mermaids aren’t bad, the jellyfish aren’t bad, and beautiful coral creatures can work also… Ah, well, but before the contract, I don’t know what it’s like after the Fusion. It’s so difficult.”
It was indeed very difficult… After all, it concerned their looks in the future… Everyone prayed for White Brook. “What about little fan?” Shi Yu took over the topic of Zou Tianwang Yun and asked Yin Zhengfan. Why was this child so afraid of strangers? He didn’t say anything.
Yin Zhengfan :”…”
“I… I guess it depends on fate,” he said. “What about the two soldiers?” Zou Tianwang Yun smiled and looked at the two Beast Tamers from the navy.
The two navy Beast Tamers with thick eyebrows and big eyes said, “We are all assigned in a fixed manner. At that time, we will become comrades with a certain general of the Dragon Palace City’s Marine Corps to protect the ocean together.”
There was no need for them to be conflicted…
After that, everyone started to chat. From the totem dragon king of Dragon Palace City to the famous overlord general and the environment of Dragon Palace City…
Perhaps the subsidiary forces of Dragon Palace City were in different seas, but Dragon Palace City was an independent deep sea mystic realm.
That was also a brand new small world. What was relatively special was that there was also air there. On the contrary, there were not many water resources, but this didn’t affect anything. Because the water elements in the mystic realm were rich, both sea creatures and humans could move freely in the Dragon Palace City mystic realm. Therefore, this Dragon Palace banquet was naturally held in the mystic realm of Dragon Palace City.
“We’re almost there.”
Among the 12 people, someone kept counting the time.
As they approached the one-hour flight mentioned by the Tyrannical Sea Legend, everyone looked at the water screen.
Suddenly, the water screen collapsed. Everyone felt the sky and earth shake, as if they were pushed by a huge repulsive force.
“Tyrannical Sea Legend, you haven’t changed. Welcome, welcome.”
In the secret realm of Dragon Palace City.
On a floating island continent.
A huge sea beast in the form of a tiger whale seemed to have turned the air into an ocean as it floated quietly in midair.
Opposite the Sky Penetrating Whale was an even larger sea beast nearly a hundred meters tall. It had a blue body similar to a whale, and its huge abyss mouth had a circle of sharp white fangs. Its wild beast-like yellow pupils were filled with violent patterns. Its chest fin, abdomen fin, back fin, and tail fin were different from ordinary fish. They were like long and dense white feathers that fluttered with the wind.
At this moment, on the head of the Mutated Giant Leviathan, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was standing. Behind him were young people who had been teleported until they were dizzy.
“You’re the same. You still look so weak.” Legend Sea Tyrant smiled faintly. “Hahahaha.” The Sky Penetrating Whale laughed loudly and looked at the group of young people behind the Legend. At this moment, Shi Yu and the others also reacted and realized that they had arrived. Everyone stood on the Giant Leviathan’s huge body. When they observed their surroundings, they were immediately stunned.
The Dragon Palace Mystic Realm… was very big. As far as they could see, dozens of sky islands floated in the sky, and on them were dazzling palaces.
The place they were at was also very huge. It was impossible to see the end of it. Tens of thousands of shrimps and crabs guarded various places densely, as if they were welcoming guests. “Gulp.” Someone gulped and recognized the Sky Penetrating Whale. The Sky Penetrating Whale was completely famous among the sea beasts. It was a popular general in Dragon Palace City and had fought in countless seas. As long as it was an enemy of Dragon Palace City, even the larger whales and even the overlord ferocious sharks that made countless sea beasts tremble in fear… was just a meal to this Sky Penetrating Whale.
“Dragon Palace City, Sky Penetrating Whale, I heard its partner recently gave birth to a small tiger whale. I wonder if it’s true.” Among the crowd, someone’s heart immediately rippled when he saw the Sky Penetrating Whale.
If he could obtain the recognition of the Sky Penetrating Whale and be entrusted with its heir, that would be a leap into the sky. The Sky Penetrating Whale was an absolute top-notch overlord even among overlord-level creatures. Its strength and race were only inferior to the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s Giant Leviathan, an even more abnormal existence.
“Woo ~~” Just as Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the other young people looked at the Sky Penetrating Whale with anticipation, a white wind suddenly blew from the distance. Under everyone’s gaze, a small white dragon suddenly flew over excitedly.
Legend Sea Tyrant raised his brows and looked over.
“Dragon Palace City’s Third Crown Prince, White Azure Dragon?” Legend Ba Hai said.
At this moment, many young people, even Zou Tianwang Yun, who had come specially for a certain race, were instantly excited when he saw this divine dragon.
Holy shit.
They widened their eyes at the approaching divine dragon.
Looking at the smooth and powerful body that was like a painting of water and mountains, any Beast Tamer who was proficient in feeding could tell how top-notch this divine dragon was. At this moment, its body moved casually, waved its dragon claws, and circled in the sky. Its powerful dragon might involuntarily emitted. It was high and mighty, perfectly matching the expectations of most Beast Tamers present for the next pet.
“Dragon Palace City’s Third Prince, the son of Lin Feng’s legendary pet, the Sea Dragon King. No, he’s the son of the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King, a high-level overlord
race!”
At this moment, seeing this divine dragon, Zou Tianwang was extremely tempted. Although the Black Flood Dragon’s attributes were more compatible with him, the White Azure Dragon’s race, potential, talent, and background were stronger!
After all, it was the son of two totems. Moreover, as the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City, he had the chance to compete for the position of Dragon God with the other Dragon King heirs in the future.
Even Beast Tamers who didn’t have pets of their liking at the start were instantly tempted when they saw this White Azure Dragon.
Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, Zou Yun, and the others’ expressions turned serious.
However, they also knew that this was basically impossible.
In all these years in Dragon Palace City, there had never been a situation where the son of the totem followed humans.
At most, the heirs of the subsidiary overlords of Dragon Palace City would follow human Beast Tamers.
A totem son like the White Azure Dragon was a completely unreachable existence. Its identity might be ten times more honorable than the descendants of a legendary Beast Tamer. It was impossible for it to follow a human. Its totem parents couldn’t agree, unless that human had the legendary bearing to reach the height of the seven legends of Dong Huang, but obviously that was not possible…
Therefore, when they saw the Sky Penetrating Whale, Yu Shu and the others might still fantasize, but when they saw the White Azure Dragon, they quickly gave up. “Why would the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City appear here…”
In the next moment.
Dragon Palace City’s Third Prince, the White Dragon, looked at Shi Yu in the crowd and shouted excitedly, “Senior Shi Yu, Senior Shi Yu, I’m here. I’ll take you to take a look at Dragon Palace City.”
Yu Shu, Zou Tianwang, and the others: “?”
“????”
“Don’t cause trouble.” The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the White Azure Dragon in a deep voice and also said to Shi Yu, “Sir Shi Yu, the Sea Dragon King has been waiting for you for a long time.” “You’re finally here.”
As soon as he finished speaking, apart from the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Zou Yun, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others opened their mouths wide and widened their eyes as they looked at Shi Yu.
Holy shit, what, what was going on?!!
Didn’t everyone come to show their talent and potential together and wait for the overlord big shots of Dragon Palace City to invest? Old thief Shi Yu, what’s wrong with you!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - Could It Be Buggy’s Epic Strengthening
chapters.content:
Chapter 271 Could It Be Buggy’s Epic Strengthening
“Long time no see…”
Seeing the Sky Penetrating Whale and the White Azure Dragon, Shi Yu chuckled. He didn’t expect that the one in charge of guarding the entrance of the Dragon Palace City’s mystic realm was an old familiar beast.
At this moment, under the shocked expressions of everyone, the Transcendent Whale asked again, “Excuse me, is your friend here?” “Oh, oh, I’ll call it.”
The conversation between Shi Yu and the Sky Penetrating Whale confused Zou Tianwang, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others.
But in the next moment, their expressions froze.
Hu hu hu ~
Hu hu hu ~ ~
Under Shi Yu’s summoning, the surrounding temperature fell almost instantly.
Strands of cold wind lingered on the ground without any warning, freezing the air instantly and causing frost crystals to dance in the sky.
Under the outline of the snowstorm, a huge monster dozens of meters long spread its huge wings and descended, as if a legend had appeared. “Roar!!!”
It roared, and the strong ice stone body covered in blue and purple dragon scales directly stretched out. A cold wind swept the dragon might in all directions…
Boom!!!
With a boom, the surrounding time seemed to have frozen. After the Sky Penetrating Whale and the Mutated Giant Leviathan suddenly froze, they looked at this incomparably huge dragon.
“I feel so good.”
The frost dragon felt comfortable in its heart. It had only yawned just now. After being summoned from the Ice Dragon Ruins by Shi Yu, it swung its thick tail and looked around with its dragon eyes. It stopped for a moment on the Sky Penetrating Whale and the Mutated Giant Leviathan.
“Woo!!”
Seeing the frost dragon, the little white dragon instantly widened its eyes. It directly sensed the might of its parents’ level from its body.
So strong… The Sky Penetrating Whale also fell silent instantly. It sensed abnormally terrifying power fluctuations from the Ice Dragon and understood that it was definitely not this senior’s match.
“We’ve arrived at Dragon Palace City.”
The frost dragon spoke slowly and searched for Shi Yu.
“We’re here…”
Beside Shi Yu, a cute creature that looked like a ragdoll appeared. It also yawned and looked at the familiar surroundings.
“Are you Senior Ice Dragon, who followed the Time Emperor?”
At this moment, as this ice dragon appeared, General Whale asked respectfully.
An old monster that could survive that era was worth its respect.
“Follow the Time Emperor? Sort of.”
Ice Dragon calculated in its heart. It had been caught by Mu Huiyin. Mu Huiyin was also a general under Emperor Shi, so it wasn’t bad to say that it had followed Emperor Shi.
“Senior Ice Dragon.”
Beside him, the Tyrannical Sea Legend also said, “Nice to meet you. I’m one of the current Titled Legends of Dong Huang, Yu Zhihui.”
After all, the Ice Dragon had participated in the totem battle and was a first-generation sage who had helped humans establish a dynasty. The Tyrannical Sea Legend also respected these seniors very much.
“Uh, Legend Yu, hello.” Ice Dragon looked at the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the Giant Leviathan under him. It felt that the strength of this combination seemed to be ridiculously strong, not inferior to any general under Emperor Shi back then.
It couldn’t help but show a kind expression. Sigh, the current human Beast Tamers were really strong. If it hadn’t broken through, it really didn’t plan to come out of the ruins. At that moment, perhaps the appearance of the ice dragon caused too much change, causing the totems in the depths of Dragon Palace City to be alarmed.
It was not a small matter for a totem-level expert to suddenly appear in this territory.
“Roar!!!!”
A moment after the ice dragon came out, strange movements appeared in the sky of Dragon Palace City again. Countless strong winds and black clouds condensed. Accompanied by a dragon roar, a huge green divine dragon nearly 100 meters tall appeared on the clouds. Because this huge dragon was too huge, its characteristics were even more obvious than the white dragon’s body…
The image of a snake body, crocodile head, lizard legs, eagle claws, snake tail, antlers, fish scales, whiskers, and beads under its forehead. Its face was silver-white, and its entire body was basically green. Its body revealed a shocking beauty filled with power. It was completely gorgeous, and various parts of it appeared extremely coordinated. Its beautiful posture was even more rich in charm, and its gaze maintained an insufferably dignified aura. “Lord Sea Dragon King!” Seeing this divine dragon appear, General Whale quickly spoke. The surrounding tens of thousands of shrimps and crabs also submitted.
“Father.” The little white dragon’s body trembled.
At the same time, the frost dragon also raised its head and met the Sea Dragon King’s gaze. In an instant, the Sea Dragon King laughed heartily.
“Welcome, Senior Ice Dragon, to the Dragon Palace banquet.”
“You’re too kind, too kind…” The mother dragon that had been a shut in for a thousand years smiled.
“Pardon me for the disturbance.”
It had a smile on its face, but it had another smile in its heart. As expected of Shi Yu, he had already set up contact. This Dragon Palace City Dragon King actually looked quite respectful to him. Not bad, not bad.
He deserved to be rewarded!
“Senior Ice Dragon, this place is simple. Why don’t we move to my Dragon Palace to talk?” the Sea Dragon King suggested.
“Yes, thank you,” Ice Dragon said.
“Then it’s decided. Legend Yu, do you want to go together?” The Sea Dragon King looked at the Tyrannical Sea Legend. It was actually considered an old friend of the Tyrannical Sea Legend. The two of them had even sparred in a friendly duel before, and they were evenly matched for a short period of time.
“I won’t go. I’ll bring this group of young people to prepare for the next Dragon Palace banquet,” Legend Ba Hai said calmly.
“Alright, Hei Ge, receive the guests from Dong Huang well,” the Sea Dragon King said to the Sky Penetrating Whale.
With that said, it even looked at Shi Yu in the crowd and said, “Sir Shi Yu, please come together.”
The Sea Dragon King knew that the Ice Dragon definitely had a deep relationship with Shi Yu. In addition, it was also very curious why the butterfly had given its scales to Shi Yu, so it definitely wanted to meet him.
“Then pardon the trouble, Lord Sea Dragon King,” Shi Yu said respectfully. Then, he said to the Tyrannical Sea Legend, “Senior Tyrannical Sea, I’ll go first.”
The legend nodded.
In the next moment, Shi Yu was teleported to the frost dragon by the gem cat. The Sea Dragon King laughed and turned to lead the way, bringing Ice Dragon, Shi Yu, and the others to his Dragon Palace.
A moment later, only the disappointed little white dragon and the gem cat that was preparing to sweep through Dragon Palace City’s food were left.
There was also the confused Zou Tianwang, Yu Shu, and the others.
Aba, Aba, Aba, Aba… Could someone tell them what exactly was Shi Yu’s identity?
Dragon Palace of the Sea Dragon King.
It was a mystic realm of the Dragon Palace’s mystic realm.
In the huge mystic realm space, the Sea Dragon King arranged the rare fruits and mutant fruits and received the Ice Dragon.
Compared to the two behemoths, the Sea Dragon King and the Frost Dragon, Shi Yu was much smaller. This made him a little tired. He even wanted to give these two guys some multiplication skills.
“Senior Ice Dragon, have you decided to join Dragon Palace City?”
As Lin Feng’s pet, although the Sea Dragon King’s strength didn’t lose to the Ice Dragon, the Ice Dragon had experience here after all. It also called it senior.
“I’ve decided. Please, calling me senior would be too much. In the future, please let me rely on you, Sea Dragon King,” Ice Dragon said.
“I wonder what the procedures are for joining Dragon Palace City.”
“This is nothing. As long as we swear in the Dragon God Ruins under the joint witness of the Dragon God and other Dragon Kings that we won’t betray Dragon Palace City, that we will suffer and gain glory together with Dragon Palace City, we’ll be together for good. Haha.”
The Sea Dragon King introduced it to the frost dragon.
“That’s easy.”
The frost dragon said indifferently. As a force that had existed for countless years, although Dragon Palace City had changed their Dragon God seat many times, it had really never declined. If it joined here, as long as it didn’t think about the position of that Dragon God, it would basically always be glorious and wouldn’t be a loss. “It’s a big deal for Senior Ice Dragon to join Dragon Palace City. Now that some Dragon Kings aren’t in Dragon Palace City, why don’t we hold the joining ceremony after the Dragon Palace banquet ends? How about it? Tomorrow, Senior Ice Dragon could watch the Dragon Palace banquet with me and see how the genius descendants of Dragon Palace City are?”
“Every year at the Dragon Palace banquet, many ocean factions will also come to seek refuge in Dragon Palace City. At that time, Senior Ice Dragon might be able to choose some good followers.” “Ah, alright.” Ice Dragon pondered in its heart. Wasn’t it also here to rely on Dragon Palace City? Sigh, it was good to be strong. Awesome.
The Sea Dragon King laughed heartily. The Dragon Palace banquet was indeed not important to the Dragon Kings. They basically took turns to host it. To put it bluntly, this Dragon Palace banquet was a conference for the younger generation of Dragon Palace City to showcase their talent and strength, including some sea beasts with potential who came to Dragon Palace City.
At that time, some old overlords, including it, the Dragon King, would take out some rewards for these juniors to compete.
Of course, the group of human Beast Tamers brought by the Tyrannical Sea Legend could also participate in this process. Moreover, they could even display their talent to obtain the recognition of some ocean overlords. At that time, the reward might not be some resources, but their heirs.
To put it more simply, the Dragon Palace banquet was a conference for the ocean overlord of the Dragon Palace faction to show off its child’s results. It was held every five years.
Compared to the totem ice dragon joining Dragon Palace City, the Dragon Palace banquet was definitely not worth mentioning.
“By the way.” The Sea Dragon King suddenly looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu also widened his eyes and looked at the Sea Dragon King.
“You have my appreciation, sir Shi Yu, for bringing Senior Ice Dragon to Dragon Palace City.”
“It’s nothing, it’s nothing.” Shi Yu smiled shyly.
“This kid is not bad. At this Dragon Palace banquet, the overlord’s son that becomes his pet would be very lucky.” Mother Dragon still was thinking about Shi Yu and immediately spoke good words for him, as if she was praising her child.
Since Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit had acknowledged Shi Yu, it definitely acknowledged him too. There was no harm in finding more powerful pet cubs for Shi Yu. “Oh?? Sir Shi Yu is also here for the Dragon Palace banquet??” The Sea Dragon King was surprised.
Shi Yu said, “Not really. It’s mainly because I was entrusted by the Butterfly God to visit the Sea Dragon King and lead the way for Dragon Mother.”
The Sea Dragon King didn’t understand, but he was shocked. “Dragon… Dragon Mother?” Ice Dragon:? “Who… Who’s your mother? Forget it, you can call me senior too,” Ice Dragon couldn’t take it anymore and said bluntly.
It was an innocent girl, but being called like this affected its reputation. It could ignore it previously, but now, it was about to become the female dragon of the Dragon Palace City’s Queen. It couldn’t let Shi Yu take advantage of it anymore. It had to control its reputation.
Otherwise, it would be difficult to find a partner in the future.
“Ah, this.” The Sea Dragon King was silent. He couldn’t understand the relationship between Shi Yu and the Ice Dragon. In theory, it was very difficult for a young man in his twenties to be related to Ice Dragon, a senior who had lived for more than 2000 years.
But they looked very intimate?
“This kid has obtained the recognition of General Mu Huiyin, the first general under Emperor Shi. General Mu Huiyin is also my Beast Tamer. In short, his future is immeasurable. He can be considered one of the few people related to me at the moment.” Ice Dragon sighed.
“Heroic Spirit Ruins?” The Sea Dragon King was suddenly shocked.
As Lin Feng’s pet, it had naturally heard of the heroic spirit ruins left behind by the Time Emperor.
“Yes.” Ice Dragon nodded.
“Hahaha…” Shi Yu scratched his head and said,” Just lucky. I didn’t expect myself to be so lucky to obtain General Mu Huiyin’s recognition.”
“Little Friend Shi Yu, there’s no need to be humble. To be able to become a member of the third and eleventh bureau at this age, you must be a dragon among men. Your future is indeed immeasurable,” said the Sea Dragon King.
The third bureau, Feeding Bureau. Bureau 11, Archeology Bureau. The dragon knew.
Shi Yu was recommended by these two parties together and could also obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit of the Great General under Emperor Shi. In the Sea Dragon King’s opinion, his talent potential could completely defeat those legendary tamers’ sons.
In addition to the relationship with Ice Dragon…
“If Little Friend Shi Yu is interested, I can recommend a few descendants of overlords with pretty good talent for you. Oh right, my family’s little white dragon is also a pretty good choice. Unfortunately, it’s lazy by nature and isn’t willing to follow human Beast Tamers. Otherwise, I would definitely recommend it.”
The Sea Dragon King said politely, but in its heart, it actually had no intention of letting the White Azure Dragon follow Shi Yu. Although Shi Yu’s talent and potential were pretty good, he still had the gift of telepathy. Even if he could listen to history… it was still lacking.
From ancient times until now, there were no Beast Tamers with the gift of telepathy that could become Titled experts and fight against totems, let alone become legendary Beast Tamers. If possible, the Sea Dragon King definitely hoped that his son could follow a super genius like Lin Feng.
“Ah, thank you, Lord Sea Dragon King. There’s no need to force this. Everything will definitely still depend on His Highness the Third Prince’s thoughts.” Shi Yu hurriedly rejected, afraid that the Sea Dragon King would let him contract the little white dragon.
Fast rejection, fast rejection…
The success rate of teaching super skills was extremely low. How long would it take to pull it up? Shi Yu had already spent enough effort to nurture Buggy and the others. Now, he only wanted a pet with the will of an overlord.
At that time, with the infinite devouring of the Mutated Leviathan, it would directly take off.
He could be a gambler again.
Little White Dragon, whoever wanted it… Could take it.
“What a pity.” The Sea Dragon King sighed.
“Then let’s see if there are suitable candidates at the Dragon Palace banquet,” it said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. That was his intention. He would be happy when the time came.
Well, he didn’t have time to look at the bunch of useless soldiers just now.
They had to go take a look!
“By the way, you just said that you were entrusted by that butterfly to visit me. What’s the matter?”
The Sea Dragon King suddenly realized and asked.
It had not contacted that butterfly for a long time. It was useless to leave a scale for it, since it didn’t come to play with it. Now, it had given the certificate to someone else. What did it mean?
“This…” Shi Yu was slightly stunned.” Actually, I have a pet that completed its evolution with the Butterfly God’s blessing. Before that pet evolved, it accidentally swallowed a Dragon Ball, causing some abnormalities during its evolution. Even the Butterfly God doesn’t know who the owner of that Dragon Ball is. It thought that the Sea Dragon King might know, so it asked me to
ask. “
“Oh?” The Sea Dragon King was stunned.
“The one that can be blessed by it to evolve… Your pet is a Green Silkworm?”
“Yes, it was a Green Silkworm in the beginning, but now, it has already evolved into a butterfly with the Dragon Ball.”
“Can you summon it for me to take a look?” said the Sea Dragon King.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
In the next moment, a huge blue spatial ripple appeared behind him. Buggy was summoned by Shi Yu in its normal state. “Wu ~ ~” An extremely gorgeous Butterfly of Imagination appeared, and its body emitted a weak dragon might, instantly making the Sea Dragon King’s full attention focused on it.
Then, it was suddenly stunned.
Although it was only a rough observation, why did it feel that this butterfly was even stronger than its carefully cultivated son…
How was this possible?
“Wu ~ (Lord Sea Dragon King, Dragon Mother)” After Buggy came out, it also greeted the Sea Dragon King and the frost dragon.
The frost dragon:?
The Sea Dragon King:?? “Who… Who’s your mother? In the future, you’re not allowed to change randomly with my dragon whiskers!!” The frost dragon cursed.
The Sea Dragon King didn’t understand, but it was shocked. It felt that the noble circle was really messy.
Fortunately, Little Chi Tong wasn’t summoned by Shi Yu. Otherwise, if it called it Mom again and let the Sea Dragon King see it, it would shock it for an entire year.
“Buggy,” Shi Yu called. In the next moment, Buggy nodded and immediately activated the Dragon of Imagination. Following that, the surrounding space cracked, and countless spatial cracks appeared. In the clouds in the sky of the mystic realm, a phantom figure appeared and gradually formed a divine dragon body. It was a huge dragon-shaped body covered in blue and white dragon scales. It kept floating and circling in the sky, the scales on its body shining, dazzling everyone.
Under its gaze, the Sea Dragon King was immediately stunned.
In the next moment, with a roar from the divine dragon, the incomparable divine dragon phantom instantly flew towards Buggy and wrapped around its back. At this moment, in the Sea Dragon King’s perception, the Butterfly of Imagination, which was originally a little stronger than its child at the same level of growth, instantly became even stronger, as if it could easily crush the White Azure Dragon.
This change made the Sea Dragon King feel even more ridiculous.
It seemed like… the White Azure Dragon didn’t tell the Sea Dragon King that it had suffered a setback in front of Eleven, Buggy, and the other four pets.
“Lord Sea Dragon King, this is the divine dragon phantom conjured by my pet after it activated the power of the Dragon Ball,” Shi Yu immediately said after Buggy used the Dragon of Imagination.
At this moment, the Sea Dragon King looked at the huge divine dragon body wrapped in Buggy and fell into deep thought. “This…”
Its brain quickly recalled and kept feeling that it had sensed similar power fluctuations somewhere.
“Lord Sea Dragon King, can you recognize the race of the Dragon Ball Master?”
“Could it be…”
The Sea Dragon King stared at the Dragon of Imagination intently, his expression becoming more and more serious. In the end, he said in disbelief, “Could it be a Sea Serpent??”
“Sea Serpent??”
Shi Yu was stunned. Wasn’t the Sea Serpent covered in golden-green dragon scales?? Wait a minute… The Sea Serpent in his impression seemed to be what Earth’s version was. He would listen to the Sea Dragon King first.
The Sea Dragon King said, “That’s a mysterious, powerful, and proud dragon. It rarely shows its true appearance to others, but it likes to maintain the form of low profile birds, shell species, and even dragon balls.”
“The Sea Serpent is a race extremely close to a Mythical creature. It has powerful brute force, but what the Sea Serpent is really respected by the dragons for is its endless and extremely profound magic power. Through this magic power, it can easily create an illusion world that deceives all creatures and easily change the weather.”
“Therefore, it’s also known as the Illusionary Divine Dragon. Most importantly, the reason why I’m so clear is that the Sea Serpent is a Dragon God of a generation in the Dragon Palace City in the totem era, tens of thousands of years ago. It has the will of the Dragon God branded in the Dragon God Ruins. I’ve been to the Dragon God Ruins and even fought with the will of the Sea Serpent, so…” “But how is that possible…” It looked at Shi Yu and Buggy and said, “How could the dragon ball it absorbed be the Sea Serpent Dragon’s? Why would the Dragon God’s dragon ball be left outside?” “Holy shit.” As the Sea Dragon King finished speaking, although the frost dragon didn’t know what was going on, it also looked at Buggy in surprise. This little guy had absorbed a Dragon God’s Dragon Ball to evolve??
Although Dragon Palace City might have hundreds of generations of Dragon Gods, no matter which generation of Dragon Gods it was, they were all super dragons at the demigod level. Their dragon balls… were simply a priceless treasure second to Mythical resources.
“This.” Upon hearing the Sea Dragon King’s words, even Shi Yu and Buggy were stunned.
Holy shit.
Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God’s Dragon Ball??
Damn.
When the gem cat obtained this dragon ball, the energy of this dragon ball had already dried up to an indescribable state and fallen into a level-four resource. However, was the owner of this dragon ball so impressive? It was actually a half-god level existence like Yun An.
“Wu-” Listening, Buggy was excited. No wonder it had obtained such a powerful skill like the Dragon of Imagination. So the owner of the Dragon Ball was a Dragon God proficient in illusions?
“You also don’t know how the Sea Dragon God’s Dragon Ball was lost in the outside world…” Shi Yu asked.
“I’m not sure. When the Sea Serpent Dragon was in power, it could at least be traced back to nearly 100,000 years ago. Who still remembers what happened at that time? Countless generations of Dragon Gods have changed during that period. However, there’s the Sea Serpent Dragon’s Dragon God’s will existence in the Dragon God Ruins… This is certain…”
“When Senior Ice Dragon enters, perhaps we can search carefully.” The Sea Dragon King looked at the Ice Dragon.
“Ah…” Ice Dragon kept feeling that it was in trouble again.
At the same time, Buggy was overjoyed.
Could it be…
This time, it was… his Epic Strengthening??
Ji!!!!
It was awesome.
Leader, Baby Ginseng, wait and see!
“Can we also go to the Dragon God Ruins to take a look? I’m an archeologist. Perhaps I might be able to…” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!!!” Buggy hurriedly persuaded Shi Yu not to.
Although it also wanted to obtain more power from the Sea Serpent, the problem was that it was a Mythical Ruins. If Shi Yu destroyed it again, even Ice Dragon mother wouldn’t be able to protect them!
Perhaps the next day, Dragon Palace City would start a war with Dong Huang.
The friendly alliance between East and Dragons was directly destroyed by Shi Yu.
It was better not to. Let Ice Dragon Mommy see.
“Uh…”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Forget it.
“Not really. Only totem-level people can enter the Dragon God Ruins, or when the time comes, I’ll go ask other totems about the Sea Serpent Dragon. Perhaps they know some inside information. After all… I arrived at Dragon Palace City relatively late,” the Sea Dragon King said. “Then I’ll leave it to you, Sea Dragon King.”
“It’s nothing…” The Sea Dragon King still looked at Buggy in surprise. No wonder this butterfly was even more impressive than the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly of the same level, even more impressive than its son. So it had swallowed the Dragon God’s Dragon Ball and successfully evolved without exploding. It was extremely lucky.
At this moment, Shi Yu never expected that he would really know who the owner of the dragon ball that Buggy had absorbed when he came to Dragon Palace City… Unfortunately, it was the dragon race from nearly 100,000 years ago. What exactly happened at that time was something he was blind about.
“Sea Dragon King—!!!” “Lord Sea Dragon King—!! Something bad happened!!”
In the Dragon Palace mystic realm, the Sea Dragon King, the Frost Dragon, Shi Yu, and the others were chatting happily.
A cry suddenly came from the outside world.
The Sea Dragon King frowned. In the distance, a huge brown turtle was swimming over with all its might.
“Prime Minister Turtle, what’s wrong?”
“Lord Sea Dragon King, two days ago, many teams that went to Dragon Palace City to participate in the banquet were attacked by unknown monsters,” the old turtle said with a long face.
“Now, the Yaksha General who went to investigate is heavily injured and on the verge of death.”
When they heard that, Ice Dragon and Shi Yu were stunned.
Holy shit, which sea beast was so bold to attack a member of Dragon Palace City? One Dragon Palace City had eight totems, and there was even a half-god among them. Was this guy kidding? “Oh?? This kind of thing? Why didn’t you report it earlier??” The Sea Dragon King revealed anger.
“In the beginning, I thought that it was a blind sea beast that went berserk, so General Yaksha went to deal with it himself.”
“In the end, I discovered that it was an overlord-level Poison Dragon. However, General Yaksha still fought it and successfully obtained the upper hand. However, who knew, who knew… Just as General Yaksha was about to kill the enemy, that overlord Poison Dragon directly mutated and turned into a totem-level monster. After that, the Yaksha overlord was no match for it at all. Moreover, it was poisoned and on the verge of death.”
“At the moment, that poison dragon has completely disturbed the passage in the surrounding sea. The poison it emitted has almost contaminated the entire sea. Moreover, it’s still moving aimlessly in the sea.”
“What???” Upon hearing the old turtle’s description, the Sea Dragon King’s whiskers immediately fluttered, and its eyes turned red.
It was its turn to organize the Dragon Palace banquet this year, but such a thing happened?? Courting death!!
“That guy, what’s his background???” The Sea Dragon King’s anger burned. He didn’t believe that a dragon overlord with no background would suddenly mutate into a totem.
The turtle prime minister said, “We’ve already started investigating from the start when it attacked the sea beasts. That dragon doesn’t seem to be an overlord living in the sea, but a rare intermediate form creature of the sea worm and land beast. It came from the seven islands…”
“Most importantly, it has no rationality at all and only has the desire to destroy. Moreover, we can’t cleanse the poison it releases at all.”
“According to Doctor Holy Clam’s analysis, the poison in its body should have come from the radiation of the forbidden weapon developed by humans. It’s a radiation-type poison, and it might have mutated into its current appearance because it came into contact with radiation…”
“Lord Sea Dragon King, what should we do now… We have no choice but to let you handle it. Otherwise, the Dragon Palace banquet won’t be able to be smoothly organized. Moreover, many sea beasts who have come to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet are already infected and difficult to treat… Until now, we haven’t found a way to cleanse the poison.”
“Seven islands?? Forbidden weapon radiation??” The Sea Dragon King’s eyes turned even redder. The frost dragon and Shi Yu’s breathing almost stopped.
Ice Dragon cursed in its heart. It didn’t expect to encounter such a thing as soon as it arrived at Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu also cursed in his heart. He similarly couldn’t understand why he was so unlucky. He had come to Dragon Palace City with great difficulty and originally wanted to rely on the dragon aura to easily choose a top-grade pet. Why the hell did he suddenly encounter a totem-level Poison Dragon causing trouble? He hoped… that it wouldn’t affect the Dragon Palace banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - Storming Dragon Palace City
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Storming Dragon Palace City
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Dragon Palace of the Sea Dragon King.
After hearing Prime Minister Turtle’s description, the Sea Dragon King fell into deep thought.
It said, “I understand. Where is that guy now? Then let me deal with that guy.”
“Prime Minister Turtle, take care of Senior Ice Dragon, Little Friend Shi Yu, and the others. I’ll be back soon.”
“also, investigate hard. How exactly was this guy born? Didn’t you say that it came from the direction of the seven islands just now??”
“Damn it, I knew that group of guys was restless. Back then, they made a lot of trouble for Lin Feng, and now they’re here again!!”
“Curse the seven islands!!!”
‘The more the Sea Dragon King thought about it, the angrier it became.
Please don’t let it find anything.
Otherwise, it would definitely encourage the other Dragon Kings to find trouble with the seven islands together.
So what if it was the Seven Nation Alliance? Dong Huang would definitely stand on the side of Dragon Palace City!
“TIl deal with that Poison Dragon first!”
“also, did you call the Immortal Dragon King back? The totem radiation that the holy shell can’t treat can only be treated by it.”
The old turtle said, “I’ve searched.”
