Shi Yu’s words directly choked the three overlords, the Holy Healing Light Shell, the Pink Sea Immortal Spirit Water Jellyfish, and the Heavenly Blue Star Coral.
Why not ask the magical Blue Sea Ruins?
Good question! But… what the hell!
How??
If it weren’t for the fact that the Turtle Prime Minister had said that Shi Yu was the Sea Dragon King’s guest, they would definitely have suspected that Shi Yu was a fool. “The Blue Sea Ruins is a dead object. Only the Inner Sea Sprites can resonate with it…” Doctor Shell explained.
“But… As long as it’s an object that has undergone the baptism of time, even if it’s just a stone mirror, it’s possible for a historical spirit to be born and record some important information,” Shi Yu said. “In telepathy, there’s a special branch of abilities that can listen to the voice of history and listen to the voice of all things. Since the Blue Sea Ruins was built by the Blue Sea Sprites that carry countless beliefs, in theory… there should also be a historical spirit.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the three ocean overlords were stunned.
“You mean the special talent of the Dong Huang archeologist?” Doctor Shell asked.
Because Dragon Palace City was in an alliance with Dong Huang, it was definitely one of the transcendent biological factions that understood the human world system the most.
For example, many of the ocean overlords of Dragon Palace City had actually followed human Beast Tamers before.
In addition to the Dragon Palace banquet that happened every five years, it wasn’t like they didn’t know anything about the situation in the human world.
Doctor Shell had really heard of the listening talent Shi Yu mentioned.
But soon, its pearl face revealed a regretful expression.
“It won’t work. I seem to remember that it’s called Bureau 11? A group of guys explored the Blue Sea Ruins in that place, and it wasn’t even the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City. But in the end, they didn’t discover anything. Are you talking about their talent?” Shi Yu :”…”
Damn it.
Senior Lu was right.
These seniors were indeed not obedient.
Wherever there were ruins, there they were.
But the problem was that if they came to explore, so be it… But they dragged down the coolness of archeologists and Bureau 11! This made it difficult for him to say that he was also a member of Bureau 11 and wanted to explore the Blue Sea Ruins.
“Ha… Ha…” Shi Yu scratched his head in embarrassment and said,” Perhaps their listening positioning was wrong.” “By the way, is the division of the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City on this island…” Shi Yu suddenly looked at a huge ruin door that seemed to be purely made of water in the distance of Clearwater Island.
Ginseng Baby: (?cowo)
Baby Ginseng suddenly felt that Shi Yu’s intention to court death was restless.
Was it because he didn’t dare to go to the Dragon God Ruins and was persuaded by Buggy to go to the Blue Sea Ruins? At this moment, Shi Yu’s curiosity was diverted again.
He wanted to take a look at the Blue Sea Ruins. Regarding the injuries of these sea beasts, he and Baby Ginseng were also helpless. They could only leave it to Dragon Palace City to deal with it themselves. However, he was deeply interested in the Blue Sea Sprite that Doctor Shell mentioned.
A water elemental life form born from the desire of countless sea creatures?
Master the strongest purification power?
Shi Yu felt that they could get to know each other.
To be honest, he had already started to consider teaching Baby Ginseng cleansing skills.
The main reason was that Eleven had yet to absorb another piece of the meteorite fragment.
According to Zhong Xuan, the meteorite fragment contained a strong power of the demon god. It suggested that it should absorb it after it reached the overlord level. Only then could its evolution be guaranteed. In the end, Zhong Xuan was afraid that Eleven’s mind would be affected by the power of the meteor.
Therefore, Shi Yu had thought of many ways to increase the success rate of Eleven absorbing the meteorite fragment. After all, he also wanted to ensure that Eleven’s evolution was foolproof. Among them, cooperating with cleansing skills was a plan. In Shi Yu’s team, Baby Ginseng was the one who contracted the purification skill the most.
However, it wasn’t especially compatible.
According to statistics, purification skills were mainly still mainstream with light, water, and wind attributes.
And Baby Ginseng’s light-element compatibility was definitely not as strong as those real light-element creatures.
It wasn’t that wood-element didn’t have cleansing skills, but there were very few, and the level was very low.
The wood element that it was good at was actually more inclined towards replenishing hp and mana.
Including the ability of the baby ginseng race, it was also to replenish blood and mana.
However, purification was still essentially eliminating bad or unnecessary impurities, allowing energy to reach a pure level. There was still an intrinsic difference from healing skills that recovered life and energy.
The reason why Shi Yu had yet to teach Baby Ginseng and the others cleansing skills was firstly because Eleven had yet to break through to the monarch level before and didn’t need the Meteorite Fragment. It wasn’t that urgent, and secondly, he hadn’t found a cleansing skill that matched them.
Now, after hearing that the Blue Sea Sprite had mastered the strongest cleansing ability, how could Shi Yu not be tempted?
If it was really as powerful as Doctor Shell said, then using this power to ensure that Eleven successfully evolved into a Demon God Panda, it would definitely be foolproof.
In fact, if it could even purify Yun An’s radiation, then Yun An would really be a pollution-free renewable resource… At that time, forget one piece, as long as they could find Yun An, Eleven would probably be fine eating a house of Yun An’s fragments.
Moreover, if it could even cleanse Yun An’s main body, then the radiation power of the Poison Dragon Totem that had similar power fluctuations with Yun An should be easy to cleanse. The situation in Dragon Palace City could definitely be successfully resolved.
“Roar!!!!”
Soon, strong winds rose above the secret realm of Dragon Palace.
Under the rumbling of lightning and thunder, a vague white divine dragon appeared in the wind. This white divine dragon was huge and not much inferior to the Sea Dragon King. It also had the appearance of an Eastern divine dragon, but from the color, it was another race. It was similar to the Third Crown Prince of Dragon Palace City, the White Dragon.
The traces of its appearance didn’t last long before its aura immediately disappeared. A moment later, the old turtle hurriedly returned to Clearwater Island and ran back.
“I’ve already informed Lord Azure Dragon to assist Lord Sea Dragon King.”
After it returned to Clearwater Island, it immediately asked the three healing overlords about the poisoner. “There’s still no other way. We can only wait for Lord Immortal Dragon King,” Doctor Shelly said.
“Sigh, what’s going on? Looks like the Dragon Palace banquet is going to be delayed this time…” The Turtle Minister looked worried.
Many factions who had decided to participate in the banquet had been poisoned and injured here. The chances of the Dragon Palace banquet successfully continuing were not high.
With its understanding of the Sea Dragon King, the other party would definitely delay the banquet and wait to settle the Poison Dragon Totem and treat the injured before continuing.
In that case… the impact was actually very big. Of course, it had an effect on the Sea Dragon King.
The factions who came to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet naturally didn’t feel that there was anything wrong.
After all, Dragon Palace City provided food and accommodation during the Dragon Palace banquet. They ate the best, slept the best.
They probably wanted to delay it for a few more days.
But in the next few days… most of the losses would be paid out of the Sea Dragon King’s own pocket.
As a live-in son-in-law… Sigh.
“Eh.” After the old sea turtle painfully thought of its loss, it suddenly realized that something was missing in front of it.
“Doctor Shelly, where’s Sir Shi Yu?”
Doctor Shell, who had already run to study the poison, said, “I think… I think he wants to go to the Blue Sea Ruins to take a look?”
Turtle Prime Minister:??
Holy shit, why did these humans from Bureau 11 like to go to the various ruins of the Blue Sea Ruins, the Dragon God Ruins, and the Dragon Palace City every time they came to Dragon Palace City?
The Sea Ruins was indeed on this Clearwater Island.
The Blue Sea Sprite mastered the power of purification, and this island was also called Clearwater Island. It was probably related to some historical story.
After Shi Yu obtained the agreement of Doctor Shell and the others, he brought Baby Ginseng to the Blue Sea Ruins.
This was the first time he had seen such a ruin.
The Blue Sea Ruins was very tall. It was more than a hundred meters in length, width, and height. It was very similar to a building in Shi Yu’s memories. It was water cubic, and the dreamy blue surface of the ruins looked like crystalline water droplets under the sun. At least, Shi Yu felt that this ruin should be made of water elements.
“Found it.”
As he approached the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu investigated the information about the Blue Sea Ruins through the archeological index and learned that this was also a half independent mystic realm-type spatial ruin.
From the outside, the Blue Sea Ruins looked like a huge water cube, but in fact, the inside of the Blue Sea Ruins was different. Most importantly, be it the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City or the countless Blue Sea Ruins everywhere in the ocean, the water cubes that could be seen in the outside world were projections of the mystic realm. They were substantial mirages. There was only one true ruin, and that was the inner space that these water cubes led to.
They were equivalent to a broadcast station and spatial teleportation point across the ocean, as if they were just for the convenience of calling the reincarnations of the Blue Sea Sprites. “Wuu.”
“Wu.”
“Yi.”
“Mi.”
At this moment, apart from Baby Ginseng, the other three little guys were also called out by Shi Yu. They also widened their eyes and observed the beautiful sea ruins together. “The Blue Sea Sprites are very particular. The ruins are so beautiful.” Shi Yu touched his chin.
“Wu ~” Buggy agreed. This was much prettier than the Ice Dragon Ruins.
“Mi!” Chi Tong didn’t like hearing Buggy question Mu Huiyin’s aesthetic taste. “Wuu!” Eleven told them not to be noisy. If they continued to do it, would there still be Iron-eating Beast ruins in the ancient capital?
That was a completely broken ruin without even an independent space. “Wuu.”
But… could it really be said that the iron-eating beast ruins were lousy?
After all, it was a ruin that he could hear something from and obtained the iron-eating beast’s evolution method.
As long as there were gains, it was a good ruin. Otherwise, it was useless if it was mute.
The current Blue Sea Ruins… looked flashy without substance.
“Indeed…” Shi Yu muttered. In the information about the Blue Sea Ruins in the archeological index, there were actually comments from the seniors of Bureau 11.
This wasn’t strange… The information was also collected by humans. Probably only the seniors of Bureau 11 had the right to evaluate such a high-level ruin.
He also saw Senior Lu’s evaluation.
Lu Qingyi: “I don’t recommend archeological newbies entering the pit.”

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - Heart’s Fifth Pet
chapters.content:
Chapter 275 Heart’s Fifth Pet
Good lord, Shi Yu was speechless.
This was definitely a loss.
Shi Yu imagined it. Senior Lu had probably been attracted by the various ruins in Dragon Palace City when she came to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet.
However, when Senior Lu was enthusiastic and spent most of her time researching the Blue Sea Ruins, apart from a pile of beautiful selfies, she didn’t obtain anything. She wasted her good time in Dragon Palace City. It was normal for her to not recommend newbies to enter the pit…
Hu…
A moment later.
Shi Yu stopped the archeological index connected to the transparent lens and observed the Blue Sea Ruins seriously.
The Blue Sea Ruins was a special ruin that couldn’t be researched at all apart from specific entry methods.
If it were ruins left behind by humans during the Beast Taming Era, such as the Iron-eating Beast Ruins, then they could still study and explore using normal archeological methods.
For example, the composition of the Nine Li Battle Beast Armor Fragment was detected by modern instruments. Moreover, through the ruins murals, one could also find the clue of the nine inscriptions.
However, this Blue Sea Ruins was completely not a ruin in the traditional sense. To be precise, it should be considered an “exclusive inheritance ruin”. It was very difficult to explore such an exclusive inheritance ruin. Even the members of Bureau 11 had only one method.
It was to try to activate the listening talent and see if they could communicate with the historical spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins and learn some special secrets.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the crystal clear Blue Sea Ruins that could even be used as a mirror. He activated his telepathy and said in unison,
“Ruins, ruins, who’s the most handsome Beast Tamer in the world?”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong:??? Was there such an opening line??
Obviously, Shi Yu’s looks did not receive the recognition of the Blue Sea Ruins. The ruins did not react.
“Lord Blue Sea Sprite, your devoted believer needs your help!”
II
11
“Excuse me… Did something happen during the reincarnation process?” Shi Yu had asked Doctor Shell and the others just now.
From ancient times until now, after the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite, it would only be a hundred years at most before it would become the spirit of the Blue Sea again.
But this time, the sea spirit didn’t appear for three thousand years.
Not only did Shi Yu think so, even the other ocean totems felt that something had happened to the Blue Sea Sprite during its reincarnation.
“Lord Blue Sea Sprite, if you don’t appear soon… your territory will be completely eroded by Yun An.”
“Do you know Yun An?” Shi Yu gestured.
“A demigod from outer space and a king of totems. It has radiation that can’t be cleansed or cured. It likes to bathe in clear seawater the most.”
“It originally lived on land, but now, it has already aimed at the sea.”
“This is simply too much, right? He’s so arrogant.”
“Two days ago, it mutated a sea beast’s radiation into a Poison Dragon Totem. Under the contamination of this Poison Dragon Totem, the sea area of Dragon Palace City has now become a radiation sea. Countless sea beasts died because of this. Your citizens… need you very much now.”
“Apart from you, I’m afraid no one can cleanse this radiation.”
“It’s this kind of power shift. Can you feel it?”
Shi Yu took out the Meteorite Fragment from the ruins space and let Buggy use its mental strength to control it to stick to the Sea Ruins.
However, there was still no reaction from the Blue Sea Ruins…
“Wuu…” Eleven poked Shi Yu. No need to hold back. Use the unique skill.
Just like when they were talking about the iron-eating beast ruins…
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. Was this alright?
However…
He still looked at the Blue Sea Ruins and substituted Yun An’s emotions.
“In fact, Yun An even provoked you and said that your cleansing power definitely can’t cleanse its radiation.”
“This sea area will be its territory in the future!”
Buzz!
A ripple suddenly appeared on the surface of the water cube.
Shi Yu and the others: { ° 1 °|||1)
Damn, what the f*ck??? It was really effective??
“It said that you…”
“If you faced Yun An… You probably won’t dare to come out.”
Buzz!!
The ripples increased.
Everyone:!!!
“A mere Blue Sea Sprite is only so-so.” Blue Sea Ruins:?
Blue Sea Ruins:?
It actually… It really worked. Shi Yu’s vision instantly turned blurry. The sound of clear spring flowing and the roar of the sea sounded in his ears, making him feel extremely absent-minded. So, his talent was not to listen to historical talent, but “100% reaction talent when it came to ruins”?
This time, Shi Yu didn’t know how long he had experienced the flashes.
He felt that it was very, very long, and very short.
He saw many scenes.
For example, he saw the Inner Sea Sprite reincarnate into a water-element divine dragon. The divine dragon’s body was completely formed by water and was born in the deep sea. It didn’t take long for the water-element divine dragon to grow to the overlord level, receive a summon from the Blue Sea Ruins, and awaken to evolve into an ocean sprite.
He also saw the Blue Sea Sprite reincarnate into a huge water-element whale. Its body was still completely formed by water and born in the ocean. It also didn’t take long for it to reach the overlord level and receive the summoning from the Blue Sea Divine Hall.
Next, Shi Yu gradually saw many water-element creatures that the Blue Sea Sprite had reincarnated into. Mermaids made of water elements and corals made of water elements. These water-element creatures had one characteristic: their initial race level was very high.
Then, slowly, the racial level of the Blue Sea Sprite after reincarnation didn’t seem to be as high as before. The dolphin formed by the water element, the shell formed by the water element… It seemed that every time it reincarnated, the racial level of the Blue Sea Sprite would decrease a little.
If the initial reincarnation could be said to be an overlord race that could grow to the overlord level very quickly and receive the summoning and inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins, then as the race level after reincarnation became a monarch race, the difficulty of the Inner Sea Sprite growing to the overlord level immediately increased a little.
As it decreased to the commander race, the difficulty of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation breaking through to the overlord level was not just a little.
The monarch race could also rely on training super racial skills to transcend perfection. There was a glimmer of hope of advancing to an overlord.
Then, the reincarnations of those commander races didn’t even have this glimmer of hope.
In many images, Shi Yu saw that the reincarnations of the Blue Sea Sprite relied on its powerful willpower to survive the difficulties time and time again in life-and-death crises. Then, it would break through its growth level and break through to the overlord level. Every time, it was very dangerous.
It didn’t rely on racial advantages and legendary resources, but on explosive potential with powerful willpower in a desperate situation to exceed the limit.
Overlord’s Will!
Every low-level reincarnation Shi Yu saw next seemed to be able to display the will of an overlord in a desperate situation and erupt with super potential to break through levels. With this method, even if the Blue Sea Sprite reincarnated into a water-element sprite that was commander level, it still had a chance to grow to the overlord level. Then, it would receive the summoning of the Blue Sea Ruins, inherit the power of the Blue Sea Sprite, and evolve into a Blue Sea Sprite.
However…
As time passed, an even worse situation occurred.
The reincarnation race of the Blue Sea Sprites had fallen to the transcendent race. In this situation, even with the super overlord will, it wasn’t so easy to grow up. In the scene Shi Yu saw, many reincarnations of the Blue Sea Sprites died directly in life-and-death crises without growing up. They could only be forced to reincarnate and start a new life. He could tell that, just as Doctor Shell had said, the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite was not strength or memory, but the heart that hoped to cleanse all filth. It was the reincarnation of will.
Every reincarnation of an Blue Sea Sprite seemed to have a very strong heart of justice. If this firm heart of justice was combined with high racial potential, it could naturally grow very smoothly, like a protagonist template.
However, if one had a firm heart but no corresponding strength, then this righteous heart would become a burden.
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, he saw the low-level reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite countless times. Because of this super willpower, it could either save its companions or show justice to face an enemy that it couldn’t defeat. Then, even if it broke through the limit, it couldn’t obtain too much power at once. It could only die regretfully and reincarnate.
As the reincarnations arrived at the transcendent race, the difficulty of the Blue Sea Sprite growing into an overlord was ridiculously high. Under Shi Yu’s observation, it seemed that only after a few accidental evolutions and raising its race level together with the overlord’s will, could it grow into an overlord.
Perhaps it wasn’t that transcendent races couldn’t become overlords with the will of overlords, but that there weren’t so many opportunities for trial and error, to make mistakes in reality…
“So this is the reason why the Blue Sea Sprite didn’t appear again in 3,000 years…”
“The reincarnation ability of the Blue Sea Sprite is not limitless.”
“Every time it reincarnates, its racial level will fall, from quasi Mythical to transcendent…”
“It’s naturally very smooth to grow up with a golden spoon in your mouth, but it’s not easy to grow up with a low race without the power and memories of my previous life and only rely on the inheritance of will…”
“This time, it seems to be relatively unlucky… It encountered a wall three thousand times in a row, but it didn’t meet the conditions for the inheritance power of the Blue Sea Ruins.”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment, but soon, he realized something.
(Please tell me where the reincarnation of this life is.]
[Even if it’s a low-level transcendent race, I’m confident that I can help it grow to the overlord level in the shortest time.]
[Perhaps, perhaps, there’s still a way to escape the restriction of reincarnation lowering race level.)
Purification ability, low growth level, high racial upper limit, overlord will, water, and elemental types. Wasn’t this the pet template he dreamed of?
When Shi Yu thought of this, he immediately became excited.
At this moment, the ruins seemed to have given a response. He was in a state of observing history. Countless images flowed, and in the end, they were fixed on the last picture.
This was an island with an uncertain location.
The environment above was very good, and a large number of transcendent creatures lived. Among them, there was a special small river. Around the small river, a water-element creature race that couldn’t be more common on the ocean lived.
They had blue translucent bodies that were like jelly. Their bodies were round, small, and looked very flexible. Their movements were simple hops… When he saw this group of creatures, Shi Yu was immediately stunned. This was… a middle-level transcendent race, a water-elemental elemental life form, a water slime?? Did this mean that the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite was a water slime?

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - Rainbow Islands
chapters.content:
Chapter 276 Rainbow Islands
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Water Slime!!!
Shi Yu didn’t know if this was a hint from the Blue Sea Ruins.
But if the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite had already been reduced to a slime, that would be too tragic…
< Name > Water Slime
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Mid-level transcendent
[Race Skill]: Multiplication, Bubble
< Introduction > It’s a low-level water elemental creature condensed from water elements. Its movements are slow, its intelligence is low, its attack pattern is single, its life form is extremely unstable, it’s not
recommended to contract.
Shi Yu:”…”
Thinking of the Beast Tamer’s evaluation of the Water Slime, Shi Yu was in a daze.
Indeed.
How should one put it?
Although it had mastered a high-level skill, even if it was facing a Beast Tamer intern, as long as that Beast Tamer was more experienced, the Slime would find it very difficult to stir up trouble.
For example, Shi Yu had once easily defeated the Electric Slime through insulation rubber gloves and replicated multiplication.
They were too slow and could only jump around. As long as it was a normal person, their speed was faster than theirs.
Their intelligence was also low, similar to the Green Silkworm. It was basically impossible for them to train their racial skills to a very high level on their own.
n addition, the life form was extremely unstable. Before “elementalization”, the racial ability that was a big deal in elemental life forms, it would turn into the corresponding elemental disintegration and die after being
heavily injured. Its life was extremely weak. This was why they were judged as transcendent races.
n any case, it was very difficult for Shi Yu to imagine how a Slime relied on its powerful willpower to grow to the overlord level.
tt wasn’t impossible, but it was too difficult. It was less than one in 100 million.
it was no wonder that the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite had fallen to this race… It had never been able to reach the inheritance conditions of the Blue Sea Ruins.
From the historical segment, the lowest standard to receive the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite’s ability should be the overlord level. This was not difficult to understand. The abilities of the Blue Sea Sprite were
definitely very unfair, like a cheat. Just like how Eleven and the others and Shi Yu couldn’t withstand the teaching of super skills. If their strength and willpower were insufficient, the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite
would probably find it very difficult to withstand the racial ability inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite.
However, at this moment, this was not what Shi Yu cared about.
Since it was the reincarnation of the will of the Blue Sea Sprite, it meant that the reincarnated Slime should have a very high-level will level.
That meant that he could add some super skills.
With this evidence, so what if the race was low? If he taught it infinite devour, a terrifying Slime Demon King was immediately born.
Even if there was no overlord will, even if it wasn’t the reincarnation of a Blue Sea Sprite… Because he had cultivated Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, Shi Yu was also confident that nurturing an ordinary Slime would
turn into a very unscientific beast if it was him as the tamer.
In short, he was very confident that it could help the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite reach the overlord level. This was only the lowest achievement. With the skill index and the will of an overlord, even if he
cultivated the Blue Sea Sprite to the Mythical level and let it escape the restraints of endless reincarnation, Shi Yu felt that it might not be impossible.
“Leave it to me.”
Shi Yu made a big statement for the Blue Sea Ruins.
“But the problem is… Even if there aren’t ten billion Water Slimes in this world, there should be at least one billion. I… Where can I find them?”
His imagination was very beautiful, but reality made Shi Yu depressed.
Even if he could detect the level of the will of every water slime through the skill index to determine if it was the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite, even if the world’s slime lined up for him to detect, he still had to
take forever…
Moreover, it was impossible for them to really line up for him to test.
Shi Yu could only go to various parts of the world to slowly search for it himself. Ignoring the safety issue for the time being, the time spent was a huge number. If this Slime Reincarnation accidentally died during this
period and reincarnated into another race, it would be even more tragic.
“Can you… give me another hint?”
Buzz!
Perhaps due to Shi Yu’s strong confidence, there were some changes in the Blue Sea Ruins.
In the outside world.
Shi Yu quickly retreated from the observation history state. Eleven and the others stayed on Shi Yu and before they could react, Shi Yu was suddenly sucked into the Blue Sea Ruins by a huge suction.
“Damn…”
Shi Yu didn’t react either. He only felt that the suction power of this thing was even stronger than the Mutated Leviathan. With Eleven and the others, their bodies seemed to have plunged into a huge pool.
Crash…
Countless streams of water hit him.
Shi Yu felt a little suffocated.
When Shi Yu reacted again, he had already been ejected from the Blue Sea Ruins.
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mil!”
Shi Yu had yet to discover anything. As he rubbed his eyes and spat out water, the pets on Shi Yu’s body cried out in shock.
“What?”
He understood what Eleven and the others meant and couldn’t help but open his eyes to look around. The identical Blue Sea Ruins was still in front of him, but…
He was no longer on Clearwater Island!
At this moment, Shi Yu was directly in a strange rain forest. The unfamiliarity of the surrounding environment stunned Shi Yu.
Where was this?
Shi Yu jointly located his current location according to the archeological index and Feeding index, but he realized that he was no longer in the range of Dong Huang’s map. He couldn’t determine where he was at this
moment…
“Spatial teleportation?”
Shi Yu quickly looked at the Blue Sea Ruins and opened his mouth slightly.
“So, every Blue Sea Ruins is really a projection of the ruins space inside…”
it was said that, be it the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City or the countless Blue Sea Ruins everywhere in the ocean, they were all projections of the Inner Sea Mystic Realm. They were all substantial mirages. There
was only one true ruin, and that was the inner space that these water cubes led to.
This saying was recorded in the archeological index, but Shi Yu didn’t expect that the Blue Sea Ruins could actually be used as a teleportation point, allowing life forms to travel freely between the various ruins.
However, Shi Yu was only stunned for a moment before quickly recovering his calm.
This was not something that exceeded their understanding.
During the Kong Emperor Era, the Kong Emperor had once established spatial teleportation arrays all over the world. Although after the Kong Emperor died, most of these spatial teleportation arrays were abandoned
because they couldn’t replenish energy, things like spatial teleportation arrays really existed at certain times, such as when there were spatial legendary Beast Tamers.
The aura of the Blue Sea Sprite was even higher than that of a demigod. It had gotten to know many ocean totems, so it didn’t seem impossible for it to create an ocean ruin that could be used as a spatial teleportation
array.
“The Blue Sea Ruins. This is the place where we were teleported to the reincarnation of this time… Or was it teleported to the place closest to the reincarnation of the Inner Sea Sprite?”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. If that was the case, the difficulty of finding the Blue Sea Sprite’s reincarnation had indeed decreased greatly.
After all, he still remembered the approximate environment of the island just now. In addition, with the restriction of the slime race, it was much easier to find.
“Brilliant!!!”
At the thought of this, Shi Yu smiled and looked away.
“Yiya!!!” However, Baby Ginseng reminded Shi Yu nervously.
Apart from the territories of the seven countries, the other places were all totem areas. They were the territories of totem-level creatures and overlord-level creatures.
Now, Mother Ice Dragon isn’t here, and the rich cat isn’t here either. Is it really alright for them rookies to…
Could this Blue Sea Ruins still successfully teleport us back to Dragon Palace City?
Baby Ginseng’s reminder made Shi Yu turn his head slightly to look at the Blue Sea Ruins.
“I’ve already marked this place and located it. Can you teleport us back first? We’ll call for some people and find the Reincarnation together.”
“Hello? Hello!”
“Say something…”
Shi Yu:”…”
Why did this Blue Sea Ruins suddenly become unintelligent again?
Shi Yu originally thought that this guy was pretty smart. He knew that the reincarnation body was about to die and planned to find someone to help, but now, it was switched off again?
Shi Yu tried to use the index to call Senior Lu… But… there was no signal.
This was very annoying!
Exploring ruins was a dangerous activity. The sayings were right.
It directly teleported him from a very safe place to this ridiculous damn place!!!
“Forget it, let’s take things as they come. It’s not like we don’t have any strength now. As long as we don’t encounter totems, we aren’t afraid of ordinary monarchs. Even if we encounter overlords, we might not
necessarily be unable to escape. It’s fine as long as we’re careful. In short, let’s find the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite first,” Shi Yu said.
With that, he put Baby Ginseng back into the Beast Taming Space.
“Stay here obediently. Don’t come out during this period of time lest you cause trouble for us.”
[Ginseng Baby:??]
“Wu!” “Wu!” “Mi!” Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong couldn’t disagree.
Initially, there might not have been any danger, but with Baby Ginseng hanging around outside, there would definitely be a lot of danger.
“Buggy, I’ll leave the reconnaissance to you. Let’s see if there are any creatures on this island first,” Shi Yu said. “Be careful. Don’t use Psychic Detection and Phantom.”
“Wu ~” Shi Yu gave the order. Buggy immediately expressed its understanding. It instantly used its phantom to create hundreds of small flying bugs that couldn’t be seen with the naked eye and started to fly in all
directions.
At the same time, Shi Yu made Little Chi Tong obediently enter his body and dye the hair red.
He put Eleven on his shoulder. This made him feel safe.
Shi Yu chatted with the Blue Sea Ruins for a few minutes.
He was very worried now. He didn’t know how Dragon Palace City would react after discovering that he had disappeared.
One Poison Dragon Totem was probably enough to give them a headache…
Shi Yu hoped he could figure this out and get back as soon as possible.
However, since he was already here, he definitely had to find the Heavenly Fated Slime first. Shi Yu had already confirmed that this guy was his fifth pet!
it wasn’t that there weren’t any creatures on this island.
However, the creatures on the island were very special.
As Buggy’s reconnaissance worm flew, it saw many colorful poisonous frogs, poisonous mushrooms, and poisonous bugs living on the island.
it was as if this island was a paradise for poison-type creatures.
However, fortunately, Buggy discovered that the growth levels of these poisonous creatures weren’t high. They basically didn’t exceed commander rank. This was a good thing. This way, the chances of Shi Yu and the
others encountering danger here were much lower.
“Wu (Little Snake)!!!”
The Phantom Reconnaissance Worm made by the worm quickly flew around the island. The strongest creature it discovered was only a monarch-level Ten Thousand Poison Python.
In the dense rainforest, in a damp cave, a multicolored python more than ten meters long was squinting, as if it was resting.
The Ten Thousand Poison Python was a monarch race’s poison-element creature. It was said that its body contained more than ten thousand types of poison.
At this moment, the Ten Thousand Poison Python was indeed sleeping. Taking advantage of this good opportunity, the flying insect illusions created by the worm crawled into its body and activated the Dream Stealing
Skill.
“How long will it take?” Shi Yu turned to ask Buggy from afar.
“Wu!!” Buggy said ten minutes.
Buggy was an all-purpose tool pet. Apart from being able to transform into various transportation tools, it was also very proficient in various vocation skills.
For example, cleaning the house. No one was faster than it. For example, when it taught other pets as a teacher, no skill was better than the Imagination Domain.
It could be a chef, a cameraman, and even a gardener for Baby Ginseng.
At the moment, it was obvious that the intelligence officer, Buggy, was online.
It directly used the phantom as a medium and used the Dream Steal skill to invade the Ten Thousand Poison Python’s dream realm, trying to steal valuable memories from its subconscious in its weak dream.
After being upgraded to the maximum level of Dream Steal, it could even steal the super skill from the ancient fossil and give it to the dream phantom, let alone the memory of the Ten Thousand Poison Python.
The information Shi Yu and the others wanted to know from the Ten Thousand Poison Python was also very simple. That was, the surrounding environment information…
As the strongest transcendent creature on this island, this Ten Thousand Poison Python should know the surrounding geographical environment better…
Generally speaking, after transcendent creatures reached the monarch level, as long as they weren’t from extremely special races, their intelligence wasn’t much inferior to humans.
This Ten Thousand Poison Python was nearly a hundred years old. It should have been in charge of this area for a long time. It already knew everything it needed to know.
“Wu ~” A moment later, Buggy sent Shi Yu a message.
“Wu =”
Firstly, this area was called the Rainbow Islands. It was a land without a master, with a total of 29 islands.
Why was it an ownerless place? Because during the last totem battle, a forbidden weapon battle happened here, causing the surrounding sea area to be polluted. There were basically no high-level creatures who
occupied this place as their territory.
The Rainbow Islands was also named at that time because the seawater at that time was basically colorful and belonged to the biological forbidden zone.
Although after more than a hundred years, the pollution had naturally become much calmer, this place was still ownerless. The strongest were only monarch-level creatures. These monarch-level creatures each
occupied an island as their territory. Then, these islands formed the entire archipelago.
This island was called Poison Fang Island, and it was the territory of this Ten Thousand Poison Python.
“Rainbow Islands?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He had never heard of it. However, there were indeed many pollution places born because of forbidden weapons. Most importantly, they were rarely mentioned…
In the early stages of the development of the Mechanic class, the development of forbidden weapons had yet to mature. Compared to the various special forbidden weapons with no pollution that could attract natural
energy now, the forbidden weapons at that time usually liked to add some poisonous substances.
This combination of self-destruction could heavily injure those overlords and totems.
However, this way, the pollution to the environment was also very difficult to eliminate.
Poison-type creatures were still very glitchy. As long as the opponent didn’t have the ability to detoxify, poison-type creatures were also small experts who could fight above their level. Low-level beats using dirty
tricks to destroy high level ones was a common sight.
“Wu ~” Buggy continued to steal the Thousand Poison Python’s dream information.
Although this place was ownerless, there seemed to be traces of human activity. From time to time, Pirate Ships would pass by the Multi Colored Islands and stop on some islands, but those who could be reduced to
pirates weren’t very strong. At most, they were at the master level. They basically wouldn’t have any conflict with these kings of the islands, and everyone had been living in harmony.
Unfortunately, the Ten Thousand Poison Python didn’t know which faction these pirates came from.
“Does it know about Dragon Palace City?2” Shi Yu asked.
Buggy searched for a moment and showed joy.
“Wul!!”
This big worm actually knew.
This was because 50 years ago, an overlord-level Poison Wyrm was born in the Rainbow Islands. It unified the Rainbow Islands. In order to increase its bloodline, it hoped to lead the Rainbow Islands to join the Dragon
Palace City and obtain the protection of the Dragon Palace City. Therefore, it went to the Dragon Palace City.
Unfortunately, after that overlord went… he never returned.
The monarchs of the Rainbow Islands guessed that if the overlord didn’t die midway, it was because the environment of the Rainbow Islands was too poor. Dragon Palace City didn’t accept it, but the overlord wanted to
join Dragon Palace City too much to find a chance to increase his bloodline. Therefore, it stayed in Dragon Palace City and gave up the island.
“Overlord-level Poison Wyrm… I’ve never heard of it either, but since Dragon Palace City can still manage this place, it means that this place shouldn’t be very far from Dragon Palace City.”
Shi Yu suddenly became happy.
“Where’s the slime? Is there an island with the slime?!”
“Wul!!” Buggy nodded heavily. There was also this.
Most of the islands in the Rainbow Islands were occupied by poison-type creatures, but there was one island that was very special.
The King of the Islands was a water-element elemental life form. The monarch-level Cleansing Water Sprite King had only risen in the past ten years.
Under its jurisdiction and purification, that island was different from other islands. The environment was relatively beautiful.
Among them, many water elemental creatures lived on that island. There were a large number of water Slimes there, all citizens of the Cleansing Water Sprite King.
However, the problem was that perhaps the individualism was too special. The Cleansing Water Sprite King and the other kings of the islands constantly clashed, and the lives of the islands and other islands often
collided…
“It should be this island. Let’s go.” After Shi Yu obtained the information, he took a deep breath and slowly floated up. “Buggy, lead the way.”
“You’ve done well for being able to find the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite so quickly! When we go back, I’ll reward you with doubled training. Try to train your overlord willpower as soon as possible!”
Buggy:???
Although it wanted to train its overlord will as soon as possible, why did this reward sound so wrong?
“Wuu.” An envious voice came from Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Buggy:???
Damn it, this was too much….

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - Dragon Palace City’s New Department
chapters.content:
Chapter 277 Dragon Palace City’s New Department
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After knowing that there were no overlords in the Rainbow Islands, Shi Yu and the others relaxed a lot.
Moreover, even if there was an overlord, it wasn’t a big problem.
Just like what the teachers in the school had taught, if he couldn’t defeat it, couldn’t he escape?
With transcendent-level Instant Transmission and the ruin’s space, if they wanted to escape, the other party might not necessarily be able to catch up or find them.
As for which teacher taught this thing, it was definitely the management teacher of the Ancient Capital University’s resource bank.
On the sea area of the Rainbow Islands.
The red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu followed behind Buggy and flew in midair.
“Wuu.” Eleven pulled Shi Yu’s shoulder and looked forward to the next little friend.
According to Shi Yu… Could it be a child with the will of an overlord?
Moreover, it could also master the power of purification and help it eat Yun An?
That was great.
Not only could it pressure itself during training, but it could also help it digest food. Eleven liked it very much!
The panda swung its legs around Shi Yu’s shoulder excitedly.
Shi Yu:”…”
“Don’t move around. It’s itchy.”
“Things haven’t even started.”
“Wuu ?” Eleven was confused.
“Contracting a pet is like chasing a girl. It’s not that the other party will agree just because you want to.” Shi Yu muttered.
if it were other water-type pets, Shi Yu would be confident even if it was the Cleansing Water Sprite King on that island.
However, facing the reincarnation of a Blue Sea Sprite with an overlord’s will, he felt that it was not very stable.
Most importantly, in the historical spirit scene Shi Yu observed at that time, it wasn’t like it had never encountered a Beast Tamer before.
But as expected, all the human Beast Tamers who wanted to contract it were rejected. Those who wanted to forcefully contract it… The reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite would rather shatter than live in dishonor.
n any case, in the scene he saw, the will of the Blue Sea Sprite was extremely firm. It would not become a vassal of humans or even other lives at all.
n this situation, Shi Yu knew very well that it was probably not that easy to obtain the recognition of the Inner Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
Some lives had no backbone. When they saw an expert, even if the other party was an Ice Dragon, they could recognize it as mom. However, some lives had their own goals and wouldn’t easily change their will and
dreams because of the outside world. Obviously, the reincarnations of the Blue Sea Sprite were all the latter. Shi Yu was very clear on this.
However, fortunately, compared to those in history, the greatest difference between Shi Yu and the Beast Tamers who wanted to forcefully contract it was because of the talent potential of the Blue Sea Sprite… Was
that Shi Yu knew in advance the pursuit of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation Body engraved in the depths of its will.
He should be able to obtain the other party’s recognition from this aspect.
“Buggy, Eleven, Chi Tong, from today onwards, I have a new dream. That is to become the environmental ambassador of Blue Planet. Everyone, monitor each other. In the future, it’s your responsibility to protect the
environment, do you hear me?”
Buggy, Eleven, Chi Tong:????
Shi Yu’s gaze was firm. As a Beast Tamer, if he pursued a pet, he had to change himself for it.
As long as it wasn’t some outrageous dream, it didn’t matter if he had a few more ideals and made more changes.
Otherwise, what right did it have to win its liking?
He was definitely going to be the environmental ambassador.
Rainbow Islands, Qishui Island.
Shi Yu and the others had just approached when they discovered the abnormality.
Originally, the sea area of Qishui Island that should have been very clean was now surrounded by a large amount of mud, and the sea water was turbid.
A large number of transcendent creatures that looked like gray mud gathered around the island, destroying the environment.
< Name > Sludge Monster
[Attributes]: Poison
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Source of Pollution, Poison
< Introduction > A transcendent life form mutated from mud containing various poisonous substances.
Shi Yu saw a large number of Sludge Monsters boarding Qishui Island from the sea and stopping in the sky, and he was slightly stunned.
The Sludge Monster was also a transcendent creature in Dong Huang. Their favorite was to dye a clean environment into an environment suitable for them to live in to obtain better growth.
However, humans weren’t qualified to evaluate the Sludge Monster race. Although they were evaluated as harmful creatures, in the end, they were transcendent lives born by humans after entering modern society.
There was no such thing in ancient times.
However, since it concerned the survival environment of the race, it didn’t matter if it was right or wrong. It just depended on the position. It was enough to clear them out.
If nothing went wrong, this group of Sludge Monsters should have targeted Qishui Island. From the memories of the Ten Thousand Poison Python, this shouldn’t be a short-term war. It should have lasted for a period
of time.
“Compared to the territories occupied by other poisonous creatures, the clean environment of Qishui Island is more convenient and suitable for the transformation of the Sludge Monsters. As for the islands that are
already covered in poisonous substances, it’s not that easy for the Sludge Monsters to pollute them, so they targeted Qishui Island…”
After a simple analysis, Shi Yu used his super vision to look into the distance.
In the distant sky, an elemental life form several meters tall, similar to a manta ray whose entire body was made of water elements, was fighting. Upon seeing this scene, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat.
Holy shit.
Wasn’t this the Cleansing Water Sprite King?
Stop fighting!
Seeing that the king of the island on Qishui Island was fighting an unknown creature, Shi Yu immediately panicked, afraid that the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite would die again in the battle of the island.
The weak little slime couldn’t withstand this kind of torment.
After discovering the battle, Shi Yu hurriedly flew into the island.
“Eleven, deterrence, charge!”
“Wuu!” Eleven patted its chest and expressed that it would take care of it.
Shi Yu gave the order. Then, an extremely shocking scene appeared in the entire Qishui Island.
As Shi Yu flew into the island, the Sludge Monster that logged onto the island almost instantly distorted and fainted with a frightened expression.
In fact, with Eleven’s deterrence, it wasn’t impossible to directly insta-kill them, but that way… the exploded Sludge Monster would become a stronger pollution source. He didn’t want to trouble the water sprites on
Qishui Island.
At this moment, as Shi Yu stepped onto the island, on Qishui Island, the Sludge Monsters fainted one after another. The Water Slimes, Water Sprites, and Mad Water Sprites that resisted the Sludge Monsters looked at
the red figure in the sky in shock.
At the same time.
The Cleansing Water Sprite King was fighting a mud dragon more than ten meters long on the island.
The color of the Sludge Dragon was similar to the composition of the Sludge Monster, but its body was in the form of a dragon. It was a mutated evolution of the monarch race of the Sludge Monster.
At the scene of the battle, as the Sludge Dragon waved its huge tail, more than 100 purple Sludge Bombs instantly flew backward like meteors, smashing towards the Cleansing Water Sprite King.
Regarding this, the Cleansing Water Sprite King was very helpless. In the face of this skill, its best way to deal with it was to dodge a portion of it. This could save a lot of physical strength, but if it let these mud fall into
the island, the environment would quickly be polluted.
“Ji~~” Therefore, the Cleansing Water Sprite King could only activate the mid-level water-elemental skill Purification to resist the Sludge Bomb on a large scale.
“Mi~ =”
In the sky, the Cleansing Water Sprite King circled its body. A light blue light emitted from its mouth, and the light spread into waves that enveloped the mud. A moment later, the purple color on the mud faded,
turning into blue water balls.
Bang!!!
Right on the heels of that, the blue water balls that filled the sky exploded, and rain started to fall from the sky. In the island, those battles between transcendent and commander ranks were actually nothing. The battle
between the two monarch ranks was the key battle that determined the ownership of the island.
However, this battle didn’t last long. The Sludge Dragon and the Cleansing Water Sprite King’s expressions suddenly changed. They looked at the red-haired human flying over from the distance, emitting a terrifying
deterrence.
“Energy value, 1,660,000.”
“Energy value, 1,710,000.”
“Not bad, but…” In the sky, Shi Yu’s expression was calm. After flying over with the deterrence Eleven emitted, his figure suddenly stopped in midair.
“Give me some face. Battle, pause.”
“Roar!!”
“Mil!”
The Sludge Dragon and the Cleansing Water Sprite King stopped fighting and looked at this red-haired human of unknown origin with fear.
“Hello.”
Stopping in midair, Shi Yu looked at the two monarch-level lives with a calm expression.
“Wuu!!” Eleven showed a ferocious expression and warned.
At this moment, Buggy’s Psychic Domain kept expanding, trying to stop the battle on the island and prevent a certain Slime on the island from dying.
“Human??” The mud dragon’s voice.
“Who are you??” It was the Clearwater Sprite King’s light female voice.
At this moment, the power of telepathy was obvious.
These two monarchs clearly didn’t know telepathy, but because Shi Yu knew how, he could directly communicate with them without any obstacles.
“Let me introduce myself. I’m the person in charge of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department established by the Ice Dragon King in Dragon Palace City. You can call me Minister.”
Sludge Dragon: “2”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King: “2”
Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong:???
Dragon Palace City had this department?
The Rainbow Islands was clearly not far from the sea area of Dragon Palace City. The monarch-level creatures here had all heard of the famous Dragon Palace City. Sensing the pressure brought by Shi Yu, the Filthy
Dragon and the Cleansing Water Sprite King were both shocked and uncertain.
“In short, from today onwards, the environmental protection problem of this sea area is under our jurisdiction. I heard that the Cleansing Water Sprite King has done meritorious service in environmental protection. I
hereby appoint you as the deputy minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department under the command of the Ice Dragon King. As for the Mud Dragon, because it violated the fourth law of the Dragon
Palace City’s Ocean Environment Protection Law, we will adopt mandatory sanctions.”
“Roar!!! (Damn it!)” The Mud Dragon was furious. What nonsense was this?
Stop looking down on it!!!
Just as it finished roaring, Eleven, who was 0.3 meters tall, stretched out its small palm and patted down on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
In the next moment, in the sky, under the situation where the Sludge Dragon and the Cleansing Water Sprite King’s eyes instantly widened, the phantom of a huge lightning palm more than fifty meters in diameter
quickly condensed, sweeping with terrifying thunder, wrapped in supreme deterrence, and fell with a bang!
The deterrence of Dao Proficiency and the lightning palm wrapped in giant transformation directly descended from the sky, oppressing the Sludge Dragon until it couldn’t move. It could only show frightened eyes as
the lightning palm landed on its body.
In the next moment, with a boom, a huge pit was directly pushed out of the ground. Under the cry of electric currents that filled the sky, beneath the disintegration of the strong electric current, the death of the mud
dragon didn’t even cause any ripples. Even the poison was instantly “cleansed” by the high temperature of the electric current.
After Eleven directly erupted all its power through the Giant Transformation skill, it instantly killed the Sludge Dragon, shocking the Cleansing Water Sprite King beside it.
“M-Mr. Minister, you’ve come to Qishui Island. Do you… Have any instructions for me, sir?”
Seeing Shi Yu’s terrifying strength, regardless of Shi Yu’s identity, the Cleansing Water Sprite King found it difficult to resist. It was mainly because the deterrence wave swept by Eleven’s deterrence palm just now was
too strong. Even as a bystander, the Cleansing Water Sprite King’s heart wavered when facing the true might of a king.
Skill: Infinite Devour
Status: Can be taught
[Teaching success rate]: Medium
Shi Yu looked at the Cleansing Water Sprite King and revealed a regretful expression.
If only Eleven and Buggy could also learn Infinite Devour. Unfortunately, this skill didn’t have high requirements for spatial compatibility, but its requirements for water-element compatibility were ridiculously high.
Only water-element pets could learn it.
t’s nothing. You’ve heard of Dragon Palace City, right?”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King nodded. Of course, the absolute lord of the Eastern Sea.
ce Dragon King… Forget it, you definitely haven’t heard of this.”
Lord Ice Dragon King is a new totem dragon in Dragon Palace City. It’s an elder who likes to be clean. It can’t stand the slightest pollution in the ocean, so it established the Ocean Environmental Protection
Department.”
“At the same time, they entrusted me, the Beast Tamer who also can’t bear to see any pollution, to be the minister of the Ministry of Environment.”
“I heard that there’s a Cleansing Water Sprite King here whose cleansing ability is pretty good, so I came to take a look. Moreover, I wanted to see if there are any potential people suitable to become members of the
glorious Marine Environmental Department among your people…”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King was stunned.
“In short, you just have to summon your citizens quickly… Tell them clearly. One goal of cleansing the ocean and a great project related to ocean environmental protection, that we need their help. There should be
people with similar thoughts among your citizens, right?”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King: “Among my people, there are indeed some creatures who are proficient in cleansing skills…”
“In short, call all the life forms together,” Shi Yu said. “This is a good thing!”
A moment later.
The Cleansing Water Sprite King gathered the thousands of water-element creatures on Qishui Island according to Shi Yu’s request.
As the guardian of these water-type creatures, the Cleansing Water Sprite King still had a very tall image in their hearts.
They had just obtained a huge victory in a battle. At this moment, these water-element creatures looked at the Cleansing Water Sprite King in admiration. At the same time, they looked at Shi Yu beside it in confusion.
“Everyone…” As the mother-level figure of the water-element life form on Qishui Island, the Cleansing Water Sprite King immediately attracted all its attention after using the special communication method of the
water-element life form.
“This is… Dragon Palace City… Ocean’s Environmental Protection Department? Sir, thanks to his help, we were able to easily defeat the invaders in the invasion of the Mud Island. The so-called Ocean’s Environmental
Protection Department is to cleanse the polluted waters and provide habitable homes for more ocean life. It’s a very great organization.”
“As for Dragon Palace City, it’s one of the strongest factions in the ocean. This time, Dragon Palace City’s Ocean Environmental Protection Department recruited new members, hoping to obtain the recognition of
more ocean life forms and join them. They will contribute their strength to protect our common home.”
“Are any of you willing to join the Ocean Environmental Protection Department?” the Cleansing Water Sprite King asked.
It felt that with Shi Yu’s strong strength, he shouldn’t resort to lying. If Dragon Palace City really had such a department, it couldn’t wait to bring all its citizens into it. However, such a high-level department definitely
wouldn’t take in people so easily.
In that case, the Cleansing Water Sprite King only hoped that more citizens could obtain the recognition of this environmental minister and then let Qishui Island obtain the protection of Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu looked at the thousands of confused water-element lives in front of him.
He said slowly, “Protecting the ocean is the responsibility of every water elemental life form.”
“The blue ocean is the cradle of life.”
“You were born from the ocean. The ocean is like a mother feeding you, and if you protect it… Not only is it protecting yourself, but it’s also protecting the future of your race.”
“Only by improving the ocean environment can everyone have a good life.”
Shi Yu recited the various environmental protection campaigns that his teacher in his previous life had given, feeding them to these marine creatures.
After more than ten classic sentences, these sea creatures were a little moved, and the Cleansing Water Sprite King beside them was a little touched.
Shi Yu was indeed real.
“Although I’m only a human, | also know the importance of protecting the ocean. We only have one blue planet. All things and nature need to coexist in harmony. Corrupting the environment is equivalent to harming
others and ourselves. Protecting the ocean environment is protecting yourself and our descendants. It’s the common cradle for all creatures. Therefore, are any of you willing to take the responsibility of protecting the
ocean and protecting nature with me?”
Many water elemental life forms that had escaped to Qishui Island due to pollution felt the same way and were tempted.
In the blink of an eye, many water-element creatures expressed their willingness to follow Shi Yu and protect the sea with the Cleansing Water Sprite King.
“Very good.”
“However, if you want to protect the ocean on the first line, you have to have the most basic ability requirement, which is to master the cleansing ability. If you don’t have the cleansing ability, it’s a pity…” As Shi Yu
finished speaking, the water sprites who had mastered the cleansing skill became very happy.
At the same time, a portion of the water elemental lives without the cleansing ability became very disappointed.
Before long, Shi Yu got the Cleansing Water Sprite King to start organizing water-type creatures with the ability to cleanse and with the intention of protecting the sea.
Shi Yu floated quietly in the sky and watched everything.
A moment later, Shi Yu smiled.
Under his request, most of the water-element creatures without the cleansing ability, even if they had the intention to protect the ocean, were dispersed by the Cleansing Water Sprite King, leaving only the
water-element creatures with the cleansing ability.
However, there were always accidents.
Among the pile of high-level water elemental life forms, an ordinary water slime stubbornly stayed on the spot, unwilling to leave no matter what.
No matter how the commander under the Cleansing Water Sprite King chased it away, it refused to leave.
Compared to the other slow Water Slimes, this body was like a blue jelly. The petite Water Slime’s gaze was extremely clear and determined, as if it was not the same race as other Slimes.
< Name > Water Slime
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
Skill: Infinite Devour
[Teaching success rate]: High
Seeing this, Shi Yu chuckled and asked the Cleansing Water Sprite King beside him, “What’s wrong with that Water Slime?”
“This…” Seeing that this water slime didn’t leave after a long time, the Cleansing Water Sprite King was also very helpless and surprised.
It said to Shi Yu, “This little guy is a little special. It’s a little different from other Slimes. You might not believe me if I say it, but although it’s just a Slime and doesn’t have the cleansing ability, it’s more concerned about
the ocean environment than any race on the island. Previously, Mud Island had also invaded several times. It was always in the frontline to resist the pollution environment. It even had several near-death experiences.”
“Fortunately, it was very lucky… In the end, it relied on its powerful will to persist.”
“I’ve paid attention to it. Its dream seems to be the protection of the ocean you mentioned, as well as a clean and clear home for all ocean life. However, due to the restriction of its race, it definitely can’t cleanse the
ocean like other water sprites. I’ll chase it away now.”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King actually had a deep impression of a transcendent-level Water Slime on the island. This situation made Shi Yu’s smile even wider. “Why chase it away?”
“Anyone is impressive with dreams.”
Shi Yu patted the Cleansing Water Sprite King and said, “A mere cleansing skill. If it doesn’t know it, I’ll teach it.”
[Recording successful.]
“I’ve decided. I’ll also let it join the Environmental Protection Department. Just let it be my private secretary.”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King:???
Below.
An ordinary Cleansing Water Sprite was persuading the Water Slime to leave. Without the cleansing ability, it was impossible for it to be taken fancy by the Environmental Department of a huge faction like Dragon
Palace City.
“Hul!!” The Water Slime opened its stubborn big eyes and expressed that although it didn’t have the cleansing ability, it could fight those bad guys who polluted the sea and also protect the sea.
“Ugh…” This ordinary Cleansing Water Sprite had a headache. Was the Water Slime very strong? Even if it broke through to the transcendent level, it was still very weak. This guy had been on the verge of death a few
times, didn’t it know that? Why was it so stubborn?
This Water Slime was also considered a popular creature on Qishui Island. After all, the lives here still liked it very much for it to fight so hard against the invaders.
However, it was not that easy to enter the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City without talent potential!
“Do you want to protect the sea very much?” Just as the Water Slime was struggling to join the Marine Environmental Protection Department, a voice suddenly came from the side. Shi Yu had descended at some point
in time. He came to the front and looked at the Water Slime as he asked.
At this moment, the Water Slime was immediately stunned when it saw the Ocean Minister of Environment.
“Hu! (Yes.)” Then, it emitted a firm voice. Its voice was like the firm vow of a young female knight, appearing in Shi Yu’s mind.
“T’ll give you a test. If you can complete it, I’ll give you the ability of cleansing and give you the ability to break through the limits of your race. I’ll let you fight on the front line of protecting the ocean and follow beside
me to protect the ocean. How about that?” Shi Yu revealed a sunny and warm smile.
The Water Slime was slightly stunned. It didn’t expect that it could be appreciated by such a big shot with similar aspirations…
Test… It would definitely pass..

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - Contracting the Water Slime
chapters.content:
Chapter 278 Contracting the Water Slime
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Cleansing Water Sprite King was very puzzled.
It and the creatures who could cleanse had already been fired up by Shi Yu’s words. They couldn’t wait to follow the environmental department of Dragon Palace City to cleanse the larger ocean.
However, why did Shi Yu turn around and leave with a water slime??
At this moment, the Cleansing Water Sprite King suddenly suspected what Shi Yu was doing.
“Cough.”
Sensing a bunch of hot-blooded gazes, Shi Yu, who was about to pull the Water Slime to talk, suddenly stopped.
He turned around and looked at the Cleansing Water Sprite King and the group of water-element sprites. He touched his chin and pondered for a moment.
“Well…”
The marine environmental department still had to be built.
Shi Yu had already helped Ice Dragon plan its future position in Dragon Palace City.
As for whether this position had any future? What a joke. With the support of the Blue Sea Sprite, how could there be no future?
At that time, the Ice Dragon King would be the strongest competitor of the new generation of the Dragon God.
And now, the companions of these Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnations were the first batch of members of the environmental department of Dragon Palace City. They couldn’t be mistreated!
Shi Yu took out three nutritional fruits from the ruins’ space and threw them to the Cleansing Water Sprite King. “These are spiritual fruits that can increase the life potential, race potential, and evolution aptitude of transcendent life forms below the
monarch level.”
“You’re the only monarch on this island, so it should be useful to them. Take these three spiritual fruits as a reward and hold an island meeting. A huge battle just happened on the island, and now many places have been polluted. Let’s compete on
who cleanses the most.”
“Of course, the goal isn’t for everyone to work hard to protect the environment for the reward, but if you work hard, there will definitely be rewards. Our Sea Environmental Protection Department is still very humane!”
In the next moment, the tempting fragrance of the nutritional fruit spread. Whether it was transcendent or commander rank water elemental life forms that stayed on the scene, when they smelled it, their breathing instantly became rapid, and they
stared intently at the nutritional fruit!!
This was…
A spiritual fruit that increased evolution aptitude and life potential?
There was actually such a thing?
Living in such a polluted environment, this group of water elemental life forms had never seen such high-quality resources.
Even the Cleansing Water Sprite King, who had obtained the nutritional fruit, instantly swallowed its saliva when it sensed the aura of the nutritional fruit at a close distance.
After all, even the nutritional fruits created by Baby Ginseng before it evolved could attract the overlord, the gem cat. Although the gem cat was suspected of being a foodie and that it was custom-made, it was enough to show the charm of Baby
Ginseng’s nutritional fruits.
Moreover, these were created after the ginseng baby evolved and learned plant control. Many elemental life forms present, including the little slime beside them, were instantly attracted, and water elements flowed out of the corners of their mouths.
“I, can I participate?” the Cleansing Water Sprite King asked.
Shi Yu: “…No, but you can be the judge. You’ll be rewarded with a spiritual fruit.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the next moment, the water sprites that could cleanse all ran crazily to various parts of the island and started the cleansing competition. Seeing this, the Little Water Slime opened its mouth slightly, and the Cleansing
Water Sprite King also opened its mouth slightly.
Was this alright?
If they had been so hardworking in the past, the neighboring Sludge Island would have long been occupied by them.
At this moment, seeing that the good peaceful island had been swept up by Shi Yu, Eleven and Buggy covered their faces at the side.
This Ocean Environmental Protection Department was established by Shi Yu with the backing of Dragon Palace City and the Blue Sea Sprite. Why did they feel that the sea beasts that polluted the ocean in the end would become very miserable…
They could already imagine that in the future, those creatures that polluted the sea would become walking bounty lists!
At the moment, the Water Slime definitely didn’t have the ability to assist Eleven in evolution. It looked like it had to be nurtured slowly again.
Shi Yu roughly looked at its data.
< Name > Water Slime
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Mid-level transcendent
[Level of Growth]: transcendent
Energy Points: 555
How should he put it? It was pitifully weak.
The skills were probably only multiplication and bubbles.
Not to mention the multiplication skill, but Bubbles, a low-level water-element skill, was also very useless.
It was just to slowly spit out a water bubble, and then the water bubble would explode when it touched the enemy. It was that simple.
It wasn’t as useful as the water-element basic skill, the Water Spear.
The water spear shot out with a whoosh, and the bubble skill had to fly slowly.
The only advantage was that after the proficiency was high, it could still be used as a control skill to restrain the enemy.
In short, the Water Slime was very lousy now. Even if it was the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite, apart from its extremely high willpower, there was nothing special about it. Perhaps it was even a little smarter than other Slimes.
At this moment, the Water Slime walked with Shi Yu, wanting to see what test the minister had given it.
Shi Yu walked in front with his hands behind his back. He said earnestly, “I acknowledge your determination, but determination and hard work alone aren’t enough.”
The Water Slime listened silently and couldn’t refute.
“My test is very simple. I heard about you from the Cleansing Water Sprite King, so I acknowledge your determination and will.”
“But just like I said, if you want to achieve a goal, determination and hard work alone aren’t enough!”
“Therefore, the first thing I want to test is your wisdom. I want to test if you understand how to be flexible and change your mind.”
Wisdom?
The Water Slime was nervous.
“What do you think you need most to achieve your dream, apart from determination?”
“Hu? (Cleansing ability and strength?)” The slime answered carefully, afraid that it would answer wrong.
“Change your voice. This “hu” is silly and not very smart.”
Slime: “2”
“Wu?” The slime said.
“T’m tired of listening to that. Change again.”
Eleven, who was watching Shi Yu deceive the ignorant girl: ??
Their feelings had faded, so there was no love.
“Coo?” the slime said.
Shi Yu said, “It sounds like it’s easy to get beaten up. Do you have any vitality?”
Water Slime: “Ning!”
“Sure, that’s it. Back to the topic. You’re right.”
“To achieve a dream, the most important thing is ability and strength, not determination.”
“Your hard work and will shouldn’t only be used to cleanse the ocean, but also to increase your strength.”
“This isn’t for you to give up on your dreams, but because only with strength can you better protect the ocean. Do you agree with this?”
Shi Yu asked, causing the Little Slime to fall silent.
“With your current strength and ability, what can you do for your dream?”
“You should feel it yourself.”
“Even if you fight with all your might against those Sludge Monsters that pollute the environment, you can only end up on the verge of death.”
“On the other hand, the powerful Cleansing Water Sprite King can not only easily expel many Sludge Monsters, but it can also protect a weak little guy like you. The reason why it can achieve all of this is not because of its faith, but because of its
strength.”
“So, what do you think you should do now?”
“Ning! (Change of train of thought, work hard to increase strength first.)”
The Water Slime was still smart. As expected of the Sea Sprite Reincarnation Body, it was different from those low-level elemental monsters with low intelligence.
“That’s right! Improving your strength is the most important thing for you to achieve your dream now.”
“When you increase your strength to the totem level, you can cleanse the ocean however you want. No one can control you. The efficiency will still be very high, unlike now, where you struggle between life and death every time.”
“Therefore, before you become a totem level, let’s put aside the matter of cleansing the sea for now and focus on increasing your strength!”
The Slime nodded and felt that it made sense. It mainly felt that Shi Yu, the minister of the Ministry of Environment, wouldn’t lie to it.
After all, everyone had the same dream.
“Alright, the wisdom test has passed. Next, we’ll continue the next test.”
The Water Slime revealed a happy expression.
“Then what do you think is the fastest way to increase your strength?”
The Little Slime fell into deep thought.
It was a Slime… It didn’t know how to quickly increase its strength.
Tt couldn’t help but look at Shi Yu eagerly.
n
i Yu said, “Actually, your insistence on joining the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City is a very good choice. A choice that can increase your strength.”
“The strength of an individual is ultimately small. When it’s weak, it can only grow better by relying on a stronger group. For example, if you didn’t have the protection of the Cleansing Water Sprite King, it would definitely be very difficult for you
to grow to this level.”
“Look, those water-element sprites who can cleanse have joined the Environmental Protection Department. Now, not only can they cleanse the environment and complete their dreams, but if their cleansing is not bad, they also have a chance to obtain
treasures to increase their strength. This is the advantage of sucking up to others. No, I mean, joining the group!”
“Therefore, compared to working hard yourself and knowing how to exchange your hard work and talent for other people’s investment, it’s also very important.”
The Water Slime felt that it understood a little.
“However, if you want to win the investment, you have to show the value you deserve. Although you’ve figured out that you should work hard to increase your strength now, it’s not up to you to determine whether your determination is there or not.”
“Ning…” The Little Slime looked at Shi Yu firmly.
It was determined… It was just that its strength was a little weak and its race was a little inferior. In that case, could it obtain Shi Yu’s recognition?
It wanted to follow Shi Yu and increase its strength and abilities. For this, it was willing to pay any price!
“Looks like you’ve thought it through.”
Shi Yu was gratified.
“Do you know why I pay special attention to you?”
The slime shook its head.
“Because you have a very strong will. This is your talent, your shining point.”
“However, it’s very difficult to stimulate this determination and potential.”

Although it felt that something was wrong, the Cleansing Water Sprite King shook its head. It was really not very sure. It only knew that Dragon Palace City was in the deep sea.
“Sigh!” Shi Yu sighed. It was really useless.
As expected, he couldn’t give the position to him.
It looked like he still had to take a look at the Blue Sea Ruins first.
This time, there was the Sea Sprite Reincarnation. Perhaps the Blue Sea Ruins was willing to open the door.
If it still didn’t work, he could only go to other islands to ask for information.
If he really couldn’t, there seemed to be pirates nearby…
“Then let’s go,” Shi Yu said to Buggy. At the same time, he said to the Cleansing Water Sprite King, “We’ll return to Dragon Palace City first. If nothing goes wrong, we should still come. During this period, you just
have to stay on the island.”
“Or do you want to go with me?”
If they left together, Shi Yu could store the Cleansing Water Sprite King and the others in the ruins space.
“Mil!”
The Cleansing Water Sprite King shook its head.
At all times, there were water sprites who escaped to Qishui Island to seek protection. If they left, the Rainbow Islands would not have any pure lands anymore.
“Alright… How about this? Before we leave, I’ll leave you a sea calming rod to protect Qishui Island!”
Thinking that it was very easy for Qishui Island to be coveted, Shi Yu decided to let Eleven and Buggy create a weapon wrapped in deterrence and lightning to stay here.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - Returning to Dragon Palace City
chapters.content:
Chapter 280 Returning to Dragon Palace City
Poison Fang Island.
That island with the sea ruins.
Shi Yu and the others used the Lightning Rod, Hardening, Deterrence, and Illusory Phantom to leave behind a Sea Calming Rod with the awareness of friend and foe on Qishui Island before leaving.
This Sea Calming Rod was created with Eleven’s strength as the core. It was easy to intimidate monarch-level sea beasts with more than 1 million energy points.
With this to protect Qishui Island, if another enemy like the Sludge Dragon came, the Cleansing Water Sprite King could easily crush it with the help of the Sea Calming Rod.
“Ning…” This was the first time the Water Slime Susu had left Qishui Island.
As Shi Yu rode the “flying bed” conjured by Buggy to Poison Fang Island, its obsessive-compulsive disorder immediately acted up.
This place was too dirty!!! It needed to be cleansed!!!
“Next time, next time!”
Shi Yu persuaded Susu. There was something urgent at the moment.
He pulled the angry and reluctant Susu and finally returned to the Blue Sea Ruins.
“Ning?”
The Blue Sea Ruins was still very special. Seeing that there was actually such a clean building on this polluted island, Susu was stunned.
In an instant, huge Blue Sea Ruins filled his vision.
It didn’t know why, but when it saw this huge water cube, it felt an indescribable sense of closeness.
“Ning…” It asked Shi Yu what this was.
“Well…”
“This is called the Blue Sea Ruins. It was built by a great existence called the Blue Sea Sprite.” “Ning?? (Blue Sea Sprite??)” Susu kept feeling that it had heard of it somewhere.
After recalling it, it was immediately stunned. This was because back in the ruins space, Shi Yu had said that after it reached the overlord level, it could evolve into the Blue Sea Sprite…
