“The Blue Sea Sprite is a water-element creature born in the ocean because countless sea creatures want to have a clean home.”
“In a sense, the Sea Sprite is the guardian of the sea, the cleaner of the sea.”
“For example, it has mastered the strongest cleansing skill, the Spirit of Sea Cleansing.”
“This ability can cleanse and wash away all filth. Even the ‘evil thoughts’ that exist in the heart of a life can be completely converted into ‘good thoughts’.”
“In the past, there were many monsters tens of thousands of times stronger than the Sludge Monster who wanted to pollute the sea. However, in the end, they didn’t succeed. Instead, under the purification of the Sea Sprite, they washed away their ambition and became the guardians of the sea.”
Shi Yu explained the background of the Blue Sea Sprite to it.
Susu was stunned.
It was already pretty impressive that Shi Yu had those water sprites try their best to cleanse the sea. That Blue Sea Sprite could actually let the Sludge Monster protect the environment?
“Yeah, it’s even said that the ‘self-cleaning ability’ of the ocean was given to the sea by the sea sprite through this skill.”
“Apart from that, it also mastered the strongest water-type skill, the Blue Sea Contract.”
“With this skill, no matter where it is, even if it’s land or sky, it can communicate with the sea at any time because it has already signed a contract with the sea. Its body is connected to the entire sea. It can mobilize the power of the sea at any time. This is the top-level skill to control the power of nature.” According to Shi Yu’s understanding, the Blue Sea Sprite only had two super racial skills.
The Spirit of Sea Cleansing and the Blue Sea Contract.
However, even if it only had these two skills, because these two skills were too heaven-defying, its strength and potential were rarely comparable to creatures.
There was no need to talk about the Spirit of the Sea Cleansing. It was the basic skill of the Blue Sea Sprite to become the cleanser of the sea. In essence, it used the power of the entire sea to cleanse everything, and it also involved the use of natural power. As for the Blue Sea Contract, it was the source of the strength of the Blue Sea Sprite.
It could sign a contract with the sea, and its body was connected to the sea. What kind of concept was this?
It meant that it almost had endless energy. As long as the sea didn’t dry up, its energy was endless. This was also why the Blue Sea Sprite could make even half-gods submit to it.
It could be said that because of the existence of the Blue Sea Contract, the Sea Sprites was the race that could mobilize the power of the sea the easiest..
After learning the Blue Sea Contract, an ordinary water spear could use the effect of a tsunami.
Its cleansing power became extremely powerful because of this.
“Ning…” Susu’s eyes immediately lit up.
So strong!
“However, because it has been cleansing those negative powers, its own consumption is also very serious. It can only obtain new life through continuous reincarnation.”
“In the Blue Sea Ruins, the incomparable purification power and Inner Sea Contract of the Inner Sea Sprite are stored. Only the reincarnation of the Inner Sea Sprite can inherit it.”
“Ning!!”
Upon hearing that the Blue Sea Sprite was actually so great and powerful, Susu immediately felt respect.
Idol!
“Oh?” Shi Yu smiled at Susu.
Susu immediately turned into water and used the water to condense a question mark.
Susu: E(°4 °|11)_!!!
It suddenly realized something.
The water trembled as it condensed an arrow and pointed at itself.
“Yes.”
“Ning??!!”
Susu was shocked. Shi Yu meant that… it was the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite??
How was this possible…
How could such a great existence… reincarnate into a slime?
“The matter of the Blue Sea Sprite’s reincarnation becoming a Slime is completely unscientific!”
“I’m also very surprised, but it should be you.”
“Although you’re very weak.”
“But you’re so weak, and you actually have such a powerful will to cleanse the filth. If it wasn’t you, who else could it be?”
Shi Yu looked at the Sea Ruins and said to Susu, “Are you excited to know that you were such a great existence in your previous life?”
Susu was at a loss.
“Are you worried that you don’t have the right to inherit the power of the Blue Sea Sprite and don’t have the determination to become the guardian of the sea?”
Susu’s body stiffened. It nodded slightly and shook its head again.
Even with its super willpower, it was still a little confused to suddenly hear such an incomprehensible thing.
The overlord’s will was not the greatest will. Although the overlord will was very impressive, in the world, there might be a lot of lives with the overlord will.
However, to be able to protect and cleanse the sea like the Blue Sea Sprites for hundreds of millions of years and have the determination to protect the sea even after countless rebirths… It could be said to be a mythical will.
At the moment, Susu was less than three years old. Even if it was determined, she couldn’t tie herself to the Blue Sea Sprite for the time
being.
“Forget it.”
“It’s better not to think too much.”
“You’re only a water slime now. You don’t have to feel too much pressure, nor do you have to care too much about the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite. Perhaps inheriting the power of the Blue Sea Sprite isn’t your end.”
Shi Yu pulled it into his hand and said, “It’s not necessarily a good thing to have too much responsibility. It’s tiring. In short, before the overlord level, just upgrade here with me easily and happily. Just like I said, you’re still very weak. You can think about the future.”
“Perhaps I can easily help you break through to the Mythical stage when the time comes. It’s fine if you don’t want to be a mere Blue Sea Sprite. Just be a Blue Sea Goddess!”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Susu was immediately very touched.
Beside them, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, who had been silent the whole time, were used to it. This was because Shi Yu had also bragged to them. Everyone had a Mythical Dream, and they were all aiming for the Mythical stage.
After all, the dream of Shi Yu, a Mythology Scholar who had transmigrated from Earth, was to find a real myth.
Since the Mythical Era had disappeared, he would open a new Mythical Era himself. Fuu!!
Just as Shi Yu finished showing off, a suction force suddenly came from the Blue Sea Ruins in front of him, causing Shi Yu and the others’ faces to immediately distort.
“Holy shit, I’m in the middle of something! Ambush! I haven’t chatted with you or asked you to teleport!”
Dragon Palace City. Clearwater Island.
Blue Sea Ruins.
At this moment, the atmosphere was especially serious and solemn.
In the sky, lightning flashed and thunder rumbled.
Four huge creatures were gathered here, staring at the Blue Sea Ruins.
Among them was a huge white dragon.
There was a huge green-blue divine dragon.
There was an ice-blue dragon.
And a light blue sea dragon with coral-like wings.
Apart from them, there was also a human figure and a cat figure. “Lord Sea Dragon King, Lord Azure Dragon King, Lord Ice Dragon King, Lord Immortal Dragon King, Lord Tyrant Sea Legend, Lord Ying, Sir Shi Yu really disappeared here…”
The Turtle Minister wanted to cry.
Who would have thought? It only brought Shi Yu to Clearwater Island to take a look… Shi Yu was gone, just like that. “Blue Sea Ruins…”
Tyrant Sea Legend looked at the ruins in front of him solemnly.
Shi Yu had been missing for a day. As the legend leading the team, he naturally received the news immediately.
It was indeed scientific for members of Bureau 11 to disappear before the ruins, but…
“Damn it, where did this kid go?” Ice Dragon cursed.
It went out for a while and he was gone?
“Don’t tell me he really entered the Blue Sea Ruins,” the Sea Dragon King pondered.
“Sir Shi Yu was indeed very interested in the Blue Sea Ruins. He asked us a lot about the Blue Sea Ruins.” Apart from this group of totem big shots, there were also overlord sea beasts like Doctor Shell beside them.
At this moment, the Holy Healing Light Shell, the Pink Sea Immortal Spirit Water Jellyfish, the Heavenly Blue Star Coral, and the other sea beasts also had bitter expressions. They didn’t understand why the Sea Dragon King’s honored guest had suddenly disappeared.
And he had been missing for so long!
“Doctor Shelly, describe the situation again,” the Sea Dragon King said to the Sacred Bei.
This Shi Yu was the one guy who shouldn’t have disappeared…
It and the Ice Dragon had just returned from a complete victory. This Senior Ice Dragon had just helped Dragon Palace City a lot, but in the end, Dragon Palace City lost the Ice Dragon’s son. How could the Ice Dragon settle in Dragon Palace City and become a queen now?
Moreover, Shi Yu was also Dong Huang’s genius and was valued by his old friend, the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly. He definitely couldn’t lose him.
“At that time, Sir Shi Yu judged that the Poison Dragon Totem was related to some half-god, Yun An. He thought that the Ice Dragon King and the Sea Dragon King would be in danger and that the Immortal Dragon King might not be able to cleanse the poison of the Poison Dragon Totem…”
“Hmph.” Although the Immortal Dragon King, who had coral-like wings, didn’t know Shi Yu, he immediately didn’t have a good impression of him when he saw that this kid didn’t trust him.
It was just radiation poison. It had just returned to Dragon Palace City and helped the injured heal.
“Well…” The Sea Dragon King and Ice Dragon nodded silently. Although it was relatively easy for them to deal with the Poison Dragon Totem, Shi Yu was concerned about them and had good intentions.
“Then, as we chatted, we talked about Lord Blue Sea Sprite.”
The Immortal Dragon King said, “If there is poison that I can’t cleanse, only the legendary Blue Sea Sprite can.”
After all, this was the true guardian of the sea that stood above the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.
“In short, Sir Shi Yu seems to want to see the Blue Sea Sprite very much, but because the Blue Sea Sprite hasn’t appeared in 3,000 years, he glanced at the Blue Sea Ruins… and said…”
“Since the Blue Sea Ruins can summon the reincarnation of the Inner Sea Sprite, the Blue Sea Ruins definitely knows where the reincarnation of the Inner Sea Sprite is. Why don’t we ask the Blue Sea Ruins?”
The Three Dragon Kings and the Tyrannical Sea Legend : “…”
This kid looked like he was dreaming.
In the hundreds of millions of years, no creature other than the Blue Sea Sprite had been able to communicate with the Blue Sea Ruins.
Ice Dragon pondered and said, “Do you think there’s a possibility that this kid really activated the Blue Sea Ruins and was teleported into the ruins?”
“To be honest, I think this kid has some skills in communicating with ruins. If I were the spirit of the ruins, I definitely wouldn’t be able to sit still!”
“This…” The Dragon King’s wife, the Azure Dragon King, said,” But the Blue Sea Ruins is an inheritance ruin that inherits the power of the Inner Sea Sprite. Why is it teleporting a human Beast Tamer?”
“Firstly, we can eliminate the possibility that Shi Yu is the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite.” Beside him, the gem cat was tired.
It was also very afraid of losing Shi Yu. It wouldn’t be able to explain to Ancient Capital University when it returned.
However, the current situation made it feel like it was similar to the time in the Emperor Wu Ruins.
Shi Yu must have done something again.
Sigh…
Just as most of the big shots in Dragon Palace City surrounded the Blue Sea Ruins and discussed Shi Yu’s situation, a wave of ripples suddenly appeared in the Blue Sea Ruins.
This change immediately attracted their attention.
Their large eyes looked in the direction of the Blue Sea Ruins.
Then, a slightly painful scene appeared. The Blue Sea Ruins was like a bed of bullets, and a bunch of creatures suddenly popped out.
One human, one panda, one butterfly, one ginseng baby, one sword spirit, one water slime… Who else could it be other than Shi Yu and the others? “Eh.” After coming out, Shi Yu was still a little stunned.
He was already used to Buggy’s Instant Transmission, but he was a little dizzy from the teleportation of the Blue Sea Ruins.
“Hu…” Shi Yu and the pets rubbed their eyes and looked over.
This look stunned Shi Yu instantly. He looked at the huge four dragon kings, as well as the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the gem cat, and the Turtle Prime Minister on the ground with a stunned expression.
“Uh, seniors, this is…”
“Look, look!! He really entered the ruins!” the Ice Dragon King said proudly. The prophecy was right! However, Shi Yu’s hair… What was going on?? “You, what’s going on?” After a moment of silence, Tyrannical Sea Legend also asked Shi Yu.
Shi Yu looked around and looked at everyone before looking at the Water Slime.
“I didn’t go to the inside of the Blue Sea Ruins.”
“But if I say that because the Blue Sea Ruins found the growth of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation too slow, so it entrusted me to take care of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation in this lifetime and teleported me to the location of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation… Would you believe me??”
“Well, it’s the reincarnation of this lifetime’s Blue Sea Sprite.” Shi Yu bent down and picked up the cute Water Slime.
“To seniors… Eh, no… Well, forget it. Just treat them as seniors and greet them.”
“Ning!”
Everyone: “?”
“???”
Huh???
This guy actually managed to get an answer from the ruins??
The Sea Dragon King, the Azure Dragon King, and the Immortal Dragon King and the other totems, along with the three healers, widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu and the Water Slime.
However, he wasn’t f*cking kidding, right?
The Blue Sea Sprite had reincarnated into a water slime?
Susu: (2_C)
It looked at this pile of big shots that was countless times larger than itself and was abnormally nervous… This was… This was… Dragon Palace City? In short, now, even the three Dragon Kings who were totems and the legendary Tyrannical Sea were completely unable to understand what Shi Yu had just said.
Boom.
Thunder rumbled in the sky, representing the mood of the big shots.
“What exactly is going on…” The Sea Dragon King asked with a hoarse voice.
It looked at the Water Slime and said, “It’s the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite??”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Yes.”
Many Dragon Kings were shocked still. They couldn’t connect the Blue Sea Sprite to the Water Slime in Shi Yu’s arms no matter what.
However, with the reaction of the Blue Sea Ruins as proof, they didn’t know where to start suspecting
Damn, no way.
“As expected of you.” The gem cat looked at Shi Yu and was extremely excited. It was the first to believe him.
You easily did what Lu Qingyi didn’t do five years ago!
“The current situation is…” Tyrannical Sea Legend asked.
“I signed a contract with it to nurture it to the overlord level before it accepts the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins,” Shi Yu said.
Holy shit.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Turtle Minister and the other creatures were even more shocked. You f*cking signed a contract with the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation??
What was wrong with him!
How was this possible! He had never heard of a Blue Sea Sprite following a human Beast Tamer in its lifetime.
This…
At this moment, the totems and overlords present were shocked because they knew very well what the name “Blue Sea Sprite” meant. Although the Blue Sea Sprite had a large number of enemies, at the same time, as the guardian of the sea, the Blue Sea Sprite had countless believers and countless followers. It was an existence even more honorable than the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.
Even Dragon Palace City had received the favor of the Blue Sea Sprite several times.
They really couldn’t imagine that such an existence would actually sign a contract with a human Beast Tamer.
For a time, these totems and overlords couldn’t help but pant. Legend Sea Tyrant was even more stunned and felt that it was ridiculous.
They came to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet to obtain the recognition of the heir of the Dragon Palace City’s overlord- this was their final goal.
In the end, he came and directly took away a life that was even more impressive than the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City? Originally, when the Tyrannical Sea Legend had heard that someone had contracted the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin, he had sighed with emotion that the younger generation would surpass the older generation. Now, as Shi Yu contracted an even more ridiculous Blue Sea Sprite, he no longer knew how to express his emotions.
Beast Tamers and pets often had achievements together.
Although he didn’t know what kind of Beast Tamer Shi Yu would become in the future, the status and identity of the Blue Sea Sprite was already placed here. The Blue Sea Sprite was almost guaranteed to become a super life form at the demigod level. In that case, wouldn’t Shi Yu definitely have legendary talent?
Even if the Blue Sea Sprite broke through to the overlord level and left Shi Yu after accepting the inheritance, because of this contract experience, Shi Yu would definitely become a friend of the sea. It might even affect the Dragon Emperor, who was on good terms with Dragon Palace City at that time. “What’s with your hair…” This was also what the Tyrannical Sea Legend wanted to ask.
At this moment, in their opinion, Shi Yu looked like he was about to die.
Shi Yu was stunned. “Perhaps it’s the necessary price to listen to the voice of the Blue Sea Ruins and contract the Inner Sea Sprite… I’m so tired… Sea Dragon King, is there any high-level resource to replenish life force in Dragon Palace City?”
With that said, he retracted Eleven, Susu, and the others with a weak expression.
“Next, I might need to rest for a while…”
“Uh, yes, yes! Prime Minister Turtle, quickly retrieve resources for him!!!” Seeing Shi Yu’s appearance, the Sea Dragon King immediately said to Prime Minister Turtle.
Following that, Shi Yu also sat on the ground.
He was indeed very tired.
Shi Yu’s sitting immediately frightened the Sea Dragon King and the other totems.
If they had to prevent anything from happening to Shi Yu in the past, that was even more so the case now!
Because they had seen Shi Yu enter and leave the Blue Sea Ruins with their own eyes, they finally chose to believe Shi Yu.
Shi Yu… was chosen by the Blue Sea Sprite and became the Beast Tamer of the Blue Sea Sprite!
This was a huge matter.
In short, if Dragon Palace City could assist the growth of the Blue Sea Sprite in this lifetime, Dragon Palace City could also obtain countless benefits.
The Sea Dragon King and the other totems were very clear on this.
Therefore, at this moment, they didn’t dare to slight Shi Yu. To be precise, they didn’t dare to slight the young Blue Sea Sprite that Shi Yu had contracted.
“By the way.”
Just as Shi Yu sat down, he suddenly recalled something and looked at the Immortal Dragon King, Ice Dragon, and Doctor Shell in confusion.
“Wait, seniors, you’re all here. Does that mean that the Poison Dragon has been resolved?”
“Yes, but not completely,” the Sea Dragon King was stunned and said.
“That guy is a sore loser. If it can’t win, it will enter an armorized state that can’t be broken through. It continues to release poison. I can only freeze and seal it first,” Ice Dragon said. “After all, if it self-destructs, everyone will be finished. Dragon Palace City’s sea area is the worst.”
Shi Yu was stunned. “What about the sea beasts affected by the poison?”
Doctor Shell: “Fortunately, Lord Immortal Dragon King has already successfully cured them.”
Shi Yu and the Immortal Dragon King looked at each other.
If it was said that the Immortal Dragon King found Shi Yu less pleasing to the eye just now now that Shi Yu had obtained the recognition of the Blue Sea Sprite, it found Shi Yu pleasing to the eye again.
“I’ve already healed those poisoned people, but my ability is indeed limited. Because these injured people weren’t deeply poisoned, it’s easier to heal and cleanse them. But that Poison Dragon Totem that lost its mind because of the poison… my ability isn’t enough to cleanse it,” the Immortal Dragon King said.
“However, now that the Blue Sea Sprite has returned, that Poison Dragon Totem can definitely be purified.”
Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that Mother Dragon was not injured and that the poisoned sea beasts had recovered.
Now, Susu had yet to receive the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite and had yet to grow up. It really didn’t have the ability to cleanse powerful poison.
Since everything was settled, that was good. “By the way, if possible, please, Sir Shi Yu. When the time comes, help that Poison Dragon Totem cleanse the negative power in its body with Lord Blue Sea Sprite,” the Immortal Dragon King said.
“That Poison Dragon Totem also became like this because it was corroded by the mutated power. Perhaps it wasn’t the culprit behind all of this. When I touched it, I could clearly hear the cries and struggles in its heart.”
“It must be those bastards from the seven islands,” the Sea Dragon King cursed. “Unfortunately, there’s no evidence, but if we can restore that Poison Dragon’s rationality, there might be evidence.”
“When the time comes, let’s fight together and find a reason.” The Sea Dragon King and the others didn’t kill the Poison Dragon Totem. After all, it was a totem and a dragon. The other party was also a victim. If possible, they would naturally turn the enemy into a friend and find a common enemy to maximize their benefits. At that time, if there was evidence, there would be a reason to attack. They could go and kill the seven islands.
However, without sufficient evidence, with only knowing that the Poison Dragon Totem came from the direction of the seven islands, it was really difficult for Dragon Palace City to fall out with the seven islands.
It was mainly because Dragon Palace City didn’t know if the legends of the seven islands had died.
sev
If that female Martial God didn’t die, the battle power of the seven islands was still strong.
None of the seven countries that could escape the control of the totems was weak. At least at that time, there was a legendary Beast Tamer.
The Sea Dragon King looked at Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
That Poison Dragon couldn’t be cleansed yet?
He still wanted to understand Yun An’s situation through this poison dragon. “I understand. I’ll nurture the Blue Sea Sprite to the overlord level as soon as possible. At that time, It’ll help cleanse that Poison Dragon.”
Shi Yu estimated that he should be able to raise the Blue Sea Sprite to the overlord level in a year.
With the talent to increase super skills, it was that fast.
Even if Dragon Palace City tried its best to nurture a Water Slime, it was impossible to do it faster than Shi Yu.
“Do you need our help?” the Sea Dragon King asked.
Shi Yu was stunned and said, “Yes, do you have that kind of water-element resource? One that’s very high quality, but its level is very low…”
“Perhaps it can be used to accelerate the growth of the Blue Sea Sprite.”
The Sea Dragon King was stunned and said, “I can get the Turtle Prime Minister to look for it in the treasure vault later.”
“Is there anything else? Why don’t you stay in Dragon Palace City, Sir Shi Yu? We’ll definitely use all our resources…”
“No!” At this moment, the Tyrannical Sea Legend said indifferently, “Dong Huang’s resources are also sufficient. It’s better for Shi Yu to return to the ground.”
The Sea Dragon King curled its lips. Damn old
man.
They were all family, and this guy…
The Immortal Dragon King said, “I think that since the Lord Blue Sea Sprite has returned, Dragon Palace City needs to establish an Oceanic Environmental Protection Department to protect the Lord Blue Sea Sprite. I think Sir Shi Yu is very suitable to be the in-charge of this department.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Holy shit, how did it know what he was going to say?
Well, he did say it back on that island…
The Azure Dragon King nodded and said, “My child is pretty smart. He can help run errands.”
The Sea Dragon King smiled in embarrassment. Son of a b*tch, a day ago, it still felt that Shi Yu’s historical listening talent wasn’t enough for its son. Now, its wife had sold their son to Shi Yu as an errand boy??
Damn, listening to history talents could be used like this? It could even casually contract the Blue Sea Sprite???
It didn’t understand!
“That makes sense. I’ll announce it at the Dragon Palace banquet the day after tomorrow. Congratulations to Senior Ice Dragon for joining Dragon Palace City and for the establishment of the Dragon Palace Ocean Environmental Protection Department. Little Friend Shi Yu, you should also come to the Dragon Palace banquet with Senior Ice Dragon,” the Sea Dragon King said politely. After all, the reappearance of the Blue Sea Sprite after 3,000 years was important. They even estimated that the Dragon God would be shocked soon. The tortoise prime minister: “What you say makes sense…”
At this moment, Ice Dragon was beside him. It suddenly felt more and more uncomfortable.
Wait a minute. He, a totem, had joined Dragon Palace City and had just helped to solve a big enemy.
Logically speaking, shouldn’t the totems of Dragon Palace City revolve around it!
Why did they all run to curry favor with Shi Yu now??
Roar!!!
Was this scientific!
At this moment, Shi Yu was also flattered. This was too blissful.
He sighed. Being a beast tamer really meant cuddling up to others. Even their own beasts…
Next, he could also follow the totem dragon king to the Dragon Palace banquet as the minister of the environmental protection department of Dragon Palace City. He wondered what Yu Shu and the others would think of him… It was annoying.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - Treasure of Dragon Palace City
chapters.content:
Chapter 281 Treasure of Dragon Palace City
In the secret realm of Dragon Palace City.
Green Sky Island.
This was an island used by Dragon Palace City to specially entertain human guests.
During the Dragon Palace banquet, Dong Huang’s visitors would stay in the buildings here.
For example, White Brook and the others were all here.
Not long after Shi Yu returned from the Rainbow Islands, he was quickly sent here to rest.
Moreover, the Immortal Dragon King, Doctor Shell, Doctor Coral, Doctor Water Lady, and the other wet nurses escorted him the whole time.
There was no other way.
Shi Yu was too weak.
No.
It was impossible to describe Shi Yu’s current situation.
Not long after Shi Yu finished asking for the life resources, among these sea beast healers, Doctor Shell, Doctor Coral, and Doctor Jellyfish, who could replenish life force… Condensed healing water to heal Shi Yu.
However.
Shi Yu’s body was like a bottomless pit. Although he had efficiently absorbed the healing water, he still looked half dead. It was very scary.
It stunned the three chiefs.
After all, they were overlord-level healers.
As for Shi Yu, he was only a master-level Beast Tamer.
They were even more shocked that Shi Yu
uld actually talk to them in such a serious situation!
How strong was his physical fitness?
It was a pity that the Immortal Dragon King only knew cleansing skills and didn’t know how to replenish life skills. Otherwise, it wanted to test Shi Yu’s limit.
In fact, Shi Yu still acknowledged the healing water skill of the three overlord healers.
The effect of their skills was much stronger than that of the ginseng baby.
At least, the cooldown period for Shi Yu’s super skills was almost reduced again.
This was something Baby Ginseng’s skill couldn’t do at the moment.
Shi Yu estimated that if Baby Ginseng wanted to surpass them, it had to at least reach the monarch level and train its source of life skill to nearly perfect level.
However, at this moment, although the cooldown time for teaching super skills had almost decreased, Shi Yu’s condition was still a little poor.
As the exhaustion this time was too serious, the protective mechanism of his body made it very difficult for him to instantly recover from this huge leap, since that would be dangerous. The closer to recovery, the worse the recovery skill effect. What Shi Yu needed now was the self adjustment process of his body.
After all, be it supplements or skills, or external forces, they couldn’t perfectly transform into the life force Shi Yu needed.
Although Shi Yu felt that he was alright… Since the Dragon Kings wanted him to rest, he decided to rest.
Due to the Poison Dragon incident, the Dragon Palace banquet was postponed for three days.
For the next two days, Shi Yu could rest however he wanted.
The medical team of the entire Dragon Palace City waited on Shi Yu at all times and listened to Shi Yu’s summon.
Shi Yu had also sent several bottles of life-type resources from level six to level eight. Apart from that, there was also the dragon blood of the body strengthening resource.
It could be said that even the little white dragon did not receive such treatment compared to Shi Yu.
“Eh.”
In the independent residence of Green Sky Island, Shi Yu looked at the one drop of level-eight Life Water on the table, ten drops of level-seven Life Water, a hundred level-six Life Water, and a bottle of level-seven Dragon Blood and fell into deep thought.
He felt that with these life resources, he didn’t have to worry about adding a few super skills.
At this moment, Shi Yu really wanted to stay in Dragon Palace City to level up.
After all, there were overlord-level nannies here. It was much better than a ginseng baby.
But soon, he shook his head. The National League was still the most important!
Number five had already joined the team, and number six, the mechanical pet, was still waiting for him!
Moreover, Dong Huang was definitely not at ease to leave him in Dragon Palace City for a long time. Compared to Dragon Palace City, Dong Huang definitely wanted to invest in the growth of the Blue Sea Sprite more.
If it was said that befriending Dragon Palace City only allowed the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang to travel freely in the sea area of the East Sea.
If they could befriend the complete Blue Sea Sprite, it meant that the entire sea could be traveled without any obstacles.
This was very important for the development of a country. Conquering the sea meant that it could freely carry out worldwide trade and make the country stronger.
“I feel that I’m already very strong now.”
At that moment, Shi Yu did not use these resources immediately. It was mainly because he felt that it was a waste to use them now that he had no use for them.
He clenched his fist and felt the physical strength after recovering this time. He sighed.
“Eleven!”
Shi Yu summoned Eleven and said, “Bean bears!”
Eleven: Wu Wu wu??
Was he going to hit them again?
“I’m just checking my current physical strength.”
“Wuu…”
A moment later, a commander-level Bean Bear was summoned by Eleven.
The confused and cute Bean Bear used the Hardening skill to equip its entire body.
Then.
A fist that swept the wind landed on it.
Click.
A moment later, the hardened armor on the bear collapsed. With a bang, the bear was sent flying by Shi Yu. Its body distorted and it turned back into a metal bean.
“Wu Wu Wu!!” Eleven had tears in its eyes and quickly picked up the poor Bean Bear.
After all, it was metal that fell from its body. It was nothing when it sacrificed itself, but it hurt to give Shi Yu a sandbag to test his strength.
“As for me now… My normal battle power should be equivalent to a relatively weak commander-level ferocious beast, right? Even if the other party uses a skill!” Shi Yu looked at his swollen fist and muttered to himself.
Great.
He set a small goal and strived to wreck the Bean Bear that used its full battle power as soon as possible.
After all, the stronger his normal battle power was, the stronger the template of Sword God Shi Yu after possessing Chi Tong. He would put aside how much attack power he could increase first. It was mainly to increase his resistance to attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 2 Treasure of Dragon Palace City (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 282 Treasure of Dragon Palace City (1)
Shi Yu had never been beaten up in the possession state, but he had to prepare for everything
“Cough.”
Just as he finished testing his strength, Shi Yu felt his body hurt. He hurriedly called Baby Ginseng out to continue healing himself.
“Yi…”
A moment later, Baby Ginseng sighed as it rubbed Shi Yu’s fist.
He still wanted to bully Bean Bear before his body recovered. This was karma…
“Wuu!” Eleven nodded while fixing the beans. That’s right. “What else? Don’t tell me I should test it on Susu?” Eleven, Baby Ginseng:??? Wasn’t hitting a water slime even more cruel!
It would turn into mud in an instant…
Put away those cruel thoughts! “Eh.”
Suddenly, Shi Yu, who was sitting on the bed, said, “How should I put it? I suddenly have a bold idea.” “Wu?” “Yi?”
Eleven and Baby Ginseng revealed puzzled expressions and looked at Shi Yu. Did he really want to hit the slime… “Obviously not,” Shi Yu said. “Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, come out.” Shi Yu also summoned the other three pets.
Buggy and Chi Tong were alright.
After Susu was summoned by Shi Yu this time, it stared at Shi Yu with its round eyes.
“Heh.” Shi Yu also smiled at it.
“Susu, look at this.”
Shi Yu took out the female armor that Ice Dragon had given to General Mu Huiyin.
[Name]: Gemini Silver Armor (Status: Broken)
[Level]: Level 6 (Perfect State: Legendary Level)
< Introduction > It’s a broken level-nine armor that contains strong power of the sun and moon. It can perfectly coordinate the power of the intersection.
“Ning?” Susu looked at the armor and was confused.
Was it food?
“This… can’t be eaten for the time being.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Use the elementalization ability to cooperate with the control of the water element and transform into a human form. Wear this armor. Then, Chi Tong, possess Susu and fuse fire and water!!”
“Buggy, materialize a phantom of General Mu Huiyin for Susu and let it see General Mu Huiyin’s size.”
“Wu Wu Wu Wu… (Wait, wait a minute?)” Buggy’s eyes were filled with tears. Didn’t they agree to let it use the [Ice Dragon General Rebirth Combination Tactic] with Chi Tong?
Why did it become a tool worm again with the Water Slime?
“It must be that water and fire are more compatible with the intersection power.” Shi Yu touched his chin.
“And I reckon that Chi Tong definitely likes Susu more than your phantom.”
Soon, under Shi Yu’s arrangements, Susu turned into the water-element form and wore the Gemini Silver Armor.
Because it was water element, it could freely adjust its size. At this moment, it perfectly loaded its equipment without any resistance.
Shi Yu and the others looked at the Water Element General in front of them eagerly and observed silently.
“Susu, use the water element to control the nature of the ice and turn yourself a little cold.”
“Ning.” Susu obeyed. The next moment, this Water Element General emitted a cold aura.
“Mi!!” In mid-air, the little sword spirit Chi Tong’s eyes instantly lit up like a female pervert.
Susu, come over here~
“Ning??” “Possession,” Shi Yu said.
In the next moment, the little sword spirit possessed the Water Element General. The moment the two came into contact, the blue and red light on their bodies immediately flourished. Under the light, a taiji pattern formed by water and fire appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others. With a roar, Chi Tong and Susu’s fusion seemed to have undergone a qualitative change. In front of Shi Yu, the change in their energy value increased rapidly!
Boom!!!
A moment later, a Water Element General with red hair and eyes appeared in front of Shi Yu with a flaming sword in hand.
Energy Points: 2.4 million
“Ning Mi.” The Water Element General, who was even taller than Shi Yu, let out a voice and looked at its state in surprise.
At this moment, Shi Yu blinked.
He looked at Chi Tong and Susu’s new forms in surprise.
Holy shit.
It was really feasible.
Its energy level was much higher than Chi Tong’s possession of his body.
2.4 million.
After all, their energy values added together were less than 240,000, and they were both commander rank!
Although it was thanks to Mu Huiyin’s armor, it was impossible for Shi Yu to wear it at all. Therefore, the possession effect was undoubtedly strong.
Generally speaking, the best possession target for undead was the Beast Tamer who contracted it. Even if Chi Tong possessed Eleven and Buggy’s illusions and ginseng baby… The enhancement from possessing Shi Yu would definitely be better. But now, because of the exclusive equipment, Mu Huiyin’s armor, Chi Tong temporarily had a more perfect possession target. The combination of Chi Tong and Susu directly maximized the effect of Mu Huiyin’s armor!
Now, they were all commander rank. When they all broke through to the monarch rank and combined, how strong would their strength be?
Although it might not be as ridiculous as ten times the increase, it probably wasn’t a problem to crush Eleven even at its full strength.
[Eleven:??]
“Wuwuwu.” Buggy also sensed the power of Chi Tong and Susu after using the equipment. It wiped its tears. As it said, equipment was the most important element in battle power!
It was quite strong itself with the Ice Dragon Whiskers, Sea Dragon Scale, and Tyrant Dragon Fang. In fact, it recommended that the equipment system be permanent! “Yi…” Baby Ginseng looked at the combination of Chi Tong and Susu in envy.
Why didn’t it have such a perfect pair?
Baby Ginseng had a bitter expression. If a pet partner fought with it, the pet would probably want to eat it and become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - Treasure of Dragon Palace City (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 283 Treasure of Dragon Palace City (3)
It was fine without a partner!
A moment later, Chi Tong and Susu removed their possession states.
Chi Tong returned to its sword spirit form, while Susu returned to its water slime form.
After recovering this time, the way Chi Tong looked at Susu changed.
So springy, so cold, so soft!
It suddenly liked this little slime that joined the team later.
“Ning!” At this moment, Susu was also very surprised by the change in its strength just now.
It felt that even if it defeated the Sludge Dragon that invaded Qishui Island, it wouldn’t be difficult!
It looked at Chi Tong, and its gaze changed.
Good sister!
“Ning!”
“Mi!”
A moment later, the two good sisters stuck together to exchange possession experience and combination skills.
Shi Yu, who had newly developed a dual battle strategy with extremely strong potential, was lamenting. As expected of himself. He had finally thrown out the hot potato Mu Huiyin’s armor, saving Little Chi Tong from thinking about letting him wear it every day.
As for Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, they sighed at the side. Damn it.
A new generation replaced the old.
The classic Wuji Airlines, Yiji Oneshot, and Yiji Array Bombardment strategy were completely gone. It was completely different from the gorgeous tactics of these newbies.
“Lord Shi Yu.”
“Lord Shi Yu, are you there!!”
Just as Shi Yu and the others were accompanying Susu to test the new strategy and taking the opportunity to quickly integrate it into the team, in the outside world, Prime Minister Turtle came again.
“What’s wrong, Prime Minister Turtle?”
After throwing the pets to the ruins to mess around, he directly invited the walking Turtle Minister in.
Although this Turtle Minister was only at the monarch level and his will level was only extremely low, his energy level was terrifyingly high. It was a total of 9,960,000, making Shi Yu very confused.
This was already much higher than the fused Gao Xuan.
In other words, this seemingly frivolous prime minister was a super expert!
He now suspected how many years this turtle prime minister had lived.
If it had lived for hundreds of years, it might have eaten countless treasures in Dragon Palace City during this period.
Otherwise, this energy value would definitely be unscientific.
“Lord Shi Yu, I found a few treasures of high quality but low level that you mentioned from the treasure vault. Please take a look and see if there are any that Lord Blue Sea Sprite needs.”
“Apart from water-element resources, there are other types of resources on it. Take a look.”
The Turtle Minister handed over a book.
The portraits and information of the booklet were all just made with ink.
The meaning of high quality and low level was very easy to understand.
For example, the nutritional fruit created by the ginseng baby was limited by its growth level. After overdrafting its strength to create it with all its might, the energy level was only level 4. However, because its nutritional supplement skill had been maxed out, the quality of the nutritional fruit created was very high.
This was high quality and low level.
Similarly, the Dragon Ball that Buggy absorbed came from the Demigod-level Sea Serpent. At the start, it was a proper legendary-level resource, a level-nine resource. But because of the erosion of time, its energy flowed away and dried up, and the energy level decreased to level four. However, because it was the Dragon God’s Dragon Ball, the quality was definitely ridiculously high, not something other level-four resources could compare to. There was also the Mu Huiyin Armor gifted by Ice Dragon. They were both high quality and low-level examples.
Now, if Shi Yu wanted Susu’s race level to improve, apart from waiting for the Blue Sea inheritance, he could only find similar resources.
After all, the level of the resource was too high. It was limited by its growth level, and it couldn’t devour or digest it.
“Sorry to trouble you, Prime Minister Turtle.” Shi Yu took the booklet and looked at them one by one without holding back.
He didn’t dislike being invested in. In all of Dong Huang, which one of the five major financial groups didn’t pull in investments everywhere when it came to powerful and high potential people? In all of history, there wasn’t a single expert who had never accepted an investment. Now, he had to accept more investment. When he grew up in the future, he just had to double the amount. This was also the goal of all the investors. The current investment was for the greater return in the future.
Shi Yu was currently lacking resources. It would be a waste not to.
Making friends and investing everywhere was the fastest way to become stronger!
Of course, he accepted it so readily because Shi Yu knew that he had the ability to repay in the future. Others also knew that clearly, if he didn’t have the potential, he might not necessarily be able to obtain this investment.
Tears of Mermaids.
This was a gem-shaped resource. The gem cat would likely be overjoyed.
Blackwater Pearl.
It was about the same. The gem cat would be ecstatic.
Coral Spirit, million-year-old tortoise shell… Shi Yu looked down one after another and realized that Dragon Palace City was really rich. Perhaps, this might not necessarily be all the collections of Dragon Palace City, but only the personal collection of the Sea Dragon King. Was this the wealth of a totem-level dragon?
“Wu…”
A moment later, Shi Yu aimed at a resource that looked more suitable.
< Name > Dead Fire Sea
(Level): Level 5
< Introduction > When the surface of the lava rock erupted by the underwater volcano was quickly cooled by the seawater, under the interweaving of the extremely hot and extremely cold states, an elemental sprite of an overlord race was born. However, just as it was born, it immediately died because of the surrounding harsh environment. Only the elemental core was preserved.
Shi Yu : “…”
Damn, unlucky child.
Therefore, it was called the Dead Fire Sea?
After Shi Yu saw this, he immediately thought of the combination strategy that Susu and Chi Tong had just researched. Susu undoubtedly represented extreme coldness, and Chi Tong undoubtedly represented extreme heat. Their strength could perfectly display the effect of the Interlocking Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - Treasure of Dragon Palace City (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 284 Treasure of Dragon Palace City (4)
But clearly, the two of them used the Interlocking Sword and Chi Tong as the tactical core.
This Dead Sea Fire looked a little interesting. He wondered if Susu could evolve any skills that were better suited to the extremely hot power after devouring this to turn their combination battle strategy into a dual-core system.
In addition, this level wasn’t high either…
Shi Yu continued watching, but there weren’t that many resources that were perfectly compatible. He had flipped through a lot, but he only found Dead Fire Sea interesting. As for the others, it wasn’t that he couldn’t devour them, but the randomness was too strong. The skills might not be of much value.
“Huh??”
Suddenly, Shi Yu flipped to the back and discovered a strange portrait.
This was… a goat horn?
No!
[Name]: Kirin Horn fossil
(Level]: None
< Introduction > It’s suspected to be a Mythical creature, a fossil of the divine beast, the Wind Kirin.
“Holy shit,” Shi Yu exclaimed.
“Oooh.” The Turtle Minister was shocked. “F*ck, f*ck, f*ck, f*ck.” Shi Yu exclaimed in succession. “Prime Minister Turtle, this fossil… is this serious?”
“Mythical creature’s fossil?? Are you kidding?”
“Ah… That fossil is indeed suspected to be the fossil of the Mythical creature, the Wind Kirin. In the beginning, it might even be a Mythical resource,” the Turtle Prime Minister said.
“It was obtained from the Dragon God Ruins by a certain generation of the Dragon God hundreds of millions of years ago. It’s said that at the beginning, its energy level was close to a level-ten Mythical resource.”
“But the problem is that although the energy level is very strong, this fossil has almost no effect. It’s just that the pure energy is strong, and it’s useless…”
“In the end, it was collected by Dragon Palace City for generations. Then, it was still useless. It has been tossed around until now. Well, it landed in the hands of Lord Azure Dragon King. Its energy level has also fallen to level zero under the erosion of hundreds of millions of years. There’s no longer any energy wave.”
“But because its origin is really not simple… no Dragon King wants to throw it away.”
Shi Yu stared intently at the goat horn on the manual. Ah, no, the Kirin Horn image.
Fossil!!!
Moreover, it was a fossil of a Mythical creature?!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart thumped. The first thing he thought of was not to let Susu devour it.
Instead… Dream stealing, and materializing the divine beast, the Wind Kirin, even if it was just an illusion with just one hundred millionth of its power!
Then, with the mythical beast phantom as the template, he would create the sixth mechanical
pet!
Initially, his goal was an ancient species like the Tyrant Dragon, but now, he had actually discovered a fossil suspected to be from the Mythical Era??
Damn it, why would he want an ancient seed? He should just use a divine beast to make machinery.
Mecha Kirin, super battleship Kirin!
Of course, the premise was that… this thing had a dream world that he and Buggy could enter and replicate it.
But no matter what, Shi Yu was completely attracted by this Kirin Horn fossil.
“Prime Minister Turtle, can we also choose this fossil?” Shi Yu asked.
“Of course. Lord Sea Dragon King, Lord Azure Dragon King, and Lord Immortal Dragon King said that you can choose whatever you want!” it said.
“But Lord Shi Yu, are you sure you want this… The Dragon King has studied this for many generations of Dragon Gods. It’s basically useless…”
“I’m thinking about it,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright… By the way,” the Turtle Prime Minister reminded. “Lord Sea Dragon King also said that you should go to the treasure vault to choose a few more resources to use as a reward for the Dragon Palace banquet the day after tomorrow.”
“Huh?”
“At the Dragon Palace banquet, many overlords will take out some resources as a reward and let the juniors of Dragon Palace City compete and compete at the banquet. When the time comes, you and Lord Ice Dragon King will also attend the banquet as the core upper echelons of Dragon Palace City. I wonder if you plan to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet?”
“According to the Sea Dragon King, taking out some resources to greet the juniors of Dragon Palace City is also a good choice. It can provide resources.”
Shi Yu : “…”
Good lord, as the minister of the Environmental Protection Department, could he use the rewards to oversee those young overlords, young monarchs, and even Heavenly King Zou, Senior Bai, Yin Zhengfan, and the others??
Ah, this.
“Cough, there’s no need for that. Let me see. As a reward resource, I should have…”
Shi Yu felt that it was better not to trouble the Sea Dragon King about this kind of thing. Why don’t he use the Time Fruit to tempt those overlord cubs? Especially for dragons with slow growth, the Time Fruit, a time-element treasure that temporarily obtained a higher realm, should still be very valuable…

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - Slime vs Little White Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 285 Slime vs Little White Dragon
In the end, Shi Yu chose four of the resources.
After Shi Yu finished choosing, Prime Minister Turtle took leave.
Soon, the gem cat circled Dragon Palace City and returned to Shi Yu.
“Ha ~” The gem cat yawned and entered. It saw Shi Yu, who was recuperating. “Eh, your hair turned black?”
As soon as it entered, it discovered Shi Yu’s change. “Has it turned black?”
Shi Yu was also stunned. Then, he smiled and said, “Perhaps because I’m in a good mood.”
The gem cat curled its lips. Changing hair color depending on the mood? What was this guy talking about.
“Where’s the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite?”
“I brought it delicious food. Let me see it again,” the gem cat urged.
Not only Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang, even the cat wanted to build a good relationship with the Blue Sea Sprite before it grew up. “Uh, it’s training with Eleven and the others…” Shi Yu looked.
“What???” The gem cat was immediately shocked.
Gem Cat: w (A) w
“You won’t let a Slime do such cruel training in your team for some overlord’s will, right?”
The gem cat immediately worried if Shi Yu would play this Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to death.
“Calm down!!”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “The Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation isn’t as weak as you think. When it’s at the transcendent or even the Awakening level, it might have already mastered the overlord’s will. It’s even higher than your will level. There’s no need to train at all. It’s almost natural.”
“Huh?” The gem cat was stunned.
So rude.
What did it mean that the level of willpower was higher than its?
Since when did it not only have to be a battle force unit, but also a willpower unit?
“Then I’ll call it out?” Shi Yu hurriedly changed the topic.
“Yes, yes,” the gem cat urged. Damn it, Shi Yu had completely won this time. “Call Baby Ginseng and the others out too. I’ve also prepared them delicious food.”
Might as well please its companions, after all.
Then, Shi Yu summoned a bunch of pets.
The gem cat immediately acted like a gentle big sister and went to feed all kinds of delicious food brought from Dragon Palace City to Susu.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong also borrowed the love directed at Susu and quickly ate.
“It’s not bad to train hard, but you also have to work and rest them accordingly. Look at how hungry they are,” the gem cat muttered. Shi Yu : “…”
He never starved them before… Even if they were full, they wouldn’t be able to control themselves if this cat took out so many things!
“Where’s Senior Bai and the others?” Shi Yu asked.
“Are they on the island now?”
The gem cat: “I’m not sure… they might be here, or they might have gone to play. I’m not with them.”
“For example, that Heavenly King Zou seemed to have gone straight to Black Flood Dragon Island from the start.” “The banquet is now delayed for three days. I reckon they might not necessarily be able to stay.”
“Oh, oh, I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
Heavenly King Zou knew very well.
Before the Dragon Palace banquet started, he would visit the Black Flood Dragon overlord first. He had a clear goal.
What did it mean to strike first?
What did it mean to be the early worm!
After the others reacted, they realized that there was sufficient time. It was normal for them to go tend to their studies or affairs one by one. “They probably don’t know about the Poison Dragon Totem and me yet, right?” Shi Yu confirmed.
The gem cat said, “I don’t know. Only the totems and a small number of sea beasts who have experienced it personally know about the Poison Dragon Totem. The news is temporarily suppressed.”
“As for your matter… Probably even fewer people know about the Blue Sea Sprite at the moment. Only less than ten people present knew.”
“However, your relationship with Ice Dragon was deduced by Yu Shu and the others.”
“Oh?” Shi Yu revealed a curious expression. “Yu Shu?”
“Yes, after you and Ice Dragon left, he was stunned for a long time before deducing your relationship with Ice Dragon.”
“As expected of the first target Buggy used the Ice Dragon Phantom to torture. He’s indeed talented…” Shi Yu said.
Because Shi Yu had displayed the Ice Dragon Phantom in the vocation assessment, Yu Shu, the descendant of the Dragon Tamer, had investigated Shi Yu.
Connecting Shi Yu’s identity as an archaeologist to the legends of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and Ice Dragon Ruins in Icefield City, it was not difficult to determine that Shi Yu and Ice Dragon might have a relationship. In addition, the old principal of Ancient Capital University was also associated with a guardian through archeology. What else could Yu Shu say? He could only envy Shi Yu and his experience. He was clearly the Dragon Tamer, but Shi Yu, this guy who didn’t even have a dragon tamer family, had a better relationship with dragons than any Dragon Tamer or dragon race. It was unfair…
However, although they guessed that Shi Yu might have met this ice dragon when exploring the Ice Dragon Ruins, the seniority of the ice dragon still shocked Yu Shu and the others. Even the Sea Dragon King who had followed Lin Feng, a legend, called the Ice Dragon Senior… The Ice Dragon followed the Time Emperor. What kind of concept was that? It completely made Yu Shu and the others dizzy. They were even more envious that Shi Yu could cozy up to such a powerful figure.
“I heard that Shi Yu is back!”
Outside Heaven Green Island.
A group of people was flying towards Green Sky Island. At this moment, Yu Shu, White Brook, and the others who had come to visit Dragon Palace City, apart from Heavenly King Zou and the two navy Beast Tamers, were all among them. A little white dragon flew in front of them to lead the way.
1.
Behind the little white dragon, Yu Shu and the others had happy expressions. They also understood the benefits of sucking up to it.
The one they chose to cozy up to was naturally the little white dragon.
As expected, these people weren’t idling on the island.
As Shi Yu, the Ice Dragon, and the Sea Dragon King left, after the little white dragon came to Green Sky Island to look for Shi Yu for the second time without any results, Yu Shu and the others took the opportunity to cozy up to the Third Prince and started to fool around with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - Slime vs Little White Dragon (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 286 Slime vs Little White Dragon (1)
Under the lead of the local dragon, the Third Prince, they went to meet many heirs of overlords and monarchs and became familiar with each other in advance.
ce
“Hehe.” Among them, Yu Shu directly contracted a dragon of a quasi overlord race without waiting for the Dragon Palace banquet to begin. His progress was one step faster than everyone, and he was ecstatic.
“Thank you for the recommendation, Third Prince.” Yu Shu thanked the White Azure Dragon again and again.
“You’re welcome. You’re Senior Shi Yu’s friends, so you’re my friends,” the little white dragon said generously, making Yu Shu tear up.
“I wonder what Shi Yu… will contract in the end,” Yu Shu muttered.
The White Azure Dragon said, “I’ll definitely introduce a better one to Senior Shi Yu! It has to be at least 60% of my quality! Believe in my taste!”
Yu Shu: QAQ is envious.
Soon, everyone returned to Green Sky Island. At the same time, Shi Yu, who had just recovered and eaten a pile of food, was taking Eleven, Susu, and the others for a walk on Sky Green Island to admire the scenery of Dragon Palace City.
After coming to Dragon Palace City with much difficulty, Shi Yu didn’t want Eleven and the others to always just train. It was also very important to broaden their horizons.
The gem cat led the way in front and introduced the situation of Green Sky Island to Shi Yu and the others.
“I don’t know if it’s true. I also heard Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi’s speculation.”
“But you must be interested in this.”
“It’s said that the name of the Green Sky Island is formed using one character from each of the names of the Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor…” The cat lowered its voice.
Shi Yu: “???”
Wait a minute, what kind of tone was that?
Buggy and the others were excited and prepared to listen to gossip.
The gem cat said, “In any case, it’s fine as long as you know the situation is very complicated. It’s said that the Dragon God of this generation in Dragon Palace City is the Dragon Emperor’s soulmate, but he’s restricted by his race. Both parties couldn’t be together at that time. The Dragon God’s race was originally a Heavenly Sea Divine Dragon, but for the Dragon Emperor, it forcefully evolved into the image of a humanoid dragon lady. Unfortunately, the Dragon Emperor is already dead at this time.”
“But it’s said that it’s because of this relationship that Dragon Palace City was not only willing to befriend Dong Huang during its glory days, but even when it was weak, it was also willing to help Dong Huang.” “Really…”
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly. This Dragon Emperor was definitely Long Aotian. It was fine if he fell off the cliff when he was young and obtained the recognition of the Mythical Ruins… Now he suddenly had a partner from another race?
As expected of the legendary emperor with the greatest luck in Dong Huang’s history. “It can’t be fake…”
“Of course, if such a history can’t be verified by the person involved, no one dares to say that it’s true,” the gem cat said. “Just eat up the gossip. Don’t talk nonsense…”
Shi Yu nodded, indicating that he understood…
Something that even Bureau 11’s index didn’t dare to record randomly. Who knew if it was a folk history from somewhere? What, Principal Feng and Senior Lu said it? What they said might not be accurate.
“Wu Hu ~”
Just as Shi Yu was gossiping with the gem cat, a familiar cry came from the sky.
They looked up and saw the White Azure Dragon flying in front of them, rushing over with White Brook, Yu Shu, and the others.
White Brook had huge white wings at this moment, and her hair was still white. Shi Yu knew that this was the combination form of her and another pet. The pet was an immortal feather crane with an outstanding aura.
The others also flew in their own ways, such as Yu Shu still riding the bone dragon.
“Senior Shi Yu, you’re finally back. What exactly were you talking about with my father?”
After the little white dragon came down, it said excitedly.
When Shi Yu saw it like this, he knew that regardless of whether it was the Poison Dragon Totem or the Blue Sea Sprite, the Sea Dragon King had never told it. As expected of this spoiled Third Prince…
“Shi Yu!”
After White Brook and the others landed, they greeted Shi Yu one by one.
Shi Yu looked at the eight people and one dragon and said with a smile, “It’s nothing. I didn’t chat much with the Sea Dragon King. I just passed by an island on the way back and encountered a pet I was very familiar with. I was delayed by the contract.”
“Huh?” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the little white dragon was stunned.
Yu Shu, White Brook, Yin Zhengfan, and the others were also stunned.
“You finished the contract before the Dragon Palace banquet too?” Yu Shu was shocked. “Too?” Shi Yu looked at him. “Under the introduction of the Third Prince, Yu Shu successfully contracted an ancient sea horse called Ancient Sea Dragon,” White Brook said.
White Brook was also very happy. After all, Yu Shu was also from Ancient Capital University. Ancient Sea Dragon+his untamed heroic spirit seed also made him a potential successor for the battle club.
“Heh.” Yu Shu smiled smugly again. The Ancient Sea Dragon was a quasi overlord race, and Yu Shu was already very satisfied.
It was too difficult to have a true overlord’s son. He was only an intermediate Beast Tamer now, so the chances of contracting one were really not high.
Fortunately, the dragon-element evolution resource prepared by his family this time, the Nether Dragon Grass, was a rare commodity. Even in Dragon Palace City, it was a popular item.
Nether Dragon Grass.
Dragon and undead resources.
Its value even exceeded spatial resources of the same level.
It could allow the dragons it consumed to awaken a super-level skill, the Undead Dragon. The Undead Dragon was a super-level clone and evolution skill. Its training exceeded the perfect stage and could allow the user to have a perfect undead clone with comparable battle power. Then, both parties could also undergo a fusion evolution. For those monarch races with only one super skill, this resource was definitely top-notch.
This time, Yu Shu relied on this to deceive a young dragon of a quasi overlord race.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - Slime vs Little White Dragon (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 287 Slime vs Little White Dragon (2)
What luck. He didn’t expect Yu Shu’s mother to be so generous. Using their status as a dragon tamer family, she had paved the way. As expected of an only son, he was much luckier than someone with a bunch of siblings.
Yin Zhengfan, Xia Qingwei, and the others beside him were more or less a little envious.
“Senior Shi Yu, who did you contract? Do I know him?” The white dragon said regretfully. It still wanted to help Shi Yu find a contract.
White Brook, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others also looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
Good lord, Shi Yu was pretty fast.
As expected of a lucky person who had managed to cozy up to the Ice Dragon and Sea Dragon King. He had contracted his favorite pet so quickly.
They estimated that… even if they just made a conservative guess, it had to be a low-level overlord race to be worthy of Shi Yu’s current identity. Only then could Shi Yu take a fancy to them.
“It’s over there.” Shi Yu pointed behind him.
The Third Prince and everyone looked behind Shi Yu.
Well, there was a panda, a butterfly, a sword spirit, and a ginseng baby. What else was there?
Everyone looked carefully and realized that a small water slime was also mixed in.
Everyone couldn’t react for a moment. The little white dragon asked, “Senior Shi Yu, where is it?”
“Susu,” Shi Yu called. The Water Slime standing behind the Iron-eating Beast with Chi Tong immediately bounced forward.
“Ning…” The Water Slime called. “That’s it.” Shi Yu smiled.
As the Water Slime jumped out, the White Azure Dragon, White Brook, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others immediately opened their mouths wide. For a moment, they were even more at a loss. They still didn’t react, unable to understand. “This, this, this is, Water Slime??” The White Azure Dragon was extremely stunned.
“Senior Shi Yu, why did you contract such a thing!” It was quite honest.
Although it felt that this thing was stronger than ordinary Slimes, it was still very weak.
Why would Shi Yu contract it?
Shi Yu had clearly asked it about a bunch of overlord heirs, but in the end… it didn’t choose any.
“Ning???” Susu was stunned when it heard that. Then, her whole body became a water ball.
What did it mean “such a thing’!
It wanted to ask Shi Yu if it could punch this
guy!
The gem cat was also stunned. Good lord, even its father didn’t dare to talk to it like this. It was so brave. Wasn’t it afraid its father would beat it up?
“It’s not an ordinary Slime. Little White, you might not necessarily be able to defeat it, and your potential might not necessarily be stronger than it,” Shi Yu said with a smile and ill intentions.
“Uh??” The Third Prince was stunned.
“How is that possible? Hahahaha.”
“Senior Shi Yu, what are you saying? I’m inferior to a Slime?”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong looked up. Did it think it was very strong?
The Third Prince’s smile stopped.
However, it still shook its head suddenly. It couldn’t believe it. When it came to Iron-eating Beasts, Butterfly of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, and this Sword Spirit… It had lived in Dragon Palace City since it was young and didn’t understand it at all. However, things like Water Slimes were too common in the ocean and too common in Dragon Palace City. They were basically equivalent to the Green Silkworm in the forest on the ground. They were completely not worth mentioning compared to powerful sea beasts.
If it was told that it was inferior to a slime, it wouldn’t believe it even if it was beaten to death!
“Come, little guy, attack and take a look. Look here.” The Third Prince stretched out its face and pointed at itself with his claws, saying softly to Susu.
“Ning??” Susu was stunned. She had never seen such a request.
However, it was exactly what it wanted.
In the next moment, it enlarged.
[Activating the devoured ‘Time Fruit’. Transformation successful.]
Susu had once eaten the Time Fruit in the ruins space. Although it couldn’t transform the Time Fruit into a permanent racial skill, with the Infinite Devouring Space, it was the most effective pet in Shi Yu’s team apart from Baby Ginseng
Although it was only a monarch race, with the will of an overlord, it was also fine to say that it had the potential of an overlord. In addition to the transformation effect of Infinite Devouring… At this moment, through the Time Fruit stored in its body using the Infinite Devouring skill, it directly activated most of its potential with the overlord’s will and the Time Fruit. Its energy value instantly increased from 40,000 to more than a million.
Boom!
A shocking monarch deterrence erupted from the Little Slime’s body along with the mist that filled the sky. It opened its mouth wide. Under the confused expressions of the White Azure Dragon, White Brook, and the others, strong water instantly condensed and compressed in its mouth.
“Holy shit, monarch level.” At the same time, Yu Shu and the others were immediately stunned when they sensed the monarch aura emitted by the slime.
Damn, a Slime of an extraordinary race had reached the level of a monarch?
The Slime roared!
Water Elemental Control, Water Dragon Ball!
“Roar!!!!” As the water compressed in Susu’s mouth, a water dragon that seemed to have been condensed from the water of a bottomless lake suddenly formed. The water dragon bared its fangs and brandished its claws, wrapped in a blue halo. With a roar, under the little white dragon’s stunned expression, it smashed onto its body with a bang!
With a loud bang! Accompanied by a huge impact, the little white dragon’s “fragile” body was directly pushed away suddenly. It was instantly smashed dozens of meters away, and then its entire body hit a small mountain by the river with a bang.
Click.
The mountain shattered, and the little white dragon that was sent flying into the mountain wall felt the pain in its body and opened its mouth wide.
What happened just now? Who was it? Where was it? What was it?
“Roar?? (Monarch level… Slime?)” At this moment, seeing a Water Slime that should only know how to multiply and bubble control the water flow so perfectly, with its own body that had even reached the ridiculous monarch level… Yin Zhengfan, Yu Shu, and the others widened their eyes in confusion as they looked at the little white dragon that was miserably sent flying.
They then looked at Shi Yu, who had an innocent expression as he scratched his cheek and tilted his head.
“I already said that my Slime Susu is very strong.”
ILII
Damn, you call this a Slime?
A moment later, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others reacted.
Third Prince!!!
They forgot to tell it that every pet Shi Yu contracted was not scientific! That was definitely not a water slime. It was definitely a deep sea ferocious beast wearing a slime skin!!

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - The Owl Broke Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 288 The Owl Broke Through
Green Sky Island.
Beside the river.
The little white dragon flew up slightly with a look of disbelief.
It looked at the Water Slime on the shore in confusion and then at Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the other big shots who didn’t find it strange at all. It fell into deep thought.
For a moment, the little white dragon actually started to feel that this world was unreal.
Especially when it saw White Brook, Yu Shu, and the others silent and doubtful gazes, it wanted to cover its mouth and cry.
No, something was wrong. How could a Slime reach the monarch level? Commander level… No, even transcendent level was difficult, alright?
“Impossible!”
“How can a slime be so strong!”
“Try again. This time, it’s my turn to attack!”
The little white dragon’s defense was broken.
It didn’t look very smart.
“Because it’s not an ordinary slime, but a mutated slime…” Shi Yu explained in all seriousness.
No one wanted to hear this explanation!
No one would believe Shi Yu!
Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others looked at Shi Yu and thought in all seriousness, feeling even more like complaining.
How exactly did he manage to contract some strange pets that were so strong!
At the start, the Iron-eating Beast, the Green Silkworm, the Ginseng Baby, and now the Water Slime, could he choose some pets with matching races and strength!
“Ning!! (You attack, then!)” At that moment, Susu looked at the white dragon without any fear.
Not to mention that its strength had been increased by the Time Fruit, even at the Awakening level, it was not afraid of experts at all.
At Qishui Island, if it weren’t for the Cleansing Water Sprite King stopping it, it would even dare to fight the monarch-level Sludge Dragon!
There was a reason why it died so many times and didn’t grow up.
“Let me try…” The White Azure Dragon still muttered in disbelief.
It was mainly because if it didn’t defeat Susu, it would lose all its face!
He had to win!
“Roar…” In an instant, the little white dragon’s aura rose steadily. The substantialized deterrence spread out. Under Shi Yu’s gaze, its energy level actually began to increase through special super skills.
Almost instantly, the little white dragon’s eyes filled with purple light.
Dragon Race Secret Art! Dragon God Possession!
However.
Just a few seconds after the little white dragon increased its strength to Susu, something came from the sky! “Idiot!!! Stop!!!”
With a shout, a mysterious object that looked like an extraterrestrial flying saucer flew over from the horizon, sweeping up strong water currents and hitting the little white dragon’s face with a bang.
“Uh…” The little white dragon’s eyes moved. Before its face turned, its face was instantly distorted by the impact. Its eyes popped out, and then its eyes rolled back. It was sent flying again, leaving the UFO spinning on the spot for a moment before suddenly stopping, turning into a majestic old turtle.
The tortoise prime minister glanced at the little white dragon that was sent flying by him and then at the unscathed Susu, immediately heaving a sigh of relief.
It looked at the innocent-looking Susu and the group of people with their mouths agape, making it even more incomprehensible. Then, it looked at Susu with a fawning expression.
“Lord, you’re not injured, right? This brat doesn’t know the height of the sky and the depth of the earth, it’s got no manners. I’ve already taught it a lesson for you. Don’t take it to heart, hahahaha,” the Turtle Minister rubbed its turtle hand and said to Susu.
“Holy shit.”
“It’s even harder for me to think.”
The Dragonman, the mechanical man, the blue-haired girl, and the others were all stunned.
White Brook, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others were stunned for a moment before looking surprisingly calm. Could they say that they were already used to this unconventional magical reality? “It’s alright… friendly spar… friendly spar… Prime Minister Turtle, what’s wrong?” Shi Yu looked at the Turtle Prime Minister and the little white dragon flying far away in shame.
The status of the Turtle Prime Minister was higher than he imagined. It actually dared to hit the Third Prince.
“Lord Shi Yu, I’ve brought the resources. Fast enough, right?” The Turtle Prime Minister took out a big box from his four dimensional tortoise shell.
“Ah, this, this.” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. It was super fast.
It had not even been an hour.
Who said turtle speed was slow? This was clearly a flying saucer!
“Then let’s go.” Shi Yu immediately wanted to open the box with the Turtle Prime Minister.
“The resources are for you. The Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King are looking for the Third Prince. I want to bring it over immediately…” The Turtle Prime Minister said dutifully.
“That works too…” Shi Yu nodded. He suddenly felt that the Third Prince’s trip was a little dangerous.
A moment later, the Turtle Minister pulled the white dragon with stars in its eyes and flew into the sky, leaving Yu Shu and the others looking at Shi Yu in silence.
“Yes.” Shi Yu waved his hand and put the resources back into the ruins space.
Then, he grinned at White Brook and the others and smiled. “It’s too troublesome to explain. Senior White, I still have something to do. You guys play first.”
With that said, under Shi Yu’s farewell, Buggy teleported and immediately sent them back to their residence.
“Teacher Ying…” White Brook looked at the gem cat, wanting to obtain some explanation from it.
The gem cat elegantly passed by them. It sensed White Brook’s messy gaze and said, “Don’t ask. If you ask, the water is too deep. Figure it out yourself!”
Then, it also left with an Instant Transmission.
Everyone : “…”
This further confirmed everyone’s guess that it was a deep-sea ferocious beast wearing the skin of a slime…
“I don’t understand!”
“It’s useless even if you don’t understand. The difference between people is sometimes greater than the difference between the White Azure Dragon and the Slime.”
At the residence.
With the joy of opening the box, Shi Yu opened the four resources sent by the Turtle Prime Minister.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - The Owl Broke Through (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 289 The Owl Broke Through (1)
Tears of Mermaids!
Sea of Fire Sprite Core!
A million-year-old turtle shell!
Kirin Horn fossil!
In the end, Shi Yu chose the four resources that were more compatible.
It was mainly because it was too time-consuming for him to analyze other resources. It might not necessarily be compatible with Susu if he awakened new skills.
First, Tears of Mermaids.
Although it was called the Tears of the Mermaid, it wasn’t the Tears of the Mermaid.
It was the final crystal formed after a mermaid sacrificed herself.
It was said that mermaids were the beloved of the sea. When they shed tears in the most desperate moment, the sea and the sky would also cry, forming a weeping phenomenon. A sea in the sky would appear, causing a storm. At that time, after the mermaid sacrificed herself, she would turn into an ethereal water vapor and become a “fish that soared in the sky”, perfectly controlling the sky. The Mermaid’s Tears were the power crystals left behind at that time.
There was naturally no need to talk about the elemental core of the Sea Flame Sprite. Due to the birth of high temperature and extreme cold, Shi Yu wanted to bet on whether this could create a combination skill suitable for Susu and Chi Tong.
As for the million-year-old shell, it had actually been modified.
What modified it was the great-grandmother of all the Turtle Ministers in Dragon Palace City. It was a totem-level old turtle. It used a super skill to modify the shell into several protective shells and gave them to a junior. It once had the effect of protecting itself.
Including the Kirin Horn fossil.
These were all resources of ridiculously high levels and quality.
But as time passed, among these resources, the current highest-level Sea of Fire Sprite core was only level five.
The Mermaid’s Tear and the million-year-old turtle shell were only level three.
This was pretty good, just what Shi Yu wanted.
Compared to this, the other resources’ levels were still a little higher. Swallowing it was a waste of time to digest it, delaying the increase in points. Shi Yu planned to find more suitable resources after returning to Dong Huang. “Susu -“
Susu: (..’yo)
“Ning! (Here!)”
Seeing that Shi Yu had gathered new resources, Susu was very surprised.
It could devour stuff again.
It liked that it could become stronger through devouring “Yi!” “Wu!” “Mi!”
Seeing that Susu, who had the will of an overlord, didn’t mind reaping the benefits without sowing, Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and Chi Tong started to stare at Eleven. Look, this meant that adding points might not necessarily corrode the heart.
Who said that strength and willpower needed to be trained hard?
Eleven: …
Eleven turned around stubbornly and silently did push-ups… “Wuu!!!”
Soon.
Susu’s entire body turned into a black hole, directly swallowing the mermaid tear that Shi Yu had picked out like a transparent crystal.
After devouring it this time, Susu didn’t immediately evolve, unlike eating digestive food like the nutritional fruit to awaken new racial skills.
Because the quality of the devouring item was too high, it instantly felt sleepy.
(Devour successful, digestion…)
It looked reluctantly at the huge white turtle shell, the blue and red intertwined core of the Sea Flame Sprite that was like a pebble.
“Stop looking.”
“Devouring and sleeping are more compatible.” Shi Yu flipped his hand and gave Absolute Sleep for Susu to devour in peace.
“One by one. You can’t just gobble up hot stuff without taking your time!”
“Ning!!”
Susu was stunned.
It realized that it had suddenly learned a new skill. Just like the last time when it learned Infinite Devour, it immediately looked at Shi Yu in extreme joy and nodded hard.
“Sleep,” Shi Yu continued. “Ning…” A moment later, Susu was taken back into the Beast Taming Space in Shi Yu’s palm and fell asleep in peace. Susu’s sleeping posture made Eleven and the others reveal envious expressions.
Infinite Devour was a good skill!
Water was so good…
It could actually learn such a powerful skill.
It could evolve by devouring resources… There was no restriction on types, even living creatures…
They also wanted to become water-element creatures.
“Not only that… I originally thought that Chi Tong and fire-element was a perfect match…” Shi Yu said.” But from the looks of it… water-element is.”
Chi Tong: (*+_+*)~
Because…
Skill: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy
[Skill Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a dual skill of ice and time. It’s a special ice-type power. After mastering it, you can transform your ice-type power into Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that can freeze time.
Not only could she learn the cheat skill Infinite Devour, but even the abnormal ice-type skill copied from Dragon Mother was suitable for teaching
Thinking about it carefully, it made sense. Now that Susu had mastered the control of the water element… Let alone the liquid state, now she could also freely transform fixed ice and gaseous water vapor. The ice and water elements were not separated in the first place.
