In addition, Susu had been reincarnated for hundreds of millions of years, so it was understandable that it had a high compatibility with the time element. Perhaps it used a time skill to reincarnate.
“Don’t worry, it’s good for Susu ~” Shi Yu chuckled and said to Chi Tong, “The Frost General that can freeze time is definitely a better target for you to possess… It’s a perfect match.”
“Mi ~” Chi Tong’s eyes lit up.
“Ah…” However, Shi Yu was suddenly very worried. This was because he really didn’t want to try the feeling of teaching super skills a second time. The feeling of his life being taken away and his vitality flowing kept giving him the illusion that he might be the first to learn the overlord’s will before Eleven and the others.
“In short, forget about Susu. Come and see the Kirin horn fossil…”
“Buggy, everything depends on you…”

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - he Owl Broke Through (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 290 The Owl Broke Through (2)
An hour later.
Shi Yu and Buggy looked at the motionless white Kirin horn fossil with bloodshot eyes. Their patience was gradually worn out…
At the same time, everyone in Dragon Palace City was taking action.
Dragon Palace City, Sea Dragon King Mystic Realm.
The little white dragon was being beaten by the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King.
It let out a painful howl.
“Wuu, wuu, wuu, wuu!!”
Beside him, the Turtle Prime Minister, who had watched for a long time, wiped its sweat. It felt like it had betrayed the prince.
“This is the North Wind Crystal.”
After beating up the disobedient little white dragon, the Azure Dragon King gave the little white dragon an extremely rare resource.
“It can let you master the power of wind purification. If you still want to be a Third Prince, go to the Dragon Palace banquet the day after tomorrow and join the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City.” “Before that, apologize to Lord Blue Sea Sprite!”
“I know!!!” The Third Prince’s eyes were filled with tears.
Howl! Why did a Slime become a Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation!
Shi Yu tricked it!
However, from a different perspective, Shi Yu was so awesome!
Instantly, the Third Prince worshiped Shi Yu even more. After laying the path for the Third Crown Prince, the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King were tired. Since the little white dragon was unwilling to follow a Beast Tamer, following the Blue Sea Sprite was not a bad choice.
In any case, the Blue Sea Sprite probably wouldn’t be able to follow Shi Yu for long. At that time, the sea would be the true home of the Blue Sea Sprite.
After befriending the Blue Sea Sprite, perhaps the little white dragon in the future would also have a chance to compete for the position of the Dragon God with the heirs of other Dragon Kings?
“I’ll give you another mission. After the Dragon Palace banquet, follow your Uncle Hei Ge to help recover the Rainbow Islands and integrate that place into the Dragon Palace City.”
“I understand…” The Third Prince held its sore buttocks and felt like he had nothing to live for.
After kicking the Third Prince and the Turtle Prime Minister out, the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King started chatting.
“Has Lord Dragon God awakened?”
“I’ve already called, but there are no signs of awakening.” “Sigh, then let’s carry out the Dragon Palace banquet according to our previous preparations,” said the Sea Dragon King. “Alright. Right, did that little guy only take four resources?” the Azure Dragon King suddenly asked.
“Yeah,” the Sea Dragon King said. “Why is he only taking so little?”
“I clearly told Prime Minister Turtle to ask him to take more.”
“This is also convenient for him to recruit new people at the Dragon Palace banquet.”
At this moment, in the Sea Dragon King’s eyes, the nature of the Dragon Palace banquet had changed.
Human geniuses and overlord heirs meeting?
The exhibition of his heirs? Pleasing, binding the Blue Sea Sprite, the recruitment meeting of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City… That was the focus now!
The Sea Dragon King’s idea was to provide Shi Yu with resources and let Shi Yu use these resources as a temptation to recruit new members for the Ministry of Environment and expand the influence of the Ministry of Environment.
However, Shi Yu directly rejected it… At that time, without the resource reward, they couldn’t use just the name of the Blue Sea Sprite to recruit new people, right? Before the Dragon God woke up, they didn’t dare to casually spread the news that the Blue Sea Sprite had appeared in Dragon Palace City. After all, the Blue Sea Sprite had many enemies.
Countless years ago, the sea in the west was called the Abyss Sea. The sea was dark and bloody, and all the sea beasts were infected and turned into monsters.
Although it was later purified by the Blue Sea Sprite and the sea returned to calm, the power of the Abyss Sea had never been severed. After all, it was a heritage from the Mythical Era just like Dragon Palace City. “Forget it, let them be. Let’s see the situation when the time comes. If Shi Yu and the others can’t produce a decent reward, it won’t be too late for us to provide it,” the Sea Dragon King said.
At this moment, the various factions in Dragon Palace City were waiting for the Dragon Palace banquet the day after tomorrow.
Ice Dragon had already moved the Ice Dragon Ruins into Dragon Palace City and was slowly renovating its new home.
Its good friend, the gem cat, gave Ice Dragon advice while eating and drinking. It was envious of Ice Dragon’s totem level life. When could it have totem power? At that time, it could upgrade from the guardian of Ancient Capital University to the guardian of Dong Huang! The treatment would be super doubled!
On the other side, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was quietly guarding Heaven Green Island, protecting Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite. Everything seemed calm, but at this moment, a huge commotion had already been raised on land. Dong Huang, Imperial Capital, Imperial Capital University.
“Ahhhhh!!!”
“Wu Wu Wu Wu Wu Wu Wu!!!”
“Awesome.”
“You called me over just to see this?” Principal Feng of Ancient Capital University looked at the crazy Prediction Owl with a stunned expression.
“No…” President Ye and the principal of Imperial Capital University were extremely silent.
“It’s that Senior Owl… broke through.”
“Its Future Prediction skill proficiency has reached perfection.”
Principal Feng: “Then… what big event did you predict correctly?!!”
The proficiency of Future Prediction could only be increased with the correct Future Prediction. It was very difficult. Although it relied on resources to break through to the overlord level, the super skill proficiency of the Prediction Owl had been stuck for a long time. This time… it finally broke through?
Principal Feng looked at the owl in surprise.
“Wait, you called me over for this kind of thing… It means…”
“This time, Senior Owl said… that the correct prophecy event is related to Shi Yu,” President Ye said.
“Huh?” Principal Feng frowned and suddenly had a bad feeling. He said, “It… predicted something?”
President Ye was incomparably silent. “I predicted what kind of pet Shi Yu would contract if he went to Dragon Palace City. This… it happened. The corresponding prophecy fulfillment gave Senior Owl’s ability proficiency.”
“The contents of the prophecy are… Shi Yu will contract… a water-element totem when he goes to Dragon Palace City this time!”
Principal Feng: ????
“???”
“Huh???”
It widened its eyes and looked at the old principal and President Ye of Imperial Capital University, Hu Fei, dancing. Was it sure this was a prophecy, not a rumor or a lie?
It happened? Was it kidding? How could a master contract a totem!
The two of them also shook their heads in confusion and could only look at the owl.
The prophecy owl widened its big eyes and said, “I’m just an owl. I don’t know how to explain it to you. In any case, the skill proficiency has increased, so I should have hit the jackpot… This is the most ridiculous thing I’ve predicted in the past hundred years. It’s off the charts!!”
“It’s not a totem heir, it’s a totem!”
“From today onwards, I’m also a proper overlord. Hahaha, hahahaha, hahahaha!! As expected of me. I am the light of this world! Who dared to say my predictions were unreliable!”

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - Hundred Transformations Stone
chapters.content:
Chapter 291 Hundred Transformations Stone
[Devour success.]
[Digestion, analysis, transformation…)
[Evolution successful.]
[It has been converted into this substance and awakened the racial skill ‘Rain Prayer’.]
(Devour success.]
[Digestion, analysis, transformation…]
(Evolution successful.]
(Life level has been increased, awakened racial skill ‘Steam Explosion’.)
“Ah.”
A while later, Shi Yu’s surprised voice came from the ruins in Shi Yu’s residence.
Shi Yu looked at the awakened Water Slime and rubbed it hard with a look of disbelief.
“Huh???”
Susu tried to struggle.
Shi Yu said, “How should I put it? I keep feeling that it’s a loss. Why are there only two high-level skills?”
“This is… a failure?”
[Name]: Qi Yu
< Introduction > It’s a high-level water-type skill. It can summon rain clouds through prayer and rainstorm.
< Name > Steam Explosion
< Introduction > It’s a high-level water-type skill. It transforms water into high-temperature steam and compresses it into detonation.
They were all high-level water-element skills.
Although the former was the weather skill with the highest cost-effective ratio, and the latter was a very powerful water-element attack skill, it couldn’t change the fact that they were high-level skills.
After sleeping and digesting for a day, Susu had awakened two high-level racial skills. Shi Yu didn’t expect it.
After all, it had swallowed the last crystal left behind by a suspected totem-level mermaid after sacrificing itself.
Shi Yu originally thought that it would be some super skills like “Tears of Heaven” or “Sea of Sky” or “Holy Spirit Mermaid Summon”…
In the end, there were only two high-level skills that could be replicated and taught casually. Shi Yu cried.
Moreover, these skills could also be replaced by water element control.
“Ning?”
Susu looked at Shi Yu with watery eyes.
Wasn’t the rain prayer good?
Wasn’t the steam explosion good?
It felt that it had become much stronger after waking up.
“It’s not that it’s bad… Eh, I understand.”
A moment later, Shi Yu discovered the problem.
As everyone knew, the race level was determined jointly by various aspects such as “vitality”, “energy value”, “physical fitness”, “racial talent”, “racial skill”, and “attributes”.
Some pets only had one super skill, but because their physical fitness was off the charts, they could be considered a quasi overlord race.
Some pets only had two super skills, but because of the other attributes, it was possible for them to reach high-level overlord races.
Shi Yu observed Susu carefully again and realized that after it completed the Infinite Devour evolution, the main increase was not “racial skills”.
But in other aspects…
Firstly, Susu’s energy level was higher, reaching more than 50,000. Among monarch races, it was definitely the best. After all, its racial skill proficiency had never increased at all.
Secondly, Susu’s life force also seemed to have improved. The most direct performance of this quality was that it could increase the pet’s lifespan and recovery speed of its injuries.
Apart from that, Susu’s talent-type skill elementalization seemed to have been mastered better.
“Let’s take a look at elementalization,” Shi Yu said.
“Transform into gaseous water.”
“Ning…!” Under Shi Yu’s gaze, Susu instantly turned into a nearly invisible gas and turned into gaseous water. It was also as fast as turning into liquid water, as if this was the key to awakening the “steam explosion”.
Now, this should be Susu’s interface.
< Name > Mutated Water Slime
[Race Level]: High-level Monarch
“Then it looks like it’s not bad.”
Shi Yu nodded. Balance development was the most important. This was not a loss!
If Susu had a bunch of super skills and had a body as weak and as lacking in mana like Buggy… Shi Yu would also have a headache. It was pretty good now!
The reason why the dragons were powerful was because their bodies were strong. Even without using skills, they could rely on their super powerful physical attacks alone to smash a group of strong enemies. In addition, the bodies of the dragons had top-notch resistance to elements.
Now, not only could Infinite Devour increase the number of racial skills, but it could also strengthen Susu’s other shortcomings. It was very perfect.
“Ning—”
“Again, again, I’ll give you another one.”
“I’ll try to awaken a super skill this time.”
Soon, Susu, who had just woken up, was fed a turtle shell and a pile of common materials for absolute sleep by Shi Yu. It fell asleep again in a daze.
Shi Yu didn’t know what skill Susu could awaken this time, but he hoped that Infinite Devour could transform Absolute Sleep into Susu’s racial skill through the common materials used to teach Absolute Sleep.
At that time, the combination skill of Absolute Sleep and Infinite Devour could probably devour higher-level resources at the fastest speed.
“Ha…”
After checking on the changes in Susu, Shi Yu came out of the ruins with sleepy eyes and went for a casual walk.
He had been researching that Kirin horn fossil for the past two days, tiring him and Buggy out.
In the end, he still couldn’t figure out anything
It didn’t seem to be the same difficulty for entering a dream Mythical Creature fossil compared to ordinary ancient creature fossils.
Dragon Palace City had been collecting this thing for hundreds of millions of years. A bunch of Dragon Kings and Dragon Gods had yet to develop anything. Shi Yu didn’t know if he could get lucky.
However, unlike Dragon Palace City, he actually had a certain research advantage.
Because in modern times, humans had established the special dream stealing system of meditation and dream stealing.
This was a special dream entry ability that belonged to human Beast Tamers.
Only Beast Tamers could use it with pets that could steal dreams.
It was created by Emperor Shi and then developed abroad. It even gave birth to the special profession of dream stealing…
“One of the prerequisites of the Dream Transformation Stone is that Buggy’s proficiency must have already reached a transcendent level with the Dream Steal skill, but Buggy was already beyond that, so… It’s definitely not because of proficiency, but the strength level of growth that was affecting the performance of the skill.” “Apart from that, the second condition is that the Beast Tamer has to use the special meditation technique created by Emperor Shi to cooperate… And the Beast Tamer’s level determines the effect of meditation.”
“Therefore, if the Mythical fossil can also let me enter a dream, the reason why it can’t succeed might be because of the level of Buggy and me.”
II
11
“How annoying.”
Shi Yu walked on the street in frustration, wanting to find Senior White to chat about pets. If he really couldn’t find her then Xia Qingwei was good too, or that blue-haired girl. He could easily suffocate from studying alone. However, as he walked, Shi Yu’s gaze was still attracted by a man.
It was the mechanical man from Star Capital University. He seemed to have just returned from the outer island alone. He was riding a black mechanical steel eagle that was several meters tall, looking majestic.
Shi Yu focused.
< Name > Mechanical Wings of Heaven
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
(Race Level]: High-level Monarch
(Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 1,900,000
< Introduction > It’s modified from the evolution of the Wings of Wind.
It looked pretty good. As a young man, the energy value of his mechanical pet was even higher than that of the dean of the Ancient Capital University’s Mechanical College. Of course, this was also related to the type.
Dean Hao’s Purple Electric Mecha needed to fuse with the Beast Tamer to display its strongest battle power. At that time, its battle power might even multiply. It was similar to Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast, but this mechanical man from Star Capital University… His mechanical pet was a biological modification faction and couldn’t fuse with the Beast Tamer.
“Hi,” Shi Yu greeted the guy in the sky.
Upon hearing that, Master Mechanic Fan Yu, who had graduated from Star Capital University, looked down at Shi Yu and silently let the mechanical beast land.
“Shi Yu?” After he descended, he looked at Shi Yu and couldn’t understand this junior. First, he had tricked the totem frost dragon into coming to Dragon Palace City, and then he contracted a strange super slime. Shi Yu’s experience was really rich.
Unlike him, who could only bring a bunch of technical reports everywhere to deceive the sea beasts into becoming his research partner, it was very bitter.
“Have you found any sea beasts willing to be modified?” Shi Yu chuckled.
“No…” Fan Yu shrugged.
“Do you have a target?”
“No…”
“Do you want to come and chat?”
“About what?” Fan Yu was stunned.
“Anything is fine. I’m quite interested in mechanical modification now.”
Fan Yu had a suspecting face.
Facing Shi Yu’s attempt to hit on him, he kept feeling that Shi Yu was up to no good.
“For example, do you know Gao Xuan?” Shi Yu asked.
Fan Yu’s expression changed. “I know him. Why mention him?”
“Isn’t he very powerful?”
Fan Yu said, “Of course he’s powerful… Among Mechanics under the age of 30, almost no one is stronger than him… Heh, after this National League ends, he might have a chance to rank in the top ten among Beast Tamers under the age of 30 in Dong Huang.” “You mean the mechanical reward for the National League?” Shi Yu asked. “You know too??” Fan Yu was stunned. He had only obtained this information because he had a member of the fourth bureau at home. “That’s true. The National League will be held in a month. The reward information should have been leaked by now.” Fan Yu nodded.
“What is it?” Shi Yu asked.
“??? Do you know about this event or not?”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “I know it’s a mechanical material, but I don’t know the specific type. I heard it’s wind-element or ice-element?”
He had also heard it from Principal Feng last time. After hearing it, he didn’t pay much attention.
“Alright… The main reward is actually the wind-element Hundred Transformation Stone…”
Wind element!
Principal Feng and the others were right.
[Name]: Hundred Transformations Stone (Wind)
[Level]: Level 8
< Introduction > The Stone of thousand Transformations has memory function, top-notch mechanical materials, easy awakening, easy combination, easy modification.
The moment Fan Yu finished speaking, Shi Yu quickly investigated the information about the Hundred Transformation Stone through the index.
Then, the index popped up a pile of reference materials and a pile of reference videos for him.
Shi Yu opened a battle video.
In the video in front of him, a woman wearing a mecha battle suit with short black hair appeared. Then, she started to summon her pet. A cube prop that looked like a “Rubik’s Cube” appeared in her hand. As she threw it, the black Rubik’s Cube immediately divided into even smaller black cubes that filled the sky and combined in the sky.
In the blink of an eye, countless black Rubik’s Cube formed a super humanoid body filled with a black rock texture and huge rock wings.
[Hundred Transformations Stone (Dark), the main material to form the overlord-level body of the Black Wing Demon God.]
[Pilot: Xiao Shuang]
After closing the video, Shi Yu opened some other videos and realized that this Hundred Transformations Stone was indeed the best mechanical material.
With this as the main ingredient, it seemed that it could modify multiple mechanical forms at the smallest cost. It could allow mechanical pets to switch freely between various mechanical forms, greatly reducing the difficulty of modification for Mechanics. The machinery that was still a huge mecha just now could instantly become a battleship, a heavy mecha, and a sniper cannon with a Mechanic’s thought!
“Hey, hey.” At this moment, Fan Yu saw that Shi Yu was suddenly distracted and couldn’t help but shout.
“What are you thinking about?”
“Do you know what the Hundred Transformations Stone is?” he asked.
Shi Yu reacted and looked at him. “I know, and I want it…”
He felt that if he developed the Wind Kirin Phantom one day, it would be very compatible with it… Even if he couldn’t develop a magical beast, throwing a white Rubik’s Cube casually could turn it into a battleship and a Gundam. It was also quite handsome. At that time, he would let Chi Tong and Susu possess it. It was enough that he had a Gundam. This was the romance of men.
Fan Yu: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 292 Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (1)
“Wake up!!” Fan Yu waved his hand in front of Shi Yu. “Why do you want this thing?” “Building machinery,” Shi Yu said.
The corners of Fan Yu’s mouth twitched. “You’re not a Mechanic, right?”
Was he an archaeologist or a Feeder?
In short, he definitely had nothing to do with Mechanics!
And now he was interested in machinery. It was just that his thoughts were problematic… Moreover, who would want to use the Hundred Transformation Stone to create machines right from the start? This was a high-end transforming machine, and it could only be played by Legends. It was good for newbies to understand the four-wheel-drive and remote-controlled planes first.
“Forget it, I’m not talking to you anymore. I still have to come up with a temporary modification plan for that sea beast with a missing body.”
Fan Yu muttered and patted the Wings of Wind, planning to slip away.
Shi Yu had contracted an impressive water-type pet himself, but he had yet to contract it.
“Eh.” Shi Yu was stunned. Why not talk a bit more?
“Let’s talk another day.”
“I’m busy looking for a pet.”
Fan Yu hurriedly waved.
“Alright…” Shi Yu covered his forehead.
Forget it, it was immoral to stop others from looking for a pet. He’ll let him go then…
“However, the main reward of the National League is actually the Hundred Transformation Stone?”
Then, as he watched Fan Yu leave, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He really didn’t expect this.
This thing was a level-eight resource, worth about 1 billion.
From the situation of the previous National League, it was already not bad if the value of the champion reward was 10% of this one. The fourth bureau was really going all out this time.
eau was
In short, at that time, if Gao Xuan won the Hundred Transformations Stone, Imperial Capital University would completely lose.
After all, the results of the National League also determined the distribution of education fees for the nine major universities to a certain extent.
However… if the national champion wasn’t Gao Xuan, would the fourth round… cry?
“It’s not a big problem. As long as I join the fourth bureau, everyone will be family. No one will lose out.”
“There’s still a month…”
“Kinda want this reward…”
In an instant, Shi Yu had already browsed through most of the information on the Hundred Transformations Stone.
Although a Hundred Transformations Stone couldn’t make him create too powerful mechanical pets, creating one that was pretty good was enough to build a good foundation. For an overlord-level Black Wing Demon God like the Legendary Mechanic of Dong Huang, the main ingredient was indeed a Hundred Transformations Stone, but it was not as simple as just one.
A Hundred Transformations Stone was not enough to connect the many mechanical materials to form a huge body more than ten meters tall.
If he wanted to form such a body, he might not even be able to stack ten pieces. However, in a competition at the level of the National League, it was impossible to reward too many such rare resources.
One piece was already a very rare situation. Because the characteristics of the Hundred Transformations Stone were easy to modify, easy to assemble, and easy to awaken. Even if there was only one piece, it could perfectly match Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and increase the potential of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. At that time, the Hundred Transformations Stone would be equivalent to an accessory ingredient of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. There was still a difference from the core main ingredient.
If Shi Yu obtained the Hundred Transformations Stone, with the fact that he didn’t have any other rare mechanical materials, he would definitely use the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core.
Shi Yu didn’t mind.
The formless and formless Hundred Transformations Body without a fixed form was quite in line with his thoughts.
With the Hundred Transformation Stone as the main mechanical material, it wouldn’t be incompatible with the illusion. It was pretty good.
Of course, there were also shortcomings. It was expensive…
Seeing that the mechanical man had run away, Shi Yu planned to find the beast-eared girl to chat and give her a plan to contract a mermaid.
Shi Yu wanted to see what a human and a human-type pet mermaid looked like… However, at this moment, the Tyrannical Sea Legend suddenly appeared in front of Shi Yu.
Shi Yu looked at the top battle power of Dong Huang who had suddenly walked out and stopped.
“Senior Yu, what’s wrong?”
Tyrannical Sea Legend was wearing clothes similar to a Chinese tunic suit. His eyes under his short gray hair were very lively. He looked at Shi Yu and said, “What are you going to do?”
“To find White Brook and the others to chat.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend shook his head and said, “At your age, you should prioritize business. Let’s talk when we get back. They also came to look for you previously, but they were stopped by me. The first thing you should prepare now is tomorrow’s Dragon Palace banquet.”
now
“Huh???” Shi Yu was paralyzed.
No way, even the Tyrannical Sea Legend wanted to interfere.
Was the Tyrannical Sea Legend trying to restrict his personal freedom?
Ever since he returned, the Tyrannical Sea Legend had always asked him to take this Dragon Palace banquet seriously. Shi Yu indeed took it seriously.
He had already made Baby Ginseng and Buggy work overtime. As a Beast Tamer, couldn’t he chill a little?
“You have to take it seriously,” said the Tyrannical Sea Legend.
“Although the Sea Dragon King and the others support the Blue Sea Sprite to establish their faction with the power of Dragon Palace City, the name Blue Sea Sprite can’t be revealed.” “Therefore, how much power you can gather in this event will depend on your own ability.”
“Whether it’s to show your potential or to gain benefits, you have to do it well.” “At the moment, although Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City are allies, no human has been able to interfere in the internal affairs of Dragon Palace City. You will also be the first in a thousand years for a human to take on the important role of Dragon Palace City.”
“In the long term, this is a good thing for your future development and the growth of the Blue Sea Sprite.”

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 293 Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (1)
“Don’t be smug just because you contracted the Blue Sea Sprite. This race has far-reaching ambitions. You might not be able to keep it in the future, so you have to work hard to improve yourself. In fact, if you really want to become partners with it and enjoy the convenience brought by this identity, you have to bear a certain amount of responsibility. Do you have this awareness?”
The Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “The enemies of the Blue Sea Sprite are much more than the enemies of General Mu Huiyin.” “I understand.” Shi Yu rubbed his hair to indicate that he understood.
After contracting Susu, he had indeed quickly understood this matter.
The greatest enemy of the Blue Sea Sprites should be the Western Abyss Sea.
It was said that the rulers of that sea area in ancient times were gods from the universe that could be traced back to the Mythical Era. Ordinary creatures would fall into madness just by seeing their totems and touching their traces. Their blood dyed the entire sea area. These existences were also regarded by the generations of sea elves as the greatest ecological pollutants and invaders of the blue planet’s sea.
Although the Abyss Sea had disappeared, if it really came back, there would probably be another storm of blood in the ocean. Shi Yu was optimistic…
Damn it, he couldn’t be optimistic.
Thinking about it carefully, in the team, Buggy seemed to be the one who made him worry the least!
Buggy, as expected of it… To a certain extent, it was the most harmless. Shi Yu didn’t know if it was praise or a belittlement.
On the other side, Legend Sea Tyrant asked again, “Do you really not need me to give you some resources?” “Don’t worry, I’m prepared for this.” Shi Yu grinned. “It can definitely attract all the sea beasts!”
“Alright.” Legend Sea Tyrant nodded and didn’t ask further.
Shi Yu came from Bureau 11 and the third bureau, and he even knew the totem ice dragon. He didn’t believe that he didn’t have anything good.
“Then I’ll go back and continue preparing?” Shi Yu said.
With the Tyrannical Sea Legend stopping him, he couldn’t slack off.
“Yes.” Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded.
The next day.
The Dragon Palace banquet that had been delayed for three days was finally about to begin.
The area of the Dragon Palace City’s mystic realm, even if it wasn’t a deep mystic realm, was far larger than Ancient Capital City.
At this moment, the gazes of the entire Dragon Palace City were attracted by an island.
Dragon Yan Island.
This island wasn’t small either. It could easily accommodate hundreds of thousands of elite sea beasts from various seas.
The entire Dragon Feast Island was arranged outward at the center. According to strength and race ranking, every area had different sea beasts.
For example, in the center was the host of this Dragon Palace banquet, the Sea Dragon King. It lay on the huge dragon nest and enjoyed the worship of countless sea beasts. The little white dragon and the Turtle Prime Minister stood on both sides and guarded at the side.
However, what was new was that there was a huge dragon nest beside the Sea Dragon King, which surprised the sea beasts participating in the banquet. Could it be that this was prepared for the Azure Dragon King? The Azure Dragon King was also hosting this banquet?
As for the area surrounding Sea Dragon King, it was the territory of the Sky Penetrating Whale, the Sea Yaksha, the other overlord-level generals of Dragon Palace City, the Mermaid Queen, the Black Flood Dragon overlord, and dozens of other ocean overlords.
These Dragon Palace overlords and their clansmen, such as their heirs, occupied the second core circle.
Of course, in this area, apart from them, there was also a special force, the human race.
Tyrannical Sea Legend sat calmly in the seat and looked at the Sea Dragon King in the center quietly. Beside him, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others were especially reserved.
So many overlord-level creatures!!
As expected of the strongest group in the ocean!
“Only on such an occasion can one feel the insignificance of the Beast Tamer individual and feel the power of Dong Huang,” Heavenly King Zou said with a smile as he sat in the seat.
With his strength, it might be very difficult for him to fight against one of the weaker overlords, but there were dozens of such overlords in Dragon Palace City. This was only to participate in the banquet. In addition to the other totems other than the Sea Dragon King, Heavenly King Zou deeply sensed the power of this totem faction.
However, as a human super force not inferior to Dragon Palace City, Dong Huang was also the main reason why they could sit here.
“By the way, what about Shi Yu? What’s wrong with the Slime you guys were talking about…” “It can’t be some totem son who can transform, right??”
After Heavenly King Zou arrived at the scene, he realized that Shi Yu didn’t come with everyone.
He had also heard everyone talk about the monarch-level Water Slime and couldn’t help but be extremely curious. If it weren’t for the Tyrannical Sea Legend stopping him, he would have long gone to Shi Yu to satisfy his curiosity.
“He has additional activities with Senior Ice Dragon.”
The Tyrannical Sea Legend said calmly.
“Oh…” Heavenly King Zou felt that he was being a bit annoying. The corners of his mouth twitched. He shouldn’t have asked.
“Zou Yun, Yu Shu, Wang Xu, Peng Zijie, Shi Yu and the others have successfully contracted their pets. This Dragon Palace banquet is one of the few opportunities left for you. Soon after the Dragon Palace banquet, we will leave the ocean, so you have to seize the opportunity.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend reminded White Brook, Yin Zhengfan, and the others.
As a top-notch master of Dong Huang, a young genius who could resist an overlord with all his might, Heavenly king zou had enough qualifications to negotiate with the Black Flood Dragon overlord. He had already successfully obtained the recognition of the Black Flood Dragon overlord and was entrusted with the commander-level Black Flood Dragon cub.
Yu Shu relied on resources and the introduction of the little white dragon. As for Wang Xu and Peng Zijie, they were Beast Tamers of the Dong Huang Navy. They had a contract with the ocean army of Dragon Palace City and were assigned regularly. Naturally, they also found their comrades.
Therefore, at the moment, almost half of the Beast Tamers who came to Dragon Palace City had already achieved their goal.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 294 Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (2)
As for the others, they might still be waiting for an opportunity to find their favorite pet on the largest stage, the Dragon Palace Banquet.
“Brother Sponge, how have you been?”
“Ah, isn’t this Brother Octopus?”
“Ah, the overlord sea star is here too.”
At the same time, in the core area of the Dragon Palace Banquet, the sea overlords who had better relationships were also chatting with each other.
The huge yellow sponge overlord and the gloomy-looking octopus overlord greeted each other politely. Not far from them, a pink and strong sea star also joined the group with a smile.
Elsewhere.
The pregnant mermaid queen received greetings and concerns from various races and asked most questions about whether she should arrange a baby marriage for the little mermaid in her stomach.
Sky Penetrating Whale General and Sea Yaksha General, were with many overlords and drank and chatted happily. As for the overlord heirs, such as the Sponge Baby, the Octopus Brother, the silly Sea Star, the Tiger Whale Sister, and the Demon Sister, they continued to size up and observe the young geniuses in the human area.
Their elders had also instructed that if they encountered a suitable young Beast Tamer, they could follow, but the human had to be outstanding. The most basic requirement was to be able to show off at the Dragon Palace banquet.
At this Dragon Palace banquet, the lowest threshold to participate was also the level of a monarch. Only the monarch-level factions in the Dragon Palace City’s sphere of influence were qualified to participate. At the moment, apart from the Sea Dragon King at the core, the overlord factions in the inner circle, the monarch factions in the outermost circle… There were no lower-level factions.
However, it was impossible to fill an island with monarch-level sea beasts and overlord-level sea beasts alone. At the moment, there were more overlord-level big shots, the family members of monarch-level sea beasts, and their followers on Dragon Banquet Island. They were here to join in the fun.
Beside the Sea Dragon King, the Turtle Minister slowly floated up. When it flew to the height where all the sea beasts could see it, it looked around.
“Cough, cough, cough.”
The old turtle coughed dryly. Its voice was extremely penetrating, immediately attracting the attention of all creatures.
Countless sea beasts immediately looked at the Turtle Minister.
It was said that the Turtle Minister Race… could be traced back to the early stages of the establishment of the Dragon Palace.
As the saying went, the iron-willed Turtle Prime Minister, the Dragon God of the flowing water.
For hundreds of millions of years, the races of the Dragon God and the Dragon King had changed countless times, but the Turtle Prime Minister Race had always relied on its monarch race to survive until now.
For countless years, it wasn’t like the Turtle Minister Race had never produced an expert. Every once in a while, it wasn’t surprising for them to produce a totem. After all, among all the known races, the Turtle Minister’s race, the “Longevity Turtle”, was the race with the longest lifespan among the known races at the same level of growth. Even some overlords, totems, elemental life forms, and undead life forms couldn’t compare to the Longevity Turtle of the monarch race in terms of lifespan.
Now, every dragon king in Dragon Palace City had a tortoise prime minister assisting them. If nothing went wrong, after the Ice Dragon King joined Dragon Palace City, the Longevity Turtle Race would also send a tortoise to help the Ice Dragon manage trifles.
At the moment, following the Sea Dragon King, the Turtle Minister, was the one who had been assisting the Sea Dragon King ever since it joined Dragon Palace City. Its status was very high, not inferior to some overlord-level sea beasts.
“On behalf of the Sea Dragon King, I welcome everyone to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet.” It sent a telepathic message.
“I’m really sorry for making everyone wait three more days because of an accident.”
“Roar!! (It’s alright, we still have to thank the Sea Dragon King for entertaining us for three more days. Hahahaha)” Below, many sea beasts roared.
“Yes ~” In the human area, the gem cat also nodded. How good would it be if it was delayed for another month… Forget it, losing weight was important.
“At the moment, there might be a portion of guests who don’t know why the Dragon Palace banquet is delayed. Before the Dragon Palace banquet starts, I’ll explain to everyone and announce a piece of news,” the Turtle Prime Minister continued.
The sea beasts looked at the prime minister curiously.
After most sea beasts arrived at Dragon Palace City, they would eat, drink, and play around. They really didn’t know what had happened. In addition, Dragon Palace City didn’t specially promote it, so only a small number of people knew about the situation.
The Turtle Minister said heavily, “A few days before the Dragon Palace banquet, several forces of the Dragon Palace who came to participate in the Dragon Palace banquet were attacked on the way. The attacker was a mutated Poison Dragon Totem. This is the main reason why the Dragon Palace banquet was forced to be delayed!”
Whoosh!
After Prime Minister Turtle finished speaking, the crowd immediately went into an uproar.
Totem?
Poison Dragon Totem?
In the human area, Yu Shu and the others also cursed.
“Are there any sea beasts who dare to attack the Dragon Palace?”
“Poison Dragon Totem? What’s going on?”
Many sea beasts were shocked.
“In order to resist this Poison Dragon Totem, General Luosha was heavily injured, and many soldiers of the Dragon Palace were also heavily injured. If not for the timely return of Lord Immortal Dragon King, along with the full support of Doctor Holy Shell, Doctor Jellyfish, and Doctor Coral, the consequences would have been unimaginable.”
“Of course, in order to let everyone successfully carry out the Dragon Palace banquet, after the Sea Dragon King received the news, he personally took action to suppress the Poison Dragon Totem. With the help of Lord Azure Dragon King and Lord Ice Dragon King, the suppression operation went very smoothly.”
“Thank you, Sea Dragon King!”
“Thank you, Sea Dragon King.”
Many sea beasts that had been injured by the Poison Dragon Totem and had been healed were thanking the Sea Dragon King again at the banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 295 Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (3)
“There’s no need to thank me. This is what I should do,” the Sea Dragon King said slowly as he circled the dragon nest.
“If you want to thank someone, thank the Immortal Dragon King, the Azure Dragon King, and the Ice Dragon King.” “Thank you…” Below, another wave of thanks erupted. Regardless of whether it was those who had never experienced the Poison Dragon incident, they all thanked him. In any case, gratitude didn’t cost money. It was always right to thank him more. However, suddenly, these sea beasts realized that something was wrong.
Eh?
They knew the Immortal Dragon King, one of the eight totems of the Dragon Palace.
They also knew the Azure Dragon King. One of the eight totems of the Dragon Palace who was even the wife of the Sea Dragon King.
However, what was this Ice Dragon King?
Many overlord and sea beasts looked at each other. The monarch and sea beasts were even more stunned. They had never heard of it.
At this moment, the Turtle Prime Minister coughed dryly and said, “I have to announce something important.”
“At this Dragon Palace banquet, a great being wanted to join our Dragon Palace City. Just as it arrived, it cooperated with the Sea Dragon King to seal the Poison Dragon Totem. It played a very critical role in this battle and helped our Dragon Palace City perfectly survive this crisis.”
“This is the honorable Lord Ice Dragon King!!”
“Everyone, welcome to Lord Ice Dragon King’s seat.”
“Roar!!!!!”
With a sentence from the Turtle Prime Minister, the surrounding temperature instantly fell
Strands of cold wind lingered around the island without any warning, freezing the air and making frost crystals dance in the sky. Under the outline of the snowstorm, a huge monster dozens of meters long flew over from the sky. It spread its huge wings and descended here, like a legend descending. “Roar!!!”
It roared, and the strong ice stone body covered in blue and purple dragon scales directly stretched out. A cold wind swept the dragon might in all directions…
Boom!!!
With a boom, the surrounding time froze. Countless sea beasts opened their mouths wide and looked at this super dragon that emitted the power of totems, not understanding the situation.
The ice dragon slowly landed on the dragon nest beside the Sea Dragon King. At this moment, all the sea beasts finally knew who the dragon nest beside the Sea Dragon King was left for.
They widened their eyes and were a little shocked. A totem-level dragon had just joined Dragon Palace City, and it was a dragon from the west!
This Dragon Palace banquet… wasn’t for nothing! The power structure of the Dragon Palace was about to change again.
“Holy shit.”
At this moment, looking at the frost dragon that landed in the dragon nest, Heavenly King Zou, Yin Zhengfan, Yu Shu, Fan Yu, and the others immediately clicked their tongues.
It wasn’t that they were shocked that the frost dragon had suddenly descended. After all, they had seen the ice dragon in advance. Just as they arrived at Dragon Palace City, what shocked them the most was the ice dragon’s shoulder.
A figure supported himself on the huge frost dragon’s body and stood calmly on the totem dragon’s shoulder. Then, it descended and became the focus of countless sea beasts. Who else could this person be but Shi Yu?
As the ice dragon descended, the Sea Dragon King nodded at the ice dragon and Shi Yu. The ice dragon and Shi Yu’s gazes looked at the many sea beasts in all directions.
At that moment, not only Heavenly King Zou and the others, but these sea beasts also naturally realized that something was wrong. The descent of the totem ice dragon naturally shocked them. However, there was actually someone standing on the shoulder of a totem. This shocked them even more. What right did this person have? Even if he was a titled legend, he wasn’t qualified to stand on the shoulder of the totem, right? Moreover, this person was so young. “Let me introduce you to everyone.”
The tortoise prime minister said, “This is Senior Frost Dragon.”
“You might be unfamiliar with its name.”
“But after hearing my introduction, it definitely won’t be unfamiliar.”
“The Dong Huang has been on good terms with our Dragon Palace for generations. Since ancient times, we have a good friendship with humans.”
“And in a country with a history of 2500 years, there’s definitely no way to avoid talking about the legendary Beast Tamer who pioneered everything, which is Senior Emperor Shi, who established the Dong Huang Dynasty.”
“As for Lord Ice Dragon King, it was the senior who participated in the totem battle with the Emperor 2500 years ago, the guardian general Mu Huiyin, and won the totem battle. Its reputation was known to everyone at that time. It was the true founder of Dong Huang. This time, it will join our Dragon Palace City and start a new journey.”
Initially, many sea beasts indeed didn’t know the origin of this ice dragon, but after hearing the introduction of the Turtle Prime Minister, their eyes instantly widened. Holy shit, holy shit, this identity origin was so cool.
Why did it feel that it was even more impressive than the experience of the current Dragon God in Dragon Palace City?
The current Dragon God of Dragon Palace City had only successfully advanced with the help of the Dragon Emperor of Dong Huang a thousand years ago.
And this new dragon was actually a super big boss who had followed Emperor Shi to end the totem battle?
In an instant, countless ocean overlords sucked in a breath of cold air emitted by the ice dragon. Countless weaker sea beasts shouted respectfully, “Lord Ice Dragon King.”
“Hello,” Ice Dragon breathed out cold air and said proudly. “Of course… There’s another lord that needs introduction…” The Turtle Minister continued to cough dryly and looked at Shi Yu, who had come with the frost dragon, on the frost dragon’s shoulder.
It said to everyone, “And this human lord…”
As it finished speaking, dozens of ocean overlords and thousands of monarch-level sea beasts looked at Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 296 Dragon Palace Banquet Begins (4)
They were silent and kept guessing. They had all seen it. The super big boss of Dong Huang, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the human big boss who could fight equally with the Sea Dragon King was sitting there. Although the Tyrannical Sea Legend was no longer a stranger to these sea beasts, after all, the reputation of the Tyrannical Sea Legend was obtained from fighting in the sea. What abilities did this young man have to be introduced exclusively? Even the Tyrannical Sea Legend didn’t have this treatment this time!
What was the connection between him and the Ice Dragon King??
Heavenly King Zou, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others gulped.
They kept feeling that there was something wrong with Shi Yu.
[Damn it, what’s wrong with this guy? Why is he always in the limelight?] Heavenly King Zou cried in his heart.
If it were him, how handsome would he be? He would take a photo and post it on the Internet. It would be the headlines for a month, alright?
At that time, when the traffic came, there would be more money to train pets.
“This guy.” White Brook, Xia Qingwei, and the others also gritted their teeth. Although they were used to him showing off, everyone clearly came here regularly. Why did only Shi Yu’s appearance have special effects! It was unfair!
“This is…” The Turtle Prime Minister thought for a moment.
“This is Lord Ice Dragon King’s spokesperson, Lord Shi Yu!”
“Lord Shi Yu has outstanding talent and is a super genius of Dong Huang. He was recognized by Lord Immortal Dragon King, Lord Sea Dragon King, Lord Green Dragon King, and Lord Ice Dragon King and was specially allowed to become a general of Dragon Palace City!”
“The Dragon Palace will establish the Sea Environmental Protection Department of the Dragon Palace City under the management of Lord Shi Yu. The Sea Environmental Protection Department will be in charge of overall coordination and supervision of major environmental issues. Guidance, coordination, and supervision of ecological protection. The Sea Environmental Protection Department has many functions and has extraordinary origins. Under Lord Shi Yu’s lead, I believe it can definitely bring a huge positive impact to the Dragon Palace City.” “Let us… also welcome Lord Shi Yu to Dragon Palace City!”
Eh?
As soon as the Turtle Minister finished speaking, Heavenly King Zou, White Brook, Yu Shu, and the others opened their mouths slightly, as if they had heard something unbelievable.
Not only them, even these ocean overlords instantly opened their mouths wide, cursing in their hearts.
What??
They looked at Shi Yu in shock. A general of the Dragon Palace City was a position that basically only a top overlord like the Sky Penetrating Whale could sit steadily in. Its status was only below the totem dragon king. Although the Dragon Palace City had always been friendly with the humans, it had never let humans take on such an important role!
This… Countless sea beasts looked at the calm and extraordinary Shi Yu on the Ice Dragon’s shoulder in shock. They were shocked. They didn’t understand who the person in front of them was to actually obtain such high recognition from the four dragon kings.
Instead, the little white dragon, who had been beaten up, looked at Shi Yu with admiration.
As expected of Senior Shi Yu…
“Hello, everyone. I’m Shi Yu.”
At this moment, the importance of Shi Yu’s telepathy appeared again.
He narrowed his eyes and looked at the countless ocean bosses. Below, Ice Dragon had a displeased expression. This damn little brat had grabbed onto the name of the Blue Sea Sprite. Its status in Dragon Palace City was actually almost catching up to it immediately.
However, when it thought of how Shi Yu was under it and worked for it with the Blue Sea Sprite to help it earn results, Ice Dragon endured it.
Although Shi Yu was the head of the Ministry of Environmental Protection, the boss of this department was still the Ice Dragon King.
It hoped that when the time came… Shi Yu could let it be a comfortable queen who freeloaded.
“Lord Shi Yu…”
Soon, sounds that shattered the values of Heavenly King Zou, Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others came from the entire Dragon Yan Island.
“F*ck.” Yu Shu’s eyes almost exploded. He couldn’t understand.
What exactly was going on?
It was one thing for Shi Yu to seduce the Ice Dragon, but why did he also obtain the recognition of the other three Dragon Kings at the same time and become a general of some Dragon Palace City?
What was going on?
“Is this scientific!!” Fan Yu exclaimed. According to his understanding, there were also many humans who had a good relationship with the Dragon Palace totem. Why was Shi Yu addressed so respectfully by some overlords?
Then what were they, this group of people who were kneeling to the overlords and begging the other party to entrust their heirs to them? The little Yin Zhengfan was a little regretful that he had come to Dragon Palace City this time. He was not very old, but he had endured pressure that he shouldn’t have. His gaze was blank. Not to mention President Gao Xuan, could even the big shots of the fourth bureau receive such treatment from Dragon Palace City? No, that was impossible.
He looked at the Tyrannical Sea Legend in confusion.
This was… how did he do it?
At this moment, Tyrannical Sea Legend sighed and said, “If you don’t mind, I suggest you join the environmental department of Dragon Palace City. It will be beneficial to your future development.”
According to his speculation, at that time, there should be no lack of heirs of the overlords of Dragon Palace City’s Environmental Protection Department.
The pavilion closest to the water enjoyed the moonlight first, as the saying went. If they couldn’t contract an overlord’s son, they would have more chances in the future if they joined the Environmental Protection Department.
Heavenly King Zou and the others: “Ah???”
Damn.
Therefore, what exactly was going on? Coming to Dragon Palace City to participate in the banquet and becoming Shi Yu’s subordinate… This plot was something they couldn’t understand! This didn’t make sense!

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - Invincible Environmental Badge
chapters.content:
Chapter 297 Invincible Environmental Badge
After Prime Minister Turtle introduced Ice Dragon and Shi Yu, the various overlords and monarchs were a little silent.
This was really explosive news…
They didn’t know what changes the addition of Ice Dragon and Shi Yu would bring to Dragon Palace City.
“Then, the Dragon Palace banquet will begin now.”
“I hope everyone can spend a happy time at this banquet ~”
The Turtle Minister said in mid-air, “Next, the banquet will be freely carried out by everyone
211
With that, the Turtle Prime Minister landed.
The entire Dragon Yan Island became noisy again.
The segment of the Dragon Palace banquet was very simple.
Many sea beast overlords and sea beast monarchs could do anything they wanted, such as showing off their children to each other.
Apart from eating, drinking, and chatting with each other, the most lively project should be to show off their descendants.
Usually, in this segment, the corresponding ocean overlord elders would take out a rare resource as a gimmick.
For example, whoever defeated its child could obtain the resources.
Of course, there was even a situation of spouse finding in the Dragon Palace banquet, and it was even a large-scale marriage venue.
Apart from that, some small factions could also offer treasures to the Sea Dragon King or a certain overlord faction.
As long as it was within the imagination, they were allowed to do it at the Dragon Palace banquet. The Sea Dragon King also wouldn’t interfere and only silently supervised from above.
With the Sea Dragon King watching, no matter how many sea beasts there were, the Dragon Palace banquet could maintain order.
For countless years, everyone had already formed a tacit rule.
“No matter what, you have to obtain the holy bead bestowed by the Holy Healing Immortal Shell, do you hear me!”
Somewhere, a shell-type monarch said to a child who had surpassed him.
“But I don’t want to learn medicine! Learning medicine won’t revive Dragon Palace City!” The White Star Shell, who had just stepped into the monarch domain and had an extraordinary aura, said.
“Do you listen to you or me?!”
At every Dragon Palace banquet, Doctor Shell would give a fixed holy bead to the sea beasts to compete. This holy bead could allow a certain transcendent healing skill of the shell-type Biology Association to be learned. After learning it, one could also join Doctor Shell’s medical team and receive its teaching. It was a resource that many shell races coveted.
“I heard that the Mermaid Queen has the intention to betroth the mermaid princess in her stomach.”
“Whether you can pass the test and find a rich woman to bring honor to your ancestors depends on you!” A group of ugly and ferocious monarch sea beasts said to their babies.
“We have to compete for the Purple Crystal Origin Water.”
“You have to obtain quasi-mythical dragon blood and strengthen our bloodline.”
After so long, the resources that any overlord faction took out were already very fixed. Many sea beasts specially came for the rewards of a certain faction, and it was fine even if they joined them.
Of course, this was for those monarch powers. For these overlord powers, the most important thing was definitely to display the power of their own factions and display the outstanding talents of the younger generation.
However, this time, none of the overlord powers took the lead to stand out.
There was no other reason. This time, after the Ice Dragon King became the greatest guest of this banquet, they definitely had to see if the Ice Dragon King had anything to say. Everyone looked over and saw Shi Yu floating slowly on the ice dragon. Soon, he floated in the air and replaced the position of the Turtle Prime Minister, becoming the focus of many sea beasts.
“This time, let me start.”
Shi Yu welcomed the tens of thousands of gazes and said without any fear.
Since he was recruiting new students, he naturally had to be early. Otherwise, all the outstanding talents should have been snatched away.
“The initial construction of the Dragon Palace Environmental Protection Department. At the moment, apart from me, a lone commander, there’s still a lack of capable, determined, and responsible members.”
“I want to use this occasion to recruit some members for the Environmental Protection Department.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the crowd was in an uproar.
In fact, up until now, many sea overlords were still confused about this Environmental Protection Department. Now, they wanted to see what Shi Yu said.
However, Shi Yu didn’t seem to have the intention of introducing the Marine Environmental Protection Department in detail.
Instead, he directly said, “The Sea Environmental Protection Department isn’t as complicated as everyone thinks. The core is to cleanse the ocean and maintain its original color. It’s mainly targeted at monsters that release radiation toxins and pollute the ocean like the Poison Dragon Totem.”
“Therefore, the recruitment conditions of the Marine Environmental Protection Department hope that you have the cleansing ability. If not, it’s alright. If you have enough battle potential, you can also join the Marine Environmental Protection Department. The department will even tailor a cleansing ability for you.”
Countless sea beasts looked at Shi Yu. At this moment, they weren’t concerned about this, but about the benefits of the Environmental Protection Department.
Even the most basic ocean army in Dragon Palace City had a clear promotion channel. The battle merits reward could allow them to see a beautiful future. If the Environmental Protection Department didn’t have enough benefits, it would probably be difficult to attract some sea beasts to join.
Although Shi Yu’s appearance was very mysterious and might have a big secret, not many sea beasts were willing to take a gamble against a baffling organization. “Shi Yu is serious…” Heavenly King Zou and the others looked at each other.
Good heavens, the Dragon Palace banquet was openly forming cliques.
“Of course, there are also certain benefits to joining the Marine Environmental Protection Department.”
“For example, every member of the Environmental Protection Department can obtain an Environmental Protection Badge. This badge is a symbol of their identity as a member of the Environmental Protection Department.” With that said, Shi Yu took out a blue circular badge that looked like a flattened slime.
As Shi Yu took out the badge, many sea beasts were stunned.
However, before they could be puzzled for too long, Shi Yu immediately explained,
“Everyone, you might be curious about what use this badge has other than representing the identity of a member of the Ministry of Environment.”
“Next, I’ll show you.”
Shi Yu gently pressed the badge. In the next moment, shocking cold air spewed out.
“Roar!!!!”
A terrifying dragon roar instantly sounded, causing many sea beasts to be momentarily stunned. Even the overlord sea beasts were no exception. After being in a daze for a moment, they were directly stunned by the dragon might and were suppressed by the bloodline.
At the same time, snow condensed, and a terrifying ice dragon phantom was born beside Shi Yu.
This Ice Dragon Phantom was huge, its body seemed to be made of ice rocks. The color was ice-blue and dark purple, representing extreme cold.
It was surprisingly identical to the Ice Dragon King beside him. Apart from its size, there was almost no difference!
Many sea beasts looked at the smaller Ice Dragon Phantom and the Frost Dragon totem lying in the dragon nest. After comparing them, they opened their mouths slightly.
“This badge is wrapped in Lord Ice Dragon King’s dragon might. Most importantly, through this badge, the user can summon Senior Ice Dragon’s phantom three times through it. Lord Ice Dragon King’s phantom also grasps a super time skill, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.”
“This skill came from Emperor Shi.”
“Whether you want to use the badge to come into contact with learning time skills, or to use the badge to protect yourself and deter the enemy, or to feel the deterrence of Lord Ice Dragon King at a close distance, you can do it with this badge.”
Shi Yu narrowed his eyes and said, “I forgot to say. Senior Ice Dragon relied on the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy skill that can freeze time to have a lifespan that exceeds its own race.”
“If you’re on the verge of serious injuries or encounter any special circumstances, you can summon the Ice Dragon Phantom and use the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy to freeze and seal your injuries. At this moment, time would almost stop. You have plenty of time to wait for treatment.’
“The Poison Dragon Totem and the sea area contaminated by it were frozen by Lord Ice Dragon King with this skill.”
“In addition, the user can also freeze themselves with the environmental badge and enter an ice sleep state. In this state, your life activity will be completely frozen, and the time on your body will stop. Even if ten years have passed in the outside world, when you wake up again, you will still look the same.”
“To a certain extent, it’s a tool that can indirectly extend one’s lifespan.”
“From now on, every member who joins the Ministry of Environment will receive such a badge.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, countless water-element sea beasts were shocked.
Holy shit, a badge that could summon the Lord Ice Dragon King’s phantom three times?
It even had a super time skill, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy?
What kind of equipment was this? It could even preserve a time-element super skill!
How exactly did he do it?
“Tch.” Ice Dragon curled its lips on the dragon nest. This kid, Shi Yu, let that worm run into its dream for a long time when it was sleeping. After coming out, that worm could even simulate the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. This was ridiculous.
Although it only had an entry-level effect and its power had been super castrated, it was still Heavenly Frost Cold Energy after all. It was tailor-made for it by Emperor Shi!
That butterfly’s dream stealing skill was so abnormal. Even Ice Dragon couldn’t help but think.
At this moment, under the cooperation of Shi Yu and the Ice Dragon, the Environmental Protection Department badge with the Ice Dragon Phantom as a guardian spirit wrapped in the deterrence of a totem-level Ice Dragon was the most basic equipment for the members of the Environmental Protection Department.
This equipment’s value could be high or low. From the level and time limit, its shelf life wasn’t long. It was mass-produced, but from the power contained inside, it was extraordinary. At this moment, even some overlord-level sea beasts were very envious.
After all, ice and water were not separated. As long as it was a water-element creature, it could basically learn ice-element skills. In the face of a skill like the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, who didn’t want to give it a try? Although there was a high chance of learning it, every living being had the mentality of a gambler.
Most importantly, it was too easy to obtain such an emblem just by joining the Environmental Protection Department.
Some overlords even wanted to register in the Ministry of Environment and take it back to study.
Just imagine, if they encountered any special circumstances, such as an incurable injury or a poison that couldn’t be cleansed, they could completely rely on the environmental protection badge to protect their life and wait for the cure and the cleansing method to appear. During the Wu Emperor Dynasty, if Emperor Wu could contract a totem that mastered the power of time, he might be able to extend his life for a long time.
This was the power of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. All processes on life forms could be stopped by time.
This was the power of Buggy’s skill in Dao proficiency Dream Steal. As long as it was given enough time, it could even simulate the other party’s super racial skill!
The value of equipment forged with rare super skills was naturally needless to say. Most importantly, it was unique, and it was very difficult to replicate.
“This…”
“I want it!!”
In the human area, Yu Shu was also extremely envious, his eyes filled with blood vessels.
Damn it, he had long been hungry for Shi Yu’s ability to summon the Ice Dragon Phantom.
Now, Shi Yu could actually create illusions and give them away? Was it that ridiculous?
“Can this resist aging?” The blue-haired girl was also envious.
“Probably…” Xia Qingwei was silent.
White Brook curled her lips. Wasn’t it amazing enough to use the Time Fruit to become a loli? Shi Yu still had something better!
She didn’t know if Shi Yu would take it out later. In her opinion, that was much more useful than the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
Seeing this badge, the Tyrannical Sea Legend also narrowed its eyes and nodded. The value of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was not inferior to his Giant Leviathan’s Infinite Devour. They were both top super skills. Using this equipment as a temptation was indeed enough. “Roar…”
“Roar—”
This equipment was expensive because it was rare. It involved the protection of the Ice Dragon King’s dragon might and the dual-element Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
Many sea beasts became restless. If they were given this just by joining the Environmental Protection Department, then joining didn’t seem to be a loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - Shocking Dragon Palace City
chapters.content:
Chapter 298 Shocking Dragon Palace City
After Shi Yu displayed the environmental protection badge containing the Ice Dragon Phantom, many sea beasts became restless.
“You, go and register and try…”
Among the dozens of ocean overlords, the Ice Emperor Lobster overlord, who was famous for its ice-element power, said to its cub.
It actually didn’t want its heirs to follow humans, but if it was the internal department of Dragon Palace City, it didn’t matter.
Most importantly, the Frost Dragon was the only totem in Dragon Palace City that was proficient in ice power. The Ice Emperor Lobster overlord was suddenly a little tempted.
It felt that following this old senior might give him more benefits.
From the first totem battle to now, Ice Dragon was clearly a super big boss!
“Ah…” In the face of its parents, this monarch-level Ice Emperor Lobster that had already grown up was confused. Wait a minute.
Giving such a precious piece of equipment after joining was definitely not that simple.
It wasn’t too late to go after Lord Shi Yu made himself clear…
Similar scenes were playing out elsewhere.
“Go and try,” many overlord-level sea beasts said to their heirs or clansmen.
Some monarch-level sea beasts even muttered to themselves, wanting to join the Ministry of Environment.
After all, Shi Yu’s Environmental Protection Department didn’t specify any levels, race, or age.
“I wonder if I have any hope…”
“Lord Shi Yu, I wonder if there are any specific conditions for me to join the Environmental Protection Department.”
“I want to join!!”
“Lord Shi Yu, look at me!!”
In an instant, thousands of sea beasts shouted.
Just now, many sea beasts still had a wait-and-see attitude towards the Marine Environmental Protection Department, but in the blink of an eye, the Environmental Protection Department became popular.
After all, who could withstand a group giving away super resources upon entry? It was freeloading!
“Holy shit, will he really get a bunch of sea beast followers?”
Seeing the Dragon Palace banquet become a large-scale recruitment venue, Yu Shu cried in envy.
Wouldn’t Shi Yu be able to do whatever he wanted in the East Sea in the future?
How envious!!!
The other young people also looked envious.
Ahhh, they wanted to do this too!
“Everyone, don’t worry. I’m not done.”
At this moment, facing the enthusiastic sea beasts, Shi Yu said calmly, “Please let me finish. This environmental protection badge is actually the most basic welfare treatment for the members of the Ministry of Environment.”
“We also prepared another precious resource for the core members of the Ministry of Environment.”
Eh?
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the sea beasts were stunned. There was more?
Legend Sea Tyrant and Sea Dragon King were also slightly stunned.
There was more?
In their opinion, this environmental badge was already a huge investment. After all, it was a high-quality equipment that could store time skills.
In the end, Shi Yu even prepared something more expensive?
“Looks like this kid plans to use this event to rope in enough power.”
The Sea Dragon King narrowed its eyes and quietly looked at what Shi Yu was preparing to take out.
“This resource is also a resource related to time.”
Shi Yu’s expression was calm. He put away the Ice Dragon Badge and the Ice Dragon disappeared with the snow. In the next moment, he took out a white fruit. At this moment, when they saw the white fruit in Shi Yu’s hand that looked like a pineapple, many sea beasts revealed confused expressions.
Not to mention them, even the Sea Dragon King turned his head and didn’t know what it was.
Something to do with the time element?
“What’s this?” The little white dragon asked the Turtle Prime Minister in a low voice.
The turtle prime minister shook its head. With its experience after living for so long, it actually didn’t know.
At that moment, when they saw that Shi Yu had indeed taken this out, Ice Dragon, Gem Cat, and the other big shots narrowed their eyes and silently watched the show. Next, they wanted to see how destructive this thing was… They just didn’t know how Shi Yu planned to show it…
“Did you… just say that you want to join the Environmental Protection Department?”
After Shi Yu took out the Time Fruit, under the gaze of many sea beasts, he didn’t explain anything to everyone immediately. Instead, he looked at a faction.
That was the faction of the Mermaid Queen.
Apart from the overlord-level mermaid queen, there was also a pile of mermaids and a pile of pink eel-like creatures.
< Name > Cherry Heart Fish
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: High-level commander
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
< Introduction > It’s a beautiful fish from the deep sea, one of the prerequisites of mermaids. There’s a chance to evolve into a humanoid creature, mermaid.
The cherry heart fish looked like a pink eel-shaped creature with a beautiful and elegant appearance. Its body was surrounded by pink silk-like fins, and it was already somewhat similar to a mermaid.
Before they evolved into mermaids, they were already the most beautiful fish species in the deep sea. Of course, the most beautiful was definitely a mermaid. That appearance could even tempt other species.
“Fufu?”
In the mermaid faction, the Cherry Heart Fish, who was named by Shi Yu, had a nervous and surprised expression. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to suddenly look at it and talk to it.
It loved cleanliness, so it indeed felt that the Marine Environmental Protection Department was a good department and wanted to join. Shi Yu was right about this.
“General Shi Yu, what’s wrong with that?” The noble and elegant mermaid queen, whose upper body was in a humanoid form and had a beautiful appearance even among humans, asked Shi Yu.
“Your Majesty, I wonder if you can invite it to do an experiment with me.” Shi Yu smiled.
The mermaid queen glanced at the extremely ordinary Sakura Heart Fish in the group and said, “Of course. Go

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - Shocking Dragon Palace City (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 299 Shocking Dragon Palace City (1)
With that said, it nodded and said to the Sakura Heart Fish.
A moment later, the Sakura Heart Fish swam to Shi Yu nervously.
At this moment, countless sea beasts were puzzled. Why did Shi Yu suddenly call a Cherry Heart Fish over?
This Cherry Heart Fish should be a relatively ordinary member of Mermaid Island. After all, if it was a mermaid royal, it would be born in a mermaid state.
Only the commoners of the mermaid race would be born in other races, such as the Cherry Heart Fish.
However, since it could accompany the Mermaid Queen to such a place, it meant that this Sakura Heart Fish’s talent was pretty good.
Perhaps it could evolve into a mermaid in the future.
This involved an evolution-type skill of the Sakura Heart Fish. However, this evolution-type skill was definitely not easy to train. Some Sakura Heart Fish exceeded the racial limit and reached the monarch level, but they might not necessarily be able to train their evolution skills to the level where they could evolve.
“Hello.”
After the cherry Heart Fish came over, Shi Yu smiled. It was very simple why he chose this cherry Heart Fish. It was because under his gaze, he realized that this small and low-level cherry Heart Fish’s willpower was actually very good. It had reached the middle stage, comparable to Eleven.
After all, the will stage of the little white dragon and the other overlord heirs was only extremely low.
It was obvious how determined its heart was under its soft and beautiful appearance.
A high-level overlord’s will could assist in breaking through to the overlord level. It had a medium-level will, so it was completely fine to say that it had the potential of a monarch. It would definitely evolve into a mermaid in the future.
“Fufu… (Lord Shi Yu)” Yin Xinyu greeted.
“Prime Minister Turtle, can you help me?”
After the Sakura Heart Fish came up, Shi Yu called for the Turtle Prime Minister below.
Words were useless. He wanted to use experiments to show the power of the Time Fruit to the sea beasts in Dragon Palace City.
Only by showing them the true effect of the Time Fruit could they join the Ministry of Environmental Protection wholeheartedly!
Now that there were experimental subjects in the growth stage, Shi Yu called the old Turtle Prime Minister.
“Me??”
Below, the standing Turtle Prime Minister was stunned.
It was indeed very old. Ordinary Longevity Turtles had white stripes on their bodies, but the stripes on its body had already turned black. Its originally white abdomen was already a little yellow. Apart from that, its brown tortoise shell also had countless years’ marks, let alone its wrinkled and old face.
wn
Of course, with the race of the Ten Thousand Year Tortoise, even if it looked old, it could still live for a long time.
“Alright!” The Turtle Minister flew up in confusion and stood beside Shi Yu with the Sakura Heart Fish.
“This fruit is the resource I prepared for the core members of the Environmental Protection Department. Its effect might be more intuitive for everyone to see with their own eyes.” With that said, Shi Yu took out another time fruit and handed the two fruits to the Sakura Heart Fish and the Turtle Minister.
“Fufu!”
“Ah.”
When the Sakura Heart Fish and the Turtle Prime Minister saw that Shi Yu meant for them to eat this mysterious fruit, they were immediately shocked.
The Turtle Minister was still alright, but the Sakura Heart Fish’s entire body instantly burned. It didn’t understand why it could directly obtain the reward that only core members of the Environmental Protection Department could obtain?? “No problem.” Shi Yu handed it over.
Soon, as the Time Fruit was handed to Prime Minister Turtle and the Sakura Heart Fish, a new round of discussion immediately arose.
“Let the Turtle Prime Minister and that Cherry Heart Fish eat it?”
“What exactly is the effect of this fruit? Why does he have to experiment with the Turtle Prime Minister and a cherry heart fish…”
The sea beasts discussed.
Click.
At the same time, the Turtle Minister and the Cherry Heart Fish also ate the Time Fruit according to Shi Yu’s request.
Each of these Time Fruits was created by the ginseng baby that exceeded its limit. The limit of a day was one fruit, so the effect was very good. It could even take effect on monarchs.
It might not be accurate to describe it with the Time Fruit, because it was a combination skill of max-level Nutrition and max-level Time Fruit.
Shi Yu named it: Miracle Fruit.
Because in a sense, this fruit could indeed bring about a miracle…
“What’s this?” In the human area, Heavenly King Zou was still at a loss.
At the moment, all the audience’s moods were also different. Some had already made some guesses, while others were still in a daze.
“In any case, it’s a very exaggerated thing…” White Brook said beside him.” For example, it can instantly make Little Fan beside us become filled with philosophy.”
Yin Zhengfan: “?”
As soon as she finished speaking, Legend Sea Tyrant narrowed his eyes.
The Sea Dragon King also focused all his attention.
At this moment…
It had been a while since the Turtle Prime Minister and the Sakura Heart Fish had eaten the Miracle Fruit.
Under everyone’s gaze, they didn’t change much, but as time passed, something unexpected happened.
After eating the Miracle Fruit, the Turtle Prime Minister and the Cherry Heart Fish widened their eyes almost instantly. They sensed a magical power awakening the hidden potential in their bodies!!
“This…”
“Fufu ~ ~”
As the Turtle Prime Minister and the Cherry Heart Fish exclaimed in surprise, dazzling power of time instantly spread from their bodies, turning into a dazzling star!! At that moment, as time waves emitted from their bodies, their auras began to increase steadily. The sea beasts observing immediately perked up.
In the next moment.
The Sakura Heart Fish was the first to change.
The power of time on its body instantly transformed into the power of evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - Shocking Dragon Palace City (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 300 Shocking Dragon Palace City (2)
Under the white evolution light, its one-meter-long body quickly changed and grew rapidly. In the light, it didn’t take long for its body to reach more than four meters.
In the white light, the form of the body gradually changed from the cherry heart fish to another form.
Seeing this scene, the Mermaid Queen, the mermaids and the Sakura Heart Fish behind were first stunned before shaking their heads suddenly
How was this possible!
However, the real scene in front of them made the mouths of the overlord factions and monarch factions, including the mermaid factions, widen. The venue instantly fell silent.
Under the shocked gazes of all the sea beasts, as well as Yu Shu and the others, the commander-level Cherry Heart Fish just now suddenly erupted with a monarch-level deterrence under the white light and shattered the white light on its body.
At the same time, its new appearance also appeared in front of the many sea beasts.
It had a huge body, elegant pink long curly hair, watery blue eyes, beautiful appearance, a plump upper body, and a deep pink fish tail.
Its entire body displayed the deterrence of a monarch. Countless shining water beads lingered around its body, and its beautiful eyes were filled with a pitiful confusion.
Seeing this beautiful creature, countless sea beasts widened their eyes again. Heavenly King Zou, Yu Shu, and the others rubbed their eyes hard in disbelief.
Just now, it was just a commander-level Cherry Heart Fish. After eating the fruit, it directly evolved?
Moreover, it had reached the monarch level?
How was this possible!
“Roar!!!!!”
What shocked them even more was still coming. At this moment, in mid-air, the Turtle Minister also revealed its figure under the white light.
After the light collapsed, the excited and energetic roar of the Turtle Minister came! Originally less than two meters away, its body had already withered and looked like a little old man. At this moment, its body directly doubled.
