Its huge and bright brown shell, clear patterns, white spots that represented vitality on its body, thick limbs that seemed to be filled with muscles, and in addition to its ferocious and wild face and bright red pupils, none of them didn’t indicate the current situation of the turtle prime minister’s body.
“I’m young again!”
The Turtle Minister said in disbelief in the sky.
At this moment, its entire body emitted a deterrence wave stronger than the mermaid beside it. The substantial deterrence instantly made countless streams submit and linger around it.
At this moment, the Turtle Minister was teary-eyed.
It controlled its young body in disbelief.
Now, let alone the Turtle Prime Minister and the group of sea beasts, even the Sea Dragon King opened its mouth wide.
After all, ever since it came to Dragon Palace City, the Turtle Minister had already looked so old, but now…
Seeing that the Turtle Prime Minister had instantly recovered even younger and more energetic than him, as if it had returned to the strongest moment of his life, the Sea Dragon King immediately roared in confusion.
“Holy shit… Prime Minister Turtle, it…” Below, the little white dragon’s eyes widened when it saw the change in Prime Minister Turtle.
At this moment, countless sea beasts looked at the changes in the Turtle Prime Minister and the Cherry Heart Fish, and their brains suddenly felt a little uncomfortable.
In midair, Shi Yu looked around and looked at his masterpiece in satisfaction.
Then, he looked at the countless sea beasts with a smile and took out a time fruit. He explained,
“As everyone can see.”
“This fruit contains powerful time power. This time power can temporarily allow a life form in the growth stage to reach a stronger state in the future. It can also allow an old life form to recover to the peak state in its life.”
“It can lead you to the future and control the power of the future. It can also let you return to your youth and awaken the power of the
past.”
“This fruit is called the Time Fruit, also known as the Miracle Fruit. It’s a fruit that can bring miracles.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, countless sea beasts and even the Sea Dragon King revealed shocked expressions.
There was actually… such a thing?
It must be fake!
“I won’t say much about its various hidden effects. I’ll only say two that are easier to think
of.”
“For example, it can unearth potential and let you experience the form you might evolve into in advance, allowing you to find the path of evolution.”
As soon as he finished speaking, countless sea beasts with evolution potential looked at the beautiful mermaid with reddened eyes and yearning
“For example, it can also allow you to return to your youth and make up for some regrets. Cough, like some seniors who didn’t want children when they were young and missed the optimal stage of reproduction. The Time Fruit might be able to help you fulfill your dreams…”
As soon as he finished speaking, it wasn’t just the dragon babies this time. Even some overlord-level creatures’ pupils instantly constricted as they realized a possibility.
In an instant, the atmosphere of the Dragon Palace banquet became extremely hot.
Scorching gazes looked at Shi Yu, the mermaid, and the Turtle Minister!
What kind of monstrous resource was this!!!
How could there be such a heaven-defying fruit!!
Forget about some young sea beasts, even the overlord sea beasts wanted to immediately join the Environmental Protection Department and become core members!
Compared to this, the badge just now was nothing!
The hardest thing about overlord-level creatures was reproduction. Even if they successfully gave birth, it would only be one child. As Shi Yu said, this Time Fruit even represented the possibility of a second or third child?

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - Shocking Dragon Palace City (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 301 Shocking Dragon Palace City (3)
If it could give birth to a nest of overlord cubs, it would be invincible!
Even if they didn’t want to have children, who didn’t want to have a chance to return to the
peak?
“I want to join the Environmental Protection Department!!”
“Count me in!!”
“It’s not too much for me to be a core member at the overlord level!” Countless monarchs and even overlords started to shout, making Heavenly King Zou and the others’ values collapse.
What was going on!!
Where did Shi Yu find this thing!!!
It was too sick!!
The young people in the human area were all shocked. Even the Tyrannical Sea Legend took a deep breath. He suddenly felt that it was a little ridiculous for Shi Yu to use this thing as a reward.
“Of course, everyone, there’s no need to be too excited. The level of this Miracle Fruit isn’t high. It can only have an effect on life forms below the monarch level. If it’s consumed at a higher level, the price will be very high, very high, and even death. Moreover, the time effect is very short.” Shi Yu saw the enthusiastic response of so many sea beasts and felt a little embarrassed. He smiled bitterly.
As soon as he finished speaking, the smiles of the overlord-level creatures instantly stopped.
The Sea Dragon King knew that there was definitely a limit to this kind of thing. Otherwise, it would go crazy and couldn’t help but want a few.
At this moment, Shi Yu snapped his fingers. Beside him, the Turtle Prime Minister and the mermaid gradually recovered. The duration was very short, but this way, with no battle consumption, the burden on them was much smaller.
After recovering, the Turtle Prime Minister looked at Shi Yu with a fawning expression. Even if it was temporary, it still wanted it a little. It didn’t have a child.
At the side, Yin Xinyu recalled her beautiful posture just now and looked at Shi Yu in admiration. She was even more determined to join the Environmental Protection Department.
At this moment, Shi Yu added, “However, although the Miracle Fruit has restrictions, it’s also special. Its greatest characteristic is its growth ability. Its level effect will become stronger and stronger with time. Perhaps it’s only effective for monarchs now, but in special places with abundant time power, putting this fruit in there and letting the different time zone pass… It might be effective for overlords in a few decades!”
“Roar??!!!”
At this moment, the originally lost overlords were pleasantly surprised. The mood of the overlord creatures changed from low to high and returned to an excited state. This was great!
No, or it could be said that even if they paid the price of death to exchange for battle power at their peak when they were weak, it wasn’t bad. Even if they didn’t use it, as long as they had it… It was a deterrent against the enemy.
Countless sea beasts coveted the Time Fruit!
This thing… had to be made.
“Of course, the greatest flaw of this Time Fruit is that the number is limited. It’s a nonrenewable resource. I also obtained it accidentally from the ruins.”
“So, maybe only the senior members of the Environmental Protection Department can get it. If they join too late, they probably won’t.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Alright, I’ve finished talking about the benefits of the Ministry of Environment.”
“Next, everyone, welcome to join.”
“If you’re an overlord senior and want to join the Environmental Protection Department, you can directly become a core member. There’s no specific duty. You just have to register. You just have to take action when the Environmental Protection Department encounters some unsolvable difficulties.”
“Similarly, the Ministry of Environmental Protection will immediately distribute a time fruit to you.”
Countless overlords widened their eyes. There was such a good thing?
What was the difference between this and giving away the badge for free just now? “Of course, if you’re at the monarch, commander, or transcendent level, you probably won’t be able to. Even if you become an ordinary member, you have to undergo some tests.”
“The goal of the Ministry of Environment is to only recruit elites!!!”
“After all, the number of badges and fruits is really limited. I have to screen the members.”
As soon as he finished speaking, countless monarchs and commanders became nervous, afraid that they weren’t qualified.
In the next moment.
Shi Yu chuckled.
A huge blue array appeared in mid-air and under his feet.
Then, five pets condensed in the blue array.
Seeing this scene, many knowledgeable sea beasts were stunned.
“Blue summoning array, master-level Beast Tamer.”
“Minister Shi Yu… is only a master-level Beast Tamer?”
This strength was already not weak in Dong Huang’s eyes.
But in this Dragon Palace banquet where elites gathered, it was indeed not enough.
After all, the minimum requirement for participating in the Dragon Palace banquet was also a monarch faction.
However, since Shi Yu had already taken out such impressive resources, they didn’t care about Shi Yu’s strength. As long as there was milk, it was the mother!
A moment later, five pets appeared in the air. Eleven, who was more than a meter tall, crossed its arms and looked down with an invincible expression.
The huge Butterfly of Imagination flew behind Shi Yu and looked at the pile of sea beasts with a burning gaze.
Baby Ginseng’s Leaf Wings spread out and stood high in the sky. Who said it couldn’t fly!
There was also the red sword spirit Little Chi Tong, who was dancing in the air, and Susu, who had just joined the team. All the members instantly appeared beside Shi Yu. “The content of the test is also very simple.”
“Monarch level, you need to fight the Iron-eating Beast I contracted. It’s also monarch level, your examiner.” “Below commander rank, I need you to complete the test under one of my commander rank pets, the Butterfly of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, Sword Spirit, and Water Slime.” “You can choose examiners freely.”
Shi Yu smiled. He didn’t plan to miss this opportunity to train Eleven and the others. There were too many powerful pets in Dragon Palace City.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - Shocking Dragon Palace City (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 302 Shocking Dragon Palace City (4)
For example, although the Turtle Minister was only at the monarch level, at its peak, its energy value exceeded ten million. It was very terrifying It was all battle experience!
Of course, Shi Yu did not do this purely to test the battle power of these sea beasts. He even wanted to use this opportunity to screen a batch of low-level pets with the will of an overlord and join the Environmental Protection Department to become the strongest team for Susu in the future.
“Roar…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, countless sea beasts looked at the Iron-eating Beast, Little Butterfly, Baby Ginseng, and even the Water Slime in confusion.
They thought that the test would be very difficult.
In the end, they just had to fight them??
In fact, he didn’t even ask for a definite win?
Holy shit, this badge was indeed a free gift. If they won, would they become a core member and be able to get the Time Fruit!
Shi Yu was a master-level Beast Tamer. How strong could his pets be?
Of course, there were also people who were tactful. For example, when the little white dragon saw Shi Yu letting Eleven and the others be examiners, its expression immediately darkened.
Damn, it, the most talented handsome dragon in Dragon Palace City, was insta-killed by them in one move. Could ordinary sea beasts pass this test?
Fortunately, it could directly become a core member through the back door using its father!
Now, as Shi Yu mentioned the benefits and entry conditions of the Environmental Protection Department, the atmosphere of the Dragon Palace banquet instantly reached a climax!
Countless overlord sea beasts took the lead to say, “Hahaha, I have a responsibility to protect the sea. I’ll join this Environmental Protection Department!”
“Me too.”
“Brother Sponge, Brother Octopus, what do you think?”
“Joining!”
“I, the Black Flood Dragon overlord, also want to join.”
There was even less of a need to talk about the generals like the Sky Penetrating Whale that Shi Yu was familiar with. They all wanted to sign up for themselves. If they did, there would be fruits. It would be a waste not to join. Even the Turtle Minister was winking at the Sea Dragon King Could it join too?
The Sea Dragon King’s face was pitch-black. Good lord.
Ice Dragon was overjoyed. Damn, damn, so many underlings. Hahahaha. However, the Time Fruit indeed had this attraction, and Ice Dragon was not surprised. Shi Yu had already confirmed with Ice Dragon that Emperor Shi had indeed mastered the ability of the Time Fruit as well! In short, now that the overlord sea beasts were all like this, the monarch sea beasts and commander sea beasts were obviously excited as well. They looked at Eleven and the others with burning and battle intent.
At this moment, the Dragon Palace banquet… was completely in chaos.
Heavenly King Zou, who had just obtained the recognition of the Black Flood Dragon overlord and was entrusted with its son, looked at the Black Flood Dragon overlord who took the initiative to join the Environmental Protection Department with a confused expression. Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others shook their heads and lost their ability to think!
This was recruitment?? Was Shi Yu sure this wasn’t taking over Dragon Palace City??
Even a totem-level dragon king didn’t have as many overlord-level minions as him!! “Tyrannical Sea Legend… Then do we still join… Don’t tell me we also have to pass Shi Yu’s test…” Yu Shu cried.
They clearly came to accept the test of the overlord-level sea beast. Why did it become accepting Shi Yu’s test now?
Moreover, the key was that they also really wanted the badge and the fruit! Tyrannical Sea Legend was silent and didn’t answer.
He was thinking about how he should tell the people from the association about the mess at the Dragon Palace banquet.
After leading the team for so many years, this was the first time he had seen such a situation… He was very tired.
He felt that the current Shi Yu was even more “first bureau” than the people of first bureau!
Therefore, shouldn’t Dong Huang also set up a 14th Bureau of Environmental Protection Bureau for Shi Yu to be the director? If the battle power of this bureau was included in the Ocean Environmental Protection Department, its battle power would probably be at the top of the dozen or so departments in Dong Huang…

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - Hell’s Difficulty Test
chapters.content:
Chapter 303 Hell’s Difficulty Test
Dragon Yan Island.
In the Dragon Palace banquet.
At this moment, the benefits of the department had already been displayed. Soon, it was the nervous and exciting assessment segment.
“I’m the deputy minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department. If you overlords want to join the Environmental Protection Department, you can register with
me.”
The gem cat had run from the human area to Shi Yu’s side at some point in time, stunning the sea beasts.
Damn, why was this cat here again this year?
It even became the vice minister of the Marine Environmental Protection Department.
Was it going to rely on food to maintain the ecological balance of the species and indirectly protect the environment?
“I’ll be in charge of the assessment,” Shi Yu said. “So, is anyone willing to accept the assessment and join the Environmental Protection Department?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the sea beasts looked at each other.
The overlord-level sea beasts were still relatively reserved. Some directly communicated telepathically, while others planned to talk to the gem cat after the banquet.
However, the monarch and commander-level sea beasts were all eager to try.
However…
According to the previous rules, no matter the order of the banquet, it was arranged according to race and strength. Therefore, even if they wanted to accept the environmental department’s test, high-level sea beasts and races would come first.
“I wonder what’s the requirement to become a core member of the Environmental Protection Department.”
Boom!
At this moment, accompanied by a thunderclap, a figure suddenly flew over from the horizon. It emitted a shocking dragon might and landed in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Seeing this figure, the little white dragon cursed.
The surrounding sea beasts were also stunned.
This was a huge Eastern Dragon dozens of meters long. Its black body floated with white hair that was like a thundercloud. Black lightning lingered in the dragon might that shot out.
< Name > Primordial Thunder Dragon
[Attributes]: Thunder, Dragon
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
< Introduction > The second prince of Dragon Palace City, son of the Thunder Dragon King.
Energy Points: 7,060,000
“Your… Your Highness the Second Prince?!” Seeing this person, the Turtle Prime Minister was stunned. He didn’t expect this person to suddenly appear at the Dragon Palace banquet.
The moment it appeared, it looked at the Sea Dragon King and the Ice Dragon King and said, “Lord Sea Dragon King, Lord Ice Dragon King.” “Oh? You’re here too.”
The Sea Dragon King clicked its tongue. It was very familiar with this lightning dragon.
In the Dragon Palace, the little white dragon had been bullied by this guy a lot.
For this, it and the Azure Dragon King often went to the Thunder Dragon King to reason.
“It’s His Highness the Second Prince. It’s actually here too…”
Many sea beasts were shocked when they saw the Primordial Thunder Dragon.
“An impressive existence has come.” In the human area, Heavenly King Zou’s gaze immediately turned serious.
This person’s strength, among the monarch-level battle power in Dragon Palace City, was definitely at the top. Only some sea beasts with long lifespans or other opportunities might be stronger than the Primordial Thunder Dragon, and it was limited.
Most importantly, this guy was still in the high-speed growth stage. Its potential had not been stimulated at all…
In terms of strength, it might not be the strongest among the monarchs in Dragon Palace City, but in terms of potential, it was definitely one of the best.
The Primordial Thunder Dragon was an Electric Eel Transformation Dragon. It was a race with extremely strong battle power and potential among the current dragons.
“I wonder what’s the requirement to become a core member of the Environmental Protection Department.”
The sudden appearance of this Primordial Thunder Dragon was clearly also for the Time Fruit.
“If you fight it equally at the same level or defeat it, you can become a core member of the Environmental Protection Department.”
After Shi Yu saw the Primordial Thunder Dragon, he smiled and signaled for Eleven to come forward.
“Wuu!”
Eleven, who was floating in the air with the electromagnetic levitation, stepped forward.
The Primordial Thunder Dragon narrowed its eyes and looked at the little Iron-eating Beast. It also sensed that it was also playing with electricity. However, was Shi Yu serious? Letting such a little guy be an examiner…
“This… even His Highness the Second Prince has to take the assessment?”
“His Highness, the Second Prince, is almost invincible in the monarch domain of Dragon Palace City, right?”
At this moment, even some overlord heirs felt inferior when they saw the Second Prince’s Primordial Thunder Dragon.
No, or rather, even the little white dragon felt weak when it saw this guy.
The Thunder Dragon King’s battle power was one of the best among the seven Dragon Kings in Dragon Palace City. Its descendants were naturally ridiculously strong.
“Come, then!!”
The Primordial Thunder Dragon spat out lightning and circled in midair, indicating that it wanted to accept the so-called assessment.
In the face of the confidence of the Primordial Lightning Dragon and the surprise of the surrounding sea beasts, Shi Yu only smiled.
Unfortunately…
This Primordial Thunder Dragon was indeed strong, but he couldn’t let it win.
Although it was a lie to say that the Time Fruit was a nonrenewable resource, there were indeed not many Time Fruits. According to Shi Yu’s thoughts, providing each overlord with one was already very expensive.
Therefore, he had no intention of giving the Time Fruit to monarch and commander-level sea beasts from the start to make them core members.
At most, it could become an ordinary member. And how to do it was naturally to increase the difficulty of the assessment a little.
Of course, not giving it now didn’t mean not giving it in the future. However, that was after Baby Ginseng became stronger.
This way, by dragging it out slowly, these ordinary members could also work hard and pursue promotion. If they reached a high position from the start, they wouldn’t work hard.
Under normal circumstances, it was really a little difficult for Eleven to face a monarch-level divine dragon of a quasi Mythical race with 7 million energy points. Even if it won, Eleven himself would probably be quite tired and need to explode to resist the enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - Hell’s Difficulty Test (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 304 Hell’s Difficulty Test (1)
However, when he saw that this guy had lightning, Shi Yu was immediately amused.
With the Dao Proficiency storage lightning and the super lightning rod, this guy was basically equivalent to a free charging treasure.
In addition to the high proficiency explosiveness, the other party might not be able to last one round against Eleven!
However, even if the other party wasn’t a thunder-type, it wasn’t that easy for the enemy to win. After all, he was already determined to not be able to afford losing. He had made sufficient preparations.
“Then Your Highness, we won’t be polite either.” Shi Yu said.
[No need to be polite. Beat him up fiercely. If you win, I’ll give you a good thing.]
The Sea Dragon King said telepathically. However, it didn’t know if Shi Yu could do it.
Shi Yu had a strange expression and coughed dryly.
Was this alright…
“Polite? Just treat it as a normal assessment!” The Primordial Lightning Dragon said proudly. At the same time, shocking lightning shot out of its white hair.
Boom!!!
Almost instantly, its entire body was covered in endless white lightning, dazzling and domineering. Skill: Primeval Thunder Soul < Introduction > It’s a super thunder-element skill. Summon the Primeval Thunder Soul Possession. During the existence of the Thunder Soul, it can increase the user’s strength, speed, lightning strength, and battle will. At the same time, the body is protected by lightning. It can cause strong lightning damage to the enemy who comes into contact with it!
Although it was confident that it could defeat the little guy opposite, the Primordial Thunder Dragon still activated the super skill Possession at the start.
“You guys attack first.”
In the state of the Thunder Soul, the Primordial Thunder Dragon’s eyes seemed to contain lightning. It looked at the tiny Iron-eating Beast in mid-air and said.
“Then we’ll attack first.”
Shi Yu said indifferently.
At the same time, Fan Yu, Yun Shu, and the others in the human area started discussing. “Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast should have broken through to the monarch level.”
“However, the opponent is a super dragon species like the Primordial Thunder Dragon. Can it really be done…”
“This Primordial Thunder Dragon… feels like it’s not weaker than President Gao’s Ultimate Sacred Dragon Beast at all…” Yin Zhengfan said after a moment of silence.
“Believe them,” White Brook said. In her opinion, Eleven could defeat a monarch at the commander rank. Now that it was a monarch rank was fighting a monarch rank, it shouldn’t be a problem.
“It definitely can. I remember this guy…” Yu Shu was silent. He remembered that this guy was immune to lightning when facing that foreign guy’s lightning unicorn, right??
He wanted to know if Eleven was still immune to the Primordial Thunder Dragon’s dragon lightning “Can he win? Generally speaking… it’s unlikely. Even that Lu Qingyi definitely can’t defeat this lightning dragon at the master level.” Heavenly King Zou narrowed his eyes. With his strength, defeating this Primordial Lightning Dragon was naturally easy. However, Shi Yu was only an ordinary master at the moment. Moreover, he didn’t have any strengthening talent. Heavenly King Zou really wanted to know Shi Yu’s true strength!
“The battle between the Second Prince of Dragon Palace City and the human genius recognized by the four Dragon Kings?” “That creature should be an Iron-eating Beast, right? Why do I remember that this creature is a transcendent race? Did I remember wrongly?”
Many ocean overlords discussed when they saw the situation in front of them.
To be honest, under the same level and talent, human Beast Tamers were definitely stronger. This was because they had contracted many pets and had the Beast Taming Talent. The advantage was that transcendent creatures who fought alone couldn’t compare to them. But now, it was clearly 1VS1. Moreover, the pets Shi Yu sent made these ocean overlords very puzzled.
Iron-eating beast…
There were even some overlords who didn’t know about iron-eating beasts at all. After all, the sea and land were very far apart.
Therefore, they didn’t even know about the Iron-eating Beast, let alone that the Iron-eating Beast had already been researched and evolved in Dong Huang…
“Eleven!”
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t stand on ceremony and directly ordered Eleven to attack. “Thunder God Form.” “Wuu!”
Upon hearing that, white light began to linger around Eleven’s one-meter-tall body in mid-air. Its size increased crazily at a visible speed.
The Primordial Thunder Dragon, which was originally complaining that the Iron-eating Beast was too small, was stunned when it saw this scene. It saw that the little Iron-eating Beast that was just a meter tall just now was quickly enlarging. Soon, it became a huge beast ten, twenty, thirty meters tall… And it didn’t stop!
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast’s body enlargement seemed to be endless. In an instant, under the constricted pupils of the Primordial Thunder Dragon and countless sea beasts, it turned into a huge monster hundreds of meters tall.
Its body had become even larger than the Sea Dragon King and the Frost Dragon!! At this moment, this was the first time its battle power was fully released!! After the monarch level, Eleven could finally withstand this extreme transformation!
The shocking change shocked even the Sea Dragon King. It opened its mouth slightly. It had never seen a creature that could reach this level of transformation!
What shocked the Primordial Thunder Dragon and many sea beasts was that during the transformation, the Iron-eating Beast’s appearance had completely changed!
The sharp mode of Inner Power erupted and it directly turned into the form of the Nine Li Battle Beast. Under the cover of the black and silver armor, the hundred-meter eleven revealed two eyes that seemed to contain lightning. At this moment, its entire body also revealed a deterrence aura. The deterrence and the lightning wrapped around its body emitted a terrifying aura.
Because it was the deterrence of Dao Proficiency, the lightning Eleven controlled was like a king among lightning. In almost an instant, the Primeval Thunder Soul on the Primordial Thunder Dragon let out a sizzling cry. Regarding this, the Second Prince’s expression instantly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - Hell’s Difficulty Test (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 305 Hell’s Difficulty Test (2)
“Roar!!!! (How is this possible!)”
Sensing the racial and ability suppression from Eleven, the Primordial Thunder Dragon widened its eyes. It actually felt that this guy’s race was even more perfect than its own.
“Grab it!”
Under Shi Yu’s command, Eleven stretched out its huge hand wrapped in lightning. At this moment, the tiny one was the immemorial thunder dragon that had yet to grow. In the face of Eleven’s palm, the Primordial Lightning Dragon directly growled. Black lightning in the form of dragons erupted from its body, turning into a group of dragons that bit at Eleven.
Skill: Black Dragon Lightning
< Introduction > It’s a super thunder-element, dragon-element skill, special lightning.
Under the enhancement of the Primeval Thunder Soul, the destructive power of the extremely terrifying and violent Black Dragon Lightning reached the extreme. However, the moment the black tide approached Eleven’s black hardening palm, the lightning power on the lightning dragon lightning seemed to have been swallowed by a black hole, leaving only the dragon-shaped energy weakly crushed by the huge hand!
Dao Proficiency Storage Lightning, Lightning Star!
Moreover, the absorbed lightning directly made Eleven’s aura increase again, and black air waves emitted from its body. With a boom, Eleven’s deterrence erupted with all its might. The huge deterrence enveloped the body of the Primordial Thunder Dragon like the sky collapsing. Compared to the deterrence of Eleven’s Dao Proficiency with its perfect-level dragon might, the aura of the two parties was simply like the difference between heaven and earth. In an instant, the Primordial Thunder Dragon showed an expression of disbelief. Its entire body seemed to have fallen into the Thunder Abyss, and its body was pinched in Eleven’s hand!!
Seeing this scene, the little white dragon was the first to open its mouth wide with a shocked expression.
Holy shit…
In that Dragon Palace City, the Second Prince, who was a little bit stronger than it, was directly controlled by the opponent?? “Holy shit.” At that moment, Yu Shu and the others were also shocked. Seeing that the Second Prince of Dragon Palace City was restrained by Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast in a single exchange, they widened their eyes!
Although they had enough confidence in the abnormal Shi Yu, this was too easy.
The other party was the monarch-level son of a totem divine dragon!!
It was an existence that stood at the top of all races.
This guy, an Iron-eating Beast, evolved into this form and pinched it just like that? Next, was it going to tear apart the dragon with its bare hands?
“Roar!!!”
After controlling the Primordial Thunder Dragon, Eleven was actually already confident of victory, because at this moment, the distorted Primordial Thunder Dragon not only realized that the dragon power it was proud of was actually suppressed by this monster, but even the powerful lightning that erupted disappeared the moment it touched the other party and was swallowed by the other party!
How could it be such a ridiculous thing? It roared and struggled, unable to understand!
“Roar!!! (You’re a f*cking Mythical Race, right!!)”
The Second Prince of Dragon Palace City shouted at Eleven, its mentality breaking down.
At that moment, the Sea Dragon King, the Turtle Prime Minister, and the many sea overlords watched the outcome of this battle in shock. They never expected that this “Dragon Palace City’s Minister of Environment” was also so powerful!
Was this Iron-eating Beast… a monster?!
In an instant.
Many monarch-level sea beasts also had drastic changes in their expressions along with the Primordial Thunder Dragon. Wait, wait, wait, f*ck, how could there be such an examiner? It immediately restrained the strongest monarch of the monarch group in Dragon Palace City. How could they take the test? Was this a test that they really wanted to pass?? Not good!!

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange
chapters.content:
Chapter 306 The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange
The battle between Eleven and the Primordial Thunder Dragon showed the effect of the skills in a battle.
The strength of the dragon race’s body was strong, but the 100-meter enlargement directly raised its strength to the maximum, a perfect crushing!
The lightning dragon’s Black Dragon Lightning was powerful, and Eleven directly countered it with the Lightning Resistance and Lightning Absorption skill!
Even if the overall attributes of the Primordial Thunder Dragon were a little stronger than Eleven in various aspects, it seemed a little helpless under the suppression of the skill.
Skill proficiency was Shi Yu’s pet’s greatest advantage!
In terms of skills, apart from overlords who trained super skills to perfection, or totems that trained super skills to perfection, there should be very few creatures below overlord level that could compete with Shi Yu’s pets.
“Second Prince, let’s stop here. You might still be a little lacking from the standard of a core member.”
“However, with your potential, I believe you can quickly be promoted to a core member.” “Roar!!”
Eleven squeezed its hard palms, and the Primordial Lightning Dragon’s face turned green and red. It was so angry that it gritted its teeth.
Why was lightning ineffective against this guy!
Why was this guy stronger than him!
This was the first time the Primordial Thunder Dragon had experienced such an aggrieved battle.
“Heh, you’ve already done pretty well. After all, Shi Yu is a Beast Tamer cultivated by me,” Ice Dragon said happily.
“His aptitude is 60% as elegant as Emperor Shi back then.”
“You should start as an ordinary member.”
Countless sea beasts looked at the Ice Dragon with respect. As expected of a senior who had survived from the early stages of the Dong Huang Dynasty! Shi Yu: “?”
Eleven: ??
What did it have to do with this guy!!!
It couldn’t even defeat Mu Huiyin, why was this guy dragging Emperor Shi into this!
However, Shi Yu suddenly felt that Ice Dragon’s shameless aura was a little similar to
his.
He didn’t contract the ice dragon either. But, was his shamelessness powerful enough to subtly influence it… What was going on..
“I, I understand.” When the Ice Dragon King totem spoke, the Primordial Thunder Dragon immediately admitted defeat in admiration.
After all, if it continued, it wouldn’t look good if it lost consciousness.
After the second prince admitted defeat, Eleven let go of the huge palm. Under the light shining from its body, it shrank to a size of less than centimeters and cried out.
“…” Seeing Eleven suddenly become a harmless panda, the Second Prince wanted to say something but hesitated. It cursed in his heart.
No wonder Dragon Palace City wanted to befriend humans for generations. These human Beast Tamers were too bullshit.
“I’ll start from an ordinary member. My strength is indeed lacking.” After the Primordial Thunder Dragon admitted defeat, it obediently landed in a public area and planned to continue watching.
It wanted to see who could defeat this thing.
It wasn’t convinced!
As long as no one could defeat that black and white thing, as long as everyone lost and couldn’t become a core member, then it technically didn’t lose as well! “Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and nodded.
At this moment, the scene suddenly fell silent.
After all, many monarchs had seen the battle just now.
They believed that they would be insta-killed by the second prince.
Then wouldn’t challenging the black and white monster that suppressed the Second Prince in one move be stupid!
In the human area, the few masters who had graduated from top universities took a deep breath.
“This Shi Yu is only in his first year…”
Wasn’t this strength a little too scary?
Even they couldn’t guarantee that they could defeat that second prince, let alone easily defeat him.
Logically speaking, shouldn’t a first-year student be at a different level? They looked at Yu Shu.
Yu Shu: “?”
Yin Zhengfan:… “Heh.” White Brook was in high spirits.
Heavenly King Zou fell into deep thought. Fortunately, Shi Yu didn’t have that special battle strengthening talent. Otherwise, other young Beast Tamers wouldn’t be able to live!
“Roar!! (Excuse me, I’m commander rank, do I have a chance to become a core member?)”
Among the monarch ranks, no sea beast spoke for a long time. Suddenly, a commander rank overlord heir spoke.
It was a huge shark nearly ten meters long and completely dark blue. Its side had red intelligent eyes and black gills, and the sharp teeth it revealed seemed to be able to bite through everything.
[Name]: Deep Sea Dragon Shark
[Attributes]: Water, Dragon [Race Level): Low-level overlord
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Energy Points: 90,000 Shi Yu looked over and felt that he had heard of this guy somewhere. It seemed that it had been called a fool by the little white dragon when he met it.
“Does a commander rank have a chance to become a core member? Of course.” Shi Yu looked at its indeed not very smart appearance and smiled.
“The core position of the Environmental Protection Department depends on potential, so even if it’s only commander rank, transcendent rank, and awakening rank, there’s still a chance to become a core member. However, the conditions are definitely even harder.”
“Roar??? (Really?)” The shark’s expression was delighted.
“Well, as long as you defeat them, you can become core members.” Shi Yu walked past Eleven, who had just finished fighting, and pointed at Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu, who were still training their willpower at the lower level.
“They’re also commander rank. Of course, their strength is definitely not bad.”
“Roar! (Then can I choose an examiner freely?)” The shark said in surprise.
“Sure, you can choose the examiner freely. At that time, you can become a core member after defeating the examiner. If you lose, but do well, you can become an ordinary member. But if you lose very badly… Then…” Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 307 The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (1)
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the monarch-level sea beasts immediately hated themselves for being monarch-level and not commander-level.
As for the commander-level sea beasts, they were all overjoyed.
Forget everything else.
They looked at the water ball. Wasn’t this the Water Slime?
Not bad, what the hell?
They didn’t know about the iron-eating beasts, so they could just treat it as a very strong race. But the Water Slime, this was clearly… the bottom of the water-eating food chain!
There was also the small red sword that kept shaking its head. It was fire-element, right! It must be fire-element! It was countered by water!
As for the flying ginseng baby, apart from its wings that were a little unfamiliar, they had also seen its appearance!!
They looked at the ginseng roots imported from the ground on the plate in front of them and fell into deep thought. They silently placed them in their mouths and chewed…
Among the four pets, only the butterfly seemed to have something going on.
This difficulty clearly looked much smaller than challenging the Iron-eating Beast.
“Roar!! (Then I want to challenge that Water Slime Examiner!!)”
The shark shouted and looked at Susu with intelligence.
“As expected of my son, It’s not too stupid.” Behind the baby shark, the even larger shark overlord thought to itself.
Although most overlord-level sea beasts did not have perception or reconnaissance skills, with their experience, they could vaguely sense the strength of Shi Yu’s pets in the sky. Every pet summoned by Shi Yu was very strong among those of the same level. This ocean overlord could be sure. However, if they had to find the weakest one, then these overlords would undoubtedly choose the water slime.
Many overlords cast appreciative gazes at the shark.
Apart from Doctor Shell and the other overlords…
“Sure.” As the shark made its choice, Shi Yu nodded.
At the same time, below, the little white dragon had just finished mocking the second prince in secret when it cast a silly look at the shark.
Similarly, Yu Shu and the others cast sympathetic gazes.
F*ck, that was a water slime that could directly break through to the monarch level!
Even the son of the Sea Dragon King was insta-killed by it in one move. How could a low-level overlord race’s shark dare try!
If it was said that everyone might still have doubts about the water slime’s situation previously, Yu Shu and the others vaguely guessed why that water slime could break through at the last minute.
It must have eaten the Time Fruit!
This Water Slime had the ability to store the nature of the Time Fruit and didn’t need to eat it at the last minute!
“Susu.” As the shark chose Susu, Shi Yu called it out. Susu immediately turned into a stream of water and flew over, taking Eleven’s place and looking at the shark below.
“Ning!!” It was a little nervous on such a big occasion.
However, it would work hard to defeat the other party.
“Roar!” Compared to Susu, the shark appeared much more confident. It was a young version of the second prince. It swam into the sky confidently.
However, just as it came out, it suddenly trembled.
He sensed the scrutinizing gazes of the Sea Dragon King, the Turtle Prime Minister, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, and the other big shots.
“…” The shark suddenly panicked. Wh-what was going on? “Don’t be nervous, you attack first.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said.
Then, he looked at Susu.
[Race Name]: Mutated Water Slime (Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation Body)
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: High-level Monarch (Quasi overlord)
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Race Skill]:
Low-level: Bubble (Dao Proficiency), Lightning Resistance (Expert), Poison Resistance (Expert)
Intermediate: Water Regeneration (Expert), Boiling Water (Expert), Freezing Water (Expert), Purification (Expert)
High-level: Water Dragon Ball (Expert), Multiplication (Expert), Rain Praying (Expert), Steam Explosion (Expert), Guardian Water (Expert)
Super level: Water Elemental Control (Initiate)
[Taught Skill):
Advanced: Deterrence (Expert), Absolute Sleep (Expert)
Super level: Infinite Devour (Initiate)
Energy Points: 90,000
The reason why he let Susu come out as an examiner was not only because it could store the nature of the Time Fruit in the infinite devouring space and use it at any time.
It was because after the Tyrannical Sea Legend stopped him, Shi Yu temporarily gave Susu some overtime.
It was just a casual point adding. It wasn’t high, but it was enough for Susu to have very strong battle power.
In addition, it could indeed use the Time Fruit to cheat. There was no need to use it too much, though. It only converted a little of its nature and its battle power doubled. It was not something ordinary commander-level pets could fight against.
Apart from that, it was worth mentioning… It was a pity that after devouring the turtle shell, Susu still couldn’t awaken super skills.
Absolute Sleep also didn’t become a racial skill. It had only awakened a high-level water-element skill, Water Protection.
However, this skill was also useful.
As the name suggested, this skill could create water that could protect the target.
After training to perfection, the water created with the could have autonomy, could differentiate between friend and foe, and could detect dangerous auras. When danger was imminent, it would automatically protect the target and be immune to most damage.
At the same time, after reaching transcendent, it could also leave the user and exist independently in the outside world for a long time.
In short, this was a very friendly move for Beast Tamers. Shi Yu planned to give Susu priority to this skill in the future. At that time, not only could he have one more protective talisman, but he would also have one more skill to build equipment…

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 308 The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (2)
“(Roar) Then I won’t be polite!” At the same time, under the gazes of many sea beasts, the shark roared and instantly condensed the Giant Shark Skill in front of its mouth!
Buzz!
Around it, hundreds of ferocious-looking water sharks the size of water bottles quickly condensed.
In an instant, these water sharks attacked Susu like a rain of arrows!
Skill: Giant Shark
< Introduction > It’s a water-element super skill. It can create a Giant Shark made of water elements. The Giant Shark can devour the enemy’s energy through biting. When the Giant Shark returns to its main body, it can replenish the devouring energy to the user.
It was unknown if the shark was protective of the fairer sex or if its attitude was serious. Although it had used a super skill right from the start and didn’t underestimate the enemy, this super skill was considered to have relatively low lethality. It would only devour the enemy’s energy completely and not cause any serious damage. The Hundred Water Shark attacked Susu, and at this moment, Susu only used a very simple skill.
“Hu!!!” Its body swelled until it was round. It blew bubbles in big mouthfuls. Then, an incomparably huge water bubble was blown up by it.
Seeing this scene, many sea beasts were slightly stunned.
Was he planning to use his low-level racial skill to fight head-on with the super racial skill of the Shark Clan?
Skill: Bubble
< Introduction > It’s a low-level water-element skill. It creates water bubbles. When the water bubbles are touched, the water will explode.
No matter how he thought about it, it wasn’t a quantitative water-type skill.
However, the next scene exceeded the imagination of most sea beasts. They saw Susu blowing the bubble wider and wider. In the blink of an eye, the transparent water bubble became dozens of meters wide. As for itself, after blowing the bubble, it immediately hid in the bubble!
The moment the attacking Giant Shark touched the bubble, it didn’t detonate the bubble. Instead, it was absorbed into the bubble with a bang. Then, it was stunned on the spot and didn’t continue attacking the Water Slime.
Dong! Dong! Dong! Dong! Dong! In a short moment, many Giant Devouring Sharks were swallowed by the bubble. After entering, they directly lost their intelligence. The shark also lost its connection with them with a stunned expression, shocking it to immediately control the other Giant Devouring Sharks to not come into contact with the bubble.
Unfortunately, under Susu’s control, this incomparably huge bubble began to advance and continue to expand. It suddenly swallowed a large number of Giant Devouring Sharks.
“Ning!! (I’ll return it to you!!)”
With the nature of the Dao Proficiency level bubble wrap skill, Susu directly cracked the other party’s skill. Moreover, on the jelly-like water slime’s body, it used its talent skill elementalization to condense a water elemental hand. Its thin hand made a finger gun gesture. With a boom, it raised its finger. The huge bubble dozens of meters in diameter seemed to have been injected with hormones. It didn’t fly slowly like other bubble skills at all. Instead, it was like a cannonball shot out, a falling Mercury, and flew towards the shark with a boom!
“Roar!!! (Damn!)” Seeing this strange bubble skill, the shark was instantly stunned. The other sea beasts were also stunned. When the shark reacted, it was already wrapped in the huge bubble.
At this moment, Susu was already outside the bubble, watching the show quietly.
Seeing this, the shark roared and swung its body. Another super racial skill with extreme lethality was activated. This time, it was the “Deep Sea Fang’ famous for its lethality and destructive power.
It was said that it could compress the power of water that was comparable to a tsunami onto the huge teeth of its race. Coupled with the natural huge teeth, it formed an incomparable tearing force, causing both physical and elemental damage! In the face of the bubble that wrapped itself, the Wyrm Shark raised its head. Its huge teeth turned into sharp blades as it suddenly charged towards the outside world in an attempt to leave. However, the Deep Sea Tooth that could cut apart a tsunami bit at the bubble like a fist hitting cotton, only causing a ripple. At this moment, the Wyrm Shark was stunned again.
Countless sea beasts opened their mouths wide and looked at the shark that was being played by the Water Slime.
Wait a minute… This plot… was wrong!
Why was the ability of a water slime so ridiculous!
Low-level bubbles suppressed two super skills?
Even if the shark was still weak and had never trained its super skills much, it shouldn’t be crushed by low-level skills…
In the next moment, something that made the shark even more panicked appeared. The huge bubble suddenly started to shrink, instantly changing from a circular bubble to a bubble membrane that stuck to its body. At this moment, let alone losing control once it had entered the bubble, the shark felt that its body instantly lost control!
“I’ll give you ten seconds. If you can break free of the bubble, you can become an ordinary member of the Environmental Protection Department.”
“If you can’t break free in ten seconds, the bubble will explode. You will fail this battle, and the test will fail.” Shi Yu’s words, which were narrowed, were like the whisper of a demon in the heart of the shark. It looked at the blurry water slime in the distance in horror and struggled with all its might.
Then, it felt the membrane that was stuck to its body begin to burn. Almost instantly, the shark felt like it was about to be cooked.
The current bubble began to look like a huge boiling pot boiling hot water, making the shark suffer indescribably. Under the boiling water, its struggle became stronger and stronger. One second, two seconds, three seconds… eight seconds… nine seconds…
And this scene was even more ridiculous in the eyes of many sea beasts.
The dragon species of a low-level overlord race was tested by the water slime of a transcendent race… They opened their mouths wide and quickly realized that Shi Yu wasn’t lying, nor was there a need to lie. This weak species of water slime in their impression was ridiculously strong!

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 309 The Test Is Becoming More and More Strange (3)
Just like that Iron-eating Beast, it was almost invincible at the same level. It was definitely comparable to an overlord race!
“Silly boy—Why did you choose it?—There must be a reason for things to be abnormal. Although this water slime looks weak, there’s clearly something wrong!” The shark overlord cursed his disappointing son.
Wasn’t it better to choose other pets? It had failed!
Embarrassing!
The family was unlucky!
“Roar!!!”
As time was about to end, the shark roared. Finally, as Susu held back a little, it penetrated the water bubble with an extremely excited expression and instantly swam far away.
It couldn’t be helped. After all, it was the son of an overlord. It was not bad to take him in as an ordinary member to run errands. Shi Yu wasn’t that unreasonable.
At the same time, the time limit of the boiling shark-shaped bubble reached the limit. In the next moment, it exploded with a bang. Almost in an instant, the terrifying steam turned into a wave of air that was comparable to a tsunami, pushing in all directions. The shark that was originally happy to break free from the bubble was instantly sent flying out in a daze and smashed onto the ground.
Following that, the spreading steam produced a second explosion. “Boom” explosive sounds swept the entire sky. It was as if fireworks appeared in the Dragon Palace banquet. The continuous explosions made the shark on the ground tremble.
Countless sea beasts opened their mouths wide. They didn’t expect a bubble to produce so many subsequent reactions.
The terrifying power made many sea beasts no doubt at all that if this Water Slime didn’t give the shark a chance to break free and directly detonated the bubble instead, the shark would instantly be blown into rotten fish wings!
At this moment, how could the dragon shark still have the thought of defeating the water slime? It directly felt a lingering fear.
“Congratulations on passing the assessment of ordinary members. Do you still want to continue?”
In the sky, Shi Yu smiled at the shark.
“Ning!” Susu also had its hands on its hips. She had yet to fight to her heart’s content.
Below, the shark with several burn marks on its body was stunned. It shook its head crazily. What a joke!!
If this continued, it would die!!
“I admit defeat, I admit defeat. Ordinary members are pretty good too…” it hurriedly said.
Obviously, the shark that wanted to pick a weak opponent chose the wrong one. It couldn’t even make Susu convert the power of the Time Fruit!
Seeing this, the Sea Dragon King and the other big shots looked at Susu in admiration. As expected of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. It was awesome, just different from ordinary water slimes. The heir of an overlord? It could beat it up just like that!!
Seeing that Susu wasn’t bullied and instead easily defeated her opponent, the Sea Dragon King was amused and very satisfied. However, the expressions of those commander-level sea beasts instantly darkened like the monarch-level sea beasts from before.
Just as the monarch-level sea beasts were complaining about how ridiculous the commander-level test was, the commander-level sea beasts even cried. This Water Slime was clearly not easy to bully. They knew very well how strong the shark was. Although it couldn’t be considered strong at the commander level, it wasn’t weak either. In short, Shi Yu definitely didn’t want them to easily become core members. They were certain!
At that moment, the little shark touched its burn marks in pain, as if it felt that it couldn’t continue to be so embarrassed. Since its strength wasn’t enough, it had to show its intelligence and ask more information for the other sea beasts to highlight its existence. It asked intelligently…
“Minister Shi Yu, the commander level test is so difficult. Wuwuwu, what kind of test will be given to the transcendent and awakening levels?”
“Uh…” The little shark’s question indeed stumped Shi Yu. Shi Yu’s thoughts were very simple. It was the will of an overlord. However, this definitely couldn’t be said directly. Moreover, the chances of finding it were really not high. After a moment of silence, he felt that it wasn’t too good to let Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others use their clones to test those weak ones. Therefore, he thought for a moment and said,
“This is even easier. Just defeat me in the transcendent and Awakening tests. It’s very simple, right?” Now that he had the strength of a bean bear, it shouldn’t be difficult to deal with sea beasts below the commander rank!
The sea beasts, Heavenly King Zou, and the others:?? Why was the test getting more and more strange!!

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - The Next Generation of Dragon Palace City
chapters.content:
Chapter 310 The Next Generation of Dragon Palace City
Shi Yu chuckled and thought about which transcendent and awakened sea beast would challenge him.
However, at this moment, clearly no transcendent or awakened-level sea beast dared to move rashly.
With the battle just now as a precedent, there was definitely something wrong with Shi Yu being so confident now!
(Could this guy be a ferocious hybrid?]
Many sea beasts muttered in their hearts. Otherwise, what gave Shi Yu the confidence to challenge the sea beasts with his human body?
“Is Shi Yu’s physique very good…?”
Heavenly King Zou asked in confusion.
White Brook: “That isn’t the problem here…”
“When he was a high-level Beast Tamer, his physique wasn’t inferior to a commander-level ferocious beast.”
“Now, he’s a master-level Beast Tamer. I reckon… his physique should be close to that of a monarch-level ferocious beast.”
“Well… Although I have to consider the fact that transcendent creatures have skills, it shouldn’t be a problem for Shi Yu to rely on his physical body to defeat some weaker commander-level creatures.”
Yin Zhengfan and the others :…
Tyrannical Sea Legend :…
“This…? So, it’s really not a hybrid?” Heavenly King Zou couldn’t believe it. His Beast Taming Space was already level six, one level higher than Shi Yu, but why did he feel that its physique wasn’t even half as good as Shi Yu’s?! “Usually, in school he looks weak, but in the end, he’s like a freak. So every time, he’s always been over-training.” Yu Shu curled his lips. He didn’t doubt White Brook’s words. After all, during the Heroic Spirit Ruins, Shi Yu had relied on the level of an intermediate Beast Tamer to withstand the possession of the heroic spirit of a high-level overlord of the same level…
After all, that was a violent sword spirit that the Ice Dragon General judged to be impossible to withstand at the same level. In Yu Shu’s eyes, Shi Yu was no different from a human-shaped ferocious beast. He even suspected that Shi Yu could smash his bone dragon with a punch now.
“How can he find a girlfriend like this…” The blue-haired girl was stunned.
“Find a hybrid to solve it perfectly,” the hybrid Dragonman said. “Of course, I’m not talking about me.”
“I have a sister… I’ll lay my cards on the table. I want to be this guy’s brother-in-law.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend was silent towards the gossip.
“Little White Dragon, go. You should also contribute to purifying the sea.”
Just as everyone was waiting for the next sea beast to challenge Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong…
Suddenly, the Sea Dragon King spoke to the little white dragon that had learned the power of the north wind.
If it was said that before Shi Yu took out the reward, it would still be alright with sending its little white dragon in as a core member… Now that Shi Yu had taken out such a precious reward, even the Second Prince had accepted the test. Logically speaking, it should let the little white dragon go through the program. It was equivalent to training.
Wa
To be honest, the Sea Dragon King was still a little confident in his son.
Although it had been pampered and had never experienced setbacks, it had inherited its and the Azure Dragon King’s abilities at the same time. According to the human detection method, the Wyrm Shark only had 90,000 energy points, and its son was as high as 160,000. Obviously, the difference between the overlord races was also huge.
When transcendent life forms reached the totem level, they basically trained their racial skills to transcend perfection. It was equivalent to them already trying to open up their own path. At this stage, the powerful life realm could not only allow the elemental totems to imprint their traces of existence in nature, reaching the effect that made them very difficult to kill, but it could also allow traditional creatures to change, optimize their bloodlines, develop new racial skills, make up for their racial flaws, and customize the next generation’s racial skills.
Among the commander ranks in Dragon Palace City, the little white dragon’s strength was also considered the first tier. Its race was very perfect, and it could break through to the monarch level at any time. However, the Sea Dragon King was not in a hurry to let it break through. Instead, it let it continue to build a foundation. This way, it could have the ability to compete with the monster-like Second Prince and the even more ridiculous Eldest Prince in the future.
Of course, as Eleven defeated the Second Prince, the Sea Dragon King was not very confident at this moment. This was because it felt that Shi Yu’s pet was also suppressing its level. The aura of the butterfly it sensed previously didn’t seem to lose to its son at all…
In short, those who could suppress levels were all monster geniuses.
From the Awakening Level to the Commander Level, the energy form would change in the three forms of Gas, Liquid, and Solid. As the pet grew and trained, the energy form would slowly accumulate, compress, and change its form in the creature’s body. Every growth and transformation represented an energy qualitative change in a transcendent life form. It could bring a large increase in energy, and the increase in energy would also lead to the increase in all the qualities in the body. If it was said that the transformation of energy from the Awakening Stage to the Commander Stage was still a macroscopic change, then the breakthrough from the Commander Stage to the Monarch Stage was the huge energy in the commander rank creature’s body. From a microscopic point of view, it was the process of perfectly integrating into the most basic composition of the extraordinary creature’s body.
During this process, the energy would even more exaggeratedly change the pet’s body, spirit, and soul to increase the pet’s life level. Then, the pet’s entire body would undergo an extremely huge transformation. The deterrence skill was also awakened independently by the increase in life level during this process.
At this moment, the energy and the transcendent lifeform had reached the most coordinated state. After the pet reached that stage, it could control the power in its body more easily and train various skills with twice the effect with half the effort.
Generally speaking, it was impossible for a commander-level life form to grow to the monarch level. It was just like how humans naturally grew up. It was the autonomy of their bodies that subtly changed. Changing and growing required time. When the opportunity arrived, they naturally broke through. Transcendent life forms couldn’t decide anything

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - The Next Generation of Dragon Palace City (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 311 The Next Generation of Dragon Palace City (1)
However, for some powerful creatures, because they had trained the proficiency of various skills to an extremely high level when they were at the commander rank, their microscopic control of energy might be even more proficient than monarch-level creatures. Because such creatures were too genius, they could use the perfect energy control to slow down or even stop the microscopic energy in their bodies to integrate and strengthen the basic units of the body, thereby achieving the pressure effect.
Apart from that, it was very difficult to suppress it. It might have to rely on contracts and other methods to restrict its growth.
In the Sea Dragon King’s eyes, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming level was enough, and the strength of the pets like the Butterfly of Imagination was also enough, but they had yet to break through to the monarch level. They were definitely suppressing their levels. That Iron-eating Beast must have experienced similar stages. Only through this method could the Iron-eating Beast’s strength be so ridiculous.
In fact, the Sea Dragon King’s judgment was also right. Before Eleven broke through to the monarch level, all the skills, be it racial skills or teaching skills, apart from super skills, were basically at the maximum proficiency. Its control over energy was completely incomparable to creatures of the same level, so it naturally easily held back its power to a low level.
In fact, during the breakthrough, it would also rely on its powerful energy control. Not only would it use the energy in its body to change its body, but it also borrowed the power of the natural heavenly lightning to strengthen its body. If not for its exaggerated lightning control, it definitely wouldn’t be able to achieve such a breakthrough that exceeded the limit.
“Huh???”
At the same time, when it heard that its father wanted it to accept the test too and enter the Environmental Protection Department openly, the little white dragon’s face immediately fell.
Many overlords also looked at the little white dragon.
The White Azure Dragon was one of the commander-level dragons in Dragon Palace City. Creatures like flood sharks were completely unable to defeat the little white dragon.
Perhaps… the little white dragon had a chance…?
“It’s inferior to me at the same level. If I pass the test, it won’t look good!” However, the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince knew in its heart.
Moreover, the little white dragon’s response confirmed the second prince’s words.
“I think I should stay out of it…” The White Dragon looked at the Sea Dragon King with a bitter expression. At the same time, it looked at Eleven, Chi Tong, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng.
It couldn’t tell its father that they had met and fought before… Just the deterrence skill alone was enough to scare it silly. It originally thought that it was very impressive for it to train its dragon might to perfection at the commander level, although it had used a pile of resources.
But these four guys were all transcendent-level deterrence. It was very ridiculous, alright!!!
It estimated that in Dragon Palace City, there were definitely less than 20 people who had mastered transcendent deterrence, including nine totems!
What was it supposed to do?! None of Shi Yu’s pets were simple.
“Actually… I’ve interacted with Senior Shi Yu’s pet before. I… might not be his match. Haha… Ha…” The little white dragon said awkwardly.
It didn’t tell its family about being fished up and beaten up at all…
Sea Dragon King: “?”
“Huh???” The Sea Dragon King widened its eyes and looked at the little white dragon. “You’ve come into contact with it??”
“Which one?”
“All, all…” The little white dragon said in embarrassment. In any case, it didn’t want to fight again here. It would directly admit defeat. It wasn’t like it didn’t see what the Second Prince was like. When the time came, it would directly be insta-killed by a deterrence. It would be even more awkward.
As the little white dragon finished speaking, everyone fell silent. Many sea beasts looked at the little white dragon in disbelief and at the butterfly, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong. Did the Third Prince mean that its strength was inferior to every pet here??
How was this possible!!!
It was a son of two totems! It couldn’t defeat a supplement? As a divine dragon, it couldn’t defeat a worm?
“Cough, cough. Third Prince, you’re too polite. It was also very difficult for them to win back then.” Seeing the little white dragon directly self-destruct in a silly manner, Shi Yu was also embarrassed. Was it stupid? If it didn’t care about looking good then its father did! He quickly made it look better.
“No, no,” the little white dragon said guiltily. “In any case, I’ve already fought. I’m indeed a little inferior to the standard of a core member. Why don’t I start from an ordinary member? After all, even the ‘invincible second prince with strength, talent, and potential to dominate Dragon Palace City’ is an ordinary member.”
The Primordial Lightning Dragon: “?”
The Sea Dragon King was silent for a moment. Below, the gem cat’s expression was the most strange.
Alright.
At this moment, as the Sea Dragon King and the little white dragon self-destructed, the commander-level sea beast below who wanted to become a core member and obtain the Time Fruit felt even weaker.
It was cold.
At the same time, countless commander-level sea beasts began to panic. Their gazes kept jumping on Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and the Slime. For a moment, they actually had difficulty choosing!
Which one… should they choose?
It was not easy to choose at all!
Obviously, at this speed, the recruitment of the Environmental Protection Department might take a long time. After all, there were too many sea beasts who wanted to join. Shi Yu scratched his cheek and thought for a moment before saying with a smile, “Why don’t the next recruitment of the Environmental Protection Department be carried out in an independent space? Those who are willing, come here to queue for the assessment. It won’t delay everyone’s banquet time. You can come over at any time during the entire Dragon Palace banquet stage.”
Then, Shi Yu waved his hand, and a spatial ripple appeared below. This was a spatial portal to the ruins space of Shi Yu. Next, he planned to slowly give these sea beasts a test in the ruins. For this test, he had gotten Baby Ginseng to prepare supplements for a long time in advance. The goal was to let Buggy and the others fight for a few days and nights to sharpen their will.
Although there might not be a life-and-death battle, apart from the overlord will, the other stages of will, such as low and intermediate will, didn’t have such high requirements. The confidence of victory accumulated from fighting thousands of sea beasts for several days would definitely be able to help their will increase.
Usually, they underwent various difficult training. Now, it was time to sublimate their willpower through continuous victories.
“Alright…” The Sea Dragon King agreed to this. Many monarch-level sea beasts and commander-level sea beasts also sighed softly when they saw this.
Great!!! There was no need to be beaten in front of so many big shots. Good, good, good!
If it was a test in a private space, it was alright to die.
As Shi Yu made a decision, the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince, the young Wyrm Shark, and the others revealed bitter expressions. Holy shit, why didn’t he make this decision earlier? Why did they have to do this!!
Then, under the strange expressions of most sea beasts and under the silent gazes of Yin Zhengfan and the others, the Dragon Palace Banquet and the Environmental Protection Department began to move in sync. However, no matter how one looked at it, this Dragon Palace banquet still changed.
In the outside world, the Dragon Palace banquet was in full swing.
However, from time to time, there would be overlord cubs that walked out of the testing space almost suspiciously.
“Freak, a freak, what the hell… Wuwuwu, that butterfly can summon the illusions of the Ice Dragon King and the Sea Dragon King!!”
“What, it even used an illusion to hit you? I was directly insta-killed by Psychic power.”
“Ahhh, the ginseng baby I chose is the strange one. It insta-killed me with one deterrence.”
“Why did I receive a fruit that would explode! I thought it could be eaten, but it exploded in my mouth! My teeth!”
“That sword spirit is clearly the most ridiculous, alright? It can also expand. At the start of the battle, I realized that the other party wasn’t to be trifled with, so I quickly retreated 39 meters. It directly turned it into a 40-meter-long sword and cut me down!”
“Ah, I’m dead. Yours was a 40-meter long sword. It hit me and directly separated 100 clones. The clones will even become phoenixes… Do you know what despair is?”
“Wu Wu Wu Wu, I was punched to the ground by Minister Shi Yu…”
Many sea beasts surprisingly discovered that everyone had lost, and it was not so awkward anymore. They even discussed how they had lasted for a few seconds and actually became the capital for the sea beasts in Dragon Palace City to show off. In the outside world, many overlords looked at the Dragon Palace banquet that was gradually becoming ridiculous with the discussion and fell into deep thought. They kept feeling that the next generation of Dragon Palace City was going to collapse.
Three days later! A human figure with dragon horns floated in the sky above the Dragon Banquet Island. When it arrived, the Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the other totems didn’t sense anything
The Dragon God of the Dragon Palace City listened to the discussion of the next generation at the Dragon Palace banquet in silence and fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - The Dragon God Is Here
chapters.content:
Chapter 312 The Dragon God Is Here
In Shi Yu’s ruins space.
After fighting for three days and three nights, Shi Yu and the others had already killed countless sea beasts.
During this period, countless sea beasts entered.
Among them, the commander-level test of Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng was relatively easy. No sea beast could force them to use their full strength.
Shi Yu easily won the tests below the transcendent level.
The only ones who felt a little uncomfortable were Susu and Eleven.
Some commander-level sea beasts… Susu had to rely on the power of the Time Fruit to win. Although the power activated each time was not much, it was very tiring to be unable to withstand it many times.
As for Eleven, it was purely because it had encountered too many powerful sea beasts.
Under commander rank, no matter how strong it was, it wouldn’t be that strong. It basically hadn’t cultivated super skills.
However, the upper and lower limit of monarch-level sea beasts was too big.
Some monarch-level sea beasts had just broken through. Their super racial skill proficiency was only at entry level, proficient, or just proficient. They were very weak. However, some monarch-level sea beasts couldn’t be said to be the younger generation.
They had already trained their super skills to an extremely close to perfect proficiency. They were just short of breaking through to the overlord level.
If the skill proficiency was divided into numbers, entry level was 1, proficiency was 2, expert level was 4, and perfection was 16. The closer a super racial skill was to a perfect monarch, the more terrifying its strength would be. It might be several times the battle power of a weaker monarch.
There was basically no weak sea beast like this, so every time they fought, Eleven had to explode and explode.
Compared to Buggy and the others who could easily deal with the test, Eleven was simply teary-eyed. It would overload every time. After three days, even if Shi Yu had prepared a bunch of recovery methods in advance, it was straining.
Fortunately, most of the sea beasts here were water-element, and they were still countered by Eleven. Moreover, no Beast Tamer gave them strengthening talent. Otherwise, it would be really difficult for Eleven to maintain a perfect victory.
Therefore, Eleven should be the one to collect the most gains this time.
It was mainly because Eleven had yet to reach the peak of the monarch level. The proficiency of super skills was still not high, and it wasn’t even proficient yet, so there was still a lot of room for growth.
It purely relied on high-level races+a pile of low-level, mid-level, and high-level racial skills to survive. The battle experience gained this time was not something Buggy and the others could compare to.
“Uh.”
“No more?”
In the ruins space, after sending away another Red Prawn, Shi Yu and the others waited for the next candidate.
However, a minute passed this time. No next candidate came in for a long time. Shi Yu calculated the time.
It had been three days, and the Dragon Palace banquet was almost over. Although it was tiring this time, the gains were indeed not small.
Among the sea beasts that entered, Shi Yu even discovered three sea beasts that had mastered the overlord’s will!!
Unfortunately, these three had all reached the monarch level. Otherwise, if it was a transcendent or even a commander rank, he would definitely directly abduct it. It would be a second team. Shi Yu had long started to have the intention of nurturing the second team.
But thinking about it carefully, apart from a will reincarnation like Susu, it was indeed not easy to master the overlord’s will at a low level.
Below the monarch level, the highest batch of wills Shi Yu had seen was only medium-level. He had never encountered anyone with overlord will.
On the other hand, among the group of ocean overlords in Dragon Palace City, there were several overlord-level sea beasts with overlord will.
It seemed that the will of the Dragon mom and the gem cat was indeed on the side that was weaker.
“There’s really no one else,” Shi Yu muttered. Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others shrunk and rested.
So be it. However, what was with this overly quiet and oppressive atmosphere…
“I’ll go out and take a look,” Shi Yu shouted at Eleven and the others before leaving the ruins space.
At the Dragon Palace banquet venue.
Shi Yu had just come out when he suddenly fell silent.
Because he suddenly realized that the outside world seemed to be equally silent.
Although most of the ocean forces were still around, every life form seemed to be looking at the sky in awe, not daring to breathe.
Even the Sea Dragon King totem looked at the sky with respect. Shi Yu also subconsciously looked over and saw a humanoid figure in an ancient white dress.
She had fair skin and dazzling white hair that naturally fell down, like a sparkling sea waterfall under the light. Her expression was emotionless, as if she was a high and mighty god overlooking everyone. When Shi Yu saw the complicated white dragon horns on her head and the green and white dragon ball the size of a glass ball on her forehead, his heart immediately skipped a beat. He understood why no one suddenly went in to take the test. “Lord Dragon God!!! You’re finally awake!!!”
Upon seeing this, the Sea Dragon King’s expression turned to joy.
At the side, the ice dragon was a little silent with an obedient expression. Although it was a senior and might even have more experience than the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, this was a world where strength was respected. Facing the Sea Dragon King and the others, it could still pretend, but facing a half-god, a powerful existence who controlled Dragon Palace City, it couldn’t not be obedient. Half-gods fighting ordinary totems was like a mother fighting her daughter.
Demigod, yes, it was the legendary Beast Tamers in history.
As for ordinary totems, they were labeled Titled Legends. The two were not of the same level.
Emperor Wu contracted nine totems with pretty good strength, and together with their top-notch Fusion Talent, although it could suppress a half-god like Yun An, it was still beaten by the other party in the end. From this, one could see the power of a half-god.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - The Dragon God Is Here (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 313 The Dragon God Is Here (1)
“Yes.” The Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God floated in midair. Not only did it attract the attention of all the sea beasts, but it also shocked and silenced Yu Shu and the others in the human area.
Shit, shit, shit. Wasn’t the Dragon Palace banquet usually presided over only by a totem? Why, why did the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City run out! They glanced at Shi Yu, who had also just come out of the ruins, and immediately felt a chill in their hearts. Could it be that Shi Yu had caused a huge commotion at the Dragon Palace banquet and woke the Dragon God? Ah, it was over. Shi Yu was going to die…
wa
Similarly, the gem cat, who was calling a group of overlords sisters and eating and drinking, was also guilty for a moment when it saw the appearance of the Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God. After all, it had just finished gossiping about the relationship history of the Dragon God with Shi Yu.
“Lord Dragon God!!”
After the Sea Dragon King finished greeting, countless sea beasts spoke respectfully. Many devout believers knelt down to worship. In the face of these voices, the Dragon God in the form of a Dragoness did not pay too much attention. Instead, she looked at Shi Yu, who had just come out of the ruins.
Shi Yu : “…”
“Is the Dragon Palace banquet over?” The Dragon God’s gaze stopped on Shi Yu for a moment before she asked the Sea Dragon King.
“It’s over!” the Sea Dragon King immediately said.
Even if it wasn’t over, it was over now.
Listening to the Dragon God’s instructions was the most important.
“Well, then let them go back and reflect on themselves,” the Dragon God said.
Many sea overlords were shocked.
The expressions of the Dragon Palace City elites who were discussing how they had lasted for a few seconds in Shi Yu’s hands gradually froze.
Holy shit.
The Dragon God… When did she come!
What did she hear!
Many heirs of Dragon Palace City’s overlord couldn’t sit still.
[Apart from that human and the Ice Dragon Totem, everyone else, disperse.]
“Then, let’s get down to business.” After instructing the Sea Dragon King, she looked at the frost dragon. There had to be something important for the Dragon Kings to awaken the Dragon God in seclusion. The reason why she was awakened this time was because of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation Body and the addition of the Ice Dragon Totem.
In her eyes, the Dragon Palace banquet was not important at all.
In fact, the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite was not important in the eyes of the Dragon God.
