She looked at the Ice Dragon. At the moment, what concerned her the most was the Ice Dragon Totem that followed the Time Emperor.
Ice Dragon: “Huh?” (*
*)***
“Yes!!”
Upon hearing the Dragon God’s instructions, the Sea Dragon King immediately glared at the many ocean overlords. These ocean overlords directly took their leave listlessly.
(Tyrannical Sea, you should leave with them first.]
[Ice Dragon and I will take care of Shi Yu.)
(The Dragon God must have something to say to him.) Upon hearing the Sea Dragon King’s telepathy, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was expressionless and didn’t say anything. Since the Dragon God didn’t plan to let him stay, he would take Yu Shu and the others back to Heaven Green Island.
As for whether Shi Yu would be in any danger, he shouldn’t be. After all, in the subsequent totem battles, the Dragon God was an ally who helped Dong Huang. If it weren’t for the Dragon God, even if Dong Huang still existed, it wouldn’t have grown so smoothly. It could be said that the significance of the Dragon God to Dong Huang far exceeded that of any titled legend.
A moment later, only the Dragon God, the Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon, and Shi Yu were left on the huge Dragon Banquet Island.
The gem cat also left with the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others.
On the island, Shi Yu sensed the awkward atmosphere and thought about how to cozy up to Senior Dragon God.
After all, this person could be said to be the top big boss and rich lady in the entire Blue Planet.
A ceiling-level figure!
Shi Yu thought for a moment. Perhaps among the women he knew, only the legend leader in Tingxiang the one in the seven islands could compare! “Lord Dragon God, do you want to see Lord Blue Sea Sprite’s reincarnation?”
The Sea Dragon King asked the Dragon God.
The Dragon God glanced at Shi Yu and shook her head. “We’ll talk about the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation later. I’ll leave it to you to nurture it. There’s no need to ask for my opinion if the Abyss Sea doesn’t come out.”
“Yes!” the Sea Dragon King immediately said. It knew that the Dragon God would respond this way.
Since controlling the Dragon Palace City, apart from cultivation, this Dragon God basically didn’t care about the affairs of the Dragon Palace City.
Now, as expected, even the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite didn’t matter much.
However, those overlord heirs could actually make the Dragon God rebuke them and reflect. Looks like their negative energy made the Dragon God speechless… The Sea Dragon King muttered in its heart.
“Senior Ice Dragon.”
After speaking to the Sea Dragon King, the Dragon God looked at the Ice Dragon. This honorific melted the ice and snow on the Ice Dragon’s body. The Ice Dragon hurriedly smiled in embarrassment and said, “Lord Dragon God is too polite, too polite. I can’t be called a senior…”
“I heard that you followed the Time Emperor. Is that true?”
The ice dragon’s heart skipped a beat. It cursed Shi Yu for digging a hole for it. It said, “Sort of. I have indeed fought a few battles with Emperor Shi, but most of the time, it’s protecting the number one general under Emperor Shi, the Ice Dragon General Mu Huiyin.”
The Dragon God smiled and said, “I’ve heard that Emperor Shi used the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein to travel through time to the totem era tens of thousands of years ago. I wonder if it’s true.”
“Ah, this…” Ice Dragon was stunned. It, it didn’t know. Where did she hear about this?
Even if there was, it was probably after they retired and went home… In any case, during the totem battle, Emperor Shi had basically been fighting Beside him, Shi Yu was also at a loss. Emperor Shi had transmigrated through time and gone to the totem era??
“This, I’ve indeed never heard of it, but Emperor Shi has studied the past and the future. This indeed exists!!”
“Is that so?” The Dragon God couldn’t help but show a regretful expression when she heard that Ice Dragon didn’t know either.
At this moment, Shi Yu was still wondering why the Dragon God kept him here since she didn’t care about the Blue Sea Sprite.
However, in the next moment, he understood. The Dragon God then turned to Shi Yu and said, “Are you very knowledgeable about the cracking of the ruins space?” Shi Yu: “This… Sort of. I’ve indeed cracked a few ruins spaces.”
The Dragon God nodded and said, “Since ancient times, you’re the first human to be able to communicate with the Blue Sea Ruins. Human, I want to entrust you with something to help me do.”
“What is it?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“I know of a spatial dragon vein. Legend has it that the spatial dragon vein is the habitat of the Mythical creature, the Time Sprite. Every spatial dragon vein has a spatial ruin that has the power to transcend time. I want you to help me find and crack the spatial ruins.”
The Dragon God looked at Shi Yu and said, “I want to use the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein to return to 1,000 years ago.”

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - Black Hand from the Mythical Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 314 Black Hand from the Mythical Era
“This, this, this, this.”
After the Dragon God finished speaking, the Ice Dragon King and the Sea Dragon King were shocked.
Especially Ice Dragon.
No wonder the Dragon God suddenly asked if Emperor Shi had transmigrated.
So the Dragon God also wanted to transmigrate through time?
A thousand years ago? It seemed to be the node for the rise of the Dragon Emperor after the collapse of the empress dynasty and hundreds of years of chaos?
“This…”
Shi Yu also completely didn’t expect that the Dragon God wanted him to stay behind because she wanted to entrust him to help crack the ruins.
Almost instantly, Shi Yu recalled the gossip between Teacher Cat and him that day.
The Dragon God was Dragon Emperor Long Qingyun’s soulmate.
However, both parties couldn’t be together due to race and other reasons.
After that, the Dragon God, who was a divine dragon of the Heavenly Sea, even began to study its bloodline in a bid to change its race. In the end, it evolved into a humanoid dragon-type dragon life dragon girl.
However, although the Dragon God succeeded, the Dragon Emperor died for some reason.
Could it be that the Dragon God wanted to return to a thousand years ago to find the Dragon Emperor?
Shi Yu immediately imagined love that crossed a thousand years in his mind.
How nice.
Shi Yu immediately felt speechless.
“If it’s to explore ruins, I might be able to give it a try.”
“However, I can’t guarantee success…”
The spatial ruin mentioned by the Dragon God should be a Mythical ruin.
The Blue Sea Sprite could already be considered high-level in the Blue Sea Ruins transmitted from the various seas of the blue planet. As for the Mythical Ruins, their levels were even higher.
They were all ruins left behind from the Mythical Era. They weren’t that easy to come into contact with.
“It’s alright. After failing for so long, I don’t mind failing again. In any case, I don’t have much confidence in you,” the Dragon God said.
Shi Yu: “?”
This person also knew how to goad people?
Go to the ruins yourself.
“Can I take the liberty to ask what you want to do when you return to a thousand years ago?”
Shi Yu couldn’t suppress his curiosity and asked.
If she only went to date, Shi Yu felt that cracking this ruin would be very boring.
The Dragon God glanced at Shi Yu and said, “I want to do something.”
Everyone : “…”
Who didn’t know that it was to do something? What else could it be, tourism?
“I want to verify something. I want to kill a certain Mythical life form.”
The green and white dragon ball on her forehead lit up, and her beautiful hair fluttered.
As soon as she finished speaking, Sea Dragon and Ice Dragon were shocked.
Shi Yu was also shocked.
Wasn’t she going to date?
“Mythical life form? Could it be that there are still living Mythical lives?” Shi Yu hurriedly asked. When it came to Mythical life forms, including the previous Time Sprite, he was instantly not sleepy.
This was much more exciting than the Dragon Emperor’s love history. “To be precise, it’s a Mythical remnant soul.”
The Dragon God said calmly.
“Ah.”
“Wuu?”
“Myth?”
The Sea Dragon King, Ice Dragon, and Shi Yu immediately turned into spectators.
“Before Long Qingyun rose, he had once obtained the recognition of a dragon mythical ruin. He also relied on this mythical ruin to lead to the legendary domain.”
Shi Yu and the others knew about the description of the Dragon God.
In history, the Dragon Emperor was completely known as the Son of Luck. It was said that he had endless good luck in his life.
In the beginning, this Dragon Tribe Mythical Ruins was the start of all good luck.
This ruin made him grow into a legendary emperor comparable to Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, and the empress as an ordinary person with a very common strengthening talent.
After all, Emperor Shi’s time talent, the top-notch fusion talent of Emperor Wu, and the empress’s phoenix bloodline were all top-notch powers. However, the Dragon Emperor was different. His strengthening talent was too common. Even in the Icefield High School where Shi Yu graduated, there were many types.
Without special luck, it was indeed very difficult for such a Beast Taming Talent to grow into a legendary Beast Tamer.
Of course, it was very difficult for powerful talent to grow without a certain amount of luck. For example, although the first-generation principal of the Imperial Capital University also had a time talent, in the end, he only cultivated the Prediction Owl…
“He is indeed a person with great luck, but this luck also has a price.”
“In this Mythical Ruins, a dragon soul from the Mythical Era is sleeping.”
The Dragon God said, “The Mythical Ruins only acknowledged Long Qingyun as their master under the interference of this dragon soul.”
“And the goal is to use Long Qingyun’s power to nurture dragon sacrifices to revive it.”
“The Dragon Emperor and his nine Great Beasts you mentioned died under the possession of the dragon soul.”
After the Dragon God finished speaking, the Sea Dragon King and the Ice Dragon opened their mouths wide. This was the first time they knew such a thing.
After all, the legend didn’t record the cause of the Dragon Emperor’s death at all.
“Where’s that dragon soul?” Shi Yu asked.
The Dragon God said, “It’s what I want to verify. Long Qingyun discovered a certain conspiracy hidden in this Mythical Ruins a long time ago, so he wasn’t surprised by the arrival of this day. He even made many preparations.”
“Why did you still use this Mythical Ruins when you discovered it early and nurture pets according to the resources and information provided by the ruins?” Ice Dragon asked.
The Dragon God said, “He said that even if this power was destined to have a price, he had a reason to use this power in that totem world. Otherwise, with his own power, he couldn’t end the totem world at that time.”
“After realizing the possibility of the mastermind behind the Mythical Ruins, he was already prepared to deal with all changes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - Black Hand from the Mythical Era (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 315 Black Hand from the Mythical Era (1)
“In order to not affect the Dong Huang Dynasty that had just recovered peace, he even chose to deal with it alone.”
“I don’t know the final outcome. I only know that Long Qingyun died, but I can’t confirm the final outcome of that Mythical remnant soul.”
“Perhaps Long Qingyun killed it, or perhaps Long Qingyun sealed it again, or maybe it successfully escaped. But what’s certain is that the Mythical remnant soul didn’t successfully possess Long Qingyun and his pet. But no matter which it is, I want to personally return to the past to verify it.”
“At that time, I didn’t have the strength to assist him, but now, my strength should be stronger than any of his companions.”
After the Dragon God finished speaking, she observed Shi Yu again and said, “But your strength seems to be a little weak. With your current strength, without my protection, I’m afraid you can’t move freely in the power of the dragon vein.”
“Uh.”
“There’s still time. There’s a chaotic spatial tide in the core of the Space-time Dragon Vein. At this stage, even demigods can’t come into contact with it. It’s a forbidden zone for life. Only at a specific time will the spatial tide recover its stability. At that time, it’s the only chance to enter the core area of the Space-time Dragon Vein. Since you’ve agreed to explore the Space-time Dragon Vein with me, quickly increase your strength before you can enter.”
“It’s best to reach the Legendary level.”
“When the time is right, I’ll look for you.”
“Ah…” The current Shi Yu was like the group of little sharks that had been beaten up by him. He stopped thinking.
After hearing so much from the Dragon God, he suddenly calmed down and regretted a little.
Although exploring Mythical spatial ruins was a fatal attraction to Shi Yu, it did sound very dangerous.
He was a noob… Could he do this?
However, since it wasn’t a request for him to go right now, Shi Yu could still accept it.
At this moment, Ice Dragon and Sea Dragon were completely numb.
So that was how the Dragon Emperor, the Son of Destiny, died.
It turned out that the Mythical Ruins the Dragon Emperor had obtained had a remnant soul from the Mythical Era!
“Since you can torment Dragon Palace City to this state, it means that your talent potential is not bad.”
“Even the Blue Sea Sprite was contracted by you. With your potential, it should be very easy for you to become a legendary Beast Tamer.”
“Help me explore the spatial ruins. Whether it succeeds or not, I’ll pay you enough.”
“I can give you some help now to help you increase your realm as soon as possible.” “Sea Dragon King, in the report previously, you once said that a pet he contracted absorbed the Dragon God’s Dragon Ball,
right?”
“Yes,” replied the Sea Dragon King.
The Dragon God nodded and looked at Shi Yu. “If I didn’t hear wrongly before, your pet grasps the power of illusion. Moreover, it can also rely on various dragon-element power to strengthen itself.”
Before coming out, the Dragon God had heard a lot of descriptions of Buggy from the young cubs of Dragon Palace City.
For example, summoning an extremely realistic Ice Dragon Phantom.
For example, releasing dragon might at once.
For example, suddenly becoming a dragon.
Or perhaps it was still a butterfly form, but it had obtained the dragon attribute in an instant. Its physical fitness was even more terrifying than the dragon attribute.
Through these, it was not difficult for the Dragon God to determine that Buggy had mastered the power of illusions and could strengthen itself with the power of the Dragon of Imagination.
“Can you summon it and let me take a look?”
“Alright.” Shi Yu never expected that the first thing the Dragon God wanted to see was not Susu, but Buggy.
Shi Yu quickly summoned Buggy.
In the next moment, accompanied by an empty ripple, Buggy, which had shrunk to the size of a palm and was recovering its strength, appeared in the outside world.
After coming out, Buggy looked at the noble Dragon God and was immediately cautious, not daring to say a word.
It was a super big boss!
“Show me the ability you displayed to the Sea Dragon King back then.” The Dragon God looked at the little blue butterfly.
“Buggy,” Shi Yu instructed again.
“Wu!” Buggy immediately nodded.
In the next moment, a huge dragon-shaped body covered in blue and white dragon scales kept condensing, floating and circling behind Buggy!
“Roar…” Then, with a roar from the divine dragon, it instantly flew towards Buggy and fused into its body. At this moment, Buggy’s strength directly changed, and its aura increased greatly.
Skill: Dragon of Imagination
(Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It’s a combination of spiritual, spatial, and dragon skills. Through the power of imagination, it can transform its physique into the body of a divine dragon. It has true attributes, physique, energy, life force, and dragon might that are comparable to dragons. It’s an ability to compare to and surpass dragons.
“As expected…” At the same time, the Dragon God saw this scene and understood everything
Her white finger pointed at Buggy. In the next moment, Buggy immediately became huge. The divine dragon phantom on its body was ejected and wrapped around Buggy’s back again.
Buggy was shocked. Under its observation, the characteristics and colors of the divine dragon it imagined began to quickly disappear. Soon, it became an illusory divine dragon that was almost gray. After understanding the characteristics of this skill, the Dragon God said, “Not a bad skill. This is an evolution skill. Through the power of imagination, it simulates the power of the divine dragon and then transforms the power of the divine dragon into its own power.”
“When trained to perfection, it can evolve into a dragon and break through the limit of the skill. It will surpass the dragon and reach the extreme, walking its own path.”
The Dragon God’s words revealed the nature of the Dragon Skill of Imagination, making Shi Yu nod.
“The most important thing about this skill is to make up for its racial flaw through the racial merits of the dragons.”
“The imaginary divine dragon phantom core is equivalent to an empty shell. It’s extremely malleable. The process of increasing skill proficiency is the process of filling this shell through different divine dragon advantages. Its real training method shouldn’t be limited to one dragon for its imagination.”
“Even dragons have their own racial advantages according to their race. If you want to train this skill to the extreme, you have to imagine and absorb the merits of many dragons. The stronger and more divine dragons you visualize, the faster the skill proficiency increases, and the higher the upper limit of the skill you can reach.”
“It’s not much different from what I thought In that case, I’ll let you visualize the wills of the past Dragon Gods in the Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God Ruins.” The Dragon God made a decision.
When she finished speaking, the Sea Dragon King was shocked.
Shi Yu was also stunned.
The Dragon God continued, “If I remember correctly, compared to using cultivation resources to meditate, the fastest way for human Beast Tamers to increase their strength after stepping into your level should be to increase their own level through the increase in the strength of their pets. If you can visualize the figures of the past Dragon Gods, its path of advancement will be very clear and fast. In this way, under its lead, you can also guarantee that you can quickly advance to legendary.”
After the dragon’s words fell, at the side, Buggy was completely stunned. Then, it was even a little touched. Weren’t the generations of Dragon Gods in Dragon Palace City all demigod-level dragons? It… could it visualize them all?
If it imagined them, even if each illusion only had one ten-thousandth of their power, how strong would its Dragon of Imagination become!
At this moment, Buggy, who had returned to its junior position in the team, suddenly saw an incomparably dazzling path. If it weren’t for the Ice Dragon already, it would have to acknowledge another mother!

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - Returning to the Dong Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 316 Returning to the Dong Huang
Dragon Palace City.
On an island located deep in the mystic realm of Dragon Palace City, Dragon God Island.
With a thought from the Dragon God, a violent wind wrapped around Shi Yu, Buggy, Ice Dragon, and Sea Dragon King.
When they reacted again, they had already appeared on a wide land.
What entered their eyes was a huge rock ruin that looked like a mountain range.
When the Dragon God decided to let Buggy visualize the figure of the Dragon God’s will, she teleported Shi Yu and the others over with a thought.
“This!”
“Wuu.” After being teleported over, Ice Dragon was shocked.
Was this the Dragon God Ruins?
On the island, there was an endless mountain that stretched out like a dragon’s back, filling the vast land. In every mountain, under the lingering white mist, there were ghost-like statues. They were lifelike divine dragons. Just from their appearance, they emitted an earth-shattering domineering aura, as if they were ancient gods sleeping in ruins, waiting to wake up at any time.
Just looking at the stone statues themselves, they even felt stronger than overlords like cats.
After Shi Yu and Buggy arrived, they looked at the Dragon God Stones one after another and gulped.
“Senior Dragon God, is this the statue of the will of the past Dragon Gods?” Shi Yu asked.
“Wu!”
Buggy’s eyes lit up.
“To be precise, it’s the will of the past Dragon Gods who were willing to leave their traces.” The Dragon God said, “These stone statues were all left behind by the former Dragon Gods in order to let the future descendants of the Dragon Race who came to the Dragon God Ruins see their heroic bearing.”
“When the dragons sense and look at the stone statues with all their might, they can hallucinate and see their former power…”
“In the end, they’re just a bunch of guys who show off too much.”
“Although it’s not a dragon, your pet can temporarily transform itself into a dragon through that skill. It shouldn’t be a problem to visualize it…”
“…” Hearing the current Dragon God’s evaluation of the previous Dragon God who had left behind the will statue, the Sea Dragon King was stunned, but it seemed that it really made sense.
There was no rule that forced the Dragon God to leave a will statue in the Dragon God Ruins. For example, the current Dragon God didn’t carve her own stone statue.
However, these wills looked really handsome.
The Sea Dragon King sighed.
When it first came to the Dragon God Ruins, it had almost looked at them one by one, and its knowledge increased.
In its opinion, the Dragon God represented by every stone statue here was stronger than its master’s black dragon.
At the thought of this, the Sea Dragon King gritted its teeth. It was clearly not much worse than the black dragon.
In the end, because it wasn’t a female… and because the Divine Feather Butterfly wasn’t a female, it wasn’t contracted.
When remembering that the nine pets Lin Feng had contracted were all female, the Sea Dragon King felt a wave of hatred. Why wasn’t it a female? Why did Beast Tamers still favor girls over boys?
“Senior Dragon God, why is there a broken Dragon God statue there?”
As Shi Yu observed, he suddenly discovered a blind spot and saw the statue of the Dragon God’s will that had been smashed into pieces.
“That?” The Dragon God looked over and said, “That’s the statue of the previous Dragon God. I didn’t like it much, so I smashed it.”
Shi Yu, Buggy, and Ice Dragon : “…”
“Next, the Dragon God Ruins will be open to you. If you have needs, you can come at any time. Unfortunately, your pet is not a totem and can’t enter the interior of the ruins space. Otherwise, you can gain more. Forget it.”
The Dragon God said, “Senior Ice Dragon is at the totem level and can enter the interior of the ruins to accept the trial of the ruins.”
“As for you and this butterfly, you should visualize these statues of the Dragon God’s will outside. However, although they’re just dead things, the ones who left them are, after all, the previous Dragon Gods. Your pet’s strength is still too weak. During the visualization process, it might cause a huge burden on its body and mind, so be mentally prepared. Of course, if you can successfully visualize them, it should have a good effect on its will tempering.”
“Wu?!”
What!
When it heard that visualizing the statue of the Dragon God’s will had side effects that could also temper the will, Buggy’s eyes immediately lit up.
There was such a good thing?
Not only could it train the Dragon of Imagination skill, but it could also train the overlord’s will. This was a win-win situation!
“Yes, I’ll make it pay attention,” Shi Yu replied.
At the same time.
Ice Dragon asked eagerly, “Lord Dragon God, can I just go directly to the trial of the Dragon God Ruins?”
“Didn’t the Sea Dragon King say before that there was a need to carry out some joining ceremony? It only joined after swearing in the ruins under the witness of you and the many Dragon Kings.”
The Dragon God said, “Forget about formalism, just go in. When the time comes, let the Sea Dragon King inform the various Dragon Kings and let them know.”
“Ah, this.” Ice Dragon didn’t expect it to be so simple.
“Alright.” Seeing that the Dragon God was so casual, the Sea Dragon King nodded speechlessly. Speaking of which, the last time it joined Dragon Palace City, the Dragon God seemed to have only sent a clone to deal with it. In any case, it felt that it didn’t look like its real body.
“That’s all I have to say.” After instructing, the Dragon God looked at the Dragon God Ruins and then at Shi Yu. She didn’t continue speaking. After taking two slow steps, he disappeared in front of everyone.
Seeing this, the Sea Dragon King revealed an envious gaze at Shi Yu.
“I think the Dragon God Island and the Dragon God Ruins can only be accessed if you pass through Lord Dragon God’s chambers. Generally, without special circumstances, even the Dragon Kings can’t come over casually. You’re very lucky. You’re one of the few humans who came to the Dragon God Ruins, and you can actually come over to visualize the Will statues of the Dragon Gods. With its skill, maybe you can really have a big harvest. The Dragon God’s judgment is definitely not wrong.”
“Has anyone else been here?” Shi Yu asked curiously.
“I heard that the Dragon Emperor also came a thousand years ago. I’m not sure about the ones before and after. In short, you have to grasp this opportunity.” The Sea Dragon King’s gaze was complicated. It didn’t expect that Shi Yu could actually be thought of highly by the Dragon God.
Therefore, in the end, it was its son who wasn’t worthy of Shi Yu?
After all, it would be fine if Shi Yu only had one outstanding pet, Susu. The key was that every one of them was so outstanding.
The Sea Dragon King sighed.
“By the way, it’s about what was mentioned last time. Senior Ice Dragon, after you enter the interior of the ruins, you can carefully search for the will of the Sea Serpent Dragon. Inside the ruins, at some special checkpoints, most of the Dragon Gods also left traces of their own existence.”
“Ah, alright.” Ice Dragon nodded and looked at Shi Yu and Buggy.
“But you guys are visualizing this now, so you shouldn’t be in a hurry to find clues related to the dragon ball, right?”
“There’s no hurry,” Shi Yu replied. “That’s good!” Ice Dragon said. “Cough, I think I should prepare to go to the Dragon God Ruins again. I’m not ready yet.”
After all, it was a trial-type ruin. Although it could have huge gains, it was probably not simple. The Ice Dragon planned to stabilize itself and recuperate for a while. At least, it could stabilize its totem power first. After all, it had just broken through not long ago.
“Then can we start…”
At this moment, Shi Yu rubbed his fists. He wondered if observing the will statues of the previous Dragon Gods could let Buggy’s will reach medium willpower.
If possible, he would really make a killing.
“Wu!!! (Perfect proficiency, evolution into a dragon!)” Buggy shouted in anticipation. It still felt that the butterfly’s body was too weak and needed to evolve again.
You have a lot of ideas… Shi Yu curled his lips.
However…
Its body strength was inferior to Eleven, its life force was inferior to Baby Ginseng, and it couldn’t become stronger like Chi Tong. Its affinity for the power of nature was also inferior to an elemental life form like Susu. The worm-type creatures were indeed miserable, and it was at the extreme opposite of the dragon race.
Generally speaking, when bugs had the advantage in nature, they basically used the worm sea strategy and relied on numbers to win.
However, although that was the case, Shi Yu still reminded Buggy.
“Proficiency is secondary, and evolution into a dragon is also secondary. What you need to do is train your willpower. As long as your willpower is strong enough, your race can be ignored. Even if you’re still a green worm, you can still kill dragons.”
“In short, although these Dragon Gods are strong, you don’t have to pursue imitating their power too much. After visualizing their power, just strive to walk your own path. Strong will is the foundation.”
As long as it had the overlord’s will… Once the super skill was maxed out, the Green Silkworm could also become a demigod.
Or myth.
At that time, a strand of silk could instantly kill everything
“In short, give yourself the thought that even if you’re a Green Silkworm, you can defeat the Dragon God and visualize it,” Shi Yu said telepathically.
“Wu!!” Buggy was shocked. It sounded good, but was this scientific?
Forget it, Shi Yu wasn’t scientific in the first place. It was definitely right to listen to Shi Yu.
Three days later.
As they had to wait for Shi Yu, after the Dragon Palace banquet ended, Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others had yet to leave Dragon Palace City.
This also gave Yin Zhengfan and the others more time to find their favorite pet.
At this stage, apart from White Brook, all the young people who came to Dragon Palace City had contracted their favorite pets. It wasn’t that the beast-eared girl didn’t have a chance, but she was actually still thinking about the Iron-eating Beast. It was mainly because she had a water-type pet. Compared to another one, White Brook still liked the Nine Li Battle Beast and wanted to be a panda mother.
“What exactly did Shi Yu do?”
After basically everyone contracted their pets, Yu Shu and the others began to do nothing on Green Sky Island. They wanted to know what exactly Shi Yu had been pulled by the Dragon God for.
At the thought that not only could Shi Yu be chosen by Ice Dragon, but he could also be chosen by the Dragon God now, they were envious and jealous.
Green Sky Island.
The few people who were free often fought in pairs.
For example, Yu Shu went against Yin Zhengfan and fought several times in the past two days.
After subduing the new dragon pet and awakening a super skill, Yu Shu’s battle power increased greatly.
He naturally wanted to challenge this young genius who he couldn’t defeat in the vocation assessment again.
As for Shi Yu, he had completely given up on chasing after him.
“Yo, you guys are dueling?”
Boom!
On the arena, Yu Shu’s Ancient Sea Horse and Yin Zhengfan’s desert monarch were colliding. At this moment, a figure suddenly appeared nearby through Instant Transmission. Shi Yu and the worm on his shoulder looked at Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan in the battle.
“Shi Yu?”
“Shi Yu…”
Seeing Shi Yu suddenly appear after disappearing for three days, Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan were stunned. Yu Shu almost subconsciously said, “Why were you called by the Dragon God?”
Shi Yu scratched his cheek. Was this something he could tell him casually?
“The Dragon God saw that I bullied the younger generation of Dragon Palace City too ruthlessly and called me over to beat me up.”
“Wu!!” Buggy cried. The past Dragon Gods had beaten it up.
“Huh?”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Yu Shu and Yin Zhengfan were stunned.
No one would believe Shi Yu!
They looked at Shi Yu’s smile. How could he smile so brightly after being beaten??
“Eh, you’re back!”
Not long after Shi Yu returned to Clear Sky Island, the gem cat also ran over with an Instant Transmission.
It wasn’t very puzzled. It and the Tyrannical Sea Legend had already known what Shi Yu was doing through the ice dragon.
“How is it?” The gem cat asked about Shi Yu.
“Thinking about it… is much harder than we imagined. It might have to digest for a while before continuing. We plan to prepare for the National League first.” Shi Yu scratched his head and smiled.
“I see. Alright, let’s go back.” The gem cat nodded. It had indeed stayed in Dragon Palace City for a long time. It was tired of eating fish. Ugh.
However, it was quite a pity to leave now. Ice Dragon, this good sister, was too slow. The gem cat still wanted to wait for it to see if Ice Dragon could take out some legendary gemstones from the Dragon God Ruins. In the end, Ice Dragon didn’t dare to enter the Dragon God Ruins after a long time. Where was its breakthrough opportunity…

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - A Big Change in 100 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 317 A Big Change in 100 Years
Inatella.
This island had the title of the World Root.
It was the habitat of the World Tree, the embodiment of the planet’s will, and its guardian.
In the center of Inatella, on a huge tree that reached the sky, countless small, cylindrical green bugs separated from it.
Their forms were very similar to single-cell protozoa Grass Treadworms, but every one of them was clearly visible with the naked eye. After these green tree bugs separated, they quickly moved in all directions.
Their destination seemed to be all over the world.
The number one country in technology, Shenfeng, the country of snow plains that was covered in snow all year round, the country of glory Rongguo that believed in the power of light, the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua that was covered in undead, the seven islands of the Nation of Ten Thousand Islands…
The figure of this green tree worm could be seen even in the country led by the elven queen, who was now half human and half elf.
And Dong Huang.
In a courtyard in the headquarters of the Dong Huang Association, a young man put down his teacup. He looked at the departing figure of the tree worm and then at the endless blue sky.
“Is this a sign of some kind of disaster?” He revealed an aura that didn’t match his appearance and age, and a towering tree was gradually reflected in his eyes.
East Sea, Dragon Palace City.
Tyrannical Sea Legend looked at the 12 young men in front of him and nodded.
This trip to Dragon Palace City could be considered a perfect end.
“Prime Minister Turtle, there’s no need to send me off.”
Then, the Tyrannical Sea Legend looked at the Tortoise Prime Minister who was holding a banner beside him.
“It’s alright, it’s alright. Have a safe trip, everyone,” the Turtle Prime Minister waved the banner.
It mainly looked at Shi Yu and smiled. “Lord Shi Yu, come again next time.”
“Yes, yes.” Shi Yu smiled. Besides, that day wouldn’t be far.
After all, he was now the minister of the environmental protection department of Dragon Palace City.
Although the Environmental Protection Department was only in the initial stage and the department’s operation had yet to enter the right track, it would definitely be used appropriately in the future.
Apart from that, the Dragon Palace City mystic realm with the Dragon God Statue and the Blue Sea Ruins was also closely related to the growth of Buggy and Susu.
Tyrannical Sea Legend said to Shi Yu and the others, “Are you all ready? If you are, let’s set off.”
Shi Yu, Yu Shu, and the others nodded. Then, an incomparably huge blue Giant Leviathan covered in dense white hair was summoned by the Tyrant Sea Legend.
The first time was unfamiliar, but the second time was familiar.
This time, Shi Yu and the others didn’t feel uncomfortable being swallowed by the Giant Leviathan into the body. They quickly returned to the water-element world.
In the water-element world, there was still a huge water screen that allowed everyone to share the Giant Leviathan’s perspective and see the situation outside.
However, this time, just as they left Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu and the others discovered a strange phenomenon.
“What’s that?”
Not long after leaving Dragon Palace City, Yu Shu pointed at the big green fish swimming slowly on the water screen and showed a stunned expression.
This green big fish looked very strange. At least in Yu Shu’s impression, he didn’t know this kind of sea beast.
He wasn’t the only one. The others also cast curious expressions before shaking their heads. They didn’t know it.
“There are more underwater creatures than land creatures. It’s not surprising that we don’t know them.” Shi Yu realized that there was no information about this guy in the index.
“It looks pretty nutritious. Green food.” This time, without Ice Dragon’s space, the gem cat was also in the Infinite Devour space. It looked at the green fish that had just swam over and said.
Everyone grinned. That thing clearly looked like a mutated fish species that had been contaminated.
Many young people present didn’t know this green fish, but Tyrannical Sea Legend, who had come into contact with some secret legends before… After arriving in the Giant Leviathan’s inner space, he received the Giant Leviathan’s feedback and fell into deep thought.
By the sea.
At the Binhai Training Hall.
When they left Dong Huang, everyone left. When they returned, they naturally returned here. In a huge pool in a room in the Dao field, a deep sea whirlpool teleported Shi Yu and the others out.
“Teacher, you’re back!”
While Shi Yu and the others were still adjusting, the disciple of the Tyrant Sea Legend, the sect master of the Dao field, Zheng Hai, quickly came to welcome them.
He looked at the still expressionless teacher, as well as Shi Yu and the others, whose expressions had changed drastically. He knew that the gains from this trip to Dragon Palace City would definitely be pretty good.
“Yes.” The Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded and said, “Treat them well.”
With that said, he walked out of the room step by step. At the same time, Zheng Hai looked at Heavenly King Zou and the others happily.
“You’ve been gone long enough.”
“Did you gain something big?”
“By the way, what pets have you contracted? Tell me.”
“Overlord dragon species, black flood dragon,” Zou Yun said with a chuckle.
“Holy shit.” Zheng Hai was shocked. You really contracted it.
With another new overlord race divine pet, Heavenly King Zou would probably be on the trending list again.
This time, Heavenly King Zou was the only one who had contracted a cub of an overlord race, so he was pretty smug.
As for the others, although they had contracted their favorite pets, they were basically all high-level monarch races or quasi overlord races. They weren’t that lucky.
Generally speaking, overlord races still wouldn’t follow people easily. Only Beast Tamers like Zou Yun and Lu Qingyi, who were super geniuses themselves, had a chance of being recognized by overlord creatures.
After all, the probability of an overlord race growing to the overlord level was very, very high. On the contrary, if humans didn’t have the potential to grow to the legendary level, why should an overlord race ever follow you? Everyone was in a different position.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - A Big Change in 100 Years (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 318 A Big Change in 100 Years (1)
“Ancient Sea Dragon.”
“Dragon Claw Battle Prawn.”
“Dragon-Eyed Jellyfish.”
Then, under Zheng Hai’s questioning, the others also mentioned what pet they had contracted.
However, after asking Shi Yu, Shi Yu immediately couldn’t answer Zheng Hai.
“Water Slime.”
Zheng Hai: “?”
He looked at the most talented Shi Yu among the few of them and was stunned. This was a super genius who researched the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast and the evolution of the Green Silkworm overlord race, but he contracted such a thing?
Even if he couldn’t obtain the recognition of an overlord race, he had to contract a quasi overlord dragon. Slimes were ridiculous.
“Although it’s a Slime, it’s still pretty strong. Sort of a mutant.”
Before Shi Yu could finish, Heavenly King Zou, Yu Shu, and the others hurriedly stopped him.
“Sect Master Zheng, don’t listen to him, Versailles. That thing can’t be called a Water Slime anymore. Have you seen a Water Slime that instantly killed the Third Crown Prince of Dragon Palace City, White Azure Dragon, and the shark of an overlord race!!”
Zheng Hai: “?”
Wait, wait?
At a private room on the beach.
Returning to the ground, the Tyrannical Sea Legend sorted out his gains in Dragon Palace City and took out a communication tool.
Dragon Palace City had no signal, so just as he took out his communication tool, Tyrannical Sea Legend saw many messages from Principal Feng and President Ye.
They were concerned about Shi Yu’s situation. After the Tyrannical Sea Legend returned, he would inform them first.
Initially, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was prepared to directly report the situation of Dragon Palace City to the Dong Huang chairman. However, when he saw Shi Yu’s two recommenders, especially since Shi Yu was an orphan, Principal Feng could be considered half an elder of Shi Yu. The Tyrannical Sea Legend still chose to explain the situation to them first.
He opened a group call and called Principal Feng and President Ye at the same time. A moment later, the two of them picked up.
A light screen popped up on the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s communication device. A three-dimensional holographic projection directly projected the half figure of Principal Feng and President Ye in mid-air.
“Legend of the Tyrannical Sea, you’re back? Did it go smoothly?”
After being called by the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Principal Feng and President Ye were stunned.
“It’s pretty smooth. Why did you send me so many messages?” Legend Sea Tyrant asked.
Principal Feng and President Ye’s projections looked at each other and smiled. “It’s already calmed down now. It’s not a big deal. We also sent Shi Yu a lot of messages, mainly to ask about your situation in Dragon Palace City.”
“Shi Yu, did he contract an impressive existence?” the two of them probed.
Tyrannical Sea Legend was stunned. “How do you know…”
“As expected! What exactly is it?” Upon hearing Tyrannical Sea Legend’s words, Principal Feng and President Ye’s expressions turned solemn. Holy shit, the owl’s prophecy was indeed correct.
“I happen to want to talk to you,” said the Tyrannical Sea Legend.
“Is it a totem reincarnation!!” Principal Feng and President Ye asked.
In Principal Feng and President Ye’s opinion, it was impossible for Shi Yu to contract a totem with the owl’s prophecy. After all, Shi Yu was only at the master level. This level was not enough to support him contracting a totem.
However, when they thought of Zhong Xuan in the ruins of the Emperor Wu and remembered that it had already been reincarnated, other totems could also be reincarnated. After analysis, they determined at that time that Shi Yu was definitely a reincarnation of a certain totem.
This was super big news.
However, in fact, they quickly calmed down. When they recalled that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast, Butterfly of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, and Sword Spirit were all super overlord races, they were relieved. Even if it was a totem reincarnation, it still wouldn’t surpass an overlord race. Its race might not even be as high as Shi Yu’s pets. They had already been shocked so many times, so there was no need to continue making a fuss. After all, it wasn’t a totem at its peak. Growth still required time.
“Yes.” Legend Sea Tyrant nodded, making Principal Feng and President Ye tear up.
“It’s really the totem reincarnation of Dragon Palace City.”
As expected, Shi Yu could surprise them every time.
F*ck, this was too ridiculous. Even if it was a totem heir, they would feel better. Contracting a totem reincarnation was ridiculous.
“Wait, this totem might be different from the totem you imagine,” said the Tyrannical Sea Legend. “It’s not a certain totem dragon king in Dragon Palace City, nor is it the former totem of Dragon Palace City.”
“Uh?”
“You know the guardian of the sea, the Blue Sea Sprite, right? It’s a demigod-level ocean elemental sprite that once destroyed the Western Abyss Sea and was born because of the faith of the ocean creatures. To be precise, it shouldn’t belong to Dragon Palace City.”
“Shi Yu successfully communicated with the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City and found the reincarnation of the Inner Sea Sprite that didn’t appear again in 3,000 years. He successfully contracted it.”
Principal Feng and President Ye were stunned and couldn’t react for a moment.
“Apart from that, he also established some Ocean Environmental Protection Department with the four dragon kings of Dragon Palace City through his relationship with the Sea Sprite. He became a minister and befriended 52 ocean overlords, inviting them to become core members of the Environmental Protection Department. Apart from that, he also invited thousands of powerful monarchs and commanders to join. Among them, there was no lack of overlord heirs. Well, the second and third princes of Dragon Palace City also became ordinary members of this Environmental Protection Department.”
“In the past few days, I, the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City, and the overlords have established a preliminary agreement between Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City to further cooperate around this environmental department.”

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - A Big Change in 100 Years (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 319 A Big Change in 100 Years (2)
“In short, it’s because of these things that we delayed a little. We might be busy next.” Legend Sea Tyrant looked at the two of them.
At this moment, Principal Feng and President Ye’s mouths were already agape. Their eyes were about to pop out as they looked at Tyrannical Sea Legend in disbelief.
“Holy shit,” they shouted in shock.
Their brains were a mess.
They suspected that the Tyrannical Sea Legend was talking nonsense.
This…
The Blue Sea Guardian that hadn’t appeared in 3,000 years had been contracted by Shi Yu?
Shi Yu cracked the Blue Sea Ruins?
And with this relationship, he had plotted against almost the entire Dragon Palace City and become the superior of many ocean overlords?
Wait, wait, it was a little messy!!!
Are you sure this isn’t another novel?
“Oh, there are also a few things. The Dragon God of Dragon Palace City saw Shi Yu and seemed to have reached some agreement with Shi Yu. I’m not sure about the specifics,” said the Tyrannical Sea Legend. “Apart from that, there’s also a mutated Poison Dragon Totem affected by the forbidden radiation that invaded the sea area of Dragon Palace City and was sealed by the Dragon Kings. Its power fluctuations are suspected to be from Yun An, and this Poison Dragon Totem is said to have come from the direction of the seven islands. Aren’t you guys looking for Yun An? Perhaps you can explore in that direction to see if you can gain anything.” “F*ck…”
At this moment, Principal Feng and President Ye were completely numb.
Dragon God?
Yun An?
Poison Dragon Totem?
Was the Dragon Palace banquet so explosive?
“I’ll take my time…”
“Damn, there’s been a lot of shocking news recently…” President Ye’s expression was messy.
“Why do I feel like a storm is brewing?”
“Did anything else happen recently?” Legend Sea Tyrant asked.
Principal Feng and President Ye, who had yet to recover from their shock, looked at each other.
Then, Principal Feng sighed.
“Too much.”
re
“The president has recently issued a notice to the thirteen bureaus. Look carefully, you should have received the news too.”
“The World Tree has awakened. Soon, a new World Tournament will begin in about a
year.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend was stunned.
World competition?
He took a deep breath, very surprised.
The World Tournament was a huge competition between young Beast Tamers under the age of 30.
The champion of the World Tournament would obtain the title of “World Legend” and the blessings of the World Tree. He would almost definitely become a legendary Beast Tamer.
However, the difficulty of this competition was also very terrifying. The title of world legend required the strongest legend under the age of 30. Basically, only legendary-level Beast Tamers under the age of 30 had the qualifications to fight for the championship title. If they didn’t reach the legendary level, they were equivalent to cannon fodder in the world competition.
Dong Huang’s last Beast Tamer, Lin Feng, who had obtained the title of “World Legend”, had obtained this title by consecutively defeating legendary elites under the age of 30 in the other six countries.
“In the entire Dong Huang, can there be five legendary Beast Tamers under the age of 30?” Tyrannical Sea Legend fell into deep thought.
“Regardless, it’s related to the blessings of the World Tree. We have to prepare for battle with all our might. There should still be a period of time. Geniuses like Lu Qingyi and Zou Yun who haven’t grown up will probably receive important support next.”
“Unfortunately, that kid, Shi Yu, might not be able to make it in time.” Principal Feng thought of Shi Yu, who had contracted five powerful overlord races. Shi Yu’s potential was completely not inferior to those super geniuses who became legends under the age of 30 in Dong Huang. He might even surpass them, but the date of the World Tournament was so uncertain. It would begin in a year. Although Shi Yu’s growth speed was already very fast, the hope of him becoming a legendary Beast Tamer in a year was almost zero.
Otherwise, this would almost definitely become a legendary opportunity. No matter what profession a Beast Tamer was, be it archeology or feeding, they were all very worth competing for. This competition concerned the fate of the country.
Until now, there had been no sign of the next legendary Beast Tamer appearing in Dong Huang. Therefore, this world competition was very important to Dong Huang, or to every country.
“This is indeed a big deal.” Legend Sea Tyrant fell into deep thought again.
Principal Feng smiled bitterly and said, “If that’s all, perhaps President Ye wouldn’t be so worried. It’s said that the rules of this World Tournament might be a little different from the previous ones.”
“Huh?”
“It’s said that the envoy of the World Tree of Initiation not only informed the seven-nation alliance, but also went to many totem countries. If I’m not wrong, this World Tournament might turn into a world battle to compete for the blessings of the World Tree, divided into multiple camps. Perhaps the human Beast Tamers of the totem countries can also participate. If that’s the case, it’s too chaotic. Indeed, the World Tree has never been just the guardian of the seven-nation alliance.”
As soon as Principal Feng finished speaking, the expression of the Tyrannical Sea Legend immediately changed. In history, the competition between the seven countries in the world competition was already tragic. If the totem faction joined, it would probably be impossible to end every battle without determining life and death. Just by listening, he could already imagine the tragic world battle scene.
“What do you think, President?” Legend Sea asked.
“The country will organize the Sequence Battle and choose ten young Beast Tamers under the age of 30 to participate in the World Tournament. Beast Tamers can freely register. If nothing goes wrong, this news will be announced soon. At that time, be it the National League or the Heavenly King Tournament, all the domestic competitions will become the foil for this competition. It’s said that in order to respond and publicize the World Tournament, there will also be some changes in the rules of the National League.”
“It’s indeed a storm that’s about to happen… Even a huge change that hasn’t happened in a hundred years.” The Tyrannical Sea Legend was solemn. The World Tree was the embodiment of the planet’s will. It was said that only when Blue Planet was threatened would it awaken. An existence that could be regarded as a threat by Blue Planet… Even a demigod had no right. As for the Blue Sea Sprite, it was the guardian of the sea. It also chose to follow humans at this time. Although the level of the Blue Sea Sprite was very far from the World Tree, when these things collided, it was indeed very easy for people to feel that a big event was about to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - World Tree’s Game
chapters.content:
Chapter 320 World Tree’s Game
At the Binhai Training Hall.
After Shi Yu and the others returned, Zheng Hai, the sect master of the Binhai Training Hall, immediately welcomed them.
No matter what, he had to treat Shi Yu and the others in the venue before letting them leave.
Shi Yu and the others didn’t mind a meal, so they naturally agreed.
Moreover, after returning, they had yet to officially thank the escort of the Tyrannical Sea Legend
AS
Dragon Palace City was in the deep sea. Even if it was a top-notch master proficient in water-element, it was very difficult to go to Dragon Palace City alone. Therefore, the escort of the Tyrant Sea Legend was quite necessary.
“When can your other pets break through to the monarch level?”
In the hall, White Brook whispered to Shi Yu.
During this trip to Dragon Palace City, although the batch of Beast Tamers accompanying them had not seen many battle scenes regarding Shi Yu, judging from Shi Yu’s battle results, it was already very terrifying
After fighting the sea beasts of the Dragon Palace for three days and three nights, he maintained a complete victory. Even if he had sufficient replenishment, it was an unimaginable battle result.
In addition to the shock of the Iron-eating Beast crushing the Second Prince of Dragon Palace City, basically no one treated Shi Yu as a normal master.
Therefore, White Brook immediately became restless. Her goal was the throne of the champion of the National League.
Shi Yu from Ancient Capital University was with her. She felt that it was alright!
“But there shouldn’t be a need for the National League, right?” Shi Yu muttered.
There was Eleven in the solo battle, and there was the Time Fruit in the team battle. What was there to be afraid of?
“Don’t look down on Gao Xuan. He’s not the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince that you can restrain. Mechanics are the most sinister. Even if he doesn’t have forbidden weapons, he still has various methods. We gotta be more stable,” White Brook said. “Don’t forget, he has been focused on upgrading the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. There are still a few contract spots that he hasn’t contracted. This time, Yin Zhengfan, this little kid, has also seen your strength. He’ll definitely tell Gao Xuan when he goes back…”
“Previously, he only focused on nurturing a machine because he thought that there were no opponents, but if you show a threat…”
“At that time, even if he doesn’t have to use a forbidden weapon, if he suddenly contracts a bunch of machines that counter you… It won’t be safe!”
“Can you not plot loudly?” Yin Zhengfan held a cup of water and looked at Shi Yu and White Brook, who were plotting loudly, with a red face.
Heavenly King Zou, Yu Shu, and the others, who were sitting on the sofa and browsing their cell phones and reporting the situation to their relatives, were also speechless.
e?
“It’s so good to be young,” the blue-haired girl and the other Beast Tamers who had already graduated from university sighed.
The National League this year was not going to be peaceful.
Was Ancient Capital University about to counterattack????
Shi Yu’s pets were indeed monsters. They were even fiercer than Lu Qingyi back then.
“That’s true.”
Upon hearing White Brook’s words, Shi Yu was immediately stunned. He had almost forgotten about this. Because he was too invincible, Gao Xuan had never contracted other mechanical pets. It was still a little difficult to modify a pile of explosive babies that could counter him at the last minute.
He still remembered clearly the scene of Gao Xuan using a forbidden weapon to destroy the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. This guy’s Beast Taming Talent was very strange.
“Be it Gao Xuan or Shi Yu, they’re both pretty threatening.” Heavenly King Zou glanced at Shi Yu. Fortunately, these two weren’t from the club system, so they wouldn’t snatch his rice bowl and resources from him. He would just watch the two of them have fun and kill each other in the National League for the time being.
As long as he didn’t come to snatch his trending topic for no reason! This was all traffic! Flow was money and resources! As long as he used it well, it wouldn’t be any less than the profits from the research results of Shi Yu and Gao Xuan’s research.
Thinking of this, Zou Yun photoshopped the selfie of himself and the overlord dragon species, the black flood dragon, and posted it on the Internet. He also informed his subordinate companies to operate as soon as possible.
No one should snatch his spot on the trending topic this time, right? Although Shi Yu was in the limelight in the Dragon Palace this time, Shi Yu shouldn’t be so high-profile… If he revealed his experience, the others wouldn’t be so crazy as to publicize it.
“Dinner’s ready. Everyone, let’s go eat. Master is also here.” At this moment, Zheng Hai, who had gone to see the situation, returned to his room and smiled at everyone. “You’ve worked hard!”
“Alright!”
Everyone responded.
Soon, everyone arrived at the dining location of the training hall. Perhaps because they knew that everyone was tired of eating the food there in Dragon Palace City, the training hall by the sea specially prepared the special dishes based on land.
Soon, everyone sat at a table happily.
A moment later, the Tyrannical Sea Legend also sat down.
However, modern young people still couldn’t change the bad habit of holding cell phones at the dining table. Dragon Palace City had them cooped up for several days. They could only watch novels and videos that had already been downloaded. When it came to land, there weren’t so many things to pay attention to. They could swipe whatever it wanted.
“This.” Not long after they sat down, the blue-haired girl from the elemental family said in disbelief, “Quick, look at the news number one on the trending list.”
Upon hearing the blue-haired girl’s words, Zou Yun, who was not far away, chuckled. Eh, I was accidentally discovered. It’s so embarrassing…
“What’s wrong?” The blue-haired girl’s surprise confused White Brook, Xia Qingwei, and the others.
“It’s the World Competition. The official media said that Dong Huang is about to start the battle teams for the World Competition. A total of ten Beast Tamers under the age of 30 are to be chosen according to their strength. Wuuah, I didn’t expect that I could actually catch up to the World Competition in my lifetime.”
“What?” The blue-haired girl’s words stunned everyone and also stunned Zheng Hai. Legend Sea Tyrant was also a little surprised.
The others were stunned by this news, but the Tyrannical Sea Legend didn’t expect it to announce the news so quickly.
Among the crowd, everyone was attracted by the word world competition. Zou Yun was no exception. However, after he reacted, he quickly took out his cell phone and looked at the news of the world competition on his news. His expression immediately darkened. Ah, this…

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - World Tree’s Game (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 321 World Tree’s Game (1)
“Really?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he heard that. Then, he quickly took out his cell phone. Even the cat was no exception. It floated in the air and stared at Shi Yu’s cell phone.
The timing of the World Tournament was very irregular!!!
No one expected that they could actually catch up in their lifetime.
After all, the last time the Seven Nation Alliance organized a world competition was 20 years ago.
Moreover, in the 200 years since the establishment of the Seven Nation Alliance, the World Tournament had only been held three times.
The timing of the event was completely dependent on the mood of the World Tree. In this situation, it would be strange if the entire country didn’t explode when the news of the World Tournament suddenly appeared.
In the previous batches, because the technology was not advanced yet, the Beast Tamers had only heard of it. But this time, when they encountered it, it instantly caused a discussion among the people.
“Through the Sequence Ranking Battle, the selection of the ten strongest Beast Tamers under the age of 30 in Dong Huang will be held. Legendary Beast Tamers under the age of 30 can automatically enter the top ten. In addition, the top 100 Beast Tamers will be ranked by the officials of the Dong Huang Association according to their past battle results in major competitions such as the National League of University, the Heavenly King Cup of the Club, and the Beast Tamer Troops’ internal martial arts competition.”
“The others can register online and challenge the Beast Tamers in the rankings from scratch to increase their ranking. The higher their ranking, the richer the rewards. There are also rewards for defeating the challenger. Beast Tamers who already have rankings can also challenge higher. A year later, the ten remaining sequences will form the national team and participate in the world battle…”
“Holy shit.”
After Shi Yu saw this news, he felt that things were not simple.
“Wow.” The gem cat’s eyes also lit up. Was the world competition coming again? It wondered if there would be a participant among the students who graduated from Ancient Capital University this time. At that time, it could also travel abroad together.
Food from abroad.
“Have you all seen the news?” The Tyrannical Sea Legend saw that many young people, including Zheng Hai, were looking at their cell phones with their heads lowered and said.
“Master, you already know?” Zheng Hai asked.
“Yes.” Legend Sea Tyrant nodded. At this moment, everyone couldn’t be bothered to eat anymore and looked at Legend Sea Tyrant.
“The situation of this world competition might be a little special. Among you, Zheng Hai, Zou Yun, there’s still some hope. If you have any thoughts, you can work hard.” In the opinion of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, if they didn’t reach the Legendary level or didn’t have the ability to fight against overlord-level creatures, they would also be sending itself to death in this World Tournament. It might not necessarily be able to return alive.
Therefore, he only suggested to Zheng Hai, the disciple of a legendary Beast Tamer under the age of 30, who was a top-notch master and could already fight against an overlord, Heavenly King Zou Yun, and his Beast Taming Space had already reached level seven. He was just short of an overlord-level pet to become a legendary Beast Tamer under the age of 30.
As for the others, they were basically ordinary masters at the fifth level of the Beast Taming Space. The difference between them and the competition criteria was too big.
“Ahhh, why is it only a year?” These people also knew. For example, White Brook looked at the date on it in pain and felt a little despair. She had just broken through to level five Beast Tamer and reached the master level less than a year ago.
The difficulty of reaching level six and level seven in the Beast Taming Space was several times higher than before. Even if there was another year, it was completely impossible.
“Damn it.” Yu Shu, an intermediate Beast Tamer who wasn’t even 20 years old, could only watch the news and cry.
As for Yin Zhengfan, he also clenched his fists with an indignant expression. If he had been born 15 years earlier, he would have been able to catch up to this year’s World Tournament.
This was a stage to compete with all the Beast Tamers in the world.
Without knowing that the next World Tournament would be held decades later, the Beast Tamers who couldn’t participate this time might very well have no hope in their lives.
After all, the blessings of the World Tree were only effective for humans under 30 years old. Their age wouldn’t stop growing.
“Don’t think too much. The world war this time isn’t necessarily a good thing. Perhaps the totem country will also interfere and kill a winner among hundreds of super geniuses. Do you think it’s that fun?” Seeing the dissatisfaction on the faces of these young people, the Tyrannical Sea Legend smiled coldly.
His words stunned everyone. What? The totem country could also participate in the battle?!
“Wasn’t the Seven Nation Alliance the only one participating in the previous world competition?” Zou Yun and Zheng Hai asked in disbelief.
The seven countries were all in the same alliance. Although there were injuries and deaths in the battle, it was more for the sake of winning the battle. If anything happened, it was caused by a slip up. If there was no deep hatred, under the circumstances that one could crush his opponent, he wouldn’t have done it so ruthlessly.
However, the totem country and the seven-nation alliance were powers that were incompatible like fire and water. The feud had been formed from the totem battle 200 years ago, no, even longer. There was really a deep blood feud. In this situation, it could no longer be called a competition.
It was the game of the World Tree. Under the gaze of the World Tree, it was very difficult for both parties to leave the battlefield alive.
Thinking of this, Zheng Hai and Zou Yun’s expressions changed. Even they began to seriously consider whether they were qualified to participate in this world competition.
“This rule…” White Brook, Yu Shu, and the others didn’t understand.
“No matter what, the battle of the Sequences in this country is still worth participating in. Every time the World Tree awakens, the entire Blue Planet won’t be calm. It’s a sign. The country should focus on nurturing Beast Tamers with potential next. Therefore, in this battle of the Sequences, the Dong Huang Association should invest a lot of resources. If you can achieve good results in it, even if it’s not related to the World Tournament, it’s still beneficial for you.”
“As for the Blessing of the World Tournament…” Legend Sea Tyrant shook his head and said,” It’s better not to bite off more than you can chew.”
“That’s true…” Zheng Hai and Zou Yun were still a little unwilling.
It was mainly because the blessings of the past World Trees were too fragrant.
For example, the Blessing of the World Tree could increase the pet’s understanding and learning ability and increase the development efficiency of the pet’s super skills.
For example, the Blessing of the World Tree was also equivalent to a meditation accelerator. It could allow the Beast Tamer to reach the legendary level very quickly. Legend had it that when Lin Feng participated in the World Tournament, he was only an ordinary legend. However, after becoming the champion, it only took two years to break through two levels and enter the legendary domain to become the youngest legendary Beast Tamer in the world. The World Tree Blessing was indispensable.
In addition, the Blessing of the World Tree and the effect of letting pets evolve could also increase the lifespan of Beast Tamers. The various effects were completely equivalent to giving a Beast Tamer the potential to become the strongest in the world. In this situation, which Beast Tamer wasn’t tempted?
“Ah…” Shi Yu, who was looking at the cell phone screen, became a little shark that fell into deep thought again. He looked at the World Tree Blessing effect discussed on the Internet and immediately felt a little fragrant. What he was most worried about now was the leveling speed of the Beast Taming Space. If he could get a Blessing, wouldn’t he be invincible very quickly? Of course, at the moment, the level of the Beast Taming Space seemed to be the greatest factor limiting Shi Yu’s strength. If his Beast Taming level didn’t go up, his physique wouldn’t go up, and his pet’s strength level would go up. Then, he wouldn’t have any fate with the World Tournament…
Of course…
“To be honest, I’m not very interested in the World Tournament. The effect of the blessing… I might as well be given a Mythical cub for me to raise.” Shi Yu looked at the news and muttered to himself in his heart. With the skill index, he could become a powerful Beast Tamer sooner or later. However, Shi Yu was very interested in the World Tree itself.
The embodiment of the planet’s will… Was this thing not a Mythical life form? Didn’t people say that the mythicals had already disappeared? Therefore, did this World Tree have power or intelligence? As the embodiment of the planet’s will, could it possibly know everything that had happened to this planet in the past billions of years? For a moment, Shi Yu was suddenly extremely curious about this.
He could choose not to fight in the competition, he could choose not to receive blessings. But couldn’t he just bring a bag of melon seeds and a big watermelon to chat with the World Tree or its spokesperson and guardian?

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - Mechanical Tyrant Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 322 Mechanical Tyrant Dragon
The news of the world competition shook the country.
Now, everyone in the country was paying attention to the world competition.
Many higher-ups of the Dong Huang Association were also concerned about the world competition.
For a small matter like Heavenly King Zou contracting the overlord dragon heir, he couldn’t even get second on the trending list.
Because second on the trending list, they were guessing the list of the top ten Echelon members of Dong Huang in this world competition.
Although there was still a year before the final confirmation, he could still judge the candidates now.
“Ah, this meal.”
In less than an hour, the meal at the Binhai Training Hall dispersed.
During this period, no one discussed the matter of Dragon Palace City at all. The entire time, they surrounded the World Tournament as the exchange content.
Heavenly King Zou was disinterested. He felt that he had announced his dragon pet too early…
This world competition was too much of a scam, but he felt that he had to participate.
If he wasn’t wrong, the hot topic on the Internet for the next year would probably be the changes in the ten major sequences of Dong Huang
If he didn’t participate, it was equivalent to cutting off his own future.
In short, no matter what, he had to get into the top ten and get a participant spot. Only then could he ensure that he wasn’t a has-been.
“Was the meal alright?”
Zheng Hai, the leader of the Bin Hai Training Hall, wiped his mouth. His mind had also drifted to the World Tournament.
As the disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, his strength, potential, and talent might be even stronger than those legendary sons. He was naturally tempted to participate in the Sequence Battle of Dong Huang. “Very good,” everyone replied.
“Are you returning to the ancient capital or Ping Cheng next?” White Brook sat beside Shi Yu and poked his arm.
“Let’s return to Ping Cheng,” Shi Yu said.
Next was to prepare for the National League, but the cooperation with Dragon Palace City was not over. It was not very convenient to go to the Ancient Capital to prepare for the National League.
Instead, when they were preparing for battle in Ping Cheng, behind the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, it was connected to the ocean… And they could contact the sea beasts in Dragon Palace City at any time.
“Then I’ll return to the ancient capital first. I heard from the Tyrannical Sea Legend that the rules of the National League might change. I’ll inform you when I have news.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, the Tyrannical Sea Legend stood up slightly and said to everyone, “Then the trip to Dragon Palace City will be completely over. All the best, young people.”
“In addition, Shi Yu, come with me.”
“Eh!”
Shi Yu was stunned. Under everyone’s gaze, he was called over by the Tyrannical Sea Legend.
In another room.
Legend Sea Tyrant stopped and said, “From your expression just now, you’re interested in the world competition?”
“Uh.” Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. “I’m not interested in the World Tournament, but I’m interested in the blessings of the World Tree.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend: ?
Wasn’t that still interested in the world competition?
There was a difference?
Why were young people nowadays beating around the bush?
However, what the Tyrannical Sea Legend didn’t know was that other people wanted to participate in the World Tournament because they wanted to obtain the title of World Legend and the blessings of the World Tree. They wanted to become the strongest to prove themselves.
As for Shi Yu, he wanted toâ€
[Replication successful.]
(Divine skill has been recorded: Blessing of the World Tree.]
This was a skill that could increase the lifespan of humans.
Apart from that, chatting with the World Tree about the history of the planet was the most interesting thing!!!
Of course, Shi Yu couldn’t say it directly.
“Youâ€” Tyrannical Sea Legend fell into deep thought. He actually didn’t doubt Shi Yu’s talent potential, but the problem was that Shi Yu was still too young.
There was completely no time.
Even if it was his disciple, to be honest, he didn’t have much confidence. It had to be known that in the World Competition that year, Lin Feng won the championship with seven overlord-level pets.
As for the recent championship 20 years ago, although it wasn’t as valuable as Lin Feng’s batch, it wasn’t much different.
In this situation, not to mention Shi Yu, even if some veteran legends older than 30 years old in the country participated, they would probably die.
For example, the legend Hua Xiajin in Divine Capital, as a legend who specialized in butterfly-type creatures, she had only an overlord-level pet.
Since the World Legend was the title for a legendary Beast Tamer, it meant that the strength of the legendary Beast Tamer who could win the World Tournament was already close to a Titled Legend like him. Even if he was still a little lacking at that time, he could quickly catch up after receiving the World Tree’s Blessing
“You don’t actually have to worry too much about the world competition.”
“You’re already very lucky to have the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation in the contract. This opportunity isn’t necessarily worse than the Blessing of the World Tree. Have you already decided to establish a land branch of the Dragon Palace City’s Ocean Environmental Protection Department in the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain of Ping Cheng?” the Tyrant Sea Legend asked.
“Yes, that place isn’t far from Dragon Palace City anyway,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright, I’ve already told Principal Feng, President Ye, and the others about Dragon Palace City. If nothing goes wrong, I should send some assistants to assist you in the next few days.”
“Alright, I’ve already told Principal Feng, President Ye, and the others about Dragon Palace City. If nothing goes wrong, I should send some assistants to assist you in the next few days.”
He estimated that it wouldn’t be a problem for Shi Yu to charge into the top 20 or even the top 15 in a year. It wasn’t impossible for him to even enter the top ten. However, even if he reached the top ten, the Tyrannical Sea Legend didn’t recommend Shi Yu to participate in the world competition as a Beast Tamer who had important connections with the Blue Sea Sprites and Dragon Palace City.
After all, even the strongest Beast Tamer under the age of 30 in Dong Huang might not necessarily be first in the world competition, let alone only in the top ten.
And the first place in the World Tournament could only become a legendary Beast Tamer.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 3 Mechanical Tyrant Dragon (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 323 Mechanical Tyrant Dragon (1)
A legendary Beast Tamer was only equivalent to a half-god. As for befriending Dragon Palace City and the Blue Sea Sprite, it was more like two and a half. After all, the Blue Sea Sprite still had many hidden guardians in the sea!
Moreover, the former had a chance of less than 1%, and it might be life-threatening. As for the latter, it was almost 100%. It was a very simple mathematics problem.
“I understand. Thank you, Tyrannical Sea Legend.” Shi Yu humbly accepted the senior’s suggestion, but he still planned to consider it carefully when he returned.
This Shi Yu mainly wanted to see his strength at that time. If he didn’t have the corresponding strength, he wouldn’t go even if the Tyrannical Sea Legend wanted him to participate by pointing a knife at him.
On the same day.
Ping Cheng
Shi Yu returned alone.
WE
As for the gem cat, it had not returned to Ancient Capital University for a long time. It was afraid that its working clones would be exhausted, so it wanted to go back and euthanize them before creating a new batch of clones to replace its work.
Therefore, this time, only Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng himself.
Shi Yu returned silently and didn’t inform anyone. The moment he returned, he lay on the bed lazily.
As for the pets, they didn’t need Shi Yu’s instructions at all. They started to do their own things.
Eleven continued training. Although it was exhausted from fighting for three days and three nights, it recovered quickly. After all, it was just fighting
On the other hand, Buggy and the others were in trouble. They no longer had the strength to train. For example, Buggy had continuously visualized the Dragon God Statue and drained its energy. In addition, it had created so many Ice Dragon Phantom badges, so it had yet to recover.
It was the same for Baby Ginseng. After creating so many Time Fruits and supplements for the team members to fight for three days and three nights, the exhaustion level could be imagined. It was also half-dead tired.
As for Chi Tong, its consumption was relatively normal, it was one of the ones in the team who could move normally. As for Susu, after returning, Shi Yu had it eat the last resource, the Sea Flame Sprite core..
The Tears of the Mermaid helped it awaken the rain and the steam explosion. The million-year-old turtle shell awakened the water guardian. Shi Yu was very curious about what skills the Sea Flame Sprite core could awaken this time. As expected, after eating this, Susu fell asleep again.
After returning, Shi Yu slept for a whole day and night. After all, he had not slept in Dragon Palace City for a few days. He was staying awake on supplements. This time, with Chi Tong’s clone possessing him and the support of the recovery effect, he slept for another day before feeling completely energetic.
On the ground, Shi Yu, who was covered in fiery flames and looked like he had just come out of the cremation furnace, slowly got up and opened his eyes.
“Ha ~”
Shi Yu got up with sleepy eyes. Chi Tong’s clone quickly separated and disappeared. After waking up, Shi Yu glanced at the time and suddenly recalled something. He wore his pajamas and arrived at a certain place in the ruins space with a thought.
This was the Mechanical Stone Research Institute.
It had always been used by Shi Yu, Buggy, and the others to study the mechanical modification of the phantom beast species.
The so-called phantom beasts were pets created with illusions. Shi Yu took a look at the motionless dragon circle and knew that the group of little Tyrant Dragon illusions they raised had exhausted their energy and disappeared.
“Sigh.” Shi Yu entered the research institute and glanced at the Mythical fossil that Buggy had yet to conquer from Dragon Palace City and the Tyrant Dragon fossil that, although it had been conquered, couldn’t be modified mechanically. He felt a sense of loss.
“Buggy, let’s try again.”
After Shi Yu shouted, Buggy, who was lying on the ground and fighting the Dragon God Phantom in a dream, opened its eyes. Tiredly, it instantly teleported to Shi Yu.
“You’ve visualized the Dragon God Statue for three days and three nights. Theoretically speaking, the Dragon of Imagination skill should have improved. Let’s create another mechanical Tyrant Dragon to try!”
“Wu!!!”
Buggy nodded, although it still felt that there was no chance.
Soon, Shi Yu took out a set of golden and silver armor from the fossil mechanical research institute.
This mechanical armor was clearly not prepared for humanoid creatures. From the structure, it was clearly for creatures like the Tyrant Dragon.
However, the size of this mechanical armor was not big compared to the real Tyrant Dragon. It was only about a meter tall.
It was mainly because it was still in the experimental stage. Shi Yu didn’t want to use expensive materials to experiment.
