[Dream Mechanical Alloy), this was the name of the material for this mechanical armor. This mechanical alloy could transform electricity into dream spiritual energy. It was the core material of the mechanical beast [Mechanical Dream Beast).
Mechanical Dream Beasts were mechanical beasts that could help life forms improve their sleep quality, were good at hypnosis, and created various dreams. They mainly relied on charging to maintain their activity.
Buggy’s illusion was essentially a dream illusion. The energy was also dream spiritual energy, so it shouldn’t be wrong to use this dream mechanical alloy that could be converted into dream spiritual energy as a shell.
The current armor was something that Shi Yu had bought and assembled with a pile of basic materials after investigating various information.
However, he only prepared armor materials and intelligence chips. For things such as skill chips and even more complicated battle equipment… He definitely didn’t prepare them. After all, what he wanted to create wasn’t a mechanical dream beast, but a mechanical Tyrant Dragon. Moreover, it was only the initial stage of its birth. Everything was still in the experiment, so there was no need to pursue perfection.
In Shi Yu’s concept, illusions were the chips that carried all skills, so what he needed to do now was to connect the illusions to these mechanical parts as a whole and awaken it into an intelligent life form.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - Mechanical Tyrant Dragon (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 324 Mechanical Tyrant Dragon (2)
In the huge fossil research institute, the super metal (Dream Mechanical Alloy), which was intertwined with gold and silver, hung in the room. Under Buggy’s imagination, a shrunken Tyrannosaurus figure slowly filled the mechanical armor.
A moment later, the connection device of the mechanical armor was inserted into the body of the Tyrant Dragon Phantom. A mechanical Tyrant Dragon Beast in gold and silver mechanical armor, with huge [Eleven Special Lightning Rod Claw] on its arms, and the shell on its back was the prototype of the strongest shield (Eleven Special Lightning Rod Shield).
The special quality of one of the materials in the (Dream Mechanical Alloy) was that it could be relatively perfect for charging materials. Shi Yu took the materials for this charging material on the spot and naturally chose Eleven’s hardening substance. After all, it could perfectly attract lightning. When the time came, he could rely on the lightning in nature to charge it.
After everything was assembled, the intelligent chip inserted into the phantom’s body by the mechanical armor also lit up. However, at this moment, Shi Yu did not show any joy. This was because, just like before, the intelligent chip was not compatible with the Tyrant Dragon Phantom, causing this mechanical life form to be unable to undergo subsequent awakenings.
“Change, change for me.”
“Change, change, change.”
Shi Yu held the Awakening Mirror and shone it on the smart learning upgrade chip installed in the Tyrant Dragon’s body for a long time. There was no reaction at all. This situation gave Shi Yu an especially headache.
Assuming that he had used the Dream Mechanical Alloy and the intelligent chip to create the mechanical dream beast according to teaching skills, he would definitely have succeeded now. At the moment, there were only a few more changes. Changing the various templates of the mechanical dream beast into phantom templates, the process would directly be stuck, and it would be very uncomfortable.
“Forget it, it’s just a fantasy to create mechanical beasts of overlord races according to the teaching materials of the Mechanic Department of Ancient Capital University. I’ll try it slowly after the National League.” Shi Yu stretched and gave up struggling again.
However, it wasn’t that this mechanical Tyrant Dragon couldn’t fight or move…
After Buggy also sighed, it immediately gave the Tyrant Dragon command with the power of imagination.
Soon, this mechanical Tyrant Dragon opened its violent eyes and jumped up to celebrate the failure of this experiment again.
The illusion was created by Buggy, so it could naturally give it commands. However, although this way, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon could move around and could also rely on mechanical armor and lightning to maintain the energy needed to move, the current it couldn’t be judged as a life at all. It was just a phantom wearing mechanical equipment, no different from those machines on Earth that could move after charging.
Not only would Shi Yu’s index not react to it, but it was also impossible for a Beast Tamer’s contract to successfully contract a phantom wearing equipment. Therefore, in essence, it wasn’t considered a living life form or a mechanical life form.
After all, even mechanical lives had the most basic requirement: to learn the ability to think and grow on their own.
In the current situation of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon, it was even inferior to the forbidden weapon that suppressed its ability to think.
“Stop giving it commands. Don’t give it any commands. Let it try acting instinctively and see if it can give birth to intelligence,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!” Buggy nodded. In the next moment, it canceled the command to broadcast gymnastics to the mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
“Roar?”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon, which was in the midst of jumping, was stunned. Then, its gaze became even more violent.
It was a pair of ferocious eyes without any rationality, only retaining the most primitive hunting desire of the Tyrant Dragon in the dream. In an instant, Shi Yu determined that the current mechanical Tyrant Dragon still couldn’t be called a mechanical life form, but a proper killing machine.
“Roar!!!! (I am the Overlord of the Earth!!)” Buggy only left behind the most primitive instinct of the Tyrant Dragon in the Tyrant Dragon’s dream that was replicated through the dream stealing skill. This mechanical Tyrant Dragon, which was more than a meter tall, stared at Shi Yu with a ferocious gaze. It opened its bloody mouth and roared. A blazing wind instantly blew over.
Boom!!!
At the same time, it immediately bit at Shi Yu, as if it wanted to hunt food and fill its stomach.
Bang!
However, the moment the mechanical Tyrant Dragon attacked, Shi Yu swung his fist and hit its face. The huge impact sent several of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s teeth flying, causing its face to completely deform. Then, it flew backward with a whoosh and hit the wall.
“What king are you??” Shi Yu asked.
Although this guy had inherited all the skills of the overlord race’s Tyrant Dragon, including super skills, the initial battle power that Buggy had set for it was transcendent, so it naturally couldn’t defeat Shi Yu.
Of course, it couldn’t understand Shi Yu’s words either. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon had no intelligence at all. Even if Shi Yu had telepathy, Shi Yu couldn’t communicate with it normally.
This intelligence was simply inferior to the Green Silkworm.
“Roar…” After suffering the impact, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon immediately wanted to escape instinctively.
Buggy :”…”
It looked up at Shi Yu. What else could it do?
Shi Yu sighed. “Forget it, I’ll let it maintain the most primitive wild activity in the dream first. I’ll lock it in the dragon ring. This time, I’ll let the phantom maintain a mechanical state for a longer time. Let’s see if it can slowly develop feelings with the smart chip.”
“In any case, there’s a battery. As long as it doesn’t destroy itself, it shouldn’t disappear so quickly.”
“Wu!!” Buggy understood.
The next moment, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon without intelligence and missing teeth was instantly teleported into the dragon circle and continued to roar at the sky.
“Roar!!!! (I am the overlord of the earth!!)”

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - Healing Movie
chapters.content:
Chapter 325 Healing Movie
After tormenting the mechanical Tyrant Dragon without any results, Shi Yu and Buggy decisively gave up.
Shi Yu stretched and pulled Buggy out to eat ice cream to reward Buggy.
Buggy was actually pretty interesting. Although it didn’t work as hard as Eleven during normal training, it easily did what Eleven and the others couldn’t.
Even when sleeping and resting, it could train in its dreams.
“Wu!”
In such a situation, Buggy felt that apart from the cheat Water Slime, it might be the second big boss in the team who could train its will to the intermediate level after the leader!
After all…
“TT_TT Mi… Mi…”
Just as Shi Yu and Buggy came out of the ruins space, they heard a strange sound.
Shi Yu and Buggy looked at each other in confusion. Then, they quickly teleported to the living room.
Chi Tong, in the form of a sword spirit, was watching the television with tears in its eyes. It hugged the ice basin and cried.
Of course, its tears were fire silk.
“It’s really you.”
“Mi-” Chi Tong pointed at the screen with tears all over its face.
Shi Yu and Buggy looked over. It seemed like a movie had just ended. At this moment, it was broadcasting the ending song and the situation of the producers.
Shi Yu and Buggy were immediately confused.
“Mi!! (Look at my willpower, has it become an overlord’s will!)”
Chi Tong cried as it said to Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “?”
Buggy:???
What did it mean?
Although Shi Yu didn’t understand, he still took a look.
Skill: Interlocking Sword
[Teaching success rate]: Medium “Huh??!”
This look stunned Shi Yu and he revealed an incredulous gaze.
Chi Tong and Buggy looked at the shocked Shi Yu.
“Although it hasn’t reached the stage of the overlord’s will, it’s just one level away. Your current will stage is already close to eleven, surpassing Buggy and Baby Ginseng. How did you do it?”
Shi Yu was stunned.
In his opinion, Buggy, who had visualized the Dragon God Statue and tempered its will, should be the first to reach medium will.
In the end, Little Chi Tong, who had always kept a low profile, overtook them silently.
“Huh???” When he heard Shi Yu say that Chi Tong’s willpower improved faster than its, Buggy was instantly stunned and revealed a confused expression.
It didn’t make sense.
On the other hand, Chi Tong, who was crying, bent its sword and smiled. It was in a much better mood.
“Mi!!” With that said, it explained to Shi Yu and Buggy how it operated.
It asked Susu what it needed to do to train a powerful will.
Susu’s answer: A firm goal.
A firm goal that could make one sacrifice one’s life.
Then, Chi Tong thought about the meaning of its birth.
As a “heroic spirit”, it existed to protect Beast Tamers.
Even without a contract, the heroic spirit hatched by the Beast Tamer could still have a close connection with the Beast Tamer. Therefore, its most determined goal was to protect Shi Yu from any harm.
It wanted to strengthen this belief!
For this, Chi Tong began to flip through a large number of movies with protection as the topic to watch, hoping to understand the true meaning of protection. It finished 13 movies a day and night, but after watching them, its heart was calm.
This was very uncomfortable.
Then, it saw a “healing-type” movie on the website. Chi Tong, who wanted to change its taste and change its mood, directly clicked on it to watch. However, who knew that this movie was really so healing?
Chi Tong was quite happy watching the first half of the story. The plot was also quite healing, but later on, the protagonists and supporting actors died one after another. In the end, no one could protect each other. Chi Tong was directly depressed, and it cried as it watched.
It felt that its mentality had collapsed. After collapsing, it recombined. Its willpower seemed to have improved, and its willpower to protect Shi Yu became even stronger.
“Mi!” Chi Tong showed an expression as expected of himself.
Buggy: ?????
“Wu!! Ji!!! Wu wu! Ji!!” After Buggy heard that, it was very confused and asked Shi Yu crazily. Was this reasonable! It had trained so hard while awake, and even when it was asleep, it trained. Its willpower had yet to break through, but Chi Tong had already broken through after watching a movie. Was this reasonable!!
Shi Yu was silent. He didn’t know if this was reasonable or not, nor did he dare to ask, but…
Shi Yu glanced at the name of this movie. “Black Forest”. Chi Tong, how did it get this title related to a healing-type movie??
“This is very scientific. Not only is willpower related to experience, but it’s also related to race. Some races are born bold and brave, while others are born timid and weak. This will all affect their willpower after birth. Chi Tong is a heroic spirit race, born to protect. Its goal is firm. In addition, its General Mu Huiyin’s power reincarnation is similar to Susu’s situation. It’s very normal for its willpower to increase quickly…” Shi Yu comforted Buggy beside him.
Buggy: (? _ m)?? Its race was naturally timid and weak. Wasn’t he talking about the Green Silkworm?
Shi Yu squeezed Chi Tong with a smile and said, “Little Chi Tong is still the best!”
“Mi!!”
However, after pinching Chi Tong, Shi Yu was a little worried. Chi Tong’s greatest dream was to protect him. Was it alright?
amn
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. In fact, he didn’t want his pet’s dream to be related to him.
For example, the greatest dream of the Blue Sea Sprites was to cleanse filth and protect the sea.
Baby Ginseng wanted to change the fate of the supplements and become a powerful battle ginseng. It wasn’t bad.
Even if he was gone one day, they could still continue their dreams.
However, if Chi Tong’s dream was to protect himself, with the lifespan of humans that was only two to three hundred years, wasn’t this a scam?
Compared to the undead race, the lifespan of humans was less than one percent of the other party’s life.
After he died, wouldn’t Chi Tong become a salted fish that had lost its dream?
Unless he could really obtain the blessings of the World Tree and become a longevity type.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and felt that it was better to find a more serious dream for Chi Tong to pursue. The heroic spirit race was too stubborn. It wasn’t like he had never studied this. Almost all the undead born in the heroic spirit ruins had this personality trait.
After rubbing Little Chi Tong’s head, Shi Yu looked at the television.
After the movie was broadcast, the show automatically switched to the relevant fluff.
“Teacher Yan Junyi, do you have any thoughts about the overall box office earnings of ‘Black Forest’ breaking through 3 billion and becoming the most popular movie in the history of Dong Huang?” In the scene, a reporter holding a microphone was interviewing a woman with an oval face and a very gentle appearance. This woman was very beautiful, and Shi Yu recognized her at a glance.
The other party was the most famous actress and female celebrity in Dong Huang, Yan Junyi. When he saw that the movie Chi Tong was watching was the other party’s main lead and that the box office was so high, Shi Yu immediately understood why Chi Tong only had feelings when it watched this movie.
It couldn’t be helped. There were too few good movies that could stir people’s emotions. Most of the time, it was a lousy movie. It was like you didn’t even watch it. It was rare for a movie with a reputation and explosive box office. It was normal for Little Chi Tong to feel a little uncomfortable after watching it.
“Wu!!!” Buggy was excited. It was a rich lady!
It looked at Shi Yu. It was three billion yuan at the box office. Was there a need to get to know each other?
“There’s no need.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. There were so many rich ladies. How could he get to know them all?
Shi Yu looked at the television again.
This Yan Junyi was also a Beast Tamer. In this day and age, no matter what, even if it was filming a movie, it would still look very unprofessional if one didn’t have a Beast Tamer title. Moreover, the hottest topic now was still a movie about Beast Tamers. If the main lead was a powerful Beast Tamer, the audience would be very convinced.
As a currently popular female star, this Yan Junyi was naturally not weak either. She was a famous top-notch master. She had contracted an overlord species pet, Flower Fairy, and was also known to have a legendary figure. In short, like Heavenly King Zou, she was a celebrity-type Beast Tamer. However, she basically specialized in filming movies, while Zou Yun specialized in competing. His focus was a little different.
“She doesn’t seem to be 30 years old. I wonder if she’s interested in the World Tournament. Well, such a beautiful woman should stay in Dong Huang to raise the eyes of the netizens. It’s not suitable for a place like the World Tournament where people fight and kill,” Shi Yu muttered before looking at Buggy.
Buggy was also looking at him. “Why are you looking at me?” “Wu…” Buggy’s eyes were filled with tears. It didn’t want to watch anymore. It wanted to go back and train.
“Don’t worry, the movie looks pretty good. I haven’t seen it yet. Watch it with me.”
Buggy fell into deep thought.
Wasn’t this a waste of time? It wasn’t confident that it could break through just by watching a movie like Chi Tong…
“This is also a form of training. After watching it, write me a review. I won’t make things difficult for you. Just replay every scene, every scene, and every frame in the two-hour movie with the Imagination Domain.”
Buggy: ???
“This is equivalent to training super skills.”
“In addition, it’s also considered to be nurturing a secondary role for you. Look, movies are so profitable. This three billion box office isn’t the highest. When the day comes when you can use the Imagination Domain to create an explosive movie, under the situation where the actors, venues, special effects, and clothes are all saved, you’ll earn the most. This is much easier than selling equipment, right?”
“If we film a blockbuster movie, we can even buy legendary-level resources.”
Buggy: Wu?!!
Wait a minute?
Buggy’s eyes gradually lit up as it looked at Shi Yu. That seemed to be the case. This seemed to be easier than selling equipment one by one?
It understood. It would apply for an account now and train from filming to uploading short videos.
Then, it would film a few more “Legend of Mu Huiyin”, “Emperor Wu vs Yun An”, “The Things About the Undying Dark Phoenix and the Empress”, “The Love of the Dragon Emperor and the Dragon God that Crossed Thousands of Years”, and “Shiyu Causing Trouble In the Seas”. When the box office exploded, it would directly buy ten legendary resources to guarantee totem level!
Shi Yu: “?”
ne.
“I just want you to watch a movie with me What do you know?? Can these things be filmed?”
Was it sure the other party won’t come and show off your ashes after it filmed the Dragon God’s movie? And what the hell was Shi Yu messing around with the sea?
“Mi! (I want to be the female lead of ‘Mu Huiyin’s Legend’… sword.)” Chi Tong and the worm director applied for the dragon costume position.
“Why are you joining in the fun… Go and prepare to break through to the monarch level first.” Shi Yu pulled Chi Tong up. It was time to break through to the middle level of will. The other pets were the same as Eleven. They would break through to the middle level of will. The overlord will was too difficult. It could slowly train after the monarch level. The main reason was to suppress his meditation speed. Without strength, how could he touch the World Tree?
If possible, his requirements weren’t high. He would get a national team reserve position, the tenth sequence at the bottom, and follow to the World Tree to touch it and broaden his horizons. If it was a real battle, he would leave it to those super geniuses.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - Breaking Through Monarch Level for Chi Tong
chapters.content:
Chapter 326 Breaking Through Monarch Level for Chi Tong
The sun was shining brightly today. In the cold villa area of Ping Cheng, Shi Yu hugged the pillow with the cute panda picture and swiped through the movie Chi Tong had just finished.
After watching it, Buggy cried hard, completely destroying the dreamy form of the Butterfly of Imagination.
“Wu, Wu, wu, wu.”
Buggy couldn’t help but cry. The person who wrote the script was definitely sick.
“Pfft—” Shi Yu took a tissue and wiped his red eyes before blowing his nose.
He had no objections to writing the protagonist and supporting role to death, but it was too much to write everything to death in the end, even though the front part was so well filmed.
Even if he was spoiled by Chi Tong in advance, he almost couldn’t recover.
“This Yan Junyi is not only the main lead, but also the author and director of the script?”
Shi Yu looked at the comments on the Internet and immediately understood that this was a ruthless bad woman.
“When we encounter her in the battle of the Sequences, let’s eliminate her. What kind of stupid play is this? She was just giving out candy when she suddenly attacked.”
“Mi!”
Chi Tong was stunned. Wasn’t this a little too targeted? Why would the audience take revenge on her for making a movie? Sob, sob, sob.
Although the plot was a little depressing, at least it had broken through.
“Wu!!” Buggy looked at Chi Tong. Stop it, it was even more depressed after hearing this. Why didn’t it break through after watching it!!
Director Bug decided that it didn’t want to film something like this. It wanted to film something inspirational!
It was bitter first, then sweet.
Legend of Mu Huiyin!
The story of the ostracized mixed-blood girl growing into the number one general who established the dynasty!
Most importantly, after the first movie ended, it could continue to film the second movie, “Mu Huiyin’s Legend of Second Rebirth, Chi Tong”. It could earn more money!
Even the external story “The Phoenix Race’s Conspiracy” “Mu Huiyin and the empress”… could be filmed.
“Mi!!” Chi Tong’s eyes lit up.
It still wanted to be the female lead’s sword!
After watching so many cartoons and movies, it was very interested in going on screen.
Although it could only be the sword of the female lead and had almost zero presence, it was not bad.
“You guys are really torturing…” Shi Yu pondered.
“Modifying and distorting history… You have to go to jail.”
“Wu!! (This movie is purely wishful thinking…)” Buggy added. “Let’s not talk about this anymore. We can’t shoot anything else, but this Legend Mu Huiyin is indeed alright.”
IO
Seeing that Buggy and Chi Tong were really interested, Shi Yu said.
Mu Huiyin’s history was not recorded.
Although the hundreds of people in the heroic spirit ruins knew the reason.
However, most Beast Tamers in Dong Huang didn’t know that there was a person like Mu Huiyin.
The Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng and even Icefield didn’t know the true identity of the Ice Dragon’s owner.
Those who could come into contact with Mu Huiyin’s information were all extremely core upper echelons.
Generally speaking, this archaeological discovery could be announced.
However, at that time, because Shi Yu was only an intermediate Beast Tamer and was too weak, it was not good for him to be so weak and related to the heroic spirit of a sensitive figure like Mu Huiyin.
Therefore, in order to let Shi Yu not be targeted by the totem clans, the news about Mu Huiyin was temporarily sealed.
However, now, Shi Yu felt that there was no need to seal the news at all, because he already had the initial strength to protect himself.
A genius that had yet to grow up needed protection, but a genius that had grown up needed a bright sword, not restrained, but showing off.
Gao Xuan’s Awakening Talent was the same as the mechanical legend. His potential posed a greater threat. Why did he dare to reveal it?
This was because he could release a small forbidden weapon. Even if the totem didn’t appear, an overlord could still shatter when it came. This was his confidence.
Similarly, Shi Yu was now considered one of the best among the masters. In this situation, even if Chi Tong’s race was announced, Shi Yu felt that it was nothing.
They had already contracted the Blue Sea Sprite that had enmity with the Abyss Sea, so why would they be afraid of involving the totem power Mu Huiyin had offended?
The more the debt, the greater the pressure!
“General Mu Huiyin chose to hide her history because of the social situation at that time, but the situation now is different.”
Shi Yu recalled Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit’s evaluation of the empress as “I’m inferior to her”. That relieved tone made Shi Yu understand that Mu Huiyin actually cared a lot about the evaluation of her as a mixed-blood general in the future.
Aunt Ice Dragon had also said that Mu Huiyin was actually a cold person on the outside but warm on the inside. She very much wanted to be acknowledged. Unfortunately, due to her childhood experience, apart from the pets she contracted, Mu Huiyin had never opened her heart to anyone.
Shi Yu felt that it was time to restore General Mu Huiyin’s heroic deeds. He could also leave Chi Tong’s true race to fate and not deliberately hide it.
“Shoot. Let’s make a one-minute trailer to warm up first. Dig a pit on the short video platform and make it better.” Restoring history through Buggy’s Imagination Domain! If he filmed it well, he might even be able to snatch a few of Heavenly King Zou’s trending topics.
“Wu!!” Buggy’s expression was excited. Alright.
“Mi!!” Chi Tong was instantly excited when he heard that he could also participate in Mu Huiyin’s legend.
“Why don’t we go to the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain to film? We can also let Chi Tong break through there.” Shi Yu smiled.
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
Although the interior had already become a flaming mountain, the outside world was still an ice and snow environment. Many snow ferocious beasts lived here.
This time, Shi Yu really didn’t bring any bodyguards into the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
With Shi Yu’s current strength, he wasn’t afraid of anything. Under Chi Tong’s possession, he directly swept the flames through the snowstorm area.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - Breaking Through Monarch Level for Chi Tong (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 327 Breaking Through Monarch Level for Chi Tong (1)
Soon, they arrived at their destination.
Perhaps it was because the snow mountain had been cleared previously, but when Shi Yu and the others came this time, they didn’t even encounter a ferocious beast blocking the way. It was especially smooth. Apart from the fact that the natural environment was a little difficult to deal with, everything was alright.
Hu hu ~
At the border of ice and fire, Shi Yu looked at the ice and snow on the side and at the Flaming Torrent at the side. He sighed. It was really the difference between ice and fire.
The environment here had been changed by the small forbidden weapon, the Sun Rose. It was a very good place to sense the power of the sun. Shi Yu planned to let Chi Tong break through here.
Just like how Eleven triggered the heavenly lightning to strengthen its breakthrough back then, Little Chi Tong definitely had to learn it and stimulate the power of the sun to break through.
“Mi ~” After reaching their destination, Chi Tong and Shi Yu separated and looked up at the fiery red sun in the sky.
Eh?
However, as they watched, Chi Tong and Shi Yu were quickly stunned.
In the sky, two black dots gradually appeared. Soon, the red and blue figures gradually enlarged and emitted a fierce cry. It was a huge ice and snow bird with wings like ice crystals, as well as a huge fire bird with three heads and shining flame feathers.
< Name > Ice Feather Bird
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
[Name]: Flame Three-Headed Bird
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
Shi Yu quickly saw their figures and was puzzled. It was fine if there were Ice Feather Birds here, but how could there be a Flame Three-Headed Bird on a snow mountain?
However, he didn’t encounter any trouble along the way. When he arrived at his destination, trouble came out. This was something Shi Yu didn’t expect.
“Jiu!!! (Darling, let’s settle them. We finally found a place suitable for the two of us to stay at at the same time. We can’t be disturbed.)”
“Jiu Jiu Jiu!! (Alright, my dear, you actually took advantage of our fusion of ice and fire to invade. Too detestable.)”
Shi Yu and Chi Tong: “?”.
Did they think they couldn’t understand?
When did this place become your habitat?
These guys clearly couldn’t be together, there was reproductive isolation going on. How come they were mingling?
There were all kinds of strange creatures in nature, so how could they be better at playing than the dragons in Dragon Palace City?
Shi Yu felt that these two guys might have moved over from somewhere.
He didn’t expect that the Ice Fire Snow Mountain had attracted “compatible” wild creatures in such a short period of time…
“Jiu!!!”
“Jiu!!”
As the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird communicated, they swooped down together, wanting to add a meal before “mixing” their ice and fire parts.
Shi Yu naturally couldn’t let them do as they pleased.
He glanced at Chi Tong and sighed slightly. Then, he waved his arm and said, “Since they like the fusion of ice and fire so much, Chi Tong, satisfy them.”
“Soul Slash!”
“Mi!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, Chi Tong also waved gently in the form of a little sword spirit.
Boom!
In the next moment, the Soul Slaying Sword Domain formed. A gray transparent sword domain instantly enveloped the attacking Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird, stunning them.
In the next moment, in the sword domain, two transparent gray sword lights slashed out. Although they were also commander rank, the difference in strength was several times, making them unable to fight back at all against Chi Tong’s ability. The gray sword light directly slashed into their bodies in their frightened eyes.
However, what shocked the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird even more was that this sword light did not cause any damage to their bodies and minds!
But it wasn’t like it didn’t affect them at all.
In a short second, the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird were extremely afraid. This was because they discovered that after this gray sword light slashed into their bodies, it was like an agile scalpel. It was as if it was tearing apart their bodies one by one, wanting to separate their souls from their bodies!
During this process, they felt an extremely repressed power that made them unable to control their movements. They could only watch helplessly as their souls were perfectly sliced apart by this sword light.
“The saber slashes the body, the heart slashes the soul, so the two of you will always be loving.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, with a snap of his fingers, the souls of the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird in the Soul Sword Domain quickly left their body under the push of the sword pressure.
Under Shi Yu and Chi Tong’s bad taste, the Ice Feather Bird’s soul that was perfectly extracted from its body was pushed into the Flame Three-Headed Bird’s empty shell body. The Flame Three-Headed Bird’s soul was pushed into the Ice Feather Bird’s body…
With a simple operation, the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird in midair immediately shuddered. Then, like kites with their strings broken, they fell down with widened eyes. As they fell, they looked at each other in disbelief.
Skill: Soul Slash
< Introduction > It’s a high-level undead skill. It can release Soul Slash and double the damage to undead creatures.
If it was a perfect-level Soul Slash, it would naturally be a simple Soul Slash. However, a max-level Soul Slash had many uses. For example, it was like a soul scalpel that could perfectly cut the enemy’s soul away from the body…
It was a very safe and clean skill to collect soul power and physical materials of ferocious beasts.
Right now, the Ice Feather Bird and the Flame Three-Headed Bird were equivalent to exchanging souls, so after they fell to the ground, they were extremely stunned.
It was really a fusion of ice and fire.
Such a strange event made them think that they were dreaming. In addition to the powerful soul aura emitted by Chi Tong just now, they couldn’t care less about their bodies and souls. After two screams, they controlled their new bodies with difficulty and flew into the sky, trying to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - Breaking Through to Monarch Level Chi Tong (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 328 Breaking Through to Monarch Level Chi Tong (2)
Shi Yu didn’t stop them. He touched his nose that was covered in snowflakes. After wiping away the water droplets, he shook his head regretfully.
How could they show off their love and still want to kill a single guy like him… Farewell. There are only a few days left to live. Treasure it well.
Although Chi Tong could cut the other party’s soul out of his body without being injured, it couldn’t perfectly let a soul enter another object. The soul would be in the outside world for a long time or in an incompatible object. If it couldn’t evolve into an undead race in time, then what awaited them was the destruction of their souls.
The level of the Soul Slash skill was still too low. Otherwise, it would be pretty good to draw a soul for the mechanical beast to use as a brain.
If he wanted to do this, Shi Yu estimated that he had to at least use a super skill, Soul Exchange. Moreover, the skill proficiency couldn’t be low.
In fact, Shi Yu was still more hungry for the skill that Emperor Shi’s undead and time dual-element that could create heroic spirits… In theory, Emperor Shi could completely use this skill to transform himself into an extraordinary life form and obtain a longer lifespan, right?
“Continue breaking through,” Shi Yu said. “Mi!” Chi Tong nodded.
Sun Flame+Energy Storage Beam instantly summoned the power of the sun from outer space.
Sparks quickly gathered on the little sword spirit floating in the air… At this moment, the power accumulated in Chi Tong’s body, under the control of the energy control trained by its super high skill proficiency, swept up the power of the sun that descended from the sky and began to crazily baptize its spirit body.
In the sky within the range of the Ice Fire Snow Mountain, an extremely grand scene appeared. The Sword Spirit Body completely formed by orange-red sun flames became larger and larger. Countless sun flames scattered in all directions to form a fire bird, and then it grew into a fire phoenix covered in orange-red sword feathers. In the end, it integrated into the Sword Spirit’s body.
All the flames began to converge inward. The flames carried a shocking phoenix might. The orange sword light that shot into the sky instantly filled the sky.
Shi Yu held his breath and carefully observed the changes after Chi Tong’s breakthrough.
Chi Tong’s rising aura was actually a manifestation of the change in energy value.
The perfect fusion of microscopic energy into the body brought about a transformation in the level of life and strength. It could allow Chi Tong to be reborn and its strength to increase greatly.
500,000…
1 million…
2 million…
Just like Eleven’s breakthrough, after Chi Tong broke through, he easily exceeded the basic energy level of ordinary overlord-level pets.
It was still increasing crazily.
3 million… 3.5 million…
“Can it break 4 million?” Shi Yu was curious.

Energy Points: 3,910,000
In the end, Chi Tong’s energy level stopped at 3.91 million. However, Shi Yu didn’t have much regret. He looked at Chi Tong, who had restrained all its flames and aura and returned to its little sword spirit form, and nodded happily.
Not bad.
Although it was a little worse than Eleven’s Normal State of more than four million, much worse than Eleven after its eruption, Chi Tong could possess him. Its max-level possession was even more ferocious than Eleven’s restrained sharpness at the moment. In addition, the proficiency of the Spirit Release was easy to farm. It would quickly reach the perfect level and unlock the overlord new form. It might be the first to reach the overlord level in the team. If it wasn’t it, it would be Susu. These two had the greatest hope.
“Congratulations,” Shi Yu said.
“Mi!!!! (When do we start filming a movie!!!)” Little Chi Tong flew over quickly.
“…What’s the hurry?”
A day later.
Shi Yu, Buggy, and Chi Tong returned to Ping Cheng exhausted.
Buggy picked up its cell phone and used Shi Yu’s identity card to register an account in the cultural community and video platform where the young people of Dong Huang were gathered.
ere
Account nickname: Time Traveler
Then, it sent the video it had filmed onto the screen. The content was simulated by the Imagination Domain, and the camera used was from a cell phone. There was a reason why cell phones in this world were expensive. They had good functions in all aspects, and they weren’t inferior to the top cameras on Earth.
The title was “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin”.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - Slime of the Overlord Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 329 Slime of the Overlord Race
Dong Huang, Demon Capital.
At the Pyro Company’s headquarters.
Pyro was now a cultural community and video platform where young people of Dong Huang gathered.
Celebrity Beast Tamers like Zou Yun, Yan Junyi, and the others had stationed stations and were head traffic figures.
Buggy finally chose this platform to release its carefully composed and edited “Mu Huiyin Legend”.
The reason was very simple. Recently, there was an activity here. There was an event to help newbies rise.
As a newbie, Buggy wanted to be taken care of.
Not long after it was uploaded, the backstage team received the video released by Buggy from the video review editor of the Pyro platform.
“Once the website starts an event, all the random things come at us. Do they even know how to make videos?”
The review editor, Wang Dahu, numbly reviewed one video after another.
Although his job wasn’t to judge the quality of the video, but to review whether the video was suitable to be released, whether it was inappropriate, or whether there were sensitive topics, watching the video was, after all, a process of receiving information. He still subconsciously evaluated the level of the video in his heart.
For example, a video like “What would the outcome be if you gave the Green Silkworm ten peppers” or “Change my pet, the Flame Monkey, into a maid costume” might even have some views.
But was there a problem with those distributors who didn’t even have pet elements in the video? Did they know what the hot topic was now? They didn’t even do their homework and came to participate in the event!
Beautiful girls, handsome guys, strong pets, cute pets! If it really couldn’t be done, one could even use the truth to gain popularity. For example, he could create a world competition player tier list for the audience to fight over.
–
If he didn’t have any of this, how dare these participants still want to get an award?
The review editor, Wang Dahu, reviewed a video in ten seconds and quickly flipped through it. Soon, he reviewed “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin”.
“What kind of lousy title is this? Will someone click on it?” He muttered and opened the video.
[Even the overlord of ice and snow can’t suppress my power?]
At the start of the video, a female voice that hit the soul came from the black screen.
The moment the female voice landed in the ears of the review editor, Wang Dahu, he subconsciously judged that this might be a video of a certain edited cartoon and movie. If it weren’t for the voice talent that had undergone professional training, how could a normal person say such a transient voice?
In the next moment, the scene changed. The black screen gradually became clear. In the background of the endless snow mountain that was blowing snow, on the snow, a woman with peerless charm and extraordinary boldness appeared in silver armor and a fire-like red cloak.
Her back was facing the scene, but soon, the scene changed to the front with the snow and wind, allowing the review editor to see her face clearly.
This person had soft snow-white skin, fiery red hair that draped over her shoulders, and a very beautiful face without any makeup. The most unique thing was her deep starry eyes.
Mu Huiyin stood on the snow. On the ground in front of her was a fiery red longsword with the tip of the sword slightly sunk into the ground. Her hands naturally pressed on the hilt of the sword as she stared at the towering snow mountain in front of her.
“Holy shit, who is this?”
In an instant, the review editor was stunned by General Mu Huiyin’s extraordinary aura and beautiful face. He quickly recalled which movie this was, but before he could react, with a boom, Mu Huiyin’s body in the scene erupted with flames that shot into the sky. The flames shot into the sky. In an instant, the world changed. The snow on the entire snow mountain actually started to melt and evaporate, and white mist swept through the sky.
“Roar!” Then, countless ferocious beasts in the snow mountain raised their heads in shock, looking at the drastic change in the sky and the shocked expression of sensing the heat wave coming. In a few seconds, the ferocious beasts that appeared involved transcendent races to overlord races, the snow wolves that looked up collectively, and the Ice River Spine Beasts whose pupils constricted on the snow mountain. The figures of more than ten thousand ferocious beasts appeared in the scene and were forced back a few steps by the sudden hot wind.
Such a spectacular scene stunned the review editor, Wang Dahu, because he had bragged about seeing countless movies. However, he swore that if there were such a big movie, he would definitely have watched it before. He wouldn’t be so stunned now.
In just ten seconds, the reviewing editor was fully focused. He didn’t review it quickly, but watched carefully and seriously.
Then, the scene continued to change. The huge title of “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin” appeared in the video again. Then, other voices began to appear in the video. However, the dry, heavy, and blurry voices made people feel that this voice didn’t sound like it was made by humans. In fact, the figures that appeared were also some ferocious beasts and alien races.
[It’s a unit under Emperor Shi.)
(It looks like that hybrid Beast Tamer named Mu Huiyin.)
(This woman will be our greatest threat.]
They had been evaluating a special figure.
Just as they finished speaking, with an incomparable explosion, the female general and the woman they were talking about at the start of the video swept up orange flames in the smoke. She rode a frost dragon and landed in the enemy camp with a flaming sword in hand.
Following that, it was the grand and explosive battle scene. Countless words appeared.
(A mysterious female general with two bloodlines.]
(The earliest Beast Tamer to be given a title in the ancient country.]

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - Slime of the Overlord Race (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 330 Slime of the Overlord Race (1)
[Suppressing the totem with her own strength.]
[Annihilating 39 overlords, destroying countless monarchs.]
In just a minute, the video was stuffed with a lot of content. The battle scene occupied the core, allowing people to clearly experience Mu Huiyin’s strength. She didn’t rely on any pets at all. All the pets were even just mounts. A person and a sword killed countless overlords. The fiery sword light covered the sky and the ground.
In the video, Mu Huiyin and her holding the longsword called Red Sparrow that could emit the cry of a phoenix were absolute protagonists.
[From today onwards, you are the Ice Dragon General of the Dong Huang Dynasty.]
A dignified voice sounded.
However, what appeared in the scene was the figure of the woman leaving the seed of power on the heroic spirit altar that many people were familiar with before gradually leaving.
[This place doesn’t suit me.)
(A snow mountain is not enough to isolate the huge ocean empire. Leave the border of the dynasty to me. Remember to erase my information.)
As the final voice fell, the video ended.
“Lost History: Legend of Mu Huiyin”, please wait for more.
A few big words appeared again, making the review editor, Wang Dahu, fall into deep thought. “What’s going on, what’s going on…!”
He stopped work and opened the webpage. He searched for the words “Mu Huiyin” on the webpage, but he got no results.
He used the video to check the heavy software and compared this video in the resource bank. The result was also that this was a very new original video.
What the hell…
He widened his eyes. Don’t tell him that this was created by a newbie. Are you sure this isn’t a promotional film for a huge movie worth hundreds of millions?
However, this level 1 alternate account named Time Traveler didn’t even have a certification. It didn’t look like the official account of a big company at all. The review editor couldn’t be rectified immediately.
“Lost history… Remember to erase my information… General under Emperor Shi? Holy shit, what does this video mean?”
Icefield, Ping Cheng.
An hour after Buggy posted the video, the assessment finally passed. Buggy ran to Shi Yu excitedly with its cell phone.
“It passed?”
Buggy used its mental strength to control the cell phone to show Shi Yu the video interface. Shi Yu, who was meditating, was slightly stunned.
It was pretty fast.
However, the video had just passed the review. There were only six views, and there were no comments.
“This won’t do. The video is not bad, but there’s no reach…”
Shi Yu took out his cell phone and sent Senior Lu a message.
Shi Yu: “Senior, do you have a Pyro account? Do you have a lot of fans? Help me repost a video!! The Legend of Mu Huiyin we talked about yesterday is done!”
A moment later.
Lu Qingyi: “…”
Senior Lu: “…You really did it. There is an account, but there aren’t many fans, and there’s no identity verification.”
Shi Yu: “Ah, forget it then. I’ll call Principal Feng.”
Senior Lu: “He definitely doesn’t have such a thing…?”
Shi Yu: “It’s not a big problem. He can use the Ancient Capital University’s official account.” Lu Qingyi: “?”
Soon, Principal Feng, who was at Ancient Capital University, let out a puff. He used the video software he had just downloaded to swipe “Mu Huiyin Legend” while speaking to Shi Yu through voice chat. He was infinitely stunned.
“Why are you so fast!!” Yesterday, Shi Yu had just told him that he was preparing to announce General Mu Huiyin’s deeds and even wanted to film a documentary movie with General Mu Huiyin as the protagonist. Why was it filmed today?
“Which film company did you hire? How did you do it!”
After watching the video, Principal Feng was immediately shocked.
“Isn’t there the Butterfly of Imagination?”
“Wu-” On the other end of the phone, Buggy’s proud voice came.
“Uh.” Principal Feng was stunned. Holy shit, was this how the butterfly of imagination of the overlord race was used?
“You…” Principal Feng sighed.
Regarding Shi Yu being able to do things related to history, even in a way that he, an old man, wasn’t familiar with, Principal Feng was quite gratified. At least, it was more in line with Shi Yu’s identity than playing with feeding and even machinery. However, publicizing the truth of history… Why was he making such a big scene, making his blood boil, and why was it so exaggerated?
Moreover, was the preview appropriate? Why was it incomplete?
“Why didn’t you finish it in one go?” Principal Feng asked.
“It’s too tiring. According to my experience, continuous dramas are more popular. At the same time, the trailer can also stimulate the curiosity and desire of the audience to explore. When the time comes, it will be archaeological for everyone. Isn’t this more meaningful as clearly exploring history instead of crushing it, and feeding it to people in one go?”
“Principal Feng, times have changed. How can there be so many young people who care about history now? Using this kind of movie preview model will stir up more discussion and also let more people know the truth of history. The news released by the archaeological Association isn’t as high as Heavenly King Zou’s selfie traffic… Don’t worry, I’m a professional.”
“I plan to announce General Mu Huiyin’s deeds in ten videos! Every time, it won’t be long, mainly because many people don’t watch it for too long.”
Principal Feng :”…” Principal Feng pondered. Really?
Don’t lie to him.
“Alright… I’ll get Ancient Capital University to… certify you.”
With Principal Feng’s nod, the official account of the Pyro Company of Ancient Capital University helped repost this video.
He even left a message: Big archaeological discovery!! Thumbs up!
Most of the people who paid attention to the official account of Ancient Capital University were students of Ancient Capital University. For a moment, the students of Ancient Capital University, especially the archeology students of Ancient Capital University, also gradually refreshed this video.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - Slime of the Overlord Race (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 331 Slime of the Overlord Race (2)
Ancient Capital University, archeology Department, third-year dormitory.
Zheng Yingjie, an archaeological Department student, was browsing the Ghost Beast Video in boredom. Then, he discovered the promotion of Ancient Capital University.
“Huh?” Zheng Yingjie clicked it.
A minute later, he opened his mouth slightly.
“Holy shit, what’s this?”.
“Lost history? Meaning actual lost history?”
“The Ancient University certification is real?”
“Ice Dragon General under Emperor Shi? A mixed-blood Titled Beast Tamer? Really?”
“Who is this time traveler account?”
Under extreme shock, he quickly forwarded the video to a small group called the archaeological Seven Elites.
“Look, what does the school’s official account mean by forwarding this video?”.
Apart from this, some students from the archeology Department and the battle department of the first year of Ancient Capital University also saw this video.
Unlike those who didn’t know the situation, as people who had personally experienced the heroic spirit ruins, they originally knew part of General Mu Huiyin’s situation!
It was just that due to the contract at that time, they couldn’t say what happened to the heroic spirit ruins.
But at this moment, when they saw the unknown account pushed by the school and the video of “Mu Huiyin Legend” released by the unknown account, their faces flushed. Holy shit, the news had been sealed for almost a year. Was this archaeological discovery finally going to be announced?
“At the same time, in other words, the news that Shi Yu contracted General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit won’t be hidden for long?” Wang Ling, Yu Shu, Miao Dongdong, and the others from the archaeology Department, who were born in the same batch as Shi Yu, had hateful expressions on their faces. Damn it, this time, Shi Yu could act cool again.
Eh? Time Traveler… F*ck, it couldn’t be Shi Yu, right?
A well-made video became popular very quickly.
Even if it was a pure rookie production without any traffic, it could quickly ferment with the amount of passers-by. Moreover, Shi Yu had even gotten the Ancient Capital University’s official account to do this with.
In less than an hour, the number of views on this video exceeded 10,000. It first spread among the archeology departments of the nine major universities.
Imperial Capital University, archeology Department, second year class group.
This video was forwarded by a student here. The students instantly discussed.
(Look, everyone. The Ice Dragon General under Emperor Shi, a titled Beast Tamer that hasn’t been recorded. Is this for real? It feels more like a preview of a big movie, but it’s ridiculous if it’s reposted and verified by Ancient Capital University. So, it’s a real archaeological discovery?)
[Is the archaeological Association going to collapse? Why are the archaeological discoveries starting to be announced in Pyro?]
[F*ck, where can I buy this production and movie tickets?]
(Ice Dragon General is so beautiful, Goddess Mu Huiyin. I want to be the dog of the Ice Dragon General! Step on me!)
Teacher: “Cough, cough.”
This archaeology teacher’s face darkened. What was going on? However, he also looked at the video and fell into deep shock. At the first moment, he also thought that it was a promotional video for a high-quality big movie. But soon, compared to the quality of the video, what attracted him more was the information revealed in the plot.
The number one general under Emperor Shi? A mixed-blood titled Beast Tamer?
In history, there had never been a record of such a super expert.
However, the end of the preview told the audience that it was a history that Mu Huiyin had taken the initiative to hide.
In addition, Ancient Capital University had certified…
In short, if it was true, it would definitely be the greatest archaeological discovery of the year. But why was it published in this way?
“The number one general under Emperor
Shi?!
At Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan from the battle department also saw the video on his Moments. However, after he finished watching it, apart from the shock and amazement of the others, there was also a trace of confusion.
Why did he feel that apart from the difference in size, the form, color, and even voice of the Red Sparrow Sword in Great General Mu Huiyin’s hand was almost identical to the sword spirit Shi Yu had contracted?
It was like the sword spirit Shi Yu contracted to act as General Mu Huiyin’s sword.
“Look.” After Shi Yu did these things, he looked at Buggy and Chi Tong, who had become popular in the video, and was very excited.
After all, it was the result of their hard work for a day. This was much more tiring than training, especially Buggy. It felt that shooting a preview was even more tiring than fighting for three days and three nights!
Now, the video had rushed to the leaderboards in just a few hours. How could Buggy and Chi Tong not be surprised?
At this moment, there were more comments below the video.
[Are all newbies monsters?]
(Tell me, which big boss is it! Ancient Capital University… Could it be Dr. Lu Qingyi?]
(Why is it a preview—Without General Mu Huiyin I’m gonna die…]
(Vote cast, quickly update.]
Shi Yu chuckled. Speaking of which, he and Chi Tong had never fought in a relatively public competition.
The martial arts conference was considered half popular, but unfortunately, it had just begun and ended. He didn’t know if anyone would discover the relationship between Mu Huiyin and Chi Tong.
To be precise, someone had already discovered that White Brook, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others, who were more familiar with Shi Yu and had more contact with Chi Tong, had already begun to send private messages to confirm.
“Eh, are you awake?”
Suddenly, Shi Yu, who was paying attention to the video, temporarily looked away.
In the Beast Taming Space, Susu’s aura suddenly began to climb steadily.
Shi Yu understood that it had successfully swallowed the sea of fire core!
“Come.” Under Shi Yu’s summoning,
Soon, a Water Slime filled with Essence Energy appeared in front of Shi Yu.
“Ning!”

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - Slime of the Overlord Race (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 332 Slime of the Overlord Race (3)
After appearing, Susu slowly opened its blue eyes on the table.
“Mi!!!” Chi Tong greeted Susu and instructed Buggy to quickly show Susu the video.
“Wu… (Ah, battery is dead.)” Shi Yu and Susu : “…”
“Who cares about the video now?” At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t have the time to pay attention to the video. He looked at Susu in surprise.
“Ning!” Susu was excited.
After devouring the core of the Sea of Fire Sprite, it successfully evolved and mastered a new skill!
The newly awakened skill made it even more satisfied.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt very good looking at the energetic Susu!
< Name > Mutated Water Slime
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
(Level of Growth]: Commander Level
This time, after Susu swallowed the Flame Sea Sprite core, her race level finally broke through to overlord.
The skill it awakened also made Shi Yu feel invincible.
Skill: Holy Water Ring
< Introduction > It’s a super water-type skill. It creates a resistance water ring. When affected by negative effects, they are reduced and the water-type skill effects are increased!
“Perfect.”
Among the three treasures Dragon Palace City wanted, the first two didn’t allow Susu to awaken super skills and become an overlord race. In terms of regret, there definitely were some.
Whether it was the final power crystal of the overlord-level mermaid or the million-year-old protective shell created by the totem-level old turtle, the quality of the resources was definitely not low. It was not much inferior to the evolution materials of Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng. Therefore, the problem could only be solved with skills.
Shi Yu thought about it and guessed that it was because the proficiency level of Infinite Devour was too low.
Eleven’s was an evolution skill that had advanced into the Dao, and so was Buggy’s. Baby Ginseng’s, on the other hand, was a transcendent high-level evolution skill. In terms of effect, it was definitely stronger than the entry-level Infinite Devour, even if Infinite Devour was a super skill.
However, after devouring so many nutritional fruits, time fruits, and various high-quality resources, the proficiency increase was surprisingly fast. Coupled with Absolute Sleep, it quickly had the effect of proficiency. Therefore, this time, Susu swallowed the Sea of Fire Sprite core and instantly obtained a super skill. Its race level naturally reached the overlord level.
Holy Water Ring
This skill didn’t look much, and perhaps it didn’t look like Buggy’s phantom image or a high-level skill like Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit, both of which were stronger, nor could it compare to skills like the Imagination Domain and the Time Mark… However, this skill was undoubtedly the most suitable for Susu.
With the Holy Water Ring, no matter what poison, curse, or pollution it was, as long as it didn’t exceed the endurance level of the Holy Water Ring, it could directly become its nutrition, in turn increasing the effect of its water-type skills!
Purification was also a water-element skill. The stronger the poison, the better the cleansing effect. This directly countered the enemy!
Moreover, as a super skill, even in harsh environments like extreme heat and extreme cold that could completely change Susu’s life form, the Holy Water Ring was also effective. It could also increase the power of Susu’s water-type skill, and its nature was similar to the Interlocking Sword.
The Sea Fire Sprite core had made a huge contribution. Shi Yu immediately felt that he had chosen the right resource.
With this skill, when it received Chi Tong’s Possession, Chi Tong could not only rely on Susu’s water-element power to increase the effect of the Interlocking Sword, but Susu could also rely on Chi Tong’s Sun Flame power to increase the effect of the water-element skill. Both parties could block each other’s BUGs and instantly increase to the upper limit of their endurance. This was an invincible super combination skill.
“Susu, next, I’m going to increase your skill proficiency with all my might. Are you prepared to break through to the monarch level?” Shi Yu couldn’t wait to upgrade Susu’s racial skills. It had a bunch of racial skills. After maximizing them and adding the overlord’s will, it was easy to break through to the monarch level. There was no need to get stuck.
At that time, when he fused with the monarch-level Chi Tong, it was not impossible for his energy to exceed ten million. Shi Yu would be invincible below the overlord level!
“Mi!” Chi Tong was pleasantly surprised.
“Wu wu wu wu?” Buggy was stunned by the side. Susu was only at the transcendent level previously, but it was going to break through to the monarch level so quickly? In other words, was Buggy going to be the fourth person in the team to break through to the monarch level?
It was clearly the first overlord race in the team…

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - Baby Ginseng Wants to Self-Explode
chapters.content:
Chapter 333 Baby Ginseng Wants to Self-Explode
On the huge arena, trees lined the ground, and the green grass was like a carpet. Countless young figures were sweating on it.
In the corner of the training ground, an energetic figure walked to the white wall and leaned against it slightly. She stretched her white legs and arms.
White Brook wiped the sweat on her face and neck with a blue sports towel and took out her cell phone from the ruins space.
After returning from Dragon Palace City, she returned to the supervisory team of Ancient Capital University to train. After all, the National League was around the corner.
Just now, the battle club instructor of Ancient Capital University had just come to the training ground to inform everyone about the changes in the rules of the National League.
Because of the world competition, there would be a certain change in rules in the National League this year and next year. It was mainly to cater to the world competition and even the domestic Sequence battles. Even the rewards had increased.
Unsurprisingly, in this year’s National League, the schools would work abnormally hard and crazily throw resources at the students in the last half a month.
“What are you doing?”
After the call was made, White Brook yawned tiredly and asked.
“Work overtime for training,” a voice came from the other side of the phone.
“Ning! (Beast Tamer, increase points!)”
“Oh… It’s cultivating that water slime…” White Brook understood.
Although he wasn’t at Ancient Capital University, it looked like Shi Yu was pretty hardworking. With Shi Yu’s strength, he was even stronger than her. There was indeed no need for him to train with the school team.
She was already looking forward to the scene of Shi Yu and Susu killing everyone in the National League.
“No, the rules have changed this year. I might also be the target of getting killed.” White Brook’s face suddenly darkened.
“What’s wrong, Senior?”
“The rules of the National League have changed. This year, it’s going to be divided according to strength.”
“Beast Tamers below the master level are to participate in the team competition. Master-level Beast Tamers are not allowed to participate in the team competition anymore. In contrast, only master-level Beast Tamers can participate in the individual competition this time.”
“It’s still divided into two titles: National champion team and individual national champion.”
Shi Yu: “Eh, isn’t that change not so big? It’s just that Masters aren’t allowed to participate in the team competition anymore, while the individual competition has a threshold for strength.” White Brook: “No, it’s very big. This National League reduced the reward ratio of the team competition and increased the reward ratio of the individual competition. Therefore, only the two of us can participate in the individual competition in Ancient Capital University this year. Moreover, the changes in the rules of the individual competition are the most ridiculous.”
“What about the specific rules of the individual competition?” Shi Yu asked.
“This is the most scamming thing. The team competition is still the same as in the previous years. A bunch of people are obediently playing in the arena, but this individual competition…”
“It’s very similar to the survival trial in the vocation assessment. It’s said that all the participants are thrown onto a huge island filled with ferocious beasts and then they let these people fight indiscriminately.”
“The condition to advance to the next round is to eliminate two master-level Beast Tamers from other schools or their own schools on the island and successfully survive until the end of this competition.”
“In the end, the contestant who advances will go into the competition for the national championship in the second round.”
“However, this doesn’t mean that one person can only eliminate two people on the island. The more people each candidate eliminates, the more rewards will be divided.”
“Of course, if the contestants on the island are eliminated to only one person at the end of the competition time, there’s no need to carry out the next round. The person left behind in the end is the national champion.”
“This process will also be broadcasted nationwide.”
“…” After White Brook finished speaking, Shi Yu was stunned.
Damn, they really prepared for the world competition in advance.
Wild battles were much harder and more dangerous than proper arena battles.
Shi Yu said, “Then what if I’m attacked by more than ten people, especially Imperial Capital University? What if the three masters team up to fight me?”
White Brook was stunned. “You shouldn’t be that hated… right?”
After hanging up the call with the beast-eared girl, Shi Yu rubbed the Water Slime on his thigh and fell into deep thought.
A battle in the wild.
It meant that if he could use a few pets, the Beast Tamer himself could also participate in the battle. Of course, equipment that exceeded his level definitely couldn’t be used. In this situation, it tested the overall quality of the contestants.
For example, if you couldn’t defeat someone, you could run fast. It’s also an advantage if one couldn’t be eliminated.
For example, if the other two were fighting, it was also in line with the rules for one person to jump out and take advantage of the situation when the other party was injured.
For example, Shi Yu could get Baby Ginseng to create a clone and lure the wild ferocious beasts to Gao Xuan’s side. Letting Gao Xuan suffer the attacks of monarch-level ferocious beasts was even more of a battle strategy that conformed to the rules!!
Such rules were much worse for performance, but it was understandable. At that time, the world competition would definitely be even more dangerous than this. They wouldn’t even care about life and death. The various competition versions were also to give the young Beast Tamers of Dong Huang a warning in advance. In the next year, there would probably be more and more such competitions.
“Whatever rules you like, then. I’ll just add points.” Shi Yu sighed.
As the National League approached, he just had to add some points.
Strength was the most important thing in dealing with all rules!!
A day later.
In the ruins space.
At this moment, Eleven was training the Bean Bears daily.
“Wu wu wu wu wu!!!”
Eleven, who had enlarged, was holding several bean bears in its palm.
The Bean Bears, who knew its fate, cried.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - Baby Ginseng Wants to Self-Explode (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 334 Baby Ginseng Wants to Self-Explode (1)
When they used the “impregnable” group defense skill together, Eleven even used electromagnetic control.
As everyone knew, after its defense reached an indestructible level and gave it extreme speed, it could also be converted into super strong attack power.
Eleven opened its palm and activated the combination skill “Super Electromagnetic Bear”. It directly shot out indestructible Bean Bears wrapped in impregnable iron as cannonballs!!
Boom!!!
The super Electromagnetic Bear turned in the magnetic field and bounced back. Its target was actually Eleven itself.
With a bang, ten lightning bolts hit Eleven from all directions, immediately causing a violent explosion.
The smoke dissipated, and the hardened substance fell from Eleven’s body layer by layer. Shocking wounds covered Eleven’s entire body.
But soon, a white halo of light “healing” wrapped around these injuries.
Coupled with the racial talent of the Panda Royal Family, which was the buff to increase strength after being heavily injured, it didn’t take long for Eleven to increase its energy value from the 4.04 million basic energy it had just broken through to 4.07 million. Its various abilities had improved greatly.
However, Eleven was not satisfied and felt that the increase was not big enough.
Generally speaking, the more serious the injury, the better the increase in effect after recovery. However, the problem was that the heavier the injury, the longer the recovery time would be. This would cause other training to be delayed. This gave Eleven a headache. Otherwise, it could do even more cruel training.
Of course, it was fine with the cooperation of Baby Ginseng. Unfortunately, Baby Ginseng was very busy at the moment and was being squeezed dry by Shi Yu and Susu.
Without a doubt, Eleven was currently firmly sitting on the throne of top 1 as a solo combatant in Shi Yu’s team.
As for the second one, it was Chi Tong, who had just broken through. After breaking through, Shi Yu gave Chi Tong a mission to let it choose low, intermediate, and high-level skills that it liked.
Compared to the other fancy teammates, Chi Tong had the least skills. Shi Yu felt that he should teach Chi Tong more skills.
After all, after Chi Tong learned the skill, the cost-effective ratio was still very high.
For example, after it learned super vision and possessed Shi Yu, Shi Yu could also use super vision himself. Such a common skill was very valuable.
As for the way Chi Tong chose skills, it was also very simple. It was through various Beast Taming Movies. In a day, it had already made many records. It was just waiting for Shi Yu to replicate and teach it.
[Chi Tong’s laptop]
(Skill 1: Red Fire Armor, Flame Forms Armor]
[Skill 2: Soul of Fire, protected by the Soul of Fire.]
(Skill 3: Protective Flame, a protective flame that can predict danger.]
[Skill 4: Soul Protection…]
[Skill 6: Holy Soul Qin Shield…]
They were all high-level defensive strengthening skills. Chi Tong felt that for the sake of Shi Yu’s safety, it should learn more defensive skills, preferably buff defensive skills.
After possessing him, it would first stack more than ten defense buffs with transcendent proficiency on Shi Yu. This way, it could fight without any worries.
At that time, there shouldn’t be any big fool who would fight a fully armed turtle. It could let Baby Ginseng attract the enemy’s firepower. In any case, Baby Ginseng could be revived after it died.
“Regarding the fact that as long as all the skills are given to the Beast Tamer with some defense, the Beast Tamer won’t die.” Chi Tong felt that it was very awesome.
On the other hand, Shi Yu still didn’t know that his role had already been arranged appropriately.
He was still working overtime with Baby Ginseng in one hand and Susu in the other.
“Ning!!”
Susu, who was on Shi Yu’s thigh, was in a happy mood. It was like a docile cat that had already accepted the fate of being rubbed every day. It should become stronger with every pinch. It really couldn’t refuse such a good thing For some reason, this feeling of leveling up while lying down made Susu feel very relaxed, as if the thousands of years of training had finally been cleansed.
No one could refuse the temptation of additional points.
Not even the overlord’s will.
If there was, it would definitely be because the points added were not super skills. Otherwise, if half-gods went straight for adding points, the totems wouldn’t be able to hold on
“Yiya…”
Shi Yu added points to Susu, Baby Ginseng added points to Shi Yu.
Looking at the rising aura of Susu, Baby Ginseng was very worried.
Eleven was a monarch, and the level of Chi Tong was monarch. Susu, this little fellow without any worries about suppressing its level, could even reach the level of a monarch at any time.
In other words, it and Buggy might be the last two to break through to the monarch level in the team?
Buggy did not want to be the last to break through in the team, but Baby Ginseng also didn’t want to either.
However, in the team, Buggy and Baby Ginseng were the busiest and most labor intensive.
At this moment, Buggy imagined a few of its clones. Some were making the Ice Dragon Badge, some were filming movies, and some were training the Dragon Skill of Imagination to visualize the Dragon God’s will in the dream. It was very bitter, and Baby Ginseng was not much better off. It commanded a group of clones to enrich its inventory.
Dragon Palace City had pretty much consumed all the Time Fruits and Nutrition Fruits. Now that Shi Yu was about to activate a new round of points, it couldn’t rest for a moment.
In this situation, Baby Ginseng felt that it was very dangerous.
Although it had the Time Fruit and could have monarch-level battle power at any time, this wasn’t as fragrant as the Normal State Monarch level.
Therefore, as he provided supplements to Shi Yu, who was adding points, Baby Ginseng also thought about how it could reach mid-level willpower first and become a monarch.
According to the current situation, Buggy that had visualized the Dragon God Statue was probably the first to break through. This was very bad.
“Alright, the purification and poison resistance are all full.”
A long time later.
Skill: Poison Resistance (Dao Proficiency)
Skill: Purification (Dao Proficiency)
After completing the additional points of these two skills, Shi Yu stretched comfortably.
“Ning!!” Beside him, Susu transformed into two big words of thanks and hopped in front of Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng.
“You’re welcome, but after you break through to the monarch level, it’ll be time for you to work.” Shi Yu smiled.
The purification was already maxed out!
At the maximum level of purification, apart from the effect of cleansing poison and curses, even some negative emotions could be cleansed.
For example, if a pet was in an extremely angry, afraid, and desperate state, then once the cleansing was released, the other party’s anger and fear would slowly disappear.
This effect was very suitable to assist Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng in training their overlord willpower. After all, the overlord will is gained through overcoming negative emotions like fear and despair.
Apart from that, after Susu broke through to the monarch level, Shi Yu felt that he should be able to let Eleven absorb the Meteorite Fragment. At that time, with the protection of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation that had mastered max-level cleansing, evolution shouldn’t be a problem.
“Ning!!” Susu returned to a ball of water, indicating that he should leave it to it.
“Yiya!!” At the same time, Baby Ginseng secretly poked Shi Yu.
It widened its green eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
“What?”
“Yi!! (I want to experience true life and death once.)” Seeing that Buggy wasn’t here, Baby Ginseng secretly said to Shi Yu.
“Huh??” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Yi!! (Applying for permission to self-destruct once and then revive!)” Baby Ginseng said.
Even a life form with the overlord’s will had never died in the true sense of the word. If it really died once, then revived and experienced life and death, even if it couldn’t train the overlord’s will, it shouldn’t be a problem to train it to a medium will!
At that time, it could break through to the monarch level before Buggy, and wouldn’t be at the bottom of the team.
“Ah…?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought before saying, “Have you thought about it?”
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng nodded in anticipation.
It had thought about it.
It had never used its full strength after learning these two skills. It had long wanted to use them once.
“Alright.” Although Shi Yu wanted Baby Ginseng to keep it since the time mark was difficult to recover, Shi Yu was also very supportive since it was Baby Ginseng’s own idea. The earlier Baby Ginseng broke through to the monarch level, the better it would be for the team to add some super skills.
“Yiya, Yiya, Yiya!!!” After obtaining Shi Yu’s permission, Baby Ginseng jumped up in surprise. “But it’s rare to self-destruct. It’s a pity to self-destruct without any practical use. I feel that it’s better to self-destruct in battle.” Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “If only there were any strong enemies. Self-destructing once can at least provide more benefits… I can also observe the effects of the self-destruction more directly. It’s easier to use in the future.”
Baby Ginseng looked at Shi Yu eagerly. A strong enemy?!
Fishing for strong enemies!

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish
chapters.content:
Chapter 335 Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish
“I know where to go.” Looking at Baby Ginseng, Shi Yu chuckled. Baby Ginseng wanted to self-destruct, but it definitely couldn’t self-destruct in the city.
After all, the power of its self-destruction was probably not much different from the small forbidden weapon that Gao Xuan had thrown.
Although it was only a commander rank now, it would die either way. Before it self-destructed, it would definitely be filled with buffs.
For example, the Time Fruit ability that stimulated the greatest effect.
In general, in order to not bear the side effects of the Time Fruit, the effect of the Time Fruit it created was not maxed out, be it the food it ate or the Time Fruit it gave Eleven and the others.
The Time Fruit with the greatest effect could theoretically raise the pets of these overlord races to the overlord level in an instant.
However, the side effect was definitely ten times greater than Shi Yu teaching super skills. If it dared to try, it would die.
However, since Baby Ginseng was already determined to self-destruct, there was no need to consider the side effects of the Time Fruit.
It was about to die, why would it be afraid that the fruit is poisonous?
Therefore, the self-destruction of Baby Ginseng was directly equivalent to the self-destruction of an overlord-level “ferocious beast”.
Even if they were also overlords, they would probably tremble in fear when they saw it.
Perhaps only top-level overlords like the Dragon Palace City’s General, the Sky Penetrating Whale, and the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mutated Leviathan could face it calmly.
Other ordinary overlords would either die or be heavily injured. A killer move of this level could even ambush an overlord. It had to be used in the right place…
Shi Yu glanced at the cell phone message and said, “It’s Saturday today, right?”
“Then the assistant Principal Feng and the others mentioned should be here today…”
Although the news of the World Tournament had now swept through Dong Huang, the matter of Shi Yu cooperating with the Ice Dragon to establish an Environmental Protection Department with Dragon Palace City as the center also attracted high attention.
In order to strengthen their cooperation with Dragon Palace City, the Dong Huang Association decided to also establish the Marine Environmental Protection Department in Dong Huang and lay the foundation for them to befriend the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. As for the headquarters of this Environmental Protection Department, Shi Yu confirmed the address to the sea area near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain in Icefield City.
At that time, Legend of the Sea Tyrant, Principal Feng, and the others said that they would send an assistant to assist Shi Yu in establishing it. The so-called assistant would reach Icefield City today and from the sea.
“I remember. It seems to be the Dong Huang Navy?” Shi Yu said. “They will drive a battleship to assist us and build an environmental base on the sea.”
Shi Yu said, “I have a driver. I know where to
go.”
Boom! Boom!!
Just as Shi Yu was filled with bad ideas, the outside world suddenly trembled.
Seeing this, Shi Yu scratched his head.
“Alright, the bodyguards are in position. We’re even safer now.” Outside the training villa, a hungry white big cat ran back to Ping Cheng from the ancient capital with a yawn.
In any case, it was just sleeping at Ancient Capital University. It was better to come back and eat and drink.
Eastern Sea.
A silver battleship 200 meters long and more than 20 meters wide was slowly sailing in the direction of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
On the battleship, two young men and a young woman in white navy clothes were looking at the snow mountain in the distance.
