Among the three, there were two men and a woman. They didn’t look very old and couldn’t be more than 30 years old. From the badges on their uniforms, the highest military rank of the woman among the three was a standard general. The other two were major and were all officers.
Among the three major units of the Beast Tamer Troops, be it the air force, the navy, or the army, having certain military ranks basically meant that they had master-level strength.
“We’re almost there.” The leading female general looked fiercer. Half of her face had huge burn marks, and she was holding a cigarette.
“General Xiao Qin, we’ve already contacted Minister Shi Yu. He said he’ll wait for us at the edge of the snow mountain,” the major said.
“I understand.” The brigadier general named Xiao Qin nodded.
She recalled the order she received two days ago.
Dong Huang Navy headquarters.
In the office of the legendary general, Xiao
Hai.
“The Dong Huang Association has recently established a Marine Environmental Protection Department. From today onwards, you will be transferred to work there. This is the document.” Xiao Hai handed the document to the female general in front of him.
“I don’t understand. Didn’t I say I wanted to participate in the world competition? Why did you transfer me to such a strange place?”
The woman glanced at the document and patted the table. “Dad, what do you mean to do? What’s this Marine Environmental Protection Department?”
The Environmental Protection Department didn’t sound like a proper place.
As a top-notch master, she should have been fighting at the front line, but in the end, she went to the environmental department?
“The meaning is very simple. You’re not qualified to participate in the world competition. If you were half as outstanding as your sister or that Ye Xing, I wouldn’t be so worried about you,” the legendary Beast Tamer Xiao Hai said.
“Go. This Environmental Protection Department isn’t simple. You can obtain better training here,” Xiao Hai said. “Moreover, with your mechanical attainments, it won’t take you much effort to help build an ocean base there.”
“Alright.” Xiao Qin frowned and glanced at the document. “But there’s no key information written on this at all. I want to know what this Marine Environmental Protection Department does exactly. Who’s in charge? Don’t tell me I’m only going to help build a sea base.”
“As the name suggests, the Ocean Environmental Protection Department is the department that protects the ocean environment.”
Xiao Qin: “?”
“The minister is Shi Yu. At the moment, he’s the only one in the entire Marine Environmental Protection Department.”
Xiao Qin: “?”
“Which legend is Shi Yu? Why haven’t I heard of him? A new legend? Or is he a top-notch master? Is there such a figure in the navy?” Xiao Qin asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 336 Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (1)
“He’s not a legendary Beast Tamer or a member of the navy,” Xiao Hai said. “He’s a freshman in Ancient Capital University.”
Xiao Qin: “?”
“What?”
“But he’s also an official member of the third and eleventh bureau. Oh, the first bureau too, I suppose. That should be soon. It’s very normal that you haven’t heard of his name. You don’t really pay attention to the situation on land, but you should know this. The Green Silkworm cocoon, this special evolution form of the Green Silkworm that’s about to be promoted in the army, was developed by him.”
Xiao Qin still frowned and suddenly had an impression.
She knew about the Feeding Bureau, the Archeology Bureau… the Green Silkworm cocoon. However, Xiao Qin didn’t understand. How could such a genius Beast Tamer of a research type, science type, and exploration type be related to the Marine Environmental Protection Department? Moreover, he actually wanted her to be a subordinate or even help build a base. It was ridiculous.
“I don’t understand,” she said.
“I don’t understand either.” Xiao Hai looked at his daughter and said, “In fact, an Ocean Environmental Protection Department has also been established in East Sea Dragon Palace City. Dong Huang’s Environmental Protection Department is actually established to correspond to the department of Dragon Palace City. You just have to know that this Shi Yu is also the minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City. According to reliable news, there are more than 50 overlords of Dragon Palace City joining the Sea Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City. The Sea Dragon King, the Azure Dragon King, and the descendants of the Thunder Dragon King have also joined. Many descendants of overlords and monarchs are only ordinary members among them. Apart from that, there are even tens of thousands of monarchs and commanders inside. So, do you understand now?”
On the other side, Xiao Qin’s pupils dilated slightly.
“In short, there’s nothing wrong with you joining this department. If it weren’t for the fact that it’s unsuitable for me, Even I want to go see what’s going on.” Xiao Hai pushed out the documents.
At the same time, General Xiao Qin said in disbelief, “How is this possible?”
This person called Shi Yu led dozens of overlords? Tens of thousands of monarchs and commanders?
How was this possible? Unless he was the son of the Dragon God.
No, even if it was the son of the Dragon God, it was too ridiculous.
“He also has a deep relationship with a totem ice dragon that survived from the Time Emperor Era. That ice dragon has already joined Dragon Palace City and become the eighth Dragon King of Dragon Palace City. Shi Yu himself has even obtained the honor of being a general of Dragon Palace City. With the relationship between Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang, his identity and status are not a problem for him to be a general of our navy. Letting you temporarily become his subordinate is in accordance with the rules. This is all the information I know. As for whether there are more secrets, you can explore them yourself.”
“I hope you can grow a little in the Marine Environmental Department that has a deep connection to Dragon Palace City. Do you still have any questions?”.
“…” Xiao Qin had yet to recover from her shock. After a moment of silence, she said, “Apart from me, is anyone else going this time?”
“Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi.”
Xiao Qin said, “The two of them… By the way, did the two of them get a chance to go to Dragon Palace City this year?”
These two people were also genius warriors in the navy. Their results in the Marine Beast Tamer’s military arena were very good.
“Well, they should have seen Shi Yu long ago and are the first batch of Marines to know about the Marine Environmental Protection Department.”
“Is this Shi Yu really as powerful as you say?”
“He easily defeated the Second Prince of Dragon Palace City with the Iron-eating Beast and used a Water Slime to defeat the heir of an overlord…”
On the battleship driving towards the snow mountain, Xiao Qin licked her lips and asked Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi, the two majors beside her.
The tall, thick-browed, and big-eyed Qin Mingzhi sighed and said, “Although we didn’t come into contact much in the past few days, from the situation at the Dragon Palace banquet, Minister Shi Yu’s strength is very unfathomable.”
“I’m not sure about other things. That Nine Li Battle Beast is a monster. Its strength and ability crushed the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince. A hundred-meter-tall beast… It’s even larger than the totem dragons. It’s so scary. I’m definitely not its match,” Huang Qi said with a tsk.
Xiao Qin said, “Then I have to meet this Minister Shi Yu later.”
The Beast Tamer, who was still strong, talented, and had a very mysterious experience, was about to become her superior. She wanted to fight him and take a look.
“Ah, this.” The other two smiled bitterly. No way, did they have to fight…
The battleship was getting closer and closer to the glacier. Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, and Qin Mingzhi, the three navy Beast Tamers sent by the Dong Huang Association to assist Shi Yu, suddenly discovered a super floating ice.
On the floating ice, a figure was sitting on a chair fishing
On his body, a Water Slime sat on his head. The Water Slime became a bird’s nest, and a little bird spirit was lying on it. On the young man’s left shoulder was a panda, and his right shoulder was a butterfly. The most unbelievable thing was that there was a ginseng baby on the fishing pole. “Coming.” Apart from these pets, there was also a gem cat beside the young man. It yawned and slowly spoke.
e was
At the same time, Shi Yu looked up at the battleship in the distance.
“Shi… Shi Yu.”
On the other side, holding a telescope and looking at this figure from afar, Qin Mingzhi took a deep breath and said, “How enjoyable. Is this the life of a big boss?”
“Not a bad battleship.”
“Unfortunately, it doesn’t look like it can fly.”
< Name > Silver Sea Warship
[Attributes]: Machinery
[Race Level]: High-level Monarch (Quasi overlord)
(Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 20.6 million
As the battleship approached, Shi Yu put away his pole and slowly got up.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 337 Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (2)
It was a super battleship with special energy enhancements. It was expensive to build, right?
However, although the energy of this kind of battleship was huge, it was basically used to maintain its function. It was actually very tiring to fight. It was best at super long-range attacks. If it was boarded by the enemy, the countermeasures weren’t that strong.
A moment later, the silver sea battleship stopped not far from Shi Yu. Xiao Qin and the other two stood on the battleship, and the four of them looked at each other.
“We meet again.” Shi Yu smiled and greeted the two soldiers.
Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi nodded. At that time, the Tyrannical Sea Legend had suggested that they join the Environmental Protection Department. They didn’t expect there to really be a chance. They hoped to obtain the Ice Dragon Badge too!!
As for the Time Fruit, as long as he worked hard for Shi Yu, he should have a chance to become a core member, right??
“I’m Xiao Qin, quasi general of the Dong Huang Navy’s Dong Hai Fleet. Later on, because of my injuries, I’ve been recuperating in the mechanical army. This is the first time we meet, Minister Shi Yu.” Xiao Qin looked at Shi Yu. Because it was the first time they met, she took the initiative to introduce herself.
“General Xiao Qin, hello.” Shi Yu also nodded. He had obtained some information about the other party from Principal Feng.
Xiao Qin, the daughter of the legendary Beast Tamer Xiao Hai in the Beast Tamer Troops. After she became an adult, she directly joined the army and grew into a quasi general all the way. She was a Beast Tamer with the strength of the navy. However, later on, she fell into danger due to the harsh weather when she was crusading against pirates. In the end, she was seriously injured. It was said that in order to recuperate, she withdrew from the front line.
When Shi Yu saw the scar on the other party’s face, he knew that it might be true. As for the other two, they were also well-known figures in the younger generation of the navy. Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to obtain a spot in Dragon Palace City that occurred once every five years. They were both master-level Beast Tamers who had contracted several monarch-level sea beasts. Shi Yu remembered that Huang Qi seemed to have contracted another monarch-level sponge life form in Dragon Palace City this time, while that Qin Mingzhi had contracted a monarch-level Dragon Claw Octopus. “Did you contract this battleship?” Shi Yu asked Xiao Qin.
Xiao Qin shook her head and said, “No, this Silver Sea battleship is the subsidiary of a super battleship of the navy’s mechanical army. It’s similar to a clone, and it can’t be contracted. However, I can rely on commands to command it for the time being. Next, I’ll use this battleship as the core and modify it into a sea base of the Marine Environmental Protection Department.”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. They wanted to use this big guy to modify it into a sea base for the Ministry of Environmental Protection.
Not bad.
However…
“There’s no hurry. This thing is very fast, right?”
“Do you have the coordinates of the Chaos Sea? How about we take a look over there?” Shi Yu smiled.
When he returned from the Rainbow Islands in the Dragon Palace City, he asked the Ice Dragon and the Sea Dragon King to help him recover the Rainbow Islands. The Sea Dragon King indeed promised to send troops there later.
Shi Yu didn’t know what the situation was over there either. He wanted to take a look.
The Multicolored Archipelago belonged to the Chaotic Sea at the border of the Dong Huang Sea and the Seven Islands Sea. It wasn’t too far away. Susu had yet to return home after following him out. Now that it had mastered the maximum level of cleansing, it wasn’t bad to go back and train.
On the way, he sent the badge to Ice Dragon in Dragon Palace City.
Most importantly, after leaving the range of Dong Huang, the Multi Colored Islands were all near the totem area. Perhaps he could find targets suitable for the bombardment of Baby Ginseng.
As for danger… Shi Yu looked at the gem cat fishing on the ice beside him. With the protection of the overlord cat that could teleport, what was the danger? For the gem fruit, the gem cat returned not long after returning to Ancient Capital University… It was impossible for it to put Baby Ginseng in danger.
“Chaotic Sea Region?” Xiao Qin raised her eyebrows and said, “That place is already far from the Dong Huang Sea Region. Pirates are everywhere there. Why are we going there?”
“Don’t tell me it’s also for the treasure left by the Pirate King.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“What did you say just now?” This girl also transmigrated? How did she know about the Pirate King and One Piece?”
Was it a misunderstanding?
“One Piece is… real?” Shi Yu probed.
“What one piece?” Xiao Qin was confused.
“What’s with the Pirate King and the big secret treasure you just mentioned…” Shi Yu sighed and asked.
“And, what’s this Pirate King?” Shi Yu asked again.
“Don’t you know?” The corners of Xiao Qin’s mouth curled up. “I thought you knew.”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets hung on Shi Yu and shook their heads secretly.
How could Shi Yu know this info? This fellow had already been tortured by adding points and meditation to the point where he didn’t have time to study. He was hanging on by the index’s search function.
As for the index, it only included information in the country. It would be strange if Shi Yu wasn’t confused about things from abroad.
“The Chaotic Sea Region is the paradise for pirates. These pirates mainly prey on the merchant ships between the seven islands and the Dragon Blood Beast cubs of the East Sea. They don’t belong to any force, but because they’re wanted by Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and the seven islands, they’re mainly stationed in the various totem countries and sell their goods.”
“Since entering the modern era, there have actually been very few pirates, and even fewer powerful pirates. However, in ancient times, the profession of pirate was very popular. There were even many legendary Beast Tamers who ran rampant on the sea, calling themselves the overlord of the sea. The so-called Pirate King was a titled-level pirate who appeared on the seven islands during the era of the Sky Emperor Dynasty. It was said that he roamed the world as a pirate and plundered the treasures of many countries, completing the dreams of many pirates. Before he died, he even announced that the Beast Taming Space had been modified into a mystic realm, leaving behind a legendary resource that was sealed in a certain place in the East Sea, waiting for the fated to find it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 338 Gem Cat’s Breakthrough Wish (3)
“But after a long time, no one really found the so-called big secret treasure, but some time ago, news of the Pirate King Ruins suddenly spread, and many pirates started to party again. The Dong Huang Navy also secretly paid attention to this matter, but I don’t know if it’s a rumor or if it’s true.” Xiao Qin put out the cigarette and said.
“It’s ridiculous.” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
Speaking of which, it was good to have strength. One could travel the world as a pirate and even plunder treasures from other countries…
“What legendary resource?” Shi Yu asked again.
“It’s said to be a legendary gem snatched by the Pirate King in the Gem Kingdom. Why, are you interested?” Xiao Qin said.
“That’s not it. It’s just that I’m meeting a member of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City in the Multi Colored Islands in the Chaotic Sea,” Shi Yu said.
However, just as he finished speaking, the gem cat beside him almost fell into the water with a shocked expression!
Gem Kingdom?
Was it the totem country that believed in the Gem King Beast?
That was the best place to produce the Cat’s Eye Gem needed for the evolution of the gem cats.
Legendary-level gem?
“Huh?”
Suddenly, the gem cat looked at Shi Yu.
“Huh?”
Shi Yu also looked at the gem cat.
The gem cat stared…
Damn…
Damn Shi Yu, how could he not be interested!
If there was really a gem, it could successfully break through to the totem level with the gem and become a better bodyguard!!
“Huh?”
Shi Yu was stunned. He suddenly remembered that the gem cat seemed to have been thinking about the Legendary-level gem resource and wanted to rely on this to break through… Could it be that the gem cat was interested in the ruins of the Pirate King…
However, if he remembered correctly, the gem cat seemed to have used a legendary gem to try to break through.
Unfortunately, it failed.
Although Legendary-level resources could almost 100% allow monarch-level pets to break through to the overlord level…
However, there was less than a tenth of a chance for an overlord-level pet to break through to the totem level.
Using this to break through was too extravagant.
Now, Teacher Cat actually wanted to break through again?
But even if he obtained the gem, the success rate of this breakthrough was also worrying.
Shi Yu: “In any case, even if there are really ruins of the Pirate King, aren’t there so many pirates? Isn’t it a little dangerous…”
(Do I have to disguise Baby Ginseng as a gem and kill a bunch of them first?]
Gem Cat: “Just lead the way. I’ll think of a way.”
The man and cat communicated secretly.
However, if there were really legendary-level resources that needed to be snatched by force, Shi Yu and the others were really very relaxed.
As the minister of the Ministry of Environmental Protection of Dragon Palace City, the various Dragon Palace overlords owed him a favor. With a call from him, he could pull dozens of overlords over. Even if the Pirate King revived, he would be scared to death, let alone a group of small pirates. “We can go to the Chaotic Sea,” Xiao Qin said indifferently. In any case, there was a battleship.
“But before we go there, Minister Shi Yu, I wonder if you can give me some guidance. Of course, it’s alright to refuse. I just heard the two of them talk about the magical deeds of Minister Shi Yu’s pets and wanted to experience it if possible.”
Xiao Qin’s gaze, which contained battle intent, landed on Shi Yu’s cute pets. She was very curious why these cute pets were so scary in the mouths of Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi.
After recuperating in the mechanical department for so long, it had been a long time since she had fought with experts. The World Tournament was imminent, and Xiao Qin, who hoped to enter the top ten, didn’t want to miss any opportunity to challenge experts.
“Battle?” Shi Yu didn’t expect the subordinate sent by the association to challenge him. He was momentarily stunned.
If he remembered correctly, the other party was level-six, while he was only level-five. Wasn’t this bullying him?
If he lost, how could he be happy as this person’s superior?
“Yes, it can be done with single 1vsi.” As Xiao Qin finished speaking, with a thought, a purple summoning array appeared in front of her. In the summoning array, a red sea star that was completely naked, covered in black holes, two meters tall, and had human features appeared.
< Name > Demon Sea Star
[Attributes]: Water, Spirit
(Race Level): Low-level overlord
(Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 2,8800,000 “Tsk tsk…” After this terrifying red star appeared, it smiled at its Beast Tamer and waved at the other three. In the end, it looked at the panda, ginseng baby, butterfly, and red bird spirit on Shi Yu’s body.
Boom!
At the same time, energy surged on Xiao Qin’s body. Her short hair fluttered as she activated her strengthening talent.
< Name > Demon Sea Star
Energy Points: 6.9 million
The rising aura of the red star made Eleven and the others look serious.
“Not bad.” Seeing that Xiao Qin’s development of the Beast Taming Talent had actually reached this level, Shi Yu’s gaze was stunned.
As expected of a top-notch master of Marine strength.
“You’ve already summoned your pet. How can I refuse?” Then, Shi Yu said helplessly. At his signal, Chi Tong, in the form of a bird spirit, slowly flew up.
“Screech ~!” It met the gaze of the Demon Sea Star, and burned.
Since this person would be assisting him, then why not a friendly battle.
“Huh?” At this moment, when it saw Shi Yu and this girl who weren’t anxious at all nor afraid that the gem would be taken by others first… Not to mention they were even about to fight here… The gem cat beside them was immediately anxious. These guys could fight when they came back! What about its breakthrough opportunity…

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - Shi Yu vs the Admiral
chapters.content:
Chapter 339 Shi Yu vs the Admiral
Demon Sea Star!
What Xiao Qin summoned was a very strange pet.
Of course, for Shi Yu and the others, this Demon Sea Star was not strong alone.
However, as a super genius with a top-notch master title who raised her Beast Taming level to level six, coupled with her strengthening talent, this Demon Sea Star was quite extraordinary. If it weren’t for the fact that Shi Yu had two talents that could solidify the foundation of the pet through the skill index and train the skill level to a very high level… Relying on telepathy alone as he leveled up would make it really difficult for him to fight these Beast Tamers with enhancement talents.
A master-level Beast Tamer with the strengthening talent could increase the pet’s energy level by a million, depending on the development of the strengthening talent.
As for top-notch masters like Heavenly King Zou and Xiao Qin, once the strengthening talent was activated, it wasn’t impossible to strengthen millions of energy points.
And to reach ten million, that was exclusive to legendary Beast Tamers.
The reason why the pets cultivated by Beast Tamers were stronger than wild ferocious beasts was largely dependent on the support of Beast Tamers.
“Forget it, you guys can fight if you want. As soon as possible.”
Seeing that Shi Yu and Xiao Qin had already reached the point of hostility, the gem cat sighed helplessly and gently placed its paw on the ground.
In the next moment, its gem eye turned ice-blue, and a cold aura blossomed from its cat claws. With a hum, in a short second, the thousand-meter range with it as the center quickly turned into hard glacier land. Even the Silver Sea battleship was frozen inside.
“Huh?”
In fact, Xiao Qin had long noticed this gem cat. However, there was no information about the gem cat in Shi Yu’s team information. At this moment, seeing this gem cat casually erupt with such a powerful strength, she instantly recalled something.
“You’re the cat that followed Lu Qingyi to the Dragon Palace banquet five years ago?” Xiao Qin said subconsciously.
“Little girl, your memory is pretty good.” The gem cat didn’t have a deep impression of Xiao Qin, but after hearing what Xiao Qin said, it estimated that Xiao Qin had also gone to the Dragon Palace banquet.
“General Xiao Qin, this Teacher Ying is the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University, the deputy minister of the Marine Environmental Protection Department.”
Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi, who had been to the Dragon Palace banquet, quickly explained.
Hearing this, Xiao Qin nodded speechlessly. The blue energy wave surging around her body slowly fused into her body.
After taking a deep breath, she leaped gently onto the glacier. When she landed, a stream of water appeared out of thin air under her feet, slowing the impact of her jump and allowing her to land steadily!
“Heh!!!” However, the Demon Sea Star’s movements were much more domineering. It bent its legs and flashed, instantly appearing in front of Xiao Qin. A crack was even stepped onto the glacier under its feet.
“My pet is this.”
At the same time, Shi Yu also took a few steps forward with one hand in his pocket. At this moment, Chi Tong, who was in the form of a bird spirit, flew in front of Shi Yu noisily.
“Wu Wu Wu Wu!!!” Seeing this, the little panda Eleven, who was left on the stool, couldn’t do anything. Although it also wanted to fight, it had just finished self-mutilating in the ruins space before leaving. It was still in the resting stage and had yet to recover. It could only hand it to Chi Tong first. After all, the opponent didn’t look weak.
“Wuwuwu.” “Yiya!!” Buggy and Baby Ginseng expressed that it was fine to watch the show. A battle of this level was not something they could participate in. Even if they used the Time Fruit, it would be difficult. After all, the time it took to erupt was too short.
“Ning.” Susu lay on Eleven’s head and was curious why the increase in the strength of that starfish was so big all of a sudden, even greater than the Fruit of Time.
It had just arrived in the outside world not long ago, and it was still not very clear about the various situations of Beast Tamers.
“Yiya!!” The team’s knowledgeable ginseng baby quickly explained. This was a water-element strengthening talent. Although it was a common talent, this woman’s cultivation was abnormally powerful!
However, there was no problem. Although Chi Tong’s energy might not necessarily be higher than the other party, its skill proficiency was high. Moreover, it could use Shi Yu as a strengthening equipment with the same effect!
“A bird spirit? Why do I remember it’s a sword spirit?”
At that moment, Xiao Qin looked at Chi Tong who flew out and said slowly. Although she and the Demon Sea Star could sense that this cute, harmless, and pigeon-like little bird spirit was not simple, if she remembered correctly, Shi Yu’s information recorded that he contracted a fire sword spirit!
“It’s just the different forms of the same pet,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Jiu!!”
At the same time, a fire spirit sword appeared under Chi Tong’s tender feet.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
As it flew, it grabbed the fire sword spirit with its claws and swung out a few fire sword auras. Little Chi Tong revealed a calm expression as if it’s an alternate account.
“Interesting.” Seeing this, Xiao Qin showed a very interested expression. This was the first time she had seen such an undead race that could switch forms between sword and bird.
However, it was not important. There were too many strange pets in this world. As a Marine, she was especially profound about this. After all, almost every day, there would be new deep sea species updated in the navy’s database.
“End the battle quickly!” At this moment, as the gem cat urged, Xiao Qin and Shi Yu nodded and entered battle mode at the same time.
Water flowed in Xiao Qin’s eyes. Because the strengthening process required a high level of tacit understanding with the pet, on the glacier, the Demon Sea Star slowly raised its fingertip. When it aimed at Chi Tong in the sky, Xiao Qin also made a finger gun posture and aimed at Chi Tong in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - Shi Yu vs the Admiral (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 340 Shi Yu vs the Admiral (1)
Bang!
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! In an instant, several spinning water balls completely made of red liquid shot out from the fingertips of the Demonman Planet like water cannons, turning into red meteors that locked onto Chi Tong in the sky.
Super skill, Wave Cannon.
Swoosh!
At the same time, in the sky, Chi Tong, who was holding the sword spirit with both feet, also threw the sword spirit away. It used the Sun Flame as a fuel and activated the Light Flame Sword skill. The moment the sword spirit was thrown out, it erupted with a speed faster than the red wave cannon. It also turned into similarly many sword lights in the sky, wanting to block the red wave cannon!
“So fast,” Huang Qi exclaimed.
“However, its power is a little weak,” Qin Ming said.
The max-level Light Flame Sword was incomparably fast. Unfortunately, it was a fire-element skill after all, countered by water.
In just a single exchange, countless red wave cannons swept up heat waves amidst the “bang” sound of collision, devouring the sword light and continuing to attack Chi Tong.
Seeing this, Chi Tong was so scared that it hurriedly spread its wings and ran. The Demon Sea Star chuckled and moved its hands. These wave cannons actually followed Chi Tong like gas bombs.
However, the total number of sword lights just now seemed to be one more than the wave cannon. After the collision that filled the sky, a sword light fell from the gap and continued to descend. Seeing this, Xiao Qin’s gaze froze. After the Demon Sea Star reacted, it instantly made a blocking posture.
“Yi!” The substantialized Psychic wave condensed into a shield in front of Demonic Man Star and instantly pinched the sword light that escaped the net. “Be careful.” At the same time, Shi Yu reminded Chi Tong appropriately. However, there was no need for him to remind him. Chi Tong, who had super vision, was already flying quickly in the sky, trying to dodge these wave cannons that were constantly chasing it through its super reflexes.
“This isn’t a simple wave cannon.”
“It’s a combination skill.”
However, as Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi gulped, something unexpected happened.
As they approached the bird spirit, Chi Tong, these wave cannons had no intention of hitting it directly. Instead, they collided with each other. Then, a tsunami-like water wave power swept in all directions, locking the agile Chi Tong in a huge area.
Seeing this, with a boom, orange flames erupted around Chi Tong, trying to resist for the last time. However, the impact of these water waves was much stronger than its strength. It instantly swallowed the flames and turned into a tsunami that swept up Chi Tong’s entire body. At the same time, a red Psychic wave invaded its body!
“High-level psychic skill, mental control. This is a combination skill of the Water Wave Cannon and mental control. As long as the attack comes into contact with the enemy, it can control the other party’s mental power.” Huang Qi and the others immediately thought solemnly when they saw this.
Just as they thought, the moment the water touched the bird spirit, mental waves instantly invaded its body. A trace of redness instantly flashed in the bird spirit’s eyes, and its mind was controlled, turning it into a puppet of the Demon Sea Star.
However, just as the two of them thought that Shi Yu and Chi Tong were in trouble, suddenly, the roar of the Demon Sea Star came from the battlefield.
“Roar!!”
The two of them looked over in surprise, only to see that the Demonman Sea Star, who had condensed a mental shield, was still in a stalemate with the Light Flame Sword. No, to be precise, it was in a stalemate with the main body of the Light Flame Sword and the sword spirit.
“So this is the main body.” After Xiao Qin shouted, the bird spirit in the sky gradually disappeared.
The bird spirit, which had been controlled and successfully attracted the firepower of the super skill, was instantly given up by Shi Yu because it was Chi Tong’s clone. At the moment it condensed a sword spirit, the relationship between the bird spirit and the sword spirit’s main body had already been changed.
Crack!!!
At this moment, Chi Tong, who had successfully approached the enemy’s main body, was in a lock. Although its strength was inferior to the other party… It was also using all its strength to release stronger attacks.
It swept up the Sun Flame and burned its soul power. The Interlocking Sword formed by the Soul Sword and the Sun Flame Sword wrapped around a strong deterrence wave and directly slashed out.
Boom!
The gray sword that contained a hot aura slashed over. The Psychic Shield created by the Demon Sea Star instantly shattered, and the shocking sword light was about to hit the Demon Sea Star.
“Wave Cannon.” Xiao Qin was neither anxious nor slow. She instantly made the Demon Sea Star understand the Beast Tamer’s tactical intention.
It immediately condensed a huge blue water wave in its mouth to resist.
The wave cannon condensed in front of the Demonic Man Star, directly acting as a second shield to withstand the sword light slash. As Xiao Qin expected, the sword light directly detonated the wave cannon, and the energy explosion wave that swept over again instantly swept Chi Tong and the Demonic Man Sea Star flying!!
A shocking explosion caused serious damage to Chi Tong and the Demon Sea Star!!
“Crazy woman.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth immediately twitched when he saw that the other party’s young lady actually liked to exchange injuries.
Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the others also realized this brigadier general’s valiance again.
However, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others not far away, liked it.
Unfortunately, this move was useless against Shi Yu’s pets. In this day and age, who didn’t know a recovery skill?
“Mi!!”
The huge explosion instantly blew Chi Tong away, but it didn’t affect anything. In the smoke, during the process of Chi Tong flying backward, under the wrapping of the Flame of Regeneration, its injuries and physical strength recovered almost quickly.
It hurt, but it wasn’t a big deal. After all, it was the main attacker. The core of the explosion was even closer to the Demon Sea Star!
“Ah!!!” On the other side of Chi Tong, the Demon Sea Star, which had several cracks all over its body from the explosion, shouted and cried out. However, seeing that Chi Tong was fine, it immediately stopped crying and revealed a dissatisfied expression. The damaged parts all over its body quickly regenerated and instantly recovered to normal. Soon, no injuries could be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - Shi Yu vs the Admiral (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 341 Shi Yu vs the Admiral (2)
Super skill, Cell Speed!
“Jiu!!!” This scene made the bird spirit’s red eyes spread open in the sky and solemnly look at the Demon Sea Star opposite solemnly.
At the same time, Xiao Qin crossed her arms and also revealed a serious expression. “You’re indeed very strong.”
After a short confrontation, Chi Tong and the Demon Sea Star were still in a stalemate, making Huang Qi and the others swallow their saliva.
Both parties were so strong. As expected of General Xiao Qin’s daughter and the sister of Legend Xiao Shuang. This family was so abnormal. The strength was still so great even after the previous trump card’s fall in a mission.
How strong was General Xiao then, who commanded trump cards?
“Strengthening talent is really a headache.” Shi Yu also chuckled and scratched his head.
“A Beast Tamer without strengthening talent is too disadvantaged in battle.”
Even if Chi Tong was a full-level skill and had an extremely high use of energy, it was still at a disadvantage.
Xiao Qin nodded and said, “That’s true.”
“The two of you, can you hurry up and use whatever moves you have?” At this moment, the gem cat really couldn’t wait anymore and urged in pain. Wu Wu Wu Wu, it didn’t want the gems to be stolen by other kittens.
“…” Seeing the gem cat say this, Xiao Qin was stunned. Then, she said, “In that case.”
“Next, we have to do our best,” Xiao Qin said. “Demon Sea Star, go berserk.”
Although this sword spirit was very strong, the Demon Sea Star that she had strengthened was still a little lacking. If it was in its normal state, they would definitely not be its match, but talent was also a part of strength. Why not use it?
“Ah!!!”
As soon as Xiao Qin finished speaking, the redness in the Demon Sea Star’s eyes immediately became even deeper. A black vortex even appeared in its pupils, and its entire body instantly emitted a wildness ten times stronger than before, like a ferocious beast coming out of a cage.
Splash.
At the same time, its hands and feet quickly wrapped around the red water wave that looked like a glove.
“Ha ~” The aura of a demon was undoubtedly displayed on the Demon Sea Star.
Seeing this, Shi Yu knew that he couldn’t continue underestimating the enemy. Otherwise, Chi Tong would definitely fail on its own.
“Then let’s end the warm-up.”
“I want to contribute to the battle too.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Xiao Qin, who was opposite him, said, “Huh?”
Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi were also stunned.
“Chi Tong, possess me.” Soon, Shi Yu’s voice sounded, making the expressions of the three change. They had almost forgotten about this.
Possession?
Could it be that this undead with abnormal strength also knew the possession skill?
Although many undead had mastered possession, some undead races didn’t. This wasn’t a racial binding skill.
Chi Tong was already so strong. Xiao Qin originally thought that its abilities had all been focused on its own body. Now, he was telling her that such a powerful undead could still fuse with a Beast Tamer?
“Jiu!!” At the same time, Chi Tong didn’t want to fight alone anymore. It gradually descended from the sky. There were two of them, and it was too much of a loss to fight alone.
Soon, Chi Tong landed in Shi Yu’s hand. Under everyone’s gaze, it turned into a fire sword spirit again. At the same time, a red flame flowed from the sword spirit to Shi Yu’s entire body. Suddenly, a shocking aura swept out of Shi Yu and Chi Tong.
Under the blazing aura, Shi Yu’s eyes and hair color were dyed red. His thin figure and deep eyes seemed to have stepped into the realm of
gods.
Boom!
The powerful aura spread, making Xiao Qin’s expression change, and the other two majors reveal shocked expressions. They felt that the increase in Chi Tong’s strength was even greater than the increase in the Demon Sea Star!
“Ah, fight.”
Almost instantly, Shi Yu’s body emitted an aura that made even a ferocious beast like the Demon Sea Star feel danger. Its gaze focused, and it instantly arrived in front of Shi Yu. Ripple Fist wrapped around its hand as it suddenly smashed out!!
Boom!!
Intense white mist spread.
Then, a shocking wave of air spread from their bodies, shattering a layer of ice and sweeping up waves a thousand meters away.
The smoke dissipated, and the Demon Sea Star’s punch did not succeed. Shi Yu held his sword in one hand and stood the sword in front of him, easily blocking the wave fist.
Shi Yu’s red pupils looked at the Demon Sea Star that was even taller than him and said, “You’re too anxious.”
With that said, an illusory huge red pair of wings spread out behind Shi Yu. Every feather on these gorgeous phoenix wings seemed to be formed by a sword spirit, emitting a strong phoenix might. Seeing this, the Demon Sea Star suddenly had a bad feeling.
“Stay away from him!”
Xiao Qin shouted.
The Demon Sea Star exerted strength with its legs, and indeed, its pupils constricted as it quickly retreated.
At the same time, Shi Yu raised the sword spirit slightly. It was as if thousands of sword lights shot out from behind him, sweeping up a hot wind and instantly devouring the Demon Sea Star that was quickly retreating. The thousands of sword lights instantly began to cut its body like a thousand cuts, making it let out a miserable cry in the hot wind!!
“Ah!!!”
In the hot wind, the figure of the Demon Sea Star gradually blurred. The injuries on its body were one after another, making Xiao Qin take a deep breath. She instantly revealed an extremely serious expression and stared at the red-haired young man opposite her.
Impossible.
She had seen undead that could possess and Beast Tamers that could fuse.
However, it was just possession. There was no reason for its strength to increase so ridiculously!
Of course, what Xiao Qin didn’t know was that Shi Yu’s physical fitness and the full-level possession skill couldn’t be considered a simple combination anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - Shi Yu vs the Admiral (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 342 Shi Yu vs the Admiral (3)
This was cheating!
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu transform into this posture and almost invincible form, Huang Qi and the others were already stunned. This was the first time they had seen it. Even in Dragon Palace City, they had never seen it!
In this state, they actually felt that Shi Yu was even more terrifying than the hundred-meter-long Iron-eating Beast back then!!
“Ahhh!!”
Soon, the hot wind dissipated, and half of the ice disappeared. The Demon Sea Star, which was already broken, stood on the water and looked at its opponent in silence.
If it were a normal life form, at this level, it would already be a life-threatening injury. However, the Demon Sea Star had the super skill Cell Speed. The healing effect of this skill on itself was also at the top of super skills.
It could be said to have an immortal body. Even after enduring the joint attack of Shi Yu and Chi Tong just now, it was fine. After roaring, it instantly recovered completely.
“Ahhh!!!”
After recovering to its original state, the Demon Sea Star directly sank into the water, as if it wanted to launch a surprise attack from the bottom. However, at this moment, Shi Yu, who was standing on the ice, was very calm. Under the lock of transcendent super vision, even if the enemy dived into the water, in his eyes, it was no different from a frontal attack.
as
“Wave Fist!!” Xiao Qin didn’t know if a sneak attack in the water was useful, but she could only give it a try. The current Shi Yu made her very uneasy.
Boom!!!
After the Demon Sea Star hid in the water for a long time, the ice around Shi Yu suddenly shattered. Seven to eight wave cannons shot out from the water. Shi Yu ignored these wave cannons because these were only fake attacks of the Demon Sea Star. In front of its super vision that could see through the changes in energy, the ice and water couldn’t stop its control of the battle.
Crack!!
Then, with a feint, the Demon Sea Star in the water didn’t wait long. It smashed over with all its might. At the same time, Shi Yu slowly stabbed the sword spirit into the ground.
If Eleven were to face this Demon Sea Star, it might have a headache. This was because its cell speed was too difficult to deal with. Even if Eleven’s eruption could turn it into meat paste, it might not necessarily be able to insta-kill it. However, if it encountered Chi Tong, it could only be considered unlucky.
“Soul Slash.”
Boom!
As Shi Yu finished speaking.
In the next moment, a gray airflow erupted from the sword body, forming a soul sword domain. Moreover, it was wrapped in spiritual deterrence. The substantialized deterrence instantly turned into red sword feathers that filled the sky. Like an illusory sword dance and the cry of a hundred phoenixes, it swept towards the wave cannons in all directions.
As Shi Yu floated slightly in the air, the sword spirit he inserted in the ground increased in size with a bang under the incredulous expressions of Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, and the others. It immediately turned into a hundred-meter-long sword, like a divine weapon that suppressed the ocean. It instantly erupted with a terrifying soul pressure, and the sword pressure smashed onto the Demon Sea Star that was just about to break out of the ice.
In the sea, the Demon Sea Star sensed the huge pressure that descended from the sky. Its berserk eyes instantly recovered their clarity and revealed a frightened expression. In the next moment, with a final scream, with a splash, its eyes turned white from shock without a trace of injury and it kept falling into the sea!
Boom!!
At the same time, the sea roared, and huge waves swept in all directions.
Countless ice layers instantly turned into ice flowers.
“Cough.” At the same time, sensing that the Demon Sea Star had lost its mental connection with her and its strengthening had been interrupted, Xiao Qin took a step back in dizziness and looked up at Shi Yu, who had red hair and red eyes.
“This.” The other two majors were at a loss. Only the gem cat smiled and said, “Alright, the outcome has been decided. We should set
off.”
With that said, its Psychic power wrapped around the Demon Sea Star that fell to the bottom of the sea. With a designated Instant Transmission, it fished this guy out and sent it to Xiao Qin.
Demon Sea Star: @
Looking at the stunned Demon Sea Star, Xiao Qin was extremely silent. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “I lost, but you defeated me with your telepathy talent at level five. Are you a monster?”
The last person she recognized as a monster was the grandson of the commander-in-chief of the three armies, Ye Xing. This guy had stepped into the Legendary level before the age of 30, and he had contracted two overlord-level lives. He had even personally hunted three overlords. He was a monster in name only, even more abnormal than her sister back then.
As for Shi Yu, he was a monster in another sense. With his telepathy talent, he had such strength…
Of course, what she couldn’t understand was Shi Yu’s identity as the minister of the Environmental Protection Department.
And if he combined all of this… it didn’t seem that difficult to understand.
“Monster.” Seeing Shi Yu still so calm, Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi, who were not far away, were in disbelief.
If they remembered correctly, Shi Yu’s sword spirit was still at the commander level in Dragon Palace City.
It was not a problem to break through to the monarch level now, but to immediately have such a terrifying strength after breaking through… If it wasn’t a monster, what would it be if Shi Yu was given some time to strengthen his pet?
“You flatter me. I’m still far from it.” At the same time, Shi Yu exited his possession form. Chi Tong also turned into a bird spirit and landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder again. Shi Yu said, “And if it weren’t for the accident that happened to your trump card, General Xiao Qin…”
This trump card of General Xiao Qin seemed to have suffered a lot of losses. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have been transferred from the front line to the mechanical army.
“It’s all in the past. It’s not so bad now. Let’s go then, Minister.” After Xiao Qin lost, she acknowledged Shi Yu as a minister wholeheartedly.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, the most anxious one was still the gem cat. When it heard their words, it directly moved the few of them and their pets onto the battleship.
A moment later…
“Why is this big guy so slow…”
“Then take the battleship and teleport together.”
“Forget it, forget it…”
At the same time, at the moment that the few of them headed to the Rainbow Islands, the initial version of the sequence ranking that countless people were looking forward to was finally out. This was the ranking of strength according to the various battle results of the Beast Tamers under the age of 30 in the country.
Moreover, this ranking quickly caused a huge commotion in Dong Huang.
Among them, there were many figures that Shi Yu was unfamiliar with, and also many figures that Shi Yu was familiar with.
For example, the first sequence: Ye Xing.
First place in the Three Armies Martial Arts Tournament, level-seven in the Beast Taming Space, legendary Beast Tamer, contracted two overlord-level lives, and had the battle record of killing overlords.
For example, the fifth sequence: Ji Feng.
A certain national individual champion that had graduated from Imperial Capital University. He had the Beast Taming Talent, All Things Affinity. Not only could a top-notch master have affinity with various ferocious beasts, but he could also have affinity with the power of nature. He could let his pet mobilize the power of nature at the monarch level. As an outstanding figure among top-notch masters, he successfully assassinated an overlord-level life form during the undercover totem area and escaped unscathed. He even had the battle record of defeating the genius of Bureau 11, Lu Qingyi.
For example, the seventh sequence: Lu Qingyi.
Although her reputation was usually not obvious, and the basic race of each pet was not high, as a genius archeologist, she had once obtained a huge opportunity in the Mythical Ruins. Some pets had received the Mythical inheritance and mastered the strongest super skill, “Mythical Revival”. It could allow pets to easily fight above their level.
For example, the eleventh sequence: Zou Yun, Heavenly King Zou.
As the current Heavenly King of the Master Tournament, he was happy to mention the lucky number 11.
There was also the national individual champion, Gao Xuan, who was ranked 22nd. He was in the front row. He was the youngest at 21 years old. There was also the navy brigadier general, Xiao Qin, who was ranked 29th. They were all huge hot topics.
The current ranking was only ranked in the top 100 according to their past battle results and current situation. Among them, the contestants at the top had one characteristic, which was that they had fought with overlord-level creatures!
A certain someone had also signed up online. He didn’t know if Dragon Palace City’s battle results were included, but because he had never fought an overlord-level life form, his ranking… didn’t seem to be high.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - Pirate King Ruins
chapters.content:
Chapter 343 Pirate King Ruins
On the endless ocean, a battleship was driving quickly, as if it was rushing to reincarnate. “Is there any more news about that legendary gem, such as its attributes, allusion, color, and size?”
The gem cat looked at Xiao Qin, its eyes shining. It drew circles with its claws and kept gesturing
As everyone knew, the attributes and colors of the evolution gem depended on the eye color and skill attributes of the gem cat after evolution.
Although it was a mutated species and had already used more than ten gemstones to evolve more than ten times and obtained many attributes, this didn’t stop it from thinking about the characteristics of the new gemstones.
“So where are we going?” Xiao Qin’s gaze stopped on Shi Yu. Didn’t they say that they were going to the Rainbow Islands to meet the members of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City? Why did she feel like she was going to treasure hunt with the gem cat? Why did this cat keep thinking about the legendary gem of the Pirate King?
“Wait, don’t tell me you want to rely on this illusory legendary gem to break through?”
Suddenly, the corners of Xiao Qin’s mouth twitched as she looked at the gem cat in confusion.
Now, it could be said that they still didn’t know anything about the gem. They weren’t sure if it was a strengthening resource, but this cat was already eyeing it?
How obsessed was it with breaking through?
Moreover, even if it was a strengthening-type legendary resource, the chances of an overlord breaking through to the totem level seemed to be pitifully small. This was even under the situation where the gem attribute and the pet attribute were completely compatible.
“You don’t understand.” The gem cat looked into the distance leisurely.
It was a mutated species. If it wasn’t picky, it was also an old gambler. As long as it was a gem, it could absorb it.
“It’s on the way anyway.” Shi Yu yawned, but he didn’t have much hope for the legendary gem.
Did it think this pirate king was a fool? He was about to die, but he still left the resources as a mystic realm for then?
The key was that how could a pirate be so kind?
However, he could understand the gem cat’s desire to break through to the totem level.
In this world, awakening to commander rank was basic battle power.
From monarch level to overlord level, it was a medium to high-level battle power.
Only after reaching the totem level could one stand at the top of the pyramid. Not only were pets pursuing this realm, but Beast Tamers were also pursuing it.
A few hours later.
Everyone drove out of the Dong Huang Sea Region and arrived at the Chaotic Sea Region.
After entering the Chaotic Sea, this was the territory of the totem area.
Between the Dong Huang Sea and the Seven Islands Sea, apart from Dragon Palace City in the sea, there were four other totem factions on the ground island.
They all had one unified characteristic, which was that they had all separated after the seven islands became independent. They had been enemies with the seven islands since ancient times.
These totems were the lava beasts born in the volcano.
The giant ape totem that had mutated and evolved because of the radiation of the moon.
The Orochi snake with eight heads, with an ancient background,
And the island god that had become a spirit and evolved into a floating island.
Among the four totem factions, there were humans who believed in them, in the territories of the eight-headed snake, the island god, and the giant ape.
As for the Lava Beast’s volcano island, it was purely a faction gathered by transcendent creatures.
Compared to the seven islands, Dong Huang was much luckier. There were basically no hostile totems around the sea area.
Because Dragon Palace City was too strong, the enemies were basically all destroyed by Dragon Palace City.
Although the eight-headed snake, the island god, the giant ape, and the other totems also coveted the Dong Huang Continent, they were all restricted by Dragon Palace City and didn’t dare to cross.
However, although there were fewer threats in the sea, Dong Huang still had many threats on land.
For example, the current Dong Huang Continent was surrounded by eleven totem factions, and the situation was even worse than the seven islands.
More importantly, none of these totem factions… Factions that could last until today after many totem battles, were easy to deal with.
The larger totem faction was even similar to Dragon Palace City. It was an alliance formed by multiple totems. “A Pirate Ship has been discovered.”
Not long after entering the Chaotic Sea, Xiao Qin, who had detected a special situation, frowned.
She observed the battleship monitor floating on the deck and said, “The most powerful Beast Tamer of the Black Snake Pirates is a master-level Beast Tamer with a bounty of 12 million.”
Shi Yu also looked at the monitor. On the monitor was a huge ship. However, compared to the mechanical battleship they were riding, the other party’s huge ship was still an ancient ship. Although the construction materials looked very expensive and the hull was very resistant, the difference in era could be distinguished at a glance.
Obviously, apart from the seven countries, most factions didn’t have the ability to build mechanical lives.
At this moment, this huge black ship was being dragged by two incomparably huge monarch-level black sea snakes.
Shi Yu watched for a moment and said in surprise,
“The bounty is pretty high. This way, even if there are no legendary gems, it doesn’t seem to be a loss to wipe out the pirates who gathered because of the news?”
Xiao Qin: “?”
Didn’t they agree to meet the members of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City in the Rainbow Islands?
It was fine if the gem cat cared about the gem, but why was Shi Yu also starting to be greedy!
Why did it change its mind again!!!
“Leave it to me!” At this moment, the gem cat was the most excited to discover a pirate. It happened to want to ask the local tyrant about the legendary gem.
After all, didn’t Xiao Qin say that the news of the Pirate King Ruins had started to spread among the pirates first?
The gem cat’s figure flashed and hung on the railing of the huge ship. It looked into the distance that Shi Yu and the others couldn’t see with their naked eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - Pirate King Ruins (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 344 Pirate King Ruins (1)
“The other party is at least 20,000 meters away from us,” Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi, who were standing guard beside him, said.
But just as they finished speaking, they immediately shut up.
Because as the gem cat’s gem eye lit up, with a boom, under the sweeping of the powerful Psychic power, a huge tsunami 20 to 30 meters tall formed with a bang and charged into the distance.
“F*ck… So fierce.” Seeing this, the two weak and pitiful majors swallowed their saliva. It was difficult to compare this fierce cat to the gluttonous cat in Dragon Palace City.
A few seconds ago.
On the Black Snake Pirate Ship, as a sea eagle landed, a pirate in charge of reconnaissance in the sky also informed his boss of the discovery of the Dong Huang Navy battleship immediately.
On the deck, a middle-aged man with a black snake tattoo on his face and a black singlet walked out with a frown. “The Dong Huang Navy and the Seven Islands Navy have been active recently.”
“Let’s avoid them. We won’t provoke them. Let’s leave quickly so they won’t pester us…” Just as the pirate leader finished speaking, the dozen or so pirates on the ship widened their eyes and looked into the distance.
“F*ck, f*ck, Boss, sea, tsunami!!”
The Beast Tamer with the black snake tattoo looked into the distance and saw a monstrous sea roar that instantly formed. It was roaring towards them at an extremely fast speed.
Seeing this scene, the Beast Tamer was immediately stunned. Then, he cursed, “F*ck, didn’t I just poach some sea beasts? Is this necessary?”
“Overlord level, it’s definitely overlord level!!”
“F*ck.”
The Black Snake Pirates often transacted with the Orochi Totem Nation to find some sea beasts with weak dragon bloodlines in the East Sea to hunt. Then, they would be transported to the Orochi Totem Nation. In the Orochi Totem Nation, snakes were respected, and dragon blood was the favorite supplement of the snake-type pets there.
However, in this way, it touched the interests of Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City. They were also wanted because of this.
In fact, they could understand why cannonballs flew out of the battleship and sea beasts swam out, but why the hell did a tsunami suddenly appear!
Boom.
As the tsunami approached, the two sea snakes turned around and fled with the pirate ship almost crazily. However, if escaping worked, wouldn’t the overlord cat lose face?
After a roar, only a broken Pirate Ship was left swaying on the water in the distance. Under the power of a group of Pirate pets, the Pirate Ship barely didn’t completely sink, but it had already lost its mobility.
On the shattered deck, a group of heavily injured Beast Tamers and sea beasts looked at the approaching silver sea battleship with anger, as well as the four humans standing on the battleship.
“A brigadier general and two majors, bad luck.” The Beast Tamer with the black snake tattoo seemed to have long ignored life and death. At this juncture, he still had a fierce expression.
He stood on the circling giant snake and looked at the messy Pirate Ship and many missing crew members. Finally, he looked at the culprit of this attack.
His gaze leaped past Xiao Qin, who had the military rank of a brigadier general, and Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi, who had the military rank of a major, and landed on the gem cat in front of Shi Yu. This was because the overlord aura of this gem cat made the two blackwater snakes he contracted tremble.
At the same time, Xiao Qin and the other two were also watching everything in front of them in silence.
As expected of the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University.
Although it looked out of place, this power was really strong.
“Buggy, go!” At this moment, the gem cat didn’t want to talk to these pirates at all. It decided on a hypnosis skill and wanted to directly hypnotize all the surviving pirates present. Then, it issued an order similar to that of a Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu and Buggy : “…”
Just as Xiao Qin and the others were still confused, the Butterfly of Imagination on Shi Yu’s shoulder sighed. It controlled its spiritual consciousness to invade the dreams of these pirates and began to search for the information the gem cat wanted.
“Have you found it?”.
The gem cat looked at the butterfly flying in the air in anticipation.
A moment later, Buggy’s spiritual consciousness retreated from the boss of the Black Snake Pirates and nodded.
“Wu!! (Yes, it’s said that a pirate has obtained some clues. The ruins left behind by the Pirate King are about to appear on the ‘Hot Summer Island’, so a large number of pirates in the Chaotic Sea, as well as some Beast Tamers from the Orochi and Giant Ape Totem Kingdoms, have already headed to Hot Summer Island. That place has already become the most chaotic island in the Chaotic Sea at the moment.)” Buggy sent a telepathic message.
With full-level Psychic power, it was also the first pet in Shi Yu’s team to use telepathy.
The voice that fell into the minds of Xiao Qin and the others was the voice of a child.
“Wu… (Of course, its accuracy can’t be confirmed.)”
As for whether any ruins would really appear, the captain of the Black Snake Sea Pirate Ship didn’t know. He was only a small figure in the Chaotic Sea. He thought that he wouldn’t gain anything by going to Hot Summer Island, so he planned to do more business while many factions were attracted by Hot Summer Island.
However, who knew that he would directly encounter Shi Yu and the others… He was unlucky.
“Yes.” After obtaining the specific news, the gem cat nodded in satisfaction.
“Target, Hot Summer Island.” It patted the boat with its cat claws, and the lazy voice of a big sister came out. However, this time, there was a very strong tone of anticipation in the laziness.
“…No.” At this moment, after a moment of silence, General Xiao Qin couldn’t help but say, “Just the pirates are difficult enough. At the moment, although there are no legendary Beast Tamers in the East Sea, there are many powerful top-notch masters. In the totem country, there are countless ferocious creatures. It’s too dangerous to go there.”

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - Pirate King Ruins (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 345 Pirate King Ruins (2)
“Even if you’re very strong, there’s still a risk.” She looked at everyone.
Because her trump card had died in battle because of pirates, Xiao Qin was very cautious.
The gem cat sighed and wanted to go solo.
Because it was a professional at running away.
“If the news is accurate, the navy must have planted people to lurk on Hot Summer Island too, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes.” Xiao Qin nodded.
“Why don’t we do this? Let’s split up.” Shi Yu licked his lips and said, “A portion of us will go to Hot Summer Island to take a look at the situation first, while the other portion will go to the Rainbow Islands to find reinforcements.”
At this moment, although Shi Yu felt that it was unreliable, the word ruins also had a natural attraction to him.
So many Beast Tamers were on Hot Summer Island. It shouldn’t be a problem for them to keep a low profile and take advantage of the situation, right?
Shi Yu was also very confident in the escape ability of the gem cat.
In other words, if there was really a legendary gem that could allow Teacher Cat to break through by fishing in troubled waters, it seemed more convenient for him to have a gluttonous totem-level backer when exploring other dangerous ruins in the future.
“Isn’t this worse…”
“It’s alright.” Shi Yu patted Buggy beside him. Buggy immediately created an illusion clone.
At the same time, the bird spirit, Chi Tong, possessed Shi Yu. Shi Yu, who had entered the red-haired Chi Tong state, also created a red-haired clone beside him.
In the blink of an eye, two Shi Yu appeared on the ship, making Xiao Qin and the others reveal shocked gazes. Wait, this clone of yours didn’t make sense.
Shi Yu said, “So the problem now is whether to let the phantom clone go to the Rainbow Islands or to Hot Summer Island. This thing can still be maintained for a few days.”
Everyone : “…”
The gem cat revealed a praising expression. As expected of its student, it finally understood how to squeeze a clone dry. If it wasn’t very necessary, it could just leave it to the clone to settle!
With that said, it also created a clone, but this clone had a long face.
Hot Summer Island.
This was an island in the Chaotic Sea under the influence of the Lava Totem.
However, because the Lava Beast Totem slept in the volcano all year round and it didn’t nurture human believers, the only clansmen it had lived everywhere in the volcano, so the area near its habitat was basically a free area.
The environment on the island was hot, and the beach and fruit trees coexisted. The scenery was pretty good.
After spending another half a day, Shi Yu and the others arrived. However, after approaching, they didn’t dare to drive the warship over.
Shi Yu directly put the warship into the ruins space at the last minute. Shi Yu, Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the others, as well as the gem cat, changed their clothes and boarded a pirate ship to Hot Summer Island.
At the moment, there were already dozens of pirate ships of various sizes around Hot Summer Island. Countless skeleton flags fluttered in the wind. Shi Yu and the others’ arrival did not attract much attention.
As for where their pirate ship came from, it was naturally conjured by Buggy. At the same time, the clothes similar to the style of these pirates were also conjured by Buggy and temporarily draped over their bodies. This was not an illusion. The thing that was conjured by Buggy was a real object. As long as its power was not exhausted, it could exist forever, and it could even last longer than real similar items.
“We’re here.”
Just as they stepped onto Hot Summer Island, many shouts came from the surroundings. Among them were Dong Huang language, the seven islands language, and some unknown native language. As the navy, Xiao Qin and the others had received professional training and could understand and talk to these languages.
Shi Yu had even less of a problem. He had the gift of telepathy and could even understand Panda language, let alone the different languages of humans. Even if he went overseas in the future, going to the seven islands, Rongguang, and Tingxiang could allow him to communicate with the local humans without any obstacles.
Therefore, there were still many Beast Tamers with the gift of telepathy…
“Let’s find a place to ask for information first,” Xiao Qin said helplessly after landing on the island.
He was originally here to join the Environmental Protection Department, so why did he inexplicably come to explore the ruins??
Was it the Marine Environmental Protection Department or the Marine Ruins Exploration Department?
However, when she recalled that Shi Yu was from Bureau 11 and that he was an archeologist, she was relieved. It was too much.
“Yes, Boss,” Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi replied, making the corners of Xiao Qin’s mouth twitch again.
It had to be said that the scar on her face made her look more like a pirate than Shi Yu and the others.
In fact, with Xiao Qin’s identity and status, it wasn’t difficult for her to find a way to get rid of the scar. However, in order to commemorate her dead pet, she chose to let the scar from the battle be permanently preserved on her originally young and beautiful face.
Hot Summer Island wasn’t big.
But at this moment, many wooden houses and stone houses had already been temporarily built on the island.
From the construction traces, it was obvious that it was built through the power of pets. For example, using wood-element skills and earth-element skills to carry out the combination skill “Civil Engineering”.
Apart from the temporary buildings that could be seen everywhere, there were also traces of battle in many places. In such an orderless place, accidental conflicts were too common. Even if someone died, no one would care.
Just as Shi Yu and the others arrived at the island, two more pirates started fighting not far away. At the same time, a group of pirates saw that they were young and wanted to come over to collect the protection fee.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - Pirate King Ruins (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 346 Pirate King Ruins (3)
“Hey, are you… newbies? Do you know the rules?” As they walked over, Shi Yu raised his head slightly.
“Get lost.” As soon as he finished speaking, a terrifying deterrence emitted from his pocket. It was like a thunderclap exploded in their minds, making them instantly fall to the ground in a daze.
Xiao Qin and the others didn’t take another look. Under Xiao Qin’s lead, everyone walked to the street and entered a huge wooden house tavern that looked fancy.
After following Xiao Qin in, the fragrance of wine instantly came from the room, and it was very noisy. Shouts, curses, and the sound of alcohol kept circling in the smoke-filled tavern.
“A veteran…” Shi Yu muttered when he saw Xiao Qin’s experienced movements.
“This is the garrison symbol of a pirate group that specializes in intelligence business.” Beside him, Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi were also knowledgeable and introduced it to Shi Yu.
After the four of them entered the tavern, Xiao Qin walked to the front desk.
Standing at the front desk was a female pirate with a fiercer expression than Xiao Qin.
“Drink?” she asked the few people who came in.
“Drink,” Xiao Qin replied in the next moment, but when she heard this voice, the fierce-looking female pirate was immediately stunned.
She looked at Xiao Qin’s face carefully and revealed an incredulous gaze.
“Hello.” Then, she called her companions to take her place and looked at Xiao Qin and the others. “Follow me.”
This development stunned Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi.
However, Shi Yu had already reacted thoughtfully.
Then, Shi Yu and the others were brought to another room by this person. Then, they entered the underground room with stone steps.
At this moment, Xiao Qin said, “They’re with
us.”
As soon as she finished speaking, Huang Qi and Qin Mingzhi were shocked.
Holy shit, the huge pirate group that often sold information in the Chaotic Sea was one of them?
This group of spies.
“Xiao Qin, you, why are you here!!” At the same time, the female pirate still looked at Xiao Qin in shock.
“Are you also here because of the rumors about the ruins of the Pirate King?”
“Sister Shi, let’s not talk about this anymore. How’s the situation on the island now?” Xiao Qin smiled bitterly and asked.
The female pirate named Sister Shi pondered for a moment and said, “Nothing happened. I can’t even tell if the news is true or false.”
“However, on this island, there are many extremely ferocious guys gathered. Among them, the most noteworthy is an overlord-level snakeman on the Eight Qi Island and an overlord-level Vajra on the Great Ape Island. They all have human servants beside them, and their strength is quite extraordinary.”
“Two overlords?” Xiao Qin was shocked.
“Yeah, it’s fine if the pirates were attracted over, but even the overlord races were attracted over. It’s probably their human servants fanning the flames behind their backs again,” Sister Shi said in frustration.
“Two overlords…” Upon hearing the battle power distribution on the island, the gem cat yawned. Serpentman and King Kong? They sounded stupid. If it wanted to run, the other party definitely couldn’t catch up to it. It was stable, alright?
If there was really a legendary gem, it would slip away!
“This cat…” Sister Shi looked at the gem cat that spoke.
“This…” Xiao Qin glanced at the gem cat and the freeloading Shi Yu and the others. She introduced them to Sister Shi.
“Huang, Qin, the rising stars have monarch-level pets. They’re my subordinates.”
After being stunned, Sister Shi cast an appreciative gaze at the two young hunks. Not bad! The navy was getting stronger and stronger, and the master-level Beast Tamer was getting younger and younger.
She looked at Shi Yu. This one was even younger. He looked less than 20 years old. Could he also be a master-level Beast Tamer?
Then, Xiao Qin looked at Shi Yu and said, “This is my new superior.”
Sister Shi: “?”
Sister Shi opened her mouth slightly. What?
Wasn’t Xiao Qin General Xiao’s daughter? A top-notch master less than 30 years old, a former super genius of the navy. Why, why did she suddenly have a boss around 20 years old??
What was going on?
At this moment, Shi Yu also narrowed his eyes slightly and said, “There’s no news about the ruins at all?”
“No, there’s no trace at all. We can’t even determine where the rumors came from,” Sister Shi immediately replied after being stunned.
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu looked at the gem cat and shrugged.
It meant, look.
It was most likely a rumor.
The gem cat pouted stubbornly.
It suspected that Shi Yu was targeting it!
Without the legendary gem and the ruins of the Pirate King, what good would it do!
He clearly wanted to explore it himself.
“Then, is there any ruin or stone statue related to the Pirate King on this island?” Shi Yu asked.
“Also, can we sell information? Can you help me spread information? Let’s say that in the Pirate King Ruins, apart from the precious legendary gem, there’s also a legendary quality Undying Ginseng. One whiff can extend one’s lifespan by a hundred years. If you put it in your mouth, you can even live forever…”
Baby Ginseng: Your head will explode.
Sister Shi looked at Xiao Qin in confusion. Who exactly was he? She couldn’t do this anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - Threat from the Two Overlords
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Threat from the Two Overlords
“Things related to the Pirate King…”
“No, but to be honest, this island is rumored to be the place where the Pirate King died… Does it count?”
Shi Yu : “…”
This…
Did it count?
Could it be that he had to kneel on the ground and listen for the spiritual hints or something??
Although it wasn’t impossible, it didn’t suit his handsome figure.
“Also, what’s this Undying Ginseng rumor?”
Sister Shi’s gaze kept lingering on Shi Yu and Xiao Qin.
It was as if it was saying to Xiao Qin, “Help, why don’t I understand your new superior’s orders?”
Xiao Qin was also a little confused.
What was the Undying Ginseng? Good question. She also wanted to know.
“Can you do it? I was just casually mentioning it. It’s alright if you can’t,” Shi Yu said indifferently.
“Yes, I can,” Sister Shi said. “But I heard that the Pirate King died of old age. If the Undying Ginseng is so powerful, how could the Pirate King die?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
“Because the Undying Ginseng wasn’t mature yet.”
“It’s the greatest regret of the Pirate King that he couldn’t eat the mature Undying Ginseng. Therefore, he modified a mystic realm suitable for the growth of the Undying Ginseng and prepared to give it to the fated person along with the gem after it matures.”
“Well, is that alright?”
Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and Sister Shi were silent.
Tears welled up in his eyes. Why did he say it out loud?
The gem cat was also a little teary-eyed. It suddenly suspected that the news of the legendary gem was also casually made up by someone like Shi Yu to deceive a naive and honest little cat like it.
…
At the same time, in the Rainbow Islands in the Chaotic Sea.
Half a month ago, this was still a paradise for poison-type creatures.
But now, everything had changed.
Every island was occupied by a group of shrimps and crabs.
A group of monarch-level ferocious beasts that ruled the island submitted without any resistance under the deterrence of the overlord that enveloped the archipelago.
When the Dragon Palace City army arrived, anyone who didn’t submit would die.
On Qishui Island, the old leader of the Water Slime Susu, the Cleansing Water Sprite King, looked at the two members of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department in front of it in shock.
The famous deep sea overlord, the Sky Penetrating Whale, claimed to be a core member of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City.
The son of the Sea Dragon King of the East Sea Dragon Palace City, the White Azure Dragon with a totem bloodline, called itself an ordinary member of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department.
Although it knew that the Marine Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City was very strong, the Cleansing Water Sprite King didn’t expect it to be so strong.
Therefore, when Shi Yu first came, what did he mean by giving it the title of deputy minister??
Did it still count?
Facing the Sky Penetrating Whale and the White Azure Dragon, it didn’t dare to mention it, nor did it dare to ask.
“Minister Shi Yu called us here,” the little white dragon that came to earn results said to the Cleansing Water Sprite King in a dignified manner.
“From today onwards, the Rainbow Islands are under the jurisdiction of Dragon Palace City. The Marine Environmental Protection Department wants to cleanse the ocean from here!”
“Yes.” The Sky Penetrating Whale nodded. It was here to be a bodyguard. As for its performance merits, it should be given to the little white dragon.
“Welcome, welcome…” The Cleansing Water Sprite King and the water sprites behind it expressed their welcome.
“Reporting…” But at this moment, a monarch crab rushed over.
“What’s wrong? Didn’t the suppression of the other islands go smoothly?” the little white dragon asked.
“No, no. General, Second Prince, a mysterious ship is coming from afar. The figures on it seem to be… the minister and the others.”
“Huh?”
…
At the edge of the island.
The Sky Penetrating Whale, the little white dragon, and the Cleansing Water Sprite King heard the report and quickly came here.
However, when they saw the blurry figures on the ship floating over from afar, they instantly fell silent.
“Aba, Aba, Aba, Aba…” As it was too far from the main body, Shi Yu’s clone couldn’t withstand it just as it arrived at the destination and directly disappeared.
“Wu wu wu wu wu…” Buggy’s phantom could still persist, but because it wanted to slack off, its form was relatively rigid. At this moment, it suddenly didn’t know the meaning of its life and slowly disappeared.
Only the gem cat clone with a depressed face looked at its two dead shipmates in disappointment.
What a disappointment. They still lacked training.
“Vice, Vice Minister?”
“What’s going on?”
Seeing the gem cat, the little white dragon asked in surprise.
Was this a traveling illusion troupe?
What was going on?
“Great, they’re all here.” The gem cat was very happy to have successfully arrived at its destination.
“Has the Rainbow Islands been recovered?” It looked at the Sky Penetrating Whale, the White Azure Dragon, and the Cleansing Water Sprite King curiously.
“I didn’t disappoint!! After my hard work…” The little white dragon started talking non stop to the gem cat, the deputy minister of the Environmental Protection Department, and talked about its contributions. It was hoping that it could increase in value as a cadre and obtain the Time Fruit.
“Wu!” The gem cat cast an appreciative gaze. As expected of a second-generation heir, it actually had an overlord bodyguard. This saved trouble.
“Very good!! Then the matter here has come to an end. Next, there’s something more important. Head to Hot Summer Island of the Lava Totem Domain and meet Shi Yu. He has prepared a large number of Ice Dragon Badges to be transported to Dragon Palace City,” the gem cat said.
“Hot Summer Island?” The Sky Penetrating Whale was stunned. “Wasn’t there a rumor that some Pirate King ruins appeared over there recently?”
