“That’s right.” Seeing that the Sky Penetrating Whale had also heard of it, the gem cat’s eyes lit up.
“Dragon Palace City also paid attention?”
“No, it’s just a legendary gem. I don’t know if it’s real or fake. It’s not worth Dragon Palace City’s attention,” the Sky Penetrating Whale said honestly. After all, there were also many ruins, mystic realms, and even Mythical resources in the deep sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - Threat from the Two Overlords (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 348 Threat from the Two Overlords (1)
They really didn’t pay much attention to the things on the ground.
Gem Cat: QAQ.
Hot Summer Island.
Soon, some strange rumors began to spread on the island.
“Haha, have you heard? In the ruins of the Pirate King, it’s said that not only is there a legendary gem left behind by the Pirate King, but there’s also a legendary quality Undying Ginseng. It’s getting more and more ridiculous.”
“There are no gems, no Undying Ginseng. It’s all fake. Only a fool would believe it! Bah.”
“However, it’s said that this Undying Ginseng can not only increase the evolution aptitude of pets, but also increase the lifespan of both humans and pets. Why do I feel that it’s even more attractive than the unknown legendary
mo
gem?”
The pirates discussed. Two overlords from the totem country also received the news.
Somewhere on the island.
A snakeman several meters long with a black snake tail and a human female upper body. Her upper body and face were covered in green scales and she listened to the news brought back by her subordinate and revealed a disdainful gaze.
“Undying Ginseng, I’ve never heard of it. Moreover, is the legendary gem you mentioned true or false?”
“We’ve been waiting for a day, but we still haven’t seen anything.”
Opposite the snake stood a young man in a cotton shirt. He said to the snakeman overlord in front of him, “It should be true. Although the treasure map passed down from the Space Emperor Era has been destroyed, the pirate factions who fought for it at that time clearly determined that the location of the treasure ruins was here.”
“Moreover, the opening time of the ruins recorded on it is recent.”
“Most importantly, according to the rumors, the Pirate King indeed died here.”
“I’ll believe you this time.” The overlord-level snake picked up a fruit beside it, opened its mouth, and swallowed it with a gulp.
Elsewhere, a huge black ape six to seven meters tall was sitting on a huge rock like an overlord, listening to the reports of the two strong men in front of him in boredom.
“An Undying Ginseng that can increase evolution aptitude and extend lifespan?”
“It sounds good, but are you sure that such a thing really exists?”
“Master, we’re not sure either. It’s information spread by pirates…”
“Then what are you guys talking about? Where’s my gem!!”
Now, many people were tortured by the news of the legendary gem and the legendary Undying Ginseng.
As for the guy who spread some information, he was walking leisurely on Hot Summer Island.
According to what Shi Yu knew, there were a total of six relatively powerful factions on the island.
The snake overlord and the black ape overlord from the totem country were considered two. They were respectively subordinates of the eight totems and the golden giant ape totems.
It was too common for many overlord-level creatures of various sizes to gather under some totems.
Apart from the two overlords from the totem country, the other four factions were all great pirates who had top-notch masters presiding over the Chaotic Sea and had battle records against overlords.
In this situation, Shi Yu felt that they were relatively safe on the island. After all, the gem cat was one of the few overlords on the island. Moreover, it had the rare spatial divine skill, Instant Transmission.
At this moment, not only were many pirates searching for traces related to the Sea King Ruins, but even Shi Yu began to take action.
“I’m counting on you, Yu.” The gem cat cosplayed as a pirate cat and walked arrogantly beside Shi Yu with a pirate hat and eye mask.
“Even if you say so…”
Shi Yu sighed.
“Believe in yourself, you can do it!”
The gem cat trusted him very much.
In its opinion, Shi Yu, this genius of Bureau 11, was more reliable than these pirates no matter what. “Sigh, I’ll just try.”
“It might not necessarily work.”
Shi Yu sat down in silence and patted the ground.
He closed his eyes and activated his listening talent. He sensed the entire island and listened to the sound of the island.
Of course, as usual, he couldn’t hear anything
However, Shi Yu had a killer move.
(You’ve been a Pirate King for half your life and plundered so many treasures. In the end, you only left behind a legendary gem. You’re too poor.)
[No, there might not even be a single gem. After all, I haven’t even seen a shadow of the ruins. Don’t tell me it’s all bragging.]
[In addition, after doing so many evil things like burning, killing, and looting, why don’t I believe that you’re so kind as to give me gemstones?]
Shi Yu expressed his thoughts to the ground of the island telepathically.
Generally speaking, he didn’t think that this was useful, nor did he think that it was a good job.
However, the strange thing was that Shi Yu really heard some strange sounds in his daze.
“Ha ha ha…”
It was like the evil laughter of an old man!!
Apart from that, there was nothing else.
“Ha ha ha…”
“Holy shit.” When the terrifying laughter entered his ears, Shi Yu’s mind rumbled. He suddenly stood up with a shocked expression.
He could tell that it was the Voice of History.
The voices left behind by some life forms at a certain historical time on this island.
But this was the first time he had encountered such a situation.
“What’s wrong?”
Seeing Shi Yu suddenly shocked, the gem cat immediately asked nervously.
“Why do I feel that something is wrong?” Shi Yu’s face darkened.
“This island is indeed not simple. Some secrets are hidden, but it’s definitely not a good thing.”
“Let’s run! Believe me, believe my intuition as an archeologist,” Shi Yu said.
“Ah!” The gem cat was stunned, but it didn’t hesitate. Considering the death rate of the members of Bureau 11, it teleported Shi Yu back to the tavern just now and went to meet Xiao Qin and the others again. It planned to leave first.

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - Threat from the Two Overlords (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 349 Threat from the Two Overlords (2)
In the tavern.
Sister Shi was chatting with Xiao Qin and the others in surprise.
Xiao Qin and the others hid Shi Yu’s identity.
However, some vocation information couldn’t be hidden.
After all, before Shi Yu left just now, he had said that he wanted to investigate.
“Your new boss is actually an archeologist?” Sister Shi was surprised. Archeology and ruins seemed to be pretty compatible.
He just didn’t know what good news Xiao Qin, his new superior, could bring back.
“I’m back.”
As they were communicating, a white light suddenly flashed. Shi Yu and the gem cat appeared in front of them.
“So fast?” Shi Yu had returned less than an hour after leaving, shocking Xiao Qin and the others.
However, they realized that Shi Yu’s expression didn’t seem very happy. “What’s wrong?” Shi Yu said, “This island might be hiding some unknown danger. Let’s retreat a little first. Let’s return to the sea and see the situation first.”
“Sister Shi, your people should go too. Gather them.”
Sister Shi was instantly at a loss.
However, after Xiao Qin’s expression turned serious, she chose to believe Shi Yu immediately.
Updates by
. com
“Let’s do as he says.”
Shi Yu took a long breath. What did that laughter mean?
Forget it, He’d challenge this island when the reinforcements from Dragon Palace City arrive!
Forget it, I’ll meet this island when the reinforcements from Dragon Palace City arrive!
However, while Shi Yu’s idea was good, but accidents were always a step faster.
With a loud bang, Shi Yu and the others, who were about to leave the island, suddenly trembled.
Boom!
On the oppressive island, a huge vibration suddenly came from the sky, breaking the string in everyone’s hearts.
The pirates in the tavern were instantly shocked and threw the wine aside.
“Holy shit, the ruins have descended.”
“The ruins must have descended.”
The huge change instantly attracted the attention of everyone on the island.
It also made Shi Yu, Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, the gem cat, and the others widen their eyes in shock.
“Let’s go out first.”
There was an earthquake.
The ground cracked, and the buildings on the island instantly collapsed, forcing everyone out.
Boom!
When he arrived in the outside world, under the shocking vibration, a dark blue vortex seemed to appear in the sky.
And space seemed to have been sliced open, and a huge crack appeared.
The big pirates and two overlord-level foreign races all over the island revealed looks of ecstasy when they saw this scene.
“It’s indeed a ruin!!!”
“There really is a Pirate King Ruins!”
“Wahaha, legendary gem, legendary Undying Ginseng. No matter what treasure it is, it’s mine!”
On the island, the vigilance of many factions was raised to the extreme.
After all, if there was really a treasure, then a storm of blood would definitely arise on this island.
Treasures could only be obtained by the strongest faction.
Under the gaze of countless lives, the sky changed again.
A dazzling white light shone in the sky, as if a treasure had fallen from the vortex.
At the moment, although they couldn’t see what it was, the pirates attacked very quickly.
“It’s a gem, I can sense it!”
“There’s really a legendary gem!” At this moment, the most shocked was still the gem
cat.
Just as the phenomenon appeared in the sky, it could feel the gem eye trembling crazily.
It felt like he had been hungry for a long time and would subconsciously drool when he saw delicious food.
Out of racial instinct!
“Did I sense wrongly? Since it’s a treasure, we’ll snatch it too!!!” Shi Yu shouted at the gem cat.
Damn, there was really a legendary-level treasure.
No matter what kind of sinister laughter it was, as long as it was a real treasure, it was a hearty and kind laugh.
As for the two overlords, he really wasn’t afraid. With Etherealization and Concealment, these two overlords who weren’t spatial overlords would be at a loss.
10 billion, 10 billion.
The treasure appeared.
In an instant, many pets flew into the sky and rushed towards the vortex. It was already impossible to tell which pet was which faction.
However, with a shocked roar and vibration, all the pets in the air froze.
“Roar!!! (Get lost!!)”
Under the gaze of the pirates on the island, a black giant ape relied on its jumping power to directly leap into the sky. Moreover, its entire body emitted a huge overlord deterrence. A perfect-level deterrence instantly blew away the pets who wanted to snatch the treasure like a tornado.
With a wave of its arm, the monarch-level pet that blocked the way was instantly smashed into meat paste, making many pirates’ faces turn pale.
“You’re the one who wants to get lost.”
However, at this moment, the Black Ape overlord wasn’t the only overlord on the island.
As an equally powerful deterrence spread, the two overlord deterrence formed a confrontation in the sky. It was as if the sky had cracked, making countless pirates reveal serious expressions.
Putting aside the group battle strategy, these two overlords should be the strongest two life forms on the island.
“This is for Lord Yaqi. You get lost.”
In the sky, a snakeman also flew up with the light, forming a confrontation with the giant ape. A moment later, under the collision, the two overlords were bounced back.
However, no one expected that at this moment, a third party suddenly stepped in. A powerful Psychic domain instantly spread and enveloped the sky. With the advantage of its attributes, it was the first to touch the gem. Then, under the envelopment of Psychic power, the gem quickly disappeared with the spatial ripples! “You’re courting death!”
Seeing this, the snakeman overlord and the giant ape overlord were stunned for a moment before flying into a rage.
In the sky, they looked in the direction where the Psychic Domain came from.
Apart from them, countless pirates also acutely locked onto the direction.
Of course, the most shocked were still the pirates near Shi Yu and the others.
Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, and the others, as well as the nearby pirates, saw it with their own eyes. The gem cat beside Shi Yu erupted with powerful strength. When the snake person and the Black Ape overlord weren’t paying attention, it used its Psychic and spatial abilities to combine and teleport the treasure to its side.
Then, the treasure instantly disappeared, as if it had never appeared in the world.
In fact, the gem cat had given the gem to Shi Yu to store in the ruins space the moment it snatched it.
Unfortunately, it couldn’t be sloppy when absorbing legendary-level resources. It needed time, or else it would want to absorb it now.
“Meow.” At this moment, after snatching the gem, the gem cat looked pleasantly surprised and excited.
The moment its Psychic power locked onto the gem, it already knew what it was.
It was a legendary gem, nine-colored jade.
It was a core crystal that could only be taken out by killing a totem-level creature, the Gem Beast King!
Legendary-level resources were all worth more than ten billion.
Moreover, it was a super resource that even money couldn’t buy.
Among them, the nine-colored jade was even considered a relatively top-notch legendary resource. It contained the power of nine attributes!
However, snatching the treasure was equivalent to becoming a hatred attraction on the island.
In an instant, a terrifying deterrence enveloped half the island.
Countless figures moved crazily towards them. Among them, the snake overlord and the Giant Ape overlord were the fastest.
It arrived almost instantly.
Boom!
The giant ape overlord landed on the ground and smashed a huge pit. In the smoke, it stared at the gem cat fiercely.
The snakeman overlord followed closely behind with a ferocious expression.
This scene almost frightened Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the others. They were instantly nervous to the extreme.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu and the gem cat were still licking their lips. They were not afraid at all because of the overlord’s hostility. There was a gene called madness and risk in their bones.
“You’re courting death!!!”
The overlord giant ape was the first to roar. However, it also discovered that the gem cat was an overlord. It didn’t attack first, afraid that the snake overlord would benefit from it.
“Hand over the treasure!!”
The snake overlord looked at Shi Yu and the others fiercely and said, “Otherwise, you will become the enemy of the entire country.”
In the face of the threat of the two overlords, although Shi Yu also broke out in cold sweat, he still said calmly,
“Impossible. The so-called treasure belongs to the capable. I won’t hand the Undying Ginseng to you!!!”
“I won’t give you the Undying Ginseng even if I die!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord
Undying Ginseng!!!
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, the two overlords’ hearts surged.
The pirates who rushed over were instantly extremely serious.
Only Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, and the others were silent.
Was this also part of his plan?
At the same time, Shi Yu stared at the two overlords and kept asking himself in his heart whether the cat was reliable.
< Name > Snake Lord
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 43,990,000
< Introduction > It’s a hybrid race created by the Orochi Totem with its blood essence. It’s a noble of the Yamata Nation. It’s extremely dangerous!!
< Name > Earth Demon Ape
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
Updates by
. com
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 51,730,000
< Introduction > It’s one of the five overlord apes under the Seven Islands Giant Ape Totem. It’s extremely dangerous!!
Shi Yu realized that his third and eleventh bureaus could actually detect their specific origins.
Extremely dangerous…
“It’s alright to deal with one person alone, but not two together. But we can escape. Shall we?”
When the gem cat focused, it was also communicating with Shi Yu.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
At the same time, everyone was attracted by Shi Yu’s words.
“Undying Ginseng?”
“No legendary gem?”
On the island, not everyone immediately heard the Undying Ginseng’s rumors.
The time it took for the rumors to spread was still too short.
Only some relatively powerful factions obtained this information immediately.
Obviously, the two overlords knew this news.
“Only the Undying Ginseng?”
“Really? I don’t believe it.”
The snakeman overlord let out a sharp voice, more willing to believe that there were many treasures.
The eyes of this snake girl were surprisingly sharp.
Seeing the treasure disappear surprisingly, its gaze locked onto Shi Yu’s bracelet.
Suddenly.
Its gaze became even hotter.
She quickly figured out why the treasure had disappeared.
It didn’t expect that the human in front of it actually had such a treasure.
Spatial equipment!
Even in the entire Orochi Totem Country, there weren’t many overlords with independent spaces.
This snakeman overlord didn’t expect that apart from the treasures in the Pirate King Ruins, it could actually encounter humans with treasures.
It instantly revealed a greedy expression.
“Eightfold Dance!!!”
Boom!
In an instant, a strong aura erupted from the snakeman overlord. Black clouds lingered behind it.
Under the lingering clouds, along with its own tail, eight huge black tails that kept extending danced in midair, sweeping with a terrifying deterrence as it attacked Shi Yu and the others.
“Not good!”
Seeing this, Xiao Qin, Sister Shi, and the others were shocked. But in the next moment, the gem cat attacked.
The gem eye in its eye turned ice-blue. As it flickered, overwhelming cold air emitted from its body. In an instant, the cold air swept over, and the eight huge tails of the snakeman overlord froze in the sky!
Half of the snakeman overlord’s body was also frozen.
“That’s all?” the gem cat said disdainfully. It suddenly felt that this guy wasn’t very strong.
What a joke! After all, it was a pirate cat!
Would it be defeated by a mere snake!
“I’ve decided. I’ll crush them!” Shi Yu thought to himself after deciding.
Gem Cat+Baby Ginseng might be able to crush them.
The Dao Validation Battle was today!
“Damn it!!”
After failing to succeed in one attack, the snake overlord revealed a ferocious expression. Under the force of its entire body, frost shattered, and eight huge tails attacked again.
At the same time, she shouted, “Big guy, this human has spatial equipment, so he must have a pile of treasures on him. Let’s work together to destroy them first. When the time comes, we’ll split the treasures equally. Don’t forget, our countries were once allies.”
“Only this once.” The giant ape overlord beside her felt that it was alright.
Seeing this, Shi Yu retreated and said, “You’re bullying me with numbers. Are you afraid!”
Boom!!!
At the same time, the Snake Lord’s eight giant tails collided with the gem cat’s Psychic Shield, stirring up huge sand that swept across half the island.
“Hahahaha, you humans are the least qualified to say this,” the Snake Lord said with a ferocious expression.
“Yeah, in terms of shamelessness, you humans are still better!!”
Boom!!
At this moment, the Earth Demon Ape also completed its transformation. Its body increased exponentially, and its entire body was covered in black and brown matter. Its body was like dry land, and even its eyes emitted a dark light.
It cooperated with the Snake Lord and raised its fist, smashing it at the gem cat’s Psychic Shield.
“Holy shit, I already said one by one.”
What it was afraid of came. At this moment, seeing that the Earth Demon Ape had also joined the battlefield and wanted the righteous two-on-one, the gem cat instantly felt a headache, and its pirate hat was instantly blown away.
On this topic, the Snake Lord and the Earth Demon Ape seemed to have reached a consensus that humans were the most shameless.
This angered Shi Yu. He was such a simple person.
“Since you’re unwilling to let go, no one can get the Undying Ginseng. I choose to eat it directly!!”
With that said, Shi Yu stretched out his hand. A white light flashed in his hand, and a ginseng baby with its eyes closed was pulled into his hand from the ruins space.
At the same time, an incomparable fragrance bloomed from Baby Ginseng.
Every wisp of the max-level sweet aura was the feedback of his countless nourishing effects. Almost at the moment Shi Yu took out the ginseng baby, a shocking fragrance swept out like a violent wind!
As the fragrance spread from Baby Ginseng’s body, the entire sky was like the birth of the Undying Divine Medicine, condensing a very spectacular natural phenomenon in the sky.
The fragrance became clouds!
At this moment, the huge fragrance seemed to contain endless magic, instantly attracting the attention of all life!

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (1)
On the island, after being stunned, all the pets trembled. Their genes were shouting and breathing hard.
The pirates who originally wanted to watch the battle between the three overlords instantly sensed the crazy reaction of their pets.
At this moment, be it commander-level pets or monarch-level pets, their brains were excited to the extreme as they smelled the fragrance.
Even smelling it made them feel comfortable.
If they could swallow the Undying Ginseng in one bite, they even felt that they could directly evolve and reach the overlord race. It wouldn’t be a problem for them to break through levels!!
This rich life aura was an incomparable taboo for any life form.
Even overlord-level pets had the same reaction.
When it was in Imperial Capital University and evolved, the guardian overlords of Imperial Capital University were unsurprisingly attracted by the newly evolved ginseng baby, thinking that some Undying Divine Medicine had appeared.
At that time, if it weren’t for the principal of Imperial Capital University stopping them, it would definitely have become a battle between overlords.
And now, Baby Ginseng was even stronger than before. Under the enhancement of the power of time, its nourishing effect had increased countless times.
After all, just a perfect Time Fruit condensed by Baby Ginseng had the chance to let a commander become an overlord. Although the price was a little tragic, its own effect was definitely many times better than a Time Fruit.
Under the enhancement of the power of time, the nourishing effect of Baby Ginseng itself increasing its evolution aptitude and lifespan would be raised to the maximum.
Therefore, the moment Shi Yu took out the ginseng baby with “full battle power”, the Snake Lord and the Earth Ape Demon stopped attacking the gem cat. Their gazes were both attracted by the thing in Shi Yu’s hand.
Updates by
. com
They widened their red eyes and gulped. They also felt the trembling of their bloodline power.
Holy shit, there was really an Undying Ginseng.
This Pirate King was a good person.
He really left behind such a treasure!!
Usually, Baby Ginseng didn’t even dare to “go all out” in the team, afraid that its teammates would crush it. But now, it finally didn’t feel any pressure and tried its best to show its temptation.
Unfortunately, Baby Ginseng had yet to be enhanced to the overlord level by the power of time. Otherwise, it would really be no problem to say that its level was comparable to a legendary resource.
“Ah…”
“None of you can get it.”
After Shi Yu took out the ginseng baby, he opened his mouth wide and subconsciously wanted to stuff the ginseng baby into his mouth.
“Human!! Stop!!!”
“Let go of that Undying Ginseng!!!”
“You’re courting death!!!”
The eyes of the Snake Lord and the Earth Demon Ape were red. Under extreme anger, their battle power even directly increased. ” ”.They shattered the gem cat’s Psychic Shield together, causing the gem cat to somersault several times and eat a mouthful of dust in anger.
“You’re too much!”
At the moment, the Snake Lord and the Earth Demon Ape only had one thought.
Stop Shi Yu!
They definitely couldn’t let Shi Yu eat the Undying Ginseng.
These humans were very bad.
It was actually unwilling to give them the Undying Ginseng and would rather start destroying it.
Yes, in their opinion, it was no different from destroying such a treasure if it was eaten by a human.
“Snatch!!!”
“We’ll snatch it too!!”
At this moment, the few big pirates hidden in the crowd who had the ability to fight against the overlord finally couldn’t hold back under the strong trembling of their pets!
How could they tolerate it? After all, the information their pets gave them was that they were confident of becoming overlords after eating this fruit.
Among these great pirates, there was no lack of quasi legends whose Beast Taming Space levels had reached level seven, but their pets had yet to reach the level of overlords. Now, this fruit was definitely worth fighting for with their lives.
Shi Yu’s act of eating the Undying Ginseng Baby immediately made Shi Yu the public enemy of the entire island.
However, at this moment, the ginseng baby in Shi Yu’s hand suddenly opened its eyes. Its entire body erupted with power, and with a boom, it bounced Shi Yu away from its side. Then, the plant turned into wings and flew into the sky!!
Seeing this, everyone was stunned. Shi Yu also shouted in disbelief, “Not good, the Undying Ginseng is a living creature. It ran away!!”
No one expected such a change.
However, at this moment, many factions no longer cared about anything. Their first goal was to move from Shi Yu to Baby Ginseng, who was flying in the sky.
After all, the current baby ginseng was still emitting fragrance, and it was even getting stronger and stronger.
“Yi!!!” Under the lock of countless auras, Baby Ginseng, who flew into the sky and fled, almost ran with tears in its eyes.
Although it had made the decision to find an opportunity to self-destruct…
However, was there a need for such a big scene? This was crazy.
[Go, Baby Ginseng. The future belongs to you.]
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was sent flying by Baby Ginseng, supported his body with both hands. He looked at Baby Ginseng in the sky and muttered in his heart.
At that moment, no one cared about Shi Yu anymore. Even if Shi Yu had spatial equipment, they didn’t care. After all, after Shi Yu was sent flying, the gem cat almost instantly created a “clone” to protect Shi Yu, and its “main body” also participated in the battle for the ginseng baby.
Under the obstruction of an overlord clone, no one was confident of hurting Shi Yu.
Obtaining his spatial equipment was also a difficult quest now.
In comparison, the Undying Ginseng could be eaten directly after being snatched. There were immediate benefits, and it was obvious which one to choose.
Moreover, the array of the Undying Ginseng was even larger.
Of course, at this moment, there were also people who felt that it was strange. They felt that this Undying Ginseng looked like a ginseng baby, but it wasn’t a big problem. Which ginseng baby could emit such an alluring fragrance? It was too normal for the Undying Ginseng to look like a ginseng baby. After all, they were all ginsengs.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (2)
The battle situation on Hot Summer Island changed rapidly.
Now, the most stunned were still Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the others who knew Shi Yu.
They opened their mouths wide, completely confused by Shi Yu’s actions just now.
What happened?
Was there really an Undying Ginseng?
Something was wrong.
That wasn’t an Undying Ginseng at all.
Wasn’t that the ginseng baby Shi Yu contracted? That was the ginseng baby!!
Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the other Beast Tamers who knew about Shi Yu’s pet widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: This is all part of the plan.
“Sister Shi… Remember not to let our own people chase after the Undying Ginseng, or else you’ll bear the consequences.”
…
“Yiya…”
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was still running with tears in its eyes.
Updates by
. com
It couldn’t be helped.
If it didn’t run far, it was afraid that it would kill Shi Yu and the others.
The self-destruction of an overlord that exceeded the limit was not a joke.
“Stop!!!”
In order to fight for the Undying Ginseng, this group of ferocious beasts went all out.
The deterrence of the Snake Lord and the Earth Demon Ape swept over like a hurricane.
However, they didn’t dare to use too much strength.
It was afraid that it would damage the Undying Ginseng and cause the supplement to lose effect.
This also caused Baby Ginseng to easily escape with the deterrence of the two overlords.
However, the other pets chasing Baby Ginseng weren’t that lucky.
Those below the monarch level were all knocked out by the deterrence of the two overlords.
The two overlords didn’t allow another mistake. They didn’t allow the Undying Ginseng to be eaten by other weak guys.
Boom.
The Snake Lord used a special method to fly. As for the Earth Demon Ape, it couldn’t fly. However, when it leaped from the ground, the sound of air being torn sounded. It was no different from flying, and its speed was similarly terrifying.
“The Undying Ginseng is mine!!”
“It’s mine!!!”
The roars of the two overlords sounded, and their gazes became more and more crazy. They drooled as they flew. The reason was very simple. As Baby Ginseng escaped, its aura became stronger and stronger, as if it was becoming more and more nourishing as time passed.
Energy Points: 5 million
10 million!
20 million!!
30 million!!
The reason why the energy value swelled was because Baby Ginseng had started to transform the power of time and the power of the Moon Explosion.
Under the enhancement of the power of time, its own level was not only increasing, but the proficiency of Moon Explosion was also increasing.
During this process, Baby Ginseng was in a lot of pain. It felt a huge burden on its body.
However, when it thought that this was a necessary step to grow and transform, it resisted.
Of course, although Baby Ginseng’s aura was getting stronger and stronger, countless ferocious beasts didn’t realize anything.
It couldn’t be helped.
The impression that it was a natural treasure had already been deeply rooted in people’s hearts.
Who would mind that a good meal was too fragrant?
Due to the speciality of the race, the stronger the energy, the more fragrant it was.
The hazy moonlight shone on Baby Ginseng, making it look especially tempting.
40 million!
50 million!
Shi Yu stood in the distance and captured the change in Baby Ginseng’s strength in shock.
Its strength was still increasing.
However, an overlord was an overlord after all. Baby Ginseng had only learned to fly not long ago. Even if a group of ferocious beasts treated it like a little pet and couldn’t bear to force it too much, it was still quickly stopped.
The Earth Demon Ape got behind Baby Ginseng and grabbed with its big hand, scaring Baby Ginseng. However, at this moment, with a hoarse roar, the Snake Lord in the sky trembled. This time, not only did eight tails appear, but eight heads also appeared on its body!!
“Yamata!!!”
The Snake Lord roared, and a huge phantom dozens of meters tall instantly appeared behind it. This phantom also had eight heads and eight tails, and its body was as huge as eight mountains and eight valleys.
Almost instantly, the Snake Lord tied the Earth Demon Ape with a few huge tails. As for Baby Ginseng, it instantly felt a devouring suction from the Snake Lord’s eight heads.
“Roar!!! (You’re crazy!!)”
The moment its body was tied up, the Earth Demon Ape revealed a shocked expression. Yamata, the Octagon Aspect was a super forbidden skill that would consume the blood essence bestowed to the snake masters by the Octagon Totem and burn its life force to erupt. Seeing the snake master release this skill in order to snatch the Undying Ginseng, the Earth Demon Ape instantly cursed.
“Roar!!!” However, the Earth Demon Ape completely didn’t want to watch as Baby Ginseng was sucked into the Snake Lord’s mouth. After the Earth God Armor erupted to its strongest state, it also tried its best to use brute force to break free from this snake’s restraints.
Seeing this scene, the most anxious ones became the pets of the pirates following closely behind.
Dozens of skills smashed towards the Snake Lord at the same time.
However, at this moment, the Snake Lord was already extremely crazy. Its huge eight-headed form directly helped it block all the attacks. Its main body grinned and opened its mouth wide. Accompanied by a black mist vortex in its mouth, it looked at the Undying Ginseng that it had swallowed with a burning gaze.
“No one can stop me.”
“I’ll remember this. After this, all of you have to die!”
Boom!!
The Snake Lord’s huge tail swept across, sending many monarch-level ferocious beasts flying and killing them. However, five huge tails were also destroyed by some pets that had been strengthened by the Beast Tamer to the quasi overlord level. However, in the face of the Snake Lord, who was determined to devour the Undying Ginseng, these monarch-level pets were really helpless.
Even after the Earth Demon Ape tore apart the huge tail wrapped around it, it was already too late. It could only watch helplessly as Baby Ginseng approached the snake master’s huge mouth.
“Roar!!!” The giant ape revealed an unacceptable expression.
No!!!
Countless ferocious beasts also roared.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Towering Emperor Self-Exploding Overlord (3)
As for the Snake Lord, it felt that its spirit had reached a climax. Its gaze was filled with joy because its mouth was less than a meter away from Baby Ginseng.
It clearly smelled the delicious body fragrance of the ginseng baby and looked at its frightened green eyes. It was extremely happy.
“Baby, don’t be afraid. From today onwards, we’re one. I’ll be very gentle and swallow directly. I won’t let you feel any pain.” The Snake Lord was extremely considerate.
Upon hearing the Snake Lord’s words, Baby Ginseng was relieved. The moment it approached the Snake Lord’s mouth, traces of the Time Hexagram appeared in its green eyes. At the same time, an honest voice sounded.
“Yi. (Thank you, Auntie. I’ll remember you forever.)”
Then, its aura rose steadily.
Today, the towering emperor had stepped into the overlord realm to kill the overlord.
…
“What exactly are you planning?!”
At the same time.
Beside the tavern that had long lost its smoke.
Xiao Qin looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
At the moment, there were less than ten people left here. They were all from Dong Huang.
Apart from Shi Yu and the others, the rest were spies planted by the Dong Huang Navy among the pirates.
Updates by
. com
Xiao Qin and the others knew that Baby Ginseng was Shi Yu’s pet.
Seeing that Shi Yu had attracted the enemy’s attention with Baby Ginseng, they could be said to be very confused.
Of course, what was even more incomprehensible was why Baby Ginseng could emit such a tempting fragrance.
If it weren’t for Shi Yu stopping them, even their pets would have wanted to participate in the ginseng baby battle with the main group.
“If we don’t do this, how can we escape?” Shi Yu said calmly.
“Wu.” “Wu!” “Mi!” “Ning!” Four little pets also appeared from Shi Yu’s body.
“But…” Sister Shi still couldn’t understand.
“Did you predict this and let us do that in advance?” She was referring to spreading the news of the Undying Ginseng.
“I wouldn’t say that.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek.
Could he say that even without the ruins of the Pirate King, he still wanted to scam an overlord to death and get more benefits?
“Stop talking, let’s run first,” Shi Yu said.
“Are we going to abandon Baby Ginseng?” Xiao Qin was a little angry.
Shi Yu’s actions were too similar to the scumbag behavior of using the ginseng baby to attract the enemy’s attention in order to obtain other treasures.
This kind of abandonment of pets for the sake of life was really common in the Beast Taming World.
She felt that Shi Yu shouldn’t be such a Beast Tamer.
“Of course not.” At this moment, the gem cat chuckled and answered for Shi Yu.
At the same time, the Psychic domain had already enveloped everyone, planning to move further away.
Shi Yu looked into the distance with a serious gaze and said, “I’m afraid… that if we get too close… Baby Ginseng will accidentally injure us when it kills those enemies later.”
“What?” As soon as he finished speaking, Sister Shi, Xiao Qin, and the others widened their eyes in shock.
What did that mean?
Wait a minute…
“Coming!” At this moment, sensing the energy reaction fusion in the distance, the gem cat grinned and teleported everyone further away with a whoosh.
Just as they landed, everyone saw a white light flash in the distance!
[You… Could it be…]
At this moment, the ferocious beasts near Baby Ginseng sensed the strongest.
The second before it swallowed the ginseng baby, the snake owner was still very happy.
But in the next second after swallowing the ginseng baby, it felt that something was wrong.
It felt that his body was extremely hot.
Not far away, the expression of the Earth Demon Ape, which was showing disbelief, also changed instantly. Its body was warned to the extreme, and its hair kept trembling.
The surrounding monarchs who were looking at the Snake Lord unwillingly also instantly felt a fatal wave.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, the ground rumbled. Countless ferocious beasts took a step back and turned around with distorted expressions. At the same time, they were still informing the Beast Tamers to escape.
Escape.
Run!
However, it was already too late.
With a boom, the sky seemed to have changed drastically. The entire sky darkened. With a loud bang, everyone was pulled to another space and time, arriving at a world that belonged to the night.
The dark sky and bright night moon made everyone silent.
At this moment, time seemed to have stopped.
In the dark night, everyone clearly saw a strong light erupt from the snake’s main body in the next moment.
Boom!!!
Endless strong light spread in the surroundings. At this moment, the Snake Lord’s body was almost instantly obliterated. The Snake Lord’s eyes were still filled with an incomprehensible expression, including the eight-headed form it had created. The moment it came into contact with the strong light, it instantly turned into nothingness!
A terrifying energy wave shook the sky and earth, forming a spreading huge explosion. Everything in the range of the explosion would directly sublimate.
“No!!!” The overlord giant ape also shouted crazily. Even if it wasn’t at the core of the explosion, it still felt an unprecedented threat. At this moment, the explosive desire to live made it instantly stack countless defensive skills and escape into the distance with all its might.
And those monarch-level ferocious beasts were trembling to the extreme.
However, the explosion spread faster!
Almost unsurprisingly, the enemies who wanted to devour the ginseng baby were all enveloped by white light!
The light of the explosion quickly spread for several kilometers before slowing down. Although the destructive power continued to weaken, it still destroyed everything in a breath. The pupils of the big pirates who followed their pets to chase after Baby Ginseng constricted almost instantly. They tried their best to use all their life-saving skills to face the white light!
As for Shi Yu and the others who were further away from the explosion, apart from Shi Yu and the gem cat who were relatively calm, Xiao Qin, Sister Shi, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the others’ eyes almost popped out.
They looked at Shi Yu as if looking at a monster.
“Beautiful, Baby Ginseng.”
The gem cat was extremely impressed.
As for the others, they were stunned.
This was a f*cking ginseng baby?
This was the pet of a f*cking master-level Beast Tamer???
Wasn’t this a nuclear bomb baby?
At this moment, the entire island could see the huge explosive energy phantom that filled the sky. It was a white energy body similar to a ginseng baby. It was a hundred meters tall and opened its round arms, as if it was hugging the world. It was very happy.
But under the energy phantom was endless ruins, a huge pit thousands of meters in diameter. The entire island rumbled, as if it was about to sink.
“Well done. You’re the fully deserving MVP in the team today.”
Shi Yu held his headache and smiled as he looked at the white baby ginseng phantom that connected the sky and the ground. At this moment, the baby ginseng that had finished absorbing the power of the moon and was reborn slowly condensed its body in the air at the center of the explosion with the help of the time mark. Bit by bit, it condensed.
Moreover, with the power of the moonlight, it completed the breakthrough and was reborn!
It looked down at everything.
< Name > Undying Ginseng
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 7 million
“Yi…” It swept up transcendent deterrence and roared. The deterrence swept through the sky and ground of Hot Summer Island, and its size multiplied several times. It spread its white Leaf Wings and flew in the sky, its gaze sweeping across the pirates still alive on the island.
With the towering emperor here, who else wanted to eat it? Come if you have the guts!!!
At this moment, the survivors on the island looked at the Undying Ginseng that killed two overlords in the sky. Their pupils constricted, and the entire island was stunned.

Its will had reached the intermediate level.
This meant that it could directly break through without suppressing its level.
At that instant of self-destruction, Baby Ginseng felt its entire body disappear, and its consciousness almost instantly blurred.
At the same time, the most tragic thing happened.
The contract between it and Shi Yu began to break because of its death.
Fortunately, the final update of the time mark recorded its contracted state.
Therefore, when revived, under the effect of the power of time, it quickly repaired the contract before it completely broke!
This made Baby Ginseng heave a sigh of relief.
When a pet died and the contract broke, it would more or less affect the Beast Tamer.
If the Beast Tamer was in a good state, the impact could be ignored.
But if the Beast Tamer’s condition was extremely poor at that time, the Beast Tamer’s life would also be in danger.
Fortunately, Shi Yu’s actual physique was off the charts and not as weak as he looked, so Shi Yu only felt a little dizzy and in pain.
If this move was used by other Beast Tamers in a desperate situation in poor condition, it was hard to say if the pet would self-destruct or if the Beast Tamer and the pet would self-destruct together.
At that moment, after reviving, Baby Ginseng looked around.
It actually didn’t know if the explosion killed the two overlords.
However, even if it didn’t die, it should have been crippled.
It had already broken through to the monarch level. Sensing its powerful strength, Baby Ginseng was not afraid of the two crippled overlords at all.
Although its only time mark had been consumed, and it would take months to condense it again if it wanted to revive, and it couldn’t self-destruct in the short term… it could still use the Time Fruit.
It had finally broken through to the monarch level. Now that it was creating the complete version of the Time Fruit to use, the side effects were much smaller.
It wasn’t accurate to say that it had monarch-level battle power now. It should be called a quasi overlord-level strength. With the help of the Time Fruit, it could still pay an acceptable price to launch an overlord attack. Although it wasn’t as powerful as self-destruction, it shouldn’t be a problem to hit the old, weak, sick, and crippled overlord.
It was this confidence that made Baby Ginseng look down from the sky.
With a look, it was impressive.
Baby Ginseng was immediately shocked.
Many monarch-level ferocious beasts nearby had already been blown to ashes, including the overlord-level ferocious beast, the Snake Lord, that had already turned into dust.
But in the huge pit, a huge black ape still had vital signs and breath.
The Earth Demon Ape wasn’t completely dead!
Although it wasn’t completely dead, it seemed to have lost its battle power. Realizing this, Baby Ginseng was delighted.
This wasn’t a bad thing.
Speaking of which, Baby Ginseng felt that it was a pity that Aunt Snake had been blown to ashes.
After all, the materials on the overlord were all level-seven resources. That snake skin was definitely the top-notch material.
In the end, it exploded just like that. How regretful.
Now that it saw that the Earth Demon Ape was still alive and its body wasn’t destroyed too badly, Baby Ginseng’s gaze gradually became fierce.
Swoosh!
Its arm spread into a huge tree trunk, forming a wooden strip. It grabbed the Earth Demon Ape and raised it into the sky.
“That’s… the Black Ape overlord.”
The survivors were shocked when they saw the “corpse” raised by Baby Ginseng.
“Master, wu wu wu, my master!”
Among the servants of the Black Ape overlord from the totem country, there was also a survivor. He looked at the Black Ape overlord in the sky and covered his mouth with tears.
However, did he dare to move? He didn’t dare to move at all.
This Undying Ginseng killed two overlords in one strike and directly became a great horror, making all the survivors afraid.
No one knew what had happened just now. Self-destruction and revival… No matter how imaginative a Beast Tamer was, they couldn’t think in this direction at this moment.
In everyone’s eyes, it was basically equivalent to what ability the Undying Ginseng used to kill the strong enemy in one go.
Now that they were facing such a strong Undying Ginseng, how could they dare to offend it again?
“Yi!!!”
At the same time, holding the spoils of war, Baby Ginseng roared excitedly.
Seeing this, Shi Yu and the others, who were rushing towards Baby Ginseng, subconsciously smiled. Baby Ginseng was feeling good today!
Eleven and Buggy looked enviously at Shi Yu.
They didn’t know when they could easily destroy an overlord like Baby Ginseng.
Though, it didn’t last long.

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - Buggy Wants to Break Through (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Buggy Wants to Break Through (1)
With a boom, the explosion just now seemed to have awakened and disturbed the sleep of some powerful creature.
The sky above the island, which had just recovered from darkness to blue, changed again!
It was still the phenomenon that appeared with the legendary gem just now.
Countless vortices filled the island, land, and sea.
Countless spatial cracks spread everywhere like spiderwebs.
Under the change, a faint deterrence spread out from nowhere and enveloped the entire island.
When the deterrence touched Baby Ginseng, Baby Ginseng’s expression froze almost instantly, and its smug expression stopped.
When the deterrence touched Baby Ginseng, Baby Ginseng’s expression froze almost instantly, and its smug expression stopped.
He kept feeling that he had gotten into trouble.
Wait, could it be that the boss of these two overlords was here to take revenge for them…
“Yi…! (Shi Yu, save me!!)”
“This is…”
The expression of the gem cat beside Shi Yu instantly changed.
“The power of a totem!”
Updates by
The gem cat shouted in disbelief.
“Where did this totem come from?”
Shi Yu was also extremely shocked. Then, he realized something and looked at the spatial cracks.
[Hehehehe.]
At the same time, the strangest thing was that Shi Yu, who was rushing towards Baby Ginseng, had his brain rumble again.
It entered the “listening to the Voice of History” state.
This time, not only was there that sinister laughter, but a blurry historical image appeared in front of his eyes.
[In the scene, it’s a white-haired old man in his twilight years. He’s wearing a coat. He’s sitting on a huge rock at the edge of the island, looking at the sea and muttering to himself, “I’m going to die.”]
[Woof, woof.] Beside the old man was a huge pirate dog. It had a black and white intertwined body, and its face was half white and half black, as if it was wearing a pirate mask.
[Old pal, what do you think? I plan to transform the Beast Taming Space into a ruin and then put in a legendary gem to attract future explorers. Of course, since it’s an exploration, there’s a reward, so there has to be a little risk. How about we put the Vortex Demon Beast that we worked so hard to seal… Together with the gem? When the gem appears, the Vortex Demon Beast that wreaked havoc in the sea at that time will also be unsealed. I hope it can add a hint of fun to these explorers.]
[Hehehehe. At that time, they should hate this old man very much. I wonder if the pirates hundreds of years later can successfully steal this old man’s gem under the threat of the totem. How interesting. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to see it.]
[Eh, hehehehe.]
[Woof, woof, woof] (Perhaps I’m not human, but you’re a real dog).
“F*ck.”
The shadow of history shattered, and Shi Yu instantly cursed.
Pirate King? This old man was very bad.
He could understand even if he plotted to possess, revive, and seek benefits for your descendants and pets.
But wasn’t this operation harming others without benefiting oneself? It was too harsh.
So he had set a trap beside the treasure. No wonder his smile was so sinister.
Shi Yu didn’t know what the Vortex Demon Spirit was, but the word totem alone carried great power.
“We’re screwed. What the hell is this?” At that time, when Shi Yu recovered from the shadow of history, the sky outside had already changed.
The huge ruins space seemed to overlap with the entire Hot Summer Island.
Under the island, a huge demonic shadow that looked like an octopus appeared.
Its countless tentacles spread out and broke out of the water like it was stretching.
Right on the heels of that, along with the tentacles, countless streams of water also followed closely. Hundreds of water pillars with a diameter of 100 meters connected to the dark cloud vortex in the sky, sealing the entire island.
Beside Shi Yu, the gem cat looked at the changes in its surroundings in shock and was extremely stunned.
The survivors on the many islands also looked at the huge monster that enveloped the island in shock.
The power it emitted was incomparably terrifying. In an instant, everyone realized that this was a totem.
“Ridiculous, why is this thing here?”
“Heavens, our ship…”
< Name > Vortex Beast
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: ???
[Level of Growth]: Totem Level
[Energy Points]: ???
< Introduction > The monster that wreaked havoc on the seven islands in ancient times disappeared for a mysterious reason.
The most ridiculous thing was that Shi Yu’s archeological index actually recorded information about this thing.
This guy was a totem magical beast from hundreds of years ago!
“Let’s go,” Shi Yu immediately said.
At the same time, he telepathically told the cat what he had just seen. In an instant, the cat’s expression froze.
“Let’s go,” the cat said with a tremble.
The man and cat didn’t regret snatching the legendary gem, but they didn’t want to face the Vortex Demon Beast in front of them at all.
At this moment, the cat shouted in the sky, its spiritual perception spreading throughout the island.
“Not good, we’ve all been tricked. Be it the legendary gem or the Undying Ginseng, it’s all a conspiracy of the Pirate King. That Undying Ginseng is the first trap left behind by the Pirate King for us, and this Vortex Demon Beast is the second trap left behind by the Pirate King. His goal is to kill us.”
Before running, it didn’t forget to transfer the hatred and clear Shi Yu’s name.
The gem cat’s words instantly broke the defense of the pirates on the island.
A subtle pain appeared on their bodies.
“Son of a b*tch, I shouldn’t have believed in the nonsense about treasures.”
“That bastard Pirate King.”
“Vortex Demon Beast, isn’t that the monster that wreaked havoc on the seven islands hundreds of years ago? How is this guy related to the Pirate King? Bastard!”

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - Buggy Wants to Break Through (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Buggy Wants to Break Through (2)
At this moment, the surrounding temperature plummeted. Countless stiff pirates looked at the sealed sea area and were at a loss.
At this moment, someone discovered that the Undying Ginseng and the “corpse” of the Black Ape overlord had already disappeared.
But at the moment, this was no longer the question everyone was most concerned about.
Now, as the Vortex Demon Beast woke up and the ships on the sea were instantly swallowed, they only wanted to know how they could leave here alive in this situation.
The gem cat instantly gave the black ape overlord the finishing blow. At the same time, after teleporting back to Baby Ginseng, it immediately escaped with Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng, who had just shown off.
They quickly returned to Xiao Qin and the others, who also looked panicked.
“I’ll take you away first.”
After arriving, under the cover of the gem cat’s psychic power, it was about to teleport away from the island. However, the next moment, the cat was stunned.
The light in the gem eye stopped.
Instant Transmission failed!
“What’s wrong?” Seeing that the gem cat didn’t move for a long time, Shi Yu hurriedly asked.
Now, there were super vortexes around the island, enveloping the island. Even battleships couldn’t pass through with ships. They could only rely on Instant Transmission.
Everyone was like a turtle in a jar.
“Because the space in the ruins overlaps, the surrounding space seems to be in a sealed state. Instant Transmission can’t lock onto the location outside the island.” The gem cat wanted to cry. It wanted to leave this place more than anyone else.
Updates by
“What about flying?”
“No, it looks like we’re still on the island, but we’re actually already sealed in the subspace. If we can’t find a way to crack the ruins, I’m afraid we won’t be able to escape at all. We’ll be like ghosts running around the island.”
As soon as it finished speaking, the Vortex Demon Beast that created countless water pillars was like a wild beast that had been hungry for a long time. Everyone only heard a deep roar from the bottom of the sea, and countless tentacle-like water pillars began to whip down towards the island.
The target locked onto every life on the island.
Hundreds of water pillars that reached the sky hit the life forms on the island like whips and tentacles.
“Ah!!!”
In an instant, countless screams came from the island.
Those pirates who didn’t get too close to Baby Ginseng and survived the explosion were almost unable to resist the attack of the totem-level Vortex Demon Beast.
Under the huge water flow, those Beast Tamers and monarch-level ferocious beasts were instantly smashed into meat paste.
Then, the life essence in the bodies was absorbed into its body by the Vortex Demon Beast.
“Meow, meow!!!”
Shi Yu and the others were considered lucky because they had the overlord-level gem cat.
Although these tentacles were strong, they weren’t all coming towards Shi Yu and the others. Under the gem cat’s Psychic power, the tentacles that smashed over were directly fixed in midair. Then, they were crushed by the gem cat with full battle power and thrown back.
“This guy is very weak now. Although it’s a totem, it’s far inferior to those Dragon Kings in Dragon Palace City,” the gem cat shouted.
Shi Yu and the others were delighted.
“However, I still can’t defeat it!”
“If this continues, when the others are absorbed, it will sooner or later divert all its attention to deal with us.”
“It’s been sealed for hundreds of years. Although it’s weak now, it’s even hungrier and more brutal than all the ferocious beasts just now!”
Then what the hell!
“It’s indeed ferocious.”
Shi Yu also cursed in his heart. He tried to communicate with the Vortex Demon Beast telepathically, hoping to talk nicely. There was no need to fight and kill as a friend, but this guy seemed to be irrational at this moment.
After being sealed for so long, its hunger directly turned it into a “real magical beast”.
“We can’t call for help either… The spatial magnetic field is in chaos, the signal has been cut off.” Xiao Qin looked at the communicator solemnly.
“Minister, why don’t you summon the battleship and give it a try?”
“Although I don’t know if it can contact its main body in the chaotic spatial magnetic field, we can only give it a try. If it succeeds, someone will definitely come to save us. We just have to last until that moment… Or, Sister Shi, there should be our people on the surrounding islands.”
“Our people are indeed on the surrounding islands. They should have already captured the current situation here, but…” Sister Shi said at this moment. However, she hesitated. She looked at herself and the few navy spies around her.
She wasn’t confident.
Even if the Dong Huang Navy noticed the situation here, with their identities and status, it would probably be very difficult for the navy to send experts who could resist the totems to save them in a short period of time.
On the other hand, if Xiao Qin was in danger, her father would definitely invite experts to rescue her immediately.
“That’s too slow,” the gem cat said. “When the time comes, it’ll be too late. They can only be treated as our last hope.”
It didn’t think that they could last long under the siege of the totem.
“The current situation is very difficult to deal with, unless…”
It had spatial skills, so it could understand the difficulty of this sealed space better than Xiao Qin.
Under the influence of the Vortex Demon Beast’s power, the descending ruins space had already become a cage.
Unless someone could become the master of the ruins and obtain the right to control the ruins, just like how Shi Yu obtained the ruins bead back then… Only then could he leave safely.
However, in such an environment, the chances of becoming the master of the ruins were minimal. In fact, when the Pirate King modified the ruins, it was one thing if he left behind a switch to control the ruins.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - Buggy that couldnt take it anymore and wanted to break through (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Buggy that couldn’t take it anymore and wanted to break through (3)
“Give me a few minutes.”
“Shi Yu, give me the gem.”
Suddenly, the gem cat looked at Shi Yu.
“You mean…” Shi Yu immediately understood. He took out the Legendary Gem from the ruins space and threw it to the gem cat.
The nine-colored gem nine-colored jade instantly floated beside the gem cat.
“I don’t know if it can work, but I can only take a gamble. During this period, I want to try my best to absorb the power of the gem. Your safety depends on yourselves. The power of one of its tentacles isn’t strong. Shi Yu, you should be able to barely resist it. You can also use the power of the battleship.”
“Most importantly, protect me from being disturbed.”
During the process of absorbing the gem, it couldn’t be disturbed. Unfortunately, the level of Shi Yu’s ruins space was too low. Otherwise, it might be able to try to break through in the ruins space, but to be able to withstand a totem-level ruins space, even in its perfect state, it had to be a legendary Beast Tamer’s space.
Therefore, it could only try to break through in the outside world.
If the breakthrough was successful, with the power of the totem, it would be easy to shatter the ruins space of the Pirate King and the power barrier of the Vortex Demon Beast. All of them could leave successfully.
“I understand. Don’t worry and absorb it.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the gem cat floated in the air. Its eyes flashed with a holy light as it interacted with the nine-colored jade in front of it and tried to absorb the power of the legendary gem.
At this moment, Shi Yu also took a deep breath. Pets stood on Shi Yu one after another.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu looked solemnly at the hundreds of tentacles dancing crazily on the ocean towards the island.
Updates by
The island trembled and was getting closer and closer to sinking.
The silver sea battleship and the legendary gem were summoned by Shi Yu and thrown to the side. Xiao Qin immediately boarded the battleship.
Sister Shi, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the navy also looked at the tentacles in the sky solemnly with the pets they had summoned.
Soon, two huge tentacles attacked again.
That was because the life forms elsewhere had already been absorbed by the huge tentacles. In the blink of an eye, there were already very few Beast Tamers on the island who could resist the Vortex Demon Beast.
With a boom, the silver sea battleship shot out a huge golden cannon and directly smashed back a tentacle.
Sister Shi’s monarch-level Giant Crocodile Turtle, Huang Qi’s monarch-level Dragon Tornado Sponge, Qin Mingzhi’s monarch-level Dragon Claw Octopus, and nearly ten monarch-level pets attacked another tentacle together.
However, their combined strength was also very helpless against this huge tentacle.
Although there were many skills, they were too scattered and couldn’t condense into a force. They couldn’t form effective destructive power at all.
None of them was a top-notch master. Facing a totem-level tentacle, even if it was a totem without skills and in a weakened state, it was still very difficult to resist.
“Damn it.” Seeing this, Huang Qi and the others revealed indignant expressions.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu’s attack successfully defeated the tentacle.
Susu leaped up and transformed into a humanoid water elemental form. It wore the Gemini Silver Armor that appeared out of thin air and swallowed the Time Fruit!
Boom!
When a huge monarch aura erupted from Susu’s body, fiery red flames also erupted from its body. A longsword filled with sun flames appeared in its hand.
With the Legendary-level Gemini Silver Armor as a medium, Chi Tong possessed Susu. In the blink of an eye, their auras rose to an extremely terrifying level, even surpassing Shi Yu, who was possessed by Chi Tong.
The appearance of the red-haired Chi Tong and the armored Water Element General instantly made Sister Shi, Qin Mingzhi, Huang Qi, and Xiao Qin, who was trying to communicate with the outside world and waiting for her skills to cool down, reveal shocked expressions.
It was almost a sword.
The sword pressure of red and blue directly swept up a huge force, crushing countless water streams and sending the tentacles flying.
Of course, this was not worth bragging about at all. The weak Vortex Demon Beast did not even use any skills. Just its hundreds of tentacles wrapped in natural power caused shocking damage to the Beast Tamers on the island. At this moment, just as it repelled one, four more tentacles slapped down, making Shi Yu and the others reveal serious expressions.
Seeing this, the monarch-level ginseng baby and Eleven stood out immediately.
Only Buggy was at a loss.
It felt that with the strength of a commander rank, even if it brought equipment, it was useless against this tentacle.
It couldn’t devour infinitely like Susu. It could absorb the Time Fruit relatively quickly and perfectly. At this moment, Buggy suddenly realized that it was trash…
Buggy: !!!
No… No!!!
It didn’t want to be the one holding the team back!!
“Stop it, break through!”
Shi Yu’s voice sounded. “Although I don’t know what happened, your will increased in that instant.”
Buggy: …???
Buggy was instantly silent.
So, Eleven’s mid-level willpower was improved by awakening the royal bloodline. Baby Ginseng’s willpower was trained by experiencing life and death. Chi Tong’s willpower was enhanced by the meaning of life. Susu’s powerful willpower was tempered by countless reincarnations, and it…
Did its will break through because it didn’t want to be at the bottom?
Buggy instantly looked at the Vortex Demon Beast angrily. Damn it, it was too much of a bully! Die!

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm
In order to ensure that every pet had a good foundation, Shi Yu let every pet choose a special breakthrough method when they broke through.
One was to strengthen oneself with the power of nature.
When Eleven broke through, it absorbed the power of the heavenly lightning to the greatest extent.
Chi Tong absorbed the power of the sun.
As for Baby Ginseng, it absorbed the power of the moonlight.
Of course, not every pet could do this.
Firstly, pets needed to master extremely high energy control. Secondly, they also needed to have the skill to mobilize the power of nature.
Eleven and the others matched this.
But compared to Eleven, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng, Buggy didn’t have any skills to trigger the power of nature…
However, it had two more special skills.
Illusory Phantom and Imagination Domain.
These two skills could allow Buggy to create illusions, and the characteristic of illusions was that they could use external objects to strengthen the illusion itself.
At the same time, Buggy also had the Dragon of Imagination skill.
The Dragon of Imagination could rely on the divine dragon phantom created to strengthen itself.
Therefore, although Buggy couldn’t borrow the power of nature, it could maximize the effect of some dragon-element resources.
For example, back then, with the help of the level-seven resource Ice Dragon Whiskers, Sea Dragon Scales, and Tyrant Dragon Fang, it could directly lead it to battle monarchs.
Therefore, when it broke through, Buggy also began to rely on external forces.
As for the external force this time, it wasn’t the three level-seven resources.
It was the traces of the power of the hundred Dragon Gods it had stolen in Dragon Palace City.
Although Buggy had only stolen less than 1% of the traces of power that contained the Dragon God’s will, to be honest, Buggy had yet to digest it.
They were all forcefully imprinted by Buggy through Dream Steal and stored in its consciousness space.
/
Usually, when he slept, he was “conquering” these things.
Now that Buggy’s will had broken through, Shi Yu and Buggy felt that perhaps Buggy could try to control these powers.
“Not good!!”
At this moment, four huge tentacles attacked from Hot Summer Island. Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
The two just now were already fatal. Now that there were four here, what would happen?
Boom.
The silver sea battleship fired another energy storage cannon and sent a tentacle flying.
At the same time, Xiao Qin shouted solemnly, “No, I can’t contact the main body.”
As soon as she finished speaking, the surrounding Dong Huang Marines fell silent.
Although they had never expected it to work, it was still very uncomfortable to receive such news.
Buzz!!
Accompanied by the attack of the silver sea battleship, the second tentacle was still pressed back by the combination of Susu and Chi Tong with the Interlocking Sword.
“Roar!!!”
As for the third tentacle, it was suddenly caught by the huge beast that had suddenly enlarged to a hundred meters with a bang.
Boom!
Under the huge impact of the tentacles and water, the ground under Eleven’s feet caved in. However, with a sizzling sound, Eleven also successfully used the Thunder Palm to penetrate the water, charring the tentacles and pushing them back.
“There’s one more.”
Huang Qi and the others looked at the last huge tentacle that swept the water over.
“Leave it to me. You guys go charge the silver sea battleship.”
Shi Yu said to these guys who couldn’t be of much help.
Although this Vortex Demon Beast was in a weakened state and didn’t use any skills at this moment, attacking purely with its physical body and natural power, it wasn’t something ordinary Beast Tamers and ordinary monarch-level pets could deal with.
Even Eleven and the others found it very difficult to resist.
Instead of watching here, it was better to be a battery for the Silver Sea Battleship. Just Xiao Qin’s battery wasn’t enough.
At the same time, the one who resisted the last tentacle was not Baby Ginseng, who had just broken through.
Although Baby Ginseng was also very strong, at the moment, the most suitable position for Baby Ginseng was undoubtedly still support and treatment.
There was another way to deal with this tentacle!
“Wu!!!”
The Butterfly of Imagination had long flown up.
At this moment, the surrounding environment seemed to have become a huge valley under the modification of the power of imagination, making everyone reveal shocked expressions.
Because if it were an ordinary valley, it would be fine, but this valley… was very huge. Moreover, hundreds of dragon statues of different forms were carved between the mountain walls!
Among them, they were from the Sea Dragon Race, Thunder Dragon Race, Heavenly Dragon Race, and Sea Serpent Race, but each individual form was unique. They were all quasi-mythical races, emitting incomparable dragon might.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, in the Imagination Domain, every Dragon God statue was lifelike and filled with deterrence, as if they had come alive.
On their bodies, illusions slowly appeared, gradually forming the bodies of divine dragons that flew into the sky. For a moment, the dragons in the sky danced around in extreme shock.
Combination skill… Dragon God Ceremony!
As Buggy mobilized the weak power of these Dragon Gods with its sublimated will, it seemed to want to sacrifice these Dragon God phantoms and make them its power!
“Roar!!!”
Accompanied by a roar that filled the sky, the hundred divine dragon phantoms flew towards the butterfly’s body together and instantly surged into the Butterfly of Imagination. The energy of Buggy began to increase steadily!
< Name > Butterfly of Imagination
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
At this moment, with the help of the Dragon of Imagination skill, Buggy directly broke through.
In front of Shi Yu, Buggy’s energy level began to increase crazily.
The first stage.
Energy Points: 3,790,000
This was the energy value of Buggy’s normal state.

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (1)
Then, as Buggy entered the Dragon of Imagination state and obtained the life, energy, physique, and attributes of the divine dragon, it gathered the merits of countless perfect dragons. Even if it was just a trace, its attributes directly doubled.
Energy Points: 7,880,000
The increase in his body was not inferior to Eleven’s Inner Power at all.
At this moment, although Buggy still maintained its butterfly body, its strength was no longer as simple as a butterfly’s.
Even the seemingly weak wings were like the wings of a dragon. They contained the physical strength to destroy everything, enough to smash a steel building without any skills.
Hu hu hu!!!
Stopping in midair, Buggy began to expand. It spread its huge wings and waved them.
The surrounding valley environment instantly collapsed. The Imagination Domain turned into a hurricane environment.
Countless strong winds began to sweep out of Buggy’s wings. The fierce white whirlwind rushed over like a tsunami. The water on the tentacle almost instantly disappeared. Then, the strong winds left countless marks on the tentacle like blades. Moreover, they erupted with very powerful strength and directly pressed the tentacle back.
“Wu!!!”
In the sky, Buggy tried its best to display its strength. It was very satisfying.
Now, there was no need to be at the bottom, right?
“Gulp.” Not far away, Sister Shi and the other Marines gulped and were shocked by Shi Yu’s strength.
It was fine if it was just one, but why was every pet of Shi Yu so ridiculous?
Updates by
In comparison, as monarchs, why were their pets so weak…
Of course, the stronger Shi Yu was, the happier they were. Whether they could successfully leave alive depended on this person. No, to be precise, they looked at the gem cat that was absorbing the nine-colored jade in midair.
Most importantly, whether this cat could successfully break through.
At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at the gem cat worriedly.
Could it work?
If the gem cat failed to break through, it would be troublesome.
At that time, they could only take a gamble and hide in Shi Yu’s ruin ring space. Although they couldn’t leave the island, they could hide deeper.
This Vortex Demon Beast didn’t have spatial power or rationality, so it might not be able to find them. Although this choice meant giving up struggling and becoming a living target, if the enemy couldn’t find the target, there might be a chance for the Vortex Demon Beast to leave.
The use of the equipment that Bureau 11 gave to every member to protect their lives was revealed at this moment.
But if it didn’t leave…
In this situation, Shi Yu looked at the sea. He could probably only wait for the reinforcements from Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and the totem country.
The Snake Lord and the Earth Demon Ape died in the hands of the vortex totem. The Eight-Headed Orochi Totem and the Giant Ape Totem were both outstanding among top-notch totems. There was no reason for them to let the weak Vortex Demon Beast go!
…
In the outside world.
As the changes happened on Hot Summer Island, it was trapped by countless water pillars and the ruins that overlapped with reality. The Dong Huang Navy hidden around it indeed discovered the abnormality immediately and looked at everything in shock.
“This, this is…”
On a certain Dong Huang Navy battleship, a brigadier general looked at the image displayed on the battleship’s monitor and compared it in shock.
On the warship, there was naturally a detection system. Almost effortlessly, they recognized the identity of the culprit behind all of this.
During the Space Emperor Era, the Demon Beast that wreaked havoc in the sea was a totem-level monster!
“Not good, not good.”
The brigadier general transmitted the news here to the Dong Huang Navy headquarters almost immediately.
However, although the news had been transmitted, at the moment, be it the navy, the pirates, or the passing sea beasts, none of them dared to approach the surroundings of Hot Summer Island at all. After all, that was a totem-level monster.
Going to that chaotic area was courting death.
But at the moment, what made these Dong Huang Marines feel even more troubled was…
The change in Hot Summer Island and the appearance of the Vortex Demon Beast seemed to have attracted more trouble.
< Name > Lava Beast
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
< Introduction > It’s a powerful life form born naturally in magma.
There were already two lava beasts heading over.
They were dozens of meters long and looked like turtles. Their shells were like volcanoes as they walked directly on the sea. With every step they took, hot land would be formed on the sea.
These Lava Beasts were all subordinates of the Lava Totem and belonged to the same race.
Hot Summer Island belonged to the Lava Totem territory. The moment the Vortex Demon Beast appeared, it alarmed the overlord of the Lava Kingdom.
“Human!!!”
The arrival of the two overlords made the scalps of the brigadier general on the warship and the Marines standing on it tingle. They didn’t expect to bump into these monsters.
“Give us an explanation!!!”
After the two overlords who had stepped on the ocean arrived, they immediately threatened the Dong Huang Navy that had intruded into their territory. At the same time, they looked at the Vortex Demon Beast in the distance with fear.
“The overlords of the Lava Nation.”
General Ma Zheng of the Dong Huang Navy took a step forward with a dark expression and said, “I also want to know what’s going on. Why did the Vortex Demon Beast that wreaked havoc in the East Sea hundreds of years ago appear in your territory?”
Because the wrath of Dong Huang was backing him up, and the recording device was on the warship, he wasn’t very afraid of the two overlords.
“How do we know? It must be another conspiracy by you humans!!!”
The Lava Beast had a classic temper. They didn’t like the Vortex Demon Beast either. After all, they were incompatible. Now that the Vortex Demon Beast had appeared in their territory and humans happened to be gathered here, how could they be happy?

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (2)
“If you don’t give an explanation, even Dragon Palace City won’t be able to save you!”
The two lava beasts roared.
“What did you say!!”
“What’s the point of dragging in Dragon Palace City?” A voice erupted.
“Roar!!!”
Just as the two lava beasts were denouncing him, the sea suddenly trembled.
In the next second, with a boom, a huge water tornado rose out of thin air and connected to the sky from the deep sea.
Moreover, a deep whale-like cry was emitted.
Whoosh…
Then, the waterspout dissipated from the inside, and a huge whale wrapped in water rushed into the sky.
Its back was black, its abdomen was grayish-white, and it had a sharp back fin that looked like a tiger whale. The question just now came from its mouth.
At this moment, when they saw this huge monster, the expressions of the two lava beasts instantly changed. General Dong Huang, Ma Zheng, was also instantly stunned.
What a coincidence.
Right now, it was the number one general under the Sea Dragon King in Dragon Palace City, the overlord of the strongest ladder team in Dragon Palace City, the Sky Penetrating Whale.
Updates by
On the Sky Penetrating Whale, they also saw a white divine dragon. They recognized at a glance that this was the son of the Sea Dragon King, the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City.
Apart from that, there seemed to be a little cat.
The vibration of Hot Summer Island was naturally noticed by the Sky Penetrating Whale and the others who were rushing from the Rainbow Islands to Hot Summer Island.
The cat clone’s expression changed almost instantly, and it urged the Sky Penetrating Whale to come over quickly to see the situation.
At this moment, the cat clone looked at Hot Summer Island wrapped in the vortex, and its expression gradually collapsed.
“Mister Whale, leave them alone!!!”
“I can feel my main body there. This, what’s going on!!”
“Shi Yu and the others are definitely inside. Hurry, hurry up and think of a way.”
“Why would a totem appear? I can already imagine the tragic situation of the main body and Shi Yu inside. They must be crying and crying so pitifully at this moment. Wuwuwu, quickly save them.”
“What the?” At this moment, the Sky Penetrating Whale was also very shocked. It looked at the Vortex Demon Beast in the distance in confusion.
Didn’t he say he was here to give the badge?
What the hell was this!
Why was it different from what they had agreed on!
It was clearly here to take the badge, so why did it become a fight with the totem!
There had to be overtime pay for this!
The little white dragon: “Ah, this…”
So what was going on?
“Sky Penetrating Whale, Dragon Palace City’s Second Prince!”
As the Sky Penetrating Whale appeared, and even the son of the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King appeared, the two lava beasts instantly cowered. Who didn’t know that the Sky Penetrating Whale’s battle power was enough to rank in the top five among the overlords of the East Sea?
Even if the two of them worked together, they might not necessarily be able to defeat the Sky Penetrating Whale.
