Moreover, there wasthe greatest trigger in the East Sea here.
Offending the White Azure Dragon was basically equivalent to provoking two totems…
Dragon Palace City was clearly very far away. Why would they suddenly come?
“General Whale… Second Prince…” At this moment, when they saw the appearance of the Sky Penetrating Whale, the most surprised were still these Dong Huang Marines.
Ma Zheng seemed to have found his backbone and instantly said,
“General Whale, do you know what’s going on? There’s the Dong Huang Navy on Hot Summer Island. Please help. When the time comes, the Dong Huang Navy will definitely be very grateful!”
At this moment, the Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the Vortex Demon Beast and the sealed space and ignored the brigadier general.
What did it have to do with the Dong Huang Navy? How could it go and provoke the totem for a few Marines?
However… Shi Yu…
According to the gem cat, if Shi Yu was really inside, it definitely couldn’t let Shi Yu be in danger.
Shi Yu had too much to do with Dragon Palace City. Not only did he have a deep relationship with the Ice Dragon King, but he also obtained the Dragon God’s favor.
Therefore, when it saw the island being crazily beaten by the Vortex Demon Beast’s tentacles, it instantly panicked.
But it didn’t have the confidence to break into the space either. This was very unsolvable.
“The other party is a totem. I’m not very confident. I can only try my best to stall it.”
“Little White, didn’t the Sea Dragon King give you a life-saving scale? Don’t keep it anymore. Use it quickly. If it senses that you’re in danger, the Sea Dragon King and the others will definitely come looking for you.”
With that said, General Whale charged towards the Vortex Demon Beast with a whale roar. At this moment, it could also sense the weakness of the Vortex Demon Beast. It believed that it could still delay the other party for a moment.
“I understand.”
At the same time, the little white dragon immediately said.
And now, looking at the Sky Penetrating Whale that suddenly rushed towards Hot Summer Island and the Vortex Demon Beast, General Ma Zheng and the two lava beasts were a little stunned.
At that moment, no matter how dumb they were, they knew that an extremely important figure was trapped on the island.
Just that bit of Dong Huang Navy was not enough to make Dragon Palace City work so hard.
General Whale and the others attached great importance to him. They even didn’t hesitate to let the Third Prince use the life-saving scale to summon the Sea Dragon King?
“Who is it?” The two lava totems were silent.
Who exactly was on that island?
…
On Hot Summer Island.
The Vortex Demon Beast was still attacking.
At the moment, most of the life forms on the island had been absorbed by it.
A few minutes had passed.
Shi Yu and the others felt double the pressure.
Without the others attracting the attention of the Vortex Demon Beast, its many tentacles began to concentrate on sweeping towards Shi Yu and the others.
Eleven!
In a few minutes, Shi Yu and the others had already spent a lot of effort to resist the multiple attacks of the Vortex Demon Beast, but the counterattack was like a tickle to this guy. It didn’t seem to be of any use at all.
This was an attack that purely used its body to sweep up the power of nature without using any skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (3)
“Is this a totem?”
Shi Yu was extremely solemn.
“There are too many this time.”
Seeing the eleven tentacles attack, Shi Yu’s scalp went numb. Eleven and the others also looked tired, and they even had injuries on their bodies.
If not for the fact that the gem cat was still breaking through and couldn’t be disturbed, Shi Yu would have already wanted to bring everyone into the ruins space.
“Hold on a little longer,” Shi Yu said to Eleven and the others.
“Wu!!” “Wu!!” Eleven, Buggy, and the others looked at the tentacles of the Vortex Demon Beast with determination.
It had to be said that the results of the willpower training were reflected. In the past, they might not have been able to deal with the totem’s attack so actively.
Although they had yet to temper their overlord will, each of them had already started to have the mentality of an expert.
“No, there are too many.”
However, there were still too many tentacles. Seeing the tired Eleven and the others, Xiao Qin and the others on the battleship already felt that it was very difficult to resist.
However, at this moment, with a boom, the tentacles that filled the sky seemed to have encountered a huge impact. Its entire body suddenly trembled, and even the tentacles that swept towards Shi Yu and the others suddenly stopped in midair. Then, they subconsciously retracted. This scene stunned Shi Yu and the others.
“Someone attacked outside and attracted the attention of the Vortex Demon Beast.”
Shi Yu subconsciously reacted and looked at the gem cat.
Updates by
Good thing.
Although he didn’t know who it was, he hoped they could buy them more time.
At this moment, under Shi Yu’s attention, the gem cat’s energy level was increasing crazily.
It had already increased by a few minutes.
It came to 60 million.
Even if it couldn’t break through successfully, legendary-level resources were still top-notch treasures. They could also strengthen many pets’ battle power.
However, at the moment, the gem cat wasn’t pursuing this level of strengthening. It wanted the legendary gem to increase its life level and reach the totem level.
It didn’t know what was going on outside.
The Vortex Demon Beast didn’t continue attacking. Although its tentacles were still waving, most of them were waving outside the fog.
“Don’t worry… Don’t worry…”
At that moment, immersed in the process of absorbing the legendary gem, the gem cat was also trying its best to remain calm.
There was hope.
This gem was simply tailor-made for it.
Originally, it was just an ordinary gem cat from Ancient Capital University.
But at the moment of life and death, something unexpected happened.
Ordinary gem cats could only evolve once through the Eye of the Gem and the Evolution Gem, but after it mutated, it could absorb multiple gems and absorb gems multiple times to constantly evolve.
Depending on the attributes of the gem, one could also obtain skills with different attributes.
It was this outstanding talent that made the gem cat reach the overlord level while lazing around.
This nine-colored jade contained nine attribute powers. Generally speaking, it was not a very good strengthening resource, because very few pets could match it.
But the gem cat felt that it might be able to.
At this moment, it wasn’t interested in whether the gem could allow it to evolve again. This wasn’t important. It only wanted to know if this gem could increase its growth level!
Soon, ten minutes had passed since the gem cat began to absorb the legendary gem.
In the outside world.
At this moment, the Sky Penetrating Whale was fighting the countless tentacles of the Vortex Demon Beast with difficulty.
After absorbing a lot of life essence, the power of the Vortex Demon Beast had already recovered a small portion.
A thick fog began to envelop its endless tentacles.
In addition, at this moment, hundreds of tentacles triggered the power of nature together and wrapped around deterrence. The Sky Penetrating Whale faced a huge pressure that Shi Yu and the others didn’t.
“Roar!!!”
The Sky Penetrating Whale roared.
Its body was wrapped and whipped by countless tentacles. It struggled free again and spat out dragon waves that swept across the tentacles.
Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled around him. Waves appeared frequently, and tornadoes wreaked havoc. It was like an apocalypse scene.
The Lava Beast, the little white dragon, and the Dong Huang Navy swallowed their saliva crazily.
“Why isn’t the Sea Dragon King here yet!”
The Sky Penetrating Whale was furious. If this continued…
Every time it was attacked, it felt that a lot of its life essence was absorbed by this guy.
If this continued, it wouldn’t be saved unless it had ten Time Fruits for its retirement!!!
“General Whale, it…”
“Can we win?”
On the navy battleship, the brigadier general watched all of this solemnly. At this moment, he still wanted to know how the interior of the island was.
“That’s impossible.”
“No matter how strong the overlord is, no matter how weak the totem is, as long as there’s no Beast Tamer strengthening it, it’s very difficult for the overlord to defeat the totem,” the two lava overlords said.
Buzz!!
A terrifying power formed a confrontation in the air.
Roar!
The Vortex Demon Beast roared. The spreading fog formed a deep power that swallowed the Sky Penetrating Whale’s move.
Violent, bloodthirsty, chaotic, hungry…
A series of negative emotions spread out, corroding the Sky Penetrating Whale’s will.
“Why isn’t Father here yet…” At that moment, even the little white dragon was anxious.
If it encountered danger, with this rescue speed, it would have long died.
“Dong Huang, where’s your rescue?”
“Why isn’t it here yet?”
“Yes, yes, quickly apply to launch that whatever intercontinental missile. Blast it!” the gem cat urged.
Facing the question of the little white dragon and the gem cat, the Dong Huang Navy was silent.
But at this moment, the equally anxious gem cat clone was suddenly stunned. It looked into the distance and sensed something.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (4)
“Totem.”
Its words instantly attracted the attention of the little white dragon and Brigadier General Ma Zheng.
The little white dragon was delighted. “Father is here?”
But clearly, it wasn’t.
This totem power didn’t belong to the dragon race.
As the gem cat clone finished speaking, with a boom, a huge spatial crack appeared in the sky above Hot Summer Island.
Suddenly, the clouds were disturbed and dark clouds gathered.
The spatial crack slowly opened like a huge eye.
It was indeed a huge eye that was filled with the power of strong totems.
Seeing this scene, the people who could see Hot Summer Island suddenly swallowed their saliva. They didn’t know what had happened again. The two lava beasts felt a headache, not understanding why another mysterious totem had come.
“General Whale, move aside.” After the huge eye opened, it revealed the nine-colored gem eye on it. A familiar female voice was transmitted, shocking the Sky Penetrating Whale, the White Azure Dragon, and the other lives in the outside world.
The power of the totem this time was much stronger than the weak Vortex Demon Beast. For a moment, the deterrence swept through the endless sea area, causing countless sea beasts to stop moving.
In the deepest volcano magma of the Lava Island, the lava totem that even the Vortex Demon Beast’s commotion couldn’t wake up suddenly opened its eyes. Its hundred-meter-tall body swayed.
In the deep sea, the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King, who were roaring as they rushed to Hot Summer Island, sensed the new totem power from the Hot Summer Island area.
This aura was very strange. It contained many powers, but it seemed to have condensed into one. For a moment, no one could determine which totem had descended.
Boom!!
After a huge eye appeared in the sky, the entire Chaotic Sea Region trembled. The violent lightning, wind, and waves almost instantly calmed down.
…
Inside Hot Summer Island.
Boom!!!
As Shi Yu and the others protected it for a long time, before anyone could react, a shocking aura suddenly erupted from the gem cat. This aura that shot into the sky instantly stunned Shi Yu and the others.
The gem cat floating in the sky opened its nine-colored gem eye and emitted an incomparable totem power!
Seeing this, Shi Yu was instantly overjoyed.
A one in ten chance of breaking through.
The gem cat only tried twice before succeeding.
Apart from not being willing to work hard, it was really damn lazy after all.
“Did it succeed?”
“Totem level?”
Xiao Qin and the others had looks of disbelief and joy.
[Energy Points]: ???
In an instant, the gem cat’s energy level broke through to the point where Shi Yu’s index couldn’t be detected.
At the same time, the breakthrough gem cat was like a god descending to the mortal world. It floated in the air and looked at the spatial fog and the tentacles that filled the sky. At this moment, the chaotic Pirate King Ruins space was no longer an obstacle to it.
It instantly knew the situation inside and outside the island.
“Leave the rest to me.”
On this day, the gem cat stepped into the totem realm!
The space behind the gem cat, whose aura was rising steadily, blurred, and gradually divided into eight clones.
Including its main body, there were a total of nine bodies floating in the sky.
Right on the heels of that, light of different colors began to linger on the nine gem cats. Then, their eyes began to transform into different colors.
White, blue, red, black, purple, green, gold, pink… All kinds of different lights bloomed.
A powerful aura instantly erupted from the nine gem cats.
Boom!!
When the light completely dissipated, with the Nine Gem Cats at the center, the nine gem cats that emitted totem-level power turned into various light balls. The nine light balls directly formed a galaxy that rotated around each other.
At the same time, the huge eye in the sky also emitted endless light.
Super multi-element combination skill, Illusion Star Annihilation!
The inside and outside resonated with each other. A powerful move instantly passed through space and appeared in the ocean, smashing heavily onto the body of the Vortex Demon Beast!!
“Meow…”
The light that pierced through space was infinitely enlarged in the eyes of countless people. It was almost as if it could destroy everything. With the aftermath, it shattered the entire broken Pirate King Space. Countless mist disappeared under the shattering of the mirror.
“Roar!!!”
Boom!!
The Illusory Star Destruction shattered space, sank the Vortex Demon Beast, and smashed into the deep sea. It directly penetrated an eternal hole in the ocean, making countless currents circle around!
At this moment, Hot Summer Island appeared in the outside world again as if it had seen the sun. The many lives in the distance and the Sky Penetrating Whale that had been forced back by the aftermath of the power instantly saw the situation on the island clearly.
Hot Summer Island was already broken.
A gem cat floated in the sky and looked at the sinking island in dissatisfaction. It was bargaining with the young man who had a mini panda, butterfly, ginseng baby, sword spirit, and slime.
“It’s all thanks to me this time. I only want 10% of your collection. It’s not too much, right? That pile isn’t even worth a legendary gem.” Shi Yu argued reasonably.
“How is it not too much!!…” The totem cat in the sky roared. It didn’t expect to be butchered just after breaking through.
However, forget it. It was happy today. It would give the collections to Shi Yu. It just needed Shi Yu to take care of its meals.
At the same time, the Sky Penetrating Whale in the sky looked at the gem cat clone in the distance in silence, then at the gem cat’s main body that had repelled the Vortex Demon Beast with a single attack. It was extremely silent.
This was the gem cat that was always being noisy and causing a fuss?
What the f*ck… The Sky Penetrating Whale looked at the totem-level cat in the sky with a shocked expression. Its values were completely shattered. It didn’t understand why this hooligan who went to Dragon Palace City to eat and drink every time could break through to the totem level.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: The Gem Cat Stepping Into the Totem Realm (5)
Splash.
Before long, under the vibration of countless ocean creatures, two hundred-meter-long divine dragons appeared from the sea and circled in the sky. They looked at the fine little white dragon and the gem cat in the distance that emitted the power of totems in silence.
“Dad, Mom, I’m fine. I called you over to save Minister Shi Yu, but from the looks of it, it’s alright too?”
The little white dragon looked at Shi Yu, who was “directing” the totem-level gem cat, with shining eyes. It knew that Shi Yu was a hidden expert.
Cultivating totems was the ability of the legendary Beast Tamer!
“Minister Shi Yu…”
“What exactly happened here?”
The Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King were also stunned.
“That cat…”
As for Brigadier General Ma Zheng on the Dong Huang Navy battleship, he instantly learned the identity of this gem cat through the warship’s reconnaissance system.
[Protector Overlord of Ancient Capital University]
No, it should be called [Ancient Capital University’s Guardian] or [Dong Huang’s Guardian] now.
Why was it here?
Soon, General Ma Zheng discovered the humans near the gem cat and saw the navy members he was worried about.
He even saw Xiao Qin and the others in disbelief.
General Xiao’s daughter and the Silver Sea Warship… Why were they also here?
Of course, most importantly, there was Shi Yu.
The warship’s detection system quickly detected Shi Yu’s identity.
Upon hearing the little white dragon and the others, how could General Ma Zheng not know that the little white dragon had called over the two totems to save Shi Yu?
[Student of Ancient Capital University, Minister of the Dong Huang Ocean Environmental Protection Department.]
This was the identity of Shi Yu in the navy’s information bank. This was the first time General Ma Zheng had heard of the Marine Environmental Protection Department, but when he heard the little white dragon and the Sea Dragon King address Shi Yu as minister, he was instantly confused.
He quickly sent the information here back to the Dong Huang Navy headquarters and the current situation here.
Although he didn’t know what had happened, he felt that everything that happened here would definitely shake the entire Dong Huang. There was no other reason than because Dong Huang had another guardian.
At that moment, the ones who were trembling the most were the two lava overlords from the Lava Kingdom who had come to investigate the situation. They were sandwiched between the four totems and regretted coming out.
“What’s going on today…”
Soon.
The waves rolled again. The Vortex Demon Beast wasn’t so easily defeated. A huge aura began to come from the deep sea again.
But in the next moment, the power of the three totems locked onto the Vortex Demon Beast.
The Vortex Demon Beast gradually woke up:???
…
Dong Huang Navy Headquarters.
A totem-level Vortex Demon Beast appeared in the Chaotic Sea. In addition, the Vortex Demon Beast was a ferocious totem from hundreds of years ago. It was indeed a very serious matter.
After General Ma Zheng sent the news, almost immediately, the Beast Tamers above the lieutenant general position in the headquarters gathered and discussed the situation in the Chaotic Sea.
Although General Ma Zheng had sent news that a navy spy was trapped on Hot Summer Island, totem-level creatures were involved. Even the Dong Huang Navy couldn’t immediately rescue them.
As the organizer of this meeting, the legendary general Xiao Hai had already held a few minutes of meeting with the navy generals and roughly understood the situation on Hot Summer Island.
“In other words, a large number of pirates have gathered on Hot Summer Island because of the rumors of the Pirate King Ruins. The totem clans, including our spies.”
“Then, something unknown happened on the island. The Vortex Demon Beast that mysteriously disappeared hundreds of years ago appeared again and sealed the entire island. Moreover, it attacked the island indiscriminately.”
“That’s about it.”
The navy conference room was already filled with confusion. Regarding this matter, everyone didn’t know how to deal with it for a moment.
It was hopeless. In the face of a totem-level attack, any life form on the island, even overlords, would probably find it difficult to survive.
“The latest information about Hot Summer Island!”
Just as many navy generals couldn’t make up their minds, an intelligence officer rushed in.
“Speak,” General Xiao Hai patted the table and said.
“The Vortex Demon Beast has been suppressed. Hot Summer Island will see the light of day again.”
“What? What’s going on? Could it be that the Lava Totem was awakened?” When the generals heard this news, they were immediately shocked.
General Xiao Hai was also instantly stunned. It wasn’t that easy to have a conflict between totems, right?
“No, the latest information from General Ma Zheng is that General Xiao Hai, your daughter Xiao Qin, Major Huang Qi, and Qin Mingzhi are also on Hot Summer Island.”
“What did you say?” General Xiao Hai, who was still very calm just now, was immediately shocked. “Why is she there? She’s fine?”
The expressions of the other navy generals also instantly turned serious. General Xiao Hai’s daughter had already encountered a major change because of a mission. Why was she in such a dangerous place now?
“It’s alright, General Xiao Qin and the others are alright. Although the Vortex Demon Beast attacked the life forms on the island indiscriminately and the life forms on the island suffered heavy casualties, our Dong Huang didn’t seem to have many casualties.”
“What’s going on?” General Xiao Hai said heavily.
“According to General Ma Zheng’s information, the Minister of Marine Environmental Protection, Shi Yu, and the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University, the Gem Cat, are also on the island.”
Marine Environmental Protection Minister Shi Yu?
Among the generals present, including Xiao Hai, not many knew about Shi Yu’s situation. Even General Xiao Hai only knew that Shi Yu had become the minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City, but he didn’t know why he was so valued by Dragon Palace City. Just the relationship of the Ice Dragon Totem wasn’t enough!
As for the other generals, they even more so didn’t know who Shi Yu was. To be precise, they couldn’t associate Shi Yu, a student from Ancient Capital University, with the Marine Environmental Protection Department, a department they had never heard of.
“I only know Shi Yu, who developed the Green Silkworm cocoon…”
“The Shi Yu ranked 81st in the Sequence Battle? It shouldn’t be the same person, right?”
“No, Shi Yu is a student of Ancient Capital University. In addition, the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University is also here… It’s the same person?”
Many generals discussed.
At this moment, the intelligence officer continued,
“Although I don’t know what happened, the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University, the Gem Cat, broke through to the totem level and repelled the Vortex Demon Beast. At the same time, in order to save Shi Yu, the two totems the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King descended on Hot Summer Island. In the end, under the joint efforts of the Gem Cat, the Sea Dragon King, and the Azure Dragon King… the Vortex Demon Beast was suppressed.”
“What!!!!”
The information on Hot Summer Island was still too explosive. When the group of generals heard that the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University had broken through to the totem level, their eyes immediately widened. Then, they heard that two totem dragon kings had descended from Dragon Palace City in order to rescue Minister Shi Yu, whom the intelligence officer mentioned. They opened their mouths in disbelief.
Who exactly was this Minister Shi Yu of the Marine Environmental Protection Department?
They all looked at General Xiao Hai. At this moment, Xiao Hai fell into endless thought. Shi Yu… What exactly did he do there!

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 364 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang
Chaotic Sea Region, Hot Summer Island.
The Vortex Demon Beast was suppressed by the totem cat, the Sea Dragon King, and the Azure Dragon King.
If it was a totem at its peak, it might be a little difficult to deal with.
However, a weak totem that had been hungry for hundreds of years could not resist the combination of the three totems at all.
However, under the Sea Dragon King’s suggestion, the weak Vortex Demon Beast wasn’t directly killed.
Although the gem cat wanted to try the totem-level iron-plate squid whisker, it was immediately stopped by the Sea Dragon King.
They couldn’t kill it…
Totem-level creatures were full of treasures. Living totems were like raised hens that could produce treasures at any time. Their value was greater than dead totems.
Dragon Palace City had a deep sea prison that specialized in sealing, suppressing, and locking totems. The previous Poison Dragon Totem was locked there. If he handed the Vortex Demon Beast to Dragon Palace City to deal with, its value could be maximized.
After it died, it wouldn’t be fresh anymore. It was better to cut it when it was alive. It could still be reborn.
Hearing that the Sea Dragon King made sense, the gem cat agreed.
It decided to go to Dragon Palace City to eat and drink later. Now that it was at the totem level, it wasn’t troublesome to go to Dragon Palace City alone.
Pretty good.
Seeing this, Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh. It was really dark. It was almost catching up to him, who wanted to use Yun An as a renewable resource.
To be able to nurture such a Sea Dragon King, it looked like Lin Feng Legend wasn’t a kind person either…
…
In the Chaotic Sea, after the mutation of Hot Summer Island, under the attack of the Vortex Demon Beast, apart from Shi Yu and the others, only two people survived.
One was a quasi-legendary big pirate. Because the level of the Beast Taming Space was high enough, he had the ability to etherealize and relied on the spatial etherealization to last until the end.
The other little pirate had a special Beast Taming Talent that could allow him and his pets to disguise as rocks, dust, and wood to temporarily erase traces of life. Therefore, he dodged the attack of the irrational Vortex Demon Beast.
The others might also have some escape methods, but they weren’t that lucky in the face of the sharp attack of the Vortex Demon Beast. In the end, they all became nutrients for the Vortex Demon Beast.
Unfortunately, although these two lucky people escaped the attack of the Vortex Demon Beast, they still couldn’t escape the punishment of the gem cat in the end.
Unlike the Vortex Demon Beast that relied on instinct to hunt previously, after the gem cat’s psychic domain enveloped the entire Hot Summer Island, it immediately discovered the two of them.
In the end, when the gem cat teleported Shi Yu and the others to a safe area in the distance, it also knocked the two of them out and teleported them over.
“Place your bets!”
On the warship, General Ma Zheng commanded the sea soldiers to lock up the two surviving pirates and prepare to ask them questions later. Beside him, on the Silver Sea battleship, Shi Yu and the others were leaning against it weakly to rest.
The Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King didn’t stay for long. They directly escorted the Vortex Demon Beast back to Dragon Palace City. After all, this was the territory of other totems, and it wasn’t appropriate to stay for long. Similarly, two lava overlords slipped away. They had already slipped away during the battle of the four totems, afraid that they would provoke trouble if they stayed for too long.
Soon, the chaotic sea area of Hot Summer Island returned to calm.
During this period, Shi Yu and the others naturally chatted as they walked.
“Yo, little white dragon, you broke through too.”
Leaning on the deck, Shi Yu and his pets smiled at the Third Prince who stayed behind.
“Yeah, hehehehe. Senior Shi Yu, I helped you call for help immediately this time. It’s not too much to become a core member of the Environmental Protection Department, right?”
“Not too much. I’ll give you two Time Fruits!” Shi Yu was rarely generous.
“Tell me, what natural treasures did you use?” Shi Yu smiled.
< Name > White Azure Dragon
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 5,610,000
There was something wrong with this energy value. Previously, the little white dragon only had 160,000 energy points, lower than even commander-level Buggy.
In the end, it was broken. The normal energy level was stronger than Eleven and the others?
Only the ginseng race, which was known for its energy value, could suppress the little white dragon?
It definitely used some high-level resources!
“I used hundreds of millions of strengthening resources before and after the breakthrough. It’s nothing, nothing,” the little white dragon said in embarrassment.
“What level?”
“They’re all only level-eight.”
Damn it!
Shi Yu sighed. Dragon Palace City was still rich.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others also revealed envious expressions.
Not to mention level-eight strengthening resources, even if it was level-seven strengthening resources, Shi Yu did not prepare them when they broke through. They were all free natural energy.
Of course, it wasn’t a big problem.
Wasn’t money tight previously? After taking over the gem cat’s collection, he would have money.
Shi Yu planned to cooperate with Eleven and the others when they broke through to the overlord level.
There were a total of three ways for a monarch-level pet to break through to the overlord level.
1. Overlord will, and using it to break through the limit.
2. Legendary-level resource strengthening. Unlike the 10% chance of letting an overlord advance to the totem level, almost 100% of legendary-level resources could allow a monarch to advance to the overlord level. It was still very safe.
3. Super racial skill reaching perfect proficiency.
The strength of the breakthrough was basically the overlord’s will, which was equivalent to the strengthening of legendary resources smaller than the proficiency of super skills.
Of course, this was only one of three.
The strongest state would definitely still be when the proficiency of the super skill reached the standard and had the overlord’s will. At the same time, it would use legendary strengthening resources to strengthen it.
Therefore, if possible, Shi Yu naturally hoped that he could have all three components when breaking through.
As for commander rank to monarch rank, three components was just too much for that small breakthrough. It wasn’t that particular.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (1)
“Mister Whale, thank you for attracting firepower outside. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to last until I broke through. Next time, I’ll give you dried fish in Dragon Palace City.”
On the other side, the gem cat retracted its clone and immediately received the memories of the clone during this period of time. Then, it thanked the Sky Penetrating Whale that was also left behind.
“I, you, it… forget it, congratulations…”
The Sky Penetrating Whale still didn’t understand why it was inferior to a hooligan who broke through to the totem level first even though it had been fighting in the sea for so many years.
Its super racial skill proficiency was definitely higher than the gem cat. After fighting for Dragon Palace City for so long, it had even obtained three rewards for legendary resources. However, after using legendary resources three times, it had never successfully broken through to the totem level.
This made the Sky Penetrating Whale very uncomfortable. It looked at the sea, at its face that looked like a tiger whale, at the face of the gem cat that looked like a big white cat, and immediately came to a conclusion.
Perhaps it was because its face was darker, while the gem cat’s face was paler…
However, in order to prevent itself from being envious, jealous, and hateful, the Sky Penetrating Whale quickly found a balance and comforted itself.
totems that used resources to break through were the weakest totems. Without a solid foundation, their battle power was lacking.
It was not envious, not envious, not envious… It was not envious at all.
At this moment, Sister Shi and the others’ superior, Brigadier General Ma Zheng, finally started to ask about the specific situation.
After saluting Xiao Qin and the others, he began to ask about the cause and effect.
However, although Sister Shi and the others were directly under General Ma Zheng, when it came to the situation on the island, they still subconsciously cast their gazes at Shi Yu, Xiao Qin, and the gem cat.
Without the permission of Shi Yu and the others, they didn’t dare to say anything, even if the other party was their superior.
“It’s alright, just tell the truth,” Shi Yu said.
There was such a big commotion here. In addition, they were all family, so there was nothing to hide. Most importantly, Shi Yu was very satisfied that the gem cat had broken through to the totem level. It was invincible. This time, it was really invincible. Who else was at the totem level? Although it was the weakest totem, as long as it ran fast, there was no problem.
A moment later…
“Is the Vortex Demon Beast really a conspiracy of the Pirate King…”
“What!! The legend of the Pirate King Ruins is true? The gem cat successfully broke through with the help of the gem?”
“Wait, wait a minute? Minister Shi Yu… used Baby Ginseng to shatter two totem country overlords? And he insta-killed them?!!”
…
The story gradually became clear. The student of Ancient Capital University, who was also an archeologist of Bureau 11 and the minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department, Shi Yu, brought the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University to follow the traces of the legendary gem to explore Hot Summer Island. In the end, not only did he really discover the legendary gem, but he also snatched it in the midst of danger under the two overlords and shattered the overlords. Then, an even greater conspiracy by the Pirate King appeared. The Vortex Demon Beast broke through, but not only was Shi Yu and the others fine, the gem cat even temporarily used the gem to break through. With the appearance of a new totem, it defeated the Vortex Demon Beast that had once wreaked havoc in the East Sea and had incomparably terrifying strength…
The incident on Hot Summer Island, with the highest secret, only reached the hands of the navy headquarters’ General Xiao Hai. After watching it, General Xiao Hai couldn’t calm down for a long time, his gaze blurry.
He understood the logic, but what the hell was with Shi Yu crushing two overlords?
Wasn’t Shi Yu a level-five Beast Tamer and a master-level Beast Tamer?
Although Shi Yu was very strong, the Sequence Competition Committee had ranked Shi Yu at 81. To a certain extent, it was already a comprehensive evaluation of Shi Yu’s battle results and strength, but what was that now?
Even Ye Xing, who was ranked first in the Sequence, couldn’t instantly kill two overlords so easily!
Under normal circumstances, Xiao Hai would definitely find it difficult to believe, but the problem was that this battle result was jointly confirmed by Xiao Qin and nearly ten other Marines present. Even the two pirates who were captured had seen with their own eyes that it was a ginseng baby that shattered the two overlords with a flip of its hand.
The pirates might not know the situation, but the Marines present knew that the ginseng baby was not the Undying Ginseng of the Pirate King Ruins at all, but Shi Yu’s pet…
“This 20-year-old young man… used Baby Ginseng to shatter two overlords in one hit?”
It was off the charts!
This navy general was completely confused. He only felt that this incident revealed an unscientific and strange feeling.
He quickly thought of how Shi Yu had used the power of the gem cat to deliberately lie about his battle results in order to fight for the ranking of the Sequence. However, he quickly felt that there was no need. With Shi Yu’s identity, there was no need for him to do this. Moreover, such an increase in ranking would immediately give him away. So… it was true?
“Shi Yu? I’ll remember that. If everything is true, I look forward to your next performance.”
General Xiao Hai walked to the phone and prepared to pass this information to the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the old principal of Ancient Capital University who had entrusted him to help Shi Yu establish the Ocean Environmental Protection Department. Moreover, he had to let the principal of Ancient Capital University know about the gem cat’s breakthrough first…
…
Ancient Capital University.
The retired Principal Feng was training Lu Qingyi.
In fact, Principal Feng was very unwilling to let Lu Qingyi participate in the World Tournament. After all, Lu Qingyi’s strength was not strong to be honest. Although her battle results were outstanding and she was now ranked in the top ten of the Sequence Tournament committee, how could Principal Feng not understand that these battle results were obtained by Lu Qing with the super forbidden skill “Mythical Revival”?

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (2)
The effect of this skill was similar to letting the shadow of a divine beast possess a pet to fight for her. It was an opportunity obtained by Lu Qingyi in the Mythical Ruins. After using it, it could increase the overall strength of the pets Lu Qingyi had obtained. For example, just the energy value could increase to more than ten million. However, the side effects every time she used it were not small, so Principal Feng was not willing for Lu Qingyi to take the risk in the World Tournament.
However, he also understood the attraction of the World Tree to archeologists. Therefore, after careful consideration, he could only decide to use this year to increase Lu Qingyi’s normal battle power with all his might, so that she wouldn’t rely too much on the skill “Mythical Revival” to increase the battle power of her pets.
“But apart from Qingyi, there aren’t many people from Ancient Capital University who can achieve results in the Sequence battle. It’s a pity about those rewards.”
Principal Feng sighed as he looked at the ranking that occasionally changed in the Sequence Battle. His gaze landed on Shi Yu, who was 81st.
This ranking was too low.
This ranking only included Eleven’s battle result of defeating the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince in Dragon Palace City. Although it was already very impressive, it couldn’t withstand the fact that Shi Yu only had one monarch-level pet at that time. In addition, Shi Yu had a telepathy talent and didn’t have any other dazzling battle results.
Overall, 81 was already not bad, but Principal Feng knew that Shi Yu rarely fought head-on. In terms of explosive strength, Shi Yu was also very terrifying now.
For example, although that ginseng baby was only at the commander level, with that Time Fruit, if he didn’t care about the price, Shi Yu might be able to fight an overlord. Of course, the price of fighting an overlord was too high, but it was still easy for all of them to have monarch-level battle power.
In Principal Feng’s opinion, Shi Yu should have a place in the top 20. As for higher, it depended on whether Shi Yu was willing to pay such a huge price for the battle.
“Huh?”
Looking at the ranking Principal Feng, the communication device page was suddenly occupied by a call. He looked at the caller ID and was stunned.
“General Xiao Hai.”
“Principal Feng.”
Principal Feng picked up the phone. The two of them went straight to the point.
“Principal Feng, I have some information to tell you,” General Xiao Hai said.
“It’s related to Shi Yu and the guardian overlord of your school, the Gem Cat.”
“Tell me.” Principal Feng’s heart skipped a beat. He suddenly had a bad feeling.
But a moment later…
Chaos Sea, Hot Summer Island, Pirate King Ruins, Vortex Demon Beast… A pile of information surged into Principal Feng’s ears, causing his expression to gradually change until it froze.
“Holy shit!!! The gem cat broke through to the totem?? How is this possible?”
“What!! Shi Yu commanded Baby Ginseng to crush two overlords?!”
“Wait, wait… I’m a little confused.”
…
Dong Huang Sea Region, near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
Dong Huang and the others didn’t stay long in Hot Summer Island because the previous battle would definitely awaken the Lava Totem. As a top-notch totem, although Dragon Palace City wasn’t afraid and didn’t fancy it, Dragon Palace City wasn’t willing to offend it. After all, even if there were many divine dragons working together, they couldn’t defeat this guy.
This was because apart from its battle power, its escape skills were also top-notch. When the time came, it could burrow into the depths of the magma and underground. The Dragon God couldn’t do anything to it.
Just look at the countries that had offended it. For example, the seven islands. Now, it would even erupt a slight volcano from time to time and cause a slight earthquake. It was all the revenge of the Lava Totem.
To be precise, none of the totems that could be active in the Chaotic Sea were easy to deal with. If there were no special circumstances, Dong Huang, the Seven Islands, and Dragon Palace City were unwilling to directly fall out with them.
Therefore, Shi Yu and the others quickly left the Lava Totem Domain and returned to Dong Huang.
At this moment, although Shi Yu and the others had learned that the Rainbow Islands had been recovered, they were not in the mood to take a look over there. They planned to wait until the Chaotic Sea Region stabilized.
So many pirates had died in the Lava Totem Domain, and an overlord had died in the Ba Qi Nation and the Great Ape Nation. Next, the Chaotic Sea Region would definitely be even more chaotic. It was not suitable to stay for long, not suitable to stay for long…
The Sky Penetrating Whale, the White Azure Dragon, and the others escorted Shi Yu and the others out of the Chaotic Sea. After obtaining new resources from Shi Yu, they returned to Dragon Palace City.
As for Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu and the gem cat also planned to visit later. It was better to return to Dong Huang to report such a big matter like the gem cat’s breakthrough.
“Why did you suddenly become diligent?”
On the silver sea battleship, Shi Yu was amused to see the gem cat lying on the flying carpet and cultivating.
This didn’t look like a gem cat.
Logically speaking, after breaking through, shouldn’t he be more lazy and have no worries at all?
“What do you know?” The gem cat curled its lips.
Its current hard work was for it to slack off better in the future!
“Why don’t I understand?” Shi Yu also curled his lips and said, “Aren’t you just perfecting your race?”
After transcendent life forms reached the totem level, race and race levels were no longer important to them.
Because at this level, they could already unearth the potential of life and automatically optimize their race, develop new racial skills themselves, and optimize their own and even the next generation’s bloodlines.
Although it couldn’t reach the Mythical race, as long as a totem-level life form was willing to train, there was basically no one lower than a high-level overlord race. The term quasi Mythical race was tailor-made for the totem level.
It could be said that every totem was ultimately a quasi Mythical race.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (3)
Therefore, if there was a small chance that there might be identical races and races among the creatures of overlord races, then it was already very difficult to find completely similar races among totem-level creatures because they could automatically DIY and optimize their race’s bloodline.
For example, the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City evolved herself into a humanoid dragon girl through this ability.
The gem cat grinned. “No, the most important thing is to develop new skills.”
“What skill?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s a secret.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Is it very powerful?”
“It should be very powerful.” The gem cat was certain. After all, it could slack off.
Shi Yu nodded. “Then you develop it. After the development is successful, I’ll see if it’s powerful. If it’s powerful, it’s mine.”
Now, Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to replicate super skills, even if it was the cat’s Illusion Star Annihilation.
Although the Illusion Star Annihilation was very powerful and a rare multi-element super skill, not necessarily weaker than skills like the Interlocking Sword, or even much stronger, he didn’t replicate it. It did not have the novelty from before.
It was mainly difficult for non-racial skills to lead to an increase in growth level, and super skills were difficult. Therefore, unless it was super strong super skills like the Time Mark and Infinite Devour, Shi Yu still planned to prioritize increasing the racial skills of his pets. This could also better lead to an increase in growth level.
“We’re here.”
At this moment, they were getting closer and closer to land.
…
Although it was Shi Yu and the gem cat who courted death by bringing Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, and Qin Mingzhi to Hot Summer Island, and the three of them were almost involved in danger because of Shi Yu and the gem cat’s courting death, after experiencing this crisis, the three of them were completely convinced by Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s ginseng baby had shattered two overlords. Any one of the pets could resist the attack of the Vortex Demon Beast. He could even attract two totems to save himself. In addition, he had “cultivated” a totem-level gem cat. Without thinking, it knew that if it followed Shi Yu, it would definitely be able to eat well.
When Shi Yu got off the ship and prepared to return to Ping Cheng, Xiao Qin stood on the warship and nodded at Shi Yu. “Leave the modification of the Marine Environmental Protection Department base to me.”
“Please.” With that said, Shi Yu’s figure had already turned blurry. He was teleported back to Ping Cheng by the totem-level gem cat with Instant Transmission.
Once.
It only used Instant Transmission once.
In an instant, they crossed the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, which was even larger than Icefield City, and arrived at Ping Cheng, arriving at Shi Yu’s training villa.
This Instant Transmission efficiency simply made Shi Yu drool.
When could Buggy reach the totem level? This Instant Transmission was no different from the city’s teleportation array. It was too useful, ten thousand times better than before.
Totem level was beautiful.
“Aiya, I feel that it’s still much inferior to the Intercontinental Teleportation Formation of the Space Emperor. Annoying.” However, the gem cat beside him was very dissatisfied.
“Stop being dissatisfied,” Shi Yu said with the corners of his mouth twitching.
The reason why they were in a hurry to return this time was that Principal Feng had directly rushed over from the ancient capital and was waiting for them. They couldn’t let the old man wait too long.
Of course, the most important thing was still…
“Principal Feng, this time, there shouldn’t be a problem for me to be an official member of the first bureau, right?”
Seeing that Shi Yu and the others had finally returned, Principal Feng, who had been sitting at the stone table in the courtyard for a long time, finally got up happily. However, Shi Yu and the others’ next words just as they returned made Principal Feng speechless.
The requirement of an official member of the first bureau was to have the ability to command the totems in battle and solve the Dong Huang crisis together. Although Shi Yu and Ice Dragon were on good terms previously, it didn’t look like he could casually invite Ice Dragon to attack, but this time…
He looked at the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University who was eating and drinking with Shi Yu. No, it should be called Dong Huang’s guardian now. He was silent for a moment. In addition… the two totem dragon kings had gone to save Shi Yu together… and the Blue Sea Sprite in its growth stage… With this background, and even some other minor details, it could be ignored. It wasn’t impossible to enter the first bureau in advance.
“Shi Yu will be covered by me. Let him join,” the gem cat said generously.
It would be a waste not to take the resources of the first bureau.
At this moment, Principal Feng had many things to say, but when he saw Shi Yu and the others, he didn’t know where to start.
He should reprimand Shi Yu and the others for running around and going to dangerous places. The key was that their gains this time had reached a ridiculous level.
If he wanted to praise it, Principal Feng, who regarded Shi Yu as his own child, treated Shi Yu the same way he treated Lu Qingyi. He didn’t want to encourage his arrogance of going to dangerous places randomly.
In the end, Principal Feng only covered his forehead helplessly and said, “Your ginseng baby should have used the self-destruction effect of the Time Fruit and Moon Explosion together, right?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“As expected… But it can actually kill an overlord. I underestimated the power of this combination skill…” Principal Feng sighed.
Shi Yu and the gem cat : “…”
Perhaps he didn’t underestimate it, but sending the ginseng baby into someone else’s mouth before exploding… A Beast Tamer with a clean heart really couldn’t do this. This was much more powerful than directly self-destructing…
How could the effect of a forbidden weapon exploding beside someone be the same as exploding in his mouth?
“However, this move shouldn’t be able to be used in the short term, right?” Principal Feng said.
“Yes…” Shi Yu nodded. He didn’t know how long it would take Baby Ginseng to condense the next time mark, but it definitely wouldn’t take a year. It wouldn’t delay him from going to the World Tournament to blow up an overlord. In any case, he had already planned to obediently increase his points in Dong Huang within this year. He shouldn’t encounter any danger.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Great Harvest After Returning to Dong Huang (4)
“Then don’t run around anymore. Stay in Dong Huang obediently. Haven’t you already signed up to participate in the Sequence Tournament? Your ranking is pretty good. There are even legendary resources as a reward for the top few.” Principal Feng gave Shi Yu a thumbs up, not wanting him to run around anymore.
“What?! Legendary-level resource?!” Shi Yu was indeed affected when he heard that.
“After all, we’re going to compete with the totem country for the blessings of the World Tree. The country will definitely nurture the best of the contestants with all its resources. If we can obtain the blessings of the World Tree and give birth to a legendary Beast Tamer, even if we have to spend more than ten legendary resources, it’s worth it. For the world competition, the country can be said to have invested a lot.”
“Teacher Ying, don’t let Shi Yu run around anymore. Let him stay here obediently for a while.” Principal Feng smiled bitterly.
“I understand. Even if he wants to cause trouble, I won’t accompany him in the short term.” The gem cat smiled and said, “I’m going to enter seclusion to cultivate for a period of time.”
Shi Yu shrugged. It didn’t matter. As long as it didn’t forget the deal about its collection.
However, it still didn’t feel enough.
If he wanted Eleven and the others to achieve a perfect breakthrough in the future and become perfect overlords… It was still a little difficult. After all, the gem cat had saved up for a hundred years and only had enough money for one legendary resource.
And he currently had five pets…
It was probably difficult to rely on saving. He probably had to find other channels, such as the Sequence battle where he could freeload legendary resources.
“By the way, do you want to announce your battle results to the Sequence Competition Committee?” Principal Feng said to Shi Yu, “Actually, I suggest not. Or rather, even if it’s announced, it’s more troublesome overall. It’s better to use it as a trump card.”
“Huh?”
“Although the battle result of killing two overlords can allow you to enter the top five or even the top three of the Sequence, can you still replicate this battle result in the short term? Even if you can, can you easily use it in the Sequence battle?”
“Uh,” Shi Yu said. “It’s difficult…”
Firstly, there was no way to revive, and secondly, self-destruction was too fierce in a battle between his own people.
“At that time, when you reach the top five or top three, there will be countless challenges waiting for you. You might not be able to protect that position now. The Beast Tamers in that position all have true overlord-level battle power.”
“For example, although Gao Xuan can apply for a small forbidden weapon to use, such a weapon won’t be allowed to be used in the battle of the Sequences. Therefore, when he couldn’t create small forbidden weapons himself and use them as he pleased, this kind of battle result basically didn’t calculate the ranking of the battle of the Sequences. Therefore, his overall ranking is only 22. The situation of your ginseng baby’s battle result is actually very similar.”
“So my suggestion is not to announce it or announce it after you can control the corresponding strength ranking in the future.”
“The initial ranking of the Sequence Battle is out?” Shi Yu discovered the blind spot.
Principal Feng was stunned. “You still don’t know?”
Shi Yu: “…I really didn’t notice. Let me see.”
He quickly took out his cell phone and logged into the official website of the Sequence Battle. He checked the ranking and ignored the person in front. Soon, he found his position… 81st.
So low.
Shi Yu looked forward and indeed saw Gao Xuan on the 22nd and Xiao Qin on the 29th.
However, this ranking should have been calculated “long ago”. At that time, Chi Tong, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng had yet to break through to the monarch level. Now, Shi Yu estimated that he could easily get into the top 20.
It wasn’t impossible to get close to the top ten if he didn’t care about the consequences.
As for the top five, it indeed didn’t seem like it could be taken easily. The top four were actually legendary Beast Tamers with true overlord-level battle power!
Shi Yu immediately became serious. From the looks of it, it wasn’t that easy to obtain legendary-level resources from the Sequence battle.
After all, even if Baby Ginseng self-destructed, it couldn’t kill the Black Ape overlord in one go. Moreover, the Black Ape overlord was a wild overlord without a Beast Tamer.
“Then I’ll listen to you. We can fight our way up step by step,” Shi Yu said.
In fact, there was no need to deliberately fight. After the National League ended, they could strive to defeat Gao Xuan and almost get a high ranking.
“But Principal Feng, it’s not too much to distribute a legendary resource if it’s the first bureau, right?” Shi Yu suddenly said.
Principal Feng:!!!
“After all, even if there are ten legendary-level resources, they might not necessarily be able to nurture a totem.” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat and felt that it wasn’t too much for the members of the first bureau to be responsible for the battle power of the thirteen bureaus and distribute a legendary-level resource.
“I don’t think it’s too much either. It’s best if there are two. It’s not too much to obtain a legendary gem after becoming Dong Huang’s new guardian, right?” The gem cat also planned for its future. Breaking through to the totem level was to receive more wages!
The corners of Principal Feng’s mouth twitched. “It’s not a matter of whether it’s too much. It’s that the legendary resources in the country are all strategic resources. Every one of them has strict and necessary uses before they can be mobilized.”
“For example, fighting for the blessings of the World Tree.”
Shi Yu said, “Isn’t befriending the Blue Sea Sprite strategic enough?”
Principal Feng realized that he couldn’t argue with Shi Yu. He said, “Forget it, forget it. It’s not mine anyway. I’ll help you apply.”
It had to be said that with the things Shi Yu had created, the Iron-eating Beast Evolution Chain and the Green Silkworm cocoon Evolution Chain, creating a totem cat and befriending the Blue Sea Sprite, even Principal Feng felt that it didn’t seem too much to distribute a legendary-level resource to Shi Yu.
However, he would probably have to wait for approval for this kind of thing for a while. Recently, legendary-level resources were used everywhere and were very lacking.
“I don’t know about the situation of legendary resources, but there’s a level-eight resource. I reckon I can definitely help you apply for it.” Suddenly, Principal Feng thought of something.
“What?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Burning Gold.” Principal Feng smiled.
Burning Gold…
Shi Yu was stunned and couldn’t react for a moment. But soon, his expression gradually became rich.
“Burning Gold?”
“Burning Gold!”
Damn, he remembered. This was what Zhong Xuan had told him back then. The Iron-eating Beast needed one of the nine corresponding metals to carve the nine inscriptions!!
After coming out of the ruins of Emperor Wu, he had reported all nine metals, hoping to find them with the help of the association. This was because these metals were basically extremely rare types. They might not necessarily still exist in the modern era, and he could only rely on the power of the country.
After so long, he finally found a piece?
“Actually, Burning Gold was found a while ago in an ancient ruin, but compared to using it, it was the first to be studied. After all, this is the first time the association has discovered this metal. I don’t think they can figure out anything. Why don’t you come over and let your Iron-eating Beast use it?”
Shi Yu said, “Sure, sure, I like this!!”
Although it was called Burning Gold, according to Zhong Xuan, this was not a metal that could allow the Iron-eating Beast to awaken “metal and fire” super racial skills.
Burning Gold corresponded to the spiritual element.
Shi Yu instantly looked forward to it since it could allow the Iron-eating Beast to awaken new “metal and spirit” dual-element super racial skills. Unlike teaching skills, the more super racial skills there were, the better. After all, it could lead to growth.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Monarch Level Achieved
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Monarch Level Achieved
For the next period of time, Shi Yu chose to work overtime at home and fight the national competition.
“Ning, Ning, Ning.”
On this side, Susu couldn’t go to the Rainbow Islands to cleanse the heavily polluted Rainbow Sea. After returning, Susu felt very uncomfortable.
It was as if he had OCD and knew that a place in the house was very dirty, but he couldn’t clean it.
However, Susu was also very sensible. It knew that the Chaotic Sea was in danger now.
Therefore, it purified the Shi Yu family and the ruins ten times before calming down.
Susu: ε(┬┬_┬┬)3
It still wanted to go to the Rainbow Islands…
“Don’t worry, don’t worry.”
After Shi Yu rested, he said to Susu, “The Rainbow Sea is just a small fight. After the National League, I’ll take you to a place called the Undead Battlefield.”
“That place is filled with plagues and curses. It needs cleansing more than the Rainbow Sea. You definitely like it.”
Susu: (?????) Undead Battlefield?
It didn’t sound like a place in the world of the living. Great.
“Mi!!”
Chi Tong’s eyes also lit up as it applied to team up with Susu.
At that time, Susu would cleanse the plague and curses. It would “cleanse” those undead. A perfect partner!
“Alright, I’ll let you team up.”
Shi Yu chuckled.
Previously, he originally didn’t plan to go to the Undead Battlefield for the time being. After all, there was a sealed top-notch totem there. Chi Tong’s mother was very threatening.
However, wasn’t the gem cat at the totem level!
Why would he be afraid of a mere sealed Undying Dark Phoenix?
At that time, he would let the gem cat lead the team.
This place was a good place.
Chi Tong’s Spirit Release skill was currently at expert proficiency. If it wanted to advance to perfect proficiency, it still needed to kill an overlord-level undead and a hundred monarch-level undead.
At that time, Shi Yu planned to bring Chi Tong to the Undead Battlefield to level up and increase the proficiency of this super racial skill.
Even if it couldn’t reach perfect level, reaching expert level+10 wasn’t bad!
What?
There were no overlord-level undead in the Undead Battlefield? There weren’t enough high-level undead? Even if there were enough, they could hide too well, so they couldn’t be found?
Was that a problem? He would directly carry a basket of nutritional fruits and time fruits. He would give them something good to eat first, raise their levels, and then send them on their way. He would perfectly solve this problem.
Although he didn’t know if the level increase with the Time Fruit counted, it was definitely better than directly killing it.
At the same time, the Undead Battlefield was also a good place for Susu.
Not only could it train Chi Tong’s Spirit Release, but it could also train Susu’s Holy Water Ring.
Skill: Holy Water Ring
< Introduction > It’s a super water-type skill. It creates a resistance water ring. When affected by the abnormal state of its life form, it reduces the effect of the abnormal state and increases the effect of the water-type skill!
The Undead Battlefield was filled with plagues and curses from top-notch totems. It had been more than a thousand years and had yet to disappear. Compared to the Rainbow Islands, where the pollution had mostly dissipated in less than a hundred years, that place was much more dangerous.
If it went deep and stayed for a long time, even overlords would probably be affected. However, Susu definitely loved this environment.
Coupled with the Holy Water Ring and the max-level water-element cleansing skill, perhaps… it could really make a name for itself in the Undead Battlefield.
At the same time, in the Undead Battlefield, Susu and Chi Tong could also practice combination tactics from time to time and kill monarchs. This was simply a training treasure land customized for them.
Although he couldn’t train ruthlessly in the ruins space, there were still many good places in Dong Huang!
“At the moment, there’s no Beast Tamer in the country who can cleanse the dangerous land of the Undead Battlefield. If Susu can do it in the future, that would be a huge contribution.”
“Why don’t we start with the Undead Battlefield after the Dong Huang Environmental Protection Department is built…”
Shi Yu sighed. This was not a gift from the heavens…
In short, super skills were still difficult at the moment, so adding points and training still had to be carried out at the same time.
At the moment, there was still more than half a month until the National League. Shi Yu tightened his grip.
In the past half a month, he planned to devote all his energy to Susu.
As for Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, they had already reached the monarch level. Shi Yu made them stop their high-intensity battle training. After all, it was very difficult for the ruins space to withstand the continuous torment of monarch-level power.
Therefore, the training content of the four of them was still mainly to train their willpower and develop profundities.
It was to use Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit to return to the Awakening, transcendent, and commander levels to withstand various imagined extreme environments.
This training method was indispensable for their willpower to reach the mid-level so quickly.
…
Half a month later.
The Burning Gold that Principal Feng mentioned still hadn’t come, and there was still no news of the legendary resources. It would probably take a while to approve it. During this period of time, Shi Yu had already maxed out Susu’s pile of skills.
< Name > Susu (Mutated Water Slime, Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation)
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]:
Below super level (all max level): Multiplication, Bubble, Water Regeneration, Poison Resistance, Purification, Lightning Resistance, Boiling Water, Frozen Water, Water Tornado, Praying Rain, Steam Explosion, Protection Water
Super level: Holy Water Ring (Initiate), Water Element Control (Expert)
[Taught Skill]: Deterrence (transcendent), Absolute Sleep (transcendent), Infinite Devour (Proficient)
Energy Points: 4,290,000
After half a month of hard work, Susu’s growth level also reached the monarch level under Shi Yu’s additional points.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - Monarch Level Achieved (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Monarch Level Achieved (1)
Among them, all skills below super level were maxed out by Shi Yu.
Although there were no additional points for super skills, because he had added many low-level water-element skills to Water Element Control, under the lead of low-level skills, the proficiency of this super skill had also reached expert level.
As for the proficiency of Infinite Devour, it was increased by devouring the three gemstones and the nutritional supplements created by the ginseng babies in Dragon Palace City.
At that moment, Shi Yu’s team could be said to be very powerful.
Baby Ginseng, now Normal State 7.01 million energy points. Susu, Normal State 4.29 million energy points. Eleven, Normal State 4.11 million energy points. Chi Tong, Normal State 3.94 million energy points. Buggy, Normal State 3.81 million energy points.
All at the monarch level!
Moreover, every pet was very powerful. Just the energy value of the Normal State was enough to kill ordinary monarchs…
Apart from that, they also had a bunch of explosive skills…
For example, Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit.
For example, Susu could summon the water elements of the natural world through max-level rain prayer and store them in the Infinite Devouring Space to achieve a storage effect similar to Eleven’s Inner Power. With the control of the water elements, it had a huge reserve of energy.
This usage was even more ferocious on the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s side. He even raised tens of thousands of water-elemental lives in the Giant Leviathan’s body as a backup energy source… As expected of a Titled Legend that could fight totems.
Also, for example, Eleven’s Inner Power and army skills.
Or even the new profundity developed by Chi Tong, the Infinite Converging Sword. Through the perfect combination of clone and possession, it would possess itself and stack the power of countless clones on itself, erupting with super battle power.
For example, Buggy’s Dragon of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, Eleven, Susu, Chi Tong, Ice Dragon, and the gem cat phantom fighter.
They could all obtain battle power that exceeded their current state.
In this situation, Shi Yu looked at his 101st ranking in the Sequence Battle and was speechless.
After half a month, he directly fell 20 places.
It fell out of the top 100.
It wasn’t that Shi Yu had lost to anyone during this period.
Although a bunch of challengers had appeared behind the scenes of his Sequence Battle website and hundreds of challengers wanted to pinch him, a soft persimmon with unknown battle results… He felt that it was too troublesome and didn’t take any of their challenges.
Although there were resource rewards for winning, he didn’t fancy the ranking rewards that were too low. He planned to charge to the front in one go after working overtime.
Therefore, in half a month, as the contestants who were ranked behind him and the new contestants worked hard to advance their rankings… Shi Yu, who had never had a battle record, did not have enough basic points. His ranking quickly fell.
“If you don’t advance, you’ll fall behind.” Shi Yu muttered and stretched.
It wasn’t a big problem. The National League was in a few days. At that time, after crushing Gao Xuan, who was currently in 24th place, he could replace Gao Xuan.
During this period, Gao Xuan also lost two places. He should be working hard to prepare for the National League like him, so he ignored the Sequence Tournament.
Although he didn’t know what kind of special training Gao Xuan had done during this period, he had made sufficient preparations to fight Gao Xuan.
All at the monarch level!
If he took out any pet alone, it might not be inferior to Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
Moreover, among these pets, there could also be a combination of two, three, and four. In this situation, unless Gao Xuan really used a small forbidden weapon, Shi Yu believed that his chances of winning were relatively high, even if the other party contracted a few more pets at the last minute.
He was determined to get the level-eight mechanical material, the Hundred Transformations Stone.
During this period, apart from being at the monarch level, Shi Yu’s own physique naturally reached the current upper limit through continuous points.
As for his Beast Taming Space level, although it didn’t take much time to increase, because his pets broke through to the monarch level one after another, the feedback from his pets didn’t make the increase in his Beast Taming Space fall behind.
The feedback from these pets saved Shi Yu at least five years of cultivation.
However, although he had obtained many benefits, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space level was still a little far from level six.
Therefore, Shi Yu planned to quickly increase the level of his Beast Taming Space.
The World Tournament was imminent, but his Beast Taming Space was only level five. Even if he could add some super skills now, at that time, the level of the Beast Taming Space would become a burden to his pets again, preventing them from advancing to overlord.
Only at level seven could one contract an overlord-level pet.
At the moment, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space was only level five. It was still a distance away from level six. This gave Shi Yu a headache.
“Everyone, gather ~”
Looking at the time, Shi Yu summoned the five little pets training in the ruins space and planned to do the final training.
Soon, in front of Shi Yu, an angry panda covered in lightning, a butterfly flying out as it slept, a ginseng baby in a scholar hat, a red bird flying on a sword, and a limp water slime appeared.
Of course, in the ruins space, in a certain dragon ring, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon that had been raised was also jumping around, wanting to come out, but this was impossible.
“The National League is in a few days. It’s time to test the results.”
Gulp.
As Shi Yu lectured, the expressions of the pets gradually became fierce.
Charge, charge, charge!
“My requirements aren’t high either. At that time, apart from Gao Xuan, as long as you can each eliminate a contestant and all his pets alone, it’s good. It’d be a little bullying for us to attack together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - Monarch Level Achieved (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Monarch Level Achieved (2)
The pets’ expressions didn’t change.
“In addition, I reckon that you’ve been doing baby training for long enough during this period. Your bodies might have rusted, so before you participate in the National League, you should have a team ranking competition with each other first. Not in the form of a baby, but in the peak state of a monarch,” Shi Yu said with a smile as he touched his chin.
As soon as he finished speaking, the pets were immediately shocked. Why did Shi Yu still remember this?
“Wuu.” “Wuu!” “Ya.” “Mi.” “Ning.” In an instant, the five pets looked at each other.
They became afraid of each other.
Although they didn’t know everything, how could they not know the abnormal strength of their teammates?
This internal battle was probably even more bumpy than the next National League.
“Now that you’re all at the monarch level, apart from the super skills, the skills have basically been maxed out. It’s considered very fair. I won’t participate in the battle either. The rules this time don’t allow external equipment. You guys can do it yourself. Oh right, when the legendary resources of the first bureau are applied, the first place this time can obtain a legendary resource to use when breaking through to the overlord level.” Shi Yu smiled.
“At that time, I’ll prioritize choosing legendary resources that match the first place.”
“The legendary resource that allowed the gem cat to break through.”
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
As soon as he finished speaking, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng immediately separated and looked at each other hostilely.
Chi Tong and Susu were a little speechless.
“Mi!”
“Ning!”
Chi Tong and Susu stuck to each other. Good sisters, unmoved by benefits!
Compared to the other three who were very concerned about the ranking, the two of them seemed to be relatively “different”. However, even if they were more Buddhist, when they heard about legendary resources, their hearts were secretly moved…
They could give it a try!
Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were naturally competitive. Chi Tong and Susu looked relatively calm, but it was only on the surface.
One was the power reincarnation of a titled general who had resisted fate, while the other was a little guy with the will of an overlord. How could they admit defeat so easily?
Seeing that they were all so proactive, Shi Yu was also curious. What exactly was the team ranking like…
In terms of energy value alone, Baby Ginseng was the highest, but this was purely a matter of attribute allocation. Although its energy value was high, it was also the weakest among the five pets, even weaker than a normal worm. After all, it was a supplement race, specially made for humans to eat…
An ordinary monarch with 1 million energy points as an enemy, for example. Eleven’s body could withstand it just physically without being injured at all. Its physique was comparable to a dragon, but if it was a ginseng baby, no matter how weak the enemy skill was, its body would probably immediately shatter without using defensive skills.
After all, even Shi Yu could bite it.
If nothing went wrong, in the team battle, most of Baby Ginseng’s energy points would probably be used to repair its broken body and defend. Otherwise, the battle couldn’t continue at all. It would crack with a touch.
Of course, Baby Ginseng also had a trump card, the Time Fruit, but Eleven and the others knew the effect of the Time Fruit. They knew that this fruit had a time limit. The more it increased, the shorter the duration, and the stronger the side effects. Therefore, whether Baby Ginseng could defeat its opponent with the Time Fruit depended on the tactical arrangements.
If Baby Ginseng used the Time Fruit, Buggy would immediately teleport thousands of meters away and hide. Baby Ginseng would also be stunned. It would probably collapse from exhaustion before it could attack Buggy.
Among Shi Yu’s pets… Little Eleven’s electromagnetic levitation, Buggy’s Instant Transmission, and Chi Tong’s Light Flame Sword were all ridiculously fast. It was probably very difficult to deal with Baby Ginseng. After all, it was also at the bottom of the team in terms of speed.
In this situation, Shi Yu felt that it would be very interesting for the pets to decide the winner with their battle experience and battle awareness.
“You guys go back and prepare yourselves today. We’ll go to the snow mountain tomorrow and fight there.”
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!”
…
The next day.
Ice Fire Snow Mountain.
Shi Yu’s ruins space couldn’t withstand their torment now, so he could only choose this place.
According to Shi Yu’s understanding, his current ruin ring was still left behind by a level-seven legendary Beast Tamer in the Beast Taming Space.
If it was the ruins space of a titled legendary Beast Tamer, it might be more useful.
If it was a mythical Beast Tamer ruins space, that would be even better…
Of course, this was purely wishful thinking…
Somewhere in the snow mountain.
On the endless icy plain, Shi Yu and the others found a quiet place and stopped.
The cold wind blew, but the six guys were all energetic.
“The competition is a points system. You have to take turns fighting. At the moment, there are sufficient supplements, medicine, and resources in the ruins space. Don’t worry and fight.”
“We’ve fought in Dragon Palace City for three days and three nights. We can definitely do it this time.”
All the pets: !!!
Was that the same difficulty level?
Compared to the team internal competition, the national competition and the Dragon Palace City dungeon were all baby cups!
“Let me see the results of the draw…” Shi Yu held his cell phone and fell into deep thought. He used the small program he had downloaded in advance to input the names of the five pets and made the system randomize…
A moment later…
The system rolled to the name “Chi Tong”.
“Chi Tong.” Shi Yu flipped over his cell phone and showed them. Then, he said, “You’re the first to go on stage.”
“Mi!!” Chi Tong immediately became nervous. It was the first.
Who would the opponent be?
It had already researched targeting tactics against Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng!
He wondered if it would work!
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others also looked at Chi Tong cautiously. Although Chi Tong looked like it was aloof from worldly affairs, apart from Eleven, the other pets in the team didn’t have any way to defend against soul attacks. They were very afraid of the Soul Slash skill. Apart from that, Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence profundity… They were lucky to be able to even see its movement. This was the strongest possession profundity that relied on the clone skill to remove the external object!
This battle was not easy!
The pets took a deep breath.
Soon, Shi Yu’s little program rolled to the second name. When he saw this name, Shi Yu was stunned. Then, he flipped it over and let them take a look.
“Chi Tong’s opponent, Susu, you guys… carry out the first battle!”
Chi Tong: Mimi???
Chi Tong was also stunned. Susu?
It looked at the confused Water Slime.
At this moment, after Susu was at a loss, it quickly reacted and looked at its good sister firmly.
Great, it was water-element and countered fire-element. This wave was stable.
During this period, it had asked Baby Ginseng for guidance and had already memorized the attribute restraint table proficiently.
Sister Chi Tong… It apologized in its heart, but decided to take this fight.
“Ning!!”
As Susu bounced out, Chi Tong, who immediately sensed Susu’s aura, fell silent.
The backstabbing of sisters often happened in a moment.
This was a battle between best friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - Team Rankings
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Team Rankings
Ice Fire Snow Mountain.
The red bird spirit stepping on the spiritual sword and flying on the sword looked at the Water Slime on the icy plain in silence.
At the side, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were holding melon seeds and eating them. They looked at Shi Yu.
They suspected that there was an inside story.
“I like to see women fight… No.”
Shi Yu stood in the distance and looked at the battlefield fairly and impartially.
“There’s no inside story. It’s all random.”
“Friendship first, competition second, remember guys. First team competition, first battle, Chi Tong vs Susu. Are you all ready?”
“Ning!”
“Mi!”
The two pets immediately nodded, indicating that they were ready.
Friendship was second, competition was first! They understood!
In the blink of an eye, the battle began.
Boom.
A deafening sound immediately spread throughout the icy plain.
With a huge commotion, dark clouds instantly appeared in the sky.
