The heavy rain fell, and the sky was pitch-black. Amidst the rolling rain clouds, one could vaguely see the phantom of the Dragon King that could summon wind and rain.
The combination profundity of Water Dragon Ball and Praying Rain, Dragon Rain!
At this moment, the heavy rain was pouring. Every drop of water seemed to have been compressed into a water dragon. The strength of every drop of water was very hard, and the speed of every drop of water falling was extremely fast.
These water droplets were like bullets fired at high speed, falling indiscriminately towards the icy plain like a meteor shower.
Buggy: ╰(*°▽°*)╯ It’s Dragon King Spray!
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets pointed.
They didn’t expect that Susu, who had just finished adding points, had already started researching profundities.
This move seemed to be very fierce and had a large attack range, but it actually didn’t consume much energy.
It was mainly because it had borrowed the power of nature through rain prayer.
At the same time, as the surrounding water elements condensed, Susu could also use them again through the control of the water elements and Infinite Devour…
Chi Tong: Σ(°△°|||)_!!
Seeing Susu attack without warning, Chi Tong was immediately shocked.
However, it wasn’t an easy target.
This profundity that didn’t look very powerful was not worth mentioning. It could be broken easily.
Apart from Buggy’s Instant Transmission, Chi Tong was first in speed in Shi Yu’s team.
Even in terms of Instant Transmission, that worm was only faster in the short term. In terms of endurance, Chi Tong was still better.
High-level skill, Light Flame Sword!
Swoosh!
In an instant, Chi Tong used the Sun Flame skill that had been raised to the proficient level under the lead of the energy storage beam as energy to activate the max-level Light Flame Sword. It turned into an invisible sword light and attacked Susu’s main body.
This sword light was extremely fast. Even with Susu’s super vision, it was difficult to capture. Before the rain fell, Chi Tong was only a step away from Susu. The attack arrived instantly!
Splash!
Susu was shocked and couldn’t react at all. Fortunately, the automatic defense “Protection Water” skill saved it once, turning into a water screen to block the Light Flame Sword. But even so, violent energy fluctuations still erupted between the two parties, producing a huge explosion that sent Chi Tong and Susu flying together.
However, this kind of non-frontal aftershock damage could be ignored for Chi Tong, who had the “Flame of Regeneration”, and Susu, who had the “Water Regeneration”.
At the same time, countless raindrops completely descended. At this moment, Sun Flame lingered around Chi Tong’s body. Before the raindrops even touched Chi Tong, they all evaporated due to the high temperature. However, this didn’t make the rain ineffective. As the water droplets turned into high temperature, the water droplets immediately changed nature, turning into high temperature steam and then producing a “steam explosion”!
Boom!
In an instant, continuous explosions triggered beside Chi Tong. Seeing this, Susu revealed a happy expression, but in the next moment, its expression immediately changed.
“Mi! (So annoying!)”
Chi Tong temporarily ignored the damage and endured it to recover. At the same time, it separated countless sword spirits that filled the sun and circled in the sky.
Then, countless clones began to overlap through the possession skill.
The final profundity of possession and clone, Myriad Sword Convergence!
Boom!
After the ten thousand swords became one, a terrifying aura erupted from Chi Tong’s main body. The attributes of countless clones superimposed on him through the possession skill, immediately making Chi Tong’s strength reach an extremely terrifying level.
It swung its sword at the sky, and an incomparably fierce sword pressure was born from its body. Its aura spread in all directions, and countless sharp swords flew like a storm, filling the sky. The sword aura was like a net, incomparably fierce, and it was a spectacular sight. In an instant, the water droplets that filled the sky disappeared. A huge hole was broken through the dark clouds, and the Dragon King’s body swimming inside was divided into two.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s energy level was close to ten million.
Although they were all profundities, Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence was more powerful than Susu’s Dragon Rain!
The so-called combination profundity didn’t just depend on skill proficiency and skill level. It also depended on the effect of the skill combination!
Myriad Sword Convergence was clearly a super explosive skill.
Of course, Chi Tong couldn’t last long in this state. Taking advantage of the increasing burden, it directly activated the Light Flame Sword again and turned into a beam of sword light.
This time, the speed of the sword light was not only completely unable to be captured by Susu’s transcendent super vision, but it also didn’t even have time to automatically defend against the protective water.
The sword pierced Susu’s body. With a boom, Susu was shattered.
“Ning…” After the steam dissipated, circles appeared in Susu’s eyes. Its body was shattered like a fist and it fell asleep. At this moment, countless sword lights floated above Susu’s head, indicating that it could attack at any time. In the team competition, everyone knew everything. It was impossible to give it time to recover.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - Team Rankings (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Team Rankings (1)
After a moment of silence, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng looked at Chi Tong. This profundity was indeed strong.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “The first winner, Chi Tong!”
“Mi ~!!” In the sky, Chi Tong cried out in joy.
Great!
“Ning…” Susu was dizzy. It didn’t understand why it couldn’t defeat Chi Tong even though its attributes clearly countered Chi Tong. This didn’t make sense.
“Not bad on both sides. Continue to work hard next time.” Shi Yu smiled and shook his head. Susu’s battle experience was clearly insufficient.
Because it had been adding points recently, it didn’t have much time to train and develop powerful combination profundities on its own. Therefore, in terms of battle power, it was still a little inferior to Chi Tong and the others, who had specially trained with Eleven and the others and had their own customized profundities.
Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence and the advantage of the strongest speed in the team were indeed unsolvable, but if Susu combined all the skills that had just been upgraded into the corresponding profundity, it might not be impossible to fight.
In short, the future was promising. Susu’s next direction of improvement should be to develop stronger combination profundities that were more compatible with itself, just like Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong.
Soon, Susu was dragged down to eat fruits and rest. It looked at Chi Tong in the arena with tears in its eyes.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Then continue. The order of the ten battles has already been drawn. Chi Tong, come over and rest too. The next match will still be you.”
“Mi??? (You still say there’s no inside story?)”
“Don’t worry, the system really made it random.”
…
The second team civil war.
Chi Tong, who had recovered, fought Buggy!
Buggy didn’t dare to be sloppy, but it wasn’t afraid either. If there was anyone other than Shi Yu who knew every pet in the team the best, it would be Buggy.
When it trained Eleven and the others’ will, Buggy stole their phantom templates through dream stealing.
Although the phantom template was not as powerful as the main body, it could also allow Buggy to have a deep understanding of each teammate.
At the start of the battle, Chi Tong still used the same trick again, using a fast attack strategy and slashing with the Light Flame Sword.
“Mimi! (Phantom Sword Dance!)”
However, just because Susu couldn’t react didn’t mean that Buggy couldn’t.
The same super vision was currently being used by spiritual-type Buggy. The effect was definitely better than water-type Susu.
Buzz!
Buggy left the attack range of the other party’s skill through Instant Transmission.
“Roar!!!”
After dodging the attack, Buggy immediately entered the Dragon of Imagination state and obtained the various qualities of the dragon race. Its overall attributes immediately exceeded Chi Tong and transformed into a divine dragon body that wrapped around the butterfly’s body. It used its strongest profundity, Dragon Painting, to collide with Chi Tong.
Under the powerful attributes and acceleration of Psychic power, at this moment, Buggy’s profundity speed exceeded the Light Flame Sword, and its strength far exceeded Chi Tong.
As a blue light flashed in front of him, Chi Tong was forced into a helpless state. It could only continue to enter the Myriad Swords Convergence state, planning to use its stronger attributes to fight Buggy head-on.
Boom!
Chi Tong’s ten thousand swords overlapped again.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s strength and speed exceeded Buggy again as its profundities erupted. Of course, Chi Tong’s side effect was even greater.
The two erupted in succession, making Susu, who was watching the battle, widen its eyes. So strong, so strong…
Eleven and Baby Ginseng watched in silence, constantly gathering information and analyzing information…
As expected, Buggy, who had the finishing touch profundity, and Chi Tong, who was in the Myriad Sword Convergence, collided directly. A violent wave spread. Among them, Chi Tong had the advantage and pierced through the divine dragon!
However, at this moment, Buggy itself wasn’t injured at all, and the consumption wasn’t high either. This was because in the body of the divine dragon phantom, it directly activated the Concealment state and could ignore all non-spatial damage. As for Chi Tong, it didn’t have any way to crack the Concealment skill at all.
Therefore, it was basically equivalent to Buggy paying the greatest price with the smallest price.
“Mi!!!” As it suffered the backlash of the Myriad Sword Convergence and the direct damage of the finishing touch, Chi Tong looked at the worm that had entered concealment and shouted that it was cheating and cheating. Then, it quickly removed the possession.
“Wu ~” Buggy didn’t care so much. It continued to use the same trick and entered the Dragon of Imagination state to materialize the finishing touch. This time, Chi Tong had learned its lesson. It didn’t erupt with power stronger than Buggy. It just wanted to maintain a stalemate. It planned to rely on strong endurance to defeat Buggy.
Buggy: ?(?? ??)
Unfortunately, Buggy didn’t plan to fight head-on this time. Just as the two parties were about to collide, Buggy disappeared from this space with its skill, causing Chi Tong to miss. Obviously, Buggy teleported with its skill. Then, it instantly appeared from behind Chi Tong so that it wouldn’t exchange injuries with the other party. It smashed Chi Tong from the sky to the ground with a claw.
“Mi!!”
In terms of strategy, Buggy suppressed Chi Tong the whole time. Soon, the battle between the two was won by the tired Buggy without any suspense. Not only was its body tired, but its brain was also quite tired from constantly scheming against Chi Tong.
Everything was still within Shi Yu’s expectations for this battle.
This time, it was Chi Tong, who had been dragged back for emergency treatment, who looked at Buggy with tears in its eyes and anger.
“Ning.” Seeing that Sister Chi Tong, who had easily defeated her, was defeated, Susu was a little sad. It wasn’t that she felt pity for Chi Tong. Judging by comparisons, didn’t it mean that it was especially weak?

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - Team Rankings (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Team Rankings (2)
…
The third internal battle!
Buggy vs Eleven!
“Well, all the best.”
As Shi Yu announced the next name list with a smile, Buggy’s expression turned solemn.
“Wuu!” Eleven stared at Buggy, but its expression was relatively calm.
The little panda rubbed its fists, its eyes shining.
Come on.
Buggy, let me test your training results!
“…” Buggy was silent. It didn’t expect to fight the leader so quickly.
Could it… defeat the leader?
“Yiya…” Baby Ginseng’s expression also became serious. It wanted to know the outcome of this battle.
In its opinion, the two greatest threats to it were Eleven and Buggy.
“Mi.” “Ning.”
Chi Tong, who was resting, cheered for Eleven, hoping that it could beat up the sinister and cunning Buggy.
As for Susu, it fell silent. After constantly analyzing and thinking about it, it determined that it… might be at the bottom?
At the start of the battle.
Eleven erupted with all its strength.
It enlarged to more than ten meters and erupted with sharpness. Its energy level doubled.
At the same time, Buggy also conjured the Dragon God Valley through illusions and imagination… and created a geographical advantage.
But the next moment.
“Boom…”
When Buggy conjured it to strengthen its Imagination Domain, it was directly shattered by Eleven, who had evolved into a Nine Li Battle Beast and had grown more than ten meters tall.
Super skill, Space Quake!
It specialized in destroying spaces!
Boom.
Space completely shattered.
Buggy: (⊙?⊙)
A power that could topple mountains and overturn the seas transmitted to the surroundings, even making Buggy not dare to teleport or hide.
In front of Space Quake, these two skills were useless!
It could only maintain the Dragon of Imagination state and try to fight Eleven head-on.
However, Buggy’s strongest profundity, finishing touch, turned into a beam of light and hit Eleven. In the end, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and Chi Tong covered their mouths with tears.
Bang!!!
The divine dragon phantom seemed to have hit an unbreakable iron wall. There was only a sound and no crack. With a bang, Buggy was knocked dizzy by the opposite force and was picked up by Eleven, who continued to expand!
Even after entering the Dragon of Imagination state, facing Eleven, whose huge body was filled with Bean Bears and had entered the army formation impregnable state, Buggy actually couldn’t break through its defense!
Buggy: What the hell is this defense!!!
Buggy even suspected that even Chi Tong’s full-strength attack couldn’t break through Eleven’s army defense skill.
Boom.
In the next moment, lightning descended.
As expected, the Buggy that Eleven was holding was shattered by Eleven.
Seeing this, Chi Tong and Susu’s expressions were solemn to the extreme. Baby Ginseng was even more serious. However, its eruption was stronger than Buggy’s. It shouldn’t be a problem to shatter it.
“As expected of Eleven.” Shi Yu chuckled.
…
The fourth match, Susu vs Baby Ginseng!
The fourth battle list was finally announced. Susu went on stage out of fear.
In the face of this big boss who had destroyed two overlords, Susu felt that it was more threatening than Eleven.
It was mainly because the Time Fruit was too buggy. It could even increase battle power to the overlord level!
How could they fight!
Baby Ginseng: ( ?) ?) Calm down.
Although Susu was the little sister with overlord will, the overlord’s will was not battle power.
Otherwise, the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation wouldn’t have died countless times in three thousand years.
Only in life-and-death situations could the overlord’s will have a chance to display its effect, allowing the pet to erupt with potential or break through.
This kind of “peaceful” team competition was basically a blank slate.
In order to take care of the little sister who had just joined the team and didn’t know the dangers of the seniors in the team, Baby Ginseng didn’t even use the Time Fruit.
Boom.
As soon as it started, the icy plain beside Baby Ginseng cracked, and countless trees wrapped around its body.
Soon, Baby Ginseng’s figure disappeared and was swallowed by the huge tree.
In its place was a huge tree several meters tall, a huge tree with arms that were brown in color!
As soon as Baby Ginseng started, it used plant control and hardening to create a huge hard tree. It sneaked in and protected its main body.
After all, its main body was really weak. Perhaps it didn’t need to care too much about dealing with passers-by, but it was better to be safe against this group of teammates with full skills and explosive destructive power…
At this moment, seeing Baby Ginseng so sneaky, Susu was stunned.
Among plant-type pets, there were many pets with fast speed.
Baby Ginseng’s speed was already fast enough. Now that it saw Baby Ginseng in this state, it looked like it had completely given up on this idea and planned to defend completely.
Seeing this, Susu, who had just been ravaged by Chi Tong’s speed, relaxed.
But soon, it cried.
It really understood what was dangerous in the world.
Its various water-type skills attacked the target ginseng baby, but they didn’t cause any ripples at all. They were all sucked into the huge tree.
“Yiya!! (Anti-Susu Energy Fruit!)”
In the huge tree, Baby Ginseng controlled the huge tree to absorb the power of the water element and turn it into nutrients for the energy fruit on the tree.
This was the attribute restraint!
Boom.
Then, the huge tree’s hand threw the energy fruits that had been enhanced by the Moon Explosion at Susu.
Susu: …
…
“It’s been four matches.”
As Susu returned from its defeat again, Shi Yu looked at the array table.
At this moment, Susu was very depressed, because he had already lost two consecutive battles.
However, for Susu, who had the will of an overlord, these defeats would not only not have the opposite effect, but it would also greatly increase its competitiveness. It was a good thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - Team Rankings (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Team Rankings (3)
It couldn’t be helped. The team was just that cruel. Even the reincarnation of a powerful demigod like the Blue Sea Sprite couldn’t firmly take first place. Of course, at the moment, Susu had yet to accept the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance. After accepting it, who knew what the battle situation would turn into.
“Yiya!” Baby Ginseng was very excited after easily defeating the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
As for Eleven, Buggy, and the others, they were saying that Baby Ginseng was sinister.
What the hell was a fruit that could absorb water?
Although wood countered water, it couldn’t be done like this.
Water storage ginseng baby? How was the water element supposed to play with this?
“Yiya.” Baby Ginseng felt that Buggy, this spatial element, wasn’t qualified to say that it was sinister.
But this was also forced. It couldn’t be helped. The team was too complicated. It had to study the Anti-Buggy, Anti-Susu, Anti-Eleven, and Anti-Chi Tong energy Fruits.
“In the fifth round, Baby Ginseng, continue. Fight Eleven.”
Now, Shi Yu announced the fifth match.
Baby Ginseng: (`?д?′)
Eleven: (`?д?′)
Fifth match, Baby Ginseng vs Eleven!!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the surroundings immediately fell silent.
“Yi?”
“Wuu?”
This battle made all the pets’ expressions become serious.
With the Time Fruit, it could temporarily release an overlord attack. This was the ginseng baby that had once destroyed two overlords.
As for the team leader, Eleven… who was better?
Eleven had always been the spiritual leader of Buggy and Baby Ginseng, the goal they had always wanted to surpass.
Now that it had finally waited for the opportunity to officially collide with Eleven, Baby Ginseng took a deep breath.
It had finally come.
Come on!
“Yi! (Leader, this time, I want to win. The current me is already invincible!)”
“Wu wu wu! (In front of me, no one is invincible.)” Eleven’s gaze was firm.
The atmosphere on both sides was solemn to the extreme.
Buggy, Chi Tong, and Susu gulped.
After resting, Baby Ginseng and Eleven looked at each other on the icy plain.
“Yi! (Battle!)”
“Wu wu! (Fight!)”
At the start of the battle, boom, Baby Ginseng still used the same trick. It first created a huge tree to protect itself.
However, when Baby Ginseng reacted, it was directly stunned.
Eleven relied on the electromagnetic flying speed that was not inferior to Chi Tong’s Light Flame Sword to turn and run. It flew into the sky and instantly fled until only a black dot was left.
If it weren’t for the fact that Baby Ginseng also had super vision, it really couldn’t see.
Baby Ginseng on the ground: ???
What was going on?
Before Baby Ginseng could react, Eleven had already completed its eruption in the sky. It opened its arms and pulled away from Baby Ginseng. Countless electromagnetic cannons shot out from the sky.
It displayed a completely different battle style from when it fought Buggy.
Air firepower bombardment!
The electromagnetic acceleration was getting more and more satisfying. Eat my super electromagnetic cannon!
Baby Ginseng on the ground: ???
After locking onto the super vision, the hardening cannonball that was enchanted with the effect of lightning and tearing through the air was accelerated by Eleven’s electromagnetic power and shot at Baby Ginseng!!
Knowing that Baby Ginseng could explode very well, Eleven was very smart and didn’t enlarge its size into a target for Baby Ginseng.
Instead, it directly flew to a height that Baby Ginseng couldn’t reach and attacked.
From the sky, Eleven seemed to say: “If you have the ability, throw the fruit here. Throw it then. Let’s see if you throw it first or I’ll bombard it first.”
Ginseng Baby: w(?Д?)w
Leader, you’ve changed!
Didn’t it like to turn into a huge monster and crush things with brute force??
Boom.
What awaited the confused ginseng baby were endless electromagnetic cannons.
Of course, a ginseng baby with 7 million+ normal energy points was not to be trifled with.
After its expression changed, it immediately controlled countless hardening trees to resist.
Boom!
Countless trees rose.
However, countless giant trees still couldn’t withstand the bombardment of Eleven in its sharp state.
The destructive power of the Hardened Space Quake Cannon accelerated by the electromagnetic power was too strong.
As the sea of trees quickly collapsed, Baby Ginseng was forced to convert the power of the Time Fruit. However, it didn’t dare to do too much. It only raised its energy level to more than ten million. This way, it could still maintain it for a while. If it was raised to an overlord in an instant, it would probably fall with just one attack. If it couldn’t insta-kill Eleven, it would lose.
Next, Baby Ginseng could finally complete its defense. However, because Eleven had the right to control the airspace, it refused to get close to Baby Ginseng and kept a safe distance. Baby Ginseng could only be forced to defend. At this moment, the only move it could hit with was the storage beam. It couldn’t break through Eleven’s army defense skill at all. It was impregnable.
Eleven’s Bean Bear skill had already reached the proficient level under the lead of its clone. With so many Bean Bears summoned, it was impregnable. Even if Baby Ginseng’s attack power was higher than Eleven, it still couldn’t break through its defense. This was the power of army skills.
Soon, the battle between the two parties turned into a battle of attrition. Baby Ginseng had the Earth Chain and the Energy Storage Beam to recover. Eleven had the Energy Storage Lightning to recover its physical fitness with the use of Lightning Guiding. However, because of the venue, Baby Ginseng couldn’t recover its physical fitness with the Earth Chain on the icy plain. The Energy Storage Beam wanted to absorb the power of the sun, but because of the dark clouds attracted by Eleven’s Lightning Guiding skill, the sun was covered.
This also caused Baby Ginseng to be quickly worn down by Eleven.
Eleven, who didn’t follow the routine and changed its tactical style, had forced it into a corner.
“Yiya, yiya, yiya.” Baby Ginseng was furious. In the end, Baby Ginseng gambled everything and decided to activate the power of the Time Fruit to a greater extent, raising its strength to the overlord level and unleashing the overlord attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - Team Rankings (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Team Rankings (4)
Splash.
A huge amount of energy began to increase in Baby Ginseng’s body. 20 million, 30 million…
At the commander level, the price to increase to the overlord level was death. But now that Baby Ginseng had broken through to the monarch level and advanced to the overlord level, the side effects were much smaller. It could almost let it launch an overlord attack. It was just exhausting, and its life wouldn’t be in danger.
Baby Ginseng was confident that it could shatter impregnable and instantly kill Eleven with an overlord attack.
“Yi!! (I’m invincible!!)”
However, Baby Ginseng didn’t know that Eleven had been locking onto it through its super vision the whole time. When the energy in Baby Ginseng’s body began to increase violently, Eleven discovered the problem at a glance.
“Wu wu wu! (Whoever claims to be invincible can’t lose.)”
Then, it turned and ran, leaving Baby Ginseng, who had just increased its strength, behind. It couldn’t find its target and fell into deep thought.
Baby Ginseng: ???
As expected, the outcome of this battle was Eleven using the kite strategy to successfully drag Baby Ginseng into the water and let it rely on the side effects of the Time Fruit to tire itself out.
It was very strong, but Eleven won’t fight it. In any case, there’s no venue area restriction. With Baby Ginseng’s Leaf Wings, even if it was at the overlord level, it couldn’t possibly catch up to Eleven, who had shot out its electromagnetic attack.
“In the fifth match, Eleven wins,” Shi Yu announced after a moment of silence.
Ginseng Baby: @. @
Eleven: (.?ˇ?ˇ?)I know tactics too.
Chi Tong and Buggy: !!!
This didn’t look like their leader!!!
Susu also opened its mouth wide. Everything was obvious.
Shi Yu sighed. Although Eleven liked to be reckless, it wasn’t stupid. Fighting it head-on was for when it was fighting a weakling. Who was willing to fight the self-destruct ginseng head-on?
“Continue, continue. Ahem, why don’t we limit the area of the venue in the next meeting?”
The unconscious Baby Ginseng raised its hands in agreement.
Buggy, on the other hand, expressed that it was best to update the equipment system! Chi Tong also agreed on this. It could also possess equipment, and that Ice Dragon Blade was pretty good.
Susu, on the other hand, expressed that it was best to change the venue… to the ocean battlefield…
For a moment, the pets discussed.
…
About a day later, five more battles occurred.
A total of ten battles ended, and the first team meeting ended successfully.
The final ranking, from weak to strong, was as follows.
Fifth place, Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation, Susu.
First, it was destroyed in the sister bureau with Chi Tong, and then it was countered by Baby Ginseng’s anti-Susu energy fruit.
Then, the Buggy they encountered was even more unreasonable. Buggy directly conjured the ginseng treasure artifact and teleported to Susu’s side. Susu wasn’t fast, and its defense wasn’t strong. It was shattered without any resistance.
It was countered by Baby Ginseng again.
As for the battle with Eleven… Although Susu had max-level lightning resistance, Eleven’s main attribute was metal. The outcome was self-evident. It was suppressed and shattered by a huge palm.
It couldn’t be helped. Even if Eleven didn’t take the initiative to attack and stood there for Susu to hit… As long as it activated the army skill, Susu might not necessarily win.
In Shi Yu’s team, under the solo rules, only Baby Ginseng could break through Eleven’s army defense skill with the Time Fruit. In this situation, Susu was helpless.
After the meeting ended, Susu was completely depressed.
If it was at the bottom of the team internal competition, how could it protect the sea?
Shi Yu’s evaluation was: “All the best. Even if we wait until you’re so strong that you could protect the sea, you still might not necessarily be the champion of the team internal competition.”
Susu: “?”
Human language?
Fourth place, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit, Chi Tong.
It only defeated Susu.
Then, it was first tortured by Buggy with spatial torture and lost. Then, it encountered Baby Ginseng.
In the beginning, Chi Tong also wanted to learn Eleven’s kiting strategy to defeat Baby Ginseng, not to mention that it countered Baby Ginseng.
However, Chi Tong’s endurance, attack power, and defense were clearly not as strong as Eleven’s. Eleven was pretty much strong without any shortcomings. This also caused Chi Tong to directly let Baby Ginseng’s energy storage beam shoot it down and shatter while trying to learn Eleven’s strategy.
In the end, Chi Tong was speechless when it encountered Eleven.
After failing to break through its defense a few times, it was directly suppressed.
Next was Baby Ginseng.
Although Baby Ginseng was invincible, apart from defeating Chi Tong and Susu, it still couldn’t defeat Eleven and Buggy.
Of course, it didn’t lose to Buggy.
Both parties fought a draw, and there was no winner or loser. After fighting for three hours without a winner, Shi Yu shouted for a draw.
Buggy’s strategy was similar to Eleven.
It couldn’t be helped. This was the best strategy to deal with Baby Ginseng, who couldn’t fly and wasn’t good at aerial battles.
Although Baby Ginseng had accumulated the power of mutation of the spatial element through the mutated fruit skill in advance and could create the “Anti-Buggy Energy Fruit” at any time, in the face of the worm that was unwilling to fight head-on and hiding in the sky, it didn’t have any effective means to shoot the fruit at all. Even if it threw it with a tree branch, it couldn’t throw it high or fast at all. It could easily be dodged by teleportation.
The only storage beam that could attack the sky was also countered by Concealment. It was similar to facing Eleven’s impregnable situation.
However, Buggy couldn’t do anything to Baby Ginseng. In the face of Baby Ginseng, who didn’t go far enough to disable itself by using its trump card to go to the overlord level, it didn’t have very good attack methods. It conjured Eleven, conjured an ice dragon, and conjured Baby Ginseng’s bomb to instantly teleport to the side of Baby Ginseng’s main body. They were all broken by Baby Ginseng one by one. After all, what it conjured was definitely not as strong as the main body. Even if Baby Ginseng’s phantom self-destructed, it couldn’t blow up Baby Ginseng, who had used part of the power of the Time Fruit to increase its energy level to ten million and had endurance.
The two of them fought stubbornly for three hours, hoping to get second place and not become third.
If this continued, perhaps a winner could be decided, but when Shi Yu got tired of watching, he directly shouted for it to stop…
…
The next night, the moon was bright and the stars were sparse.
As the team meeting completely ended, every pet was somewhat unwilling.
Team rankings: Eleven, Buggy/Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu.
Even Eleven, who had gotten first place, was a little regretful because it felt that it had won dishonorably. Buggy and Baby Ginseng were both in second place. If it could also crush Baby Ginseng head-on like when fighting Buggy, it would be perfect.
Fortunately, there was no restriction on the range of the venue this time. Otherwise, it and Buggy would probably be shattered by Baby Ginseng.
As the pet with the most comprehensive attributes and the most super racial skills in Shi Yu’s team, Eleven deserved to be first. It had a powerful physique, sufficient endurance, army defense skills that no one could break through, and metal and lightning were all powerful attack attributes. The distribution was almost perfect.
On the other hand, Buggy relied on its understanding of every teammate and defeated and tied the other teammates with the weakest racial attributes and powerful racial skills and tactical arrangements.
Buggy was indeed not easy. If one ignored the increase brought by the active skill and purely divided vitality, energy value, and physique into three dimensions of the pet’s racial attributes, Eleven’s three dimensions should be vitality (medium), energy (medium), and physique (extremely high).
Chi Tong and Susu’s three dimensions were vitality (high), energy (medium), and physique (medium).
Baby Ginseng’s three-dimensions were vitality (extremely high), energy value (extremely high), physique (extremely low).
As for the three-dimensional aspect of Buggy, it was vitality (extremely low), energy value (medium), physique (extremely low). It looked pretty sad.
Therefore, it was really not easy for Buggy to reach this stage. It was all thanks to the strangeness of the spatial element and the fact that its spatial skill was not as big a side effect as Baby Ginseng’s time skill.
Although it might not be able to defeat Baby Ginseng if the venue was limited, Buggy had yet to bring any equipment. If it could bring a level-eight and level-nine dragon-element resource, its increase might not be any smaller than the Time Fruit. After all, the Time Fruit was a high-level skill. Without the potential of a Mythical race, the upper limit of its increase was to increase the pet’s strength to the overlord level.
Shi Yu was not surprised that Baby Ginseng, which had the highest racial attribute, was ranked second.
Its attributes were really strong.
Unfortunately, without teaching skills, apart from Moon Explosion, none of its racial skills were attack skills. This was also the price of having strong racial attributes.
“A bunch of crazy little guys.”
After the team internal competition, Shi Yu began to bring them down the mountain. Next, it was time to go to the national competition to see the situation.
With the current strength of this team, although it was still difficult for the world competition where the threshold to participate was the ability to fight overlords… It would still be courting death if they went. However, in the national competition, they should be able to kill them, right? It was like playing the baby cup… It could be said that this team internal competition was a warm-up for the national competition. He hoped that everything would go smoothly!

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - Eleven’s New Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Eleven’s New Skill
After the team internal competition, Shi Yu returned.
After finally winning the team competition, Eleven stopped training and kept hanging around Shi Yu, acting cute.
Shi Yu didn’t go easy either. He squeezed for a long time.
It had to be said that after getting used to pinching Susu recently, petting a panda again had a different flavor.
Eleven: (?????)
“Wu wu wu.”
Eleven’s thoughts were completely seen through by Shi Yu.
It meant that when could the rewards of the team competition be received?
Wasn’t it working so hard to win the team internal competition precisely for the legendary resources!
This was a good question.
Shi Yu also wanted to know.
Coincidentally, at this moment, Shi Yu’s phone rang.
It was Principal Feng.
Shi Yu placed Eleven on his shoulder and picked up the phone.
“Principal Feng.”
“Shi Yu.” Principal Feng’s voice came from the other side.
“Do you remember what we talked about last time?”
Shi Yu was stunned and turned to look at Eleven.
It was here!
Whether Eleven’s legendary resources could be transferred depended on what Principal Feng said next.
If it succeeded, he would have resources.
If it failed, he could only think of other ways later.
“Burning Gold has already been sent to me. Are you coming to the ancient capital, or will I give it to you in two days when we go to Demon Capital?”
This year’s National League was held in Demon Capital. It was about to begin. In two days, the teams from Ancient Capital University would head to Demon Capital.
Shi Yu would naturally participate in the competition in Demon Capital.
“Well, I’ll go to the ancient capital. When the time comes, I’ll go to Demon Capital with the school team,” Shi Yu said.
“By the way, Principal Feng, what about the legendary resources?”
Burning Gold!
This metal could allow Eleven to carve a new inscription and awaken a new racial skill.
Of course, Shi Yu was also looking forward to this, but legendary resources couldn’t be lacking.
He had spent all his money on buying evolution-type resources. Although evolution-type resources were the most cost-effective, and once they evolved, they could increase the potential of the pets in all aspects, now, every pet of Shi Yu had almost evolved to the end. It was very difficult to go further, so the cost-effective ratio of strengthening-type resources was obvious.
Especially legendary resources. This kind of resource was something that had to be fought over, be it for monarchs, overlords, or totems.
If it could allow a monarch to perfectly strengthen to the overlord level, it could allow the overlord level to have a chance to strengthen to the totem level. It could even allow the totem level to take another step forward, saving countless years of bitter cultivation.
It was normal for a totem-level resource to be difficult to approve.
“I knew you would ask this.” Principal Feng chuckled and said, “From the current approval progress, there’s basically no problem. The chances are still very high.”
“The difficulty now is not whether you’re qualified to obtain legendary-level resources, but that you’re only at the master level. Isn’t it too early to hold legendary-level resources? Whether you can perfectly use the value of legendary-level resources is the problem the association is worried about now.”
“By the way, tell me your request for legendary resources.”
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu chuckled and realized that it was stable. He said, “Metal.”
“It’s best if it’s a metal-element strengthening resource that can strengthen vitality and energy points.”
“I understand.” Principal Feng nodded. He knew that it was prepared for Eleven again.
For a life form like the Nine Li Battle Beast, there were actually no shortcomings in its three-dimensions, but it wasn’t impossible to continue strengthening it.
Their physiques were comparable to dragons, almost the top of all pets.
Therefore, it was very difficult to continue strengthening the physique.
However, in terms of racial vitality and racial energy, the Nine Li Battle Beast still needed to be improved.
Life force determined the pet’s lifespan and self-healing ability, the recovery effect after being treated, and its growth potential.
Under normal circumstances, in a battle where their battle power was about the same, the stronger the life force of the pet, the higher the chances of survival and victory.
Even with an incomparably strong will, it was very difficult for a miracle to happen without the support of life force.
And energy value represented how much energy the pet’s body could withstand.
Although some pets could use the power of nature to fight, and the energy value was no longer that important to them, the more energy their bodies could withstand, the more benefits there would definitely be. After all, the power of nature relied on the environment too much.
Just like Susu and Baby Ginseng this time, because they were fighting on the icy plain, their battle power couldn’t be perfectly displayed.
If it were a battle in the deep sea, Shi Yu’s other pets would probably go crazy apart from Buggy, but Susu would definitely be like a fish in water.
If it were a battle in a forest with rich earth power, with Baby Ginseng’s endurance, even if it couldn’t hit Eleven, it might not be afraid of Eleven. Everyone would drag it out for ten days and ten nights.
Of course, a place like the Icefield was definitely not the best place for Chi Tong and Eleven to fight or anything. Everyone was more or less on the same terms.
Only Buggy could ignore the adverse effects of various environments because of the power of imagination.
From this view, Buggy was still powerful.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s idea was that Eleven was already very perfect in terms of physique. Therefore, the next legendary resources were inferior to strengthening Eleven’s life and energy racial values. This way, it could become even more flawless.
“Alright, I’ll try to help you apply for suitable resources,” Principal Feng said.
“No hurry, no hurry. Take your time.” Shi Yu was satisfied.
This was indeed not urgent, because the worries of the higher-ups were reasonable. Even if he was given legendary-level resources now, he wouldn’t need them. He was just collecting them in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - Eleven’s New Skill (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Eleven’s New Skill (1)
If he really had the ability to use legendary-level resources, he had to at least reach level seven in the Beast Taming Space. Otherwise, if he gave Eleven legendary-level resources now, he could indeed break through to overlord, but he couldn’t withstand it.
Moreover, if Shi Yu wanted to nurture a perfect overlord, he had to pull their super skills to perfection in advance.
“Well, by the way, is the construction of the Marine Environmental Protection Department smooth?” Principal Feng asked.
“It’s very smooth. The Silver Sea Battleship already has the prototype of a sea base. General Xiao Qin is still powerful,” Shi Yu said.
In the past half a month, although he didn’t go there often to take a look, he could still discover the huge changes in the silver sea battleship only occasionally.
“That’s good. Their family is indeed very powerful. Her sister and her mother are both very powerful Mechanics. Haha.” Principal Feng smiled and said, “Speaking of which, the special guest of this year’s National League is General Xiao Qin’s sister.”
“Legendary Mechanic… Xiao Shuang?” Shi Yu was stunned.
Xiao Shuang should be in her thirties or forties now. She was a super genius of the previous generation. Shi Yu’s greatest impression of her should be that she had a huge dark-element mecha made of the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core!! She was very handsome.
“Yes, she’ll be the one handing the prize this year.”
Shi Yu was amused. “Oh, oh.”
Not bad.
He hoped that at that time, with his relationship with General Xiao Qin, he could touch the other party’s mecha and replicate some powerful mechanical skills in advance. This would also save him the trouble of not knowing how to nurture mechanical pets after obtaining the Hundred Transformations Stone.
“I went off topic, ahem,” Principal Feng said. “I wanted to tell you just now that Dragon Palace City has invested a lot of resources in the Marine Environmental Protection Department, right?”
“On Dong Huang’s side, apart from investing in a base and a few talents, we will also invest some resources in the future. What do you think is more suitable?”
If Shi Yu didn’t mention legendary-level resources himself, Dong Huang wouldn’t have been in a hurry to give them. Then, even if Shi Yu didn’t want the Environmental Protection Department’s investment, Dong Huang would still give it away desperately.
Rather than investing in Shi Yu, it was more like investing in the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
If you didn’t treat the child well when it was young, don’t blame the child for not being close to you when it grew up.
Dragon Palace City invested and sent beasts. When it came to Dong Huang, there was nothing. There was no need to talk about befriending the Blue Sea Sprite.
“Then let’s start with cultivation resources, cultivation resources for the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. They’re mainly some high-quality cultivation water-type resources below level eight.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“Well, apart from resources, the association seems to be preparing to open a few top-notch water-element pet cultivation venues to you. I’ll send you the information later.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
“That’s all I have to say. And about the National League… Well, you, come and see. If you can get first place, that would be best.”
On the other hand, Principal Feng had a strange expression. Initially, when Shi Yu wanted the reward for first place in the National League, he felt that there was not much hope.
After all, last time, Shi Yu didn’t have a monarch-level pet, and Gao Xuan had been a super genius famous outside a long time ago.
In this situation, he felt that it was normal for Shi Yu to have little hope.
However, who knew that Shi Yu would go to Dragon Palace City and cause such a huge commotion? Not only did Eleven break through to the monarch level, but after breaking through, it could even suppress the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince!
Apart from that, Baby Ginseng even blew up two overlords, making Principal Feng understand the potential of the Time Fruit again.
Although he couldn’t achieve that kind of power again, it shouldn’t be a problem to unleash a move that was the level of an overlord attack, right?
Now, according to his understanding, every pet of Shi Yu had already reached the monarch level. In this situation, if Gao Xuan didn’t contract a new pet for this National League, then Gao Xuan definitely didn’t have the ability to fight Shi Yu.
There were clearly many contract positions, but he only contracted one pet. It was Gao Xuan’s greatest weakness previously, but it was also his greatest trump card.
If Gao Xuan chose to empty the contract slot and contract the equipment to strengthen the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, his strength would probably increase.
After knowing Shi Yu’s strength, Imperial Capital University and the fourth bureau would definitely help Gao Xuan with all their might during this period.
Therefore, at the moment, Principal Feng had a lot of expectations for Shi Yu, but he didn’t dare to have too much expectations. In short, if he could get first place, that would still be very good. After all, the National League determined a portion of the annual education funds, but if he couldn’t get first place, second place wasn’t bad either. In any case, he was satisfied.
“Don’t worry, leave it to me.” Shi Yu nodded. “I’ll return to the ancient capital tomorrow.”
It was time for the Iron-eating Beast Knight to reappear.
…
The end of this year could be said to be quite lively.
Not only was the National League in December worth looking forward to, but the National Professional Examination in January next year was also a hot topic.
In addition, the recent popularity of the Sequence battle that swept through the country made the current Beast Tamer domain filled with vitality.
“Hu…”
In the sky above the icy plain flying to the ancient capital, two people were sitting on each of the two white divine dragons.
Both of them were wearing panda suits. The difference was that the young man was wearing black pants, while the girl was wearing a black short skirt with a panda tail decoration, apart from a loose white short-sleeved shirt.
“Are you used to it?”
Shi Yu asked Lin Xiuzhu beside him.
“It’s very exciting.” Senior Panda sat on the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City conjured by Buggy and looked ahead with a red face.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - Eleven’s New Skill (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Eleven’s New Skill (2)
This time, from the icy plain to the ancient capital, Shi Yu did not choose to take a plane. Instead, like before, he directly passed through the wild area.
Lin Xiuzhu was also going to the ancient capital with him this time. In Lin Xiuzhu’s words, he couldn’t miss the opportunity to promote the Iron-eating Beast and Green Silkworm package to the contestants who lost the National League.
After this competition ended, the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm would definitely welcome another wave of enthusiasm.
After personally witnessing Eleven’s evolution and knowing that Eleven had millions of energy points, Lin Xiuzhu was quite confident in Shi Yu’s strength.
Moreover, during Eleven’s cultivation process, she had also participated in the childhood breeding stage and the awakening of the royal bloodline stage. She had even greater expectations for where Eleven could go in the National League this time.
Soon after.
The two of them directly passed through the wild area and arrived at the mountain range cleared by Ancient Capital University for students to train in. They entered Ancient Capital University from here.
“Damn.”
“F*ck, what’s this?”
The students from Ancient Capital University who were training and training in the mountain range looked at the two white divine dragons flying past in the sky and widened their eyes in unison, looking like they had seen a ghost.
After arriving at Ancient Capital University, Lin Xiuzhu chose to see her teacher and the three little Iron-eating Beasts of the Iron-eating Beast Research Institute. Now, these three Iron-eating Beasts with the “thought seal” had already become the “school mascot” of Ancient Capital University. Although they had yet to become national treasures, they had become the “school treasure” of Ancient Capital University first.
Ancient Capital University had already confirmed that they wouldn’t give these three Iron-eating Beasts to students or let them contract them. With the resources of Ancient Capital University, they had raised them for their entire lives. Just like how Ancient Capital University raised a bunch of cats a hundred years ago, they were purely used as the school’s symbol.
Moreover, who said pandas weren’t cats? They had the same word in Chinese characters.
It was also an old tradition of Ancient Capital University.
It was mainly because these three pandas were very self-disciplined. They trained themselves every day and led the way. Even the iron-eating beasts worked so hard, so why wouldn’t the students work hard?
Initially, the beast-eared girl wanted to contract one of the three, but later on, she changed her mind. She planned to wait for a royal Iron-eating Beast. A royal like Eleven had already found a way to help the royal Iron-eating Beast awaken its bloodline. In the future, the royal Iron-eating Beasts should appear one after another.
On this point, White Brook had long made an appointment with Lin Xiuzhu. Even Senior Lu had made an appointment with Lin Xiuzhu for a royal Iron-eating Beast.
…
In Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu first found Principal Feng and asked him for the gold.
Then, he went to look for the gem cat.
The reason why he didn’t go to Demon Capital directly and came to the ancient capital first was because Shi Yu planned to receive the gem cat’s treasure vault.
After returning last time, the gem cat directly returned to Ancient Capital University to enter seclusion. Shi Yu suspected that it was hiding from him.
However, it couldn’t hide forever. He had seen the gem cat’s treasure vault resource list. They had agreed that not a single resource could be lacking…
Although those resources couldn’t compare to a legendary resource, nor could they compare to half of it, it was probably not a problem to sell them for billions.
At that time, Shi Yu planned to use this money to strengthen his pets first.
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, the gem cat still had a level-eight pearl that sealed the overlord soul of the Undying Race. He wondered if he could unseal it and let Chi Tong slash it. It could be considered half an overlord-level undead, right?
There was also a pile of gems, pearls, and jade. From the gem cat’s collection of the Dragon God and Dragon Pearl, one could tell how rich it was. It was like a rich cat. As expected of the richest overlord of Dong Huang this year.
“Where’s your main body?”
In the resource area of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu stared at the gem cat clone and asked.
“Forget it, it’s the same for the clone. Bring me all the resources first.”
Gem Cat Clone: (?▽?)
“Meow. (I’m just a clone. What resources? My main body didn’t tell me.)”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Then do you know where it is? Call it over.”
Gem Cat Clone: (?▽?)
“Meow. (I’m not sure, but I’ll contact you immediately after I find it.)”
Shi Yu left. He suspected that the gem cat was hiding from him.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. In any case, the gem fruits the gem cat took away weren’t enough to eat for long. When it was hungry, it would definitely come out…
“Let’s go back to the dormitory first…”
Shi Yu took the gold and ran to the dormitory. Ignoring everything else, he wanted to see what skills this metal could awaken for Eleven!!
…
In Shi Yu’s student dormitory.
He didn’t seem to have returned for a long time.
Shi Yu originally wanted to let Buggy out to clean up first, but after thinking about it, he let Susu out.
The room after its purification, along with the air, was fresh. Some of the harmful substances in the house would also disappear more completely. Therefore, some renovation companies liked to contract some pets with cleansing abilities. The service was right.
Susu: ヽ(`⌒ ?メ)ノ Leave it to me! It’s spotless!
After contracting Susu, Buggy might become the greatest winner, not Chi Tong.
“Good child!”
After arranging the mission for Susu, Shi Yu began to head to the ruins space and pulled Eleven to strengthen it.
On the wide training ground outside Eleven’s exclusive training room, Eleven looked at the Burning Metal in Shi Yu’s hand excitedly.
This was a special metal the size of a fist. It was very irregular and contained blue fire patterns, as if the entire metal was about to burn!

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Eleven’s New Skill (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Eleven’s New Skill (3)
At first glance, it really looked like a special fire-element metal.
However, in fact, according to the research results of the third bureau, this metal was a level-eight special metal that could effectively strengthen the mind.
Even if it wasn’t used for the iron-eating beast’s evolution, it still contained special energy radiation that could “burn” the spiritual will of life forms, surging with huge battle intent.
Of course, this burning had nothing to do with flames. It was just a metaphor.
“It seems that after you break the record for the testing platform in Emperor Wu’s ruins, the reward is this Burning Gold… Unfortunately, Zhong Xuan said that the Burning Gold there was taken away by an ancient general. Now, I can be considered to have made up for the regret.” Shi Yu smiled and threw the Burning Gold to the eager Eleven.
“An evolution-type resource that can make spiritual will burn… I wonder if it can allow Eleven to break through in terms of will…” As Shi Yu was thinking, Eleven had already eaten the burning gold excitedly.
Boom!!!
Right on the heels of that, Eleven’s eyes flashed. The substantialized blue deterrence aura slowly filled its body, causing its aura to climb steadily.
“Wuu!!!” Because it had already had experience carving inscriptions the previous few times, it was very proficient this time.
It quickly carved the corresponding inscription and began to receive the power of the auric flame to transform it into potential through the digestion ability brought by the inscription!
Squeak…
Eleven hardened the sharp claws of its right hand and began to slowly scratch its body.
Then, under Shi Yu’s nervous gaze, white light began to linger on Eleven’s body!
At this moment, Eleven was very excited because it immediately felt an even faster increase in strength!
“Wuu!!”
Eleven roared and its body was completely wrapped in white light. At the same time, the index in front of Shi Yu quickly displayed Eleven’s growth changes.
Energy Points: 4,620,000
It didn’t increase much because Burning Gold wasn’t a traditional strengthening-type resource. The increase in various aspects of the pet wasn’t much. It only symbolically increased Eleven’s mental strength. Otherwise, if it were other level-eight strengthening-type resources, Eleven’s strength could still be strengthened more.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t expect this either. He looked forward to Eleven’s new skill more!
Could it be helpful in practicing the overlord’s will?
Back then, Zhong Xuan left quickly and he couldn’t ask in advance what the super skills of the iron-eating beasts were. It was his greatest regret.
Soon, the white light and deterrence power on Eleven’s body gradually converged during this process. At the same time, Shi Yu instantly knew the information of this new skill through the mental connection between the Beast Tamer and his pet!
Skill: Impregnable
[Attributes]: Metal, Spirit
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > When in a near-death situation, you can erupt with power that exceeds the limit and is unstoppable according to the strength of your spiritual will.
Shi Yu: “Huh???”
Damn, I want a skill that’s helpful in mastering the overlord’s will. I didn’t let you awaken a skill with an effect similar to the overlord’s will. Is this transforming the overlord’s will from passive to active??
“Wuu!!!” At this moment, Eleven’s eyes lit up. It felt that this skill was quite powerful.
It matched the Inner Power skill!
Inner Power could erupt with power that exceeded the limit, but it would cause itself to suffer a serious burden. If too much power erupted, it would even enter a near-death state and fall into a desperate situation!
There was no need for the enemy to push it into a desperate situation. He could use his Inner Power to manually activate the desperate situation mode. Two consecutive super eruptions were really unstoppable!
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven felt that it was very good.
“Do you need me to teach you another ‘Rise from the Dead’ and ‘Holy Counterattack’ skill so that you can erupt three or four times in a row?” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched as he asked.
Eleven’s eyes lit up. Every time, it would be an eruption that exceeded the limit. Every time, it would be on the verge of death, but every time, it could continue to erupt after being on the verge of death. Its trump cards would appear one after another, and it would become an immortal Panda King. It thought that it would work. When the time came, Baby Ginseng would only be so-so.
“What the hell? If you play like this, you’ll explode sooner or later.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. If you’re not careful, you won’t be smug from near death to really dying. You don’t have any revival skills…
The skills of the Nine Li Battle Beast were really f*cking dangerous. No wonder Emperor Wu had hidden injuries… Even if it wasn’t Yun An, this battle method was still dangerous for Beast Tamers after it fused with them… Fortunately, his talent was telepathy.
It looked like it was right to let Principal Feng help him apply for the legendary resource to increase the Iron-eating Beast’s life force…
No… When he thought of Chi Tong’s Interlocking Sword, Shi Yu’s head hurt. Although his physique could withstand Chi Tong’s possession now, using the Interlocking Sword would still cause damage.
Sigh, in short, Eleven’s skill was a little dangerous. If he wanted to use it, he would have to be on the verge of death. Who could withstand this? Although, perhaps Eleven was already used to hurting itself daily?
Shi Yu looked at the skill index.
At the moment, the high-speed healing didn’t feel enough for Eleven to use. He would replicate more life-saving skills for Eleven another day.
After the National League ended, in order to face the World Tournament, it was time to strengthen the pets. The suitable low-level teaching skills and super racial skills had to be arranged.
“Wu wu.”
At this moment, Eleven didn’t seem to be satisfied after eating a level-eight metal and awakening a new skill.
It returned to its mini form and poked Shi Yu, asking if there was still a meteorite fragment. Could that be eaten? Susu’s cleansing skill was already maxed out, and its strength was already at the monarch level!
It should be able to protect it when it absorbed the meteorite fragment to evolve.
If it really didn’t work, it could eat the Time Fruit. The full-level purification of the overlord-level Susu would definitely be safe.
Shi Yu smiled and stood up. “That’s right, I think so too. However, try again after the National League ends. After all, absorbing the Yun An fragment isn’t zero risk. Unlike Burning Gold, the National League is next. If something goes wrong during the process and you can’t participate, a large amount of resources will be wasted…”
“Moreover, during the absorption of the meteorite fragment, according to Big Boss Zhong Xuan… There’s the worry that the dark power will erode the will. I feel that it might also be a good opportunity to train the will. It’s best if we don’t need Susu’s help. It’s better to wait until there’s enough time before wholeheartedly accepting the challenge.”
Eleven: Wuu (Alright!!!)
…
At the same time.
In a mechanical research institute in the capital.
Gao Xuan put down the tool in his hand and looked at the “Anti-Shi Yu Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast” in front of him. He finally heaved a sigh of relief.
As expected, Gao Xuan knew about Shi Yu’s battle results in Dragon Palace City. Even if he didn’t know, as Shi Yu’s name appeared in the top 100 of the Sequence battle, he could determine that Shi Yu definitely had hidden strength.
Therefore, before the National League was held, he decisively upgraded the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast with the help of the seniors from Imperial Capital University and the fourth bureau.
He took out all his assets and awakened and contracted four new machines that could be used to fuse with the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and new mechanical equipment of the monarch race. Among them, there were new energy sources, new converters, and new weapons. It was very complete. He originally planned to awaken the combination after obtaining materials such as the Hundred Transformations Stone, but he didn’t expect that he would be forced to work hard in advance. This would cause him to have to adjust again when the time came. It was very tiring.
“With this, with the combination of five pets and myself, under the circumstances of six being one, even an overlord’s attack should be barely alright. Moreover, the Fusion Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast can even release an overlord-level attack. Although it will be overloaded, I feel that it’s a little overkill.”
Gao Xuan fell into deep thought. Forget it, he would just treat it as working hard in advance for the Sequence battle. He picked up the supplements weakly. Recently, he had been working hard to upgrade his machinery, and it had exhausted him. Before this, he really didn’t expect that a first-year student would become a threat to him at the last minute.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Killing in the National League
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Killing in the National League
Ancient Capital University.
After Shi Yu finished feeding Eleven the gold, he came out to check on Susu’s cleaning results.
“Ning!”
It was still so perfect. The room was filled with a fresh aura.
If he could have had the combination of purification and sweetness earlier, he wouldn’t have been so impatient in meditation.
“Beautiful.”
“Ning!”
“Let’s go, I’ll take you around the school.”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand. Susu hopped onto Shi Yu’s arm and climbed onto his head.
Susu: (.í_ì.)
At this moment, Shi Yu looked like he was wearing a blue hat, looking especially young.
This was the first time Susu had come to Ancient Capital University.
If it was going to the Undead Battlefield to train next, it would have to stay here for a long time. Shi Yu planned to bring it to familiarize it with the environment first.
In addition, he had not returned for a long, long time. He didn’t even participate in the final exam this year. Being this kind of student… was really awesome!
…
Battle Club.
As the National League was in two days, Shi Yu came over to take a look.
When he arrived, Principal Feng seemed to be there too. He should have gone out to take a look at the contestants of Ancient Capital University after giving him the Gold.
Dean He, the instructor of the battle club, was also there. He was lecturing the members of the battle club.
“There are no master-level teams participating in the team competition this year, so if you guys get the last place again this year, it won’t make sense no matter what.”
“Xu Ze, you’re the vice president. What do you think Ancient Capital University will get this time?”
Vice President Xu Ze looked conflicted and said, “Well, it’s hard to say…”
“You guys are cowards. I’ll set a number. The top five of the team. This time, all the members of the battle club will go to Demon Capital together, including the reserve members. However, regardless of whether you participate or not, you have to write a post-battle analysis of no less than 100,000 words according to the competition situation after the competition.”
As Dean He finished speaking, the expressions of the hundreds of battle club members below immediately turned bitter.
Damn it!
Even if the training was doubled, it was better than 100,000 words of post-battle analysis.
“Eh, Shi Yu is here.” At this moment, Principal Feng, who was listening to Dean He lecture the members, suddenly looked at the door.
To be honest, he didn’t have much hope for the team competition of Ancient Capital University. After all, the school’s resources were completely different from the resources of other schools. At the moment, he was hoping that Shi Yu and White Brook, the two members who participated in the individual competition, could do well.
This year, it was decided that the individual competition received more education funds.
In the past years, the results of Ancient Capital University were indeed not very good, so the annual education funds were basically crushed by Imperial Capital and Demon Capital University several times. But next year, they might be able to be generous for once.
The results of the Green Silkworm cocoon of the Feeding Department, the results of the Iron-eating Beast of the archeology Department, and in addition to the battle results of the National League, it was definitely the achievement of a top-notch school in the first tier.
And all of this… seemed to be thanks to the super genius Lu Qingyi picked up from that small county.
“Shi Yu?” Upon hearing Principal Feng’s voice, the hundreds of members of the battle club and Dean He looked at the door.
“Cough.” At this moment, Shi Yu also coughed dryly and entered in embarrassment. He didn’t expect everyone to be in a meeting.
“Dean He, Principal Feng.”
“Shi Yu, you came at the right time.” Seeing Shi Yu, Dean He smiled.
The other students also looked at this god in silence, their gazes extremely complicated!
The reason was very simple!
It wasn’t because Shi Yu had once swept through Imperial Capital University and defeated the careless vice-captain of Imperial Capital University with his equipment.
Instead, Shi Yu, who had disappeared from Ancient Capital University for a few months, had actually appeared in the top 100 of the Sequence Battle!!
This was what shocked everyone the most.
Although Shi Yu didn’t feel anything at that time, once the ranking of the Sequence Battle was announced, every student of Ancient Capital University, especially the Beast Tamers of the battle club, was very shocked.
After all, the Beast Tamers in the Sequence competition weren’t just university students.
In other words, among all the students of the nine major universities, only two had entered the top 100.
One was Gao Xuan, and the other was Shi Yu.
Even Bai Wenjie from Imperial Capital University, who Shi Yu had once defeated, and the official captain of Ancient Capital University, White Brook, were ranked hundreds away.
Although Shi Yu was quickly “killed” in the top 100 and his ranking fell, he had entered it before.
The top 100… The top 100 were all super geniuses who had already grown up, seniors who were several years older than them and had already graduated for a long time, or people who had reached the top of other systems. Among them, almost all were top-notch masters. In this situation, Shi Yu, a freshman, entering that? It made those who knew Shi Yu feel like they had seen a ghost.
In their impression, Shi Yu was only a high-level Beast Tamer. Although he could fight above his level, he was only a high-level Beast Tamer. However, looking at this ranking, there was no doubt that Shi Yu had definitely broken through again. Not only him, but some pets must have also reached the monarch level and their battle power was off the charts.
Not many people knew that Shi Yu had broken through to the master level in the Emperor Wu Ruins. Even fewer people knew that he had gone to Dragon Palace City. Therefore, this gave these Ancient Capital University students the illusion that it was suddenly unscientific.
Now that they finally saw the missing Shi Yu, many people started to guess what Shi Yu had experienced.
“What he had experienced…” In the crowd, Yu Shu, who knew part of the truth and had been to Dragon Palace City, cried.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Killing in the National League (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Killing in the National League (1)
What Shi Yu had experienced was the kind of thing that no one would believe even if he was telling the truth.
Therefore, Yu Shu was tactful and didn’t publicize the matter of Dragon Palace City. In Yu Shu’s opinion, Shi Yu’s battle results in Dragon Palace City were indeed worth entering the top 100 of the Sequence battle. That Iron-eating Beast was a monster.
Not to mention these students, even Dean He didn’t know at all. He hadn’t reached that level.
However, he also had a guess. At least, he knew that Shi Yu had contracted the heroic spirit of the overlord race, Mu Huiyin, and the Butterfly of Imagination of the overlord race. He knew that Shi Yu was a member of Bureau 11. He suspected that these two pets might have completely grown up under the secret investment of Ancient Capital University and Bureau 11 and reached the monarch level.
The other students didn’t know Shi Yu’s identity, but they knew that the cultivation resources Shi Yu obtained were definitely much more than these ordinary students.
“Shi Yu, you know that only you and White Brook are participating in the individual competition this time, right?” Dean He said.
“Well… But hasn’t Senior Xu broken through yet?” Shi Yu asked subconsciously.
Among the nine major universities, it was said that including him, there were a total of 21 master-level Beast Tamers.
Apart from him, White Brook was the only master in Ancient Capital University. It was too much.
As the vice president, why was Senior Xu Ze so weak?
Xu Ze: “?”
Why was he being dragged into this? Damn.
It wasn’t that easy.
“The mission of Xu Ze leading the team competition is also very difficult,” Dean He said. “However, all of you still have to learn from Shi Yu. Shi Yu. White Brook isn’t around today. As one of the few contestants in the battle club who can participate in the individual competition, do you have anything to say to everyone?”
After the new rules of the National League were changed, White Brook temporarily handed the mission of training the school team to Dean He. She returned to Wu Ling City to prepare for the individual competition. Her family also prepared some resources for her.
Shi Yu knew this very well. In his conversation with Senior Bai, he had already learned that White Brook had already strengthened three pets to the monarch level. They were the Immortal Feather Crane, the Nine-tailed Light Fox, and the Heavenly Light White Tiger. Although they weren’t male or the heir of the Wu Ling Bai family, the ruins space, the spot in Dragon Palace City, and then a large amount of resources were invested. Senior Bai seemed to be very favored in the Bai family.
“What I want to say?”
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “Everyone… good luck?”
Everyone :”…”
Was it any different from not saying anything!
…
The next day.
The group from Ancient Capital University started to head to Demon Capital.
There was a mighty super team of more than a hundred people, including teachers and students.
As for the other students who wanted to come and watch the battle, they had to think of a way themselves.
Of course, someone with connections like Senior Panda must have been taken advantage of by Shi Yu for a public trip.
Before leaving, White Brook arrived at Ancient Capital University. However, when she heard from Principal Feng that Lu Qingyi was cultivating in the ruins and wouldn’t go to watch the battle, she couldn’t help but be very sad.
However, being able to stick to the beautiful panda senior, White Brook quickly recovered her good mood.
Demon Capital.
At this moment, a large number of geniuses from the nine major universities had already gathered in the National League Village near the East Sea.
Soon, the team battle and the individual competition final would be held in the East Sea Arena near the contestant village.
Of course, the venue of the individual competition, an island filled with ferocious beasts, was naturally elsewhere.
In the contestant village of Ancient Capital University, after everyone arrived, White Brook, who had not seen her teammates for more than half a month, immediately gathered everyone and asked about the training and tactical arrangements.
Even though Dean He had already arranged it properly, she was still worried and planned to check again.
Shi Yu also sat beside her in boredom. The more he listened, the less hope he had for the team competition of Ancient Capital University.
After White Brook dismissed the ten main team members, White Brook looked at Shi Yu, who was playing with his cell phone in the corner.
“How’s your preparation?” she asked.
“Not bad.”
“What are you doing?”
“Looking at the video edited by Buggy… It plans to post Mu Huiyin Legend Two…”
The corners of White Brook’s mouth twitched. So, the National League was around the corner, and it was fine if this guy’s pet didn’t train seriously… But it actually didn’t even rest and was doing this?
Although… she had also subscribed…
“Don’t you have any sense of urgency?” White Brook asked.
“It doesn’t matter if it’s others, but there’s still Gao Xuan!”
Gao Xuan, a super monster who was only 21 years old and ranked in the top 20 of the Sequence Battle, couldn’t be ignored.
The Sequence Competition Committee ranked Shi Yu’s battle results in Dragon Palace City at more than 80 and Gao Xuan at more than 20. This meant that Gao Xuan definitely had hidden trump cards and stronger battle results.
“Don’t worry, my goal is the same as Senior Lu. It’s the world competition. If I can’t kill indiscriminately in the National League, I don’t have to go to the world competition.” Shi Yu was very serious.
He didn’t underestimate the enemy. The number of trump cards he had prepared was definitely not what the beast-eared girl could imagine.
White Brook: !!!
Damn it, he was bullying her for not being qualified to go to the World Tournament.
“Your pets are really at the monarch level,” she asked.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu smiled.
When they were in their natural state, at least.
Apart from that, he had a bunch of fancy combinations.
“Alright then.”
White Brook sighed and felt a little tired. Compared to worrying about Shi Yu, she should worry about herself first.
…
At this moment, geniuses from various top universities were gathered in the National League’s contestant village.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Killing in the National League (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Killing in the National League (2)
Imperial Capital, Ancient Capital, Demon Capital, Divine Capital, Star Capital, Demon Capital, Spirit Capital… At the same time, special rare pets from various cities appeared everywhere in the contestant village with Beast Tamers. It could be said to be an unprecedented grand occasion.
Media teams shuttled through the contestants’ village one after another, looking for contestants to interview.
On the Internet, there were also endless speculation discussions about the National League.
Although it was a rare occasion, Shi Yu still chose to return to the contestants’ dormitory to lie down. The competition would begin tomorrow, and today was another boring day.
Tomorrow was the individual competition preliminaries.
At that time, 21 masters would compete on an island filled with ferocious beasts. The final contestants could enter the finals to determine the individual champion.
The individual competition preliminaries, team competition, and individual competition finals would determine the order of the National League this time.
After returning, Shi Yu continued to take out his cell phone and swipe it.
It wasn’t because of the discussion about the National League on the Internet, but because the preview of “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin” released by Buggy had passed the review.
It was another short and powerful super short film that was more than a minute long. It was as short and weak as the Green Silkworm.
However, although it was short and weak, there were many explosive scenes added this time.
The ID [Time Traveler] had increased by 100,000 fans since it was flipped over by the official account of Ancient Capital University.
Many people were looking forward to the follow-up of Mu Huiyin’s legend.
Unfortunately, he disappeared for nearly a month.
Therefore, the moment preview 2 passed the review, many strange comments were added.
“Grandpa, the author you were following has finally updated.”
“It’s fine if it’s a monthly, but why is it a preview! This is too much!”
“I’ll like it first before looking at it. I’ll develop a good habit…”
These were the comments before watching the content.
As for the comments after watching the content…
“Wu wu wu wu, General Mu Huiyin’s childhood was so miserable. Not only was she ostracized by her clansmen, but she also suffered the torture of the fire bloodline.”
“Because the fire bloodline in her body is too strong, she has no choice but to contract an ice-element pet to suppress it? Hiss, no wonder General Mu Huiyin contracted an ice-element pet even though she clearly has a fire talent. The bloodline power of a hybrid human can actually be so strong? She needs an ice dragon to suppress it?”
“I also have a hybrid friend. There’s no such situation at all. It’s just that she has too much hair and can’t suppress it.”
“Holy shit… Emperor Shi used undead and time-element super skills to transform General Mu Huiyin’s bloodline power into a heroic spirit and sealed it in the ruins?? Really??”
“Damn, why does this ruin look so much like the heroic spirit ruins of the ancient capital?”
This time, in the preview of “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin”, the information revealed was that General Mu Huiyin of the hybrid race was tortured by the power of her bloodline, so she had no choice but to contract an ice-element pet to suppress her strength. By a freak combination of factors, she obtained the title of Ice Dragon General. At the same time, she displayed General Mu Huiyin’s tragic childhood and the suffering brought by her mixed blood during her growth.
Although an expert had already analyzed the previous video, after this time, everyone finally confirmed the reason why General Mu Huiyin erased her traces.
Because her mixed blood was not accepted by the world.
Indeed, before the era of Dong Huang and the empress dynasty, the mixed-blood humans had always been treated as foreign races.
Such a bumpy experience made many modern Beast Tamers sigh.
Their hearts ached for General Mu Huiyin.
However, what made countless Beast Tamers even more concerned was that General Mu Huiyin’s bloodline had actually turned into a heroic spirit form and even existed in the world??
It was sealed in the heroic spirit ruins of the ancient capital by Emperor Shi??
Soon, this news was completely confirmed.
Because the official account of Ancient Capital University reposted this video again.
At the same time, the University commented, “According to archeological discoveries, General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit was indeed sealed in the heroic spirit ruins, and the so-called heroic spirit ruins are…”
