The Ancient Capital University account began to explain what the Heroic Ruins were.
Then, the main point came.
“Not only the heroic spirits of General Mu Huiyin, but the heroic spirits of the generals under Emperor Shi also exist in the heroic spirit ruins.”
“Our Ancient Capital University organizes students to go to the heroic spirit ruins every year to communicate with the ancient heroic spirit and inherit the will of the predecessors. Those with outstanding talent even have a chance to obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit and contract them. It’s better to act than to be tempted. Welcome to the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University next year. Hug.jpg.”
The conspiracy of the admissions office of Ancient Capital University!
No, it was a conspiracy!
All the Beast Tamers wiped their saliva and suspected that this was the recruitment method of Ancient Capital University.
Being able to come into contact with the heroic spirit ruins was indeed the core competitiveness of Ancient Capital University.
However, not everyone liked undead.
Even if its predecessor was an ancient sage, some Beast Tamers couldn’t accept it.
They felt that under the same conditions, it was inferior to other races. The dragon-element resources in the Imperial capital and the mechanical pets in Star Capital were similarly attractive.
Ancient Capital University had its own core competitiveness, and so did other universities. Every university could take out rare pet resources that were not inferior to the heroic spirit ruins to attract new students.
Moreover, the conditions for the heroic spirits in the heroic spirit ruins to recognize their master were indeed high. There was no doubt about this.
But this time, it had to be said that General Mu Huiyin was too charming. A hybrid human, red hair, red eyes, powerful strength, and a beautiful general. The combination of multiple labels made many Beast Tamers go crazy.
“I understand. I’ll apply to Ancient Capital University next year!”
“Is it too late to change schools now?”
“Damn it, I want to go to Ancient Capital University. My mom signed me up for Star Capital University.”
“I’m eight years old now. I can go to university in ten years. I wonder if I still have a chance…”
“Dream on. Also, Ancient Capital University, transfer me money.” Shi Yu looked at the comments and shook his head.
However…
During the National League, if everyone knew that he had contracted Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit in advance, would he become the public enemy?

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent
Union calendar, December 1, 178.
After lying down for a day, the National League officially began.
Millions of gazes focused on the National League.
Those with qualifications came to the scene of Demon Capital.
Without any conditions, they waited for the live broadcast in front of their cell phones and television.
“Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Dong Huang Radio and Television Station.”
“This is the East Sea District of Demon Capital. The 114th National League is about to begin.”
On the live broadcast of the National League, the female host said, “I’m the host, Han Lu.”
The male host said, “I’m the commentator, Gu Yu.”
These two had already presided over the five National League competitions. To the audience who paid attention to the competition every year, they were all familiar faces.
Soon, as the two of them spoke nonsense, colorful fireworks rose outside the East Sea Arena. The school flags of the nine Beast Taming Universities of Dong Huang also fluttered.
At the same time, nine teams of more than ten people began to enter the venue from different directions.
In the Ancient Capital University team, Shi Yu followed behind White Brook. Behind him were the high-level Beast Tamers who participated in the team competition.
After the contestants and audience were in place, on the platform of the venue, an old man with a big beard started to talk.
Shi Yu looked at the bent, white-haired, and bearded old man. He knew him, but not completely.
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, the other party should be the person in charge of the eighth bureau, Zhong Yan, Principal Feng’s superior.
He had the powerful battle results of finding and teaching a Titled Legendary and a Legendary Beast Tamer.
As for his own strength, that was unknown.
Beside him was a very beautiful long-haired lady with a very cool aura. She was a legendary Mechanic, Xiao Shuang, who was also General Xiao Qin’s sister.
It was said that the security of the individual preliminaries of the National League was handled by her overlord-level mechanical life form, the Eye of the Stars.
As for the last very dignified middle-aged man, Shi Yu also knew him. He was the president of the Beast Tamer Association of Demon Capital City, the legendary Beast Tamer Xia Man. Because it was Demon Capital’s turn to hold the competition this year, this person naturally had to attend.
As for why Shi Yu knew him… It was because this guy was the husband of Dr. Zuo, who had developed the Ice Phoenix Moth. His daughter, Xia Qingwei, had even been Shi Yu’s assistant at the Feeding Conference… He had clearly not been promoted previously. This promotion speed was pretty fast.
“Cough.” Good heavens, the three important people who attended this year’s National League were not simple.
A long time later.
Director Zhong and President Xia finally finished speaking. Many contestants looked at the platform again. At this moment, Madam Xiao Shuang, who was wearing a black trench coat, stood up. With a thought, her figure teleported under the platform.
As she walked, she said, “I’m Xiao Shuang. Due to the special rules of this year’s National League, I’ll be the special guest judge. Next, the contestants of the individual competition of the nine major universities, come and draw lots.”
“The result of the draw will determine where you will be teleported to the competition island, Glass Island. Glass Island covers an area of 40,000 square kilometers. The internal environment is complicated. The initial location will affect the outcome of your competition to a certain extent.”
“The time for the individual preliminaries is one day. In one day, you need to eliminate two contestants on the island, regardless of the school. Only in this way can you meet the conditions to advance to the next round. If the conditions aren’t met after a day, you will fail to advance.”
“During this process, the more contestants are eliminated, the more rewards can be divided in the end. At the same time, the island is filled with ferocious beasts. Every monarch-level ferocious beast hunted can also receive ten million yuan.”
When they heard this rule again, everyone felt that it was very difficult!
There were only 21 contestants in this individual competition.
Moreover, they were all master-level Beast Tamers.
In this situation, it was as difficult as ascending to the heavens to eliminate two people in the specified time.
Moreover, although there were no overlord-level ferocious beasts on Glass Island, there were definitely many wild monarch-level ferocious beasts. In other words, after arriving at the island, not only did they have to worry about competitors, but they also had to worry about the threat in the wild.
It was still more comfortable to play the team competition in the arena.
“Let’s go.” In the Ancient Capital University team, White Brook called Shi Yu and called him to draw lots.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
At the same time, a total of 21 master-level students from the nine major universities walked to the designated location of Legend Xiao Shuang.
During this process, the 21 people were observing each other, but there was actually no need to observe.
Because they were all old acquaintances. They had fought in the National League last year.
The only unfamiliar face was probably Shi Yu.
Therefore, most people sized up Shi Yu.
[That guy who evolved from an archeological Iron-eating Beast.]
[A genius who developed the Green Silkworm cocoon and contracted the Butterfly of Imagination.]
[I heard that he defeated the vice-captain of Imperial Capital University in the Imperial Capital exchange event.]
[Top 100 at the start of the Sequence Battle, a freshman. Are you kidding?]
The contestants from the other universities muttered the information they knew in their hearts.
Among the many contestants, even Gao Xuan’s presence couldn’t suppress Shi Yu. After all, Shi Yu’s achievements had crossed several domains.
“There are many more masters than last year.”
On the platform, as the contestants of the individual competition went to the preliminaries to draw lots, Old Master Zhong Yan chuckled.
“Your daughter is also here, right?”
“She just broke through not long ago, and she’s just here to make up the numbers. It’s good to train,” President Xia said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (1)
“Which one do you think the individual champion will be?” Zhong Yan touched his beard and said.
“Wellâ€¦” President Xia pondered. He wanted to say Gao Xuan, but there was indeed a variable this year.
He looked at Shi Yu, who was drawing lots. Others didn’t know about Shi Yu’s battle results in Dragon Palace City, but his daughter, Xia Qingwei, had also gone to Dragon Palace City. As a father, he naturally knew.
Therefore, it was very likely that this year’s champion would be between Shi Yu and Gao Xuan. It depended on how much progress the two of them had made during this period.
One was a genius from the fourth bureau, and even the rewards for this year’s competition were specially customized for Gao Xuan.
One was a dual domain genius from the third and eleventh bureau. He had even created such a huge miracle in Dragon Palace City. His rise was so fast that it was difficult to understand.
“I’ll bet on Shi Yu,” President Xia said with a smile.
As for Bureau Chief Zhong, he laughed and said, “Then I’ll bet on Little Gao.”
Below.
Everyone had basically finished drawing lots. Shi Yu didn’t know what kind of place the “Yunying Mountain Range” was. He didn’t understand the detailed map of Glass Island in advance. It didn’t matter. In any case, with their speed, as long as they used the right pet, it wasn’t difficult to search for opponents on an island of 40,000 square kilometers.
“Prepare to land on the island.”
After drawing the lot, Xiao Shuang said straightforwardly.
At the same time, his gaze, like President Xia and Director Zhong, paid more attention to Gao Xuan and Shi Yu.
One was a junior in the mechanical field… She had also heard of the other from her father and sister.
Crushing two overlords, was this for real?
If that was the case, what was the point of Gao Xuan fighting? Wasn’t the resources for the fourth round of the National League wasted?
Of course, she didn’t believe this, because his father and sister didn’t know what was going on either.
Xiao Shuang was more willing to believe that Shi Yu had relied on external forces, just like how Gao Xuan could use small forbidden weapons.
In short, she felt that it was a little ridiculous. She planned to let the Eye of the Stars broadcast Shi Yu’s situation more later.
Boom.
In the sky, the sea of clouds broke open, and a hundred-meter-long mechanical huge eye that looked like a blue star appeared.
“Gulp.” Countless people suddenly looked at the sky.
< Name > Eye of the Stars
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
“!!!” This big guy reminded Shi Yu of the Eye of Heaven during the Ancient Capital vocation assessment. He was very emotional.
Soon, countless pillars of light shot out of the Eye of the Stars in the sky and landed on Shi Yu and the others. There were a total of 21 contestants.
Then, everyone slowly disappeared from the spot!
Only countless spectators and the team competition contestants of the nine major universities looked at the venue eagerly.
“In the next 24 hours, the Eye of the Stars will broadcast the situation of the 21 contestants at the same time. When they don’t encounter other contestants and monarch ferocious beasts, the live broadcast will choose to use the blurry distant scenes. When they encounter each other or encounter monarch ferocious beasts, the clear live broadcast will be carried out,” Xiao Shuang said.
“Please arrange your time reasonably.” She mainly said to the other team battle contestants. After all, tomorrow was the team battle immediately after.
If they stayed up late to watch the individual competition preliminaries, although it was not a burden considering the physique of a Beast Tamer, it would more or less affect their state.
“Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Dong Huang Radio and Television Station.”
“I’m Han Lu. I’m Gu Yu.”
“In the next 24 hours, we will explain the entire preliminaries of the National League’s individual competition.”
At the same time.
On the big four-sided screen of the East Sea Arena, in various places in the contestant village, on various major Internet platforms, and on the television channels, the two commentators in charge of presiding over the National League continued to show their faces.
Even Xiao Shuang, Zhong Yan, and Xia Man sat quietly and watched the two of them explain. These two were both experienced masters and industry insiders. It was not a problem for them to explain the National League.
Moreover, Xiao Shuang would also be in charge of supplementing the situation that they couldn’t explain through the Eye of the Stars.
“It’s startingâ€¦”
“I’m a little nervous.” At this moment, the students of the nine major universities looked at the disappearing pillar of the school and the gradually lit up live broadcast scene. They swallowed their saliva.
The principals and teachers of the various universities had also arrived. At this moment, Principal Feng brought Dean He and the others to a certain place to watch the live broadcast.
There were a total of 23 live broadcast images. Among them, 21 small images were in the corner and were blurry. They matched 21 contestants. As for the clear main image, it was the area mainly responsible for broadcasting when the contestants had any conflict. The remaining small image was the profile picture of the host, Han Lu and Gu Yu.
“As the contestants will be scattered and teleported to various places on Glass Island at the start, the contestants won’t encounter each other for the time being.”
“Before that, I, Han Lu, will introduce these 21 contestants from the nine major universities in turn.”
“Firstly, it’s the personal champion of the last National League, the leader of the champion team, the genius Mechanic from Imperial Capital University, contestant Gao Xuan!”
“According to what I know, he even participated in the Sequence Battle this year. Now that he’s ranked 24, he can be said to be quite impressive!”
“This means that among the young Beast Tamers under the age of 30 in Dong Huang, contestant Gao Xuan’s strength is enough to rank in the top 30! You have to know that he’s only 21 years old this year.”
“Look, he’s starting to summon his trump card machinery.”

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (2)
“Middle-level overlord race, Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast!”
At this moment, the situation of Glass Island had already clearly appeared in the scene. On a plain, Gao Xuan, who was wearing a silver battle suit, was teleported here.
After arriving at Glass Island, Gao Xuan’s expression was calm. A huge spatial array appeared behind him. A handsome Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast mecha descended. It bent down and stretched out its huge hand to lift Gao Xuan up and send him to the cockpit.
[Gao Xuan, charge!]
[Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Handsome Explosion!]
[Champion, consecutive championship.]
[Sequence ranking 20+. Captain Gao will definitely be stable this year. It’s up to the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to kill!]
On the Internet, as Han Lu introduced Gao Xuan, it immediately caused a flurry of comments.
At the scene, the old principal of the Imperial Capital University and the director of the battle club of the Imperial Capital University were all smiling. Those Imperial Capital University students, such as Yin Zhengfan, who was sitting in a corner of the audience, also trusted Gao Xuan very much.
At the moment, all 21 contestants had arrived at Glass Island.
Shi Yu was no exception.
After arriving at Glass Island, he was teleported to the Yunying Mountain Range. The geographical environment was surprisingly good. The mountains were clear and the rivers were beautiful. Naturally, there was sufficient energy. The surroundings were clear, and his vision was wide open. Seeing this, Shi Yu was amused.
He suddenly had a bold idea.
Didn’t they say just now… that the more contestants eliminated in the individual competition, the more monarch-level ferocious beasts they defeated, and the more rewards they would get in the end?
If he meant if, if he could “pack up” the remaining 20 contestants on this island, would the reward explode?
What final? The preliminaries could just be the end.
It was still the same thing. If one couldn’t even kill everybody in the National League, why would they go to the World Tournament to hunt overlords and totems?
“Even hunting monarch ferocious beasts has rewards, but among these people, apart from Gao Xuan, no one should be so bored as to provoke monarch ferocious beasts,” Shi Yu muttered to himself.
After all, the reward for entering the main competition was even richer. Among the first place prizes, just the Hundred Transformations Stone alone was worth more than a billion. The rewards for the other rankings weren’t bad either. On the other hand, if they gave up everything to hunt monarch ferocious beasts and didn’t enter the main competition, it would be a huge loss.
“The competition authorities specially cleaned up the overlords of Glass Island, leaving behind an empty shell of Glass Island without overlords for the contestants to harvest resources. Then I won’t be polite.”
“If the others hunt another monarch, I’ll lose 10 million. I have to think of a way to move faster. It’s best if I can attract the ferocious beasts and contestants at the same time.”
He wondered how many monarchs there were on Glass Island. If there were enough, it would be a considerable number.
With that said, Shi Yu took a deep breath and made a decision.
At the same time.
After Han Lu, the commentator of the National League, spent a few minutes introducing Gao Xuan’s battle results, she immediately switched to Shi Yu.
As a host, she had also done her homework. Naturally, she had to choose the popular contestants to introduce first.
As the only two Beast Tamers who entered the top 100 of the Sequence battle, it was never wrong to introduce them first.
“The second contestant we’re going to introduce next, I believe everyone is not unfamiliar with him.”
“He’s from Ancient Capital University. He’s only a first-year student of Ancient Capital University now. He’s only 19 years old. It can be said that he’s the youngest contestant in this competition. More importantly, although he’s young, his achievements are very legendary. He’s a first-year student of the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu!”
“When contestant Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer intern, he discovered the evolution method of the Iron-eating Beast through archeology. Later on, he even personally researched the important result of the evolution chain of the Green Silkworm cocoon, which was beneficial to the country and the people. He’s a very outstanding young talent. More importantly, contestant Shi Yu’s strength seems to be very terrifying.”
“According to the information, contestant Shi Yu has also signed up to participate in the Sequence Competition of the world competition. The Sequence Competition Committee even set contestant Shi Yu’s initial ranking at 81. This is very unbelievable. Now that contestant Shi Yu has appeared here, perhaps he has already proven his strength like us… A master below the age of 20 is still very rare. Next, let’s see how contestant Shi Yu performs.”
“Uh.” Just as the commentator Han Lu finished speaking, Shi Yu began to summon his pet in the scene.
Unlike Gao Xuan, Shi Yu didn’t directly summon an ace battle beast that could be used to escort him to kill everyone.
With countless eyes staring at the live broadcast screen, Shi Yu stretched out his hand and summoned a… ginseng baby?
A small ginseng baby appeared in Shi Yu’s hand, making most of the audience fall into deep thought.
[Baby Ginseng?]
[What’s going on…]
[He’s tired before it starts?]
It was fine if he came to a dangerous wild area and didn’t summon his pets to protect himself, but what did he mean by summoning a ginseng baby??
Moreover, a genius who had entered the top 100 of the Sequence competition contracted a ginseng baby?
“As expected of you.” In Ping Cheng, although the young Beast Tamers who had participated in the supplement heat and imitated Shi Yu’s method had become useless themselves, they were very emotional when they saw Shi Yu, who was getting stronger and stronger, taking out the supplement immediately.
They lost!
Of course, these were all people who didn’t understand Shi Yu. They only felt that Baby Ginseng was a transcendent race and a supplement.
Those who had a deeper understanding of Shi Yu, such as students from Ancient Capital and Imperial Capital University, froze when they saw this ginseng baby.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (3)
This was not an ordinary transcendent ginseng baby, but… a battle ginseng that knew attack skills!
Moreover, its strength was not bad.
Some students and teachers of Imperial Capital University were even more solemn. Shi Yu’s ginseng baby had undergone an evolution in Imperial Capital University.
The old principal of Imperial Capital University was one of the few people who knew about the Undying Ginseng. Although Yin Zhengfan and the others didn’t know about the Undying Ginseng, they had also seen the commotion caused by the ginseng baby at Imperial Capital University.
At that time… the fragrance that filled the sky almost attracted all the pets in Imperial Capital University, including overlord-level pets.
How nutritious was this ginseng baby?
Now, when they saw Shi Yu choose to summon this pet immediately, they revealed serious expressions. What was Shi Yu… doing?
“Holy shit.”
In the next moment, a shocking scene occurred.
A fragrance that was almost corporeal bloomed from Baby Ginseng.
A fragrance visible to the naked eye flowed into the sky like a tide.
Even through the live broadcast, the Beast Tamers had never seen such a ridiculous sweet aura skill.
In the impression of people, sweet aura skills were silent.
However, on Shi Yu’s ginseng baby, it seemed to have gone from being soft and silent to a fragrant tornado.
As the fragrance spread from Baby Ginseng’s body, the entire sky was like the birth of the Undying Divine Medicine, condensing a very spectacular natural phenomenon in the sky.
“Gulp.” Everyone could clearly hear the grunt coming from the live-stream screen.
“Whose voice is it?”
“It sounds a little mechanical.”
“Could I have heard wrongly?”
[Eye of the Stars]: Aggrieved.jpg
On the platform of the East Sea Arena, Xiao Shuang’s face was speechless. She sensed the desire of the Eye of the Stars for the ginseng baby from afar.
Wait, was there something wrong? Why was a mechanical pet of the Eye of the Stars interested in the ginseng baby?
Xiao Shuang was very puzzled.
However…
This ginseng baby…
Xiao Shuang looked at the ginseng baby in Shi Yu’s hand on the screen with a deep gaze. She had heard from her father and sister that Shi Yu had… crushed two overlords through a ginseng baby!!
Now that Shi Yu had summoned Baby Ginseng, what did it mean??
No… Perhaps the intention was already very clear.
As Baby Ginseng appeared, it emitted a fragrance. In an instant, with Shi Yu as the center, the countless ferocious beasts in the surrounding area began to stir. Moreover, this area… was still expanding!!
This fragrance slowly spread to the entire island with the wind of nature. Although the smell gradually faded, the fragrance was like a fuse that connected to the richest center!
If nothing went wrong, soon, the entire island would be able to smell this fragrance!
“This…” The host, Han Lu, clearly immediately realized Shi Yu’s intention. She found it very difficult to understand.” Contestant Shi Yu… Contestant Shi Yu, he summoned Baby Ginseng and made Baby Ginseng release a large-scale sweet aura skill!!”
“As everyone knows, the sweet aura skill is a special fragrance to relieve fatigue, but in the wild, many creatures are actually attracted by this sweet aura. What is he doing? Could it be that he wants to attract the ferocious beasts?”
“Using this method to attract monarch-level ferocious beasts to hunt?”
“Looks like contestant Shi Yu is very confident in his strength.”
Gu Yu: “I think so, but the sweet aura skill of contestant Shi Yu’s ginseng baby… seems to be a little too terrifying. What level has this ginseng baby’s strength reached… Could it have reached the monarch level? Monarch-level ginseng baby?”
“Everyone, look. There’s already a terrifying number of ferocious beasts moving in the direction of contestant Shi Yu!!”
Initially, the two commentators wanted to introduce the 21 contestants before there was any conflict.
However, who knew that this Shi Yu would not follow the routine and cause such big news?
As a result, they couldn’t move the scene away and could only concentrate on explaining Shi Yu’s situation.
At this moment, under Xiao Shuang’s mental instructions, apart from the basic commands, the Eye of the Stars also began to mobilize more images from other places.
Soon, the situation around Shi Yu was broadcasted in the form of an aerial view.
In the next moment, all the spectators gasped and their breathing almost stopped.
“This…”
“How is that possible?”
“There are at least 100,000 of them!!!”
Because in the live broadcast, as Baby Ginseng released its fragrance, at least 100,000 ferocious beasts, from transcendent to monarch level, walked towards the mountain range where Shi Yu was with red eyes.
They involved various races and types. They were all ferocious beasts that posed a huge threat to humans in the wild recorded in textbooks. During their journey, the sky and the ground were pitch-black and dense. Just the tens of thousands of transcendent-level Killer Bees led by the Queen Bee made all the spectators’ hair stand on end.
“What kind of sweetness is that?”
“This Shi Yu is crazy.”
“With such a big commotion, forget about the ferocious beasts, the other contestants nearby should also be attracted by him.”
The rules of this preliminaries were originally to let every contestant be careful of ferocious beasts in the wild and other contestants. Everyone was like hunters hunting in the dark forest and needed to be careful. It was best to defeat others through sneak attacks and picking up scraps. In the end, Shi Yu released a signal flare into the sky to mark himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (4)
Looking at the dense army of 100,000 ferocious beasts marching towards Shi Yu in the aerial map, countless spectators gulped.
Even the beast tides encountered in some cities were only so-so.
“The analysis results are out…”
“Among these ferocious beasts, there are a total of ten monarch-level ferocious beasts. About 3,000 commander-level ferocious beasts, and 110,000 transcendent-level ferocious beasts.”
The commentator, Han Lu, gulped and said.
A beast tide of this level could almost instantly paralyze a third-level city like Ping Cheng.
And this was only attracted in less than a minute after Shi Yu summoned Baby Ginseng??
In the East Sea Arena, Senior Panda sat nervously in her seat.
“Don’t worry.” A moment later, a female voice came from the side.
A big white cat had arrived at some point in time and joined the audience of Ancient Capital University.
“Teacher Ying!” Lin Xiuzhu was surprised to see the gem cat.
At the same time, the contestants on the competition island might not know the situation, but the teachers and students of the nine major universities outside the island widened their eyes in unison. They looked at all of this in disbelief and at Shi Yu’s crazy actions.
It had attracted nearly 120,000 ferocious beasts!!
Ignoring everything else, just the ten monarch-level ferocious beasts were enough to make several contestants suffer.
“This kid is dishonest. We can’t let Qingwei find such a boyfriend in the future.” On the platform, President Xia’s gaze was deep.
“Even if all his pets master perfect-level deterrence, it’s still difficult to disperse such a huge beast tide, right?” Director Zhong clicked his tongue.
Wasn’t this inviting trouble?
Generally speaking, deterrence couldn’t deal with monarchs of the same level. As for the 100,000 ferocious beasts, although they could be dealt with by deterrence, there were too many of them. Even if they used deterrence, they would be exhausted.
Moreover, the monarch commanding them would also help resist the deterrence. In this situation, Shi Yu’s situation was rather dangerous.
Even if these pets dispersed in the end, Shi Yu himself would probably consume a lot of energy.
At this moment, no one cared about the situation on the other contestants’ side.
All eyes were focused on Shi Yu.
At the moment, there were already ferocious beasts very close to Shi Yu.
As for Shi Yu, he also sensed the aura of wild beasts from all directions.
“Eleven, come out. Let’s settle one wave first.”
After Baby Ginseng, Shi Yu summoned his second pet.
An extremely confused little Iron-eating Beast that was more than a meter tall appeared beside Shi Yu.
The moment it came out, its body subconsciously emitted a faint deterrence. Although the hundreds of ferocious beasts near Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng with burning eyes, they didn’t dare to act rashly.
[Iron-eating Beast…]
[Shi Yu summoned the Iron-eating Beast. I watched the Iron-eating Beast Knight grow up.]
[So what does he do next? Don’t tell me he’s going to let the Iron-eating Beast fight. In my opinion, slip away. It’s more exciting to run after showing off.]
Countless comments quickly flashed across the major live-stream platforms.
At this moment, Shi Yu began to do serious things.
“Make as much noise as possible and attract all the contestants.” Shi Yu gave Eleven an order.
“Wuu!!” Eleven patted its chest, indicating that it would take care of it.
In the next moment.
The Little Iron Eating Beast walked a little away, and then white light began to linger on its body.
Boom!!!
Under the light, a terrifying deterrence erupted from its body.
Apart from that, an invisible white flash of flames erupted from Eleven, who was covered in white light, like an erupting volcano. Blue electric arcs flickered in the huge flames that were several meters tall.
Under this light, Eleven’s body suddenly enlarged. It was two meters tall, five meters, ten meters, twenty meters, fifty meters, a hundred meters, and it was still increasing!!
At this moment, a shocking change made the audience watching the scene suddenly open their mouths and quietly watch everything.
Countless people widened their eyes and looked at a little Iron-eating Beast that was more than a meter tall. It suddenly multiplied to more than a hundred meters.
Although they knew that there were Beast Tamers who could master the skill of enlarging after the Iron-eating Beast evolved, wasn’t enlarging to this size… a little against common sense?
In the giant transformation, Eleven’s form was also changing.
As the light dissipated, its entire body was wrapped in hard black armor… Its face and head were covered in armor that had already become the color of silver lightning.
Apart from that, the place where its limbs touched its body, the iron ring-shaped thick armor also turned silver-white with lightning lingering.
Mysterious, domineering, honorable, and wild were the qualities revealed by the iron-eating beast today.
At this moment, Eleven’s originally black eyes had completely turned into a sky-blue color that contained lightning. Coupled with the black and white armor and the flowing electric current on the armor, it looked extremely ferocious, like an overlord that could suppress everything!!
“Roar!!!” Eleven, who had entered the sharp state and erupted with all its might, immediately roared at the sky, its king’s might erupting!!
Dao Proficiency Deterrence!!!
Deterrence of this level had already exceeded the transcendent deterrence of the binding object and skill. It could already imprint deterrence in the depths of the souls and bloodlines of other lives, branding it in the ethereal natural power, fusing, and triggering the powerful natural power to display its might.
In other words, Eleven didn’t need to consume a huge amount of physical strength at all. Just once, it could trigger the lightning here to transform into its own will and consciousness to deter the ferocious beasts that came!

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Deterrence that Exceeded Transcendent (5)
Boom!!!
With Eleven’s roar, the sky immediately exploded with a loud bang that resounded through the sky. A shocking bolt of lightning swept across the sky and emitted incomparably dazzling lightning, like a divine judgment.
An incomparably terrifying bang instantly appeared in the hearts of the 100,000 ferocious beast army that rushed over one after another. It resounded in their ears. The explosive deterrence exploded their minds, hearts, souls, and bodies, making their pupils turn white. They fainted one by one. Before they arrived at the location of the ginseng baby, their consciousness collapsed uniformly!
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! 100,000 thuds fell to the ground. It was almost like an earthquake as it resounded in this place. Be it transcendent, commander, or even the ten monarch-level ferocious beasts in the beast tide, after witnessing the deterrence lightning that flashed in the sky, all of them lost their ability to fight without exception. Their eyes turned white from fear. For these ordinary monarchs with less than two million energy points, ordinary monarchs whose deterrence proficiency level had yet to reach perfection, this shocking lightning was the difference between a god and a mortal. It was impossible to surpass.
The hundred-meter-tall beast looked down at the fallen ferocious beasts and instantly killed 100,000 ferocious beasts. To Eleven, there was nothing to be proud of. Its full-level royal deterrence might only be useful in this situation. It couldn’t be helped. Although its deterrence level was very high, in the team internal competition, its teammates were also transcendent-level deterrence. It was really not useful.
However, for Eleven, it might be a very ordinary thing, but for the audience watching the live broadcast at this moment, it was an unbelievable thing that was enough to make their eyes explode and almost pop out.
“This…”
Looking at the 100,000 ferocious beasts that instantly fell to the ground with a thunderclap, even the ten not weak monarch-level ferocious beasts lost their ability to fight. The two hosts in charge of explaining the National League instantly opened their mouths wide, completely unable to explain this deterrence.
At this moment, the comments in the major live-streams stopped for a moment. Countless spectators looked at the scene in disbelief.
The audience at the scene was similarly confused. Not to mention them, even the top big shots on the platform were extremely silent.
Then, Zhong Yan took a deep breath and said in disbelief,
“This is…”
“This is a deterrence that has exceeded the transcendent level and reached a higher level. At the moment, this level of deterrence has never appeared on a Beast Tamer’s pet in the modern era. Only those foreign kings are qualified to have it.”
“This Nine Li Battle Beast… What’s going on?”
First, the fragrance slowly spread throughout the island, followed by a thunderclap. Shi Yu indeed instantly became the center of attention. Even from very far away, many contestants sensed the energy fluctuations here and were attracted by the commotion here. They carefully rushed over to take a look at the situation. One of the faster ones had already arrived on an elemental pet at a low altitude. However, he looked at the pets lying on the ground nearby with confusion in his eyes.
At the contestant area of Ling Du University, at this moment, the school leader of Ling Du University was surprised to see his contestant appear in the area where Shi Yu was playing on the blurry small screen. His eyes immediately widened and his gaze exploded.
Damn, silly child, run!!! Why did he go there for no reason? Don’t get targeted by that monster!!!
That kid wasn’t kidding. He… really wanted to attract all the monarchs and contestants to kill them together!

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime
“Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Dong Huang Radio and Television Station!!!”
“An extremely unbelievable scene has appeared!!!”
“After contestant Shi Yu attracted a large number of ferocious beasts with Baby Ginseng’s sweet aura skill, he actually instantly killed all the ferocious beasts!!”
“Ten monarchs, thousands of commanders, 100,000 transcendents. Unbelievable. According to the recorded information, even in the main battlefield of the totem battle, there has never been a record of a monarch-level pet instantly killing 100,000 ferocious beasts!”
“This should still be deterrence, right???”
After Han Lu and Gu Yu were shocked, they quickly reacted and immediately explained.
Since he didn’t know how to explain this phenomenon, he would repeat the live broadcast in words. It was an old basic skill.
They were professionals!
[What the hell?!]
[I’m not blind, I can see.]
[Who can explain what’s going on? Is this reasonable!! I’ll believe it if you say this is an overlord-level Iron-eating Beast.]
A question mark from the audience.
Boom.
In the scene, lightning flashed continuously, and occasionally, lightning arcs landed on Eleven.
Eleven used the lightning of nature to charge itself, shrinking and recovering.
In the blink of an eye, they saw the huge beast that had grown to a hundred meters and returned to its cute mini form. The audience was silent for a moment.
[I remember that when Shi Yu participated in the vocation assessment, although its Iron-eating Beast could also expand, it was only to an acceptable level of ten meters…]
[And now, this size… reminds me of those totem beasts in movies.]
[Can other contestants still play? They’ll get insta-killed!]
“Contestant Shi Yu’s performance exceeded everyone’s expectations. Regarding contestant Shi Yu’s performance, Director Zhong Yan has something to say.”
The host, Gu Yu, also knew that the two of them couldn’t explain this situation alone, so she could only ask the three guests for help.
Soon, the camera turned to the platform and to Bureau Chief Zhong, President Xia, and Legend Xiao.
At this moment, the three of them were also very silent. Director Zhong pondered for a moment and said, “It’s indeed as Master Gu Yu said. This is a deterrence skill!”
“However, it’s a very unusual deterrence.”
“After training the deterrence skill to the expert level, it can form a monarch’s aura. It can stun creatures with willpower, weak minds, and much weaker strength than itself on a large scale.”
“However, there’s still a limit to the monarch aura. It definitely can’t reach the level of stunning ferocious beasts of the same level. Moreover, just now, contestant Shi Yu’s Nine Li Battle Beast didn’t show an obvious monarch aura. Instead, it was accompanied by a thunderclap that resounded through the sky that stunned 100,000 ferocious beasts. This is no longer a monarch aura, but a higher-level deterrence!”
“It’s not perfect, nor is it transcendent. Instead, it has exceeded the transcendent realm. With a thought, heavenly lightning is born, turning lightning into will, and intimidating everything in its place. This skill even exceeds the entanglement skill of transcendent deterrence. Since ancient times, animals have feared fire, lightning, and all natural disasters in nature. This is the fear engraved in their bloodlines, and that deterrence just now has already reached the level of fusing the power of nature to deter everything.”
“As for why this Nine Li War Beast can train deterrence to such an extent, I also find it very difficult to understand…”
“However, to be able to stun a monarch of the same level, that Nine Li Battle Beast is undoubtedly a natural king. The pet cultivated by contestant Shi Yu might have created a record, a miracle.”
There were very few overlord-level creatures that had mastered transcendent-level deterrence. As for creatures that had mastered higher-level deterrence, they were too rare in the areas that humans could come into contact with.
As soon as Director Zhong finished speaking, the scene was silent. A deterrence that exceeded transcendent proficiency??
For most spectators, although the skill Deterrence was very strong, their impression of it was that it was a divine skill to torture noobs and was useless in battles of the same level. However, after seeing Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast instantly kill 100,000 ferocious beasts, at this moment, they couldn’t say that this skill was just a divine skill to torture noobs.
Their deterrence could only torture noobs because its proficiency wasn’t high enough!
Even ten monarch-level ferocious beasts of the same level were instantly insta-killed!!! There were even 100,000 low-level ferocious beasts!
“Hahahaha.” At this moment, in the audience seats of Ancient Capital University, Principal Feng was shocked for a moment. After a long silence, he laughed.
“We might be able to give an explanation here!”
Beside him, the panda senior, Lin Xiuzhu, was so excited that her face was red. She looked at the changes on the screen. Eleven rushed forward, and so did Shi Yu.
Their commotion immediately attracted Xiao Shuang’s attention. The camera turned to the audience seats of Ancient Capital University and to Principal Feng and Senior Panda.
“Principal Feng, what do you think of contestant Shi Yu’s performance in your school?”
“That’s indeed a deterrence that exceeds transcendent. As for why Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast can train its deterrence to that extent, that’s because Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast is from the royal family of Iron-eating Beasts, and the royal family of Iron-eating Beasts is one of the strongest king beasts!!”
“According to archeological discoveries, the legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Wu, had the thought of changing his trump card after seeing the Iron-eating Beast King! This is enough to prove the Iron-eating Beast’s potential!”
“And the one who discovered all of this is Shi Yu. He traced the history of the Ancient Capital’s Iron-eating Beast Ruins and cracked the Emperor Wu Ruins in Wu Ling City. He discovered the truth of this loss and even found a way to help the Iron-eating Beast awaken its royal bloodline. His Nine Li Battle Beast has already completed the final evolution towards the Iron-eating Beast King, on the basis of the information about the Nine Li Battle Beast that has already been announced!”

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (1)
“Now, the race level of his Iron-eating Beast has already reached the high-level overlord race. It’s the indisputable strongest race, a true beast king. It’s normal for it to have such a performance.”
As soon as Principal Feng finished speaking, the entire Dong Huang Domain trembled again. Countless spectators looked at the old man on the screen in disbelief.
Everyone was naturally not unfamiliar with this person.
The principal of Ancient Capital University, one of the most famous big shots in the archeology world.
There was no reason for everyone to not believe what he said.
Shi Yu had discovered the iron-eating beast’s overlord race evolution method after the Iron-eating Beast King evolution method?
Iron-eating Beast King?
High-level overlord race???
Legend had it that Beast Tamer Emperor Wu had also wanted to use the Iron-eating Beast as a trump card?
As the old principal of Ancient Capital University revealed this news, countless people widened their eyes and looked at the little Iron-eating Beast on the screen in disbelief again.
Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit, high-level overlord race???
Didn’t Shi Yu already contract a Butterfly of Imagination of a middle-level overlord race? He actually had another monarch of a high-level overlord race?
Higher than the race level of Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast???
F*ck, no wonder Shi Yu could be ranked 81st by the Sequence Competition Committee!!!
Everyone believed the racial level mentioned by Principal Feng without a doubt, because if it wasn’t a beast king of a high-level overlord race, the deterrence that instantly killed a beast of the same level just now was impossible to explain.
Now, everyone looked at the screen and was deeply shocked. The Iron-eating Beast King was so strong.
Shi Yu was so strong.
If nothing went wrong, from today onwards, the Iron-eating Beast race would immediately become the target of all Beast Tamers! It would be even crazier than before!
At the side, the panda senior was still excited. Alright, alright!!!
She started planning for the incoming panda popularity.
…
The level of attention in the National League couldn’t be said to be small. This royal deterrence, together with Principal Feng’s certification, instantly made the reputation of the Iron-eating Beast King sweep through the country.
This made Yu Shu, Yin Zhengfan, and the others, who had fought Shi Yu in the vocation assessment from the start, silent and at a loss.
It felt familiar.
Back then, Shi Yu had promoted the archeological discovery of the iron-eating beast’s evolution in the vocation assessment.
Again?
Addicted?
If he really went to participate in a world competition, would he go to the world competition to promote archeological discoveries again and show off to the totem clans?
“This old man…” Director Zhong looked at the smug Principal Feng and felt a sense of loss. Good lord, this old man had really picked up a super genius this time.
Beside him, President Xia was a little stunned. In his impression, it was already impressive that Shi Yu could nurture a pet like the Butterfly of Imagination. In the end, there was an even higher race??
“Hey, hey, hey, no way…” Legend Xiao Shuang was also silent. Although she was shocked, at this moment, compared to the Iron-eating Beast, she was still more concerned about that ginseng baby!
Did these people forget something?
That ginseng baby instantly summoned 100,000 ferocious beasts. No, the ferocious beasts from other places on the island were still coming over one after another. It was also very terrifying, even more terrifying than that Iron-eating Beast, alright? Moreover, it had a battle record that was suspected to have crushed two overlords…
[Why do I suddenly feel that Captain Gao is unstable?]
[F*ck, I’ve only seen high-level overlord races on television.]
[Captain Gao is definitely stable. Don’t forget, the most impressive thing about mechanical pets is that they can fuse with Beast Tamers. Moreover, Captain Gao has the same Beast Taming Talent as that person.]
Many supporters of Gao Xuan from Imperial Capital University suddenly wavered.
However, a large portion of them still believed that Gao Xuan was stronger.
“Contestant Shi Yu has once again made us understand his astonishing achievements in the archeological field.”
“Iron-eating Beast King, the Iron-eating Beast King that instantly killed 100,000 ferocious beasts. Impressive!!”
The host, Han Lu, and Gu Yu, were very teary-eyed. This wasn’t their fault. They couldn’t explain anything about this new archeological discovery that hadn’t been announced.
Fortunately, at this moment, there was other content to explain.
“Contestant Shi Yu’s ginseng baby is still continuing to create fragrance. Thunder is also continuing to rumble above contestant Shi Yu. Apart from absorbing a large number of ferocious beasts nearby, the huge commotion here seems to have also attracted some contestants.”
“I originally thought that it would still be a while before the contestants would meet, but I didn’t expect that because of the commotion created by contestant Shi Yu, the distance between the two contestants would be at the stage where they were about to encounter each other so quickly.”
This change surprised the two commentators again. Damn, they had only introduced two of the 21 contestants. They originally wanted to finish introducing them for a while, but now it looked like they had to get to the point.
The entire Glass Island was 40,000 square kilometers, larger than several Demon Cities added together. They didn’t expect the contestants who had deliberately scattered could encounter each other so quickly. As expected, apart from deliberately attracting ferocious beasts, this Shi Yu was also deliberately attracting contestants from other places on the island!
“Let’s see which contestant is closer to contestant Shi Yu…”
The scene changed.
What entered the screen was a green pet more than three meters tall. It looked like a large sparrow. Although it looked like a bird, if one observed carefully, they could tell that it wasn’t an animal, because its body and every feather was like a green tornado, fluttering messily.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (2)
< Name > Tornado Sparrow
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
< Introduction > It’s a wind-element life form. It can create a tornado with a flap of its wings. It’s extremely dangerous!
On this Dragon Tornado Sparrow rode a fully armed young man in a green battle suit. Everyone recognized him at a glance. After all, there were only 21 contestants in total. There were too few people.
“It’s the captain of the school team of Spirit Capital University, Li Qiu and his pet, the Dragon Tornado Sparrow!!”
Spirit Capital, the capital of elements, produced elemental pets. As the representative of Spirit Capital University, Li Qiu’s trump card pet was also an elemental life form, and it was the Tornado Sparrow known for its speed and destructive power.
At this moment, not only were Li Qiu and the Dragon Tornado Sparrow attracted by the fragrance, but they were also attracted from afar by the huge lightning just now. For a moment, Li Qiu and the Dragon Tornado Sparrow actually didn’t think that there were contestants nearby. Such a charming fragrance made the Dragon Tornado Sparrow’s heart pound. It only made them think that some natural treasure had appeared nearby.
However, the Blood-eating Ants, Killer Bees, Gale Sparrows, and other ferocious beasts everywhere nearby also made their hair stand on end and they shuddered.
“Something’s wrong, something’s wrong, something’s wrong. It’s definitely not as simple as the birth of a natural treasure. From the looks of it, they seemed to have fainted from the lightning. What exactly happened? For safety’s sake, we can’t go. Let’s observe and hide first.”
Li Qiu felt a sense of danger.
“Jiu!!!” However, when the Tornado Sparrow smelled the fragrance, it really couldn’t hold it in anymore. Its entire body was restless and uneasy. Under the surging airflow, the strong wind made Li Qiu’s lower body hurt.
Delicious!!!
The Dragon Tornado Sparrow shouted.
“Bear with it. With such a big commotion, the other contestants will definitely be attracted over. We can’t act rashly first!!”
Li Qiu didn’t have the strength of Gao Xuan and Shi Yu, so he didn’t dare to relax too much.
The restriction of his thoughts didn’t make him think that someone was deliberately fishing.
“Silly child, run, run quickly. Ah, right, right, right, don’t go. Turn around and leave now. Don’t be curious!!!” The teachers and students of Spirit Capital University said to their representatives in their hearts.
The principal of Spirit Capital University didn’t think that his student could defeat that little monster, Shi Yu.
At the first year of university, he had already contracted two overlord species pets, and they weren’t ordinary overlord races. What kind of monster was this? Why did Ancient Capital University pick it up?
Just from the battle results of entering the top 100 in the Sequence battle of Shi Yu, it could be determined that apart from Gao Xuan, the others were definitely not Shi Yu’s match.
“Although Li Qiu and contestant Shi Yu are the contestants with the greatest hope of encountering each other at the moment, Li Qiu doesn’t seem to have any intention of continuing to explore the truth. At the moment, there’s still a certain distance between them. If he maintains this, I wonder when they will encounter each other.”
When the host, Han Lu, saw that Li Qiu didn’t follow the direction of the fragrance and continued exploring the commotion just now, she couldn’t help but say regretfully.
“Wait, wait a minute. Although contestant Li Qiu hid in the valley and didn’t continue forward, contestant Shi Yu and the others seem to have suddenly looked in the direction of contestant Li Qiu!!”
In the scene, Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng, and Eleven, who were standing on Shi Yu’s shoulder, looked into the distance in Li Qiu’s direction.
Transcendent super vision.
With their extremely powerful reconnaissance skills, Baby Ginseng and Eleven sensed the powerful monarch-level energy wave that suddenly approached.
Although their figures couldn’t be seen at all, the monarch-level energy wave that spread could be clearly “seen” by Shi Yu and the others.
“The first opponent is here, but unfortunately, it’s not Gao Xuan,” Shi Yu thought.
Let’s get rid of the other party first…
Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided to take the initiative to attack.
Although the other party seemed to be hiding very far, Shi Yu’s pet could reach this distance quickly.
Apart from Baby Ginseng.
“Contestant Shi Yu is indeed looking in the direction of Li Qiu’s candidate…”
“Could it be that he discovered the other party? This distance… is unbelievable. Everyone, look, contestant Shi Yu has summoned a new pet again!!”
Three blue summoning arrays appeared around Shi Yu.
Under the dazzling light, Shi Yu’s other three pets also appeared in the audience’s vision!
The first thing to come out of the summoning array was a beautiful butterfly-type creature with gorgeous and exquisite blue wings that were less than the size of a palm.
The moment they saw this pet, although its size didn’t match, everyone still determined what kind of creature it was immediately!
Mid-level overlord race, Butterfly of Imagination!
For the first time, it was this pet that allowed Shi Yu’s name to be widely spread throughout the country. For the first time, Shi Yu’s personal potential was evaluated as someone with a super rare pet that could potentially become a legend!
Apart from the Butterfly of Imagination, not many people had seen Shi Yu’s other two pets.
One was a red fire sword spirit in the form of a spirit body.
This sword spirit was also very pocket-sized. Like Baby Ginseng, Mini Eleven, and the Butterfly of Imagination, it was less than the size of a palm and very small.
As Shi Yu’s pets were all at full level at multiplication, unless the racial characteristics were especially obvious, such as ginseng babies and iron-eating beasts, it was difficult for the audience to clearly determine what pet it was.
However, as expected, the group of pets in the form of babies immediately caused a wide discussion.
[It’s all in the form of a baby. Big Boss Shi Yu definitely has the heart of a girl.]

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (3)
[What girl’s heart? Didn’t you see the giant Nine Li Battle Beast just now? Didn’t you see the normal-sized Butterfly of Imagination? They’re all so handsome, alright? You lost if you were deceived by their appearance.]
[Holy shit, is that a Water Slime???]
Apart from Buggy and Chi Tong, Susu was also summoned.
Originally, the little sword spirit of an unknown race should have caused the most discussion and let people discuss what pet this was.
However, Susu quickly stole Chi Tong’s limelight.
The reason was not that no one knew it, but because they knew the Slime race too well, so they were very stunned.
“Contestant Shi Yu summoned three more pets!! One is the Butterfly of Imagination, the other is a fire-element sword spirit, and the other is the Water Slime?”
Water Slime, a pet of transcendent race.
Although it was much stronger than the Green Silkworm and the Dragon Carp and was even rarer in Dong Huang, this couldn’t let it escape the fact that it was at the bottom of the elemental food chain.
No one was surprised that Shi Yu had broken through to the master level and could contract five pets. However, Shi Yu, who had contracted two overlord races, had given a contract slot to a pet like the Water Slime. Many people were extremely confused.
[No, you can’t judge a book by its cover. Have you forgotten about the transcendent ginseng baby just now???]
[A transcendent ginseng baby that can instantly attract 100,000 ferocious beasts, is this reasonable? It’s probably a thousand-year-old ginseng!]
[This Water Slime must also be terrifyingly strong. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been contracted by Big Boss Shi Yu!]
That was right. The initial form of the Nine Li Battle Beast, the initial form of the Green Silkworm of the Butterfly of Imagination, and that ginseng baby didn’t look like very powerful pets. However, the few in Shi Yu’s hands clearly looked different from other Iron-eating Beasts, other Green Silkworms, and other ginseng babies. This Water Slime was definitely in the same situation.
At this moment, countless spectators were more willing to believe that this Water Slime was also very unusual. However, they were more curious about what was so extraordinary about this Water Slime that Shi Yu could contract it.
With this thought in mind, everyone continued watching.
In the scene, Shi Yu carried Baby Ginseng and called Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Susu.
“Buggy, you’re in charge of guarding the east.”
“Eleven, you guard the west.”
“Chi Tong, you guard the south.”
“Susu, guard the north. I’ll leave that enemy to you.”
The Four Holy Beasts, Green Worm Buggy, White Panda Eleven, Fire Bird Chi Tong, Turtle Shell Susu. Perfect!
“Baby Ginseng, continue to release your fragrance here. Next, ferocious beasts and contestants will come from all directions. As long as ferocious beasts and contestants enter your vision, deal with them. Don’t place them on me and Baby Ginseng. Let’s see who can defeat more opponents. The prizes for eliminating contestants and dealing with monarch-level ferocious beasts are all yours. They’ll be divided according to number.”
“In that case, it’s more efficient than moving together.”
“Wu?” “Wu?” “Mi?” “Ning?”
The four pets were stunned and then full of energy.
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng cried. Why couldn’t it go? Why did it have to continue releasing fragrance as bait? It could fight too!!
“Of course, the final reward will definitely be divided with Baby Ginseng. It’s all up to it to gather monsters.”
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng was delighted. That was more like it. This was what it meant to be lying down and winning?
Moreover, two overlords had already been blown up. Baby Ginseng was indeed not interested in the small characters here!
After Shi Yu made the arrangements, the four pets started moving.
Electricity lingered around Eleven’s body. It used electromagnetic levitation and flew with the power of lightning. It instantly turned into a lightning afterimage and flew west.
As for Buggy, it teleported and instantly disappeared from the spot, heading east.
Chi Tong made a “Mi” sound and burned the power of the Sun Flame, turning into an orange-red sword light that flew south.
As for Susu, it didn’t have their speed. Its speed was only one level faster than Baby Ginseng. However, this was merely the speed ranking in the team. Buggy had Instant Transmission, and Eleven and Chi Tong had full-level speed racial skills. Susu naturally couldn’t compare. But outside the team, its speed was also very terrifying.
After all, it was an elemental creature. After mastering the ability of elementalization, it was basically a flying expert. It wasn’t something Baby Ginseng could compare to with its speed of condensing wings with grass.
“Ning!!”
With a whoosh, Susu compressed the huge water elemental power onto its body and compressed itself into a high-speed water spear that shot out. In an instant, it also turned into a blue afterimage, like a high-speed shooting star, and flew fiercely in the direction it wanted to guard.
Because Susu was at the bottom of the team in the previous internal competition, in order to take care of Susu, Shi Yu gave it a battle result for free. Just now, the area where they had captured the contestants was the north where Susu was about to go!
“Eh!!!” At the same time, Shi Yu summoned all his pets in one go and sent out four of them, including the powerful overlord race, the Butterfly of Imagination, and the Nine Li Battle Beast. The scene directly shocked all the audience and made the host speechless.
He… He actually… scattered his pets??
Was he letting his pets find someone to fight on their own?!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (4)
“Contestant Shi Yu, after he summoned all his pets, he actually sent four of them out, leaving only a ginseng baby beside him! What does he want to do!”
In the contestant area of Spirit Capital University, the ten elites who participated in the team battle and hundreds of teachers and students looked at the Water Slime that turned into a water afterimage and flew towards the north towards Li Qiu in shock. For a moment, their brains couldn’t process it.
The other pets were alright. There were no contestants or active ferocious beasts in a certain range, but the Water Slime was quickly approaching Li Qiu.
The speed of the water jet was actually much faster than the tornado sparrow just now!
Swoosh!
Soon, the Water Slime Susu shot into the sky above Li Qiu. Then, it suddenly landed and looked at the enemy!!
The creature that suddenly descended also shocked Li Qiu and his Dragon Tornado Sparrow, who were hiding on the ground and silently observing the situation. Then, they saw the… Water Slime that landed on the ground?
“Wh-what’s going on?” Li Qiu and the Tornado Sparrow looked at the Water Slime that had descended without anyone noticing with stunned expressions.
Water Slime?
When?
At this moment, in the valley surrounded by mountain walls, Li Qiu stood on the ground with the Tornado Sparrow beside him. The two had already left their riding state, and the Water Slime landed opposite them and faced them.
Seeing the Water Slime sent by Shi Yu descend beside Li Qiu from afar, apart from Li Qiu, who still didn’t know what was going on, the audience behind the scenes widened their eyes in disbelief.
Holy shit, Shi Yu, the Beast Tamer himself, didn’t move. He directly sent a pet to snipe Li Qiu???
He had indeed discovered Li Qiu, right!!
However, was he serious about only sending one Water Slime?
Don’t tell them that this Water Slime’s growth level had also been cultivated to the monarch level by Shi Yu!!
Although the contestants of the individual competition were all outstanding figures of the nine major universities, among these masters, two to three monarch-level pets were considered outstanding.
All five contracted were at the monarch level. That situation was very, very rare.
Moreover, even if it reached the monarch level, did it have to fight one against six and deal with Li Qiu and his other five pets he contracted?
The confrontation between the captain of Spirit Capital University, Li Qiu, and the Water Slime sent by Shi Yu immediately made all the spectators who were paying attention to the individual preliminaries of the National League swallow their saliva.
“Ning!!!” In the next moment, the Water Slime in the scene erupted with strong power, instantly making Li Qiu and the Dragon Tornado Sparrow’s pupils shrink.
Boom!!!
It was as if an invisible blue tsunami erupted from the Water Slime’s body!
As it looked at its opponent, the surrounding air began to hum and vibrate. A substantial deterrence wave formed a blue deterrence aura around it. This scene suddenly made Li Qiu and the tornado cloud reveal extremely serious expressions.
Monarch aura, expert in deterrence?
Water Slime, how was this possible!
A terrifying deterrence wave spread!
“Tornado Sparrow,” Li Qiu called.
Li Qiu’s Dragon Tornado Sparrow was not to be trifled with either. It also instantly erupted with a strong deterrence wave. It was actually also an expert-level deterrence. The almost substantial green deterrence aura quickly pressed down on the Water Slime.
But…
Crack.
With the Water Slime as the center, the deterrence that spread out cracked the surrounding ground and rocks. Li Qiu and the Dragon Tornado Sparrow’s gazes were immediately shocked to the extreme.
It wasn’t expert level deterrence.
It was a perfect-level deterrence that could materialize and cause physical destruction!!!
Boom!
The monarch aura erupted by the Dragon Tornado Sparrow was immediately shattered. A terrifying deterrence enveloped the Dragon Tornado Sparrow and Li Qiu.
The Dragon Tornado Sparrow’s spiritual consciousness instantly trembled. It directly felt a suffocating terrifying aura. It looked at the little creature in front of it in disbelief, its face filled with incomprehension. Its mental state was seriously affected.
As for Li Qiu, he wasn’t much better. The defensive pendant equipment on his chest trembled violently and swayed. It even showed signs of cracking, making Li Qiu’s face pale. It was a little difficult for him to do anything else. His thoughts and movements were restricted.
At the same time, dazzling water waves gathered in the Water Slime’s mouth and wrapped around it with shocking deterrence.
Transcendent Level Deterrence, Deterrence Entanglement!
At this moment, Li Qiu’s pupils constricted again as he felt an incomparable threat.
“F*ck, it’s not perfect, it’s transcendent. What the hell!!!” he shouted.
Then, its body erupted with powerful potential. As it resisted the deterrence with difficulty, it erupted with all its strength and used its wind-element strengthening talent on the Tornado Sparrow!
Buzz!
The aura of the Dragon Tornado Sparrow rose steadily. In the blink of an eye, its strength far exceeded before.
However, as the terrifying water that had been compressed to the extreme moved in the Water Slime, Li Qiu and the Tornado Sparrow were not at ease at all.
Boom!!!
Deterrence Armor, Water Element Control, Water Cannon!
It was fired!
The blue light flowed in the Water Slime’s mouth and eyes. With a boom, it was incomparably thick and its speed was astonishing. It compressed the water cannon the size of a sea and directly locked onto the Tornado Sparrow with deterrence and attacked.
“Jiu!!!” At this moment, under the two levels of deterrence lock-on, the Tornado Sparrow still found it difficult to move. It could only condense the “Jade of Wind” in its mouth with difficulty and use a compressed and spiral huge wind ball to resist this water cannon.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: The Lucky Person Who Was Crushed by the Slime (5)
However, this water cannon was, after all, Susu gathering the power of nature and mobilizing the sea stored in its body. It was also wrapped in a powerful attack of deterrence. It was not something the opponent could block at all. Even after being strengthened by the Beast Tamer, the energy value of this Dragon Tornado Sparrow was still less than half of Susu’s.
ZIn the face of this attack that contained terrifying deterrence and water-element power, the moment the white Wind Jade made contact with it, it was immediately like a balloon falling into a waterfall. It was torn into pieces by the water and finally swallowed.
The water cannon hit the Tornado Sparrow.
In an instant, under the Dragon Tornado Sparrow’s sudden expression, its entire body was swallowed by the water cannon and charged into the distance!
Boom…
The entire valley shook!
Because the water cannon directly charged the Dragon Tornado Sparrow into the mountain wall. The moment the two parties touched, the entire mountain instantly collapsed because of this water cannon. The rumbling sound was like a tsunami and an earthquake.
The mountain wall cracked, the ground rumbled, and a storm fell from the sky. Scattered deterrence waves flew in all directions, and the Tornado Sparrow slowly sank into the newly formed small lake, accompanying the gravel. Its expression was tragic, and it completely lost its ability to fight.
As for Li Qiu, who had brushed past the water cannon, he also stood on the spot in a daze. He felt the cry of the Dragon Tornado Sparrow that had lost its battle power, and his mind went blank.
“Ning! (Surrender!)” Seeing that this Beast Tamer wasn’t very smart, and that his reaction was slower under the deterrence… It didn’t continue attacking and was extremely considerate.
At this moment, Li Qiu had indeed lost his ability to think. He didn’t understand what this Water Slime was.
It was a wild ferocious beast, right? But then, which wild ferocious beast looked like this and was so strong?
Li Qiu had never heard of anyone contracting a Water Slime, and it was a Water Slime with such abnormal strength. Most importantly, he had never even seen this little guy’s Beast Tamer.
At this moment, Li Qiu was unwilling to face the truth. He only felt that he was still in a dream. The National League would only begin tomorrow.
Although the other spectators didn’t have their values shattered as directly as Li Qiu, when they saw a Water Slime erupt with such powerful strength and instantly kill the high-level monarch-level Dragon Tornado Sparrow that had been strengthened by the Beast Tamer in one hit, their minds also rumbled and they were extremely shocked.
“This, this, this, this…”
“I’m a little doubting my eyes now.”
The two commentators were once again unable to explain the situation in front of them.
“This is a f*cking Water Slime???”
At that moment, as the encounter between the Water Slime and Li Qiu turned into a conflict and ended with Li Qiu being crushed, the teachers and students of Spirit Capital University were confused. This, this, this, who could tell them what was going on!!
It was fine if Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination was strong, but why was this Water Slime so unscientific!!
Everyone looked at the Tornado Sparrow that was insta-killed.
This was undoubtedly Li Qiu’s trump card. It had been insta-killed. They didn’t doubt at all that even if Li Qiu summoned all his pets, he still couldn’t escape the fact that he would be killed and shattered by this Water Slime.
This was not the same dimension at all.
Silly child, they told him to run, why didn’t he listen? Look, wasn’t he going to be the first unlucky person to be eliminated? Moreover, he was eliminated alone by a pet raised by the Beast Tamer. How depressed would he be if he knew the truth after coming out?
In the previous National League, under the same level of monarchs, only Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast had such strength.
But this time… there was a random Water Slime??
Not only Spirit Capital University, but the teachers and students of the other universities also looked at the scene in shock. Only the Imperial Capital and Ancient Capital University were extremely silent. They only felt that this situation was both familiar and unfamiliar.
Obviously, this didn’t make sense!

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Butterfly with Physical Strength of a Dragon
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Butterfly with Physical Strength of a Dragon
“Too strong…”
“Contestant Shi Yu’s pet has refreshed our understanding again!”
Regardless of whether it was scientific or not, since it had happened, it was reasonable.
Han Lu and Gu Yu, the two commentators, looked at the Water Slime in the scene in shock, as well as the shattered rock.
“Transcendent Level Deterrence!”
“A water spear with power comparable to a tsunami!”
“Not only did it easily defeat the Dragon Tornado Sparrow, but it also relied on the impact of the water to instantly collapse a mountain wall and drown it into a lake!”
“Is this still the Water Slime? Is it really that transcendent elemental creature?”
“This level of deterrence, this level of elemental control… I even believe that it’s the Slime King. No, even the Slime King can’t do this!”
The Slime King was the only high-level life form of the Slime race. It was a monarch race, but its evolution method was unknown. Only slimes that were born as a Slime King had been discovered.
Moreover, Shi Yu’s Water Slime looked like a normal Water Slime. It was completely different from the Slime King.
“Is there really such a water slime?” The two commentators asked the three big shots on the platform.
They couldn’t understand how a Water Slime could be so strong unless it used water-element legendary resources.
The audience also couldn’t understand why Shi Yu’s pets were so ridiculous.
Similarly, this time, the three big shots on the platform were speechless again.
This was the first time Shi Yu had publicly sent the Water Slime to battle.
Apart from a few people, the others didn’t know the situation of this water slime at all.
At this moment, on the platform, President Xia looked at the camera and slowly said,
“I only know that contestant Shi Yu’s Water Slime was contracted in the East Sea Dragon Palace City.”
“Obviously, it might not be as simple as an ordinary Water Slime.”
When President Xia finished speaking, everyone was speechless.
Dragon Palace City?
As long as it was a Beast Tamer who had passed their history test, they naturally knew where that was.
It was all thanks to a huge monster like Dragon Palace City that the sea area of Dong Huang was so peaceful.
That was the paradise of the dragons.
There had been several Dragon Kings in history that shocked the sea.
There were countless ocean overlords.
Shi Yu’s Water Slime was contracted in Dragon Palace City???
Upon hearing that this pet had the background of Dragon Palace City, the audience instantly fell silent. The information they could obtain was that Shi Yu had been to Dragon Palace City, but if he was qualified to go to such a place, he undoubtedly had a chance to see more rare pets, even purebred dragons. In this situation, Shi Yu had only contracted one Water Slime. What exactly was this Water Slime…
Perhaps there was no need to be puzzled at all, because the battle just now very well explained the power of this Water Slime. If it were any other Beast Tamer, they wouldn’t mind such a Water Slime.
[It’s too exaggerated. I’ll even believe it if he says that this Water Slime is the illegitimate son of a totem dragon king in Dragon Palace City!!!]
[Me too, I heard that totem-level creatures can change their race at will. Could this Water Slime really be a totem descendant?]
[So annoying… I want such a Water Slime too!]
In the audience of Ancient Capital University, Principal Feng chuckled.
What were they thinking?
Be bold!
This was the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite!
Of course, this matter was very important, so Principal Feng couldn’t reveal more.
Compared to now, Principal Feng looked at the screen.
He hoped that one day, after this Water Slime really obtained the name of the Blue Sea Sprite, Shi Yu could still control it to fight!
At that time, Shi Yu’s name would be comparable to the legends of Dong Huang!
…
The competition had already ended before it even started. What kind of experience was this?
As Li Qiu didn’t have telepathy and couldn’t understand Susu’s words, he wouldn’t surrender. Without a doubt, he was directly shattered by Susu.
A bubble skill sent Li Qiu to heaven.
Then, the Eye of the Stars took charge of the aftermath.
As the first contestant to be eliminated, Li Qiu from Spirit Capital University was completely brought back to the East Sea Arena in a daze.
Even when he was sent back, he didn’t know what that Water Slime was.
“I’m…”
In the East Sea Arena, when the Eye of the Stars clone teleported Li Qiu back, Li Qiu stood on the arena, feeling the gazes of the 100,000 spectators in the arena and looking at everything in confusion.
“Contestant Li Qiu…”
At this moment, the comforting voices of Gu Yu and Han Lu came from the screen.
“Contestant Li Qiu unfortunately encountered the pet water slime sent by contestant Shi Yu. After a defeat, he was judged by the judge to be eliminated. It’s too regretful.”
“Looks like… the first contestant to be eliminated has appeared!”
“Contestant Li Qiu is already cautious enough. In the face of the fragrance and commotion emitted by contestant Shi Yu to lure his opponent, he maintained enough vigilance.”
“Unfortunately, contestant Shi Yu still discovered him and sent out a terrifying Water Slime!”
“Forget about Li Qiu. Someone seems to be heading towards Shi Yu again.” The comments flooded the screen.
Li Qiu: “?”
What the f*ck???
What were the two of you explaining just now? Say it again?
“Wu wu wu Li Qiu, my Li Qiu…” In the audience seats of Spirit Capital University, the juniors who supported Captain Li Qiu cried and said,” That Water Slime is so strong and cute. ”
The school leaders of Spirit Capital University were silent. Their team leader was the first to be eliminated. They didn’t know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (1)
Was Li Qiu weak?
In terms of pet growth level, there was naturally nothing to say about the monarch level.
In terms of race level, apart from Shi Yu, Gao Xuan was the only one among the students of the nine major universities who had contracted an overlord race pet. Therefore, high-level monarchs were already the top batch, they were naturally not weak.
In addition, Li Qiu could strengthen the pet’s energy level to more than two million through the pretty good talent he developed. Among the master-level contestants of the nine major universities, he was definitely not weak.
Therefore, it was completely because the other party was too abnormal.
At this moment, Li Qiu clearly realized how much he had experienced.
Li Qiu listened to the key words “Shi Yu”, “the Water Slime sent out”, and “the first to be eliminated”. He also saw the Water Slime standing on the huge rock and looking at the sky. His gaze and mentality slowly changed from confusion to explosion…
His expression gradually became ferocious.
“Ah…”
Damn, that Water Slime was Shi Yu’s???
