The school leaders of Spirit Capital University cast comforting gazes.
[It’s alright, it’s alright… As long as the other schools are as miserable next, no one will care about our Spirit Capital University.]
[Look, aren’t the unlucky people from the other schools also heading in the direction of Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng?]
In fact, that was the case.
Those who were closer to Shi Yu were all pretty unlucky. Li Qiu wouldn’t be the last.
At this moment, the only thing that comforted the teachers and students of Spirit Capital University was that another figure was gradually approaching Shi Yu from the east. Clearly, it was also attracted by the commotion.
“It’s the vice-captain of the school team of Divine Capital University, Chu Yi’ang.”
The principal of Spirit Capital University’s tone was filled with joy.
On the side of Divine Capital University, when they saw their contestant rushing over second, their expressions immediately changed.
It was a huge dragon lizard with a horn that looked like a golden crown, and its body was covered in golden feathers. It flew in mid-air with a hedgehog-headed young man sitting on its rough body.
At this moment, the feather dragon and the young man were communicating in confusion.
“Roar… (There’s no mistake, it’s a lightning-element natural treasure!)”
“Roar… (The birth of thunder-element natural treasures is often accompanied by lightning. This taste, this array, will definitely be a resource above level-seven!)”
The Feather Dragon crazily painted a beautiful picture for its Beast Tamer. Go, go, go. As long as it obtained this, it would earn more than crushing ten monarch-level ferocious beasts.
“The competition authorities also arranged for natural treasures to be fought over by the contestants? Could it be that they want to use this method to stimulate the conflict between the contestants and accelerate the competition? If that’s the case, there might be other contestants nearby who will be attracted over. We can’t be careless. Be careful.”
As for Chu Yi’ang, he also believed in the feather dragon. The two of them carefully went over.
“It’s the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon and Chu Yi’ang!”
< Name > Thunder Crown Feather Dragon
[Race Level]: High-level monarch (Quasi overlord)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
“Not good, that direction is…”
After many teachers and students from Divine Capital University compared them, they silently discovered that their contestant, Chu Yi’ang, and his pet were flying in the direction of Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination!
If it was said that before this, when Shi Yu was mentioned, the first pet people thought of was definitely the Butterfly of Imagination!
This pet that allowed Shi Yu to be evaluated as having legendary aptitude… That was displaying incomparable light at the Butterfly Meeting and the Feeding Conference…
“I didn’t expect that less than half an hour after the competition, there would be consecutive encounters!”
“I have to say that contestant Shi Yu’s strategy has had a very good effect. According to our observation, a large number of contestants are gathering in this direction. Among them, the vice-captain of Divine Capital University, Chu Yi’ang, is the second contestant to encounter Shi Yu after contestant Li Qiu!”
The two commentators were very excited.
This was the first time they were explaining such a national competition.
They also admitted that Shi Yu really knew how to play.
This kind of direct battle with all contestants and ferocious beasts, telling the other party “I’m right here”, was too crude.
“However, the one who’s about to encounter contestant Chu Yi’ang and the others won’t be contestant Shi Yu himself, but another pet he sent in this direction, the Butterfly of Imagination!”
“Everyone is definitely not unfamiliar with the Butterfly of Imagination. This is one of the pets representing contestant Shi Yu. It’s a powerful butterfly-type creature with both mental and spatial attributes.”
“I wonder what kind of sparks will fly after it encounters contestant Chu Yi’ang…”
Glass Island, in mid-air.
Chu Yi’ang was riding the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon when they suddenly stopped. The Thunder Crown Feather Dragon and Chu Yi’ang instantly revealed serious expressions.
“Roar!!!”
The Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s Thunder Crown was like a radar that could sense the surrounding situation through electromagnetic waves. Just now, they sensed the change in a powerful spatial magnetic field wave. A very strong ferocious beast was attacking!
Buzz!!!
Just as Chu Yi’ang and the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon sensed the change and retreated crazily, with a bang, under the spatial ripples, a huge butterfly-type creature descended!!!
A huge butterfly about four to five meters tall slowly appeared with a strong pressure.
It had incomparably huge wings. The entire surface of the wings was like white waves surging on the blue sea. Its color and patterns were very spectacular, like a piece of art!
At this moment, a string of beautiful white halos embedded at the edge of the huge butterfly’s blue sky-like wings shone. It was very dazzling and gorgeous. The moment it descended, its gorgeous figure instantly shocked Chu Yi’ang and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (2)
At this moment, Buggy was overjoyed.
He didn’t expect himself to be so lucky to encounter a bonus so quickly.
Buggy was very happy, but Chu Yi’ang and the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon were not very happy.
The Butterfly of Imagination?! Why?!
Holy shit.
“As expected, there were other contestants nearby who were attracted by the natural treasures. This pet…”
“This pet is… Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination!”
There were only 21 contestants in the individual competition. Chu Yi’ang had memorized almost all the known pet information of the contestants, let alone a celebrity pet like Buggy. It was instantly recognized by Chu Yi’ang.
After leaving Shi Yu, as it was going to fight, Buggy returned to its normal state, so it was not difficult for the other party to recognize it.
No, compared to normal, to be precise, it was called battle mode now.
The battle state of the Dragon of Imagination!
At the moment, Buggy was doing training to transform the Dragon of Imagination state into its normal state. Compared to Eleven and the others’ explosive skills, its Dragon of Imagination, as long as it didn’t use high-level props to exceed its limit, was actually not that difficult to bear now. It was easier to use than Eleven’s Inner Power, Chi Tong’s Infinite Converging Sword, and Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit.
Most importantly, after transforming into a dragon’s physique, it could specially magnify the advantage of a certain dragon race, such as the advantage of a dragon with powerful recovery abilities, to make up for its endurance. For example, if it transformed its physique into the physique of the Sky Dragon God, just eating air could recover its physical fitness. Of course, with Buggy’s current ability, it definitely couldn’t do a perfect transformation, but even if it replicated a trace of its physique, it would benefit infinitely.
These were all the benefits of visualizing the Dragon God Statue, giving Buggy various choices that approached perfection.
If Buggy’s stats were like this: life force (extremely low), energy value (medium), physique (extremely low), then in the Dragon of Imagination state, it was this: life force (extremely high), energy value (extremely high), physique (extremely high), and was extremely ferocious.
Such a ferocious quality naturally made the enemy feel a strong threat.
In an instant, Chu Yi’ang didn’t say anything else. Although he didn’t know why he didn’t see the Beast Tamer, he immediately ran as if this butterfly was a calamity!
No way!!
If it were other contestants, he might still fight, but Shi Yu… He couldn’t see through him. As one of the few overlord races in this competition, only a fool would fight head-on!
However, Chu Yi’ang also seemed to feel that running was useless.
Therefore, the moment the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon and he turned around, another Thunder Crown Feather Dragon instantly appeared between them and the Butterfly of Imagination!
“Look, contestant Chu Yi’ang and contestant Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination have met! However, contestant Chu Yi’ang doesn’t seem to have any intention of fighting. Instead, he immediately turned and left. However, in order to stop the Butterfly of Imagination, he used his Beast Taming Talent, ‘Clone’!”
“The Beast Taming Talent, ‘Clone’, is similar to the pet’s Clone Skill, but not completely the same. Through this Clone Talent, the Beast Tamer can create a clone with 100% perfect replication of the pet’s strength. However, the duration of this clone depends on the Beast Tamer’s physical fitness. At the moment, the new Thunder Crown Feather Dragon is clearly the clone of contestant Chu Yi’ang’s Thunder Crown Feather Dragon. Although it’s a clone, it also has a completely similar strength!”
“I wonder if this Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s clone can buy some time for contestant Chu Yi’ang’s tactical retreat…”
The scene on the screen turned into a confrontation between the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon and the Butterfly of Imagination in the blink of an eye.
The audience took a deep breath.
Most people had only heard of the Butterfly of Imagination, but they had never seen it fight.
Spirit, space, what kind of sparks could these two attributes create?
Only some spectators from Imperial Capital University thought of some bad memories.
In order to buy enough time for Chu Yi’ang to retreat, the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s entire body was surrounded by blue-purple flames as it attacked the Butterfly of Imagination!
“Roar!!!—”
Suddenly, the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s flying speed increased, releasing an aura that made the air tremble. With a whoosh, it tore through the air, and its flying speed turned into an afterimage. At the same time, blue-purple flames surged all over its body, and the flames all over its body led the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s flying speed. The aura filled with killing intent was mixed with the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s faith. Seeing this scene, the audience immediately recognized this unique skill.
“It’s a super skill, Dragon Charge!!!” The two commentators said, “A dragon-element ultimate skill that can cause physical and elemental damage!!”
“The incomparable physique of the dragons, together with their unique dragon energy, dragon-type skills have always been synonymous with destructive power!”
The blazing blue and purple dragon figure surged forward.
Although Dragon Charge was a dragon-type skill, it also had some fire and lightning properties. It was very easy to cause burning and paralysis effects. It was a very threatening skill.
This powerful move was definitely not to be touched by bugs, especially weak bugs like butterflies.
Even overlord-level butterfly-type creatures were unwilling to be attacked by the dragon-type skills of monarch-level dragons.
The audience understood this, so they subconsciously judged the next situation.
However, just as everyone thought that the Butterfly of Imagination would use its skill to counterattack violently or dodge through the strange spatial element, a shocking scene occurred.
The Butterfly of Imagination didn’t move on the spot, completely ignoring the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon that was charging towards it!!

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Butterfly with Physical Strength comparable to a Dragon (3)
That’s it?
Buggy wanted to despise the power of the other party’s unique skill. It couldn’t even compare to the power of its leader that didn’t use skills. In the empty dragon state, using other skills was a waste of energy.
Boom!!!
Because Buggy ignored it and let the skill collide, a huge explosion immediately came from the sky.
The Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s body trembled as it hit the Butterfly of Imagination, but the Butterfly of Imagination floated steadily in the sky without moving at all. Just now, it was like a grasshopper hitting an elephant, unable to cause any damage to it at all!
Sensing the huge reaction force and the pain in its body, the pupils of the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon clone constricted, and its heart was shocked to the extreme.
This scene was also shocked by a bunch of spectators and two commentators!
[Holy shit!!!]
[What’s going on??]
[The butterfly’s body resisted the ultimate move of a dragon-type creature??]
[Eye of the Stars, film it more carefully… Zoom in! Holy shit, it took the hit physically…]
[I’ll report it. This is not legal at all!!]
At this moment, all the Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast were shocked.
Then, an even more shocking scene occurred. The Butterfly of Imagination glanced at the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon clone. Then, its right wing flapped slightly, and its body came into contact with the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s body. In the next moment, the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s body directly caved in by a large half, as if a huge rock had violently pressed onto its flesh and blood. Almost instantly, the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s pupils turned completely white. Under the slap of the worm, its body fell towards the forest on the ground like a falling meteor!!
Boom!!!
Smoke rose, and the fallen Thunder Crown Feather Dragon directly scraped the ground, dragging a deep trench. It knocked over dozens of big trees in succession before the sound at the bottom fell silent.
There were no energy fluctuations the whole time. Buggy completed it with its physical strength.
This scene stunned many people.
[F*ck, Butterfly, killed the dragon with a slap!]
[Is this a f*cking butterfly? Legend Hua, who specializes in butterflies and cries weakly every day, is seriously protesting.]
The two commentators were also stunned.
At the same time, Chu Yi’ang, who had already walked a distance away, sensed the situation of the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon clone. His brain immediately rumbled, and his gaze was filled with disbelief and fear. Then, a scene that made its gaze explode appeared. From an incomparably far distance, his and the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s bodies were suddenly frozen by the blue Psychic light that appeared out of thin air!
“Roar!!!” The Thunder Crown Feather Dragon that was flying at high speed immediately roared loudly, but it was useless. Then, under Chu Yi’ang’s frightened expression, he separated from the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon he was riding. Then, under the control of Psychic power, with a boom, the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon’s main body was also smashed to the ground from the sky!
Boom!!!
The smoke rose again. This time, the power was even stronger. It still dragged out a deep ditch that was more than a hundred meters long. It knocked over dozens of big trees in succession before the sound at the bottom fell silent.
The forest surrounded by smoke looked like two meteorites had just fallen. It was a mess.
In the sky, Chu Yi’ang, who was frozen and couldn’t even see the figure of the Butterfly of Imagination, was directly scared silly, afraid that he would be accidentally crushed by the Butterfly of Imagination.
“F*ck, I admit defeat, I surrender…”
“Let go of me…”
“Another, another, another one.”
At the same time, looking at Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination that easily eliminated another contestant, the audience’s mouths were dry. As they sympathized with Chu Yi’ang, they felt even more deeply the horror of Shi Yu’s strength. This Butterfly of Imagination’s strength was even more f*cking unscientific!! This was the spiritual and spatial element? What was this physical strength, was it not the spiritual, spatial, and dragon elements?

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land
“The second one.”
In the center of the Yunying Mountain Range, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng sat quietly on the huge rock.
Susu had solved one, and Buggy had also solved one. Not bad.
“A little more.”
Shi Yu was happy to be free.
His leisure and smile fell into the eyes of the audience. He was completely a demon.
“Another, another, another one!”
“The pet sent by contestant Shi Yu has eliminated another contestant!”
“This is the Dong Huang Radio and Television Station. At the moment, it’s broadcasting the individual preliminaries of the National League for you. contestant Shi Yu’s pets are simply unbelievable. The weak butterfly-type creature actually insta-killed the dragon-type with just its physical body?”
“Even if its overlord race, this…”
The entire country’s audience was numb.
Especially those Beast Tamers who had cultivated the evolution form of the Green Silkworm Butterfly.
They summoned their butterflies and pinched their delicate skin. They were speechless.
[Butterflies: Excuse me???]
“Wu wu!”
The encounter between the Butterfly of Imagination and contestant Chu Yi’ang from Divine Capital University made the teachers and students of Spirit Capital University extremely excited.
Li Qiu, the captain of Spirit Capital University, sat back in the audience with a blank expression. He kept feeling that this scene was familiar.
Only the teachers and students of Divine Capital University had bitter expressions.
They knew that this pet that Shi Yu had contracted early couldn’t be weak.
However, they were really sad that Chu Yi’ang was insta-killed without being able to fight back.
At least hold on for a while…
As long as they successfully fought back a bit, Divine Capital University wouldn’t lose face. After all, everyone knew that Shi Yu was very strong and that he had entered the top 100 of the Sequence battle.
But… a dragon-type pet was shattered by a butterfly-type creature with just a wing. What was this?
Even if it was a clone, it was a clone that matched 100% of the main body’s strength. Moreover, the main body didn’t show off much. It was directly smashed down by someone’s Psychic power from ten thousand meters away… and insta-killed by a low-level mental skill.
How embarrassing!
Only Shi Yu, the gem cat, and a few others knew that this… was completely normal.
Chu Yi’ang didn’t have any strengthening talent. In terms of energy value, his Thunder Crown Feather Dragon wasn’t even two million. It was over-killed by Buggy several times. In addition, it was a mere alternative dragon. No matter how strong its physique was, compared to the perfect dragon physique that had absorbed the advantage of the demigod-level Dragon God physique, it was nothing in front of an expert.
This time, Gu Yu and Han Lu, the two commentators, also learned to be smart. They directly got the three big shots on the platform to explain this ridiculous phenomenon again.
After a moment of silence, President Xia said, “That’s why I said that contestant Shi Yu is a genius.”
“As everyone knows, Dr. Zuo successfully let the Green Silkworm obtain the Phoenix Race bloodline during the evolution process and evolve into an Ice Phoenix Moth with the characteristics of a Phoenix.”
“In fact, everyone should have heard of the natural phenomenon that appeared when contestant Shi Yu’s Green Silkworm evolved at the Butterfly Meeting. At that time, a divine dragon appeared.”
“Therefore, I think that contestant Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination might have used dragon-element resources to strengthen its physique when it evolved, and it succeeded!”
“For example, dragon blood and dragon balls are resources that can strengthen other lives and physiques. To be able to absorb such resources so perfectly during the evolution of the Green Silkworm, as expected of a genius researcher who can develop the evolution chain of the Green Silkworm cocoon…”
President Xia explained weakly, but that was the only explanation.
Everyone acknowledged and understood what he said, and they knew that it was the truth.
Everyone naturally saw the situation of the Butterfly Meeting.
However, the problem now was that Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination was no longer as simple as its physique being improved by dragon-element resources!
It was useless. It insta-killed a quasi overlord dragon type that was using a super dragon type skill!!
Even a divine dragon of the high-level overlord race couldn’t do it!
If dragon-element resources were so impressive, the price wouldn’t still be suppressed by time, space, and other attributes. Moreover, this Butterfly of Imagination was a spiritual and spatial attribute.
What resource could strengthen it so ridiculously?
“Wu wu wu, my Dragon Ball, my Dragon Ball.” President Xia touched the Gem Cat’s sore spot. As soon as he finished speaking, in the audience seats of Ancient Capital University, the gem cat immediately pressed its cat claws on its face and cried silently with tears streaming down its face. This, this, this was the Dragon God’s Dragon Ball!!
After Shi Yu learned the origin of the Dragon Ball from the Sea Dragon King, he didn’t hide it and openly told the gem cat. This telling was no different from adding fuel to the fire, almost causing the gem cat to have a heart attack and suddenly die.
If it had known that the dragon ball with the lost energy was the dragon ball of the Sea Serpent Dragon from countless years ago in Dragon Palace City, it would have signed a “hundred-year-old food contract” with Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng before giving it to Shi Yu no matter what, and not be tricked by the lousy fruit Shi Yu created with a few ginseng treasures at the commander level.
“Teacher Ying, are you uncomfortable?” Lin Xiuzhu saw the gem cat’s expression suddenly change, and her body twitched as she immediately said.
“I… I’m just crying from joy. I’m happy to see Buggy so powerful.”
“I’m happy too.” Lin Xiuzhu’s beautiful eyes flowed with anticipation. The Iron-eating Beast and Green Silkworm package should increase in price again!
At this moment.
The commentators, Gu Yu and Han Lu, suddenly exclaimed!!!
“Look.”
“The captain of Imperial Capital University, Gao Xuan, is also heading in the direction of Shi Yu and the others.”
“The distance between Gao Xuan and Shi Yu is much greater than the distance between contestant Li Qiu and contestant Chu Yi’ang against contestant Shi Yu.”

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (1)
“Just now, contestant Gao Xuan also easily hunted a monarch ferocious beast with lightning speed. After that, he seemed to have suddenly discovered something and immediately locked onto contestant Shi Yu’s direction!!”
At the moment, apart from those related to Shi Yu, the other contestants had yet to meet, let alone do something as tiring as hunting monarch-level ferocious beasts so quickly.
Only Gao Xuan hunted a tiger king in a forest.
In the scene, Gao Xuan was riding in the body of the huge Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. The huge silver mecha flew in the sky and passed by a forest. It was regarded by the monarch-level Thousand Rock Tiger King as an invader and was attacked.
“Roar!!” This king of beasts standing on the thousand rocks had a ferocious rock-like body. Its attacks were filled with rock blades.
“Finish it.” Gao Xuan and the others had very strong strength. Just like Shi Yu, they didn’t have to worry about their consumption after being targeted by a monarch-level ferocious beast.
Buzz ~
In the face of the Thousand Rock Tiger King’s Rock Flying Blade, a crystalline transparent protective wall automatically appeared on the outside of the huge Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast mecha. After instantly annihilating and absorbing all the flying rocks, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast slowly raised its mechanical palm. In the next moment, green flying dragon energy condensed!
Boom!!
“Roar!!!” The energy wave turned into a lifelike green flying dragon that instantly swallowed the Thousand Rock Tiger King at an extremely unbelievable speed. The aftermath of the move destroyed a large area of the mountain into ruins. The Thousand Rock Tiger King was naturally insta-killed without any surprise.
After that, something unexpected happened. Just as it finished dealing with the Thousand Rock Tiger King, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast suddenly raised its head and quickly rose into the sky to look into the distance.
At this moment, the fragrance had yet to spread to this place, and the lightning in the distance couldn’t be heard here either. It couldn’t be transmitted that far. However, because the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was a monarch-level mechanical pet, the top monarch-level mechanical pet had a stronger detection system. Its sensitivity to all changes was even stronger than Shi Yu’s pets who had mastered transcendent super vision.
“This is…”
“Now, contestant Gao Xuan seems to be flying in the direction of contestant Shi Yu. Did he sense something? I’m suddenly a little excited. Will the two contestants with the highest chances of winning the National League meet so early?”
“What will the outcome be after they meet?”
[Holy shit, Gao Xuan went for Shi Yu?]
[Are the two big shots going to love and kill each other so quickly?]
[Who will win, who will win!!]
[If it were before, I would have bet on the Gao Xuan team, but now… I feel that it will be a tragic battle. It’s hard to say.]
“Contestant Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast could dominate the National League with an absolute advantage a year ago.”
“It’s said that in order to prepare for this National League, he also prepared other secret trump cards!”
“As for contestant Shi Yu, he’s undoubtedly the super dark horse of the National League. Before the ranking of the Sequence Battle was announced and before the start of this National League, no one expected that contestant Shi Yu, who had just entered university, could enter the highest stage of the National League so forcefully.”
“However, I’m actually a little worried at this moment,” the commentator, Gu Yu, said. “At the moment, contestant Shi Yu’s pets are very scattered. In such a situation, if he encounters contestant Gao Xuan, will it have a disadvantageous impact on contestant Shi Yu?”
The commentator’s words made sense.
Everyone analyzed the current situation.
At the moment, Shi Yu had a total of five pets, and only one ginseng baby was beside him.
The distance between the other four and Shi Yu was almost increasing.
In such a situation, no matter which direction Gao Xuan came from, Shi Yu’s side was at a huge disadvantage.
[Big Boss Shi Yu probably wants to send four pets to guard the surroundings and defeat all the ‘bonuses’ that have been attracted over to pursue efficiency.]
[From the performance of the Iron-eating Beast, the Water Slime, and the Butterfly of Imagination, I think it’s alright… Of course, the premise is not to encounter Captain Gao.]
[Damn, isn’t Big Boss Shi Yu really worried that a certain pet will encounter Captain Gao alone or that a fish that escaped the net will break through and kill him and Baby Ginseng? Speaking of which, the defense power around Big Boss Shi Yu seems a little weak.]
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who was sitting alone with Baby Ginseng on the rock on the screen, and expressed their views.
As if in response to the expectations of countless spectators, the two commentators suddenly discovered the abnormality of the other contestants again!
“Demon Capital University contestant Shi Zhuo disappeared from the scene!!!” Han Lu explained in surprise.
“Contestant Shi Zhuo is also one of the few contestants closer to contestant Shi Yu. After sensing the commotion just now, he was also moving in the direction of contestant Shi Yu. However, suddenly, he seemed to have disappeared!”
“Let’s see the replay.”
In the scene.
A dark-skinned young man was riding a huge snake more than ten meters long on the ground.
This huge snake was silver-white all over, like metal. It had reddish-brown eyes and an extremely fierce appearance.
The young man stood on its head and rushed in the direction of the fragrance.
“Roar!!” This huge snake, like the Tornado Sparrow and the Thunder Crown Feather Dragon just now, lost its mind from the sweetness. It was very excited.
As for the young man, he seemed to have the intention of going to the venue to investigate. Compared to the other two, he was relatively calm, because he had the confidence to “successfully escape” even when facing Gao Xuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (2)
“It’s Shi Zhuo from Demon Capital University and his Iron Cliff Snake!!!”
Seeing this person, the teachers and students of the other universities were immediately stunned.
In the past two years, the level of the Beast Tamers of Demon Capital University was actually above Imperial Capital University. Unfortunately, Imperial Capital University had a cheat like Gao Xuan, so even if the students of other levels were stronger than Imperial Capital University, they couldn’t win the championship in the previous National League.
This year, the quality of the students of Demon Capital University was still not bad. This Shi Zhuo was one of the leading figures among the master contestants of Demon Capital University.
Of course, compared to Gao Xuan of Imperial Capital University, there was definitely a certain difference. After all, his ranking in the Sequence Battle was the same as the master contestants of other universities. They were all hundreds of places away and had suffered a loss because of their young age.
“It’s getting closer and closer. Iron Cliff Snake, Earth Escape.”
“Roar!!”
In the scene, following Shi Zhuo’s command, Shi Zhuo’s body was suddenly wrapped in crystals. Then, his entire body flowed into the body of the Iron Cliff Snake like liquid metal. Then, the incomparably huge Iron Cliff Snake suddenly stabbed into the ground!!
Boom.
In the blink of an eye, with a huge hole, the Iron Cliff Snake and Shi Zhuo disappeared from everyone’s vision. They entered the ground through the Earth Escape skill, planning to go to the scene in this way to see what was going on.
The transcendent Earth Escape skill was the reason why Shi Zhuo felt that Gao Xuan couldn’t keep him here. As long as he escaped quickly enough, unless the other party blew up the entire island, he might not be able to catch them with the obstruction of the ground!
Underground, the movement speed of the Iron Cliff Snake was comparable to that of a wind-element pet flying in the sky. Water-element pets swimming in the water were considered racial bonuses!
< Name > Iron Cliff Snake
[Attributes]: Metal, Earth
[Race Level]: High-level monarch (Quasi overlord)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
< Introduction > It’s a special elemental life form that lives deep underground. It’s the king of the earth. Its body, trained from underground pressure and high heat, is harder than any metal. Moreover, it’s extremely strong. With a flip, it can cause a strong earthquake and easily destroy a town.
“Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh!! So contestant Shi Zhuo chose to let the Iron Cliff Snake use the Earth Escape skill to secretly approach the source of the commotion.”
“Although we can’t see contestant Shi Zhuo’s location now, through the symbol of the Eye of the Star, everyone can determine the position of contestants through the ‘yellow dot’ on the big map.”
“Eh, wait a minute. At this moment, contestant Shi Zhuo’s position… Heavens, the four pets sent by contestant Shi Yu don’t seem to have discovered the Iron Cliff Snake deep underground. At this moment, they’re already closer to contestant Shi Yu’s location than the four pets sent by contestant Shi Yu!!”
“Something interesting is about to happen. Although contestant Shi Yu eliminated two contestants previously, these two have never seen Shi Yu in person. This time, contestant Shi Zhuo is going to be the first contestant to really come into contact with and encounter Shi Yu!!”
As this scene played, the East Sea Arena immediately erupted!
The first thought in countless people’s minds was that Shi Yu had gone too far!! He had failed!
Even if Shi Yu’s four pets’ reconnaissance abilities were pretty good, how could they be good at everything?
Look, didn’t this directly let Shi Zhuo and Iron Cliff Snake break through the four main forces and were about to snipe the Beast Tamer himself?
“A good opportunity!!!” The teachers and students of Demon Capital University were even more proud than the students of Spirit Capital and Divine Capital University.
After all, from the strength of the school to the strength of the contestants, they were not at the same level.
Although in a fair battle, Shi Yu’s strength was definitely better, this was not a fair battle, but a field battle.
If it was a sneak attack from underground… With the current combination of Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng, perhaps Shi Zhuo could really eliminate this monster that had caused a huge commotion just now!!
If that was the case, Demon Capital University would be hot stuff. Even if no one could win the national championship in the end, the might of Demon Capital University would be completely displayed.
“Not good!”
Unlike Demon Capital University, the teachers and students of Ancient Capital University began to feel a little nervous.
“Don’t, don’t panic. That ginseng baby isn’t simple either…”
However, there were also teachers and students who had seen Baby Ginseng fight in Ancient Capital University, but even so, they were still a little worried.
After all, that ginseng baby’s battle style seemed to be “Light Clearing Cannon” and “Explosive Fruit”?
From these two battle styles, if this ginseng baby was also at the monarch level, coupled with that strange sweet aura, it might indeed be able to fight the opponent in a head-on battle. However, the opponent was now ambushing!!
It directly passed through the defense line of Shi Yu’s other pets and came over without anyone noticing. This was not a head-on battle!
Therefore, it made sense for the teachers and students of Ancient Capital University to be a little nervous.
[It’s over, it’s over. Big Boss Shi Yu is going to fail.]
[It’s good to fail. It’s ridiculous to send all his battle power out just to leave a supplement beside him. I’ve long expected this scene.]
As the “yellow dot” on the map approached Shi Yu, many spectators held their breaths.
Holy shit, what would happen next?
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who was still sitting on the huge rock, recuperating, and Baby Ginseng, who was releasing a sweet aura. They felt nervous and their hearts raced.
“I know this Shi Zhuo. His Iron Cliff Snake is indeed extraordinary, especially in terms of Earth Escape. With some other skills, it can complete some special tactics without anyone noticing. Moreover, although it’s underground, they should know the situation on the ground like the back of their hand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (3)
On the platform, even President Xia, who had praised Shi Yu twice just now, became slightly serious.
“There’s a good show to watch…” Director Zhong Yan was also amused. He liked to see this kind of non-frontal encounter. This was the charm of a field battle.
“Why do I keep feeling that… the one in danger will be that Shi Zhuo…” Legend Xiao Shuang was silent.
Coupled with the battle results of Baby Ginseng crushing the two overlords, in addition to the fragrance performance just now, and… because of the mental connection with the Eye of the Stars, she knew very well that among Shi Yu’s pets, this Baby Ginseng was the strongest energy wave!
What would happen next…
“Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Dong Huang Radio and Television Station. Now, contestant Shi Zhuo is getting closer and closer to contestant Shi Yu… Next, double…”
As the commentator, Gu Yu, spoke, he was suddenly stunned. This was because in the scene, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng, who had been silent and maintained the same posture just now, suddenly changed their movements!
In the depths of the Yunying Mountain Range, Shi Yu stretched his shoulders slightly and stood up on the rock to stretch.
“Someone’s coming from the ground.”
“Yiya!! (Yes.)” Baby Ginseng beside him released its sweetness as it said.
“Yiya! (They’re really unreliable!)” Baby Ginseng patted its chest. At the critical moment, Shi Yu still had to rely on the great Ginseng!
“I did think of this possibility at the start, but I didn’t expect these contestants to be so showy,” Shi Yu said.
Eleven, Chi Tong, Buggy, Susu, and the others might not have noticed.
But it wasn’t a big problem. Baby Ginseng was different. Its perception of the ground was deeper.
The reason was very simple. It had the transcendent earth-element skill Strengthening and the Dao Proficiency earth-element racial skill Earth Chain. Coupled with its super vision, its perception of the underground was not something Eleven and the others could compare to.
So be it… Shi Yu thought about it. Should he play with the other party?
In fact, Shi Yu was not worried about his safety at all.
At this moment, he was wearing a water drop pendant on his neck. This water drop was the full-level protective water created by Susu. With this, he wasn’t afraid of sneak attacks at all. Unless it was an overlord-level attack, it couldn’t break through his defense at all. Shi Yu had already tested it.
And this was only one of the strange pieces of equipment on Shi Yu’s body. Although the equipment he brought were all equipment that conformed to the rules, because these equipment were self-made, they were definitely more ferocious than the equipment fully armed by other contestants. It could even give Shi Yu the confidence to fight weaker monarch-level ferocious beasts alone.
Moreover, there was no need for him to face it himself. Wasn’t Baby Ginseng here? If the last team internal competition wasn’t held on a glacier but here where the earth and plants were filled with natural energy, Baby Ginseng might really be able to defeat Eleven and Buggy.
Here, some of its combination skills could be better used…
“Forget it, Baby Ginseng, I’ll leave it to you,” Shi Yu chose in the end.
Upon hearing this order, Baby Ginseng nodded. Then, it looked into the distance and underground.
Shi Yu also looked in that direction.
With this look, the Eye of the Stars immediately caught a close-up. It also made countless spectators discover Shi Yu and the others’ abnormalities!
[Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit, did Shi Yu and the others look underground just now?]
[Has Shi Zhuo been discovered?]
[I don’t know, but even if he’s discovered, Shi Yu shouldn’t be able to lock onto the other party now and attack him.]
“Just now, contestant Shi Yu seemed to have glanced at the ground with Baby Ginseng!!!”
“Could it be that he was exposed?”
“It’s said that contestant Shi Zhuo’s Iron Cliff Snake has already trained its Earth Escape skill to perfection. It can already perfectly fuse with the ground and is almost very hard to discover. contestant Shi Zhuo even relied on this move to kill a monarch-level ferocious beast in the territory of an overlord-level creature and retreat unscathed. Therefore, theoretically speaking, their movements are very secretive.”
The two commentators immediately introduced Shi Zhuo’s battle results to everyone.
However, no matter how they tried to fix it, they were already discovered. Soon, in the scene, Baby Ginseng stopped releasing the sweetness and looked at the ground with deep green eyes.
Then, it gently jumped under the rock, bent down, and pressed its palm to the ground!
Combination skill, Earth Demon!
Boom.
In the next moment, a scene that made all the audience silent appeared.
As Baby Ginseng pressed its palm to the ground, the surrounding ground immediately began to tremble violently with it as the center.
With a boom, the ground behind Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng cracked, and a wooden giant grew out.
Right on the heels of that, a brown substance swept across the wooden giant, and its size was still increasing crazily.
In just two seconds, accompanied by a shocking change, the huge wooden statue born behind Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng expanded to a hundred meters tall. Moreover, limbs began to extend from its body, and its head became a dignified earth-brown hundred-meter-tall statue!
The height of the huge wooden statue had already made it the focus of the entire screen.
The appearance of the huge combination skill that was more than a hundred meters tall made Shi Yu and the others feel dizzy, as if the iron-eating beast had shocked the surroundings just now.
Earth Chain+Strengthening+Plant Control+Multiplication super combination skill. Earth Demon that could maintain its activity by absorbing the power of the earth!!

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: Baby Ginseng Crushing the Land (4)
Many people’s expressions froze.
Damn… What was this!!!
That ginseng baby… what did it do!!!
Countless people shouted in their hearts.
Against its understanding, it compared Baby Ginseng’s small body to the huge wooden statue.
At the same time…
Deep underground.
Shi Zhuo carefully rode the Iron Cliff Snake forward, but in the next moment, their expressions suddenly changed as they sensed the huge change in the ground.
It felt a little dangerous.
But at this moment, it was already too late. A transcendent deterrence directly penetrated the ground and penetrated deep underground, making the Iron Cliff Snake’s pupils suddenly shrink, shocking it on the spot.
In the next moment, the ground trembled even more.
In the audience’s perspective, in the scene, after the Earth Demon Beast appeared, Baby Ginseng returned to its standing posture and flipped its palm gently.
With this flip, the Earth Demon also moved. Its incomparably huge arm… quickly fell, and its palm directly penetrated the ground.
The entire hand was like five mountain peaks. It was incomparably huge, enveloping everything and covering everything. Then, it touched the ground. At this moment, the ground cracked, and countless rocks and dust flew away. The hard ground was like soft mud to the huge hand of this earth demon. Accompanied by a rumbling sound, everyone opened their mouths in shock a moment later!
Boom!!!
Baby Ginseng crushed the land with a flip of its hand!
Even if they weren’t at the scene, everyone seemed to be able to experience the tragic scene personally.
This, this was f*cking…
The scene was blurry, and smoke lingered.
When everyone could see more clearly, they saw that in the scene, the Earth Demon behind Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng still looked like a god.
Its arm and palm had already stretched out from the ground. Apart from that… unlike when it penetrated the ground, the current Earth Demon’s palm was holding an incomparably huge snake with an extremely terrified expression!!
“Roar!!!”
The Iron Cliff Snake’s entire body was controlled, and it struggled with all its might. However, its endless strength was completely crushed!!
At this moment, a figure also came out of the Iron Cliff Snake’s body with a pale face. After he came out, he opened his mouth wide and looked at the hundred-meter-tall demon in front of him in shock. He looked at Shi Yu, who had his arms crossed and was looking at him calmly, and Baby Ginseng, who had his arms crossed, and fell into endless confusion.
His mentality exploded.
Who am I, where am I, this place… What’s going on? What exactly happened…
This was indeed the first contestant to encounter Shi Yu, but unfortunately, he was suppressed before he could see Shi Yu…
In the outside world.
Countless spectators opened their mouths wide again and looked at this scene in confusion. The teachers and students of Demon Capital University even got up with stunned gazes. They kept cursing and lost the ability to think!
The teachers and students of Ancient Capital and Imperial Capital University felt that this ginseng baby was even more terrifying than their impression of it. The netizens and the two commentators were extremely shocked at this moment, and their views shattered again.
Don’t tell them… This was created by that ginseng baby. F*ck, this was a ginseng baby??
When Shi Zhuo came over, many people were sweating at Shi Yu. At this moment, they looked at the Iron Cliff Snake that was pinched and unable to break free, as well as Shi Zhuo, who was pale and afraid to move on the spot. They felt that this world was so crazy. Not only was this ginseng baby f*cking nutritious, its battle power was also f*cking terrifying!!
Why were all Shi Yu’s pets so strange! Even the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University, such as Yin Zhengfan, who trusted Gao Xuan extremely, had their expressions change at this moment. They were a little worried. Captain Gao, Captain Gao shouldn’t be a problem, right…

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - Gao Xuan Was Beaten Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: Gao Xuan Was Beaten Up
“Yi (You fell before I even used any strength.)”
In the depths of the Yunying Mountain Range.
Baby Ginseng stood on the ground.
Behind it was a hundred-meter-tall Earth Demon.
Under the suppression of the Earth Demon, the Iron Cliff Snake and Shi Zhuo slowly fainted.
The surprise element was part of it, but the sweetness aura also played a part.
The Earth Demon was actually a very comprehensive combination skill.
As a plant body, it could also produce hypnotic sweetness.
Or, it could receive the enhancement of the power of the Moon Explosion and undergo a partial and overall explosion.
It was completely no problem to crush the opponent.
Of course, although it was big, its self-destruction power was definitely inferior to a small ginseng baby.
Although the Earth Demon looked violent, Baby Ginseng’s moves were relatively gentle. It only used the hypnotic sweet aura to finish its opponent.
However, no matter how Baby Ginseng defeated its opponent, this scene was still so unbelievable in the eyes of the audience.
“As… as everyone can see.”
“Contestant Shi Zhuo’s Earth Escape strategy… I originally thought that it would pose a certain threat to contestant Shi Yu, but, inconceivably, the concealment of the Iron Cliff Snake is impossible to hide from contestant Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng!! The most shocking thing is that contestant Shi Yu’s Baby Ginseng’s battle power is actually not inferior to contestant Shi Yu’s other pets’ performance. It’s simply unbelievable.”
Han Lu and Gu Yu, the two commentators, watched everything eagerly.
The others also looked at the Earth Demon Beast created by Baby Ginseng eagerly.
F*ck, no wonder Shi Yu dared to send other pets. This ginseng baby wasn’t necessarily weaker than those pets. They were almost deceived by its appearance again!!
At Imperial Capital University, the old principal of Imperial Capital University was extremely silent.
Although on the stage of the National League, they were competitors with the teachers and students of Ancient Capital University…
However, from the perspective of a Beast Tamer, the old principal of the Imperial Capital University felt that Shi Yu’s ginseng baby was the most terrifying.
That short confrontation just now… She knew that this ginseng baby didn’t even use half its strength. Those even more abnormal skills like Moon Explosion, Time Mark, and even the Time Fruit were useless.
“With something like the Time Fruit, even if there are side effects, Shi Yu definitely has the ability to temporarily fight against overlords.”
“Although there’s nothing wrong with Gao Xuan now, but…” The old principal of the Imperial Capital University sighed. She didn’t know what the outcome would be. Shi Yu’s current basic strength had really exceeded her imagination.
Although she knew that Gao Xuan was fully prepared, she still couldn’t help but worry.
In the scene.
The Earth Demon calmly threw the combination of the Iron Cliff Snake and Shi Zhuo into the sky.
It meant that it was up to the Eye of the Stars to take care of this.
The Eye of the Stars was also very straightforward. It directly enveloped the little kid with light and sent him away.
After this scene happened, the expressions of the teachers and students of Demon Capital University turned bitter, while Spirit Capital and Divine Capital University laughed.
Of course, the common thought of the audience was still confused.
[That ginseng baby… How did it break through the racial restrictions of the supplements and obtain such strong battle power?]
[The life force and energy of the supplement race is strong, but the weakness and price is physique, weak battle power, high life force, high energy, and high battle power. Isn’t this f*cking invincible?]
Shi Yu still didn’t know how big an impact Eleven, Susu, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng’s performance had already caused in the outside world.
At this moment, he was looking at the Earth Demon happily.
So be it. In any case, the Earth Demon could connect to the ground, just like those plants. It relied on absorbing the power of the earth to maintain its life force and wouldn’t continue to waste Baby Ginseng’s physical strength.
Of course, the premise was that they were not in an intense battle. If it was a high-intensity battle and the energy supply was insufficient, the Earth Demon would quickly collapse.
“Yi.”
After sending away the elites of Demon Capital University, Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu whispered to each other. Both parties communicated telepathically.
“Yi!!”
Baby Ginseng rubbed its hands and asked if Shi Yu could teach it an Earth Escape skill someday.
It had an earth-element racial skill. Although its body wasn’t earth-element, it should be able to learn Earth Escape.
At that time, so be it. If they had the ability, Eleven, Buggy, and the others could also try to burrow into the ground!
If nobody would lose, it wouldn’t be afraid!
“Sure.” Shi Yu smiled and sat back on the rock. Wasn’t this easy?
Earth Escape was not a rare skill. He could go get an Earth Mouse in the countryside. It was fine to replicate one for Baby Ginseng.
Although it couldn’t increase Baby Ginseng’s battle power much, its life-saving ability could indeed increase greatly.
In the future, when he went fishing for prey, he could also have more escape methods.
“Yiya!!!” Baby Ginseng was excited. Alright, alright.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
But this way, if there was another team meeting next time, the venue would probably be restricted.
Otherwise, when the time came, whether it was hiding, flying, escaping, or diving, these little guys in the team might not necessarily be able to determine the outcome even after fighting for 100 years.
“After the National League ends, apart from starting to add some super skills, I can start a new round of collection of top-notch low, medium, and high-level skills.” Shi Yu took a deep breath.
In the past, it was because there were too many key skills and his physique couldn’t keep up. In addition, there was no pressure, so he wasn’t in a hurry. But next, if he wanted to go to the World Tournament, the more trump cards he had, the better.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (1)
…
“Next, let’s see how the other contestants are doing.”
In the outside world, everyone was gradually used to the abnormal performance of Shi Yu’s pets.
They swore that no matter what abnormal abilities Shi Yu’s pet displayed next, they could withstand it and not make a fuss.
At this moment, many people were confused.
Was this really the level of someone ranked outside the top 100 of the Sequence Battle?
They felt that something was wrong, because in the past few days, it wasn’t like there weren’t contestants at the front of the Sequence battle who had fought openly, but their performance didn’t seem to be as fierce as Shi Yu?
At this moment, it wasn’t that there weren’t any Sequence contestants paying attention to the National League.
Among them, there was no lack of top 20. The top 50 contestants were also paying attention to the National League.
When they saw Shi Yu’s performance, they fell silent and immediately felt threatened.
This was definitely not the strength of a Beast Tamer ranked above the 100th place in the initial ranking. This guy… wasn’t that simple!
“Contestants Li Qiu, Chu Yiang, and Shi Zhuo are the closest to contestant Shi Yu.”
“The other contestants are relatively far away and more cautious. Although they’re moving over, they don’t move forward at a high speed. The chances of the pets Shi Yu sends encountering them in the short term aren’t high.”
“Calculating the current distance and the contestant’s movement speed, next, the one most likely to encounter contestant Shi Yu… is contestant Gao Xuan??”
In the live-stream, Han Lu and Gu Yu analyzed.
“Moreover, from the direction of contestant Gao Xuan, if he continues to fly at such a high speed on the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, the pet that he’s most likely to encounter in the future is…”
Flame Sword Spirit, Chi Tong!!
Everyone immediately judged it.
This result stunned many people.
It wasn’t that powerful Water Slime, nor was it the powerful Nine Li Battle Beast, nor was it the powerful Butterfly of Imagination, but the fire sword spirit that didn’t have much of a presence at the moment?!
At the same time.
As the strength Shi Yu displayed became more and more ridiculous.
At this moment, the most nervous group was not the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University!
In many mechanical research institutes all over Dong Huang, there were super big bosses who could be said to be at the highest level in the mechanical field of Dong Huang. For some reason, they paid attention to the National League.
In a research institute in the capital.
The retired dean of the Imperial Capital University’s Mechanical College, the senior of the fourth bureau, an old man who had unearthed and cultivated Gao Xuan, watched the live broadcast of the National League in silence.
“Old Liu, can Little Xuan do it? This Shi Yu looks very powerful… As expected of the elites of the third and eleventh bureau.”
“Old Liu, if you want to help Little Gao apply for resources, so be it. Why give it to him through the National League? If this fails, you’ll lose everything.”
The Mechanic named Old Liu kept receiving messages from his peers in the bureau, making him quite unhappy.
What did they know!!
If he gave it away for free, would the kid have a greater sense of accomplishment if he didn’t know how to cherish it after experiencing a test??
If he didn’t use this method, would that kid, Gao Xuan, have the chance to come into contact with his peers if he stayed in the research institute all day? Could it be that he was going to marry a robot in the future? Old Liu, who didn’t have any descendants, clearly treated Gao Xuan, who he had raised since young, as his grandson.
Moreover, Gao Xuan didn’t lose yet.
“Just watch. Little Xuan won’t lose. In order to deal with this Shi Yu, he strengthened all his savings in advance…”
Mechanic Elder Liu looked at the red sword spirit in the scene and was slightly silent. However, one way or another, the “training” of Gao Xuan this time was indeed a little bigger than he imagined. This Shi Yu was indeed a little monster.
At this moment, on the island of the National League, Glass Island, south of the Yunying Mountain Range.
Chi Tong flew in the sky angrily.
Because in this direction, there didn’t seem to be any contestants or even monarch-level pets coming over.
Compared to the unlucky Chi Tong, the other directions were much better.
Susu defeated a contestant, Buggy defeated a contestant, and even Baby Ginseng from “Our Base” defeated a contestant. Only Chi Tong didn’t encounter the moving “bonus”.
On Eleven’s side, although it didn’t encounter any contestants, Eleven encountered a monarch-level ferocious beast that rushed over after smelling the fragrance not long after flying out.
Unsurprisingly, it fainted from Eleven’s might.
As Eleven had stunned 100,000 ferocious beasts in an instant, including ten monarchs, this small experience was not broadcasted at all. However, that was still 10 million yuan.
Only Chi Tong was relatively miserable at the moment.
The people passing by below were all low-level noobs, the kind that weren’t included in the battle results.
“Mi!!”
Chi Tong flew in the sky angrily.
But suddenly, it was stunned.
It sensed a strong energy wave attacking from afar.
This energy wave was even stronger than its strength.
Moreover, it also felt that this wave was very familiar.
It was as if he had seen it somewhere.
“Mi!”
Gao Xuan, Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast!!
Soon, Little Chi Tong in the sky was extremely happy as if it was facing a great enemy.
What a surprise!!!
It was still complaining just now, but Chi Tong never expected that it would actually win the first prize!
“Mi! (Big female lead’s refreshing mode activated!)”
Chi Tong was extremely excited.
It quickly informed Shi Yu that it had encountered a big fish!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (2)
In the depths of the Yunying Mountain Range.
As he sensed a connection, Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He looked south where Chi Tong was.
At this moment, although Chi Tong was already very far away from him, there was still a mental connection between the two parties.
Not only because of the contract, but also because Chi Tong was a soul seed hatched by Shi Yu. Most importantly, Shi Yu had a telepathy talent.
The distance that could be maintained with a contracted pet was much further than other talented Beast Tamers.
It was precisely because of this that Shi Yu could easily send all his pets out and not be afraid of losing contact.
“Gao Xuan finally appeared.” Shi Yu was as surprised as Chi Tong.
In his opinion, the only troublesome guy in this National League was Gao Xuan.
As long as he dealt with Gao Xuan, he would basically lock onto the national champion. He would also have a pile of top-grade mechanical materials.
[Chi Tong, test it. If it doesn’t work, run.]
[You might not necessarily be able to defeat it, but it definitely can’t outrun you.]
Shi Yu still acknowledged Chi Tong’s first speed in the team.
[We’ll go over now. When the time comes, we’ll gang up on him!]
[Chi Tong: QAQ? Mi?]
Wu wu wu.
What about the trust between Beast Tamers and pets? Why was it that the other teammates were just killing randomly, but when it came to him, it had to run if it couldn’t do it?
What happened to the cool female lead story?
Shi Yu actually wanted to stabilize the result.
After all, Chi Tong’s strength was inferior to Eleven and Buggy, and it wasn’t like Susu in the distance, who could have the Time Fruit in its stomach to transform perfectly. The side effects were extremely small, second only to Baby Ginseng. Therefore, it was better for it to run quickly. It was better for them to all gang up on him.
At that time, if Chi Tong possessed him, it would be equivalent to Chi Tong being the one who won, so it would probably be satisfied..
Of course, the premise was to test it out and run “if it can’t win”. If it worked, he would pretend that he didn’t say anything.
Chi Tong and the others weren’t sent out empty-handed by Shi Yu.
Shi Yu had prepared many trump cards for the National League. This was not just for show.
At this moment, on the hilt of Little Chi Tong in the south, there was a thread-shaped ring made of transparent worm silk that was almost invisible to the naked eye…
This ring was not simple.
This was a spatial equipment created by Buggy with worm silk and spatial pocket skills.
Not only was there low-level equipment of legendary quality inside, but General Mu’s Gemini Silver Armor also had an environmental protection badge with the Ice Dragon Phantom created by Buggy…
Apart from that, the Gemini Silver Armor had even been enchanted by General Mu Huiyin’s illusion with Buggy’s phantom.
Hehe… Although it couldn’t last long, if the opponent didn’t have the strength of an overlord, they would have to pray for themselves when facing Chi Tong’s equipment.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s spiritual consciousness seemed to be in a dark space.
The space was like an alternate world. Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and Susu’s spiritual consciousness were also there.
The six life forms confirmed the other party’s situation as if they had started an “on-line meeting”.
[Confirm the location and deal with Gao Xuan together!]
Shi Yu’s summoning stunned Buggy, Eleven, and Susu.
Gao Xuan was here?
Oh!
Great!
Gao Xuan and the pets were excited. They aimed at Gao Xuan’s “bounty”.
“This is Dong Huang Radio and Television Station!!”
Shi Yu and the others realized that Gao Xuan was approaching. The audience watching the live broadcast was even more certain.
At this moment, everyone was extremely excited.
Holy shit, the two big boss-level contestants of the National League were finally going to meet.
“As everyone can see, contestant Gao Xuan is already less than ten thousand meters away from contestant Shi Yu’s fire sword spirit. He’ll encounter it in the blink of an eye!!”
In the scene, there was a huge silver mecha more than ten meters tall with obvious dragon-shaped characteristics on its head. It looked like a dragonman. At this moment, it was flying at lightning speed with the support of white energy light wings.
In the body of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Gao Xuan sat inside. Through the detection equipment of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, he had already perfectly locked onto Chi Tong in the distance.
In terms of detection ability, Shi Yu’s pets were indeed inferior to Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
Before Chi Tong discovered Gao Xuan, Gao Xuan had already discovered Chi Tong.
Gao Xuan looked at the fiery red sword spirit in the scene and his expression immediately froze.
The reason why he quickly came over was indeed because he sensed something.
It was the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that sensed a high-intensity energy wave. It was this that attracted Gao Xuan.
However, Gao Xuan didn’t expect to encounter Shi Yu’s pet on the way…
[Race Name]: Sword Spirit (No detailed classification at the moment)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 3,950,000
“It’s Shi Yu’s sword spirit!”
“As expected…”
When he first saw Shi Yu at the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, he had discovered the abnormality of this sword spirit. At the commander level, it had 180,000 energy points. After the monarch level, its strength would definitely be even more terrifying.
And now, his prediction was indeed correct. 3,950,000 energy points was almost comparable to the normal energy of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that he had specially strengthened in terms of energy!
If this sword spirit mastered the possession skill again, Shi Yu would definitely be able to threaten him back then.
Yes, him back then.
As for now, Gao Xuan looked at the sword spirit’s energy value and felt no fluctuations in his heart. Fortunately, he was prepared and had even upgraded the fire resistance system.
When flames of the same level hit the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, the power could at least offset 30%.
However, what puzzled Gao Xuan the most was that with the powerful detection system of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, there was actually no Shi Yu or his other pets in a large area around this sword spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (3)
Even the huge energy wave just now disappeared in an instant. What exactly was going on?
But no matter what, when he saw Shi Yu’s pet, his greatest competitor, even if the other party’s Beast Tamer didn’t seem to be around, Gao Xuan didn’t plan to let it go.
In the scene, the distance between the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Chi Tong was getting closer and closer.
[Captain Gao, invincible!]
[Captain Gao, charge, charge!!]
At this moment, the cries of the audience became louder and louder.
With a bang, Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast descended a hundred meters away from Chi Tong. The two parties faced each other in the air.
“Where’s your Beast Tamer?” Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast carried a telepathy device.
At this moment, time seemed to have stopped.
[Don’t tell me that Big Boss Shi Yu’s sword spirit can still kill indiscriminately, even if the opponent is Captain Gao.]
[Stop kidding. The situation this time will definitely be different, alright?]
[However, I’m certain that Big Boss Shi Yu’s mysterious sword spirit can definitely deal with Captain Gao. If we want a real battle, we might have to wait for the king to fight the king.]
The audience held their breaths.
“Finally, finally… Gao Xuan and Shi Yu’s pets have finally met. What kind of intense battle will there be next!!” The commentator, Gu Yu, shouted excitedly.
Amidst the shouting, the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University and Ancient Capital University, the three big shots on the platform, revealed extremely serious expressions.
“Mi! (I’m enough.)” Chi Tong.
“You alone?” Gao Xuan smiled.
Wasn’t Shi Yu’s pet a little too arrogant?
Gao Xuan stopped talking and directly entered the fusion mode with the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. His energy level increased to nearly eight million.
As for the stronger super frequency driving mode that was installed with his new equipment, due to the huge side effects, Gao Xuan didn’t choose to use it directly. After all, there were still many contestants on the island, and Shi Yu and his other pets had yet to show their faces.
Using the super frequency mode with powerful side effects so early, wasn’t it just waiting to be picked up by others?
In Gao Xuan’s opinion, this current state was enough to crush this sword spirit.
Boom!
After entering the fusion state, the aura of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast increased exponentially. At the same time, honorable golden patterns appeared on its silver-white body. This was the mechanical change after the two parties fused.
Seeing this scene, countless spectators were extremely excited. They didn’t expect Captain Gao to use his strongest state right from the start.
“It appeared. It’s the combination loading state of Gao Xuan and his Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast!!!”
“According to the intelligence of the National League last year, the fusion state of Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast could reach a terrifying seven million energy points a year ago!!”
“This powerful strength almost suppressed the contestants of the competition back then. Now that a year has passed, I believe contestant Gao Xuan has become even stronger!”
“Everyone, look, this is…”
In the scene, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast Gao Xuan was riding raised its arm slowly. A super light sword slowly appeared in its palm. Seeing this scene, the eyes of the audience lit up.
“It’s a super skill specially developed by contestant Gao Xuan himself, the Holy Dragon Light Sword!!!”
“In terms of power, it’s said that it’s no longer inferior to expert level super skills!”
“With this move, contestant Gao Xuan even has the battle record of riding an Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to injure an overlord. The power of the move is incomparable and very terrifying!!”
Holy Dragon Light Sword!
“Mi! (Is that all?)”
But at the same time, just as Gao Xuan was looking forward to Shi Yu jumping out to save this sword spirit, the little sword spirit’s voice in the distance made Gao Xuan’s veins pop out. Damn.
What did it mean by that?
Gao Xuan immediately wanted to slash at this “bad girl” in anger.
But…
Suddenly, the warning system of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast let out a crazy cry!!!
[Danger, danger, danger!!]
Three consecutive danger notifications stunned Gao Xuan. His attention was instantly raised to the extreme.
However, at this moment, everything seemed to have stopped. A cold wind that could freeze time instantly swept through the sky and ground.
A faint layer of frost instantly filled the entire Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, even the Holy Dragon Light Sword. Moreover, this ice power even perfectly stopped the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s reaction speed for an instant.
“This is… a time skill?”
On the platform, Legend Xiao, who maintained a mental connection with the Eye of the Stars, was suddenly shocked.
“Roar!!!”
Then, with a terrifying dragon roar, everyone looked at the scene that seemed to have been frozen by the power of ice with their mouths agape.
What was going on?
Shouldn’t that fire sword spirit be both undead and fire?
Now, this was… Why would an ice-element skill appear???
The sky suddenly darkened, and blue ice clouds condensed.
In an instant, hail and snow began to fall. The thin snow mixed with strong winds formed a snowstorm!
As the snow lingered, many spectators widened their eyes almost at the same time and revealed incredulous expressions.
Because at this moment, under the lingering snow and wind, a huge monster was forming, an ice dragon!!
The strong body of the frost dragon in front of him was made of ice and stone. Its color was ice-blue and deep, representing extreme cold.
Not only its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, as well as its pair of wings, were all strong and powerful. Its scales even revealed the Extreme Cold Domain. Snow lingered, making it look incomparably domineering.
Its few ice-blue whiskers fluttered in the wind, looking very impressive. However, what shocked everyone at this moment was not completely because an ice dragon appeared beside the fire sword spirit, but because another figure appeared on the ice dragon!!

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Gao Xuan Was Beaten Away (4)
On the ice dragon, a woman with peerless charm and extraordinary spirit appeared. She was wearing the Gemini Silver Armor and a fiery red cloak.
This person had soft snow-white skin, fiery red hair that draped over her shoulders, and a very beautiful face without any makeup. The most unique thing was her deep starry eyes.
[Holy shit… This person is…]
At this moment, when they saw this person, some of the audience instantly widened their eyes and revealed incredulous expressions.
The shocked audience was basically Beast Tamers who had watched the lost history on a certain video platform!
At this moment, their eyes almost popped out as they watched the perfect replay of the video.
In the venue were all the Beast Tamers of the nine major universities. Almost every one of them had seen the short video of Mu Huiyin’s legend, so at this moment, they were far more shocked than the audience watching the live broadcast.
“Mi!!!”
The moment time seemed to have stopped under the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy of the Ice Dragon, in the vision of the audience, the sword spirit Shi Yu sent out suddenly changed into countless clones that landed in the armor of this phantom.
The ten thousand swords became one! Possession again!
In the next moment, red flames that shot into the sky erupted from Mu Huiyin’s phantom. The flames burst into the sky. In an instant, the world changed. Countless snow clouds instantly disappeared, and the entire sky was immediately dyed orange-red.
At the same time, a red sword appeared in Mu Huiyin’s phantom hand.
Then, she looked at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast with a calm Chi Tong…
As if it was saying: “Be careful… Don’t die… If you have hidden strength, take it out…”
“This…” In the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body, after a short daze, Gao Xuan had already recovered. However, at this moment, he was even more absent-minded as he looked at everything in disbelief!
How was this possible!!!
Swoosh…
As soon as he finished speaking, an incomparably dazzling sword aura that was more than ten meters tall, intertwined with blue and red, was like a rolling snowstorm. It was like an erupting volcano, directly sweeping the dragon and phoenix might towards the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to crush it, intersecting…
The combination skill of Buggy and Chi Tong crossing thousands of miles, General Mu Huiyin’s descent!!!
Boom!!!
On the other side, Gao Xuan almost resisted the incomparable pressure and made the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast swing the Holy Dragon Light Sword. At the same time, he activated the super frequency mode to strengthen the defense system of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to the limit.
Because this power… was no longer purely the power of fire.
Just the fire resistance system of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast… couldn’t defend against it!
In the next moment.
The Interlocking Sword crushed space. The shocking sword light almost instantly swallowed the Holy Dragon Light Sword and crushed it into light that filled the sky. Then, the pupils of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan, who was inside, constricted. An incomparably terrifying sword pressure descended on the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast!!
The sword pressed down and directly swept up a huge smoke, devouring the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast in one bite. The terrifying aftermath instantly turned into cold wind and hot wind that spread in all directions. At the same time, in the sky, the golden and silver figure of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast fell into the distance like a kite with a broken string. White smoke lingered on its body, and it was filled with injuries.
At this moment, the sword in Mu Huiyin’s phantom’s hand trembled.
Because it sensed that this attack couldn’t hurt the other party. Although it suppressed the other party, it was only the most basic scratch. At the last moment, the other party activated a defense system comparable to an overlord and offset most of the damage.
However, although Chi Tong felt that it didn’t hurt the other party much, the scene of it sending the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast flying with a swing directly caused an incomparable commotion all over the country. Countless Beast Tamers looked at Mu Huiyin’s phantom in the scene in shock and at the red sword spirit in her hand, revealing extremely shocked expressions!!
“This… This…”
“What exactly…”
The two commentators seemed to have lost their minds as they looked at the shocking scene in front of them.
The big shots of the fourth bureau, especially Old Liu, got up from the sofa with a whoosh. Their teeth kept colliding, and they were very shocked.
The teachers and students of Imperial Capital University also stood up together and exclaimed that it was impossible. Yin Zhengfan’s eyes were filled with confusion.
Even the old principal of Imperial Capital University was the same. He couldn’t believe that Gao Xuan was actually suppressed by a single pet.
Only the teachers and students from Ancient Capital University who had experienced the heroic spirit ruins with Shi Yu were extremely excited. Their hair stood on end, and their expressions were shocked and overjoyed.
[This, this, this, this, this…]
[Why would an ice dragon appear!!]
[Wait, isn’t that figure General Mu Huiyin?!]
[Holy shit, wait, why does Big Boss Shi Yu’s fire sword spirit look so similar to the sword in General Mu Huiyin’s hand in the video?] The Internet was equally shocked.
At this moment, Legend Xiao Shuang felt that it was no longer suitable for the two master-level Beast Tamers to explain the situation in front of them. She directly stood up and looked at the scene with a deep gaze.
“Those are… illusions.”
“An illusion created by the Butterfly of Imagination.”
“That sword spirit has always carried the phantom created by the other party on its body. This is a combination skill that has crossed a long distance.”
As soon as Legend Xiao Shuang finished speaking, it caused another huge commotion. The audience found it even more difficult to understand. The fire sword spirit and the Butterfly of Imagination were worlds apart. How could this be a combination skill?
Moreover, this combination skill form was simply…
At this moment, Legend Xiao Shuang couldn’t explain further. She looked at Principal Feng, who was sitting in the seat of Ancient Capital University. At this moment, only Principal Feng could explain this situation.
At that moment, looking at the scene, Principal Feng laughed and said,
“I know this combination skill.”
“It’s called: Mu Huiyin Descent!”
“The reason why it’s called this is because the sword spirit Shi Yu contracted is the heroic spirit of the legendary Mu Huiyin, the number one general under Emperor Shi of the Dong Huang Dynasty and known as the Ice Dragon General!!”
“It’s a high-level overlord race.”
“And that Ice Dragon Phantom is General Mu Huiyin’s first battle pet. It’s worth mentioning that this Ice Dragon has actually lived until today. The Ice Dragon Snow Mountain that has always lived in Icefield City has even advanced to the totem level and become our country’s new guardian.”
“In the past, that Butterfly of Imagination often summoned its illusions to fight.”
“This is also Shi Yu’s archeological discovery. Those who don’t know can pay attention to Shi Yu’s account. There’s a lost historical video he posted there. There’s a certain introduction to General Mu Huiyin.”
“This combination skill was created by Shi Yu through archeological discoveries. As expected of the archeological genius of our Ancient Capital University, hahaha.”
As soon as Principal Feng finished speaking, those who didn’t know the situation revealed the most shocked expressions today through the clues in their words. As for those Beast Tamers who had already known about Mu Huiyin’s legend and had seen the video, after hearing that the sword spirit Shi Yu contracted was the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin, they immediately opened their mouths wide and looked at the beautiful general phantom in the scene who repelled Gao Xuan with a sword again. They revealed collapsed expressions as if they had lost their dreams.
At this moment, the fourth round shook. A group of mechanical big shots who pursued “innovation” looked at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that was suppressed by “archeology”. Their gazes wandered.
Legend Xiao Shuang, President Xia, and Director Zhong also looked at Principal Feng and the phantom combination skill in the scene in silence.
At this moment, the ones who wanted to cry the most were still the commentators. They swore that they would never explain Shi Yu’s battle again in the future. It was too difficult. They didn’t know how to do this…
However, the battle was still intense, and no one was allowed to be too shocked.
Looking at everything in the scene, the commentator, Han Lu, suddenly made a shocking discovery.
“F*ck… Look, after the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was beaten to the ground, it didn’t lose its ability to fight, but it didn’t continue to counterattack either. Instead, it… activated the ‘escape system’. It turned around and flew away!!”
In the scene, after a round of confrontation, Gao Xuan was shocked to the extreme. Although he could activate the final super frequency driving mode to fight the sword spirit to the death, from the beginning to the end, Shi Yu himself had yet to show his face. In this situation, he crazily suppressed his urge and didn’t dare to act rashly. He decided to take his time and instantly turned to run.
As long as there was life, there was hope. This sword spirit was too f*cking strange!!!
At the same time, seeing Gao Xuan escape, Gao Xuan’s supporters opened their mouths wide. Ah, this… Captain Gao was chased away??

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League
Gao Xuan was chased away!
The audience looked at the fleeing Gao Xuan and opened their mouths wide.
The teachers and students of Imperial Capital University, such as Yin Zhengfan, almost fainted.
