After Shi Yu displayed a portion of his strength, everyone imagined many situations.
The imagery of Shi Yu and Gao Xuan that went all out and were evenly matched. One of them would win with a slight advantage.
Or, when Shi Yu and Gao Xuan collided with all their might, one side displayed astonishing strength and displayed a huge advantage the whole time!
However, no one had imagined this situation!
Gao Xuan had only encountered Shi Yu’s “one” pet, but he was directly shattered and chased away in a single move?
Holy shit!!!
This result directly made all the spectators who had watched the National League last year and felt Gao Xuan’s dominance lose their minds.
Although in theory, that was a combination skill of the Sword Spirit and the Butterfly of Imagination, the problem was that from the beginning to the end, the Butterfly of Imagination didn’t show its face!
The sword aura that swept through the sky and ground was still emitted by the sword spirit as the main body. Even without the cooperation of other illusions, everyone felt that this sword spirit was definitely not weak.
At least, there was no problem with fighting the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
Moreover, in theory, the combination of Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was also a combination skill!
It was so direct that it was unreasonable.
[It can’t be helped… That sword spirit is too terrifying.]
Principal Feng’s words from Ancient Capital University were still ringing in their ears.
High-level overlord race, Titled Legend, the number one general under Emperor Shi, Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit!
How could it be weak?
From the sound of it, this was probably not the most impressive pet in Shi Yu’s team.
Until here, suddenly, all the audience shuddered.
Shi Yu… had actually contracted five monarch-level pets!!!
The growth levels of the five contracted pets were actually all at the monarch level.
Among the other contestants, those who could contract two monarch-level pets were not bad.
Most contestants only had one.
Moreover, Shi Yu’s Nine Li Battle Beast, the Butterfly of Imagination, and the Sword Spirit were actually all overlord races!
No, those two ginseng babies and water slime that instantly killed high-level monarch-level opponents definitely weren’t as simple as low-level races!!
It had definitely been strengthened by Shi Yu to be comparable to an overlord race!
At the thought of this, as a master-level Beast Tamer, Shi Yu contracted five monarch-level pets of overlord races. Countless spectators had blank expressions. The Beast Tamer shed tears of envy and jealousy.
Every top-grade pet was the lifelong pursuit of a Beast Tamer, and Shi Yu alone took five?!
“The ranking of the Sequence Battle will be updated after today…”
On the platform, President Xia looked at this rising star in shock.
Although he knew that Shi Yu was very strong, he didn’t expect him to be so strong.
Five pets, no matter which one it was… their battle results were so terrifying.
Even if two of them combined, not to mention it being a combination skill that had crossed a long distance, they could still crush Gao Xuan in his fused state?
He looked at the equally shocked President Zhong Yan. This was because apart from being the director of the eighth bureau, the Education Bureau, this old man was also one of the people in charge of the committee responsible for ranking the contestants in this Sequence battle.
“Monster… Five overlord races. If only he were born ten years earlier… No, as long as he was born five years earlier, he could definitely become a super contestant who perfectly represented our Dong Huang in the world competition, like Ye Xing.” Director Zhong Yan couldn’t help but feel that it was a pity.
The world competition required one to be under 30 years old, while Shi Yu was only 19 years old.
If Shi Yu was given another ten years, wouldn’t Dong Huang be even more stable in this world competition? Even if Shi Yu didn’t have a battle talent.
What a pity. Though, based on Shi Yu’s current battle results, it was definitely not a problem for his strength to rank in the top 20 of the Sequence battle.
As for how high it was, whether it could approach the top ten depended on the subsequent battle between Shi Yu and Gao Xuan.
After all, Gao Xuan didn’t seem to have completely lost his ability to fight. It was just a strategic retreat.
As for Shi Yu’s sword spirit, it was probably not easy for it to unleash an attack that was comparable to an overlord.
“Heh…” At this moment, the genius Mechanic from the fourth bureau, Legend Xiao Shuang, looked at the situation on the screen and smiled faintly.
Although she also thought very highly of Gao Xuan at the start, why did she feel that Elder Liu’s plan was going to fail this time?
If those mechanical materials were really taken away by Shi Yu, Elder Liu and Gao Xuan would faint from crying in the toilet.
However, because of the high recognition her father and sister had for Shi Yu, Xiao Shuang didn’t reject Shi Yu from snatching the resources prepared for Gao Xuan in the fourth bureau. After all, everything was a competition within the rules. Moreover, Shi Yu probably didn’t need these resources. At that time, it would most likely still flow into the market.
After that, Gao Xuan would save up money to buy it himself. In any case, it wasn’t slow for a Mechanic with awakened talent to earn money.
“Everyone, look.”
In the broadcast room, the commentator, Gu Yu, looked at the figure of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast in the scene and continued to explain.
“Contestant Gao Xuan, under the attack just now, although his super skill was obliterated and he was smashed hundreds of meters away, he surprisingly didn’t seem to have suffered much damage. Moreover… he chose to retreat strategically!”
The scene began to slow down and replay. Everyone immediately saw clearly that just as the “Interlocking Sword” was about to hit the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body, a white “Holy Dragon Shield” with the symbol of a holy dragon appeared in front of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast with the blue summoning array.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (1)
Moreover, the shield was immediately connected to the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast by the dark red electric current shot out of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s arm.
After that, the shield and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast seemed to be one. Under the lingering dark red electric current, it erupted with super defense and perfectly blocked Chi Tong’s full-strength attack just now.
Although the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast still suffered a huge impact, due to the appearance of the shield, its body didn’t suffer much damage.
[This is…]
The audience was shocked when they saw the slow down replay.
“This is a high-level monarch-level mechanical life form, the Holy Dragon Shield. It’s a new mechanical pet created by Gao Xuan to further strengthen the defense system of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.”
“Although they belong to different individuals, Gao Xuan temporarily made the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and the Holy Dragon Shield become one and erupted with a stronger defense power, successfully blocking this attack.” Legend Xiao Shuang sat on the platform and said calmly.
As soon as he finished speaking, the audience was stunned and looked at the scene.
Damn, Captain Gao finally contracted a new mechanical pet?
However, as expected, it continued to strengthen around the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
“Wait, in other words, Captain Gao was suppressed while he had more numbers just now??” Suddenly, the audience discovered the blind spot and looked at the sword spirit figure even more incredulously.
Xiao Shuang’s expression was deep… More than that…
In that instant just now, Gao Xuan had summoned at least three new mechanical pets and entered a fusion state with the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to block the sword.
An energy-type machine, an energy conversion and connection-type machine, and a Holy Dragon Shield. If not for this, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast wouldn’t have been able to so easily display the defense of the Holy Dragon Shield to resist the overlord’s attack. This was all thanks to the energy converter connecting them.
If she wasn’t wrong, Gao Xuan should have developed an attack-type machine that could be combined with the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, but it was still useless.
However, Xiao Shuang could also tell that this state was a high load mode for Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast. Therefore, was this the reason why Gao Xuan chose to retreat strategically?
He couldn’t even easily crush Shi Yu’s single pet. Even if he erupted with all his strength to fight that sword spirit, his condition would definitely be ridiculously poor afterward. With Shi Yu missing, Gao Xuan was clearly unwilling to throw his greatest trump card on a little sword spirit.
“After contestant Gao Xuan chose to retreat strategically… contestant Shi Yu’s sword spirit chose to continue chasing!”
In the sky, Gao Xuan drove the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast away. Behind him, Chi Tong naturally couldn’t let go of the reward.
Solo kill!
Chi Tong’s eyes lit up. It immediately dispersed the illusion and turned into a sword light to chase after them. Apart from wanting to kill them alone, it was more important to help Shi Yu and the others navigate. They couldn’t let Gao Xuan and the others successfully escape and slip out of sight.
Soon, a scene appeared in the sky. A huge mecha with smoke coming out of it was running quickly in front, and behind it was a shocking sword light chasing after it!!
Unfortunately, due to the Interlocking Sword that used Myriad Sword Convergence just now, Chi Tong’s burden was not small, and its speed was much slower. But soon, its shocking endurance also appeared.
In Shi Yu’s team, under specific “sunlight intensity” circumstances, the one who was the most ferocious in movement in the team was actually Chi Tong.
Its expert level Spirit Release had the Flame of Regeneration that “recovered physical fitness and life”. Its effect was close to an expert level super recovery skill.
Therefore, the skill Spirit Release could be seen as a new ability that could help Chi Tong unlock a super skill at every proficiency stage.
And the proficiency of this new ability was close to the proficiency of the Spirit Release.
Therefore, Chi Tong could basically be seen as having a super skill with physical strength and vitality restoration, close to expert level. At this moment, the sun was shining brightly. During the pursuit of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, be it the physical strength consumed just now, or the burden of using the Myriad Sword Convergence and the Interlocking Sword, they were all recovering at a high speed.
Of course, it wasn’t that the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast didn’t have any endurance. In the nutritional cabin of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Gao Xuan was lying down panting. Inside was also a pile of facilities of various sizes operating crazily, replenishing energy by absorbing solar and wind energy.
“Damn it, why is this guy so fast…”
In the body of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Gao Xuan’s expression darkened when he sensed the sword spirit chasing after him.
This was too much!
Gao Xuan had never been so cowardly.
Until now, he still had a surreal feeling and was extremely confused.
“Chase after us if you have the ability.” In the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body, Gao Xuan cursed when he saw the other party chasing after him.
He was very annoyed now.
It was very annoying.
Seeing that Chi Tong was chasing after him like a plaster, Gao Xuan immediately thought of a strategy.
In short, he definitely couldn’t fight this guy head-on.
If they wanted to fight head-on, they would have to find Shi Yu first. They would leave the ultimate move to Shi Yu and try their best to eliminate Shi Yu in one go.
Therefore, Gao Xuan’s strategy immediately changed from strategic retreat to searching for Shi Yu as he ran.
What he was most worried about was being caught up by Shi Yu after he had used his eruption, but as long as he used the eruption to eliminate Shi Yu, there would be no problem. As for the other contestants, although they were also a threat, they weren’t that big.
Swoosh…
Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and the sword spirit flew one behind the other. The terrifying speed made the ferocious beasts below watch speechlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (2)
It had to be said that Gao Xuan’s tactical vision was indeed good. Whether he threw his trump card at Chi Tong or decided to find Shi Yu himself to erupt with a big move and eliminate Shi Yu, it was the best choice under normal circumstances.
However, accidents often happened very suddenly.
“Contestant Gao Xuan and contestant Shi Yu’s sword spirit are still in a chase.”
“However, long before they met, contestant Shi Yu also seemed to have sensed a special situation through telepathy with his pet.”
“Currently… the Iron-eating Beast, the Butterfly of Imagination, the Water Slime, and even Shi Yu himself have already left the spot and surrounded contestant Gao Xuan??”
Everyone looked at the red dot moving towards Gao Xuan on the map and immediately broke out in cold sweat for Gao Xuan.
Because from a distance, Gao Xuan was about to bump into another Shi Yu’s pet that had surrounded him during his escape…
“Wuuuu!! Wuuu!!”
As Gao Xuan flew, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that had activated the detection system suddenly detected excited voices and powerful energy fluctuations from afar.
Due to the mental connection with Chi Tong, Gao Xuan and the others’ positions had always been locked onto by Eleven, Shi Yu, Buggy, and Susu.
This also led to…
“It’s endless!”
Sensing a huge energy wave in front of him, Gao Xuan was suddenly stunned.
That was… Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast?
[Holy shit, Captain Gao!!!]
[That direction, that position… Holy shit, it’s an Iron-eating Beast that insta-killed ten monarchs of the same level along with 100,000 ferocious beasts!!]
The audience quickly realized that something was wrong and quickly sensed that Gao Xuan was already in a pincer attack state.
Boom!!!
Under a deafening thunderclap in front of him, a huge monster more than a hundred meters tall quickly appeared.
“Roar!!!” Under the lightning, in the distance, the Panda King Eleven, who had transformed into the form of a Nine Li Battle Beast, looked at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast flying over excitedly. It was extremely happy.
Of course, it was very happy. The Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Chi Tong, who were flying over, were not.
Chi Tong was furious when it saw Eleven rush over so quickly to snatch the kill. Tears were already in its eyes.
At this moment, Gao Xuan was shocked to discover that there was something wrong with the Nine Li Battle Beast in front of him.
Energy Points: 8 million
Eleven, who had entered the sharp state, directly erupted to the level of 8 million energy points, blocking thousands of meters away from Gao Xuan and the others.
Realizing the terrifying energy value of this Nine Li Battle Beast, Gao Xuan directly cursed and was very confused again.
If he knew that Eleven could continue to use the natural lightning to erupt and obtain energy values comparable to ten million levels, he would definitely be even more confused.
Of course, in Eleven’s opinion, there was naturally no need to fight so hard to deal with Gao Xuan, who had to escape even when facing Chi Tong. In Eleven’s opinion, this state was enough. After all, he still had to save his strength to eliminate the other contestants.
After discovering Gao Xuan, Eleven roared and stretched out its huge palm, slapping over from afar.
Whoosh.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu—” The ten Bean Bears floated in the air and appeared in front of Eleven’s palm. They hugged together and activated hardening and impregnable. They hugged themselves into an iron ball and kept enlarging!
Boom!!!
In the next moment, under the combination skill of the “Super Electromagnetic Bear” that enlarged Eleven, the impregnable Bean Bear Army that had undergone electromagnetic acceleration was like a huge golden-blue cannonball as it tore through the air. Its target was the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast in the distance!!
Eleven, who had shot out the Bean Bear Cannon, had a deep gaze. Eat this!
[Danger, danger, danger!!!]
“F*ck…”
In the distance, Gao Xuan sensed that this attack wasn’t much inferior to the sword spirit’s attack just now. His gaze exploded to the extreme. What the f*ck was this? Most importantly, wasn’t this Shi Yu’s initial pet? Why didn’t he see that damned Shi Yu!!
It still couldn’t be stopped. If it couldn’t be stopped, it had to use the super frequency driver mode again!!
Soon, Gao Xuan was shocked to discover that an ordinary fusion state was actually still unable to withstand this ridiculous attack.
Moreover, the speed of this move was incomparably terrifying. It was even wrapped in a world-shaking deterrence. Even mechanical pets with extremely good resistance to deterrence actually sensed an overwhelming pressure at this moment.
“Wuu—”
Soon, the Super Electric Bear tore through the air and tore a long spatial crack in midair. Almost instantly, Chi Tong, who was in the distance, turned and ran. It didn’t want to face the aftermath of this move, but the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that was locked onto by deterrence and super vision wasn’t that lucky.
Under the constricted pupils of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan inside, the electromagnetic bear army arrived with a bang, erupting with shocking destructive power. It swallowed the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that raised its shield in despair into the huge smoke again.
This time, the aftermath directly turned into an electromagnetic storm that swept in all directions. At the same time, in the sky, the golden and silver figure of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast fell into the distance like a kite with a broken string again. White smoke lingered on its body, and it was filled with injuries. Moreover, the speed of its fall was even faster this time. It smashed into a huge mountain in the distance and it crumbled!!
[F*ck…]

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (3)
[Captain Gao…]
The extreme reversal made the audience open their mouths wide and speechless.
Holy shit, Captain Gao was sent flying by another pet??
At this moment, countless spectators once again recognized the shocking strength of the Nine Li Battle Beast.
Damn, how were the other contestants supposed to play!
Shi Yu, this monster…
Every pet was so abnormal!
However…
This didn’t seem to be the end. After being sent flying this time, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast still didn’t look heavily injured.
However, although the machinery was good, Gao Xuan’s mentality had already collapsed.
“What the hell!”
He shouted and commanded the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast to accelerate in another direction. His gaze was shocked to the extreme. No, no, no. If this continued, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast would really be crippled!
[Captain Gao, that direction is…]
Everyone looked at Gao Xuan’s escape path again and was suddenly shocked.
In the seat of Spirit Capital University, Li Qiu, who had returned, gulped and looked eagerly at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast flying in the direction of the Water Slime…
On Glass Island.
Eleven and Chi Tong were stunned when they saw that the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was still fine and hadn’t lost its ability to fight. Then, their gazes focused as they chased after the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan again.
But soon, the two of them were as stunned as the audience.
Because before the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast could run far, it was directly locked onto by a Water Slime with a face full of surprise, as if it had won the lottery.
“Wuu!” “Mi!”
Stop, Susu—let go of that Holy Dragon Beast and let them do it!
“Holy shit, what’s this!!!”
Unlike other contestants, Gao Xuan’s detection ability was very strong. He once again discovered a floating Water Slime in the distance, blocking his path.
This wasn’t the most important thing. The most important thing was that the energy value of this Water Slime had reached an unimaginable four million, and it was still rising!!
5 million… 6 million… 7 million… 8 million…
In the distance, Susu looked at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast flying towards it happily. However, it also knew that it definitely couldn’t defeat the other party, so it directly activated the time power stored in the infinite devouring space.
It wasn’t too greedy to transform it into the power of an overlord in one go. It was worried that it would fall after the attack. It only raised its energy level to a barely bearable ten million before stopping. Then, it aimed its gaze fiercely at Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
“Ning ~!!!”
Water mist erupted from the little slime’s body. It opened its mouth wide, and under the shocked expression of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, strong water instantly condensed and compressed in its mouth.
“Holy shit, 10 million.” At the same time, Gao Xuan was stunned when he sensed the energy change that erupted from the slime.
Damn, where did this monster water slime come from???
Wait a minute, Zheng Fan seemed to have said that the fifth pet Shi Yu contracted was the Water Slime?
At the same time.
The Slime roared!
Water Elemental Control, Water Dragon Ice Bullet!
“Roar!!!” As the water compressed in Susu’s mouth, a water dragon that seemed to have been condensed from all the water in a bottomless sea suddenly formed. The water dragon bared its fangs and brandished its claws, wrapped in an ice-blue halo. With a roar, it smashed towards the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast!!
There was a bang!
Accompanied by a huge impact, the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast was directly pushed away. It was instantly sent flying hundreds of meters away. Then, with a boom, its entire body hit a mountain.
Click.
The mountain shattered, and the entire mountain was frozen into an “Ice Dragon Snow Mountain” by the combination skill of the Water Dragon Ball and Frozen Water. The Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, which was sent flying into the mountain wall, felt its frozen body and was extremely annoyed…
Inside, Gao Xuan gritted his teeth.
What happened just now? Who was it? Where was it? What was it?
At the same time.
In the outside world.
The audience watched as Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast were sent flying by Shi Yu’s pets like they were being kicked by a rubber ball. Their mouths opened wide again.
Captain Gao…!
What sin had he committed that deserved such suffering?
The consecutive setbacks increased the burden on the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, causing it to be unable to immediately recover its mobility.
It felt so aggrieved!
In the sunken Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, Gao Xuan and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast were extremely aggrieved.
However, to Gao Xuan’s joy, after experiencing a bunch of difficult setbacks, he finally captured Shi Yu’s presence!
In the distance.
Shi Yu, who was carrying the ginseng baby, teleported over under the Instant Transmission of the Butterfly of Imagination.
Buggy cried.
Why could the other teammates directly stop Gao Xuan? Only it had to return to fetch Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng.
Bah, it was all Baby Ginseng’s fault for not flying fast.
Although Shi Yu was a few steps slower, he still arrived quickly.
He didn’t know where on Glass Island he was.
Shi Yu’s figure flashed and he finally arrived at the battlefield.
After discovering Shi Yu’s arrival, Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, and the others gathered beside Shi Yu.
They wanted to ask Shi Yu whose credit it was.
Everyone was evil.
After arriving, Shi Yu looked at the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast embedded in the ice mountain with a strange expression and fell into deep thought.
Gao Xuan didn’t seem to be as powerful as he imagined?
Or could it be that his pets had unknowingly become too strong…
Crack!!
At the same time, after Shi Yu arrived, Gao Xuan and the others shattered the ice mountain and came out. Be it the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast or Gao Xuan, they looked at Shi Yu surrounded by pets and were furious.

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (4)
“Damn Shi Yu, I’ll fight it out with you.”
After finally seeing Shi Yu and seeing that all of Shi Yu’s pets were gathered here, Gao Xuan finally heaved a sigh of relief.
He admitted that he had completely underestimated Shi Yu.
This guy was simply a monster.
The moment he learned this guy’s identity, he should have paid full attention and been wary of him.
If he had been more prepared, he wouldn’t have been suppressed so badly.
However, it wasn’t too late now. He could finally let go of all his worries and unleash his full strength.
[It’s over, it’s over. Demon King Shi Yu’s entire team is here. Captain Gao is dead!]
[Captain Gao, my Captain Gao!!]
[It’s over. It’s already difficult to fight one of the pets alone. Now that all the other party’s members are here, Captain Gao has no hope.]
At some point, countless contestants who supported Gao Xuan, even the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University, had a psychological shadow over Shi Yu after seeing his battle results one after another.
This archeologist with the gift of telepathy was a super monster. His entire body was ridiculous to the extreme.
Before this, no one expected that the new star in the mechanical field, who had the same awakening talent as the legend of the divine source, would actually be suppressed so badly by an archeologist with a telepathy talent the whole time.
“First, it was General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit, then the Nine Li Battle Beast that evolved again. Then, it was that ridiculous Water Slime…”
“When contestant Gao Xuan rode the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast over, he encountered contestant Shi Yu’s three pets in succession. However, in the end, without exception, they were all crushed and forced back!”
“Although the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast resisted one move after another with its powerful defense, from the current situation, contestant Shi Yu’s battle power clearly has the upper hand…”
“At the moment, both parties have finally encountered each other. Captain Gao Xuan’s situation is extremely disadvantageous. He’s completely at a disadvantage and has been forced into a desperate situation. Could it be that the two strongest contestants in the National League will decide the winner between them in the preliminaries, and in less than an hour after the preliminaries begin??”
“I have to say, even if I’m watching the live broadcast, I can feel it with Captain Gao Xuan. No one expected contestant Shi Yu’s pets’ strength to be so terrifying. This demon-like pressure is simply suffocating.”
Under the two commentators’ explanations, countless spectators held their breaths.
In the beginning, they thought that Gao Xuan had a higher chance of winning, but now, Gao Xuan was forced into a corner. The change was simply too fast.
In the scene.
The Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast holding a shield looked at Shi Yu, who was surrounded by five pets.
“No!!” Just as a shocking battle was about to happen between the two parties, Gu Yu suddenly discovered some changes.
A shocking aura that had materialized suddenly erupted from the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
The entire Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast seemed to have a body of flesh and blood. Its muscles “expanded” and countless metals spread out, causing the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body to expand rapidly.
The space around the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast began to collapse. Energy matter that was like a black hole spread from the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s body, changing it to dark red.
The ground under its feet shattered into nothingness. The tall mountain behind it instantly turned into powder. A dark dome appeared in the sky, causing the sky to darken.
Boom!!!
The violent change not only shocked the audience outside the arena, but even Shi Yu and the others in the arena were forced back by the overlord aura erupted by the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, revealing looks of surprise.
Did he still have any trump cards?
“This energy…”
“Did he successfully awaken that metal skeleton into a mechanical weapon?”
In the outside world, Legend Xiao Shuang’s gaze froze. She immediately reminded the Eye of the Stars to concentrate all its attention here.
Forget about the other contestants for the time being. At least, he had to ensure the safety of the confrontation between these two “extraordinary” contestants.
“This, this, this is…”
As the giant of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast changed, it was the two commentators’ turn to be stunned again.
At this moment, apart from the members of the fourth bureau, almost everyone was extremely confused by Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s new form.
“Gao Xuan did it in the full-power overclocking mode.” The big shots in the fourth bureau were silent.
They naturally knew how many special mechanical materials Gao Xuan had taken from the bureau to strengthen himself.
However, they didn’t expect Gao Xuan to really do it. Moreover, he was really forced to use his full strength.
However, in this state, the burden on oneself and the damage to the opponent would be immeasurable.
He wondered if Xiao Shuang could control the situation at the scene.
“Contestant Gao Xuan… has entered an unprecedented state!!!”
As the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast turned from a gold and silver dragonman mecha to a dark red giant god soldier, such a reversal made the two commentators immediately shout.
“This state is…”
“The mechanical fusion mode of the five-in-one. Through the connection of the special energy and the special converter, the core is the entire metal skeleton of the overlord-level dragonman life form, the Tyrant Dragon King.” At this moment, Legend Xiao Shuang stood up and spoke solemnly.
“10 million… 20 million…”
“Under this full-power overclocking state, it can temporarily allow Gao Xuan and the others to obtain the full power of an overlord. The power they can display is not what a simple attack from an overlord-level ferocious beast can compare to. Of course, the burden on their bodies will also be huge.”

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (5)
As he spoke, Xiao Shuang’s eyes filled with light. She communicated with the Eye of the Stars in the distance and protected this battle with all her might.
Her words instantly ignited the crowd.
Captain Gao still had a trump card!!!
At this moment, when the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University saw the huge change in Gao Xuan, they were almost instantly pleasantly surprised.
As for the teachers and students of Ancient Capital University, their excited expressions disappeared. Their gazes instantly froze, and their expressions became serious.
“This Gao Xuan is so difficult to deal with.” Principal Feng gritted his teeth.
“Yes, that’s it. Victory!” The old principal of Imperial Capital University clenched his fists.
Just now, when Gao Xuan fell from the altar, it directly made them think that Imperial Capital University was going to miss this national championship, but from the looks of it, everything wasn’t over!
[There’s still hope!]
[All the best, big brother in the mecha!]
[Holy shit, what trump card is this? Is he trying to kill Big Boss Shi Yu?]
An all-round overlord power!!
It was also an overlord-level attack. A low-level skill from an overlord-level life form was definitely different from a serious attack from an overlord-level life form or a full-strength attack.
And now, the power that the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast could erupt with had already reached the average strength of an overlord-level life form.
“With Sister Xiao Shuang around, you guys will be fine!!”
“But next, it’s your turn to suffer.” In the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Gao Xuan was panting.
“Combination skill, Black Star Annihilation Cannon!!”
The entire body of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast had already been modified to be completely different from the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast just now. It was filled with a violent aura, and its arms even turned into huge cannon barrels.
Boom!!!
The terrifying dark red energy that was like a small star exploding turned into a violent energy pillar that could devour everything. It locked onto space and swept towards Shi Yu and the others unstoppably.
The entire scene was covered by a dark red energy wave, making everyone watching the live broadcast instantly feel their hearts skip a beat. This pressure…
At the same time.
Xiao Shuang and the Eye of the Stars quickly locked onto Shi Yu and the others’ situation.
The live broadcast also switched to Shi Yu.
However, to everyone’s surprise, Shi Yu still looked calm in the face of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that had become even more terrifying.
It was as calm as when he had just arrived and faced the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan.
However, what stunned everyone the most was not Shi Yu’s expression, but Shi Yu’s state!!
At this moment, Shi Yu had a small Nine Li Battle Beast standing on his left shoulder, the Butterfly of Imagination on his right shoulder, a Water Slime on his head, and a sword spirit in his right hand. He was fully armed and looked extremely serious, but he didn’t look that serious either.
As for Baby Ginseng, it hid behind and looked at these guys with a headache.
Was there a need to be so ruthless?
Shi Yu’s state stunned everyone.
This guy…
What was he doing?
“It can even seal space.”
Shi Yu was very surprised, but it didn’t matter.
An attack of this level was only akin to one of his pets that ate the full-strength Time Fruit.
It could be easily cracked.
Facing the incoming Black Star Annihilation Cannon, Shi Yu and the others did not dodge. Instead, they chose to counterattack head-on!
“Then I’ll also show you our strongest attack under normal circumstances…”
Boom!!!
In an instant, red fire threads erupted around Shi Yu and lingered around him.
At the same time, the sky and ground below him changed almost instantly.
An extremely close fiery red sun appeared in the sky.
Under his feet was a shocking sea of lightning surrounded by black clouds.
Buggy materialized almost instantly in the environment Shi Yu needed the most.
Imagination Domain!
Under the light of the flames, Shi Yu’s gaze seemed to contain flames as well. The color of his eyes gradually changed in the direction of Chi Tong’s burning eyes.
With a boom, a fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun turned into flames that wrapped around Shi Yu’s entire body. At this moment, Shi Yu’s entire body seemed to have become thinner but more powerful!!
Moreover, at this moment, Shi Yu’s hair had completely turned bright red. His skin also became even fairer under the illumination of the fire spiritual energy!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s aura had completely changed. He no longer looked like a human. The emotions in his eyes had faded a lot. The moment Chi Tong possessed Shi Yu, Eleven also hardened Shi Yu’s entire body and gathered the power of lightning hardening on the spiritual sword in Shi Yu’s hand.
Metal Thunder Flame Sword!
As for Susu, it completely turned into liquid frozen water and fused into Shi Yu’s body, helping him cool down.
“Thunder Flame Sword Pressure!”
At this moment, Shi Yu raised his arm high. The fire sword condensed in his hand and slowly landed.
With a loud bang, the fire spiritual energy on Shi Yu’s body instantly fused with the lightning. At this moment, blue lightning lingered on Shi Yu’s body, and orange-red sun flames flowed. Under the interweaving of the two intertwined powers, Shi Yu’s aura increased further!
With the Interlocking Sword as the core, the sword pressure that fused the power of lightning and the power of sun instantly displayed power that exceeded the limit…
Boom!!!
In an instant, the Thunder Flame Sword Domain that bloomed in front of Shi Yu, the huge power of the Thunder Flame that surged into the sky, and the Black Star Annihilation Cannon squeezed together. The shocking collision sound lingered in the air, but in an instant, the incomparably powerful Black Star Annihilation Cannon was directly pushed back by the Thunder Flame Sword. With a boom, under the incomprehensible gazes of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan, the sword pressure instantly swallowed the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan without a trace under everyone’s incredulous gazes!!

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Shi Yu Ascends to the National League (6)
Boom!!!
Right on the heels of that, the Thunder Flame Sword pressure was still pushing forward, directly splitting the island land into two. The huge Thunder Flame Storm instantly swallowed everything around it!
At this moment, almost half the contestants and creatures on the island looked at the terrifying Thunder Flame Cloud rising in the sky in shock!
“What happened?”
All over the island, the contestants revealed shocked expressions.
Outside the island, the audience looked at the short black screen of the live broadcast and also revealed incomparably shocked expressions.
Holy shit.
What happened!
Countless spectators and the two big shots on the platform looked at Legend Xiao Shuang.
At this moment, Legend Xiao Shuang’s expression was filled with disbelief.
“Is that kid… a monster?”
“Gao Xuan has already done this, and he’s still… unable to fight back?”
A moment later!!
Everything disappeared. The figures of the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and Gao Xuan had completely disappeared. What entered his eyes was a complete mess. It was divided into two halves, the ruins of the island burning with flames and spreading lightning.
The outcome was self-evident.
Although they didn’t know what had happened, the audience was shocked to the extreme.
Countless spectators opened their mouths wide and looked at the scene in front of them in shock. They were speechless.
Damn, damn.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who had red hair and red eyes like a god. They looked at the spiritual sword in his hand, the Black Star Annihilation Cannon and the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast that had been crushed into nothingness… They were shocked to the extreme.
This was… Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit possessing Shi Yu?
But the power of this sword move…
Didn’t the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast just now have the complete overlord power???
This, this, this…
Where was the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast, Gao Xuan? Could it be that… Shi Yu…
Was this guy a monster!!!
Seeing that Shi Yu, who was still calmly burning everything with a single attack in the face of Gao Xuan, everyone was stunned to the extreme. Didn’t this guy have any limits?
“Gao Xuan is fine. I’ve already teleported him away from the island. He’s eliminated.”
At the same time, on the platform, Xiao Shuang took a deep breath and spoke.
At this moment, the big shots of the fourth bureau, especially Old Liu, suddenly felt dizzy.
Everyone looked at the scene again.
After dealing with Gao Xuan, Shi Yu immediately exited the possession state. Then, he heaved a sigh of relief. His mind and body were a little tired.
Fortunately, at this moment, Baby Ginseng had already created a few exclusive nutritional fruits at the back and handed them to Shi Yu and the others.
“Crack!”
In the scene, Shi Yu bit into the apple-like nutritional fruit. The other pets also ate happily. During the process of eating the fruit, Shi Yu sighed. He needed to get his mechanical pet quickly. Possession of his own joint attack was still tiring, but if he could create a huge mecha that could perfectly integrate Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and his strength, with less side effects, that would be perfect.
“Gao Xuan, eliminated. Let’s count it as everyone’s score.”
Shi Yu said.
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Mi!” “Yi!” “Ning!!”
The five pets cheered.
“Alright, the most ‘difficult’ guy has been dealt with. Next, we can quickly clean up the other contestants on the island without any worries.” Shi Yu finished eating the nutritional fruit and said to the pets who had also finished eating the nutritional fruit.
In the next moment, a scene that everyone in the audience and the contestants of this National League regarded as a terrifying nightmare appeared in the scene.
The Nine Li Battle Beast, the Butterfly of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, the Sword Spirit, and the Water Slime each separated into five clones. Then, this pile of clones erupted with terrifying power and flew into the sky, flying to various parts of the island. This scene made the spectators outside shocked until their jaws couldn’t close again. They suddenly thought of a terrifying fact.
If Gao Xuan was easily defeated by this monster, would the other contestants still be his match?
Definitely not.
In fact, in this monster’s eyes, the other contestants seemed to be beatable with just the clones of his pets?
Looking at Shi Yu’s pets flying out excitedly like hunting food, the two commentators directly said,
“This, this, this… contestant Shi Yu, is he preparing to defeat all the contestants in the preliminaries and become the final winner?!”
The shout of the commentator echoed in everyone’s ears. Countless people were stunned, but they felt that this didn’t seem to be difficult for this monster.
In less than an hour, he had already easily eliminated the previous champion, three contestants, and more than 100,000 ferocious beasts. It was as if there was no limit.
At this moment, the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University had long “suffered a heat stroke”. Seeing their invincible legend easily lose, they spat out a mouthful of blood.
Of course, the current scene fell into the hands of Shi Yu’s huge supporters. They were satisfied all the way, especially those spectators who had been paying attention to Shi Yu since the vocation assessment. Those who had watched the Iron-eating Beast Knight grow up were completely excited.
“It’s stable!” The gem cat said happily as it looked at Shi Yu’s figure in the scene.
“It’s stable!” Principal Feng’s face was also red.
“Is Shi Yu and the others going to reach the top of the National League?” The panda senior was still in a daze and had yet to react.
…
At the same time.
The screams of contestants and ferocious beasts kept coming from all over Glass Island, making the audience tremble in fear.
Of course, there were also those who weren’t that miserable, those who were quite tactful.
In a certain forest, White Brook looked at the group of Shi Yu’s pet clones walking over arrogantly and subconsciously raised her hand.
This National League had become a butcher’s field.
As Shi Yu kept cleaning up the remaining contestants, more and more Beast Tamers who didn’t pay attention to the National League also looked at the National League.
This was because a monster had appeared in the National League this time. Not only did he easily eliminate the genius Mechanic Gao Xuan from the last champion, the fourth bureau, but he also eliminated the other contestants one after another, planning to end the National League in the preliminaries!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - National Champion Shi Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: National Champion Shi Yu
Glass Island.
After Shi Yu finished dealing with Gao Xuan and let his pet recover a little, he chose a more efficient competition method.
It was to let the pets split into clones to deal with the remaining contestants.
When he was young, when he watched cartoons, those big villains would wave their hands and a bunch of lackeys would go and destroy the world. Their efficiency was super high.
Shi Yu happened to have similar skills.
In fact, they even formed small teams. Each team brought a ginseng baby clone that could gather and clear monsters faster.
As for whether it would fail?
Shi Yu looked at the Bean Bear with more than a million energy points and shook his head.
This clone was almost comparable to the trump card battle pet of ordinary contestants. Since Gao Xuan had been eliminated, it was impossible for it to fail.
…
The vice-captain of Imperial Capital University, Bai Wenjie.
He had a monarch-level pet, the Ice River Mammoth.
Its strength was not bad.
He had once fought Shi Yu in the exchange between Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University.
Because he had underestimated Shi Yu, he was defeated by the commander-level Butterfly of Imagination without activating his Beast Taming Talent.
This time, through the drawing of lots, he was teleported to a snowfield area of Glass Island. His luck was pretty good. It was a home environment.
“Although it’s the home ground, why do I feel that there are no contestants nearby?”
“As expected, I still have to go to other places to take a look. That’s right, probably no contestant will run to the snowfield. Sigh.” After Bai Wenjie arrived at Glass Island for an hour and didn’t see anyone, he sighed and decided to take the initiative to attack.
But at this moment, he surprisingly saw five figures flying towards him.
“This is…”
Seeing these five figures, Bai Wenjie’s expression changed drastically.
The Ice Silk Phoenix under him and the Ice River Mammoth beside him also instantly became extremely serious.
It was the little Iron-eating Beast that flew with electromagnetic power, the Butterfly of Imagination that flapped its wings, the little sword spirit that flew with flames all over its body, the elemental creature that turned into water and swam in the air, and… the ginseng baby carried by the Iron-eating Beast!
This combination made Bai Wenjie, who had plenty of info on Shi Yu and had fought him before, determine almost instantly that Shi Yu had secretly locked onto him!!
Moreover, he had even sent all their pets to surround him!!
“Not good!!”
If it were a few months ago, even if he had lost to Shi Yu, Bai Wenjie would still be very unconvinced.
However, ever since Yin Zhengfan returned from Dragon Palace City and shared Shi Yu’s battle results with the school team of Imperial Capital University, as well as Shi Yu’s name appearing in the top 100 of the Sequence battle, Bai Wenjie knew that this monster with heaven-defying growth speed was no longer something he could fight against.
Therefore, when he saw Shi Yu send all his pets to surround him this time, Bai Wenjie immediately acted as if he was facing a great enemy. He turned around with his pets and ran into the snowfield, hoping to use the ice and snow environment to increase the battle power of his pets and deal with Shi Yu!!
However…
Boom.
Unexpectedly, when the five pets saw Bai Wenjie, they were like hungry wolves seeing lambs. Their eyes turned red as they charged over. Even Baby Ginseng instantly broke free from Eleven’s arms and shot out an energy storage beam from afar, hoping to snatch this kill.
A moment later.
East Sea Arena.
The vice-captain of Imperial Capital University appeared with a blank expression. He was vexed and indignant. He didn’t expect Shi Yu’s pets to be so strong. He didn’t expect that he had only entered the competition for an hour before being found and eliminated by Shi Yu. It was even more difficult for him to accept that he didn’t even see Shi Yu’s figure!!
“Captain Bai…” After Bai Wenjie was eliminated, a student from Imperial Capital University immediately picked him up.
“I…” Bai Wenjie felt ashamed to face the nurturing of Imperial Capital University, the expectations of his juniors and teachers. He was actually eliminated before he could even enter the finals.
Damn it, Shi Yu’s pets were indeed strong and too fierce.
Presumably, the school would understand him.
However, at this moment, the student who came said with a silent expression, “Captain Bai, listen to me. What I’m going to say next might be a little cruel. Do you want me to say it, or do you want to watch the live broadcast yourself…”
“Huh?” Bai Wenjie suddenly realized strangely that after a super genius like him was eliminated, the 100,000 spectators present actually didn’t have any reaction!
What he didn’t know was that the audience was already numb.
He looked at the live broadcast screen in confusion.
At this moment, Han Lu and Gu Yu, the two commentators, were also saying regretfully, “Unfortunately!! contestant Bai Wenjie, the deputy captain of Imperial Capital University, was also defeated by contestant Shi Yu’s pet clone team.”
“Looks like… Shi Yu, who defeated contestant Gao Xuan, is indeed unstoppable, even if it’s just his pet clones…”
“Let’s see the search situation of the other clone teams…”
In the split screen, there were several small teams formed by five pets flying high in the sky of Glass Island, searching for lone contestants and monarch-level ferocious beasts.
Seeing the contestants, the group of clones rushed forward as if they were on steroids. In order to snatch the first kill, they went all out and quickly eliminated the contestants.
Of course, if they encountered someone they knew, they were still relatively polite.
For example, in a certain dense forest, Xia Qingwei, who had been Shi Yu’s assistant, looked at the group of Shi Yu’s pet clones walking over arrogantly. When she heard their words, “Gao Xuan is insta-killed, Ancient Capital is prosperous, King Shi Yu!”, she almost turned and ran.
However, it was useless to run. The Buggy phantom used worm silk, the ginseng baby clone used the hypnotic sweet aura, and the few pets pitifully eliminated Shi Yu’s acquaintances without causing them any harm.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - National Champion Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: National Champion Shi Yu (1)
“F*ck!!! That’s a clone?!!!!!”
“What, Captain Gao was insta-killed?”
In the arena, after watching the live broadcast for a long time, Bai Wenjie finally reacted. The reaction was a little long, and he immediately shouted in shock.
“Another one went crazy.”
In the contestant area of Spirit Capital University, Li Qiu, who had long been eliminated, Chu Yi’ang, who had long been eliminated, and Shi Zhuo, who had long been eliminated in the contestant area of Demon Capital University… All looked at Bai Wenjie, whose pupils had also lost hope, without any hope in his eyes, and said regretfully…
“Next.”
The other eliminated contestants and the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University looked at this fact in silence, no longer wanting to struggle.
The three big shots on the platform looked at this “massacre” national competition preliminaries and no longer wanted to say anything.
…
Icefield City, Ping Cheng.
Hall Master Lin, Commander He, President Feng, and the others swallowed their saliva and watched the live broadcast of the National League in a daze.
Shi Yu’s consecutive performance in the National League kept impacting their values.
Although they knew that Shi Yu was very strong, the few Ping Cheng masters never expected Shi Yu to be so ridiculously strong.
Five monarch-level pets of overlord races?
The same talent as the mechanical legend, the last national champion with the greatest talent in the mechanical field, Gao Xuan… Instantly killed?
“A good National League has forcefully turned into a baby cup of killing…” In the environmental base outside the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, General Xiao Qin, Huang Qi, Qin Mingzhi, and the other navy rookies who had experienced the battle of the Vortex Demon with Shi Yu watched the live broadcast. They covered their eyes and couldn’t bear to look.
A monster that had killed two overlords and shaken a group of guardians to crush a totem magical beast… To let this guy participate in the National League, wasn’t this letting a tiger into the sheep pen!
“That Gao Xuan is a little…”
At this moment, everywhere in the country, be it big shots or passers-by, they were all paying attention to the National League and swallowing their saliva crazily.
Legend Xiao Hai from the navy headquarters, Legend Yin Zhongrong from the ancient capital, Legend Hua Xiajin from the Divine Capital, Legend Wu Lingbai… These veteran big shots were no exception.
“Finally, someone can feel my pain?” Even in a certain place, Master Qu Jie and the Ox-Headed Beast King watched the competition calmly.
As Shi Yu’s pets all appeared in the National League and displayed their extraordinary strength, many people finally recognized this young man who had only had academic achievements previously. They didn’t expect his strength to be so terrifying.
The National League had only started less than three hours ago.
It was not even noon that day.
Everyone was shocked to discover that all the contestants placed on Glass Island had already been neatly eliminated by Shi Yu alone.
“1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 17…”
At this moment, somewhere on Glass Island, Shi Yu and his pets were still conflicted over the math problem.
“Damn.”
“Which one of your clones eliminated the two guys we just found?”
“Didn’t we agree to keep two?”
On the island, Shi Yu shouted in confusion.
The pets were also stunned.
Damn it, who was it?
Everyone looked at each other and searched for the mole.
“The competition time is a day. Only a little time has passed, and there’s still a pile of monarch-level ferocious beasts on the island. If we eliminate all the contestants so early, what if the competition authorities teleport us out before the time ends?” Shi Yu muttered.
“It’s all bonuses.”
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!!”
The five pets were stunned. Yes, yes.
At the same time.
Just as Shi Yu had said, as all the contestants on the island were eliminated, the Eye of the Stars, or rather, Legend Xiao Shuang, who controlled the Eye of the Stars, indeed didn’t plan to let the preliminaries continue until 24 hours later, which was tomorrow. She directly let the Eye of the Star teleport Shi Yu, this wolf, back.
This also caused Shi Yu and the others on Glass Island to look at the big eye that appeared. They were very unwilling.
Soon after.
Shi Yu and his pets were also teleported back to the East Sea Arena.
At the same time, the two commentators shouted crazily,
“Unbelievable!!! In just three hours, contestant Shi Yu eliminated all the contestants with invincible strength. Looks like the individual competition champion of this year’s National League was born with absolute battle results in the preliminaries!!”
“He’s… contestant Shi Yu from Ancient Capital University!!”
The commentator shouted very hard.
However, as Shi Yu appeared, the East Sea Arena was still silent. The teachers and students of the other major universities and the contestants just now looked at Shi Yu fiercely.
This wave… belonged to one person who defeated the eight major universities and became the public enemy.
Shi Yu smiled. It couldn’t be helped. The competition authorities had priced the heads of the contestants from each school…
At this moment, Han Lu and Gu Yu, the two commentators, suddenly liked Shi Yu. Damn, they were originally going to work hard for 24 hours, but this time, it actually ended so quickly??
Next time, please have more contestants like Shi Yu!
They liked it!
However, it was useless just because they liked it. Shi Yu was too ruthless this time. He directly traumatized the eight major universities. They definitely wouldn’t like him.
Only the teachers and students of Ancient Capital University were extremely excited.
Of course, although the high-level Beast Tamers from Ancient Capital University who participated in the team battle were also excited, they also felt that it was very bitter. They kept feeling that after Shi Yu finished showing off, they would be the ones to take revenge again… Just like the exchange competition at Imperial Capital University.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - National Champion Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: National Champion Shi Yu (2)
In addition, White Brook, who was also forced to surrender by Shi Yu, was also angry.
Didn’t Shi Yu know how to take it a bit easier on her?
“Hahahaha.” In the end, Director Zhong Yan’s laughter broke the unbelievable silence. On the platform, he looked at Shi Yu and said, “I believe you already know that you’ve won the individual championship of this National League, right?”
“Congratulations. Anything you want to say?”
President Xia and Legend Xiao also took a deep breath.
Shi Yu was stunned as he stood at the venue. Then, he said happily, “The National League is very good. I’ll come again next time.”
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!!”
They also found it interesting. They would come again next time! Wasn’t this picking up money!
Everyone: “?”
The eight major universities:???
Only then did the eight universities realize that Shi Yu was only in his first year of university.
The first, second, and third-year students of the eight major universities, the low-level elites who were about to replace their seniors as representatives of the school, instantly widened their eyes.
This kid… get lost!!!
Don’t come over!
What the hell!
The principals of the eight major universities were shocked. All the education funds this year would be given to Ancient Capital University. Could they ban this kid from competing for the rest of his life??
“Ah, this.” Director Zhong’s balls hurt. If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have asked…
…
Shi Yu didn’t stay at the venue for long. It was mainly because the scene was too hot for him to bear.
He immediately ran back and didn’t even plan to participate in the interview. He decided to watch the live broadcast replay and admire his and his pets’ heroic bearing first.
Originally, the individual competition preliminaries would last for an entire day, but due to some accidents, it ended in less than half a day.
The contestants naturally returned to the contestant village. As for the audience, they returned to their residence and waited for the team battle tomorrow.
Of course, compared to the “intense” individual battle, the discussion and attention of the low-level team battle were not very high.
The entire Beast Tamer domain of Dong Huang was still discussing Shi Yu.
At the moment, the most sensitive person to this incident was Zou Tianwang of the Dark Club in Demon Capital.
Zou Tianwang, Heavenly King Zou, originally didn’t pay much attention to the national competition, but he discovered a lot of news. “Shi Yu defeated Gao Xuan”, “The Nine Li Battle Beast evolved again”, “Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit”, “The National Champion Shi Yu eliminated all members”, “The mystery of the physical strength of the Butterfly of Imagination”, “Is the Water Slime that strong” and “Is Baby Ginseng worth contracting”, among other trending topics, he realized that something was wrong. His eyes gradually turned red and he was extremely envious.
F*ck, why were there so many trending topics related to Shi Yu!!!
Massacre!
This was an achievement even more impressive than being first on the trending list.
Damn it, he was envious.
“This guy… why is he so ruthless!!!”
“This guy is probably more popular than Ye Xing now.”
“Why don’t we invite Shi Yu to a Sequence battle?”
“Wait… This kid’s strength… is so strong?! Ah… What if I lose?”
Then, there were various trending topics such as “Shi Yu advanced to Sequence 24”. For a moment, Shi Yu’s name swept through the country.
The recognition level this time could be considered to have completely reached the national level. It was mainly because this National League was too ridiculous, and the attention was several times higher than last year.
At this moment, at the core of the entire incident, Shi Yu and his pets were resting well in the contestant village.
He also calculated the reward.
“Every monarch-level ferocious beast I hunted is 10 million yuan. It’s too stingy. They only give bonuses and they still confiscate the ferocious beasts. Some ferocious beasts have more than 10 million yuan worth of materials, not to mention that I preserved them so perfectly… It’s better to find wild areas to pick up materials and sell in the future…”
“A total of 31 monarch-level ferocious beasts were hunted, about 310 million.”
“Every contestant eliminated is 20 million yuan. This is also stingy. We’ve eliminated a total of 20. In total, it’s only 400 million.”
“Gao Xuan has so many monarch-level pets, and he’s even the previous champion. He’s actually worth the same price as Senior Bai. He’s a BUG in this reward system. Anyone would say that this is a BUG.”
Shi Yu and the others calculated for a long time. In the preliminaries, they could obtain about 700 million yuan.
However, this was all a bonus.
Most importantly, the physical reward for the final ranking of these 21 contestants and the physical reward for the first place national champion were the main rewards.
Although there were only two rewards, they were both expensive!
First reward for individual champion: Hundred Transformations Stone (Wind) and a set of top-notch basic mechanical materials.
The Hundred Transformations Stone was a wind-element level-eight mechanical material that was worth more than a billion. Moreover, it was a super rare resource that was difficult to buy even with money. Its number was extremely limited.
Individual champion reward number two: Space Crystal (Space).
This was a level-six ore resource with a spatial attribute. It was worth hundreds of millions, a resource to assist Beast Tamers in raising the level of the Beast Taming Space. In the third bureau, they had once given Shi Yu a piece. It was this that helped Shi Yu raise the Beast Taming Space from level four to level five in a few months.
Now that Shi Yu was at the master level, the effect of the Space Crystal should be much weaker, but it was better than nothing.
Therefore, in this National League, Shi Yu had obtained a total of two billion worth of resources. It was a huge gain.
Of course, Ancient Capital University also made a killing with Shi Yu this time. This year’s education funds should be able to suppress Imperial Capital and Demon Capital University. At that time, as a meritorious minister, Shi Yu would definitely have a lot of benefits.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - National Champion Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: National Champion Shi Yu (3)
In addition, the gem cat’s little vault… No, that was his. The billions in his little vault, after some calculation… Shi Yu felt that he was already so rich.
“Sigh, rich my ass. I have to use the mechanical materials myself. I might even have to keep adding funds to them. The rest can’t even buy me half a legendary resource. I’m still poor.” However, after being happy for a moment, Shi Yu sighed.
The rewards and prizes could only be received after the competition completely ended. At this moment, Shi Yu was thinking if there were any other places where he could get resources or money.
The National League was over. It was time to look into the future. He planned to collect five to six legendary resources in a year. It would be best if his spatial level broke through to level seven and he became a legendary Beast Tamer. Then he could obtain the qualifications to go abroad. Whether he participated in the World Tournament or not, he wanted to see the World Tree.
Shi Yu also knew that time was tight. He wanted to see if he could increase the level of his pet and his own body at the same time by crazily adding some super skills this year…
…
At the same time, in the contestant village of Imperial Capital University.
Gao Xuan, who was covered in bandages, opened the door in disappointment. He subconsciously said, “Principal, I didn’t…”
“Teacher?”
Gao Xuan was stunned. Seeing that the person who came was not the old principal of Imperial Capital University, but his guide in the fourth bureau, Elder Liu, he immediately didn’t want to face him.
“Lost? You feel very uncomfortable, right?”
Elder Liu, who had rushed to Demon Capital, looked at Gao Xuan and sighed.
“Sorry, Teacher. I disappointed you and lost the competition… I didn’t get the mechanical materials.”
“Forget it, it’s not your fault.” Old Liu shook his head.
If Gao Xuan had lost the competition for other reasons, he would indeed be disappointed. However, this time… Shi Yu, who had suddenly appeared, even if Elder Liu was in Gao Xuan’s shoes, he didn’t know how to break out of the situation. He only felt deep despair. This little monster was too strong.
Gao Xuan was already very prepared. Apart from small forbidden weapons that couldn’t be used, he had already used all his trump cards. But even so, he was still not Shi Yu’s match. Not to mention, he had no chance at all. Old Liu could only sigh. This newbie from the third and eleventh bureau was really scary.
Gao Xuan’s loss was not unjust. He accepted it.
“It’s just a Hundred Transformations Stone. It’s not rare,” Old Liu said.
Gao Xuan was silent. It wasn’t about the Hundred Transformations Stone, but the loss of this competition. It made him feel very uncomfortable and he gritted his teeth.
“It’s also a good thing. If you don’t count Shi Yu, you should be the youngest Beast Tamer in the top 100 of the Sequence. You’re only 21 years old, but you already have such achievements. You’re already very talented. I was originally worried that you would be too arrogant because of this, but there’s no need to worry now. With a monster younger and stronger than you spur you on, it’ll save you the trouble of relaxing. It’s just a National League, and it’s far from the end. Since he’s also participating in the Sequence battle, you guys will have a chance to fight sooner or later.”
“In addition, don’t you want to participate in the world competition? If you have any hope of entering the top ten of the Sequence, he will also successfully enter. Apart from being a competitor, you will also be teammates in the future. The stronger your teammates are, the more at ease you should be. In short, only by encouraging each other can we grow together. Do you know what to do next?”
“Don’t worry about the National League first. You’re about to graduate. At that time, concentrate on preparing for the Mechanical Conference. This conference is far more important to you than the National League.”
“I understand.” Gao Xuan nodded.
The Mechanical Conference was similar to the Feeding Conference. It was the annual innovation mechanical product exhibition of Dong Huang. Because Dong Huang had developed the mechanical field vigorously in recent decades, the attention, value, and various benefits of the Mechanical Conference were higher than the entry requirements of the Feeding Conference.
Gao Xuan had been researching an extremely important innovative technology product through his “Awakening” talent since a long time ago. Perhaps he had hope of winning the Gold Award of the Mechanical Conference with this. Many seniors in the fourth bureau also thought very highly of it, so apart from the National League, the fourth bureau also prepared very rich rewards at this conference to support new stars in the mechanical field…

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin
Shi Yu had already made a decision.
Initially, Shi Yu’s plan was to wait until the pets mastered “Advanced Will”, which was also “Overlord Will”, before teaching them super skills.
“Teaching success rate: high” It looked safer this way.
But now, he changed his mind.
Beast Tamers were all fickle.
“Teaching success rate: Medium” might not necessarily be impossible.
Although, if the pet’s willpower and mind weren’t strong enough, forcefully accepting the super skill experience might cause its mind to lose its rationality and cause the teaching to fail.
However, Shi Yu thought about it. Contracting Susu was the perfect move.
When he added points, Baby Ginseng would heal him while Susu had the ability to cleanse the mind. Wasn’t this a pet combo that allowed adding super skills??
If he added some super skills to Eleven and the others, with Susu cleansing their hearts beside him so that they could better withstand the baptism of super skills, the theoretical success rate would not be low.
Moreover, according to Susu’s feedback, the process of adding some super skills was very tempering to the recipient’s will and heart.
Perhaps he could increase their willpower by adding some super skills to them so they could strive to reach the overlord’s will.
“Baby Ginseng, heal me.”
“Susu, cleanse the pet.”
“If it goes as smoothly as I have judged, I should be able to add free points freely soon.”
Shi Yu was still lying in the dormitory.
After calculating the rewards, he continued to check his resources.
At the moment, the resources on him, the ruin ring, archeology, Feeding index, Awakening Mirror, the ruins crystal left behind by Emperor Shi, the meteorite fragment, and the Kirin fossil.. .They were relatively precious.
Apart from these, there were also three level-seven dragon-element resources, the Ice Dragon Whiskers, the Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth fossil, and the Sea Dragon King’s scales. Although these looked pretty good previously, they were basically useless now. Shi Yu had already made preparations. When the time came, he would let Susu swallow the Ice Dragon Whiskers and the Sea Dragon King’s scales. As for the Tyrant Dragon’s Teeth, he would leave them for the phantom beast mechanical experiment.
There was also the Gemini Silver Armor gifted by the Ice Dragon. Because it was broken, although it was of legendary quality, it couldn’t be said to be precious. When it was first obtained, it was still at level six, but after using it a few times, the energy loss was very serious. It had already fallen to level five, and the more it was used, the worse it became.
Shi Yu planned to leave it to Chi Tong as a cultivation resource. Although it would accelerate the damage, Chi Tong’s Interlocking Sword skill might be able to rely on the Gemini Silver Armor to approach expert proficiency.
Apart from that, Shi Yu also discovered that there was a level-eight Water of Life, ten level-seven Water of Life, a hundred level-six Water of Life, and a bottle of level-seven Dragon Blood in the ruins. After he returned from the Rainbow Islands, the Sea Dragon King saw that his hair was white and his face was weak and asked the Turtle Prime Minister to send them over.
Shi Yu didn’t use it for the time being, but after he continued adding points to super skills, he could use it with the nourishment of the ginseng baby.
As for the level-seven dragon blood essence, although it was also an extremely precious resource, because Shi Yu didn’t need to train his physique, this didn’t seem to be of much use to him. When the time came, he could sell it for other resources.
The other daily consumption resources, such as Eleven and the others’ food and nutritional supplements, were replenished as they were consumed. Shi Yu didn’t care. In the end, he looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon that was still jumping around outside the fossil research institute.
“By the way.”
Shi Yu suddenly thought of something.
It seemed that after Buggy broke through to the monarch level, they had never studied the Kirin fossil together.
Although the Dream Steal skill had long been upgraded to the maximum level by Shi Yu, these max-level skills actually couldn’t be perfectly used with the commander rank strength of Buggy and the others.
Just like Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit, if Eleven and the others ate the Time Fruit it created when it was at the commander level, the side effects would be huge. If Baby Ginseng reached the totem level itself, there might not be any side effects. Just like an ordinary low-level skill, Fireball… Being used by transcendent-level pets would result in much different effects than if it were used by totem-level pets. end
Since Buggy had broken through, could it try to study the Kirin fossil again?
Although there was still no progress in using the Tyrant Dragon fossil to study mechanical phantom beasts, this didn’t stop Shi Yu and the others from being curious about the secret of the Kirin fossil.
After all, it was a fossil suspected to be a divine-level life form. If it could really enter the dream successfully, the mechanical beast would be secondary. The most important thing was to come into contact with the Mythical Era.
“Buggy.”
Shi Yu shouted and entered the ruins space.
…
At the fossil research institute.
Shi Yu sat in front of the table, and Buggy landed on the table. Both parties stared at the Kirin Horn fossil in front of them.
The white fossil was very beautiful, like white jade. However, although it was called a Kirin Horn fossil, it actually looked no different from a goat horn fossil.
This was also normal, because in myths and legends, Kirin and divine dragons were totems formed by the characteristics of different races.
Among them, it was said that the Kirin had the head of a sheep, the paws of a wolf, a body like an elk, a tail like a dragon’s tail, and some dragon scales and horns.
Of course, this was a myth and legend on Earth. On Blue Planet, Kirin was a Mythical race even more mysterious than dragons and phoenixes. The looks recorded in various wild histories were also completely different from the Kirin described in Earth’s myths. Shi Yu gave up on imagining it.
As for why this Kirin fossil was collected in the Dragon God Mystic Realm, no one knew.
“She’s so beautiful. She must have been a girl when she was alive,” Shi Yu judged.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (1)
“Wu…” Buggy was silent. It was also very beautiful, but it was still a boy.
The leader was also very cute and a boy.
As for Baby Ginseng, Buggy had been puzzled. Was there really a gender difference in the ginseng race?
“Stop being narcissistic,” Shi Yu said.
Buggy: ???
Bah, this Beast Tamer…
“Hurry up and do business,” Shi Yu said.
As soon as he finished speaking, Shi Yu entered a meditative state. As for Buggy, it maintained a mental connection with Shi Yu and activated its Imagination Domain, trying to steal the Dream Kirin Horn fossil!
One second… two seconds… three seconds…
Ten minutes passed, but nothing happened.
“Heh heh.” Shi Yu opened his eyes and sighed.
“Wu wu.” Buggy also opened its eyes and sighed.
Why was this fossil still in seclusion?
“We can still continue trying.” Shi Yu didn’t give up. “Have a bite of the Time Fruit.”
“Wu—?”
Buggy was stunned and looked at Shi Yu with tears in its eyes.
It didn’t have many Time Fruits left… Even Baby Ginseng wasn’t willing to make more for them.
“It’s alright, it’s alright. I’ll get Baby Ginseng to reimburse you later. This is all business,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!!” Buggy was immediately relieved when it heard this. It took out a Time Fruit from its spatial pocket.
“Wuu.” Then, its huge body swallowed it in one bite.
Crack!
After biting the fruit and swallowing it, Buggy’s aura began to climb steadily. It temporarily stepped into the overlord domain and seized the opportunity to enter the dream stealing state with Shi Yu again!
It used the full-strength dream stealing skill!
In the darkness, Shi Yu locked onto the Kirin Horn fossil through meditation. His forehead was covered in sweat. He didn’t know if he could succeed this time…
“Wu—(Buggy for the win! Time Fruit for the win!)” But at this moment, he heard Buggy’s praise for Baby Ginseng.
With a cry, under the dark meditation state, the Kirin Horn fossil that Shi Yu had locked onto began to suffuse a white halo. The light grew larger and larger, as if it wanted to envelop Shi Yu and absorb him into another world, the fossil’s dream world.
Boom!
Shi Yu opened his eyes and appeared on the barren ground with Buggy. In the world here, the sky was covered in gray clouds. The ground was covered in dry dust, and it was a silent scene of the apocalypse.
Under such a scene, soon, a beautiful and extremely handsome creature appeared in Shi Yu and the others’ eyes.
[This is…] Seeing this creature running over on the barren ground, Shi Yu’s eyes instantly widened.
Could it be…
Success?
This was the owner of the Kirin Horn fossil, the divine beast, the Wind Kirin?
This creature had a deer-like body, but its body was lighter and thinner. On its white body, some green patterns condensed into cloud-like hair, reflecting the image of the wind. It was completely different from the pictures of the Kirin Shi Yu had seen on Earth. It was already not bad if it was 10% similar. Compared to the Kirin portraits he had seen, it was more elegant, beautiful, and handsome. Its entire body was like the embodiment of the wind, and its head was even smaller and gentler.
Every time it stepped on the ground, a light breeze lingered around it. The even more elegant green-blue silk-like hair on its head also fluttered with the wind.
It was unlike when they entered the Tyrant Dragon fossil dream previously, where they were insta-killed by the irritable Tyrant Dragon. This Wind Kirin that looked like a cub was filled with fear and uneasiness, as if it was running for its life and wanted to escape.
Although it was a dream illusion, it seemed to have also seen Shi Yu and Buggy. In its panic, it stepped on the breeze and didn’t even think. Under Shi Yu and Buggy’s confused expressions, it flipped them onto its body and continued to escape, as if it wanted to save some lives in the face of some disaster.
During this process, it was very difficult for Shi Yu and Buggy to resist. This was because this dream was very strange. They felt that their strength had been sealed, and the surrounding natural energy was almost nonexistent. Even at this moment, Shi Yu and Buggy couldn’t even speak.
It was like sleep paralysis. Although it could think, it couldn’t even break free from the dream and shake its body.
Boom!
Right on the heels of that, something unknown happened. The dream realm completely shattered. Shi Yu and Buggy seemed to have been reborn. They left the fossil dream realm with sweat all over their faces and appeared in the real world again. At this moment, due to the side effects of the Time Fruit, Buggy was already completely exhausted. It lay helplessly on the table and slept.
As for Shi Yu, apart from cold sweat and a pale face with a weak expression, his mental state was not very good. He shook his head and looked at the Kirin Horn fossil again.
“Isn’t the Kirin an auspicious beast? Why did the surroundings look like an apocalypse land?” Shi Yu panted and wiped his sweat.
In this world, auspicious beasts were also a thing.
Success, he had finally entered a dream.
After seeing the Wind Kirin’s dream illusion in the dream, Shi Yu was very happy. However, what concerned Shi Yu more was the world and era background he was in at that time.
That… Could it be the Mythical Era?
After a long time, Buggy also recovered.
It also looked weak. Compared to when it entered the Tyrant Dragon fossil phantom, the side effects weren’t this taxing.
“Can you replicate the Kirin Phantom just now?” Shi Yu asked.
“Wu…” Buggy shook its head. It couldn’t even move in the fossil dream just now. There was no way to carry out the next step of dream stealing and replicating its state.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (2)
“Rest, rest, and then come again,” Shi Yu said, unwilling to give up.
At the same time, he called Baby Ginseng over to replenish himself and Buggy.
Buggy: Σ(°△°|||)_!
Again… again.
“Of course.”
Buggy’s face was covered in tears. It felt so tired.
…
As Shi Yu and Buggy studied the Kirin Horn fossil with all their might, a day had already passed in the outside world.
