During this period, White Brook, who had been eliminated by Shi Yu, turned her grief and indignation into motivation. She continued to guide the other team members in the team battle at the last minute and give them advice.
Although she was very miserable in the individual competition, Ancient Capital University was at least first place. Not bad, the team battle next couldn’t be too bad!
Then, the National League continued, starting the next day’s team battle.
There were a total of nine schools. Because it was a points system, it required each school to take turns fighting the other eight schools.
Therefore, there were a total of 36 big matches. This team battle lasted for a long time, and it would last for several days.
During this process, the gem cat couldn’t be bothered to watch anymore and slipped back to the ancient capital. As for Senior Panda, she still stayed at the scene and constantly replaced Shi Yu to accept interviews.
As for Shi Yu himself, he told Principal Feng and Senior Panda that he had some insights and wanted to go for emergency training. After handing the interviews to them to handle, he devoted himself to researching the Kirin Horn fossil with Buggy. In the eyes of outsiders, it was as if he had disappeared from the national competition.
“Isn’t that enough?”
A few days later, Shi Yu and Buggy had already tried entering and stealing dreams countless times.
If they didn’t have any results every time, they wouldn’t be so hardworking. It was mainly because every time they entered a dream, they felt that their condition was better and they were constantly familiarizing themselves with that dream. Therefore, this was the reason why the two of them kept trying.
After a few days, Shi Yu and Buggy could already barely move in this fossil dream. Buggy could even barely steal and replicate the Wind Kirin’s dream illusion in the dream.
Unfortunately, in the recent few times, he felt that something was lacking. Every time Buggy’s replication progress reached 99%, it was suddenly interrupted and it couldn’t replicate successfully.
After Shi Yu and the others tried countless times…
With the help of Shi Yu, Buggy finally made a breakthrough in surrounding the “Kirin Horn fossil”.
With Buggy’s current temporary overlord-level strength, it couldn’t materialize the illusion in the fossil dream out of thin air. However, relying on the Kirin Horn fossil as the foundation for the illusion, placing it on the fossil and letting the fossil be the core of the illusion… This, Buggy could barely do at the moment.
No matter what, it had successfully materialized.
Buggy and Shi Yu were instantly pleasantly surprised.
At the same time, through the dream stealing, Buggy and Shi Yu instantly knew the skill mastered by this Wind Kirin through the dream connection.
However, what puzzled Shi Yu and Buggy was that they didn’t know if the Wind Kirin only knew these three skills or if the fossil had been from too long ago, causing the dream illusion to be incomplete. The illusion that Buggy tried its best to materialize only had three skill traces.
Although it was a divine beast in myths, there were no so-called divine skills.
There were only three super skills!
Of course, in Shi Yu’s opinion, these three super skills were really impressive.
< Name > Turning Misfortune into Luck
< Introduction > It’s a wind-element super skill. It can absorb skills that are dangerous to itself and double its power against the enemy.
< Name > Wind Spirit Bead
< Introduction > It’s a wind-element super skill. The Wind Spirit Bead can absorb and adapt to most attributes. It can also spread the effects of other attributes to the maximum through the power of the wind.
< Name > Wind Blessing
< Introduction > It’s a super skill of the wind, time, and space elements. It can increase luck with the help of the wind of nature.
There were no divine skills, but it was normal. It would be unscientific if Buggy could materialize a divine beast that could master divine skills.
Even without a divine skill, the three skills brought by this Wind Kirin Phantom were already very powerful.
What the hell was this Wind Blessing?
A three-element skill like the Dragon of Imagination? And a space-time dual-element skill? This was too sick.
Hu hu hu hu!!!
Hu hu hu!!!
At the same time.
As the green and white wind lingered around the Kirin Horn fossil, the remaining dream illusion inside gradually revived under the stimulation of the external power. Soon, the appearance of the Kirin phantom Shi Yu and Buggy had seen in the dream materialized.
“Wu!!”
But at this moment, Buggy was suddenly stunned, and its expression changed.
“Wu!!” It cried out nervously.
After it conjured a fossil phantom through the Kirin Horn fossil, it actually didn’t have any control over the phantom. In the past, it had absolute control over the dream phantom of other creatures, but this time, its power seemed to be just a medium for the revival of the dream phantom of the Kirin Horn fossil. The moment the phantom appeared, it broke its connection with the other party.
“What?” Shi Yu was also stunned.
At the same time, the Wind Kirin Phantom, which was not tall or even more than a meter tall, slowly opened its confused eyes. However, in the next moment, the phantom disappeared, as if the energy on its body was not enough for it to be born. In an instant, it turned into a breeze again, and its figure completely disappeared. The Kirin Horn fossil at the core of the phantom fell to the ground again.
This scene completely stunned Shi Yu and Buggy. Then, the huge consumption made Shi Yu and Buggy quickly sit on the ground and look at the Kirin Horn fossil tiredly.

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Auspicious Divine Beast Kirin (3)
“This phantom…”
“It’s still an illusion and not a life form. Then, the problem is how to transform it into a life form and keep that Wind Blessing.” Shi Yu looked at Buggy, and Buggy also looked at Shi Yu eagerly. Then, they looked at the Kirin fossil together.
A skill to increase luck?
It didn’t sound like much, but how could time and space be weak?
Shi Yu instantly felt that the past few days had not been in vain.
If he could replicate this skill and add points to the maximum level, how powerful would that be?
Would it add a wind of luck to itself? If the enemy wanted to harm him from half a planet away, a meteorite could accidentally smash it to death?
This was too fierce. In other words, if he added a wind of luck to two totem-level creatures, would it be possible for them, who were horrible at reproducing, to get the deed done instantly?
With this, he could easily get on the good side of the totems…
Also, if he was even luckier and had a 100% chance of listening to history, that would be even more perfect.
“I have to obtain this skill.” Shi Yu crawled up. Then, there was a problem. It was so difficult to modify the Tyrant Dragon Phantom into a mechanical life form. How could he modify this even more difficult-looking Kirin Phantom Revival into a mechanical life form that could inherit and release the original skill of the phantom?
“Wu!!” Buggy asked what to do next.
Shi Yu didn’t know either.
Just as he got up, he continued to lie on the sofa like a salted fish and sighed.
“Let’s do this first. The competition will end today. Let’s go get the Hundred Transformations Stone and mechanical materials first…”
“It’s still too tiring to study mechanical phantom beasts myself…”
“It’s too troublesome to find other legendary mechanical big shots to help. After all, it’s not anything important. We don’t have time to invest all our energy in this. When the time comes, it won’t be good for us to slack off when others work.”
Suddenly, Shi Yu was stunned.
Wait a minute.
Others were working, but he was lazing around?
He realized that his previous train of thought was completely wrong.
Why did he have to directly use illusions to create machinery???
Why did it have to be done in one go?
Even Gao Xuan’s Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast wasn’t an overlord race when it was created, right? It was modified and upgraded step by step.
This was originally extremely ridiculous. It was something that created a new field in mechanical research. Even those legendary Mechanics might not necessarily be able to do it with their mechanical knowledge.
Moreover, he was a mechanical noob.
Find a big boss to guide him!
Soon, Shi Yu thought of this method, but this wasn’t a big boss in the traditional sense.
Instead, he would create a big boss himself.
Mechanical lives were divided into battle-type machines, support-type machines, and research-type machines.
Most machines had the ability to learn and grow on their own. The so-called race level could also be increased through upgrading the day after tomorrow.
There was no need for him to pursue the mechanical beast from the start.
What if he contracted a research-type mechanical pet and filled its research ability, learning ability, creation ability, and mechanical knowledge through the skill index to the Dao Proficiency level? Then, he would let it study how to transform itself into a mechanical phantom beast with a divine beast template??
Why did he have to study it himself!
Wouldn’t it be easier to squeeze his pets dry?
At this moment, Shi Yu’s thoughts instantly cleared. The pressure on him was completely gone.
“I can even contract the most ordinary research-type mechanical life form. Then, by maxing out its research ability and letting it upgrade itself, I’ll just increase points and pay for the materials.”
“At that time, researching mechanical phantom beasts will be enough with mechanical pets and bugs. I can slack off.”
“As long as I nurture my pet into a research-type big boss, I, a Beast Tamer, will be equivalent to a big boss.”
At the side, Buggy’s gaze was filled with horror as it listened to Shi Yu’s muttering. Damn it, what level of capitalist are you…
—-

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery
That day, the National League ended.
In this National League, the national champion of the individual competition was taken by Shi Yu. As a result, Shi Yu’s name received widespread discussion.
And the champion of the team battle was taken by Demon Capital University.
Imperial Capital University’s second place was very miserable. Not only was it not the champion in the individual battle, but the team was also not…
Of course, in the team battle, Ancient Capital University was even worse. It was ranked seventh, which was third from the bottom.
It verified that the strong were really strong, and the weak were really weak.
However, in the National League next year, the audience had reason to believe that the overall results of Ancient Capital University would increase.
At least, the education funds of Ancient Capital University would definitely not be small next year. With money, the school could invest more resources in the students.
“The competition should be over at this time.”
Shi Yu came out of the room listlessly. At this moment, his mind was filled with mechanical pets.
He came out at the right time. Principal Feng happened to rush over from the arena. Following him was a woman in a black trench coat.
“Are you done?”
From afar, the old man asked with a smile. He had been very happy these past two days.
Although the team battle results of Ancient Capital University were as lousy as ever, their individual competition results this year were strong.
Apart from Lu Qingyi’s batch of Ancient Capital University students who were lucky enough to get second place, they had never entered the top five in the past ten years!
This time, it took off completely and directly took first place with an absolute advantage.
“I’m done,” Shi Yu replied with a smile.
“Legend Xiao.”
Then, Shi Yu greeted the lady beside Principal Feng.
This person was the judge of this competition, the legendary Mechanic Xiao Shuang of the fourth bureau.
“Yes.”
Xiao Shuang saw Shi Yu and said, “You don’t look very good. The competition has ended for so long, haven’t you rested yet?”
So, Shi Yu’s slash that shattered Gao Xuan’s mecha in the National League also had huge side effects?
Xiao Shuang was silent. Indeed, after they finished cutting, they seemed to have eaten a pile of supplements…
“Ah…”
Shi Yu shook his head. Really?
He had clearly just finished eating Baby Ginseng’s supplements. Did he look very weak??
Baby Ginseng had become weaker.
Or had he become stronger?
“Perhaps. We’ll immediately carry out other training after the competition,” Shi Yu said.
Forget it, so be it. As long as he didn’t feel anything.
The weak state of others was 1/100, while his was 100/10,000. It was different.
Legend Xiao Shuang nodded. A genius was indeed extraordinary.
“Cough.” Principal Feng didn’t sense anything unusual about Shi Yu.
The old man said, “The competition is over. Legend Xiao Shuang specially came over to distribute the prizes to you personally.”
There would be an award ceremony tonight.
However, that trophy that was only given as a symbol of honor was not worth much.
What was really valuable was still the money and physical rewards distributed by the competition authorities.
The other contestants might have to register themselves, but on Shi Yu’s side, Legend Xiao Shuang chose to personally distribute it.
Most importantly, she wanted to come into contact with Shi Yu personally.
Previously, she had only seen it in the video or from afar. She still wanted to observe this abnormal young Beast Tamer up close.
Outstanding Beast Tamers were always very attractive.
“There are a total of three prizes.”
Legend Xiao Shuang said, “Rewards card, Space Crystal, as well as the Wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone and the accompanying basic mechanical materials.”
As soon as she finished speaking, a white light flashed in front of her.
It was unknown if it was because of the ruins space or other special spatial equipment, but a large white suitcase-shaped box immediately appeared between Shi Yu and her.
On the big box was a wooden box the size of a photo frame.
Apart from that, it was a black card that appeared out of thin air in Legend Xiao Shuang’s hand.
She first handed the bonus card to Shi Yu and introduced, “The wooden box contains the Space Crystal Stone. As for the white mechanical box, it contains the Hundred Transformations Stone, high-level intelligence chip, and various basic materials for the adaptability device.”
“You can use the Space Crystal for your own cultivation. As for these mechanical materials, they’re still considered complete. With the existing materials, you can synthesize a mechanical life form of a high-level monarch race. If you have any ideas, I can help you. Of course, the Mechanical College of Ancient Capital University can also do it,” Xiao Shuang said.
Shi Yu should know these things. After all, the rewards of the National League had been introduced in sufficient detail when it was announced.
Although these were all prepared for Gao Xuan, they definitely couldn’t say it out loud when it was announced.
Therefore, what was publicized was a set of top-notch mechanical materials that could be assembled into a “high-level monarch race mechanical life form”.
They were respectively made of the Hundred Transformations Stone (Wind), high-level intelligence chip, and adaptability device.
Among them, the Wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone determined the race, attributes, and core abilities of the mechanical life form.
Under normal circumstances, mechanical lives created with the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core would have two skills.
One was high-level, while the other was super-level.
High-level skills were the “Hundred Transformations” of the Mechanic class.
It was a very rare Mechanic skill, mainly appearing on the Hundred Transformations Stone.
Hundred Transformations was also divided into two abilities: decomposition and combination.
The effect was roughly that decomposition could allow a Hundred Transformations Stone to break into countless Hundred Transformations Stones. It was similar to the elementalization of elemental creatures or a clone, but it had a physical body. Its main body directly divided, not created out of thin air.
As for combination, it was the decomposition of the body parts that could be perfectly combined again. The relationship between the two was similar to shrinking and enlarging in multiplication. The connection was very deep.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: - Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery (1)
Through the “Decomposition Combination”, the Hundred Transformations Stone could realize its Hundred Transformations ability. As long as the level of these two skills was high enough, they could transform into anything.
If a Hundred Transformations Stone in the form of a Rubik’s Cube wanted to become a triangle, it might require entry-level Hundred Transformations.
But if it wanted to go from a Rubik’s Cube to a complicated fighter plane and mecha, it might have to use skills with higher proficiency.
Moreover, just the skill level was not enough. After all, the Hundred Transformations only determined its appearance. If it wanted the accompanying ability, it still had to use the mechanical life form in the Hundred Transformations along with other mechanical equipment to complete the transformation to increase strength.
Therefore, although the Hundred Transformations Stone was a top-notch pet very suitable for newbie Mechanics, it still needed a certain level of mechanical proficiency to help the Hundred Transformations Stone create different mechanical forms.
As for super skills, they were elemental control with corresponding attributes. The Wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone was “Wind-element control”, a very adaptable wind-element skill.
Similar to “Water Elemental Control” and “Plant Control”, it was a high-level skill for a bunch of basic wind skills.
If the Hundred Transformations Stone was the body of a mechanical life form, then the smart chip was the brain of a mechanical life form.
In the beginning, mechanical lives could only be created by Beast Tamers with “Awakening Talent”.
However, with the birth of the “smart chip”, even ordinary people could rely on the smart chip to create a mechanical life form with intelligence and the ability to think for themselves.
It was the most important part of a mechanical life form, and it concerned whether a mechanical life form could be called “life”.
At the moment, the market was divided into “ordinary intelligence chip”, “high-level intelligence chip”, and “top-notch intelligence chip”.
The smart chip determined the talent of a mechanical life, which was to learn, understand, and calculate abilities.
Ordinary smart chips could give mechanical lives “basic intelligence”.
As for high-level smart chips, they could give mechanical life high-level skills “high-level intelligence”.
Of course, there were also low-level intelligent skills that could only carry out fixed procedures, but those were prepared for special machines… such as forbidden machines.
Among the rewards of this National League, the only mechanical materials accompanying the Hundred Transformations Stone were high-level smart chips.
This was very normal.
This was because top-notch intelligence chips couldn’t be directly created. They were upgraded later. Moreover, every top-notch intelligence was very difficult to replicate. It was the result of the joint efforts of a legendary Mechanic and his mechanical pet and the crystallization of intelligence. It was a super ability, and it was very rare.
As for the adaptability device, it allowed the Hundred Transformations Stone, the smart chip, and other mechanical materials to quickly adapt to the device that could be perfectly assembled.
Although there were only three types of mechanical materials, they could coincidentally be assembled into a mechanical life form, and it was a Hundred Transformations Mechanical Life form with extremely high malleability. This was the champion prize publicized in the National League. For most Beast Tamers, it still had a very fatal attraction.
Xiao Shuang looked at Shi Yu.
However, she felt that Shi Yu shouldn’t be interested.
After all, Shi Yu had five overlord species pets. Unlike other contestants, his horizons were definitely very high… Even if he contracted a new pet, there was no need to be interested in the Mechanic class with extremely high requirements for professional knowledge.
It wasn’t enough for the Beast Tamer to worry about.
Some Beast Tamers without mechanical knowledge, but with good talent potential and ambition, would definitely not choose mechanical lives… Especially complicated mechanical lives. The reason was very simple. Maintenance was too troublesome, leveling up was too troublesome, and everything was troublesome.
“Thank you.” Shi Yu nodded and said,
“I remember that Legend Xiao’s trump card is the super body created with the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core, right?” Shi Yu suddenly looked at Legend Xiao Shuang.
“Huh?”
“If nothing goes wrong, I should also create a mechanical life contract with the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core…”
“I wonder, before that… Can I take a look at your mecha?”
Xiao Shuang was stunned.
Wait, what did he just say???
He really wanted to use this Hundred Transformations Stone to create a mechanical life contract??
No kidding??
She quickly looked at Principal Feng.
It meant that Shi Yu’s previous pets, the Iron-eating Beast, the Butterfly of Imagination, the Ginseng Baby, the Sword Spirit, and the Water Slime, were all very “regular” pets. Was the sixth one suddenly contracting a mechanical life form for real??
Nurturing mechanical lives… was different from nurturing animals, plants, and elements. The professional knowledge needed was huge.
“Ah, this.” Principal Feng smiled bitterly beside him.
To be honest, he didn’t recommend it either.
There were usually two types of people who contracted mechanical lives.
1. There was really no other choice. Buying a mechanical life form with pretty good strength wasn’t for ambition. The tamer wouldn’t expect to rely on the Mechanic class to climb to the highest peak, but he just had to make a living for the time being. Upgrading and repairing depended on spending money to find a Mechanic.
2. The tamer was a Mechanic with very strong professionalism. He had the ability to modify, upgrade, assemble, and repair mechanical lives himself.
He didn’t know if Shi Yu was the former, but it definitely wasn’t the latter…
However, Shi Yu just wanted to contract it.
It wasn’t like Principal Feng didn’t know this. It wasn’t the first time he had heard Shi Yu nag about wanting to contract a handsome mechanical life form… He was also very helpless about this playful thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Hundred Transformations Stone Machinery (2)
“Can I, Legend Xiao?” Shi Yu still looked at Legend Xiao Shuang eagerly.
“Are you really planning to contract a mechanical life form??” Although Legend Xiao Shuang believed that Mechanics were the strongest, that was in the hands of Mechanics. If someone who didn’t know mechanical knowledge contracted a mechanical life form, they would definitely go astray.
Although it wasn’t too late to learn mechanical knowledge at Shi Yu’s age, if it were anyone else with a high-level monarch mechanical life form, she would be very supportive of the other party entering the mechanical domain. However, the problem was that Shi Yu, this beast, already had five overlord species pets. Why was he still thinking about a monarch species’ machinery??
Even if the Hundred Transformations Machine was extremely malleable, it wasn’t that easy to upgrade it to an overlord race… Because her pet used the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core, she knew very well.
“I haven’t made a decision yet, so I want to see your overlord body, Demon God Black Wing…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Legend Xiao Shuang fell silent.
After a long silence, she said, “Alright.”
She didn’t care anymore. In any case, she wasn’t familiar with Shi Yu. She would leave this to Principal Feng to persuade.
Legend Xiao Shuang sighed and stretched out her hand. A cube prop that looked like a “black Rubik’s Cube” immediately appeared in her hand. Then, the black Rubik’s Cube flew away on its own, splitting into even smaller black cubes that filled the sky and assembling itself in the sky.
In the blink of an eye, countless black Rubik’s Cube formed a super humanoid body more than ten meters tall. It was filled with a black rock texture and had huge rock wings.
“This is the Black Wing Demon God. What do you want to see?” After Xiao Shuang summoned the mecha, she asked Shi Yu.
This super mecha that had mastered dark, Mechanic, and spatial powerful attributes was her proudest creation!
“Can I touch it…” Shi Yu looked at the Black Wing Demon God, who was a hundred times more handsome than Dean Hao’s Purple Electric Mecha, and said with stars in his eyes.
Black Wing Demon God : “…”
Xiao Shuang nodded and said, “Touch it…”
She could tell that Shi Yu was the same as the mechanical men in Star Capital University. He couldn’t move when he saw mechas even more so than when he saw beauties. Such a guy should be sent to Star Capital University. It was a pity to go to Ancient Capital University.
Shi Yu quickly arrived beside the Black Wing Demon God mecha and asked, “Sister Xiao Shuang, is Senior Black Wing Demon God a high-level intelligence or a top-notch intelligence?”
Legend Xiao Shuang said indifferently, “Top-notch intelligence. Although the Hundred Transformations Stone is known as the easiest mechanical material to control, in fact, the complicated Hundred Transformations Stone requires extremely professional mechanical knowledge and extremely high computational ability of the mechanical life form to perfectly display racial abilities. If you really treat the Hundred Transformations Stone as a newbie mechanical material, you’re wrong.”
The Black Wing Demon God nodded proudly. To be able to instantly assemble a huge mecha with the various mechanical equipment in its body through countless fragments, its computing power was not to be underestimated!
Shi Yu was surprised and asked, “How many variations are there after the combination?”
Black Wing Demon God: “?”
Xiao Shuang and Principal Feng: “?”
[Replication successful]
< Name > Divine Net
[Attributes]: Mechanic, Spirit
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It can split multiple intelligent brains to form a complicated neural network system to have computing, analysis, and learning abilities that exceed supercomputers.
Shi Yu’s heart stopped.
Skill index, forever amazing.
However, super skills, damn it, could a newbie machine learn these?!

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - Returning to the Ancient Capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Returning to the Ancient Capital
After Shi Yu successfully replicated the “Divine Net” skill, he glanced at the Black Wing Demon God Mecha.
This Divine Network was undoubtedly a top-notch intelligence system.
It should be an exclusive skill researched by Legend Xiao Shuang that combined the racial characteristics of the Hundred Transformations Stone Body.
With the skill, Shi Yu glanced at the mecha.
[Teaching success rate]: High
“Eh?”
Shi Yu was stunned.
It actually had the will of an overlord?
Impressive.
But then again, how should the will of mechanical life be judged?
He had really never paid attention to the level of the mechanical life form’s will before.
Should he start from the lowest, or would the level of willpower be different according to the level of the smart chip and the initial setting?
Unlike other lives that were born “blank”…
Some mechanical lives were not actually blank when they were born.
Most mechanical lives would have some settings added before they were created.
For example, there were battle and protective machines set as “Protect Master”.
For example, a mechanical maid with the setting of “Only Love Master”.
There was also the research-type machine with the setting “study constantly”.
These settings were equivalent to the dreams of mechanical lives. They were written by the creator.
Shi Yu felt that although the level of the will of this mechanical life form that could be written down in the initial settings wouldn’t be very high, it probably couldn’t be low either.
After all, a human could casually change his dream. If he was lazy, he could choose to do nothing.
However, with a fixed mechanical life form, its execution in this aspect shouldn’t be weak. This meant that its willpower shouldn’t be bad.
Although it was unrealistic to expect a cleaner robot to explode in power, as long as it still had energy and wasn’t damaged, it wouldn’t go on strike for no reason. In some positions, it was too common to see a mechanical life that held their post for decades.
“Although it’s a battle-type machine, it’s still a top-notch intelligence. Your question is too simple,” Legend Xiao Shuang said calmly.
Her words interrupted Shi Yu, who was in deep thought.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He smiled and said, “I was just asking, just asking…”
“Ask something useful,” Principal Feng said.
“Legend Xiao Shuang is the new generation Mechanic with the greatest potential in the mechanical field.”
“Generally speaking, top-notch intelligence only appears on research-type machines, but Legend Xiao Shuang managed to successfully upgrade battle-type machines to top-notch intelligence. This is unique.”
Principal Feng sighed. “If you have any questions, quickly ask Legend Xiao.”
Principal Feng didn’t think that he could persuade Shi Yu not to contract a mechanical pet. Since he couldn’t persuade him, he would try to let Shi Yu take fewer detours.
“Is it very difficult for battle-type machines to have top-notch intelligence?” Shi Yu asked.
Legend Xiao Shuang said, “It’s very difficult, but it’s not impossible. You can treat top-notch intelligence as a super skill.”
“Mechanical lives are actually the same as other pets. The principle of them being unrefined is also applicable to them.”
“After all, the capacity of the body is limited. If it mainly develops battle abilities, it will cause other restrictions, and vice versa.”
“Then your Black Wing Demon God…” Shi Yu asked.
“Its top-notch intelligence is only used to assist in battle.”
“Although my Black Wing Demon God has top-notch intelligence, if it’s converted to the proficiency of super skills, it’s only about the proficient level. It hasn’t even reached the expert level. Its main leveling path is still the battle direction, so its battle-type super skills are upgraded relatively smoothly. They have all reached perfect proficiency.”
“So if you really want to contract a mechanical life form, my suggestion is also to specialize in one direction to level up, be it battle, support, or research type.”
“It’s like a fighter jet. Its own function should be to gallop in the sky and constantly strengthen its flying and battle ability. A research-type index should mainly develop intelligence, not be relied on to fight.”
“Although the mechanical lives of us legendary Beast Tamers are involved in various aspects of life, they’re not completely proficient. It’s just to support our main abilities. After all, the decomposition combination of the Hundred Transformations Stone indeed requires a huge amount of computational power.”
Shi Yu nodded.
In the end, the energy of mechanical lives was limited. They couldn’t take care of all their abilities.
Just like Zhong Xuan’s suggestion back then, just specialize in one super skill. Don’t invest too much energy in the other skills. It was the same principle.
Shi Yu understood.
Index, increase points!
Combat skills and intelligence skills were all maxed out.
“If we use the Hundred Transformations Stone as the core to create mechanical lives, we can actually choose battle-type machines and research-type machines.”
“The special decomposition and combination structure allows them to be qualified for many missions. As for which one you major in in the future, that’s up to you.”
Legend Xiao Shuang finished.
As Shi Yu also had achievements in feeding and archeology, it wasn’t impossible for him to contract a research-type machine as a support.
“Alright, is there anything else you want to ask?”
“Yes, yes, yes…”
…
A day later.
Ancient Capital.
After the National League completely ended, the main group of Ancient Capital University returned to Ancient Capital.
The award ceremony was nothing new. Although Shi Yu was the champion, he had slipped past pretty much the whole situation the whole time and his mind was on his mechanical pet.
However, from Legend Xiao Shuang, he replicated three useful skills.
The first was the top-notch intelligent system skill “Divine Net”. This was a super skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - Returning to the Ancient Capital (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Returning to the Ancient Capital (1)
There was also the high-level mechanical fusion skill “Load”. This skill was similar to “Possession” and “Fusion Talent”. It was a move that allowed machinery and Beast Tamers to become one.
As well as the high-level skill of both mechanical and spatial elements, “Machinery Space”.
The mechanical space was a skill similar to Buggy’s “spatial pocket”. It could also open an independent space in the body.
The reason why Legend Xiao Shuang’s Hundred Transformations Stone could transform so smoothly and directly change from a Rubik’s Cube to a mecha was because its other mechanical equipment were all stored in the mechanical space.
“Damn it.”
“Can’t Senior “Maiden” give more effort when creating equipment?”
After returning to Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu sighed.
Last night, he tried to awaken the high-level intelligence chip into a transcendent life form.
In the end, it failed.
After careful investigation, Shi Yu realized that even if it didn’t involve other mechanical materials, the high-level intelligence chip had simply awakened into a mechanical life chip. Its race level was also a commander race, a top-notch research-type mechanical core.
This was very annoying…
The Awakening Mirror couldn’t be used again.
After all, this thing could only awaken the most basic transcendent race.
In other words, even though he had obtained a high-level smart chip, he still couldn’t directly awaken with the Awakening Mirror.
Of course, if he went to the Ancient Capital Mechanical College to find other Mechanics to help, he could still awaken it.
The so-called high-level smart chip was actually… a transparent glass the size of a cell phone screen.
It was not ordinary glass, but a special substance.
Mechanics also accidentally discovered this substance in nature. It had been specially modified. After being shone on by special rays, it could give birth to intelligence and could perfectly match most mechanical materials. It was the core of mainstream mechanical life today.
Special rays that awakened smart chips could be found in the Mechanical College of Ancient Capital University.
Therefore, Legend Xiao Shuang said that the Mechanical College of Ancient Capital University had the ability to help Shi Yu use these materials to create a “high-level monarch race” mechanical life.
“Why are you frowning? There’s a huge harvest this time.”
After getting off the plane, White Brook patted Shi Yu’s shoulder.
At the side, Lin Xiuzhu smiled and said, “Resources are probably never enough. The more money there is, the more high-end the things you want… The less money you’ll feel is enough.”
Lin Xiuzhu, who had accumulated the evolution materials of the Iron-eating Beast for so long, felt it was very relatable.
Principal Feng said, “I reckon he’s worried about how to use the Hundred Transformations Stone…”
Shi Yu looked up. “Principal Feng and Senior Lin understand me better. Senior Bai can’t…”
White Brook:???
What the hell!
Right on the heels of that, the other teachers and students also came down. Shi Yu waved at Principal Feng and the others and said, “I won’t be going to the celebration banquet tonight. There are some other things.”
“Eh…”
Just as he arrived at the ancient capital, Shi Yu slipped away.
He planned to go to the Mechanical College and use the Mechanical Research Institute there to undergo the initial awakening of mechanical lives.
The restrictions of the Awakening Mirror were still too great, and its ability was still too weak. As a mechanical noob, he didn’t feel good using it at all.
Shi Yu didn’t mind if it absorbed more stamina, but it was too much to restrict its awakening level.
In the initial stage, it was better to use the modern method to awaken. After he cultivated his mechanical pet into a mechanical big boss, he could let it use the Awakening Mirror to upgrade itself.
“Wu…”
After Shi Yu left, he directly summoned Buggy and planned to let it bring him to the Mechanical College.
However, Shi Yu suddenly thought of something and frowned.
“Wait, let’s go to the resource bank first…”
Shi Yu heard that the gem cat had also gone to the National League.
However, he didn’t even see it.
Shi Yu had reason to suspect that the gem cat was hiding from him and didn’t want to give him resources!
Let’s settle this first!
Buggy was stunned and expressed its understanding.
Soon…
In the resource area, Shi Yu’s figure appeared.
At the same time, in Ancient Capital University, the sleeping gem cat shuddered and woke up from its nightmare. It immediately searched for the source.
In the next moment, it teleported in front of Shi Yu and the others who had returned to Ancient Capital University. It bared its fangs and brandished its claws, afraid that this guy would directly empty the resource bank.
“Wait, wait, wait, don’t move.”
The gem cat appeared and waved its claws.
“Eh, are you a clone or your main body today?” Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
“Main body.” The cat’s expression darkened.
“Teacher Ying, when are you going to give me the resources you promised previously…” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat looked conflicted.
It had just broken through and was in the midst of joy, so it casually agreed.
But later on, it felt a little reluctant.
These days… it had been thinking of ways to remedy it.
“How about we change our train of thought?” The gem cat looked up and grinned.
Unfortunately, it really found one.
“Huh??”
“The collector value of my lousy gems is greater than their practical value. It’s useless even if I give them to you. It’s also very troublesome to sell them, right?”
“One legendary resource!”
“I’ll keep my collection, but I’ll get you a legendary resource. How about that!” the gem cat said fiercely.
Shi Yu was stunned. “???”
Buggy was also shocked.
“Are you serious?”
The collections of the gem cat were worth less than legendary resources, right?
The lowest value of legendary resources was also ten billion.
“Isn’t this because I have feelings for these gems?” the gem cat said with tears in its eyes.
“Among them, there’s also a birthday gift from the late Electric Rat and other friends… Wu wu wu wu wu…”
Shi Yu: “…Stop, stop, stop.”
“Legendary-level resource, what’s going on?”
“Think about it.” The gem cat analyzed for Shi Yu.
“You helped Ancient Capital University get first place in the competition. Ancient Capital University will definitely give you a reward, right?”
Shi Yu nodded.
“Apart from that, you’ve made indelible contributions in archeology, feeding, and helping me break through, right?”
Shi Yu nodded again.
“You don’t have a use for anything else either.”
“Then, it’s not too much for the school to reward you with a legendary resource, right?” the gem cat said.
Shi Yu was stunned.
Buggy was also stunned. Disaster was approaching…
At this moment, Shi Yu naturally felt that it wasn’t too much. It was even better if there were two.
However, it was already stingy and slow to apply for legendary-level resources from the association. It had yet to be approved, and the size of Ancient Capital University was even poorer than the Beast Tamer Association. Could a legendary item even be taken out??
“Although Ancient Capital University is poor, it still has one or two legendary resources. It’s the school’s trump card!”
“The legendary resource I used to break through back then was bought from Ancient Capital University. Although the breakthrough failed, it’s still a genuine legendary resource.”
“It’s definitely a little difficult for you to apply alone. Even if Principal Feng agrees, he can’t make the decision alone. However, don’t you have me? I’ve broken through to the totem level now. At that time, when the approval comes, I’ll also support you. I guarantee that it’s another legendary resource!”
“When I was in Demon Capital, I’ve already made an application to Principal Feng.”
“How is it!” the gem cat said. “I guarantee that you can obtain a legendary-level resource. Then, my gems can be left alone… sob…”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
It wasn’t a loss.
In the future, there would be plenty of places to squeeze the cat dry. It was better not to push it too hard.
“Deal!”
The gem cat heaved a sigh of relief. Next, it would use the status as a new totem to help Shi Yu snatch the legendary resource. In short, it was good that the gems could be kept.
“This way… there are two…” At the same time, Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
There were a total of two legendary resources from the Dong Huang Association and Ancient Capital University!
“Then it’s decided happily. Is there anything else?” The gem cat felt pretty good again.
“Well, I’ve already promised you this kind of thing. Then, it’s not too much to help me, right?”
The gem cat: ???
It suddenly had a bad feeling.
“Wh-what is it?”
“It’s nothing. I’ll just bring Chi Tong and Susu to the Undead Battlefield to train sometime in the future…”
The cat immediately had a heart attack. Damn, that kind of dangerous place… Oh, it was a totem now, right? Then it was fine.
“Sure.” The gem cat heaved a sigh of relief again. It thought it was something difficult.
“What about other things?”
“Not for the time being. We’ll talk about it in the future.”
The gem cat: ???
“Oh, send me to Dean Hao of the Mechanical College. Buggy doesn’t know the map over there.”
The gem cat:…
“Alright… Wait, what are you doing over there?” the gem cat asked.
“Awaken the reward item of the national champion into a mechanical life form and use the beam of the Mechanical Research Institute to illuminate the high-level smart chip.”
“Eh, I thought you hadn’t reached level six…”
“I’ll awaken first. It’s not too late to contract it when I do level up.”
“…” Playboy behavior.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - Birth of a Mechanical Pet
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Birth of a Mechanical Pet
Ancient Capital University, Mechanical College.
The archeology specialization of Ancient Capital University was top-notch, but the level of the Mechanic class was not much. It was even inferior to its Feeding Department…
However, that was in the past!
“Shi Yu…”
“You really plan to let me help you awaken your machinery?”
“He really plans to contract a mechanical life form.”
In the Mechanical College, Dean Hao rubbed his hands with an excited expression.
“I have a premonition that you will be the pride of the Mechanic class in Ancient Capital University in the future!”
It was also very reasonable for a student to be the common pride of the archeology Department, Battle Department, Feeding Department, and Mechanic Department… Wasn’t it?
“No, no…”
“I’m a mechanical noob, a pure newbie…”
Beside him, Shi Yu said humbly.
Behind them was a sighing cat.
The gem cat was already thinking about how this mechanical pet would be cultivated by Shi Yu in the future.
He had to think in an unscientific direction…
It looked at the sky. Would it become a cosmic battleship? At that time, could a star-destroying cannon in space destroy a totem country below?
Or would it become a time machine that traversed time and space?
“Haha, in that case.”
“Leave it to me. I guarantee you’ll be satisfied,” Dean Hao patted his chest and said.
The most correct thing he had done in his life was to participate in the evolution research of the iron-eating beast and help Eleven build evolution armor.
Now, he was helping Shi Yu undergo the initial awakening of a mechanical pet. What did this entail? In the future, when Shi Yu soared into the sky, his name would definitely be heavily colored.
As for whether Shi Yu could achieve meteoric success, it was needless to say. Dean Hao had never seen such a monstrous Beast Tamer like Shi Yu!
Although he didn’t attend the National League, it didn’t stop him from twitching in front of the television.
At the thought of the soul of his ten-year-old granddaughter questioning, “Grandpa, is this the person you wanted me to learn from, Big Brother Gao Xuan?”
“He’s so miserable… I don’t want to be a Mechanic anymore. I want to be an archeologist!”
Dean Hao was speechless.
Shi Yu was very good. He successfully made the granddaughter of a Mechanic lose her dream of being a Mechanic and instead aim to become an archeologist.
…
Dean Hao brought Shi Yu and the others to his research institute.
Shi Yu couldn’t understand the messy mechanical equipment in the research institute anyway.
Beside him, the gem cat was in a normal state.
Back then, it had tried to transform its clone into a mechanical cat!
Although it failed and caused its clone to be blown up, with its rich experience in mechanical modification, it was not something a rookie like Shi Yu could compare to.
As for why it had yet to leave after sending Shi Yu over, it mainly wanted to see what initial instructions Shi Yu would set for the mechanical pet.
This concerned the personality and behavior of the mechanical pet in the future. It was very curious.
“This is the place.”
Shi Yu and the others arrived at an independent room. In this room, there was a huge experimental table with three big lights on it.
It didn’t feel like a laboratory to Shi Yu, but like an operating theater…
“What should we do next…” Shi Yu asked.
“Put the smart chip on the table and shine it through the Awakening Ray for a period of time.”
“Uh, it’s indeed as simple as the information,” Shi Yu said.
It felt no different from the Awakening Mirror.
“Haha.” Dean Hao smiled and said, “This isn’t simple.”
“You think it’s simple because the awakening device has been built already.”
“If I build an awakening device of this level from scratch, I’ll have to invest hundreds of millions.”
“In addition, the release of the Awakening Ray will also consume a large amount of rare energy.”
“The consumption of awakening a high-level intelligence chip can paralyze a town.”
“Well, don’t we need to assemble the Hundred Transformations Stone and that adaptability device in advance?”
“No need. To be precise, we can’t.”
“If there are Beast Tamers with awakened talent, they can directly assemble the three together… Then, they can just use their awakened talent on it. At that time, the mechanical life of the monarch race can be directly born.”
“But the Awakening Ray of the Awakening Device can only awaken intelligent chips. If you assemble them together and use the Awakening Ray, the outcome can only be failure.”
“Usually, the process is to awaken the smart chip first. Then, through the adaptive device, you connect to other mechanical materials. Finally, you activate the smart chip and complete the fusion evolution. If it succeeds, that means that the creation is successful.”
“This process is relatively complicated, troublesome, and the failure rate is extremely high. Once you fail, there’s a chance that the mechanical materials will be scrapped. It’s not as safe and convenient without the awakening talent, but you don’t have to worry. The reward you obtained from the National League is a set of top-notch mechanical materials with perfect compatibility, so there’s no risk of the awakening failing.”
Shi Yu nodded.
Awakening talent was equivalent to “evolution talent” in the mechanical system.
It could increase the success rate of the mechanical life’s fusion evolution and reduce the risk of failure.
With the Awakening Talent, Mechanics could upgrade their mechanical lives with twice the results at half the effort.
“Of course, there’s also a mechanical system with the highest risk of failure,” Dean Hao said with a chuckle.
“Biological modification,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, this kind of mechanical system is even more dangerous than the mechanical system that purely uses intelligent chips. Therefore, apart from Star Capital University, no other universities have mechanical subjects for biological modification.”
Biological modification was very dangerous. As for why it wasn’t forbidden…
The reason was also very simple.
Because the upper limit of biological mechanical modification was also extremely strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - Birth of a Mechanical Pet (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Birth of a Mechanical Pet (1)
The Divine Wind Nation, also known as the Divine Eagle Nation, was also famous because they had successfully modified the local totem, the Wind God Eagle, into a half-god level mechanical divine eagle back then.
Apart from that, there were also rumors that the current legendary Beast Tamer of the seven islands was a “man-made person” involved in biological mechanical modification. Therefore, even without the power of a pet, her own battle power gave her the right to be called a Valkyrie.
After Dragon Palace City was invaded by the Poison Dragon Totem, without concrete evidence, the reason why they didn’t dare to make a confrontation directly and chose to investigate the evidence instead was simple. It was because the other party had the valkyrie presiding over them.
“Like the cyborgs in Dragon Ball?” Shi Yu muttered in his heart. This was all gossip from the Sea Dragon King of Dragon Palace City. There were no records of this in Dong Huang.
Or rather, it was not good to let ordinary Beast Tamers know.
“Alright, let’s do this.”
As Shi Yu took out a high-level smart chip from the ruins space and placed it in the groove of the experiment table, Dean Hao said.
Soon.
Under Dean Hao’s operation, three lights lit up and emitted red, white, and blue beams.
The three-body beam focused and covered the entire high-level smart chip.
Soon, the transparent glass-like smart chip was dyed in three colors. The three colors were like liquid as they began to flow and fuse in the mirror.
About a minute later, the color on the high-level smart chip began to fade, returning to the appearance of a transparent lens.
At the same time, the light from the three lamps slowly disappeared.
The gem cat watched eagerly.
“Alright!” Dean Hao chuckled and said, “Next, it’s time to assemble it and the Hundred Transformations Stone with an adaptability device.”
When Shi Yu heard that, he nodded and took out the Cube-like Hundred Transformations Stone.
The Hundred Transformations Stone wasn’t big, but it was made of 27 small cubes. It was like a Rubik’s Cube, and the middle could be turned like the Rubik’s Cube.
Depending on the attributes, its color was also different. For example, the wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone was white with a weak green halo.
As for the adaptability device, it was very similar to a high-level smart chip. If the high-level smart chip was like a hard transparent lens, then the adaptability device was a pile of transparent stickers.
Although it looked simple, Shi Yu and the others had used their super vision to carefully observe these mechanical materials. They realized that be it the smart chip or the adaptability device, there were countless dense codes on them. They were very complicated.
“The Hundred Transformations Stone is easy to awaken, easy to assemble, and easy to modify. You only need to paste the adaptive device on both sides of the smart chip, insert it into the Hundred Transformations Stone, and paste the adaptive device on the 54 small faces on the six sides of the Hundred Transformations Stone. Then, you can complete the assembly.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu immediately followed Dean Hao’s instructions. It was indeed simpler than he imagined. As expected of the most user-friendly mechanical material to newbie Mechanics.
Soon, Shi Yu completed the operation.
At the same time.
It was unknown if it was the Hundred Transformations Stone shining, the adaptive device shining, or the three reacting.
A green light instantly enveloped the entire Hundred Transformations Stone. It was very dazzling.
Seeing this, Dean Hao touched his beard and said, “This way, it’s completed.”
“Next, as long as you make physical contact with it and enter a meditative state for more than a minute, you can establish a mental connection with it and set the initial command.”
“After this is completed, it will be completely activated. It will complete the final evolution and become a real life form.”
“In addition, because it’s a high-level intelligent chip, it can have a certain understanding of the world when it just woke up. It has a certain amount of basic knowledge stored inside, like a professional encyclopedia. It can be seen as a super genius with a very good foundation. After that, no matter what you want to teach it, its acceptance can be very fast.”
“Among them, there’s also some basic mechanical knowledge. Even if you know nothing about the mechanical field, it can take better care of itself in the beginning. You don’t have to worry about it getting sick.”
“Of course, it knows a little about everything, but at the moment, it only knows a little about everything. For example, the knowledge in the archeological and Feeding directions is definitely not as rich as the knowledge recorded in your archeological index and Feeding index. Therefore, if you want to carry out subsequent upgrades to its data chip, you can also come to me. This will be faster than learning manually.”
“However, although it has a certain understanding of the world, in essence, it’s still a newborn. Its personality after birth is related to the initial command you designed. This process is also considered ‘early education guidance’.”
Dean Hao explained in detail to Shi Yu.
A moment later, Dean Hao finished speaking.
Shi Yu picked up the Hundred Transformations Stone and thanked him. “Thank you, Dean Hao. I’ll go back and do the final awakening now.”
“Huh?” Dean Hao was stunned and nodded.
“Meow?”
The gem cat was also stunned. It looked at Shi Yu and widened its eyes. “What initial command are you planning to set?”
“Let it wake up before going back.”
Shi Yu refused. How could he let a cat know about such a private matter?
The gem cat was furious. It was certain that Shi Yu was definitely up to no good.
…
After returning to the dormitory of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu immediately entered the mechanical research institute in the ruins space and shook off the curious gem cat.
In his research institute, Shi Yu sat on a stool and took out the Hundred Transformations Stone.
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!”

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - Birth of a Mechanical Pet (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Birth of a Mechanical Pet (2)
After Shi Yu returned, Eleven and the others surrounded the room and muttered and discussed.
They all knew that Shi Yu was creating a child inside.
“What do you think?”
After sitting and thinking for a while, Shi Yu opened the door and looked at the pets.
The reason why he returned was also to hear every pet’s opinion.
Shi Yu’s positioning of the sixth pet was an all-round machine.
It could study and was proficient in battle.
It would be best if it could study itself into a battle-type mecha that could accommodate multiple pets.
At that time, he would sit in the driver’s seat, Chi Tong would be a weapon, and it would evolve into a Blue Sea Sprite. He could connect to the sea and the Susu with infinite energy points as energy. Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng would each do their own jobs. Wasn’t this invincible?
Therefore, when setting the initial command, if he could integrate some of Eleven and the others’ ideas… Perhaps everyone could cooperate better in the future.
Apart from that, in terms of daily life, Shi Yu also felt that he lacked a butler and assistant-type pet. He could squeeze in this aspect.
Now… it was equivalent to customization in games.
However, in games, it was about appearance. This was about personality, behavior, and dreams.
“Wuu—”
Outside the door, Eleven was the first to give a suggestion when it saw Shi Yu suddenly poke his head out.
It hoped that the little machine’s personality had elements such as hard work, self-discipline, and diligence.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. Of course, that was not a problem.
Mechanics… As long as they didn’t die, they just had to fight to the death.
“Wu!! (Not afraid to work!!)”
Buggy also gave a suggestion that was similar to Eleven’s.
However, the corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He kept feeling that something was wrong.
Was it afraid that when it studied mechanical beasts with the little machine, the other party would squeeze him dry by lazing around?
“Yi!! (Knowledge changes fate!)” Baby Ginseng pushed its glasses.
It heard that the new little machine was a genius?
Heh, it looked like it had another assistant.
The genius ginseng looked up at the starry sky.
It had already imagined himself wearing fighter armor and destroying a Bean Bear with each shot.
Shi Yu nodded. Of course.
Machines that couldn’t learn and research themselves weren’t good machines.
“Mi!! (Girl!)” Chi Tong strongly suggested.
“Oh…?” Shi Yu raised his eyebrows. Could this be set?
It seemed like it could?
But why did it have to be a girl!
Was it trying to adjust the level of Yin and Yang in the team?
Of course, this was even less of a problem. Even if Chi Tong didn’t say it, he still planned to do it.
The female voice definitely sounded better than the male voice.
“Ning.” Susu’s thoughts were the simplest.
It hoped that the little machine liked pollution-free energy.
After all, its hometown, the Rainbow Islands, was polluted by the power of the forbidden machinery of the seven islands.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
The Hundred Transformations Stone (Wind) used wind as the main energy source. In the future, when it fused with Susu, it could also use the energy of the sea as a power source with the “Blue Sea Contract” of the Blue Sea Sprite. Wind power and water power were both pollution-free energy sources.
Shi Yu would naturally consider this. Otherwise, it would be bad if Susu and the little machine fought in the team.
“Alright, alright, you guys go train.”
After hearing the pets’ thoughts, Shi Yu chased them away and returned to the research institute.
It began to build a mental connection with the mechanical pet and set up the initial command.
In the bright room, Shi Yu sat in anticipation. He played with the Cube in his hand and closed his eyes to enter a meditative state.
A minute later…
Shi Yu seemed to have entered the virtual online game space of a VR game. His mind was connected to the Hundred Transformations Stone’s machinery, and his surroundings were like a cosmic tunnel. The mechanical Rubik’s Cube filled the sky as it circled around him.
[Firstly… gender, female.]
[Setting: Butler, Assistant, Secretary.]
[As for personality, it’s hardworking, diligent, not afraid to work, likes to study, and has rock-like willpower. It has a very strong sense of responsibility for work and missions…] Shi Yu set it for a few minutes.
[Treat Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu as companions… Admire and worship the most handsome and outstanding ‘Creator Shi Yu’ in the world as an idol…]
Shi Yu coughed dryly.
[The dream is, or rather, the main storyline is to become the most powerful all-purpose machine and assist Beast Tamer Shi Yu and his companions in becoming stronger.]
Shi Yu kept customizing the machinery in the spiritual space. The initial setting of the little machinery was being perfected bit by bit.
In the room, Shi Yu held the Hundred Transformations Stone and muttered.
Outside the house, Eleven and the others looked at each other. Why didn’t they come out yet?
Obviously, none of them went to train. They were all waiting for the results.
After a long time…
[Completed!]
After customizing for a long time, Shi Yu finally exited the mental connection state.
At this moment, the high-level smart chip was completely activated.
The nine squares on one of the six sides of the Hundred Transformations Stone directly transformed into a smooth mirror, just like a cell phone screen!
At the same time, because it was a high-level smart chip with a human language, the Hundred Transformations Stone directly said its first words in a human voice.
At this moment, the Hundred Transformations Stone Machine was like a smartphone. One side of the screen lit up, and a virtual profile picture that was automatically synthesized according to the existing information and Shi Yu’s settings appeared on the cube’s screen.
It was a girl about ten years old with long white hair, a chibi type. Her long hair was tied into a ponytail at the back of her head and naturally hung down. There was a stray bouncy strand of hair at the top of its head. It slowly opened its eyes and let out a clear, experienced, and pleasant female voice. “Are you… my master?”

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - Birth of a Mechanical Pet (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Birth of a Mechanical Pet (3)
“Huh?” Shi Yu frowned and looked at the chibi on the screen..
“Why is it a chibi…”
“You… are my master?”
“So be it if it’s a chibi, but… why is it still a pixelated version?” Shi Yu looked at the blurry profile picture on the screen that looked like countless small boxes and was speechless. Which era’s high-level intelligence chip was this?
“You… are my master?”
[Teaching success rate]: Medium
However, what delighted Shi Yu the most was that the success rate of super skills taught to high-level intelligent life forms was actually medium??
It was medium at the start. Was it that good?
“You… are my master?!”
“That’s right, I’m your Beast Tamer.” Shi Yu revealed a thick smile.
“My master is the most handsome and outstanding Beast Tamer in the world. You…” The new little machine let out a puzzled voice, making Shi Yu’s heart skip a beat. Was there a bug?
Was he not handsome? Was he not outstanding? Even if he wasn’t, it had to think so!
Wait, or did it mean that even if the initial command was set, it had to be guided slowly?
Dean Hao seemed to have said that high-level mechanical lives were different from ordinary machines. They weren’t low-level machines that rigidly carried out procedures. They also had a certain level of self-thinking ability. The initial command only had a certain impact. If he wanted the mechanical life to believe it, he still had to have a long-lasting strengthening setting…
“It’s me,” Shi Yu said firmly. “I’m the most handsome and outstanding Beast Tamer in the world, Shi Yu.”
The profile picture on the Cube screen hesitated for a moment before nodding and choosing to believe it for the time being.
High-level mechanical lives were actually similar to heroic spirit soul seeds. They would have a certain mental connection to the person who set up the initial command.
Therefore, even if there was no contract for the time being, it would still treat Shi Yu as its master.
Of course, he still couldn’t enjoy the various benefits of the contract for now.
“I’ll give you a name next.” Shi Yu looked at the shining Rubik’s Cube and said, “Well… Let me think. In the future, you have to complete a research mission. Use a dream illusion of a Kirin fossil to transform yourself into a mechanical Illusion God. This is also the evolution direction in the future. Then, let’s find a name from this direction.”
“Why don’t I call you Rubik’s Cube?”
“?” The little machine’s profile picture disappeared and turned into a pixel question mark.
It could understand the meaning of the name, the meaning of the mission, and the meaning of evolution. Even for a divine beast like the Kirin, its basic information had simple records. It knew that this was an auspicious divine beast from the Mythical Era.
In short, it could understand every word Shi Yu said, but after connecting them, it didn’t understand why its name had become “Rubik’s Cube”.
“Well… It does seem to be alright. It’s so difficult.”
“Maybe I can call you Lin directly?”
In the myths on Earth, the male Kirin, “Qilin”, was known as Qi, and the female Qilin was known as the Lin. It was similar to the male Phoenix and the female Phoenix being called “Feng” and “Huang” respectively. Although there was no such thing in the Phoenix Race in the Mythical System of Planet Blue, Shi Yu still followed this saying and studied names for the virtual assistant.
“Not good… The name doesn’t sound like a girl’s.”
The little machine: “…”
Wait, why not, Yaoguang?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. The light of the Big Dipper represented auspiciousness, and the Kirin was also an auspicious beast. Moreover, this name felt pretty compatible with a mechanical life form…
Wait, after pronouncing it carefully, Shi Yu felt that this name was a little like a villain. It was not intimate.
It gave people the feeling that it would kill its master and destroy the planet.
It was not auspicious at all.
The profile picture in the Cube said seriously, “Master, please think carefully…”
“Forget it, then let’s call you ‘Ling’, changing the word ‘Lin’,” Shi Yu said. “Ling, be serious. Treat your work seriously. When you become a mecha later, it’s best if you’re also majestic.”
The profile picture was silent for a moment before accepting it silently again.
It looked at Shi Yu and then outside the room. After a moment of silence, it said, “From today onwards, I will set strict learning and training missions for Master and your pets.”
“Now, I’m gathering basic information. Master, how long do you meditate every day?”
“Uh, meditation? If I’m free, I meditate a little. If not, I play. Everything will depend on fate. We’ll see if we’re free that day.”
Ling: !!!
“According to scientific research, the best meditation time for a Beast Tamer every day is eight hours, so in order to let Master sign a contract with me as soon as possible, you have to maintain a strict eight hours of meditation time every day.”
Shi Yu had a strange expression. Wait a minute, did something go wrong when setting the initial command? Why was it related to his own work?
“I’ll formulate a training plan as soon as possible. Next, I want to collect the daily training of my companions.” With that said, it wanted to go out and find Eleven and the others.
“No hurry, no hurry…”
“No, it would be my fault for wasting too much time.”
“Ah…” Shi Yu looked at the Magic Cube that had turned around like a confused little shark and looked at the ceiling. He kept feeling that something was wrong with the design this time.
It seemed like he had designed a troublesome kid. How could he slack off now? Was there a need to be so serious?
In the outside world.
As the mechanical life came out, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu immediately surrounded it with curiosity.
At the same time, Mechanical Ling also observed its companions in the settings seriously.
Iron-eating Beast… Mid-level transcendent race. Unknown butterfly, presumed to be bug-type. Ginseng Baby, high-level transcendent race. Unknown spiritual body, probably undead-type. Water Slime, high-level transcendent race!
Its main mission was to help its master and companions become stronger. In addition, it was hardworking, diligent, not afraid to work, and had rock-like willpower. It had a very strong sense of responsibility for its work and missions… Therefore, it immediately asked about Eleven and the others’ current training missions, wanting to formulate a more detailed and scientific training plan for them.
It thought it could do it well!
The moment it saw its companions, the basic information of Mechanical Ling quickly arranged and assembled a theoretically scientific training plan.
“Wuu!” “Wu!!”
In the face of their new companions’ questions, Eleven and the others naturally answered seriously.
“Wu wu wu!! (It’s the willpower training stage now. I have to turn into a young form and swim in the volcano, jumping down from a height of ten thousand meters…)”
“Wu!! Wu!! (Recently, I’ve been talking to the generations of Dragon Gods in Dragon Palace City in my dreams… Putting together their racial merits and sticking them to myself.)”
“Yi! (I’ve been researching the concept of ‘samsara’ and ‘reincarnation’ recently. For the Time Fruit, I wonder if it is possible to summon the power of a reincarnation life form’s previous life?)”
Shi Yu followed closely behind, but he was still a little late.
In the outside world, the mechanical screen had already blurred. The expression on the profile picture had become “@. @” blurred eyes, as if its thinking was a little overloaded. Beside it, Eleven and the others looked panicked.
It only explained the daily training situation. How did it become like this!
Ling: “Analysis failed… Restart… Restart…”
Shi Yu :”…”
It was better to increase Ling’s intelligence first.
At the current intelligence level, it was probably very difficult to understand Eleven and the others’ daily behavior logic.
Forget about researching epic missions like mechanical phantom beasts and fused mechas, even newbie missions would probably be very difficult to complete now.
< Name > Ling
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Level 1 Awakening
[Race Skill]: Hundred Transformations, Advanced Intelligence, Wind Element Control
Shi Yu touched it twice.
[Teaching successful]
[Advanced Intelligence (Initiate) has been upgraded to Advanced Intelligence (Proficient)]
At this moment, Ling’s gaze instantly became a little more intelligent, but after sensing the upgrade of his intelligence, it was still more confused.
“I can’t understand…”
Seeing the dumb mechanical Ling, Eleven and the other pets shook their heads. Mechanical lives weren’t very smart either. Was this really a genius?!

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Master, Increase Points
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Master, Increase Points
In Ling’s understanding, as a mechanical life form, with high-level intelligent skills as an example, there were only two ways to increase the level of this skill.
First, increase intelligence through continuous self-learning.
Second, use other top-grade mechanical materials to upgrade the smart chip.
The former required a lot of time, while the latter needed rarer mechanical materials and high-level mechanical skills.
However, Ling shockingly discovered that his master had only touched it twice before his intelligence level increased.
This, it couldn’t understand at all.
At the same time, what was even more incomprehensible was the daily training reported to it by its master’s pet, its other companions.
It completely didn’t match the information it had analyzed.
A ginseng baby should have obediently strengthened its life force and earth-element affinity. With this training mission as the core, it should strive to evolve into a “ginseng fruit tree” with wood and earth attributes and stronger life force as soon as possible. This was the scientific training route.
In the end, what was the concept of samsara and reincarnation? What was the Time Fruit?!
Mechanical Ling realized that it couldn’t understand what its companion was saying at all. Under its forced analysis, it even almost got a fever and fell sick…
“Baby Ginseng, heal me…”
Shi Yu’s weak voice came from the side.
Under the chaotic gaze of mechanical Ling, its high-level intelligence level went from entry level to expert level.
At this moment, Ling’s profile picture was still staring at Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu in confusion. It still didn’t understand the mechanism of this operation.
This was because Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng’s combination skill of adding points and nourishing didn’t look like a Mechanic’s normal upgrade of a mechanical life form.
“I still have to continue…”
Beside him, the voices of Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng could be heard.
He added more points and continued.
Ling still didn’t look very smart.
“Yi!”
Soon, as the level of the high-level intelligence began to increase from expert level to perfect level, mechanical Lin was finally not so confused.
Gradually, it had some clear understanding.
Ling said, “〣(oΔo) Master, you… cheated?”
Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng paused.
It couldn’t be said to be a mistake.
“This is called adding points. You can understand it as my second Beast Taming Talent.”
“Second… Beast Taming Talent? I can’t understand…”
“It’s alright, understand slowly.”
“Wait, wait, wait, wait. I want to check if there are any safety hazards first,” Ling said nervously.
This sudden upgrade made it feel uneasy…
It stopped him from adding points.
Beside it, Eleven silently liked it.
Buggy, Chi Tong, and Susu looked at each other.
As for hidden dangers… Maybe addiction?
However, for a new partner to be able to calmly analyze a problem just after birth, to a certain extent, it was still impressive.
“Alright, we can rest too.” Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng panted.
“Yi…”
Next, Shi Yu prepared to upgrade Ling’s Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence points.
This way, Ling could use the Hundred Transformations to create various mechanical tools to do research and upgrade itself.
At the same time, it could also obtain better learning and analysis abilities to assist Eleven and the others in training.
A moment later.
Ling didn’t seem to find anything wrong.
Moreover, through self-analysis, it discovered that the so-called additional points were all beneficial. There was no disadvantage.
This shocked Ling.
On the Cube screen, Ling hesitated for a moment and raised its head slightly. After confusion, thinking, and analysis, it came to the final conclusion.
It looked at its Mechanic in admiration and worship.
“Master, add points!”
It admitted that it had misjudged previously. Its master was indeed very outstanding.
Now, it could add points and add points. Only by quickly increasing its intelligence could it better formulate a strengthening plan for its master and companions!
Shi Yu :”…”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others : “…”
“Wuuu!!”
At the same time, seeing that their new teammate had finally become smart and said, “Beast Tamer, increase points!” The five little ones cheered loudly to welcome their new teammate into the team.
…
In the next two days, Shi Yu began his “seclusion” life again.
Hard work and recuperation coexisted.
Ling’s skill data was also reborn.
< Name > Ling
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Hundred Transformations (transcendent+1), Advanced Intelligence (transcendent+2), Wind Element Control (Initiate)
Under Shi Yu’s points, Ling’s Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence quickly reached transcendent and advanced to the maximum level.
Apart from Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence, Shi Yu had nothing else.
He wanted to activate the “loading” skill first and experience the feeling of fusing with machinery, but the problem was that he couldn’t.
He had replicated a total of three mechanical skills from Legend Xiao Shuang’s Black Wing Demon God, which were “Divine Net”, “Loading”, and “Machinery Space”. Among them, only the super skill “Divine Net” was in a teachable state.
As for “loading” and “machinery space”, they both showed insufficient compatibility and couldn’t be taught.
Shi Yu roughly understood this.
Mechanics might have a higher compatibility requirement for skills.
If he didn’t have the corresponding “machinery equipment”, it would be very difficult to learn the corresponding “mechanical skills”. If Shi Yu wanted to teach Ling the two skills of “loading” and “machinery space”, he had to further upgrade Ling’s own race. He needed to upgrade the corresponding mechanical parts.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - Master, Increase Points (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Master, Increase Points (1)
On the contrary, the top-notch intelligence, the Divine Network, was described as only splitting into multiple intelligent brain areas to form a complicated neural network system. There was no need to upgrade the configuration. It just needed to upgrade through points on the existing high-level intelligence chips.
Shi Yu didn’t find this discovery troublesome. When Ling’s intelligence increased, he would just have to provide the materials and let Ling upgrade itself.
It had to be said that after raising the Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence, the change in Ling was very big. It was so big that Shi Yu could feel good now.
“Ling.”
In the ruins space, Shi Yu held the Cube. Under Shi Yu’s command, the Cube in his hand changed quickly with a conflicted expression. In less than a second, it turned into a multi-barrel rotating Green Machine Gun that was held in Shi Yu’s hand.
Black and green, very cool.
In the next moment, endless wind elements gathered. As Shi Yu pressed the switch, the muzzle of the machine gun began to produce air bullets compressed by the wind element!
Tut tut tut…
A minute later, nearly ten thousand bullets hit the mountain in front of them, turning the entire mountain into a hole.
This wasn’t the end.
Shi Yu was having a lot of fun.
“Master, I think this is meaningless…”
“Just change.”
“…”
In the next moment, Ling turned into a silver sniper cannon. Shi Yu held it in front of him. As the wind elemental power condensed and aimed, with a boom, a single-target stronger wind pressure cannonball directly turned the small mountain in front of him into powder.
Machine guns, sniper cannons… and mechanical swords. At this moment, Ling, who had transcendent-level Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence, could quickly transform!
Of course, it was a pity that at the moment, it was only “shapeless”. Apart from being able to use the different uses of “Wind Element Control” better, different forms had no other functions. In other words, it was still just for show.
If he wanted to really upgrade these forms into strategic trump card forms, he had to gather mechanical materials around these forms and upgrade them in a targeted manner.
For example, in the form of a sniper rifle, if it was equipped with abilities such as “vital lock-on”, “full-level super vision”, “loading fusion”, and “energy solidification”, Shi Yu could use the sniper rifle to greater effect. From 800 miles away, it wasn’t a big problem for him to kill an enemy above his level with one shot.
Of course, these were all just for fun. The most important thing was still the “mecha form” with the most comprehensive ability.
However, this form was very difficult to complete with Ling’s current ability. It wasn’t that its intelligence level and Hundred Transformations level weren’t enough, but that its main body was only a Hundred Transformations Stone. Without enough growth level, it didn’t have enough volume to break down and assemble into a mecha…
This was also the most difficult thing about the Hundred Transformations Machine. If it wanted to assemble into a larger mechanical life form, it needed to continue fusing more Hundred Transformations Stones. It was all small money.
Of course, this difficulty was actually easy to solve on Shi Yu’s side because he could teach Ling the “clone” and “multiplication” skills.
Therefore, as long as it was given the blueprint, it could still turn itself into a mecha after a certain amount of time.
