However, the performance of this mecha was different. The mecha that was forcefully created, be it battle power or endurance, was definitely much more inefficient and mismatched than a comprehensive mecha like Legend Xiao Shuang’s… Which was completely made of real Hundred Transformations Stones.
But it didn’t matter if the configuration was perfect or not. It didn’t matter if it didn’t have special abilities. It didn’t matter if it changed into an empty shell. At the moment, being handsome was enough.
As for how to become handsome and useful, that was a question that Ling should consider itself. Otherwise, wouldn’t it be even more meaningless for its high-level intelligence to be added so high?
“Alright, today’s gun test is over…”
“Let’s go back and continue to increase points.”
“…”
A few days later.
Ling’s Hundred Transformations and high-level intelligence were all maxed out by Shi Yu.
At this moment, the Hundred Transformations skill had already reached an extremely exaggerated level. In terms of decomposition, it could already break the Cube-sized body into countless super small cubes that couldn’t be seen with the naked eye. Shi Yu didn’t know if it had reached the atomic level. In any case, even with super vision, it was very difficult to determine the number of bodies after Ling’s decomposition.
As for the combination ability, it corresponded to the decomposition ability. It could control these countless small cubes at the same time and quickly assemble new objects.
With the current precision level, the new machinery it turned into was definitely one of the best among mechanical lives. It belonged to the type with a very strong foundation. In the future, after adding other mechanical materials to upgrade, with this precision as the foundation… It would be very difficult for flaws and loopholes to appear.
As for how strong a max-level high-level intelligence was, Shi Yu couldn’t judge. In any case, all the mechanical equipment he had bought previously and placed in the Mechanical Research Institute could already be “quickly disassembled” and “quickly assembled”. He was like a legendary Mechanic.
Moreover, from Ling’s calm appearance, it probably already had some clues about the “Machinery Phantom Beast Plan” and the “Mecha Plan”.
Outside the Mechanical Research Institute.
Mechanical Lin that was already in the posture of a big boss floated in the air. It looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon running in the dragon circle and said, “Leave it to me. I’ll try to complete the mechanical phantom beast plan in three months.”
“As for the ‘Fusion Mecha Plan’ and the ‘Mythical Phantom Mechanical Plan’, it might be after this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - Master, Increase Points (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Master, Increase Points (2)
“Why three months?” Shi Yu asked.
“Because three months later is the start of the new Mechanical Conference in Dong Huang. If you can successfully develop an ancient phantom machine, Master can consider whether to participate in this conference. If you can win the championship, it will be very helpful in researching the more difficult ‘Fusion Mecha’ and ‘Mythical Seed Machinery’.” Ling analyzed. “The Mechanical Conference is the same as the Feeding Conference and the National League. There are records in my initial information, but Master, you didn’t notice.”
“Machinery Conference?” Shi Yu was stunned. Then, his expression gradually became happy. “There’s such a conference? All the best.”
“Let’s take the championship back first. At that time, we’ll get a mechanical index of the fourth bureau. It’ll indeed be easier for you to level up yourself.”
In his archeological index and Feeding index, there was various high-end archeological information about Dong Huang. In theory, the fourth index should have mechanical information, right?
“Yes.” Ling nodded.
In Ling’s current research difficulty judgment, the ancient mechanical phantom beast was the easiest to study. The difficulty of the entire team’s fused mecha followed closely behind. The hardest was to modify himself into a Mythical phantom beast machinery.
“I’ll work hard, but please meditate hard, Master. If you can contract me, my learning, calculations, and research ability can still increase again,” Ling urged.
“Alright, alright. Tell me if you have any needs in mechanical materials and mechanical knowledge. I’ll help you buy materials and find teaching materials,” Shi Yu said.
“(????) Alright.”
“At the moment, the basic mechanical theory knowledge is enough. All mechanical systems can’t do without the foundation. There shouldn’t be any mechanical theory information about mechanical phantom beasts now, so there’s not much need for other mechanical knowledge at the moment. What I need to do now is to design a new mechanical system, but during this period, I might need the help of Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu.”
After reaching the maximum level of high-level intelligence and being updated on Eleven and the others’ information, Ling no longer found Eleven and the others’ situation that difficult to understand.
Among them, Eleven was the armory, the illusions of Buggy, Baby Ginseng’s time fruit and the Fruit of Life, Chi Tong’s soul exchange ability, and Susu’s mental cleansing ability, Ling felt that they might be of help during the research of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon, so it needed the support of its teammates.
“Alright!”
At this moment, Shi Yu was very relieved.
Sure.
The mechanical phantom beast project could finally make progress. If it went smoothly in three months, it might even get first place. Moreover, he didn’t have to worry about it. Great.
He should have done this long ago. It looked like his capitalist skills had yet to reach Dao Proficiency.
“Master, it’s time to meditate.”
“…” Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: _( ??`」∠)_
“Principal Feng is looking for me for something. Meditate… I’ll definitely do it tomorrow.”
“The mission list has been updated. Today’s meditation mission has been reasonably assigned to the next three working days.”
Shi Yu: “Ah…”
....
Principal Feng was indeed looking for Shi Yu.
To be precise, Principal Feng and the gem cat were looking for Shi Yu.
“Sigh, Teacher Ying, why do I feel that this is a little inappropriate?”
Principal Feng looked old.
At the moment, Ancient Capital University only had two legendary resources. They were the school’s cornerstone treasures.
This time, the gem cat applied with the might of a new totem and its old veteran experience.
With Principal Feng and the totem cat working together, their right to speak was indeed not something the core higher-ups of Ancient Capital University could compare to.
With one slap, the assets of Ancient Capital University were all gone.
“How could that be? Those two legendary resources are useless. Resources are good resources only when used. When Shi Yu and Qingyi grow up, it’s all worth it,” the gem cat said confidently.
Principal Feng had a strange expression. As a guardian overlord, this cat directly emptied Ancient Capital University right after breaking through. There was no one else.
However, after being bewitched by the gem cat, Principal Feng still subconsciously stood on the gem cat’s side.
The reason was very simple. The gem cat was applying for legendary resources for Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi, the two most outstanding students of Ancient Capital University in recent decades. Principal Feng also thought quite highly of these two, so he supported them.
Otherwise, just him and the gem cat alone definitely couldn’t decide the ownership of the school’s cornerstone treasure. Of course, the most important factor was that the gem cat had advanced to a totem. Not to mention two legendary resources, even five of them couldn’t compare to a totem in its peak state.
“Cough, this is all for the good of Ancient Capital University,” the gem cat confirmed again. It wouldn’t say that this was the best way to protect its gems.
However, it was indeed useless to just collect these legendary resources. It was better to give them to new generation Beast Tamers with potential.
At the start, Ancient Capital University collected a total of three legendary resources.
The three legendary resources came from the mystic realm of the Undead Battlefield.
A hundred years ago, under the dual effects of the Undying Dark Phoenix Rampage and the appearance of the mystic realm in the totem era, an undead disaster occurred. Although this disaster caused huge losses to the Ancient Capital, the Ancient Capital also obtained countless treasures in the mystic realm. These three legendary resources were part of the treasures obtained by the Ancient Capital University.
One of the undead gemstones was used by the gem cat itself. It was a waste…
The remaining two were also legendary resources of the undead element. The gem cat had calculated them and planned to hand one of them to Shi Yu.
In its opinion, this resource was very suitable for Shi Yu’s Little Chi Tong. It would definitely be useful.
< Name > Bone Sword
[Attributes]: Undead
[Level]: Level 9 (Legendary-level)
< Introduction > The Sword of the Dead can revive the life it killed in the form of an undead and control its will.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition
Ancient Capital University.
In a classic courtyard.
This was Principal Feng’s residence.
At this moment, Principal Feng and the gem cat were leisurely drinking hot tea.
Soon, a tired figure rushed over.
“Principal Feng, bone sword, bone sword, bone sword, let me see.”
After Shi Yu arrived, he asked Principal Feng and the gem cat in anticipation.
His own people were more reliable after all.
Legendary-level resources were applied for just like that.
Unlike the Dong Huang Association, who were slow like snails.
Good thing he had made so much news.
“Yes, yes, I can’t lose it.” Principal Feng smiled.
At the side, the gem cat was elegant and calm. “Where’s Little Chi Tong?”
The legendary undead resources this time were very useful to Little Chi Tong.
Shi Yu said calmly, “What Chi Tong? How can I give it to it directly?”
“When it gets first place in the team competition, I’ll give it to it.”
“How can you get the bone sword without experiencing storms?”
Principal Feng and the gem cat : “…”
It didn’t know if it was a good thing or unlucky to be his pet.
When Beast Tamers obtained legendary-level resources, they couldn’t wait to use them immediately to strengthen their pets. But this guy was treating it as a reward?
Wait, what was the team competition?
This guy was not human anymore…
“In any case, my level isn’t high enough now. I can’t maximize the effect of the legendary resource even if I use it,” Shi Yu said.
Generally speaking, legendary resources were used when monarchs broke through to the overlord level, when overlords broke through to the totem level, or when totems strengthened themselves.
Under the restriction of Shi Yu’s spatial level, even if Chi Tong’s growth level was strengthened by legendary resources, it was impossible for it to break through again.
He definitely had to use it at the right time.
“It’s alright,” the gem cat said.
“I know your level is low. The bone sword isn’t a traditional strengthening-type resource. You can use it at any time.”
“It’s considered a strengthening and special fusion resource.”
“Firstly, it has the ability to revive and control the lives it kills in the form of undead.”
“It can be said that it’s an ability that can help other lives change their race.”
“Of course, after becoming an undead, most of them will have remnant souls, similar to the dragon remnant soul of your classmate, Yu Shu. Their racial abilities will definitely decrease.”
“However, it’s also an excellent soul container. Although it can only store spiritual bodies inside, it shouldn’t be a problem to store dozens or millions of them. Be it the undead it creates or other undead, as long as they enter the bone sword, they will subtly strengthen the bone sword. This is permanent strengthening.”
“Especially through the possession skill, the effect will be better. The higher the level of the possession skill, the better the strengthening effect.”
“Therefore, in theory, it can not only be used as a strengthening-type resource to strengthen undead creatures, but it can also be like a special-type resource, allowing pets to obtain some new abilities. If it completely absorbs the power of the bone sword, it might be able to master its ability to create undead races.”
“Most importantly, it’s different from pure strengthening-type resources. Strengthening is subtle. The effect isn’t that fierce, and it won’t be like common strengthening-type resources where it can’t stop and explode the user in an instant,” the gem cat said.
“Well, that’s about it. Ancient Capital University has two legendary resources. One is the bone sword, and the other is a traditional strengthening-type resource. Among them, the effect of the bone sword is especially suitable for you and Chi Tong.”
Principal Feng sighed. “Didn’t it master the Spirit Release skill? The Spirit Release skill is only effective against formed undead lives. It’s useless to kill other types of lives, but if we have the bone sword…”
“When your ginseng baby cripples a few more overlords one day and uses the bone sword to stab them, they will become undead puppets. Not only can they be fighters, but they can also be nutrients for its Spirit Release.”
Shi Yu was stunned. Good heavens, they had already calculated it.
Recycling.
If there was such a good thing, they should have taken it out earlier.
“Also, if you’re desperate one day and your body suffers an incurable injury, your soul will be fine. Take the bone sword and stab yourself. Perhaps you can also die in the form of a soul. Although human spiritual bodies are the easiest to disappear, you should still have a few years of consciousness. It’s better to live than to die.” The gem cat chuckled.
Shi Yu :”…”
“Where’s the bone sword?”
“Here.”
The gem cat teleported a black box over and opened it.
A small white sword that looked like a fruit knife appeared in front of Shi Yu.
The bone sword was smaller than Shi Yu imagined. It was clearly a “dagger” about the size of a Mini Chi Tong. How could this be called a sword?
“What kind of bone is this…”
The bone sword was quite beautiful, like white jade, but after Shi Yu took a look, the feed index didn’t react at all. He couldn’t analyze its material.
Even the material of General Mu Huiyin’s Gemini Silver Armor could be detected in an instant by the Feeding index, but this one didn’t react.
“I’m not sure, but it should be made of the bones of a demigod-level totem.” Principal Feng stroked his beard and said, “The mystic realm that this was obtained from came from the totem era.”
“The dragon ball I obtained, which is the one Buggy used, was also obtained from the derived mystic realm of this mystic realm,” the gem cat said.
Shi Yu nodded. The totem era…
Although the Beast Tamer culture of the totem era might not necessarily be as strong as the ones from the Beast Taming Era, the time span of the totem era was really too long.
In this long period of time, more than a hundred Dragon Gods had changed in Dragon Palace City. It was obvious that there were also many Beast Tamers among humans.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (1)
Shi Yu recalled the owner of the Awakening Mirror, Yue Maiden.
The other party was undoubtedly also an expert of the totem era.
Stealing the Beast Taming Talent of other Beast Tamers was too much…
Although he was curious about the totem era, Shi Yu was also quite glad. Fortunately, he didn’t transmigrate to the totem era at the start and instead transmigrated to the modern era. Otherwise, his days would be bitter. He wouldn’t even be able to play with his cell phone, let alone his mecha.
“Thank you.”
Shi Yu put away the bone sword and laughed. “Ancient Capital University will always be my home.”
Principal Feng and the gem cat sighed.
This was what it felt like to be a mother.
“Although it’s about the same for me,” the gem cat muttered in its heart.
“Principal Feng, Teacher Ying, is there anything else? If not, I’ll go meditate first.”
It was better to do the meditation mission today. Otherwise, it would be even more uncomfortable to distribute it tomorrow and the day after.
“Yes, don’t worry. There’s still a bunch of things.”
Principal Feng rubbed his head and said, “There are still a few things for you.”
He took out two identification documents and a data chip from his ruins space.
“Official member ID of the first bureau.”
“The data chip of the first index.”
“Although the legendary resources have yet to be approved, you’re already a member of the first bureau.”
The gem cat raised its head. If one befriended a totem guardian and had the ability to make a totem guardian take action could enter the first bureau.
Now, it was basically no problem for Shi Yu to let Ice Dragon and Gem Cat take action, so he naturally obtained the documents for the first bureau.
Shi Yu was already immune to the handsome photos on the documents. At this moment, he was more curious about the difference between the data chip of the first bureau and the information contained in the third and eleventh bureau.
The third bureau’s feed index recorded various cultivation information. Bureau 11’s index recorded various archeological information. Then, what about the first bureau?
“Could it be that various secret skills are recorded on this?” Shi Yu picked up the chip in deep thought.
“How is that possible!” Principal Feng said.
“On this, it records the information on the known totem-level creatures in the world gathered by Dong Huang. Be it friend or foe, including the totems in the totem area, the totem information of the other six countries can be found. Because generally speaking, when it’s up to the members of the first bureau, the incident will basically involve totems.”
Shi Yu nodded. So that was the case.
However, it didn’t feel as useful as the third and eleventh index…
Forget it, with this, he would know which totem was easy to bully in the future. He would have to avoid whichever totem he saw. It was alright.
“What’s this?” Shi Yu looked at another certificate curiously.
He picked it up and took a look. So it was an identification card from the Environmental Protection Department. Boring.
“This certificate is special. Unlike the one General Xiao Qin and the others have obtained, the rights they can exercise are equivalent to the members of the other 13 divisions of Dong Huang. They can prioritize using and developing ocean resources. If necessary, they can mobilize the legendary power of the navy, the navy’s military weapon.”
“Of course, you’re the only one who has this certificate at the moment. As for whether the Marine Environmental Protection Department can become Bureau 14 of Dong Huang, it depends on the subsequent development. After all, you’re the only one qualified to have this certificate. It’s very difficult to establish Bureau 14 alone.”
Principal Feng had a strange expression. There was no one else.
Shi Yu now had a bunch of titles. He was afraid just looking at him!
Was he trying to gather Bureau 14 documents and summon a mechanical legend?
“This is good!” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up as he put away his Environmental Protection Department identification documents.
In the next moment, he was stunned. “There’s more?”
“There’s more.”
Principal Feng continued to take out three resources.
“Although the legendary resources have yet to be approved, these few water-element resources came with the Environmental Protection Department documents. Didn’t you say last time that you wanted high-quality water-element resources for the Blue Sea Sprite to use?”
“This is the first batch selected to be suitable.”
Shi Yu immediately looked over.
They were respectively level-two, level-six, and level-seven resources.
Although the energy levels were different, the most important thing was their quality.
Their predecessors were all legendary-level resources.
Principal Feng pointed at one of the water-blue elemental cores and said,
“During a certain period in ancient times, because of the eruption of an underwater volcano, the eastern hemisphere encountered an unprecedented super tsunami. Moreover, the tsunami obtained life and became an elemental life form. It was born as a totem. At that time, it wreaked havoc in the east, but just as it was about to encounter the Dong Huang Continent, it was jointly killed by land creatures.”
“This is its elemental core. Because it contains a powerful wave power, it’s also called the Sea Wave Stone. However, because it’s been too long, many creatures might have fought and used the Sea Wave Stone. Now, its energy level has fallen to level two.”
“However, although it no longer contains powerful water-element power, the branded wave super profundity is worth comprehending for water-element pets.”
Then, Principal Feng continued to point at another fist-sized dark blue meteorite and said,
“Water-element planet. In ancient times, a meteorite containing water-element power fell on Blue Planet. Generally speaking, when a meteorite falls here, unless it’s especially large, it’s very rare for it to pass the high temperature test of the atmosphere. However, this water-element meteorite is very special. It’s not big, but due to its special structure, it’s not afraid of high temperatures and successfully fell in a certain place in Dong Huang.”
“It’s also very special. In the beginning, it was a legendary-level resource. It fell to level six because of time. Its effect is to contain the power of a ‘star’. When you hold this meteorite, the water-type pet can feel the natural power of the water-type from outer space. It’s very magical.”

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (2)
“The last level-seven water drop is called the Memory Crystal. It’s a late special water-element and time-element totem of our Dong Huang. It’s a tool that stores the control experience of the transcendent water-element power. At the start, it was also a legendary resource, but because it was used many times, most of the skill experience has been digested. There’s not much skill experience left, and the energy level naturally fell.”
“But even so, it’s still a rare treasure for water-element life forms below the overlord level. One can quickly increase the proficiency of water-element skills while carrying the memory crystal. Under the lead of the memory crystal, the skill proficiency of the Blue Sea Sprite’s reincarnation will increase very quickly. At that time, under the lead of the skill level, it’s not difficult to break through to the overlord level.”
“This is the most suitable resource for the current Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. In fact, there are many water-element resources in the national resource bank. You can also search through the third bureau’s index. If the Environmental Protection Bureau has any special needs, you can satisfy them later,” Principal Feng said.
“For example, when the limit is close to the overlord level, water-element legendary resources… Ahem, it should be possible.”
The memory crystal guaranteed the stable growth of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. Communicating with the power of the water outside the skies was a special power that the Blue Sea Sprite had never possessed when it was alive. The Sea Wave Stone guaranteed the battle skills of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation. In the eyes of the Dong Huang Association, these three low-level legendary-level resources could turn the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation into a powerful overlord. It was not a problem.
As long as the Blue Sea Sprite needed true legendary resources, the Dong Huang Association wouldn’t be stingy.
In the eyes of the Dong Huang Association, quickly nurturing Susu to the overlord level and accepting the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance was the most important thing.
Of course, they didn’t dare to help it grow too much. It wasn’t a good thing to level up too quickly. This way, they wouldn’t be able to befriend the Blue Sea Sprite in time. Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation had been together for too short a time, and it wasn’t conducive to establishing bonds.
The Dong Huang Association still wanted stability.
“Alright.” Shi Yu was satisfied.
Not bad.
Although this Susu could use and involve itself in water elemental control, it was indeed not proficient. The power of a star? That was even less involved. As for the memory crystal, to be honest, it was the one Shi Yu was the most interested in.
It wasn’t because it might save Shi Yu the effort of adding some water-element control skills a few times. Instead, it was created by time-element skills. What if Susu mastered a similar ability after swallowing it?
“What a harvest.” Beside him, the gem cat’s face was filled with envy.
Damn it, damn it, damn it. This damn tycoon, Shi Yu, was countless times richer than it. He even pretended to be poor all day.
“It’s alright, it’s alright.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“Also.” Principal Feng wasn’t stopping.
“There’s more?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“This is dispensable to you. It doesn’t mean much.” Principal Feng took out another license.
“Top-notch Beast Tamer license, top-notch master. The requirement is that the Beast Tamer’s battle power can temporarily resist overlord-level creatures. Apart from being able to undergo the assessment at the association’s headquarters, some proven battle results can also be used as the assessment judging criteria. Because of your performance in the National League, the Dong Huang Association’s headquarters directly issued you a top-notch master license, and you’re exempted from the advancement assessment.”
“Our Ancient Capital doesn’t have the right to issue the top assessment. It’s easier now. You don’t have to take the assessment in the capital anymore.” Principal Feng chuckled and said, “Speaking of which, because we’ve presided over your three assessments, as well as the fact his daughter’s made some achievements, our Ancient Capital Association’s Master Qu Jie seems to have also received a promotion opportunity from the capital. He can go to the capital headquarters to work at any time.”
“I wonder if he’ll go…”
“The opportunity to be assigned to overlord-level colleagues and teammates to become a legendary examiner for top-notch masters and legendary Beast Tamers is rare.”
Shi Yu had a strange expression. Master Qu Jie was going to be promoted to the headquarters. Pretty good.
Unfortunately, he already had a top-notch license. There was no need to look for him for the assessment.
“Eh, Master Qu Jie has a daughter?” Shi Yu suddenly discovered a blind spot.
Forget it, it had nothing to do with him.
“Sorry to trouble you.” After Shi Yu reaped his harvest, he thanked Principal Feng.
Then, he asked carefully, “This time… there shouldn’t be anything left to attend to, right?”
This made him a little expectant. He hoped that there would be more things to do. Once something happened, resources and documents would come. Who could withstand it?
“No more!” Principal Feng chuckled.
“Speaking of which, hasn’t Senior Lu come out of seclusion yet?” Shi Yu asked.
Principal Feng was fine, but he had something to do.
Ever since Lu Qingyi decided to participate in the Sequence Battle, she had started to enter seclusion to cultivate hard. She wanted to break through to the legendary level and had yet to come out. Senior Lu still didn’t know that Shi Yu had blown up two overlords and become the national champion.
The cultivation location was a legendary ruins space left behind by a legendary Beast Tamer from the totem era that Lu Qingyi had obtained herself. Shi Yu was very envious.
In short, Shi Yu missed Senior Lu after not seeing her for so long. The Mythical Revival skill that Senior Lu had obtained from archeology was known as the strongest grade super skill. At first, Shi Yu didn’t mind, but as he wanted to study the Mythical Beast Kirin fossil, Shi Yu wondered if this skill could help in his research. He planned to replicate it and see if he could teach it to Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Another Great Harvest and Shi Yu’s Ambition (3)
“Qingyi… not yet.” Principal Feng shook his head and said, “We have to wait for her to come out before giving her that legendary resource… After strengthening that courtyard sprite, maybe it can help her.”
Among the six pets Lu Qingyi contracted, the newly contracted Courtyard Sprite didn’t have the Mythical Revival skill. It was the weakest, but if it had the school treasure of Ancient Capital University, it might be able to become a short-term trump card.
“Why are you looking for Qingyi?” Principal Feng asked in anticipation.
Could it be that Shi Yu…
“Well, I feel that my strength is enough. I want to challenge Senior Lu.”
“It’s alright, it’s alright. Aren’t you in a hurry to leave? Hurry up and leave,” Principal Feng said with a raise of his eyebrows.
“Ah… tell me when Senior Lu leaves seclusion…” Shi Yu said.
He would defeat Senior Lu, replicate a skill, and increase his ranking in the wave ranking competition. He just didn’t know if he could defeat her…
…
After making a trip to Principal Feng, Shi Yu had a huge harvest of resources again.
After returning, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.
He began to prepare the “strengthening plan”.
For the sake of the Sequence battle, Senior Lu was charging at the Legendary level. That was because her Beast Taming Space had already reached level six. Her pet’s strength was not weak either, and she even had the legendary ruins space to carry with her to assist in her cultivation.
As for Shi Yu’s strength strengthening plan, it had to be combined with his own situation.
Next was summer break. He planned to take advantage of these two months to travel the entire Dong Huang and go to various places to replicate some low-level top-notch skills. At the same time, he would upgrade some super skills.
After returning, he would let the gem cat bring Chi Tong and Susu to the Undead Battlefield to train. At that time, he would also stay in Ancient Capital University and concentrate on meditation to break through to level six in the Beast Taming Space.
The skills to replicate, such as Baby Ginseng’s Earth Escape and the strengthening buff skills chosen by Chi Tong, had to be replicated.
Apart from that, Susu didn’t need to replicate skills. It just needed to devour. However, a new batch of top-grade water-element resources had just arrived. If it swallowed them, it would probably sleep for a long time. Also, Shi Yu was prepared to let Susu devour resources like the Ice Dragon Whiskers and the Ice Dragon Badge to prepare for teaching the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy skill.
He hoped that after the trip ended, Susu could finish digesting it.
Of course, Eleven and Buggy weren’t without benefits on this national trip.
It could even be said that this national trip to replicate skills was prepared for Eleven and Buggy. It was prepared to make up for their shortcomings. They were the core of this cultivation.
For example, Shi Yu had carefully chosen four skills for Eleven. It needed to go to various places in Dong Huang to find corresponding ferocious beasts to replicate. It might not necessarily be able to find them in the ancient capital.
The four skills chosen for Eleven were three high-level and one super-level.
Reinforced Iron Bones: High-level skill, metal-element. It can increase the physique by taking a beating. It is a slow accumulation and permanent increase. The upper limit of the increase depends on the skill proficiency.
Tempered Steel: High-level skill, metal-element. It can obtain the ability to temper the body with fire. Using fire to strengthen the body is also a permanent increase, similar to the former.
Overlord Body Armor: High-level skill, metal-element. It can create a layer of armor. The armor can easily exceed the limit and accumulate damage, preventing external damage from affecting the pet’s own movements. However, after the armor reaches the upper limit of its endurance, the damage will be applied to the pet in one go.
Also, a super metal-element skill that could transform the damage it suffered into vitality to recover from injuries.
Shi Yu didn’t know if he could successfully find these four skills, but he had to go.
In his opinion, was the Nine Li Battle Beast strong? Strong.
However, every skill of the Nine Li Battle Beast belonged to the extreme explosive type. It was too harmful to the body. Emperor Wu’s body was not good as well. Apart from Yun An’s incurable injuries, Shi Yu estimated that it was also related to the pile of self-mutilating skills of the Nine Li Battle Beast…
Zhong Xuan had also mentioned this. Giant Transformation, Inner Power, Impregnable, and Lightning Rod could easily overload one’s body. Even skills like Space Quake and the spatial rebound would put a certain burden on the Nine Li Battle Beast that wasn’t spatial element in the first place.
As for the Iron-eating Beasts, they weren’t the kind of race that was good at healing skills. Although they were ruthless, they were also injured.
Therefore, Shi Yu prepared to nurture a completely different Nine Li Battle Beast. It could transform the damage it suffered into vitality, a ferocious Panda King with the strongest physique. Of course, the premise was that he could successfully find the super rare super skill recorded in the index…
This way, it was easy for Eleven to surpass Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast.
As for Buggy… To be honest, although it had the Imagination Skill to make up for its racial shortcomings and increase its endurance, Shi Yu felt that it was not enough.
Therefore, Shi Yu targeted a bug-type super skill.
Ultimate Absorption.
This bug-element super skill could absorb the enemy’s life force and energy points through attack to recover its injuries and physical fitness.
If Buggy could learn this skill and form a combination skill of “Ultimate Absorption” and “Illusionary Phantom” with the support of high proficiency…
In that case, under the configuration of its “Instant Transmission” and “Ethereal Concealment”, Buggy could let the endless illusions attack the enemy. At the same time, it could also recover its health and mana, allowing Buggy’s racial advantage to be displayed.
If everything went smoothly, even if Eleven, Buggy, and the others didn’t reach the overlord level, they would probably have the strength to resist the overlord level for a short period of time. They would purely rely on various disgusting skills to fight head-on!
This was Shi Yu’s ambition. He wanted Eleven and the others to be able to rely on their skill advantage to fight and crush overlords at the monarch level.
However, there were drawbacks to Shi Yu’s cultivation of Eleven and Buggy.
That was, it was easier for them to make the next team meeting… even more complicated.
“There are a lot of places to go to to replicate these skills, but it’s just fine. I can also travel around Dong Huang. After transmigrating for so long, I haven’t been to many places,” Shi Yu thought to himself.
And before leaving… It was time for Eleven to try absorbing the meteorite fragment.
…
At the same time.
As the National League ended and the vocation assessment approached, Beast Tamers from all over the country began to head to big cities with vocation assessment aptitude.
Among them, countless genius rookies were gathered in the nine first-level cities.
At the Ancient Capital Airport.
On the flight from Wu Ling City to Ancient Capital, a Beast Tamer trainee walked down the plane. He took a deep breath and looked in the direction of Ancient Capital University.
If Shi Yu were here, he would definitely be able to recognize this youth. It was surprisingly An Chang, who had given him his family heirloom, the Awakening Mirror. He was also the one who had successfully evolved the Dragon Carp into a sea dragon with Shi Yu’s help.
“I wonder if I can see him…” An Chang was nervous.
After all, he was just a small figure, while Shi Yu…
Although he knew that Shi Yu was very powerful, he didn’t expect Shi Yu to be so powerful. He had seen the National League. Shi Yu was simply a god who had descended into the mortal world. This made An Chang, who already regarded Shi Yu as his idol and benefactor, worship Shi Yu even more. Apart from participating in the vocation assessment and seeing the Ancient Capital University he was about to enter, An Chang’s main goal this time was to find Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - An Chang’s Family Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: An Chang’s Family Treasure
In the ruins space.
Shi Yu and Eleven had been waiting for this day for a long time.
The other five pets also ran over to join in the fun.
Now that everything was ready, Shi Yu and the others finally prepared to use the Meteorite Fragment to let Eleven evolve to a higher life level.
In terms of strength and willpower, Eleven was already not weak.
In terms of external forces, Susu had the strongest cleansing power. Baby Ginseng could also increase Susu’s cleansing power through the Time Fruit.
Apart from that, Shi Yu had telepathy. Beast Tamers with talent in telepathy were the least prone to being hypnotized and confused by external forces.
The reason was very simple. This was because this talented Beast Tamer usually had a deeper spiritual and mental connection with his pets than other talented Beast Tamers. It was easier to awaken his pets through contracts.
In terms of data, Susu and Ling analyzed the power of the meteorite fragment together and judged that it wasn’t a big problem for Eleven to overcome its power.
Therefore, with everything prepared, Shi Yu felt that Eleven could already charge forward!
Demon God Panda, charge, charge!
“Wuu!!!” Eleven held the meteorite fragment and roared in anticipation.
At the side, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu were in deep thought.
Eleven was already so strong. Let’s continue strengthening Eleven?
After being first in the team, it was strengthened by the Burning Gold and Yun An fragments one after another. Then, there was the exclusive skill set meal and legendary resources. How could they fight in the future?
“Let’s begin.”
At the same time, as Shi Yu gave the order, Eleven entered a sharp state. The Nine Li Battle Beast form descended. It swallowed the meteorite fragment that emitted the power of the Dark Demon God with ease!!
In the arena, Eleven, who was wearing impressive armor, had extremely deep blue eyes.
As it swallowed the meteorite fragment, its expression quickly changed.
As expected of a legendary-level evolution resource, the reaction of the meteorite fragment was completely different from the previous few times.
Boom!
Just as it swallowed it and before Eleven could start carving inscriptions to digest the power of Yun An, the substantialized dark magic power was like a messy and destructive airflow that immediately lingered on its body, blowing the hair under its armor!
At the same time, Eleven immediately felt that the dark magic power in its body had formed a deer-shaped creature that tried to corrode its spiritual consciousness and the depths of its heart.
In an instant, Eleven almost lost its mind. Its blue eyes were dyed with a trace of violent black mist. Its mind was so confused that the figure in front of it began to blur. Looking at Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong, it could no longer see the original appearance. Even Shi Yu looked like a distorted demon in Eleven’s eyes.
“Engrave inscriptions.”
Shi Yu’s voice appeared in the depths of Eleven’s heart.
“Roar!!!”
Eleven immediately roared. Before its willpower was completely corroded, it immediately carved the very deep inscription in its memory into the armor.
Squeak…
As Eleven carved the corresponding inscription, it relied on this method to “quickly absorb” the power of the evolution resource. The dark power brought by the meteorite fragment was first suddenly suppressed, making Eleven more awake. Then, the dark power began to counterattack. Even if Eleven was very strong, there was an extremely terrifying resistance that prevented it from perfectly carving this inscription.
“Roar!!” During the inscription process, Eleven’s eyes began to turn red. It was extremely difficult. Beside him, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Chi Tong, and Ling swallowed their saliva. Especially Susu, who had been waiting for Shi Yu’s command to cleanse Eleven’s negative emotions at any time.
However, Eleven didn’t seem to need help at all. In all aspects, it had already reached the point of absorbing the meteorite fragment. Although it was difficult, soon, the dark power converted from the meteorite fragment was suppressed in Eleven’s body.
The dark power gradually converged, and Eleven’s aura rose steadily. In a short moment, his physique, energy, spirit, and mind had been baptized by the dark power and strengthened.
“Success?” Seeing this, Shi Yu’s heart immediately tightened.
At this moment, sensing Eleven’s surging power, Buggy and the others watched eagerly, extremely envious.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven also continued to absorb the power of the Demon God that it had suppressed excitedly, trying to do further racial evolution and awaken new super skills.
Boom!
Black evolution light began to spread from its body. Its energy value continued to increase steadily, and in the blink of an eye, it broke through the five million energy mark.
However.
“Wuu?”
Although it was extremely smooth at the start… As the black evolution light spread on Eleven’s body, five seconds passed and ten seconds passed. Eleven was stunned. It actually felt that its body was rejecting the dark power in its body. This newly converted power couldn’t completely integrate into its body and become a part of it to assist it in breaking through the existing level of life.
Shi Yu was also stunned. To be precise, Shi Yu was completely stunned. He looked at the sign in front of him that was no different from “evolution failure”. For a moment, he was a little confused.
“This…”
To be honest, Shi Yu had thought of the possibility of failure, but that probability was established on the basis that the power of the meteorite fragment was too strong and Eleven couldn’t withstand it at all. But now, it didn’t look like Eleven couldn’t withstand the evolution power of the meteorite fragment no matter how he looked at it. It had clearly suppressed it very smoothly.
However, it still failed.
“Huh?” As his body rejected the dark power, Eleven was completely at a loss.
The evolution light on its body also began to dim. It looked at the Beast Tamer for help.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - An Chang’s Family Treasure (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: An Chang’s Family Treasure (1)
What was going on?
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and looked at Ling for help.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets looked at each other.
At this moment, Ling fell into deep thought and analyzed Eleven’s current state.
“It failed…” Ling said.” This situation is recorded in the Feeding index, but it’s very rare. ”
“What’s going on?” Shi Yu quickly asked.
In order to let Ling better customize training plans for Eleven and the others, Shi Yu directly threw the data chips regarding feeding knowledge in the Feeding Index to Ling to learn. It was very difficult to perfectly absorb the intelligence crystals of many feeders in Dong Huang with the learning ability of humans. However, it was different for machinery. Therefore, it was easier for Ling to find the direction of some unorthodox feeding knowledge than Shi Yu.
“This wave-shaped energy rejection phenomenon is because Eleven’s current racial foundation is too strong. The power of this meteorite fragment alone is no longer enough to support it to increase its life level greatly again.”
“What do you mean?”
“In short, its foundation is too strong. If it wants to successfully complete its evolution, it needs more meteorite fragments or other methods to evolve. The evolution method suitable for most ordinary iron-eating beasts is already very weak for it.”
“Its race has already deviated too much from normal iron-eating beasts for some reason… The evolution resources needed might also multiply.”
Eleven : “…”
Ling spoke slowly with a strange expression. That meteorite fragment was a legendary level-eight resource.
Such resources were actually not enough to change Eleven’s current racial attributes and let it evolve in other directions?
As expected, it was a monster.
Eleven showed an innocent expression.
“This…” Shi Yu was stunned when he heard Ling’s words.
Was it a bad thing to have a strong foundation?
Ling’s words were not difficult to understand. Now, Eleven had both metal and lightning attributes. Moreover, the low-level racial skills of these two attributes had been pulled to the maximum level by Shi Yu, and its foundation was incomparably firm. As for the Meteorite Fragment, if Eleven wanted to add new dark attributes and greatly change Eleven’s race in this situation, it had to first have the effect of being stronger than Eleven’s current racial foundation.
But clearly, the power of this meteorite fragment was not enough to change Eleven’s current race.
The other resources like Burning Gold that didn’t change their attributes and forms were still alright. They were only absorbed by Eleven, but the mechanism of the Meteorite Fragment was different. It was a resource that could change Eleven’s attributes and race, so it was immediately rejected by Eleven, who had a strong racial foundation.
“Wu wu wu!!!” Eleven cried. What was going on?
In other words, if it wanted to evolve again, it had to eat more meteorite fragments?
But the problem was, where could he find Yun An? This was even a gift from Zhong Xuan.
“Lin, is there no other way?” Shi Yu looked at Lin.
“Three directions. The first is to continue searching for the meteorite fragments. By devouring a larger number of meteorite fragments, you can complete the traditional evolution path of the iron-eating beast that you discovered in archeology. As long as you collect enough meteorite fragments, you can continue to complete the evolution. Moreover, it will be a stronger super demon that is far stronger than what the super-heavy Xuan acknowledged.”
“Second, give up this evolution path and give up the power of darkness. In the future, it will evolve in other directions and open up a new evolution form.”
“Third, retain this dark power in your body and find other metal evolution materials that can complement the meteorite fragments. Replace a larger number of meteorite fragments and open a new evolution form through the combination reaction of different evolution resources.”
Ling looked at Shi Yu.
As for Shi Yu, he fell into deep thought. Initially, when he threw the news of Yun An to the association, he didn’t pay much attention. He thought that since he couldn’t find it, and since he already had a Yun An fragment, it no longer had much to do with him.
But who would have thought that a meteorite fragment was not enough?
If the Dong Huang Association couldn’t find Yun An and deal with it, Eleven wouldn’t be able to evolve according to the evolution path of the iron-eating beast ruins.
“I suddenly remember.”
Shi Yu was stunned.
Back then, they had asked the Prediction Owl where Eleven’s evolution opportunity was.
The scene predicted by the owl was Eleven fighting an unknown totem, not Zhong Xuan giving treasures and evolving in the ruins.
In other words, if the owl’s premonition was correct, and they were experiencing evolution here, failure was inevitable? If they wanted to evolve, they would eventually fight Yun An and chase after it?
“Ah…” Eleven rubbed its stomach. Although it didn’t evolve successfully, it was full.
“…Eleven, store the power of the Demon God in the source of physical strength first,” Shi Yu said after a moment of silence.
Eleven: “Yes!!”
…
Eleven absorbed the meteorite fragment and became lonely. Apart from its energy level increasing, its skills didn’t awaken, its race form didn’t change, and its attributes didn’t increase. It couldn’t become a rare three-element transcendent creature.
Ling’s three suggestions circulated in Shi Yu’s mind.
One was to continue searching for Yun An according to the evolution method discovered by archeology and complete the evolution, following the path researched by the ancients.
The second was to give up the power of the Demon God and give up this evolution path. He would find an opportunity to study other things.
The third was established because he couldn’t find other meteorite fragments and didn’t want to give up the power of the Demon God in his body.
He needed to find materials that could replace and cooperate with the meteorite fragment to complete the evolution in another way. It was also equivalent to opening a new evolution path.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - An Chang’s Family Treasure (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: An Chang’s Family Treasure (2)
Shi Yu was a little confused for a moment. He chose to let it go first. He sighed and walked out. Then, he discovered a missed call.
Shi Yu called back. It was from Senior Bai.
A moment later, Senior Bai’s voice came from the other side. “Shi Yu, where are you now?”
“I just came out of the ruins space. What’s wrong?”
“There’s someone looking for you. Are you free? I’ll give him your dormitory address.”
“Who?” Shi Yu.
“Do you still remember An Chang? You mentioned the person who helped him evolve into a Dragon Carp in Wu Ling City previously. He later joined the Bai family’s dojo and came to the ancient capital to participate in the vocation assessment. Then, he found the Ancient Capital University’s battle club and said that he wanted to see you.”
“Him?” Shi Yu was stunned and immediately thought of who it was.
Back then, when An Chang’s mother was seriously ill, he had no choice but to sell his family heirloom, the Awakening Mirror, to save her life. Shi Yu was the only person who discovered the use of the Awakening Mirror at that time and bought it.
That person had joined Senior Bai’s dojo… That was normal. After all, it was a Fusion Talent and had the pet of a monarch race. It had proper master potential. Only a fool wouldn’t accept it.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t know why this guy was looking for him, but he was fine now, so he casually said, “Let him come over.”
Soon after.
The rather reserved An Chang arrived outside Shi Yu’s dormitory villa and carefully pressed the doorbell.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were watering the flowers outside. As An Chang arrived, Shi Yu looked over.
“Senior Shi Yu,” An Chang said. “I’m very sorry to disturb you.”
“It’s you. How is it? Is your mother feeling better?” Shi Yu asked.
“Thanks to you, there’s no problem anymore. Thank you very much,” An Chang thanked.
“But from your expression, you seem a little weak?” Shi Yu had a strange expression.
“Cough… Cough, cough.” An Chang said in embarrassment, “Because the race level of the Sea Dragon is too high. Even if I have a Fusion Talent and a very good physique, I often consume too much energy and need to rely on supplements to maintain my state every day. But it’s alright.”
Shi Yu smiled. This was a blessing in disguise. If he was always weakened, his physique would become better.
“I heard from Senior Bai that you seem to want to participate in this vocation assessment and apply to Ancient Capital University, right? In that case, your Beast Taming Space has reached level two, and your pet has also broken through to the transcendent level, right?”
“Yes.” An Chang nodded. This was also thanks to Shi Yu. This was because Shi Yu had evolved its Dragon Carp into a sea dragon of a monarch race. Only then could he become a genius apprentice of the Bai family’s dojo under Dean Bai’s recommendation and receive good training.
At the second level of the Beast Taming Space, it contracted a low-level monarch race, a transcendent-level dragon-type creature. This foundation was already close to Yin Zhengfan back then.
If nothing went wrong, An Chang should be a super rookie in this year’s Ancient Capital assessment.
“You came to find me for something, right?” Shi Yu asked.
An Chang was stunned, then nodded and said, “Thanks to you, I entered the Bai family’s dojo to learn under Dean Bai’s recommendation. During this period, I also heard many of your legendary experiences and knew that you were a very powerful archeologist… Therefore, I want to give you something when I came to the ancient capital!”
With that said, he quickly flipped through his backpack. Under Shi Yu’s surprised expression, he handed over a box containing a transparent glass ball.
“This is also our family’s heirloom. It comes from the totem era, but Father warned us not to sell it. It’s a very important treasure, so we didn’t sell it last time…”
“But it’s a waste to leave this unknown ancient item in our hands. I think that Senior Shi Yu, you’re an archeologist… This antique might be able to play a more meaningful role in your hands and find its use.”
“For me?” Shi Yu subconsciously observed the glass bead and discovered that it was indeed an antique from the totem era. Moreover, it was extremely close to the year of the Awakening Mirror. The difference couldn’t be more than a hundred years.
This discovery, together with An Chang’s words, stunned Shi Yu. At the same time, his heart immediately tightened.
Could it be…
Shi Yu took the glass bead and looked over.
[This… Could it also be a treasure left behind by the Yue Maiden?]
As Shi Yu locked onto the clue, he made a guess.
In the next moment, his brain rumbled.
It triggered the listening state like the last time he saw the Awakening Mirror.
[This is for you.]
In the blurry scene of history, Shi Yu saw the blurry figure of a white-haired old woman.
Although it was an old woman, Shi Yu vaguely felt that he had seen her somewhere before!
In the scene, the old woman took out a bag and distributed the dozens of transparent glass balls in the bag to the group of children in front of her.
[Take it.]
[This is the ‘Talent Bead’ that I created with my talent. As long as I chant an incantation to it, I can use them to extract the abilities of dying ferocious beasts and make them into toys…]
[Of course, using it on a Beast Tamer who’s on the verge of death and can’t resist… is also effective. However, you have to remember to eliminate the roots and not leave any clues.] The old woman smiled kindly.
The scene changed.
“Plunder!”
“Plunder!!”
It was another girl. She held the “Talent Bead” and sealed the skills of the defeated ferocious beasts in the bead, playing happily.
Every bead had been modified into a precious artifact that consumed the user’s physical strength and could release skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - An Chang’s Family Treasure (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: An Chang’s Family Treasure (3)
This scene completely stunned Shi Yu.
A moment later, Shi Yu woke up. His pupils constricted as he looked at the transparent glass bead in his hand.
He had just… entered a listening state again?
Wait a minute, that old woman just now… Could it be the Yue Maiden who mastered the “plunder talent” mentioned by Senior Lu?
“Senior Shi Yu.” At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu suddenly staring at the transparent glass bead in a daze, An Chang asked nervously, “What’s wrong?”
“This thing… Is there a problem?”
Shi Yu remained silent. He looked at the Talent Bead and then at An Chang.
“Yes.”
“This is indeed a treasure.”
If he wasn’t wrong, this Talent Bead was similar to the Awakening Mirror. It contained a certain “talent ability”.
If the Awakening Mirror contained awakening abilities, then the Talent Bead was the “predatory ability” of the Yue Maiden.
He could plunder skills from ferocious beasts and transform the Talent Pearl into a skill toy… Of course, this ability was definitely extremely useless to Shi Yu because he had the skill index and could replicate skills casually. As for this Talent Pearl, it looked like a one-time toy no matter how one looked at it. Otherwise, the Yue Maiden wouldn’t have taken out so much for children.
However, from the description of the Yue Maiden, the “Talent Bead” could also plunder the Beast Taming Talent of other Beast Tamers!
This was an ability that Shi Yu’s skill index didn’t have.
If it only plundered talents like “Attributes Strengthening” and modified the Talent Bead into an attribute strengthening tool, it naturally wouldn’t be very useful.
But if he used the Talent Bead to plunder some extremely precious talents, such as awakening talents, the value would be great.
Therefore, An Chang’s father was right when he said that this was a treasure that could not be abandoned.
As long as he found the right target, its value might even be greater than Shi Yu’s Awakening Mirror.
“Re-really?” An Chang was stunned.
“Yeah, but if we maximize its value, it’s also a lethal weapon… It can’t be used casually in Dong Huang.” Shi Yu was silent. This was a man-eating treasure.
Stealing the Beast Taming Talent of a dying Beast Tamer was no different from killing him.
Unless that person was about to die of old age or was on the verge of death due to certain circumstances and was willing to donate his talent.
And if someone created plundering conditions and had a target, that would be hunting people.
“Then I have no choice but to leave it in your care, Senior Shi Yu,” An Chang said. “Sorry to trouble you.”
Shi Yu looked at An Chang and said, “You really plan to give this to me?”
Shi Yu was indeed tempted. The real use of this thing was not to plunder the skills of ferocious beasts, but to plunder even more strange Beast Taming Talents. Although there might only be one chance, if the plundering was right, its value was even greater than the Awakening Mirror.
In Dong Huang, there was probably no longer a stage for the Talent Bead to display its potential. However, if it went out of the country, especially on a stage like the World Tournament where one had to fight the totem clans, the Talent Bead might be able to gain a lot. When it came to that side, there were probably many top-notch Beast Taming Talents.
“Yes.”
Shi Yu was silent and said, “The value of this thing is indeed extraordinary. It’s not an ordinary ancient item. It might involve a legendary Beast Tamer from the totem era. Its value is extraordinary. If you pass this to me, according to the rules, you can ask for a certain reward. Do you have any needs?”
The ownership of the family heirlooms belonged to the individual, but if he took the initiative to hand it over to the archeological Association, he would receive a certain reward. The right of Bureau 11 was above the archeological Association. All the highest management rights of ancient artifacts and ruins in Dong Huang were on Bureau 11. Therefore, it was no different for An Chang to hand the Talent Bead to the country. Bureau 11 was the highest representative of Dong Huang in the archeological field. There was no higher level.
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, An Chang immediately stammered. To be honest, he had sent this purely to thank Shi Yu. However, when he heard Shi Yu’s words, he couldn’t help but be tempted. That was human nature.
“Can I really mention it…”
Shi Yu thought to himself how un-shameless this kid was. If it were him, he would have long asked for a lot.
“Of course,” Shi Yu said.
“I haven’t contracted a second pet…”
“So, you want a top-notch pet? That’s simple.”
“It might be difficult for overlord races, but you can choose any monarch race.”
“No… I actually already have a goal. The second pet, I want to contract a Green Silkworm or an Iron-eating Beast,” An Chang said. “So… What I want is to acknowledge you as my master!!”
“I want to be a Beast Tamer as outstanding as Senior Shi Yu.”
Shi Yu :”…”
Damn, Shi Yu didn’t expect this guy to become his fan.
What was there to contract between the Green Silkworm and the Iron-eating Beast? It was just rotten fish and shrimp. Were the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm strong? No, it was money that was strong.
“This…” Shi Yu immediately fell into deep thought.
“Can I?” An Chang said nervously.
Shi Yu :”…”
If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have said so much.
It was troublesome.
“You’re about my age. I don’t have much teaching experience either. It might delay you. If you want to take me as your master, I can recommend you to other Beast Tamers, even legendary Beast Tamers.”
An Chang shook his head and said, “I still want to become a Beast Tamer as outstanding as you.”
“Of course, it doesn’t matter if it’s not okay…”
In his eyes, Shi Yu was indeed much stronger than ordinary legendary Beast Tamers.
Could a legendary Beast Tamer contract five overlord species pets? Could a legendary Beast Tamer be proficient in battle, archeology, and feeding in three fields at the same time?
Moreover, Shi Yu was his benefactor.
Most importantly, Shi Yu from the National League was too handsome. He also wanted to do what he did in the National League one day…
Moreover, he really wanted to contract the Iron-eating Beast. After hearing that the Iron-eating Beast was also a trump card of Emperor Wu, his Fusion Talent was immediately tempted. In terms of nurturing the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu was undoubtedly the most powerful Beast Tamer in Dong Huang. Even Titled Legends couldn’t compare.
Shi Yu :”…”
“How about this? There’s no need to become a disciple. If you really plan to nurture Iron-eating Beasts and Green Silkworms, I can teach you the cultivation experience, and even the cultivation experience of the Sea Dragon.”
“Alright.” An Chang smiled when he heard that. He was already very satisfied.
At the same time, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. Fortunately, this child didn’t go through hell insisting to become a disciple. Otherwise, it would be really difficult.
“Eh, wait.”
“Speaking of which, can I enter the Education Bureau of Principal Feng and Director Zhong if I nurture a legendary Beast Tamer?” Shi Yu suddenly fell into deep thought and muttered to himself.
Soon, he shook his head. He wasn’t a legend yet. How long would it take to teach a legend…
However, since he had already promised An Chang to guide him… Shi Yu thought for a moment and immediately had an idea.
He had yet to contract the Iron-eating Beast and the Green Silkworm. He should put them aside first. As for the Sea Dragon… he could strengthen it.
He had the “Sea Dragon King Scale” and “Level-seven divine dragon blood essence” on his side. They were both top-notch resources. He just happened to have no use for dragon blood. From the looks of it, there was no need to sell it. After diluting it, it seemed to be able to directly allow the Sea Dragon to approach the overlord race. At the same time, it could strengthen An Chang’s physique to the limit of the same level.
“I’ll leave Ancient Capital in a few days, but before I leave, I’ll give you some guidance on the vocation assessment,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll find a place for you to stay at Ancient Capital University later. You can stay at Ancient Capital University these few days.”
“Alright!”
As An Chang replied, Shi Yu looked at the Talent Bead again…
This thing…
If he could really snatch a Beast Taming Talent, he had to investigate what powerful talent it was. It would be best if it was like the Awakening Mirror, a talent that could be very helpful to his foundation. If he used it well, it would be no different from having the third and fourth Beast Taming Talents!

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - Mad Replication Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Mad Replication Skill
Speaking of which, what exactly were An Chang’s ancestors doing?
There was a big boss among the ancestors…
And a tomb raider?
After putting away An Chang’s two family heirlooms, Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
Something was wrong with this family.
How could a normal person have so many family heirlooms?
Moreover, they were all related to legendary figures from more than 7,000 years ago.
If it was an ordinary family, he wouldn’t believe it even if he was beaten to death.
However, Shi Yu thought that An Chang didn’t know about this himself.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have empty family heirlooms but not know how to use them.
“Compared to the ‘incantation’ of the Awakening Mirror, the incantation of the Talent Bead is much simpler.”
“From the looks of it, the Awakening Mirror might be a toy made by the Yue Maiden when she was young, so the incantation is more down-to-earth.”
“The Talent Bead is an exclusive special tool developed by the Yue Maiden after she became a powerful Beast Tamer and could involve the source of the Beast Taming Talent.”
Shi Yu looked up at the sky.
Although he didn’t have the time to take in a troublesome disciple, it wasn’t bad to take in so many benefits from the other party.
In fact, Shi Yu had the ability to teach. Even if he taught a legendary Beast Tamer, it wasn’t impossible. However, he found it troublesome.
After all, he still had a bunch of things to learn and really didn’t have the energy to teach others.
However, it was still possible to continuously provide some resources.
He had nothing but resources! Ahem, the resources he created.
Of course, there were also some special resources that he didn’t create himself.
At this moment, Shi Yu found a number and dialed the student dormitory management office.
After the call was made, a middle-aged man’s voice came from the other side. “Who is this?”
“Teacher Zhang Dongsheng?”
“I’m a first-year student of the archeology Department, Shi Yu. I want to ask you for a favor and help a new student settle in in advance. He hasn’t participated in the vocation assessment, but it shouldn’t be a problem for him to enter the school.”
“By the way, his name is An Chang. Can you let him look for you later?”
“Shi, Shi Yu?” After being stunned, the teacher on the other side immediately expressed his understanding. “Alright, no problem. Leave it to me.”
Shi Yu had only met this Teacher Zhang once when he entered school, but this didn’t stop him from knowing him and opening a back door for him.
After hanging up, Shi Yu looked at An Chang and said, “Next, you should look for this Teacher Zhang.”
“After you come back, I’ll prepare something for you.”
“Sorry to trouble you, Senior.” An Chang nodded heavily and admired Shi Yu even more. He was too impressive. He was clearly only a first-year student, but he felt that the school was run by Shi Yu’s family.
…
Next, Shi Yu returned to the dormitory and began to screen resources for An Chang.
It didn’t take long for An Chang to run back excitedly.
It was too big.
The dormitory prepared for students by Ancient Capital University was simply too big. He thought that Shi Yu’s residence was special, but he didn’t expect that any student dormitory was like a villa.
“You’re back?”
At the same time, Shi Yu had already finished. He was sitting in the courtyard happily drinking tea and waiting for An Chang.
“Senior Shi Yu, Teacher Zhang has helped me complete the procedures.”
“Alright, sit first. Have a drink of water.”
“Just now, you said that you want to apply to Ancient Capital University and haven’t contracted a second pet, right?”
“Yes…”
“Then have you thought about what department you want to enter?”
“Battle department.”
“I see…” Shi Yu nodded.
“In addition, you also said that your second pet wants to contract an Iron-eating Beast or a Green Silkworm, right?”
“Yes… But I haven’t thought of which one to contract,” An Chang said. “Senior Shi Yu, do you have any suggestions?”
“Wu…”
“In my opinion, it’s better to contract the Green Silkworm.”
“The growth period of the Iron-eating Beast is too long, and the evolution materials are too complicated. It can’t form battle power in the short term. It’s suitable to return and nurture it after having a certain amount of strength and resources.”
“As for the Green Silkworm, its evolution cycle is fast, and the cultivation difficulty is relatively low.”
“Most importantly, the diversity of evolution can make up for your shortcomings.”
“For example, the evolution form of the spiritual element can make up for your shortcomings in terms of mental strength compared to your weaker physique. If it’s an Iron-eating Beast, it might repeat the positioning of the sea dragon. They both strengthen the physique after fusion.”
“That makes sense.” An Chang nodded.
“Of course, it’s not that easy to nurture a Green Silkworm. To have high evolution potential, the proficiency of the worm silk has to be at least transcendent, right? This is very difficult to nurture with personal strength.”
An Chang smiled bitterly. Transcendent Worm Silk… He felt that it was actually pretty good already to have perfect.
“You have to have goals.”
“The Ancient Capital vocation assessment is in less than a month. It’s not very meaningful for you to contract a second pet now. How about this? If you can obtain the top scholar in this Ancient Capital vocation assessment, which is first place, I’ll apply to Ancient Capital University and give you a Green Silkworm that has mastered the proficiency of the transcendent worm silk. How about that?”
Shi Yu chuckled. As the green cocoon system was born, a large number of feeders surged into the research of the green cocoon. In the past few months, green worms that had mastered the transcendent level of worm silk would be produced a fixed batch for research every once in a while under the consumption of manpower, material resources, and financial resources. It was very simple for him to find one.
“First, first place?” An Chang was shocked.
“Just first place in the vocation assessment. They’re all newbies. It’s not as difficult as you think. You contracted a dragon-type creature of a monarch race, and it’s a Fusion Talent. Although I don’t know the level of the other candidates this year, with your configuration, it shouldn’t be a problem to rank in the top three in our batch. If it were a simpler batch, you would be first place.”

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - Mad Replication Skill (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Mad Replication Skill (1)
“Besides, there’s still time to prepare.”
“I heard that because of you, Senior Shi Yu, the vocation assessment of Ancient Capital University this year might be even crueler than the vocation assessment of Demon Capital and Imperial Capital…”
“…It’s not a big problem, not a big problem.”
“Don’t forget, I’ll also teach you the cultivation experience of the sea dragon.” Shi Yu smiled.
“There’s still more than half a month until the Ancient Capital vocation assessment. This period of time is enough for you to undergo a new round of strengthening.”
As Shi Yu spoke, he directly took out a bottle of about 100ml of golden red blood.
“Do you know what this is?”
“This is…” Seeing the blood, An Chang was immediately stunned.
“The blood essence from an overlord-level purebred divine dragon can strengthen your sea dragon’s bloodline, physique, and your own physique.”
“Of course, this is a level-seven resource. You can’t use it directly, but after dilution, it can be used for a long time. It’s completely fine to use it at the monarch level and master level.”
He originally planned to sell all the useless resources through Ancient Capital University before the trip to exchange for money, but from the looks of it, there was no need to sell the dragon blood inside.
The divine dragon blood essence was a top-notch resource to purify the bloodline of dragon-type creatures and strengthen the physique of Beast Tamers and pets. The Sea Dragon King had asked Prime Minister Turtle to send him this bottle of level-seven dragon blood. For Beast Tamers with Fusion Talent and contracted dragon-type creatures, it was definitely the best resource.
“This…” When Shi Yu finished speaking, An Chang’s gaze was shocked. He said in disbelief,” Level-seven divine dragon blood essence? ”
“This, this, this, this is too precious.”
“I can’t accept it.”
Level-seven resources were worth about 100 million. Among them, the price of dragon-element resources was even doubled. In other words, this small bottle of blood essence might be worth hundreds of millions. An Chang couldn’t take it anymore, and his heart thumped.
“It’s indeed quite precious,” Shi Yu muttered in his heart. However, at the moment, An Chang’s previous Awakening Mirror and the Talent Bead were clearly more precious. Shi Yu thought about it and treated it as an unequal exchange. In any case, the resources he was lacking couldn’t be filled with a bottle of dragon blood.
It was better to give it to this kid to make him feel at ease.
This kid was strange. Perhaps there were other family heirlooms waiting for him to appraise… Shi Yu would even believe it if he said that he was the descendant of a Yue Maiden.
“Keep it. You have to know that I definitely won’t let myself take a bad deal.” Shi Yu didn’t give the other party a chance to refuse and confessed.
Under An Chang’s shocked expression, he continued to take out a blue scale.
“This is the scale of friendship of a totem-level creature, the Sea Dragon King. Back then, your Dragon Carp used its power to evolve into a Sea Dragon.”
“I’ll lend it to you for safekeeping now.”
“If your Sea Wyrm has the chance to evolve into a dragon of an overlord race, I can also send you to Dragon Palace City to cultivate.”
Shi Yu took a look at the Sea Dragon King’s scale and decided not to let Susu swallow it. Compared to the other resources he had recently obtained, the Sea Dragon King’s scale was purely dispensable. After all, it wasn’t created by the Sea Dragon King. It didn’t have any special power, so it was better to have the Ice Dragon Badge with the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
However, it was useless for him and Susu, but it was extraordinary for An Chang. After all, the Sea Dragon evolved through the power of the Sea Dragon. Carrying the Sea Dragon King scale could also subtly change the Sea Dragon bloodline. If An Chang’s talent was good, he could let An Chang take the Sea Dragon King scale and let him accept the guidance of the Sea Dragon King through the channels of the Environmental Protection Department.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. Although he didn’t have the time to take in a disciple, it wasn’t bad to nurture a little brother and help the Marine Environmental Protection Department run errands in the future. At that time, it wouldn’t be impossible to establish Bureau 14!
“This…” An Chang revealed a shocked expression again, shocked by Shi Yu’s actions.
His ears… Did he hear wrongly? Totem-level creature, Sea Dragon King scale??
“And these.”
“Although this sea dragon-shaped pendant is a level-five resource and a consumable, it contains a water dragon phantom inside. At the critical moment, it can be used to protect your life. You can also summon it with your consciousness to guide the sea dragon’s skill training.”
In terms of skill proficiency, Shi Yu got Susu to use the full-level Water Dragon Ball+full-level Water Protection+expert-level Water Element Control. Coupled with Buggy’s Illusory Phantom+Dragon of Imagination+Dragon Might, he made a “Sea Dragon Statue” figurine for them to comprehend. At the same time, it was life-saving equipment. With this, it was basically not dangerous to encounter non-overlord-level creatures.
“And, this bag of beans.”
“It’s a supplement to recover physical fitness and injuries. There are 100 pills. It’s recommended to break it open and use it when you’re at your weakest. Save it.”
Shi Yu had just gotten Baby Ginseng to use the seed to create a bag of divine beans. The effect was better than the divine beans on the market. It was the kind that could strengthen the body’s life foundation without harming the body.
These things could basically make An Chang almost invincible at every level before the master level, laying a very powerful foundation. Even if it were other teachers or legendary Beast Tamers from Ancient Capital University trying to plan a growth path, it was impossible for them to do better than Shi Yu’s growth plan. The resources on his side were too rich.
“I…” At this moment, looking at the table of resources, An Chang was already stunned.
Shi Yu thought that it wouldn’t make sense if this kid couldn’t get first place in the vocation assessment now… Apart from this batch, the personal rewards for the previous National League champions might not necessarily be this rich!
These resources were completely built for an invincible foundation. Back when Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer intern, he didn’t even have such good resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - Mad Replication Skill (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Mad Replication Skill (2)
“I’ll still be at Ancient Capital University in the next two days. You can look for me if you have any questions, but I’ll be going out for a while. I’ll contact Dean He from the battle department. You can look for him if you have any questions in the future. He’ll definitely be very happy to guide you.” Shi Yu smiled.
After what he did, this An Chang might be the genius with the greatest potential in the battle department of Ancient Capital University in the next four years. Dean He definitely had to guide him like a treasure…
…
After giving the pile of things he didn’t need to An Chang and sending him away, Shi Yu got Buggy to send the rest of the useless things to the gem cat and entrusted it to help exchange them for high-level resources to replenish life energy, such as the Life Water.
Soon, Shi Yu prepared to add some super skills. From his previous experience, teaching super skills was very harmful. Just the nourishment of the ginseng baby might not necessarily be able to do it. Therefore, Shi Yu still needed an additional batch of resources to ensure the endurance of himself and the ginseng baby.
He estimated that it wouldn’t be long before he needed to continue buying the Water of Life given by Dragon Palace City.
About two days later, the gem cat was done. It sent Shi Yu a pile of level-seven life supplements, “Resurrection Grass”.
Of course, apart from the word resurrection in its name, its effect was completely unrelated to revival. It was possible to save a dying person, but it was impossible to revive the dead.
At this moment, apart from some precious resources and a pile of life supplements that could not be sold for the time being, there was completely no useless junk left on Shi Yu.
“You’re so prepared. Where are you going?”
“Don’t tell me we’re going to blow up overlords again?”
“Principal Feng said to watch over you and not let you mess around anymore.”
The gem cat licked its claws and stared at Shi Yu, who was putting away the resources, with a doubtful expression.
“No, I just want to travel around during the summer break. I won’t go abroad.”
“The first stop is the insect border. Are you going?” Shi Yu chuckled.
Insect Border City, a second-level city. Outside the city was the paradise of the insect race. In the forest over there, there were a large number of wild insect-type ferocious beasts. It was a forbidden area for inexperienced Beast Tamers. If they weren’t careful, they would die inside.
However, it was a dangerous place in the country after all. As long as it wasn’t a place where totems that couldn’t be dealt with were sealed, it was no different from a backyard for the current Shi Yu. This was because it was impossible for there to be overlord-level creatures. The highest was at the monarch level, so there was no danger.
The “Ultimate Absorption” skill he wanted to replicate was a bug-type super skill.
It was very difficult to find in the ancient capital.
