After some investigation, Shi Yu discovered that there was a famous wild worm king in the insect border who had mastered this skill.
Although there were also Beast Tamers whose pets had mastered it, compared to replicating the skills of wild ferocious beasts, it was too troublesome to find Beast Tamers.
“No, I hate bugs the most.”
“Buggy is very hurt.”
“It’s not considered a bug.”
“Buggy is even more injured. What’s the difference between this and saying to people that you’re not human…”
“Why aren’t you leaving yet!”
“Teacher Ying, the level-eight soul pearl in your treasure vault shouldn’t be especially valuable, right? After all, it can’t be sold for the price of ordinary level-eight resources.”
Gem Cat: “?”
“I don’t want anything else. It’s useless for you to keep this one. In any case, you don’t have to save money to buy legendary resources anymore. Why don’t…”
The gem cat: ???
…
The next day, Shi Yu left the ancient capital.
As for the gem cat’s pearl that sealed the overlord soul of the Undying Race, Shi Yu still obtained it in the end.
This was the spoils of war of the gem cat, the remnant soul of an overlord it had once killed in the Undead Battlefield.
This thing indeed couldn’t be sold for a good price, but it was very useful to Shi Yu.
With the help of the gem cat, Shi Yu let Chi Tong absorb it through Spirit Release.
Chi Tong’s normal energy level directly went from nearly 4 million to 5.51 million, becoming the second in the team.
It also increased the proficiency of the Spirit Release by a lot. It was one step closer to perfect level.
Unfortunately, Chi Tong couldn’t learn any skills.
However, speaking of skills, before going on this trip, Shi Yu had taught Chi Tong a high-level undead skill, Nether Cold Fire. It was currently entry-level.
Although this skill had a mixed name, cold and fire, it was not related to ice and fire. It was a pure undead skill.
It was considered a mutation of the ghost fire. If the ghost fire skill was the death aura that burned the soul, then the Nether Cold Fire was the death aura that froze the soul. It was just that it existed in the form of flames.
The reason why he taught this skill was because Chi Tong’s Interlocking Sword required two conflicting energies to maximize its power.
And judging from Chi Tong’s current accompanying moves, although the Soul Slash skill and Sun Flame skill could barely cooperate, the compatibility was not very good. It was inferior to Eleven’s lightning, Susu’s water-element power, as well as Chi Tong’s original partner, ice-element power. This also caused Chi Tong to not be able to perfectly display the advantage of the Interlocking Skill alone in a one-on-one situation.
Therefore, Shi Yu copied an undead-type skill with the “cold nature” as the core, Nether Cold Fire, to let Chi Tong cooperate with the Sun Flame skill with the “hot” as the core to counter the undead to form the Interlocking Sword. This way, Chi Tong’s individual battle power could be even stronger.
It wasn’t very troublesome to replicate the skill Nether Cold Fire. After all, the ancient capital was the capital of the undead. After letting Buggy search in advance, Shi Yu casually went to the wild area and found a wild undead to replicate the skill. Apart from that, Shi Yu even caught an Earth Mouse on the way and replicated an Earth Escape skill for Baby Ginseng.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - Mad Replication Skill (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Mad Replication Skill (3)
These two skills were not difficult to find in the ancient capital.
Among them, the Nether Cold Fire was mainly for the sake of cooperating with Chi Tong to use the “Gemini Silver Armor” to train the proficiency of the Interlocking Sword. Before the armor was used up, there was no hurry to strengthen Chi Tong with the legendary resource, the bone sword. After all, it had just absorbed a level-eight resource and needed to continue digesting it.
Apart from that, Susu also began to devour the tsunami sprite’s elemental core, water-element star, memory crystal, Ice Dragon Whiskers, and a pile of idle Ice Dragon badges. It slept and digested them. It would probably sleep for a while. If there were no special circumstances, Shi Yu didn’t plan to wake it up. As for assisting Ling, it was enough to have the water-element clone it created with the control of the water-element.
After it completely digested it, its race level could probably be strengthened to middle or high-level overlord. Even if it didn’t accept the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance, it could be much stronger.
As Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu began to strengthen to different degrees in succession, with even the sixth Ling starting to study the “mythical domain”. Buggy began to panic.
Therefore, this time, Shi Yu’s first destination was Insect Border City. He wanted to find the ultimate skill to make Buggy feel at ease. Of course, although they would feel at ease, he definitely couldn’t teach it in the short term. He would definitely prioritize low-level skills to teach when Susu was sleeping and couldn’t help with the burden.
…
Two days later.
Insect Border City.
In the White Twilight Mountain Range filled with ferocious bugs, a young man in a dark red exploration suit and a blue butterfly appeared.
After two days of searching, Shi Yu locked onto one of the kings of the Baimu Mountain Range, the Six-Winged Ghost King Mosquito.
Buggy sighed at how difficult it was. It was clearly a pretty butterfly, but it had been swept up by the team to learn the skills of mosquitoes.
However, this move was not exclusive to the mosquito beast.
Among the butterfly-type creatures, Legend Hua’s ‘Hundred Flower Goddess Butterfly’ had actually mastered this skill, but Shi Yu didn’t want to touch Legend Hua’s pet. It was too troublesome to find an opportunity, so he came to find the easier Six-Winged Ghost King Mosquito.
To be honest, this guy had quite a lot of underlings. It was very good at hiding. The millions of mosquito beasts all over the mountain were its cover. Fortunately, Shi Yu and the others had max-level deterrence and mosquito repellent perfume. Otherwise, it would probably be difficult to find the Mosquito King’s nest.
[Replication successful]
As he replicated the ultimate absorption of the Six-Winged Ghost King Mosquito, Shi Yu was in no hurry to teach Buggy. Instead, he continued to run to the next destination, planning to wait until Susu woke up.
During this period, he was upgrading Baby Ginseng’s Earth Escape and Chi Tong’s Nether Cold Fire skill proficiency.
Two days later.
Shi Yu touched the high-level skill “Tempering Steel” on the Golden Flame Beast in the deep mountains of Spirit Capital.
He also replicated the high-level skill “Protection Flame” on an elemental creature from a local fire mountain. This skill was similar to Protection Water. It was the same type and was prepared for Chi Tong.
Chi Tong had gathered a total of 18 defensive and protective skills that theoretically matched it. Shi Yu felt a headache coming on. It was impossible for him to find all of them for Chi Tong…
Defensive and protective skills were not what Chi Tong thought at all. The more the better. Firstly, many skills were conflicting. Secondly, using them consumed time and energy. In Shi Yu’s opinion, he just had to find one or two that were more cost-effective. For example, the Flame of Protection could defend against everything. It was still automatic, so it was easier.
Therefore, after discussing with Chi Tong, Shi Yu planned to replicate a few defensive and protective skills with higher cost-effective ratios.
A week after Shi Yu left the ancient capital.
Shi Yu had separately touched the two high-level skills “Iron Bones” and “Overlord Body Armor” among the pet beasts in the Demon Capital.
Even if these high-level skills were very rare, finding and touching them was very easy for the current Shi Yu.
Unlike the Shi Yu when he had just transmigrated, even if he only wanted to replicate a mere healing skill, he had to hurt himself and find an opportunity first.
However, although things were smooth, Shi Yu was quickly stumped by the most important skill that needed to be replicated.
< Name > Undying Golden Body
[Attributes]: Metal
< Introduction > It’s a super metal-element skill that transforms the body into an Undying Golden Body. When injured, it can transform the damage into life force to heal injuries.
This skill, like Inner Power, was a top-notch skill among metal-element skills. It was very rare, and there were very few metal-element pets that mastered it.
It was said that when trained to the transcendent level, one could achieve an effect where the incoming damage matched the recovery. Unless it was insta-killed or killed through special methods, it was an immortal existence.
In Shi Yu’s investigation, no Beast Tamer’s pet in Dong Huang had mastered this skill.
Among the wild ferocious beasts, there were only three races that had mastered the Undying Golden Body.
First, the Destructive Divine Mammoth.
This was a beast of a totem country around Dong Huang, a totem-level divine elephant who had mastered the transcendent Undying Golden Body. Therefore, totems that could survive the totem battle were all old immortals with super trump cards.
Shi Yu definitely couldn’t go to the totem country. Even if he brought the cat along, it was too hard. The power of the cat’s little skill was still passable when it came to fighting the weak Vortex Demon Beast. To fight the Destructive Divine Mammoth, which had mastered the transcendent Undying Golden Body and had astonishing strength and defense, it would be like giving it a massage. The damage they could deal wouldn’t even be higher than the recovery amount.
It was too dangerous. Even if the cat had Instant Transmission, running after touching it was still life-threatening…
Second, the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow.
This was a creature of a middle-level overlord race. At the same time, it had the bloodline of a dragon and phoenix. It was very powerful. However, this thing didn’t exist in Dong Huang at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - Mad Replication Skill (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Mad Replication Skill (4)
It was a species of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua, and even in the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua, it was an extremely rare overlord. Only legends were qualified to contract it. Shi Yu had nowhere to look now.
But the problem was that this Undying Golden Body was important to Eleven’s battle system…
Third, high-level monarch race, Undying Dragon.
Although this guy was called a dragon, it was actually an earthworm. It was of the earth and metal elements. It lived by living underground and eating metal mineral veins. It rarely appeared on land, so it was very difficult to find. It also mastered the Undying Golden Body skill. Though, in the ancient times of Dong Huang, the Undying Dragon had a record of appearing. It might be Shi Yu’s only chance at the moment.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s method was to help Baby Ginseng maximize its Earth Escape skill. Then, he would go to the place where more earthworm-type transcendent creatures gathered and slowly search.
This kind of creature didn’t live on the surface, so it was difficult to find. However, as long as he aimed his gaze underground, there might be a chance. Shi Yu planned to spend a month searching first. During this period, he wouldn’t be idle. He would first arrange other skills for his pets. He could continue to replicate other rare skills along the way.
If he couldn’t find it no matter what, he could only find an opportunity overseas in the future.
About half a month later.
More than 20 days had passed since Shi Yu left the ancient capital.
At this moment, the vocation assessment was about to be held in the ancient capital. Shi Yu was looking forward to that person’s performance.
However, he had a headache. Although he copied three rare low-level skills on the way and gave them to Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and Chi Tong, he still couldn’t find the Undying Dragon.
This guy had only been discovered twice in more than 2000 years of history recorded by Dong Huang. Clearly, it was a super rare creature, making Shi Yu extremely angry.
At a high-end restaurant in Divine Capital.
After traveling here, Shi Yu, who had put on makeup to avoid being recognized, sighed. He didn’t know when he would be able to find this bastard Undying Dragon.
After ordering delicious food, he took out his cell phone and started browsing the news during the meal.
It had been a while since the end of the National League. The current hot topic was basically the change in ranking in the Sequence Battle, but Shi Yu didn’t participate. He felt that it was more important to increase his strength at the moment. As for ranking, it wasn’t too late to charge in at the end. In any case, it wasn’t time for the settlement of the legendary resources yet.
[Big news!! The fifth-rank ‘Ji Feng’ failed to challenge the fourth-rank ‘Jiang Tianyang’!! The legendary young master has returned!]
“Ji Feng?” Shi Yu was a little surprised to see this news.
The fifth in the sequence, Ji Feng, was a national individual champion. He graduated from Imperial Capital University and was an elite of the Intelligence Bureau. He had the Beast Taming Talent, All Things Affinity, the sixth level of the Beast Taming Space, and a top-notch master. Not only could he be intimate with various ferocious beasts, but he could also be intimate with the power of nature, allowing his pets to mobilize the power more easily.
Back then, Senior Lu lost to this guy in the National League.
However, that was also because Senior Lu had yet to master the Mythical Revival skill at that time. Now, Senior Lu’s strength was already different from before.
But looking at the sequence ranking, Ji Feng’s ranking was still above Senior Lu’s ranking. He was definitely stronger than a few years ago.
It was mainly because this guy’s Beast Taming Talent was very powerful. It was considered a fusion of a special and strengthening talent. It had special effects and could strengthen the pet’s control over natural power. Therefore, every monarch-level pet could display power comparable to an overlord through a large amount of natural power, and it was the kind without side effects. The only thing that limited this guy was the physical consumption of using its talent.
“Fifth…” In the current situation, if he didn’t use the Time Fruit, Shi Yu didn’t have the confidence to defeat this guy. Even if he used the Time Fruit, it was hard to say if he could defeat the other party in a short period of time.
“Did this guy lose?” After seeing the news, Shi Yu opened the details. The one challenged by Ji Feng was a genius legendary Beast Tamer under the age of 30.
The top four of the Sequence battle were all legendary Beast Tamers.
Among them, the legendary noble son, Jiang Tianyang, was the son of a certain financial group leader of one of the five major financial groups of Dong Huang. He was a super rich second-generation heir.
Although he was rich, he kept a low profile and didn’t participate in public competitions. He rarely appeared, but there were rumors that when Jiang Tianyang was still a master-level Beast Tamer, and that the basic energy value of every monarch-level pet was above five million. They were all piled up with strengthening resources.
Only when the other party registered for the Sequence battle did people know that this very low-profile noble son had already reached the legendary level.
Ji Feng vs Jiang Tianyang, a top-notch master and a legend. It was normal for him to lose.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu did not manage to find the battle video.
He scrolled through other hot topics in boredom.
A moment later…
Shi Yu’s pupils constricted as he discovered a sentence that stimulated his nerves.
[Ming Hua’s exchange team has arrived at Dong Huang!!]
[After the World Tournament is confirmed, the Seven Nation Alliance and some totem countries have signed a year-long non-aggression treaty. The focus of both parties is on the preparations for the World Tournament. A certain amount of exchange will be carried out between the seven countries.]
[According to sources, the hundred-man exchange team of the Ancient Ming Hua Nation arrived at Dong Huang a day ago under the lead of a titled legend and two legendary Beast Tamers.]
[Among them…]
“Legendary Beast Tamer of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua, Katavi, represents a battle pet, overlord-level Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow.”
When Shi Yu saw the name of the legend leading the Ming Hua’s exchange team, his expression immediately turned solemn. He immediately recalled the information he had investigated when he was searching for the Undying Golden Body skill.
Damn.
He didn’t find the Undying Dragon, but he found the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow. Shi Yu’s expression was complicated, not knowing if he should be surprised or depressed.
He wanted to go to a forum and ask for help! How could he shatter the legend of the Ancient Ming Hua Nation and touch the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow? It was quite urgent!

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - Birth of the Mechanical Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Birth of the Mechanical Beast
Divine Capital.
After Shi Yu finished eating, he immediately left.
In the outside world.
Shi Yu called Principal Feng.
“Huh?”
Principal Feng’s surprised voice came from the other side.
“Kid, why are you suddenly calling me?”
“I just want to ask…”
“As I said last time, there’s only one last process left. It probably won’t be long before it’s delivered to you.”
“It’s not about the legendary resource,” Shi Yu said.
“Oh, Qingyi hasn’t come out yet.”
“No! Principal Feng, I just saw the news. It’s said that the exchange team of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua has come to Dong Huang?”
“Uh…” Principal Feng was stunned.
He suddenly had a bad feeling.
“Yeah, what’s wrong?”
“Where are they now?”
Shi Yu said warmly, “I’m quite interested in the history of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua. I want to communicate with them.”
At the moment, among the seven countries, only Dong Huang and Ming Hua were known as ancient countries. The development history of Beast Tamers was relatively complete.
The history of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua could also be traced back to the totem era. The evolution process was very complicated.
On the other side, undead were prevalent in the Netherworld. There were many Spirit Mediums, but there were also traditional Beast Tamers who pursued transcendent races such as cows, snakes, elephants, and peacocks.
“You…”
When Principal Feng heard that, he pondered for a moment.
He fell into deep thought.
This time, the exchange team that Ming Hua came to Dong Huang with was a very complete exchange team. There were elites in the business world, archeologists, feed masters, mechanical masters, and young Beast Tamers who might participate in the World Tournament to broaden their horizons.
In theory, Shi Yu was a member of the third and eleventh bureaus. As the owner, it was completely fine for him to welcome and communicate with the guests.
However, why did he have a bad feeling when he heard Shi Yu’s excited tone?
Shi Yu… was restless…
“They should be in Demon Capital now…”
Principal Feng said, “Are you sure you want to go over?”
“Then can I contact President Xia?” Shi Yu asked.
He knew the president of the Demon Capital Association.
The exchange team was in Demon Capital. In theory, President Xia would definitely be in charge of receiving them.
“Yes.” Principal Feng nodded and said, “But our school’s Director Li also went to communicate with the Ming Hua’s exchange team as an archeologist representative. If you want to go over, you can look for Director Li over there.”
“But generally speaking, apart from commercial trade and sparring among the younger generation, there’s nothing else to communicate about this kind of exchange. It’s just a formality. It’s actually meaningless for you to go,” Principal Feng said.
“I’ll go take a look.” Shi Yu was rather serious.
He had liked the Ming Hua culture and Ming Hua pets since he was young. After communicating with the Ming Hua Legend through various methods such as battle, feeding, and archeology, it wouldn’t be too much to “hug” and take a photo with the other party’s pet.
This was already giving Legend Ming Hua a lot of face!! This was a friendly opportunity to communicate with a super big boss who was also a member of four bureaus!!
…
In the suburbs.
Shi Yu summoned Chi Tong’s clone.
“Mi!”
Chi Tong’s sword bent with tears on its face.
It had the same expression as the gem cat clone.
The tool sword was ready.
“To Demon Capital.”
Shi Yu hung the ruin ring on Chi Tong’s clone.
“I won’t possess you to fly today. You fly yourself.”
After locating it, Shi Yu himself crawled into the ruin ring, leaving Chi Tong’s clone sighing and looking south.
Life was not easy, the clone sighed.
This time it was Chi Tong’s clone that was transporting him!
At the same time.
In the ruins space.
Shi Yu heaved a long sigh of relief. After searching for so long, he had to replicate the Undying Golden Body no matter what.
Otherwise, if he missed this opportunity, he might not be able to see this skill again.
“Let’s see Eleven and the others’ training.”
After arriving at the space, Shi Yu strolled.
For the past 20 days, he had been in pain and joy.
In 20 days, he went to many places in Dong Huang and ate many unique delicacies. He also replicated a bunch of rare skills.
However, the skills copied also had to be added as points.
A bunch of high-level skills was tiring work.
However, in less than a month, the increase in the strength of Shi Yu’s pet was also very gratifying.
This kind of reward that could be seen made Shi Yu feel that being exhausted was worth it.
The temperature was getting hotter and hotter.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived at a desert area.
At this moment, there was a worm creating a sun. At the core of the sun was a black and white panda…
It widened its big eyes and enjoyed the burning of the flames…
In the four corners of the Worm Sun, there were also four Bean Bears. From time to time, they would release a super electromagnetic cannon from four directions to bombard the injured Eleven inside.
“Well…” Shi Yu rubbed his head.
In the past 20 days, Eleven had learned a total of three new high-level skills.
The reinforced iron bones that became stronger after being beaten, the tempered iron that became stronger after being burned, and the Overlord Body Armor that exceeded the limit of enduring damage!
Not only did Eleven learn it, but it had also been raised to perfection by Shi Yu.
Of course, the upper limit of these teaching skills and skill index was only transcendent.
However, although it was only transcendent proficiency, the increase in Eleven’s physique was ridiculously large.
At this moment, even if Eleven didn’t use any skills or energy, it wouldn’t be a problem for it to fight ferocious beasts of the same level with its physical strength alone.
Even if he didn’t use any defensive skills and relied on his body to resist Baby Ginseng’s energy explosive fruit enhanced by the Moon Explosion, Eleven wouldn’t be heavily injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - Birth of the Mechanical Beast (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Birth of the Mechanical Beast (1)
It was getting more and more like a ferocious beast.
Among the many attributes, only metal-element or dragon-element creatures could train their physiques so fiercely.
Moreover, the strength of Eleven’s body had definitely far exceeded those high-level overlord races and even quasi Mythical races of the same level.
“6,090,000.” Shi Yu glanced at Eleven’s normal energy level.
Its powerful physique also made Eleven’s body contain more energy. Its energy level also broke through to 6 million, reaching the normal level of 6.09 million.
It had only learned two skills, and the increase in energy was even greater than absorbing level-eight resources like Burning Gold and the Yun An Fragment.
This made Eleven extremely excited, so even if the skill index couldn’t be used to teach anymore, it didn’t give up and continued to train the two skills, Reinforced Iron Bones and Tempered Steel.
Just continue to be beaten and burned? This training content was not difficult at all for Eleven.
It directly called Buggy and Chi Tong to create a sun.
Although the upper limit of the skill index’s increase in non-racial skills was transcendent, it didn’t mean that transcendent was a bottleneck. When pets trained themselves later, they could still strengthen their proficiency, but the increase was very slow.
Obviously, Eleven wanted to rely on its own hard work to train the two skills, Reinforced Iron Bones and Tempered Iron, to the maximum level.
Regarding this, Shi Yu and Ling considered Eleven’s style… and didn’t refuse.
In any case, training “impregnable” had a requirement that it had to reach the limits of the body. In any case, the Panda King had the racial talent bonus of becoming stronger after being heavily injured. It could increase its strength very quickly. Training like this was completely not troublesome.
Because of the speciality of race and skills, only Eleven dared to train like this in the team.
“Let’s rest for a while.”
Shi Yu shook his head. Eleven was much stronger now than in the National League.
Although it couldn’t successfully use the meteorite fragment to evolve, it didn’t stop it from being still brutal.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven’s voice came from the Worm Sun.
It couldn’t walk anymore.
It looked to the bean bears for help.
Shi Yu looked at the sky :”…”
Its endurance was still a little poor?
As expected, he still had to get the “Undying Golden Body” quickly.
At that time, Eleven’s battle power could definitely fight an overlord at the monarch level! It could rely on its own strength without the Time Fruit!
Even if he couldn’t win, he definitely wouldn’t lose too quickly.
“Wu wu wu wu.”
In the crowd, the Bean Bears started to save Eleven. They ran to the same spot and used the super electromagnetic cannon to blast Eleven out of the Worm Sun.
What goes around comes around.
Shi Yu watched for a while before Buggy and Chi Tong flew over.
They created a sun…
Buggy and Chi Tong became stronger.
Although Shi Yu had yet to teach Buggy the bug-element ultimate move, Ultimate Absorption…
However, during the half a month of searching for the “Undying Dragon”, Shi Yu copied some rare skills he encountered on the way and taught them to Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng.
Among them, Shi Yu taught Buggy the high-level skill “Swarm Command”.
This skill was also very rare.
At the moment, in Dong Huang, only the high-level monarch race worm, the spatial dual-element “Queen Bee of Ten Thousand Nests”, had it.
The racial talent of the Queen Bee was that its body was like a beehive space. It could give birth to a large number of “young bees” without life characteristics, like puppets and clones, for the Queen Bee to control. The young bees could replace the Queen Bee as a clone to carry out various orders, such as picking honey.
As for the Queen Bee, it controlled them through the “swarm command”.
The skill of commanding insect-type and spiritual-type insects could allow the user to establish a mental connection with a large number of young bees and command them to fight like an army.
Of course, it wasn’t an army skill.
There were no special army buffs, but there was one thing. The young bees that died under the command of the swarm would return to the main body in the form of a special bug-type signal after death, increasing the main body’s attributes in all aspects.
At that time, when Shi Yu and the others accidentally encountered the Queen Bee, they directly replicated this move.
He planned to let Buggy use the “spatial pocket” to simulate the beehive space and let it imagine a bunch of “Dragon Gods of Imagination” that were controlled by the insect swarm command. Its main body would be the one who issued the “swarm command”, the master of all dragons, the strongest Dragon Tamer.
During this process, it would hide and let the divine dragon phantoms fight. Not only was it safe, but the divine dragon phantom could also strengthen Buggy’s main body after it died.
If it learned the “Ultimate Absorption” in the future, it could even let the phantom suck blood and energy when it was alive. If it died, it would strengthen its main body and squeeze itself dry. At that time, Buggy would be like Eleven, an immortal cockroach.
However, the form was different. Eleven fought head-on and turned the damage into life through, like an immortal war god. As for Buggy, it hid at the back and commanded the bugs to fight.
Now, this skill had also been given points to perfection by Shi Yu. Buggy had already combined with the phantom illusion and spatial pocket. It was just that the formation process of the Dragon Army was a little unsuccessful. Its energy value was not enough for it to summon too many Dragon God Phantoms. If it relaxed the number, the battle power of the phantoms would be weak again…
It was just that a few divine dragons really didn’t have the domineering aura of an insect swarm.
Now, Buggy wanted a high-level resource more than anyone, a dragon-element resource. This way, it could summon the Dragon Army by carrying equipment.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - Birth of the Mechanical Beast (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Birth of the Mechanical Beast (2)
It wasn’t low-level equipment like the Ice Dragon Whiskers, Tyrant Dragon Fang, and Sea Dragon Scale. What Buggy wanted was legendary dragon-element equipment!
For this, it had already decided that no matter how fierce the leader was, it would take first place in the next team meeting.
“Wu ~” Buggy flew over with tears in its eyes. Before that, it still had to help the leader build a special training environment. It was too difficult.
“Mi ~” Chi Tong chuckled.
As a little daughter, Chi Tong was treated extremely well.
Apart from the “Nether Cold Fire” and “Protection Flame”, Shi Yu also taught it a high-level undead-type protective skill, “Scapegoat”.
This was similar to Baby Ginseng’s time mark. It was a skill that required a lot of effort to condense, but after condensing it, it could be maintained forever.
Chi Tong could condense a “scapegoat”. This spirit body could form a connection with the user. When the user was injured, this damage would be transferred to the “scapegoat” through the curse.
After the scapegoat was trained to perfection, the user could condense a total of two scapegoats. At the same time, the scapegoat could also be used as a guardian spirit. Not only could it be used by oneself, but it could also be used by a person selected by the user.
In other words, with this skill, Shi Yu had more abilities to protect himself, such as “Protection Water”, “Protection Flame”, “Scapegoat”, and “Etherealization”. His safety had increased by an epic level.
Apart from that, this move could also withstand the damage caused by its own skill for Chi Tong. In other words, if Chi Tong’s explosive “Interlocking Sword” that exceeded the limit caused itself injury through the power of intersection, the scapegoat could completely withstand it in its place, allowing it to erupt multiple times like Eleven.
It was also an epic strengthening.
“Is Baby Ginseng still farming at Ling’s side?”
After observing the energy changes of Buggy and Chi Tong today, Shi Yu asked them.
“Wu!!” Buggy nodded.
Yes, yes.
“I’ll go take a look,” Shi Yu said.
For the past few days, Baby Ginseng had been researching a special fruit with Ling.
Of course, the leveling up of Baby Ginseng didn’t fall behind.
Although it had only been taught two skills, one of which was still a low-level Earth Escape… With the other high-level wood-element skill, nutrient plundering, it was already as unsolvable as Eleven and Buggy.
Nutrition plunder was also an absorption-type skill. It could be sustained by absorbing the enemy’s nutrients. Although the absorption effect was inferior to the ultimate absorption of the bug type, it was still a pretty good skill.
As for the super wood-element absorption skill, Shi Yu only found a super wood-element killing skill that absorbed all the enemy’s life nutrients to increase its growth speed, similar to Spirit Release.
Unfortunately, it was useless for Baby Ginseng. After all, Shi Yu’s pets weren’t lacking in growth levels now. When Shi Yu’s level rose, their growth levels wouldn’t have a bottleneck.
With Earth Escape, it could hide underground and fight. In addition to the nutritional plunder and the Earth Chain that relied on the power of the earth to recover its physical fitness, it could completely hide behind the scenes like Buggy and summon endless trees to attack.
All of them became an army!
A low-level and multiple high-level skills… This teaching frequency was basically one transcendent high-level skill every two days. During the 20-day trip, Shi Yu completed the super strengthening of Eleven and the others again.
Their skills and battle tactics were strengthened intensely.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t care about Susu before it woke up. A pile of top-notch resources was waiting for it to absorb them. There would probably be a lot of skills awakened later.
As for Ling, Shi Yu took the time to teach it cloning and multiplication.
Its current growth level had long reached commander rank. From birth to commander rank, it took less than a month. It could be said to be very fast.
At this moment, with his identity as the owner of the ruins, Shi Yu quickly arrived at the Mechanical Research Institute.
Just as he arrived, he suddenly heard the excited voices of Ling and Baby Ginseng.
“Success, success!!!”
“Yi!!! (As expected of me!!)” Baby Ginseng was excited.
“Master, we succeeded!!!”
Just as Shi Yu arrived, in the sky, a mechanical Rubik’s Cube suddenly turned around. The cartoon profile picture on it said excitedly.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned.
He was just about to ask when his expression suddenly changed. He immediately saw a ferocious-looking mechanical Tyrant Dragon baby about a meter tall jumping around energetically in the dragon ring.
“Roar!!!”
In the dragon circle, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon roared.
It was hungry!
However, it was restricted by the surrounding spatial shackles and couldn’t come out no matter what. It could only helplessly hit the spatial barrier.
At this moment, the Magic Cube Ling was looking at this guy in the sky in surprise.
Baby Ginseng pushed its glasses and closed the book at its waist, revealing a lonely expression.
This time, it had made a huge contribution, although it was Sister Ling’s plan.
Shi Yu looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon with a burning gaze.
[Name], [Attributes], [Race Level], [Race Skill], all ???
However, in terms of [Level of Growth] and [Energy Points], it was the unbelievable “Transcendent” and “3187”!
Shi Yu was immediately stunned before quickly reacting.
“It succeeded?”
“The research path of the ancient mechanical phantom beast was successful?”
Seeing that the index could detect the life fluctuations of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon, Shi Yu was immediately pleasantly surprised.
He looked at Ling excitedly.
They had agreed on three months, but it had only been less than a month!

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - Birth of the Mechanical Beast (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Birth of the Mechanical Beast (3)
As expected, relying on pets was the most effective productive force!
If they had done this earlier, they would have gotten a mechanical pet and intelligence level earlier. Perhaps they would have even created forbidden weapons!
Ling: (????)
“It’s all thanks to Baby Ginseng’s help.”
“Yi. (No, it’s indeed powerful.)” Baby Ginseng sighed. It had already sensed the difference in its learning ability from the mechanical life form.
It would take a long time to finish reading a book, but for the knowledge of a library, the mechanical life form could immediately memorize it as long as it downloaded it!
It made it want to find a smart chip for itself and modify itself into a mechanical Undying Ginseng.
Perhaps it could work? Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought. It would transform itself into a forbidden machine and self-destruct with the Moon Explosion. In any case, it could still be revived and carry out the explosive art to the end.
Shi Yu: “Stop flattering each other…”
“Tell me, how did it do it? What’s its current situation?”
Ling nodded and looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon. He immediately introduced it to Shi Yu. “Well, but at the moment, intelligence can only be considered a preliminary success. It’s not perfect.”
“The revived mechanical Tyrant Dragon isn’t like in ancient times, an earth overlord of a middle-level overlord race.”
“At the moment, due to the incomplete genes, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s race level can’t be perfectly recovered even through skills like Dream Steal and Phantom Illusion.”
“Its current race level is probably a low-level monarch race. It has only inherited the super skill ‘Earth Domain’. Its other super skills, including low-level skills, were all lost during the revival process.”
“This might be the inevitable price to pay for the combination of the Dream Phantom, the intelligent chip, and the mechanical equipment to ‘evolution’ or ‘mutate’ into a mechanical Tyrant Dragon. If you want to restore the full glory of the ancient overlord, you might have to optimize it further.”
“However, because it became a new race, it also obtained new skills. They are the high-level thunder-element skill Lightning, the intermediate-level thunder-element skill Storage Lightning, and the intermediate-level Mechanic skill Basic Intelligence.”
“So its current attribute judgment will be very strange…”
“Machinery, lightning, and earth?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Lightning, storage lightning?”
Because the claws and shield used Eleven’s lightning-attracting hardening metal, the earth-element Tyrant Dragon learned thunder-element skills after becoming a mechanical Tyrant Dragon?
This worked?
Good lord, mechanical, earth, and thunder…
Then… was this still an ancient species…
“It’s already not bad. No matter what, it’s a mechanical beast of a monarch race. It even successfully inherited a skill,” Shi Yu said. “If you really restore the perfect overlord race Tyrant Dragon at once, that wouldn’t be scientific.”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment and said in relief.
A stable overlord race cultivation path definitely wouldn’t be easy.
“So, how did it succeed?” Shi Yu looked at the irritable Tyrant Dragon and asked.
“Its modification materials are still the ‘Dream Mechanical Alloy’ that you chose previously and Eleven’s ‘Lightning Hardening Metal’. It still uses electricity as the main energy source.”
“In the original idea, I combined the skills of Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu. With Baby Ginseng’s ‘Mutated Fruit’ and ‘Time Fruit’ as the core, and with the theoretical knowledge of the third feeding index as the foundation, I cultivated a special spiritual fruit called ‘Soul Heart Fruit’ that can allow mechanical beasts to awaken into real life forms after eating it.”
“You guys really came out…” Shi Yu looked at the sky.
He was indeed wise and farsighted. If he didn’t teach the third bureau of feeding knowledge to Ling, this so-called Soul Heart Fruit wouldn’t have come out so easily. Ling would probably have to study it from other directions. At that time, it was still uncertain how long it would take.
“The Soul Heart Fruit contains various powers such as mental dreams, soul and mind, time of life, and the power of purification. It has already purified the remaining ferocity of the fossil, so the mechanical Tyrant Dragon cub in front of me, after combining with the smart chip, is equivalent to a newborn Tyrant Dragon cub. Although it looks fierce, this is because this race’s personality is like this.”
“Huh??”
“Then quickly give it food.”
Shi Yu felt that the mechanical Tyrant Dragon cub seemed to be crying!
Buggy’s spatial shackles isolated the natural power of lightning, preventing it from eating naturally.
“Yi…”
After being stunned, Baby Ginseng immediately condensed a nutritional fruit that looked like a potato. It contained the power of the earth and it threw it to the mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
Although the mechanical Tyrant Dragon relied on electricity to last… In theory, the Earth Fruit could also be eaten.
“Roar!! Roar!!”
In the dragon ring, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon baby immediately bit the delicious potato bitterly.
Seeing this, Shi Yu said, “But I feel that this little guy is stupid. Does he really have a chance to get first place in the Mechanical Conference…”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon: “Roar!!!”
The little mechanical Tyrant Dragon raised its head. Although it was a cub, it was really different from a newborn cub. After all, it had basic intelligence, and its intelligence was not inferior to a child a few years old.
“Roar!!! (I am the overlord of the earth!!)”
This obsession had not been cleansed!!! Shi Yu looked at Ling!!
Ling: “Well… That’s true. If we rely on it alone, the research results will definitely not be enough to firmly take first place. Therefore, I still have to continue the research of the ancient mechanical beast and strive to be perfect. Otherwise, it’s even more impossible to carry out the research of the Mythical Beast.”
Shi Yu nodded. Yes, only one skill was left after reviving the Tyrant Dragon. If he fused with the Qilin Phantom and only one skill was left, all the important skills would be lost. Then it would be a waste for it to revive!!
It had to be perfected!
“At the moment, the mechanical phantom beast needs to be built under the joint efforts of Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others to successfully revive.”
“If you want to get first place in the Mechanical Conference, there are two research routes. The first is to upgrade the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s race level to the overlord race.”
“The second route is to achieve the popularization and replication of mechanical phantom beasts.”
Ling: “A fossil phantom recovery device that can restore the dream illusion of a fossil. This way, there’s no need to rely on the power of Buggy.”
“Then, I’ll develop a stable breeding channel for the Soul Heart Fruit so that it can be obtained through artificial cultivation. This way, I can obtain it without the help of Baby Ginseng and the others.”
“After researching these two results, you can completely open up a new system in the mechanical field.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
It would be best if he wanted all of them!!
“There are still more than two months. Can you develop it?”
“Try your best!” Ling’s eyes lit up. “However, more research funds are needed.”
“I can spend all of them! If I develop this, I have to apply for a legendary resource for the Mechanic class from the fourth bureau!!!”
....
Demon Capital.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived on a Cloud Piercing Arrow.
This was the second time Shi Yu had come to Demon Capital.
When he arrived, Shi Yu’s excitement had yet to pass. He had been teasing the Little Tyrant Dragon for a long time just now. It was alive! Alive!
However, it was important… He would leave it to Ling.
He took out his cell phone and planned to call Director Li of the archeology Department of Ancient Capital University to say that he also wanted to participate in the exchange activity. It would be best if he could communicate deeply with the legendary Beast Tamer, Ms. Katavi.
However, at this moment, before Shi Yu could find the number, a trending change in news stunned him.
He took a look and was rather silent.
Because it seemed… there was no need to communicate with the legendary Kartavy anymore.
He discovered a simpler and cruder method.
[The top 50 Beast Tamers of the reserve contestants of the World Tournament of the Ancient Kingdom! The battle exchange will begin in a day!]
The general content of the news was that five young top-notch Beast Tamers in the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua’s exchange team would invite the Dong Huang genius to an exchange battle in the Demon Capital Arena in a day.
Heavenly King Zou and the others from the Dark Club had already responded.
Among them, what concerned Shi Yu was that the news also briefly introduced the basic information of the five Ming Hua geniuses. The information of one of them attracted Shi Yu.
Amy Rui, female, 28 years old. A top-notch master in the Ancient Ming Hua Nation. A disciple of the legendary Beast Tamer, Katawei. She represented her battle pet, the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow! Just like her master!
“In other words, as long as I also participate in this battle exchange and have Chi Tong possess me, I can give them a punch and the skill will be successfully replicated, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - Dragon Mother’s Treasure (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Dragon Mother’s Treasure (1)
Top-notch Beast Tamer, Amy Rui, her ace Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow, strengthening talent for the metal element…
On the way, Shi Yu stopped on the spot and looked at the information on this genius from the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua. He fell into deep thought.
Fight, they definitely had to fight.
He just didn’t know how strong the other party was.
If the other party’s strength was only like General Xiao Qin, he should be able to easily replicate the skill.
But if the other party’s strength matched a top-notch Beast Tamer ranked between 5 to 10 in the Sequence Battle…
If they fought, he would probably have to formulate a strategy.
“But no matter what, with my current strength, I shouldn’t be unable to touch my opponent.”
“It’s not a big problem.” Shi Yu closed the news interface.
At the moment, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming was at level five. His pets were all at the monarch level. They looked very strong, but they were actually not invincible below the legendary level.
The standard for legendary Beast Tamers in the Seven Nation Alliance was that they had a level-seven space and an overlord-level pet.
Below that was quasi legend, for example, the disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Zheng Hai.
In these people’s situation, their Beast Taming level had reached level seven, but their pets had yet to reach the overlord level for various reasons. Not everyone’s pets could rely on points to quickly break through levels like Shi Yu’s pets.
This kind of Beast Tamer was still called just a top-notch master, but they were super strong.
Because if they had strengthening-type Beast Taming Talent and their talent development was not bad, it was not a problem to help their pets increase their energy level by more than 10 million.
If the basic energy value of the pet was 2 million, increasing it to 10 million would also make it a top-notch monarch with ten million energy points.
Moreover, for a Beast Tamer whose cultivation speed could be so fast, it was impossible for his pet to only have two million basic energy points. The low-level skills of his pet were probably above perfect proficiency. Some of them would be transcendent. It was impossible for their super skills to be lower than expert proficiency, too. It was even possible for them to be close to perfect proficiency.
If that was the case, it would be more dangerous for Shi Yu to fight at the moment. After all, there were two levels worth of difference.
Apart from quasi legends, there were only normal top-notch Beast Tamers at the sixth level of the Beast Tamer level who contracted monarch-level pets.
If they had a strengthening talent, they could also easily help their pets increase millions of energy points.
For example, General Xiao Qin’s Demon Sea Star’s basic energy value was 2.88 million, but after being strengthened by her Beast Taming Talent, it instantly reached 6.9 million when she fought Shi Yu, increasing by 4 million.
And this was the most common performance of strengthening talents in battle.
If it was an extremely rare special battle-type talent like the Sequence Fifth Era’s Wind, the increase was even stronger than common strengthening-type talents. In this case, it was also relatively dangerous for Shi Yu to fight.
Apart from that, there were also special Beast Tamers like Senior Lu. Although they had non-combat-type talent, they had mastered super skills that were close to perfect level. Their pets were basically top-notch monarchs that could reach ten million energy levels.
As for people like Shi Yu, who was at level five and had the gift of telepathy on the surface, but was given the title of top-notch Beast Tamer… people like this were rare, even rarer than quasi legends. They were strange.
However, Shi Yu knew that he wasn’t weak at the moment. Eleven and the others were also top-notch monarchs with more than ten million energy after erupting. Among the young Beast Tamers under the age of 30 in Dong Huang, probably no one could steadily defeat him, excluding the four who had already reached the Legendary level.
Shi Yu judged that his strength was definitely not a problem to be ranked in the top ten of the Sequence. He belonged to the first tier.
And the overall strength of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua was at the bottom of the seven-nation alliance.
In the previous world competition 20 years ago, Dong Huang was second, and Ming Hua was sixth. The difference in strength was very obvious.
Shi Yu didn’t even think that he would lose to the geniuses of his own country, let alone Ming Hua’s geniuses.
He dialed President Xia of the Demon Capital Association.
At the same time.
In a luxurious hall used for meeting guests in Demon Capital Pearl Square.
The hundred-man exchange team of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua was eating freely in the buffet restaurant. With them were famous people from all walks of life in Dong Huang. There were businessmen, feeders, Mechanics, and archeologists. They were all elites who had come to carry out this exchange with Ming Hua under the orders of the Dong Huang Association.
In the exchange team of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua this time, there was a Titled Legend “Nether King” leading the team, as well as two ordinary legends. The lineup was quite grand.
On Dong Huang’s side, the president of the Demon Capital Association, Legend Xia, the legendary Beast Tamer Yao Senshan in the first bureau, and the legendary Beast Tamer Guo Yinghong in the fifth bureau were in charge of communicating.
The legendary Beast Tamer Yao Senshan was in charge of diplomacy all year round in the first bureau, while the legendary Guo Yinghong was in charge of the business activities between Ming Hua and Dong Huang in the fifth bureau.
As for Legend Xia, it was purely because the second stop of this exchange activity was Demon Capital that he was pulled in to work.
At the banquet.
President Xia smiled and communicated with the Ming Hua legend, Katavi.
Not far from them, Dr. Zuo smiled and communicated with Ming Hua’s top-notch Feeding Master about the Green Silkworm cocoon system.
“Unbelievable, simply unbelievable!!!”
“Green Silkworm… is there such an evolution method?”
“Continuous evolution… Really?”
The dark-skinned auntie opposite Dr. Zuo was shocked.
Green Silkworm, Green Silkworm cocoon, a stable and cheap transcendent, commander, and monarch race evolution path! She revealed an envious expression.
Although the environment of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua was not suitable for the growth of the Green Silkworm, and there were almost no Green Silkworms… As the top-notch Feeding Master of the Ming Hua, she naturally knew all kinds of pet races. The Green Silkworm was one of the most numerous pets in Dong Huang, and even in the world. If Dong Huang could develop such a feeding result, it could definitely quickly increase the national strength by increasing the number of low-level Beast Tamers.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - Dragon Mother Giving Treasures (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Dragon Mother Giving Treasures (2)
In recent years, Dong Huang’s breakthrough in the feeding field was not small…
“Excuse me, which Feeding Master developed this result? Is he here?”
“I wonder if he has studied our Ming Hua’s ‘Black Velvet Worm’.”
The Black Velvet Worm was actually similar to the Green Silkworm. It was Ming Hua’s unique pet.
Between the two of them, there was a small robot flying with the translation system. It was in charge of synchronizing the mental perception translation.
“He didn’t arrive.”
“But you should be more unfamiliar with him. Before this, he was only a new student in a university. He was only 19 years old and not a famous Feeder. He was very young, so he shouldn’t have studied the Black Velvet Worm,” Dr. Zuo said with a smile. As soon as she finished speaking, the Ming Hua Feeder opposite her was even more shocked. What? 19 years old?
“He can have such results at the age of 19. Is he a genius??” The Ming Hua Feeder was shocked.
Beside them stood a girl in a white dress. When the girl and President Xia, who were not far away, heard the black-skinned auntie’s shocked voice, they muttered in their hearts.
If they knew that this guy who developed the Green Silkworm cocoon was an archeologist, that the feeding results were just casually produced, and that he had even evolved a spatial overlord race butterfly through this method, wouldn’t their jaws drop?
“Sorry, I have to take this call.” At this moment, President Xia, who was communicating with Legend Ming Hua, suddenly apologized.
“It’s alright.” Legend Katavi smiled, indicating that it was fine.
After President Xia picked up the phone, he was clearly stunned.
He never expected that just as his wife finished bragging about Shi Yu, this guy would call him.
Shi Yu… Why was he calling him?
The two of them actually didn’t have much interaction.
“Hello, President Xia. I’m Shi Yu.”
“Shi Yu, what’s the matter?” President Xia found it strange.
“I heard that the exchange team of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua has arrived in Demon Capital. There’s still an exchange battle event held in the Demon Capital Arena tomorrow. Isn’t that so? Well, I’m also in Demon Capital now. Is it too late to register for the exchange battle event now?”
Ah, this!
President Xia was stunned. So that was the reason.
However, Shi Yu had just finished the National League. How long had it been? Why did he suddenly target the Beast Tamer of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua?
In fact, in President Xia’s eyes, Shi Yu wasn’t someone who liked to fight.
If he loved to fight, why didn’t he register for the battle department instead of the archeology department?
If he loved to fight, why had he not challenged anyone from the sequence ranking?
Although Shi Yu was indeed very strong, President Xia was still slightly stunned when Shi Yu suddenly came to ask him about this.
“It’s not late, but… are you sure you want to come?”
If he remembered correctly, Shi Yu was still a level-five Beast Tamer.
Although he and Gao Xuan were freaks at the top of the Sequence, and their strength was not necessarily inferior to top-notch masters, the five contestants of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua were not simple.
Their strength could definitely be ranked in the top ten of the younger generation under the age of 30 in the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua.
Among the five reserve contestants of the World Tournament that Ming Hua had come to Dong Huang for this battle exchange, there were two top-notch masters at the quasi legendary level and three ordinary top-notch masters. Clearly, they were core contestants of Ming Hua.
Although it was called a reserve now, if nothing unexpected happened, it would basically represent Ming Hua in the world competition.
He wasn’t surprised that Heavenly King Zou and the other top-notch masters of the Sequence would fight, but was Shi Yu really going to come?
Although Shi Yu could kill indiscriminately in the National League, the individual competition contestants of the National League were only university students in their early twenties after all. These students were only the weakest batch in the master-level domain. Just because Shi Yu and Gao Xuan could kill these student masters indiscriminately didn’t mean that they could defeat the real world competition contestants whose strength was enough to rank in the top ten of Ancient Ming Hua.
These people had cultivated for at least five years more than them.
“Yes, I’m just going to broaden my horizons…”
“Alright…” President Xia pondered for a moment and said,” By the way, do you have a place to stay in Demon Capital? There are banquets here from now to night. Do you want to come over? Why don’t I get Qingwei to pick you up? ”
“It’s alright, there’s no need…”
“No need to be polite. Qingwei…” In the hall, President Xia called Xia Qingwei, who was quietly drinking milk tea at the side and was not interested in communicating with the young people of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua, and said, “Come here for a while, you go and fetch someone. ”
“Huh?” Xia Qingwei raised her head and looked at her father with a puzzled expression.
“Pick up a person?”
“Who is it?” Xia Qingwei was unwilling. It was finally the holidays. It was fine if she couldn’t rest and was pulled to participate in the banquet, but why was there a mission?
“Shi Yu.”
Xia Qingwei was stunned, then said, “Oh… Okay.”
President Xia quickly explained to Xia Qingwei.
Then, he smiled at Legend Katavi opposite him and said, “It’s a Beast Tamer who suddenly wants to participate in the battle exchange tomorrow.”
“Oh, oh.” Legend Katavi smiled.
He was very curious about the strength of this batch of Dong Huang’s younger generation.
Although this was a rare national exchange opportunity, and the most important thing was economic trade, because the World Tournament was imminent, this battle exchange was also very valued by the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua.
Apart from testing the strength of the contestants in the world competition, it could also let the contestants go to various places to see different pets. This was more conducive to their survival in the world competition.
After all, the pet races in various regions were still very different.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - Dragon Mother Giving Treasures (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Dragon Mother Giving Treasures (3)
Of course, there would also be some prizes around the exchange event, such as deciding who had the initiative in the business exchange event, or deciding how many special cultivation mystic realms Dong Huang would open for them to use and train.
This year, with the momentum of the World Tournament, it would be a frequent period of exchange between the seven-nation alliance. If nothing went wrong, at that time, Dong Huang would also establish an exchange team and go to the other six countries to communicate. At that time, the battle exchange would be an extremely important project.
…
“Sigh ~” After Shi Yu hung up, he looked at the blue sky and white clouds.
He had just finished eating. What was the point of going to the banquet after eating?
However, it was fine to go over and take a look. Perhaps there was a chance to directly replicate some rare skills at the banquet.
Just as Shi Yu hung up, another call came.
Shi Yu subconsciously thought that it was Xia Qingwei, but when he focused, he realized that it was General Xiao Qin, who was far in the sea area beside the Ice Fire Snow Mountain…
“…” Shi Yu picked up the phone.
“Minister Shi Yu, the people from Dragon Palace City, um, the sea beasts, came to visit our Environmental Protection Department base.”
General Xiao Qin’s voice came from the other side.
“They said that they’re subordinates of Lord Ice Dragon and came to invite you and the Gem Cat to go to Dragon Palace City to play. They said that it entered the Dragon God Ruins and successfully obtained a pile of treasures inside. They can give you and the Gem Cat two useless things. They also want to hold a banquet and eat roasted octopus tentacles together?”
“It can’t be the Vortex Totem, right…” General Xiao Qin felt extremely hungry.
Shi Yu : “…”
“This…”
When Shi Yu heard the content, he was immediately stunned. Ice Dragon had finally entered the Dragon God Ruins. From the looks of it, it had gained a lot??
The Dragon God Ruins was indeed filled with treasures.
There were legendary and Mythical resources.
The Kirin fossil was something from the Dragon God Ruins.
It was said that when the totem dragon king first entered the Dragon God Ruins, it had never returned empty-handed. In the worst cases, anyone who went in had at least brought out one or two legendary resources.
Unfortunately, only totem-level dragons could enter this ruin.
Shi Yu wiped his saliva.
What a “mom”! She had good things and still knew to think about them.
However, only a few useless resources were given. What the hell?
It was probably just being polite. In fact, maybe it had already prepared several legendary resources, waiting to give them a surprise!
He remembered that before they separated, after he let Ice Dragon enter the ruins, he paid attention to whether there were any resources that could strengthen Buggy.
Did this mean that Buggy’s legendary resources were also in place?
Buggy was half a child of the Ice Dragon after all. It couldn’t be mistreated, right?
One dragon-element legendary resource, and three or four dragon-element level-eight resources. With Buggy’s equipment, its battle power could probably increase. The insect swarm (dragon group) strategy could also be gradually perfected around the equipment.
Shi Yu looked up at the sky. He had Eleven’s legendary resources, Chi Tong’s legendary resources, but he still lacked Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and Ling’s.
Susu, though, he didn’t have to worry about. When the time came, he would just have to apply to the Environmental Protection Department. Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang would probably be willing to give it to it.
As for Ling, he could see if there was a chance to pass the Mechanical Conference.
As for Buggy’s, it might also be in place this time. From the looks of it, it wasn’t impossible to collect six legendary resources and prepare one for every pet to break through to the overlord level with a “perfect foundation”.
“Thank you, Mother Dragon.” Shi Yu was excited. He immediately prepared to tell this good news to Ice Dragon’s good friend, the gem cat.
Let’s go to Dragon Palace City to eat roasted octopus tentacles. This was totem meat. Even if it was just the most ordinary tentacle, it had to be comparable to a level-seven resource. It was very nutritious!
It was the new year. The elders had sent New Year’s red packet money.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - Still Killing Indiscriminately (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Still Killing Indiscriminately (1)
“I’m hanging up.”
After receiving the news from Xiao Qin, Shi Yu informed the gem cat that Demon Capital was looking for him to play.
The gem cat definitely didn’t want to miss such a good thing.
Cultivation my ass. The most important thing was to freeload. The gem cat had been eyeing the Vortex Demon Beast’s octopus tentacles for a long time.
“What!!!”
As expected, at Ancient Capital University, the gem cat’s eyes immediately lit up when it received Shi Yu’s call.
Without another word, it threw a clone to work and its main body started to teleport.
Sensing the commotion over there, Shi Yu hung up with a sigh.
“But this way, I have to replicate the skills as soon as possible…”
Shi Yu looked into the distance. He couldn’t waste too much time in Demon Capital.
Otherwise, it would be bad if Mother Dragon changed her mind and didn’t want to give him legendary resources.
He stretched and walked leisurely in the direction of Pearl Square.
Soon, Shi Yu saw Xia Qingwei, who had also rushed over to find him.
It was obvious that the other party had just come out of the banquet. She was wearing a purple petal see-through dress. The purple petals on both sides of her shoulders made her look very young, although she wasn’t very old herself.
Xia Qingwei saw Shi Yu from afar and stopped.
“Little Xia,” Shi Yu immediately said when he saw her.
Xia Qingwei pursed her lips. At this moment, she was still brooding over the fact that Shi Yu’s pet used its clone to eliminate her in the National League.
To be precise, from the moment the limelight of the Butterfly Meeting was snatched away to the moment her pet was insta-killed by Shi Yu with deterrence in Legend Hua’s courtyard, then to the moment where she became Shi Yu’s research assistant, she had never stood up to Shi Yu.
No matter what, she was still the daughter of a legendary Beast Tamer and a famous doctorate!
How could a strange guy like Shi Yu be born in this world?
“I heard you’re participating in the battle exchange with the Ming Hua Beast Tamer tomorrow.” She wanted to know what Shi Yu was up to now.
“Well, have you seen those Beast Tamers?” Shi Yu asked.
Xia Qingwei nodded and said, “I took a few looks from afar and they gave off a very strong feeling…”
Shi Yu smiled. “Where are their pets?”
“Didn’t see them.” Xia Qingwei shook her head.
“Wu.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Didn’t the other party show their pets at the banquet? Then why would he go to the banquet?
“Why, you don’t want to go to the banquet anymore?” Xia Qingwei seemed to have seen through Shi Yu’s thoughts.
Therefore, Shi Yu wanted to come because he was curious about Ming Hua’s pets?
“Ah… Anything is fine,” Shi Yu said. He was free anyway.
“Up to you.” Xia Qingwei shrugged and said, “However, it’s indeed a little boring over there.”
Today, the exchange activity had actually not completely started. It was just the relevant people from various fields meeting and getting to know each other.
For a real exchange activity, there would definitely be special venues in various fields.
For example, the battle exchange would be held in the Demon Capital Arena tomorrow.
“Actually, if you’re more curious about the Ming Hua pets, I can take you to the research institute to take a look. Dong Huang took advantage of this exchange to introduce another batch of Ming Hua native pets. A batch of bug-type creatures has gathered at the research institute. There should be six to seven races.”
“Eh, let’s go to the research institute then,” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
Let’s see if we can replicate another skill for Buggy!
“Alright!” Xia Qingwei said. The research institute was ultimately more fun than a banquet.
Half an hour later, in the banquet hall, President Xia was rather confused. Why hadn’t his daughter brought him over after half an hour? Where was he?
“Stop looking.”
Dr. Zuo walked over and said, “My daughter sent me a message. She said to bring Shi Yu to the research institute to take a look.”
President Xia was stunned. “No wonder this girl agreed so readily. So she didn’t plan to come back. Then, when the banquet is almost over, shouldn’t we hurry over and greet Shi Yu?”
Speaking of which, he could be promoted to the president of the Demon Capital Association this time because of his wife. After all, Dr. Zuo was currently in charge of the national research project, the Green Silkworm cocoon project.
And for Dr. Zuo to be able to take on this project, the most important thing was actually the nod of the big boss of the third bureau, Shi Yu.
“Sure.” Dr. Zuo felt that it was alright.
…
The Demon Capital Worm Department Research Institute. This was Dr. Zuo’s research place, and also Xia Qingwei’s research place.
As a research student of Demon Capital University, she was going to take over her mother’s work in the future. Compared to battle, she was more proficient in feeding.
The Worm Department Research Institute was established in a natural mountain area. It was a huge natural garden. The forest path that arrived here led to the door. The monarch-level Sun Moth was in charge of guarding the nest in the sky.
Six pairs of orange wings surrounded it. The Sun Moth that had a graceful white belly saw that it was someone familiar, so it turned a blind eye and let it pass.
Shi Yu originally came with anticipation, wondering if he could replicate another rare skill for Buggy that was difficult to find in Dong Huang.
However, the outcome made him very helpless. He realized that there was nothing worth replicating.
“Are you interested or not?”
Xia Qingwei, who was trying hard to introduce the Black Velvet Worm, the Shell Worm, and the other special pets of the Ming Hua, had a strange expression.
Why was this man so fickle? He was excited when he came just now, but why was he unhappy again after seeing the worm?
She looked at the black furry worm in the cage. Wasn’t this cute?
“I was interested just now, but I’m not interested now.” Shi Yu looked at the Black Velvet Worm covered in trash skills and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - Still Killing indiscriminately (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Still Killing indiscriminately (2)
“…”
Seeing this, Xia Qingwei covered her forehead and couldn’t be bothered to introduce it anymore.
“Then I won’t go back to the banquet,” she said. After returning to the research institute, she found an opportunity to change the uncomfortable dress into a school uniform. She felt much more comfortable now. It was too troublesome to change back.
“Whatever.”
“However, don’t go yet. My parents just sent a message saying that they want to treat you to dinner.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu sighed. Eating again? In the past half a month, apart from adding points, he had only eaten.
…
In the evening.
Dr. Zuo left the banquet before President Xia, afraid that her daughter wouldn’t receive Shi Yu well. The last time Shi Yu came to Demon Capital to participate in the National League, the time was tight. Shi Yu also left in a hurry and they didn’t have time to entertain Shi Yu properly. This time, she had to personally cook to entertain Shi Yu no matter what.
She wanted to be a good host.
At night, Shi Yu regretted it a little. He understood that the world was a dangerous place…
At President Xia’s house, Shi Yu looked at the fried bamboo worm on the table. Fried golden cicada, egg steamed sea worm, scorpion soup… He felt a little dizzy.
Damn it, how could you bug-type researchers eat bugs?
This was no different from a dog lover eating dog meat.
In his previous life, he had never been so extravagant even when exploring deep in the mountains…
“Don’t worry about it, just treat it as your own home,” Dr. Zuo said with a smile.
Xia Qingwei: Hmm (`?Д?)?
“Shiyu, I’ll add you to the exchange event tomorrow.” President Xia and Xia Qingwei looked very normal.
“Alright, thank you…” After a moment of silence, Shi Yu changed the topic.
“By the way, I wonder what the rules of the exchange competition are.”
Shi Yu had asked in advance to avoid missing the replication opportunity tomorrow because he didn’t understand the rules.
“The rules are very simple. Usually, this kind of exchange activity is solo.”
“Group battles consume too much energy for Beast Tamers, especially for Beast Tamers who want to strengthen the strengthening talent of multiple pets in one go. It’s very easy for accidents to happen in battle.”
“Therefore, tomorrow’s exchange between Dong Huang and Ming Hua will be a 3VS3 solo. Generally speaking, Beast Tamers at this level rarely have any bias. Those who are good in team battles are also good in solo battles.” President Xia smiled.
“Also, this exchange activity will actually also reposition the ranking according to the performance of the contestants Dong Huang represents. If you want to charge at the ranking of the Sequence Battle, you can indeed perform well this time. Director Zhong of the Sequence Battle Committee will still go as a guest this time.”
“I see.” Shi Yu nodded.
However, this way, it was best for him to go on stage as soon as possible tomorrow. Otherwise, if the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow was killed by other Beast Tamers of Dong Huang in advance, he wouldn’t have a chance to fight. It would be pretty sad, and he didn’t want to find another way. It was best to completely achieve his goal tomorrow. After that, he would directly go to Dragon Palace City to avoid wasting time.
Moreover, he had to leave Chi Tong to that Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow.
After all, the condition for replicating a skill was to see the other party use the skill and touch it within 30 minutes.
In the 1VS1 solo situation, regardless of whether Shi Yu sent Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, or Susu, it was not easy for him to naturally touch the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow.
On the other hand, if he sent Chi Tong to fight the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow, he could become the main force of the battle after Chi Tong possessed him. This way, it would be easier to touch the enemy.
“These Beast Tamers from the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua are very strong. They should be the best of the younger generation in their country. They’re different from the Beast Tamers you encountered previously. Let Old Xia tell you their basic information later. You can also watch the battles of the others tomorrow,” Dr. Zuo said. “For example, Heavenly King Zou and the others from the Dark Club will also be at the scene tomorrow.”
In the eyes of Dr. Zuo and the others, Shi Yu was still a little young. Although he had started an exciting competition with Gao Xuan in the National League, Gao Xuan was only a level-five Beast Tamer after all. Moreover, he had a non-combat-type strengthening talent. However, this group of people was completely different. They all had combat-type talent, were older, had stronger pets, and had higher levels.
“Aunt Zuo, don’t worry.”
“Alright, eat quickly. The bugs are getting cold.”
Shi Yu : “…”
Shi Yu sighed and picked up the fried cicadas that he could accept. He didn’t know the taste of other things, but this should be edible.
…
In the building where the Ming Hua exchange team lived.
At night, in a conference room.
Legend Katavi, who was in charge of tomorrow’s exchange, looked at the three men and two women below and also prepared information about tomorrow’s exchange for them.
“Tomorrow, you will represent the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua to carry out the first exchange battle with the seven contestants of Dong Huang.”
“Although you have fewer people and they have more people, the more pets you can defeat, the richer the resources you can obtain from your country and Dong Huang. Therefore, everyone, be prepared to take turns fighting. We will prepare sufficient supplements.”
“In order to choose the contestants of the World Tournament, Dong Huang specially launched a ranking competition called the Sequence Battle. To a certain extent, the ranking of this competition represents the strength of their contestants.”
“The seven Beast Tamers who will fight you this time are respectively ranked sixth, tenth, thirteenth, fifteenth, nineteenth, twentieth, and twenty-second in the Sequence battle.”
“Although their rankings are generally not high, the overall strength of Dong Huang is a little stronger than ours. For example, the top four of their Sequence Battle are all legendary Beast Tamers, while we only have one legend under the age of 30. Moreover, we don’t have any peers this time, so you all should probably understand the value of this ranking.”

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - Still Killing indiscriminately (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Still Killing indiscriminately (3)
Below, the expressions of the contestants from the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua were solemn. Although they were both ancient countries, the difference in strength between the two parties was indeed huge. They wouldn’t be sloppy.
“Next, I’ll give you a simple introduction of their basic information. Time is tight, and there’s only basic information.”
“Of course, they only have your basic information as well,” said Legend Katavi. In such an international exchange, the basic information of their group of envoys had to be given to Dong Huang. It was inevitable.
“Sequence number six, Zheng Hai. Age 29, Beast Taming level seven. His trump card is a monarch-level Giant Leviathan of an overlord race. He’s a quasi legendary Beast Tamer. He’s a disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend of Dong Huang. He’s very strong. His Beast Taming Talent is water-element strengthening… He has the battle record of defeating an ocean overlord.”
“Sequence 10, Zou Yun, age 27, Beast Tamer level 6, dark-element strengthening talent, top-notch master… He has a battle record of tying with an overlord.”
“…”
The five Ming Hua contestants had natural expressions. Fortunately, they were quasi legendary Beast Tamers. This time, Dong Huang only sent one person, and they had two!
It was unknown if Dong Huang looked down on them or if they deliberately pulled their punches a bit and planned to prioritize friendship first and competition second.
Everyone continued to listen.
Soon, they introduced the last person.
“Sequence 22, Shi Yu, age 19, Beast Tamer level five, telepathy talent, top-notch master…”
“What?” At this point, a woman in a white sari below was slightly stunned. “Teacher, what did you say? 19 years old, level five Beast Tamer, top-notch master?”
“It’s 19, not 29? It’s level five, not level six? And it’s a telepathy talent??”
The few people introduced in front were alright. As Legend Katavi introduced Shi Yu’s information, the five young people from Ming Hua were stunned.
They could barely accept a 19-year-old with a level-five Beast Taming Space. After all, this person could rely on using resources. However, was the title of top-notch master serious? Coupled with the age and talent in front, it was very unbelievable.
Telepathy, this talent could also be used to fight an overlord two levels higher? What a joke. It had to be fake. The title was fake, right? It was more like an ordinary master. The ranking… was also high.
“That’s right. However, this Beast Tamer’s name was added at the last minute. There’s relatively little other information…” Katavi looked at the five young men and said,” However, I’ve asked around. He’s very famous in Dong Huang. He just won the individual championship of the national university competition. ”
“Although he’s young, doesn’t have a battle-type talent, and doesn’t have the battle record of fighting overlord-level creatures, he’s suspected to have contracted five overlord-level pets alone!”
“Now, do you still have any questions?”
As soon as Legend Katavi finished speaking, the few people opposite him immediately opened their mouths wide in shock. What was it? Five overlord species pets??
“How is this possible!”
They looked at each other. Was this guy the descendant of a legendary Beast Tamer? Even as a group of super elites of the Ming Hua, each of them only had one or two pets of overlord races…
Five overlord races, this was something humans did???
When did overlord species pets become so common?
“I was also very surprised when I learned, but that’s the reality.” Legend Katavi sighed.
“Although it’s a telepathy talent, it’s not strange to reach this ranking with the race of his pets,” Legend Katavi said. “However, the focus you should pay attention to this time is not him, but the other Beast Tamers ranked higher.”
“Although this Shi Yu has the strongest potential among the few of them, his current strength is definitely still inferior to the others. Just pay attention and don’t let your guard down.”
“Kyro, Karen, Plash, Amir, Ayasha, do you hear me?” She looked at the five young people.
“Yes.” The few of them nodded and thought to themselves that it was scary. Dong Huang was really filled with crouching tigers and hidden dragons… Fortunately, this Shi Yu was only 19 years old and only had a telepathy talent. Otherwise, this lineup of five overlord pets was crossing the line…
....
The next day.
Hundreds of people were gathered in the Demon Capital Arena.
This exchange activity was only publicized to the public, but the process was not publicized.
This was the request of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua.
