Realizing this, the Void Mantis opened its mouth wide in extreme shock. It looked at Shi Yu in disbelief and said, “You’re a level-five Beast Tamer??”

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - Worldview Shattered (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Worldview Shattered (5)
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned. He looked at the collapsing expression of the Void Mantis and said, “It doesn’t affect me much, not much. I have a telepathy talent. In any case, I can’t contract an overlord-level pet. It’s the same at level five or six. It won’t affect my battle power.”
The Void Mantis: ???
Telepathy… telepathy talent?
“Aiyo, ow, ow, ow…”
F*ck, when the Void Mantis screamed, it also suddenly noticed that it was true. Why didn’t this challenger f*cking use his Beast Taming Talent?
In the end, it wasn’t that he had forgotten to use it, but that it was because it was a telepathy talent that didn’t increase the battle much, so it didn’t show anything special?
The values of the Void Mantis were directly impacted. It cried in pain, feeling even worse than admitting that it had lost just now.
In other words, this Iron block had forced him into a desperate situation without the support of its Beast Tamer talent?
Thinking of this, the expression of the Void Mantis darkened. Its already dark face darkened even more.
It was cultivated by the Space Emperor after the legendary level. How could it lose to the black and white bear cultivated by a level-five kid with a telepathy talent? This didn’t make sense.
“Yi! (Want to eat?)”
When the Void Mantis’s world view shattered, a fragrance and voice woke it up. It saw a ginseng baby clone holding a fruit and walking to its side, handing it the fruit and asking.
The Void Mantis looked at this guy in silence and then at Shi Yu.
Why did such a powerful Beast Tamer contract a ginseng baby?
“No.” The Void Mantis let out a cold and arrogant cry. It continued to use the void power of the ruins to repair and recover the damage on its body, making Baby Ginseng’s clone purse its lips. This guy lost to its leader.
At this moment, Shi Yu asked with a smile, “Well, the Space Beast Egg… And I heard that after defeating you, I can cultivate in the Space Emperor Ruins. Is that true…”
Shi Yu rubbed his hands in anticipation.
The Void Mantis howled and said, “I know, it’s so annoying.”
With that said, it summoned a round, white egg the size of a football with purple patterns.
“For you…”
It casually threw it into Shi Yu’s hand for him to catch. At the same time, a leather blueprint fell on the egg.
“It records the method to hatch and contract.”
Shi Yu ignored the egg and looked at the blueprint. The words on the blueprint were from the Space Emperor Era. There were only a few changes from now, so Shi Yu still recognized them.
After taking a look at the blueprint, Shi Yu was not too concerned about the contract method. However, the hatching method stunned Shi Yu.
So troublesome.
It recorded that if one wanted the star pet egg to absorb enough nutrition to hatch, they needed specific star power.
Under normal circumstances, Beast Tamers had no place to look for the power of the stars. However, the Space Emperor had sufficiently prepared something for the lucky person who beat the mantis.
Because only specific geographical locations could attract specific star power…
In four places, he established four large arrays that could attract four different types of starlight.
Beast Tamers who obtained the egg could go there and borrow the power of the ruins array formation to help the egg hatch.
If that was all, Shi Yu didn’t mind. However, when he glanced at the location of the four special ruins marked on the map, his expression immediately darkened.
This was f*cking crazy. One of the ruins was on the seven islands, the other was in Rongguang, the other was in Tingxiang, and the other was in the totem area. Emperor Kong was messing with people.
However, Shi Yu quickly understood. If it were during the Space Emperor era, this position was nothing because the Space Emperor had established the Continent Teleportation Array. It would take an instant to go anywhere on Blue Planet, but the problem was that the Teleportation Array could no longer be used now!
“Let’s go out and take a look.”
Before Shi Yu could complain too much, the Void Mantis couldn’t help but chase him away. It said, “If you want to come to the Space Emperor Ruins to cultivate, do it from tomorrow onwards. For now, you guys leave first. I want to rest. Aiyo.”
After facing challenges for several days in a row, the Void Mantis was exhausted after this battle. It suddenly wanted to sleep.
Before Shi Yu could react, he and Eleven, who was hugging Baby Ginseng in pain and joy, were teleported out of the ruins space.
....
In the outside world.
The people outside were also really bored.
The fifth in the sequence, Ji Feng, was clearly a mess at socialization. The others didn’t know how he became a spy.
At this moment, under everyone’s questions, he had no choice but to reveal the situation of his battle with the Void Mantis.
“The elemental lord’s half self-destruction can’t even work??”
“I knew it. Apart from the spatial element, it’s very difficult for other elements to hurt this guy.”
“But if it’s a spatial element, it’s undoubtedly showing off in front of an expert. There’s no solution at all.”
“Ji Feng, don’t be depressed. I understand you.” Seeing Ji Feng’s silent appearance, Heavenly King Zou was deeply touched. He also felt that that mantis was too uncomfortable.
“Don’t get close,” Ji Feng said after a moment of silence.
“I’m not depressed. After all, that’s a pet cultivated by the Space Emperor. Moreover, its strength is indeed very strong. Whether it’s me or Jiang Tianyang, whose overlord-level pet fought that Void Mantis, we might not necessarily be able to gain any advantage.”
Jiang Tianyang, fourth in the Sequence, legendary Beast Tamer. Ji Feng had once publicly challenged him, but he lost.
Everyone sighed. Yes, that Void Mantis could completely be seen as overlord-level battle power.
It had not broken through for a long time, so it was most likely holding back from breaking through. After all, the skill proficiency was extremely close to the standard.
“Unfortunately.” President Wang said regretfully, “Unfortunately, there are no Beast Tamers with ‘spatial strengthening talent’ among the top masters in our Dong Huang. Otherwise, we might be able to rely on the combination of Beast Tamers and pets and the targeted cultivation of the association to obtain the qualifications to fight that Space Mantis in the future.”

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - Worldview Shattered (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Worldview Shattered (6)
“Use the attributes the other party is good at to defeat the other party.”
Time strengthening and spatial strengthening were both top-notch talents. They were very rare and very difficult to inherit. Dong Huang didn’t have a top-notch master with this talent now, which made the association very helpless.
“Speaking of which, why isn’t Shi Yu out yet?” Heavenly King Zou suddenly looked at the crack. It had been so long.
“Is it possible that Senior Shi Yu can defeat that Void Mantis!” Fang Lan said with anticipation.
“Little kid, don’t have unrealistic fantasies.” Heavenly King Zou smiled and looked at Fang Lan. “You might as well look forward to Shi Yu’s Beauty Mantis Strategy succeeding… Using the Beauty Mantis Phantom to exchange for a pet egg.”
Fang Lan: Wu…
“Perhaps that Void Mantis is playing around again.” Ning Tianming snorted, very unhappy with the Void Mantis’s arrogant and bad taste.
“That’s true…” Everyone had clearly been teased by that Void Mantis.
Buzz!
At this moment, a spatial ripple suddenly appeared. The figure of a man and two pets appeared in the outside world.
“Sob…” At this moment, Eleven was still hugging the ginseng baby and crying in pain. The three extreme eruptions were too painful. It was simply as painful as when it received the Undying Golden Body teaching. It didn’t want the ginseng baby, it wanted the ice cleansing cloak.
Listening to Eleven’s miserable cry, the hearts of many Beast Tamers in the outside world trembled. They subconsciously had the thought that the Void Mantis was ruthless this time.
But soon, when their gazes stopped on Shi Yu, they were completely stunned.
Because at this moment, Shi Yu was holding a pet egg. On the pet egg was a piece of parchment.
Egg…
Seeing Shi Yu holding the egg, Principal Feng, President Wang, Dr. Chen, Grandma Li, Lu Qingyi, Zou Yun, Ji Feng, Ning Tianming, Tong Yan, and the others were stunned. They looked at the pet egg in a daze and couldn’t react for a moment.
The black crack passage in the sky began to close. At the same time, a familiar voice came from inside.
“The challenge has ended. The Starry Sky Pet inheritance has been sent out. The ruins for the time being… Oh my god, it hurts so much. Howl, damn it, how are your Sequence rankings even decided? It’s ranked very horribly. You’re not allowed to rank anymore next time. Close!!”
A cursing voice came from the ruins.
Then, everyone opened their mouths slightly and looked at the mature looking Shi Yu.
“As expected of a pet personally cultivated by the Space Emperor. I feel that it’s not bad compared to overlord-level creatures. If it weren’t for our skills being higher, we would be in danger.” Shi Yu sighed with lingering fear.
“If only I had a strengthening talent…”
Everyone: “?”
After the Beast Tamers present reacted, they suddenly cracked. Holy shit, wait, what did it mean? They suddenly revealed incomprehensible gazes!!! Don’t tell them that Shi Yu defeated the Void Mantis!!
The top masters in the top ten of the Sequence and a group of old seniors were all shattered by that mantis.
In the end, Shi Yu, a Sequence rank 11, defeated the Void Mantis the first time he entered?!
“Fortunately, I didn’t disappoint you.” Shi Yu patted the pet egg and revealed a gentle smile, making everyone open their mouths wide… It seemed to be true! It really arrived, making Ji Feng and the others in the crowd find it difficult to understand. They didn’t understand how that Void Mantis was defeated. When it really arrived, Heavenly King Zou, who was ranked tenth, gradually had his expression distort and collapse…

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - Fame in Dong Huang
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Fame in Dong Huang
Holy shit!
Seeing Shi Yu like this, everyone was stunned.
Shi Yu defeated the Void Mantis?!
Whether it was the pet egg in Shi Yu’s hand, the suddenly closed ruins, or the howling Void Mantis, it seemed… to prove everything.
However, everyone was still a little stunned and felt that it was unreal.
This was because before Shi Yu entered, no one expected Shi Yu to succeed in the challenge.
Zou Yun and the other Beast Tamers in the top ten of the Sequence had gone in to challenge it themselves. Be it their trump cards or main forces, they were all defeated by the Void Mantis like a joke.
Top-notch masters like Grandma Li and Dr. Chen had also entered before and were mercilessly shattered by the Void Mantis.
The president of the Kong Association had received countless famous veteran top-notch masters nationwide. In the end, without exception, they all lost.
The conclusion they came to was that the pet cultivated by the Space Emperor was invincible. Under legends and overlords, it could not be defeated.
...
If there was, it might have to be a pet cultivated by big shots of the same level, such as Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Evolution Legend, and Mechanical Legend.
Even Beast Tamers like Ji Feng and Tong Yan, who had battle records of killing overlord-level creatures, were not its match at all.
However, in reality, a Beast Tamer with only a level-five space and a telepathy talent had achieved a battle result that everyone judged to be impossible??
“How is this possible!” Everyone still subconsciously found it unbelievable.
Lu Qingyi’s expression was subtle. She had fought Shi Yu recently. She was indeed very shocked by Shi Yu’s growth speed, but in her judgment, Eleven was definitely still quite inferior to the Void Mantis.
Therefore, what kind of special training had Shi Yu and Eleven undergone this week?
Ji Feng, Tong Yan, Ning Tianming, and the others completely didn’t expect that it would actually be Sequence rank 11, who they didn’t pay attention to at the start, who defeated the Void Mantis.
Heavenly King Zou’s mentality collapsed to the extreme. Holy shit, if it was true, didn’t that mean that Shi Yu’s Sequence ranking would increase again?
Now that Shi Yu was in the eleventh place, no matter how much he rose, when the time came, the one who fell to the eleventh place would definitely be him, Zou Tianwang.
He had finally made it into the top ten, but in just a few days, he was going to fall again before his butt warmed up. Heavenly King Zou’s heart ached.
Something was wrong, something was wrong. When did Shi Yu start to counter him in every way? The two parties clearly didn’t have much interaction, so why did he make him feel uncomfortable every time?
“You, you, you, you… really?” The principal of Kong University looked at the egg in Shi Yu’s hand in a daze!!
“He really won?” Principal Feng was momentarily stunned. What, in other words, Shi Yu was stronger than Qingyi now?
“I knew it. Senior Shi Yu can definitely win,” Fang Lan said excitedly. Shi Yu was more powerful than she imagined.
“Well, we’ve tried to develop Yun An’s dark gold Demon God power these few days,” Shi Yu said. “Unfortunately, Eleven can’t perfectly control that power. Otherwise, it should be easier to win.”
Sigh, after being done with this period of time, he would quickly help Eleven find a new evolution skill and open up a new evolution path. He couldn’t waste the power of Yun An.
Continue gambling!
Crack.
Upon hearing that, everyone gritted their teeth. Apart from Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and a small number of people who could understand, the others couldn’t understand much. However, just from Shi Yu’s tone, it wasn’t human language. What did it mean that it could be won more easily? What the hell?
“This…” Principal Feng was stunned before accepting it easier.
So that was the case. The Demon God Iron-eating Beast was Emperor Wu’s trump card. Using Emperor Wu’s trump card cultivation path to defeat a secondary pet cultivated by the Space Emperor… This way, it didn’t seem impossible.
Although that was the case, it was still too ridiculous. Principal Feng looked at Eleven. This little guy was only two years old.
If Emperor Kong knew, no, Emperor Wu also knew, the two of them would cry in the toilet together, alright?
“The power of a demon god…” Lu Qingyi took a deep breath. Eleven didn’t use that power in battle with her. Now that Eleven had mastered it, in other words, in a one-on-one situation, she would no longer be a match for Shi Yu and the others?
“So, this is that cosmic pet egg?” President Kong looked at Shi Yu’s hand.
What kind of species would a white purple pattern be?
This was difficult to determine, because it was definitely not a blue planet creature.
Could he determine its attributes? It was not easy…
Shi Yu also looked down again and nodded.
It was difficult for him to judge. White-striped… starry sky… For a moment, he could only think of the Cosmic Emperor, Frieza…
“This is,” Shi Yu said.
“I’m envious.” Tong Yan looked at the egg eagerly. Apart from the cultivation opportunity in the ruins, she was here for this egg!
The Space Beast Egg sounded very powerful.
How could a pet specially left behind by the Space Emperor be bad?
It might even be a high-level overlord race, or even a Mythical race.
The others were also secretly envious. Who didn’t want such a rare thing?
“I wonder what race it will be… When can it hatch?”
Someone asked.
“This might not be easy. From what I understand, the conditions for this egg to hatch are extremely high. It requires a specific place. Without a year and a half, there should be no hope of hatching.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“Ah, I’ll talk to you later. I’m going to recover my pet first.” At this moment, in the ruins space, Susu had already made the frost cleansing suit. Next, it had to cooperate with Baby Ginseng’s treatment and recover Eleven well.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - Fame in Dong Huang (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Fame in Dong Huang (2)
Shi Yu estimated that after this battle, with the physique of the Iron-eating Beast King, Eleven’s strength would definitely increase after it healed.
“Is there anything you need?” Seeing that Eleven’s injuries were so miserable, even if Baby Ginseng continued to treat him, it was still very miserable. Principal Feng gulped and said.
“Oh?… Life supplements above level-seven, is that alright?” Shi Yu said casually. He had previously taught the Undying Golden Body and had used up all the supplements. He wanted more.
“The Kong Association has prep resources. Let’s go there and get them,” Principal Feng said bluntly.
Dong Huang and even the Kong Du Association had taken a pile of resources to conquer the Kong Emperor Ruins. Now that the exploration of the ruins was successful, these supplements would be sent back anyway. It was better to give them to Shi Yu and Eleven.
Soon, Principal Feng pulled Shi Yu and the others to run to get supplements, leaving everyone looking at the ruins in the sky in confusion and silence.
President Kong looked up at the sky. What kind of person was this…
However, the news that a Beast Tamer who was only 20 years old had defeated the legendary Beast Tamer, the Space Emperor, would probably change the entire Dong Huang.
At the same time, he looked at the silent Heavenly King Zou, Ji Feng, and the others. He also knew that the Sequence ranking was about to change.
“Ji Feng.” After a moment of silence, Lu Qingyi looked at the fifth Sequence, Ji Feng, and said, “Prepare yourself. Next, we’ll carry out the Sequence battle.”
...
....
On the other side, Shi Yu, who was going to get various supplements with Principal Feng, faced Principal Feng’s question again.
There were many people over there just now, but now, the two of them had reached the main point.
“What, you have to go to the seven islands, Rongguang, Tingxiang, and Heavenly Fox?”
When he heard Shi Yu say that he had to go to the designated Space Emperor Ruins to receive the baptism of the power of the stars, Principal Feng immediately became serious.
Shi Yu had conquered the Space Emperor Ruins. In theory, this egg belonged to Shi Yu.
However, it was simply too difficult to hatch this egg with Shi Yu’s personal strength.
“What do you plan to do?”
“I’ll hatch it myself. I originally wanted to go overseas to take a look too. Don’t worry, when the time comes, I’ll definitely bring Teacher Ying and even the Ice Dragon in Dragon Palace City. There won’t be a problem.”
“Uh.” Principal Feng couldn’t refute. Indeed, going abroad was extremely dangerous even for legendary Beast Tamers.
However, for Shi Yu, who could casually carry a totem bodyguard with him, it was no different from having a titled legend protecting him. It didn’t seem to be that dangerous. The premise was that he didn’t take the initiative to court death.
“This, this, this, this, this.” The old principal was conflicted again. Why did he still have to go overseas?
Whether it was Lu Qingyi or Shi Yu, he actually didn’t want the two of them to participate in the world competition and wander abroad.
However, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were clearly not idle. Now that there was another Starry Sky Egg that needed to be hatched at a designated location, Shi Yu had a reason to go out and play again.
“Don’t worry, it’ll be fine. I won’t run around without the ability to protect myself.”
“Moreover, before the Mechanical Conference began, I’ve already decided to cultivate in the Space Emperor Ruins and strive to break through to level six.”
“At that time, level-seven will be far in the future. It’s useless even if I stay. I might as well go train.” Shi Yu also knew that he wasn’t someone who could stay.
“Moreover, I also obtained the protective skill of the Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God. I’ll be fine.”
Upon hearing that, Principal Feng was stunned and his pupils constricted. Good lord, this guy even managed to get the Dragon God’s things.
Cozying up to a demigod? Damn! He should be the director of the first bureau!
After all, in the first bureau, no one could reach demigod level.
The Dragon God had never communicated directly with Dong Huang. Only evolution legends and mechanical legends had seen the Dragon God a few times.
“In that case… it’s indeed not that dangerous. The Heavenly Fox Nation is one of the less threatening countries in the totem country. As for the other three countries, if nothing goes wrong, the exchange team led by a Titled Legend in Dong Huang will go next. If you really want to go, you can also go with the team,” Principal Feng said.
At that time, he could still have another titled legend and a few more legends as bodyguards. It would be difficult to encounter danger.
It was not a bad idea to take advantage of the short peace between the Seven Nation Alliance and the Totem Alliance during the World Tournament to broaden his horizons.
Principal Feng sighed. Shi Yu could do whatever he wanted.
It was indeed very difficult for Beast Tamers who lacked experience to reach the legendary level.
“By the way.” Shi Yu suddenly thought of something and said, “After this, can my Sequence ranking reach the top five?”
“Didn’t they say that the top five of the Sequence Battle will obtain a legendary resource at the final settlement as a reward to assist the contestants in the world competition?”
“Speaking of which, can I borrow this reward in advance? Just treat it as an investment in advance… There’s no need to wait until the eve of the world competition…”
“Uh.” Principal Feng was stunned. There was such a thing, but what the hell was this advance payment? Moreover, he wasn’t even in the top five!
“Ji Feng can’t defeat the Void Mantis. You’ve defeated it. In theory, it’s a very good comparison, but in reality, this is still 1VS1 after all. It can’t be seen as the overall strength of the Beast Tamer. Moreover, his talent is countered by the Void Mantis. Therefore, I can’t say for sure if the Sequence Competition Committee will use this battle result as a judging standard…” Principal Feng said.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Didn’t you say that the association was prepared to take out a batch of resources to nurture an invincible monarch to challenge the Void Mantis? Now that the challenge has succeeded, this resource is saved. Why don’t you combine it with the ranking reward for the Sequence Battle and give me a legendary resource in advance?”

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - Shocking Dong Huang (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Shocking Dong Huang (3)
“If possible, I might as well announce my battle results of killing two overlords in the Chaotic Sea and count it in. I’ll directly jump to fifth place. After a period of time, I feel that I shouldn’t be afraid of other people’s challenges.”
“Good lord, you wish.” Principal Feng was stunned.
Eleven’s legendary resources, in addition to the legendary resources of the Sequence ranking, and the future Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation breaking through to overlord… Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t give up the opportunity to apply for legendary resources. Shi Yu had his eyes on the Dong Huang legendary resource bank!
“But…” Principal Feng pondered for a moment and felt that it didn’t seem impossible. He said,” I’ll fight for you. ”
“Thank you, Grandpa. I want time-element.” Shi Yu was filled with anticipation.
“Bullshit, how is that possible!!” Principal Feng was angry.
“Then wood and light elements… They’re all passable…”
He had Eleven’s legendary resources, Buggy’s, Chi Tong’s, Susu’s, and definitely Susu’s. He thought of a way from the Mechanical Conference. If the Sequence ranking could be done, he would give it to Baby Ginseng.
This way, all the legendary resources were achieved!
Next, as long as they found an opportunity to temper their will into the overlord will and pull the super skill situation to perfection, they could undergo an invincible breakthrough. They would strive to make every one of them not inferior to the Void Mantis.
At the thought of having several top-notch overlords by his side soon, Shi Yu was filled with happiness.
“Of course, if there are legendary spatial cultivation resources, the kind for Beast Tamers to use, that’s fine too…” Shi Yu added.
….
......
Shi Yu and Principal Feng calculated Dong Huang’s legendary resources.
Shi Yu also took a pile of top-notch supplements for Eleven and Baby Ginseng from the preparation area of the Space Emperor Ruins.
After that, Principal Feng suddenly realized something and said, “By the way, Qingyi seems to have made a battle appointment with Ji Feng…”
After being stunned, Shi Yu suddenly thought of this.
Immediately, the two had strange expressions.
Just now, he was still planning to apply for legendary resources in advance through Sequence rank five.
But if Lu Qingyi defeated Ji Feng, wouldn’t the fifth place be Lu Qingyi’s?
At that time, Shi Yu would not be fighting Ji Feng, but Lu Qingyi.
Shi Yu immediately had an innocent expression…
“It can’t be that scammy…”
Soon after, in the Myriad Mountain, Ji Feng and Lu Qingyi indeed started a battle.
Principal Feng and Shi Yu ran over to be spectators.
Heavenly King Zou and the others stayed behind to watch this battle.
The battle between the fifth and seventh ranks was still very attractive.
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and the entire Shi Yu team stood at the top of the mountain and quietly watched below.
Boom!!!
On Ji Feng’s side, there were six pets proficient in controlling natural power. The three overlord races and the three quasi overlord races all had the ability to injure overlords under his meteorological affinity.
With the six of them working together, forget about temporarily resisting an overlord, they could even suppress ordinary overlords.
Ji Feng indeed had the battle record of using the natural advantage to kill overlords.
Ordinary overlords referred to ordinary overlord-level creatures with about 50 million energy points, low levels of natural power cultivation, and transcendent racial skills that didn’t exceed perfect proficiency. For example, the Snake Lord and Earth Demon Ape Shi Yu encountered were all like this.
Invincible overlords like the Dragon Palace City’s Sky Penetrating Whale, a famous top-notch overlord in the East Sea overlord circle, and the Tyrant Sea Legend’s mutated Leviathan that could fight against totems naturally weren’t included.
On Lu Qingyi’s side, there were five. Wind Demon Lion, Green Phoenix Bird, Imperial Concubine Flower, Mermaid Princess, and Hurricane Demon who had mastered the perfect-level teaching skill “Mythical Revival”. Each of them didn’t have high basic energy, but through the Mythical Revival skill, they could reach more than 20 million energy points, equivalent to half an overlord.
In addition, although Lu Qingyi’s new contracted Courtyard Sprite didn’t have a Mythical Revival, it had absorbed half of the legendary undead resources of Ancient Capital University. Its strength wasn’t much inferior to the other few. Under the possession of its natural spirit, the other few pets’ already very strong strength increased again.
After the Wind Demon Lion and the Green Spirit Wind Bird were cultivated and evolved by Lu Qingyi, her lineup was also three overlord races, three quasi overlord races.
It could be said that apart from the four who had already become legends, the two of them almost represented the strongest battle power of the younger generation of Dong Huang. They were the pillars of Dong Huang’s legendary battle power in the next few decades.
The peak battle between the two directly made the gazes of Zou Yun and the others solemn to the extreme, feeling the difference.
“Wuu.” “Wuu.” “Yi.” “Mi.” “Ning.” “So impressive…” Shi Yu and the others were also in deep thought.
If it was a team battle, these two people were indeed very scary.
“It’s not a big problem.” Shi Yu took a deep breath. Apart from Eleven, it was indeed not easy for his other pets to deal with the other main forces of the other party alone. However, due to the existence of the Time Fruit and Eleven’s current overwhelming strength, it was not impossible to win a team battle. It was just very difficult, but this situation wouldn’t be long.
Next, when he broke through to level six and Eleven and the others’ super skill proficiency increased, he would really be invincible below the legendary level.
Before that, for the sake of legendary resources, he would take a seat at fifth place first…
…
The next day.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - Shocking Dong Huang (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Shocking Dong Huang (4)
The three trending topics regarding the Sequence Battle competition shook the entire Dong Huang.
First, Zou Tianwang, who was ranked tenth in the Sequence, fell to eleven.
As expected of a celeb. Zou Yun wasn’t the only one who fell in the rankings today, but he was the only one who was singled out.
Around this topic, countless Internet battles began.
Heavenly King Zou reluctantly accepted all the attention.
Second, Sequence 7 Lu Qingyi vs Sequence 5 Ji Feng.
With the victory of the genius archeologist, the vice president of the archeological Association, Lu Qingyi, this peak battle that happened at the Myriad Mountain in Kong ended.
The results of this battle were announced, and Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain trembled.
Countless female Beast Tamers were extremely excited, because this way, there would be two women in the top five of the Sequence.
Apart from Lu Qingyi, in the top five of the Sequence, there was also a female legendary Beast Tamer, Divine Bell, who was ranked second. She was a descendant of a mechanical legend, but this divine bell was extremely mysterious. It was said that as a descendant of a mechanical legend, she wasn’t a Mechanic. The outside world knew very little about her.
Therefore, Lu Qingyi defeated Ji Feng, and it was a revenge battle with her telepathy talent that defeated a top-notch battle talent. In addition, Lu Qingyi’s looks were quite high, instantly making Lu Qingyi the idol of many female Beast Tamers and a national goddess.
However, Lu Qingyi, who was fifth in the Sequence, didn’t stay for more than a few minutes. Then, more shocking news about Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain appeared.
The national champion, Shi Yu, who was originally Sequence 11 and had already advanced to the top of the Sequence at an astonishing speed, instantly replaced Lu Qingyi as Sequence 5, shocking the entire Dong Huang.
......
“How is this possible? That Shi Yu…”
Everyone in Dong Huang was shocked.
At the venue of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment.
After the final battle ended, after the shocking dark horse from Wu Ling City, An Chang, won the championship, what exploded everyone was not the announcement of the champion, but the top of a trending news.
“Genius archeologist, national champion Shi Yu cracked the Space Emperor Ruins and defeated one of the Space Emperor’s secondary pets!”
“The Kong Capital descended and was established in the Space Emperor Ruins hundreds of years ago. The guardian is a secondary pet cultivated by the legendary Beast Tamer, the Space Emperor. It’s said to be an invincible monarch-level Void Mantis. In just a week, dozens of veteran top-notch masters challenged. Ji Feng, Lu Qingyi, Zou Yun, Ning Tianming, and Tong Yan in the top ten also challenged one after another, but they were all defeated.”
“Until Sequence 11 Shi Yu challenged the ruins and successfully defeated the Void Mantis, only then was the Space Emperor Ruins was cracked.”
There was more detailed content in the report.
Countless Beast Tamers’ jaws fell.
At the scene of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment, An Chang browsed the news in shock. The little bit of pride he had just obtained as a professional top scholar immediately disappeared.
“A battle that crossed time? Shi Yu vs Emperor Kong? This kid actually f*cking did this?!”
Master Qu Jie, who was about to be promoted, widened his eyes. He couldn’t understand the speed at which Shi Yu became stronger. He looked at An Chang below. After all, a year ago, Shi Yu was just standing there. He was a newbie who had just stepped into the professional field.
The announcement of this news made Shi Yu’s fifth place in the Sequence become true to its name.
After all, he had defeated the Space Emperor’s pet. Although it was only a secondary pet left behind to protect the ruins, that was also cultivated by a legendary Beast Tamer. Moreover, the battle results of this pet were incomparable. From the veteran top-notch Beast Tamer of Dong Huang to the young Lu Qingyi and Ji Feng in the top ten of the Sequence, no one could defeat it.
In this situation, it was actually the ruins Shi Yu cleared?
If the concept of the Space Emperor’s secondary pet was too far away from people, then another trending topic made everyone numb.
In a private mechanical research institute in the capital.
Gao Xuan, who was preparing for the Mechanical Conference and was currently ranked in the top 20, widened his eyes and looked at the trending topic in front of him.
“The battle results of Sequence five Shi Yu are announced. Three months ago, he assassinated two overlords and retreated unscathed!”
A master with a level-five space and a telepathy talent had killed an overlord at a higher level. As soon as this battle result was announced, Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain erupted again.
Holy shit.
Even some new legends rarely had such battle results. Although it was an assassination and not a frontal attack, it had to be known that Shi Yu was only 20 years old and a level-five Beast Tamer.
In various places in the country, others were shocked as well, such as Legend Xia, Xia Qingwei’s father, Legend Xia, and Yin Zhengfan’s father, Legend Yin. These legends with overlord battle power and legends who were more familiar with Shi Yu were shocked to the extreme when they saw Shi Yu’s battle results.
Initially, many people were a little stunned by Shi Yu’s sudden increase to fifth place in the Sequence. But at this moment, not only did they not recover from the shock, they were even more stunned. They were stunned from many angles.
“Three months ago, at that time… Didn’t the National League not begin yet?” Gao Xuan was extremely shocked. He actually had the ability to kill overlords, but that was with the help of a forbidden weapon, not his own strength. However, Shi Yu actually had the ability to assassinate overlords before defeating him? How exactly did he do it…
Ping Cheng.
Inside the Bamboo Stone Dojo…
Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu, Hall Master Lin Hongnian, President Feng, White Brook, and the other members of the Bai family who had come to Ping Cheng to discuss the Iron-eating Beast Corps watched the news and looked at each other in the conference room.
“That guy is even more powerful than Senior Lu?” White Brook was stunned.
“Well…” Lin Xiuzhu suddenly felt that the property price of Dong Huang might not even increase as quickly as the iron-eating beast.
Demon Capital.
Half a month after the Ming Hua exchange team arrived at Dong Huang, they had already planned to leave.
Be it Ming Hua’s legend or the young world competition contestants, they also noticed the change in the sequence ranking and cursed.
What were they doing earlier? They should have updated this monster’s ranking long ago. He killed the overlord three months ago, but in the end, it was more than 20th place? What a joke. The update was too slow. Wasn’t this a scam!
Sequence rank five…
On this day, Shi Yu obtained a title because of his valiant battle results and shocking advancement speed.
Although it wasn’t officially recognized and was only publicized on the Internet, its spread was not inferior to Zou Yun’s reputation as a heavenly king.
[Shi Yu, the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang.]
This time, with Shi Yu’s many battle results, his name could be said to be known to everyone in the Beast Taming Domain.
At the same time, Kong, Myriad Mountain.
After resting for a day, Shi Yu looked at the reopened Space Emperor Ruins.
As the ruins opened, he entered directly.
Inside, the Void Mantis yawned.
In the ruins, the Void Mantis and Shi Yu stared at each other.
“Hehe.” Shi Yu chuckled.
The Void Mantis: “Huh???”
“Senior.”
“This ruin… Can I call a few more people in to cultivate together?”
The Void Mantis was stunned and snorted. “You’re really greedy, but up to you. This ruin was specially modified by Master. It’s very suitable for meditation, but as the number of people increases, the efficiency of meditation will be divided equally. The apple is only that big. If two people eat it, it’ll be half for each person. If you don’t mind, I don’t mind.”
“Ah, this… Forget it then.” Shi Yu had a headache.
“Then, Senior, what are your plans next? Are you still in the ruins or do you plan to go out and take a look? Why don’t I watch the ruins for you? Don’t worry, I definitely won’t break it,” Shi Yu said seriously.
“Huh??” The Void Mantis suspected that this guy was thinking about its ruins.
“I want to break through to the overlord level here first. If I don’t suppress my level, it’s just a matter of practicing my skills again. At that time, I’ll leave. But even if I leave, I still have to take the ruins with me. Don’t even think about it.” The Void Mantis snorted. “In other words, you can only meditate here only when I’m still cultivating here before I break through to the overlord level.”
“This is because you’ve inherited your master’s pet egg.”
“That’s not bad either!” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. “Senior, how about letting my pet be your skill sparring partner? This way, the skill proficiency might increase faster. They’re all pretty strong.”
Sigh, he would be meditating for the next period of time. Since he was free, why not let this ridiculously strong Void Mantis be Eleven and the others’ sparring partner? Then, he could find an opportunity to touch a few spatial skills…

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - Breaking Through to Level (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Breaking Through to Level (1)
“Training partner?”
At this moment, when it heard Shi Yu say that he wanted its pet to be its sparring partner, the Void Mantis was stunned for a moment before revealing an “you’re very smart” expression.
“It’s not impossible.”
Training the proficiency of super skills in battle was indeed faster than thinking about it himself.
“Right?” Shi Yu smiled warmly.
Training partners were good.
Shi Yu judged that apart from Eleven, the other pets in the team couldn’t defeat this Void Mantis.
Even if Eleven fought again, the chances of defeating this Void Mantis were not high.
After all, the other party already knew Eleven’s battle style. Moreover, Shi Yu couldn’t let Eleven use the power of the Demon God anymore.
The flexibility of this Void Mantis far exceeded any pet of Shi Yu. It was impossible to counter.
...
Therefore, with such an invincible pet of the same level as a sparring partner for Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu, one could imagine how much their battle experience would increase after a period of time.
In short, as long as they finished eating this Void Mantis, Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t be afraid of similar spatial enemies in the future.
“Well, I’ll open an independent cultivation space for you first.”
After the Void Mantis nodded, it directly waved at the air, and a spatial door appeared.
The Space Emperor Ruins was empty, like an empty starry sky.
Whether it was here or the cultivation room reopened by the Void Mantis for Shi Yu, it was all the same.
“Well…” Seeing this, Shi Yu interrupted and said,” Senior, can I move in some things, such as flowers and plants? I’ll build a house and get some beds and chairs. ”
How could he cultivate in this empty space? Even if the cultivation efficiency was high, the environment was too poor.
If he didn’t let Baby Ginseng create some plants that emitted a sweet aura, didn’t let Susu create a cleansing stream, and didn’t let Buggy show some soft beds, Shi Yu really suspected that he couldn’t stay here. This was no different from being locked in a small black room.
“Up to you. Humans are so troublesome,” the Void Mantis muttered.
Unlike it, which felt that this place was pretty good. The void energy that filled the space could be eaten, drunk, or used in battle. The darkness also made it very comfortable.
Even the nutritional fruits handed over by Baby Ginseng were inferior to the void power here in the eyes of the Void Mantis.
After all, it was the pet of the Space Emperor. It had seen the world and was more stable than some overlords and totems.
“Then I’ll go fix it first.” Shi Yu said with an excited heart and trembling hands.
Union calendar, year 179, January 10.
After Shi Yu ascended to fifth place in the Sequence and was known as the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, he had already planned to settle down in the Myriad Mountain in Kong.
The Space Emperor Ruins was indeed not bad.
Shi Yu meditated here for a moment and felt that it was several times more efficient than meditating in his ruins space.
This ruins space wasn’t modified with any Beast Taming Space.
According to the Void Mantis, it was purely an alternate space created by the Space Emperor with a transcendent spatial skill after using its talent to strengthen its top-notch totem battle pet.
Then, after a long time of modification, it became a special space suitable for spatial cultivation.
Not only was this place suitable for human Beast Tamers to cultivate, but it was also suitable for spatial pets to cultivate. It was a reward from the Space Emperor to the Void Mantis.
It could also be said to be a salary for the Void Mantis.
Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh. Such a space wasn’t inferior to legendary spatial resources. Its value even exceeded it.
Emperor Kong had casually given it to a secondary pet. If the current netizens knew, they would definitely spam comments like ‘I want to be Emperor Kong’s pet'”…
Shi Yu had never felt that his cultivation speed was this fast in the already modified personal cultivation venue.
In addition, he still had a cultivation resource, the Space Crystal…
Shi Yu judged that he had a high chance of cultivating to level six before the Mechanical Conference.
His heart was excited again, and his hands were trembling.
The increase in the level of the Beast Tamer was the most exciting moment for every Beast Tamer.
Apart from affecting the number and strength of the contracted pets, it also affected the Beast Tamer’s physique, lifespan, and Beast Taming Talent.
It could be said that in the hands of a level-six strengthening-type Beast Tamer, even a commander-level pet could defeat wild monarch-level ferocious beasts.
Although Shi Yu had the gift of telepathy and the upgrade of the Beast Taming Talent, which at most made the distance of the telepathy increase, the increase in the number of targets of telepathy at the same time did not increase his battle strength much.
However, Shi Yu wasn’t looking forward to this in the first place. He was looking forward to his physique breaking through the upper limit. At that time, he could add points to super skills more happily. At the same time, by adding points, his physique could also reach a new limit.
At that time, the effect of Chi Tong possessing his full-body fusion strategy would also be stronger. Now, they could all use a sword that threatened ordinary overlords. When he broke through, the sword that was full-body fusion might even make a top-notch overlord like the Sky Penetrating Whale afraid.
Most importantly, Shi Yu had two talents. Although Shi Yu had the experience of his predecessors and knew what the changes in every level of telepathy were, he didn’t know the changes in the skill index.
Shi Yu realized that when his Beast Taming level increased, the skill index would also increase like other Beast Taming Talents.
For example, when he broke through to level four, the skill index unlocked the general teaching method of low-level skills. When he broke through to level five, the Beast Taming index unlocked the teaching of super skills and the risk reminder of teaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - Breaking Through to Level 6 (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Breaking Through to Level 6 (2)
Then, what would happen to the skill index when he reached level six?
With a bunch of anticipation, even Shi Yu, who couldn’t stay still, decided to forcefully stay in for another two months and break through to the next level.
…
Shi Yu started cultivating.
Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and Susu were also occasionally released by Shi Yu.
As for Ling, it still had to continue preparing for the Mechanical Conference.
At this moment, the Void Mantis also saw the pile of sparring partners Shi Yu mentioned.
Apart from Eleven, Buggy and the others fought the Void Mantis one by one.
In the end, it was very tragic.
If all of them lost, there was no need to think about Susu. It belonged to the side that was insta-killed in one move. Even if it converted the time power stored in the Infinite Devouring Space, it was still not a match for the agile Void Mantis.
Chi Tong could fight the Void Mantis for a while with all its might, but the strongest speed in the team that Chi Tong was proud of had no advantage against the Void Mantis at all. It was quickly defeated.
...
Baby Ginseng was even worse. Its speed was too slow and its defense was too weak. The Void Mantis countered Baby Ginseng even more than Eleven. If Baby Ginseng was given a time mark, it was confident that it could shatter the Void Mantis like Eleven under the restriction of the venue.
Unfortunately, there were no time marks for it to use.
Therefore, like Susu, it would be quickly shattered. Even if it used the Time Fruit and temporarily stepped into the overlord level, its speed and defense were still suppressed by the Void Mantis. Only its destructive power could win, but the problem was that its Anti-Buggy Energy Fruit was not very effective against the Void Mantis at all.
Another reason was that there was no ground in this ruin at all. There was void power everywhere. It was considered the home ground of the Void Mantis, so it restricted Baby Ginseng’s Earth Escape. Otherwise, both parties might be able to fight longer.
In terms of Buggy, it also didn’t gain any benefits. Its Imagination Domain was directly covered by the Demonic Domain. The illusions it imagined, such as the Dragon of Imagination’s body, could directly be cleverly broken down under the near perfect-level spatial control of the Void Mantis. There was no other way. It was a skill counter.
After they finished fighting the Void Mantis, Buggy and the others understood how powerful the opponent Eleven defeated was. Only then did they understand how strong the current leader had become.
However, the Void Mantis also gave Buggy and the others affirmation. In terms of individual strength, although Shi Yu’s other pets were inferior to it, among the opponents it had encountered in the past few days, their strength could also be ranked at the top.
Shi Yu was a level-five Beast Tamer. To be able to contract so many strong pets, the Void Mantis felt that it was ridiculous. It felt that the princes and princesses of the Space Emperor were trash in front of Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was happy to see this situation.
He was just worried that there was nothing for his pets to do… But the Void Mantis, this excellent sparring partner, appeared.
It didn’t matter if they couldn’t defeat them now. After all, Eleven and the others’ basic energy levels were inferior to the other party, and their skill proficiency was inferior to the other party. It would be strange if they could defeat it.
Even Eleven barely won with extremely outstanding accompanying moves and attributes.
At this moment, the situation of the Void Mantis could be roughly seen:
[Race Skill]:
Super level: Space Control (Expert+11), Demonic Domain (Expert+11), Space Slash (Expert+11)…
As for Eleven and the others, their super skills were all entry-level and proficient. The highest was only at expert level. It was normal that they couldn’t defeat it.
But it was precisely this kind of opponent he couldn’t defeat that could better train some of the abilities of these pets.
For example, teamwork.
If Susu couldn’t defeat it alone, Chi Tong would possess Susu and fight it together.
If Buggy couldn’t defeat it alone, Buggy and Baby Ginseng would fight together.
Or the four of them together. This way, the Void Mantis would feel more pressure to train its skills better…
“Wuu… (You guys have no honor!)” The Void Mantis was exasperated.
…
Unlike the situation of being completely locked in a small black room in the ruins of Emperor Wu, Shi Yu could still go out to take a breather while cultivating in the Space Emperor Ruins.
However, generally speaking, there were only a few things for him to do when he went out for a breather.
From the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University, he took mechanical materials for Ling to experiment with. From Grandma Li, he took various different ancient fossils for Ling to experiment with.
Apart from that, he often bought some food and nutritional supplements for Eleven and the others. Of course, it was also for himself to eat.
Of course, the most satisfying thing Shi Yu experienced during the process of constantly coming out was still Eleven’s legendary resources being approved.
This was a legendary resource that Shi Yu had applied for after becoming a member of the first bureau and helping the gem cat break through to the totem level.
Back then, Shi Yu’s request was that it was best if metal-element strengthening legendary resources could increase the pet’s life force and energy value.
He had planned to use it as a reward for Eleven’s first place in the team competition. Now, it had finally arrived.
“This is Aurora Magnetic Gold.” Principal Feng handed the sealed level-nine legendary metal resource to Shi Yu and said.
“Aurora Magnetic Gold?” Shi Yu said. “It sounds like metal and lightning?”
“Yes, I couldn’t find the legendary resources to strengthen life and energy with pure gold. However, I found this. If it’s for the Iron-eating Beast, this metal might be more suitable for your Eleven.”
“The Aurora Magnetic Gold is a metal that contains strong lightning power born from the combination of the solar wind and the blue planet’s magnetic field.”

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - Breaking Through to Level 6 (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Breaking Through to Level 6 (3)
“Its effect is to allow the metal-element or thunder-element pets it carries to be affected by a special magnetic field to strengthen their physiques. It’s similar to lightning tempering. When their physiques increase, it naturally increases their vitality and energy value. It can be considered to have satisfied your requirements.”
When Shi Yu heard that, he smiled bitterly.
“From the looks of it, you’re not very satisfied??” Principal Feng was stunned.
“Not really,” Shi Yu said. “This… is very good.”
Eleven’s physique was already strong enough, so his idea was to find a metal-element legendary resource that specialized in strengthening vitality and energy value to increase Eleven’s shortcomings. This way, the strengthening effect would be more obvious. In the end, this other one was another one that strengthened the physique…
The increase in physique would indeed lead to an increase in vitality and energy, but in comparison, the effect was definitely not as good as a single strengthening. However, when Shi Yu heard that, he felt that it was not bad. After all, if one could increase physique, life force, and energy, it was indeed more precious than a legendary resource that increased life and energy alone.
The association didn’t deceive him. They specially found the most suitable and rare resources for him.
Sigh… It looked like Eleven was going to continue strengthening its physique. It was already strong enough… If it used legendary resources to strengthen it again, when it broke through to the overlord level, would it be able to tear apart ferocious beasts of the same level without using skills?
“This is not bad.” Principal Feng chuckled and said, “Back then, not only was there one piece of Aurora Magnetic Gold, but eight. This is only one piece obtained by Dong Huang. Other factions have also obtained Aurora Magnetic Gold. Among them, some lucky pets even awakened new skills after using Aurora Magnetic Gold.”
“This is considered a legendary resource that has been studied more thoroughly. The cost-effective ratio is extremely high.”
“What skill?” Shi Yu asked curiously.
...
“Super thunder skill, special lightning, White Thunder.”
“Uh.” Shi Yu felt that this skill was a little familiar.
Back then, wasn’t the Rongguang kid who came to Ancient Capital University a user of the White Thunder Talent?
“Haha, of course, it’s just a casual mention. Your Eleven doesn’t have much affinity with the light element. Instead, it has affinity with the dark element. The chances of awakening the white lightning aren’t high.”
White lightning had the nature of inclusion, affinity, and compatibility with the light element… It could be said to be light lightning, and with Eleven, it made sense if it mastered dark lightning.
However, it didn’t matter to Shi Yu. It didn’t matter if it didn’t awaken nor if it awakened, he could make do with it. He could do anything.
“I understand,” Shi Yu said. “Then this one.”
The corners of Principal Feng’s mouth twitched. What did he mean by that? He made it sound a little unwilling. Damn it.
Old Feng even felt that he had never touched more legendary resources than Shi Yu in his life.
“By the way, Principal Feng, the Sequence ranking and the legendary resources of the Space Emperor Ruins… Can I apply for them?” Shi Yu still couldn’t forget the legendary resources of the ginseng baby.
“What do you think?” The corners of Principal Feng’s mouth continued to twitch. “Cough, cough, you have to let the association calm down. It’s just for Baby Ginseng, right? I’ll remember.”
“Don’t worry. In the next year, Dong Huang will start trade with various countries. At that time, it will use legendary resources that we don’t need to exchange for legendary resources that we can use. At that time, the selection will be more rich.”
“I understand, thank you.” Shi Yu laughed.
“Stop showing off… Hurry up and cultivate. Don’t waste time!”
....
After Principal Feng left, Shi Yu entered the Space Emperor Ruins to cultivate immediately.
Although the Aurora Magnetic Gold was a legendary resource promised to Eleven, Shi Yu still didn’t give it to it immediately.
Just like how the bone sword and the Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball weren’t given to Chi Tong and Buggy.
It wasn’t that he wanted Eleven to take first place in the team again, but now that it was used on Eleven, with the suppression of his taming space, using it would waste most of the effect. This was still alright. If there was a mistake and Eleven accidentally broke through, it would turn into Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space collapsing and the Beast Tamer would become a cripple.
Lu Qingyi dared to let the Courtyard Sprite use it because Senior Lu’s spatial level was one level higher than Shi Yu’s. Moreover, the foundation of the Courtyard Sprite was much worse than Eleven’s. It was still very far from the overlord level, but with Eleven’s current foundation, even if its super racial skill proficiency didn’t meet the standard, it wasn’t much different from the overlord level standard.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s plan was to give it to Eleven after he broke through to level six.
At that time, it didn’t matter even if Eleven broke through to the overlord level.
Generally speaking, only the physiques of level-seven Beast Tamers could withstand contracting overlord-level pets.
However, Shi Yu was a special case. There was a precedent of a contract above his level.
In terms of physique, he had reached the limit of every level. Other Beast Tamers couldn’t compare.
In terms of recovery power, he had contracted a quasi-mythical ginseng baby, so it was also something other Beast Tamers couldn’t compare to. A contract above his level wouldn’t be too weak.
In terms of spatial stability, every level of space Shi Yu had previously was a perfect space. It had both area, strength, and environment. Its foundation was very good.
Apart from that, he also contracted a spatial worm. Contracting a spatial pet could also increase the stability of the Beast Taming Space.
If it were more ruthless, Chi Tong’s full-level possession could even change Shi Yu into a hybrid. However, Shi Yu didn’t have this thought for the time being.
Overall, it was indeed not impossible for Shi Yu to skip levels and contract.
Ordinary level-four Beast Tamers could only contract commander-level pets, but when he was level-three, he contracted a quasi overlord race, the commander-level Nine Li Battle Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - Breaking Through to Level 6 (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: Breaking Through to Level 6 (4)
Therefore, Shi Yu sometimes wondered if he could try contracting a higher level this time!
It was said that the difficulty of breaking through from level six to level seven was ten times that of level five to six. Under normal circumstances, even if there was an opportunity like the Space Emperor Ruins, Shi Yu probably wouldn’t be able to reach level seven in a few years.
However, if pets could exceed the spatial level and reach the overlord level in advance, what was the difference between him and a legendary Beast Tamer?
Although at that time, the pet could break free of the contract with a thought and counterattack the Beast Tamer, Shi Yu believed that Eleven and the others wouldn’t do that. If they had this thought, Eleven and the others would have broken free the first time he crossed levels to contract.
Now, with a level-five space and a level-five physique, Shi Yu didn’t dare to let his pets break through to overlord with legendary resources. However, with a level-six space and a peak level-six physique, he could completely give it a try. He could nurture a certain pet to overlord level first.
It was too slow to wait for the level of the Beast Taming Space.
At that time, he would let Ling use its top-notch intelligence to analyze the success rate. As long as it was feasible, he would give it a try.
This cross-level contract was definitely more difficult than the previous one. However, for the sake of the World Tree’s Blessing, he would give it his all. As long as he didn’t die, it didn’t matter if he was a little weak every day.
As long as he obtained the Blessing of the World Tree, there was hope for him to reach the titled legend level in three years, let alone the legendary level. At that time, he could go anywhere in the world. It would be exciting.
.
With this determined thought, Shi Yu entered the crazy cultivation stage again…
…
...
In the blink of an eye.
A month and a half later.
The color of Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space Crystal Wall completely turned purple.
Colorless, gray, white, green, blue, purple… The purple crystal wall and summoning array corresponded to the sixth level of the Beast Tamer.
At this level, the relatively lousy Beast Tamers were still ordinary masters, but the more powerful ones could already be called top-notch Beast Tamers with the help of their Beast Taming Talent.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t care about this at all because he had already obtained a top-notch Beast Tamer license in the level-five space.
“Hu…” In the Space Emperor Ruins, Shi Yu sighed.
Under the multiple buffs of the meditation technique of the ruins, the cultivation ruins of the Space Emperor, the meditation incense plant, the Lake of Purification, the Space Crystal, the super physique, and all the pets breaking through to the monarch level, he finally became a level-six Beast Tamer.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s physical strength, mental strength, and soul strength suddenly increased. His powerful physique made Shi Yu, who had exhaled, feel a little smug.
“What strong strength…” Shi Yu clenched his fist and casually shook it. With a boom, the air suddenly rumbled, and the sound was like a thunderclap. An air cannon instantly uprooted the surrounding plants and raised dust.
“Damn, am I still human?”
Shi Yu was shocked and felt more and more that he wasn’t human.
This… he could already casually wave out the Air Cannon?
Race, Shi Yu Beast, low-level wind-element skill, Wind Fist!
Shi Yu clenched his fist and fell into deep thought. This was the benefit of breaking through to the limit every time.
He felt that after he reached the limit of this physique again, he might be able to fight Senior White Brook in the fusion state without any buffs!
It was too sick, too sick. When he reached his current limit again, Chi Tong would possess him. Pushing himself to the limit, he might be able to fight ordinary overlords.
The World Tournament was only so-so!
At the same time, in the ruins space of the Space Emperor Ruins, Eleven and the others also sensed the Beast Tamer’s breakthrough and shouted to come out.
Shi Yu smiled and summoned them. In the past month and a half, he had not cared much about the points added by his pets. They had all trained themselves. Their daily routine was to fight the Void Mantis and accompany Ling to study it. However, next, it was firstly to increase their physique and secondly to strengthen their pets. It seemed like he could add a new round of points…
With the additional points of super skills, he shouldn’t be as miserable as before, right?
However, it was better to go out and buy some supplements later. It was alright to teach Susu, but Shi Yu was really afraid that he still couldn’t withstand teaching other pets with mid-level willpower. After all, the lower the willpower, the greater the consumption.
“Wu!!” “Wu!!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!” “Alright!”
Something strange mixed in the cries of the six pets. Eleven and the others looked at Shi Yu in excitement and surprise.
He broke through!
Shi Yu, increase points!
As for Shi Yu, he was suddenly stunned after smiling again.
“Holy shit.”
His heart trembled. He looked at the skill index in his mind and suddenly discovered an extremely unbelievable update.
Apart from the increase in the basic page count, the skill index had indeed undergone another huge change!
In terms of page count, Shi Yu had basically ignored it. This was because low-level skills could be deleted after being maxed out. With not many super skills, he could no longer use up the page count.
Therefore, other updates had completely become Shi Yu’s anticipation.
The last time Shi Yu broke through, the skill index had updated the common teaching methods for low, intermediate, and high-level skills.
And this time, what was updated was the general teaching method of super skills!
Skill: Undying Golden Body
Skill Level: Super
< Introduction >…
[Status]:…
[General Teaching Method]: With the help of Earth Fire, combine the Undying God Metal, Life Stone Powder, metal-element overlord dragon blood essence, and metal-element overlord phoenix blood essence into one thing and eat it. There is a chance of awakening the Undying Golden Body skill. The awakening probability depends on the compatibility of the pet talent, pet race, and pet with this skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - Breaking Through to Level 6 (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 516: Breaking Through to Level 6 (5)
Shi Yu took a look and was first excited. Then, his expression darkened.
Son of a b*tch.
It was better to update a high-speed skill proficiency method.
A long time ago, Shi Yu had felt that the general teaching method of the skill index update was useless.
This was because many resources were things Shi Yu had never heard of.
What was the Undying God Metal? What was the Life Stone?
BUG skills like the Memory Water Bead and the Time Fruit also had universal teaching methods. For example, the universal teaching method of the Memory Water Bead was to let the pet absorb the Time Water Bead.
Shi Yu directly ignored it because he had never even heard of the Time Dew. The top-notch Feeding index of the third bureau didn’t have such a thing recorded either. There wasn’t even anything similar. The teaching materials made him feel lonely.
And the Undying God Metal and Life Stone were clearly the same.
Only those more common skills, such as deterrence, high-speed healing, and absolute sleep, could he understand.
However, Shi Yu quickly ignored this.
...
This was because the other function of the skill index update made Shi Yu even more excited.
On the last page of the skill index, a huge black and white vortex furnace image appeared.
[Technique Fusion] (Unlocked)
< Introduction > It can fuse two or more skills that have reached perfect proficiency into new skills. The higher the skill proficiency, the higher the compatibility between the skills, and the higher the success rate of fusion. The success rate of fusion will also depend on the physique of the Beast Tamer and the will of the pet.
Shi Yu: !!!
At first glance, Shi Yu thought that it was an ability to help develop the profundities of the combination skill, but suddenly, he discovered that something was wrong. This was not a combination, but… fusion!!
It completely fused two different skills into a new skill!
This ability was clearly obtained after the biological totem level.
Totem-level creatures had the ability to develop new skills themselves, develop new racial skills, and tailor-make racial skills for their descendants. They had the ability to optimize skills and races.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect the skill index to be updated in advance.
What did this mean?
Shi Yu knew it too well.
Firstly, it could fuse skills with extremely low upper limits into stronger skills.
For example, Reinforced Iron Bones+Tempered Iron+Overlord Body Armor+High Speed Healing+Super Sight+Absolute Sleep+Multiplication might fuse into a super physique skill comparable to a divine skill. At that time, it could continue to increase points to transcendent or Dao Proficiency.
Apart from that, if two super skills could be fused into one, did that mean that adding points saved half the effort?
At the same time, this was equivalent to walking his own path.
Back then, Zhong Xuan had said that maxing out super racial skills was not the premise of advancing to the Mythical stage. The premise of advancing to the Mythical stage was to combine races and develop exclusive divine skills that belonged to oneself and were suitable for their own race. Through this skill fusion, perhaps it could help pets develop more efficiently?
“We are invincible now, really invincible…”
“I’ll fuse a bunch of low-level skills that have been maxed out and become a stronger super skill. Then, I’ll max out… The Dragon God and Yun An will cry when they see this.”
“Wait, why is it locked??? Damn it, what do you mean!!!”
—-

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - Invincible Below Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Invincible Below Overlord (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After being immersed in the changes in the skill index for a moment, Shi Yu was awakened by the pets in front of him.
“Master, Master…!”
The Rubik’s Cube, Ling, flew at the front. In the green Rubik’s Cube, the white-haired loli had a serious expression. She was very unhappy with Shi Yu for always being distracted.
Generally speaking, this was a sign of mental weakness…
Fatigue and excessive pressure might be the cause. It was very dangerous.
He still wanted to contract an overlord-level pet in advance?
It was very worried about its Mechanic’s life.
“Wu.”
Shi Yu shook his head.
For example, Shi Yu couldn’t understand the teaching content of relatively top-notch super skills. He was very confused.
For example, if one wanted to learn the Spirit Release, they first needed their pet to commit suicide and undergo undead reincarnation?
...
Suicide in order to learn skills… This was only one step. Only ghosts would learn it!
In short, some of the more unorthodox super skills were not very reliable.
It was fine to directly replicate these skills and teach them, but using normal methods to teach them was not something humans could do.
However, Shi Yu could understand teaching methods like plant control, wind element control, water element control, and wave cannon, which were relatively common super skills.
But the problem was that there was no need for the skill index to teach such a skill…
His third index also recorded dozens of common super skills… including these skills.
There were thousands of low-level skill teaching methods recorded in the third bureau’s index, so Shi Yu said that the skill index was useless.
Forget it, forget it.
Shi Yu sighed. There would always be a need in the future.
What if he found those rare materials that he had never heard of from some ruins?
As for the skill fusion, although Shi Yu was envious, it was messing with his mentality as it was locked.
Just like the super skill back then, it would show it to him but wasn’t teachable.
So, did his Beast Taming level not meet the standard, or did his physical fitness not meet the standard?
Well… there seemed to be no difference. The two were closely related.
However, Shi Yu hoped that it was just that his Beast Taming level didn’t meet the standard, not his physical fitness.
He didn’t want to experience the pain of his physical fitness and life being drained again on other functions.
“Yes.” After waking up, Shi Yu looked at the pets with a smile.
At this moment, apart from Ling with a helpless expression, Eleven and the others were used to it. They were only filled with excitement and anticipation.
Because Shi Yu had already nagged at these pets many times.
When he broke through to level six, he could easily add some super skills.
“Contract Ling first.”
Shi Yu said calmly and looked at the white-haired loli in the Cube.
“Wuu! ~” Eleven and the others shouted one by one. Oh right, there was still Sixth Sister to contract… No, this wasn’t a sister.
Ling, who pulled them to study machinery every day and even took the time to supervise their training, was simply a mother.
“Yay ~” Ling cried out happily.
Even the serious Ling had happier moments.
Wu wu wu ~ The Mechanic had finally broken through. It had waited so long.
…
“Sixth contract, activate.”
In the ruins space.
Shi Yu’s contract halo slowly fused into the mechanical life form in front of him.
< Name > Ling
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Commander
[Race Skill]:
“Advanced”: Hundred Transformations (Dao Proficiency), Advanced Intelligence (Dao Proficiency)
“Transcendent”: Wind Element Control (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]
[Intermediate]: Super Sight (transcendent)
“Advanced”: Clone (transcendent), Multiplication (transcendent), Absolute Sleep (transcendent), Deterrence (transcendent), Loading (expert), Mechanical Space (expert)
“Transcendent”: Divine Net (unlearned), Mythical Revival (unlearned), Turning Misfortune into Luck (unlearned)
During this period of time, Shi Yu had been importing goods and mechanical materials from Ancient Capital University.
Apart from the necessary materials to study mechanical phantom beasts, he also got the mechanical materials to learn loading and mechanical spatial skills.
After coming, Shi Yu didn’t care much. Ling relied on its max-level intelligence to upgrade itself successfully.
Shi Yu didn’t increase its points either, but in just a month, Ling had managed to upgrade two high-level skills to expert level.
Moreover, it was researching the resting time of the mechanical phantom beast to level up…
Shi Yu couldn’t help but sigh. This was a genius machine with max-level intelligence.
Unfortunately, it was only an ordinary upgrade at the moment. It had yet to upgrade these skills into racial skills through evolution. However, with Ling’s intelligence, it could definitely do it in the future.
In addition, although Shi Yu had yet to teach the super skills prepared for Ling…
Shi Yu had maxed out the common spiritual skills such as super vision, absolute sleep, and deterrence before he even started cultivating.
The goal was to increase its mental strength so that it could study it more easily.
“Wu…”
A moment later, Shi Yu and Ling completed the contract. Because of Ling’s feedback, Shi Yu instantly felt his brain become clearer.
And because of Shi Yu’s feedback, Ling’s attributes in various aspects also improved greatly. At the same time, his understanding of Shi Yu’s physical condition was more comprehensive.
After that, Shi Yu said very happily, “It’s done.”
At this moment, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling… Shi Yu was already very satisfied with his pet configuration.
In the future, these were his six main forces!
He didn’t think about the seventh one for the time being.
Next, Shi Yu planned to focus on increasing the strength of the Beast Taming Space instead of increasing in all aspects like before. Although the increase in physique and Beast Taming Talent was greater, it was too time-consuming. In any case, he didn’t have a favorite pet in the seventh contract slot at the moment. There was no hurry.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - Invincible Below Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Invincible Below Overlord (2)
On the contrary, increasing the strength of the Beast Taming Space and allowing him to contract an overlord above his level was the most important thing.
“The seventh…”
Although in Shi Yu’s current ruins space, apart from the mechanical Tyrant Dragon at the start, there was another pile of mechanical phantom beasts that had been newly developed, Shi Yu had no intention of contracting them because there was no need.
For example, Eleven was an initial pet. Needless to say, it was also the strongest battle power in the team. It was indispensable.
As for Buggy, it was an all-purpose pet. Its weather and venue skills could be used everywhere. It could match anyone and was indispensable.
Baby Ginseng and additional points complemented each other and were irreplaceable. It was the team’s healer and backup ingredient.
Chi Tong’s possession skill concerned Shi Yu’s safety and battle power. It was also indispensable.
Susu was the cleansing hand of the team when facing some negative buffs, otherwise Shi Yu might be like Emperor Wu and encounter an enemy like Yun An, corrupting him. Apart from that, its cleansing power could also reduce the burden of other pets learning super skills.
If it went smoothly, when it developed the “fusion strategy”, it would be the key core to integrate the strength of the entire team. Shi Yu’s team also needed such a core with the strongest brain to plan for every member to become stronger.
If Shi Yu really planned to contract a seventh pet, its positioning and ability would definitely be irreplaceable.
Even if it was a pet that he didn’t contract, they had to have their own shining points.
...
Apart from those mechanical phantom beasts that he could choose, Shi Yu still had a Space Beast Egg in his hand. Shi Yu hoped that it could give him some surprises when the time came.
“Contract completed.”
“Next, the first mission goal is to increase the strength of the entire team.”
After the contract was completed, Ling took the initiative to say excitedly.
It was very chill now.
Because the research of the mechanical phantom beast was almost over.
Be it the machine that could rely on special energy to revive the fossil phantom without the help of Buggy and Shi Yu, or the stable planting method of the special fruit that turned the mechanical phantom into a life form, it had already researched it for more than a month.
None of this was difficult for Ling, who had max-level intelligence.
However, Ling couldn’t fuse with the Mythical Phantom and modify itself into a super machine suitable for the entire team’s strength with his current ability.
In Ling’s analysis, it might have to wait until its monarch level and various abilities improved and it absorbed higher-level mechanical theory knowledge.
After the Mechanical Conference, after using the rewarded materials to upgrade itself and absorbing the mechanical theory knowledge of the fourth index, it could continue to carry out higher-level research.
At the moment, Ling could only return to being Shi Yu’s little assistant.
“It’s time to crazily add some super skills.”
Shi Yu also sighed with emotion after looking at the pets like the Mechanical Armored Dragon, Mechanical Sword Dragon, and Mechanical Winged Dragon accompanying the Mechanical Tyrant Dragon in the backyard of the Mechanical Research Institute.
There was still more than half a month until the Mechanical Conference. If there was still a little worry previously, it was completely stable now.
Next, he just had to get through this half a month as soon as possible.
As for Shi Yu, he decisively chose to use the additional points of super skills to pass the time.
The Mechanical Conference was stable, but the World Tournament had yet to stabilize. It was time to sprint!
“Wuuuu ~ !!!”
Eleven and the others, who had been following beside Shi Yu and Ling the whole time, shouted excitedly as Shi Yu and Ling completed the contract.
Increase points, increase points!!!
…
Before adding some super skills, Shi Yu checked the proficiency of all the pets’ super skills.
Eleven:
Inner Power, Bean Soldier, Lightning Rod, Space Quake, Impregnable, Undying Golden Body. All six skills were “Proficient”.
Among them, Inner Power and Bean Soldiers were considered (Proficient+1), close to expert level, but they hadn’t reached expert level anyway, so there weren’t too many qualitative changes.
This was already very good.
Even Eleven, who had learned Impregnable and Undying Golden Body after fighting the Void Mantis every day for the past month and had to explode twice every day, forcefully raised its proficiency.
Buggy:
The Imagination Domain and the Dragon of Imagination were both expert level.
However, they were only at the expert level.
Because there were fewer skills and the opportunities were not bad, Buggy’s super skill proficiency was higher than Eleven.
The Dragon of Imagination relied on visualizing the Dragon God Statue to quickly improve. This was no different from using legendary resources to level up.
The Imagination Domain was similar. This Space Emperor Ruins was specially created by the Space Emperor for the Void Mantis to cultivate. It was very suitable for spatial pets to cultivate. Buggy also took the opportunity to freeload.
In addition, after fighting the Void Mantis for a month, various illusions were often cracked by the Void Mantis. Buggy also racked its brains to increase the level of the Imagination Domain, but unfortunately, at this level, it was still not its match.
Baby Ginseng:
Moon Explosion, proficient level, source of life, and plant control were all close to expert level. They were considered (Proficient+1). Because they used it often and obtained the lead of low-level skills, their proficiency was not bad, but the time mark was still at entry level.
This skill was very difficult to train. It had been a long time since the last time it finished using the time mark. Every time Baby Ginseng rested, it would take the time to condense a new one. But even so, it had yet to condense a complete one.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - Invincible Below Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Invincible Below Overlord (3)
If he wanted to condense a new one, he probably could only rely on adding points next.
