Chi Tong:
Sun Flame, proficient level close to expert level, considered (Proficient+1).
The Interlocking Sword and Spirit Release were both expert level. Moreover, they were both at the intermediate level of expert level. It wasn’t as simple as just becoming expert level.
Among them, the reason why the skill proficiency of the Interlocking Sword suddenly increased was because Chi Tong used the “Gemini Silver Armor” as a resource. With the help of its coordination, it quickly pulled up the proficiency of the Interlocking Sword.
As for Spirit Release, it was naturally because it had swallowed a level-eight Death Spirit Treasure Bead.
Susu:
The Wave Cannon and Holy Water Ring were both proficient level, mainly because it controlled expert level water elemental control. Under the lead of this skill, it was easier to train other water-type skills.
As for Infinite Devour, according to the current spatial volume and digestion speed, it should also be at the expert level after absorbing so many top-grade materials.
Even if Shi Yu rarely added any super skills to his pets, under the lead of various opportunities, their own training, and low-level skills… Their super skill proficiency was not low.
Next, Shi Yu planned to add points to every super skill of every pet with the standard of “expert level”.
He would ignore skills above expert level for the time being.
However, skills below expert level would all at least reach expert level.
......
After all, from entry level to proficiency, one only needed to add points once to be proficient. As long as one added points twice, the skill would undergo a qualitative change faster.
Apart from the super skills that needed to be improved, Shi Yu still had a few super skills that he had yet to teach.
For example, Buggy’s final absorption, spatial control, anti-magic domain, Ling’s Divine Net, turning misfortune into luck, or Susu’s Heavenly Frost Cold Energy…
Shi Yu still successfully replicated the Void Mantis’s skill.
However, he only replicated spatial control and the anti-magic domain.
In terms of low-level spatial skills, there was nothing new about the Void Mantis. It didn’t increase Buggy much.
The four super spatial skills, Space Distortion and Space Slash, were actually included in Space Control. Space Control could also achieve a similar effect. Although the effect was definitely inferior to those two skills under the same proficiency, it was better in all aspects. Shi Yu felt that with limited energy, it was enough to just teach Space Control.
After learning spatial control, spatial blades, spatial cutting, and spatial distortion, it could be used. Its status was equivalent to plant control, water elemental control, and wind elemental control. It was a core skill of a certain type. It contained a lot of things, so learning it was definitely not wrong. If the single effect was not enough, the proficiency would make up for it.
Of course, the skill of the Anti-Demon Domain definitely had to be replicated. In a battle above the overlord level, the cultivation level of the natural power was important. If Buggy could use the Anti-Demon Domain, Shi Yu’s tactical choice would have more performance.
At that time, the combination skill of the Imagination Domain and the Anti-Demon Domain would create a suitable weather and venue to support his teammates. On the other hand, he would use the Anti-Demon Domain to restrict the enemy’s control over natural energy and his own energy. It was a perfect venue!
.
After the inspection was completed, Shi Yu began the first round of adding points after breaking through to level six. He naturally chose Eleven as the first target to add points.
“Don’t worry, next, according to the order of the team’s internal competition ranking, I’ll give you various super skills to expert level first.”
Shi Yu smiled and looked at the eager pets. “I’ll also teach you new skills during this period.”
“Wuuu!!” Eleven was pleasantly surprised.
Buggy and Baby Ginseng also heaved a sigh of relief. Then, they, who were ranked second, suddenly looked at each other. Who was number two?
Chi Tong and Susu chose to lie flat with watery eyes. Sigh, let’s wait. Wu wu, we have to be at the front of the next team competition!
The sisters would never admit defeat!
Ling: Team competition…
“Doing Eleven first is still very necessary,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Eleven had a mid-level will, so its consumption was greater and more representative. Moreover, it had successfully added points once. The success rate of adding points would be higher than other pets, and it was very suitable to experiment with the consumption after breaking through.
At the same time, he also let the other pets prepare more. Just because their mid-level eleven willpower could succeed didn’t mean that they could succeed too. It was never wrong to be more prepared.
“Alright, you guys come and help first…”
“I’ll start now…”
It was still the same thing as when he taught the Undying Golden Body…
Eleven, who had the Frost Purification Suit on its body and the Inner Power skill, was directly added to the expert level by Shi Yu.
“Wu wu wu wu wu…”
Eleven was still screaming in pain like before.
As for Shi Yu, he was also very miserable, but not as miserable as the last time he taught Eleven new skills.
After breaking through, the side effect was similar to the first time he taught Susu super skills. Although it was also very miserable, and Baby Ginseng alone still couldn’t heal it, it was already very good. After all, adding points to mid-level willpower consumed more energy than adding points to overlord willpower.
“It still doesn’t work…”
“However… the effect of the new body absorbing nutritional supplements is better, and the recovery is better. Cough, cough…”
“Damn it, I still have to buy supplements.”
Shi Yu lay weakly on the ground.
After adding points once, Shi Yu was directly persuaded to stop. He crawled and rolled out of the ruins space, running outside to buy various supplements.
Half a month ago, the Void Mantis stopped fighting Buggy and the others. It began seclusion training, trying to break through the bottleneck of expert spatial control to perfect spatial control.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - Invincible Below Overlord (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Invincible Below Overlord (4)
Shi Yu didn’t know how it was doing, but Shi Yu wanted the key to enter and exit the Space Emperor Ruins. This was very convenient.
After one experiment, Shi Yu directly exchanged all the money he had through the third bureau’s channels for a large number of life nutritional supplements and various energy crystals from the national resource warehouse.
They were all above level-seven.
With this, Shi Yu caught Eleven and started to increase his points crazily.
On the first day, its Inner Power increased to expert level. Shi Yu was nursed by Baby Ginseng for a long time. Eleven was nursed by Susu for a long time. Then, after Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng, and Susu ate a pile of supplements, they recovered about three days later and started a new round of points.
Then, Eleven’s bean soldier skill added points once and reached expert level.
At this moment, Eleven could already summon 30 Bean Bears in one go. Its impregnable skill was also stronger.
Expert Level Bean Soldier+Dao Proficiency Impregnable. With the inscription on Little Bean’s body, the Void Mantis alone might not necessarily be able to break through Eleven’s defense.
Another week later, Eleven’s Impregnable skill was added to expert level by Shi Yu.
For the past half a month, Shi Yu and Eleven had been in pain and joy.
The large consumption of resources and endless torture in exchange for gratifying gains.
Firstly, although Shi Yu’s physique had yet to reach the limit after breaking through, it had improved greatly compared to when he first broke through. The side effects of adding some super skills decreased time and time again. As for Eleven, after repeated training, its willpower level actually loosened a little under Eleven’s own judgment.
It seemed that it was not far from the overlord’s will.
......
He didn’t know when, but adding points didn’t corrode the will anymore. It could actually train the will.
Eleven covered its mouth with tears. How good.
It could accept it more with a clear conscience.
< Name > Eleven
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Inner Power (Expert), Lightning Rod (Proficient), Space Quake (Proficient), Bean Soldier (Expert), Impregnable (Expert)
[Teaching Skill]
“Super Level”: Undying Golden Body (Proficient)
Energy Points: Normal State 7.5 million
In just two months, Eleven’s basic energy level had already exceeded Baby Ginseng and become the first in the team.
At the same time, it was also the number one physique in the team. If it included the Undying Golden Body, its vitality could definitely fight against Baby Ginseng.
This was not only due to the proficiency of the super skill, but also because Eleven had been fighting the Void Mantis every day for the past month. The physique of the Iron-eating Beast King was “it will become stronger after recovering from serious injuries”. This was a good racial buff very suitable for Eleven.
From the current situation, when Eleven’s all super racial skills were trained to (Expert+11), its normal energy level would definitely exceed ten million. It could definitely surpass the Void Mantis, and its battle power would exceed even more.
Even now, even without using the power of the Demon God, Eleven was confident that it could fight that Void Mantis evenly.
He didn’t dare to say the past or the future, nor did he dare to say it in the world, but at the moment, in Dong Huang, there shouldn’t be anyone stronger than Eleven among monarch-level pets. This was even before Eleven had unearthed all its potential.
Under the overlord level… it was almost invincible. Ah, wait, Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit+Moon Explosion+Time Mark seemed to be able to fight. However, after Baby Ginseng ate the Time Fruit, it became an overlord, so it wasn’t at the monarch level. It was reasonable.
At this point, Shi Yu temporarily stopped adding points. It wasn’t that he didn’t want to continue, but someone was starting to panic.
The Mechanical Conference was about to begin. In the past two days, Principal Feng, Grandma Li, Dean Hao, and even Fang Lan and her parents kept asking Shi Yu if he was ready and how the preparations for the Mechanical Conference were.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. In order to use his full spirit to show off at the Mechanical Conference, he stopped adding points and planned to wait until after the Mechanical Conference.
It was currently March 8th, and it was said to be November in the world competition. He still had eight months to strengthen the entire team.
Eight months was neither long nor short. After stepping into level six, Shi Yu sensed his meditation speed. Even if he meditated in the Space Emperor Ruins every day for eight months, he couldn’t reach level seven. He couldn’t even reach half the progress. However, if eight months was used to increase points…
Everyone could obtain a huge increase. It didn’t even seem impossible to increase a pet’s super skill to (Perfect+47) if they stared at a skill upgrade alone?
A proper top-notch overlord.
A top-notch overlord was probably “extremely rare” even in the World Tournament. If not for the spatial level restriction, Shi Yu might really be able to produce a totem-level pet!
This speculation made Shi Yu even more confident of facing the world competition.
Of course, it was hard to say if a simple super skill (Perfect+47) could have the combination profundity of two perfect super skills that were very compatible. Shi Yu planned to study it later.
After making the decision, Shi Yu packed up in the Space Emperor Ruins. He estimated that the Void Mantis was about to break through. In that case, he wouldn’t stay here anymore. It didn’t matter where he added points next. In any case, it was impossible to meditate anymore. It was useless even if Ling came.
However, he could give the spare key here to Senior Lu later and let her try to break through to the Legendary level. In fact, if the Void Mantis left, Shi Yu felt that it was not bad to let Senior Lu be its modern guide. As long as he could freeload on the Space Emperor Ruins, it would not be a loss…

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - Invincible Below Overlord (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Invincible Below Overlord (5)
There was still no news from the Void Mantis. After Shi Yu came out of the Space Emperor Ruins, he sighed.
He took out his cell phone and was just about to call Senior Lu to inform her of this good news when suddenly, a black shadow came from the sky.
“Wu ~ ~ ~” With a huge roar, a yellow-brown Ancestral Rock Wings Bird descended. At the same time, a long-haired young man descended from above.
The seventh sequence, Ji Feng.
Initially, fifth place was first beaten to sixth place by Lu Qingyi, then squeezed to seventh place by Shi Yu…
Ji Feng was silent for a moment when he encountered Shi Yu at the Myriad Mountain.
It was very normal for Shi Yu to stay here to cultivate after conquering the Space Emperor Ruins…
“Ji Feng?” Shi Yu looked at this guy in surprise.
“Shi Yu, is the Void Mantis around? I’m here to challenge it,” Ji Feng said after a moment of silence.
Two months ago, he lost miserably to the Void Mantis. He knew that he wasn’t its match, so he cultivated bitterly for two months and came to challenge again.
“Uh, the rewards are all gone…” Shi Yu said.
“Not for the reward, but for the battle,” Ji Feng said.
“That’s probably impossible. It’s in seclusion to challenge the overlord level… I can’t contact it. If I can, I reckon it’s also an overlord…”
Ji Feng: “…%$^%^”
Ji Feng was extremely silent, feeling very uncomfortable.
After returning from his cultivation, he first went to challenge Lu Qingyi. In the end, Lu Qingyi said that she wasn’t free and directly rejected Ji Feng.
The Sequence battle could only be forced in the later half of the year. At the moment, whether to accept the challenge depended on the Beast Tamer’s own wishes.
Since Lu Qingyi said she wasn’t free, Ji Feng didn’t shamelessly chase after her.
Therefore, he thought of the Void Mantis and planned to come here to test the cultivation results. In the end… the Void Mantis couldn’t either?
In the end, Ji Feng’s gaze landed on the “number one person below legend” and the “fifth sequence” Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu… I want to challenge you.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“I’m not free either…”
Ji Feng: “?”
“Why aren’t you free either?” Ji Feng’s mentality collapsed. What was the meaning of this?
When a group of people challenged him, he never refused anyone.
“This…” Shi Yu was stunned. He was really not free. He had just finished adding points and looked fine now, but his core was still weak. Not only him, Eleven, Susu, and Baby Ginseng were also weak at this moment. It wasn’t their best state.
Ji Feng wasn’t weak. If he didn’t use his best state to fight, Shi Yu felt that it was not very stable. After all, Buggy didn’t have the anti-magic domain like the Void Mantis to restrict the other party’s talent.
“My pet just underwent overload training. It can’t even fight now…”
“It can wait for a few days,” Ji Feng said. “Moreover, it doesn’t have to be a full-strength battle. I just need to challenge your Iron-eating Beast that defeated the Void Mantis.”
He wanted to see how strong that Iron-eating Beast was.
After defeating the Iron-eating Beast, theoretically speaking, it had defeated the Void Mantis.
Shi Yu covered his forehead and said, “Alright, how about tomorrow, Star Capital?”
“Star Capital?” Ji Feng.
“Yes, I’m going over there to do something.”
“Sure.” Ji Feng nodded and said, “I’ll wait for you in the Star Capital Arena tomorrow.”
Shi Yu also nodded… Well, he wondered how Eleven would perform against Ji Feng’s trump card pet that could activate its Beast Taming Talent.
Forget it, let’s put the battle aside and think about the Mechanical Conference first.
In the past few months, the Dong Huang exchange team had first traded with Ming Hua. Then, they traded with Xue Yuan and Shen Feng. Shen Feng was the country of machinery, the birthplace of Mechanics, so there were many top-grade mechanical materials. Shi Yu had heard that Dong Huang had purchased a large batch of Hundred Transformations Stones. Cough, cough, cough, he didn’t know if Gao Xuan still needed them… But he and Ling really lacked them!!

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - Susu Can Also Be Sold (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Susu Can Also Be Sold (1)
After challenging Shi Yu, Ji Feng left in satisfaction.
After leaving, he applied to the Star Capital Association to fight.
Battles above the master level had to be announced in the city.
At the same time.
On Shi Yu’s side, after seeing Ji Feng leave, he shook his head and continued calling Senior Lu.
Soon, the call went through.
Through the video, Shi Yu immediately saw Senior Lu in a black and blue battle suit.
“Eh, Senior, where are you?”
Seeing that the other party was wearing a battle suit, Shi Yu asked.
“The suburbs of the ancient capital…”
“I accidentally heard and activated a ruin previously and just finished exploring it today. Unfortunately, it’s a small ruin. Apart from obtaining a ruin space, I didn’t gain much. I wasted another half a month…”
Shi Yu could sense Senior Lu’s resentment through the screen.
Shi Yu was stunned. Alright, she didn’t even fancy a ruins space at this point, right?
However, from Lu Qingyi’s perspective, an ordinary ruins space was really useless to her.
After all, she had long obtained the legendary ruins space. Apart from exchanging some resources, this new ruins space had no other use.
“Not bad… At least it can be exchanged for many resources to strengthen pets,” Shi Yu said.
“Yeah.” Lu Qingyi smiled and asked, “What’s wrong?”
“I broke through to level six and just came out of the Space Emperor Ruins. I won’t be able to break through in the short term, so Senior, do you want to try the Space Emperor Ruins? I got the key to enter the ruins from the Void Mantis. It doesn’t mind me bringing the others over.”
“Yes!” Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, the face on the screen suddenly approached and immediately shouted.
However, she was quickly stunned. “You… broke through to level six so quickly??”
If she remembered correctly… Shi Yu broke through to level five half a year ago, right? He went from level five to level six in half a year?
This was nothing. Some Beast Tamers with fortuitous encounters could do it, but the problem was that it had only been two years since Shi Yu became a Beast Tamer…
Before breaking through, Shi Yu was known as the strongest below Legend Dong Huang. After breaking through, he probably lived up to his name. He approached Legend in two years and became the strongest below Legend. This speed was too much.
Even compared to the legendary paths of legendary emperors in history, it was not inferior at all.
Lu Qingyi’s expression was complicated. What a ridiculous guy she had discovered in that small place in Ping Cheng.
“It’s alright, it’s alright…” Shi Yu laughed.
He still found this slow.
“Then Senior, come over quickly,” Shi Yu invited.
In the Space Emperor Ruins, the small courtyard he got Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Susu to build together wouldn’t be torn down. The spiritual plants inside that could assist in meditation and the Ling Xi that emitted the aura of purification had spent a lot of effort. It would be a pity to tear it down. Coupled with the Space Emperor Ruins, Lu Qingyi’s cultivation speed would definitely take off.
There were still eight months until the world competition. Shi Yu hoped that Senior Lu could break through to the legendary level. This way, his safety would be more guaranteed.
Most importantly, the venue of the World Tournament, Inatena, known as the root of the world, was the place with the most Mythical ruins…
It was understandable that Lu Qingyi wanted to take a look. He and Lu Qingyi were both archeologists who specialized in Mythical Ruins.
He hoped that at that time, he and Lu Qingyi could team up and crack a few more Mythical ruins.
In the last world competition, the World Tree used different Mythical Ruins as the competition venue. Many contestants obtained benefits, and they didn’t know what the situation would be this time.
If there were still Mythical Ruins as the venue of the competition, it would be the home ground of archeologists like him and Senior Lu!!!
After the notification was completed, Shi Yu began to wait for Senior Lu. At the same time, he summoned Susu and Ling to play.
“I’m free anyway…” Shi Yu looked at the starry sky. Susu and Ling immediately understood!
“Ning ~!! Ning!”
Susu started gesturing with the white-haired loli in the Rubik’s Cube in front of it.
“Which direction do we look at this time?” Ling also asked.
During this process, the Rubik’s Cube divided into countless small cubes and kept assembling.
First, it condensed into a mechanical hat and buckled it on Susu’s head. It raised an antenna and let Susu become the antenna slime baby.
Then, some other cubes quickly assembled into a cosmic telescope.
Seeing this, Susu revealed a happy smile. It enlarged its body and quickly used the cosmic telescope.
Soon, a white water ball fell from the sky at a high speed.
At the side, Shi Yu had already prepared the container. Under Susu’s control, the white water ball slowly landed in the container.
“This again.” Looking at the white water ball, Shi Yu sighed. Susu also looked angry.
Why were they all basic resources?
Couldn’t he pray for some rarer resources!
In the past half a month or so, apart from super skills, Shi Yu had also occasionally gotten some low-level skills from his pets.
As this comparison to super skills didn’t take much effort, Shi Yu pulled Susu’s Blizzard, Star Sea, and Memory Water from transcendent to the maximum level.
Apart from that, Ling’s loading and mechanical space had naturally reached the maximum proficiency of the teaching skill, transcendent.
The transcendent mechanical space was just a larger internal space. As for transcendent loading, Shi Yu was very fond of this skill. He liked it as much as possession. This was because this skill could turn Ling into a “machine gun” or a “sniper rifle” when used by Shi Yu. It was as if it had given Shi Yu a transcendent firearm skill, allowing him to be one with the weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - Susu Can Also Be Sold (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 523: Susu Can Also Be Sold (2)
With Shi Yu’s current physique and Ling’s “loading”, although Ling was only a commander rank now, after they fused, they had nearly ten million energy points. Shi Yu could kill a monarch from afar without any effort.
At the moment, the most impressive combination method was for Ling to become a sniper rifle and enter a loading state with Shi Yu. Then, Chi Tong would possess Shi Yu!
Double Fusion!
It consumed a lot of energy for Shi Yu, but it was also really strong.
At the moment, they didn’t have any skills to cooperate with. In the end, Ling still needed to continue researching the combination strategy.
Of course, as he studied it during this period of time, apart from firearms, Ling could also become some other mechanical tools through the Hundred Transformations.
For example, the Space Telescope… As for what use this thing had…
It had to be mentioned that Susu’s Star Sea skill. The max-level Star Sea directly allowed Susu to obtain the power of the Star Prayer. It could summon the water resources in the starry sky to the greatest extent through the max-level Star Sea.
The white water ball just now was the Starry Sky Strange Water summoned by Susu through the Star Sea skill.
If there was any special effect of this stupid water, well, there wasn’t. It was equivalent to a level-five resource. It could strengthen the energy value of light-type pets below the monarch level. The effect was even worse than a level-five light-type energy crystal.
Judging from Susu’s energy consumption and time consumption, this deal was clearly not worth it. It was better to condense the memory water drop.
After all, a max-level memory water drop was too powerful. A transcendent-level memory water drop could only transmit its skill experience, but a Dao Proficiency-level memory water drop could allow other pets to transmit their skill experience through the water drop.
For example, if Buggy held a drop of memory water, it could transfer its skill into the Dao Level worm silk experience and teleport it into the memory water drop. Then, other Green Silkworms could absorb the corresponding skill experience at a high speed through this skill water drop.
It was similar to Shi Yu’s skill index.
This was a high-level skill?
.....
The only pity was that regardless of whether it was Susu or other pets, after transmitting their skill experience through the memory water drop, this skill experience would be forgotten from their minds.
It wasn’t that they still kept it after transmitting it. Although he might be able to rely on other skills to quickly recover through analogy, it would indeed affect his memories for a short period of time.
Apart from that, transferring the skill experience into the memory water drop and absorbing the skill experience from the memory water drop was not as fast as teaching the skill index. Susu did an experiment. If it wanted to transmit the perfect level of the bubble experience, this low-level skill would take dozens of minutes.
If it was absorbed by wild water-type pets by the roadside, the other party wouldn’t be able to absorb it for at least half a month.
Perhaps this speed could only decrease when Susu’s growth level increased.
However, because of these effects, the memory water drop could actually be called the Forgotten River Water, the skill teaching water drop.
This was also the reason why the guardian of Dong Huang, who could use water droplets, only converted the skill experience into a memory crystal before its death. When it was still alive, of course it wasn’t willing to forget its power.
Of course, this side effect did not affect Shi Yu’s pet.
Its pets could all create clones. It could directly summon a clone and let the clone pinch the memory water drop. The time cost would be greatly reduced.
Under the lead of the gem cat, a world where only clones were injured was born.
Although the skill proficiency of the clone was inferior to the main body and couldn’t maximize the effect of the skill, it was fine if it really needed the main body to condense the memory water drop. So be it if the skill was forgotten. In any case, it wasn’t troublesome for Shi Yu to teach it back.
Shi Yu’s pets had terrifyingly high skill proficiency. Coupled with the memory water drop, the memory water drop might be able to become a super resource in the team that was comparable to or even exceeded the Time Fruit.
Therefore, it was better to condense this thing to exchange for resources than to summon strange water to earn money.
At the same time, this thing was not bad as gifts.
The additional points in the past half a month had almost consumed all of Shi Yu’s assets. Under the many strong invitations of the gem cat, Shi Yu was already prepared to open a company with the gem cat to be in charge of the sales of high-end resources to earn some extra money.
He even planned to hold a private auction not long after the Mechanical Conference ended and invite some legends and rich people to test the market.
He wanted to try the Hardening Sword that was wrapped around the full-level deterrence for a hundred years, the spatial bag woven by the worm silk, the special life evolution fruit made by the ginseng baby, and something like the memory water drop. He wanted to see how much it could be sold for.
At that time, Shi Yu and the gem cat planned to stir up the concept and rarity level, making things rare.
After all, although these things were good, they were limited by Eleven and the others’ growth levels. They could only condense level-five or six resources at most. It required a lot of physical fitness, energy, and time. This investment was better to use it to increase strength and become an overlord. At that time, the resources would be stronger.
If they relied on numbers to win, it was better to rely on marketing. Buggy and the others could also have it easier.
The first round of legendary resources had already been saved. The next round was to prepare a new round of legendary resources for the pets to break through to the totem level. It was unrealistic to rely on various applications. Shi Yu planned to build his business empire like the founders of the five major financial groups.
Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and even the Beast Tamers of the six countries would be his potential customers in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - Susu Can Also Be Sold (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Susu Can Also Be Sold (3)
The Star Sea skill was actually not bad. The rare thing was that the strange water summoned was not the only one. It all depended on luck. It was commonly known as a dog bet skill.
Although the white light-element mutant water was not very good, Susu had also summoned the blue mutant water previously. The strengthening effect on water-element pets was very good.
No one knew how many strange things there were in the starry sky.
What if he could summon some purple rare water and golden legendary strange water in the future?
Susu was quite addicted.
As for Ling, in order to study resources from outer space, it also became a support tool. It observed the starry sky with Susu every day.
Shi Yu was also very supportive of this.
Because of the skill fusion…
Ordinary Blue Sea Sprites had endless energy just by signing a contract with the sea of Blue Planet.
Then the Blue Sea Contract skill+Star Sea Skill = Star Sea Contract skill… This wasn’t too much, right?
Susu’s goal shouldn’t be just the sea, but the sea of stars!
“Ning… (The path is, the sea of stars! All can be cleansed!)” Susu raised its head, its eyes shining.
Before that, it wanted to quickly obtain the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance and become number one in the team.
......
The status of the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance in Susu’s heart… gradually decreased. Becoming first in the team had already become the main mission.
A moment later, both Susu and Ling suddenly discovered the abnormality in the sky.
Lu Qingyi rode the Green Spirit Wind Bird that had evolved into the Green Spirit Phoenix and rushed to the ruins of the Kong Capital. When Shi Yu saw Senior Lu arrive, he immediately welcomed her with a smile.
“Senior.”
“Sorry to have kept you waiting,” Lu Qingyi apologized after getting off the Green Phoenix.
“No.” Shi Yu smiled and handed Lu Qingyi a Void Key Stone. “Here, this is the tool to open the Space Emperor Ruins.”
“I also opened a subspace inside. It’s very suitable for cultivation. I can enter with this.”
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu told Lu Qingyi about the situation with the Void Mantis. Lu Qingyi nodded repeatedly.
She understood.
Although the Void Mantis would leave with the Space Emperor Ruins after breaking through to the overlord level, as long as it followed the Void Mantis and walked with it as a guide to the outside world, it could always freeload on the Space Emperor Ruins.
After all, with a grandfather from the first bureau, Lu Qingyi still knew how to flirt with big boss-level transcendent creatures.
The fact that Lu Qingyi could get a lot of information about the Space Emperor Ruins from the Void Mantis was enough to prove that Senior Lu’s skills in this aspect were not bad.
“By the way, this is for you.” Lu Qingyi suddenly thought of something and took out a nearly transparent jade from the ruins space.
Shi Yu was stunned when he saw it.
The Feeding index tested it but couldn’t analyze what it was. It wasn’t in the database.
However, the Feeding index detected a huge energy wave on this jade. This was a level-eight resource!
“This is…?”
“Spirit Accumulation Jade, a level-eight resource. I got it from a friend. It contains a chaotic power. Any energy can be injected into it and it can subtly and slowly strengthen any power.”
“Didn’t you say last time that Eleven didn’t succeed in fusing with the power of Yun An? You can try this. At least it can avoid the consumption of the power of the Demon God. As time passes, it might even be able to strengthen the power of the Demon God in Eleven’s body,” Lu Qingyi said.
“Spirit Accumulation Jade…” Shi Yu was very surprised that there was actually such a resource. Senior Lu was right. If Eleven had this, it could inject the power of the Demon God into this place bit by bit to store it. Then, this Spirit Accumulation Jade would be like interest, producing more and more power of the Demon God. At that time, even if he didn’t find Yun An, he could naturally increase the power of the Demon God and try to evolve.
Also, the power of the Demon God used to fight the Void Mantis could also be recovered through this thing.
Even if the accumulation of this thing was relatively slow and not enough to support dark-element evolution in the short term, it was always good to recover a little of the power of the Demon God. After all, at that time, if Shi Yu successfully developed other evolution paths, the more the better.
Shi Yu was willing to call it a jade pendant.
“However, this is too expensive,” Shi Yu said.
Although he kept talking about legendary resources, Senior Lu’s personal gift…
“You’ve learned to be polite too?” Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu with a smile. In her impression, Shi Yu didn’t refuse anyone.
“Cough, cough.” Shi Yu coughed in embarrassment and said, “Alright, I won’t be polite then. Eleven can indeed use it.”
“I’ll take it. Senior, you have to work hard to break through to the Legendary level. After I participate in the Mechanical Conference, I have a few things for you.”
Shi Yu’s idea was that Eleven’s full-level deterrence, Buggy’s full-level Psychic, Chi Tong’s full-level possession, and other skills were very common. When the time came, he could condense a memory water drop and give some to his senior to strengthen her battle power. After all, Lu Qingyi had indeed given him a lot of help in the early stages.
In fact, without Senior Lu’s invitation, he would have missed Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and a series of pets.
“Machinery Conference…” Lu Qingyi was stunned.” By the way, we still have to see the Mechanical Conference. ”
“There’s nothing to see. When the time comes, I’ll go to Ancient Capital University to see the real thing. Breaking through to the Legendary level is more important!” Shi Yu said.
“Alright.” Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “I hope I can gain something in eight months.”
“Yeah, Senior, I’ll take you to see the Space Emperor Ruins first.”
After Shi Yu handed the Void Key Stone to Lu Qingyi, he immediately brought her into the Space Emperor Ruins to take a look at the small courtyard he had built.
Lu Qingyi was quite satisfied with this new cultivation place. She couldn’t guarantee that she could break through, but it was definitely more likely than cultivating elsewhere.
.
After arranging it for Senior Lu, Shi Yu began to head to Star Capital.
This was the venue of the Mechanical Conference and also the technological capital of Dong Huang. Star Capital University was even known as the number one mechanical specialization in Dong Huang. Although they couldn’t recruit a genius like Gao Xuan a few years ago, many big shots of the fourth bureau, such as Legend Xiao Shuang, had graduated from here.
…
The Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University had long arrived a few days earlier than Shi Yu.
Principal Feng, Dean Hao, Grandma Li, and the relevant people were already in Star Capital.
At the same time, Professor Fang and his wife also brought their daughter, Fang Lan, to Star Capital to be spectators of the Mechanical Conference.
These people who knew some inside information in advance were looking forward to the Mechanical Conference.
Mechanical phantom beast, Tyrant Dragon Reincarnated!
The ancient dinosaurs that were extinct in the totem era were revived and even successfully inherited some lost skills. If this wasn’t an epoch-making discovery, what was?
At this year’s Mechanical Conference, Ancient Capital University would definitely be the most handsome.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Master Ji, Stop Scratching
“He’s finally here!”
Star Capital Technology Garden.
At the Mechanical Garden of Ancient Capital University.
When Shi Yu arrived, Principal Feng and the others couldn’t wait to welcome him.
“Sorry for the wait.”
Shi Yu said to Principal Feng, Dean Hao, Grandma Li, and the others who came out to welcome him.
“We’ve waited so long.”
Dean Hao of the Mechanical College of Ancient Capital University said eagerly.
This year, his mood was like taking a train.
First, Shi Yu won the National League. The education funds of Ancient Capital University increased greatly. The Mechanical College was also a pie that he took a slice of. He was very happy.
But then, Principal Feng informed him that apart from the basic expenses, all the research funds of the Mechanical College this year were given to Shi Yu to use. It directly made Dean Hao’s heart skip a beat, not understanding what was going on.
In the end, when Principal Feng showed Dean Hao the information on the mechanical phantom beast, the old top-notch mechanical master was stunned.
It felt very ridiculous.
After his worldview shattered and recombined, he wished he could run to the ruins of Kong Capital to be Shi Yu’s assistant.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu didn’t want any assistants… He only wanted mechanical materials, making Old Hao anxious.
PLease reading on Mybo x no v el. com
He didn’t understand what was going on with Shi Yu!
Didn’t Shi Yu know that he had just contracted the Hundred Transformations Machine? He was clearly a newbie Mechanic, so why did he suddenly create such an awesome thing? It didn’t make sense.
In fact, Shi Yu wasn’t that heartless to reject Dean Hao. It was mainly because he felt that Dean Hao’s level was too low and might delay his research progress.
The heartless one was Ling…
In short, it was not until he chatted with Principal Feng and Dr. Li that Dean Hao realized that Shi Yu had had this plan for a long time.
A long time ago, Shi Yu had the idea of reviving ancient creatures because of the Illusory Phantom skill and the experience of entering the dream of the Tyrant Dragon fossil.
As Shi Yu discovered the tool that contained the “strongest talent of the Mechanic class, ‘Awakening’, this idea completely matured.
Apart from Lu Qingyi and White Brook, they also told Principal Feng, Grandma Li, and the others about Shi Yu’s archeological discovery of the Awakening Mirror. They were so envious. Why was this kid so lucky?
This made them very emotional. They were also members of Bureau 11, but there was undoubtedly a difference between people.
His listening talent was indeed powerful, but the other members of Bureau 11 weren’t as powerful as Shi Yu.
Lu Qingyi cracking part of the Mythical Ruins and her pet obtaining the Mythical inheritance was already an extremely good harvest in Bureau 11.
However, for Shi Yu, be it the Mu Huiyin inheritance, the Emperor Wu inheritance, the secret of the Great Empress, the Space Emperor inheritance, the huge gains from the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City, or the Yue Maiden tool… It was not inferior at all.
The benefits Shi Yu obtained from the ruins and archeology were simply too ridiculous. They estimated that only the Dragon Emperor, who had directly obtained the ownership of the Mythical Ruins in history, could compare to Shi Yu in terms of opportunities.
“How’s the progress?” Grandma Li asked.
“Everything is smooth. Apart from the Tyrant Dragon, there will also be a few extinct species displayed as mechanical phantom beasts with it,” Shi Yu said. “Thank you for your fossil.”
“Sure, just take a few more fruits next time.” Grandma Li smiled and chased him away. She was talking about the Time Fruit. This was given to Grandma Li by Shi Yu not long ago. After all, without her, he wouldn’t have been able to contract the ginseng baby.
In fact, Grandma Li was also very emotional about the mutated ginseng baby.
It could actually be cultivated by Shi Yu to this extent and actually become an existence that could kill two overlords after evolution… As expected, it wasn’t given wrongly. Fortunately, she didn’t use it herself and instead gave it to Shi Yu to nurture. Otherwise, she would have lost out.
Time Fruit, the representative skill of Emperor Shi’s pet.
Grandma Li guessed that if Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had obtained the inheritance from Emperor Wu, then Baby Ginseng must have obtained the time-element inheritance from Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit or the totem ice dragon under Emperor Shi.
Shi Yu was really lucky. All his archeological results could be used to strengthen himself. Grandma Li’s judgment was right. Baby Ginseng’s mutation had indeed absorbed a lot of time power in the Ice Dragon Ruins.
“Don’t worry, leave the Mechanical Conference to me. When the time comes, I’ll definitely surprise the seniors,” Shi Yu confirmed. “I’m going to prepare for the battle now.”
“Battle?” Principal Feng and the others, who were just about to ask Shi Yu more detailed questions, were stunned. What battle?
Weren’t you here to participate in the Mechanical Conference? Why was it related to battle again?
“When I came from Kong Capital, I bumped into Ji Feng and arranged a 1VS1 battle with him. It’s in Star Capital. I want to prepare for battle first.”
.
Everyone was stunned. F*ck, this guy didn’t stop even when he came to participate in the Mechanical Conference… Shouldn’t he be preparing for the Mechanical Conference now? What the hell was this battle with Ji Feng?
“No choice, no choice… Why don’t we come and watch the battle tomorrow? In any case, the Mechanical Conference is the day after tomorrow… There’s no hurry.” It was enough for Ling to prepare for the Mechanical Conference himself.
Everyone:…
....
Shi Yu indeed wanted to prepare for battle.
Pre-battle preparations were still very important.
Eleven had just finished its special training and wasn’t in a good state. It definitely had to adjust.
How could the battle power that could be displayed be the same as accumulating enough energy to fight?
Apart from that, Eleven also needed to accumulate Bean Bears in advance before the battle.
In the battle of the Beast Taming Domain, there was no rule that didn’t allow pets to stack their buffs and states before the battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Master Ji, Stop Scratching (2)
However, generally speaking, many self-strengthening skills consumed a lot of energy and couldn’t be used for a long time, so very few pets would enter an explosive state in advance.
For example, Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence, Eleven’s sharp eruption, and Giant Transformation were all strengthening buffs, but they were not suitable to enter in advance because it was meaningless. It would only waste more stamina.
However, there were some skills that could be used in advance. Not only would it not increase the consumption, but it would also reduce the consumption.
Shi Yu had seen Ji Feng’s battle. His Elemental Lord could accumulate reserve elemental energy in his body in advance and directly use it in battle. It was similar to Eleven’s Inner Power and Susu’s Infinite Devour Space.
This was the kind of advance strengthening that followed the rules.
As for Eleven, apart from the source of its restrained physical strength, it also had a similar skill, which was to condense beans into soldiers.
It could spend its physical strength to create the greatest number of Bean Bears before the battle and carry them on its body. Then, it could slowly recover its full physical strength. At that time, in the battle, it could directly send the condensed Bean Bears to battle without needing to spend huge physical strength to condense them on the spot.
This was the true use of bean soldiers.
Chi Tong’s scapegoat and Baby Ginseng’s time mark were the same.
Ji Feng definitely wouldn’t let go of the idea of filling up the backup energy before the battle. Shi Yu naturally had to be sufficiently prepared.
A moment later.
In the ruins space, the round Eleven sat on the ground. As it ate, black beans condensed and stuck to its body like little magnets, fully armed…
It wasn’t night yet, and a total of 30 Bean Bears were temporarily born in the form of beans. Eleven inscripted them all over their bodies!
…
The next day.
PLease reading on Myb o x no ve l. com
Star Capital Arena.
As the largest arena in Star Capital, this place was directly cleared by the president of the Star Capital Association today.
The reason was very simple. He had received Ji Feng’s application. Sequence 7 Ji Feng wanted to have a 1VS1 battle with Sequence 5 Shi Yu in the Star Capital Arena!
This was an impressive matter. The association headquarters had long issued instructions that every battle in the top ten of the Sequence required the high cooperation of the associations everywhere.
Even Director Zhong of the Sequence Competition Committee rushed to Star Capital overnight, wanting to witness this battle with his own eyes.
“Elder Zhong, you’re here.”
“Little Ma, long time no see.”
In the Star Capital Arena, Director Zhong, one of the people in charge of the Sequence Competition Committee, met President Ma of the Star Capital Association and started chatting.
“I’ve finally caught another battle with Shi Yu,” Director Zhong sighed.
During the Ming Hua Competition, he had judged that the Iron-eating Beast’s full strength was very terrifying.
However, who would have thought that he would actually directly defeat the Space Emperor’s pet later and take off, vaguely becoming the strongest monarch in the country!
After that, although Shi Yu’s ranking had gone up, Director Zhong, who had never seen the battle with his own eyes, had always wanted to see Shi Yu fight with all his might. Now, Ji Feng challenging Shi Yu was a very good opportunity.
“Hahaha, I’ve long heard of Ji Feng and Shi Yu’s reputation as geniuses. I can finally watch their battle this time.” President Ma also sighed with emotion. Ji Feng’s grandfather was a legendary Beast Tamer. He had perfectly inherited Old Master Ji’s All Things Affinity talent and was very strong. As for Shi Yu… President Ma had seen his city’s Star Capital University being beaten up by Shi Yu, so he was not unfamiliar with it.
“They’re all here.”
Apart from Director Zhong, President Ma, Principal Feng, Grandma Li, and the others couldn’t help but watch the commotion. After hearing yesterday, they also came to the scene today… Regarding this, apart from warmly welcoming them, Director Zhong and President Ma didn’t seem to have any other choice.
There were only so many spectators. There weren’t many. The battles in the top ten of the Sequence weren’t suitable for large-scale public battles. After all, as a human country, many totem clans wanted to obtain various information about contestants from Dong Huang.
The first lesson of the battle departments of the various universities was this: No matter when, it was best to have a trump card that no one knew about.
Soon, the time Shi Yu and Ji Feng had agreed on arrived.
The two of them each took some battle materials from the staff, such as supplements to replenish their stamina and medicine to recover from their injuries. Then, they entered the arena from both sides.
On the left, Ji Feng was wearing a brocade robe and had long hair. He didn’t look like a modern person, but this was normal. After being a spy in the totem country for many years, he might not have changed his habits.
On the right, Shi Yu was wearing his daily panda suit. Because Susu had become stronger too quickly, the previous level-six Flame Demon Armor had almost burned up and couldn’t be used anymore. As for battle suits above level-seven, it was impossible to find one that was so suitable for the time being. Shi Yu planned to customize one later.
Now, there was no need to possess him to fight anyway, so he wore casual clothes to make do.
After the two of them stepped onto the arena, they nodded at each other.
“Let me see how strong that Iron-eating Beast is,” Ji Feng said.
To be honest, he had been undercover in the totem country for so long and had seen many hundred-year-old monarchs. In the totem country, monarch-level ferocious beasts were generally stronger than the wild beast monarch ferocious beasts in Dong Huang.
But even so, the Void Mantis was definitely the strongest monarch he had ever seen. It was even stronger than some overlords. In this situation, he still didn’t understand how Shi Yu defeated the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Master Ji, Stop Scratching (3)
“Let’s do our best,” Shi Yu said seriously.
In a one-on-one situation, Senior Lu might not necessarily be able to defeat Ji Feng. This was because the consumption of a Beast Tamer with enhanced talent to strengthen a specific pet was definitely different from strengthening the entire team’s pets. In order to make his current ranking live up to its name, and in order to reduce the number of challengers next, Shi Yu felt that it was indeed necessary to fight Ji Feng.
It was mainly because he had too few battle results.
As long as Ji Feng lost to him, then there was no reason for others to skip Ji Feng to challenge him. He could relax even more.
Apart from that, if he stabilized the top five, it might be easier to get legendary resources!
Shi Yu only accepted Ji Feng’s challenge with this thought.
At this moment.
The battle that was about to begin attracted the attention of everyone.
Director Zhong, President Ma, Principal Feng, and the others couldn’t wait anymore.
Boom!
As Shi Yu and Ji Feng summoned their pets together, the battle instantly began!
“Little Zhang, record!” Director Zhong of the Sequence Competition Committee said to the bespectacled recorder beside him.
…
......
…
“Elemental Lord!!!”
Purple light flashed.
With a boom, natural energy surged in the arena, and the sky changed.
Fire, wind, and light. The body was made of red, green, and gold. A Human-shaped elemental creature more than two meters tall descended into the arena in the purple summoning array.
An illusory figure, an empty gaze, and powerful fluctuations.
Mid-level overlord race, monarch level, elemental lord! Nature’s favorite!
As expected, Ji Feng sent out his trump card.
Many big shots’ eyes flickered.
On Shi Yu’s side, there was the same purple summoning array.
“This kid…”
Director Zhong and the others had rich expressions.
Shi Yu broke through to level six?
So fast?
It looked like the Space Emperor Ruins was indeed a good place to cultivate.
Under the purple light, Eleven was also summoned amidst the blue and purple lightning.
Eleven, who was in a restrained state with black and white interweaving, shook its hair. Its blue eyes that contained lightning were bright as it looked at the enemy calmly in the chaotic elemental fluctuations.
“Wuu!!”
The one-meter-tall Little Iron Eating Beast stared at the big guy opposite it carefully.
Ji Feng also looked at the purple array and the Iron-eating Beast in front of him solemnly.
Elemental Lord vs Iron-eating Beast!
Seeing this, Director Zhong and the others took a deep breath. This was what they wanted to see.
As the two parties were in the confrontation stage, the few big shots surrounding them quickly analyzed.
“Elemental Lord, basic energy value 5,770,000.”
“Although the energy value of the elemental lord isn’t high, its cultivation level of natural power is very high.”
“In addition to Ji Feng’s All Things Affinity talent…”
“It can ensure that the power of every attack is not inferior to an overlord’s attack, but the consumption won’t be very high.”
“Ji Feng lost to the Void Mantis largely because of the other party’s Anti-Demon Domain. In addition, the natural energy in the ruins is thin, so he can’t perfectly display the greatest effect of the All Things Affinity talent…”
After a pet broke through from the monarch level to the overlord level, its body would be reborn again. Its body and mind would be extremely sensitive to natural energy, and it could feel the clear elemental power with its eyes closed.
A fire-element overlord-level ferocious beast might only use 100 energy points to condense an ordinary small fireball, but under its powerful natural control, this small fireball might instantly be mobilized during the attack. The hot elements from nature and the sun would become a fatal fireball that could easily kill monarchs.
This was the use of natural power.
Using the smallest price to increase the power of the skill to the strongest.
Using the natural power of heaven and earth to attack.
Therefore, its energy level was no longer the first reference for overlord-level creatures.
Because an ordinary skill that used 100 energy points to display a normal skill might display incomparable terrifying power under the enhancement of natural power, or even change nature.
The reason why Ji Feng was so strong was that his All Things Affinity talent could increase the pet’s affinity and control over natural power to achieve a similar effect. Therefore, one would definitely lose if he was deceived by the low five million energy points of this pet.
Even Shi Yu’s current pets… Even if some skills involving the power of nature were trained to the maximum proficiency, their affinity control over the power of nature was still inferior to Ji Feng’s pets. After all, they didn’t have the support of talent.
However, after they broke through to the overlord level, their life level increased, and their bodies and nature became one, they would have the backing of max-level natural skill proficiency. Their control over natural power wouldn’t be bad, and they would be very strong.
“In a battle outside, Ji Feng’s strength can be displayed to the maximum…”
After Director Zhong finished speaking, he looked at the Iron-eating Beast and was shocked.
“Energy value, 7.5 million!”
“Ridiculous!”
Everyone present knew that the Nine Li Battle Beast was divided into a restrained state to accumulate energy, a normal state to strengthen the physique, and an overload energy enhancement state to erupt with sharpness.
The restrained state was the Iron-eating Beast form. This form was the weakest form of the Iron-eating Beast. Why did even this form have 7.5 million energy points!
“You’ve already used that legendary magnetic gold, right?” Principal Feng said.
“I wonder what the outcome will be… if the power of nature vs sharpness erupts.”

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Master Ji, Stop Scratching (4)
Everyone focused their attention on this battle.
“Wind Burning Light Blade!” At the start of the battle, Ji Feng let the elemental lord use the unique skills of the wind, fire, and light elements to attack the iron-eating beast.
In the next moment, the elemental blades wrapped in whirlwinds, flames, and flashes quickly condensed in the elemental lord’s hand. At the same time, under Ji Feng’s slightly closed gaze, the dark world was filled with endless light!!
The light from the sun, the high temperature, and the wind elemental power from the air suddenly gathered towards the already terrifying Wind Burning Light Blade in the elemental lord’s hand.
Buzz!!!
In an instant, it was as if an elemental tide had occurred in the outside world. Natural energy gathered in this skill, causing the elemental lord’s body to emit terrifying energy fluctuations.
Seeing this, the gazes of the audience froze. It was indeed an overlord-level power.
At this moment, it wasn’t like Shi Yu and Eleven didn’t react at all when facing the other party’s imminent attack. Eleven raised its head slightly. Although it had mastered the Lightning Rod, that thing’s mobilization of natural power was completely inferior to the other party, so it wasn’t eye-catching.
Boom!!!
After raising his head slightly, Eleven let out a roar and its aura erupted!!
Dao Proficiency, King’s Might!
Its small body erupted with a powerful aura.
With a crack, the sound of space shattering sounded. In an instant, the natural energy gathered in the arena seemed to have seen a real elemental lord. It quickly dispersed like a wave in all directions and felt a shiver!!
......
A powerful deterrence skill could completely make the rain clouds disappear with a thought and calm storms. It was already to the point where nature could give it face.
Although he didn’t have the aptitude to learn the Anti-Demon Domain, Eleven could still suppress the other party’s natural power to a certain extent through deterrence.
At this moment, the gaze of the elemental lord opposite froze. Its mental waves and beating heart thumped as it felt the terrifying pressure from this Iron-eating Beast.
With a boom, under the collision of the incomparable elemental tide and deterrence wave, it was as if space collided and squeezed each other. The entire venue was wrapped in a huge aura confrontation.
Swoosh!!
At this moment, the elemental lord had already condensed the less perfect but still terrifying Wind Burning Light Blade. As for Eleven, during the deterrence process, the hardening substance naturally covered a large area of the ground through physical contact.
A hardening domain ten meters in diameter quietly formed, and the ground was pitch-black.
Right on the heels of that, the elemental lord held an elemental blade. The elements turned into a flash and attacked Eleven at an extremely fast speed. It slashed over fiercely like a knight holding a longsword.
Through its super vision, Eleven could still see the other party’s movements clearly. In the face of an attack that was difficult for others to see with the naked eye, it crossed its arms calmly and golden light flickered on its body.
At the same time, on the hardening domain under its feet, the 30 Bean Bears that had hatched from the hardening domain immediately appeared behind Eleven!!
When they were born and grew up, they were just like Eleven, their bodies flickering with white gold light!!
Army skill, impregnable!
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu…” Among the 30 cries, 30 Bean Bears appeared. At this moment, the Bean Bears had actually been reborn.
Under the combination of the expert level Bean Soldier and the transcendent level clone, the growth level of the Bean Bears had long reached the monarch level. At this moment, every Bean Bear had a million energy points, comparable to ordinary monarch-level ferocious beasts.
With 30 of them added together, the energy value was 30 million.
If it weren’t for the fact that these Bean Bears had been saved in advance, Eleven wouldn’t have been able to release so many Bean Bears in a normal battle.
What was even more terrifying was that although the expert-level Bean Bears still couldn’t inherit super skills, they had already unlocked the proficiency of low-level skills to perfection.
In other words, at this moment, every Bean Bear with 1 million energy points had a transcendent impregnable skill to use.
Right on the heels of that, a scene appeared. With Eleven’s Dao-level Impregnable as the core, the 30 monarch-level Bean Bears spread out and superimposed 30 instances of Impregnable!!
These 31 instances impregnable were under the special resonance effect of the army skill, and an extremely dazzling power erupted!
In the crowd, in the arena, the platinum light on the 31 Iron-eating Beasts turned into a huge golden domain that enveloped them.
Boom!
The metal domain was like a huge illusory city. It was unbreakable and shot out a shocking light. The golden flames were incomparably dazzling. Panda King Eleven stood in front with its arms crossed in front of its chest, leisurely. The 30 Bean Bears army behind it was also growing. They crossed their arms in front of their chests, their eyes filled with an invincible aura.
In an instant, the elemental lord, who had turned into an element and was holding a super skill strengthened by the power of nature, collided the Wind Burning Light Blade with Impregnable. Then, an unbelievable scene appeared.
There was a boom.
The Wind Burning Light Blade slashed at Impregnable, like an egg hitting a rock. The Wind Burning Light Blade directly exploded, and Impregnable only shook violently for a moment before quickly recovering its calm. It looked unscathed!
Boom!!!
Under the violent elemental eruption, the Elemental Lord was suddenly repelled. It looked at the Iron-eating Beast Army that appeared in front of it in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Master Ji, Stop Scratching (5)
On the other hand, Ji Feng’s expression suddenly changed as he looked at the golden domain in front of him solemnly.
“Elemental Storm!” Ji Feng shouted in disbelief. Another skill formed by three elemental powers.
After the elemental lord, who was repelled, stopped, it clasped its hands together and instantly opened them. Then, a violent elemental storm swept the natural power on the arena and formed.
Every part was enough to instantly devour ordinary monarch-level creatures.
Every part was not inferior to an overlord-level attack.
Multiple elemental storms attacked with a bang. On the other side, the 30 Bean Bears led by Eleven had already restrained the impregnable domain and shrunk the domain to wrap around their bodies to avoid wasting energy. However, at this moment, there was still a connection between each impregnable domain and resonance.
“Boom!”
The multiple elemental storms swept past and directly crushed the Iron-eating Beast Corps, but their bodies stood in the elemental storms. Every Bean Bear’s eyes didn’t blink at all. The elemental storms were like quails shaking a tree. At most, it could make the impregnable flickering brighter, but it wasn’t enough to break through this absolute defense!!
Boom!!!
Bean bears, including Eleven, were swept into the elemental storm. They directly tore with their arms. In the next moment, countless elemental storms exploded from the interference. The terrifying explosion wave flickered the entire arena, and colorful elemental particles turned into fireworks that filled the sky.
In the center of everything, Eleven and 30 Bean Bears were still standing unscathed in the arena, looking at the elemental lord with indifferent gazes.
It was as if it was saying, “Master Ji, stop scratching.”
Elemental Lord, stop scratching!
......
Unfortunately, the proficient level Undying Golden Body couldn’t be fused with Impregnable. Otherwise, it really wouldn’t have received as much damage as it recovered health.
At this moment, it was impregnable. Only a true overlord could break through its defense. This was also why Eleven dared to think that it wasn’t inferior to the Void Mantis.
The current scene was undoubtedly very terrifying for Ji Feng and the elemental lord. After all, even overlord-level creatures didn’t want to take their coordinated attack head-on because they would be injured. However, everything that happened in front of them was completely against common sense.
It actually… couldn’t break through its defense?
“How is this possible!”
Even if the power of nature was affected by the other party’s deterrence, it definitely wouldn’t be like this!
Ji Feng’s pupils constricted. It was difficult to understand. The elemental lord’s gaze was also cautious to the extreme.
As for the audience, such as Director Zhong, Principal Feng, Grandma Li, President Ma, and the others, they also opened their mouths slightly and looked at everything in shock.
“They won’t last long.” After a moment, Ji Feng gritted his teeth and gave the order, choosing to let the elemental lord suppress the enemy with firepower.
He didn’t believe that Shi Yu and the others could maintain this state for long.
However, with the huge amount of energy stored in its body, the elemental lord had almost unlimited energy. It was completely fine to continue fighting for at least a few hours.
Boom!!!
As Ji Feng continued to make choices, the elemental lord began to create elemental clones one after another. These elemental clones all rushed towards Eleven and the others and launched self-destruction attacks.
On the other side, Shi Yu saw through the other party’s thoughts and said, “Senior Ji, your pet isn’t the only one with backup energy.”
Elemental Lord clones rushed over one after another and exploded in front of Eleven, the Bean Bear, and the others, causing an incomparable explosion. Under the eruption of energy, Eleven and the others ignored it and were about to counterattack.
Every Bean Bear had mastered the storage lightning skill. The energy in their bodies could be converted into electricity and transmitted to their main bodies. In other words, every accumulated Bean Bear was a backup energy source!
The Iron-eating Beast Army stood on the hardening domain, and endless electric currents flowed into Eleven’s body in the center. At the same time, its body suddenly enlarged and expanded. During this process, its entire body flickered with light and directly entered the extreme explosive state of overload strengthening energy!!
On the other side, Ji Feng and the elemental lord’s expressions froze.
“Roar!!!” Surrounded by many Bean Bears, Eleven only enlarged to nearly ten meters before stopping. However, its rising energy didn’t stop.
The power accumulated in his body, in addition to the power transmitted by the Bean Bear, and with the help of the sharpness skill, Eleven forcefully raised his extreme energy to 30 million. In this state, no matter how strong Eleven’s physique was, it instantly exceeded the load. But it didn’t matter. With the Undying Golden Body maintaining it, it would be fine since it was just one hit.
It could even be said that their cooperation was unstoppable. It was not a problem for them to erupt with two more rounds!
Eleven, who was in the Nine Li state, directly hit the elemental lord from afar!!!
Boom!!
Lightning filled the sky.
A lightning palm that was dozens of meters long and wide instantly formed. The power of the palm was overwhelming, as if it could suppress everything.
Giant Transformation+Thunder Palm+Deterrence!!!
Under an even more terrifying deterrence, the natural power of heaven and earth suddenly dissipated. Space seemed to have frozen. Under the powerful thunder palm, the pupils of the elemental lord opposite constricted, and it revealed an incredulous expression.
Master, this thing was as uncomfortable as f*cking fighting a Void Mantis!
It wanted to mobilize the power of nature, but it discovered that the power of nature had already scattered under the deterrence. With its control over the elements, it was not enough to exceed the control of the deterrence at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - Master Ji, Stop Scratching (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Master Ji, Stop Scratching (6)
So annoying!
At the same time, the deterrence on the Thunder Palm also shocked the elemental lord.
What did it have to do with him?
Ji Feng, who was using his talent with all his might, felt helpless. He could only look at everything in confusion.
Boom.
The Elemental Lord was directly slapped onto the arena by the Thunder Palm. Its elemental body was instantly torn apart by the lightning and shattered on the ground without any resistance!
Seeing this, Ji Feng was stunned.
On the other side, Shi Yu sighed. It was indeed a wise move to accumulate Bean Bears in advance. This way, it wouldn’t be difficult to fight.
At this moment, Shi Yu was fine, but Ji Feng’s mentality collapsed. He knew what the Void Mantis felt now. He had used an elegant spatial slash to attack the Iron-eating Beast, but it didn’t even break through its defense. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t break through its defense. Then, the other party erupted with an energy value comparable to an overlord and released a terrifying attack that instantly killed everything.
Who the hell could fight this?!
No wonder the Void Mantis was cursing at that time.
Now, Ji Feng also opened his mouth slightly and wanted to curse. He looked at the Iron-eating Beast Corps opposite him and didn’t understand why there was such a pet. What kind of battle strategy was this?
Of course, the most shocked at this moment was still the members of the various bureaus who had been watching the battle, as well as the local president of Star Capital. They were stunned as they watched the outcome of this battle. Although they wouldn’t be too surprised no matter who won, because both outcomes were possible, they never expected that the former Sequence fifth Ji Feng actually couldn’t even break through the other party’s defense when facing Shi Yu.
......
The trump card pet was even less of a match for the other party’s one hit.
“This…” Director Zhong was stunned, and the recorder beside him was also stunned. The last time Ji Feng lost so badly, it seemed to be when he found a legendary Beast Tamer to challenge…
“Is this kid a monster? He turned that legendary resource into strength so quickly?” Principal Feng was also extremely shocked.
This speed of becoming stronger was too fast. Lu Qingyi had clearly told him previously that Eleven, who didn’t use the power of the Demon God, was about the same strength as the Wind Demon Lion, but from the looks of it, that wasn’t the case.
At the same time, in the arena, Ji Feng’s expression instantly darkened. He suddenly recalled the power of the Demon God that Shi Yu had mentioned in the Space Emperor Ruins… During the battle just now, Shi Yu and the others… didn’t seem to have used it.
“Thank you for the match.” Facing the opponent whose face darkened, Shi Yu smiled. This smile made Director Zhong, President Ma, and the others instantly fall silent!
The officials had never acknowledged the title of the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, but now… why did they feel that this title was so true to its name?
…
That day, the Sequence Battle Committee announced the results of the challenge.
In various places in Dong Huang, the members of the Sequence battle looked at the latest news on the Sequence website in silence.
Sequence 7 Ji Feng challenged Sequence 5 Shi Yu, and Ji Feng lost!
If it was said that without the battle results of the contestants to prove Shi Yu’s identity as fifth in the Sequence, some people still had a wait-and-see attitude, then now, many people were silent. The original fifth in the Sequence… had lost to Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu, the two students from Ancient Capital University…
Lu Qingyi was alright, about the same age as Ji Feng, but Shi Yu… was clearly ridiculous at the age of 20!
There was a heated discussion on the Internet.
Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, and the others were silently browsing the news. Below was the place where a group of Beast Tamers were discussing.
[Iron-eating Beast Warrior]: Invincible, invincible. Is there a problem with calling him the number one person below the legendary level this time? Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu are both from Ancient Capital University. They definitely fought before. Their ranking hasn’t changed, which means that Shi Yu is stronger!
[Bug Catching Boy]: Big Boss Shi Yu is the number one in the world. He’s proficient in battle, archeology, and feeding. He’s too awesome. Is there anything Big Boss Shi Yu doesn’t know!
[I’m Not Buggy] replied: Probably not. Even if not now, there will probably be in the future. With such an outstanding group of pets, I’ll even believe that Shi Yu developed a new mechanical school tomorrow!
Seeing this, Gao Xuan frowned. He felt that the current netizens were more or less a little sick.
Mechanics were the foundation of Dong Huang and the seven countries. If a totem battle really happened, they still had to rely on the mechanical army. Did these people really think that Mechanics were that easy?
He directly clicked on this [I’m Not Buggy], suppressed his mood to argue with him along the Internet, and directly blocked him.

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (1)
Shi Yu stabilized his ranking by fighting the seventh-rank Ji Feng.
Regarding this, there was a heated discussion on the Internet.
In Shi Yu’s room in the Ancient Capital Technology Garden, Buggy browsed through the comments. After casually sending a few messages with its account [I’m Not Buggy], it happily went offline!
“Wu ~!!”
Buggy’s eyes flickered. Stupid mortals, wait for tomorrow to see the mechanical phantom it created!
Although it was definitely the Beast Tamer who went to show off again, as long as the audience wasn’t stupid, they could judge and analyze that this phantom should be related to it!
Mechanical phantom beasts, illusions, weren’t they its worm’s imagination, illusions!
“Master, a mole has been discovered.”
At the side, Ling immediately detected Buggy’s message on the Internet and reported to Shi Yu.
“Wu!!”
Buggy turned to look at Ling. How could it defame Buggy for nothing!
“Mi!! (Let’s do something serious!)”
Chi Tong, who was watching the movie with Susu, also looked at Buggy.
It waited for “Lost History 001: Legend of Mu Huiyin” 3 until the flowers withered.
This preview was already filmed. Hurry up and edit it and upload it.
Reading on Myb o xno vel. com ,Please!
“Wu! (Leave it to Ling!)”
Buggy was bold and confident.
It was already in charge of scenes and special effects. How could they let it edit?
In this aspect, Ling should be a professional.
“Ning, Ning.”
Susu was anxious. It told the pets to be quiet and not disturb its movie.
It was anxious to watch this environmental-related movie. It wished it could transmigrate and cleanse everything!
“Mi…”
Chi Tong poked Susu. This didn’t look good. They should watch some battle shows!!
Susu shook its head fiercely. It would talk about it after it finished watching these environmental movies.
It held a small notebook and recorded what it saw.
[The Mechanic class is a big source of pollution to the ocean environment. It will remember this.]
[At the same time, seven islands!! Bad guy!!]
Because Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City were on good terms and valued the ocean environment, most of Dong Huang’s environmental protection movies portrayed the seven islands next door as villains, directly making Susu anxious.
It asked Shi Yu telepathically when they were going to the seven islands to fight.
Especially after learning that the Rainbow Sea was polluted by the forbidden weapons of the seven islands, Susu directly bore a grudge+10086 and wanted to talk to the legendary Valkyrie of the seven islands.
“Don’t worry about Buggy,” Shi Yu, who was lying on the bed, said casually with his cell phone.
“Ling, help edit the footage. By the way, give Ice Dragon more shots and let Ice Dragon’s image be more positive and stronger. It has to be Mu Huiyin’s greatest support. Well, let Ice Dragon be the protagonist this time.”
Chi Tong: “?”
“It can’t be helped. This is what Mother Dragon requested herself. She wants our video to publicize its powerful heroic bearing. Although it’s a little like tampering with history, when we go to the seven islands, we still have to find Mother Dragon to be our bodyguard.”
Susu: Moo! (Yay!)
Water flooded the seven islands! Ice could seal the seven islands!
Chi Tong: QAQ, but shouldn’t the female lead be it?
“You’ll suffer a small loss and do something big. When the time comes, let Mother Dragon kill two more overlord undead for you. It’ll definitely be a good deal.”
Chi Tong: !
Ling hesitated for a moment. Legend of Mu Huiyin 3, it was time to talk about Mu Huiyin suppressing the Ice River Totem with the Ice Dragon in her later years. It was also the last part of the preview trilogy…
The first video made a name for itself and laid the foundation. The second video promoted Ancient Capital University and the Heroic Ruins. The third video was to promote the history of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain and the Icefield, making Icefield City a tourist holy land. It would lead the iron-eating beast industry and lick the Ice Dragon at the same time.
Master was scheming!
“Then leave it to me.” Ling sighed.
“I’ll leave it to you ~” Shi Yu continued to lie down and search with the cell phone index.
After fighting Ji Feng, Shi Yu slipped away.
Because at that time, both Director Zhong and Principal Feng wanted to talk to Shi Yu in detail and figure out Shi Yu’s current battle power.
Even Ji Feng himself wanted to communicate more with Shi Yu after losing to understand the true difference between him and Shi Yu.
Regarding this, Shi Yu, who found it troublesome, naturally couldn’t give in. Moreover, if he communicated with them in depth now, in less than two days, Eleven and the others would be added with more points. Wouldn’t their battle power be updated again? Therefore, it was meaningless and a pure waste of time.
He directly slipped back with the excuse of preparing for the Mechanical Conference.
However, this made Director Zhong, President Ma, and Ji Feng even more stunned. Mechanical Conference, what Mechanical Conference? What did the Mechanical Conference have to do with him?
After returning, Shi Yu naturally didn’t prepare for any meeting. Instead, he continued to slack off. At the same time, he also called his pets to slack off together. The special training in the Space Emperor Ruins was already bitter enough. It was understandable for him to slack off for the next few days.
Although Shi Yu had called his pets to slack off together, every pet’s response was different.
Chi Tong and Buggy completed the last trailer of Mu Huiyin’s legend.
On the other hand, Susu was obsessed with environmental movies under Chi Tong’s recommendation.
As for Eleven, it originally wanted to roll it up. However, the recent high-intensity battles and the additional points of super skills had indeed made Eleven tired both physically and mentally. Therefore, it chose to slack off and squeeze the Bean Bears to train the army drills as a form of relaxation.
The training of the Bean Bear could also increase its strength. It was training and lazing around. The world where the clones were injured appeared again.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (2)
As for Baby Ginseng, it was really resting. It lay there and condensed the time mark.
Of course, although he was lazing around, Shi Yu wasn’t really lazing around. He was thinking about Eleven’s new evolution form.
Although now that he had the Spirit Accumulation Jade given by his senior, the power of the Demon God was no longer a one-time consumable, it would probably take a long time for it to be large enough to support Eleven’s evolution.
At least before the World Tournament, there was definitely not much hope, because the strengthening speed of the Spirit Accumulation Jade was not very fast. In eight months, it would at most replenish the power of the Demon God that Eleven had consumed previously.
It would probably take at least eight to ten years to accumulate enough to evolve.
Therefore, Shi Yu was looking for skills or materials that could assist the power of the Demon God to help Eleven evolve.
At the moment, Shi Yu had another goal. It was to let Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling evolve another round before the world competition! They would cooperate with legendary resources to break through to overlord!
