On Ling’s side, it must have evolved around the form of the super mecha and the Wind Kirin fossil. Ling could worry about this itself. It only needed to find the materials.
As for Susu, if it broke through to the overlord level, it could receive the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins. It was equivalent to evolution.
Chi Tong and Buggy’s Spirit Release and Dragon of Imagination skill proficiency had reached perfect level, which was equivalent to a different evolution. They just had to add points.
Therefore, the focus that needed to be paid more attention to was Eleven and Baby Ginseng.
Among them, Baby Ginseng had a mutation. With its current race, the suitable legendary, Mythical, and resources that contained a certain amount of mutation power had a chance of being optimized again on the current Undying Ginseng race. Shi Yu planned to start with light and earth.
As for Eleven, it might be the most difficult to evolve again.
Because its current race was the strongest in the team. The difficulty of evolution was obvious.
However, Shi Yu already had some thoughts.
Reading on Myb o xno vel. com ,Please!
The Aurora Magnetic Gold sent by Principal Feng had a chance to allow Eleven to awaken “White Thunder”. This was lightning that contained the nature of light, or it could also be called Light Thunder.
As for the power of the Demon God of the meteorite fragment, after it was absorbed by the hardening substance that contained lightning, it could give birth to the “black lightning” of the dark-element Demon God nature. It could also be called the dark lightning. This was the embodiment of the power of the Demon God in Eleven.
The black and white lightning was indeed as Principal Feng had said. They were two conflicting attributes, so he felt that it was normal for Eleven, who had a certain level of affinity for the dark element, to not have much hope of learning the white lightning.
However, conflicting powers… This word suddenly reminded Shi Yu of Chi Tong’s Interlocking Sword.
Who said that conflicting powers couldn’t be used together?
Not only could it be done, but it could also be stronger.
Light and darkness intertwined, not inferior to fire and water.
If Eleven could master the Light and Darkness Interlocking Lightning and evolve with it, its strength would definitely be stronger.
At that time, under the lightning armor of the Yin Yang Divine Thunder, the overload brought by the intersection of attributes would definitely be super explosive. Coupled with the Undying Golden Body and Impregnable, it would definitely be invincible.
Therefore, Shi Yu needed a thunder-element evolution skill that could perfectly fuse the black and white lightning…
He searched, but couldn’t find it.
However, Shi Yu did find a metal-element evolution skill.
< Name > Super Alloy
[Attributes]: Machinery, Metal
[Level]: Super level
< Introduction > It can synthesize the power of different metals and complete super evolution. The success rate of evolution depends on skill proficiency, metal compatibility, and one’s endurance of new alloys.
Shi Yu originally couldn’t find this skill because this skill didn’t exist in Dong Huang.
This skill was the racial skill of the mechanical and metal-element mechanical pet, the “Alloy Monster”. This pet also had the technology to create the Alloy Monster. Only Shen Feng and the Seven Islands had it.
Although this skill wasn’t thunder-element, if Eleven could master it, there was a certain chance of completing the evolution of light and darkness.
This was because Eleven’s hardening was also the iron-eating beast’s racial evolution skill. At the maximum level, it could already absorb special energy and change its metal nature.
As long as Eleven entered the form of a demon god through hardening and gave itself the power of a demon god, at the same time, it could use the White Thunder to modify part of the hardening substance. Then, it could activate the super alloy skill and let the Light Thunder Hardening and Dark Thunder Hardening fuse. In theory, it could complete the evolution of light and darkness.
However, the problem was that Shi Yu didn’t know if Eleven could learn this skill with a Mechanic.
At the same time, he thought that it was equivalent to gambling. He couldn’t be sure of the success rate. After all, who knew if the light and dark metals could be perfectly fused?
At the same time, he thought that it was equivalent to gambling. He couldn’t be sure of the success rate. After all, who knew if the light and dark metals could be perfectly fused?
With this thought in mind, Shi Yu organized it and planned to throw it to Ling to analyze.
They could study if Eleven could learn the superalloy skill of the Mechanic class!
If there was no chance, there was no need to find a place to replicate the skill. He could only wait until the skill fusion was activated before helping Eleven bet on an evolution skill.
After that, he would study the success rate of the super golden light dark evolution.
If it succeeded, the power of Yin Yang Interlocking would definitely not be inferior to the power of time.
The fusion of light, darkness, yin, and yang, was indistinguishable. It was chaos. The Nine Li Battle Beast directly evolved. The Chaos Panda and the Limitless Panda should be stronger than Emperor Wu’s Demon God Panda.
....
That night, the night before the Mechanical Conference.
Shi Yu was still lying on the ground when he received an invitation from Principal Feng.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 533  The Eve of the Mechanical Conference (3)
"How is it? Why isn't there any movement at all? Why don't you follow us to a banquet first?"
"The banquet of the Mechanical Conference, the nine major universities, and dozens of participating representatives of the Mechanical Research Institute who are qualified to participate in the Mechanical Conference will attend."
"Oh, alright." Shi Yu shook his confused head and touched his stomach. He thought about his food for the past half a month. The last normal meal was when he was in Dragon Palace City. He hadn't eaten anything good in a long time… The Mechanical Conference banquet shouldn't be bad, right? Then he should go take a look.
He turned around and put his pets into the ruins space, leaving his beloved Buggy behind. "Teleport."
Buggy: "!"
Star Capital Technology Garden, Seven Star Hotel.
Shi Yu followed Principal Feng, Grandma Li, Dean Hao, and the others here.
"Senior Shi Yu…" To Shi Yu's surprise, just as they entered, a little girl pounced on Shi Yu. When she saw Shi Yu, she looked excited.
"Fang Lan." Shi Yu was immediately speechless when he saw the little girl guarding the door.
Principal Feng and the others looked at this youngest member of Bureau 11 and chuckled. Fang Lan's parents were both professors of the Mechanic Department of Kong University, so it wasn't strange for them to appear here.
"Senior Shi Yu, I've opened up the Beast Taming Space!" Fang Lan said excitedly with Shi Yu. "In addition, I've already finished self-studying the Mechanic classes of high school and first and second years. I've also done the test questions. I got full marks for all of them."
"Grandpa Feng, Grandma Li, Grandpa Hao…" She then greeted the others.
"Ah." Shi Yu touched his chin. It was pretty fast. From the looks of it, the memory water drop was very useful. How long had it been?
However, when Shi Yu looked at Fang Lan's dark eye circles, he kept feeling that this girl was working hard. "Healthiness first…"
"It's alright." Fang Lan was not afraid at all. In order to contract the mechanical phantom beast, she directly turned into a time management master. First, she asked her family for spatial cultivation resources, wanting to open up the Beast Taming Space as soon as possible. Then, she took various supplements, such as the Refreshing Capsule, stayed up late to study and do questions. Her hard work paid off. In just half a month, she completed all the Mechanic research topics from first to second year.
"Alright." The corners of Shi Yu's mouth twitched. Forget it, I should choose a mechanical phantom beast for this girl after the meeting. Shi Yu could understand the anticipation of the other party and even the entire family.
After the Mechanical Conference ended, mechanical phantom beasts were no longer a rare species. A new chapter would begin in Dong Huang's mechanical domain.
For this, during this period of time, under Shi Yu's suggestion, Grandma Li's people had often mixed in the Dong Huang exchange team and crazily bought ancient fossils from other countries…
"Little Lan, where are your parents?" Principal Feng asked.
"On the second floor inside."
"I see. You can bring us over," Principal Feng said with a smile.
"Alright ~"
Fang Lan ran over to report her mission progress to Shi Yu and immediately said happily. Under Fang Lan's lead, everyone began to walk to the second floor. During this process, Shi Yu was surprised to see Xiao Shuang and General Xiao Qin on the first floor. The two of them also discovered the new Ancient Capital University team. At the same time, they looked at Shi Yu in surprise.
Why was Shi Yu here?
There were still many familiar faces. What was even more surprising was that Shi Yu was still on the first floor when he discovered Gao Xuan, who was being interviewed by the official media and was representing Imperial Capital University…
"I… Cough, cough, cough."
Opposite Gao Xuan, a female reporter and a male photographer were interviewing the youngest contestant of the Mechanical Conference. At this moment, halfway through the interview, Gao Xuan's gaze was suddenly attracted by Shi Yu and the others who passed by not far away. Then, he immediately choked.
Gao Xuan widened his eyes and looked at the person who had just passed by. Holy shit, he knew the principal of Ancient Capital University. He also knew Dean Hao of Ancient Capital University's Mechanical College, but why was Shi Yu also following beside them?
Although Shi Yu was a genius figure of Ancient Capital University and represented the students, there was no need to bring Shi Yu to an event like the Mechanical Conference, right?
Just like how he wouldn't participate in the Feeding Conference and archeological Conference, why was Shi Yu here!
"Student Gao, are you alright?" The female reporter saw that Gao Xuan's emotions were suddenly unstable and immediately asked with concern.
At the same time, she slowly looked in the direction Gao Xuan was looking at with widened eyes. Then, she saw Shi Yu, who was walking and glancing over curiously.
The female reporter: !!!
When she saw Shi Yu, she was immediately shocked. This was because Shi Yu was also the person she had always wanted to interview. This was a super hot topic ranked fifth in the Sequence. Unfortunately, she had never found an opportunity and couldn't contact him.
Why… Why would Shi Yu appear at the Mechanical Conference?
Yes, after interviewing Gao Xuan, she would interview Shi Yu!!! She would ask about the situation!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - Crossing Worlds (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Crossing Worlds (1)
Seven Star Hotel.
At this moment, there were indeed many celebrities gathered here.
Among the hundreds of people, there was no one whose identity was unknown.
The team from Ancient Capital University attracted the attention of many people.
The reason was very simple. Although the Mechanical Conference was worth taking seriously, it was very intriguing that the principal of Ancient Capital University had also come with Dean Hao.
Generally speaking, if there were no especially big results, the person in charge of the Mechanic class of every school in every Mechanical Conference, plus their own scientific research team, would be enough.
The principals of the various schools basically wouldn’t follow.
At the same time, not only was Principal Feng beside Dean Hao of Ancient Capital University, but there was also someone wearing an Iron-eating Beast shirt beside him. It was even more ridiculous. Wasn’t that the national champion, Sequence five Shi Yu?
He actually… actually came?
Apart from that, the big boss of the fossil field, Dr. Li Lianping, actually came too? And she was with Ancient Capital University… What was going on!
Among the group, only Dean Hao was a famous person in the mechanical field. The other three were all from the archeological world. This crossed from their industry.
Many people followed, such as the Xiao sisters, the few official reporters who were let in today, and Gao Xuan, who they had hurriedly ended the interview with…
“Shi Yu.”
......
Legend Xiao Shuang and General Xiao Qin followed Shi Yu and made him stop.
“Sister Xiao Shuang, Sister Xiao Qin. You’re here too.”
Shi Yu was forced to pretend that he had just seen them and said in surprise.
However, he was really a little surprised. Among the two of them, Xiao Shuang was a legendary mechanical genius in the fourth bureau. It was nothing for her to appear in the Mechanical Conference.
However, shouldn’t General Xiao Qin be working for the Marine Environmental Protection Department at this moment? Why was she here?
Was she on leave? Why didn’t he know!
Oh, the Environmental Protection Department had yet to issue missions and formulate rules and regulations. That was fine.
The two of them also greeted Principal Feng, Dean Hao, and the others. Then, they answered Shi Yu,
“Isn’t it normal for us to appear here?”
Legend Xiao Shuang smiled and said, “Speaking of which, the speed of your Sequence ranking increase is really unexpected. Little Qin hasn’t entered the top 20 yet, but you’ve already become the number one person below the legendary level.”
Xiao Qin was speechless at the side. If it weren’t for the fact that her trump card had unfortunately sacrificed itself and spent a lot of time recuperating and adjusting, it would have been nothing to enter the top 20.
“You flatter me. It’s just gossip,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Is that so? Speaking of which, you should have already contracted or prepared to contract the Hundred Transformations Stone rewarded by the National League, right? In that case, you’ve already made the decision to step into the mechanical field. Are you here to broaden your horizons this time?” Legend Xiao Shuang asked.
Recently, she, a legendary Mechanic, had also been shocked by Shi Yu’s growth speed and various news. When she thought of how such a super genius had previously thought of involving the mechanical field, she was very curious about how far Shi Yu could go.
“Uh…” Principal Feng, Grandma Li, Dean Hao, and the others had strange expressions.
They had thoughts in their hearts, but they didn’t say them.
If they said it, they would scare them in the fourth bureau!
How was Shi Yu stepping into the mechanical field? He was clearly here to challenge the mechanical field. He wanted to change the current mechanical field structure!
This innovation was probably not much inferior to the technological products created by the respected Mechanics in the fourth bureau.
Fang Lan also secretly looked at her former idol, Legend Xiao Shuang. She didn’t expect the other party to actually talk to Senior Shi Yu!
Although she didn’t understand, she could understand that the other party seemed to have misunderstood something about Senior Shi Yu.
“Ah, yes and no. I’m here to represent Ancient Capital University in the Mechanical Conference.” Shi Yu revealed a hearty smile.
“Huh???” As soon as he finished speaking, Legend Xiao Shuang and General Xiao Qin were stunned.
Legend Xiao Shuang knew that Shi Yu had never come into contact with the Mechanic class before, and General Xiao Qin knew even more. This was because she was in charge of modifying and upgrading the Marine Base of the Environmental Protection Department. At that time, Shi Yu was like a mechanical noob, asking her questions.
Was there no one else in the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University? He wanted Shi Yu to represent Ancient Capital University in the Mechanical Conference?
“What!!!”
At the same time, an incredulous voice sounded.
A sweet-looking female reporter with shoulder-length hair and a business suit ran over anxiously, as if she had heard some incredible news.
“I’m very sorry to disturb you. I’m a reporter from Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Bai Lu. This is my interview certificate for this Mechanical Conference.” After the reporter barged in, she suddenly reacted and immediately carefully introduced his identity to the many big shots present. At the same time, she said, “I just heard that Student Shi Yu, you want to represent Ancient Capital University to participate in this Mechanical Conference. Is that true??”
She looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
Xiao Shuang and Xiao Qin also wanted to know if it was true. What a joke.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s focus was on this reporter. Bai Lu? What was her relationship with Dong Huang Radio and Television Station’s colleagues Gu Yu and Han Lu, who were in charge of explaining the National League? They literally all had weather related names, they’ve almost gathered all the 24 solar terms! Was it their real or fake names?
“Yes,” Shi Yu replied as he complained in his heart.
His answer directly confused the Xiao sisters. Behind them, two reporters hurriedly arrived at Imperial Capital University’s Gao Xuan on the second floor. They didn’t return to Imperial Capital University immediately, but followed over and heard this news that shocked him.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - Crossing Worlds (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Crossing Worlds (2)
Gao Xuan opened his mouth slightly. He wanted to ask what was going on more than anyone present.
Before coming to the banquet today, he even believed what a fool said on the Internet about Shi Yu researching a new mechanical faction tomorrow. Why was reality even more illusory than the Internet? Shi Yu really came to the Mechanical Innovation Conference?
After he arrived, he wasn’t in a hurry to interrupt. Instead, he watched silently from the side. This was because this reporter, Bailu, definitely wouldn’t disappoint him. She would ask what he wanted to know.
As expected, after being shocked, reporter Bai Lu immediately said, “Student Shi Yu, can I interview you? It’s just a little time, please.”
Shi Yu turned his head to look at Principal Feng and the others, then at Legend Xiao Shuang and the others. He nodded and said, “Alright, as quickly as possible.”
“According to what I know, isn’t your main profession an archeologist? Although you’ve also made incomparable achievements in battle, feeding, and other fields, these fields shouldn’t be very related to the Mechanic class. How did you become a representative of the Ancient Capital University’s Mechanical Conference?”
“Well, to answer that, technology has already integrated into various fields. Archeology, feeding, and core projects can’t do without the support of machines. For example, most archeologists need detection machines to analyze the year of ancient artifacts. Therefore, as an archeologist, I know a little machinery. As a Beast Tamer, it’s very normal for me to know a little feeding.”
“As for why I came to participate in the Mechanical Conference… It’s naturally because I accidentally developed some results.”
Gao Xuan : “…”
Xiao Shuang and Xiao Qin : “…”
Was this guy sure that the bit of “detection machines that analyze the year of ancient artifacts” was the same as the bit of machinery needed to participate in the Mechanical Conference?
“Ah…” The reporter was speechless.” In other words, with you as the core researcher, you developed a technological mechanical product that’s enough to represent Ancient Capital University in the Mechanical Conference, right? May I ask if you can reveal the type of this mechanical product, what field it will be suitable for? For what reason did you cross worlds to develop it? ”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment and said, “The type? It’s pretty wide, right? It’s suitable for the battle domain… Feeding domain… Archeology domain… Everything is involved a little. As for the goal…”
......
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It must still revolve around archeology.”
Bai Lu’s eyes lit up. “So, it’s a mechanical device that can assist archeology?”
In that case, it didn’t seem that difficult to understand.
However, the youngest contestant of the Mechanical Conference might have to be changed.
“Yes.” Shi Yu was certain that using the power of technology to revive fossils from the dinosaur era of the totem era into mechanical dinosaurs to study ancient times through it was also considered a support archeological equipment.
“…” Beside him, Gao Xuan, who was originally in a rather depressed mood, heaved a sigh of relief. He was wondering why Shi Yu would come to participate in the Mechanical Conference. From Shi Yu’s resume, it was impossible. He probably used the platform of Ancient Capital University to come up with some machines to assist in archeology and then come to earn honor.
In the previous batches, the research results of the Mechanics of Ancient Capital University were also archeological machines. There was nothing new. Compared to high-end products like Star Capital, Imperial Capital, and Demon Capital University, they were not outstanding.
It looked like it was the same for Ancient Capital University this year. In fact, from the situation of pushing Shi Yu out, there was completely no one left.
At the thought of this, Gao Xuan was relieved… Although he didn’t know why he cared so much about Shi Yu.
“Student Shi Yu is indeed a genius…” Reporter Bai Lu still sighed.
No matter what, it was already very impressive to be so omnipotent.
At the side, after a pause, Legend Xiao Shuang and General Xiao Qin couldn’t help but sigh. Shi Yu really liked to cause trouble. An archeological support machine?
Interesting. They wanted to see what would be displayed tomorrow. If it wasn’t inferior to the archeological support machines displayed by the previous batches of Ancient Capital University, it was enough to show that Shi Yu also had a certain amount of talent in the Mechanic class. This was definitely impressive.
A person who displayed talent in many fields at the same time was undoubtedly a monster.
At this moment, Principal Feng and the others looked at Legend Xiao Shuang, General Xiao Qin, Reporter Bai Lu, and Gao Xuan, who had calmed down not far away. They muttered in their hearts, feeling that they had misunderstood something. Did they subconsciously ignore that Shi Yu said that his research results also involved battle and feeding??
“In short, everything will be revealed tomorrow.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’m very confident that this is definitely a great invention!”
....
Since Shi Yu had said so, be it Reporter Bai Lu, Legend Xiao Shuang, or General Xiao Qin, they didn’t ask further. In any case, they would know tomorrow. However, looking at Shi Yu’s smug expression, it looked like Shi Yu was really very satisfied with his research results.
They thought about it carefully. This was normal. After all, they had crossed over. If there were any results, it was worth being proud of.
Gao Xuan left indifferently and didn’t mind. It was indeed beyond his understanding that Shi Yu could reach Sequence fifth. He had already treated Shi Yu as the target he needed to surpass the most in battle, but in the field of machinery, he didn’t need to care about Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - Crossing Worlds (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Crossing Worlds (3)
At the age of 13, he successfully created a virtual electronic life form himself and used it to hack into the local association’s network. Then, in the learning of the fourth bureau, he invented dozens of mechanical patents of various sizes. Even the other members of the fourth bureau were amazed by his achievements in this field.
And this year’s Mechanical Conference, what he brought was a research result that he had studied for a full three years. In the future, it was enough to change the structure of the Beast Taming Domain!
In his opinion, if this research result could be popularized, it would not be inferior to the green cocoon system developed by Shi Yu at all, or even stronger!
It could be said that he was here for the gold award of this year’s Mechanical Conference, which was first place. At that time, with research funds, top-notch mechanical materials, and various investments for him to choose from, he could quickly catch up to Shi Yu in battle strength.
That night, Shi Yu ate very happily at the Mechanical Conference banquet. He also obtained a few news. For example, at this year’s Mechanical Conference, apart from the fourth bureau’s judging, there were also two legendary Mechanics from abroad who came to Dong Huang to exchange and learn as judges. It was very grand and would even be broadcasted live on the Internet.
At the same time, Shi Yu didn’t notice or care. His interview answer soon became a trending topic. Gao Xuan’s interview couldn’t even compare to the heat of Shi Yu’s interview.
The reason was very simple. At this moment, because Shi Yu had just defeated Ji Feng, he steadily sat in the fifth place of the Sequence and was in the limelight. Now, there was news that the number one person below the legendary level, the super genius of archeology, Feeding, and Battle, Shi Yu, had run to participate in the Mechanical Conference again. Who wouldn’t be curious and shocked?
Soon, comments about this interview filled the Internet!!
[Bug Catching Boy]: Holy shit, what did I say on the last trending topic? Is there anything Big Boss Shi Yu doesn’t know? Look, I’m here to participate in the Mechanical Conference today.
[Science Fatty]: It’s ridiculous, but he should be here to increase his resume. A machine to assist in archeology… It’s probably still the same as a few years ago at Ancient Capital University, but I feel that there’s really no need. God Shi Yu’s experience is already legendary. There’s no need to add mechanical achievements.
Most of the netizens were very rational. Although they looked forward to what Shi Yu could do at the Mechanical Conference, their minds were also very clear. Moreover, the machines that studied archeology had long been studied to death. What innovation could there be?
Of course, this didn’t stop many people from suddenly paying attention to the Mechanical Conference that they originally didn’t pay much attention to. After all, Shi Yu’s name was even more popular than the Mechanical Conference recently.
[I’m Not Buggy]: No, it shouldn’t be that simple. Look at the content carefully. The types of machines are wide and suitable for battle domains… Feeding domain… The Archaeological domain is clearly not simple. In addition, Shi Yu himself said that it was a very great invention. It’s completely worth looking forward to.
......
There were also netizens who were very stubborn, such as [I’m not Buggy].
At this moment, the Internet was in an uproar, especially on the forum of the Mechanical Conference. The hundreds of representatives from the factions who came to participate in the Mechanical Conference were also watching this interview in silence and fell into deep thought. What the hell? You, an archeologist, came to the Mechanical Conference after harming the Feeding Conference?
…
The next day.
Star Capital Technology Garden, National Science and Technology Exhibition Center.
The huge venue was full.
Thousands of elites and participating teams sat in their seats, looking forward to the start of this event.
In the seat of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu was wearing a white research suit. A green Rubik’s Cube floated beside his shoulder. On the Rubik’s Cube screen, the virtual sprite “Ling” opened its eyes curiously.
[Master, it’s about to begin. Can I take a look underground later?] Ling said telepathically.
[Yes.] Shi Yu nodded.
At the same time, he instructed Ling: “You can take a look… But don’t have any bold ideas.”
[No way.] Ling.
The steel venue in the center of the venue was connected to the complicated mechanical equipment in the basement. Next, all the participants would display their works on the steel venue. The support machines and energy needed could be satisfied and cooperated with in the mechanical energy room underground, apart from the ones they brought.
“The judges this time are two legendary Mechanics from the fourth bureau… The president of the Star Capital Association.”
“Apart from that, there’s also a legendary Mechanic from Shen Feng and a legendary Mechanic from the seven islands. They will be special guests.”
“Every year, the nine major universities will display it first. Then, the scientific research teams of the various large financial groups and some local research institutes will display the results. The meeting will last for a few days. Our order is the eighth. The eighth will be displayed and we’ll be done today,” Dean Hao said.
He wasn’t introducing it to Principal Feng, Shi Yu, and the others, but to the few Mechanic professors and core students of Ancient Capital University beside him.
“We all understand the logic, but this time, is our Ancient Capital University… really represented by Shi Yu?”
At this moment, the professors and students were still stunned. Not to mention the others, even those from Ancient Capital University didn’t know why the representative of Ancient Capital University for this Mechanical Conference was Shi Yu. They couldn’t think of any mechanical research results from Ancient Capital University that Shi Yu would participate in this year.
If he wasn’t showing these, in other words, what he was showing was completely developed by Shi Yu himself?
“Let’s wait and see,” Dean Hao said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - Crossing Worlds (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Crossing Worlds (4)
“It’s about to begin…” Principal Feng looked at the time and took a deep breath.
In theory, it would definitely be his turn today. He looked at Shi Yu, who was sitting quietly beside him. Thinking of Shi Yu’s performance at the Feeding Conference, he suddenly had more confidence in Shi Yu. After the Feeding Conference, the Mechanical Conference would definitely be fine. After all, they were all super results that could change the current situation!
After today, Ancient Capital University would definitely become famous in Dong Huang again.
Before the meeting, the judges and guests entered one by one.
The first was born in the capital and graduated from Imperial Capital University. At the moment, he was the legendary Mechanic Elder Liu, who was in charge of the forbidden weapon project at the Dong Huang Academy of Science. At the same time, he was also the guide of the genius Mechanic Gao Xuan from Imperial Capital University.
Then, there was a middle-aged woman with brown hair and a serious expression. She was also the legendary Mechanic of the fourth bureau. Her name was Mei Xiuying, and she was the wife of the legendary navy general Xiao Hai. She was also the mother of the legendary Mechanic Xiao Shuang and the navy general Xiao Qin. She had made major contributions to the research of sea, land, and air strategic overlord-level machines.
The last person was President Ma of the Star Capital Association. He wasn’t a legendary Mechanic in the traditional sense. However, among the contracted pets, there were also mechanical pets. In a place like Star Capital where mechanical culture was prosperous, his personal style would inevitably be affected.
Apart from them, there was also a gray-haired old man from Shen Feng. He was also a legendary Mechanic named Chris Aches. The other was a legendary Beast Tamer from the seven islands next door, Ju Qianyao. For special reasons, the two of them came to Dong Huang to exchange and learn and came to the Mechanical Conference as guests.
As the World Tournament was imminent, the communication between the seven countries became more and more frequent.
Of course, apart from the legendary big boss on the platform, there were also big bosses in the crowd below. For example, the legendary Mechanic Xiao Shuang was sitting in the audience this time to watch the commotion.
Under the gaze of countless eyes, the host in charge of presiding over the Mechanical Conference appeared. He introduced the judges, guests, and the arrangements of the Mechanical Conference today. Under the cameras of many media and official media, the conference officially began!
The first to go on stage was the scientific research results led by Dr. Mo Qing of Star Capital University.
Dr. Mo Qing was a top-notch mechanical master in his fifties. He was dedicated to the research field of combination machinery and cultivation and was also a strong contestant in the industry. After all, to be able to make a name for himself in technological places like Star Capital and Star Capital University, he had to have some skills.
[Skill Training Machine]
After Dr. Mo Qing went on stage, the white screen lit up, and words appeared on it. The Mechanics who were assistants carried a huge nutritional cabin-type machine to the center of the venue and installed it on the spot.
Reading on Mybo xn o v el. com ,Please!
At the same time, Dr. Mo Qing chuckled and said,
“Everyone should be familiar with skill teaching machines and training machines. The market is filled with various technological skill training machines, and what we brought today is a little different from any kind on the market.”
Skill training machine…
There were actually many types of innovative machines that could be displayed in the Mechanical Conference. New mechanical pets, new training machines, new mechanical equipment, as long as they were related to machinery.
Among them, the skill machine was clearly the more convenient one. Who didn’t want their pets to easily learn a few more skills or quickly increase their skill proficiency?
“This skill machine mainly focuses on ‘dream training’.”
“At the moment, the training machines on the market are more targeted. They are all tailor-made for specific pets and specific skills. Moreover, they need Beast Tamers and pets to cooperate and use them. During the usage process, although it can more effectively increase the skill proficiency of the pets, similarly, Beast Tamers and pets also need to spend a lot of energy.”
“But this skill training machine is different. It can be used during the pet’s sleep and rest time, and it won’t make the pet feel tired the whole time. It also has the effect of strengthening mental strength.”
As Dr. Mo Qing finished speaking, the Mechanics and Beast Tamers present were stunned.
“Come.” Under Dr. Mo Qing’s greeting, an assistant carried a rabbit with green fur onto the arena. She quietly placed the low-level transcendent Whirlwind Rabbit on the skill training machine.
This skill training machine was similar to a huge nutrition cabin. After putting the Whirlwind Rabbit in, a special electromagnetic wave spread. At the same time, a new scene appeared on the screen.
On a green grassland, a Whirlwind Rabbit was running while frequently releasing wind blades.
“This skill machine can let the pet enter an absolute sleep state through special electric waves. Moreover, it can let the pet use its racial skills frequently in the dream according to a specific program. This isn’t just letting the pet dream. During this process, the special electric waves will also strengthen the dream’s physical memory and the pet’s mental strength, making the experience in the dream no different from the experience in reality, reaching the effect of increasing the skill proficiency.”
“It can be said that after the pet wakes up, due to the increase in mental strength, it won’t forget the contents of the dream, nor will it feel tired. Instead, the skill usage experience in the dream can be brought into reality!”
“After our experimental research, the fastest result at the moment is to let an ordinary Whirlwind Rabbit only need 11 months and 20 days to raise its wind blade proficiency to perfect level through daytime training and night machine teaching without any resources.”

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - Crossing Worlds (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Crossing Worlds (5)
“Of course, the skill training machine can not only increase the proficiency of the wind blade, but any active skill of any pet can be effectively improved through this machine. Its greatest meaning is still to use the pet’s free time to increase the skill proficiency efficiently!”
As Dr. Mo Qing finished speaking, the crowd fell silent for a moment before erupting.
On the Internet, Beast Tamers instantly drooled.
Holy shit.
“I want this.” Many young Mechanics were envious.
He could let his pet train when it slept? There was such a good thing?
After being stunned, the Mechanics present instantly understood how helpful a Beast Tamer could be to training pets if they had such a skill training machine.
“Star Capital University has already decided to fully invest the skill training machine in various places in Star Capital University for the students to use this year.” As Dr. Mo Qing finished speaking, on the platform, President Ma of Star Capital was full of smiles. He also felt that it was very good.
This way, the overall strength of the new generation in Star Capital could increase by a lot, greatly saving the time and resource cost of the Beast Tamers training skills.
On the other side, in the audience seats of the ancient capital.
After Star Capital University displayed it, Shi Yu muttered.
“Snatching bamboo shoots.” They didn’t even let their pets rest soundly when they slept. Why was he like Buggy? He had to train even when he slept. Even capitalists weren’t so black-hearted.
Absolute Sleep+Dream Training was exclusive to Buggy, but Shi Yu’s expression was shocked. He didn’t expect a Mechanic to study this model into a machine with extremely wide adaptability.
If it weren’t for the fact that he had found the iron-eating beast hardening cultivation method, this thing would be pretty good for the iron-eating beast.
Star Capital University was indeed something.
Reading on Mybo xn o v el. com ,Please!
“The research results of Star Capital University every year are all useful.” Principal Feng secretly complained about Dean Hao’s Mechanical College.
Dean Hao had a serious expression. Could they even compare? How much money did they have?
Right on the heels of that, Dr. Mo Qing continued to add and introduce it, proving that although the cost and consumption of this machine were not low, it was definitely not a loss if it was used on a large scale in places like the nine major universities and the Beast Tamer Troops. It was basically equivalent to using energy to exchange for the increase in speed of Beast Tamers and pets.
“This is really an impressive invention.” As Dr. Mo Qing finished speaking, the host also exclaimed and handed the evaluation rights to the three judges and two guests.
“Dr. Mo Qing has always been dedicated to the combination of technology and cultivation. This skill training machine has indeed achieved a perfect fusion of the two. As expected of Dr. Mo Qing. This machine is undoubtedly a very strategic product for the vast number of genius Beast Tamers in Dong Huang.” Old Liu nodded heavily, his expression surprised as he gave a high evaluation.
“That’s indeed the case. The increase in racial skill proficiency can also lead to the growth level of the pet. This is a relatively perfect cultivation machine,” Mei Xiuying said with a sigh.
Although this machine was more effective for weaker pets and more effective when the skill proficiency was lower, and it was basically for Beast Tamers below the master level, this group of people had the most Beast Tamers in Dong Huang.
If they could grow quickly, the meaning would be far-reaching. In short, as long as this machine could save those genius Beast Tamers half a year, it would be considered an extremely powerful research.
In the audience, Gao Xuan, a genius Mechanic, also nodded and felt that it was not bad.
“Dr. Aqi, Legend Ju, what do you think?” President Ma looked at the two foreign friends.
The young woman, Legend Ju, nodded in surprise and said, “It’s indeed not bad. Unfortunately, the cost and consumption are not small. It’s probably very difficult to apply on a large scale, but if it can be optimized, it’s definitely a huge boon to the grassroots of the Beast Taming Domain.”
She was not stingy with her praise. Of course, in her experience, this thing was already very difficult to optimize. But even so, it was not bad. It was unrealistic to want a product to be suitable for all levels. This kind of thing should be a good thing for those genius Beast Tamers with superior families. It could allow them to quickly transform resources into strength.
With this, there would be more geniuses in Dong Huang.
“Dream training machine.” Beside him, Dr Aqi smiled and said, “There’s also such a machine in Shen Feng, and it’s already applicable to various famous schools. It’s indeed as everyone said, its impact is extraordinary. It can effectively increase the growth speed of the younger generation. From the current results, this machine should still have a lot of room for optimization. It’s a very promising research result.”
As Dr. Aqi finished speaking, Dr. Mo Qing’s smile stopped.
“There are similar machines in Shen Feng??” President Ma was stunned.
“Yes.” Dr. Aqi was relatively proud. Dong Huang’s technological progress was still not good. An invention of this level could actually surprise these people?
However, it was also normal. In Dr. Aqi’s eyes, Dong Huang’s mechanical level was indeed not high. Together with the country Xue Yuan, it was barely close to their Shen Feng.
He had already expected how boring Dong Huang’s so-called Mechanical Conference would be. It was probably all stuff that Shen Feng had done.
At this moment, the various judges were recording various data evaluations on their evaluation tables. In the Mechanical Conference, every round of display was just a display. The final evaluation results would only be announced after the conference ended.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - Crossing Worlds (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Crossing Worlds (6)
It was divided into three awards, gold, silver, and bronze. There was one gold award, and the other two awards didn’t limit the number.
A moment later, everyone from Star Capital University went down.
“The last Gold Award was Star Capital University. Will it be the same this year?” After they left the stage, many participating teams discussed.
“I feel that this result is already very strong. It’s better than last year’s. I really want a skill training machine,” a young Beast Tamer said.
“But the problem is that this thing seems to be left behind by Shen Feng. If the Gold Award was given for something that those guys had researched for a long time, I feel a little unhappy.”
“Let’s face the difference. We have no choice. Let’s see the results of the other universities first.”
Then, research groups from other universities went on stage one after another.
The second was the research team of Kong Capital University, led by Fang Lan’s parents.
Their research results were a high-level commander race, a support-type mechanical pet called [Son of Heaven]. This pet mastered weather skills of various attributes such as Blizzard, Praying Rain, and Clear Sky. This support pet in many directions indeed made many people’s eyes light up.
It was still a pretty good invention.
Of course, compared to an invention with a wider range and more strategic meaning like the [Skill Training Machine], the meaning of the [Son of Weather] was not that great. After all, there were very few occasions where so many weather skills were needed.
It wasn’t like there weren’t pets and machines that specialized in one weather skill. This kind of miscellaneous research only made Kong Capital University show off their skills.
In the face of the second research result of the Mechanical Conference, Dr Aqi from Shen Feng also had a calm expression.
......
Then, the third, fourth, fifth, sixth…
The research teams of the various major universities came up one after another to show it. Among them, there were new machine products, new types of mechanical pets, and new theories, but compared to the [Skill Training Machine], they were actually much inferior and somewhat overshadowed.
At the same time, they didn’t receive any high praise from Dr Aqi.
“That Dr Aqi from Shen Feng is so smug.”
At this moment, on the Internet, there were already Beast Tamers who were unhappy with Dr Aqi.
On the side of Imperial Capital University, the old principal of Imperial Capital University was sitting in the seat. She had also been unhappy with Dr Aqi for a long time. Not only her, but many Mechanics present were also very unhappy. This was because this guy’s comments were all “Shen Feng this, Shen Feng that,” As if these innovative products were nothing in the Shen Feng Nation.
Why did they find such a thing to be a guest at this meeting?
Not to mention ordinary Mechanics, even the corners of the legendary Mechanics on the platform twitched. They were a little unhappy with Dr Aqi’s evaluation tone.
“This is very normal. Aren’t the Mechanics of Shen Feng always very arrogant? After all, that also comes from strength.” At Imperial Capital University, Gao Xuan’s expression was calm. “It’s our turn. I believe the next research results will shock his eyes and tear his pride apart.”
“Haha, Little Xuan, you’re right.” The old principal of Imperial Capital University laughed and nodded very confidently.
At this point of the Mechanical Conference, among the nine major universities, there were still three universities, Imperial Capital, Ancient Capital, and Demon Capital, that had not been displayed. In the first round, the value of Star Capital University’s [Skill Training Machine] was still the highest. After that, no more dazzling innovative products appeared.
A moment later.
“Sorry to have kept everyone waiting ~”
“Next, let’s invite the seventh display team.”
“From Imperial Capital University, a research team led by a Mechanic graduate, Gao Xuan, is displaying a new mechanical life form!!!”
As soon as the host finished speaking, the school emblem and Gao Xuan’s profile picture of the Imperial Capital University appeared on the big screen, as well as the type of product they wanted to show.
Team in-charge: Gao Xuan!
Show theme: New mechanical pet!!
As soon as the theme was out, the audience was surprised.
“It’s Gao Xuan.”
“Fourth round, Gao Xuan.”
On Imperial Capital University’s side, only Gao Xuan walked onto the arena. He was alone.
As soon as Gao Xuan appeared, everyone’s attention immediately focused.
The anticipation people had for him was even stronger than the exhibition team of Star Capital University.
Not only ordinary Mechanics, but even the two legends from other countries narrowed their eyes and their expressions became serious when it was Gao Xuan’s turn.
“It’s him, the one with the awakening talent?”
A Mechanic genius with the same talent as the Shen Feng Mechanical Legend and the Dong Huang Mechanical Legend…
Gao Xuan’s appearance also made Shi Yu, who was meditating with his eyes closed, open his eyes.
He sighed at the fact that he had encountered Gao Xuan at the Mechanical Conference.
Although it was very normal for Gao Xuan to participate in the Mechanical Conference as a Mechanic, Shi Yu still couldn’t help but sigh when he encountered Gao Xuan twice in a row. The path was quite narrow…
At this moment, Gao Xuan stood calmly in the arena and looked around.
He stretched out his arm and a black bracelet appeared in his palm.
At the same time, a picture of the black bracelet appeared on the big screen.
“This is a research result that can change the current structure of the Beast Taming Domain.”
After Gao Xuan appeared, his first words directly made the crowd boil.
Gao Xuan’s teacher, Elder Liu, was smiling. Dr. Mei Xiuying also revealed a shocked expression. President Ma, Dr. Aqi, Legend Ju Qianyao, and the others were even stunned.
Below, Principal Feng, Dean Hao, Shi Yu, Xiao Shuang, and the others also gathered their gazes on the thing in Gao Xuan’s hand.
“I call it the Ethereal Bracelet.”

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - Crossing Worlds (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Crossing Worlds (7)
“Etherealization, this term might not be unfamiliar to everyone. When the Beast Tamer level reaches level seven, they can use the Beast Taming Space to develop various legendary skills. Among them, etherealization is a self-protection skill that allows the body to turn ethereal and hide in an alternate space to make oneself invincible.”
“Therefore, after Beast Tamers reach level seven, their safety ability can be greatly improved in wild battles. However, for low-level Beast Tamers, they can’t master etherealization. Their own safety, even with the protection of various equipment, is still very easy to fall into a dangerous situation.”
“Among the skills of pets, there’s a skill called Concealment. When the skill proficiency of Concealment reaches transcendent, pets can use this skill to help Beast Tamers enter the Concealment state. The current state is very similar to etherealization.”
“The etherealized bracelet I developed is a kind of spatial system that has mastered transcendent-level concealment at the start. At the same time, it can sense danger and assist Beast Tamers in entering the etherealized state.”
“Its cost price is not high, and it can be mass-produced. Beast Tamers above the master level can afford it. Moreover, it can be maintained with electricity.”
“Holy shit.” As soon as Gao Xuan finished speaking, cries of surprise immediately came from the crowd.
Apart from those who already knew, even Mei Xiuying, President Ma, Ju Qianyao, Xiao Shuang, and even Dr Aqi, who had never been moved before, were shocked.
What, what did this kid say just now?
“This…” On Ancient Capital University’s side, Principal Feng, Dean Hao, Grandma Li, and the others also looked at the ethereal bracelet in Gao Xuan’s hand in shock. Even Shi Yu was slightly stunned. What was going on?
On the Internet live-stream, the comments and comments were all impressive.
This Gao Xuan…
It seemed like he had indeed researched something impressive.
Spatial support mechanical pet!
Moreover, if the cost wasn’t high, could the wealth of a master-level Beast Tamer afford it?
Let a master-level Beast Tamer master legendary skills in advance?
For masters who were idle in the city, this might not be very valuable.
But for those masters of the Beast Tamer Troops, this thing was simply equivalent to a second life.
In war, if this thing was given to a master-level Beast Tamer, the effect it could display could even be said to be able to reverse the battle!!
After all, be it transcendent-level Concealment or legendary skills, they were things that many Beast Tamers couldn’t even dream of. On the market, there were many life-saving equipment and life-saving pets, but in terms of the strongest life-saving effect, it was definitely still spatial!
The research results Gao Xuan took out immediately made everyone silent.
Shi Yu’s expression also turned serious for a moment before quickly relaxing. This thing was definitely more important than the skill training machine. This Gao Xuan was indeed something.
In the arena, under Gao Xuan’s instructions, an assistant and pet to assist in the experiment came up. The assistant was a young man. He was wearing an ethereal bracelet, and the pet opposite him was a Thunder Wolf.
The Thunder Wolf condensed the Thunder Fang and charged at the young Beast Tamer. However, in the next moment, as if passing through a phantom, the attack failed. With the support of the phantom bracelet, the young man safely ignored a fatal attack!
“A very outstanding research result!!!” Seeing this, Dr. Mei laughed and glanced at Elder Liu beside her. She didn’t expect Gao Xuan to still have this hidden move. She actually didn’t know that Gao Xuan was researching this kind of thing.
“Yeah! If we popularize this in the Beast Tamer Troops, the casualties can be effectively avoided.” Old Liu also nodded with a smile.
“Heroes come from youths,” President Ma said. The one who developed such a mechanical life form was actually a young man in his early twenties? Was this a genius?
On the stage, Gao Xuan smiled and said, “I’m done showing.”
“Excuse me, is this also in Shen Feng?”
With that said, he looked at Dr Aqi of Shen Feng. At this moment, Dr Aqi was very silent. As expected of a mechanical genius who had awakened his talent. Naturally, there was no such thing in Shen Feng. However, Dr Aqi still smiled and said stubbornly,
“Student Gao Xuan is indeed a genius. It’s true that the Mechanics of Shen Feng have never studied this thing. It’s mainly because we believe that attack is the best defense. The price of occupying a contract slot for a protective machine is too high, even if it has a transcendent initial skill chip. Moreover, it doesn’t seem to have a high growth rate… If we can optimize it to a certain extent and increase its battle potential, it will indeed be like what Student Gao Xuan said. It will be a result that is enough to change the structure.”
Gao Xuan grinned and clenched his fists.
This thing was not prepared for powerful Beast Tamers in the first place. It was prepared for ordinary masters, so it reduced the cost as much as possible. This would be easier to popularize.
Just like Shi Yu’s research on the green cocoon, it could change the structure of a fixed level.
“Dr Aqi, this is already a very impressive result,” Legend Ju praised. “I feel that Student Gao can completely take first place in this conference. The most important skill is not the Ethereal Bracelet, but the transcendent initial skill chip, and it’s a high-level spatial skill.”
“Even you, Dr Aqi, can’t let a new machine have a transcendent high-level skill, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - Crossing Worlds (8)
chapters.content:
Chapter 541: Crossing Worlds (8)
Dr Aqi snorted. “This is still alright. It’s not that difficult.”
At this moment, everyone could tell that Dr Aqi was stubborn. At the same time, they were extremely impressed by Gao Xuan.
“Gao Xuan is awesome.”
“As expected of a super mechanical genius who was sucked into that place at the age of 13…”
As Gao Xuan finished showing it, be it the scientific research teams of Star Capital University or other universities, their expressions turned cold.
Unbelievable.
The most unbelievable thing was that Gao Xuan was only in his early twenties, but he had already developed this kind of technology that could move even legendary Mechanics. It was a transcendent initial skill chip!!
And it was a high-level concealment skill.
How much was Gao Xuan’s mechanical proficiency?
After Gao Xuan got off the stage, the media quickly took action like hungry dogs. They felt that this ethereal bracelet could definitely cause a new wave like the previous green cocoon.
On the Internet, the Beast Tamers were envious again and wanted one.
“Not bad!!” On Imperial Capital University’s side, after Gao Xuan returned, the old principal of Imperial Capital University laughed and said, “Just as Old Liu judged, the Gold Award of the Mechanical Conference will definitely be yours.”
“Well, it’s still hard to say.” Gao Xuan was humble for a moment and said, “After all, there are still so many financial groups and research teams who haven’t gone on stage.”
“There’s no need to be too humble. Your research is extremely meaningful even in the previous Mechanical Meetings,” the old principal of Imperial Capital University said with a smile.
“The next display team is Ancient Capital University, right?” Gao Xuan took a deep breath and looked in the direction of Ancient Capital University.
“Well…” The old principal of Imperial Capital University also looked over in confusion. She naturally saw the interview and knew that Ancient Capital University was displaying it with Shi Yu as the representative.
“You’re concerned about that Shi Yu. Don’t worry, after this Mechanical Conference, you can definitely slowly surpass him,” the old principal of Imperial Capital University encouraged with a smile.
Although it was a little difficult, it was definitely not a problem to gradually narrow the gap.
“I hope so…” Gao Xuan took a deep breath. He had an ominous feeling…
A moment later, it was time for the eighth place, Ancient Capital University.
The host was still introducing it.
“Then, let’s invite the eighth team to showcase…”
“It’s a new archeological machine brought by the archeology Department… A second-year student, Shi Yu.”
After the host finished speaking, everyone present felt that this scene was familiar.
It seemed that someone had also participated in a certain meeting as an archeologist.
However, the last time was the Feeding Conference, and this time was the Mechanical Conference.
As a powerful Beast Tamer, Shi Yu had graduated from the high school Feeding Department. It was fine if he knew a little Feeding.
But this time, the mechanical domain had nothing to do with him.
“I wonder what kind of archeological machine it is…” However, everyone was still curious.
After all, Shi Yu was too famous.
On the Internet, pairs of eyes also became especially serious.
After the host finished speaking, Shi Yu walked to the arena under the serious scrutiny of Elder Liu, Dr. Mei, President Ma, and Legend Xiao.
At this moment, after Shi Yu went on stage, Bean Bears more than a meter tall also went on stage.
As heartless porters, they carried a huge machine. Apart from that, a Bean Bear carried a display cabinet filled with ancient fossils up. As for Ling, he ran underground to be in charge of connecting and assembling.
The huge machine was like an altar. In the center of the altar was a booth. Apart from that, there was nothing else. It was very simple.
Seeing this, everyone gulped. They didn’t understand what this was. An archeological machine?
They looked at another glass display cabinet that the Iron-eating Beast had carried up. They recognized the things on it. Weren’t those strange rocks fossils??
What was he doing?
After Shi Yu went on stage, he looked at the entire venue and the judging table.
“Hello, everyone.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “As everyone can see, this is a machine used in archeology. Moreover, it’s a machine for archeology through ancient biological fossils.”
“This is also a research result that can change the current structure of the Beast Taming Domain and even the mechanical domain!!”
Whoosh!!!
When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was in an uproar.
Gao Xuan himself was stunned.
Was he deliberately looking for trouble???
“This is the super archeological genius ranked fifth under the age of 30 in Dong Huang?” Dr Aqi and the Legend Ju had also heard of Shi Yu’s famous name, but according to their understanding, this Shi Yu was a genius archeologist, not a Mechanic.
Now, what was going on?
A research result that could change the current Beast Taming Domain structure and even the mechanical domain structure??
Why was it the same tone as the super mechanical genius of Dong Huang just now?
What was going on!
What was wrong with the young people of Dong Huang!
“This…” President Ma and the others were stunned.
After all, logically speaking, Shi Yu was here to showcase an ordinary new archeological equipment. What was he saying?
At the same time.
Under the cameras of many media outlets, Shi Yu’s figure was spreading crazily.
Everyone’s gazes gathered on Shi Yu, wanting to see what this genius from the archeological world had come across the world to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - Crossing Worlds (9)
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Crossing Worlds (9)
Looking at Shi Yu, he looked very confident…
At this moment, under the gaze of everyone, Shi Yu first walked to the counter filled with fossils and took out a Tyrant Dragon fossil.
“Everyone, look here first. This is a fossil of a Tyrant Dragon. The Tyrant Dragon is an earth overlord that has been extinct since the totem era. It’s a top-notch transcendent creature on the ground. At the moment, our archeological research on the Tyrant Dragon can only rely on fossils.”
Then, Shi Yu took out another Sea Dragon fossil and said, “This is a fossil left behind by the Sea Dragon, a top-notch transcendent creature in the sea of the totem era.”
He continued to take out a fossil and said, “This is a fossil left behind by the Wind God Winged Dragon, a top-notch transcendent creature in the sky of the totem era.”
Shi Yu held these fossils and said, “They all have one characteristic. They have completely disappeared from this world. We don’t have much to do with their archeological research anymore.”
“However, through this machine, we can restore their true appearance and even the state of the ancient world more clearly with these ancient fossils! Everyone, please wait and see!”
Under Shi Yu’s voice, everyone saw Shi Yu place the three fossils on the display table of the huge archeological machine.
Then,
The booth emitted light, and the light ball enveloped the three fossils.
Then, the entire altar-like archeological machine suddenly flickered!!!
An extremely illusory huge projection appeared on the altar.
This altar was like a virtual projection device. Through these fossils, it displayed a very magical scene.
On the altar was an extremely unfamiliar environment.
Some unknown special plants were everywhere, and the surrounding energy fluctuations were filled with natural wildness and ancient aura.
Seeing the projection, many people were stunned.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s voice slowly sounded. “In the fossils of powerful ancient creatures, there will be traces of time. These traces of time will record the state experienced by some ancient creatures in the form of fossil dreams.”
“However, it’s very difficult to pry into this kind of fossil dream!”
“Only through the transcendent Dream Steal skill and a special meditation technique created by Emperor Shi can there be a 1% chance of spying!”
“Therefore, under normal circumstances, this kind of dream back to ancient times is impossible to achieve. Our research on ancient fossils also stopped here. However, through this machine, we can finally cross this step.”
“Moreover, it can even materialize them in reality in the form of a dream illusion!”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, a deafening roar came from the altar.
The environment became a scene of the sky and the ground coexisting.
In the sky, a streamlined Wind God Winged Dragon with a wingspan of 11 meters swooped down and directly grabbed the Tyrant Dragon cub below to bite and kill!!
Wind-element skill, Ripping Claw!
The overlord aura on its body was incomparably rich, shocking everyone. Its green sharp claws instantly divided the Tyrant Dragon cub into two.
After the Tyrant Dragon cub was killed and hunted, on the ground, an incomparably huge Tyrant Dragon phantom condensed. It raised its neck and let out an angry roar, releasing the Earth Domain. It used the earth element to condense the Space Splitting Sword and slashed at the sky.
Boom.
The overlord aura tore apart the surrounding sky and tore off the single wing of the Wind God Winged Dragon.
Gulp.
A moment later, the Tyrant Dragon and the Wind God Winged Dragon disappeared, and the illusion turned into the sea. The humid aura made everyone feel that it was really the deep sea in front of them. A lizard-shaped ancient creature, the Sea Dragon, slowly appeared.
It roared, and the deep sea immediately trembled.
“This is…”
Seeing the clear illusion of an ancient creature, many Mechanics widened their eyes.
Especially Legend Ju and Dr Aqi. They took a deep breath and were rather shocked.
Be it those Wind God Winged Dragons or Tyrant Dragons, the various countries only had fossils and uncertain images.
But now, Shi Yu actually directly used this archeological machine to display their three-dimensional forms and the environment they were in in ancient times through illusions?
On Imperial Capital University’s side, the old principal and Gao Xuan of Imperial Capital University were stunned. They suddenly recalled something. When Shi Yu challenged Imperial Capital University, the Butterfly of Imagination had conjured the phantom of the Tyrant Dragon!
That was the ability of the Butterfly of Imagination!
But now, Shi Yu had actually modified this ability into a machine?
“This guy.” Gao Xuan’s expression froze. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to have such talent.
But just this was not enough.
Changing the situation… Stop kidding.
At this moment, Shi Yu stood in the arena and smiled.
“Unlike the images and habitat environment of ancient creatures simulated by other machines, this machine can directly spy on the traces of time on the ancient fossil itself. In other words, the illusions in front of me are all scenes they really experienced when they were alive.”
“Through this machine, we can more accurately observe the full appearance of the ancient era.”
“From these illusions, we can clearly discover those lost skills we’ve never heard of, ancient resources we’ve never seen, and extinct creatures we’ve never come into contact with.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, many Mechanics cast shocked gazes. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to really be able to develop something useful.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - Crossing Worlds (10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Crossing Worlds (10)
In front of the television, archeologists and ancient scholars looked at the machine in shock. They found it unbelievable and immediately had a new opinion of Shi Yu’s talent.
Even on Ancient Capital University’s side, Principal Feng, Grandma Li, and the others were stunned. Wait a minute, wasn’t he going to display the mechanical phantom beast? Didn’t mechanical phantom beasts only materialize and create through the abilities of Shi Yu and the Butterfly of Imagination?
Why did Shi Yu suddenly create an ancient phantom materialization machine?
When did this happen?
“The illusion just now was indeed incomparably realistic. In fact, even super skills like the Earth Domain and the overlord aura could be displayed through the dream illusion. Unbelievable, this is a machine you developed??” Elder Liu looked at Shi Yu in disbelief. If it was developed by other mechanical masters, he would barely accept it. However, how was it possible for Shi Yu, an outsider younger than Gao Xuan, to do this?
“That’s right. This is the machinery I developed with the ability of my Butterfly of Imagination as the blueprint,” Shi Yu said with a nod.
As soon as he finished speaking, Xiao Shuang and Xiao Qin were extremely stunned. Shi Yu actually had mechanical talent?
At the same time, the spectators who were originally looking forward to Shi Yu’s performance were also extremely shocked. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually develop such a high-end machine.
However…
“There are also Beast Tamers who have mastered the ability you mentioned in the Shen Feng Nation. They’re called Dream Stealers. This one of yours is indeed a very impressive invention. It can be considered a perfect combination of machinery and archeology. However, it’s not enough to say that it’s rewriting the structure of the Beast Taming and even the mechanical domain, right?” Dr Aqi asked.
Although this research result was indeed extraordinary, forget about rewriting the structure, it was even far inferior to Gao Xuan’s research results. At most, it was slightly stronger than the dream training device of Star Capital University.
“I never said that I was done showing it.” Shi Yu chuckled.
At this moment, under the control of Ling backstage, the machine once again conjured illusions through the three fossils.
In the next moment, accompanied by three roars, the huge bodies of the three ancient overlords appeared in reality again. They descended around Shi Yu in the form of illusions!!
Shi Yu slowly walked to the display cabinet containing fossils. He opened a drawer and took out three mechanical Soul Heart Fruits. These were made by the Soul Heart Fruits created by Baby Ginseng and the smart chip.
With the three Mechanical Soul Heart Fruits in hand, Shi Yu slowly walked back to the spot. At this moment, no one knew what Shi Yu wanted to do, but in the next moment, the three ancient overlords suddenly opened their mouths. At the same time, Shi Yu threw the three Mechanical Fruits he had just taken out into their mouths!!
“This is…???”
“What’s going on? What did he feed those illusions?”
Shi Yu’s actions confused everyone.
However, what was even more confusing was still to come!
After eating the Mechanical Soul Heart Fruit, the auras of the three ancient overlords suddenly began to change.
A dazzling white light flickered on the three huge overlords. This scene that looked like the light of evolution directly stunned everyone!!
Under the flickering of the evolution light, the bodies of the three huge beasts began to change. They didn’t expand, but shrank as the light flickered.
Soon, their bodies shrank to more than a meter. Then, their full appearance appeared in everyone’s vision!!
It was more than a meter tall, and its entire body was yellow-brown, like a baby Tyrant Dragon. Its pupils flickered with light…
It spread its wings for more than a meter and was completely gray, but it still retained the posture of a Wind God Winged Dragon…
As for the young Sea Dragon, it was lying on the ground like a huge lizard…
At this moment, when they saw the three huge illusions suddenly shrink, everyone couldn’t react for a moment. But in the next moment, the detection device on the huge screen was activated.
Everyone was naturally familiar with this detection device.
Previously, a team had created new mechanical pets and used detection devices to test energy and other data.
This was a device specially used to detect the various attributes and energy information of transcendent creatures. It was one with this exhibition venue.
At this moment, under everyone’s incomprehension, several rows of words appeared on the huge screen.
[Race Name]: Mechanical Tyrant Dragon
[Attributes]: Machinery, Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Advanced Intelligence, Earth Domain
Energy Points: 3143
…
< Name > Mechanical Wind God Winged Dragon (Machinery Beast)
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
[Race Level]: Low-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: High-level intelligence, Ripping Claw, Wings of the Wind God
Energy Points: 3019
…
< Name > Mechanical Sea Dragon (Machinery Beast)
[Attributes]: Machinery, Water
[Race Level]: Low-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: High-level intelligence, Water Dragon Bite Explosion, Water Dragon Bullet
Energy Points: 3080
[Machinery Beast Revival successful!]
At this moment, the entire place suddenly fell silent. Everyone’s brains couldn’t react for a moment.
They looked at the three smaller creatures that were identical to the Tyrant Dragon, the Wind God Winged Dragon, and the young Sea Dragon. For a moment, their breathing was a little rapid. They looked at the words on the screen in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - Crossing Worlds (11)
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Crossing Worlds (11)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Elder Liu was suddenly stunned. Dr. Mei widened her eyes. President Ma’s mouth opened slightly. Legend Ju from the seven islands took a deep breath. As for Shen Feng’s Dr Aqi, he directly faced Shi Yu.
“Dr Aqi, this is the real result.”
“Supplementing it with a special mechanical Soul Heart Fruit, the greatest use of this research result is to perfectly materialize the illusions of ancient creatures. Then, with the mechanical system, these illusions will be revived in the modern era in the way of mechanical phantom beasts.”
“Although they will lose most of their power after reviving, they can still preserve a portion of their power. As everyone can see, these three mechanical phantom beasts that revived in the form of mechanical lives each preserve a super racial skill.”
“Straightforward research on mechanical phantom beasts will be more convenient for archeological exploration of the totem era.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the legendary Mechanic from Shen Feng had already widened his eyes and revealed an incredulous expression. “How is this possible!!!”
At the same time, Gao Xuan, who was sitting in the Imperial Capital University seat, also shouted with his mouth open. He stared at everything and said, “How is this possible!!”
How could an ancient creature phantom become a mechanical life form? With that mechanical fruit just now, with this machine?
How was this possible!!
At this moment, all the Mechanics present widened their eyes. They really couldn’t believe this scene, but in order to make them believe, Shi Yu chose to continue the experiment.
He looked at the audience, at Legend Xiao Shuang, and in the direction of General Xiao Qin. At this moment, Legend Xiao Shuang, a genius Mechanic, also widened her beautiful eyes in disbelief. This was because her mechanical index had also detected the life fluctuations of these mechanical phantom beasts.
What Shi Yu said was true. These mechanical phantom beasts were real life forms!!
“It’s very simple to verify.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Now, which audience is willing to contract these three mechanical phantom beasts and give it a try??”
Shi Yu’s words resounded in the audience like a bolt from the blue.
In the direction of Ancient Capital University, Dean Hao was the first to run down. He had been waiting for this moment. He said excitedly, “I still have a contract slot.”
Ancient Capital University, Mechanical College, Dean Hao!
Everyone knew this old man. Although he wasn’t a top-notch Mechanical Master in the mechanical field, he was still very capable to be the dean of one of the nine major universities.
At this moment, Dean Hao came down excitedly and walked onto the arena. Then, under Shi Yu’s nod, he excitedly contracted the mechanical Wind God Winged Dragon of the three mechanical phantom beasts!!
A purple contract halo appeared. Under the silence, the mechanical Wind God Winged Dragon blinked its clear eyes like a cub and accepted the contract of the old man in front of it without any resistance!
In the next moment, it was a scene that all Beast Tamers were extremely familiar with. The Wind God Winged Dragon that was just an illusion was directly contracted by Dean Hao into the Beast Taming Space in the form of a pet life!!
The purple light dissipated, and the Wind God Winged Dragon disappeared from the scene. Then, it was summoned by Dean Hao again. With a cry, it flew into the sky, and its wings emitted a green dragon-shaped light. It directly used the super skill that had been lost for tens of millions of years, the Wind God Wings!!
“As everyone can see, this is the skill that has been lost for tens of millions of years, the Wings of the Wind God.”
“Through this method, the lost skill can also appear again.”
Shi Yu’s voice echoed throughout the venue.
“I don’t believe it!!!”
At this moment, Gao Xuan couldn’t sit still in his original seat. He widened his eyes and wanted to get up, but he was immediately pressed down by the equally shocked principal of Imperial Capital University.
“Little Xuan, what are you planning to do?”
“I want to hit the wall and see if I’m dreaming.”
At this moment, Gao Xuan’s heart was beating crazily, and tears welled up. He looked at this scene in disbelief.
What… was going on?
At this moment, everyone was shocked. They looked at Dean Hao and the Wind God Winged Dragon in disbelief, and at the same time, at the Tyrant Dragon cub and the Sea Dragon cub.
How was this possible?
How could an ancient creature revive?!! Was this a miracle?
No, this was a miracle!!!
Everyone looked at the machines on the arena in confusion and at the people and beasts on the arena.
Mechanics, archeologists, and Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast all over the country had their eyes glued to the screen. They hugged the screen and observed in disbelief.
“This, how is this possible…” Even the legendary big boss of the fourth bureau, Old Master Liu, spoke in disbelief, unable to understand this phenomenon.
“How exactly did you do it?” The legendary Mechanic Mei Xiuying said in shock.
“I, I don’t understand.” The Mechanic from the seven islands felt that this world was so unfamiliar.
“…” Dr Aqi of Shen Feng didn’t know how to evaluate the thing in front of him. His words were stuck in his throat.
“This is what I want to show. The Ancient Beast Revival System can revive ancient creatures into the modern era in the form of mechanical lives through fossils.”
“At the moment, there are two major systems in the mechanical field. Smart life forms and biological modification. I think mechanical phantom beasts can completely form a three-way structure with the first two. This is because they have the common advantage of the two. The Mechanical Soul Heart Fruit contains intelligent chips that can allow them to infinitely increase their intelligence like intelligent life forms. At the same time, their bodies have inherited the power of ancient powerful creatures. Moreover, due to the speciality of the phantom body, the risk of mechanical modification is much lower than that of living creatures. In fact, at the phantom stage before revival, they can already be modified without harming the safety of the creature.”

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - Crossing Worlds (12)
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Crossing Worlds (12)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“We’ve already carried out strict experiments on this.”
With that said, Shi Yu summoned the mechanical phantom beasts that had been modified in the ruins space. If the three that had just revived still retained the complete appearance of ancient creatures, then the ones Shi Yu summoned now, while retaining the appearance of ancient creatures, were all mechanical weapons!!
“Roar!!!”
Under everyone’s stunned expressions, mechanical winged dragons in armor, mechanical sword dragons holding mechanical swords, and mechanical armored dragons carrying mechanical shields and cannons appeared in front of everyone.
It attacked everyone’s values again, making them open their mouths wide.
This wasn’t the end. Shi Yu said, “Apart from archeology, this device can also mass-produce ancient mechanical phantom beasts through high-level fossils that contain a large amount of energy, creating a batch of new mechanical pets with potential and extraordinary strength. Just like now, they can be contracted.”
“But this way, it will continue to consume the energy of the fossil. Of course, it can also directly give the power of the entire fossil to a mechanical phantom beast. This way, the power it can inherit will be stronger.”
With that said, Shi Yu summoned another mechanical Tyrant Dragon. This mechanical Tyrant Dragon was wearing hardened armor. It was several meters tall and especially domineering!!
Boom!
An incomparable aura erupted from its body. It was the Tyrant Dragon that Shi Yu had experimented with at the start. Now, it had been completely studied by Ling.
“Roar!!! (I am the king of the earth!!)”
Under its roar, its information appeared on the screen.
[Race Name]: Mechanical Tyrant Dragon
[Attributes]: Machinery, Earth, Thunder
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
Visit /Myb o x nove l. com/ to read, pls!
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Super racial skill]: Earth Domain, Earthquake
Energy Points: 7114
“In fact, as long as the level of the fossil is high enough and the mechanical modification materials are top-notch, it’s not impossible to revive an overlord race’s mechanical phantom beast.”
Shi Yu’s words were like a thunderclap in everyone’s ears.
