Mechanics looked at the venue one by one.
At this moment, these legendary Mechanics and ordinary Mechanics were already completely stunned.
The audience on the Internet gradually lost their ability to think.
However, what made them numb was that Shi Yu was still talking and stimulating them.
This beast…
“In general theory, if the ancient fossils of the totem era can be revived, then the Mythical Creature fossils of the Mythical Era might be able to be revived. Although there have been no successful cases now, I believe that as long as we invest the money and continue researching, reviving divine beasts and materializing Mythical creatures into the Beast Taming Era to revive in the form of machinery, it might not be impossible.”
Shi Yu said, “I’m done.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the entire place continued to be dead silent.
[This is also a research result that can change the current structure of the Beast Taming Domain and even the mechanical domain!!]
Initially, everyone still felt that Shi Yu’s words were ridiculous, especially Dr Aqi from Shen Feng. But now, this was more than mere changing. This was simply tearing apart and rebuilding!!
The mechanical legends of the fourth bureau looked at Shi Yu in shock. They looked at this archeologist who had suddenly come to participate in the Mechanical Conference for no reason and the members of Bureau 11 who had come to participate in the Mechanical Conference and were a little stunned. Who told them what was going on?
It was fine if he came to participate, but was this result serious?
What the hell was this research result? How could it even create an overlord race mechanical pet!!!
What was even more ridiculous was that this guy wanted to revive a mechanical divine beast??
“What’s wrong with this guy?” Legend Xiao Shuang said in shock. Wasn’t this guy still a mechanical noob previously? Why did he suddenly become even more strange than a group of super mechanical masters in the fourth bureau?
This was something that a mechanical noob could develop?
At the side, General Xiao Qin was also extremely confused, but her gaze stared at the mechanical Sea Dragon with yearning.
There were Beast Tamers staring at those mechanical phantom beasts with yearning everywhere. Fang Lan’s red face was filled with urgency. She wanted it so much~
“This…” The host looked at the judging table and kept feeling that the scene was a little out of control. He kept feeling that everyone was already stunned by the results.
On the judging table, many big shots were silent. Even the Shen Feng Legend, who was extremely arrogant just now, cracked at this moment. He suddenly felt that Dong Huang was a little ridiculous.
Damn, an archeologist researched an archeological machine??
What a joke!!!
Were the people of this country serious!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the National Science and Technology Exhibition Center.
A silent aura filled the entire place, and countless people looked at the venue.
Many legendary Mechanics on the platform wanted to say something but hesitated.
Mechanical phantom beast!
Collect the common merits of intelligent life and biological modification?
How ridiculous!!!
The advantage of intelligent life machinery was that it could fuse with intelligent chips and constantly increase its learning ability. It could be used to assist in various jobs and had a rich skill pool.
As for biological modification, it could make up for the racial shortcomings of some pets through the mechanical system and specifically strengthen their merits, making them stronger!
The two couldn’t be combined, because there was a conflict between the smart chip and life intelligence. However, what this mechanical phantom beast meant was… not only could it inherit the powerful race of ancient creatures and modify it, but it could also make the smart chip its intelligence core?
This, this, this… A path that had always been imagined but never realized!
The thing was there was more!
Most importantly, he used just a portion of the power of the three fossils to create three mechanical creatures of monarch races?
Using an entire fossil could potentially create an overlord race?
What was even more ridiculous was that it actually said that there was hope of reviving a divine beast?
Fortunately, Shi Yu didn’t really successfully revive the divine beast at the conference. Otherwise, he would probably directly become the fuse for the next totem battle!
Visit Myb0 x nove l. com to read, pls!
“…Da da da.” Old Liu, who was in the Fourth Bureau, clicked his old teeth.
Obviously, he was shocked to the extreme.
At this moment, he had completely forgotten about his student, Gao Xuan, and the Mechanical Conference. He only wanted to satisfy his curiosity.
He said, “Then, those three fossils are all level-seven fossils, right? How many of these mechanical phantom beasts can be created with these level-seven fossils? Apart from fossils, what’s the cost of this machine?”
Shi Yu looked at Elder Liu and said, “A level-seven fossil can be revived with this device. With mental energy and spatial energy as energy, it can probably create about 100 mechanical phantom beasts of monarch races or mechanical phantom beasts of overlord races.”
“The cost of the machine isn’t high, and the energy cost of materializing illusions isn’t very high either. However, the creation of the Mechanical Soul Heart Fruit is a little troublesome, but I’ve already completed a stable manufacturing channel. It can be used on a large scale.”
“Ba.. Ba…” Old Liu was shocked.
A fossil could actually create so many mechanical phantom beasts??? This system was actually so perfect?
There weren’t many fossils, but there were definitely a good number. In various places, it wasn’t a rare resource. The collection value was greater than the use value, but such a pile of collection resources could actually be converted into so many pets with powerful potential?
The initial stage was a low-level monarch race… After all, the greatest characteristic of Mechanics was that the replication of upgrades and evolution was extremely high. In addition, mechanical phantom beasts had the merits of intelligent life and biological modification. It was not wrong to say that their potential was huge.
Moreover, the significance of an overlord species pet was much greater than 100 monarch species!!!
Even if it was a one-time use, if there were hundreds of mechanical phantom beasts of overlord races, Dong Huang’s national strength would greatly increase.
“You said that this machine referenced skills like Dream Steal and Phantom Illusion…”
“Then, if we don’t rely on machines and use skills like Dream Steal and Illusory Phantom to materialize the dream illusions of living overlord-level and totem-level creatures, can we also transform them into mechanical phantom beasts?!” Dr. Mei asked with rapid breathing, suddenly thinking of this possibility.
Below, Shi Yu was stunned. He said regretfully, “I’ve thought of that too, but unfortunately, reviving mechanical phantom beasts requires the power of time. Only the ancient phantom with traces of time conjured from the ancient fossil containing traces of time and the mechanical Soul Heart Fruit that contains the power of time can allow the ancient phantom to revive in the modern era.”
“However.” Shi Yu looked up with a smile and said, “However, as long as we perfectly preserve the bones of the powerful creatures now, many years later, they might also contain traces of time. At that time, they can be like the heroic spirit ruins in the ancient capital, passing the power of the powerful guardian of our era to the future to form a stable mechanical phantom beast system.”
Shi Yu’s answer made the mechanics present curse.
A stable… overlord race cultivation channel???
Although the time span was a little long, as long as it lasted for ten thousand years, it seemed like… it could really be formed?
Keeping the body parts of powerful creatures was much easier than letting overlord creatures give birth to a child!
Shi Yu’s invention was even more impressive than Emperor Shi’s heroic spirit ruins.
“Of course, not every powerful creature can accept such a method, but the fossils that this world has preserved for hundreds of millions of years are enough for us to develop this system,” Shi Yu said.
Blue Planet was different from Earth. Ancient creatures were also transcendent creatures. It was easier for them to leave traces. Therefore, on Blue Planet, there were many fossils of ancient creatures, especially fossils of powerful creatures.
Therefore, even if fossils were consumables, the fossils accumulated over hundreds of millions of years on Blue Planet were still a considerable number. Compared to worrying about not having enough fossils, it was better to worry about the production consumption of the Mechanical Soul Heart Fruit… After all, without the support of the ginseng baby, it was still quite troublesome to nurture it on a large scale.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In short, next, it might start the fossil fever in the country. A large number of Beast Tamers would devote themselves to the Mechanic excavator specialization and dig rocks everywhere.
“Yes, that’s indeed the case.” Dr. Mei was dazzled as she looked at the young man in shock.
She was very familiar with Shi Yu. Her two daughters had come into contact with Shi Yu, but she never expected that the genius Beast Tamer her two daughters mentioned could one day cause such a huge impact on her in the mechanical field.
“I…” President Ma of Star Capital originally thought that the shock from watching the battle between Shi Yu and Ji Feng was big enough. At that time, when he heard that Shi Yu wanted to participate in the Mechanical Conference, he didn’t think too much about it. However, he didn’t expect that Shi Yu didn’t follow the routine… He didn’t follow the routine!!
Was he still human? It was fine if his battle power was so impressive, but archeology and feeding were also so powerful. The key was that now, his mechanical achievements had also become epoch-making results. How could he be like this? What would other geniuses think!
Of course, the most shocked were still the two foreign friends.
Regarding the annual Mechanical Conference of Dong Huang, they had originally come with the mentality of watching a show.
But now, they gradually realized that their brains weren’t enough.
The legendary Beast Tamer of the seven islands, Madam Ju Qianyao, suppressed her trembling heart and felt that it was ridiculous. It was difficult to imagine that she had only come to Dong Huang to exchange and learn symbolically at the request of the higher-ups. During this process, she actually encountered such an epoch-making invention?
Moreover, such an epoch-making invention was invented by a 20-year-old young man from another country?
What did Shi Yu say he invented it for? Yes… archeology… He called this an archeological machine?
He wanted to understand the Mythical Era and directly revive the divine beast and ask it directly, right?
“This person has to be remembered…” Legend Ju Qianyao looked at Shi Yu carefully and thought that she definitely had to transmit the news of Shi Yu and the mechanical phantom beast back to the country. This person was simply a super genius that only appeared once in a hundred years. If only she could dig him to the seven islands.
......
At the moment, the seven countries were in an alliance. Unlike the totem clans who wanted to destroy the geniuses of the seven countries, the seven countries were relatively harmonious on the surface. If a large-scale totem battle occurred in a country, the other countries would even send more troops. In this context, the seven countries usually used various methods to poach the geniuses of other countries to their countries to serve their countries.
Ju Qianyao saw that Shi Yu was young and should be at the stage where he was facing countless temptations. No matter how much it cost, it was worth it to dig up such a talent.
“Why, why would such a genius appear in Dong Huang? Is it really just an archeologist?” Dr Aqi of Shen Feng also fell into a deep silence. At this moment, he didn’t know what to say, because with his shallow mechanical knowledge, he actually couldn’t understand how this mechanical phantom beast revived.
Forget about this machine, what was that so-called Mechanical Soul Heart Fruit??? Spiritual energy, spatial energy, and the power of time that Shi Yu mentioned just now. How could such a little kid play with the technological system of space and time?
Dr Aqi didn’t understand.
At this moment, the entire venue was still in a strange atmosphere.
Everyone stared intently at the mechanical phantom beast on the arena and the fossils on the stage.
They actually… didn’t want Shi Yu to leave at all.
The skill training machine and the Ethereal Bracelet didn’t give them much of an impact, but this so-called “archeological machine” simply filled them with curiosity. Tell them more, tell them more, introduce more.
There were still so many fossils!!! Revive more for them to see, don’t stop!!
The first two were only effective in fixed domains. The skill training device was for low-level Beast Tamers with superior family backgrounds who were willing to work hard. The latter was for master-level Beast Tamers who often carried out dangerous missions and could afford the Ethereal Bracelet, or for Beast Tamers in the army to distribute it uniformly. It had little to do with them.
However, the results Shi Yu brought were completely to open up a new domain. It could lead to a new industry and let countless people dig up fossils. It could also lead countless Mechanics to devote themselves to the research of the mechanical phantom beast domain. It could even let a powerful race like the mechanical phantom beast attack the current Beast Taming structure and form a complete chain.
At that time, traditional Beast Tamers, feeders, archeologists, and Mechanics would all go crazy.
Moreover, Shi Yu even drew a big picture and said something about reviving divine beasts…
The Mythical Domain was the common pursuit of Beast Tamers for millions of years, the highest pursuit.
“Lost, completely lost.” Professor Mo Qing of Star Capital University smiled bitterly with shock. When Gao Xuan went on stage, he originally wanted to struggle, but Shi Yu’s research results directly crushed everything.
He originally thought that it was just a dream device, but… materializing a dream or reviving a dream illusion was simply a legendary method.
Such an invention would probably even alarm that mechanical legend.
“Shi Yu…”
At Imperial Capital University, Gao Xuan still couldn’t calm down. Shouldn’t the Mechanical Conference be the stage for him to display his results? Shouldn’t the normal script be for him to win the Gold Award of the Mechanical Conference and leap into the sky with this? Why, why did Shi Yu, an archeologist, also come to interfere and do this?
He felt that the Mechanical God was joking with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Suddenly, Gao Xuan thought of something and recalled a comment on the Internet. That silly guy called [I’m not Buggy] predicted that Shi Yu would develop a new mechanical faction. Initially, Gao Xuan looked at this comment like he was looking at a fool, but now, he was suddenly a little confused and felt that reality was a little unreal.
He quickly took out his cell phone and went to the blacklist to find that [I’m Not Buggy], but he suddenly realized that [This account has been deleted]…
Gao Xuan: “?”
At this moment, although no one wanted Shi Yu to leave the stage, it still had to end.
Ling, who was in the form of a Rubik’s Cube, had already come out from backstage and floated beside Shi Yu’s shoulder. It was being crazily photographed by the media with him.
At this moment, Xiao Qin and Xiao Shuang’s mother, the legendary Mechanic Mei Xiuying, took a deep breath and asked Shi Yu, “One last question. Did you really develop such a device just for archeology?”
Shi Yu was stunned. “Not entirely. Speaking of which, when I was young, my greatest dream was actually to be an astronaut and ride the machinery I created to the starry sky. Unfortunately, at that time, I didn’t have the financial conditions to go pursue the Mechanic class…”
“Becoming a Beast Tamer and an archeologist is something for the future. My greatest dream when I was young was to be a legendary Mechanic.”
“Now, half of my dream has been fulfilled.” Shi Yu sighed. Who didn’t have the dream of being a space person and a scientist when they were young?
Upon hearing that, many Mechanics were silent and sighed bitterly. Yes, if they remembered correctly, although Shi Yu was a genius, he seemed to be an orphan.
Mechanics were indeed not something that such a family could come into contact with. Only after Shi Yu rose through his archeological talent could he return to fulfill his dreams.
Dr. Mei was also extremely emotional… Unfortunately, if only Shi Yu had come into contact with the Mechanic class from the start.
No, it wasn’t too late now. She wanted this person in the fourth bureau!
......
However, at the same time, many spectators had strange expressions, such as Dr. Zuo, Xia Qingwei’s family, and President Ye of the third bureau of the Feeding Bureau, who were watching the Mechanical Conference before the live broadcast. Wait, wasn’t your childhood dream to be a legendary Feeder??
How many dreams did he have!!! Can he say them all at once and let them be mentally prepared?
….
At this moment, because the Mechanical Conference was broadcasted live on the Internet, the country was already in an uproar.
In Ancient Capital University, the Mechanic students were also paying attention to the Mechanical Conference.
A portion of the Mechanics of Ancient Capital University were forced to accept transfers here. A portion of them really liked machinery, but because their results were poor, they only got into the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University and didn’t get into Imperial Capital or Star Capital University.
After coming to Ancient Capital University, although the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University was more than enough to teach them, and the Mechanic knowledge of Ancient Capital University couldn’t be learned even after ten years… Every time they saw any extremely influential mechanical results from other schools, they looked at their own schools and the archeological machine research projects they participated in. The Mechanic students of Ancient Capital University couldn’t help but sigh.
It was at the bottom of the professional food chain of the major universities.
But today, they watched the entire Mechanical Conference in a daze.
In the end, they were simply impressed.
They all blushed. They understood that the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University was about to take off this time. Just like the Feeding Department and the Battle Department, it was about to take off. Moreover, it was the same person who brought them up. This person was Big Boss Shi Yu from the archeology Department next door!!
Of course, at this moment, the students from the archeology Department and the Battle Department of Ancient Capital University, such as Yu Shu, Wang Ling, and the others who had seen the Mechanical Conference, also had strange expressions. It was difficult to understand!! Shi Yu, this beast… was he still human!!
Soon, as the display of Demon Capital University was completed, it barely struggled under the light. It was also time for the Mechanical Conference to take a break. During this process, the news of the mechanical phantom beast spread and fermented like a tsunami!!
Aqi, the legendary Mechanic from Shen Feng, left almost immediately and came to his room.
He took a deep breath and took out a machine with a mechanical fruit logo. This machine was like a large cell phone or a small computer.
Dr Aqi directly activated the machine.
At the same time.
On the other side of the ocean, in a very special communication room in this country with many titles such as the Nation of Divine Wind, the Nation of Divine Eagle, the Nation of Machinery, the Nation of Technology, and the Nation of Freedom, a young woman with wine-red hair and white skin was surprised and picked up the communication.
“Dr Aqi, what happened?”
At the moment, due to the totem area and various restrictions, the seven countries couldn’t communicate normally with technology at all. However, what Dr Aqi was using now was the latest research results of the Divine Wind Nation. Even if it crossed two countries, it could still communicate for a short period of time, but it would consume a lot of energy.
At this moment, the contact person in charge of contacting Dr Aqi saw Dr Aqi, who was communicating and learning in Dong Huang, suddenly activate this device and immediately realized that something big might have happened.
“Judy, listen to me first. Inform the association to collect ancient fossils from all over the country. I’ll send you the specific reason after sorting it out.”

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: The Fourth Bureau, Shi Yu (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Eh??” The person named Judy was very surprised. “Dr Aqi, what exactly happened?”
“Do as I say!” Dr Aqi said. Although Shen Feng had yet to master Shi Yu’s technology at the moment, Shi Yu’s invention had provided them with an idea. With the technological power of Shen Feng Nation that was so much stronger than Dong Huang’s, it might not be impossible to replicate!
Judy was first stunned, then she suddenly thought of something and said, “Dr Aqi, can you… tell me about it first?”
“What exactly did you discover?”
“Why are you talking so much nonsense!” Dr Aqi panicked.
Judy was stunned. “Because, because the Dong Huang exchange team that came to Shen Feng previously bought a huge batch of ancient fossils from us to use as a friendly memorial for Dongfeng. It’s quite a big batch…”
While buying a large number of mechanical materials, Dong Huang also used other rare resources to exchange for relatively low value fossils. Shen Feng was naturally happy to see this.
“???”
“Gfft!!” Dr Aqi’s vision darkened and he almost spat out a mouthful of blood. To hell with being friendly. Was this something a human could do?
“This, this, how can you guys give them away!!” He was furious.
“Those are core resources that are enough to impact the current structure of the mechanical field, a new mechanical faction!!”
“What?!!” Judy was stunned.
Dr Aqi sighed and said, “A Dong Huang person named Shi Yu. He developed a new mechanical faction called the Mechanical Beast. Through the ancient fossil, he revived ancient lives. The core resource used is ancient fossils!!”
......
“It’s alright. It’s impossible for the other party to completely buy everything. Moreover, if it really doesn’t work, we’ll start a war with the totem country and snatch some,” Dr Aqi said with a deep breath.
Judy was still stunned and didn’t react. She didn’t understand what it was that made Dr Aqi, who looked down on the mechanical field of other countries, have such a high evaluation.
“Shi Yu?? Who is this? A legendary Mechanic from Dong Huang? Also, reviving ancient lives?” She was deeply confused and shocked. God, was this not a miracle?
Dr Aqi shook his head and said, “This person… is just a 20-year-old archeologist.”
That day.
In Shen Feng Nation, many legendary Mechanics were shocked. This was the first time Shi Yu’s name had spread overseas in an extremely influential manner.
This also gave Dr Aqi, who was in Dong Huang, an important mission. He had to rope in and befriend this mechanical genius named Shi Yu, as well as exchange this technology with Dong Huang. The Shen Feng exchange team would immediately head to Dong Huang!
…
At that moment, during the intermission, Shi Yu was so busy that he exploded.
Because Legend Xiao Shuang, General Xiao Qin, Fang Lan’s parents, and Fang Lan had all come to find him to see the mechanical phantom beast.
Principal Feng, Dean Hao, and Grandma Li were naturally overjoyed the whole time.
For Principal Feng, it was because Ancient Capital University was about to take off again. For Dean Hao, it was because the Mechanic class was about to take off. In addition, he had contracted a mechanical phantom beast. According to Shi Yu, the Wind God Winged Dragon fossil+machinery phantom beast sprout+his own modification… This could completely reach the overlord race in the future! This was even his first pet with overlord potential!
As for Grandma Li, or the greatest winner, she was originally the person who collected the most fossils in Dong Huang. She was the highest authority in the fossil field. More than 60% of the rare fossils in Dong Huang were in her hands. Two months ago, she also bought a large number of foreign fossils through the Dong Huang exchange team. This wave also took off directly.
Of course, they had obtained benefits. Since Shi Yu was the founder of this domain, there would definitely be many benefits in the future.
“Little Lan, do you have any thoughts in the future? When the time comes, I’ll revive a mechanical phantom beast of a transcendent race for you first. This way, it’ll be easier for you to contract it. In any case, you can still modify and upgrade it in the future.” In the preparation area of Ancient Capital University, Shi Yu smiled at Fang Lan.
“Sister Xiao Qin, do you want one? Don’t you also know mechanical modification? I remember you still have a contract slot, right?”
Shi Yu was naturally not stingy with his own people. Well, in the future, he would also arrange for mechanical phantom beasts for Senior Lin, everyone in Ping Cheng, An Chang, and every member of the Environmental Protection Department. A monarch race could definitely attract people.
“…”
Shi Yu kept promoting these mechanical phantom beasts to his acquaintances and gave them to the Yu family.
“Thank you, Senior Shi Yu. I want the Tyrant Dragon. Roar.” Fang Lan almost hugged Shi Yu’s thigh. Fortunately, she was stopped by her parents.
At the same time, Father Fang and Mother Fang advised her earnestly. The Tyrant Dragon was famous, but it couldn’t fly. Their family studied aerial machinery. Was this appropriate?
Xiao Qin was also rather embarrassed, but it was difficult to refuse. After all, it was a pet with overlord potential, and the Mechanical Sea Dragon looked pretty good. It was very compatible with her navy identity… It looked like she had to work hard for Shi Yu to repay her debts.
The Environmental Protection Department was so fragrant.
“Shi Yu.” Legend Xiao Shuang looked at Shi Yu with a deep gaze, very confused.
She said, “You should understand what your research results mean, right?”
Shi Yu also looked at Legend Xiao Shuang in the fourth bureau and nodded heavily. “It means that Sister Xiao Shuang, we can become colleagues soon.”
Xiao Shuang : “…”
Xiao Shuang opened her mouth slightly, but she couldn’t refute because the fourth chat group had already exploded.
Many mechanical big shots who had not appeared for a long time, and even some retired mechanical big shots, appeared one after another to discuss the mechanical phantom beast.
This research result was undoubtedly worth the research of the entire country, just like the green cocoon system.
Dr. Mei Xiuying had even recommended to the bureau to let Shi Yu join the fourth bureau and integrate the resources of the fourth bureau to open the research of the mechanical phantom beast domain.
[The telepathy talent is very suitable to command the mechanical army and become the core. Why was such a talent and genius suitable for the Mechanic class intercepted by Bureau 11, the third, and the first bureau first? It shouldn’t be.]
[But it’s not too late now.]
[He has already displayed such mechanical talent. It’s indeed suitable to absorb it into the fourth bureau to nurture. It’s a pity to waste this good talent.]
[Machinery phantom beast, a genius idea, and it actually succeeded. Impressive. By the way, who’s Shi Yu?]
[Elder Hu, you’re already 150 years old. Don’t interfere in these things and retire in peace.]
[Bastard, I’m not old yet. Moreover, aren’t we encouraging old people to be agile and find jobs again now? This mechanical phantom beast is quite interesting. I want to help!]
[…]
Gao Xuan was silent in the group chat. He trembled and didn’t dare to say a word. He should be the protagonist today… This was too much. Was this forcing him to develop a mechanical domain even more impressive than a mechanical phantom beast!!
…
“Sister Xiao Shuang, are you here to invite me to join the fourth bureau?” Shi Yu looked at the black-haired beauty in front of him.
Xiao Shuang was speechless. How could he be so direct?
However, judging from the discussion in the bureau, there was an 80% chance that the fourth bureau would accept Shi Yu. They even had to beg Shi Yu to come. After all, such a big project would undoubtedly become a national project. As the founder, Shi Yu couldn’t not have the corresponding identity.
In order to better carry out this project, the seniors in the fourth bureau definitely hoped that Shi Yu would know more about the Mechanic class and accept the system’s mechanical training like Gao Xuan.
At the same time, they could also obtain more information on mechanical phantom beasts from Shi Yu.
Xiao Shuang wanted to say something but hesitated.
“I understand. The responsibility will also be greater if I add more departments, but I’m already prepared.”
Shi Yu had a serious expression. It couldn’t be helped. The greater the ability, the greater the responsibility. In order to expand, scale, and standardize this project, he had to guide these Mechanic seniors.
“Talk in detail… talk in detail…”
This time, it was epic strengthening!
In the fourth bureau, he could choose any of the top-notch mechanical materials in the mechanical index and Dong Huang’s mechanical warehouse. It was just a matter of time for Ling to research himself into a quasi Mythical race!!! Super mecha, starry sky battleship, mechanical illusion god, he could have them all!

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - About the Top Four of the
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: About the Top Four of the Sequence Who Became My Bodyguard (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Mechanical Conference would last for several days.
But next, both the judges and the audience felt that it was boring.
The Mechanics all entered sage mode after the shock.
Although there were also inventions comparable to dream training devices later, in the eyes of the audience, they were only so-so.
Mechanical phantom beasts were forever gods!
At this moment, the nine major universities and many research teams weren’t thinking about how to apply for more funds with their inventions.
Instead, they were thinking about how to get intimate with Shi Yu and sit on the mechanical phantom beast, the ride that led to the future Golden Road!
If they caught this wind, even pigs could take off, let alone the elites that they were. They had to catch up.
For example, Star Capital University gave a plan that made the gem cat clone cry.
Star Capital University wanted to cooperate with Ancient Capital University. They would let their pets train normally during the day and let their pets train in their dreams at night. When their pets died and their corpses were preserved, they could still revive them to continue training, fighting, and working countless years later.
This was simply a perfect cooperation. The world would become better and better.
Of course, Shi Yu naturally ignored such an inhumane method.
Right now, he only wanted to receive the fourth bureau’s resources in peace.
......
He had already learned the benefits of the fourth bureau from Legend Xiao Shuang.
First was the mechanical index. This was definitely there.
Just like how the archeological index was filled with archeological knowledge and the Feeding index was filled with Feeding knowledge, the Mechanical index was naturally filled with Mechanical knowledge.
For Ling, this was the most important thing to make it stronger, not inferior to the legendary resources of the Mechanic class.
After all, knowledge was a resource in the Mechanic class.
Apart from that, it was the right to apply to activate forbidden weapons after becoming a member of the fourth bureau.
Just like how Gao Xuan could take a small forbidden weapon to destroy the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, if Shi Yu had reasonable needs, he could also apply for the right to use the forbidden weapon.
Naturally, it was definitely only an ordinary or even a small forbidden weapon, and it needed to pass the joint vote of multiple departments.
Moreover, the members of the fourth bureau were qualified to come into contact with some control mechanical materials in Dong Huang. Moreover, they had a certain amount of funds every year and could directly exchange mechanical materials.
After hearing this, Shi Yu was overjoyed. Everything was better.
…
Because of the mechanical phantom beast, in the third, fourth, and eleventh bureau, many big shots gathered and discussed this project.
After all, mechanical phantom beasts were not a matter of the Mechanical Bureau. The archeological Bureau and the Feeding Bureau were not inferior to the Mechanical Bureau in terms of curiosity about ancient overlords.
In a conference room in Star Capital.
Principal Feng, Grandma Li, President Ye of the third bureau, Dr. Mei of the fourth bureau, Legend Xiao Shuang, and the others gathered.
“The mechanical phantom beast system indeed requires cooperation.”
The three parties had already reached a consensus.
Bureau 11 had the most ancient fossils, so it definitely couldn’t be lacking.
Secondly, the cultivation difficulty of the Soul Heart Fruit was very high. If there was no ginseng baby, it could only rely on the joint efforts of the legendary feeders in the third bureau to form a stable cultivation channel.
In the end, it was the combination of the smart chip and the Soul Heart Fruit, the modification of the mechanical phantom beast. These were the core skills of the mechanical phantom beast.
This needed the Fourth Bureau.
Therefore, Shi Yu had already decided to share the various technologies of the mechanical phantom beast system with Bureau 3, 4, and 11, which was equivalent to handing it to Dong Huang.
In the conference room, the big shots of the three bureaus looked at the plan concluded by Ling in their hands with serious gazes.
Then, Legend Xiao Shuang revealed a puzzled expression and looked at Shi Yu. “Why aren’t you in these cooperation plans?”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned.
The other big shots also looked at Shi Yu.
Yes, why?
But this was very simple. Shi Yu didn’t want to do it anymore!
“Cough.” The president of the Feeding Association and a member of the fourth bureau, President Ye Hui, had a strange expression. He kept feeling that this scene was a little familiar.
It seemed that after someone developed the green cocoon system, he immediately threw it to Dr. Zuo, Legend Hua, and him.
Again?
“Because I’m already at a technical bottleneck and can’t overcome it in the short term. And I still have to prepare for the world competition. I’m helpless,” Shi Yu said with a shrug.
What a reasonable reason to slack off.
World Tournament…
Everyone was silent as they looked at Shi Yu speechlessly.
What world tournament?!
Although it was already very impressive for Shi Yu to reach Sequence fifth in such a short period of time, the lowest threshold for survival in the World Tournament had to be at least legendary.
There were still eight months. Shi Yu, who had just broken through, couldn’t catch up no matter how anxious he was.
Moreover, legends were only the lowest threshold of the World Tournament.
Countless legends and overlords went to compete for the title of “World Legend” and the blessings of the World Tree.
Therefore, it was basically difficult to win the championship without a titled legend’s battle power.
Be it Lin Feng Legend back then or the Divine Wind Beast Tamer 20 years ago, when they won the championship, their battle power was close to the titled level. They could temporarily match totems. This was how they won the championship.
Shi Yu was really too far behind that standard.
Moreover, the difficulty of this year’s world competition was even higher because of the participation of the totem country.
It would be fine if Shi Yu didn’t have so many halos on him. He could just go and treat it as training and gambling his fate. Even if he couldn’t win the championship, there might be other benefits. However, with the pile of achievements on Shi Yu, there was no need for him to take the risk in the World Tournament.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
With Dong Huang’s resources, it wasn’t impossible to pile Shi Yu up to the “titled level” and let Shi Yu break through the restrictions of the telepathy talent Beast Tamer to have the battle power of a titled level. It wasn’t impossible for him to become the first legendary Beast Tamer with the strength of a titled level.
“In my opinion, let’s not go. Although there are many Mythical ruins over there, it’s not like our Dong Huang doesn’t have Mythical ruins,” Principal Feng said.
He had changed his mind again, mainly because he was excited by Shi Yu at the Mechanical Conference. Why didn’t he study such an impressive system like the Mechanical Beast instead of going to the World Tournament!
“It’s different. Inatella Island has only opened once in so many years. Who knows when the next time will be?” Shi Yu said. “Besides, I still have a reason why I must go.”
“Apart from courting death in the ruins, what other reason can you have!” Principal Feng said.
“I do have a reason.”
“Didn’t Senior Lu want to go too? If I go too, I can at least protect Senior Lu and take care of each other,” Shi Yu said seriously. This sentence directly made Principal Feng open his mouth wide. He didn’t know how to refute. Bastard, using Lu Qingyi as a shield?
The big shots of the other bureaus were also slightly stunned before looking at Principal Feng.
Of course, Shi Yu’s words were half true and half false. In fact, he had been studying the skill index these few days.
He had been studying that locked [Technique Fusion] ability.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, this ability might be the most critical function to reach the Mythical domain.
Shi Yu tried many methods to unlock this ability.
After a while, although he didn’t succeed, what made Shi Yu very silent was that he received the feedback of the index. Just like how he instantly knew the usage of the index when he first awakened it, he suddenly knew how to unlock this ability!
......
[Technique Fusion] (locked)
< Introduction > It can fuse two or more skills that have reached perfect proficiency into new skills. The higher the skill proficiency, the higher the compatibility between the skills, and the higher the success rate of fusion. The success rate of fusion will also depend on the physique of the Beast Tamer and the will of the pet.
[Unlock Condition]: Obtain the Blessing of the Planet’s Will
It wasn’t waiting for him to have reached the Legendary level, nor was his physical fitness insufficient…
Instead, like the general teaching methods of those skills, it needed the power of the outside world.
Shi Yu was extremely silent. What else could he do?
“Let him go.”
Just as everyone was expressing their views on Shi Yu wanting to go to the World Tournament, a young man’s voice suddenly came from outside the room.
Everyone was stunned and subconsciously looked over. They saw a pair of slender hands push open the door. The first thing they saw was a woman in ancient clothes.
Her skin was fairer than snow, and her eyes were like a pool of clear water. When she pushed open the door and looked forward, she had an elegant and elegant aura, making people feel inferior and not dare to profane her. However, her cold, arrogant, and agile appearance was quite enchanting, making people unable to not dream about her.
Shi Yu looked at the woman in white ancient clothes with a sword at her waist and was very surprised. He felt that the other party’s appearance was only below the Dragon God. It was enough to compete with Senior Lu in her elven form. Who… was this person?
“Legend of the Divine Bell, and President Lin?” Many big shots present exclaimed and stood up.
Behind the woman was a handsome young man in his twenties in luxurious clothes. However, the aura between his eyebrows was filled with vicissitudes, not like a person of this age.
Upon hearing Principal Feng and the others’ surprise address, Shi Yu immediately realized and immediately stood up.
Sequence two, the descendant of the mechanical legend, the legendary Beast Tamer, Divine Bell!
The other was Lin Feng, a descendant of Legend Lin Feng who had succeeded the position of president of the Dong Huang Association after the legend of the divine source abdicated. Although he looked young, he was already more than a hundred years old.
He was the person with the most prominent status in Dong Huang apart from the mechanical legend. He could command the many totems left behind by Lin Feng, as well as the overlord and totems that had received Lin Feng’s guidance.
When he saw two figures related to the legendary Beast Tamer, Shi Yu was instantly stunned. Why was the other party here?
But soon, he understood. It must have been him.
“You’re Shi Yu, right?” President Lin looked at Shi Yu.
“I am, President Lin.” Shi Yu looked at this “young man” with a calm expression.
President Lin Xiao smiled faintly and said, “Thank you for your contribution to Dong Huang. You just said that you wanted to participate in the World Tournament, right?”
The legendary Beast Tamer, Shen Ling, sized up Shi Yu with her beautiful eyes. She had naturally heard of Shi Yu. She only felt that Shi Yu was a very strange person. He had an ordinary background, but he quickly rose up. To have such achievements, even if it was a listening to historical talent, it was a little ridiculous.
Of course, Shi Yu also felt that the Divine Bell Legend in front of him was very strange. She was clearly a descendant of the founder of the Dong Huang Mechanic class, the Divine Source Legend, but she was dressed in ancient clothes and even wore an ancient sword… It was fine if she didn’t inherit the family assets, but why was she becoming more and more backward?
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“President Lin, you just said to let Shi Yu go??” Principal Feng blinked. You know that this guy contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation, contracted the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin, contracted a bunch of overlord species pets, and even developed many shocking results such as the Green Silkworm cocoon and mechanical phantom beasts.
Why were they letting him go out instead of watching over him?
“Yes.” President Lin nodded and looked out the window. “The awakening of the World Tree is not as simple as it looks. My ancestor once talked to the World Tree and was one of the few people who knew some secrets.”

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“According to my ancestor, every time it awakens, it means that we have accelerated the recovery of the myths, that we are closer to a mythical era. They are all signs of disaster. As for the Mythical Ruins on Inatella Island, they are clues that pass through history and are also hidden divine pathways.”
He looked at Shi Yu and said, “Although you’ve only awakened your talent for a short period of time, to be able to obtain the recognition of the Blue Sea Sprite and the recognition of the Dragon God, you’re already one of the best talents in Bureau 11. You can go to Inatella this time. The blessings of the World Tree are unimportant, but if you can obtain some clues through those Mythical Ruins, it might be helpful for Dong Huang to welcome the next disaster and era.”
“Originally, I had expectations for Lu Qingyi in Bureau 11. The importance I placed on her is even higher than Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others. This is because as an archeologist with the talent to listen, it’s easier for her to explore those Mythical ruins. But from the looks of it, you’re a better candidate than her.”
“From the various signs, the awakening of the World Tree this time should be the greatest change in the Beast Taming Era,” President Lin said. “A change that hasn’t happened in hundreds of millions of years.”
Principal Feng’s face fell.
However, at the same time, he was shocked.
The awakening of the World Tree was also related to the approach of the Mythical Era???
President Lin Xiao was the descendant of Lin Feng Legend. His words naturally had credibility.
Because Lin Feng was one of the few humans who had received the blessings of the World Tree.
“The awakening of the World Treeâ€¦ is related to the revival of the Mythical Era?” Shi Yu was stunned.
He also suddenly recalled the Dragon God’s words. The World Tree was the embodiment of the planet’s will. The real Blue Planet’s will had already fallen asleep with the end of the Mythical Era. The frequent awakening of the embodiment of the planet’s will represented something. It seemed to be possible.
At this moment, when they heard President Lin’s words, the others also revealed shocked expressions.
“That should be the case.”
“Moreover, no one can determine if the revival of the myths is a good thing or a bad thing. For example, my ancestor once had a pessimistic attitude, as if he understood something,” President Lin Xiao said calmly.
If the Mythical Revival was a disaster, then the Blue Sea Sprite, mechanical phantom beasts, national Beast Tamers, and stable evolution channels of overlord races would be nothing.
Gods and mortals would be completely different domains.
In the face of such a changing world, information, information, and all clues related to myths were the foundation.
“If you don’t want to go there, naturally no one will force you to go. But since you want to go to Inatella Island to explore the Mythical Ruins, Dong Huang will definitely give you some help,” Lin Xiao said.
“At that time, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the other contestants who have already become legendary Beast Tamers, Dong Huang, will protect you in the competition. You and Lu Qingyi will be the leaders. You don’t have to forcefully try and get the blessings of the World Tree, but it’s best to investigate as many clues about the Mythical Ruins as possible.”
Beside President Lin Xiao, the expression of the legendary Beast Tamer, Shen Ling, changed. She looked at Shi Yu. What, he wanted her to be Shi Yu’s nanny?
Principal Feng and the others were also very shocked and stunned.
Holy shit.
Let the top four legends of the Sequence be Shi Yu’s bodyguards to explore the Mythical Ruins?
This, this, this, this…
Shi Yu was also shocked by President Lin’s words. How could this be?
When everyone else was competing for the Sequence ranking, he directlyâ€¦ became the target that all the top Sequence contestants needed to protect in the world competition?
However, President Lin’s expectations for himself seemed to only be to find some clues about the Mythical Era in the World Tournament through his listening talent to better welcome the changes in the future.
As for Shi Yu himself, he was relatively silent. Although he also wanted to explore the Mythical Ruins, he couldn’t leave the skill fusion function unlocked, right?
If possible, he wanted all of them.
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Yes.” President Lin also nodded and said, “Principal Feng previously wanted to apply for the legendary resources in the top five of the Sequence for you, right? The association will directly approve this. Although the chances of using the growth of pets to break through to the legendary level are not high, you don’t have to worry about wasting them. Those legendary resources… just use them. It can more or less increase your strength.”
“With your foundation and these legendary resources, you won’t be much weaker than those overlord races in the World Tournament. Just be careful. Your safety can still be guaranteed.”
“Apart from that, the association will also give you an additional five billion as resources. You should try your best to increase your strength.”
He looked at President Ye and Dr. Mei and said, “At the same time, you can also use the fossils from the Mythical Era in the resource bank to study the mechanical phantom beast project. Just as Shi Yu said, this is indeed a way to explore myths.”
“Yes.” President Ye, Dr. Mei, and the others nodded.
After President Lin finished speaking, even the Divine Bell beside him was envious. However, she also knew that Shi Yu deserved it.
“Alright, that’s enough,” President Lin said. In the past few months, he had come into contact with many titled legends from other countries, some totem clans, and even some totem allies. This year’s World Tournament was not a small matter. It might be a sign of the revival of the myths. If not for that, he would not be willing to send out a genius like Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In this world competition… The strategic significance of Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu in Bureau 11 might be greater than the other four legends.
“Wait, President Lin, there’s one more thing,” Shi Yu suddenly said.
“Is there anything else?” President Lin asked.
Shi Yu said, “I know the location of a ruin that might have Mythical resources and many legendary resources. It might be the resource mystic realm of the Phoenix Race that has already been eliminated. However, I don’t know if there’s any conspiracy behind this ruin, like what I know. Therefore, I want the Dong Huang Association to cooperate with me and complete the exploration before the World Tournament. This way, I can also strengthen Dong Huang’s national strength again.”
“Ah, I know about this. You want to go to the seven islands during this period, right?” President Lin said.
Shi Yu nodded. Apart from Principal Feng and the others, the big shots of the third and fourth bureaus were still stunned.
What, Mythical resources? Multiple legendary resources? Seven islands? Phoenix Race’s resource mystic realm? What was going on!!
The Undying Dark Phoenix in the Undead Battlefield, which was suspected to be Chi Tong and the empress’s biological mother, told Shi Yu about a Mythical resource mystic realm. It said that it wanted to use this to nurture Chi Tong’s growth and let Shi Yu save it through Chi Tong. This mystic realm was on the seven islands.
Back then, because the Undying Dark Phoenix went berserk, Shi Yu had told Principal Feng about this. As for Principal Feng, he had definitely reported it to the higher-ups.
Therefore, Shi Yu was not surprised that President Lin knew about this. After all, the position of Division 13 was at the top of Dong Huang. There was only one superior, and that was the president of the Dong Huang Association, Lin Xiao.
However, because this mystic realm needed Chi Tong’s bloodline to open, Dong Huang had never taken action. At that time, Shi Yu was still too weak and not suitable to explore the Phoenix Race’s resource mystic realm.
“After a while, I’ll invite the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the Guardian Goddess Ying, and the other members of Bureau 11 to form an exchange team to the seven islands. At that time, you can follow the team to the seven islands to explore.”
Shi Yu said, “Then we have to watch the Undead Battlefield too. If that mystic realm is the key to unsealing the Undying Dark Phoenix, it’ll be a big problem…”
......
President Lin said, “You don’t have to worry about that.”
Shi Yu added, “There’s also the Space Emperor Ruins’ Space Beast Egg. It also needs to go to different areas to hatch…”
President Lin was silent.
Why was this kid so troublesome???
“There will also be an exchange team and titled legends and guardians as your bodyguards.”
“However, if you want to go abroad, you need to undergo a certain amount of disguise and change your identity and name. You can’t go out to train as Shi Yu. If nothing goes wrong, your name will be on the totem clans’ must-kill list soon,” President Lin said calmly.
“What, the totem clans still don’t know my name?” Shi Yu was stunned.
To think that he was worried previously, but in the end, the other party was so unprofessional?
However, one had to disguise themselves when going abroad. This could be used as a reference, but to be honest, Shi Yu couldn’t trust Buggy’s disguise skill.
It was better to use the skill index to disguise himself. As long as he added points to look white-haired and had an old and weak aura, who could recognize him? It was natural.
Everyone :”…”
“Since it’s alright, Little Ling, let’s go,” President Lin said.
“Alright, Grandpa Lin.” The divine bell’s voice sounded.
President Lin came and left quickly, leaving the big shots of Division 13 looking at each other and falling into deep thought. They also sensed the aura of some big events from these words.
….
After the Mechanical Conference ended, the impact of the Mechanical Conference continued to ferment.
As too many people were looking for him, Shi Yu decided to disappear.
Among them, the two mechanical legends of the seven islands and Shen Feng wanted to come into contact with Shi Yu the most. Shi Yu had given them a chance, but they weren’t rare.
Shi Yu asked them if there were any pets that knew superalloy, but they said no.
Then he decided to talk when they knew more.
After the Mechanical Conference, Shi Yu basically handed over the mechanical phantom beast technology.
However, without the help of Baby Ginseng, Dong Huang would probably have to digest it for a while. Shi Yu and the others were the most comfortable with the mechanical phantom beast system. If others used it, they would have to spend more effort.
Among them, the revived mechanical phantom beasts on Shi Yu’s side had also been thrown to the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University to study, leaving only a mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
In other words, the guy they personally created at the start with Eleven’s hardening substance.
After all, Ling still had to continue researching the Mythical mechanical phantom beast. There had to be one to experiment with as the little white mouse. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon had already been used, so it would continue to stay in the dragon enclosure in the ruins space.
At the moment, Shi Yu had already successfully joined the fourth bureau and obtained the mechanical index. Moreover, he had also obtained 5 billion+5 billion in resources.
Among them, 5 billion was used by the Dong Huang Association to nurture Shi Yu. The other 5 billion was the mechanical materials funds of the Mechanical Bureau. It was specially prepared for Shi Yu, the winner of the Mechanical Conference’s Gold Award.
The day Shi Yu obtained it, he spent it all. According to Ling’s request, he exchanged for three Hundred Transformations Stones (Wind) and two billion mechanical materials to upgrade Ling.
This was what Ling deserved. After all, it had contributed greatly to the research system of the mechanical phantom beast. Apart from that, Baby Ginseng also contributed greatly. However, its reward was a legendary resource. It was the legendary resource of the Sequence ranking that Shi Yu had always wanted to apply for in advance. With President Lin’s nod, it was successfully applied.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - About the Top Four of the
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: About the Top Four of the Sequence Becoming My Bodyguard (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Although… The effect was a little unsatisfactory.
However, Shi Yu also knew that legendary resources relied purely on luck. There was nothing to choose from.
For example, Eleven’s legendary resource. He originally wanted a legendary metal-element resource to strengthen life or energy, but in the end, it gave him a metal-element and lightning-element resource that could strengthen the physique and have a chance of awakening the white lightning.
On Baby Ginseng’s side, what Shi Yu wanted the most was earth-element and light-element resources that contained the power of mutation stimulation. Of course, time-element resources were definitely better, but it was impossible for there to be. In the end, on the association’s side, there was only one earth-element legendary resource to increase life force for Shi Yu to choose from.
< Name > Divine Earth of Life
[Attributes]: Earth
[Level]: Level 9 (Legendary-level)
< Introduction > It’s a soil that contains strong life force. Even if an ordinary tree is planted on it, it might bear a Fruit of Life after a long time.
Obviously, what Shi Yu obtained was an earth-element resource that increased life force. It was definitely useless for Baby Ginseng’s mutation and evolution. Of course, it didn’t mean that it was useless for Baby Ginseng. It was just like Eleven’s situation last time. The association was still very kind. This resource was also very suitable for Baby Ginseng.
After all, supplement races relied on vitality and energy.
His ginseng baby had the source of life skill, and the source of life was a physique skill. Its proficiency could be increased by absorbing life resources. With this divine earth of life, it was estimated that without Shi Yu adding points, after completely absorbing it, it could directly let the proficiency level of the source of life reach perfect level. Apart from that, its own life attributes would also undergo a qualitative change.
Shi Yu thought about it and felt that it was not bad. After all, after Baby Ginseng’s vitality increased, it would be easier for him to add points. After contracting an overlord pet, its endurance would also be higher.
This legendary resource could be used!
......
As for the evolution resources, he would talk about it in the future. Perhaps when he went to the Phoenix Race’s mystic realm on the seven islands, he could casually find them and pick them up.
Apart from that, the association also gave an additional legendary resource. To be precise, it was distributed to the Environmental Protection Department and specially given to Susu. It looked like this World Tournament was really unusual. The association directly accelerated the cultivation progress.
< Name > Cold Sky Drop
[Attributes]: Water, Ice
[Level]: Level 9 (Legendary-level)
< Introduction > It can give second attributes to water and ice-element pets and strengthen the attributes of water and ice-element pets to the limit.
It was still a relatively ordinary resource. It was considered a strengthening-type resource, but it was better than nothing. In any case, it was just a monarch breaking through to overlord. It didn’t need any good resources. It was already not bad if it was useful.
After all, in the entire world, there shouldn’t be many Beast Tamers who would give their pets a legendary resource to lay the foundation for them when they broke through to the overlord level at the monarch level.
At this point, Eleven’s Aurora Magnetic Gold, Buggy’s Green Sky Divine Dragon Ball, Baby Ginseng’s Divine Earth of Life, Chi Tong’s Bone Sword, and Susu’s Cold Sky Droplet were all in place.
As for Ling, it had the fourth bureau index, the Wind Kirin fossil, three Hundred Transformations Stones, two billion top-notch mechanical materials, and the fourth bureau mechanical materials warehouse.
For Mechanics, knowledge was a resource. If Ling could fuse with the Wind Kirin fossil and quickly develop a Mythical Phantom, this wouldn’t be inferior to any legendary resource.
In addition, just as Grandma Li had said, there was also a Mythical fossil in the Dong Huang Resource Bank, but it was said that its race was unknown. It only had the power of a god. Shi Yu didn’t want this fossil, but left it for the third, fourth, and eleventh bureau.
This was an opportunity for the three bureaus to work for him.
After all, Ling couldn’t study the two Mythical fossils either. And if they were placed over there, there would be a bunch of legendary Mechanics in the fourth bureau to help study the Mythical Beast. After the progress was out, they could also share the knowledge with Ling. This way, Shi Yu didn’t believe that Ling couldn’t make huge progress in a short period of time.
Now, Shi Yu could be said to be rich.
He returned to Ancient Capital University and planned to continue his seclusion to increase his points while waiting to go to the seven islands. However, just as he returned, the gem cat came looking for him.
” ~” The gem cat looked at the rich Shi Yu in front of it and drooled. Damn it.
“How’s the matter we talked about last time? How is it?”
“Let’s form a company together and earn big money!!”
“You’re in charge of contributing, I’m in charge of bringing the goods.”
“The company’s name will be Shi Yi Group. It suits your and Eleven’s names.”
Shi Yu glanced at the gem cat in front of him and shook his head. “There’s no need. I don’t lack money for the time being. Let’s talk about it after the world competition.”
The gem cat: ???
Why didn’t he keep his word!
“How much can a level-five or six resource be sold for? It’s even difficult for Eleven and the others to accumulate a legendary resource after tiring themselves out. Why don’t we wait until the world competition and they break through to the overlord level? It’ll be easy to earn.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Moreover, Teacher Cat, prepare yourself. We’ll go to the Phoenix Race mystic realm mentioned by the Undying Dark Phoenix later. It’s said that Mythical and legendary resources are everywhere. Isn’t this faster than selling resources!”
The gem cat was angry. Then, its entire body went limp. Forget it, it made sense.
“Right, right?” Shi Yu chuckled. Who knew that he would become rich so quickly after the Mechanical Conference? If he had the time, he should let his pets train their willpower more. He wondered if he could get the overlord’s will before the world competition.
However, he could take the time to create some, but not to sell them. For example, he could get some skill water drops and give them to Senior Lu to increase her strength.
It was already very obvious now. The core of this world competition was clearly him and Senior Lu, the two archeologists. They were fifth and sixth in the Sequence. As for the four legends in the top four of the Sequence, they were just bodyguards who explored the Mythical Ruins.
Archeologists were indeed a good profession. The top four of the Sequence became his bodyguards!

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
March 14.
A day after the Mechanical Conference ended, Shi Yu had already started his “leisure” life at Ancient Capital University again.
It wasn’t attending class or anything. It was just adding points and resting…
Of course, with the memory water drop, Shi Yu was no longer afraid of the exam.
Even Fang Lan could perfectly self-study all the classes in high school+first year and second year in just two months, let alone him.
However, if he wanted to learn, what he, Baby Ginseng, and Ling should learn now should also be transcendent biological knowledge and world history from abroad.
After all, it wouldn’t be long before they had to leave Dong Huang and train abroad.
Now, Shi Yu had already advanced to his second year.
Perhaps Ancient Capital University knew that it was impossible to expect Shi Yu to attend normal classes and graduate, so they directly awarded Shi Yu the title of doctorate in archeology, Feeding, and Mechanical Science.
Wasn’t that enough!
Moreover, who dared to question the value of these titles? The country had already verified it immediately!
From now on, Lu Qingyi wasn’t the only genius archeologist under the age of 30 in Ancient Capital University. There was also Dr. Shi Yu, who was proficient in archeology, feeding, and machinery.
Apart from that, there was a larger change that had been decided a long time ago.
......
After the beast-eared girl, White Brook, and the other older students graduated, the battle department of Ancient Capital University was completely “out of stock”.
Apart from Shi Yu, there was actually no master-level student.
After school started, Shi Yu was forced to become the president of the battle club and the captain of the school team.
Although it was only in name, and Shi Yu had never paid attention to that side, this wasn’t for the long term. Shi Yu still hoped that his juniors and seniors could stand up quickly.
However, this situation should improve quickly. After all, the education funds of Ancient Capital University this year were really a lot. It should be easy to pile up one or two more masters.
Shi Yu recommended more resources to nurture the Dragon Tamer Yu Shu, the Spirit Medium Wang Ling, the Gu Master Miao Dongdong, the Elemental Envoy Zhang Qianyi, and the other second-year students who participated in the same vocation assessment as him.
There was also the first-year genius new student of An Chang’s batch. This way, the older students wouldn’t graduate just as they finished nurturing them.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t care if the school listened to his suggestion. He just wanted to increase his points quickly.
At the same time, Shi Yu also entrusted the gem cat to him to buy various resources, such as high-level water-element energy crystals, wood-element energy crystals, and life supplements.
These were all necessities to increase points.
The additional points of a super skill, be it Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng, or Susu, would all fall to the extreme.
Although they could slowly recover by relying on natural recovery, this required a lot of time and a suitable environment.
The efficiency was completely not faster than directly using resources and supplements.
Shi Yu looked at the five billion in his pocket and felt that it was useless to leave it there. It was better to use resources to increase efficiency. After all, there were only eight months left in the world competition. There was no time for them to slowly go to various places with abundant natural energy to spend a lot of time recovering natural energy.
After returning to his leisurely life, Shi Yu continued to add points to Eleven.
At the moment, Eleven still had three skills that weren’t expert level: Space Quake, Lightning Rod, and Undying Golden Body.
Shi Yu chose to add the Undying Golden Body first. After the Undying Golden Body reached expert level, the changes would be very huge.
If it was said that the entry-level Undying Golden Body converted 10% of the damage into vitality, then the expert-level Undying Golden Body converted 25% of the damage into vitality, allowing Eleven’s endurance to become even fiercer.
After adding another point to Eleven and increasing the Undying Golden Body from (Proficient) to (Proficient+1), Shi Yu used all the supplements he could use, the treatment of the ginseng baby, and the purification of Susu. The cooldown was finally reduced to 48 hours and no longer changed.
These 48 hours were no longer physical factors. There were also side effects of mental, life, and time corrosion.
Whether it was Eleven or Shi Yu, the additional points of super skills had a huge impact on their bodies and minds. If not for Susu, they would probably really be reduced to slaves of power like the warning in the index.
“Wuu…” After adding points, Eleven lay on the ground tiredly.
“Hu…” Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and the others also lay down tiredly.
After adding points, the entire team rose to the sky.
Judging from the current increase in points, if he continued to increase points in the World Tournament now, he should be able to catch up. At that time, he still had the ability to fight those overlords.
As for how far it could reach, it still depended on the experience after obtaining the first overlord-level pet.
Although Shi Yu judged that with his level-six space and current physique, it shouldn’t be a problem to contract an overlord-level pet above his level, if it was two or three, it would probably be a big problem.
Therefore, he wanted to see how many overlords his physique could withstand.
If he could become an overlord, why would he be afraid of the world competition?
Of course, this situation was probably very difficult to achieve.
However, even if there were only one or two, Shi Yu believed that no matter which one it was, as long as Eleven and the others stepped into the overlord level, they would be outstanding among ordinary overlords. Their battle power would even be comparable to top-notch overlords. It was not a problem for them to fight alone.
After a short rest for the entire team, Shi Yu left the ruins space. He had to combine adding points and relaxing so that he could be in a better state to add points in the next round.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
During the break, Shi Yu chose to head to the Ancient Capital’s Undead Battlefield and bring Chi Tong and Susu to kill the undead and cleanse them to relieve the pressure!
If he wanted to reduce the cooldown now, he didn’t rely on supplements or purification. Instead, he had to make his heart happy in order to effectively sublimate his state.
What could make him happy?
Shi Yu thought for a long time. Apart from eating and drinking, probably only resources, cracking history, and showing off himself could do the trick.
Therefore, Shi Yu chose to come to the Undead Battlefield and transform into “Sword God Shi Yu”. He wanted to experience the thrill of punishing demons and killing ghosts to relieve his boredom.
…
Ancient Capital, Undead Battlefield, stationed army.
Commander Xu, Master Xu Kai, guarded here day after day, working diligently every day.
It couldn’t be helped. A few months ago, the top-notch totem here, the Undying Dark Phoenix, had just “gone berserk” once. The entire ancient capital was under a lot of pressure.
The undead riot was a small matter. If the Undying Dark Phoenix came out, it would be over!
And all of this started from a student…
“‘Dr. Shi Yu’, why are you here again? Don’t tell me you want to enter the Undead Battlefield? This isn’t fun!!”
Today, Commander Xu received a kid who often gave him nightmares. When he saw Shi Yu visit, his face immediately turned bitter and his mood was unstable.
......
“Ahaha, Instructor Xu, long time no see.”
Shi Yu looked at Commander Xu, who was in charge of their “Heroic Spirit Ruins” training, in embarrassment.
“You’re right. I’m just going in to take a look. It’ll be fine. Now, the entire Undead Battlefield has been locked onto.” Not only was it locked onto by the gem cat, but it was also locked onto by the mechanical intelligence of the reincarnation of the divine source legend.
“What?” If Shi Yu wanted to enter, Xu Kai naturally couldn’t stop him. However, what did Shi Yu mean?
“In a while, Dong Huang will have a higher-level defense force coming here. You should be able to receive the news soon, I’m just revealing it to you in advance,” Shi Yu said.
He wanted to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm on the seven islands. In order to prevent any connection between the two, he definitely had to strictly control the Undead Battlefield.
“What happened?” Master Xu Kai’s expression turned cold.
“It’s not a big deal,” Shi Yu said. “By the way, when I just came over, I realized that the new students of Ancient Capital University are training in the heroic spirit ruins over there again, right?”
Initially, he wanted to go in directly, but because of an unexpected discovery, he came to see Master Xu.
“Yeah, there are many good seedlings in Ancient Capital University this year. If we don’t count you, the quality is even higher than the newbies last year,” Master Xu Kai said as he looked at the monster, Shi Yu.
“There’s a student called An Chang, right? Has he obtained the recognition of the heroic spirit?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes, this year’s top scholar of the Ancient Capital. However, he hasn’t ascended the altar yet, but it shouldn’t be difficult for him to obtain the recognition of the heroic spirit later on,” Master Xu said. “This kid’s performance in the vocation assessment this year is even more exaggerated than yours!!”
The opponent in second place was directly insta-killed by An Chang in the fusion state of the flood dragon. It was too exaggerated.
Another super genius.
“I see. Then train him hard during the military training. Don’t hold back.”
“Uh.” Master Xu Kai looked at Shi Yu. They had a grudge?
“I nurtured him. I’ve invested a lot of resources in him, so it’s always good to experience some training.” Shi Yu chuckled.
It was normal to be strong. Hundreds of millions of investment funds, a pile of level-seven resources! At the start, even he himself only had ten million.
If An Chang couldn’t become a legend, Shi Yu would feel that he had suffered a huge loss. Although he had also obtained two family heirlooms from him… he definitely hoped that An Chang could successfully grow up.
“What, you nurtured him??? What do you mean?” Master Xu Kai was shocked. What was going on?
You’re only a f*cking second-year student. Don’t tell me you took in a first-year disciple… Although, Shi Yu can’t be treated as a normal student…
The number one person below the legendary level.
This title made Master Xu understand that Shi Yu’s current battle power could easily kill him.
“It’s good that you know… Just help train on the highest scale.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek. If An Chang grew up quickly, he could get rid of his lousy position of president of the battle club that he couldn’t get any benefits from.
“Set more tests for him. After it’s over, help me give this to him.”
Shi Yu took out a drop of “Buggy Silk Memory Crystal” in a water bottle. It was An Chang’s second pet. He had contracted the Green Silkworm given by Ancient Capital University that had mastered the transcendent Worm Silk. According to Shi Yu’s understanding, the worm had yet to evolve, so this thing seemed to be useful.
“Alright…” Master Xu Kai was stunned before nodding.
“Thank you,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
It was pretty good to have a top-notch master like Xu Kai helping with the military training for a while.
“By the way, I also brought you tea!”
Shi Yu took out a bottle of special fruit tea brewed by Baby Ginseng and drank it happily with Commander Xu as a reward.
This thing was very nourishing to middle-aged men.
…
After chatting with Commander Xu, Shi Yu stood on the ancient capital city wall and prepared to enter the Undead Battlefield to kill monsters to relieve the pressure.
But at this moment, his cell phone suddenly rang.
It was Lin Xiuzhu.
Shi Yu was stunned. The call went through. Lin Xiuzhu saw that Shi Yu had picked up the call and said in surprise, “Are you busy?”
“I’m already done.”
“That’s good.” Lin Xiuzhu heaved a sigh of relief.
Two days ago, she naturally paid attention to the Mechanical Conference, but she was worried that Shi Yu would be very busy at this time, so she didn’t disturb him.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: The Three Armies Under Shi Yu (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
She only called after the Mechanical Conference ended.
“Senior Lin, what’s wrong?” Shi Yu smiled.
He was just about to look for Senior Lin after killing the monsters when the other party called first.
“I’ve seen the Mechanical Conference. How did you develop a mechanical phantom beast? It’s too powerful.” Lin Xiuzhu was very excited.
“I was lucky, I was lucky,” Shi Yu said.
“Well, I want to ask if it can revive the fossil of the iron-eating beast ancestor!!” Lin Xiuzhu said excitedly.
“I remember that the Iron-eating Beast ancestor appeared ten million years ago in the totem era, right!”
Shi Yu was stunned. As expected, Senior Panda was still thinking about pandas.
Shi Yu said helplessly, “We indeed have the fossil of the Iron-eating Beast ancestor here, but the Iron-eating Beast ancestor is just a very ordinary bear-type carnivorous transcendent creature. It’s not even metal-element. It only evolved into metal-element later. There’s no research value.”
“The true stage of the Iron-eating Beast race’s development was when a certain faction developed an evolution form through Yun An and various special metals thousands of years ago.”
Even Emperor Wu only inherited the evolution system of the mysterious faction in that totem era.
Unfortunately, at this time, no iron-eating beast fossils were born. Moreover, after Emperor Wu Dynasty, the iron-eating beasts seemed to have been wiped out, producing history and inheritance gaps, and their numbers decreased greatly.
“Wow.” When the panda senior heard this news, she was immediately worried.
......
No.
She had waited for nothing.
“Alright… By the way, I broke through to the master level.” After complaining, Lin Xiuzhu immediately reported the good news to Shi Yu.
In the beginning, Lin Xiuzhu was only a high-level Beast Tamer. Because she was in the Feeding specialization, she didn’t care much about cultivation. Her chances of breaking through to the master level weren’t high in the short term. However, as the Iron-eating Beast’s status rose, the Lin family rose from the richest family in Ping Cheng to the richest family in Icefield City. The Lin family had more resources to nurture heirs.
Senior Lin directly used a pile of cultivation resources to reach the master level.
“Really?” Shi Yu was stunned and immediately congratulated her. Then, he asked, “Senior, where are you now? I have a gift for you.”
“Gift? What is it?” Lin Xiuzhu was curious.
“The level of hardening that can allow your Iron-eating Beast to have a huge increase in resources again. After using this, you should be able to let it complete its evolution. At that time, your metal-element strengthening talent and nurturing method, together with the Nine Li Battle Beast of a high-level monarch race, will make you even more powerful.” Shi Yu smiled.
Hardening Memory Water!
Although when they were together, Eleven would help Senior Lin’s Iron-eating Beast increase its hardening level whenever it was free, it was still too slow. However, now that he had the memory water drop, the speed could increase greatly.
On the other side, Lin Xiuzhu was stunned before being pleasantly surprised.
The reason why she was already at the master level and wasn’t in a hurry to let the Iron-eating Beast evolve was firstly because she wanted to save more money to buy evolution materials. Secondly, because the skill level of her Iron-eating Beast had yet to reach the limit Shi Yu mentioned.
