“I’m not in Ping Cheng now. I’m in Wu Ling City, not very far from the ancient capital. Why don’t I go find you?” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“Eh? What are you doing in Wu Ling City?”
Lin Xiuzhu said, “Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
“The Iron-eating Beast Corps has already started to form. It has officially become one of the seven new pet armies supported by Dong Huang this year. My father is Commander, and Junior White Brook is Deputy Commander. Oh right, she has also contracted an Iron-eating Beast. It’s also a royal. After fusing, it’s very cute.”
“And I’m the chief feeder of the Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
“By the way, by the way, one of the seven new pet armies Dong Huang is supporting this year is related to you. It’s the Green Silkworm Army. Well… To be precise, it’s the Green Silkworm cocoon army. Legend Hua Xiajin is the commander, and Dr. Zuo Jiangyun is the chief feeder.”
“These two armies are both under your command, although I don’t know how the Beast Tamer Troops arranged it…”
“This…” Shi Yu held the phone with a surprised expression.
“Belong to me? Why didn’t I know… Forget it, I’ll ask later.”
Was someone deliberately letting him enter the military?
It seemed normal. He still had a general position in Dragon Palace City.
However, compared to the person in charge of the Green Silkworm cocoon army, the person in charge of the Iron-eating Beast Corps was a little low.
Well… That made sense. This was still normal. After all, the Green Silkworm cocoon system had been perfected, and it could definitely form battle power.
As for the Iron-eating Beast Corps, it was at most an investment at the current stage. After all, the evolution materials were too expensive, and Yun An had yet to be caught. It was better to use the Green Silkworm cocoon army.
“But I feel… from the current situation…” Senior Lin said,” Why do I feel that the country will add another mechanical phantom beast army to the pet army that is heavily supported this year… ”
She had a strange expression. At that time, Shi Yu would be the commander-in-chief of the three armies?
“Haha, if that’s the case, that’s interesting,” Shi Yu said.
In Dong Huang, the overall weight of the Beast Tamer Troops was even higher than Division 13. They were the core power to protect Dong Huang. If a war happened, they would definitely be at the front line.
Back then, if it weren’t for the orphan benefits and the successful loan to buy the Iron-eating Beast, Shi Yu might have joined the army and waited to be assigned pets.
However, although he didn’t successfully join the army, Shi Yu was also very emotional because he had given birth to three special soldiers.
The Iron-eating Beast Army, the Green Silkworm cocoon Army, and the mechanical phantom beast army.
“I’ll look for you later. I want to see what this Iron-eating Beast Army looks like,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright ~ Then you have to come and let Eleven teach them a lesson. Let them know how to work hard like the three little Iron-eating Beasts of Ancient Capital University.” Lin Xiuzhu had a headache. “Soon, there’s still the New Recruit Tournament. In their state, I feel that they will definitely be last.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled. Wasn’t it just a mental seal?
Let Eleven use max-level deterrence to wash their minds and immediately become a hardworking panda.
As the future national treasure army, its thinking couldn’t fall. Moreover, this army was still under his name, so they couldn’t drag him down.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - Changing Fate (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Changing Fate (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Ancient Capital, Undead Battlefield.
A young man holding a longsword cut the undead one by one.
After cutting fodder for a while, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. He felt that the pressure had been lifted, but not completely.
He held the spatial sword that combined hardening and space vibration and felt that being strong was lonely.
In the end, the opponent was still too lousy.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s weapon was updated again.
Because the Ice Dragon Blade was swallowed by Susu, it was useless and thrown away.
As the lightning was not easy to control, Shi Yu often electrocuted himself. He was not used to it and threw it away.
This longsword was actually not very useful.
It was mainly because the rebound of space was not small. Every time he slashed, Shi Yu would feel dizzy.
If it was used too many times, it would be like motion sickness.
Shi Yu directly stabbed it into the ground and buried it deeply. He didn’t want it anymore. He would give it to a fated person. In any case, the shelf life wasn’t long.
“Jiu ~ ~”
......
Beside him, a dark blue little sparrow with flaming tail feathers was also chattering unhappily.
Too weak, too weak. Not only did Shi Yu not slash them to his heart’s content, but it also did not burn them to its heart’s content.
There was no increase in proficiency at all…
At the moment, Chi Tong should be the pet with the highest proficiency in super skills in the team…
Its Interlocking Sword and Spirit Release skills were about the same (Expert+5). It was normal that they couldn’t increase.
The former was due to the fact it had digested the Gemini Silver Armor, and the latter was because it had swallowed the soul pearl of the overlord of the Undying Race…
“It can’t be helped. The powerful undead were either killed by the Undying Dark Phoenix last time or hid and didn’t dare to come out…” Shi Yu shrugged and looked at Little Chi Tong.
Chi Tong: QAQ!!
“Ning!!!” Shi Yu and Chi Tong were not very happy, but Susu, who was beside them, was very happy.
The Undead Battlefield was a place filled with curses and plagues. It was very relaxing to cleanse it.
He just hated that he was too weak and couldn’t cleanse it perfectly.
Although it had purified a large area of flawless land along the way, it would probably be corroded by plague and curses soon after leaving.
Purification was not easy. Susu sighed.
It shook its ice-blue body with the frost crown. After its excitement was endless loneliness.
Now, Chi Tong and Susu looked a little strange.
For example, Chi Tong had changed from the bird spirit form of the orange-red sun to the bird spirit form of the blue ghost fire.
Susu, on the other hand, changed from its jelly-like water slime form to the form of the Ice Slime King with a frost crown.
This was a new form that Shi Yu had recently developed for them.
The principle was also very simple.
Chi Tong’s bird spirit form was originally mainly to release the power of the sun. Then, as long as it restrained and suppressed the power of the sun and used the Nether Cold Fire as the power displayed, its appearance would naturally change.
Be it undead or elemental life forms, it was quite easy to change their appearance.
As for Susu, it was because it had stored the Cold Sky Water in its body.
Although it had yet to devour it, this legendary resource had also given it a second attribute, ice.
In addition, it had mastered the Dao Proficiency Blizzard, the expert level Water Element Control, and ice water. It was very simple to change its elemental form into an Ice Slime.
Even the index could be deceived.
In fact, it wasn’t a lie. Susu, who was now a middle-level overlord race, was no longer a water slime. It was just that it had been maintaining its water slime form previously.
In fact, it wasn’t a lie. Susu, who was now a middle-level overlord race, was no longer a water slime. It was just that it had been maintaining its water slime form previously.
Soon, he would be going abroad. Shi Yu naturally chose to listen to President Lin’s suggestion and decided to change their image.
As for himself, he just had to change his clothes a little with white hair.
Apart from him, the pets also had to change appearance and appear in a new manner.
This way, not many people could recognize him.
Chi Tong often appeared in the form of a sword spirit. Very few people had seen it in the form of a bird spirit. Moreover, its strength system had changed from the Sun Flame that countered undead to a pure ghost fire. Its image and aura had changed drastically, and it was impossible for anyone to recognize it.
As for Susu, it went from an ordinary Water Slime to the Ice Slime King. It also looked brand new.
Apart from that, Ling knew the Hundred Transformations skill. After completing its evolution, it would also look new.
On this trip abroad, Shi Yu planned to use the three of them as the main force so as to train these three. As for Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, he would seal them first.
Compared to Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling… Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were more representative.
Moreover, according to the order of adding points, the three of them were also the first to add points. They just had to wait for the automatic upgrade in the ruins, but there was no need for training.
“Roar!!! (I am the overlord of the earth!!)”
Of course, apart from the few of them, Shi Yu also had a burden.
It was a Tyrant Dragon cub nearly two meters tall.
< Name > Mechanical Tyrant Dragon
[Attributes]: Machinery, Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Basic Intelligence (Intermediate Mechanic Skill, Entry), Space Splitting Sword (High-level Earth Skill, Entry), Earth Domain (Earth Super Skill, Entry), Earthquake (Earth Super Skill, Entry)
Energy Points: 7116
It held a long rock sword in each of its short hands, playing the dual-blade style.
This was the Tyrant Dragon that Shi Yu, Ling, and the others had been experimenting with. At this moment, its form was no different from that of a normal Tyrant Dragon cub.
The excess mechanical modifications were all taken down by Ling, and the skills such as lightning and storage lightning were naturally forgotten.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - Changing Fate (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Changing Fate (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The reason why they did this was because Ling and the others realized that it was not easy for the modified body to recall its previous skills.
However, even if it abandoned the equipment other than the smart chip, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon only awakened the Space Splitting Sword, an earth-element skill that increased the damage to flying pets.
Tyrant dragons like the overlord aura, brute force, and desolate body… Because its body was essentially an illusion and not a physical body, it couldn’t successfully recall it at the moment.
“The data collection is complete,” the white-haired loli on the green Rubik’s Cube screen said crisply beside the mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
< Name > Ling
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
[Race Level]: High-level monarch (Quasi overlord)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]
“Advanced”: Hundred Transformations (Dao Proficiency), Advanced Intelligence (Dao Proficiency)
“Super Level”: Wind Element Control (Expert)
[Teaching Skill]
[Intermediate]: Super Sight (transcendent)
......
“Advanced”: Clone (transcendent), Multiplication (transcendent), Absolute Sleep (transcendent), Deterrence (transcendent), Loading (transcendent), Mechanical Space (transcendent)
Energy Points: 3,610,000
After using the three new wind-element Hundred Transformations Stones to upgrade himself, Ling successfully broke through to the monarch level and improved her all-round qualities.
The greatest change was the Wind Element Control skill. Because of the lead of the Wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone, it had reached expert level.
At this moment, there was actually a large amount of mechanical materials left in the ruins space. Ling planned to use them to modify the loading and mechanical space into racial skills. Apart from that, he also had to use those mechanical materials to study the Wind Kirin fossil and the mecha form. These were not things that could be completed in a short period of time.
“Then let’s stop here. We’ll go to Wu Ling City.” Shi Yu stretched.
Don’t let Senior Panda wait too long.
“Also, when are you going to upgrade its intelligence? Its basic intelligence doesn’t look very smart…” Shi Yu said.
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon widened its eyes.
Ling shook his head crazily and said, “If it’s too smart, it won’t cooperate with my research.”
“Next, I plan to evolve it into an ‘earth-element dragon’! This is a very important experimental process before fusing with the Wind Kirin fossil.”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon still widened its eyes.
“Roar! (Is that… still the overlord of the earth?)”
Ling comforted it and said, “Don’t worry, I won’t give you wings.”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon roared happily.
Change, change. When it became stronger and stronger, it would take back all the pressure it had suffered these days!!
Let Shi Yu and the others understand who the real king was!
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon immediately imagined the scene of it ascending to the throne and commanding the Iron-eating Beast Army to dominate the ground under the respectful expressions of Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Shi Yu.
“Roar…” The Tyrant Dragon continued to roar.
Shi Yu, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling frowned. Compared to high-level intelligence, basic intelligence was indeed inferior.
This was all Shi Yu’s fault. In the beginning, he didn’t have the money to get high-level intelligence and only gave it basic intelligence…
….
As Shi Yu headed to Wu Ling City, he called Principal Feng.
In Ancient Capital University, the busy Principal Feng was stunned. In fact, he was a little afraid of Shi Yu’s call, afraid that he would accidentally cause trouble again… Fortunately, it was just a question this time.
“Principal Feng, what’s going on with the Iron-eating Beast Army and the Green Silkworm cocoon army? I heard they’re under my name?” Shi Yu’s curious voice came from the other side.
“Yes, it was appointed by you when you were cultivating in the Space Emperor Ruins. Be it the Iron-eating Beast Army or the Green Silkworm cocoon army, they’re all related to you. In the end, they will all belong to the Dong Huang Environmental Protection Department. They’re in charge of the ecological protection of the Dong Huang Sea, the Continent, and the Space Regions.”
“I see. In other words, Legend Hua, a legendary Beast Tamer, is also my subordinate??” Shi Yu was slightly shocked, but he suddenly felt that something was wrong.
“Sort of… Legend Hua is very interested in the Green Silkworm cocoon system.”
“Apart from these two legions, it’s said that under Dr. Mei’s suggestion, the Mechanical Beast Army is also about to be established. General Xiao Qin is the commander and chief Mechanic, who is also under your Environmental Protection Department.”
“I heard from Dr. Mei that your Environmental Protection Department is idle. General Xiao Qin and the other two members have nothing to do all day. Why don’t you train your soldiers and strengthen the foundation of the Environmental Protection Department?”
“If you’re free, you can take the time to give guidance. After all, if this kind of heavily supported new recruits want to fight for more military funds, it still depends on actual results and battle power.”
“You should be very good at guiding iron-eating beasts, green cocoons, and mechanical phantom beasts. After all, you were the one who created them.”
“For example, the current first-rank Ye Xing’s ‘Star Army’ has won the honor of being the number one unit in the army for three consecutive years. It’s also because he’s number one in the army’s martial arts competition and the army he brought is the number one in the army that he’s so strong. They’re all invisible resources!”
“Cough, cough, cough. Of course, I also know that you’re not free. I was just saying.” Principal Feng laughed. At the moment, it was more important for Shi Yu to increase his strength as soon as possible.
After all, President Lin had already appointed Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi to participate in the world competition. Principal Feng could only sigh and express his support.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - Changing Fate (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Changing Fate (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Ah…” Shi Yu also sighed and asked, “Have you confirmed the specific departure time of the seven islands exchange team?”
“It’s about half a month later. After all, going out requires a lot of manpower and financial resources. During this period, we definitely have to prepare more transaction materials. By the way, the reason why the establishment of the Iron-eating Beast Corps is on the right track this time is also because the Dong Huang exchange team bought a lot of first-stage evolution materials for the Iron-eating Beast in other countries. Unfortunately, the second-stage evolution metal needed to carve inscriptions was only found with a piece of Divine Space Iron. You don’t need it.”
Shi Yu indeed had no use for the Divine Space Iron, a level-eight material that was used to awaken the Space Quake skill.
After being stunned, Shi Yu said regretfully, “Looks like the path is completely cut off.”
He still had to study it himself.
“Principal Feng, I’m hanging up first. I’ve arrived.”
“Huh??? Aren’t you at Ancient Capital University? Where did you go!” Principal Feng asked.
“Wu Ling City, came to take a look at the Iron-eating Beast Corps. Before going abroad, I’ll give them some pointers. Perhaps they’ll be first in the army competition.”
Principal Feng: “?”
....
At the same time that Shi Yu arrived at Wu Ling City, the Iron-eating Beast Corps recruits from all over the country also gathered in the new recruit camp outside Emperor Wu Ruins.
There were more than 1,000 people in the entire team. All of them had contracted Iron-eating beasts.
Among them, there were three master-level Beast Tamers. Commander Lin Hongnian contracted a monarch-level Nine Li Battle Beast, Deputy Commander White Brook contracted an awakened-level royal Iron-eating Beast cub, and Feeder Lin Xiuzhu contracted a commander-level Iron-eating Beast.
......
The remaining 1,000 ordinary soldiers all contracted transcendent Iron-eating Beasts. Those who didn’t reach commander rank. After all, the Iron-eating Beast’s race level was only transcendent. If it wanted its growth level to break through the racial restriction and reach commander rank, it wasn’t something that ordinary people could do in the short term.
In the new recruit camp, a female soldier in her twenties was looking for a place to stay.
Zhuang Yue.
Quasi professional Beast Tamer, Ping Cheng.
Because the Iron-eating Beast was too cute and its racial attributes were not bad, in addition to the discount for the locals of Ping Cheng, she chose the Iron-eating Beast as her initial pet.
However, the cultivation difficulty of the Iron-eating Beast was much higher than she imagined.
It took her a long time to nurture the Iron-eating Beast to the transcendent level and participate in this year’s Icefield City vocation assessment.
Unfortunately, because her strength didn’t meet the standard, she still couldn’t pass.
Although the family didn’t say anything, Zhuang Yue herself couldn’t accept this outcome when she thought of the investment her family had made in her all these years.
Although she could still continue taking the exam next year, when she thought of her talent and the daily savings at home, Zhuang Yue understood that her future was already destined.
Choosing the Iron-eating Beast… was it the wrong choice?
If she had chosen other pets back then, would she have already passed the vocation assessment?
Along the way, Zhuang Yue had originally complained a few times in her heart. However, from the beginning to the end, there was a figure guiding her forward.
This person was Shi Yu.
That day, she and her friend passed by the public training ground and saw Chen Kai, a top student in her class, commanding his Ice-Armored Beast to fight a Beast Tamer who commanded iron-eating beasts.
That Iron-eating Beast was very strong. It instantly killed the “unhindered class” Ice-Armored Beast. The Iron-eating Beast’s Beast Tamer also attracted her attention.
Soon after, she coincidentally went to the countryside with Shi Yu to carry out the association mission to eliminate the Earth Mice. She once again saw how extraordinary Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast was. It was self-disciplined, hardworking, and powerful. If her Iron-eating Beast was also like this, how good would that be?
However, it was naturally impossible for pets to be completely the same. Zhuang Yue’s situation didn’t improve until…
The archeologist named Shi Yu became the top scholar of the vocation assessment in Ancient Capital and discovered the evolution of the iron-eating beast. Once this news was announced, it could be said to be a pleasant surprise for the Beast Tamers who contracted iron-eating beasts all over the country.
Iron-eating beasts had the evolution form of a monarch!!
After that, Zhuang Yue was filled with motivation again. Not only did she successfully reach level two, but the Iron-eating Beast was also cultivated to the transcendent level. During this period, Shi Yu became the national champion and discovered that the Iron-eating Beast had undergone a second stage evolution. The information that the Iron-eating Beast suspected to be Emperor Wu’s trump card battle pet had been dug up by Shi Yu, and they tried their best to encourage the Iron-eating Beast Tamers.
Unfortunately, under this motivation, Zhuang Yue still failed the vocation assessment even in a second-level city like Icefield City. She was discouraged again and realized the difference between Beast Tamers.
Even at this point, Zhuang Yue was actually still very grateful to Shi Yu. Because of Shi Yu’s experience, the current rarity of the Iron-eating Beast had long exceeded that of a monarch pet cub. It was no longer something ordinary people could afford.
Not only did it require a large amount of money, but it also needed a recommendation spot. And these lucky people who had contracted iron-eating beasts very early were clearly lucky.
It was as if they had just bought a house cheaply and the property price immediately increased tenfold.
Now, Beast Tamers who had contracted iron-eating beasts, even if they were ordinary employees at the Iron-eating Beast Amusement Park in Ping Cheng, or if they had some acting talent and cooperated with the iron-eating beasts to perform some shows… They could get a pretty good salary.
Because of this, Zhuang Yue fell into deep thought. She wondered if she should recognize her ordinary self and not pursue illusory dreams. She might as well do an ordinary profession and subsidize her family, but at this moment, surprise came again.
The Iron-eating Beast Corps was established and recruited Beast Tamers under the age of 30 who had contracted Iron-eating Beasts.
As long as she joined the army, the benefits and treatment would correspond to high-level professional Beast Tamers. The country would cover the cost of cultivating the Iron-eating Beast!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - Changing Fate (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Changing Fate (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Those who performed well could even obtain the opportunity to evolve the Iron-eating Beast. The evolution materials were still included by the country!
At this moment, Zhuang Yue almost cried. She felt that her years of persistence had not been in vain. She was determined and answered the country’s call to join the army with her Iron-eating Beast.
Although it would be very bitter, the benefits and treatment of a high-level professional Beast Tamer were already an opportunity that many Beast Tamers couldn’t obtain even after working hard for their entire lives. After all, the master-level Beast Tamers in Ping Cheng were only in the single digits. In the eyes of ordinary people, high-level Beast Tamers were already dragons and phoenixes among men, the level of graduates from the nine top universities!
Moreover, the country had already paid for the cultivation cost of the iron-eating beasts. They only needed to train hard. Was there a better chance to change their fate than this?
Zhuang Yue was just one of the many Iron-eating Beast Tamers. These Iron-eating Beast Tamers from all over the country had similar experiences as her.
The Iron-eating Beast was originally an ordinary pet of a transcendent race, but now… it was filled with endless possibilities.
Every Beast Tamer who came to the Iron-eating Beast Corps had endless anticipation and looked forward to the future.
Thank you, Iron-eating Beast, thank you, Shi Yu.
“Sister, are you from Ping Cheng? Why do you look so familiar?”
“More than half of the people here are from Ping Cheng. There’s nothing strange, right?” Zhuang Yue looked at the young man in front of her.
“Hahaha, that’s true. Let me introduce myself. My name is Jiang Rui. I was once an apprentice at Bamboo Stone Dojo and was even lucky enough to be insta-killed in a battle with Shi Yu. Hello.”
Zhuang Yue: “?”
Why did he sound so proud?
......
At this moment, an older young man in a new recruit uniform passed by.
“Yo, you’re the junior brother of Bamboo Stone Dojo. You’ve fought Shi Yu before? Hahaha, not bad. I’m your senior brother, an apprentice of the dojo a few years older than you. My name is Yan Qi. I once taught Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast the ‘Thunder Palm’ skill. Hahahaha.”
Yan Qi, the little bear who had once been a security guard at the training base of Mt. Tian Mang, stretched out his tongue and laughed crazily with a smug expression.
“What?!!” The new recruits’ camp was in chaos. Many Beast Tamers from Ping Cheng flaunted their relationship with Shi Yu.
Instant kill could be used as a topic of conversation. Those who taught Shi Yu were even more like gods, attracting the envy of the Beast Tamers in other cities.
Outside Emperor Wu Ruins, thousands of new recruits were here to undergo recruit training. After all, this was the use of Emperor Wu Ruins.
…
In another direction.
Similarly, a new army had gathered.
Green Silkworm cocoon army.
The registration conditions of the Green Silkworm cocoon army were a little diversified. Unless it was a mental strengthening talent, Beast Tamers who contracted a Green Silkworm with perfect proficiency worm silk could register.
After registering, Beast Tamers with mental strengthening talent would be given free Green Silkworms with perfect skill proficiency. After that, including all other Beast Tamers, the army would help the Green Silkworm evolve into a Green Silkworm cocoon for free.
If the Iron-eating Beast Corps gathered Beast Tamers who had contracted Iron-eating Beasts in their early years for various reasons, then a portion of the Green Silkworm cocoon army gathered “Shi Yu’s fanatical fans”.
Because once the results of the Green Silkworm cocoon system of the Feeding Conference were announced, Dong Huang welcomed a bug-catching frenzy.
Most of the people who contracted Iron-eating Beasts had metal-element strengthening talent, but the evolution of the spiritual-type Green Silkworm cocoon didn’t have such strict requirements for the Beast Taming Talent. Spiritual-type Psychic power was a hundred times better!
Here, a similar situation was happening to the Iron-eating Beast Army.
A young man with the ginseng baby whiskers of the Refreshing Capsule and Baby Ginseng in his pocket laughed and said, “Speaking of which, you might not believe me, but Shi Yu’s first time battle was taken by my Brother Chen Kai.”
“I’ve witnessed Shi Yu’s growth all the way! I know that there must be someone among you like me who didn’t have a mental strengthening talent and went bankrupt to buy a Green Silkworm with high worm silk proficiency. I’m very nervous now, but let me tell you, I definitely won’t lose out!”
“Do you see him? He’s the nephew of our president of Ping Cheng. He’s already here. Moreover, I have news. Do you know who our commander is? The legendary Beast Tamer, Hua! Xia! Jin!! Have you seen a legendary Beast Tamer leading a newbie team? What kind of treatment is this!”
“…” Beside him, a young man was silent. It was surprisingly President Feng’s nephew, who Shi Yu had defeated outside the Ping Cheng ruins. These people had contracted a Green Silkworm with very high skill proficiency under the recommendation of their elders and came to the Green Silkworm cocoon army to further their studies.
Many people chose an unknown path because of Shi Yu. Many people changed their lives and fate to a certain extent because of Shi Yu.
At this moment.
In the center of all the storms, the protagonist of all events, Shi Yu, had already arrived at the center of the new recruit camp under the Instant Transmission of the traffic worm.
Outside the door, Lin Xiuzhu, who was wearing a panda suit, immediately waved with a smile when she saw Shi Yu.
Shi Yu also walked up with a smile.
“Senior Lin, long time no see.”
“It’s been a long time!” Lin Xiuzhu said helplessly, “I thought I was busy enough, but I feel that you’re even busier than me.”
“I should be pretty free these few days.” Shi Yu smiled. He just had to keep adding points these few days. There was nothing else. Apart from studying, the cooldown period for adding points was also taken up by meditation. He was indeed free before heading to the seven islands.
“Senior, let’s go in first and discuss something.”
“Huh??”
Shi Yu and Senior Panda directly entered the room inside. During this period, Shi Yu told Lin Xiuzhu his opinion. He said, “I want the Iron-eating Beast Corps to become the first army in this batch of new recruits.”
“Huh?” Lin Xiuzhu had just sat down when she was shocked by Shi Yu. Although she also wanted it to be first in the Iron-eating Beast Corps, the chances were too small.
For example, the green cocoon army led by Legend Hua next door couldn’t be defeated 100%.
“How are your military expenses arranged?” Shi Yu asked.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “Apart from daily food, nutritional supplements, supplements, and medicine expenses, Bamboo Stone Dojo also provides cultivation methods and resources for Thunder Palm, Cannon Fist, and Giant Transformation. I hope these Iron-eating Beasts can learn…”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “The former can be shrunk first. In a while, I’ll give you a skill teaching manual for ‘Absolute Sleep’ to increase their training efficiency. The Iron-eating Beast can cooperate with the energy of this skill. There’s definitely no need for as much resources.”
“Teach this skill first. As for Giant Transformation, there’s no hurry to learn it. Training that consumes too much energy.”
“I’ll give you another universal teaching method for enlarging. Using it with your research manual can increase the success rate of awakening.”
“Apart from that, I’ll give you an ‘impregnable’ skill teaching manual. This way, they can also enjoy the skills after evolution before they even evolve.”
“After that, I’ll let Eleven change their lazy personality through deterrence and imprint the mental seal of ‘strengthening’. At that time, we’ll get a few more team competitions. Only by ranking in the former can we be qualified to learn ‘impregnable’ and ‘giantization’. The outstanding ones have a higher chance of being rewarded with evolution materials. Do you believe in miracles?”
They were all rolled up!
There was nothing that the mental seal and reward couldn’t solve.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven, who was in the ruins space, cried out. It wanted to self-discipline the Iron-eating Beast army and charge forward.
At the side, Buggy’s gaze was solemn. Was this reasonable? It was fine if it couldn’t defeat the leader, but why did its clansmen have to be bullied by a panda army with the mental seal of “working hard to become stronger”… Was this fair!!
“Wu!!!” Buggy also chirped. It applied to guide the Green Silkworm cocoon army. It wanted to create an imaginative domain to guide dream training for the Green Silkworms to increase their mental strength and manually create the dream training device of Star Capital University!

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - Assigning Legendary Resources (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Assigning Legendary Resources (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Absolute Sleep Teaching Manual.
Impregnable teaching manual.
These were good things.
Both were top-notch high-level skills.
Even the third index didn’t record the teaching method of these two skills.
However, teaching manuals were different from adding points to low-level skills. The success rate was not 100%.
The success rate was related to the pet’s race, attributes, level, talent, and the quality of the materials used.
If Shi Yu used the universal standard manual to teach Baby Ginseng, it would be impossible for Baby Ginseng to learn anything.
Therefore, Shi Yu couldn’t guarantee that every Iron-eating Beast could learn Absolute Sleep. However, the success rate of these Iron-eating Beasts learning Impregnable would definitely not be small. After all, it was a racial skill after evolution.
As long as they could all learn Impregnable, then even if these Iron-eating Beast Corps’ pandas didn’t evolve into Nine Li Battle Beasts, they could still display the power of the strongest army of Emperor Wu!
After all, the most impressive thing about Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast Corps was the combination of Giant Transformation and Impregnable. Lin Xiuzhu had long researched the skill teaching manual that allowed the Iron-eating Beast to learn Giant Transformation.
Now, there was also the impregnable skill manual sent by Shi Yu. Apart from these skills that couldn’t be racial skills, they were already not much different from the Nine Li Battle Beast.
The only pity was that Impregnable required a certain amount of proficiency to upgrade to an army skill. This required time. However, in the Beast Tamer Troops, soldiers had the least lack of training time.
......
He could still slack off in school, but in the army, there were pitifully few opportunities to slack off. Almost all time was spent on training!
At the same time, because there was a clear cultivation direction, the military expenses could probably be applied for. In the face of new recruits like the Iron-eating Beast Army that might become a stable overlord race army in the future, the association would definitely not be stingy with the military expenses.
Senior Panda looked at the two skill manuals Shi Yu took out with a stunned expression.
She widened her beautiful eyes and looked at Shi Yu!
“You, what kind of place did you come from?”
“Guess.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“By the way, you can also try to apply for the Clear Gem Fruit. It’s the kind of fruit cultivated by Imperial Capital University at the Feeding Conference that can awaken the army skill ‘Battle Roar’. This is still very useful for the Iron-eating Beast Army that hasn’t reached the monarch level.”
Lin Xiuzhu nodded like a rattle drum.
“Then this.” Shi Yu took out a pendant that looked like a drop of water and gave it to Lin Xiuzhu. “This is a teaching tool condensed from the memory water of water and time skills. It contains the hardening skill experience above transcendent.”
“In the next period of time, I might not have time to let Eleven help your Iron-eating Beast increase its hardening level. Try this. This increased speed should be faster than the Iron-eating Beast increasing its hardening level one-on-one, but unfortunately, it’s very difficult to mass-produce,” Shi Yu said regretfully.
Mass production consumed too much energy for Shi Yu, Eleven, Susu, and Baby Ginseng.
At the moment, Shi Yu didn’t have much time. He wasn’t free enough to even add points to his pets.
Therefore, he only condensed the Worm Silk Skill Water Droplet and Hardening Skill Water Droplet for the time being and gave them to An Chang and Senior Lin.
He definitely had to nurture An Chang. After all, the other party had given him two precious family heirlooms.
On Senior Lin’s side, she had spent a long time helping Eleven awaken its royal bloodline. Shi Yu had said that he wanted to help Eleven increase its hardening level for a long time. This time, he could finally do it.
At the same time, there was also the Psychic Skill Water Droplet, the Deterrence Skill Water Droplet, the Possession Skill Water Droplet, the Water Dragon Ball Skill Water Droplet, and the Rain Prayer Skill Water Droplet. Shi Yu planned to give them to Senior Lu to strengthen the battle power of the Imperial Concubine Flower, the Courtyard Sprite, and the Mermaid Princess. This was also good for the strong alliance when the time came.
Of course, before the batch of water droplets for Senior Lu was completed, Susu would have to work overtime. Therefore, Shi Yu rewarded the legendary resource, Cold Sky, to it in advance.
However, although it was satisfying, it still couldn’t be completely used. If the super racial skills didn’t reach perfect proficiency and relied on resources to break through to the overlord level, it would cause the foundation to be unstable. Shi Yu definitely still hoped that the pets could build a perfect foundation.
“Hardening memory… Water drop??” Lin Xiuzhu still looked at the pile of manuals and treasures Shi Yu took out in a daze.
She looked up at Shi Yu and said, “Is this the resource you said can quickly increase hardening proficiency?”
Lin Xiuzhu originally thought that it would be some special metal-element resource, but she didn’t expect it to actually be a time-element resource, a water drop that contained hardening experience? Why did it sound so unbelievable?
“Yeah.” Shi Yu nodded heavily and said, “I’ll leave the mission of reviving the glory of the Iron-eating Beast to you, Senior.”
Shi Yu hoped that the Iron-eating Beast Corps could become the strongest army in Dong Huang in the future!
“This…”
“Don’t worry, leave it to me.” Senior Panda took Shi Yu’s pile of resources and regained her fighting spirit.
Shi Yu was too generous now.
Was this still that little newbie who relied on Bamboo Stone Dojo to eat and drink resources?
She even wanted to hug Shi Yu’s thigh and beg to be his disciple.
….
Apart from Senior Lin, who received Shi Yu immediately, Hall Master Lin, Senior Bai, and Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo, who were in charge of the Iron-eating Beast Corps, also came to see Shi Yu.
“Holy shit…”
When Hall Master Lin heard that Shi Yu had brought absolute sleep and impregnable manuals, he widened his eyes. Then what was the point of learning Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist? He could directly arrange for the entire army to be impregnable. Wasn’t this invincible?

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - Distribution of Legendary Resources (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Distribution of Legendary Resources (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The army resonance produced by Shi Yu’s 31 Iron-eating Beasts was already strong enough. Even if the skill proficiency of the 1,000 Iron-eating Beasts couldn’t compare to Shi Yu and the others, it was obvious how fierce it would be!
“There’s a skill manual for Impregnable?”
When Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo heard this, they were immediately shocked. They looked at Shi Yu, especially Legend Hua, and asked, “Little Yu, you can’t favor one over the other. Even I have personally come and helped you nurture an army. As the in-charge, shouldn’t you also leave something?”
“As the saying goes, the palm is flesh, and the back of the hand is also flesh. The Iron-eating Beast Army is your eldest son, and the Green Silkworm cocoon army is your second son.”
“Aunt Hua knows that you’re more generous than most legends now!” The beautiful woman also muttered.
She and Master Lin were in charge of the two major new recruits at the same time. At that time, as a legendary leader and a famous insect-type doctor in charge of feeding, it would be embarrassing if her army was not as powerful as the army led by the Lin father and daughter.
“Don’t worry. I’ll get the Butterfly of Imagination to create an Imagination Dream Domain that can increase the level of spiritual power and worm silk as a cultivation place for the Green Silkworm cocoon army to train,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
The Green Silkworm cocoon knew the racial skill Psychic. If the cocoon form increased the level of Psychic, it could also effectively increase the foundation of the Green Silkworm cocoon after evolution.
At that time, he would directly let Buggy eat a Time Fruit and use the power of an overlord to create a Holy Land of Imagination. The Green Silkworm cocoon army would definitely not be weak under Buggy’s blessings!
The overlord-level strength already had the ability to change the natural environment. Although the Imagination Domain couldn’t be maintained permanently, it was still more than enough to train a group of Awakening-level bugs for a year and a half with the suitable resource environment.
“The effect won’t be much weaker than the Butterfly God’s Blessing,” Shi Yu confirmed.
“Really??” Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo were pleasantly surprised. Shi Yu’s words were enough.
“Of course.”
......
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu!” At this moment, White Brook also said with a happy expression, “Shi Yu, I discovered a secret you definitely didn’t discover.”
“Uh?” Shi Yu looked at the beast-eared girl.
“Heh.” White Brook took a deep breath and said, “Iron-eating Beast, Possession!”
In the next moment, light flickered on her body. White Brook instantly turned into a beastwoman with a surging figure, long black and white hair, panda ears, and a panda tail!!
She opened her slightly red eyes and grinned. “The racial talent of the Iron-eating Beast King is to increase its strength slightly after recovering from an injury. I discovered that if it’s in the form of a fusion with the Iron-eating Beast and the Beast Tamer is also injured with the Iron-eating Beast, even if we separate after the battle, the Beast Tamer can still enjoy some of the racial bonuses of the Iron-eating Beast after recovering!”
“My physique will be strengthened!”
“In other words, if I recover from my serious injuries in the Iron-eating Beast Fusion state, my physique will be greatly enhanced. Legend has it that Emperor Wu is known as the strongest physique of humans. I think I know the reason.”
“How is it? Are you envious?” White Brook realized that the Fusion Talent was the correct way to open the Iron-eating Beast Tamer!!
“What!” Shi Yu looked at the cute Senior White Brook in shock. A Beast Tamer with Fusion Talent could actually enjoy the racial talent bonus of an Iron-eating Beast?
Damn it, there was such a good thing? No wonder Zhong Xuan said that under the same level, Emperor Wu’s physique was first and it was second.
“I’m not envious.” Soon, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. Forget it, if he had to be beaten up to get stronger, how could it be better than comfortably eating supplements to increase his physique?
“This ability is good, but even if it’s Junior Bai, you have to take care of your body.” Lin Xiuzhu had a headache. “Don’t train yourself and the Iron-eating Beast until you’re covered in injuries every time. You’re all girls no matter what.”
“Alright, alright ~” White Brook hugged Lin Xiuzhu and smiled. “I know the severity. Thank you for your concern, Senior Lin.”
White Brook sighed in her heart. She hoped that it was Senior Lu who injured her. This might even feel good.
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked at the completely familiar beast-eared girl and panda girl and immediately sighed. He hoped that Senior Lin wouldn’t be harmed by Senior Bai.
….
That day.
In the ruins of Emperor Wu.
Thousands of Iron-eating Beast Corps recruits gathered. Among them, the ratio of male and female soldiers was about 1: 1. The female Beast Tamers who contracted Iron-eating Beasts occupied a considerable number.
However, because these new recruits had different experiences, their strength was uneven. A large number of them were even not professional Beast Tamers.
These new recruits had just entered the Beast Tamer Troops and had yet to completely adjust their mentality. The Iron-eating Beasts beside them had yet to completely adjust their mentality. They still didn’t know what kind of fire pit their Beast Tamer had brought them into…
Deng… Deng… Deng… Deng…
Just as these new recruits stood in line and waited for the commander and the various instructors to appear, a scene that made them fall silent appeared.
Thirty little Iron-eating Beasts less than a meter tall, the size of cubs, and much smaller than their Iron-eating Beasts walked onto the high platform filled with the aura of overlords.
“What is it?” someone said blankly.
Just as all the Iron-eating Beast Corps recruits opened their mouths slightly, confused, something unexpected happened.
With a boom, according to tradition, the veteran showed off to the new recruits.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - Distribution of Legendary Resources (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Distribution of Legendary Resources (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The 30 Bean Bears, whose energy levels exceeded a million and were at the monarch level, suddenly released transcendent-level deterrence waves at the same time. The substantial deterrence waves shook the sky with might, sweeping up from their bodies like a hurricane!!
In the next moment, the pupils of the 1,000 Iron-eating Beasts that were accurately attacked by this group of Bean Bears suddenly constricted. Their mental defense was instantly defeated. In an instant, they stood on the spot in a daze with sweat and fear, their eyes filled with fear.
Their Beast Tamers’ faces instantly turned pale. When had they ever endured a monarch-level deterrence? Even if these deterrence energy fluctuations were controlled very well by the Bean Bears and wouldn’t hurt them, the transcendent-level deterrence fluctuations wrapped around their bodies instantly made these new recruits tremble.
Crack!!!
Under the shocked gazes of all the recruits and Iron-eating Beasts, the soaring deterrence wave tore open the sky, scattering the clouds, and directly tore open a huge spatial crack in the ruins of Emperor Wu.
“How is this possible…” The new recruits of the Iron-eating Beast Corps looked at the group of Iron-eating Beast cubs in disbelief and shock.
What exactly was this…
“From today onwards, for seven days, they will all be your instructors!!!” At this moment, Master Lin Hongnian, who was wearing a military uniform and had a determined expression, slowly walked onto the high platform. Beside him was an even taller and more powerful iron-eating beast evolution form, the Nine Li Battle Beast!!
The dark armored domineering figure was more oppressive than any Iron-eating Beast present.
However, at this moment, Hall Master Lin’s Nine Li Battle Beast swallowed crazily between deterrence and trembled. Son of a b*tch, even its deterrence proficiency was only expert level. What the f*ck was going on with this group of Bean Bears!!
Hall Master Lin also swallowed his saliva crazily, but on the surface, he still did his best. He stared at the group of new recruits with a cold gaze and said, “Treasure these seven days.”
Behind the scenes, Eleven observed in secret. They should cherish this opportunity. Eleven thought for a moment and was afraid that the effect of its own mental seal would be too strong, causing these iron-eating beasts to suddenly die from excessive training. Therefore, it decided to squeeze the Bean Bear to imprint their mental seal instead.
The bean bears also mastered transcendent-level deterrence, more than enough to guide the thoughts of this group of lazy guys. After all, the Bean Bear was also trained by it.
......
…
On the other side, a huge Holy Land of Imagination with a level-seven spiritual energy crystal as the core was created by a huge butterfly with a hundred-meter-long wing.
The entire area suddenly became dreamy, like a paradise in the Spirit Domain filled with white mist.
The domain was as big as a football field, enough to accommodate many Green Silkworms and even Green Silkworm cocoons sleeping and cultivating inside.
Shi Yu stood underground and looked ahead. He nodded in satisfaction. As for Legend Hua and Dr. Zuo, they opened their mouths wide and looked at the Butterfly of Imagination that had enlarged to its complete state after eating the Time Fruit.
Energy Points: 53,450,000
Sensing the terrifying energy fluctuations of the Butterfly of Imagination, Legend Hua and the others, who didn’t understand, were completely shocked by Buggy’s shocking strength. Especially Legend Hua, who felt that the energy fluctuations emitted by the Butterfly of Imagination weren’t much inferior to her Myriad Flower Butterfly Fairy King and was speechless.
It was still like yesterday when Shi Yu brought the green cocoon to evolve. At some point, Shi Yu actually had the battle power of an overlord… It was too fast.
Although it was only a few seconds after creating the Imagination Domain, the Butterfly of Imagination seemed to have leaked air and shrunk to the size of a palm in exhaustion… But, be it the instantaneous eruption or the magnificent feat of changing the environment, it shocked Legend Hua and the others.
“As expected of the number one person below the legendary level…”
Just this move was enough to make any Beast Tamer below the legendary level cry.
“You flatter me, you flatter me. I’m done here.” Shi Yu clapped his hands and smiled.
Alright, he had already arranged the initial stages of the Iron-eating Beast Army and the Green Silkworm cocoon army. How far they could go next depended on their own hard work.
As for the mechanical phantom beast army, Shi Yu didn’t care. Compared to the Iron-eating Beast Army and the Green Silkworm cocoon army, the lower limit of the mechanical phantom beast army was very high. It might be that all the monarch races could take off with their eyes closed. It was better to leave it to General Xiao Qin to do it herself.
Ling was still busy researching itself, so how could she have time to lead the army?
On the other hand, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon was very keen on being king. It probably wanted to have its own underlings.
“Next… Why don’t you let your ginseng baby…” Legend Hua still wanted to say something.
For example, letting Baby Ginseng plant some flowers and grass. The Green Silkworms could increase its evolution foundation with a bite.
Shi Yu hurriedly said, “There’s nothing next, I want to rest…”
Good heavens, they had military expenses so just use military expenses!!! Didn’t ordinary people pay so much taxes for them to spend?
Although he was in charge of the army, they couldn’t just suck him dry.
“Alright, alright,” Legend Hua said with a smile.
“I’ll call that girl Qingwei over too. In any case, she’s already a master. Why would she go to school?” Dr. Zuo looked at the cultivation field in front of him and also made a decision.
Shi Yu had a strange expression. Anything was fine…
Well… Were the people (White Brook, Xia Qingwei) who had been crushed by him in the National League going to work for him? Unfortunately… if only he could let Gao Xuan work for the mechanical phantom beast army… Shi Yu still admired this guy!

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - Distribution of Legendary Resources (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Distribution of Legendary Resources (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
If the ethereal bracelet he created was given to every soldier in the three armies, wouldn’t it be awesome?
However, considering that Gao Xuan might not want to talk to him now, Shi Yu decided to talk about it in the future…
….
After coming to Wu Ling City and providing hundreds of millions of help to his Environmental Protection Department army, Shi Yu entered the ruins space with the beautiful future of his Environmental Protection Department army in mind.
After entering, he realized that there was still a cooldown time for skill teaching. He couldn’t help but sigh.
“A meeting!!!”
Shi Yu shouted and pulled Eleven and the others together in the ruins space.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling looked at Shi Yu and waited for instructions.
“Now, I have a total of five legendary resources in my hand. They are Aurora Magnetic Gold, Legendary Dragon Ball, Divine Earth of Life, Bone Sword, and Cold Sky.”
“Among them…” Shi Yu took out the Aurora Magnetic Gold and threw it to the excited Eleven.
“Among them, the Aurora Magnetic Gold is theoretically the reward for first place in the team meeting. If you also want to get the legendary resource, you have to get first place in the team!!”
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu: !!!
It was so difficult!!!
......
Eleven: “Wu wu wu!! (You guys have to work hard!!)”
It hugged the magnetic gold with love.
“However, considering that the World Tournament is approaching, there’s not much time to hold frequent meetings for you to compete. Therefore, I’ve decided to let you use the legendary resources first,” Shi Yu sighed.
“Wu!!” “Yi!!” “Mi?!” “Ning!!!” The pets’ eyes lit up with surprise.
Our Beast Tamer… was finally a kind human???
“You just have to remember that you owe yourself first place in the team. After using the legendary resources, you have to work twice as hard!” Shi Yu muttered. “I want to see who hasn’t gotten first place after seven or eight internal team competitions.”
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Ling’s expressions turned cold. Damn it.
They all had stronger self-esteem and didn’t have any bad mentality. When they thought about how they didn’t get first place in the team competition after seven or eight years after using the legendary resources in advance, they immediately felt embarrassed.
No, no matter what, they had to get first place in the team!
“Wu wu.” Eleven looked confident and advised them not to think about it. With it around, such a thing couldn’t happen.
“However, although the legendary resources will be distributed to you later, you’re not allowed to use them directly.”
“You can only use a portion of its power to cultivate slowly. Don’t use it to break through the bottleneck of your growth level. Without my permission, no one is allowed to break through to the overlord level,” Shi Yu warned solemnly.
“Ling, tell them what the consequences will be if they directly break through to overlord.”
After a moment of silence, Ling said, “The Beast Tamer will directly be drained to death… No one will give you more points in the future…”
The pets: !!!
Shi Yu sighed and said, “That’s the logic.”
“Therefore, Eleven, you mainly use the Aurora Magnetic Gold to learn the ‘White Thunder’ skill. Continue to use the power of resources to slowly strengthen your physique through electromagnetic control. Don’t completely absorb its power.”
“Wuu!!” Eleven nodded.
“Buggy, you’re using the Dragon of Imagination to train your spatial attainments with the legendary Dragon Ball. After that, I’ll teach you spatial control, anti-magic domain, and other skills to use with the Dragon Ball. Don’t directly swallow the Dragon Ball to break through levels.”
“Wu!!” Buggy nodded.
“Most importantly, Baby Ginseng, you too. You’re not allowed to eat the divine soil of life. Instead, you have to take root in it yourself and slowly strengthen your life force to increase the level of the ‘source of life’ skill. Try to get close to the perfect level.”
“When I add points to you, whether I die depends on the increase in this skill.”
Although they were all mid-level willpower, Shi Yu felt that Eleven’s willpower level was still a little stronger than Buggy and Baby Ginseng. Every time he and Eleven did a points adding session, they were so miserable even with the support of everyone…
If he added points to Baby Ginseng, no one would heal him. Either Baby Ginseng wouldn’t be able to hold on, or Shi Yu himself wouldn’t be able to hold on.
Although Baby Ginseng’s clone could be left behind to assist, the effect of the clone’s support was definitely inferior to the main body. Fortunately, during the period of adding points to Eleven, Shi Yu’s physique was still rising. Otherwise, Shi Yu really suspected that he would die from exhaustion when he added points to Baby Ginseng.
Therefore, it was very meaningful to overdraft the Divine Earth of Life for Baby Ginseng to use in advance to increase the level of its source of life. This way, even if it was a life clone, the support effect would be pretty good.
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng’s expression was firm!
“Chi Tong, the bone sword is relatively special. You just have to possess it often to strengthen your spiritual body, but remember not to absorb its power at a high intensity.”
“Mi!!!”
“Susu, you too. Use the Cold Sky Drop to sense the changes in the attributes of ice and water. Don’t devour it directly. Focus on familiarizing yourself with the form of the Ice Slime King.”
“Ling, supervise them.”
“Ning!” “Yes!” Susu and Ling replied at the same time.
Shi Yu smiled. Alright, after distributing the legendary resources, he could continue to increase points…
Next, he had to wait for half a month.
At that time, he could head to the seven islands.
During this period, Shi Yu planned to hurry up and increase Eleven’s battle power. It was still short of three skills to expert level all super skills!

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - Distribution of Legendary Resources (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Distribution of Legendary Resources (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
….
Ten days later.
Shi Yu still diligently added points to Eleven.
At the side, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling worked hard to support.
“Wuu!!!!”
Now, Eleven had already advanced all the low-level racial skills into Dao Proficiency, and all the low-level teaching skills were transcendent… Those that weren’t super level were all regarded as low-level by Shi Yu.
As for super skills, apart from the Lightning Rod skill, Eleven was already proficient in all of them!
From Inner Power to the Undying Golden Body, it was proficient in all of them. Now, Eleven was experiencing the last point increase to raise the Lightning Rod to expert level!
Shi Yu and Eleven were both in endless pain. After adding points so many times, Shi Yu also discovered it.
The experience of adding points to different super skills was different for pets.
For example, when Eleven added points to the Undying Golden Body, it was really like it had died countless times. It had to experience endless pain that was almost death.
When Eleven added points to the Lightning Rod, it felt that it was being tortured by countless lightning without any extraordinary power. It recalled the most basic fear of lightning in the beast bloodline.
This experience made Eleven and Shi Yu, who felt it with Eleven, feel immense pain. At this moment, Shi Yu was still wondering if Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, Ling… Could the four of them really withstand the pain of adding points to super skills?
......
Apart from Susu, he still wasn’t confident…
“Eh…” It was quite easy to be distracted and let his imagination run wild in endless pain. Shi Yu was considered unique. He had really trained it. If humans also had a will level, his current level could also be medium.
However, Shi Yu quickly realized that it wasn’t that his willpower level had broken through, but that the adding process was suddenly approaching the end.
It took less time than any previous time to add points to Eleven.
This feeling was just like when he added points to Susu back then…
The white-haired Shi Yu suddenly opened his eyes.
“Wu?!” “Ning…” “Yi…” “Mi?” “This is…” Apart from that, Buggy and the others who had added points suddenly looked at Eleven sitting opposite Shi Yu!
At this moment, the change in Eleven’s aura gave them a very unusual feeling.
After Shi Yu took a deep breath, he finally discovered the change!!
Skill: Inner Power
[Teaching success rate]: High!
[Teaching Risk]: Low!
“Huh???” At this moment, although Shi Yu was extremely weak, he was suddenly as happy as a child. He wanted to jump up and celebrate.
Fortunately, his body and waist didn’t allow it. Otherwise, this jump could directly destroy Shi Yu.
“Sob…” At this moment, Eleven slowly opened its eyes. Its blue eyes were very beautiful. Coupled with its soft black and white hair, its initial form was considered the most handsome in the team. It was cute.
Of course, Susu wasn’t bad either.
At this moment, apart from the Lightning Rod skill successfully reaching expert proficiency, Eleven itself also sensed some changes in other aspects.
With the feedback of the stronger and more powerful Impregnable skill, it could clearly sense that its willpower level had a huge breakthrough!!
Overlord’s Will!!!
Under the many times that super skills added points to corrode the mind, under the daily self-mutilating training, and under the enhancement of the Impregnable, Eleven, who had endured it time and time again, successfully broke through the limit with his willpower and condensed the overlord’s will!!
A three-year-old overlord’s will!
“Wuu!!!” Eleven sat on the ground and shouted excitedly!!!
< Name > Eleven
[Race]: Iron-eating Beast, Nine Li Battle Beast
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]:
“Super Level”: Inner Power (Expert), Lightning Rod (Expert), Space Quake (Expert), Bean Soldier (Expert), Impregnable (Expert)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Super Level”: Undying Golden Body (Expert)
Normal Energy Points: 8,010,000
[Will Level]: Advanced (Overlord’s Will)
“Wuu!!!” Eleven shouted excitedly, but like Shi Yu, it couldn’t stand up. It was extremely happy. This way, when Shi Yu added more points to itself next time, it could reduce the time. Shi Yu could suffer less.
Shi Yu was also quite happy. This way, the pressure to upgrade Eleven’s super skill to perfect level was much smaller.
“Wu wu wu wu wu!!!” Beside him, Buggy also cried out in excitement. It was both happy and sad. The sad thing was that the leader walked in front of it again and became the second pet in the team to have the will of an overlord.
Fortunately, it was finally its turn to add points.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng looked at Buggy. Something was wrong. Next, it should be the one getting points. It was clearly the second place in the team competition. It was the towering emperor. What did it have to do with Buggy?

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Wu!”
“Yi!!”
After adding points to Eleven, Buggy and Baby Ginseng started arguing about who to add points to.
After all, they were tied for second place in the last team meeting.
Then, it was reasonable if either one was chosen.
Buggy thought that since it was the second senior to join the team, it should be the second to add points.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, felt that Buggy didn’t dare to fight it head-on in the battle. It had already lost in terms of aura. The real second place should be it. Buggy’s draw was disgraceful, so Baby Ginseng should be the second to add points.
Both had their reasons…
Chi Tong and Susu watched from the side and didn’t dare to interrupt. After all, their rankings were low and they were trembling.
“Wuu.”
At this moment, Eleven, who was beside him, became popular.
It rubbed its paw pad, its blue eyes revealing ill intentions as it looked at the blue butterfly and big white radish in front of it.
“Wuu! (You guys have another match. Whoever wins this time will add points first.)”
......
“…” Buggy and Baby Ginseng’s argument stopped.
To hell with that.
Neither Buggy nor Baby Ginseng wanted to fight the other anymore. It was too tiring.
“Wu ~”
A moment later, Buggy snorted proudly, indicating that it would give the opportunity to Baby Ginseng first.
After all, no matter who it added points to, Baby Ginseng was very hardworking and had it rough.
It apologized to Baby Ginseng, indicating that it shouldn’t have fought.
“Yi…”
Upon hearing Buggy’s words, Baby Ginseng was too embarrassed to fight for it.
It also snorted, indicating that it would give Buggy more points first.
Just as Shi Yu and Buggy had said, it still needed to be in charge of healing Shi Yu during the additional points process. It was really indispensable.
After adding points to Buggy, Shi Yu’s physique and its source of life level could both increase. At that time, it wouldn’t be too late for it to accept the additional points.
“Wu ~! (I’ll add it to Baby Ginseng first.)”
“Yi!! (Add points to Buggy first!)”
The two pets would decide who to add points to first.
A moment later, Buggy sighed. “Wu! (Baby Ginseng is right, then give it to me first.)”
Baby Ginseng: ???
Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, and the other pets shook their heads.
Shi Yu sighed helplessly. Baby Ginseng, didn’t it realize that Buggy was tricking it from the start?
…
If he added points to Buggy, it would mainly revolve around the three super skills “Ultimate Absorption”, “Space Control”, and “Demon Suppression Domain”.
If all the points were added to expert level, it would be 12 lessons. If everything went smoothly, it would take about half a month. It was another painful process of adding points.
As for its Imagination Domain and Dragon of Imagination, they were already at the expert level. It could slowly increase by playing with the Dragon Ball, so there was no hurry to increase them.
Two days later.
Shi Yu tried adding points to Buggy for the first time.
The skill was ultimate absorption.
The teaching process was very painful. It could be said that the “medium” teaching success rate and risk were definitely a lie.
If not for Baby Ginseng and Susu, Shi Yu and Buggy felt that they definitely wouldn’t have been able to survive the additional points this time. Their teaching would have failed, causing them to waste an opportunity.
Fortunately, it barely succeeded in the end.
The price was that almost all the pets in the team almost died.
Two days later.
Shi Yu also taught Buggy the spatial control skill.
Ultimate absorption and spatial control were very important to Buggy.
If Eleven’s Undying Golden Body converted the damage it suffered into vitality…
Then the ultimate absorption of Buggy was to transform the damage it caused to the enemy into vitality and energy.
They were all powerful methods to ensure their endurance.
Q: With the max-level Undying Golden Body and the Ultimate Absorption, can Eleven and Buggy form a Yingji (perpetual motion machine)?
As for spatial control, this skill could effectively increase Buggy’s control and affinity with other spatial skills.
In addition, exploring mystic realm spaces and ruins spaces was also very important.
For example, some archeologists from Bureau 11 of Dong Huang actually had the ability to forcefully tear down the ruins space. They didn’t have to follow the rules of the ruins and relied on skills similar to spatial control.
For example, if the overlord-level gem cat had been the one to crack the ruins in the beginning of Ping Cheng, it wouldn’t have had to follow the rules at all. It would have just broken it with brute force.
However, that would easily destroy the ruins, causing the ancient items inside to be destroyed and the ruins space to be damaged. They couldn’t obtain the spatial ruins to recognize them, so very few archeologists did this.
Of course, if the level of the ruins was high enough, such as the Space Emperor Ruins, then it was different. Because it was built by the Space Emperor, even if the gem cat was already at the totem level, it was helpless and it couldn’t be cracked violently. The Beast Tamers in the outside world could only listen to the arrangements of the owner of the ruins, the Void Mantis, and accept the test.
For Shi Yu, although he didn’t like violent behavior towards ruins and was a civilized person, it was never wrong to back up a skill like spatial control for emergencies.
For example, when they were trapped in the Pirate King Ruins, if the gem cat was more hardworking and had higher spatial attainments, it would directly lead them to break open the ruins violently and escape. There would be no need to fight to the death on the spot…
About half a month after arriving at Wu Ling City.
Shi Yu came out of seclusion.
Because the Dong Huang exchange team heading to the seven islands had already gathered.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s image changed drastically.
He was 1.68 meters tall, had white hair, and a young, mature, old, and weak face. He looked sick.
He was wearing simple casual clothes like a sick young man. Clearly, this was Shi Yu’s second form after the red-haired Chi Tong possessed him!

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In this form, with the help of Baby Ginseng’s special Time Fruit and the power of adding points, the medicinal effect was better than APTX 4869.
Not only had his height shrunk a lot with the help of the Time Fruit, but his appearance had also changed.
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t believe that those people with ill intentions could still recognize him.
Otherwise, he’d be forced to transform into an old man…
In order to go abroad, Shi Yu even used the memory water drop to learn a few fluent languages of the seven islands, Rongguang, Tingxiang… Coupled with telepathy, he was invincible.
Apart from that, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling also ate the “Sealing Fruit” specially made by Baby Ginseng.
In fact, in essence, it was still the Time Fruit.
However, Baby Ginseng used Master Qu Jie’s talent as a reference and researched and improved it a little.
It could use the power of time to disguise Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling’s energy levels at the normal monarch level of more than 1 million.
Even the top index of Dong Huang couldn’t detect their true energy value. Unless it was a totem-level creature proficient in the power of time, only then could it see through their true strength. But this kind of creature couldn’t be found in the entire Blue Planet.
Low profile!!!
After all, he was going to the seven islands to “pick up resources”.
......
Although the Phoenix Mystic Realm was established by the Undying Dark Phoenix and promised to Chi Tong by the Undying Dark Phoenix, it was located on the seven islands after all.
Therefore, Shi Yu was really a little nervous to go to other countries to explore mystic realms.
….
After coming out of seclusion, Shi Yu maintained his white hair form and walked around Wu Ling City. No one recognized him at all.
After secretly observing the progress of the Iron-eating Beast Army and the Green Silkworm cocoon army, he nodded silently and left Wu Ling City.
These days, he had been paying attention to the situation of the two armies.
Among them, the soldiers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps were already stunned and their values shattered.
Because their Iron-eating Beast, which used to like to be lazy, had somehow become a training maniac after being trained by the Bean Bears.
Every day, before dawn, the Iron-eating beasts had already woken up. They were even more diligent than the Beast Tamers.
“Beast Tamer, have you seen Emperor Wu Ruins at four in the morning?”
After the iron-eating beasts woke up, they pulled the Beast Tamers to train one by one, making the green cocoon army next door cry. What was going on…
Of course.
The situation on the Green Silkworm cocoon army’s side wasn’t very good either.
During the day, the soldiers needed to bring the Green Silkworm to train the worm silk, physical fitness, and various training to accumulate evolution foundation.
At night, the green worms still had to undergo dream training in the Imagination Domain. It was similarly tragic.
If it weren’t for the fact that these two new armies had a lot of military expenses and were heavily supported by the country, normal resources might really not be enough to support the two armies’ training!
As for Shi Yu, who had caused all of this, he hid his merits and reputation and left quietly.
Shi Yu didn’t head to Demon Capital immediately to meet the Dong Huang exchange team that was preparing to head to the seven islands area. Instead, he came to the Kong Capital and the Space Emperor Ruins.
At this moment, the Void Mantis still hadn’t come out of seclusion. It looked like it couldn’t successfully break through to the overlord level. It was also possible that the Void Mantis wanted to become a perfect overlord, which was to break through after all super racial skills reached the perfect level, so it needed a longer time.
Outside the ruins, Lu Qingyi was sitting on a rock and feeding her pets.
Suddenly.
A spatial ripple flickered. Lu Qingyi and her pets turned their heads and looked at the white-haired figure.
“Who is it!”
Seeing this figure, Lu Qingyi was stunned. Then, her gaze locked onto the figure’s face and she was at a loss.
She opened her mouth slightly, wanting to say something, but hesitated.
“Shi Yu??”
“It’s me,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“You…” Lu Qingyi was very sure that Shi Yu was currently in his normal state. However, she looked at Shi Yu’s short height, his sickly aura, and his natural white hair and was very confused.
What, what was going on!!!
How did he do it!
If Shi Yu had not arranged to meet her today in advance, she might not have been able to recognize Shi Yu if they passed each other on the way.
The change in the current white-haired Shi Yu and the black-haired Shi Yu was even greater than the change in the image of the black-haired Shi Yu and the red-haired Shi Yu!
“Aren’t we going to the seven islands? President Lin, Principal Feng, and the others suggested that I change my identity.”
“Therefore, it became like this,” Shi Yu said with a shrug.
“Uh…” Lu Qingyi was silent. The seven islands. Shi Yu and the others were going to the seven islands to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm and the Space Emperor Ruins. Lu Qingyi also knew about this.
Be it the Phoenix Mystic Realm or the Space Emperor Ruins that hatched the Space Beast Egg, they were both on the seven islands. It was indeed impossible not to go on this trip.
“This is for you, Senior Lu. I won’t stay long. I’ll tell you the use, and I have to go to Demon Capital quickly.”
After Shi Yu arrived, he directly gave the memory water droplets condensed by Susu and the others in different bottles to Senior Lu.
A moment later, Lu Qingyi looked at the few bottles of top-notch resources in her hand in surprise.
This… was what Shi Yu wanted to give him?
It could quickly increase deterrence and other skill levels to transcendent memory water droplets in a few months!
Memory water drop… Wasn’t that the ability of the deceased guardian of Dong Huang? Where did Shi Yu come from!
Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu’s departing figure and clenched the resources in her hand. Although she had also given Shi Yu a Spirit Accumulation Jade, in Lu Qingyi’s opinion, this memory water drop was undoubtedly more valuable.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
….
Demon Capital.
The Dong Huang exchange team this time was made up of a total of 72 people.
It involved elites in many fields such as battle, feeding, archeology, machinery, and business.
Among them, the Beast Tamer leading the team was the Tyrannical Sea Legend Fish.
The fourth bureau’s legendary Mechanic Xiao Shuang, the eleventh bureau’s legendary Beast Tamer Ke Yingzong, and the fifth bureau’s legendary Beast Tamer Jiang Tianyang.
One titled legend, three ordinary legends!
Among them was the totem-level gem cat, Ying.
The battle lineup could be said to be very luxurious. Even if it was to destroy the weakest totem country like the Heavenly Fox Nation next door, it was enough.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Thousand-faced Fox God of the Heavenly Fox Nation was very good at currying favor with powerful people and had devastating aesthetics, such a small country with only ordinary totems wouldn’t be able to withstand the totem battle at all.
Among these people, only four legends and the guardian Ying knew Shi Yu’s true identity. Shi Yu’s external identity was the genius Beast Tamer cultivated by President Ye of the Dong Huang Feeding Bureau. He rarely appeared.
There were actually many such geniuses in Dong Huang. For example, the descendant of the Divine Source Legend, Shen Ling, was a genius that had been secretly cultivated. If it weren’t for the start of the Sequence Battle, the outside world wouldn’t know about her at all.
When Shi Yu arrived at Demon Capital, the overlord-level battleship with an internal mechanical space had already docked at the shore.
......
“Not good, kid.”
However, just as Shi Yu arrived nearby, the gem cat locked onto Shi Yu accurately and teleported over.
The reason why it could see through Shi Yu’s disguise was not because its eyesight was powerful, but purely because Shi Yu had sent it a selfie…
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu immediately said as he looked at the shocked gem cat.
The gem cat cursed, “Undying Dark Phoenix, it didn’t lie to us!!!”
“The Phoenix Mystic Realm really has a large amount of resources!!!”
Shi Yu was stunned.
Back then, the Undying Dark Phoenix said that Chi Tong’s transcendent-level Sun Flame was the only way to unseal, cleanse, and save it.
In order to nurture Chi Tong and quickly let it grow, it told Shi Yu and the others the location of the resource mystic realm it had established.
Shi Yu and the others had been worried about whether there were any traps in this mystic realm. For example, could this mystic realm be the switch to break the seal of the Undying Dark Phoenix?
Just as they opened it, the Undying Dark Phoenix on the Undead Battlefield would break through.
If that was the case, it would be too much.
Therefore, Shi Yu reported the news of the mystic realm. The country had made foolproof preparations, so Shi Yu and the others came to explore.
This way, even if there were any changes, everyone could react.
Of course, this was the worst guess. After all, according to the Undying Dark Phoenix, this mystic realm was purely a place for it to store resources. It was filled with treasures!
It wasn’t that Shi Yu and the others didn’t believe it completely. If they didn’t believe it, they wouldn’t have come to explore. What if what the Undying Dark Phoenix said was true?
What if it really left a bunch of Mythical and legendary resources for Chi Tong?
Then they would have wronged Mother Feng.
It was precisely because he had various doubts that Shi Yu was stunned when the gem cat said that the Undying Dark Phoenix wasn’t lying.
“How do you know?”
“In addition, if it’s true, isn’t it good news? Why do you say it’s bad?”
“Well… It’s both good and bad.”
The gem cat said, “Not long ago, our… Ahem, friend from the seven islands found concrete news.”
“It seems like someone accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm before we decided to find it!!!”
“According to the Undying Dark Phoenix’s map, we can confirm that the location of the Phoenix Mystic Realm is one of the seven islands, ‘Red God Island’. However, after careful investigation, we discovered that 15 years ago, a Beast Tamer from the seven islands accidentally entered a mystic realm related to the Phoenix Race on this island and obtained a large amount of resources from it.”
“Because of this, she grew into a legendary Beast Tamer whose name shook the seven islands at an extremely fast speed.”
“Holy shit, you’re saying that the mystic realm she accidentally entered is the mystic realm mentioned by the Undying Dark Phoenix? Didn’t the Undying Dark Phoenix say that only creatures with its bloodline power can open the mystic realm?”
“#@%@#￥@” Shi Yu also widened his eyes and cursed.
