“How would I know?” the gem cat muttered. “However, it’s said that that legend is also a hybrid, and it’s also a telepathy talent. Could it be a dual buff combination of a phoenix hybrid and listening to the Voice of History?”
With the treasure gone, it would be the one who was most saddened.
“Don’t tell me she’s also an illegitimate daughter left behind by the Undying Dark Phoenix. The sister of Chi Tong and the empress, the third sister??? Or is it a bloodline left behind by the empress? If it weren’t for the situation on the seven islands, the Undying Dark Phoenix wouldn’t have placed the mystic realm on the seven islands. In addition, during the era of the empress dynasty, there was quite a lot of communication with the outside world…” the gem cat imagined.
Shi Yu was at a loss. What was going on?
“Then what should we do? Fight over and let that legendary Beast Tamer return the resources??” Shi Yu said.
“Let’s go acknowledge our relatives and let Chi Tong split the family assets.”
The gem cat was stunned. “Wait, wait, I guessed it. It might not be related. Moreover, the situation isn’t that bad.”
“Forget it, I’ll take you to see Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others first. We just received the news and are in a meeting to discuss.”
“Hurry, hurry, hurry,” Shi Yu said.
In the battleship.
In the conference room.
Regarding the news that had just come from the seven islands, Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others indeed fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: The Seven Islands Ruins Targeted by Shi Yu (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
This trip to the seven islands for the exchange and trading was secondary.
Most importantly, it would cooperate with Shi Yu to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm and hatch the Space Emperor’s inheritance egg.
In the end, as they were about to set off and received such news, they had to reconsider everything.
The figures of the gem cat and Shi Yu appeared in the depths of the battleship.
In the conference room, the four legends sat at the conference table.
Among them, Legend Sea Tyrant and Legend Xiao Shuang were old acquaintances of Shi Yu. He knew them.
As for Bureau 11’s Senior Ke Yingzong, although Shi Yu had not come into contact with him much, he knew that he was an old archeologist who studied the history of the seven countries. He was a legendary battle power in Bureau 11.
The last was a handsome young man not much older than Shi Yu. He was a fourth-rank Beast Tamer, Jiang Tianyang, the heir of the largest financial group in Dong Huang. It was said that 20 years ago, when he was very young, he took advantage of the seven countries’ exchange bonus period in the last world competition to follow his elders all over the world to see the outside world. He was also very talented in business.
“Senior Yu, Sister Xiao, Senior Ke, Mr. Jiang,” Shi Yu greeted them one by one after arriving.
At this moment, when the four of them saw Shi Yu and the gem cat, they immediately nodded. The Tyrannical Sea Legend also let Shi Yu take a seat and said,
“You’re here,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said. “Senior Ying told you, right?”
“Yes. What’s the current situation?” Shi Yu asked.
“The situation isn’t that bad. According to the subsequent news, the legendary beast tamer of the seven islands only accidentally entered the mystic realm. She didn’t have the ability to enter the Phoenix Mystic Realm steadily, and she couldn’t take all the resources in the mystic realm.”
......
“It’s said that the deeper you go in this Phoenix Mystic Realm, the stricter the requirements for the power of the bloodline, and the hotter the interior. Therefore, she only took away the low-level materials of the mystic realm, and the high-level materials of the mystic realm are protected by powerful flames.”
“And when she came out and wanted to enter the mystic realm again, she couldn’t find a way to enter.”
“In that case, the core resources of the Phoenix Mystic Realm are still inside?” Shi Yu asked.
Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “That should be the case.”
“However, yes, but the problem is that the seven islands have long known about this mystic realm more than ten years ago.”
“Although they didn’t have the ability to crack and enter, the Beast Tamer who accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm established the ‘Phoenix Divine Society’ after growing up to protect the entrance of the mystic realm.”
“Moreover, for more than ten years, they’ve been researching how to enter the Phoenix Mystic Realm again. Therefore, it’s probably difficult for us to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm secretly. This mystic realm isn’t in the wild, but under the gaze of the Phoenix Divine Shrine, one of the top factions of the seven islands.”
“Even if you can 100% crack the mystic realm according to the Undying Dark Phoenix, the seven islands probably won’t watch us directly take away the core resources inside.”
“According to the information we’ve obtained, there should be Mythical resources at the core of the Phoenix Mystic Realm. Moreover, there are at least two legendary resources. Otherwise, that legend of the seven islands wouldn’t be so obsessed with exploring for more than ten years.”
“She even cultivated many Phoenix Witches because of this, hoping to enter the mystic realm with similar methods.”
Mythical resources!
As expected!
Shi Yu was envious.
Level-nine legendary resources were already difficult to apply for. This was a level-ten Mythical resource!!
The Undying Dark Phoenix was indeed Mu Huiyin and the empress’s biological mother. It was indeed the top expert of the Phoenix Race. As expected of a big boss who could be a top-notch totem after reincarnation. Its wealth was too rich.
“We can’t give up, right?” Shi Yu said.
“Of course we can’t give up,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said. “So, we’re thinking if we can scam the seven islands…”
“How?”
“A bet.” Jiang Tianyang, who had the aura of a noble son, smiled and said, “This is very common. For example, when the Ming Hua exchange team came to Dong Huang, didn’t you fight the Ming Hua Beast Tamer?”
He looked at the completely changed Shi Yu and smiled.
“That’s actually a bet.”
“If Dong Huang wins, we can gain some advantage in the exchange and trade. And if Ming Hua wins, we have to open some special cultivation mystic realms unique to Dong Huang for their Beast Tamers.”
“This time, we can also give it a try and use a certain bet to obtain the right to explore the seven island mystic realms and ruins. As long as we write it out in black and white in advance, they can’t go back on their word later.”
“We’ll use other aspects to make the seven islands feel that they have gained an advantage. At the same time, they want the right to explore a batch of ruins and mystic realms that they can’t crack. As long as there’s enough gambling money, the authorities of the seven islands will definitely bet on those unbreakable ruins. After all, unbreakable ruins can’t be considered resources, but the stuff Dong Huang can take out is clearly visible resources.”
“Even if the seven islands don’t know about the Phoenix Mystic Realm, we will definitely dig a similar pit first to avoid any conflict after the exploration is completed. And now, since the seven islands already know about the Phoenix Mystic Realm, we have to perfect our preparations in this aspect.”
“Well, apart from everyone present, no one knows that you can 100% crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm,” Legend Xiao Shuang said. “You can let the seven islands suffer in silence.”
“If they regret it later, that’s their problem. Even the seven islands aren’t willing to fall out with Dong Huang for a Mythical resource at this moment.”
After hearing what the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others said, Shi Yu was instantly relieved.
“You guys are still the most sinister,” the gem cat said happily, grinning.
Shi Yu also took a deep breath and said, “It’s not impossible…”
“Then how do we bet with the seven islands in exchange for the right to explore the seven island ruins and mystic realms?”
Senior Ke Yingzong stroked his beard and said, “This… We can only confirm it after we reach the seven islands and communicate with the higher-ups of their association.”
“It’s possible that they’re letting their archeologists explore our unsolved ruins mystic realm in exchange for us to crack their ruins mystic realm. This is a gamble in the archeological field. How many resources we can obtain depends on our own abilities.”
“It’s also possible that they’re betting on whose world contestant is stronger through battle communication.”
“It’s also possible that we need to take out legendary resources to gamble. Or, they might also be eyeing some of our skills, such as mechanical phantom beasts and green cocoons. In short, no matter what, the Seven Islands Association will definitely have something they want to bet on.”
“As long as we’re 100% sure that we can crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm and obtain the myths and legendary resources inside, we’ll always be invincible in this bet.”
Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
“The bet of cracking the ruins is good. It’s a competition of speed and number. In this aspect… I’m good at it!!!”
As long as he was given time, he could fight all the Mythical Ruins and legendary ruins of the seven islands. He would definitely be able to fight a few of them. He wouldn’t feel any mental pressure to fight the ruins of the seven islands.
In fact, on deeper thought, Shi Yu was really a little excited.
In the past half a month, he had studied the history of the seven islands hard because he wanted to show off his skills here.
“Cough, cough, cough.” Everyone had strange expressions. Calm down, you’re just an ordinary white-haired Beast Tamer now. Don’t keep thinking about causing big trouble. In short, when we reach the seven islands, let’s dig a pit for the Seven Islands Association first!!
He couldn’t expose his identity too early. Now, Dr. Shi Yu’s name had already spread throughout the seven islands. If the Seven Islands Association knew that Shi Yu had gone over, they would probably use Shi Yu as a bet to let Shi Yu have a child on the seven islands before leaving.
It was really hard to say which was more important in the eyes of the Seven Islands Association.
Back then, a legendary Beast Tamer from Dong Huang was tricked overseas like this. Heroes couldn’t resist beauties… If they weren’t wrong, Shi Yu was still… single?

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
On Dong Huang’s side, they planned for big news.
This caused the departure time to be delayed for half a day.
During this period, it was mainly to ask President Lin.
Regarding this matter, President Lin expressed ‘screw it’.
If Shi Yu had that ability, it would be best to blow up a few more seven island ruins.
After hearing about this…
Shi Yu fell silent…
The Lin family definitely didn’t like the seven islands.
The grudges probably went back to a hundred years ago!
President Lin was the descendant of Lin Feng Legend.
He had most likely heard some small story.
As for why Shi Yu knew, it was because the Sea Dragon King had said it in Dragon Palace City.
When he heard that the Poison Dragon Totem was from the seven islands, the Sea Dragon King kept cursing.
He couldn’t wait to drown the seven islands immediately.
It seemed like Lin Feng had conflicts with the seven islands back then.
“I should have brought the Sea Dragon King and his wife along…” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, a member of his Dragon Palace City’s Marine Environmental Protection Department had gone to the seven islands to investigate the poison radiation a long time ago. He wondered if there were any results from the investigation.
If Dragon Palace City caught wind of this, this group of totem dragon kings would definitely go to the seven islands to extort money.
After all, in terms of overall strength, Dragon Palace City was definitely not inferior to the seven islands.
In addition, Dong Huang was an ally of Dragon Palace City.
If evidence was really caught, the seven islands could only admit it.
After Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City formed an alliance, both parties were on the same side.
It was also because of the alliance with Dragon Palace City that Dong Huang’s overall national strength had always been first among the seven countries.
After all, with the Mechanical Legend+Dragon Palace Dragon God, Dong Huang had two demigods!
This was something the other five countries couldn’t compare to.
The only thing that could compare was the Shen Feng Nation. They also had a mechanical legend. Moreover, this mechanical legend had successfully used creatures to modify a demigod-level mechanical divine eagle.
However, between the Dragon God and the Divine Eagle… there was no doubt at all which was stronger.
The battleship heading to the seven islands finally set off.
Driving a battleship to communicate was also a unique style in this world…
After all, natural disasters were extremely frequent on Blue Planet, and there were countless ferocious beasts in the sea.
Even ordinary legends had to rely on transportation very much when they went abroad.
After the battleship set off, Shi Yu came to the deck and blew the sea breeze.
In the sky, groups of transcendent sea birds flew across the sky and rode the sea breeze.
On the deck, Shi Yu wasn’t the only one. There were also some other Dong Huang elites.
It was rare for them to go abroad. The dozens of elites from various fields were either chatting and communicating in the banquet in the battleship or breathing fresh air on the deck outside.
There were even some Beast Tamers who released their water-element pets and flying pets to swim the sea and soar in the sky above the sea.
With the overlord-level battleship and so many legendary escorts, the safety of the Dong Huang exchange team was still guaranteed.
Moreover, the East Sea here was also the domain of Dragon Palace City, so there was even less of a problem.
But, when they approached the seven islands, they needed to pass by a few totem territories.
For example, the Earth Demon Ape and the Snake Lord that Baby Ginseng had exploded. Their hometown… was over there.
However, during the World Tournament, most of the totem countries had already issued a joint statement that during this period, everyone had to be stable and not cause trouble, so the chances of something happening weren’t high.
Of course, even so, they had to be careful. After all, the resources brought by the exchange teams of the seven countries were enough to make many overlords and totems envious.
Not all totem countries would be stable. A large faction like Dragon Palace City didn’t even care about the joint declaration of the Seven Nation Alliance and the Totem Alliance. After all, Dragon Palace City wasn’t even interested in participating.
“Eh.”
Just as Shi Yu was sitting at the edge of the battleship, a familiar voice suddenly came from afar.
“Little brother, you look unfamiliar.”
“Who are you with?”
A young man in sunglasses took off his sunglasses and looked at the white-haired Shi Yu curiously.
Obviously, he didn’t recognize Shi Yu.
Moreover, he was rather curious about Shi Yu’s hair color…
It didn’t look like it was infected. Was it a special disease?
Looking at Shi Yu’s complexion, it was indeed not very healthy.
“Heavenly King Zou…”
As for Shi Yu, whose figure, height, hair color, and aura had changed because of the Time Fruit and the additional points, he looked at the young man in front of him and smiled in surprise.
Oh, wasn’t this Zou Tianwang!
Was he going to the seven islands to find hot topics?
Why wasn’t he in the country anymore?
“Huh?”
Seeing that this white-haired youth knew him, Zou Yun immediately chuckled and said, “What heavenly king? Just call me Zou Yun.”
How could anyone who could enter this exchange team be simple? As a Beast Tamer from the club, Zou Yun definitely had to maximize his interpersonal skills. When the time came, it would be more convenient for him to change his style.
“I’m President Ye Hui’s student, Lu Bai. There’s a mission assigned by the teacher this time. I’m going to observe the unique pets of the seven islands.” Shi Yu spoke nonsense and stole the surnames of Senior Lu and Senior Bai.
It had to be said that this name matched his white hair.
“I see! Lu Bai, Master Ye Hui’s student? In that case, you’re a Feeder?” Zou Yun said.
“Part-time. As for my main job, I’m still a Beast Tamer.” Shi Yu smiled.
“I see.” Zou Yun didn’t take it seriously. After all, he didn’t see Lu Bai’s name in the Sequence ranking.
Then, Shi Yu and Zou Tianwang chatted freely and obtained impressive information.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Zheng Hai, Ji Feng, Ning Tianming, and Tong Yan, who were in the top ten of the Sequence, were all here!
Shi Yu thought for a moment. It was normal. After all, the exchange between the two countries during the World Tournament would definitely not be lacking in battle exchanges. The Dong Huang exchange team definitely had to bring a batch of geniuses.
Unfortunately… Heavenly King Zou wasn’t in the top ten anymore. Once he left the country, he would definitely be looked down upon by his international friends…
…
The journey to Dong Huang was calm.
This was also normal. The number of creatures qualified to rob this ship, excluding Dragon Palace City, was less than two.
After a period of sailing, the Dong Huang exchange team was about to approach the sea area of the seven islands, close to one of the seven islands, “Heavenly Rainbow Island”.
This island was famous for being able to see beautiful rainbows in the sky all year round. It was one of the seven major islands in the seven islands area.
In terms of area, it was about the size of a second-level city in Dong Huang. It was much smaller than a first-level city.
However, in terms of development level, the core cities of every island in the seven islands were not what Dong Huang’s second-level cities could compare to. They matched Dong Huang’s first-level cities.
The huge battleship gradually approached Heavenly Rainbow Island. On Heavenly Rainbow Island, they also knew that Dong Huang’s exchange team was coming today. Several legends had already come to welcome them.
…
The exchange belonged to the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others. At the moment, Shi Yu only needed to wait for the results and wait for the higher-ups to tell him what to do.
After arriving at the seven islands, the overlord-level battleship boarded the land in the form of a base car.
The members of Dong Huang’s exchange team were all arranged to stay in a high-level residence called the Heavenly Rainbow Tower in Tian Hong City. Shi Yu also directly carried his bag and checked in. The gem cat that followed him checked that the room was fine and yawned.
“Why did you come with me??”
Shi Yu ate the sweet fruit and spoke unclearly.
“To protect you.”
The gem cat said, “Stop eating, hurry up!”
“What’s so good about fruits?”
“I’m still waiting to eat the raw fish slices from the banquet… I wonder how it’s compared to the big meal in Dragon Palace City…”
Shi Yu : “…”
Arrogant! It actually said that the fruits planted by Baby Ginseng weren’t delicious? It wasn’t like it wouldn’t keep asking for gem fruits in the future!
“I thought you wanted to take the time to take a look at the Space Emperor Ruins first.” Shi Yu curled his lips.
The Space Emperor established a total of four “Star Prayer Ruins” to mobilize the power of the stars as nutrition to hatch the Space Beast Egg.
And the “Star Wilderness Island” in the seven islands area had one of the four ruins.
Therefore, apart from going to the “Red God Island” to take a look at the Phoenix Mystic Realm, they also had to go to Star Wilderness Island to find the Space Emperor Ruins. They were also busy enough.
“Let’s go, let’s go,” Shi Yu said. “I want to eat that kind of food that can ‘burst my clothes’. I wonder if there’s any.”
The gem cat: ???
What the f*ck was that?
“It’s similar to those ‘glowing’ dishes.”
As a “disguiser”, Shi Yu did not exchange feeding experience with his friends from the seven islands. His destination was clear. Like the gem cat, he was already here. He would eat more special food first.
….
On the other side.
The legendary Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, led by the Tyrannical Sea Legend, also met the higher-ups of the Seven Islands Association.
On the seven islands, the one in charge of welcoming the Dong Huang exchange team was the titled legend of the seven islands, General Tian Zhi, known as the “Legend of the Warring States”. This title came from this Beast Tamer. He had once destroyed a small totem country that threatened the seven islands, by himself.
From the seven islands, two legends also arrived. They were the legendary Mechanic “Orange Qianyao” who had studied and communicated with Dong Huang, and the legendary Beast Tamer “Su Zijin” of the Suzuki Financial Group, the largest financial group of the seven islands.
Dong Huang and the seven islands started a discussion for hours about the exchange between the two countries.
Just as some rules were confirmed, Shi Yu had also finished his meal and was lying in his room…
“They’re calling you to the meeting.” Beside him, a cat was also in charge of passing the message.
These words surprised Shi Yu. “The discussion results are out. I wonder when I can show off…”
“Cat, Instant Transmission!”
“I can’t use Buggy now.”
The gem cat: ???
Did he not have legs?
Couldn’t it walk after not having Instant Transmission?
“Hurry up and climb,” the gem cat cursed.
At the same time.
In the lounge of the four legends of Dong Huang, the four legends were sitting together and discussing the exchange just now.
At this moment, a figure flashed over, making the four of them look up together.
“How’s the situation?” Shi Yu asked them after arriving in a daze.
Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others nodded and said, “It’s pretty smooth, but for both parties, it’s a bet.”
“What do you mean?” Shi Yu also sat down.
Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “In the seven islands, the one they’re most concerned about is still Dong Huang’s mechanical phantom beast system. However, Dong Huang definitely won’t let go in this aspect.”
“Apart from that, what they’re most concerned about are the various mystic realms, ruins, and rich resources in the Dong Huang area.”
This was very normal. After all, the area of the seven islands was much smaller than Dong Huang, and their history was even shorter. Therefore, places like ruins and mystic realms were far fewer than Dong Huang.
And places like ruins and mystic realms happened to be the treasure land that produced the most resources and inheritances. It would be strange if the seven islands weren’t envious.
Therefore, there was no need for Dong Huang to take the initiative to mention it. The seven islands, like Ming Hua, had their eyes on Dong Huang’s ruins and mystic realms.
Dong Huang only followed the thoughts of the seven islands and easily drafted the communication rules they wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Let’s not talk about the changes in the other business exchanges first. The most important thing this time is the bet between the ruins and mystic realms.”
“How do we bet?” Shi Yu asked.
“Of course it’s the most direct battle,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said. “Just like the exchange between Dong Huang and Ming Hua that you participated in back then, using the battle results to determine the authority of both parties.”
“This time, the seven islands will open their ‘Champion Path’ to contestants under the age of 30 who are below the level of Beast Tamers and overlords.”
“How many ruins and mystic realm resources we can use, explore, and obtain this time will depend on the outcome of the challenge on the path of the champion.”
“The path to champion… What’s that?” Shi Yu asked in confusion.
When he studied the history of the seven islands, there was no such thing.
“A new place for the Seven Islands Association to choose ‘legends’.”
Legend Xiao Shuang said, “There are a total of ten stages on the path to champion. The first nine stages will be guarded by nine powerful top-notch masters. The tenth stage will be guarded by an overlord-level pet.”
“The challenge rules are 1VS1. The challenger can change pets after every level. If the challenger can pass ten levels in ten hours, it’s successful, and the Seven Islands Association will reward a ‘legendary resource’ to the local contestants who can complete the challenge.”
“It’s similar to our Sequence battle. It’s the venue of the selection legend established by the seven islands to support them under the age of 30.”
“This…” Shi Yu was immediately shocked.” If we pass, will they also reward us with legendary resources? ”
The legends: “Dream on!”
How was that possible!
“In the territory of the seven islands, there are no Beast Tamers who have successfully passed the Road of Champions. This challenge is undoubtedly very difficult. The highest battle result of their contestants is only passing the eighth level. It’s not easy for us to challenge results on this Road of Champions…”
“The contestant who passed the eighth level is known as the number one master of the new generation of the seven islands. He’s quite extraordinary.”
“Of course, we don’t have to worry too much. In terms of the strength of young geniuses, Dong Huang has always been one of the best.”
“And the seven islands are about the same as Ming Hua.”
“It means that the better the results our contestants can achieve, the more mystic realms and ruins the seven islands can open to us. On the other hand, if our results don’t reach the standard of the bet agreement, our Dong Huang will open some Dong Huang mystic realms and ruins to them,” Senior Ke said.
“The seven islands will open their special cultivation mystic realms and ruins of different levels to the contestants who break through the fifth, sixth, and seventh levels.”
“Among them, as long as contestant Dong Huang successfully breaks through the eighth level, the seven islands will open their unsolved mystic realms and ruins to Dong Huang. We can try to crack them. Then, the two parties will split the gains according to 4: 6. 4 for us and 6 for them.”
“If we successfully pass the ninth level, we can crack the unsolved ruins and mystic realms of the seven islands ourselves within the specified time. The gains will all belong to Dong Huang. The more people pass, the longer we can explore!”
“And as long as contestant Dong Huang successfully breaks through ten levels, the seven islands will open one of their completely cracked Mythical ruins for contestant Dong Huang to cultivate for seven days. Although its value is inferior to legendary resources, it’s not bad.”
“Apart from that, Dong Huang will also obtain the initiative in this business activity. It can use one of our legendary resources to exchange for one of their legendary resources unconditionally. The choice is in our hands.”
This was equivalent to using Dong Huang’s useless legendary resources to exchange for the other party’s rare legendary resources.
After Senior Ke Yingzong finished speaking, Shi Yu took a deep breath.
Good lord.
It was indeed a huge bet.
As long as he passed the ninth level of the championship path, the seven island ruins mystic realm would be freely explored by Dong Huang, and all the benefits would belong to Dong Huang. Wouldn’t this be like sending a sheep into the tiger’s mouth??
Of course, from the perspective of the Seven Islands Association, perhaps this was nothing.
After all, the premise for all the gains to belong to Dong Huang was that Dong Huang cracked the ruins, and which of the seven islands’ unsolved ruins and mystic realms had not been attempted after researching for dozens or hundreds of years?
Even if Dong Huang studied it, they might not necessarily gain anything. Instead, there was a high chance that it would be all for nothing.
At the same time, although Senior Ke didn’t say what Dong Huang needed to pay for not passing the ninth level, it seemed that Dong Huang also had to pay a certain price, but it wasn’t as big as the seven islands.
“The difficulty of passing the championship is indeed high… Unless it’s legendary battle power, the difficulty of defeating an overlord-level pet in a one-on-one situation is terrifyingly high.”
“However, it’s only the ninth level. It shouldn’t be a big problem for Ji Feng, Tong Yan, and the others, who have the experience of killing overlords head-on and poisoning them.”
“In short, our contestants just have to pass nine levels. They have the right to explore the seven islands and obtain all the benefits.”
Senior Ke Yingzong was filled with anticipation. “That kid Ji Feng should be able to do it!! Unfortunately, your disciple Zheng Hai’s Beast Taming level hasn’t reached the standard, so he can’t challenge it. Sigh, if only Qingyi were here. This challenge definitely won’t be a problem. The tenth level might be very difficult, but the ninth level can definitely be achieved.”
“The seven islands gave five challenge spots. Ji Feng, Zou Yun, Tong Yan, and Ning Tianming are still lacking one. Why don’t I go to Dong Huang to fetch Lu Qingyi?” Legend Sea Tyrant said. “If I’m in a hurry, I should be back tomorrow. I can make it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Uh.” Shi Yu looked at the four legends and said, “Have you forgotten something? Don’t you still have me?”
“From the sound of it, nine levels shouldn’t be difficult. We can also give the tenth level a try.”
Shi Yu’s words attracted the attention of the four legends present.
They were silent.
Jiang Tianyang looked at Shi Yu strangely.
But now, he wasn’t Shi Yu, he was Lu Bai!!
Shi Yu, the number one person below the legendary level of Dong Huang. Not to mention nine levels, there might even be hope for ten levels, but the problem was that if Shi Yu came to challenge, wouldn’t his disguise be pointless?
“Unless you recover to Shi Yu and challenge it with your Iron-eating Beast.” The corners of Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mouth twitched.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “That’s not necessary. My other pets are also very strong.”
With that said.
A purple summoning array condensed in front of him, and cold air surged. An Ice Slime with a frost crown and a frozen body appeared in front of everyone.
“Ning!”
At the same time, an illusion condensed in the air, and a blue bird spirit flickering with ghost flames landed on the crown.
“Jiu!”
“There’s no need to rely on Eleven. Every one of my pets has quasi overlord battle power at this moment. The two of them are enough to challenge the champion path. Moreover, look at their images…”
The bird spirit covered in blue flames was completely different from the sword spirit Chi Tong with pure energy.
The monarch race, the mainstream elemental pet of the seven islands, the Ice Slime King, was also a world-shaking change from the previous transcendent race, the Water Slime.
Seeing Shi Yu’s two pets, the expressions of the four legends changed in shock.
What was going on?
For a moment, they couldn’t react.
But soon, Senior Ke said, “This, this bird spirit, could it be???”
Was it Senior Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit? Why did it become like this!
After a moment of silence, the Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “Why has it become like this too? Evolution??”
He was referring to the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite.
Why did it go from the water slime of a transcendent race to the Ice Slime King of a monarch race?
If ordinary Slimes were low-level creatures among elemental creatures, then the Slime King was a top-notch elemental pet. In the world, many Beast Tamers contracted the Slime King. This was a relatively powerful monarch battle pet… It was completely different from Slimes.
However, until now, no one had found a way to let the slime evolve into the Slime King. The Slime King could only be born naturally.
However… Even if water and ice were the same, evolving from a Water Slime to the Ice Slime King in an instant was too big a leap.
“It just borrowed the power of legendary resources. Moreover, it doesn’t have a specific race now. Even if it transforms into a human form, dragon form, and phoenix form, it can still do it. Even the top index can’t explore its essence,” Shi Yu said.
Moreover… ever since Susu learned Infinite Devour and evolved many times, it was no longer a water slime.
Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered to think of a new race name. He directly called it “Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation”. It saved him trouble!
“Let Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and the others come first. If they can’t defeat it, I’ll go on stage.”
“Or I can go up and scout first before letting them go up.”
Now, Chi Tong and Susu’s strength was no longer as miserable as in the team competition. Their current strength was already stronger than the champion at that time, Eleven. After all, they had undergone more systematic training and used a large amount of resources.
Shi Yu felt that it wouldn’t be weaker than Ji Feng, Senior Lu, and the others’ trump cards, or they might even be stronger!
“You plan to only let the two of them challenge the champion path??” Tyrannical Sea Legend said.
“Yes.”
….
The next day.
Ji Feng, Ning Tianming, Tong Yan, Zou Yun, Shi Yu, and the others were summoned by the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others.
“The path to champion?”
Upon hearing this news, Ji Feng and the others fell silent.
As Legend Xiao Shuang explained the specific bet agreement between the two countries, Ji Feng and the others were stunned. In other words, who had the initiative in this exchange… Depended on the performance of Sequence contestants like them during the challenge of the champion path?
“We have a total of five spots. After confirmation, the five of you will challenge it. Is there anyone who doesn’t want to participate?” Legend Xiao Shuang asked.
Ji Feng, Ning Tianming, Tong Yan, and Zou Yun naturally had no objections.
Before they came to the exchange team, they were already prepared to fight the seven island Beast Tamers.
It could be said that if it weren’t for the sake of fighting, they wouldn’t have come to the seven islands at all.
However,
The four of them looked at the “fifth person” among them and the white-haired youth who was coughing with his hand covering his mouth. They immediately fell into deep thought.
What was this?
Why did they bring a patient?
Such a guy was so weak that he could fall to the ground in the next moment. Could he really fight?
Are they sure they’re not here to scam the seven islands?
“Little Brother Lu Bai…” Zou Yun was puzzled. What was going on?
As even its size had changed, these guys who had seen Shi Yu before didn’t recognize him. This made Shi Yu sigh. As expected of himself.
Not to mention them, even the gem cat totem couldn’t recognize him at the start.
Edogawa Conan, learn from me. It’s not enough to just shrink. I suggest changing your hair color and hairstyle and even the face! A weak face!
“He’s Lu Bai, President Ye Hui’s student. He’s been recuperating because of his poor health, but there’s no problem with his battle skills. In terms of strength, he’s not inferior to you. Although he looks like this, he’s already in his twenties. He’s an older top-notch master.”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Cough, cough, hello.” Shi Yu greeted the four of them again, making them unable to calm down for a long time.
“Hello…” They could only reply like this.
…
At the same time.
On the Seven Islands Association’s side, they also began to mobilize the candidates for the champion path.
They even wanted to replace some of the existing guardians. After all, how many levels Dong Huang could pass concerned a large amount of resources. Neither party was willing to suffer a loss, so they naturally had to create some difficulty for Dong Huang in this aspect.
Both parties were preparing for this championship challenge.
As for Shi Yu, he had also plunged into the ruins space and decided to strengthen Susu at the last minute to stabilize it.
There was a reason why Shi Yu said that Chi Tong and Susu were already stronger than Eleven in the National League.
First was Chi Tong.
After the National League, not only did it learn many new sinister skills like “scapegoat”, but after devouring the Gemini Silver Armor and the Death Spirit Treasure Bead, the proficiency of the Interlocking Sword and Spirit Release even reached (Expert+5), making its normal energy level reach more than six million.
It directly made Chi Tong become a pet that didn’t need any super skills in Shi Yu’s team…
Apart from Sun Flame, who had yet to reach expert level, the remaining two super skills were both expert level, and they occupied the highest proficiency in the team.
As for Susu, the reason why it was at the bottom of the team competition was purely because it joined the team too late.
Although the skill level had been increased back then, there wasn’t enough time for Susu to train these skills into combination profundities.
In essence, low-level skills were far from super skills. Even high-level skills with Dao Proficiency were far inferior to a perfect-level super skill. However, it wasn’t that pets didn’t have the ability to fight above their level. They relied on combination skills and profundities.
For example, Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence was a very good combination profundity. As for Susu, it had also developed a few under Shi Yu’s suggestion recently. Its battle power had increased greatly.
At the same time, it was also the only pet in the team that could store the power of Time Fruit in its power and transform it at any time. It was all thanks to the Infinite Devour Space.
Moreover, it had also obtained its second attribute… In addition, Shi Yu planned to teach the ice and time skill “Heavenly Frost Cold Energy” to Susu in advance and let it deal with the path to champion. That was even less of a problem.
A time-element super skill, even if it was entry-level, was incomparably powerful. It could be seen from the time mark.
“Susu.”
In the ruins space, the white-haired Shi Yu hugged Susu and started to add points.
Susu had the will of an overlord, so it was relatively easy to add points.
“Ning!!”
A moment later, Susu opened its ice-blue eyes, and its entire body was filled with a cold aura that could freeze time.
< Name > Susu
[Race]: Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation
[Attributes]: Water, Ice
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
[Race Skill]:
“Super Level”: Holy Water Ring (Proficient), Water Element Control (Expert), Wave Cannon (Proficient)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Super Level”: Infinite Devour (Expert), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (Initiate)
Normal Energy Points: 5,890,000
To put it bluntly, the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was a special ice-element power that could transform its ice-element power into a special ice-element power that could freeze time. Its nature was similar to skills like White Thunder. At this moment, it seemed to be entry-level, but if it was combined with skills like max-level Blizzard, the power… was incomparable.
….
The next day.
Seven Islands Region, Heavenly Rainbow Island, Crown Rainbow Mountain Range.
A Sky Ship slowly flew over. On the hull, a large number of Beast Tamers from Dong Huang and the seven islands gathered.
On Dong Huang’s side, apart from the five challengers, the four legends were all present. There were also Zheng Hai and the other Dong Huang elites. Some of the more free people came to watch the challenge first.
On the seven islands, the three legends who were in charge of communicating with the Dong Huang exchange team yesterday were also present.
Apart from that, there were also a large number of top-notch masters from the seven islands, at least 20.
They were all guardians of the championship path. Among them, there were relatively young and older ones. There were about half and half of them.
Shi Yu stood among the Dong Huang contestants and looked over from time to time. He saw a lean old man in a ninja suit with messy silver hair, a beautiful witch in a red and white witch dress, and a big sister in a Yin Yang Master dress. Every Beast Tamer had a rather powerful aura, making contestant Dong Huang discuss among themselves.
Shi Yu was relatively calm. For example, the uneasy Heavenly King Zou had long grasped the hot topic. He held his cell phone and ran to various places to chat.
“Old Master, are you a ninja? Can we take a photo together?”
“Kid, you’re the challenger for this championship path?” The old man glanced at Zou Yun.
“A challenge is a challenge, but let’s take a photo as a memento first.” Heavenly King Zou chuckled and spoke fluently in the Seven Islands language.
Whether it was a selfie or the photo of him confidently defeating every Beast Tamer on the seven islands, it would be on the trending list.
A good opportunity couldn’t be missed.
The humiliation of being kicked out of the top ten of the Sequence by Shi Yu had to be vented on the seven island Beast Tamers these few days!
It was fine if it was this old ninja, but he didn’t believe that the netizens didn’t like that beautiful witch.
As long as he beat them, there would definitely be a lot of likes.
“I’m not doing it.” The old ninja rejected Zou Tianwang. If he didn’t like this kind of machine, Zou Tianwang could only look for a young lady, but he was also rejected coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Please have some self-respect,” the witch from the unknown shrine said coldly and seriously, giving Heavenly King Zou the cold shoulder.
“This Zou Yun.” Seeing that Zou Yun was so unreliable, the female Poison Doctor Tong Yan from Division 13 immediately sighed. She hoped that Zou Yun wouldn’t screw up on the path champion later.
Otherwise, don’t blame her for putting laxatives in Zou Yun’s food.
Tong Yan then arrived beside the weak Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was really weak. After all, he had just taught the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy not long ago.
Seeing Shi Yu’s expression, Tong Yan from the Medical Bureau was slightly stunned. He walked to Shi Yu’s side and said, “Are you alright? Do you need me to take a look?”
“Thank you.” Shi Yu looked at the other party and said weakly, “It’s alright, I’m already used to it. It looks pretty serious, but it’s actually fine.”
Now, it was still not a problem to crush a commander rank with a punch. The physiques of those legendary Beast Tamers might not necessarily be better than his.
“Really…” Tong Yan said suspiciously.
Soon, as the Sky Ship went deeper, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Yu Hui, and the Warring State Legend, Tian Jiangzhi, had already announced the beginning of the path to champion. It officially began!
“The entrance to the Path to Champion is ahead. Our first guardian is already waiting below.”
“Next, choose your challenger charge all the way through.” The legend of the Warring States touched his white goatee and said to the Tyrannical Sea Legend with a smile.
Two Titled Legends sat on the top of the Sky Ship.
The other legends sat on the lower level and looked down from high above. With the vision of legendary Beast Tamers, it was easy for them to see the environment and battles in the Crown Rainbow Mountain Range below.
The entire Sky Ship was like a huge audience seat. Many Beast Tamers from Dong Huang and the seven islands would watch the entire competition.
The challenge process would last for a total of five days. There were five contestants in Dong Huang, so it was one contestant a day.
The reason why it took so long was to give the challenger sufficient time to rest during the challenge. After all, using the strengthening talent to fight was quite draining.
They couldn’t challenge ten strong enemies in a row without giving them time to rest.
“Alright.” Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded and looked at the white-haired youth of contestant Dong Huang.
Shi Yu suggested that he be the last or first to appear.
The reason was very simple. In the remaining three to four days, Shi Yu didn’t want to be an audience here. He wanted to take the opportunity to look for the Space Emperor Ruins.
Tyrannical Sea Legend thought for a moment. Since Shi Yu planned to only use two pets and didn’t plan to use trump cards like the Iron-eating Beast and Baby Ginseng, theoretically speaking, Shi Yu’s strength definitely couldn’t be completely displayed. In that case, everyone decided to let Shi Yu be the first to go on stage.
To test the waters for Ji Feng and the others.
Of course, it would be best if Shi Yu could pass nine levels in one go.
They still believed in Shi Yu’s strength. After all, that was Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit and the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation!!
Moreover, Shi Yu had corresponding legendary resources!
The only pity was that only two of his pets could fight with different images for the disguise. In terms of switching between just these two, Shi Yu would definitely be at a disadvantage. He was inferior to Ji Feng and the others. The individual styles of the Iron-eating Beast, the Butterfly of Imagination, and Baby Ginseng were still too obvious.
“Lu Bai,” the Tyrannical Sea Legend said in a low voice. On the sky ship, Shi Yu nodded and jumped down from the sky ship under the surprised gazes of Ji Feng, Zheng Hai, and Zou Yun.
Hu hu hu!!!
Everyone was attracted by Shi Yu, who leaped down, and looked down!!!
Shi Yu’s fall was not that fast. His body appeared extremely light. During the descent, a huge purple summoning array appeared, and extremely cold ice elemental power condensed!!
Hu hu hu!!!
As Shi Yu landed lightly, a human-shaped elemental sprite made of pure ice elements appeared beside him!!
The elemental sprite was about the same height as Shi Yu. Its entire body was ice-blue, and cold air filled the air. The ice and snow outlined its humanoid form, but its body and facial features were still ice elements. From its appearance under the frost, it seemed to be a little like a pure and flawless holy maiden. Its long ice-blue hair fluttered, and it held a holy sword made of frost. It condensed beside Shi Yu like a guardian.
As Shi Yu took a step forward, the Ice Elemental Sprite also floated forward!
On Dong Huang’s side, they sent Shi Yu as the Beast Tamer who challenged the path to champion today!!
After Shi Yu appeared, the expressions of the legends on the seven islands and the other Beast Tamers instantly froze.
This was because among the five Beast Tamers of Dong Huang today, the only ones they were familiar with were Zou Yun and Ning Tianming. As for Ji Feng, who had been a spy overseas for many years, or Tong Yan, who rarely appeared or even fought publicly in Division 13, or Shi Yu, who was “Lu Bai”… there was not much information about them on the seven islands.
Especially Shi Yu. Although there was little information about Ji Feng and Tong Yan, they were at least on the list of Dong Huang’s Sequence. However, this “Lu Bai” had purely appeared out of nowhere. The seven islands didn’t know which secret weapon Dong Huang had cultivated.
“Ice elemental creature…”
Sensing the cold aura of the ice elemental creature around Shi Yu, many Beast Tamers on the seven islands were also slightly stunned. At the same time, many people took out indexes and tested the creature.
However, to their surprise, the index of the seven islands actually couldn’t detect what this creature’s “own race” was.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time (7)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“What kind of pet is this…”
At the moment, the Beast Tamers of the seven islands could only determine that this was an ice-element elemental creature.
Also…
Energy Points: 1,190,000
This extremely ordinary basic energy value also made the Beast Tamers of the seven islands silent.
In addition, Shi Yu’s sickly and weak white hair made the Beast Tamers of the seven islands wonder if this person could do it. What did Dong Huang mean?
“Hundred God, what do you think?” In the seven island audience seats, a young and beautiful woman in a JK uniform sat beside a brown-haired young man and asked.
“I can’t tell, but this energy is definitely not real.” The brown-haired young man’s expression was calm.
“Then judge if the number of levels he can clear can surpass yours.” The girl smiled.
The Thousand River Hundred God was known as the number one master of the new generation of the seven islands. In other words, among the non-legendary Beast Tamers under the age of 30, the strongest person was the current best battle record holder on the champion path. He passed a total of eight levels and unfortunately lost at ninth.
He had heard that the Beast Tamer of the Dong Huang exchange team, the contestants of the Dong Huang World Tournament, had come to challenge the path. He then took the initiative to be the guardian of the champion path.
“No, because I’ll guard the eighth level,” Hundred God said.
…
Below.
Shi Yu walked step by step. The scenery of the Crown Rainbow Mountain Range was very special.
In the sky, there was a clear sky rainbow. It was said that as they went deeper into the island, there were also various natural wonders. There were volcanoes, snow peaks, waterfalls, and forests. It was a miracle mountain carved by nature.
At the moment, the place where Shi Yu descended was a mountain path made of rocks and ordinary vegetation. He had only taken a few steps when a figure appeared.
This was also a young man. However, the other party was wearing floral pants and a black leather jacket. Such a strange combination of clothes immediately stunned Shi Yu.
In addition, the other party’s fashionable pink mohawk made Shi Yu suspect where this bad young man came from.
“Yo, you’re the challenger of Dong Huang this time?” At the same time that he spoke in a ruffian manner, the surrounding purple summoning array appeared. A huge dog-type creature more than two meters tall, completely black, and with hair like swaying black flames appeared beside him.
Apart from its bright red eyes, this dog-type creature’s tail was the most strange. It was like a black fire tornado that wrapped around its body, and its tail was even longer than its main body.
< Name > Hell Fire Hound
[Attributes]: Fire
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 4.3 million
“Roar!!!” After the Hell Fire Divine Hound appeared, black flames swayed around its body. It immediately formed a confrontation with the ice elemental life form in front of it. Its blood eyes were rather unfriendly, and heat waves surged!
“His name is Quan Zhongye, the heir of the largest gang on the seven islands. His fire-element strengthening talent has been trained very well. In addition to the Hell Fire Hound’s own explosive skill, his strength can reach the level of a top-notch monarch.”
A top-notch monarch! This was a name that was given to those that exceeded ten million energy points.
On the sky ship, be it the legends of the Warring States or the legends of the seven islands, they were introducing the information about Quan Zhongye to their friends beside them.
Quan Zhongye wasn’t strong, but it wasn’t weak either. Among the Beast Tamers under the age of 30 on the seven islands, its strength was enough to rank in the top ten.
If they wanted to defeat him, Dong Huang’s contestants definitely had to pay a price.
The reason why he introduced it to Dong Huang now was that the seven islands also wanted to hear some information about this contestant from Dong Huang.
He had already taken the initiative to chat with him, so it was a little inappropriate for him not to reveal his contestant’s information, right?
At the moment.
The Beast Tamers of the seven islands and Dong Huang were all paying attention to “Quan Zhongye” and “Shi Yu”. Even Dong Huang’s own people, apart from a few legends, no one else knew where Shi Yu’s transformation into Lu Bai came from.
“This dog… looks like it’s not easy to deal with.” Zou Yunwang was stunned. He suspected that the seven islands were targeting him. The first level was holding such an opponent. If the difficulty of the later nine levels was not much different from the first level, that would still be alright. If the opponent’s strength had always been increasing, then it would be more and more difficult to fight towards the end! After all, the physical fitness of a Beast Tamer was limited. Even if there were supplements to replenish it, how much could it replenish with their time limit?
Not everyone could absorb supplements easily.
“That’s all?” Ji Feng’s expression didn’t change. His goal, the mission given to him by the Tyrannical Sea Legend, was to pass ten levels as much as possible. At the very least, he had to pass nine levels. The difficulty of this first level was indeed not much for him.
However, Ji Feng didn’t know how this “Lu Bai” was.
At this moment, as the battle was about to begin, the legends of Dong Huang were silent for a moment before slowly speaking.
“Lu Bai, he’s good at training pets…”
Eh?
The seven island legends had yet to react.
Below.
Susu, who was beside Shi Yu, was already muttering as it looked at its opponent.
Boom!!!
All the ice-element power in its body erupted, and a terrifying energy wave formed a snowstorm. On the other side, Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound gritted their teeth and were about to fight when something unexpected happened.
Almost instantly, Susu, who had broken the time seal, had its energy level increase to nearly six million. If that was all, it would be fine. The most terrifying thing was that Susu was using the combination skill of Dao Proficiency Blizzard and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
The moment Susu activated the max-level snowstorm, the natural environment here was completely changed in the blink of an eye. Cold air filled the sky and froze the mountain path.
If that was the case, an ordinary weather skill couldn’t affect Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound at all. However, the difficulty was that the current Susu had already mastered the special ice-element power, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. Its current ice-element power already had a weak time freeze nature.
It was as if space and time had frozen. The moment the weather was changed by the max-level snowstorm, the expressions of Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound froze. There was even no time for Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound to activate their talent and erupt.
In the blink of an eye, the ice elemental power condensed. Quan Zhongye and Hell Fire Hound, who couldn’t react to the combination skill of Blizzard and Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, directly turned into ice sculptures under Shi Yu and Susu’s gaze.
The ground was already covered in ice shards. After taking a look at his opponent, Shi Yu calmly walked forward. Susu followed beside him and brushed past his opponent in the first round.
The first level was done in an instant.
Instant kill.
Even Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound themselves didn’t know why they didn’t have time to resist the enemy’s snowstorm at all.
In the eyes of the Beast Tamers in the outside world, it was also very ridiculous.
The Beast Tamers of the seven islands opened their mouths wide. They didn’t understand why Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound couldn’t handle a snowstorm. Even if the activation speed of that snowstorm was very fast and their proficiency had probably reached transcendent, they shouldn’t be completely unresponsive!!
Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and the others were also shocked and confused.
At this moment, looking at the frozen Quan Zhongye and the Hell Fire Hound, as well as Shi Yu and the ice elemental life form that passed them and continued to walk towards the second level, the Beast Tamers of the seven islands were collectively silent. Even the seven island legends revealed extremely serious and shocked expressions. Their expressions kept changing as they recalled the scene just now. Soon, the Warring States Legend took a deep breath and said in disbelief,
“That snowstorm just now…”
The Beast Tamers of the seven islands looked at him.
“It froze time!!!” Finally, the legend of the Warring States made a judgment, making the expressions of the seven island Beast Tamers change.
This was… an extremely rare transcendent life form that controlled the power of time!!

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - Sweeping Through the Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 578: Sweeping Through the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Dong Huang’s challenger instantly killed a genius ranked in the top ten of the new generation of Beast Tamers on the seven islands!
Looking at the cold ice sculpture, the faces of the seven island Beast Tamers also froze.
Their expressions froze. Even Ji Feng and the other Beast Tamers of Dong Huang were suddenly shocked when they heard the judgment of the legend of the Warring States.
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who was walking deeper into the Crown Rainbow Mountain Range.
“Just now, the energy wave of that ice-element pet increased to nearly 6 million.”
“An ice-element skill that freezes time??? What race is this…”
“Don’t tell me… it’s time…”
Putting a top-notch master with vigorous physical fitness and good strength like Quan Zhongye in the first level, the Beast Tamers of the seven islands could tell that the difficulty of the champion path this time had increased more than a little.
When they challenged back then, the first guardian wasn’t that strong.
For example, this Quan Zhongye had also challenged the path of the champion and even reached the sixth level.
Who would believe that he was only strong enough to be stationed as the first guardian?
However, just as the Beast Tamers of the seven islands thought that even if the friends from Dong Huang could pass a few levels this time it would be difficult… This happened.
Perhaps it was carelessness, or perhaps it was underestimating the enemy. No matter what, Quan Zhongye didn’t even have the chance to react before it was insta-killed by the opponent and the Beast Tamer. This outcome undoubtedly made the hearts of the Beast Tamers of the seven islands heavy. It also made the hearts of the legends of the seven islands and the legend of the Warring States who organized this exchange heavy!!
This time, the plan of the seven islands was to control Dong Huang’s level before the eighth level. It definitely couldn’t exceed the ninth level.
If Dong Huang broke through the fifth, sixth, and seventh levels, the seven islands would open some cultivation mystic realms to the contestants who cleared it. This was nothing. After all, they couldn’t let Dong Huang return empty-handed. Even if they opened it, it wouldn’t affect the seven islands too much.
As for contestant Dong Huang breaking through the eighth level, the seven islands needed to publicize the ruins mystic realm that they had not successfully cracked for Dong Huang to explore. Then, the benefits would be divided 60-40. Dong Huang would take 40 and the Islands 60. The seven islands could accept this.
In any case, they couldn’t crack it themselves. If they let Dong Huang help crack it, they could still get more than half the benefits. With the World Tournament imminent and the urgent lack of resources, it was still a good deal.
And if Dong Huang broke through the ninth level, the price would not be something the seven islands could bear. Not only did they have to publicize the unsolved ruins mystic realm to Dong Huang, but if Dong Huang successfully cracked it, the benefits would all belong to Dong Huang.
It would be fine if Dong Huang didn’t crack it successfully. Dong Huang would have passed the ninth level for nothing. But if Dong Huang really gained something, the seven islands would cry.
However, at the same time, as a bet, if Dong Huang didn’t pass the ninth level, Dong Huang would have to spend a lot in this transaction between the two countries. It would have to sell many Dong Huang resources to the seven islands at a low price. At the same time, when the seven islands exchange team headed to Dong Huang, Dong Huang also needed to open a certain number of ruins and mystic realms. This outcome was something the seven islands were happy to see.
The tenth level also had a bet that could not be won. However, the bet was not as big as the ninth level. Dong Huang also knew that the tenth level was not easy to break through. Therefore, the result that the seven islands wanted to see the most was that contestant Dong Huang could not break through the ninth level and falling in the ninth level.
Therefore, from the first level, the seven islands had arranged seven powerful elites at different levels on the road to champion.
Quan Zhongye was originally a good candidate, but the higher-ups of the seven islands didn’t expect this guy to be so weak… He was actually insta-killed in one move!
“Time-element skill…” Of course, the seven island legends with serious expressions also knew that this didn’t seem to be all Quan Zhongye’s fault.
Time element.
It had always been the most mysterious attribute. Even spatial attributes couldn’t compare.
Today, be it the seven countries or the totem countries, when talking about Dong Huang, the legendary figure they thought of the most was definitely Emperor Shi.
Even if the subsequent legends had similarly ended the totem war, as the first emperor of Dong Huang, as the most unpredictable time-element emperor in history, Emperor Shi’s reputation on the entire Blue Planet was unshakable!
Apart from the fact that he was the first legendary Beast Tamer to end the totem era, it was also because he was the Beast Tamer on Blue Planet who had cultivated his time strengthening talent to the highest level.
Be it time-element skills or time-element pets, they were all extremely rare. Even if the entire country was mobilized, it was very difficult to nurture outstanding time-element species. A time-element pet of a monarch race was even harder to find than a spatial pet of an overlord race, let alone other types.
Therefore, at this moment, seeing that Shi Yu’s pet had mastered a time skill that could freeze time, how could these seven island Beast Tamers not be shocked?
Although Susu’s Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was only entry-level, the power it displayed just now was definitely not as simple as entry-level super skills. The powerful thing about this “special energy” skill was that it could perfectly integrate other whiteboards skills of the same element and inherit the proficiency of other skills.
If Eleven learned White Thunder in the future, it would be the same. It could also display stronger power through skills like Thunder Palm.
“Holy shit, this guy.” On the Beast Tamer’s side, Heavenly King Zou was stunned.
Before the start, he was still worried about this ridiculously weak white-haired guy. In the end, Heavenly King Zou suddenly realized that this guy was much fiercer than he imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - Sweeping Through the Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 579: Sweeping Through the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Tong Yan, Ning Tianming, and the others opened their mouths slightly. They immediately understood that Legend Xiao Shuang and the others weren’t lying. This person’s strength might really not be inferior to theirs.
President Ye actually hid and cultivated such a strong precious student??
Dong Huang’s waters were deeper than they imagined! There were actually so many geniuses! They suddenly felt that there should still be many geniuses like “Lu Bai” who had yet to participate in the Sequence ranking. When they joined in later, the competition would probably be even more intense!! The top ten couldn’t be guaranteed!!
“Master…” Zheng Hai, the quasi legendary Beast Tamer, also looked at his teacher, the Tyrannical Sea Legend. He was very surprised. This Lu Bai was so strong. Initially, he was still disappointed that he couldn’t participate in the challenge of the champion path, but seeing such a strong Beast Tamer replace him, Zheng Hai’s heart immediately relaxed.
Unfortunately, if it was Lu Qingyi or that Shi Yu… Perhaps it would be better!
Shi Yu’s move directly made the Beast Tamers of the seven islands silent.
After being stunned, Tyrannical Sea Legend laughed, but he was also shocked in his heart. Wasn’t this… Senior Ice Dragon’s Heavenly Frost Cold Energy??
The reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite had actually learned it???
However, when he thought of how Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination could create a badge with the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, thought of the relationship between Shi Yu and the Ice Dragon, and thought of the countless possibilities contained in the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation that had lived for hundreds of millions of years, he was relieved.
As expected of the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang. No wonder he was so confident at the start. The Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation that had been strengthened by legendary resources and the many top-notch resources of Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang might have already firmly occupied the second throne in Shi Yu’s team.
It was only inferior to the Nine Li Battle Beast that had swallowed more resources and defeated the Void Mantis and Ji Feng as Shi Yu’s main pet!
“As I said, Lu Bai… He’s good at training pets. His ice-element pet grasps the power of time. Apart from that, under his special cultivation talent, various attributes such as energy value aren’t as simple as the results of the index,” the Tyrannical Sea Legend maintained a calm expression and said calmly.
His words made the Beast Tamers of the seven islands fall silent again.
“Hundred God…” At this moment, as the guardian of the eighth level, the strongest master of the new generation of the seven islands, Thousand River Hundred God, was still watching. The girl beside him asked with a serious expression,” Do you have a way to withstand that snowstorm just now? ”
At this moment, Bai Shen was also silent for a moment before saying, “Stop kidding. It’s just that Ye was being stupid again. If he entered a strengthening state at the same time he summoned his pet and dealt with it with all his might, with the temperature of his Hell Fire Hound’s flames, it’s completely impossible for the time in the surrounding domain to be frozen.”
“It’s just close to 6 million energy points. Unless the energy level of that ice elemental life form is higher, I have a hundred ways to ignore this skill…”
After the hundred god finished speaking, he also looked down solemnly. He had never fought a Beast Tamer who was proficient in time. The premise he mentioned was that the power displayed by the ice element just now was the limit.
If this ice elemental also had the battle power of a top-notch monarch and its energy level could exceed ten million, he would feel that it was difficult to deal with, but…
“Time skill… The consumption should be very high…” The hundred god muttered in their hearts.
The consumption of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy was indeed very high.
It required a huge amount of energy.
As a super skill, using the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy once consumed more energy than using the Wave Cannon five times.
However, that was for ordinary monarch-level pets.
For Susu, who had mastered Infinite Devour… This was called consumption?
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others had no intention of resting under everyone’s gaze. They continued forward.
In Susu’s Infinite Devour Space, it was filled with a large number of ice-element and water-element energy crystals. They were being converted into energy at a high speed.
In terms of using equipment to increase battle power, Susu might not be as good as Buggy, who had mastered illusions, but in terms of efficiently transforming the resources in its body into energy, Buggy was definitely inferior to Susu, who had mastered Infinite Devour.
How could the legendary Sea Tyrant’s Leviathan be called an invincible overlord that could fight totems? It was all because the space in its body stored an entire ocean army.
An army of krakens!
At the moment, it was easy for Susu to use energy crystals to replenish its consumption. The efficiency exceeded the imagination of outsiders, just like how Ji Feng’s elemental lord could store hundreds of millions of energy points in its body.
Although it couldn’t be displayed to strengthen itself at once like Eleven’s sharp eruption, it could be used to replenish consumption.
Shi Yu walked calmly while Susu followed quietly beside him.
“Ning ~” Right now, Susu enjoyed this state very much.
Not only because it was the only one fighting side by side with Shi Yu, but also because it was fighting the Beast Tamers and pets of the seven islands!!
Susu was especially excited. It strongly requested that it be given all ten levels so that Chi Tong could rest.
“We can try. Who’s next?”
Shi Yu left for a while. This period of time was also used to recover Susu’s energy. Soon, a middle-aged man in a furry coat with the image of a tough guy was waiting for Shi Yu and the others at the top of the mountain. He was discovered by Shi Yu!
Beside him stood a huge dragon!!!
This dragon had a white body and blue wings. It had a strong body like a traditional dragon. It was more than ten meters tall and emitted a powerful dragon might.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - Sweeping Through the Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Sweeping Through the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Roar!!!!!”
The middle-aged man and the dragon looked at Shi Yu and the others coldly and cautiously.
The middle-aged Beast Tamer already knew the process and outcome of the battle between Shi Yu and Quan Zhongye just now, so he naturally didn’t dare to be sloppy when facing Shi Yu. The moment Shi Yu appeared and the two of them officially came into contact, the middle-aged man’s entire body emitted a powerful aura. His wind-element strengthening talent also worked on his Storm Dragon!!
“Roar!!!”
< Name > Storm Dragon
[Attributes]: Dragon, Wind
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 10,980,000
After being strengthened by the Beast Tamer, the energy level of the Storm Dragon easily entered the ranks of top-notch monarchs. In addition to the incomparably powerful physique and dragon might of the dragon race, their terrifying might instantly pressed down on Shi Yu and the others!!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s confrontation with the second guardian once again became the focus of all the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang and the seven islands on the sky ship!
“Captain Da Quan. Originally a Beast Tamer of the Seven Islands Navy, he began to travel on the sea alone on a boat in order to break through the limit after leaving the navy. After experiencing a near death experience, not only did he successfully reach the west, but he also contracted a dragon of an overlord race during the trip. After returning, he became a first-rate expert among the top masters of the Seven Islands!!”
The Beast Tamers of the seven islands present all knew the person in front of them. This Captain Da Quan was no longer a new generation Beast Tamer of the seven islands, but an experienced top-notch master of the strength faction. He had experienced countless life and death battles in his life and had rich battle experience.
In addition, it had contracted a dragon of an overlord race. Its strength was definitely stronger than Quan Zhongye just now.
However, just as the Beast Tamers of the seven islands looked at Captain Da Quan with anticipation, wanting to see Captain Da Quan, who had not underestimated the enemy and was prepared in advance so he could give the Dong Huang challenger in front of them a lesson… A scene that stunned them again appeared.
Countless Beast Tamers from the seven islands holding the energy detection index looked at the energy value data of the machine in their hands in a daze…
2 million… 3 million… 4 million… 10 million… 18 million!!!
The ice elemental life form that had only displayed nearly 6 million energy points just now had its energy fluctuations increase to an unbelievable 18 million without any warning!!
“Finish it,” Shi Yu said, letting Susu use the combination skill developed after the team competition.
First, he used the power of the Time Fruit stored in the Infinite Devouring Space to increase its energy level to 18 million!
This wasn’t cheating. As long as it was power that a pet could store and digest in its body, it was its own strength. After all, which pet didn’t use the energy accumulated and replenished by eating various food?
In that case, it was very reasonable for Susu to eat the Time Fruit as its basic food and store its energy in its body. This was its unique ability to master Infinite Devour!
However, at this moment, it was far from the limit of Susu’s potential, far from the limit of the Time Fruit. The burden Susu needed to bear had not reached the peak.
After all, at the moment, if the Time Fruit could be used to the limit, it could instantly increase the energy value of each of Shi Yu’s main pets to about 50 million. This was the normal energy value of an overlord race. It was also the limit they could withstand.
It was just that the opponent in front of them wasn’t worth Shi Yu and Susu going all out. After all, after that attack, they really wouldn’t have any strength left.
18 million was enough. It could still recover as if nothing had happened.
At the same time, due to the effect of the super skill Holy Water Ring, the side effects of increasing to 18 million energy points were still decreasing!
Skill: Holy Water Ring
< Introduction > It’s a super water-type skill. It creates a resistance water ring. When affected by the abnormal state of its life form, it reduces the effect of the abnormal state and increases the effect of the water-type skill!
After the burden of using the power of time to increase strength was reduced by a portion by the Holy Water Ring, the power of Susu’s water-element skill was strengthened a second time by the Time Fruit. After two terrifying stages of strengthening, facing the opponent in front of it, Susu only used a very ordinary mid-level skill.
Frozen water.
“Ning!” In the face of the storm raised by the storm dragon in the distance, Susu only raised the ice sword in its hand. At the same time, a crystalline water ring wrapped around its wrist like an ice ring accessory and connected to the ice sword.
At the edge of the sword, frozen water filled the air, lingering with cold air. Then, Susu gently swung down. In an instant, the frozen water turned into a water slash that swept with cold air, like a blue sword arc, slashing at the Storm Dragon!!
Wherever the water sword arc passed, cold air erupted like a frozen world. The storm that filled the sky was frozen into a snowstorm and counterattacked with a bang. The terrifying ice power directly made the pupils of Captain Great Spring and the Storm Dragon opposite shrink…
Boom!!!
The mountain peak turned into an ice mountain. The huge dragon that wanted to spread its wings and escape also turned into a beautiful ice sculpture like the huge dog from before. On its chest, a frost blade that penetrated the dragon scales was obvious. It was shocking!!
After the attack, Susu’s aura calmed down again and returned to normal. It continued to walk down the mountain with Shi Yu to the third level.
Only the stunned Beast Tamers of the seven islands were left.
This…
Although they had already realized Shi Yu’s extraordinariness through the time-element skill just now, as Shi Yu and the ice-element pet effortlessly used “pure energy levels” to crush their opponents in the second round, the Beast Tamers of the seven islands immediately felt their hair stand on end.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - Sweeping Through the Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Sweeping Through the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Hundred God, who was relatively calm just now, changed his expression almost instantly.
It actually… instantly reached 18 million energy points without the strengthening of the Beast Tamer??
How was this possible!
The expression of the girl beside him, who was also part of the new generation Beast Tamer of the seven islands, suddenly changed.
It wasn’t strange for Dong Huang’s geniuses to pass a few levels. Even if he reached the seventh, eighth, and ninth levels, they wouldn’t be surprised. However, in their imagination, he should have experienced a difficult battle to reach this level. What was with this huge difference in battle power!
“Impressive.” At this moment, only the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang secretly clenched their fists. This Lu Bai really had some skills!!
Tong Yan, Zou Yun, Ning Tianming, and the others finally relaxed.
How could they not be relieved!!
If this guy had only insta-killed the guardian of the second level, they wouldn’t be like this. However, at this moment, Shi Yu still had no intention of stopping. Instead, he continued to walk towards the third level. This directly made Ji Feng and the others of Dong Huang understand how strong and confident the incomparably weak looking Beast Tamer was!!
“Dong Huang’s genius is indeed worthy of its reputation.” At this moment, after a moment of silence, the Warring States Legend of the seven islands spoke to himself, his expressions no longer changing.
He instantly knew that Dong Huang’s secret trump card was not simple. He began to relax and let Shi Yu challenge it. The top-notch master of the true strongest ladder team of the seven islands was waiting for Dong Huang’s challenger in the eighth and ninth levels!
If he had the ability, come. He didn’t believe that Shi Yu could continue like this.
Just as the Beast Tamers of the seven islands “expected”, Shi Yu charged ahead.
In the third level, outside a forest, a middle-aged man from the Green Wood Dojo, a top-notch master of the seven islands, commanded the monarch-level Giant Spirit Tree to set up an iron wall to fight Shi Yu!
In order to fight the Dong Huang challenger, the seven islands had indeed put in a lot of effort. This was a plant controller stronger than the previous guardian.
However, as expected, under the shocked expressions of all the seven island Beast Tamers, Shi Yu made the ice elemental life form beside him use the same trick again. This time, Susu’s energy level instantly increased to 20 million!!
“How can it still increase!!!” The Beast Tamers of the seven islands looked at the monarch-level ice elemental life form that could still erupt with stronger strength before breaking through the enemy’s defense.
A frozen stream that froze everything sealed a large area of the forest, turning the Green Wood Forest into an ice forest and finishing the opponent!
