Apart from that, some pets also mastered skills that could predict the future in advance such as “danger premonition”, “Protection Water”, “Protection Flame”, and “Future Prediction”.
At that time, as long as the Cloud Tiger sensed it in advance that there was a shrank Susu who approached it, it would be in a very dangerous situation.
However, wasn’t this because the sneak attack on the totem cat successfully gave them confidence!
At that time, he had also consulted the gem cat. Even if it was an overlord-level creature, if it didn’t master the overlord’s will, it was very rare for it to reach this realm. After all, even it as a totem almost failed.
Basically, only overlords whose willpower had been tempered and who had mastered the will of overlords could reach this body and mental realm that made them sense a completely hidden danger.
Therefore, when Shi Yu saw that the willpower of the tiger cat on the mountain was medium, he knew that it was stable. Then, he bet that the other party didn’t have skills like Dao Proficiency’s Water of Protection and Flame of Protection. Even transcendent-level skills weren’t enough!
After a series of complicated games, Shi Yu succeeded, so his opponent lost.
“What’s with the ridiculous energy eruption of your pet?” At this moment, Jiang Tianyang couldn’t help but say, afraid that Shi Yu would target him after returning.
It looked like this fourth-rank person still didn’t know that he would become Shi Yu’s bodyguard in the future. Otherwise, he wouldn’t care so much about ranking or victory.
“This… is a secret.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s related to its overlord will. It’s not convenient to talk about it in detail.”
Shi Yu lied. How could he tell him to use Infinite Devour to store the power of the Time Fruit?
After all, the Tyrannical Sea Legend wasa right there…
However, Shi Yu didn’t lie. Without the overlord’s will, he couldn’t add points to Infinite Devour. Without Infinite Devour, there was no way to erupt. It was very reasonable.
“Overlord’s will…” Jiang Tianyang was shocked. What, that ice pet had an overlord’s will??
Overlord will was very rare even among overlord-level creatures.
Only among totems was it not rare. Among the ten totems, nine of them could have the will of an overlord. After all, those who could grow into totems were all extremely extraordinary.
“Overlord’s will…” Xiao Shuang and Senior Ke were also slightly shocked. For example, although Xiao Shuang’s pet had also mastered this, Shi Yu’s monarch-level pet… had also mastered the overlord’s will?
What race was this!
Only the Tyrannical Sea Legend was silent. It was naturally normal for the Blue Sea Sprite’s will reincarnation to master the overlord’s will.
This was the Blue Sea Sprite!
The willpower of the top-notch demigods who had fought the Western Abyss Sea many times definitely exceeded everyone’s imagination, even after reincarnation.
“In the next four days, Ji Feng and the others should continue to challenge. The time to explore the ruins mystic realm will also start the day after tomorrow. During this period, what are your plans?” the Tyrannical Sea Legend asked.
“I want to find the Space Emperor Ruins to take a look first. I don’t plan to stay and watch the battle,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll save some time. It’s been so long. I reckon it might not be that easy to find the Space Emperor Ruins.”
“I want to find the Space Emperor Ruins to take a look first. I don’t plan to stay and watch the battle,” Shi Yu said. “Save some time. It’s been so long. I reckon it might not be that easy to find the Space Emperor Ruins.”
“I’ll watch over him. No problem,” the gem cat said casually.
“No problem. Just treat it as me resting in Dong Huang Base. We’ll also leave a clone behind,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright then.” Legend Sea Tyrant nodded and confirmed his train of thought. Next, Shi Yu and the gem cat went to find the coordinates of the Space Emperor Ruins first. The others continued to watch the Road of Champions challenge and carry out other exchanges.
Finally, it was time for the Dong Huang exchange team to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm together.
…
The next day.
The second round of the champion challenge began. Today’s challenger was Zou Yun, Heavenly King Zou.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - Overlord (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Overlord (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, the legends of the seven islands realized that Lu Bai from Dong Huang didn’t come to watch the battle today.
“Lu Bai consumed too much energy yesterday. The eruption of his pet is related to his special cultivation talent, so he needs to rest deeply for two days.”
The Tyrannical Sea Legend gave the Battle State Legend of the seven islands a response, making the Battle State Legend fall silent.
“Do you need our help?”
“Don’t worry, it’s not a big problem. He’ll be fine after resting for two days. Our base has accompanying rest facilities,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said with a smile.
“Damn it…” The legend of the Warring States was silent. Yesterday, they had already discussed a strategy to poach this Lu Bai to the seven islands. Even today, they had already arranged for the proud daughters of heaven of the seven islands to come to the Sky Ship to contact Lu Bai, but Lu Bai didn’t come?
Could they only rope him in when he used the ruins mystic realm…
At this moment, Shi Yu was already hiding in the ruins ring space. He was brought far away from Heavenly Rainbow Island by the totem-level cat. They were running in the direction of Star Wilderness Island, one of the seven islands. It was very exciting.
But at this moment, what excited Shi Yu the most was not that he was about to turn the hatching progress of the Starry Sky Egg into quarter completion, but that something big had happened in the ruins!!
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Ling trained and studied as usual. Naturally, nothing big happened to them. As for Susu, it had just cleared the champion path and was very confident. It couldn’t wait to participate in the next team competition. It felt that it had already been reborn. It shouldn’t be a problem to rank in the top three of the team.
However, it wasn’t that a happy thing had happened to it, but Chi Tong.
“Mi!!”
In the ruins space, in Chi Tong’s house built with various ice-element energy crystals…
The bone sword was placed in the most conspicuous position. Usually, Chi Tong would follow Shi Yu’s request and possess the bone sword to cultivate.
And today, it was still cultivating as usual, but its body suddenly changed.
Through the bone sword, it comprehended a skill!
“This works?”
In the space, Shi Yu looked at the confused Chi Tong and the bone sword with still strong energy fluctuations. He was stunned to the extreme.
< Name > Bone Sword
[Attributes]: Undead
[Level]: Level 9 (Legendary-level)
< Introduction > The Sword of the Dead can revive the life it killed in the form of an undead and control its will.
This was a legendary resource distributed to Shi Yu by Ancient Capital University. Not only did it have a special effect, but it was also a legendary weapon. At the same time, the undead that possessed and lived inside could also be subtly strengthened.
At the same time, when he gave it to Shi Yu, Principal Feng also said that if he completely absorbed the power of the bone sword, he might inherit the special ability of the bone sword.
Super skill, Undead Revival!
It would revive the life it killed in the form of an undead and make it its puppet’s skill!
This skill was also a top-notch skill among undead-type super skills.
But logically speaking, it needed to completely absorb the power of the bone sword to have a chance of inheriting it, but now…
“Mi ~”
< Name > Chi Tong
[Super Skill]: Revival of the Dead (Initiate)
Chi Tong didn’t wait for it to completely absorb the power of the bone sword at all. Instead, when it used the bone sword to cultivate daily, it directly comprehended the ability of the bone sword!
At this moment, Chi Tong was also very confused. After all, suddenly awakening a super skill while cultivating was too scary. Of course, after the shock, it was completely unexpected ecstasy.
“Mimi ~” Chi Tong was overjoyed.
“Wu.” Shi Yu was also silent. Could it be because of the possession skill at the level of “Dao Proficiency”?
Therefore, it let Chi Tong get closer to the requirements of the bone sword?
If that was the case, he could find more similar resources in the future.
“Mimi ~ ~!!” Chi Tong was extremely excited. This skill was good.
It couldn’t wait to kill a few ferocious beasts and turn them into undead to become its followers.
“Not bad… Eleven, you have to work hard too.” Shi Yu nodded heavily. Then, his gaze swept across Eleven and the others who had come to watch the commotion.
Eleven was stunned before nodding aggrievedly.
Was it the same? How could it be the same!
Chi Tong could possess the bone sword, but Eleven could only carry the magnetic metal for training. It was different!
Among the legendary resources Shi Yu had obtained, the soil of life was a standard strengthening resource. Its use was purely to strengthen the life force of plant-type life forms.
As for the legendary Dragon Ball, it was an evolution-type legendary resource, but it also had a strengthening nature.
The Cold Sky Drop was a legendary strengthening resource that could give new attributes.
As for the Aurora Magnetic Gold and the Bone Sword, apart from a certain strengthening effect, they both had the effect of awakening specific skills.
The magnetic metal was white lightning, and for the bone sword it was the revival of the dead.
Shi Yu originally thought that Eleven would awaken the White Thunder first because the rarity and control difficulty of the White Thunder was far inferior to the Undead Revival, nor was it as mysterious as the Undead Revival. However, he didn’t expect that Chi Tong would gain something first.
“Wu ~” “Yi!!” “Ning!” The other pets were envious. Could their legendary resources also drop skills?
“Ah.” At this moment, Ling’s little brain also moved. “After Baby Ginseng’s time mark is healed, let Chi Tong’s Bone Sword kill Baby Ginseng through the Revival of the Dead. Is there any hope of creating two Baby Ginsengs, one revived Baby Ginseng and one undead Baby Ginseng!”
Baby Ginseng: ???
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng took a step back and widened its eyes. Was this thing a demon?! The time mark wasn’t something to be abused like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - All Overlords (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: All Overlords (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Mi!!” Chi Tong was stunned, its eyes shining. If it had the undead ginseng baby as a puppet, wouldn’t it be first in the team competition!
“Cough, cough.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “We’ll talk about it in the future. It’s entry level right now so it isn’t safe.”
Baby Ginseng: ???
So they really considered it?!
“Very good. In a few days, I’ll teach you another skill,” Shi Yu said.
Demon Blade Curse!
Shi Yu had already imagined how to use it.
When they encountered an overlord-level ferocious beast, they would first cripple it in a group battle. Then, Chi Tong would attack. Firstly, the first wave directly absorbed a large amount of “Ghost God Curse Power” as the energy for the Demon Blade Curse skill. Then, through the Revival of the Dead, it would transform its soul that was about to disappear into an undead life form!!
First, he would let the undead puppet work for him. When it had no use for him, he would let Chi Tong attack and shatter it. Through the “Spirit Release” skill, he would use its power as nutrients for the Spirit Release to increase his growth!
Perfect.
Chi Tong was still the most efficient one. If it encountered a ferocious beast, it could break it into several pieces to utilize!
Unlike Baby Ginseng, which exploded directly and couldn’t even pick up the materials on the enemy’s body.
“Mi!! ~ ~” Chi Tong continued to cheer.
At the same time, Shi Yu chuckled and felt that the future was beautiful.
In the past few days, he had also thought of something clearly. A way to have a few more overlord-level battle powers before the world competition!
As everyone knew, the increase in racial skills would lead to an increase in growth level. Therefore, if Shi Yu raised the pets’ super racial skills to above perfect level, they would accidentally break through to the overlord level. As they cultivated daily, holding back from leveling up was very difficult. If they weren’t careful, they would break through the space and make Shi Yu a cripple. Even if Shi Yu could withstand it, he would quickly be drained dry and become extremely weak, causing his subsequent cultivation and points to be delayed.
However, what if when their super racial skill proficiency approached perfect level, Shi Yu only leveled up their taught skills alone?
Taught skills resulted in less than a tenth of the growth level progress of racial skills. It was almost negligible.
Why was Lu Qingyi’s pet so strong? It was because its previous pets had all received special inheritances and mastered the perfect-level teaching skill Mythical Revival. This super skill taught skills and not racial skills. Even if it reached perfect-level, it didn’t lead the growth level of Senior Lu’s pet to the overlord level. Lu Qingyi herself wasn’t affected at all.
Therefore, if Shi Yu specialized in teaching skill points after Eleven and the others’ racial skills were unsuitable, he seemed to be able to achieve a similar effect…
For example, Eleven.
If it mastered the “transcendent Undying Golden Body” when it was at the monarch level, the limit of the injury and recovery ratio was close to one to one. Then, didn’t that mean that as long as the overlord-level creature couldn’t insta-kill it, it might not lose any hp even if it stood and let the overlord-level creature fight?
The Undying Golden Body was a taught skill. Even if it broke through to perfect level, it wouldn’t lead Eleven’s growth level to break through to overlord.
Similarly, Buggy’s spatial control, Baby Ginseng’s plant control, Chi Tong’s Demon Blade Curse, and Susu’s Heavenly Frost Cold Energy were not racial skills! Instead, they were taught skills! Even if it reached transcendent, apart from the loss of points, Shi Yu wouldn’t be too affected.
For Eleven and Susu, who had the will of overlords, the frequency of adding points to super skills could be completely controlled to one to two days. As for transcendent-level super skills, adding 48 points on the foundation of perfection was enough. They could complete one in less than two months.
There were still eight months until the world competition. It seemed like he could do it.
He wanted to increase the teaching of super skills before the World Tournament so that every pet had overlord-level battle power. He could give up the overlord level, but he could still have overlord-level battle power!
At that time, Buggy and the others would clearly only be at the monarch level, but once they attacked… it would be a “transcendent super skill” that even some totem-level creatures had yet to master!
It was like fighting a baby cup!
Of course, if the conditions allowed, it was best to still try to let a pet break through at a higher level. It was better to have a real overlord-level pet by his side. In terms of battle power, a beast with transcendent super skills and overlord level could probably crush top-notch overlords like the Sky Penetrating Whale in Dragon Palace City. An invincible overlord like the Tyrant Sea Legend, the Mutated Leviathan, could fight a totem as an overlord!
“Hey, hey, hey.”
As Shi Yu was sorting out the additional points plan, the traveling gem cat suddenly shouted in the outside world. The ruins space immediately trembled.
“We’re here, we’re here.”
Upon hearing the gem cat’s voice, Shi Yu was stunned. Then, he quickly evacuated Eleven and the others before coming out of the ruins space himself.
After he came out, he was directly in a forest. The gem cat yawned beside him and said, “This is Star Wilderness Island. The current location should be some forest. It’s already very close to the location marked on the map by the Space Emperor Ruins. In any case, it’s nearby. Look at the map and see where we go next.”
Shi Yu took out the map and the Space Pet Egg. He grunted and looked at the sky. “The vicinity should be the wild.”
“Yes! It’s very far from the few big cities on Star Sea Island. There aren’t even many Beast Tamers in the vicinity.”
“Let’s look around,” Shi Yu said. “According to the Void Mantis, it’s a very common small stone ruin exposed to the outside world…”
“Put the egg on it, and it will automatically activate the altar to slowly absorb the starlight.”
“But…”
So many years had passed. Shi Yu also suspected that the ruins left behind by the Space Emperor to attract starlight were still around.
The Space Emperor Dynasty had already died, let alone an altar. The possibility of it still existing was really not high.
If the altar had long been torn down, Shi Yu and the others would probably have to find another way to hatch this egg.
“The scenery is pretty good.” This forest should be on a mountain. Some weak Awakening-level creatures in the mountain were very active.
Splash ~
Splash ~
Moreover, all of them seemed to be quite fierce. When Shi Yu and the others passed by a lake, water splashed from inside, as if they didn’t want Shi Yu and the others to barge into their territory. A water-type pet suddenly jumped out and blocked in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Shi Yu yawned in boredom and said, “Teacher Cat, I’ll leave it to you.”
The gem cat: ???
“Is it appropriate for a totem level like me to bully a transcendent level? I can’t afford to embarrass myself like that” The gem cat was angry and didn’t even want to release its deterrence.
“Call your pet out yourself. I don’t care anymore. I’m going to rest next. You settle it yourself.” The gem cat turned and left.
“Uh, is that necessary?” Shi Yu muttered. However, at the same time, he felt that it was a waste of talent to let Susu and the others deal with a transcendent creature. It was better to give the other party a punch himself.
Shi Yu looked at the blue water-element creature that looked like a duck.
With a look, Shi Yu’s expression changed almost instantly.
He had already developed the good habit of letting the skill index scan any transcendent life form he encountered, in order to test the other party’s will level and whether it had a Mythical bloodline.
However, the good habit had been maintained for so long, and Shi Yu had never missed it.
But this time…
“Holy shit, another pet at the transcendent level that has mastered the overlord’s will. What’s going on?” Shi Yu was shocked. He looked at the blue duck in front of him. Susu was the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite. It was fine if it had the overlord’s will.
Who was this transcendent-level Duckbill Beast that suddenly appeared!
“Quack…” The standing blue Duckbill Beast looked at Shi Yu and the others unkindly. It closed its hands and pulled them apart. A water spear condensed. After it swung in a posture, the spearhead was aimed at Shi Yu and the others, warning them not to come over!

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - This Duck Is Not Simple (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: This Duck Is Not Simple (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
< Name > Duckbill Beast
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Water Blade (Intermediate water-type skill, can condense water into a long-handled stabbing weapon formed by a sharp blade and a stick.)
Psychic Strike (Intermediate spiritual skill, concentrate, increase your perception and detect the enemy’s weakness).
< Introduction > The Duckbill Beast lives in rivers and lakes. Its attack method is to create spear-like water blades. When you see it, you have to be careful of its movements, because it might be looking for the most fatal attack method.
Energy Points: 2333
Skill: Water Element Control
[Teaching success rate]: High
Shi Yu looked at the blue duckbill beast in front of him that had its claws and looked like a human. He was slightly stunned.
“Duck, you’ve successfully piqued my interest,” Shi Yu said slowly.
Transcendent level, overlord will…
Moreover, the energy value of ordinary transcendent races was rarely so high. It was basically between 500 to 1,000.
As for this duck, it was almost close to the standard of the monarch race’s transcendent level. As a wild creature, it was very rare.
Shi Yu didn’t believe that this Duckbill Beast could reach this stage at its age.
It was most likely the reincarnation of a totem big boss.
Zhong Xuan could reincarnate, and the Blue Sea Sprite could reincarnate, so other totems might have the ability to reincarnate.
“Let’s catch it and take a look…” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
Although he had encountered a low-level pet with the will of an overlord, because he already had the water-element Susu, Shi Yu didn’t have much desire to take in the pet. He was just curious and wanted to know what this guy was like.
“Quack!!!” The Duckbill Beast’s gaze was cautious. It was fine if this group of people casually barged into its territory, but they always said nonsense. It really couldn’t tolerate it!
“Quack!! (Go away, I’ll pretend nothing happened. Don’t force me to attack.)”
“Little Ji, I’ll leave it to you.”
Shi Yu snapped his fingers. Out of respect for the “big boss”, he didn’t rely on his “level” to bully it. After all, if the Bean Bear couldn’t withstand Shi Yu’s punch without using its skills, it would be insta-killed, let alone an transcendent-level Duckbill Beast.
“Roar!!! (I am… the overlord of the earth!!)”
Boom!
Under Shi Yu’s summoning, light appeared. In the ruins space, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon that was sleeping in the dragon ring was pulled out by Shi Yu.
It just so happened that it was also at the transcendent level. Why not use it to test the situation of this Duckbill Beast?
“Roar!!” As soon as the mechanical Tyrant Dragon came out, its disdainful gaze locked onto the Duckbill Beast in front of it.
Without needing Shi Yu to call it, it knew what was going on.
During this period of time, Ling had collected a lot of its battle data. Wasn’t it just fighting?
“Roar!!” In the roar, the Tyrant Dragon condensed two Space Splitting Swords with its short hands and looked at the Duckbill Beast holding the Water Spear with a burning gaze.
“Quack!!! (That’s it?)” The Duckbill Beast looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon in disdain.
Tyrant Dragon: “?”
Although it couldn’t understand what the Duckbill Beast was saying, the disdain in its expression undoubtedly stimulated the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s nerves. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon was furious.
“Roar!! (Don’t insult a king!!)”
With that said, it stepped heavily on the ground and slashed at the Duckbill Beast with two earth-element heavy swords!!
Boom!
The heavy sword had no edge, but the skill was great!!
Eat its King’s Sword!!
The battle between the two transcendent pets was naturally a battle between rookies, but Shi Yu’s gaze was rather serious…
In terms of race, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon was simply better than the Duckbill Beast. Its energy level even exceeded 5,000 points.
Under normal circumstances, even at the same level, this Duckbill Beast would still be insta-killed.
However, this Duck-billed Beast that had mastered the overlord’s will kept giving Shi Yu an unusual feeling.
Things wouldn’t be that simple!
“What the hell are you doing!” Beside him, the gem cat that had run off to take a walk turned around. Shi Yu had already sent the mechanical Tyrant Dragon to fight the Duckbill Beast. The corners of its mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
It was already so difficult to fight a low-level wild monster, how could he find an empty egg incubator?
“Huh?” The cat was just about to question, but its gem eyes suddenly flickered with a light, revealing a surprised expression.
This was because as the opponent finally attacked, the Duckbill Beast’s gaze suddenly became fierce.
It was as if a peerless expert was standing at a very high realm, looking down at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
“Duck!!!”
Its aura and energy rose steadily.
As the Duckbill Beast breathed, the surrounding air seemed to have a rhythm.
Energy Points: 9999
A transcendent-level Duckbill Beast with energy fluctuations approached commander rank with a bang. Shi Yu and the gem cat couldn’t tell what skill the Duckbill Beast had used at all. Its strength level naturally increased just like that.
“Quack!!!” The Duckbill Beast also moved. After a flash of its gaze, it charged towards the incoming Tyrant Dragon at an extremely fast speed!!
High-level earth-element skill, Space Splitting Sword!
Intermediate-level water-element skill, Water Blade!
Brown light and blue light flashed.
The two heavy swords crossed and slashed at the tiny duck, while the duck, with a water spear, directly stabbed at the weakness of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s move.
In the next moment!
The Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast exchanged positions. The two pets held weapons and had their backs facing each other!
Boom!!
A violent airflow erupted from the two of them. With a crack, the two heavy swords held by the mechanical Tyrant Dragon directly shattered. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon revealed an incredulous expression and looked down at the saber mark on its chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - This Duck Is Not Simple (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: This Duck Is Not Simple (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Quack!!” The Duckbill Beast didn’t even turn around. It swung its gun and continued to look at Shi Yu.
That was all?
“Meow, meow, meow??” At this moment, the gem cat was extremely shocked. A wild duck shattered the mechanical Tyrant Dragon??
What was going on?
Shi Yu’s expression also changed slightly. Overlord will?
However, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon was too lousy. Did it know how much it was worth?! How could it lose so easily?!
He instantly felt very cheated.
Also, this Duck-billed Beast just now had definitely naturally activated its overlord will, stimulating its potential and erupting with stronger strength. It wasn’t a skill, but purely a basic skill to fight a strong enemy above its level.
Susu also knew this ability, but even Susu didn’t activate it as smoothly as this duck.
How was this possible…
What exactly was this duck…
“Roar!!!” At this moment, on the other side, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon covered its pierced chest in pain. It was unable to restrain its anger. It, the dignified overlord of the land, the king dragon, was actually… by a duck… A duck…
Buzz!!!
A rich brown light began to spread with the mechanical Tyrant Dragon as the center of gravity. It directly activated the Earth Domain, and its energy fluctuations also rose steadily at this moment. Seeing this, the Duckbill Beast instantly turned around and jumped up acutely, because in the next moment, a violent earthquake wave attacked!
Boom!!!
The earthquake wave swept over like a tsunami, making the jumping Duckbill Beast’s gaze solemn. It also made Shi Yu’s gaze solemn…
“Idiot, it attacked me!” Shi Yu was also furious. If it couldn’t control the earthquake well, it didn’t have to.
Looking at the incoming earthquake wave, Shi Yu punched the ground. With a boom, the ground on Shi Yu’s side suddenly cracked. A terrifying shock wave swept up from the ground, instantly devouring the earthquake released by the mechanical Tyrant Dragon, shattering the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s Earth Domain… and also toppling the surrounding trees.
Dust and smoke kept rising.
When the Duckbill Beast landed, its body was still swaying. It opened its mouth wide and looked at the Tyrant Dragon in front and the humans behind in confusion.
Duckbill Beast: ⊙o⊙
Wait a minute, who was the Beast Tamer and who was the pet?!
Why was it different from the outside world it knew?!
The Duckbill Beast opened its mouth wide. It felt that Shi Yu’s punch just now could instantly kill it.
“Roar!! (Next time, I’ll definitely control it well.)” The Tyrant Dragon said timidly, afraid that Shi Yu would hit it.
However, Shi Yu suspected that the mechanical Tyrant Dragon wanted to accidentally kill him and usurp the throne.
“What’s wrong with this duck?” At this moment, the gem cat was also curious. As a cat, it was normal for it to be curious.
“Wu…” Shi Yu looked at the duck in front of him in deep thought and said,” I don’t know, but it’s worth researching… ”
“Little Ji, continue attacking,” Shi Yu continued to say to the Tyrant Dragon.
“Roar!!!” The mechanical Tyrant Dragon looked at the Duckbill Beast fiercely, determined to get back at it.
The Duckbill Beast also suddenly looked at the mechanical Tyrant Dragon. A battle was about to begin!
A battle between machine and duck!
….
A moment later.
Shi Yu carried the unconscious duck and said to the gem cat, “Why don’t… you help find the Space Emperor Ruins first? You saw it just now. This thing has the will of an overlord. It’s most likely the reincarnation of a totem creature. I’ll study it.”
The gem cat: !!!
“Meow!!” The gem cat was furious. It might as well eat that egg. Why hatch it? In any case, Shi Yu didn’t seem to be in a hurry to hatch it.
However, the gem cat looked at the blue duck and fell into deep thought.
Totem reincarnation, duck?
Compared to the octopus tentacles of the totem-level Vortex Demon Beast, which was better?
“Are you planning on cooking it as imperial capital roasted duck?” it asked.
Fried Star Egg+Roasted Totem Duck. This was simply a god-like life. It could make the Prediction Owl cry with envy.
The unconscious Duckbill Beast’s duck palm twitched twice.
“How is that possible!!” Shi Yu retorted. “This duck’s aptitude is extraordinary. It’s a pity to leave it on the seven islands. I’ll bring it to Dong Huang to see if I can sell it for a good price. If it’s really a totem reincarnation, it’s worth a legendary resource no matter what.”
“The Dong Huang Association definitely doesn’t mind having another future guardian.”
As for the Duckbill Beast’s opinion, he didn’t consider it.
It was very similar to the ginseng baby that was snatched away by Grandma Li at that time.
However, he wasn’t as cruel as Grandma Li. He wouldn’t use ducks to make soup.
He had never thought of using a ginseng baby to make duck blood radish soup with the Duckbill Beast.
“Please, Teacher Cat!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he directly carried the Duckbill Beast and entered the ruins space, leaving the gem cat outside blowing the northwest wind.
“This…”
The gem cat thought for a moment and came to a conclusion after a rational analysis…
It was used by Shi Yu as a tool anchor again!
Finding the Space Emperor Ruins was such a boring thing. How could it be more interesting than researching the overlord will duck?
“Damn it, this matter won’t end until there are 100 million gem fruits!”
…
In the outside world, the gem cat began the process of searching for the ruins while cursing. In the ruins ring space, Shi Yu and his pets surrounded the unconscious Duckbill Beast.
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon vs the Duckbill Beast. In the end, it was almost a draw between the two pets, and they ended up exhausted together.
In terms of explosive power and skill, the Duck-billed Beast was clearly better, but it couldn’t withstand the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s thick skin and longer endurance. To Shi Yu, this draw was the mechanical Tyrant Dragon losing. To Ling, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon also lost.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - This Duck Is Not Simple (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: This Duck Is Not Simple (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
It lacked training.
“In some aspects, it still needs to be improved…” Ling said.
The few of them ignored the Tyrant Dragon. Next, Shi Yu brought Eleven and the others to observe the Duckbill Beast on the ground.
They surrounded it.
“Wu ~” Buggy shook its head. It had just entered the Duckbill Beast’s dream to take a look.
This Duckbill Beast was ordinary, and its experience was also very ordinary.
It was just that he was a little genius. After it was born, the proficiency of various skills and battle skills increased very quickly. That was all.
If it was experience, it was challenging various transcendent creatures along the way and becoming a tyrant in the mountains and lakes. It was a very ordinary experience. Such pets were definitely common on Blue Planet.
It really didn’t look like it could have the will of an overlord.
After all, that was only a lake overlord, and this mountain didn’t have any creatures stronger than commander rank!!
If it could have the will of an overlord even like this, there was no reason why it, Buggy, couldn’t.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng let Buggy know that it was still the overlord of the lake after all. How could it be the same?
Buggy: !
How bold!
“The more ordinary it is, the more ordinary its experience is. This means that it was more affected by its previous life. It’s most likely totem reincarnation.”
“However, what I’m curious about now is whether its previous life was an ordinary totem or a top-notch totem?” Shi Yu touched his chin.
“Baby Ginseng.”
“Yi!”
As Baby Ginseng waved its hand in front of the Duckbill Beast’s nose, the unconscious Duckbill Beast instantly perked up. Its tail fluttered, and its eyes opened shakily.
After opening his eyes, he felt that his surroundings were dark.
It looked up and suddenly realized that pairs of eyes were looking down at it.
“You’re awake,” Shi Yu said.
Duckbill Beast:!!!
“Quack!!!” The Duckbill Beast was shocked and jumped up, but Eleven pressed its hand down.
“Wuu!! (Don’t move.)” Eleven said.
The huge strength made the Duckbill Beast swallow crazily and become a drooling duck. However, it still erupted with power that exceeded its limit and resisted.
However, it was useless.
It revealed a tragic expression and decided to fight to the death.
At this moment, Shi Yu said, “Don’t be excited, don’t be nervous. We’re good people. I just feel that it’s a waste of your talent to stay on this small mountain with your aptitude.”
Duckbill Beast: “?”
“Are you interested in coming with us to see the outside world, a wider world?”
“With your aptitude, I believe you can quickly choose an overlord, suppress totems, and dominate the world.”
Shi Yu activated telepathy and comforted the duck first.
“The heavens gave birth to you for a reason!”
“A duck is not a creature in a pool. It transforms into a dragon when it encounters a storm! A cold light arrives first, and then, like a spear, you shoot out like a dragon!”
The Duckbill Beast opened its mouth slightly again. Although it couldn’t understand a little, it felt that it was awesome. Its DNA seemed to have moved.
“Yi!!”
At this moment, Baby Ginseng took out a fruit and started babbling.
Let Shi Yu try this.
It used Susu’s memory water to water the Time Fruit that was specially cultivated. It was a powerful product named “Reincarnation Fruit”.
There was hope that the reincarnated pet could temporarily activate the power of its previous life, and it was considered the sister fruit of the Soul Heart Fruit.
This was indeed useful.
Especially for those reincarnated pets.
In Shi Yu’s team, Susu was the only one that had any effect after using it.
However, although it had tasted it, Susu still judged it to be useless.
Because the Reincarnation Fruit was limited by Baby Ginseng and Susu’s strength, its strength was limited. At most, it could make the pet recall the power of its previous life.
As for Susu, it had reincarnated countless times in the past thousand years. The number of reincarnations was almost countless. Moreover, the power of its reincarnation recently was pitifully weak. There was really no value in recalling it.
Using this thing, Susu only recalled its power as a “water elemental sprite” in its previous life. And that power, while not absolutely useless, could still be said to be very useless.
But from the looks of it, Baby Ginseng still didn’t seem to have given up on the “Reincarnation Fruit” it was researching. It wanted to try using this duckbill beast that was suspected to be a totem reincarnation.
“Yi!!! (Not every pet can reincarnate infinitely like Susu.)”
Baby Ginseng was decisive. Perhaps this Duck-billed Beast’s previous life was a totem. With this Reincarnation Fruit, it could directly determine its identity!!
“Quack?” The Duckbill Beast looked at the mumbling Baby Ginseng, Shi Yu, and the others in confusion.
“Then… give it a try?” In the next moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng nodded heavily and looked at the Duckbill Beast.
Duckbill Beast: “?”
“Yi!! (This is delicious.)” Baby Ginseng shook the fruit and said to the Duckbill Beast.
The Duckbill Beast took a step back and rejected it very much.
As if it would believe this. This group of people was very bad.
This… was definitely not a good thing.
“Yi!! (Eat, eat, eat.)” Baby Ginseng was angry. It directly used the sweet aura skill to give the Reincarnation Fruit’s water-element creature its favorite aura and threw it into the air.
In the next moment, its aura flowed, and the Duckbill Beast’s pupils constricted.
“Quack!!!” The Duckbill Beast leaped up and swallowed the fruit into the duck’s mouth.
Duckbill Beast: (*⊙~⊙) Burp.
Gulp.
The fruit was swallowed by the Duckbill Beast. Then, its expression changed. A dark power and a black water-like mist suddenly spread from its blue body.
This black mist was like the light of evolution, directly enlarging the body of the Duckbill Beast!!
Seeing this, Shi Yu was stunned.
“Damn, it really works.”
This scene stunned Shi Yu and the others. They retreated in unison, leaving some space for the Duckbill Beast.
Buzz!!!
One meter, two meters, three meters… five meters…
The Duckbill Beast’s body began to become fat. Its blue skin began to be covered in black, leaving only a portion of dark blue patterns.
The most conspicuous thing was its neck. The black water froze like a ribbon, becoming a scarf-like part that floated behind it.
In just a short instant, the image of the Duckbill Beast changed completely.
It directly turned from the seemingly silly blue Duckbill Beast to the extremely handsome Dark Duckbill Beast, like a demonic beast.
Its strength level also temporarily increased crazily to the monarch level because of the Reincarnation Fruit.
A moment later, the Duckbill Beast opened its deep red eyes.
Although the fragment-like power memory and identity memory were already blurry, it still made it remember something.
“Quack… (I am of the Abyss Sea, demigod overlord, Duck God, Abyss Demon Duck!!)”
Boom!
A terrifying abyssal magic power erupted from the Duck-billed Beast’s body. Even Eleven and the others’ expressions changed slightly. So strong!!
But wait… What did it just say?
Deep… Abyss Sea!!
Shi Yu and Susu: ???!!
Damn, what the f*ck?!!
Wasn’t that the greatest enemy of the Blue Sea Sprite!!
“What the hell? As expected, it’s better to stew soup! This duck can’t be left alive.”
Abyss Demon Duck: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - Second Team’s Construction (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Second Team’s Construction (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Duck!!!”
After turning into the Abyssal Demon Duck, the Duckbill Beast was a little stunned.
It felt a crazy battle awareness spread above.
It was very excited.
Its eyes gradually turned red as its own will resisted another will.
Fight! Fight! Fight!
The will and memories of the Abyss Demon Duck constantly corroded the Duckbill Beast, wanting it to defeat all the enemies in front of it.
The strong battle intent made the Duckbill Beast’s body heat up.
As for the Duckbill Beast’s will, it still maintained its calm and tried its best to fight the Abyss Demon Duck’s will.
It couldn’t let this happen!!!
It couldn’t fight!
They had more people! They couldn’t win!
It didn’t want to turn into duck soup!
Battle, battle, battle!!
No way!
The two wills kept resisting…
At this critical moment, a basin of cold water descended from the sky, instantly waking the Duckbill Beast up. It widened its round eyes and was a little stunned.
After summoning the Duckbill Beast back with the cleansing water, Baby Ginseng directly pressed its hand on the ground. In the next moment, it activated its plant control and the tough vines directly tied the Duckbill Beast tightly.
Eleven still felt that this was a little unsafe, so it directly pressed its hand on the ground. A black cage immediately formed on the ground, locking the Duckbill Beast inside.
In an instant, the Duckbill Beast became a caged duck.
In the cage, the Duckbill Beast looked around. (⊙_⊙)?
Wait a minute… What was going on…
“The Abyss Sea…”
“Demigod overlord…”
At this moment, Shi Yu, Eleven, Susu, and the others stared at the Duckbill Beast solemnly and cautiously.
As for the Duckbill Beast, it looked at Shi Yu and the others who were staring at it as if they were facing a great enemy. It felt like a duck was sitting at home and a pot was falling from the sky.
It didn’t even understand what was going on.
It was clearly this group of people who intruded into its territory. It just wanted to chase them away.
In the end, not only was it captured, but it was also repeatedly deceived!
At the start, the other party clearly said that he was a good person, but in the end, he immediately turned against him. How could this be!
“You… are the demigod overlord of the Abyss Sea, the Abyss Demon Duck!” Shi Yu said.
“Duck!!! (I’m not, I didn’t, what do you mean?)”
The Duckbill Beast struggled crazily, feeling that the strength and memories just now were a little strange.
Now, it was also a little afraid, because just now, its will had been swallowed.
It was about to become duck soup.
“It’s useless to deny it.” Shi Yu discussed with Eleven and the others how to deal with the Duckbill Beast.
As expected, it was better to make soup.
This made the Duckbill Beast in the cage beside him feel cold.
Then, anger surged.
These people were indeed not good people.
“Quack!! (30 years in a lake, thirty more years in the same lake! Do not disturb my peace!)” It let out its final roar.
Shi Yu and the others decisively ignored it. It was definitely impossible for them to just give it 30 years to grow.
At that time, who could stop him after becoming an abyss demigod?
Eh… 30 years… Why did it feel like Susu could even become a mythical?
“Abyssal Demon Duck…”
“Wait a minute…”
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others were investigating the information about the Western Abyss Sea.
Suddenly, Ling spoke quickly.
Abyss Sea.
This was a super ocean faction that had been passed down in the Mythical Era, just like Dragon Palace City. However, it was an enemy faction.
Moreover, it was a big villain that had been destroyed many times but couldn’t be completely destroyed.
Although the Abyss Sea was destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite from time to time, the inheritance of the Abyss Sea had never been severed.
Every once in a while, a new demigod overlord would be born in the Abyss Sea.
Therefore, there were also many demigod overlords in the Abyss Sea, just like the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.
Just now, Shi Yu and the others were searching for information about the Abyss Sea through the first index.
The first index recorded information about totems all over the world, both ancient and modern. Even information about some totems in ancient times was recorded.
Among them, there were four demigod overlords of the Abyss Sea recorded in the first index. They corresponded to different periods, and the earliest could be traced back to hundreds of thousands of years ago.
To Shi Yu and the others’ surprise, the Abyss Demon Duck happened to be in the record.
“Abyss Demon Duck, one of the rulers of the Abyss Sea. It’s also the strangest ruler…” Ling said quickly.
“According to the investigation, the revived Abyss Sea was destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite every time…”
“But the Abyss Demon Duck was… not destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite when it was the overlord.”
“It’s said that at the start, the Abyss Demon Duck was just an ordinary Duckbill Beast. Because it wanted to become stronger, it resolutely threw itself into the darkness. While all water-element creatures couldn’t avoid the pollution of the revival of the Abyss Sea and were afraid that they would be infected and become irrational monsters, it took the initiative to come into contact with pollution and radiation, obtaining the power of the Abyss Sea Evil God and completing its mutation.”
“Moreover, for some reason, it didn’t completely fall into madness and lose its mind. Instead, it perfectly controlled this power. However, it didn’t leave the Abyss Sea because of this. Instead, it used this power to begin a crazy battle to train itself. In the end, it only took less than a hundred years to become a demigod overlord and the demon that unified the Abyss Sea…”
“It became the strongest totem in the ocean at that time, the fully deserving title of the king of ocean totems.”
“Then, there was a problem… Generally speaking, the final goal of the Abyss Sea is to pollute the entire ocean and make the entire ocean become the territory of the Abyss Sea. However, because when the Abyss Demon Duck was in power, the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite had yet to grow into a demigod. Before the Blue Sea Sprite appeared, the Abyss Demon Duck made its subordinates stop expanding. It felt that it was too easy to conquer the sea when people were defenseless. It wanted to wait for the Blue Sea Sprite. According to the rumors, compared to conquering, it preferred to fight and enjoyed fighting experts more. It was willing to wait for the Blue Sea Sprite to appear again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - Second Team’s Construction (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Second Team’s Construction (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“However, the Abyss Demon Duck didn’t seem to be able to stay idle, so it turned around and aimed at the land… It planned to expand the land into the sea before conquering the sea and complete a greater goal. At the same time, it could challenge more experts.”
“In the end, the Abyss Sea and the Abyss Demon Duck were destroyed by the land forces.”
“It’s said that because they left the ocean home ground, their battle power on land was greatly reduced. The Abyss Demon Duck didn’t want to give up no matter what, and in the end, it was wiped out.”
Shi Yu and Susu: …
The pets: …
F*ck, was this Abyss Demon Duck stupid?
Even overlord-level pets knew that they had to fight on their home ground. What was the point of expanding the ocean to conquer the land before managing to conquer the ocean?
“What’s your dream?”
Shi Yu and the others were in an encrypted conversation just now, so the Duckbill Beast couldn’t understand. As he was too curious about the duck, Shi Yu suddenly turned around and looked at the aggrieved Duckbill Beast, wanting to confirm again.
“Quack!! (I didn’t expect that I would die before I could turn the land into an ocean.)” The duck was angry.
The reason why it was so alert to Shi Yu and the others approaching its lake was because it had a greater dream!
Expand the entire land into his territory!
Its territorial awareness was not ordinary.
Shi Yu : “…”
Damn, it was definitely the reincarnation of the Abyssal Demon Duck. There was no escape.
The Abyssal Demon Duck probably didn’t really die when it came to fight on land. Instead, it was lucky to escape from the demigod on land. However, it was already on the verge of death and could only be forced to reincarnate.
Then, it reincarnated into the seven islands… and became a Duckbill Beast?
However, the dream of the Duckbill Beast felt a little familiar.
Wait a minute, did that mechanical Tyrant Dragon also want to expand the land and conquer the sea, turning everything into the earth and becoming the overlord of the earth?
Shi Yu completely didn’t expect that the dignified Abyss Sea demigod overlord was actually at the same intelligence level as the basic intelligence mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
Shi Yu pulled Eleven and the others around to discuss again.
“What do you think?”
“Although the Abyss Demon Duck is the only recorded Abyss Lord that hasn’t fallen into madness, this only means that its threat is greater…” Ling analyzed.
It was a battle maniac who also coveted land. This threat was clearly greater than other abyss demigods.
If it awakened the power and memories of its previous life, be it the sea or the land, it would probably be in chaos again…
“Wuu. (I’m not eating.)” After Ling finished analyzing, Eleven expressed that it didn’t like to eat ducks.
Apart from Baby Ginseng, the only “life form” that had ever moved Eleven’s heart, none had ever appeared.
Buggy and Baby Ginseng also shook their heads, indicating that they didn’t like to eat ducks.
“Mi! (Why don’t we cut it?)” Chi Tong requested to fight. This way, not only could it freeload the Abyssal Demon Duck’s undead puppet, but its body could also be kept to stew soup. One duck was more useful like that.
“Ning!!!” Susu hurriedly shook Chi Tong to stop it from being rash.
“Ning…” Susu looked at Shi Yu and felt that Duckie didn’t deserve to die.
Although it was also shocked at the start, wouldn’t it be bad to use its identity in its previous life to veto a life that had yet to do anything wrong?
“Yes.” Susu’s words made Shi Yu nod.
After he calmed down, Susu’s point of view was most in line with his thoughts.
“Ning!” Susu immediately said.
Why not let it try to cleanse the Abyss Duck God into a good duck?
At that time, when the Abyss Sea made a comeback, it would let Duck Duck accept the inheritance of the Abyss Sea and continue to be the overlord of the Abyss Sea. It and Duck would cooperate from the inside and out. Perhaps it could cut off the Abyss Sea from the “origin”!
“Mm.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
He kept feeling that he had come to look for the Space Emperor Ruins, but in the end, things developed in a baffling direction.
He turned around and looked at the Duckbill Beast that was biting the vine.
After thinking about it, Shi Yu said, “The Duckbill Beast is the overlord of the Abyss Sea. It’s also something from my previous life.”
“We’ve also seen its memory experience just now. From its birth until now, it hasn’t even attacked a human. In other words, it’s still a good duck now.”
“It’s indeed a little immoral to directly kill the current it according to its identity in its previous life. After all, from the looks of it, it’s completely different from the Abyssal Demon Duck.”
“Ning!!” Susu agreed very much. As a reincarnation, it also didn’t like its companions to treat it as a Blue Sea Sprite. It was also different from the Blue Sea Sprite. It wanted to be a Star Sea Sprite…!
“Let’s do as Susu says. We’ll just take good care of it. It’s a pity to directly stew a duck with overlord potential,” Shi Yu said.
“Do you want to contract it?!” Ling asked.
“No contract, no points. Let’s raise it together with the mechanical Tyrant Dragon later!” Shi Yu said.
Although the Duckbill Beast wasn’t equivalent to the Abyss Demon Duck now, raising it was still a little risky.
Be it contracts or points, there were risks.
If the Duckbill Beast became stronger too quickly, it would easily cause too much damage when it suddenly recovered its memories from its previous life.
As for the contract… Shi Yu couldn’t guarantee that the reincarnation of an abyss demigod didn’t master any methods to counterattack Beast Tamers.
It was also the least risky to raise it in the ruins space. This way, the Duckbill Beast could be monitored by them at any time. There was no possibility of its will being occupied by the Abyss Demon Duck. Moreover, because it controlled the speed of becoming stronger, even if the duck’s will was occupied by their previous life, they could immediately solve it.
“Just like the Void Mantis of the Space Emperor, nurture it as the second team!” Shi Yu said. “It’s probably not difficult to rely on its original potential to grow quickly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - Second Team’s Construction (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Second Team’s Construction (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“However, its growth speed is definitely inferior to Susu. This way, the danger can always be maintained in a controllable range.”
“When it can ignore the influence of the Abyssal Demon Duck one day, escape from it, control it, and live its own life, I’ll give it freedom. Now, be a good fighter and experimental material!”
“Ning!!!” Susu’s eyes lit up. It promised to cleanse the Duckbill Beast into a good duck.
At that time, they would cooperate from the inside and attack the Abyss Sea!
“Wuu…” “Wu…” “Yi…”
The other pets looked at each other and fell into deep thought, instantly imagining a scene.
When the Abyss Sea revived again, under the lead of the Abyss Demon Duck and the Duck God, it was just about to fight the guardian of the Blue Sea Sprite to the death. Suddenly, the Abyss Demon Duck directly betrayed the Abyss… and became the number one lackey of the Blue Sea Sprite.
Abyss Sea: Why are you attacking us, your majesty?
“Quack…”
Just as Shi Yu and the others were harboring ill intentions, duck cries came from the other side again.
“Quack… (Kill or stew, do it quickly!)”
Swoosh.
Seeing this, Eleven and Baby Ginseng directly untied the restraints and cage, making Duckie widen its eyes in confusion.
“Cough.” Shi Yu looked at it solemnly and said, “Just like what you’ve experienced, there’s an evil existence that wants to possess you and replace your will. It’s our true enemy, and also your enemy. And you’re innocent. You don’t want to be its puppet, right?”
“The enemy of an enemy is a friend.”
“In that case, how about we help you become stronger and get rid of it?”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and said, “From today onwards, we’re comrades.”
“Wuu!” “Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!” “Hm…”
Duck Beak Beast: ???
Looking at the group of people who suddenly changed their expressions, Duck Duck fell into deep thought.
Although it didn’t know what was going on, it seemed like it didn’t have to die.
….
Next, Shi Yu and the others tricked the Duck Beak Beast for several hours.
Throughout the whole process, the duck’s expression was especially serious.
Shi Yu was right at the start. Even if the Duck Beak Beast was really the reincarnation of the Abyssal Demon Duck, so what? As an independent will, who wanted the will of their previous life to replace their current self?
If it were anyone else, they probably wouldn’t admit that they were still themselves in their previous life.
This was also why the inheritance mechanism of the Blue Sea Sprite only inherited the will and racial skills to protect the sea and not the memories.
Of course, this was only the inheritance mechanism of the Blue Sea Sprite. It didn’t mean that all pets would start again after reincarnation. For example, Zhong Xuan had said that after its reincarnation, it might awaken its memories. As for the Undying Dark Phoenix, it was actually a reincarnation. It also retained its memories.
Therefore, Shi Yu and the others couldn’t say for sure if the Duckbill Beast would awaken the memories of the Abyss Demon Duck later.
From the perspective of the Duckbill Beast, it was very unwilling to let some Abyss Demon Duck replace it. Therefore, although it had experienced humiliation at the hands of Shi Yu and the others, after several hours of brainwashing, the Duckbill Beast understood.
In the end, if it didn’t listen, it would definitely be made into soup.
Then it chose to follow Shi Yu and the others to cultivate and strive to control its fate!
“That’s right!”
Seeing that the Duckbill Beast was so smart, Shi Yu was very satisfied. From today onwards, Duck was a member of his team!
Well, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon had been working hard for so long. In addition, it might still be studied for a period of time and had invested a lot of resources. That mechanical Tyrant Dragon was also one of the members of the second team.
Shi Yu temporarily didn’t plan to contract or add points to them, but he would use other methods to help them grow.
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon naturally grew, became stronger, and evolved through continuous mechanical experiments.
As for the Duckbill Beast, the growth process was the process of constantly controlling the power of the Abyss Demon Duck in his previous life.
The upper limit of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s growth depended on the upper limit of Ling, while the upper limit of the Duck-billed Beast’s growth was at the demigod level. Therefore, in the end, the potential of the two of them was probably not bad.
After Shi Yu decided to start the second team, his mood was especially good. Alright, the team was going to be lively again. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon finally had a companion. Otherwise, Shi Yu would feel quite apologetic that the mechanical Tyrant Dragon had always been incompatible with other pets.
Now, it could make friends.
It was indeed lively…
As a member of the second team, the address of the Duck Beak Beast was built beside the address of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon by Shi Yu and the others.
Perhaps it was because they didn’t get along, or perhaps it was because they had just fought, but when the two pets met, their eyes were especially red.
“Roar!!! (I am the overlord of the earth!!)”
“Quack!!! (Earth? Earth belongs to the ocean!!)” The Duckbill Beast wearing the translator Ling glared at it. It finally knew what this guy was talking about. No wonder it was so unhappy with this guy.
The Duckbill Beast’s territorial awareness was very strong. Under the influence of its previous life’s will, its greatest obsession at the moment seemed to be transforming the ground into its own territory, water territory…
Buzz!
Swoosh!
The earth-yellow sharp blade and the water-blue sharp blade were condensed by the two pets.
“Roar!! (Space Splitting Sword!)”
“Quack!! (Water Blade!!)”
Boom!!!
In the distance, smoke rose.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. “The relationship is so good. Ling, look after the mechanical Tyrant Dragon, Susu, look after the Duck Beak Beast… As long as nothing happens.”
“Roger!” Ling nodded.
“Ning!!” Susu also nodded.
Rather than saying it was Shi Yu’s second team, it was more like it was Ling and Susu’s little brother.
An ancient phantom beast junior, an abyss demigod junior… Beside him, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng revealed envious expressions.
Clone skills felt different from underlings with their own will.
“Mi!!” After thinking about it, Chi Tong decided to kill an undead puppet that retained its will later and join the big family of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Abyssal Demon Duck as its sidekick.
“Yi…”
Baby Ginseng pondered for a moment and shook its head. Forget it, forget it. It should work hard to become the number one in the team first. At that time, it could directly let Buggy be its underling and form a dimensional reduction attack on Susu and Ling.
“Wuu!” Eleven also looked at Buggy. It had the same thought. What kind of underling was better and more functional than a tool worm?
Buggy: “?”
Bastard!! It was team one!! Stop thinking about squeezing it into team two!!

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Seven Islands Region, Star Wilderness Island, Bonfire Village. This was an ordinary village.
There were a total of three professional Beast Tamers in the village, and the highest level was only an intermediate Beast Tamer.
Even if such a village faced the invasion of commander-level ferocious beasts, it would quickly become ruins without external help.
And today, a super ferocious beast that stood above transcendent, commander, monarch, and even overlord descended on this place.
“Meow ~ Found it.”
Standing on the roof, a creature with a wedge-shaped head and dark eyelids covered its blue eyes swung its long and fluffy tail in boredom, calling out to someone.
At the same time, its gaze kept sizing up the altar in the abandoned area of the village.
“I’ve found the Space Emperor Altar, but it looks broken. Who knows if it can still be used?”
“Found it? Double joy.” Another figure quickly appeared.
He sat in the house and said, “By the way, Teacher Cat, I’ve also figured out the origin of that duck just now.”
The gem cat turned around. “Huh?”
“What?” It asked with interest. “So it’s edible?”
Shi Yu chuckled. “In its previous life, it was the demigod lord of the Abyss Sea, the embodiment of pollution and radiation. Are you sure you want to eat it?”
“It’s alright if you have diarrhea. I’m afraid you’ll mutate into an Abyss Demon Cat.”
“What!!??” The gem cat shouted with a shocked expression.
Wait… demigod overlord of the Abyss Sea?!!
What a joke!!!
It widened her gem eyes and looked at Shi Yu.
However, how did he come up with such a low-level name like Abyss Demon Cat?
“I’m not kidding.”
“I’m thinking that if we can apply for a large number of cultivation resources with the Blue Sea Sprite, how much can we apply for to modify this duck…”
“The Environmental Protection Department’s Shi Yu, Susu, and the Guardian Cat Ying… After countless hardships and life-and-death crises, they subdued the boss of the Abyss Sea… This achievement is a good start for the Environmental Protection Department,” Shi Yu muttered.
Its performance was better than the other thirteen bureaus!
It wasn’t too much to get a promotion and a raise, right?
“There’s credit for me too?” The gem cat was stunned and revealed a knowing expression.
“Forget it, let’s take a look at this egg first.” Shi Yu took out the Space Beast Egg.
He looked at the Space Emperor Ruins the gem cat had found.
“Wait, tell me about the duck first!” The gem cat was angry. He was just leaving it halfway! What exactly is going on!
“Uh.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek.
“Speak.”
Shi Yu sighed and told the gem cat about the “Reincarnation Fruit”.
Shi Yu was actually unwilling to tell the gem cat about the “Reincarnation Fruit”. The reason was very simple…
As expected, just as Shi Yu finished speaking, the gem cat’s eyes lit up.
It instantly forgot about the Abyss Demon Duck and said, “Tell me, I’m so powerful. Could it be that in my previous life, I was a half-god empress and also the king of totems? I even left me many precious treasures in my previous life…”
The gem cat felt that the possibility was very high.
After all, it was too special as a gem cat.
Other gem cats could only use one gem to evolve and could only evolve once. As for it, it could use many pieces to constantly evolve without limit. No matter how one looked at it, it was very unscientific.
Even if it was a mutation, there had to be a reason. In its previous life, being a big boss was a possibility.
The gem cat revealed a shining gaze and felt that its demigod path was on this Reincarnation Fruit.
“No…” Shi Yu said,” I’m afraid you were also a villain in your previous life. If you eat the Reincarnation Fruit and can’t control yourself, I’ll be finished… ”
The gem cat: “Give me one, give me one. I can control myself! Don’t you believe in my will?”
Shi Yu shook his head crazily and very quickly. Yes, he didn’t believe it!
This half-god reincarnation had its own overlord will, but this…
Shi Yu said, “We’ll talk about it when I become a legendary Beast Tamer and can suppress totems with a flip of my hand.”
The gem cat: ???
This guy wanted to suppress it?!
…
…
To be precise, the Space Emperor Ruins was at the edge of a dilapidated altar.
After the gem cat isolated a large area from its perception of this place, Shi Yu came here with the egg.
According to the parchment, as long as the Starry Sky Egg was placed in the groove of the altar, it would automatically activate the ruins array and let the egg absorb the starlight to accumulate the nutrients for hatching.
Shi Yu compared it to the altar and took a deep breath. He placed the Space Beast Egg on it…
According to the description, the normal reaction was that when the pet egg absorbed the power of the stars, a faint halo would spread. The absorption process would last 24 to 48 hours. After absorbing enough specific nutrients, the light would dim and stop absorbing.
Therefore, after putting the pet egg on it, Shi Yu was very nervous. He was afraid that the altar would break, that the egg wouldn’t light up, or that the egg had already become a bad guy and couldn’t be absorbed normally. After all… it had been so long.
Crack.
Shi Yu and the gem cat beside him stopped breathing and looked at the Space Beast Egg nervously.
1 second, 2 seconds, 3 seconds…
A few seconds later…
A weak halo spread from the white-striped pet egg!
White and purple intertwined!!!
“It can be used!” Seeing this, Shi Yu was overjoyed. His expression was filled with surprise.
“I feel better, I feel better.”
When the gem cat saw this, it said, “I mean, is there a possibility that when the time comes, three altars can be used, but the last altar can’t be used, causing the hatching progress of the egg to be stuck at 3/4. It can’t hatch and becomes a useless egg. I don’t like useless eggs.”

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu : “…”
Was this something a normal cat could care about?
….
The Space Beast Egg had successfully absorbed the first special star power!!
Shi Yu’s mood continued to be happy.
As expected, hatching an egg was more exciting than knowing in advance.
As he waited for the Space Beast Egg to absorb the nutrients, Shi Yu did not stay idle. He studied the Duckbill Beast with the gem cat.
At the moment, the two skills of the Duckbill Beast, Water Blade and Heart Strike, were both above Perfect Level Proficiency, close to transcendent. Their levels were very high.
In comparison, the few skills of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon were relatively lousy. They were all entry-level proficiency.
In addition, the Duckbill Beast could use the overlord’s will. No wonder the Tyrant Dragon was suppressed by the transcendent Duckbill Beast. If it weren’t for the fact that its race was stronger, it might have knelt very quickly.
Today, it was rare for Duckie to join the team. Shi Yu and Susu gave it a greeting gift.
“Cleansing Memory Water.”
It could help the Duckbill Beast learn, master, and increase its cleansing skill. After learning it, it could cleanse itself.
As for Team One, Shi Yu was helpless. He had yet to recover from the temporary addition of the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. If he wanted to continue increasing Buggy and the others, he might have to wait a day.
…
Heavenly Rainbow Island.
Shi Yu’s quiet departure did not mean the end of the challenge on the path to champion.
A new round of battle began.
The next day, Dong Huang’s Ji Feng followed suit.
Ji Feng’s strength was undoubtedly the strongest in the Dong Huang exchange team apart from a few legends and Shi Yu. His appearance also made the seven islands curse continuously.
It also swept through the first few levels as fiercely as “Lu Bai”.
However, what made Seven Islands glad was that Ji Feng wasn’t that abnormal. After reaching the last few stages, his condition was clearly not as good as before. After all, his strength was established on the “Myriad Affinity” talent, and this talent would cause Beast Tamers to exhaust their physical strength in battle.
But even so, because Ji Feng was willing to change pets, he didn’t have a single pet the whole time. He easily passed the first eight levels until he arrived at the ninth level and faced the Demon Blade God.
The seven islands were extremely solemn.
Today, on the sky ship that was watching the championship path, apart from the original team from yesterday, another person came here.
She was wearing a white and red witch suit. She had an oval face and exquisite and beautiful facial features. She had a beautiful black smooth hair style, and her red eyes were calmly looking at the young man below.
Her name was Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court, a witch from the Phoenix Divine Shrine. She was currently ranked third among the younger generation of the seven islands.
[Jiyi, your mission is to get close to the young man named ‘Lu Bai’ in Dong Huang and get closer to him.]
In the eyes of the Seven Islands Association, a woman who could attract an outstanding young man like “Lu Bai” definitely had to be extremely outstanding.
The disciple of a legendary Beast Tamer was also a quasi legend. At the same time, the Phoenix Court, which had the Phoenix bloodline as a hybrid witch, was naturally the best choice.
The higher-ups of the seven islands knew very well that the people of Dong Huang worshiped dragons and phoenixes very much. In their opinion, if they let the Phoenix Court come into contact with “Lu Bai”, Lu Bai would definitely fall into it. After all, because of mixed blood, the Phoenix Court’s appearance was also top-notch on the seven islands.
However, it was a pity that “Lu Bai” didn’t appear at the competition venue today.
“This person’s strength is not bad either.” Jie Yi looked at Ji Feng below and fell into deep thought. So how strong was Lu Bai who instantly cleared ten levels? She wanted to see it.
In the end, Ji Feng from Dong Huang barely defeated the number one person below the legends of the seven islands, the Demon Blade God Era, again stimulating the nerves of the seven islands. However, at this point, Ji Feng no longer had the strength to challenge the overlord. His challenge ended here.
The third day.
Zou Yun of Dong Huang issued a challenge. As the first two contestants of Dong Huang were ridiculously abnormal, Heavenly King Zou was targeted very badly. He only passed seven levels and knelt at the eighth level.
This made Tong Yan and the others feel disdain.
It was also on this day that the gem cat and Shi Yu secretly returned to the Dong Huang Base in Tian Hong City. They were considered to have “recovered”. Next, they could walk around casually.
After sending a private message to Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others to tell them that he was back, Shi Yu couldn’t help but plan to take a walk as Lu Bai.
He wasn’t afraid that the seven islands would plot against him after discovering him.
His trump card was never his strength! Nor was it this bodyguard, the gem cat!
Instead, it was the demigod-level Dragon God Protection on its body!!!
At the moment, the Dragon God was the greatest rich woman and the thickest thigh!
With this thing, safety was naturally guaranteed at the maximum level.
However, Shi Yu realized that he had underestimated the seven islands.
On the seven islands, they had mobilized a method that even the Dragon God’s Protection couldn’t stop. Shi Yu had just left the Dong Huang Base and was about to walk around when a red-eyed woman in a witch suit stopped in front of Shi Yu.
“‘Lu Bai’?” Jie Yi looked at the young man in front of her and smiled. “I found you.”
“You are… May I help you?” Shi Yu saw the beautiful witch in front of him and immediately became cautious.
The words “Beauty Trap” appeared in Shi Yu’s heart.
Not good!
This gem cat and the Dragon God Protection couldn’t help him block it.
It was time to test his willpower.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Eleven had obtained the overlord’s will by adding points. In theory, his willpower wouldn’t be low after experiencing so much pain!
“Beast Tamer of the seven islands, Phoenix Court Jie Yi. Level, quasi legendary.” Jie Yi’s red lips swayed slightly as she said, “The higher-ups of the association asked me to approach you and build a good relationship with you.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Initially, Shi Yu was still thinking about how to reject the other party, but the moment the other party spoke, Shi Yu couldn’t do it anymore.
She’s showing her hand?
How could she use a beauty trap like this?
Did she know how to play?
No, that wasn’t right.
Instinct told Shi Yu that this girl’s skill was very high… He had to be careful.
Shi Yu said with a pale face, “Cough, I’m sorry. I have an infectious disease and don’t like to make friends.”
In the alternate space, the gem cat looked at the two people fighting and shook its head, happily munching on melon seeds.
In the outside world, Jie Yi was silent for a moment.
He indeed looked sick.
However, she smiled and said, “It’s alright. I have the Phoenix bloodline in my body. I’m immune to all diseases. Since I was young, there have been no diseases that can get close to me.”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. Wait a minute, Phoenix bloodline?
Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court said, “I’ve heard of your deeds. If the higher-ups let me come into contact with others, I won’t hesitate to tell them to get lost, but I’m still very interested in experts.”
“Even I might not necessarily be able to clear the path of the champion. You’re very strong, and most importantly, you’re not ugly. Even as a future partner, I won’t be very against the idea. How about it? Do you want to try getting to know each other?”
Shi Yu’s heart was like still water. He took a deep breath. If not for the fact that he had many female fans in Dong Huang and was already used to confessions, he would have been tempted.
“I…”
Shi Yu was just about to reject her when the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi said, “By the way, isn’t there a mystic realm crack in the bet between Dong Huang and the seven islands? I’m from the Phoenix God Shrine. Our divine temple has an unsolved mystic realm. Do you want to take a look?”
“Although it’s very difficult to crack, I think the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang will be very interested in the mystic realm of the Phoenix Race, right?”
“Apart from that, there are many interesting things on Phoenix Mountain.”
Shi Yu was stunned.
Phoenix… Shrine?
Shi Yu looked at this witch. As expected, Phoenix bloodline, witch. He was wondering what was wrong.
So, this guy’s teacher was the legend of the seven islands who accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm?
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and silence.
If she wanted to talk about this, it was a different story.
However…
Did she know what it meant to play with fire and “lure a wolf into the house”???
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and looked at the beautiful witch opposite him. “But I have to wait for my companions.”
“Alright.”
Seeing that Shi Yu had agreed, Jie Yi immediately understood that Shi Yu still couldn’t withstand her attack.
After giving Shi Yu an “exploration mystic realm”, Shi Yu took the bait.
At that time, as long as she provided some more information about the Phoenix Mystic Realm and strategies, Shi Yu would definitely have a good impression of her+1+1+1+1.
Unfortunately, the Phoenix Mystic Realm was destined to not be cracked by ordinary people. During this period of time, Shi Yu and the others would waste it.
“Then it’s decided.” The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi smiled.
“Yes.”
In order to let this person leave faster, Shi Yu immediately agreed.
Then, Jie Yi left, leaving Shi Yu behind to think about life…
He hoped that after tearing down the Phoenix Mystic Realm, this witch wouldn’t transform into a witch and curse him.
….
Soon after that day, the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others returned from the Crown Rainbow Mountain Range.
After returning, Tyrannical Sea Legend immediately met Shi Yu alone.
“There’s something wrong with you!!!”
As soon as they met, the Tyrannical Sea Legend widened his eyes and said, “So, the greatest gain from your trip with Senior Ying is not that you gathered the energy of the Starry Sky Egg, but that you casually caught an Abyss demigod reincarnation??”
“Yes, yes,” Shi Yu said. “My luck is really good…”
Tyrannical Sea Legend: ???
He opened his mouth slightly.
This, what was this!
Shi Yu, this kid… This couldn’t be attributed to luck anymore, right?
Was he some Mythical creature that cultivated luck?
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment. “Let’s talk about this when we return to Dong Huang. The main problem now is still business. Business, business in the seven islands.”
The corners of the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mouth twitched.
It felt like even if the reason they came here didn’t work out, this trip would not be a loss.
“By the way, the surveillance cameras at the base today captured the vicinity of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi. They captured your contact with her. Did something happen between the two of you?” Legend Sea Tyrant took a deep breath and temporarily forgot about the Abyss Demon Duck Shi Yu mentioned and talked to Shi Yu about “business”.
“She’s the personal disciple of the legendary Beast Tamer who accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm. Both of them are dedicated to cracking the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
“It’s not a big deal.” Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “The Seven Islands Association probably asked her to rope me in. Then, she invited me to play at the Phoenix God Shrine later. I agreed.”
“We’ll go over sooner or later anyway.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend : “…”
He had never seen anyone court death like this.
“I understand,” the Tyrannical Sea Legend said. “But I have to remind you… don’t fall for the beauty trap of the seven islands. Well, it also includes Shen Feng, Tingxiang, Rongguang, Ming Hua, and Xue Yuan. You’re indeed not young anymore. If you have any thoughts, our Dong Huang also has many outstanding female Beast Tamers.”

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Beauty Trap from the Seven Islands (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“I remember that Lu Qingyi, Tong Yan, and even Divine Bell are all single. If you have such thoughts, they’re undoubtedly more outstanding. They’re not what a mere Beast Tamer from the island country can compare to.”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “Don’t worry, I know the severity. Do I look like someone who can’t resist temptation?”
Tyrannical Sea Legend: “Yes.”
Shi Yu : “…”
Damn it!
“Let’s not talk about this anymore.” Seeing that the Tyrannical Sea Legend was so bored, Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “Uncle Yu, how’s the situation on the path to champion?”
“Ji Feng stopped at the tenth level, and Zou Yun stopped at the eighth level,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said, not too surprised.
Shi Yu was stunned. Ji Feng was alright, but what was wrong with Heavenly King Zou!
This time, he could already imagine… Heavenly King Zou being scolded on the trending list.
It was alright. They were different after all.
“By the way, didn’t they also say that after passing the tenth level of the Road of Champions, you can enter the seven island Mythical Ruins to cultivate for seven days?” Shi Yu said. “Is there any information about this Mythical Ruins? What are the specific cultivation effects inside?”
Shi Yu began to think about his most important reward.
Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded and said, “I’ve already obtained the information. This Mythical Ruins is a ruin that increases the efficiency of skill training. In theory, in seven days, it can allow the pet cultivating inside to train a super skill that has just entered the entry level to nearly expert level and master it at a very fast speed.”
“Of course, if the skill trained by the pet is at the expert level, it’s still effective. The rule is that the lower the skill proficiency, the easier it is to increase. And vice versa. It’s said that with this ruin, it can steadily nurture overlord-level pets. The effect is comparable to a renewable legendary resource.”
