“However, every time this ruin opens, it consumes a huge amount of resources. The cost-effective ratio of nurturing ordinary overlords isn’t high, and it’s only suitable for geniuses. If nothing goes wrong, the two legendary world contestants from the seven islands and the Phoenix Court that you came into contact with must have cultivated here.”
Shi Yu: “?”
What?
That was it?
Seven days? Just add more points, right?
The cultivation effect of the Mythical Ruins was only at this level?
Compared to the seven island Mythical Ruins, adding points could also train the pet’s will and physique. In comparison, Shi Yu immediately felt bored.
Shi Yu compared it to the Mythical Ruins that Senior Lu had cracked.
The Mythical Ruins that Senior Lu cracked gave her the corresponding Mythical bloodline of the five pets and even inherited five perfect Mythical Revival skills… In comparison, although the Seven Islands Mythical Ruins couldn’t be said to be useless, it was useless to Shi Yu, who had the skill index. It wasn’t as attractive to him as the ruins that Senior Lu cracked.
As expected, Mythical ruins were also divided into levels. That’s right… It was impossible for the seven islands to open the ridiculous ruins to outsiders.
“Seven days of cultivation is not bad. Most importantly, all the contracted pets can enter together. If used appropriately, it will welcome a very good increase,” Tyrannical Sea Legend said.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and shook his head. “Transfer this opportunity to Big Brother Zheng Hai. I’m now Lu Bai, so it’s not convenient for Eleven and the others to enter the ruins to cultivate. Moreover, seven days is not very meaningful for my strength to increase. Isn’t Zheng Hai’s pet only a little away from the overlord level? Using this opportunity, perhaps Dong Huang can immediately have a new legendary Beast Tamer.”
Shi Yu said decisively on account of the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s Infinite Devour! Upon hearing that, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was stunned. This was because Zheng Hai was his disciple. He completely didn’t expect Shi Yu to say that he would give the opportunity to enter the Mythical Ruins to Zheng Hai.
“The price will be discounted according to legendary resources. Friendly price.” Shi Yu looked up and said, “Uncle Yu, are you paying or Zheng Hai?”
Selling this opportunity to buy supplements to increase points was more cost-effective.
Tyrannical Sea Legend: ???
“Cough, cough.” Legend Sea Tyrant’s scalp went numb. “Although I don’t know what you’re thinking, you can talk to Zheng Hai yourself later.”
“As for him, if he wants that Leviathan to perfectly advance to overlord, he didn’t miss any super skill proficiency upgrade chances, so his progress is a little slow. He should indeed want this cultivation opportunity in the ruins very much.”
“If he doesn’t have enough money, you can come to me.”
“Alright, it’s just a gesture. I’m mainly afraid that you and Brother Zheng Hai will feel embarrassed if I give it to you for free,” Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
The corners of Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mouth twitched. This guy really knew how to talk!
However, the Tyrannical Sea Legend had a good impression of Shi Yu at this moment. After all, the one who cleared the level was Shi Yu, but the one who benefited was his disciple.
He didn’t become a bodyguard for nothing.
Wait a minute, after Zheng Hai reached the Legendary level and participated in the World Tournament, would he also have to be Shi Yu’s bodyguard?? With Shi Yu’s courting death level… The Tyrannical Sea Legend’s scalp went numb again.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - Phoenix Shrine (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Phoenix Shrine (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Zheng Hai.
The personal disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Yu Zhihui. His talent was a water-element strengthening talent, a very common talent. The reason why he was taken in as a disciple by the Tyrannical Sea Legend, a titled expert, was because Zheng Hai’s contracted Blue Salamander accidentally mutated into the Leviathan race after swallowing unknown resources due to a cultivation mistake.
This experience could be said to be identical to the Tyrannical Sea Legend. In the early years of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, it was only an ordinary fishing youth. His initial pet was also the Blue Salamander of a low-level transcendent race. It only knew one bubble skill.
However, it was precisely because this Blue Salamander accidentally swallowed an unknown resource and completed its mutation evolution that it obtained the super racial skill Infinite Devour. This allowed the Tyrannical Sea Legend to directly rise and become a super expert at the top of Dong Huang.
Zheng Hai was similar. In the beginning, he was just an ordinary fishing youth, so he was lucky. However, he wasn’t as lucky as the Tyrannical Sea Legend, because after his Blue Salamander mutated, it didn’t master Infinite Devour and only completed the racial mutation.
But even so, because the Tyrannical Sea Legend had seen some possibilities on Zheng Hai’s Giant Leviathan, after a test, he also took Zheng Hai in as a disciple. Now, under the nurturing of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, that ordinary fishing youth had already become eighth in the Dong Huang Sequence!
The trump card pet had also mutated all the way to a middle-level overlord race and mastered three super racial skills. Moreover, it had been trained by Zheng Hai to nearly perfect level.
“Master, you’re looking for me?”
This time, Zheng Hai was also brought to the seven islands by the Tyrannical Sea Legend. After all, the seven islands were the country of water, and it was very suitable for Zheng Hai to train. Unfortunately, the champion path this time prohibited quasi legendary participants. Although Zheng Hai’s pet wasn’t at the overlord level, his Beast Taming level prevented him from challenging the champion path.
Zheng Hai also felt that it was a pity. However, to be able to see Dong Huang’s genius Beast Tamer, Lu Bai, sweep through the seven islands, he also felt that he didn’t come for nothing. This Lu Bai was really impressive. He felt that even his overlord race, the Giant Leviathan, definitely couldn’t withstand a single move from that ice elemental life form.
At this moment, Zheng Hai was very confused because he suddenly received a message from his master to come to “Lu Bai’s” room.
After arriving, Zheng Hai discovered Lu Bai, who was sitting and communicating with his master, in the room. He also discovered that his master’s expression didn’t look right…
“Yes.” Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded.
“Because Lu Bai passed the tenth level of the champion’s path, Dong Huang obtained the right to use the Seven Islands Mythical Cultivation Ruins on the seventh day.”
Zheng Hai also nodded. He naturally knew this.
“Originally, this cultivation opportunity was Lu Bai’s, but for some reason, he planned to pass this cultivation opportunity to you to use.”
“What!!!” Zheng Hai widened his eyes and looked at Shi Yu eagerly. “Brother, is this for real!”
Looking at Shi Yu, who looked like a white-haired youth, Zheng Hai called him brother in shock.
With this, his Giant Leviathan’s three super racial skills had reached perfect proficiency. It would definitely not be a problem to break through to the overlord level.
Apart from that, the strength of the other pets could also increase in the short term.
It could save him a lot of time and ensure that he had more time to stabilize his strength before the World Tournament began!!
Wait a minute, Lu Bai was not related to him at all. Why would he give such a huge opportunity to him?
Zheng Hai was puzzled for a moment, but he quickly understood that his master might have fought for it for him.
He was immediately touched.
“Cough, cough.” Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “Wait a minute. It’s not a free gift. It’s according to the internal friendship price. There’s no problem, right…”
Zheng Hai’s eyes flickered. “Of course. I won’t let Brother Lu Bai suffer a loss. Even if I sell the Binhai Training Hall and go bankrupt, I definitely won’t let Brother Lu suffer a loss.”
Since it was arranged by his master, he naturally wouldn’t let Lu Bai suffer, lest Lu Bai and President Ye looked down on them!!
Wasn’t it just money!!
He would give double the amount Lu Bai wanted!
Zheng Hai wasn’t stupid. He had calculated it.
If he obtained the cultivation opportunity gifted by Lu Bai, his Giant Leviathan could quickly become a perfect overlord.
At that time, he would be the fifth legendary Beast Tamer in the top ten of the Dong Huang Sequence!!!
Coupled with his water-element strengthening talent, his overlord Giant Leviathan’s strength was definitely extraordinary.
Even monsters like Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and Ji Feng definitely couldn’t defeat the Leviathan race that had the enhancement of Beast Tamers.
Then, in theory, he should be able to enter the top five of the Sequence.
At that time, the reward for the Sequence Battle would be a legendary resource!!!
What was wrong with investing more now? In any case, after breaking through to the legendary level, the resources could be quickly returned.
He had already wasted too much time to let the Giant Leviathan perfectly advance to an overlord. He had to seize this opportunity.
“Brother Zheng Hai, no need to be polite,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“No, I should be the one thanking Brother Lu Bai. I won’t stand on ceremony. This opportunity is indeed very important to me,” Zheng Hai said.
“There’s actually another reason why I called you over this time,” said the Tyrannical Sea Legend. “Tomorrow, you and Old Ke will go to the Red God Island with Lu Bai to visit the Phoenix God Shrine and try to crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm behind the Phoenix God Shrine.”
“Huh?” Zheng Hai was stunned.
Although he had reached the quasi legendary level and was also a legendary disciple of the Tyrannical Sea, like Ji Feng and the others, he didn’t know the real purpose of the Dong Huang exchange team coming to the seven islands, nor did he know the true identity of “Lu Bai”.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - Phoenix Shrine (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Phoenix Shrine (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, when he heard his master say that he wanted to send them to some Phoenix Mystic Realm, he immediately said, “Are we going to start cracking the ruins mystic realm of the seven islands? So our first goal is this Phoenix Mystic Realm?”
“With Bureau 11’s ‘Old Ke’ as the core…” Zheng Hai said,” What do I have to do. ”
“You?” Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “Just follow Lu Bai to discuss business. There’s no need to do anything.”
Make a good relationship with this guy so that he wouldn’t kill you!!
Tyrannical Sea Legend was really worried that his disciple would suffer from Shi Yu. After all, for Shi Yu to be able to get so many legendary resources from the association, he was definitely not easy to deal with.
Zheng Hai : “…”
…
Because the member of the Dong Huang exchange team, “Lu Bai”, had been invited by the Phoenix Witch of the seven islands, “The Phoenix Court”, to visit the Phoenix God Shrine, the Dong Huang exchange team decided to form a special exchange team and go together.
Legendary Beast Tamer, archeologist Ke Yingzong of Bureau 11, quasi legendary Beast Tamer, Sect Master Zheng Hai of the Binhai Training Hall, and Shi Yu himself. It was a very simple combination of three.
Of course, there was definitely the gem cat behind the scenes. However, most of Dong Huang’s own people didn’t know that the gem cat following them the whole time was Dong Huang’s guardian, let alone the seven islands.
The next day, the challenge on the road to champion continued. Today, Ning Tianming, who was a hybrid of human and ghost, continued to challenge. As for Dong Huang’s special exchange team, they had already set off for the Red God Island and the Phoenix God Society.
On the ocean and the huge ship, Zheng Hai kept feeling that this special exchange team was strange, but he couldn’t tell what was strange.
“Old Ke, are we really going to explore the mystic realm?” He asked the archeologist from Bureau 11 beside him, Senior Ke Yingzong.
“What else?” Old Ke said.
“Why do I feel that it’s to prevent Brother Lu from being abducted!” Zheng Hai looked at Lu Bai and the Phoenix Court couple who were “romancing” side by side in the distance and felt confused and envious.
Wait, wait, wait, when did Lu Bai hook up with the Phoenix Court, the number three on the seven islands?
Compared to exploring the mystic realm, why did he feel that the goal of the Dong Huang exchange team this time was to look after “Lu Bai”?
Damn it, why didn’t the seven islands send someone to use a honey trap on him?
He also wanted to challenge his weakness.
“Look at yourself…” Old Master Ke shook his head.
He didn’t believe that Shi Yu would be swayed by beauty in front of a Phoenix Race ruins mystic realm. The will of their Bureau 11 archeologists… was definitely firm!
Ruins! Ruins! Ruins!
Women would only delay their speed of tearing down the ruins!
“If anyone’s getting abducted, it should be us who abducts that little girl to Dong Huang.” Old Master Ke was a person with great ambition.
The Phoenix Divine Society was established to protect and worship the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
As long as they moved the Phoenix Mystic Realm to Dong Huang, the Phoenix Shrine would also move to Dong Huang. It was very reasonable for a group of witches to marry into Dong Huang.
This Zheng Hai had definitely never heard of a popular idiom in Bureau 11.
Because Shi Yu, a newcomer to Bureau 11, had cracked the mystic realm of the ruins too quickly after joining Bureau 11. In Bureau 11, the saying that “times had changed” had been circulating for a long time… It was probably no exception this time.
However, he wasn’t sure if they could do it this time. Hopefully it wasn’t a demolition.
“Ah…”
Zheng Hai, who didn’t know the purpose of this trip and Shi Yu’s identity, only felt deep confusion.
…
“I didn’t expect you to make a decision so quickly. I thought you still had to think for a while.” On the huge ship, Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court, who was wearing a witch suit, looked at the sea and said in surprise.
“It’s mainly because Senior Ke from the exchange team was very interested after hearing about the Phoenix Mystic Realm and couldn’t wait to explore it,” Shi Yu coughed dryly and said weakly.
His short white hair fluttered, and she looked like she was about to die in the next moment, making Jie Yi, who was beside her, a little panicked.
She was afraid that “Lu Bai” would suddenly fall beside her.
In that case, it would make it seem like she was here to “assassinate” Lu Bai.
“Is that so?” Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court forced a smile and said, “However, I have to remind you in advance that although the Phoenix Mystic Realm is also an unsolved mystic realm, it’s still fundamentally different from other ruins.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu said. “Please elaborate.”
“My teacher has done sufficient research on this mystic realm. In this mystic realm, only humans with special phoenix bloodlines have any hope of communicating. It can be said that people of mixed blood are the key to cracking the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
“Other methods can’t cause any changes in the Phoenix Mystic Realm, so compared to wasting too much time on the Phoenix Mystic Realm, my suggestion is that under my lead, we visit the Phoenix God Shrine and Phoenix Mountain more. The scenery here is still very beautiful,” the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi said.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
It was similar to what he had learned.
The Undying Dark Phoenix also said that Chi Tong’s bloodline was the key to opening the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
As for Chi Tong’s power, it was essentially a hybrid of a human and a phoenix. Although it was a heroic spirit now, the nature of its power would not change.
“Is there anything special over there?” Shi Yu asked again.
“Of course,” Jie Yi said. “On Phoenix Mountain, hundreds of phoenixes dance together. It’s filled with rich Mythical colors. It’s the most unique of the new shrines on the seven islands.”
“These are all pets of the witches in the shrine.”

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - Phoenix Shrine (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Phoenix Shrine (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Apart from that, the spiritual plants on the mountain are also unique. They’re rare in the outside world.”
Shi Yu said, “I heard that the witches of the Phoenix Shrine are all mixed-blood?”
He had been curious about this for a long time. Even in Dong Huang, apart from Mu Huiyin and the empress, he had never heard of anyone being a phoenix hybrid.
Why were there so many on the seven islands?
Could it be that the hybrid faction of the Phoenix Race escaped from Dong Huang to the seven islands?
This was also a possibility.
Dong Huang’s geographical area was incomparably vast, many times larger than the seven islands. As for Dong Huang, it was the center of the totem battle in ancient times and a place to fight for. Therefore, at that time, in order to leave the center of the war, many Beast Tamers fled to relatively barren and peaceful places.
Not far away, Old Ke was researching this. The Dong Huang bloodline was distributed in the dozen or so totem countries near Dong Huang.
Therefore, it was completely possible for a portion of the Phoenix Race to escape to other countries during the internal strife of the Phoenix Race.
“Yes. They’re all the same as me. The difference is just the density of their bloodlines and their compatibility with the Phoenix bloodline,” the Phoenix Court said.
“At that time, after my teacher came out of the Phoenix Mystic Realm, she began to study how to increase the purity of her Phoenix bloodline. After ten years of hard work, she developed a resource called the Phoenix Fruit. This fruit can not only give a specific human Phoenix bloodline and make it a hybrid, but it can also strengthen the bloodline concentration of the Phoenix species pets. The entire Phoenix God Society was built relying on the special resource, the Phoenix Fruit.”
These were not secrets. She told Shi Yu bit by bit, making Shi Yu’s expression change slightly.
Phoenix Fruit?!
“There’s such a resource?” Shi Yu found it very unbelievable.
Back then, the information obtained by the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others didn’t mention such a thing.
“This is the fruit of Teacher’s hard work, but unfortunately, after creating countless keys through the Phoenix Fruit, the Phoenix Divine Society still can’t crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm,” the Phoenix Court said. “Although, it has cultivated many outstanding mixed-blood Beast Tamers.”
She smiled and said, “If it weren’t for Teacher, I would never have such achievements, let alone reach level seven at this age through the Phoenix bloodline.”
“Senior of the Phoenix Court is really impressive…” Shi Yu said.
If this were Dong Huang, this person could at least get a high position in Bureau 12!
Bureau 12, hybrid bureau!
In Dong Huang, there were many mixed-blood Beast Tamer families.
Apart from some Beast Tamers with rare bloodlines, those who could join this bureau were basically the patriarchs of some mixed-blood families or successors with extremely high potential. For example, Ning Tianming was the heir of a large family.
Their status in the hybrid world was important, and they were a very important part of Dong Huang’s Beast Taming power.
However, until now, apart from normal reproduction, Dong Huang had no stable way to create mixed-blood Beast Tamers.
The Phoenix Fruit developed by the owner of this Phoenix Shrine could actually steadily create Beast Tamers with the Phoenix bloodline in batches?
No matter how weak the bloodline was, mixed blood still had a certain advantage over ordinary Beast Tamers!
[I can let Baby Ginseng and Ling study it someday. They can even develop strange things like the Soul Heart Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit. There’s no reason why they can’t develop the hybrid fruit…]
[At that time, I might be able to use this research result to enter Bureau 12 and take a look.]
Shi Yu muttered to himself.
“Why, are you very interested in the Phoenix Fruit?” Jie Yi said.
“I’m indeed very interested. I wonder if my body can become better after becoming a hybrid…” Shi Yu coughed dryly and revealed a weak expression.
“Unfortunately,” the Phoenix Court said. “The Phoenix Fruit is only effective for women, and not on any woman. Apart from the hard condition of being a virgin, probably only one in a million people has the corresponding compatibility.”
Shi Yu: “Cough, cough, cough.”
He wanted to say: “Give me the fruit cultivation method. I’ll help you study and optimize it!”
He trembled in anger. When could the male Beast Tamer stand up?
Men could also have the Phoenix bloodline!
If Shi Yu wanted to, he could let Chi Tong transform him into a hybrid through max-level possession.
However, Shi Yu was afraid that something bad would happen to his body, such as his entire body being covered in red feathers, causing his later years to be inauspicious, so he didn’t have this thought.
In short, let Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and Ling study the fruit… Perhaps it could really be optimized!
“That’s a pity,” Shi Yu said.
“But maybe in the future, the Phoenix God Shrine can develop a way to make men become Phoenix Race hybrids.” Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court smiled and said, “If you still have any thoughts at that time, you can come and find me.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled.
“By the way.” Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court looked at Shi Yu and said, “This time, apart from showing you around the Phoenix God Society, I also want to fight a Beast Taming Battle with you. It can be considered a response to the missions of those higher-ups.”
“Battle?” Shi Yu said. “What you’re talking about shouldn’t be a simple battle, right…”
“Yes, there’s a bet.”
“If I win, you’ll date me.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu immediately grabbed the railing and said, “Then I’m sorry. After becoming a Beast Tamer, I’ve never lost a battle. I won’t lose.”

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - Phoenix Shrine (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Phoenix Shrine (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Besides, what if I win?” Shi Yu asked.
The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi smiled. “If you don’t mind, I can also date you if you win.”
Shi Yu said, “I’m still more interested in the Phoenix Fruit. If I win, can you give me one?”
Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi: “?”
So he was really interested in the Phoenix Fruit?
She was silent for a moment. “Only teacher has the right to handle the Phoenix Fruit. If she agrees, it’s fine.”
Shi Yu said, “But speaking of which, according to what I know, the shrines on the seven islands should be the residences of various legendary Mythical creatures or the guardians of the seven islands… The Phoenix God Shrine established by your teacher enshrines and sacrifices…”
“Of course it’s the founder of this Phoenix Mystic Realm, the owner of this place,” Jie Yi said. “Teacher said that this mystic realm changed her fate. If not for this mystic realm, she would already be a dead person. In that case, she’s willing to worship the owner of the mystic realm as a guardian.”
More than ten years ago, no, even now, some rural areas of the seven countries were still very feudal.
The founder of the Phoenix Divine Temple, the legend of the seven islands, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court, came from a feudal countryside. At that time, this place had yet to change from the thoughts of the totem era.
They felt that they needed to carry out a “life sacrifice” to the gods every once in a while to obtain peace.
At that time, Ji Xiang and her pet from the Phoenix Court were the targets to be burned alive and sacrificed.
Because she didn’t want to die, Ji Xiang chose to escape.
At that time, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court was only a Beast Tamer intern. The outside world was incomparably dangerous, and ferocious beasts were everywhere. She was already mentally prepared to die in the mouth of ferocious beasts during her escape.
However, the truth was that as a Beast Tamer intern, she accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm during her escape and awakened her bloodline.
With this opportunity, she and her pet changed their fate. In just ten years, they became legends whose names shook the seven islands.
After that, in order to protect and explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm, she established the Phoenix Divine Society.
She had also changed her original surname to her current surname, Phoenix Court.
Ji Yi of the Phoenix Court knew this and knew her teacher’s experience, so she also sincerely protected the Phoenix Mystic Realm. However, although she was a teacher, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court was actually not much older than the group of witches of the Phoenix God Society. She was only in her thirties now, comparable to Legend Xiao Shuang of Dong Huang.
“Unfortunately, due to the serious break in the history of the seven islands, the origin of this mystic realm is already impossible to determine,” said Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court with a shake of her head.
Being unable to know the history of the Phoenix Mystic Realm had always been a knot in the Phoenix Court legend.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
Therefore, the one they worshiped was indeed the Undying Dark Phoenix.
If the Undying Dark Phoenix knew that it had accidentally obtained a large number of believers, who knew what it would think…
“I hope that through our offerings, the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm can appear one day,” the Phoenix Court said. “Through the power of faith.”
“That day will come…” Shi Yu was silent.
If the prophecy of the owl was accurate enough, one day… Chi Tong would probably break open the seal of the Undying Dark Phoenix.
However… there were actually believers of the Undying Dark Phoenix on the seven islands. This was a dangerous sign. Fortunately, there weren’t many believers.
The power of faith, this power, really existed.
No one knew the first creature to collect the power of faith, but many totems could be created to strengthen their skills through the power of faith. This was also why some totems had to establish countries and fight for territories and citizens.
Becoming a god through the power of faith was also a very widespread legend.
Although many powerful totems disdained this, such as Yun An, who completely relied on strength to attain the Dao, it was undeniable that this was also a path to become stronger. For example, the fox gods of the Heavenly Fox Nation around Dong Huang were totems that mainly collected the power of faith.
Even the legendary emperors of Dong Huang had studied the power of faith.
Even some transcendent creatures were born from the power of faith. For example, the Blue Sea Sprite was a combination of the power of faith and the power of the sea.
Therefore, this was also the third high-level ability that could be studied apart from optimizing races and creating skills.
If the Undying Dark Phoenix could also collect the power of faith to become stronger… Wouldn’t this Phoenix God Society be helping the Undying Dark Phoenix break through the seal in disguise?
No… He had to think of a way to break the power of faith of the Undying Dark Phoenix!

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - Yun An and the Dragon Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Yun An and the Dragon Palace Environmental Protection Department
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The destination of the Dong Huang exchange team, Red God Island.
There weren’t many legendary factions on this island. There were only five.
The Phoenix Shrine was one of the new legendary factions.
Apart from that, there was also a relatively new legendary faction, the Ke Yuan Financial Group.
This was a technological faction. It involved many industries such as medicine, healing, life engineering, and biological modification, including many top-secret plans that couldn’t be made public…
….
The huge ship from Heavenly Rainbow Island to Red God Island slowly approached the shore. Shi Yu looked at the huge island in front of him that was like a continent and was already prepared to fight.
However, just as he was getting closer and closer to the island, he suddenly sensed something and was slightly stunned.
“This wave is…”
After being stunned for a moment, Shi Yu asked the gem cat to use its clone to investigate the situation.
At the same time.
Somewhere in the depths of the sea area of the Red God Island, a group of hidden sea creatures was on standby.
Among this group of sea creatures, there were two overlords and more than ten monarchs. They basically had spatial, spiritual, and undead attributes. Their lineup was incomparably luxurious. If they worked together, they could instantly cause a huge and nasty impact on the Red God Island.
However, this group of sea creatures hid very well. The investigation methods of the Seven Islands couldn’t discover their traces.
This group of sea creatures also thought that they had hidden very well. They dived into the dark deep sea to rest and didn’t notice that a totem clone was approaching them.
At this moment, a light suddenly shocked them, making them feel as if they were facing a great enemy.
Impossible!
How could they be discovered!
“Cat, cat, it’s a cat, there’s a cat in the sea!!!” After an instant of observation, they were even more shocked. This was because in this dark and deep sea, a cat with bright eyes that illuminated the deep sea suddenly appeared in front of them!!
After the shock, they were calm. The hearts of these sea creatures suddenly stopped, because why did this cat feel a little familiar?
“Vice, Vice Minister?!!”
The leader of the ocean overlords widened its eyes.
“Hi!!”
The gem cat looked at these hidden sea beasts strangely. If it weren’t for Buggy sensing the phantom fluctuations it created through the environmental badge, they really wouldn’t have discovered these guys.
Yes, the group of sea beasts hidden near the Red God Island were members of the Marine Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City!
The Ice Dragon Badge they carried was the most important thing that Shi Yu could instantly sense their movements. As long as it reached a certain range, Buggy could sense the illusion it had created, and inside the Ice Dragon Badge was the Ice Dragon Phantom created by Buggy.
Through this ability, in times of crisis, Buggy could also call the members of the Environmental Protection Department who carried badges within a certain range to save them.
It could be said that Shi Yu had this plan when he created the badge.
Otherwise, wouldn’t it be very boring to lead such a group of overlords but not be able to use them?
Therefore, although these sea beasts hid very well, they were still instantly discovered because they were holding Buggy’s locator.
“What are you guys doing here?”
“We… we’re on a mission,” the spatial jellyfish overlord in the lead said.
Mission…
The gem cat was stunned for a moment and said, “Could it be that it’s investigating the Poison Dragon Totem that invaded the sea area of Dragon Palace City a few months ago??”
“That’s right!!!” The Space Jellyfish overlord cried and said, “But why don’t you know anything about the mission of the Environmental Protection Department, Deputy Minister?”
The gem cat : “…”
It wasn’t just it.
Their minister probably didn’t know.
“Then did you… find out anything?” the gem cat asked.
The Space Jellyfish overlord’s expression was serious as it said, “The birth of the Poison Dragon Totem might be related to a faction called the Ke Yuan Financial Group on the Seven Islands. The Poison Dragon Totem is an experimental subject of their biological modification experiment. A few months ago, an unknown experimental base of the Ke Yuan Financial Group was destroyed. The experimental subject defected. This experimental subject that defected can basically be determined to be the predecessor of the Poison Dragon Totem, the Poison Dragon overlord.”
“In addition, we’ve also obtained some evidence of other secret experiments on the Ke Yuan Financial Group. We’ve already gotten others to send it to Dragon Palace City. We’re all on standby here.”
“But according to the investigation, the core figure of this Ke Yuan Financial Group seems to have slipped away a few months ago…”
“Ahhh?” The gem cat’s expression became serious and fierce.
The Poison Dragon Totem was indeed related to the Seven Islands?
It smelled a big event.
It would be fine if it was just biological modification. Which country had not done it?
However, the biological modification on the Poison Dragon Totem was not simple!
The power fluctuations on its body came from Yun An!
King of totems, demigod Yun An, a powerful extraterrestrial creature that had once forced Emperor Wu to a dead end!
Not only was Dragon Palace City investigating, but Dong Huang was also investigating the Poison Dragon Totem for the clues behind Yun An.
Now, they actually found out something?
What was the relationship between this Seven Islands Science and Technology Financial Group and Yun An?
It could already imagine how Dragon Palace City would use the excuse to start extorting the Seven Islands after receiving the news.
It could already imagine what Dong Huang would do after learning that Yun An might be related to the Seven Islands.
“However, what do you mean the core figure slipped away??”
“Tell me everything about the investigation,” the gem cat said quickly.
The Space Jellyfish Overlord said, “We suspect that this Ke Yuan Financial Group of the Seven Islands has colluded with the totem faction…”
….
On the huge ship that arrived at the Red God Island, Shi Yu synchronized the information through the gem cat’s main body. His mood and expression became more and more serious.
He didn’t know if it was a good thing or a bad thing…
“We’re finally here.” Zheng Hai stretched. Red God Island!
“Yes.” Senior Ke Yingzong smiled and nodded.
He had been looking forward to the Phoenix Mystic Realm for a long time.
Although he had also explored many mystic realms in his country, they weren’t as fragrant as other ruins mystic realms.
The grass was always greener on the other side…!
“The Phoenix God Shrine is located in a remote place. Next, let me lead you to the Phoenix God Shrine,” Jie Yi said to the three Beast Tamers of Dong Huang.
“My teacher’s already waiting for you all, Senior Ke.”
“Teacher wants to know more about the Phoenix Race from you, Senior Ke.”
The founder of the Phoenix God Society, Ji Xiang, was very interested in the Phoenix Race because she was a hybrid. The one who studied the Phoenix Race the most was Dong Huang, because since the totem era, dragons and phoenixes had been the supreme totems of the Dong Huang Continent.
The worship of dragons and phoenixes was far greater than that of other countries. Of course, before other countries left the control of the totems, they also had their own supreme faith. For example, Xue Yuan worshiped bears.
“This…” Senior Ke Yingzong said,” I indeed have some new archeological discoveries here, but unfortunately, I can’t confirm it yet. The one who discovered it wasn’t me, but another archeologist from our Dong Huang. ”
“Shi Yu.”
“Brother Shi Yu?” Beside him, Zheng Hai was surprised. Then, he said, “That’s true.”
Shi Yu’s Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit was related to the Phoenix Race. It was a hybrid. He believed that Shi Yu had studied the Phoenix Race.
“Ah, Shi Yu.” Shi Yu also said from the side, revealing a curious expression.
“I’ve heard of this name. He’s the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang, a genius archeologist,” the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi said.
With that said, she looked at Lu Bai, wondering who was stronger between Lu Bai and Shi Yu.
‘Lu Bai’ had a calm expression and smiled. “That person is indeed powerful.”
“Has Brother Lu Bai interacted with Shi Yu??” Zheng Hai asked curiously. In his opinion, these two people were super geniuses.
“Not yet, but I’ve heard of it long ago. When I return this time, I should challenge him and see how powerful the number one person below the legendary level in Dong Huang is,” Shi Yu said calmly.
He challenged himself.
The number one person below the legendary level, Shi Yu, vs the hidden genius, Lu Bai, who had swept through the Seven Islands!
The outcome might depend on whether Susu could defeat Eleven at the moment.
At the side, the corners of Senior Ke’s mouth twitched. This guy was really addicted to playing this role.
He had reason to suspect that he wanted to occupy two Sequence positions and cheat more resources!
“Really?” Upon hearing that Lu Bai wanted to challenge Shi Yu, Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court revealed an interested expression and said, “But before that, I hope Lu Baijun can fight a battle with me without any regrets.”
Shi Yu covered his mouth and continued to cough dryly. His face was pale as he said, “Of course.”
Naturally, he had to negotiate with the legend of the Phoenix Court first before fighting.
He didn’t want to fight a meaningless battle.
However, no matter how many times Shi Yu repeated the title Phoenix Court Legend, he kept feeling that it was strange. He felt like he was singing the name.
Something like ‘The mystic realm of the Seven Islands is my love~ The ground under the ancient ruins is cracking~’

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - Secret Art of Time (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Secret Art of Time (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Phoenix Shrine was located on a remote mountain in the depths of the Red God Island. This was a fiery red mountain. From afar, the mountain was filled with fiery red spiritual plants. It was beautiful.
Shi Yu and the others ascended the steps. After a complicated etiquette, they entered the Phoenix God Shrine. At this moment, Chi Tong, who was in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, sensed the fluctuations of the mystic realm just like how Buggy sensed its illusion previously.
Chi Tong, Shi Yu: o(〃’▽’〃)o
The Undying Dark Phoenix was right.
There was really an inheritance!
Shi Yu’s mood immediately improved.
However, perhaps because of the special situation today, there were no people from the Phoenix God Shrine who came to pray. The interior was very cold.
“Senior Jie Yi, distinguished guests.”
As Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court led Shi Yu and the other two to the divine temple, a woman who was also wearing a red and white witch dress walked forward. She was about twelve or thirteen years old and looked very young. She raised her head and said, “This way, please. The Divine Master is waiting.”
“I understand.” Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court smiled at the young witch and said, “Everyone, please follow me.”
Ke Yingzong, Zheng Hai, and Shi Yu nodded.
Soon, Shi Yu and the others were brought to an ancient house. In the house, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court had already made tea and was waiting for the arrival of the guests.
She was a legendary Beast Tamer in her thirties. She wore a pure white feather sweater over her white and red kimono. Her orange-red long hair naturally fell. From the outside, she didn’t look much older than Jie Yi from the Phoenix Court. However, the aura emitted from his body instantly made Ke Yingzong, Zheng Hai, Shi Yu, and the others’ hearts freeze.
They felt that what existed in front of them was an overlord-level ferocious beast.
This was a powerful pressure unique to high-level mixed-blood Beast Tamers.
In Dong Huang’s team, although Ning Tianming had already started to emit pressure, compared to this legendary Divine Master of the Phoenix Divine Shrine, he was still a child in comparison.
“Welcome, esteemed guests.”
After the legendary Divine Master of the Phoenix Shrine got up to welcome him, she smiled calmly and said,
“I’m the Divine Master of the Phoenix Divine Society, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court.”
“Legend of the Phoenix Court. Hello, I’m the legendary archeologist of Dong Huang, Ke Yingzong,” Ke Yingzong replied.
“Zun Hai, quasi legendary Beast Tamer of Dong Huang.”
“Top-notch Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Lu Bai.”
Shi Yu and the others also introduced themselves one by one. Ji Xiang’s gaze swept past the few of them one by one. Then, it stopped on Shi Yu for a while and her heart skipped a beat.
She didn’t feel threatened from the legendary Beast Tamer Ke Yingzong or the disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, but this sickly Lu Bai made Ji Xiang feel strange.
As a wild beast, if she was a Phoenix Bird soaring through the sky, then the “Lu Bai” in front of her was a giant with a body comparable to a mountain and extraordinary strength that could pluck stars and grab the moon and reach her.
How was this possible…
He clearly looked like a sickly young man, but the pressure was even stronger than those titled legends…
This pressure was not related to the strength of the Beast Tamer. It was purely produced by the Beast Tamer’s bloodline, physique, spirit, and will.
After being slightly surprised, Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court calmed down and said, “I’ve long heard of your names. Please take a seat first. Jie Yi, you sit too.”
“Yes, Teacher.”
Soon, the five of them started talking. The host, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court, was the first to start the topic. “Legend Ke should be here for the ‘Phoenix Mystic Realm’, right? I’ve also heard of the bet agreement on the path of champion. I wonder why Legend Ke and the others chose this ruin?”
At the side, Jie Yi from the Phoenix Court immediately became reserved…
“This… I heard it from ‘Lu Bai’. In addition, the dragon and phoenix have been the representative totems of Dong Huang since ancient times, so I’m naturally a little interested,” Ke Chuanqi said.
Ji Xiang looked at Lu Bai.
Shi Yu said, “Eh, wasn’t it you, the legend of the Phoenix Court, who invited us to explore?”
Shi Yu put the little witch on the spot.
Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court looked at Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court.
“…” Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court was silent.
This, this, this, wasn’t this because Teacher had the higher-ups of the association asking her to come into contact with this “Lu Bai”? Wasn’t she just trying her best to make him interested?
Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court pondered for a moment and quickly understood the cause and effect.
In the end, she looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu revealed his sharpness. The Seven Islands Association had taken a fancy to Shi Yu’s potential and hoped to keep him here. Even if they couldn’t keep Shi Yu here, they could let him have a few more children on the Seven Islands. It would be good if they could inherit Shi Yu’s mysterious “Beast Taming Talent”.
Among them, the first and first choice to come into contact with Shi Yu was the Phoenix Court.
Even Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court felt that this was nothing. Although the strength of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi was not bad, she had already judged that it was not the key to open the Phoenix Mystic Realm. Therefore, compared to the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi, the Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang looked forward to what changes the child of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi could bring.
After all, bloodlines could also be passed down through reproduction. If one party’s bloodline was outstanding enough, it might even optimize the other party’s bloodline. The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi and “Lu Bai” were undoubtedly very outstanding. The Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang didn’t care about nationality or anything. She only cared if both parties had enough outstanding bloodlines to give birth to a child who could become the key to the Phoenix Mystic Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - Secret Art of Time (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Secret Art of Time (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Therefore, when the higher-ups of the Seven Islands looked for the Phoenix God Shrine, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court was not in a hurry to refuse. Instead, she fought for the opinion of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi. The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi was not a weakling anymore. This kind of thing naturally should be taken into consideration by Jie Yi herself. Fortunately, the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi was also interested in the strong.
However, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court didn’t expect that this girl would use the Phoenix Mystic Realm as a date venue and bait him.
“Forget it, this isn’t important. I also have some questions I want to ask Legend Ke.” Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court shook her head. In any case, in her opinion, it was impossible for this group of people to crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
After she became a legend, she went to various places to train, including the seven countries and the totem country. According to what she knew, in the seven countries, their Phoenix Divine Society was the only one with mixed blood. Therefore, the only possibility of cracking the Phoenix Mystic Realm was still on them.
Although Dong Huang used dragons and phoenixes as totems, it was mainly hybrids of humans and dragons. They were known as the successors of dragons, but no one was a phoenix hybrid.
“What?” Ke Yingzong felt that it should be about the Phoenix Race.
“According to what I know, although Dong Huang doesn’t have the mixed blood of the Phoenix Race anymore, in ancient times, that legendary Beast Tamer known as the empress was a mixed blood of the Phoenix Race. Therefore, I want to ask Legend Ke if he knows the related origin of the mixed blood of the Phoenix.”
“I know that.” Before Senior Ke Yingzong could answer, Shi Yu answered first, making Ji Xiang look at Shi Yu in surprise.
Shi Yu said, “I’ve only heard of it, but I don’t know its accuracy.”
“Tell me about it.”
Shi Yu said, “More than two thousand years ago, the development of the Phoenix Race fell into a certain bottleneck. A voice appeared in the Phoenix Race. The power of the bloodline is about to be given to some humans with suitable physiques to break this bottleneck with humans with the Phoenix bloodline.”
“However, because the growth of hybrids requires too many resources and the Phoenix Race has many members who pursue the purity of their bloodline, two factions have been divided in the race.”
“One side supports the hybrid human plan, while the other side firmly opposes humans sharing the resources of the Phoenix Race. From this, the Phoenix Race’s internal strife was born. Many mixed-blood humans were chased by the purebloods. Some died, and others escaped.”
“The internal strife lasted for thousands of years. In the end, the hybrid faction gained the upper hand. The Empress of Dong Huang was said to be the strongest among the mixed-blood Beast Tamers at that time, and the origin of the Phoenix Race’s mixed-blood was also Dong Huang. If Senior Phoenix Court is curious about your identity, you might be able to go to Dong Huang in the future to take a look too.”
“Perhaps your ancestor was the Dong Huang person who escaped from the Phoenix Race’s internal strife back then,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
After he finished speaking, Senior Ke, who was beside him, exclaimed was shocked. This guy was just starting off with that right off the bat?
He didn’t just want to take away the mystic realm, right? He also wanted to move the entire Phoenix God Society to Dong Huang!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Ji Xiang’s expression changed. She didn’t expect that she could really obtain some secrets from the Dong Huang people that she didn’t know before. However, just as Shi Yu had said, even he didn’t know if this was true or false. Ji Xiang didn’t immediately believe it.
At the side, Jie Yi from the Phoenix Court also opened her mouth slightly. “Lu Bai” said that Teacher’s ancestor might be from Dong Huang?
“Is this Dong Huang’s archeological discovery?” Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court asked. “You can’t determine the accuracy because there’s no evidence?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “There’s no conclusive evidence.”
“But actually, the discoverer himself is decisive evidence. The Beast Tamer who discovered this secret is said to be the genius archeologist of Dong Huang, Shi Yu. He has already made several epoch-making archeological discoveries in Dong Huang. With his qualifications, the authenticity of this statement should be very high.”
“Shi Yu…” It wasn’t the first time Ji Xiang had heard this name.
“Did Shi Yu discover this too??” Beside him, Zheng Hai was very shocked. But soon, he came to a realization and said, “Yes, the heroic spirit contracted by Brother Shi Yu, General Mu Huiyin, is also a hybrid of a human and a phoenix. It’s not strange for him to know some inside information.”
“Mu Huiyin, heroic spirit? What’s that?” Ji Xiang asked.
Although the higher-ups of the Seven Islands Association had investigated Shi Yu, Ji Xiang didn’t know much about him.
Therefore, the saying that Dong Huang didn’t have mixed blood now was actually an old version.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s said that the fourth pet of Shi Yu, the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, is a heroic spirit formed by an ancient sage. That sage is also a hybrid of a human and a phoenix.”
Ji Xiang was stunned. So, there was a hybrid in Dong Huang now?
Soon, she shook her head. It didn’t mean much. Not every hybrid was related to the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
There were so many mixed-blood Beast Tamers in the Phoenix Divine Society, but they still couldn’t open the mystic realm.
Moreover, they had already turned into undead. They shouldn’t have any bloodline concept anymore.
She looked at Shi Yu and said, “You know this Shi Yu very well.”
Shi Yu said, “With his reputation in Dong Huang, everyone should know him. It can be said that the younger generation of Dong Huang lives under his light.”
Zheng Hai: !
The corners of Old Master Ke Yingzong’s mouth twitched crazily. Was this f*cking guy done? His alternate identity was about to fall, fall!!
What Old Master Ke didn’t know was that Shi Yu no longer cared about the identity at this moment because he already had a premonition that the relationship between the Red God Island, or rather, the Seven Islands, would immediately become tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - Secret Art of Time (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Secret Art of Time (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The legendary faction of the Seven Islands was studying Yun An… This kind of thing was clearly about to happen. Dong Huang didn’t know, but at least Dragon Palace City had long wanted to extort the Seven Islands. They just didn’t have evidence previously.
This time, the Environmental Protection Department caught the evidence and even sent it back to Dragon Palace City. If Shi Yu’s judgment was right, it shouldn’t be long before several totem-level Dragon Kings came to the Seven Islands to take a look and see if they could compensate for the loss of mental pollution.
The Seven Islands… were about to be in turmoil. Who would care about a small master like him?
He wanted to lay the foundation for Shi Yu’s information. Perhaps in the future, he would have the chance to deceive the Phoenix God Shrine into joining Dong Huang as a member of Bureau 12. After all, the other party worshiped the Undying Dark Phoenix, and he was the designated heir of the Undying Dark Phoenix!!
If the other party’s faith was sincere enough, they would split the grave to save their mother.
“Moreover… a friend I know also contracted a phoenix bloodline pet, so he’s also a little concerned about these aspects,” Shi Yu said.
“I see,” Ji Xiang said and nodded at Shi Yu. Although this Lu Bai looked a little sick, his strength and knowledge looked pretty good. He was worthy of Jie Yi.
Unfortunately, if it was the combination of Shi Yu and Jie Yi that the other party mentioned, it might be even more perfect.
But Ji Xiang also knew that that was unrealistic.
She didn’t know his strength, but in terms of talent, that Shi Yu was definitely better than Lu Bai. Jie Yi probably couldn’t come into contact with such a super genius protected by Dong Huang.
“Jie Yi, when are you guys getting married?” the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court asked.
“Pfft…” Old Ke and Zheng Hai almost spat out their tea.
“Cough.” Shi Yu himself almost choked.
Holy shit, this legend of the Phoenix Court was even more direct than this witch.
The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi also coughed and said, “Teacher, how can progress be that fast? I still have an unfinished battle with Lu Bai. If I win, he’s willing to date me.”
Ke Yingzong and Zheng Hai: ???
The two of them opened their mouths wide and looked at Shi Yu. Holy shit, did someone really seduce him?
They suspected that Shi Yu/Lu Bai would deliberately lose.
Wait, they shouldn’t even talk about whether it was intentional or not. The opponent was at least third place on the Seven Islands, a quasi legend. How could he dare to agree? Was he thinking that it wouldn’t be a loss whether he won or lost?
“Is that so?” Ji Xiang was surprised. “Then when are you preparing to fight?”
The Phoenix Court said, “Anytime, but I can’t agree to Lu Baijun’s request. His bet is that if he wins, he wants the Phoenix Fruit cultivated by the Phoenix God Society.”
Phoenix Fruit!
Upon hearing this bet, Ji Xiang’s expression immediately became serious. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “You want our Phoenix Shrine’s Phoenix Fruit?”
“It’s not like it’s something that can’t be used as a bet, but what do you want it for?”
The Phoenix Fruit was a rare spiritual fruit that she had researched for ten years with a plant-type pet with the Phoenix bloodline and her own bloodline power. It could be called an “exclusive secret manual”.
Not only could it give a specific human Phoenix bloodline, but it could also purify the racial strength of the Phoenix bloodline pet. It could be said to be the foundation of the Phoenix God Society. Even the witches here found it very difficult to obtain one.
“You probably don’t want to become a hybrid Beast Tamer yourself, right?” Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court looked at the sickly Shi Yu and said.
As long as a mixed-blood Beast Tamer could survive, their physical fitness, lifespan, and cultivation speed were a little stronger than ordinary Beast Tamers. Looking at Shi Yu’s dead appearance, it wasn’t impossible for him to have thoughts about mixed-blood bloodlines.
“How could that be?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Miss Jie Yi has already told me the conditions to become a hybrid.”
“I think if it’s because a friend of mine has a pet with the bloodline of the Phoenix, I heard that the Phoenix Fruit is a rare resource to increase the bloodline of the Phoenix Race. I want to give one to her.”
This saying was clearly more normal in everyone’s ears.
“Her?” But soon, Jie Yi discovered the blind spot.
A woman?
She used “love” as a bet, but he was thinking about another woman?
Although she originally didn’t have any emotional foundation for “Lu Bai” and only worshiped the strong, at this moment, the corners of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch. She clenched her fists and had the urge to beat Shi Yu up.
It was decided.
After defeating Shi Yu, she would date him for a day and immediately dump him to become a woman he could never have.
“Sure.” At this moment, Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court nodded and said, “Alright, if you can defeat Jie Yi, I’ll give you a Phoenix Fruit.”
“Thank you.” Shi Yu was immediately excited when he heard that.
A Phoenix Fruit…
He wondered if Ling, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng could develop a replica through research.
After researching it, he would give it to Senior Lu. If the research failed, it would be fine.
“Then let’s fight now,” the Phoenix Court said. “The rules, double, is that acceptable?”
“Double?”
“Yes,” Jie Yi said.
Although she had contracted many pets, two of them were the strongest and had the best cooperation. At the same time, her Beast Taming Talent’s current limit was to stimulate the power of both pets at the same time. Therefore, the double rule was the most beneficial rule for her.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - Secret Art of Time (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Secret Art of Time (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Since she wanted to defeat Shi Yu, he naturally had to choose the rules that were most beneficial to her.
“Sure.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Is it really alright?” Zheng Hai looked at Shi Yu. Double… He didn’t seem to know about “Lu Bai”‘s other pets apart from his ice-element pet.
Senior Ke also looked at Shi Yu and judged that Shi Yu probably wanted Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit to fight…
In the form of that “bird spirit”, it could also be said to be a “bird spirit”.
Although that form didn’t have any characteristics of a sword spirit, it actually still had some characteristics of the Phoenix Race. Was it alright…
….
As Shi Yu was going to fight the Phoenix Court, the Phoenix Shrine immediately prepared the venue.
The venue was set in the divine vision domain of the shrine. This venue was turned into a battle venue domain with a divine gaze, representing absolute fairness.
Among the witches of the Phoenix Court, Jie Yi was the one with the most outstanding experience and strength. She was the senior of all the witches here and the only one who had been accepted as a disciple by the legend of the Phoenix Court.
The fact that she was fighting an outsider in the Divine Vision Domain immediately attracted all the witches to watch the battle. This was also a tradition. The battle of the Divine Vision Domain required the witches to watch as representatives of gods.
“Ah… How nice.” In the Divine Vision domain, Zheng Hai looked at the eight Phoenix Witches around him and sighed. This Phoenix God Society was much better than his Binhai Dao Field.
If his training hall apprentices also changed from ugly fishing youths to water dancers wearing gorgeous swimsuits, their hair tied into a bun, and wearing various beautiful head accessories… The training hall might be able to have more funds for pet cultivation…
“Senior Jie Yi wants to fight…”
“I know who her opponent is. It’s that Beast Tamer from Dong Huang who passed the champion path.”
“It’s said that the Thousand River Hundred Gods, Mr. Shen Dai, and the overlord of the Crown Rainbow Mountain Range couldn’t even last one move against him…”
“Stop discussing. The Divine Master is also here. Hurry up and tidy your appearance and sitting posture.”
The group of witches whispered to each other and discussed softly. They were all mixed-blood Beast Tamers with the bloodline of the Phoenix. Their strength ranged from the trainee level in their teens to the professional level and master level in their twenties.
Coupled with the red and white witch clothes, their young and beautiful faces, as well as their red hair, white hair, red and orange eyes… They were very dazzling.
At this moment, they were extremely curious. Not only were they curious about the recently rumored Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Lu Bai, but they were also very curious about the outcome of the battle between him and Senior Jie Yi.
“Let’s begin.”
In the Divine Vision domain, the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi, who was wearing a witch suit, looked at Shi Yu calmly and took a deep breath. To be honest, the pressure Shi Yu gave her was still very high.
If she were to participate in the challenge of the path to champion, her results might not necessarily be better than Shi Yu’s. She might even lose to the ninth level and lose to the number one person below the legendary level, Shen Dai.
However, she still wanted to fight. She was betting that Shi Yu was only strong in one-on-one battles, but if he played doubles, his strength would gradually decrease. There were many such Beast Tamers who specialized in the cultivation of a certain pet, and they even only cultivated one pet. It was very common.
For example, the current legendary Valkyrie of the Seven Islands had only contracted one pet, but who could say that she wasn’t strong? One person and one pet could display the strength to crush top-notch totems. No one on the Seven Islands could defeat her.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
In the Divine Vision domain, the Divine Master Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang, Dong Huang’s Ke Yingzong, Zheng Hai, and the others were also paying attention to the battle between the two people below like those witches.
There shouldn’t be a problem…
Seeing Shi Yu’s calm appearance and Shi Yu’s previous battle results, Senior Ke and Zheng Hai nodded. There was definitely no problem!
Soon.
After looking at each other, Jie Yi directly summoned her pet!!
“I set the rules. According to tradition, I’ll send out my pet first.” Her sleeves fluttered, and a black summoning array appeared in front of her. On the array was a dazzling red light, and a fiery aura spewed out. A huge tree slowly appeared.
This was a huge tree that enveloped the arena after appearing. It was 20 meters tall. It had brown branches, green leaves, and fiery red flowers. The flames ignited by the flowers burned half the sky red. It was beautiful. In the flames, a huge red bird appeared and landed on the huge tree. Its entire body was also burning with flames. Its phoenix feathers were like flames as it stared at Shi Yu with a bright and dignified gaze.
“The leaves are the feathers of a flying phoenix, the flowers are the crown of a phoenix. My pets are the Phoenix Fire Tree and the Undying Fire Phoenix. It’s your turn.”
After summoning the two powerful monarchs, Jie Yi looked at Shi Yu calmly.
“It’s so beautiful.”
At this moment, Zheng Hai looked at the fiery red arena and the Undying Phoenix that landed on the Phoenix Fire Tree. His eyes were lit up by the flames.
“It doesn’t look like much now, but this Phoenix Court is a quasi legend. After using the Beast Taming Talent, the two pets should become very strong…” Zheng Hai analyzed.
Even if it was a strengthening talent that had never been developed, it was not difficult for a level-seven Beast Tamer to increase the pet’s energy level by ten million.
If it was some special talent, it would probably increase even more.
Moreover, Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court was a hybrid. Moreover, her pet and her bloodline were the same. Who knew what bonuses there would be?

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - Secret Art of Time (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Secret Art of Time (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Are they all pets with the Phoenix bloodline?” When Shi Yu saw this, he said regretfully, “You’ve already lost.”
“What do you mean?” As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expression of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi changed. What a joke.
Was he humiliating her?
However, in the next moment, it was indeed the Phoenix Court that was shocked and realized the life and death crisis.
No, even the expressions of the surrounding witches and the legend of the Phoenix Hall, the Divine Master of the Phoenix God Shrine, changed drastically.
A huge purple array appeared in front of Shi Yu. Then, cold air condensed in the sky.
Seeing this change, the Phoenix Court thought of the ice-element pet immediately.
The first pet Shi Yu summoned was indeed Susu.
However, it was still Susu’s mimicry!!
This time, Susu wasn’t in a humanoid form anymore. Of course, it wasn’t an Ice Slime either. Instead, through enlarging, it enlarged into the form of an Ice Phoenix that was even larger than the Phoenix Fire Tree!
The extreme cold cut through the sky filled with flames, almost freezing the entire battlefield. As the cold rose, the ice mist gradually faded, revealing a huge figure.
It had beautiful blue feathers, and its wings seemed to be made of ice.
On its head was a crown made of three dark blue prismatic ice crystal feathers, making it look like a king had descended.
As the colorful flag-shaped long tail fluttered, snow lingered, forming a confrontation with the pet summoned by the Phoenix Court.
This wasn’t the reason why everyone’s expressions changed drastically. This was just a very ordinary ice elemental mimicry. There was nothing strange about it. However, as a bird spirit wrapped in cold blue ghost flames flew out of the black summoning array, it flew and fused with the huge ice phoenix, causing its ice crystal wings, ice crystal crown, and ice tail to ignite the ice blue extreme cold flames. A terrifying deterrence erupted from the pet, shocking everyone!!
The Time Fruit was activated.
Because of possession, Chi Tong and Susu enjoyed the enhancement of the Time Fruit at the same time and arrived at the overlord level together.
It was equivalent to the overlord-level Chi Tong and the overlord-level Susu.
At the same time, due to the existence of Chi Tong’s scapegoat, the explosive burden they suffered was all borne by the scapegoat.
Boom!
Right on the heels of that, with Chi Tong’s mental strength as the main body, it reached perfection and displayed the might of a phoenix!
This was Phoenix Might.
Just like the supreme might of a dragon, the might of a phoenix was the bane of a hundred birds.
In a battle between races, the deterrence level was important. This was a decisive skill.
Just like how Xia Qingwei’s Ice Phoenix Moth couldn’t develop battle awareness when facing Buggy’s perfect-level deterrence back then.
At this moment, the deterrence level of the Phoenix Fire Tree and the Undying Fire Phoenix, which were far from transcendent, instantly constricted in the face of Chi Tong and Susu’s combination skill, revealing incomprehensible shock.
Chi Tong and Susu combined profundities.
The dignity of the Ice Phoenix King.
Boom!!!
It wasn’t just these two pets. At this moment, as Chi Tong and Susu erupted, the dignity of a king of the overlord-level Phoenix Race was revealed. Even the witches with the phoenix bloodline like Jie Yi also felt a bloodline suppression that was even more terrifying than ordinary deterrence.
In an instant, sweat flowed down the forehead of the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi before quickly freezing into ice crystals. The deterrence from her bloodline directly made her feel like she had fallen into an ice cave. Her body, spirit, will, and soul seemed to have been frozen and shattered by this Ice Phoenix King at this moment.
“Jiu!!!!!!”
Now, the Phoenix Fire Tree and the Undying Fire Phoenix, who were facing Chi Tong, Susu, and the others’ joint deterrence “bullying strategy”, didn’t even have the strength to resist before their consciousness instantly disappeared. Even at this moment, their Beast Tamers didn’t have time to use their Beast Taming Talent to increase and strengthen them.
The Phoenix bloodline indeed allowed the Phoenix Court to have talent that exceeded ordinary Beast Tamers, but it also allowed her to obtain some weaknesses that ordinary Beast Tamers didn’t have. For example, when she encountered a phoenix pet with a very high deterrence level, she would instantly lose the ability to resist and the will to fight. In nature, unless she had the will of an overlord, it was very difficult for creatures to cross this kind of suppression that came from the bloodline and level of their own race. This was also one of the reasons why Shi Yu was unwilling to become a hybrid.
Boom!!!
Under the strong deterrence, the Undying Phoenix directly fell from the sky and fell heavily to the ground. The flames ignited by the Phoenix Fire Tree also quietly extinguished, and the domain was silent.
The Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi blacked out and fell forward in shock. She half-knelt on the ground and forcefully supported her body. Her mind was incomparably confused.
How was this possible…
What happened…
She… They…
They were actually scared out of their minds by this Lu Bai’s pets’ deterrence skill?
“Jie Yi!” At this moment, the Divine Master of the Phoenix Divine Shrine, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court, suddenly stood up. At the same time, sweat flowed down her forehead. She also looked at the huge Ice Phoenix in shock and confusion. In an instant, she actually felt that her trump card, the Phoenix Pet, seemed to be only so-so in front of this Ice Phoenix.
She looked at Lu Bai in the domain in disbelief.
She suddenly understood why Mr. Shen Dai, the number one person below the legends of the Seven Islands, and that Heavenly Cloud Tiger couldn’t withstand a single move from him.
This guy was a monster.
Not only was his ice-element pet ridiculously strong, but the mysterious bird spirit just now, the bird spirit that burned with the Ice Blue Ghost Fire, was also ridiculously strong. Its strength was definitely not weak. After all… it had transcendent deterrence!! Even her pet had yet to master it.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - Secret Art of Time (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Secret Art of Time (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Moreover, that deterrence wave couldn’t be wrong. That was the Phoenix Might. Only pets with the Phoenix bloodline could show the special deterrence that countered hundreds of birds.
This guy had also contracted a pet of the Phoenix Race. Was it that ice-element pet or that bird spirit?? Could the real race of that ice-element pet be the ice-element phoenix? Could that bird spirit have been a phoenix when it was alive? For a moment, Ji Xiang was a little confused and kept guessing.
“Senior Phoenix Court, with this… I won, right?”
At this moment, in the arena, Shi Yu stretched out his hand. The Ice Phoenix King in the sky slowly shrank to the size of a sparrow that Chi Tong had when it just appeared. It landed in Shi Yu’s hand in the possession form of an ice-blue mini phoenix.
If Susu was in this state, even if it didn’t rely on assassination, it could still fight the overlord tiger head-on for a few rounds and suppress the other party during this process!
Even Eleven would probably be quickly suppressed by the Chi Su combination in this state. It couldn’t be helped. It was shameless to use the Time Fruit in a 2v1.
“You…” Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court still found it unbelievable. She only felt that Shi Yu was talking nonsense. She glanced at the half-conscious Jie Yi from the Phoenix Court and at the surrounding audience. Although they weren’t unconscious, they were seriously shocked. She felt that this Lu Bai was extremely ridiculous, because even her heart was thumping just now.
Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court looked at the disciples of Legend Ke and Tyrannical Sea Legend. What made her silent was that even the two companions of “Lu Bai” had their mouths slightly agape, as if they were very shocked by the scene in front of them.
In other words, even his companions didn’t know how strong this guy’s true strength was.
“You win…” Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court said. At the same time, she sat down again and said to the two people beside her,
“With such strength, is he really just a top-notch master?”
Even the two legendary new generation geniuses of the Seven Islands… In the opinion of Phoenix Court, she felt that they were slightly inferior to Lu Bai in that state just now.
“This…” How could Legend Ke know that Shi Yu was also so fierce? He didn’t see the energy value that erupted in an instant just now, but it definitely far exceeded ordinary overlords.
In addition, Shi Yu didn’t want to pretend anymore. This time, Shi Yu and Lu Bai both had undead with the Phoenix bloodline. What if they were associated with it? Although… The power system and undead form were still different, and the Phoenix undead wasn’t a unique pet in Dong Huang, Legend Ke still didn’t know what Shi Yu was thinking.
In fact, Shi Yu didn’t use his full strength in the battle just now. Otherwise, the mental impact could even destroy the enemy’s spirit. At this moment, only a moment later, the Phoenix Court’s owner woke up in a daze. Then, she recalled in extreme confusion. In the end, she was stunned on the spot.
She instantly recalled the scene of her and her pets falling into the other party’s deterrence without any resistance. Then, her face turned pale.
How was this possible…
She dragged her heavy spirit and looked at Shi Yu, who had retracted his pet. At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at her in embarrassment and said, “In that case, thank you for the match.”
“That’s Phoenix Might, your pet has the Phoenix bloodline. Is the friend you’re talking about yourself?” Jie Yi asked.
Perhaps there was a possibility that “Lu Bai” wanted to give the spiritual fruit to her after winning the Phoenix Fruit and give it to her as a gift to the Phoenix Court.
Shi Yu: “?”
What kind of strange focus was this?
“Hahahaha, we came at the wrong time.”
Just as the battle ended, the witches covered their foreheads with shocked expressions. Outside the Divine Vision Domain, two people slowly walked over from the outside world. At the same time, a laughing old voice sounded.
It was an old man with sunken eyes, no hair, a walking stick, and a face filled with wrinkles. Beside him was a female researcher. Like Shi Yu, she looked sick. She was wearing a white coat, her brown hair was casually scattered, and her eyes were listless. She was about 40 to 50 years old.
When Jie Yi saw the two of them, her expression changed slightly.
“President of the Island. Legend Xiao Yuan,” she said to the two.
“Hehehe… I believe these are the guests from Dong Huang, right?” The old man raised his head and looked at Shi Yu and the others. “I am Yuan Yi of Temple Island, the president of the Beast Tamer Association of Red God Island. Welcome to Red God Island.”
“Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, please don’t mind my sudden disturbance.”
Ji Xiang’s expression didn’t change. “Of course not.”
When the two of them arrived, Senior Ke Yingzong’s gaze landed on the female researcher.
The female researcher also looked at Ke Yingzong and said, “Senior Ke, long time no see.”
“Long time no see,” Ke Yingzong said in surprise.
These two people probably didn’t come just to welcome them.
The president of the Red God Island Association was a legendary Beast Tamer, and this Legend Xiao Yuan was an archeologist of the Seven Islands. He was one of the few top archeologists on the Seven Islands who had the ability to listen to the Voice of History.
On the Seven Islands, there might not be five Beast Tamers with the listening talent, so this Legend Xiao Yuan had a very high status on the Seven Islands.
As a legendary archeologist, Ke Yingzong naturally knew the other party.
“President of the Temple Island, Legend Xiao Yuan, why are you here?” the Phoenix Court Legend said.
“Hahaha.” The president of the temple island laughed and said, “Look at what you’re saying. Of course, we’re here to see our honored guests from Dong Huang. I heard that Dong Huang’s Legend Ke, the disciple of the Tyrannical Sea Legend, Zheng Hai, and the super genius, Master Lu Bai, who passed the path of the champion, are going to visit the Phoenix God Shrine. As landlords, we naturally have to visit some.”

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - Secret Art of Time (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Secret Art of Time (7)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“It’s rare for Legend Ke and the others to come over. I called Legend Xiao Yuan over to communicate. Everyone can gain more.”
“Also, from the looks of it, was there a battle just now??” The president of the island looked at “Lu Bai” and the Phoenix Court standing on the arena. Seeing that their faces were pale, he asked despite knowing the answer.
Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court chuckled in her heart. They were probably worried that Jie Yi wouldn’t act according to the mission and wouldn’t be able to keep “Lu Bai”. Probably, they were even more afraid that the Dong Huang exchange team would really obtain some benefits in the Phoenix Mystic Realm, so they came to supervise.
Although the Phoenix Mystic Realm was protected by the Phoenix Divine Palace, just like Dong Huang, the Seven Islands also had relevant rules. The ownership of the ruins mystic realm in the country belonged to the country, so the Phoenix Mystic Realm was not the personal property of the Phoenix Divine Palace. At most, the Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang could get more resources as the discoverer and guardian. Over the years, the other factions of the Seven Islands also wanted to get a share of the Phoenix Mystic Realm. Unfortunately, the Phoenix Mystic Realm was not so easy to crack.
As for the Phoenix Mystic Realm, it was also located on Red God Island. Therefore, if the mystic realm was cracked, the Red God Island Association would naturally be the greatest beneficiary. In this situation, knowing the bet between the Dong Huang exchange team and the Seven Islands Association, how could the president of the Red God Island Association sit still? He was afraid that the Dong Huang exchange team would crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm and take all the resources away, or that they couldn’t crack this and lock onto the other ruins mystic realms of the Red God Island. In that case, he didn’t know if the Phoenix Association would suffer a loss, but the Red God Island Association would suffer a huge loss.
He had to think of a way to lure them to other islands!
“Lu Bai and Jie Yi fought, but from the outcome, it seems Jie Yi’s cultivation isn’t good enough,” Ji Xiang said.
Below, Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court also didn’t expect the difference between her and Lu Bai to be so huge, to the point where it was unimaginable.
Unless her pet broke through to overlord as soon as possible, she might not be able to cross this gap.
“Did Jie Yi lose?” The president of the island was silent.
“But from the looks of it, Dong Huang’s guest hasn’t started exploring the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu looked at the old man, wanting to see what he was saying.
President Shi said, “There’s nothing to explore in this lousy mystic realm.”
Ji Xiang and Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court: ???
“It’s almost been studied by the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court. One needs to have ‘mixed blood’ to be qualified to cause changes in the mystic realm. Moreover, it’s only a mere change. It’s very difficult to crack it. It requires a very high concentration of bloodline. I’m afraid it’s already difficult to achieve in this era. I know that there’s an unsolved legendary ruin on Star Sea Island with a long history. Its exploration value is extremely high.”
“Legend Xiao Yuan beside me has explored that place before. She might be able to give you some advice.”
Shi Yu, Legend Ke, and Zheng Hai : “…”
This old man was very bad.
Wasn’t it just because they didn’t want them to explore the ruins mystic realm on Red God Island? It was too obvious!
Legend Xiao Yuan pushed up her glasses. To be honest, she didn’t want these guys from Dong Huang to obtain benefits from any of the Seven Islands’ ruins. It was the same for Red God and Xingye.
If the ruins and mystic realm of the Seven Islands were dug away by the archeologists of Dong Huang, she was very worried that she would do something rash.
“By the way.” Suddenly, Shi Yu in the crowd said, “The Phoenix Mystic Realm should be in the back mountain of the divine temple, right?”
“What’s wrong?” Legend Xiao Yuan looked at this beautiful young man with hair, pale face, and weak tone. She wanted to punch him to see if he could fall.
This was Dong Huang’s genius who had swept away the path of champion.
The world was really big, and there were all kinds of strange things.
“When I was fighting just now, I seemed to feel that something was calling to me. It seemed to be the Phoenix Mystic Realm. The bet agreement has already taken effect, and the time has already started. If I crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm, the resources inside will all be mine, right?” Shi Yu pretended to be in deep thought. With one hand as a palm and the other as a fist, he patted gently and looked up.
Phoenix Court Ji Xiang, Phoenix Court Jie Yi, the many witches, the president of Temple Island, Legend Xiao Yuan: ???
What did he say? Did he faint from exhaustion? What was he thinking? The mystic realm was calling him?
Senior Ke widened his eyes. Was it coming? Had he sensed it?! That secret time power history thing?
Zheng Hai blinked, confused.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - One Mythical, Two Legendaries (!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: One Mythical, Two Legendaries (!)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
