Atlas Studios
Shi Yu suddenly spoke, making everyone look at him.
The Phoenix Mystic Realm was calling him?
What a joke!
“What do you mean?”
The Divine Master of the Phoenix Court stood on the high platform with a burning gaze.
Legend Xiao Yuan, an archeologist from the Seven Islands, also frowned and looked at Shi Yu.
What nonsense was this guy talking about?
Did he think he had a listening talent? The mystic realm was calling it?
“What did you hear?” Legend Xiao Yuan asked.
“It’s also possible that I’m dizzy from exhaustion. I got a little absent-minded.” Shi Yu shook his head slightly.
To be precise, it seemed to be calling Chi Tong.
After sending Chi Tong out to fight just now, the mystic realm in front was even more attractive to Chi Tong.
This attraction, in Chi Tong’s strange metaphor, seemed to be like that show “Little Tiger Returning Home”, or “The Temptation to Go Home”.
In any case, there was definitely something from the bloodline that attracted Chi Tong in the mystic realm.
Everyone : “…”
“Senior Phoenix Court, I won the battle, right?”
At this moment, Shi Yu stopped thinking about the mystic realm and repeated the battle results.
Upon hearing Shi Yu repeat it a second time, Ji Xiang’s expression darkened.
There was no need to repeat it so many times!
“I understand.”
Ji Xiang immediately understood what Shi Yu meant and waved at Shi Yu with an unfriendly expression.
In the next moment, a Phoenix Fruit in her spatial equipment, a special fruit that looked like a Phoenix Pear but had red skin and leaves, flew towards Shi Yu.
Shi Yu directly raised his arm and caught the Phoenix Pear… Phoenix Fruit with one hand. He scanned it through the third index, which was the invisible lens in his eyes.
There was no information.
However, it could be judged by the energy level. It was a level-seven resource.
It was filled with the power of fire.
Even if she wanted to give it the Phoenix bloodline, she would probably make it to the Fire Phoenix bloodline, just like the Phoenix Court, so she was a fire-element pet.
At the same time, even if it could increase the strength of the phoenix pet bloodline, it had to be from the fire-element phoenix race.
As for Senior Lu’s Green Phoenix, it was wind-element. It looked like if she couldn’t develop a mutation, it was useless.
For Chi Tong, there was no need for this thing. After all, Chi Tong’s bloodline was top-notch even in the Phoenix Race.
Apart from divine-level bloodlines, Chi Tong’s bloodline was the highest level. This thing naturally couldn’t have any effect on Chi Tong.
“This is…”
At this moment, the president of the Red God Association and Legend Xiao Yuan, who he had invited, were immediately stunned when they saw the fruit in Shi Yu’s hand.
He quickly understood that there was most likely a bet in the battle just now.
As for the winning item of Shi Yu’s battle, it was the core resource of the Phoenix God Shrine, the Phoenix Fruit.
[Lost again…] At this moment, after confirming that the number three of the Seven Islands World Tournament had also lost to “Lu Bai”, the president of the island and Legend Xiao Yuan were a little silent.
Although this was very normal. After all, if they fought with all their might, the Phoenix Court Jie Yi might not necessarily win against the Demon Blade God Generation, but battles couldn’t be generalized like this. After all, fire countered ice. It was very normal for different Beast Tamers to have different wins and losses.
And now, apart from the two legendary contestants of the Seven Islands, “Lu Bai” had tortured both the older and new generations. This was undoubtedly a huge blow to the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands.
“Thank you, I’ll take it.” At this moment, Shi Yu smiled. He directly put away the Phoenix Fruit through the ruins space. With his current trump cards, he didn’t mind showing his spatial equipment.
At the same time, he looked in the direction of the back mountain of the Phoenix Shrine and said, “Next, can we take a look over there?”
“I keep feeling that there’s something I care about.”
“Next, we want to take a look at the Phoenix Mystic Realm,” Ke Yingzong said.
Regarding this request, the president of the temple island, Legend Xiao Yuan, and the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court were silent.
Usually, they were naturally unwilling to let outsiders explore the unsolved mystic realm protected by the Seven Islands.
However, the Seven Islands Association and the Dong Huang Association had signed a bet contract. At this moment, they had no right to stop Dong Huang from exploring the ruins mystic realm of the Seven Islands.
“Of course,” the Phoenix Court God said.
“He really won’t give up until the end,” the president of the island said with a headache.
Damn Dong Huang, obediently go to the next island and explore any other island.
Although he didn’t think that the Dong Huang exchange team could crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm, President Shi was still unhappy.
It was as if his girlfriend was being peeked at.
“Jiyi, prepare to enter the Divine Realm,” Ji Xiang said.
“Yes, Teacher.” At this moment, Jie Yi had already recovered from the deterrence. Her mind gradually calmed down, but she still felt a lingering fear as she looked at Shi Yu with a complicated expression.
This “Lu Bai” was stronger and much more terrifying than she imagined.
He had more than one legendary powerful pet. Apart from the legendary ice-element pet, he also had at least one other pet that was very terrifying and could fight against overlords.
At this moment, Jie Yi understood why the higher-ups and teachers of the Seven Islands wanted her to befriend “Lu Bai”.
At the same level, even the two legends from the Seven Islands might not necessarily be Lu Bai’s match.
For such a genius, legendary level was only inevitable.
This terrifying Beast Taming strength was like an unreachable throne. It was probably very difficult to conquer him from the Beast Tamer perspective.
[Perhaps he’s really not interested in me.]
Jie Yi thought a lot in an instant, and then a will to not admit defeat appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - One Mythical, Two Legendaries (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: One Mythical, Two Legendaries (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As Shi Yu put away the Phoenix Fruit and looked at the Phoenix Mystic Realm again, the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi woke up.
At the same time, she had a strong hostility towards the female friend with the phoenix bloodline that Shi Yu mentioned.
So, the reason why this “Lu Bai” was not interested in her was because there was another female Beast Tamer who was better than her and stronger?
Who was it…
….
Divine Realm.
It was where the Phoenix Mystic Realm was.
After the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi recovered, she brought thousands of thoughts and the other witches who had yet to recover from their shock to lead Dong Huang and the others, as well as the president of Temple Island, to the back mountain of the Phoenix Divine Temple to visit the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
Even the ground was red.
Not to mention the fiery red spiritual plants all over the mountain.
This was indeed a holy land for phoenix pets, especially fire-element phoenix-type pets.
“Actually, the entire back mountain is the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
After arriving, the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court said calmly.
“Back then, I accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm here. At that time, this place was still an ordinary green forest, but after time passed, the environment had already been turned into this by the mystic realm after a long time.”
She looked at everyone and said, “Let’s go.”
“I’ve actually always been curious about something,” Ke Yingzong said. “Legend of the Phoenix Court, did you hear or see some strange voices and scenes when you accidentally entered the Phoenix Mystic Realm?”
“According to what I know, you also have a telepathy talent.”
The special use of the telepathy talent was not a secret among legends.
Upon hearing this question, Ji Xiang from the Phoenix Court smiled. “You mean the listening talent? Unfortunately, I don’t know either.”
“Because before I entered the mystic realm, I fainted. When I woke up, I was already in the mystic realm. From what I know, my talent has never shown anything special.”
“It’s all because you’re too obsessed with the Phoenix Mystic Realm.” Legend Xiao Yuan chuckled and said, “If you want to become a top archeologist, you have to learn universal love. If this mystic realm ignores you, then change your research.”
“A person like you won’t understand,” the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court said coldly.
As the legendary big boss spoke, the group of witches beside him didn’t dare to interrupt.
“Heh heh.” Legend Xiao Yuan shook her head and looked at Shi Yu, who was in deep thought, confused, weak, and surprised. “Kid, your expression changes quite a lot. Do you want to say that you heard something again?”
Shi Yu looked at the “members of Bureau 11” of the Seven Islands and shook his head.
At this moment, Chi Tong could already confirm that it had already overlapped with the mystic realm.
However, at this moment, Chi Tong didn’t feel how it should open the mystic realm.
As for the mystic realm, he didn’t take the initiative to open it either.
What should he do next…
Shi Yu was thinking about this.
“Then what about you, Senior Ke?” Legend Xiao Yuan chuckled and said, “You’re a senior in the archeological world. Have you thought of any other ways to open the mystic realm apart from relying on the key of the Phoenix hybrid?”
Senior Ke smiled and said, “Aren’t you asking the obvious? For ruins mystic realms with exact rules, following the rules is the only way. Apart from that, it’s to crack it violently, but this clearly won’t work. This looks like a very high-level mystic realm.”
“Moreover, even if we open the Phoenix Mystic Realm, it’s useless.” The Divine Master of the Phoenix Court had a calm expression.
“Because this is an inheritance-type ruins mystic realm. The interior of the mystic realm is filled with endless flames. The deeper you go, the more pain from the burning of the bloodline. Therefore, even if the mystic realm is opened, as long as there aren’t enough rich phoenix mixed bloods, you can’t take away the core resources,” Ji Xiang said.
This was also why she had been researching how to increase her bloodline and try her best to create a phoenix hybrid.
It was so that after the mystic realm opened, she could enter the core area of the mystic realm one day.
“Hahaha, Legend Ke, did you hear that? This kind of ruins mystic realm with clear cracking rules is the most difficult.” The president of the island shook his head and said.
As he listened to everyone’s conversation, Shi Yu gradually had an idea.
Hu hu hu hu ~ ~
Hu hu hu ~ ~
Just as the president of the temple island finished speaking, Shi Yu raised his hand. A purple summoning array appeared in his palm. Chi Tong, who had been summoned in the battle just now, landed on the back of Shi Yu’s hand in the form of a blue bird spirit filled with ice-blue ghost flames.
“Jiu ~” Chi Tong shook its hair and looked around.
Seeing Shi Yu suddenly summon his pet, everyone looked over again.
Especially the witches of the Phoenix God Shrine and the legendary Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, who looked at the blue bird spirit solemnly.
Even Zheng Hai widened his eyes and sized up the bird spirit.
This was… the pet that had possessed the Ice Phoenix just now.
Although the feeling it gave was that its aura wasn’t strong, and from its appearance, it was only so-so, everyone knew that this was only its appearance.
This pet was definitely very strong.
“Jiu Jiu Jiu ~ ~” Suddenly, Little Chi Tong, who was summoned by Shi Yu, cried out helplessly.
Under Shi Yu’s request, it cried out helplessly.
The Divine Master of the Phoenix Court and Legend Xiao Yuan wanted to hear what it was calling.
Because they had the gift of telepathy, they realized that this bird spirit had sealed its mental fluctuations and didn’t want them to hear it.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - One Mythical, Two Legendary (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: One Mythical, Two Legendary (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Damn it, encryption? Was it something embarrassing?
“Jiu ~ ~ (Mom, I’m back. Open the door!)”
“Jiu ~ ~ (Mom, open the door!)”
At this moment, everyone looked at Shi Yu, who had suddenly summoned the blue bird spirit who started to cry. They were confused.
Only Shi Yu suddenly revealed an extremely abnormal expression.
Because he had already clearly sensed the feasibility of doing this.
Just as everyone from the Phoenix Shrine, the two legends, as well as Zheng Hai were extremely stunned, the world suddenly changed.
Shi Yu’s mouth opened slightly and he said silently to himself… “Exactly as planned.”
Boom!!!
With a bang that was like a volcano erupting, the entire ground of Phoenix Mountain suddenly cracked, making Ji Xiang’s expression change drastically, and also making the expressions of every witch in the Phoenix Divine Temple change drastically.
Hu!!!
In the cracked ground, space overlapped, and fiery red light spread, emitting a shocking heat.
The rumbling wave instantly made the entire mountain collapse. The shock wave emitted by the mountain even spread out with a bang, causing a strong vibration in the huge area with the Phoenix God Shrine at the center!!
Earthquake!!
Boom, countless buildings in the Phoenix God Society collapsed, making the witches open their mouths wide. It also made Ji Xiang and the Phoenix Court open their mouths wide.
The shrine… collapsed?
The president of the island and Legend Xiao Yuan were even more stunned. Of course, the most stunned at this moment was still Zheng Hai, who didn’t react at all. His gaze was stunned and his expression was blank. On the other hand, Senior Ke, who was beside him, couldn’t bear to look at it. He didn’t expect the descent of the Phoenix Mystic Realm to be so big.
This was going to be difficult.
“What happened!!!” The violent change shocked the president of the Island and Legend Xiao Yuan.
In the next moment, everyone here felt the gradually rising heat. This heat further made everyone’s expressions change.
“Yes, the Phoenix Mystic Realm and reality have overlapped!” Ji Xiang was the first to discover the change and immediately said with a shocked expression.
“What?” Ji Xiang’s words also shocked the Witch Sect, President Shi, and the others.
At the same time, in the outside world, although the Phoenix God Shrine was located in a remote area, due to the huge fluctuations of the descent of the mystic realm, the entire Phoenix Mountain had already become a burning cloud.
As strong energy fluctuations and vibrations, as well as the red phenomenon in the sky, many Beast Tamers from the Seven Islands in the distance could see the shocking change from the Phoenix Divine Temple as long as they raised their heads. Their gazes were stunned. After being stunned, they quickly rushed in the direction of the change.
Including the headquarters of the Red God Island Association, they immediately detected this energy wave that exceeded 100 million, like a powerful energy reaction of a totem descending.
On Phoenix Mountain, flames rose.
Now, the area where Shi Yu and the others were was already covered in flames.
Of course, this place had just entered the range of the mystic realm. It was the outermost flame, so it couldn’t hurt everyone yet.
The most terrifying thing was the energy fluctuations and temperature coming from the core area of the Phoenix Mystic Realm at the top of Phoenix Mountain.
That was where the core resources of the Phoenix Mystic Realm were.
As the Phoenix Mystic Realm descended, the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, Legend Xiao Yuan, and even the president of the island were stunned for a moment before quickly reacting.
Among them, the archeologist of the Seven Islands, Legend Xiao Yuan, directly summoned a huge black crow. Lightning flickered on the crow’s body. Legend Xiao Yuan directly leaped up and headed straight for the core resource.
“This wave can’t be wrong. At least two legendary-level resources, and even a Mythical-level resource!!”
Legend Xiao Yuan shouted in her heart, but as she approached the core area of the Phoenix Mystic Realm, the heat wave that erupted with a bang was like the rising sun in the core area of the sun. A terrifying power that even totems, no, even top-notch totems, feared greatly suddenly made Legend Xiao Yuan and her Thunder Crow, who were charging straight for the core resource, feel only a trace of threat. Their pupils immediately constricted and they gave up advancing.
The aftermath of the rising power directly sent them flying.
“Idiot!” Seeing this, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court in the distance cursed coldly. She remembered that she had reminded them that the core of the mystic realm was not something ordinary Beast Tamers could approach at all.
Only a phoenix hybrid could avoid burning. No, even if it was a phoenix hybrid, if its compatibility with this mystic realm was insufficient, it would still be blocked.
She was like this back then.
She couldn’t obtain the three most precious resources at the core of the mystic realm no matter what.
“Jiu—” With a scream, the Thunder Crow, whose hair was almost burned, and Legend Xiao Yuan, who was on its body, landed on the spot miserably. Legend Xiao Yuan relied on her etherealization ability to dodge a life-and-death crisis. However, even space was directly burned just now, directly pushing her to the gates of hell.
“Damn it!!” Legend Xiao Yuan also cursed in a low voice. She couldn’t tolerate the disappointment of being unable to take away Mythical and legendary resources in front of her.
“That temperature is very difficult to pass even for totem-level, no, even top-notch totems. Don’t act rashly,” the Phoenix Court Divine Master said.
The owner of this mystic realm was definitely a demigod-level existence. She was very sure.
“What exactly is going on!!” The president of the island was stunned and pleasantly surprised. He was pleasantly surprised that the Phoenix Mystic Realm had actually opened. He was stunned that he didn’t know how it opened.
Of course, there was also shock. Seeing the miserable state of Legend Xiao Yuan, he immediately knew that the resources of this ruins mystic realm were not so easy to obtain.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - One Mythical, Two Legendaries (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: One Mythical, Two Legendaries (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Lu Bai, you…” At this moment, Jie Yi was observing Shi Yu. From just now, she felt that something was wrong with Shi Yu. The changes in the Phoenix Mystic Realm clearly started when Shi Yu summoned his pet!!
Upon hearing Jie Yi’s words, everyone suddenly noticed this and looked at Shi Yu, who had just made a strange move.
With a look, they saw that the blue bird spirit was slowly fusing into Shi Yu’s body through the possession skill.
One second… two seconds… A cyclone began to linger under Shi Yu’s feet, blowing up dust.
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu’s body began to turn cold. Blue sparks slowly erupted and lingered around him.
Buzz…
The fire threads slowly became dense. In the next moment, Shi Yu’s pupils gradually changed to the color of a sapphire. There seemed to be white ghost flames lingering inside the gem.
Apart from that, his hair slowly turned blue from his pale hair.
After a few seconds, the two parties finally matched.
With a boom, countless fire threads condensed. The cold Nether Ghost Flame turned into flames that wrapped around Shi Yu’s entire body. At this moment, his hair completely turned white and blue, like a death god.
Boom!
Shi Yu ignored everyone’s shocked gazes and directly flew with Chi Tong’s power, heading straight for the center of the flames. After possessing it, he and Chi Tong could sense that the hot flames had no effect on them at all. There was no burning effect at all.
Undying Dark Phoenix! Mother Phoenix! She wasn’t lying. This was really an inheritance!
At this moment, under the temptation of Mythical and Legendary resources, Shi Yu no longer cared about anything and charged forward.
At that moment, the best evidence that there was no danger was that the Dragon God Protection they carried had no reaction at all. Otherwise, if this flame that was enough to threaten the totems became hostile to Shi Yu and the others, the protective water created by the Dragon God would probably instantly extinguish this flaming mountain.
At that time, Shi Yu and the others could also take the resources and not be threatened by the fires!
In short, under various favorable conditions, Shi Yu, who had entered a special possession state, went straight to the core of the resource. His flying speed was so fast that Legend Xiao Yuan, who had just hit a wall, opened her mouth wide in confusion.
“How is this possible!” She saw that Shi Yu was fine. During the flight, countless sun flames retreated as if they had encountered their master. She was very confused.
“Not good.” Seeing this scene, Ji Xiang and the others from the Phoenix Court immediately realized that something was wrong, especially the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court. She directly summoned his contracted Flame Phoenix Master and tried to fly over together.
“You guys also try to enter.” At the same time, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court gave the witches of the Phoenix God Society an order.
Jie Yi and the others, as well as these witches with different strength, didn’t hesitate at all. They directly used various methods to advance to the resource core.
Even the president of the Temple Island and Legend Xiao Yuan, who had lost once, wanted to charge into the core area again when they saw that Shi Yu was unstoppable.
“Wait!!” Zheng Hai was about to move too. Although he didn’t know what had happened, he just had to snatch the resources. However, in the next moment, Senior Ke, who knew, grabbed him.
“Wha-!” Zheng Hai widened his eyes in confusion.
“Don’t go,” Legend Ke said.
As soon as he finished speaking, as expected, the many Phoenix Witches and even the three legends who followed Shi Yu to the core area triggered the resistance of the flames again. They sensed the shocking heat and were about to fly to the core area when Legend Xiao Yuan and the president widened their eyes up and were stunned on the spot.
Although the restrictions on the witches and the Divine Masters of the Phoenix Court with the Phoenix bloodline were relatively alright, as they approached, Sun Flame quickly swept through the Phoenix Mystic Realm and stopped them outside. The hot Sun Flame made each of their expressions change. They didn’t doubt that if they took another step forward, they would immediately be burned to death.
“What happened…”
At this moment, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court, who was flying in the sky, watched as the blue-haired and blue-eyed “Lu Bai” flew smoothly towards the core area. Her face was filled with confusion. She stared with a blank expression.
What was wrong with this guy?
Now, it could basically be determined.
He was the one who summoned the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
Moreover, apart from summoning the mystic realm, he also had a way to enter the core area of the mystic realm without letting the mystic realm hurt him!!
This Lu Bai was definitely not as simple as a new generation Beast Tamer who came to the Seven Islands to train.
From his smooth movements just now, this guy seemed to have planned it long ago.
Who exactly was this Lu Bai?
“Legend Ke, we need an explanation.” At this moment, being stopped outside the flames, the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court directly said to the motionless Ke Chuanqi.
“Explanation, what explanation… I’m also very confused now.” Legend Ke couldn’t take it anymore.
At the same time, the seven island Beast Tamers who were stopped outside the flames were also unable to deal with Legend Ke. They immediately recalled the bet agreement and their expressions darkened to the extreme.
At this moment, the Phoenix God Shrine had already become ruins. The commotion on Phoenix Mountain was very huge. In a short moment, nearby Beast Tamers had already arrived outside the divine shrine. They looked at the fallen divine shrine and the divine mountain covered in flames, and their hearts raced.
The matter of the Phoenix Mystic Realm was no longer a secret with the establishment of the divine temple and the rise of the Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang. At this moment, many Beast Tamers immediately thought of something.
“This… Don’t tell me the Phoenix Mystic Realm appeared again!!”
At this moment, Shi Yu had already successfully arrived at the top of Phoenix Mountain. After the mystic realm overlapped with reality, it was in the core area.
The blue-haired and blue-eyed Shi Yu looked at the small tree with a burning gaze.
And the two spiritual flowers that looked like fire roses beside him.
After seeing these three resources, Shi Yu’s breathing almost stopped.
“We’re rich…” He said to Chi Tong!!
Coincidentally, the third index could detect these three resources. This meant that their usage methods, effects, attributes, and levels had all been recorded. These resources had been used by predecessors!
< Name > Sun Flame Flower
[Level]: Level 9 (Legendary-level)
< Introduction > It’s a strengthening resource. A flower that contains the power of the sun can be used to strengthen fire and light life forms. There’s a chance for pets to awaken Sun Flame skills.
There were two of these flowers. Both of them could increase the proficiency of Sun Flame. At this moment, Shi Yu finally understood why the Undying Dark Phoenix had let them come to this ruin.
He finally understood why there were resources here that could nurture Chi Tong. With this, even if it didn’t do anything, if Chi Tong ate it now, it could immediately obtain the power of a top-notch overlord and approach the totem level!!
It could allow Sun Flame’s skill proficiency to break through to perfection at a very fast speed and approach perfection.
Of course, this was not what Shi Yu was most concerned about. At this moment, what shocked him the most was that they were surrounding another fruit.
Because this white fruit had been detected by the index as a level-ten, Mythical resource!
This was the first time Shi Yu had seen a Mythical resource. The Wind Kirin fossil didn’t count. After all, its level had already fallen.
< Name > Undying Fruit
[Level]: Level 10 (Mythical)
< Introduction > It can allow dead lives to reincarnate in the form of undead and live a second life. After reviving and reincarnating, the lowest level of life growth is the totem level. If it’s higher than the totem level when it was alive, there’s a high chance of inheriting the power when it was alive and reincarnating in a perfect state to live a second life. There’s a very small chance of losing a portion of its power. It’s an Undying Divine Medicine that legendary emperors have searched for and pursued. It’s extremely precious!
Shi Yu’s eyes flickered.
“Unfortunately, it’s not a strengthening resource… However, if the user commits suicide and revives, it’ll be at the totem level. It’s also a different strengthening resource?”

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Undying Fruit!
Mythical resources!
Its effect was still worthy of this level.
If it was said that there was only a one in ten chance for an overlord-level pet to break through to the totem level, then this Undying Fruit could definitely allow a pet to reach the totem level.
It could even let the newly born Awakening-level Green Silkworm reach the totem level!
This was the power of Mythical resources.
Of course, the premise was that the Green Silkworm killed itself after eating the Undying Fruit and lived a second life in the form of the Undead Worm.
Apart from that, the Undying Fruit actually had a certain restriction, which was that it was useless for users who were already undead. Of course, it was just that it couldn’t revive undead lives again. It was still possible to directly strengthen this undead to the totem level.
The Undying Dark Phoenix said that Chi Tong could easily reach the totem level with the resources here. It probably meant the Undying Fruit and two Sun Flame Flowers. The former increased its realm, and the latter increased its skill level.
Upon seeing this resource, Shi Yu suddenly recalled the situation of the Undying Dark Phoenix.
According to the Undying Dark Phoenix itself, it had fallen once. At the start, it also mastered the pure power of the sun. It was one of the strongest races in the Phoenix Race, the Sun God Phoenix Race. It was later when it became an Undying Dark Phoenix.
Shi Yu suspected that the Undying Dark Phoenix itself should have eaten this Undying Fruit before!
Therefore, after falling and reviving, it still had the power above top-notch totems. The Undying Dark Phoenix at its peak was probably also a demigod-level big boss, a ceiling expert in the Phoenix Race.
After all, Mythical resources had always been exclusive to legendary experts and demigod experts in history. Even top-notch totems rarely had the chance to collect Mythical resources.
“I remember that back then, Zhong Xuan said that in order to heal himself, Emperor Wu used many Mythical-level Undying Divine Medicine, but he still couldn’t escape the injury of Yun An. I wonder if Emperor Wu has used the Undying Fruit.”
At this moment, Shi Yu made a decision the moment he saw the Undying Fruit.
If it was possible, if there was a chance…
He would eat it himself!
Giving it to Chi Tong was not the best choice. After all, for Chi Tong, the totem level could be easily reached without this thing. As long as Shi Yu wanted to break the contract and spend a few months to add points, the effect would immediately be equal to these three resources.
It was better to eat it himself!
Yes, the Undying Fruit was real. Even humans could eat it.
If they died, they could directly reincarnate into a totem-level undead life form.
It was equivalent to obtaining a second life after eating this.
Moreover, it was the kind of long life that could still live for at least a thousand years. At the same time, it also had powerful battle power.
Archeology was a rather dangerous thing, and so was Beast Taming. But with this, even if he didn’t have the ability to control beasts in the future, without his pets by his side, he could still fly around.
Shi Yu was tempted.
Of course, he couldn’t be too reckless. After all, at that time, although he had the power of a totem, his battle power was probably weaker than totems like the gem cat that relied on resources to break through. He could be said to be the weakest totem.
“After becoming an undead, losing the Beast Taming Space is inevitable, but I wonder if I’ll lose the skill index. If I die one to two hundred years later, or die during archeology trips and reincarnate as an undead, if I can still retain the skill index talent, I wonder if I can add points to myself… From the totem level to the Mythical level…”
“Ghost God Shi Yu!”
“Even if I can’t keep the skill index, a totem-level undead life form is not bad. If Eleven and the others have already been cultivated to the Mythical stage by me at that time, with them by my side, it doesn’t seem impossible for me to live for thousands or tens of thousands of years in the future.”
This number was almost eternal for the 20-year-old Shi Yu.
Shi Yu muttered in his heart. Initially, he didn’t think it was a strengthening resource, but on careful thought, this was a top-notch resource that could be used on Beast Tamers. It was even more impressive.
Eating it was a huge life guarantee for him. This was much more stable than Chi Tong’s soul surgery. After all, it was a resource recorded in the third index.
The third and eleventh index recorded that when the Dragon Emperor Dynasty was destroyed and the Space Emperor Dynasty was established, the ancient mystic realm descended, attracting a large number of overlords, totems, and human Beast Tamers to explore.
During this process, a titled legendary human Beast Tamer accidentally obtained the Undying Divine Fruit. Without a word, he ate it himself. Of course, this action also made the totem creatures angry and directly surrounded him.
Unfortunately, in this battle, all the pets of this titled legend died. The Beast Tamer himself also died.
Of course, he also successfully reincarnated because of the fruit. Although he successfully reincarnated and indeed obtained the power of a totem-level undead, unfortunately, his soul was still shattered.
This was one of the stories recorded in the Undying Fruit.
According to the legends, this Titled Legend didn’t do it selfishly because of the effect of the Undying Divine Fruit, but because he didn’t want such a Mythical resource to fall into the hands of the totem clans. He could only destroy it.
This was only one of the cases. The Undying Fruit was a very top-notch resource among the Mythical Undying Divine Medicine. There were many stories, and legendary emperors had searched for it.
The wealth of the Phoenix Race was really rich… And this was only the personal collection of the Undying Dark Phoenix?

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
When he recalled that the Undying Dark Phoenix had said that it knew many mystic realms of the Great Empress Dynasty and the Phoenix Race’s inheritance mystic realm, Shi Yu was tempted.
“If it were other Mythical resources… For example, resources that can only strengthen certain attributes, or Mythical resources like the Wind Kirin fossil that aren’t very useful, it wouldn’t attract too much coveting. After all, for the seven countries, they also have a few Mythical resources in their inventory, but this thing seems to be a little abnormal. I hope everything goes smoothly.”
At this moment, when Shi Yu thought of the legends and stories, he fell silent again. He looked down from the top of the mountain. At the moment, be it the president of the Red God Island or the archeologist, Legend Xiao Yuan, they gritted their teeth and looked up. They wanted to come up, but they couldn’t. They were anxious to death.
“But speaking of which…” Shi Yu looked at the three resources again.
No matter what, at least others had yet to see these resources. How should he store the Undying Fruit?
At this moment, Shi Yu had already determined that this was a fixed mystic realm. It was established at this place with spatial ability and couldn’t be moved. Therefore, it was unrealistic to directly take it away with the mystic realm. Then, he could only take the resources alone.
Among them, the collection and preservation method of the Sun Flame Flower was recorded in the third index. It was enough to pluck it down to the roots and store it in a place with rich fire power. The energy of the resources would not wither and disperse for ten years.
If it was transplanted to a place with sufficient sun energy, it could still be maintained for a longer time. For example, here, the sun flames were everywhere, and it was a place with abundant sun power.
In Shi Yu’s team, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong could easily create a place to preserve the Sun Flame Flower and directly transplant it into the ruins space.
However, the index didn’t record the detailed use and preservation of the Undying Fruit…
“Ling, is there anything special about plucking the Undying Fruit?” Shi Yu asked.
In the Beast Taming Space, Ling walked up to Shi Yu and fell into deep thought.
Ling felt that this beast tamer was being unreasonable.
How could it know the problem that wasn’t recorded in the index?
“Master, let’s transplant the Sun Flame Flower first. It’s quite time-consuming to transplant legendary-level resources… I’ll immediately analyze the situation of the Undying Fruit,” Ling said.
“Why don’t we eat it directly?” Shi Yu looked at the Undying Fruit and fell into deep thought. In the records, it shouldn’t be a problem to eat it directly.
“Come, come, come, let’s confirm together and see if it’s okay to eat this. Is there any danger? Don’t let it be the Undying Dark Phoenix’s conspiracy.”
[Undying Dark Phoenix:?]
….
Heavenly Rainbow Island, the venue of the Road to Champion challenge.
The huge change in the Red God Island quickly spread to the Heavenly Rainbow Island.
The legend of the Warring States was the in-charge of receiving the Dong Huang exchange team. His strength could be ranked in the top three of the Seven Islands’ Beast Tamers, already at the top of the Seven Islands’ power.
At this moment, the legend of the Warring States and the legend of the Tyrannical Sea were watching Ning Tianming mess around and challenge the path. At that moment, Ning Tianming had already challenged the seventh level and was about to enter the eighth level.
At this moment, the legend of the Warring States suddenly received a message. After taking a look, his expression changed drastically.
[Legend of the Warring States, bad news. After the Dong Huang exchange team led by Ke Yingzong, Lu Bai, and the others arrived at the Phoenix God Society, the Phoenix Mystic Realm descended. A powerful energy wave was transmitted from the mystic realm. There seems to be one Mythical resource and two Legendary resources.]
[President of the Temple Island, Legend Xiao Yuan, the Divine Lord of the Phoenix Court, and the others can’t approach the core of the mystic realm, but Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer, Lu Bai, can ignore the obstruction of the mystic realm. At the moment, he has already come into contact with resources…]
What?!
The legend of the Warring States widened his eyes.
It meant that… the Phoenix Mystic Realm… had been cracked by the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang?
“Bastards!!!” On the sky ship, the legend of the Warring States was suddenly furious. His gaze exploded as he stood up with a bang.
Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit, what was going on?
Logically speaking, Lu Bai and the others should have just arrived at the Phoenix God Society not long ago.
Why was the Phoenix Mystic Realm cracked? Impossible!
Moreover, one Mythical resource and two Legendary resources were about to fall into the hands of Dong Huang’s Lu Bai. Was he serious??
“!!!” Along with the legend of the Warring States was the Tyrannical Sea Legend. He also widened his eyes and suddenly received the connection from Ke Yingzong and the others.
He learned that Shi Yu had already cracked the mystic realm and came into contact with a Mythical resource and two legendary resources.
Awesome!
In an instant, the Tyrannical Sea Legend felt refreshed and looked at the Warring States Legend.
Legend of the Warring States: ???
“The challenge on the road to champion continues. I suddenly have something to do. I’ll leave first,” the legend of the Warring States said, directly summoning his strange pet.
It was a huge demon with a crab-like black body, a black goat head, and meat wings on both sides of its body.
The legend of the Warring States immediately boarded the pet’s huge body that was nearly ten meters tall, attracting everyone’s attention.
“Count me in.” Tyrannical Sea Legend chuckled and also summoned his invincible Giant Leviathan. Two Titled Legends who could fight totems suddenly summoned their pets, immediately stunning the Beast Tamers here.
At this moment, the legend of the Warring States couldn’t be bothered with the Tyrannical Sea Legend anymore. He directly flew in the direction of the Red God Island.
“This…” A moment later, Legend Xiao Shuang, the legendary noble son Jiang Tianyang, and the others, as well as Legend Ju Qianyao, Legend Suzi, and the others from the Seven Islands who received the Dong Huang exchange team together, immediately knew about the change in the Red God Island. They widened their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In an instant, the Crimson God Island became the center of a storm.
“No… What happened?” At this moment, Heavenly King Zou and the others were considered the third wave of Beast Tamers who had obtained the internal information of Dong Huang. They stood on the sky ship. Heavenly King Zou looked at his cell phone and the information obtained by the Tyrannical Sea Legend and fell into deep thought.
The descent of the Phoenix Mystic Realm… Lu Bai… cracked… One Mythical and two Legendary resources…
“Holy shit! Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit!!!” Heavenly King Zou was directly stunned. Wait a minute, although Lu Bai had passed the path to champion and completed the bet agreement, wasn’t this cracking speed a little too ridiculous?
The battle wasn’t over yet!
Moreover, for Heavenly King Zou, this information style feltl so familiar…
“Is this guy human?!” His eyes were extremely red.
“Moreover, one mythical and two legends. F*ck, can the exchange team still successfully leave the Seven Islands?” While feeling sour, Heavenly King Zou was suddenly stunned.
Even if they could leave successfully, after returning to the country, his battle results would be even more useless compared to Lu Bai’s battle results. What should he do? It could be said that Zou Yun, Ji Feng, Tong Yan, and the others, who had also received the news at this moment, were like the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands. They opened their mouths in shock and gradually lost their ability to think.
….
Outside Phoenix Mountain.
In a short period of time, a large number of Beast Tamers had already gathered here. Among them, the legendary Divine Master of the Red Fire society, the legendary Beast Tamer of the Unknown Fire Family, and the top experts of the legendary factions native to the Red God Island were also rushing over at an extremely fast speed.
“President, Divine Master, Legend Xiao Yuan, what happened!!”
The legendary Divine Master of the Red Fire society was the first legendary expert to rush over. He descended into Phoenix Mountain and looked at the situation in front of him in shock.
At this moment, the three of them didn’t have the time to care about him. The weak, pitiful, helpless, and lost witches of the Phoenix Shrine could only act as commentators.
At the side, Zheng Hai was already stunned. He tugged at Senior Ke and whispered, “Could it be that the commotion is a little too big?”
Senior Ke’s expression didn’t change. “What’s there to be afraid of? We have a bet agreement. The greater the commotion, the better. The greater the commotion, the harder it is to go back on your word. Moreover…”
