Senior Ke’s expression didn’t change. “What’s there to be afraid of? We have a bet agreement. The greater the commotion, the better. The greater the commotion, the harder it is to go back on your word. Moreover…”
[Give me some time. It’s a plant-type resource. The transplant requires time. Don’t worry about the Seven Islands. Our reinforcements will be here soon.]
At the same time, Senior Ke also heard Shi Yu’s voice transmission from afar. He took a deep breath.
“This, this, this, this…” At the same time, the Divine Master of the Red Fire society, who had rushed over, gradually understood what was going on.
His expression kept changing. A Mythical-level resource and two legendary-level resources were given to Dong Huang just like that?
How could this be!
“Legend Ke, is Lu Bai or his pet a hybrid of the Phoenix Race!” At this moment, Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Academy asked Ke Yingzong.
Otherwise, there was no reason for him to enter the mystic realm directly like this.
Moreover, the most ridiculous thing was that it was as if Lu Bai was the owner of this mystic realm. How was that possible?
The witches of the Phoenix Court also looked at the top of the mountain with complicated expressions.
“This, I don’t know either.” Legend Ke shook his head. At the same time, he looked at the top of the mountain with a burning gaze and said, “However, according to the bet agreement, it can be confirmed that it was Lu Bai who cracked the mystic realm and also the resources obtained by Lu Bai. Everyone, please don’t try to snatch the resources like just now. This is already a violation of the bet.”
The bet!
At this moment, when they heard Legend Ke mention this, the expressions of President Si Island, Legend Xiao Yuan, and the others changed, but they didn’t know how to refute for a moment.
Because at their level, it was not enough to openly tear up the agreement between the Seven Islands Association and the Dong Huang Association. They couldn’t bear the consequences at all.
The only outcome of this was to start a war with Dong Huang.
At this level, at least a Titled Legend or a guardian had to give the order.
However, watching helplessly as top-notch resources were taken away from their territory by others made the legends of the Seven Islands extremely uncomfortable.
At this moment, they were racking their brains to think of ways to reverse the situation and distort the truth.
“According to my research, only the direct bloodline of the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm can be immune to the damage of those flames. Even extremely close bloodlines will be rejected.” At this moment, the legend of the Phoenix Court still didn’t give up.
She said, “I don’t care about resources now. I just want to know why ‘Lu Bai’ can avoid being injured by the mystic realm.”
Due to his respect for the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm, the legend of the Phoenix Academy only wanted to know the truth.
Their Phoenix Shrine couldn’t decide the ownership of the bet agreement and the Phoenix Mystic Realm. However, if Lu Bai or his pet was really a direct descendant of the Phoenix Mystic Realm’s owner, then the Phoenix Shrine, which had received the Phoenix Mystic Realm’s favor, should at least not stand opposite Lu Bai and the others under any circumstances.
Due to her childhood experience, the issue of the ownership of the Phoenix Mystic Realm was even deeper than the Seven Islands. It could be said that the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm was the number one faith figure of the Phoenix Divine Society.
“Well, you can ask him yourself later. I don’t know either.” Ke Yingzong shook his head, unable to explain.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Soon, the legendary Beast Tamer of the Red God Family arrived. The situation at the scene became more and more complicated.
More and more high-level forces gathered on the Seven Islands.
Just as the few parties had different thoughts, the greatest change appeared!!!
Boom!!!
In the sky above the mystic realm of Phoenix Mountain, a huge dimensional vortex appeared. The sky became even redder, and a scarlet wave gradually condensed into a flaming face that looked like a demon.
A totem-level aura was undoubtedly revealed from its body.
The flaming pupils instantly passed through the Sun Flame and sensed the power of legendary and Mythical resources on the mountaintop.
In the Seven Islands area, there were a total of six totem-level guardians. They were all guardian beasts left behind by ancient experts in the Seven Islands area. Together with the seven island female weapons, they protected the Seven Islands.
Among them, a guardian was sleeping in the depths of the Red God Island. It was a totem-level elemental life form. Its form was a ball of fire. Because it was red, it was called “Red God”.
At this moment, not only did the Beast Tamer Association of the Seven Islands sense the powerful energy fluctuations produced by the fusion of the Phoenix Mystic Realm and reality, but even this fire guardian also sensed the attraction of the Sun Flame’s power. It was restless and woke up from its sleep to descend into the world again.
“I didn’t expect to be so lucky.” Red God, who was in the sky, was extremely excited. Although it didn’t sense what the Mythical resource was, the power of the two Sun Flame Flowers was completely sensed by it.
It instantly judged that if it ate those two flowers, it could enter the top totem level.
In addition to that unknown Mythical resource, perhaps there was hope for demigod level?
It was crazy.
Such a top-notch resource actually appeared in the territory he was protecting, making Red God extremely excited.
However, just as it was excited, it suddenly sensed the disappearance of another resource power.
After being stunned for a moment, Red God was furious. He realized that someone was plucking his “resources”.
you are reading on our content copy site.Please copy and search this link " https://bom.so/sBJMIa " to support us
“Bastard!!”
It directly condensed a huge flaming hand, wanting to pinch the resources at the top of the mountain.
“Lu Bai…” As Red God appeared, the Beast Tamers below opened their mouths wide and looked at the guardian of the Red God Island in shock. Among them, Senior Ke and Zheng Hai’s pupils constricted when they saw Red God suddenly attack.
The gem cat in the alternate space also frowned. It wanted to teach this weakling a lesson, but it quickly stopped condensing its strength.
Because the power of the Phoenix Mystic Realm was something that even the fire totem couldn’t cross.
Boom!!
In the next moment, Red God, who wanted to pluck the resources in the flames, instantly sensed the Sun Flame power that was difficult for even him to cross.
The huge heat wave instantly burned it very painfully, making its huge eyes shrink as it retracted its strength.
“Bastard!” It cursed again.
At the same time, its huge eyes frowned as it looked below.
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands below had long noticed this person.
Hadn’t this master been sleeping for more than ten years?
It was… attracted by the fluctuations of resources?
“Lord Red God!!!” As the descendant of a Red God Beast Tamer, the Divine Master of the Red Fire society, who believed in Red God, was instantly extremely excited to see his ancestor.
“Oh, it’s you, kid.” Red God also recognized the bloodline of the Red Fire society’s Divine Master and said, “Hurry up and think of a way. I want the resources inside.”
“But…” The Divine Master was immediately unable to deal with Red God.
“But? This is the resource left to me by my Beast Tamer, your ancestor. Look, we’re all fire-element!” Although Red God didn’t know what was going on, he directly announced the ownership of the resources in the Phoenix Mystic Realm in a high-profile manner.
This shameless statement stunned the witches of the Phoenix Shrine.
However, it made the expressions of the president of the island, Legend Xiao Yuan, and the others suddenly happy.
This was inappropriate.
A guardian was taking the blame.
“Legend Ke, you also heard it. The situation seems to have changed. The resources of the Phoenix Mystic Realm seem to be the inheritance left behind by the seniors of the Seven Islands to Lord Red God. It can’t be considered an unsolved mystic realm. We still have to discuss the specific situation a little. Please hand the resources inside to the Seven Islands for safekeeping first. The Seven Islands will definitely give Dong Huang a reasonable explanation.”
The president of the island said. At this moment, with the Red God standing on their side, they were more confident. At least, at least, they couldn’t let Dong Huang take all the resources. As long as two legendary resources were left behind, it would be a profit. On Dong Huang’s side, under the circumstances where there were benefits, it definitely wouldn’t fall out with the Seven Islands for a legendary resource. It was best if everyone had meat to eat.
“Indeed.” The Divine Master was naturally on Red God’s side. He also looked at Legend Ke forcefully.
Legend Xiao Yuan also nodded. How could they give Dong Huang the initiative completely?
Even if Dong Huang was powerful, there was definitely still room for negotiation. At least, here, the Seven Islands were stronger.
When that Lu Bai came out, the resources would definitely not be given to him.
“What are you talking about!!!” Legend Ke cursed. Were they trying to cheat?
Not only could Legend Ke not stand these words, but even Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court revealed a sullen expression. She said to the guardian of the Red God Island, “Lord Red God, before you speak, you have to think carefully. Don’t make things up, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Shi Yu’s Totem Friends Descend (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Red God’s Beast Tamer’s experience was known to everyone, and it was the same for Red God. It was definitely unrelated to the Phoenix Mystic Realm. This Phoenix Court’s Ji Xiang was very certain! The other party’s words were a trampling on the Phoenix God Society’s existence!
“Huh? You’re doubting me??” Red God frowned.
“I’m just advising Lord Red God to be honest,” Ji Xiang said.
Red God didn’t say a word. A huge pressure pressed down on Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court, making her expression change and reveal an incredulous expression. She didn’t expect the guardian of the Red God Island to be so unreasonable.
She was just about to resist when someone directly helped her in the next moment.
“Hey, hey, hey.”
At the same time, out of thin air, a totem-level deterrence flowed upstream from the alternate space, squeezing the pressure of the Red God into the sky.
At this moment, Red God’s expression changed.
Boom!!!
Two totem-level deterrence directly tore through space. In the black spatial crack, a gem cat slowly walked out and stepped in the sky. It looked straight at the fire monster in the sky and said, “Big guy, I suspect you’re playing with fire.”
Another totem!!!
“This is… a gem cat?? How is this possible!!”
As the gem cat appeared and displayed the power of the totem, the legends of the Seven Islands widened their eyes. This was because the race of the gem cat was not high. Even after it evolved with the gem, the highest was only a monarch race.
How could it reach the totem level!
Moreover, this gem cat was too unfamiliar. The Beast Tamers from the Seven Islands didn’t know it.
Even the legends of the Phoenix Court were stunned. They looked at the gem cat in disbelief, not knowing why it wanted to resist the pressure for them.
“It’s Senior Ying…” Legend Ke was delighted. Beside him, Zheng Hai was also stunned. Wasn’t this the guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University?
At this moment, the matter was becoming more and more complicated. In the sky above the sea outside the Crimson God Island, a large number of flying overlords rushed to the core of the incident at an extremely fast speed. The goat demon rode by the legend of the Warring States, the Giant Leviathan rode by the legend of the Tyrannical Sea, and Legend Xiao Shuang and the others were rushing over at an extremely fast speed.
Around Phoenix Mountain, the low-level Beast Tamers sensed the deterrence on the mountain and looked at Red God in the sky. They felt hot sweat flowing and felt that something was wrong. A huge battle might happen here!
“And who are you…” At that moment, the most angry one was still the totem Red God. It looked at the weak totem cat in front of it and said,” Do you want to fight me? ”
The gem cat yawned and said, “I’m just saving you.”
“I advise you not to plot against the resources on the mountain and not to disturb the people inside. Otherwise, the consequences will be unimaginable.”
“In addition, you have to repay me for saving your life. Remember, you owe me a legendary resource.”
Red God: “?”
The seven island legends: ???
“Huh??” Red God smiled and was angry. As one of the guardians of the Seven Islands, it had never seen such an arrogant totem in its territory.
“It’s coming,” the gem cat whispered.
At this moment, Red God still didn’t understand, but in the next moment, its expression changed drastically.
One, two, three, four, five…
One, two, three…
It felt an endless powerful aura suddenly approaching.
Among them, there were at least six totem levels, and among these six totems, there were even top-notch totems!!
“How is this possible!!!”
Red God was shocked. This number…
At this moment, a crack suddenly appeared in the higher sky, a huge black crack.
Dragon roars came from the crack, resounding through the world, making Red God’s expression change even more.
It also made the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands gradually stunned.
A huge frost dragon dozens of meters tall was the first to fly out of the spatial crack, bringing with it endless cold air.
Its cold gaze stared at the entire Phoenix Mountain, causing the temperature here to plummet.
Totem level, frost dragon!
Following closely behind.
A hundred-meter-long sea-blue Eastern Divine Dragon, a white Eastern Divine Dragon, flew out of the spatial crack. their huge bodies circled the sky.
Dragon Palace City, Sea Dragon King, Azure Dragon King!!
Their huge dragon eyes stared down, searching for someone.
This wasn’t the end.
Under the sound of lightning, the golden Eastern Divine Dragon, which was also a hundred meters long, appeared with the totem dragons in front!!
Dragon Palace City, Thunder Dragon King, Immortal Dragon King.
In the end, as the spatial crack shrank, a nearly illusory and transparent divine dragon came out. Dragon Palace City, the Space Dragon King!
Its heavy voice resounded in all directions. “Seriously, it’s this close and you still want me to tear open space.”
Six totems!!
Apart from that, the shrunken crack didn’t completely close. The Sky Penetrating Whale, the Rakshasa General, the Space Jellyfish, and the other top overlords of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City followed closely behind the totem dragon kings and descended here.
A terrifying aura that filled the sky suppressed the Red God Island.
Six totems and more than ten top-notch overlords had descended!!!
At this moment, even the flames of Phoenix Mountain were much weaker.
Looking at the six totem dragon kings that had suddenly descended, the legendary Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands, the nearby low-level Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands, their pets… They felt their hearts almost stop. They were almost unable to breathe. They widened their eyes and couldn’t believe their eyes.
Even Red God was so scared that it was about to pee its pants. It didn’t understand why the hooligans of Dragon Palace City would suddenly descend on the Seven Islands.
Even during the totem battle, the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City had never traveled together like this.
Of course, Legend Ke and Zheng Hai were also stunned and shocked.
This group of Dragon Kings was originally called by the evidence of the Environmental Protection Department to ask for an explanation from the Seven Islands. They planned to use the Poison Dragon Totem to extort some resources.
However, on the way, they were stopped by the gem cat clone and were informed that someone was bullying Shi Yu, so they came here first.
Shi Yu couldn’t be bullied. After all, this was the master of the Blue Sea Sprite, the Beast Tamer chosen by the Dragon God, the son of the Ice Dragon King. They were all family!
At this moment, as the totem dragon kings descended, Shi Yu, who was collecting resources, seemed to have entered the end. In the flames, a blue figure slowly flew up.
Shi Yu, who flew up from the core of the mystic realm, immediately became the focus.
On his body, the Ice Slime King was hanging. It was too hot…
At this moment, when Red God saw this little thief who stole his “resources”, his gaze was filled with hatred.
Legend of the Seven Islands and the others also looked at Shi Yu, having yet to recover from their shock.
Right on the heels of that, an even more shocking scene appeared. The totem dragon kings’ actions made everyone’s eyes explode.
The totem dragon kings were slightly stunned when they saw Shi Yu. The gem cat had already told them about Shi Yu’s disguise, so they could still recognize him at this moment. After being stunned, they said unevenly, “You’re pretty energetic. I heard from that cat that someone is bullying you. Who is it? They’re very bold.”
Shi Yu looked aggrieved.
“It’s that guy.” Shi Yu pointed at the unreasonable Red God. He needed to at least be compensated one legendary resource from this guy, or it wasn’t over!
Red God: “???”
The seven totems looked at Red God.
Red God’s mentality exploded: QAQ, what the hell… No way, no way!!

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - Opening the Door and Letting Shi Yu In (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Opening the Door and Letting Shi Yu In (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Red God’s current mentality was quite broken.
To be honest, this was the first time it had encountered such a situation.
Even in the last totem battle, when it fought alongside its Beast Tamer, it had never seen so many totems at the same time.
Moreover, every one of them here was a dragon with powerful battle power!
Apart from that cat.
No matter how slow Red God was, he could understand what was going on.
The human who took the resources had several thighs that he leaned on, and these thighs were especially thick!
At this moment, Red God was filled with endless anger.
It was not for Shi Yu, not for the totem dragon kings, but for the president of the island, Divine Master of the Red Fire, and the others.
As the totem guardian of the Seven Islands and a guardian beast left behind by the former experts of the Seven Islands, its status in the Seven Islands was very high. Therefore, when it saw the resources unearthed in its protective territory, it subconsciously wanted to take them for itself.
This was originally a very normal thing. In the Seven Islands, it was said that the Valkyrie couldn’t come out of seclusion. None of the other five guardians were fire-element. Who else could this resource be given to!
The agreement of the island’s president, the Divine Master of the Red God society, and the others at the start also made Red God very satisfied.
But from the looks of it, Red God really wanted to curse these two guys.
A Beast Tamer with such a rich background that he could even summon the totem dragon kings of Dragon Palace City. Why didn’t they say this in advance??
If they had said in advance, of course it wouldn’t do anything like this!
It’d sit down and talk to these foreign friends!
Red God immediately felt that it was the president of Temple Island and the others who had harmed it. It was wronged!
Dear readers! you are reading on our content copy site.Please copy and search this link " https://bom.so/sBJMIa " to support us
At this moment, the reason why Red God was so afraid was that the aura of these seven totems had locked onto it!
Several terrifying deterrence wrapped around it like a cage.
This feeling of approaching death at the limit even made Red God have no time to think about why a Beast Tamer who wasn’t from the Seven Islands would pick resources in its territory.
This was no longer important. After all, in this world, the strongest fist was the law. At this moment, it was clearly being beaten up by a group of big fists.
“It’s a misunderstanding…”
Red God wanted to explain and push the blame to the president of Temple Island and God Lord Chi Huo, who believed in it, but the totem dragon kings of Dragon Palace City didn’t plan to deal with it simply.
Although it wasn’t enough trouble for them to just destroy the Red God, as one of the seven island guardians, it was undoubtedly more convenient for it to see the difference in strength with its own eyes so that things would be easier in the subsequent compensation segment.
“Seven Islands, you’re getting more and more bold.”
The Sea Dragon King widened its eyes and glared. Its dragon eyes were filled with an unreachable deterrence. The front of its long body slapped at Red God with its dragon claws.
“Wait!”
Seeing this, Red God’s expression froze. At the same time, it cursed in its heart. Just as it was about to resist, it suddenly felt that it seemed to have been instantly deprived of the right to control the fire elements!
“Wait!”
Although it was only for an instant, it still shocked Red God.
It felt as if it had entered another world at once, and the laws of fire in this world were completely different from the previous world.
“Anti-magic.”
In the sky, the mysterious Space Dragon King that Shi Yu had never seen before looked at Red God with a deep gaze.
In an instant, transparent spatial fluctuations spread and gathered into a domain, restricting Red God and immediately depriving it of its ability to control flames.
Transcendent level, Anti-magic Domain!
“Roar…”
This was not the end. As the Sea Dragon King attacked, the dragon might of the other totem dragon kings also completely erupted. Like a spatial vibration, it made the sky pitch-black, causing the spatial crack to wrap into a huge black hole, emitting a shocking aura.
“Top-notch totem…”
As soon as the Space Dragon King attacked, Red God knew that it was completely not this guy’s match. Just this spatial divine dragon was enough to suppress it. Moreover, the other big guys were also not to be trifled with.
Crimson God was immediately filled with sorrow. What a sin.
At this moment, the joint suppression of the many totems made it impossible for the Red God to resist. It could only watch helplessly as the Sea Dragon King’s huge dragon claw enveloped the sky and earth and smashed towards it!
With a boom, Red God felt its mind tremble. This dragon claw wrapped in dragon might directly suppressed the flames that filled the sky and knocked it out of its original form, making its body like a rain of fire as it smashed towards Phoenix Mountain!
The huge flaming face kept distorting, turning into a strange elemental life form with a demon face that looked like a huge rat.
“Squeak…”
The claw was slapped down, and the intense pain made Red God cry out. The place it landed instantly formed a sea of fire that squeezed the Sun Flame area of the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
In the sea of fire, the pupils of the huge rat Red God constricted as it glared at this group of bastards.
He cursed, “Let’s talk about it!”
“Do you want to start a war with the Seven Islands!”
“Are you even qualified to represent the Seven Islands?” The Sea Dragon King continued to slap over from afar.
The dragon-shaped water claw and the surrounding six to seven totem-level dragon might directly made Red God burn with anger, and its pupils constricted.
“You #￥#@, Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands, what are you still staring at? Hurry up and call for reinforcements!”
“Also, you injured me. The legend of the Seven Islands won’t let you off…” It revealed an extremely arrogant expression, and its expression gradually distorted.
Boom!!!
With another slap, the flames around Red God were all destroyed. As for Red God’s main body, the five to six-meter-long fire rat, it directly curled up on the wet ground, looking extremely miserable.
The Anti-magic Domain continued to envelop it, and seven totem-level deterrence wrapped around its body. It couldn’t spare any strength to deal with the Sea Dragon King’s huge claws.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - Opening the Door to Release Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Opening the Door to Release Shi Yu (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Squeak…”
At this moment, the miserable state of the Red God fell in the eyes of the Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, the president of Temple Island, Legend Xiao Yuan, the Red Fire Divine Master, and the others, attacking their hearts at all times.
“Lord Red God…”
The Red Fire Divine Master trembled as he wanted to help the other party, but be it him or the overlord pet beside him, they felt the aura formed by dozens of pressure in the sky and didn’t have the courage to stand out at all.
At that moment, Ke Yingzong and Zheng Hai also swallowed their saliva crazily, stunned by the scene in front of them.
It was too ferocious.
This was the guardian of the Seven Islands. Why was it as miserable as a primary school student being bullied by an evil force?
“Ah, ah, ah.”
At this moment, Shi Yu finally heaved a sigh of relief.
In fact, when Red God appeared and stretched out his big hand to grab the top of the mountain, he panicked for a moment. He didn’t expect that the guardians of the Seven Islands would be summoned like this.
However, the current Shi Yu was completely at ease.
It didn’t expect that there were his dragons in the sea.
“Bingbing, steady.” Beside a pile of totem dragon kings, the cute gem cat mixed in also released deterrence while secretly praising the frost dragon.
At first, the gem cat thought that there were probably only two or three Dragon Kings who had come to the Seven Islands, but it didn’t expect that the boss of the Dragon Palace City’s Environmental Protection Department, Ice Dragon, was so awesome. It called the Thunder Dragon King and the Space Dragon King, two big shots whose battle power was also at the top of the Dragon Palace Dragon Kings.
It looked like Ice Dragon was doing pretty well in Dragon Palace City.
Could it be that from the perspective of a dragon, Bing Bing was also a great beauty?
The gem cat fell into deep thought.
“Eh, heh.” Ice Dragon also maintained its seriousness and was secretly excited.
This was much better than participating in the totem battle with Mu Huiyin. The situation at that time was so torturous. It was difficult to rely on the strength of an overlord to fight top-notch totems, unlike now.
After joining Dragon Palace City, it casually gathered a totem team and bullied totems from other countries. It was like bullying a child.
“What exactly do you want—”
At this moment, Red God suspected that it couldn’t survive today. It was extremely regretful and didn’t understand why it woke up today.
At the same time, the Beast Tamers present still knew what was going on. The Beast Tamers who rushed over were even more stunned.
In the distance, the legendary Beast Tamers from the Seven Islands and Dong Huang, including the Warring States Legend and the Tyrannical Sea Legend, were rushing towards the Phoenix Temple with all their might.
One mythical and two legendaries. The legend of the Warring States clearly wasn’t willing to hand all of these resources to Dong Huang.
As for the Tyrannical Sea Legend, he could also predict that the Seven Islands were definitely unwilling. Therefore, they also had to come to the scene as soon as possible in Dong Huang’s position to pressure the Seven Islands.
Both parties originally thought that after arriving at the Phoenix God Shrine, it would be a battle without blood and merely a theoretical battle. However, as terrifying fluctuations came from the distance, as they approached the Phoenix God Shrine, the legends of the two countries were stunned.
From afar, the Legend of the Warring States of the Seven Islands saw the six huge totem dragons circling above Phoenix Mountain and was shocked to the extreme.
He naturally knew these guys. It was because he knew them that his brain suddenly rumbled and he had an extremely bad feeling.
“This…” After the Tyrannical Sea Legend sensed that the Dragon Palace people were on Shi Yu’s side, he was also shocked. He accelerated like the War State Legend. When they descended, they directly saw a rather shocking scene.
In the sky.
A blue-haired and blue-eyed young man with a Frost Slime King on his shoulder looked down gently.
Behind him, six terrifying totem dragon kings flew in the sky and dominated the sky. Their dragon might was peerless. Behind the young man, there were also ocean overlords that revealed top-notch might one after another. They had evil expressions as they stared at the miserable Flame Rat totem below with him.
“Real Bullying”.
In this terrifying scene, apart from Red God who still dared to curse, the president of the island, Legend Xiao Yuan, and the other legends had already lost their ability to think. They didn’t even dare to interrupt, afraid that the deterrence revealed by the totem dragon kings would erase their minds.
“This is… What’s going on!!!”
When the Legend of the Warring States saw the miserable appearance of the guardian totem of the Red God Island, the blue-haired young man whose appearance could still be vaguely seen as “Lu Bai”, and the terrifying lineup behind him… For a moment, He almost fainted and lost his ability to think.
Following that, Legend Ju, Legend Suzuki, and the others revealed shocked expressions. Looking at the scene in front of them, even the legends of Dong Huang were silent the whole time, not knowing what to say.
“Titled legend.”
As the legend of the Warring States arrived, the Sea Dragon King and the others could also sense this guy’s strength. Their sixth sense told them that this man was even stronger than that Red God.
Was he considered the head of the Seven Islands?
They looked at the man, making the legend’s expression turn cold.
“You are the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City.”
After the legend of the Warring States arrived, he asked with a shocked expression, “Why did the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City come to the Seven Islands? Do you want to start a war?!”
In the Seven Islands, there was legendary battle power and that human-type forbidden weapon. Legend of the Warring States didn’t believe that the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City would come to the Seven Islands for no reason and even attack their guardian.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - Opening the Door to Release Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Opening the Door to Release Shi Yu (2)
"This is what we want to ask!"
Under the Sea Dragon King's low voice, it looked at the legend of the Warring States angrily.
"Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands, your Seven Islands colluded with the totem country and controlled the Poison Dragon Totem to invade the Dragon Palace sea area and hurt countless lives under Dragon Palace City. Now, you have the intention to hurt the friend of the Dragon Palace. Do you want to start a war!"
"If you want to fight, our Dragon Palace City will entertain you!" "What nonsense are you talking about!" The expression of the legend of the Warring States changed drastically. "Nonsense?"
The Sea Dragon King looked at Red God and said, "Just now, this guy intended to attack our friend from Dong Huang, a friend of Dragon Palace City. Countless people witnessed it. What do you have to say!"
The legend of the Warring States looked at the Phoenix Mystic Realm below and at Shi Yu, who was scratching his head in front of him. He opened his mouth slightly. Soon, he analyzed what was going on. Most likely, Shi Yu had cracked the Phoenix Mystic Realm and the fluctuations of resources had attracted the attention of the Red God, causing a conflict between the two parties.
It would be fine if it was just a conflict, but the most incomprehensible thing was why the Dragon Palace people had also descended on the Seven Islands and were even caught red-handed! "Of course, this is only a situation we accidentally encountered when we descended." "Our goal in coming to the Seven Islands is to ask for an explanation."
"A few months ago, a crazy Poison Dragon Totem that mutated due to the radiation pollution of a forbidden weapon invaded the Dragon Palace sea area during the Dragon Palace banquet, causing countless creatures in Dragon Palace City to die tragically. According to our investigation, that Poison Dragon Totem came from your Seven Islands!"
"We've investigated and confirmed that the Poison Dragon Totem is the biological weapon sent by your Seven Islands!"
"How do you explain this?"
The Sea Dragon King was aggressive and questioned the legend of the Warring States with a murderous aura. "We need an explanation." "Human, give us an explanation."
"Otherwise, we will regard the actions of the Seven Islands as a declaration of war against Dragon Palace City." The Thunder Dragon King, the Space Dragon King, the Azure Dragon King, and a few other Dragon Kings released a huge deterrence one after another, enveloping a huge area with the Phoenix Divine Society as the center.
In this range, countless Beast Tamers from the Seven Islands who had rushed over could hear their words clearly with shocked expressions.
Until the deterrence wave expanded and enveloped the entire nearby city.
At this moment, the most confused and shocked person was still the legend of the Warring States. He only felt that Dragon Palace City was so unreasonable and suspected that Dragon Palace City was framing and extorting! "Impossible!!" Legend of the Warring States said angrily. "Our Seven Islands have always loved peace and have always followed the alliance contract. It's definitely impossible for us to collude with the totem country and hurt the allies of the seven countries. Don't slander us."
"Impossible??" The Sea Dragon King was angry and smiled at the same time. "Looks like you won't shed tears until you see the coffin. After Dragon Palace City was attacked, we've been investigating. In the end, the leads pointed at the power of your Seven Islands, the 'Ke Yuan Financial Group', and we've already obtained concrete evidence and now took control of your several biological experimental research institutes scattered all over small islands. Even the Poison Dragon Totem is being suppressed and imprisoned by our Dragon Palace. Do you dare to confront us?"
"The one who colluded with the totem country is your faction, the 'Ke Yuan Financial Group'. Do you dare to call all the core Beast Tamers of this faction out for a confrontation?"
The expressions of the seven island Beast Tamers changed again. The Beast Tamers of Doug Huang here suddenly sensed that things were not simple. The descent of the totem dragon kings was not only because of the incident just now, but also for another reason!
"So you've investigated it." Legend Sea Tyrant took a deep breath. This also meant that the seven island factions were colluding with the Yun An faction!
At this moment, the Tyrannical Sea Legend also said to the Warring States Legend in a low voice, "Mr. Tian Jiang, at the Dragon Palace banquet a few months ago, I happened to be in Dragon Palace City. There was indeed a Poison Dragon Totem that invaded the Dragon Palace. You have to give an explanation for this. In the contract of the Seven Nation Alliance, Dragon Palace City is an ally of our Dong Huang. It is regarded as one with Dong Huang. Invading Dragon Palace City is invading Dong Huang!"
"In addition, the Seven Islands Guardian even openly attacked our Beast Tamer and tore up the bet agreement. I also want to ask, do the Seven Islands want to start a war with Dong Huang?"
Legend of the Warring States, Red God: ??
Many Beast Tamers of the seven islands had their hearts stop.
At that moment, the expression of the legend of the Warring States, Tian Jiangzhi, darkened to the extreme. He completely didn't expect things to develop to this extent. However, at this moment, what he wanted to know the most was what Dragon Palace City meant by the Ke Yuan Financial Group colluding with the totem country!
At least, from what he knew, the core higher-ups of the seven islands definitely had no intention of betraying the Seven Nation Alliance.
However, he didn't know the situation of the scattered factions on the seven islands. The Keyuan Financial Group, the faction of the Red God Island, started with technologya€: He looked at the president of the Red God Island Association, the local legend of Red God Island, the Phoenix Court, the Unknown Fire, the Red Fire Society, and the others.
Because of the commotion here, the local legends of the seven islands were basically all here. Only the helmsman of the Keyuan Financial Group was not here. This suddenly made the legend of the Warring States sense that something was wrong.
"Impossible!!" Red God, who was beaten up before the legend of the Warring States, was the first to say angrily, "The seven islands definitely can't collude with a totem country."
Back then, it participated in the totem battle. Many companions and Beast Tamers died in the hands of the totem country. There was a blood feud here, and the guardians of the other islands were in a similar situation. It definitely wouldn't accept the false accusation of Dragon Palace City.
"The seven islands definitely have no intention of betraying the alliance. There must be a misunderstanding." At this moment, the situation was pressing. Legend of the Warring States took a deep breath and said, "Everyone, please wait a moment.."

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - Releasing the Beast Shi Yu (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Releasing the Beast Shi Yu (4)
'President of Temple Island, I want to know the situation of Legend Bai Chuan. Where is he now?" Legend Warring States asked the President of Temple Island.
"Can you contact him?
At this moment, the president of the Temple Island stood on the ground and trembled. When he heard the question, he was first stunned. Then, he swallowed his saliva and said, "I can give it a try, but I need time."
The legend of the Warring States looked at the many totem dragon kings and said, "We'll find the leader of the Ke Yuan Financial Group now. Please give us some time. There's definitely a misunderstanding."
Apart from the legend at the helm of the Keyuan Financial Group, the guardians of the other islands and the other titled legends had to be awakened and informed. The legend of the Warring States was covered in cold sweat. He felt that the Seven Islands were in the most dangerous moment.
He alone definitely couldn't handle the current situation. "Five minutes." "I'll give you five minutes."
The Sea Dragon King's expression was cold. At the same time, spatial cracks appeared in the sky. Buildings that looked like experimental laboratories were pulled out by the Space Dragon King and thrown down.
Apart from research institutes, there were also researchers from the Keyuan Financial Group in white research clothes with extremely frightened expressions, as well as monsters with deformed bodies that emitted strange radiation.
These were all secret experimental labs of the Ke Yuan Financial Group that Dragon Palace City had destroyed in various secret places.
At this moment, when he saw these people and these radiation monsters, the expression of the legend of the Warring States changed. Regardless of whether what Dragon Palace City said was true or false, even if it was a false accusation, the scene in front of him was enough to show that Dragon Palace City had made full preparations.
And if it were true, then it was even more disadvantageous for the Seven Islands to have a traitor inside. "These are part of the evidence!" the Sea Dragon King said. "There's definitely a misunderstanding," Legend of the Warring States said with a dark expression.
Seeing the aggressive appearance of the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, the legend of the Warring States knew that regardless of whether it was true or false, Dragon Palace City would definitely not let the matter rest. This included Dong Huang. This time, they had seized the opportunity to ruthlessly extort the Seven Islands. This time, the legend of the Warring States estimated that the Seven Islands probably couldn't avoid it. At least, the Seven Islands definitely couldn't withstand the joint pressure of Dong Huang and the Dragon Palace.
Unless other countries were willing to help the Seven Islands. However, this was clearly impossible. Without benefits, who would help? No matter what, the Seven Islands would lose a piece of flesh. "Regardless of whether it's a misunderstanding or not, I only want an explanation now!"
"If your Seven Islands don't have the intention to start a war with Dragon Palace City, then hand over the culprit we've investigated and let us confront him in person!"
"The Ke Yuan Financial Group is still operating normally on the Seven Islands. If you don't hand over the culprit, we have reason to confirm that you're protecting the mastermind!" the Sea Dragon King said.
Legend of the Warring States gritted his teeth and looked at the president of Temple Island. "Wait a moment."
Below, the president was covered in sweat. This was because he couldn't reach the numbers of any of the core higher-ups of the Keyuan Financial Group that he had personally recorded. This situation was abnormal, too abnormal.
Even if he dialed the next level of management of the Keyuan Financial Group, the other party said that he had not seen the higher-ups of the financial group led by Legend Bai Chuan for a long time.
One possibility was that the higher-ups of the Ke Yuan Financial Group really had colluded with the totem faction. Moreover, before the problem occurred, they had already sensed the news and fled. The second possibility was that this group of people had already been secretly killed by Dragon Palace City. There was no evidence. No matter which one it was, it was extremely disadvantageous to the current situation.
At this moment, the president of the island couldn't understand why a "simple mystic realm exploration" gradually upgraded to a fuse in the battle between the two countries.
Both parties were in a stalemate.
At that moment, Ji Xiang, Jie Yi, and the others from the Phoenix Court were extremely silent. Compared to what Dragon Palace City had mentioned, they were more concerned about the young man flying in the sky.
What was wrong with this guy?
Not only did he easily crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm, but he could also make so many totem dragon kings stand behind him. From the situation, it seemed like he knew every totem dragon king, and they all knew him. How was this possible!
Even the Titled Legends of Dong Huang couldn't possibly know every Dragon King of Dragon Palace City. Was this guy the illegitimate son of the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City! "Why are you so slow?" At this moment, seeing that the Dragon Kings were no longer attacking him and had turned their attention to the leader of the Ke Yuan Financial Group, Red God urged the president of the island.
President of Temple Island: "fi€:Legend Tianjiang, Lord Red God, this, this, Legend Bai Chuan and the others can't be contacted!"
His face was pale.
As soon as these words were spoken, although the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City had expected it, they were still furious. The Seven Islands were too useless. It was fine if they couldn't supervise the traitor, but they actually let the other party escape without a trace.
In fact, Dragon Palace City also didn't believe that the core upper echelons of the Seven Islands would openly betray the alliance. It was very likely that a rat had appeared inside, but it didn't matter. No matter what, it was an indisputable fact that the forces of the Seven Islands had invaded Dragon Palace City. They naturally had to use this as an excuse to make a fuss and get enough compensation.
"What do you mean!" The Sea Dragon King glared at them and said, "You mean you can't present anyone?"
The legend of the Waning States broke out in cold sweat and cursed the president of the island. Would it kill him to answer slower?
Just as the legend of the Warring States was about to explain, the Tyrannical Sea Legend beside him spoke..

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - Releasing the Beast Shi Yu (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Releasing the Beast Shi Yu (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“I believe that the Seven Islands won’t betray the Seven Nation Alliance.”
“However, Legend of the Warring States, please seriously investigate the situation of your country’s Ke Yuan Financial Group and whether they colluded with the totem country.”
The Warring States Legend sighed and said, “I will. If a traitor appears internally, we will definitely punish him severely and give Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City an explanation.”
“Explain!!!” The Dragon Palace City Lord, the Sea Dragon King, who had come to claim compensation this time, said, “That’s easy to say. Can your Seven Islands afford the loss of a totem invasion!!”
“Based on the losses in Dragon Palace City…”
“This matter won’t end without ten legendary or one Mythical resource!”
Legend of the Warring States, Red God, and many legends of the Seven Islands: ???
Damn, how could they ask for so much!
The legend of the Warring States said with a dark expression, “After investigating the matter, we will naturally give Dragon Palace City a reasonable explanation.”
In order to appease the Dragon Kings in Dragon Palace City, he didn’t directly refuse, but he didn’t agree either.
In short, if he really found out something, it had nothing to do with him either!
The Keyuan Financial Group was one of the ten largest financial groups on the Seven Islands and had a rich family background. If there was really a traitor inside, the Keyuan Financial Group would definitely confiscate it. At that time, they would directly compensate from the Keyuan Financial Group!
Now, the only thing the legend of the Warring States was worried about was that the core assets of the Ke Yuan Financial Group had also been transferred away. If the higher-ups of the Ke Yuan Financial Group disappeared collectively, it might be a conspiracy by Dragon Palace City or Dong Huang. Then, if the core assets of the Ke Yuan Financial Group also disappeared, there was definitely a problem internally.
This was the worst situation for the Seven Islands.
“I hope your country can give us a reasonable explanation. In addition, shouldn’t your island’s guardian give us a certain explanation for attacking our Beast Tamer Dong Huang?” At this moment, after the Tyrannical Sea Legend finished playing the role of a good cop in Dragon Palace City, his tone suddenly rose as he said to the Warring States Legend and the Red God.
“Lu Bai, are you alright?”
At the same time, the Tyrannical Sea Legend looked at Shi Yu and immediately asked about Shi Yu’s situation. From Shi Yu’s arrogant appearance, it didn’t seem like anything was wrong.
“I’m fine,” Shi Yu said. “It’s that big guy who wanted to snatch my resources. If it weren’t for the power of the mystic realm stopping it, I might have died.”
Red God: “???”
Damn it, was this guy being reasonable? That cat had definitely been hiding beside him the whole time. Even if it didn’t block the fire, he was fine, alright? Moreover, its fire hand originally wanted to snatch resources, so why would he die!
“Legend of the Warring States, the agreement is clear in black and white. If the Seven Islands’ unsolved mystic realm is cracked by our country’s Beast Tamer during this period, the problem of the resource ownership is very clear. Therefore, what does your country’s guardian mean by snatching the resources??”
The Warring States Legend had a defeated look the whole time today. He looked at Red God in silence, and Red God’s rat tail swayed. It turned its head and didn’t look at him directly.
“Lord Red God has been asleep for a long time. It didn’t know about the bet. A Mythical-level resource and two Legendary-level resources suddenly appeared in the mystic realm. Such a powerful energy wave is even coming from Lord Red God’s protected territory. It’s normal for it to be awakened and protect the resources,” the legend of the Warring States said.
Legend Sea Tyrant was not satisfied with this statement and said, “This matter won’t end without ten legendary resources or a Mythical resource.”
Legend of the Warring States: ???
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of the Seven Islands could tell that this group of people were bandits!
At this moment, the people from the Dragon Palace, led by the Sea Dragon King, were also very surprised when they heard these conversations. This was because they only knew that Shi Yu had been bullied, but they didn’t know why Shi Yu had been bullied.
At that moment, when they heard that he was bullied because Shi Yu had dug up a mythical and two legendary resources on the Seven Islands, they immediately widened their eyes. They also wanted to bully Shi Yu and ask for protection fees.
Especially the Ice Dragon King, who said in shock, “Kid, is this for real? One mythical, two legendaries??”
“…” Shi Yu looked at the totem dragon kings who suddenly stared at him and the corners of his mouth twitched. Holy shit, could it be that these bandits had their eyes on him? They weren’t going to snatch a child’s money, right?
They should be exorting the Seven Islands!
Why were they staring at him!
“Yes… However, the two legendary resources are both fire-element. They don’t seem to be useful to you seniors.” There was no fire-element Dragon King in Dragon Palace City. This made Shi Yu heave a sigh of relief. At least he didn’t have to be worried.
“What is the Mythical resource?” the Sea Dragon King asked curiously. The other Dragon Kings also looked at Shi Yu eagerly. After all, Mythical resources were super top-notch resources even for them. They had a chance of being used to try to become top-notch totems and demigods!
At the mention of Mythical resources, Shi Yu smiled and said, “Let’s talk when we get back.”
That thing… was already in his stomach…
Fortunately, he had already eaten it. Otherwise, Shi Yu estimated that this group of Dragon Kings would be envious. At that time, no matter how he dealt with it, it would be very troublesome. It was better to eat it himself.
Of course, although he had eaten the Undying Fruit, Shi Yu didn’t plan to commit suicide. This thing was equivalent to a revival armor. It only had one effect. He could wait for himself to die of old age or in an accident.
Even Shi Yu didn’t know when the Undying Fruit he ate would take effect.
“Let’s talk when we get back!”
The totem dragon kings were extremely excited. At the same time, because of the conversation just now, these dragon kings thought of something.
Shi Yu was a super archeological genius who could even crack the Blue Sea Ruins and was recognized by the Dragon God.
In a mystic realm, Shi Yu had obtained one Mythical resource and two Legendary-level resources. Just now, weren’t the resources they were asking for too little in comparison??
The Ice Dragon King was very smart. It looked at the legend of the Warring States angrily and said, “We’ve changed our mind. Apart from what we mentioned just now, from today onwards, the ruins mystic realm of the Seven Islands will be permanently publicized to Dragon Palace City. All the gains from the mystic realms will belong to Dragon Palace City.”
They wanted to go all out!
The other Dragon Kings felt that it was very impressive.
Wonderful.
Legend of the Warring States: ???
The Dragon Palace City wanted to release Shi Yu on these guys!

chapters.title: Chapter 632  Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 632  Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (1)
Ice Dragon's words made the Dragon Kings feel that it was very good, and also made the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the others feel that it was very good.
What a genius idea.
As the victorious faction in the last world-wide totem battle, the seven countries currently enjoyed the richest resources.
Even countries that once lacked resources were rich after the totem battle.
Ruins and mystic realms were also a resource.
Among them, no matter which country it was, there was a pile of unsolved ruins and mystic realms.
Obtaining the permanent exploration right of a country's unsolved ruins mystic realm was much more exciting than ten legendary resources.
What was important was sustainable development!
"Alright, alright."
Old Master Ke was extremely excited. There was such a good thing?
If it really worked, he estimated that more than half of the archeologists in Bureau 11 would run over.
The Dong Huang archeological Association would also establish a Dong Huang branch on the Seven Islands.
After all, although there were more mystic realms in the Dong Huang Ruins, they were basically impossible to crack.
Dong Huang's archeologists had been messing around with old ruins and mystic realms all day. They were probably tired of it long ago. It was better to develop new resources to relieve their boredom.
At that time, it was suggested that the Seven Islands directly change their name to: [11th District].
"This is too much!!!"
Dong Huang felt that it was not bad, but the eyes of the legendary Warring States and the Red God Totem turned red.
Bastard, would Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City be stationed on the Seven Islands when the time came?
This kind of unfair treaty that disgraced the country was definitely impossible to accept, but… They looked at the covetous expressions of the six totem dragons and fell silent.
He only felt that the current situation had reached a certain level of disaster. He had to awaken the legend from seclusion.
Otherwise, they had no right to talk to these two factions equally.
"Please give us some time to investigate the relevant matters of the Ke Yuan Financial Group."
"After the investigation results appear, we will definitely give everyone a satisfactory explanation."
"At the moment, everyone is gathered here, but it can't solve the problem. The most important thing is to investigate the truth. If it's really as you say, after all, it involves the infiltration of the totem country into the Seven Islands."
The legend of the Warring States took a deep breath and said, "Compared to the internal conflict, the key is for us to cooperate and investigate that totem country."
At the moment, looking at Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City, no matter what the investigation results were, they would definitely eat a piece of the seven islands.
And the only way the current legend of the Warring States could think of to reduce the losses of the seven islands was to use this opportunity to start a war with a certain totem country.
Benefits from war could reduce the losses of the seven islands.
If the Ke Yuan Financial Group really betrayed the country, neither the Ke Yuan Financial Group nor the totem country behind them would be able to escape!
Although the seven islands were at the bottom of the seven-nation alliance, compared to most totem countries, they were still huge factions.
"Therefore, I hope to use the evidence of Dragon Palace City to carry out a joint investigation," the saga said. "In addition, I'll gather the higher-ups of the seven islands as soon as possible to officially negotiate about this matter."
In short, a large-scale conflict definitely couldn't happen here. With the destructive power of this group of totem dragon kings, even the Red God Island would probably sink. At that time, the losses would be even greater.
After the legend finished speaking, it looked at the dragons.
The Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City were silent.
Damn, so be it.
They also knew that forcing the legend of the Warring States at this moment couldn't solve anything. He couldn't afford so much compensation alone, so he still had to negotiate with the real representatives elected by the seven islands.
"Then let's investigate together," Tyrannical Sea Legend also said.
At that moment, apart from claiming resources, Dong Huang valued Yun An more.
After all, this was the totem king that had once caused the destruction of the Dong Huang Dynasty. Whether it made a comeback or if the faction it left behind was active in the dark was a very bad sign for Dong Huang.
The potential real threat had to be eliminated! Moreover, Yun An had another extraordinary meaning to Dong Huang…
They had to search in detail within the seven islands!
It would be best if they could find Yun An's main body!
If it came to the point where they had to use forbidden weapons, it was best to fight on the seven islands or other places, not involving Dong Huang.
"In that case, let's launch a joint investigation first!" The Sea Dragon King said. "The seven islands have to cooperate with the Environmental Protection Department led by the Ice Dragon King to investigate."
"The investigation this time must be supervised by Dragon Palace City the whole time. After all, the seven islands have yet to clear their suspicion of colluding with the totem country!"
"Apart from that, we will be stationed in the Seven Islands Region during this period until the matter is resolved!"
In any case, Dragon Palace City didn't plan to participate in the world competition. They had plenty of time to accompany the seven islands.
The Dragon Kings planned to freeload for a few months on the seven islands first. Although it would consume a lot of energy since they were all active, it would be no problem if the seven islands took care of food.
"Dong Huang will also immediately send a special investigation team to the seven islands to investigate the possible totem invasion," Tyrannical Sea Legend said.
"In addition, the seven islands have to give an explanation in the negotiation meeting!"
At this moment, the legend of the Warring States and the Red God wanted to cry.
Especially the legend of the Warring States. He didn't know why a good exchange event would become like this.
If he had known, he wouldn't have welcomed the Dong Huang exchange team this time.
The Legend of the Warring States and the others came to the Red God Island because they originally wanted to split the resources "Lu Bai" obtained from the Phoenix Mystic Realm no matter what, but now, forget about these three resources, why did the seven islands still owe 20 legendary resources?? They even wanted them to give up their land?

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
….
At this point, the conflict temporarily stopped to avoid escalation.
It was impossible for Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang to really have a violent conflict on the seven islands.
After all, there were still too many civilians. At that time, they would undoubtedly be condemned by the other allies. Of course, it would only be verbal condemnation.
Apart from that, the most important reason was that there was a legendary figure on the seven islands.
Be it the Legendaries of Dong Huang or the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, they basically only attacked when Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City were in danger. Therefore, if they forced the seven islands and ignited the killing weapon, the Seven Islands’ Valkyrie… Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City were unwilling to see this scene.
At the moment, no faction could withstand a demigod/legendary invasion without huge damage.
As long as the seven islands didn’t really betray the Seven Nation Alliance, this incident would ultimately be resolved at the negotiation table. Of course, from the current situation, there was no doubt that Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City, who were stronger and had a reason, would receive a large sum of compensation.
In the end, the six Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City pulled the “Red God” as a rat hostage and opened a temporary mystic realm on the Red God Island as a residence.
[Red God: QAQ]
As for the members of the Dragon Palace City Environmental Protection Department who came with the Six Dragon Kings, they entered Red God Island openly. They wanted to investigate the Ke Yuan Financial Group with the cooperation of the seven islands.
As for Dong Huang, they also decided to stop the exchange activity first and escort the members of the exchange team back to the country. Moreover, they would mobilize their battle power from Dong Huang to the seven islands.
At this moment, looking at the Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City, the gem cat, the Tyrannical Sea Legend, and Lu Bai entered the mystic realm space that the Sky Dragon King had temporarily opened. On the seven islands, the Legend of the Warring States and the others wanted to cry but had no tears. They were helpless.
The current tense situation had calmed down. However, this was clearly only the beginning. Neither the seven islands nor Dong Huang knew which side the situation would develop next.
“It’s over…”
In this conflict, even a legend like the president of the Red God Island couldn’t interrupt the whole time. Legend Xiao Yuan, God Lord Red Fire, and the others stood trembling underground the whole time.
Fortunately… there was no battle. Otherwise, none of them would have survived.

Of course, the most miserable victim of the seven islands this time was none other than the Phoenix Divine Society. Their home was gone.
Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court stood silently on Phoenix Mountain. The Phoenix Court’s Ji Yi and the other Phoenix Witches stood beside the legend of the Phoenix Court and silently looked at the ruined divine temple.
This was the first time they had seen so many totems and such a huge formation. For a moment, they had yet to recover from their fear.
“Teacher, what should we… do next?” Jie Yi asked.
Ji Xiang looked at her and said with a complicated gaze, “Next, lead them to find a place to settle down… I might have to go to Dong Huang.”
“Teacher, you want to find that ‘Lu Bai’ to ask about the Phoenix Mystic Realm, right?” Jie Yi immediately said, “I want to go with you.”
….
In the independent mystic realm established by the Space Dragon King.
It was like a super conference room.
After Dong Huang and the Dragon Palace entered, the Tyrannical Sea Legend said to Shi Yu,
“Next, you should return to the country first. There might be some conflict in the subsequent negotiation process. The higher-ups of the seven islands will probably all gather. If the other higher-ups of the seven islands are also involved with the totem country, it’s undoubtedly very dangerous to stay. After all, you’ve just obtained Mythical and legendary resources here.”
Shi Yu said, “I understand, I understand…”
He didn’t want to stay anymore.
“It’s just about my ten legendary resources… I have to find a reliable negotiator.”
Tyrannical Sea Legend: ???
“Do you really think the seven islands can take out 20 legendary resources?” The corners of the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mouth twitched.
“Don’t think too much. This negotiation will probably last for a long time. Compared to this, Yun An’s traces are the most important.”
“Then the right to explore permanently is fine too.” Shi Yu felt that Mother Dragon was right. After he became stronger, it would be more convenient to have a legal right to explore the seven islands.
Tyrannical Sea Legend sighed and felt tired.
At this moment, he thought of something and asked,
“What are the resources you obtained from the Phoenix Mystic Realm?”
“Yeah, what are the Mythical resources you obtained from the seven islands?!”
At this moment, as they entered the independent space, be it the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the Totem Dragon King, or the gem cat, they all stared at Shi Yu intently.
As for Shi Yu, he fell silent for a moment and revealed an embarrassed expression.
He said, “The two legendary resources are the Sun Flame Flowers, which cultivates the power of the sun.”
“Huh?”
Many Dragon Kings revealed bored expressions.
Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded. Just like the Sun Flame Flame in the Phoenix Mystic Realm outside, it was also the same as the description of the Undying Dark Phoenix. It looked like the Phoenix Mystic Realm was really an inheritance resource left behind by the Undying Dark Phoenix for Chi Tong?
“What is the Mythical resource!!!” Ice Dragon King roared. Damn it, it didn’t even obtain Mythical resources when exploring Mythical ruins like the Dragon God Ruins. Why could Shi Yu, this damn thing, obtain Mythical resources when he came to the seven islands?
“Well…”
“The situation was dangerous just now. That big flame guy wanted to attack me, and I was shocked. When I thought that there might be more seven island totems coming to snatch it later, I ate the Mythical resource first… That’s the Undying Divine Medicine, the Undying Fruit.”

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu scratched his cheek in embarrassment.
It meant that they should stop thinking about it.
The mythical resource has been eaten…
Silence, complete silence. At this moment, the entire mystic realm space was dead silent.
The moment these words came out of his mouth, every super life form present, including the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the Gem Cat, and the various totem dragon kings, widened their eyes and opened their mouths wide. Their hearts exploded.
“!!!!”
Among them, the extremely crude Ice Dragon let out a heart-wrenching cry.
Undying Fruit!!!
Wasn’t this the super Undying Divine Medicine that Emperor Shi had searched for but could never find?!
Shi Yu obtained it? He obtained it?
It was fine if he found it, but he even ate it himself??
What was this if not a waste!!!
The Tyrannical Sea Legend, the Totem Dragon King, and the gem cats looked at Shi Yu with stunned expressions.
“You, you, you ate it???” Legend Sea Tyrant was stunned.
“That Undying Fruit that will let you reincarnate into a totem-level undead after eating it, be it because of an accident or normal death??” The Sea Dragon King looked at Shi Yu in shock.
The Azure Dragon King, the Immortal Dragon King, the Thunder Dragon King, the Space Dragon King, and the other totem dragon kings looked at Shi Yu with red eyes.
What a waste.
Why did he eat such a good thing?
Wasn’t it good to give it to them?
He was a Beast Tamer. Shouldn’t he keep it for his pet??
“Yes, that Undying Fruit. If I die, my soul should be able to be preserved and become a totem-level undead life form,” Shi Yu said with a sigh.
“Do you feel anything else unusual?” Legend Sea Tyrant’s expression was complicated.
Was he not afraid that the fruit will have side effects??? How could he?
However, looking at Shi Yu’s lively appearance, he seemed to be fine.
In other words, Shi Yu’s next lifespan might be longer than that of a legendary Beast Tamer?
It could even survive for a thousand years and become the guardian ghost god with the longest inheritance of Dong Huang?
“No, oh, wait, the strength of my soul seems to have increased a little. I should be completely immune to soul and spiritual attacks below the totem level now. Even above the totem level, I should be able to avoid most of the damage,” Shi Yu said.
After eating the Undying Fruit, he could already clearly feel the power of his mental strength and soul power.
His body was already extremely strong. At this moment, after the Undying Fruit entered his mouth, there were no shortcomings inside or out.
From now on, if some enemies wanted to curse and attack him through mental abilities, it was very likely that they would be ignored by Shi Yu unless it were a totem level attack.
Unfortunately, there were no other obvious effects. The true effect of the Undying Fruit could only be displayed after death.
Of course, this was also not bad. The increase in mental and soul strength also meant that Shi Yu, after being possessed by Chi Tong, could erupt with stronger power.
Even if he didn’t eat the Time Fruit, with Chi Tong and Shi Yu’s current cooperation, it shouldn’t be a problem for them to clear the ten stages of the path of champion and defeat that Cloud Tiger head-on.
It could be said that the red-haired Shi Yu form now had the initial battle power of a “stable overlord”.
The strength was not much inferior to the gem cat before it broke through.
Though, he didn’t know if it was strong or weak.
Apart from that, Shi Yu felt that his meditation efficiency had also improved greatly. If nothing went wrong, the success rate of contracting an overlord-level pet with a level-six space would also be higher.
“Roar!!!” The Dragon Kings, the gem cat, and the Tyrannical Sea Legend still stared at Shi Yu.
At the thought of Shi Yu eating the Undying Fruit, their hearts bled.
“Wu wu.” Especially the gem cat, whose eyes were filled with tears.
Did anyone know how much effort it had spent to break through to the totem level? How long had it been saving up? It had gone through quite some pains…
As for Shi Yu, he had only become a Beast Tamer for a few years, but he was about to have totem-level strength.
At the thought that after Shi Yu died, his strength would immediately be on par with its own, the gem cat cried.
The other totem dragon kings and Tyrannical Sea Legends also instantly understood the meaning of Shi Yu eating the Undying Fruit.
Although it was impossible for Shi Yu to want to court death now, after he died, he would undoubtedly become Dong Huang’s new guardian.
Totem-level battle power!
If what Shi Yu said was true, then he could completely be on equal footing with the guardian level/totem level now.
In Dong Huang’s position, he would leap into the core circle, equivalent to a Titled Legendary expert, with one foot in the ranks of top experts!
The totem dragon kings looked at Shi Yu in front of them and were speechless.
“When do you plan to die?” Many experts asked Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “?”
“It’s best if I die of old age!” Shi Yu said.
Now, Shi Yu was most worried that he couldn’t die, especially after he had already become a Mythical Beast Tamer and cultivated a bunch of Mythical pets.
Then wouldn’t the Undying Fruit be eaten for nothing? What a waste.
As for why it was wasted, it was because he suspected that it shouldn’t be difficult to create an Undying Fruit after Baby Ginseng reached the Mythical stage.
….
At this moment, the seven islands were in turmoil.
Apart from the legendary Valkyrie, three of the guardians of the other five islands had already awakened.
Apart from the Warring States Legend, the other two Titled Legends of the seven islands also understood the cause and effect. They flew to Red God Island in silence.
Although the chances were not high, in order to prevent the conflict from escalating and causing damage to the new generation, Ice Dragon and the Gem Cat, as bodyguards, began to escort the non-legendary battle power of the Dong Huang exchange team back to the country under the teleportation of the Space Dragon King. The exchange activity was temporarily suspended.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - Officially Stepping Into the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Officially Stepping Into the World of the Top Experts (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, Zheng Hai, Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and the other members of the Dong Huang exchange team were in a ruins space. They were brought back to the country faster by the cat.
In the space, Zou Yun and the others felt that it was extremely exciting this time. They all knew what had happened just now.
Lu Bai cracked the Phoenix Ruins and obtained a Mythical and two Legendary resources!
It also attracted the guardian totem of the Red God Island to tear up the contract and snatch the resources!
It was a very soul-stirring matter, but because of the sudden reversal of the six totem dragon kings, Red God was slapped in the face!
As for the reason why the six totem dragon kings descended, it was because the Seven Islands Keyuan Financial Group and the totem faction had colluded to invade Dragon Palace City!!
Right on the heels of that, Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City joined forces to pressure the seven islands. The situation was unprecedentedly tense.
“Unfortunately, this kind of thing definitely can’t be publicized.” What a hot topic… Zou Yun felt that it was a pity.
“Speaking of which, where’s Lu Bai?” Zou Yun said.
“I don’t know, I didn’t see him,” Ji Feng said.
He should still be on the seven islands?” Ning Tianming said.
They were extremely envious. This Lu Bai was so ridiculous. Not only was he powerful, but he also became a key figure in cracking the seven island mystic realm. Even those famous archeological big shots in the country didn’t obtain one Mythical and two Legendary resources from the ruins mystic realm in one go, right?
Although they estimated that Lu Bai would still have to hand over these three resources, especially the Mythical resource, judging from Lu Bai’s performance, it was completely no problem for him to be rewarded with two legendary resources later.
This guy was already strong enough. If he obtained two suitable legendary resources, wouldn’t he be invincible?
“Zheng Hai, tell me. Weren’t you at the scene? What’s going on?” Zou Yun Heavenly King asked Zheng Hai beside him.
At this moment, Zheng Hai still had yet to recover.
He was filled with confusion.
Why were the totem dragon kings of Dragon Palace City so familiar with “Lu Bai”?
Why was there a guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University beside Lu Bai… Oh, no, it should be Dong Huang’s guardian gem cat now. Why was it protecting him?
Why did Lu Bai easily crack the Phoenix Ruins mystic realm even though he was clearly a disciple of a feeder?
Although this guy’s appearance, temperament, name, and age looked different from a certain person he knew, his identity configuration was too similar.
Moreover, that person had the Water Slime with abnormal strength, and Lu Bai’s ice-element pet had also appeared in the form of the Ice Slime King…
That person had the Phoenix hybrid heroic spirit that mastered the Sun Flame, while Lu Bai had the bird spirit that mastered the Phoenix Might of the Blue Ghost Flame!
Moreover, after this phoenix bird spirit possessed Lu Bai, it could actually make that realm disperse as if it had met its master. No matter how he thought about it, it didn’t seem right. It was too much of a coincidence.
So, this Lu Bai couldn’t be the person he was thinking of, right…
Zheng Hai’s expression was exaggerated, and the corners of his mouth twitched.
He could even make the connection. If nothing went wrong, soon, the seven islands might also be able to make the connection.
Sigh, of course, what made Zheng Hai most uncomfortable was that he didn’t know if he could still enter the Mythical Ruins of the seven islands to cultivate.
“Hey, hey, hey, Zheng Hai, what are you thinking about?” Zou Yun looked at Zheng Hai, who was sitting on the sofa in silence and deep in thought.
Zheng Hai was stunned. He raised his head and looked at Zou Tianwang. “It’s nothing. I just thought of a subtle and painful possibility.”
“I better not talk nonsense with you guys…”
The truth might be too cruel.
….
Seven islands, Red God Island.
Ji Xiang, the legendary Beast Tamer of the Phoenix Temple, was not concerned about the conflict between Dragon Palace City, Dong Huang, and the seven islands. At this moment, she was gathering information about the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already successfully arrived at Dong Huang, Demon Capital!
The signal between Dong Huang and the seven islands was not connected, so during the time he was on the seven islands, the information Shi Yu’s cell phone received from Dong Huang could not be displayed. There was a delay.
At this moment, after entering the Dong Huang Sea Region again, Shi Yu’s cell phone seemed to have been bombed. There were many messages.
Among them, the one who sent the most messages was the legendary Mechanic from Shen Feng.
[Dr. Shi Yu, when can we communicate?]
[Dr. Shi Yu, the Shen Feng exchange team has already arrived at Dong Huang. Among them is the mechanical pet that you want to study to master the ‘super alloy’ skill.]
[Dr. Shi Yu…]
Shi Yu was silent. He had almost forgotten about this guy. This Mechanic from Shen Feng had also participated in the Mechanical Conference at that time. He had been eyeing Shi Yu’s mechanical phantom beast technology and wanted to poach him.
At that time, Shi Yu only asked one question. Did the other party have a pet that had mastered the super alloy skill?
After this Dr. Aiqi said no, Shi Yu decisively ignored him.
He didn’t expect the other party to be so persistent… Shi Yu patted his forehead.
“Forget it.” He originally wanted to find an opportunity to replicate the superalloy skill on the seven islands on the way, but he seemed to have forgotten. In that case, it looked like he still had to deal with this Dr Aqi.
After replicating the skill, he could study Eleven’s Light and Darkness Evolution. However, before that, Shi Yu estimated that after returning to the country, it would be so troublesome to deal with various matters related to the seven islands. The association would have many things to ask him to understand.
“This matter is indeed more troublesome. It’s not just Yun An, but also the Abyss Duck… Let’s stay quietly and steadily in Dong Huang for a while…”
“Be good and add points. Should I go to the Heavenly Fox Nation first, Rongguang, or Tingxiang?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
However, he felt that he couldn’t use Lu Bai’s alias anymore.
Even if no one connected Lu Bai to Shi Yu, Lu Bai would probably be banned from Tingxiang and Rongguang.
Therefore, it was indeed more suitable to go to the Heavenly Fox Nation where vixens were everywhere… Shi Yu also had another plan, which was to use the [Bone Sword and Undead Revival] to kill some enemy overlords of the totem country to be Chi Tong’s servants. He felt that the nine-tailed fox was pretty good!

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Dong Huang, Demon Capital.
The specific incidents of the Seven Islands incident had already been sent back to Dong Huang before Shi Yu and the others.
President Lin of the Dong Huang Association had been waiting for Shi Yu and the others to return to Demon Capital for a long time.
Just as Shi Yu and the others arrived in Demon Capital, Shi Yu was summoned by President Lin.
In the absence of the mechanical legend, President Lin Xiao stood at the peak of Dong Huang’s power.
Division 13 of Dong Huang was established by President Lin alone. Division 13 was also led by President Lin Xiao alone.
He and the other titled legends also represented Dong Huang’s strategic power, which was comparable to a human-type forbidden weapon.
“Yun An’s tracks…”
“Two Sun Flame Flowers…”
“And the Undying Fruit you ate…”
In the private room, a young man in his twenties in luxurious clothes was drinking tea quietly. He looked calm, as if what happened on the seven islands still couldn’t shock him too much.
