President Lin looked at Shi Yu in front of him and fell silent. He put down his teacup.
As expected, he was a troublemaker. He was like a moving attraction, having some of his ancestor Lin Feng’s style.
However…
Whether there were factions on the seven islands that might collude with the Yun An faction, or that Dragon Palace City would one day attack the seven islands, or that there was really a possibility of Mythical and legendary resources appearing in the Phoenix Mystic Realm, President Lin Xiao actually expected all of the outcomes.
The only thing he didn’t expect was that the Mythical resource would actually be the Undying Fruit. Moreover, the fact that Shi Yu actually ate it directly.
“What good luck.” Even President Lin couldn’t help but sigh.
At the same time, he felt a little regretful.
If only such a fruit had appeared earlier.
If it could be eaten by the mechanical legend or the Dragon God, it might be able to be of greater use.
Of course, it was reasonable for Shi Yu to eat it. After all, this inheritance was left behind by the Undying Dark Phoenix for Shi Yu and the others. At the same time, Shi Yu and the others were the ones who cracked the Phoenix Mystic Realm.
It was alright. Compared to still relying on the older generation, believing in the new generation might be a good choice.
After eating the Undying Fruit, Shi Yu’s safety in the World Tournament would be greater.
He might not be able to determine the future of the other new generations, but Shi Yu…
Not only did he obtain the recognition of the Blue Sea Sprite, but he also obtained a Mythical opportunity. He would definitely become a totem-level guardian ghost in the future.
However, President Lin kept feeling that it was still a little unstable.
“You’ve already eaten the Undying Fruit. The Sun Flame Flower seems to be a useful resource for you, so you should use it reasonably.”
Shi Yu nodded crazily. “Yes, yes.”
In that case, he accepted it.
“Apart from that, I’ll give you a mission. The mission reward is a legendary resource.”
Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
“Anyone is good. Try your best to get married and have children before you turn 30. For every child you have, I’ll give you a legendary resource,” President Lin said.
“Pfft…”
Shi Yu almost spat out his tea. What kind of mission was this?
Although it looked simple and looked like legendary resources were readily available, why did he feel that it was even harder than cracking a Mythical Ruins?
“Next is to investigate Yun An with all our might.”
President Lin stood up. In his opinion, compared to seeking compensation from the seven islands, it was more reliable to deal with Yun An as soon as possible. It could strengthen Dong Huang’s national strength.
In particular, the Ke Yuan Financial Group had used the power of Yun An to develop a totem-level radiation monster without the seven islands noticing. This was impressive… The value of Yun An, this extraterrestrial monster, might be even greater than they had imagined at the start.
“President Lin, there’s one more thing…”
“Tell me.”
“Our Environmental Protection Department subdued the boss of the Western Abyss Sea, the Abyssal Demon Duck, on the seven islands.”
President Lin: “?”
“Reincarnation,” Shi Yu said. “As I have the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation here and can supervise it, I’ll keep it beside me and raise it first…”
President Lin was silent. This guy was the god of troublemaking.
…
After Shi Yu returned to Dong Huang, he returned to his original appearance.
After his secret meeting with President Lin, he rushed to Ancient Capital and went home.
Of course, there was also the gem cat that didn’t plan to return to the seven islands.
It yawned. Although it felt that it was pretty good to return to the seven islands to eat and drink with Bing Bing, considering that it was not safe there, it still decided to retire in Dong Huang.
“I have a feeling that as they talk, they will definitely fight on a small scale,” the gem cat muttered.
After all, the seven islands still had a legendary figure. It was impossible for her to still not come out after such a big thing…
It didn’t want to be beaten up!
“Can you look forward to something better?” Shi Yu said.
“Do you think we should look for the Undying Dark Phoenix after returning to the ancient capital?” the gem cat asked.
“Let’s ask about two more ruins locations.”
The Phoenix Mystic Realm was so fragrant.
Unfortunately, there were no resources it could use.
Gem, gem, gem! It wanted a gem!
“Forget it, forget it.”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He would digest his gains first.
This time, when he cracked the Phoenix Mystic Realm, he didn’t find any abnormalities in the Undead Battlefield in the ancient capital. This also made Shi Yu conflicted about the Undying Dark Phoenix’s words again.
Perhaps this guy was really a good person?
When Chi Tong reached the totem level and mastered the transcendent-level Sun Flame, should it really save the Undying Dark Phoenix?
Well, they definitely have to save it…
However, considering that the Undying Dark Phoenix Transformation might have been at the demigod level when it was alive and its methods were extremely terrifying, Shi Yu felt that it was not very stable to only master transcendent-level Sun Flame and totem-level strength to save it.
It was better to upgrade Chi Tong’s Sun Flame to the “Dao Proficiency” level and let Chi Tong’s strength approach that of a demigod. After possessing him, they could reach the level of a demigod. Then, they could save it. It was stable.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - Sigh, It’s Great Having Two
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
During the process of rushing to the ancient capital, Shi Yu sent a message to Dr Aqi of Shen Feng and arranged a time to meet him.
He was prepared to find an opportunity to replicate the “superalloy” skill.
Apart from Dr. Aqi, something else happened during Shi Yu’s time away. At the same time, Senior Lu had also sent Shi Yu a very important message.
The Void Mantis had broken through to the overlord level.
Fortunately, she successfully tricked the Void Mantis and became its guide to travel all over Dong Huang. For the time being, she could still meditate and cultivate in the Space Emperor Ruins.
When I go to the other three Space Emperor hatching bases, I might be able to call the Void Mantis along, Shi Yu thought.
Overlord-level spatial element.
And it was cultivated by the Space Emperor.
It should be better than Buggy.
It could be used during the time the gem cat went on strike…
…
Ancient Capital University.
Mechanic class.
Ever since “Dr. Shi Yu” developed the mechanical phantom beast system, this specialization had taken off.
The Mechanical Beast course had also become a compulsory course for Mechanic students of Ancient Capital University.
Even many students from other departments insisted on changing majors.
Including some other schools, they also sent exchange students to the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University to learn.
To readers! our content is stolen.Please copy and search this link " /39hpcn6j " to support us
For example, Fang Lan and her parents were currently studying and researching at Ancient Capital University…
For a moment, the limelight of the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University vaguely exceeded that of Star Capital and Imperial Capital University.
“Dean Hao.”
In the Mechanical College, Dean Hao had already regarded this place as his home.
At this moment, he was working hard in the office. He was definitely going to turn the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University into a top-notch specialization in the country.
Initially, this was hopeless, but because of the all-round genius of Ancient Capital University, everything became hopeful.
“Shi Yu???”
At this moment, when he heard a familiar voice from outside the door, Dean Hao was stunned. He immediately welcomed him in surprise. He ran over to open the door himself. After opening the door, he saw the energetic Shi Yu and laughed. “Why are you here?”
No more than ten people in Dong Huang knew that Shi Yu had gone to the seven islands, so Dean Hao thought that Shi Yu had been cultivating there for the past half a month.
After Shi Yu entered, he smiled and said, “I’ve made an appointment with Shen Feng’s exchange team. They should bring the ‘Alloy Monster’ to Ancient Capital University to visit later. I’d like to ask you to prepare some metal materials and cooperate with research to explore the evolution skills of the Alloy Monster.”
“Shen Feng exchange team?!” Dean Hao was stunned. “You invited them?”
“They also wanted to visit the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University previously, but they were rejected by me and Principal Feng.”
“This group of people has been thinking about the mechanical phantom beast technology these days.”
“Because they haven’t been able to get it, it’s been very noisy these few days.”
Shi Yu smiled. “Of course not. Just brush it off. I’m mainly more interested in their alloy monsters.”
Dean Hao nodded and said, “Alloy monster… What do you want it for?”
Shi Yu said, “It’s a superalloy skill. It can help pets complete evolution by fusing different metal powers. Don’t you think it’s very suitable for iron-eating beasts?”
“Ah…” Dean Hao had a strange expression.” It makes sense, but isn’t your Iron-eating Beast… ”
Didn’t it f*cking evolve into the Mythical race?!
Why was he still researching evolution!
Moreover, superalloy was a Mechanic skill.
Did he want to modify a mechanical panda?
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Eleven and I naturally don’t have many thoughts. Isn’t this to benefit the entire iron-eating beast race? After all, a conventional evolution method is too difficult. Not every iron-eating beast’s Beast Tamer can afford to consume it.”
As if ~
He wanted Eleven to continue evolving.
Although there were no other race levels during this period of time, even just a quasi Mythical race was insane. The difference in this level was incomparably huge.
After transcendent life forms reached the totem level, they were constantly optimizing their race. As a quasi-mythical race, the optimization of the Red God Totem of the seven islands would definitely be worlds apart from an optimization of a demigod like the Dragon God.
Therefore, evolution was endless.
“I see. Alright, basically, you want to prepare some rare metal materials,” Dean Hao said.
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Yes.”
….
Director Zhong of the Sequence Competition Committee was very happy that the Dong Huang exchange team that went to the seven islands returned early.
He immediately contacted Ji Feng, Zheng Hai, Zou Yun, Tong Yan, and Ning Tianming and pulled up an online chat.
Director Zhong: “I’ve already heard that there was an accident with the seven islands exchange, but you came back at the right time.”
Zou Yun: “What’s wrong, Director Zhong? Could it be…”
Director Zhong was the person in charge of the eighth bureau’s Education Bureau. At the moment, he was in charge of the Sequence Battle selection and a member of the Sequence Battle Committee. Under normal circumstances, if the exchange teams from other countries came to Dong Huang, Director Zhong was most likely one of the people who picked them up, just like when he received the Ming Hua exchange team.
Director Zhong: “Not long ago, the Shen Feng exchange team came to Dong Huang. Among them, there are two Shen Feng world competition contestants. In the beginning, they only carried out ordinary Mechanic academic exchanges, but in the past few days, they have started to challenge the Sequence contestants of Dong Huang.”
[Originally, they wanted to challenge the top ten of the Sequence, but you guys weren’t around when you went to the seven islands, so they started to challenge the top 20 of the Sequence. Now that they’ve basically challenged everyone, our people have all lost.]
[Every time they win, they like to post the results on social media. At the moment, the online reviews are very bad for us. We urgently need a victory.]

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 638: Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
[Many netizens hope that you can come out and fight, but you weren’t in the country at that time. Now, who’s interested?]
Zou Yun: “Me, me, me, me, me, me, me, me, me! I’ll do it! Don’t fight with me!!”
[I knew it was this matter. I have a lot of fans tagging me and asking me to fight when I return.]
In the Dark Club in Demon Capital, Heavenly King Zou’s eyes were red.
Damn it, he didn’t get any hot topics on the seven islands this time. After returning to the country, there were finally hot topics.
Thank you, Shen Feng’s friend, for laying the foundation for his popularity!!!
When he insta-killed this group of Shen Feng world contestants, he would directly take off!
Everyone: […]
Zheng Hai: “Aren’t Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and the others around?”
Director Zhong: “I can’t contact Lu Qingyi. For Shi Yu… Shen Feng’s exchange team is here for Shi Yu’s mechanical phantom beast technology. Shi Yu is probably avoiding them too. It’s better not to trouble him.”
Zou Yun: “So, leave it to me!”
Director Zhong wasn’t very convinced. “Little Zou, are you stable? Although the other party isn’t a legend, he’s a genius Mechanic of Shen Feng. He’s known as the Shen Feng Mechanical Gemini. He’s the first or the second person under legend in the new generation of Shen Feng under the age of 30.”
Zou Yun: “Huh?”
Ji Feng: “Let me do it. After dealing with the number one person below the legendary level of the seven islands, I can use the number one person below the legendary level of the Shen Feng to try. These people can’t be stronger than Shi Yu and Lu Bai, right?”
Director Zhong: “Eh? Looks like your experience on the seven islands is pretty rich. But who’s Lu Bai?”
Who was Lu Bai…
The Beast Tamers who went to the seven islands were stunned. Director Zhong actually didn’t know about Lu Bai?
Tong Yan: “A disciple of President Ye in the third bureau…”
Director Zhong: “When did Little Ye take in a disciple?”
….
Ancient Capital University.
After discussing with Dean Hao, Shi Yu (Buggy) teleported back to the dormitory and waited for the Shen Feng exchange team. He lay leisurely and swiped his cell phone, planning to rest for a day before working hard.
The matter of Shen Feng’s two mechanical Gemini coming to Dong Huang to challenge the Sequence contestants had indeed caused an uproar. It was everywhere on the Internet.
Shi Yu only swiped casually and saw the relevant news. He couldn’t help but yawn in boredom.
“They actually stole the show while Heavenly King Zou wasn’t around.”
“Old Zou is probably so angry that he exploded.”
Shi Yu chuckled. What made Heavenly King Zou uncomfortable was that he might not be able to defeat the other party.
The number one or second person below legendof the new generation of Shen Feng…
Shen Feng’s strength was not something Ming Hua and the Seven Islands could compare to.
The champion of the last World Tournament was won by the legendary Mechanic of Shen Feng. Now that more than 20 years had passed, it was unknown if that Mechanic had broken through from legend to the legendary level after being blessed by the World Tree.
If he broke through to the legendary level, Shen Feng would have three demigod/legendary experts.
Therefore, the number one or second person of the new generation of legends in Shen Feng was completely winnable for geniuses like Ji Feng and Lu Qingyi. Heavenly King Zou probably couldn’t defeat them.
“Why are there so many people tagging me?” Shi Yu realized that on the Internet, there were many voices calling him, Lu Qingyi, and Zou Yun to fight.
The two young Beast Tamers of the Shen Feng exchange team were too high-profile, causing the young people of Dong Huang to feel very unhappy with them.
But they couldn’t defeat them themselves, so they could only tag Big Bosses to come out and fight.
“This…”
Shi Yu scratched his ear and thought for a moment. It wasn’t impossible.
After all, he was the one who provoked the Shen Feng exchange team to Dong Huang. It was not a problem for him to clean up the mess.
However, he had just invited the Shen Feng exchange team to study the alloy monster together. Wasn’t it too unfriendly to beat up their contestant?
Should he fight after studying it?
“Forget it, why don’t I let ‘Lu Bai’ finish them?”
Shi Yu thought for a moment and took out a Time Fruit to eat.
As the special Time Fruit entered his mouth, Shi Yu’s body immediately shrank and his hair turned white.
Then, he summoned Chi Tong’s possession and clone.
In an instant, apart from Shi Yu, who was sitting on the sofa, a “Lu Bai” clone immediately appeared on the ground because of the clone skill.
After splitting out his clone, Shi Yu’s main body removed the possession and time power and returned to the form of the black-haired Shi Yu. On the other side, Shi Yu’s Lu Bai clone was still standing on the ground, waiting for Shi Yu and Chi Tong to control it.
“Lu Bai, can you deal with the number one person below the legend level of the new generation of Shen Feng?” Shi Yu asked.
Lu Bai rubbed his eyes and said weakly, “Don’t talk to yourself, alright? You look really dumb.”
“Mi!! (This is what I wanted to say)” Beside him, Chi Tong was speechless.
Shi Yu smiled. At the moment, after eating the Undying Fruit, his soul power had increased greatly. With Chi Tong possessing him, he could obtain stable overlord-level battle power. At this moment, even if it was a clone, in Shi Yu’s opinion, it wouldn’t be much inferior to Senior Lu and Ji Feng’s trump cards.
And this was only under the situation of the clones of Shi Yu and Chi Tong.
If it was Shi Yu and Chi Tong’s main body, their strength could still be stronger.
If he distributed another pet, it would be even stronger.
“Chi Tong, transform into a blue bird spirit and challenge the number one person below the new generation of legends with your clone later.”
“Of course, this isn’t very stable. Bring Susu and Ling along. Ling stays home all day to study the Tyrant Dragon. How boring. Let it fight too.”
[Ling: Master, thank you.]
“Mi!! Chu!”
Chi Tong changed from the form of a sword spirit to a blue bird spirit. It landed on the clone’s shoulder happily, indicating that it understood.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
When the three sisters went out to battle, the land would be desecrated!
Shi Yu continued to lie down. Sigh, clones were so useful. It was like he had two alternate game accounts.
With a clone, he could let his pet bring the clone to fight everywhere, and he would slack off!
….
At the same time.
A plane was heading to Ancient Capital.
In the plane, the seven-man-sized Shen Feng exchange team members had different expressions.
Dr Aqi, who was in the lead, looked troubled.
Hard work paid off. This damn Shi Yu finally agreed to communicate with them.
And the premise was to let Dong Huang study the unique pet alloy monster of their Shen Feng.
If it were other technological products, Shen Feng might still be conflicted, but the alloy monster… The seven islands also mastered this technology, so there was no problem. If Shen Feng didn’t give it to him, Dong Huang could also go to the seven islands to study it. It was better to let Shi Yu get his way in this case, lest the seven islands beat him to it.
Therefore, Dr Aqi immediately gathered some researchers from his hometown and let them bring two alloy monsters over.
Among them, the two strongest Mechanics under the legendary level among the new generation under the age of 30 also came over.
They were extremely curious about this Dr. Shi Yu, the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang. They had long wanted to learn from him.
Unfortunately, they had not even a single trace of him.
“I can finally see that Dr. Shi Yu.”
On the plane, a golden-haired young man spun a key with anticipation in his eyes.
“Lundi, several Beast Tamers in the front row of the Sequence on Dong Huang’s side suddenly responded to the challenge. Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and the others.” Beside him, a blonde and blue-eyed woman held a cell phone and said in surprise.
Lendi shook his head and said, “Don’t worry about them. We just have to challenge the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang.”
“The two of you, shut up!” Dr Aqi said angrily. “Don’t mess around. Our goal is the mechanical phantom beast technology. We want to befriend this Dr. Shi Yu, not let the two of you challenge him!”
“Can the two of you save me some trouble?”
The blonde woman smiled and said, “Doctor, how can Dong Huang communicate with us about mechanical phantom beasts? We just have to deal with the tasks above. Don’t tell me you really think you can gain anything?”
“Why don’t we let this Shi Yu see the strength of our Shen Feng? When he knows the strength of Shen Feng, he might directly join our Shen Feng. No matter what, we’re also the number one country among the seven countries.”
Aqi said, “That won’t do either!”
Lendi said helplessly, “Then answer the challenge of that Ji Feng and Zou Yun.”
….
The Shen Feng exchange team arrived very quickly. During this period of time, they had encountered a wall in Dong Huang for a long time. This time, Shi Yu and Ancient Capital University finally agreed to communicate with them. The Shen Feng exchange team was extremely teary-eyed.
As the number one technological country, when they went to other countries to communicate about the Mechanic class, they had never suffered such grievances!
The only regret the two young Mechanics had was that the leading doctor didn’t allow them to challenge Shi Yu, afraid that it would ruin the friendship between the two countries and cause them to be unable to obtain the mechanical phantom beast technology.
At the second airport of the ancient capital, a tall, white-skinned exchange team walked out of the airport. When the people by the roadside saw them, they started discussing.
“The Beast Tamers of the Divine Eagle Nation?” A passerby immediately exclaimed after discovering them.
This group of people had not stopped in Dong Huang recently. They were even more high-profile than the previous Ming Hua exchange team!
In Shen Feng, Internet communication was much more developed than Dong Huang, so the people and Beast Tamers there had developed the habit of showing off on the Internet.
Therefore, the itinerary for the past few days, especially the battle experience, was announced online anytime and anywhere. They even registered on Dong Huang’s social media accounts because of this.
Many Beast Tamers were also familiar with Dr Aqi, who was in the lead. This was because this guy’s arrogant performance at the Mechanical Conference made the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang very unhappy.
As soon as they appeared in the ancient capital, they immediately attracted a lot of attention and guessed their goal in coming to the ancient capital.
“I knew it. We can quickly become famous in Dong Huang.” Listening to the chattering around him, Lendi, who was looking straight ahead, smiled. He looked smug and enjoyed this feeling very much.
“Although it’s not really a friendly kind of famous,” the blonde woman, Elise, said casually.
Apart from the two of them, the other five middle-aged and old Mechanics were also chatting. “Now, I’m more and more certain that in the past 20 years, our technological level has already far exceeded Dong Huang.”
“This is very normal. Among our Beast Tamers, Mechanics account for more than 50%, and it’s already not bad for Dong Huang to have 5%. Obviously, they haven’t given up on the other Beast Taming branches.”
“However, it can’t be denied that there are indeed some geniuses among them. If this Shi Yu can migrate to Shen Feng, he can definitely obtain better development. His talent will be delayed in Dong Huang.”
The few old men discussed and spoke in bird language that others couldn’t understand. After coming out of the airport, they directly walked in the direction of Ancient Capital University.
Although the surrounding passers-by were curious, they didn’t dare to take photos of them and go up to talk to them. They could only take out their cell phones and use words to post that the Shen Feng exchange team had come to the ancient capital.
After all, among this group of people, they were all above top-notch masters. Taking another look was also very stressful for passers-by.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 640: Sigh, It’s Great Having Two Alternate Accounts (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Shen Feng’s Beast Tamers?” In the crowd, a figure frowned and looked at them.
“An Chang, stop looking. You can definitely surpass them in the future.” A delicate girl tugged at the young man’s clothes and said, “An Chang, An Chang, let’s go watch a movie.”
“I said, I’m not free. Stop following me.” The first-year student of Ancient Capital University, An Chang, looked at this girl helplessly. This was a genius Beast Tamer from the same vocation assessment as him. He had defeated her before, but now… was she pursuing him?
An Chang had already rejected her. In his opinion, if he wanted to catch up to Senior Shi Yu, he had to use all his time to cultivate. Being in a relationship would only delay his Beast Taming speed.
“Huh?” An Chang was just about to refuse again when he suddenly realized that a figure had stopped the Shen Feng exchange team in front of him. He looked over with a shocked expression.
It was a white-haired young man less than 1.7 meters tall who looked extremely weak. On his shoulder stood a blue Ghost Fire Bird Spirit. On his wrist was a technological white mechanical watch.
An Chang could sense that both the blue Ghost Fire Bird Spirit and the white mechanical watch were very powerful pets!
It was so powerful that it was definitely not something his strength could compare to.
The appearance of this white-haired youth also stunned the people from the Shen Feng exchange team who were heading to Ancient Capital University. Many passers-by around them cast surprised gazes.
After Shi Yu’s clone, Lu Bai, found the group of people from the Shen Feng exchange team, he looked at the golden-haired young man and girl and coughed weakly. “Sorry to disturb you. Are you Lendi and Elise, from Shen Feng?”
“Who are you?” The golden-haired young man looked at the weak white-haired young man in front of him in confusion.
“Lu Bai, Beast Tamer of Dong Huang. I heard that the two of you are pretty strong. I’ve come to take a look.” A smile appeared on Lu Bai’s weak face.
Upon hearing that, the surrounding passers-by were immediately shocked. These two Mechanics, Shen Feng, had been very famous in Dong Huang recently. They had defeated most of the Beast Tamers in Sequence 10 to 20. This person actually took the initiative to challenge them?
Lu Bai… Who was this?
Why had they never heard of it?
“An Chang, do you know this person?”
Beside An Chang, the delicate ponytail girl was also attracted by Shi Yu’s clone.
“No, I don’t, but…” An Chang said,” He looks very strong. ”
“How can you tell??”
“Weak,” An Chang said. “He looks very weak. This means that he has cultivated too much. That white hair is the best proof.”
“He became weak but also stronger.”
The ponytail girl was stunned. What nonsense was this?
Shouldn’t it be becoming bald that made one stronger?
At this moment.
The sudden challenge of this white-haired young man named Lu Bai undoubtedly made many passers-by watch the commotion, and also made the challenged Lendi smile.
“Sorry, I won’t accept the challenge of an unknown Beast Tamer.”
“Let’s go.” Elise wasn’t interested either. She still had to see the mechanical phantom beast next and couldn’t waste time.
“Your courage is much inferior to the number one person in the new generation of the seven islands, the Thousand River Hundred God, and the number one person below the legends of the seven islands, the Demon Blade Shen Dai.” Shi Yu’s clone revealed a playful smile.
At this moment, when they heard these two names, Lun Di and Elise’s expressions changed.
The relationship between Shen Feng and the seven islands was very close. This was because the Mechanic class of the seven islands had once been supported by Shen Feng alone. Therefore, Shen Feng knew the situation of the seven islands very well. The two of them naturally knew the status of the Thousand River Hundred God and Demon Blade mentioned by Shi Yu.
What they didn’t understand at this moment was why this Beast Tamer of Dong Huang also knew so much.
Moreover, from his tone, he had even fought with the two of them?
“What do you mean?” Lundy said.
“It means that they weren’t so afraid when fighting me.”
Shi Yu’s words made Lendi and Elise fall silent. Who was this person? Why could he fight the Thousand Rivers Hundred God and the Demon Blade of the seven islands? Why didn’t they have any information?
“Alright, then I’ll waste some time on you.” In order to figure out what was going on with this white-haired youth, Lendi narrowed his eyes and said.
Seeing this, Dr Aqi and the others were silent for a moment. They felt that it was very troublesome. Unlike Lendi, they were not interested in this Lu Bai at all.
Dr Aqi said, “Lendi, follow when you’re done. Elise, you go with Lendi.”
“…” Elise was stunned and said helplessly, “Alright then.”
With that said, Dr Aqi and the others continued walking towards Ancient Capital University. They didn’t think that the two of them would lose to a baffling Beast Tamer from Dong Huang.
As for Lendi and Elise, they stared at the mysterious white-haired young man who stopped them.
“A full team fight then,” Lu Bai said. “Follow me to the Ancient Capital Arena.”
“Alright.” Lendi cracked his fingers and smiled.
At this moment, the passers-by beside him were completely shocked. They didn’t expect that these two mechanical Gemini of Shen Feng would actually really accept the challenge of this white-haired youth who came out of nowhere.
“Damn, who exactly is this person?”
“I’m not sure. In any case, it can’t be a student from Ancient Capital University.”
“Of course.”
The passers-by discussed it again. Many people directly followed Lu Bai, Lendi, and the others to see if they could sneak into the Ancient Capital Arena and watch the battle.
An Chang hesitated for a moment and immediately followed.
“Eh, An Chang, wait, wait for me.”
….
Ancient Capital University.
Because of the visit of the Shen Feng exchange team, Principal Feng was also forced to open for business. After all, there were two legendary Mechanics in the other party’s team.
Of course, he wasn’t afraid that the other party would cause trouble. The guardian of Ancient Capital University was the strongest among the nine universities!
Principal Feng, Dean Hao, and Shi Yu had been waiting for Dr Aqi and the others for a long time.
Although they had a deep grudge just now, as they saw Shi Yu in person, the faces of these Divine Wind Mechanics immediately bloomed like brilliant chrysanthemums.
“It’s good to see you again, Dr. Shi Yu ~”

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 641: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Location, Ancient Capital Arena.
This was the largest battle arena in Ancient Capital City.
The highest defense facilities could withstand overlord-level battles.
As the Sequence battle project began, if Ancient Capital City carried out a high-level Sequence battle, it would basically be carried out here.
“Master Qian, bad news.”
It was Qian Tongming, the in-charge of the Ancient Capital Arena, a top-notch master.
At this moment, he received his subordinate’s message and revealed a shocked expression.
“Those two Shen Feng Nation Mechanics who go around challenging Sequence contestants have come to our arena!”
“There’s also a white-haired Beast Tamer with them. From the license level, he’s also a top-notch master. They should be fighting!”
“This… These two scourges, why are they in Ancient Capital?” Master Qian cursed. He directly put on his coat and rushed to the arena under the stunned expressions of his subordinates.
At the same time, he was puzzled. Who was the white-haired top-notch master?
Outside the Ancient Capital Arena.
Shi Yu’s clone, Lu Bai, and the two Mechanics, Shen Feng, were waiting in the hall for the staff to arrange the battlefield.
The Beast Taming license Shi Yu handed over was actually fake. It was for the convenience of going to the seven islands.
Of course, because it was forged by the officials of Dong Huang, it was actually not fake.
Even in the headquarters’ database, one could find someone like Lu Bai.
And using this identity card to use the battle facilities of the Ancient Capital Arena was naturally not a problem.
As for the Beast Taming License of Shen Feng’s mechanic Lendi, it had also been activated when he came to Dong Huang. He could also use some of Dong Huang’s battle facilities.
Therefore, their battle application was very smooth.
At this moment, after confirming their identities, Shi Yu and the others chose the “bet battle”, which was the battle mode Shi Yu had used with the top student Chen Kai for the first time. Whoever lost would pay the venue fee.
The two of them weren’t in a Sequence battle, so the officials naturally wouldn’t give them free use of the venue.
After choosing, Shi Yu sighed. Why not update the venue of the Ancient Capital Arena?
This was a free opportunity. He just had to extort it later.
“Master Lendi, Master Lu Bai, the security guard said that there are many passers-by outside who want to watch the battle…”
The female staff carefully asked for Lu Bai and Lendi’s opinion.
Under normal circumstances, both parties had the right to refuse and fight in private.
Of course, if the two parties didn’t mind, the arena could also open the audience seats and let the audience in.
“Ask him.” Lendi casually shook his golden hair and said,
“I don’t mind, but your Beast Tamers in Dong Huang seem to like to fight secretly. Are you afraid that your trump cards will be seen through?”
“But no matter what, I’ll say this in advance. If you lose, I’ll still record your defeat.”
Lu Bai smiled. “The audience? It doesn’t matter. Let them in.”
“Hey, you just said that you fought with the Thousand River Hundred God of the seven islands and the Demon Blade. What happened? Who won?”
At this moment, after arriving at the Ancient Capital Arena, the blonde Mechanic, Elise, who was browsing her cell phone behind Lendi, looked up and asked.
“You’ll know after the battle.”
Shi Yu’s clone, Lu Bai, chuckled.
These words made Lendi and Elise show unfriendly expressions. Damn it, he really deserved a beating. Could it be that he had heard the names from somewhere and was here to trick them?
“Very confident. Then you shouldn’t mind if I do a live broadcast.” Elise pursed her lips.
….
“We’re in!!!”
“Yay!”
Shi Yu and Lendi didn’t care if there were spectators. After checking the identities of the spectators in the arena, those with qualified identities were let in one after another.
Students from Ancient Capital University like An Chang naturally entered the audience seats easily.
He found a place to sit down in anticipation and took a deep breath to observe the situation below.
In the front row of the audience, there was also a blonde woman sitting. There was no one sitting around her. Idly, Elise summoned her mechanical pet and let it connect to the cell phone.
A moment later, a live-stream called “Another Overconfident Challenger” appeared on her social media platform.
In the past few days since Lundy and Elise came to Dong Huang, if their opponents allowed it, they would often do this to broadcast battles to increase their attention.
This effect was indeed very good. In just a few days, because of their powerful strength and their identities as foreign Mechanics, they obtained more than a million followers.
At that moment, Elise started broadcasting again. The Beast Tamers from Dong Huang, who was paying attention to her, immediately received the news.
[Damn, these people came to the ancient capital???]
In Ancient Capital University, the “Dragon King” and “Dragon Knight” Yu Shu were also one of the people who paid attention. The moment he saw the cover of the live-stream, he could tell that this was the arena of Ancient Capital.
Because of the ostentation and strength of these two Divine Wind Shen Feng Mechanics, Yu Shu really wanted to teach them a lesson himself, but he had yet to develop completely.
[If they’ve come to the ancient capital, open the door and let Shi Yu loose on them!!] Yu Shu was anxious.
However, from the looks of it… the challenger didn’t seem to be Shi Yu?
It was a Beast Tamer he didn’t know?
Yu Shu revealed a regretful expression. At the same time, he was worried about this Beast Tamer.
After all, this Lendi was really strong…
Demon Capital, Dark Club.
Because he had responded to the challenge of the mechanical Gemini, Zou Yun also used his alternate account to pay attention to their movements.
He also received their broadcast reminder immediately and clicked on it.
This was impressive. After entering the live broadcast channel, he immediately opened his mouth wide and revealed a shocked expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
[Holy shit.]
Heavenly King Zou’s heart trembled. This was because in the live broadcast, apart from Lendi, who had been very famous in Dong Huang recently, he knew the other two Beast Tamers standing on the battlefield.
White hair, a weak face, and a short stature. Wasn’t this Lu Bai!!!
[Holy shit, my trending topic is gone again!!!]
Heavenly King Zou thought of this possibility immediately.
If it were other challengers, apart from the top ten Sequence contestants, Heavenly King Zou judged that the Shen Feng Mechanic most likely had a higher chance of winning.
However, if the challenger was this white-haired youth, then what were these two Divine Wind Mechanics doing?
In the end, these two were only the strongest experts under the age of 30 and below the Legendary level.
However, Lu Bai had even insta-killed the number one person below the legendary level, and they didn’t restrict age limits on the seven islands. He had even insta-killed overlord-level ferocious beasts. These two probably couldn’t escape the fate of being insta-killed.
Heavenly King Zou’s expression was indignant and sympathetic…
At the same time, he quickly took a screenshot of the live broadcast and forwarded it to the small group that Director Zhong had just created.
It was attached: “It’s already over. Do we… still need to challenge?”
….
On Director Zhong’s side, he had already heard about Lu Bai’s battle results on the seven islands from Heavenly King Zou and the others.
However, he really didn’t know this person.
President Ye had another disciple?
He had never heard of it.
But if it was true, this Lu Bai was too terrifying. His strength was even stronger than Ji Feng and even exceeded Lu Qingyi. He might be able to catch up to Shi Yu.
Why didn’t such a person register to participate in the Sequence battle?
Could it be that it was really as Zou Yun and the others said, that he was weak and didn’t want to participate in such an activity?
It didn’t look like it at all!
Director Zhong contacted President Ye to ask about the situation.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t contact him.
After all, President Ye was also a busy person. He wasn’t free at all times.
Everything was still unclear, but as Heavenly King Zou sent the message to the group, it immediately attracted Director Zhong’s attention.
Director Zhong, Zou Yun, Ji Feng, Zheng Hai, and the others also followed this battle through this live broadcast.
….
Ancient Capital Arena.
Master Qian Tongming rushed over. In a battle of this level, he could only be the judge.
However, neither this Lendi nor this Lu Bai seemed to know him very well, nor did they care who the judge was. This made the corners of Master Qian’s mouth twitch.
It didn’t matter. Master Qian looked at the white-haired youth with a burning gaze. He was also very puzzled. Who exactly was this guy?
Top-notch master license… In Dong Huang, there were a good number of top-notch masters, but not many.
There was no reason for him not to know such a young top-notch master. Moreover, this Lu Bai didn’t participate in the Sequence battle. It was too strange.
Not only was Master Qian puzzled, but the Beast Tamers who entered were also very confused.
However, they were happy to see someone step forward to challenge these two Shen Feng Mechanics.
“It’s just a little difficult. The Beast Tamers in the top ten of the Sequence were crushed by these two people. This person can’t be stronger than them, right?”
“That’s hard to say. After all, he took the initiative to challenge. He must have some understanding of these two Shen Feng people before challenging…”
No matter what the audience said, Lendi and Shi Yu had already walked onto the battlefield.
The two of them stood looking at each other, and their auras involuntarily emitted, like two ferocious beasts.
Master Qian Tongming’s heart skipped a beat. He understood that this battle was probably not that simple…
He raised his arm and took a deep breath. After seeing that both parties were ready, he said directly,
“Both parties…”
“Ready…”
As Master Qian Tongming was giving the battle command, Elise, who was broadcasting in the front row of the audience, smiled and said,
“Do you know why I said he was an overconfident challenger?”
“I’m free anyway. Let me analyze it for you.”
“Look at that ‘Lu Bai’. The white watch on his wrist is actually a Mechanic life form.”
“Look at the blue bird spirit on his shoulder. That’s clearly an undead.”
“This guy contracted undead and a machine. Is he collecting them?”
In the Beast Taming World, in most cases, specialization was stronger.
For example, Dragon Tamers who specialized in dragons, Mechanics who specialized in mechanical lives, Spirit Mediums who specialized in undead lives… They were much stronger than Beast Tamers without contract plans.
Their team configuration was more systematic and compatible.
In comparison, “Lu Bai” had an undead beside him and was wearing the configuration of a mechanical life. No matter how one looked at it, he was an outlier.
Moreover, Elise used her energy detection device to take a look. The energy value of these two pets…
One was 2.33 million, and the other was 2.5 million. Although it was not bad, compared to them, even if this guy had explosive skills and strengthening skills, it felt completely lacking.
Unless there were still stronger pets hidden. This was the only possibility.
[Stupid.] As Elise analyzed, Ji Feng and the others revealed mocking expressions as they watched the live broadcast.
What she said might make sense, but this guy couldn’t be treated as a normal person…
There were many capable people in Dong Huang who cultivated different types of pets into very strong pets!
For example, Shi Yu, the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, wasn’t specialized in a certain type of pet!
“Battle… begin!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Some people felt that Elise’s analysis made sense, while others ignored her analysis. As the judge gave the starting order, Lendi and Lu Bai on both sides of the arena entered battle mode at the same time!
“Come out, my invincible partner!!” After the battle began, Lendi shouted excitedly.
A strong energy wave immediately spread on the arena!
At the same time, a dazzling light bloomed in front of him!
“Roar!!!…”
On Lendi’s side, he summoned a huge pet more than ten meters tall. It was a dragon!!!
The moment it appeared, the venue immediately changed. The sky suddenly darkened, and golden lightning shot out from the black clouds!!
This huge dragon’s brown strong body was wrapped in golden mechanical armor. Its long dragon horn was like a sharp sword, and sharp steel teeth spread on its frilly head.
A long dragon tail circled around its body. Its two strong feet slowly left the ground and flew up with a pair of huge wings that looked like black light wings.
During this process, as several purple summoning arrays appeared, the vibrating electric saw was armed on the mechanical dragon’s arms. Under the magnetic connection, the two huge electromagnetic cannons perfectly fused with the mecha on its shoulder.
Mechanical dragon, go!
“Gulp.”
As this mechanical dragon floated up, strong winds and pressure spread in all directions. The surrounding audience swallowed their saliva and revealed shocked expressions. The Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast were also slightly silent.
Not many people doubted Shen Feng’s mechanical modification technology.
The reason why Shen Feng was also called the Divine Eagle Nation was because they had mastered the most perfect biological modification technology. They had once modified a huge eagle with the strength of a top-notch totem into the strength of a demigod.
This purebred dragon race was a natural overlord race and was incomparably powerful. If they couldn’t strengthen its original strength, Mechanics definitely wouldn’t make an unnecessary move to modify it. This mechanical dragon… was definitely stronger than the foundation of a dragon!
“Roar!!!”
In the sky, not only was the mechanical dragon modified into a mechanical life form, but there were also several mechanical lives armed with it.
In a short moment, the energy fluctuations on the mechanical dragon’s body exceeded 30 million, approaching the lowest standard of an overlord race. Under this terrifying pressure, the ground and air began to tremble.
The mechanical dragon’s red eyes stared at their common opponent with its Mechanic.
“Lendi’s mechanical dragon has a second energy source loaded in its body. Its actual energy is twice the energy that can be detected. At the same time, its brain has also been modified. Its reaction speed is faster than spiritual pets, comparable to a computer.”
“Apart from that, every equipment it’s armed with has an independent energy source and a support skill to strengthen its main body. It can form extremely strong combination profundities. Most of the previous Sequence contestants lost to him,” Elise said with a smile.
“Let me see. The current surface energy value of the mechanical dragon… is about 34 million.”
Her words made the Beast Tamers who were watching the live broadcast fall silent. There were few people who were all Sequence 10 to 20 contestants. They had fought this Lendi before and knew this guy’s strength the best.
“Machinery modifying a dragon is ridiculous…” At this moment, even through the live broadcast screen, most people could feel the pressure of the mechanical dragon. The Beast Tamers present, including An Chang and the others, looked at the mechanical dragon wrapped in lightning and were shocked by its strength.
At this moment, Master Qian, who was the judge, instantly understood why the previous contestants of Dong Huang had lost to this guy.
In the arena, strong winds rose.
It was enveloped in the shadow of the floating mechanical dragon.
Lendi crossed his arms and looked at the white-haired youth opposite him playfully.
At this moment, “Lu Bai”‘s expression was very calm.
As the mechanical dragon appeared, he also entered battle mode.
“Machinery armor, sniper form…”
In the strong wind, the white-haired and white-skinned “Lu Bai”, with his slender figure and muscular hands and feet, looked like they would be blown down by the strong wind at any time.
He was wearing very ordinary gray sweatpants and a white mesh coat. As he entered battle mode, the white mechanical watch on “Lu Bai’s” wrist immediately changed into a white sniper rifle nearly a meter long with a light.
If an ordinary person used such a huge sniper rifle, they would definitely have to find a place to support themselves. However, the strength of a Beast Tamer was different from that of an ordinary person. Just like that, “Lu Bai” held the huge sniper rifle in one hand, stretched out his arm, and aimed at Lendi opposite him. His aura was not at all inferior.
This scene also fell accurately into the vision of Lendi and Elise.
They subconsciously sneered.
Therefore, this “Lu Bai” was very amateurish.
They could tell at a glance that the type of this sniper rifle was centered around the Hundred Transformations Stone.
The change speed was not slow, but there were usually only two types of Mechanics who played with this mechanical material. One was an expert, and the other was a newbie.
Experts usually formed various complicated fighter jets, mechas, and extreme mechanical operations with huge numbers of Hundred Transformations Stones.
And this guy had turned the Hundred Transformations Stone into an ordinary sniper rifle. Wasn’t this a joke? He was clearly a newbie.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - Blue-haired Spear God Lu Bai vs
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Blue-haired Spear God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
They might have overestimated this “Lu Bai”.
As for the audience, although they couldn’t determine the type and level of the mechanical weapon in “Lu Bai’s” hand, just from the appearance, one was a mechanical modified dragon, and the other was a mechanical gun that could be bought anywhere on the market. The level of technology was also immediately determined, making many people reveal serious expressions.
They were very worried about Lu Bai.
“What are you smiling about?”
Lendi still had his arms around him. He was on the battlefield and was not worried at all. From the looks of it, he had a backup plan to ensure his safety. In Shi Yu’s eyes, his smile was the one who overestimated himself.
As Shi Yu spoke, Shi Yu raised his arm and aimed the muzzle at the mechanical dragon.
Because he was worried that if he aimed at the Beast Tamer himself, with the other party’s defense ability and the judge’s ability, it was not enough to ensure the Beast Tamer’s survival.
“I’m smiling…”
Lendi was just about to say something when his expression stopped. This was because in an instant, the energy fluctuations on “Lu Bai”, whose energy level didn’t exceed ten million, suddenly increased. The speed of the increase made Lendi feel fear!
His expression changed drastically.
[Ling, how’s this mechanical dragon?]
Shi Yu’s clone asked the mechanical Ling in its hand.
[Biological modification isn’t my forte, but give me some time. It’s not difficult to reach this level of strength.]
[I see. As expected of you. Remember not to use wings.]
[Master, hurry up, hurry up. Don’t waste time. After dealing with it, I still have business to do.]
Under Ling’s urging, the clone Lu Bai slowly contributed its strength. At the same time, the blue bird spirit sleeping on its shoulder slowly fused into the clone’s body!
Boom!!!
In the next moment, Ling and Chi Tong no longer hid their energy through the Time Sealing Fruit. Ling’s nearly 4 million normal energy points and Chi Tong’s nearly 7 million normal energy erupted!!
At the same time, Ling used the loading skill and activated the second energy source it had created in the mechanical space, arming itself and Shi Yu’s clone.
As for Chi Tong, it first used the Myriad Sword Convergence to increase its energy level to more than 20 million. Then, it possessed Shi Yu’s clone!
At this moment, under the double armor, “Lu Bai”‘s aura increased by a terrifying amount just like what Lendi sensed!
In addition, Shi Yu’s clone was already ridiculously strong because of his terrifying physical fitness. At this moment, with a flash of blue flames, the strongest form that shocked everyone present and in the live broadcast appeared!!
In an instant, blue flames flickered around “Lu Bai”.
His surroundings changed almost instantly, affected by this powerful force.
Under the shine of the blue flames, “Lu Bai’s” gaze seemed to contain blue ghost flames. The color of his eyes gradually changed in the direction of deep blue.
With a hum, a wave of hellish cold air that seemed to be able to freeze everything in the world turned into flames that wrapped around “Lu Bai”‘s body.
Moreover, at this moment, “Lu Bai”‘s short hair had also completely turned blue. As it fluttered with the wind, it made his aura look like a death god that had walked out of an extremely cold hell to harvest all creatures.
“Then let’s end it as soon as possible!”
“Lu Bai” was still holding the sniper rifle. Under the light of the blue ghost fire, the white sniper rifle also had a blue color.
“Impossible!!!”
Perhaps the Beast Tamers before the live broadcast didn’t feel it, but Elise, who was at the scene, felt the shocking change in “Lu Bai” almost instantly. In her opinion, this change was incomprehensible.
First, the sniper rifle and the blue bird spirit suddenly erupted with extraordinary power, and then they were armed with this Beast Tamer at the same time?
This was both mechanical and undead equipment?!
How was this possible!!!
Judging from the energy value erupted by the two pets, it was definitely impossible for a normal human’s physique to withstand it!!
The mechanical dragon could withstand multiple layers of armor because its main body was a dragon!!!
At this moment, Elise doubted her eyes.
At the same time, the people watching the battle were also shocked.
[Holy shit, what’s this…]
[Look, the sniper rifle and his arm are wrapped together. The blue bird spirit has also fused with its body!! Mechanical and undead dual possession?]
[No way, how can a human body withstand it? Won’t there be a conflict?]
[But he endured it.]
[If the pet is weak enough, it’s possible… But clearly, this person’s pet is definitely not weak. Now I know why he looks so weak with white hair!]
[He’s playing with his life in battle!!]
“You’re a lunatic!”
“I was wondering why you looked so weak!”
Along with the audience, Lendi suspected his eyes.
It wasn’t impossible for mechanical and undead to possess each other, but the consumption of the Beast Tamer himself was definitely very terrifying.
Although human Beast Tamers were the best carriers for mechanical lives and undead, and had the greatest increase in strength after being armed, the physique of humans also limited the upper limit of this combination.
And from the looks of it, Lu Bai had no intention of cherishing his body.
“I knew it. This person is an expert!!” In the audience, An Chang immediately said as Lu Bai erupted with strength, “The outcome of the battle is still uncertain.”
At this moment, without allowing Lendi to think too much, after being shocked by Shi Yu’s change, his body quickly flickered with light. A silver-red armor wrapped around him tightly, not daring to be arrogant anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the same time, during this process, he also gave the mechanical dragon an attack command!!
Boom!!!
However, it was “Lu Bai” who attacked first, aiming at the mechanical dragon in the sky.
An invisible blue light flashed at the muzzle of the sniper rifle.
Right on the heels of that, an ordinary combination skill with the sniper rifle as the carrier and the Nether Ghost Flame and wind element as the energy source was born.
“Netherstorm Cannon…”
In the next moment, the blue light shot out and turned into a blue beam.
The moment the beam left the muzzle, a terrifying energy was released. The beam shot by the small sniper rifle suddenly displayed a change that shocked Lendi and the mechanical dragon.
Under the light, at this moment, the caliber of the sniper rifle seemed to have enlarged to an unbelievable extent. Under the light, a terrifying shock wave nearly ten meters in diameter bloomed from the muzzle.
At this moment, “Lu Bai” seemed to be holding an annihilation cannon that wanted to destroy the entire arena!!
Master Qian’s pupils constricted. Fortunately, it was shooting at the sky!
Boom!!
The moment the beam of light ten meters in diameter bloomed, the air around the arena froze. The strong winds on both sides suddenly squeezed towards the mechanical dragon, fixing it in the attack trajectory of the blue flames…
Under the lingering of the hurricane, the terrifying blue flames gradually turned into a blue hurricane shock wave that attacked, making the mechanical dragon roar with difficulty.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, as the mechanical dragon roared, three golden lightning bolts lingered in the two cannon muzzles on its shoulders and its mouth. The electromagnetic cannon was ready!!
Boom!!
On the mechanical dragon’s side, the moment the three electromagnetic cannons were fired, they wrapped around each other and also became a terrifying golden electromagnetic cannon combination skill!
At this moment, Divine Wind’s Lendi didn’t even think about it. He directly used his spatial armor to teleport to “Lu Bai”‘s side and carry out the “decapitation strategy”.
However, he completely underestimated the power of this sniper cannon.
The three-in-one electromagnetic cannon spat out by the mechanical dragon first squeezed together with the Nether Hurricane Cannon. The shocking collision sound lingered in the air, but in an instant, the incomparably powerful three-in-one electromagnetic cannon was directly swallowed by the terrifying Nether Hurricane Cannon!!
With a boom, the electromagnetic cannon sank into the flames and disappeared. Then, the Nether Hurricane Cannon continued to emit powerful fluctuations that swallowed the mechanical dragon!!
Boom!!!
The Nether Hurricane Cannon advanced quickly, making the mechanical dragon’s pupils shrink. Its claws tore at the Hurricane Cannon, but submerged in the light of this sniper shot, its resistance was very weak. In an instant, its entire body was swallowed by the blue ghost fire swept by the hurricane!!
After devouring the mechanical dragon, the power of the Nether Hurricane Cannon did not decrease. It still pushed towards the sky, as if it wanted to rush out of this planet. Its power was so terrifying that it instantly dyed the sky blue!!
Moreover, it penetrated a vortex-like hole!!!
It dispersed the black clouds!!
The entire audience was stunned!
“Lu Bai” calmly put away the sniper rifle and pointed the muzzle down. He sensed the enemy’s movements that were not restricted by the mechanical dragon at all.
At the same time.
Lendi, who was wearing silver-red armor, appeared in the air behind “Lu Bai”. At this moment, Lu Bai was still looking straight at the beautiful blue sky.
Behind him, Lendi revealed a crazy expression. He aimed his palm at “Lu Bai” and red flames condensed. But at this moment, Lu Bai seemed to have eyes on the back of his head. His reaction speed was even more unimaginable than Lendi in mechanical armor.
“Go to hell!!”
Boom!!
A huge flame shot out of Lendi’s palm, but what made Lendi’s crazy expression stop again was that his opponent’s figure directly disappeared in his attack range.
Boom!
The flames burned the ground.
But in the next moment, Lendi felt something pressing against his back. At a higher altitude, “Lu Bai” went behind Lendi at a speed invisible to the naked eye. He raised his sniper rifle slightly and aimed at Lendi’s back.
At the same time, a transcendent-level deterrence wrapped around Lendi’s entire body, making his expression stiffen and cold sweat fall.
At this moment, Lendi felt the hand of Death touching him. The cold touch made it difficult for him to move. Lendi revealed an incomprehensible expression.
“Impossible!!!” he shouted.
Impossible, how could this person be so strong!!
Although he later realized that Lu Bai was not simple, after two exchanges, Lendi seemed to have fallen into an abyss. He looked up at the unreachable sky and was unable to touch it.
“In my opinion, you’re no different from the Thousand River Hundred God and the Demon Blade Shen Di.”
As soon as “Lu Bai” finished speaking, with a boom, the cannon that controlled the power directly swallowed Lendi’s entire body, making his pupils shrink!
Boom!!
At the same time, gravel flew everywhere, and a huge pit more than ten meters in diameter appeared on the ground!
The terrifying shock wave directly embedded Lendi and the armor underground.
Boom!!!
As the huge pit appeared and as Lendi himself was suppressed, Elise’s gaze exploded. All the spectators were stunned.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!!!
Right on the heels of that, countless mechanical parts fell from the sky like rain. Along with them was the shocking mechanical dragon from before.
At this moment, there was not a single intact place on its body. Its entire body was frozen and burned by the blue ghost flames, filled with the scratches of wind blades. Its gaze closed as it fell from the sky. With a boom, it also smashed a huge pit in the arena!

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The battle ended. The sniper rifle in “Lu Bai’s” hand turned into a white watch again and wrapped around his wrist. At the same time, the blue flames on his body slowly disappeared.
His hair returned to white, revealing an expression of pity.
He thought that the number one person under the new generation of legends in Shen Feng would be stronger, but in the end, even Susu was not used.
Even the two scapegoats who suffered the side effects of the double armed weapon… Only one was dead.
As expected, it was right not to let the main body come.
“Is it over just like that?” Lu Bai turned to look at Elise, who was broadcasting for Lendi, and asked her, “Aren’t you guys some mechanical Gemini? Who’s stronger between you and him? Do you want to give it a try?”
At this moment, Elise’s expression was filled with shock and paleness, even paler than Lu Bai’s face. She looked at the arena in disbelief, unable to believe her eyes.
She looked at the sky that had a huge hole blasted out by the cannon and the arena that had been shattered by the cannon. Her gaze exploded to the extreme. She looked at the broken body of the mechanical dragon and the dying Lundy in the pit. Her throat was stuck and she couldn’t say a word.
Master Qian, who was the judge, also opened his mouth wide. He looked at everything in front of him and looked at the number one person below the legend level of the new generation of Shen Feng, who had been defeated with two cannons. He forgot to announce the outcome!
The other Beast Tamers present, such as An Chang and his classmates, also looked at the messy scene in disbelief. They couldn’t understand this scene. This… was it over?? What happened just now!!
Apart from that, there were also tens of thousands of people watching the battle in Elise’s live-stream. They watched all of this in disbelief and suspected that the scene just now was fake.
Those Sequence 10 to 20 Beast Tamers from Dong Huang who had been defeated by Lun Di were completely stunned. They looked at Lendi, who was insta-killed with two shots, and doubted that he was the powerful Shen Feng Mechanic they had fought.
“This…” Director Zhong also watched the live broadcast the whole time. Was this the super monster that Zou Yun and the others mentioned, the one that swept through the older and younger generation of the seven islands?
The wrinkles on his face trembled. He was indeed a monster. He also knew Lendi’s strength. It was definitely ridiculously strong. In his understanding, Zou Yun would find it hard to deal with him. They could only let Ji Feng try, but this situation… What was it??
“As expected…”
Seeing this, Ji Feng, Zou Yun, Tong Yan, Ning Tianming, and the others were not surprised. They only sighed again at Lu Bai’s terrifying strength and were silent.
Obviously, they had long expected this outcome.
At this moment, all the Beast Tamers who watched this battle live broadcast were infinitely shocked.
Wait, wait, who exactly was this Beast Tamer?
When did such a person appear among the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang?
Controlling undead and machinery at the same time… Those two shots just now were simply cool.
“That… that machine…” At this moment, Zheng Hai, the only one who had suspected Lu Bai’s identity, looked at the mechanical gun heavily.
That should be a mechanical weapon created by the Hundred Transformations Stone.
Moreover, it was wind!!!
Shi Yu had naturally never used this before, but was there a wind-element Hundred Transformations Stone in the champion reward of the National League Shi Yu participated in?
At this moment, Zheng Hai suspected that this Lu Bai was Shi Yu.
However, in the next moment, Lu Bai’s words made him silent again.
“Boring.” In the arena, Lu Bai looked at the silent and unresponsive Elise, who was clearly stunned, and shook his head.
“I originally thought that I could warm up before challenging ‘Shi Yu’, but from the looks of it, I can’t warm up at all.”
“Boring. Let’s go.”
Through the live broadcast, everyone heard Lu Bai’s words, the man who had just insta-killed the number one person below the legend level of the new generation of Shen Feng.
In the audience, An Chang’s mouth opened slightly. Wait, what did this person just say?
This person was here to challenge Senior Shi Yu???
Who exactly was this guy?
As Lu Bai issued a challenge to Shi Yu, everyone’s hearts skipped a beat. At the same time, Zheng Hai suddenly thought of something and quickly called Shi Yu.
Ancient Capital University.
In the Mechanical Research Institute.
At this moment, Shi Yu was touching the huge alloy monster in front of him in surprise. It could really evolve by devouring metal.
Not bad, not bad, excellent.
“Hahaha, the skill superalloy can synthesize the power of different metals and complete super evolution. The success rate of evolution depends on the skill proficiency, metal compatibility, and the endurance of the alloy monster itself.”
“Unfortunately, due to technical difficulties, the upper limit of the super alloy level of the alloy monster we created has yet to exceed expert level. Otherwise, it’s not impossible for the alloy monster to evolve into an overlord race mechanical life form!”
“At that time, it will be a stable evolution channel for overlord races.” Dr Aqi flaunted the potential of the alloy monster.
In order to curry favor with this Dr. Shi Yu, they had invested a lot to let the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University study alloy monsters. However, if Ancient Capital University didn’t show some sincerity, they definitely wouldn’t exchange core technology.
“It’s indeed a pretty good skill.” Principal Feng and Dean Hao nodded. If the Iron-eating Beast could master this, it would be invincible!
At this moment, just as Shi Yu was about to say something, his cell phone suddenly rang. He took a look and realized that it was Zheng Hai.
The super alloy skill had already been replicated. After gesturing to Dr Aqi and the others, Shi Yu directly picked up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Blue-haired Gun God Lu Bai vs Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu (7)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the next moment, Zheng Hai’s face appeared in the video.
As Shi Yu picked up the phone, Zheng Hai’s face revealed a stunned and confused expression, as if it was very unbelievable for Shi Yu to answer the phone at this moment.
He looked at the scene of Elise broadcasting through the split screen and then at Shi Yu, who was talking to him through the video call. He was immediately stunned.
“Brother Zheng Hai, what’s the matter?” Shi Yu asked.
“This, this, this, Brother Shi Yu, where are you now?” Zheng Hai asked in the video call.
“I’m at Ancient Capital University. I’m with Principal Feng and the others now.”
Zheng Hai was confused. Through the background of the video, it was true that Shi Yu seemed to be in a laboratory.
Could it be that he was wrong?
Lu Bai… wasn’t Shi Yu?
“Hahaha… It’s alright, it’s alright. Did you see the live broadcast battle that a Divine Wind Mechanic made just now? Do you know Lu Bai??”
Shi Yu revealed a puzzled expression and said, “Lu Bai? I’ve heard of him. Isn’t that the disciple of President Ye in the third bureau?”
Zheng Hai’s expression was extremely complicated. Really?
It looked like he was overthinking?
He said, “Yes, this Brother Lu Bai is also ridiculously strong. Did you know that just now, in the Ancient Capital Arena, he fought with the number one person below legend of the new generation in the Shen Feng exchange team, ‘Lendi’? He only used two moves to defeat the other party. It’s simply abnormal.”
“Moreover, Brother Shi Yu… Brother Lu Bai seemed to have publicly challenged you just now…”
Shi Yu was surprised. “Challenge me??”
He smiled and said, “It doesn’t matter. No matter whose challenge it is, I’ll accept it.”
Zheng Hai was silent. Could he watch the battle??
This was a f*cking peak battle!
“Sorry, I still have something to do here. I’ll hang up first. Talk to you later.”
“Alright,” Shi Yu said. In the video, Zheng Hai also nodded. The two of them immediately hung up with different feelings.
After hanging up, Shi Yu looked at Dr Aqi and the others.
“Dr Aqi, is that Lendo or something guy from your side? Just now, my friend said that he seemed to be fighting our Beast Tamer from Dong Huang in the Ancient Capital Arena. He was insta-killed with two shots and his injuries are very serious. Do you want to take a look…”
Mechanics had it rough when it came to repairs, right?
As Shi Yu finished speaking…
Dr Aqi and the others were stunned.
Then, he was stunned again.
What, what did he say? What happened?
….
At this moment, the Internet was boiling because another ridiculously strong new generation Beast Tamer had appeared in Dong Huang!
Lu Bai!
Two shots instantly killed the number one person below legend of the new generation of Shen Feng!!
Monster-like strength!!
Previously, Shen Feng’s mechanical Gemini Stars fought everywhere in Dong Huang and announced its victory, making the group of Beast Tamers of Dong Huang unhappy for a long time.
But at this moment, with Lu Bai’s two shots, all the pressure disappeared.
Although they didn’t know why Lu Bai didn’t participate in the Sequence Battle and didn’t know his identity, the news that Lu Bai was going to challenge the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, Dr. Shi Yu, made everyone extremely excited!!
Holy shit, a strong battle!!
They wondered if Dr. Shi Yu would fight.
One was a blue-haired gun god holding a white sniper rifle.
One was a red-haired Sword God holding a fire sword spirit.
At this moment, the Beast Tamers who wanted to watch the show were more or less all excited.
In the small group chat pulled up by Director Zhong, Zheng Hai stood at the front line and immediately shared this big news to Zou Yun, Director Zhong, and the others.
“Everyone, I just called Shi Yu. He’s also in the ancient capital now. He said that he will accept this Lu Bai’s challenge!!” Zheng Hai said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After replicating the super alloy skill, Shi Yu slipped away.
Principal Feng slipped away with him.
Only Dean Hao and the Shen Feng exchange team were left.
“That’s it?”
Seeing that Shi Yu had only watched the evolution of the two alloy monsters once before slipping away, Principal Feng was puzzled.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “They definitely won’t simply tell us the core technology of superalloy.”
“I’ve already told Dean Hao what I intend to learn from them. Let him communicate with the other party in depth.”
“If I can freeload from Shen Feng, I’ll get it for free. I can’t freeload… Well, aren’t there still the seven islands? When it comes to compensation, I can also take the superalloy technology.”
“You..!” Principal Feng muttered.
Be it Shen Feng or the seven islands, they were unlucky to have encountered him.
“By the way, what’s going on at the Ancient Capital Arena?” Principal Feng had a strange expression.
“‘Lu Bai’, isn’t that your fake identity when you went to the seven islands?”
Because Principal Feng was a relevant person, he was one of the few people who knew that Shi Yu had gone to the seven islands to crack the Phoenix Mystic Realm with Lu Bai’s identity.
Just now, when he heard that Lu Bai insta-killed the new generation genius of the Shen Feng exchange team in the Ancient Capital Arena, he was also stunned for a moment.
It wasn’t that he was stunned that the other party’s genius was insta-killed, but that Lu Bai was supposed to be Shi Yu.
However, at that time, Shi Yu was indeed beside them, so he was as stunned as Zheng Hai.
“It’s a clone, but the pet it brought along isn’t a clone, so it’s easier to win,” Shi Yu said. “Isn’t this because the main body still has to receive Dr Aqi and the others?”
Principal Feng opened his mouth slightly.
He repeated his thoughts.
Be it Shen Feng or the seven islands, they were unlucky to have encountered him!
If the other party’s genius knew that it was only a clone that tortured them, wouldn’t their mentality collapse?
“By the way, Principal Feng, do you know where Senior Lu and the Void Mantis are now?”
After Shi Yu smiled, he quickly forgot about the Shen Feng exchange team. Their value was temporarily gone.
Principal Feng shook his head and sighed.
“I heard that the Void Mantis wants to take a look at the old sites of the Space Emperors in Dong Huang. Why, what’s the matter?”
“Are you looking for Qingyi or the Void Mantis?”
“It’s nothing. I just plan to go out and play with them in a few days…”
“You still want to go out?!” Principal Feng was furious. F*ck, you’re now covered in legendary resources, you’re holding even more stuff than the national treasury of a totem country.
If anyone killed them on the way, the treasures dropped would probably be enough to create a totem!
The Phoenix Mystic Realm having treasures in there was due to luck being on his side. This guy was addicted.
“It’s alright, I’ll definitely call Teacher Cat. Moreover, I’ve already eaten the Undying Fruit and have the protection of the Dragon God. How can there be so much danger?” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Even President Lin doesn’t mind me wandering around. I think you’re thinking too small in this case, principal.”
Principal Feng : “…”
President Lin was indeed not like an elder like Principal Feng. President Lin didn’t care much about Shi Yu’s thoughts of going to various places to train and even the intention to participate in the World Tournament.
“I wonder what he’s thinking.” Principal Feng hated it.
“I’ll stay obediently during this period of time, but Principal Feng… There really aren’t many places for pets to train if I stay obediently. My current ruins space can’t withstand Eleven and the others anymore.”
Shi Yu looked up and showed Principal Feng the ruin ring in his hand.
“Speaking of which, it’s time to update this thing. Our bureau should have a higher-level ruins space, right? I want to change it.”
Principal Feng was silent for a moment before looking at the ruin ring in Shi Yu’s hand.
That was true.
Shi Yu’s improvement speed was too fast. In a short period of time, he already had overlord-level battle power.
This ordinary ruins space was indeed about to be unable to support his pet’s special training.
“I understand. I’ll help you get it. I can’t find a legendary one like Qingyi’s, but there should still be a stock of high-level ruins with higher strength,” he said. “It should be able to ensure that overlords can fight and train inside.”
Good!
Shi Yu was happy. Before he found the legendary ruins space, he could only continue to rely on Bureau 11 to replenish his equipment.
…
At the same time, Lu Bai became popular, and so did Zou Yun.
As Lu Bai easily crushed the genius of Shen Feng, Zou Yun’s comment that was forwarded to the live broadcast made Zou Yun become the second trending topic.
Zou Yun: “Who exactly is the overconfident one? Although the battle hasn’t started, I’ve already expected the outcome. If nothing goes wrong, this Shen Feng Mechanic will be insta-killed by Lu Bai. PS: I’m good friends with Lu Bai. He’s much stronger than me.”
Everyone was extremely unfamiliar with Lu Bai, and Heavenly King Zou directly became the only big boss who knew Lu Bai.
As Zou Yun’s “divine comment” that had been published before the two of them started fighting was dug out, Heavenly King Zou’s popularity as Lu Bai defeated the Shen Feng genius also appeared on the trending list.
In the Dark Club in Demon Capital, Heavenly King Zou looked at the rising popularity and fell into deep thought.
He seemed to have found the secret to success.
Why not stop working hard?
Wouldn’t it be easier for him to follow behind people like Shi Yu and Lu Bai?!
Of course, in the face of various questions from his fans, Zou Yun didn’t reveal any other information about Lu Bai. He knew when to stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, what most Beast Tamers wanted to know was when Lu Bai and Shi Yu would fight. Would Lu Bai register for the Sequence battle and enter the ranking?
The Sequence Competition Committee was also facing the same problem. They wanted to drag this Lu Bai in.
Unfortunately, Director Zhong had already contacted President Ye and was gradually approaching the truth.
“Lu Bai… Ah.” When President Ye heard Director Zhong’s question, he felt awkward. Lu Bai, wasn’t that Shi Yu’s alternate identity? When he created this fake identity, it was casually made up by Principal Feng, President Ye, and the others…
Only the higher-ups related to the trip to the seven islands and the Phoenix Mystic Realm knew about this alternate identity. Director Zhong had been presiding over the Sequence battle in the country and was unrelated to this matter. It was normal not to know.
However, President Ye didn’t know if it was appropriate to reveal it now. He could only kick the ball to President Lin.
Therefore, Director Zhong contacted President Lin.
“Lu Bai?” After President Lin heard Director Zhong explain the matter, he was silent for a moment. “Lu Bai challenged Shi Yu? Are you joking?”
Director Zhong: “Ah, Elder Lin, what’s the joke? What’s wrong? I heard that this Lu Bai’s performance on the seven islands is very dazzling. His age is also suitable for participating in the Sequence battle… But President Ye said that it was your arrangement to not let him register?”
President Lin said, “Lu Bai is a disguise of Shi Yu. If you don’t find it troublesome, you can play along with him.”
Director Zhong: “?”
Director Zhong opened his mouth slightly. There were many question marks now.
Wait, wait, wait!
Didn’t Zheng Hai call Shi Yu when Lu Bai was fighting Lendi??
It was the same person?
