Director Zhong’s old brain suddenly felt a little uncomfortable. Something was wrong, something was wrong. President Lin, Zheng Hai, Shi Yu, and Lu Bai, one of these “four” had to be a big liar!
….
After Lu Bai finished fighting Lundy, he calmly left the Ancient Capital Arena. No one knew when he would challenge Shi Yu.
At the same time, people also realized that Lu Bai didn’t participate in the Sequence battle either. Even if he challenged Shi Yu, no one would definitely publicize the outcome, let alone the battle process. They definitely couldn’t see it.
This couldn’t help but make the Beast Tamers who wanted to watch the show feel an itch. They felt that they had been interrupted and didn’t get to see any follow-up.
At this moment, Shi Yu himself also received messages from various contacts and friends to ask about the situation.
Shi Yu’s unified reply was that Lu Bai had yet to find him.
Although Lu Bai might not exist in the future, the legend of Lu Bai would definitely be forever spread in the martial world with this wave.
As for the real Shi Yu vs Lu Bai, Shi Yu thought about it and felt that it wasn’t impossible. He would talk about it during the second team meeting.
At that time, apart from individual battles, they could also have an entire team battle.
Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng versus Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling.
The three brothers and three sisters.
Before that, Shi Yu decided to find a place to work overtime for two months.
He wanted to increase the super skills of every pet to expert level.
…
That day, Principal Feng’s high-level ruins space was sent over.
He handed Shi Yu a black ruin ring.
“Speaking of which, Qingyi was the one who cracked this high-level ruins space. The master was a titled female plant controller in the totem era, so this ruins space has been modified. It’s very suitable for the growth of plants.”
“How many ruins did Senior Lu crack?” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. If he remembered correctly, Senior Lu’s legendary ruins space was also cracked by her.
Principal Feng chuckled and said, “There definitely aren’t as many as you, but the ruins that Qingyi cracked are all relatively well preserved. They can all be used, while yours seem to have either shattered or imploded.”
“I don’t think you’ve handed in many ruins spaces until now, right?”
Shi Yu : “…”
Could he be blamed?
The mechanism of cracking the ruins was different!
Shi Yu coughed dryly and took a new ruin ring. “I’ll… hand it back after moving the things inside.”
Principal Feng said, “There’s no hurry. I’ll leave it with you first. Aren’t you giving Fang Lan an assessment? After she becomes an official member of Bureau 11, you can just give that old one to her.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and smiled. “Sorry to trouble you, Principal. With this, I can train hard for a period of time.”
Principal Feng snorted and said, “I hope so…”
….
“Perfect!”
After obtaining the new ruins space, Shi Yu chose to return to the “paradise” of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain outside Ping Cheng to cultivate.
But first, he had to move.
On the icy plain, Shi Yu opened the teleportation channel that connected the ruins to reality. After opening the teleportation channel that connected the ruins to reality, Eleven and the others began to move.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven cracked the ground and directly jogged to the new space with both hands in the training room and bedroom.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong transplanted the Sun Flame Flower with difficulty.
The easier one was Susu. It had its own independent space and didn’t have much junk.
Ling was still alright. Although it had a huge research institute, it had a mechanical space, so it was relatively easy to move. Moreover, its huge computing power allowed it to easily not miss anything.
The most bitter one was none other than Baby Ginseng. Most of the spiritual plants in the original ruins space had to be transplanted over. Apart from that, there was also a pile of seeds and medicine in its research institute. In order to make it more convenient and less noisy, it could only ask the tool worm to help move.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Tyrant Dragon and Duckbill Beast (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
After about an hour, Shi Yu and the others finished moving.
During this period, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast… were still fighting in the dragon circle.
Shi Yu and the others dealt with these two guys in the end.
“Stop fighting.” Shi Yu sighed and pulled out the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast.
The two of them glared at each other, neither willing to give in.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I got Buggy to create a training ground for you. You can’t tell who’s stronger now. You can fight after training and becoming stronger.”
“It’s very suitable for you to train your strength.”
“Roar? (What?)” The mechanical Tyrant Dragon turned its head curiously. It urgently needed strength!!
Now, perfectly defeating the duck that threatened its position as the king of the earth had become the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s main motivation.
“Quack! (Where…)” The Duckbill Beast also revealed a sharp gaze. It also urgently needed strength now.
No matter what, it had to make this guy who was trying to expand land and conquer the sea realize who the real boss was.
“There.” Shi Yu pointed at the teleportation array over there and said, “I got Buggy to create an illusion domain in the new space.”
“There are ten guardians there. They are the ten illusions created by Buggy through Eleven’s hardening substance, its worm silk, Baby Ginseng’s whiskers, Chi Tong’s feathers, and Susu’s water drop.”
“It’s considered Eleven and the others’ baby form.”
“Next, you have to pass ten levels and defeat your seniors’ baby form phantoms. Every level you pass, there are resource rewards. Believe me, after passing, your strength will undergo a tremendous change.”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast were stunned.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu’s transcendent and commander-level illusions??
The two of them revealed calm expressions.
When the opponent didn’t have the strength of a monarch, that unreachable figure might not be impossible for them to touch!
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast quickly entered the new space and ran to the training domain Shi Yu had prepared for them.
As soon as they stepped in, they saw the guardian of the first level.
It was a palm-sized green worm that was sleeping.
Seeing this, both the huge mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast that had eaten many bugs smiled.
“Heh.” The Tyrant Dragon was like a husky.
“Quack.” The Duckbill Beast also smiled and entered something like puberty.
That was it?
“Roar!!! (I’ll go first!)” The Tyrant Dragon roared and directly took a step forward, stepping on the ground. With a boom, a huge earthquake wave swept towards the Green Silkworm sleeping on the lawn!!
Seeing this, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon thought that victory was in its grasp. However, in the next moment, the Green Silkworm phantom opened its eyes tiredly and looked at the sweeping shock wave. It yawned.
Its body gradually turned ethereal.
Expert level, Concealment!
Boom!!!
The earthquake directly swept across, not hitting the Green Silkworm phantom at all. Then, the Green Silkworm turned around and changed its posture, stunning the mechanical Tyrant Dragon.
“Ji! (Trash!)”
In the next moment, the Green Silkworm Phantom’s expert level super vision locked onto the mechanical Tyrant Dragon. It accumulated strength in its mouth, and the Dao Proficiency worm silk formed a “white sharp spear” that penetrated the mechanical Tyrant Dragon!!
Swoosh!!!
The white line spat out of its mouth shot out at a high speed like a bow. Its destructive power seemed to be able to penetrate steel in one hit. Its speed was so fast that only an afterimage could be seen, stunning the mechanical Tyrant Dragon again!
Bang!!!
The Worm Silk Spear penetrated the mechanical Tyrant Dragon’s body, causing its body to directly cave in, making it widen its eyes. With a retch, it almost vomited out the soil it had eaten for lunch. It felt that all the bones in its body were about to shatter instantly. A shocking wound even appeared on its body. Then, its body was smashed out like a cannonball!!
Boom!!
It landed on the ground in the distance.
“Ji.” The Green Silkworm phantom glanced at the Duckbill Beast, yawned again, and continued sleeping.
Duck Beak Beast: ???
The Duckbill Beast looked at the extremely miserable mechanical Tyrant Dragon that flew backward and then at the Green Silkworm Phantom in front of it. It opened its beak wide and looked at Shi Yu beside it.
It was as if he was saying that this monster was transcendent?
Shi Yu said, “Transcendent, yes. Its energy value isn’t necessarily higher than your normal state and explosive power. It’s just that the accompanying moves and skill proficiency are a little unscientific.”
“Next, try to overcome the pressure brought about by their baby forms first. By fighting them, you will understand that you still have a long way to go.”
“The world is very big. Don’t just set your sights on what’s immediately in front of you. No matter how long the two of you fight, you won’t be able to improve much. Let’s broaden your horizons first.”
The mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast fell into deep thought.
As expected of an overlord race, the Tyrant Dragon was still resistant to beatings.
It actually wasn’t insta-killed after taking a hit from the worm silk.
However, he still had a crisis.
This was… the first level?
Then… What was behind it?
They suspected that Shi Yu was lying to them!!
Was this the strength of a green worm?
“This is the battle power of your Senior Buggy when it was at the transcendent level. There was even a video record at that time…”
“By the way, there’s a time limit for each level. If you can’t clear it in the specified time, the food in the future will be halved.”
Mechanical Tyrant Dragon, Duck Beak Beast:???
“However, challenging illusions doesn’t necessarily have to be 1VS1. If you really can’t defeat it, the two of you can also team up. Working together also counts.”
After Shi Yu finished speaking with a smile, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast looked at each other and turned around. Who the hell wanted to cooperate!!
“All the best, I’m leaving! Call me if you need anything!”
After arranging the “path to godhood” for the two members of Team Two, Shi Yu slipped away.
To be honest, it was a little difficult to defeat a member of the team with the “strength of points”.
However, the Mechanical Tyrant Dragon could rely on Ling’s research ability to constantly perfect its race and upgrade, while the Duck Beak Beast could rely on Susu and Baby Ginseng’s research to gradually recover the power of the Abyss Demon Duck. Perhaps, even without adding points, they could slowly defeat Eleven and the others of the same level.
Probably…
Shi Yu nodded. If they couldn’t defeat it, they could still cooperate. It wasn’t a big problem.
Compared to the “Baby Fighting Training Method” of the members of the second team, the members of the first team were also about to start the super skills and training that they enjoyed torturing each other.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and walked towards Buggy and the others calmly…
….
Working overtime.
….
Time passed.
….
Two months later.

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - Cultivation Results in Two Months (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Cultivation Results in Two Months (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the blink of an eye, two months had passed since Shi Yu returned from the seven islands.
For the past two months, Shi Yu had been in Ping Cheng and working overtime in Icefield City.
He cultivated wholeheartedly.
However, he didn’t stop receiving information from the outside world.
During this period of time, Shi Yu was most concerned about the situation on the seven islands.
In the beginning, Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang had the absolute advantage in the negotiation.
The two parties still demanded from the seven islands according to the number of resources mentioned at the start.
Twenty legends, or two myths, and the right to explore the ruins mystic realm…
Until the legendary Valkyrie came out of seclusion and both parties engaged in a small-scale confrontation.
After a collision, Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang finally pulled back a bit.
After all, they still had to give the legendary level respect.
According to what Shi Yu understood, at that time, the Seven Islands Valkyrie was not at a disadvantage when staring down several totem dragons alone. She even had the upper hand. In order to avoid the conflict from escalating, Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang finally pulled back.
After all, the goal of both parties was only resources and not a war.
The conditions were so high because they were originally waiting for the seven islands to bargain.
However, after all, the seven islands had done something wrong. They still had to compensate.
However, the specific compensation had been discussed for two months. This made Shi Yu glad that he didn’t stay there for long. Otherwise, he would have waited too long.
This kind of thing was indeed not something that could be negotiated in the short term.
It was as troublesome as when he applied for legendary resources.
The reason why they were still negotiating was that Dong Huang, the seven islands, and Dragon Palace City had currently placed their focus on investigating the Ke Yuan Financial Group and the totem faction behind it.
At the moment, the seven islands could basically confirm that the core higher-ups of the Ke Yuan Financial Group had betrayed the country and joined the totem country.
The reason was very simple. The core assets of the Ke Yuan Financial Group had long been secretly transferred.
This was not good news for the Seven Nation Alliance. Although the totem country had been plotting against the technological system of the seven countries for a long time, and this was not the first treason case, no matter what, the Keyuan Financial Group was still a super large financial group that started with technology in the seven islands.
For the other six countries, the betrayal of a large financial group of this scale was a wake-up call, making the seven countries supervise the forces in the country more strictly.
At the same time, Dong Huang understood that things weren’t that simple this time because it involved a demigod, Yun An.
Of course, Shi Yu temporarily didn’t have the energy or strength to interfere. His current priority was still to increase his strength and wait for the World Tournament to begin.
Now, there were still more than six months until the start of the world competition.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, there was still plenty of time. This was because in the past two months, his strength and the strength of his pets had undergone a complete change. According to his current progress, he would definitely be invincible in another half a year.
Of course, apart from him, there were also some changes in the ranking of the Sequence battle, making Shi Yu very surprised.
There was no change in the top ten and top eight of the Sequence.
The top four were still those legends. The fifth was still him, the sixth was still Senior Lu, the seventh was still Ji Feng, and the eighth was Zheng Hai. However, the ninth and tenth were different.
Ning Tianming, this half ghost, as well as Tong Yan, the poison doctor of the Medical Bureau, were directly killed.
Heavenly King Zou became number nine.
Shi Yu didn’t know what he had done. Perhaps he had pulled in an investment or had a fortuitous encounter. Every pet’s strength had increased greatly.
The tenth became a guy that surprised Shi Yu. The fourth bureau, Gao Xuan.
Ever since Gao Xuan lost the National League, just like before, he still wasn’t active in the Sequence battle. After being attacked by the Mechanical Conference, he was even less in the mood.
He didn’t even appear when the Shen Feng exchange team came to Dong Huang, but in the past month, Gao Xuan had made a high-profile comeback.
Originally, according to his strength, it was not enough to enter the top ten of the Sequence if he couldn’t use small forbidden weapons,
However, during this period, Gao Xuan might’ve been in seclusion. After coming out of seclusion, his Beast Taming level broke through from level five to level six. The strength of his awakening talent increased, and his research ability increased. He even completed a new round of strengthening of his Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast.
In this ranking, he shocked the world and directly entered the top ten of the Sequence.
In terms of strength, it was even praised by the Beast Tamers on the Internet. It wasn’t much worse than the number one person below the legend of the new generation of Shen Feng, Lun Di.
It could probably withstand a shot from Lu Bai.
This made Gao Xuan, who had just returned, fall silent again.
During this period, the most annoying thing was still Lu Bai. Lu Bai still didn’t register for the Sequence Battle. This undoubtedly made the Beast Tamers on Dong Huang’s side feel that it was a pity. It had been two months since they looked forward to Lu Bai vs Shi Yu, and there was still no news.
What they didn’t know was that at this moment, today, Shi Yu and Lu Bai were finally going to fight…
….
In the ruins space, on the huge grassland, Shi Yu yawned. He looked at the pets that had become stronger after a round of points and smiled.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling also looked at Shi Yu energetically.
“Alright, this round of points adding has already ended…”
“Two months have passed in the blink of an eye. More than half a year has passed since the last team meeting.”
“After two months of adding points, you’re almost on the same level. Why don’t we hold another team meeting?”

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - Cultivation Results in Two Months (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Cultivation Results in Two Months (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“You haven’t forgotten, right? Apart from Eleven, you all owe yourselves a championship because you enjoyed legendary resources in advance.”
Six pets: !!!
“Wuu!” Eleven clenched its fists with fighting spirit. Its right arm waved and spun like a windmill.
Impossible. With it around, no one could think of getting first place in the team!
“Wait, wait!!” Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu all showed different expressions. As for Ling, it said excitedly, “Why did you call me over? Don’t tell me you want me to participate too?”
Shi Yu was stunned. He looked at Ling and said, “What else?”
< Name > Ling
“Advanced Skill”: Hundred Transformations (Dao Proficiency), Advanced Intelligence (Dao Proficiency), Mechanical Space (Dao Proficiency), Loading (Dao Proficiency)
“Super Skill”: Wind Element Control (Expert), Divine Net (Expert), Turning Misfortune into Luck (Expert)
Energy Points: 4 million+
As for Ling, Shi Yu had finally taught it the “Divine Net” and “Turning Misfortune into Luck”.
However, this was not Ling’s greatest gain. Its greatest gain was that it completed its evolution through its own upgrade.
During this period, he turned the teaching skills “Divine Net”, “Machinery Space”, and “Loading” into racial skills.
In other words, Ling’s race level had also increased to an overlord race because it had two super racial skills.
Among them, because of the speciality of the “Divine Net” skill, its strength was comparable to a spatial skill. It was not a problem to say that Ling was a “medium-level overlord mechanical race”.
This was thanks to the powerful intelligent research and self-leveling ability of the Divine Net skill.
It was also because it had learned Divine Net that Ling could be busy with various research projects at the same time.
Otherwise, it would have to study the “Fusion Mecha”, the “Qilin Revival”, and the “Super Alloy Iron-eating Beast”. Even if it had full-level high-level intelligence, it wouldn’t be able to handle it.
At this moment, although Ling had yet to successfully fuse with the Kirin fossil and learn Mythical Revival, Ling’s mecha form already had a prototype.
It was just that he couldn’t fuse the power of the entire team yet. At most, he could perfectly fuse the power of the three parties like the sniper form at that time.
However, with the mechanical space and various equipment, in Shi Yu’s opinion, it was already considered initial battle power.
“No, no, no.” In the Rubik’s Cube, the white-haired loli shook her head crazily, resisting.
Although its strength had also improved greatly in the past two months, but…
It looked at Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu and fell silent.
After its top-notch intelligence, expert level Divine Net skill analysis, its chances of winning against the five of them were below 0.1%…
Usually, as the team’s instructor, Ling would seriously supervise the training of every pet, like a big sister.
If it got last place in the team meeting, it probably wouldn’t be able to hold it in.
Its persona would directly collapse. Ling thought for a moment. It couldn’t fight!
It was very scientific for a good trainer to not be strong.
“I, I’ll be the judge!” Ling said quickly with a red face!
“Contestants: Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu.”
“It’s not that I don’t dare to fight, but that it’s boring.” Ling turned around, very nervous.
Its mecha form and its Kirin form had yet to be developed. There was not much meaning in participating in such a competition… It would talk about it in the future.
“Wu?” “Wuu…” “Yi…” “Mi!” “Ning?”
Not participating?
The other five looked at Ling with burning gazes, making its heart shiver.
“Then next time.” Shi Yu smiled.
Shi Yu and the others didn’t expose Ling’s thoughts.
Indeed, compared to the other five, Ling’s cultivation level was not very high. Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided to let it be the judge with him first.
“You’re not participating in the individual battle, but remember to participate in the team battle later,” Shi Yu added without allowing Ling to refuse.
Ling wanted to cry.
“Also, the second team meeting has to be updated to a certain extent compared to the first team meeting.”
“Apart from the team battle after the individual battle, I also plan to add a new system this time.”
Among the six pets, Eleven showed an invincible expression.
It was still very confident. No matter what, it was still very stable!
< Name > Eleven
“Super Skill”: Inner Power (Expert+1), Lightning Rod (Expert), Space Quake (Expert), Bean Soldier (Expert), Impregnable (Expert+1), Undying Golden Body (Expert+1), White Thunder (Expert)
Normal Energy Points: 9 million+
In the past two months, Eleven had successfully awakened the White Thunder skill through the “Aurora Magnetic Gold”.
Moreover, after Shi Yu added points to the expert level, the power of its lightning skill increased greatly!
At the start, Principal Feng judged that the chances of the dark-element affinity Eleven awakening White Thunder were not high, but he had underestimated Eleven’s other thunder-element skill proficiency.
Under the lead of the high proficiency of other basic thunder-element skills and the electromagnetic control power of Dao Proficiency-level electromagnetic levitation, Eleven absorbed the power of the “Aurora Magnetic Gold” very smoothly.
Not only had it learned a new skill, but its physique had also increased greatly because it used the legendary resource “Aurora Magnetic Gold”. Of course, the reason why it became stronger so quickly was also related to its two months of self-mutilating demonic training.
The only pity was that the “super alloy” skill replicated by Shi Yu did not have enough Iron-eating Beast compatibility and could not be taught directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - Cultivation Results Two Months Later (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Cultivation Results Two Months Later (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
However, it wasn’t a big problem. Shi Yu had already gotten Ling to study how to increase the Iron-eating Beast’s compatibility with superalloy skills.
Even if it had yet to evolve through the super alloy, with such an outstanding combination and overlord will, Eleven was very confident.
How could it lose!
Seeing Eleven so confident, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu had heavy expressions… This guy was indeed not easy to fight.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “This time, I’ve decided to add a new equipment system!”
“Therefore, in this team meeting battle, you can rely on external forces. After all, weapons and equipment are also a part of strength.”
“Your future enemies won’t fight you fairly. They will have preparations.”
“Our Dong Huang also relied on external forces like forbidden weapons to dominate until now. It’s very reasonable to have an equipment system.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven’s confident expression froze.
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven’s confident expression froze.
Equipment system?
“Wu!!!” On the other hand, Buggy was extremely happy.
Equipment system?!
Seriously?
It could bring equipment to battle? It could kill indiscriminately?!
There were two special existences in Shi Yu’s team.
One was Buggy, and the other was Susu.
The latter could store a large amount of nutrition from food in the body space through the Infinite Devour skill and temporarily transform it in battle.
Through this skill, Susu could use Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit at a smaller price and high efficiency at any time.
As for Buggy, because of the speciality of skills like Phantom Illusion and Dragon of Imagination, it could use “dragon-element equipment” to increase its strength.
If the utilization rate of Eleven and the others using equipment was 10%, then Buggy was 100%. Its compatibility with equipment was extremely high.
This advantage was unique to Buggy in the team. Of course, Future Ling might also have it.
Therefore, when it heard that equipment could be used in this team meeting, Buggy immediately became excited.
Eleven’s face immediately fell.
Because it didn’t have any usable equipment. Aurora Magnetic Gold? It couldn’t increase its battle power at all!
And that worm had a legendary dragon ball in its spatial pocket…
Under the enhancement of the legendary Dragon Ball, Buggy’s strength erupted to a top-notch overlord, an invincible overlord, and even totem level. It was not a problem. It purely depended on the limit Buggy could withstand.
This was even fiercer than the Time Fruit.
“Wuu!!!” At this moment, when it heard Shi Yu say that it could use equipment, Buggy felt that it could stand up.
< Name > Buggy
“Super Skill”: Imagination Domain (Expert+2), Dragon of Imagination (Expert+8), Space Control (Expert+2), Anti-Demon Domain (Expert), Ultimate Absorption (Expert)
Normal Energy Points: 5 million+
In terms of super skills, be it racial skills or teaching skills, Buggy had also reached expert level and above.
Among them, the Dragon of Imagination skill was even closer to perfect level because Buggy was constantly training with the “Space-element Legendary Dragon Ball”. It almost didn’t rely on additional points.
When Buggy used dragon-element equipment to use the Dragon of Imagination, it was also a process to train the Dragon of Imagination’s skill proficiency, so its increase in this aspect was very fast.
In fact, as long as Shi Yu gave the Dragon of Imagination four more points, Buggy could complete its evolution and break through to the overlord level with its dragon transformation.
For example, Shi Yu only stopped when it reached expert level in the Imagination Domain and Space Control. The subsequent proficiency was increased by Buggy itself through training and resources.
Although there weren’t many skills, because of the equipment mechanism of this team meeting, Buggy felt that it could challenge the position of leader!
“Wu!!”
“Wuu!! (So be it, who’s afraid!)” Eleven was still very determined.
This new system was the most beneficial to Buggy.
Shi Yu wasn’t biased towards anyone, but in a real life and death battle, who cared if one used equipment or ate supplements?
The Gem Cat usually carried a pile of life-saving equipment with it. Absolute fairness didn’t exist at all.
He still didn’t know the rules of the World Tournament. If they could bring equipment, those totem country opponents would definitely be fully armed. Shi Yu had to prepare in advance.
Being able to perfectly borrow equipment was also the effect of Buggy’s skill. Before the world competition… he definitely had to go to Dragon Palace City more.
“Yi!!!” At this moment, Baby Ginseng became nervous and asked Shi Yu.
Then, self-destruction and revival… could it be used?
Eleven, Buggy: ???
Shi Yu: “?”
“Do you want to kill Buggy or Eleven?” Shi Yu’s mouth twitched as he asked.
Baby Ginseng sighed. As expected, it still couldn’t be used.
“Wu wu wu.” Baby Ginseng let out Eleven’s aggrieved voice. Buggy could rely on rules to increase its strength, but it was restricted by rules. It suspected that there was a conspiracy and something fishy!
After two months, Baby Ginseng successfully condensed a new time mark.
< Name > Ginseng Baby
“Super Skill”: Source of Life (Expert+11), Time Mark (Expert), Moon Explosion (Expert), Plant Control (Expert+2)
Normal Energy Points: 9 million+
After two months of adding points, Baby Ginseng took the least super racial skills and recovered to the highest normal energy level in the team, exceeding Eleven again.
The reason was very simple. Under the lead of the legendary resource “Divine Earth of Life”, its source of life skill level increased faster than Buggy’s Dragon of Imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - Cultivation Results Two Months Later (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Cultivation Results Two Months Later (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Apart from that, the greatest change in Baby Ginseng was that after Shi Yu leveled up the “time mark” to expert level, it finally accelerated and condensed a new time mark.
In other words, Baby Ginseng had obtained the ability to revive again.
Unfortunately, this combination skill of “Self-destruction+Resurrection” was directly destroyed by Shi Yu in the team competition.
Baby Ginseng thought about ginseng life… It suspected that it had been targeted by a conspiracy, and Buggy had definitely bribed Shi Yu.
“Mi…”
“Ning…”
Chi Tong and Susu also looked at each other.
Although they were at the bottom in the last team meeting, this time, both Chi Tong and Susu wanted to advance a little.
“Mi!!” Chi Tong looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
The greatest problem now was that it had yet to find a suitable undead puppet.
< Name > Chi Tong
“Super Level”: Interlocking Sword (Expert+5), Sun Flame (Expert+2), Spirit Release (Expert+5), Undead Revival (Expert+2), Demon Blade Curse (Expert)
Normal Energy Points: 7 million+
On Chi Tong’s side, it was actually the most comfortable, because in the team, it was the only one with three legendary resources!
On its side, Shi Yu still didn’t add many points. He only pushed the Demon Blade Curse and Undead Revival to expert level.
However, because of the power of the two Sun Flame Flowers and the enhancement of possessing the bone sword, its Sun Flame Proficiency and its Dead Revival Proficiency increased very quickly.
This was the power of legendary resources!
This was even when it only possessed the Sun Flame Flower and only absorbed power and didn’t completely eat it.
If it completely ate one, he would probably immediately break through to the overlord level.
This made Shi Yu sigh. As long as the Beast Tamer was rich enough and had enough suitable legendary resources, the increase in skill proficiency might not be slower than adding points.
Unfortunately, although he had tested the power of the Revival of the Dead with the ferocious beasts on the snow mountain, Chi Tong had yet to find a suitable undead puppet. If he could have the support of an undead puppet with good battle power, Chi Tong felt that its chances of winning could be greater!
“There’s no other way.” Shi Yu shrugged and said, “In the country, it’s basically impossible for there to be suitable ferocious beasts for you to kill.”
“Let’s talk about it after we go abroad. At that time, we’ll raise the Revival of the Dead to perfect level and directly take an overlord undead as our little brother! For now, pretend that you don’t have this skill.”
Chi Tong: Mi? QAQ
“Ning!!” Susu comforted Chi Tong.
At this moment, Susu was actually a little nervous.
The last time, even if it had the will of an overlord, it was still a little traumatized. It was very worried that it would still be at the bottom this time.
As for Ling, it would directly slip away and not participate. Now it was definitely impossible for it to be at the bottom. Now that Sister Chi Tong had also been destroyed, in Susu’s opinion, it was a good thing. Susu felt that it was a little further from the bottom now. Great.
Now, Susu, who had learned the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, felt that it was still very strong.
It had already been reborn since the last team meeting.
< Name > Susu
“Super Skill”: Holy Water Ring (Expert), Water/Ice Elemental Control (Expert+2), Wave Cannon (Expert), Infinite Devour (Expert), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (Expert)
Normal Energy Points: 6 million+
Compared to other pets, Susu’s situation was relatively normal.
Its legendary resource, “Cold Sky Drop”, didn’t help it much in terms of skill proficiency. It only added some changes to its water elemental control.
It was as proficient in controlling the ice element as the water element. This was also thanks to the fact that ice was a form of water.
Because of the existence of the overlord’s will, Susu was also the most suitable for Shi Yu to add points. He basically finished it in a few days.
Unlike when he added points to Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others, he had to rest for two days every time he added points.
“Mi ~” After being comforted by Susu, Chi Tong stuck to Susu. Good sister.
“Come on, come on.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “A new team meeting!”
….
Two days later.
In the ruins space, accompanied by a rumbling vibration and an energy storm, Shi Yu sat calmly at the judge’s seat and looked at the pets in the battle.
Beside him, a Rubik’s Cube floated with lingering fear.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s physique was almost maxed out. After two months of points and recovery, his physique had undoubtedly reached the limit of level six.
After using Buggy’s phantom experiment, it was probably not a problem for Shi Yu to fight a monarch-level dragon of an overlord race with his bare hands.
Shi Yu’s physical strength increased very quickly. He could even fight weaker masters like President Feng and Commander He in Ping Cheng with his bare hands.
If he were to retake the ordinary master license, Master Qu Jie’s Ox-Headed Beast King might not need Eleven to take action. Perhaps Shi Yu could do it himself without sending his pet.
Unfortunately, apart from being able to withstand greater pressure when possessed by undead and mechanical armor, making his overall strength stronger, and being able to withstand more pressure when adding points… It didn’t seem to be useful.
After all, his current opponents were no longer ordinary master-level and monarch-level. They were all legends and overlords.
Even Eleven and the others couldn’t withstand an overlord-level skill, let alone him.
The increase in his physique made Shi Yu feel more comforted. It was the icing on the cake. At least, the chances of him dying from the aftermath of the battle were even smaller.
It was still unrealistic for him to deal with the opponent he was about to face himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - Cultivation Results in Two Months (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 655: Cultivation Results in Two Months (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the moment, the team meeting was already coming to an end.
On the arena, with an indignant and aggrieved roar, a huge panda fell down aggrievedly under the excited and teary gaze of the green divine dragon.
After the cruel battle and the upgrades, the strength ranking in the team changed a hundred million times.
First, Buggy, second, Eleven, third, Baby Ginseng, fourth, Chi Tong, fifth, Susu.
As the saying went, there was a different king each generation. Due to the enhancement of the equipment system, Buggy won every battle with an absolute advantage.
When it carried the legendary Dragon Ball and turned into a divine dragon to fight, its energy level was basically maintained at “over 50 million” and it could continue fighting. Its physical strength was not inferior to Eleven’s. A dragon claw that could tear through space… Even Eleven’s expert level Undying Golden Body and Eleven’s army skills couldn’t withstand more than a few hits.
As for the consecutive eruptions of Eleven, who was in a desperate situation, its power was also greatly weakened under Buggy’s “Demon Suppression Domain”. It couldn’t pose a fatal threat to Buggy. Moreover, Buggy also mastered the “Ultimate Absorption”. Its physical endurance wasn’t much inferior to Eleven.
After a fierce battle, although Eleven became the opponent who posed the greatest threat to Buggy, Buggy still barely defeated it. This made Buggy extremely excited, and it also made Eleven deeply understand the dangers of the world.
“Roar!!! (Leader, thank you!!)” In the sky, Buggy, who had transformed into a green divine dragon, shouted in gratitude. Although it had borrowed external help, it had still beat the leader once.
“Sob…” Eleven, who had fallen to the ground, looked indignant. It wanted to fight again because it couldn’t bear to use the power of the Yun An Demon God just now. Because it was the team meeting, it couldn’t bear to use this almost one-time-use evolution resource. After all, it was still waiting to cooperate with White Thunder and the superalloy to evolve.
It wasn’t convinced!!!
Wuu——!
It wanted to see if Buggy still dared to fight it after it evolved!
“Hoho.” Shi Yu smiled as he watched. Eleven finally knelt once.
Eleven had already worked hard enough. He hoped it wouldn’t go overboard in training now that it lost to Buggy…
At the side, Ling looked at the playful Shi Yu and suspected that Shi Yu planned this all along…
Second place, Eleven. Although it was one move away from losing to Buggy, the other pets still posed a relatively small threat to Eleven. Only Baby Ginseng was a little scarier.
In the beginning, Baby Ginseng hid underground and Eleven flew into the sky. The classic scene reappeared. Eleven and Baby Ginseng couldn’t do anything to each other.
However, after Eleven was forced into a corner, it directly self-mutilated and entered a desperate situation. It exceeded the limit of multiple eruptions. After every electromagnetic cannon touched the ground, it produced an effect comparable to the “Perfect Level super skill Earthquake”. It directly stunned the weak ginseng baby underground, causing it to have a concussion.
In third place, Baby Ginseng was inferior. Its time mark was restricted, and it was destined to be unable to unleash a dazzling attack.
In fourth place, Chi Tong. Chi Tong won very dangerously because if it wanted to erupt with powerful strength, it could only rely on the Myriad Sword Convergence, the Interlocking Sword, and the Demon Blade Curse to stack various buffs. And these few skills had a huge burden. Its two scapegoats were not enough at all.
Time was tight in the team meeting. During this period, Chi Tong definitely didn’t have time to condense a new scapegoat. There were a total of four opponents, so the scapegoats weren’t enough.
Therefore, Chi Tong chose to fight passively against Buggy, Eleven, and Baby Ginseng. It left the two scapegoats to Susu. Only then did it use the two scapegoats as the price of dying and being injured under the extreme eruption of the Myriad Sword Convergence and the Interlocking Sword to successfully let Susu be at the bottom. Otherwise, it would be really dangerous to face the stronger Susu.
As for Susu, who had been schemed against by the plastic sister again… It was completely depressed, making Ling’s heart ache… Fortunately, i didn’t participate.
After this battle, it was obvious that Eleven and the others had obtained a terrifying increase in strength compared to the first team meeting. Although they were still at the monarch level, it was basically no problem for Eleven and the others to fight weaker overlords above their level.
Unfortunately, although Shi Yu had pulled the super skills of his main pets to above expert level in two months, be it Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, or Ling, none of them could upgrade their willpower like Eleven during the painful super skills. It looked like Eleven’s talent was still unique.
Shi Yu still hoped that they could have the overlord’s will quickly. After all, apart from having a huge increase in strength, the greatest difference between mid-level willpower and overlord’s will was that after the one with overlord’s will added points and various supplements were added, Shi Yu would recover for about a day. The burden was lighter, while mid-level willpower needed him to recover for about two days.
At this moment, the strength of each main pet was already passable. While waiting for the pets to recover and for the team battle, Shi Yu was also thinking if it was time to get an overlord-level pet.
After thinking about it, Shi Yu confirmed it. Next, he started over and added points to Eleven.
He added all of Eleven’s super skills to perfect level. Then, with the legendary resource “Aurora Magnetic Gold” and the overlord’s will, he let Eleven break through to perfect overlord level.
Two months of silence had made Shi Yu much thinner. After all, he had either added points or learned various foreign historical knowledge. He had already been forced to the limit…

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - Cultivation Results in Two Months
chapters.content:
Chapter 656: Cultivation Results in Two Months (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
However, because the results of his hard work could receive obvious feedback and with Susu cleansing his heart, Shi Yu could still hold on. They were already considered good here. The really miserable ones were the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duck Beak Beast.
It had been two months. The mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast had yet to defeat the transcendent-level Green Silkworm in the first level, even if they worked together…
Shi Yu could testify that Buggy really didn’t cheat. That was really its strength at the transcendent level.
It was purely because the transcendent-level Green Silkworm was ridiculously strong to begin with. Not only did it master spatial skills, but it could also materialize an ice dragon… Everyone knew how to fight as a duo.
The overlords of the earth and the ocean were destined to be unable to defeat the green worm.
After resting for half a day, Shi Yu was preparing to carry out the team battle of “Shi Yu vs Lu Bai”. He planned to casually take a photo and post it on the Internet to entertain himself and reduce the cooldown time. However, a call interrupted his movements.
It was President Lin.
In the video call, President Lin’s young face appeared. Shi Yu suspected that President Lin had also eaten some special legendary resource. Otherwise, it was impossible for him to look younger than him at 100 years old.
“Shi Yu.” As soon as the call connected, President Lin said, “Didn’t you say before that you wanted to go to the Heavenly Fox Nation?”
Shi Yu was stunned and immediately nodded. “Yes, what’s wrong? The Space Emperor’s Space Beast Egg has an incubation point over there.”
“Are you free now? If you want to go over, you can consider carrying out an additional special mission,” President Lin said.
“What?”
President Lin said, “A legendary ruin descended in the Heavenly Fox Nation. According to our spies, this ruin might have come from the Emperor Wu Era and is related to the Iron-eating Beast.”
“The location of the ruins is a remote village in the Heavenly Fox Nation, and a large number of iron-eating beasts live near this village.”
“This is the first iron-eating beast trace discovered outside Dong Huang.”
“The other situations are still unclear. At the moment, this ruin has already been controlled by the ‘Heavenly Fox Nation’. It shouldn’t have been cracked yet. Next, we’ll send a few people to infiltrate the Heavenly Fox Nation and take over this ruin. You’re an expert in the archeology of the iron-eating beasts. If you participate, it might be much smoother.”
“Moreover, there’s a guardian in the country who used the prophecy ability to determine that there might be iron-eating beast evolution materials in this ruin. It’s just that we can’t be sure if it’s an evolution material or a second-stage evolution material.”
“Of course, apart from accepting this ruin, you also have to bring the Iron-eating Beast race that wandered in the Heavenly Fox Nation back to Dong Huang.”
Shi Yu was stunned. “The Heavenly Fox Nation… has an Iron-eating Beast Race?!”
“There might be iron-eating beast evolution materials in the ruins?”
“Well, that’s right.” President Lin nodded and said, “Of course, for you, the most important thing is your own safety and hatching of the Space Beast Egg. Then comes the task of bringing back the Iron-eating Beast Race, and then cracking and bringing back the ruins. If there’s no progress in the ruins, you can give up. After all, that place is already strictly controlled by the totem country…”
“Although the power of the Heavenly Fox Nation isn’t strong, and their fox god is only comparable to the guardian cat Ying, it’s still an extremely dangerous place…”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. From the looks of it, he couldn’t continue to stay cooped up and increase points. It was better to increase points as he walked. When he heard that there were ruins, and they were iron-eating beast ruins, the blood that Shi Yu had cooled down for two months immediately burned. As expected, exploring ruins was youth…

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - Hunting An Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 657: Hunting An Overlord (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
On the icy plain, the cold wind blew like a blade and hit Shi Yu.
Shi Yu held the phone and asked President Lin, “President Lin, when are we leaving? Apart from me, who else is there?”
On the other side, President Lin said, “Apart from you, the other candidates haven’t been confirmed.”
On the other side, President Lin said, “Apart from you, the other candidates haven’t been confirmed.”
“Because I just received the news, the first person I contacted was you,” President Lin said.
“However, I have almost an idea about the other candidates.”
“For example, Ji Feng from the tenth bureau.”
“Although his strength is a bit weaker, his All Things Affinity talent can not only be close to natural energy, but also to all things.”
“In the gaming terminology of you young people, it means that he has a favorable affinity while in the enemy territory… It’s very suitable for infiltration operations. This is also why he can enter the Intelligence Bureau.”
“Although he’s not strong, Ji Feng has also infiltrated the totem country]ies many times to carry out missions. He can definitely help you.”
“For example, Ke Yingzong from the eleventh bureau. You guys have formed a team to explore the Phoenix Mystic Realm. You might be very compatible with each other. He’s also an experienced person. He’s a legend who has gone to the totem country many times to carry out archeological missions.”
“Of course, the most important thing is still the guardian of Ancient Capital University that you have a good relationship with.”
Shi Yu: “Mm.”
Was this lineup really alright?
Didn’t their Dong Huang have any other guardians? Why did they always pull a cat around?
“I’m not asking you to fight. It’s a secret mission, so the number of people isn’t the key,” President Lin said.
“Don’t expose your identity in this mission. After all, we’re in a special contract period now. The Heavenly Fox Nation has also signed a world competition contract. In theory, we can’t invade the sovereignty of the Heavenly Fox Nation.”
Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment.
“Of course, in order to ensure safety, apart from Guardian Ying, I’ll also ask another guardian to go with you.”
Shi Yu expressed his understanding.
Two guardians, that was fine.
Low profile.
“There will also be a member of the tenth bureau in charge of picking you up in the Heavenly Fox Nation. I’ll send you her specific information later. After this mission, you have to bring her back safely. This is also her last mission.”
The last mission?
Why did it sound a little wrong…
Shi Yu nodded. He understood. He wasn’t going to fight, but to do something sneaky.
President Lin said, “You and the gem cat are a team. Set off alone. Go and hatch the Space Beast Egg first. Be at your destination in seven days.”
“The other infiltration team will set off alone. They will arrive before you and collect information. You and the gem cat will be their backup.”
“They’re in the light, but you and the gem cat are in the dark.”
….
After receiving the mission from President Lin, Shi Yu immediately received the information about Dong Huang’s spies in the Heavenly Fox Nation and the other guardian that President Lin planned to send.
Shi Yu fell silent.
Members of the tenth bureau, Qu Ling.
Why did this name sound so familiar?
Wasn’t this… Master Qu Jie’s daughter???
He had previously heard that Master Qu Jie’s daughter was a little genius and stayed in the tenth bureau. Master Qu Jie was also promoted because his daughter’s performance in the mission was outstanding. He didn’t expect to meet her in this way…
Apart from that, President Lin also sent Shi Yu the information on the guardian who had gone to be a bodyguard for another infiltration team.
Shi Yu fell silent again.
Dong Huang’s guardian, Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly.
Wasn’t this… the butterfly god that helped Buggy evolve??
One of the members of the second team of Lin Feng Legend.
Was he going to be woken up by President Lin not long after holding the Butterfly Meeting?
As the descendant of Legendary Lin Feng, President Lin seemed to be able to persuade the pets that this Legendary left behind. The Sea Dragon King seemed to have a good relationship with President Lin too.
“Then there’s no problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
In addition to the gem cat, there were a total of two guardians. If they went to the weakest totem country, the Heavenly Fox Nation, and also remembered to keep a low profile, it wouldn’t be a problem…
….
Shi Yu called the gem cat and informed it to come over to travel together. The cat cursed and hung up.
Apart from the gem cat, Shi Yu originally wanted to find the Void Mantis and Senior Lu.
Because his original plan was to call them when he went to places like the Heavenly Fox Nation to travel.
However, due to the sudden addition of a mission, Shi Yu thought for a moment and decided to forget it. He still had to ask President Lin. It was too troublesome.
Women would only delay his speed of cracking the ruins…
Eh? Wait a minute, Senior Lu was also an archeologist. It didn’t seem to delay the speed of cracking the ruins. There could even be an additional effect…
But it was still troublesome. It was a pity that he couldn’t experience the speed of the mantis car.
He was quite satisfied with the speed of the cat car and the bug car. He wondered how the Space Emperor’s mantis car felt.
While waiting for the cat to come, Shi Yu did not stay idle. He summoned all his contracted pets.
“Wuu!” “Wu!!” “Yi?” “Mi!” “Ning?!”
After Eleven and the others were summoned, apart from Ling, they looked at Shi Yu in anticipation.
Maybe a team battle was about to be held?
“No, after Teacher Cat comes, we have to go to the totem country to carry out a mission. We have other things to do during this period, so we can’t waste too much energy,” Shi Yu said.
“Yay ~” Ling’s originally depressed face suddenly became happy.
“But I’m free now anyway…” Shi Yu smiled. Suddenly, Ling had a bad feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - Hunting An Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 658: Hunting An Overlord (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
As expected… Shi Yu let Chi Tong possess him and split into two.
A blue-haired Lu Bai clone and a red-haired Shi Yu clone.
Shi Yu looked at the two clones and nodded. He chuckled and said, “Let’s fight. Eleven, Ling, you guys also go and split into clones to help them.”
His main body didn’t have the energy to fight anymore. Let Lu Bai’s clone fight Shi Yu’s clone for fun.
Eleven, Ling: ???
Lu Bai and Shi Yu’s clones: ???
Then, under the gaze of Shi Yu and his pets, a world where only the clones were injured appeared.
The battle between the Shi Yu clone+Eleven clone+Buggy clone+Baby Ginseng clone+Chi Tong clone vs the Lu Bai clone+Ling clone+Susu clone+Chi Tong clone was about to begin.
As there was an additional clone on the left, in order to balance the battle power, Shi Yu only let the Chi Tong clone on the left have the power of a level-one awakened beast. It was purely used as a cosmetic.
The outcome was also very tragic. Baby Ginseng’s clone self-destructed and directly blew up both parties, forcing a draw.
The main bodies shook their heads repeatedly.
As expected, it was right to ban Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction in the team competition…
Although both parties had died, Shi Yu’s goal had been achieved. He held his cell phone and looked at the battle photo of [Red-haired Sword God Shi Yu vs Blue-haired Spear God Lu Bai]. He was very satisfied.
In the scene, the red-haired Sword God, Shi Yu, held a fire sword spirit, and the blue-haired Spear God, Lu Bai, held a sniper rifle. The battle between the sword light and the impact cannon was extremely spectacular.
“Sigh, boring.”
Shi Yu directly got Buggy to post a status through the [Time Traveler] account and send the photo.
Shi Yu and the others only posted Mu Huiyin’s video before turning it down. This was the only account where netizens could find Shi Yu, so many people tagged this account to ask about the results of Shi Yu and Lu Bai’s battle.
The reason why the audience was so eager to know was that Lu Bai’s battle results in challenging the champion on the seven islands had been exposed.
It wasn’t exposed by Dong Huang’s own people.
It was exposed by Lendi of the Shen Feng exchange team in embarrassment.
Because he lost to Lu Bai, a group of people ran over to criticize him, so he investigated Lu Bai. Then, he exposed the battle results of Lu Bai instantly killing the number one person under the legends of the new generation of the seven islands on the path to champion. He wanted to show that it wasn’t that he was weak, but that this guy was too abnormal and not a regular human.
This made Shi Yu and Lu Bai’s match very sought after…
And now, everyone had finally gotten what they wanted.
This update of Buggy could be said to have shocked all of Dong Huang…
Because apart from a picture of Shi Yu vs Lu Bai, there were also three words attached to the account:
“I won.”
Holy shit!
Shi Yu vs Lu Bai, Shi Yu won!
Apart from Director Zhong, Principal Feng, Legend Noble Gui, Legend Xiao Shuang, Legend Ke, and the others, most people were shocked.
Lu Bai’s battle results were already strong, but Shi Yu could actually win!
How strong was Shi Yu?!
As he looked at the comments praising him, Shi Yu was happy and in a good mood. The cooldown time for adding points immediately decreased because of his good mood…
….
“What are you doing?”
Ping Cheng, in Shi Yu’s big villa.
The gem cat rushed over and said, “We’re going to the Heavenly Fox Nation, just the two of us??”
It looked at Shi Yu, who was playing with his cell phone, and said, “You should… want a few more bodyguards, right?”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “Why are you even more cowardly than me?”
“It’s not just the two of us. There’s also a guardian…” Shi Yu quickly repeated what President Lin had told him to the gem cat. When it heard that the butterfly god was around, the gem cat immediately nodded in satisfaction.
That was alright.
“You don’t understand. It’s dangerous outside.” The gem cat looked serious and said, “For example, if we want to go to the Heavenly Fox Nation, the road is very dangerous.”
“Have you seen the map?”
“If we want to go to the Heavenly Fox Nation, we first have to pass through a forbidden area of an unknown size. Many overlords over there have established themselves and occupy mountains as kings. It’s considered a chaotic area. Some overlords aren’t necessarily weaker than that whale.”
“Then, after leaving the forbidden zone, you have to pass through either the ‘Divine Tree Nation’ or one of the countries in the ‘Divine Elephant Nation’ to reach the ‘Heavenly Fox Nation’.”
“The controller of the Divine Tree Nation is a divine tree with the strength of a top-notch totem. The plants everywhere in the country might be its eyes. No one knows where its main body is.”
“And the controller of the ‘Divine Elephant Nation’, the Destructive Divine Mammoth, is also a top-notch totem. It has mastered the ‘Perfect Undying Golden Body’. It’s difficult for a demigod to kill it.”
“I know.” Shi Yu nodded. He naturally understood this.
“So let’s go from the ‘Divine Elephant Nation’ to the ‘Heavenly Fox Nation’. It’s safer this way. I’ll directly hide in the ruins space. You can teleport me over. In the blink of an eye, I’ll reach my destination,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“I reckon that the Butterfly God and the others should have also used this method to infiltrate.”
The gem cat: ???
“Let Buggy do it!!” The gem cat said, “I have to be vigilant of my surroundings at all times to protect your safety. Traveling is too tiring.”
Shi Yu said, “Then let Buggy do it!”
It was first in the team, wasn’t it? The capable ones did more work.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - Hunting Overlords (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 659: Hunting Overlords (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Did it really think it was so easy to first in the team?
[Buggy]: ???
“Alright ~” The gem cat was much gentler after that.
“When are we leaving?” The gem cat couldn’t wait anymore.
Legendary-level ruins!
Just now, Shi Yu had said that this was a legendary ruin!
If there was a gem inside, it would be given priority.
Even without the gem, the salary would be a lot, at least not less than the Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly’s.
“As soon as possible, but President Lin asked us to go later. Let the others investigate the situation first. Safety first,” Shi Yu said.
“What do you think?” the gem cat said.
“Safety first. Let’s go prepare first. We’ll change our appearance in the forbidden zone and increase our trump cards before hatching the pet egg. Finally, we’ll meet the main group.”
“How do we prepare??”
“Of course, it’s better to change my appearance simply and change my pet to increase my battle power.”
The gem cat: “?”
“What other pets do you have to exchange?? Don’t tell it’s that duck.”
“Yes, have you forgotten Chi Tong’s Undead Revival skill? It has already learned this skill through the bone sword.”
“Although Chi Tong’s Undead Revival hasn’t reached perfect level and it can’t control overlord-level undead puppets, doesn’t this still have legendary resources? As long as Chi Tong possesses the bone sword and kills overlord-level creatures through the bone sword, the effect is the same. It can control overlord-level undead.”
“Let’s hunt two to three overlord-level creatures in the forbidden zone of the Lost World first and turn them into undead puppets to control in the bone sword. At that time, won’t my new identity be created?”
“Legendary Spirit Medium… Undead Calamity… Undead Master…”
“An evil Undead Sorcerer exploring ruins in the Heavenly Fox Nation. It will feel completely different from Shi Yu and Lu Bai.”
Lost World Forbidden Zone.
It was considered the buffer area between Dong Huang and the totem country.
This… was also Baby Ginseng’s hometown.
The environment was very dangerous. The ferocious beasts inside were far stronger than the ferocious beasts in Dong Huang.
Of course, the strongest was only an overlord. With the gem cat leading the way, transmigrating was easy.
Apart from that, this was also the place where Dong Huang produced the most beast tides.
There would definitely be undead puppets suitable for Chi Tong.
Chi Tong had always hated why it wasn’t sufficiently prepared before the second team meeting. Otherwise, if it possessed the bone sword and killed a few overlords first, this equipment system would also be beneficial to it. Buggy might not necessarily be first!
The gem cat fell into deep thought.
After some thought, he came to a conclusion and looked at Shi Yu with a burning gaze.
“You… Don’t tell me you want me to be your fighter and help you fight overlords!!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “How could that be? Let’s try it ourselves first. We’ll treat it as practice before the world competition. If we can’t defeat it, you can come again…”
The gem cat: !!!
So it was still it who had to do it!
The gem cat’s face fell.
“Confirm with me before you choose which overlord to fight…”
“No way, even totems have to choose weak targets when fighting overlords?”
“What do you know!”
….
Dong Huang, border area, White Mountain Town.
This place was the same as Icefield City. It was at the border of Dong Huang’s land, but Icefield City was next to the ocean. This place was next to a huge mountain range, and this mountain range contained many forbidden areas of the Lost World inside. It was a natural danger zone that isolated Dong Huang, the Divine Tree Nation, the Divine Elephant Nation, and the other totem areas. It was very difficult to cross.
Even legendary Beast Tamers were unwilling to go deeper. Of course, because the forbidden zone contained rich resources, there would still be Beast Tamers who took the risk from time to time to enter the inner area to hunt and search for treasures.
For example, back then, Grandma Li only caught Baby Ginseng because she came here to explore a fossil mystic realm.
They were about to go home. In Shi Yu’s team, Baby Ginseng was as excited as Chi Tong.
Chi Tong was excited that it would soon have an overlord undead puppet…
As for Baby Ginseng’s passionate suggestion, it would first hunt those monsters that it had memories of. It wouldn’t be too late for Baby Ginseng to take revenge. It was back!!

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - Undying Sun Ginseng (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Undying Sun Ginseng (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu and the others didn’t stop in White Mountain Town. Instead, they directly teleported into the Lost World forbidden zone and smuggled out of the country!
The complicated natural environment here was like a maze, and the interior was extremely dangerous. Even if a legend stepped in, there was a chance of death, so it was called Lost World.
Now, the place where Shi Yu and the others were was a dark forest that was difficult to see through. The huge trees were all dozens of meters tall, and the atmosphere was extremely oppressive. From time to time, the roars of ferocious beasts would come from the surroundings.
At the moment, Eleven and the other six pets were all outside, hanging on Shi Yu scatteredly. It was difficult to discover them without careful observation.
For example, Eleven was lying in his pocket, like Chi Tong, who was hanging in front of his chest like a sword-shaped accessory.
Among them, Ling had even turned into a pair of glasses through the Hundred Transformations skill. Shi Yu put it on his face and it cooperated with him to observe the situation in all directions.
Due to the speciality of the Mechanic class, the glasses that Ling had turned into had number one reconnaissance ability in Shi Yu’s team.
Shi Yu could clearly see the changes in all directions with himself as the center through the glasses and super vision skill.
Through this method, they could also avoid getting lost to the greatest extent… and avoid some meaningless battle consumption.
“Baby Ginseng, we’re not there yet?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yi!! (I don’t know, I, we seem to be lost…)” Baby Ginseng stuck its head out.
As expected! It had forgotten the way home!
Shi Yu slapped his forehead. It was unrealistic to expect Baby Ginseng to lead the way. At that time, it was only an transcendent-level supplement. Then, it was brought out by Grandma Li. How could it know the way inside!
During the process of passing through the forbidden zone, Shi Yu and the others also wanted to pass by Baby Ginseng’s hometown.
Firstly, he wanted Baby Ginseng to return home in glory, and secondly, he wanted to find an undead puppet for Chi Tong.
Regarding the undead puppet, Shi Yu and the others’ first goal was the overlord of Baby Ginseng’s hometown, the Green Scaled Dragon.
Baby Ginseng still had a fresh memory of this guy. Although it had never met the Green Scaled Dragon directly, Baby Ginseng had often heard of the ferocious name of the Green Scaled Dragon.
The Green Scaled Dragon liked to let its subordinates collect various spiritual herbs and spiritual fruits to enjoy. Many supplements that Baby Ginseng knew were captured because of this. If it weren’t for the fact that it was lousy at that time and had to be fattened up before being killed, it would probably have already become a meal.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng expressed its childhood trauma.
“Wuu!!” “Wu!!” “Mi!!”
Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong made Baby Ginseng calm down. When the time came, they would attack together. Whatever Green Scaled Dragon or Dark God Chicken this was, they would all become undead.
“Yi! (I’ll try it myself first. If I can’t defeat it, you guys attack!)”
Baby Ginseng chuckled. If it could self-destruct, Baby Ginseng was a little confident, but if it couldn’t self-destruct, so it still felt that it was a little dangerous.
And a trump card like self-destruction… naturally couldn’t be left to the green-scaled dragon.
Shi Yu and the others already had an idea where to use this revival…
“Let’s search again and see if we’re lucky… Well, wait.”
As Shi Yu walked, he suddenly frowned and discovered the mess in the distance.
It was as if a huge battle had happened not long ago and it had already become ruins.
They rushed over and saw a place filled with corpses and dark red blood.
There were human corpses and pet corpses here. Of course, they were already almost gone. Mostly eaten.
“It should be a Beast Tamer from Dong Huang who came here to take the risk,” Shi Yu said. “He died in the past two days.”
“It wasn’t done by wild ferocious beasts. It was done by human Beast Tamers.” At this moment, the gem cat that was yawning in the alternate space appeared. Its gem eyes seemed to be able to see the past and the future.
It said, “We’re already considered to have gone deep into the forbidden zone. This is the border between Dong Huang and the totem area. These Beast Tamers who came here to explore might die in the hands of ferocious beasts, or they might die in the hands of the Beast Tamers in the totem area.”
“After all, entering this place is a matter of life and death. Even if you die, no one will investigate.”
“I’ve already discovered that person. The other party isn’t far away.” The gem cat looked into the distance.
Shi Yu said, “What level?”
“Ah, how should I put it?” the gem cat said. “The Beast Tamer should be at level six, but the pet is at the overlord level.”
Shi Yu was stunned. “A contract above their level?”
“Yes.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded. Pets relied on squeezing out the life potential of Beast Tamers to grow. It was an old tradition in the totem country.
“Then let’s go over there and take a look.” Shi Yu revealed an expectant expression.
“What?” the gem cat said. “You want to take revenge for this group of people?”
Shi Yu grinned and said, “That’s not it. Be it here or there, they should have been prepared to die before entering such a place. I’m just going to check on their Beast Taming Talent. You’ve reminded me that when I reach the totem area, I can also find suitable Beast Taming Talents.”
Shi Yu was quite open-minded about this kind of thing. Humans hunted ferocious beasts, and ferocious beasts hunted humans. In his opinion, it was quite normal for the seven countries and the totem country to fight for resource territories. He wasn’t an ideal and great young man. The benefits of himself, the people, pets, and factions related to him were the greatest.
For example, pursuing world peace and equal life was impossible.
“You brat.” The gem cat recalled that Shi Yu had told it that apart from the Awakening Mirror, he had also obtained a talent bead created by a Yue Maiden that could replicate the Beast Taming Talent from An Chang. Therefore, Shi Yu had even asked the gem cat to protect An Chang in Ancient Capital University.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - Undying Sun Ginseng (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Undying Sun Ginseng (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“After this Beast Tamer’s talent has been plundered by you, do you still want to turn their pet into an undead and snatch it?” The gem cat curled its lips.
Shi Yu said, “That depends on the strength of the pet. If it’s too weak, it’s not worth occupying the spatial position of the bone sword…”
“Damn it, you still look down on overlords.”
….
In the dark forest, a Beast Tamer in dark green ancient clothes hidden in complicated plants was sitting cross-legged on a tree, meditating with his eyes closed.
“Not enough, not enough, not enough!!!”
A violent, bloodthirsty, and low voice kept coming from the Beast Tamer’s heart.
“High-level Beast Tamers are rare individuals. We definitely won’t be able to encounter the next batch in the short term. Let me rest first, and then we’ll change places to hunt.”
This Beast Tamer’s face was pale and he looked very weak. From time to time, he would take out a pill from his clothes and place it in his mouth.
“Your recovery is too slow.”
Its voice was impatient, but suddenly, its tone changed.
“Eh? There’s movement? This is a supplement’s aura?”
A violent, bloodthirsty, and low voice sounded, stunning the Beast Tamer.
She opened her eyes. In the next moment, a fragrance slowly came to her. In an instant, she felt that her exhausted body had improved a lot.
This was very unbelievable, because she had contracted an overlord-level creature at level six. Her body had already been dragged down to less than five years of lifespan, and her body was constantly on the verge of collapse. In order to maintain her life, she had tried countless medicines, but the effect was very small.
But just an aura just now actually made her feel like her body had changed its vitality??
What exactly was it!
However, she still said cautiously, “Something’s wrong… This is the territory of the Green Scaled Dragon. It has always loved to eat nourishing spiritual fruits. How can a nourishing life form come here…”
“Cut the crap. It looks like its level isn’t low. Let’s catch it and split it.”
The violent voice sounded, making the Beast Tamer fall silent slightly. “If you continue to mess around with your overlord-level strength, we’ll all die. This is the border of Dong Huang. The Beast Tamers you eat are all from Dong Huang. There are countless people who can get rid of us over there.”
“You’re too careful.”
“Are you looking down on my overlord-level strength?!!” As its voice fell, the life figure that made them sense that something was wrong slowly appeared.
It was a ginseng baby about 0.3 meters tall in a white coat, a doctorate hat, and a green leaf scarf…
The appearance of this ginseng baby made the Beast Tamer and the mysterious voice who sensed its figure fall silent.
“Monarch level, ginseng baby??” The mysterious voice was shocked. It was completely new.
“Something’s wrong, this isn’t a wild ginseng baby!! Its clothes are from Dong Huang!!!”
However, at the same time, the female Beast Tamer’s vigilant mental voice instantly sounded.
In the next moment, the ground directly collapsed and cracked. Countless wooden spikes shot into the sky and bent towards this ginseng baby!!
Boom.
Underground, a huge tree demon rose from the ground, revealing a deep red single eye as it waved its bloodstained branches.
< Name > Earth Abyss Demon Tree
[Attributes]: Wood, Earth
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 30.6 million
The Earth Abyss Demon Tree and the female Beast Tamer stared at the ginseng baby that had been pierced by the Earth Thorn. But not long after, their expressions changed drastically, because with a boom, the Earth Thorn that surrounded the cage was immediately torn into pieces, turning into messy fragments that bounced in all directions with a wind pressure!
Inside the Earth Spike, the ginseng baby that was attacked just now was not affected at all. There wasn’t even dust on its body.
At this moment, it was holding a sword-shaped leaf like a sword immortal, looking elegant!
The commotion just now was caused by it waving the sword leaf!
Boom!
A terrifying overlord-level might erupted from this ginseng baby.
The power of the Time Fruit was activated. The ginseng baby, which was originally at the monarch level in the other party’s eyes, instantly increased to the overlord level. The energy wave was at least twice that of this Earth Abyss Demon Tree.
Seeing this scene, the expressions of the Earth Abyss Demon Tree and the female Beast Tamer changed drastically again.
“Overlord-level ginseng baby, how is this possible!!!”
“Retreat!!”
They instantly had the same thought because everything was too ridiculous.
However, Baby Ginseng didn’t seem to want to give them this chance.
“Yi… (Anything is possible.)” Baby Ginseng’s expression was calm. The sword leaves created through plant control vibrated crazily in its hand, and from time to time, sword cries that tore through the air could be heard.
In the next moment, like a sword light that broke through the darkness, Baby Ginseng’s aura was like an unsheathed sharp sword. As Baby Ginseng hooked its finger, the sword leaf directly turned into a sword light with a light and slashed at the Earth Abyss Demon Tree.
Towering emperor, sword control technique!
“Why does this Baby Ginseng know how to attack!!!” The Earth Abyss Demon Tree was shocked.
Swoosh!
The fatal aura made the Earth Abyss Demon Tree’s entire body turn cold. At this moment, it still didn’t understand what was going on. However, with its wood-element strengthening talent, it no longer cared about anything. It directly hardened its entire body and resisted this attack!!
With a boom, the sword leaf hit the Earth Abyss Demon Tree and drew a sunken wound on its stomach. And because of the hardening existence, half of the sword leaf was directly stuck on the Earth Abyss Demon Tree’s body, making it unable to take another step forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - Undying Sun Ginseng (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Undying Sun Ginseng (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
It was only a light injury.
The attack couldn’t completely break through its defense.
“Huh???” Seeing this, the Earth Abyss Demon Tree heaved a sigh of relief. It suddenly felt that it was only so-so.
Yes, why should he be afraid of a mere ginseng baby?
Even if it was at the overlord level!
“Not good!!” But at this moment, the contractor of the Earth Abyss Demon Tree felt a life-and-death crisis.
The half sword leaf on the Earth Abyss Demon Tree’s body… flickered with orange-red light.
It emitted a warm aura.
That was… the light of an explosion.
On the other side, Baby Ginseng shook its head. As expected, it was still not suitable to be a sword immortal. Explosion was the eternal art…
Mutated Moon Explosion!
As the light became stronger and stronger, the Earth Abyss Demon Tree’s pupils constricted.
Boom…
A dazzling red light came out, accompanied by a world-shaking bang. The rolling heat wave tide rose into the sky like a volcano eruption.
The red smoke swept up energy fluctuations like Sun Flame Flowers that instantly bloomed in the sky.
The violent hot wind and shock wave uprooted countless huge trees and burned them. At this moment, as strong wind and strong light blew over, the female Beast Tamer on the tree instantly sensed the death message of the Earth Abyss Demon Tree. It also made her already weak life aura even weaker because of the backlash of her pet.
Right on the heels of that, her figure disappeared from the explosion like the Earth Abyss Demon Tree and died completely. Even the enemy’s Beast Tamer couldn’t be seen!
Until everything calmed down…
“It was directly killed?” Shi Yu and the others slowly walked over, and the gem cat asked.
“Wood-element strengthening talent. Boring. I looked forward to it for nothing.”
“I mean that tree. Didn’t it become an undead?”
“No…”
“Although it’s at the overlord level, it’s a monarch race at the overlord level. It’s too weak… It’s useless for it to become an undead puppet,” Shi Yu muttered.
It was all for nothing.
When the gem cat was at the overlord level, it had more than 50 million energy points. The two overlords Baby Ginseng had killed previously also had about 50 million. This 30 million was too weak, equivalent to the weakest overlord. It had no collection value at all.
Moreover, as a Beast Tamer, it was also professional ethics not to throw a pokeball at the pets of other Beast Tamers!
“Yi ~” In the hot ruins, Baby Ginseng straightened its hat and took root on the spot with a weak expression. It used the Earth Chain to recover its state. Just now, it used the Time Fruit to erupt, directly draining its state.
Although it was just a leaf, it had exhausted most of its energy. The profundity was the final explosion.
“You’ve changed,” the gem cat also muttered.
This kid wasn’t that little brat who had to have a bodyguard even when killing monarch-level undead in the Undead Battlefield.
“The pair just now should be from the Divine Tree Nation, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Well, both pets and Beast Tamers,” the gem cat analyzed. “Moreover, that overlord should be an overlord who was given ‘special power’ by the controller of the Divine Tree Nation. Otherwise, how could that guy break through to the overlord level?”
“Ordinary Earth Abyss Demon Trees don’t have the habit of sucking blood, and this one seems to like sucking blood very much, and it likes to suck human blood very much. It’s probably the way it breaks through to overlord.”
The gem cat said, “Also, it’s quite ruthless to squeeze its contractor dry. That Beast Tamer’s life fluctuations are like candles that are about to be extinguished…”
It was completely using unorthodox methods to use Beast Tamers as a resource to break through the racial restrictions. Most high-level pets of totem countries had mastered such skills.
Shi Yu fell silent and said, “If I contracted an overlord-level pet in advance, would I become as weak as that woman?”
The gem cat grinned. “That’s not for certain. Even if you don’t contract in advance, you look pretty weak.”
“Tch.” Shi Yu shrugged.
His physique shouldn’t be something others could compare to… Probably.
Shi Yu came to Baby Ginseng’s side and handed it a level-seven energy crystal to accelerate its recovery.
At this moment, the gem cat said again, “Speaking of which, what was that move just now… No matter how weak that overlord is, under normal circumstances, it shouldn’t have been blown to pieces, right…”
“It’s the Sun Flame Flower. Baby Ginseng added the power of the Sun Flame Flower,” Shi Yu said.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng held the energy crystal and nodded!
