On the top of Baby Ginseng’s head were ten ginseng leaves and a ginseng flower.
There were great tactics here. It stored the mutation power it had collected through its mutations.
For example, the ten ginseng leaves stored spatial power and were an important source of power to use the Anti-Buggy Energy Fruit in battle.
Among the ginseng flowers, Baby Ginseng was currently storing the legendary sun power from the Sun Flame Flower.
“Sun Flame Flower???” The gem cat was stunned and said, “Isn’t that Chi Tong’s resource?”
“Mi!!” The sword spirit pendant hanging on Shi Yu’s neck swayed. There were two, so it was fine to give one to Baby Ginseng.
As long as Baby Ginseng had more chances to revive, it would be fine as long as Baby Ginseng allowed it to eat it a bit…
Baby Ginseng: …
Shi Yu said, “My new idea is to let Baby Ginseng evolve again through the Sun Flame Flower.”
Moon Explosion was a method to use Moonlight Radiation to make plants explode, and Moonlight came from the sun. If Baby Ginseng could also mutate through sun-type resources, its self-destruction might be even stronger.
When it exploded, the sun and moon shone together!
The explosion of the sun was stronger than the explosion of the moon, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - Undying Sun Ginseng (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Undying Sun Ginseng (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
If only Baby Ginseng could master the nuclear fusion ability of the sun…
However, the Sun Flame Flower was a legendary fire-element resource after all, and Baby Ginseng was a wood-element resource. Such a reverse-element mutation was definitely very dangerous. Therefore, at the moment, Shi Yu was letting Baby Ginseng experience and adapt through this method.
In fact, he had already adapted most of the time. He wasn’t prepared previously, but now, Baby Ginseng’s revival skill had already cooled down. When he found an opportunity, he might be able to let Baby Ginseng try using the Sun Flame Flower as a mutated resource.
If it succeeded, it would be the Undying Sun Ginseng.
Even if it failed, it could still revive.
Not only could the Time Mark be used to self-destruct, but it could also be used to bet on mutations!
“Is it reliable?” The gem cat’s eyelids twitched. The last time, the fact that you let Baby Ginseng absorb the power of death was already unreliable. This time, you still want Baby Ginseng to absorb the legendary sun power to evolve??
He really wasn’t afraid that Baby Ginseng would die.
It was as if he thought everything would be fine since it could revive…
“Yiya.” Baby Ginseng wiped its tears. If not for the sake of being first in the team, which wood-element plant would be willing to absorb the power of fire?
….
Next, Shi Yu and the others searched. In the end, the gem cat discovered the traces of the Green Scaled Dragon.
The place where they were fighting just now was actually the edge of the Green Scaled Dragon’s territory. As Shi Yu and the others infiltrated and discovered many Green Scaled Snakes, they understood that they had already entered the other party’s territory.
The Green-scaled Snakes were commander species creatures, while the Green-scaled Flood Dragons were low-level overlord species creatures. They were the overlords of this forbidden zone. They were at the top of the food chain in the form of races, commanding other weak races.
“Yi!!!” After returning home, Baby Ginseng was extremely excited. Yes, it was these guys!!!
However, although Baby Ginseng was excited, the gem cat’s expression was a little troubled. “Are you sure you want to provoke this guy?”
It stood on the same mountain as Shi Yu and looked at another mountain. It said, “Although I can only sense it from afar, I can roughly confirm that this guy is on a completely different level from that Earth Abyss Demon Tree and that Heavenly Cloud Tiger. It’s very likely a top-notch overlord.”
In the gem cat’s opinion, even if Shi Yu and the others worked together to fight a top-notch overlord, it would be very difficult. At that time, it would most likely still need its help.
“Top-notch overlord?” Shi Yu was stunned. “Are you sure?”
“In any case, the aura is very strong,” the gem cat said. “The places where overlords live all year round will have their deterrence and reflect their strength. It’s also a warning to the enemy.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s good to be a top-notch overlord. It’s meaningless to fight ordinary overlords. Why don’t we use a top-notch overlord to test Eleven and the others’ strength? In any case, there’s still you…”
Gem Cat: “! @#% #￥@￥”
“I’m not done!!!” the gem cat said. “Moreover, from the situation over there, there shouldn’t be just one overlord, but three!!”
The gem cat said, “I sensed the aura of three overlords from that side. The other two shouldn’t be stronger than the Green Scaled Dragon, but they’re definitely not weak. They won’t be weaker than that Heavenly Cloud Tiger!!”
“Three? It’s already good enough that these overlords don’t fight for territory, why are they still gathered together? Are they playing together?”
Green Scale Mountain.
In the Green Scaled Dragon’s territory, apart from the Green Scaled Dragon, there were indeed two overlords. One of them was the Ice-Eyed White Tiger, and the other was the Mountain Tortoise.
The incomparably huge Green Scaled Dragon circled around the rock and stared at the two overlords below. “Have the two of you already decided?”
“I’ve decided.”
“In any case, I don’t have much lifespan left. I might as well give it a try.”
The Mountain Tortoise and the Ice-Eyed White Tiger roared. During this period of time, the overlords of the forbidden zone of the Lost World often received invitations from the totem countries. The conditions promised by the totem countries to join were getting higher and higher. Apart from level-eight resources, there would also be humans as blood food and nutrients for growth.
Compared to the totem country and the human countries, the wild overlords without factions were originally the weaker side. They didn’t rely on any faction because they were used to freedom, but this time, it was unusual.
This time, the World Tree allowed the totem country to participate in the World Tournament. Most of the totem countries had been invited to the World Tournament. If they joined the totem country, they would have the chance to obtain high-level resources and human blood food to participate in the World Tournament and change their fate. For some wild overlords, it was quite a temptation.
After all, the habitat of the World Tree had a large number of mythical and legendary ruins that could change one’s fate. It was no longer a secret. In the mouths of humans, this was a world competition, but for the totem country, this was the battle for the ruins mystic realm!
“Haha, then the three of us brothers will fight together!!” The green-scaled dragon laughed.
The Mountain Tortoise said, “Hahaha, good, unfortunately, if only we had another bird-type brother. At that time, we can get a combination of the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise!”

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 664: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Green Scale Mountain Cave.
The Green Scaled Dragon, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger, and the three brothers had already decided to seek refuge in the largest totem country nearby, the Dragonman Empire.
The humans in the Dragonman Empire were all hybrids. Being able to withstand their need for nutrients, they could provide them with more growth nutrients.
Beast Taming Contracts were two-way. When the Beast Tamer was strong enough, the Beast Tamer would occupy the dominant position and could forcefully control pets.
When a Beast Tamer wasn’t strong enough, the pet would dominate and use the Beast Tamer as nutrients for growth.
Of course, in the human countries, Beast Tamers and pets were still on equal footing in most situations.
In short, they were all overlords. No matter which totem country they went to, they would be guests…
“Not good, enemy attack!!!”
The green-scaled dragon smiled, but suddenly, its smile stopped. Its expression changed drastically as it sensed a spatial wave accompanied by a fatal threat!!
Boom!!!
The smiles of the other two overlords also stopped.
Boom!!!
Endless strong light gathered inside, and the mountain cave instantly collapsed and destroyed.
At this moment, the eyes of the three overlords were still filled with an incomprehensible expression. As the shock wave arrived, they quickly used defensive skills to protect themselves!!
“Roar (Damn it!!!)!!!” The Ice-Eyed White Tiger roared in anger!!!
Because in an instant, it had a premonition that it would be the most miserable of the three overlords in this enemy attack.
….
“Let’s shoot them first!”
Although the gem cat had said that there were three overlords, Shi Yu still couldn’t help but attack.
So be it. No matter how strong an overlord was, unless it was someone like the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s Giant Leviathan, it was definitely not the gem cat’s match.
Since he had a bodyguard, why not go crazy for once?
As long as he killed all of them, Chi Tong would have three overlord-level undead.
Such a configuration could even make a legend like Hua Xiajin, who only had one overlord, cry.
Of course, it was rare for him to touch the other party’s nest under the concealment of the gem cat without alarming any life form. Shi Yu didn’t have much honor here.
Instead, he directly used the energy fruits stored in Baby Ginseng’s laboratory for experiments to get Buggy to pack them up and teleport over to detonate them!
These Energy Fruits were Explosion Fruits of various attributes: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, Darkness, and Space Poison. Their combined power was not small.
Of course, it was definitely not as strong as Baby Ginseng’s full-strength attack after eating the Time Fruit.
In the ruins space, Baby Ginseng didn’t dare to experiment with the overlord-level energy fruit yet, because if it wasn’t careful, it would blow itself up.
Also, this was even less powerful than Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction.
However, it was enough to greet and knock on the door to call the enemy out.
Boom!!!
Nine-colored black smoke and white light enveloped Green Scale Mountain, and the angry roars of three overlords came from inside!!
As a cold wind blew, a huge green-scaled dragon was the first to rush out of the explosive area and fly into the sky!!
The clouds rolled and howled from the clouds, as if a roaring dragon was churning in the clouds.
On its huge body that was dozens of meters long, the green-scaled dragon’s huge dragon eyes instantly locked onto Shi Yu and the others on another mountain.
At this moment, the gem cat had long run off to god knows where. Shi Yu, this human, naturally became the most conspicuous enemy in its vision.
< Name > Green Scaled Dragon
[Attributes]: Dragon
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 70,860,000
At the same time, Shi Yu also saw it and gasped hotly on the spot, increasing the speed of global warming. This energy value was indeed a top-notch overlord!!
Although it was a little inferior to the 87 million energy points of the Dragon Palace City Whale General and the mutated Giant Leviathan that was nearly 100 million energy points, this energy value was already higher than the energy of most overlords of Dragon Palace City.
Such a “real” dragon was actually raised in a small forbidden zone.
If it was just a simple high energy value, that would be fine. It was nothing, but looking at the age of this dragon, its skill proficiency was probably ridiculously high.
Moreover, Buggy could sense that there was a dragon vein underground. It was an environment with strong dragon-element energy. Perhaps this dragon could also borrow the power of the earth vein.
After all, this was its territory. The power that an overlord creature could display in its territory was multiplied. It was equivalent to borrowing the power of nature. Just as the cat said, it was not easy to fight at all!
Moreover, Shi Yu also discovered that this guy actually had the will of an overlord!!
In addition to the other two overlords, it was even harder to fight!
“Uh!!!!” In the next moment, a figure enlarged with a bang. In the ruins, a huge turtle more than ten meters tall with a rock texture all over its body, as if it was carrying a few small mountains, appeared with a furious voice.
< Name > Mountain Tortoise
[Attributes]: Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 61,220,000
This huge turtle was similarly not weak. Under the explosion just now, neither it nor the green-scaled dragon suffered obvious injuries. There were only light injuries, which made Shi Yu, who was on the opposite mountain, excited.
If he could transform these two overlords into undead, even if their strength would be weakened after the transformation, they would definitely have the strength of an overlord race.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 665: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
This was unlike the previous lousy tree with 30 million energy points, whose strength was not strong to begin with. It relied on the evil path to break through. If it turned into an undead, it probably wouldn’t have much battle power left. It might not even be able to defeat Ji Feng’s pet. It would only waste the power of the bone sword for nothing.
But these two were completely worth it.
Of course, their battle power would probably be several times higher than that monarch race’s Earth Abyss Demon Tree.
“Roar!!!” At the same time, a huge white tiger with ice-blue patterns all over its body and ice-blue eyes came out. It was also nearly ten meters long, and the deterrence strength was only inferior to the dragon might of the green-scaled dragon. However, the injuries on its body were… the most serious among the three overlords!
< Name > Ice-Eyed White Tiger
[Attributes]: Ice
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 62,740,000
At this moment, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger was extremely furious and felt extremely aggrieved.
Because in the face of the sudden attack just now, the Green Scaled Dragon was strong enough and could mobilize the power of the dragon vein here to strengthen itself. It could naturally withstand it at a lighter price.
As for the Mountain Tortoise, it was not difficult for it to instantly mobilize the power of the earth to strengthen itself between the mountains. In addition, the Mountain Tortoise was known for its defense, so only the Ice-Eyed White Tiger was injured.
Its territory was the Snow Realm. Fighting here would undoubtedly weaken its battle power a lot.
“The wild overlords abroad are indeed stronger than the wild overlords in the seven countries.”
Seeing these three overlords, Shi Yu had already confirmed using the Heavenly Cloud Tiger of the Seven Islands and the Prediction Owl of Imperial Capital University.
These three were undoubtedly much stronger than they looked. Among them, with a lower race, this white tiger even had stronger strength than the Heavenly Cloud Tiger!
Although this big cat was still lousy.
“Roar!!! (Human, courting death!!!)”
In the distant sky, the green-scaled dragon was the first to roar in anger. Green light immediately condensed in its mouth, and an ear-piercing sonic boom appeared around the green light.
With a boom, a huge dragon breath that looked like a dragon instantly opened its huge claws and attacked Shi Yu and the others.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already issued battle arrangements to every pet beside him. The telepathy transmission was completed in an instant.
[Ling, Chi Tong, Susu, the three of you, deal with that white tiger with me.]
[Eleven, Baby Ginseng, the two of you, deal with that big turtle.]
[Buggy, I’ll leave this dragon to you!]
[Let’s see who can defeat the opponent first.]
[Buggy: ??????]
[Buggy: Didn’t we agree to let Baby Ginseng fight the overlord of its hometown???]
[Baby Ginseng: Wu wu wu, I changed my mind. This guy is stronger than I imagined. As expected of my childhood trauma… Buggy, all the best. When you defeat it, I’ll defeat you in the future. That’s equivalent to me defeating it.]
[Buggy: ??]
[Shi Yu: Believe in yourself. You’re the number one in the team. This time, you can mobilize the power of the legendary Dragon Ball to a greater extent. In a battle of the same race, the other party still has the will of an overlord. This is a very good opportunity for you to train yourself.]
[If you can’t defeat it, there’s no need to defeat it. As long as you stall until we finish the other two overlords, if we still have the strength, we’ll help you.]
[If we don’t have any spare energy, let Teacher Gem Cat help you…]
“…” Buggy sighed, but then its battle intent rose. Shi Yu, its Beast Tamer, had handed the strongest enemy to it!!
Even Eleven had to team up to fight, while he could take charge and deal with the strongest opponent!!
Legendary Dragon Ball!!
This was the key to Shi Yu letting Buggy fight the Green-scaled Flood Dragon alone. The legendary Dragon Ball was more useful to Buggy than the Time Fruit.
The current Time Fruit could at most raise Buggy to the ordinary overlord level. Moreover, the side effects were huge. After a few battles, Buggy would collapse from the overload.
However, with the legendary Dragon Ball and the Dragon of Imagination skill, Buggy could increase its energy level to 100 million at most. At the same time, with the corresponding strength of its dragon body, it wasn’t difficult to unleash a totem attack.
Of course, this was a one-time use.
It wasn’t that the Dragon Ball couldn’t take it, but that if it exceeded this limit, Buggy couldn’t take it.
The conventional usage method was the way Buggy used the legendary Dragon Ball to train daily. It only raised its energy level to about 50 million. This way, it could maintain its battle state for a long time and wouldn’t affect anything.
Buggy usually relied on this state to train its Dragon of Imagination skill proficiency for the team meeting to defeat Eleven.
Of course, against this green-scaled dragon, its conventional state was definitely not enough. Even if the green-scaled dragon didn’t mobilize the power of the dragon vein, it would be difficult.
Therefore, its only way out was to overload the Dragon Ball and raise its energy level and physical level to the same level as the Green Scaled Dragon. Then, through powerful accompanying moves, it could deal with it!
Although it was still very difficult for it to withstand it at its current level, it was at least qualified to fight.
“Roar!!!” When the green-scaled dragon’s dragon breath condensed, Buggy on Shi Yu’s shoulder also moved. It directly turned into a huge green divine dragon phantom, and its entire body was wrapped in a powerful dragon might as it soared into the sky!!
The light on its dragon claws became stronger and stronger. In the blink of an eye, its strength and speed suddenly erupted. Under the drive of Psychic power, its huge body tore straight at the incoming dragon breath!!

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 666: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Space Control, Space Rending Claw!!!
Boom!!!
The Green Scaled Dragon, the Mountain Tortoise, and the Ice-Eyed White Tiger were all shocked. They only felt a white light flash in front of their eyes. Then, their pupils constricted even more. Under this huge claw that could cut through space, the dragon breath wave instantly divided into two, erupting with a violent impact!!
Under the surging energy, the green divine dragon transformed by Buggy continued to fight the green-scaled dragon!!
“Roar!!! (Purebred overlord divine dragon, transcendent dragon might, you guys… pray for yourselves!!)”
The green-scaled dragon determined that this green divine dragon was difficult to deal with almost instantly. It actually had transcendent-level dragon might, just like it!
Moreover, its aura wasn’t much inferior to its own. This made the Green Scaled Dragon feel as if it was facing a great enemy, and it directly entered a battle state. It didn’t have the time to care about what the Mountain Tortoise and the Ice-Eyed White Tiger were thinking at the moment.
Almost instantly, Buggy’s Space Rending Giant Claw, a super spatial attack that even Eleven couldn’t withstand, tore apart the dragon breath and waved in front of the green-scaled dragon!!
As for the Green Scaled Dragon, it also waved its dragon claws!!!
“Roar!!! (Little brat, who are you looking down on!!!)”
However, it didn’t directly collide with Buggy. Instead, it staggered and directly endured this attack. Moreover, it also made Buggy directly suffer its attack!!
Exchanging injuries!!!
Boom!!!
Under the collision of the two terrifying dragon might, the sky cracked!!!
With just one attack, Buggy’s heart trembled. It felt that this guy was even harder than Eleven!!!
The moment the attack touched the other party’s scale, the terrifying dragon scale defense actually reversed the powerful impact, almost causing the Dragon of Imagination to collapse. This was… a super reverse scale with perfect proficiency!!
Moreover, it was definitely not as simple as just perfect level!
It must be the result of cultivating for a long time at this proficiency!!
At this moment, the Green Scaled Dragon’s eyes were already red as it entered a crazy reverse scale state.
After being attacked in its nest, it was the most furious. Under the enhancement of the power of the reverse scale, it allowed the dragon to erupt with power that far exceeded Buggy’s ordinary overlord power that needed the help of legendary equipment. However, in a confrontation, Buggy’s substantialized huge body couldn’t withstand the other party’s attack and was torn apart by the other party’s huge claw, smashing into the distance!!
“Ji!!!” Even though the phantom had endured most of the power and its main body was hidden well, the violent vibration still made Buggy scream.
[I can’t defeat it…] In an instant, Buggy realized that even if it used the legendary Dragon Ball to erupt with a totem attack, it definitely couldn’t insta-kill this guy in the other party’s territory.
A top-notch overlord, and a dragon-element overlord. This should be the most difficult opponent Shi Yu and the others had encountered apart from the weak Vortex Demon Beast.
After all, the Sky Penetrating Whale, which was also a top-notch overlord, could even fight a weak totem!
At the thought of this, Buggy’s eyes filled with tears as it understood. Shi Yu had sent it to be beaten up. From the start, Shi Yu had been thinking that when the time came, everyone would deal with the Green Scaled Dragon together. He didn’t expect it to win alone.
Buggy, who had the spatial element, was indeed the guy who could tangle with the other party the most.
“!!!!”
When Buggy started fighting, Eleven and Baby Ginseng also attacked together. Their target was the Mountain Tortoise!!
At this moment, the Mountain Tortoise no longer had the mood to care about the Green Scaled Dragon. It didn’t even have the intention to help the Green Scaled Dragon. The enemy clearly came prepared, and it was also a powerful overlord. It didn’t have the slightest desire to fight.
For this old turtle, this kind of useless battle was best avoided as much as possible. It chose to directly escape underground!!
However, Eleven and the others also had an Earth Escape skill. As huge vines grew out of the ground and wrapped around the Mountain Tortoise, its Earth Escape was directly interrupted and tied up by countless trees and thorns.
At that moment, Baby Ginseng, who had stimulated the power of the Time Fruit, arrived at the overlord level again and used plant control to restrict the other party’s movements!!
At the same time, energy fruits of various sizes appeared on the countless trees that wrapped and bound the Mountain Tortoise!!
On the ground in the distance, Baby Ginseng pulled the green leaf scarf and threw it down. The ginseng leaves fluttered in the wind.
Its green eyes were filled with fighting spirit.
Burial of the Trees!!!
Plant Control+Energy Fruit+Moon Explosion!!!
This time, Baby Ginseng only added pure wood-element energy and didn’t use the power of the Sun Flame.
Although the power of the Energy Fruit with the power of the Sun Flame was greater, all the legendary Sun Flame power stored just now had already been used to insta-kill the Earth Abyss Demon Tree. Baby Ginseng had already lost a drop.
In addition, because the opponent was pure earth-element, using pure wood-element moves to counter with attributes might not necessarily be worse than before.
Boom!!!
Fruits flickered with white and green light!!!
“Uh!!!! (I have no grudge with you…)” The Mountain Tortoise roared.
At the same time, because it was restrained by the thorns, it couldn’t break free for the time being. It simply gave up struggling and directly shrank its limbs and head into its body. Its body was tightly wrapped and immediately airtight!!
Come!!
Damn it!!
Its defense was even stronger than that green snake. Come on!!
The Mountain Tortoise chose to defend and directly entered a full-strength defense posture. It also activated a super defense skill with perfect proficiency. At the same time, it mobilized the natural power of the earth to strengthen itself.
Under the dazzling light, the Mountain Tortoise was buried in the sea of trees. In the sky not far away, Eleven, who had countless Bean Bears on its body, had a dissatisfied expression. It couldn’t interfere at all with Baby Ginseng fighting like this…

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Did it not know how to cooperate!!!
Was it going to steal the kill?
Eleven wanted Baby Ginseng to cooperate with it, not eat the Time Fruit. As it slowly became stronger and perfected its consecutive moves, this thing became more and more difficult to use. It was better to use its specific eruption+Undying Golden Body+Impregnable to last longer and make smoother eruptions. After all, the overlord’s will combined with the Impregnable eruption might not be weaker than the enhancement of the Time Fruit.
After using the Time Fruit, the burden would easily overflow, preventing the Undying Golden Body from circulating and easily breaking. In Eleven’s opinion, the greatest effect of Baby Ginseng on it at this moment was if it followed Eleven’s lead. Every time it erupted, it would cooperate with the Undying Golden Body to replenish its state!!
Let it erupt infinitely!!!
“Yi!!!” Eleven was mumbling, but suddenly, Baby Ginseng’s shocked voice came. This was because after its attributes countered the bombardment, the Mountain Tortoise still maintained a powerful defense posture and it couldn’t completely break through its defense!!
The powerful life aura was still vigorous, as vigorous as a mountain. Moreover, its aura was still rising steadily. Clearly, it was relying on the power of the ground to last!!
Baby Ginseng immediately judged that this guy’s defense was probably stronger than that Earth Demon Ape!!
Although its current Moon Explosion proficiency was no longer at the entry level at that time, even at the currently stronger expert level, or even if it self-destructed, Baby Ginseng was a little hesitant about whether it could instantly kill this guy.
Unless this guy was willing to eat it, in which case it could enter the other party’s shell and self-destruct!
Of course, it couldn’t insta-kill it, though it could definitely heavily injure the other party and make it lose its ability to fight. However, the problem was that Baby Ginseng couldn’t self-destruct at the moment.
The thing that allowed Baby Ginseng to experience this guy’s terrifying physical fitness the most was when it fought the Earth Abyss Demon Tree previously, it didn’t absorb much of the Earth Abyss Demon Tree’s power through the “Nutrition Plunder” skill, but this guy’s strength was seemingly endless…
Originally, that blow just now was enough to make Baby Ginseng consume a lot of energy, but this inhalation successfully allowed Baby Ginseng to last a little longer.
On the ground, the rooted ginseng baby was just about to carry out the next round of attacks and bombard it with the Space Fruit, but it was immediately stopped by Eleven!
“Roar!!!”
Eleven showed an excited expression and roared, indicating that it would let Baby Ginseng assist it. It would fight!!
At this moment, seeing that the Time Overlord Baby Ginseng’s Energy Fruit was useless against this turtle, Eleven also hesitated if its multiple eruptions could break through its defense. However, compared to Baby Ginseng, it had an advantage!!
That was, mastering max-level deterrence could allow the attack to have mental attacks. This turtle couldn’t have shocking defense in all aspects, right?
Boom!!!
“Yi!!” As Baby Ginseng cried out, a white lightning flashed, and the hundred-meter-tall giant Eleven descended in front of the Mountain Tortoise, making the Mountain Tortoise in the shell fall silent… Come on!!
When the enemy was tired, it would slip away!
However, this time, the Mountain Tortoise didn’t wait for death. The mountain peak on its back gradually strengthened. Although its main body was still defending, the mountains on its back directly grew into mountain giants several meters tall!!
Super summoning skill!!!
Although their physiques were very small compared to Eleven, each of them had the strength of an overlord skill. From the aura of each summon, they were stronger than the Earth Abyss Demon Tree just now!!
The battle between the three parties was carried out at the same time.
At this moment, Shi Yu had the most people and chose the weakest opponent, or rather, an opponent with relatively average attributes in various aspects.
“Roar!!!” It had the same thought as the Mountain Tortoise. Because it wasn’t their home ground, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger didn’t want to fight at all. It didn’t want to fight this group of people who had attacked the Green Scaled Dragon’s territory at all.
It wasn’t slow either. However, what shocked the Ice-Eyed White Tiger was that it discovered that this space had already been completely locked!!
At this moment, they were already in a huge spatial cage, and the strength of this spatial wall only made the Ice-Eyed White Tiger know that it was very difficult for it to break through.
Among the three of them, probably only the green-scaled dragon with the full strength of the dragon vein had any hope of shattering it.
Although the gem cat didn’t join the battle, it still played a support role to prevent these overlords from escaping.
Otherwise, with just Shi Yu and the others, if these overlords wanted to escape, they might not necessarily be able to keep them.
It couldn’t escape…
Realizing this, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger looked at its enemy fiercely.
Mechanic class…
It was someone from the Seven Nation Alliance…
It clearly saw that the human had become the mechanical life form in front of it.
The white-haired young man who was originally standing on the mountaintop with glasses disappeared from its vision under the white cube that filled the sky as the other pets attacked the Green Scaled Dragon and the Mountain Tortoise.
In its place was a white cube that kept splitting and increasing. Under the entanglement of the substantialized green hurricane, it gradually formed a huge humanoid mecha 20 meters tall!!
The huge mecha’s entire body was white as the base. It had red and blue colors as support. Its limbs, head, and body had layers of mechanical devices.
Behind it were sixteen huge pairs of green light wings. Under the flickering of the light wings, the entire mountaintop turned into powder and disappeared in the strong wind. The huge body flew in the sky, and the gaze on its head had already completely locked onto the Ice-Eyed White Tiger.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 668: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Although its body was in the form of a human, its head had the characteristics of the sheep race. Under the contrast of the white Kirin Horn, its entire face looked like a white demon.
“Come on, kitty.”
In the mecha cockpit, Shi Yu smiled. Ling had fused with it through the full-level loading skill.
At this moment, Shi Yu was like this huge mecha. He felt the powerful strength and broad vision very happily.
This feeling of being one with the wind was a new feeling compared to possessing Chi Tong!
Now, this was the prototype of the Ling Mecha form. At the moment, it wasn’t perfect, because it couldn’t perfectly integrate the powers of Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Susu.
It wasn’t that it couldn’t be forcefully fused, but the fusion wasn’t perfect. The enhancement was too small. For an intelligent life form like Ling, a trace of imperfection wasn’t considered a success.
But now, he could make do with it.
“Chi Tong, possess me!!”
“Susu, enter full power!!”
As Shi Yu gave the order, Susu, who was connected to mechanical equipment in the energy room in the mecha, opened its blue eyes.
At the same time, in the weapon room, Chi Tong took the initiative to open the door and integrate.
With a boom, the blue and red patterns on the huge white body lit up at the same time!!
The huge white sword in the white body’s hand instantly lingered with cold air and water that froze time!!
The white sword in the other arm revealed its original appearance. It was a bone sword, a legendary undead resource bone sword after enlarging!!
Hot Sun Flame power instantly spread on the bone sword!!
At the same time, the mecha’s red and blue eyes lit up!
At this moment, the formation of this super body undoubtedly created a huge pressure on the Ice-Eyed White Tiger.
Although it didn’t participate in the totem battle 200 years ago, it had also heard from its elders how the human Mechanic class expelled those insufferably arrogant totem overlords from the areas with the richest resources.
At this moment, sensing the powerful pressure of this body, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger regretted coming to this place to discuss joining the Dragonman Empire with the Green Scaled Dragon and the Mountain Tortoise.
If they joined the Dragonman Empire, they would definitely fight the humans of the seven countries in Inatena. If the opponents of the seven countries were all such humans, the chances of them achieving their goal would probably be very slim.
“This guy.” Not to mention the Ice-Eyed White Tiger that had never seen the world, even the gem cat that had seen the world was completely stunned when it saw Shi Yu, Chi Tong, Ling, and Susu transform into this form.
When…
What had Shi Yu and the others done in the past two months?
Initially, the gem cat still felt that even if Shi Yu and the others attacked together, they wouldn’t be able to defeat the green-scaled dragon.
However, as Shi Yu piloted this super body to appear, the gem cat was silent for a moment. As a totem level, it could clearly sense that the potential this super body could erupt with posed a greater threat to it than Buggy, who had used the legendary Dragon Ball.
Perhaps there was no need for it to help. The current Shi Yu already had the qualifications to fight a top-notch overlord…
In fact, could this ridiculous crazy action of controlling six monarch-level pets to challenge three overlords with the strength of a top-notch master really succeed?
The gem cat was stunned. If it succeeded, this guy would be a monster in name…
At the thought that it might be able to slack off, the gem cat was especially happy.
“Roar!!!”
At the same time, realizing that it couldn’t leave, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger could only choose to fight. A biting cold snowstorm blew in the sky. In a place without a snow realm, its strength was undoubtedly severely restricted. However, it was also an overlord with extraordinary strength after all. Through changing the weather, it still revealed its fangs as the king of beasts!!
….
….
Green Scale Mountain.
An unprecedented battle was taking place on the three battlefields.
There was no doubt about the scale of the overlord battle.
As challengers above their level, Shi Yu and the others were at a disadvantage. They could only challenge through fighting with more numbers or borrowing the power of legendary resources.
In the snowstorm, Shi Yu’s white body had already collided with the Ice-Eyed White Tiger for the first time!!
[4: 54]
As a driver, Shi Yu could clearly see the stable duration of their bodies in this state as estimated by Ling’s top-notch intelligence.
Under normal circumstances, there was only five minutes. If Susu activated the power of time and Chi Tong used the Interlocking Sword to undergo an overload eruption, this time would even accelerate and shorten. The true limit was probably only one to two minutes.
However… it was enough.
At that moment, with Shi Yu and Ling as carriers, Chi Tong and Susu, who had combined into the eruption of the dual sword style profundities, could already erupt with their fusion sword skills to the greatest extent without any worries.
Skill: Interlocking Sword.
< Introduction > It can absorb and fuse the power of the outside world. The more conflict this power has with the power of fire, the greater the increase in the power of the sword.
Under the dual sword skill of water and fire and under the transformation of Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence and Susu’s time power, Shi Yu and Ling shared a certain burden. The current super body’s battle power was also fully deserving of being a top-notch overlord!!
“Roar!!!”
The biting red and blue sword light was enough to split mountains and crush the huge white tiger. The snowstorm in the sky also turned into an ice crystal storm that attacked the huge body from three directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The Ice-Eyed White Tiger used a large-scale skill. It was difficult for the mecha to dodge, so it could only take it head-on. Fortunately, the max-level snowstorm jointly created by Susu and Ling severely weakened the snowstorm controlled by the Ice-Eyed White Tiger.
Although as an overlord, it was extremely sensitive to the control of natural power, its opponent was a freak who had mastered the full-level Blizzard skill and was also extremely sensitive to natural power!
Hu!!!
Most of the power of the Ice Crystal Storm’s natural enhancement was offset, but the powerful destructive power of the Perfect Level Proficiency super skill still made the ice crystals like sharp blades that swallowed the body.
Boom!
At this moment, the huge body burned with Sun Flame. Under the entanglement of the green whirlwind, the Sun Flame wrapped around the entire body. When the ice crystal swept over, it was first melted by the Sun Flame. Then, it came into contact with Ling’s protective mechanism, “Turning Misfortune into Luck”, which directly absorbed the frost power into its body.
Under the burden that the body could withstand, it didn’t activate the skill effect to injure itself. Instead, Susu in the mecha converted this power for its own use through the control of the water element.
At the same time, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger also faced the fatal threat of the “Cross Interlocking Sword Pressure”. The ice crystal storm in front was directly shattered by the cross slash. This power was not something it could resist head-on…
“Roar!!!”
The Ice-Eyed White Tiger roared. Its body tried its best to move, but it realized that it was already wrapped in layers of deterrence. It was extremely angry. It was angry that as the king of beasts, it was actually still stunned by the deterrence of the enemy. As the patterns on its body appeared, a dazzling light bloomed from its eyes!!
At this point, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger directly used its trump card skill, Absolute Zero!!
Skill: Absolute Zero
< Introduction > It’s a super skill of both ice and spirit. It creates the Ice Sealing Domain and freezes energy flow and mental activity!
If it wanted to use this move to the greatest extent, it would consume its life. However, it couldn’t care less now. A shocking cold light erupted in the Ice-Eyed White Tiger’s eyes. At this moment, the interlocking sword light that the Ice-Eyed White Tiger had attacked previously seemed to have stopped moving and entered a huge ice-sealing domain.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s super body was pulled into the frozen domain. In this domain, all objects were instantly frozen. Even layers of frost instantly appeared on Shi Yu’s super body.
This skill was like a sure hit, quickly reversing the situation.
Swoosh!!!
The intertwined sword light slowly advanced, and the figure of the Ice-Eyed White Tiger had already appeared in front of Shi Yu. It successfully dodged the fatal attack and hit the mecha’s head with its frost claws. The expression on its tiger head was violent.
In its opinion, this should be the fatal weakness of this life form, right?
The Ice-Eyed White Tiger’s gaze was cruel, but in the next moment, its violent expression stopped.
“Are you underestimating the mental reaction speed of a top-notch intelligence?”
In that instant, be it Shi Yu, Chi Tong, or Susu, all their thoughts seemed to have slowed down. However, Ling was not affected. The computational reaction speed brought by its top-notch intelligence exceeded that of a supercomputer, allowing it to have the top battle awareness at all times.
In the Ice-sealing Domain, any movements of the Ice-Eyed White Tiger were within its calculations.
Bang!!!
The bone sword wrapped in Sun Flame swung over and directly slashed at the Ice-Eyed White Tiger. Under the sharpness of the legendary weapon, its body was directly divided into two…
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, the Ice-Eyed White Tiger’s body and soul let out a heart-wrenching roar under its shocked gaze.
Seeing this, the gem cat stopped its extended cat claws and looked at the soul of the Ice-Eyed White Tiger with a burning gaze. It was absorbed by the huge bone sword. It was a spirit body identical to the Ice-Eyed White Tiger, but its entire body emitted a dark blue cold aura…
Absolute Zero!!
This was also an ice-element super ultimate move. Although it wasn’t as powerful as the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, it was not bad. Shi Yu felt that it was a pity that there weren’t enough skill slots.
At the moment, he had already recorded a lot of super skills. He couldn’t even bear to replicate the Tyrant Dragon’s Earth Domain to teach Baby Ginseng. He only replicated the Duck’s Heart Strike and taught it to every main pet.
Next, before he broke through, contracted a new pet, or could delete super skills, Shi Yu’s record of super skills should be very strict and carefully selected.
The remaining slots were still reserved for the stage of the World Tournament. At the very least, they had to leave a slot for the Blessing of the World Tree. They couldn’t add any more skills.
“Also, why are you aiming at the head?” Shi Yu knew that the ferocious beasts would definitely like to hit the head of the mecha and the heart of the mecha.
He chuckled.
As expected, it was right to deliberately let Ling build the cockpit at the butt to avoid the core impact.
Even if their heads were blown up, they would be fine!
….
After Shi Yu finished dealing with the Ice-Eyed White Tiger, he immediately looked at the other two battlefields.
On Baby Ginseng and Eleven’s side, Baby Ginseng finally chose to support Eleven. However, wasn’t this turtle a little too tough…
First, it erupted manually and forced itself into an extreme state. After dealing with the Mountain Giant created by the Mountain Tortoise, Eleven began to attack the old turtle’s main body with the eruption of Impregnable+Overlord Will.
“Roar!!!” But under the huge hammer that shook the ground, although the tortoise shell was already covered in cracks, it was still as firm as a rock, and the cracks were still continuing to repair.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 670: Shi Yu’s Mecha Form (7)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Eleven was extremely furious. It had already erupted four times in a row with the support of Baby Ginseng. Its condition was getting worse and worse, but why was this guy so hard!!
“Uh!!!” In the tortoise shell, the Mountain Tortoise was also extremely shocked. Why was this guy’s attack power stronger and stronger each time! Why wasn’t it exhausted yet!! Moreover, why was this guy’s deterrence so strong!! Coupled with the spatial vibration, the deterrence directly passed through the tortoise shell, making the Mountain Tortoise dizzy.
If it weren’t for the fact that its deterrence level wasn’t low and it had a mental defense skill, it would probably have collapsed.
At that moment, when he saw this scene, Shi Yu suddenly knew why Emperor Wu’s Zhong Xuan hated Iron-eating Beasts so much. Of course, perhaps Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast also hated Zhong Xuan.
If Eleven and Baby Ginseng were tortured by this overlord turtle’s shocking defense, then Buggy was just purely tortured by the Green Scaled Dragon.
The Green Scaled Dragon, which was originally in the reverse scale state, could suppress Buggy of the same energy and physical level with its skill proficiency. As the Green Scaled Dragon mobilized the power of the dragon vein in its territory, its suppression of Buggy was better.
Buggy realized that the proficiency of its Anti-Demon Domain was not enough to completely restrict this guy’s mobilization of the dragon vein power. A top-notch overlord was even more difficult to deal with than it imagined.
At this moment, the divine dragon phantom conjured by Buggy was already broken. The main body of the butterfly with the divine dragon physique inside was also covered in injuries of various sizes. It was constantly relying on high-speed healing and ultimate absorption to recover. In order to recover, it didn’t even have the time to care about the divine dragon phantom!!
As for the Green Scaled Dragon opposite, although its body was also covered in injuries of various sizes, there were no serious fatal injuries.
“Wu!!! (Damn it, if I had two legendary equipment…)” Buggy wanted a healing-type dragon-type equipment. In that case…
Seeing this, Shi Yu directly chose to join the two battles. Firstly, he wanted to help Eleven and the others.
“Can it defend against mental attacks?”
With Shi Yu’s reminder, Eleven and Baby Ginseng directly dodged. The slash filled with gray light landed on the Tortoise from the sky and directly slashed into the shell!!
As soon as Shi Yu joined, he directly reversed the situation. The undead-type legendary bone sword, together with Chi Tong’s Soul Slash skill, directly penetrated all the defense of the Mountain Tortoise and directly heavily injured its soul and pulled it out of its body!!
“Uh!!!” In the huge turtle shell, the Mountain Tortoise wanted to persist a little longer. If it persisted a little longer, it would be able to run away. However, in the next moment, its round eyes directly revealed an incredulous expression in a daze.
Its vision was instantly enveloped by gray light.
Soul… attack…
Its only shortcoming…
“Uh!!!” The brown turtle spirit had a panicked and afraid expression as it was directly absorbed by the bone sword in the sky. At this moment, it still retained some consciousness and was filled with endless fear.
Who exactly was the enemy? Why did he have such an evil method? It wasn’t enough to kill them, but he even had to modify their souls.
At this moment, the Mountain Tortoise could clearly feel that its soul consciousness was losing its control.
Seeing this, Eleven and Baby Ginseng beside it revealed dissatisfied expressions.
Damn it, after fighting for so long, it was still intercepted by the Beast Tamer. The four of them formed a team and even brought a legendary weapon and even the Time Fruit. They were simply cheating!!
“Let’s go help Buggy…” Shi Yu smiled and called out, but he didn’t receive a response from Eleven and Baby Ginseng. At this moment, Eleven and Baby Ginseng were panting on the spot. They didn’t have much strength left.
Eleven and Baby Ginseng looked at Buggy. Although they wanted to help, they were already helpless.
Shi Yu had indeed picked up a bargain. Before arriving, Eleven and Baby Ginseng had already beaten the Mountain Tortoise to its lowest state.
At this moment, they expressed that they should let Teacher Cat help.
“Alright.” Shi Yu glanced at the time in the mecha.
[0: 51]
According to Ling’s calculations, the mecha form was about to collapse in less than a minute. At this stage, Shi Yu and Ling felt immense fatigue.
Although he could still go to the Green Scaled Dragon to erupt with a round, after thinking about it, there didn’t seem to be a need. If his condition was too poor, it wouldn’t be easy to cause trouble in the totem country later.
Through the battle just now and the situation on Buggy’s side, Shi Yu or Ling could already roughly analyze the situation if they encountered a top-notch overlord.
If a top-notch overlord like the Green Scaled Dragon fought in the Green Scaled Dragon’s territory, then with all of them working together seven against one, the chances of winning should be above 50%.
If they weren’t fighting in the Green Scaled Dragon’s territory, but in an environment that was beneficial to them, their chances of winning against a top-notch overlord like the Green Scaled Dragon should be above 75%.
But no matter what, they would probably have to pay a considerable price and couldn’t win easily.
This was because this green-scaled dragon had mastered the overlord’s will. If it erupted on the verge of death, it might not be something Shi Yu and the others could withstand.
However, their strength was no longer weak. Even among legendary Beast Tamers, they should be medium-level.
“Buggy, do you need help?” Shi Yu looked at Buggy a thousand meters away.
Buggy: Ahhh!!! (No need, I’m the number one in the team. I can win!!)
Boom!!
Its huge body was torn apart by the green-scaled dragon again and sent flying.
Buggy: Ahhh!! (I could use some help too.)
At this moment, the Green Scaled Dragon was even more afraid than Buggy, because it had already sensed that the life auras of the other two overlords had disappeared.
“Teacher Cat, help. We don’t want to fight anymore. Help Buggy.” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat in the air for help.
In the air, the gem cat was silent for a moment and cursed.
When it saw that Shi Yu was fighting so fiercely, it thought that it didn’t need its help anymore. Why did it still want its help in the end?
“There’s still a mission. I still have to do archeology later…” Shi Yu said,” My condition can’t be too poor… ”
“Just this once.” The gem cat sighed.
“Yes…”
After Shi Yu and the gem cat finished communicating, in the distance, the green-scaled dragon, who was fighting Buggy, revealed an expression of horror that it had never seen since it was born.
A huge spatial vortex suddenly appeared above the green-scaled dragon and Buggy.
In the vortex, white, blue, red, black, purple, green, gold, pink… Different lights bloomed.
A huge spiral light ball with nine-colored light that was like a galaxy descended from the sky like a meteor!!
In less than a second, it left a nine-colored light mark in mid-air, connecting the vortex to the Green Scaled Dragon!!
Boom!!!
In the next moment, the green-scaled dragon was swallowed by the light ball and continued to fall with the light mark.
Just as the light ball approached the ground, the light disappeared. With a boom, the aftermath of this skill directly brought the incomparably huge body of the Green Scaled Dragon to the ground!!
A terrifying energy wave wreaked havoc on the ground. After a loud bang, a huge pit dozens of meters in diameter and more than ten meters deep appeared on the ground.
The edge of the huge pit was filled with traces of various attributes. Frost, fire, lightning, wind marks, curses…
“I only used the aftermath. Otherwise, the nearby mountains would have been gone. Usually, apart from eating, I don’t like to kill,” the gem cat said disdainfully. “It hasn’t died. Hurry up and kill it.”
“It’s much weaker than that whale.”
In the sky, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling looked at the power of the gem cat’s move and fell into deep silence. They had agreed that the totem that used resources to break through was the weakest totem. Why was a top-notch overlord… killed in one move…
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth also twitched. This power seemed to be much stronger than the skill power of the gem cat when it first broke through to fight the Vortex Demon Beast. Was the gem cat really just lazing around and not secretly training?
“Speaking of which, Green Scaled Dragon, Ice-Eyed White Tiger, Mountain Tortoise Undead… In addition to Chi Tong, who’s controlling them, this seems to be able to form a group of the Four Undead Holy Beasts.” Shi Yu suddenly realized something.
In the weakest Heavenly Fox Nation, if the Fox God didn’t appear, could it run rampant…
At this moment, the gem cat was not in the mood to listen to Shi Yu’s joke.
It looked at the huge amount of energy crystals consumed by the move in its own space and felt its heart bleed… This paywall battle strategy was specially developed by it to show off. The price was huge. It hoped that from today onwards, Shi Yu could show it more respect…

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 671: Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the huge pit, the green-scaled dragon was already on the verge of death.
The gem cat’s power control was very good.
Not only did it ensure that the green-scaled dragon lost its ability to fight, but it also didn’t completely die.
If it was completely dead, Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t be able to transform the Green-scaled Flood Dragon into an undead puppet.
He had to use the bone sword or the Undead Revival to kill it!
The power of resources and skills would change the structure of the transcendent life form’s soul the moment it was killed, allowing it to inherit the power of its body when it was alive to a certain extent and become a new undead race!
At first glance, the effect of the bone sword was actually similar to the Undying Fruit.
However, there was still a difference between one as a legendary resource and the other as a Mythical resource.
That was, the bone sword was only effective for lives below the totem level, while the Mythical resource, the Undying Fruit, was known to be effective for demigod-level lives.
As for whether it was effective against Mythical creatures, he didn’t know.
Of course, if Chi Tong’s Undead Revival skill reached transcendent and Dao Proficiency, it wasn’t impossible for the skill effect to exceed the legendary resource, the bone sword.
“Buzz!!”
The huge mecha slashed down with its sword. The Green Scaled Dragon in the huge pit also died completely like the Ice-Eyed White Tiger and the Mountain Tortoise!!
Although they were already dead, their spiritual bodies had already been imprisoned by the bone sword.
At this moment, they were already puppets of the bone sword.
Through max-level possession, Chi Tong, who had already controlled the bone sword, immediately erased the remaining intelligence of the three undead through the power of the bone sword.
This way, it would be easier to control.
Be it the bone sword or Chi Tong’s Undead Revival, after killing the enemy, the enemy’s undead could still retain some of their consciousness from when they were alive.
Of course, if it was to control it as an undead puppet, it would be best if its mind was erased too.
Chi Tong could also choose to let them retain some consciousness. However, these three overlords looked very boring. There was no need.
With their death experience, if they retained some consciousness, they would definitely be crying, making a fuss, and being fierce in the bone sword!
“Roar…”
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others had already exited the mecha form. After all, this form consumed too much energy.
Chi Tong also returned to its sword spirit form and possessed the bone sword that had returned to the size of a fruit knife.
It began to summon the undead puppets they had hunted together!!!
“Roar…”
In the gray mist, a green-scaled dragon in the form of an illusory spiritual body, as well as a Ice-Eyed White Tiger and a Mountain Tortoise, were summoned by Chi Tong again!!
“Roar!!!”
The three undead overlords still looked majestic, but they submitted to the bone sword and Chi Tong.
< Name > Green Scaled Dragon Spirit
[Attributes]: Undead, Dragon
Energy Points: 53,150,000
…
< Name > Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit
[Attributes]: Undead, Ice
Energy Points: 47,060,000
…
< Name > Mountain Tortoise Spirit
[Attributes]: Undead, Earth
Energy Points: 45,920,000
The moment they appeared, Shi Yu detected their approximate energy fluctuations through the index.
“What a pity.”
Seeing this, Shi Yu couldn’t help but say regretfully.
“It’s much weaker.”
At the side, the gem cat also landed and looked at the three huge undead that had submitted to the bone sword in front of it.
“Well, it’s the same as the effect of experimenting with commander-level and monarch-level ferocious beasts previously. It’s much weaker than when it was alive. Fortunately, most of the skills have been inherited, and the skill experience has not been lost much in the soul. It can still display overlord-level battle power,” Shi Yu said.
Although the power of the legendary bone sword was magical, the process of reviving the undead still couldn’t avoid losing most of its power.
However, Shi Yu was already very satisfied at this level. For example, the Green Scaled Dragon’s perfect super skill, the reverse scale, and the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit’s perfect super skill, Absolute Zero. These skill experiences were all preserved well.
It could be said that any one of these three undead could kill the Earth Abyss Demon Tree they had encountered previously.
As for that Earth Abyss Demon Tree, Baby Ginseng only defeated it with all its might.
Chi Tong controlled a total of three such undead.
In addition to the power of Chi Tong’s main body, if there was another team meeting, even if Buggy could use the legendary Dragon Ball, the first place wouldn’t be Buggy’s, but Chi Tong’s.
Even if Eleven erupted with the power of a Demon God, it was hard to say if it could defeat the current Chi Tong.
After all, Eleven had to erupt to the limit to have any hope of defeating each of these three overlord undead. Without the support of the ginseng baby, it was very difficult for Eleven to erupt for so long.
As long as Chi Tong controlled the undead behind him and played tag battle, Eleven would suffer.
“How long is the shelf life?” the gem cat asked again.
At the moment, these three undead were all remnant souls created by the bone sword. It was impossible for them to have such a long lifespan like complete overlord undead.
“Less than a year, but if I nurture them in the bone sword, they can always exist before the bone sword’s energy is exhausted. Moreover, they can be strengthened by the bone sword and become stronger. When the opportunity comes, they might even be able to turn from remnant souls into complete spirit bodies. There’s no need to worry about this.”
“However…” Shi Yu pondered. Why did he feel that in a year, they would look down on overlord undead of this level?
However, it wasn’t a big problem. When the overlord undead were eliminated, it wasn’t useless. He just had to let Chi Tong cut off and absorb it through the Spirit Release and transform it into nutrients for Chi Tong’s own growth. In the end, be it the power of the overlord undead or the power of legendary resources, they wouldn’t be wasted.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 672: Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“How nice.” The gem cat couldn’t help but be envious.
This looked much cooler than a clone.
“Mi ~!!!!” In the sky, Chi Tong was also asking excitedly and happily.
Therefore, when was the next team meeting to be held? Otherwise, it might as well be now.
“Wuu…”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and the others looked at the sky.
Damn it.
Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were the most envious. Now, not only did Susu and Ling have followers, Chi Tong also had them.
Moreover, they were three overlord-level sidekicks. This was too strong.
Previously, it was extremely difficult for Shi Yu and the others to take down these three overlords together. And with the help of the gem cat, they had all become Chi Tong’s puppets.
A long time ago, Chi Tong could rely on a big boss to lead the team to kill undead and farm experience to level up.
Why were there more big bosses now? Damn it.
“Mi ~” Chi Tong chuckled. Of course, for Chi Tong, it felt that there was a flaw.
Although it could form the Four Undead Holy Beasts with them, in its aesthetic sense, these three overlords weren’t the most perfect.
It didn’t put them at the same level as the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast at all. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have erased the other party’s mind so readily.
In Chi Tong’s opinion, it was impossible for Shi Yu to take these three guys in as members of the second team.
Only undead puppets that could qualify as members of the second team were worthy undead puppets.
In Chi Tong’s aesthetic sense, it wanted an overlord-level frost dragon undead. It would be best if its energy level when it was alive was above 80 million. Only then could it recreate General Mu Huiyin’s lineup.
Of course, it was referring to other frost dragons. It definitely had no intention of offending Mother Dragon.
Moreover, a lackey without intelligence was slightly lacking…
Of course, if there was a better choice, it would also happily accept it! For example, the ginseng baby undead.
“Clean up the battlefield. Let’s go. We’ve been delayed for a day. It’s time to set off.”
Shi Yu looked at the messy battlefield and took a deep breath.
“Let’s go, let’s go. It’s a pity about these corpses.” The gem cat looked at the bodies of the three overlords.
Most of their strength had been extracted by the bone sword and given to the corresponding spirit body, so they could no longer plunder high-level resources from them. Unfortunately.
However, although it couldn’t be sold for much, it could still recover some HP!!
The gem cat planned to put away these resources and sell them when it returned.
However.
Shi Yu said, “It’s not a pity, not a pity. Buggy, quickly put it away.”
The gem cat: “?”
Buggy: !
Shi Yu said, “The corpses of three overlords are also good stuff. Although they can’t be sold anymore, the corresponding physical strength is still preserved.”
“That tiger might be a little weak, but it’s not a problem for the Mountain Suppressing Tortoise and the Green Scaled Dragon to beat up ordinary monarchs with their physical strength alone.”
“Moreover, the overlord-level body should still have a trace of affinity with the power of nature. Let Buggy use the worm silk parasitic thread to repair it with the ginseng baby. Just with the physical strength and the power of nature, the battle power of the three physical puppets might be able to be on par with that Earth Abyss Demon Tree! It’s worth collecting!”
“You can have the evil Undead Sorcerer and the evil Gu Master!”
Buggy was overjoyed. Could it have some too?
After all, even if it didn’t contribute to this battle, it had worked hard.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Susu, and Ling cried.
It was already too much to bring legendary equipment, and now they even had three overlord-level puppets?
The gem cat was also furious. What level of capitalist was this guy? It was fine if he extracted his soul, but why did its body have to be repaired and made into a puppet!!
Wasn’t that… six overlord-level puppets?!
Shi Yu was excited.
Although he had been delayed for a day, it was still worth it. With the six overlord puppets on him, he had a new alternate identity to play with on this trip to the Heavenly Fox Nation… He didn’t have to worry about causing trouble for Dong Huang at all!
Under the totem level, it was invincible!
….
….
After Shi Yu and the others cleaned up the battlefield, they collectively entered the ruins space to rest.
The gem cat came to travel with the ruins ring.
Although the gem cat had discussed with Shi Yu to let Buggy be the driver before setting off, Buggy probably wouldn’t recover without resting for two days.
This made the gem cat curse. If it had known, it would have helped Buggy in advance.
If it had attacked directly from the start, at least it wouldn’t have to be a driver.
Unlike now, where it had to be a driver again.
Moreover, the original driver also intercepted the few spoils of war.
Unfortunately, there was no medicine for regret.
In this world, it was a lonely traveling cat.
Because it was going to pass by the totem country, for the sake of safety, it had to be vigilant at all times to avoid the enemy country totem noticing. The gem cat didn’t dare to use its slightly weaker clone and could only do it itself.
At this moment, in the high-level ruins space, Shi Yu and the others had almost adjusted after a day of rest.
After all, Shi Yu had prepared a lot of supplements and resources in advance. Under the paywall battle strategy, there was no need to slowly recuperate.
Even the injured Buggy glowed with vitality again under the treatment of various supplements and ginseng babies.
After recovering, Eleven and Baby Ginseng began to panic.
This battle revealed many problems.
Buggy used legendary equipment, and although it was being beaten the whole time, it could fight a top-notch overlord for so long.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 673: Obtaining Six Overlord-level Puppets (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
If it were them fighting the Green Scaled Dragon alone, they would probably be defeated by the Green Scaled Dragon in less than three rounds.
If only Buggy was so strong, Eleven and Baby Ginseng could still accept it. But now, after the battle, Chi Tong’s strength might even exceed such a Buggy. Eleven and Baby Ginseng only felt that it might be harder and harder to get first place in the team.
Three overlord puppets!
Damn it, no, there were six. Buggy also had one.
After that, Susu still had the evolution inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite waiting, and Ling’s mechanical intelligence advantage had gradually appeared. If it fused with the Mythical Kirin fossil, who knew how strong it would become…
It was too difficult, too difficult.
Eleven went to Ling. As the saying went, in a three-man team, there would definitely be an expert. As for Coach Ling, there was something it could help Eleven with.
At this moment, in Ling’s laboratory, several Bean Bears and Nine Li Battle Beast clones were experimental subjects placed on the experiment table.
The goal was to study the compatibility method between the Iron-eating Beast and the superalloy skill.
From Shen Feng, Shi Yu and the others couldn’t obtain the core technology of the superalloy, but from the perspective of the seven islands, they still successfully obtained the core technology of the superalloy and the alloy monster.
The reason was very simple. The Ke Yuan Financial Group had mastered such technology, and Dragon Palace City, the Seven Islands, and Dong Huang had directly confiscated the Ke Yuan Financial Group. It was undoubtedly very simple to divide some spoils of war.
Now, Eleven couldn’t wait to undergo the next round of evolution. It ran over again to ask about Ling’s research progress.
“Uh…” Ling said,” Don’t worry, don’t worry… ”
Ling already had a specific idea. It was to modify Eleven’s body and let a certain organ in its body be more similar to the alloy monster.
The risk of biological modification was undoubtedly very high. Even it had to carefully ensure that the success rate was 100% before it could help Eleven carry it out.
“Wuuu!!” Eleven was excited, its big eyes filled with hope.
When it fused with the power of light and darkness and evolved again, it would definitely be invincible in the world.
One punch, one overlord puppet!
“Yi…” In another part of the ruins space, Baby Ginseng wasn’t idle either.
As Eleven was waiting for an evolution opportunity, it was also researching on its own and had been guarding the Sun Flame Flower Chi Tong had given it.
The power of the Sun Flame Flower was undoubtedly in conflict with the power of the ginseng baby.
If Baby Ginseng ate it directly, there was only one outcome: it would be burned to death.
It wouldn’t strengthen it to the overlord level.
If one wanted to rely on legendary resources to break through to overlord, there were two conditions for resources. One was that the resource was strengthening, and the other was that the resource and the user had to have strength and attributes compatible.
However, it was precisely because they weren’t compatible that Baby Ginseng’s mutation could be used. If the power was compatible, its mutation wouldn’t be able to absorb the power of the Sun Flame Flower.
The so-called mutants basically had let their bodies come into contact with powers that were not compatible with them. They would mutate and gradually adapt to their physiques in unsuitable environments and powers!
The power of the Sun Flame Flower was very violent. To Chi Tong, it was a delicacy, but to Baby Ginseng, it was a ferocious plant that affected life activity!
It had only stored 1% of the Sun Flame Flower’s power in its body, but it had spent a lot of effort. Its body was at its limit. If it wanted to perfectly absorb the power of the legendary Sun Flame to mutate, relying on transcendent-level mutations might not be enough. It would be very dangerous.
Unless it grew to the totem level and mutated with the legendary Sun Flame Flower.
But that was meaningless, because at the totem level, it had the ability to optimize its own race.
Although Baby Ginseng currently had a chance to revive and could brainlessly absorb and forcefully mutate to take a gamble, Baby Ginseng was still unwilling to act rashly.
Firstly, it would waste too much power of the Sun Flame Flower, and secondly, it would waste the opportunity to revive.
It wanted to study thoroughly how to maintain a success rate above 100% before mutating!
Moreover, this mutation had to awaken a skill that was meaningful to its battle power.
Mutations didn’t mean success.
For example, if Baby Ginseng mutated and got a Sun Flame skill through the Sun Flame Flower… Although the mutation was successful, there were very few enhancements to its battle power.
The mutated skill had to be useful to it!
Different racial skills had different increases in strength.
It wasn’t every time that it had the chance to bet on top-notch skills.
Because of this and the price of this failure, Baby Ginseng had to grasp this mutation opportunity by itself. It couldn’t be a gambler anymore.
Although it was still a gamble in essence, if it made some preparations during the mutation process, it would be a little psychological comfort.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng was sitting beside the Sun Flame Flower, thinking about its conversation with Shi Yu…
Shi Yu: “It’s best if the mutation this time can increase your attributes in all aspects. Your advantage is that your life force is huge. You can start from this aspect. Endless life potential is hidden in the life force. For example, when the overlord’s will erupted, the power that far exceeds the limit was squeezed out of the life force.”
“And the risk of doing this is that our life force will be consumed too much and we’ll easily die young. If Eleven doesn’t have the Undying Golden Body, and if you’re not in the team, and if we don’t have a huge number of life supplements that can allow Eleven and the others to quickly recover after erupting… I definitely won’t dare to let Eleven and the others squeeze out their life potential frequently.”
“But even so, the eruptions of Eleven, Susu, Ducky, and the others are only happening one at a time. These are all self-protection mechanisms of life. And your advantage is that the skill proficiency of the source of life might be very high in the future. The recovery of life force will be very fast. Even if you erupt improperly and die, you can still revive. Therefore, the battle method of infinitely squeezing out life potential might be very suitable for you.”
“The Time Fruit will be obsolete sooner or later. Next, we have to find, study, and squeeze out the potential of the life force…”
At the moment, Baby Ginseng could maintain the advantage at the front of the team thanks to the Time Fruit.
However, the upper limit of the Time Fruit’s increase was the overlord level. As everyone entered the overlord level, the Time Fruit didn’t have any huge advantage.
Although at that time, the side effects of the Time Fruit had already been reduced to the lowest as the level of the ginseng baby increased, it was already impossible for them to fight above their level.
At that time, not only would Susu and Baby Ginseng give up on the Time Fruit, but they wouldn’t use this as the tactical core.
Therefore, after the overlord level, Baby Ginseng had to have a new skill that could replace the Time Fruit and increase its battle power!
Only in this way could it maintain its advantage.
Therefore, the direction of the mutation this time was best if it was an explosive skill that could squeeze out life potential…
“Yi… (I want to plant a fire seed in my body. This fire seed can erupt with huge energy in the form of burning life force and stimulates my potential at any time.)”
Burning its life force was one way. There was another way, which was to establish the relationship between the Sun Flame power and the Moonlight Radiation during the mutation process. The Moonlight Radiation came from the Moonlight, and the Moonlight came from the Sunlight. If it could absorb the Sunlight at the same time during the Moon Explosion and transform the Sunlight into the Moonlight Radiation, the power of the Moon Explosion could be even greater!
Of course, this might also be possible to increase the proficiency of the Moon Explosion in the future. It was not the best choice. The best choice was still to burn its life force. After all, after erupting with life potential, its own strength would increase greatly. Then, it could self-destruct. It could also increase the power of the self-destruction.
Although Baby Ginseng understood Shi Yu’s meaning, it was still not mentally prepared… After all, the price of failure was a legendary resource!! Dying was nothing, but wasting a resource would make it very sad. After all, it was given by Chi Tong out of goodwill.
Moreover, as Baby Ginseng thought about it, it cried. What the hell? It was a wood-element supplement plant, and its skills were either burning life or self-destructing. Could it still play happily?

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - Wind Rises, Heavenly Fox (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 674: Wind Rises, Heavenly Fox (1)Translator: Atlas Studios  Editor: Atlas Studios
After entering the forbidden zone of the Lost World from the border of Dong Huang and spending two days passing through the forbidden zone and the Divine Elephant Nation, Shi Yu and the others finally arrived at the Heavenly Fox Nation.
The Heavenly Fox Nation was very special. It was the only country among the eleven totem countries around Dong Huang that didn’t have top-notch totems.
As for the Divine Tree Nation and the Divine Elephant Nation around Dong Huang, the controllers were all top-notch totems. Even the overlord of a huge totem country like the Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King, had battle power limits close to the demigod level and had a chance of becoming the new totem king in the east!
“We’re hereâ€¦”
In the ruins space, Shi Yu was meditating with his eyes closed, studying his telepathy talent.
After eating the Undying Fruit, his telepathy talent had actually undergone some changes. As time passed, this change became more and more obvious. Shi Yu couldn’t help but take the time to study it carefully.
At this moment, as a slight vibration occurred in the ruins space, Shi Yu opened his eyes and understood that the gem cat was knocking on the door, meaning to call them out.
Shi Yu stood up, ate the blueberry-sized Time Fruit, and started the initial transformation.
The Heavenly Fox Nation and even the surrounding totem countries were similar to the ancient times of Dong Huang. There was no technology here, and the clothes were mainly ancient clothes. If Shi Yu wore a modern panda battle suit and wandered around the streets, he would definitely be instantly exposed.
“Heh hehâ€¦” Shi Yu put on the gray robe he had prepared in advance and held a wooden walking stick in his hand. It was actually a tool to seal the bone sword’s energy wave. As the Time Fruit he ate took effect, Shi Yu’s hair turned gray and silver.
At the same time, his face quickly aged, becoming exactly the same as when his life force was sucked dry after adding some super skills.
Whoosh!
The gray robe trembled, and the gray-haired old Shi Yu emitted a twilight aura. At this moment, he was no longer Shi Yu, but the evil Beast Tamer who roamed the totem countries, Lin Ying, Old Demon Lin.
The names were from Senior Panda and the gem cat.
Although his appearance had become older, he still had a very elegant auraâ€¦ If Lu Bai and Shi Yu were still a little similar, then Old Demon Lin and Shi Yu were completely different!!
“What’s wrong?”
Shi Yu appeared from the ruins space with a walking stick. At this moment, he appeared in an alley in an ancient city.
The gem cat hid in the alternate space and said, “We’re already in the Heavenly Fox Nation.”
“This seems to be the Moon City of some Heavenly Fox Nation. It’s one of the hatching locations marked on the map given by the Void Mantis. It’s in this city. I searched simply but couldn’t find it. It should be in a secret place or something. Next, you have to ask yourself.”
“Oh right, Moon City should be a relatively large city-state in the Heavenly Fox Nation. The ruler seems to be an overlord-level little fox. Although it’s not very strong, you have to be careful. Don’t attract the Fox God. I definitely don’t want to fight with the totems. In short, I’m lying down ~”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment, indicating that he understood. At the same time, he felt that it was extremely troublesome!!
Why was the second hatching place of the Space Beast Egg in such a big city?
If only it were still a small village like the Seven Islands. It would be extremely easy to find, but this side was clearly like a dragon’s pool or a tiger’s den.
Shi Yu sighed and walked out of the remote and dark street. Like an old beggar, he entered the street.
On the streets of Moon City, people came and went. Although it was a totem country, this country was still dominated by people. Even the status of human Beast Tamers was not low. Of course, the fox race had a higher status. Before Shi Yu came, he naturally came into contact with sufficient information.
