In the Heavenly Fox Nation, the highest commander was the Fox God. Under normal circumstances, the Fox God didn’t appear in the world. The one who replaced the Fox God to manage the country was a human female Beast Tamer called the “Heavenly Fox Saintess”. They were passed down from generation to generation and had legendary strength. They were the spokesperson of the Fox God.
As for the seven overlords under the Fox God, they managed the seven largest city-states in the Heavenly Fox Nation. At the moment, the Moon City Shi Yu was in was the city of the Moon God Fox under the Fox God.
Of course, under normal circumstances, the Moon God Fox didn’t show its face either. It was just the guardian overlord of Moon City. On the surface, Moon City was still managed by the “Moonlight Family”.
They were a human Beast Tamer family that specialized in helping the Moon God Fox nurture its clansmen. Their status was supreme in Moon City.
Beast Tamers who could contract the Moon God Fox Race were considered superior in Moon City. It could be said that in the Heavenly Fox Nation, they were basically the bosses of the fox race. As for the humans who served the fox race, they were number two, while the other life races were ranked lower.
The Heavenly Fox Nation was a totem country with a higher human status. Because the benefits were relatively good, being above all races below the fox race. They might be living more comfortably than in the seven countries.
This was also the reason why some humans were unwilling to join the seven countries after the totem battle. After all, joining a human ruled seven nations did not mean that they could have a high status as humans.
Generally speaking, if Beast Tamers who betrayed the Seven Nation Alliance wanted to join, they would only join such totem countries, not countries that treated humans as food and human pets. Of course, if Beast Tamers were strong enough and reached the Legendary level, no matter which totem country they joined, they could become distinguished guests like overlord-level creatures.
Depending on the national system, the status of all races in the totem country was also different.
The reason why Dong Huang arranged for Qu Ling to be a spy in the Heavenly Fox Nation was because the status of ordinary humans in the Heavenly Fox Nation was relatively high and not easy to discover.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - Heavenly Fox (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 675: Heavenly Fox (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
If it was a place like the Dragonman Empire, although humans were also below the dragon race and above the myriad races, that was only limited to humans of mixed races. If they went there to spy, the pressure would be huge.
“If I hadn’t transmigrated to Dong Huang when I transmigrated, I wonder what would have happened when I transmigrated here.” After Shi Yu came out, he muttered in his heart.
His clothes were also prepared for the national situation of the Heavenly Fox Nation. He appeared on the busy street and didn’t pay much attention.
It was quite new for Shi Yu to come to the totem country for the first time. As he walked, he looked around. On the streets, there were cries of vendors and shouts. People like the candied hawthorn that Shi Yu was familiar with were also selling here. He even saw adults buying stuff for their children!
From the thriving scene on the street, it was impossible to tell that this was the ferocious and violent totem country described in the textbooks.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. This was also normal. After all, even in the totem era before the Beast Taming Era, there were also good totems and evil totems. For example, in the totem era, some of the Dong Huang humans survived under the protection of the divine dragon race. They all believed in divine dragons. Even in the current Dong Huang, although humans were the rulers, a large portion of them still believed in divine dragons.
According to historical records, the Heavenly Fox Nation was still alright. It had never directly participated in the totem battle with Dong Huang. The Fox God only hugged a bunch of big bosses’ thighs everywhere the whole time, preventing the Heavenly Fox Nation from destruction. However, this didn’t affect the fact that the Heavenly Fox Nation and Dong Huang were enemies now, because at the moment, the Heavenly Fox Nation’s greatest backer was enemies with Dong Huang.
The friend of an enemy was the enemy.
“The Heaven Leaderboard has been announced…” Shi Yu had only taken a few steps when he heard the street suddenly become noisy. A large number of people gathered towards a wall. Shi Yu took a look and gave up squeezing through the crowd.
With a flick of his finger, Buggy’s countless Dream Stealing Worms began to fly all over the city.
Soon, Shi Yu understood what the “Heavenly Ranking” was and learned a lot of local information.
When the World Tournament began, the Heavenly Fox Nation was also invited. However, apart from the Heavenly Fox Saintess, there were no powerful Beast Tamers in the Heavenly Fox Nation, let alone powerful Beast Tamers under the age of 30.
There was no legendary Beast Tamer under the age of 30 in the Heavenly Fox Nation! There were even very few level-six ones!
And if one wanted to participate in the World Tournament and have overlord-level battle power, that was the threshold.
Therefore, if the Heavenly Fox Nation wanted to participate in the battle, they could only choose the extreme method, which was to take a step back and choose level-five and level-six Beast Tamers who were willing to participate.
The chosen candidates had a chance of being chosen by the seven overlord fox clans under the Fox God to fight in the world competition as temporary contractors.
A contract above their level!
At that time, it would definitely be mainly the overlord fox race. As for those human Beast Tamers, if they wanted to contract above their level, they would definitely have to pay a heavy price, just like the Beast Tamers of the Divine Tree Nation Shi Yu had encountered previously.
However, from the dream memories of the people here, the young Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Fox Nation didn’t seem to be rejected. Most of them were willing to sacrifice themselves and contract the overlord fox race at a huge price to fight in the world competition, as if this was a supreme honor.
Shi Yu also discovered an interesting point. In the seven countries, people called the competition organized by the World Tree a world competition, and in the totem countries, more people seemed to call it the “battle of countries”. It was an opportunity for their country to rise.
“The power of faith is very strong…”
Shi Yu didn’t find it strange. If these humans couldn’t provide the fox god of the Heavenly Fox Nation with a huge amount of power of faith, it was impossible for them to have such a high status.
“Miss Yue’e is indeed on the Heaven Leaderboard.”
“Yes, yes, it’s completely unexpected. After all, she’s the pride of our Moon City.”
“Lord Yue hasn’t searched for a contractor for nearly 20 years. I wonder if Miss Yue’e can be chosen by Lord Moon.”
On the street, there was a flurry of discussion. The discussion about Beast Taming was not low in Dong Huang. Even ordinary people participated in the discussion excitedly.
However, this was not what Shi Yu cared about. In his opinion, what else could such a person who contracted an overlord above his level be if not cannon fodder??
Unless that Moon God Fox had the strength of a top-notch overlord that wasn’t inferior to the Green Scaled Dragon.
But even in Dragon Palace City, there weren’t many such top-notch overlords, let alone the Heavenly Fox Nation.
Shi Yu held his walking stick and continued to search for the “hatching altar”.
….
Before long, Shi Yu used a similar method to let Buggy fly to various places in Moon City through the Dream Stealing Worm to collect information and determine where the Starry Sky Altar might be.
“Are you sure??” In the alternate space, the gem cat muttered.
Shi Yu thought to himself, “I’ve gathered the memories of many people and even let Buggy infiltrate the City Lord Manor of the Moonshine Family. It shouldn’t be wrong.”
The gem cat was surprised. “Your efficiency is pretty fast.”
It felt that even if it came to investigate, it might not necessarily be faster and more stable than Shi Yu.
Shi Yu chuckled and thought to himself, “Isn’t this all thanks to Buggy’s dream stealing and phantom skills?”
The combination of phantom illusion and max-level dream stealing made Shi Yu more suitable than most Beast Tamers to be a spy who stole information.
Shi Yu felt that he and Buggy should at least have a place in the tenth bureau’s Intelligence Bureau!!
Of course, Shi Yu’s current boldness was also related to the overall strength of the Heavenly Fox Nation and Moon City being too lousy.
There was no legend in the entire city, only an overlord. Buggy alone could fight the entire city and steal as it pleased!

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - Heavenly Fox (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Heavenly Fox (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
If it were other targets, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t dare to be so bold. For example, in the Shen Feng exchange team at that time, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t dare let Buggy invade Dr Aqi’s dream to look for mechanical knowledge.
After Beast Tamers reached the legend level, they had too many methods. Apart from Beast Taming Strengthening, there was also Etherealization, space manipulation, and sealing techniques. Some Legend Beast Tamers even knew Instant Transmission, Soul Out of Body, and Spirit Deterrence. They were already life forms on another level.
Although Hua Xiajin Legend just had a few overlords, that wasn’t an accurate representation of her strength. In a real life and death battle, legends had a huge advantage over non-legends, especially experienced legends.
The gem cat said, “So what’s the situation?”
Shi Yu said, “This depends on the history of the overlord of Moon City, the Moon God Fox.”
“It was originally an ordinary white fox. It didn’t have much of a presence in the fox race of the Heavenly Fox Nation. However, one day, it accidentally discovered an altar. There was nothing special about the altar at the start, but this fox slept right there, leaning against it.
“Who knew that at night, the power of starlight was especially rich where the altar was? In addition, by chance, this white fox was there for a special astronomical phenomenon. It was lucky to directly mutate and become a star fox.”
“However, this is only an accident. Apart from when there’s a special phenomenon, this is just an ordinary altar. However, the mutated star fox still thinks that this altar hides a big secret.”
“However, this is only an accident. Apart from when there’s a special phenomenon, this is just an ordinary altar. However, the mutated Celestial Fox still thinks that this altar hides a big secret.”
“In the past hundred years, in order to study the altar, the Moon God Fox has invited various capable people to crack it together more than once. It even invited the Fox God to study it. However, there were no results.”
“I guess that the altar that made the Moon God Fox mutate is the altar left behind by the Space Emperor to hatch the Space Beast Egg. Of course, the Moon God Fox mutation was purely a coincidence, like a blind cat bumping into a dead mouse. The contribution of the altar is there, but it’s not big. It’s mainly because of the special phenomenon. The altar is at most a coordinate, the most suitable coordinate to absorb the power of that starlight, so it just seems like the altar is responsible.”
The gem cat said, “The investigation is very good, but next time change your ‘blind cat’ metaphor to something else.”
“In addition… if it’s really as you investigated, you mean that we should go to the habitat of the Moon God Fox and fight for the altar?!!”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “If the Moon God Fox is guarding its home, this is the only way…”
“The most troublesome thing is that the pet egg needs 1 to 2 days to absorb the starlight…”
“Teacher Ying, do you have a way to instantly kill it without anyone noticing?”
“Directly fighting would attract the attention of the outside world and easily attract the Fox God, wouldn’t it?”
The gem cat: ???
“How is that possible!!” the gem cat said. “I can’t insta-kill it, you do it yourself.”
“Can’t??”
“Its habitat is in this city. It’s impossible to destroy the layers of barriers without anyone noticing. It will definitely attract the attention of many people,” the gem cat said angrily.
“Moreover, just because it’s a totem country doesn’t mean that it’s a backwater place. Who knows if they have long-range communication methods.”
Shi Yu: …
“Forget it, forget it.”
“Wait, as long as we are nimble enough and let Buggy materialize the Moon God Fox Phantom to deceive the people outside and pretend that nothing happened… Just let it say that it’s testing out some skills!” Shi Yu said.
“…” The gem cat said,” Do you want to gamble on that? There’s only one chance. Moreover, if the Moon God Fox and the Fox God have some mental connection, the Fox God will also sense it after it dies. Wouldn’t it be over? Generally speaking, there’s a close faith connection between the totems and overlords of the totem country. If that gets the Fox God out and it interrupts the hatching of the pet egg… Unless we kill the Fox God, it’s impossible to successfully hatch. ”
“Ah…” Shi Yu was like a little shark that had lost its dream.
“Then lure the Moon God Fox out for two days,” Shi Yu said. “Moon City is quite far from Fox God City and the location of the legendary mystic realm. As for the Fox God, it should be in its Fox God City or the legendary mystic realm at the moment. As long as we don’t cause a big commotion, it shouldn’t attract its attention.”
“After all, it’s not like the Moon God Fox would contact the Fox God for every little thing that happens.”
“How??”
“Can we use the ‘mystic realm’?”
“Huh?” The gem cat was stunned. “What do you mean?”
Shi Yu said, “Use the power of space to open a small mystic realm space nearby. We’ll use the ‘Energy Fruit created by Baby Ginseng that’s filled with the fragrance of the moon’ to attract the Moon God Fox Race over and let the Moon God Fox be obsessed with cracking the mystic realm and not pay attention to its hometown.”
“If it wants to leave, seal it!”
The gem cat grinned and said, “There will definitely be mechanisms in ordinary overlord-level habitats. The kind that can be sensed the moment someone enters. Perhaps that Moonlight Family will also guard outside the altar.”
“Moreover, what if the Fox God’s spatial perception is pretty good and I’m sensed when I open up the space? This commotion is much greater than Instant Transmission. Moreover, its statues are everywhere in the Heavenly Fox Nation. Don’t underestimate these statues…”

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - Heavenly Fox (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Heavenly Fox (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu rolled his eyes and said, “There’s the spiritual connection with the totem fox god, and there’s mechanisms in place since we’re in its territory. You’ve already blocked off all the options, let’s stop caring so much. Let’s just do it directly.”
“You’re just too cautious. When the time comes, things will always work out. When I do archaeology, it gets to my head and I never consider the risks!”
“Damn!” the gem cat muttered. It also felt that it was quite troublesome to think too much. Perhaps the Fox God wasn’t that free!
Just as they finished communicating, a terrifying aura suddenly came from the core of Moon City. A deterrence that shot up circled in the sky, tearing a huge moon mark there.
In Moon City, most of the Beast Tamers and foxes suddenly looked over, as that was the holy land of the Moon God Fox overlord!!
As the wind and clouds changed, a huge fox more than ten meters long with light golden hair and starlight lingering around it stepped on the air and soared into the sky, leaving Moon City.
“Lord Moon God!!!”
Seeing this huge fox appear, many mortals and Beast Tamers in Moon City bowed.
< Name > Moon God Fox
[Attributes]: Light
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 61,110,000
Shi Yu was stunned for a moment. He looked at the Moon God Fox that was getting further and further away and pondered for a moment.
Although he didn’t know what had happened, the Moon God Fox… seemed to have left its hometown??
“See, everything will work out when the time comes. The Moon God Fox left on its own.” Shi Yu thought to himself, “There’s no one to watch its house now. Teacher Ying, are you confident that we can sneak to the altar without causing any commotion?”
The gem cat was also silent for a moment before saying, “Let’s give it a try.”
….
At the same time.
Moon City, City Lord Manor.
In a hall, a middle-aged man in an ancient suit with a moonlight symbol was pacing back and forth.
Soon, a beautiful woman in the same clothes entered the hall. When she saw the middle-aged man, she bowed slightly and said, “Father, you were looking for me.”
“Yue’e, you saw the Moon Lord leave the city just now, right?”
The genius Beast Tamer of the Moonlight Family, Yue’e, nodded and said, “Father, did something happen?”
The head of the Moonlight Family said, “Lord Moon Master said that there was a problem with the mystic realm that descended in the south. In order to fight for the ownership of the mystic realm, other factions entered the Heavenly Fox Nation. At the moment, the ruins mystic realm seems to be in a confrontation stage. Lord Moon Master was summoned by Lord Fox God to help.”
“Who is it?” Yue’e’s expression changed.
“I’m not sure…”
“However, with Lord Fox God and the Holy Maiden present, there shouldn’t be any problems…”
The Moonlight family head said, “Yue’e, before Master Yue left, she said that you can enter the Holy Land to cultivate in a day. This means that Master Yue should have chosen you!!”
“Really!!” Yue’e’s expression revealed joy. The so-called holy land was the habitat of the Moon God Fox. The moonlight energy there was rich, and the spatial fluctuations were strong. Not only was it suitable for the growth of the fox race, but it was also very suitable for meditation. If she could go there to cultivate, her strength would definitely improve!
“Yeah, this is a rare opportunity!!” The Moonlight family’s master also said with an excited expression, “This is a token left behind by the Moon Goddess that lets you in the holy land!”
….
Shi Yu was very high now. Although the gem cat teacher always looked very unwilling before doing anything and looked like it was very, very difficult, every time he did it, everything seemed to turn out very smooth in the end!!
With the help of the gem cat, they successfully entered the holy land where the Moon God Fox lived. Although there were layers of barriers and restrictions outside the holy land, under Teacher Cat’s powerful spatial attainments, it was like “picking a lock”. They entered very smoothly!!
After entering, the gem cat was already drenched in sweat. It wiped its sweat with its claws and said, “Fortunately, my spatial control doesn’t lack training. Otherwise, it would really be a little difficult.”
“This is it!!” At the same time, Shi Yu had already arrived at the most conspicuous altar in the Holy Land. It was this, identical to the Starry Sky Altar in the countryside of the Seven Islands!!
Shi Yu quickly took out the Space Beast Egg. After absorbing the power of the starlight here, the hatching progress was two out of four…
….
South of the Heavenly Fox Nation.
Outside the legendary mystic realm that had descended not long ago.
Legend Ke and the others, who had already arrived and infiltrated the vicinity, had already made contact with Qu Ling. They also learned something from Qu Ling, who was currently among the Heavenly Fox Guards!
They only felt that it was extremely troublesome, especially Legend Ke himself!!
He didn’t expect that apart from Dong Huang, there were also people eyeing this Iron-eating Beast Ruins.
What shocked Legend Ke the most was that the leader of the other factions who led the negotiation with the Heavenly Fox Nation was actually the controller of the Seven Islands Ke Yuan Financial Group!
Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and the Seven Islands searched for a long time but couldn’t find the legendary Beast Tamer of the Seven Islands who used the power of Yun An to carry out biological experiments!
Why would they care about this ruin?
Could it be that… this ruin was not only related to the Iron-eating Beast, but also Yun An?

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - Shi Yu vs Fox God
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Shi Yu vs Fox God
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Moon God Fox Holy Land.
At this moment, the pet egg on the Starry Sky Altar was absorbing the faint golden light.
Under the illumination of the faint golden light, the white and purple-striped pet egg continued to emit a halo.
Shi Yu remembered that the last time he was on the Seven Islands, the starlight that connected the altar to the starry sky seemed to be white.
And this time, it turned pale gold.
What was the science behind this?
Both Shi Yu and the gem cat were very curious.
Unfortunately, they didn’t have much research on the power of the starry sky. Even Susu, who had mastered the Star Sea skill, couldn’t analyze what was going on with this starlight.
“Forget it, I’ll just follow the inheritance left behind by the Space Emperor.”
Shi Yu gave up on researching. Instead of wasting time on this, it was better to continue researching telepathy.
In the two months of bitter cultivation in Icefield City, the increase in physique was not what Shi Yu cared about the most in the past two months.
What concerned him the most was the other changes in his body after he ate the Undying Fruit, which increased his soul power!
After his soul power increased, he felt that his telepathy talent was more useful.
Using Baby Ginseng and Ling’s description, it was just an ordinary conversation when Shi Yu used telepathy to talk to them previously.
However, recently, Shi Yu had used telepathy to talk to them. It was as if the power of the heart could touch their hearts like invisible hands.
It was as if Shi Yu’s spiritual power had materialized.
This discovery surprised Shi Yu.
At the moment, in the world, the highest record for Beast Tamers with the gift of telepathy was level eight. The records regarding level-seven telepathy and level-eight telepathy after level six were quite comprehensive.
They had only expanded the range of their telepathy. There were no other special changes. A situation like the one Shi Yu’s pet sensed didn’t exist at all.
Shi Yu tried using the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast again. Unfortunately, they didn’t experience the same feeling as Baby Ginseng and the others.
This made Shi Yu certain that only the six pets he had contracted could sense the change in his telepathy talent.
This speciality was like a Beast Tamer with a “fire-element strengthening talent”. The strengthening power could only be added to the pet he contracted.
[After the soul power is strengthened, it can allow the telepathy talent to undergo some special changes.]
Of course, this enhancement was probably not something that simple pet feedback strengthening could do.
Otherwise, the Spirit Medium Beast Tamer who had contracted many undead would have long discovered this change.
Obviously, the Undying Fruit’s strengthening of Shi Yu’s soul power was very huge.
Right on the heels of that, the strengthened soul power and telepathy produced some unknown changes.
For Shi Yu, this novel thing was completely worth spending time exploring. In any case, he was free while waiting for the cooldown time and the hatching of the pet egg.
Shi Yu sat in the holy land of the Moon God Fox and meditated, his imagination running wild.
“We can try to develop the telepathy talent…”
“Ordinary Fusion Talents can only fuse with one pet. Ordinary telepathy Talents can only talk to life, but Emperor Wu’s Fusion Talent can fuse with multiple pets. As for the archeologists of Bureau 11, not only can they talk to living creatures, but they can also listen to the voice of everything.”
“Every Beast Taming Talent is definitely not as simple as it looks. As the individual is different, as the Beast Tamer develops deeper, it’s possible to develop new usage methods or even mutate.”
“I ate a Mythical resource, and after I die, I can even become a totem-level undead. Then, it’s impossible for me to not change at all when I’m alive. The Undying Fruit is already slowly strengthening my soul power… And such strengthening clearly caused some mutations in my telepathy talent!”
“According to the description of Baby Ginseng and the others, it was an ordinary conversation previously, but now, it’s like I’m using both hands and a mouth? It feels real?”
Just from this description, Shi Yu had many thoughts…
At the moment, apart from the pets he contracted, other pets like the Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast couldn’t experience this feeling. But, as he developed his telepathy, was it possible for them and even the pets contracted by others to experience it?
Generally speaking, telepathy was not mandatory. Only when one’s life opened their mind could they communicate. For example, when some Beast Tamers fought Beast Tamers with telepathy talent, no matter what opponent they fought, they would seal their pets’ and their own minds to avoid external interference.
They only retained the right to communicate telepathically with their pet and tried to concentrate the most.
Therefore, Shi Yu was wondering if it was possible for his telepathy to ignore the other party’s mental seal and forcefully enter the communication space to apply his thoughts to the other party.
It could even imitate the telepathy of the Beast Tamer of the other party’s pet and give the wrong fatal command to the pet?
If this could be done, Shi Yu felt that it would be very annoying. In high-level battles, an instant of absent-mindedness was almost fatal.
Of course, Shi Yu felt that this kind of “dirty trash talk” battle method was meaningless. It didn’t match his handsome style at all.
He was still wondering if there were any other ways to train telepathy into a battle talent apart from this method.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - Shi Yu vs Fox God (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Shi Yu vs Fox God (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Since ancient times, there had never been a Beast Tamer with too powerful a telepathy talent. It was because the telepathy talent didn’t have much achievements in the battle direction.
If he could develop the function of the telepathy talent in battle more, Shi Yu felt that his battle power could still go up another level.
His train of thought was also very simple. Most strengthening talents strengthened the power of pets by consuming the power of Beast Tamers.
Because of this, many Beast Tamers would be very weak after battle.
During this strengthening process, there was a special “connection” between Beast Tamers and pets.
If Shi Yu wanted to use “telepathy” to strengthen his pet, he would definitely have to build this “connection”.
This connection was closer to a “materialized connection”. If it were before, telepathy that could only be used as an “ordinary conversation” ability would definitely not be able to achieve a deep connection. However, now that the telepathy had mutated, Shi Yu felt that he could give it a try.
However, he had been experimenting for a long time. At the moment, there were no good effects.
And because it wasn’t anything important, he didn’t trouble Ling to start a research project alone. After all, Ling was busy enough at the moment. Every project was important.
At the moment, Ling was trying to study a “skill alloy” and “new inscription”. In Ling’s research, the armor of the Nine Li Battle Beast was inextricably linked to the body structure in its body.
By eating different metals and carving special patterns on the armor, it could combine the metal it ate to change the body structure of the Nine Li Battle Beast and let it complete its evolution.
The evolution of the Nine Li Battle Beast for the first inscription and the second inscription relied on this. Even the Demon God Iron-eating Beast relied on this mechanism.
Therefore, Ling had been using this racial mechanism to create a special alloy food according to the superalloy technology. It planned to cooperate with the inscription method to change Eleven’s compatibility with the “superalloy” skill.
The tenth inscription!
Since ancient people could develop nine inscription evolution paths and figure out the evolution path of the iron-eating beasts without any scientific research conditions, Ling believed that it could do it too.
Shi Yu let Ling study it. As for the development of telepathy, before Ling was busy, he could only rely on himself to explore blindly.
“Since telepathy is mutated through the strengthening of the soul…”
“Perhaps I can strengthen my pet through the method of a ‘spirit body’.”
“What’s the most common strengthening method for spiritual bodies? Obviously, ‘possession’.”
“If I can use my soul power as a shell, my telepathy as a bridge, and my mental and physical energy as energy, I can condense a substitute and possess my pet. Perhaps my pet’s strength can also be strengthened.”
“I don’t think there’s such a Beast Taming Talent, right?”
“Condense your body’s energy and transform into a pure energy body, which is a shrunken version of yourself. Possess your pet and let yourself become one with your pet.”
“Then here’s the problem. What should I do?” Shi Yu muttered. He couldn’t mobilize his soul, spirit, and physical energy… let alone condense a Nascent Soul.
But according to what he knew, mixed-blood Beast Tamers could mobilize some extraordinary power.
For example, some mixed-blood Beast Tamers could awaken mental deterrence after reaching the Legendary level.
Some Beast Tamers with mixed blood could even try to let their souls leave their bodies after reaching the Legendary level.
But this had nothing to do with pure-blooded human Beast Tamers.
Could it be that he really had to stop being a human to play the game happily?
No… No!
Now, Shi Yu had a new idea every day. Today, he even wanted to condense a “Nascent Soul”.
Beast Taming Immortal Cultivation!
“Stop dreaming.” As Shi Yu was engrossed in his fantasies and experiments, a day passed in the blink of an eye. Before the current Space Beast Egg could finish absorbing the energy, the gem cat kicked Shi Yu awake and said, “Stop dreaming. The barrier has been opened. Someone entered.”
“F*ck.” Shi Yu suddenly woke up and said, “Why is the Moon God Fox back so quickly?”
He took a quick look at the egg and heaved a sigh of relief.
“But it’s not a big problem. The egg will be finished absorbing in a while!”
“This time, even if the Fox God comes, we have to hold on!!”
Now, the light of the egg had gradually dimmed. According to his previous experience, it would take less than half an hour.
“Don’t worry, it’s not that Moon God Fox. It seems to be a human. It’s not very strong. You settle it yourself, ha ~”
Just as the gem cat’s sleepy voice fell, the surrounding spatial power fluctuated. A woman in white ancient clothes and a monarch-level Star Moon Fox were teleported into the Moon God Fox Holy Land and not far from Shi Yu and the others.
At this moment, just as they descended, the eldest daughter of Moon City, Yue’e, was filled with joy. Beside her, the Star Moon Fox was also filled with joy.
After all, it was too rare to enter such a holy land to cultivate.
However, their expressions suddenly stiffened. They saw Shi Yu, who had disguised as an old man with a sinister aura, sitting beside the Moon God Fox’s altar and looking at them with empty eyes.
“Who are you…” Yue’e was immediately shocked when she saw Shi Yu.
There shouldn’t be anyone else in the Moon Master Holy Land. She had been chosen by the Moon God Fox to cultivate, but she had never heard of anyone else being here.
< Name > Star Moon Fox
[Attributes]: Light
[Race Level]: High-level monarch

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - Shi Yu vs Fox God (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Shi Yu vs Fox God (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
[Level of Growth]: Monarch Level
Energy Points: 1,660,000
When Shi Yu saw the other party, he instantly determined her identity. He and Buggy had investigated many memories and recognized her at a glance as the eldest daughter of Moon City. She was also the only Beast Tamer in Moon City who had reached level six under the age of 30.
It was a little weak. Not to mention comparing it to the Beast Tamers in the top 100 of the Dong Huang Sequence, even compared to those guys in the National League, this girl wasn’t strong.
According to the information gathered by Shi Yu, the elite Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Fox Nation basically only cultivated spatial strength and environment. They didn’t go bigger in scale. They only contracted one fox in their lives and didn’t contract a second pet. From a certain perspective, they were also dedicated.
However, this was also normal. The fox race was supreme in the Heavenly Fox Nation. How could they let their poop pickers serve other foxes at the same time?
“Jiejiejiejie, since you’ve discovered us, stay…”
Shi Yu’s hoarse voice sounded. Under the other party’s panicked expression, a gray mist appeared above them!!
In the gray mist, dark blue eyes lit up. Accompanied by a terrifying deterrence, a huge tiger spirit that emitted an evil aura appeared.
Overlord-level, Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit.
At this moment, the gem cat couldn’t help but complain beside the alternate space. F*ck, this guy was even addicted to cosplaying now? What was with that laugh?! Seeing this evil Necromancer cosplay, it decided to give full marks!
“Don’t kill them. Their social status isn’t low. Search their souls first and see if there’s any valuable information.” Shi Yu gave Chi Tong an order in his heart. The Tiger Spirit was controlled by the bone sword, the bone sword was controlled by Chi Tong, and Chi Tong was controlled by him. This layer of nesting dolls made Shi Yu feel that it was quite troublesome.
Chi Tong: …
Wasn’t this just searching their memories? What did this guy mean when he changed it to the “searching of souls”… With the director experience of filming a few movies, Chi Tong also gave Shi Yu full marks. The next time Legend Mu Huiyin started filming, it would invite Shi Yu to be the villain.
The person who came was only a weak chicken. Shi Yu and the gem cat didn’t mind, but this little genius of Moon City and the Star Moon Fox were extremely frightened.
Overlord-level undead!
Legend level Spirit Medium!!
They were in trouble!
Moon City… Moon Master Holy Land… An invader had appeared!!!
Unfortunately, it was too late. Under the perfect deterrence of the overlord level, the human and fox’s consciousness were already on the verge of fainting. A huge crisis lingered on their bodies.
However, just as Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox thought that they were about to die, suddenly, in the center of Moon City, a huge fox statue suddenly lit up and similarly erupted with a huge might!!
Buzz!!!
This power directly acted on Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox. The powerful force was even stronger than the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit. In an instant, it sent the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit flying.
At this moment, Shi Yu and the hidden gem cat’s expressions suddenly changed. They felt an overlord-level power. This power was even stronger than the Ice-Eyed White Tiger and even the Mountain Tortoise when they were alive!!
As for the Star Moon Fox and Yue’e, who had been saved by the mysterious power, their faces were pale and they were drenched in sweat.
“Wu ~ ~ ~ ~” Her Star Moon Fox let out a miserable cry.
“It’s Lord Fox God’s blessing…” At this moment, Yue’e immediately understood what was going on. She had escaped death and still had lingering fear.
Half a month ago, after the Heavenly Fox Nation’s genius ranking battle ended, every genius of the Heavenly Fox Nation received the Fox God’s blessings.
The Holy Maiden said that this blessing could allow them to receive protection when they encountered any form of threat in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
The geniuses of the Heavenly Fox Nation were extremely rare to begin with. Even a level-six Beast Tamer made the Fox God take her seriously.
In the Moon God Fox Holy Land, as the Fox God Statue in Moon City emitted a light that shocked the entire city, a huge fox phantom condensed in the sky above the Holy Land, making Shi Yu’s balls hurt slightly. Meanwhile, the gem cat’s stomach hurt.
It was a nine-tailed fox phantom more than ten meters long. It was covered in white hair and had a pair of golden eyes. Its body was well-proportioned, making it look noble and elegant. Its nine tails were fluffy and graceful, and every sway seemed to be able to affect people’s hearts.
“Beauty…” Although the gem cat’s stomach hurt, it immediately felt like it had seen delicious food when it saw this phantom. It was very excited.
Shi Yu’s telepathy: “??”
“Firstly, you’re a cat. That’s a dog. Secondly, you’re a female cat.”
“What do you know? Vulgar! Moreover, the problem is that your jinx has come true. The Fox God really came, what should we do!!”
“It’s alright, it’s just the spiritual clone of the Fox God. It should be the protective talisman of that woman and the fox. From the looks of it, it’s not as strong as the Green Scaled Dragon. I’ll settle it. There’s less than half an hour left. Hold on.”
“Don’t attack. If you insta-kill it, the Fox God’s main body would come here. We have to pretend to be weak and let it think that it can defeat us with its clone. Stall it!”
In an instant, Shi Yu and the gem cat communicated a lot through telepathy and reached a unified opinion. They couldn’t insta-kill this guy. It was too easy to provoke the Fox God’s main body over. Show weakness, show weakness, stall for half an hour, and slip away after the egg hatched!
This was a spiritual clone used by the Fox God to receive the power of faith. In the fox statues everywhere in the Heavenly Fox Nation, there was a clone. The strength of the clone was at the overlord level. Apart from being a storage jar to receive the power of faith, these clones were also the guardians of the Heavenly Fox Nation.
At this moment, as the Fox God Statue changed, the entire Moon City trembled. They understood that an enemy had invaded.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - Shi Yu vs Fox God (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Shi Yu vs Fox God (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At the same time, the Fox God clone had already locked onto the invader through Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox. It stared at the evil-looking gray-robed old man in the sky.
The size and length of its nine tails suddenly multiplied. Each of them turned into a huge tail dozens of meters long that reached the sky, spreading white light as it slapped at the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit!!
Boom!!
The sound of air being torn was strong. The power of the super skill, Nine Tail Dance, was destructive.
“Lord Fox God…”
“Wu ~” At this moment, Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox’s hearts completely relaxed. They felt that they had survived.
At the same time, the power of faith towards the Fox God became stronger.
In their opinion, if the Fox God attacked, this evil Beast Tamer who had invaded the Moon Lord Holy Land would definitely be helpless!
“Jiejiejie…”
“Little Fox, if you want to defeat me with your clone, cultivate for another hundred years!”
As soon as he finished speaking, gray mist condensed.
Another Green Scaled Dragon Spirit with an even greater aura as well as the Mountain Tortoise Spirit appeared beside the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit. The three overlord undead roared in unison and attacked together.
The Green Scaled Dragon Spirit swung its dragon claw down, and the mountain on the back of the Mountain Tortoise Spirit materialized and exploded. The Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit also roared and swept up snow!
Boom!!!
In the dust mist of the nine tails and three moves, Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox’s pupils constricted.
Three overlords!!
Who exactly was the other party!
Such strength was top-notch in any totem country.
….
Iron-eating Beast Legendary Mystic Realm.
The Fox God, the Holy Maiden, and even the overlords of some city-states were still facing these mysterious factions that had come to the Heavenly Fox Nation.
The reason why they started a confrontation was that the other party’s faction was also very strong. A totem came.
This was a dark-element totem that looked like a black goat, emitting an ominous aura.
The spokesperson of this black goat totem was a Beast Tamer in black. His expression was extremely calm as he said, “Honorable Lord Fox God, we came with great sincerity.”
“This ruin is undoubtedly a sealed ruin, and there’s the aura of our Fallen Race inside. We only want to help our clansmen unseal it. That’s all. We’re willing to exchange a level-eight resource for the right to control the ruin.”
The huge fox god was silent. It was only a level-eight resource. Who did they think they were looking down on? This was a legendary ruin. Without two legendary resources, it was definitely impossible for others to explore.
“Fox, don’t refuse our goodwill.” After a day of negotiation, the Black Goat Totem was already extremely irritable. It said, “Don’t think that you can raise the price on the spot just because you have the protection of the Heavenly Wolf Nation.”
“I’ll give you a chance to rely on my master. Otherwise…”
“What are you planning?” The Fox God looked at the black goat with a smile.
The Black Goat Totem also sneered and said, “Of course, we’ll show you a bit of our strength.”
The Fox God chuckled. A mere goat dared to threaten it? Did it really think that the Heavenly Fox Nation relied on the protection of the Heavenly Wolf Nation to survive until now?
The fox god was completely not afraid of the threat of the black goat, but suddenly, it revealed a sullen expression and said, “So, is this your show of strength to us?”
Boom!!!
The Fox God’s fierce aura directly erupted, stunning the Black Goat Totem and the others.
“Moon, your city-state has been invaded,” the Fox God said. Its gaze locked onto the invader in front of it fiercely. As soon as it finished speaking, the Moon God Fox behind the Fox God also rose in anger and looked at this group of people.
At the same time, the other overlord foxes and the Beast Tamers led by the Heavenly Fox Saintess gathered here also suddenly emitted killing intent.
Black Goat Totem, Legend Bai Chuan of the Ke Yuan Financial Group: ???
Scam?
When did they invade Moon City!
Boom!!!
A violent energy wave rose from this place.
In the distance, the Butterfly God, Legend Ke, Ji Feng, and the others, who were still hiding, had already tried to transmit the situation here back to Dong Huang!
With the people from the Ke Yuan Financial Group around, they had to keep them here!
However…
They looked at the fluctuations of the totem battle in the distance and fell into deep thought. Why did they start fighting…

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Moon City.
A violent explosion sounded in the Holy Land.
The Fox God Statue also appeared.
At this moment, the Beast Tamers in Moon City had already determined what was going on.
The Moonlight family’s master summoned his monarch fox with red eyes and rode it towards the Moon Lord Holy Land.
At the same time, the city guards in Moon City and the Beast Tamers of the many Beast Tamer families in Moon City also rushed to the Moon Lord Holy Land one by one.
In Moon City, the Fox God Statue was supreme. On top of that, the Moon Lord Holy Land was inviolable. Now, battle fluctuations that resounded through the sky came from the Moon Lord Holy Land. Clearly, a huge change had happened!!
Soon, the Moonlight family head arrived outside the Holy Land.
The nearby city guards were even faster than them, but the hundreds of city guards Beast Tamers gathered around didn’t dare to approach the holy land at all.
The pets of these ordinary city guards were not foxes. There were pets of various races. At this moment, the pets also had fear on their faces, completely stunned by deterrence!
The battle of overlords was not something these commander and transcendent pets could interfere in at all.
“That’s…”
After the Moonlight family’s master arrived, he looked at the sky of the Holy Land in shock. A huge white nine-tailed fox was fighting three undead!!
The nine-tailed fox’s divine might was peerless. Its three opponents, the flood dragon spirit, the tiger spirit, and the turtle spirit, each had an incomparably terrifying deterrence. However, after a battle, the nine tails swept over, and the three undead attacking it immediately retreated in defeat.
However, there were three opponents, and they were all overlords. The Moonlight family’s master could also tell that the Fox God couldn’t let out all its might. Because the Nine-Tailed Heavenly Fox wanted to protect the city-state, it was very difficult for it to fight with all its might.
The battle of overlords could destroy cities.
The battle of totems could even destroy countries.
In order to protect its citizens, the fox god was controlling the aftermath of the battle.
“Fox God Phantom!”
“Overlord undead!”
“How’s Yue’e?” After the Moonlight family head arrived, he immediately cared about his daughter. His daughter had just entered the Moon Lord Holy Land. He wanted to enter with a panicked expression, but the Star Moon Fox beside him immediately stopped him.
“Calm down, the overlord battle isn’t something we can interfere in.”
Be it the deterrence emitted by the Fox God’s projection or the deterrence emitted by the three undead overlords, they made it difficult for ordinary monarchs to move.
“But Yue’e…”
“Let’s inform the Moon Lord to return to the city first,” the Star Moon Fox said.
In the Holy Land.
Shi Yu quietly guarded the altar and also controlled the three overlord undead to not let the aftermath of the battle affect them.
He was a little regretful now. Why did he have to cosplay as a villain? In the end, he provoked the Fox God’s projection.
If he could restart it, he wanted to be a good person and be friends with this lady in front of him. After coaxing the little girl, he would leave quietly.
It was not fun to pretend to be a villain at all. It was easy to kick the wrong target that happened to have plot armor. What kind of ordinary level-six Beast Tamer had the protection of totem clones?
At this moment, the female Beast Tamer and her Star Moon Fox, who had entered the Holy Land at the start, were directly knocked out by the deterrence in the battle of the four overlords. Buggy in Shi Yu’s pocket teleported her over.
Buggy’s Dream Stealing abilities still successfully entered her dream, making Shi Yu understand what was going on. It turned out that the Fox God had given every genius of the Heavenly Fox Nation a protective blessing.
With this blessing, the projection clones of the hundreds of fox statues in the Heavenly Fox Nation could become the bodyguards of these geniuses!
“The Moon God Fox actually went to the ruins mystic realm?”
“The Fox God, the Heavenly Fox Saintess, and most of the main battle power of the Heavenly Fox Nation went over there?”
“A mysterious faction is confronting the Heavenly Fox Nation outside the ruins?”
“Wait, this mysterious faction can’t be the Butterfly God and the others, right? Don’t tell me they’ve been exposed.”
“Then have I… caused trouble to them now?”
Shi Yu really obtained a lot of useful information from this young lady of Moon City.
His expression kept changing. He didn’t want to be delayed here any longer. He also wanted to hurry to the ruins with the gem cat to take a look.
He felt guilty…
Although he was using Old Demon Lin’s identity now… it was still easy for there to be a misunderstanding.
“Mi, Mi!!”
At this moment, Chi Tong reminded Shi Yu that at this rate, the three overlord undead might be blown up by this fox god projection!!
The power of this fox god projection seemed to be continuously increasing.
In the sky, the Fox God’s Nine Tails slapped down and directly smashed the Mountain Tortoise Spirit into the ground. If it weren’t for the fact that this turtle’s defense was strong, it would have already lost its ability to fight.
The absolute zero of the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit was originally extremely resistant to energy moves, and even more so to this kind of mental clone. However, the reaction speed of this fox god clone was actually not inferior to Ling, who had top-notch intelligence. It directly crossed the snowstorm and sent the Tiger Spirit flying.
Only the flood dragon spirit was a little stronger. Coupled with the transcendent dragon might and reverse scale, it could restrain the fox god projection.
“Mi.”
Chi Tong suggested something according to the movie plot it had seen. It would use this totem country’s Beast Tamer as a hostage to force the Fox God to yield. They could strive to walk further and further onto the path of the villain.
“That projection clearly doesn’t have high intelligence.” Shi Yu directly refuted Chi Tong’s suggestion. Although this projection’s battle power wasn’t weak, it didn’t seem to have any consciousness.
It had protected its genius for so long. How could it let its protected target be knocked out by the battle deterrence and then be picked up by the enemy?
“It’s almost done.” At this moment, the gem cat was hiding and protecting the Starry Sky Altar and the egg in the overlord battle beside it. It stared at the egg with a burning gaze and said to Shi Yu, “Hold on for another two minutes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“That’s good.” Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.
However, at this moment, something unexpected happened. As the aura strengthened again, the fox god projection that didn’t look intelligent just now gradually cleared its eyes. Its nine huge tails swept over with a boom and directly sent the flood dragon spirit flying, forcing Chi Tong to control the flood dragon spirit to retreat.
“Who are you?” The fox god projection revealed an angry expression.
Its golden pupils looked at the gray-robed old man who was holding the genius of the Heavenly Fox Nation hostage. Its anger increased. “Let go of her, or bear the consequences.”
Shi Yu was stunned. It was conscious now?
Moreover, Shi Yu looked at the other party. It actually really cared about this little genius. However, it was just right. He had to put on a full show. After this, he would never do it again. He wasn’t planning on killing her like the female Beast Tamer from the Divine Tree Nation.
From the dream memories of the Beast Tamer they searched, if they didn’t consider the position of the country, this person was really a good person. She helped the poor in various ways and punished evil and spread good. She especially hated the totem countries that used humans as food and squeezed humans dry. On the other hand, she looked forward to Dong Huang very much. She was very curious about the human countries like Dong Huang, making Shi Yu feel that it was very unsuitable to kill her.
Even if this guy might become Dong Huang’s enemy in the future, at least she wasn’t now, not yet. It was still fundamentally different from the Beast Tamer from the Divine Tree Nation who hunted Dong Huang’s Beast Tamers. In addition, Shi Yu still didn’t know the situation on the butterfly god’s side, or whether or not they were confronting the fox god’s main body. He couldn’t expand the conflict.
Good deeds would still be rewarded. The Beast Tamer in Shi Yu’s hand directly saved her own life by being good.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Do you want her to live?”
The three undead overlords retreated and moved in front of Shi Yu. Shi Yu held the Beast Tamer hostage and faced the Fox God’s projection. At the same time, as the battle temporarily stopped, a large number of Moon City Beast Tamers led by the Moonlight family’s master entered the Holy Land.
In a boom, an army of hundreds entered together.
Among them, the Moonlight family head looked at the gray-robed old man holding a hostage, his eyes filled with blood vessels. “Let go of her…”
“Your master has already surrendered. Do you still want to resist fearlessly?” The Fox God stared at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was stunned.
He kept feeling that something was wrong.
Even if the Butterfly God and the Fox God fought, it shouldn’t be so fast, right?
After all, it was the legendary second team of Lin Feng. If it weren’t for the fact that it was born of the wrong gender, it might even have entered the first team.
Its strength was close to a top-notch totem, so it was definitely stronger than the cat. It was a hundred-year-old totem.
It couldn’t be that it couldn’t even defeat the fox in the weakest totem country, right?
Could it be that it wasn’t the Butterfly God and the others?
[The egg has been absorbed. We can slip away now.]
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu relaxed and expressed his understanding. He gave Buggy and Chi Tong orders. At the same time, he looked at the Fox God and the others.
“Master?” The gray-robed Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Looks like you misunderstood something.”
“But forget it, I’ve already achieved my goal.”
“I’ll give her to you, but you have to let me leave. Otherwise, if a big battle breaks out, it won’t be good for anyone. This city might become ruins.”
Shi Yu was also unwilling to have a big battle in Moon City. After all, there were still millions of ordinary people in the city who weren’t even Beast Tamers. If there was really a conflict, these people would die.
From the way the Fox God protected Moon City, it probably didn’t want to have a conflict here.
With that said, Shi Yu didn’t wait for the other party to answer and directly threw Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox at them.
[Don’t participate in the world competition. Don’t go and die with this little strength,] Shi Yu thought. At that time, the other enemies wouldn’t be as kind as him.
The totem countries were also enemies against each other. If it weren’t for the fact that many totems were restraining each other and were also wary of each other, the Seven Nation Alliance wouldn’t be so stable.
This made Shi Yu feel that when he had the strength, he could subdue a few totem countries to play with.
For example, didn’t the Heavenly Fox Nation like to cozy up to powerful people? They could also cozy up to him.
Moreover, the Space Emperor actually built the altar here. Perhaps since ancient times, this place had been Dong Huang’s territory…
The hostage was thrown over.
At the same time, they disappeared collectively!
They quickly took Yue’e and the Star Moon Fox. At the same moment, the Fox God’s projection flew into the sky and sensed the enemy’s traces.
But…
The expression of the Fox God’s projection darkened. The aura and energy wave had completely disappeared?
How was this possible? A mere legend Beast Tamer…
….
Hu hu hu…
On the super high clouds in the starry sky, a gem cat opened its starry eyes and sat on the clouds, flying leisurely.
It said that its escape was first-rate.
“Do you want to come out and see the scenery?” The gem cat knocked on the ruins space. Just as Shi Yu came out, he was shocked. He grabbed the cloud cautiously as if he had lost half his life.
“Damn, why do you still know how to summon Sun Wukong’s Cloud?”
“Sun Wukong? What’s that?” The gem cat was stunned.
Shi Yu said, “Cough, it’s nothing.”
Shi Yu felt that he was currently protected in a Psychic barrier. The cloud’s flying speed was very fast, but it made Shi Yu feel very good. He said, “Did you hear what the fox god projection said just now?”
“According to the memories I’ve investigated, the Fox God’s main body seems to have conflicted with some faction.”
“Don’t worry, it’s not the Butterfly God.” The gem cat yawned and said, “The tool President Lin gave me to contact the Butterfly God is still intact. If something happens over there, I would know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 684: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu grinned and said, “That’s good. Then let’s go to the Iron-eating Beast Ruins now. I can’t wait anymore.”
The corners of the gem cat’s mouth twitched. “You just finished one thing, and now you’re going to wreck the next set? The Fox God’s main body is over there.”
“I think we should just snatch the Iron-eating Beast and leave. Don’t think about the mystic realm anymore. The risk of this thing is too high.”
“How can we do that? Didn’t the prophecy say that there are iron-eating beast evolution materials inside? If it really doesn’t work, then even if Dong Huang has to send a diplomatic mission to use resources to trade with the Heavenly Fox Nation, we have to get the iron-eating beast evolution materials.” Shi Yu still felt that he couldn’t give up the iron-eating beast evolution materials.
Even if they had to buy it, if it was a useful evolution ingredient. He had to get it from the fox.
“Then I’ll contact the Butterfly God and the others,” the gem cat muttered. “Let’s see what they’ve investigated first.”
....
At the foot of the mountain in the Heavenly Fox Nation, at the legendary mystic realm.
The battle that was extremely short quickly ended. The Black Goat Totem and Legend Bai Chuan were extremely afraid. The Black Goat was even covered in injuries as it looked at the Fox God in shock.
After just two exchanges, the Black Goat Totem understood that this fox was not as weak as the rumors said.
Top-notch totem!
It was definitely a top-notch totem battle power.
Did it advance recently, or was it hiding its strength from the beginning to the end?
“Wait, I don’t understand what you’re saying. Although you’re strong, don’t bully goats too much. Otherwise, your Heavenly Fox Nation will definitely be plunged into misery and suffering.”
The huge black goat stood in the ruins. It looked at the white nine-tailed fox standing under the moonlight and starlight and wanted to retreat.
“Are you underestimating my cleansing power?”
Although it was stronger than the other party, the moment the collision occurred, the earth trembled and the mountains trembled. The fox god gave up attacking. It sensed an energy range that was difficult to expel on the black goat totem.
The fox god was unhappy and didn’t want to be infected by such a dirty thing.
“Even if you have some cleansing power, you think you can cleanse the radiation after my death?” The black goat said the most cowardly words in the toughest tone.
The Fox God remained silent. That was true. Even if it could deal with this black goat, it would cause very bad luck. At the same time, the entire Heavenly Fox Nation would probably become a land of radiation.
“We came with sincerity. One, one legendary resource!!”
After witnessing the strength of the Fox God, Black Goat and the others also relaxed.
“Invading our city-state and wanting our ruins? You want to send us away with a legendary resource??” Before the Fox God could say anything, the huge Moon God Fox behind it glared at the enemy.
“I #@%￥#￥.”
The black goat only felt that this group of foxes was something else. When did they invade the city-state?
This time, they only sent two people. How could they have the time to invade a city-state? Did the city-states of their Heavenly Fox Nation have anything to invade for? Did they have any valuable resources?
“It’s not us. One legendary resource. Take it or leave it. There are no valuable resources in the ruins at all. It’s just that our general is sealed. As long as we can save it, a legendary resource will immediately be offered.”
“Invading your city-state? That is nonsense!”
The Heavenly Fox Nation and the Yun An faction were still in a stalemate, and the Nine-tailed Fox God disdained the Black Goat’s words. This Black Goat was already difficult enough to deal with. If another similar monster was released, would the other party still be willing to hand over the legendary resource?
Moreover, the Nine-tailed Fox God kept feeling that the other party’s power was not that simple. This black goat was probably not the strongest among them.
These were troubled times…
The nine-tailed fox god was extremely depressed. This legendary ruin had descended in the Heavenly Fox Nation. It had a premonition that it might not be a good thing.
Fortunately, it still had a top-notch totem bootlicker. In addition to itself, it wouldn’t be afraid of any faction.
“Whether it’s you or not doesn’t matter anymore,” Fox God said.
It looked like the descent of the legendary ruins had attracted many factions.
For this group of factions to discover the descent of the legendary ruins in the Heavenly Fox Nation so quickly, there was a possibility that they had discovered the descent of the ruins through some method to seal their clansmen, just as they said.
Another possibility was that there were spies from other factions in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
Either way, the Fox God couldn’t accept it.
“Gather the Beast Tamers of all the armies around the ruins. I want to check their identities!!” the Fox God said to the Holy Maiden.
The Heavenly Fox Saintess had black knee-length hair and was wearing a translucent cloth with golden edges that could be seen on her skin. She was a rather beautiful legendary Beast Tamer. After hearing Lord Fox God’s command, she nodded slightly. “Yes.”
....
At the same time.
In the distance of the legendary ruins, on a green mountain, a palm-sized white butterfly was stunned.
“Senior Butterfly God, what’s wrong?”
Beside it were two old men in cotton clothes, a man and a woman. Apart from them, there was also a young man.
“Reinforcements are here,” the Butterfly God said.
“So fast?” Legend Ke was stunned.
“But I just sent the news back not long ago…” The old woman said strangely.
Butterfly God said, “They’re reinforcements that have been confirmed before the mission. They’re not new. After they were done with the other missions, they contacted me.”
“Who is it?” Ji Feng said.
“Coming.” As the butterfly landed, spatial ripples appeared beside it. An old man with a walking stick appeared beside them.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - Talent Plundering, Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 685: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“Senior Butterfly God, long time no see.”
Shi Yu had just been sent over by the gem cat when he greeted the butterfly god that he had not seen for a long time.
“Yes, long time no see.”
The butterfly god looked at this old man strangely. It naturally knew the identities of the other two reinforcements. One was Dong Huang’s new guardian gem cat, and the other was the number one person below the legendary level, the minister of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City, and the archeologist of Bureau 11, Shi Yu.
When it woke up, the butterfly god was also very shocked. The newbie it blessed had actually become the number one super genius in Dong Huang.
Shi Yu’s sudden descent shocked the other three. The gem cat’s teleportation was too secretive. Even the Butterfly God didn’t sense it, let alone Legend Ke, Ji Feng, and the others.
“This is…” Seeing this gloomy old man, Legend Ke subconsciously said.
He didn’t know him.
Was it a disguise?
It was very normal to disguise oneself. The three of them had also done so.
“It’s me.” Shi Yu recovered his original voice and smiled at the three of them. His wrinkles trembled. Although the other party had also disguised themselves, he knew the name list and could roughly determine their identities.
“Holy shit.” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s voice, Legend Ke and Legend Zhang were stunned. As for the originally silent Ji Feng, he directly spoke in disbelief.
He was extremely stunned. “Why are you here, and in this state…”
Why did they feel that it was even better than their disguise? After all, they had gotten the best disguise master in the tenth bureau to help change their appearance.
“It’s actually you!!!” Legend Ke was also stunned. Holy shit, why did President Lin let Shi Yu go too? Ah, it seemed normal. After all, it was said that this was the Iron-eating Beast Ruins…
“I want to know the exact situation now,” Shi Yu said.
He frowned and looked into the distance where the world was changing.
Legend Ke said, “Let me.”
“The situation has changed. A group of factions has also targeted this ruin. Moreover, the two people from this faction are suspected to be the totems of the legendary helmsman of the Ke Yuan Financial Group, Bai Chuan, and the remaining faction of Yun An.”
When Legend Ke finished speaking, Shi Yu’s expression changed. “Are you sure?”
What was going on…
Could it be that they looked in the direction of the ruins? Could it be that the so-called iron-eating beast evolution materials in the ruins were Yun An Fragments??
Otherwise, was there anything worth attracting Yun An’s faction?
But no matter what, this was a good thing.
Be it the Ke Yuan Financial Group or the Yun An faction, they were both enemies that Dong Huang was currently searching for.
“It’s basically confirmed. Although the Ke Yuan Financial Group’s Bai Chuan has also changed, through the pet he contracted, we can basically confirm that it’s him.”
“Madam Qu Ling has already told us the specific information over there.”
Apart from the information that the legendary ruins might be the place where their Yun An faction general was sealed, Qu Ling had already told Legend Ke and the others about the other information through her position.
“Then what should we do?” Shi Yu asked.
“We’ve already sent the news back to request support,” Legend Ke said. “If necessary, let’s subdue that Bai Chuan first.”
“But the situation has changed greatly. Just now, the Fox God had a certain conflict with the other party. The Butterfly God judged that the Fox God’s strength might not be just at the ordinary totem level, and its strength might not be inferior to it. And now that the two totems have stopped moving, no matter what, we definitely can’t carry out the mission perfectly with just us.”
“So unless it’s necessary, it’s better to wait for reinforcements slowly.”
Was the Fox God so strong?
Shi Yu was stunned.
However, the Fox God and Yun An’s faction had a conflict?
Shi Yu had a strange expression.
It shouldn’t have anything to do with him, right?
He quickly looked at the old woman among the three and understood that it was a message from her.
This old woman was also a member of the tenth bureau. Her surname was Zhang, and she was at the legend level. Her Beast Taming Talent was very special, and it was teleportation.
She could teleport her contracted pet to the place where the teleportation array was set up in advance.
The greatest teleportation distance could cross the forbidden zone of the Lost World and three totem countries.
She was an important member of the infiltration team who maintained contact with Dong Huang.
Not long ago, she had already gotten her pet to send the news here back to Dong Huang as quickly as possible.
If nothing went wrong, after Dong Huang received the news, they would immediately send strong reinforcements.
It was even possible to directly send an army to pressure the Heavenly Fox with the excuse of “the Heavenly Fox Nation luring the legends of the Seven Nation Alliance to betray the country”.
“What about the Iron-eating Beast??”
“Didn’t they say that there’s an Iron-eating Beast race around the ruins?” Shi Yu asked.
The main mission this time was to bring this Iron-eating Beast race back.
According to the information, there were at least hundreds of iron-eating beasts.
“The Iron-eating Beasts are currently being guarded by an overlord of the Heavenly Fox Nation. Because there are a large number of traces of Iron-eating Beasts at the ruins location, as well as traces of the Emperor Wu Army, this ruin has been judged to be related to the Iron-eating Beasts. They watch the Iron-eating Beasts very closely and think that this group of Iron-eating Beasts is the key to cracking the ruins,” Legend Ke said.
“Although the security is very tight, it’s not very difficult to take it away forcefully,” the Butterfly God said. “It depends on when we attack.”
“Although that fox is more difficult to deal with than I imagined, its speed shouldn’t be faster than mine. Moreover, I have rich experience dealing with fox spirits.”
The butterfly god let out an indignant and youthful voice.
Shi Yu was silent. He suspected that there was definitely a female fox in Lin Feng Legend’s team…
Next, Shi Yu, Legend Ke, and the others kept exchanging information.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 686: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Including the battle power distribution in the legendary mystic realm, the information on the black goat being dark-element, and the specific battle power information of Legend Bai Chuan, everything was shared with Shi Yu one by one so as to make the next mission smoother.
“You should know the information about the Seven Islands’ Bai Chuan, right?”
At this point, Legend Ke wanted to slack off because Shi Yu had also gone to the Seven Islands at that time. Bai Chuan was an important clue to the Ke Yuan Financial Group, the Poison Dragon Totem, and the Yun An faction. Legend Ke believed that Shi Yu, the minister of the Environmental Protection Department, should know very well, so he wanted to skip it.
However, Shi Yu said, “Cough, tell me about it.”
The corners of Legend Ke’s mouth twitched. “Ke Yuan Financial Group’s Bai Chuan, Beast Tamer level seven. His Beast Taming Talent is ‘body control’. Because of his Beast Taming Talent, he has been learning the knowledge of biological modification from a Mechanic since he was young. His ‘body control’ talent can assist his pet in controlling various organs and even a hair in an incomparably exquisite manner. Therefore, his attainments in biological modification are very strong, and his pet’s energy control is also very strong.”
“Therefore, the seven pets it contracted are all biological modification-type pets. Apart from that, it’s said that after reaching the Legendary level, his ‘body control’ talent can also allow him to control the changes in every organ and hair on his own. His control over his body has also reached a very high level. Because of this talent, his physical fitness is very strong. He can even mobilize his mind and soul power through ‘body control’ and even develop spiritual power.”
“However, due to the weak physique of humans, the Seven Islands say that his special abilities are only comparable to commander-level pets, but you have to be wary of his hidden methods. Apart from that, his pets are…”
Legend Ke quickly introduced the information about Legend Bai Chuan to Shi Yu. Shi Yu was originally listening quietly, but as Legend Ke introduced this Legend Bai Chuan’s Beast Taming Talent, Shi Yu was stunned.
He first thought that it was no wonder the Ke Yuan Financial Group could create the Poison Dragon Totem and use the power of Yun An to modify creatures. It turned out that this Bai Chuan Legend’s Beast Taming Talent specialized in this aspect.
Then, after hearing that Legend Bai Chuan could even use the “body control” talent to control his body, mind, and soul energy, Shi Yu’s brain rumbled.
In an instant, he felt that his thoughts were extremely smooth.
When he studied the “Telepathy” talent and wanted to develop telepathy into a strengthening ability, what was he lacking the most?
What he lacked was a way to control his various energies.
Due to the aptitude of humans, apart from the Beast Taming Talent skill, it was very difficult for humans to control their energy. Even if Chi Tong possessed Shi Yu, it would only directly consume Shi Yu’s strength.
Although Shi Yu’s mental strength was not necessarily inferior to a monarch-level ferocious beast, he could not materialize his mental strength to condense Psychic power.
However, Psychic power could be done by an Awakening-level spiritual pet.
If humans wanted to control energy other than the ability to control beasts, there was only one way. That was to become a hybrid and obtain the aptitude of other races.
Therefore, it was as difficult as ascending to the heavens for Shi Yu to control other energy and develop telepathy himself.
However, Legend Bai Chuan’s “body control” talent stunned Shi Yu. He suddenly thought of a key problem.
If he plundered the “body control” talent with the Talent Bead and could control his body, mind, and soul energy with the support of the Talent Bead, did that mean that he could try to fuse other energies and develop the telepathy talent?
“A plundered talent is ultimately an external force attached to a tool. Just like the Awakening Mirror, it can’t grow.”
“However, if I can plunder this control talent and develop my telepathy talent through the body control talent, making telepathy very strong… This way, as I grow, telepathy can continue to evolve infinitely. Everything will be my own strength.”
Instead of relying on other people’s talent…
It was better to use other people’s talent to develop his talent.
This way, its value could be maximized.
“Apart from that, the functionality of ‘body control’ sounds pretty good. It might help Ling study the ‘tenth inscription’ and ‘Kirin Phantom’.”
At the thought of this, Shi Yu seemed to have suddenly found the best candidate to use the Talent Bead he had obtained from An Chang.
This Legend Bai Chuan who had joined the Yun An faction… His talent… was the best choice!!
“What’s wrong with you?”
Legend Ke realized that as he spoke, Shi Yu’s eyes were green.
This disguise even had a flash effect???
“This Bai Chuan must be taken…” Shi Yu said,” This kid is too critical. We can’t let him escape. ”
“Moreover, we have to keep him alive. We can’t kill him.”
If he killed it, he wouldn’t be able to plunder the talent.
“Of course I know that.” Legend Ke nodded. If he didn’t squeeze enough information from Legend Bai Chuan, how could he let him die so easily?
After everyone finished exchanging information, they waited.
Not only were they waiting for Dong Huang’s reinforcements…
They were also waiting for the update on Qu Ling at the legendary ruins.
The Butterfly God used its skill to turn everyone’s aura fluctuations into wind. By observing the situation here, it could react at the fastest speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 687: Talent Plundering, Target Candidate (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“There’s news.” Before long, the old woman, Legend Zhang, held a jade stone and said, “It’s news from Qu Ling…”
Shi Yu, the Butterfly God, Legend Ke, and Ji Feng looked at the old woman.
Under everyone’s gaze, this jade stone gradually turned black. This scene immediately made the old woman’s expression change. “Oh no, oh no, Qu Ling’s identity is at risk of being exposed. Her current situation is very dangerous.”
As the old woman finished speaking, the expressions of many people changed.
“What should we do?” Ji Feng immediately said solemnly.
Although the intelligence officer of the tenth bureau had ways to destroy all their memories in a crisis and ensure that everyone’s identities weren’t leaked, they would definitely be in huge danger, even if they could continue the mission.
It was obvious that the other party was in an extremely dangerous situation.
Shi Yu’s expression also changed. “This person…”
This person was Master Qu Jie’s daughter, right?
“I’ll go save her.”
“This is also part of the mission.”
Shi Yu said, “You guys wait for the news here. Don’t worry, we won’t be exposed.”
Shi Yu summoned the gem cat almost without hesitation and went to the legendary ruins together. These missions could be interrupted, but he couldn’t let anything happen to Master Qu Jie’s daughter in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
….
Outside the legendary ruins.
The Heavenly Fox Army of more than ten thousand people stood neatly together.
Among them, a woman was extremely panicked and understood that a big problem was about to happen.
Ever since she came to the Heavenly Fox Nation, she had never joined the official faction because the risk of being exposed was too high. This time, because the matter of the legendary ruins of Emperor Wu was very important, she had no choice but to take the risk and use various connections to enter the Heavenly Fox Guard to investigate more information.
Although she had already expected this moment, Qu Ling was still a little afraid.
Her heart was thumping.
Although her mental fortitude was pretty good, the totem-level fox god stood in the sky and looked down at them. After that, overlord-level foxes appeared one after another.
Under this pressure, as a top-notch master, Qu Ling really couldn’t breathe.
“Hahahaha, are you looking for spies?” At the side, the Black Goat Totem that flew over looked at this group of cute humans and chuckled.
Beside him, Legend Bai Chuan was expressionless. His gaze was more focused on the illusory legendary ruin door that connected heaven and earth.
The method to crack this ruin was what he was most concerned about.
Unfortunately, after so many days, the Heavenly Fox Nation still couldn’t crack this legendary seal ruin.
Unfortunately, they temporarily couldn’t find a very good way to crack this sealed ruin.
“You…” Under the Fox God’s gaze, through some unknown method, its gaze focused on a middle-aged Beast Tamer in the army. Under its gaze, the middle-aged man was covered in sweat, his eyes filled with fear.
“No, no, spare me, Lord Fox God, spare me!!!”
The middle-aged man let out a miserable cry and was pulled into the sky by a wave of spiritual power. Then, with a miserable cry, he fainted and was thrown to the ground by the Fox God.
“A spy from the Heavenly Wolf Nation?” The Fox God’s expression was unfriendly. It was rare for it to wake up. It didn’t expect this much trouble.
Its bootlicker actually dared to plant people in his territory?
It looked at a woman with a fox beside her. After looking over, the middle-aged woman was instantly shocked.
Just like the outcome of the middle-aged man from before, the middle-aged woman was instantly pulled out, her memories extracted, and thrown out.
In the next moment, another pale young man was pulled out and thrown out.
The corners of the mouths of the Black Goat Totem and Legend Bai Chuan twitched.
How many spies did this Heavenly Fox Nation have!!!
Under the repeated searches of the Fox God, soon, six spies were pulled out, making the Heavenly Fox Saintess and the overlord foxes reveal unfriendly expressions.
Son of a b*tch.
Soon, the fox god’s gaze landed on a captain of the Heavenly Fox Guard, a woman in her twenties. Her expression was calm and she kept silent. She looked at the fox god and was filled with piety.
“You’re pretending very well.”
The Fox God said coldly and looked at Qu Ling. These words almost made Qu Ling cry.
The Fox God’s Psychic wave enveloped over.
As for Qu Ling, she seemed to have resigned to her fate. Her expression was filled with despair. Fortunately, Qu Ling knew that her memories had the ability to self-destruct and that her identity wouldn’t be leaked.
