With his rich experience, totems like the Fox God and the Black Goat wouldn’t rashly enter the ruins after seeing the scene just now. Instead, they would let their subordinates be the vanguard.
It would be best if Bai Chuan came in alone!
Now, Shi Yu really wanted to meet a real legend in the ruins. He had several bold ideas regarding his “body control” talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - Third Beast Taming Talent (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: Third Beast Taming Talent (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In the legendary ruins space, after the Black Winged Horse Ape entered, it was stunned by the scene in front of it on the spot.
The ground that looked like it had experienced a forbidden weapon explosion, the hot sky, and the totem corpse… It definitely meant that this place had just experienced a tragic battle!!
However, after entering, the Black Winged Horse Ape didn’t discover any threatening creatures.
The three overlord-level undead that had locked onto it weren’t very strong according to the Black Winged Horse Ape’s intuition.
It was impossible for the changes here to be caused by them, so what exactly was going on?
Before the Black Winged Horse Ape could investigate further, the Green Scaled Dragon Spirit, the Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit, and the Mountain Tortoise Spirit moved again.
Dragon Breath.
Ice light.
Flying Rock.
It arrived with a bang.
At the same time, a gray-robed old man flew in the sky in the distance, his gaze green as he walked over.
The Black Winged Horse Ape’s heart skipped a beat as it realized that it couldn’t stay long.
Although they didn’t look like much, looking at the cow’s miserable state, there was definitely great danger inside.
“Is that all ~ ~” Of course, facing the enemy’s attack, a trace of disdain still appeared on the Black Winged Horse Ape’s face.
It waved the black light sword in its hands, and the phantom-like sword light instantly resisted the dragon breath, ice light, and flying rocks that attacked in all directions!
This Black Winged Horse Ape’s strength was indeed extraordinary. Shi Yu also acknowledged it very much. After all, its Beast Tamer was ranked among the legends of the Seven Islands.
Bai Chuan, a level-seven Beast Tamer, had contracted seven overlord-level pets!
The number of overlord-level pets contracted by this one person was almost comparable to the number of overlords in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
This was also normal. In terms of financial resources, excluding the private assets of the totem Fox God, the entire Heavenly Fox Nation could be beaten up by the Ke Yuan Financial Group.
Boom!!!
The sword light that was like a violent wind phantom canceled out the dragon breath, ice light, and flying rocks in the smoke explosion.
During this period, the three undead overlords continued to approach the Black Winged Horse Ape. As for Shi Yu, he rushed over as if he was looking at prey.
Beside him, Ji Mengzhu was silent. What was he doing…
Shi Yu licked his lips.
What else could he do!
Of course, it was to attract its Beast Tamer through this big monkey!
The light in Shi Yu’s eyes was still shining.
But soon, his expression stopped. This was because after the big monkey curled its lips in disdain, it actually turned around and ran. It flew towards a spatial crack not far away, wanting to return to the outside world.
“Wu’er ~ ~”
The Black Winged Horse Ape had almost understood the internal situation. Its Beast Tamer’s order was to take a look and go back to confirm if the Black Meteorite Yak was really dead.
Now that the mission was completed, there was no need to fight.
Seeing this, the corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He quickly said telepathically, “Senior Ji, is there no way to seal it here?”
Ji Mengzhu said, “No… If this space wants to have the power to seal again, I’m afraid it won’t be possible without a thousand years.”
“Even if it’s an internal and external teleportation and sealing of the ruins, I’m afraid we have to wait until the ruins are almost repaired. That attack just now has already completely disturbed the stability of space.”
“Of course, if we only make equipment to strengthen spatial seal-type moves, the ruins can do it, but there has to be another life as the main body. It can only play a support role.”
Shi Yu sighed. From the looks of it, he couldn’t lure the opponent in through this big monkey. The other party’s speed was too fast, and he couldn’t catch up at all.
The opponent was very sneaky.
But at this moment, something unexpected happened.
Ji Mengzhu’s pupils constricted.
Two voices appeared in Shi Yu’s ears at the same time.
“Not good, a totem has entered!!”
[Eh, you ran pretty quickly. Kid, are you alright?]
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu, who was flying in midair, smiled and said, “It’s one of ours.”
New spatial fluctuations appeared beside Shi Yu, Ji Mengzhu, and the others.
A woman in the battle robe of the Heavenly Fox Nation and a big cat appeared.
The moment they appeared, Ji Mengzhu immediately sensed that this cat was the totem-level life form she had sensed with “Shi Yu” previously.
Ji Mengzhu didn’t expect that this Dong Huang guardian… actually looked so harmless.
“Senior…” At this moment, when she saw Shi Yu and saw that the gray-robed old man who saved her was fine, Qu Ling’s expression was also delighted.
But soon, she and the gem cat also noticed the messy scene in this sealed space like the Black Winged Horse Ape just now.
The corners of the gem cat’s mouth twitched. This mark looked like it had just appeared!!
Moreover, why did it feel so similar to Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction traces??
At this moment, Baby Ginseng and Eleven had already been taken back by Shi Yu, leaving Chi Tong possessing the bone sword.
Similarly shocking was the spirit body following beside Shi Yu. When it saw this spirit body, the gem cat wanted to rub its eyes with its cat claws.
What the f*ck was going on?
Wasn’t this the little girl who raised pandas in Ping Cheng?
Wait… Looking carefully, the difference was still quite big. At least, she was much more mature than that little girl.
At this moment, there was no time for the gem cat to think too much. After seeing the gem cat, Shi Yu immediately revealed a hearty smile.
He said, “You came at the right time. Help me with something. If the Black Goat and that Beast Tamer still come in later, we’ll kill them before they come in!”
“If they don’t come in and just guard outside. We’ll wait too.”
“If they want to run, take the initiative to attack and kill them!”

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - The Third Beast Taming Talent (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 702: The Third Beast Taming Talent (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The gem cat: ???
As Shi Yu spoke to the gem cat, its face fell.
It regretted coming in.
As it knew that Shi Yu was inside the ruins, it wasn’t as afraid as the black goat and the others that didn’t dare to enter.
It saw that an overlord had entered and might pose a threat to Shi Yu and the others, so the cat directly entered. However, it didn’t expect that just as it entered, the baboon would run away. Moreover, Shi Yu started to order it around right after meeting.
And now it had to fight a dangerous totem like the Black Goat Totem.
Even that fox god was unwilling to be too entangled with this black goat!!
“Why are you in such a hurry!!” The gem cat was a little afraid.
He didn’t want to fight the black goat head-on.
“I’m afraid that Beast Tamer will run away.”
Shi Yu said, “Don’t forget, he’s the core figure of the change in this mission… Of course, that guy’s talent looks pretty good.”
The gem cat : “…”
“No problem, the space is about to be repaired.”
“At that time, we’ll directly carry out the kill strategy and persist for a while as we hide in this space. A mere totem can’t do anything to us.”
“At least, the strength of this space is still online.”
“Senior Ji, didn’t you just say that this legendary sealed ruin can be used as equipment to increase the effect of spatial moves?? Hehe, the user is here now.”
Shi Yu’s words made the corners of the gem cat’s mouth twitch. What was going on?
Ji Mengzhu was also very silent. Wait a minute… was it really alright?
However, in the face of Shi Yu’s starry gaze, she still quickly took out the ruins controller.
“This is the ‘core’ of this ruin.”
At this moment, Ji Mengzhu finally handed the control equipment of the legendary ruins to Shi Yu. This was something that looked like a black stone card. Shi Yu temporarily called it the ruins card.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded after taking the card.
With this, he could instantly retreat back into this ruin. As long as the ruin was repaired and they instantly hid inside, even if it was at the totem level, it couldn’t do anything to them.
After all, this was a legendary ruin.
Even without the sealing ability, the strength was still there.
If it was an ordinary ruin like Shi Yu’s ruin ring, he would undoubtedly be instantly torn down by the black goat if he wanted to use it to dodge the pursuit, causing the entire ruin to collapse. There was nowhere to escape.
However, this was a legendary ruin that could even seal top-notch totems. It was completely no problem to hide for a moment.
At that time, he just had to wait for Dong Huang’s reinforcements in the ruins.
Even if Dong Huang’s reinforcements didn’t arrive, he could find an opportunity to let the gem cat slip away with the ruin card and escape from this guy.
In short, he was definitely going to eat this Bai Chuan up.
If he let the other party escape this time, there would be no chance next time. The other party had to stay!
….
At the same time, in the outside world.
Swoosh!!
With just a probe, the Black Winged Horse Ape immediately came out of the crack. Bai Chuan also understood the situation inside the ruins through it. His expression was dark as he said, “It’s bad, there are Beast Tamers, many overlord-level undead enemies, and large-scale lethal weapons.”
“The Black Meteorite Yak was killed just now.”
“I can confirm that there are no longer any signs of life.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the black goat beside it was also shocked, its mood constantly changing.
“Give up, let’s retreat first.”
“That fox has probably already called for help, and the Black Meteorite Yak is no longer around. It’s disadvantageous for us to continue staying.”
“Besides, there’s still a certain amount of danger inside the ruins. We don’t know what trump cards the other party has.”
Although Bai Chuan felt that it was a pity, the Black Meteorite Yak, a key life form that could help revive Yun An, was already dead. He felt that for the sake of safety, he should give up this mission.
“Damn it!” Although the Black Goat was unhappy, it didn’t refute. The mission this time was to bring back the Black Meteorite Yak. If even the target was already dead, there was indeed no need to stay here and take risks.
“Let’s go.” The black goat was silent for a moment before saying unhappily. It turned around and planned to leave.
Bai Chuan took a deep breath and planned to leave.
Seeing this…
The eyes of the two groups who were paying attention to the black goat and Bai Chuan flashed.
The Heavenly Fox Saintess stood beside the Fox God and said, “Lord Fox God, looks like they don’t plan to explore this ruin anymore. What should we do next?”
Should they hold onto these people who entered the Heavenly Fox Nation or let them leave?
They weren’t exploring ruins anymore. Should the Heavenly Fox Nation explore it?
These needed to be decided by the Fox God.
The Fox God’s nine huge tails danced, and its gaze was unfriendly. “Let them go.”
Just as that black goat said, if they started a war, the Heavenly Fox Nation would definitely pay a huge price.
The Fox God was clearly unwilling to make such a sacrifice.
Although from the looks of it, the legendary ruins had already been taken by someone else, the Fox God had already decided to suffer in silence.
At this moment, the Fox God was still suspecting that the gray-robed old man was in cahoots with the Black Goat and the others.
After all, the goal of the Black Goat and the others was the legendary ruins, and the gray-robed old man was also in the legendary ruins. Everything was too suspicious.
Although from the looks of it, the black goat and the others had yet to achieve their goal, but what if the so-called goal was just something used to deceive them from the start?
Perhaps one of them, the gray-robed old man, had already achieved his goal in the legendary ruins.
That would mean that the situation being shown now was just an act for the Fox Nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - The Third Beast Taming Talent (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 703: The Third Beast Taming Talent (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
However, no matter what the truth was, the Fox God indeed didn’t want to pursue it anymore. This was because in the dark right now, there was at least a spatial totem. It was the totem that had saved the spy just now. Regardless of whether this totem was with the Black Goat and the others, if there was a conflict with the Black Goat now, it would be extremely disadvantageous to the Heavenly Fox Nation.
That third party could easily benefit if they fought each other right now.
The Heavenly Fox Nation was not a strong totem country to begin with. Since there were not many losses this time, the Fox God decided to ignore it. It was better to let the bootlickers deal with these guys in the future to avoid the Heavenly Fox Nation becoming the main battlefield.
….
In the distance, Dong Huang’s group, Legend Ke, Legend Zhang, Ji Feng, the Butterfly God, and the others began to panic when they saw the changes happen one after another and saw that the Black Goat and Legend Bai Chuan were about to leave.
Now, capturing Bai Chuan’s mission level was definitely higher than bringing back the Iron-eating Beast and figuring out the truth of the ruins.
They couldn’t watch helplessly as the black goat and Legend Bai Chuan left.
“Follow.”
“If necessary, we can only attack.” The butterfly god sighed. It only hoped that when it and the gem cat fought this black goat, the fox god wouldn’t help the black goat.
….
Everyone aimed their sights at the departing Black Goat and Bai Chuan.
At this moment, the first to not hold back and choose to attack were Shi Yu and the others.
Because the ruins space had almost been repaired.
Boom!!!
The black goat and Bai Chuan, who had flown away, were already prepared for the possibility of the Heavenly Fox Nation stopping them.
However, they didn’t expect that the one who attacked wasn’t the Fox God.
It seemed to have come from the power in the legendary sealed space!!!
Boom!!!
A transcendent-level blue deterrence appeared out of thin air. The black goat that turned around and left frowned and also erupted with a shocking aura. The blue deterrence and the black deterrence swept into the sky, instantly making the sky change color.
Boom!!!
In the blink of an eye, a huge black and blue hole cracked in the sky. Through this huge hole, one could clearly see the starry sky and thousands of stars flickering.
This scene instantly made the hearts of the Heavenly Fox Nation tremble.
It also made the expressions of the Butterfly God and the others in the distance change. They realized that Shi Yu and the gem cat were the first to attack.
Under the deterrence, Bai Chuan’s expression instantly darkened. The seven overlord pets all appeared beside him and cooperated with the black goat to release deterrence!!
However, this deterrence was only a show of strength. The real killing move was the subsequent immobilization!!
Buzz!!!
In an instant, everyone, including the Black Goat, Bai Chuan, and Bai Chuan’s seven overlord-level pets, felt that they were frozen by a spatial power.
Just as this power appeared, the expressions of Bai Chuan and the seven overlord pets changed drastically. This was because with their strength, they seemed to be completely unable to break free from this restraint.
The black goat’s expression also changed drastically. It felt that this binding power was difficult to deal with!!
“This wave…”
As for the fox god in the distance, it immediately determined that this wave not only had the fluctuations of the ruins space, but also the power fluctuations of the spatial totem that had just stolen the spy from its hands.
At this moment, the Fox God was puzzled. What did this mean?
That totem stopped the black goat and the others from leaving?
Weren’t they together???
“Wow, so fierce.” In the distance, the butterfly god was also shocked. Even from afar, it could feel the strength of this spatial immobilization.
Even it might have to struggle to break free for a few seconds.
Was this the move of the gem cat sister?
Was this the move of the gem cat sister?
However, the strength of this move didn’t look like a fresh new totem no matter how one looked at it.
In an instant, an ordinary totem+seven overlords+a legendary Beast Tamer was frozen!
From the expression of the black goat, this move was definitely very powerful.
At this moment, in the legendary ruins space, the gem cat holding the legendary ruins black card was also very shocked. The enhancement of this ruin card to spatial seal-type moves was so fierce.
It felt that the effect of its skill had been increased by at least 50%!
No wonder the spirit of the ruins could drag Shi Yu away without anyone noticing. Although it was distracted that time and had to focus on the Fox God, this ruins space was clearly a good thing.
Damn it… I want it so much…
“In short, as expected of me.” The gem cat looked at the totem and overlords it had frozen, its face quite pleased.
However, the most important thing at this moment was not it, but Shi Yu.
In the outside world.
Space ripples surged.
Under the gazes of the Heavenly Fox Nation’s Fox God, Holy Maiden, and many overlords, the Butterfly God, Legend Ke, and Ji Feng…
A gray-robed old man appeared from the spatial ripples.
He stood on a green dragon, and his figure instantly arrived, heading towards Bai Chuan.
Seeing this gray-robed old man, the expression of the Fox God changed. Ji Feng and the others’ expressions also changed.
Their understanding of the gray-robed old man’s identity was naturally different.
However, at this moment, the gray-robed old man’s actions made the pupils of all the lives present, including Black Goat, Bai Chuan, and the others, shrink.
“Hehe, kid, you sent your pet to spy on us and want to run away. How can there be such a good thing?”
“Pay up some interest.”
As Shi Yu smiled evilly, he flew over. He looked even more like a big villain than the Black Goat and Legend Bai Chuan, his entire body emitting an evil aura.
Everyone’s expressions were solemn and serious. Under the immobilization of an unknown power, the gray-robed old man riding the Undead Dragon instantly appeared beside Legend Bai Chuan. Then, he directly stretched out the old black hand wearing the Talent Bead bracelet and penetrated Legend Bai Chuan’s heart!!

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - The Third Beast Taming Talent (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 704: The Third Beast Taming Talent (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Because his fingers had been given hardening and Space Quake elements, along with Shi Yu’s monarch-level dragon physique, this attack unsurprisingly made the frozen Bai Chuan’s face turn pale. He was heavily injured. His face was filled with disbelief and found it difficult to accept.
Sensing the heavy damage to his body, Legend Bai Chuan felt his life force flowing faster. Every contracted pet of his sensed that the Beast Tamer was in a very dangerous near-death state!!
“Roar!!!”
“Roar!!!”
Their eyes were red and their expressions were fierce, but their movements were restricted by the immobilization, unable to move!!
The Heavenly Fox Nation and the Black Goat were shocked by the gray-robed old man’s actions. They froze a totem and seven overlords in the air and directly came in front of the legendary Beast Tamer to complete the kill.
Who exactly was this guy?
“This…” The Fox God, who originally suspected that the gray-robed old man and the Black Goat were in cahoots, was stunned.
This didn’t look like they were in cahoots at all.
From the looks of it, this gray-robed old man was an even more evil villain than the black goat and the others.
He wanted to kill a Beast Tamer just because he was glanced at?
“Wait…” The Butterfly God was also shocked. Didn’t they say to keep him alive and investigate the memories of this legend of the Seven Islands?
What was Shi Yu doing?
At this moment, the one who knew best what Shi Yu was doing was Legend Bai Chuan himself. His eyes were filled with darkness. He felt that not only was his life force flowing away, but his Beast Taming Talent and his control talent over his body were also starting to disappear.
This feeling made Bai Chuan very afraid.
He felt that all of this was related to the gray-robed old man in front of him.
[Plunder.]
After heavily injuring Legend Bai Chuan into a near-death state in one hit, Shi Yu’s expression was calm. The Talent Bead on his bracelet directly activated its strength and plundered Legend Bai Chuan’s “body control talent”!!
At this moment, as the power of the Beast Taming Talent was plundered, Legend Bai Chuan’s Beast Taming Space also collapsed. In an instant, his contractual relationship with the seven pets was all broken!!
At that moment, Bai Chuan only had one breath left. Seeing this, the one who burned the most in anger was not Bai Chuan’s seven pets, but the black goat that was frozen at the side!!
Its current anger was even greater than when it saw the Black Meteorite Yak die. The Yun Race had spent a lot of effort to nurture a legendary Beast Tamer, especially a legendary Beast Tamer who was proficient in biological modification. Now, now…
Someone actually killed him under its nose. This scene caused a surge of huge anger, directly helping the black goat break free from the gem cat’s spatial restraints!!
“Roar!!!!” A terrifying black deterrence wave came from the black goat.
“Not good!!!” In the legendary ruins space, the gem cat’s expression changed. It immediately wanted to send Shi Yu and the others back to the space.
At this moment, Shi Yu was already satisfied. He had completely achieved his goal!!!
Talent Bead, Body Control Talent, plunder successful!!
It really succeeded!
Not only that.
Buzz!
At the same time, in Shi Yu’s walking stick, Chi Tong, who had possessed the bone sword, also completed the final kill of Legend Bai Chuan from afar and imprisoned its undead spirit in the bone sword. This way, it could directly control its undead form and better investigate its memories through the undead.
In an instant, a super legend that was ranked among the seven islands died under the cooperation of the gem cat and Shi Yu.
However, at this moment, although both the plundering talent and “capturing” Bai Chuan were very smooth, the threat of the black goat also followed closely!!
“Roar!!!” The black goat’s eyes seemed to have turned into black holes. Its mountain-like huge hooves swept at Shi Yu. Just as he obtained his third talent, Shi Yu was about to face a totem attack!

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - Your Father Even Assessed Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: Your Father Even Assessed Me
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The huge hoof swept over. Facing the totem attack, Shi Yu was extremely nervous. He waited for the gem cat’s teleportation.
At the very least, there should still be the protection of the Dragon God. However, at this moment, what helped him block this attack was neither teleportation nor protection!
The gem cat was just about to use the power of the ruins to teleport Shi Yu when it nervously discovered that the spatial fluctuations here were instantly disturbed, causing its teleportation to fail.
With its rich spatial experience, the gem cat understood that a powerful life form had teleported over.
Its spatial abilities were even above it. Even if it borrowed the power of the ruins, it couldn’t compare.
As a spatial ripple appeared, a young man in luxurious clothes stepped out and appeared between the black goat and Shi Yu.
After he appeared, the black goat’s attack directly stopped in midair. Then, a huge impact sent the black goat flying!!
Boom!!!
With a shocked expression, the black goat’s entire body was sent flying and hit the mountain peak below. In an instant, the mountain peak collapsed. Its body was swept into the smoke and completely buried.
The young man in luxurious clothes looked at the black goat and then at the fox god in the distance. He also looked at the gray-robed old man who was digging out Bai Chuan’s heart not far away and fell silent.
At this moment, the most shocked were still the black goat and the fox god in the distance. When they saw this luxuriously dressed young man, their expressions were instantly filled with extreme fear.
“President Lin…” Of course, the most surprised were the Butterfly God, Qu Ling, and the others. Seeing the president of the Dong Huang Association personally come, the Butterfly God instantly heaved a sigh of relief. It knew that this mission was stable. There was nothing more reliable than this reinforcement.
“It’s stable, it’s stable. Although this guy looks young, he’s already more than 100 years old. He’s the strongest Beast Tamer alive in Dong Huang, a Titled Legendary! Moreover, he definitely has a bunch of backup plans!” In the ruins, the gem cat was extremely excited and said to the stunned Ji Mengzhu. Alright, it could slack off now.
“Lin Xiao…!” However, compared to the calmness of the Butterfly God and the others, the nine-tailed fox of the Heavenly Fox Nation had an extremely unfriendly expression.
“What is the meaning of this?”
Seeing the boss of the enemy faction come directly to their territory, anyone would be nervous.
“Lord Fox God, there’s no need to be nervous.” President Lin smiled and looked at the nine-tailed fox. “I didn’t come this time to destroy the Heavenly Fox Nation.”
“I’m just here to clean up.”
He looked at Bai Chuan and said,
“That person is a traitor of the seven countries.”
“And this goat is a totem that lured him into treason.”
“After that, they even openly attacked Dong Huang’s allies.”
“Lord Heavenly Fox, you understand, right? Do you want to protect them, or are you also part of this?”
The fox god’s expression changed and it stopped talking.
“You lured the humans of the Seven Nation Alliance to betray the country and even openly attacked Dong Huang’s allies. I believe you’re already mentally prepared, right?”
President Lin chuckled. The rest of his words were said to the black goat in the mountain.
“Damn it.”
The black goat looked frightened.
Of course, the current Bai Chuan no longer had any life aura, and the black goat only had one thought: escape!
President Lin ignored the black goat and the fox god and looked at the gray-robed old man Shi Yu had changed into. He said, “Old man, can you hand that person to me?”
At this moment, looking at the confrontation between President Dong Huang and the gray-robed old man, the Fox God and the Black Goat were completely confused.
The Fox God felt that the situation in its territory had become chaotic to a certain extent.
It was impossible to tell who was who and who was in cahoots with the other!
At this moment, President Lin naturally knew that the gray-robed old man was Shi Yu, but regardless of whether others believed it on the surface, he still had to do it.
Shi Yu’s expression changed. He directly threw Bai Chuan’s corpse down and rode the dragon spirit to run.
“Dong Huang, huh? I’ll give you some face.” At the same time, he left some harsh words.
At the same time, the thing that scared the Fox God and the Black Goat the most came.
“Does your Dong Huang want to start a war…”
The Fox God looked at the flash in the sky and said with a drastic change in expression.
As for the black goat, it looked at the flash in the sky and had an even stronger urge to escape. With a boom, it flipped its body and leaped a thousand meters, but…
However, the speed of this strong light completely exceeded the scope of the black goat’s understanding. It shot from the edge of the Heavenly Fox Nation and instantly descended here. The black goat was indeed not easy to deal with. Even if it was a top-notch totem group fight, they would be injured by its radiation power.
In order to reduce the damage, the best solution was to use cleansing forbidden weapons.
This was the Heavenly Fox Nation. Dong Huang had no burden using forbidden weapons.
“Don’t worry, I won’t let you die.” President Lin looked at the black goat with a calm expression.
….
“It’s a forbidden weapon. Is it small, ordinary, or modified?” When Ji Feng and the others saw that even the forbidden weapon was here, they instantly understood that President Lin Xiao wasn’t the only one who came.
Perhaps there was still a titled legendary Mechanic presiding behind.
“Is that a forbidden weapon?…”
At this moment, in the legendary ruins space, Ji Mengzhu also sensed a huge energy wave that suddenly came from the sky. This energy wave was even stronger and more condensed than Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction just now!!
“Yeah…”
In the distance, Shi Yu, who was constantly fleeing, couldn’t help but turn around. He knew that this trip to the Heavenly Fox Nation was over.
“This is a forbidden weapon. I wonder where it was fired from.”

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - Your Father Even Assessed Me (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Your Father Even Assessed Me (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“But it shouldn’t be Dong Huang. Otherwise, it would probably cause chaos in the other totem countries.”
In the ruins, Ji Mengzhu said, “You mean that the attack range of the forbidden weapon is very far??”
“Of course, without any interception in the middle, it’s completely no problem to shoot from one end of Blue Planet to the other.”
Ji Mengzhu’s mouth opened slightly. She couldn’t understand. She had never heard of a skill with such a long attack range!
Shi Yu turned around.
Sigh, although Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction was useful, its agility was still a little lacking. It looked like he had to let Ling develop super long-range teleportation. At that time, even if they were in Dong Huang, they could instantly teleport Baby Ginseng to a totem country and accurately self-destruct.
Then, Baby Ginseng would revive in the Beast Taming Space… The range would be true!
“No…” At the same time, the forbidden weapon shot from half a country away accurately hit the black goat that wanted to escape crazily, causing the shocked black goat to be swallowed by the endless strong light.
This forbidden weapon didn’t cause a large-scale lethality. After accurately hitting the black goat, it directly wrapped its entire body in a huge ball of light!!
Right on the heels of that, a sound that resounded through the sky came from inside the light ball, causing the atmosphere to change with a bang. It also made the ground tremble violently, and a super earthquake occurred!
As the cleansing-type forbidden weapon exploded on the black goat, the space here kept trembling. Space cracks appeared one after another. Sea Dragon King, Azure Dragon King, Divine Feather Phoenix Butterfly… Guardians of Dong Huang appeared from the spatial cracks and descended in the Heavenly Fox Nation!!
Their gazes locked onto Bai Chuan’s overlord-level pets and the black goat that had been hit by the forbidden weapon.
“Just leave it to them. These are Dong Huang’s reinforcements.” Shi Yu smiled.
….
Shi Yu was not willing to deal with the matters in the Heavenly Fox Nation. After all, his identity as a gray-robed old man had caused too much trouble in the Heavenly Fox Nation, and it was not legitimate.
On the other hand, now that the Dong Huang army had descended, there was a legitimate reason. Shi Yu ran crazily. Soon, they arrived in the distance and met Legend Ke, Legend Zhang, and Ji Feng!!
“Come up.”
Looking at the three of them, Shi Yu and the gem cat pulled the three of them into the ruins space without a word. At the same time, they didn’t forget another mission, which was to bring back the Iron-eating Beast Race!!
This mission was relatively simple. Following the change just now, the overlord guarding the iron-eating beast race had long rushed over, leaving a group of iron-eating beasts trembling on the spot, crawling on the ground and not daring to move.
During the process of slipping away, Shi Yu smoothly swept the iron-eating beasts back into the ruins.
At the same time, after pulling them in, he directly let Buggy hypnotize them to sleep to relieve the pressure.
The mission this time could be said to have been completed extremely smoothly. Moreover, there was an unexpected surprise…
That was the third talent and the clue to the Yun An Race.
At this moment, in the legendary ruins space.
Ji Mengzhu looked at the Iron-eating Beast race that had been recovered and was overjoyed. At the same time, she looked at the two old men and a young man who had been brought in and felt gratified. These were the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang now, right?
“I’m so tired.” In the ruins space, the gem cat cursed.
“Sorry to have made you suffer.” As for Legend Zhang, a senior of the tenth bureau, he looked at Qu Ling with emotion.
It wasn’t easy for this little girl either.
She had come to the totem country to hide for several years in his twenties. How long had it been since she last went home?
Moreover, she almost died just now.
“Is it Senior Zhang?” Qu Ling said excitedly.
“It’s me, Little Ling. You can go home after this. Your father misses you very much.”
Ji Feng also smiled at his companion in the tenth bureau.
Qu Ling rubbed her red eyes and said, “It’s nothing. Thank you, seniors, for saving me. By the way…”
She looked at Shi Yu and said, “I still don’t know your identity, Senior…”
“Well…” The spirit of the ruins, Ji Mengzhu, also discovered the blind spot. Although she had experienced so much, she didn’t seem to know the name of this gray-robed old man.
At the same time, she didn’t know too much about the identities of these Beast Tamers from Dong Huang after 2000 years.
“And this is…” Not only Shi Yu, but Qu Ling, Legend Ke, Legend Zhang, Ji Feng, and the others also didn’t understand the identity of Ji Mengzhu’s ruins spirit.
But from the looks of it, she was indeed an ally, and she was related to the legendary ruins.
“Let me introduce you one by one.” Shi Yu was also relaxed at this moment. He smiled and said, “This is Ji Mengzhu, a senior from the Emperor Wu Era. She’s a legendary feeder of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast Corps. In order to seal a totem of the Yun Race, she transformed into the spirit of the ruins and protected the seal until now…”
“Just now, I entered the legendary ruins and got to know this senior.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Qu Ling, Legend Ke, Ji Feng, and the others suddenly widened their eyes and looked at the spirit body female general in shock.
As for Ji Mengzhu, she also smiled and nodded. “I’m just an ancient from the old era. If not for… everyone’s help, I might have died.”
She looked at Shi Yu. At this moment, she still didn’t know Shi Yu’s name.
“Old man, do tell me your name first.” Among this group of people, Ji Mengzhu was the most grateful to Shi Yu.
“Yeah.”
Qu Ling was also rather grateful to Shi Yu and the gem cat.
Old man?

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - Your Father Even Assessed Me (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Your Father Even Assessed Me (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, when they heard how they addressed Shi Yu, Ji Feng and the others had strange expressions.
Although Shi Yu’s current appearance was indeed that of an old man, he was indeed not an old man.
Shi Yu also smiled and shook his head. “Senior Ji, you’re already a senior from 2000 years ago. Don’t call me old.”
“This is just a disguise. I’m actually quite young.”
“Not even 21 years old.”
At this moment, the gem cat had already brought the ruins space away from the battlefield. They were about to leave the Heavenly Fox Nation and were returning to Dong Huang. The matters here were left to President Lin and the others. There was no need for Shi Yu to hide his identity now.
As the power of the Time Fruit disappeared, the color of Shi Yu’s hair slowly darkened, and the wrinkles on his face gradually disappeared. His age immediately returned to his early twenties from his sixties or seventies.
This change completely shocked Ji Mengzhu and Qu Ling.
Especially Ji Mengzhu, who was so shocked that she couldn’t say a word. She looked at Shi Yu, who had returned to his 20-year-old appearance, in silence…
This, this, this…
“My name is Shi Yu.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Ji Mengzhu was completely speechless. She had seen Shi Yu’s various moves just now. A level-six Beast Tamer, annihilating a totem, controlling an overlord undead group, commanding a totem-level life form to freeze a totem and overlords, so that he could insta-kill a legend…
If all of this was done by an experienced level-six Beast Tamer, she could barely accept it with a shocked brain. But now, someone was telling her that the “culprit” of all of this was a 20-year-old young man??
How was this possible…
Even Emperor Wu didn’t have such a terrifying battle result at this age.
“You, you, you…” At that moment, Qu Ling also looked at Shi Yu in shock.
Initially, she also thought that Shi Yu was a senior. After all, he could still team up with a totem in such a dangerous place. How could he not have some experience and reputation?
However, when she saw Shi Yu return to his younger appearance and say that he was only 20 years old, Qu Ling was momentarily in a daze.
She had also seen Shi Yu’s performance just now.
“This guy is a freak,” Ji Feng curled his lips and said.
He felt that he had let Shi Yu settle this mission all by himself before he started doing anything…
“I can’t believe it…” At this moment, Ji Mengzhu still didn’t react. She looked at Legend Ke and the others and said,” Don’t tell me you guys are also… ”
Could it be that these old people were also extremely young? In that case, her values would probably be further impacted!
Legend Ke laughed and said, “How could that be? Shi Yu is an exception. Don’t treat him as a normal person. He’s the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang now, the most talented archeologist in Dong Huang. There’s no need to be surprised, no need to be surprised…”
The number one person below the legend level of Dong Huang!
Qu Ling widened her eyes and looked at Shi Yu. After all, before she went abroad, Dong Huang didn’t have such a title…
No, before she went abroad, Shi Yu was probably not old enough to graduate from high school.
What exactly happened in Dong Huang during this period…
Being in a totem country, Qu Ling could be said to have no idea at all.
At this moment, Shi Yu also smiled at Qu Ling and said something that made Qu Ling’s face filled with question marks.
“Master Qu Jie is your father, right? You indeed look identical. Speaking of which, my vocation assessment, intermediate assessment, advanced assessment, and even master assessment were all done with Master Qu Jie’s help.”
“After you go back, Miss Qu Ling, please greet Master Qu Jie for me.”
Qu Ling: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (1)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
At this moment, Qu Ling was a little stunned.
The number one person below the legend level of Dong Huang in front of her, a young man who looked very, very strong, actually passed the assessment done by his father?
Was his father… So powerful?
Qu Ling was very shocked. At the same time, she was even more curious about Shi Yu.
“Really…”
However, at this moment, she was too embarrassed to ask Shi Yu more. She secretly decided that she had to ask her father more about Shi Yu when she returned.
His father must have already discovered the other party’s shining points in the assessment…
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have given the other party several assessments in a row.
“Yes.” Shi Yu sighed slightly.
Speaking of which, Master Qu Jie seemed to be the Beast Tamer who fought him the most, right? Shi Yu couldn’t remember clearly…
“This is…” Shi Yu quickly introduced Legend Ke and the others to Ji Mengzhu. Then, he said, “Everyone, let’s chat first. I just captured the soul of that Beast Tamer. I’m going to search… search the memories to see if there’s any important information.”
Everyone was silent.
So he wasn’t completely killed?
The gem cat was also silent. Killing, stealing talents, and capturing souls made the cat very afraid.
Shi Yu was becoming less and less like a good person… Oh, it was an accomplice, wasn’t it. That was fine.
“So you still have a trump card.”
Legend Ke was shocked. He thought that Shi Yu had directly killed Legend Bai Chuan.
Upon hearing that they could still squeeze information from Bai Chuan, both Legend Ke and Legend Zhang heaved a sigh of relief.
It looked like Shi Yu was more prepared than they imagined.
But this kid…
The two legends had strange expressions. They felt that Shi Yu was not easy to deal with.
“Do you need our help?” Legend Zhang said.
“There’s no need.” Shi Yu smiled. Chi Tong and Buggy had already started searching!
“Go and do it, then.” Ji Mengzhu also nodded. There was no need to care about her. Shi Yu and the others’ mission was the most important at the moment.
….
The trip to the Heavenly Fox Nation was like a dream.
Legend Ke and Ji Feng felt that they had yet to do anything. They were purely here to help.
Legend Zhang played a key role and called for reinforcements through his teleportation talent.
As for Qu Ling, she was also very important and provided a lot of important information.
If the rewards were distributed according to merit after returning this time, it should be Shi Yu who did more than Qu Ling and Legend Zhang…
After Shi Yu introduced these humans to Ji Mengzhu one by one, he quickly came to Buggy and Chi Tong and received Bai Chuan’s memories.
His memories were very important. Be it the information about the Yun Race or the experience in using his physical control talent, they were all what Shi Yu needed.
….
Xin Zhizhu. This was the full name of Legend Bai Chuan.
His family background was very ordinary. He came from a small town, and his parents weren’t Beast Tamers. His entire family worked together to let Legend Bai Chuan go to Beast Tamer School.
However, because he came from a small place and had a weak childhood personality, Bai Chuan often encountered bullying in school. The bullying of his peers and the disregard of adults made Bai Chuan hate his society very much.
The turning point was that in the year that Legend Bai Chuan awakened his talent, his talent was chosen by a passing Mechanic and he was taken in as a student to nurture. If this Mechanic was a normal person, nothing would naturally happen. However, “luckily”, this Beast Tamer was a Mechanic cultivated by the Yun clan.
Ever since the Yun Race was destroyed in the Dong Huang Continent, there was only a small portion of power left. They hid and didn’t come out until the outside world forgot about the Yun Race. Only then did they appear again.
The Meteor Race was very smart and knew how to learn advanced powers. They spent many years successfully taking root in the Seven Islands area and planted many spies. It was hard to say if Bai Chuan was lucky or unlucky to have been chosen by them.
Because in Bai Chuan’s understanding, everything he had today was given to him by the Yun race. The Yun race treated him better than most humans did. Compared to the teachers in school, he trusted his master more.
Slowly, his dream was also a dream to strengthen the Yun Race, revive the king of the Yun Race, Yun An, and change this rotten world.
“So it wasn’t the leader of the Ke Yuan Financial Group who betrayed the country, but the Yun race that cultivated the Ke Yuan Financial Group on the Seven Islands…”
Shi Yu was speechless. He knew it. Why would a legend level Beast Tamer in charge of a super large financial group take things too hard and rely on the totem clans? So he was originally cultivated by the totem clans. That was fine.
In the end, it was still the Seven Islands School’s fault.
The Yun Race undoubtedly took a fancy to Bai Chuan’s talent.
For a life form at the demigod level, it was not difficult to change the aptitude of its subordinates and create tailored subordinates.
Emperor Shi could tailor-make skills for the frost dragon, and Yun An could use its own strength to personally modify the Yun clan. Even Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Ling in Shi Yu’s team had created mechanical phantom beasts.
In Bai Chuan’s memories, Yun An’s power was very domineering. Not every race was qualified to become a member of the Yun Race. Therefore, the purpose of the Yun Race nurturing Bai Chuan was obvious. They hoped that he could learn biological modification technology to increase the success rate of ordinary creatures transforming into the Yun Race to strengthen the power of the Yun Race.
The body control talent was undoubtedly born for this.
As for Bai Chuan, he was also very talented. From a professional, to a master, and to a legend. He grew all the way and established a research team and a company. With the support of the Yun clan, he grew bigger and bigger. In the end, he didn’t disappoint and mastered his technology. Even the totem poison dragon that entered the sea area of Dragon Palace City was modified by Bai Chuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
However, unfortunately, no one expected that an accident would happen in the modification experiment this time, allowing the sleeping Poison Dragon to escape. It even mutated into totem level during the escape, attracting the attention of Dragon Palace City.
It could be said that it was from this accident that the Yun clan began to gradually withdraw their factions on the Seven Islands. They were worried that they would be exposed because of this and be targeted by the higher-ups of the Seven Islands.
Before Yun An revived, no matter how strong the Yun clan was, it couldn’t be a match for the Seven Islands.
“It’s actually a lab accident,” Shi Yu complained weakly.
Shi Yu knew everything that happened after that. Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang had attacked the Seven Islands because of the Poison Dragon Totem. The Ke Yuan Financial Group was indeed as the Yun clan had expected, completely exposed. Fortunately, the Yun clan had already completed the transfer of core assets.
These memories were not too important. What concerned Shi Yu the most was that Legend Bai Chuan’s memories provided two key clues!
The king of the Yun Race, Yun An, was about to revive!
The current headquarters of the Yun Race was mainly in three mystic realms!
Now, the Yun race had a total of three totems. One of them was a top-notch totem, while the other two were ordinary totems. The Black Goat was one of the ordinary totems.
And this top-notch totem, like the Black Meteorite Yak, was a totem from the Emperor Wu era. It was personally modified by Yun An.
After being nurtured, this Bai Chuan was already one of the core upper echelons of the Yun race below the three totems.
“F*ck…” At this moment, Shi Yu was both excited and nervous.
If it were a Beast Tamer from the Emperor Wu Era who heard that Yun An was about to revive, they would definitely tremble in fear.
But now, when Yun An was regarded as a “Iron-eating Beast evolution resource”, did it mean that he could take the initiative to attack??
Although he had already obtained ten meteorite fragments from Senior Ji Mengzhu, who would complain about having too many of them?
However, the difficulty was that although Bai Chuan was already a core figure of the Yun clan who also knew the locations of the three Yun clan mystic realms, he didn’t know where Yun An would revive.
In Bai Chuan’s impression, only the top-notch totem personally modified by Yun An knew this.
Shi Yu fell silent. Therefore, Dong Huang’s next strategic goal should be confirmed. It was to use this information to destroy the three mystic realms of the Yun clan first.
If possible, it was best to learn the revival location of Yun An from that top-notch totem.
“Next, what I have to do is organize the memories of Bai Chuan’s undead form into memory crystals.”
“I’ll hand its undead and memory crystals to Dong Huang. Then, wait for the national machine to activate and wait for the resources to be transferred to the account at home.” Shi Yu immediately knew his position in this segment.
As for personally going to the Yun Family mystic realm to raid the bases? Capture Yun An? Forget it, even if there was a big boss leading the team, he wasn’t interested. He felt that it was a little dangerous.
It was already his limit to bully the weakest totem country, the Heavenly Fox Nation. No, who said that the Fox God was weak? Who said that the Fox God was only comparable to the gem cat? The Fox God was clearly a top-notch totem that pretended to be a lamb to eat a tiger!
It was true that they were a little cowardly like the gem cat, but they were definitely not weak. If they faced the fox god head-on, they might have been dead by now.
It seemed to be what President Lin said…
As he organized Bai Chuan’s memories, Shi Yu also organized his experience in using the “body control” talent.
This talent had many uses. For example, it could be used to assist in modifying creatures. The effect was very good, such as helping pets better control skills and special energy. The effect was also very good. It could also train one’s physique and mental strength through physical control. Bai Chuan had developed various skills.
Among them, the most attractive and useful thing for Shi Yu was to control his physical strength through the “body control” talent.
Shi Yu was nervous. He only had one Talent Bead. It could be said that he had bet all his assets on this “body control” talent. If it couldn’t help him develop the “telepathy” talent to a very powerful level, it would be a huge loss.
….
While Shi Yu was busy receiving information, Legend Ke and the others also began to chat freely.
They surrounded Senior Ji Mengzhu.
This was the living history of ancient people from 2000 years ago!!
If they asked her, they would definitely know a lot about the Emperor Wu Dynasty!
Even Shi Yu thought so. Although he didn’t obtain other inscription metals from Ji Mengzhu, he should be able to understand what skills those metals could bring, right?
However, Shi Yu was not in a hurry to ask. There was plenty of time later. He would let Ji Mengzhu, Legend Ke, and the others talk freely first, while he was in charge of more important information.
After all, this was the key to him joining the tenth bureau’s Intelligence Bureau!!
As they chatted, Qu Ling and Ji Mengzhu had some understanding of Dong Huang’s current situation. They understood Dong Huang’s current situation through Shi Yu.
At the moment, Dong Huang in the Seven Nation Alliance was preparing for the World Tournament, and the contestants of the World Tournament were selected through the Sequence method. Among them, Shi Yu was fifth in the Sequence, the number one person below the legendary level, and Ji Feng was seventh in the Sequence.
Ji Mengzhu even understood Shi Yu’s terrifying achievements.
He was born from a grassroots family. In the first year of becoming a Beast Tamer, he successfully cracked the ancient ruins and obtained the top scholar of the Ancient Capital vocation assessment, with his results suppressing those of a legend’s child.
Later on, he even discovered the lost Iron-eating Beast evolution path, cultivated overlord species pets, and developed the Green Silkworm cocoon evolution system that benefited the country and the people!

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
National champion, mechanical phantom beast, fighting Kong Emperor’s secondary pet, and the number one person below the legendary level. Shi Yu’s achievements stunned Ji Mengzhu and Qu Ling.
After all, all of this happened in two years.
Qu Ling finally knew why she had never heard of Shi Yu before she came to be a spy. This was because Shi Yu’s legend path had only taken two years!!
“Shi Yu… genius archeologist discovered the lost iron-eating beast’s evolution path…” At this moment, Senior Ji Mengzhu had a strange expression.
Shi Yu’s growth experience undoubtedly shocked her. This kind of growth experience could even be said to be legendary.
However, what concerned her the most at this moment was if Shi Yu had bragged about himself in third person when he was using the old man persona to communicate with her.
At this moment, Qu Ling and the others also learned more about Ji Mengzhu’s identity.
Ji Mengzhu’s ancestors had cultivated Iron-eating Beasts for generations. Among them, Ji Mengzhu’s father was even the number one general under Emperor Wu, the strongest expert of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe. As for Ji Mengzhu and her mother, they were both legendary feeders in charge of the feeding of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast Corps.
It could be said that Ji Mengzhu’s father was a figure like Emperor Wu’s right-hand man. He was a brother and comrade who had gone through life and death together.
Therefore, Ji Mengzhu knew a lot of information about “Uncle Emperor Wu”.
“Cat, how long until we reach Dong Huang…”
As everyone was chatting, Shi Yu suddenly ran over and asked the gem cat clone that was eating melons in the ruins.
The gem cat raised its head lazily and said, “Soon, soon.”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Accelerate, accelerate. There’s important information.”
“Yun An is about to revive. The country has to enter a battle state quickly.”
“What!” Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, Senior Ji Mengzhu’s expression changed. She said, “The Yun race is so active. I knew something was wrong. Half-god-level elemental life forms are indeed not that easy to kill…”
“We’ll deal with it when the time comes. Senior Ji, there’s no need to be so pessimistic. After the Emperor Wu Dynasty, Dong Huang has experienced too many difficulties. So be it if Yun An comes. No matter what disaster we encounter now, Dong Huang can be confident enough to deal with it,” Shi Yu said.
Almost every legendary left a lot for Dong Huang.
For example, the recent two legendaries, the pile of pets left behind by Lin Feng, were all at the totem level, the guardians of Dong Huang.
The pile of forbidden weapons left behind by the mechanical legendary was Dong Huang’s greatest capital at the moment.
In the distant future, in the era of the Dragon Emperor, the friendship left behind by the Dragon Emperor with Dragon Palace City still affected Dong Huang. It was the key factor in Dong Huang’s overall strength as the strongest country.
Generations of Beast Tamers had left behind a lot of things. Compared to the era of Emperor Wu, the current Dong Huang had already accumulated an additional 2,000 years of heritage. Even when facing a totem king like Yun An, it wouldn’t be as desperate as in ancient times.
If one wanted the current Dong Huang to be in turmoil, one might have to wait for a mythical threat to descend.
“Can I do something?” Ji Mengzhu said. “As the spirit of the ruins, in my awakened state, it’s not a problem for my spiritual body to be active for another few decades. Is there anything I can help with?”
“That’s easy. Senior Ji, after you return to Dong Huang, why don’t you still do your old job and nurture iron-eating beasts?” Shi Yu smiled.
The others also nodded. Yes, Ji Mengzhu was a legendary feeder who nurtured the Iron-eating Beast Corps for Emperor Wu, and the Iron-eating Beast Corps could now be confirmed to be the strongest army of Emperor Wu Dynasty.
In fact, Ji Mengzhu had even told everyone just now that her father was in charge of leading the Iron-eating Beast Corps and even had a battle record of killing totems!
If such an army revived in the modern era, it would definitely increase Dong Huang’s strength greatly.
“Alright.” Ji Mengzhu nodded. Indeed, this was the most suitable for her.
She said, “Leave the 108 Iron-eating Beasts just now to me to nurture.”
Previously, the gem cat and Shi Yu had brought in a total of 108 Iron-eating Beasts.
There weren’t many, but there were also quite a lot.
The batch Ji Mengzhu and the others brought out to escape should be “elite”.
Each of them had reached Perfect Level Hardening Proficiency.
They should have received very careful cultivation very early on and was only a step away from evolution.
If they continued to nurture it, they could pull up a Nine Li Army the size of a hundred bears in a very short period of time.
“No problem.” Shi Yu smiled. At that time, be it Senior Ji or this group of Iron-eating Beasts, they had to be pulled into the Iron-eating Beast Corps under his command!
“Senior Ji, is Yun An very strong? Have you seen Yun An?” At this moment, Qu Ling looked at Ji Mengzhu.
She was also very concerned about Yun An. After all, ever since Shi Yu came out of Emperor Wu Ruins, Qu Ling had an additional mission, which was to investigate Yun An’s information in the totem country.
“Very strong.” Ji Mengzhu looked at her.
“Yun An has mastered a ‘quasi-divine skill’, which can also be said to be a ‘prototype divine skill’. No one can defeat him at all…”
“Lord Emperor Wu contracted a total of nine totem-level pets. Some of the pets even reached top-notch totem battle power.”
“And Lord Emperor Wu’s top-notch Fusion Talent can allow him to inherit the merits of the nine pets alone. Even so… After several years of battle, the first to not be able to hold on was Lord Emperor Wu. In many battles, Yun An relied on his racial advantage to survive, but Lord Emperor Wu was one step ahead of his pets and couldn’t hold on anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (4)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“This is all because of the ‘quasi-divine skill’ mastered by Yun An.”
Ji Mengzhu told Legend Ke and the others about the situation in disappointment.
“Yes, I heard it from Senior Zhong Xuan,” Shi Yu said.
“Can’t Senior Emperor Wu fuse with the nine totems?” Ji Feng’s expression was solemn.
Ji Mengzhu shook her head and said, “Although Lord Emperor Wu can mobilize the power of multiple totems to suppress Yun An through his top-notch Fusion Talent, in the face of a quasi-divine skill, he won’t be able to gain much advantage after battle.”
“The quasi-divine skill has already come into contact with the power of the natural order, and the damage caused by the power of the natural order, even if one were to use Mythical medicine, is very difficult to heal if the attributes don’t match.”
“Yun An’s skill brings with it an incurable radiation injury that cannot be cleansed.”
“Quasi-divine skill… That’s super skills cultivated to the extreme, right?” Legend Ke muttered.
Even a legend like him had actually never come into contact with this level.
After all, the only life form Dong Huang could come into contact with that had mastered the prototype of a divine skill was the Dragon God.
Apart from Shi Yu, only President Lin and the Mechanical Legendary could come into contact with the Dragon God. Even for an expert like the Tyrannical Sea Legend, it was very difficult.
Unlike Ji Mengzhu, her father had even participated in the battle with Yun An, so she knew very much about this.
“Yeah.”
“But according to Lord Emperor Wu, there are three conditions.”
“When a super skill is cultivated to the extreme, it’s just one of them.”
“Every one of these three conditions is as difficult as ascending to the heavens. Even a legendary Beast Tamer like Lord Emperor Wu will find it very difficult to achieve. This is only a quasi-divine skill, let alone that unreachable Mythical Domain and complete divine skill.”
Thinking of Emperor Wu’s lonely expression at that time, Ji Mengzhu felt very uncomfortable.
“Let me tell everyone.”
“The first is to cultivate super skills to the extreme. This difficulty is said to be ten times harder for an ordinary pet to cultivate itself to the totem level through super skills!”
Ji Feng, Qu Ling, and the others were speechless.
When super skills reached perfection, they would be at the totem level.
This difficulty stuck most of the Beast Tamers now.
There were less than ten legendary Beast Tamers on Blue Planet who could personally nurture a pet to the totem level.
And the difficulty of cultivating a quasi-divine skill was ten times higher than this?
“Senior Ji, what about the other methods?” Ji Feng couldn’t help but ask.
This was a good opportunity to broaden his horizons.
This time, he didn’t come for nothing.
Even the gem cat, a totem, couldn’t help but turn its head and listen.
“Lord Emperor Wu said that the second method is to rely on the bloodline inheritance. If the parents of a pet are a Mythical race, there’s a chance that it will have its own quasi-divine skill after birth, which is the prototype of a divine skill. As it grows and trains this skill, this skill will naturally become a ‘complete divine skill’, helping it cross to the Mythical level.”
“Therefore, a Mythical creature cub might have its own quasi-divine skill. However, if it’s already so difficult for overlords to reproduce, it should be even harder for Mythical creatures…” Ji Mengzhu said.
“Has Lord Emperor Wu seen Mythical creatures and young divine beasts??” Qu Ling said in surprise.
Ji Mengzhu shook her head. “I don’t know either, but that’s what Lord Emperor Wu said…”
“The third method is said to be a ‘combination’. Since it’s very difficult to rely on one skill to master a ‘quasi-divine skill’ and there’s not enough time to develop a skill to the extreme, one can rely on two, three, four, or even more super skills, more special power, and even the power of a Beast Tamer to form a powerful combination skill. It’s enough to touch the combination skill of the rules and optimize it to become a ‘quasi-divine skill’.”
“But in Lord Emperor Wu’s words, this isn’t necessarily easier than the first method. You need peerless talent and rely on talent to smooth out the time.”
“If it succeeds, that life form can already be called a ‘mythical race’. Like a demigod-level life form, like a divine beast cub, it has the foundation to grow to the Mythical level.”
Shi Yu said, “Can you be called a Mythical race just by mastering a quasi-divine skill?? You don’t have to master a divine skill??”
Ji Mengzhu said, “A quasi-divine skill is the prototype of a divine skill. It has the potential to grow into a complete divine skill. Apart from the skill level, divine skills also represent strength. Apart from Mythical races, life forms who have mastered a complete divine skill can already be called Mythical. And creatures who have mastered ‘quasi-divine skills’ are only Mythical races, not Mythical level.”
Qu Ling said, “Wait a minute, if the first method is to cultivate a quasi-divine skill, its battle power will definitely be at the demigod level. Then the second and third methods don’t sound like there’s a requirement for strength? It can be completed at any level?”
Ji Mengzhu smiled and said, “Probably. The second method requires a natural Mythical race. Even if it’s the son of a divine beast, there shouldn’t be a reason for it to be born at the Mythical level. Perhaps it also has to experience the growth levels of monarchs and overlords…”
“As for the third method, although it sounds like there’s hope of developing and combining quasi-divine skills at any level, it’s not that simple. Only at the totem level can transcendent life forms’ development of skills be considered initial. And if a totem-level creature cultivates a quasi-divine skill, its strength will naturally be at the demigod level.”
Ordinary totems, top-notch totems, and totem half-gods were all at the totem level. The three were not realms, but the division of battle power. Everyone instantly understood Ji Mengzhu’s meaning.
Having a quasi-divine skill was basically demigod-level battle power. And if one wanted to have a quasi-divine skill at the monarch and overlord levels, they might have to be a cub of a Mythical creature. It was very difficult to complete after birth.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (5)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
However, young people like Ji Feng and Qu Ling still had fantasies.
Although Ji Mengzhu said that there was only a small chance to develop quasi-divine skills only at the totem level, it didn’t stop them from imagining it.
If a monarch-level pet mastered a quasi-divine skill, how strong would it be?
The description would be Mythical race, monarch level.
Could it fight weaker totems two levels higher?
If not, what about Mythical race, overlord level?
There shouldn’t be a problem, right? After all, the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s Giant Leviathan wasn’t a Mythical race yet. It could already fight a totem level twice.
Quasi-divine skill, Mythical Race!
In an instant, Ji Feng’s expectations were extremely high.
However, he also understood that he could only think about it. After all, it was said that none of even Lin Feng’s pets had reached the Mythical race.
At the side, Shi Yu fell into deep thought…
“Of course, Lord Emperor Wu told my father about this. Then, my father told me. I don’t know the accuracy of this information either. After all, no one has really experienced the Mythical Domain…” Ji Mengzhu said.
“Then is there anything special about quasi-divine skills compared to super skills?” Qu Ling asked.
“Of course.”
“The strongest thing about ‘divine skills’, according to Lord Emperor Wu, is that they have already mastered ‘laws and origin power’. Among them, quasi-divine skills are the stage where they first come into contact with laws. For example, Yun An’s quasi-divine skills are known as ‘incurable injuries’ because they have reached this level. If one doesn’t master corresponding abilities of the same level, they can’t resist.”
“Actually, my father has seen the battle between Emperor Wu and Yun An. He said that that’s not a battle that other low-level life forms can interfere in at all. In the battle, Yun An, who has mastered a quasi-divine skill, forms a world of its own with phenomena around him. Any power around it is completely suppressed, including the power of nature and the power of space. This is a higher-level method than borrowing the power of nature.”
“It can be said that once a quasi-divine skill is released, it can suppress all the surrounding powers that are not of the same level. All life forms who see a quasi-divine skill will have their bloodline tremble if they don’t master the same power. It’s like… like a transcendent-level Iron-eating Beast facing the deterrence of a monarch-level royal Iron-eating Beast. It will feel like its bloodline is being suppressed.”
“This is the difference between a myth and a non-myth. It’s an insurmountable difference. Therefore, it’s really impressive that Lord Emperor Wu could suppress Yun An and even kill it,” Ji Mengzhu said.
Everyone quietly listened to Ji Mengzhu, who had personally experienced the totem battle, explain.
They understood the power of a demigod again and the power of a legendary Beast Tamer.
Even if it was such a Yun An, Emperor Wu could suppress it.
Unfortunately, Emperor Wu didn’t have the ability to remove the other party’s Law Power. Otherwise, the historical direction might be new.
At the same time, Ji Feng, Qu Ling, and the other Dong Huang geniuses were also curious. The current Dragon God, who had always been on good terms with Dong Huang, was also at the demigod level. They wondered how its strength was compared to Yun An and what kind of power it had.
According to Emperor Wu, a half-god like the Dragon God and a half-god like Yun An could be considered a Mythical race?
Shi Yu thought that they were at most experts who had evolved to the extreme of the “quasi Mythical race”.
“Well, why do I feel that Ji Mengzhu’s father isn’t very reliable? I should ask the Dragon God another day,” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
Ah, right, but the Dragon God seemed to have also said that the World Tree could be considered a Mythical race, but it wasn’t at the Mythical level. It was only the strongest demigod. In that case, it was really possible that demigods could be considered Mythical races?
However, when they thought about it, the demigods didn’t care about this racial title anymore. They were probably more concerned about when their growth level could break through to the Mythical stage, and not what the racial level represented their potential.
After a long time…
The gem cat said, “We’re at Dong Huang.”
….
After arriving at Dong Huang, no one relaxed. Next, they still had to continue working on this mission. Everyone first went to the headquarters of the tenth bureau.
As it concerned a demigod-level life form that threatened Dong Huang, Shi Yu also ran around with them. He didn’t find it troublesome, but with the cat car, it really wasn’t much trouble.
Fortunately, President Lin and the others also returned that day to preside over the overall situation. The Black Goat Totem was undoubtedly ‘captured alive’. Of course, in the current state of the Black Goat, to put it nicely, it was ‘captured alive’. To put it bluntly, it was ‘not dead’.
As for the Black Goat Totem, it naturally couldn’t be imprisoned in Dong Huang. It was directly transported to the deep sea prison of Dragon Palace City by the Sea Dragon King and the others. Only here could the totem be suppressed.
The Poison Dragon Totem was also locked here.
Dong Huang didn’t have to make payment for using the underwater prison of Dragon Palace City. As long as the Immortal Dragon King didn’t die after purification, the goat legs and lamb chop were for the dragon kings to eat as they pleased. In any case, the key was the information about the Yun race in the goat brain.
In fact, President Lin still had a lot to say to Shi Yu and Ji Mengzhu, about the Black Meteorite Yak. He wanted to ask Shi Yu how he dared to blow up a top-notch totem, even if it was weak.
However, at this moment, because he still had many more important things to deal with, he didn’t have the time to care about Shi Yu. After chatting for a while, Shi Yu was completely liberated. He brought Senior Ji Mengzhu to Wu Ling City, where the ruins of the Iron-eating Beast Corps were.
“Aren’t you going to deal with Yun An?” Seeing Shi Yu slip away from the headquarters of the Dong Huang Association without any reluctance, Senior Ji Mengzhu, who was in the ruins, said.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (6)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Shi Yu said, “Senior, I’m only a level-six Beast Tamer. I’m not even at the Legend level.”
Ji Mengzhu : “…”
So this guy still knew that he was a level-six Beast Tamer?
That wasn’t what the totem corpse lying in the ruins thought!
Shi Yu smiled bitterly, thinking that he really wasn’t free.
Although Yun An was important, it was more important to seriously add points!
Because he had heard Ji Mengzhu’s words previously, Shi Yu was even more concerned about the skill index’s [Technique Fusion] function!!
After Ji Mengzhu mentioned the three conditions of the prototype of the divine skill, Shi Yu realized that training super skills to Dao Proficiency was not the only condition to reach the prototype of a divine skill.
It could also be done by relying on multiple super skills to form a perfect combination skill?
She should have said so earlier!
[Technique Fusion] could directly fuse the two skills into one skill. Was there a more perfect combination method than this?
In other words, through [Technique Fusion], continuously fusing super skills could develop quasi-divine skills?
And a pet that had mastered a quasi-divine skill was a Mythical race. In other words, the function of [Technique Fusion] was the key to making Eleven and the others a Mythical race??
In that case, it was even more necessary to obtain the blessings of the World Tree.
Shi Yu definitely couldn’t activate super racial skills above the transcendent level. His Beast Taming level was too low, so he couldn’t support Eleven and the others to break through to the totem level. This had to be done in the level-nine Beast Taming Space. Even if he contracted above his level, it would have to be at level eight, and he was only at level six.
However, if Eleven and the others could have “quasi divine skills” at the overlord level and become “mythical races”, it didn’t seem bad? They might be able to fight totems!
Regardless of the preparation of the ancient information Ji Mengzhu mentioned, he believed it for the time being. He immediately became full of motivation.
How could he solve his worries? The only way was to increase points!
After dealing with Ji Mengzhu, Shi Yu decided to go back and start a new round of points.
Apart from that, the development of telepathy and the research of superalloy required time!
As for when he would go to Tingxiang and Rongguang to unlock the last 2/4 progress of the Space Beast Egg, he definitely had to wait for Baby Ginseng to condense another time mark and for the situation on Dong Huang’s side to stabilize. Otherwise, he would probably only have the gem cat as a bodyguard again. He didn’t feel safe.
Tingxiang and Rongguang were a little special.
If they were prepared for the worst, these two countries were even more dangerous than the eleven totem countries around Dong Huang and the Seven Islands.
In the east, due to the powerful strength of Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City, there were currently no demigod-level factions on land and in the sea, but for other countries, there were actually demigod-level factions eyeing them covetously…
In the Dark Night Forest outside Tingxiang, there was a demigod-level Dark Elven Empress who had always been at odds with the mixed-blood Elven Empress of Tingxiang.
The Demon Kingdom outside Rongguang was the greatest enemy of Rongguang. Both parties were in small-scale battles all year round. The leader of the Demon Kingdom was also a demigod.
The Dragon Empire in the west, the snow land in the north… There were demigod-level lives, even the Abyss Sea and the endless sea territory…
It could be said that if it weren’t for the fact that there were still so many demigod-level factions outside the seven countries, the seven countries with Mechanic advantages would have long swept through the world.
From this point, the Seven Islands were actually considered lucky. Their geographical location was not bad. Because of the existence of Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang, there were no powerful demigod-level totem factions eyeing them covetously…
“Senior, does this place feel familiar?”
Shi Yu stood on the tall building and asked Ji Mengzhu.
Ji Mengzhu said, “I’m no longer familiar with it. 2000 years have already passed. Everything has changed. The world has changed. I’m afraid I still have to adapt to the current Dong Huang for a long time.”
“Be it buildings, transport, or culture…”
Shi Yu smiled. “There’s plenty of time. The Iron-eating Beast Ruins where Zhong Xuan is is located is here. By the way, I still have someone to introduce to you…”
“Huh??” Upon hearing that Shi Yu had brought her to the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ training ruins, Ji Mengzhu’s expression was filled with anticipation. However, Ji Mengzhu was a little puzzled about the people Shi Yu had always said he wanted to introduce to her.
She didn’t understand why this kid was so excited.
Who was it?
Could it be that Zhong Xuan wasn’t dead yet?
Ji Mengzhu kept guessing.
….
In the ruins of Wu Ling City.
At the moment, this place had already been used as the training venue for the “Iron-eating Beast Corps”, “Green Silkworm Cocoon Corps”, and “Machinery Beast Corps”. As the New Army Tournament approached, these armies trained even harder in order to fight for military funds.
“You are…” At the entrance of the ruins in Wu Ling City, the expression of the Beast Tamer in charge of guarding the door changed when he saw Shi Yu. Shi Yu smiled, indicating that there was no need to make a fuss. After showing his identification, he directly entered the ruins.
After he entered the ruins, Ji Mengzhu’s figure immediately appeared beside him.
“As expected, it’s still the same,” Ji Mengzhu said happily. “I have good news for you.”
Shi Yu was stunned for a moment before saying, “What good news?”
“Wait, Senior Ji, why did you come out of the sealed ruins??”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. Wasn’t Ji Mengzhu the spirit of the ruins in the legendary ruins? Previously, she had sensed the outside world in the ruins, so why…
Ji Mengzhu said, “This is the good news I want to talk about. Didn’t I tell you before that I participated in the modification of this ruin?”
“Yeah.”
“My authority over the ruins is still there. Give me some time. I can also become the spirit of the ruins in this ruin. Didn’t you say that the Iron-eating Beast Corps is currently training here? After I become the spirit of the ruins in this ruin, I can better control those training facilities.”

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Lin Xiuzhu’s Portable Grandma (7)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Ji Mengzhu looked at Shi Yu and said, “After completing the transfer, I’ll give you the legendary ruins I’m staying in now. Although there’s no sealing effect, as a spatial equipment, it’s not bad as a cultivation place.”
“You should encounter a lot of danger in the future. It’s safer to bring such a high-level ruin. This is a treasure left to me by my father. I’ll leave the rest to you.”
“It’s also to thank you for dealing with the Black Meteorite Yak.”
Shi Yu was stunned. Although he had always wanted a legendary ruin, Ji Mengzhu’s sealed ruin as the spirit of the ruin clearly wasn’t suitable to carry with him because of its spirit, but now, the other party actually said that the she could transfer it? Moreover, the legendary ruin could be given to him?
“This isn’t appropriate, right…” However, Shi Yu was still relatively shy.
Such a precious thing…
However, afraid that Senior Ji would regret it, Shi Yu said again, “Since it’s Senior’s good intentions, I’ll accept it respectfully…”
After all, the gem cat seemed to like this ruin quite a lot. There would be more safety guarantees in the future!
Ji Mengzhu : “…”
Shi Yu was excited. Although the legendary ruins no longer had any special sealing effect, compared to the high-level ruin that Senior Lu had cracked, which he was using now, it was clearly better.
However, he had just moved less than two months ago and he had to move again. It was so tiring.
He decided to forget it and just move.
But in that case, he seemed to have four ruins… There seemed to be too many. It was useless to have so many. He would hand two over later and return the ruins stone to Senior Ji!
“Alright, who did you say you were bringing me to see?”
Shi Yu said, “Don’t worry, Buggy, Instant Transmission.”
“Looking for Eleven’s big sister.”
Shi Yu directly summoned Buggy.
“Wu…”
Even the number one in the team couldn’t escape the fate of the tool worm.
….
Iron-eating Beast Corps camp.
