The chief feeder, Lin Xiuzhu, had not even left the ruins for a long time. If there was nothing else, her food, drink, and accommodation were basically completed in the ruins.
Shi Yu had given her so many resources. She couldn’t disappoint Shi Yu’s expectations no matter what. She had to nurture the Iron-eating Beast Corps into the strongest army!
In the room, Lin Xiuzhu was doing the cultivation plan of the Iron-eating Beast Corps. She had the data of every Iron-eating Beast Tamer in the Iron-eating Beast Corps…
Knock, knock, knock.
“Please come in,” Lin Xiuzhu said and looked out the door. With a look, her expression was slightly stunned. She saw a woman who looked even more like her than her mother walk in and look at her.
To be honest, Lin Xiuzhu had lived for so long. Even when Shi Yu and Eleven created miracles in succession, she had never been so stunned.
Similarly, Ji Mengzhu, who had been instigated by Shi Yu, also saw this girl and fell silent for a moment.
Obviously…
The two of them realized that the other party looked very much like them…
“Haha.” Just as the two of them were very stunned, Shi Yu laughed and followed Buggy in.
At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu, Lin Xiuzhu, who was wearing a black and white military uniform, was stunned. She kept looking at Shi Yu, Buggy, and the mature woman version of herself and finally discovered the problem. Then, she revealed an angry blush and said, “Shi Yu, you’re too much. Hurry up and get Buggy to remove the illusion.”
Lin Xiuzhu quickly realized that this mature version of “herself” didn’t look like a real person.
After seeing Shi Yu and Buggy, he directly determined that Shi Yu had made Buggy use illusions.
“Wait, wait.” Shi Yu was also stunned. He understood that Senior Panda must have misunderstood something. He hurriedly said, “What does it have to do with Buggy?”
“Wu!!” Buggy also felt very innocent.
Ji Mengzhu looked at Lin Xiuzhu and smiled. She gradually understood and said, “Little girl, does your family have a family tree record?”
Lin Xiuzhu: “?”
Shi Yu said, “Senior, Senior Ji was a legendary feeder during the era of Emperor Wu Dynasty 2000 years ago. At that time, she was also in charge of the feeding of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast Corps…”
“You think I’m very similar to this little girl, so you think she’s a descendant of my race, right?” Ji Mengzhu said. “I do feel a bloodline connection. Interesting…”
Lin Xiuzhu: ???
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu was a little panicked. The pen in her hand remained in midair. What, what…

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - The Hopeful Panda Senior
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: The Hopeful Panda Senior
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
“That’s what happened…”
After arriving at Senior Panda’s office, Shi Yu pulled out a chair and sat opposite her, explaining the mission experience to her.
For things like fighting the Fox God, blowing up totems, and catching legends, Shi Yu chose to omit them, afraid that he would scare Senior Panda.
He mainly explained Senior Ji Mengzhu’s background to Senior Panda.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Lin Xiuzhu’s entire face was still stunned. On the other hand, Ji Mengzhu quickly accepted this setting. She looked at the various iron-eating beast related models, ink paintings, and felt very emotional.
Although two thousand years had passed, the Iron-eating Beast Tribe still didn’t separate from the Iron-eating Beast. Very good.
It seemed that the other clansmen who hid from the war were very lucky to have passed it down.
“You, you, in that case, are you really my ancestor?”
At this moment, Lin Xiuzhu felt that it was ridiculous.
She knew that Shi Yu was very powerful.
Even if Shi Yu cracked some Mythical Ruins one day, Lin Xiuzhu would not be surprised at all.
However, Shi Yu actually ran over and said that he would get an ancestor for herself. This kind of thing… would stun anyone!
Before Shi Yu explained, she almost thought that Shi Yu had gone to dig up the Lin family’s ancestral grave.
But speaking of which, her ancestor was actually the Iron-eating Beast General under Emperor Wu?!
Titled legend expert?
During the era of Emperor Wu Dynasty, he was a Beast Tamer whose strength was only inferior to Emperor Wu?
Senior Panda couldn’t believe it.
According to Lin Xiuzhu’s understanding of Shi Yu, the other party shouldn’t lie to her.
She imagined that Shi Yu might have wronged Shi Yu for letting Buggy transform into a mature version of herself to tease her…
“Perhaps.”
Ji Mengzhu was very happy at this moment. She didn’t expect to see a descendant of her own race apart from the Iron-eating Beast. She looked at Lin Xiuzhu and said, “But it’s not important anymore.”
“I heard from Shi Yu that your name is Lin Xiuzhu, right?”
“Yes, Senior Ji.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded hard.
“How old are you? What’s your Beast Taming level? What’s the Iron-eating Beast’s level?”
Lin Xiuzhu said in embarrassment, “25 years old, Beast Tamer level 5, Iron-eating Beast… It’s still commander rank at the moment.”
It was indeed a little low…
At the thought that her ancestor was the number one general under Emperor Wu, and had to see her family had become like this, Senior Panda was a little nervous.
“Sigh.” After hearing that, Ji Mengzhu sighed slightly. She had already expected this situation just now.
What she learned was that the iron-eating beast only rose after Shi Yu discovered the iron-eating beast’s evolution path two years ago.
During this period, the Iron-eating Beasts were only ordinary middle-level transcendent races that had only mastered hardening.
Although the Iron-eating Beast race wasn’t completely extinct, the inheritance was almost broken.
In this situation, the descendants of the Iron-eating Beast Clan’s Beast Tamer wouldn’t be too strong if they were in charge of pets of a transcendent race.
She looked at Shi Yu and could imagine that it was all thanks to Shi Yu that Lin Xiuzhu and even the Iron-eating Beast could have such a status in Dong Huang.
“It’s not too late at 25.” She looked at Lin Xiuzhu and said, “From today onwards, I’ll guide your cultivation and guide you in cultivating iron-eating beasts. In the next period of time, I’ll teach you all my experience.”
Lin Xiuzhu was slightly stunned.
“Do you want to guide me in cultivation? But I’m very stupid…”
Shi Yu was speechless. If she was stupid, how would others survive?
Senior Panda was talented. If not for Shi Yu, Senior Panda would be the number one genius in Ping Cheng.
Ever since she became a Beast Tamer, Senior Panda had displayed pretty good talent. However, in order to study the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast, she didn’t put her mind on increasing her strength.
But even so, it was already extraordinary to be able to become a master at this age. Moreover, Lin Xiuzhu’s cultivation talent was also maxed out. Not only did she develop the “Giant Transformation Teaching Manual” that allowed the Iron-eating Beast to master the Giant Transformation before it evolved, but she also developed the nurturing technique to increase the Iron-eating Beast’s hardening proficiency. It could be said that she was much stronger than Hall Master Lin Hongnian.
After all, Lin Hongnian had only developed Thunder Palm and Cannon Fist… How could she say that she didn’t have talent?
“No, you’re very talented.”
A cultivation form written by Senior Panda appeared in Ji Mengzhu’s hand at some point in time. She smiled and said, “Next, I’ll do my best to let you become a legend level Beast Tamer before the age of 30.”
“Legend?!” Lin Xiuzhu was shocked.
Even Shi Yu, who was beside him, revealed a stunned expression. Wait, she wasn’t kidding, right?
He felt that this Senior Ji thought more highly of Senior Panda than him.
Legends under the age of 30 could be counted on one hand even in Dong Huang…
It could no longer be described as a genius.
Ji Mengzhu said, “There’s nothing impossible.”
She said, “Although the person beside you is very outstanding, don’t underestimate me. I personally helped choose Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast. Even the growth plan of that Iron-eating Beast to become Emperor Wu’s strongest pet was made by me.”
“Do you believe me?”
Lin Xiuzhu’s face was red. She suddenly felt that this ancestor grandma, ah, no, this ancestor big sis, was a good person. If she could become stronger, who wouldn’t be willing?
“Wait, Senior Ji, if you teach me, what about Shi Yu… Can you help him formulate the growth plan of the Iron-eating Beast like how you helped Emperor Wu? His Eleven’s talent is also very good.” Lin Xiuzhu immediately remembered Shi Yu and Eleven.
“Uh.” Ji Mengzhu was silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - The Hopeful Panda Senior (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: The Hopeful Panda Senior (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Little girl, why mention that?
If possible, didn’t she want to?
But the problem was that she only took a look at Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast and could tell that the cultivation level of that Iron-eating Beast was even higher than Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast…
How could she teach anything?
Moreover, when she thought of how Shi Yu could even nurture a monarch-level ginseng baby to destroy totems two levels higher, Ji Mengzhu felt that she was even more unqualified to teach Shi Yu.
She even suspected that that ginseng baby was a Mythical race…
After thinking about it, she still felt that it was easier to impart all her knowledge to Lin Xiuzhu, a little girl who looked very much like her.
“I can’t teach him. His Iron-eating Beast is already more outstanding than Lord Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast at the same level.” Ji Mengzhu shook her head.
“Uh.” Lin Xiuzhu was stunned. She opened her mouth slightly and turned to look at Shi Yu.
This was because Shi Yu was a pioneer in the field of Iron-eating Beast cultivation. Although Lin Xiuzhu and the others knew that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast was strong, very strong, so strong that it had evolved several times, they still didn’t have an accurate concept of how strong Eleven was.
According to Shi Yu’s archeological discoveries, the Iron-eating Beast was even the trump card of the legendary Beast Tamer Emperor Wu!
Then Lin Xiuzhu and the others naturally thought that Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast should be the strongest Iron-eating Beast.
After all, that was a legendary level Beast Tamer, not even just a mere legend level.
However, this was the first time Lin Xiuzhu had heard that Eleven was even stronger than Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast at the same level. Moreover, these words came from the feeder who cultivated Iron-eating Beasts for Emperor Wu…
Instantly, Senior Panda was rather shocked. Lin Xiuzhu looked at Shi Yu in confusion. Wait a minute, wasn’t it a little ridiculous for him to be stronger than a Emperor Wu trump card of the same level…
It was fine if they defeated the Space Emperor’s secondary pet, but why was he now being compared with the legendary Beast Tamer’s trump card…
“Is that so?” Shi Yu also scratched his cheek innocently. Was he that powerful? That made sense. After all, even if it was Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, it couldn’t maximize all the racial skills such as Giant Transformation, Deterrence, and Impregnable at the monarch level…
Of course, apart from these, there was also a pile of body forging skills… Even the Overlord Body Armor and the Undying Golden Body…
“By the way, Senior Lin, your Iron-eating Beast hasn’t evolved yet, right? You can let Senior Ji plan it,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, yes.” Lin Xiuzhu nodded.
Ji Mengzhu also nodded and said, “In that case, I’ll carry out the transfer first. It’ll take about a day.”
Ji Mengzhu wanted to move from the legendary ruins to the Wu Ling Ruins. Shi Yu naturally had to wait for this day.
After all, they were still waiting to take over the legendary ruins.
“During this period, bring me to see the Iron-eating Beast Corps in the ruins and receive a new batch of Iron-eating Beasts.” Ji Mengzhu looked at Lin Xiuzhu and smiled.
“Alright!” Lin Xiuzhu was full of motivation.
At the same time, he said, “Shi Yu, you should come too.”
“Forget it.” Shi Yu hurriedly rejected.
Compared to seeing how his three armies were doing, he still wanted to study the Control Talent Bead as soon as possible!
In the face of Senior Panda’s invitation, he decisively took the memory crystal of Legend Bai Chuan’s experience in using the Beast Taming Talent and ran to develop the telepathy talent.
Apart from that, Ling also held the memory crystal of Legend Bai Chuan regarding biological modification technology and continued to study the “tenth inscription” in detail.
Eleven naturally cooperated with Ling.
The other pets were also busy.
Baby Ginseng had just evolved and was very smug, but it was quickly arranged by Shi Yu to study the “Phoenix Fruit”.
Now that Baby Ginseng had fire-element, the difficulty of researching the Phoenix Fruit should have decreased a little. This was the key to joining the mixed-blood bureau!
As for Buggy, it was using the worm silk and phantom illusion to modify the corpses of the three overlords and the Black Meteorite Yak as puppets!
However, looking at the totem-level corpse, Buggy felt that it was boring.
It felt that even if it was repaired, it would only be so-so. After all, Baby Ginseng was the one who blew it up.
It was better to go to Baby Ginseng and replicate a dream illusion. Then, it would imitate and would condense a Baby Ginseng illusion every day and store it in its spatial pocket.
Although the self-destruction power of Baby Ginseng’s phantom was worlds apart from Baby Ginseng’s main body…
However, if the power was not enough, could it be made up with numbers?
It seemed feasible to save 600 billion ginseng baby phantoms and let them line up to self-destruct?
However, the greatest problem was that the maintenance of the “forbidden ginseng baby weapon” also required a lot of energy. Buggy didn’t have time to maintain so many “trump cards” at all times. This was so difficult to solve…
After thinking about it, Buggy could only helplessly look at the totem corpse again.
Chi Tong was staring at its three overlord undead. The more it looked at them, the more it disliked them.
Their battle results were too lousy.
Ever since it controlled these three undead, they had never had a good battle result.
Apart from pulling the corpse, there didn’t seem to be any other use.
Chi Tong was thinking about when to kill them and change to a powerful new undead.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t allow it. After all, if it killed them, the proficiency of the Spirit Release skill would definitely directly reach perfect level, allowing Chi Tong to break through to the overlord level.
Obviously, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t let Chi Tong be the first to break through.
Skill proficiency, legendary resources, and overlord will. This was the threshold to break through in Shi Yu’s team.
Apart from the proficiency points to be added, only Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Susu had the corresponding conditions to reach these thresholds.
Among them, Shi Yu was not in a hurry to let Baby Ginseng and Susu break through because they could use the Time Fruit to reach the overlord level at any time. The impact of breaking through was not very big.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - The Hopeful Panda Senior (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: The Hopeful Panda Senior (3)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
Therefore, the most suitable to break through was undoubtedly Eleven, who wasn’t very compatible with the Time Fruit. At the monarch level, Eleven could defeat Baby Ginseng and Susu, who had used the Time Fruit. After breaking through to the overlord level, it would definitely be stronger.
Apart from that, it was also to take care of the initial pet and the most hardworking Eleven in the team.
….
The pets were busy with their own things. Even the Tyrant Dragon and the Duckbill Beast were training themselves crazily. It had been two months, but they still couldn’t defeat the transcendent-level Green Silkworm!!
They were very hateful.
< Name > Green Silkworm Phantom
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Skill]: Worm Silk (Dao Proficiency), Absolute Sleep (Expert), Illusory Phantom (Perfect), Deterrence (Proficient), Super Sight (Expert), High Speed Healing (Proficient), Space Shackles (Perfect), Instant Transmission (Expert), Concealment (Expert)
[Energy Points]: 4399
Of course, this was also related to the skill proficiency and skill accompanying moves of the transcendent-level worm. It was indeed too ridiculous…
Shi Yu also closed his eyes and cultivated.
He held the “Control Talent Bead”.
Just like the “Awakening Mirror”, when Shi Yu used this “Control Talent Bead”, it consumed physical strength.
The difference was that the awakening talent level contained in the Awakening Mirror was very low. It could only awaken creatures of transcendent races, so it didn’t consume much physical strength at all.
As for the “Control Talent Bead”, Shi Yu had plundered it from the legend Beast Tamer. The other party’s development of this talent had already reached a very high level, so when Shi Yu used it, it consumed a lot of physical strength.
The talent level plundered depended on the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming level and development level!
However, considering that the Yue Maiden was only at the legendary level herself, the toy she created shouldn’t be able to plunder the talent of a legendary Beast Tamer. She probably had to do it herself.
The talent of a level-seven and level-eight Beast Tamer might be the limit of the plundering of this bead.
A level-seven Beast Taming Talent. If other level-six Beast Tamers used this Beast Taming Talent, they would probably instantly squeeze the other party dry.
However, Shi Yu really didn’t feel any pressure when using it. Soon, half an hour passed.
As he didn’t have anyone to compare him to, Shi Yu didn’t know if he was a genius.
He opened his eyes, and blue spiritual waves spread in his eyes. In the next moment, the rock in front of him was directly controlled by his spiritual power to float. Then, it was crushed with a bang!!
Stone fragments flew!
In just half an hour, he used Bai Chuan’s development experience to develop the use of spiritual power with the “Talent Control Bead”.
In terms of power, it wasn’t very strong. It was only used to deal with commander-level pets.
His mental strength level was still inferior to his physique level.
Combat Department Shi Yu… Evolution… Combat Department, Spirit Department Shi Yu!
It was another icing on the cake, a dispensable skill+1.
It could be used to turn on the lights and get drinks.
After learning Psychic power, Shi Yu put down the Talent Bead again. Unfortunately, after leaving the Talent Bead, he couldn’t use Psychic power anymore. His control over his body was immediately much weaker.
However, Shi Yu could sense that as long as he trained hard and constantly let his body become proficient in this use experience, he would sooner or later leave the Talent Control Bead and could easily use Psychic power.
“Wait, I’ve also learned Psychic power now. Even if I can’t use the skill index to add points, can I increase the experience of using Psychic power through the Psychic Memory Water??” Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
He felt that if he could master Dao Proficiency Psychic power, even if the telepathy development didn’t succeed, it didn’t seem to be a loss?
No, no, no… He was no longer a child. He should want all of them!
“Speaking of which…” Shi Yu looked at the Talent Control Bead and was already completely certain that this was a good thing.
This talent was not wrong.
This Control Talent Bead could completely be passed down as a family heirloom and sect treasure.
What Beast Tamers lacked was the ability to control their strength, and the Legendary-level Talent Control Bead completely made up for this flaw.
If he successfully developed his telepathy talent through this Control Talent Bead and made his telepathy stronger, could others, such as Senior Lu, use this Control Talent Bead to imitate him and develop his talent?
If Emperor Shi could create a special time meditation technique for others to learn, and the Iron-eating Beast General could develop a massage technique to strengthen the metal-element talent to help the Iron-eating Beast become stronger, then he, Shi Yu, could definitely open up a new mental school.
Create a new spiritual talent usage that was different from an “archeologist”!
Shi Yu suddenly had the thought of becoming a master and felt that it was quite interesting.
Just like creating the Green Silkworm cocoon system and the mechanical phantom beast system, it was very interesting.
If the future Beast Tamer with the gift of telepathy in Dong Huang had battle power stronger than a strengthening-type Beast Tamer, that would be awesome.
At that time, the telepathy talent could wash away the humiliation of the “weakest battle power talent”.
Perhaps… it wasn’t limited to the telepathy talent.
For example, was it possible for the beast-eared girl to use the Control Talent Bead to develop the Fusion Talent so that her body could fuse with multiple pets at the same time like Emperor Wu? In that case, it would be awesome.
“Cultivate! Cultivate!” However, the most important thing now was to quickly develop his talent and prove the feasibility of all of this.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - Creating a Super Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Creating a Super Sect
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
The next day, Ji Mengzhu successfully transferred and became the spirit of the iron-eating beast ruins.
After the transfer was successful, she gave the legendary ruins to Shi Yu according to the agreement.
As for Shi Yu, he returned the other party’s ruins stone.
Although that was the case, Senior Ji would probably leave it to Senior Panda. After all, she didn’t need spatial equipment as a ruin spirit.
Among them, there was also a large number of iron-eating beast evolution resources. Shi Yu had no use for them, but it was suitable to nurture the iron-eating beast army.
As for the ten meteorite fragments, Shi Yu took them away first and strengthened them in the rest of the Spirit Accumulation Jade. He gave Eleven priority for the evolution resource to avoid insufficient resources.
Shi Yu estimated that there would be some left in the end. If he used the rest and sent it back to the Iron-eating Beast Corps, he would try to save two pieces for his senior!
The best situation was that Dong Huang could catch Yun An as soon as possible. Even if they couldn’t, blowing up a leg was enough for a bunch of Iron-eating Beasts to evolve into second stages.
However, ordinary Iron-eating Beasts didn’t have an overlord level will. If their willpower didn’t reach above medium level, it would probably be very difficult to control the power of the Demon God.
After that, Shi Yu stayed in Wu Ling City for two more days.
In the past two days, Lin Hongnian, the beast-eared girl, White Brook, and the others from the Iron-eating Beast Corps gradually learned of Ji Mengzhu’s existence. They were shocked to the extreme. They were very confused about Shi Yu digging out an ancestor.
However, once they accepted the setting, no matter who it was, they liked this ancestor from 2000 years ago very much. They asked her all kinds of questions about the Emperor Wu Dynasty. Lin Hongnian was like this, and so was the beast-eared girl. Of course, Shi Yu was no exception.
For example, he had asked about all the skills corresponding to the remaining inscriptions.
Among them, the Iron-eating Beast that evolved with the meteorite fragment could awaken a skill called “Demon God Body”.
This skill was both metal and dark element. The skill effect was simpler than Shi Yu imagined.
It was an Iron-eating Beast that could transform its body into a Demon God Body with extremely high affinity for the dark element. The Iron-eating Beast with the Demon God Body could automatically produce the power of the dark element Demon God in its body. It could mobilize the power of the Demon God to perfectly integrate into any metal-element skill and increase the effect of the skill in all aspects.
For example, it could allow the dual-element Space Quake to be upgraded to a skill of the metal, space, and dark elements!
It could allow the lightning needles of the metal and lightning elements to be introduced into the lightning in the body and upgraded to special black lightning of the dark, metal, and lightning elements.
It was similar to the effect of the Demon God form that Eleven entered with the power of the Demon God in the source of physical strength.
But if it used skills, the consumption and side effects would definitely be smaller, and the increase would be greater.
This skill was a key skill that could increase the overall strength of the Iron-eating Beast. It could allow the Iron-eating Beast to obtain a perfect second or third element.
Apart from that, the other four inscription skills also had their own characteristics, but unfortunately, there was no metal!
Even if there was metal, Shi Yu had no skill slot. The Iron-eating Beast race was really inconvenient.
Two days later, Shi Yu still decided to return to Ping Cheng.
“Aren’t you staying for longer?”
Seeing that Shi Yu was about to leave, Lin Xiuzhu said.
“No, there are other things.”
Shi Yu realized that it was easy to be distracted if he stayed here.
He stayed here and always wanted to see the situation of his three armies from time to time.
With a look, he would discover that the cultivation speed of the Beast Tamers and pets in the three armies was too slow, causing Shi Yu to panic.
In his anxiety, he wanted to help and provide some help, causing his focus to be delayed.
It was better to return to the cold icy plain to train hard. Out of sight, out of mind.
Although Senior Panda, the beast-eared girl, and Senior Ji Mengzhu could chat from time to time, there were too many external things, causing him to be unable to concentrate all his energy.
Of course, there was another reason. It was because Shi Yu had already inquired about the history of the Emperor Wu Dynasty from Senior Ji Mengzhu through two days of chatting. There was no need to stay any longer.
“Alright.”
Lin Xiuzhu said, “By the way, do you want to take a look at the military martial arts competition later?”
“This will definitely come.” Shi Yu smiled. Seeing the Panda Army defeat other soldiers, how could he not come?
Of course, he would also cheer for the Buggy Army and the phantom beast army…
“Alright.” Lin Xiuzhu also smiled excitedly. She felt that with Senior Ji’s help, there would definitely be no problem. What Green Silkworm cocoon, what mechanical phantom beast? They would all lose to the Iron-eating Beast Corps this time!
“Don’t worry and go.” At this moment, Senior Ji Mengzhu was like Lin Xiuzhu’s personal grandmother, guiding Lin Xiuzhu with all her might. She smiled and nodded at Shi Yu. She believed that the next time Shi Yu came, he would definitely be shocked by the changes in the Iron-eating Beast Corps!
….
Icefield City, Ping Cheng, Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
Perhaps it was his hometown, but Shi Yu still felt that cultivating here was the most interesting.
There was only half a year left. Shi Yu made up his mind to be serious and not slack off.
After returning to the icy plain, just like two months ago, Shi Yu called all his pets over to move again…
Then, he began his painful cultivation life.
Shi Yu had two goals for this bitter cultivation.
First, he would let Eleven’s super racial skills reach perfect level. With the help of the Aurora Magnetic Gold, it could break through and become a perfect overlord. Then, it would work hard towards evolution.
Shi Yu felt that the skill of the Demon God Body was not bad. He decided to let Eleven master it before the evolution of light and darkness. However, according to Senior Ji Mengzhu, the more meteorite fragments it swallowed, the stronger the evolution of the Demon God Body. Shi Yu decided to let Eleven devour and evolve after the overlord level. After all, the overlord level was definitely stronger than the monarch level’s devouring and digestion.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - Creating a Super Sect (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Creating a Super Sect (2)
Translator:
Atlas Studios
Editor:
Atlas Studios
In any case, the meteorite fragments were in ample supply now. There were ten of them. When the time came, he didn’t know if he could control a few fragments in one go.
Finally, he would increase the height of the superalloy and white lightning points and evolve the light and darkness through the combination of the power of the Demon God and the power of the white lightning!
If the conditions allowed, it was best to find another light-element legendary resource!
Second, prioritize adding some points to Ling’s top-notch intelligent divine net to increase its research ability again. After all, this ability concerned the progress of many researches such as superalloy, fusion mecha, and Kirin phantom beast.
Shi Yu was very familiar with adding points.
Although it was still painful every time, practice made perfect.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t look at his own will level. Otherwise, Shi Yu felt that he had to have an overlord’s will no matter what.
At that moment, Shi Yu was happy and in pain.
The happy thing was that he could actually use the Psychic memory water drop created by Buggy and Susu.
He could learn the experience of Buggy using Psychic power, the Dao Proficiency level Psychic experience!!
It was an export transfer.
From being able to use Psychic power to turn off the lights and get water, to using Psychic power to create a mental barrier defense, to controlling a stone to fire a cannonball-like attack, to using Psychic power to create a perception domain… Shi Yu’s development of mental power increased at lightning speed!!
This made his mental strength level quickly as terrifying as his physique.
Now, with the skill, although Shi Yu only had one low-level skill, with his physique, he could finally say to a monarch-level pet, “Come, one-on-one.”
Of course, it was only limited to ordinary monarchs below the level of the National League.
Letting Shi Yu challenge monarchs like Eleven and Baby Ginseng alone was definitely purely looking for trouble.
Apart from that, there was also a surprise. As his Psychic proficiency increased, the burden of adding points was much smaller.
The pain he endured when adding points was even smaller. After adding points, his recovery speed was even faster!
Physical control talent was indeed not a wrong choice!
In fact, at the transcendent level of Psychic power, Shi Yu could already leave the Talent Bead and use Psychic power on his own.
Regarding the development of mental strength, Shi Yu was undoubtedly a huge success.
However, regarding the development of soul power and telepathy talent, Shi Yu suffered every time.
In this aspect, there was no experience to reference. After all, Bai Chuan himself had only developed one transcendent ability, Psychic.
He followed his previous thoughts and used his soul power as a shell, his telepathy as a bridge, and his mental and physical energy as energy to condense a substitute to condense a Nascent Soul on his pet. He kept trying, but in the end, he undoubtedly failed.
It didn’t work at all.
As expected, cultivation was not that easy.
Shi Yu began to try other ideas.
But none of them succeeded.
It was only when Shi Yu raised the proficiency of his Psychic power to the Dao Proficiency level through the memory water drop that a new usage of max-level Psychic power made up for Shi Yu’s pain.
This new usage was mental strengthening.
Through the max-level Psychic proficiency, it could strengthen the spiritual power of other life forms.
Buggy had long known this move, but the tactical meaning was not great and it was useless. After all, it was the only one in the team who played the spiritual element.
However, if this skill appeared on Shi Yu, the difference would be different.
Shi Yu had yet to successfully develop his telepathy talent. Firstly, through the “Body Control Talent” and the “Psychic Memory Water”, he developed a low-level mental strengthening talent.
This made Shi Yu not know whether to laugh or cry. He didn’t know if he should be happy or what.
Because his intention to establish a sect seemed to be completed in a short period of time?
“I have the experience method to use the ‘Control Talent Bead’ to develop spiritual power here. I also have the ‘Max Level Psychic’ memory water drop here. Through these three combinations, I seem to be able to let a Beast Tamer have the ‘low-level second talent, spiritual strengthening’?”
Shi Yu was silent. He would take note of it in a small notebook.
It was called the “superpower school”.
Not only could he obtain superpowers, but he could also use them to strengthen pets!
“Control Talent Bead”, “Memory Water for Psychic Development Method”, and “Memory Water for Psychic Full Proficiency” were indispensable.
After gathering these three things, he could obtain the low-level second talent!
Just imagining if Senior Lu, who was already very strong, had learned the “mental strengthening skill”…
It was simply so strong that it exploded!!!
Shi Yu was excited!
Unfortunately, its limitations were greater.
One would need him to provide the Experience Water and Talent Bead.
Moreover, not everyone could use the Talent Bead. Considering the consumption of this Talent Bead, Shi Yu’s initial judgment was that it had to be at least a level-six Beast Tamer to barely develop spiritual power.
Apart from that, compared to the mental strengthening talent of Beast Tamers of the same level, the consumption was greater and the effect was smaller.
This point destined that superpower schools could only be used by Beast Tamers with non-strengthening and non-combat talent. For example, it was very suitable for Beast Tamers with telepathy talent.
As for those Beast Tamers who had battle-type talent, it was definitely impossible for them to choose not to use their main talent for a second talent.
After all, the stamina of Beast Tamers was limited. They couldn’t activate two strengthening skills together.
Even Beast Tamers with telepathy talent probably wouldn’t be willing to use it on anyone, such as Shi Yu.
When Chi Tong possessed him, he needed to invest a lot of physical strength and energy to pilot the mecha. He didn’t have the energy to use mental strengthening at all. Unless he pursued instant eruption or used it when sending Buggy out in 1VS1, the cost-effective ratio wasn’t very high.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - Creating a Super Sect (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Creating a Super Sect (3)
But even so, Shi Yu felt that he had unintentionally created an epoch-making invention.
It was better than nothing. Even if it was a legendary Beast Tamer, they probably wouldn’t refuse the opportunity to obtain superpowers.
If he established a sect, he would probably be able to crush Brother Zheng Hai’s Binhai Training Hall in minutes and become the most popular Beast Taming Sect in Dong Huang.
After all, there were still a bunch of Beast Tamers with non-combat talent in the country. There were especially many of these people in Bureau 13 of Dong Huang.
For example, all the members of the Feeding Bureau, all the members of the archeological Bureau, Gao Xuan of the Mechanical Bureau, and even Legend Yin and his son in the ancient capital… None of them had battle-type talent.
They were already talented. If they had the chance to obtain a mental strengthening talent, even if it was a low-level version, who wouldn’t want it??
Their battle power would undoubtedly increase greatly!
Even Beast Tamers with battle talent would probably be very curious about superpowers. After all, they didn’t have to strengthen their pets. They could use them for fun.
“Susu, eternal god!! Skill memory water drop, eternal god!”
This discovery made Shi Yu’s disappointment that he had not successfully developed the telepathy talent disappear. He had a stronger motivation to continue developing the telepathy talent.
However, he felt that he had to change his train of thought.
His telepathy mutation was caused by the Undying Fruit and by his soul power.
But clearly, his use of soul power was inferior to mental power.
As for the control skill of the soul, Bai Chuan didn’t successfully develop it either. He only developed mental strength, mental power, various life-nourishing skills, and physical strength skills. From this, one could tell the specialness of soul power.
Therefore, Shi Yu was thinking that since Bai Chuan had no experience in developing soul power, could he reference the experience of others?
For example, he could directly use Chi Tong’s “Possession” and other soul skill memory water droplets to cultivate with the “Talent Bead” to increase his understanding of soul power.
For example, he could go to the mixed-blood bureau and get a set of soul cultivation manuals… Then, he would think of a way to increase the proficiency of this skill!
The previous failures all stemmed from insufficient proficiency!
With enough proficiency, he didn’t even want to develop the mental strengthening talent. The talent would have already come out on its own.
Memory water drop… was undoubtedly a good thing!!!
It looked like he had successfully found a way to exploit the system.
Using the memory water drop, he felt that he was one step closer to developing the strongest Psychic talent that combined mental, soul, and physical strength.
….
Handsome people were pretty lucky. In most cases, they were happy.
After Shi Yu successfully developed the superpower school and had a clearer development path, not long after, good news came from Baby Ginseng.
At this moment, it was shaking its leaves proudly. It didn’t waste much energy at all before successfully researching the cultivation method of the Phoenix Fruit.
Shi Yu looked at the fiery red Phoenix Tree and the two fresh Phoenix Fruits on it with a happy expression.
“Yi.” In the words of Baby Ginseng, the Phoenix Fruit that contained the characteristics of phoenixes, flames, and plants that could modify the bloodline of the human body was indeed very difficult to nurture, but this time, they encountered this talented research ginseng.
Baby Ginseng just had Chi Tong use its full-level possession to possess it. Through the mutation, it personally comprehended the power of the Phoenix and directly used its flames and plant characteristics to find a large number of ways to nurture the Phoenix Fruit.
Moreover, it created two Phoenix Fruits to prove its success. As for the first one, it had been dissected already.
“As expected of you guys.”
“Mi!” “Yi!” Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng expressed that there was no need to celebrate. This was all basic.
Go, use the Phoenix Fruit to show off!
Shi Yu was very grateful to Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng for helping him join another bureau.
After mastering the planting method of the Phoenix Fruit, it meant that Shi Yu could also establish a “Phoenix God Shrine” in the country and create a “Phoenix Family”. With this condition, it was easy to join the mixed-blood bureau.
Shi Yu was actually quite curious about the benefits of the mixed-blood bureau…
“I understand.” Shi Yu smiled readily. In the next moment, his expression changed again.
Three blessings all at once!
He quickly came to Ling’s side.
On Ling’s side, the tenth inscription was finally successfully developed.
In the Mechanical Research Institute, Shi Yu personally watched Eleven eat the “superalloy” created by Ling. Then, he hardened his body and carved a new inscription that was different from the previous nine inscriptions, completing the evolution again.
However, what made Shi Yu’s balls hurt was why this new inscription looked so much like the Chinese word “void”?
The evolution this time was very small. Eleven’s entire body was filled with the light of evolution for a moment before it ended. Eleven didn’t awaken any new skills because of this, but its energy level increased to more than ten million.
However, this didn’t affect anything. Through the skill index, Shi Yu could clearly confirm that the current Eleven could already learn superalloy through the skill index!
“Wuu!!” Eleven looked at Shi Yu nervously and excitedly.
As for Ling, it had an affirmative expression.
“It can be taught.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Wuuu!!!”
Eleven cheered excitedly.
Evolution! Evolution! Return to first place! Return to first place!
“This is already the limit. The difference between the Iron-eating Beast Race and the Alloy Monster Race is still too big. It can only cooperate with a small evolution to increase the skill compatibility and use your talent to learn superalloy.” Ling sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - Creating a Super Sect (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Creating a Super Sect (4)
This way, it would be very difficult for other Iron-eating Beasts to replicate this path.
Ling felt that this research was not perfect enough, but an expert level top-notch intelligence could only do this much.
“It’s good enough. Let’s do this first.” Shi Yu nodded. He was already completely satisfied.
This way, the basic conditions for evolution were about the same!!!
After Eleven broke through to the overlord level, it could carry it out.
However, he had to increase the superalloy skill points first.
Shi Yu was considering whether to reach Perfect Level or the transcendent level, which was the upper limit.
If it reached the perfect level, it was hard to say if it could fuse the Demon God Metal and the Light Thunder Metal to complete the evolution at the same time. After all, it was a conflicting power.
And if it was transcendent, the investment would be too big. However, in this case, the success rate and the racial level after evolution would definitely be maxed out.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. The World Tournament was still early. At the moment, he could add points to Eleven. The cooldown of a super skill would take less than a day. He felt that there was still hope for 64 points into superalloy.
“Transcendent-level superalloy+Dark Demon God Metal+Light White Thunder Metal. Is it possible to reach the Mythical race and awaken quasi divine skills?”
Suddenly, Shi Yu recalled Senior Ji Mengzhu’s words.
Relying on the fusion of many skills and special powers, it was possible to form the prototype of a divine skill…
As for the transcendent super evolution skill superalloy, it was clearly a skill to fuse special power…
Transcendent super racial skills could already be at the totem level. As for Eleven’s superalloy, although it wasn’t a racial skill, the difficulty of mastering it was usually higher than those skills.
Using it to fuse special powers… One of them came from the half-god Yun An, and the other was the conflicting white lightning.
What if…
Shi Yu smiled and stopped daydreaming. He felt that the chances were not high. If Eleven could really become a Mythical race at the overlord level, wouldn’t he be even more impressive than Legend Lin Feng?
However, if there were conditions, it was definitely better to maximize superalloy. Even if it couldn’t reach the Mythical race, it would definitely be the pinnacle race below the Mythical stage. It would completely defeat Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast.
“Let’s continue adding points…”
That was what Shi Yu thought. However, the Bean Bear guard who was in charge of answering the call outside the ruins suddenly ran in to inform Shi Yu to answer the call.
Shi Yu was stunned. He decisively left the ruins and came to a place with a signal.
The caller was President Lin.
Shi Yu picked up the call in surprise and said, “President Lin, how is it?”
On the other side of the video, President Lin shook his head and said, “The three mystic realms of the Meteor Race only broke through the nest of the Black Goat and the nest of another ordinary totem. We didn’t find the traces of that top-notch totem’s mystic realm. One possibility is that it’s a legendary and Mythical mystic realm that we can’t crack. It hid. The other possibility is that it’s a mobile mystic realm. That totem learned of the danger in advance and escaped.”
“Now that we’ve locked onto the location of this ruins mystic realm, regardless of whether it hides or escapes, this place will continue to be monitored.”
“Unfortunately, I couldn’t use this opportunity to find Yun An’s revival location. The two ordinary totems know nothing about Yun An’s revival location.”
“This…” Shi Yu was slightly stunned.” Then, are we just going to wait? ”
President Lin said, “Next, Dong Huang will gradually mobilize the members of Bureau 11 to investigate this ruins mystic realm. However, this matter isn’t urgent. You and Lu Qingyi will still prioritize the World Tournament first. This is more important. This place has already been locked onto by Dong Huang’s forbidden weapons. They can’t cause any waves. After the World Tournament ends, if there’s still no progress, you might need to come here and investigate together.”
“After all, you’re also one of the best archeologists in Bureau 11, and you have a huge relationship with the Yun family.”
Shi Yu had a headache. He thought that Dong Huang could directly capture Yun An alive. Why was it stuck at cracking the ruins mystic realm again? It wanted him to take action…
Damn, Shi Yu suddenly recalled the battle between Demon God Eleven and the mysterious dark-element totem that the owl had predicted…
Why did it feel that it was developing more and more in this direction…
No, no, no. He had already decided to let Eleven evolve. It definitely wouldn’t happen. Nothing would happen.
“I understand,” Shi Yu replied to President Lin.
“Yes,” President Lin said. “There are two more things…”
President Lin chuckled. “There’s also good news. Although there are no legendary resources in the nest of the two totems of the Fallen Race, there are a lot of other resources. Apart from that, the Seven Islands have also paid a certain amount of resources to Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang.”
“It’s all thanks to the information you provided. Do you still lack any resources?”
Shi Yu’s eyes lit up. “Is there any more Aurora Magnetic Gold? Another piece.”
Eleven had evolved, and eleven meteorite fragments were prepared. They were all level-eight resources of legendary quality. As for the corresponding resource, Aurora Magnetic Gold, although it was a legendary level-nine resource, there was only one. Moreover, it had used most of its strength. Shi Yu felt that it was more balanced with another Yin Yang.
This way, the proficiency requirement for the White Thunder skill might be lower. He didn’t have to spend much effort to increase it.
President Lin nodded and said, “Sure.”
Shi Yu said, “Then President Lin, can I enter the Intelligence Bureau?”
President Lin: “?”
“Didn’t you say… that the information provided this time is quite important?” Shi Yu coughed dryly.
President Lin fell into deep thought. If he remembered correctly, Shi Yu had already joined four bureaus.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - Creating a Super Sect (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 722: Creating a Super Sect (5)
President Lin established Bureau 13 of Dong Huang to gather elite talents from various fields and promote the prosperity and development of various fields. Together, he wanted Dong Huang to become stronger. Every Beast Tamer qualified to enter one of the bureaus was considered a pillar of the country.
However, why did Shi Yu feel like he was playing the key national departments he had established as a “collection game”?
Moreover, Shi Yu wasn’t the first to say that to him.
The first to feel that Shi Yu should have joined the tenth bureau’s Intelligence Bureau was Legend Zhang of the tenth bureau that had accompanied him in the Heavenly Fox Nation!
Although very silent back there, Grandma Zhang was very emotional when she spoke to President Lin afterward.
“I’ve long heard of many of this Shi Yu’s deeds. Today, it looks like he’s indeed a super genius. Old Lin, speaking of which, this Shi Yu is quite suitable to join the Intelligence Bureau. He’s simply played an irreplaceable key role this time. This telepathy talent is simply born for information.”
“Not only can it communicate with foreign races with language barriers, but it can also listen to history. In this era, the importance of information is self-evident.”
If the information was correct, everything could be set up in advance. Even demigods would have to kneel!
However, in the face of Legend Zhang’s praise for Shi Yu, President Lin didn’t mind much. He thought that Shi Yu would find it troublesome. After all, he had already joined so many bureaus.
But from the looks of it, not only did this guy not find it troublesome, he even seemed to be enjoying it?
“Yes.” President Lin thought for a moment and nodded slightly. Some special benefits of joining the Intelligence Bureau seemed to be helpful for Shi Yu’s safety when he was active abroad.
In that case, he could do as he wished.
Shi Yu was excited. Alright, five bureaus.
“By the way, President Lin, do you know the Phoenix God Society of the Seven Islands? It’s the Seven Islands faction that was lucky enough to obtain the low-level resources of the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
President Lin said, “Of course. Speaking of which, their legend seems to want to come to Dong Huang to visit you and Lu Bai. However, because the relationship between the Seven Islands and Dong Huang was tense previously, they couldn’t come. But after a while, Dong Huang and the Seven Islands should let them pass.”
“Did you expose your alternate identity?”
Shi Yu was stunned, but he didn’t mind. He said, “Probably not. He’s most likely curious about the origin of the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
“President Lin, what I want to say is that didn’t their legend Divine Master develop a resource called the Phoenix Fruit that can modify humans with suitable talent into phoenix hybrids?”
“I’ve also researched the cultivation method of this resource! With the resources in place, it can be produced in large quantities. A phoenix hybrid should be quite strong, especially since the Phoenix Race’s headquarters is Dong Huang in the first place. With the empress also a hybrid of the Phoenix Race, she can definitely find a batch of young female Beast Tamers with special aptitude. I feel that we can make a phoenix army!!”
“Isn’t the strongest army of the empress dynasty the Phoenix Army? Now that we have the Iron-eating Beast Army, isn’t it not bad to have the Phoenix Army?”
The more Shi Yu thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible. Iron-eating Beast Army, Green Silkworm cocoon army, mechanical phantom beast army, Phoenix Army… It looked like his armies had to increase by one.
If it was going to happen in the future, why not go for it now? After hanging up, he would get Buggy to fly around and see if he could find a beautiful girl with the aptitude of a phoenix and nurture her in advance.
When President Lin heard that, he fell silent again.
Did this kid still want to join the mixed-blood bureau?
He remembered that when he established Bureau 13 of Dong Huang, he probably didn’t mention the strange setting of “as long as you gather all 13 bureaus, you can become the next president of Dong Huang”…

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis
chapters.content:
Chapter 723: Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis
President Lin was silent.
However, the Phoenix Fruit of the Phoenix God Shrine was indeed a good thing.
The humans of Dong Huang used dragons and phoenixes as totems. Among them, the empress was a hybrid Phoenix Race. The symbolism was huge. It could be said that the empress was the idol of most female Beast Tamers in Dong Huang.
Now, the dragon hybrid had been passed down, but the phoenix hybrid had been lost. It was a little regretful.
If he could use the Phoenix Fruit to dig up the Beast Tamers with hidden Phoenix hybrid aptitudes among the Dong Huang humans and help them awaken, Dong Huang might be able to add several powerful legends.
“Arrange for it to be done,” President Lin said. “As long as nothing goes wrong.”
The World Tournament was imminent, and he had more important things to do. He didn’t have time to care about these things now, so he handed Shi Yu full authority to deal with it himself.
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu smiled brightly and said, “Alright.”
When the Phoenix Army was established, the mixed-blood bureau would probably be completed!
The others that were easier to join, such as the Medical Bureau, the Business Bureau, the Education Bureau… didn’t feel very difficult.
After hanging up, Shi Yu immediately got Buggy to bring him around Ping Cheng to find Beast Tamers with the aptitude of a phoenix hybrid…
Then, after searching around, Shi Yu returned to the icy plain and threw a mission to Ling’s clone.
He took the time to make “Phoenix Radar” and “Phoenix Search Compass”. It was the kind of detector that could automatically show the position of a Beast Tamer with the aptitude of a phoenix hybrid.
It was indeed too troublesome to find it himself.
Ling: “…#” Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong: ~
….
Time passed. In the blink of an eye, another two months had passed since Shi Yu returned from his mission in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
In two months, Dong Huang produced big news.
Zheng Hai, the quasi legend who was originally eighth in the Sequence, had his pet break through to the overlord level. He passed the legend assessment and became the new legend of Dong Huang!
This news could be said to have made Dong Huang’s inner sect explode with firecrackers.
This way, there would be five legend Beast Tamers in the top ten of the Dong Huang Sequence!
However, what made people the most curious was what number the Sequence ranking would increase to after Zheng Hai officially became a legend.
Should he replace the fifth place of the Sequence, the number one person below the legendary level, Shi Yu, or directly replace one of the top four legends?
Either one was enough to be a topic of conversation!
Because at that time, Shi Yu would fall to sixth place.
However, Zheng Hai himself had no intention of challenging Shi Yu…
Others might not know how he became a legend so quickly, but he himself obviously knew.
He couldn’t bite the hand that fed him.
Zheng Hai had allowed his pet to break through to overlord through the Mythical Ruins of the Seven Islands. After the matter of the Yun Race surfaced, after the relationship between Dong Huang and the Seven Islands eased, Zheng Hai still successfully entered the Mythical Ruins.
Then, he let his trump card, the Battle Leviathan, break through to overlord.
As for the right to use this ruin, it was transferred to Zheng Hai by Shi Yu. Zheng Hai naturally couldn’t turn around and challenge Shi Yu…
At this moment, Zheng Hai had already learned from his teacher, Legend Sea Tyrant, that Shi Yu and Lu Bai were the same person.
When he learned about it, Zheng Hai could be said to be extremely stunned.
Because at that time, he had clearly watched the battle live broadcast of Lu Bai and the Shen Feng Mechanic and called Shi Yu!
Moreover, Shi Yu even fought Lu Bai!
The older the wiser. The Tyrannical Sea Legend saw through it with a single sentence. What if one of them was a clone?
Upon hearing that, Zheng Hai was immediately shocked and understood his immaturity.
At the same time, he felt that Shi Yu was more and more ridiculous. An alias of his could kill indiscriminately in the Seven Islands?!
He was still human?!
“Brother Shi Yu, you’ve been hiding quite a bit of stuff from me…” On the phone, Zheng Hai kept smiling bitterly at Shi Yu.
“But I’m still very grateful to you. I’ll prepare the resources we discussed previously as soon as possible and send them to you.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “No hurry, no hurry. Congratulations, Brother Zheng Hai, for passing the legend assessment. What are your plans next?”
Zheng Hai was stunned. “You mean the Sequence ranking? I plan to challenge Jiang Tianyang or Zhou Ming, who’s third or fourth, after stabilizing my strength.”
The top four of the Sequence were all legends. Among them, Jiang Tianyang was originally in fourth place, but he successfully challenged the original third place, Zhou Ming, and advanced by one.
Because these two people didn’t cultivate enough, they only contracted one overlord-level pet. Therefore, Zheng Hai decisively targeted them.
They would both have just one, so he wasn’t afraid.
He couldn’t challenge Shi Yu, who was fifth in the Sequence and wasn’t a legend yet, right? That would be too much.
Whether he won or lost, it wasn’t good.
As for the first and second ranks of the Sequence, they both had more than one overlord-level pet. It was difficult to fight, so the best choice was still third and fourth.
“Then I wish you success, Brother Zheng Hai,” Shi Yu blessed.
“Cough, cough, I keep feeling a little apologetic…” Zheng Hai felt awkward and said,” If I enter the top five, Brother Shi Yu, you’ll fall down. Only the top five have legendary resources as a reward, and I can pass the legendary assessment so quickly because of your help… ”
Zheng Hai was in a dilemma.
Sigh, if he had known that Lu Bai was Shi Yu, he wouldn’t have accepted the right to use this Mythical Ruins no matter what. It wasn’t suitable to fight now, nor was it suitable not to fight.
However, it was impossible to give up. Zheng Hai planned to make up for Shi Yu more with the resources he had promised previously.
“Don’t worry about me. I have other missions in this world competition. No matter what my final ranking is, I’ll have legendary resources and participate in the competition. Just fight up without worry,” Shi Yu said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (2)
His legendary resources had long been taken in advance.
It didn’t matter even if his ranking fell below 100.
If Zheng Hai had the ability to fight and get another one, that would be his luck and strength.
“Really?” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Zheng Hai was stunned.
“Of course.”
Zheng Hai was overjoyed. “Thank you.”
If he could obtain the legendary resources in the top five of the Sequence, he might be able to nurture another overlord before the World Tournament began!
After confirming with Zheng Hai when the resources promised by the other party would be transferred, Shi Yu smiled. Fortunately, Zheng Hai didn’t plan to challenge him, who was fifth place. Otherwise, he would probably cry very badly.
That was because Eleven was about to break through to the overlord level. The other pets were also strengthened at the epic level!
Two months ago, he could already barely fight against the three overlords…
Not to mention now, two months later…
A newly advanced legend was definitely not his match.
Eleven was about to break through to overlord. Buggy had four body puppets, including half a totem corpse puppet. Baby Ginseng evolved again. Chi Tong had three overlord undead puppets. Apart from that, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling’s fusion mechas were even more perfect.
In addition, he had cultivated to the maximum level of Psychic power, so his spirit and stamina were more abundant. He could withstand longer possession. He estimated that in the current Sequence ranking, the only ones who could pose a threat to him were probably the first place Ye Xing and the second place Divine Bell.
One of the two had an abnormal Beast Taming Talent related to the power of the stars, while the other was a descendant of the mechanical legendary. Shi Yu couldn’t figure out their strength.
But this wasn’t important. In any case, they would all be his bodyguards in the end. The stronger the better.
Moreover, Shi Yu estimated that the next top five of the Sequence should be very impressive. Even if he didn’t participate in the competition, Zheng Hai might not be able to get into the top five…
Because… Lu Qingyi contacted Shi Yu before Zheng Hai did.
For the past half a year, she had been cultivating in the Space Emperor Ruins with the Void Mantis.
Recently, she had also successfully broken through to the Legend level. She and that Courtyard Sprite and her broken through to level seven alone, and one sprite had reached the overlord level. They were only one assessment away from the title of Legend Beast Tamer.
As for her strength, it completely reached the standard.
Shi Yu smiled. For the sake of legendary resources, Senior Lu definitely had to fight for the top five. At that time, with so many legends fighting for the top five, there was bound to be an unlucky person.
As for Brother Zheng Hai, it felt like he was that unlucky guy…
“Wu…” Shi Yu glanced at his cooldown interface.
[Cooldown Time: 0: 11]
There were still 11 minutes left. He entered the ruins and prepared to add a new round of points to Eleven. Then, he would go to Ancient Capital University to see the legend Senior Lu.
After Lu Qingyi broke through to the legend level, she wanted to thank Shi Yu in person. Shi Yu didn’t let her come to Ping Cheng and arranged to meet her at Ancient Capital University.
After all, Ping Cheng was in the middle of nowhere. There wasn’t even a good place to have a meal together. It was better to go to Ancient Capital.
In the ruins, Eleven was in the gym, training with two legendary resources, Aurora Magnetic Gold.
< Name > Eleven
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch level
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Inner Power (Expert+11), Lightning Rod (Expert+11), Space Quake (Expert+11), Bean Soldier (Expert+11), Impregnable (Expert+11)
[Teaching Skill]
“Super Level”: Undying Golden Body (Perfect), White Thunder (Perfect), Super Alloy (Perfect)
Normal Energy Points: 15,010,000
In the past two months, Shi Yu had mainly added points to Eleven, Ling, and Baby Ginseng.
Among them, Ling upgraded the top-notch intelligent divine net, while Baby Ginseng upgraded the Fire of Life and was upgraded to expert level. As for the Lightning and Energy Storage Beams, it was relatively simple to upgrade them, so it was naturally maxed out.
As for Eleven, it was only a step away from breaking through to perfect overlord. Among them, it was due to Shi Yu, resources, and even Eleven’s own hard work.
In fact, Shi Yu didn’t even upgrade a skill like White Thunder, but it was difficult for its proficiency to be low if it hugged two legendary resources that contained the power of the White Thunder Rule Force every day.
It was the same for superalloy. Through the superalloy food specially developed by Ling, the continuous eating for two months had at least made Shi Yu save two point-adding sessions, but it was a little expensive.
Apart from that, skills like Inner Power, Undying Golden Body, and Impregnable were also very good for Eleven, who had the will of an overlord, courting death training, and had Baby Ginseng to cover its injuries. Coupled with the most important points Shi Yu added, the entire team’s gains in two months were better than Shi Yu imagined.
“Huh?” Shi Yu walked to Eleven’s gym. When Eleven saw Shi Yu, its eyes lit up.
It was about to break through to overlord.
“There’s no hurry. Let’s order the superalloy first.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Shi Yu originally wanted to let Eleven complete its breakthrough and evolution in one go.
However, under Ling’s suggestion, Shi Yu decided to pull up the skills of the other pets before letting Eleven break through.
That was because Eleven’s strength after breaking through and evolution would definitely be very terrifying. Although it might also feedback to Shi Yu’s stronger physique, the consumption would definitely be greater than strengthening. It would be fine if Shi Yu’s physique could withstand it, but if he couldn’t, breaking through too early would make Shi Yu weaker. It would undoubtedly delay the subsequent increase in points.
Shi Yu thought about it and agreed. It was best to let Eleven break through and evolve on the eve of the World Tournament. In any case, it was coming soon, so he couldn’t be anxious.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (3)
….
After adding points to Eleven again, Shi Yu headed to the ancient capital and temporarily stopped his bitter cultivation.
At this moment, the appearance of Ancient Capital University was already completely different. Ever since the last National League, after Ancient Capital University obtained sufficient education funds, it began to renovate internally and externally, and the cultivation facilities were completely upgraded.
In a private courtyard of Ancient Capital University, Lu Qingyi was leisurely sitting on a chair and reading. With a spatial ripple, Shi Yu appeared nearby.
“You’re here. I just arrived too.” After Shi Yu arrived, Lu Qingyi got up and smiled.
“Senior, long time no see.” Shi Yu greeted his senior and retracted Buggy to let it rest. After rushing all the way, Buggy was exhausted.
Ever since they met before going to the Seven Islands, Shi Yu seemed to have not seen Lu Qingyi for almost five months.
After breaking through to the legend level, Lu Qingyi’s current aura was once again filled with charm, like a natural spirit. It should be related to the feedback of the overlord-level Courtyard Sprite.
“Where’s that mantis?” Shi Yu asked curiously after arriving.
“Cough.” Lu Qingyi coughed dryly. The surrounding space flashed again. A Void Mantis holding and nibbling a drumstick had an unfriendly gaze. “Kid, show some respect.”
Previously, he was still calling it senior, but now he was calling it mantis. Was he arrogant?
“Senior Mantis, long time no see. Congratulations on breaking through.” Shi Yu’s eyes lit up.
< Name > Void Mantis
[Attributes]: Space
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 62,210,000
62.21 million… It was about the same as the Mountain Tortoise and the Ice-Eyed White Tiger!
Of course, it definitely couldn’t be calculated that way. After all, the Void Mantis was a spatial type, and it had just broken through less than two months ago. Its growth potential was huge, different from those old overlords whose potential had almost been consumed.
Moreover, if Senior Mantis could borrow the power of the void at the monarch level, it would definitely be even more terrifying after the overlord level. The power of the void was much stronger than the power of the dragon vein borrowed by the Green Scaled Dragon. Its strength was probably not weaker than that Green Scaled Dragon.
“It’s alright,” the Void Mantis said calmly. It was just the overlord level. What was so strange about breaking through?
Lu Qingyi said, “It’s all thanks to Senior Void Mantis’s guidance during this period of time. If it hadn’t agreed to lend the Space Emperor Ruins, I wouldn’t have been able to break through so quickly.”
The Void Mantis said, “It’s no big deal. You’re the one with pretty good talent.”
“By the way, kid, how’s the hatching progress of that egg? How many places have you gone?”
Shi Yu said, “I’ve gone to two places. It’s pretty smooth. Only Tingxiang and Rongguang are left.”
“The progress is so slow,” the Void Mantis said. “I still want to see what hatches.”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “There’s no Space Emperor Teleportation Array anymore. How can it be so easy to hatch an egg from such a far place?”
The Void Mantis: “You definitely didn’t hatch the egg properly.”
Shi Yu: “I was already very close to death! I almost fought a totem.”
The Void Mantis: “Ah… That’s a little dangerous…”
Shi Yu sighed. It had followed the Spatial Kong Emperor since he was young, so it naturally didn’t know the hardships of the world.
Lu Qingyi asked, “By the way, when do you plan to go to Tingxiang?”
“I haven’t decided. What’s wrong?” Shi Yu asked.
Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “I feel that we can go together. I also have something to do in Tingxiang. After my sprite reached the overlord level, it has more memories from when it was alive. It wants to return to her hometown to take a look.”
“I see. How about in a month?!” Shi Yu said.
For a month, he would work overtime and let Baby Ginseng condense another time mark. At that time, he would be more at ease…
“Alright, I can use this month to fight for the ranking,” Lu Qingyi said with a confident smile.
“Just fight this kid!” At the side, the Void Mantis encouraged.
In its opinion, Lu Qingyi’s current strength was definitely stronger than Shi Yu.
“Senior Mantis, don’t encourage her randomly. If you want to come, do it yourself.” Shi Yu smiled.
He didn’t want to fight Lu Qingyi. At the moment, Lu Qingyi only had the Courtyard Sprite at the overlord level. During the battle, it would definitely be the sprite possessing Lu Qingyi. If he wanted to win, he could only hit the user. How could he do it to someone he knew?
Void Mantis: Hm?
Lu Qingyi was stunned. Although she knew that Shi Yu’s battle results on the Seven Islands were very strong, she couldn’t help but feel curious when she saw that Shi Yu was even more confident than her.
She could be said to know the strength of the Void Mantis after breaking through. Once it broke through, it was not a problem to say that the battle power of the Void Mantis was comparable to a top-notch overlord.
“I think you’re arrogant!” The Void Mantis sneered. “You’re itching for a beating again. Then I really want to teach you a lesson.”
The Void Mantis had also been Shi Yu and the others’ sparring partner in the Space Emperor Ruins for a long time. Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were no match for the Void Mantis at that time and were tyrannized every time.
But at that moment, in Shi Yu’s space, be it Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, or Susu, they were all extremely active. Just now, before the Void Mantis appeared, they were all shouting that they wanted to fight the Void Mantis again.
Shi Yu was helpless. He could only find an opportunity to challenge the Void Mantis that had broken through and give them a chance to “have revenge”. A monarch level expert fighting an overlord level expert… Moreover, he was quite excited. Only Shi Yu’s team could find such a ridiculous thing.
“Alright, let’s fight!” Shi Yu said.
“Where’s the venue?” the Void Mantis said.
At the side, Lu Qingyi was also quite helpless. Why were they going to fight as soon as they met?

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Legend Senior Lu and the Overlord Void Mantis (4)
“Then… let’s go to my legendary ruins.” Lu Qingyi sighed. They definitely couldn’t fight in Ancient Capital University.
At that time, the university would be in ruins.
Only her legendary ruins could withstand overlord-level battles.
“Sure.” The Void Mantis and Shi Yu nodded. Among them, the pets in Shi Yu’s space had already begun to shake the sieve to see who got to fight it first.
Because it would definitely be a 1VS1 battle, but several of them wanted to fight. They definitely had to choose who to fight through this method.
According to the order of entry… A huge sieve kept rolling on the ground. A few pets stared intently.
In the end, the outcome of a white and red pair made the pets’ expressions change.
Only Buggy revealed an excited expression and quickly went to the spatial pocket to repair the three overlord physical puppets and the Black Meteorite Yak’s physical puppet.
After being tortured by the Worm-type Void Mantis so many times, it would definitely avenge its previous humiliation this time. It was first in the team!
“Are we fighting now?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“In the afternoon,” Shi Yu said. Buggy had just rushed all the way. It was better to let it rest for a while.
“In the afternoon, then!” The Void Mantis said. “We can continue eating.”
It bit off the chicken bone and teleported away. No one knew where it went.
….
After Shi Yu and the Void Mantis made an appointment in the afternoon, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi continued to chat about Shi Yu’s trip to the Seven Islands.
Lu Qingyi naturally knew about “Shi Yu” clearing the path to champion through the news.
Lu Bai’s experience had long been exposed by the Mechanic of Shen Feng. However, because Lu Qingyi was busy cultivating, she didn’t know much about other things.
After Shi Yu introduced the Phoenix God Shrine, Lu Qingyi had a surprised expression and said, “A Phoenix Fruit that can give humans the Phoenix bloodline and turn them into hybrids? It can also strengthen the bloodline concentration of pets of the Phoenix race? There’s such a thing?”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu smiled and took out a red fruit. “And at the moment, I’ve already mastered the cultivation method. Do you want to give your Green Phoenix a taste?”
Lu Qingyi wanted to say something but hesitated. She had a headache and said, “The memory water drop you provided has already helped me a lot. How can I still use your resources?”
“Senior, you’re too polite. The high-level ruins you cracked are still with me. It’s that high-level ruin that’s suitable for the growth of plants…”
Lu Qingyi: “?”
Didn’t she hand it in? Why did it go to this guy?
Shi Yu coughed dryly and said, “At that time, there was no suitable ruin to use, so I ran to the bureau to get it. At the moment, the Phoenix Fruit is being cultivated here.”
Initially, after having the legendary ruins, Shi Yu wanted to return the high-level ruins, but he suddenly realized that even the legendary ruins’ growth effect on plant pets and the growth enhancement effect of spiritual plants were inferior to this high-level ruin. As the saying went, there were specializations in various fields.
Therefore, after consideration, Shi Yu chose to stay behind to study and plant the Phoenix Fruit and the Reincarnation Fruit to maximize the benefits of using the ruins.
“I see.” Lu Qingyi came to a realization. “But I’m more curious. Can a fruit really transform humans into hybrids?”
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “But it requires a suitable aptitude.”
“For example, when the Phoenix Race modified the pure-blooded humans into hybrids, not just anyone can do it. Instead, they have to choose those with compatible aptitudes. For example, General Mu Huiyin and Senior Empress should be very compatible.”
“The conditions for using the Phoenix Fruit are similar. Beast Tamers also need to have a certain amount of aptitude, or have ancestors that have mixed blood of the Phoenix Race. Those whose bloodline inheritance has been broken, or those who have compatibility themselves, might be modified into mixed blood by the Phoenix Fruit.”
Lu Qingyi asked, “Then how do we determine?”
Shi Yu said, “It was difficult to determine previously, and it was very troublesome to find, but now…”
He took out something that looked like a mechanical radar and smiled. “I got my mechanical pet to take the time to make this. The bloodline detector can detect humans with the Phoenix bloodline within a certain range.”
After the radar was created, Shi Yu had already gotten Ling to fly around Icefield City to test it. There were two humans with the aptitude of a phoenix hybrid in a second-level city in Icefield City!!
Unfortunately, one of them was already an old granny in her sixties. She wasn’t even a Beast Tamer. Shi Yu and Ling felt that it was a little unsuitable to ask her if she wanted to join the Phoenix Army with the Phoenix Fruit, so they gave up on this candidate.
The other was a little girl who had just entered kindergarten. Her parents were both Beast Tamers. Although she was a good seedling, she was too young and still not suitable. After being annoyed by that fact, Shi Yu and Ling didn’t continue looking for her. In any case, it was enough to prove that the radar could be used.
“After using it, if there are humans with bloodlines that match their aptitude nearby, it will automatically track them.” Shi Yu activated the radar. In the next moment, a red dot appeared on the radar and a beeping sound appeared.
Shi Yu was stunned.
Lu Qingyi was stunned.
Lu Qingyi said, “This means… is there anyone nearby who meets the aptitude?”
“Wait, don’t tell me it’s me.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s not you, Senior, but if you want to become a hybrid, apart from the Phoenix Fruit, there’s still a way.”
“I know, but I don’t have this intention for the time being…” Lu Qingyi quickly shook her head.
Before Shi Yu went to the Seven Islands, he gave her the memory water drop. With the memory water drop, Lu Qingyi’s Courtyard Sprite’s possession skill had also reached the level where it could change the bloodline of the target.
If she wanted to, Lu Qingyi could have the elven bloodline in a while. However, like Shi Yu, she was not interested in becoming a hybrid. She still preferred the identity of a pure-blooded human.
“Then can this be a Beast Tamer of Ancient Capital University…” she asked Shi Yu.
Shi Yu nodded and said, “The detection range of the radar isn’t big. It’s only about a quarter the size of Ancient Capital University. From the looks of it, it should be.”
“Let’s go take a look together?” Shi Yu said.
At Ancient Capital University, genius Beast Tamers gathered. The people here with the phoenix hybrid aptitude shouldn’t be as useless as the first two, right?
“Will it be a teacher or a student?” Lu Qingyi was a little curious.
“As long as it’s not the canteen auntie,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu added, “I prefer it to be a student. I still seem to be the president of the battle club of Ancient Capital University… I should hurry up and get more students with some aptitude to replace me…”
Otherwise, he couldn’t possibly finish the world competition at the end of the year and fight a bunch of totem countries before returning to the country in January to continue participating in the national university competition…

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - Buggy vs the Void Mantis
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Buggy vs the Void Mantis
Ancient Capital University, Battle Club.
To Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi’s surprise, the Phoenix Radar actually led them here.
The two of them stood outside the battle club building and looked at each other.
“A Beast Tamer of the battle club?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“Isn’t that good?” Shi Yu was excited.
He really got what he wanted.
Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi directly entered the battle club building. They walked to the audience seats on the second floor and looked at the training ground.
At the moment, there were only a dozen or so people here.
Shi Yu looked over and was rather surprised because they were all second-year students.
Apart from this group of students, Dean He, the instructor of the battle club, was also present.
Initially, it was the president’s job to be in charge of daily training, but the problem was that the president was busy.
In other schools, teachers slacked off while student cadres worked. In the Ancient Capital, students cadres slacked off while teachers worked.
After the physical training was completed, Dean He said to everyone, “Everyone, rest first.”
He looked at these dozen or so people. Yu Shu, Miao Dongdong, Zhang Qianyi, Wang Ling, Han Dong, Fang Ji, Xu Jingyin… They were all geniuses from Shi Yu’s vocation assessment.
Yu Shu, who had been teased by Shi Yu’s Buggy’s Ice Dragon Phantom, Miao Dongdong, who had been teased by Buggy’s worm silk, Zhang Qianyi, who had been shattered by Shi Yu’s Eleven’s Giant Thunder Palm, and Han Dong, who had been insta-killed by Eleven and Buggy’s double deterrence… More or less, they had all suffered a beating.
But was this a bad thing? Not necessarily. Because they had been beaten up by Shi Yu, Shi Yu actually recognized them.
