After the huge amount of education funds from Ancient Capital University this time, under Shi Yu’s suggestion, this batch of second-year students became the main cultivation target of Ancient Capital University. Naturally, there were more training courses.
Physical training like today naturally couldn’t be escaped. Of course, in comparison, Ancient Capital University would also provide nutritional supplements to increase physique and high-level supplements to recover physical strength.
At the moment, with the huge investment of Ancient Capital University, the best among them, such as Yu Shu, Zhang Qianyi, and Miao Dongdong, had already passed the high-level Beast Tamer assessment. Their strength was not necessarily inferior to the third and fourth-year seniors. They might all become master-level Beast Tamers before graduation.
Apart from that, a super genius like An Chang also appeared among the first-year students. With some time, Mechanic students had a chance of rising. Ancient Capital University could completely be said to have a bright future!
Dean He was excited!
“Can you confirm which one it is?” Sitting on it, Lu Qingyi asked.
Shi Yu held the radar and said, “Sure.”
With that said, he activated the automatic search function of the radar. The radar instantly left Shi Yu’s hand and floated up, flying towards the training ground below.
Lu Qingyi looked at this black technology-like thing and didn’t know how Shi Yu created it.
Ling: “Laziness is the best productivity…”
“It’s very convenient, right? It’s just that the energy source is a little expensive.” Shi Yu smiled. However, it was fine as long as it was convenient. This was much more convenient than the method of finding people in the Phoenix God Shrine he understood.
Below, just as the crowd dispersed, the radar flew in front of a girl and stopped.
The radar flying over directly attracted everyone’s attention, making them look at this strange machine together.
At the same time, Shi Yu said in surprise, “So it’s her.”
The girl in front of the radar was very tall. She was wearing the gray training uniform of the battle club. She had short hair and a beautiful face that was still covered in sweat. At this moment, she was wiping her sweat with the sports towel around her neck. She was also very confused about the machinery that stopped in front of her.
Zhang Qianyi, a second-year student of the battle department of Ancient Capital University, an elementalist who was once called “Elemental God” in the vocation assessment.
At that time, every candidate was more or less given a nickname, but while some were pleasant to the ears, others were unpleasant. For example, Shi Yu’s was “Iron-eating Beast Knight”.
Even Lu Qingyi had some impression of her, because the other party’s Beast Taming Talent was pretty good. It was the Elemental Coordination Talent. She had once fought Shi Yu in the vocation assessment, but she was completely no match for Eleven’s Giant Thunder Palm that descended from the sky.
After that battle ended, Shi Yu even announced the evolution of the iron-eating beast and walked into the public’s vision.
However, this didn’t mean that she was weak. Even Yu Shu, who came from the Imperial Dragon Family, had been shattered by her in a few seconds. Her combination skill, Thunder Cloud Storm, was probably invincible in that assessment apart from when facing Shi Yu and Yin Zhengfan.
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, this girl came from a small city. Her parents weren’t Beast Tamers. Because she was talented, she walked the path of a Beast Tamer. It was her first time coming to the Ancient Capital to participate in the vocation assessment, and because her foundation wasn’t strong enough, she didn’t even pass the preliminaries.
However, because of this, she was chosen by a top-notch master and taken in as a disciple. That was why she was in the second round of the vocation assessment against Shi Yu.
A person with the aptitude of a phoenix hybrid… It was actually her. It was good that he knew her.
“What’s this?” Dean He saw the machinery and immediately looked around.
At the same time, a voice appeared in Dean He’s head.
“Dean He, this is Shi Yu. Sorry to disturb you. Um, do you have time to get Zhang Qianyi to come over?”
Damn.
As soon as he finished speaking, Dean He suddenly looked in his direction and really saw Shi Yu standing there… Even Lu Qingyi as well. He looked at the two who arrived and was stunned.
He didn’t understand why these two gods would suddenly come here.
Although Dean He was the dean of the battle department of Ancient Capital University and a top-notch master, he also knew that his strength had long been surpassed by young geniuses like Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 8: Buggy vs the Void Mantis (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Buggy vs the Void Mantis (2)
He was extremely confused by the sudden descent of these two super geniuses who should be chatting and laughing with the legends.
Moreover, why was he looking for Zhang Qianyi?
At this moment, the batch of second-year Beast Tamers training here also looked at the two people who appeared on the second floor. They were first stunned, and then their expressions immediately became very exaggerated.
“Damn, that… is that Shi Yu…” The Gu Master Miao Dongdong had pretty good eyesight.
“There’s no need to doubt it, that’s him!” Dragon King Yu Shu said.
” Beside him… Isn’t that Senior Lu, who has already graduated?” Someone also recognized Lu Qingyi.
As the only two super geniuses who entered the top ten of the Sequence, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were naturally known to everyone in Ancient Capital University.
“Why are they here?”
The crowd discussed, their eyes filled with light.
“Zhang Qianyi.” Dean He listened to the discussion and was stunned for a moment. Then, he quickly said, “Shi Yu is looking for you. Go over and see what’s going on.”
“Looking for me?” In the crowd, Zhang Qianyi revealed a confused expression.
Although she was in the same batch as Shi Yu, Shi Yu didn’t have much interaction with her. No, it could be said that Shi Yu didn’t have much interaction with any student of the same batch. According to rumors, this guy didn’t attend many classes seriously. He was very hard to get a hold of.
In fact, ignoring his student activity, there were rumors that no one had ever seen Shi Yu even in the archeology Department’s final exam.
“Yes.” Dean He nodded. He didn’t know why…
Upon hearing that, Zhang Qianyi looked over and saw Shi Yu smiling at her.
Seeing this, the other battle club students immediately panicked. Damn, what was going on?
“When did they hook up?” Yu Shu was shocked.
He didn’t remember any connection between Shi Yu and Zhang Qianyi.
Miao Dongdong: “Well… I have an ominous feeling.”
He looked at the mechanical radar.
“What?”
“I feel… I feel that once Zhang Qian returns, her strength can defeat us. I’m afraid that any resources Shi Yu leaks now are enough for Master level people to fight over for crazily…”
Yu Shu: “What strange intuition is this?!”
Miao Dongdong was silent. He had heard through certain channels that the monster in his first year, An Chang, was Shi Yu’s underling…
….
On the second floor, after Zhang Qian came over, she was a little nervous. It was alright when facing Shi Yu. Although Shi Yu was now the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang and had created so many miracles, when she recalled that Shi Yu rode an Iron-eating Beast and slashed around during the vocation assessment and even fought with her, she suddenly didn’t feel that much of a distance.
On the other hand, Lu Qingyi beside her made her a little nervous. She looked at this goddess-like school legend and admired her very much.
“Senior Lu… Shi Yu?”
“Are you looking for me?”
“Little Zhang, long time no see,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Zhang Qianyi: “?”
Zhang Qian suspected that she had forgotten something. Was she… that familiar with Shi Yu?
“Hello, Junior.” Lu Qingyi also smiled.
At this moment, Shi Yu said, “Come, come, sit down and talk.”
“Yes.” Zhang Qianyi nodded.
Shi Yu said, “I’ll get straight to the point.”
At this moment, the mechanical radar had also returned. Shi Yu held it and said, “You were also present when I contracted General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit in the heroic spirit ruins, right?”
Zhang Qianyi nodded. That was the military training of the new students, so she was naturally there.
“Then you should know that General Mu Huiyin is a hybrid of a human and a Phoenix, right?”
Zhang Qianyi nodded again. It was all revealed in the preview of Shi Yu’s “Mu Huiyin Legend”.
There shouldn’t be anyone from Ancient Capital University who hadn’t seen this video.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “That’s good then. Do you want to become a hybrid Beast Tamer of the human and phoenix races like General Mu Huiyin and even the empress in history?”
“Huh? Wait…” Zhang Qianyi opened her mouth slightly and was suddenly stunned. This change made her unable to react for a moment.
Shi Yu said, “There have been mixed-blood Beast Tamers since ancient times. After the empress dynasty, they completely integrated into Dong Huang. However, after so long of development, the other mixed-blood families have been passed down, but for some historical reasons, the Phoenix Race’s mixed-blood has already been severed in Dong Huang.”
“Not long ago, I found a way to help human Beast Tamers awaken the Phoenix bloodline, but there are some requirements for the Beast Tamer’s talent. Did you see that radar just now? It found you, which means that you’re that one in a million human with the Phoenix bloodline aptitude. Of course, it’s also possible that your ancestor is a hybrid of the Phoenix Race, but the bloodline in your generation has thinned.”
“At the moment, I want to establish a Beast Tamer Corps mainly made up of mixed-blood Beast Tamers of the Phoenix Race. If you’re interested, I can help you become a mixed-blood of the Phoenix Race. After you graduate, you can come to the Phoenix Army to work. Of course, there are definitely benefits. After becoming a mixed-blood of the Phoenix Race, your meditation cultivation speed will be much faster. Apart from that, your physique will also exceed that of ordinary people, comparable to a real transcendent life form. Your lifespan will also increase greatly. The disadvantage is the same disadvantage that all mixed-blood Beast Tamers have…”
If it was easy to be countered by high-level creatures of the same race, or there might be difficulties getting pregnant. It was all the drawbacks of mixed-blood Beast Tamers.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Zhang Qianyi was even more confused. Her mind was a little confused.
Slow down.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Of course, you don’t have to make a decision in a hurry. Although the chances of becoming a legendary Beast Tamer after becoming a hybrid will become very high, your Beast Taming Talent is already very powerful. Even if you don’t become a hybrid, there’s a high chance of you becoming a powerful Beast Tamer in the future. Therefore, why don’t you go back and discuss with your teacher first? After careful consideration, you can make a decision?”

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - Buggy vs the Void Mantis (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Buggy vs the Void Mantis (3)
As he was an acquaintance and the impact of becoming a hybrid was huge, Shi Yu was not in a hurry to let the other party decide. It was better to follow her own wishes. After all, he didn’t want to become a hybrid himself, and others might not necessarily be willing.
“I… Then I’ll consider it,” Zhang Qianyi said.
After being stunned, she quickly reacted.
Firstly, there was no need for Shi Yu to lie to her.
Moreover, Lu Qingyi was still beside him.
If what Shi Yu said was true, she was actually willing. After all, be it Mu Huiyin or the empress, they were both female Beast Tamers of Dong Huang and figures worshiped by female Beast Tamers of Ancient Capital University. Most importantly, this was the Phoenix race, a race with rich myths and legends. It was much more attractive to women than mixed bloods of other races.
If Shi Yu said that there was a way to awaken into a “human pig” hybrid, probably not many people, male or female, would be willing… However, mythical creatures like dragons and phoenixes were different.
Apart from that, Shi Yu had just said that he had the intention to rebuild the Phoenix Army, and the Phoenix Army was the number one army during the era of the empress dynasty. Zhang Qianyi understood her talent. It was very difficult to become a legend, but if she could join such an army, the chances would definitely be much higher.
However… She looked at Shi Yu. Shi Yu was only in his second year. Did he already have the ability to decide to establish such a Beast Tamer army? Her heart was in conflict. She kept feeling that the difference between everyone was increasing.
Although that was the case, she still had to seek her teacher’s suggestion. After all, it was all thanks to her teacher’s digging that she could have her current achievements. Zhang Qianyi more or less had to take her suggestion as a reference.
“Alright, when you’ve decided, just contact me directly after thinking it through,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes, thank you,” Zhang Qianyi said.
The whole time, Lu Qingyi watched silently at the side. Everyone chatted for a while more. After Zhang Qianyi left, Lu Qingyi said, “You just said that you want to establish the Phoenix Army?”
Shi Yu looked at her and smiled. “How is it? Not a bad idea, right?”
“In fact, I still want to gather the six major armies in history.”
The strongest armies in each era. Wu Dynasty’s Iron-eating Beast Army, Empress Dynasty’s Phoenix Army, Dragon Emperor Dynasty’s Dragon Army, and the current strongest army, the Mechanical Army.
Apart from that, the Space Emperor’s spatial army could instantly let an army descend into the enemy’s core with the spatial teleportation array. They could also rely on the spatial array to kill and seal powerful enemies above their level.
As for Emperor Shi’s army, they all had military advisors who were proficient in the power of prophecy. They were known to be unpredictable. In addition to a series of time-element resources similar to the Time Fruit, their equipment was also very powerful.
At the moment, it seemed like it could be done?
“Forget it.” Lu Qingyi saw through it at a glance and sighed. “Are you sure it wouldn’t end up with you throwing it to others to carry it out after you came up with the ideas?? The Iron-eating Beast Army, the mechanical phantom beast army, and the Green Silkworm cocoon army in the ruins of Wu Ling City seem to be like this. White Brook told me everything.”
“Are you sure you won’t throw this Phoenix Army to others…”
Shi Yu came to a realization. So that was an option too. He said, “By the way, Senior, are you very familiar with the Phoenix Nest? I remember that your Green Spirit Wind Bird was contracted there, right? Why don’t you be in charge of this Phoenix Army?”
“I’ll give the technology and the resources, and you can give yourself to the cause.”
“Ah, right, isn’t Auntie working over there?”
Phoenix Nest, a ruins mystic realm where bird creatures lived. Some bird creatures inside had some phoenix bloodlines. Principal Feng successfully explored and cracked it when he was young. Then, Principal Feng left it to his daughter, Lu Qingyi’s mother. She was the current in-charge of this mystic realm. Because of this relationship, Lu Qingyi had also explored it many times over there.
Lu Qingyi: “?”
Upon hearing that Shi Yu had his eyes on her mother, Lu Qingyi immediately had a question mark on her face.
She patted her forehead.
Damn it, she clearly wanted to use Shi Yu as a tool in the beginning, so why was her family becoming his tool now?
She had a premonition that if Shi Yu looked for her mother, she definitely wouldn’t refuse…
“Okay, slow down there…”
….
Soon.
After the Void Mantis finished eating, it shouted and asked them when the battle would begin. In the ruins space, the various supplements provided to Buggy through the ginseng baby had almost helped finish its recovery.
Lu Qingyi was tired and brought these two guys to her legendary ruins.
In the ruins, the Void Mantis stretched its body with the question of why Shi Yu was so suicidal.
When it was at the monarch level, it could already defeat Shi Yu’s pet. Now that it had broken through, it felt that it could instantly kill Shi Yu!
“Why don’t all of you attack together?” The Void Mantis sighed.
It would be more fair. Wasn’t Shi Yu a top-notch master?
Wasn’t the standard of a top-notch master someone who could fight an overlord with all their members?
It was an overlord. Such rules were more reasonable!
Shi Yu was stunned. “There’s no need for that, but if Senior Mantis is free, you can take turns fighting them…”
The Void Mantis was undoubtedly a good sparring partner! A top-notch spatial overlord sparring partner was not that easy to find.
Of course, it would be better if the gem cat was willing to be a sparring partner. Unfortunately, this guy was even lazier than Shi Yu.
“Ah, I’m not late, right?” Speaking of the cat, the cat arrived. Just as Shi Yu and the Void Mantis were about to fulfill the agreement and fight, the guardian gem cat of Ancient Capital University knocked on the door and ran in to watch the commotion.

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - Buggy vs the Void Mantis (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Buggy vs the Void Mantis (4)
“Senior Ying.” In the ruins, Lu Qingyi immediately smiled when she saw the gem cat.
The Void Mantis also glanced at this totem.
“Senior Mantis, all the best. Be careful,” the gem cat encouraged. It was the gem cat who invited the Void Mantis for lunch today. As the host, it naturally had to greet the guests.
Although it was stronger than the Void Mantis, the gem cat still politely called the Void Mantis senior. After all, the other party was the secondary pet of the Space Emperor.
“All the best?” The Void Mantis was silent. What was there to cheer for in this battle without any suspense?
“Are you ready?” Lu Qingyi asked.
“It’s 1VS1, right?”
“Yes.” The Void Mantis and Shi Yu nodded.
At the same time, Shi Yu also summoned Buggy. Under the purple summoning array, the figure of the Imaginary Dream Butterfly appeared. Under the purple light, Buggy appeared in the sky with its huge body and looked at the Void Mantis.
“Wu…” The Void Mantis was stunned. It was this guy!
It looked at Shi Yu. Was it sure it wanted this kid to fight it?!!
No kidding?!
When Shi Yu was cultivating and working hard to break through to level six in the Space Emperor Ruins, all his pets had been sparring partners with the Void Mantis. Among them, Buggy was the one who was tortured the most by the Void Mantis.
The reason why Buggy could be very strong in the team was because of the speciality of the spatial element. However, when it encountered the Void Mantis with stronger spatial attainments, it felt like it was showing off in front of an expert. It was countered everywhere.
Therefore, the Void Mantis felt that this butterfly was the easiest to deal with in Shi Yu’s team. Its skills were like a child in front of it.
“Wu!!!” Buggy looked at the Void Mantis seriously, indicating that it was no longer the previous Buggy.
“What’s the difference…” The Void Mantis muttered.
Apart from the stronger energy fluctuations, it didn’t feel like there were any changes.
Although the energy fluctuations were stronger, it wasn’t too much more compared to before it broke through.
The Void Mantis shook its head and suddenly smiled. It looked at Shi Yu and spoke.
“Kid, do you want to bet?”
“What?” Shi Yu was stunned.
“If I win, let your ginseng baby prepare food for me for a month. How about that?”
It had been a long time since it had eaten a fruit made by a ginseng baby. It really missed it.
At first, it didn’t pay much attention to it and only treated it as a dessert after eating the power of the void, but after not eating for a few months, he really missed it.
Shi Yu was stunned. That wasn’t a big deal.
“Sure.”
“Then what if I win?”
Void Mantis: “?”
“You still want to win?”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. Didn’t this guy want to make a bet?
It still wanted to freeload?
“If I win, how about I get to come to the Space Emperor Ruins to cultivate anytime in the future?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s best if I can bring others along…”
The Void Mantis had a look of disdain. This guy wanted to use its ruins again!
Forget it, forget it!
“Fine, let’s begin.”
In any case, it wouldn’t lose.
The Void Mantis shook its head and revealed a bloodthirsty smile. Its body directly disappeared!!
It felt that it wouldn’t take more than one move to deal with this guy!!!
One move was enough!
At this moment, as the Void Mantis disappeared, Buggy’s expression turned cold. It felt a huge threat appear in its mind. At that moment, it seemed to have predicted the future!!
“Wu!!! (Dragon Ball, Possession!!)”
Buggy shouted in its heart. The legendary Dragon Ball in the spatial pocket immediately fused with it because of the Dragon of Imagination skill. At this moment, with the power of the legendary Dragon Ball and the Dragon of Imagination skill (Expert+11) that was only a step away from perfect proficiency, Buggy instantly emitted a powerful dragon might, and its strength increased explosively!!
It arrived at the top overlord state when it fought the Green Scaled Dragon. At the same time, it used its Psychic power to wrap itself!!
Swoosh!
A light that seemed to have broken through the darkness swung over and directly cut Buggy. When its black saber wrapped around the super skill Space Slash and attacked the enemy with the power of space, the Void Mantis had already expected the outcome.
The Void Mantis had already held back in this slash. It only used its monarch-level strength. If it used its overlord-level strength, it would probably kill the butterfly in front of it.
Even with the power of the monarch level, coupled with the spatial power mobilized, the Void Mantis felt that it was enough to heavily injure the little butterfly in its impression! However, with that ginseng baby to save it, it wasn’t a big problem.
“Huh?”
However, as the black saber landed, the expression of the Void Mantis in the air changed. The Butterfly of Imagination in front of it flapped its dreamy blue butterfly wings, and the butterfly wings wrapped in Psychic power blocked its attack!!
The spiritual power and the spatial blade intertwined and instantly froze.
“This is…” The moment it approached Buggy, it instantly sensed the terrifying dragon energy that had increased by more than ten times!!
Dragons had mixed attributes, and common mixed attributes were wind, water, thunder, and fire. However, the dragon fluctuations on Buggy’s body were spiritual and spatial. It was the dragon attribute strengthened by the Green Sky Divine Dragon Ball.
“70 million!!!” At the side, Lu Qingyi also spoke in surprise. She realized the change in Buggy. In the next moment, Buggy’s wings exerted strength, and with a boom, a spatial storm condensed, directly sending the Void Mantis in front of her flying!!
Fwoom!!

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - Buggy vs the Void Mantis (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Buggy vs the Void Mantis (5)
During the process of being sent flying, the Void Mantis wasn’t injured either, because Buggy had also held back. It was equivalent to warming up. At the same time, it was telling the Void Mantis its current strength. During the process of flying backward, the Void Mantis’s expression was shocked, and soon, its body stopped in midair.
“Time Fruit?” The mantis and Lu Qingyi asked at the same time.
However, in exchange, Shi Yu shook his head. The Void Mantis quickly understood. No, it wasn’t the Time Fruit.
Using that fruit, it wasn’t that Buggy couldn’t obtain overlord-level power, but it definitely wasn’t that high. Moreover, the side effects of that fruit were huge. After Shi Yu’s pet ate it and stepped into the overlord level, it would collapse in two to three moves at most. It definitely wouldn’t be that calm!
The Void Mantis looked at the calm state of the Butterfly of Imagination and immediately understood that it could even maintain this state for a long time. It was definitely not an overlord with only one or two moves!!
“It was with the help of external props. Senior Mantis, you shouldn’t mind, right?” Shi Yu asked.
Compared to when it fought the Void Mantis previously, Buggy’s greatest change was that it wore divine armor.
“Heh, let me put it this way, it’s also your strength to be able to reach this realm with external tools.” The Void Mantis smiled excitedly. So that was the case. This way, it could also let loose. This guy could actually use tools to reach such power. No wonder it dared to challenge it!!
However, this was still not enough. It still had strength, but it looked like its skills were lacking!!
“How many tools do you have? Use them all. However, the gap between the monarch level and the overlord level isn’t that easy to cross with external objects!! Its spatial element is still a little young!” The Void Mantis laughed crazily, its face gradually distorting. It was a battle maniac to begin with. The pets in Shi Yu’s team more or less knew its abnormality in battle.
“Of course I know this…” Shi Yu also took a deep breath. He naturally didn’t expect Buggy to defeat the Void Mantis with the power of the Dragon Ball.
Under the circumstances where Buggy’s various spatial skill proficiency was crushed by the Void Mantis, even if its energy level was 20 to 30 million higher, the chances of winning were not high.
However, if space didn’t work, what about relying on the bug element?
This time, the Void Mantis didn’t rashly teleport over. Instead, in the distance, its two blades merged. In the next moment, spatial sword dances filled the sky. The gray sword light was like a light blade that could cut through space, directly crushing towards Buggy like a tsunami!!
This time, the Void Mantis used the power of an overlord. It wanted to see what realm Buggy could reach with external help!!
“Wu!!! (Senior, sorry!!)” In the face of the Void Mantis’s attack, Buggy also took a deep breath and directly used the mental strength of a top-notch overlord to transform!!
In the next moment, a huge black mist that kept rolling and festering appeared from Buggy’s body. Then, the sky darkened, and spatial fluctuations surged around Buggy. An incomparably huge body dozens of meters tall descended!!
“Moo!!!”
As for Buggy, it was instantly wrapped in its body and hid inside the iron wall!!
This was the body of the Black Meteorite Yak Totem!!
Although it had already been blown into shape by Baby Ginseng, under the continuous repair of the worm silk and phantom illusion, it finally recovered some battle power!
Boom!!
The powerful spatial blade descended on its huge body, but it only sliced open a small portion of its body before being blocked. Even if it was a corpse, its physical strength was still terrifying!!
Right on the heels of that, the body sliced open by the spatial blade was quickly repaired by white worm silk!!
In the huge black mist, part of the Black Meteorite Yak’s body was constantly sliced open and repaired, revealing terrifying body organs.
It had sticky black flesh, a mouth dripping with mucus, and short distorted legs. At the end of its legs was a black hoof that could barely be called a “bull” hoof, making it emit terrifying power.
As the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet descended, the first round of attacks of the Void Mantis was directly resisted by this puppet with the worm silk without injury. On the other side, the Void Mantis opened its mouth wide and looked at this totem corpse puppet, a little stunned.
What was this!
Boom!!
Before the Void Mantis could react, Buggy controlled the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet to stomp in the air!!
“Moo!!!” As light appeared in the black mist-like eyes, a huge hoof that seemed to be able to crush space crushed towards the Void Mantis!!
The huge leg that was like a mountain swept across. At this moment, the Void Mantis felt an even stronger threat than when Buggy used the legendary Dragon Ball. It widened its eyes and looked at the descending black hoof. It wanted to quickly teleport and escape, but this physical attack that seemed to be able to shatter space directly caused countless spatial cracks to scratch the body of the Void Mantis during the teleportation.
Boom!!!
A huge pit was stepped into the ground.
Buzz!!!
The Void Mantis appeared in the sky in a flash. It looked at the disappearing figure of the worm and the figure of the Black Meteorite Yak that appeared and immediately cursed with an explosive expression. It had already sensed that this thing… Was the body of a f*cking top-notch totem!!
That worm was hiding inside!!! Controlling it!!
Although it no longer had life force, with the control of the worm silk and the power of imagination, its strength was still terrifying.
“You, you cheated!!!” The Void Mantis cursed and said, “Is this thing something a level-six Beast Tamer can obtain??”
“I said you could use props, not the corpses of top-notch totems!!!”
“I won’t bet with you anymore!!”
The Void Mantis regretted it. Who knew what this guy could take out later!
It couldn’t afford to play with this guy!
It wasn’t the only one. At this moment, when she saw the corpse of the Black Meteorite Yak, even Lu Qingyi was momentarily absent-minded with a shocked expression.
What was this?!
Top-notch totem corpse?
“Why not?” Shi Yu was immediately stunned when he saw the Void Mantis trying to shrug off the bet. He said, “Why can’t we use the totem corpse we hunted ourselves?”
“Don’t you know the profession of Gu Master, Senior Void Mantis?”
“This is even more legal and scientific than using props.”
The Void Mantis was furious. “Bullshit, this is even more ridiculous than your rank 11 in the sequence. You hunted a top-notch totem!!!”
“Cough, cough.” At the side, the gem cat muttered softly, “But he really killed it… I’ve said before, Senior Mantis, be careful and don’t underestimate them. This kid is sinister… Why did you court death and raise a bet yourself?”
The Void Mantis: ???
When the Void Mantis heard the totem cat’s words, the corners of its mouth twitched, and its gaze was stunned. What did this totem cat just say? Impossible, impossible, impossible. Was it trying to lie to it?! It wasn’t an uneducated mantis, alright?!

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - Chapter 732: Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (1)
The Void Mantis was naturally not unfamiliar with the profession of Gu Master.
Even in ancient times, this profession was especially prosperous.
It wasn’t like it had never fought a Gu Master.
However, the Gu Master in its impression seemed to be completely different from Shi Yu!
It had never heard of a level-six Gu Master who could control a top-notch totem body as a puppet!
Where did an ordinary level-six Beast Tamer get a top-notch totem body puppet?
Was this some novel titled “My Legendary Beast Tamer Father”?
Even if there was, how could it be controlled by a monarch-level bug-type creature?
Of course, what made the Void Mantis most unwilling was that the gem cat said that Shi Yu had hunted this thing himself?
Bullsh*t!
Even in the Space Emperor’s team, half of them weren’t even totems!
It was an extremely powerful creature. How could a level-six Beast Tamer kill it!
Even if Shi Yu was one level higher, it wouldn’t believe it!
“Senior Ying, is what you said true?”
Not to mention the Void Mantis, even Lu Qingyi was very confused and shocked when she heard the gem cat say this.
How was this possible…
Shi Yu said, “Cough, there’s an element of trickery. This totem has been sealed for 2000 years. When it woke up, it didn’t even have the strength of an ordinary totem.”
“We successfully killed it in its cradle before it could react…”
Lu Qingyi’s mouth opened slightly.
The Void Mantis also widened its eyes.
Bastard! He was explaining it so seriously?!
They wanted to hear this guy say “just kidding”, not explain why the hunt was successful!
No matter what its state was, it was still a totem.
“Senior Mantis, are we still fighting or not? You can’t go back on your word,” Shi Yu said.
The Void Mantis had delivered itself to his door, so how could Shi Yu not want it?
The meditation cultivation effect in the Space Emperor Ruins was even better than Lu Qingyi’s legendary ruins and Ji Mengzhu’s legendary ruins. It was specially modified by the Space Emperor and might be useful in the future.
Even if he obtained the blessings of the World Tree later and didn’t need it, letting the Void Mantis use the ruins to guide Shi Yu’s friends and family was a good choice.
“You’re the one who didn’t consider the virtue of the duel first!”
“You’re the one who didn’t talk about virtue first!”
It didn’t know if it should believe Shi Yu or the gem cat.
If it was true, it wanted to curse this cow to death!
What kind of trash was this damn cow? Why was it killed by a level-six Beast Tamer??
Damn it.
It originally thought that dealing with Buggy would be very easy, but as Buggy used the legendary Dragon Ball and the totem body puppet one after another, the Void Mantis was slightly annoyed.
It wasn’t afraid of fighting experts, but seeing a junior who was originally inferior to it cheat his way to the same level of strength as it in just a few months was a little unbalanced! Unbalanced! Did anyone understand?
Moreover, if it lost, wouldn’t it be very embarrassing!
The Void Mantis looked at the yak totem solemnly and seriously. Then, it took a deep breath.
So that was the case.
It was indeed a weak totem, and when it died, its body had already been destroyed beyond recognition!
Otherwise, if it was a perfect top-notch totem body, its spatial blade just now might not necessarily be able to break through its defense.
It was shocked just now. Now that he took a closer look, this totem puppet was completely strong on the outside but weak on the inside. The powerful appearance it had was all because of Buggy’s “power of imagination”!
It no longer had any strength. Even its physical strength was much weaker!
Under normal circumstances, even if Buggy reached the overlord level with the help of the Dragon Ball, it was very unlikely to use the worm silk to control the Black Meteorite Yak’s body. However, Buggy used a trick to repair this body through the “Illusionary Phantom”.
Phantom illusions could materialize illusions with materials…
The Black Meteorite Yak had been blown up by Baby Ginseng previously. The reason why it could be so complete now was because Buggy used the remaining physical body as materials and imagined constructing a complete Black Meteorite Yak.
In other words, “repair”.
Because at the moment, the Black Meteorite Yak was repaired by Buggy through the power of imagination and worm silk, and so Buggy obtained the right to control this puppet. But even so, because the physical exhaustion was too serious and the parasitic method wasn’t brilliant, Buggy couldn’t obtain the complete right to control it like those legendary Gu Masters.
Buggy didn’t have the ability to let this puppet release the skills it had when it was alive. Not even a low-level skill. It could only purely use its physical strength as a shield!
Realizing this, the Void Mantis pondered for a moment. So that was the case. If that was the case, as long as it dragged this guy down, it could win. If it was controlling this big guy and using the Dragon Ball to become stronger, Buggy would definitely suffer a huge consumption.
Apart from that, if it found the weakness of this puppet and defeated it, it could also pull out the worm inside!
“Continue!!!”
When the Void Mantis thought of this, it attacked again!!
This time, it chose to fight a long-range battle of attrition with Buggy!
It was at the overlord level. It could mobilize the power of the void to strengthen skills like how it mobilized the power of nature. Its consumption would decrease greatly. In a battle of attrition, the Void Mantis felt that it was not a problem to fight for a day and night.
But it believed that the worm opposite definitely couldn’t last.
As for the puppet, although it was strong on the outside, it was also weak on the inside. It didn’t have the true power of a totem. Facing its spatial attainments, it couldn’t cause fatal damage to it. It just had to increase the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 733 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (2)
chapters.content:
733 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (2)
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!!!
The Void Mantis floated far away from the Black Meteorite Yak and kept using the spatial blade to consume energy.
“They’re fighting again…” Seeing this, Lu Qingyi, who was watching the battle, was slightly stunned.
The gem cat chuckled and said, “Guess who will lose.”
Lu Qingyi was silent. It was completely hard to say. In the beginning, she felt that the Void Mantis had a 100% chance of winning, but now, as Shi Yu took out the totem puppet, she directly lost her judgment of the situation.
Fortunately, she didn’t listen to the Void Mantis’s instigation to challenge Shi Yu to increase his Sequence ranking…
Although she had used the legendary resources distributed by Ancient Capital University to strengthen the Courtyard Sprite to the overlord level, Lu Qingyi felt that it was very difficult for her and the sprite to be Buggy’s match now.
This was very ridiculous. Why was the increase in strength of Shi Yu’s team’s pets even greater than her breakthrough?
“Senior Ying, what do you think?”
The gem cat said, “Well, if the Void Mantis can’t crack the puppet, Shi Yu will win. If it can crack the puppet, it will win.”
“In a battle of attrition, the Void Mantis might not necessarily be comparable to Shi Yu and Buggy.”
Lu Qingyi: “Huh??”
She quickly looked at the battlefield. What did it mean? Could a worm that relied on equipment and totem puppets to increase its strength last longer than a real overlord?
The defense power brought by the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet indeed made Buggy extremely at ease.
At this moment, the Void Mantis didn’t notice at all that the attrition strategy it chose was exactly what Buggy wanted!
After entering the Black Meteorite Yak’s body, without the worry of being insta-killed, Buggy immediately began to use its strongest strategy!!
Worm Command+Ultimate Absorption+Imagination Phantom combination skill!!!
[Swarm Command]: A high-level bug-type skill of the bug-type and spiritual-type. It can use its mind to control the larva puppet to complete various commands in its place. After the larva dies, it will return to the main body in the form of a special bug-type signal, increasing the main body’s attributes in all aspects.
[Ultimate Absorption]: A bug-type super skill. It can absorb the enemy’s life force and energy value by attacking the enemy to recover its injuries and physical fitness.
Under normal circumstances, Buggy would use “concealment” to dodge and use this combination skill in an alternate space. However, the problem was that the spatial attainments of the Void Mantis were too strong, and Buggy couldn’t dodge in a spatial situation.
The appearance of the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet solved this problem. It could completely let Buggy have no worries and control the Phantom Puppet to fight the enemy. Then, with the help of the Phantom Puppet’s death in battle, it could constantly strengthen itself and recover its physical fitness. It would fight a battle of attrition!
Using this strategy consumed much less energy than controlling the totem puppet to fight.
“Roar!!!!!”
At this moment, the surrounding environment of the yak seemed to have become a huge valley under the modification of the power of imagination. Between the mountain walls, hundreds of Dragon God statues of different forms were carved!
Among them, there was a sea dragon, wind dragon, thunder dragon, and serpent dragon. Each individual form was unique, emitting an incomparable dragon might.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, in the Imagination Domain, every Dragon God Statue was lifelike and filled with deterrence, as if it had come alive.
On their bodies, illusions slowly appeared, gradually forming the bodies of divine dragons that flew into the sky. For a moment, the dragons in the sky danced around in extreme shock.
At that moment, they were the “swarm” controlled by Buggy!!
Divine dragons were born one after another. Seeing this scene, the Void Mantis revealed a disdainful expression. They were just a group of illusions.
They looked strong, but it could kill one with one slash!
Wasn’t this a waste of strength?
Buggy definitely couldn’t last long!
“Roar!!!”
A sea dragon was the first to fly over. Its entire body was filled with water, and it waved its claws. But in an instant, the Void Mantis dodged its water dragon claws. With a flash of light, the Void Mantis that appeared above the Sea Dragon God again cut the Dragon God in half!
The illusion disappeared!
“That’s all.”
The Void Mantis spoke, but as soon as it finished speaking, it was stunned. It saw that the power fluctuations of the shattered Sea Dragon Phantom actually didn’t disappear. Instead, it transmitted to the Black Meteorite Yak’s body in a strange signal pattern.
At the same time, the strength of the Butterfly of Imagination’s spiritual wave instantly increased by another level, reducing the burden of controlling the legendary Dragon Ball.
“What the hell!!” Seeing this, the Void Mantis was stunned.
In the next moment.
“Roar!!!” Another lightning dragon flashed with lightning and collided. The Void Mantis could only kill the enemy, but with this kill, the dead lightning dragon’s power once again increased the spiritual power of the worm in the Black Meteorite Yak’s body in the form of an insect-type signal!
The expression of the Void Mantis turned cold. In the next round, it tried to interfere with the spatial magnetic field and establish a barrier to block the signal from being transmitted back. Only then did it stop Buggy from being strengthened continuously!
However, the Void Mantis quickly realized that doing this consumed a lot of energy. Its expression couldn’t help but darken.
This wasn’t a meaningless waste of strength!
After these illusions died, they could still return to strengthen their main bodies. So disgusting!!
And if it wanted to stop it, it could only consume more energy!
Because this wasn’t a spatial skill, it couldn’t be broken through with pure skill. It could only rely on brute force.
No, it had to quickly crack the puppet and catch that worm!!
“The power of illusions can be used like this??”
Lu Qingyi, who was watching the battle, quickly discovered the characteristics of the illusions created by Buggy and couldn’t help but be shocked.
After being killed, it could still return to the main body to strengthen its main body. This was too torturous for the opponent.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 734 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (3)
chapters.content:
734 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (3)
What they didn’t know was that this wasn’t the use of illusions at all, but a combination skill of illusions and another bug-type skill!
“The torture is still to come,” the gem cat muttered.
In the blink of an eye, the Void Mantis had already used spatial cutting to kill more than ten Dragon God phantoms.
As there were too many opponents, it was inevitable that it would miss out on blocking the signals. Many death signals still returned to Buggy’s main body.
The Buggy’s mental fluctuations in the Black Meteorite Yak also quickly rose to a higher level.
At this moment, the Void Mantis was helpless, but it quickly understood. It still felt that the other party wouldn’t be its match in a battle of attrition!
After all, the level difference was there.
Continue!
Swoosh!!!
Most of the Void Mantis’s attention was focused on the Black Meteorite Yak’s body, searching for weaknesses.
However, as the saying went, a wise man would definitely make a mistake. After easily cutting down so many divine dragon phantoms, a ginseng baby phantom wearing hardened armor riding on the divine dragon phantom made the pupils of the Void Mantis shrink.
The divine dragon phantom was divided into two by the Void Mantis, but the Undying Sun Ginseng phantom in the Space Quake Hardening Armor leaped up.
Its body emitted light beside the Void Mantis.
“Yi! (Buggy is so handsome!)” Baby Ginseng’s phantom shouted!
Boom!!!!
The powerful self-destruction wave coupled with the nature of the Space Quake instantly shattered the surrounding space. Even if the Void Mantis dodged very timely, some injuries were inevitable.
Not only was there a divine dragon phantom, but there was also a teammate phantom!
Using the mental-type skill Heart Strike and super vision, Buggy successfully found the other party’s mistake after a few rounds of confrontation.
The Void Mantis was looking for the puppet’s weakness, and it was also looking for the Void Mantis’ mistake!
“Damn, damn, damn…”
It was this attack that almost made the Void Mantis curse.
During the process of flying backward, the Void Mantis covered its wound with its black saber with constricted pupils.
Because it felt that it had dodged this attack in time. The damage the move caused to itself was definitely limited, but being hit was an outcome that was beyond the expectations of the Void Mantis.
A force directly extracted a portion of its life force and energy.
Moreover, it transmitted to the Butterfly of Imagination in an even stronger bug-type signal method. Even its spatial barrier couldn’t block it.
“Why can it also absorb vitality and energy!!!” The Void Mantis was about to curse.
This guy could use the endurance skill of sucking blood and mana in a battle of attrition! What the hell was this!
“This is…”
Seeing the panicked expression of the Void Mantis, Lu Qingyi said, “Buggy can absorb life force from the damage caused to the Void Mantis?”
The gem cat nodded and said, “So you know why I said it’ll get even more disgusting later, right?”
Lu Qingyi was speechless. The gem cat had been by Shi Yu’s side for a long time, so it clearly knew more about Shi Yu’s pet situation.
She finally believed the gem cat’s words.
If this continued, the Void Mantis might really be in danger!!
This strategy was so dirty!
Lu Qingyi herself definitely didn’t want to fight this strategy.
The enemy hid in an indestructible puppet and released a Phantom Little Brother. After the Phantom Little Brother died, it could still strengthen the main body. The Phantom Little Brother could even suck blood and mana when it hit the enemy. How could there be such a dirty strategy!
At this moment, the Void Mantis also completely panicked, because it felt that as Buggy’s mental strength increased again, the strength of the divine dragon phantom it continued to create increased gradually.
Swoosh!!!
The Void Mantis’s black saber slashed at a black dragon beside it again, but this attack couldn’t instantly kill the other party. Under the other party’s final counterattack and the encirclement of the surrounding divine dragons, the Void Mantis’s body was directly sent flying by a dragon tail!!
“F*ck…”
Spatial attack!!
The concealment was broken, and its body fell. The Void Mantis felt a portion of its physical fitness being extracted again.
When Buggy used this move to fight Eleven and Baby Ginseng, who also had endurance, the effect was not very good. However, now that it was used to fight the Void Mantis without endurance, Buggy instantly experienced extreme joy.
However, in contrast, the Void Mantis was extremely aggrieved at this moment. It realized that it couldn’t continue like this.
It didn’t know the limits of Buggy under this strategy at all.
If this continued, it would be disadvantageous to it.
Finally, the disgusted Void Mantis suddenly noticed a problem.
As it flew backward, it looked at Shi Yu, who was watching the battle with a smile outside the arena. It was furious.
It seemed to have thought of something and smiled. It stopped and looked at the Black Meteorite Yak puppet opposite it, at the dragons in the sky, and at Buggy and Shi Yu opposite it.
Stretching out its arm, the black saber pointed at Shi Yu and the others and said, “By the way, Beast Taming battles allow attacks on the Beast Tamer himself, right?”
“Little worm, I advise you to come out and fight me. Otherwise, I’ll teleport to your Beast Tamer’s side now and use him as a hostage.”
“With the Beast Tamer gone, fighting me again is no different from losing.”
“You can’t spare any energy to protect a Beast Tamer with such a big puppet, right?”
The Void Mantis gave up. What it said was naturally very reasonable. After all, apart from the battles that protected newcomer trainees, even in competitions, one could basically attack the Beast Tamer himself.
However, be it the challenge of the Space Emperor Ruins or the current battle, as a “senior”, the Void Mantis had never done this.
However, this time, it was forced into a corner. It was enough to see the disgusting level of Buggy’s strategy. Upon hearing that, not only the Buggy in the puppet, but also Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and the gem cat, who were watching the battle, were stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 735 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (4)
chapters.content:
735 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (4)
She didn’t expect that as a senior, even the Void Mantis had also started to throw virtue out the window.
“Eh, I didn’t expect this move just now!!!” At this moment, the gem cat came to a realization and said, “As expected, the older the wiser. In a 1VS1 situation, we can just use Shi Yu’s safety to force Buggy out of the puppet.”
Lu Qingyi coughed and looked at the Void Mantis. She felt… felt that Senior Mantis’s mentality had indeed collapsed. Otherwise, there was no need to be so ruthless when facing two juniors.
“Wu… (For your own good, I advise you not to…)”
“For your own good, I advise you not to…”
However, in the face of the threat of the Void Mantis, Shi Yu and Buggy spoke in unison.
“If you don’t come out, I’m serious!” The Void Mantis ignored Buggy and Shi Yu. Seeing that Buggy still had no intention of coming out, it aimed its gaze at Shi Yu.
Although Shi Yu had the gift of telepathy and didn’t give Buggy any bonuses in battle, and it wasn’t appropriate to capture him, the Void Mantis didn’t want to lose.
It was true that it liked to fight, but like Eleven, it liked to fight the enemy’s main body. What the hell was this battle against a group of suicidal clones!!
Facing Shi Yu, a level-six Beast Tamer, the Void Mantis was much calmer.
Even if Shi Yu was at the Legend level, even if Shi Yu could use the ruins and have the spatial etherealization ability, it could actually instantly turn Shi Yu into a hostage. After all, it was a spatial overlord.
The Void Mantis chuckled and teleported towards Shi Yu!!! It planned to use a hostage and force Buggy!!
It wanted to let Shi Yu and Buggy realize that society was very sinister.
The Void Mantis planned to teach Shi Yu and Buggy a lesson.
In the next second, spatial ripples appeared in front of Shi Yu. Facing a top-notch assassin like the Void Mantis, Buggy indeed couldn’t react and protect Shi Yu immediately.
Controlling puppets and illusions was already its limit.
At this moment, Lu Qingyi’s expression was serious. The gem cat beside her also grinned, preparing to see Shi Yu suffer.
There weren’t many times that it could make Shi Yu suffer. The gem cat estimated that this would be a rare occasion.
Unless Shi Yu let other pets take action, Shi Yu was destined to become a hostage. However, letting other pets other than Buggy take action was against the rules of this duel.
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the spatial ripple in front of him helplessly. A light appeared in his eyes. “I said it’s best not to do this… I don’t want to use this move…”
If it were two months ago, Shi Yu really had no choice when facing this battle strategy of the Void Mantis. Apart from letting other pets attack, he could only wait to be controlled.
With his monarch-level dragon physique, he couldn’t resist the attack of a spatial overlord at all.
However, the version had already changed. In two months, although Shi Yu had still not successfully developed the “Telepathy Talent” a second time and was stuck at the last step, his cultivation of spiritual power had already become more and more perfect.
At this moment, as spatial ripples flashed, the Void Mantis descended in front of Shi Yu. Its gaze was filled with ill intentions and it looked sinister. At this moment, something unexpected happened around Shi Yu. The air began to hum and vibrate, and almost corporeal spiritual power formed a blue outline around Shi Yu.
At the same time, the worm in the Black Meteorite Yak’s body in the distance seemed to have completed resonance with Shi Yu. The terrifying spiritual energy fluctuations on its body erupted, and a blue Psychic outline appeared on the huge Black Meteorite Yak.
One of the derived skills of Dao Proficiency Psychic, Spirit Strengthening.
Second skill of Dao Proficiency Psychic Derivation, Spiritual Link.
With the help of the spiritual connection of the contract, Shi Yu and Buggy strengthened their mental connection. A terrifying spiritual power wave bloomed from Shi Yu’s body, and Shi Yu’s pupils were instantly dyed in an extremely deep blue.
At this moment, the Void Mantis that had just descended was slightly stunned and had yet to react.
In the distance, the gem cat and Lu Qingyi were also stunned when they sensed the terrifying mental fluctuations close to the totem level that suddenly appeared on Shi Yu’s body.
At this moment, Shi Yu seemed to have turned into a spiritual-type human-type ferocious beast close to the totem level. His eyes were filled with infinitely deep mental strength. As the Void Mantis descended, Shi Yu raised his arm and aimed his palm at the Void Mantis.
When the Void Mantis was not very guarded against Shi Yu, a level-six Beast Tamer, its entire body was instantly wrapped in a powerful spiritual power. The strength of this spiritual power directly made the expression of the Void Mantis change, and its gaze was filled with disbelief.
Looking at Shi Yu, who looked like a top-notch overlord ferocious beast, for a moment, it didn’t know what had happened.
In the next moment, Shi Yu squeezed his palm and swung his arm. With a boom, the Void Mantis was directly thrown to the Black Meteorite Yak’s side like a blue meteor by Psychic power. During the process of being thrown away, the space around the Void Mantis trembled and the air wailed. It still had a stunned expression!!
“Moo!!!! (I’ve already advised you not to!!)”
Seeing that Senior Void Mantis didn’t listen to his advice and ran to attack the Beast Tamer, Buggy was also helpless. If it were a few months ago, it wouldn’t have been a problem. However, the problem was that after Shi Yu also learned max-level Psychic power, its and Shi Yu’s mental strength could be connected and strengthened.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 736 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (5)
chapters.content:
736 Shi Yu’s Superpower Form (5)
At this moment, Buggy’s already terrifying spiritual power had been strengthened by Shi Yu again. Its burden had also reached a certain upper limit. However, when it saw the mantis suddenly get sent flying over after constantly dodging the Black Yak, it immediately chuckled.
It knew that it was over.
Boom!!!
The huge black ox hoof stepped in the air. The Void Mantis opened its mouth wide, still unable to understand why Shi Yu’s telepathy talent had just displayed such power. A black shadow filled the air in front of it, and it was instantly suppressed with a boom!!
“Bastard…” In the vibration, the miserable cry of the Void Mantis came. It still didn’t understand at all.
At this moment, looking at Shi Yu, who was covered in spiritual power fluctuations like a top-notch overlord, Lu Qingyi and the gem cat had yet to recover. They gulped and looked at him with shocked expressions.
Lu Qingyi was extremely confused. Just now, Shi Yu used Psychic power??
No, apart from that, there was also mental strengthening!!
She could sense that Buggy’s mental fluctuations had suddenly increased by a lot as Shi Yu’s body changed. It was as if Shi Yu had used his mental strength to strengthen his Beast Taming Talent.
However, wasn’t Shi Yu’s telepathy talent? Wasn’t Shi Yu a human? How could a human use Psychic power?
Wait a minute, it was indeed possible for non-pure-blood mixed-blood Beast Tamers to use superpowers, but Shi Yu wasn’t a mixed-blood either.
Even the transcendent abilities of mixed-blood Beast Tamers were still weaker than pets. How could they be as strong as this?
The consecutive reversals made Lu Qingyi’s brain a little confused.
“Senior Ying…”
“F*ck.” The gem cat was also a little stunned and couldn’t react for a moment. This was because in the past two months, even when Shi Yu developed Psychic power, it wasn’t beside Shi Yu and had already returned to the Ancient Capital.
However, the gem cat indeed knew more than Lu Qingyi. It immediately thought of Shi Yu’s “body control” talent. The original owner of that talent, Legend Bai Chuan, also knew Psychic power!
However, although it was all psychic power, and Bai Chuan having psychic power was understandable, what was going on with Shi Yu?!
Why was his Psychic power stronger than the original owner’s talent?!!!
....
The battle undoubtedly ended in the defeat of the Void Mantis.
If it fought Buggy normally, it would be just as the gem cat said. It was still uncertain who would win. As long as it kept attacking, hitting vital points, cracking the puppet that was always repaired with illusions… If it succeeded in pulling out Buggy, the victory would most likely be its.
However, no one expected the Void Mantis to choose the smarty pants method and run to control Shi Yu to force Buggy out. It was forced to turn the “real 1VS1” into “fake 1VS1”.
After the battle ended, Shi Yu looked at the shocked expressions of the gem cat, Senior Lu, and the others. He looked at the arm of the Void Mantis that was swaying and trying to rise on the battlefield and fell silent.
Ah…
His head hurt.
Shi Yu covered his head. During this period of time, he had experienced the pain of a Beast Tamer with a strengthening talent a lot. Strengthening with the derived skill of Psychic power consumed much more energy than strengthening with the Beast Taming Talent. Even for Buggy, who had become stronger after strengthening, it could only last for a while.
The intense headache after using it was also why Shi Yu didn’t want to use it at the start.
But what could they do? The Void Mantis charged at him…
The gem cat and Lu Qingyi quickly came over. They looked at the messy battlefield and Shi Yu, who was knocking his head, and were speechless.
“Cough, looks like I won. Baby Ginseng, treat Senior Mantis first…” Under his headache, Shi Yu still shouted for Baby Ginseng.
After Baby Ginseng came out, it looked at the situation on the battlefield and shook its head repeatedly.
It was unknown if Senior Mantis was lucky or unlucky to have drawn Buggy.
At the moment, although Buggy might not be the strongest in a one-on-one battle in the team, with Shi Yu’s mental strengthening, Buggy’s strength was still very fierce without the strengthening of other pets.
“I… I want an explanation…” At this moment, the Void Mantis looked up at the sky weakly. It stretched out its arm and shouted under Baby Ginseng’s rapid treatment.
This was unscientific!
“Cough, I’ll explain it to you, I’ll explain it to you.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek and looked at the gem cat, the Void Mantis, and Senior Lu. “But Senior Mantis, I won this battle, right?”
The Void Mantis: “Ah… I… This is bullsh*t…”
It was extremely unconvinced to be defeated by a monarch-level butterfly. It felt that… It was too ashamed to face the Space Emperor.
At the side, Lu Qingyi couldn’t bear to look at the miserable Void Mantis. She never expected this outcome. She felt that she was still sixth in the Sequence…
She decided to forget about the Sequence ranking and pass the legend assessment first.
She had already contacted the association to take the assessment. It was said that the headquarters would send a local acquaintance from the Ancient Capital to take the assessment for her…
....
In a big villa in the Ancient Capital, Master Qu Jie, who had already been promoted to the headquarters of the Imperial Capital’s Beast Taming Association to be in charge of the legend assessment, returned home excitedly.
After his position was promoted, he was assigned an overlord-level senior as a partner and became one of the legend examiners. However, there were pitifully few legend assessments in the country. Most of the time, he was very free.
Therefore, two months ago, he and some other colleagues were sent by the association to bring a group of young Beast Tamers to the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua to exchange activities. They had just returned to the country nearly two days ago.
As soon as he returned to the country, Master Qu Jie received good news one after another. His daughter, Qu Ling, had returned from a mission and was waiting for him in the Ancient Capital!!
It was also because of this that the headquarters directly gave Master Qu Jie two months off. However, although there were many holidays, they had to carry out another mission, which was to give Lu Qingyi, who had just broken through in the Ancient Capital, a legendary assessment.
Master Qu Jie could be said to be extremely emotional. Lu Qingyi, the proud daughter of heaven in the Ancient Capital. He didn’t expect that she had also broken through to the Legend level now. Letting him, a new examiner, be in charge of the assessment was probably because of the fact that they were from the same hometown.
At the thought of his daughter’s return and the new legend genius in the Ancient Capital, Master Qu Jie felt double joy.
“Dad!!” Just as he arrived home, Master Qu Jie saw his daughter, Qu Ling, running out to welcome him. Seeing that her daughter was still so beautiful, Master Qu Jie cried.
“Old pal, look who’s back.” After seeing his daughter, Master Qu Jie immediately summoned his initial pet, the Ox-Headed Beast King. Although the Ox-Headed Beast King was now the weakest pet in his team, it was the closest pet to Master Qu Jie’s family.
When Qu Ling was young, the Ox-Headed Beast King often accompanied her to play. In addition, the Ox-Headed Beast King was not young anymore, and Qu Ling even called it “Grandpa Ox” warmly.
“Roar!!” After the Ox-Headed Beast King came out, it also looked at the grown-up little girl happily.
At this moment, Qu Ling ran to her father and the Ox-Headed Beast King and said, “Dad, Grandpa Bull, I missed you guys so much. I thought I could see you when I returned, but I didn’t expect to wait so long.”
“Sorry, sorry.” Master Qu Jie smiled bitterly. If he knew that his daughter was coming back soon, he wouldn’t have gone abroad to learn and communicate no matter what.
Qu Ling smiled indifferently and said, “Dong Huang has changed so much now…”
“Yes, yes.” Qu Jie and the Ox-Headed Beast King looked very happy no matter what Qu Ling said. They felt that there were countless things to talk about later.
But in the next second, Qu Ling said, “By the way, Father, Grandpa Bull, you know Shi Yu, right? I heard that you were the ones who presided over his few assessments? Impressive!”
After returning to the country, she further understood Shi Yu’s power. Her father had actually witnessed the growth of such a super genius…
However, what she didn’t understand was why the smiles of her father and the Ox-Headed Beast King in front of her suddenly… stopped?

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 737 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (1)
chapters.content:
737 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (1)
After Baby Ginseng healed the Void Mantis, the Void Mantis got up trembling.
At this moment, Buggy had already recovered to its original state. The puppet retracted its spatial pocket, and the illusion had already been retracted.
It looked at the Void Mantis with an innocent expression, while the Void Mantis looked at Shi Yu and Buggy indignantly.
It was unwilling to accept the fact that it had lost.
“What was that?” it asked coldly.
If it didn’t relax when it approached Shi Yu and instead had the mentality of facing an opponent of the same level, it definitely wouldn’t have been unable to react!
It had been so “considerate” of Shi Yu so much. Shi Yu, this junior, was simply too much. What… was that just now?
The Void Mantis felt that it shouldn’t be wrong. That was a spiritual power wave much stronger than Buggy’s spiritual energy!
However, how could this power appear on a Beast Tamer?
Wasn’t Shi Yu’s telepathy talent?
It felt that… it had been beaten for no reason!
“Psychic power.” At this moment, Baby Ginseng was sitting on Shi Yu’s shoulder. He chuckled and said, “No matter what, Senior, I won, right?”
“I…” The Void Mantis cursed in its heart.
It knew it was Psychic power, but how could a non-hybrid Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent know Psychic power!
“It was developed with special resources. I used special resources to learn Psychic power. Then, I used special resources to increase Psychic proficiency to a high level. That was a qualitative change in the connection and strengthening of Buggy and my spiritual energy just now.”
“Senior Mantis, you didn’t lose in vain.” The gem cat grinned at the side. “A legendary equipment, a top-notch totem puppet, and a Beast Tamer who’s not human beside them as support. It’s very normal to be defeated by someone above your level.”
The Void Mantis glared. This guy was horrible with words. It lost!
It was just that it wasn’t serious and underestimated the enemy. If it fought seriously, they would all die!
“Why don’t we have another match?” Shi Yu pondered for a moment and said.
Let Eleven and the Void Mantis try again. At the moment, Eleven, who had mastered the perfect Undying Golden Body, was very fierce.
“Another…” The Void Mantis was just about to say that they should have another match, but its heart suddenly sank.
He suddenly recalled that this worm’s strength was not very good a few months ago.
Shi Yu’s black and white bear was much stronger than it back then.
If the increase of Shi Yu’s other pets was also so terrifying, it would still be dangerous!
No, the increase was definitely very terrifying.
It suddenly recalled the totem puppet. At this moment, as Shi Yu revealed more and more things, it suddenly believed that Shi Yu had hunted it himself.
If Shi Yu could even defeat a totem, then why would it fight this guy a second time?!
“There’s no need for an additional round. Although I didn’t perform well because I underestimated the enemy, there’s no need to argue with you juniors.”
“Let’s consider it your win.” The Void Mantis gritted its teeth. Legendary-level equipment and totem puppets could help humans learn Psychic power? At least, it had to be a legendary spiritual-type resource.
It looked at Shi Yu, this super rich guy. How rich was this guy!
Even the Space Emperor’s sons didn’t get this much stuff!
It felt more and more that the heirs of the Space Emperor, including the descendants of the rich families of the Space Emperor Dynasty, were much inferior to this guy.
“Anything is fine.”
Shi Yu chuckled. In any case, as long as the mantis didn’t back out, the cultivation rights of the Space Emperor Ruins were open to him at any time.
Shi Yu looked at Lu Qingyi, thinking about when he could provide her with the opportunity to cultivate spiritual power. However, at this moment, in the ruins space, Ling suddenly contacted Shi Yu through telepathy!
[Master, there’s progress in the research. You can try to fuse with the Kirin fossil to evolve.]
As soon as Ling finished speaking, Shi Yu was immediately stunned. Creating a school of superpowers and teaching superpowers were thrown to the back of his mind!
Kirin, Kirin, his Kirin!!
He looked at Lu Qingyi and said, “Senior, I still have one set of resources left. Perhaps there’s a chance for you to learn Psychic power too, but it might take a while.”
“Huh???” Lu Qingyi was in disbelief. “I can do it too?”
She had also seen Shi Yu’s performance just now. She also had a spiritual pet, the Imperial Concubine Flower. If she could learn a spiritual power skill of this level, it would undoubtedly increase everyone’s strength greatly.
Compared to battle-type Beast Tamers, a Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent was lacking in strengthening abilities. This was too important.
“Sure,” Shi Yu confirmed.
Upon hearing that, Lu Qingyi’s eyes turned watery. She was overjoyed. “Really? Then I won’t hold back.”
This kind of thing… couldn’t be rejected.
After thinking about it, Lu Qingyi said, “I’ll help you take good care of the Phoenix Army. Tell me if you need anything.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Wasn’t this girl very resistant previously?!
This change was too fast.
“Can’t you guys just be Beast Tamers with a normal telepathy talent?” At this moment, as it listened to Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi’s conversation, the corners of the Void Mantis’s mouth twitched. They had a telepathy talent, so stop adding any strange abilities!
“The World Tournament is so dangerous. One should have more abilities and trump cards.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Unfortunately, because he still had to use the Talent Bead to develop telepathy, there was also problem creating memory water droplets was too wasteful of Susu, Shi Yu, and Buggy’s time and energy, Shi Yu could only take care of Lu Qingyi, who also didn’t have battle talent.
Otherwise, without the pressure of the World Tournament, he would have to recruit disciples widely no matter what.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 738 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (2)
chapters.content:
738 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (2)
If anyone else wanted to learn all this psychic stuff that Shi Yu had, they had to pay up, naturally.
“World Tournament, World Tree…” The Void Mantis looked at Shi Yu and said,” There’s less than four months, right? ”
“At that time, I’ll follow you to join in the fun. My Beast Tamer once wanted to go to Inatella, but unfortunately, because the World Tree was sleeping, he couldn’t go. This time, I’ll go take a look on his behalf.”
Lu Qingyi said, “I promised Senior Mantis to bring it along when the time comes.”
“Of course.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “The various countries should still be able to bring a lot of spectators to every world competition.”
“Well… Senior, I just remembered that I still have something to do in the afternoon. Let’s talk during dinner.” Shi Yu couldn’t wait to go to Ling’s side to see the situation. He immediately said.
“Alright.” Lu Qingyi nodded slightly and said, “Then I’ll confirm the time of the legend assessment with the association.”
Even if one became a professional Beast Tamer, they could receive resources from the association every month and obtain a legendary Beast Tamer license. That was even more impressive. Every year, they could receive a batch of high-level resources above level seven. It would be a waste not to take the assessment.
At the same time, only those who had reached the Legendary level were qualified to run for the position of president of the Beast Tamer Association in first-level cities like Demon Capital and Ancient Capital. It could be said that after reaching the Legendary level, they had one foot in the core positions of higher-ups of Dong Huang.
For someone like Shi Yu, who had “medium” strength but had entered important departments in the country, his right to speak was extremely heavy. For him to casually build an army, talk and laugh with totems, and lead a bunch of overlords… They were just examples.
“Eh, you brat…” At this moment, seeing Shi Yu slip away so quickly, the gem cat rolled its eyes and felt that things weren’t that simple.
Usually, with Shi Yu’s panicked appearance, there should be something “good” waiting for him…
“…” At this moment, the Void Mantis was still very depressed as it watched Shi Yu leave. Seeing this, the gem cat couldn’t help but comfort it. “Senior Mantis, cheer up. At least in the future, when Shi Yu goes to the Space Emperor Ruins, he has to bring some greeting gifts, right?”
The Void Mantis was silent. This was the only way to think about it.
However, it was afraid that this kid would send some strange person over instead of personally coming. Maybe he would be sending Lu Qingyi or something over…
....
After Shi Yu left Senior Lu’s legendary ruins, he ran back to the dormitory and entered his ruins steadily, arriving at Ling’s Mechanical Research Institute.
At this moment, apart from Ling, there was also the mechanical Tyrant Dragon in the research institute.
“Roar!!!”
Perhaps it couldn’t be called a mechanical Tyrant Dragon anymore. After all, it had completed its evolution under Ling’s upgrade in the past two months.
At this moment, it was nearly ten meters long and prostrated on the ground. Its earth-brown dragon scales were impressive and domineering. Behind its huge head, several spike-like scales extended, and its deep blue-gray dragon eyes were filled with invincibility.
Apart from not having wings, it was closer to the Western dragon than in the form of the Tyrant Dragon.
For the past few months, Ling had been fusing a second fossil for the mechanical Tyrant Dragon. It was a level-eight fossil. It came from a totem-level earth-element dragon and was also the king of the earth. From this Earth Dragon, the little machine obtained three new racial skills and completed its evolution.
< Name > Little Ji
[Race]: Mechanical Life
[Attributes]: Machinery, Earth, Dragon
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Commander
[Race Skill]
“Intermediate”: Basic Intelligence (Expert)
“Advanced”: Space Splitting Sword (Expert), Dragon Breath (Proficient), Deterrence (Perfect)
“Super Level”: Earth Domain (Initiate), Earthquake (Initiate), Reverse Scale (Initiate)
Energy Points: 100,000
After evolution, Little Ji’s personality had become much worse. This was because it had obtained the reverse scale skill. It dared to be angry at anyone who denied that it wasn’t the overlord of the earth.
It was angry.
After all, apart from Duckie, it couldn’t defeat anyone else.
Although it was the true king of racial skills apart from Eleven, this didn’t stop it from being a junior.
“Roar ~” After Shi Yu arrived, Little Ji stretched out its dragon claws, its gaze revealing a sharp expression, indicating that it was all thanks to it.
Unlike that duck, who was just an additional mouth to feed. That guy couldn’t provide any contribution to the team!
It still had to be the king of the land!
“Sure.” Shi Yu looked at the increasingly handsome little machine and gave it a thumbs up. “If Ling evolves successfully, you’ll be the first to be credited. When the time comes, I’ll sell my kidney if I have to and find a legendary resource to help you break through to overlord.”
“Roar!!!” Little Ji was extremely excited. The expert level basic intelligence had already made it less stunned. It already knew what a legendary resource was.
That was a super treasure that even the members of the first team dreamed of!
Even Big Sister Ling had never obtained a legendary resource!
And Shi Yu actually said that he wanted to give it one too!
That was good!
Although it was only commander rank now, it didn’t stop Little Ji from imagining the future.
After becoming an overlord, it would be the true overlord of the earth!
“No, it’s too wasteful,” Ling said from the side. Hey, hey, hey, it felt that its master was getting more and more arrogant. What legendary resources? Even if it was the first team, they were still lacking at the moment, alright?
Wasn’t it a waste to give it to this big guy?
“What’s the matter?” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Little Ji is also very willing to work hard.”
“Roar! (That’s right, that’s right.)” Little Ji looked at Ling with tears in its eyes. It didn’t expect Big Sister to be so heartless.
In order to cooperate with the experiment, it lay on the mechanical bed 12 hours a day and let itself be dissected.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 739 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (3)
chapters.content:
739 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (3)
There were still another 12 hours where it got beaten up.
Until they broke through to commander rank, Little Ji and Duckie couldn’t defeat the transcendent-level Green Silkworm Phantom.
In the end, these two guys almost couldn’t suppress their growth levels anymore. In the end, they relied on the level advantage after breaking through to charge over.
Along the way, it relied on the level advantage to defeat the transcendent-level Buggy, Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, and Baby Ginseng.
Although they had defeated it, the journey was not easy either. It was shocked when it fought the transcendent challenge.
But at the moment, they were all stuck at the sixth level.
Facing the commander rank Green Silkworm cocoon phantom… a new round of reincarnation began.
“Up to you.” Ling turned around. Forget it, as long as Shi Yu was happy.
Shi Yu smiled. He didn’t treat the mechanical Tyrant Dragon as an outsider now. In addition, this guy’s talent was really good. It didn’t go through any additional points at all. In less than a month, it had raised the deterrence skill level from the initial awakening stage to perfect proficiency.
Although Eleven occasionally gave him some pointers, maybe it was because of the second fossil that was wrapped in deterrence waves that made it undeniable that the current Little Ji’s talent was ridiculously good.
It really had the aptitude of a king!
Well, in Shi Yu’s plan, Little Ji had to at least be cultivated to the totem level in the end. It couldn’t be inferior to the second team pets of the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the others!
“Alright, hurry up and fuse.”
Shi Yu urged Ling and said, “What’s the success rate?”
“Estimated success rate… 100%,” Ling said.
“You’re the most reassuring,” Shi Yu praised.
He didn’t add points to Divine Net in vain (Expert+11).
Top-notch intelligence was still strong.
“If we really succeed, won’t our progress be faster than the fourth bureau?”
Shi Yu pondered for a moment. In the fourth bureau, there was also research of a low-level Mythical fossil. The fossil race was unknown, and both parties were researching it at the same time.
Before the fourth bureau succeeded, Ling made progress first. Interesting.
Although the current top-notch intelligence of Ling might already be higher than Legend Ah Shuang’s Black Wing Demon God, there was a mechanical life form with perfect top-notch intelligence in the fourth bureau.
They would definitely participate in the research of the mechanical phantom beast. Even when such a big boss participated, they weren’t as fast as Ling, who was called by Shi Yu to study superalloy and radar from time to time. This was simply… As expected of him! He was good at nurturing!
“That’s because there’s the support of Buggy and Baby Ginseng.” Ling could tell what Shi Yu was thinking at a glance.
In terms of mechanical phantom beasts, Buggy’s max-level dream stealing and imagination power along with Baby Ginseng’s time life and death power couldn’t be lacking.
“Huh?”
“Of course, Master has the greatest contribution.”
“You’re right.” Shi Yu smiled. He was looking forward to the scene after adding Ling’s top-notch intelligence to transcendent.
At the moment, according to what Shi Yu knew, no mechanical life form had trained top-notch intelligence skills to perfection.
Even the mechanical legends of Shen Feng and Dong Huang were the same.
