Although their totem mechanical pets had other types of mechanical skills that had reached transcendent, such as super forbidden self-destruction and super forbidden missiles, their super intelligence stopped at perfect proficiency.
Dong Huang’s mechanical legendary, Shen Yuan, even said that if a mechanical life form could have top-notch intelligence and increase its skill level to above transcendent, it would lead a new chapter in the Mechanic class.
How could Shi Yu not look forward to this…
Under Shi Yu’s urging, Ling quickly called Buggy and Baby Ginseng over, planning to start evolution!
When Shi Yu saw this critical moment, he also called Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, and Duckie over to witness it together.
“Wu ~” Buggy was excited after winning a battle.
It had defeated the legendary Space Emperor’s pet!!
Shi Yu, the eternal god!
“Roar…” Little Ji saw Buggy and was a little traumatized.
After being tortured by Buggy’s illusions all day, it was normal for it to be afraid when it saw the main body.
“Quack…” Apart from it, the Duckbill Beast that rushed over also had a wrinkled face.
It used to like worms the most…
It didn’t expect that karma would come. It had been tortured by the worm for almost half a year.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Susu also rushed over, especially Susu.
After all, Ling had said that it would participate in the team meeting after it completed its evolution.
Susu, who had been at the bottom continuously, couldn’t wait to pull Ling in to replace him.
Good sister!
“Then I’ll start?”
Seeing that everyone had arrived, the image of the cold white-haired girl on the cube-shaped screen became clearer and clearer, and her eyes were filled with light.
The cube kept splitting and transforming into a floating experimental table. It took out the Kirin Horn fossil from the mechanical space and placed it on the experimental table, calling Buggy and Shi Yu for help.
In the next moment, Buggy nodded. Shi Yu nodded. Buggy first used the legendary Dragon Ball to increase its power of imagination to a higher level. Then, Shi Yu and its mental strength were connected and strengthened each other!
The reason why Ling could achieve a breakthrough was also related to Buggy obtaining the legendary Dragon Ball, its skill proficiency increasing drastically, and Shi Yu also obtaining superpowers that could be connected to Buggy’s spirit.
This would make the replicated Wind Kirin Phantom even more perfect.
With a cry, Shi Yu and Buggy entered another world in the dark meditation state, the fossil dream world.
It was still a desolate world. The sky was covered in gray clouds, and the ground was covered in dry dust. It was a silent apocalypse scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 740 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (4)
chapters.content:
740 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (4)
That beast that was not only beautiful, but also extremely handsome and elegant, was still running away from something.
Buggy’s gaze was solemn as it immediately began to replicate!!!
In the outside world.
Outside the Kirin Horn fossil, a deer-like white body slowly appeared.
On its body, some green patterns condensed into cloud-like hair, reflecting the image of the wind. Its entire body was like the embodiment of the wind. Its head was petite and gentle, and various praises for elegance, beauty, and handsomeness could be used on it.
When it was first conjured, a light breeze lingered around it. The even more elegant green-blue silk-like hair on its head also fluttered with the wind. At this moment, Ling began to move. Its entire body turned into particles that were difficult to see with the naked eye and instantly fused into the Wind Kirin phantom.
Layers of green and white halos formed by Ling wrapped around the Wind Kirin.
“The fusion starts now. It’s estimated to take five minutes.”
Ling’s voice sounded in Shi Yu and the others’ ears. Shi Yu and the others nodded, knowing that this was only the beginning.
Right on the heels of that, Ling also had to take out various mechanical parts from its mechanical space during the fusion process and various resources to assist its fusion process and undergo internal modification!
Originally, this was the job of a Mechanic, but Shi Yu, who knew nothing about this, could only quietly wait for Ling’s good news.
“Sob.”
“Wu ~”
“Yi!”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others focused their gazes and looked forward to it very much. Mythical creatures… They didn’t know how Ling’s strength would become after successfully fusing.
In the past five minutes, Shi Yu and the others indeed had nothing else to do. They stared at the dreamy Wind Kirin Phantom in front of them. It closed its eyes and emitted a gentle breeze, giving people a very peaceful feeling.
One minute…
Two minutes…
Three minutes…
As the time Ling deduced approached, Shi Yu and the others couldn’t help but feel nervous. Four minutes… four minutes and 30 seconds…
At this moment, Ling, or it could be said that some changes had finally happened to the Wind Kirin Phantom!
Evolution light lingered!!
Buzz!!!
Accompanied by the light, a clearly strong energy wave, but very gentle wind, quickly spread in all directions. Green ripples instantly covered the entire courtyard of the Mechanical Research Institute!
In the legendary ruins, the blue sky was dyed green and white. A rising energy made Shi Yu hold his breath.
“It’s here!!”
Shi Yu shouted and looked at Ling’s energy change with a burning gaze.
Apart from Little Ji and Duckie, the other pets also activated their full-level super vision and observed the changes in the energy fluctuations on Ling’s body!!
Boom!
After two months of cultivation, Ling’s energy level had originally reached 5 million, but now, 6 million, 7 million, 8 million… It didn’t look like evolution at all, but like a breakthrough. The increase in energy level was very ridiculous!!
9 million!!
Soon, Ling’s energy fluctuations exceeded Buggy, Susu, and Chi Tong and came to third place in the team. After all, it was the only pet in the team that had not been strengthened by legendary resources, and be it super skills or low-level skills, it had the least number.
However, under such circumstances, its energy level still increased at a terrifying speed.
“Is it because of the Kirin Horn fossil?”
Shi Yu muttered in his heart. Although the energy level of the Kirin Horn fossil was already “level 0”, it was once a Mythical resource after all. It was of Mythical quality and contained traces of billions of years!
After the power stimulated by the resources provided by the ginseng baby fused into Ling’s body, this change seemed to be understandable.
However, the energy points were all weak.
What concerned Shi Yu the most was skills, skills!
This fusion, this evolution, and this awakening, could he obtain the skills of the Wind Kirin??
Soon.
Through the contract, Shi Yu received an answer.
< Name > Turning Misfortune into Luck
< Introduction > It’s a wind-element super skill. It can absorb skills that are dangerous to itself and double its power to the enemy.
First was turning misfortune into luck. Shi Yu had already replicated this skill from Senior Lu and taught it to Ling in advance. During this evolution process, this skill directly changed from a non-racial skill to a racial skill.
Apart from that.
< Name > Wind Spirit Bead
< Introduction > It’s a wind-element super skill. The Wind Spirit Bead can absorb and adapt to most attributes. It can also spread the effect of other attributes to the maximum through the power of the wind.
The Wind Spirit Bead, the skill Shi Yu and the others had sensed from the Wind Kirin fossil dream, had also been successfully awakened by Ling. This skill was also very important!
It was the key skill Ling had judged to create the “Fusion Mecha”!
“There’s one more, there’s still one more.” Shi Yu was filled with anticipation. There was still the strongest skill.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, that super skill was not a divine skill, but it looked like a divine skill!
However…
At this moment, Ling was silent. The evolution light dissipated. The Wind Kirin Phantom, which was not tall or even more than a meter tall, slowly opened its eyes.
“Success,” Ling said, its intelligent eyes filled with joy.
“Where’s my Wind Blessing! Where’s my big Wind Blessing!!” Shi Yu was stunned. He was happy to see Ling successfully evolve, but he was also stunned.
In his opinion, this skill was the most important.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 741 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (5)
chapters.content:
741 Fusion of the Kirin Fossil (5)
< Name > Wind Blessing
< Introduction > It’s a super skill of the wind, time, and space elements. It uses the wind of nature to increase luck.
Without this skill, could it still be called a Wind Kirin?
Ling was not sad at all. Its voice was still filled with joy. “This skill is different from turning misfortune into luck and the Wind Spirit Bead. It’s extremely difficult to fuse. I can feel that I can’t control this skill at the moment, but it can still awaken at any time. This is a quasi-divine skill, the prototype of a divine skill. It’s a talent skill inherited from its Mythical parents!”
Wind Blessing, a quasi divine skill!!
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, and Baby Ginseng suddenly opened their mouths wide.
After communicating with Senior Ji Mengzhu, they naturally knew how impressive quasi-divine skills and prototype divine skills were.
As long as he mastered this, it wouldn’t be too much to say that it was a Mythical race.
Wind Blessing was a quasi-divine skill?
It wasn’t as simple as an ordinary super skill?
“It’s alright, Master. Don’t forget, we still have the ‘Mythical Revival’ skill,” Ling quickly reminded.
Ling’s reminder immediately made Shi Yu react and look at it.
Skill: Mythical Revival
< Introduction > It’s a super special skill. It can awaken the divine power sleeping in creatures.
Status: Teachable
Cooldown Time: 42 hours
He could teach Mythical Revival too!
“You mean…” Shi Yu reacted and understood that the current Ling undoubtedly had the power of a god sleeping in its body. If he taught Ling this skill, even if the Wind Blessing was a divine skill and it couldn’t control it with its current fusion speed, as the proficiency of the Mythical Revival skill increased, it would be able to master the Wind Blessing sooner or later.
So that was the case.
As expected of a top-notch intelligence, it was smart.
Shi Yu was originally annoyed that Ling couldn’t awaken the Wind Blessing, but when he heard that the Wind Blessing might be a quasi-divine skill and that it could be awakened through the Mythical Revival skill, he was instantly excited.
It was awesome.
This way, Ling might be the first pet in the team to master a quasi-divine skill?
The first was to become a pet of a Mythical race?
Perhaps not. Shi Yu fell into deep thought. If awakening the Wind Blessing had too high a requirement for the skill proficiency of Mythical Revival, it would be difficult.
Forget it, today was a happy day anyway!
“Wuu!!!” Eleven and the others also asked. Apart from awakening two new racial skills, were there any other changes?
Ling nodded proudly. Of course!
If the wind elemental life form was the pet of the wind element, then the Wind Kirin was the master of the wind element!
After evolution, the proficiency of its Wind Element Control skill had even increased to nearly perfect level, thanks to the perfect affinity of its current physique with the wind!
< Name > Ling
[Race]: Mechanical Life
[Attributes]: Machinery, Wind
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch level
[Race Skill]:
“Advanced”: Hundred Transformations (Dao Proficiency), Advanced Intelligence (Dao Proficiency), Mechanical Space (Dao Proficiency), Loading (Dao Proficiency)
“Super Level”: Wind Element Control (Expert+11), Divine Net (Expert+11), Turning Misfortune into Luck (Expert), Wind Spirit Bead (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]
“Intermediate”: Super Sight (transcendent), Heart Strike (transcendent)
“Advanced”: Clone (transcendent), Multiplication (transcendent), Deterrence (transcendent), Absolute Sleep (transcendent)
“Super Level”: Mythical Revival (Unlearned)
Energy Points: 9 million+
“Wuu!!” “Wu!!” “Yi!!”
Upon hearing that Ling had changed so drastically after fusing with the Kirin form this time, Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng were curious. Why don’t… they fight? Let’s fight!
“Mi!” “Ning!!” Chi Tong and Susu also felt that it was still manageable. Fight, fight!
“No.” Ling turned its head mercilessly. Its entire body directly turned into a breeze and returned to the form of the Rubik’s Cube. “I haven’t completely evolved. The power of the Wind Kirin fossil hasn’t been completely activated at all. I need to learn the true Wind Kirin form after the Mythical Revival.”
“When the time comes, we’ll fight.”
Ling rejected cleanly, not giving Susu and the others a chance. Shi Yu smiled.
However, after taking a look at the cooldown time, Shi Yu’s expression changed. “Damn it. If I had known earlier, I wouldn’t have wasted my energy on Eleven.”
Eleven: “?”
It seemed like love didn’t last.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 742 Another Mythical Resource (1)
chapters.content:
742 Another Mythical Resource (1)
Ling had evolved.
Next, Shi Yu naturally had to study Ling’s strength after evolution.
This research was impressive.
Shi Yu realized that Ling in the form of a Wind Kirin should have the strongest speed in the team under the same level.
This title originally belonged to Chi Tong, but now, it was directly snatched away by Ling.
Of course, this referred to the movement speed on land and in the sky.
If it was in the sea, Susu would definitely be better.
This made Shi Yu feel that he might be able to abandon Buggy and use Ling as a transportation tool.
After all, Buggy’s Instant Transmission was “driving and stopping” and “intermittent”. It was easy to get carsick.
Moreover, the consumption of Instant Transmission was not small. Every time Buggy finished using it, it would complain that it was tired, making it look like he was squeezing Buggy dry.
Unlike Ling, who could directly use natural wind as an energy source to continue and fly at a high speed.
It was energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, stable, and fast.
“Ling, quickly study the form of the Kirin fighter plane. We’ll fly the plane ourselves when we go to Tingxiang this time.”
As for mechas, they were too conspicuous. They were easy targets to take a beating, and their speed might not be faster than the fighter plane form.
He wanted Ling to show off its plane speed in the sky.
It would be pretty fast!
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s suggestion, Eleven and the others communicated solemnly. Buggy heaved a sigh of relief.
As long as it didn’t teleport.
“Wu…” Ling frowned.
Although it wasn’t impossible, it was a perfectionist. Spending time researching the form of a fighter jet would waste a lot of time.
However, it still had to continue researching the Kirin form and the Fusion Mecha…
Ling quickly said, “Why don’t… we go by sea?”
“Let’s enter Susu’s infinite space and let it bring us over.”
“Including the strengthening of the Time Fruit, Susu’s speed should be faster than mine.”
“Most importantly… safety.”
“The commotion of me flying in the air will be very big, but if Susu shrinks and travels in the ocean, no one can sense it.”
Back then, the Tyrannical Sea Legend had let Shi Yu and the others enter the Giant Leviathan’s infinite space and head to Dragon Palace City.
Compared to the huge formation of the Giant Leviathan, Susu, who could multiply to the maximum level, was naturally invincible in the vast sea.
If it wanted to hide, ordinary totems probably couldn’t find it.
“Ning.” When Susu heard Ling’s suggestion, it widened its eyes and shook its head.
Tingxiang was so far away. It would be exhausted along the way!!!
“Alright, then let’s go by sea. Before we go to Tingxiang, I happen to want to take a look at Dragon Palace City,” Shi Yu said.
Susu: QAQ?
Shi Yu continued to study it. It was extremely novel. He even rode the Kirin Phantom a few times.
The so-called Kirin was Qi Ling!
In the flying state, although it was very fast, it gave Shi Yu a very comfortable feeling. There was no discomfort from the wind pressure.
Of course, they also kept experimenting around Ling’s new Wind Spirit Bead skill.
This move was very interesting.
Ling condensed into a high-speed spinning wind ball. It had a strong tearing and devouring effect.
Throwing it out directly could also cause huge destructive power, like a compressed typhoon.
However, what was even more magical was that Eleven’s White Thunder, Chi Tong’s Sun Flame, Susu’s Wave Cannon, and Buggy’s Imagination power could all be integrated into the “Wind Spirit Bead”, dyeing the Wind Spirit Bead with new attribute colors and increasing its power greatly.
It could be said that the Wind Spirit Bead was a perfect combination skill template. Unfortunately, the current entry-level Wind Spirit Bead could only fuse and spread one power, but after its level was high, it should be able to fuse the power of Eleven, Susu, Buggy, Chi Tong, and Baby Ginseng to strengthen and become stronger.
This was also why Ling said that the Wind Spirit Bead skill was very likely to be the key skill of the Fusion Mecha.
When the proficiency of this skill was high, with the Wind Spirit Bead as the core of the mecha, it could indeed maximize the power of all pets.
Although the Wind Spirit Bead’s increase in a single attribute was not as powerful as Chi Tong’s “Interlocking Sword”, it could not withstand its small load and high accommodation. It was more suitable for Mechanics.
After all, injuries to Mechanics were really fatal. Even Baby Ginseng didn’t have good treatment methods for Ling.
The healing effect of the ginseng baby was the most obvious for Eleven, Buggy, and Shi Yu, but the effect on Susu, Chi Tong, and Ling gradually decreased. Fortunately, the three sisters also had their own healing skills.
....
With this torment, Shi Yu worked from noon to night. When he thought of the meal with his senior, he hurriedly came out of the ruins space.
Now, he couldn’t teach Ling Mythical Revival. He could only wait for tomorrow. Before coming, he had taught Eleven skills and wasted a lot of physical strength through strengthening in the battle of Buggy. There was still time.
“Senior, where are you?”
After coming out, Shi Yu called Lu Qingyi and called her.
“Where are we going to eat tonight?”
Shi Yu touched his stomach. He was already hungry.
However, on the other side of the phone, Lu Qingyi didn’t immediately reply to Shi Yu about eating. Instead, she said, “Did you just come out of the ruins?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Let’s wait a bit regarding the meal first. I’m with Grandpa now. There seems to be an online meeting in Bureau 11 later. President Lin called it. Let’s see what it is first.”
“Oh? Alright.” Shi Yu was stunned.
An online meeting of Bureau 11?
He had joined Bureau 11 for so long, but it seemed like he had never been in a meeting in the bureau.
Just like what Senior Lu said when she tricked him into joining the team, it was very loose and free. There were no missions at all…
No!
Shi Yu was suddenly stunned. Didn’t President Lin give him an archeological mission to the Heavenly Fox Nation two months ago?

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 743 Another Mythical Resource (2)
chapters.content:
743 Another Mythical Resource (2)
Oh, that Heavenly Fox mission didn’t seem to be enforced. He could choose whether to go or not. That was fine.
From the looks of it, it was really quite easy. He just didn’t know what it was this time.
Summoning all the members of Bureau 11 in one go should be more important than the Iron-eating Beast Mystic Realm in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
“Could it be that something happened to the Yun Clan’s mystic realm?”
Shi Yu recalled that President Lin seemed to have said that he would send archeologists to investigate the lost race mystic realm that couldn’t be found recently. Could something have happened here?
Shi Yu quickly took out his cell phone and connected to the archeological index. It wasn’t a problem to guess like this. It was better to understand through the meeting later.
....
About half an hour later, in Bureau 11 of Dong Huang, ten official members entered the Internet conference room.
At the moment, including official members and trainee members, Bureau 11 should have 12 people.
However, Fang Lan, a trainee high school student, naturally wouldn’t participate in such a meeting. As for the other one who was absent, Shi Yu took a look at the name on the list and immediately knew what was going on.
It was that senior…
Shi Yu had never seen this senior since he entered the bureau. He had only heard that he had the highest overall archeological achievements in Bureau 11. Through the ruins, just the resources alone had helped Dong Huang obtain two Mythical resources and more than ten legendary resources. Apart from that, he had also obtained more than ten ruins space.
If Bureau 11 had a director position, it should be him.
Unfortunately, it was said that he had gone to explore a Mythical Ruins and had not come out for five years.
No one knew if he was dead or alive.
His name was Gu Yun, a legendary figure in Bureau 11 and one of the elders. Shi Yu had heard a lot of his deeds, but he didn’t know when he could meet him and communicate.
Back then, when he entered the Mythical Ruins, Elder Gu’s message to Bureau 11 was that if he couldn’t come out, don’t look for him.
This person was naturally absent.
Apart from that, Principal Feng, Legend Ke, Grandma Li, Dr. Chen, Senior Lu… The members of Bureau 11 were already in position.
Shi Yu entered at about the same time as everyone. Among these people, Shi Yu was considered the least experienced. However, when these seniors saw the name “Shi Yu”, they had mixed feelings.
This was because although Shi Yu had not been in the game for long, in a short period of time, his attainments in the archeological field had far exceeded most of the seniors present.
It was simply the second Gu Yun. In fact, from the momentum, he might one day surpass that guy.
“Everyone is here, right?”
After everyone entered the conference room, President Lin’s figure appeared on the screen. He said, “It’s been a long time since I called everyone together.”
“President Lin, what’s the matter this time?” An old voice sounded. Shi Yu recognized that it was an old senior. He had retired even more completely than Principal Feng, mainly because his body was weak.
“Yes,” President Lin said. “I believe everyone already knows about the change in the World Tree.”
“In less than four months, Inatella will open.”
“Inatella, the habitat of the World Tree, also known as the Domain of the Gods. The island contains a large number of legendary ruins and Mythical Ruins. It’s the place closest to the secret of the Mythical Era.”
“Inatana, the habitat of the World Tree, also known as the Domain of the Gods. The island contains a large number of legendary ruins and Mythical Ruins. It’s the place closest to the secret of the Mythical Era.”
“Therefore, apart from sending the younger generation to participate in the world competition, the seven countries also decided to form an ‘archeological team’. As spectators of the world competition, they will head to Inatella and try to come into contact with the ruins that might appear in Inatella this time. If they can’t come into contact, they will assist the contestants from the various countries who can come into contact with the ruins to crack it.”
“The members of the ‘archeological team’ are elites of the archeological world of the seven countries. It’s to face the Mythical Revival and explore the vanguard of the Mythical Era. Dong Huang will naturally participate.”
As soon as President Lin finished speaking, no one in the conference room was surprised.
After all, Inatella had only opened for so long. Apart from the old man who had already retired to the point where he couldn’t even walk, no one present was willing to miss this opportunity to go to the World Island.
“The ‘archeological team’ established by the various countries should be completed in the ‘Glorious Kingdom’ of Rongguang on the eve of the World Tournament. That’s the closest place to Inatella.”
“As the various countries have not communicated together for a long time, at that time, the Seven Nation Alliance will also hold an unprecedented archeological event in the Rongguang. The theme is ‘totem’ and ‘myth’.”
“Archeologists who have new archeological discoveries of the ‘totem era’ and ‘mythical era’ can exchange their gains in the conference.”
“It’s considered an information-sharing meeting of the countries before heading to Inatella. Generally, relatively important information won’t be casually shared even between the seven countries. Therefore, this time, the Seven Nation Alliance took out two Mythical resources and ten legendary resources from the alliance’s inventory as a reward.”
“The two most important pieces of information will respectively obtain Mythical resources. The next ten will be getting legendary resources for the archeological discoveries.”
In the totem battle, in the nearly 200 years of history of the alliance era, there were many battles where the seven countries cooperated to harvest a large amount of resources. A portion of these resources had always been stored in the alliance, shared by the seven countries, waiting to be distributed.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 744 Another Mythical Resource (3)
chapters.content:
744 Another Mythical Resource (3)
Whichever country that made a huge contribution to the human race of the alliance would see these resources distributed to the factions with the most results first. It was a rule jointly established by everyone at the start of the Seven Nation Alliance.
Obviously, because of the World Tournament, the Seven Nation Alliance planned to take out a portion of resources as a reward and encourage the seven countries to share important information about the Mythical Era and the totem era that had been explored.
So that was the case.
As soon as President Lin finished speaking, everyone from Bureau 11 immediately understood the reason for his meeting.
He wanted some members of Bureau 11 to represent Dong Huang to participate in this archeological event and join the joint archeological team of the seven countries.
Although one or two legendary resources were dispensable to Dong Huang, Mythical resources were rare treasures even for the seven countries.
Just like the Undying Fruit Shi Yu had obtained previously, any country that obtained it would have a legendary strengthening of the country’s strength.
If the Undying Fruit was obtained by the Seven Islands and eaten by their legendary Valkyrie, who would dare to underestimate a legendary battle power that could live for two lifetimes? To a large extent, it could allow the Seven Islands to prosper for another thousand years!
“Do we have any new discoveries about the Mythical Era that are very important and can affect the future situation and share important information?”
At this moment, as President Lin finished speaking, the members of Bureau 11 fell into deep thought.
Mythical and legendary resources were definitely not that easy to obtain.
If he wasn’t wrong, if he wanted to obtain Mythical resources, he definitely had to take out important information about the Mythical Era that could allow the seven countries to benefit together.
The information of the totem era might not even be qualified.
At this moment, Shi Yu was slightly stunned when he heard President Lin finish speaking. An archeological event in Rongguang?
He could use this opportunity to hatch an egg at Rongguang.
After hatching, he would go to Inatella to participate in the world competition.
Before that, it was to go to Tingxiang to complete the three thirds of the progress.
As for this archeological event with rich rewards, Shi Yu pondered for a moment. His archeological achievements seemed to be from the Beast Taming Era. Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, Space Emperor… didn’t seem to be qualified to participate in this archeological event? Wait…
Shi Yu was stunned. Suddenly, his eyes lit up. Mechanical phantom beast, Mythical Kirin! He had almost forgotten about the great invention of the mechanical phantom beast system that went from the Mythical Era to the totem era to the Beast Taming Era.
Just now, he had just “revived” the Wind Kirin.
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, the Mythical Era should have suffered some kind of calamity. At the moment, people were completely unaware of this calamity, but it could be displayed in the Wind Kirin’s dream.
Unfortunately, the information provided in the dream was too little. He didn’t know if teaching Ling Mythical Revival more could restore it more clearly.
What about using the memory water drop?
If only there were more Mythical creatures’ dreams to reference. At that time, he and Buggy could understand the truth through entering dreams.
If he could find the reason for the calamity of the Mythical Era, the details would be worth a Mythical resource no matter what.
Speaking of which, was there still a fossil from the Mythical Era that he had yet to develop in the fourth bureau? Shi Yu thought for a moment. It was a little wasteful to give it to the fourth bureau to study. It was better to quickly come over and study it himself. After all, his superpower, together with Buggy’s max-level dream stealing and Ling’s research, should be more efficient than the fourth bureau.
At the thought of this, the transparent Shi Yu, who had been silent just now, said, “President Lin, I’ve successfully modified the Wind Kirin Phantom of the Mythical Era into a mechanical phantom beast.”
“The dream memories of such Mythical creatures should also be archeological information, right?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the entire conference room suddenly fell silent.
A moment later.
Principal Feng was extremely stunned. “Wait, what did you say?”
“That Mythical Kirin fossil has successfully revived?!!”
Grandma Li was also shocked. “Shi Yu, really? When did this happen?”
Legend Ke: “F*ck… Did I hear wrongly? Really?”
The conference room of Bureau 11 was shocked.
In a courtyard, Lu Qingyi, who was with Principal Feng, was slightly stunned when she heard Shi Yu’s words.
It really succeeded?
The mechanical phantom beast system Shi Yu studied at the Mechanical Conference could undoubtedly be related to archeology.
Among them, Shi Yu had even exaggerated at the scene, saying that with the mechanical phantom beast system, he could revive divine beasts one day!!
Regarding this, the archeologists and Mechanics of Bureau 11 and the fourth bureau were undoubtedly very excited when they heard it.
They were so excited that they exploded.
However, after the joint research of Bureau 11 and the fourth bureau, they realized that Shi Yu was really just making a big show.
It was already difficult enough to revive extinct creatures from the totem era. The chances of reviving creatures from the Mythical Era that were at least billions of years ago were extremely small. Even if it was possible, it might take hundreds of years of research.
The traces of time contained in the Mythical fossil were too complicated.
At that point, the archeological big shots of Bureau 11 could only sigh slightly.
They didn’t know if he could wait until that day.
But today, Shi Yu said that he had successfully revived the biological fossils of the Mythical Era?
How was this possible!
“Shi Yu, is what you said true? When did this happen?” President Lin’s expression was also solemn. He naturally knew this about the analysis of the fourth bureau, that there was nothing he could do about it. After all, no research could be done overnight. However, Shi Yu actually exceeded the progress of the fourth bureau so much with his own strength?

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 745 Another Mythical Resource (4)
chapters.content:
745 Another Mythical Resource (4)
How did he do it?
“What a coincidence… Today.”
“Perhaps it’s because we have mastered higher-level dream entry, dream stealing, and materialization methods. We didn’t rely on Mechanic methods, but found another way, so it’s more smooth,” Shi Yu said. “We made some modifications to Emperor Shi’s dream meditation skills.”
“It can make the effect of entering a dream better.”
“Improvement?” President Lin’s expression was complicated. Wait a minute, it was a time meditation technique used to detect traces of time and could even enter dreams through traces of time. That was a top-notch meditation technique developed by the most mysterious legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Shi. It was improved just like that?
The other members of Bureau 11 were also stunned.
The others didn’t understand, but Lu Qingyi quickly reacted with a complicated expression. The so-called modification… could it be to use the Beast Tamer who assisted pets also master super Psychic power himself?
“Yes, but the dream fragment of the Kirin fossil is severely incomplete. There’s too little useful information. We might have to study it in depth to find valuable information. President Lin, why don’t you bring me the Mythical fossil in the fourth bureau to study it first? Perhaps we can find some valuable information to participate in the archeological event,” Shi Yu said confidently.
F*ck…
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the other members of Bureau 11 were still stunned. They felt that this kid was ridiculous.
As for President Lin, he also knew that Shi Yu wasn’t someone who bragged. He nodded and said, “I understand. I’ll immediately inform the fourth bureau to send you that Mythical fossil.”
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu was excited. After all, the Mythical fossil might contain quasi divine skills.
He didn’t know what divine beast that Mythical fossil was left behind… It seemed to be said that Dong Huang didn’t know the origin of this fossil either.
Sigh, after going around in circles, he still had to rely on himself.
Shi Yu felt very busy, while the other members of Bureau 11 were endlessly silent. They could already predict how the fourth bureau would cry for their parents. If what Shi Yu said was true, then this time, it was equivalent to Shi Yu using archeological methods to crush the scientific research methods of the fourth bureau.
The other party would definitely be extremely shocked by Shi Yu’s progress.
“Shi Yu, how did you modify the time meditation technique?” Grandma Li, who also knew the time meditation technique’s dream entry skill, couldn’t wait to ask.
As for Shi Yu, he didn’t plan to hide the fact that he had obtained the Talent Bead from An Chang and developed superpowers.
In that case, he would reveal the fact that he had developed superpowers to these seniors first.
These seniors from Bureau 11 with the gift of telepathy should be the ones who needed superpowers the most.
Principal Feng and Grandma Li were familiar with him, just like Senior Lu. They definitely had to be taught first.
“It’s very simple.”
Shi Yu simply applied for permission to broadcast something. In the next moment, Shi Yu’s figure also appeared in the video in the conference room.
“I discovered that as long as Beast Tamers also master Psychic power with extraordinary proficiency, the spiritual-type pets that use the Dream Stealing skill to complete the mental connection will have a better effect if they use Emperor Shi’s Time Meditation Technique to enter the dream fossil together.”
Huh?
No one reacted.
In the next moment.
“That’s it…” In the video, Shi Yu shouted for Ling to insert an image of himself fighting the Void Mantis just now.
In the scene, almost corporeal spiritual power formed a blue outline around Shi Yu.
A terrifying spiritual power wave bloomed from Shi Yu’s body.
As spatial ripples flashed, a pitch-black mantis holding a black saber descended in front of Shi Yu!
Everyone present recognized this living historical figure. This was… the secondary pet of the Space Emperor that had broken through to the overlord level, the overlord Void Mantis!
Shi Yu was fighting it?
Looking at the posture of the Void Mantis’s attack, everyone in the conference room felt their hearts skip a beat.
However, what shocked them even more was the next second.
Shi Yu seemed to have turned into a spiritual-type human-type ferocious beast close to the totem level. His eyes were filled with infinitely deep blue spiritual power. As the Void Mantis descended, Shi Yu raised his arm and aimed his palm at the Void Mantis.
In the next moment, Shi Yu squeezed his palm. The Void Mantis was directly controlled by its spiritual power with a shocked expression. Its entire body was unable to break free. As Shi Yu swung his arm again, with a boom, the Void Mantis was sent flying by the spiritual power like a blue meteor!!
“This…”
Seeing Shi Yu use his spiritual power to defeat the overlord-level Void Mantis with his bare hands, everyone watching the video revealed incredulous expressions.
This was what Shi Yu claimed to be very simple? As long as the Beast Tamer also mastered Psychic power with extraordinary proficiency?!

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 746 The Final Form of Telepathy (1)
chapters.content:
746 The Final Form of Telepathy (1)
As everyone knew, the video couldn’t be photoshopped, so it was true.
Looking at the illogical scene in front of them, President Lin and the others fell into deep thought.
What a joke!
“Is this true?” Dr. Chen widened his eyes.
When the Void Mantis was at the monarch level, it could be said to be the strongest pet at the level of the Dong Huang’s monarchs.
After breaking through to overlord, with the previous foundation and the advantage of the spatial element, even if it had just broken through, it would be much stronger than ordinary overlords.
As for the scene, it was sent flying by Shi Yu’s slap?
Was this really not a cartoon created by Shi Yu’s Butterfly of Imagination with illusions?
“It’s true…” Before Shi Yu could say anything, Lu Qingyi said,” When Shi Yu fought Senior Void Mantis, I was beside him… ”
It was true…
As Lu Qingyi confirmed it, the members of Bureau 11 present were a little confused.
Principal Feng immediately looked at Lu Qingyi, as if he was asking her why she didn’t tell him such a ridiculous thing just now!
“Can this ability be popularized?” After Shi Yu displayed it, President Lin immediately understood what was going on.
Body Control Talent!
It was spiritual power developed by Shi Yu through the talent of plunder!
Bai Chuan was a target of the Seven Islands, Dragon Palace City, and Dong Huang, and Shi Yu had plundered his talent. He definitely had to tell President Lin.
Therefore, not only did the gem cat and other familiar faces know about the Talent Bead left behind by the Yue Maiden in the totem era, but President Lin also knew later.
However, President Lin completely didn’t expect Shi Yu to use the talent he should have plundered better than the original owner of the talent.
This couldn’t be blamed on Bai Chuan. After all, Bai Chuan didn’t have a heaven-defying time skill like the “Memory Water”.
Although the memory water drop and the Time Fruit were both high-level skills, the value produced in Shi Yu’s team exceeded a large number of super skills.
“It’s impossible to popularize it on a large scale. The consumption of resources is too great, and it’s too time-consuming and tiring. There’s only one key tool needed. However, it shouldn’t be a problem to help a few or more people master it. The lowest mastery threshold is at the master level. It’s an elite ability,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s not bad.” President Lin nodded and instantly realized the value of this ability.
If he wasn’t wrong, that was a skill that could only be mastered by relatively high proficiency Psychic power. Such proficiency Psychic power could also be derived into many applications. If it was mastered by Beast Tamers with special battle talent, the increase in strength would undoubtedly be extremely huge.
He looked at Shi Yu in the video. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to give him another surprise.
“What!!!” President Lin and Shi Yu’s question and answer stunned the seniors of Bureau 11.
In the video, how could others have a chance to learn the ability Shi Yu used?
From what Shi Yu said, it was not a problem to teach it to more than ten people??
In an instant, even a senior like Legend Ke was instantly tempted and felt a little tempted.
Were they… involved?
Seeing this, Lu Qingyi grunted. Shi Yu should teach it to her first, right?
From the looks of it, she should be the first person to know that Shi Yu had mastered this ability. Even President Lin didn’t seem to know.
“Alright, this matter has come to an end. We’ll talk about everything after the world competition,” President Lin immediately said.
This was a meeting to discuss the archeological event, and it was not the time to discuss this.
He estimated that he definitely couldn’t obtain Shi Yu’s Psychic level just by controlling the Talent Bead. Shi Yu definitely had other improvement skills that belonged to Shi Yu himself. President Lin’s idea was to specially establish a department and let Shi Yu become the superpower chief instructor of Bureau 13. He would start from young geniuses like Lu Qingyi and Gao Xuan who didn’t have battle talent to teach them this special ability.
If he had the energy, he could teach the older generation.
Even if the consumption of resources was high and it was too time-consuming, it shouldn’t be a problem to pile up dozens of super geniuses who could use superpowers with the country’s resource bank, right? President Lin thought.
In this way, Dong Huang and Shi Yu would both benefit. Dozens of super geniuses would be added to Dong Huang, and Shi Yu would use this opportunity to connect to a huge network and completely become one of the most powerful Beast Tamers in Dong Huang.
President Lin fell into deep thought. If he included the connections of the Blue Sea Sprite and Dragon Palace City, the complicated relationship network behind Shi Yu would probably become more and more complicated.
“Alright.”
As soon as President Lin finished speaking, the members of Bureau 11 naturally had no objections. They would think about this after the world competition.
It was just nice to give them sufficient time to prepare.
Archeologists like Legend Ke and Dr. Chen were already thinking about what “gift” to visit Shi Yu with next.
It was obvious that there were spots in order to learn this ability. They definitely had to be familiar with Shi Yu first. They understood that the pavilion closest to the water enjoyed the moonlight first.
As for someone like Principal Feng, who wasn’t in the mood to be active and had already retired, he looked at Lu Qingyi. He didn’t mind. He’d just let Shi Yu teach this ability to Qingyi. If possible, it would be best if it was before the World Tournament. At that time, Lu Qingyi would be safer in the World Tournament.
“Back to the topic.” Then, President Lin told everyone about the time of the World Archeological Conference. He said, “Those who are interested in representing Dong Huang in the competition and who are interested in joining the archeological team of the seven countries, contact me later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 747 The Final Form of Telepathy (2)
chapters.content:
747 The Final Form of Telepathy (2)
“In addition, the personnel aren’t limited to Bureau 11. There’s also the archeological Association, the civilian talents, and the ancient families. Next, you guys will come into contact with them one by one. I’ll provide you with a list. You can also dig it out yourself.”
The meeting lasted for about an hour. In short, Bureau 11’s mission for the past two months was to continue to collect, summarize, and report special archeological information about the Mythical Era and the totem era.
Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were the only two members who had not been given missions because they still had to prepare for the World Tournament. The archeological teams of the seven countries only assisted the participants in cracking the ruins. As for the two of them, they didn’t need the support of others to directly fight those Mythical Ruins themselves.
However, although there were no missions, the two of them definitely couldn’t stay idle. Shi Yu planned to dig deeper into the Mythical fossil, while Lu Qingyi decided to dig deeper into the Mythical Revival skill before going to the ruins to take a look at the inheritance of this skill.
....
After the meeting ended.
Shi Yu chatted privately with President Lin for a few minutes more and told the Wind Kirin about the situation.
In the scene, President Lin pondered slightly.
After learning that the Wind Kirin, a mechanical phantom beast, had learned the lost skill Wind Spirit Bead and had a chance of becoming a Mythical race, President Lin nodded.
“Not bad.”
“If your mechanical phantom beast really evolves into a Mythical race, it’s undoubtedly equivalent to a new demigod in Dong Huang in the future!”
“I’ll inform the fourth bureau to send the other fossil to you as soon as possible.”
If it could really awaken a quasi-divine skill, even if it was very difficult to grow to the Mythical stage, it was not difficult to grow to the demigod level!
Spending money, even if it was ten legendary resources… As long as the pet that had mastered a quasi-divine skill was strengthened to the totem level, then the battle power of a totem with a quasi-divine skill was undoubtedly at the demigod level.
Although Shi Yu had said that the quasi-divine skill mastered by the Wind Kirin might not be a battle-type skill, President Lin still had a lot of anticipation.
The quasi-divine skill Wind Blessing was a move to strengthen luck. It definitely couldn’t be considered a battle move, but the effect might not be bad in battle.
He made Shi Yu believe in the power of quasi-divine skills. That was the power that involved the laws of the world.
“Speaking of which, President Lin, if I showcase the ability to revive Mythical creatures at the archeological event, I won’t be targeted, right?” Shi Yu thought.
“I feel that if the totem country finds out, they will definitely target us in the World Tournament…”
President Lin nodded and said, “Of course, but what gave you the illusion that you wouldn’t be targeted to death even if you didn’t show it?”
Shi Yu said, “I’m not afraid, but what I mean is that in order to ensure Ling’s safety, can we get it a repair-type and defensive-type Mechanic-type legendary resource? If it really doesn’t work, any wind-type legendary resource is fine… We can accelerate the cultivation progress. Perhaps we can have greater gains. When the time comes, we can directly exchange for a Mythical resource at the archeological Conference!”
President Lin: …
It was true.
“President Lin, tell me. Would Senior Dragon God agree to let Ling acknowledge her as godmother?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. “The Kirin fossil came from Dragon Palace City. No matter what, Ling has some ‘blood relations’ with Dragon Palace City. With an additional identity, the other totem countries have to consider it if they want to target it…”
Ling: …
President Lin: …
Chi Tong: I’m familiar with this.
President Lin said, “The legendary resources will be for you. Don’t disturb Senior Dragon God.”
“Ah, alright.” Shi Yu was helpless.
President Lin was silent. He hoped that Shi Yu’s mechanical phantom beast could really awaken a quasi-divine skill.
If it succeeded, with the Blue Sea Sprite, it would be two pets with demigod aptitude…
After Shi Yu suggested that President Lin find more Mythical fossils, the two of them ended the call. Shi Yu came to Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi.
“So, are we still eating?”
“Principal Feng is also here. Let’s go together.”
After Shi Yu came over, Principal Feng immediately looked at him with a burning gaze.
“Call Teacher Ying and Senior Mantis too. By the way, don’t mention that I played a battle replay in the conference room later…”
“Huh…?” Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi were silent.
This kid still knew not to let the Void Mantis know!
If the Void Mantis knew that he had secretly recorded the scene of it being beaten up for others to see, it would kill him!
“Let’s talk about eating later. Shi Yu, that superpower was plundered from An Chang’s Talent Bead, right?”
Shi Yu entrusted the gem cat to take care of An Chang, so he naturally entrusted Principal Feng to take care of this kid.
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Yes, it was developed through the Talent Bead. However, thinking of my level, this is only one of the conditions.”
“That kid is really a lucky star of Ancient Capital University!!” Principal Feng sighed.
An Chang’s Awakening Mirror gave Shi Yu the initial idea of the mechanical phantom beast system.
An Chang’s Talent Bead allowed Shi Yu to develop superpowers through it.
“Therefore, I plan to make a trip to Dragon Palace City before going to Tingxiang this time. I’ll also bring him over and throw him over to train for a few days to thank him.” Shi Yu smiled.
He would ask Senior Sea Dragon King to give his sea dragon special treatment and Senior Butterfly God to bless his green cocoon.
“Sure.” Principal Feng nodded and smiled. Training was good. Training was good so that he could grow into the new pillar of Ancient Capital University.
Just as Shi Yu and the others were about to eat, something was happening at the Mechanical Research Institute in Wu Ling City…

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 748 The Final Form of Telepathy (3)
chapters.content:
748 The Final Form of Telepathy (3)
In order to study mechanical phantom beasts, Dong Huang established a total of three mechanical phantom beast research institutes, respectively in Wu Ling City, Ancient Capital University, and Star Capital.
Among them, Star Capital was the main research base. The most common were mechanical intelligence and Mechanics from the fourth bureau.
As for the mechanical phantom beast research institute in Wu Ling City and Ancient Capital University, it was purely because the mechanical phantom beast army that Shi Yu applied for later was training with the Iron-eating Beast Army and the Green Silkworm cocoon army over there.
As for Ancient Capital University, in order to develop the Mechanic class, they also established a phantom beast research institute. At the moment, some Mechanic students had made it through and contracted a mechanical phantom beast.
Therefore, when this batch of Mechanic students grew up, perhaps the battle club of Ancient Capital University could harvest another batch of unexpected new blood.
....
Star Capital Technology Garden.
In the fourth bureau, Dr. Mei Xiuying, Legend Xiao Shuang, and Major General Xiao Qin were all neatly working for Shi Yu to study the mechanical phantom beast system.
Apart from that, some of the other seniors from the fourth bureau, even Grandma Li from Bureau 11, President Ye from the third bureau, and even Fang Lan’s parents and the others were here. The mechanical phantom beast research institute here could be said to have gathered dozens of elites in the mechanical, archeological, and feeding fields.
It wasn’t like there wasn’t a super research brain with perfect proficiency.
Under the hard work of this group of people and with the support of some of the technology and ideas provided by Shi Yu, the cultivation of the Soul Heart Fruit was smooth. Batch after batch of mechanical phantom beasts successfully revived, and the technology was gradually perfected. In just a few months, Dong Huang relied on this technology to revive many extinct pets and many lost skills.
However, what gave this group of elites the greatest headache was that the research progress of the most important Mythical fossil was still almost zero.
The dream illusion of this Mythical fossil was like a ball of mist. It was impossible to see clearly, let alone materialize, replicate, and revive into a phantom life form.
At this moment, one of the main people in-charge here, Legend Xiao Shuang and Major General Xiao Qin’s mother, Madam Mei Xiuying, who was the judge of the Mechanical Conference at that time, suddenly received a call from President Lin.
“President Lin.” Mei Xiuying was not surprised to receive President Lin’s call. This was because the research progress of the mechanical phantom beast had to be continuously reported recently.
She estimated that President Lin was here to ask about the progress again.
“President Lin, you called just in time. Good news.”
“What good news? Dr. Mei, could it be that your research on the Mythical fossil has also made progress?”
Dr. Mei Xiuying chuckled and said, “How is that possible? The progress of that fossil is still the same. It’s just that our initial judgment is that the evolution potential of the mechanical phantom beast is very huge. Apart from upgrading through mechanical parts, a mechanical phantom beast can also evolve by loading a second fossil. In other words, a mechanical phantom beast might contain the power of two illusions! Fusion evolution!”
“Although mechanical phantom beasts are the same as biological modification machines and don’t have long lifespans, this discovery has improved the strategic significance of mechanical phantom beasts…”
Dr. Mei Xiuying said excitedly. Just imagine, how cool would it be if the Tyrant Dragon Phantom that originally couldn’t fly successfully fused with the Wind God Winged Dragon Phantom and grew wings? At the same time, it would become the overlord of the earth and sky.
Fusion of the Sea Dragon Phantom and the swimming Sea Tyrant Dragon… was also pretty cool!
“Huh?” As Dr. Mei Xiuying spoke, she suddenly felt that something was wrong. She said in surprise, “President Lin, what did you just say? What do you mean by ‘Could it be that our Mythical fossil research has also made progress’?”
She had discovered a blind spot.
President Lin said, “Shi Yu improved the Time Meditation Technique and optimized the dream entry skill. He has already successfully revived the Wind Kirin Phantom. Since you haven’t developed any results, send this Mythical fossil to Shi Yu first and let him study it.”
Dr. Mei Xiuying: “?”
“Wh-what!!!” The old woman said in disbelief, “Shi Yu… Shi Yu succeeded?”
No, stop kidding.
The dozens of them and the super smart brain studied together, but the progress was still stuck here. How could Shi Yu be so fast?
President Lin said, “Not many people need to know about this. Just send the Mythical fossil to Shi Yu as soon as possible.”
Dr. Mei looked shocked. So, it was true??
She still felt that it was a little ridiculous!
“I understand.” Whether it was true would be known as long as she personally sent the fossil to Shi Yu later.
....
At the meal, Shi Yu and the others chatted about superpowers and the Phoenix Army for the entire night.
After learning that Zhang Qianyi had the aptitude of a phoenix hybrid and that Shi Yu had the intention of establishing the Phoenix Army, Old Master Feng was extremely excited.
This matter had to be dealt with by Lu Qingyi’s mother, his daughter!
Good things shouldn’t be left to outsiders.
The Phoenix Army sounded like a powerful army battle power in the future.
Apart from that, after learning that Shi Yu still wanted to continue developing his telepathy talent through the Talent Bead, Principal Feng and Lu Qingyi couldn’t help but fall silent for Shi Yu’s bold idea.
He didn’t expect that one spiritual power couldn’t satisfy Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu also expressed that he would try his best to let his seniors learn Psychic power before the World Tournament.
After that, Shi Yu went back to rest. He planned to recover quickly and teach Ling Mythical Revival.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 749 The Final Form of Telepathy (4)
chapters.content:
749 The Final Form of Telepathy (4)
At the same time, he also received a call from Dr. Mei, planning to wait for them at Ancient Capital University tomorrow.
After returning, in the ruins space, Shi Yu and Ling were drinking memory water.
On Ling’s side, it wanted to see if it could recall more dream memories through the memory water drop.
Unfortunately, the situation was not good.
In the end, he probably had to start with the Mythical Revival.
As for Shi Yu, he was searching for memories of his “past life”.
He held the Talent Bead and continued to develop his telepathy talent.
It took more than two months. Shi Yu had failed many times, but at the moment, he was gradually confirming the idea of telepathy development.
It was Eleven and Buggy that had inspired Shi Yu.
It was the profession of archeologist that gave Shi Yu inspiration.
It was his experiences in his previous life that gave him inspiration.
The core of Shi Yu’s current thought process was “Idealism”.
“Everything is born of the heart.”
“The universe is my heart, and my heart is the universe.”
“All existences are materialized from the heart.”
In other words, Buggy’s power of imagination.
Buggy’s power of imagination could turn all imagination into reality.
To put it bluntly, it was to dare to think. The bigger the imagination, the bigger the heart, and the bigger the world.
Therefore, Shi Yu was wondering if he could rely on his mental strength and imagination to strengthen his pet.
If he believed that if Eleven could defeat a divine beast, Eleven would obtain powerful strength.
It firmly believed that if Buggy could become the strongest dragon, it could definitely become the strongest dragon.
It was purely a power born from the heart.
However, imagination alone was useless. Shi Yu also needed more to support his imagination and faith.
Just like how Buggy’s Imagination Phantom also needed to rely on equipment, Shi Yu also needed to rely on some “external forces”.
And for these external forces, Shi Yu chose “archeological discoveries from his previous life”, “mythical legends from his previous life”, and “heart thoughts from his previous life”.
Before transmigrating, Shi Yu was a Mythical Scholar and an archeologist. In his previous life, he had come into contact with more ancient ruins than in the two years he had transmigrated.
However, those ruins on Earth didn’t have extraordinary power, so they looked ordinary.
However, the current Shi Yu didn’t think that they were ordinary.
Because he had also seen the nine inscriptions carved on Eleven in a certain ruin on Earth.
There was a connection between Earth and Blue Planet that Shi Yu had yet to forget.
In fact, figuring out this connection was Shi Yu’s greatest goal now.
In that case, if some of the myths, beliefs, and power he knew were true, could he borrow them for himself?
He relied on the power of his imagination to transfer their power to his pet.
With the help of the memory water drop, Shi Yu kept wandering in the sea of memories. In the dark world, he saw a “First Chinese Painting” carved on the stone wall. It was two black and white Yin Yang fish wrapping each other. With the help of the memory water drop, with the help of mental strength, and with the help of the meditation technique, they looked much more magical than when Shi Yu saw them himself.
Countless layers superimposed. Shi Yu seemed to see the process of the universe going from infinity to Taiji to the transformation of all things. He saw the process of chaos splitting Yin and Yang and even splitting Yin and Yang.
As a transmigrator, Shi Yu naturally knew what these were. They indeed seemed to contain some powerful power, and the concept of Yin Yang Taiji didn’t exist on Blue Planet in the Beast Taming Era. Therefore, Shi Yu was thinking that if this painting really contained some kind of power of the natural order, was it possible to rely on his understanding and mental strength to affect his pet?
Apart from that, in the dark meditation scene, Shi Yu also saw a starry sky and a constellation through the power of the memory water drop. They were also carved on the stone wall. However, the simple pattern was lifelike in Shi Yu’s eyes.
There were a total of seven constellations. They were connected together and looked like dragons. This was the origin of one of the Four Spirits of Heaven, the Green Dragon.
The myths and legends of the Green Dragon existed on Earth and Blue Planet, but similarly, both Earth and Blue Planet thought that this was fiction.
In both places, the Green Dragon referred to the name of the Eastern Dragon-shaped constellation. It originated from the worship of the ancient constellations. On Blue Planet, the Green Dragon was the earliest recorded in the totem era. It was said that it was a divine beast made up by humans in the totem era in order to scare other totems.
In the east of Blue Planet, the Green Dragon was very famous. It was one of the dragon-element Mythical totems that humans believed in. However, among the orthodox dragons, be it East Sea Dragon Palace City or the Western dragons, they didn’t recognize the Green Dragon.
This was because there were detailed records in Dragon Palace City and the Western Dragon Empire. The ancestor of the dragon race was a World Destruction Divine Dragon named “Ancestral Dragon”. It was a native divine dragon of Blue Planet born on its mother planet, not a green dragon totem created by humans and some subspecies dragons through the constellations.
If the green dragon was formed by a constellation, it was no longer a native creature of Blue Planet, so the concept of the green dragon was not orthodox on Blue Planet.
However, the concepts of the Green Dragon, the Vermillion Bird, the White Tiger, and the Black Tortoise spread very widely on Blue Planet. In fact, many transcendent life forms believed it and evolved towards these concepts. There was even no lack of totem-level creatures and even demigods in the future, but most dragons still recognized the Ancestral Dragon more.
It was mainly because one had evidence, and the other didn’t.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu discovered some divine powers of the green dragon through the green dragon diagram in his memory.
That made sense. Even if the Green Dragon was really fictional, after being worshiped for so long, it should have given birth to a spirit like the Blue Sea Sprite, right?
Unfortunately, Shi Yu still couldn’t connect these miracles to Eleven, Buggy, and the others…
“Is there anything lacking…”
Shi Yu opened his eyes. The Yin Yang Taiji Painting flashed in his eyes that reflected his heart, but it quickly disappeared. Shi Yu sighed. He definitely didn’t have enough awareness.
Damn it.
But no matter what, after seeing these magical patterns from the ruins of Earth through the memory water drop and the power of meditation, Shi Yu was even more certain that developing telepathy in this direction was not wrong.
Through their mental connection, they could transmit the magical power they sensed to their pets. Through the power of imagination, they could use this power on them and help them become stronger. As long as they dared to imagine it, Eleven could step on the Yin Yang Diagram and fight a divine dragon. Buggy could occupy the seven stars and become a green dragon.
He felt that this should be the final form of the archeologist’s telepathy in Bureau 11! In comparison, spiritual power was just a casual addition during the development process

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 750 Unlucky Person (1)
chapters.content:
750 Unlucky Person (1)
The next day.
Shi Yu woke up in a daze.
He looked at the time. It was not even eight in the morning. It was still early.
He could still sleep for eight more hours.
However, when he recalled that he had to get a delivery at eight this morning, he had no choice but to get up.
Soon, Shi Yu went out. Soon, he brought back the Mythical fossil researched by the Star Capital Mechanical Beast Research Institute.
The delivery team was Dr. Mei and her daughter.
Although Dr. Mei and the others wanted to talk to Shi Yu in detail, there didn’t seem to be anything to talk about. This was because the progress of the Mechanic class was similar to that of the Star Capital Research Institute. There was nothing to share and communicate about.
The ones from the Star Capital Research Institute were Beast Tamers with max-level Psychic power, the father of mechanical phantom beasts, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng. Shi Yu had no communication.
After sending the three deliverymen away, Shi Yu returned to the dormitory and looked at the gray fossil.
“Buggy.”
After Shi Yu shouted, Buggy swung its tail and flew out eagerly. It was very smug and had yet to recover from the smugness of defeating the Void Mantis.
“Let’s go in and take a look,” Shi Yu said to Buggy with the fossil.
“Wu!” Buggy nodded, indicating that it would leave it to him.
Two minutes later…
Shi Yu and Buggy came out of the fossil dream with serious expressions.
He felt that he couldn’t blame the research progress of the Star Capital Research Institute for being slow.
It was because the dream of this fossil was too strange. Even if Shi Yu and Buggy went in to take a look, it was a fog. There was nothing.
Holding this Mythical quality and level-five Mythical fossil, Shi Yu and Buggy looked at each other.
So difficult?
Shi Yu and Buggy didn’t believe it and kept trying in various ways.
The so-called various methods were to stack buffs. Be it possession, the Time Fruit, or borrowing equipment, they would do whatever they could to stack their attributes.
After a long time…
Shi Yu and Buggy’s eyes were red. They were as tired as dogs, but they still couldn’t see anything!
“So scammy?” Shi Yu said.
They had even entered the dream of the Kirin Race. Could this fossil be higher than the Kirin Race?!
According to archeological discoveries, in the Eastern Mythical Era, the dragon, phoenix, and Kirin races occupied the main positions. They should have the highest status in the Mythical Era. They had orthodox Mythical inheritances and were Mythical races.
Apart from top-notch myths like the Ancestral Dragon and the Origin Phoenix, there were also many sub-races. For example, the Kirin Race included many attributes. There was the Wind Kirin, naturally, there was the Golden Kirin and the Fire Kirin…
It was precisely because the race was huge and there were many ruins left behind that their historical traces could be passed down to this day.
Among them, the dragon race was at the top, leaving behind the two huge factions that crossed the Totem Era and the Beast Taming Era, Dragon Palace City and the Dragon Empire.
Therefore, the dragons didn’t acknowledge the Green Dragon because in their inheritance, the Green Dragon was just a figment of the humans of the totem era.
However, it was true that the Green Dragon totem had collected an incomparably huge amount of faith.
Green Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermillion Bird. These totem divine beasts that humans created with their constellations condensed a large amount of faith. If they were also real, their strength might not be weak.
After all, using faith and becoming a god was also a path. This was what the fox god of the Heavenly Fox Nation relied on. Even the Blue Sea Sprite was born from faith.
This was also why some totems evolved in the direction of the fictional Four Holy Beasts.
Shi Yu suspected that, including the “four holy beasts” gathered by Emperor Wu and the original owner of the legendary dragon ball equipped by Buggy, they had all evolved in the direction of the four holy beasts with little thoughts.
He was probably wondering if he could get some power of faith by evolving in this direction.
Otherwise, without benefits, who would be so bored as to evolve in the direction of the fictional totem divine beasts? But if they could inherit their power of faith, that would be different.
After all, even in the current Dong Huang, many people believed in the Green Dragon Totem.
Although the Four Holy Beasts were fictional, they could be said to be household names among humans and transcendent creatures.
Ordinary people in Dong Huang might not know about the Ancestral Dragon, but they definitely knew about the Green Dragon.
Compared to the prosperity of the Dragon Race, the Phoenix Race was more miserable. In ancient times, it was even glorious and was even the behind-the-scenes totem of the empress dynasty. But in the modern era, there were already very few powerful Phoenix Races.
The only one Shi Yu knew was still sealed.
As for the Kirin Race, they were even worse than dragons and phoenixes. Although there weren’t many purebloods in the Phoenix Race, there were still some transcendent creatures with part of the Phoenix bloodline. However, the Kirin Race really didn’t have any inheritance at all, only leaving behind their once glorious history, proving that they were once as powerful as dragons and phoenixes.
However, this was enough. After all, it was one of the few races with Mythical races in the east.
Therefore, if Shi Yu used the Wind Kirin fossil to create the mechanical phantom beast of the Kirin race, it would undoubtedly be an earthquake for the archeological and Beast Taming worlds.
As for those divine beasts without races and “individuals who became gods”, their inheritance and history were even more serious. Even their names had already disappeared in the long river of history.
Shi Yu and Buggy continued to take a look at the fossil. They still couldn’t spy on the dream.
“This should be a fossil left behind by a real Mythical creature,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!” Buggy nodded. That should be the case.
That Wind Kirin should only be a Mythical race and not a Mythical level, so it was easier for them to spy on its dreams.

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 751 Unlucky Person (2)
chapters.content:
751 Unlucky Person (2)
Because the Wind Kirin’s growth level was not high, even if the fossil it left behind was preserved by Dragon Palace City, its energy had already disappeared.
However, this fossil that also came from the Mythical Era still had level-five energy fluctuations after so long. It definitely couldn’t be as simple as a divine beast cub.
There was an 80% chance that it was a Mythical big boss when he was alive!
Shi Yu and Buggy still wanted to continue researching when another call came.
When Shi Yu saw the caller ID, he was immediately amused and chose to answer.
“Shi Yu, I’ve considered it. I want to become a hybrid of the Phoenix Race.” On the other side, Zhang Qianyi’s voice came from Shi Yu’s batch of Beast Tamers.
“Have you considered it? Alright, then contact Lu Qingyi.”
Zhang Qianyi: …
Didn’t this guy ask him to contact him?
Why did it become someone else after just a day?
Then why didn’t he let her contact Senior Lu directly…
Shi Yu had already thrown the Phoenix Fruits, research data, cultivation method, and Phoenix Radar to Senior Lu and Principal Feng at the meal yesterday.
He just had to wait for the Phoenix Army to take shape.
“Oh right, Senior Lu seems to be carrying out the legend assessment today. If no one picks up, wait. Don’t worry, you can also go to Principal Feng, but maybe Principal Feng also went to see the legend assessment…”
Zhang Qianyi: …
After Shi Yu brushed off the young lady here, he continued to be busy. He was also thinking if he should go and take a look at his senior’s legend assessment…
Forget it, the legend assessment wasn’t difficult. It wasn’t worth watching.
Senior Lu shouldn’t feel any pressure to pass.
A legend Beast Tamer license required the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming level to reach level seven, and a pet’s growth level to reach the overlord level. At the same time, this overlord-level pet couldn’t be too weak. With the help of the Beast Tamer, it couldn’t be justified for it to be weaker than ordinary overlords without the enhancement of the Beast Taming Talent.
Therefore, the legendary assessment was a 1VS1 between overlords.
They weren’t expected to win, but one couldn’t be too lousy either.
For example, the “Earth Abyss Demon Tree” Shi Yu had encountered previously would definitely not be able to pass Dong Huang’s legend assessment.
Under normal circumstances, it wouldn’t be easy for Senior Lu either.
Because her pet that broke through to overlord was the Courtyard Sprite, and the Courtyard Sprite was her latest contracted pet. It had never received the “Mythical Revival” skill inheritance.
The reason why this pet was the first to break through was because Senior Lu had obtained the legendary undead resources of Ancient Capital University and could be used by the Courtyard Sprite.
Considering the practicality of the possession skill of the Courtyard Sprite, it could make up for her shortcoming of not having battle power and not being able to cooperate with her pet. Lu Qingyi simply didn’t use this resource to exchange for other legendary resources.
However, that was a normal situation. The situation was abnormal now. Shi Yu firmly believed that Senior Lu could pass because he had given Lu Qingyi a drop of memory water. It was enough to increase the proficiency of the possession skill to Dao Proficiency.
An overlord-level sprite, undead, and a legendary Beast Tamer. The two combined through max-level possession. Even if their battle power couldn’t compare to a top-notch overlord, they could definitely suppress ordinary overlords.
The enhancement of max-level possession was much stronger than the enhancement of a Beast Tamer’s pet with a strengthening talent.
However, Shi Yu heard that the one who gave Senior Lu the assessment was Master Qu Jie, who had obtained an overlord-level partner… This was very coincidental.
“It’s all thanks to me…” Shi Yu sighed!
As noon approached, Shi Yu gave up studying fossils and stopped wasting his energy. If he wasted any more energy, he really wouldn’t have time to teach Ling Mythical Revival.
Shi Yu was just about to pick up the phone to ask Senior Lu and the others about the assessment when Lu Qingyi called Shi Yu first.
“How is it?” Shi Yu asked.
“I passed. It’s all thanks to your possession memory water drop. Otherwise, I’m afraid I wouldn’t have been able to win this battle.” Lu Qingyi was extremely happy and thanked him.
Shi Yu coughed. There was no requirement to win the legend assessment. Usually, one would pass after fighting for an hour or two without a winner. It was very rare for new legends to defeat the examiner at once, but from the looks of it, Senior Lu had done it.
Master Qu Jie’s new overlord partner didn’t look good.
Could it be at the level of the Prediction Owl?
“What did Master Qu Jie say?”
“He seems to be very shocked. I didn’t expect my strength to increase so much after I entered the possession state.”
“Haha, then what did you say…”
“It’s all thanks to you, which is what I told Master Qu Jie.” Lu Qingyi smiled. Shi Yu had indeed taught her well. No, the resources provided were very good!
“This…” Shi Yu said,” Then? ”
“Then… Then, Master Qu Jie was expressionless and didn’t say anything. He just wanted to treat you to a meal tonight to thank you for saving Qu Ling in the Heavenly Fox Nation…”
Shi Yu scratched his head. Was it sincere?
….
The news of Lu Qingyi passing the legend assessment was announced very quickly.
The assessment she passed in the morning had already been announced to the outside world by the Dong Huang Association at noon.
This news undoubtedly caused a stir in Dong Huang’s Beast Taming Domain again.
Six!!
There were already six legend Beast Tamers in the top ten of the Sequence.
In the world competition more than 20 years ago, Dong Huang had only gathered three legends under the age of 30.
And 20 years later, the number actually doubled.
The sect master of the Binhai Training Hall, Zheng Hai, had just broken through to the legendary level when Lu Qingyi followed closely behind, making the Beast Tamers’ gazes focus on the Sequence ranking again.
Wu Ling City.
White Brook looked at the battle picture of Lu Qingyi in her sprite form on the headlines. She couldn’t wait. So beautiful! So beautiful! Damn it, she couldn’t keep up with Senior Lu’s progress anymore. What should she do?

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 752 Unlucky Person (3)
chapters.content:
752 Unlucky Person (3)
In fact, in the past few days, White Brook felt that she was about to be surpassed by Senior Panda. Senior Ji Mengzhu was too strong. Even White Brook was considering whether she should be thick-skinned enough to acknowledge Senior Ji Mengzhu as her master.
Imperial Capital.
Ji Feng watched in silence as his former defeated opponent overtook him step by step. He sighed slightly. As for him, he probably had no hope of breaking through to the legend level before the world competition. The progress was too different.
Big news always followed. After the Dong Huang Association announced the news that Lu Qingyi had advanced to the legend level, the Sequence ranking was immediately updated.
The updated ranking stunned everyone.
Sequence first place, Ye Xing, this second-generation heir’s status was still unshakable.
Sequence two, Divine Bell, descendant of a mechanical legend. The ranking was still stable.
Third, Jiang Tianyang, the legendary noble son of a large financial group, fourth in the Sequence, Zheng Hai, the legendary disciple of the Tyrannical Sea!
Seeing this, everyone realized that Zheng Hai had successfully challenged the original fourth place, Zhou Ming!
Zhou Ming was considered the weakest in the previous top four of the Sequence. The reason why he was so fierce was that his Beast Taming Talent had mutated, and it was a fusion talent.
It could allow the different pets he contracted to temporarily fuse and evolve. Because of this powerful talent, he was taken in by a legendary Beast Tamer as a disciple to nurture.
However, from the looks of it, an ordinary legend’s disciple was still inferior to a Titled Legend disciple. Once he broke through, Zheng Hai immediately challenged Zhou Ming successfully and obtained fourth place in the Sequence!
Of course, this was also related to the cultivation idea of the Tyrannical Sea Legend. The Tyrannical Sea Legend paid a lot of attention to Zheng Hai’s foundation. When one of Zheng Hai’s Giant Leviathan’s super racial skills was close to perfect proficiency, the Tyrannical Sea Legend didn’t let him break through. Instead, it let him train all super racial skills to this level before breaking through in one go.
This way, the overlord body he obtained would be even stronger.
Therefore, once Zheng Hai broke through, his strength was quite extraordinary.
The Beast Tamers who were watching the show felt that it was nothing. They only felt that Legend Zhou Ming was a little unlucky. He was first defeated by the noble son of a large financial group, and then by the Titled Legendary disciple. He was an unlucky person.
If that was all, it wasn’t too much of a scam. The most scammy thing was that it was Sequence five…
Sequence five… Everyone was very sure that their eyes weren’t wrong.
On the fifth place of the Sequence, the name was still “Top-notch Master Shi Yu”!!!
As for Zhou Ming, after losing two consecutive battles, he directly fell to sixth place and squeezed Lu Qingyi, a new legend, to seventh place. However, fifth place… The fifth place that was stuck between a bunch of legends was still Shi Yu, a top-notch master.
This change undoubtedly stunned everyone.
They instantly understood what this meant.
This meant that the Sequence Competition Committee thought that Zhou Ming, who was ranked third in the former Sequence, couldn’t defeat the number one person below the legendary level?
It was fine if Lu Qingyi had just advanced without any battle results, but Zhou Ming was originally third in the Sequence… He was actually ranked behind Shi Yu.
Causing trouble!
Most Beast Tamers immediately felt that the Sequence Competition Committee was causing trouble.
In Divine Capital, a young man less than 1.7 meters tall, fair and tender, with a chubby figure and face, stared at his falling Sequence ranking, his heart bleeding.
