His face was incomparably red as he muttered, “It’s over, it’s over. Even if I lose two rounds of my legendary resources, why am I ranked sixth? Is this reasonable?”
“I’ve clearly never fought this Shi Yu before, so why am I ranked below him!!”
He immediately targeted Shi Yu.
However, when he saw that there was still Lu Qingyi, who had just advanced to the legendary level, Zhou Ming had a subtle headache. He felt that if he couldn’t enter the top five, he would be beaten to death by his master…
What he didn’t know was that the Sequence Battle Committee had no choice. This was because the budget of the entire selection competition was five legendary resources. Shi Yu had already taken one away in advance, so they naturally had to rank him in the top five…
Moreover, Director Zhong, who had watched the battle between Zheng Hai and Zhou Ming, was indeed not very satisfied with this little fatty’s performance. He felt that he was too relaxed, so he naturally couldn’t let this fatty easily obtain legendary resources.
The settlement of the Sequence ranking was about to end. Whether he wanted to obtain the legendary resource depended on whether he could give it a try in the end.
Even if Shi Yu had already taken away a legendary resource in advance, if someone defeated him, the Sequence Competition Committee could only apply for one more.
And if, as a legend, they couldn’t even defeat a top-notch master like Shi Yu, it would be a waste to apply for another legendary resource for them. It was better to give Ye Xing and Divine Bell to strengthen the primary battle power more.
Shi Yu… directly became a touchstone arranged by the Sequence Committee for Lu Qingyi and Zhou Ming…
“Is Director Zhong causing trouble?”
At this moment, Shi Yu from Ancient Capital University also discovered the updated ranking.
Shi Yu wouldn’t be surprised if he was squeezed out of the top five. After all, he was the only one in front who wasn’t a legend.
After being squeezed out, he wouldn’t continue fighting. After all, he had already received the resources. It was impossible for the association to give him repeats, so he wouldn’t scam others.
But the problem was, what did they mean by placing himself in fifth place…
Shi Yu had a strange expression. Soon, he silently received a challenge application from the sixth of the Sequence… This little fatty with a weak presence panicked.
[Challenge Message]: Dr. Shi Yu, Dr. Shi Yu, let’s fight ~
“Challenging a top-notch master like me, you have no integrity.”
“Forget it, ignore it.” Shi Yu took a look. After all, it was his future bodyguard. It was better not to damage the child’s confidence.
At the moment, the Sequence battle was coming to an end. It was a mandatory challenge stage. The challenged party couldn’t refuse. If they didn’t accept it within 24 hours or refused to accept the challenge, they would automatically be judged to have lost.
Shi Yu chose to ignore the challenge and wait for the system to automatically squeeze him out. As for this Zhou Ming, Shi Yu estimated that even if he entered the top five, he wouldn’t stay long. He would eventually be beaten by Senior Lu. He was an unlucky guy.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 753 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (1)
chapters.content:
753 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (1)
Shi Yu ignored Zhou Ming and continued recuperating.
With a nourishing meal, if it went smoothly, he could teach Ling the Mythical Revival skill tonight.
At this moment, he didn’t plan to stay idle. He took out his phone and called his lucky star, An Chang.
“Senior Shi Yu!”
Ever since he gave the memory water drop to An Chang before going to the Seven Islands, Shi Yu had never paid attention to him.
An Chang had always wanted to thank Shi Yu in person, but unfortunately, he couldn’t find Shi Yu.
This time, Shi Yu called. An Chang was very excited.
“Little An, how’s the situation recently? Are you a high-level Beast Tamer?”
“Ah, this.” An Chang was a little stunned. How could it be so fast? He was only in his first year.
“Senior Shi Yu, I’m already an intermediate Beast Tamer, but I’m still a little short of a high-level Beast Tamer…”
“Well…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said,” What about the pet situation? ”
An Chang immediately said, “It’s all thanks to your dragon blood, Senior. Although I’m only level three and the Sea Dragon is only at the transcendent level, after we fuse, it’s easy for us to defeat ordinary commander-level pets.”
His tone was filled with joy as he said, “And the Green Silkworm has also successfully evolved. It used the super proficient worm silk to evolve into a Green Silkworm cocoon. Its growth level has also reached the transcendent level. It shouldn’t be long before it can break out of the cocoon and become a butterfly.”
“By the way, the evolution materials are the recommended ones for the White Star Phoenix Butterfly evolution path researched by Dr. Zuo.”
“On the basis of the low-level monarch race’s White Star Butterfly, there are additional phoenix materials.”
“I haven’t contracted the third pet, but Principal Feng has already contacted me and said that he wants to give me a talented Iron-eating beast cub.”
Shi Yu said, “Not bad. Are you free recently?”
“I’m free. Senior, what’s the matter? By the way, I haven’t thanked you for that water drop…” After An Chang obtained Shi Yu’s Worm Silk Memory Water in the Heroic Ruins, he could be said to be extremely shocked.
Originally, his Green Silkworm Silk proficiency was transcendent and was already very rare. However, after using this memory water drop, the worm silk proficiency actually continued to increase. In the end, it even reached another realm.
This also made his Green Silkworm magical during the evolution process. Its life force and energy value had a qualitative leap.
If it broke out of the cocoon… He didn’t dare to think about it.
This was definitely a super treasure.
“It’s good that you’re free. Let me introduce you to a friend. Go and find it to help evolve the Green Silkworm cocoon now. Then, in a few days, come to Dragon Palace City with me. I’ll arrange some training missions for you. Try to become a high-level Beast Tamer before school starts in your second year.”
After hearing Shi Yu’s words, An Chang was slightly stunned. Senior Shi Yu wanted to personally arrange a training mission for him?
In an instant, An Chang was extremely excited. He had also seen the updated Sequence ranking just now. He still believed in the value of Shi Yu, the number one person below the legendary level and the national champion.
“Alright.” An Chang nodded heavily.
Shi Yu also nodded. The Awakening Mirror and Talent Bead An Chang took out played a crucial role in the entire development of Dong Huang. One was the mechanical phantom beast system, and the other was the superpower system. Shi Yu had already decided that even if he used resources, it would pile him to the legend level.
After the Butterfly God and the Sea Dragon King helped build the foundation for the pet, Shi Yu didn’t believe that he couldn’t nurture a Beast Tamer with legend potential.
Next, Shi Yu provided the location of the butterfly god’s habitat to An Chang and let him find it himself. As for helping it evolve, Shi Yu had already informed the butterfly god in advance.
Although for ordinary Beast Tamers, even Shi Yu of Bureau 11 at that time, the daughter of a legend, Xia Qingwei, had to wait for a specific time for the Butterfly Meeting to help evolve. However, with Shi Yu’s current situation, it was definitely easy for the Butterfly God to help. The Butterfly God would also give him face.
After all, Shi Yu… had already shattered one totem. In addition to a series of achievements, it was very difficult for the butterfly god not to treat Shi Yu as a figure of the same level.
After arranging for An Chang to leave, Shi Yu received a call from Director Zhong in the eighth bureau.
As soon as the call was picked up, Director Zhong’s chuckle came from the other side. “Shi Yu, did you see Zhou Ming’s challenge at the Sequence ranking?”
“I did.”
“Why don’t you accept it…”
Shi Yu said, “In any case, I’ve already taken all my rewards. If Senior Zhou Ming is willing to snatch the top five, so be it. Why should I join in the fun?”
Director Zhong: “?”
Why was this kid like this? He didn’t want to fight for the top five if there were no resources! He still had fame!
Director Zhong’s old face immediately fell. He had a headache. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to not follow the routine.
“Didn’t Lu Qingyi also break through to the legend level? Let the two of them fight. Whoever wins will get fifth place. I won’t join in the fun,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
The treatment he received for taking the legendary resources in advance had already exceeded first place. What else was there to think about? Unless the Sequence Competition Committee said that first place could get two legendary resources and not just the priority choice, he might go and fight for first place.
“I…” Director Zhong sighed and gritted his teeth.” I understand. ”
Obviously, he couldn’t do anything to Shi Yu either. After all, Shi Yu didn’t even care about the ranking, so he couldn’t force Shi Yu to accept the challenge.
After hanging up, Shi Yu stretched. It was easy not to pursue anything. If this were Heavenly King Zou, he would definitely be obsessed again.
In the next few days, Shi Yu stayed at Ancient Capital University as usual to relax. He even gathered with Master Qu Jie. Although he was a little traumatized by Shi Yu, he was grateful that Shi Yu had saved his daughter. Master Qu Jie was also sincere. In short, he didn’t suffer those beatings for nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 754 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (2)
chapters.content:
754 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (2)
As for the Sequence ranking, it successfully fell to seventh place under Shi Yu’s lousy laziness. However, the old unlucky Zhou Ming didn’t take fifth place either. Instead, it was intercepted by Lu Qingyi in the blink of an eye.
According to Senior Lu, the other party’s fusion talent development was not yet in place. It could only support the fusion and evolution of two pets. As long as Zhou Ming could let the three pets fuse and evolve together, or if he could let the four pets fuse and evolve separately, the outcome of the battle was uncertain.
In the form of a sprite, Lu Qingyi fought the fusion overlord. Senior Lu was slightly at a disadvantage, but the remaining top-notch monarchs who could revive their myths fought Zhou Ming’s other monarch pets. After the battle, Senior Lu quickly won the battle at the monarch level.
Then, with the support of the monarch pet, Senior Lu quickly took back her advantage and advanced to fifth place.
!!
From then on, Dong Huang’s Sequence ranking stabilized. Shi Yu, the number one person below the legendary level, was reflected in the ranking. He was really the number one person below the legendary level.
Regarding this, most Beast Tamers were also very regretful. They didn’t understand why Shi Yu ignored Zhou Ming’s challenge. Did he think that his strength wasn’t enough to face a legend, or was there something he had to do?
There were various opinions on the Internet. Some felt that Shi Yu wasn’t ready to face a legend, while others felt that Shi Yu might be able to fight a legend above his level. However, as a busy person, he might not necessarily be able to take care of the tense Sequence ranking competition system. When he was free, he would definitely fight back.
Shi Yu didn’t care much about these claims. Instead, he was focused on “adding points to Mythical Revival”.
Now, Ling’s Mythical Revival had already been raised to (Proficient+1) by Shi Yu. He had added a total of three points.
Every time Shi Yu taught the Mythical Revival, Ling’s Kirin form would have more divine power. And after entering the Mythical Revival state, Ling’s energy level could also exceed 20 million.
If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, when Ling’s Mythical Revival proficiency reached the proficiency of Senior Lu’s pets, its energy level would be comparable to an overlord with a monarch. It shouldn’t be a problem to exceed 50 million.
Firstly, Ling’s foundation was stronger than Senior Lu’s pets, and secondly, Senior Lu’s pets’ divine power might not be as pure as the Wind Kirin’s divine bloodline.
After all, Ling had completed its evolution through the Wind Kirin fossil, while Senior Lu’s pet had only changed part of its bloodline and didn’t successfully evolve with divine power.
Shi Yu was naturally very happy that the strength of the youngest in the team had finally caught up. However, it had yet to master the “Wind Blessing” through Mythical Revival, which gave Shi Yu a headache.
The reason why he didn’t add points to Eleven’s superalloy and ran over to prioritize the Mythical Revival first was because he hoped that Ling could awaken a quasi-divine skill as soon as possible. If he had the providence of a quasi-divine skill, whatever he did next might be smoother.
However, the delay in awakening finally made Shi Yu decide that if the Mythical Revival didn’t cause a qualitative change after reaching expert level, he would do superalloy first.
“Senior Shi Yu, I’m ready.”
At Ancient Capital University, under Shi Yu’s dormitory, An Chang, who had returned from Divine Capital, held his cell phone and called for Shi Yu.
“Wait a second.”
Shi Yu hung up and packed up, preparing to set off for Dragon Palace City.
He had previously promised Senior Lu to go to Tingxiang together in nearly a month. It wasn’t time yet, so Shi Yu planned to bring An Chang to Dragon Palace City to take a look.
It was just waiting for Senior over there. When the time came, everyone would go by sea.
Apart from that, Shi Yu definitely had a goal.
He also planned to train Buggy. Firstly, he would let it visualize the Dragon God Statue in the Dragon God Ruins more before the World Tournament. Secondly, Dragon Palace City had many powerful overlords, much more than Dong Huang. With his position in Dragon Palace City, it shouldn’t be difficult for him to find a bunch of overlords to be sparring partners. It could also be considered to be preparing in advance for the World Tournament.
In Dragon Palace City, there were top-notch overlords and even invincible overlords comparable to totems. According to what Shi Yu knew, the Crown Prince of Dragon Palace City was an invincible overlord whose strength was not inferior to the Tyrannical Sea Legend, the Giant Leviathan. It could fight against totems.
“Let’s go.” After packing, Shi Yu came downstairs and looked at An Chang, who was already taller and stronger than him as if he had been injected with hormones. He was slightly silent.
Wasn’t this kid quite weak at the start? Why was he so strong?
Fusion Talent was really strange!
“You’ve gotten fatter,” Shi Yu said.
An Chang: …
Fat…?
“Ah… Perhaps it’s because I ate more,” An Chang scratched his head in embarrassment.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Relax. Next, I’m going to put you into the ruins space. When we reach Dragon Palace City, I’ll let you out. This is faster.”
“Alright.” An Chang nodded.
“I won’t let you be idle either,” Shi Yu said. “In order to test your strength, there’s my second team’s pets in the ruins space. Fight it after you enter.”
“Team Two pets?” An Chang was surprised. Senior Shi Yu had already started training Team Two?
That made sense. With the gift of telepathy and the portable ruins space, in addition to being very powerful and rich, it was normal for him to have the energy to nurture the second team.
“Yes, a Duckbill Beast.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, An Chang was even more shocked. Wait, Duckbill Beast?
Wasn’t the Duckbill Beast a pet of a transcendent race?
An Chang fell into deep thought. When he was put into the ruins space and saw the Duckbill Beast waiting for him in front of him, he was even more certain that his judgment was right.
At the same time, he was puzzled. Why would Senior Shi Yu contract a transcendent race to be the second team?

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 755 The First Quasi-Divine Skill in the Team (3)
chapters.content:
755 The First Quasi-Divine Skill in the Team (3)
With Senior Shi Yu’s strength, it should be easy for him to find an overlord cub.
“Quack.” Now that it had relied on its overlord will and battle experience to break through the racial restrictions, the commander rank duck looked at the new sparring partner Shi Yu had sent and frowned slightly.
“Hello.” An Chang also looked at the Duckbill Beast nervously.
He confirmed that it was an ordinary Duckbill Beast.
However, he didn’t dare to underestimate it. After all, Shi Yu was a very powerful man who could even nurture pets like the Iron-eating Beast, Green Silkworm, Baby Ginseng, and Slime. It was normal for a Duckbill Beast to be very strong.
“Quack!!”
As he couldn’t understand the duck’s words, An Chang quickly took out the top-notch mechanical equipment rewarded by Ancient Capital University, a mechanical equipment that connected ears and eyes like a battle power detector.
This was a type of spiritual sensing equipment that could allow Beast Tamers who couldn’t use telepathy to understand some of the language of transcendent creatures. It was considered a very high-level mechanical equipment. Even master-level Beast Tamers would find it difficult to afford it.
However, Ancient Capital University was rich this year. It could be said to be very generous to geniuses, especially the geniuses Shi Yu had named and taken care of.
“Quack. (You’re An Chang!)” Duck looked at this “weak” human compared to Shi Yu and said.
“Senior Duckbill Beast, I’m An Chang.” An Chang nodded crazily. At the same time, the information about the Duckbill Beast appeared on the lens.
< Name > Duckbill Beast
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: High Transcendent
[Level of Growth]: Commander
[Race Skill]: Water Blade, Heart Strike
Energy Points: 29,998
As expected!
As expected of Senior Shi Yu. Although this second team pet looked ordinary, its growth level had already broken through the racial level restriction. Moreover, as a transcendent race, commander rank, its energy level was already comparable to most commander rank races.
However, he felt that he could fight!
An Chang was especially grateful to Shi Yu at this moment. This was because under the butterfly god’s blessing, his green cocoon had already successfully evolved!
Low-level overlord race, White Star Phoenix Butterfly!
In addition, with the help of the Sea Dragon’s Fusion Talent, it might be able to fight above its level.
The standard of an intermediate Beast Tamer was that they could fight commanders above their level. An Chang had naturally reached it long ago.
Now, as the green cocoon evolved, there was even less pressure.
Moreover, it was mainly because Senior Duck Duck… It looked pretty harmless.
It reminded him of the Imperial Capital roast duck he had just finished eating the day before yesterday.
“Quack! (Then come on!)” Duck was about to vomit from fighting Little Ji and the Green Silkworm cocoon phantom all day.
It was good to change its taste!
Although it felt that An Chang’s strength was not much, Shi Yu had introduced him after all. He shouldn’t be too weak. Duckie thought for a moment and directly entered its second form. It was better to take it more seriously.
In the next moment, it looked at An Chang and its body suddenly increased to two meters!
Its blue skin began to be covered in black, leaving only a portion of dark blue patterns.
At its neck, the black water froze like a ribbon, becoming a scarf-like part that floated behind it.
In just a short moment, the image of the Duckbill Beast changed completely.
The terrifying aura emitted made the originally relaxed An Chang’s expression change drastically.
The Duckbill Beast’s deep red eyes opened and it looked at An Chang. At this moment, An Chang’s spirit seemed to have fallen into an abyss. In an instant, cold sweat flowed out of his entire body. He was so frightened that he took a step back and sensed an extremely terrifying evil aura.
< Name > ???
Energy Points: 74,747
“Quack! (Come, I’ll warm up with my weaker form first and see how your strength is.)”
An Chang: “?”
In the past few months, the duck had been eating the Abyss Reincarnation Bean cultivated by Baby Ginseng. Every time it ate it, it could awaken a portion of the abyss power. At first, it was indeed very difficult to control, but as Baby Ginseng reduced the amount of medicine in the Abyss Reincarnation Bean, and as Susu let the duck understand the full-level cleansing water through the memory water drop, it could gradually control the abyss power in this body.
Therefore, Duckie obtained two new forms. The first was in the current state. It was relatively easy to receive a portion of the power of the abyss. With this state, it could barely fight small opportunities of overlord races and commander ranks.
There was also a final form that received stronger abyssal power, but it was relatively difficult to control. It needed to cooperate with the overlord’s will. It would be extremely tired after the battle, so Duckie rarely used it. Most importantly, it couldn’t defeat the green cocoon phantom even if it used it.
Although it had only received a portion of the abyssal power now, it depended on whose abyssal power it was. In its previous life, as a demigod expert, Duckie’s aura was still very terrifying, immediately making An Chang a little absent-minded.
It condensed a black water spear and stabbed it into the ground, indicating that the boy opposite should quickly send out his pet.
“Wait, wait, Senior Duckbill Beast, what are you doing?”
“If you’re teaching newbies, isn’t that initial form enough…”
An Chang panicked. Why could the Duckbill Beast still transform? As expected, the textbooks weren’t trustworthy.
Duckie: “?”
….
At this moment, Shi Yu had already shouted for Ling to transform into its Kirin form and fly ten thousand meters in the sky.
Shi Yu originally wanted to enter the ruins and arrange for Duckie to fight An Chang, but as a busy person, he had never been free.
Just as he was about to set off for Dragon Palace City, he received a call from the Tyrannical Sea Legend.
“Senior Yu, what’s wrong?”
Tyrannical Sea Legend: “Legend Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court of the Seven Islands Phoenix God Shrine and Legend Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court are coming to Dong Huang in a while. They should want to see you. Are you free?”

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 756 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (4)
chapters.content:
756 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (4)
Shi Yu had a bitter expression. Why didn’t he say so in advance?
He was about to go to Dragon Palace City.
“Wait, the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi also passed the legend assessment?” Shi Yu discovered the problem.
The Tyrannical Sea Legend said, “Probably. She became the new legend of the Seven Islands. Therefore, it wasn’t easy for them to come to Dong Huang this time. The Seven Islands gave many obstructions. Perhaps because the incident of ‘Red God’ attacking the Phoenix Divine Master at that time also made the Phoenix God Society have some ill feelings towards the Seven Islands, so Dong Huang’s intention is to see if they can persuade the two of them to bring the Phoenix God Society to join Dong Huang.”
“As the designated heir of the Phoenix Mystic Realm, you might have a way.”
Dong Huang had always welcomed the immigration of such high-end talents. Even the other countries were poaching each other. Of course, if it were those lazy and useless foreign trash Beast Tamers who liked to point fingers, Dong Huang naturally wouldn’t accept it. If anyone could enter, Dong Huang wouldn’t be the number one country now.
Shi Yu was vexed and said, “Well… Let them be guests in the ancient capital first. Senior Lu and Principal Feng know the history mentioned by the Undying Dark Phoenix. Let them receive them first. I’m going to Dragon Palace City now. I have something to do. I’ll go back after I’m done.”
“Sure, they haven’t come yet anyway.” The Tyrannical Sea Legend nodded. This time, the two legends of the Phoenix Court shouldn’t leave in the short term.
After chatting for a while, Shi Yu and the Tyrannical Sea Legend ended the call. Then, Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
The Phoenix Shrine really came.
He just didn’t know if Dong Huang could be deceived.
Forget it.
Shi Yu entered the ruins, but the moment he entered, he saw the normal duck revealing a lonely expression as an expert, as well as An Chang, the Sea Dragon, and the White Star Phoenix Butterfly lying on the ground covered in injuries like a dead dog.
“Wu…” An Chang lay on the ground with his hands and feet twitching, his face filled with sorrow. Why, why was this Duckbill Beast so strong after returning to its normal state? It was different from the commander rank it had fought before with about 30,000 energy points!!
It was as if it had experienced hundreds of battles and was extremely experienced, like a master playing with a child.
“Quack… (After fusing with the pet, this guy can’t fight as well as Shi Yu could by himself…)” The duck sighed.
It looked like it had overestimated this kid.
“Looks like your cultivation isn’t good enough…” Shi Yu looked at An Chang and fell into deep thought. Why couldn’t he even defeat pets that had never been given points? This couldn’t do. When he arrived at Dragon Palace City, he had to train well.
….
Dragon Palace City.
First, they flew in the air on Ling, then dived into the sea through Susu. It didn’t take Shi Yu and the others long to arrive here.
Previously, if he wanted to come to Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu either had to let the Tyrannical Sea Legend bring him or the gem cat. But now, he himself had the ability to come to Dragon Palace City.
Dragon Palace City didn’t know at all that Shi Yu had come to Dragon Palace City this time. He didn’t inform them in advance, so when he arrived, the Dragon Palace army in charge of guarding the mystic realm of Dragon Palace City was very shocked. They didn’t expect Minister Shi Yu to come at this time.
However, Shi Yu was also considered a higher-up of Dragon Palace City. He even had his own palace in Dragon Palace City. Coming to Dragon Palace City was like coming to his home. He loved this place very much.
After entering Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu was not in a hurry to go home. Instead, he visited Mother Dragon first.
“Why are you here, kid!”
In the Ice Dragon Palace, the frost dragon looked at Shi Yu with disdain.
Nothing good would happen when Shi Yu came.
“I missed you, so I came to take a look,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Stop being cheeky. If you have something to say, let it go quickly. It’s delaying my cultivation,” Ice Dragon said.
“It’s not a big deal. I just want to go to Tingxiang to play for a few days later. Mother Dragon, isn’t your hometown over there? Do you want to travel for a few days? The gem cat will also go.”
The frost dragon was just about to refuse and say that it wasn’t free, but it suddenly recalled Shi Yu’s gains on the Seven Islands.
One Mythical and two Legendary!
Back then, when Shi Yu went to the Seven Islands, he had also invited it. It rejected him and regretted it later. After all, Shi Yu’s ability to find resources was top-notch.
This time… Shi Yu was going to Tingxiang to cause trouble again?
“Well, let me think. I’ll give you an answer later,” the frost dragon said, not in a hurry to refuse.
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I still have something to do with Senior Sea Dragon King. Then I’ll go over there first.”
“Go, go, go.”
Next, Shi Yu came to the Sea Dragon King’s Dragon Palace, but he was told by the Turtle Prime Minister that the Sea Dragon King had brought the little white dragon out to train… But he should be back in the next two days.
Shi Yu : “…”
What else could Shi Yu do? He could only wait.
This time, he returned to his palace in Dragon Palace City.
As for An Chang, he was in the ruins. It wasn’t a big problem to let the Duckbill Beast and Little Ji train for two days.
With him providing supplements and recovery items and being able to cultivate in the ruins, the effect would not be bad.
Then, when the Sea Dragon King returned, it would help the Sea Dragon purify its bloodline and evolve. It would be enough.
Shi Yu recuperated again and waited for the next Mythical Revival to add points. Only Buggy was released by Shi Yu and was sent to the Dragon God Statue in the Dragon God Ruins to cultivate.
At the moment, Shi Yu and Buggy were the only “outsiders” allowed by the Dragon God to go to the Dragon God Ruins through the Dragon God Palace. It wasn’t the first time Buggy had gone over itself, so it wasn’t a big problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 757 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (5)
chapters.content:
757 The First Quasi Divine Skill in the Team (5)
Even if the Dragon God discovered it, nothing would happen.
However, the situation was a little different this time.
Dragon God Palace.
At this moment, apart from the peerless Dragon God, there was actually a humanoid woman whose appearance was not inferior to the Dragon God.
She had sharp ears, long green hair that draped over her shoulders, golden eyes, a queen-shaped baby face, a delicate figure, skin, and huge natural charm. Her aura was extremely transcendent.
“Tian, a little guy seemed to have passed by your palace just now,” the green-haired woman said lazily.
“Don’t worry about it.” The Dragon God shook her head and also discovered the passing worm.
She understood that Shi Yu had come to Dragon Palace City again.
She had indeed given Shi Yu and Buggy the right to visualize and cultivate at the Dragon God Statue.
“A butterfly… And among monarchs, it’s considered very strong. It shouldn’t be a member of your Dragon Palace City, right?”
“Well, a pet of a human junior from Dong Huang.”
“Syl, continue talking about what happened just now.” The Dragon God looked at the Elven Empress from Tingxiang, an expert who was also a demigod-level life form like her.
Very few people knew that the Dragon God and the Elven Queen, Sylphra, were actually good friends.
“Alright, but I really didn’t expect your Dragon Palace City to choose not to participate in this world competition. I thought you would cooperate with Dong Huang.” Sylphra smiled.
“Since you’re not participating, help me. Let the few young people in our Tingxiang come to your Dragon Palace City to train and accumulate experience dealing with the dragons. Or you can let your overlords travel to Tingxiang. I’ll treat them well.”
The reason why the Dragon God and the Elven Empress had a good relationship was also because their relationship with the Western totem faction, the Dragon Empire, was not very good.
As for why the relationship between Tingxiang and the Dragon Empire was not good, it was because the Western legend said that the legendary Beast Tamer, the Dragon Hunter, was from Tingxiang…
The main reason why the Elven Empress descended this time was to discuss with her good friend about the Mythical Era that might approach next…
….
Two days later.
In the legendary ruins of Shi Yu’s palace.
Shi Yu looked at the gradually disappearing cooldown time and heaved a sigh of relief.
Then, he looked at the Cube in front of him.
At this moment, Ling analyzed and said, “According to calculations, the first qualitative change will occur when Mythical Revival reaches expert level.”
“It’s very likely to make the dream memory clearer, and it’s very likely to awaken the quasi-divine skill, Wind Blessing.”
“Stop talking, come on!”
Shi Yu couldn’t wait anymore. He directly pinched the cube in front of him and started to add points!!
Ling’s analysis was right. After adding points this time, the recovery of the divine power in its body was even stronger than before!!
As he was immersed in endless pain, Ling sensed the change in the Kirin fossil…
Soon, an incomparably huge surprise appeared in Ling and Shi Yu’s minds.
Quasi-divine skill, Wind Blessing, awakening!!!
As Shi Yu upgraded the Mythical Revival skill to expert level, the quasi-divine skill, the Wind Blessing that Ling couldn’t awaken when it evolved previously, was finally going to awaken this time!
Both Shi Yu and Ling were extremely excited. They knew what this meant.
This meant that Ling could directly jump from a quasi Mythical race to a Mythical race and obtain potential comparable to those demigods.
When it awakened the Wind Blessing, Ling directly returned to its Wind Kirin form. Its perfect form appeared again. The entire legendary ruin was affected by it at this moment. The sky and ground were white, and a light breeze circled. At this moment, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and the others, who were also in the legendary ruin, had their expressions suddenly change as they sensed the suppression from their bloodlines.
Even at this moment, the Tyrant Dragon, the Duckbill Beast, and even An Chang and the others in the ruins widened their eyes in shock. They sensed indescribable and indescribable power fluctuations that enveloped the world, making it difficult to breathe.
Dong…
At this moment, it was as if the legendary ruins had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of worldly laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power in the space were all suppressed, and it was no different from the abnormality of the quasi-divine skill described by Senior Ji Mengzhu.
In fact, forget about the legendary ruins, even the few islands around the island where Shi Yu lived felt an indescribable pressure as Ling awakened its quasi-divine skill and crossed the line to the Mythical race!!
The dragons looked at the sky in shock. This pressure shocked them, even more so than the Dragon Kings’ pressure. Although it wasn’t strong, the texture made some overlord dragons recall some memories.
Yes, this was the feeling when they saw the Dragon God!!!
“Has Lord Dragon God come out of seclusion?” Most of the dragons looked at the sky in shock.
The further away from Shi Yu, the harder it was to sense this divine pressure. However, for true experts, it was not difficult to sense this same power even from countless layers of space.
In the Dragon God Palace, the Dragon God and the Elven Empress were still chatting freely. Suddenly, their expressions changed slightly as they looked into the distance.
“Ah Tian, this is…” Sylphra looked surprised.
The Dragon God also looked confused.
How was that possible?
There were actually creatures in Dragon Palace City who could come into contact with the God Domain like them demigods? Those totem dragon kings? No, with their aptitude, it was impossible.
“There’s a life form that cultivated the prototype of a divine skill in Dragon Palace City!”
The Dragon God and the Elven Empress made a judgment at the same time. However, it didn’t look like a life form had broken through to the demigod level, but like a Mythical cub had descended… The two demigods quickly left the Dragon God Palace. Then, they saw a blue butterfly flying back awkwardly and anxiously… It looked at them…
Buggy: …

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 758 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (1)
chapters.content:
758 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (1)
Following the nomological fluctuations of the quasi-divine skill, the Dragon God and the Elven Empress descended on the island where Shi Yu was.
The island Shi Yu was on was called Blue Sea Island. It was specially modified for him to live as the minister of the Environmental Protection Department, Shi Yu.
Of course, a big shot like the Dragon God had naturally never paid attention to this kind of thing from the beginning to the end. It was all planned by the Ice Dragon King’s Turtle Prime Minister, so the Dragon God didn’t know whose territory this island was.
This island was not big, and the environment was very beautiful. It was cleansed to the point where there was not a trace of dirt. Even the Elven Empress, a natural sprite who controlled the forest and wind, discovered that this island was different from the other islands in Dragon Palace City.
The owner of this island… definitely had mysophobia.
“The other party is in an alternate space.”
Although Blue Sea Island didn’t look lifeless at this moment, after reaching the demigod level, these experts had already mastered very strong spatial attainments. Be it the Dragon God or the Elven Empress, they instantly determined that the other party was in the deep space of the Dragon Palace mystic realm.
“And it’s not just a simple alternate space,” the Elven Empress, Sylphra, said. With her perception, even ordinary totems probably couldn’t forcefully enter this space.
The spatial level was relatively high. It was a legendary spatial mystic realm.
Of course, for them, shattering a legendary space was already easy.
Standing in the sky and sensing the weak law fluctuations that contained the power of time and space, the Dragon God Tian Li and the Elven Empress Sylphra stretched out their hands together, wanting to forcefully enter the alternate space to investigate.
During this process, the Dragon God was slightly stunned and felt a strange wave.
Because it sensed traces of its own strength in this deep space… Although it was isolated by the legendary space and its perception was very vague, it shouldn’t be wrong.
“Wu!!! Wu!!! Wu!!”
Just as the Dragon God and Sylphra were preparing to enter the mystic realm, Buggy, who had just met the Dragon God and the Elven Empress but was quickly ignored by the two demigods, also rushed back crazily.
At this moment, seeing the two super experts eyeing this area covetously, Buggy swallowed its saliva crazily and said, “Seniors, seniors, wait.”
Buggy called out to the two demigods through telepathy, afraid that they would suddenly barge in and affect Shi Yu’s points.
“It’s the little worm just now,” the Elven Empress said in surprise when she saw Buggy.
“I see.” Seeing that Buggy was also flying to this place, the Dragon God was slightly stunned. She suddenly understood everything.
From the looks of it, the one in the deep space should be Shi Yu.
That human who had contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
Initially, the Dragon God was still wondering what was going on, but this explained it clearly.
It looked like the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation had begun to awaken the abilities of its previous life.
Although she didn’t know much about the Blue Sea Sprite, as an outstanding figure among demigods, it wasn’t strange for it to master quasi-divine skills in advance.
“I know what’s going on.” The Dragon God calmly dispersed her power. Beside her, Sylphra said in surprise, “What do you mean?”
“Wait a minute,” the Dragon God said. “The person inside is the Beast Tamer of this butterfly, the human junior I mentioned previously.”
“Perhaps his pet is awakening a quasi-divine skill.”
Sylphra was even more surprised. “You mean, the pet of a human Beast Tamer has mastered a quasi-divine skill?!”
She was very surprised and couldn’t help but be surprised. This was because at the moment, in the entire Blue Planet, there were very few lives who were still alive who had mastered quasi-divine skills. The ones she knew wouldn’t be more than ten.
These experts stood at the top of Blue Planet. Even if a legendary Beast Tamer went all out, they might not necessarily be able to defeat them.
Even if it was a peak-level human legendary Beast Tamer, the pets they contracted were basically ordinary totems, or some top-notch totems, not totem half-gods.
For example, she, the legendary Beast Tamer in charge of Tingxiang, had contracted nine Nature Sprites.
Even legendary Beast Tamers found it very difficult to contract pets with “mythical potential” that had mastered “quasi-divine skills”.
It was the same for her, and so were the Beast Tamers of the other six countries. It was the same for those legendary Beast Tamers who had left behind various legendary experiences in history.
Legendary Beast Tamers versus demigod-level life forms was enough to prove the power of quasi-divine skills.
And now, the Dragon God was actually telling her that there was a human Beast Tamer’s pet that had mastered a quasi divine skill?
“Yes.” The Dragon God nodded. Previously, she was still wondering why the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation chose a human.
But from the looks of it, Shi Yu seemed to have done very well. It had only been a short while, but he had already helped the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite that had yet to recover its strength after 3,000 years.
It looked like the Blue Sea Ruins left behind by the Blue Sea Sprite still had some taste.
At this moment, through a layer of space, Buggy could also communicate with Shi Yu telepathically. This was the power of the telepathy talent. If it were other talents, they definitely wouldn’t be able to. They wouldn’t be able to chat with pets across servers.
In the legendary ruins, Baby Ginseng nursed Shi Yu. They looked at Ling, who was surrounded by the wind of space, and swallowed crazily.
“Wind Blessing!”
“Divine skill of luck!”
“From now on, I have become rich.”
“I’m looking forward to betting on the fusion skill more and more.”
“Eh, the Dragon God is here. Oh no, is the awakening wave of the quasi-divine skill so strong?” Shi Yu was immediately stunned when he heard Buggy’s shout outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 759 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (2)
chapters.content:
759 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (2)
At the same time, Buggy also reminded that apart from the Dragon God, there was also a beautiful sister who looked very, very strong.
It looked… like an elf.
Shi Yu had a headache and felt that it was troublesome. After all, there was such a big reaction to awakening a quasi-divine skill through a legendary ruin. No matter what, he had to find a wilderness to awaken before coming to Dragon Palace City.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. The Dragon God was one of them, and even the Kirin fossil was from Dragon Palace City. This time, Ling could directly acknowledge them as family.
Shi Yu was excited!
….
In the outside world.
Spatial ripples appeared. Shi Yu directly came out of the legendary sealed ruins and looked at the Dragon God in the sky and the beautiful big sister mentioned by Buggy.
She was indeed very beautiful… She was the only existence Shi Yu had seen whose appearance was not inferior to the Dragon God.
In an instant, Shi Yu determined the other party’s identity.
“Senior Dragon God…”
“Elven Empress?!”
Shi Yu was rather shocked. He didn’t expect the legendary of Tingxiang to appear in Dragon Palace City.
The Elven Empress was a half-elf. Her human bloodline dominated. Not only did she master extraordinary abilities, but she could also open up the Beast Taming Space and contract pets like human Beast Tamers. She could be said to be very powerful.
“Just now, your pet awakened a quasi-divine skill, right?” The Dragon God slowly landed on the ground and said to Shi Yu.
“Can you summon it and take a look?”
Shi Yu hesitated for a moment. He didn’t know the relationship between the Elven Empress and the Dragon God, but from the looks of it, the Dragon God didn’t care that the Elven Empress was beside him.
It seemed that the relationship between Dong Huang and Tingxiang was not bad. In that case, Shi Yu nodded. A purple summoning array appeared. Accompanied by a green and white whirlwind, a white creature with a deer-like body and a light and slender body slowly appeared.
At that moment, when they saw this creature, its sheep head, deer body, and dragon tail, as well as its elegant and beautiful body that was like the embodiment of wind, the expressions of the Dragon God and the Elven Empress changed slightly.
The reason why the Dragon God and the Elven Empress had a good relationship was also related to the fact that they were both wind-element life forms. Others might be unfamiliar with the creature in front of them, but for transcendent life forms like them, who stood at the top of the wind-element, they instantly saw the wind laws lingering around it through Ling’s Kirin form.
“Mythical race, Wind Kirin!” At this moment, the Elven Empress was the first to speak in disbelief.
She was shocked to the extreme. How was this possible? Didn’t the Kirin Race… go completely extinct in the Mythical Era?
Of course, at this moment, the Dragon God was also extremely confused. Wait a minute, why wasn’t it that Blue Sea Sprite?!
Where did this Wind Kirin come from!!!
This was completely different from what she had judged just now!
The Dragon God was silent for a moment. Fortunately, she didn’t say too much to Sylphra just now.
“Wu…” The two demigods were shocked. The worm in the sky was also shocked with tears in its eyes. It also sensed Ling’s current strength.
This didn’t make sense.
As the last pet to enter the team, how could it be so strong!
< Name > Ling
[Race]: Mechanical Beast
[Race Level]: Low-level Mythical
[Level of Growth]: Monarch level
[Race Skill]:
“Super Level”: Wind Element Control (Expert+11), Divine Net (Expert+11), Turning Misfortune into Luck (Expert), Wind Spirit Bead (Initiate)
“Quasi God-level Skill”: Wind Blessing (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Super Level”: Mythical Revival (Expert)
Energy Points: 20.02 million
“Wu…!!” What was this surprise? Buggy had tears in its eyes. It felt that the team was getting more and more uncomfortable.
“Wind Kirin?” The Dragon God also followed the Elven Empress and looked at Shi Yu.
“No, it’s not completely a Wind Kirin,” Shi Yu said. “This is a mechanical phantom beast we developed with the Wind Kirin fossil through the power of imagination, the power of time, the power of life and death, and the power of machinery.”
“Compared to the true Mythical race, the Wind Kirin, it should still be lacking in some aspects.”
Dragon God: “?”
The Elven Empress: “?”
“You’re Shi Yu.” At this moment, the Elven Empress of Tingxiang finally knew who this young man in front of her was.
During this period, there were also exchanges between Dong Huang and Tingxiang.
In Tingxiang, although the mechanical field was far inferior to countries like Shen Feng, Dong Huang, and Xue Yuan, as the current strongest department, Mechanics were also paid attention to no matter where they were.
The Elven Empress naturally knew that a genius Mechanic from Dong Huang had researched the mechanical phantom beast system.
However, she didn’t expect that the genius Mechanic was the young man in front of her who was in the Dragon Palace and had contracted a Mythical race.
The mechanical phantom beast system… could actually revive the extinct myth?!
Originally, Tingxiang valued the mechanical phantom beast system, but the Elven Empress never expected this technology to be ridiculous to this extent.
“You’ve mastered the ability to revive myths?” The Dragon God realized that she had still underestimated this human young man who had contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
She had witnessed the growth of the Dragon Emperor, the Space Emperor, the mechanical legendary, the evolution legendary, and many other Dong Huang legendaries along the way. At this moment, the Dragon God felt that she was about to witness a new legendary star slowly rising.
Dong Huang’s luck was really powerful.
A Beast Tamer with legendary aptitude would appear in every era.
Even when Shi Yu had contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation, he didn’t manage to give the Dragon God any greater shock than this.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 760 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (3)
chapters.content:
760 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (3)
“Not really… It’s mainly because this Wind Kirin fossil is relatively intact. It came from the Dragon God Mystic Realm and was given to me by the Sea Dragon King. I’ve also come into contact with other Mythical fossils, but only one has the conditions to revive…” Shi Yu said.
The Elven Empress looked at the Dragon God. No wonder the Dragon God knew what was going on. So this new Mythical race was a member of Dragon Palace City?
The mechanical phantom beast system actually had the participation of Dragon Palace City.
“Congratulations.” The Elven Empress smiled and said, “Unfortunately, it’s not a dragon. Otherwise, the candidate for the next Dragon God of Dragon Palace City can be confirmed in advance.”
“Is that so?” The Dragon God shook her head. Forget it, after being shocked, the Dragon God recovered her calm. Compared to this, she was still more curious about whether Shi Yu could crack the spatial ruins left behind by the Time Sprite.
So be it if it was a kirin. It wasn’t important anymore.
But from the looks of it, if this Wind Kirin grew to the overlord level, Shi Yu, who planned to participate in the world competition, would have a high chance of winning the championship…
She looked at Shi Yu. The Elven Empress suddenly realized this and felt a headache for her contestants.
Although the Elven Empress didn’t think that her contestants had the talent to win the championship and obtain the blessings of the World Tree, hoping that they could gain more growth during the participation process, it was still a little uncomfortable to have seen this spoiler of the outcome in advance.
Mythical race!
In the previous world competitions, there had never been such a ridiculous battle pet.
If it were the previous world competition, the Mythical race’s overlord-level pet would definitely have locked onto the champion’s throne!
However, this time, although it was still very advantageous, the Elven Empress couldn’t figure out the specific situation.
Although Dragon Palace City rejected participating in the world competition, demigod-level factions like the Dragon Empire, the Dark Night Forest, the Demon Kingdom, and the Arctic Snowfield responded.
Although these demigod factions might not be able to take out Mythical pets, they probably could let their legend Beast Tamers contract invincible overlords and their special talent legendary hybrid Beast Tamers contract totems above their level at all costs.
Therefore, the Elven Empress felt that this world competition might be the most difficult and cruel one.
“What’s its skill?” However, out of curiosity, the Dragon God still asked Shi Yu about the quasi-divine skill of the Wind Kirin.
Regarding this, Shi Yu replied, “Wind Blessing. It can use the wind of nature to increase luck.”
“Not a battle-type skill, but a luck-type skill?” The Dragon God was stunned.
“Isn’t it a battle type?” The Elven Empress was also slightly surprised. In that case, the battle power of this Wind Kirin would be greatly reduced.
However, luck-type quasi-divine skills were also very good. At their level, they naturally knew that ethereal things like luck really existed and were very important.
Especially for a country’s faction, the fate of the country was abnormally important.
In an instant, the Elven Empress was rather envious of Dong Huang. If Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer from Tingxiang, she would definitely nurture such a Beast Tamer as an heir no matter what. Coupled with quasi-divine skills like luck, he could probably make a big country prosper for thousands of years.
“But skills that increase luck shouldn’t be completely useless in battle and war, right?” Sylphra smiled and looked at the Dragon God. “Can I let this little friend fight a battle to see?”
“I’m a little curious about this ability.”
Dragon God Tian Li said, “You can ask him yourself.”
Sylvera turned to look at Shi Yu and said, “Little guy, can I?”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment before looking at Ling. Who was he fighting?
“Alright, but we can’t say for sure if we have mastered this Wind Blessing skill, because this move can originally bless other lives, but from the looks of it, it shouldn’t be able to control this move yet. It seems that it can only increase its luck. Most of the time, it’s a passive skill.”
“Moreover… who are we fighting…” Shi Yu looked around and looked at Buggy. It seemed to be the only one.
Buggy: ??
Experimental worm.
“It’s alright. I just want to prove some guesses.”
“As for the battle target.” The Elven Empress looked into the distance and said, “You’re pretty lucky. A suitable guy happened to come.”
“Looks like the skill is effective?” The Elven Empress smiled and said, “In that case, follow the guidance of the wind.”
“Wuhu ~ ~ ~ ~” In the distance, the Third Prince, the little white dragon, who had just come out of the ruins to train, immediately ran over to find Shi Yu after hearing from the Turtle Prime Minister that Shi Yu had come to Dragon Palace City to visit the Sea Dragon King.
Previously, it and its father weren’t around, but now that it was done, Shi Yu could go as a guest at any time.
It had come this time to invite Shi Yu.
However, just as it approached Blue Sea Island, the little white dragon’s happy expression stopped. It realized that something was wrong with the situation on Blue Sea Island.
After it flew close to the core area of Blue Sea Island, it immediately widened its eyes and looked at the situation below.
Shi Yu… and…
“Lord… Lord Dragon God!!!”
Damn, why was the Dragon God here!!!
“Third Prince?” Shi Yu also looked at the little white dragon in surprise.
< Name > White Azure Dragon
Energy Points: 6.99 million
Ah, the little white dragon’s strength progress was pretty good.
“I…” At this moment, the little white dragon, who had originally come to look for Shi Yu happily, was immediately stunned when it realized that the atmosphere here was solemn. Not only was the Dragon God here, but there was also a female human who had the same pressure as the Dragon God.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 761 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (4)
chapters.content:
761 The Power of a Quasi Divine Skill (4)
“You,” the Elven Empress said when she saw this not very smart little white dragon.
When Shi Yu saw this, he also felt that the little white dragon was a little unlucky. It had come at the wrong time.
Although the little white dragon’s current strength looked pretty good, compared to Ling, whose normal energy level was 20 million, the difference was not just a little.
It would definitely be tortured.
It was going to lose face in front of the Dragon God and the Elven Empress.
However, if the Elven Empress wanted to see Ling’s strength, Shi Yu couldn’t refuse. He looked at the little white dragon that had arrived and said helplessly, “Third Prince, long time no see. Let’s fight!”
The little white dragon: “?”
What was going on?
Why did he have to hit it the moment it arrived?
What did it do wrong?
The Dragon God said, “Try it. If your performance is not bad, I’ll give you a gift.”
The little white dragon: !!!
“Lord Dragon God…” The little white dragon was shocked and looked at Lord Dragon God. It didn’t expect Lord Dragon God to be so easy to talk to. It’d get a gift if its performance was not bad?!
If its parents and those bad friends knew that their Third Prince, the little white dragon, had obtained a gift of the Dragon God, wouldn’t it take off?
In an instant, the little white dragon was eager to give it a try. It looked at Brother Shi Yu for help, hinting for him to please hold back a bit.
Everyone would be able to develop peacefully.
Shi Yu: …I’ll try my best.
With a battle target, Shi Yu fell silent. Ling walked out and looked at the little white dragon in the sky.
At this moment, the little white dragon also looked at the pet it had never seen before walking out of Shi Yu’s side with a serious expression.
A feeling of its bloodline being suppressed arose, making the little white dragon even more serious.
Wait, its opponent couldn’t be this one, right?
It wasn’t Shi Yu’s monster main forces??
Great!
Although it sensed that this pet was also extraordinary, at least it wasn’t that panda, radish, sword spirit, slime, and… It looked at Buggy. This worm!
If it weren’t for these five, even if it felt its bloodline being suppressed, the little white dragon would have heaved a sigh of relief.
The little white dragon was clearly traumatized by Shi Yu’s first five main forces.
Ling also looked at the silly little white dragon and analyzed its information.
“Little white dragon, you attack first,” Shi Yu said.
In order to give the little white dragon a chance to perform, Shi Yu said this to prevent Ling from insta-killing this guy.
“Wuhu, I understand!!” Upon hearing that, the little white dragon’s eyes focused and it took a deep breath.
It was just about to condense dragon energy and attack Ling below, but at this moment, its dragon eyes suddenly widened, and the blood energy in its body surged. With a puff, it spat out a mouthful of dragon blood and quickly fell from the sky. The hidden injury from the ruins training… relapsed.
Bang!
It fell to the ground.
It directly lost its mobility.
Shi Yu, Ling, Buggy: ???
The Dragon God and the Elven Empress were silent.
On the ground, the little white dragon said with a weak expression, “It’s over. It seems that the injuries left behind from the previous challenge have relapsed. After the challenge ended, I clearly received Doctor Shell’s treatment. Wu wu wu, but I don’t think it was completely treated, leaving behind hidden injuries.”
Quack doctor, quack doctor!!
Just as they were about to fight, the internal injuries suddenly relapsed and it vomited blood and fell. At this moment, the little white dragon wanted to find a hole to hide in. It felt like it had lost face in front of the Dragon God and Senior Shi Yu.
Doctor Shell misled him!
Everyone: …
The Elven Empress, Sylphra, was silent for a moment before looking at the little white dragon. Emerald-green energy immediately lingered around the little white dragon’s body as she helped it treat it. At the same time, she said, “As expected of a quasi-divine skill. Looks like it can indeed be used in battle.”
“Alright, I’ve already experienced the power of this move.”
Little White Dragon: What, what?
Shi Yu and Buggy also looked at the innocent-looking Ling speechlessly. Ling was also very stunned. What did it do?
Don’t tell it that this was all thanks to the Wind Blessing. It had just analyzed 4,399 victory methods through its top-notch intelligence, but it never expected that the little white dragon would fall before the battle even started… This didn’t make sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 762 Ascending to the Sky (1)
chapters.content:
762 Ascending to the Sky (1)
A moment later, the little white dragon woke up energetically under the treatment of the Elven Empress.
It looked at the beautiful green-haired woman gratefully and said, “Thank you, Senior.”
Although it didn’t know who this person was, she was probably a very powerful being able to stand beside the Dragon God.
“It’s nothing.” Sylphra smiled.
After the little white dragon recovered, it was silent for a moment before reacting. Just now, everyone seemed to have said that some quasi-divine skill could indeed be used in battle?
They had already experienced the power of this move?
What was going on?
It looked at Shi Yu eagerly and said, “What do you mean? Are… are we still fighting?”
Shi Yu took a look and said, “I don’t think there’s a need. You already lost just now.”
The little white dragon: Huh??
“It has the skill to increase our luck. According to ‘relativity’, it’s to make you even more unlucky.”
“Just now, your hidden injury relapsed. Perhaps this skill was effective.”
“I think it’s better not to fight. This move is a little dangerous and uncontrollable… If you have some hidden incurable disease later, or if spatial turbulence suddenly appears in the Dragon Palace mystic realm and sweeps you to death, it won’t be easy to clean up…”
The little white dragon’s expression was stunned. A skill to increase its luck and make the enemy unlucky?
There was such a skill?
Its hidden injury relapsed just now because it was hit?
“How can there be such a terrifying skill?” The little white dragon was shocked.
It immediately looked around and then looked at the sky, afraid that a meteorite would fall from the sky and smash it to death.
Oh, this was the ocean mystic realm. There were no meteorites, so it was fine.
“Wu, wu!!” Buggy also said. That’s right, how could there be such a terrifying skill? Buggy had already started to imagine it.
In the future team competition, if it was fighting Ling, just as it teleported, spatial turbulence could suddenly appear and sweep it to death.
How could they fight?
It would lose for no reason.
“Let’s leave it at that for now. This move is indeed a little dangerous,” the Elven Empress said with a smile.
“But there’s no need to worry too much.”
“The reason why this little white dragon is so miserable is because it’s too weak and is more heavily affected by the power of the natural order.”
“If the opponent is very strong, this skill won’t be useful. I can feel that this weak law wave can’t affect me.” The Elven Empress smiled.
“If it wants to forcefully affect a life form with powerful luck, the backlash it suffers will also be very serious.”
“Therefore, it’s better for you to master this move as soon as possible.”
As the Elven Empress finished speaking, Shi Yu and Ling quickly nodded. They also understood what the other party said.
However, this move still looked very strong!
Shi Yu was already imagining it!
After that, Ling would still research various machines. Could it be that it would be lucky enough to succeed for no reason?
As everyone knew, research needed to be accompanied by a large number of experiments. If one was unlucky, it would be difficult to achieve results in their lifetime, but if one was lucky, it was completely possible to do it in one go.
Or in the World Tournament, if he encountered Beast Tamers who contracted pets above their level, was it possible that before the battle even started, the other party’s body suddenly couldn’t hold on and thus would result in their deaths?
Also, the current Ling should be considered to have Mythical potential.
Generally speaking, the upper limit of the Time Fruit depended on its racial potential. Most of the time, it was at the overlord level, but for Ling, who had Mythical potential, even if the side effects were too great and it couldn’t reach the Mythical level, was it possible to temporarily unleash a totem attack?
The more Shi Yu thought about it, the more excited he became. Impressive, impressive.
“Did you come to Dragon Palace City this time to prepare for the world competition?” The Dragon God saw that Buggy had also just returned from the Dragon God Statue, so she asked Shi Yu.
“Yes, I’m here to train hard.” Shi Yu nodded. He indeed had the intention of coming to Dragon Palace City to challenge overlords to train.
“Well, all the best.” The Dragon God nodded. In that case, after figuring out the reason for the change in this place, it was time to leave.
She looked at Sylphra, but at this moment, she smiled at Shi Yu.
“Oh? Then do you want to go to our Tingxiang to train?”
“You’re still a genius archeologist of Dong Huang. Can your archeological ability and its luck enhancement also be used to crack ruins? Our Tingxiang still has a few important ruins that are difficult to crack. Do you want to go over and take a look?”
“If you gain anything, I won’t mistreat you.”
“Uh…” Shi Yu was stunned.
“It’s alright. After a while, your Dragon God and some overlords of Dragon Palace City will go to Tingxiang. You just have to accompany them.”
Shi Yu looked at the Dragon God. Was this for real? Why would Dragon Palace City go to Tingxiang?
“That’s indeed the case, but if you don’t want to go, you should cultivate in Dragon Palace City. Don’t worry about her.”
The Dragon God felt that it was better for Shi Yu to obediently use the Dragon God Statue to cultivate than to go to Tingxiang to train.
Shi Yu said, “I want to go, I want to go. I happen to have something to do in Tingxiang.”
Wasn’t this a coincidence? If he could go with Dragon Palace City, he wouldn’t have to care about Dong Huang.
Dong Huang might not necessarily have as many bodyguards as Dragon Palace City.
The Dragon God was silent. She didn’t expect Shi Yu to be seduced by the other party in a few words.
“Let’s go together. Don’t worry, I’ll ensure his safety.” The Elven Empress, Sylphra, smiled and said, “Ah Tian, don’t you believe me? Moreover, you’ll go over yourself. Are you afraid that I’ll eat him?”
“Fine then, in that case.” The Dragon God looked at Shi Yu and said, “Choose ten overlord-level dragons from the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City and head to Tingxiang together. You’ll be in charge of the exchange mission between Dragon Palace City and Tingxiang. Is there a problem?”

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 763 Ascending to the Sky (2)
chapters.content:
763 Ascending to the Sky (2)
“Exchange mission?” Shi Yu came to a realization. So Dragon Palace City and Tingxiang wanted to communicate?
However… he was leading the team?!
Although as the minister of the Environmental Protection Department, he could indeed command overlords, but… was it suitable?
“Alright… I promise to complete the mission…” Shi Yu said.
“Yeah.”
“Let’s go,” the Dragon God said to the Elven Empress. She no longer planned to stay here for long. However, before leaving, she looked at the little white dragon beside her and said, “When we go to Tingxiang, bring it along. As the Third Prince of Dragon Palace City, it’s a little weak.”
Little White Dragon: QAQ???
Ahhh, not only did it not mention the gift, but it was also scolded. The little white dragon immediately felt that it was so difficult. If it had known earlier, it would have gotten the Turtle Prime Minister to look for Shi Yu.
“Alright, let’s go.” The Elven Empress smiled. If she told Dong Huang, Dong Huang might not necessarily be able to let Shi Yu go to Tingxiang to train. It was easier to talk to her, her best friend.
However, to the surprise of the Elven Empress, this Shi Yu’s status in Dragon Palace City was so high?
Not only could he obtain the Mythical fossil from Dragon Palace City, but he could also command overlords. As the leader of an overlord-level dragon party, this treatment was simply no different from the totem dragon king of Dragon Palace City, right??
Even the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City didn’t seem to be able to do what Shi Yu did…
However, Shi Yu, who could contract a Mythical pet, seemed to really have this qualification. Although creatures with quasi-divine skills were restricted by the rules of the world, it was still as difficult as ascending to the heavens to break through to the Mythical stage. However, it was not difficult to grow to the demigod level.
Tingxiang had a good relationship with Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang. Sylphra was naturally willing to befriend such geniuses from Dong Huang and Dragon Palace. This was legendary potential!
After the two legendary level women left, the little white dragon sighed heavily and looked at Senior Shi Yu with a worried expression. It didn’t dare to look at the ridiculous life form directly.
It was afraid that it would really be as Shi Yu said, that it would suddenly die!
“Senior Shi Yu…”
“Let’s go to your father,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Sigh, alright, but Senior Shi Yu, can you not tell my father that the Dragon God despises me for being weak…” The little white dragon felt aggrieved.
Shi Yu was silent. But it really was weak!!
As the son of a totem, even if it couldn’t compare to the Void Mantis at the monarch level, it couldn’t be too inferior, right?
“No, but Senior Dragon God has already named you. Come with me to Tongxiang to train later.” Shi Yu was helpless.
“Ah!” The little white dragon was angry. It was not easy for a dragon to live.
It only wanted to be an old worm.
If it still wanted to work hard, what was the point of its father and mother’s hard work?
….
Shi Yu did not expect to be personally invited to Tingxiang by the Empress.
This was also good. He saw that the Dragon God and the Elven Empress had a good relationship. Perhaps he could openly crack a few ruins on the way this time?
With the protection of the Dragon God and the Elven Empress, there was no need to care about safety. After all, the combination of these two might not be invincible on Blue Planet, but it was pretty much almost there.
Shi Yu had also learned and understood the culture of Tingxiang.
They were different from humans, but humanoid transcendent life forms that looked similar to humans. They were extremely strong, and their physical strength could compete with dragons or be contracted by Beast Tamers.
Dwarves who were proficient in forging and could forge various top-notch equipment were also transcendent humanoid life forms that could be contracted. Most of the Mechanics in Tingxiang would contract a Dwarf as their assistant.
Apart from that, there were various myths and legends.
Even the undead, elemental life forms, plants, and dragons were naturally different from the east.
As Mother Dragon’s hometown, Shi Yu had long wanted to take a look, but before that, he had thrown An Chang to the Sea Dragon King.
It was very reasonable for the Sea Dragon King to take care of his disciple since he was taking care of its son, right?
“What, you just saw the Dragon God?!”
“And the empress of Tingxiang?”
Sea Dragon Palace.
The Sea Dragon King looked at Shi Yu, who had been called over by the little white dragon, and was in disbelief.
Did the Empress of Tingxiang come to Dragon Palace City?
Speaking of which, his Beast Tamer, Lin Feng, had once been beaten up by the Elven Empress in Tingxiang. If it weren’t for the good relationship between the Elven Empress and the Dragon God, Lin Feng might not have been able to return. As for why, the Sea Dragon King didn’t dare to ask. It only knew that there was also an elf in Lin Feng’s team.
The water there must be very deep…
“Well, Lord Dragon God and the Elven Empress wanted me to bring some overlords of the Environmental Protection Department to Tingxiang to train. Oh right, Lord Dragon God saw that the Third Prince’s growth speed was pretty good at that time. Compared to the last Dragon Palace banquet, it improved a lot. It also asked me to bring it along and felt that it had a lot of potential. It’s worth nurturing. The future is promising.”
At the side, the little white dragon was extremely touched. Yes, yes.
It also remembered that Lord Dragon God had said so.
“Lord Dragon God said that?” The Sea Dragon King was suspicious and looked at the little white dragon. What right did this kid have?
Or could it be that the Dragon God discovered potential on the little white dragon that it itself didn’t see…
The Sea Dragon King was immediately happy. It didn’t train this kid for nothing. It was actually chosen by the Dragon God. Not bad, not bad.
“Then I’ll leave it to you, Shi Yu. When the time comes, supervise this kid well. As long as he doesn’t die from training, train to the death!”
“No problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
“You didn’t come here just to visit me, right??” The Sea Dragon King’s huge dragon eyes stared at Shi Yu. According to its understanding of this Shi Yu, this guy didn’t come to Dragon Palace City for no reason. It was most likely because he had something to ask of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 764 Ascending to the Sky (3)
chapters.content:
764 Ascending to the Sky (3)
“Hehe.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I have a junior with a very good relationship. His initial pet is a Dragon Carp. With my help, it evolved into a monarch race Sea Dragon through the power of your Sea Dragon Scale, so I wanted to come and see if you can help guide me later, senior?”
“His talent is not bad. His second pet even obtained the blessings of Senior Butterfly God and evolved into an overlord race. He also has legend aptitude.”
“Huh?” The Sea Dragon King frowned. The Butterfly God had also helped train him? However, the initial pet that evolved with its strength was only a monarch race. Why was the second worm blessed by the Butterfly God an overlord race?
Although it didn’t mean anything, it kept feeling that it was inferior.
It said, “I understand, but my guidance is very strict.”
“It’s alright. As long as he doesn’t die from training, train to death!” Shi Yu also said!
The opportunity for the totem dragon king to be a teacher was rare. He believed that An Chang wouldn’t refuse.
“There’s no need to trouble you too much, Senior. Just give him some guidance and throw him to the Turtle Prime Minister. Isn’t there a few ruins mystic realms for newbies to train in Dragon Palace City? When the time comes, you can let him try them. Before we return from Tingxiang, let him stay in Dragon Palace City.”
“Alright,” the Sea Dragon King said. “It’s a small matter.”
“An Chang, come and meet Senior Sea Dragon King.”
At this moment, Shi Yu also pulled An Chang out of the ruins space.
The current An Chang had yet to react to the fluctuations of Ling’s awakening divine power and was a little stunned.
Seeing this strong and silly boy, the Sea Dragon King was slightly silent. His physical strength was very strong. His Fusion Talent was not bad, but he didn’t look very smart.
….
After Shi Yu dealt with An Chang, he returned to his Blue Sea Island easily.
He wasn’t in a hurry to go to the Environmental Protection Department to choose people to form a training team. Instead, he hurriedly returned to study Ling’s ability, wanting to study the Mythical Dream World in detail.
In the ruins, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and the others could be said to have complicated feelings.
“I’ll participate in the next team competition and take a look.” Ling displayed the demeanor of a big sister again.
The normal State was 20 million energy points. This was the power of a Mythical race!
In addition to the expert level Mythical Revival, its strength had tripled. It wasn’t necessarily inferior to other teammates after they had eaten the Time Fruit and used equipment.
At the thought of this, Ling felt that it had finally made it through. As expected, knowledge was power.
Sigh ~
During this period of time, although Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong had all been strengthened at the epic level, Ling’s increase in strength and that ridiculous quasi-divine skill made Eleven and the others a little confused about Ling’s battle power.
This skill was too strange.
For example, Chi Tong was very worried that when it fought Ling, the interlocking power would suddenly be chaotic and misfire, causing it to be heavily injured by it…
Of course, the only thing it didn’t have to worry too much about was that there seemed to be Susu at the bottom. Chi Tong secretly glanced at Susu, who was shaking its head.
“Ning…”
At this moment, Susu, who was made of water, looked at Ling with tears in its eyes and asked if it could get some of this luck.
Susu felt that as a member of the team at the bottom continuously, its luck was the worst.
“This… This…” Ling was silent. How could they split it?
Although the Wind Blessing looked like a skill that could bless others, perhaps because its proficiency was too low, it couldn’t be used as an active skill at all.
“Ning! (Add points!)” Susu was excited.
It wasn’t afraid of low proficiency. It just had to add points.
Shi Yu had a headache. “No, a quasi-divine skill is probably a certain difference from a super skill. Forget it. Let’s try adding some quasi-divine skills after we become legend level.”
If it was said that maximizing super skills made it a quasi-divine skill…
Then when a quasi-divine skill was maxed out, it would probably directly advance into a divine skill.
Was the consumption the same? Even if he had yet to try, he felt that it was impossible.
He was afraid that after adding points, he would directly become a totem undead.
“Yes,” Ling suddenly said and had a bold idea. Therefore, top-notch intelligence was indeed top-notch intelligence. It directly used its loading skill to hug Susu and make both parties become one.
In that case, could they share the luck?
“Ning…”
Susu was stunned, but Shi Yu smiled and shook his head. “Even if the quasi-divine skill is very powerful, it’s definitely not as ridiculous as you think. Let’s get down to business first.”
Even if it was lucky, there had to be an “incident” to have a “good outcome”.
If they had somehow fused together so weirdly. It would be strange if there were any results.
“Ning!” However, just as Shi Yu finished speaking, Susu, who had become stronger through Ling’s loading and was comparable to an overlord, was suddenly stunned.
It sensed that something was wrong and took the initiative to activate the power of time, allowing its life level to also reach the overlord level.
At this moment, Susu, who was wearing a blue mechanical hat, widened its watery eyes and quickly looked at Shi Yu.
It seemed to have sensed the inheritance summoning of the Blue Sea Ruins!
Shi Yu: “?”
Chi Tong: “?”
The inheritance conditions of the Blue Sea Ruins were at the overlord level. Susu naturally didn’t meet the standard, but a long time ago, Shi Yu and the others wanted to try if they could use the Time Fruit to temporarily let Susu reach the overlord level and cheat to cause a reaction from the Blue Sea Ruins.
But clearly, it failed. The system of the Blue Sea Ruins was surprisingly perfect. There were no loopholes.
However, this time, Susu clearly sensed that after it stacked its overlord-level battle power through various methods, an obvious summoning guide wave appeared in the Blue Sea Ruins!
“Huh?”
Upon hearing Susu’s words, Shi Yu, Chi Tong, and the others were stunned on the spot. Don’t tell them that their luck was so good that they happened to encounter a bug in the Blue Sea Ruins and mistakenly treated Susu, who had obtained overlord-level strength by stacking buffs, as having reached the condition to reach the inheritance…
At this moment, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong were all crazy. They looked at the mechanical hat Susu was wearing.
No!!
How could there be such a cheating skill!
He could do whatever he wanted just because he was lucky?
When could he try fusing with them?
“This…”
Shi Yu also fell into a deep silence. He didn’t know if they were lucky or unlucky. It was a good thing that the Blue Sea Ruins had reacted, but it was said that after the Blue Sea inheritance, the strength of the Blue Sea Sprite would quickly increase and quickly reach the totem level. Clearly, he couldn’t control it.
It was a good thing for Susu, but not necessarily for him, a Beast Tamer.
“Forget it, I’ll go take a look first. At most, I won’t accept the power inheritance first. Apart from the power inheritance, there might be other inheritances. I’ll see if you left any inheritances in your previous life, such as myths and legendary resources.” Shi Yu was eager to give it a try, but he still couldn’t resist the temptation of the ruins.
“Yes, yes, yes!!!” Susu was also extremely excited. Wow, it was taking off!
Ling, the eternal god!

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 765 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (1)
chapters.content:
765 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (1)
Clearwater Island.
In the Dragon Palace mystic realm, on the island where the Blue Sea Ruins was.
Susu temporarily became an overlord through the Time Fruit and used the Wind Blessing to create a bug in the Blue Sea Ruins. After mistakenly thinking that it had reached the inheritance standard, Shi Yu and the others immediately ordered Buggy to bring them here.
Looking at the water cube-like Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu, Susu, and the others were slightly nervous.
!!
Could it really succeed?
Regardless of whether it could succeed or not, they were already here. If they didn’t go in and take a look, Shi Yu and the others would definitely be indignant.
In the past, when Shi Yu and the others came into contact with the Blue Sea Ruins, they would be blocked and unable to enter. However, this time, they easily entered the Blue Sea Ruins like passing through water.
….
The Blue Sea Ruins had a spirit.
