This Dao Spirit was more like a rule mechanism.
In order to ensure that the Blue Sea Sprite race could be passed down infinitely,
It was in charge of passing down the inheritance to every generation of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
It was in charge of summoning every mature Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to receive the inheritance.
It was also in charge of ensuring that the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation could grow up and have enough strength to accept the inheritance mission even if an accident happened.
The spirit of this ruin was created by the first generation of the Blue Sea Sprite. It established a rules mechanism and was strengthened by the Blue Sea Sprite that accepted the inheritance every generation, ensuring that it could exist forever.
The form of the spirit of the ruins in the Blue Sea Ruins was similar to the first-generation Blue Sea Sprite. As an elemental life form, its entire body was made of water elements. It maintained a noble humanoid posture, like a mermaid. Its upper body was humanoid, but its lower body was like blue water waves.
Its entire body was surrounded by mist, and a thin mist covered its beautiful body. Coupled with the water refracting a faint halo, it gave it a hazy beauty…
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins that woke up from its sleep felt extremely strange.
It fell into a recall state. The last time it woke up seemed to be a year ago. At that time, a special telepathy woke it up.
This telepathy was very special, as if it was searching for traces of the Blue Sea Sprite.
The spirit of the ruins should have ignored this thought.
However, due to the special situation at that time, the spirit of the ruins made a difficult choice.
It wasn’t too much to say that the first generation Blue Sea Sprite was a Mythical race. It had mastered two incomparably powerful quasi-divine skills and could be said to be the strongest demigod.
However, even if it was a demigod or an elemental life form, it was extremely difficult to withstand the wear and tear of time and become eternal.
However, in order to protect the sea, the first generation Blue Sea Sprite thought of the method of will reincarnation. It relied on the power of faith and the inheritance of will to constantly reincarnate and reproduce.
This way, as long as the faith continued and the inheritance continued, the Blue Sea Sprite race could exist forever.
However, there was also a certain risk. As the power of faith fell, as the strength before each reincarnation decreased, and as time continued to wear down, the racial potential after each reincarnation might fall.
From a quasi Mythical race to a high-level overlord, to a middle-level overlord, to a low-level overlord… In the beginning, this fall was still within the acceptable range of the Blue Sea Sprite.
However, countless years later, the race level of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation fell to the transcendent race, and the inheritance mechanism of the Blue Sea Sprite could no longer be maintained.
A gap of 3,000 years appeared in the Blue Sea Ruins inheritance. During this period, it was the time when the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation died the most midway. It was getting harder and harder for the reincarnation to reach the strength standard to accept the inheritance.
The awakened spirit of the ruins realized that this might not be able to continue. It had to seek change. Otherwise, in another hundred years, there might be a situation where the reincarnation failed and the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance was completely severed. At that time, the Blue Sea Ruins and it would disappear together.
At this moment, a human Beast Tamer with special telepathy who could awaken it from its sleep appeared.
Therefore, the spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins decided to make a bold attempt.
It no longer let the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation grow on its own.
Instead, it handed the reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite to other life forms to nurture.
Although this might more or less affect the unformed thoughts of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation, there was no other way.
Originally, there were many good choices in the Blue Sea Ruins. In the ocean, many totem factions had obtained the favor of the Blue Sea Sprite, such as Dragon Palace City.
If it were them, they would definitely be very happy to help the Blue Sea Sprite grow.
Unfortunately, every time it woke up, it was very difficult for the spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins. In addition, it couldn’t strongly affect the outside world and couldn’t take the initiative to contact those lives. In the end, it chose to awaken the “human Beast Tamer” who shamelessly spoke to it.
It actually despised this human Beast Tamer, but at that time, there was no better choice. Therefore, it helped this human Beast Tamer find this generation’s Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation, hoping that he could quickly nurture this generation’s Blue Sea Sprite.
However, to the surprise of the spirit of the ruins, it didn’t expect that in such a short period of time, in just a year, this human had cultivated the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to the overlord level.
This made the spirit of the ruins heave a sigh of relief and confirm that its choice was right. At the very least, it didn’t let the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite be severed because of this. As for whether the next inheritance could still be so smooth, it would have to rely on this generation of Blue Sea Sprites to grow into demigods and think of a way themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 766 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (2)
chapters.content:
766 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (2)
In a ruin that looked like a deep sea world.
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins stared at the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation that had been summoned and entered the ruins to receive the inheritance, as well as the human Beast Tamer it chose.
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins understood that it was time for the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to separate from this Beast Tamer.
After accepting the inheritance, the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation grew into a demigod-level existence in an extremely short period of time and controlled the ocean again.
And after that, both parties might not be from the same world. Although they were very grateful to this Beast Tamer for helping this generation of Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnations grow, the mission of the Blue Sea Sprite was still in the sea. It couldn’t follow beside this Beast Tamer forever.
“Huh?”
The spirit of the ruins looked at the Blue Sea Sprite and the human Beast Tamer who entered. Suddenly, its mood changed subtly.
Sensing the life fluctuations of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation gradually decreasing to the monarch level, a huge question mark appeared in the mind of the spirit of the ruins.
Wait, wait, didn’t it sense that the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation had reached the overlord level?
It woke up again because of this.
Why did it return to the monarch level!
Was it still dreaming?
At this moment, the spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins fell into deep thought.
At this moment, they finally arrived at the Blue Sea Ruins. Looking at the holy and noble “Blue Sea Saintess” who was the “Spirit of the Ruins” in front of them, Shi Yu and Susu were also very excited.
“I knew it. There’s indeed a ‘guardian spirit’ in the Blue Sea Ruins.” Shi Yu had an ‘as expected’ expression. He knew it. If not for the guardian spirit, how could the Blue Sea Ruins have handed Susu to him so accurately?
At this moment, Shi Yu and Susu were quite excited to see this humanoid elemental life form.
However, the spirit of the ruins was very silent at this moment.
It kept feeling that something was wrong.
Why was what it saw with its own eyes different from what it had just sensed?
What exactly blinded its perception?
Forget it, it wasn’t important anymore.
“Hello, this generation’s Blue Sea Sprite and its guardian.”
The spirit of the ruins emitted a gentle voice.
Shi Yu and Susu: …
What guardian?
Why did it feel that the style of this ruin spirit was different from theirs?
Was this how they called Beast Tamers in the totem era?
“Senior guardian, you summoned us, right?”
“Can it already accept the inheritance now?” Shi Yu said.
“Ning ~!”
The spirit of the ruins looked at Shi Yu and the others and nodded calmly. It carefully observed the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation and discovered that although it had yet to reach the overlord level, it was already fast.
With the help of its will, it could break through to the overlord level at any time. The foundation was enough.
It was naturally impossible for the spirit of the ruins to admit that it had sensed wrongly just now, so it felt that it seemed feasible to let the Blue Sea Sprite break through to overlord on the spot and accept the inheritance.
“Yes, it’s only a step away from the standard to accept the inheritance. If it breaks through with its will now, it can accept the inheritance.”
The spirit of the ruins nodded.
“This… Does it have to break through?” When Shi Yu heard that, he was originally quite happy, but now, he immediately wilted.
“But my Beast Taming level isn’t enough to support the overlord level… Moreover, I feel that its foundation isn’t very strong.”
The spirit of the ruins said, “Just break the spiritual contract. After accepting the Blue Sea inheritance, the Blue Sea Sprite will recover its peak strength in an extremely short period of time. At that time, no matter what, the contract can’t continue to be maintained. As for the rest, don’t worry. During the inheritance process, its race will constantly be optimized.”
“Remove the contract…?” After the ruins spirit finished speaking, Shi Yu and Susu were stunned.
Shi Yu was speechless. As expected, just as he had understood, after accepting the inheritance, Susu would probably quickly recover its demigod-level strength. At that time, the contract would definitely not be able to be maintained.
“Ning…”
Susu also looked troubled. It didn’t want to break the contract, afraid that Shi Yu wouldn’t want it after it was broken.
After all, the second team still had an Abyss Sea demigod eyeing the first team’s position covetously.
And it happened to be at the bottom of the team.
“Breaking the contract doesn’t mean anything. After accepting the inheritance, it will still be it. The experience you guys have spent together won’t disappear, so there’s no need to worry. This is only for the Blue Sea Sprite to grow faster.”
The spirit of the ruins said calmly, “Ten years pass in the blink of an eye. At that time, it will become the new master of the sea. This is the best choice for Lord Blue Sea Sprite and the entire sea.”
Shi Yu and Susu: “?”
“Ten years? What do you mean?”
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins said, “The acceptance process only requires ten years to let it recover the peak power of the Blue Sea Spirit.”
Susu: “?”
“Ning.” Susu turned to look at Shi Yu. Why don’t they leave? It didn’t want this Blue Sea inheritance anymore.
After ten years?! The flowers would have withered already!
Susu made a simple calculation.
It took a day to add points to a super skill, and 256 to reach “Dao Proficiency”.
In other words, it could obtain a quasi-divine skill in less than a year.
In ten years, that would be more than ten quasi-divine skills!
Although it also took time to consider the fact that Shi Yu needed to add points to other pets, the problem was that Shi Yu’s level would also continue to increase. When the time came, the time needed to add points would also decrease.
Ten years. Susu felt that when the time came, the second team would be at the Mythical stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 767 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (3)
chapters.content:
767 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (3)
And meanwhile, it would still be accepting the inheritance.
This was unacceptable.
If it didn’t accept the Blue Sea inheritance, it could still protect the sea.
At that time, it would cooperate with Duckie from the inside and out. It would take down the Abyss Sea first.
Shi Yu: …
“Too slow,” Shi Yu said with a frown.
Ten years, wasn’t this a scam?
How many decades did life have?
The spirit of the ruins: “?”
The spirit of the ruins originally thought that Shi Yu would consider the big picture and give up the contract for the future of the Blue Sea Sprite to let the Blue Sea Sprite accept the inheritance and return to the peak.
As for the Blue Sea Sprite, in order to protect the will of the sea, it would also obtain and inherit stronger power.
However, the conversation between the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation and this human Beast Tamer directly stunned the spirit of the ruins.
The Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation didn’t want to accept the inheritance anymore?
Its Beast Tamer said that becoming a demigod in ten years was too slow??
What was going on!
Were these guys crazy or was it crazy?
“Don’t you understand how strong the peak power of the Blue Sea Sprite is?” the spirit of the ruins said.
“At the peak of the Blue Sea Sprite, it was one of the few lives that had mastered the prototype of two divine skills. It could be said to be the strongest below the Mythical stage.”
“This realm is something that countless lives have difficulty cultivating for millions of years.”
“And now, it would only need to sleep for ten years during the acceptance period to recover the strength at its peak…”
“Ning… (It’s still too slow.)” Susu was extremely aggrieved. It originally thought that the Blue Sea Ruins would be the start of its counterattack, but it didn’t expect this inheritance to be so scammy.
It actually had to be passed for ten years.
How was it lucky?
It was clearly extremely unlucky.
Why did it have to know such a bloody truth so early?
In Shi Yu’s ruins space, Chi Tong and the others were also paying attention to the situation outside.
Upon hearing that it would take ten years to accept a demigod inheritance and obtain two quasi-divine skills, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and the others rolled on the ground with laughter.
They felt that Susu was extremely pitiful.
“Why don’t we not accept the power inheritance first, Lord Protector… Apart from that, are there any other resource inheritance…” Shi Yu asked shyly.
The spirit of the ruins: “?”
“What a joke!” The spirit of the ruins was immediately angry. What was going on? Why was this batch of Blue Sea Sprite so difficult to lead? Why was it different from the previous batches of Blue Sea Sprites?
Was this the disadvantage of handing the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to other life forms to nurture?
Instantly, the spirit panicked.
It felt that things had exceeded its expectations, making it not know what to do.
“Cough, cough, cough, Lord Protector, does it have to be at the overlord level? Does it have to be passed down for ten years?” Shi Yu said. “I roughly understand what you mean.”
“You mean that the Blue Sea Sprite probably has to be at the overlord level to have enough ability to receive the two skills, ‘Sea Cleansing Spirit’ and ‘Blue Sea Contract’. During the inheritance process, the proficiency of these two skills will increase with time, until it touches the rules and becomes the prototype of a divine skill.”
“Therefore, is there a possibility that it will only accept a portion of the inheritance? It’s fine as long as it learns these two skills. There’s no need to reach very high proficiency.”
“This way, can the time used be shorter? Can it receive the inheritance at the monarch level?”
“Ning! (In any case, I won’t break the contract. In any case, I won’t accept ten years of inheritance.)” Susu was aggrieved and had a very strong attitude.
The spirit of the ruins: ???
“If you don’t reach the overlord level, even the will of the Blue Sea Sprite will find it very difficult to withstand the power of the inheritance. I’m afraid you’ll get lost.”
“Once the inheritance is opened, if it’s interrupted midway, it might cause the inheritance power to be lost. At that time, even if it loses a trace of power, it won’t be able to let the Blue Sea Sprite master the ‘prototype of a divine skill’. It might cause its strength to be unable to reach its peak in this lifetime.”
“If it can’t reach its peak, it can’t leave behind an inheritance that allows the next generation of Blue Sea Sprites to reach their peak.”
“Therefore, it will cause the inheritance mechanism of the Blue Sea Sprite to be severed.”
“So, do you know how simple your thoughts are?”
“In other words, it can?” Shi Yu said. “As long as it can withstand the inheritance of two skills at the monarch level, as long as it doesn’t care about the loss of the inheritance power, it can complete the inheritance in a short period of time, right?”
“You don’t understand at all!” The spirit of the ruins was angry.
Shi Yu and Susu were quite talented to be able to anger a seemingly noble and holy spirit of the ruins into anger.
“Ning. (Lord Protector, I think this is alright!! Let’s only accept a portion of the inheritance first!)” Susu said.
Ruins Spirit: @!#@￥#￥
“Give me a reason!” The spirit of the ruins was a little regretful. It had handed the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to the human in front of it to nurture.
In any case, it couldn’t understand the thoughts of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation and the human in front of it.
“Reason…”
Shi Yu was silent for a moment. He looked at it and said, “Ten years is too long. Let it accept a portion of the inheritance. Even if it has just mastered the ‘Sea Cleansing Spirit’ and the ‘Blue Sea Contract’, I’m confident that I can restore it to its peak strength or even stronger in three years.”
“Is this reason alright?”
The spirit of the ruins wanted to refute, but it felt that Shi Yu was a little arrogant. Shi Yu had previously said that he could nurture the transcendent reincarnation of the Blue Sea Sprite to an overlord. It was willing to believe this because it wasn’t that difficult.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 768 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (4)
chapters.content:
768 Don’t Want the Blue Sea Sprite Inheritance (4)
However, Shi Yu actually said that he could nurture a Blue Sea Sprite to peak strength? Moreover, three years?
“Ning!” Before the spirit of the ruins could refute, Susu replied trustingly. It believed it.
The spirit of the ruins was completely confused. It only felt that Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation had gone crazy.
“Why don’t you guys leave?” The spirit of the ruins gritted its teeth. It didn’t want to waste any more effort with them.
It was better to wait for this generation’s Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation to die and hope that the next generation’s Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation could be more normal.
In any case, the inheritance mechanism definitely couldn’t be broken.
“No, no, no.” Shi Yu knew that he could accept part of the inheritance at this moment. How could he leave so easily?
He smiled and said, “Lord Protector, please believe us this time.”
“Believe us this time. Perhaps this generation of Blue Sea Sprites can become eternal and mythical.”
“To completely escape the fate of endless reincarnation.”
The spirit of the ruins: “?”
At this moment, Susu condensed a memory water drop and handed it to the spirit of the ruins.
The spirit of the ruins received the memory water drop.
Then, it saw unbelievable scenes.
“Ning! (Shi Yu, increase points!)”
A Water Slime was touched on the head and mastered the Infinite Devour that could devour everything to evolve.
“Ning! (Shi Yu, increase points!)”
A Water Slime. Its head was touched. It had mastered the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that could freeze time. As it added points, the skill proficiency increased quickly.
“Ning! (Shi Yu, increase points!)”
A Water Slime that had just learned purification only took a day to be added to full proficiency.
“Master, increase points.”
In its memory, under the gaze of the spirit, a Rubik’s Cube touched the law of luck with a bang and stepped into the Mythical Domain.
“Wuu! (Beast Tamer, increase points.)”
“Yi! (Add points!)”
As the points were added, the spirit of the ruins saw many ridiculous phenomena.
At this moment, the spirit of the ruins was a little silent.
Infinite Devour. Wasn’t that the strongest water-element skill that could be traced back to the Mythical Era, comparable to the “Sea Cleansing Spirit” and the “Blue Sea Contract”?
How could the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation learn it?
Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. How could the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation master such a dual-element skill of ice and time before accepting the Blue Sea inheritance?
Also, why could these skills quickly increase proficiency as the human Beast Tamer touched the head of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation?
From the memories, the so-called super skills improved almost effortlessly with Shi Yu’s help.
It was even a quasi-divine skill. The human Beast Tamer also helped his pet master it.
At this moment, the spirit of the ruins felt that it was a little unscientific.
At the same time, it seemed to know why this generation of Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation could grow so quickly.
At the same time, it understood why it was so against the word ten years.
It was difficult to go from extravagant to frugal…
Therefore, they were really confident that they could help a transcendent life form cultivate a quasi-divine skill in a short period of time?
What was this?
The spirit of the ruins was extremely confused by Shi Yu’s skill index talent.
A real divine skill?
“Senior Protector, you should believe me now, right? As long as it masters these two skills, I can let it grow to its peak in a shorter period of time.”
“It can even surpass the peak and become a true Mythical life form.”
At this moment, Shi Yu indeed hoped that Susu could accept the inheritance in advance.
With the “Blue Sea Contract”, the cleansing power of the “Sea Cleansing Spirit” was definitely much stronger than the cleansing of mid-level skills.
At that time, with these two skills, he could add points to the entire team. Perhaps the cooldown time could be much shorter.
Obviously, this was a skill that could increase the efficiency of adding points. The earlier he obtained it, the better.
For this, he even showed the spirit of the ruins the growth experience of Susu and the others.
With a look, the spirit of the ruins was indeed silent. It looked at Shi Yu in confusion and at the human Beast Tamer in front of it.
It fell into deep thought.
“You guys, experiment in front of me. That ‘point increase’ just now.”
….
A few days later.
Under the magical power of points, after witnessing an inheritance that was even more ridiculous than the Blue Sea inheritance, the spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins was convinced.
It was willing to let Susu try accepting some of the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance in this state.
During this period, Shi Yu felt that it was a pity that apart from the inheritance power, the previous generation Blue Sea Sprite had left nothing behind.
Apart from that, it was a pity that the basic “Sea Cleansing Spirit” and “Blue Sea Contract” were different from the Wind Blessing. They were not natural quasi divine skills.
It needed to be raised to the extreme and touched the laws before it could be upgraded to a quasi-divine skill.
According to Zhong Xuan, every super skill was the embryo of a quasi-divine skill. Obviously, there were good embryos and ordinary embryos.
For example, if the control of the water element was cultivated into a quasi-divine skill, it would definitely come into contact with the law of water.
And for example, if the time mark cultivated into a quasi-divine skill, it would definitely come into contact with the time life and death law.
The use involved after cultivation was naturally different.
The reason why the Blue Sea Sprite was so strong was because it had cultivated these two skills into quasi divine skills.
And when these two skills were combined, they could undoubtedly display an effect comparable to a divine skill.
Just like ordinary time marks, they didn’t have any destructive power, but when combined with self-destruction, it wasn’t too much to say that they were divine skills.
The combination quasi-divine skill of the Blue Sea Sprite had a similar effect.
< Name > Blue Sea Contract
< Introduction > It’s a water-element and spatial super skill. Contract with the sea. No matter where you are, you can directly mobilize the power of the sea and obtain endless energy.
This skill could directly give Susu “infinite energy value”.
From this description, it wasn’t too much to say that it was a quasi-divine skill, but there were shortcomings.
Although it could mobilize endless energy, due to the difference in skill proficiency, the “quantity” that could be mobilized in an instant was also different.
Even if a water pipe could flow forever, it was impossibly difficult to drown a city.
However, the eternal rainstorm that continued to sweep through the world could destroy land.
This was the effect of the Blue Sea Contract with different proficiency. It could be said to be a super skill with very strong potential.
With this skill, Shi Yu’s team should not lack energy anymore.
Apart from that.
< Name > Sea Cleansing Spirit
< Introduction > It’s a water-element and spiritual-element super skill. It can create a spiritual body that cleanses everything. The more energy it provides when creating the cleansing spirit, the greater the cleansing strength.
At first glance, it was an “ordinary” cleansing skill, but with the Sea Cleansing Spirit and the Blue Sea Contract with endless energy, even if both skills were entry-level, as long as they were combined and given enough time, the Blue Sea Sprite could also use the endless sea energy to create the strongest cleansing spirit that could cleanse the Abyss demigod.
It was said that the first generation Blue Sea Sprite used the power of the entire sea to create a cleansing spirit and fused with the sea. Only then did the sea produce the ability to cleanse itself.
When these two skills were combined, it was the foundation of the Blue Sea Sprite as the strongest tier demigod.
Both skills were indispensable. If it lacked one, it wouldn’t be a Blue Sea Sprite.
Just like Baby Ginseng’s Moon Explosion and Time Mark, if it lacked one, it wouldn’t be a self-destructing ginseng that could destroy totems above its level.
At this moment, Shi Yu was waiting for Susu to complete the initial inheritance. As long as it learned the Sea Cleansing Spirit and the Blue Sea Contract, as long as the target of the Purification Spirit’s possession was added points, the entire team’s ability to withstand the pain of adding points could receive an epic increase.
As long as the pet didn’t waste too much time, the additional points Shi Yu needed to spend would be much less. In addition, the Spirit of the Sea Cleansing could also cleanse his fatigue. Perhaps before the World Tournament, the skill level of the entire team would be higher than expected!

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 769 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (1)
chapters.content:
769 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (1)
In the dark blue Blue Sea Ruins.
A water pillar connected heaven and earth.
Inside the water pillar, Susu in the form of a Water Slime had been sleeping for a long time.
It was accepting the power inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins.
During this period, Shi Yu accompanied him.
The meditation effect in the Blue Sea Ruins was really good.
It was much better than the ruins left behind by the Space Emperor for the Void Mantis.
It wasn’t too much to say that it was a Mythical cultivation ruin.
Initially, Shi Yu could not forget the ruins of the Void Mantis.
But now, it felt like it wasn’t a big deal.
After Susu finished accepting the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance, the control of the Blue Sea Ruins fell into Susu’s hands.
It meant that it fell into Shi Yu’s hands.
Shi Yu was already looking forward to the scene of walking around with the Blue Sea Ruins.
Although he and Susu said that they didn’t even want the Blue Sea Inheritance, the Blue Sea Ruins was still good stuff.
The powerful thing about this ruin was not just the meditation effect.
Instead, there were more than 100 projections of this ruin worldwide.
For example, the Blue Sea Ruins in Dragon Palace City and the Blue Sea Ruins in the Rainbow Islands were all projections of the main body ruins.
And through the Blue Sea Ruins, they could teleport between these projection ruins!
In other words, if Shi Yu obtained the Blue Sea Ruins, he would have a spatial teleportation array that covered the world.
Shi Yu naturally knew what this meant.
He would be invincible.
For example, at the Seven Islands, if he had the Blue Sea Ruins, even if he didn’t have any bodyguards and obtained Mythical resources in front of everyone, the totems and legends present couldn’t do anything to him.
This was because Shi Yu could instantly teleport himself to Clearwater Island in Dragon Palace City through the Blue Sea Ruins or instantly teleport himself to Poison Fang Island in the Rainbow Islands to escape.
Just like how the Blue Sea Ruins teleported him in order to let him find the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
It was probably very difficult to interrupt this teleportation without being at the demigod level. After all, this was a ruin created by the Blue Sea Sprite at its peak.
As for the strength of the Blue Sea Sprite at its peak, it was probably only inferior to the World Tree clone. After all, it had gathered the faith of the entire ocean at that time.
“The willpower of this generation’s Lord Blue Sea Sprite is stronger than I imagined…”
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins originally thought that with Susu’s monarch-level strength, it would be a little difficult to receive the inheritance of super skills, but it realized that it was wrong.
Susu slept very comfortably the whole time. It had really trained. After all, when it was at the transcendent level, it had already started to constantly experience the baptism of super skills on Shi Yu’s side.
“Thanks to my good training.”
The spirit of the ruins: …
“How’s the progress?” Shi Yu asked.
The spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins said, “The reception is very smooth. The initial evolution can be completed immediately.”
“Is that so…” Shi Yu looked at the water pillar in anticipation.
As expected, with the reminder of the spirit of the Blue Sea Ruins, Susu in the form of a Water Slime quickly had blue evolution light lingering around its body. Its life form began to change.
Every generation of the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation would evolve towards the primitive race of the Blue Sea Sprite, which was the form of the first generation of the Blue Sea Sprite.
At this moment, under the entanglement of the blue evolution light, Susu’s figure began to change, outlining its mermaid-like form. The water formed a long blue hair, bright blue eyes, beautiful appearance, and plump upper body. Its lower body was a blue fishtail that kept flowing like a wave.
Its entire body was made of water. It was similar to the humanoid ice elemental life form Shi Yu had transformed into when he challenged the Seven Islands with his Lu Bai alternate identity. However, its aura was more noble and it had an otherworldly aura. In the form of a dreamy ocean sprite, it revealed a holy cleansing wave.
< Name > Susu
[Race]: Blue Sea Sprite
[Attributes]: Water, Ice
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch level
[Race Skill]:
“Super Level”: Holy Water Ring (Expert), Water/Ice Elemental Control (Expert+2), Wave Cannon (Expert), Blue Sea Contract (Initiate), Sea Cleansing Spirit (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Super Level”: Infinite Devour (Expert), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (Expert)
Energy Points: 8,010,000
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, Susu’s opened eyes also looked outside the water pillar.
At this moment, sensing that Susu had inherited a new skill, Shi Yu could be said to be extremely excited. However, he also had an incomparable headache. He couldn’t wait to break through to the legendary level and obtain a new skill slot.
Or, he felt that he should maximize the skill points of the superalloy and other skills and delete them to make room for new skills.
However, it wasn’t a big problem not to replicate the Blue Sea Contract and the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
Because the Blue Sea Ruins contained all the Blue Sea Contract and Sea Cleansing Spirit experience from entry level to Dao Proficiency.
Susu just had to constantly receive inheritance from here.
And when there was no need, it could be interrupted.
Although it was a little lower than adding points, it would be a waste not to.
Now, as it evolved, the figure of the ruins spirit beside it kept dimming, while Susu was completely awake.
“What a waste…” Its figure became dimmer and dimmer, and the spirit of the ruins couldn’t help but mention it.
This inheritance was clearly safer to completely receive in one go. And now, Susu had only received a portion and interrupted the inheritance. This would definitely cause the loss of the inheritance power.
If this continued, it was already difficult to rely on the inheritance power to cultivate a quasi-divine skill normally.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 770 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (2)
chapters.content:
770 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (2)
However, it looked at Shi Yu. With the help of this Beast Tamer, it would be fine to lose some of its inheritance power.
After all, if they didn’t do this, the reincarnation of this generation of the Blue Sea Sprite wouldn’t accept the inheritance no matter what.
They should be able to successfully cultivate the lost parts themselves…
Just as it was about to fall into a deep sleep, the spirit of the ruins felt aggrieved. It felt that it had purely brought this upon itself by finding a father for the Blue Sea Sprite.
If it could do it again…
“I hope everything goes smoothly…” The spirit of the ruins was silent.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’ll go smoothly. When it reaches the demigod level, we’ll wake you up.”
“At that time, I’ll let you witness it become a myth. If we can’t break through, we’ll also ensure that the mechanism of the Blue Sea inheritance continues.”
The Blue Sea Ruins, the Blue Sea Sprite, and the spirit of the ruins were symbiosis.
Opening the inheritance consumed the power of the ruins spirit. It would also fall into a deep sleep because of this. Only when the new generation of Blue Sea Sprites grew to the peak could it give it consciousness again through its ability and let it be in charge of the next reincarnation.
During this period, the Blue Sea Sprite would take over the right to control the Blue Sea Ruins.
After completing the mission, it was unknown if there was a next reincarnation for the ruins spirit. However, it hoped that Shi Yu and the others could really succeed and let the Blue Sea Sprite reach the Mythical stage.
After all, if there was a next reincarnation, the race level of the Blue Sea Sprite would probably decrease. At that time, it was unknown if the reincarnation would be so lucky to grow up.
The Blue Sea inheritance method had to change. Otherwise, the Blue Sea Sprite race would really be extinct.
If Susu was the reincarnation of the will of the Blue Sea Sprite to protect the sea, then the spirit of the ruins was the will of the Blue Sea Sprite to ensure that its race could continue.
“I hope so…”
After obtaining Shi Yu’s promise, the ruins spirit nodded and slowly turned into a sea-blue water drop.
Shi Yu took the ruins water drop and understood that this was the controller of the Blue Sea Ruins.
Usually, after the Blue Sea Sprite accepted the inheritance, it would devour the ruins water drop and become the new owner of the ruins. However…
“You’re still young. I’ll hold it for you first. I’ll give it to you when you reach the demigod level,” Shi Yu said to Susu in the sky.
Susu : “…”
“Ning!!” Susu was interrupted from the inheritance. It returned to its Water Slime form and still felt that this form was more convenient and comfortable.
Although the other form was stronger, it kept feeling uncomfortable using it.
In battle, the Blue Sea Sprite form, in daily life, still the Water Slime form.
At that moment, Susu watched helplessly as Shi Yu took the ruins water drop away. It couldn’t say anything.
Blue Sea Ruins… Its Blue Sea Ruins…
Forget it, it wasn’t important anymore!
Susu then revealed an excited expression.
It had already sensed the power of the two new skills.
Initially, Susu was worried about whether its strength could increase after accepting the inheritance.
But now, after sensing the power of the new skill, it was no longer worried.
Infinite energy!
At this moment, it already had unlimited energy!
Perhaps it was a little exaggerated to say this, but the energy of the entire sea was something that no number of demigods could compare to. With the energy behind Susu being the entire sea, it was completely no problem to say that it was infinite energy.
Susu could feel that it could already multiply the maximum level as its normal state without any consumption!
Could Eleven do that?!
Susu could also feel that as long as it was given enough time, it could condense 600 billion water clones in the infinite space in its body.
Baby Ginseng couldn’t condense 600 billion clones to self-destruct because it was limited by maintenance and energy, but Susu, who had endless energy, could completely do it.
At that time, with 600 billion clones exploding together, Susu would already feel that a beautiful future was waiting for it.
Apart from that, the skill Sea Cleansing Spirit had no level upper limit at all. It was not restricted at all when it was created. As long as it created the Sea Cleansing Spirit and outputted enough water-element power, even if it was at the monarch level now, it could still create the Sea Cleansing Spirit that could cleanse the Poison Dragon Totem, the Black Goat, the Black Yak, and even Yun An!!
As long as it was used with the infinite energy of the Blue Sea Contract, it could be done.
Of course, limited by the output power of the entry-level Blue Sea Contract, it would probably take a year and a half to create a totem-level Sea Cleansing Spirit. It would probably take decades to create a demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit. This was something Susu couldn’t wait for… It felt that it was even harder to condense than a time mark.
However, if it was only a Sea Cleansing Spirit that could cleanse overlord-level poison-type creatures, it could easily condense it.
As for the Sea Cleansing Spirit, it could also be condensed and stored in advance. Just like the Bean Bear, the Sea Cleansing Spirit not only had the power to counter poison, curse, and plague, but it could also cleanse will and emotions.
For example, if the enemy was chasing after Shi Yu and it sent a sea spirit over, the enemy would think about why they had to fight and kill. Wasn’t it good for everyone to be friendly?
If Susu was fighting Eleven, its Sea Cleansing Spirit would instantly cleanse Eleven’s battle intent. It would feel that the team shouldn’t be so chaotic. It should give in to Fifth Sister and take the initiative to surrender.
After experiencing the power of the Sea Cleansing Spirit, Susu couldn’t wait to start the next team meeting… Ah, wait, it had to use a month to prepare for battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 771 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (3)
chapters.content:
771 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (3)
Just like before Eleven fought, it had to condense a full Bean Bear. Before Chi Tong fought, it had to condense a full scapegoat. Before it fought, it had to condense enough Clear Sea Spirits.
“Ning!!!” Susu excitedly shared the power of these two skills with Shi Yu.
“Yes, you have to condense more.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Ning! (Right? Right?)”
“Yes, how many times you can add skills in the team before the world competition depends on whether your Sea Cleansing Spirit is powerful.”
“Let’s arrange Eleven’s superalloy first!”
Susu: “?”
The originally happy Susu’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.
It suddenly realized that the strongest effect of his Sea Cleansing Spirit was to cleanse negative emotions and pain.
When Shi Yu added points to his pet, the pet would receive super skill experience. It would be extremely painful and there was a risk of losing itself.
The longer the receiving time, the longer the additional points, and the greater Shi Yu’s consumption.
Therefore, its cleansing ability determined how much Shi Yu consumed.
If Shi Yu’s consumption decreased, the team’s increase in points could naturally increase.
Susu’s expression turned bitter. Wait, wait, was something wrong?
How was this its epic strengthening?
It was clearly an epic strengthening of the entire team.
Why did Baby Ginseng obtain powerful battle skills after evolution… And it, after finally accepting the inheritance, obtained the cleansing skill to assist the entire team…
“Ning…” Susu’s eyes were filled with tears again. It felt that after becoming a Blue Sea Sprite, it was still very bitter.
“Don’t worry, after we maximize Eleven’s superalloy, I’ll give you more points,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Ning!” Susu felt that this was more like it.
….
After Shi Yu and the others came out of the Blue Sea Ruins, they held the ruins water drop in their hands and looked at the Blue Sea Ruins in front of them. They could sense that they could teleport themselves to the projections of other Blue Sea Ruins with a thought.
However, each projection could only be teleported once for a period of time. It would take a long time to recover its energy, but these problems were not big. More than a hundred projection ruins could be used as a teleportation location, which was equivalent to them adding more than a hundred new escape opportunities. It was enough no matter what.
Also, after returning this time, Shi Yu could sense that he was not far from becoming a legend Beast Tamer.
The feedback from Ling’s evolution and Susu’s evolution was incomparably huge. After all, one was a Mythical race, while the other was the strongest demigod race. If he cultivated bitterly in the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu felt that in less than a year, he could break through the strength of the Beast Taming Space to level seven.
This breakthrough speed would definitely be shocking.
“However, it’s still a little lacking.” After Shi Yu returned, he sighed. He still couldn’t make it to the world competition. After all, that thing was only three months away, and during this period, it was impossible for him to keep cultivating and meditating.
If no new opportunities appeared, he could probably only rely on his identity as a level-six Beast Tamer to fight in the world competition.
However, even so, Shi Yu wasn’t discouraged. Who said that a level-six Beast Tamer couldn’t become the most valuable titled legend?
After returning, Shi Yu called the little white dragon over and sent it to invite the overlords of the Dragon Palace City’s Environmental Protection Department who were willing to participate in the event in Tingxiang. As for himself, he was stopped by Ling to study the fossil dream together.
After the experiment, even with the enhancement of the good luck buff, the fossil of the Mythical creature still didn’t let them into the dream.
However, as the good luck buff and the Mythical Revival skill improved, and as Ling and the Kirin fossil perfectly fused, Shi Yu and the others captured a lot of the dream information left behind by this fossil.
At the moment, Ling was seriously and carefully analyzing.
Ling, in the form of a Rubik’s Cube, showed Shi Yu its research results in the form of a dream scene on the screen.
In the scene, it was still a Wind Kirin cub running away. Compared to the last time, the difference was that Shi Yu and the others saw the creature chasing after the Wind Kirin.
It was a creature that Shi Yu and the others had never seen before. Like those Mythical totems, its appearance looked to be made of many different species. It had a purple-red ant-like body and was extremely huge. Every hand and foot was like the limbs of a huge dragon. At the end were sharp dragon claws, and its face was as ferocious as a demon. Under its blood-red eyes were rows of sharp white teeth that revealed green saliva.
Even on its back, four pairs of long and huge sharp purple-red thorns stretched out, looking extremely evil. At the same time, the originally barren world it stepped on was even stranger. The sky and ground were covered in purple-red, as if it had formed a domain.
“What’s this?” Seeing this monster, Shi Yu could sense a huge pressure even through the screen.
Ling said, “According to the dream information, this shouldn’t be a native creature of Blue Planet.”
“Alien life invasion?” Shi Yu asked.
“Do you have any speculations? Tell me, tell me.”
“Alright, Master.” Ling nodded and said, “According to the dream information, the Mythical Era was originally an era with very abundant natural energy. All races had a chance to become gods. The transcendent creatures of that era grew easier than our era and it was easier to reach the Laws of the world.”
“In the dream memories of the Wind Kirin, it has feelings that are extremely nostalgic for the beautiful life of the past. All of this ended with a sudden war. All the creatures on Blue Planet were swept into a huge battle, including Mythical creatures.”

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 772 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (4)
chapters.content:
772 The Reason for the End of the Mythical Era (4)
“Because of this battle, the Blue Planet space was shattered and countless genocides occurred. Because the battle frequently mobilized natural energy, the natural energy level of the entire planet also fell to the bottom, causing the entire world to enter a desolate era.”
“And the fuse of this battle shouldn’t be a battle between native creatures on Blue Planet, but a ‘foreign enemy’. Because in the Wind Kirin’s dream memory, the monster chasing it is an ‘invader’.”
“Therefore, I deduce that the Mythical Era of Blue Planet was originally an extraordinary era, but because the life civilization in the universe coveted the resources of Blue Planet and invaded, Blue Planet was forced to be involved in the war. Master, do you remember Susu’s sworn enemy, the Abyss Sea?”
“The Abyss Sea is also a faction inherited from the Mythical Era. Its power system comes from outer space, and its final goal is to pollute the Blue Planet’s ocean. I judge that the Abyss Sea should be one of the great enemies facing the Mythical Era at that time.”
“And there should be many enemies like this. The enemy that caused the extinction of the Kirin race should also be one of them.”
“This is an invasion. An invasion of a cosmic civilization against Earth.”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Many archeologists have indeed made this guess. They think that the Mythical Era ended in a war, or in internal strife, or invasion.”
However, no archeologist could produce evidence.
Ling said, “This war should have ended with Blue Planet’s victory. However, the price of victory is too huge. The planet’s energy has almost dried up because of the divine battle. Therefore, under the request of Blue Planet’s will, the divine beasts that survived the war fell asleep one by one or left Blue Planet to find a new home and wait for Blue Planet’s energy to recover to the level of the Mythical Era.”
“At the same time, the will of Blue Planet left behind a clone that turned into a World Tree to supervise the ecology of the entire Blue Planet.”
“The invasion of the cosmic civilization should be for something. We can treat it as a ‘planetary resource’ war, but because of this war, Blue Planet went from a planet with rich resources to a barren world. In addition to the power of the native divine beasts on Blue Planet, to a certain extent, it severed the thought of the cosmic civilization wanting to invade Blue Planet again. Because there are no benefits to be found, and there was no longer a battle of this scale in the totem era.”
“However, planets can recover on their own. After enough time, Blue Planet will return to its previous state sooner or later. At that time, cosmic civilizations should invade Blue Planet again, and even the Abyss Sea. Perhaps the Abyss Sea is an inheritance left behind by a certain cosmic civilization to supervise the ecology of Blue Planet.”
“Even Yun An might be an investigation soldier sent by a certain cosmic civilization. For billions of years, there have been many civilizations passed down from outer space on Blue Planet. The Western Abyss Sea and the Eastern Yun An Race are only a part of it. No one knows how many cosmic lives have already integrated into Blue Planet.”
“And if the Mythical Era revives again, it means that Blue Planet’s energy level is about to recover to the standard of the Mythical Era. At that time, not only will those meditating divine beasts awaken again, but Blue Planet will also enter the eyes of the invaders who are eyeing Blue Planet covetously. It’s very likely that a new round of divine battles will happen around Blue Planet.”
After Ling finished analyzing, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He felt that it was extremely troublesome.
It was better to have another totem battle.
What Ling analyzed was actually various similar versions in the archeological world today. However, these claims couldn’t be verified.
However, the conclusions Ling found through the biological dream of the Mythical Era could be proven in terms of authenticity and accuracy. If he used this discovery to participate in some archeological conference, he would for sure be able to obtain the Mythical resources. At that time, not only the seven countries, but even the other native totem countries would be extremely afraid of extraterrestrial factions like the Abyss Sea and the Yun An Clan.
For humans, the totem clans were enemies, but for the entirety of life on Blue Planet, the life forms of the universe were even greater enemies.
However, just this information was definitely not enough. It was probably very difficult to obtain recognition. He definitely had to showcase Ling, who had mastered a quasi-divine skill. Shi Yu felt that if he wanted to take this Mythical resource, it would probably be very difficult.
Apart from that, what made Shi Yu feel troubled was that Susu had already evolved into a Blue Sea Sprite. If it also wanted to participate in the World Tournament, there was a certain chance of revealing that the Blue Sea Sprite had been contracted by a human Beast Tamer. At that time, the Abyss Sea would probably target him.
Shi Yu cried. He felt that he had clearly done nothing, so why did he have so many potential enemies?
“Master, there’s no need to be sad. Think about it better. Perhaps I’m wrong.”
“But I’m still so angry. Let’s go beat up Duckie.”

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 773 Seventh Pet (1)
chapters.content:
773 Seventh Pet (1)
When Shi Yu was in Dragon Palace City, the legendary Beast Tamer of the Seven Islands, Ji Xiang and Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court arrived at Dong Huang.
Because their goal was clear and their destination was the Ancient Capital, Dong Huang was received by the former legend of the Ancient Capital, the principal of the Ancient Capital University, and the new legend of the Ancient Capital, Lu Qingyi.
“Teacher, do you think Shi Yu and Lu Bai are the same person?”
After Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court and Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court arrived at Dong Huang, they were still very puzzled by this question.
Although no one in Dong Huang thought that Shi Yu and Lu Bai were the same person, they had different views after personally seeing Lu Bai crack the Phoenix Ruins.
In any case, Lu Bai was definitely not as simple as he looked. He was definitely not a Beast Tamer who was purely there to communicate. He should have been eyeing the Phoenix Ruins from the start!
In Dong Huang, the most likely to crack the Seven Islands Phoenix Ruins was the archeologist Shi Yu, who had contracted a hybrid spirit of the Phoenix Race. In addition, Lu Bai also had a similar pet…
“It’s no longer important, and we’ll know soon.” After arriving at Dong Huang, the two legends directly saw the legend of the Ancient Capital waiting for them.
“Welcome.” When Principal Feng saw the two legends of the Seven Islands, he immediately smiled and introduced himself.
“And this is the honorary president of the Dong Huang Archeological Association, Legend Lu Qingyi. She also has some understanding of the legend of Mu Huiyin and the history of the empress.”
Beside Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi nodded slightly.
“Hello, Legend Feng and Legend Lu,” the Phoenix Divine Master and Ji Xiang said.
“Aren’t Dr. Shi Yu and the others around?” However, what concerned the two of them was that Shi Yu and Lu Bai, who they had expressed to Dong Huang that they wanted to see the most, weren’t around.
“Shi Yu and the others have a mission and aren’t around at the moment. They might only return in a few days,” Principal Feng said.
Ji Xiang and Jie Yi were silent.
“Then can we know why Lu Bai can crack the Phoenix Ruins?”
“We’ve indeed studied this. We can tell the two of you.” Principal Feng nodded and said, “Let’s find a quiet place first.”
In order to rope in Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court and the Phoenix Court, it was impossible to say nothing.
In a private room, Principal Feng and the two of them sat looking at each other and said, “According to our research, the reason why Lu Bai could crack the Phoenix Ruins back then and enter the ruins to take the inheritance without being injured by the Phoenix Ruins… Was because his pet’s bloodline is a direct descendant of the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm.”
“We’ve already guessed it,” Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court said. “Therefore, the bet agreement of the Dong Huang exchange team has a certain goal from the start, right? Before coming to the Seven Islands, Lu Bai knew that he could definitely crack the Phoenix Ruins.”
Principal Feng smiled and didn’t say anything.
But it was equivalent to saying everything. If he didn’t have the confidence to win, why would he play a bet? Wasn’t that stupid?
“In other words, Dong Huang already knows the identity of the owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm?” Jie Yi asked.
Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “The owner of the Phoenix Mystic Realm was an expert of the Phoenix Race named ‘Sun God Phoenix’ when it was alive.”
Sun God Phoenix…
Sun flames were indeed everywhere in the mystic realm.
The two legends of the Phoenix Court acknowledged it.
“And this Senior Sun God Phoenix is currently in Dong Huang. It’s the guardian of Dong Huang during the era of the empress dynasty, and it has a deep relationship with the empress.”
“What, it’s still alive?!” The two Phoenix Court legends were shocked.
No, if it was still alive, how could it leave its ruins mystic realm outside?
“Although it’s alive, it’s no different from death. I believe the two of you have also understood some of Dong Huang’s history before, right? The empress dynasty has been destroyed for a long time. The reason for its destruction is naturally because of the totem war. As an important guardian during the era of the empress dynasty, it was the first to bear the brunt when the empress dynasty was about to be destroyed. It was cursed by the enemy and could only be forced to reincarnate.”
“However, because this curse involves the power of laws, it might have come from a demigod. Even after it reincarnated, it still carried a strong plague and a second curse. It was a living disaster. For this, the empress at that time could only seal it.”
“Unfortunately, the destruction of the empress dynasty was too sudden. Before it could be unsealed, Dong Huang was already on the verge of collapse.”
The expressions of Jie Yi and Ji Xiang changed slightly.
Lu Qingyi continued, “Although it was sealed, it still retained its consciousness. As time passed, the curse power on its body became weaker and weaker. Its own consciousness became clearer and clearer, and it told Dong Huang how to recover.”
“At the moment, Dong Huang is working hard to save and recover this senior.”
“The location and cracking method of the Phoenix Mystic Realm were also told by this senior. This is a treasure vault left behind before it was sealed. Some resources inside can be used to cleanse the curse on its body.”
“If the two of you really want to confirm the origin of the Phoenix Mystic Realm, you can come after we rescue this senior.”
“This makes sense…” Ji Xiang’s expression was complicated. She had also studied the Phoenix Mystic Realm very deeply and already believed half of Lu Qingyi’s words.
Principal Feng said, “Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, according to what I know, the Phoenix God Society mainly believes in this senior, and you, Divine Master of the Phoenix Court, only rose because of the mystic realm left behind by this senior. Why don’t you bring the Phoenix God Society and join Dong Huang?”

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 774 Seventh Pet (2)
chapters.content:
774 Seventh Pet (2)
“I heard from the Tyrannical Sea Legend that the guardian of the Red God Island at that time even attacked you because of the Phoenix Mystic Realm. This kind of thing definitely can’t happen in our Dong Huang.”
“Impossible.” Ji Xiang shook her head and said, “There’s no need to say anymore.”
She was alone, but many witches of the Phoenix God Shrine had families on the Seven Islands. Some people even came from large families. Leading the Shrine to go join Dong Huang was impossible.
“I don’t want to talk about anything else. I just want to know if there’s anything I can do to help save and recover this senior. I want to communicate with it with its clear consciousness as soon as possible.”
Principal Feng: “Why don’t the two of you stay in Dong Huang first? Lu Bai has a deep connection with this senior. When he returns, we’ll communicate in depth.”
Principal Feng didn’t think that he could successfully poach them directly. Everything had to be done slowly.
Principal Feng and the others didn’t hide the Undying Dark Phoenix, because regardless of whether what the Undying Dark Phoenix said was true or false, it was no longer important.
So what if the Undying Dark Phoenix was an enemy?
In Shi Yu’s words, Mother Feng was so generous that she had even sent over Mythical resources. Even if it was an enemy, he couldn’t bear to hurt Mother Feng. Therefore, it was better to wait for Susu to become a demigod before rescuing the Undying Dark Phoenix. Even if the Undying Dark Phoenix had any schemes, under the purification of the quasi divine skill and the Sea Cleansing Spirit, it could still become the kind-hearted guardian of Dong Huang and become a good phoenix.
It could be said that from the moment Shi Yu contracted the Blue Sea Sprite that had mastered the strongest cleansing power, it had been checkmate.
Which proper Beast Tamer would use Sun Flame to cleanse the curse?
….
While the little white dragon helped run errands and form the Environmental Protection Department’s exchange team, Shi Yu experimented with the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
The Sea Cleansing Spirit looked like a blue water spirit body. Its form was identical to the Blue Sea Sprite. It could possess other living or dead creatures like undead and complete cleansing.
After Susu used the Time Fruit to temporarily reach the overlord level, it tried its best to use the Blue Sea Contract to condense a maximum cleansing sea spirit.
At this moment, this was not just a Sea Cleansing Spirit. It could be said to be a combination skill of Purification+Time Fruit+Blue Sea Contract+Sea Cleansing Spirit!
After condensing, it fused into Eleven’s body.
“Add more points!”
At the same time, Shi Yu’s hand landed on Eleven’s furry head and started adding points to the superalloy.
“Yi!” Beside him, Baby Ginseng tried its best to heal. Every pet did its own job. Chi Tong’s possession and Ling’s loading increased Shi Yu’s condition as much as possible.
After some operations, Shi Yu looked at the [Cooldown Time] and fell into deep thought.
Cooldown Time: 12 hours
With the support of the entire team, it only took 12 hours to add some super skills to a pet with the will of an overlord. The time was halved!
“It’s stable!!”
After being stunned, Shi Yu was overjoyed.
This meant that before the world competition, he should be able to let the team have three transcendent skills!
Transcendent super skills were abilities that only totem level experts could master.
With three people on his side, even if the opponent was an invincible overlord and a totem level, it might not be impossible to fight.
Susu mastering the Sea Cleansing Spirit was indeed an increase in the team’s Epic level.
Initially, Shi Yu was in a hurry to develop his telepathy talent because he was worried that there wasn’t enough time to add points and that he wouldn’t be able to kill indiscriminately in the World Tournament and be forced to find new abilities.
But now, even if his talent had not been successfully developed, the chances of winning the championship had increased by at least 30%. It was stable.
“Ning ~!!” At this moment, the team started discussing who to add points to next.
Three opportunities for transcendent skills!
Eleven’s superalloy definitely had to take up one. After all, it was the skill with the closest proficiency to transcendent in the team at the moment. It would be a waste not to do it.
Although Eleven thought that it would be best to also activate its Undying Golden Body to transcendent and create a true immortal body, it was a little embarrassed to continue competing for favor since it had already been given points to.
Susu, on the other hand, felt that it should use its Heavenly Frost Cold Energy. Time-element skills that were both supportive and offensive could definitely shine and play a key role.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, felt that it should use its plant control. The Time Fruit modified from transcendent plant control would definitely be the best support tool in the team. It could increase the entire team greatly.
Perhaps it could allow Ling of the Mythical race to have stable totem-level battle power after eating it.
Ling, on the other hand, felt that although it didn’t have the will of an overlord, the cost-effective ratio of Mythical Revival was still very high. After all, it was a skill that could unearth the power of a god.
Buggy and Chi Tong also had some thoughts. For example, Chi Tong wanted undead revival to reach perfection. That way, it could control totem-level undead and its battle power would also increase greatly.
Buggy also had a small idea. A transcendent-level anti-magic domain could directly cripple 99% of overlords and make them unable to control the power of nature… It was also super cost-effective.
“Wu…” Shi Yu also had a headache. At this moment, his best method was actually to temporarily give up on adding points to superalloy. After all, Eleven’s potential and strength after evolution were unknown. It was equivalent to a bet.
However, the proficiency of the superalloy was already so high. If it didn’t continue, it would be a waste.
In any case, with the enhancement of good luck, Shi Yu decided to continue gambling. Perhaps he could rely on transcendent-level evolution skills to bet on a Mythical race.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 775 Seventh Pet (3)
chapters.content:
775 Seventh Pet (3)
With the remaining two main positions, Shi Yu fell into deep thought and finally decided to give it to Baby Ginseng and Susu.
They all had the will of overlords, so it was easier to add points. As for who followed, it depended on the situation.
“Wu ~ ~” Shi Yu’s gains were huge. After confirming the additional points plan, the little white dragon ran back excitedly.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, the ten dragons have been gathered ~”
There was no need for too many overlords to go to Tingxiang this time. Ten was already a lot.
Choosing ten from the Environmental Protection Department, which had nearly a hundred overlords, was naturally easy.
The little white dragon flew over quickly, and Shi Yu walked out of the room.
“Have you gathered them? Who are they?” Shi Yu asked.
“Uncle Hei Ge… Second Brother… Doctor Shell… Sister Ice Dragon…”
Shi Yu nodded. There were some familiar faces.
Uncle Hei Ge, the Sky Penetrating Whale, a top-notch dragon-element overlord. Its energy level was nearly 90 million, so it should be able to defeat that green-scaled dragon.
The legend contestants of Tingxiang would probably be crying.
‘Second Brother’ probably referred to the Second Prince, the Primordial Thunder Dragon. It had been beaten by Eleven. Wasn’t this guy at the monarch level? It looked like it had broken through.
Doctor Shell… At that time, the overlord healer in charge of treating the Poison Dragon Radiation. Although it wasn’t a dragon, it was very normal for the exchange team to bring healers.
“Who’s Sister Ice Dragon?” Among them, only this title stunned Shi Yu.
“The Ice Feather Dragon is Senior Ice Dragon King’s adopted daughter. Senior Shi Yu, don’t you know?”
“Ah, this.” Shi Yu was stunned. He really didn’t know!
Having another sister for no reason?
It looked like Ice Dragon had also stabilized itself in Dragon Palace City and started to take in adopted daughters. A few overlords should have already gathered under it.
“Speaking of which, isn’t your crown prince also an overlord? Didn’t you call him?”
Seeing that there was no Crown Prince on the little white dragon’s list, Shi Yu asked curiously.
The little white dragon’s face darkened. “How would I dare? Moreover, that guy is a cultivation fanatic. He trains in the ruins of the Dragon Palace all year round. If he wants to break through to the totem level as soon as possible, he shouldn’t be interested in exchange activities.”
“I see.” Shi Yu nodded. The eldest prince of Dragon Palace City was a nine-clawed golden dragon. He should be the strongest dragon below the totem dragon king of Dragon Palace City. As expected of the eldest prince, it was more promising than the third prince.
After the exchange team was gathered, Shi Yu saw that it was about time. He said, “I’ll call someone else. Then, we’ll prepare to set off.”
“Alright ~!!” The little white dragon agreed repeatedly.
As for Shi Yu, he directly summoned Susu and let it bring him back to the sea.
On the East Sea, after leaving the Deep Sea Mystic Realm, Shi Yu took out his cell phone and called Senior Lu.
A moment later, Senior Lu’s voice came from the other side. “Shi Yu?”
“Senior, I’m almost done preparing here. Are you free? We can set off now.”
“On my side…” Lu Qingyi’s face darkened.” The legend of the Phoenix God Society has arrived. ”
“That Seven Islands Legend called Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court even pestered me to ask if Shi Yu and Lu Bai were the same person. When we communicated with the Phoenix pet, she said that she could sense it. My Green Phoenix also ate the Phoenix Fruit and they asked if Lu Bai gave the Phoenix Fruit to me.”
“Well… She still wants to fight me. Shi Yu, Shi Yu… Did you say something nonsense to them?”
“And your alternate identity… Why do I feel that anyone can guess it?”
Shi Yu : “…”
He had almost forgotten about the two legends of the Seven Islands.
“Cough, it’s mainly because at the end, I don’t want to hide it anymore. In any case, I’ve already obtained the resources and the Dragon Palace City army has arrived.”
“Forget about them for the time being. Let Principal Feng receive them. Let’s go to Tingxiang first.”
“Huh?” Lu Qingyi asked. “Aren’t we waiting for Dong Huang to form an exchange team?”
“Let’s not wait anymore. Dragon Palace City happens to be forming a team to go to Tingxiang. We’ll go with Dragon Palace City.”
“If you’re done over there, come over quickly with Teacher Ying.”
“Alright.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
….
After receiving the news from Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, the gem cat, and the Void Mantis set off for Dragon Palace City in the ancient capital.
Shi Yu remembered that the Elven Empress seemed to have said that the Dragon God would also go to Tingxiang, but in the past few days, there had been no movement from the Dragon God and the Elven Empress.
After throwing the exchange mission to him, there was no more news.
So should they go together or separately?
Or had the two legendary big shots left?
Shi Yu couldn’t help but be curious, so he encouraged Buggy to ask.
Above the Dragon God Palace, when Buggy went to the Dragon God Statue to train, it passed by and asked carefully, “Wu, wu, wu.”
It told Senior Dragon God that the Beast Tamer and the others were preparing to go to Tingxiang soon. Should they go together or go separately?
In the Dragon God Palace, the Dragon God and the Elven Empress had been exchanging cultivation insights for the past few days.
The Dragon God was a demigod-level life form, and the Elven Empress, as a hybrid Beast Tamer, had the Beast Taming Talent similar to Emperor Wu. She could borrow the power of nine contracted elves to temporarily become a demigod-level life form and master quasi-divine skills.
The two legends were both experts who had come into contact with the power of laws, and they both involved wind-element laws, so they naturally had a lot of experience to exchange. When the two parties invested in the exchange, a few days passed in the blink of an eye.
“Looks like they’re ready,” the Elven Empress said.
“Then let’s go,” the Dragon God said.
“What do you think about letting Shi Yu go to that Mythical Ruins with us?” the Elven Empress said.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 776 Seventh Pet (4)
chapters.content:
776 Seventh Pet (4)
The Dragon God glanced at her and said, “He’s not even a legend. Do you want him to die?”
The Elven Empress smiled and said, “How could that be? Forget it then. I just feel that he might be able to help. Then, it shouldn’t be a problem to let him torment those low-level ruins in Tingxiang, right?”
The Dragon God said, “As long as it’s safe.”
“Don’t worry, I can’t bear for anything to happen to him either. This is a little genius who contracted a Mythical race.” The Elven Empress smiled and said, “If he’s as unreliable as that Lin Feng, I’ll have a headache. After all, I’m prepared to entrust him with a royal sprite.”
Back then, Lin Feng took a genius royal elf valued by the Elven Empress from Tingxiang. In the end, not long after, Lin Feng disappeared. The Elven Empress was so angry that she gritted her teeth.
The Elven Empress felt that she had not learned her lesson. This time, when she saw Shi Yu’s talent, she actually had the thought of letting Shi Yu contract a Courtyard Sprite. It could be considered to be something that deepened the connection between Shi Yu and Tingxiang.
The Elven Empress was half human and half elf. Her family, which was now the royal family of Tingxiang, involved three races: humans, elves, and half-elves. Among them, the elven royal family could be contracted.
However, it was still different. Lin Feng took the initiative to go to Tingxiang to abduct elves, while on Shi Yu’s side, the Elven Empress took the initiative to befriend Shi Yu. In the Elven Empress’s opinion, Shi Yu’s talent was even stronger than Lin Feng’s. After all, Lin Feng didn’t even nurture a Mythical pet with an evolution talent, but Shi Yu did.
Although Shi Yu was an archeologist and this profession was very dangerous, and it was very likely that he would disappear in the future after exploring ruins like Lin Feng, Shi Yu should not be that unlucky with the protection of the Wind Blessing.
Therefore, after careful analysis, the Elven Empress felt that it was very necessary for Shi Yu to contract a Courtyard Sprite to deepen the connection between the two parties.
Especially in such a revolutionary era, having one more trump card meant one more way out. Although Shi Yu was very weak now, no matter how one looked at it, contracting a Mythical race would definitely make him a legend in the future.
“He might not be willing to contract the elves on your side,” the Dragon God said.
Shi Yu came to Dragon Palace City and directly contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation.
Now, there was another Mythical pet.
Even that worm was not simple. If the power of imagination mastered was cultivated into a quasi-divine skill, it would undoubtedly be the strongest power of law. It was a creation-type and creation-type laws had extraordinary potential.
She felt that the Elven Empress was having one-sided thoughts.
“Now this is something you don’t understand. Why do you think Lin Feng is thinking about the elves? Is it because the elves have extraordinary potential and outstanding talent?” the Elven Empress said.
As a humanoid life form, the beautiful elves, like the mermaids and dragon girls of Dragon Palace City, happened to have human aesthetics. Sometimes, what attracted Beast Tamers was not necessarily strength, potential, or appearance.
Moreover, the Elven Empress was still very confident in the talent potential of her elves. They were a group of sprites so arrogant that even the local genius legend Beast Tamers weren’t up to their standards.
“Did we forget to reply to that worm?”
“Looks like it.”
….
The result of Buggy’s question was not ideal.
After staying near the Dragon God Palace for a while without any response, Buggy immediately ran back.
“Wu, wu!”
Buggy stammered as it spoke to Shi Yu in the air.
“Not there?”
Shi Yu shook his head. Forget it, forget it. Let’s go directly.
When Senior Lu and the others arrived, they would gather the environmental department and set off!
“Are you looking for us?”
On Blue Sea Island, not long after Buggy returned, the figure of the Elven Empress appeared in the sky, scaring Shi Yu and Buggy.
Didn’t it say they weren’t around!
Buggy: “Wu…” (Damn it, they weren’t replying).
“Your Majesty.” Shi Yu immediately looked over and said, “It’s alright, it’s alright. I’m just asking when we’re leaving.”
Sylphra said, “We can set off when you’re ready.”
“In addition, you’re a level-six Beast Tamer now, right?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu was stunned. What was wrong?
“You shouldn’t be far from becoming a legend Beast Tamer, right?”
“Well… In another year or two, it feels about right,” Shi Yu conservatively estimated.
Sylphra said, “Not bad. Do you have any thoughts about the seventh contract slot?”
“The seventh contract slot?!” Shi Yu was stunned. Why was the Elven Empress asking this?
“Well, on this trip to Tingxiang, are you interested in contracting an elf?” Sylphra asked with a smile.
The elves!
Shi Yu was very surprised. “If there’s a suitable partner, I’m naturally willing. However, I might not be able to contract it in the short term. Even if I find a suitable partner, I’m afraid I’ll have to wait a long time.”
Shi Yu’s initial idea was to have one pet of all types.
Animals, plants, elements, undead, machinery, humanoids… At the moment, it seemed that there was indeed a lack of humanoid pets!
Sprites, mermaids, dragon girls, angels, demons, and so on were actually not bad choices. Now that the Elven Empress had taken the initiative to chat with him, Shi Yu directly abandoned the other options.
The Elven Empress clearly took a fancy to his potential and wanted to befriend him!!!
After contracting the sprite, everyone would be family!
Of course, the premise was that he could find a suitable partner. After all, he currently had very strict requirements for the pets of the first team. The positioning had to be beneficial to the entire team.
Shi Yu calculated that if he could become a legendary in the future, he still had three contract slots.
Shi Yu indeed didn’t have any thoughts about the seventh pet. His original idea was to see what the Space Beast Egg could hatch. If it was suitable, he would contract it. If not, it would be the second team. But now, he seemed to have another choice.
“These are small matters,” the Elven Empress said. “Before the contract, just treat it as training. If you don’t get along, there’s no need to continue the contract.”
“In that case, when we reach Tingxiang, I’ll introduce you to a few elves.”

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 777 Ancient Kingdom of Tingxiang
chapters.content:
777 Ancient Kingdom of Tingxiang
The Elven Empress left.
Before leaving, Shi Yu’s heart was hooked.
She wanted to introduce sprites to him.
Why did it feel like a blind date?
Shi Yu sighed.
He recalled the situation in Tingxiang.
The predecessor of Tingxiang was originally a huge elven country.
They believed in the Mother Tree of Life.
It was said that the Mother Tree was formed by a plant-type god who had fallen in the Mythical Era.
Now, it no longer had the power of the past. It was only equivalent to a Mythical resource.
The elves were born under the nurturing of the Mother Tree.
As for the elves, they naturally took on the responsibility of protecting the Mother Tree.
However, such a resource would naturally attract many covetous eyes.
However, because of the power of the elves, although the elven country often fought with external enemies, it was basically fine. Every time, it ended in victory.
But there was no such thing as eternal prosperity.
The decline of the elven country came from the Mother Tree mutating into the Dark Mother Tree for unknown reasons, infecting a large batch of elves into dark elves.
Because of this change, the elves split.
The infected races that had become dark elves were still willing to believe in the Dark Mother Tree, but the elves who weren’t infected thought that the Mother Goddess had encountered a dark invasion.
This caused internal strife among the elves.
The humans of Tingxiang relied on this time to rise. The final outcome of the internal strife ended with the dark elves having the advantage.
The Holy Land of the elves, the Forest of Life, was also renamed the Dark Night Forest.
Some of the orthodox elves had fled further into the Nature Forest or the depths of the ocean, while others relied on the help of humans to fight against the Dark Forest, which was the current Ancient Kingdom of Tingxiang.
The first ruler of Tingxiang was a legendary Beast Tamer who contracted a sprite.
However, as the relationship between the humans and this portion of the elves grew closer and closer, the hybrid half-elves finally became the core royal family of Tingxiang.
Of course, even if the current ruler of Tingxiang was a half-elf, the bloodline was still mainly human. Otherwise, it was impossible for them to join the Seven Nation Alliance.
After all, the Seven Nation Alliance was an alliance formed by humans.
The reason why it could accept hybrids was that the legendaries in power in other countries were also not very normal.
The mechanical legendaries of Shen Feng and Dong Huang had already modified themselves into mechanical lives.
The legendary of the Seven Islands was a modified person with the human side as the main body. It was also not a normal human.
The legendary of the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua was only contracted undead pets, which also made himself look neither human nor ghost. Shi Yu estimated that it relied on the full-level undead possession to change its bloodline and soul. Through this method, he delayed his life force and increased his strength.
Therefore, no one said anything.
“Humans have limits.”
I have to hold back and not be like then… Shi Yu thought.
However, after eating the Undying Fruit, he seemed to be destined to not be a normal person anymore. His eyes were filled with tears.
Which normal person could still become a totem-level undead after dying?
….
“Coming, coming!”
Soon, the gem cat brought the Void Mantis and Lu Qingyi to Dragon Palace City.
Apart from that, Lu Qingyi also had an overlord-level sprite beside her.
She was more than 1.6 meters tall. Her long silver-white hair and purple gem-like eyes were extremely exquisite.
She was wearing a low-cut white robe formed by the wind elements, with gorgeous purple light decorating it.
Its illusory figure meant that it was an undead race and not a normal sprite.
