Obviously, when Senior Lu entered the possession state, all the changes were inherited from this elven girl.
“Yo, little girl, you’re going home soon. Looking forward to it?”
Shi Yu smiled and looked at the elf sprite beside Senior Lu.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the sprite hid behind Lu Qingyi nervously. Then, it revealed an angry expression and said, “In terms of age, I’m older than your great-great-great-grandmother.”
“But aren’t you just a child among the elves at your age?” Shi Yu was amused.
“Alright, alright, Lian, whatever he says.” Lu Qingyi said helplessly, “You’re like a child anyway…”
The sad Courtyard Sprite thought that these guys were bullying her together.
“Come to me. I’ll get your teacher to bring you to various places in Dragon Palace City to play,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
He had naturally seen this wind-element Courtyard Sprite long ago. In addition, because she had used Chi Tong’s memory water drop to learn possession, theoretically speaking, Chi Tong was still her teacher.
As for this sprite, he didn’t know how it was when it was alive, but after it turned into an undead, it lost a lot of its memories. It was basically no different from a child.
Although Eleven, Buggy, and the others weren’t very old either. If this sprite was considered a child, then Eleven and the others should be considered babies and cubs.
“Why don’t you bring me to play too?” the Void Mantis said. Although the Space Emperor had come to Dragon Palace City, this was its first time!
Dragon Palace City seemed to still have the teleportation array established by the Space Emperor. Unfortunately, without the maintenance of the Space Emperor, it shouldn’t be able to be used anymore.
“Let’s go, let’s go. I’ll take you to see Bingbing,” the gem cat said happily.
The Void Mantis: “What’s Bingbing?”
“It’s nothing. Just a senior from the Emperor Shi Dynasty.”
The Void Mantis: !!!
“How can there be someone so experienced!” The Void Mantis was shocked. How could it still be alive?
“Time element, you understand.”
“This…” The Void Mantis was envious and jealous. Its sense of superiority in space disappeared in front of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 778 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (2)
chapters.content:
778 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (2)
….
After Senior Lu and the others arrived, Shi Yu simply received them. Then, he began to inform the little white dragon to confirm the departure time.
A day later, the large group of Dragon Palace City gathered.
The leader was a level-six Beast Tamer, Shi Yu.
Bodyguard, totem level frost dragon and gem cat.
Among the members of the exchange, there were ten overlords of Dragon Palace City led by the general of Dragon Palace City, the Sky Penetrating Whale, and the Second Prince, the Primordial Thunder Dragon.
The accompanying people were Lu Qingyi, the Courtyard Sprite Lian, the Void Mantis, and the Third Prince, Little White Dragon.
It could be said that the lineup was quite luxurious.
With this lineup, it was not a problem to fight the Heavenly Fox Nation, even if the Fox God was a top-notch totem.
And this was only the tip of the iceberg of the Dragon Palace City faction. It was enough to see how powerful Dragon Palace City was among the totem factions.
Shi Yu felt that in fact, soon, Dragon Palace City should have a new totem dragon king.
Because now that Susu had already accepted the Blue Sea Sprite inheritance, it wouldn’t be long before it could cleanse that Poison Dragon Totem.
At that time, Shi Yu could barely give it a position as a general of the Environmental Protection Department and make it become his underling. It would enjoy extremely high treatment. He hoped that it wouldn’t fail to appreciate his kindness.
After all, he had saved his life!
“The dragons are all here, right?” On an island very close to the entrance of the Dragon Palace City’s mystic realm, Shi Yu looked at the eleven Dragon Palace City members in front of him and said.
“Minister Shi Yu, everyone is here,” the Sky Penetrating Whale agreed.
Apart from those who were more familiar with Shi Yu, the other overlord dragons were paying more attention to Shi Yu.
For example, the Ice Feather Dragon that the frost dragon had taken in. It was an overlord-level ice-element divine dragon with extraordinary strength. It looked at Shi Yu and worshiped him very much.
It was endlessly curious about Shi Yu, who could make its foster mother mumble all day and never forget him, and who could be chosen by the Dragon God to lead over a hundred overlords in Dragon Palace City.
“I wonder how far Lord Blue Sea Sprite has grown,” Doctor Shell muttered quietly
“With my current strength, I should be able to crush it, right? The exchange in Tingxiang this time is not so important. I have to find an opportunity to take revenge.” The Primordial Thunder Dragon was also muttering.
At the Dragon Palace City banquet, after being tortured by Eleven, the Primordial Thunder Dragon was very annoyed. Although it had really joined the Environmental Protection Department after that, it was actually aiming to challenge Shi Yu!
Although the Primordial Thunder Dragon was a little more reliable than the Little White Dragon, the Second Prince, who came from a superior and pampered family, it had never cultivated crazily like the eldest. It was mainly because with its identity, even if it challenged an overlord above its level in Dragon Palace City, the other party would still hold back a little out of consideration.
It had never suffered the treatment of being crushed and countered.
Therefore, it remembered Eleven and Shi Yu a few more times.
Now, after some hard work, it went to ask his top-notch totem father for a legendary resource. The Second Prince had already been reborn. With the proficiency of super skills and a thunder-element legendary resource, it broke through to the overlord level in both aspects!
Invincible.
“87, 71, 66, 58…”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s gaze also swept across this batch of exchange members. Among the combatants, the Sky Penetrating Whale’s energy level was definitely the highest. Next was the Second Prince’s 66 million.
Shi Yu felt that it had probably used some strengthening legendary resource that could specially strengthen its energy level when it broke through. Otherwise, how could it have such a high energy level when it had just broken through?
The others were relatively average. Apart from Doctor Shell, who was a healer at 71 million, the others were all about 60 million. Apart from the Sky Penetrating Whale, no top-notch overlord battle power came. Even the Sky Penetrating Whale was probably here to watch over the little white dragon.
That was true. For top overlords like General Luosha, the Mermaid Queen, and even the strongest overlords like the Crown Prince, an exchange event was not worth them making a big fuss about.
However, although there was no top-notch battle power or weak chicken, and although the energy value didn’t mean anything, none of the energy values were lower than 55 million. This already explained the problem.
It was suitable to communicate with the contestants of the World Tournament in Tingxiang.
“Since we’re all here, let’s go,” Shi Yu said with a smile. “For the sake of efficiency, I’ll put you into a ruins space next. I’ll call you out when we reach our destination.”
“It’s boring on the way. I’ve already prepared special drinks and fruits in the space. Everyone can chat and communicate there first.”
“Thank you, Minister Shi Yu ~” The Black Flood Dragon overlord and the others said politely. This was the father of the Black Flood Dragon Baby that Zou Yun had contracted. Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t as strong as the Green Scaled Dragon.
“Then everyone, come in first.” Shi Yu nodded.
He now had a total of four ruins spaces. One was the Blue Sea Ruins Water Droplet. It was only used for Susu to accept inheritances and for it train with him. It could be regarded as an exclusive Mythical cultivation resource and also as the eye of a super teleportation array.
One was a legendary ruin card. As Eleven and the others’ daily training, it could also be used as equipment to strengthen spatial sealing moves.
Next was the ruins ring, which was used by Baby Ginseng to study various spiritual fruits. It was the Shi Yu family’s granary. If the food ruins and training ruins were put together, it would be a little dangerous.
Right on the heels of that was the ruin bracelet. It was eliminated by Shi Yu and was prepared by Bureau 11 to be used as a gift for Fang Lan to enter the bureau.
These guys were all overlords, so Shi Yu naturally welcomed them into the high-level ruins equipment, the ruins ring. Baby Ginseng had already prepared various spiritual fruits that water and dragon-type creatures liked, enough for them to squander all the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 779 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (3)
chapters.content:
779 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (3)
As for Ice Dragon and the gem cat, they were both playing cards with the Void Mantis, Lu Qingyi, and the others in Ice Dragon’s own ruins space.
When everything was ready, Shi Yu summoned Susu and set off.
Even without this pile of bodyguards, Shi Yu could be said to have the capital to cross countries.
Transnational strength was originally a positioning for Legend-level. However, it was also very easy for Shi Yu, who had mastered various ridiculous full-level skills.
Initially, Susu had a headache being a driver, but after learning the Blue Sea Contract, it didn’t matter. Infinite energy points were capricious.
On a ship, it depended on the waves.
….
Tingxiang Ancient Nation, capital, Rogue Lance.
The peak of Ting Xiang’s power was naturally the Elven Empress. However, usually, the president of the Beast Tamer Association in Ting Xiang would handle the trivial matters of the country on her behalf.
Auland, an old granny in her sixties. The Seven Nation Alliance had given her the title “Qingtian”, meaning ‘holding up the sky’.
Her strongest battle result was defeating a giant totem with strength enough to hold up the sky. Coincidentally, her main contracted pet was also a humanoid creature, from the Giant Race. Her trump card was an invincible overlord, the Earth Giant.
That was why her title was so domineering and legendary!
At this moment, President Auland had already gathered the contestants of this year’s Courtyard World Tournament, two young legends under the age of 30, and five top-notch masters who could fight overlords.
These five people were all the contestants Tingxiang had decided to send to participate in the world competition. They could only take out these contestants because the others would also be cannon fodder if they went. These could at least obtain some benefits in the overlord battle.
Not every faction was aiming for first place. When the World Tournament began, mythical and legendary ruins were everywhere. There would also be endless opportunities.
In the previous world competitions, it wasn’t like there weren’t people who obtained huge benefits and broke through to the Legendary level at the last minute in Inatella. They even obtained legendary and Mythical resources.
In terms of results, Tingxiang had some impressive results. After all, they had already been at the bottom three consecutive years.
“In a day, the overlord team of the East Sea Dragon Palace City will arrive at Tingxiang. The battle power of the dragons in the Dragon Palace City is valiant, and their strength is even above the Dragon Empire. They are very good candidates for you to test your strength before heading to Inatella.”
“In recent years, the conflict between us and the Dragon Empire has been expanding. In the World Tournament, you will definitely be targeted by them. Our Tingxiang doesn’t have many local dragon overlords. This time, we specially invited the overlords of Dragon Palace City to communicate. You have to cherish this opportunity well.”
“Yes, President Auland.”
There were five young people, three men and two women. There was also a man of mixed blood with sharp ears. He looked like a male half-elf.
The elves were one of the few transcendent races without reproduction isolation from humans. For example, those dragons, phoenixes, and humans were actually transcendent life forms who injected the power of their bloodlines into humans and forcefully changed the formation of their bloodlines. Then, those hybrids reproduced and strengthened among the hybrids.
However, elves and humans could directly reproduce. However, the chances of reproduction were really not high. Moreover, in most cases, it was not to reproduce geniuses, but hybrids with many flaws.
Although it was easy to create flawed races if the technology was not mature, compared to directly reproducing, the cost of trial and error was much lower. It was easier to form and find a stable method.
“President Auland, you were looking for us.”
After President Auland finished instructing, the five Beast Tamers left and waited for the Dragon Palace to arrive. Soon, four beautiful elves arrived. Three of them were pure-blooded elves, and the other was a half-elf. Among them, the half-elves dominated with the elven bloodline and mastered extraordinary power. They couldn’t open up the Beast Taming Space, but they could be contracted.
Of the four elves, two were overlords. They were tall and had extraordinary auras. As for the other two, including the half-elves, they were like girls. They were slightly shorter, one monarch rank and one commander rank.
They were all members of the royal family in Tingxiang.
Their talent was very good, especially the two overlord elves.
Unfortunately, they were restricted by their race and were destined to not be able to participate in the world competition alone.
Be it the seven human countries or the totem country, they were very puzzled about why the planet’s will, the World Tree, loved humans.
Things like the Blessing of the World Tree had always been given to humans.
In the beginning, competitions like the World Tournament were only held for the seven human countries.
Even if it was opened to the totem country, only human Beast Tamers under the age of 30 were allowed to participate. If other transcendent lives wanted to participate, they could only sign a contract with humans. Be it a contract with transcendent lives, an equality contract, or a contract with humans, they had to sign a contract.
Because of this, many people even guessed that humans were doted on because they were a race created by the World Tree.
However, it was undeniable that ever since the rise of the Beast Tamer profession, be it the factions mainly made up of humans or the totem factions that squeezed humans dry as nutritional supplements, they had developed quickly. Human Beast Tamers were like a catalyst for the rapid development of Earth’s civilization.
For example, the elves and dragons originally grew slowly. If they didn’t eat a large amount of resources, it would take a long time to grow naturally. However, as long as they cooperated with human Beast Tamers and entered the Beast Taming Space, their growth speed would undergo a tremendous change. Then, they would have more time to break through the racial limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 780 Ancient Kingdom of Tingxiang (4)
chapters.content:
780 Ancient Kingdom of Tingxiang (4)
The appearance of the Beast Taming Space and Beast Taming Talents greatly increased the upper limit of the growth of transcendent lives.
“Well, I called you over also because of the Dragon Palace City exchange team.” President Auland nodded.
“Are we also participating in the exchange?” Among the four elves, the leader was a mature female elf in leather armor with a fiery figure and long red curly hair. She had a puzzled expression.
“No, but it’s also related to this matter.” President Auland looked at the four elves and said, “There will be a Beast Tamer from Dong Huang in the exchange team of Dragon Palace City this time. Your mission is for one person to obtain his recognition and contract with him.”
“What?” As soon as President Auland finished speaking, another overlord-level elf with long golden hair, a white princess dress, and sky-blue eyes said, “President Auland, you’re not kidding, right?”
“Sign a contract with Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer?” The young half-elf also widened her blood-red eyes and said in confusion.
“Why are we doing this?” The last elven girl with four pairs of transparent light wings and emerald green hair also asked in confusion.
After all, their status in Tingxiang was extraordinary. Even if it was those legend geniuses in Tingxiang who were enough to fight in the world competition, as long as they were unwilling, the other party was not qualified to enter an equal contract with them.
In terms of race level, the four of them were all high-level overlord races. Although they wouldn’t necessarily become totems, they had a high chance of charging at the totem level. As for the overlord level, the end point of other creatures would only be their starting point.
“This isn’t my intention, but Her Majesty’s.” President Auland shook his head and said.
Her words shocked the four elves opposite her.
Just like how the sons and even totems of Dragon Palace City didn’t have much chance to see the Dragon God, in Tingxiang, the Elven Empress was also a mysterious and high and mighty existence. Even in Tingxiang’s royal family, not many people could see her.
And such a high and mighty Elven Empress actually took the initiative to ask them to contract a human, a human who wasn’t from their country?
Who exactly was the other party to make the empress take him so seriously?
“Her Majesty said that this is also for your own good. She won’t force you. She only provided you with an opportunity. Whether you can grasp it depends on yourselves.” President Auland was actually very incredulous at this moment, but after all, it was said by Her Majesty herself. She didn’t have the right to speak at all.
“Grandma Auland, who is this person?” The only hybrid, the Blood Elf girl, said in a daze.
“Ye Xing? Divine Bell?”
The fiery female sprite was very knowledgeable. She directly locked onto the two most talented Beast Tamers of Dong Huang and asked.
“It should be the divine bell. It’s said that she’s a descendant of the Dong Huang Divine Source Legend.”
If it were her, it seemed to be understandable. This divine bell was extremely mysterious, and was even a legendary’s descendant. She was also a genius legend. If she stood in the common interest of Tingxiang and Dong Huang, the deep alliance between the two would be beneficial to both parties.
In addition, she had two overlords, so they definitely had to be at the Legend level to be qualified to contract them.
If it was Divine Bell, the identities of both parties were really on the same level. No, they would actually be the ones looking upwards.
After all, they weren’t directly related to the Elven Empress, and the Legend Divine Bell was a descendant of the Divine Source Legend.
“Divine Bell?” President Auland shook his head and said, “It’s not her.”
“She’s just a legendary’s descendant. It’s not worth Her Majesty’s attention. Her Majesty said that the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang she mentioned will definitely become a legendary himself in the future.”
Definitely become a legendary?!
The four elves were shocked. Was this evaluation serious?
There were less than three legendary Beast Tamers even since the founding of Tingxiang.
Who exactly was it that received such a high evaluation from the empress?
“I don’t know if you’ve heard of his name,” President Auland said. “Shi Yu, a genius archeologist of Dong Huang. It means that he has developed the mechanical phantom beast system. At the moment, he’s the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang, a level-six Beast Tamer.”
To be honest, although Shi Yu’s name had a huge impact on the machinery and archeology of the seven countries, his name was really not very familiar to this group of genius elves. After all, the most popular topic in the seven countries recently was still the World Tournament.
And the ones with the highest discussion in the World Tournament were undoubtedly the geniuses from various countries who had already reached the legend level, as well as the legends of the totem country.
For example, Ye Xing and the Divine Bell were a group of people who received a lot of attention.
As for the title of number one person below the legend level, he was in an awkward position.
Even if he was the number one person below the legend level, he wasn’t a legend after all…
As for the world competition, legends should be the threshold to compete for the championship.
As they didn’t know much about machinery and archeology, the four elves didn’t know the meaning of this name very well.
However, the name Shi Yu still shocked them very much, because President Auland said… that the other party was only a level-six Beast Tamer?
A level-six Beast Tamer…
The two overlord-level elves looked at each other. How did the empress see that the other party had legendary potential?
“Her Majesty didn’t tell me the specific reason, but Her Majesty must have her reasons for saying this. It’s worth mentioning that this Shi Yu is the leader of the Dragon Palace City exchange team this time. He also has a high status in Dragon Palace City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 781 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (5)
chapters.content:
781 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (5)
“As an honorary general of Dragon Palace City, he’s in charge of a special department and has nearly a hundred overlords under him. The training team that came this time are all Shi Yu’s subordinates in Dragon Palace City.”
If the concept just now was a little abstract, then when President Auland said this news, the four elves present were stunned for the first time. What a joke!
A level-six Beast Tamer had nearly a hundred overlords under him?
Even if it was a totem dragon king alone, it didn’t have so many overlords under it, right? This meant that he had captured all the overlords in Dragon Palace City in one go!!
How was this possible? Although the relationship between Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang was already very good, it was definitely impossible for a level-six Beast Tamer to have nearly a hundred overlord subordinates!
How could this Shi Yu have such a high status in Dragon Palace City?
“What exactly is Her Majesty doing?” At this moment, not to mention the four elves, even President Auland was rather puzzled and shocked. She didn’t understand why Her Majesty would evaluate a new generation genius of Dong Huang like this.
He would definitely become a legendary?
A ridiculous evaluation.
However, compared to the four elves, President Auland indeed knew Shi Yu’s achievements better. The mechanical phantom beast system was indeed an epoch-making invention. It even made the Shen Feng Nation buy fossils crazily. Could it be that Dong Huang and Her Majesty had reached some kind of condition? For example, the mechanical phantom beast technology? It didn’t feel like it… If that was the case, Her Majesty wouldn’t have such a high evaluation of Shi Yu.
The key was definitely Shi Yu himself.
She didn’t know now, but she should know soon. As long as the four of them came into contact with Shi Yu, they would know why this level-six Beast Tamer had a higher evaluation than a legendary’s descendant like the Divine Bell Legend in the words of the empress.
Moreover, if this person was really as extraordinary as the empress said, he would definitely become the most dazzling new star on a larger stage!
….
After driving the ship, Shi Yu and the others finally arrived at Tingxiang.
At the port of Rogue Lance.
After approaching, Shi Yu called everyone out.
Frost Dragon, Gem Cat… The Second and Third Princes and the other Dragon Palace members descended on the sea.
At this moment, the descent of a huge dragon and even many divine dragons could be said to have instantly shocked the Sea Sprite army stationed in Rogue Lance.
They almost thought that the Dragon Empire was attacking.
After all, it looked like the leader was a huge dragon.
However, immediately, the in-charge remembered that a Dragon Palace City exchange team would arrive soon.
President Auland had been waiting for a long time in Tingxiang. She stood on the port and enjoyed the sea breeze. When she saw the Dragon Palace descend, she immediately smiled.
“Welcome, distinguished guests. Please follow me,” President Auland said.
“Hello, President Auland.” As the leader, Shi Yu took the responsibility of communicating.
The frost dragon couldn’t be bothered with this. It had already shrunk to a normal size, about two to three meters tall, and was very cute.
As a totem level, it already had the ability to modify race and develop skills. The first thing most totem creatures did was to develop multiplication skills to allow their physiques to reach a suitable scale in different occasions.
At the same time, maintaining a smaller state was also beneficial to long-term activity. Otherwise, it was fine to move with a hundred-meter-long body to show off his domineering aura or fight, but if it was daily boredom and purely looking for trouble, it would be hungry very quickly. It was better to sleep.
“Sir Shi Yu.”
“And this is Sir Ice Dragon King, right?”
President Auland looked at the Ice Dragon King with the most prominent identity. She was very curious about a dragon joining Dragon Palace City because most dragons would join the Dragon Empire. However, she also knew that this was related to the fact that this ice dragon was the battle pet of the predecessors of Dong Huang.
At the same time, it was also related to Ice Dragon’s own nagging. After all, the inheritance of the Dragon Empire 2000 years ago was almost destroyed by a human Beast Tamer. The prestige of the Dragon Empire immediately decreased in the young Ice Dragon’s heart.
At that time, it didn’t resist with those dragons. In order to prevent itself from being implicated, it decisively slipped away and slipped to Dong Huang. Then, it was captured by Mu Huiyin as a cooler.
Although the life of fighting side by side with Mu Huiyin was very painful, it did change Ice Dragon a little.
“I am. You’re President Auland from Tingxiang, right?” Ice Dragon saw that the other party was talking to it and replied, “I hope this exchange can go smoothly.”
Titled legends also had classifications. For example, President Auland was considered a normal Titled Legend. She could fight against totems and even defeat weaker totems.
As for Mu Huiyin, she was a relatively strong Titled Legend. During the totem battle, the totems they faced were basically top-notch totems. At that time, it was very difficult for ordinary totems to survive. They were directly killed by Emperor Shi as the first batch of targets. As for Mu Huiyin, although she couldn’t defeat top-notch totems, she could still resist for a long time and not fall behind. As expected of the number one general under Emperor Shi.
In Ice Dragon’s opinion, that Tyrannical Sea Legend wasn’t bad either. His full strength wouldn’t be much weaker than Mu Huiyin, and the current President Lin Xiaolin of Dong Huang might be even more terrifying. Ice Dragon had never seen this guy send his pet, but this guy shook a bunch of totem-level Lin Feng’s second team with a shake. This was already almost a f*cking legendary Beast Tamer.

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 782 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (6)
chapters.content:
782 Tingxiang Ancient Nation (6)
As for this Auland, she was clearly inferior, so Ice Dragon was also very unyielding.
Therefore, it made sense for Tingxiang to be the weakest country among the seven countries.
Not only was the strength not strong, but they were also in a hostile relationship with two demigod factions. The situation could be said to be very tense.
“Of course.” President Auland smiled and said, “But there’s no hurry for the exchange. We’ve already prepared a lunch banquet to welcome everyone. You’ve been tired all the way, so why don’t you rest for a day?”
!!
“Roar ~!”
The dragons nodded. That was good. Then let’s see if the food in Tingxiang was better than what that white radish provided.
Ignoring everything else, the fruit created by that ginseng baby was really top-notch.
They just didn’t know how Baby Ginseng itself would taste…
Apart from the people from the Dragon Palace, there was also a group of Beast Tamers and elves that President Auland had called over previously. Of course, just these few people were not lively enough. In order to show enough etiquette, most of the legend Beast Tamers, overlord-level lives, and even members of the royal family in Tingxiang’s capital had come.
The huge exchange square could be said to be extraordinarily lively.
However, although there were many people, the most important thing was still the geniuses from Dragon Palace and Tingxiang. They were the main targets of communication in the next few days.
“It’s actually Shi Yu!”
“The leader of Dragon Palace City is actually him?”
“Who’s Shi Yu…?”
“You don’t even know Shi Yu?!”
“Machinery phantom beast, mechanical phantom beast! Moreover, he’s the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang! But it’s still strange. Why does he have such a deep relationship with Dragon Palace City, and as one of the leaders Dragon Palace…”
The Mechanics and archeologists who were familiar with Shi Yu were shocked.
In the exchange square, Shi Yu was chatting happily with President Auland with a smile. He felt that coming out of Dragon Palace City was much better.
If he went out with the Dong Huang exchange team, he was just a junior. He would lower his head when he saw legends, but if he came out with Dragon Palace City, the president of the Tingxiang Association, one of the seven major countries, the Titled Legend, would directly contact him!!
This was the minister of the Environmental Protection Department!
“It’s better to start the exchange as soon as possible. It’s best if the exchange starts tomorrow.” At this moment, Shi Yu had already started to confirm the date of the exchange with President Auland.
Although Shi Yu was not in a hurry to return, it was naturally better to end this kind of business as soon as possible. Only then would he have the energy to busy himself with private matters.
“No problem.” At this moment, when President Auland saw Shi Yu in person, she still couldn’t tell how extraordinary Shi Yu was.
It looked like she could only leave it to the four elves to discover.
What President Auland didn’t know was that Shi Yu was even more anxious than her. At this moment, seeing so many beautiful elves in the exchange square in Tingxiang, he couldn’t wait to use his method to screen them.
Although the Elven Empress said that she wanted to introduce him, it was still more convenient for him to find it himself.
In any case, everything that could be introduced was probably already here.
He had already sensed that many gazes were observing him.
As for Shi Yu’s method of finding a contracted target, it was also very simple.
Skill index scan.
At the moment, with max-level Psychic power and strong perception and his entire body was covered in gazes. He scanned very quickly.
Firstly, those without the overlord’s will were all passed.
He was just that willful.
It didn’t matter if the talent was good or bad, whether it came from a noble background, or if it was beautiful. He didn’t care if it delayed the process of adding points.
He wanted to be an emotionless points adding machine.
However.
Shi Yu’s scan results were not rich.
He even sensed two overlord-level beautiful young elves. They were powerful, but their will levels were intermediate and low. They were boring.
As for the other low-level sprites, although they also looked extraordinary with extraordinary spirituality and were naturally agile, their willpower levels were not high.
“By the way, President Auland, I have a friend. Can my friend also join this exchange? Speaking of which, she has a huge relationship with Tingxiang… She also contracted a sprite, but it’s a sprite that turned into an undead. Moreover, she was discovered in the natural ruins of Dong Huang.” At this moment, Shi Yu had already started to promote Lu Qingyi to President Auland.
After all, this time, Tingxiang had prepared a considerable reward for every Dragon Palace overlord as a sparring partner.
Although Senior Lu might not necessarily like it.
However, Senior Lu definitely needed the cultivation information of the elves, and that little elf had always wanted to figure out her identity.
Unfortunately, after Senior Lu arrived, Shi Yu had never seen the Elven Empress. Otherwise, he would have directly asked her in person. It couldn’t be helped, he was thick-skinned.
“Elven undead?” President Auland was rather surprised.
She looked at Shi Yu, but he was no longer looking at her. Instead, he was looking into the distance.
President Auland also looked over.
There was a young royal elf from Tingxiang, about eleven or twelve years old. It was sitting silently at the side, alone.
Although she was from the royal family of Tingxiang, President Auland had an impression of this elf. She wasn’t an elf with especially good talent potential, but an elf with a huge talent flaw. Even she didn’t invite her to come into contact with Shi Yu.
Because it was impossible for Shi Yu to contract her.
This elven girl’s mother was a hybrid, and her father was a hybrid, but she was a pure-blooded elf. She didn’t inherit any human bloodline, but at the same time, as a pure elf, she actually didn’t have any transcendent power and couldn’t awaken any skills. Apart from her normal elven physique, which was a little stronger than humans, everything else was simply too ordinary.
What was even more pitiful was that not long after she was born, her parents died in an accident. She became an orphan before she could learn to speak. Although she was taken care of, she could still be said to be a little transparent in the royal family in Tingxiang.
In cruel words, it was a “failed product” of mixed blood reproduction.
Of course, being born into the royal family, even if she didn’t have talent, the growth conditions were still alright.
Why was Shi Yu paying attention to her?
At this moment, Shi Yu was also very surprised because he saw that ever since he transmigrated, this was the only target where no skills of the skill index could be taught to her.
Recently, in order to let Eleven create a full-level deterrence memory water drop for a team of other pets to learn, he had temporarily recorded the deterrence skill in the index and had yet to delete it. At this moment, the situation was that this little elven girl couldn’t even learn the popular skill deterrence, indicating that it couldn’t be taught.
This situation had never happened before. Until now, any transcendent life form Shi Yu had seen could learn deterrence!
It was the same for the other elves present. They could learn it, but not her.
Apart from that, the super skills recorded by Shi Yu could be said to cover various attributes. There were more or less a few sprites present who could learn them. The compatibility was enough, but it was the same. Only this one showed that all skills couldn’t be taught.
But that wasn’t absolute.
This guy had a skill that she could learn.
Mythical revival.
This skill that could only be learned with the power of a god in her body was the only skill she could learn.
Ridiculous.
Was this the reincarnation of a Mythical creature?
Shi Yu should have been very happy to encounter this situation.
This was much rarer than encountering an overlord’s will.
However, what made Shi Yu very uncomfortable was that the success rate of the Mythical Revival teaching displayed in the skill index was extremely low.
This guy’s will level was the lowest… It was two levels lower than the gem cat. Just like a Green Silkworm by the roadside, it was also very ridiculous.

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 783 Qi (1)
chapters.content:
783 Qi (1)
“Sorry.”
As the newly discovered elven girl was too special, Shi Yu inevitably paid more attention and forgot that he was talking to President Auland. It was a little rude.
“Yes, I wonder how my friend’s contracted elven undead reincarnated itself.”
“As the reincarnation is incomplete, it also lost some memories.”
!!
“In addition, it’s also very strange for it to appear in Dong Huang. Therefore, we’re wondering if that sprite passed by from Tingxiang. We came this time also to return to her hometown and see if we can recover any memories.”
“Is that so? Of course.” President Auland nodded and said, “Perhaps it’s an elf who escaped to the east during the internal strife of the elves. However, if it can reincarnate, its identity must have been very noble when it was alive. It’s worth exploring.”
“Tingxiang will do its best to help your friend.”
“Thank you very much.” Shi Yu nodded with a smile.
“By the way.” Shi Yu looked back at the elven girl and asked, “Is that little girl also a member of the royal family in Tingxiang?”
“Yeah, her name is ‘Qi’, and she’s also a member of the elven royal family. Dr. Shi Yu, what’s wrong?” President Auland asked.
She had also noticed it just now. Shi Yu had taken a few looks at Qi.
“It’s nothing. I’m just curious. Because in my perception, she seems to be the only elf present who hasn’t mastered transcendent power.” Shi Yu turned around.
“Well… Her parents are both mixed-blood elves, so her body isn’t suitable for growth. Perhaps she won’t be able to reach the transcendent level in this lifetime,” President Auland said regretfully.
“I see. That’s a pity.” Shi Yu nodded and stopped talking about this ‘prayer’ in detail.
The higher-ups of Tingxiang seemed to think that this elven girl’s body had flaws because of her mixed blood…
Although it did make sense, Shi Yu could tell through the skill index that she should have some powerful “God’s Laws” contained in her body.
It should be that this power of laws suppressed other extraordinary powers, causing her to be unable to master other extraordinary powers.
Didn’t the people in Tingxiang notice?
That made sense. It would be strange if they could discover it. Even Ling was only discovered after it really awakened a quasi-divine skill and caused a huge commotion.
And it seemed that no one could help this elven girl unearth her hidden power.
“There’s no other way.”
Shi Yu was at his wit’s end. The other party’s will was too low. Direct teaching definitely wouldn’t work.
It wasn’t enough to rely on the skill teaching manual brought by the skill index either, because there were too many materials in the teaching method of Mythical Revival that Shi Yu didn’t know, such as what the hell the Miracle Stone was.
However, through the memory water drop, there was a slight chance. However, it wasn’t big. Her ability level was too low. The absorption efficiency of the memory water drop depended on talent and foundation. If these were too poor, she couldn’t learn them.
It was equivalent to giving a seven-year-old child some experience as a soldier or king. It was impossible for him to really control a sniper rifle and fly a plane.
For example, the transcendent-level duck had to learn for nearly half a year to completely master the power of the cleansing water drop.
This was only an intermediate skill. In addition, it had the will of an overlord and even broke through to commander rank during this period. It had also taken so long.
As for himself, he had a monarch-level physique, monarch-level spirit, and overlord-level soul. He had also learned low-level Psychic power with the memory water drop for nearly a month.
For an Awakening-level elven girl, wanting her to learn the most difficult super skill, Mythical Revival, through the memory water drop might also be as painful as adding some super skills.
Although Shi Yu was curious, he was not in a hurry to talk. He would be in Tingxiang for the next few days, so there was no hurry.
….
At the banquet, the Dragon Palace and the people in the courtyard communicated very happily.
In fact, the so-called exchange was just bragging and exchanging information.
The Beast Tamers and overlords of Tingxiang didn’t know much about the ocean.
As for the overlords of Dragon Palace City, they weren’t very proficient in the information on the ground.
Everyone told each other some strange things they knew and quickly chatted.
For example, a big-bellied dwarf was holding a large bottle of beer and saying to the little white dragon with a smile, “Your Highness, you might not believe me, but I’ve seen the heir of the Dragon Empire. Compared to you, it’s simply worlds beneath!”
“Burp.” The little white dragon also drank wine with an intoxicated expression. “What’s there to not believe?”
“…” The Sky Penetrating Whale and the Second Prince’s Primordial Thunder Dragon were speechless.
The Black Flood Dragon overlord spoke. “Oh? You’re fifth in Tingxiang? Not bad. Speaking of which, my son is currently cultivating with the ninth in the Dong Huang Sequence. We can communicate tomorrow.”
The Black Flood Dragon overlord said to a young man of Tingxiang.
This kind of thing happened in various places. The overlords of Dragon Palace City were indeed very attractive, especially the Frost Dragon King totem. It even attracted many Beast Tamers from Tingxiang. They looked at the Frost Dragon King respectfully.
The frost dragon said, “Hmph, even dogs don’t go to the Dragon Empire. You don’t know the bad reputation of the Dragon Empire in the past 2000 years. Burning, killing, and looting are simply all evil. It’s also within expectations that they were almost destroyed. After all, that Dragon Hunter is pretty strong. I’ve fought with the legendary Dragon Hunter before he became a legendary. He’s very strong. Although he’s not my match in a one-on-one battle, I’m indeed a little pressured when he sent all his pets.”
“Unfortunately, after he grew up, I had already come to Dong Huang to travel as an overlord. I was even invited by Emperor Shi to create a great undertaking together and was conferred the title of the guardian dragon of Dong Huang. I wasn’t in the mood to return.”

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 784 Qi (2)
chapters.content:
784 Qi (2)
Impressive!!!
One by one, the Beast Tamers of Tingxiang widened their eyes and looked at the Ice Dragon King. They suddenly understood that the Ice Dragon King was the most impressive existence in the team this time.
It had actually lived for so long and fought with the young Dragon Hunter.
It was even invited by the first legendary emperor of Dong Huang, Emperor Shi, to become the guardian dragon of Dong Huang.
“Impressive.” The Void Mantis was shocked. A senior was indeed a senior.
“…” Gem Cat.
The gem cat was willing to call this exchange meeting a bragging meeting. However, it kept a low profile, so there was no need to talk about its powerful battle results.
In fact, no one noticed that the cat that followed Dragon Palace City to Tingxiang was also a totem.
It ate silently.
Of course, the one who received the most attention at this moment was still Shi Yu. For example, the four elf geniuses that President Auland had brought later had been paying attention to Shi Yu.
There were also archeologists, Mechanics, and mechanical dwarves in Tingxiang who couldn’t wait to communicate with Shi Yu.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu had been talking to President Auland, so they didn’t have a chance.
Even after the lunch banquet ended, they didn’t find an opportunity because President Auland wanted to talk to Shi Yu too much.
First was the contracting of the sprite.
“Her Majesty did tell me,” Shi Yu said.
“Then how about I introduce a few elves to you now?” President Auland smiled and planned to lead the way.
“There’s no hurry. Let’s wait until the lunch banquet ends. I’m more concerned about the ruins now,” Shi Yu said.
The Elven Empress had said that he could crack the Tingxiang Ruins as he pleased. If he successfully cracked it, everyone would split it 50-50. She wouldn’t treat him badly.
Shi Yu decided that it was best to crack a legendary resource before leaving. It was not a wasted trip.
“Ruins?” President Auland nodded. The empress seemed to have also mentioned the ruins and said that Shi Yu could easily crack the unsolved ruins in Tingxiang.
However… although Shi Yu was a genius archeologist of Dong Huang, could he really crack the ruins of Tingxiang?
After all, weren’t archeologists who listened to history more likely to crack the ruins they were more familiar with?
Wasn’t it a little difficult to crack across cultures?
“There are indeed many unsolved ruins in Tingxiang.”
“From Mythical Ruins to ordinary ruins…” President Auland said.
Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t touch the Mythical Ruins in the short term.
Shi Yu still had some limits.
He knew that the most dangerous place was the Mythical Ruins. Even if there were treasures inside, he couldn’t afford to take them for the time being.
For example, regarding the guardian beast, the legendary ruins might only seal totems, while the Mythical ruins might have real Mythical creatures sleeping…
Even legendaries like Emperor Shi and Lin Feng were said to be powerless in the face of Mythical Ruins.
Therefore, ruins mystic realms below the legendary level were Shi Yu’s first choice.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t forget the main mission of this trip. It was to continue searching for the Space Emperor Ruins and hatch the pet egg.
Next, after understanding a few legendary ruins from President Auland, Shi Yu was satisfied. These unsolved legendary ruins involved humans, elves, dwarves, giants, dragons… There were all kinds.
Shi Yu decided to take the time to take a look at them one by one.
….
After the banquet ended.
Shi Yu and the others were arranged to rest in the nearby huge palace.
Although tomorrow was the exchange battle between the Dragon Palace and the young geniuses of Tingxiang, the other exchanges had already started after the lunch banquet.
First was Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi.
President Auland said that she would get two elven geniuses to visit Shi Yu in the afternoon.
One of the two had extraordinary battle power, while the other was knowledgeable. The latter should be able to help the companion Shi Yu mentioned.
Tingxiang Imperial Palace.
The four elven geniuses that President Auland had brought back then were already prepared. At the exchange banquet, although they couldn’t communicate with Shi Yu, through their interaction with the legend Mechanics and archeologists in Tingxiang, they already knew that Shi Yu’s achievements were extraordinary!
Mechanical phantom beast system!
This was an epoch-making invention. If Tingxiang could obtain it, the overall strength of Tingxiang might be able to catch up to the four countries a hundred years later.
This was a major research result that could increase the strength of an entire country and ensure the foundation of a country.
The Mechanics in Tingxiang could be said to be extremely shocked that such a genius Mechanic could come to Tingxiang, but President Auland didn’t give them a chance to come into contact at all. This was also the most uncomfortable thing.
Of course, they also understood that even if they came into contact with him, they definitely wouldn’t be able to obtain the mechanical phantom beast technology.
Talent could indeed give a Beast Tamer additional points. After hearing their own people praise Shi Yu, these elves thought much higher of Shi Yu, especially the two overlord-level elves. They felt that it didn’t matter if the Beast Tamer was weak, but he mainly had to be talented.
Moreover, Shi Yu wasn’t weak either. As the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, they had seen Dong Huang’s promotion and the battle record of assassinating an overlord.
This afternoon, President Auland planned to let the two overlord-level elves, the Fire Elf Annie and the Light Elf Lil, come into contact with Shi Yu first. However, the Blood Elf Loy and the Forest Elf Hillia also wanted to join in the fun. They hoped that their two sisters would bring them along.
Annie and Lil didn’t refuse. When the four of them were ready, they went to the temporary address of Dragon Palace City to visit Shi Yu.
However, just as they passed by the royal training ground, they stopped slightly and looked over.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 785 Qi (3)
chapters.content:
785 Qi (3)
It was a sprite about eleven or twelve years old. She was not tall and had light pink long hair. She was wearing a white dress and holding a bow with a green bowstring and a silver bow arm. She was practicing archery.
Their gazes stopped on this sister for a moment. They were naturally not unfamiliar with this “Qi” situation.
The other party didn’t have any transcendent power, but this “Qi” didn’t give up. At least, she still had the physique of the elves’ natural energy.
This allowed her to control some energy equipment like a fish in water.
!!
With the help of this level-two equipment weapon, “Wind Bow”, although she didn’t have transcendent power, she could rely on it to have a certain amount of battle power, probably comparable to transcendent creatures.
Every time the Wind Bow was pulled, it could mobilize a weak wind power to form a Wind Arrow.
In Qi’s opinion, since she didn’t have transcendent power, as long as she could use various transcendent equipment and weapons proficiently, she could still have battle power and not be underestimated.
In the last totem battle, didn’t the humans rely on various powerful mechanical equipment and weapons to win?
In Tingxiang, dwarves were natural weaponsmiths. Their greatest interest was to collect various equipment and weapons to enrich their strength.
However, equipment and weapons were external forces after all… “Qi” was still limited in the recognition of the various royal teachers. In addition, because she couldn’t grow successfully through transcendent power, its lifespan might also be much lower than that of ordinary elves.
“Hello, Qi.”
Qi, who was practicing shooting, quickly turned around and saw a girl with blood-red hair calling him.
“Sister Luo Yi.”
“Sister Annie, Sister Lil, Sister Hillia…”
Seeing the four people gathered together, Qi was nervous.
After all, these four were the most talented elves of this generation.
Although there was a trace of stubbornness in her heart, Qi was still a little weak in personality. She didn’t have much confidence when facing other more talented royal elves.
“Qi, do you want to go and play together?” Luo Yi called out to him.
“No, thank you, I still have to practice shooting,” Qi said.
“You can train another day. We’re going to Dragon Palace City.”
“I better not go.”
“Luo Yi.” Annie glanced at Luo Yi and told her not to force it. Since Qi was willing to practice archery, let her continue practicing.
“Alright.” Luo Yi pouted.
….
At Shi Yu’s residence.
Shi Yu had been reading the ancient books of Tingxiang for a long time.
He had asked the maid in charge of taking care of them to get it from the royal library.
Such a book that recorded the ancient history of Tingxiang couldn’t be seen in Dong Huang.
It was very helpful for him to explore the ruins of Tingxiang next.
At the same time, Shi Yu was also waiting for the elven geniuses President Auland mentioned to come.
“Sir Shi Yu, Annie, Lil, Luo Yi, Lady Hillia are visiting…”
The voice of the maid sent by Tingxiang to be in charge of their itinerary came from outside the door, making Shi Yu look up.
“Let them in.”
“No, I’ll go out and welcome them,” Shi Yu said.
Soon, he went out directly. After thanking the maid beside him, he walked out of the door and saw the four elven geniuses outside.
At the same time, he understood. It was indeed these four. At the banquet, he had already made a judgment. Tingxiang would most likely recommend these four to him.
Overall, they were younger and had stronger potential and talent. They belonged to the type of people that legends and even titled legends would be very tempted to see.
“Sir Shi Yu, sorry to disturb you.” At this moment, they finally saw Shi Yu with their own eyes. The two younger sprites were a little excited, wanting to see what was special about Shi Yu. As for the two older overlord-level sprites, they were relatively calm.
“You’re not interrupting. Welcome, everyone.” Shi Yu’s expression was calm, and he was very nervous.
Could they really be contracted?
The elves were different from elemental elves.
They were completely made of flesh and blood.
Apart from some elf characteristics, they looked no different from a human.
It was even more humanoid than dragon girls and mermaids.
“Everyone, please come in first,” Shi Yu invited.
A moment later, everyone sat together. The golden-haired Light Elf, Lil, was the first to ask, “Sir Shi Yu, I heard from President Auland that you have an elven friend from Tingxiang who wants to explore the mystery of her identity, right?”
“Perhaps I can help.” As a royal librarian, Lil was still very confident in her knowledge reserves.
“Yes, thank you, but my friend might only arrive later,” Shi Yu said.
“Why don’t we talk about something else first?” Shi Yu smiled. There were a few things about the ruins that he wanted to understand more…
However, just as Shi Yu finished speaking, the Fire Sprite, Annie, said, “Sir Shi Yu, I heard that you’re the number one person below the legend level of Dong Huang and have even defeated an overlord. I’m very interested in Dong Huang’s pets. How about we spar a little?”
As soon as Annie finished speaking, the hearts of the other three elven geniuses skipped a beat.
They knew that Big Sister Annie’s personality was straightforward and that there would be problems.
What kind of person wanted to fight right from the start?
Heartbreak.
Annie was also too curious. This was because the Elven Empress’ evaluation of Shi Yu said that he would definitely become a legendary. Even if Shi Yu was only at level six at the moment, there should be something very special about him. She couldn’t wait to see it.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 786 Qi (4)
chapters.content:
786 Qi (4)
She wanted to see the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang that the Elven Empress mentioned had an extremely high evaluation. What was so powerful about him that he was stronger than the two legend geniuses she knew?
With legendary aptitude, defeating an overlord-level genius like her at level six shouldn’t be a problem, right?
“Uh.” Shi Yu was slightly stunned, but he didn’t mind. “Sure, I suppose.”
“However, I’m very strong.” He smiled at the other party.
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 50,110,000
This number was very good for the elves.
The elves weren’t a race with high energy values. They were more experienced in mobilizing the power of nature. Although the energy data wasn’t high, the skills used after mobilizing the power of nature were ridiculously powerful.
After Shi Yu nodded, Annie smiled brightly. Shi Yu was not coy. It was alright.
“I have a high-level ruins space that can withstand battles on the scale of overlords. We can go there to fight,” Annies seemed to be prepared and said.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, the other three elves looked at each other and had a headache. They didn’t know what the outcome would be…
….
After Annie took out the high-level ruins equipment, Shi Yu and the others entered on the spot and arrived at another alternate space.
This place was like a training ground, but the surrounding fire elements were rich, and the ground and sky were red. Annie said, “This is the training ruins of the royal archer team I’m in charge of.”
“Sir Shi Yu, the rules are very simple. There are no rules.”
It meant that it was up to Shi Yu to send a few pets. She was at the overlord level, and Shi Yu had yet to reach the legend level. Overall, it looked like she was taking advantage of him. However, Shi Yu was also a top-notch Beast Tamer and had the strength to fight against the overlord level. If it was an irregular battle, she didn’t take too much advantage.
“Sister Annie’ home ground…” The Blood Elf girl and the Wood Elf girl discussed softly.
They felt that this Sir Shi Yu might be a little in danger. After all, here, Annie could mobilize very strong fire elemental power.
At this moment, Annie was already standing on one side of the red ground, while Shi Yu was on the other.
“Then, let’s start as soon as possible,” said Annie.
Shi Yu also nodded. He wanted to end the battle quickly. After all, Senior should be coming over later.
Therefore, Shi Yu thought for a moment and directly summoned Eleven.
Under the light of the purple level-six summoning array, a one-meter-tall panda cub appeared in front of Shi Yu. It shook its hair and opened its blue eyes.
“Wuu?” Eleven looked at the surrounding environment and then at the tall and fiery Flame Elf opposite it. It understood who its opponent was!
Fire element?
Eleven showed a fearless expression.
It was least afraid of thunder and fire.
The former could be absorbed.
As for the latter… Its tempered skill wasn’t just there for show! Its physique, which was trained with Chi Tong’s Sun Flame every day, was not for show!
If there was a Thunder Resistance and Fire Resistance skill, Eleven should have advanced into the Dao at the moment.
After all, in order to train tempered steel, it often trained its body in the Sun Flame Domain created by Chi Tong after it ate a time fruit and went into full overlord strength.
“What a strong energy wave!” As soon as Eleven appeared, battle intent erupted. As for Annie, she was slightly shocked to see Eleven, who was like a cub. As the owner of the ruins, she was relatively clear about Eleven’s energy state.
This guy should still be at the monarch level, but its energy level definitely exceeded 10 million!! Moreover, it didn’t just exceed a little.
Scary.
This was the first time she had seen a monarch with such a ridiculous energy level.
Her perception was right. Eleven’s current energy level had already exceeded 15 million. A pile of racial super skills was only a step away from perfection. Apart from that, it also had three perfect non-racial super skills.
After all, ordinary overlords only had one perfect super skill.
In addition to the overlord’s will…
It could only be said that if it fought that Mountain Tortoise again, even without the support of the ginseng baby, Eleven wouldn’t be as miserable as a few months ago, where it couldn’t break through its defense after fighting for a long time.
At the moment, Eleven’s strongest combination skill, the Yin Yang Jade that used superalloy to fuse the White Thunder Metal and Dark Thunder Metal… Even Chi Tong and Buggy, who had overlord undead and physical puppets, were unwilling to deal with it. After all, this was already the ultimate profundity formed by super skills. It would crush overlords.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 787 They’re Too Normal (1)
chapters.content:
787 They’re Too Normal (1)
After Eleven appeared, the gazes of the four elves present gathered on it.
“What race is that?” Blood Elf Luo Yi asked.
The other three elves were also transcendent life forms. Because of their physiques that were affinity with nature, they could also clearly sense the terrifying energy hidden in Eleven’s body better than humans.
Although it wasn’t big, seeing Eleven’s eyes was like seeing endless lightning explode in front of them. It was extremely shocking.
“Iron-eating Beast, metal-element… I investigated yesterday. This should be Sir Shi Yu’s initial pet, his trump card battle pet. It has already evolved. Look at its eyes, ordinary Iron-eating Beasts are black, but its is like blue lightning,” Lil said.
“Although it’s still at the monarch level, the quality of this energy is ridiculously high…”
Metal element!
The pet fire sprite facing fire actually sent out a metal-element pet!
However, after all, this was Shi Yu’s trump card. The elves could understand.
Shi Yu probably had to continue summoning other pets.
However…
“Aren’t you going to summon other pets?” At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu didn’t summon other pets after summoning the Iron-eating Beast, Annie frowned and asked.
Shi Yu shook his head.
“No, let’s do this first,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu was still very clear about the strength of every pet.
At the moment, it was a little bit pressuring to fight a top-notch overlord, but it should be relatively easy for Eleven to fight an ordinary overlord.
Shi Yu’s words instantly made Annie fall silent. She knew that she had been underestimated by Shi Yu.
“Although your strength is not bad, are you underestimating me?”
Her emotions instantly surged. She raised her long white arm. Then, a fire bow made of elements appeared in front of her. She held it and aimed at Eleven.
“If you underestimate your opponent, you will pay the price.”
As soon as she finished speaking, with a hum, a soaring flame had already gathered. With a cry, a bow wave that was like a flaming Undying Bird shot out from Annie and attacked Eleven!!
“Jiu!!!”
The Undying Bird’s Arrow swept up endless flames and triggered a small portion of the natural energy in this ruin. As a test skill, Annie didn’t use her full strength, but it should be more than enough to instantly kill those below the overlord level.
This move was indeed strong. As it flew, it seemed to have roasted space until it was blurry.
If it landed in the outside world, it could probably trigger a huge fire that lasted for months.
Boom ~ Boom ~ Boom ~ Boom ~
Accompanied by the roar of flames and the explosion of heat waves, this huge attack descended with a bang. In an instant, the Undying Bird Arrow swallowed Eleven, as if it was wrapped in endless purgatory.
“Tank it.”
Shi Yu’s expression was calm.
On the other side of the arena, Annie’s expression suddenly changed.
An even more dazzling light flickered on the Undying Bird Arrow that swallowed Eleven.
Right on the heels of that, this light became stronger and stronger. The sea of fire kept deforming and exploding amidst the bangs. Then, it instantly turned into countless tiny fire snakes that flew in all directions.
In the center of the light, a battle beast about three meters tall in black and silver armor was still looking at its opponent with a domineering gaze despite its injuries!
Boom!
Deterrence erupted, and the scattered fire snakes were instantly annihilated.
The terrifying deterrence was like an Asura aura, instantly enveloping the entire venue, making the overlord, Annie, turn pale with fright. She felt that the surrounding natural energy was suppressed by the deterrence.
What was this!!
The other three elves also couldn’t understand. How was this possible? A monarch had forcefully withstood the attack of an overlord. From the looks of it… it only looked like a light injury? No, for pets, it would be as if its coat were stained with dust?
“Eleven,” Shi Yu said. Eleven, who was in the deterrence aura, moved without any effect.
Of course, the opponent couldn’t understand. Although the energy value they could sense from Eleven looked like it was only at the monarch level, in fact, its physique had long reached the overlord level after continuous strengthening!
This was very difficult for the elves to sense!
Eleven had never given up training after reaching the limit. Its level was no longer as simple as transcendent.
In addition to its extremely high physique foundation and the two legendary body-forging resources, Aurora Magnetic Gold, its physique defense reach an unbelievable level.
Of course, the most important thing was that after the Undying Golden Body reached perfect proficiency, the Undying Golden Body had already turned into a passive state. Similarly, it had undergone an epic strengthening of the physique. As long as the opponent couldn’t instantly kill Eleven, 50% of the damage would be converted into vitality to repair the damage Eleven suffered.
A series of body tempering skills and resources combined with extremely high basic physique talent created a monster that could withstand overlord-level moves without any problems at the monarch level.
Unless it was a top-notch overlord battle power, Eleven could fight as it pleased now.
“Roar!!!” Shi Yu gave the order, and Eleven also launched a counterattack. After a few months of cultivation, it wasn’t just defensive methods that had been strengthened.
< Name > Superalloy
< Introduction > It can synthesize the power of different metals and complete super evolution. The success rate of evolution depends on skill proficiency, metal compatibility, and one’s endurance of new alloys.
Although superalloy was an evolution skill, no matter what skill it was, as long as the proficiency was high enough, it could give birth to enough usage methods.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 788 They’re Too Normal (2)
chapters.content:
788 They’re Too Normal (2)
Just like mutants, not only could they mutate and evolve, but they could also absorb the power of mutation to store it. Just like Infinite Devour, not only could they evolve, but they could also be used as spatial equipment.
It was actually the same for superalloy.
This was a skill that could synthesize the power of different metals. It could better form a combination skill, and it didn’t necessarily have to be used to evolve. At this moment, Eleven raised its arm high, and a large amount of hardening substance flowed in its palm.
At the same time, the energy eruption on his body was first to erupt its energy level to more than 50 million through Inner Power, at the overlord level.
The normal state had 15 million energy points. With the help of the Inner Power that was close to perfect proficiency, it wasn’t difficult to erupt to more than 50 million. Even if the side effects were huge, due to the powerful physique and the transformation of the Undying Golden Body, this move was already better for Eleven than the Time Fruit.
In this state, some of the hardening substances it mobilized were wrapped in white lightning, while others were wrapped in white spatial fluctuations.
Eleven was fusing the spatial power into the metal substance through the skill of the Lightning Rod.
Then, through the superalloy, they super-fused into one.
Rip. Rip.
Crack, crack, crack.
A white metal arrow with lightning lingering around it was grabbed by Eleven and thrown at the opponent. The skill power was even more terrifying than the Undying Bird Arrow just now, shocking Annie. She couldn’t believe that this was a monarch level.
Although Annie was at the overlord level, she only had one super skill. Its proficiency had reached the perfect level. The rest were only at the normal expert level, including the Undying Bird just now.
As for Eleven’s combination skill, it was a super combination skill fused by two perfect super skills, and it had three super skills that were close to perfect level, with a total of five super skills.
This proficiency was a skill compatibility that other overlords didn’t have. Shi Yu had specially combined it through the skill index.
Even with the level difference, its power was enough to make ordinary overlords feel a huge threat.
“This move…”
As the arrow surrounded by white lightning attacked, Annie’s mind tensed up. She directly went all out and used her strongest combination skill to block!
Among the elves in Tingxiang, skills actually had another name, ‘magic’.
As for Annie, as a royal archer who fought with the Dragon Empire all year round, the magic combination profundities she cultivated had even been given extremely high honors. Dragon Hunting Magic!
The so-called dragons had extremely strong elemental resistance. If one wanted to resist them, the power of the skills definitely had to be strong enough.
This was a killer move to deal with a dragon, but at this moment, Annie felt that if she didn’t use it, her opponent’s attack would instantly make her lose the ability to resist.
“Dragon Hunting Magic, Green Flame, Divine Loss!”
Boom!
Unlike the red flames just now, this time, it was completely materialized by the green flames. The huge human-shaped armor that was several meters tall wrapped around Annie.
She was inside the huge fire giant spirit and made an archery posture. The giant spirit formed by the green flames also maintained 100% synchronization and made an archery posture.
Seeing this, Blood Elf Luo Yi and Forest Elf Hillia swallowed their saliva. They didn’t expect Big Sister Annie to even use this move.
This was a combination magic used to hunt dragons.
How much pressure did that Iron-eating Beast give Big Sister!
Boom!
Soon, they knew.
In the next moment, an incomparably huge green flame arrow shot out and collided with the lightning arrow thrown by Eleven near Annie!!
Boom!!!
The two incomparably terrifying moves collided, instantly causing cracks to appear in the surrounding space. Under the interweaving of the green and white light, endless aftershocks shot out, instantly causing cracks to appear in the green flame armor wrapped around Annie and starting to collapse.
At the same time, a violent wave swept towards Eleven. After the attack, the two moves were actually evenly matched, making the other three elven geniuses unable to understand.
After all, even an overlord-level dragon had to take this move seriously, but it could only barely block this monarch-level Iron-eating Beast’s move?
“Chase after victory,” Shi Yu said.
Although Eleven’s current energy level was not inferior to the other party after erupting and the composition of the combination skill was more luxurious, the opponent was an elf.
The physique and energy value of the elves were not their forte. The use of natural power was their racial talent.
In addition, this was the other party’s home ground. After this Green Flame Divine Arrow absorbed and gathered countless natural energy, it instantly offset the luxurious combination skill Eleven used. However, although the skill offset it, the impact of the powerful aftermath on both parties was different.
The aftermath of the explosion instantly disintegrated the Green Flame Giant Spirit’s entire body, making Annie inside feel a little uncomfortable. However, in the face of the aftermath that was also enough to injure an overlord, Eleven’s entire body shot out lightning and directly endured it.
One word described it. ‘Reckless’.
It was just an injury.
The difference in physique made both parties have different movements when facing the backlash of the skill.
Annie quickly used the “Flame of Regeneration” to repair her armor and injuries, while Eleven ignored it and directly resisted the aftermath to enter the brutal White Thunder Armor state. At the speed of light, it approached Annie.
White lightning was light. It was stronger and faster than ordinary lightning. Its ability to cleanse darkness was more efficient.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 789 They’re Too Normal (3)
chapters.content:
789 They’re Too Normal (3)
“So fast…”
A light flashed. When a warrior approached the archer, the outcome was obvious. Seeing the violent beast covered in injuries in front of it arrive in front of it at an unbelievable speed, the pupils of Annie, who was inside the giant spirit, constricted. Then, she felt an incomparable impact.
Zizizizizizi!!!
A high-intensity white electric current filled Eleven’s palm, forming a chaotic and violent electric current.
!!
The voice was like the cry of a thousand birds.
Intermediate-level skill, Thunder Palm!
However, the lightning used was the perfect super skill, White Thunder.
Under the illumination of the lightning, Eleven’s entire body was still in the holy light. Its palm gently pressed on the stomach of the giant spirit. In the next moment, the entire giant spirit continued to disintegrate!!
“This…” The Light Sprite, Lil, and the other elves widened their eyes in disbelief, unable to understand why that Iron-eating Beast was so cruel.
This was simply a battle body even more brutal than a dragon. Wasn’t it afraid of injuries? Did it not feel pain!!
“Sister Annie!” Luo Yi and the others’ hearts tightened.
At this moment, Annie, who was inside, instantly felt a huge shock wave. She could already sense that she would be sent flying in the next second. Her life and death were unknown!
However, at this moment, the violent energy wave dissipated. Annie stood on the spot with sweat all over her face. She looked at the huge lightning palm in front of her and couldn’t move.
In his vision, apart from the white lightning, it was all darkness.
“I think we can end it now,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes… I lost,” Annie said with a pale expression.
At the same time, huge waves rose in her heart.
Was this the Shi Yu Dong Huang had promoted? He had the battle record of assassinating overlord-level ferocious beasts?
She couldn’t understand.
The word assassination.
In this kind of promotion, did that not mean that he defeated the enemy when they were weak and when the enemy wasn’t paying attention?
With Shi Yu’s strength, were they sure he wasn’t passing by the overlord territory and casually slapping it to death before leaving calmly?
At this moment, when she thought about how Shi Yu had only sent one pet and that the other few had yet to appear…
At the thought that Shi Yu still had a telepathy talent and was only a level-six Beast Tamer, Annie was shocked. She couldn’t understand the battle process just now.
What had she experienced?
And now, seeing that Annie was in the opponent’s attack range and was forced to admit defeat, Lil and the other elves were as serious as Annie.
It was too short. In just two rounds, the super genius of the Tingxiang royal family was suppressed by someone below her level.
This pressure instantly made Lil and the other elves unable to breathe. They looked at the calm Shi Yu in disbelief.
“I lost…” Annie was extremely silent.
Was this the legendary aptitude that the empress mentioned… She believed it.
“Miss Annie, there’s no need to worry.” Shi Yu smiled. Eleven returned to its restrained form and recovered.
There was indeed no need to care. Eleven was working hard and cheating. It couldn’t compare to normal situations. The other party’s level was already considered good at her age.
Shi Yu’s initial judgment was that this Annie’s strength was about the same as the Ice-Eyed White Tiger and the Mountain Tortoise.
Although it sounded weak, it was actually not weak.
Because that Ice-Eyed White Tiger and the Mountain Tortoise were definitely experts among overlords. Moreover, they weren’t young and had cultivated for at least a hundred years. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been heavily invited by the Dragonman Empire.
As for these four elves, they were only the younger generation of the royal family in Tingxiang. Their potential was still very huge. If they gave this Annie a little more time, although the chances of becoming a totem were not high, it shouldn’t be a problem to cultivate to the level of the Green Scaled Dragon. No, it could be said to be very simple.
“Can I know… was… that its full strength just now?” Annie looked at the shrunken Eleven and asked with surging emotions.
“Huh?” Eleven lowered its head. Full strength, definitely not.
Shi Yu said simply, “No.”
He had yet to force Eleven to use the strongest battle strategy. The combination of Inner Power+Impregnable+Undying Golden Body+Overlord Will was even more brutal.
Apart from that, the superalloy combination skill just now was not the strongest combination skill they had studied recently.
The strongest combination skill was to fuse the Meteorite Demon God Metal with the perfect White Thunder Metal.
In order to simulate evolution, Shi Yu and the others had wasted a little of the power of the Demon God to experiment once and used the superalloy to create a “Yin Yang Jade” the size of a marble.
The metal the size of a marble displayed at least twice the power of the lightning arrow just now after Eleven smashed it out. Its power was incomparably terrifying, but it was a little difficult to control.
Ling silently speculated that after this move was perfected, it might really become a quasi-divine skill.
At the moment, if Eleven was erupting with all its might. Shi Yu felt that it shouldn’t be much inferior to the Green Scaled Dragon at its peak. In terms of battle power, it should have reached the threshold of a top-notch overlord. It was considered a gatekeeper with top-notch overlord battle power.
After it broke through to a perfect overlord and completed its evolution, Shi Yu and Ling speculated that its strength should be enough to defeat an old top-notch overlord like the Sky Penetrating Whale. Its battle power should not be inferior to an invincible overlord like the individual mutated Leviathan.
It was enough to carry the banner of suppressing the world competition.
“Are you really only at level six and monarch level…”
After hearing Shi Yu say that Eleven had yet to use its full strength, Annie broke.
They felt that compared to Shi Yu, the two legends in Tingxiang were both trash.
Shi Yu laughed and looked at Li and the others. “Do you want to give it a try too?”

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 790 They’re Too Normal (4)
chapters.content:
790 They’re Too Normal (4)
“No, there’s no need.”
Lil, Luo Yi, and the other elves shook their heads and rejected.
Forget it.
It was impossible to fight.
!!
Annie was already the strongest among them.
“Alright then,” Shi Yu said. As expected, these four elves weren’t suitable for him.
They were too normal.
Annie had the strength of an overlord and medium will. She wasn’t weak, but it wasn’t enough.
Lil, overlord strength, low-level willpower, Luo Yi, and Hillia, a monarch and a commander, had extremely low willpower.
Not very good.
Shi Yu was silent. After thinking about it, it was indeed the Awakening-level problem child elf that attracted him the most.
Although the other party also had the lowest will, it still had the power of a god.
Moreover, him wanting the level of the will of an Awakening-level young girl to be high was too harsh.
When Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and Chi Tong were at the commander rank, their willpower was still extremely low. Wouldn’t that be even more useless? Didn’t they train themselves all the way to this point?
Did he ever say that he had to contract someone with overlord’s will? He didn’t remember him saying this.
“Then let’s go out. My friend should be here soon,” Shi Yu said.
As soon as he finished speaking, the four elves nodded. After seeing Shi Yu’s strength, they already respected this Beast Tamer of Dong Huang even more. Moreover, from their initial resistance, they became more and more interested in Shi Yu and thought of ways to attract Shi Yu.
….
Lu Qingyi arrived late, mainly because after the banquet ended, the Courtyard Sprite Lotus wanted to walk around, so Senior Lu accompanied it.
“Sorry, I’m late.”
After arriving, Senior Lu said apologetically. At this moment, the four elven geniuses looked at the lotus following beside Lu Qingyi in surprise and looked at this elven undead curiously.
Although they had heard it from Shi Yu just now, this was the first time they had seen an elf who had become a complete undead life form.
“This is the legend Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Lu Qingyi. She’s fifth in the Dong Huang Sequence. The friend I’m talking about is her. This is her contracted partner, the Wind Sprite Lotus,” Shi Yu introduced.
“Legend Lu, Lian, hello,” said Annie and the other elves.
“Hello.” Lu Qingyi greeted. Then, Lian beside her also looked at the group of elves and nodded slightly.
Lil, the royal librarian of Tingxiang, observed Lian seriously and said, “Miss Lian, don’t you remember your identity at all?”
Lian shook her head.
At this moment, Lil thought for a moment and smiled. “Then why don’t we go to the royal library?”
