“In the library, there’s an omniscient and omnipotent book made of the skin shed by the Mother Life Tree. It records most of the information about the elves and records the bloodline information of most of the elves. It’s a legendary book. If you use it, you can definitely figure out everything.”
“The Book of All Things?” Lu Qingyi was slightly surprised. There was such a thing?
“Yes.” Lil nodded. This book couldn’t be used easily, but on account of Shi Yu, she was willing to activate it. Moreover, she was more curious about this lotus herself.
“Alright, Sister Lil, are you going to open the Book of All Things?” Upon hearing that, Luo Yi and Hillia were also extremely surprised.
“Can we go take a look too? Can I ask it a few questions?”
This was a legendary weapon of the elves.
Only the elves recognized by the Book of Legends were qualified to open it.
And Lil was one of the few elves recognized by the Book of Legends.
Lil had a headache. “This is a special situation. I allow you to go together, but you’re not allowed to mess around.”
“Thank you very much.” At this moment, seeing that in order to help her, the royal family of Tingxiang even took out the legendary book, Lu Qingyi was immediately extremely grateful to them. Beside her, Lian also said gratefully, “Thank you.”
“You’re welcome. Elves are all family.” Lil smiled and said, “I’ll also invite the two of you to the palace to watch.”
“Alright, let’s go take a look,” Shi Yu said. There was actually such a tool.
….
After making the decision, Shi Yu and the others began to head to the Elven Palace in Tingxiang under the lead of the Light Elf, Lil.
Although the seven countries had established an alliance and established the Beast Tamer Association according to the requirements of the alliance, the ruling model was still very different.
For example, Tingxiang and Rongguang still retained the tradition of royal nobility. The status of the royal Beast Tamer was supreme.
Of course, although the systems in the other countries were different, there was no difference in essence. It was still the strongest Beast Tamers and their family factions who had the greatest say.
In this transcendent world where one person could destroy a country, strength was the foundation of everything.
“My ability lets me use the blood of other life forms as a medium to materialize their original bodies.”
As they walked, the half-elf, Luo Yi, proudly introduced her abilities.
The Tingxiang Blood Elves were divided into two major schools. One was like a vampire, absorbing the blood essence of other transcendent life forms to train its physique and cultivate various battle skills. The other used transcendent blood as a medium to create summoned creatures to fight. Luo Yi was clearly the latter.
“Not a bad ability.” Shi Yu felt that this ability was very similar to illusions.
“There’s still me, there’s still me.” The wood elf, Hillia, was also in a hurry to introduce her abilities.
[Master, they seem to be very enthusiastic about Shi Yu.] Lian muttered to Lu Qingyi.
The two elves were more active. Although the two big elves were more reserved, they were also thinking of ways to attract Shi Yu’s attention.
[Of course I saw it.] Lu Qingyi sighed. So were they here to help her or to invite Shi Yu to play?

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 791 They’re Too Normal (5)
chapters.content:
791 They’re Too Normal (5)
This Shi Yu… He didn’t come to Tingxiang to contract a sprite and go back, right?
Everyone communicated as they walked. Soon, they passed by the royal training ground in Tingxiang. Luo Yi stuck her head out and took a look. “That Qi is still training.”
Qi?
Upon hearing Luo Yi’s words, Shi Yu indeed realized that the elven girl he had noticed previously was practicing shooting in the huge training ground beside him.
However, the Blood Elf, Luo Yi, only mentioned it for a moment before continuing to walk away. Apart from Shi Yu, no one cared much.
“Didn’t that little girl just now have no transcendent power?” Shi Yu asked after walking past.
“Yeah, Qi doesn’t have transcendent power, but she’s quite proficient in various weapons. Bows, two-handed swords, one-handed swords, long-handled weapons, firearms, shields, and so on. She knows how to use them. She also likes them very much,” Luo Yi said. “Eh, Brother Shi Yu, how do you know that she doesn’t have transcendent power?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “President Auland introduced many people to me at the banquet. She mentioned them.”
“Oh, oh.” Luo Yi nodded. So that was the case.
“No transcendent power? What’s going on? Isn’t she an elf?” Lu Qingyi was also puzzled.
“I don’t know. The doctor, the Book of All Things, and even the empress can’t determine this strange disease,” Lil said.
“What a pity,” Annie said regretfully. That was why she didn’t like mixed blood very much. Although there was a chance of giving birth to a genius, it was also because it wasn’t responsible for the descendants. It was easier for flaws to appear.
Everyone continued forward.
At this moment, Shi Yu was already thinking.
So she liked various weapons and equipment?
So that was the case. Because she didn’t have extraordinary power, she relied on various extraordinary weapons and equipment to become stronger.
Even without transcendent power, her physique was still that of the elves. She was undoubtedly more proficient than ordinary humans in controlling these energy weapons.
This was also a cultivation idea.
Using various powerful weapons and equipment to arm a life form.
“If we can abduct this Qi…”
“Before awakening the power of a god, I can use this idea to nurture her.”
“Weren’t weapons and equipment wholesale here?”
“It’s definitely more magical than the equipment made by the dwarves in Tingxiang!”
“She was holding the Wind Bow just now, right?”
“I can build it too.”
“Let Baby Ginseng use plant control to create a bow arm and let Buggy use the worm silk to create a bowstring. Then, use the spatial pocket to open an alternate space in the worm silk. Then, use the phantom illusion to materialize a Wind Kirin artifact spirit in.”
“When the user pulls the bowstring, the bow arm will automatically be filled with sweet aura to help the user concentrate. At the same time, it will mobilize the power of the Kirin Phantom and condense the Wind Spirit Bead. If there are a few more phantoms inside, it can also fuse various attributes into the Wind Spirit Bead. The all-element archer will be born!”
“It’s not difficult for Eleven to mold weapons like big swords with hardened metal. The Heavenly Thunder Sword that attracts natural lightning and the spatial blade that shatters space can be forged.”
“In terms of defense, there’s also Susu’s protective water and Chi Tong’s protective flames. They can be made into armor.”
Shi Yu thought for a moment. He was really an equipment and weapons wholesaler. A pile of equipment made of Dao Proficiency skills would probably make even dwarves cry.
After Shi Yu’s thoughts cleared, he immediately informed Eleven and the others in the ruins.
“Have you heard of [Change Magic]? Ling, quickly study a growth-type change tool. It’s to summon various weapons and equipment to equip yourself according to the different battle situations.”
“As for materials, just use your skills. Make the equipment in an hour. There have to be at least 12 weapons and equipment.”
“The kind that can be controlled in the ocean battlefield, land battlefield, and sky battlefield.”
In that case, there was no need to add points. After training her willpower, he would directly activate the power of a god!
Whether it could attract the other party depended on whether the magic tools Ling and the others worked overtime to change into were attractive. Just treat it as a greeting gift.
The task really gave Ling a headache.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 792 Qi’s True Identity
chapters.content:
792 Qi’s True Identity
At the Royal Library of Tingxiang.
It was a mystic realm that looked like a huge tree.
Under the lead of the librarian, the Light Sprite Lil, Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and the others successfully entered.
As soon as they entered, they were greeted with a pure white library filled with chairs.
“Lil ~!”
“These people are…”
After they entered, a tree sprite with a human body but only the size of a butterfly and a pair of light wings flew out.
< Name > Ancient Tree Sprite
[Attributes]: Wood
[Level of Growth]: Totem Level
[Energy Points]: ???
When Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi saw it, they were stunned.
Well…
It was very normal for the guardian sprite of the royal library to be stronger than the guardian cat of Ancient Capital University and Imperial Capital University.
“Lan, help me find the Book of Knowledge.”
“Huh? You want the Book of Knowledge?”
It looked at Lil and the group she brought.
Of course, it knew the three elves, but Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and even the elven undead…
“I need to use the Book of Knowledge to investigate some information. Don’t worry, it’s a serious matter ~” Lil said seriously.
“Alright, alright,” the Tree Sprite said.
Although the Book of Knowledge only recorded information about the elves, it was also a very precious legendary treasure.
For example, it recorded more than 100 teaching methods suitable for the super skills of the elves.
There were countless teaching methods for low, intermediate, and high-level skills.
Such a treasure could only be said to be a divine weapon of the elves.
“Thank you, Senior.” After the Tree Sprite nodded, Lu Qingyi, Lian, and the others thanked it.
As for Shi Yu, he observed his surroundings in boredom. He was not interested in Lian’s identity.
He was worried that Qi would leave soon. If she left, he still had to find him.
After the investigation, he wanted to slip away immediately and talk to the sprite with the bloodline of a god.
It was hard to say if she could be in Team One, but it depended on the function of the divine skill.
However, if the other party was willing, he could still give her a spot in the second team.
….
The Tree Sprite’s movements were very fast.
Soon, a huge brown leather magic book was summoned.
Lil took the Book of Knowledge and placed it on the table. She smiled and said, “Lian, right? I need you to touch this book.”
“The Book of Knowledge is equivalent to the elves’ household register management system. After you touch it, you can trace your ancestors through the traces of your life.”
“If your ancestors are recorded on this, you can display their information.”
“Well… Under normal circumstances, the success rate is 100%, as long as you are an elf after the Tingxiang era.”
“It requires a lot of energy to activate the Book of Knowledge. Let’s start with the bloodlines closest to your era.”
“Alright.” The silver-haired and purple-eyed Lian nodded and gently stretched out her hand to place it on the Book of Knowledge.
Soon, the Book of Knowledge flickered. It automatically flipped to a page, and dense symbols appeared on the open two pages.
Lu Qingyi could only understand a portion of these symbols, but Shi Yu could understand all of them.
It was the elven language in Tingxiang.
Simple.
He had learned it through the memory water drop.
At the moment, Shi Yu had mastered more than ten important foreign languages. He was no longer the guy who had a headache when facing the university assessment.
Not to mention the official language of the seven countries, Shi Yu could even argue in elven language, dragon language, and Rongguang divine prose!
“Wendy Crumin?”
Shi Yu translated simply and said, “Eh, I really found it. There’s quite a lot of information.”
Below the name was some information about the bloodline connection of the sprite that Senior Lu contracted.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi continued to work hard to translate, but they didn’t realize that the expressions of the tree sprites, Lil, Annie, and the others had already changed to a very exaggerated level.
“It’s actually Lady Wendy,” Lil shouted in disbelief.
Although she had already expected that this sprite undead contracted by the legend of Dong Huang wouldn’t be simple, it was still scary. It was far from Tingxiang and had appeared in the distant Dong Huang. Without some ability, she really couldn’t pass. Moreover, there were no records of how to transform into an undead in the form of a sprite.
Therefore, Lian’s identity was definitely not simple.
However, to Lil and the others’ surprise, Lian was actually from the royal family of Tingxiang more than 2,000 years ago!
“Wendy Crumin…” Shi Yu translated and was slightly stunned.
“This.” He looked at the silver-haired, purple-eyed elf girl beside Senior Lu and said, “She’s Wendy Crumin’s daughter?”
“Wendy Crumin? Who is it?” Senior Lu translated slower and didn’t recognize many words. She and Lian looked at the shocked elves and swallowed their saliva.
After hearing this name, Lian’s expression changed slightly, and she was a little touched.
“Wendy Crumin, a totem-level Wind Sprite. She’s one of the contracted sprites of the legendary Beast Tamer Albera, who established the ancient country of Tingxiang and ended the chaotic totem world in Tingxiang!!”
Blood Sprite Luo Yi said in extreme shock.
In Tingxiang, the status of the legendary expert, Albera, was comparable to Emperor Shi of Dong Huang. They were both legendary experts who had ended the chaotic totem world and established a country with humans as the overlords.
Lian was the descendant of this contracted sprite…
It was no wonder that the tree sprite and the four elves were shocked.
“I… is this my mother’s name?” Lian’s expression was blank.
“This, this, what exactly is going on!” At this moment, the totem Tree Sprite was also shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 793 Qi’s True Identity (1)
chapters.content:
793 Qi’s True Identity (1)
“Everyone, calm down.” Shi Yu saw that everyone was a little uneasy and said, “If I remember correctly, the first Tingxiang Dynasty was destroyed by the flames of war with the Dark Night Forest, right?”
Just like Dong Huang, Tingxiang was also divided into many dynasties. The first dynasty that Albera belonged to had long been destroyed for two thousand years.
“Yes…” Lil said, “According to the historical books, all of Lord Albera’s contracted lives and himself died in battle. There are no records at all. ”
She looked at the confused Lian. She didn’t expect that this was a royal family even older than the Elven Empress!
!!
After all, back then, Albera had given every contracted life form royal family status.
Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so many mixed-blood royals in Tingxiang now.
“During the period when the Alberaa Legendary was in power, Dong Huang should be in the Emperor Wu Dynasty…” Shi Yu and Senior Lu looked at each other.
Although there were no records of communication between Tingxiang and Dong Huang in ancient times, they realized the problem out of instinct.
The Elf Race’s Mother Life Tree fell into the dark mutation for unknown reasons and created the Dark Elf Race. It wreaked havoc with Yun An in the east and called itself the king of totems. It seemed to have created the Yun Race at the same time.
[Could it be that the Elven Mother Life Tree was also infected by an extraterrestrial faction?] Shi Yu fell into deep thought.
Of course, the elves themselves had this guess, but it was not very meaningful. After all, the Dark Mother Tree had already been destroyed in a totem battle, and so much time had passed.
Their faith had long left the Mother Life Tree and relied even more on Tingxiang.
“If Lian is the descendant of Lady Wendy, it makes sense that she can transform into an undead. After all, Lady Wendy is the guardian of the elves who follows the legendary of Abera,” Lil said. For such a legend, it shouldn’t be difficult to do this, right?
They had to inform President Auland, no, even the empress, about this.
After all, this was Lady Wendy’s bloodline. Although it had already become an undead, it was still the orthodox royal family from 2000 years ago!
“Wait a minute, if Lian is Lady Wendy’s bloodline, can they enter the ‘natural ruins’?” Hillia said.
The natural ruins of Tingxiang were created by the legendary Abera. It was similar to the combination of the heroic spirit ruins and the Dragon God ruins. It was to preserve the heritage ruins for Tingxiang.
It relied on the creation of a natural spiritual vein. As long as the natural spiritual vein didn’t dry up, the internal resources were endless. Those who entered could obtain a certain amount of resources according to their bloodline level.
However, only the noble bloodline of Tingxiang that Albera had personally conferred could enter this ruin. In other words, the contracted life forms or descendants of Beast Tamers who had fought with him back then could enter.
The more honorable the bloodline and the stronger the talent potential, the more benefits one could obtain.
Now, most of the royal family in Tingxiang could no longer meet the requirement to enter. Even if they could enter, there were very few who could obtain huge benefits. After experiencing a few totem chaos eras, the current Tingxiang royal family and the Tingxiang royal family back then might not necessarily be the same batch of people.
As the direct descendant of the Wendy Guardian, Lian could definitely enter and obtain huge benefits. They just didn’t know if the current undead form Lian could obtain recognition.
But since the Book of Knowledge had acknowledged it, the natural ruins shouldn’t have a problem. Luo Yi and the others immediately looked at Lu Qingyi and Lian.
[Senior, it seems like your opportunity has come.] Shi Yu looked at her and said telepathically,
[Don’t forget about us…]
“Well…” Lu Qingyi fell into deep thought. She felt that she had a new main mission.
Investigate the reason why Lian appeared in Dong Huang and investigate the relationship between Tingxiang and Dong Huang back then.
“Legend Lu, Miss Lian, are you free now? Can you come with us to meet President Auland and even Her Majesty?” Lil asked.
“Perhaps you have a chance to enter the natural ruins and obtain the inheritance resources of Tingxiang.”
“Alright, I have no problem.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
At this moment, she was already satisfied after figuring out Lian’s identity.
Beside her, Lian still had more time to receive this information.
“Sir Shi Yu, you should come too,” Lil said.
Shi Yu said, “Can I enter that natural ruin too?”
“Ah…” Lil was stunned. “No, only the first-generation nobles and extremely strong contractors in Tingxiang can enter the natural ruins…”
Shi Yu said, “Then I won’t go. I still have some other things to deal with. Why don’t you bring Legend Lu to visit Her Majesty?”
Since it was his senior’s opportunity, he wouldn’t snatch it. He planned to prepare and find his own opportunity.
There were so many ruins in Tingxiang, so there was no need for him to snatch one from his senior.
[Senior, go for a while. The Elven Empress and the Dragon God are good friends. If you can obtain benefits from that natural ruin, you definitely won’t lose out.]
Of course, Tingxiang definitely had to get a piece of meat too. After all, this was their territory.
[I know.] Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu communicated telepathically.
Lu Qingyi was clearly in a good mood. She said: “Don’t worry, I’ll give you a little if I gain anything.”
“Well, well… Can we go see Her Majesty?” At this moment, at this point, Luo Yi and the others suddenly forgot about Shi Yu. At the mention of visiting Her Majesty, their eyes immediately lit up.
Shi Yu smiled and was happy to be suddenly free. If these guys left, he could go find Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 794 Qi’s True Identity (3)ewqqQ
chapters.content:
794 Qi’s True Identity (3)ewqqQ
…
Everyone stayed in the library for a while longer before splitting up.
Shi Yu left directly, while the other elves brought Lu Qingyi and Lian to visit the Elven Empress.
Looking at this long history, if Lu Qingyi and Lian could enter the natural ruins, it was even possible to take out legendary natural resources!
After the two parties separated, Shi Yu said that he wanted to leave the palace, but he didn’t go out. Instead, he came to the royal training ground and stood on the high wall.
“Fortunately, she’s still here,” Shi Yu said.
He looked at a training area of the royal training ground. The little girl with light pink hair was still holding the exquisite and small Wind Bow and practicing shooting.
The accuracy was alright…
At this moment, Shi Yu was still waiting for Ling and the others to finish. He watched silently from the side.
This Wind Bow should be custom-made. After all, if it was a normal bow, with this Qi’s height, it definitely couldn’t be controlled.
“1.2 meters?” Shi Yu was suddenly stunned.
He suddenly realized a problem.
So short!!
It was similar to Eleven’s restrained form, like a little girl.
Shi Yu hurriedly communicated with Ling and the others in the ruins telepathically. He’d forgotten to instruct them on important things.
“Ling, when creating weapons and equipment, don’t create them according to the size of a normal person. You have to create them in the form of a human cub about 1.2 meters tall.”
In the ruins.
Ling: “?”
Ling looked at the 1.4-meter-long black sword with white lightning patterns on the stone table in front of it and fell into deep thought.
This was a lightning sword that used hardening substances as the foundation and gave it the characteristic of lightning attracting. It contained the artifact spirit.
With a wave, it could trigger heavenly lightning and shatter the ground with lightning.
“Is it a big problem to use a huge sword that’s 1.2 meters tall, Master?” Ling asked.
“The weapon is basically ready. It’ll take time to redo it, but the armor hasn’t been made yet. It can be adjusted.”
“According to my top-notch intelligence judgment, it’s not a big problem.”
Shi Yu : “…”
Shi Yu imagined a 1.2-meter-tall humanoid cub waving a huge sword that was even larger than her and shook his head.
“It’s indeed not a big problem. If the size is right, it’s too deliberate. However, the scale of armor and armor should be more suitable, alright?”
“I understand!!”
After a while, Ling was finally done.
It also integrated the twelve weapons and equipment into a prop, an umbrella.
The size of this umbrella was suitable. The handle, umbrella bone, and umbrella surface were all made of the worm silk and the wooden plants of the ginseng baby. The overall color was white.
It looked like an umbrella, but an independent space had been opened inside, containing various weapons and equipment.
By controlling this umbrella, he could communicate with the “Artifact Spirit” of every equipment weapon and materialize new weapons and equipment with the ever-changing worm silk.
For example, when facing the enemy’s attack, opening the umbrella to block could activate the Flame of Protection or the Water of Protection, forming an elemental shield to block the attack.
Of course, without doing anything, the Flame of Protection and the Water of Protection could also automatically defend, but the problem was that wouldn’t it be more handsome if it was opened!
It could also deceive the opponent and make them think that they had to open the umbrella to defend!
“I’ll call you…”
Shi Yu held the mini umbrella in his hand and fell into deep thought. He decided to call it Shiyu, with Yu meaning rain.
Shi Yu chose to name it after his own name.
Legendary equipment, Shiyu.
It could materialize various equipment to solve various difficulties at the critical moment!
The image of the umbrella corresponded to the concept of rain!
This weapon should be considered level-seven.
Under the overlord level, as long as it didn’t encounter a monster like the Void Mantis or a monster that could crush it, it shouldn’t be a problem to defeat all the invincible monarchs.
Although the tool level was level seven, its quality could already be said to be legendary. After all, it was created by Ling and the others with a bunch of “divine” combination skills.
For resources and equipment, their energy levels and quality levels were actually equivalent to the growth level and race level of pets.
Without a doubt, this Time Umbrella had already reached an extremely exaggerated level. If it was auctioned, even if it couldn’t compare to legendary resources, it shouldn’t be a problem for it to be a level-eight resource comparable to rare quality attributes.
And the price…
In the ruins space, Eleven and the others were as tired as dead dogs. Every pet recovered weakly. Through various methods, they slept, freeloaded natural energy, and ate. After all, they all worked in their best state after eating the Time Fruit. The effort was obvious.
“Master, Master.”
At this moment, after obtaining the Umbrella of Time, Shi Yu was already prepared to meet the other party. However, at this moment, Ling suddenly spoke.
It already knew Qi’s situation.
Ling said, “Although it might not be able to awaken the power of a god now, you can try to take a drop of her blood or a strand of hair from her. I can create a Mythical Revival device to try to test the type of law.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded. As expected of you.
It was more reliable than the skill index.
…
At the training ground.
Qi had been practicing for the entire afternoon.
Although she didn’t have transcendent abilities, the physique of the elves was still much stronger than humans.
“Hu…”
Qi’s sore arms fell naturally, and the Wind Bow was thrown to the ground. She wiped the sweat on her forehead with her sleeve, and her light pink hair was already a little messy.
Her similar pink eyes were filled with confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 795 Qi’s True Identity (4)
chapters.content:
795 Qi’s True Identity (4)
Although she could also defeat some ordinary transcendent-level ferocious beasts by controlling various weapons and equipment, this path still made Qi feel uncertain about the future..
If she could obtain those legendary weapons, legendary equipment, and even divine artifacts, she could naturally become an expert. However, why would that tool be given to a sprite without transcendent power?
The same weapons and equipment would definitely only be more effective for users with higher growth levels with transcendent power.
Therefore, Qi felt that no matter what path she chose, she might still not be able to become a powerful expert.
!!
After all, even the Book of Knowledge and the empress couldn’t help her.
“It’s better to give up.”
“I don’t have to become an expert.”
“But…”
Qi shook her head hard. She didn’t have any big dreams. Her true goal of becoming stronger at this moment was still to be like other members of her race. That was all.
The other elves of the same age were all geniuses among geniuses who had mastered various extraordinary abilities, but she didn’t know anything. This difference was the foundation for Qi’s hard work at the moment.
It would be a daydream to talk about big dreams when she was in this state.
“Forget it, it won’t work at all. I should give up.”
Qi muttered to herself. This kind of thing happened to her many times a day.
As she trained as much as possible, she couldn’t convince herself that such hard work could be fruitful.
“Why aren’t you training anymore?” Shi Yu slowly walked over. His good hearing allowed him to hear the other party’s muttering from afar.
He was very speechless at this contradictory elven girl.
She was really too different in body and mind.
Of course, it was not bad for this age.
If it were him, if he had started as a loser and came from the royal family, he would have long been ruined. Or he would have gone to do other things, such as doing business to earn money to buy legendary resources to change his fate.
It was impossible to sigh while doing training without any results.
“Ah…” Qi didn’t notice anyone coming over at all. She immediately turned around and saw Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was wearing a red archeological trench coat. Under his clean short black hair, his dark eyes stared at the other party. In fact, the clothes he was wearing now were also knitted by Buggy and Ling. His resistance in various aspects was not bad. It was considered a level-seven defensive equipment.
“No, nothing,” Qi said nervously, her voice still carrying a hint of youth.
For the elves who had a longer lifespan, she was indeed young.
At this moment, Qi felt that the human young man in front of her was a little familiar. She was slightly stunned and quickly recalled.
The other party didn’t seem to be from the royal family of Tingxiang, but the young man who was talking to President Auland at the banquet today!
Qi didn’t know Shi Yu’s specific identity. She was only an Awakening-level sprite. She was only invited to eat and drink and didn’t pay much attention to the purpose of Dragon Palace City coming to Tingxiang. After all, it had nothing to do with her, but she knew that Shi Yu was definitely a big shot to be able to talk and laugh with President Auland.
Why was it here?
“Do you want to become stronger?” After Shi Yu came over, he went straight to the point.
It caught Qi off guard. She widened her round eyes and didn’t understand what Shi Yu meant.
“If you practice like this, you’ll hurt your body.”
Shi Yu looked at the Wind Bow on the ground and said, “With your current physique, you can’t withstand the damage caused by the wind pressure to your arm. The efficiency of such practice is too low.”
Qi’s pink eyes looked at the Wind Bow and looked up. “It shouldn’t be a problem… The Wind Bow is the work of Master Gerin. The side effects are very small. Moreover, when I go back, I’ll also apply herbs…”
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “The results of inefficient hard work are completely different from efficient hard work.”
With that said, he raised his arm and took out a silver longbow larger than the Wind Bow out of thin air. He threw it to Qi and said, “Try using this.”
“What’s this…” Qi hurriedly took the silver longbow that was even larger than her. Just as she received the bow arm, she was stunned.
The moment her hands touched the wooden bow arm, the life aura flowing on it instantly nourished her entire arm along her palm. Then, all the fatigue from the afternoon’s training was swept away in an instant.
Apart from that, the faint fragrance emitted by the bow arm made Qi feel that her current mental state was surprisingly good. Her gaze became clearer and clearer, as if she could see the elemental particles drifting in the air. It was very unbelievable.
Supporting the huge bow, Qi looked at Shi Yu in confusion. As Shi Yu nodded, Qi tried to pull the bowstring in the next moment.
The Wings of Wind condensed wind elements into an arrow. The bow Shi Yu gave her didn’t have an arrow either, which meant that it was a similar weapon…
At this moment, as Qi pulled, a white cyclone compressed and condensed between the bow arm and the bowstring, forming an arrow. The tail of the arrow was like a pair of wind wings, and the head of the arrow was like a wind spirit bead.
As she pulled the weapon, Qi’s expression became more and more surprised. This was because she could clearly feel incomparably terrifying wind elemental power gathering on this weapon. The strength of the natural energy gathered was at least a hundred times greater than the wind arrow shot by the Wind Bow.
In theory, no matter how close the physique of the elves was to natural energy, she was only at the Awakening level. At this moment, such a high-intensity energy wave had gathered nearby. Under normal circumstances, it would definitely instantly backfire on the user, but no.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 796 Qi’s True Identity (5)
chapters.content:
796 Qi’s True Identity (5)
In Qi’s perception, the pressure this bow produced on her was actually smaller than that level-two Wind Bow.
Boom!!
After Qi’s action ended, the Wind Spirit Bead Arrow shot out at an extremely fast speed like a white meteor. With a bang, it touched the target in the distance. Then, with a violent airflow, Qi seemed to have seen the birth of a storm eye. Wherever the arrow reached, a terrifying typhoon instantly appeared, destroying everything around it.
The chaotic white airflow swept up the fatal wind blades, instantly cutting the ground and the target into thousands of holes.
!!
“How do you feel?”
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Qi looked at the huge pit opposite in a daze. At this moment, she was holding the longbow and finally reacted. She realized that after shooting an arrow, not only was she not burdened at all, but the gentle nourishment just now also made her current state even better than before she shot the arrow!
At the same time, because of the faint fragrance that strengthened the mind and the powerful wind-element natural energy she sensed at a close distance just now, her perception of wind-element natural energy was actually much sharper than before.
“I feel… I feel like I didn’t do anything, but I somehow became stronger,” Qi stuttered.
Shi Yu smiled faintly. Of course.
What did she think?
This bow had an artifact spirit.
As for the artifact spirit, it was a Wind Kirin phantom created by Buggy with Ling’s Wind Kirin form as its prototype.
As for this artifact spirit, it had mastered expert level wind elemental control. It could use this ability to assist the user.
Ling constantly flew at a high speed with Shi Yu, and Shi Yu couldn’t feel any wind pressure, let alone Qi who had only shot a simple arrow.
Apart from that, the bow arm was created by Baby Ginseng’s combination of source of life, nutritional supplements, plant control, and sweet aura.
When held, it could restore the user’s vitality and strengthen the user’s mental state. It could enter a realm close to nature similar to “Heaven and man integration”. It could effectively accelerate the mastery of natural energy.
After this series of operations, every arrow shot was to train his control over the wind-element natural energy. At the same time, due to the speciality of the bow arm, it was not too draining for the user.
Of course, it was just a little energy-consuming. Although the bow arm and artifact spirit could slowly recover their energy through natural placement and rely on the passage of time, this speed was a little slow. As long as it was used a little more, it would probably have to rely on manual repair. It would have to spend energy, such as stuffing wood-element and wind-element energy crystals to accelerate recovery.
“Excuse me, what’s this bow called?” Qi asked.
She felt that this should be the proud work of a legendary blacksmith. It should be at least level-seven equipment!
Shi Yu said, “Wind Kirin Wings.”
“Wind Kirin Wings…” Qi’s eyes were filled with light, filled with love for this weapon.
But soon, a trace of loneliness appeared in her eyes.
Even if the legendary dwarf blacksmith wanted to forge such a weapon, it might take a lot of effort. She couldn’t find such a weapon to cultivate.
Such a weapon definitely had to be given priority to the soldiers at the front line, not to a little girl without transcendent power as a toy.
Qi handed the bow back to Shi Yu.
“Thank you for your guidance. I’ll continue to work hard…”
Shi Yu looked at her as she didn’t take the bow. “I asked you previously, ‘Do you want to become stronger’?”
Qi was stunned. She looked at Shi Yu with its pink eyes and nodded.
“Yes.”
“If you’re willing, from today onwards, you can cultivate with me.”
“You can use this bow.”
Qi was stunned.
“But, I…”
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Qi found it unbelievable. This was because she didn’t even have superpowers. Why would the other party let her cultivate with him?
“No transcendent abilities, right?” Shi Yu said. “In that case, let’s not train our transcendent abilities and just familiarize ourselves with controlling various weapons and equipment.”
“Do you think that if you can control this bow proficiently, you’ll be weaker than a commander?”
Qi said, “No…”
“Just follow your inner thoughts. Don’t worry about your royal identity. I’ll talk to your Elven Empress.” Shi Yu looked ahead and said, “By the way, the Wind Kirin Wings in your hand is only one of the forms of this tool.”
“Take it and feel it with your heart, just like when you sense nature.”
Qi became more and more nervous. She didn’t expect Shi Yu to know the Elven Empress.
But in the next moment, Qi was extremely happy. She felt that she was being valued for the first time.
She nodded excitedly and carefully sensed the weapon in her hand according to Shi Yu’s guidance.
This perception was impressive. With her eyes closed, twelve weapons and equipment immediately appeared in her dark vision.
Greatsword, katana, staff, bow, machine gun, armor, umbrella shield, accessories… Various strange equipment images appeared in Qi’s mind in a blurry light form.
She chose the huge sword in confusion. In the next moment, the bow in her hand disappeared into thin air. Then, thunder shot out in front of her, and a huge black sword with white lightning patterns descended in the outside world and fell into Qi’s hand.
She struggled to receive this huge sword that was even taller than her and barely picked it up with both hands.
“As for this sword… If the Wind Kirin Wings just now were relatively gentle, then the power of this huge sword is relatively violent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 797 Qi’s True Identity (6)
chapters.content:
797 Qi’s True Identity (6)
Shi Yu said simply, and Qi, who was holding the huge sword with difficulty, suddenly felt a numbing electric current instantly flow from the huge sword into his body.
She only felt that her body was about to be electrocuted. However, after this feeling, it didn’t bring about stiffness. Instead, Qi felt that her cells were stimulated by the lightning and became active, instantly increasing her strength.
“Sword Skill, Divine Speed,” Qi said in a low voice. Her entire body was immediately filled with electricity, and her light pink hair exploded because of the blue and white electricity spreading. Then, under the flickering of the surrounding electric arcs, she, who was holding a big sword, directly disappeared, leaving only a lightning mark.
Bang, bang, bang.
!!
The eruption of a breath was like a thunderclap that tore through the air. Then, a few crazy lightning sword lights appeared ten meters away and continued to roar forward like ferocious beasts.
In the distance, Qi, who had stopped, looked at the dancing thunderous sword light in a daze. Then, she looked at the huge sword in her hand and turned to look at Shi Yu.
This, what exactly was this!!!
In that instant, Qi actually felt that the strength of her Awakening-level body was instantly comparable to a transcendent-level ferocious beast under the strengthening of the huge sword.
Not only that, but as an elf with a natural physique, she could sense that the state just now was clearly not the limit of this sword.
It had only simply absorbed the lightning elemental particles floating in the air just now. If she wanted to mobilize them to the limit, she could even feel that this huge sword could even summon catastrophically destructive lightning.
“Although it’s a little violent, this state can train your physique. When you can’t withstand it, just summon the Staff of Life to recover from the damage,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu felt that the creation was still too rushed. He could completely create a set of lightning armor and hold a Space Splitting Blade to form a set. However, with Qi’s level, it was probably a little difficult to control multiple pieces of equipment at the same time.
He would level it up later.
“Staff of Life…”
Soon, Qi changed the form of the weapon and replaced it with the Life Staff created by Baby Ginseng. The recovery effect of this weapon was specially mutated and strengthened, even better than the bow arm just now.
Under the recovery of the green healing wave, the burden brought by the lightning stimulation instantly disappeared, making Qi feel like it was a miracle.
She realized that she had completely underestimated the rarity of this equipment.
This was not simple level-seven equipment at all. It could actually switch between 12 different forms, and every form had an unbelievable effect. It was not too much to say that it was a legendary weapon.
“Have you thought about it? Do you want to cultivate with me? You’ll suffer a lot. After that, you’ll also stay far away from Tingxiang. I don’t know when you’ll come back next.”
“However, in the end, you should be stronger than now, much stronger than other elves.”
“I… I want to follow you.” Her pink hair swayed. She had already completely fallen because of this weapon and was unwilling to give up this opportunity to become stronger.
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “Then, I’ll guide you to use this weapon first. It’s a comprehensive piece of equipment. It contains twelve forms inside. Every weapon and equipment has its own name, and in its normal state, it’s called ‘Time Rain’. It’s the legendary precious artifact, the Umbrella of Time Rain. Now, you can try to restore it to the form of the Umbrella of Time. In this form, most weapons and equipment will be in a sleeping state, and the losses will be smaller.”
Qi nodded. Soon, under Shi Yu’s guidance, she converted the big sword into a beautiful white umbrella.
She happily held this very handy tool.
She opened the umbrella and maintained the childlike innocence of the child. She raised it happily and liked it very much.
This form… was much more comfortable for her to hold.
“Next, what you have to do is adjust your mentality and be more confident. Only with enough confidence can you perfectly control the power of these equipment.”
Shi Yu spent half an hour teaching Qi to use the Time Umbrella. Qi also followed Shi Yu’s request and became more and more confident. When she tested the subsequent forms, her eyes were filled with hope.
With a smile and sweat, she tried one weapon form after another. Under Shi Yu’s guidance, she kept nodding.
Although she still didn’t understand Shi Yu, at this moment, Shi Yu had already become the person she thanked the most and trusted the most.
…
Shi Yu gave Qi a few days to bid farewell to the people she knew. As for Shi Yu, he stretched out his hand and looked at the drop of blood floating in his palm, falling into deep thought.
He told the other party that the Umbrella of Time needed to be recognized by blood to be perfectly controlled. At the same time, no one else could use the Umbrella of Time anymore. She would become the only owner of the Umbrella of Time.
This saying was also true. The only requirement to be able to use the Time Umbrella was to obtain the recognition of the artifact spirits in the umbrella.
It was not wrong to let the Umbrella of Time familiarize itself with Qi’s identity through blood.
However, most importantly, after that, Shi Yu used his full-level Psychic power to get this drop of blood.
“With this, you can test the other party’s hidden strength?”
Shi Yu asked Ling in the ruins.
“Yes, Master.” Ling nodded. After accepting the fourth bureau of knowledge and the biotechnology experience of the legend of the Seven Islands, its biotechnology foundation was not low at all!
In addition to top-notch intelligence and Mythical Revival skills, it wasn’t impossible to explore the divine power in the other party’s bloodline.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 798 Qi’s True Identity (7)
chapters.content:
798 Qi’s True Identity (7)
“Then study it,” Shi Yu said.
At the same time.
“Lalala ~”
Qi had an umbrella on her and ran in a direction excitedly.
It had been a long time since she was so happy.
She was at Master Ge Lin’s address. Master Ge Lin was considered a specially hired blacksmith of the royal family in Tingxiang. She was only a step away from becoming a legendary blacksmith. Most of the weapons and equipment of the royal family in the palace were tailor-made by her and a few other dwarves.
Among them, Qi and Master Ge Lin were very familiar because her few weapons and equipment were all made by Master Ge Lin. The other party even made a few more pieces of equipment for her because of her special situation.
If she wanted to leave this place, the first person she wanted to bid farewell to was Master Ge Lin.
“Grandma Ge Lin, Grandma Ge Lin!!”
In the silent smithy, the bearded female dwarf, Ge Lin, was sleeping soundly. She naturally participated in the noon banquet and drank a lot with her clansmen. She would probably sleep until night.
However, in her daze, Ge Lin kept feeling that a familiar voice was calling her.
She opened her eyes, got out of bed, opened the door, and saw the little girl outside the house. Wasn’t this Qi?
“Qi, what are you doing? Ah, my head hurts,” Ge Lin said uncomfortably, hitting her head with the hammer beside her.
This child was really worrisome.
Didn’t she know that she had drunk a lot at noon and needed to rest?
“Grandma Gerin, I might have to leave here,” Qi said.
“Huh???” Ge Lin immediately perked up and looked at Qi. “What do you mean? Where are you going?”
Generally speaking, a young sprite without transcendent power would only be staying here for the rest of its life. After reaching adulthood, it was not bad to casually be a clerk. With her background, her starting point was the end point of most lives. In Ge Lin’s opinion, it actually didn’t matter if there was transcendent power.
If she stubbornly insisted on cultivating, Ge Lin had no choice but to treat it as playing with her.
“There’s a lord… who wants me to cultivate with him. I might leave the palace and Tingxiang later,” Qi said.
“What!” Ge Lin was shocked. “You didn’t encounter a bad person, right?”
“No, Lord Shi Yu is a good person. He said that he would personally tell Her Majesty to bring me out of Tingxiang to cultivate,” Qi Yu said. Putting aside the fact that Shi Yu could communicate with the Elven Empress, just the value of the Umbrella of Time Shi Yu gave her was not inferior to a legendary holy weapon. How could he be a bad person?
“Wait.” Master Ge Lin was stunned.
This name…
Her expression changed slightly. “You just said, Lord Shi Yu?”
“Is the Shi Yu you’re talking about the young man in dark red clothes who was talking to President Auland at the banquet today?”
Qi’s eyes lit up. He nodded and said, “Yes, yes, yes, it’s that lord.”Z
“How can this be…” Ge Lin was completely shocked. Blacksmiths and Mechanics were actually similar professions. However, one forged transcendent equipment, while the other forged technological equipment. The latter’s technical content was even higher.
As a dwarf blacksmith, Ge Lin naturally knew how talented Shi Yu, who had developed a mechanical phantom beast, was. She couldn’t believe that he would actually look for Qi and say that he would bring her out of Tingxiang to cultivate.
“You, do you know who he is! Why would he…”
Master Ge Lin didn’t understand why Qi was chosen by Shi Yu.
“Lord Shi Yu said that since I don’t have transcendent abilities, I shouldn’t train transcendent abilities. I can still become an expert by proficiently controlling various weapons and equipment.”
Ge Lin was getting more and more confused. She said, “Have you told the others about this? I think we still have to tell the other adults.”
If Qi wanted to leave the palace and head to Dong Huang, she had to at least obtain the agreement of the elven royal family above the overlord level. Although Shi Yu said that he would tell the Elven Empress, that was Shi Yu’s business. Qi definitely had to take the initiative to ask.
“I haven’t,” Qi said. “I’ll talk to Sister Lil later…”
Master Ge Lin said, “I’ll go with you to find Lady Lil. This matter is very important…”
Although it was very difficult to believe that someone would deceive the royal family of Tingxiang, she had watched Qi grow up with her own eyes. It was very difficult to believe that someone would be willing to cultivate with Qi who couldn’t control transcendent power.
“Alright…” Qi nodded and said,” But before that, Grandma Ge Lin, I want to challenge the royal trial one last time. ”
“Can you bring me over?”
The royal trial was a trial-type mystic realm.
Every level was guarded by transcendent life forms of different strength.
This mystic realm was used to test the progress of the strength of the members of the royal family in Tingxiang.
Transcendent, commander rank, and monarch rank. Each level corresponded to four levels, a total of 12 levels.
Of course, overlord-level sprites could easily clear it, but for monarch-level sprites and master-level Beast Tamers, clearing it had a certain difficulty.
In this mystic realm, royal Beast Tamers could use their Beast Taming Talent to strengthen pets for the challenge, while the elves could use various equipment. There were no rules and restrictions. After all, it was just a small mystic realm for the new generation.
No matter what the method was, as long as one could clear it, it represented a certain amount of battle power.
Before this, Qi had barely passed the first level with various equipment, but after that, she couldn’t defeat any more.
After all, other clansmen could skip two to three levels when they were at the Awakening level.
And this time, Qi Hope could use the Umbrella of Time to challenge it again.
…
After Shi Yu returned to the address of Dragon Palace City, he received a message from Senior Lu.
She had already seen the Elven Empress and was about to head to the natural ruins.
If she was lucky, she might be able to pack up the gifts in the natural ruins today.
“Let’s see what Senior can bring out. If it’s suitable, I can exchange resources with her for Qi,” Shi Yu thought.
At this moment, Shi Yu had just returned and had yet to rest when Ling’s shocked voice came from the ruins space.
“Master, Master, there’s a result!!!”
In less than an hour, Ling, who was studying the blood prayer, shouted in shock.
“So fast?!” Shi Yu was stunned.
“Well, it might be the enhancement of the Wind Blessing.”
“Can you determine the attributes and abilities of the divine power hidden in Qi?”
Ling said, “I tried to activate the divine power in my blood with the Mythical Revival skill… I can already make a preliminary judgment.”
“Perhaps I know what its previous identity was.”
“It’s actually a little strange to say that. Why do law-type elves transform into humanoid elves… Law-type elves, elemental elves, and elves are not the same thing.”
Shi Yu said, “Stop with all that. Tell me quickly!”
“Alright!”
“The divine law in the other party’s body is very likely to be a time and space dual-element divine-level skill. Space-time Travel is also the only divine skill of the legendary rule-type life form ‘Time Sprite’ born in space and time. That skill can transmigrate into the past and the future. Although it doesn’t have destructive power, it’s very unbelievable.”
Divine skill, Space-time Travel!
“What!” Shi Yu was stunned, and his expression changed drastically. Hey, hey, hey, hey, it wasn’t kidding, right? He remembered that the Dragon God had once asked him to help crack the Space-time Dragon Vein Ruins when he grew up. This place was said to have the ability to travel through space and time, and this place was the habitat of the Time Sprite!
Now, he had found the creator of the ruins before cracking it?
However, Shi Yu was as puzzled as Ling. According to the Dragon God, the Time Sprite was a law-type sprite that couldn’t be compared to a humanoid sprite.
“Ling, are you reliable?”

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 799 Time Umbrella Killing (1)
chapters.content:
799 Time Umbrella Killing (1)
Tingxiang royal trial mystic realm.
At this moment, six to seven people were gathered here. They were all communicating and waiting outside the mystic realm.
Regarding this type of mystic realm, it had always been a rather interesting game among the younger generation in the palace.
Firstly, it was because everyone could obtain rich rewards every time they obtained the First Clear. Secondly, there was a ranking in the trial mystic realm that recorded the clearance situation of every member of the royal family.
As long as there were people, it was inevitable that there would be comparisons, and this trial mystic realm was clearly a very good place to compare.
Every time a member of the royal family could pass a certain level, or every time a genius could pass 12 levels, it would cause a huge discussion among the younger generation of the Tingxiang royal family.
For example, in the past ten years, only four challengers had passed the 12th level.
As for these four, two of them were already legendary Beast Tamers, while the other two had already become overlord-level elves.
“Qi, are you sure you want to challenge?”
“With the umbrella in your hand?”
Master Ge Lin accompanied Qi here.
When Qi said that Shi Yu had given her a very powerful weapon, Master Ge Lin was very shocked.
However, this girl, Qi, refused to show it no matter what. She said that she wanted to use the royal trial to prove the power of this weapon.
Qi was an underage elf. Even among the elves, her age was very young. At her age and level, she couldn’t participate in the trial alone. She had to be accompanied by an elder. At this moment, Ge Lin could only take on this heavy responsibility.
“Yes, Master Ge Lin, believe me!” Qi Shui’s eyes were filled with confidence. Clearly, she had been brainwashed by Shi Yu.
…
“Eh, Master Ge Lin brought Qi over again.” Outside the royal trial mystic realm, the thin old administrator, Liu Ke, yawned.
“Haha, yes.” Master Ge Lin nodded.
“Alright, I’ll arrange for her to enter now,” the administrator, Liu Ke, said.
Although there were people challenging inside at the moment, this girl, Qi, would at most take a while before being beaten up. It was fine.
…
“Ah, Little Qi is here to challenge again.”
“Is this new equipment?”
Qi wanted to enter the mystic realm to challenge. When the other royal family members nearby saw her, they also greeted her.
This was one of the exchange venues for the royal family members. A few people gathered every day.
There were neither too many nor too few young people in the palace, dozens of them.
Among them, Qi’s name was ranked at the bottom of the royal trial. In addition, her situation was special, so every member naturally knew her.
People often had sympathy for the weak. Everyone clearly felt that this elf was quite pitiful.
At the same time, Qi, who also felt that she didn’t have transcendent power but cultivated weapons and equipment skills, worked very hard. If the conditions allowed, many people would even give her equipment as a gift on her birthday.
“Yes.” Holding the Umbrella of Time in her hand, Qi nodded.
Then, she took a deep breath and directly ascended the entrance of the mystic realm to enter.
…
Because she had already passed the first level in the past, this time, Qi started the challenge from the second level.
In this space, there was a rock area. A huge rock lizard looked at Qi with a deep gaze.
< Name > Earth Dragon Lizard
[Attributes]: Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level Commander
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
The first few levels of the trial mystic realm were relatively simple.
For example, in the four levels of transcendent, they corresponded to the transcendent race, the commander race, the monarch race, and the quasi-overlord race.
For the more outstanding geniuses of Tingxiang, it was not a big problem for them to pass the four levels at the transcendent level. For the more talented ones, they could either rely on their Beast Taming Talent or equipment. They could even reach the third or fourth levels at the Awakening level.
Qi didn’t have a contractor and couldn’t use her Beast Taming Talent to strengthen herself, so she could only use equipment.
“Sss…” When the Earth Dragon Lizard saw Qi, its eyes revealed a playful expression.
The pets here were all cultivated by the royal family of Tingxiang. There was a batch of guardians in every level of the first few levels. Only the guardians of the later levels were fixed.
Coincidentally, Qi had also lost to this Earth Dragon Lizard last time, so when the Earth Dragon Lizard saw her this time, it immediately felt a little relaxed.
“It’s you!” Qi’s eyes were red and she felt a little aggrieved. The last time, she was beaten up by it.
Her head was covered in many bumps from the other party’s rocks, and her face was swollen, green, and purple.
If the opponent was earth-element, she would use wood-element to counter it…
She waved the Umbrella of Time. Under the flickering light, the Umbrella of Time immediately turned into a wooden staff.
Although she felt that it was a little careless and crude when creating it, and it was just a brown and white wooden staff, it wasn’t a big problem.
“Sss ~” At the same time, seeing that Qi had changed his equipment this time and didn’t need that bow, the Earth Dragon Lizard shook its head. Then, it summoned Flying Rock and planned to send the other party out.
However, how could upgraded equipment be that simple? The 1.2-meter-tall Qi held a staff taller than itself in both hands and ran towards the Earth Rock Lizard. The Earth Rock Lizard originally didn’t care much, but as the nourishing fragrance came, it immediately felt dizzy and its nose began to bleed.
Under a wave of dizziness, it was sent flying by the staff.
“As expected, it can be controlled!”
Looking at the Earth Dragon Lizard that she had swung away, Qi held her staff and her heart raced.
This was one of the usage methods Shi Yu had taught Qi. For creatures below the commander level, the nourishing magic of the staff could instantly stun the other party and let them fight as they pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 800 Time Umbrella Killing (2)
chapters.content:
800 Time Umbrella Killing (2)
“Wait a minute.”
At this moment, Qi felt that something was wrong. Staves and nourishing magic shouldn’t be used like this, right?
It didn’t seem to be meaningful for this attribute to counter it.
She could easily win with a bow and arrow…
However, this didn’t matter. She looked at the Earth Dragon Lizard that had been smashed unconscious and felt excited.
Next level!
…
In the outside world.
As Qi entered, most people didn’t pay much attention.
Because they were certain that she would come out with a swollen face soon.
However.
When someone noticed that behind the name representing Qi on the stone tablet in the outside world’s challenge record was refreshed, and two stars appeared, they were immediately slightly stunned.
“Hey, look, Qi seems to have passed the second level.”
This young Beast Tamer’s words immediately attracted the attention of the other members of the royal family.
“It wasn’t easy, how did Qi pass it?” another Beast Tamer said.
Awakening-level battle commander race, transcendent-level. Was this using level-three weapons and equipment?
With Qi’s level, it shouldn’t be easy to control level-three equipment.
“Cleared? So fast?” At this moment, the mystic realm administrator, Liu Ke, was still chatting with Master Ge Lin.
As the mystic realm ranking refreshed, they took a look.
“Master Ge Lin, did you prepare high-level equipment for Qi?”
“No, with her level, controlling level 2 equipment is the limit,” Ge Lin said.
Master Ge Lin pondered for a moment. “But she obtained new equipment from others. Master Liu Ke, can’t you see the situation in the mystic realm? Please see her performance next and tell me how it is.”
Master Ge Lin was not too surprised that Qi could pass the second level. After all, judging from Qi’s confident look, the equipment Shi Yu gave her should be pretty good.
“Alright.” Master Liu Ke quickly took out the mystic realm control equipment and looked at the situation inside.
Then, they saw an extremely unbelievable scene.
The short Qi faced the monarch race in front of her, the transcendent-level Ancient Frost Tree, and directly turned the umbrella in her hand into a longbow.
The bow was very big, and it was very difficult to hold and pull it. As a result, the young Frost Ancient Tree opposite was very stunned and speechless.
Then, it was this neglect that sent it away. As Qi used her hands and feet to draw the Kirin Bow, in the next moment, the Wind Spirit Bead arrow that was like a white meteor instantly blasted the Ancient Frost Tree apart.
The third level, passed!
Master Liu Ke: “???”
“What is it!!!” Master Liu Ke widened his eyes in disbelief.
“What’s wrong?” Master Ge Lin immediately said when she saw his shock. Then, she suddenly realized that three stars had already appeared behind Qi’s name, indicating that she had already passed the third level.
“What weapon is she holding? From the looks of it, its power can injure commander-level ferocious beasts,” Master Liu Ke said in shock.
“In the third level, the transcendent-level Frost Ancient Tree was directly insta-killed by her.”
If she wanted to reach this power and instantly kill an extraordinary monarch cub, she had to have at least a level-five weapon.
Just like how a baby couldn’t withstand the recoil of a cannon, it was very difficult for a low-level life form to withstand the power impact of such an attack-type weapon.
Even if it was defensive equipment, it would also bring a certain burden to the user. The fluctuations caused by the energy shield that erupted in an instant when activated would make low-level lives very uncomfortable. If the attack strength was higher, even if the defensive equipment defended against the attack, the aftermath vibrations caused could also take the lives of low-level lives.
But Qi did it. Moreover, after the battle, it continued to walk towards the entrance of the fourth level as if nothing had happened.
“That’s indeed a level-five weapon at least…!” Master Gerin said.
“Yeah.” The administrator, Liu Ke, nodded.
“Moreover, just ordinary level-five weapons are definitely not enough. It’s impossible for Qi to control ordinary level-five equipment.”
“Who exactly did she get this equipment from? Master Ge Lin, you can’t forge it, right?”
Master Ge Lin was silent for a moment. Indeed, under normal circumstances, her highest work was level-six equipment. If she used various rare materials and had help, it wasn’t impossible to forge level-seven weapons and equipment that were legendary and overlord.
However, although the energy level was high, the quality level was definitely not as high as this level-five equipment.
Because…
“This might be a weapon with an artifact spirit and autonomy. There’s only one possibility,” Liu Ke said.
Weapons and equipment with self-awareness might not necessarily be the best weapons and equipment, but the best weapons and equipment must have self-awareness!
Even if the energy level of this kind of equipment was very high, there was not much pressure for low-level users to control it.
In ancient Tingxiang, such equipment was not very rare. Some famous legendary weapons could have spirits.
But in the modern era, it was already very difficult for antique swords and other weapons to nurture spirits and become transcendent life forms.
Moreover, the weapon in Qi’s hand was still autonomous, but not a life weapon. This was even rarer.
Even legendary blacksmiths would find it difficult to forge it.
It had to be said that although Buggy’s race level was not high, its Imagination Phantom was a divine skill.
“Weapons and equipment with a certain level of consciousness… I see.” Master Ge Lin clicked her tongue. Such weapons and equipment were extremely rare. Dr. Shi Yu was really generous. He gave them to Qi just like that.
No wonder Qi confidently came to challenge the trial. Such weapons and equipment were indeed the most suitable for Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 801 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (3)
chapters.content:
801 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (3)
If it was a level-five equipment with its own consciousness, it should be able to let Qi pass the first four levels, right? Or even the fifth level?
“This…” Administrator Liu Ke was shocked again.
“What’s wrong?”
“The Warhammer Giant in the fourth level was also insta-killed by an arrow,” Liu Ke muttered.
!!
It was a giant cub of a quasi overlord race, but it was nearly ten meters tall.
But perhaps, in the eyes of the current Qi, it was a living target.
“What happened?” At the same time, more and more people noticed Qi’s crazily rising ranking and were stunned.
That Qi had passed the fourth level in less than a few minutes?
It had already defeated a transcendent-level opponent of a quasi overlord race?
“What’s going on?” The Beast Tamers and elves present had different levels, but at this moment, they were all attracted by Qi’s quickly rising ranking.
This wasn’t the end.
Soon, the fifth level was passed!
Even if the opponent’s strength reached transcendent race commander rank, inside the trial mystic realm, Qi still insta-killed with an arrow.
This stunned the other members of the royal family.
The sixth level, commander rank, seventh level, low-level monarch rank. As expected, there was still not much pressure. The arrow ended it.
Until she reached the eighth level. From this level, the guardian was unique.
The guardian of the eighth level was a spatial humanoid sprite of the quasi overlord race, commander rank. It was one of the new generation of guards in the palace. It looked at Qi in front of him in silence, not understanding how Qi, an Awakening-level elven girl, came here.
[Isn’t this the little princess who doesn’t know transcendent power?]
“Protector Lendi…” Qi also knew this young guard. After knowing that the other party was a spatial element, the longbow in her hand flickered and turned into a white tachi. The tachi was still very long, so it was more difficult for Qi to pick it up.
“What’s this?” Lendi was still silent. Seeing the other party’s longbow become a tachi, he felt a sense of novelty and muttered to himself.
Before he could think too much, a voice suddenly sounded.
“Idiot, deal with it with all your might. Don’t be careless!” This voice stunned Lendi, because this voice was the voice of the manager of the mystic realm, Old Master Liu Ke.
Lendi’s heart immediately skipped a beat. He looked at the pink-haired elven little girl in front of him in a white dress. He saw that after she transformed the weapon into a white tachi, she raised it above her head and slashed down at him.
It was as if it could swing a sword aura.
“Concealment!” Lendi was indeed not careless. He used the most shameless move of the spatial element, Concealment.
This move had another name on the legendary Beast Tamers, called Etherealization.
It was a move that could let one hide in the subspace. Under normal circumstances, only spatial moves could hit life forms in this state.
Of course, if the power of the move was strong enough to distort subspace, it could also affect it. This power had to at least be the power of an overlord’s attack. However, in such a strong attack, the consumption and reward were not proportional.
Therefore, the spatial element was really invincible at times.
After Lendi entered the concealed state, he looked at Qi again, but then a painful scene appeared. During the process of Qi slashing down the Space Splitting Blade, a white halo spread on it. Then, the space in front of the Space Splitting Blade shattered like a mirror. A shock wave swept up an incomparable spatial vibration power and attacked him in the concealed state.
During this process, Lendi seemed to see countless transparent spatial butterflies flying.
And around him, the chaotic space had already been locked, making him unable to move at all.
He looked shocked and panicked.
At this moment, Qi finally understood what Shi Yu meant by being confident.
Boom!
After the attack, she looked at the ruined world in front of her in silence and looked at the weapon in her hand, the Space Splitting Blade.
This was a weapon condensed by Eleven, who had the strength of an overlord, with Hardening and Space Quake. It was also enchanted by Buggy with the Space Butterfly Phantom.
“Ge Lin, how can her weapons and equipment still change forms!!”
“It’s actually a spatial weapon!”
“And this power is no longer as simple as a level-five equipment. Level-six, level-seven?!”
“Who exactly gave her the weapon?”
Master Ge Lin was also silent. She knew that she was wrong. It wasn’t level five. Did this Dr. Shi Yu have divine ore at home!!
In the outside world.
As Qi passed the eighth level, it was already completely chaotic. The geniuses of the royal family looked at the name that jumped onto many people’s heads in a daze, unable to understand.
“What exactly happened?”
The ninth level was already a monarch-level guardian.
Generally speaking, even the geniuses of the Tingxiang royal family found it very difficult to win above their level in this level.
Because the guardians of this level basically mastered “deterrence” with high proficiency.
Deterrence was usually a greeting gift for the guardians of level 9 to 12.
It was to test if the guardian was qualified to come to this level to guard it.
And for Qi, who had the Umbrella of Time, this level was even simpler than the previous levels.
The tachi turned into the form of an umbrella again. Qi walked into the ninth level step by step. Just as she stepped in, an overwhelming monarch aura swept over with an expert-level deterrence wave!
Boom!
Qi opened the umbrella, and a mini black and white panda metal accessory pendant appeared at the tip of the umbrella. Then, a terrifying deterrence that shook the world erupted from the opened umbrella shield!!

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 802 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (4)
chapters.content:
802 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (4)
Buzz!
The white substantialization of the deterrence wave that was like lightning instantly swallowed the deterrence of the guardian of the ninth level and squeezed over. Before the guardian of the ninth level could react, his eyes instantly turned white. He was knocked out by the backlash of Qi’s mental defense equipment and the panda pendant.
The white substantialization of the deterrence wave that was like lightning instantly swallowed the deterrence of the guardian of the ninth level and squeezed over. Before the guardian of the ninth level could react, his eyes instantly turned white. He was knocked out by the backlash of Qi’s mental defense equipment and the panda pendant.
At this moment, Qi was getting more and more excited. Was this really just defensive equipment?
This panda accessory was wrapped in a Dao Proficiency deterrence wave and contained Eleven’s overlord will. Not to mention the deterrence of a monarch-level ferocious beast, it could even protect Qi from a standard overlord-level deterrence.
After all, with this full-level deterrence binding skill, Emperor Wu had created the Iron-eating Beast Training Ruins that had lasted for 2000 years. To this day, the deterrence fluctuations of the stone pillar still had its own consciousness.
…
At this moment, Shi Yu was still researching the possibility of the Time Sprite reincarnation with Ling. He had no idea that Qi had already started to kill indiscriminately at the royal trial in Tingxiang with the top-notch equipment they had given him.
Outside the trial mystic realm, a group of young royal geniuses looked at the eleven stars behind Qi’s name and their mouths were already agape.
Qi didn’t come out for a long time, which meant that she was challenging the twelfth level.
Under their incomprehensible and unbelievable calls, more and more geniuses of the Tingxiang royal family came when they heard the news. They looked at the name Qi on the Mystic Realm Ranking in shock.
How did Qi, an Awakening-level sprite who had never mastered transcendent power, reach the eleventh level?
How was this possible?
Even if she could control level-seven legendary equipment, it was impossible for her to defeat a monarch.
Weapons and equipment were just icing on the cake.
It could make up for the shortcomings of some pets and Beast Tamers, such as letting low-level lives withstand the deterrence of high-level lives and let their attributes be more comprehensive, but it would definitely not be too ridiculous. It would not exceed the enhancement of the Beast Taming Talent, and the strength of an equipment would not exceed the transcendent life form’s own transcendent ability.
Otherwise, equipment would have long been mainstream.
“I don’t understand.”
“I don’t understand either.”
“Don’t tell me that Qi has a legendary weapon or divine weapon in her hand!”
“Stop kidding. Where did she get that kind of thing? I believe that the mystic realm is broken.”
The guardian of the twelfth level was a top-notch monarch that could temporarily match overlords. It was very difficult to defeat.
Its normal energy level reached eight million. Its race was the huge tree of war, the overlord race, the monarch level.
In a 1VS1 situation, there were only four people in the new generation of Tingxiang who defeated it.
In the forest area of the twelfth level, it was undoubtedly very difficult to defeat it, but at this moment, an unimaginable scene occurred.
“Da da da da!!!!!”
The opponent in the twelfth level was indeed very strong. Qi also fell into a bitter battle.
She was carrying a heavy huge machine gun. On the machine gun, dazzling light bullets kept condensing, spewing light energy at the rate of thousands of light bullets every minute.
This machine gun was created by Baby Ginseng and Ling together. Using mechanical theory and plant-type knowledge, it could directly photosynthesize. Through the energy storage beam, it could condense light bullets in places with light and shoot.
The artifact spirit was Baby Ginseng.
The reason why she took out this weapon was because the Giant War Tree was too strong. The entire forest was its hands and feet. The attacks came from all directions, and it was very difficult to resist with other weapons.
“F*ck, what’s wrong with this kid?”
At this moment, the huge war tree hidden behind the scenes cursed in its heart. Seeing the plant army it controlled being destroyed by that exaggerated weapon, its heart turned cold.
It condensed a vine with all its might and wanted to penetrate this machine gun from the cover like a bullet or tie up the short pink-haired elven girl. However, when the vine approached the other party, a cold aura quickly rose around the other party’s body!
It shattered the vines and protected the little girl.
Susu’s protective water mutation ability!
At the moment, it was protecting Qi with the panda pendant in the form of a water drop accessory. It was also a protective skill that had been tempered to have its own consciousness.
“I don’t understand!” The Giant War Tree, which rarely had a match among monarchs, looked at this Awakening-level elven girl in confusion. It didn’t understand why she could pass the twelfth level and why she could control so many weapons and equipment.
“The Umbrella of Time is indeed very strong!” Riding the machine gun, Qi’s expression was red. Her chubby face was filled with madness and excitement. Her cherry petal-like delicate lips were tightly pursed, and she had gradually entered a state.
….
Of course.
At this moment, the most stunned person was still Master Ge Lin, who had watched Qi grow up.
At the start, it was alright, but when Qi started to instantly kill the spatial sprite in the eighth level, everything became wrong.
The guardian of the ninth level of the monarch level still lost his battle awareness in a single move.
Until now, Qi was fighting the veteran top-notch monarch war tree in Tingxiang.
“I don’t understand at all!!” Master Liu Ke, the administrator who had been watching the situation in the mystic realm, was speechless. As a top-notch master who could resist overlords, as a friend of a legendary dwarf and a legendary Mechanic, he couldn’t understand the weapon in Qi’s hand at all.
It was fine if it could transform.
It was fine if it involved multiple attributes.
It was fine if it contained a conscious artifact spirit.
It was fine if an Awakening-level little girl could easily control it and suppress a top-notch monarch.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 803 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (5)
chapters.content:
803 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (5)
But how was that possible!
He widened his eyes and saw that Qi realized that she couldn’t take down the huge tree of war. She began to try to control multiple weapons at the same time.
She even took out a landmine that knew Earth Escape.
…
Ten minutes later.
The royal geniuses gathered outside the royal trial ruins looked at the name that ran to the top floor in silence and saw that her clearance record had become full stars.
The royal members who were called over because this matter was too ridiculous realized that what they saw was even more ridiculous than what they had heard.
Qi.
Who didn’t know her? It was that Awakening-level little girl without transcendent power. She was only a child now. How could she pass the twelfth level!!
After all, among the elves who had passed the 12 levels in the past few years, one was the current royal archer, Chang’an Nice, and the other was the royal librarian, Lil. Both had overlord-level strength and were the strongest geniuses among the royal elves.
As for Qi… How was that possible?
At this moment, the royal members far away, Annie, Lil, Luo Yi, Hillia, and the other geniuses, were waiting outside the natural ruins with the Elven Empress and President Auland.
The natural ruins were also in the capital of Tingxiang. Lu Qingyi had been in there for a while.
Finally, light flashed. Lu Qingyi and Lian came out of the natural ruins.
They looked very excited.
“How is it?” The Elven Empress, Sylphra, smiled at Lu Qingyi and Lian.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to bring an impressive girl along. She actually contracted the daughter of the ancient guardian Wendy.
In theory, she should be able to obtain a lot of resources from the natural ruins.
After all, over the years, the resources in the natural ruins had grown faster than the rate they were being taken out.
“As expected, there are a total of two legendary resources, six level-eight resources, 19 level-seven resources, and several low-level resources.”
“So many!!!” Annie, Lil, and the others were shocked.
With this many resources, it might be a little difficult to create a totem, but it was definitely not difficult to pile up a few overlords.
“Two legendary resources!” President Auland was also very surprised. This was a huge gain.
“Not bad.” When the Elven Empress, Sylphra, heard that, her expression was not bad, but she sighed in her heart. It looked like she had waited for nothing. There were no Mythical resources.
She had mastered many special abilities, so Lu Qingyi couldn’t lie in front of her.
“Your Majesty, is it 50-50 according to what we said at the start?” Lu Qingyi said.
Even if this gain was 50-50, it was a huge sum of money to her. After all, it included a legendary resource.
Sylphra smiled and nodded without much thought. She knew that Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu had a good relationship.
“Just take what you need first.”
“Alright, thank you very much.” Lu Qingyi nodded.
In fact, the most important thing was still legendary resources.
There were a total of two.
One was a level-nine Wind God Flower, and the other was a level-nine natural fruit.
The Wind God Flower was a wind-element legendary resource. It could be used to strengthen wind-element pets. It was a strengthening resource.
As for the Nature Fruit, it was also a strengthening resource. It could increase the control of transcendent life forms over natural energy, but its usage conditions were even stricter than the Wind God Flower.
As long as the pet was wind-element and had wind-element skills, the Wind God Flower could be used to strengthen it.
However, the Nature Fruit was only effective for the elves.
In the end, Lu Qingyi chose the Wind God Flower and not the Nature Fruit.
