Firstly, Lian had already used a legendary resource to reach the overlord level. She and Lian discussed it and wanted to give the new legendary resource to other pets to use and add a second overlord to the team.
Secondly, Lian was no longer a complete elf. Although it still had affinity with natural energy, the effect of using the Nature Fruit was definitely inferior to using it by elves with flesh and blood. The cost-effective ratio was not high.
Therefore, after consideration, Lu Qingyi chose to hand the Nature Fruit to Tingxiang.
After obtaining the Nature Fruit, President Auland was still overjoyed.
The Elven Empress, Sylphra, didn’t mind a legendary resource. At her level, legendary resources were rarely effective against her. She had already reached a bottleneck in the cultivation of natural power and it was no longer something a natural fruit could help her with.
“Nature Fruit. If that little brat Shi Yu contracted the Courtyard Sprite, let’s give this to him as a gift. This friendship shouldn’t be small, right?” Sylphra thought.
Contract Sprite+Nature Fruit should be able to completely tie Shi Yu, a super genius who would definitely become a legend in the future, to the chariot of Tingxiang.
However…
She looked at the envious expressions of Annie, Lil, Luo Yi, and the other elven geniuses speechlessly.
Why did these guys come to visit her after losing Shi Yu?
Was it really alright…
At this moment, Lu Qingyi, President Auland, and the others were dividing their gains on the spot. However, at this moment, President Auland received an important message.
“President Auland, in the royal trial, a new elf passed the twelfth level!”
On the other side, President Auland’s elven secretary was shocked.
“What?!! Who is it?” President Auland was also shocked. She didn’t remember anyone else having that potential.
Perhaps Luo Yi could in the future, but she was with her right now.
“It’s Qi, that Qi without transcendent power.”
“How is that possible?” President Auland said.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 804 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (6)
chapters.content:
804 Killing with the Umbrella of Time (6)
She only felt that the secretary was teasing her.
“Auland, what’s wrong?” Sylphra looked at Auland.
Auland said, “Your Majesty, my secretary said that Qi… that elven girl without transcendent power passed all 12 levels of the royal trial.”
“Huh?” The Elven Empress was stunned. She felt that this name was a little familiar.
There was no transcendent power… Back then, the elves indeed had a special elven baby without transcendent power.
However, she couldn’t see any problem with the other party either. She only treated it as a special case of mixed blood.
“Qi?! She shouldn’t be very old.”
President Auland’s words not only surprised the Elven Empress slightly, but Annie, Lil, Luo Yi, and the others were even more shocked.
Qi? That Qi who was still practicing archery on the training ground just now? How was that possible?
“Strange.” The Elven Empress pondered slightly. She had confirmed that it was impossible for Qi to awaken transcendent power. Even if she helped the other party optimize their race, it was very difficult. In this situation, unless she used suitable legendary resources to change her fate, there was a trace of hope of awakening transcendent power.
However, it was impossible for Tingxiang to use a legendary resource that had a chance of strengthening totems on a little girl.
Moreover, suitable resources were not so easy to find.
Therefore, Qi’s situation was unsolvable. How did this Qi pass the 12th level of the trial? She had personally built the mystic realm, so she still knew the difficulty.
“Is it over?” The Elven Empress, Sylphra, looked at President Auland, Lu Qingyi, and the others.
She planned to go to the trial mystic realm to take a look at Qi’s situation.
….
At this moment, outside the mystic realm, Qi walked out happily and excitedly.
She passed!
12 levels!
She was still not proficient in the use of the Time Umbrella. Even so, only four young people had passed the royal trial in the past ten years!
[I’m still too weak. If I had a higher affinity for natural energy, the power of these weapons could be greater…] Qi Xin thought.
The physiques of the elves were very close to natural energy, so they were like fish in water when using these weapons and equipment that mobilized natural energy.
Although she couldn’t awaken skills, Qi felt that Shi Yu’s reminder was right. In the future, she could major in natural physiques to increase her proficiency in controlling weapons and equipment.
The elves were born with a natural physique. It could be seen as having half an All Things Affinity talent. Ordinary pets could only have a physique like the elves when they reached the overlord level.
Totems like the Vortex Demon Beast were like this. Even if it was so weak back then that it didn’t have a trace of energy, just its physique that could mobilize the power of nature could create a monstrous tsunami and force Shi Yu and the others into a desperate situation.
“Qi!”
As soon as Qi came out of the mystic realm, she discovered countless people looking at her outside.
Even the two royal Beast Tamers from Tingxiang who were going to participate in the world competition came.
This scene instantly shocked Qi, making her hug the white Time Umbrella in her arms tightly.
At this moment, these people were extremely puzzled. Qi looked like she was still at the Awakening level. How could she pass the 12th level?
“Little girl, what’s with your weapon…?”
At this moment, Master Liu Ke couldn’t wait to walk out and ask Qi about this umbrella.
He asked Ge Lin. This dwarf didn’t say anything. Although Ge Lin knew that it was given by Shi Yu, she wasn’t willing to talk nonsense without the agreement of Qi and even Shi Yu himself. Her temper was very stubborn.
Weapon?
Everyone looked at the white umbrella in Qi’s hand.
“Master Liu Ke, you’re saying that Qizhen really relied on equipment to pass level 12??”
They were completely stunned and couldn’t understand.
“Is that a divine weapon?”
“This…” At this moment, Qi immediately became nervous. She suddenly realized that she seemed to have caused trouble.
She had definitely caused a huge commotion by passing the 12th level.
Although Shi Yu had said that he didn’t mind her casually using this umbrella and letting her use it to challenge the levels, Qi instantly didn’t know what to do after being noticed by so many people.
“Qi, let’s go back first.” Master Ge Lin walked out and walked to Qi’s side.
But at this moment, everyone suddenly held their breaths and looked at a spot.
Because, with a spatial ripple, a few extremely noble people arrived.
Be it the royal Beast Tamers, elves, or outsiders like Ge Lin who came to work, their breathing stopped. They looked at the Elven Empress who appeared in front of them, President Auland, Annie, and the others beside her.
“Your Majesty.”
In an instant, all the members of the royal family present bowed and greeted. Qi was no exception and immediately bowed nervously.
“No need for formalities,” Sylphra said, then looked at Qi in the crowd. She was surprised, but she didn’t feel that she had become stronger.
It was still an Awakening-level energy wave…
“Qi, right? I just heard from President Auland that you passed the 12 levels of the trial?”
At this moment, everyone around looked up in surprise. They didn’t expect that passing the 12th level would attract the empress.
Incredibly, even when Annie, Lil, and the others beside the empress passed the 12th level, the empress didn’t pay much attention, right?
However, Qi’s situation was indeed a little special.
“Yes, yes, Your Majesty.” Qi’s face was red as she looked at the Elven Empress nervously.
“Huh?” This mystic realm was established by the Elven Empress. Although she had handed the mystic realm to others to manage, after coming here, she instantly saw all the history that had happened in the first half a day inside the mystic realm.
At this moment, the Elven Empress’s expression changed slightly. She looked at the weapon in Qi’s hand and felt a little strange. Why was the artifact spirit of this weapon so similar to the butterfly she had seen in Dragon Palace City and Shi Yu’s butterfly’s power form?
“Who gave you this umbrella?” the Elven Empress said.
“It’s Lord Shi Yu…” Qi said.
Shi Yu!
When this name came out of Qi’s mouth, Lu Qingyi, Lian, Annie, Lil, and the others beside her were immediately stunned. They looked at the umbrella in Qi’s hand.
What was going on?
What was going on?
“As expected, it’s him.” The Elven Empress was silent and looked at Qi. Then, she turned to look at the more mature Annie and Lil. She was a little confused. Where did they lose?
What was Shi Yu thinking when he shook off the more mature and beautiful Annie, Lil, and the others to get weapons and equipment to get this elven kid?
At this moment, President Auland suddenly looked at Annie and the others. At this moment, these elven geniuses had blank expressions and had yet to react to what was going on.
“So… Qi really relied on this umbrella to clear level 12?!”
At that moment, even the empress asked about this umbrella. The surrounding Tingxiang geniuses began to find it even more unbelievable.
What exactly was this? They couldn’t defeat an Awakening-level elven girl? She defeated a top-notch monarch with this thing?
Shi Yu gave it to her?
Wasn’t Shi Yu the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang who had led Dragon Palace City to Tingxiang today!
They had heard a lot of Shi Yu’s experience at the banquet today, but they suddenly realized that they were not familiar with this guy at all. What was wrong with this guy? He gave an Awakening-level sprite an umbrella, and her strength was comparable to the current four geniuses of the new generation of the royal family?
They had yet to pass the 12th level. Didn’t that mean that they were inferior to Qi?
At this moment, the group of Tingxiang geniuses was completely stunned.
Moreover, why would Shi Yu give the umbrella to Qi…
“What exactly is Shi Yu doing?” Lu Qingyi’s face darkened. She felt that Shi Yu wasn’t someone who knew his place and always caused trouble. As expected, while she was entering the ruins, Shi Yu directly guided a little girl to clear the royal trial in Tingxiang…

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 805 The Weakest Overlord Qi
chapters.content:
805 The Weakest Overlord Qi
At that moment, everyone knew how Qi cleared the 12 levels.
Relying on weapons and equipment.
However, apart from a few people, most people still didn’t understand why Qi could clear the trial so quickly with just one piece of equipment.
For a moment, a knowledgeable librarian like Lil couldn’t think of equipment that could help Qi pass the 12th level so easily among the various legendary equipment collected by the elves.
Whether it was low-level or high-level, it was impossible for an Awakening-level Qi to control it.
It was impossible for a level 1 sprite to wear level 100 equipment.
Even some equipment with artifact spirits couldn’t recognize an Awakening-level sprite so easily. Although the conditions to use it after obtaining their recognition would be much lower, the owner recognition process was also a huge test for the user.
In an instant, Shi Yu became even more mysterious among these royal geniuses.
It wasn’t scary that he was strong. What was scary was that he could actually casually make an Awakening-level elf comparable to them through a piece of equipment.
This extremely mysterious image made the two Tingxiang geniuses present who were about to communicate with Dragon Palace City tomorrow feel a huge pressure.
“As expected of you.” Lu Qingyi looked at the umbrella in Qi’s hand and fell into deep thought.
As one of the people who understood Shi Yu the most, Lu Qingyi was the first to know what was going on.
Perhaps there was a phantom created by Buggy as the artifact spirit in that weapon.
Shi Yu often used this strategy. For example, in the martial arts conference, Shi Yu used an Ice Dragon Blade to summon the Ice Dragon Artifact Spirit Phantom to assist him in battle. He cooperated with the Artifact Spirit Phantom to lead and defeat monarchs above his level.
For example, in the National League, he even let Chi Tong activate Mu Huiyin’s artifact spirit phantom on its own and form a combination skill that crossed a thousand miles with Buggy. It used the Interlocking Sword to crush Gao Xuan.
For the people around Shi Yu, it was no longer a secret that Shi Yu had mastered a set of skills to use phantom illusions as artifact spirits.
If this method was used, it could indeed allow this little girl to easily pass the 12th level.
Lu Qingyi was silent. She naturally knew the battle power of that butterfly. Whether her overlord-level sprite could defeat the divine dragon phantom it created with all its might was a problem.
Letting these illusions be equipment artifact spirits, wasn’t this a dimensional reduction attack? It was up to Buggy to do anything it wanted.
Lu Qingyi even suspected that even without this little girl holding a weapon, it wasn’t impossible for Shi Yu to let the weapon clear the level itself. No, it wasn’t impossible to let the artifact spirit leave the equipment to clear the level.
Lu Qingyi was immediately amused. It was right that the surrounding people couldn’t understand. After all, they didn’t know the power of Buggy’s imagination.
This ability was definitely a skill that dwarf blacksmiths dreamed of.
“Alright, you guys can leave.”
After knowing what was going on, the Elven Empress began to chase people away. After she spoke, although most of the Tingxiang geniuses gathered still had many questions, they still couldn’t bear to leave under the Elven Empress’s orders.
As for the Elven Empress, Sylphra, she looked at Qi and said, “Follow me to Shi Yu.”
In the Elven Empress’s opinion, Shi Yu’s behavior was definitely up to no good. This equipment was extremely ridiculous. To be able to make many legendary dwarves fight crazily to study it, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t give it to Qi for no reason. Therefore, she wanted to figure out what Shi Yu meant.
….
“…” Shi Yu didn’t expect the Elven Empress to bring Qi to him so quickly.
Wasn’t the Elven Empress visited by Annie and the others to study some natural ruins?
“Your Majesty.” After Sylphra arrived, Shi Yu immediately welcomed her.
Beside the Elven Empress, Qi, who was holding the umbrella, was very careful and didn’t dare to say anything.
“Shi Yu, did you give her that weapon?” the empress asked.
Shi Yu glanced at Qi and said, “Yeah, what’s wrong?”
“She took this and cleared the 12th level of the royal trial, causing quite a stir.” The Elven Empress looked at Shi Yu.
Among this generation of Tingxiang geniuses, only four people could normally pass the 12 levels she had established.
In the end, Shi Yu relied on equipment to help an Awakening-level elven girl pass. She suspected that Shi Yu was targeting her.
“Ah… Haha, is that so?” Shi Yu smiled in embarrassment.
It was indeed him who encouraged Qi to establish more confidence.
It was impossible to train her willpower like before.
He had to establish confidence and shatter it again. Then, he would establish it and shatter it again and again.
“Then why are you giving such a precious thing to her?” Sylphra asked with a smile.
“I haven’t had time to tell you.”
“I want to help Qi cultivate,” Shi Yu said. “This might be a weapon, but every weapon can help her better affinity with natural energy or help her train her physique during the use. It’s equivalent to a training tool.”
“Your Majesty, let Qi follow me to Dong Huang to cultivate.”
As expected…
The Elven Empress knew that Shi Yu must have chosen Qi to make such an equipment with such importance. However, what she didn’t understand was why Shi Yu chose Qi despite leaving so many elven geniuses behind.
“Why?” the Elven Empress asked.
Why… Didn’t she say that she wanted him to contract a sprite? Shi Yu complained in his heart.
“Firstly, it’s because even if Qi doesn’t have extraordinary power, she works very hard to train herself with various weapons and equipment. I like her personality very much. Secondly, her physique shouldn’t be as simple as it looks. The reason for the flaw might be because her potential is huge.”

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 806 The Weakest Overlord Qi (2)
chapters.content:
806 The Weakest Overlord Qi (2)
Shi Yu looked at the Elven Empress and said, “She’s very similar to my other companions. In the beginning, they more or less had some problems. Therefore, I want to try and see if I can help her change her fate.”
At the side, Qi’s gaze flickered as she looked at Shi Yu gratefully. As for the Elven Empress, she nodded.
Thinking that Shi Yu had discovered something special about Qi that even she didn’t discover, the Elven Empress felt that it was nothing. There were specializations in various fields, just like how even she couldn’t develop mechanical phantom beasts and Mythical mechanical phantom beasts. It was very normal for Shi Yu to have some unique insights.
She wanted to see how far Shi Yu, this legendary genius, could nurture this flawed elven girl.
“Qi, are you willing to follow him?”
The Elven Empress looked at Qi and asked for her opinion.
Although it was different from what she had imagined at the start, as long as Shi Yu could choose a Courtyard Sprite, a Tingxiang Elf, she would have achieved his goal.
“Yes, yes, I want to follow Lord Shi Yu.” Qi nodded.
“Then from today onwards, you can cultivate with Shi Yu. I’ll announce this later,” the Elven Empress said.
If the sprites of the Tingxiang royal family were contracted by outsiders, they had to be announced to the public. It was also a form of diplomatic relations.
At the same time, because they had left the royal family, the identities of these elves would also change slightly. Moreover, when they left, the royal family would also give them blessings and gifts.
…
After getting Qi from the Elven Empress, Shi Yu was much happier.
Regardless of whether Ling’s research results were right, it was definitely true that Qi had the power of a god in her body.
At the moment, Shi Yu’s plan was to let Qi, who had inherited the natural physique of the elves, continue to train her natural power. When she became stronger, her willpower level might increase.
The natural power from the outside world was different from the transcendent power in the body. It could be cultivated, but the difficulty was a little higher. After all, that was a skill that only overlords began to cultivate.
After the Elven Empress left, Lu Qingyi returned and found Shi Yu.
“In the library, you said you had something important to do. It’s to get the little elven girl in the training ground.”
The moment Lu Qingyi arrived, she had a smile on her face. However, this smile made Shi Yu feel a little guilty.
“How could that be?” Shi Yu said perfunctorily, but it was difficult to say about the Time Sprite.
Before the dust settled, he wouldn’t tell anyone, especially the Dragon God and the Elven Empress. That would only add a lot of trouble.
After all, traveling through space and time was too much of a bug.
After passing through space and time, he didn’t know if it would change the [Future] through the [Past] or create a new [Parallel Space].
Moreover, if teleportation was a divine skill, the cost of using it would probably be very high.
It was better to take it one step at a time and nurture it first.
“Don’t tell me you want to contract that elven little girl.” Lu Qingyi felt strange.
After she contracted Lian, she didn’t feel like she was raising a pet at all. Instead, she found herself a best friend.
Regarding this, White Brook was envious, jealous, and hateful. She expressed that she also wanted to be contracted by Senior Lu…
If it was this little elven girl, Lu Qingyi felt that it was no different from raising a daughter.
“It’s hard to say, but I’ve agreed with the Elven Empress that Qi should cultivate beside me next. This Qi’s physique shouldn’t be as simple as it looks. I’m more concerned about this. Her future achievements are definitely immeasurable.”
“Senior, what’s with that expression?”
Lu Qingyi was speechless. “I’m just worried that you can’t take good care of her.”
“She doesn’t have transcendent power herself, so she can’t train like other pets.”
“I naturally know this. There’s no problem. Senior, how’s the harvest from the natural ruins? From the looks of it, you should have just returned, right?”
At the mention of the gains from the natural ruins, Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “It’s naturally very sumptuous. Since you want to nurture sprites, I’ll give you some natural resources. By the way, in the next two days, I don’t want to watch and participate in the Dragon Palace City exchange competition. I plan to bring Lian to see other Tingxiang ruins. Previously, I’ve already made an appointment with President Auland.”
Shi Yu was amused. “I don’t plan to watch either. I’m going to the Space Emperor Ruins to hatch the egg first. I’ll leave this to Senior Ice Dragon to preside over. By the way, Senior, when you go, bring Teacher Ying along. It’s safer.”
“It’s better to let Teacher Ying follow you. Not many people here know me at all, but you…”
“From the situation of Tingxiang being enemies with the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire all year round… you’re the one in more danger. Don’t forget the relationship between the Dragon Empire, Dragon Palace City, and Dong Huang.”
The Dragon Emperor was the fourth legendary emperor of the Dong Huang Dynasty. Ever since he ascended the throne, Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City had always been on good terms.
A thousand years ago, the Dragon God was already a demigod-level expert.
Logically speaking, with the protection of the Dragon God, even if the Dragon Emperor died, the Dong Huang Dynasty wouldn’t collapse again.
In fact, that was the case. Under the protection of Dragon Palace City, although the Dragon Emperor died, the Dragon Emperor Dynasty didn’t collapse. Instead, under the protection of Dragon Palace City, it continued to be passed down for a long time.
However, if Dragon Palace City couldn’t even take care of itself, and if the Dragon God didn’t have the energy to protect Dong Huang, the Dragon Emperor Dynasty would be in danger.
At that time, the eastern totem countries directly joined forces with the Western Dragon Empire and other factions. At the same time, a totem war occurred against Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City. Because Dragon Palace City wanted to fight the Dragon Empire, which also had a demigod life form, it had no time to protect Dong Huang.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 807 The Weakest Overlord Qi (3)
chapters.content:
807 The Weakest Overlord Qi (3)
This battle lasted for hundreds of years, creating a new round of totem chaos.
Only when the Space Emperor rose and became the new legendary Beast Tamer of Dong Huang in the chaotic world did the chaotic world end again.
The Space Emperor even relied on his own attributes to become the most influential legendary emperor on Blue Planet. This was because he had established a spatial teleportation array that covered Blue Planet at that time and could instantly let the Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City armies reach various places on Blue Planet.
Therefore, as an invader from the West and defeated by Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang, it was normal for the Dragon Empire to have a bad relationship with Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang.
!!
As the leader of the Dragon Palace City exchange, Shi Yu might have already been targeted by the Dragon Empire.
Therefore, Lu Qingyi felt that it was better to let the gem cat go to Shi Yu’s as a bodyguard.
“Don’t worry about me,” Shi Yu said. “Don’t forget, I have the protection of the Dragon God.”
“Moreover… Susu has already accepted the Blue Sea inheritance and inherited the Blue Sea Ruins. With my identity as the owner of the Blue Sea Ruins, I can teleport to any projection of the Blue Sea Ruins at any time. No one can stop me.”
Just like how the protective water created by Susu could help Qi easily resist overlord-level attacks before its energy was exhausted…
The protective water created by the Dragon God could also help Shi Yu block the totem’s attack.
With such equipment and the Blue Sea Ruins that could be teleported at will, it was extremely difficult for even a demigod to keep Shi Yu.
It could be said that if Shi Yu couldn’t escape with these equipment on him, then letting the gem cat protect him would be equivalent to just throwing an extra cat for whatever this insanely powerful opponent was.
At this moment, Shi Yu had completely escaped the weak period where he needed bodyguards.
The world was a place that he could go alone.
“Wait?!” At this moment, when she heard that Susu had already accepted the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins, a trace of confusion appeared on Lu Qingyi’s exquisite face.
“Isn’t that… Isn’t that an inheritance that can only be accepted by overlords? You let it break through in advance for the world competition?”
“Is your body alright?”
Contracting an overlord above his level would drain him dry.
However, when she thought of Shi Yu’s monster physique, Lu Qingyi felt that her worries were unnecessary.
“No, no. It’s just that through the Time Fruit, Susu temporarily reached the overlord level and awakened the Blue Sea Ruins. In essence, it’s still at the monarch level. It won’t cause much burden.”
“In addition, because of strength, I didn’t completely receive the inheritance. I only received a portion and inherited the entry-level Blue Sea skill.”
Lu Qingyi: “?”
Was the Time Fruit for him to abuse like this…
Shi Yu smiled. “Senior, you should believe me now, right? With the Dragon God Protection and the Blue Sea Ruins, nothing will happen to me.”
….
That night, a big event was also announced in the Elven royal family.
The elven royal girl, Qi, was about to leave the palace and cultivate with the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Shi Yu.
As soon as this news was announced, everyone in the royal family of Tingxiang could be said to be extremely shocked.
Shi Yu’s name was already very famous in the royal family because of the banquet at noon.
Leading the ten overlords of Dragon Palace City, the founder of the mechanical phantom beast system, the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang… Not to mention this problematic girl without transcendent power, even whether those overlord royals were worthy of him was a problem.
As the news of Qi clearing the royal trial with the equipment Shi Yu had given her in the afternoon spread, some people who were originally very puzzled instantly fell silent. Then, they found it unbelievable and were shocked by Shi Yu’s actions.
Perhaps… this Big Boss Shi Yu really didn’t care about Qi’s state. After all, he had only given her one piece of equipment, and Qi’s battle power had leaped into the top ten of the new generation in Tingxiang.
Since he could strengthen this Awakening-level sprite that didn’t know any skills to this extent… How strong was Shi Yu himself?
In an instant, the royal family of Tingxiang was even more curious about the true strength of Dong Huang, the number one person below the legendary level.
“Qi, you have to cultivate well with Lord Shi Yu. Don’t miss this opportunity. You have to be obedient,” Master Ge Lin instructed.
At this moment, she already knew the power of the Umbrella of Time. This equipment could completely be called a legendary level-seven equipment. Perhaps only the legendary dwarves in the history of [Tingxiang Continent] could be forged.
In the 2000 years of history of [Tingxiang Ancient Nation], no one could create such equipment anymore. If this equipment was not obtained by chance by Shi Yu, but because Shi Yu had a forging channel, then if Qi followed Shi Yu, even if she couldn’t use extraordinary power in his life, her future achievements couldn’t be low.
“Alright!” Qi was full of energy.
Tonight was destined to be a sleepless night, especially for Qi, Annie, Lil, Luo Yi, and the other elven geniuses.
As the royal family announced that Qi was about to leave with Shi Yu, Annie, Lil, and the others could be said to be extremely stunned.
They finally understood why Her Majesty and President Auland looked at them like that in the afternoon.
[It was clearly me first…]
President Auland was also stunned because Her Majesty wanted her to take out the legendary resource [Nature Fruit] from the natural ruins as a farewell gift.
If it weren’t for the fact that the empress was supreme, President Auland would even think that the empress was crazy.
Legendary resources could almost 100% nurture an overlord. Even transcendent races might rely on legendary resources to strengthen themselves to an overlord. There was even a 10% chance of strengthening an overlord to a totem.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 808 The Weakest Overlord Qi (4)
chapters.content:
808 The Weakest Overlord Qi (4)
Moreover, it was a legendary resource that matched the elves like the [Nature Fruit]. It had to be given to Shi Yu and Qi?
“Just do it,” Sylphra said calmly.
It was just a legendary resource.
It wasn’t anything precious.
Moreover, Tingxiang didn’t lose anything. The fruit was obtained for free.
….
The next day, before the Dragon Palace City exchange banquet began, President Auland brought Qi to visit Shi Yu. At the same time, she handed Qi and the Nature Fruit to Shi Yu.
“This is…” Shi Yu held the pomegranate-like green natural fruit and instantly recognized what resource this was through the third index.
He was extremely surprised. Wasn’t this one of the two legendary resources obtained in the natural ruins that Senior Lu mentioned yesterday?
Due to the initial agreement, she returned it to Tingxiang and only kept the Wind God Flower.
“This is the legendary resource, the Nature Fruit. It’s a farewell gift from Her Majesty to Qi to leave Tingxiang. It can increase Qi’s affinity and control over natural energy. This is a physique strengthening resource. Even if she doesn’t have any transcendent power, she can still use the Nature Fruit. It can be said to be one of the few resources suitable for her,” President Auland said.
At the side, Qi was stunned. She didn’t expect that when she left, the empress would give her legendary resources.
Although everyone in Tingxiang usually took good care of her, the care level of legendary resources was clearly something Qi couldn’t enjoy previously.
Although Qi was a child, she was also very smart. She knew that these changes were brought about by Shi Yu.
“Thank Her Majesty for me. I’ll take good care of Qi.” Shi Yu didn’t stand on ceremony and also accepted the Nature Fruit.
This was indeed a good thing.
If it went smoothly, he might be able to use this to strengthen Qi to the pseudo overlord level.
As for why it was a pseudo overlord, it was because if she completely digested the Nature Fruit, although she might not be able to obtain overlord-level battle power, she should be able to master natural power attainments that far exceeded ordinary overlords.
After all, although she didn’t have any transcendent skills, the natural affinity of the elves was preserved.
After a monarch-level life form broke through to the overlord level, its physique would welcome a rebirth and become an affinity natural physique.
Even if they didn’t use the transcendent power in their bodies to form skills, they still had the ability to mobilize the power of nature to form elemental attacks.
Therefore, most overlord-level lives would choose to cultivate the power of nature.
Mobilizing the power of nature to cooperate with skill attacks was the battle mode of most overlords.
Only a very small number of overlord lives didn’t cultivate with the power of nature. Of course, this was also because they might have mastered stronger special powers, such as the power of imagination of Buggy, the power of life and death of Baby Ginseng, and the power of the Void Mantis.
Among them, the elves were born with natural affinity. When they were just born, they could sense the power of nature like other overlord-level life forms and the elemental particles floating in the air. Qi was no exception.
However, when they were weak, they couldn’t mobilize them like real overlord lives.
After the elves reached the overlord level, they didn’t need to specially cultivate at all. Their control over the power of nature was comparable to the years of bitter cultivation of ordinary overlords.
If Qi ate the Nature Fruit, she should also have an overlord-level natural physique. Although she didn’t have any skills, she could easily mobilize the power of nature to attack.
This battle mode might be more dependent on the arena. When it encountered the ability of the Anti-Demon Domain, it would immediately be blinded. It could be considered the weakest overlord, and the restrictions were even greater than the pure overlord physique.
However, the benefit was that if Qi mastered the power of nature, the equipment, the Umbrella of Time, should be able to display greater effects in her hands.
Weapons, the natural physique of the elves, and the artifact spirit could mobilize the power of nature to a greater extent to form an attack, displaying power that far exceeded the upper limit of the Time Umbrella.
However, since Qi had already joined the team, Shi Yu felt that he could return to the furnace to rebuild rough products like the Umbrella of Time that had been rushed out at the last minute and let Ling and the others spend more effort to process them.
President Auland left to prepare for the exchange competition. As for Qi, she stayed behind nervously and happily and looked at Shi Yu.
“It’s very bitter to cultivate with me. You have to be mentally prepared.”
“In addition, I’m currently a level-six Beast Tamer. My contract slot is already full, so I can’t sign a contract with you for the time being.”
“Since this fruit was given to you by the Elven Empress, you should eat it when you find an opportunity. At that time, you should be considered an overlord, right?”
Overlord level!
Qi said, “Can I directly reach the overlord level from the Awakening level?”
Shi Yu smiled. “Probably not. You have to digest it slowly. Moreover, it’s not that your energy level and life level have reached the overlord level, but that you have an overlord-level physique. Note that it’s a physique. You can only have control over the power of nature that’s not inferior or even far exceeds most overlords, but it’s very likely that you still don’t have any transcendent skills. Therefore, in theory, you can be considered the ‘weakest overlord’.”
Qi: QAQ
“But at that time, you should be able to better display the power of the Time Umbrella.”
The affinity of the elves with the power of nature was comparable to an elemental life form. It was top-notch. Moreover, it was an elf who would be eating a legendary exclusive resource like the Nature Fruit.
At that time, the cultivation speed of the natural power should be enough to reach the level of a top-notch overlord like the Sky Penetrating Whale.
“In the next few days, you don’t have to train in a hurry. Relax first. From today onwards, Dragon Palace City and your Tingxiang will have an exchange. I’ll bring you over to watch the battle. You come and broaden your horizons first and see the battle between true experts.”
“Alright!!” Qi nodded and listened to Shi Yu.
She didn’t realize at all that Shi Yu couldn’t be bothered with her at this moment and wanted to walk around the Tingxiang ruins as soon as possible. After all, time was tight…

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 809 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (1)
chapters.content:
809 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (1)
After Qi arrived, Shi Yu briefly told her about the future training plan.er
Moreover, he had to let Qi understand his advantage first.
“My advantage?”
Qi said in confusion and shook her head.
She felt that she didn’t have any advantage…
“I can’t think of anything, but I’ll work hard!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “If hard work is useful, there won’t be so few experts in this world.”
“In the records since ancient times, no legendary expert has relied on hard work to reach the peak, and no creature has relied on hard work to surpass overlords.”
“Bloodline, opportunities, resources, talent, direction… These are all more important than hard work. Hard work is just support.”
“Ah…” Qi was stunned.
“Let me tell you.”
“Your advantage is in your ‘bloodline’. You’re an elf. Although you look very ordinary in Tingxiang, especially among the royal family, you’ll know when you leave Tingxiang. Compared to the many species in the natural world, the natural physique of the elves is a huge advantage.”
“After familiarizing yourself with the power of nature, it can allow you to better control some equipment, such as the partial form of the Umbrella of Time. Under normal circumstances, after you use it a few times, its energy will be exhausted and it can’t be used again. But if you master powerful natural energy, you can replenish their energy yourself.”
“Apart from that, your advantage is still in the deeper ‘potential’. It’s this potential that suppresses your transcendent ability.”
“Then… what should I do?”
“You already have the resources. Thanks to your royal bloodline and your background, you obtained the natural fruit given by Her Majesty.”
Qi nodded silently. Yes, and because she had encountered Shi Yu, this should be considered an opportunity.
“Although you can’t become a top expert after eating the Nature Fruit, it’s not a problem for you to not be inferior to other royal geniuses.”
“But it’s just a legendary resource. It’s nothing. If the goal is a higher domain, you still have to develop the hidden potential to suppress your transcendent power.”
“Hidden potential?!” Qi opened his eyes.
Did she really have any hidden potential?
“Right.”
“If we can unearth this potential, it’s equivalent to hundreds of years of hard work by others.”
Qi gulped.
“Then I…”
“What you have to do is work hard.”
Qi: “?”
The little girl’s big pink eyes were filled with confusion, so should she work hard?
“I’m just letting you differentiate between priority and priority. I’m letting you know that your hard work is meaningful, because after you work hard, you can obtain a hundred times the reward. Of course, I’m referring to targeted training. Remember this. This is an important faith for you to be able to keep calm and not collapse in the next devil training…”
Qi understood, but she was even more afraid.
Therefore, what exactly was Shi Yu doing to her?
What kind of training did she have to undergo…
What bad thoughts could Shi Yu have?
He just wanted Qi to undergo a few rounds of the demonic training that Eleven and the others had experienced at that time.
The body passed through a snowstorm, bathed in magma, jumped down from the sky, swam in the deep sea, danced in a minefield…
Apart from that, this was only the foundation.
Previously, Qi had already established confidence. It was time to deal a blow.
The Umbrella of Time definitely had to be improved. Although this equipment was already the essence of the entire team’s strength and had used all the rare materials that could be used during forging, the details could still be optimized.
Apart from being offensive and defensive equipment, equipment could also be used as training equipment. Shi Yu was prepared to arrange for the Anti-Magic Armor and Dream Training Necklace.
When training Buggy and the others, Shi Yu’s psychological burden was relatively low, but Shi Yu really couldn’t bear to train an elf like this.
Sigh, it couldn’t be helped. Even a demigod reincarnation had its own overlord will, but an existence suspected to be the reincarnation of a Time Sprite actually had an extremely low will. He couldn’t be blamed.
For the sake of a beautiful future, he’d fight!
….
Before the storm arrived, Shi Yu gave Qi one last happy time to watch the exchange match. As for Shi Yu himself, he had already set off for Tingxiang to hatch the altar.
That day, the overlord of Dragon Palace City and the geniuses of Tingxiang gathered. President Auland also personally arrived at the scene to watch the exchange competition.
After what happened yesterday, this group of Tingxiang geniuses was even more curious about Shi Yu than the dragon-element overlord of Dragon Palace City!
Even the elven geniuses like Annie and Lil, who originally didn’t plan to participate in the exchange, arrived and sat at the side.
“Sister Annie…”
At this moment, Qi, who was sent to the scene by Shi Yu, was directly caught by Annie, Lil, and the others and pulled to the courtyard area to watch the battle.
At the same time, Qi didn’t understand why the way Sister Luo Yi and the others looked at her was so complicated…
“Qi, where’s Dr. Shi Yu? Why don’t I see him at the scene?” Hillia said.
Qi shook her head. She didn’t tell her where Shi Yu had gone.
“Are you Qi?”
On Tingxiang’s side, there were only more than ten people. There were five contestants of the Tingxiang World Tournament and some royal spectators from Tingxiang. The structure was very simple. Their attention was all on Qi.
Among them, a human young man observed this pink-haired loli curiously. Clearly, he had already heard the news that the royal elf of Tingxiang, Qi, was contracted by Dr. Shi Yu of Dong Huang.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 810 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (2)
chapters.content:
810 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (2)
“Isn’t Dr. Shi Yu around?”
He looked around and said,
“Compared to challenging a dragon-element overlord, I still want to challenge Dr. Shi Yu.”
After all, Shi Yu was the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang, and he was the number one person below the legends of the new generation in Tingxiang… They were both number one people. They could spar.
“Qi, how’s Dr. Shi Yu’s strength compared to mine?”
A legendary mixed-blood male elf said. As the strongest contestant in this year’s Tingxiang World Tournament, he was also very curious about Shi Yu’s strength.
As for Qi, she might be the person who understood Shi Yu the most at the moment.
In his opinion, the value of Shi Yu, the number one person below the legend level, was definitely stronger than the idiot beside him. One was the number one person below the legend level of the new generation, and the other was the number one person below the legend level of the entire Dong Huang. How could they compare?
In his opinion, even if Shi Yu was not a legend, he was not necessarily weaker than a real legend.
“Very strong,” Qi said. In fact, she didn’t know much about Shi Yu’s strength.
Although Shi Yu had taken out such a weapon and equipment, Qi had never come into contact with Shi Yu’s strength.
However, Qi believed that Shi Yu was the most powerful. Even if he wasn’t now, she wouldn’t disappoint Shi Yu. When she unearthed her potential, she had to be able to help Shi Yu.
“Very strong.”
When the mixed-blood male elf heard this abstract answer, he smiled and shook his head.
“Rogue, I think it’s better if you don’t participate in the world competition.”
“Qi is right.”
At this moment, when she heard this group of people ask about Shi Yu’s strength, Annie seemed to have thought of herself yesterday.
“Annie, what do you mean? You seem to know something,” Rogue said.
“I just feel that with your strength, you’ll be in danger in the World Tournament.” Annie curled her lips and said, “I fought Dr. Shi Yu yesterday. I’m completely not his match.”
“What?” Annie’s words immediately attracted the attention of the five world competition contestants. They looked at Annie uniformly.
Annie, an overlord-level Fire Elf. In terms of strength, she wasn’t weaker than Rogue in his single pet state. She was the commander of the royal archer regiment in Tingxiang and had extraordinary strength.
She had fought Shi Yu?
“Sister Annie, you’ve fought Lord Shi Yu before?” Qi immediately looked at Annie beside him. She had just learned of this.
“Yeah, Lil, Luo Yi, and the others were all present at that time.” Annie nodded.
At the side, Lil and the others had complicated expressions. That battle…
“At that time, Dr. Shi Yu only sent out a monarch-level pet and didn’t go all out. He easily defeated me above his level.”
Annie looked at Rogue and the others mockingly and said,
“I feel that his full strength isn’t necessarily weaker than that Dark Elven Prince or that Flame Dragon King.”
The Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King were known participants of the World Tournament in the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire. They were both top-notch overlords with the bearing of invincible overlords.
“Looks like our Tingxiang’s generation is really not very good.”
“You guys should wash up and sleep,” Annie said heartlessly.
At this moment, the few contestants of the World Tournament had stunned expressions. They couldn’t believe what Annie was saying. Shi Yu… only sent a monarch-level pet to defeat Annie, who had extraordinary natural attainments?!
How was that possible?
At the side, Qi was slightly stunned. She felt that Big Sister Annie didn’t seem to be lying. Was Shi Yu so powerful?
“You’re not kidding, right, Annie?” Rogue’s expression froze.
That Dr. Shi Yu defeated the overlord sprite of Tingxiang with a single pet? Was he sure it was a single pet and not all of them attacking together?
….
At the border of Tingxiang.
Shi Yu had already arrived according to the guidance of the map. Although the location of the map was on Tingxiang, Shi Yu realized that to be precise, its geographical location was on a battlefield.
A battlefield where the three major factions of the Dragon Empire converged in the Dark Night Forest, Tingxiang, and Ancient Nation.
This was no longer the territory of Tingxiang, but a land without an owner, a buffer zone for three countries.
It could be said that it was a relatively dangerous place, but after thinking about it, Shi Yu still came over himself.
It was just the time to hatch an egg.
However, after arriving, what made Shi Yu’s balls hurt was that he didn’t find the so-called Starry Sky Altar after searching around!
As he lingered in midair, Shi Yu’s heart could be said to be cold and extremely complicated!
The thing he was most worried about had indeed happened.
The Starry Sky Altar was not an indestructible thing. It was established hundreds of years ago by the Space Emperor.
Too many things have happened in the past few hundred years. In addition, this place had become a battlefield. The Starry Sky Altar had probably been destroyed in the war.
“F*ck!!!” In mid-air, Shi Yu cursed. He even wanted to destroy the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire.
Why did the three of them have to fight here!
It was over.
The ruins were gone.
How could it hatch next?
He would die before he could succeed.
The egg would turn cold before hatching.
“Ling, Ling.” Shi Yu immediately asked the omnipotent Ling for help.
Ling: “…”
“To be precise, the hatching of the Starry Sky Egg only requires nutrients from the starry sky, right?”
“Since the Star Prayer Formation built by the Space Emperor can attract nutrients, can we absorb it with Susu’s Star Sea skill?”
“At the moment, the most important thing is that the nutritional starlight absorbed by the Starry Sky Egg the first two times is not the same type. The starlight summoned by this geographical location is definitely not the same type. Moreover, what Susu summoned is definitely water resources. The difference from the form of light resources is huge. Can you figure out what the Starry Sky Egg needs? When the time comes, can you change the light water?”

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 811 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (3)
chapters.content:
811 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (3)
Ling: “…I’ve preserved the data of the previous two light resources. As long as there are enough water resources summoned, I can try to study them.”
“That’s good. It’s all up to you!!” Shi Yu’s eyes were filled with tears. Fortunately, he had Susu and Ling. Otherwise, if the Starry Sky Egg couldn’t hatch halfway, he would have to shut himself down.
Since he could do it, Shi Yu was relieved. He immediately summoned Susu and Ling and got Susu and Ling to load it together.
“Ning!” Susu, who was in the form of a Water Slime, wore mechanical glasses and an antenna mechanical hat and looked up at the sky.
The goal of doing this was firstly to let Susu benefit from Ling’s luck enhancement and summon the water resources needed at once. Secondly, it could help increase Susu’s strength and summon an even larger number of water resources.
Previously, absorbing all the resources required more than a day for the Space Beast Egg. The nutritional content it needed to completely hatch was probably not a small number.
“Let’s begin.”
Shi Yu took a deep breath and summoned Buggy again. He used the Imagination Domain to change the weather of the barren mountain here, covering the traces of them summoning the sea of stars. Then, he began to move.
This summoning… lasted for half a day. Shi Yu and the others summoned a lot of water resources. They were basically all level 5. When it was dark, it was only level 4.
Most of these resources didn’t have high energy levels. They probably wouldn’t be good either, because there were repetitions.
Could something that appeared repeatedly when drawing something be good?
After half a day, Shi Yu felt that he had suffered a huge loss. After all, Susu and Ling had even tried the Time Fruit just now, but they had only summoned level-5 resources. If not for the fact that Susu had unlimited energy, they would have suffered a huge loss.
Selling the Time Fruit directly was better than this.
“It’s better than nothing. Perhaps it’s these ordinary resources. After Ling studies them, they’re the nutrients the Space Egg needs.”
With this mentality, Shi Yu continued to develop telepathy at the side. It didn’t delay his cultivation. Time was money.
Just like that… a day later.
The exchange competition had been going on for a day. On his side, there were still level 3 to 6 resources. He didn’t like to sell them much. The most annoying time was when he only pulled down level 3 resources. Of course, the most impressive battle result also pulled down a level-six mutant water blob.
However, it was still lacking.
It made Shi Yu wonder if Ling’s good luck bonus was really effective.
Forget it. As the Starry Sky Altar was gone, he didn’t know when he would come to Tingxiang next. Shi Yu planned to summon it here for three days.
He summoned more strange water for Susu to study.
In the capital of Tingxiang, after a day, the overlord of Dragon Palace City and the contestants of Tingxiang had basically communicated.
In the end, there was no doubt that apart from the two Legendary-level masters in Tingxiang, the other three top-notch masters, even the number one person below the legend level of the new generation in Tingxiang, were beaten up by the overlord of Dragon Palace City.
Although top-notch masters had the strength to fight against overlords, it still depended on what overlord it was.
Among them, the two legends of Tingxiang fought alone with overlord pets. They were about evenly matched with the ordinary overlords of Dragon Palace City. Among them, Legend Roke challenged the Sky Penetrating Whale General, but even if seven pets attacked together, they were not its match.
Shi Yu had already known all of this through the Cube clone Ling had left at the exchange venue. In short, the exchange competition was relatively smooth, but Shi Yu’s side was not very smooth.
The next day, Shi Yu did not even see a level-six resource.
Although the nutrients they needed had little to do with the level of the resources, there were no surprises after two days. It was inevitable that Shi Yu would sigh. If he wanted to pull down resources above level seven, he would probably have to wait for Susu to reach the totem level.
“I’m willing to sacrifice Yun An’s 100 years of lifespan in exchange for a golden legend!” Shi Yu said casually to the sky after developing telepathy for two days.
At the side, Susu and Ling curled their lips. This was not sincere at all.
Huh?
However, a few seconds after Shi Yu finished speaking, Susu’s expression suddenly froze. Ling, who was beside him, was also slightly stunned. They looked at the sky.
A purple light spot appeared in the deep sky like a star.
“What a strong energy wave…” Shi Yu was delighted when he observed the strange water through the contract with Susu and Ling.
Although he didn’t know if it had reached the level of a legendary resource, there should definitely be a level-eight resource.
“Susu, Ling, I wronged you guys. You guys are good.”
“Ning!!” Susu straightened its back.
It also felt that it hadn’t been easy.
Although it felt that this might be thanks to Ling’s Wind Blessing.
But soon, as the purple light in the sky became stronger and stronger, Shi Yu’s expression was slightly strange. He had an ominous feeling.
Ling’s expression was not very happy from the beginning to the end. It was very calm…
“Master, there won’t be good luck in the world for no reason.”
“The commotion of this strange water descending is gradually expanding. It’s even more dazzling than the water resources summoned just now.”
“It’s like a dazzling comet falling from the starry sky, as if it’s afraid that others don’t know that a rare treasure has descended and keeps scratching its head,” Ling said.
“Buggy’s Imagination Domain can’t cover its light at all.”
Shi Yu’s expression darkened. He felt that this was a scam.
He raised his head slightly and sighed. He only hoped that this unlucky water ball would land quickly… It was so slow…
….
Although he didn’t sense anything further away, in the nearest city of the three major factions on the battlefield of the three countries, something stirred.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 812 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (4)
chapters.content:
812 Strong Enemy in the World Tournament (4)
The experts inside undoubtedly discovered the abnormality in the sky and saw a purple meteor descending towards the battlefield area.
“Roar!!!”
In a mountain city in the Dragon Empire, a powerful overlord dragon slowly flew up and looked at the sky. It spread its fiery red wings and swept away the flames.
There was something strange, something fishy, and a treasure.
In another Forest City, a tall and handsome dark elf also hid in the darkness after seeing the phenomenon in the sky.
In the protective city of Tingxiang, the legend Beast Tamer, Jesse, frowned.
“I’ll go take a look. You guys pay attention to the changes.” After giving the order to his subordinates, he summoned a golden griffin and soared into the sky.
A treasure from outer space landed on the battlefield!
After discovering this, the three major factions immediately took action.
Although the few countries around Tingxiang had signed a peace agreement during the World Tournament, it was impossible not to fight for the descent of an extraterrestrial treasure.
Soon.
The Flame Dragon King from the Dragon Empire, Punkham, was the first to arrive. However, just as it arrived, its expression changed drastically.
It saw a totem ferocious beast.
It was an incomparably huge black yak, even larger than its Fire Dragon King body. Its entire body emitted an ominous aura of death. It was in the rolling black mist, and its eyes were dark blue flames.
It had sticky black flesh, a mouth dripping with mucus, and short distorted legs. At the end of its legs was a black hoof that could barely be called a “bull” hoof, making it emit a terrifying aura.
Its entire body emitted a faint deterrence!!!
This deterrence was only faintly revealed and not targeted at anyone, but just looking at this Black Meteorite Yak, this Fire Dragon King felt a huge pressure. It felt that the other party’s life level and deterrence level were definitely above its own!
How was that possible!
Flame Dragon King Punkham was shocked. It had mastered transcendent-level deterrence!!
However, although the deterrence level of this monster was only slightly revealed, it gave it a feeling that it was enough to crush it.
This… was probably not a totem-level monster!
The Flame Dragon King, Punkham, suddenly looked at the person on the Black Meteorite Yak. For the time being, he was considered a human.
He was wearing a gray robe, and his beard and hair were gray. His body emitted a twilight aura, and his eyes were sunken.
This person slowly raised his head and looked at the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, “Little guy, what’s the matter?”
“You’re disturbing my master.”
Shi Yu spoke slowly in dragon language and used the Psychic enhancement to enter the heart.
Dragon language!
Seeing that the other party had even mastered the Dragon language, the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, became even more cautious.
This was a dark-element totem. This human was its servant!
How unlucky!
They actually encountered such a monster.
The Fire Dragon King felt extremely unlucky.
It looked like this treasure was not easy to take.
[Damn it, where did this guy come from? Why is he so strong?] At the same time, Shi Yu cursed in his heart.
[Race Name]: Flame Dragon King
[Attributes]: Dragon, Fire
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 90,130,000
Shi Yu felt that it was a scam. This was probably a dragon with strength comparable to General Whale.
Fortunately, Shi Yu had expected that an overlord would be attracted over in advance. He had Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and Chi Tong put on makeup for the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet in advance.
At this moment, the Black Meteorite Yak’s puppet looked no different from a real totem life form. This was also the reason why the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, was afraid.
Of course, if they really fought, Shi Yu and the others would probably fall into a bitter battle when facing this guy. It was completely uncertain if they could win.
If Eleven was already at the overlord level, Shi Yu was confident, but now, facing a top-notch overlord…
Even if he could win, the price would be very heavy. If possible, Shi Yu was unwilling to fight.
After all, he wasn’t here to cause trouble.
“Who are you?” In the face of the totem, although the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, was afraid, he wasn’t too afraid.
Shi Yu smiled faintly and ignored him. Instead, he looked into the distance.
At this moment, as a black wind swept over, a dark-skinned white-haired elf with pointed ears also appeared in midair.
He also looked at the Black Meteorite Yak and Shi Yu in silence before looking at the Fire Dragon King.
Obviously, they were all experts attracted by the purple strange water descending from the sky. The speed at which they arrived was faster than Shi Yu imagined!
[Race Name]: Dark Elven King
[Attributes]: Dark
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 89,110,000
Shi Yu felt that it was indeed a little dangerous overseas.
If he had known earlier, he would have brought the cat. He would have been more confident.
At the same time, what made Shi Yu feel intrigued was that the index of the new Intelligence Bureau he had joined also had new information about the two overlords.
The Fire Dragon King and the Dark Elven Prince were suspected to be the representative overlords of the demigod faction, the Dark Night Forest, and the Dragon Empire, participating in the World Tournament. Their strength was extremely dangerous!!
Apart from that, the two of them each had a legendary hybrid Beast Tamer as a contracted servant. Because their bloodlines were the same and they specialized in contracts, they could provide a powerful battle power increase.
In the Intelligence Bureau index, it reminded them to be extremely careful of these two overlords. At the same time, they had to obtain more information about them when the conditions allowed.
“Ridiculous,” Shi Yu thought to himself. He hoped that these two guys wouldn’t be ungrateful and obediently leave the purple strange water to him. He hoped they didn’t cause trouble. Otherwise, even if he couldn’t deal with them now, they would have a good time during the World Tournament!

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 813 Target: Totem
chapters.content:
813 Target: Totem
“Looks like I came at the wrong time.”
After the Fire Dragon King and the Dark Elven Prince, the legend of Tingxiang also rode his griffin to descend here.
He looked at the scene solemnly.
The mysterious totem Beast Tamer, the enemy top-notch overlord of the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire!
!!
It looked like the purple starlight in the sky had attracted a lot of commotion.
“Another one,” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
< Name > Golden God Gryphon
[Attributes]: Metal, Wind
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 79,110,000
This legend from Tingxiang should be a general guarding the border of Tingxiang. His strength looked pretty extraordinary.
Although the pet attributes didn’t seem to be comparable to the Flame Dragon King and the Dark Elven Prince, if the Beast Taming Talent and the support of other pets were included, they weren’t necessarily much weaker.
It was one of the few legends Shi Yu had seen with strength. It was much stronger than Aunt Hua’s 50 million butterflies.
It was so annoying.
“You guys…” Shi Yu’s voice in the form of Old Demon Lin became deeper and deeper.” Don’t tell me you’re here for that thing in the sky. ”
“When a treasure descends, the capable should take it.” The dark elven prince smiled warmly and sized up the Fire Dragon King, Shi Yu, and the general of Tingxiang in an unfriendly manner.
He was naturally familiar with the Fire Dragon King and General Tingxiang. He felt that they were very difficult to deal with.
As for this mysterious totem Beast Tamer, he made the dark elf prince the most afraid. He was a dark-element Beast Tamer, so he could clearly feel the deepness of the terrifying dark power on the Black Meteorite Yak.
However, even if the opponent was a totem, if the resources that descended were very precious and reached the legendary level, he would still try to fight for it.
Although he might not be a match for the totem, he also believed that he wouldn’t be defeated easily.
“Nicholas, do you want to snatch the treasure from me?” The Flame Dragon King, Punkham, looked at the Dark Elven Prince and said.
“Lizard, don’t be too arrogant.”
Boom!
The deterrence of the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King erupted with a bang, instantly tearing apart the sky. Red and black deterrence waves collided.
Crack!!!
The powerful deterrence even affected Shi Yu and the others.
Shi Yu was expressionless. They were all transcendent-level deterrence fluctuations… The strongest overlords of these large factions were really troublesome, and they didn’t have any respect for the totem level…
From the looks of it, they were going to snatch it from him?
“These guys are really crazy.” Tingxiang’s general fell silent.
They actually wanted to snatch something from the totem.
Just as well.
The reason why Tingxiang was the weakest of the seven countries and could still be passed down despite being threatened by the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire was firstly because the Elven Empress was strong enough. Secondly, Tingxiang was in the Seven Nation Alliance and was protected by the alliance. Thirdly, the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire were not allies, and their relationship was not very good.
It could be said that if the totem factions in the world were united, then the humans had nothing to do.
In nature, the conflict between some races was even greater than the conflict between them and humans.
They all wanted to eat their lives. The ginseng baby race didn’t think that other races were any cuter than humans. This kind of check and balance was one of the important reasons why humans could rise.
“Coming.” Suddenly, the dark elven prince and the Flame Dragon King stopped facing each other and looked at the sky.
The purple water ball descended faster and faster, already descending ten thousand meters into the sky.
The Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King focused their attention and strength, preparing to snatch it. At the same time, they were secretly wary of the mysterious totem Beast Tamer.
But in the next moment, they were stunned.
Because as the purple strange water ball approached, the energy fluctuations on its body were clearer.
Although its power was not small, its energy level was only level eight.
It was not a legendary resource.
For a moment, Nicholas and Punkham hesitated, wondering if they should fight over a level-eight resource.
After an intense battle, the consumption and damage caused might not be something a level-eight resource could make up for.
Just as they hesitated, the gray-robed Shi Yu snorted. The air began to hum and vibrate. Almost corporeal spiritual power formed a blue outline around Shi Yu.
After entering the Psychic state that increased with Buggy, his mental strength level immediately reached the level of a top-notch overlord, not much inferior to the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King. He opened his blue eyes and looked at the sky.
A powerful Psychic wave bloomed from his body and shot into the sky to grab the strange water.
“On account of your elders, I forgive your rudeness, but I want to see who wants to snatch it from me,” Shi Yu said coldly. Level-eight resource!
Damn it, it wasn’t at the legendary level. However, even if it was only a level-eight resource, Shi Yu definitely couldn’t let others snatch it away.
Was it easy for him?
No, forget about level-eight, even level-one resources couldn’t be snatched away from him! It was his!
Moreover, this resource came from outer space. Although its energy level was only level eight, the quality of the resource might have reached a higher level. He couldn’t give up. It might be a key resource to hatch the Starry Sky Egg.
Boom!
The Psychic power that shot into the sky stunned the general of Tingxiang, the Prince of Dark Elves, and the Fire Dragon King for a moment. Their pupils constricted together as they looked at the gray-robed old man on the Black Meteorite Yak in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 814 Target: Totem (2)
chapters.content:
814 Target: Totem (2)
Because they could clearly sense that this power wave erupted from this old man.
A mental wave at the level of a top-notch overlord.
Who was the other party?
“A hybrid?” The dark elven prince’s heart trembled. After all, even his legendary hybrid servant didn’t have such a terrifying mental wave. It wasn’t even one-tenth of Shi Yu’s.
!!
“Who exactly is this guy?”
The Fire Dragon King didn’t attack either. It was similarly shocked by the changes in Shi Yu’s body. This was the use of the max-level Psychic skill, Psychic Link. It was very rare. What was rare was that both parties had to be connected and master the max-level Psychic power.
Perhaps for top-notch totem creatures, mastering this Psychic skill was not difficult, but for humans, even hybrid humans, it was too difficult.
Shi Yu’s move was peerless in the world, shocking the two top-notch overlords present again. At the same time, the deterrence on the Black Meteorite Yak seemed to have become stronger. Its indifferent ghost fire eyes revealed the concept of death as they landed on the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King.
Boom!
Although it was very weak and didn’t affect them much, a deterrence skill that directly hit the bloodline in their hearts made them even more serious. This max-level deterrence skill was undoubtedly very brilliant, letting the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King know that this was a warning to them.
[We can’t be enemies with it.] In an instant, the dark elven prince and the fire dragon made a judgment.
Making an enemy of a totem and his mixed-blood Beast Tamer servant for a level-eight resource was not a wise choice, especially at a critical moment like the World Tournament, even if they weren’t afraid.
General Tingxiang naturally didn’t attack either. He supervised the dark elven prince and the fire dragon the whole time. In the end, Shi Yu’s Psychic power locked onto the purple strange water ball and wrapped it up before putting it back into the ruins space!
Unknown resource!
But it contained strong star power.
He should know the effect after letting Ling study it later.
The other strange water balls summoned were also in this step.
Seeing that the strange water had been completely taken away by Shi Yu, the three parties were in a stalemate.
“In that case, I’ll give this totem senior some face.” The dark elf prince was the first to smile and give up fighting. At the same time, he said, “Senior, you look unfamiliar. You shouldn’t be an expert from the Tingxiang Continent, right? You’re a guest. Do you want to come to our Dark Night Forest to sit?”
After giving up the competition, the dark elven prince wanted to rope in the mysterious Black Meteorite Totem and Shi Yu.
“What’s there for you to go to the Dark Night Forest? Come to our Dragon Empire.” The Fire Dragon King spat out a mouthful of flames. Clearly, it had also given up fighting. It wasn’t worth offending the totem for a level-eight strange water that it definitely didn’t need.
Throughout the whole process, General Tingxiang didn’t dare to interrupt, because he knew that the gray-robed old man who recognized totems as the master was definitely not on the same team as the Seven Nation Alliance.
At this moment, Shi Yu had a strange expression. Alright, these guys sure know how to follow the wind.
Seeing that it was only a level-eight resource, it immediately didn’t want to snatch it anymore.
Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. He didn’t want to fight them either.
The other party’s race level, growth level, and skill proficiency were not inferior to Eleven and the others. Even if he could obtain the help of General Tingxiang, it would be a battle where both parties would suffer. He didn’t want to fight.
He would talk about it when he returned in two months.
“Sure, this is my master, the Great Dark Heavenly Saint Meteorite Bull God. We came to Tingxiang this time with the intention of visiting the two races,” Shi Yu said. “I’ll naturally visit later.”
Upon hearing that, the expression of General Tingxiang beside him changed drastically. Shi Yu was silent. He felt that this alternate identity was becoming more and more like a villain.
Unfortunately, he was too weak. Otherwise, he really wanted to go to the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire as a guest.
“I say…” At this moment, seeing the change in the situation, the general of Tingxiang also spoke.
His expression was unfriendly as he said, “This area has been Tingxiang’s territory since ancient times. Aren’t you too disrespectful to Tingxiang by being so presumptuous in Tingxiang’s territory?”
He spoke domineeringly, and the deterrence of the Golden Divine Griffin under him finally revealed itself, attracting the disdainful gazes of the Dark Elven Prince and the Flame Dragon King.
This battlefield was indeed the territory of Tingxiang, but now…
Just as they were about to counterattack, their expressions suddenly changed. They looked into the distance and turned to leave.
Shi Yu was stunned on the spot.
A moment later, a high and mighty creature with long green hair that looked like a goddess descended. She looked at the gray-robed old man on the battlefield and frowned.
“Your Majesty!” General Tingxiang was delighted to see the Elven Empress descend. The reason why he was so arrogant just now was because he knew that reinforcements had arrived.
In other countries, legendary-level experts rarely appeared and were all cultivating bitterly. However, because Tingxiang was the weakest country and was surrounded on all sides, the Elven Empress had no choice but to appear stronger. Even if there was the slightest movement, she would appear and let the enemy feel threatened.
Although she rarely attacked, it was indeed useful and had a deterring effect.
At this moment, a rare treasure and a mysterious totem Beast Tamer had appeared in the battle area of the three countries. The general of Tingxiang naturally reported it immediately, but he didn’t expect Her Majesty to personally come to the scene.
Although the various countries were currently in the midst of a peace agreement, and the Dark Elven Prince and the Flame Dragon King wouldn’t be killed by the demigods of Tingxiang, they were clearly still unwilling to face this Elven Empress directly and left immediately.
“I didn’t expect that the heirs of the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire would actually be deceived by this pretense.”

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 815 Target: Totem (3)
chapters.content:
815 Target: Totem (3)
Just as she descended, the Elven Empress saw that the Black Meteorite Yak was strong on the outside but weak on the inside. Her gaze landed on “Lin Ying”.
She was also very puzzled. Where did this old man come from?
“Your Majesty, the treasure that descended from the sky just now was taken by this old man.”
“He claims to be under the Great Dark Heavenly Saint Meteorite Bull God,” General Tingxiang said.
!!
It meant that he didn’t look like a good person. She should kill him.
Shi Yu : “…”
Sensing the Elven Empress’s gaze, Shi Yu panicked.
Wait a minute.
[Cough, cough, cough. Your Majesty, Your Majesty, it’s me. Don’t attack. I’m Shi Yu, on the same team.] Seeing this, Shi Yu coughed dryly and immediately said telepathically to the Elven Empress.
He opened his green eyes and looked at the Elven Empress.
[Disguise, it’s a disguise to scare the totem countries.]
He immediately explained that he didn’t want to be slapped to death by his own people.
Elven Empress Sylphra: …
[You brat…]
Sylphra was silent. She looked at the gray-robed old Shi Yu with a little stomach ache and was momentarily stunned. She carefully observed Shi Yu. Just now, her attention was all attracted by the Black Meteorite Yak. She could tell at a glance that it was a fake trick on the Black Meteorite Yak and ignored this human.
From the looks of it, the traces of time on his body were also very strong. It didn’t look normal.
Shi Yu?
Seeing this, the Elven Empress Sylphra was speechless.
Why didn’t this kid preside over the Dragon Palace City exchange in Tingxiang but instead came to the border to scare their city guardian general?
She now knew why the Dragon God didn’t want Shi Yu to run around recklessly.
“I understand. You can leave first,” Sylphra said to the general.
“Yes!” The Tingxiang general immediately nodded and left according to the order.
Then.
The Elven Empress looked at Shi Yu again. Shi Yu also looked at her in embarrassment. He really wanted to say to the Empress that she was so free. She even descended personally for such a small matter.
….
At the same time, the Dark Elven Prince and the Flame Dragon King quickly returned to their territory with shocked expressions. They didn’t know if that Great Dark Heavenly Saint Meteorite Bull God could successfully leave under that woman.
“Investigate the totem of a gray-robed old man and the Great Dark Heavenly Saint Meteorite Bull God.”
After they returned, they immediately got their subordinates to investigate the information about Shi Yu’s alternate identity. They were a little concerned about this outsider who had come to Tingxiang.
At the same time, after explaining the cause and effect of hatching the Space Emperor’s pet egg to the Elven Empress, Shi Yu was pulled back to Tingxiang by the Elven Empress.
“It’s very dangerous outside. There will be many situations like that just now. I promised the Dragon God to protect you, so you should stay obediently in Tingxiang.” Sylphra looked at Shi Yu with a headache.
She didn’t expect Shi Yu to run out of Tingxiang and almost fight the heir of the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire.
“Alright, alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
“In addition, you should have seen the Dark Elven Prince and the Flame Dragon King, right? They’re the heirs of the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire. Their status in this faction is comparable to the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City, the Golden Dragon Prince, and their strength won’t be much inferior. Therefore, little guy, you have to be careful during the World Tournament. Don’t show off too much. Such guys won’t be rare in the World Tournament.”
“In fact, it’s not impossible that even a totem might appear.”
The Elven Empress reminded Shi Yu.
In the world competition, the totem countries had an advantage over the seven countries.
Their contestants were mainly transcendent lives, and human Beast Tamers were servants.
The World Tournament only limited the age of human Beast Tamers.
Therefore, there were no strict restrictions on the battle power they could fight.
After all, servants could be changed at will. It was not difficult to nurture a legendary servant under the age of 30 against such a demigod totem faction.
However, the contracts of the seven countries were mainly human.
It was very difficult to directly contract an old top-notch overlord. It was basically a pet cultivated by him, and its strength was restricted.
Of course, it couldn’t be ruled out that some legends of the seven countries would choose to break a contract slot and cooperate with some old guardian overlords in the country to fight in the world competition. However, such old overlords in the seven countries basically had Beast Tamers. It was just that the Beast Tamers were dead, so it was very difficult to accept a new master. This condition was very difficult to achieve, unless the two generations of Beast Tamers were related by blood, or the top-notch overlord was an exclusive mechanical overlord built by the country at a huge cost. There was still a certain possibility.
In addition, the news of the World Tournament came too suddenly. There was only a year of preparation time, so it might not be enough time to train.
However, the seven countries also had a certain advantage. The Beast Tamers of the totem country basically only served one master. They were basically one master and one person. They opened up a special exclusive Beast Taming Space. On the Beast Tamers’ side, most Beast Tamers of the seven countries cultivated a lot of pets. If a battle happened, the number of pets would definitely have an advantage.
“Yes, I saw it. It’s indeed very strong.” Shi Yu nodded.
This kind of top-notch overlord with invincible aptitude had even cultivated high-level deterrence to perfection. Just like when Shi Yu faced the Void Mantis back then, it was not something he could match at his current stage. It was even fiercer than the Void Mantis. On his side, he indeed didn’t seem to have any advantage at the moment.
He could only continue to add points and take it one step at a time.
However, Shi Yu’s expression was solemn.
There would be totems?
Was she serious?
At that time, he would have a certain amount of confidence in an overlord like the Flame Dragon King, but a totem level…
Even if Baby Ginseng self-destructed, it definitely couldn’t be killed so easily in the face of a totem in perfect condition.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 816 Target: Totem (4)
chapters.content:
816 Target: Totem (4)
No, he had to strictly ask Eleven and the others.
Before the world competition, everyone had to have totem battle power!
“Next, you can move around in Tingxiang.” Lu Qingyi cracking the ruins had brought considerable gains to Tingxiang. The Elven Empress felt that Shi Yu shouldn’t be bad either.
“Alright,” Shi Yu had just replied when his expression changed slightly.
Some information appeared in front of him.
From the tenth bureau index.
