He had already joined the Intelligence Bureau. The index of the tenth bureau could actually share a lot of important information. Apart from that, the index of the tenth bureau had been specially modified and had a very powerful function.
It was that he could ignore some restrictions and communicate. For example, using a normal cell phone, he couldn’t communicate with the people in Dong Huang in Tingxiang at all, but through the tenth index, he could.
At this moment, in the country, a message was sent to him through the tenth index.
Fang Lan had disappeared and was suspected to have been sucked into a special ruin. At the moment, the ruin couldn’t be cracked, and the risks inside were unknown.
Fang Lan, the trainee member of Bureau 11 who summoned the Space Emperor Ruins.
Obviously, something had happened to her. As Fang Lan’s guide in the bureau, Shi Yu definitely had to receive the news first.
“What’s wrong?” Seeing Shi Yu’s expression change, the Elven Empress said.
“Your Majesty, something happened in Dong Huang. The situation of a junior from Bureau 11 falling into the ruins and we don’t know her situation. She’s only a Beast Tamer intern. She might be in danger. I have to rush back immediately to take a look.”
At this moment, he couldn’t care less about strolling around the Tingxiang ruins. The safety of the members of Bureau 11 was definitely more important.
The Elven Empress didn’t say anything. She only nodded and said, “Then you deal with it.”
Since Shi Yu had already chosen a sprite, the Elven Empress felt that it didn’t matter if the ruins were cracked or not. In any case, with Qi’s relationship, Shi Yu would come to Tingxiang often in the future. There was no hurry.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and immediately prepared to return to the country.
At this moment, the Dragon Palace exchange had yet to end. It could be said that it was still early. Apart from the battle, the overlords of the Dragon Palace naturally had to travel around Tingxiang. Shi Yu definitely couldn’t wait.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t contact Senior Lu and the gem cat at this moment. Shi Yu could only drag Qi away. After informing Ice Dragon, he returned to the country.
…
Dong Huang, Space Capital.
This was the second time Fang Lan had come into contact with ruins.
However, this time, it was a little sudden.
At this moment, Fang Lan’s parents were extremely anxious.
If Fang Lan’s strength could already take charge, they wouldn’t be so anxious. However, Fang Lan was only a high school student and had just become a Beast Tamer. Her pet was only at the Awakening level. With this strength, she couldn’t resist at all when she encountered danger.
Because of this, Principal Feng also came to the place where Fang Lan disappeared. He also called the other members of Bureau 11 to try to communicate with the ruins and crack them.
Just like when Shi Yu disappeared in the ruins of Emperor Wu, these archeological big shots mobilized.
Unfortunately, no matter who it was, they couldn’t find Fang Lan, who had been missing for several days.
Helpless, Principal Feng could only ask Bureau 10 to contact Shi Yu to see if he and Lu Qingyi had any ideas.
There weren’t many members of Bureau 11 to begin with, so Fang Lan, a future member, couldn’t have something happen to her during the internship stage.
“How’s the situation?”
Shi Yu returned to Dong Huang very quickly. After he arrived, he immediately contacted Principal Feng.
“You’re back, Shi Yu.”
“Do you remember Fang Lan’s two entry missions?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “One is to complete all the mechanical and archeological knowledge from high school to university in two years.”
“One is to investigate why she can hear the voice of the Space Emperor Ruins and whether she has anything to do with the Space Emperor.”
“Yes.” Principal Feng nodded and said, “This girl disappeared here when she was investigating more information about the Space Emperor.”
“There was originally an ancient battlefield ruin here. It was a protected area. I originally thought that it was just an ordinary ruin, just like the iron-eating beast ruin in the Ancient Capital, but who knew that there was also a ruin here that was summoned by Fang Lan, who came to investigate.”
“Then, she was sucked in, and the current situation is still unknown.”
“There’s no entrance to the ruins?”
“No, the ruins are currently in a completely closed state. The level of the ruins isn’t low. It should be a high-level ruin,” Principal Feng said.
“I’ll try to find it.”
Shi Yu nodded. At this moment, he was the core of Bureau 11.
At the moment, Shi Yu, who had mastered the full-level Psychic power and could connect to Buggy’s mind and transform into a human overlord, was incomparable to the ordinary legends in Bureau 11, be it the development of telepathy or his affinity for the ruins space and mystic realm space.
It was because of this that Principal Feng quickly called Shi Yu back after they couldn’t resolve it.
“Ling.” At this moment, only the Dragon God, the Elven Empress, and the others knew that Ling had successfully evolved into a Mythical race. At that moment, when he encountered such a thing, Shi Yu decisively summoned Ling, planning to let it possess him and increase his luck.
However, before Shi Yu could plan to fight, a spatial ripple suddenly appeared in the sky.
In the outside world, Principal Feng, Shi Yu, Grandma Li, and the others were stunned. In the camp, Professor Fang and his wife were also stunned.
Right on the heels of that, everyone saw light and shadow materialize. Fang Lan and her mechanical Tyrant Dragon came out of the ruins.
Shi Yu : “…”

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 817 Target is Totem (5)
chapters.content:
817 Target is Totem (5)
“I feel useless coming back,” Shi Yu said.
Ling: “Master, is it possible that this is also our good luck bonus?”
“You…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He felt that he couldn’t take credit for anything in the future. It was too easy for Ling to take credit for itself. No, he had to cut it. This way, he wouldn’t be able to experience his intelligence and talent.
“Lanlan.” After Fang Lan came out, everyone ran towards her, worried about her.
!!
At this moment, Fang Lan also had a look of realization. She felt like a lifetime had passed.
“Dad, Mom, Grandpa Feng, Grandma Li, Senior Shi Yu.” She looked at the crowd surrounding her and immediately knew how much commotion her disappearance had caused.
“Sorry to have made you worry.”
“Little Lan, what happened? Did you encounter any danger?” Principal Feng said.
Fang Lan shook her head and said, “No, no. It’s just… I encountered a remnant array spirit of the ruins.”
She looked at Shi Yu happily and said, “Senior Shi Yu, I understand why I can summon the Space Emperor Ruins.”
“Has Bureau 11’s assessment mission been completed?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “What’s going on?”
“That array spirit seems to have said that I’m the descendant of Senior Space Emperor. It also woke up because it sensed my bloodline.”
“What!” When Fang Lan finished speaking, Principal Feng was shocked.
Fang Lan’s parents were also shocked and immediately looked at each other.
Their family was the descendant of Dong Huang’s fifth legendary Beast Tamer, the Space Emperor??
“As expected.” Although Shi Yu was also very shocked to receive confirmation, this seemed to be the only explanation why Fang Lan, who knew nothing about archeology back then, could summon the Space Emperor Ruins where the Void Mantis was.
She really had the Space Emperor bloodline.
Grandma Li was rather shocked. “You should be the first descendant of an emperor, right?”
Mechanical legendary and Lin Feng legendary were relatively close to the modern era, so it was not strange for them to leave behind descendants. However, the five legendary emperors were relatively far from now. After experiencing the chaotic totem world, their descendants were definitely the number one target of the totem clans. It was very difficult to pass them down.
Among them, when they learned that Fang Lan had the bloodline of the Space Emperor, everyone was shocked and felt that it was acceptable.
Because the Space Emperor was the latest legendary emperor. Moreover, it was said that the Space Emperor had the most children.
The Space Emperor came from the spatial-type Beast Taming Family, the Wang Family. His family presided over the spatial-type, and a member of that family was a Titled Legend. Even in troubled times, such a powerful family could stand tall, so the Space Emperor could be said to have been born with a golden spoon in his mouth.
It was said that when the Space Emperor was 15 years old and had just become a Beast Tamer, he had his first child with his family’s marriage partner.
In ancient times, marriage was generally earlier, and people were encouraged to have more children in order to strengthen the human race.
According to the records, the Space Emperor had a total of 23 children and was the legendary emperor who could give birth the most. Therefore, it was understandable if he left behind a bloodline.
However, because the level of the Spacetime Emperor was not high, and the talent of the various beauties was not the same, the talent of the heirs of the Space Emperor was not top-notch. Of course, this was also compared to top-notch geniuses. Compared to ordinary Beast Tamers, they were definitely still geniuses. They all had legend’s aptitude.
“Do you know which son of the Space Emperor was your ancestor?” Principal Feng asked.
Fang Lan nodded and said, “That array spirit senior said that it’s the eighth son of the Space Emperor, Wang Mian. He’s my ancestor.”
“This array spirit is also related to Ancestor Wang Mian.”
Wang Mian… Principal Feng and Grandma Lin looked at each other. They knew that because of the Void Mantis, Lu Qingyi had revealed all the assets of the Space Emperor’s children.
The eighth son of the Space Emperor, Wang Mian, finally reached the Legend level. He didn’t inherit the Space Emperor’s spatial talent and inherited his mother’s light-element strengthening talent. He was considered a relatively transparent prince.
“Good daughter.” At this moment, seeing that his daughter was fine, Professor Fang was relieved. He immediately said, “Good daughter, did our ancestor leave any inheritance or anything?”
Principal Feng, Grandma Li, and Shi Yu were silent. It was too real.
That made sense. If they were descendants of legendary emperors, they would definitely covet their ancestor’s inheritance. That was a legendary.
It didn’t make sense without a few Mythical resources.
Fang Lan nodded. “Senior Formation Spirit taught me a set of formations created by the Space Emperor. It’s an army skill.”
She took out a formation map and said, “The cultivation method is recorded in this aspect. It seems to be a light-element skill that’s related to stars.”
Fang Lan showed everyone the blueprint.
It recorded the materials and methods needed to cultivate this kind of “Four Symbols Star Formation”.
With a rough look, Principal Feng and the others confirmed that it was an important lost army formation. Fang Lan had gained a lot this time.
….
After confirming that Fang Lan was fine, Shi Yu felt much more relaxed. Next, when she completed another assessment mission, he could officially let her become a member of Bureau 11.
This girl was really not simple. She was actually the descendant of the Space Emperor. This made Shi Yu sigh. The Space Emperor was a super second-generation heir. It was said that he rarely lost in his life. After becoming a Beast Tamer, he displayed shocking talent and grew quickly under the protection of his titled legend grandfather. Later on, he was even protected by the Dragon God and finally became a legendary expert.
It could be said that in that era, be it other human geniuses or totem clans, they lived under the shadow of the Space Emperor.
Like every legendary emperor, he was the favorite of the era.
At the thought of this, Shi Yu not only looked forward to it, but he also had the urge to meet these legendary emperors.
Ever since the Dragon God asked him to explore the Time Dragon Vein in the future, Shi Yu had this urge.
And now that he had encountered Qi in Tingxiang, Shi Yu’s urge was even stronger. If Qi really mastered Time Travel, would he have a chance to return to ancient times and spar with Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, and Space Emperor?
“Haha, it was a false alarm. It’s good that you’re fine. I made you run back. Do you still want to return to Tingxiang next?” After everyone realized that Fang Lan was fine, Principal Feng said to Shi Yu.
As for Shi Yu, he was speechless. Good lord, if he went over again and returned, it wouldn’t be too much.
“Forget it,” Shi Yu said.
In any case, with the relationship between Qi and the Elven Empress, he could go to Tingxiang anytime he wanted in the future. There was no hurry.
“No, I’ll go into seclusion to cultivate.” Shi Yu sighed.
Seeing a totem country world competition contestant like the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King, he felt a little pressured. Moreover, according to the Elven Empress, there might even be a mixed-blood legend who contracted a totem above his level.
For the blessings of the World Tree, he had to work harder.
“Alright, by the way, study the array Fang Lan brought back when you’re free. You can send it to your armies to see if it’s useful,” Principal Feng said.
Shi Yu nodded to indicate that he understood. He ignored Tingxiang and Dragon Palace City and directly chose to return to Ping Cheng with Qi in the ruins space, preparing to introduce her to the local customs of Dong Huang.
Right on the heels of that, it was time to enter seclusion to increase points. This time, he planned to increase superalloy to perfection in one go and let Eleven evolve and break through. He was still short of more than 40 points, about a month. However, in addition to the fact that the skills of the other pets had yet to be maxed out, there was not much time left for him. He had to ensure that at the start of the World Tournament, he had the battle power to match the weakest totem and defeat the invincible overlord.

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 818 Evolution of God Eleven
chapters.content:
818 Evolution of God Eleven
Hmph, hmph, hmph~
After returning from Kong Capital, Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng happily.
He no longer wanted to go all the way to Tingxiang.
Running back and forth made it easy to get carsick.
!!
Before returning, Shi Yu had brought Qi along. He had expected that he couldn’t be bothered to go back.
At this moment, Qi was in the ruins.
Shi Yu threw her in early in the morning and let her get to know the other members of the team first.
However, when Shi Yu took the time to look at the ruins, he saw that Qi’s face was a little pale.
At this moment, the 1.2-meter-tall Qi hugged the Time Umbrella and was extremely nervous.
Who knew what she saw after entering?
She saw the nine suns and a black and white bear “warming up” in the sun.
Even from afar, the hot temperature instantly made Qi feel that her body was about to melt.
She also saw a butterfly welcoming the lightning with its body and constantly bathing under the terrifying white lightning.
The lightning tore through the ground with just a trace.
She even saw a ginseng baby sitting cross-legged in the snowstorm, meditating and concentrating.
The violent snowstorm seemed to have frozen time, and the trace of cold air it revealed froze her thoughts.
Qi panicked.
She understood what Shi Yu meant by “it will be very bitter to cultivate with me”.
“What do you think?” Shi Yu arrived at the ruins and asked for Qi’s opinion.
Qi’s face was pale.
She felt that he probably wouldn’t last a day under this training.
However…
At the thought that Shi Yu’s pets could persist, she… she definitely could too.
“I believe I can,” Qi said with a serious expression.
“I can definitely do it,” she encouraged herself.
Shi Yu was surprised. “You’re so confident? I originally wanted you to start from the foundation, but since you’re so confident, I’m relieved. Let’s directly undergo willpower training.”
Qi: ???
Her cherry blossom-like eyes were filled with confusion.
“Ling, help Qi formulate three meals a day, daily routine, and training plans.”
“Yes, Master.” The green and white Rubik’s Cube condensed in midair and appeared beside Shi Yu.
The white-haired loli inside looked at the pink-haired loli in front of her and said, “Qi, right? From today onwards, I’m your instructor.”
“Just call me Ling.”
“Yes… Teacher Ling.” Qi felt that she had to finish her boast even if she cried.
“Let Qi train with Little Ji and Duckie first,” Shi Yu said.
“Little Ji, Duckie?” Qi revealed a confused expression.
“My second team pets.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Now, our big family is divided into teams one and two.”
“Among them, the members of the first team include Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling.”
“Their strength is uniformly at the monarch level. However, no matter who it is, they have the strength to defeat overlords above their level.”
“Oh right, those equipment of yours were made by the six of them. For example, the huge sword is the power crystal of Eleven’s hardening skill and the Lightning Rod skill. For example, the bow and arrow are the power crystals of Baby Ginseng and Ling…”
“The dozen or so pieces of equipment are all toys created by them through their skills. The artifact spirit among them is also Buggy’s phantom ability.”
Qi opened his mouth slightly. Toy?
“That’s right, it’s a toy. At the moment, the strength of Team One is like this. Even if they don’t attack themselves, they can be invincible among monarchs with their clones.”
Qi: ∑(っ°Д°;)っwhat!!
Her first thought was that it was ridiculous, but she suddenly recalled what Big Sister Annie said in the exchange competition.
Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast… Monarch-level Iron-eating Beast… easily crossed one level and shattered her.
Therefore, this might all be true…
Not only was the monster that Iron-eating Beast, but everyone else in the first team?!
“I’m currently a level-six Beast Tamer. I only have six contract slots. At the moment, I have a contract with all the members of the first team.”
“As for the members of the second team, an ancient Tyrant Dragon, mechanical phantom beast of middle-level overlord race, and Duckie, an abyss half-god reincarnation. They are transcendent races that have the will of overlords and can easily break through to the overlord level in the future.”
Qi was stunned again.
Mechanical phantom beast.
As she had been chosen by Shi Yu, she naturally learned about Shi Yu’s achievements from Master Ge Lin and the others.
A mechanical phantom beast that had fused the power of the overlord race, the Earth Dragon, and the ancient overlord race, the Tyrant Dragon?
Could mechanical phantom beasts still fuse two biological illusions?
Just the dragon race was powerful enough. The Dragon Empire was still the great enemy of Tingxiang, and the ancient Tyrant Dragon was said to be the ruler of the land during a certain period of the totem era… The combination of the two powers was unbelievable.
Apart from that, a demigod… reincarnated?
Qi was at a loss again. Was it really demigod level? The demigod whose strength matched that of the Elven Empress…
“Little Ji and Duckie are both commander rank at the moment. Their potential is not bad, but their strength isn’t enough to enter the first team. They can only be the second team. Next, train with them.”
Qi: (*+_+*) ~ Team Two, Team Two?
“Yes, next, you can be considered a member of my second team. You have to wait for me to break through. However, you can’t casually contract with me after breaking through.”
“It depends on the competition spots for the second team.”
“I can still fuse more phantom beast power next. Duckie was a demigod-level expert in its previous life and is currently trying to control the power of its previous life. They all want to enter the first team, so you have to work hard.”
“Compared to them, you have a huge advantage, which is that you still have a legendary resource. After the first team slots are opened, you can try to challenge the members of the first team to advance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 819 Evolution of God Eleven (2)
chapters.content:
819 Evolution of God Eleven (2)
Shi Yu said with a smile.
Roll it up.
Qi clenched the Time Umbrella and shook her head crazily in her heart.
No.
!!
She had to enter the first team.
However… Qi was slightly stunned. She suddenly realized that the Time Umbrella in her hand didn’t seem to be that fragrant anymore.
The standard to enter the first team was to challenge the members of the first team. However, how could she defeat the members of the first team with a toy created by those same seniors?
“As for how to surpass yourself, it depends on your subsequent efforts.”
Qi: o_o…
“Ling, bring Qi to her address and introduce her to Little Ji and Duckie.”
….
After arranging Qi, Shi Yu also asked Ling to continue studying the Space Beast Egg and the strange water summoned.
He was worried.
At the same time, Shi Yu took out Fang Lan’s gains again to take a look.
[Four Symbols Star Formation]
At first glance, Shi Yu thought that it was related to the totem holy beasts of the four faiths, Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise.
In the end, he realized that it had only borrowed a name.
This was only a high-level light-element skill.
The reason why it was called the Four Symbols was that it needed at least four users to use it.
Even a single pet couldn’t use this move at all.
Of course, unless he used his all-purpose clone.
However, the effect was definitely not as good as using it together with four pets of similar strength.
[Four Symbols Star Formation], a high-level light-element skill. After four pets activated it together in four directions, it could summon starlight to form a light barrier that trapped the enemy. Whether outsiders wanted to enter or internal enemies wanted to leave, they would suffer strong light-element damage from the barrier.
Gone.
Shi Yu sighed. No matter what, Fang Lan’s ancestor was a descendant of the Space Emperor, but she was only left with this little inheritance.
If he were Fang Lan, he would be too embarrassed to say it.
This was simply worse than An Chang…
Sigh, if one had to talk about it, it wasn’t very bad. At least, the inheritance Fang Lan obtained had the specific cultivation method of the [Four Symbols Star Formation] that exceeded transcendent. It might be Dao Proficiency.
In addition, it was like impregnable. It was an army skill. If the user was multiple of “four”, its power could still increase greatly.
For an army, it was a rare treasure skill.
This skill was developed by the Space Emperor and rewarded to his son. Then, it was used in the army. It shouldn’t be bad.
However, compared to trapping the enemy, Shi Yu still preferred more proactive battle tactics.
Shi Yu made a backup copy and sent it to Senior Panda, letting her do it first.
As for Shi Yu himself, he began to work overtime.
….
During the half a month Shi Yu added points, he kept feeling that he had forgotten something.
Only when Principal Feng reminded him did Shi Yu remember that he had yet to deal with the master and disciple of the Phoenix God Society. He had not even brought An Chang back.
However, it wasn’t a big problem, because it was already too late.
During the few days he was in Tingxiang, the master and disciple of the Phoenix God Society suddenly had something to do and returned to the Seven Islands. It seemed that the Seven Islands Valkyrie wanted to see them.
This made Principal Feng feel that something was wrong. It was originally very promising to poach the Phoenix Shrine, but if the Seven Islands Valkyrie came into contact with these two, Dong Huang’s hope would be slim.
Apart from that, An Chang was also brought back to the Ancient Capital by the gem cat and the others who had returned to Dragon Palace City from Tingxiang.
It wasn’t a big problem. The former would be discussed in the world competition, while the latter…
Shi Yu did not pay attention to why his sea dragon had evolved under the guidance of the Sea Dragon King. Instead, he continued to add points to cultivate.
It had to be said that with the Sea Cleansing Spirit, which reduced the burden of adding points, Shi Yu’s efficiency in adding points increased exponentially.
For this, he directly chose to cooperate with the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins and help Susu pull the Sea Cleansing Spirit first (Expert+11).
Two months after Shi Yu returned from Tingxiang.
The attributes of every pet underwent another earth-shattering change under the continuous addition of points.
Firstly, all the super racial skills of the six pets in the team had been added to (Expert+11). They were only a step away from reaching the perfect level and breaking through to the overlord level.
Among them, Eleven was already at the stage of working hard to suppress its level.
Apart from that, it wasn’t just Eleven’s White Thunder and Undying Golden Body. Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling’s non-racial skills, such as Space Control, Plant Control, Undead Revival, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, and Mythical Revival, had also been added to perfect level by Shi Yu.
It could be said that although they had yet to reach the overlord level in terms of growth level, their skill proficiency was not inferior at all.
In fact, Shi Yu even got Eleven to teach Buggy and the others the full-level deterrence skill through the memory water drop card bug.
The same method allowed Ling to modify itself and evolve, researching the clone skill into a racial skill. Then, through this method, Eleven and the others’ clones became full-level skills.
At the same time, including Susu’s full-level multiplication, everyone could master it through this method.
Deterrence, Clone, and Multiplication. The proficiency of Team One had reached Dao Proficiency.
Of course, this was not the most important thing. Most importantly, [Super Alloy] became the first super skill in Shi Yu’s team to reach [Transcendent Proficiency].
Eleven was about to evolve.
At that moment, there was less than a month until the world competition.
Even the ranking of the Sequence Battle had completely ended not long ago.
The legendary resources in the top five had already been distributed and were given to the top five to use and digest them themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 820 Evolution of God Eleven (3)
chapters.content:
820 Evolution of God Eleven (3)
Shi Yu was still ranked seventh, the number one person below the legend level. Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and Gao Xuan tactfully didn’t challenge him.
Therefore, the list of contestants for the World Tournament of Dong Huang had already been completely confirmed.
Among them, the legendary Beast Tamers were called “Team One” by the domestic Beast Tamers.
As for the remaining four, they were called [Team Two] by the Beast Tamers in the country.
Shi Yu, who was ranked seventh, was in neither a high nor low position. After all, there was no real overlord level.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu finally didn’t have to tolerate it anymore.
He had cultivated bitterly for two months for today.
Now, his team of pets could be said to be full.
All non-racial skills were above perfect proficiency, and the limit of all racial skills was close to perfect level. They were stuck at a limit.
If he wanted to improve again, it was also Shi Yu’s initial plan to reach transcendent with the teaching skill points of some pets. However, he had also discovered that even with Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit, there was still not enough time. It was only enough to reach transcendent with Eleven’s superalloy.
No, there was still half a month left. Perhaps he could reach perfection with one skill point.
In short, that was later. Shi Yu had already decided to let Eleven break through to overlord and let him have an overlord-level pet above his level!
At the same time, he let Eleven complete its evolution through the transcendent superalloy.
After all, the evolution outcome was unknown. He still needed some time to adapt. The last adaptation period of a month was suitable.
Now, although all the members of the first team were at the monarch level, each of them had the strength to defeat ordinary overlords. It could be said that they had [Top-notch overlord battle power].
After all, Buggy had three perfect super skills now, Chi Tong had two, and Susu had two… In addition, their racial skill proficiency was not low. Ordinary overlords were definitely not as stacked as this.
As for Baby Ginseng and Ling, who only had one perfect super skill, one was a time-element and the other was a Mythical race. It was naturally easy for them to defeat ordinary overlords above their level.
Just as Shi Yu had expected, after adding points for two months, he would not be afraid if he encountered that Dark Elven Prince and the Flame Dragon King again.
Of course, in a one-on-one battle, there might still be some pressure. Although it had the battle power of a top-notch overlord, there were also differences in strength. The weak ones were like the Green Scaled Dragon, and the strong ones were like the Sky Penetrating Whale, the Dark Elven Prince, and the Flame Dragon King. Shi Yu was not sure if they had never fought.
However, Shi Yu didn’t nurture so many pets to fight one-on-one.
For example, Ling’s fusion mecha was completely perfect now.
Shi Yu felt that with all the members together, it shouldn’t be a big problem to be invincible below the totem level.
Although it was only a few minutes.
[This isn’t enough.]
Although this was already very strong, Shi Yu still felt that it wasn’t enough.
After all, the Elven Empress had said that there was suspected to be a totem level participant in this World Tournament.
After that, Shi Yu investigated through Dong Huang’s channels. Although he didn’t find anything, he still arranged for the totem to be an imaginary enemy.
Ignoring the other totems, Shi Yu was currently not confident of defeating the gem cat that relied on resources to break through.
Because at the moment, no matter how hard they tried, they couldn’t launch the attack where the cat instantly killed the Green Scaled Dragon.
If it was a totem that had mastered a transcendent-level racial skill and had the will of an overlord, it would be even more dangerous.
Perhaps it could rely on Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction, but it wasn’t very stable. After all, there was only one chance.
Therefore, the process of Eleven breaking through to overlord and completing perfect evolution seemed very important.
If it could have [Invincible Overlord Strength] like [Dragon Palace City’s Crown Prince] and [Tyrannical Sea Legendary Mutated Leviathan] after breaking through and evolution, the pressure would be much lower if all of them joined forces to fight ordinary totems.
“Are you ready?”
It was already October 179 of the Alliance calendar. Shi Yu had stayed in Ping Cheng for more than two months. These two months were extremely boring, but watching his pets become stronger bit by bit made him happy.
The only regret was that the second development of telepathy still didn’t succeed. This also made Shi Yu completely give up. He first lent the Talent Bead to Senior Lu to use for a period of time and taught her how to learn Psychic power step by step.
Now that Eleven was about to break through and evolve, it was the greatest comfort for Shi Yu to relieve this sad matter.
Eleven: “Wuu () ~!” Charge! I’m ready.
On the rock ground, Eleven was overjoyed. Its black and white hair fluttered, and it was especially happy.
Who knew how long it had waited for this day?
Apart from Eleven, Shi Yu, and the members of the first team were also present.
As for the members of the second team, they weren’t around. It was mainly because the energy fluctuations of the first team, be it training, breakthroughs, or evolution, were too strong. From time to time, a little deterrence could affect the members of the second team and they weren’t suitable to train together.
“Wu ~” Beside him, the butterfly with a dreamy body in midair curled its lips.
It was too early to be happy.
Generally speaking, the earlier one evolved and broke through, the weaker they were.
Being the first to break through to overlord might not be a good thing.
Buggy had a painful understanding of this.
As the only one in the team who wasn’t above a high-level overlord race, it was simply too difficult. If it weren’t for the fact that the power of imagination was strong enough, it would have been reduced to the same level as Little Ji.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng shook the Sun Flower elegantly with an indifferent expression. Even if Eleven evolved into a Mythical race, it was still invincible in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 821 Evolution of God Eleven (4)
chapters.content:
821 Evolution of God Eleven (4)
Time Mark+Time Fruit+Moon Explosion+Life Fire Seed. It could only say that it was so delicious that it exploded. Even if a totem came, it wouldn’t win. It was better than a real divine skill.
As long as it was banned, it was the strongest.
If it wasn’t banned, then Ginseng Baby would panic.
“Mi.” The sword spirit, Chi Tong, danced in the air. At the moment, it was also ridiculously strong.
!!
After the Undead Revival reached perfect level, it didn’t need the bone sword to control the three overlord undead puppets at all.
Therefore, Chi Tong had been coddling up to Shi Yu recently, hoping that the next transcendent points could be given to its undead revival skill.
In that case, it could control the totem-level puppet.
Even at the monarch level, it could even control totem undead puppets. It would be invincible.
Now, it didn’t matter who he added points to, because for the next two months, be it Buggy, Chi Tong, or Ling, their will levels had been trained to the level of overlord will. Although there were still some differences in the time to add points, it was no longer big.
“Ning.” Susu snorted proudly, its jelly-like blue body swaying.
It hoped that Eleven would evolve stronger and not disappoint the Sea Cleansing Spirit it had worked hard to create.
At the moment, every pet had found comfort for themselves.
For example, Baby Ginseng felt that if skills weren’t banned, it was the strongest, while Susu felt that if the battlefield was the ocean, it was the strongest.
In any case, they didn’t believe that Eleven could change this situation after breaking through and evolving.
“Alright, alright.”
Shi Yu smiled. He had long prepared the ten meteorite fragments and two Aurora Magnetic Gold from Senior Ji Mengzhu.
He looked at Eleven, who nodded heavily and immediately returned to normal!
It was three to four meters tall in the form of the Nine Li Battle Beast.
It was wearing silver and black armor, revealing blue eyes. It was very domineering.
However, this might be the last time it maintained this form.
Shi Yu and the others had no idea how it would evolve next.
He just didn’t know if it could recover with the Time Fruit later.
“Wuu!!!”
“Eat, eat.”
Eleven nodded.
It had been stifled for the past few days.
In order to become a perfect overlord, it had been suppressing its breakthrough power for several days.
If it didn’t break through soon, it didn’t know if Shi Yu would be alright, but it itself would definitely explode.
However, this process also further honed Eleven’s control over its body.
At this moment, under everyone’s gaze, Eleven couldn’t wait to pick up an Aurora Magnetic Gold and stuff it into its mouth.
Legendary resource, Aurora Magnetic Gold!
Shi Yu had a total of two pieces, all applied from Dong Huang.
This was a legendary strengthening resource that could strengthen the physique.
Although Eleven and the others trained with legendary resources every day, they didn’t completely devour it.
Otherwise, the huge power of legendary resources would have long made them break through.
After all, legendary resources even had a chance of allowing overlords to break through to totems, let alone monarchs to overlords.
Now, Eleven’s gaze was excited. It could finally taste legendary resources.
However, this resource was originally meant to be carried around. It was used to subtly train the physique.
Swallowing it directly was undoubtedly very risky.
However, Ling had already undergone strict calculations. With Eleven’s current physique, it was definitely not a problem to completely devour the Aurora Magnetic Gold.
Before evolution, it would break through first.
“Eleven, charge!”
“Wu!” “Yi!” “Mi!” “Ning!” “!”
Under the cheers of the entire team, Eleven, who had swallowed the first Aurora Magnetic Gold, suddenly had a serious and frozen expression.
The suppressed power in his body finally couldn’t be suppressed.
It slowly raised its head and roared at the sky.
“Roar!!!!!!”
In the next moment, a shocking energy erupted from its body!
“Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!!!”
As Eleven roared, the ground around it exploded.
A terrifying white lightning also shot into the sky from its body!!
The lightning power contained in the Aurora Magnetic Gold!!!
This terrifying power attacked Eleven’s body crazily.
In an instant, a white lightning storm lingered with Eleven as the center.
The huge power directly forced Shi Yu and the others back.
At this moment, Eleven no longer suppressed its strength. Several perfect super racial skills led to its growth.
At the same time, under the pressure of the lightning tempering, the will of the overlord erupted.
Five perfect proficiency super racial skills, overlord will, and legendary resources.
The three breakthrough powers combined into one, making Eleven’s aura climb steadily, instantly changing the sky and earth.
In the sky, white lightning surged. The boundless land had already turned into a white lightning pool.
This was not an ordinary transformation. Even after Eleven left, this lightning environment would continue for a long time.
This was the power of an overlord.
It already had the ability to change the natural environment.
For example, if Eleven went to erupt and fight, it could directly turn that place into a thunder fire snow mountain.
As it broke through, multiple powers modified Eleven’s body.
Its life level directly reached another realm.
Its physique began to be reborn.
With the enhancement of many max-level thunder-element skills and the Perfect Level Lightning Rod, Eleven’s physique instantly acquired extreme affinity with lightning.
At this moment, Eleven suddenly had a feeling amidst the white lightning.
Even if it didn’t use the energy in his body or use any skill crystals, it could casually wave his hand and cause the lightning to fall.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 822 Evolution of God Eleven (5)
chapters.content:
822 Evolution of God Eleven (5)
This power… was so strong…
“Roar!!!!…”
In the white lightning storm, Eleven opened its blue eyes.
Devouring legendary resources to strengthen the physique was very painful, but for Eleven, who had experienced countless painful training daily and had the will of an overlord, it was not a problem.
!!
In a short moment, its aura began to increase from the original ten million energy points.
“What will happen?”
At this moment, in the distance, Shi Yu’s face was pale. He had already sensed the instability of the Beast Taming Space. The shaky space seemed to be about to collapse at any time.
He looked at Eleven in the white lightning with a burning gaze.
20 million.
40 million.
60 million.
70 million… 75 million… 78 million… 79.99 million…
Just as he broke through, Eleven’s energy level increased extremely quickly.
The violent increase made Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others swallow their saliva crazily.
Soon, Eleven’s energy level broke through to 80 million.
It was twice the minimum energy standard of ordinary overlord-level pets.
This energy value was very terrifying.
After all, when the gem cat was at the overlord level, it only had more than 50 million energy points. The famous top-notch overlord of the East Sea, the Sky Penetrating Whale, had fought for its entire life and had less than 90 million energy points.
The number one heir of demigod factions like the Dark Night Forest and the Dragon Empire only had about 90 million energy points.
These overlords undoubtedly only had this energy value after breaking through and undergoing a long cultivation.
As for Eleven, it had just broken through when its energy level suddenly increased to 80 million.
In the end, it gradually stabilized at 80.11 million.
This energy value undoubtedly shocked Buggy and the others. After all, this was only someone who had just broken through to overlord!
It had yet to devour the meteorite fragment and the second legendary resource to evolve!
80,110,000!
[Pet Name]: Eleven
[Race]: Iron-eating Beast, Nine Li Battle Beast
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
“Super Level”: Inner Power (Perfect), Lightning Rod (Perfect), Space Quake (Perfect), Bean Soldier (Perfect), Impregnable (Perfect)
[Taught Skill]:
“Super Level”: Undying Golden Body (Perfect), White Thunder (Perfect), Super Alloy (transcendent)
Normal Energy Points: 80,110,000
Terrifying attributes.
One could imagine how solid Eleven’s foundation was.
Its energy was actually mostly thanks to the strength of its physique.
At this moment, Eleven was even a little unfamiliar with its body.
The terrifying physical strength made it have a bold idea. Perhaps it could resist Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction!
Including a set of skills, it was definitely one of the best among top-notch overlords.
Probably, apart from invincible overlords like the Mutated Leviathan, there were very few Eleven’s match at the overlord level.
And this was only the beginning!
“Wuu…”
Eleven clenched its fists happily. The surrounding space seemed to tremble as the white lightning was clenched in its hand.
“Wuu!!”
It looked at the others with an excited expression and asked if its strength after breaking through was strong!!
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and the others looked envious.
They also wanted to break through to overlord.
This was simply a qualitative change in strength.
Relying on equipment, the Time Fruit, and other external forces was indeed a little lacking.
“Is it strong? You exchanged your Beast Tamer for that.”
Eleven: QAQ
Shi Yu’s face was pale as he said weakly. At this moment, the Beast Taming Space had stabilized. He had successfully contracted an overlord above his level!!
Those Beast Tamers from the totem country could contract above their level, so could he!
However, because of the contract connection with Eleven, Shi Yu felt that his stamina was almost constantly flowing away. Its speed was very terrifying.
It was ridiculous.
Did it consume so much energy?
He felt that it was impossible for other Beast Tamers to consume so much energy to contract above their level.
Shi Yu was originally very panicked, but he didn’t panic for long.
Eleven’s breakthrough also gave Shi Yu a large portion of its strength, allowing Shi Yu’s physique to reach an unprecedented height.
It made Shi Yu’s physique, which had already reached the limit, break through the limit and obtain epic strengthening again.
This strengthening was undoubtedly timely help, allowing Shi Yu to quickly recover. However, his expression was a little weak. Everything was still within his tolerance.
He took a deep breath of the sachet hanging on his neck and instantly felt revived. He felt that contracting above his level was nothing.
“That’s it,” Shi Yu said. “Another overlord won’t be a problem.”
Eleven: Wu wu wu, Shi Yu, are you alright?
Eleven looked at the pale Shi Yu, afraid that it would break the Beast Tamer’s brain.
This didn’t look like it was alright at all.
Although it was indeed no different from normal…
Ling: “Don’t be arrogant.”
“There’s also evolution.”
“Evolution!” Shi Yu nodded and also nodded at Eleven in the distance, indicating that it could continue.
With this hint, Baby Ginseng, Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, and the others became even more serious.
Hey, hey, hey, this was already ridiculous enough.
If it used [Transcendent-level superalloy], [Multiple Meteorite Fragments], and [Second Legendary resource, Aurora Magnetic Gold] to fuse and evolve next, would it be a little too terrifying?
Before starting the evolution project, Buggy and the others were originally very calm, but at this moment, they suddenly had a bad feeling.
“Yes, yes!!!” Eleven was extremely excited.
It directly ate the meteorite fragment. There were a total of ten meteorite fragments. In addition, Eleven had already eaten a top-notch fragment previously. Shi Yu didn’t know where Eleven’s upper limit was.

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 823 Evolution of God Eleven (6)
chapters.content:
823 Evolution of God Eleven (6)
However, he just had to eat it.
The more it could eat, the higher the initial proficiency level of the Demon God Body.
This was what Ji Mengzhu said.
At this moment, meteorite fragments entered Eleven’s body one after another. Eleven felt especially good.
One, two, three… Initially, Shi Yu and Susu were still wondering if they should use the Sea Cleansing Spirit to relieve Eleven.
But from the looks of it, for the current overlord-level Eleven and the almost invincible overlord-level Eleven, controlling them was too simple.
Soon, Eleven ate eight pieces in one go.
At this moment, it finally felt a trace of pressure. Its expression was serious and solemn as it felt a dark deer thumping in its heart.
After eating eight pieces, including the previous one, it was nine meteorite fragments. Eleven finally felt the burden and the corrosion of the dark power.
“Can it still be eaten? Do you want the Sea Cleansing Spirit to help?”
“Wuu!” Eleven nodded. Of course, it could be eaten, but there was no need to help. Its white lightning power could also suppress the power of the Yun An Demon God.
Initially, Shi Yu and Eleven even said that they wanted to leave two pieces for Senior Panda and the beast-eared girl, but seeing that Eleven didn’t seem to have any limit, Shi Yu didn’t plan to keep them for the time being. He directly let Eleven eat as much as possible.
After Eleven evolved, he and Eleven would directly help the two seniors hunt Yun An’s main body!
At that time, there would be enough fragments.
Boom!!!
Eleven picked up the meteorite fragment and continued eating. At this moment, its body was already intertwined with white and black lightning. It was extremely magical.
After eating, Eleven’s aura reached an extremely terrifying level.
It was as if a Thunder Demon God had descended into the world.
The power of the Demon God contained in the eleven meteorite fragments happened to allow Eleven to reach the limit of its current state.
At that moment, what excited Eleven the most was the inscription that it couldn’t carve after eating the meteorite fragment for the first time… This time, it could finally carve it.
It stretched out its huge claws and began to carve dark inscriptions, planning to complete the evolution of the Demon God.
Today, Eleven had used all the foundation it had accumulated in the past on itself.
“Come on.” Shi Yu was also extremely excited as he looked at Eleven in front of him in anticipation.
Black lightning and white lightning flowed all over its body. As it carved the evolution inscription, a black evolution light directly enveloped its entire body.
During this process, its entire body was filled with black light. Information appeared in Shi Yu’s mind.
< Name > Demon God Body
[Attributes]: Metal, Dark
< Introduction > The body can automatically produce the power of the dark-element Demon God. It can mobilize the power of the Demon God to perfectly integrate into any metal-element skill, increasing the effect of the skill in all aspects.
Powerful skills often only needed simple effects.
At this moment, Eleven was gradually transforming into the Demon God Iron-eating Beast in history.
This was Emperor Wu’s trump card battle pet, a super race that made Emperor Wu willing to nurture it as the strongest trump card.
At this moment, the black evolution light spread. Eleven’s figure slowly enlarged, and its energy level increased further.
Soon, a new appearance appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Zhong Xuan had once said that through the evolution of other inscriptions, the form of the body would not change. Only new racial skills would be added. Only through the evolution of the meteorite fragment would the form of the Nine Li Battle Beast undergo a huge change.
At this moment, its form had indeed changed completely.
The armor and body seemed to have fused into one, no longer in the form of an Iron-eating Beast wearing armor.
At the same time, the color of the armor on its body completely changed from clearly silver and black to a mixture of white and gradually black.
This color was like dark metal absorbing light, dazzling and mysterious.
At this moment, the armor was very layered, like it was made of prismatic metal. On these metal armor, the white and black colors gradually changed, turning the normal state into a Demon God Iron-eating Beast nearly ten meters tall that emitted a terrifying Demon God aura.
Although he could still see the outline of the Iron-eating Beast’s figure clearly, there was already a tight Demon God Armor on the outside.
[Pet Name]: Eleven
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder, Dark
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 88,210,000
After the evolution of the Demon God, Eleven’s current attributes underwent another huge change.
However, this wasn’t the end at all. This form was only a transition.
In the time it took Ling to take a photo, Eleven, who looked like a demon god, ate the second Aurora Magnetic Gold!!
Two legendary resources!
Ate them all!
In addition to a pile of legendary level-eight resources, it was impossible for Eleven not to be strong.
“Roar!!!!!”
As Eleven ate the Aurora Magnetic Gold this time, it began to activate the power of superalloy. Its entire body was covered in hardened metal, and the hardened metal that had fused with the power of the White Thunder Metal began to fuse with the Demon God’s metal body!!
“Wuu!!” Eleven roared with all its might.
It was extremely excited.
In the next moment, it was directly swallowed by the huge black and white interweaving lightning!!
Its entire body was extremely blurry.
Superalloy, fusion super evolution.
At this moment, the form of the Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had just evolved directly collapsed. Under the collision of light, darkness, and lightning, the Demon God Armor on Eleven’s body kept disintegrating into energy essence that fused into Eleven’s body.
After the Demon God Armor disintegrated under the power of yin and yang, Eleven’s new form was also revealed. It was a form that Shi Yu and the others completely didn’t expect. It was an ordinary Iron-eating Beast, but its body was a little taller and larger, a full ten meters tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 824 Evolution of the Eleven Gods (7)
chapters.content:
824 Evolution of the Eleven Gods (7)
It was like an Iron-eating Beast in its enlarged state.
Of course, the power formed by the light, darkness, and lightning disintegrating the armor fused into Eleven’s body and assisted it in evolution again. It wasn’t like there were no changes at all.
At this moment, every clearly visible hair began to blur. The black hair was as blurry as a black electric arc, and the white hair was as blurry as a white electric arc, with electricity lingering all over its body.
These electric arcs seemed to have become Eleven’s hair. They kept floating like a chaotic ocean.
It was like a huge beast walking out of the chaos lightning sea, like the first Chaos Thunder God after the creation of the world.
“This power…”
In the distance, Shi Yu could clearly sense endless energy fluctuations erupting from Eleven’s form.
It worked.
It was definitely a success.
Although the power of light lightning and the power of the Demon God were extremely conflicting, the level of superalloy was maxed out by him.
Helping Eleven control this power was definitely not a problem.
Transcendent super skills could allow pets to reach the totem level.
And now, it was only used for evolution!
Under Shi Yu’s extremely expectant gaze…
A shocking roar. Black and white lightning that shot into the sky erupted from Eleven’s body like flames!!
The sky, the ground, and the natural environment directly changed again. In the ruins, it became a chaos world where Yin and Yang separated and light and darkness were born!!
“Wu…”
In this area, the pressure of Buggy and the others reached the extreme. Their expressions were extremely solemn.
This was the power of leader after evolution…
[Pet Name]: Eleven
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder, Light, Dark
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 97,710,000
The current Eleven’s normal energy level of the two legendary resources actually approached 100 million.
It was already close to the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s pet even though it had just broken through…
This shocking power simply excited Shi Yu.
However, what excited Shi Yu the most was still this moment. Because of his contract connection with Eleven, Shi Yu’s mental talent directly changed.
The new skill that Eleven was about to awaken had a connection with him.
As Eleven’s light and darkness evolved, Shi Yu entered a meditative state. His mind and Eleven completely became one.
Shi Yu kept wandering in the sea of memories and experimented with his ideal telepathy talent again.
In the dark world, he saw a painting carved on the stone wall. It was two black and white Yin Yang fish wrapped around each other.
Countless layers superimposed. Shi Yu seemed to see the process of the universe going from infinity to Taiji to the transformation of all things. He saw the process of chaos splitting Yin and Yang, light and darkness not being born, and even splitting Yin and Yang.
At this moment, Eleven and Shi Yu’s minds were very clear. Shi Yu was extremely shocked to discover that as Eleven evolved, his telepathy talent, which had always been at a bottleneck, finally made progress.
Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes. At this moment, his eyes were like a spinning black and white Taiji Painting. They were mysterious and extremely deep. His eyes were the window to the mind, reflecting the power of the mind. At this moment, as Shi Yu changed, Eleven, who was in the evolution process, finally saw the same Yin Yang Taiji Painting as Shi Yu.
Shi Yu had always wanted to share the magicalness of the Taiji Painting discovered during archeological exploration on Earth with Eleven, but unfortunately, he had never succeeded.
However, at this moment, when Eleven used the transcendent-level superalloy and fused the power of light and darkness to complete its evolution, his compatibility with Eleven seemed to have reached a point. Finally, they saw the divineness of this pattern at the same time.
[So, if you want to share these powers with pets, you have to let them have a certain compatibility with this divine power first, just like teaching skills.]
At this moment, Shi Yu understood what to do next.
If Buggy came into contact with the power of the starry sky, perhaps it could really imagine transforming into the green dragon?
Boom!!!!
At this moment.
A huge Taiji Painting array appeared under Eleven and Shi Yu’s feet. Lightning leaped on it, as if forming a lightning Yin Yang Domain that wrapped them inside. They also stood on it. Baby Ginseng and the others were extremely shocked, especially Ling…
Buzz…
At this moment, it was as if the legendary ruins had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of worldly laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power in the space were all suppressed, and it was no different from the abnormality of the quasi-divine skill described by Senior Ji Mengzhu.
“Quasi-divine skill,” Ling muttered.
Moreover, it was quite powerful.
It even felt that its strength was suppressed by Eleven’s power.
At the same time, further away from the legendary ruins, in the deeper second team space, Little Ji, Duckie, and Qi raised their heads in shock and felt an indescribable pressure!!
“Roar!!!”
“Quack!!”
Little Ji and Duckie roared softly. It wasn’t the first time they felt this power, but this time, it seemed to be different from the last time. The pressure it gave them was even stronger.
At the same time, outside the ruins, on the vast Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, millions of creatures crawled down in horror, not daring to look up.
The shocking change could be said to have shocked Shi Yu.
The power of the Yun An Demon God, the power of the Aurora Magnetic Gold White Thunder, and the transcendent superalloy. In addition, with his help through telepathy, Eleven seemed to have comprehended a quasi-divine skill!!

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 825 Evolution of God Eleven (8)
chapters.content:
825 Evolution of God Eleven (8)
“Roar!!!!” At this moment, the Chaotic Yin Yang Lightning Diagram formed was only the phenomenon of a skill. At this moment, the true quasi-divine skill was in Eleven’s hand.
In fact, this was just the combination skill [Yin Yang Jade] that Eleven had fused with White Thunder and Black Thunder through the superalloy previously. Condensing a metal and giving it the fusion of light, darkness, and lightning could cause huge destructive power.
Ling speculated that this combination skill had extraordinary potential, but at this moment, no one expected that as it evolved, it would really upgrade into a new skill.
It was even the prototype of a divine skill!
At this moment, Eleven seemed to have fallen into the chaos lightning and couldn’t be seen clearly. On its palm, a circular metal formed. The metal was black and white, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.
At this moment, as the circular metal condensed and spun, Shi Yu’s expression immediately changed.
“Eleven, stop!!!”
“Wu!!” “Yi!!!” Buggy, Eleven, and the others also sensed the terrifying change in Eleven.
It felt extremely ridiculous.
He didn’t understand why Eleven was so strong after evolution.
At that moment, just seeing Eleven’s figure made them feel that it was difficult to resist.
After all, even when facing the Black Meteorite Yak, the Black Goat, and the Fox God, they didn’t feel this way.
Crack!!!
As Shi Yu spoke, the surrounding space had already begun to be obliterated, and cracks filled the sky. This was not an ordinary obliteration. What shocked Shi Yu was that this legendary spatial ruin that could withstand totem-level attacks actually began to collapse, unstable as Eleven condensed this skill!!
< Name > Yin Yang Millstone
[Attributes]: Light, Dark, Metal, Thunder
[Level]: Quasi Divine Skill
< Introduction > It contains the destructive law. It can obliterate everything by breaking down the balance of Yin and Yang.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart was excited and complicated.
Another quasi-divine skill.
It was actually a divine skill that contained laws of destruction.
Yin Yang Millstone, obliterating everything?
It could even obliterate other laws?
In other words, Eleven really evolved into a Mythical race through this evolution???
Just like Ling, it had become a divine beast cub of a Mythical race?!!!
“Wu…” Shi Yu was extremely pleasantly surprised, but suddenly, his eyes hurt and he was forced to close them. As for Eleven, although it had become incomparably powerful, it still listened to Shi Yu’s command and canceled this skill.
However, to be precise, it was suddenly a little difficult for Eleven to control this power without the enhancement of Shi Yu’s telepathy.
Its own strength, the strength of a Beast Tamer, and the combination of the two were the power of a complete quasi-divine skill, the Yin Yang Millstone.
This was the method of cultivating a quasi-divine skill that Emperor Wu mentioned by Ji Mengzhu.
Among them, the Elven Empress of Tingxiang relied on this method. As a hybrid, she relied on the power of her pet to cultivate a quasi-divine skill, and Emperor Wu was actually still a little far from this step.
However, this result was directly completed by level-six Beast Tamer Shi Yu.
It wasn’t a legendary, not a Titled Legend, or even an ordinary Legend.
Closing his eyes tightly, Shi Yu was extremely excited. He tried his best to open them and look at Eleven.
“Sob…” Eleven, who was still impressive and domineering just now, only used half a move of the Yin Yang Millstone, but the side effects were huge. From its incomparably tall and chaotic blurry form, it gradually restrained its strength and shrank, using the Inner Power and Shrinking skill.
Soon, its form returned to its original state. The black and white hair that should have been like a chaotic electric arc turned into normal hair, and its head returned to its cub form of more than a meter. However, compared to before, its blue eyes returned to pitch-black eyes.
The color of the eyes was clearly black and white, like the Yin Yang Domain that contained endless power.
On the other side, Shi Yu sat on the ground with a weak expression.
However, he was smiling.
< Name > Eleven
[Attributes]: Metal, Thunder, Light, Dark
[Race Level]: Low-level Mythical
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
[Race Skill]:
“Super Level”: Inner Power (Perfect), Lightning Rod (Perfect), Space Quake (Perfect), Bean Soldier (Perfect), Impregnable (Perfect), Demon God Body (Perfect)
“Quasi Divine-level Skill”: Yin Yang Millstone (Initiate)
[Taught Skill]:
“Super Level”: Undying Golden Body (Perfect), White Thunder (Perfect), Super Alloy (transcendent)
Normal Energy Points: 97,710,000
“Invincible. Really invincible now,” Shi Yu muttered.
Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling also felt so.
They were covered in sweat and looked at Eleven in surprise.
Their breathing was very rapid and he had yet to recover from Eleven’s shock.
Oh shit, it was over. Regardless of how the team was doing, they would mourn for its opponent in the world competition for a minute first.
With Eleven’s current attributes, it might even be able to defeat the Tyrannical Sea Legend’s mutated Leviathan alone.
It was invincible below the totem level!
At this moment, Shi Yu was originally worried that he would be a little unstable if he went to fight in the world competition, but now, he wasn’t worried anymore!!
Who else was there!
After sensing that his current Beast Taming level was still far from level seven, Shi Yu didn’t have any extravagant hopes.
He wanted to snatch the title of Titled Legend at the level of a master.
Who else could match the quasi-divine skill of the invincible overlord, Eleven!
Moreover, other pets weren’t to be trifled with.
After holding it in for two months, Shi Yu was still angry and wanted to find someone to test his saber.
Master Qu Jie? No, too weak.
President Lin? The pets he contracted normally shouldn’t have totems and were all overlords. Then Eleven was also invincible in a one-on-one battle. No… He would be suspected of plotting to usurp the throne.
Sky Penetrating Whale, Mutated Leviathan, Dragon Palace City’s Crown Prince, and even the real totem gem cat and frost dragon?
Shi Yu’s excited heart and trembling hands. It’s one of those guys, then!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 826 Undersea Prison
chapters.content:
826 Undersea Prison
At this moment, almost the entire team was circling Eleven after breaking through.
All of them were looking forward to it.
It was mainly because Eleven was too strong after breaking through.
They were too envious.
They hoped that he could be like this in the future!
Normal monarchs used one method to break through to overlord.
Eleven, on the other hand, broke through with super skills, legendary resources, and the overlord’s will.
In addition to its powerful racial foundation, it could be said to be strong after breaking through to overlord.
At this moment, Eleven was actually not invincible. It could only be said to be a top-notch overlord among top-notch overlords.
What really gave it invincibility was another level-nine legendary resource and ten legendary level-eight meteorite fragments.
Using these things to cooperate with transcendent-level superalloy evolution, it was invincible.
Ordinary totems didn’t use as many resources as it did in their lifetime.
Eleven and Shi Yu should be able to resist the weaker totems with all their might.
At this moment, Shi Yu finally stepped into the top battle power domain of Blue Planet in the true sense of the word.
At the moment, Eleven only had two forms.
An ordinary restrained and shrunken panda cub form.
The other form, the Mythical form, was the giant panda form that looked like a chaotic lightning sea after evolution.
Among them, the quasi-divine skill Yin Yang Millstone and the super skill Inner Power could only be used in that form.
It could be imagined that if the normal state could reach nearly 100 million…. As long as enough natural lightning was stored in the body in advance, including the eruption of sharpness, it shouldn’t be a problem for the energy to exceed 100 million.
In addition to quasi-divine skills, normal totems might not necessarily be able to withstand it.
However, unlike Ling, Eleven’s Mythical form consumed more energy than Ling’s Mythical form.
At the same time, similar to Ling, its quasi-divine skill was also very difficult to control. It needed Shi Yu’s support to use it.
Or rather, Eleven couldn’t master the entire Mythical form very well.
This suddenly made Shi Yu understand why only totem-level demigods could master quasi-divine skills.
Perhaps the divine beast cubs of the Mythical race might indeed master quasi-divine skills, but it was not easy to control them alone. After all, it involved the power of the natural order.
Thinking about it this way, Ling was right. They needed to enter the Mythical Kirin form through Mythical Revival. If they wanted to perfectly control the power of a god, they indeed had a long way to go.
“Practice more.”
“Try to adapt to the Mythical form as soon as possible.”
“Wuu!!!” Eleven nodded excitedly.
Generally speaking, for pets that had just evolved, it was indeed not easy to master new forms.
Not to mention the super form of a Mythical race. Eleven probably had a long time it needed to adapt.
Eleven felt that it had only completed half of the evolution.
Only when it really adapted to the Mythical form could it be considered a complete divine evolution.
At that time, even without Shi Yu’s support, it should be able to master quasi-divine skills on its own.
At that time, it would also be the so-called ” demigod-level battle power”.
“What a pity.” Everyone surrounded Eleven. Then, Shi Yu felt that it was a pity.
Because of this evolution, Eleven’s armor was completely disintegrated by the Yin Yang Millstone.
Its two armor forms, the Nine Li Armor and the Demon God Armor, were directly gone.
This made Shi Yu a little confused. If he found the corresponding inscription metal again, could it still carve inscription skills?
However, this pity only lasted for a while before Shi Yu and the others heaved a sigh of relief.
Through the regression effect of the Time Fruit, Eleven could still return to the form of the Nine Li and the form of the Demon God Armor. In that case, the problem was not big.
However, these two forms no longer had much meaning compared to Eleven’s current Mythical form. Changing back was equivalent to weakening.
With quasi-divine skills, those super skills were not especially attractive to Shi Yu. In that case, he would leave it to fate. At the moment, the most important thing for Shi Yu was to choose which opponent he wanted…
“In the era of Emperor Wu and the others, the Iron-eating Beast that evolved with the meteorite metal was called the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.”
“Then what should your racial name in the form of a Mythical race be called?” Shi Yu touched his chin.
“Wuu…” Eleven turned around casually. Beast Tamer, whatever.
It was happy today. No matter how ugly the name was, it could accept it.
“Wu…”
In the end, Shi Yu gave Eleven’s new race the name [Chaos Panda] and directly abandoned the Iron-eating Beast.
As for Eleven, it was as if it had encountered a bolt from the blue. ‘Bear Cat’? It didn’t understand why a bear like it had become a cat.
“Wuu!!” Eleven was furious.
Then after Teacher Ying evolved, should it change its name to Gem Bear?
The other pets were thinking about what this name… meant.
Could it be that Shi Yu liked cats more than bears? Moreover, ‘Wonton Bear Cat’? did Shi Yu like to eat wontons?
Buggy, who was about to evolve, suddenly felt worried. As expected, the leader shouldn’t have trusted Shi Yu. It was afraid that Shi Yu would give it the racial names of Dumpling Dragon, Bun Dragon, and Ramen Dragon…
….
Eleven sighed. Forget it, forget it. As long as Shi Yu liked it. After everyone recovered from Eleven’s evolution, Shi Yu also started to draw lots.
In the end, Shi Yu drew the [Frost Dragon] name.
Shi Yu, Eleven: Umm…
“Is it not good?” Shi Yu said.
“Sob.” Chaos Panda Eleven nodded.
The power of the Yin Yang Millstone… was definitely not weaker than the move that Teacher Ying used to instantly kill the Green Scaled Dragon.
Shi Yu and Eleven couldn’t say for sure what the outcome would be if this quasi-divine skill, which was enough to instantly kill a top-notch overlord, hit their own people.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 827 Undersea Prison (2)
chapters.content:
827 Undersea Prison (2)
Although Mother Dragon wasn’t weak anymore and had finally relied on the totem-level advantage and legendary resources to train the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy to perfection, there was still a risk of serious injuries.
Shi Yu and Eleven silently put the lot back and drew another one. They prayed in their hearts.
[Dragon Palace City Big Son], [Dragon Palace City Big Son], [Dragon Palace City Big Son]…
Although he was very worried that Eleven would end the life of this invincible Golden Dragon Crown Prince he had never met with a quasi-divine skill, it was fine as long as he didn’t use a quasi-divine skill. As long as it could guarantee victory, it didn’t matter if the opponent was a totem or an invincible overlord.
!!
Things didn’t go according to plan.
Shi Yu and Eleven looked at the new lot and fell into deep thought.
[Poison Dragon Totem].
“Why don’t we use it?” Shi Yu said.
“Wuu.” Eleven lay on Shi Yu’s shoulder and looked at the words Poison Dragon Totem on the poker card. It pondered for a moment and nodded.
That worked too.
The totem level was not an ally yet, and as the weakest totem, it was indeed very suitable to test strength.
If he remembered correctly, it should be locked in the underwater prison of Dragon Palace City.
The Poison Dragon Totem was mutated from the power of Yun An’s radiation. It should be the weakest totem.
This should be a totem that relied on “resources” to break through.
However, resources were also divided into levels. For example, the legendary resources in Shi Yu’s hands were relatively ordinary legendary resources.
As for the nine-element gem used by the gem cat, it should be the top existence among legendary resources.
As for the meteorite radiation used by the Poison Dragon Totem, it was hard to say if it had touched the threshold of legendary resources. It could only be said that the Poison Dragon Totem was lucky and unlucky.
It was lucky enough to become the totem level that countless transcendent life forms dreamed of, but because of this, his consciousness was corroded and he lost its mind.
The only powerful thing about it might be the “radiation poison” that was comparable to Yun An. Although it wasn’t as domineering as Yun An, even the overlord doctor of Dragon Palace City couldn’t cleanse it. The Immortal Dragon King had to take action.
“I wonder if Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone can destroy the rules of Yun An’s quasi-divine skill. Since Yun An’s attack can’t be cleansed and healed, can we destroy the power of laws left on the injured through destruction?”
Shi Yu felt that it was hard to say for Yun An, but there was definitely no problem with this Poison Dragon Totem.
Shi Yu gathered the entire team for a discussion and finally decided to take a look at the underwater prison in Dragon Palace City.
“I can help the Poison Dragon Totem cleanse the poison.”
“With the strongest Sea Cleansing Spirit Susu has created so far, it should be enough.”
“If the Poison Dragon Totem is obedient and willing to be a little brother after purification, arrange for it to become the new Dragon King of Dragon Palace City and enter the Dragon God Ruins. Let it get some legendary resources for us.”
“If it’s disobedient, continue to lock it up. Before the world competition, upgrade Chi Tong’s Undead Revival to perfection. Then, kill the Poison Dragon Totem and turn it into an undead puppet.”
Shi Yu’s arrangements could strengthen the team again before the world competition no matter what. He immediately obtained the strong support of Buggy and Chi Tong!
Amazing, amazing ~ ~
The two pets were pleasantly surprised and instantly looked forward to the Poison Dragon Totem.
“But before that,”
Shi Yu’s face was pale. “Baby Ginseng, create a few more sachets. This doesn’t seem to work anymore.”
Damn, the burden Eleven brought after continuous evolution seemed to be even greater.
The strength of the burden was completely greater than the attributes of the feedback.
In this state, he didn’t know if he could continue to add points happily.
Even if it was meditation, it would probably be affected.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng couldn’t bear to look at it. It was better not to think about a second overlord above his level. It was more reliable to cultivate to level seven as soon as possible.
It was very afraid that it wouldn’t be able to heal Shi Yu in the future, unless the second overlord was Baby Ginseng itself, of course!
“In short, prepare more sachets. Hurry…”
….
Because of Eleven’s evolution, even through a space, most of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain was almost paralyzed.
Even the monarchs were so frightened that their legs went weak. Fortunately, Shi Yu had learned from Ling’s evolution and didn’t break through in the city.
Otherwise, it would probably become one of the ten great supernatural incidents of Dong Huang, making the country mistake it for a totem invasion.
During the break, Shi Yu comforted Qi and the others a little to see if anything had happened to the second team. Fortunately, it was nothing serious.
After confirming that everything was appropriate, Shi Yu set off directly. His destination was the underwater prison of Dragon Palace City.
In fact, Shi Yu had long wanted to come to this place. The weakest prisoner here was also at the overlord level. Even at the totem level like the Poison Dragon Totem, there was more than one imprisoned in the underwater prison.
It could be said that both Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang had imprisoned some troublesome and valuable totems here.
As for why they didn’t kill them directly, it was because some prisoners were still useful to Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City.
For example, if they caught Yun An in the future, it would definitely be crippled and imprisoned somewhere.
The metal fragments on its body were the stable evolution resources of the Iron-eating Beast. As long as it didn’t die and they let it live on panting, it would always be a sustainable resource.
The ones imprisoned in the underwater prison were basically the same. They were either ferocious beasts that wreaked havoc in the East Sea and Dong Huang, or the defeated parties in the last totem battle.
At the same time, it was also a sustainable resource.
Shi Yu had even thought about it. If Chi Tong’s Undead Revival point reached transcendent in the future and it could enslave totem-level undead, he would directly come to the underwater prison to kill an almost useless totem. He would make do with it first.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 828 Undersea Prison (3)
chapters.content:
828 Undersea Prison (3)
In the sky where Dong Huang was flying to the underwater prison, Shi Yu stood on the Wind Immortal Sword that Ling had transformed into. With his hands behind his back, he said with a thoughtful expression,
“The underwater prison is known as an iron wall. It’s guarded by the Golden Dragon King of Dragon Palace City and reinforced by many generations of Dragon Gods. It’s known that even demigods can’t break through it. If we fight there, it shouldn’t affect us much.”
“On the other hand, fighting in the Dragon Palace mystic realm might cause a huge impact. Overall, it’s indeed the Poison Dragon Totem that we should fight.”
…
!!
In the Deep Sea Prison, the guardian was the Golden Dragon King of Dragon Palace City. In Dragon Palace City, there were a total of three top-notch totems, namely the Thunder Dragon King, the Space Dragon King, and the Golden Dragon King. The Sea Dragon King happened to be ranked in a neither high nor low position, in the middle of the original seven Dragon Kings.
Among them, the eldest prince, the Nine-clawed Golden Dragon, was the son of the Golden Dragon King.
The Deep Sea Prison was even lower than Dragon Palace City. To reach here, one had to first pass through the Dragon Palace mystic realm.
Because of this, with the suppression of generations of Dragon Palace City, there was indeed no problem coming out from the Deep Sea Prison.
After Shi Yu entered the ocean, he changed his transportation. Before heading to the underwater prison, he first arrived at the Dragon Palace mystic realm and found Mother Dragon.
As the minister of the Environmental Protection Department and an honorary general of Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu naturally had the qualifications to enter the underwater prison. However, he was only qualified to enter.
If he wanted to execute a prisoner, take a prisoner away, and release a prisoner, three or more Dragon Kings or the Dragon God had to nod. Shi Yu definitely couldn’t do it alone.
Therefore, before he went to find the Poison Dragon Totem, he planned to issue the joint ruling of the Ice Dragon King and the others.
After entering the Dragon Palace mystic realm, Shi Yu naturally went very smoothly. He directly came to find Ice Dragon.
“Kid, why are you here again!!!”
In the Ice Dragon Palace, Ice Dragon gritted its teeth in anger. It didn’t like Shi Yu very much.
It had finally been convinced by Shi Yu to follow it to Tingxiang. It originally thought that Shi Yu would bring it to crack a few ruins and obtain some treasures, but in the end, there was nothing.
Shi Yu only stayed for a few days before abducting a little elf and returning to the country, leaving it, a lonely old dragon, to preside over the exchange competition.
Damn Shi Yu.
In the future, if it followed Shi Yu out again, it would stop being a dragon!
If it weren’t for the fact that Lu Qingyi had given it a gift after the incident, Ice Dragon felt that it would have gone for nothing.
“Mother Dragon, a good thing,” Shi Yu said.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, also said, “Good thing!!!”
Huh?
The frost dragon, which had shrunk to two meters tall and could communicate normally with Shi Yu, suddenly looked at Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder with a serious expression and was a little concerned.
It looked at Eleven’s black eyes with a circle of white marks and its heart skipped a beat. It actually felt a sense of danger.
