Generally speaking, relatively powerful overlords were a little sensitive to powerful lives, let alone Ice Dragon, who had participated in the totem battle. Although it was only a cooling mount for Mu Huiyin most of the time, Ice Dragon’s knowledge was not weak at all.
At this moment, the frost dragon actually sensed danger of the same level on this little Iron-eating Beast.
What was going on?
“Why did the color of its eyes change back?” Ice Dragon said.
Ordinary Iron-eating Beasts’ eyes were indeed black, and Shi Yu’s had long turned blue because of the evolution of lightning and becoming a royal. And now, Ice Dragon realized that it had actually turned black again.
“And its aura… has reached the overlord level??”
Ice Dragon couldn’t believe it.
“You broke through to the legend level?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “No, no, I just let it break through to overlord in advance. Isn’t the world competition about to begin? I thought that an overlord in the team was more reliable. My physique is not bad, I can still take it.”
“Because it broke through to overlord and evolved again, its form changed a little.”
Ice Dragon was shocked and doubtful. It evolved again. Did it evolve with the meteorite fragment?
No wonder the aura was so terrifying.
Ice Dragon paused and was silent for a moment. It was really becoming more and more cowardly. Damn it, it actually cared about an overlord, and it was an overlord contracted by a level-six telepathy Beast Tamer above its level.
It cursed, “What good thing? Tell me quickly.”
Shi Yu said, “My Susu has received the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite and mastered the strongest cleansing skill, the Sea Cleansing Spirit. I think the current us should be able to complete the cleansing of the Poison Dragon Totem.”
“Huh?” Ice Dragon was stunned.
“After purification, the Poison Dragon Totem is a totem-level dragon-element life form. It can enter the Dragon God Ruins. At that time, it will take out two or three legendary resources and we’ll split them. Don’t you think it’s a good thing!”
“Ning!” Susu also popped its head out of Shi Yu’s pocket.
It expressed that it had already taken off.
Ice Dragon was stunned. It leaned back strategically, its eyes serious and serious.
Shi Yu naturally couldn’t take all of the Poison Dragon Totem. After all, the Poison Dragon Totem was captured by the Sea Dragon King and the Ice Dragon King together. Shi Yu didn’t want to take the majority. He just had to drink some soup. The meat was for these big shots to eat.
“You brat…” Ice Dragon’s expression immediately returned to its doting smile. It stretched out its dragon claws and pointed at Shi Yu.
Although it didn’t know why the monarch-level Susu had received the power of the sea that could only be inherited at the overlord level, it didn’t matter.
Ice Dragon was instantly excited. It felt that it could at least obtain a legendary resource this time.
It immediately found Shi Yu pleasing to the eye again.
Not bad, not bad.
“I understand. I’ll go find the Sea Dragon King and the others now.”
Ice Dragon roared. It also knew that dealing with the prison totem required the nod of the three Dragon Kings. Don’t worry, leave it to it!
At that time, everyone would go together and be Shi Yu’s bodyguard. They would ensure that Shi Yu would not be injured during the cleansing process.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 829 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone
chapters.content:
829 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone
Soon.
The frost dragon found the Sea Dragon King and the Immortal Dragon King.
Of these two, one had arrested the Poison Dragon Totem with it, and the other had cleansed the injured in the entire Dragon Palace City. They were both Dragon Kings who played a key role in the Poison Dragon incident.
At this moment, after the Sea Dragon King and the Immortal Dragon King learned that Susu had accepted the Blue Sea inheritance, they were also extremely shocked.
At the same time, there was huge confusion and more confusion.
“Shi Yu, are you sure that Lord Blue Sea Sprite has already accepted the inheritance??”
The Sea Dragon King looked at the Water Slime on Shi Yu’s shoulder and said with a doubtful expression.
Why did it feel that Lord Blue Sea Sprite’s reincarnation was still at the monarch level?
It didn’t feel that he had become stronger.
Moreover, the various Dragon Kings expected that after the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation accepted the inheritance, it should leave Shi Yu…
Why didn’t either situation make sense now?
“Something happened, but it definitely accepted the inheritance.” Shi Yu smiled.
The Immortal Dragon King was speechless. Was this a trick…
Moreover…
“Even Lord Blue Sea Sprite…” The Sea Sprite Dragon Immortal Dragon King also had a puzzled expression.
Monarch level.
Even the Blue Sea Sprite couldn’t be stronger than its own cleansing ability at the monarch level, right?
It couldn’t even cleanse the Poison Dragon Totem…
After all, it had mastered a cleansing skill that had been developed to perfect proficiency, and it was at the totem level!
“Ning!!!”
Seeing that these Dragon Kings suspected it, Susu snorted and curled its lips. Wait and see.
“Don’t worry.”
Shi Yu smiled, reassuring the Dragon Kings.
Not to mention that Susu was only at the monarch level now, even if it was only at the Awakening level, as long as it had the Blue Sea Contract and the Sea Cleansing Spirit, its cleansing power wouldn’t be weak.
The Blue Sea Contract had infinite energy. Even demigods didn’t have as much energy as it.
The more ocean energy the Sea Cleansing Spirit provided, the stronger the cleansing power.
In other words, the combination of these two skills had almost no upper limit to its cleansing power. Only “time” determined its cleansing power.
The proficiency of these two skills and its growth level could only allow it to condense stronger cleansing power in a shorter period of time.
At the moment, Susu had already condensed an extremely strong Sea Cleansing Spirit through the continuous creation of the Time Fruit and a month. The effect was even stronger than a transcendent cleansing skill.
This Sea Cleansing Spirit was already comparable to a totem-level attack. If nothing went wrong, it was easy to brainwash an overlord.
At the moment, in his team, probably only the evolved Eleven could resist the brainwashing of this Sea Cleansing Spirit.
However, just like self-destruction, this move was also banned by Shi Yu. After all, it was not easy to create one. It had to be used on the edge.
For example, supporting points-adding, cleansing the Poison Dragon Totem in exchange for resources, or saving it for the World Tournament.
There was still a period of time before the World Tournament, enough to support Susu to create another similar one, so this could be used to cleanse the Poison Dragon Totem in exchange for other resources.
“In short, it’s so confident. Let them give it a try.” The Ice Dragon King couldn’t wait anymore. It trusted Shi Yu the most.
“Alright then, let’s give it a try. In any case, with us around, the Poison Dragon Totem can’t cause any trouble.” When the Sea Dragon King and the Immortal Dragon King saw this, they didn’t say anything else. They nodded and decided to go together.
After all, the Poison Dragon was at the totem level and very dangerous. If Shi Yu went to approach and cleanse it, he would probably be in danger without the protection of more than two totems.
…
“Who is it!!!”
A moment later, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the deep sea prison mystic realm below the Dragon Palace mystic realm.
Shi Yu stood on the huge Water Slime and turned into a Slime Knight. He came with the three Dragon Kings.
At the entrance of the mystic realm, just as they arrived, a team of humanoid transcendent creatures appeared and stopped them.
More than ten humanoid creatures, the Sea Yaksha, were green like toad demons.
They were all at the monarch level and held fork-type weapons.
In the lead was a female Sea Yaksha. Her form was very different from the others, and her appearance was very sexy.
< Name > Yaksha King
[Attributes]: Water
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 72,330,000
“Eh? Minister Shi Yu?”
“There’s also the Ice Dragon King, the Sea Dragon King, and Lord Immortal Dragon King?”
This yaksha with a fiery figure and a whip had pink scales on its waist, legs, wrists, chest, and face, but its appearance was still moving. Apart from the scales, the other party’s greatest characteristics were the huge curved goat horns and sea snake-like hair.
She was immediately surprised to see the big shots coming.
The other ordinary Yakshas were abnormally shocked. This was the first time they had seen so many big shots traveling together.
“Yinlin.” Seeing the leader of this team of Sea Protecting Yakshas, the Sea Dragon King said, “We want to enter the underwater prison to see the Poison Dragon Totem. Inform the Golden Dragon King.”
Shi Yu, the Ice Dragon King, and the Immortal Dragon King smiled at her.
Yaksha King Ying Lin was the sister of the Yaksha General in Dragon Palace City. She was a top-notch overlord, one of the four guardian overlords of the underwater prison.
“Yes, Lord Sea Dragon King!” The leading female yaksha was stunned before nodding!
In the depths of the underwater prison.
The Golden Dragon King, who was in charge of guarding the underwater prison, slowly opened its golden-green eyes. Its body was strong, and golden scales covered its entire body. Its dragon claws were strong, and after it got up and flew in the sky, its insufferable dignity was revealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 830 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (2)
chapters.content:
830 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (2)
“What… are you doing!”
It leaped out and instantly circled outside the underwater prison, looking at the Dragon Kings in front of the Cherry Scaled overlord that had summoned it.
Among the original seven Dragon Kings, the Golden Dragon King, the Space Dragon King, and the Thunder Dragon King were all cultivated by the Dragon God after she destroyed the previous Dragon God and her trusted aides. As for the Sea Dragon King and the Ice Dragon King, they naturally joined later.
Therefore, even the Sea Dragon King greeted the Golden Dragon respectfully, “Big Brother Golden Dragon, we’re here this time to cleanse the Poison Dragon Totem!”
!!
The Golden Dragon King’s gaze swept across the Sea Dragon King, the Immortal Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and Shi Yu. “I thought you were here to find something to eat again.”
The last time the Sea Dragon King and the others came to the underwater prison, it was to eat the Vortex Demon Beast. This time, it thought that they were going to eat the new black goat.
“However, why did you bring him here?” The Golden Dragon King looked at Shi Yu. He knew Shi Yu’s identity, but this was the first time he had seen this so-called minister of the Environmental Protection Department.
The Immortal Dragon King said, “Because this time, Shi Yu is the main force of cleansing. We’re just bodyguards.”
“Oh?” The Golden Dragon King was stunned and looked at Shi Yu, who nodded.
“Lord Golden Dragon King, I wanted to come this time.”
“I understand. Then I’ll bring you there.”
The Poison Dragon Totem wasn’t a difficult prisoner. With the three Dragon Kings leading the team, it couldn’t cause any trouble.
After the Golden Dragon King appeared, Shi Yu and the others began to advance into the mystic realm under the lead of the Golden Dragon King.
The underwater prison was a multi-level mystic realm.
The deeper the spatial layer, the higher the spatial strength.
As it was a special spatial mystic realm, in order to ensure spatial stability, all spatial skills were forbidden here.
Therefore, Shi Yu and the others could only slowly walk and fly.
“Kid.” The Golden Dragon King led the way and said, “Don’t be afraid. Although the murderous aura here is a little stronger, they can’t come out.”
“We haven’t even reached the first level and you’re already like this. When we reach the fourth level, won’t the aura of those totems scare you so much that you pee your pants?”
Shi Yu: “Senior Golden Dragon King, I’m not afraid.”
The Golden Dragon King chuckled. On its huge golden divine dragon body, its dragon eyes said disdainfully, “Your face is pale from fright. Do you think I can’t see it?”
Shi Yu and Susu: …
“I wasn’t scared white. My body is just a little weak.” Shi Yu was speechless.
The Sea Dragon King and the others were not surprised. Although Shi Yu looked even more weak today, he usually did this.
The Ice Dragon King said, “He’s only weakened because he contracted an overlord above its level in preparation for the world competition. This little battle array shouldn’t be able to scare this kid.”
“Oh?” The Golden Dragon King was stunned. So that was the case. It said, “A level-six Beast Tamer contracted an overlord above his level? You guys are pretty hardworking for the World Tournament.”
“But from the looks of it, you can’t. Although Dragon Palace City didn’t participate, from the situation of the various totem countries, an overlord is at most an admission ticket!”
Overlords were only admission tickets. Top-notch overlords barely had the qualifications to fight. Only invincible overlords could really compete for the championship. Although Dragon Palace City didn’t plan to participate in the world competition, the Golden Dragon King knew the situation of the world competition very well.
In its opinion, even if Shi Yu contracted an overlord above his level, he would only be crushed by an even stronger overlord.
It was better to use the relationship with Dragon Palace City to cultivate well in the various mystic realms of the Dragon Palace.
“I know, but the World Tournament has been held for so many years. It would be a pity to miss it,” Shi Yu said.
“That’s true, but if you were born five years earlier and came to work for me for five years, you might have a place in the World Tournament,” the Golden Dragon King said.
“My good-for-nothing son only became so strong after training in the underwater prison for many years!”
“After the world competition ends, I’ll definitely come over to train for a period of time,” Shi Yu said.
The space of the underwater prison was divided into six levels, corresponding to ordinary overlords, top-notch overlords, invincible overlords (quasi totems), ordinary totems, top-notch totems, and totem half-gods.
Among them, the Poison Dragon Totem, the Black Goat Totem, and the Vortex Totem were basically locked on the fourth level.
It was said that even demigods couldn’t break through the fourth level and above. The spatial strength was comparable to a Mythical Sealed Ruins, and it was easy to lock totems.
From the fifth level onwards, there were actually no prisoners. The ones imprisoned were basically the defeated top-notch totems in the last totem battle. At the moment, there was not a single life on the sixth level.
The reason why Shi Yu said that was because there were really many totems here. There were definitely many rare skills on him. After all, he had already reached the level of developing skills himself. He had to have some trump cards.
Working in the underwater prison, the mission was not as simple as patrolling. Interrogating totems, dissecting totem materials, and suppressing totems were all extremely dangerous things.
Under the arrangements of the Golden Dragon King, the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City had trained here for more than ten years. It was the key for it to become an invincible overlord. After all, it had a bunch of ferocious overlords as sparring partners every day. In addition, it didn’t lack resources. It was difficult not to be strong. Of course, if it were the little white dragon, it definitely wouldn’t dare to come to such a place.
“Your mentality is not bad. Brother Sea Dragon, when will you send your little white dragon in too?” the Golden Dragon King said.
The Sea Dragon King sighed. Stop talking.
That useless trash!
It really regretted not encouraging Shi Yu to contract the little white dragon back then.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 831 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (3)
chapters.content:
831 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (3)
“Roar!!!”
“Whale!! Let me out!!”
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others had already walked there. In the dark sewer-like passage, dark golden doors were on both sides. They were doors that led to independent mystic realm spaces.
Behind the door, faint deterrence and roars could even be heard from time to time.
Apart from that, Shi Yu also noticed the number on the dark gold spatial door.
3-2.
The front represented the number of levels, and the back represented the importance of the imprisoned creature on this level.
“The sealing isn’t very good…” Shi Yu said.
Golden Dragon King: “It’s harmless.”
Soon, Shi Yu and the others arrived at the fourth level. The four Dragon Kings came together in a huge formation.
In the end, the Golden Dragon King stopped outside a huge dark gold door that was a hundred meters tall.
On it was written “4-10”, which meant that the Poison Dragon Totem was ranked tenth in danger or importance among the ordinary totems imprisoned in the underwater prison.
This made Shi Yu realize that there were probably at least ten totems imprisoned in the underwater prison. Perhaps there were 20.
“This is the place,” the Golden Dragon King said.
“Kid, be careful. Although the creatures imprisoned in the underwater prison can’t mobilize natural energy here, their own strength is very difficult to restrict. It’s also easy to kill overlords.”
“For example, on this Poison Dragon, you also know that there’s a terrifying poison radiation. Just dyeing it a little is enough to heavily injure an overlord.”
“Apart from that, its physique far exceeds that of an overlord. Even without using transcendent power, it can crush ordinary overlords with its physical strength alone.”
“With our protection, it’s alright. Let’s go in!” Ice Dragon couldn’t wait anymore.
“Alright.” Shi Yu also nodded in anticipation.
Shi Yu and the four Dragon Kings entered together. Soon, they saw the environment of the prison mystic realm clearly.
This place was incomparably huge and empty. The entire prison space was dark purple, and the sky was purple. There was no ground, only shallow seawater. Originally, the seawater here was cleansing water, but under the pollution of the Poison Dragon Totem, it had already become black poisonous water.
As for the Poison Dragon Totem, it was in the center of the shallow sea. It stood there with its eyes closed. Its limbs were bound by huge chains, and it looked like it couldn’t move.
It was a hundred meters tall and looked like a huge black dinosaur standing on two feet. It was impressive and domineering. Even though it was imprisoned, it still emitted the power of a totem. If an ordinary level-six Beast Tamer came, just looking at it would probably make their hearts tremble.
At this moment, after someone entered, it slowly opened its violent eyes.
At the same time, it let out a shocking roar!!
The chain vibrated!
The chains corroded by the poison also showed signs of falling off.
“Roar!!!” A terrifying roar seemed to have turned into a hurricane, instantly making the black waves roll.
The Golden Dragon King said solemnly, “It doesn’t have any rationality at all. It will make such a fuss every time and only sleep for a while when it’s exhausted. In its current state, it should have just rested well.”
It didn’t matter if the totems wreaked havoc in the underwater prison mystic realm, because the spatial strength here was enough to suppress them.
At the same time, the energy that erupted when they wreaked havoc would be actively absorbed by the underwater prison mystic realm to strengthen it.
Therefore, this was a dead cycle.
“It’s more troublesome to cleanse this state, right? Sea Dragon King, Immortal Dragon King, Ice Dragon King, how about we exhaust this guy together?” the Golden Dragon King said.
“Alright.” Although the Dragon Kings didn’t want to spend much effort, looking at the Poison Dragon Totem, Shi Yu probably couldn’t cleanse it directly.
However, just as the four Dragon Kings were about to attack, Shi Yu, who was standing on the huge Water Slime, licked his lips and said, “Seniors, this is very good.”
“Let me do it.”
“Huh?” Shi Yu’s words stunned the four Dragon Kings. They didn’t understand what Shi Yu meant.
Shi Yu said, “I have two cleansing plans. I want to give them a try.”
“Apart from letting the Lord Blue Sea Sprite cleanse, what other cleansing plans are there?!” the Immortal Dragon King said.
“Sabotage,” Shi Yu said.
“Huh?” The Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, the Immortal Dragon King, and the Golden Dragon King were stunned. What was this?
“I want to verify first if the poison radiation on its body can be obliterated through other methods apart from cleansing methods. This is very important. Let it maintain this energetic state first…”
If it was too weak, Shi Yu was afraid that it couldn’t withstand Eleven’s attack.
Yes, Shi Yu wanted Eleven to try and see if it could destroy the poison on this Poison Dragon Totem through the Yin Yang Millstone.
If even the poison radiation on this Poison Dragon Totem couldn’t be obliterated, then how could it resist Yun An’s incurable injuries?
It could be said that the Poison Dragon in this state was an excellent sparring partner to verify Eleven’s battle power.
“What do you mean?” The Dragon Kings had yet to react.
Shi Yu said, “That’s right. I’ll suppress it, consume it, and cleanse it alone.”
“Seniors, you only need to protect me at the critical moment.”
“What nonsense are you talking about?” Ice Dragon was stunned. At this moment, it couldn’t understand what Shi Yu was thinking.
“Roar!!!”
The monster that opened its eyes didn’t have any rationality, but no matter how terrifying the few guys opposite it were, after condensing the energy that had naturally recovered in its body, it opened its huge mouth and a black and red ball of light that emitted strong heat instantly condensed in its mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 832 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (4)
chapters.content:
832 Chaotic Panda and Yin Yang Millstone (4)
Buzz…
At this moment, the terrifying energy tide made the expressions of the four Dragon Kings change. They knew that the Poison Dragon Totem had started to attack.
The Sea Dragon King and the frost dragon were very familiar with this move. Its destructive power was very powerful. It could instantly destroy a town and raise a monstrous tsunami. At the same time, it also had the effect of poison radiation. It would be very uncomfortable to be hit.
Even when they worked together to destroy the Poison Dragon Totem, they avoided this move. They didn’t want to fight head-on, afraid that they would be infected with poison.
“Leave it to me. Believe me,” Shi Yu said.
At the same time, a summoning array appeared on his shoulder. Eleven, who had just returned to the Beast Taming Space to rest and accumulate strength, was summoned by Shi Yu.
Under the purple summoning array, the Dragon Kings were stunned when they saw Shi Yu summon his Iron-eating Beast.
No way.
This kid, Shi Yu, really wanted to suppress and consume the Poison Dragon Totem alone?
Purification with the power of destruction… What did it mean?!
They didn’t understand.
However, in the next moment, the expressions of the four Dragon Kings changed. Even the top-notch totem, the Golden Dragon King, revealed shocked expressions.
An incomparably terrifying aura was emitted from Shi Yu’s body.
Under the powerful fluctuations, Shi Yu’s eyes revealed a divine power. His eyes were like a spinning black and white Taiji Painting, mysterious and extremely deep.
At the same time, the huge black and white Yin Yang Diagram suddenly covered the “ground” of the entire prison space, forming a domain.
In an instant, the entire prison space turned black and white.
Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, had already leaped up and entered a Mythical state under the enhancement of Shi Yu’s telepathy!
Under the incredulous expressions of the four Dragon Kings, Eleven, who was less than half a meter tall just now, directly erupted with all its strength from its shrunken and restrained state. At this moment, light and darkness appeared on its body, and its body suddenly increased. In a short moment, in midair, it changed into a ten-meter-tall chaos panda form.
In this state, its entire body was blurry, as if it had fallen into a chaotic lightning sea. The black hair was blurry like black electric arcs, and the white hair was blurry like a white electric arc. Yin and Yang lightning lingered around its body.
While still maintaining the appearance of the Iron-eating Beast, its form became extremely shocking, like the first Chaos Thunder God in the world.
“This power…” At this moment, seeing Eleven become like this, the four Dragon Kings were extremely shocked. Especially the Golden Dragon King, who actually sensed power that was not inferior to or even exceeded the invincible overlord, the Golden Dragon Prince, on this pet.
This was the overlord Shi Yu had contracted above his level?
What a joke?!
Moreover!
At this moment, in the prison space, Eleven, who seemed to have just split into Yin and Yang and turned into a very blurry figure, had a circular metal formed in his palm. The metal was also black and white, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around him seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.
Buzz…
At this moment, it was as if the prison mystic realm had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. Under the sound of laws, the expressions of the four Dragon Kings became even more stunned, shocked, and unbelievable.
“Quasi-divine skill!!!” The four Dragon Kings roared in disbelief. At that moment, even their bloodlines felt a pressure!!
Ice Dragon found it even more difficult to understand. It finally knew what the pressure it experienced on Eleven was.
Quasi-divine skill!
How could Shi Yu, this Iron-eating Beast, master a quasi-divine skill!!
At least, before it and Mu Huiyin left, Emperor Shi’s pet didn’t master this kind of thing!
Shi Yu… How was this possible!!
“Let me see if the Yin Yang Millstone can obliterate everything.” Shi Yu’s voice was like the sound of laws, enough to shake space.
“Roar!!!”
Shi Yu and Eleven erupted with all their might. Law power appeared in Eleven’s palm. Then, a stream of air surged, and the Yin Yang Millstone completely formed. Then, under the enlargement, it became larger and larger, as if a millstone enveloped the entire sky.
On the other side, the Poison Dragon Totem’s Poison Dragon Hot Breath had already been spat out, but under the incomparably terrifying suction of the Yin Yang Millstone, the hot Breath instantly distorted. In mid-air, Eleven, who leaped into the sky and evolved, directly slapped the huge Yin Yang Millstone in its hand at the Poison Dragon Totem.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the hot breath was completely swallowed and obliterated by this terrifying millstone. Then, the millstone crossed the void and descended on the Poison Dragon Totem, constantly reversing and spinning. The Poison Dragon Totem was like a bean on the millstone, and its entire body was instantly broken. The poison on its body was instantly obliterated, and the surrounding chains that bound it instantly turned into nothingness.
“Roar!!!” The huge pain made the Poison Dragon Totem let out a world-shaking scream. Then, dazzling light and darkness fluctuations bloomed where it came into contact with the millstone. White and black light instantly enveloped the sky and the ground. Then, with a boom, the huge Poison Dragon was deep in the explosion. The hundred-meter-tall body it stood on was directly flipped over and fell backward, smashing into huge waves.
After it fell to the ground, it instantly let out a miserable roar.
A totem was directly heavily injured by this attack.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu said with a pale expression, “It seems to be really possible. This move can indeed obliterate poison, radiation, and all other substances.”
“It’s just too difficult to control. I don’t dare to attack its mind and soul at all. I’m afraid I still have to let Susu undergo a more comprehensive cleansing.”
“Seniors, see? We can do it ourselves.”
Before the world competition… he had to perfect and familiarize himself with the Yin Yang Millstone and use it more!
Otherwise, it would definitely not be convenient to use it when the time came.
“Wuu!!!” In mid-air, after succeeding in one hit, Eleven returned to its restrained form. Seeing this, Susu let out a cry and shook its head, indicating that in terms of cleansing, it still had to rely on it.
Physical cleansing was unreliable! It was easy to die.
At this moment, Shi Yu made a judgment, but it directly shattered the values of the four Dragon Kings. They widened their dragon eyes and looked at Eleven, who had returned to its mini Iron-eating Beast form, in shock.
F*ck, the Golden Dragon King’s heart seemed to have exploded. This was the overlord Shi Yu contracted above his level???
It looked at the broken body on the ground. There was no longer any poison on its body. Even the Immortal Dragon King and it were helpless when it came to cleansing. After the Poison Dragon Totem that couldn’t be cleansed turned into a clean and hygienic dragon totem, it was momentarily unable to accept it!
The Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the Immortal Dragon King widened their eyes and looked at the Poison Dragon Totem on the ground. For a moment, they didn’t know what to think.
‘It was just too difficult to control’? ‘It didn’t dare to attack its mind and soul at all’? ‘It probably was better to let Susu cleanse it’?
Human language?
He meant that he’s afraid of attacking its spirit and soul and completely killing it?
Even if the Poison Dragon Totem was in a weakened state, this was still a totem. Don’t casually say such terrifying words, alright!!
He was a f*cking level-six Beast Tamer!
Quasi-divine skill… But soon, every totem dragon king sensed the real reason behind this series of terrifying phenomena in extreme shock.
They were stunned. Shi Yu’s pet had actually cultivated a quasi-divine skill!!!
The Golden Dragon King opened its mouth slightly. It couldn’t understand why an overlord-level life form could cultivate a quasi-divine skill. It also couldn’t understand why an overlord contracted by a level-six Beast Tamer above its level was not inferior to the invincible Golden Dragon Crown Prince it had spent a lot of effort to nurture before erupting with a quasi-divine skill.
When it recalled that it didn’t recommend Shi Yu to participate in the world competition previously, the Golden Dragon King was stunned.
However, when it thought of how a level-six Beast Tamer could compete for the championship in the world competition where top-notch overlords were everywhere, it was even more stunned.
Great God Ancestral Dragon above, who could tell it what was going on?
“Wh-what’s going on!!!” When the frost dragon saw that Shi Yu had the strength to suppress the totem in one hit, it directly broke through its defense and looked at Shi Yu and Eleven with an explosive expression.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Didn’t I tell you? Eleven evolved a bit. This is the Chaos Panda form and its skill, Yin Yang Millstone.”
Ice Dragon: You call this a bit???

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 833 Dragon Transformation Fruit
chapters.content:
833 Dragon Transformation Fruit
This was the first time the four Dragon Kings had seen such a ferocious overlord.
It defeated the totem in one hit!
This was a quasi-divine skill. Was this a Mythical race?
Chaos Panda!
Yin Yang Millstone!
Although they couldn’t understand, they felt that it was very impressive.
The four Dragon Kings couldn’t understand why Shi Yu, a Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent, had evolved a Mythical pet.
Many Dragon Kings present knew the evolution legend, Lin Feng.
The Sea Dragon King was even more certain that even Lin Feng had yet to evolve into a pet race with quasi-divine skills.
The pets in the first team were basically only close to Mythical races.
In the Sea Dragon King’s opinion, perhaps its Beast Tamer could definitely step into the Mythical Domain in the future.
However, before Lin Feng disappeared, at Shi Yu’s age, it was definitely not that ridiculous.
How did Shi Yu do it?
In the sky, Eleven, who had returned to its restrained state to recover its physical fitness, fell back with a worried expression and landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
It and Shi Yu were relatively worried.
They felt that the power contained in the Yin Yang Millstone was too profound. No matter what, they could only see the surface. Although it was powerful enough, it was more convenient to use low-level skills.
Fortunately, the four Dragon Kings didn’t know what Shi Yu and Eleven were thinking. Otherwise, they would definitely want to strangle them to death.
“Wahhhhhh!”
“Cough, cough.” However, posturing was destined to have a price. After one move, Shi Yu’s brain and eyes instantly hurt, and his face turned even paler. Eleven hurriedly patted Shi Yu’s back.
Shi Yu seemed to be seriously ill as he took a deep breath of the sachet on his neck.
“What’s wrong with you? Are you alright?” Ice Dragon immediately asked.
Shi Yu said, “It’s alright. It’s just that the move just now consumed more energy.”
Ice Dragon was stunned before remembering that Eleven wasn’t the only one who shocked them just now. There was also the divine power produced by Shi Yu.
At that moment, Shi Yu’s eyes changed patterns.
The power emitted by the eyes was comparable to the pressure of a god. It also produced an extremely unbelievable power.
Ice Dragon opened its mouth slightly. “Why are you also…”
Shi Yu said, “The conditions for this quasi-divine skill are relatively harsh. It’s a skill that can only be used after I develop my telepathy talent a second time and enter a special state with Eleven. Therefore, the Beast Tamer himself has a certain consumption.”
“Stop talking.” The Sea Dragon King’s heart was bleeding.
Damn, could these geniuses not develop their talents randomly?
The telepathy talent was good telepathy. It could accept listening to history, but what was the meaning of supporting the use of quasi-divine skills now?
When it recalled how it despised Shi Yu because of telepathy back then, the Sea Dragon King regretted it.
It felt sorry for its little white dragon…
“But it’s alright. Susu, I’ll rely on you next.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Susu reminded before everyone’s attention turned to it.
At this moment, Susu in the form of a Water Slime began to change its form. Water swirled down, and its body flickered, outlining a mermaid-like body.
The water formed a beautiful blue long hair, bright blue eyes, beautiful appearance, and plump upper body. Its lower body was a blue fishtail that kept flowing like a wave.
Its entire body was made of water, and it was considered a humanoid elemental life form. Its aura was incomparably noble, and it had an otherworldly aura. As it changed its form, the Sea Dragon King, the Immortal Dragon King, and the other lives that had always lived in the ocean felt an unreachable might again.
Buzz!
As if its soul had left its body, a blue Sea Cleansing Spirit that looked similar to Susu’s form directly left its body and flew into the sky. Then, a huge energy wave erupted!!
This Sea Cleansing Spirit gradually enlarged and gradually grew. Soon, it expanded to a thousand meters tall. It was majestic and spectacular. The holy cleansing aura on its body was even richer, and the energy fluctuations as deep as the ocean shocked the Sea Dragon King and the other pets.
It was the monarch level again, displaying power that was enough to deter totem level.
If Eleven’s quasi-divine skill just now was of high skill quality, then this was high volume.
This was the power of the combination skill of the Blue Sea Sprite.
This Sea Cleansing Spirit was condensed by Susu in a month.
In a unit of time, the energy it could erupt with in an instant was indeed inferior to the totem level, but if time dragged on, its Sea Cleansing Spirit would be extremely terrifying as a trump card.
After condensing for a year, it could even be used as a killer move to threaten demigods.
“Ning.” This Sea Cleansing Spirit was like Susu’s incarnation. As Susu looked at the Poison Dragon Totem, the Sea Cleansing Spirit stretched out its arm and directly grabbed the huge Poison Dragon Totem in its palm.
Its palm was like a monstrous tsunami that swept over, instantly devouring the Poison Dragon Totem.
In the next moment, a sizzling sound came from the Poison Dragon Totem. White smoke that looked like ice mist spread from the huge water palm.
“Roar!!!!”
The Poison Dragon Totem let out a painful howl as if its mind and soul were being torn apart again.
It was obvious how much pain the two cleansings had caused it.
This was basically equivalent to stripping the poison attribute from its body.
It wasn’t that Poison Dragons couldn’t be poisonous, but the poison of Yun An was too strong. It couldn’t adapt. Previously, it was only an overlord, so it couldn’t bite off more than it could chew.
“Unbelievable, unbelievable. I can feel that the poison attributes on the Poison Dragon Totem are gradually disappearing.”

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 834 Dragon Transformation Fruit (2)
chapters.content:
834 Dragon Transformation Fruit (2)
The Immortal Dragon King felt that it was wrong, very wrong. It actually doubted the cleansing ability of the Blue Sea Sprite.
This was simply going to cleanse even its attributes.
“It looks like it can really succeed?”
The Sea Dragon King and the others were secretly shocked. It was really stronger than the Immortal Dragon King’s cleansing ability.
!!
As the strongest healing and cleansing dragon in Dragon Palace City, although the Immortal Dragon King wasn’t strong, its status in Dragon Palace City was extremely high. And now, the legendary Blue Sea Sprite was clearly even more ridiculous.
At the monarch level, it crushed the totem-level dragon in terms of cleansing ability.
In short, Shi Yu was too terrifying. Looking at the Blue Sea Sprite main body beside Shi Yu and the “Chaos Panda” that had sent the Poison Dragon Totem flying with a single hit, the four Dragon Kings momentarily didn’t know how to evaluate this level-six Beast Tamer.
At this moment.
The consciousness of the Poison Dragon Totem was extremely blurry, but it was also extremely clear.
It had originally lost its rationality, but as its poison-element power was purified, its rationality gradually recovered.
Memories that surged like spring water kept washing its brain.
Countless memories gradually made the Poison Dragon Totem understand the current situation.
It was the dragon-element overlord of the Rainbow Sea!
It rose in a godforsaken place like the Rainbow Sea and stepped into the overlord domain with shocking aptitude.
However, after staying in the Rainbow Islands to cultivate for decades, he thought that the small Rainbow Sea was no longer enough for him to break through the limit.
With the thought that it would rather be a weak dragon than a strong lizard, it was determined to sail far and join Dragon Palace City.
Unexpectedly, just as it set off, it was directly hit by two black-clothed humans and lost consciousness. It was forced to drink a mysterious poison. When it woke up, its body had already become poisonous.
It gradually lost its rationality and fell into the huge power, becoming a slave to power…
The Poison Dragon Totem, which had escaped from the laboratory and wreaked havoc in the East Sea, mutated and broke through. It was suppressed by the joint efforts of the two totem-level dragons and gradually recovered its consciousness. When it recalled this, it was more and more shocked.
He understood that it was very unlucky to have been captured by the evil human faction as a biological modification experimental subject. At the same time, it was very lucky to have obtained the potential to break through to the totem level during the modification process.
However, what made the Poison Dragon Totem’s heart turn cold was that after it was lucky enough to escape from the other party, it actually still entered the sea area of Dragon Palace City and even caused a huge commotion!!
It was over!
When it recalled being suppressed here by the two totem dragons, the Poison Dragon Totem directly felt a lingering fear.
Dragon Palace City was famous for being fierce.
If it had caused a scene in that area, it would definitely have been killed by the generals of Dragon Palace City.
What to do, what to do.
Even if it was still alive, there was definitely a death threat.
It didn’t think that it had the ability to fight Dragon Palace City just because it had mutated into a totem.
The memories were immediately suppressed in the underwater prison. When Shi Yu and the others appeared, it… was knocked to the ground by a pet controlled by a human Beast Tamer. Then, its strength gradually disappeared and it gradually regained its rationality.
The eyes of the Poison Dragon Totem began to become clear. Although its body was still in pain, it had already recovered its normal language ability and no longer only knew how to roar like before.
“Roar!!!! (Save… save me!)”
“Wu… (I’m innocent.)”
“Uh… (Don’t kill me…)”
“This guy…” At this moment, they clearly heard the voice of the Poison Dragon Totem. The Golden Dragon King and the others understood that the Poison Dragon Totem had completely recovered its consciousness at this moment and was no longer that crazy dragon that only knew how to attack in chaos.
Under the continuous cleansing power, the huge figure of the Sea Cleansing Spirit became dimmer and dimmer. Fortunately, Eleven completed half of the cleansing work in advance. Otherwise, Susu’s month of hard work would probably be gone.
Now, it could at least support Shi Yu to add points for a period of time.
The Sea Cleansing Spirit’s expression was indifferent and unmoved. After cleansing the last trace of poison-element power of the Poison Dragon Totem, it directly threw it into the pool with a backhand and slowly disappeared.
At this moment, not to mention the Poison Dragon Totem, even the entire prison space had been cleansed by Susu. The polluted black water was extremely clear.
Gulp.
The Poison Dragon Totem kept rolling in the pool, its mouth bubbling. It sat up in shock from its dying illness and widened its eyes as it sat up. It looked at the four Dragon Kings opposite it and the mysterious creatures that had almost killed it in one hit just now.
“Roar!!! (Sirs, please spare me, please spare me. Listen to my explanation, I’m innocent.)” Its tail and limbs kept slapping, and water splashed. Its expression was panicked, afraid that the other party wouldn’t listen to its explanation and would throw a few more skills.
“…”
Shi Yu and the others looked at the cleansed Poison Dragon Totem in silence. For a moment, they were speechless.
It was very cowardly.
However, it was better.
“Don’t be afraid, we’re listening.” Shi Yu and the others looked at the Poison Dragon Totem expressionlessly. In the next second, the Poison Dragon Totem immediately spoke like a machine gun, ignoring the bleeding injuries on its body.
“Roar, roar.” The Poison Dragon Totem shed tears and complained about the evil Yun Race, indicating that it was only a victim. Its respect for Dragon Palace City was like a surging river, endless. How could it invade the sea area of Dragon Palace City for no reason?
“But you’ve already invaded,” the Sea Dragon King said. “Golden Dragon King, according to the laws of Dragon Palace City, how should such a life be dealt with?”

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 835 Dragon Transformation Fruit (3)
chapters.content:
835 Dragon Transformation Fruit (3)
Golden Dragon King: “If there’s no value, kill it directly. If there’s value, deal with it and imprison it for life.”
“Now that it has been cleansed, the dragon meat, dragon scales, dragon skin, and dragon blood dragon tendons on its body are all good things. It’s not a bad choice to directly take them off.”
“After all, it’s a totem-level dragon body.”
“Roar!! (No, don’t.)” The Poison Dragon Totem’s expression was stunned, and its heart exploded. It was as if it had encountered a bolt from the blue and found it difficult to accept.
!!
No, no.
It was really very innocent.
“There’s no need to be so ruthless, right? It does seem to be a victim. Why don’t we give it a chance?” Shi Yu said.
“Roar! (Yes, yes!!)” At this moment, the Poison Dragon was stunned, as if it had caught a life-saving straw. It looked at Shi Yu for help and fear.
It understood that this human was also an expert and could easily kill him. He was also grateful to Shi Yu and understood that it was the other party who had recovered his rationality.
“Minister Shi Yu, what do you think?” the Golden Dragon King said.
Shi Yu said, “Let it redeem itself and join the Environmental Protection Department to make up for the losses it created.”
There was no law in Dragon Palace City. The law was the Dragon God, and the totem dragon kings.
At this moment, the Dragon Kings and Shi Yu were playing good cop and bad cop respectively, directly allowing the Poison Dragon Totem to find a chance to “live”. Its expression instantly froze and it roared.
“Roar, roar, roar!!”
It expressed its willingness to join Dragon Palace City and offer everything it had to Dragon Palace City. If it didn’t want any benefits, it would work for Dragon Palace City in its next life!
Shi Yu and the others… had been waiting for this sentence!
The four Dragon Kings and Shi Yu looked at each other.
“Sure.” Shi Yu placed his hands behind his back and flew in the air with his Psychic power. He looked at the Poison Dragon Totem calmly and said, “On account of your sincere repentance and strength, I’ll give you a chance to be a dragon again.”
“However, if you don’t perform well…”
The Poison Dragon Totem revealed a frightened expression. It understood that Shi Yu really had the ability to kill it.
After all, its current strength was even weaker than when it first mutated.
At this moment, the powerful poison attributes on his body had already been cleansed, leaving only its totem-level body and inadequate cultivation. It didn’t match the dragon-element power of its current realm.
“Roar!!! (Lord, don’t worry. I eat little, work fast, and am super diligent.)” The Poison Dragon Totem stood up and patted its chest as it guaranteed.
….
The Dragon God didn’t care how to arrange the Poison Dragon Totem at all. Shi Yu and the others started to arrange it randomly.
The world was huge, and the benefits were the greatest. No matter what, the Poison Dragon Totem was already at the totem level.
With the ability to optimize races and skills, after cultivating hard, it would definitely be another totem-level battle power.
Compared to directly dissecting it, it was indeed better to let it atone for its crimes. Moreover, if it could enter the Dragon God Ruins and take out some resources, at least two or three legendary resources, everyone would get a share. Wouldn’t that be wonderful?
Shi Yu and the others didn’t immediately deal with the Poison Dragon Totem. Instead, they continued to let it reflect in prison.
As for Shi Yu and the others, they must have quickly come out to discuss the distribution of benefits.
After shaking off the Golden Dragon, Shi Yu and the others chuckled, especially Shi Yu and Ice Dragon. It laughed the most.
They really were family after all.
Fortunately, the gem cat wasn’t around. Otherwise, the three of them would have laughed together.
“Seniors, look, the cleansing is successful.”
“Moreover, it was unexpectedly smooth. The Poison Dragon Totem didn’t resist the whole time.”
“Even after waking up, the desire to submit is very strong.”
Shi Yu said, “According to its description and what we understand, the culprit is indeed the Yun Race and the Ke Yuan Financial Group. It’s also innocent. After nurturing it, it’s basically not a problem for Dragon Palace City to have a new totem-level general.”
The Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the other dragons nodded.
“At that time, if it’s recognized to enter the Dragon God Ruins and reward everyone with the newbie rewards in the Dragon God Ruins, that would be even better.”
“That’s right.” The Ice Dragon King was about to drool. Ever since it was extorted by Shi Yu for a legendary resource, it really wanted a second one.
“When the time comes, everyone will split it equally!” Ice Dragon said.
“I should be part of it, right?” Shi Yu was filled with anticipation.
The sea dragon and ice dragon laughed. Of course.
After all, the Poison Dragon was cleansed by Shi Yu.
“Of course. If it can enter the Dragon God Ruins in the future, you should at least have a legendary resource, alright?” the Sea Dragon King said.
Although Shi Yu was a junior, the Sea Dragon King had already treated Shi Yu as a life form of the same level.
Putting aside the fact that Shi Yu would become a totem-level undead after his death, just Shi Yu’s current battle power… was enough to fight ordinary totems.
If Shi Yu was given a little more time, it would probably be impressive.
“Hehe.” At this moment, Shi Yu was a little embarrassed. He scratched his head shyly and looked at the Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the Immortal Dragon King. “Seniors, what about… Not giving me the benefits that the Poison Dragon Totem might bring into the Dragon God Ruins in the future?”
“You guys can split it.”
The three totem dragon kings were stunned.
Ice Dragon was even more stunned.
Would Shi Yu give up the benefits?
Impossible, definitely impossible!!
It refused to believe it.
“In its state, it definitely won’t be able to enter the Dragon God Ruins in the short term. Why don’t you guys crowd-fund a legendary resource for me to use first, Senior? At that time, I won’t participate in the division of the resources. You guys split it. How about that?”
The Three Dragon Kings : “…”

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 836 Dragon Transformation Fruit (4)
chapters.content:
836 Dragon Transformation Fruit (4)
“It’s mainly because the World Tournament is too dangerous. If I can obtain a legendary-level resource in advance, my team’s strength can increase greatly. At that time, it can also be safer.”
The three Dragon Kings : “…”
The World Tournament was too dangerous.
As Shi Yu said this, the three Dragon Kings recalled the scene of Iron-eating Beast Eleven crushing the totem-level Poison Dragon with a slap in prison.
Its face darkened.
‘Are you sure?’
He wanted to participate in the world competition of the overlord level. The opponents were all Beast Tamers under the age of 30.
Not a totem battle!
Was he sure that with his battle power, he would be in danger instead of killing everyone randomly?
As long as it didn’t court death, even if the opponent was at the totem level, was it willing to provoke this brat?
“What kind of resource do you want…” The Sea Dragon King hesitated and said.
“You can tell me,” the Immortal Dragon King also said.
The frost dragon widened its eyes. They were crazy. They really listened to him.
Ice Dragon felt that Shi Yu would definitely take two portions when the time came. If he wanted them this time, he would come and split the resources again.
Shi Yu had previously promised it to fly with it after becoming a legendary Beast Tamer. There was no guarantee at all.
These were clearly empty promises.
During the trip to Tingxiang, it had already seen through Shi Yu.
In fact, it was not surprising that the Sea Dragon King and the Immortal Dragon King were willing to listen, because the potential Shi Yu displayed was too terrifying.
After evolving a Mythical pet and contracting the Blue Sea Sprite, the Sea Dragon King even wanted to let the little white dragon cultivate with Shi Yu’s second team. It wasn’t a loss, because Shi Yu looked like he was clearly destined to become a legendary.
Giving resources now was all for the sake of obtaining more returns in the future. Moreover, it wasn’t much of a sacrifice. Didn’t Shi Yu say that it was just an advance payment?
Shi Yu said, “Legendary resources of dragon and wood-element life forms.”
“Or legendary resources of water and ice.”
“Dragon-element, wood-element life form? Water-element, ice-element?” The Sea Dragon King and the others were stunned.
Shi Yu naturally asked about the legendary resources of Dragon Palace City for Buggy and Susu.
He might not necessarily be able to find legendary resources from other departments here.
But if it was dragon and water, it would definitely be foolproof.
Water and ice elements were naturally compatible with Susu. Susu only had one Cold Sky Drop, and the little wallet could no longer keep up.
Which pet in the team wasn’t more generous than it?
Of course, the inheritance of its previous life, the Blue Sea Ruins, was definitely not included. Otherwise, Susu would be the richest.
As for dragon and wood-element life-type resources, they were definitely for Buggy.
As for why it was wood-element and not spiritual, spatial, or even bug-element, it was because the Dragon of Imagination skill was about to reach perfect level.
A perfect-level Dragon of Imagination could evolve into a dragon.
A transcendent-level Dragon of Imagination could surpass dragons and walk its own path.
Dao Proficiency… Who knew?
In the beginning, Shi Yu and Buggy thought of combining the merits of the many half-gods of Dragon Palace City in the Dragon God Statue to evolve into perfect dragons.
But later on, the bigger the heart, the bigger the dream.
Shi Yu wanted Buggy to give it a try and directly use the Four Spirit Green Dragon of Heaven as a template to undergo subsequent evolution. Its power of imagination creation, together with the Green Dragon mural phenomenon in Shi Yu’s memory, in addition to dragon-element, wood-element legendary resources, and the power of the starry sky, might work.
From Eleven, Shi Yu understood that no matter what the channel was, if he wanted to cultivate any special skills, he still needed “compatibility”.
“As for water-element, I don’t have it here,” the Sea Dragon King said.
“But for wood-element, I can think of one,” the Sea Dragon King said. “However, this is the common property of Dragon Palace City. It’s used to reward members who have made huge contributions to Dragon Palace City.”
“Dragon-element, wood-element, life-type legendary resource. The Dragon Transformation Fruit on the Dragon Transformation Fruit Tree can allow pets with non-dragon bloodlines to obtain dragon-element power. Back then, General Sky Penetrating Whale obtained the dragon-element power because of the reward of the Dragon Transformation Fruit.”
“If it’s used by dragon-type pets, the life race will be stronger. It’s considered a strengthening and evolution resource.”
“This kind of fruit only bears one fruit every hundred years. It needs to be nourished by the dragon vein. It’s very rare. More than half of the totem dragon kings need to nod before it can be distributed.”
“Shi Yu, what do you think?”
“If it’s this, we can help you apply. With your contribution, it’s enough. After the Poison Dragon Totem enters the Dragon God Ruins, we’ll calculate it separately. You can still split with us,” the Sea Dragon King said generously, making Ice Dragon beside it make a ‘I told you so’ face.
There was even no need for Shi Yu to mention it himself. This guy could receive two sets!
It was envious.
“Dragon Transformation Fruit?”
Shi Yu was stunned. Dragon Transformation Fruit?
What else could it be? It was it!!
Whether Buggy could evolve into a green dragon depended on this fruit.
At this moment, Shi Yu had actually been considering whether he should contract a second overlord above his level before the world competition.
He had two ideas. The first was to let Baby Ginseng break through. This way, the nourishing effect he obtained would be good. It might not be impossible for him to withstand the burden brought by the two overlords, but it was easy for the Beast Taming Space to collapse.
The other was Buggy’s breakthrough. As a spatial pet, Buggy could receive feedback from strengthening the Beast Taming Space after it evolved and broke through. There was a high chance that it would allow Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space to break through. However, these weren’t too stable. If Buggy’s evolution and breakthrough didn’t lead Shi Yu to break through, the burden could also directly kill Shi Yu. Therefore, Shi Yu had never made a decision. After all, he had yet to feel anything that could pose a threat to Eleven… It was not easy to choose.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 837 Spirit Taiji Domain
chapters.content:
837 Spirit Taiji Domain
Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu didn’t wait long before the Dragon Transformation Fruit was sent over.
The so-called public assets of Dragon Palace City that could only be distributed with the agreement of more than half of the Dragon Kings… Shi Yu felt that it was not difficult at all.
The Sea Dragon King and his wife took two votes, and Ice Dragon took another vote. That was three votes.
!!
As they were going to distribute it to Shi Yu, the other Dragon Kings wouldn’t have any objections.
After all, at the moment, Shi Yu was a popular person beside the Dragon God. Apart from that, Shi Yu had also purified a totem battle power for Dragon Palace City. It should be credited to the Environmental Protection Department.
Therefore, it was not difficult to obtain the Dragon Transformation Fruit.
“Mother Dragon, are you going or not?”
At this moment, with the resources in hand, Shi Yu was already prepared to leave Dragon Palace City.
However, before leaving, Shi Yu invited the frost dragon to the world competition again to help him.
“Let’s talk about it later.”
Ice Dragon was annoyed. It wanted to go but didn’t want to.
Inatella sounded very dangerous. When the time came, totems would definitely be everywhere. There would even be demigods.
It didn’t believe that nothing would happen to the seven countries and the totem country.
But if it didn’t go, it would be worried and curious about Chi Tong’s situation.
“Alright,” Shi Yu said helplessly. “Then I’ll leave first.”
“Go first,” the frost dragon said without any reluctance.
After Shi Yu left, the frost dragon looked at the place where Shi Yu left in silence.
A Mythical race had evolved.
As expected of its Beast Tamer, she really knew how to choose people.
Although it wasn’t good to ask for a level-six Beast Tamer like this, Ice Dragon hoped that Shi Yu could win the world competition.
It would be a pity to miss such an invincible achievement.
“Sigh, if only she was still here.”
It missed Mu Huiyin a little and wanted her to see how it looked after breaking through to the totem level. This thousand-year-old dragon sighed in the deep Dragon Palace.
Without the people they interacted with day and night beside them, they couldn’t feel energetic doing anything.
…
After Shi Yu came out of Dragon Palace City, he felt that nothing big had happened recently.
There was less than a month left until the World Tournament. Soon, the Dong Huang team should set off for Rongguang.
The contestants of the World Tournament of the seven countries would gather in Rongguang.
If he remembered correctly, tomorrow, the ten contestants of Dong Huang’s World Tournament would still have a meeting in the capital regarding the World Tournament.
As seventh in the Sequence, he also received an invitation.
Shi Yu didn’t care much about this.
What concerned him was that the seven countries seemed to be holding an archeological conference at Rongguang.
“Archeological Conference, two Mythical resources, a pile of legendary resources…”
Shi Yu had long told President Lin their research results, which was the conclusion that the reason for the extinction of Blue Planet’s Mythical Era was an extraterrestrial faction, to let him prepare in advance.
President Lin was naturally very gratified that Shi Yu could obtain useful information from the Kirin Beast. However, this information really made the ruler’s balls hurt and he fell silent.
Ordinary people might not have to care about any world-destroying crisis at all, but as the leader of a country’s Beast Tamers, Lin Xiao had to take it seriously.
At this moment, Shi Yu was conflicted about another problem.
Although he had told President Lin about the gains of the Kirin Dream Illusion, no one in Dong Huang knew that the Wind Kirin had already advanced to a Mythical race.
Just like how the racial levels of other fossil phantom beasts would decrease after reviving, when the Kirin Phantom first revived, it wasn’t a Mythical race either. It all relied on the subsequent Mythical Revival skills to increase.
Should he greet President Lin? After all, if he used a quasi-divine skill in the World Tournament, regardless of whether he could win the championship, he would definitely become the target of all factions’ attention. He would even receive greater attention than the championship.
The first champion of the World Tournament, Lin Feng of Dong Huang, the second champion, a certain Beast Tamer from Xue Yuan, and the third champion, a certain Beast Tamer from Shen Feng, didn’t have Mythical pets.
However, Shi Yu was relatively relieved that the Dragon God and the Elven Empress had both expressed that they would watch the world competition and let Shi Yu perform at ease without any worries.
“I wonder if the mechanical legendary will awaken in the World Tournament,” Shi Yu pondered.
….
Shi Yu swam and flew before finally returning to Dong Huang.
His destination was to go straight to the capital and wait for the meeting tomorrow. He planned to stay in the ruins space for the night.
The next morning, after resting fully, Shi Yu got Buggy to teleport him to the headquarters of the Imperial Capital Association.
“Legend Zhou.” Outside the association headquarters, Shi Yu drank the milk tea made by Baby Ginseng for breakfast and walked straight into the association. In the past, it might have been fine not to eat breakfast, but recently, his health had been poor. He had to nourish himself as much as possible.
Just as he arrived at the door, Shi Yu heard the respectful greetings of the two guards. He looked in front and saw a familiar fatty who had just come over to prepare to enter.
“Thank you for your work.” Sequence six, Zhou Ming, nodded, making the two guards smile. However, they were immediately stunned. They looked behind Zhou Ming and immediately said, “Dr. Shi Yu?”
Dr. Shi Yu?
Zhou Ming also suddenly turned around and realized that a young man holding a milk tea was walking behind with a sleepy expression.
Zhou Ming : “…”
Sequence seven, number one person below legend, Shi Yu!
Zhou Ming had even challenged Shi Yu, but he was ignored by Shi Yu. At this moment, this was the first time Zhou Ming had seen Shi Yu in person. He was speechless when he saw Shi Yu’s tired and sleepy look.
Why was this spirit like the students from the high school next door? He didn’t look like a young man at all. He didn’t have any vitality at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 838 Spirit Taiji Domain (2)
chapters.content:
838 Spirit Taiji Domain (2)
“Good morning.” Shi Yu also greeted simply before looking at Zhou Ming. “Legend Zhou Ming?”
“It’s me.” Zhou Ming chuckled and said, “Nice to meet you, Dr. Shi Yu. I’ve heard so much about you.”
“Same, same.” Shi Yu was immediately amused. Wasn’t this that unlucky guy?
Originally, he was third in the initial ranking. In the end, as Zheng Hai and Lu Qingyi broke through, along with the noble’s son, Legend Jiang Tianyang, who spent money to cultivate, Zhou Ming was directly beaten to sixth place. He was in pain from the loss of resources.
Therefore, Shi Yu didn’t have to care about his challenge at all. When the settlement ended, he would fall down himself.
“Dr. Shi Yu, let’s go in.” Zhou Ming sighed in his heart. He looked at Shi Yu and his troubled brother who was in the same boat.
He and Shi Yu were so miserable.
Initially, they were all in the top five of the Sequence, but who knew that the guys behind were so beastly? They immediately squeezed them down.
In an instant, Zhou Ming felt a sense of appreciation for Shi Yu.
Legend, and the number one person below legendary… Although they were glorious, who else knew the pain of missing legendary resources?
“Alright.” Shi Yu and Zhou Ming entered the association building together and arrived at the conference room of the higher-ups. At this moment, there were quite a lot of people here. Eight of the top ten of the Sequence had already arrived.
Shi Yu and the others were the last to arrive.
First in the Sequence was the legendary Beast Tamer, Ye Xing, who was wearing a military uniform and had sharp eyebrows and starry eyes.
He was the grandson of the Titled General of Dong Huang, commanding the current strongest monarch-level army of Dong Huang, the Star Army.
Second in the Sequence, he was wearing a white ancient suit with an elegant aura. There was a divine bell that never left his side with a sword.
As a descendant of the mechanical legendary Shen Yuan, this person was extremely mysterious.
Third in the Sequence, the leader of the Heavenly Ji Group, the legend noble son, Jiang Tianyang, was wearing a formal suit. He smiled as he looked at Shi Yu and the others who entered.
The Tianji Group was born from the Talent Group and Century Group, two of the five major financial groups of Dong Huang. Jiang Tianyang’s parents were the core figures of the two major financial groups.
Sequence four, Tyrannical Sea Legend disciple, Zheng Hai. Sequence five, Lu Qingyi from an archeological family.
There was also Sequence 8, Bureau 10’s Ji Feng, Sequence 9, Zou Yun, the Heavenly King Zou, and Sequence 10, Bureau 4’s Gao Xuan.
In addition, the Sequence 7 Shi Yu who had just entered and the Sequence 6 mutated fusion talent, Legend Zhou Ming, were all present.
There were a total of six legends and four top-notch masters who could defeat overlords. Compared to the only two legendary contestants of the Seven Islands and Tingxiang, this lineup could be said to be extremely luxurious.
When Zhou Ming entered, no one felt anything. However, when Shi Yu arrived, many people’s moods began to change.
In order to rest more, Shi Yu woke up almost at the same time, unwilling to waste any rest. Therefore, just as he arrived, President Lin, the organizer of this meeting, arrived.
“Everyone, sit.”
After President Lin arrived, he nodded at everyone and sat at the innermost seat.
“The Sequence ranking has already ended for a period of time. I summoned you here this time to do the final mobilization of the World Tournament.”
Everyone nodded.
President Lin said, “I roughly have two things to say.”
“Firstly, you have to know that the world competition is a stage where ‘individuals’ compete. On the surface, there’s only one ‘champion’ honor.”
“In the world competition, every one of you will be opponents.”
“But in fact, many contestants aren’t going for the honor of the champion, but to obtain a certain amount of opportunities in the Mythical Ruins of Inatella.”
“What I want to say is that regardless of whether it’s to fight for the ‘champion’ or the ‘opportunity’, you’re all from Dong Huang after all. In the World Tournament, you’ll be a whole. If the rules allow, you have to help each other.”
“Otherwise, it’s very difficult to survive in this chaotic world competition alone.”
“In addition, there’s a deeper meaning to this world competition. Apart from participating normally, Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu, the two archeologists, have the important mission of exploring the ruins. They will be your first protection targets.”
“In addition, there’s a deeper meaning to this world competition. Apart from participating normally, Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu, the two archeologists, have the important mission of exploring the ruins. They will be your first protection targets.”
Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and Gao Xuan looked at Shi Yu in silence and were a little envious. Everyone was at level six, but Shi Yu had a bunch of legendary bodyguards… However, they also understood that the two archeologists, Lu and Shi, might be the key to them obtaining a huge opportunity in Inatella.
Other countries with rich foundations should have similar configurations.
One or two main combatants went to fight for the championship position. The rest surrounded the important archeologists to harvest opportunities in the ruins. As long as there were gains, it was not a loss. If the gains were small, they would stop while they were ahead. If the gains were relatively large, they might be able to break through on the spot and join the team fighting for the championship.
“The second thing is the final sprint. You still have about half a month to prepare. You should have more or less digested the resource reward for the Sequence ranking, right?”
“In the final stage, each of you can also apply for the final resources from the Dong Huang Association.”
“As long as you have a reasonable reason to explain the need to do this, even if it’s another legendary resource, we can distribute it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 839 Spirit Taiji Domain (3)
chapters.content:
839 Spirit Taiji Domain (3)
“Apart from that, let the national guardian assist in the special training and enter the cultivation ruins mystic realm. Any request can be made.”
“The association will try their best to satisfy it.”
“If anyone has any corresponding thoughts, contact me after the meeting.”
“Alright, it’s your question segment now. You can ask any questions about the World Tournament now,” President Lin said to everyone.
“President Lin, the rules of the world competition… haven’t been confirmed?” Jiang Tianyang asked.
President Lin said, “Just like in the past, it will be decided by the World Tree after Inatella opens. No one will know in advance.”
“However, you can use the rules of the previous batches as a reference. Of course, the rules of the first three batches are different. It might also change this time, but there’s a high chance that it will still be related to ruins and battles. After all, this is the common point of the first three batches.”
Ji Feng said, “President Lin, when are you going to give us the information on the contestants from the various participating countries?”
As expected of a member of the Intelligence Bureau, he knew the importance of information.
“I heard… that there might be totems in this world competition?”
President Lin said, “There’s indeed such a possibility. The Beast Taming Talent is strange. For example, Legend Yin’s spatial strengthening talent. If it’s cultivated to level eight, it’s possible to contract a totem.”
“If you consider the speciality of the hybrid physique, if Beast Tamers and contracted creatures have the same bloodline, even if it’s a legendary Beast Tamer, it’s not impossible to contract totems above their level.”
“Therefore, you have to be mentally prepared. This situation has never appeared in the first three world competitions. Those totem countries are far crazier than the traditional Beast Tamers of the seven countries.”
“As for the information you mentioned, I’ll give it to you after the meeting, but just take a look at this kind of thing. Don’t treat it as key information.”
Everyone asked their own questions. Shi Yu listened the whole time. The more he listened, the more sleepy he became, as if he was going to Internet class in the morning.
Ah ~ So sleepy.
After an unknown period of time, the meeting finally ended. Before the meeting ended, Shi Yu was instantly energetic. After coming out, he immediately ran to Lu Qingyi and said, “Senior, how’s your Psychic training?”
Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “It’s at the passing level ~ It definitely can’t compare to yours, but it can definitely kill everyone in the world competition.”
“Here.” She handed the Talent Bead back to Shi Yu and said, “There’s still half a month. Can we make it?”
“There’s time.” Shi Yu smiled. In the last half a month, Shi Yu decided to continue perfecting his telepathy talent.
This had to be done with the Talent Bead. Apart from that, Shi Yu also planned to help Eleven adapt to his new body through the Talent Bead.
Therefore, he asked for the Talent Bead that he had temporarily handed to his senior to cultivate Psychic power.
Now, Lu Qingyi’s strength should be far from the level of fifth place in the Sequence. A legendary resource in the natural ruins of Tingxiang and a legendary resource rewarded by the Sequence ranking. After using them, she gained a new overlord pet.
Three overlords.
In addition to the Psychic Strengthening Skill, Shi Yu felt that Senior Lu’s current battle power, excluding him, should be able to steadily rank in the top three of this batch of contestants.
It was only inferior to Ye Xing and Divine Bell. As for these two, Senior Lu definitely couldn’t compare. After all, before there was any news of their World Tournament, there were already two overlords in their teams. At the moment, even if they weren’t all overlords, they were probably not much different. For their identities, there were clearly more channels to obtain legendary resources.
Of course, it was definitely not as fast as Shi Yu obtaining legendary resources.
In Shi Yu’s hands, Buggy had two legendary resources. Baby Ginseng had one, Chi Tong had two, and Susu had one. This was even after using a lot of their resources.
Unfortunately, due to the limitations of his level, Shi Yu could only look at the resources and cry. He couldn’t let them spend as generously as Eleven.
For the world competition nearly a month later, Shi Yu went into seclusion again to perfect Eleven’s incomplete Mythical form.
Apart from Shi Yu and Eleven, the other pets were also cultivating hard to welcome the next world competition.
After all, Shi Yu had told them that whether they could have quasi-divine skills and how many quasi-divine skills they could have depended on whether they could win the world competition.
After winning the championship and obtaining the blessings of the World Tree, once the skill fusion function was activated, it was easy to talk about how many quasi-divine skills they wanted.
Shi Yu felt that the Mythical stage should also be divided into levels.
Just like overlord races, those with two super skills were low-level overlords, and those with three three were middle-level overlords. In theory, it should be the same among Mythical races.
One divine skill was a low-level Mythical race, and two meant it was middle-level Mythical races. In that case, Shi Yu naturally had to pile Eleven and the others’ race levels above high-level Mythical races through the number of skills.
Skill fusion was the key!
…
A week later, Ping Cheng, legendary ruins space.
Shi Yu stood on the ground and looked at Eleven opposite him in silence.
On the other side was a huge Iron-eating Beast ten meters tall, no different from ordinary Iron-eating Beasts.
However, Shi Yu understood that this was not as simple as Eleven enlarging to this size.
The Body Control Talent Bead was more valuable than he imagined…!
Initially, Shi Yu thought that Eleven could only gradually optimize its race and adapt to Mythical race after reaching the totem level.
However, he didn’t expect that with the help of their bodies to control the Talent Bead, they only used a week to completely stabilize their Mythical form.
At this moment, even after Eleven entered the Mythical Normal State, its strength was completely restrained. It was no different from an ordinary panda.
No one could tell if it was strong or weak.
The form surrounded by the chaos lightning sea was completely controlled. Even at this moment, Eleven could still control whether the white lightning or black lightning lingered on its body. Its control over power was much stronger than when it first evolved.
“Wuu!!!” In addition, Eleven even used the Yin Yang Millstone in its hand without Shi Yu’s help.
It condensed in its hand, and the entire legendary ruin buzzed and trembled again.
However, in terms of power, it was much weaker than when it had Shi Yu’s support.
This time, there was no risk of the ruins collapsing.
“(.?ˇ?ˇ?) Wuu!!” Giant Eleven looked at Shi Yu excitedly.
Was it invincible?
Eleven had been conflicted. What if the quasi-divine skill needed Shi Yu’s support and couldn’t be used in the team competition?
But now, it felt that the future versions might all belong to it.
“The problem now is…”
“Am I still human?”
Shi Yu scratched his head. After Eleven completely controlled its body of a low-level Mythical race, Shi Yu could clearly sense that he had received physical and mental feedback again.
He was silent for a moment before activating the telepathy talent. No, now, Shi Yu had already given the second development of the telepathy talent skill another name, [Psychic Domain].
At this moment, the Yin Yang Millstone in Eleven’s hand had already disappeared, but Shi Yu’s eyes still turned black and white. As a sound of laws vibrated, Shi Yu himself conjured a Taiji Domain that enveloped a huge area.
In the black and white world, the ground and sky were both a Yin Yang Taiji Painting. Among them, the Taiji Painting spun crazily. The black and white Yin Yang fish in the pattern even materialized and swam around Eleven.
“Wuu!!!”
At this moment, Eleven felt that the power of light, darkness, and yin and yang in its body had been strengthened by an epic level!!
Eleven waved its hands, and the Yin Yang Fish also swam like it was in the sea, making Eleven feel especially interested. Just as it was about to touch the Yin Yang Fish, with a crack, the Taiji Domain shattered like a mirror.
On the other side, Shi Yu’s face was pale. Damn, had his telepathy ability also been upgraded to a quasi-divine skill?
There was the sound of laws no matter what.
[Psychic Domain, Taiji Domain] could produce corresponding rules and strengthen Eleven’s quasi-divine skill. In fact, without doing anything, the Taiji Domain could suppress all the power in the domain.
This change made Shi Yu’s balls hurt a little. He felt that it was the Mythical resource, the Undying Fruit, again…
Forget it.
Shi Yu ignored these changes and continued cultivating. When it was half a month before setting off for Rongguang, the gazes of the Seven Nation Alliance looked at Inatella.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 840 Mechanical Legendary Awakening
chapters.content:
840 Mechanical Legendary Awakening
Ping Cheng.
Legendary ruins.
A white research institute was wrapped in a starry sky.
Recently, Ling had been studying the “strength of the starry sky” hard.
The power of the starry sky was a vast school of learning.
Basically, people called the power system outside Blue Planet the power of the starry sky.
Including the power of the sun and the power of the moonlight, they were all the power of the starry sky.
Therefore, the power system of the entire Blue Planet was definitely like a drop in the ocean compared to the power of the starry sky.
Therefore, it was especially difficult to study.
However, be it hatching the Space Beast Egg or the evolution of Buggy, it seemed to be inseparable from the power of the starry sky.
Shi Yu and the others could only spend effort to open new projects.
For this, Shi Yu even handed the Four Symbols Star Formation to Buggy and the others, not letting go of any channels to study the power of the starry sky.
After some research, Shi Yu and the others’ greatest gain was that the effect of the purple strange water ball summoned in Tingxiang gradually became clearer.
