This thing was actually a growth resource.
It could devour other strange water that contained the power of the starry sky and grow on its own.
The upper limit of growth was legendary, but the premise was to devour enough cosmic strange water.
After that, using this purple strange water ball could obtain more effects.
For example, if it swallowed the strange water that strengthened the power of water and light, then after using it, its effect was also to strengthen the power of water and light. It was a resource that could fuse and magnify the effect of the strange water.
At the same time, after using it, the user and the power of the starry sky would be more amiable.
Fortunately, the ball of cosmic strange water Shi Yu and the others had obtained had already swallowed enough cosmic strange water before descending. It was not far from its upper limit, the legendary level.
Otherwise, its phenomenon at that time wouldn’t have been so obvious.
However, although they had figured out what this purple strange water ball was, Shi Yu and the others still didn’t know if it was the nutritional substance needed by the Space Beast Egg.
Even Ling had yet to develop anything. It probably had to go to Rongguang to take a look at the final power of starlight to confirm.
However, this didn’t matter. Shi Yu didn’t plan to give this purple strange water to the Space Beast Egg.
Love wouldn’t disappear, but it would transfer.
Even if it was really the nutrition needed by the Space Beast Egg, it had to be first come, first served. He planned to let Buggy use this purple strange water ball.
A long time ago, in order to help An Chang’s Dragon Carp evolve, Baby Ginseng and Buggy had jointly made a “Dragon Transformation Fruit”. Of course, although it had the same name as the Dragon Transformation Fruit of Dragon Palace City, this was definitely not a legendary resource.
At this moment, Shi Yu really had the legendary resource, the Dragon Transformation Fruit. It was a dual-element evolution resource for dragons and wood, representing life force.
Therefore, Shi Yu was wondering if he could use the Space Mutated Water and the Dragon Transformation Fruit as evolution resources to assist the evolution of Buggy.
Among them, the legendary Starry Sky Strange Water was in charge of increasing the cosmic affinity of Buggy. Its all-encompassing nature could also increase the power of Buggy’s imagination.
In addition to the Green Dragon phenomenon hidden in the depths of his spiritual soul, he could give it a try!
These days, Susu’s mission was to constantly summon the strange water and help the starry sky strange water complete the final upgrade.
Ling’s mission was to constantly analyze and study it. In the end, Ling came to a conclusion.
It could allow Buggy to break through and evolve before the world competition.
It was the conclusion it came to after combining Shi Yu’s physique, level, and level with Buggy and Baby Ginseng.
Before the world competition, he could try to break through with a second overlord and contract two overlords above his level.
After its strict calculations and consideration of various situations, the feedback of the spatial attribute after the worm evolved could 100% let Shi Yu bear the price of contracting two overlords.
Even if it couldn’t break through to level seven, the strengthened Beast Taming Space wouldn’t have the risk of collapsing.
At the same time, the feedback of his mental strength could also allow Shi Yu to better resist the consumption.
Of course, it could only be Buggy breaking through. If Baby Ginseng broke through, with only the feedback of vitality and recovery power, although Shi Yu could also better withstand the contract above his level, the Beast Taming Space definitely couldn’t withstand it.
Therefore, Ling’s suggestion was to let Buggy evolve and break through. Then, in the last period of time, in terms of adding points, it would mainly increase Baby Ginseng’s plant control to increase its nourishing effect.
Therefore, in the last half a month, Shi Yu and the others studied the evolution of Buggy.
Since Ling had said that there was no problem, Shi Yu was naturally willing to have another overlord before the world competition.
It was already very impressive for a level-six Beast Tamer in a totem country to contract an overlord above his level.
On his side, he wanted to contract two overlords above his level as a level-six Beast Tamer… It was simply more exploitative than the totem country.
In order to win more steadily and confidently, Shi Yu endured it.
“Am I a humanoid ferocious beast…”
However, the final problem was that there was no suitable breakthrough environment.
Ling believed that if possible, it was best to evolve in the starry sky.
Coupled with the power of imagination of Buggy, it could ensure that it matched the green dragon form to the greatest extent after evolution.
The evolution environment was also an evolution resource.
Evolution in the starry sky…
Ling would make things difficult for Shi Yu. Even if their current strength was extraordinary, they didn’t have the ability to break out of Blue Planet…
However, Shi Yu didn’t have it himself, but Dong Huang did.
Shi Yu quickly thought of Dong Huang’s spaceship and rocket.
Decades ago, Dong Huang had already succeeded in exploring the moon and obtained the ability to reach the starry sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 841 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (2)
chapters.content:
841 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (2)
They even established a base on the moon and explored it several times.
However, because the cost of exploring the starry sky every time was huge, it was equivalent to burning several legendary resources. After not obtaining enough positive feedback in the starry sky, the various countries basically stopped.
In the starry sky, apart from the fact that the power of the starry sky was countless times richer than Blue Planet, there was nothing strange.
However, it just so happened that Shi Yu needed the power of the starry sky environment.
It was best if he went to the starry sky to help Buggy evolve, and Dong Huang had the ability to go to the starry sky. Thinking of this, Shi Yu recalled what President Lin had said in the meeting.
The association would assist the contestants in the final sprint.
He could raise any condition. As long as it was reasonable enough, it didn’t matter even if he took out legendary resources.
In that case, Shi Yu did not stand on ceremony.
After Ling came to a conclusion, in order to not waste time, he immediately private messaged President Lin.
He expressed his hope that before the World Tournament began, it could ascend to the starry sky with the help of Dong Huang and help the Butterfly of Imagination transform into a dragon.
The meaning of doing this was naturally to win the world competition.
After that meeting, President Lin indeed received the requests of many people. For example, Zhou Ming hoped that the country could give him a second chance and pity him for giving him a legendary resource on account that he was at the legend level.
For example, Gao Xuan hoped that in the final period of time, there would be top-notch mechanical intelligence to assist him in modifying his pet.
President Lin would consider the actual situation and the reasonableness of these suggestions and answer.
However, Shi Yu’s request was the most ridiculous.
He wanted to go to the starry sky environment to help his Butterfly of Imagination evolve and break through to overlord level?
The reason why he did this was because he hoped to use the power of the Butterfly of Imagination after breaking through to evolution to lead him to break through or increase the battle power of an overlord to more steadily obtain the world competition champion?
President Lin’s first thought was that Shi Yu was crazy.
He knew that Shi Yu was very strong. Even Baby Ginseng’s combination skill could heavily injure ordinary totems and destroy invincible overlords.
But there was only one time for a period of time. There was more than one enemy in the world competition.
He also knew that Shi Yu’s normal battle power was not weak. It should be easy for him to defeat ordinary overlords. His strength was much stronger than legends like Zhou Ming, but the problem was that this was still not enough.
However, Shi Yu was decisive and said that there was no problem. He expressed that he could let President Lin personally test his strength and that they could duel each other.
President Lin was silent. He didn’t accept the challenge. He didn’t have the time to fight Shi Yu. Moreover, he couldn’t make the decision on this matter. It wasn’t something he could decide.
To head to the starry sky, the level was about the same as using a divine forbidden weapon. That person had to nod.
On this matter, even he couldn’t help Shi Yu. He might have to awaken the Mechanical Legendary. Only this person could ensure 100% safety and assist Shi Yu in reaching the starry sky.
Therefore, President Lin’s answer was that he would awaken the Mechanical Legendary. The subsequent matters would be left to the Mechanical Legendary, Divine Source Shen Yuan, to decide.
The Mechanical Legendary had also awakened once when the World Tree woke up. When the World Tournament began, it would even awaken and descend on Inatella. Therefore, the awakening this time was not entirely for Shi Yu.
In short, with the help of the Mechanical Legendary, Shi Yu could reach the starry sky, but if not, it would be difficult.
Shi Yu waited for a long time and was even about to set off for Rongguang. There was still no news from President Lin, making Shi Yu think that it was over. He was afraid that there wasn’t enough time.
Until the day before they set off…
“Shi Yu, Senior Divine Source has already woken up. It took him a little time to wake up. Next, come to the capital. After that, he will also go to Rongguang and Inatella with us. He wants to talk to you in person about you.”
Shi Yu, who had been waiting for a long time, finally received a call from President Lin.
“Alright.” In Ping Cheng, Shi Yu took a deep breath and was a little afraid.
This Mechanical Legendary… he actually didn’t want to see him.
It was mainly because when he had discussed this person with the Sea Dragon King, the Sea Dragon King had said many bad things about.
In the Sea Dragon King’s description, Divine Source was a very bad-tempered and unreasonable old man.
The Mechanical Legendary was the founder of the modern Dong Huang. He was a complete warmonger. After the totem battle ended and Dong Huang recuperated, he had always wanted to expand Dong Huang’s territory and start another war. His evaluation was the same as the Emperor Wu in history, wanting to completely destroy the totem country in the east.
However, at this moment, a pacifist legendary appeared in Dong Huang. He advocated a gentle attitude and methods to deal with diplomatic and military issues. This person was the evolution legendary, Lin Feng.
At that time, Dong Huang’s two legendary Beast Tamers and its ally, Dragon Palace City, could be said to be at its peak.
However, it was said that Divine Source wanted to start a war, and Lin Feng didn’t want to start a war, so there was a conflict between the two of them. There was even a huge battle between them. Although it wasn’t to the extent of being ruthless, the conflict had clearly already started.
No one knew the outcome of the battle, but in the end, Dong Huang continued to develop peacefully. Then, Lin Feng disappeared, and Divine Source turned into a machine and fell into a deep sleep to protect Dong Huang.
Shi Yu couldn’t evaluate these two legendaries either. He felt that both parties made sense.
It was not a problem for Divine Source Legendaryary to wish to completely eliminate the threat, but… it was definitely impossible to completely eliminate it. As long as there were enough benefits, the seven countries could have internal strife, and Dong Huang could have internal strife. It was impossible to completely eliminate the unstable factors.

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 842 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (3)
chapters.content:
842 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (3)
As for Legendary Lin Feng, Shi Yu analyzed through various clues. Lin Feng didn’t want to start a war not because he loved peace, but most likely because he was in the seven countries. He had female confidants in many totem countries. It would be very difficult to end a war…
The reason why Shi Yu didn’t want to see Divine Source Legendaryary wasn’t because he had left romantic debts everywhere like Lin Feng. However, he was lazy and was very afraid that Divine Source Legendaryary would pull him along and give him some mission to unify the world.
But now… it didn’t matter.
In order to go to the starry sky, he had to ask the Mechanical Legendary. As long as he could help him, he was a good person.
Moreover, after the battle with Lin Feng, perhaps some thoughts of the Mechanical Legendary had been changed.
….
Imperial Capital.
After the Mechanical Legendary Divine Source woke up, he transferred his consciousness to the machine.
President Lin Xiao looked at the Mechanical Legendary in front of him and was speechless.
It was a spherical silver mechanical life form with metal limbs and a red eye. It flew in the sky.
In size, it was the size of a football.
It was very cute.
It looked like a child’s remote control toy in a mechanical store.
“Senior Divine Source, your appearance…”
The silver robot’s red eye glanced at Lin Xiao and said, “There’s a shortage of mechanical materials that can accommodate my consciousness. It’s already very difficult to create such a body.”
“I see. By the way, Senior Divine Source, what do you think of the thing I transmitted to you previously?”
A few days ago, President Lin had transmitted the matter of Shi Yu wanting to go to the starry sky to evolve his pet to the half-sleeping Mechanical Legendary.
However, he never received an answer until now when Divine Source finally woke up. President Lin asked again.
“The young man who developed the mechanical phantom beast?”
The red eye of the silver robot flickered and said, “The current number one person below the legends of Dong Huang. The Iron-eating Beast has the inheritance of Emperor Wu. The Butterfly of Imagination has mastered the prototype of a creation-type law. The ginseng baby with top-notch time-type skills and he has obtained the recognition of the heroic spirit of an ancient general. He contracted the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation… He even ate the Mythical Undying Fruit.”
“Looks like another talented Beast Tamer has appeared in Dong Huang in this generation, and he’s a Beast Tamer with legendary aptitude.”
“Yeah.” President Lin nodded.
Divine Source Legendary said, “Unfortunately, the growth time is too short. To be able to grow to this extent in less than three years, he definitely has a huge amount of opportunities on him. Perhaps it’s not inferior to the Dragon Emperor’s Mythical Ruins recognizing him as its master. If he was given a little more time, the chances of Dong Huang winning this World Tournament might be higher.”
“He’s saying that he hopes Dong Huang will assist him in evolution pets in the starry sky to increase the success rate of winning the world competition?”
Lin Feng nodded. “That’s what he said.”
Divine Source said, “Looks like this young man is very confident in his strength, exactly the same as the Lin Feng back then. How far do you think his strength has gone?”
President Lin said, “That ginseng baby has mastered the combination skill of the Time Fruit, revival, and self-destruction. It has the battle record of using the power of legendary resources to kill weak totems that have been sealed for a thousand years.”
“From the power assessment, it’s a little difficult to kill ordinary totems, but under totems, no life form can withstand it. Even those lives that are invincible in the overlord domain will be instantly destroyed.”
“But he can only use this move once for a period of time. It can only be used as a trump card, but it can’t be the main attack method.”
“Apart from that, his other pets are also quite extraordinary. I’ve communicated with the new guardian Ying. They have battle results of all their members fighting three overlords. The three overlords are two ordinary overlords and a top-notch overlord. They fought relatively reluctantly at that time, but now that a few months have passed, their strength should have already improved greatly.”
“Shi Yu has many legendary resources in his hands. His strength progress won’t be slow.”
“But since he wants the Butterfly of Imagination to break through above its level, there shouldn’t be an overlord level in the team at the moment.”
“If nothing goes wrong, Shi Yu’s current strength should be close to divine bell or not much different from Divine Bell. He’s inferior to Ye Xing. It shouldn’t be a problem for him to deal with three top-notch overlords at the same time.”
“In addition, he has the strategy of self-destructing to kill an invincible overlord. It’s very normal to have the idea that he can also compete for the champion position after contracting an overlord.”
“Even I think what he said makes sense. If he contracts an overlord-level Butterfly of Imagination, even if he doesn’t break through to level seven, his strength will undergo a tremendous change.”
“Unfortunately, Dong Huang can’t find high-level spatial cultivation resources to help Beast Tamers break through to the legendary level at the moment. Otherwise, we could just give him resources directly.”
Such resources had always been in short supply. Otherwise, the geniuses of the various countries wouldn’t have gone to the World Tournament to find opportunities.
Divine Source Legendary said, “A level-six Beast Tamer with all monarchs can deal with three top-notch overlords at the same time and even kill invincible overlords?”
“It’s really scary, but this year’s world competition is different from the past.”
“Yes, there will definitely be totem-level pets in this year’s World Tournament. Perhaps there will be more than one. It’s fine if it’s a beast-type pet, but if it’s an elemental, undead, or even spatial pet, even Shi Yu’s self-destruction strategy won’t be too useful.”
“Therefore, under normal circumstances, the champion position is only possible for Ye Xing. His trump card has used three legendary resources to strengthen before and after and has already reached the level of an invincible overlord. He has the foundation of a totem. Coupled with other pets and Beast Taming Talents, he already has the strength of a ‘Titled Legend’. If it weren’t for the title of ‘World Legend’, he would have even wanted to challenge the other titles in the country a few months ago.”

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 843 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (4)
chapters.content:
843 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (4)
In the past year of preparing for the World Tournament, Shi Yu wasn’t the only one who was crazily increasing his strength.
These originally incomparably powerful second-generation geniuses were also using the power of the country’s machine to increase their strength crazily through their own methods.
“Wait for this Shi Yu. If his strength can satisfy me, I can bring him to the starry sky,” Divine Source Legendary said. “Who can stop a young man from pursuing the dream of becoming a champion?”
“Moreover, the information he provided about the Mythical Era might be able to obtain a Mythical resource for Dong Huang.”
President Lin said, “Yeah.”
….
After Shi Yu arrived at the capital, he arrived at the agreed location with President Lin.
This place was in the suburbs, the hometown of Divine Source Legendary. At this moment, it was rare for it to wake up and temporarily transfer its consciousness to the machine to move around. Divine Source chose to look around.
“Little Lin, your strength hasn’t improved at all compared to before.”
Accompanied by Divine Source Legendary, Lin Xiao, the president of Dong Huang, became without any dignity and was constantly criticized by Divine Source.
“It looks like it’s a little difficult to rely on you to become Dong Huang’s new legendary.”
“Compared to Lin Feng, you’re much worse.”
Lin Xiao kept smiling bitterly and said, “Senior Divine Source, my talent is limited. After using so many resources, I’m still a level-eight Beast Tamer. I can’t see any hope of breaking through. I’ve been disappointing.”
“Sigh.” Divine Source Legendary sighed. However, Lin Xiao had the help of a bunch of totem-level lives. Although he wasn’t a legend, it wasn’t something other Titled Legends could compare to.
At that time, in the battle between him and Lin Feng, both parties took a step back. He chose to give up on war, and Lin Feng was willing to nurture a totem-level second team pet with all his might to become the guardian of Dong Huang in exchange for thousands of years of peaceful development.
After that, Lin Xiao, Lin Feng’s most talented descendant, inherited the command of these totems.
Because of this, when President Lin Xiao established the 13 Bureaus of Dong Huang, the first bureau he thought of was the Totem Bureau.
“I wonder who the next legendary of Dong Huang will be. I hope he won’t be born in troubled times again.” Divine Source Legendary also knew that legendaries weren’t that easy to come into being. If legends could still rely on the kindness of their ancestors to become legends, it was different for legendaries. Even if their parents were legendaries, it wasn’t that easy.
“From the looks of it, the possibility of Shi Yu is the highest, but his Beast Taming Talent can’t increase his battle power. Even if he becomes a legend, it’s very difficult for him to match a demigod like the legendaries of the past.”
“At the same time, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others are still a little inferior. The possibility is even smaller than Shi Yu. However, if they have any opportunities in the World Tournament, that might not be the case.”
“In the end, it’s better to take it one step at a time… Alright… He’s here.” In the mountain, Divine Source Legendary flying in midair looked at the sky.
President Lin also looked over.
They saw a young man in a blue casual suit flying in the sky towards them under the wrap of Psychic power.
“President Lin.” After Shi Yu found him, he slowly descended and said, “It’s been so hard on me.”
“Uh, this…” He looked at the silver robot.
< Name > ???
[Attributes]: Machinery
Energy Points: ???
Totem-level little robot?
Shi Yu was stunned. President Lin immediately said, “Shi Yu, this is Senior Divine Source. His consciousness is temporarily attached to this robot.”
“Divine Source Legendary?!” Shi Yu was shocked as he looked at the circular silver one-eyed robot.
It was rather shocking.
What taste was this.
“Senior Divine Source!” Shi Yu immediately greeted obediently.
“Mm.” The little robot observed Shi Yu.
“Shi Yu, I know you. The mechanical phantom beast system you developed has opened a new chapter in the Mechanic class. It’s difficult to imagine that you’re an archeologist and have only come into contact with the Mechanic class recently.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s all thanks to the pets. Their powers combined and coincidentally created such a miracle.”
“You want to go to the starry sky?”
“You want to go to the starry sky to help the mechanical phantom beast system, and the Butterfly of Imagination that played a key role in evolution and breakthrough?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Why must we go to the starry sky?”
Shi Yu said, “Because its skill, the Dragon of Imagination, is a dragon transformation evolution skill that can decide the evolution direction on its own. We also obtained the legendary resource, the Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Dragon Ball, in Dragon Palace City. The owner of this dragon ball is a half-god of Dragon Palace City who evolved towards the Green Dragon as a template. Therefore, we also decided to evolve towards the Green Dragon as a template.”
“The Green Dragon is one of the Four Spirits of Heaven and a constellation god, so the evolution effect in the starry sky will be better than on Blue Planet.”
“Apart from the Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball, we’ve also prepared other evolution resources. We’re already completely prepared.”
Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball?
President Lin also didn’t know that Shi Yu had obtained this resource from Mother Dragon.
Although he didn’t know what other resources Shi Yu had prepared, with this Dragon Ball around, it could indeed maximize the value of resources by evolving towards the Green Dragon as a template.
“An insect turning into a butterfly, a butterfly turning into a dragon?” Divine Source Legendary said. “The Green Dragon evolution path is a path that no Beast Tamer has been able to complete since ancient times, even if it’s a legendary Beast Tamer.”
“Many Dragon Gods in Dragon Palace City have tried, but they all failed.”
“Do you know what it takes to be successful if you evolve towards the Green Dragon as a template?”
Shi Yu said, “Faith skill.”

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 844 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (5)
chapters.content:
844 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (5)
All lives born from faith had mastered faith skills.
For example, the Blue Sea Sprite’s Blue Sea Contract was actually a faith skill. Its believers were the entire sea, so it could borrow the power of the entire sea. If the level of the Blue Sea Contract was high enough, it could even borrow the power of other creatures who believed in it in the sea through the power of faith.
The dragons who were evolving towards the green dragon actually wanted to freeload the power of faith of the green dragon totem and cultivate faith skills. Unfortunately, none of them succeeded.
“If there are no faith skills, moving in this direction might not be the best choice.”
!!
“The Green Sky Divine Azure Dragon also failed. All the Beast Tamers in history have failed. This is an extremely difficult path. Are you sure you still want to try?” Divine Source Legendary asked.
Shi Yu nodded and said confidently, “I still want to give it a try.”
If there were only the Dragon Ball, Dragon Transformation Fruit, Starry Sky Strange Water, and Starry Sky Environment, Shi Yu wouldn’t be very confident.
However, in the depths of his soul, the green dragon mural phenomenon brought by his previous life was branded. This was Shi Yu’s greatest anticipation.
After all, the previous Yin Yang Fish phenomenon had already helped Eleven master a quasi-divine skill and evolve into a Mythical race.
Then, it wasn’t impossible for this green dragon phenomenon to help Buggy walk a different path.
Moreover, even if it failed, with the Perfect Dragon as a backup, its strength wouldn’t be weak. At most, it wouldn’t have any faith skills.
At most, he would wait for the next evolution.
“As expected.” Divine Source Legendary knew that Shi Yu would answer like this, but it didn’t matter.
“Are you that confident that after it evolves, it can help you win the world competition?” Divine Source Legendary asked.
“You have to know that you’re not the only one who contracts above your level. At that time, there might be more than one Beast Tamer who contracts totems above their level.”
Shi Yu was stunned. “You’re wrong. I want the Butterfly of Imagination to evolve only to increase the success rate of winning the championship. Even now, even if it can’t evolve, my goal is to win the championship.”
“If it can evolve, my chances of winning the championship will be above 99%.”
Legend of Divine Source and President Lin Xiao were stunned when they heard Shi Yu’s words.
At their age, they indeed couldn’t keep up with the young people’s train of thought.
Should he say that Shi Yu was confident or arrogant?
It was clearly made very clear that there might even be totem-level battle power in the World Tournament.
In the end, Shi Yu was still confident?
“Very confident, but you should only be a level-six Beast Tamer now, right? What confidence do you have to fight your way out of a group of legend geniuses? No matter how superior your pet race is, the other demigod factions aren’t easy to deal with.”
“Prove it to me. As long as I see where your confidence comes from, I can do my best to help you.”
Shi Yu had been waiting for this sentence. He said, “Alright, Senior Divine Source, President Lin. In that case, I’ll summon my pet.”
With that said, purple Psychic waves lingered around him. A purple summoning array immediately formed!
A black and white one-meter-tall Iron-eating Beast cub slowly appeared.
Seeing that Shi Yu first summoned his initial pet, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin were not surprised.
However, soon, they were stunned.
Because the aura on this Iron-eating Beast was clearly at the overlord level!
“Senior Divine Source, President Lin, I’ve already contracted an overlord above my level and let the Iron-eating Beast break through. This is the source of my confidence, and the Butterfly of Imagination is the second pet I plan to contract above my level!”
At this moment, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin had no time to care about what Shi Yu said.
They were all stunned by the data in front of them.
< Name > Iron-eating Beast
Energy Points: ???
It couldn’t be detected.
The energy value was unimaginably huge.
Limited by the equipment and technology level, the top detectors in the seven countries could only detect the highest energy value of 99,999,999. If the energy value exceeded 100 million, it would be impossible to detect.
Even the Mechanical Legendary and the detection equipment worn by President Lin were the same.
At this moment, when they saw the energy level of this Iron-eating Beast, their hearts trembled. They couldn’t understand.
An Iron-eating Beast with more than 100 million energy points?
Totem level?
100 million was already the threshold of the totem level.
Of course, totems with 100 million energy points might be even harder to find than totems with 10 billion energy points.
Letting a Green Silkworm eat the Undying Fruit and immediately commit suicide… After reincarnation, it might only have this bit of energy.
Otherwise, there were basically no totems stuck at this level.
No matter what, the Iron-eating Beast’s energy level definitely exceeded 100 million.
Impossible, absolutely impossible.
Shi Yu was only a level-six Beast Tamer. How could he contract a totem?
Overlord?
An invincible overlord whose energy level had reached the threshold of the totem?
But…
The two big shots recalled what Shi Yu had said just now.
He had already contracted an overlord above his level and let the Iron-eating Beast break through.
What an overlord!
But how could the data be so high?
From Shi Yu’s experience, it definitely hadn’t been long since this pet broke through.
The Mechanical Legendary’s red eye was filled with disbelief. “What’s going on with it? You’ve already contracted an overlord above your level, and you still want to contract a second one above your level?”
Shi Yu said, “Yes.”
Eleven: “Wu wu wu. (So-so.)”
“It’s because of this that I’m confident of competing with those legends.”

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 845 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (6)
chapters.content:
845 Mechanical Legendary Awakening (6)
“As for why it’s so strong, it might be because it ate a little too many resources.” Shi Yu smiled and scratched his head. “President Lin, I got Eleven to eat all eleven meteorite fragments and the two legendary resources applied from the association, Aurora Magnetic Gold.”
“Then, it became like this.”
Legend of Divine Source and President Lin were rather silent.
“As for why I’ce already contracted an overlord above its level and still want to contract a second one, that’s because the physique feedback it gives me after breaking through and evolution is still very strong.”
!!
“Evolution?” President Lin said. “Has it already evolved into the trump card of Emperor Wu in history, the Demon God Iron-eating Beast?”
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “No, we developed a new evolution path on the basis of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast.”
“Through the Aurora Magnetic Gold and the meteorite fragment, it completed the evolution of light and darkness. Apart from comprehending the Demon God Body and completely adapting to its new form, it even converted the White Thunder skill into a racial skill. Apart from that, it also awakened the greatest trump card for us to fight in the world competition!”
New evolution path!
Light and darkness evolution!
Divine Source and President Lin, who knew about Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, were clearly stunned.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually develop a new evolution path with a mature template like Emperor Wu’s trump card.
Moreover…
Buzz!
The sound of laws spread.
An invisible aura enveloped the mountains.
“Wuu!” At this moment, as Eleven stretched out its palm, a black and white metal millstone surrounded by lightning formed. The surrounding space instantly trembled.
On the other side, the pupils of the Mechanical Legendary and President Lin constricted.
At this moment, several pets in President Lin’s Beast Taming Space even woke up at the same time. They revealed shocked expressions and sensed an extremely terrifying threat.
It was as if a god had descended.
“This…” The Mechanical Legendary red eye that had turned into a circular robot was extremely shocked. It looked at the Yin Yang Millstone in Eleven’s hand in disbelief and also felt a suppression from the ‘laws’.
The two big shots looked at the Iron-eating Beast in front of Shi Yu in confusion.
Mythical race, quasi-divine skill!
Shi Yu’s new evolution path evolved this pet into Mythical?!
At this moment, Divine Source, who knew the evolution legend Lin Feng, and Lin Feng’s descendant, was extremely shocked when he saw Shi Yu, who had achieved something that even Lin Feng couldn’t.
“The strength of an invincible overlord, in addition to a quasi-divine skill, Senior Divine Source, President Lin, do you think this strength is justifiable for me to be confident of competing for the world competition champion?”
“It’s alright if it’s not enough,” Shi Yu said and continued to summon Ling.
Under the purple array, wind fluctuations lingered. Ling appeared in the outside world in the form of a Wind Kirin.
At the moment, it was the only pet not suppressed by Eleven’s quasi-divine skill. Although its level was inferior to Eleven, it was still a Mythical race.
“Wind Kirin Beast.”
At this moment, when they saw Ling, Divine Source Legendary, and President Lin, their expressions changed again.
Energy Points: 21,160,000
But…
Buzz.
The sound of laws spread again.
A wind of luck lingered around Ling.
Ever since the Mythical Revival Point reached perfect level, Ling could begin to control the Wind Blessing. It could wrap around its body on its own and make the effect better. However, it couldn’t bless others yet. It could only let others freeload through fusion.
Without a doubt, at this moment, Ling, who had taken the initiative to evolve into a Mythical state and used a quasi-divine skill, was also a Mythical race. It also triggered the voice of laws.
Boom!!!
The two sounds of laws collided, and the surrounding space instantly tore apart. With a loud bang, the sky suddenly darkened, as if the world had ended. Shocking lightning roared in the sky.
“Ling, who revived into a mechanical phantom beast through the Wind Kirin fossil, also successfully evolved into a Mythical race under subsequent upgrades. Although it’s only at the monarch level now, in the Mythical state, it’s not impossible to defeat a top-notch overlord with the help of a quasi-divine skill. The quasi-divine skill, Wind Blessing, is even a skill of luck. It might be able to bring about some unexpected gains in the World Tournament.”
“So if the Butterfly of Imagination can still evolve and break through, I think that in the World Tournament, no matter who the opponent is, they shouldn’t be able to stop us.”
At this moment, Divine Source Legendary felt that it had yet to wake up and was still sleeping.
Two Mythical races?
What a joke.
Could it be that… the Mythical Era was really about to descend again?
Otherwise, why would Mythical races appear one after another like it was super common?
He looked at President Lin. Was this what he meant by ‘might not be inferior to Divine Bell’? ‘Still inferior to Zhao Yexing’?
Starry sky? Damn it, why couldn’t they go?
President Lin was speechless… ?o?

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 846 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (1)
chapters.content:
846 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (1)
Two pets with quasi-divine skills…
What did it mean?
It meant that as long as their growth level increased to the totem level, in addition to quasi-divine skills, they would definitely have demigod battle power.
Under normal circumstances, legendary Beast Tamers could contract totem-level pets.
However, even if it was a legendary, the contracted totem wouldn’t be a totem demigod at the top of Blue Planet’s life.
They were basically ordinary totems and top-notch totems.
At most, it would rely on the enhancement of his Beast Taming Talent and the number advantage of multiple pets to obtain strength comparable to a demigod.
Restricted by resources, talent, and lifespan, it was too difficult for human Beast Tamers to personally nurture demigod battle power.
However, Shi Yu directly had the foundation of three demigods.
How could Divine Source Legendary and President Lin not be shocked? It was fine if it was the Blue Sea Sprite, which was the reincarnation of a demigod. Shi Yu was lucky that it acknowledged him as master. That was fine.
However, didn’t Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast come from a loan from the breeding base?
Didn’t he develop this mechanical phantom beast himself?
It could also cultivate a quasi-divine skill?
Most importantly, they weren’t even five years old!
For a moment, even the knowledgeable Divine Source Legendary, who had even relied on a forbidden weapon to destroy a demigod, was stunned by Shi Yu’s luxurious lineup.
It was precisely because he had destroyed the demigod life form that threatened Dong Huang that he understood how rare and terrifying demigod battle power was. If he wanted to kill it, he had to pay a huge price.
At this moment, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin recalled the conversation just now…
Even if Shi Yu stepped into the legendary level, it was very difficult for him to fight against demigods like other legendaries because of his Beast Taming Talent.
Now, they wanted to slap themselves. Even if they didn’t consider the unstable factor of the Blue Sea Sprite, Shi Yu also had two pets that would definitely become demigods!!
What? Worried that Shi Yu couldn’t reach level nine, worried that his pets couldn’t reach the totem level?
Meaningless worry. At this moment, even Divine Source Legendary felt that Shi Yu was very likely to win the world competition when he saw Shi Yu’s two pets.
After being blessed by the World Tree, even if he didn’t level up quickly like Legend Lin Feng, under the growth of Mythical pets, Legendary was definitely not a problem.
There was even less to worry about the growth of pets. For the sake of making them the level of demigod, Dong Huang would invest resources even if it had to use all its national strength!
A living demigod was an existence even more threatening than a divine forbidden weapon.
“Two quasi-divine skills, two quasi-divine skills…”
Divine Source Legendary was silent for a moment before he couldn’t help but ask, “How did you do it? It’s not as simple as just relying on evolution resources, right?”
Shi Yu’s words were simple, but Divine Source knew that the truth was definitely not that easy.
It was impossible to pile up quasi-divine skills with resources alone.
Otherwise, which legendary in history wasn’t a genius?
Which legendary couldn’t come into contact with legendary resources or even Mythical resources?
In fact, it wasn’t like there weren’t legendary big shots who used Mythical resources to evolve pets.
But even so, no quasi-divine skill had appeared.
“It’s alright if you don’t want to say it,” the legendary said.
“Eleven can cultivate a quasi-divine skill and evolve into a Mythical race. Compared to evolution materials, I think it’s more likely because I developed my telepathy talent a second time through the ‘Talent Bead’.”
“Then, through the new skill of the mind domain, I can assist in the quasi-divine skill it masters.”
“However… I feel that this path is very difficult for others to replicate. This is because even if I also have the Talent Bead, the talent can’t be the same as mine. Because I ate the Undying Fruit, my physique talent became a little special. This is the main reason why I developed my talent deeply,” Shi Yu said part of the truth.
Of course, the greatest reason why others couldn’t replicate it was that others weren’t transmigrators.
Apart from the Undying Fruit and telepathy, the power brought by his previous life was also very important.
In his previous life, there were hundreds of ruins explored by Shi Yu.
Among them, after transmigrating, through the memories of the memory water drop, two ruins left a very deep impression on Shi Yu.
One was a ruin with a Taiji Yin Yang Fish mural, and the other was a ruin with a Green Dragon Painting mural.
These two ruins were not simple ordinary ruins, but ruins that contained transcendent laws.
At that time, Shi Yu didn’t notice, but now that he recalled it, the transcendent divine essence he “saw” was clearly branded in his heart.
Moreover, these extraordinary divine powers could be augmented on pets!
Shi Yu felt that it was a pity. If only he had come into contact with more ruins that contained divine power at that time.
For example, another Vermillion Bird Divine Accumulation.
At the moment, the Taiji Painting and Green Dragon Painting in his heart were only enough for Eleven and Buggy to come into contact.
There were too few.
It was not enough for the pets to split.
If other pets wanted to enjoy the same treatment, they would probably have to wait for his subsequent research.
For example, letting Chi Tong and Susu enjoy the enhancement of the Yin Yang power of Taiji under the fusion state. After all, they were also Yin and Yang.
He wondered if a similar situation could happen in the ruins of this world.
Otherwise, he really wanted to return to Earth and spend a few days searching through the ruins of Earth.
Divine Source Legendary and President Lin were slightly stunned.
Through the Talent Bead… he developed the telepathy talent for the second time?!
He… succeeded?
Shi Yu naturally reported the fact that he had obtained the legendary Yue Maiden Talent Bead and plundered Legend Bai Chuan’s Beast Taming Talent in the totem era.
Shi Yu’s idea at that time was to try to deeply develop his telepathy talent through the Talent Bead.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 847 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (2)
chapters.content:
847 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (2)
However, in the end, Shi Yu only developed the skill “spiritual power”.
It couldn’t be said to be bad. For Beast Tamers, mastering an extraordinary power was also very rare.
President Lin originally thought that even if Shi Yu could develop the telepathy talent a second time, it would be a long time later. Even if the development was successful, in terms of battle power, it would at most be like other battle talents, such as the fire-element strengthening talent and the water-element strengthening talent, giving normal enhancements to pets.
But who would have thought that the successful development of the telepathy talent in Shi Yu’s mouth would actually become the key to “assisting pets to master quasi-divine skills”?
In an instant, President Lin Xiao’s eyes turned red. He was envious of his telepathy talent.
He even felt that it was too right for Shi Yu to eat the Undying Fruit.
The Undying Fruit modified his physical talent and controlled the Talent Bead’s development talent. Shi Yu had completely maximized the value of the resources he had obtained!
“Can I take a look?” President Divine Source was numb.
He realized that the information about Shi Yu he had learned from President Lin was seriously outdated.
That made sense. A genius like Shi Yu was improving at all times. Shi Yu had not spent much time growing up. It was indeed impossible to synchronize information at all times.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, Eleven had already removed the Yin Yang Millstone and yawned heavily.
Ling also removed the Wind Blessing and returned to the Rubik’s Cube. It half-closed its eyes and was full.
In the center, as Shi Yu nodded, he began to show his mind domain to Divine Source Legendary and President Lin!
Boom!
As Shi Yu activated his mind domain, the air around him began to hum and vibrate.
The almost corporeal mental wave formed black and white ripples around him.
Under the situation where his entire body was wrapped in black and white energy fluctuations, the pattern of Shi Yu’s eyes quickly changed, directly turning into a spinning Taiji Painting. A vast and deep power bloomed from Shi Yu’s body, and for a moment, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin felt a strong pressure again!
Buzz!
The sound of laws spread.
It made the two of them open their mouths wide.
Wait a minute, wasn’t this the sound of laws that could only be triggered by the prototype of a divine skill?
Why was a human like him…
As Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun, a strong wave bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
In an instant, a huge spinning Taiji Painting appeared in the sky and ground.
The entire world turned black and white.
On the horizon, there was even a star that was identical to the patterns in Shi Yu’s eyes. In this domain, it replaced the sun and moon.
It was also a black and white circular star. It was like the manifestation of Shi Yu’s Eye of the Heart. It hung on the horizon of the domain and watched everything.
Under its gaze, the Taiji Painting spinning in the sky and ground became more and more blurry. The pattern seemed to have turned into two Yin Yang fish that appeared in motion and slowly swam around Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s every move seemed to be able to touch the laws.
What was this!
Legend of Divine Source and President Lin were completely stunned.
He called this a telepathy talent? Huh?
If after Shi Yu ate the Undying Fruit and died, he wouldn’t be considered a human after reincarnation. He would be considered an undead-type transcendent life form. They could accept it.
However, wasn’t Shi Yu still alive!
Why did it look like he had already become a god!
Legend of Divine Source and President Lin were undoubtedly figures at the top of Blue Planet, but they had never seen such a ridiculous Beast Taming Talent…
“The level of this power of laws is the highest existence I’ve ever seen.” However, what shocked Divine Source Legendary the most was that the power of Shi Yu and the others was not some casual power of laws.
The power of laws was also divided into levels.
Without a doubt, the power of laws carried by Shi Yu and Eleven was the strongest.
Chaos gave birth to endless, endless gave birth to Taiji, Taiji gave birth to two elements, and two elements gave birth to four symbols. This was the derivation process of everything from nothing to nothing. The power on their bodies had already traced the origin of laws extremely far. Even if they were only at the initial stage, their level was still extremely high.
At the moment, because Shi Yu and the others didn’t study it deeply, they only knew the most basic rules of the Taiji Domain.
The Taiji Painting was also known as the “Pattern of Nature”.
Therefore, it was similar to the Anti-Magic Domain.
It could suppress all natural power, including spatial power.
However, the effect was even more perfect than Buggy’s perfect anti-magic domain.
Apart from being able to suppress it, the effect of Eleven mobilizing the power of nature in this field would also be better. The power of the Yin Yang Millstone would be strengthened.
It had done it in the true domain.
Shi Yu even suspected that after he activated his talent, he could fight weaker overlords with his bare hands.
Once the power of nature was suppressed, with his physique, spirit… Ahem, a humanoid overlord was born!
“Hu…” After Shi Yu displayed it, he weakly dispersed his domain and said under the incredulous gazes of Divine Source Legendary and President Lin, “At the start, Eleven’s quasi-divine skill could only be completed with the support of this mental domain.”
“However, as it uses the Talent Bead to develop in depth, it and I can complete this skill independently now. However, the combination of the two is the strongest state.”
“After I activate my talent, its power will multiply when it uses quasi-divine skills.”
“Of course, theoretically speaking, a combination divine skill can only be used once in a long time. The consumption is huge, and the consumed mental strength is very difficult to be nourished by external objects.”

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 848 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (3)
chapters.content:
848 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (3)
“That state can be considered a ‘combined divine skill’ formed by two ‘quasi-divine skills’.”
A combination skill formed by two quasi-divine skills!!
After Shi Yu finished speaking, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin were even more stunned.
Be a human.
The so-called totem demigod could stand at the top of life with a quasi-divine skill.
As for those who had two quasi-divine skills that could be combined, such as the Blue Sea Sprite, that was the peak of demigods.
After all, the Blue Sea Sprite was the first ocean totem born at the start of the totem era.
Now, he was saying that he and the Iron-eating Beast had also completed the combination divine skill of “two quasi-divine skills”?
Originally, Divine Source Legendary thought that if the Iron-eating Beast had a quasi-divine skill, the other contestants of the World Tournament would have nothing to play with.
In the end, Shi Yu said that he could still use “quasi-divine combination skills” with the Iron-eating Beast??
“Even so, do we still have to go to the starry sky to evolve the Butterfly of Imagination?” Divine Source Legendary said.
“It’ll be safer,” Shi Yu said. He couldn’t be careless.
The corners of Divine Source Legendary’s mouth twitched. “I understand. I’ll protect you as you head to the starry sky and help it complete its evolution in the last time.”
“And what you have to do is fight with all your might in the World Tournament and crush all enemies. You have to obtain the blessings of the World Tree and become a legendary in the shortest time possible!”
“I have to say, Shi Yu, you gave me an incomparable surprise.”
“With shock.”
“In all my life, this is the first time I’ve seen a Beast Tamer like you.”
“Fortunately, you were born in Dong Huang.”
President Lin said, “Yes, don’t worry about the ruins exploration mission over there first. Leave it to Lu Qingyi. With your current strength, you can completely compete for the championship position. It’s better to concentrate on competing for the championship.”
If one had to say that exploring ruins was an unstable thing, the blessings of the World Tree were definitely more fragrant to Dong Huang.
Previously, there was no other way, but now…
Shi Yu: “?”
Damn, why were they still jumping around?
Why didn’t they let him explore the ruins!
Couldn’t he take all of them?
“The things explored in the ruins might not necessarily be useful. Instead, with your current aptitude, you can definitely obtain the recognition of the World Tree and obtain a lot of important information from it,” Divine Source Legendary said.
“Back then, Lin Feng obtained very important information from the World Tree.”
“What?!” Shi Yu was stunned. “By the way, didn’t I obtain some information about the destruction of the Mythical Era from the Wind Kirin’s dream and deduce that Blue Planet might be facing some enemy from outer space? Didn’t Senior Lin Feng learn about this from the World Tree?”
“As the clone of the planet’s will, it’s impossible for the World Tree not to know about this.”
Divine Source Legendary shook his head and said, “No, at least Lin Feng didn’t say.”
“Even the next two Beast Tamers who obtained the blessings of the World Tree didn’t receive similar information.”
“Perhaps the World Tree has other thoughts, or perhaps the World Tree doesn’t know when foreign enemies will invade Blue Planet again. There’s no need to mention it too early. After all, billions of years have passed since the end of the Mythical Era. If the World Tree had announced this news hundreds of millions of years ago, would the various Blue Planet factions still care?”
“Not to mention a disaster countless years later, even if it’s a disaster a hundred years later, how many living beings will take it seriously now?”
“If it’s announced, what comes into existence might not be a resistance faction, but a racial faction loyal to external enemies.”
“In the face of power, benefits, and death threats, protecting our home is not something that all lives will defend.”
“But it’s undeniable that this is extremely important information. You can definitely obtain a Mythical resource at the archeological Conference,” Divine Source Legendary said.
“Then what information did Senior Lin Feng obtain from the World Tree?” Shi Yu asked.
Divine Source Legendary said, “The information he obtained is actually similar to the information you obtained.”
“Your information says that Blue Planet is recuperating. Lin Feng has also mentioned this. The World Tree told him that the reason why Blue Planet’s life form can’t break through to the Mythical stage at the moment is because Blue Planet hasn’t recuperated for the time being. It can’t support demigod-level life forms cultivating complete divine skills on Blue Planet and the legendary Beast Tamers upgrading the Beast Taming Space to a Mythical Beast Taming Space.”
“It’s not because the talent of these legendaries and demigods in history isn’t enough, but because the environment doesn’t allow it. If these experts who became legends and demigods in the totem era and the Beast Taming Era go to the Mythical Era, they can almost steadily enter the Mythical Domain.”
“In other words, from the end of the Mythical Era, Blue Planet entered the Cultivationless Age with incomplete rules.”
“But according to the World Tree, Blue Planet is about to recover. There are even independent Mythical mystic realms that have the conditions to break through to the Mythical stage. Because of this, after Lin Feng became a legendary, he actively explored various ruins mystic realms and searched for the opportunity to break through to the Mythical stage.”
“However, I wonder where he went during his exploration.”
“But with my understanding of him, he shouldn’t die so easily.”
The Age of Doom, a Mythical opportunity!
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. As expected.
“Shi Yu, looks like Lin Xiao has completely underestimated you. Your talent and opportunities are one of the best in the east for millions of years. You’re completely capable of becoming the next legendary of Dong Huang. Therefore, you have to get the championship of the World Tree.”

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 849 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (4)
chapters.content:
849 The Strongest Foundation of the World Tournament (4)
Divine Source Legendary said.
Initially, he wasn’t very confident that Ye Xing and Divine Bell could win the World Tournament unless they had another opportunity in the World Tournament. However, Shi Yu’s appearance gave Dong Huang hope.
Perhaps this time, Dong Huang could obtain a second world championship.
They would return to the peak era that had just been established by the Seven Nation Alliance.
Even Divine Source and President Lin had to admit that as Lin Feng disappeared and as Xue Yuan and Shen Feng gradually obtained the blessings of the World Tree, even if Dong Huang had an ally, Dragon Palace City, it was very likely that it was no longer the former number one country.
However, if Shi Yu obtained the championship of this world competition, it would be completely different.
“I will.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “But Senior Divine Source, if I reveal my quasi-divine skill in the World Tournament, I’m afraid many totem factions will see me as a threat. When you go over, bring more forbidden weapons.”
Divine Source Legendary: “Of course. Who dares to have ill thoughts on Dong Huang’s genius? I’ll call all Dong Huang’s trump cards and forbidden weapons over.”
“But speaking of which, apart from this Iron-eating Beast, it should have inherited the power of the Mythical fossil to master a quasi-divine skill.” Divine Source Legendary looked at the mechanical Kirin.
It had to be admitted that Shi Yu, this young man, had completely exceeded him in the mechanical field.
At least, even he couldn’t develop mechanical beasts of Mythical races.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
Divine Source Legendary said, “Wind Blessing, the skill of luck. This is an auspicious sign of Dong Huang’s prosperity. This awakening was indeed correct. Originally, I was still worried about the future Dong Huang, but from the looks of it, I can rest assured.”
“Apart from these two pets, your other pets are probably not weak either.”
Shi Yu said, “Well, the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin has already ‘completely’ digested the power of the legendary bone sword of Ancient Capital University and mastered the ‘Dead Revival’ skill with high proficiency. Although it’s only at the monarch level, it can already control the ‘overlord-level undead puppet’. At the moment, it has three overlord-level undead puppets. It’s also easy for four undead to fight a top-notch overlord together.”
Divine Source and President Lin Feng fell silent again.
In fact, Shi Yu had yet to say everything. In fact, the most impressive thing about Chi Tong at the moment was that it had perfected the Perfect Level Undead Revival and scapegoat into a combination skill.
Apart from the two scapegoats it had created, it could also let the undead puppet it controlled be a scapegoat to withstand the injuries.
Coupled with the perfect-level Demon Blade Curse and the profundity of Myriad Sword Convergence, and possessing Shi Yu’s current quasi overlord physique, quasi overlord spirit, and overlord-level soul, if he erupted with all his might, he might be able to suppress a top-notch overlord and have the battle power of an invincible overlord.
“Baby Ginseng’s performance is stable, but its normal strength is extraordinary. Now that the time mark is ready, if necessary, it’s not impossible to self-destruct and heavily injure the totem.”
“Apart from that, its Time Fruit is a skill that can transform potential. Now that Eleven and Ling are both Mythical races, the effect will be even better if they eat the Time Fruit. The upper limit is no longer at the overlord level. Within the acceptable range, they might be able to temporarily display totem-level battle power. Even if the opponent contracts a totem above their level, we’re not afraid.”
President Lin gulped.
He finally understood why Shi Yu had come to challenge him to verify his strength a few days ago.
This guy’s current strength…
Although President Lin wasn’t weak himself, excluding the totems left behind by Ancestor Lin Feng, if his invincible overlords were careless, they would definitely suffer greatly under Shi Yu!
Fortunately, he ignored Shi Yu because he was busy… Otherwise…
Divine Source Legendary was also rather silent. Shi Yu’s pets were simply top-notch.
Animals, plants, machinery, and undead were clearly divided into different categories, but they were even more perfect than the combination tactics of Beast Tamers who specialized in certain types!
This was the advantage of a powerful race!
In fact, Divine Source Legendary felt that it was completely unnecessary for Shi Yu to go to the starry sky to evolve. From the current lineup, although there was only one overlord and the remaining were all monarchs, and Shi Yu was even a level-six Beast Tamer, why did it give him the feeling that he could already kill indiscriminately in the World Tournament? If he were going to fight in the Baby Cup?
“Also, the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation has already obtained a portion of the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite in advance through the cheat. Its race has already turned into the Blue Sea Sprite and has the foundation of the strongest demigod. It has learned the ‘Blue Sea Contract’ and the ‘Sea Cleansing Spirit’. Although the current it is also at the monarch level, it should be easy to deal with a top-notch overlord. If the enemy is that kind of poison-element life form, due to the restraint of its attributes, the battle power it can display might even be stronger.”
“I think since I’ve already used the quasi-divine skill, it shouldn’t be a big deal to directly let it use the signature skill of the Blue Sea Sprite… In any case, I’ve already attracted enough hatred at that time, so I don’t mind another one.”
“Moreover, the Blue Sea Sprite has done many ocean totem factions a favor. If it publicizes its identity in the World Tournament, what it gains might not necessarily be enemies. Perhaps there are totem allies like Dragon Palace City.”
Legend of Divine Source, President Lin: ???
Damn.
They wouldn’t have known if they didn’t ask, but this was a shock.
The two of them widened their eyes and felt that Shi Yu’s lineup was more and more ridiculous.
What, the Blue Sea Sprite had already accepted the inheritance?
Moreover, after accepting the inheritance, it was still beside Shi Yu?
They were stunned for a moment.
Although they didn’t know why, they felt that Shi Yu was going to ruin this world competition.
“On the Butterfly of Imagination’s side, its battle power is actually not weak either. It’s the pet that’s most compatible with my Psychic skill. Before this, we’ve already defeated the secondary pet of the Space Emperor that broke through to overlord, the Void Mantis. After it breaks through, in the worst case, it will definitely have the strength of a top-notch overlord.”
“If my spiritual power increases, it will be even stronger.”
President Lin and the others were silent.
“Are you confident in contracting a second overlord above your level?” The Mechanical Legendary Divine Source only felt that his throat was dry, although he was a machine now and didn’t have a voice.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded. He trusted Ling very much. Until now, Ling had been very stable. Apart from its research speed being slower, it had never made a mistake. If it said that it was 100% fine, then it was 100% fine.
“Then go and prepare.”
“Little Lin, I’ll bring Shi Yu to the starry sky. Bring the others to Rongguang first. At that time, Shi Yu and I will parachute from the starry sky to Rongguang to find you.”
“I’ll do my best this time. We’ll be back soon. It won’t take too much time.”
President Lin Xiao’s face was still numb. He nodded to indicate that he understood.
This was… They were about to completely crush the hope of other countries winning the championship. A level-six Beast Tamer contracting two overlords above his level…
Moreover, these two overlords were probably not simple.
President Lin Xiao didn’t believe that Shi Yu, who had evolved into Eleven and Ling, would fail to evolve that Butterfly of Imagination. Even if he couldn’t become a [Green Dragon], it shouldn’t be a problem to become a [Perfect Dragon]. It was definitely another ridiculously strong overlord…
He seemed to have already seen the sad faces of the totem countries.
….
A day later.
Shi Yu brought the legendary resource [Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball] and [Dragon Transformation Fruit] and the [Space Strange Water] that had finally become a legendary resource under Susu’s hard work for half a month. He was already prepared to set off for the starry sky.
Although Buggy’s evolution didn’t have a luxurious transcendent skill like Eleven, it had three [Legendary Resources], [Starry Sky Environment], and the same [Spirit Domain].
Shi Yu looked forward to how far Buggy’s evolution could reach. He didn’t ask for Mythical races or quasi-divine skills. In any case, after Buggy’s Dragon of Imagination reached transcendent, it could still evolve again, but it wasn’t too much to give a faith skill like Susu, for example a Green Dragon faith skill, right?
At that time, in the World Tournament, would many totem countries and even the seven countries mistakenly think that he had contracted the Green Dragon Holy Beast when they saw Buggy use the absolutely impossible Green Dragon Faith Skill? The scene made Shi Yu happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 850 Evolution in the Starry Sky (1)
chapters.content:
850 Evolution in the Starry Sky (1)
“President, where’s Shi Yu?”
It was about to set off for Rongguang.
The Dong Huang archeological Team participating in the archeological Conference and the Dong Huang Sequence participating in the World Tournament had already gathered.
Their relatives and friends, such as Principal Feng of Ancient Capital University, the gem cat, and the Tyrannical Sea Legend, were also in the same team.
However, someone couldn’t help but ask when he saw that Shi Yu wasn’t among the gathered members.
“Shi Yu?”
President Lin looked at the questioner and said, “He has something to do. He’ll go to Rongguang himself later.”
“Go himself? Is that alright?” Divine Bell frowned.
Inatella was about to open in ten days. Now, not only Dong Huang, but the other totem countries also made a move. It was the most chaotic situation in the world.
At this moment, Shi Yu wasn’t following the team. Instead, he was running around. He didn’t look like he wanted their protection.
...
“No problem.”
President Lin smiled. That ancestor of hers was personally “protecting” Shi Yu.
Fortunately, Divine Source Legendaryary was not interested in arranging the fate of his descendants. Otherwise, he would definitely matchmake her with Shi Yu!
At this moment, the Mechanical Legendary that had originally planned to pay attention to Ye Xing and Divine Bell had probably been completely attracted by Shi Yu!
All his energy was placed on Shi Yu!
When Shi Yu and the Mechanical Legendary returned from the starry sky, Divine Bell and the others would probably know how ridiculous Shi Yu’s true strength was.
The subsequent world competition… it would probably become Shi Yu protecting them.
…
At the same time, somewhere in Dong Huang.
Shi Yu looked at the huge spaceship in front of him.
< Name > ???
...
Energy Points: ???
Obviously, it was a totem-level mechanical life form!
This was a huge silver circular spaceship supported by “four mechanical feet”. It looked like it could accommodate many people.
From its appearance, it was very similar to the current mechanical body of the Mechanical Legendary.
“Come in.”
The Mechanical Legendary, Divine Source, flew in the air. As it spoke, the door of the spaceship automatically opened. He said, “This time, we’re going to the most famous ‘Silver Ring Star Belt’ near the moon.”
“That’s the area with the richest and most complicated radiation power in the solar system recognized by the three countries, Shen Feng, Xue Yuan, and Dong Huang.”
“At the moment, there’s a shortage of time. We can only head here, regardless of whether it’s the best choice.”
Shi Yu nodded.
Any starry sky environment would do.
In any case, with the current level of Dong Huang’s Mechanic class, it was impossible to do the few constellations that formed the Green Dragon pattern. What was there to choose?
...
“Wu ~”
At this moment, Buggy and the others had long been summoned by Shi Yu.
They sized up the spaceship happily.
After all, this was the first time he had left Blue Planet. Shi Yu naturally wanted everyone to take a look.
It was a trip!
After Shi Yu was thrown a silver-white spacesuit by Divine Source Legendary, Divine Source Legendary planned to set off immediately.
Time was tight, and he couldn’t delay.
Before setting off, he glanced at Buggy.
< Name > Butterfly of Imagination
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space
Energy Points: 7,670,000
...
This normal energy value was already very rare and precious for a worm-type life form.
Moreover, it had also mastered the extraordinary transformation evolution skill, the Dragon of Imagination.
Divine Source Legendary also looked forward to what this Green Silkworm that had relied on the demigod Sea Serpent Dragon Dragon Ball to evolve could achieve with another Dragon God Dragon Ball…
….
In the past, every job of exploring the starry sky was a big matter that the country paid attention to. It was also a competition for the technological strength of various countries.
However, as the level of the various countries’ mechanical domains increased, they rarely paid attention to the starry sky.
Less than five people knew about Shi Yu and the others’ departure.
After the spaceship set off, it flashed through the atmosphere. In the spaceship, Shi Yu and the others didn’t feel any pressure at all. It was as if they were sitting at home, looking at the changes in the scenery outside the window.
This spaceship was very fast. It gave Shi Yu the feeling that they had left Blue Planet in just an instant.
“The Silver Ring Star Belt is made up of a group of floating silver asteroids. When the time comes, the spaceship will dock nearby.”
“There’s extremely strong cosmic radiation there, and the environment is harsh.”
...
“You can temporarily move in the starry sky in this spacesuit.”
“As for your Butterfly of Imagination…”
“With its ability, as long as it’s not long, it shouldn’t be a problem to move for a short period of time.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded. In fact, Buggy had long used the Imagination Domain to simulate the starry sky environment to train.
Although it couldn’t move in the starry sky for a long time, it had indeed trained a certain amount of resistance.
However, if it could evolve into a green dragon, it should have the ability to travel through the universe, right?
In the future, Shi Yu could naturally let Ling study a spaceship or even a cosmic battleship. However, Shi Yu felt that riding a green dragon-shaped worm through the atmosphere and into the starry sky felt more impressive!
“Wuuu!!!”
At this moment, Eleven and the others were lying by the window, looking down with shining eyes.
The surroundings were silent and dark. Suddenly, the entire Blue Planet appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
Blue Planet looked especially beautiful in the starry sky. The vast blue ocean, the green dense forest, the white snow that didn’t melt all year round, and the large yellow desert could be seen clearly from here.
...
“Ning.” Susu lay on Eleven’s head and reminded. As expected of the sea it protected.
It was indeed beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 851 Evolution in the Starry Sky (2)
chapters.content:
851 Evolution in the Starry Sky (2)
Even Blue Planet was named after this.
It looked at Buggy beside it angrily, hoping that Buggy would be more reliable this time.
After all, the cosmic strange water mass was the fruit of its hard work for half a month.
It didn’t have high requirements. As long as Buggy could materialize a perfect “Galaxy” and “Star Sea” for it to experience after evolution, it was fine.
“Wu, wu ~” The worm looked at Susu gratefully.
It expressed that the next time it fantasized about a training environment, it would give Susu a special treatment to strengthen its training environment and make it more cruel. This way, it could better increase its strength.
“Mi ~!” The focus of the sword spirit, Chi Tong, was not on Blue Planet, but on finding the sun. It had a premonition that its perfect Spirit Release or transcendent Spirit Release definitely had a form that was related to the sun.
“Yi!!” At this moment, Baby Ginseng was the most excited. It felt that it was getting closer and closer to the moon.
If it self-destructed here, the power seemed to be much greater than self-destructing on Blue Planet.
It really wanted to take the moon back.
...
Shi Yu also summoned all the members of Team Two.
“Roar!!!”
“Quack ~!!”
The Earth Dragon-like Little Ji and the Abyss Demon Duck Reincarnation Duck, looked at Blue Planet with emotion.
At this moment, they suddenly felt that the ocean and ground of Blue Planet were a little small.
But soon, they were even more indignant.
If they couldn’t even conquer such a small ocean and land, how could they conquer the starry sky?
In short, it was better to be in the first team. According to their understanding, Big Sister Susu in the first team had already aimed at the position of “Lord of the Star Sea”.
“Too powerful!!” Qi, who was also wearing a silver spacesuit, also leaned against the window and looked outside excitedly.
She naturally knew the goal of this trip to help Buggy evolve!
She, who had stayed in Tingxiang Palace previously, couldn’t imagine that someone would actually come to the starry sky to help pets evolve.
...
“Your pets are really strange.” The mechanical legendary evaluated Shi Yu in its heart.
Shi Yu’s pet style was completely different from any legendary in history.
Some people evaluated pets of various legends like this. Emperor Shi and Emperor Kong’s were mysterious because of their attributes, Emperor Wu’s was domineering because of their styles, the empress and the Dragon Emperor’s were noble because of their races. As for Shi Yu…
Apart from the mechanical phantom beast formed by the mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the mechanical dragon that looked a little like an expert, the mechanical legendary didn’t think that these pets looked strong.
They felt very harmless.
Of course, the mechanical legendary knew that this was all an illusion.
For example, that silly duck was actually a demigod reincarnation of the Abyss Sea. The mechanical legendary felt that no one else would expect it.
That was why he said that Shi Yu’s style was very special.
…
As time passed.
Shi Yu and the others were getting closer and closer to the Silver Ring.
...
In Shi Yu’s vision, he could gradually see a silver ring area in the dazzling starry sky.
Behind it was an incomparably bright moon.
It was said that there were also several mythical and legendary ruins on the moon. They were built by many divine beasts from the Mythical Era.
It could be known that in the Mythical Era, those divine beasts had obtained the ability to leave Blue Planet and live in the starry sky.
No wonder the Dragon God said that every Mythical creature had the ability to transcend Blue Planet.
“Senior Divine Source, we’re almost there, right?” Shi Yu was already looking forward to it.
“Wu wu ~” Buggy also started to look forward to it.
However, at this moment, the legendary’s red eye was filled with a strange gaze.
He said, “There are some problems.”
“Uh, what’s wrong?” Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat as he asked nervously.
Please don’t let it be that the spaceship malfunctioned and couldn’t be returned.
...
They didn’t want to wander in the starry sky.
“It’s nothing. It’s just that I didn’t expect that apart from us, someone else would actually come to the Silver Ring Belt at this time,” The mechanical legendary said.
“There are others here??” Shi Yu was stunned.
The mechanical legendary said, “It should be someone from ‘Shen Feng’ or ‘Xue Yuan’.”
“Among them, the chances of the people from Xue Yuan, also known as ‘Snowfield’, are higher.”
“No, I should say it has to be Snowfield.”
“But there’s no need to worry. We won’t interfere with each other when we do our things.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and asked,
“Don’t tell me they appeared here also to cultivate with the power of the starry sky?”
The mechanical legendary said, “We can’t rule out this possibility. They clearly came very early. If we had enough time and had also brought Ye Xing here this time, he would have also obtained huge gains.”
“After all, his talent is related to stars.”
...
“In Snowfield, there might also be Beast Tamers with similar talent.”
…
Silver Ring Star Belt.
On a certain small silver planet.
A spaceship was also docked here.
At the same time, there were several humans in space suits near the spaceship.
Beside them were pets of different forms.
They didn’t realize that apart from themselves, another group of people had already approached the Silver Ring Belt.
The entire Silver Ring Star Belt was still very huge.
Moreover, if the mechanical legendary was so easy to discover, he wouldn’t be called that in the first place.
Soon, the spaceship Shi Yu and the others were in teleported to another silver celestial body.
...
Shi Yu, who was wearing a silver spacesuit, walked out excitedly and stood on the asteroid!

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 852 Evolution in the Starry Sky (3)
chapters.content:
852 Evolution in the Starry Sky (3)
With Psychic power, he could easily overcome the harsh environment in this place without gravity and wouldn’t be too affected.
As for Buggy, it was even less of a problem.
“Wu!!!” As soon as it came out, Buggy indeed felt a strong starry sky radiation.
If it were Little Ji or Duckie, they would definitely immediately mutate and die!
So scary.
It hurriedly expressed that it should call Baby Ginseng out too.
It was rare for them to come here. It wanted to collect more starry sky mutation power and create some mutated starry sky fruits.
Just like Shi Yu, it was an old capitalist.
Baby Ginseng didn’t stop even when it came out to travel.
“Will the effect of summoning the strange water here be better?” Shi Yu also said.
No matter what, the most important thing now was to hurry up and evolve.
Their deadline was not the world competition in ten days.
After evolution, he had to go back immediately.
After all, Shi Yu still had to rush to Rongguang to participate in the archeological Conference and collect his Mythical resources.
Time was very tight.
“Then, Senior Divine Source, let’s begin.”
Shi Yu said to the mechanical legendary who had also followed out.
“Yes, go.”
“With me beside you, don’t worry and evolve,” the mechanical legendary said.
It felt very safe.
“Wu!” Buggy flew high into the starry sky with the radiation and the moonlight.
Its evolution didn’t have to be as troublesome as Eleven.
When Eleven evolved, it first had to perfectly break through to the overlord level. Then, with the foundation of the overlord level, it would digest the meteorite fragment and evolve into a Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
Then, with the help of superalloy, it completed the subsequent evolution.
But for Buggy, it just needed to directly absorb the power of the [Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball], [Starry Sky Strange Water], and [Dragon Transformation Fruit] in the spatial pocket. There were no steps.
Right on the heels of that, with the power of the three legendary resources, the Perfect Level Imagination Domain, the Dragon of Imagination, the overlord’s will, and the power of the mind domain, he imagined perfecting its green dragon body and completing evolution.
This process was in one go and continuous. However, it might take longer to evolve than other pets.
After all, three legendary resources could usually allow pets with outstanding aptitudes to break through to the totem level.
Absorbing such a huge amount of power at once and transforming them into “racial potential” was not a small project for Buggy of a middle-level overlord race.
< Name > Buggy
Race: Butterfly of Imagination
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space
[Race Level]: Mid-level overlord

[Race Skill]:
