Although Buggy’s heritage wasn’t as rich as Eleven’s and didn’t have as many racial skills, unlike Eleven, Buggy’s evolution skill was a racial skill. It was far more suitable for him than Eleven’s superalloy and Baby Ginseng’s mutation.
After checking Buggy’s data one last time, Shi Yu said,
“Come on,” Shi Yu ordered. Buggy, who had a gorgeous body, also took a final look at itself with reluctance.
In its aesthetic sense, it was more pleasing to the eye at the moment.
However, in order to become stronger, it didn’t want to be a worm.
The current change was only for a better future!
In any case, when the Dragon of Imagination reached perfection or even Dao Proficiency, it could still evolve again.
At that time, it would transform itself into the most beloved and perfect race.
As for now, it would make do with the dragon form first!
...
Buggy’s gaze gradually became firm. Then, it closed its eyes and entered the dream state, starting to fantasize!
Firstly, through the Imagination Domain, it mobilized the power of the surrounding starry sky to form a perfect evolution environment!
According to the legends on Blue Planet, soon, the first light appeared in the starry sky.
It was like a star or constellation in the dark and deep universe. Then, a second light appeared.
Second, third, fourth…
The seven lights that appeared connected to each other to become a domain, triggering the huge power of the surrounding starry sky, turning into the prototype of the Seven Eastern Constellations in the 28 constellations.
Jiao Su, Kang Su, Di Su, Fang Su, Xin Su, Wei Su, Ji Su… Before ascending to the starry sky, Buggy and the others spent a lot of effort. Soon, a ten-thousand-meter-long star domain that looked like a divine dragon was condensed by Buggy through the Imagination Domain and the power of the starry sky!
Of course, the current seven constellations were only there for looks. They could only be considered preparatory work.
Buggy was located among them, like the eye of the Green Dragon Constellation. It seemed to have used its combination profundity, the finishing touch.
“Interesting…”
The mechanical legendary was beside him. He looked at Shi Yu and the others who were preparing and focused.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 853 Evolution in the Starry Sky (4)
chapters.content:
853 Evolution in the Starry Sky (4)
It looked like in order to evolve towards the green dragon form, Shi Yu and the others had made a lot of preparations!
“Wu! (Exhausted!)”
At this moment.
After the preparations were over, Buggy began to absorb the power of the strange water in the starry sky that had been placed in the spatial pocket for a long time, including the Dragon Transformation Fruit of Dragon Palace City.
!!
It had been hungry for a long time.
Among them, the Dragon Transformation Fruit could optimize Buggy’s physique. The Dragon Ball could increase Buggy’s power of imagination and simulate the Green Dragon with the power of imagination. As for the Starry Sky Strange Water, it could increase Buggy’s affinity for the power of the Starry Sky, allowing it to absorb the huge power of the stars as much as possible!
“Wu! (So full!!)”
Although the outside world couldn’t tell, Buggy was already about to explode.
It had no choice but to immediately activate its foundation and break through.
Boom!!!
Under the lead of the overlord’s will and its racial skills, the aura on its body began to climb steadily.
At the same time, it connected the power of the three legendary resources to the Imagination Green Dragon.
In the cosmic storm that swept through the starry sky, the light was incomparably dazzling. Soon, a huge evolution light enveloped the green dragon constellation ten thousand meters tall and also wrapped Buggy!!
The power of the starry sky gathered and became nutrients to form this new body.
At this moment, although it was still in the evolution process, Buggy’s race had already begun to increase rapidly under the preparations of various evolution work.
Energy Points: 10 million
Twenty million… 30 million… 40 million… 50 million… 60 million… 70 million…
Even if it was a worm, under the continuous strengthening of the three legendary resources, it was difficult not to become a top-notch overlord.
Moreover, Buggy, who evolved with the help of the Dragon of Imagination, was no longer a worm. The dragon attribute would become its new attribute, an attribute that came with its normal state.
“Not bad, very imposing.”
“I didn’t come for nothing.”
“I didn’t expect this little guy to have the will of an overlord.”
“Looks like after breaking through, it will have at least 80 million energy points. At the same time, its physique won’t be inferior to a true quasi-mythical dragon.”
“In addition to the spatial element, the power of imagination, and Shi Yu’s Psychic Resonance, another invincible overlord is born.”
At the side, the mechanical legendary nodded silently.
At his age, he suddenly had a whim.
He could already imagine Shi Yu representing Dong Huang in the World Tournament!
Shi Yu stood on the asteroid with a burning gaze and looked at the ten-thousand-meter-long Green Dragon Constellation in the starry sky. He communicated telepathically at all times to try to touch the divine power of the Green Dragon.
When he evolved Eleven, Shi Yu came to a conclusion.
Only when the pet had the corresponding compatibility could it resonate with the corresponding divine power in its mental memory.
Eleven was originally not compatible with the Taiji Domain, but as Eleven evolved and mastered the corresponding Yin Yang power, it immediately obtained a certain compatibility with the Taiji Domain.
Therefore, theoretically speaking, it should be the same for Buggy.
In the state of the Butterfly of Imagination and under the normal state of the Dragon of Imagination, it might not necessarily have any compatibility with the Green Dragon Domain. However, at this moment, through the power of the stars, through the wood-element Dragon Transformation Fruit, through the dragon ball left behind by the Green Sky Divine Azure Dragon that was evolving towards the Green Dragon, and through the power of imagination, the Buggy that almost perfectly simulated the Green Dragon form should have a certain compatibility with the Green Dragon Domain…
Shi Yu knew that the aura of Buggy’s evolution was no longer weak. After evolution, its initial energy level would probably not be lower than 70 to 80 million. However, although the mechanical legendary was satisfied, Shi Yu was not!
This level was far inferior to the real Green Dragon.
The real Green Dragon was a god, not a dragon. It was the form of a dragon formed by the power of faith in the stars. It was a god race, not a dragon race.
If it existed, it had to be at the same level as the Blue Sea Sprite.
It wasn’t enough.
It wasn’t enough!
Under the entanglement of the green evolution light, the huge power of the stars had already outlined a dragon form. Its entire body was slowly perfecting. However, Shi Yu was still constantly communicating with the Green Dragon Domain and trying to assist the evolution of the worm.
Finally, as the green dragon’s body was perfected, hard work paid off.
Boom!!!
An extremely terrifying dragon might also erupted from Shi Yu’s body. His black eyes directly turned into golden eyes that were filled with supreme might.
Huh?
“What’s wrong?” The sudden change in Shi Yu’s body shocked the mechanical legend beside him.
At this moment, green-gold fluctuations spread from Shi Yu, who was still very normal just now. The shocking sight of his golden eyes were especially prominent in the starry sky.
The mechanical legend was slightly stunned. Shi Yu’s form was a little similar to the mental domain displayed previously…
But at that time, didn’t Shi Yu say that the developed mind domain could only power up that Iron-eating Beast?
The Yin and Yang Psychic Domain was indeed not compatible with the Butterfly of Imagination that was currently evolving towards the Green Dragon.
No.
What Shi Yu displayed at this moment was not the Yin and Yang Heart Domain at all. Instead, it was another type!
“Senior Divine Source, I think I understood something. My telepathy seems to have broken through.”
Divine Source: ???
As Shi Yu finished speaking, with a boom, a domain expanded on his body again and fused with the Green Dragon Domain that Buggy had imagined. The entire Green Dragon Constellation was even more dazzling and magical.
...
The mechanical legendary opened its mouth slightly, although it didn’t have a mouth in its current robot form.
He just didn’t understand. Was the telepathy talent really that magical?

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 854 Evolution in the Starry Sky (5)
chapters.content:
854 Evolution in the Starry Sky (5)
At this moment, he could indeed sense that the power on Shi Yu’s body was all materialized from mental fluctuations, but what was with this incomparably vast power?
Hu.
At this moment, in the dark memory world, Shi Yu saw a Star Palace. It was a green dragon mural connected by a constellation. It emitted a mysterious magic power that touched Shi Yu’s heart. Immediately, Shi Yu’s psychic power directly connected to Buggy. The evolving Buggy also suddenly saw this mysterious mural.
The transcendent power on the murals was like faint starlight, constantly gathering towards its body like the power of the starry sky in the silver ring belt.
!!
At this moment, Buggy, who had already felt its strength become more and more terrifying, felt that it was several times stronger than before.
“Wu!”
Boom!!!
In the 10,000-meter-long Green Dragon Constellation, Buggy finished the painting. The eyes of the Green Dragon Constellation were the first to open golden eyes identical to Shi Yu’s, like the eyes of a god circling in the ancient starry sky, staring at the small planet.
It wasn’t over yet.
Buggy and Shi Yu felt that this was not the end of evolution at all.
At this moment, Buggy had a magical feeling.
Apart from the power of the starry sky drifting in the starry sky, apart from the void power and natural power that filled various places, it could also sense another incomparably magical spiritual energy.
This pure spiritual energy was incomparably vast. It dotted the blue planet in the distance and resonated with Buggy.
In just a short moment, Buggy realized what this was.
It had actually sensed this power in the Heavenly Fox Nation.
This power appeared on the fox statues.
The power of faith.
That was the power of faith for the Green Dragon Totem and the Green Dragon Holy Beast!!
Buggy felt that it had absorbed the power of the starry sky, the Dragon Transformation Fruit, the Green Sky Divine Dragon Dragon Ball, and the power of Shi Yu’s heart… This couldn’t be considered to have completed the complete evolution of the green dragon.
Only by receiving the power of faith could he truly complete what many legends and demigods couldn’t.
It wanted to become a real green dragon.
“I need your strength.”
I need your strength.
The spiritual connection that crossed space was transmitted to the distant Blue Planet.
On Blue Planet.
Dong Huang, Green Dragon Village.
This was a small village under a third-level city. It was ordinary.
In the village, the strongest Beast Tamer was only a professional.
However, this village had a high-end and generous name, Green Dragon Village.
The reason was very simple. In ancient times, natural disasters wreaked havoc in the few villages around the Green Dragon Village. There was no harvest for farming, and the people were poor.
In order to survive, the people nearby began to worship the gods. They chose the green dragon totem made up by older people.
The Green Dragon Totem was known as the guardian god of the east. It had the transcendent ability to make everything vibrant. Although this ability was very common among many transcendent creatures, it was not so easy for weak ordinary people to come into contact with.
Since he wanted to believe, he naturally had to believe in the strongest.
Coincidentally, under the worship of the villagers of the Green Dragon Village, the surroundings really began to be smooth. Everything revived, and the entire Green Dragon Village was passed down in various disasters. Therefore, the custom of believing in the Green Dragon Totem was preserved here. It was passed down for hundreds of years, and the name of the village changed because of this.
Because the Green Dragon Totem was a fictional totem, ever since Dong Huang entered the modern era, it had never attacked the tribes that believed in the Green Dragon. Therefore, many tribes that believed in the Green Dragon were preserved and lived everywhere in Dong Huang.
At this moment, in the Green Dragon Temple in the Green Dragon Village, the village girl in charge of cleaning the Green Dragon Divine Statue widened her watery eyes. She looked at the Green Dragon Divine Statue that was filled with light for the first time in thousands of years and immediately ran out in shock.
“The Green Dragon Divine Statue has lit up, the Green Dragon Divine Statue has lit up!!!”
This kind of thing happened in many rural villages, but the most shocked group was still the knowledgeable Beast Tamers in big cities.
Divine Capital, Green Dragon Museum.
This was a museum that collected ancient items related to the faith of the Green Dragon God. The owner was a level-six dragon-element master. He looked at the empty Green Dragon Museum and saw that the items of the Green Dragon God’s faith flickered uniformly. He opened his mouth in shock and looked around, wondering if some senior was joking with him.
Impossible, absolutely impossible.
He was a top-notch master. Even if the other party was at the overlord level, they couldn’t pretend in front of him.
What… was going on?
In a luxurious villa in the Ancient Capital.
“Ah.” In front of a television, a curly-haired auntie sleeping soundly on the sofa suddenly woke up from her dream with a dazed expression.
“What’s wrong, honey? Did you have a nightmare?”
“What’s wrong, Mom?” Yu Shu said.
The father and son who were communicating at the side looked at this woman happily.
“It’s not really a nightmare. I just dreamed of the Green Dragon God and said that he wanted to borrow my power. It’s f*cking strange.” Yu Shu’s mother, the top-notch Dragon Tamer, cursed and lit a cigarette.
“You just haven’t rested enough,” Yu Shu said. He knew that his family believed in the Green Dragon God, so it wasn’t strange for his mother to have such a dream.
“But it feels pretty real,” Yu Shu’s mother said strangely.
This kind of thing happened everywhere in Dong Huang, even abroad.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 855 Evolution in the Starry Sky (6)
chapters.content:
855 Evolution in the Starry Sky (6)
In the Seven Islands area, there were also groups who believed in the Green Dragon Totem. At this moment, in the Green Dragon God Shrine, the witches also looked at the Green Dragon Statue that had appeared in confusion and shock.
He shouted for the legendary Divine Master.
Totem Nation, Dragonman Empire.
The surrounding totem countries were not unfamiliar with the ruler of the Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King. This tyrant called himself the orthodox Green Dragon and also evolved towards the Green Dragon as a template.
However, in the form of a green dragon, it also required the citizens in the country, be it humans or transcendent creatures, to believe in themselves and the green dragon.
At this moment, this outstanding totem, the Tyrant Dragon King known as the most likely to become a demigod in the east, erupted with a terrifying aura in extreme anger.
It felt that its power of faith had been thrown into competition.
Its dragon eyes were filled with indescribable shock. It looked at the starry sky in confusion.
At the same time, in just a short while, the hot topic of the Green Dragon Divine Appearance rushed to the highest trending topic on the Dong Huang Network, causing a national discussion!!
If it was just an exception, it wouldn’t have caused such a big reaction.
However, the faith accumulated by the Green Dragon Totem for millions of years made its believers distributed to various levels. Although it wasn’t as vast and long as the real Blue Sea Sprite, it was still a power that couldn’t be underestimated. Otherwise, it would be very difficult for many totem half-gods to covet that power.
Of course, this situation also appeared in the huge dragon faction of Dragon Palace City.
“What happened?”
“Don’t tell me that the Green Dragon was really born because of the power of faith.”
In Dragon Palace City, the Sea Dragon King received the report of the Turtle Prime Minister with a doubtful gaze.
“Should we inform the Dragon God?”
No one knew that all the mutations came from the starry sky.
In the starry sky, spiritual faith fluctuations that filled the sky crossed space and gathered on the body of the Green Dragon Constellation.
At the side, the mechanical legendary’s gaze was already stunned.
He looked at the gathered power of faith in confusion.
Just like seeing Shi Yu’s pet master a quasi-divine skill, it was extremely stunned.
From the start, the mechanical legendary didn’t think that Shi Yu’s worm could evolve into a green dragon.
It wasn’t that easy.
He didn’t refuse Shi Yu’s request because he thought that even if the evolution failed, as long as he completed the evolution, his strength wouldn’t be weak.
Didn’t those dragon totem half-gods also evolve towards the green dragon and fail? But were they weak? No.
Therefore, with the thought that it was not a loss either way, he brought Shi Yu to the starry sky.
However, what made the mechanical legend unable to calm down was that at this moment, the Butterfly of Imagination during the evolution process was actually absorbing the power of faith from an unknown source.
How was this possible!
“Roar!!!!!”
Finally, the gathering of power of faith perfected the last body of the Green Dragon Constellation.
Accompanied by a dragon roar that resounded through the starry sky, its body completely formed under the green-gold evolution light.
Its body was ten thousand meters long and occupied the starry sky. It looked like a dragon, had two golden horns on its head, and was covered in green scales. Its eyes and tail seemed to be burning with golden spiritual faith flames, and its image was extremely shocking.
After the evolution of the era and the migration of history, the image of the green dragon was different. However, the green dragon that Buggy finally turned into was not inferior to any green dragon.
After all, apart from the form of the green dragon, Buggy had also integrated the perfect dragon concept optimized by the various dragon statues into it!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart was extremely excited, and it thumped.
At the side, the mechanical legendary was still in shock.
< Name > ???
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space, Dragon
Energy Points: ???
What… happened?
The mechanical legendary looked at the energy data in front of him… Another one that couldn’t be detected?!
He said in shock, “Shi Yu!!! Don’t tell me that it really evolved successfully!!!”
“It really evolved into a green dragon that can receive the power of faith of the green dragon!!!”
Boom!!!
“Roar!!!” With a green dragon roar, the shocking power erupted by Buggy swept through the starry sky.
Under the enhancement of the power of faith from Blue Planet, its phenomenon immediately broke through the shield of the mechanical legend and lingered in the entire Silver Ring.
“What’s going on!!!”
On the other side of the Celestial Ring Belt, a group of Beast Tamers from Snowfield who had already completed the corresponding mission and were preparing to return to Blue Planet suddenly looked into the distance.
With an incredulous expression, it reflected the shocking fluctuations transmitted from afar.
Beep beep…
Energy Points: ???
The huge energy wave was sensed by them even from afar.
At this moment, this group of Beast Tamers from Snowfield who originally planned to return to the country exchanged glances. In an instant, with the help of the cosmic flying device, they also flew into the starry sky and looked into the distance.
Then, they saw a shocking scene.
...
Along with hearing a shocking dragon roar that could resound through a vast distance even in the starry sky.
It was a ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon that circled the Silver Ring Star Belt and reflected under the Moon Palace. Its body was extremely shocked. In the face of its dragon roar, even the overlord pets and totem guardians beside this group of Beast Tamers in Snowfield were shocked and felt that it was unbelievable.
“Wait, what’s that?”
“Heavens, why would a dragon appear in space?!”
“What’s going on? Hurry up and record it and send it back to Blue Planet!”
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of Snowfield were also extremely shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 856 Evolution in the Starry Sky (7)
chapters.content:
856 Evolution in the Starry Sky (7)
Of course, Shi Yu and the others had no time to care about this group of people. If they saw it, so be it. In any case, it wasn’t something to hide. At this moment, Shi Yu was looking at the green dragon!
In the spaceship, Little Ji and the others also looked at Buggy eagerly and hugged their heads in disbelief!!
“Roar!!”
As a dragon, why was it so handsome!!
“Yes.”
“Senior Divine Source.”
“We succeeded!!!”
Shi Yu’s telepathy sounded.
It made the Divine Source Legend even more stunned.
“To be precise, it’s half successful. Because its strength isn’t enough, and it hasn’t fulfilled its true obligations as a green dragon, it hasn’t received much power of faith. It can’t be considered a real green dragon, but it can already be called… the creature closest to the green dragon.”
“It has already truly exceeded other imitators and has the ability to mobilize the power of faith of the Green Dragon.”
Shi Yu looked at Buggy in its enlarged state and was already very satisfied. He was incomparably happy.
Buggy’s golden eyes stared at Shi Yu and nodded.
It was already very difficult for Shi Yu to recognize that it was still the tool worm.
It wasn’t easy…
“Skill, where’s the skill?” At this moment, the legendary Divine Source no longer had the reservedness of a legend.
Shi Yu said, “Unfortunately, there are no quasi-divine skills. However, like the Blue Sea Sprite, it has relative faith skills, and there are two! I feel that it should be very difficult for faith skills to become quasi-divine skills. It’s still relatively difficult to touch the power of laws with faith, but when these faith skills are cultivated into quasi-divine skills, it will definitely be the strongest demigod like Susu!”
As Shi Yu spoke, he had already used his Psychic power to control himself and fly towards the Green Dragon Buggy in its enlarged form. He wanted to try riding the Green Dragon.
At the same time, he didn’t hide it from the Divine Source Legend.
“It has awakened a total of three skills. The super skill, Green Dragon Roar.”
“Super faith skill, Dragon Raising Its Head, and Dragon Star Group.”
“Senior Divine Source, thank you very much!”
“Their effects are…”
< Name > Green Dragon Roar
[Attributes]: Dragon, Spirit
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It’s a deterrence skill. It can strengthen one’s deterrence skill and offset all deterrence that has a negative impact on oneself!
…
< Name > Dragon Raising Its Head
[Attributes]: Dragon, Spirit, Wood, Water
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > After being on the verge of death or after death, one can rely on the power of faith to recover or reincarnate. The faith is eternal.
…
< Name > Dragon Star Group
[Attributes]: Dragon, Spirit, Space
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It summons a dragon-shaped meteorite from the universe to attack. The meteorite is formed by the combination of the power of faith and the power of the starry sky. The stronger the power of faith, the greater the power!
The evolved Buggy directly obtained three powerful super skills!
The first could allow its deterrence to resist a divine deterrence like Eleven!
The second was a skill that could be said to be immortal like the time mark! Perhaps it could do the same thing as Susu in the future, infinitely reincarnating!
Third, just thinking about the power of the meteorite, Shi Yu could imagine how terrifying the destructive power of the Dragon Star Group could be!!
Most importantly, at this moment, Shi Yu could clearly sense that Buggy’s life force, energy value, and physique, which were originally shortcomings, were no longer shortcomings, but strengths!!
Just the huge energy value that broke through the overlord-level restrictions like Eleven proved how terrifying it was now!
Its physique had already exceeded a group of quasi Mythical races, divine dragons, and dragons. It became the strongest, approached Eleven, and became the second physique in the team.
Apart from that, it had also obtained the ability to survive fearlessly in the starry sky.
It could survive in the starry sky alone.
At this moment, Shi Yu was already riding on Buggy’s head. It had already returned to its normal hundred-meter-tall state under normal circumstances and was still peerlessly domineering.
“Roar!!!” Buggy, who had been repressed for a long time, finally felt that it had completely risen this time.
Under the shocked gaze of the Divine Source Legend, it began to fly with Shi Yu in the starry sky. Both parties were extremely straightforward!!
“Buggy, crush it!!!”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was wearing a spacesuit, gently patted Buggy’s head and looked at a huge gray meteorite floating in the distance.
“Roar!!! (Alright!)”
In the next moment, Buggy strengthened its body through the power of imagination and obtained incomparable speed and strength in the form of a perfect dragon. Just its physical strength seemed to have turned into a green-gold light that brought Shi Yu to charge at the small meteorite with a diameter of a hundred meters like a meteor.
Boom!!!
...
A green-gold meteor streaked across.
Bang!
The huge meteorite was directly penetrated and exploded into powder.
This scene happened to be seen by the Beast Tamers of the snowfield who were attracted by the huge commotion.
They were extremely shocked. Although they didn’t know why the ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon had become smaller, at this moment, they looked at the mysterious human in a spacesuit half-squatting on the green dragon’s head and holding its head. They were directly stunned!!
“There’s actually someone riding that creature!!!”
“Who is it, who exactly is it? How is this possible? A legendary Beast Tamer?!”
Shi Yu and Buggy had naturally discovered them long ago. However, since they were allies of the Seven Nation Alliance, they ignored it.
These people didn’t have any safety awareness… They actually dared to come over directly with such a big commotion.
Shi Yu smiled and ignored them. Buggy’s body turned into a green-gold meteor again and surged in the cosmic starry sky!
…
...
My name is Divine Source. I’m a legendary Beast Tamer who specializes in Mechanics. Now, I’m very confused. After I woke up, I couldn’t understand the changes in this world.
At the same time, the dozen or so aerospace elites in the Xue Yuan Space Bureau also expressed their confusion!!
Apart from training the contestants of the World Tournament, the people here also had an archeological mission. However, they never expected that the team that went to the starry sky would send back a shocking scene just as they were about to return.
It was a short video of a green divine dragon shattering a meteorite in the incomparably dazzling silver ring star belt. If that was all, it’d be fine, but… The key was that on the head of the green dragon, there was actually a mysterious human Beast Tamer in a spacesuit! From the clothes, this wasn’t a Beast Tamer from Snowfield at all. Moreover, at the end of the video, there was also a shocking discovery of the mysterious Beast Tamer riding the green dragon. His identity was unknown!

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 857 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan
chapters.content:
857 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan
Irina.
The legendary Beast Tamer of the Snowfield Nation, one of the contestants of the World Tournament, had extraordinary strength.
The trump card was the Star God Bear.
It was a new race cultivated by the Snowfield Nation after exploring the starry sky. It was known as the strongest bear.
Irina’s Star God Bear was the son of the first generation Star God Bear, the second Star God Bear in the world.
Because he was a hybrid, his talent potential was even higher than his parents.
As one of the members of the Snowfield Nation’s exploration of the starry sky, after discovering the green dragon phenomenon, she quickly followed her companions to investigate.
However, what was difficult for her to accept was that she and the Star God Bear couldn’t even get close to the target!
“Roar!!!”
A huge dragon roar sounded, and the Green Dragon Deterrence swept through the starry sky. Her Star God Bear, known as the strongest bear race, couldn’t even move at this moment, its eyes filled with fear.
Bang, bang, bang.
Irina could hear the heartbeat of the white Star God Bear in space equipment with the moon symbol between its eyebrows clearly.
“Totem level…”
“With a legendary Beast Tamer?” Her gaze was shocked. Who exactly was it?
“Let’s go back.” Beside Irina, there was also the guardian of the Snowfield Nation this time, the top-notch totem, the first generation Star God Bear. At this moment, its expression was also incomparably solemn. Cold sweat flowed as it looked at the green dragon with fear.
After hearing the other party’s dragon roar, even it felt its heart skip a beat. It felt that it was completely crushed at the bloodline level.
Even a trace of fear appeared in its heart.
< Name > Star God Bear
[Attributes]: Light
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 80,210,000
Although Shi Yu and Buggy ignored this group of Beast Tamers from the snowfield, they were also paying attention to their movements at all times.
After all, there was more than one totem-level life form inside. There were also many powerful top-notch overlords and legend Beast Tamers.
However, what made Shi Yu happy was that the pets below the totem level were actually so scared that they couldn’t move when they heard the green dragon roar.
Even totem-level lives were stunned by the deterrence and didn’t dare to act rashly.
“Not bad.”
Shi Yu could sense the power of Buggy’s current deterrence.
Its current full-level deterrence, under the enhancement of the Green Dragon Roar, should be called the [strongest deterrence] at the same level.
Perhaps there was no need to do anything at all. Just the deterrence wrapped around the body was enough to instantly kill a top-notch overlord. With a claw, it could make other lives feel unstoppable fear.
Buggy’s current deterrence gave Shi Yu the feeling that even if Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others dealt with it, they would be instantly killed.
At the same level, even the Demon God Iron-eating Beast before the evolution of light and darkness would be suppressed. However, now, Eleven relied on the power of the Mythical race and the obliteration power of the Yin Yang Millstone to not be afraid of any deterrence.
But at the same time, Buggy didn’t have to worry about the nomological pressure brought by Eleven’s Mythical race and quasi-divine skills.
Although it wasn’t a god yet, it already had the capital to fight against a god.
“Kid, enough.”
The Divine Source Legend quickly called Shi Yu back with a complicated gaze.
As for Shi Yu, he was naturally very obedient. He rode the Green Dragon and flew around before returning to the starting point.
“How’s the situation in your Beast Taming Space?”
The Divine Source Legend asked.
The evolution of the Butterfly of Imagination exceeded his imagination. He immediately asked about Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space.
Was it affected?
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “It’s a little uncomfortable. The enhancement is smaller than I imagined. The feedback attributes are spread out in various aspects such as vitality, mental strength, physique, and the Beast Taming Space. Although the space has been strengthened, I’m afraid I still have to meditate for a period of time to break through.”
The Divine Source Legend was stunned, but soon, he said, “Forget it, forget it. It doesn’t matter. In any case, in your current situation, breaking through or not is the same result. You don’t have to be anxious. You’re only 20 years old… The next ten years will be a rapid growth period.”
“Your body can still take it, right?”
Shi Yu said, “I can take it. The increase in feedback is very comprehensive. Although the burden is a few times greater than before, it’s still within acceptable range.”
“That’s good.” The Divine Source Legend then looked at the green dragon under Shi Yu that had ignited its divine fire of faith. Its mouth felt dry, although it was now a machine.
“What name are you going to give it?”
“Wu ~” Buggy didn’t say anything. It waited for Shi Yu to name it. Even someone as powerful as it began to be afraid. After the wonton panda, would it be the green pepper meat silk dragon?
It hated green peppers and green dragons.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Although it’s not a green dragon yet, let’s call it a green dragon directly. Senior Divine Source, I have an idea…”
< Name > Buggy
[Race]: Green Dragon (Evolving)
[Attributes]: Spirit, Space, Dragon (Wood, Water Mixed Dragon)
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
...
“Speak,” the Divine Source Legend said.
“Although the legend of the Green Dragon has a long history, many people know that the Green Dragon is only fiction. Although the introduction of the fiction is powerful, the people who believe in the Green Dragon are very scattered.”
“Not only are there other totems fighting for faith, just three of the four holy beasts are already fighting for the power of faith.”
“Although the faith of the Green Dragon is enough to crush any totem country that relied on faith to form a country today, there’s still a certain difference compared to an ancient half-god like the Blue Sea Sprite.”
“Although the Green Dragon is magical, it’s basically just bragging at the moment, without enough faith support. The Green Dragon has never done anything for believers.”

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 858 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan (2)
chapters.content:
858 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan (2)
“This way, it’s impossible to use faith to become a god. Reaching the level of the Blue Sea Sprite is the limit.”
“Therefore, I wonder if I can introduce some policies in Dong Huang to nurture Buggy into a true Eastern Guardian God and let it obtain more power of faith.”
“The Dragon of Imagination skill still has two evolutions in the future. With the enhancement of stronger power of faith, next next time, no, next time, maybe it can evolve into a true Mythical race’s Green Dragon, not the current ‘Green Dragon prototype’.”
“If I want to have the ability of a god like the legendary Green Dragon, I definitely need more power of faith.”
!!
The mechanical legend, Divine Source, was silent.
Shi Yu wanted to nurture believers in Dong Huang?
Back then, when he established the country, he destroyed the totem clan immediately. Those factions that believed in totems were all dealt with.
Was Shi Yu going to reverse history?
Such a faith system was very different from the current operation system of Dong Huang.
“How do you want to do this?” the Divine Source Legend asked.
Shi Yu said, “There’s no need to be too strict. Let’s just set up a new traditional festival of Dong Huang. It’ll be called the Green Dragon Festival. Dragon Raising Its Head will promote the Green Dragon culture. It’s mainly carried out among ordinary people, especially in the huge number of villages under third-level cities that rely on farming for a living.”
“They are the main force of faith.”
In Dong Huang, there were definitely more ordinary people than Beast Tamers.
“And the meaning of the Dragon Raising Its Head is the blessing of disaster eradication, smooth weather, and prosperity.”
Buggy was excited.
Was it going to become a big star?
Being a dragon was pretty good too?
“And fixed on this day, I will let it fly all over Dong Huang. With the power of imagination, it will really help the ordinary people eliminate disasters and bless them, allowing the faith zone to have good weather and prosperity.”
“Continue this for a hundred years, a thousand years, or even ten thousand years… With this faith, it can protect Dong Huang forever.”
Buggy thought it seemed tiring. Fortunately, there were clones and ginseng babies.
The Divine Source Legend fell silent again. Dong Huang currently had many guardians. Just Lin Feng alone had left many guardians behind.
However, most of these guardians ate, drank, and slept. Apart from Dong Huang encountering a disaster, they basically wouldn’t do these trivial things.
Although it was for the power of faith, was Shi Yu preparing to do it for real?
“I’ll consider it.” If it were anyone else who made such a suggestion, the Divine Source Legend would definitely ignore it. Since entering the modern era, there were very few areas in Dong Huang where they couldn’t afford food. After all, it wasn’t backward ancient times.
Therefore, the Green Dragon Festival was not very meaningful.
However, he had to consider Shi Yu’s suggestion.
This was because Shi Yu was a Beast Tamer with legendary aptitude in the true sense of the word. This worm had even done an unimaginable thing, taking the right step towards the Green Dragon God.
If Dong Huang could maintain the current situation, it naturally didn’t matter if there was one more or one less guardian. However, the problem was that there were no factions with continuous inheritance. He had to consider it in the long term.
In that case, maintaining the faith of the Green Dragon could become an indestructible trump card of Dong Huang like the mechanical phantom beast plan.
At this moment.
Shi Yu was looking forward to it.
Now, he hoped that the more power of faith Buggy had, the better.
The Green Dragon Festival was actually a traditional festival in China on Earth. On the second day of the second month of the lunar calendar, it was also a festival that surrounded the beautiful belief of the Dragon God. This festival mainly believed in the Green Dragon Astronomical Phenomenon. However, on this blue planet, because of the many wars in the totem era, very few traditional festivals were preserved.
Although there was the faith of the Green Dragon, there were no large-scale traditional holidays related to the Green Dragon.
This way, the faith of the fictional Green Dragon was actually very easy to break.
The Blue Sea Sprite had suffered a similar loss.
Shi Yu planned to imitate this holiday event when the time came. He would combine it with the national situation of Dong Huang and show the Divine Source Legend.
If Dong Huang didn’t allow him to do it, he could only go do it elsewhere.
For example, the Dragonman Empire.
After all, Buggy had two skills at this moment that were related to the power of faith. They had to utilize it.
There weren’t many gods who were willing to do real things. People had to believe Buggy more! He really planned to let Buggy fulfill the Green Dragon’s obligation.
After all, if he didn’t do this, it was impossible for Buggy to evolve into a real green dragon.
“Senior Divine Source.”
“Yes?”
“Tell me, can the world competition be broadcasted live?”
Divine Source: ?
“What do you mean?”
“If we can broadcast it live and let more people see the Green Dragon show its might, won’t its believers be very excited? Wouldn’t that allow it to gain more faith?”
“Apart from Dong Huang, its believers should be distributed all over the world, right?”
“So when we go to Inatella, can we suggest to the World Tree to follow the trend and do a competition live broadcast?”
Divine Source: …
Was this bastard going to the competition or to use it for his own gains?
“Let me see its faith skill first,” the Divine Source Legend said.
Shi Yu expressed his understanding.
...
He also wanted to see Buggy’s dragon star group.
“Roar!!!”
Buggy’s eyes were filled with invincibility.
Golden divine flames of faith flowed in its dragon eyes, dyeing its eyes golden.
Under the condensation of the power of the starry sky and the power of faith, in the cold and dark starry sky, soon, a huge meteorite condensed from nothing.
From a meter in diameter to ten meters in diameter and a hundred meters in diameter, the green-gold meteorite kept enlarging, and the energy contained inside became larger and larger. Just like that, it floated in the starry sky of the universe, making the mechanical legend gradually shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 859 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan (3)
chapters.content:
859 Green Dragon Cultivation Plan (3)
Soon, this meteorite reached a diameter of a thousand meters.
It was extremely shocking for it to become a huge asteroid.
The energy contained inside had already far exceeded the level of an overlord.
“Wait.” The Divine Source Legend hurriedly stopped and asked, “If it was on Blue Planet, could it still condense this move?”
Shi Yu said, “Yes! It’s just that the time required is longer.”
“But it’s alright, because it can condense at any time. Moreover, the condensation of this move mainly depends on the power of faith and the power of the starry sky. Be it condensing or mobilizing, it won’t cause too much energy consumption. It’s the same principle as borrowing the power of nature.”
“Even when it’s not in battle, it can condense a meteorite on Blue Planet when it’s bored and condense a meteorite group. When it needs to fight, it can summon the meteorite.”
“In terms of power, as long as there’s enough power of faith, although it’s at the overlord level now, it can cause destructive power that exceeds the demigod level. If there are no defense facilities, it can easily destroy a country with the power of the meteorite.”
“In a small country like the Heavenly Fox Nation, even the current Buggy can destroy it without any effort.”
Shi Yu was willing to call this move the strongest attack method in the team!
It was as impressive as Susu’s combination faith skill.
At the current stage, Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction and Eleven’s quasi-divine skill, Yin Yang Millstone, had to stand aside.
This move was actually similar to borrowing the power of nature. It wasn’t Buggy’s own power, but the power of the Green Dragon’s faith, so it easily gave it destructive methods that exceeded the overlord level.
From this moment onwards, Shi Yu could be said to be really not afraid of any totem faction.
If they wanted to be his enemy?
He would directly get Buggy to pull ten meteorites and smash them at their totem country to see who couldn’t take it first.
It was just a little inhumane.
It was destined not to be a skill that could be used casually in peaceful times.
It could be said that this was a skill comparable to a forbidden weapon.
Forbidden move.
It had to be banned.
Whether it was inside or outside the team, it couldn’t be used easily.
Otherwise, cities like Icefield and Wu Ling would probably instantly turn into nothingness and it would destroy the city in one hit.
If not for the fact that the surface strength and spatial strength of Blue Planet were strong enough, Shi Yu suspected that when cultivated to the extreme, this move could destroy an era and cause a large-scale extinction of creatures.
He could say that he was looking forward to Buggy perfecting the green dragon form and undergoing divine evolution more and more. Therefore, he had to collect the power of faith no matter what.
After all, condensing a meteorite consumed the power of faith. Although it was enough now, as time passed, if there was no replenishment, the faith skill would be expensive.
It was equivalent to saying that when the sea on Blue Planet dried up, Susu’s Blue Sea Contract would be useless.
Apart from that, Buggy’s immortal body and infinite reincarnation also needed the power of faith.
“Are you serious?”
At this moment, when he heard that Buggy could condense a meteorite at any time and hang it in the starry sky as a forbidden armory, the Divine Source Legendary directly shut down. You call this a “super skill”?
Even quasi-divine skills couldn’t achieve such an effect, right?
“You wouldn’t… use this move in the world competition, right?” the Divine Source Legend said.
If this move continued, it was afraid that the island where the World Tree lived would sink!
Although the World Tree would definitely defend, wouldn’t Dong Huang be banned by the World Tree after using it?
Blessing of the World Tree! The curse of the World Tree, more like!
“After all, it consumes the power of faith that’s very difficult to replenish. If the faith skill isn’t stronger, it’s not worth those dragon demigods going crazy over it.” Shi Yu smiled.
“But I think the World Tree shouldn’t prohibit any skills, right? After all, it’s the World Tree…”
Shi Yu recalled the book “About the matter of me forcing the judge to stop the battle because of a skill.”
In his opinion, the super skills like the Blue Sea Contract and the Dragon Star Group shocked him even more than Ling’s Wind Blessing.
No wonder those totems liked to play with faith to become gods.
Some faith skills weren’t necessarily weaker than quasi-divine skills of laws. Moreover, when faith skills were cultivated to the extreme, they could also touch laws and strengthen themselves.
If only the World Tournament could be broadcasted live… At that time, the status of the panda as Dong Huang’s national treasure would be completely unshakable. Perhaps Eleven could also have a faith skill in the future.
The Divine Source Legend was speechless.
With a “renewable forbidden weapon”, he actually couldn’t find a reason not to let Buggy collect the power of faith.
Just thinking about it… If thousands of meteorites more than a thousand meters in diameter or even larger hung in the starry sky of the universe, with the current world structure, as long as the Mythical Revival didn’t happen, which country would dare to start a war with Dong Huang?
….
After some communication.
The Divine Source Legend experienced an extremely complicated emotional change and began to bring Shi Yu back to Blue Planet.
The surrounding Beast Tamers of the Snowfield Nation also returned to Blue Planet dejectedly under the isolation of the mechanical legend.
At that moment, if not for the fact that the Divine Source Legend had persuaded Shi Yu, Shi Yu even wanted to ride the Green Dragon Buggy and even the meteorite condensed by Buggy just now.
At this moment, the most stunned was still President Lin!
At this moment, President Lin and the Dong Huang Team had already arrived at Rongguang.
However, not long after arriving at Rongguang, President Lin received an important report from the domestic Intelligence Bureau through special communication methods.
“President Lin, bad news. Not long ago, more than ten thousand faith items related to the Green Dragon Totem in the country filled with light.”
...
“That feeling is like faith resonance.”
“We even obtained news that not only Dong Huang, but similar things also happened on the Seven Islands, Dragon Palace City, and even the totem country.”
“I understand. Don’t worry about it.” President Lin hung up in silence and said calmly.
Then, he looked at the starry sky.
He looked in the direction of the Divine Source Legend and Shi Yu to evolve the green dragon.
President Lin: ?o?

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 860 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang
chapters.content:
860 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang
Xue Yuan Nation.
Ever since the Azure Dragon phenomenon scene was transmitted back, the video was immediately studied by several legends.
As they couldn’t detect the energy value of the green dragon, both the witness and the Beast Tamer in the Snowfield country subconsciously judged that this was a totem-level life form.
After all, overlords with energy values exceeding 100 million were really too rare. In comparison, totem level was not that rare.
Moreover, to be able to ascend to the starry sky, it couldn’t be as simple as an overlord.
Why did a green divine dragon appear in the starry sky?
Who was the mysterious Beast Tamer who controlled it?
Now, Xue Yuan was extremely puzzled, and even alarmed the legends of Xue Yuan.
“Lord Vader.”
In the Snowfield Space Agency, more than ten aerospace elites gathered and looked at the scene coming from the starry sky solemnly.
At this moment, a middle-aged man in animal skin armor with a dignified expression entered with the director of the Space Administration.
When the aerospace elites present saw this person, they immediately looked up and greeted respectfully, their hearts thumping.
The legendary God of War in Snowfield, Vader, came from a low-level soldier and rose up in the totem battle. He fought his way to the end of the war and became a legendary. He was the pillar of the entire Snowfield.
“Are our people back?”
“On the way back.”
The Snowfield Battle God, the legendary Beast Tamer Vader, looked at the green dragon in the video with a deep gaze and said, “Is this what you wanted me to see?”
“Lord Vader… One of the legendary Four Spirits of Heaven, the guardian god of the east, and also the god of fictional stars,” the director of the Space Bureau said. “In history, countless creatures evolved towards this legend. Countless Beast Tamers evolved their pets into this form in order to obtain the power of faith of the green dragon.”
“When our astronauts captured this scene in the starry sky, according to the spies everywhere, there were magical reactions from objects of the Green Dragon’s faith all over the world. No matter how you look at it, this isn’t a coincidence.”
Legend Xue Yuan said, “You mean, someone succeeded and evolved his pet into a green dragon.”
The legend of Snowfield was not unfamiliar with the Green Dragon. He had once fought in the east and chatted with the mechanical legendary and evolution legends of Dong Huang. He was a figure who stood at the legendary level. He naturally knew a lot about this kind of not-so-secret legend.
It was said that Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the other legends of Dong Huang had tried to evolve their pets into the legends of the Four Spirits of Heaven, but none of them succeeded.
Vader didn’t expect that at this moment, his subordinates would actually send information of someone suspected to have successfully evolved into a green dragon?
“Yes, it should be Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer. Our people don’t know that someone has come to the starry sky at all. Only Dong Huang and Shen Feng have this ability. Compared to Shen Feng, Dong Huang has a deeper obsession with the Green Dragon, so we determine that the Beast Tamer who evolved the Green Dragon and rode the Green Dragon should be from Dong Huang.”
“It’s just that his/her identity is still unknown. If this green dragon is at the totem level and they contracted it, is it possible that this is a new legendary of Dong Huang… Who is it? Could it be President Lin of Dong Huang? After all, he’s a descendant of Lin Feng’s legend.”
“Or is this green dragon an uncontracted creature?”
The Snowfield Battle God looked at the screen and said, “That old man Divine Source definitely knows something. He must have planned it.”
After a moment of silence, Vader said, “Have they achieved something that the legendaries of Dong Huang have never achieved? I wonder how strong that dragon is. Looks like I have to ask that old man in person about the situation. Let’s go to Rongguang.”
…
Outside Blue Planet, a spaceship was entering Blue Planet from the starry sky. Inside the spaceship, Shi Yu sat on the carpet and closed his eyes to meditate, consolidating the feedback from Buggy’s evolution breakthrough.
And in his legendary ruins, Buggy had already returned to its position!
Buggy’s evolved body was still a little big. In order to not waste too much physical strength, it still shrunk to the size of a water bottle when it wasn’t in a battle state. It was like a mutated Green Silkworm, lying on the ground smugly.
It took out the Ice-Eyed White Tiger, the Mountain Tortoise, the Green Scaled Dragon, and the Black Meteorite Yak Puppet from its spatial pocket.
After breaking through and evolving, Buggy immediately felt that these things were boring and took up a little space.
These puppets… were indeed useless to Buggy.
Even if it was a puppet of the Black Meteorite Yak.
It was still a question if it could withstand Buggy’s attack without collapsing.
It was basically eliminated after a few times.
Now, even legendary equipment was not very useful to Buggy.
Nothing was as useful as the power of faith.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s suggestion was to let Susu cleanse these puppets and pack them up in Dragon Palace City to treat the Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the others to roast meat.
He would treat it as a thank-you for the Dragon Transformation Fruit.
“Sob.” Everyone pointed at the evolved Buggy. For example, Eleven’s round body stood on the ground, its gaze filled with curiosity. It wanted to grab Buggy, but the divine dragon swung its tail and dodged.
“Wu wu wu. (Can you still spit silk now?)” Eleven waved its hands and asked.
Buggy : “…”
“Ji!! (Every dragon whisker now is the strongest silk with ever-changing changes. It can even cut through space and hardening!)”
Buggy looked invincible.
It felt that its current strength was not much inferior to the leader.
Without exhausting the power of faith, it was now immortal.
It was useless even if a Mythical race came.

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 861 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (2)
chapters.content:
861 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (2)
“Wuu?”
Eleven looked doubtful and condensed a huge metal sword for Buggy to see.
Buggy decisively wanted to prove itself. It condensed a worm silk and cut over, but in the next second, the worm silk only left a white mark on the black sword. This stunned Buggy. Then, it shouted angrily that Eleven was a sore loser.
How was this low-level skill Hardening?
!!
This was clearly using superalloy to harden the fusion of countless hardenings!
Using a transcendent-level super skill to bully its levelless skill, wasn’t it too much!
At the moment, Eleven’s skills, even the quasi-divine skill Yin Yang Millstone, were born from divine-level superalloy.
If not for this skill, it definitely wouldn’t have been able to achieve quasi-divine skills and Mythical races.
Therefore, Buggy immediately looked angry.
Damn it, if its evolution skill was also transcendent, it might be able to become a Mythical race.
“(.?ˇ?ˇ?)Heh.” Eleven expressed that Buggy couldn’t do it.
When it was free, it should come and 1vs1 its physique!
“Yi! (As for the Green Dragon, won’t it be better to use the Imagination Domain to create an environment suitable for the growth of plants?)” Baby Ginseng also asked.
Its plant control proficiency had been raised to above perfection and was moving towards transcendent. As its ability increased, Baby Ginseng had more and more ideas recently. If it could have the gardener god, Green Dragon, as its assistant, would definitely help it improve at lightning speed.
Buggy: “?”
Could they ask some normal questions? Green Dragon wasn’t a gardener!!
Buggy turned around and looked at Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling. Eleven and Baby Ginseng were too unfriendly.
“Ji, Ji.”
At this moment, it patted its chest and expressed that it would thank Susu and Ling well.
After all, these two had helped it a lot in evolution.
It would try to help condense Susu’s Star Sea and Milky Way Domain.
On Ling’s side, it would also do its best to work with stronger abilities to assist in the research of the mechanical phantom beast system.
“Ning! ~”
“Yeah.”
Susu and Ling nodded in satisfaction.
“Ji.” However, at this moment, Buggy realized that Chi Tong’s expression was a little depressed. It was stunned for a moment and couldn’t help but comfort it. “Ji. (By the way, when my power of faith increases and the proficiency of the Dragon Raising Skill increases to perfect reincarnation, can you also turn me into a green dragon undead through undead revival? At that time, the green dragon undead and the reincarnation main body will be invincible! I’m not as timid as Baby Ginseng.)”
Baby Ginseng: “?”
So they were still thinking about using the time mark to create the undead ginseng baby!
In addition, was the Faith Reincarnation Skill for it to cheat?!
Its believers would cry to death!
“Mimi.” Chi Tong was worried because it calculated that it seemed to be the only one in the team who had never evolved?
In essence, the Spirit Release skill was still to unseal the power of its bloodline, like atavism, not evolution. It was thinking when it could also undergo evolution like Eleven and Buggy.
“(*+_+*) ~ Wu wu wu.” As it thought about it, Chi Tong started “crying”. It was so difficult, it was so bitter. Of course, it was basically impossible for the current Chi Tong to waver its heart and emotions over such a small matter. However, after seeing Eleven, Buggy, and even Baby Ginseng’s invincible evolution, Chi Tong was a little envious.
At that moment, it was purely for show. It looked like a drama queen, pretending to be pitiful.
Shi Yu, who was meditating: “…”
“I understand. I’ll arrange it after the world competition,” Shi Yu promised.
“Mi! (Yay!)”
Shi Yu sighed. Unfortunately, he had never explored any Vermillion Bird Ruins or Phoenix Ruins with extraordinary power in his previous life. Otherwise, he would also want to help Chi Tong evolve.
Shi Yu knew that Eleven and Buggy could successfully evolve because of their mental domains. If they left this, it might be an ordinary racial optimization. There would be no huge increase.
There were no quasi-divine skills or faith skills.
However, in theory, Chi Tong’s Interlocking Sword also had a chance to penetrate the power of Yin and Yang. After all, everything had two sides of Yin and Yang… In fact, compared to the Phoenix and the Vermillion Bird, Shi Yu still preferred the image of the “sword”. After all, he could also use it after possessing it.
If he didn’t like it, he wouldn’t have swung a wooden sword around during the vocation assessment.
Therefore, if there was a chance to help Chi Tong evolve in the future, Shi Yu planned to revolve around the concept of the sword and not the Sun God Phoenix race. With the successful cases of Eleven and Buggy, his thoughts became bold. What Vermillion Bird Sword and Xuanyuan Sword? He just had to bet.
He would directly use skill fusion to bet and fuse a quasi-divine skill, directly jumping to the Mythical race.
…
Rongguang, a country that believed in light.
Apart from the [Beast Tamer Association] under the alliance system, Rongguang also had two major battle power institutions. Together with the [Association], they were known as the three major battle power institutions of Rongguang!
These three institutions were respectively the [Beast Tamer Association], the [Glorious Knights Order], and the [Divine Church of Light]. The latter two were all related to the light element.
At the moment, Rongguang could be said to be extraordinarily lively.
As the country closest to Inatella, before the World Tournament began, the Beast Tamers from the other six countries who participated gradually arrived.
Shi Yu and the others were no exception. After completing their evolution in the starry sky, their direct destination was Rongguang.
A spaceship that descended from the starry sky quickly descended outside Rongguang.
Even with Rongguang’s technological power, it didn’t detect this uninvited guest from outer space approaching its country at a high speed.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 862 Glory Kingdom of Light (3)
chapters.content:
862 Glory Kingdom of Light (3)
“Yes?”
Rongguang, the legendary hall.
[Rongguang Hero King] was currently receiving the legendary Beast Tamers [Tingxiang Elven Empress], [Seven Islands Valkyrie], and [Ming Hua Death God].
With the World Tournament imminent, legends of various countries appeared one after another. At this moment, they were gathered in Rongguang.
The next seven legendaries still had to supervise the archeological Conference. The two mythicals and many legendary resources in the alliance bank could only be distributed with their approval.
Although Rongguang’s technological methods didn’t detect a terrifying spaceship descending from the sky, it still couldn’t hide from the Rongguang Hero King’s perception. This seemingly old but extremely burly man in white armor immediately looked at the sky.
“Everyone, the legendary of Dong Huang has also arrived. Do you want to meet him together?” the Rongguang Hero King suggested.
“The Divine Source has arrived? But this old man actually used a spaceship to travel?” The Elven Empress of Tingxiang was speechless.
“Dong Huang.” The Seven Islands Valkyrie, who was wearing a battle-type kimono and had long black hair, spoke in an unfriendly tone.
After being extorted by Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City, she had never been very happy since she woke up. Her face, which was not inferior to the Elven Empress, was filled with hostility. As a mechanical cyborg, her appearance was the youngest among the legends.
“This way, we’re still short of Xue Yuan and Shen Feng,” an old man with silver curly hair wearing special purple clothes and a hunched body said lifelessly. A portion of his clothes was tied with a white bandage.
“Forget it.”
Seeing that these guys had no intention of welcoming the legendary of Dong Huang, the Rongguang Hero King shook his head. In that case, he wouldn’t go either. He would directly call the legendary of Dong Huang over.
…
“Oh, have you noticed me?” At this moment, in the spaceship that was still descending quickly, the mechanical legendary muttered to himself.
He had already received the Rongguang Hero King’s voice transmission that crossed the void, inviting him to meet directly.
“What’s wrong, Senior Divine Source?” In the spaceship, Shi Yu, who had already prepared to step into the Kingdom of Glory, was studying the parchment.
After arriving at Rongguang, the first thing he did was to run to the hatching altar left behind by the Space Emperor in Rongguang to assist Ling in studying the final starlight.
“It’s nothing. I originally wanted to stop outside the border of Rongguang and enter normally, but now that I’ve been discovered by Rongguang’s legendary, he invited me to go directly to the capital. In that case, let’s directly descend there.”
“Alright, then let’s go over directly. Hurry up and meet President Lin and the others,” Shi Yu said in anticipation. In short, the mechanical legendary still didn’t care. He still had to talk to President Lin about gathering the power of faith!
The mechanical legendary nodded. Soon, Shi Yu and the others crossed the void and descended in a rarely populated suburb of Rongguang Capital.
The huge spaceship disappeared. Shi Yu got down from it. The round robot-shaped red eye of the mechanical legendary looked into the distance.
“Next, contact President Lin and the others.”
“I want to see the legendary of Rongguang.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, the mechanical legendary was in a good mood. The meeting of the legendaries of the seven countries was like a parent-teacher meeting. At that moment, the mechanical legendary had already judged that it was very likely that his ‘child’ would get first place in the exam. His mood would naturally be a little strange.
He had already begun to look forward to the shocked expressions of the legendaries of the other six countries when they saw the appearance of a super genius like Shi Yu in Dong Huang.
Then, the mechanical legendary disappeared in the blink of an eye, leaving Shi Yu sighing on the spot.
This guy was really not worried that he would encounter danger.
“Let’s go.” Shi Yu hummed two nursery rhymes and took out his communication device. He was also in a very good mood as he went to meet President Lin, Principal Feng, and the others first.
Rongguang Capital.
President Lin was discussing the archeological Conference in two days with the president of the Rongguang Association and the president of the multinational associations. At this moment, although he wanted to communicate with Shi Yu as soon as possible, he really couldn’t leave.
After Shi Yu learned of it, he decisively came to look for Principal Feng, Senior Lu, and the others.
The buildings in the capital of Rongguang were mainly white. The temporary address of the Dong Huang team was also arranged in a beautiful white building complex.
“You’re finally here.” Principal Feng still didn’t know what Shi Yu had gone to do. In any case, it hadn’t been a day or two since Shi Yu liked to run around. When he saw Shi Yu, Principal Feng immediately said, “How’s the preparation for the archeological Conference?”
“It’s about time. When the time comes, I’ll just participate directly and fight for a Mythical resource!” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Principal Feng, where’s Senior Lu?”
“She went to Rongguang to ‘visit’ everywhere.”
“She must have gone to eat with Teacher Ying.” Shi Yu looked doubtful.
“In that case, I won’t delay any longer. Then I’ll directly find the Starry Sky Hatching Altar,” Shi Yu immediately said after greeting Principal Feng.
Principal Feng had a headache. Shi Yu was really a busy person, but it was also a good thing.
“Alright, it’s just that Rongguang has been mixed with good and bad people recently. At this moment, there are more than a hundred legend Beast Tamers gathered in Rongguang Capital alone. Stop it, don’t cause any trouble.”
“How could that be? I’m such an honest person,” Shi Yu said seriously.
“If you were an honest person, so many ruins wouldn’t have cracked!”
….
Rongguang Legendary Hall.
Upon the invitation of the Rongguang Hero King, the mechanical legend, Divine Source, arrived immediately. After he arrived, the legends present also looked at Divine Source’s temporary body in silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 863 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (4)
chapters.content:
863 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (4)
However, no matter what this person turned into, many legendaries present didn’t dare to underestimate him.
“Divine Source!!!”
Along with the mechanical legendary came the legendary of Xue Yuan, Snowfield. He pushed the door open and entered, not caring about the other legendaries in the room. “That person in the starry sky is indeed your Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer, right?”
“What starry sky?” In the room, the Elven Empress smiled and said, “You guys went to explore the starry sky again? I was wondering why Divine Source drove the spaceship over.”
The Snowfield Battle God said, “Then you have to ask Divine Source. Dong Huang just caused quite a commotion in the Silver Ring Belt.”
“You’re pretty well-informed,” Divine Source said indifferently.
“What happened in the starry sky?” the Rongguang Hero King asked.
“Our Beast Tamer carried out a mission in the Silver Ring Belt and discovered a Beast Tamer in a spacesuit controlling a green dragon in the starry sky.”
“‘Green Dragon’, the Green Dragon you’re talking about, do you mean a green dragon, or…” The Seven Islands Valkyrie glanced at him.
“The Four Spirits of Heaven, ‘Green Dragon’, that legendary creature. If nothing goes wrong, your Dong Huang should have cultivated a creature extremely similar to the Green Dragon, right? It can even mobilize the power of faith related to the Green Dragon.”
“What!” The expression of the Seven Islands Valkyrie changed. Among the seven countries, the two countries that knew the Green Dragon the best were definitely Dong Huang and the Seven Islands that were most affected by Dong Huang’s culture.
At this moment, when she heard that Dong Huang had even evolved into a conceptual divine beast like the Green Dragon, the Seven Islands Valkyrie was immediately stunned.
To be able to mobilize the power of faith of the Green Dragon, in terms of potential, the weakest version of this was at least at the demigod level.
It was no wonder that the legendary of Snowfield was so excited.
There were also many Beast Tamers on the Seven Islands and many transcendent creatures that tried to evolve the Green Dragon, but none of them succeeded.
How did Dong Huang do it? How did it mobilize the power of faith of the conceptual god?
Many legendaries instantly looked at the divine source.
“It’s not that exaggerated. It’s just closer to the Green Dragon,” the mechanical legendary said calmly.
It was just a quasi Mythical race that could casually summon a few meteorites. It wasn’t worth paying attention to!
After all, that guy still had two Mythical races in the team, as well as the Blue Sea Sprite that was not inferior to the Green Dragon.
Calm down, calm down.
“It’s actually true?” The Elven Empress was stunned. Then, she felt stifled. How lucky was Dong Huang!
She recalled Shi Yu, who had contracted a Mythical race, the Wind Kirin.
“Who is it?” Vader asked.
Legends like the Rongguang Hero King and the Ming Hua Death God looked at the Dong Huang mechanical legendary and wanted to ask who it was, which Beast Tamer’s pet it was, or if it was personally cultivated by a member of Dragon Palace City or Divine Source.
This was an achievement that had never been achieved in the legends of Dong Huang. In this generation, someone actually did it?
However, Divine Source couldn’t be bothered to tell them directly. Instead, it said to the Snowfield Battle God, “Speaking of which, why did your Snowfield run to the starry sky again?”
The Snowfield Battle God sat on the sofa and said, “Stop changing the topic.”
“You don’t have to say to know that it’s either archeology or training,” Divine Source said.
“Both, right? However, archeology in the starry sky… Looks like your Xue Yuan is determined to get the Mythical resources of the Alliance,” the mummy-like short old man said with a smile.
“Which one does Xue Yuan fancy? There are only three Mythical resources left in the alliance, right? When the time comes, will we choose two out of three?”
“Doesn’t that mean that whoever chooses first will benefit?” the Elven Empress said.
Mythical resources.
It was impressive, but not impressive.
If the legendary resources cultivated overlords by 100% and totems by 10%…
Then the Mythical resource was 99% when it came to cultivating to totem level.
However, being the remaining Mythical resources left in the Alliance, it was definitely not a top-notch Mythical resource like the Undying Fruit.
Otherwise, it would have long been schemed away by the various countries at that time.
What was left were some Mythical resources with relatively harsh conditions.
< Name > Heart of Eternal Frost
[Attributes]: Ice
< Introduction > It’s an ice heart that contains the power of the ice-element law. It can freeze the flow of life, but the user can’t revive from the eternal freeze before comprehending the ice law.
This was a Mythical resource that could make one almost “eternal”. It could make one fall into an eternal frozen state through the Eternal Frozen Heart. In this state, one’s life wouldn’t be lost, and it was equivalent to a different kind of eternal life. Moreover, one could comprehend the law of ice during this process and become an ice-element demigod.
It looked like a very top-notch Mythical resource, but the conditions to use it were extremely harsh. This was because if one couldn’t comprehend the Ice Law, it was equivalent to completely dying and forever being unable to break through the seal.
This was not the only Mythical resource. It came from the snow land in the extreme north. 2000 years ago, a top-notch totem used another Eternal Frozen Heart. Unfortunately, until now, that top-notch ice-element totem had yet to break through the seal. Its race had already been extinct, and the era had already changed, but it could only sleep in the ice.
It could be said that using this resource required great patience. It was equivalent to directly sleeping for thousands of years. When the user woke up, the seas and lands would be different already.
…
< Name > Soul Pearl
[Attributes]: Undead
< Introduction > It’s a wisp of soul from the Mythical Era. It’s in a deep sleep. Its energy level has maintained at level ten Mythical until now.
The second resource was even more scammy than the first Mythical resource. The first resource at least let the user see hope of becoming a demigod, but this one was purely scamming.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 864 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (5)
chapters.content:
864 Kingdom of Glory, Rongguang (5)
Firstly, one didn’t know if the remaining soul in the pearl was friend or foe. Even if one purely treated it as a resource and prepared to devour the soul with the huge soul power as a strengthening resource, one had to be wary of the remnant soul inside that might counterattack. It could be said to be extremely dangerous.
Although devouring such a huge soul power was basically not a problem to reach the totem level, there was also a risk of being possessed.
…
< Name > World Tree Fruit
!!
[Attributes]: Wood
< Introduction > It’s the fruit of the World Tree. It increases comprehension.
Among the three resources, the only one that wasn’t scammy was the World Tree Fruit. This was a gift from the World Tree to the Seven Nation Alliance in the last World Tournament and had been preserved until now.
It was similar to the blessing effect of the World Tree. It could increase the pet’s comprehension and allow a pet to train a super skill to transcendent proficiency in an extremely short period of time.
It could be said that eating this fruit could also let one become a totem, and it would be a totem that was purely cultivated by oneself. Its battle power would be very strong.
…
If nothing went wrong, if the seven countries could choose resources, they would definitely want the World Tree Fruit. After all, this was the most stable and had a wide range of applications.
Similarly…
The legendary resources stored in the alliance were more or less problematic. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been left until now.
However, although there was a problem, it was still a Mythical resource. As long as they didn’t pay a huge price, everyone wanted it.
…
“It’s in the capital. Sigh, although it’s also a suburb.”
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t know if he should be happy or sad.
At this moment, he had already arrived near the designated location of the hatching blueprint.
Rongguang, the Heavenly Fox, the Seven Islands, and Tingxiang. Among the four countries, Tingxiang and the Seven Islands had locations that were isolated. There were few people, so they casually went over.
As for the Heavenly Fox Nation, it was very difficult to deal with in the nest of overlord-level creatures. As for Rongguang, it was probably even harder to deal with in Rongguang Capital.
Shi Yu and the others descended in the east of the capital of Rongguang. Shi Yu passed through the center of the capital and arrived in the west.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived outside the huge family courtyard called the “White Rose Family”.
The map told him that the last hatching altar to hatch the Space Beast Egg might be inside.
Tsk.
However, after investigating outside the courtyard for a moment, Shi Yu surprisingly discovered that this legendary White Rose family was really not simple. It was actually passed down from a thousand years ago.
[The White Rose family’s talent is ‘White Thunder’. Hundreds of years ago, the princess of the family fell in love with the Space Emperor of Dong Huang and married from afar to become the 19th concubine of the Space Emperor… In hundreds of years, the White Rose family didn’t decline and was glorious. Even now, it’s still a huge monster that can still produce several legends.]
It was actually a family that had a marriage alliance with the Dong Huang Emperor family in ancient times.
The Space Emperor must have established the Starry Sky Altar here at that time.
“Forget it, I’ll just visit directly and get straight to the point. As long as the altar is still around, there’s definitely a way to use it. If the altar isn’t around, then it’s not around anymore. In any case, the altar in Tingxiang isn’t around either. At most, Ling’s research mission would be a little heavier…”
It was…
White Thunder talent?
It was referring to the White Thunder skill.
Why did Shi Yu feel that it was so familiar? Had he encountered a Beast Tamer with similar talent somewhere?
His expression gradually became strange.
“Who are you?” Just as Shi Yu thought of a possibility, a female voice came from behind. He immediately turned around and saw a man and a woman walking over.
The woman was in her twenties. Her long golden hair was combed into a ponytail. She was wearing a white knight suit with golden patterns on it. There was a knight sword at her waist.
The man was about 20 years old and was also wearing a similar knight suit. Shi Yu was not unfamiliar with this suit. It was the battle suit of the Knights of Glory. The Knights of Glory was similar to Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer Troops, but the organization was even looser…
At this moment, when he saw the man and woman, Shi Yu sighed in his heart. As expected.
“You, you, you…” At this moment, the short-haired young man in his twenties looked at Shi Yu, who was wearing a white casual suit with an iron-eating beast pattern, and widened his eyes.
“You’re Fu Andi,” Shi Yu said.
He was wondering why the White Thunder Talent was so familiar. Wasn’t this the Beast Taming Talent of the Rongguang Beast Tamer who went to Ancient Capital University to challenge a year ago?
The other party’s father was a member of the last Dong Huang World Tournament, but because his wife was from Rongguang, he settled here.
It was rare for this Fu Andi to follow his father back to Dong Huang. In the end, before he could warm up, he was beaten up by Shi Yu and Eleven.
It reminded Shi Yu of the book “A friend from afar must first suffer his willpower.”
“No, my name is Fu Dian!!!” The short-haired young man said angrily.
This guy was casually wrongly remembering other people’s names!
“Is it someone you know?” The tall woman in the knight suit looked at him.
“Cousin, this person is Shi Yu, the one who defeated me at Ancient Capital University. He’s also… the number one person below the legend level of Dong Huang, one of the contestants of the Dong Huang World Tournament.” Fu Dian’s expression was complicated.
Ever since he returned to the country, he had been cultivating hard, hoping to defeat Shi Yu one day.
However, Fu Dian originally thought that he could only find the chance to go to Dong Huang after he reached the Legend level.
However, to his surprise, with the arrival of the World Tournament, the communication between the seven countries became more frequent. He once again obtained the opportunity to follow the Rongguang exchange team to Dong Huang.
But this time, he heard a lot of bad news.
Who knew the complicated feelings he, who was still at the master level at that time, had when he heard that Shi Yu had defeated the Space Emperor’s secondary pet and become the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 865 Glory Kingdom of Light (6)
chapters.content:
865 Glory Kingdom of Light (6)
Who knew his complicated feelings after learning that Shi Yu had developed the epoch-making Green Silkworm cocoon system and the mechanical phantom beast system?
Although he had also broken through to the master level, Fu Dian instantly felt that his sweat had been eaten by dogs after working hard for so long.
