On Dong Huang’s side, Lu Qingyi was speechless when she saw Shi Yu looking like he was about to die on such an important occasion today.
Shi Yu’s physique was clearly very strong… But why was it like this every time?
“…” Shi Yu was helpless.
Wasn’t this for the archeological Conference? He had been researching hard these two days.
Including yesterday, he stayed up late again.
Originally, when Buggy evolved, Shi Yu quickly recuperated. However, from the looks of it, it was all fake!! He was completely strong on the outside but weak on the inside. He couldn’t stay up late and work overtime like before. If he wasn’t careful, he would suddenly die.
Next, be it the Psychic connection skill or the mind domain, they couldn’t be used casually. They could only be used as trump cards.
Otherwise, unless he ate the ginseng baby, it would be very difficult to heal.
Shi Yu sucked on the sachet and didn’t want to stay any longer in the archeological Conference. He planned to be the first to appear later and leave immediately after that.
“Looks like everyone is here.”
At this moment, the seven presidents of the associations were sitting at the judges’ table. The void tore open, and a burly man in golden armor came out of an alternate space and looked at the many archeological elites present.
His expression was dignified, and he looked like a king.
Legend of Rongguang, Hero King!
In the Rongguang area, the main enemy of the last totem battle was the Demon Kingdom.
The Rongguang at that time was purely the colonization of the Demon Kingdom.
In that chaotic world, Rongguang gave birth to many heroic figures. Among them, the Hero King was basically the king of all heroes. He led many heroes to end the chaotic world in the Rongguang area and established the Rongguang Kingdom.
“Welcome to Rongguang. I’m the Hero King, Dilan.”
“The meaning and goal of this World Archeological Conference is to hope that the Seven Nation Alliance will use history as a reference. The history of the Blue Planet’s human race is a disaster history. Only by understanding the historical laws can we better open the future. Therefore, I hope that everyone can communicate freely next. For archeologists who have obtained information beneficial to the human race of the seven countries, the Seven Nation Alliance will reward resources according to the importance of the information.”
“There are no restrictions on this exchange meeting. You can go on stage yourselves, but only one person is allowed each time.”
Everyone knew this model in advance. Under this rule, they definitely had to communicate first. The reason was very simple. If the archeological results collided, it would definitely be first come, first served.
“I…” Shi Yu had already stood up, but someone was faster than him, making the corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitch.
It was an archeologist from Snowfield, an old man in an archeological suit.
He was clearly old, but his hand speed was that of someone who had been single for decades!
At this moment, the Hero King had already left and returned to the alternate space. At the judges’ table, President Lin smiled and said, “There’s no hurry. Let this archeological master from Snowfield exchange his archeological results first.”
The archeologist from the snowfield glanced at Shi Yu and smiled. Then, he walked onto the booth.
“It’s Gufu, an archeologist from the snowfield. He’s a level-six master. He has ascended to the starry sky many times with the help of Snowfield and mainly studied the starry sky ruins,” Principal Feng said beside Shi Yu.
At that moment, the gazes of the presidents of the Seven Nation Associations landed on Shi Yu, who had sat down again, and Dr. Gufu, who had just gone on stage. They were not unfamiliar with Shi Yu and Gufu. The presidents of the associations and archeologists of other countries had already guessed most of the archeological results Shi Yu wanted to show.
He had most likely obtained some secrets about the totem era through that fossil archeological machine.
As for Gufu’s archeological results, apart from the legendary of Snowfield and the president, the others could only determine that it was related to the starry sky.
After Old Gu Fu went on stage, he coughed three times. His body already looked a little weak, but he looked very excited.
He said, “I’m Gufu. Just half a month ago, I ascended to the starry sky again.”
“We cracked it. A legendary ruin established on the moon, a legendary ruin numbered ’12’ by our Seven Nation Alliance!!”
As soon as Gu Fu finished speaking, apart from the archeologists in Snowfield, everyone was in an uproar.
Shi Yu was no exception. He was slightly stunned. There were a total of 13 ruins on the moon. Ever since humans ascended to the moon, they had only successfully cracked one empty ruin. They couldn’t crack the others. Did Xue Yuan successfully crack another one?
Gu Fu said excitedly, “This is a legendary ruin left behind by a demigod-level life form from the totem era a million years ago!!”
“After it reached the totem level, it kept evolving into a cosmic life form. After cultivating to the demigod level, it finally obtained the ability to survive and travel freely in the starry sky. It’s called a ‘star beast’.”
“This will be the first post-era life form to land on the moon after the end of the Mythical Era.”
“After our deciphering, according to the information it left in the ruins, there’s a very important message!”

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 880 Shi Yu Telling Myths (4)
chapters.content:
880 Shi Yu Telling Myths (4)
“Everyone should know that the champions of the World Tournament who have received blessings have all obtained information when communicating with the World Tree. At the moment, the laws of Blue Planet are incomplete, and it’s very difficult to break through to the Mythical stage, even with its blessings. And we discovered another path to the Mythical stage in this ruin!”
“The further away from Blue Planet, the easier it is to touch the power of the natural order and escape the incomplete restraints of Blue Planet. This is the message left behind by that demigod. It once spent 500 years exploring the starry sky and came to such a conclusion. However, the most regrettable thing is that it couldn’t break through to the Mythical stage in the end and reached the limit of its lifespan. If it was given another 100 years, it might really have a chance.”
“Therefore, it’s not wrong for us to explore the starry sky. Developing technology and reaching the depths of the starry sky is the foundation for us to step into the Mythical stage. Therefore, I think that the Seven Nation Alliance working together to develop the cosmic fleet and attack the starry sky is the future of the Beast Taming Era. We can even open a new era of starry sky pets!”
Gufu’s words caused a thousand waves. A person’s imagination was infinitely big. What he said had actually been imagined by archeologists and scientists. They thought that outer space was the key to breaking through to the Mythical stage, but there was no evidence.
And now, with the excavation of this cosmic ruin from the totem era a million years ago, the verification of a demigod-level life form that had explored the cosmos for 500 years undoubtedly added some truth to this statement.
Gufu used the technological device on the communication platform to simultaneously display the information they had explored in the cosmic ruins as evidence.
“Even if it’s true, Master Gufu, do you know how much resources it takes to build a battleship that can continuously shuttle through the universe and reach the depths of the starry sky? Do you know how much money is needed to support its navigation? With such resources, with the fact that a life form might break through to the Mythical stage, not to mention hundreds of years… Isn’t the investment too unstable?” an archeologist from Shen Feng said.
“But this is also a path, isn’t it?” Master Gufu looked over.
In the alternate space, many legendaries remained silent. This was indeed a path, but at least their generation definitely couldn’t afford to wait.
There were actually rumors about those who had gone to the depths of the starry sky to break through. However, this time, Xue Yuan had used archeological methods to produce more concrete evidence.
Around this topic, many archeologists and presidents of the various associations present immediately discussed and argued.
Among them, what Shi Yu was concerned about was the “Star Beast Demigod” of this totem era. It was really powerful. It actually broke through the restrictions of Blue Planet at the totem level and headed into the depths of the starry sky to explore.
He just didn’t know how many lives there were apart from it. It should be the kind of native life form on Blue Planet that returned after exploring the starry sky. Was there anyone who didn’t return? Or even… got lost?
After an unknown period of time, President Auland said, “This topic ends here. After the conference, the jury will analyze and collect evidence of this research result. Next, please let the next archeological master who wants to exchange the results go on stage.”
As President Auland finished speaking, everyone’s gazes landed on Shi Yu, who had not participated in the discussion just now and was sitting at a side.
Shi Yu indeed didn’t have the energy to discuss it. He had half-closed his eyes the whole time and was resting… He was so tired…
But after it was his turn, Shi Yu perked up and walked onto the arena calmly in his white research suit.
After walking onto the arena, he looked around like a big boss.
“Actually, I agree with what Senior Gufu said just now.”
“The future of Beast Tamers is in the starry sky.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was in an uproar. Master Gufu, who had just gone down, looked at this young man from Dong Huang in surprise.
However, Shi Yu’s next words made the corners of his mouth twitch.
“However, there’s no need for us humans to explore the starry sky yet, not until thousands of years have passed.”
“This isn’t the way to break through to the Mythical stage.”
“I’m Shi Yu.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth curled up. “According to my judgment, if nothing goes wrong, in about seven years, the laws of Blue Planet will be completely perfected. At that time, the Mythical era will revive. From then on, Blue Planet won’t have any restrictions that can’t break through the Mythical stage.”
“What!!!”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, all the archeologists present were stunned.
The seven presidents sitting at the judges’ table and the legendary experts guarding the alternate space were stunned.
Even President Lin and the mechanical legendary were very shocked.
Where did Shi Yu find this explanation?
Didn’t they agree on a disaster that would end the Mythical Era?
In the end, he predicted the time of the Mythical Revival the moment he came up and even predicted the exact year?!
“Dr. Shi Yu, you’re not kidding, right? Do you have any evidence?” The person who asked was the president of the Shen Feng Association. This white-bearded old man looked at Shi Yu with a scrutinizing expression.
Shi Yu also looked at him.
This was actually told to him by Qi.
Before the power completely dissipated, Qi speculated the specific recovery time of the Law Force.
It was seven years later.
At that time, when the laws revived and the world changed drastically, Blue Planet’s main body would awaken, and the natural energy would be more abundant.
Originally, only at that time would she awaken her memories. Shi Yu’s balls hurt now. He originally thought that he still had time, but after chatting with Qi, he realized that the Mythical stage was only seven years away from reviving.
He didn’t know how strong he could be before that.

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 881 Shi Yu Telling Myths (5)
chapters.content:
881 Shi Yu Telling Myths (5)
Legendary-level, all demigods in the team… It shouldn’t be a problem, right? It was just that he felt a little uneasy unless he reached the Mythical stage.
However, seven years was only the time for Blue Planet’s Mythical Revival. A Mythical external enemy might not necessarily descend immediately, so there was no need to worry too much.
As the loser of the Battle of Blue Planet, the alien factions might have paid an even heavier price.
Of course… it was also possible that it would descend on that day. For example, if a planet didn’t have the complete power of the natural order, what would it swallow? Perhaps, when the world laws recovered, it would come again…
In short, it would be best to break through to the Mythical stage in seven years, and he would have top-notch Mythical battle power.
Shi Yu set a small goal for himself.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be safe.
At that moment, Shi Yu naturally couldn’t confess.
There was no concrete evidence.
However, he could talk nonsense.
“President Logan, do you remember the fossil recovery device I developed?” Shi Yu said.
President Logan’s expression changed slightly.
“At that time, I said that if the ancient fossils of the totem era could be revived, then the Mythical Creature fossils of the Mythical Era might be able to be revived. Although there have been no successful cases now, I believe that as long as we invest money and continue researching, reviving divine beasts and materializing Mythical creatures into the Beast Taming Era might not be impossible.”
“And now…”
“You mean…” President Logan’s expression was shocked.
The expressions of the presidents of the other national associations, the archeologists at the scene, and the other legends in the alternate space changed a little.
In front of Shi Yu, a purple summoning array appeared.
As he summoned, the white research coat he was wearing fluttered in the wind.
“Yes, I’ve done it.”
“I successfully used a fossil from the Mythical Era to revive the Mythical Phantom into the modern era in the form of a mechanical god.”
“The exact time of the Mythical Revival was analyzed by it.”
On the purple array, a deer-like white body slowly appeared.
On its body, green patterns condensed into cloud-like hair, reflecting the image of the wind. Its entire body was like the embodiment of the wind, and its head was petite, gentle, elegant, and beautiful.
“This creature is the Kirin Race of the Mythical Era. It’s known as the Wind Kirin of the three Mythical races in the east along with the Dragon and Phoenix!”
At this moment, after seeing this creature, most of the people present opened their mouths wide.
They couldn’t believe their eyes.
He did it?
Shi Yu said that he did it?
In Dong Huang’s seat, Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and the others had excited expressions, especially Principal Feng. He shouted in his heart. Look! This was Dong Huang’s archeologist! Ridiculous!
“How is this possible!” Shen Feng’s mechanical legendary, Z, was the first to not believe it. He couldn’t believe that the fossil recovery device could even revive divine beasts.
It even made Shen Feng’s mechanical legend so anxious that he directly tore through space. Just like the Glory Hero King just now, it descended to the scene and observed this Wind Kirin solemnly.
“You said that it revived from a Mythical fossil, so its current race level is..?” The Shen Feng mechanical legend stared at the Wind Kirin with a burning gaze.
More than 20 million energy points should be a monarch-level normal state. This energy level was not enough to shock the Shen Feng mechanical legendary. He could also casually modify a monarch-level mechanical life form with a normal state that exceeded 20 million energy points.
What concerned him more was the race level of this Wind Kirin!
At this moment, Shi Yu completely didn’t expect the mechanical legendary of Shen Feng to suddenly appear. His heart immediately skipped a beat, but then he looked straight at the other party and said, “Unfortunately, it can’t compare to the complete Wind Kirin. When it revived, the power it inherited was pitifully small. Its skills were severely lacking, and it didn’t inherit any divine skills at all. However, the exact time of the Mythical Revival was indeed analyzed and sensed by it.”
Everyone looked at the Wind Kirin in silence.
That… should be close to a Mythical race, right?
Just like how the racial levels would decrease when the ancient Tyrant Dragons revived.
If he wanted to revive a divine beast, it was impossible for the racial power to still be mythical through the fossil.
Above high-level overlords, quasi Mythical races should be enough.
But even so, it was very terrifying.
It was actually true… The revival had succeeded.
How terrifying was the fossil recovery technology!
At this moment, the archeologists of Shen Feng were filled with regret.
They didn’t understand why they didn’t cherish fossils.
Shi Yu was actually right. Normal revival of divine beast fossils meant that the quasi Mythical race was the cap. The reason why Ling could evolve and break through to the Mythical race was not because of the fossil revival, but because of the special skill “Mythical Revival”!
Without Mythical Revival, there was no Wind Blessing, so there was naturally no Mythical race.
But at the scene, there were also people who understood, such as the mechanical legendary, the Elven Empress, President Lin, and a few other experts. They knew very well.
This was a real Mythical race!
However, there were many people here. Before knowing the rules of the World Tournament, this information naturally had to be used as a trump card.
“In the world competition, if Shi Yu uses the Wind Blessing, Z and the others will be shocked.”
The Elven Empress said to herself.
“If Senior Z thinks that this can’t be evidence, it’s alright. When the world competition starts, you can further verify it from Lord World Tree. Lord World Tree should have awakened this time to deal with the upcoming Mythical Revival.”
“If the Wind Kirin can sense it, so can the World Tree, the clone of the planet’s will.”
...
“Seven years. I think this number will also be uttered by Lord World Tree.”
“Before we obtain the verification of the World Tree, you can pretend that I didn’t say anything,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
In other words, if he obtained verification from the World Tree, the Mythical resources couldn’t be lacking.
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu so confident, the various legendaries and presidents had shocked expressions.
There were still seven years until the Mythical Revival?!
Seven years later, demigods and legendaries would have a chance to break through to the Mythical stage?
Crack!
At the same time, as Shi Yu started to talk about myths, legendaries tore through space one after another and arrived at the scene, staring at Shi Yu.
The seven legends descended together, making the archeologists present feel a little suffocated. Their eyes widened.
“This information is indeed extraordinary.”
The Rongguang Hero King looked at Shi Yu solemnly and glanced at the mechanical legendary Divine Source. “If you can obtain verification from Lord World Tree, you will definitely have a share of the rewards for Mythical resources.”
...
At this moment, since the legends had spoken, the other archeologists and presidents of the association naturally didn’t dare to push it.
At the same time, they cursed their mechanics in their hearts again. Why was he so fast?
They still couldn’t replicate Dong Huang’s fossil recovery technology for a long time.
It could actually… revive the biological phantom of the Mythical Era?!
The archeologists present looked at the Wind Kirin with jealous eyes.
Looking at this perfect creature…
At the same time, they looked at this young man in horror. No one expected that the prophecy he made at the Dong Huang Mechanical Conference a few months ago would be verified in such a short period of time.
If what Shi Yu said just now could still be true, Shi Yu was definitely a name that couldn’t be avoided in the future in the archeological field.
However, after becoming a prophet, Shi Yu still didn’t want to end it. He still wanted to say something.
He said, “Then seniors, I’ll continue?”
Everyone was stunned. There was… more?
Shi Yu’s expression was calm. This was only the beginning. This was only one of the many information pieces he had obtained from Qi. Apart from that, he, Buggy, and Ling had yet to explain the reason for the destruction of the Mythical Era.
Also… after Buggy evolved into a green dragon and worked hard for a day, he and Buggy finally entered the dream of that mysterious fossil. They finally saw the main body of this Mythical creature clearly. Through here, they also obtained relatively explosive information. Otherwise, why would he be so weak now?

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 882 Legendary Archeologist (1)
chapters.content:
882 Legendary Archeologist (1)
“A new Mythical Era might come in seven years.”
“But actually, I’m more willing to believe that this is fake.”
At the venue of the Glory World archeological Exchange.
Shi Yu first predicted the time of the Mythical Revival before speaking in front of everyone.
!!
The information he had just mentioned was not just limited to the legendaries of the countries stuck at level nine.
Even archeologists of different ages at the scene were very concerned.
The reason was very simple. If this was true, they were witnessing a major historical change!
Various ruins showed that during the Mythical Era and even the early totem era, the human race didn’t exist.
Humans didn’t make it in time. Until now, there wasn’t a single divine-level life form.
Then, if the Mythical stage revived, would it be possible for humans to give birth to their first Mythical Beast Tamer?
Was it possible for them to know this person? Everyone was looking forward to it.
However, Shi Yu’s next words made everyone fall silent again.
He had just predicted the time of the Mythical Revival, and now he was saying that his hope was fake. What was going on?
“Everyone, please look here.” Shi Yu inserted a chip into the technological device in front of him.
In the next moment, an image appeared on the screen.
It was a barren world. On the barren ground, the figure of a creature appeared.
Everyone realized that this figure was the mechanical phantom beast, the Wind Kirin, beside Shi Yu.
Or rather, the mechanical phantom beast, the Wind Kirin, looked exactly the same as the creature in the scene.
“This is…”
Archeologists who were familiar with the mechanical phantom beast system quickly determined what this was.
It should be the dream memory of an ancient fossil!
“This is the dream memory of the mechanical phantom beast,” Shi Yu said.
As expected, Shi Yu’s words confirmed this.
Everyone quickly discovered that in the scene, the Kirin Race, known as one of the three Mythical races of the east, was actually fleeing.
It looked extremely panicked, as if there was a terrifying existence behind it.
The scene changed. In the next moment, the image of the creature chasing it appeared.
Its appearance looked to be made of many different species. It had a purple-red ant-like body and was extremely huge.
Every hand and foot looked like the limbs of a dragon. At the end were sharp dragon claws, and its face was as ferocious as a demon. Under its blood-red eyes were rows of sharp white teeth and green saliva.
On its back, there were also four pairs of long and huge sharp purple-red thorns, looking extremely terrifying…
Bang, bang, bang…
Seeing this creature’s extremely uncoordinated terrifying image, many people felt physiological discomfort and their hearts skipped a beat.
“GOD… What’s this!!” A yellow-haired archeological old man muttered. This was the first time he had seen such an uncomfortable creature.
“It… is chasing after the Wind Kirin?!” Shen Feng’s mechanical legendary was stunned.
If this was the fossil dream memory, then the Wind Kirin in the dream memory was definitely a real Mythical race. It was far more complete than Shi Yu’s revival. However, even such a creature, a creature with the background of a Mythical race, was actually being chased?
Then was the one chasing it… also a divine beast?
“This creature is called ‘Space Worm’. It’s an extremely terrifying invasion species for other life planets.”
“They’re born with ‘quasi-divine skills’ that contain the ‘devouring law’. They’re considered a Mythical race. Like the Dragon, the Phoenix, and the Kirin, their race is overall a Mythical race. However, compared to other Mythical races, the ‘starry sky worm’ has a terrifying characteristic like the other bug-type creatures on our Blue Planet.”
“That is, its reproduction ability is extremely strong!”
“They have a strong appetite. They can quickly digest food with very high energy levels through ‘devouring skills’. It’s not impossible to digest the corpses of other Mythical races and divine beasts as food.”
“The most terrifying thing is that after they eat divine beasts, they can also complete their evolution and display the merits of other species on their bodies, which is to optimize their race! Apart from that, they can also store the nutrients they devour in their bodies and carry out the next generation’s reproduction, letting the next generation’s ‘starry sky worms’ inherit the merits of the creatures they swallowed.”
“It can be said that… the end of the Mythical Era was to a certain extent because of the ‘Space Worm’. An extremely dazzling era was destroyed by a ‘weakest attribute’ of our modern world.”
Shi Yu looked at the many legendaries who had yet to walk away, and at the presidents of the various countries. He looked at the archeologists of the various countries and said, “According to the dream memories, the east at that time clearly had havoc wreaked by the Space Worm Race. Even the Wind Kirin Race was forced to be involved in the racial war.”
“This is a war between ‘predators’ and ‘food’.”
Most people opened their mouths wide.
They looked at the terrifying worm in the scene in disbelief.
“Wh-what!” When Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was stunned by the ridiculous racial ability of this so-called Space Worm.
How could such a creature exist?
The legends of Shen Feng, Rongguang, the Seven Islands, Xue Yuan, Ming Hua, and Tingxiang looked at the creature in the scene in shock.
No wonder it was an extremely terrifying invading species for other life planets. This ability was simply the enemy of all races.
Shi Yu said, “Not only that, but in the Mythical Era of Blue Planet, according to the Wind Kirin’s incomplete dream memory, there was more than one invader, the ‘Space Worm Race’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 883 Legendary Archeologist (2)
chapters.content:
883 Legendary Archeologist (2)
“If the ‘Space Worm’ is the ‘Devouring Worm of Life’, then there’s also the ‘Space Beast’ of the ‘Devouring Law’. It has the ability to devour the laws of a planet and can turn a planet life form with perfect laws into a dead star. They grow by devouring the power of laws. The height of the cubs is measured in ‘ten thousand meters’. A complete cosmic beast can even pluck the stars and the moon.”
At this moment, the figure of a huge beast appeared in the scene again. It towered into the sky and had a red rock body. With a stomp, the ground trembled and the mountains trembled. The terrain of a continent was instantly changed.
Everyone’s expressions changed.
“Although the dream memory is extremely incomplete, I suspect that the reason why the power of laws on Blue Planet is flawed might be because of the invasion of the ‘cosmic beast’ to a certain extent.”
!!
This wasn’t the end. Soon, the scene changed. It was a filthy world filled with darkness and pollution, like an abyss.
There was no trace of Blue Planet here at all, as if it was operating on another law.
“Apart from the beasts ‘Devourer of Life’ and the ‘Devourer of Laws’, the invaders of Blue Planet at that time also had the ‘World Contaminating Beast’. They had the ability to turn an area of life, be it the environment or life, into their own race. If the purpose of the ‘Space Insect Race’ invasion is to devour life, complete evolution, and reproduce, and the purpose of the ‘Space Beast’s invasion is to devour planets, destroy planets, and grow… Then the purpose of the ‘World Contaminating Beast’ is to transform other life planets into new homes suitable for their own survival and colonize the entire starry sky.”
“The Abyss Sea might be the representative of this faction.”
“Many archeologists have guessed if they encountered any external enemies at the end of the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era. And now, I can confirm that there’s no mistake. Moreover, they encountered invaders from outer space with unimaginable strength. I don’t know if they were on the same side, but in that era, the native lives of Blue Planet must have experienced an extremely tragic battle.”
“Even Blue Planet fell asleep because of this.”
“The reason why I don’t have any expectations for the Mythical Revival seven years later is that when Blue Planet regains the huge life resources and law resources from the Mythical Era, will the invaders from outer space invade Blue Planet again?”
Shi Yu’s expression was extremely serious.
Everyone’s expressions changed.
Even the expressions of the mechanical legendary and President Lin changed slightly.
Previously, Shi Yu had also mentioned to them the reason for the destruction of the Mythical Era.
However, there were no such details at all.
Even the racial information of the invaders was very clear to Shi Yu.
It looked like Shi Yu’s research had probably made new progress.
This progress was undoubtedly very shocking.
The people of Dong Huang trusted Shi Yu very much, so they naturally didn’t think that Shi Yu was lying.
If it was true…
If the invaders that had been destroyed in the Mythical Era could descend again, the current Blue Planet would definitely not be able to resist.
Including humans and all other species, they would become food for the Space Worms, provided that the Space Worms took a fancy to their inferior food that had yet to reach the “God Domain”.
The entire Blue Planet would be swallowed by the cosmic beast. Now that the “divine battle power” was scarce, there were probably not many native life forms on Blue Planet who could protect their home planet.
These sounded distant, but when combined with what Shi Yu had just said about “mythical revival, there are only seven years left”, everyone’s hearts immediately thumped, as if it was the countdown to the end of the world.
“This kid…” Principal Feng’s face trembled. Why didn’t he tell him in advance about such a big matter?
It was over, the end of the world? He had yet to hug his nephew.
At the side, Lu Qingyi’s expression was also solemn. It was difficult to imagine Shi Yu’s heavy mood when he learned of these things.
All the archeologists’ expressions changed, stunned by this news.
The presidents and legends of the various countries had bewildered expressions. They looked at this young archeologist, not knowing if what he said was true.
“Regardless of whether these enemies will invade again in the future, I think we should prepare.”
“Of course, this kind of thing can only be verified with ‘dream memories’. Although I think it’s enough, it concerns the fate of the entire planet. It’s worth verifying again.”
“Just like the ‘seven-year time limit’, as a clone divided by Blue Planet, the World Tree definitely knows this. This World Tournament reveals something strange. Why did only the humans of the seven countries participate in the previous years? And this time, they let the various hostile factions go to Inatella together. There must be a crisis that’s about to affect all the lives of Blue Planet. That’s why it’s worth the World Tree doing this.”
“I think this matter, including the three invading races, can also be verified with the World Tree,” Shi Yu said.
At this moment, the hearts of many archeologists tightened.
If there were still people who felt that this disaster theory was too strange and unreal just now, why did it coincidentally happen to be in their era? But now, combined with the actions of the World Tree, they couldn’t refute it at all.
Yes, this world competition revealed something strange. It was clearly a sign that something big was about to happen.
At that moment, they felt that the person standing on the stage was no longer an ordinary archeologist. How could he say this so calmly?

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 884 Legendary Archeologist (3)
chapters.content:
884 Legendary Archeologist (3)
If the two archeological results Shi Yu mentioned just now were verified, the fossil recovery system would become the greatest invention. Shi Yu himself would definitely become a legendary archeologist in the future.
“We will also verify this with the World Tree,” the Rongguang Hero King said with a serious expression.
At the moment, even the way the Seven Islands Valkyrie looked at Shi Yu had changed.
She didn’t expect that the little brat who caused trouble on the Seven Islands actually had such an unbelievable discovery in archeology.
“Next, I want to talk about the information about the faction of the third ‘Beast of the Contaminated World’ in the above-mentioned archeological discoveries.” At this moment, Shi Yu had no intention of going down at all. “Everyone knows that the Abyss Sea is said to come from outer space, but is there a possibility that their goal is not only the ocean, but also land.”
“In fact, in the ‘recent period’, this faction has already targeted Blue Planet again.”
“Ten thousand years ago, in the totem era, a meteorite fell from the sky and landed on the blue planet. A meteor the size of a city fell on the blue planet and evolved into a life form during the fall. After it evolved into a life form, its talent was terrifying. Soon, it had the strength of a totem level and slept in the east.”
“2000 years ago, its strength reached the peak. It called itself Yun An, modified the Yun race, and dominated the Eastern Land. It mastered the radiation curse law of the ‘incurable injury’.”
“Dong Huang’s second legendary emperor, Emperor Wu, died to kill Yun An. This history was discovered by me and has already been circulated in Dong Huang.”
“Similarly, in the west, the Mother Life Tree in the Tingxiang area was also polluted by an unknown pollution source into the ‘Dark Mother Tree’. Most of the elves fell into the darkness. Although the later ‘Dark Elf Race’ left and ended the ‘Dark Mother Tree’, this history is a major turning point in the history of Tingxiang.”
“These lives that contain the power of curse pollution have the same abilities as the invaders of the Abyss Sea and the Mythical Era. Can it be seen that they come from the same faction?”
“It’s better to say that they come from the same faction!”
Everyone’s expressions changed slightly.
“This was discovered by me and Lu Qingyi, the archeologist of Dong Huang.”
With that said, Shi Yu took out two pieces of dark flesh, a small bottle of black liquid, and a black leaf.
He said, “From left to right, these are the flesh and blood of the two totem-level generals of the Yun clan under the demigod Yun An. They were obtained by our Dong Huang’s recent hunt, and the liquid in the small bottle is seawater that contains the power of the Western Abyss Sea’s Abyss. It was also obtained by my archeological accident. As for the last leaf, it’s the leaf of the Dark Mother Tree. It was obtained by Dong Huang’s archeologist, Lu Qingyi, from exploring the ruins of Tingxiang.”
“After my research, the three powers come from the same source.”
“The research data will be attached later.”
“You’re also welcome to study it together later.”
“At least this means that the factions that invaded Blue Planet have never stopped watching Blue Planet. They have already begun to stir.”
Many archeologists had shocked expressions. The seawater of the Abyss Sea, the leaves of the Dark Mother Tree… How could they find such a thing?
Compared to the Mythical Era, Shi Yu felt that this kind of thing was a small matter, but he also hoped to obtain an additional legendary resource.
However, for these archeologists, it was a big matter that made them even more nervous.
The expressions of the Seven Islands Valkyrie and the Elven Empress changed slightly. They didn’t expect that the Yun Race and the Dark Mother Tree could actually be related to the invaders of the Abyss Sea and even the Mythical Era.
At this moment, various clues showed that what Shi Yu said was largely the truth.
Dr. Gufu, who had just gone on stage, had already had hundreds of millions of changes in his expression. He was completely immersed in Shi Yu’s story just now. Only now did he realize that what Shi Yu said was all incomparable and super heavy archeological discoveries.
If he obtained the confirmation of the World Tree and the promise of the Rongguang Legendary just now, didn’t that mean that the Mythical resource had already been reserved by this kid?
The other archeologists were also stunned and realized this.
Everyone was here for the resource reward.
Not to mention archeologists, even the presidents and legendary experts of the various countries had subtle feelings.
The reason why they took out so many rewards was to encourage countries to share information.
From the current progress, if archeological discoveries such as “The Mythical Revival Period”, “Information on the races that invaded from outer space”, “The reason for the end of the Mythical Era”, and “being spied on by the pollution source faction” were confirmed, it didn’t seem right for Shi Yu, who had come up with important information related to the Mythical Era and the future of Blue Planet, not to receive the reward of two Mythical resources.
Unless an archeologist could say more important archeological discoveries later, but… they felt that what Shi Yu said had already touched the ceiling.
Now, everyone also understood that the most expensive resources had already been locked onto by Shi Yu. Unless Shi Yu failed and his archeological discoveries were overturned.
Everyone’s mood couldn’t help but become serious. They instantly hoped that Shi Yu’s archeological discoveries would be overturned. It wasn’t because of Mythical resources, but because if that was the case, they wouldn’t have to face the possible disaster.
They didn’t want to encounter another disaster that happened in the Mythical Era in their lifetime.
Then, just as everyone thought that Shi Yu, this young man who might become a “legendary archeologist”, was about to go down, Shi Yu calmly took out another fossil.

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 885 Legendary Archeologist (4)
chapters.content:
885 Legendary Archeologist (4)
After moving it out, it was a huge machine the height of a person. From its appearance, it was the archeological machine Shi Yu had displayed at the Mechanical Conference.
However, this machine had already been upgraded by Shi Yu, Buggy, and Ling yesterday.
Everyone: “?”
What… was he doing?
!!
“I still have an archeological discovery,” Shi Yu said seriously. “It can also be said to be evidence.”
Everyone: “?”
F*ck, did he want to take all the rewards?
“The mechanical phantom beast, the Wind Kirin, was revived from a fossil from the Mythical Era, but the Wind Kirin in the dream memory is only a cub that hasn’t grown to the Mythical stage.”
“But this fossil…” Shi Yu held the fossil in his hand and said,” Its owner is a real Mythical creature! ”
“As a result, with the current technological ability, it’s impossible to revive it.”
“However, although I can’t revive it, I still obtained a lot of important information from its dream memory!!”
“At the same time, some dream memories also confirm many of the above discoveries.”
Everyone widened their eyes.
“He succeeded??” Principal Feng was stunned. This fossil had also developed results!!
After all, Dr. Mei Xiuying and the others had yet to develop any results with the help of the top-notch AI!
“The fossil of a real divine beast?!”
The expression of the mechanical legendary of Shen Feng had already changed many times. He looked at the mechanical legendary in his heart.
He seemed to have underestimated the fossil recovery technology.
This thing could really touch the domain?
How was that possible!
At this moment, the Shen Feng mechanical legendary looked at Shi Yu and had the urge to kidnap Shi Yu back to Shen Feng.
At this moment, Shi Yu placed the Mythical fossil and activated this upgraded fossil archeological device.
In the next moment.
Buzz.
The power of imagination appeared in the entire display venue, and an extremely unfamiliar environment appeared.
On the dry ground, red magma rolled. On the ground, a huge monster stood motionless on it, filled with the charm of history. Traces of time lingered, making people feel that endless time had already begun to reverse. It was actually a dragon hundreds of meters tall!!
Its body seemed to be watered by the deep power underground. On its ancient earth body, hot power rolled and flickered. As it opened its brown dragon eyes, a pressure from the divine domain enveloped all life present.
Even the expressions of the legendaries changed slightly as they looked at this creature that looked like a “dragon” in shock. Its appearance was inclined towards a Western dragon, but it didn’t have wings. From the attributes, it was close to the earth element. This was the main body of the unknown mysterious fossil, a member of the dragon race of the Mythical Era, the Earth Divine Dragon that had mastered the vibration law.
Shi Yu and Ling couldn’t help but sigh. Little Ji was really damn lucky. This fossil was actually dragon-element, and it was earth-element. It had to be said that in an instant, Little Ji’s potential had increased to an extremely high level under Shi Yu and Ling’s imagination. If it could successfully fuse the phantom power of this fossil in the future, its divine-level potential would be stable.
“As everyone can see, this is a dragon that lived to the end of the Mythical Era and experienced a divine battle. It has reached the Mythical stage. It’s called the ‘Earth Divine Dragon’ and has mastered the ‘quake law’. It can easily cause earthquakes and volcanic eruptions that destroy countries.”
“From its dream memories, or perhaps it can be said to be an obsession, we obtained a lot of information worth taking seriously.”
“After the Mythical Era ended, a large number of divine beasts still survived.”
“However, at that time, the rules of Blue Planet were flawed. The nutrients of the world were no longer enough to support their survival. There were three paths waiting for them.”
“One is to leave the Blue Planet Space and head to the starry sky to find a new home.”
“Second, open an independent space, seal itself, and fall into a deep sleep. When the Blue Planet Mythical Revival happens, it awakens again.”
“Third, undergo continuous reincarnation and start from the beginning. When the Mythical Revival and the nomological memories are activated, it can also awaken again.”
“The three methods all had their own risks. At that time, the remaining divine-level creatures chose different paths according to their conditions.”
“Among them, it’s very difficult for the Earth Divine Dragon to leave Blue Planet or undergo continuous reincarnation due to the restrictions of its attributes, race, and the power of laws it controls.”
“Therefore, it chose to sleep. Although I don’t know if it can last until the Mythical Revival, this is the only way. However, one day, a meteorite descended from the sky and a huge asteroid collided with Blue Planet. Blue Planet’s space trembled again. Many sleeping Mythical creatures were affected and were heavily injured and died in their sleep, including the Earth Divine Dragon.”
“In the end, it can only appear in this era where myths are about to revive in the form of fossils because of the advantage of the earth element,” Shi Yu said slowly.
“What I want to say is that if the Mythical Era revives, a certain number of Mythical creatures that have survived the Mythical Era should awaken.”
“They might either awaken from the Mythical Ruins we excavated or awaken as reincarnations. Perhaps they will also return from outer space.”
“Although they were once native life forms of Blue Planet, we still don’t know their attitude towards humans and the current Blue Planet life forms. But if the conditions allow, I think it’s safer to maintain ‘friendship’. After all, we might have a common enemy.”
“By the way, in the Mythical Era, Mythical creatures also have racial levels.”
“According to the strength or number of people who have mastered the ‘power of the natural order’, they are divided into ‘low-level Mythical race’, ‘medium-level Mythical race’, ‘high-level Mythical race’, and ‘top-notch Mythical race’. The battle power of Mythical creatures is the same. It depends largely on the race level, or it can be said to be the strength and number of divine skills.”
At this moment, Shi Yu directly led everyone into the Mythical Era.
Looking at Shi Yu on the stage, everyone had an extremely complicated feeling.
It felt like from today onwards…
Blue Planet…
It seemed like a new chapter was about to begin.
From the moment an archeologist named Shi Yu saw a corner of the Mythical Era.
However…
“Who can stop this guy? Don’t let him talk. The more he talks, the more afraid I am…”
“Moreover, is he done? Is he going to finish the prize pool alone!!”
...
Many archeologists widened their eyes and looked at this young man. Was he an animal? Why did it feel like he had f*cking been to the Mythical Era!
….
At the same time.
Inatella.
At the root.
The consciousness of the World Tree woke up again.
“It’s starting soon.”
“The time is ripe. It’s time to tell the creatures of this era the truth of the destruction of the Mythical Era and the threat facing Blue Planet.”
“I hope they can accept this information calmly.”
It looked at the many Mythical ruins towering in Inatella and the Mythical creatures that were also reviving inside. In this World Tournament, apart from the resource competition between various transcendent races and the humans it thought highly of, it also wanted this batch of people to experience and understand the cruelty of the Mythical Era and the power of the Mythical Domain!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 886 The Eve of the World Tournament
chapters.content:
886 The Eve of the World Tournament
Through Qi’s memories, Shi Yu kept spoiling the Mythical Era at the archeological Conference.
In an instant, the archeological Conference was covered in dark clouds.
Speaking of which, the reason for this archeological Conference was that the countries felt that this world competition was a little strange.
They felt that the Mythical Era might be coming.
!!
Therefore, it was to let countries share known information.
They hoped to consolidate the truth through various information.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu directly couldn’t mess with everyone.
The meeting had just begun, and Shi Yu had finished explaining the goal of this exchange alone.
Moreover, it brought quite explosive news.
There were only seven years left until the Mythical Revival. At that time, the external enemies that had ended the Mythical Era would invade Blue Planet!
The countries thought about their archeological discoveries and fell silent.
Compared to what Shi Yu said, they were all unimportant details.
Not to mention the Mythical Era, most countries, such as the Seven Islands and Tingxiang, only brought archeological discoveries from the totem era.
Among them, it was already a very impressive result for Xue Yuan to be able to crack the cosmic ruins.
And this result was only a minor detail in Shi Yu’s archeological discoveries.
In an instant, these archeologists were not even in the mood to watch the world competition.
They only wanted to get verification from the World Tree.
Also…
Was the “machinery phantom beast system” really that ridiculous?
They widened their eyes and looked at the Earth Divine Dragon in the arena and Shi Yu in front of the Earth Divine Dragon.
At this moment, as Shi Yu spied on the Mythical Era, archeologists who were willing to believe Shi Yu, such as Dong Huang, were already trembling.
The seniors of Bureau 11 swallowed their saliva.
Some archeologists spent their lives just to restore the truth of history.
Among them, the various things of the Mythical Era were undoubtedly the most difficult pursuit. And now, someone had finally managed to peep in. Although it wasn’t them, they were also the first batch of witnesses.
Not to mention these archeologists, even these legendaries were moved.
“Divine Source, are these real?”
The Snowfield Battle God couldn’t help but ask Divine Source.
For Shi Yu to say this, it must have been verified by Dong Huang.
The six legendaries present didn’t believe that a superpower like Dong Huang would weave such a lie for just two Mythical resources with low functionality.
Moreover, it was a lie that could be verified with the World Tree.
“Of course,” Divine Source said.
If it were other archeologists, he might have doubts.
However, Shi Yu was different.
Divine Source was one of the few people present who knew. Shi Yu’s Wind Kirin was a beast of a Mythical race who had mastered quasi-divine skills.
Mythical race, monarch level.
Such a ridiculous thing had already happened. In comparison, what was wrong with spying on some fossil dream memories and understanding the Mythical Era?
It couldn’t be luck.
Moreover, what Shi Yu carried was also a luck-type quasi-divine skill!
This was a true Son of Luck.
The various legendaries present were also very serious.
Because if it was true, they were also about to witness the key moment in history.
Legendary-level people looked very strong.
In a single era, legendary-level was indeed very strong.
But in the entire history of Blue Planet, legendary level was only so-so.
Just in Dragon Palace City, there were more than a hundred demigod-level Dragon Gods who left behind the Dragon God Statue.
If all the factions were added together, there would be even more legendary/ demigod-level. There were countless of them, and there were very few who could leave traces in history.
And among so many legendaries, as legendary members closest to the Mythical Era, these legends present didn’t know if they had caught up to the best era or the worst era.
“That’s about all I have to say.”
Soon, Shi Yu finally finished speaking.
But the scene fell silent.
Before the legends of the various countries could say anything, the presidents and archeologists naturally didn’t take the initiative to speak either.
As the host of this World Archeological Exchange, the Rongguang Hero King was silent for a moment before saying,
“Thank you.”
“Dr. Shi Yu.”
...
“Because your archeological discoveries, good or bad, have greatly changed the fate of this world.”
On the stage, Shi Yu smiled and said, “Just doing my part.”
“After all, my childhood dream was to become an archeologist.”
“It’s my dream to change the fate of this world through archeological methods.”
“In addition, after the World Tournament ends, if these archeological discoveries are verified, I’m willing to share the ‘Fossil Revival Technique’ with the Seven Nation Alliance on an equal level to promote the world-wide Mythical archeological tide and help the entire world to welcome the disaster that might happen next.”
“What…?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of all the archeologists present trembled.
The presidents of the associations of countries like Shen Feng and the Seven Islands were also shocked.
What did Shi Yu just say?
He was willing to share the “fossil recovery technology” with the Seven Nation Alliance?
The countries had wanted fossil recovery technology for a long time.
...
But Dong Huang just didn’t give it to them.
But now… as Shi Yu said this, everyone’s expressions changed.
They couldn’t imagine that the creator of the fossil recovery technology in front of him would actually say such a thing.
Divine Source, President Lin, and the others had calm expressions.
This matter was actually the result of Shi Yu and the others’ discussion.
If a disaster was really about to happen, what Dong Huang needed to do was quickly increase its national strength.
Although the fossil revival technology could become an inheritance foundation tens of thousands of years later…

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 887 The Eve of the World Tournament (2)
chapters.content:
887 The Eve of the World Tournament (2)
However, the forming period was too far away. Moreover, it could only deal with ordinary totem battles. Facing the Mythical War, it would definitely be powerless.
Why not share it and “equivalently” obtain a huge amount of resources from the Seven Nation Alliance that could increase Dong Huang’s national strength now?
For example, Mythical resources, Mythical fossils.
Of course, the most important thing was that the threshold for fossil recovery technology was too high.
Apart from the founder Shi Yu, who had Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Ling, the conditions for outsiders to use it were harsh.
Even with the support of a top-notch brainpower in the fourth bureau of Dong Huang, they didn’t develop that divine-level fossil.
After all, the top-notch AI was left behind by Divine Source.
In other words, the legendary think tank pet of the Divine Source was helping the fourth bureau study. Even so, there was little progress.
In the end, they still had to rely on Buggy, who had evolved into a green dragon, Shi Yu, who had max-level Psychic power, and Ling’s luck enhancement to spy on a portion of the Earth Divine Dragon’s dream memories. Moreover, they had yet to revive it.
Therefore, Shi Yu was even more certain that if the Mythical Era was seven years later, it was better to use the mechanical phantom beast technology to exchange for more Mythical resources to grow faster and better sit on the first bus of the Mythical Era.
Moreover, in the face of external enemies, the Seven Nation Alliance together was stronger. Only then could they deal with external enemies better.
At this moment, these archeologists didn’t know Shi Yu’s little plan. Even if they knew, because the “machinery phantom beast technology” crossed eras, everyone definitely felt that the value of this technology was greater than everything and Mythical resources!
They had literally just seen Shi Yu with a revived divine beast and even a divine beast phantom!
He even spied on the Mythical Era.
If they could obtain such supreme technology in the archeological field, they were willing to pay any price!
Some archeologists had different evaluations of Shi Yu just now.
Then, they looked at Shi Yu as if they were looking at the “archeological god”.
What a structure?
“Is what you said true?”
Shi Yu’s words stunned even the mechanical legendary of Shen Feng.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
At this moment, the legendaries of the various countries, including the Seven Islands Valkyrie, who originally didn’t have a good impression of Shi Yu, reassessed Shi Yu.
Perhaps this was a pure archeologist.
Only Dong Huang’s own people had strange expressions.
After all, this guy’s childhood dream was to become an archeologist?
Relying on archeological methods to change the world was his dream?
Why did Principal Feng, Lu Qingyi, and the others remember something else… Wasn’t Shi Yu’s childhood dream to be a Feeder, Mechanic, and Beast Tamer?
In the archeological field, didn’t Bureau 11 use 10 million yuan to seduce Shi Yu into the bureau willingly?
Forget it, it wasn’t important anymore. In any case, there weren’t many secondary positions left that could be Shi Yu’s dreams.
…
Initially, in the face of Shi Yu’s archeological discoveries, there were no longer many archeologists from other countries who thought that they could obtain resources.
At this moment, when he heard that Shi Yu actually wanted to share the “machinery phantom beast technology”, they were even less hopeful.
They understood that this archeological Conference had ended before it even started.
Shi Yu had completed the kill.
If nothing unexpected happened, the two Mythical resources would probably be directly divided by Shi Yu. In fact, several legendary resources would be divided.
Although there were still many legendary resources left that might not necessarily all be given to Shi Yu, they… looked in Dong Huang’s direction.
None of the archeologists from Bureau 11 of Dong Huang had gone on stage yet. What Shi Yu had just said was almost his archeological discovery alone.
Dong Huang was the strongest archeological country. It was impossible for Shi Yu to be the only one to make major archeological discoveries.
Therefore, they could already imagine how cruel the competition would be waiting for them.
At the thought of this, these archeologists fell silent. Fortunately, compared to legendary resources, they had experienced a new history and witnessed the birth of the “archeological god”. This trip was not a loss.
“This Shi Yu should also participate in the world competition, right?”
At that moment, even the legendaries acknowledged Shi Yu’s archeological talent.
The Snowfield War God, Vader, muttered.
There were many Inatella Mythical Ruins. As the trump card of the Dong Huang archeological world, it was impossible for Shi Yu not to explore them.
“Yeah.” Divine Source nodded.
“From the fluctuations of his summoning array just now, he’s still a level-six Beast Tamer. Even if it’s as Z said, he contracted an overlord above his level. It’s still too difficult and dangerous to participate in the world competition. Divine Source, during the world competition, I’ll ask our contestants to take care of him.”
At the legendary level, they were all smart people. The Snowfield Battle God understood. He knew that although Shi Yu had promised the mechanical phantom beast technology, the word “equivalent” was actually a little scammy. It was very subjective.
It all depended on Dong Huang’s mood.
At this moment, the better his relationship with Dong Huang and Dr. Shi Yu, the smaller the price he might have to pay.
How could he get closer to Dr. Shi Yu in the simplest way?
With Shi Yu’s strength, participating in the World Tournament was really a little difficult in the eyes of the legendaries of the various countries. If he wanted to explore the ruins, he probably had to rely on others to protect him. If there was a chance to save Shi Yu’s life or help, they might be able to freeload the mechanical phantom beast technology.
“…” Divine Source.
He didn’t want to say anything.
Take care of Shi Yu?
...
Was it referring to how to show off by “taking care of Shi Yu”? Were they… trying to grasp the opportunity?

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 888 The Eve of the World Tournament (3)
chapters.content:
888 The Eve of the World Tournament (3)
…
Shi Yu followed his plan and participated in the archeological Conference.
Then, he returned to rest. He was really tired.
In order to study the Earth Divine Dragon fossil, he had consumed a lot of energy yesterday. In addition, he had received some memories from the Mythical Era through the memory water drop. Shi Yu even had a nightmare yesterday!
He only wanted to rest now.
Of course, he definitely wouldn’t miss the archeological discoveries of other countries.
The archeological conference was in progress.
At this moment, the participants of the seven countries, be it the contestants of the World Tournament or the archeologists, had naturally arrived at the Kingdom of Glory.
Apart from archeologists and contestants…
There was also a considerable number of spectators from various countries who were about to arrive.
World Tournament audience.
These spectators were all relatives, friends, supporters, and interests of the contestants.
There were also some lucky people who spent a huge price to apply for the “qualification to watch the battle” from the Dong Huang Association.
In the previous world competitions, apart from a certain number of participants, the World Tree also allowed them to bring a certain number of spectators.
These spectators hoped to see the results of the world competition immediately.
At this moment, in Dong Huang, as the World Tournament approached, the nearly ten thousand spectators had already gathered.
Among them, Shi Yu knew many people.
Senior Panda and her daughter, the beast-eared girl, and the others were all here.
Even the genius Beast Tamers of the new generation of Dong Huang, Yin Zhengfan, Yu Shu, and the others, as well as those geniuses from Sequence 11 to 100, wanted to go to Inatella to watch the battle and make up for their failure to be nominated.
As for the lineup escorting this audience team, it was also quite luxurious. Apart from the Tyrannical Sea Legend and the other sea battle experts, there was also the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City and several Dragon Kings.
In order to protect Shi Yu, most of the Dragon Kings in Dragon Palace City also came to watch the world competition as spectators of Dong Huang.
Although they didn’t participate in the world competition, it didn’t stop them from coming to watch the commotion.
At this moment.
In the huge ruins space of Inatella, the Dong Huang audience who came discussed the “Green Dragon incident” a few days ago the most.
There was even an expert like the Tyrannical Sea Legend who asked Dragon Palace City if he knew anything, but the answer he obtained was that they didn’t know anything.
“Green Dragon.”
“Back then, His Majesty Emperor Wu had four pets that evolved into the four Holy Beasts, the Green Dragon, the Vermillion Bird, the White Tiger, and the Black Tortoise, respectively. However, they all failed. Although they could also be called quasi Mythical races and were extremely powerful, they couldn’t develop a faith skill that could resonate with the Green Dragon’s faith tool.”
“If it had succeeded, I believe His Majesty Emperor Wu’s final trump card won’t be the Demon God Iron-eating Beast, but them.”
Senior Ji Mengzhu of the Emperor Wu Era told Senior Panda and the others the difficulty of evolving into a green dragon. That was a goal that even Emperor Wu didn’t achieve through Mythical resources.
Therefore, it was very difficult for Ji Mengzhu to imagine that someone could actually resonate with the Green Dragon faith equipment in Dong Huang.
“So powerful… Who exactly can it be?” Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu sighed.
Everyone was extremely puzzled.
Even the Dragon God was no exception.
After receiving the news from the Sea Dragon King and the others, she was also looking at the starry sky and thinking about who it was.
This was actually very bad.
In the territory of Dragon Palace City, there was actually a group of dragons who believed in the Green Dragon.
As a fictional god, if the Green Dragon really was believed in and became a spirit with potential, even the Dragon God felt that she was inferior.
If this creature that evolved into a green dragon aimed at the Dragon God Deity Position in Dragon Palace City, the Dragon God was worried that there would probably be another storm of blood.
At the moment, the forces of the seven countries were gathered in the outer sea of Inatella Island.
Apart from the seven countries.
The factions of the totem country also arrived nearby as the time of the World Tournament approached.
From the Dark Night Forest, the Dragon Empire, the Demon Nation, the Arctic Snowfield, the Infinite Sea, the Void Court, and nearly ten demigod-level factions…
From the Heavenly Fox Nation, the Divine Tree Nation, the Yamata Nation, the Giant Ape Nation, and nearly a hundred other normal totem countries responded to the World Tournament and arrived at Inatella.
These factions were actually only a portion of the life factions on Blue Planet. After all, there were still many factions who didn’t respond to the World Tournament because there were no humans.
Together, the scale of these factions’ participation was even larger than the last totem battle.
However, at this moment, these complicated factions with various contradictions didn’t have any friction in the Outer Sea of Inatella. The unexpected calm was like the calm before a storm.
…
After the archeological Conference ended, Shi Yu originally wanted to rest more. After all, there were still many days until the start of the World Tournament mentioned by the World Tree at the start.
In the past few days, after resting, he planned to upgrade ginseng baby’s plant control as much as possible.
He made a simple calculation. The chances of reaching transcendent might not be high, but it shouldn’t be a problem to get close.
However, to Shi Yu’s surprise, the sealed Inatella Island suddenly opened. Green tree worms came to the outside world one after another.
Regarding these green tree worms that looked like vortex worms, be it the seven human countries or the totem countries, they were not unfamiliar.
This was the emissary of the World Tree’s split, or it could be said to be a clone of the World Tree!
A year ago, it was these World Tree Worms who informed the countries about the world competition.
...
At this moment, Inatella opened and the World Tree Envoy returned. Clearly, the World Tree had important information to inform.
“Shi Yu!!”
Shi Yu, who had just come out of the ruins and was about to eat, was immediately summoned by President Lin.
Apart from him, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Lu Qingyi, and the other nine Sequences were also summoned by President Lin.
In the huge conference room, President Lin looked at the ten Sequences in front of him and said, “The latest information is that Inatella Island has opened.”
“The envoy of the World Tree came out to transmit new information.”
“It’s asking everyone to enter the island.”
“It’s about to announce the rules of this world competition.”
“In addition, because the number of participants this time has exceeded its expectations, it plans to carry out the preliminaries first. It will carry out a preliminaries for Beast Tamers who have yet to reach level-seven. Before the main competition, it will screen the participants with unqualified battle power.”
With that said, President Lin looked at Shi Yu, Ji Feng, Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, and the others.
Shi Yu : “…”
...
“The envoy of the World Tree revealed the content of the preliminaries. The difficulty is not low. Even you guys need to prepare.”
“It will create an elemental life clone with the battle power of a top-notch overlord and act as the guardian. Beast Tamers below level seven can only participate in the main competition by defeating this.”
“Actually, this is also a good thing. Perhaps it means that there’s a huge opportunity in the main competition.”
Upon hearing that, the expressions of Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, and the others changed. Fighting a top-notch overlord… These were the preliminaries?!

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 889 Shi Yu’s Name
chapters.content:
889 Shi Yu’s Name
Only by defeating elemental life forms with the strength of top-notch overlords could they pass the preliminaries and participate in the main competition with other legends!
President Lin looked at Shi Yu, Ji Feng, Zou Yun, and Gao Xuan, the four contestants who needed to participate in the preliminaries.
Shi Yu was definitely not worried.
But to be honest, he was still a little worried about the other three.
Even some legend Beast Tamers might not necessarily win against top-notch overlords, let alone level-six Beast Tamers.
This might be a little easier for those level-six Beast Tamers in the totem countries who had contracted overlords above their level.
However, Beast Tamers of the seven countries actually rarely contracted pets above their level. In other words, Ji Feng and the others had to use six monarchs and their Beast Taming Talent to defeat a top-notch overlord.
Ordinary level-six Beast Tamers usually had the title of top-notch master and could temporarily fight against ordinary overlords.
It wasn’t impossible for relatively strong top-notch masters to kill ordinary overlords, such as Ji Feng of Dong Huang.
But top-notch overlords… This was another difficult challenge.
“Cough, cough, cough. It’s just the preliminaries. Do they have to be so fierce?” The little fatty, Zhou Ming, who had reached the legend level, coughed dryly.
“This is also normal. If you can’t even pass this preliminaries, even if you compete with the legends of the totem country, your life will be in danger,” Ye Xing said with a calm expression.
“Yes.” President Ye looked at everyone and said, “What’s more comforting is that the preliminaries will last for a week. During this period, every level-six Beast Tamer can challenge infinitely.”
“It doesn’t matter if you fail once. You just have to pass in the end.”
“During this period, Dong Huang will fully bear your treatment and recovery resources.”
Zou Yun and the others heaved a sigh of relief. If there were more opportunities to try and test wrongly, that would be alright.
If there was only one chance, that would really be hellish difficulty.
“What about the legend contestants?” Lu Qingyi asked. “If Inatella opens it now… Does that mean that the ruins above can be explored casually?”
President Lin said, “The information revealed by the World Tree Envoy is limited. The most important thing is to inform us when to land on the island. Perhaps after all the participants land on the island, it will give a specific explanation.”
“Next, you guys go and prepare.”
It could be said that apart from Shi Yu… Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, and Zou Yun were a little worried.
As for Shi Yu, he was already thinking about which pet to send to play with the guardian of the preliminaries.
Six against one? No. Although the rules definitely allowed everyone to attack together, for Shi Yu, every pet actually had the strength to defeat a top-notch overlord alone.
There was no need to talk about Eleven and Buggy. It was not a problem for Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling to fight a top-notch overlord.
It was just that he still didn’t know the strength of the guardian. As for which pet to send, it depended on whether this top-notch overlord reached the lower limit of his battle power or the upper limit.
For example, the upper limit would be the Dark Elven Prince Shi Yu encountered, the Flame Dragon King, and the lower limit would be the Green Scaled Dragon that didn’t have overlord’s will. The difficulty was completely different.
“In the end, we still have to wait seven days.” After hearing that it was only level-six Beast Tamers carrying out the preliminaries, Divine Bell sighed. She was wearing ancient clothing.
Zheng Hai, Jiang Tianyang, and the other legendary Beast Tamers smiled. It was pretty good to have more preparation time.
Lu Qingyi looked at Shi Yu, and Shi Yu also sensed her gaze.
Senior Lu’s gaze seemed to be saying that it was his “demonstration time”.
She knew very well that this preliminaries was not a problem for Shi Yu.
Shi Yu had defeated an overlord-level Void Mantis above his level.
Although Senior Void Mantis had just broken through to overlord, because of the comprehensiveness of its skills and the superiority of its attributes, it was not a problem to say that it was a top-notch overlord.
Although in the previous world competitions, no equipment was allowed, Shi Yu’s Buggy’s battle power was greatly reduced.
But that was before.
She had just heard from the gem cat that Shi Yu had contracted two overlords above his level!
One was Eleven, and the other was Buggy. They were both terrifyingly strong.
Although Lu Qingyi didn’t know exactly how strong they were, she could imagine their battle results when she recalled their power back at the monarch level.
Of course, even the gem cat that had seen Eleven and Buggy with its own eyes didn’t realize their limits.
It thought that the green divine dragon was transformed by Buggy with the Dragon of Imagination.
As for Eleven, it didn’t realize that it had already completely crossed into a Mythical race.
“Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, the two of you stay.”
After letting everyone prepare, President Lin finally spoke.
Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi originally thought that President Lin was going to talk about Inatella’s ruins.
However, it turned out to be to explain the reward of the archeological Conference.
“At the start, the rewards of the archeological Conference are expected to be issued within 30 days of the end of the conference. In other words, the seven countries will only distribute the rewards after the World Tournament. During this period, they will be used to verify the archeological results and discuss among the seven countries.”
“However, if there’s a chance, Dong Huang will try to apply for the reward in advance.”
“For example, if the World Tree verifies the reason for the destruction of the Mythical Era and if Blue Planet might face a great enemy, Dong Huang will try to apply for the two Mythical resources immediately.”
“Therefore, the two of you can tell me about the resources you need. Perhaps you can increase your strength a little before the main competition and use the rewards of the archeological Conference.”
On Dong Huang’s side, apart from Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi and the other archeologists also had archeological discoveries about the Mythical Era and the totem era.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 890 Shi Yu’s Name (2)
chapters.content:
890 Shi Yu’s Name (2)
For example, Lu Qingyi had cracked a Mythical Ruins. Her Mythical Revival and Shi Yu’s Mythical Revival could be said to have come from that ruin.
The greatest archeological discovery Lu Qingyi obtained from cracking this ruin was to prove that “divine power” could be passed down.
It could be inherited from Mythical creatures to ordinary transcendent creatures.
Both parties didn’t necessarily have to be related by blood, nor would their races have to be similar.
!!
As long as the divine beast in charge of inheritance was strong enough, it could transform divine power into power suitable for other transcendent creatures and pass it down.
This archeological discovery was also extraordinary.
It made the countries look forward to Mythical creatures even more, hoping to befriend them.
If they could obtain some inheritance, they would take off.
Therefore, although there was no hope for Mythical resources on Senior Lu’s side, she could still fight for legendary resources.
“I don’t have any legendary resources in special need here. Wind, water, dragon, phoenix, plant… They’re all alright. President Lin, you know the situation of my pets.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
Now, her Wind Demon Lion and Courtyard Sprite had reached the overlord level. The Mermaid Princess, the Imperial Concubine Flower, the Hurricane Demon, and the Green Spirit Phoenix were still at the monarch level. If she wanted legendary resources, firstly, she could continue to strengthen overlord-level pets. Perhaps she could strengthen them to the battle power of top-notch overlords. Secondly, she could nurture new overlords.
“Shi Yu, what about you?” President Lin looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu said, “The Mythical resource is the [Eternal Frozen Heart], [Soul Pearl], and [World Tree Fruit], right?”
“Two out of three?”
President Lin smiled bitterly. Then this guy should be choosing two out of three.
“Let me think. The [World Tree Fruit] is a must,” Shi Yu said.
The World Tree Fruit was a wood-element special resource. It could increase the pet’s comprehension and allow a pet to train a super skill to transcendent proficiency in an extremely short period of time.
This was actually very useful. Although Shi Yu could add points, there was a limit.
For example, he really couldn’t add quasi-divine skills at the moment and didn’t dare to.
Could he use the World Tree Fruit to increase the proficiency of the quasi-divine skill?
In addition, the essence of the World Tree Fruit was to increase comprehension. Training low, intermediate, and high-level skills was also effective.
The upper limit of those non-racial skills was transcendent. If he used the comprehension of the [World Tree Fruit] to train, could he quickly increase it?
Could it be more convenient to develop the mind domain if he ate it himself?
In short, as a Mythical resource, there must be something unique about it, or it could be an evolution resource for Baby Ginseng. They were both good choices.
“Yes.” President Lin nodded. He was not surprised by Shi Yu’s choice.
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu said awkwardly, “The ‘Eternal Frozen Heart’ and the ‘Soul Pearl’ are a little scammy.”
The Heart of Eternal Frost could strengthen ice-element demigods.
However, the time might be in thousands of years.
What a scam.
A pet with good comprehension might be faster?
Using it with the World Tree Fruit… maybe it could go about quickly becoming a demigod.
But how fast could it be? A hundred years? Decades?
It was better to directly use the Blue Sea Ruins inheritance to turn Susu to a demigod. Ten years was enough!
Or increasing points would be even faster!
It was useless.
Shi Yu didn’t want it.
The Soul Pearl was even more useless. Mythical remnant souls slept inside.
It was unknown if it was friend or foe, but it couldn’t be awakened.
Although he could let Chi Tong cut off and absorb it through the Spirit Release, after absorbing it, if it broke through to the totem level, Shi Yu wouldn’t be able to hold on anymore. It didn’t mean much. It was better to go to the underwater prison of Dragon Palace City to kill creatures. The risk would be much smaller.
It was better to increase points steadily.
At this moment, Shi Yu judged that there was most likely a god who had survived the Mythical Era sleeping in this soul pearl.
He wouldn’t disturb the other party. After all, he still had the Earth Divine Dragon and the Time Sprite to deal with.
Therefore, for the second Mythical resource, Shi Yu looked at President Lin and said, “I want to use a World Tree Fruit, but the ‘Eternal Frozen Heart’ and the Soul Pearl are not very useful to me. Dong Huang can apply for whichever one it needs more. I don’t want it anymore.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Of course, sir, if you feel bad, you can also exchange it for the Mythical resources I need or maybe legendary resources…”
President Lin : “…”
“What’s your suggestion?”
President Lin didn’t know when it started, but he also had to consult Shi Yu’s suggestion.
“I think that although I don’t know if the remnant soul inside the Soul Pearl is friend or foe, from the looks of it, it will most likely awaken after the Mythical Revival. We can try to take a gamble.”
“I understand.” President Lin nodded.
“As for legendary resources…”
Shi Yu said, “Wood, earth, light, wind, undead, fire, water, and ice. I won’t refuse those. As long as it’s relatively normal.”
When President Lin heard that it was to be prepared for Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling, there was naturally no problem.
“Alright, you guys go and prepare too. Shi Yu, don’t let your guard down.”
Shi Yu said, “I understand.”
...
….
Apart from Dong Huang, the level-six contestants of the other countries were also extremely solemn.
For example, the Ancient Kingdom of Ming Hua’s Karen, who contracted the Iron Bull King and had once been blown up by Shi Yu in the Dong Huang Demon Capital. The Seven Islands Nation’s Hundred God, who had once guarded the path of the champion, the number one person below the new generation of legends who had been blown up by Shi Yu. Even the eldest daughter of the Moonlight Family, from the Shen Feng Nation, who had been captured by Shi Yu, and the number one mechanical genius below the legends who had been blown up by “Lu Bai” with a single shot. They all had to participate in the preliminaries.

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 891 Shi Yu’s Name (3)
chapters.content:
891 Shi Yu’s Name (3)
They were even more nervous than Dong Huang’s level-six Beast Tamers.
After Shi Yu returned to prepare, he started meditating.
After a while, he received President Lin’s notice.
The participants of Dong Huang were going to land on the island together.
