Shi Yu opened his eyes and looked at Inatella. He took a deep breath and understood that the outcome of this battle would deeply affect his future.
Inatella.
The area here was very large.
However, at the moment, it was still empty. It was just a natural scene. There was nothing yet.
After the island opened, the seven countries and even hundreds of totem factions would enter the island.
Compared to the seven countries, apart from the big boss leading the team and the contestants, there were not many spectators in the totem country. At most, they brought a few and a dozen or so unrelated people.
There were fewer than a hundred people.
Not to mention Dong Huang, who had brought ten thousand spectators.
As expected, it was still human nature to watch the commotion.
In short, there were less than 100,000 lives. Although some races were very large physically, Inatella could easily accommodate them.
Not to mention an island, it could even accommodate some large-scale arenas in Dong Huang.
After landing on the island, because they were reminded in advance by the “World Tree” to not fight outside the world competition in Inatella, no matter where these lives came from, they stayed obediently at the moment.
In addition, apart from a small number of demigod factions, the other ordinary factions really didn’t dare to cause trouble. Who knew if they would accidentally provoke an expert and be beaten to death?
At the moment, in Inatella, it could be said that totems were everywhere, and overlords were inferior to dogs.
Demigod-level factions basically had at least one totem-level life form leading the team. There were more in countries like the seven countries.
“Gao Xuan, how’s your detector?”
After Shi Yu and the others landed on the island, they directly met up with the audience on Dong Huang’s side. They were also surrounded by members of the seven countries and separated from the totem country.
When they arrived at the island, Zou Yun asked Gao Xuan beside him and said with a depressed expression, “Mine is indeed useless.”
“No, the precision of the machinery is all interfered with.” Beside him, Gao Xuan, who was wearing a silver mechanical suit, shook his head.
He used a detector to test the energy value of the accompanying overlord, but it only detected “213”?
He looked at the guardian overlord of Imperial Capital University. The narrowed Prediction Owl, who had also come to watch the commotion, felt that the machine had completely failed.
No matter how lousy Senior Owl was, it was impossible for it to only have 200 energy points. Moreover, it wasn’t the only one. The other accompanying pets were the same. The data was erratic.
“Even your machine can’t…”
Gao Xuan said with a serious expression, “It’s more serious than I imagined.”
Because dozens to hundreds of legendary and Mythical ruins spaces overlapped inside Inatella, the island’s spatial magnetic field was turbulent. Mechanical lives and technology would be affected to a certain extent on this island.
This was what President Lin had reminded them before coming to participate in the world competition.
This was very disadvantageous for Mechanics!
However, for mechanical lives, it was usually fine as long as they adapted for a few days. It wouldn’t affect the battle too much. It was considered “unaccustomed”.
If it affected too much, the Mechanics of the Shen Feng Nation wouldn’t have obtained such good results in the previous batch. There were even people who won.
“Really?” Shi Yu thought to himself. He could still use his.
It was still their detectors or mechanical lives that couldn’t do it…
Shi Yu’s detector was actually Ling. Through his mental connection with Ling, it used its detection function to see the situation outside.
At the moment, Ling was completely unaffected by Inatella’s spatial magnetic field. It was unknown if it was because of its race or because of a quasi-divine skill.
“Just the spatial magnetic field is chaotic, but I haven’t seen any ruins.”
Lu Qingyi massaged her temples helplessly. It looked like… they were all ruins that had completely fused into alternate spaces?
On Inatella Island, it was chaotic, and voices lingered.
Just Dong Huang was chaotic enough.
There were too many people.
Shi Yu was currently following the participating team. They followed beside President Lin. Next, all their matters in the world competition would be directly connected to President Lin. It could be said that Dong Huang attached considerable importance to this world competition.
Although Shi Yu wanted to sneak into the audience more and bring Senior Lu to chat with the beast-eared girl and the others, it was clearly not appropriate!
“This island… is already filled with monsters.”
This time, Dong Huang’s “trump card”, Ye Xing, had an extremely serious expression. Even from an infinite distance, he sensed several terrifying auras.
He was alright, but some people had already started to worry.
Every contestant had a parent. At this level, if it weren’t for the fact that their strength was overwhelming, it would be very difficult to control their strength well. If a few important geniuses died, would these factions really not have a huge battle…
They were afraid.
“There are more than ten demigods, right? Moreover, it’s much more than ten. The number might have exceeded 15,” Shi Yu pursed his lips and said.
He looked into the void.
These demigods and most totems were in a space just like back in the archeological Conference, in an independent alternate space they had established.
They paid attention to the entire Inatella.
He wanted to know more now. As the strongest demigod acknowledged by the Dragon God, could the World Tree suppress this group of demigods…
...
“Jiu ~ ~ ~!!!!”
Just as various factions logged onto Inatella Island and the island was incomparably chaotic…

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 892 Shi Yu’s Name (4)
chapters.content:
892 Shi Yu’s Name (4)
A terrifying cry spread throughout the entire arena.
Under this cry, the entire Inatella immediately fell silent and looked at the black dot in the sky.
Then, the black dot grew larger and larger, and a huge eagle-like creature appeared in the sky.
It spread its wings wide, and its green hundred-meter-long body was displayed. The black feathers at the end of its tail and wings, as well as the black feathers on its crown, made it look very domineering and mighty.
!!
Its golden eyes were like the judgment of a god, sweeping with a powerful pressure that enveloped the entire Inatella.
The pressure on its body was the reason why everyone stopped talking.
Demigod level!
Even the totem level, including the gem cat and the frost dragon, felt the strong pressure from its body and revealed a serious expression.
This green eagle probably had the strength of a demigod.
“This is one of the clones of the World Tree, just like that green tree worm.”
“In the previous few world competitions, the World Tree used this clone to supervise and watch the entire competition,” President Lin said on Dong Huang’s side.
At this moment, as the World Tree clone descended, the surrounding void tore.
The legendary Beast Tamers of Dong Huang, Shen Feng, Xue Yuan, Rongguang, and the others appeared in different postures.
They also stood high in the sky, but they were shorter than the World Tree clone and looked up at it.
Apart from them, the surrounding void tore apart, and an even more terrifying life descended.
It was like a huge black dragon that was also more than a hundred meters tall. Its bright red eyes also emitted a terrifying aura. This was the demigod lord of the Dragon Empire.
The Dark Elven Empress, who was wearing a black dress and had a graceful and luxurious aura, also walked out of the void.
The demigod of the Demon Kingdom, the Lord of the Fallen Angels with a pair of huge black wings, held the Demon Scepter and looked at the World Tree clone.
The half-gods of the Arctic Icefield, Void Court, Endless Sea Region, Eternal Desert, Ghost Sea, Origin Land, and many other factions actually descended.
For a moment, the entire Inatella was even more silent.
The silence was terrifying.
More than ten demigods stood in the sky. The eyes of the weak, pitiful, and helpless contestants were filled with blood vessels. These… were all legendary lives. At this moment, they had actually all appeared.
The Arctic Icefield, which was on par with the Snowfield Nation, was there. Those that lived in the void, the Void Court, whose entire race was a spatial life form. There was the endless sea area, the Ghost Sea, the origin of the most common life species known…
It could be said that if these factions could join forces, there would be nothing the humans could do.
The reason why these demigods descended to Inatella was because they wanted to know what this world competition meant.
The will of Blue Planet had always favored humans, so even in the totem battle, most top-notch totem factions with demigod inheritances didn’t completely commit genocide on humans. Apart from the fact that humans were useful, it was also because of the World Tree.
And this time, the World Tree, which had been helping humans, actually invited them. This undoubtedly made these top factions on Blue Planet very confused.
“Welcome to Inatella.” A female voice that seemed to be able to encompass everything and nurture everything was transmitted by this World Tree clone.
This voice entered the hearts of every life form, instantly making everyone feel like they were bathing in a spring breeze. They felt like they had thrown themselves into their mother’s arms.
The World Tree was a clone of Blue Planet, and Blue Planet was the mother planet that nurtured all life. All the races on Blue Planet indeed had a natural affinity with Blue Planet.
It was precisely because of this identity and because they knew that the main body of the World Tree was the sleeping Mythical Mother Planet that even the high and mighty demigods in their domains were willing to lower their heads.
“Lord World Tree.”
Even the demigods were willing to call it “Lord World Tree”. Many ordinary foreign races below also looked up at this clone respectfully.
“Before the World Tournament starts, I have to tell you something.”
“Firstly, it’s about the time when the ‘Mythical Revival’ is about to revive and a new Mythical Era descends.”
The expressions of many lives changed.
Even at their level, the demigods of the totem country were shocked when they heard the World Tree’s words.
They were extremely incredulous and doubted their ears.
Wait a minute, did it really have to start the event with such an explosive thing.
What did the World Tree say?
The lives of the totem countries also widened their eyes. Including the seven countries, the audience and contestants also looked at the World Tree in extreme shock.
Mythical Revival? The time when a new Mythical Era descended?
All races pursued the secrets of the Mythical Era and had never stopped until now. Unfortunately, they couldn’t. And now… the World Tree actually said that the Mythical Era was about to revive?
Even the expressions of the legendaries and archeologists of the seven countries changed slightly. They looked at Dong Huang and Shi Yu.
“Lord World Tree… You mean… the restriction to break through to the Mythical stage is about to disappear?!!” The Genesis Tree God of the Origin Land said in disbelief.
The demigods present were all stuck at the legendary bottleneck. If the Mythical Revival happened, they would have hope of advancing to the Mythical stage!
After being stunned, the Rongguang Hero King asked, “Lord World Tree, is the descent of the Mythical Revival seven years later?”
The World Tree was just about to say that the revival of the Mythical stage was seven years later. The straightforward words of the Rongguang Hero King almost choked it.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 893 Shi Yu’s Name (5)
chapters.content:
893 Shi Yu’s Name (5)
The World Tree : “…”
The lives of many factions looked at the Rongguang Hero King.
What was this guy saying?
However, the next words of the World Tree made the others even more silent.
!!
“That’s right. The time of the Mythical Revival is about seven years later,” the World Tree said.
What the World Tree wanted to say could be said to have shocked the legends and archeologists of the seven countries who participated in the archeological Conference.
It really was seven years!!!
In that case, Shi Yu was really right?
At this moment, not only were the totem countries puzzled, but even the World Tree was very puzzled. How did the Rongguang Hero King know the exact time of the Mythical Revival?
The World Tree could conclude that even ordinary Mythical creatures couldn’t deduce the exact time of the Mythical Revival. If it wanted to know accurately, it had to be at least a high-level god proficient in spatial laws.
Such a god should still be sleeping now.
“Lord Hero King…” At this moment, the audience and contestants of Rongguang, including the Knight of Rongguang Lucille and Fu Dian, looked at the Hero King of Rongguang in admiration. Rongguang actually knew the exact time of the Mythical Revival long ago?
“After the Mythical Revival, the creatures that have slept since the Mythical Era will awaken. Among them, Inatella has a batch of gods sleeping.”
“There’s a segment related to them in this world competition.”
The World Tree clone said, “After the preliminaries, seven Mythical Ruins will open on Inatella Island.”
“These seven Mythical Ruins are all places where gods sleep.”
Gulp…
As the World Tree spoke, the people on Inatella Island were already completely stunned.
Especially the archeologists, who were completely stunned by the World Tree’s next words.
“And these seven gods have already been awakened by me in advance.”
Mythical creatures… woke up!
Awakened by the World Tree in advance!
Even Shi Yu was very surprised by this news.
He wondered what the rules of this world competition were.
“You can treat these seven ruins as an opportunity to improve yourself before fighting for the championship of the World Tournament.”
“Next, the seven gods will choose through their own methods in the ruins to choose Beast Tamers who meet their requirements and give them divine rites and even Mythical inheritances.”
As the World Tree finished speaking.
All the contestants who participated in this competition had slightly stunned expressions.
Originally, those level-six Beast Tamers who didn’t have confidence in the preliminaries were instantly envious.
Mythical inheritance?
At this moment, they had to pass the preliminaries no matter what.
“The seven ruins can be seen as seven tests, but there will be a certain restriction on the candidate.”
“If a god in the ruins is a master of the metal-element law, it will only allow metal-element transcendent creatures to participate in the trial.”
“Therefore, not every ruin trial can be entered casually. At the same time, even if the conditions for participation are met, the contestants can choose to participate or not. The ruins trial won’t affect the final outcome of the world competition. It’s just an interlude.”
“The seven ruins all have similar restrictions. Apart from that, the test methods of every master of the ruins are different. Some masters of the ruins want the candidates to fight the masters themselves who have yet to completely recover. Some masters of the ruins want the candidates to kill each other. They are all different test methods.”
“As long as you perform well in the trial, you can obtain the Divine Rite.”
“After seven trials, the World Tournament officially begins. The contestants who survive the first seven trials will decide the strongest among them.”
“This is all the arrangements for this world competition.”
At that moment, President Lin and the others never expected that there was no need for archeologists to explore the Mythical Ruins this time.
The World Tree actually woke up the sleeping divine beasts in the Mythical Ruins.
It woke them up to be examiners!!
Unbelievable.
And what kind of lousy example was the World Tree giving?
Wanting a trial challenger to fight a divine beast?
Even if its strength had yet to completely recover…
Were they sure they weren’t here to torture the challengers and let them experience the cruelty of the Domain of the Gods?
But no matter what.
The World Tree’s words ignited the hot blood of all the contestants.
Even Shi Yu couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows in anticipation.
A gift from a god… Mythical inheritance… There were Mythical resources in stock at the demigod level.
A gift from a real Mythical life form would at least be comparable to a legendary resource. A Mythical inheritance probably had to be comparable to a Mythical resource.
Otherwise, it would be too shabby.
Seven ruins trials. As long as one grasped it well, no matter which world competition contestant it was, they would probably be able to obtain huge benefits and increase.
In fact, the final outcome of the championship would change because of these seven trials.
...
However, according to the World Tree, the World Tournament had actually started from the seventh trial.
In some trials, the candidates had to go in and kill until it was the last person standing. This was already equivalent to eliminating the contestants who were competing for the championship.
If the competition for the trial was more cruel, most people probably wouldn’t be able to live until the official battle.
At this moment, the legendaries of the seven countries were also a little shocked.
They didn’t expect that in this world competition, it would actually be the turn of the real Mythical creatures to test the contestants.
The demigods and legends who were originally not interested in the world competition immediately didn’t want to leave.
No one had ever seen a real Mythical creature.
In this world competition, they had to see it no matter what. They had to see the difference between Mythical races and non-Mythical races.

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 894 Shi Yu’s Name (6)
chapters.content:
894 Shi Yu’s Name (6)
However, as the rules of the World Tournament reached this point, the Rongguang Hero King couldn’t sit still anymore.
Compared to the world competition, he was more concerned about another problem.
However, in the next moment, the World Tree really started to talk about this problem.
The World Tree said, “Perhaps you will wonder why this world competition is so different from the past. There are even seven divine inheritances as opportunities.”
!!
Many totem countries were indeed puzzled. This was the first time they participated in the world competition, and the treatment was already so exaggerated, making them feel a little uneasy.
“That’s because gathering all the lives with potential on Blue Planet now is to nurture more divine-level experts.”
“After the Mythical Revival, Blue Planet is also about to face a disaster. The guys who caused the destruction of the Mythical Era might make a comeback. And you were born in this era, the best era and the worst era. In the face of invasion, apart from the gods who are about to revive, you’re the only ones who can resist external enemies together.”
“A disaster that led to the destruction of the Mythical Era?”
“Invader?!”
As the World Tree finished speaking, the leaders of the totem country were shocked again.
Wait a minute, the reason for the destruction of the Mythical Era?
“The destruction of the Mythical Era, the severance of the divine inheritance, and the lack of world rules were all because of a divine battle on Blue Planet at the end of the Mythical Era. In this battle, more than 90% of the Mythical creatures died.”
“If the Mythical Era descends again, the previous invaders might also target Blue Planet again.”
“With the overall strength of Blue Planet now, it’s far from the Mythical Era. If another war happens, the only path waiting for Blue Planet is complete destruction.”
“The lives on Blue Planet will be completely destroyed.”
“Even if it’s demigod-level strength, it’s only equivalent to an admission ticket in the divine battle.”
The World Tree said calmly. It looked at the shocked people.
Looking at the shocked demigods, it wasn’t lying.
The reason why Blue Planet could repel the invaders the last time was that the factions that invaded Blue Planet had different destinations and conflicts between themselves.
Only then did they defeat all the invaders under the bravery of the divine beasts, causing the other party’s vitality to be greatly injured.
At the same time, Blue Planet, which was riddled with holes and had its laws collapsed, and Blue Planet, where Mythical creatures were almost extinct, was no longer the primary hunting target of cosmic beasts and cosmic worms.
But if Blue Planet recovered, no one could say for sure if these invaders wouldn’t look at them again.
With Blue Planet’s current level, who knew how long it would take the World Tree to recover to the level of the Mythical Era.
At the moment, it had placed all its hopes on the human race. It hoped to rely on humans to give birth to enough Mythical Beast Tamers to restore the prosperity of Blue Planet as soon as possible.
“Huh?” At the mention of humans, the World Tree clone suddenly looked at the legendaries of the seven countries.
This batch of human Beast Tamers who stood at the top of the human race.
They…
At this moment, these legends were all thinking and silent, as if they weren’t surprised by what they had just said?
“Dr. Shi Yu is strong.”
“He’s actually right.”
“As expected of the archeological god.”
“He actually expected everything Lord World Tree said a few days ago.”
The World Tree clone listened to the whispers of some archeologists in the territory of the seven countries and fell silent.
World Tree: “?”
At this moment, the Rongguang Hero King said again, “Lord World Tree, the external enemy you’re talking about… Do you mean the ‘Space Worm’, ‘Space Beast’, and even the ‘Abyss Evil God’?”
At this moment, the World Tree clone was stunned.
It had yet to say it, so how did they know?
There should no longer be any information about the Space Worm and the Space Beast on Blue Planet.
“‘Space Worm’, ‘Space Beast’, ‘Abyss Evil God’??” The totem clans looked at the humans with cold gazes. What exactly did the humans know? Why didn’t they know at all?
After a moment of silence, the World Tree said,
“I was originally worried that you wouldn’t be able to accept it for the time being if I said this, but from the looks of it, I was overthinking,” the World Tree clone said. “What you know is far more than I imagined. Looks like you’re already mentally prepared for this.”
“They were indeed the factions that invaded Blue Planet at that time.”
“It was also at that time that it was called the ‘Three Great Invasion Disasters’.”
Totem Nation: ???
No, they didn’t know!!!
At this moment, these totem demigods only wanted to know what the so-called “Space Worm” and “Space Beast” were!
“I want to know more how you know these things. You even know the exact time of the Mythical Revival.” The World Tree’s stomach hurt at this moment. It kept feeling that today was different from its plan.
“Lord World Tree, it’s the archeologist of our seven countries, Shi Yu. He has studied the history of the Mythical Era. During the Mythical Revival, the information on the three invasion disasters was all discovered by him.” The Rongguang Hero King was completely convinced. Everything Shi Yu said was actually verified by the World Tree.
In other words, everything was true…
“Archeologist, Shi Yu.” The World Tree clone repeated this name. This was the first time he had called someone by their name after appearing. As he called them, the demigods of the totem clans also chanted this name.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 895 Shi Yu’s Name (7)
chapters.content:
895 Shi Yu’s Name (7)
“He’s very powerful.”
Even the World Tree couldn’t help but say this. After all, it had seen countless experts who were just one step away from stepping into the Mythical Domain.
But they didn’t know the truth of the world at all.
But this archeologist named Shi Yu could actually see to this extent.
It was indeed very impressive.
“Where is he?” the World Tree clone asked, wanting to see who Shi Yu was.
The Rongguang Hero King was stunned. It looked at Dong Huang’s area from the sky and at the confused Shi Yu.
Shi Yu: “?”
In the seven countries, countless Beast Tamers were also stunned when they heard this name.
They kept feeling that this name was a little familiar.
Holy shit.
Dong Huang, the number one person below the legend who had developed the mechanical phantom beast system?
“Shi Yu?!” On the Seven Islands, the legendary master and disciple of the Phoenix Court were stunned. They looked in Dong Huang’s direction in disbelief.
“It’s him?”
Rongguang, Legend Fu’s family, were also stunned. That Shi Yu who had just finished eating with them a few days ago?
The contestants of Ming Hua’s World Tournament and the elven royal families in Tingxiang were suddenly stunned.
At this moment, even the gazes of the totem demigods followed the gaze of the Rongguang Hero King and looked at Shi Yu in Dong Huang’s direction.
Shi Yu, who was only 20 years old, appeared in the vision of these top experts on Blue Planet for the first time.
At that moment, Shi Yu was slightly silent. Not to mention these top-notch experts, around him, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Zheng Hai, Zou Yun, Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, and the others clearly looked at him in disbelief.
“Shi Yu…?” Even Senior Panda, Ji Mengzhu, the beast-eared girl, and the others were completely stunned.
“Holy shit.”
In the Dong Huang audience, Master Qu Jie and his daughter, Yu Shu’s family, and even Yin Zhengfan, who were watching the show, were originally very serious when they heard that the Mythical Revival and the invasion of external enemies. However, it was still very strange for them to suddenly watch the show on someone they knew.
Shi Yu was named by the World Tree?!
Shi Yu had long archeologically figured out what the World Tree said just now?
When did this happen!
At that moment, the World Tree clone took a deep look at Shi Yu and was also stunned. This was because it actually sensed various powers from Shi Yu that were not inferior to those top-notch hybrids. At the same time, it didn’t expect that the archeologist mentioned by the Rongguang Hero King was actually such a young man.
Was he also a contestant in the world competition?
The World Tree stopped looking and said, “That’s all I want to say. Next, the seven-day World Tournament preliminaries are about to begin.”
“I’ll materialize ten natural arenas everywhere on the island, each representing ten attributes. They can condense guardians of different attributes on their own. The contestants participating in the preliminaries have to choose their own challenge targets. In seven days, only Beast Tamers who successfully defeat a guardian are qualified to participate in the trial and the final battle of the Mythical Ruins.”
“Among them, the preliminaries also have a reward mechanism. It’s determined by the challenger’s potential. Using one pet to defeat the guardian is better than using two. Using two pets to defeat the guardian is better than using all the members to defeat it. Using several monarch-level pets to defeat the guardian at a higher level is better than using overlord-level pets to defeat the guardian.”
“This is a reward mechanism for the contestants of the preliminaries that is different from the Mythical Trial. I hope that the contestants of the preliminaries can display their potential as much as possible. Only then will there be more opportunities to fight for the next opportunity.”
As soon as the World Tree finished speaking, the audience below the stage erupted again.
On Dong Huang’s side, Ji Feng, Zou Yun, Gao Xuan, and the others had also recovered from their shock. They were already numb to what had happened to Shi Yu. It didn’t matter. At the moment, what was more important was what the World Tree had said just now.
There was also a reward mechanism in the preliminaries!
The more outstanding the performance, the better the reward.
Shi Yu also recovered. He felt that his gaze had shifted away. He sighed slightly. At the same time, he was quite concerned about the World Tree’s words.
If there was such a reward mechanism, he would definitely use a monarch-level pet to crush a top-notch overlord above his level. This way, the reward would be the highest.
Eh? Something was wrong.
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
One was definitely better than two.
Then what if… He didn’t use his pet and did it himself?
Shi Yu sensed his overlord-level physique, overlord-level spiritual power, and quasi totem-level soul power and fell into deep thought. This definitely didn’t follow the rules, right? After all, they were all Beast Tamers. Moreover, it was alright to fight ordinary overlords, but it was still too difficult to fight top-notch overlords without using the mind domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 896 Not Human Again
chapters.content:
896 Not Human Again
Boom ~
As soon as the World Tree clone finished speaking, while it was still flapping its wings, loud bangs appeared all over the island.
Inatella Island. In different natural environments, huge arenas rose out of thin air.
In the mountains, rock arenas rose from the ground. In the lake on the island, ocean arenas floated up, and arenas appeared one after another.
!!
The various factions on the island quickly looked at the arena closest to them.
“Ten natural arenas. It’s easier to challenge guardians of different attributes…”
At this moment, as these arenas appeared, the level-six Beast Tamers of the various factions heaved a sigh of relief.
If they could still choose the opponent’s attributes, the difficulty would decrease again.
After all, some Beast Tamers were proficient in fire. It would undoubtedly be much easier to choose a wood-element opponent.
“But according to the World Tree, the way to determine the potential of the participants depends on how the Beast Tamer wins. Victory against disadvantageous attributes will definitely show more potential than victory against attributes that the challenger countered, right?”
There were discussions on the island.
Closer to Dong Huang was a fire arena.
A huge red rock arena rose, making many Beast Tamers look over.
On the arena, a fire python purely made of dark red fire elements condensed. It was a hundred meters long and had a thick body. The flames formed snake scales, and a burning fire crown and snake eyes that looked like white flames appeared on its head.
“Roar ~”
A portion of the flaming python’s body stood up and opened its huge mouth. A shockingly high temperature bloomed from its body, making the entire red arena incomparably hot. Even the surrounding air was ignited by it, making the surrounding space extremely red, as if it had frozen.
Bang.
There were even explosive sparks sputtering on the body of the fire python, flying out into countless fire arcs. Every fire arc was wrapped in transcendent-level deterrence fluctuations. The strong deterrence directly changed the weather, making the clouds in the sky red like burning clouds.
The nearby Dong Huang audience looked at the fire python in the arena with serious expressions.
Those Beast Tamers below the master level who were close to the arena didn’t even dare to breathe loudly. They were all stunned by the deterrence of the python.
Transcendent-level deterrence… Most overlords couldn’t have it.
The legendary Beast Tamers nearby also looked at the fire python with serious expressions. Was this the guardian of the preliminaries?
“This guy…”
The overlord of Imperial Capital University, the Prediction Owl, flew in the air and looked at the fire python in fear.
It felt that the other party’s strength was even stronger than his.
Was Shi Yu and Gao Xuan really alright?
It prophesied for fun and predicted the outcome of Dong Huang twice. Gao Xuan would lose miserably.
As for Shi Yu, it was even more ridiculous. In the scene, all the pets seemed to have fallen. Even the Beast Tamer himself was forced to go and fight the guardian overlord. It was extremely difficult.
Swoosh!!!
The moment the flaming arena appeared, on the Dong Huang World Tournament team’s side, Shi Yu and the others teleported to the place closest to the flaming arena under President Lin’s methods.
Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Lu Qingyi, Shi Yu… One world competition contestant after another looked at the fire python with burning eyes.
“No…” Gao Xuan helplessly took off the detector and couldn’t detect the data of the guardian.
“At least, it’s stronger than my trump card,” Zhou Ming said. “I feel that I won’t be its match if I send out an overlord-level pet alone.”
“We have to have multiple pets attack together to have any hope of victory. All the best. This guy isn’t easy to deal with.”
“Just the same, its power fluctuations are even above my overlord-level pet,” Zheng Hai also said. “Even with the water-element strengthening talent, 1VS1 will be very difficult. However, considering the attribute restraint, perhaps I can give it a try.”
In the Dong Huang team, the legend Beast Tamers performed relatively easily, but this was a test for level-six Beast Tamers.
Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, Ji Feng, and the others didn’t feel that this fire elemental life form was easy to deal with at all.
The three of them had experience fighting overlords, and the power and might of this fire python was definitely one of the best overlords.
“This is already the best outcome,” Shi Yu, who was beside him, said.
Energy Points: 70 million
Ling’s detection method was not much affected. Shi Yu looked over. At least in terms of normal energy value, the other party was not high. It was inferior to the green-scaled dragon.
Since it was a created elemental life clone and not a complete life form, it definitely didn’t have the will of an overlord. It was very difficult to erupt.
The only advantage was that as an elemental life form, its ability to use the power of nature was definitely very strong.
Overall, it was just as Shi Yu had estimated. It was the lower limit of the battle power of a top-notch overlord. Its battle power was not as brutal as the Sky Penetrating Whale and the others.
Of course, even so, it was very difficult for level-six Beast Tamers.
“Although the number of challenges is not limited, the preliminaries are not short. We can wait and see first. We can see the guardian overlords of the other arenas and the battle process between them and other challengers before challenging,” President Lin said.
In the other arenas.
Elemental life forms of different attributes had different forms and were all in the form of pythons. There were wood-element treants, water-element divine dragons, wind-element giant eagles, and rock-element brown bears. These elemental life forms had different forms.
But at the same time, the moment they condensed, the transcendent deterrence wrapped around their bodies, including the natural power changes triggered, created a huge pressure on the nearby participating countries.

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 897 Not Human Again (2)
chapters.content:
897 Not Human Again (2)
“Every elemental clone has the battle power of a top-notch overlord.”
“The preliminaries for level-six Beast Tamers are already so difficult. The next Mythical Trial will probably be even more difficult.”
In the sky, the legendary demigods’ gazes landed on the entire island. They saw that the higher World Tree clones had already dispersed and turned into green tree bugs again outside the various arenas. They also hid in the void again, planning to quietly pay attention to the preliminaries.
Although the preliminaries weren’t very attractive to them, they were already here. They didn’t mind waiting a few days before the Mythical Trial.
However, most of them were legendaries and demigods who were more familiar with each other. They went to the deep space to communicate what the World Tree had just said!
Mythical Era would descend, and external enemies had invaded!
This was not good.
Most of these foreign demigods went to question the legendaries of the seven countries and ask them what else they knew.
“Sylphra.”
For example, the Dark Elven Empress of the Dark Night Forest, this high and mighty goddess in a black dress, stopped in front of the Elven Empress in Tingxiang and said with a smile,
“What do you know about the ‘Three Invasion Disasters’? Tell me. You don’t want the contestants of the World Tournament in Tingxiang to be injured during the competition, right?”
The Elven Empress of Tingxiang looked at the other party with a faint smile and said, “Speaking of which, I really didn’t expect the Dark Elves to participate in the World Tournament. After all, your Dark Elves are also products of the pollution of the ‘Abyss Evil God’. Even if you betray the Dark Mother Tree, it can’t change the fact that your blood is extremely dirty.”
The Dark Elven Empress’s gaze turned cold, and her entire body emitted killing intent.
…
The legendaries and demigods retreated. The World Tree clone turned into tree bugs again and spread outside the arena. It paid attention to the entire competition, representing the official start of the World Tournament preliminaries!
Be it the contestants of the seven countries or the totem country, none of them acted rashly immediately. After all, there was also a reward mechanism in the preliminaries. They definitely had to consider carefully how to challenge it to maximize the benefits before challenging it.
But it had to be said that there were many contestants with rougher ideas.
“The first to pass an assessment, and it’s a countered attribute battle. Does it count as having huge potential?”
On the earth arena, a lightning dragon circled in the sky. On its body rode a golden-haired hybrid Beast Tamer. Both parties descended together.
This pair of challengers was clearly led by the overlord-level lightning dragon, and the mixed-blood Beast Tamer on them was a vassal.
The lightning dragon, which was more than ten meters tall, spat out thunder. It stared at the earth elemental creature in front of it with the Beast Tamer servants beside it.
It was a huge bear made of brown rocks. It was also more than ten meters tall, and its entire body was wrapped in top-notch deterrence. Its gaze revealed a domineering expression as it looked at the dragon in front of it.
“It’s the Thunder Dragon General of the Dragon Empire…”
In the surroundings, the factions of totem countries of various sizes looked at the lightning arena when they saw someone from the Dragon Empire appear first.
“There’s a good show to watch.”
As a demigod-level faction, there were many overlords who wanted to participate, but there weren’t many humans.
The Thunder Dragon General was a top-notch overlord of the Dragon Empire. Its contractor was only a hybrid level-six Beast Tamer.
Unlike the Crown Prince, the Flame Dragon King, who had legend level retainers.
Many nearby factions were not unfamiliar with the strength of the Thunder Dragon General. Seeing that it was the first to go on stage to challenge, many factions cast expectant gazes.
The Thunder Dragon General was quite confident. Earth had a natural immunity to thunder, which was equivalent to having its own lightning resistance. Was it trying to use this method to make the World Tree look at it in a different light?
Although every arena was not close, the Beast Tamers who could come to Inatella used their methods frequently. Even if they were very far away and didn’t reach the scene, they could see the battle with their own eyes.
For example, on Dong Huang’s side, Legend Xiao Shuang, who had arrived at the scene, used the Eye of the Stars to synchronize the scene of the ten arenas with the methods of the Mechanic class to the nearby Dong Huang audience.
“There’s a challenge at the thunder-element arena. The challenger is from the Dragon Empire.”
In the Dong Huang area, many people looked at the huge screen in midair. As for the Sea Dragon King, the Ice Dragon King, and the other Dragon Palace experts, they directly flew into the sky and looked into the distance.
They were especially concerned about the situation of the Dragon Empire.
In the scene.
After the Thunder Dragon General went on stage, the Earth Desolate Bear immediately launched an attack. Its huge claws that could tear apart mountains wrapped in deterrence tore at the Thunder Dragon.
The lightning dragon roared. The hybrid Beast Tamer on its body directly fused into its body in reverse, causing the lightning dragon to erupt with stronger lightning power. Golden lightning instantly wreaked havoc everywhere, even triggering the descent of heavenly lightning.
However, the Earth Desolate Bear had no intention of dodging the lightning at all. Its rock body directly endured the lightning and continued to tear.
It collided with the dragon claws of the lightning dragon.
Crack.
In the arena, the Thunder Dragon’s dragon eyes were shocked. It sensed an incomparable power from it. The heavy power was like the weight of the ground and mountains pressing down on its body. In an instant, the Thunder Dragon felt its dragon claws break. Then, a huge gravity wave acted on its body. With a boom, the Thunder Dragon General was directly sent flying by the Earth Wild Bear. Its huge body shattered part of the arena and kept sliding on the arena.
“Idiot.” The heir of the Dragon Empire, the Flame Dragon King, was instantly unhappy when he saw the Thunder Dragon General in such a miserable state.
It clearly had the strength of a top-notch overlord, and there was also the Beast Tamer who could help it win against other guardian overlords through the support of the “Special Fusion Talent”. Why did it have to think of fighting against an attribute that countered it?

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 898 Not Being Human Again (3)
chapters.content:
898 Not Being Human Again (3)
Its lightning had little effect on the other party. Its strength had never compared to the Earth Desolate Bear that stood on the ground and borrowed the natural power of the ground to make its defense and strength incomparably heavy. Even the people of the Dragon Empire felt that the Thunder Dragon General was too impatient.
In the alternate space, seeing that its contestant was the first to challenge, the violent eyes of the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire… couldn’t calm down.
“This… won’t do.”
The clone of the World Tree, the tree worm that was paying attention to the Thunder Arena, also shook its head.
!!
As expected, compared to the way the totem countries used humans, the pattern between humans and pets was stronger in the seven countries.
Therefore, it didn’t like to bring the totem countries to the world competition.
Next.
The Thunder Dragon General, who was relatively famous in the Western overlord circle, was continuously suppressed by the Earth Desolate Bear. The battle only lasted for about five minutes before the Thunder Dragon General’s Beast Tamer couldn’t hold on anymore and exited the fusion state.
Similarly, the lightning dragon was also heavily injured and didn’t gain any advantage.
“Silly.” Seeing this, in the direction of Dong Huang Dragon Palace City, the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince revealed a disdainful expression. Seeing that the other party had the support of a Beast Tamer and was in such a miserable state, it was really ridiculous.
The Dragon Empire suffered a loss. The happy ones were naturally Dragon Palace City, Tingxiang Nation, and even the Dark Elves, the Thunder Dragon Crown Prince, the World Tournament contestants of Tingxiang, elves like Annie that Shi Yu knew, and the dark elven princes of the Dark Night Forest. They revealed mocking expressions.
However, through this battle, the contestants of the various countries became even more serious.
This battle showed many problems.
In an overlord-level battle, if they were evenly matched, it was not impossible to fight for days and nights.
However, the battle style of the Earth Desolate Bear condensed by the World Tree was very crude.
It mobilized the power of nature to strengthen his physique with all his might and mobilized his energy to the limit to release a big move.
It didn’t plan to fight for a long time at all. It didn’t mind the physical consumption at all. It didn’t carry out a detailed physical distribution, as if he planned to fix the outcome in a few minutes.
If the opponent could withstand it, even if the opponent won, the opponent would naturally lose if they couldn’t anymore.
As for the Thunder Dragon General, it clearly couldn’t hold on. Or rather, it could still fight, but the Beast Tamer it contracted couldn’t hold on anymore and directly fainted. For the safety of its contractor, the Thunder Dragon General could only admit defeat immediately.
After all, if the contractor died, it would be completely eliminated. Although it was a level-six contractor with compatible attributes and bloodlines, it was also very difficult. If it admitted defeat, it still had to find an opportunity to challenge again.
This battle made the level-six Beast Tamers of the various factions understand that these guardian overlords were really not weak. Even when facing top-notch overlords of the same level with the strengthening of Beast Tamers, they weren’t at a disadvantage at all. They mustn’t think of fighting against the opposite attributes.
At the same time, Beast Tamers were very likely to be the greatest burden to contestants who contracted overlords above their level. If they could not participate in the battle, they would not let them participate. At the same time, the contracted overlord had to protect these level-six Beast Tamers and not let anything happen to them.
After all, these Beast Tamers were the tickets for them to participate.
“F*ck, it’s even stronger than I imagined.” Zou Yun looked at the scene. The Earth Desolate Bear tore and flipped the Thunder Dragon’s hand in a few rounds and instantly fell silent.
It wasn’t easy for him to enter the top ten of the Sequence. He wouldn’t stop at the preliminaries, right?
Gao Xuan and Zou Yun had serious expressions. A top-notch overlord who relied on natural power to erupt from the start?
After watching this battle, even President Lin couldn’t help but say, “Don’t think about the rewards of the preliminaries. It’s good as long as you can pass. During the battle, remember to go all out and choose the attributes you’re most confident of resisting.”
“Yes.” Gao Xuan and the others nodded.
The main goal was definitely still the reward for the Mythical Trial.
However…
Jiang Tianyang, Zhou Ming, and the others saw that the preliminaries were already so difficult. It was very difficult to imagine how difficult the next Mythical Trial would be.
Could they really compete for the opportunity?
If they couldn’t compete and their strength couldn’t increase, there was even less of a need to think about the final world champion competition. Their results definitely wouldn’t be at the top.
“Shi Yu, do you want to prepare?” In the end, President Lin looked at Shi Yu.
In his opinion, there was no suspense in Shi Yu passing the preliminaries.
With that panda, it could probably instantly kill these guardians.
However, he believed that Shi Yu definitely didn’t want to expose his quasi-divine skill so early. He definitely wanted to leave such a trump card in the Mythical Trial.
He judged that Shi Yu would most likely rely on the monarch level to fight a top-notch overlord.
After all, Shi Yu had said that his monarchs also had the strength of top-notch overlords.
Regarding this, President Lin naturally believed it. After all, most of the legendary resources Dong Huang had distributed this year had been given to Shi Yu. How could those pets not be strong?
Shi Yu should use a monarch-level pet to fight a guardian overlord above his level!
President Lin was already looking forward to the expressions of the other factions after seeing Dong Huang’s level-six Beast Tamer so fierce.
“I’ll prepare,” Shi Yu said. “I’m not too confident yet.”
President Lin said, “Alright.”
Then, on Inatella Island, with the Thunder Dragon General taking the lead, the challenges began one after another.
At that moment, there were about 600 contestants in the World Tournament.
Among them, there were more than 400 level-six Beast Tamers and more than 100 legend Beast Tamers.

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 899 Not Human Again (4)
chapters.content:
899 Not Human Again (4)
Although there were very few legends under the age of 30 in the totem country who could participate, they basically worked hard to gather one person for the world competition.
There were also many legend geniuses gathered by more than a hundred totem country factions.
As for level-six Beast Tamers, most of them had contracted overlords above their level. For example, those with outstanding talent and contracted top-notch overlords above their level were the current first round challengers.
With the lesson of the Thunder Dragon General, these people didn’t dare to play any difficult operations. Without thinking that there would be much improvement in seven days, they all provoked the guardian overlord they countered to challenge, hoping to rely on speed to win the attention of the World Tree.
!!
Soon, battles basically occurred in the ten arenas.
The fire-element arena near Dong Huang also welcomed a challenger. It was a pirate from the Endless Sea Domain.
The pirates in that area were much fiercer than the pirates in the Chaotic Sea near Dong Huang and the Seven Islands. They were all attached to the subordinates of deep sea totems, burning, killing, looting, and fighting for territory. They were like emperors on the sea, without any order.
After a battle until night, the various factions basically determined the situation of the ten guardian overlords of metal, wood, water, fire, earth, light, darkness, wind, lightning, and ice.
They mainly fought with the power of nature.
Then, challenging dark-element overlords in the day and light-element overlords at night could weaken the other party’s strength to a certain extent.
However, there were also relatively difficult targets, such as water-element overlords, earth-element overlords, and wind-element overlords. After all, in Inatella, the power of these elements was relatively rich and wouldn’t change with time.
As for light and dark elements, because their attributes were stronger, they were actually not much weaker.
For a moment, many level-six Beast Tamers were numb.
This was because even a level-six Beast Tamer from the totem country who had contracted a top-notch overlord wouldn’t have an easy time winning a battle with attributes.
After half a day, only six people cleared the level.
At this moment, after Shi Yu basically looked at the battle style of the ten overlords, he returned to his legendary ruins to prepare for battle.
In Inatella, almost every faction carried ruins with them as a resting and preparation venue for their factions. This could ensure the greatest privacy.
As for Shi Yu, because he had ruins, he didn’t have to go to the ruins Dong Huang had prepared in advance for the contestants and audience to join in the fun.
Shi Yu planned to prepare for battle seriously.
He wanted to see what reward the World Tree could give him if he didn’t use his pet to defeat the guardian!
Why was a Beast Tamer strong? This meant that the pet had many attributes, which indirectly meant that the pet was stronger!
This was clearly the method with the greatest potential to pass the preliminaries!
It was much better than using a monarch-level pet to defeat a top-notch overlord.
However, Shi Yu still felt a lot of pressure. Although it was the Earth Desolate Bear, and its battle power was inferior to the Bean Bear in Shi Yu’s opinion, that still depended on who it was compared to…
At least, although he was strong now, he still couldn’t defeat the Bean Bear.
Therefore, it was very necessary to prepare for battle.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t rely on equipment in the World Tournament. Otherwise, Shi Yu wouldn’t be so troubled. He could directly take off Qi’s equipment and fight now.
Such rules were also to restrict the demigods from personally creating equipment. Their strength was much stronger than Shi Yu’s team.
For example, if the Dragon God gave Shi Yu the Dragon God Protection, it would be easy for him to withstand a totem-level attack.
Therefore, the test of the World Tournament still belonged to the strength of the Beast Tamer and the pet themselves.
“Wuu.” “Wu!!” “Yiya.” “Mi ~”
At this moment, in the ruins, the pets of the first team were discussing who to fight.
“Yi. (Leave it to me. If I can’t kill the enemy in five moves, I lose.)” Baby Ginseng said.
“Mi!! (Me, me, me, me. If I can’t kill the enemy in three moves, I lose.)” Chi Tong fought.
“Ning!! (One move!!)”
Ling : “…”
The monarch-level ginseng baby, Chi Tong, and Susu argued endlessly, all wanting to go on stage.
After all, he had added points for so long just to kill indiscriminately in the World Tournament.
Eleven and Buggy tactfully didn’t say anything. They knew that Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t send them. He would definitely use a monarch to fight an overlord above his level.
Ling: “You guys are still too young. According to my analysis…”
“Master might go on stage himself.”
The pets: “?”
“As expected of a top-notch intelligence,” Shi Yu praised.
Ling had never disappointed him.
It was actually as smart as him and analyzed that this was the best battle strategy.
Eleven, Buggy: “?”
“It’s just the weakest top-notch overlord. There’s too little pressure for you to attack,” Shi Yu said. “Next, just cooperate with me to prepare for battle.”
….
Three days later.
The preliminaries of the World Tournament had already been carried out for three days.
In the past three days, be it Zou Yun, Ji Feng, or Gao Xuan, they had all issued challenges.
In the end, they all failed.
Or rather, none of the level-six Beast Tamers from the seven countries had succeeded.
So far, the dozen or so people who had cleared the level were all Beast Tamers from the totem countries.
...
They all had special talents and special physiques. They had contracted overlords above their level, so they could clear the level.
This situation caused the seven countries to be mocked by the totem countries for the past three days.
Although Inatella didn’t allow private battles, the verbal confrontation didn’t stop these days.
This situation made the seven countries feel immense pressure.
As a result, some countries, such as the Shen Feng Nation, had the thought of assisting level-six Beast Tamers to contract mechanical overlords above their level.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 900 Not Being Human Again (5)
chapters.content:
900 Not Being Human Again (5)
After all, if one missed the opportunity of the Mythical Trial, he might regret it for the rest of his life.
“Damn it.”
After failing another challenge, Gao Xuan was already faceless facing the seniors of the fourth bureau behind him.
Every time he lost, his Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast would be blown up.
!!
In order to repair the Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast as soon as possible, the fourth bureau consumed a lot of precious mechanical resources. A pile of legend Mechanics assisted him in recovering, but in the end…
“Little Gao, why don’t we forget it?” Elder Liu shook his head in the fourth bureau. As expected, the difficulty was still too high.
“It’s too much?”
Zou Yun was also depressed. Both challenges ended in failure.
Among the three of them, Ji Feng was the closest to victory, but in a head-on battle, he was completely no match for a top-notch overlord.
On the Dong Huang audience’s side, they were also a little uncomfortable because of the three of them’s repeated losses.
“Is Shi Yu… still preparing for battle?”
It had been three days. Now, the audience of Dong Huang was looking forward to the challenge of the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, Shi Yu.
However, Shi Yu had already prepared for three days and had yet to make his first attempt. It couldn’t help but make him a little anxious.
“He can definitely do it. It depends on how far he wants to go…”
On Shi Yu’s familiar side, Senior Ji Mengzhu and the others were still very confident in Shi Yu.
Dragon Palace City was even less worried about Shi Yu. They watched the show the whole time, waiting to see how Shi Yu wanted to challenge someone above his level.
Not only Dong Huang, but many people from the other six human countries, including most totem countries, were also waiting for Shi Yu.
If it was said that before Inatella opened, although Shi Yu was famous, he had largely spread in the seven countries.
However, as Shi Yu unearthed the secrets of the Mythical Era, his name directly spread among the totem countries.
The various factions naturally had to investigate such an archeologist.
This investigation was impressive.
Many factions were shocked that such a super genius had appeared in Dong Huang.
Although there was not much information about Shi Yu’s battle power, just a mechanical phantom beast system was enough for these totem countries to remember Shi Yu firmly.
Moreover, Shi Yu had the title of the number one person below the legends of Dong Huang. His battle power was definitely not weak.
At this moment, they were also paying attention to the seven countries. Shi Yu was one of the few level-six Beast Tamers who had yet to challenge.
…
After preparing for battle for a long time, Shi Yu, who was wearing an ordinary panda short-sleeved shirt and black pants, finally came out of the ruins again. After coming out, he took a long breath and looked in the direction of the rock-element arena.
Without a word, he planned to challenge the rock-element arena.
It was because he had gotten used to fighting Bean Bears these two days and was more experienced in fighting bears.
“You’re finally out.”
After Shi Yu came out, he immediately attracted President Lin’s attention.
“Are you ready?” President Lin asked.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Which one?”
“Earth-element arena,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright.” President Lin nodded.
“Then let…”
“I’ll send him over!” Before President Lin could finish speaking, spatial ripples appeared. The gem cat appeared at some point in time and immediately looked at Shi Yu.
Damn, it had been waiting for Shi Yu to challenge for several days. This guy was so slow.
It wanted to go to the scene to watch the battle!
“Then I’ll leave it to you, Teacher Ying,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Let’s go,” the gem cat said.
In the next moment, spatial psychic power enveloped it and Shi Yu.
At the same time, outside the rock-element arena in Inatella.
Shi Yu’s figure appeared.
After three days, the frequency of the challenge had already slowed down a lot.
When Shi Yu arrived, only the Earth Desolate Bear was still standing on the arena. It was like an immortal body. Every time it was defeated, it could quickly recover with the power of the arena.
Shi Yu’s appearance did not cause much of a reaction at the start.
However, when he walked onto the arena…
Be it the Beast Tamers of the seven countries or the Beast Tamers of the totem country, they instantly paid attention when they saw someone walking onto the arena.
They were immediately stunned by Shi Yu’s appearance.
“It’s Dong Huang’s Shi Yu!”
“He’s finally here to challenge.”
Shi Yu, who was walking towards the rock arena, listened to the voices around him with a calm expression.
...
Not only humans, but also ferocious beasts, regardless of their level, looked over.
Even in the void, a demigod opened his eyes and stared at the rock-element arena.
Shi Yu was the only level-six Beast Tamer that these demigods were more concerned about.
After all, it was because of this young man that the seven countries were much ahead of them in terms of information in the Mythical Era.
“It’s that human.”
In the distance of the rock arena, on a huge tree, the World Tree clone that looked like a tree worm looked over again.
Dong Huang was even more lively.
After learning that Shi Yu wanted to challenge, Xiao Qin prepared to quickly let the Eye of the Stars focus the scene on the rock arena.
In various places in the Dong Huang area, Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, Zou Yun, Lin Xiuzhu, Lu Qingyi, White Brook, and the others instantly looked over.
After being slightly stunned, he chose to summon his pet and head to the scene.
…
...
“The number one person below the legend of Dong Huang?”
At that moment, more than ten totem country contestants who had passed the preliminaries rushed to the scene curiously.
They were very interested in this title.
After all, at the moment, no level-six Beast Tamer in the seven countries could pass the preliminaries.
At this moment, the strength of the strongest level-six Beast Tamer in the superpower, Dong Huang, was very worth their attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 901 Not Being Human Again (6)
chapters.content:
901 Not Being Human Again (6)
For a moment, Shi Yu arrived at the rock venue and attracted the attention of various parties.
Be it fellow preliminaries contestants, legendary contestants, or stronger totem life forms, they all paid attention to the situation in the rock arena.
Under their gazes, Shi Yu slowly walked onto the rock-element arena.
At the same time, he looked up at the huge beast on the other side of the arena.
!!
“Can he win?”
“It’s difficult, unless he also contracted an overlord above his level.”
“Although he’s the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, it’s only a telepathy talent after all. Even if he contracted an overlord above his level, I think it’s barely enough.”
There were discussions everywhere.
“It shouldn’t be a problem, right?” Luo Yi and Hillia said.
“There’s definitely no problem,” Annie, the overlord sprite of Tingxiang who had fought Shi Yu, said.
After all, Shi Yu had already defeated her alone.
“Finally here.”
On Rongguang’s side, when Lucille saw that Rongguang’s level-six Beast Tamer had no hope of passing the preliminaries, she had long paid all her attention to Dong Huang.
Seeing that Shi Yu, who had easily defeated her, had finally appeared, her expression relaxed.
“This guy…” At this moment, the eldest prince of the Demon Nation had a serious expression as he flew above the rock arena. In its opinion, the strength of this Earth Desolate Bear was only so-so, but Shi Yu… He couldn’t see through him at all.
After learning that Shi Yu was actually the strongest archeologist in the seven countries, he understood that his perception at that time was right. This guy’s strength definitely came from a source.
Next, he could finally see the strength of his pet.
He didn’t think that Shi Yu wouldn’t be able to pass the preliminaries. He only wanted to see how much of a threat Shi Yu could pose to him in the main competition.
“Roar!!!”
World Tree clone, legendary demigods, contestants of the seven countries, totem clans… Under countless gazes, on the rock arena, the Earth Desolate Bear roared!!
“Roar!!!”
As long as someone stepped onto the arena, these elemental life clones would immediately attack. This also meant that the battle had already begun!!
Boom!!!
The Earth Desolate Bear, which was more than ten meters tall, stood on the arena like a small mountain. Its rock-like body was incomparably heavy, containing the aura of history. A brown deterrence wave involuntarily released from its body.
The incomparably terrifying overlord aura instantly spread, and a huge hole instantly appeared in the sky. Cracks appeared on the arena that was repeatedly destroyed and repaired under this strong deterrence.
This was the starting move of the guardian overlord. Deterrence first. Although the level-six Beast Tamers who came to Inatella were all elites among the level-six Beast Tamers in the world, most people had already lost their ability to fight in the face of this deterrence.
Transcendent-level deterrence!
Coupled with overlord-level strength.
If there were no overlord-level pets in the team, it would really be difficult to resist.
Its willpower would probably instantly collapse.
At this moment, the deterrence of the Earth Desolate Bear attacked from all directions.
Shi Yu stood in the arena without moving at all and looked straight at the Earth Desolate Bear.
At this moment, everyone was stunned.
“Why didn’t he call his pet?”
Under normal circumstances, the challenger would have already summoned his pet outside the arena.
Otherwise, just as he stepped onto the arena, he would also instantly summon his pet.
Shi Yu…
It didn’t look like it was going to summon a pet at all.
Was he crazy?
Without the help of pets to resist, with the weak physique of humans, they would probably be instantly defeated by this deterrence wave. Be it their bodies or minds, they would collapse.
Boom!!!
A huge deterrence aura completely enveloped Shi Yu and the entire arena. Shi Yu’s short hair and clothes fluttered because of this. However, what made everyone open their mouths wide was that under the deterrence of a top-notch overlord, Shi Yu’s expression didn’t change at all. He still stood in the arena without moving.
It was as if this deterrence couldn’t affect him at all.
Weak.
Very weak.
At the moment, Buggy had mastered a deterrence that was enough to deter totem-level. After its mental feedback, Shi Yu’s mental strength was almost immune to deterrence. For his overlord-level physique, spirit, and quasi totem-level soul power, this deterrence was indeed not enough.
“Deterrence… is ineffective against him?”
Before many spectators could react, Shi Yu moved.
Ignoring the deterrence, Shi Yu’s figure flashed.
This speed was undoubtedly very fast, but life forms above the overlord level could see clearly.
However, it was precisely because they could see it clearly that they all revealed shocked expressions.
“Wait, what does he want!!”
“Moreover… how is this possible?”
Bodywork.
...
Pure physical skills.
On the arena, Shi Yu purely relied on his physique that was strong enough to compare to an overlord-level dragon to move. His body disappeared from the spot like an afterimage.
His speed had even crushed most of the monarchs it had challenged previously.
In an instant, Shi Yu turned into a beam of light and ran out, leaving only the sound of wind exploding. His afterimage first moved on the arena. Then, like a broken line, he stepped on the ground and cracked it. He leaped up and instantly arrived in front of the Earth Desolate Bear with his small body.
He jumped to the height of its head.
Although he was fighting alone, Shi Yu could be said to have no worries. After all, even if he couldn’t defeat it, so be it. In any case, his pets could save the situation at any time. This big guy couldn’t cause him any harm.

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 902 Not Being Human Again (7)
chapters.content:
902 Not Being Human Again (7)
As the saying went, confidence was at the peak. Shi Yu’s battle without any worries directly erupted with incomparable potential.
The Earth Desolate Bear’s strength and defense were not weak. Speed was its disadvantage. In the previous battles, it had exchanged injuries for injuries and resisted the attack. Shi Yu’s speed still had some advantages.
He directly punched the Earth Desolate Bear’s face in midair.
Boom!!!
!!
An incomparably terrifying sonic boom, accompanied by an extremely compressed fist wind, directly hit the Earth Desolate Bear’s face. Cracks instantly appeared on the rock on its face, and its entire head leaned back slightly.
Shi Yu’s punch actually injured the Earth Desolate Bear!!
Although it was only an extremely light scratch that couldn’t even affect the Earth Desolate Bear, at this moment, all the lives watching this battle were instantly stunned.
Initially, on Dong Huang’s side, Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others were still wondering why Shi Yu didn’t send his pets.
Now, they realized that this damn child seemed to want to f*cking do it himself?
“What the hell!”
Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others, who had arrived at the scene, also looked up at the arena in shock.
They were all here to see Shi Yu’s performance, but in the end, Shi Yu’s actions directly made them unable to do anything.
“This…”
The contestants of the World Tournament who had challenged the Earth Desolate Bear previously were stunned at this moment. Their expressions were stunned as they doubted their eyes.
Those overlords looked at their weak level-six servants and then at Shi Yu, who had injured the Earth Desolate Bear in one hit on the arena.
“Ah…”
White Brook was incomparably stunned.
She felt that even if she entered the fusion state, she couldn’t launch this attack.
At the side, Lu Qingyi and Lin Xiuzhu were stunned by Shi Yu’s attack.
Legendaries and demigods… frowned together.
“Tch.” Shi Yu sensed the reaction force coming from his body and looked at the Earth Desolate Bear that had only suffered light injuries and instantly healed itself. He was extremely silent.
As expected, with just physical strength, he could only be crushed by this guy?
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, after the Earth Desolate Bear suffered the attack, it was not affected at all. It angrily condensed the Rock Roar Cannon in its mouth and swept it at Shi Yu in midair.
At the same time, the huge palm slapped at Shi Yu.
As for Shi Yu, his movements were not restricted at all in the sky.
In order to be agile, he directly maxed out his Psychic power.
At this moment, the air around Shi Yu began to hum and vibrate. Substantial spiritual power formed a blue outline around Shi Yu.
It let him fly freely in midair.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s pupils were instantly dyed in an incomparably deep blue. He raised his hand, and an ocean-like spiritual power instantly formed a torrent that intercepted the brown light pillar Rock Roar Cannon!!
Under the impact of the Rock Roar Cannon, Shi Yu’s body was quickly pushed in the sky, but the form of the Rock Roar Cannon also kept distorting under the pressure of Psychic power!!
Boom!!!
Finally, under Shi Yu’s hard work, he suddenly raised his arm. The Rock Roar Cannon directly changed the direction of the attack and was sent flying into the sky by Shi Yu’s Psychic power.
Until this moment, everyone had completely lost their ability to think. The Beast Tamers of the totem country were extremely confused.
“This is… Psychic power?”
Apart from his physical strength, the mental strength that erupted from Shi Yu’s body again stunned many totems.
It was fine if a human’s physique was so strong, but why did he also master psychic power!!
This Shi Yu was also a mixed-blood?
No, there were not many hybrid Beast Tamers present. There were even hybrids who had reached the Legendary level and mastered extraordinary power. However, all of them watched everything solemnly. This was no longer a matter of hybrids.
This guy was a humanoid overlord ferocious beast!!
However…
“It’s a super skill. The super skill of the Earth Desolate Bear.”
However, at the same time, the Earth Desolate Bear’s huge palm also descended. This super huge palm that could flatten a mountain directly charged at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu directly felt the threat of death from this huge palm.
Even if he had the physical and mental strength of an overlord, due to the restrictions of humans, he could only scratch the top overlords like the Earth Desolate Bear.
It couldn’t cause any damage to the other party that could affect the outcome.
Fortunately…
He was sufficiently prepared.
“That’s it?”
Under the pressure of life and death, the blood in Shi Yu’s body boiled.
An incomparable potential erupted from his body.
Pseudo overlord will, activate!
Because of the existence of the Undying Fruit and the mind domain, countless potential was also hidden in Shi Yu’s body.
At the same time, because he kept adding points, if Shi Yu was a transcendent life form, his willpower level would have long been tempered to the level of an overlord’s will.
...
However, what he lacked was a method to erupt with potential.
With the help of Susu’s memory water drop, Shi Yu studied for a day and took turns to understand the experience of Eleven and the others erupting with overlord will. Now, he had some success.
He could erupt with more potential.
When the human body broke through the limit, it could also be very dazzling.
Boom!!
Shi Yu’s strength was like the eruption of a small universe, like the opening of a genetic lock, constantly increasing!
It was directly strengthened!
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
In the next moment, Shi Yu stood in the sky and punched out again!!
It smashed out of thin air.
Suddenly, the air howled!!!
...
The moment he punched, Shi Yu used his physical strength and mental strength to squeeze the air and create fist wind, forming a wind-element move that combined into a terrifying air cannon.
This move also took shape under his guidance through Ling.
Fake Wind Element Control!
Through wind, it countered earth!
The Air Cannon was like a huge fist shadow several meters tall, displaying the extreme speed of light. As the white fist shadow moved, it directly emitted a vibration sound that resounded through the arena!!
Bang!!!
The terrifying fist wind turned into a wind dragon and carried out a dragon roar, directly colliding with the huge palm of the Earth Desolate Bear.
In the next moment, the pupils of the Earth Desolate Bear constricted.
In an instant, countless traces of rocks eroding and shattering were instantly left on its palm and arm.
Boom!!!
The Earth Desolate Bear, which had defeated many monarchs and overlords, directly took a few steps back under the powerful fist wind. Its figure was swallowed by the surging and violent fist wind, and the entire arena rumbled.
“Unfortunately, the damage isn’t enough? Again!” Shi Yu sighed.
Everyone revealed shocked expressions.
The space where the demigods were suddenly trembled with the change in their mood.
“Impossible, this is a human?”
“What exactly is he doing!”
Even the World Tree clone recovered its confused expression at this moment. It kept feeling that something was wrong with the way it unfolded.

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 903 Son of the Stars
chapters.content:
903 Son of the Stars
At this moment, the overlords and totems present doubted their eyes.
This human Beast Tamer named Shi Yu actually didn’t send out his pet and walked onto the arena himself. He gave the Earth Desolate Bear with the strength of a top-notch overlord two punches?
They were very certain that Shi Yu’s “self” was not in a fusion state.
The key was that the Earth Desolate Bear, which had displayed a domineering posture when facing opponents of the same level previously, was actually really forced back.
!!
The first punch looked like a scratch, but the second punch, the fist that swept spiritual power and compressed air, actually directly suppressed the super skill of the Earth Desolate Bear. The terrifying fist wind instantly swallowed the Earth Desolate Bear!
Boom!!
The Earth Desolate Bear’s ten-meter-tall body tilted backward in front of Shi Yu’s tiny body, making everyone in disbelief.
“I think Shi Yu… will have some trouble! The opponent is a top-notch overlord after all.” Before the battle, the Prediction Owl had predicted this outcome for the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang.
It didn’t hide anything and told the teachers and students of Imperial Capital University about the results of its premonition, such as the old principal of Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan, and the others.
However, at this moment, the old principal of Imperial Capital University, Yin Zhengfan, Gao Xuan, and the others, were very confused. Their gazes were filled with confusion. With a rumbling vibration, they looked at the Prediction Owl. Was this what he meant by Shi Yu being in a little trouble?
If Shi Yu sent his pet to obtain an advantage, it wasn’t that they couldn’t accept it. After all, Shi Yu was the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang. He should perform better than the level-six Beast Tamers of the other seven countries, but…
“Buzz!!!”
Just as everyone was shocked, the owl was also at a loss.
In the next moment, the feedback of the premonition power made its level loosen a little.
In the prophecy scene, it saw Shi Yu himself being attacked by an overlord. It originally thought that Shi Yu was already an arrow at the end of its flight and that his pets had all lost. Even if there was a deviation, the outcome wouldn’t be good. In the end, it was told that Shi Yu was fighting an overlord one-on-one?!
So, the problem wasn’t the prophecy, but it?
“What’s wrong with this human Beast Tamer…”
Under the confusion of the various factions, the Earth Desolate Bear lay on the ground and let out a roar that resounded through the world.
“Roar!!!”
The power of the earth continuously surged into its body. The places where its body was shattered were repaired again. Moreover, deeper-colored rock armor kept superimposing on its body.
Just as Shi Yu had sensed just now, although his attack was already very strong and definitely not a problem to deal with ordinary overlords, one hit was not enough to deal with a top-notch elemental overlord.
He had to continue attacking!
If Shi Yu had only “serious punched” just now…
Then now, he raised his arms and used “Consecutive Serious Punches”.
In a protracted battle, Shi Yu couldn’t compare to the Earth Desolate Bear, so he could only erupt.
His current state was established on the foundation of “Will Explosion”, transferring the potential of “totem-level Ghost God Shi Yu” to his current human body.
Under the enhancement of the totem-level potential and the overlord’s will, his explosive power would temporarily exceed the limit.
Boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Just as the Earth Desolate Bear’s eyes caught up, in the sky, a violent fist wind that was like a rainstorm descended with violent natural power.
“I have to let you leave the ground.”
Under this attack, the weather in the sky changed, and dark clouds gathered. Shi Yu’s powerful mental strength had already affected the weather. Raindrops fell one after another, mixed in the fist wind, making the fist wind that filled the sky like a storm devour the Earth Desolate Bear again!
Water Wind Psychic Combination Skill!
“Roar!!!”
The expression of the Earth Desolate Bear, which was just about to get up, changed. It resisted with all its might.
However, the descending fist wind was like a terrifying super storm or a super tsunami that swept for thousands of miles. It contained fatal power. The moment it came into contact, the Earth Desolate Bear felt that its entire body had suffered countless impacts and was about to fall apart…
Bang!!
It was suppressed back again and smashed back to the ground with a bang. The armor on its body shattered!
In the arena, a huge pit appeared. Shi Yu directly created an artificial lake with his Psychic power.
Whoosh!!!
In an instant, the ground cracked, the arena rumbled, and a rainstorm descended from the sky. Scattered mental strength scattered in all directions, and the Earth Desolate Bear slowly sank into the newly formed small lake with a tragic expression.
At this moment, every punch of Shi Yu’s affected nature because of his powerful superpower. His continuous attacks did not stop. After all, when his soul couldn’t withstand such an eruption, he would wither, so he had to work hard.
Crack.
Under the influence of his superpower, the temperature of the rain that swallowed the Earth Desolate Bear first plummeted and instantly froze, turning it into an ice sculpture. Then, Shi Yu’s fatal attack followed and directly descended on the Earth Desolate Bear that had turned into an ice sculpture. The collision of ice and earth directly made the Earth Desolate Bear’s defense even weaker, and its body shattered with a crack under the fist wind.
