This scene had completely exceeded the scope of people’s understanding. Suppressing the Earth Desolate Bear? They widened their eyes. A… Beast Tamer with the battle power of a top-notch overlord?
Indeed, some mixed-blood Beast Tamers and Beast Tamers with special talent were also very strong in battle, but they definitely wouldn’t exceed their level restrictions!!
How could Shi Yu, a level-six Beast Tamer, display overlord-level battle power!!
No matter how one looked at it, this didn’t make sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 904 Son of the Stars (2)
chapters.content:
904 Son of the Stars (2)
Shi Yu’s attack made the spectators experience what it meant to be in a storm. They experienced what it meant to use pure physical and mental strength to trigger the power of nature.
From a physical overlord to a spiritual overlord to an overlord that could trigger the power of nature, Shi Yu directly crushed the Earth Desolate Bear crazily as if he wasn’t human!
“Roar!!!”
When everyone reacted, accompanied by a wail from the Earth Desolate Bear, its body was already riddled with holes from the attack. Countless water ice fragments flowed out of its body, and countless wind marks covered its body. Under the influence of various natural powers, it was mixed with the restrictions of Shi Yu’s Psychic power. In just a moment, this huge monster gradually lost control of its body. It was very difficult to recover its body with the power of the elements.
!!
Its body was like a small mountain that had been blown up in front of the naked eye. It kept collapsing and shattering with a boom.
In the sky, Shi Yu’s attack suddenly stopped.
He took a deep breath and tried his best to adjust his strength.
He was excited. This was the power feedback of the two Mythical pets!
Shi Yu no longer dared to imagine how strong he would become when he contracted a team of Mythical races.
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu had really done it, totem after totem, overlord after overlord looked at the arena in disbelief.
The legendary Beast Tamers of the seven countries, the legendary Beast Tamers of the totem country, those who had known Shi Yu and fought Shi Yu directly had stunned eyes. Their values were almost shattered. They didn’t understand why Shi Yu could tear apart an overlord with his bare hands after not seeing him for a while.
What exactly was wrong with the power on his body!!!
“Is he still human?”
“Won, won?”
“The feedback of the Mythical race?” The Elven Empress looked at the Dragon God beside her.
Not to mention outsiders, even their own people were extremely shocked.
Otherwise, it was impossible to explain this power.
“There might be another reason,” the Dragon God said.
Undying Fruit.
Divine Source Legendary and President Lin didn’t want to talk anymore. They knew that Shi Yu had been preparing for three days. In the end, it turned out that it was for him. They hadn’t seen this coming at all.
Most importantly… Shi Yu really succeeded! Was the increase brought by the Undying Fruit and the contracted Mythical race that strong?
Even Divine Source Legendary and President Lin couldn’t make a judgment.
As expected, he shouldn’t have believed that Shi Yu, who would play the Iron-eating Beast Knight in the vocation assessment, could compete normally in the world competition!
He just didn’t know what the World Tree… would think.
After Shi Yu’s battle ended, the entire Inatella fell silent.
Suddenly, a huge pressure descended between heaven and earth. With a hum, a thick branch suddenly stretched out from a towering tree closest to the earth-element arena.
At the end of the branch, the green tree worm-like World Tree clone descended with a serious expression.
It finally couldn’t sit still anymore.
In its opinion, this human Beast Tamer was extremely ridiculous, completely exceeding its understanding.
As the World Tree clone appeared, everyone was numb.
Only then did they remember that the World Tree clone was paying attention to every arena at all times. Then, it would give the Beast Tamer who passed the preliminaries a reward on the spot.
The Beast Tamers of the totem country who had passed at the moment had all obtained a World Tree leaf from the World Tree. The energy level of the leaf was level eight, and its quality was between legend and myth. It could be called a quasi legendary resource. It had the power to increase physique, life force, spiritual power, soul power, and various other attributes.
For the contestants of the totem country, this reward was very useful.
After all, the previous level-six Beast Tamers were all contracting overlords above their level. Their bodies were very weak. The strengthening effect brought by the World Tree Leaf could better let them welcome the next Mythical Trial.
And this time, this human named Shi Yu actually broke through the arena without sending his pet. For a moment, it was impossible for the various factions to determine what rewards the World Tree would give.
However, to everyone’s surprise, the World Tree clone didn’t directly distribute the rewards this time. Instead, it questioned Shi Yu first.
“Human Beast Tamer, where’s your pet?” the World Tree clone said.
He looked at this archeologist who had told the seven countries about the Mythical Era in advance and at this broken arena. He kept feeling that a variable seemed to have appeared in this world competition.
A freak that it didn’t expect in advance.
At this moment, as the World Tree appeared and confirmed that Shi Yu was fighting a top-notch overlord in the Beast Tamer’s main body, many factions fell silent.
“You said that using one pet to defeat the enemy is better than using two. Then I think it might be better not to send a pet to win the battle,” Shi Yu said.
World Tree clone: ???
This was how he calculated?!
“Moreover, if a Beast Tamer is only a burden to his pet and doesn’t have enough hard strength, he can’t be considered outstanding, right?” Shi Yu said.
These words directly made the scalps of the level-six Beast Tamers who had participated in the preliminaries go numb.
It also stunned the legendary Beast Tamers who didn’t participate in the preliminaries.
Was this human language?
However, no one could refute what Shi Yu said. The Beast Tamers of the totem countries just now were examples.
They were all burdens of overlord creatures.
It was the same for the seven countries. Beast Tamers were too weak and still had to be protected by their beasts. They were also burdens to their pets.
Although it could also buff the pet, they also needed the pet to be distracted to protect themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 905 Son of the Stars (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 905 - 905 Son of the Stars (3)
905 Son of the Stars (3)
Shi Yu displayed a completely different appearance, telling everyone what a super Blue Planet person was.
“You’ve consumed Mythical resources?”
The World Tree clone looked at Shi Yu and asked.
Apart from that, it was very difficult for him to imagine that Shi Yu’s physique could reach this level just by training and the feedback of his pets.
!!
Shi Yu said,
“I’ve eaten the Undying Fruit.”
“This shouldn’t be against the rules, right…”
Don’t tell him that the unactivated Undying Fruit was also considered equipment.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of the legendaries, demigods, and totems changed.
Undying Fruit?
That Undying Fruit that could at least turn one into a totem-level undead and live a second life after death?
An Undying Fruit that could increase soul power to the limit?
How could a mere level-six Beast Tamer like him come into contact with such resources!
The Valkyrie of the Seven Islands had an even more unfriendly expression. This Mythical resource… was it really not taken from the Seven Islands?
“He’s indeed Lu Bai.” The legendary master and disciple of the Phoenix Court of the Seven Islands looked at Shi Yu with a burning gaze.
Mythical resources weren’t that common. Lu Bai had obtained a Mythical resource on the Seven Islands, and Shi Yu had eaten a Mythical resource. If it weren’t for one, they wouldn’t believe it even if they were beaten to death.
“Shi Yu actually said it!”
The Dragon God and Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City were relatively calm… They quickly reacted. This time, the Beast Tamers of the totem country would probably have to tiptoe when fighting Shi Yu.
When other beasts fought, pets needed to carefully protect Beast Tamers.
As for the Beast Tamer fighting Shi Yu, he would probably have to carefully remind his pets not to hurt Shi Yu.
If Shi Yu was killed and turned into a totem, no one could leave alive.
This was a dilemma.
The juniors of the totem country and the seven countries didn’t know what the Undying Fruit was at the start.
But as they asked the elders, their expressions exploded.
“He’ll become a totem after killing him?!”
“Why?”
How could there be such a resource? Wasn’t this cheating!!!
“I wasn’t wrong at that time. This human is indeed a monster.” The Fallen Angel Prince’s expression froze.
As Shi Yu revealed that he had eaten the Mythical Undying Fruit, even demigods and legendaries were instantly stunned.
Their faces were beyond disbelief.
Why should such a human brat enjoy such a resource?
“Undying Fruit…”
The World Tree clone was also silent for a moment.
As expected, Shi Yu’s power was strengthened from the inside out.
At this moment, everyone finally understood why Shi Yu’s battle power was so ridiculous.
A level-six Beast Tamer like him had actually eaten Mythical resources.
Of course, since Shi Yu was so strong, the Undying Fruit only played a support role, but outsiders didn’t know that due to the mystery of the Mythical resources, they subconsciously believed that the reason why Shi Yu’s main body’s battle power was so strong and why he could even activate his spiritual power was because of the Undying Fruit.
“What kind of heaven-defying opportunity is this!”
“Dong Huang can’t be so generous. In other words, he obtained it himself?”
“Don’t forget, he’s an archeologist and even investigated the history of the Mythical Era… I’m afraid the number of ruins cracked exceeds three digits, and there are even Mythical Ruins.”
If it was said that the totem factions didn’t know the value of the strongest archeologist of the seven countries just now, then now, they completely knew.
They understood that Shi Yu, who had cracked the secret of the Mythical Era, was currently the strongest archeologist on Blue Planet. His foundation might be quite rich.
“In the future, if you encounter Shi Yu, be careful. Don’t care about him. Just attack his pet.”
“After eating the Undying Fruit, this human’s strength might be even stronger than its pet. If he dies, it will be even more troublesome. Not only will he cause trouble on the spot, but the killer will also suffer the revenge of Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City later.”
The leading totems of the weak totem countries told their contestants.
If possible, they wouldn’t touch this Shi Yu.
If one really couldn’t avoid it, one would only attack the pet and not hurt it.
What the hell? This guy was the most troublesome existence to the totem country so far!
A Beast Tamer who might be stronger than his pet’s battle power, and one couldn’t even attack him! If he was killed, he could even become stronger. How could they fight!
“You… passed.” The World Tree clone didn’t dwell on this matter for long.
Although Shi Yu’s performance made its stomach hurt a little and exceeded its expectations…
However, without a doubt, Shi Yu’s potential had completely obtained its recognition.
The previous level-six Beast Tamers of the totem country were too weak. They had no potential to speak of.
What it wanted to find was Shi Yu.
The reason why he had to support a level-six Beast Tamer first was to avoid missing a genius who had yet to break through to the legendary level because of his age.
Although Shi Yu was only at level six now, his strength exceeded most legends!
After nurturing it a little, he could also compete for the Mythical Trial and champion position with other legends!
“Legendary resource, World Branch Liquid.”
The World Tree clone spoke.
A branch with liquid flew towards Shi Yu.
“After using it, it can accelerate the speed at which you strengthen the Beast Taming Space. It’s a cultivation-type resource.”
“If you accumulate enough, you can rely on it to break through to level seven during the World Tournament.”
“I look forward to your subsequent performance.”
It was a top-notch cultivation resource that didn’t exist in the Seven Nation Alliance at the moment!
Initially, Shi Yu thought that there was no hope of breaking through to legend level before the world competition. He didn’t expect that he could really obtain cultivation resources in the world competition.

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 906 Son of the Stars (4)
chapters.content:
906 Son of the Stars (4)
This time, the World Tree suddenly had an additional Mythical Trial. If other Beast Tamers obtained the divine inheritance, then Shi Yu’s championship might be unstable.
If he could break through, it would undoubtedly be even more perfect.
“Legendary-level cultivation resource!”
At this moment, when they saw that the World Tree clone had rewarded Shi Yu with legendary-level cultivation resources, the expressions of the other contestants changed. Shi Yu was already so strong at level six. If he broke through to the legend level, what would happen?
Only Dong Huang’s Divine Source, President Lin, and the others were pleasantly surprised.
Shi Yu was already a step away from the legend level. In addition to Shi Yu’s powerful pet strength, as long as he broke through to the legend level, the world competition champion could be said to be completely without any suspense.
In the Mythical Trial, he could definitely obtain more opportunities!
The gift from the World Tree was completely timely.
“Wait… Shi Yu really needs our protection?”
Among the legendary contestants of Dong Huang, Divine Bell and Ye Xing watched in silence the whole time. They had no idea when Shi Yu had eaten the Undying Fruit, nor did they know how Shi Yu had obtained such strong strength.
As long as one wasn’t stupid, they could tell that if the Beast Tamer himself was strong, the pets would definitely be stronger than the Beast Tamer. Just the Undead Possession could directly double Shi Yu’s battle power again.
They looked at President Lin and saw that he had a calm expression.
“More like take care of each other…”
President Lin was also very helpless. How would he know that this kid’s strength had increased so quickly!
Ye Xing and Divine Bell had complicated expressions.
At this moment, the World Tree clone had already retreated. The rock arena automatically repaired, and a new Earth Desolate Bear gradually condensed.
In the arena, Shi Yu held the branch and felt the surrounding gazes. He was slightly stunned.
Then, he tightened his grip on the branch and smiled in all directions.
“See you in the main competition.”
“I will become a new world legend.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of the overlords and their servants gathered around changed.
“This guy…”
At this moment, the entire venue was shocked. The contestants with the strength of invincible overlords who didn’t participate in the preliminaries and could directly participate in the main competition had unfriendly expressions.
They all felt mockery.
A mere level-six Beast Tamer who had only eaten a Mythical resource. Wasn’t he a little too arrogant!!
Did he think that he had the strength to win the championship just like that?
Not to mention the contestants of the totem country, even the expressions of the contestants of the seven countries changed slightly. They didn’t understand why Shi Yu was so brave.
Didn’t he know that saying this would directly become the number one target of the totem country…
“Holy shit, kid, you can choose not to talk if you don’t know how to talk.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, the gem cat had already enveloped Shi Yu with its Psychic power and teleported him. Shi Yu directly disappeared from the earth-element arena and was teleported back to the Dong Huang area.
“Haha, what’s the matter?” Shi Yu laughed and said, “Giving myself some pressure.”
“Let’s not talk about it anymore. Teacher Ying, I’ll go cultivate first.”
Now that the preliminaries had passed, Shi Yu only had one thought. He had to hurry up and use this world’s branch liquid to cultivate.
He didn’t want to pay attention to the changes in the outside world for the time being. Breaking through his strength was the most important thing!
“Eh.” The gem cat was just about to say something when Shi Yu couldn’t wait to study the World Tree Branch Liquid.
At this moment, storms instantly rose in the seven countries because of Shi Yu’s performance. Zou Yun, Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, and the other level-six Beast Tamers’ expressions never recovered their calm from the beginning to the end.
The Beast Tamers of the other six countries also looked in Dong Huang’s direction in a daze.
The totem country exploded.
Shi Yu, Shi Yu. This name had made them especially concerned a few days ago, and now, their concern had increased by several levels.
He actually passed the preliminaries without even sending his pet. If he sent his pet and cooperated with his pet, how strong would he be?
Most importantly, this guy was only a level-six Beast Tamer.
Now that the World Tree had given him the resources to break through, before the main competition… could he break through?
“Ignore him.”
“The key is the opportunity in the Mythical Trial.”
The totem giants hidden in the dark echoed softly.
The rules were already very obvious.
Whoever could obtain the inheritance in the Mythical Trial was most likely to become the final winner.
No matter how strong Shi Yu’s battle power was, it was only a telepathy talent. It couldn’t make the pet’s strength undergo a qualitative change.
The real outcome still depended on the strength of the transcendent creature.
In the alternate space, Divine Source Legendary, the Dragon God, and the others had long expected Shi Yu to attract huge attention in Inatella. This was only the beginning. At that time, Yu’s Wind Kirin and the other pets had no choice but to participate in the battle. At that time, Shi Yu would directly become the center of the storm.
“I hope he can successfully break through to legend.”
At this moment, in Shi Yu’s ruins space.
Holding the World Tree Branch Liquid, Shi Yu was filled with joy.
However, as he sensed the power of the World Tree Branch Liquid, someone seemed to be even happier than Shi Yu.
In the ruins space, the Ling Research Institute, the Space Beast Egg Hatching Room.
...
At that time, when Yu entered the ruins with the World Tree Branch Liquid, suddenly, the Space Beast Egg that was originally lacking a nutrient and had yet to hatch in Ling’s research suddenly flickered and erupted with a shocking light.
A powerful energy wave shook the sky, causing the legendary ruins to tremble, making Shi Yu’s expression suddenly change.
This light seemed to be indicating that it was extremely hungry for the World Tree Branch Liquid.
“What’s going on?”
At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but teleport to the side of the Space Beast Egg and stare at the egg.
At the same time, he put away the World Tree Branch Liquid, afraid that this guy would snatch resources from him.
At that moment, as it resonated with the World Tree Branch Liquid, the Space Beast Egg directly had an obvious change.
The remaining traces of time on it that even Shi Yu couldn’t see clearly began to make Shi Yu’s listening talent, which had not reacted for a long time, hear voices again.
The voice was extremely young, like a baby.
“I want.”
At the same time, listening to his historical talent made Shi Yu see exaggerated scenes on the egg.
...
In the vast starry sky.
A purple-white planet that was about to shatter disintegrated into countless fragments.
Fragments shot in various directions in the starry sky of the universe.
At this moment, apart from Shi Yu, Ling, and the others in the ruins, the creatures outside didn’t sense the change in the Space Beast Egg. It was far from the impact of the sound of laws brought by the quasi-divine skill.
However, this special wave made the World Tree clones in various places in Inatella look up in confusion.
“Why would a Son of Stars appear on Blue Planet?”
“Who brought it back?”
The Son of the Stars, the prototype of a life planet and the prototype of a world’s consciousness. As the clone of Blue Planet’s will, the World Tree Worm immediately sensed that a member of its race had appeared on Inatella.
It crossed space effortlessly and arrived at the independent space where the Son of the Stars was. Then, it silently saw a scene.
The Beast Tamer who had just been rewarded with the World Tree Branch Liquid was holding the egg of the Son of the Stars and looking cautiously at it, which had suddenly barged into the ruins.
Shi Yu was shocked. He sensed that someone had barged into his ruins and thought that it was a demigod.
In the end, it was a green tree worm.
World Tree clone!
At this moment, the tree worm was looking at him solemnly.
“Where did the egg you’re holding come from?” the World Tree clone said.
Shi Yu was stunned for a moment. “What’s wrong with it??”
The World Tree clone said, “You’re holding a cub of a planet’s will.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Huh?
A planet cub?
There was such a thing?
Shi Yu was momentarily stunned.
The egg that the gem cat had always wanted to fry was a planet?!
Then what it wanted just now was the World Branch Liquid from Blue Planet. It was… Shi Yu’s expression was strange. It was breast milk?

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 907 Space Egg Hatching (1)
chapters.content:
907 Space Egg Hatching (1)
Shi Yu hugged the Space Beast Egg.
He had thought that this thing would hatch an Abyss Evil God.
It had also thought that this thing would hatch a Space Worm.
Apart from the fact that it was a little impossible for it to be a cosmic beast, the other two races that invaded Blue Planet might hatch!
Of course, it was also possible that it was some other strange cosmic life form.
After all, it was impossible for the huge universe to only have three races, “Space Beast”, “Space Worm”, and “Abyss Evil God”.
However, no matter what Shi Yu thought, he didn’t expect that this thing was actually a “planet cub”.
Shi Yu naturally didn’t doubt the World Tree clone.
Because its main body was Blue Planet’s clone.
As a planet, it was very normal for it to recognize its own race.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s first thought was that the Space Emperor had suffered a huge loss.
It was an insane loss.
He remembered that back then, Senior Lu had said that because the contract slot was full, the Space Emperor had given up on contracting this pet egg and the idea of contracting a cosmic beast.
He planned to experiment on others first.
If the Space Emperor knew that there was a cub of a planet’s will in the egg, would he cry?
Planet… If a planet had a race, its level had to be divine, right?
Wait.
Something was wrong.
The Space Emperor might know that this was a planet cub.
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, the information Senior Lu obtained from the Void Mantis was that when the Space Emperor went to the starry sky, he accidentally entered a starry sky mystic realm and saw “many starry sky beasts” inside.
It wasn’t just one egg, but many lives.
In addition, if the Space Emperor didn’t know what this was, how did it know its hatching and contract method?
Shi Yu suddenly recalled the scene he had seen through his listening talent.
A purple and white planet seemed to have exploded, splitting into “countless” fragments.
If a fragment represented an egg, then this purple and white planet had more than one egg.
How could a planet give birth so easily?
“Lord World Tree…” At this moment, Shi Yu knew that only the World Tree clone in front of him could solve his confusion.
“This egg… was brought back by a senior from the starry sky and given to me.”
“Son of the Stars, the cub of the planet’s will, does such a thing really exist?”
“Also… why did you come in…”
“…” The World Tree was silent.
It suddenly realized that he seemed to have barged into someone else’s independent space.
Shi Yu was also very silent.
Even if a demigod wanted to barge into his space, it would probably take some effort.
In the end, the clone of the World Tree entered just like that.
At this moment, with the change just now and the intrusion of the World Tree clone,
In this layer of space, the Panda King Eleven, the Green Dragon Buggy, the Undying Ginseng Baby, and the others in training also quickly arrived. They were only a step slower than Shi Yu, who teleported through the authority of the master of the ruins, and the World Tree clone that suddenly barged in.
A shocking change naturally attracted their attention and attracted them over.
“Roar!!!” The Green Dragon Buggy was the first to arrive. Just as the World Tree clone was about to talk to Shi Yu, it saw the one-meter-long little green dragon fly into the research institute.
With a look, the World Tree clone was stunned and a little incredulous. It sensed extraordinary power that exceeded invincible overlords like the “Flame Dragon King” and the “Fallen Angel Prince” on this strange dragon-type creature.
And the life level of this creature seemed to be at the overlord level?
The second to arrive was the owner of the research institute, Ling. A violent wind blew, and Ling, who had turned into a Wind Kirin, looked at the shining Space Beast Egg and the World Tree clone that had entered the ruins solemnly.
“What’s wrong, Master?”
At this moment, the World Tree clone’s gaze landed on Ling again.
“Wind Kirin, no, it’s a mechanical life form, but, not completely.” With a look, it frowned. It actually couldn’t see through the life form of this creature at all. It looked like a mechanical life form created by humans, but it didn’t look like it either. At the same time, it sensed an incomparably mysterious potential from Ling. Was this… a mechanical phantom beast?
“Mi.” “Ning!”
Chi Tong and Susu followed closely. The normal power of the two pets far exceeded that of ordinary monarchs and was close to overlords. Their arrival also made the World Tree clone raise its eyebrows slightly. First, it sensed the power of a hybrid on Chi Tong, from humans and phoenixes. Then, it sensed a familiar wave on Susu. It kept feeling that it had seen this guy somewhere.
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng was late. It crawled out of the ground and came over. The Sun Flower swayed on its head and it looked at the World Tree clone with its green eyes.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng and the World Tree clone looked at each other. On Baby Ginseng, the World Tree Worm first judged that it was a supplement race. Then, it actually sensed many powerful powers such as life and death and time on it.
“Boom!” The last to come was Eleven, who was the furthest away. Its training location was assigned to the furthest place by Ling, mainly because its training was too brutal. Ling was afraid of it hurting the bypassers.
“This is…” At this moment, the World Tree clone was stunned again. It looked at the panda flying over with the electromagnetic levitation and actually felt power comparable to the totem level from it.
How was this possible?
“Sob.” At this moment, Eleven and the others looked into the room and asked Shi Yu what was wrong.
“It’s alright. Lord World Tree simply… came over as a guest,” Shi Yu said.
...
“They’re your pets?” At this moment, the World Tree clone suddenly realized something.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 908 Space Egg Hatching (2)
chapters.content:
908 Space Egg Hatching (2)
Two overlords comparable to totems and six monarchs comparable to overlords. These creatures were all pets of this human called Shi Yu?
He, a level-six Beast Tamer, contracted two overlords above his level?
Moreover, they were all so strong?
“…” However, when it recalled Shi Yu’s abnormal physique, the World Tree clone suddenly felt that it was normal.
Even legendary Beast Tamers who weren’t proficient in body forging weren’t as strong as this Shi Yu.
With such a physique, it was understandable for him to contract two overlords above his level.
No, Shi Yu’s strong physique might also be because of the feedback from these pets! It was mutual achievement! It focused on the Iron-eating Beast and the little green dragon with monster-like physical strength.
What race were these two guys?
The World Tree clone wanted to trace the origin and see the secrets of Eleven, Buggy, and even Ling clearly, but because the main body of the World Tree was still sleeping, it was also possible that the power on the other party had already exceeded its perception. What made the World Tree clone silent was that it actually couldn’t see through them.
It would be fine if Eleven and the others were demigods, but their life fluctuations were clearly not above the overlord level.
Most importantly, what surprised the World Tree clone was that the traces of life on their bodies were terrifyingly short.
They were basically not older than five years old!
“They… are indeed my pets.” Shi Yu nodded.
“You actually contracted two overlords above your level.”
At this moment, the World Tree clone was completely interested in this human Beast Tamer named Shi Yu!
A few days passed. The World Tree clone also understood Shi Yu a little.
He developed the fossil revival and mechanical phantom beast system. From there, through this system, he revived divine beast fossils and mobilized dream memories to spy on the Mythical Era.
The birth of the Mechanic class had already surprised the World Tree, and someone had relied on the Mechanic class to create a new phantom beast race that traced back to the Mythical Era, making it even more surprised.
The World Tree Branch Liquid was extremely precious, but at this moment, the World Tree clone didn’t regret giving it to Shi Yu at all. If this guy broke through to the legend level and relied on these pets, he would completely be a champion.
Even if it had already learned that there were two freaks who contracted totems above their level in this batch of contestants, it was still very likely that Shi Yu would do it.
As long as Shi Yu could obtain pretty good gains in the Mythical Trial…
Of course, it wouldn’t favor anyone. Whether it was the human that was the main battle power or the beast that was the main battle power, it was still verifying which of the two paths was better.
The two Beast Tamers who contracted totems above their level were both hybrids with special talents. Be it their bloodlines or Beast Taming Talents, they were tailor-made to contract specific lives. The restrictions were extremely strong, but it was undeniable that they had created a miracle.
Even the World Tree clone sighed. The totem clans were also advancing with the times. Their development of humans had reached an exaggerated level.
Contracting a totem-level life form was originally the patent of a level-nine legendary Beast Tamer.
However, it was reduced to level seven by the transcendent life form through modifying human bloodlines, talent, and modifying the contract method.
As for the human countries, the World Tree clone felt pretty good. For example, the appearance of a mechanical life form… was an extremely powerful battle power.
At the same time, this Shi Yu had also created a miracle.
“Of course,” the World Tree clone said.
“And it can be said to be the most common race in the universe.”
Shi Yu, Ling, and the others were slightly stunned as they looked at the World Tree clone.
“In the starry sky of the universe, there are countless planets. There are a few planets that will give birth to consciousness by chance. When the planet gives birth to consciousness, it has the initial qualifications to nurture divine-level life forms.”
“Although the lifespan of a planetary life form is very long, there’s still a limit. When the lifespan of a planetary life form reaches the end, it will break down and turn into countless children of stars that fly in all directions of the universe.”
“A planet might nurture more than a million Sons of the Stars. However, more than 99% of the Sons of the Stars will fail to hatch because they can’t absorb enough nutrition in the universe. As for those lucky ones who successfully hatch, they have to survive a relatively long weak period and grow quickly in danger to have the ability to protect themselves in the starry sky.”
“After all, the Son of the Stars is also food that many cosmic life forms like.”
At this moment, Eleven, Ling, and the others looked at the Space Beast Egg in shock.
So, the egg that Teacher Cat had always wanted to eat was a planet?
Therefore, Teacher Cat was also a cosmic life form?
Star cat…
“Can the Son of the Stars be contracted like ordinary pets?” Shi Yu asked.
According to the contract method provided by the Space Emperor, this kind of cosmic life form might be very strange. Just like heroic spirits, it would be bound to Beast Tamers in a special way.
Shi Yu felt that the Space Emperor might have come into contact with other Sons of Stars and had done a certain amount of research.
However, it was unknown if the Space Emperor knew that these Sons of Stars were cubs of a planet.
“In theory,” the World Tree clone said. “The Beast Taming Space of human Beast Tamers is created by simulating a planet. The growth of the Son of the Stars is the growth of the Beast Taming Space. The two will complement each other.”
“However, the complete growth difficulty of the Son of the Stars is also the highest in all lives.”
“The difficulty is equivalent to a Beast Tamer cultivating the Beast Taming Space from level nine to level ten.”
“The growth of the Son of the Stars is the process of shaping the laws of the world. They need to build a complete world in their bodies. It’s the same if Beast Tamers want to reach the Mythical stage. They need to shape the Beast Taming Space into a small world that contains laws.”

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 909 Space Egg Hatching (3)
chapters.content:
909 Space Egg Hatching (3)
“After completing this step, the life contracted by this Beast Tamer can easily comprehend the power of the natural order and break through to the Mythical stage.”
“Of course, these are still very far from you.”
Shi Yu looked surprised.
Legendary to Mythical meant to… mold the Beast Taming Space into an independent small world with laws?
!!
Legendary Beast Tamers had the ability to modify the Beast Taming Space. Therefore, after they died, the Beast Taming Space could transform into ruins and mystic realms. Shi Yu could still understand this, but how to mold the Beast Taming Space into a world that contained laws… Shi Yu was really…
No.
Shi Yu took a deep breath. Damn it.
Did his mind domain, such as the Taiji Domain, contain some kind of law?
The special environment of the spaces of those legendary Beast Tamers most likely came from their Beast Taming Talent.
Then in the future, could he integrate his mind domain into the Beast Taming Space? Create a world where Yin and Yang alternated?
“It has already absorbed a lot of nutrients, right?” The World Tree clone looked at the Space Beast Egg and said.
“Yes, it has already absorbed a lot of nutrients, but it should still be a little lacking… Just now, the World Tree Branch Liquid made it mutate. It seems to want to absorb the World Tree Branch Liquid very much.”
The World Tree clone was silent.
“This is also very normal. The World Tree Branch Liquid is the purest world energy on Blue Planet. It’s even more precious than the nutrients it absorbs that wander in the starry sky of the universe.”
“After absorbing it, its growth will be even smoother.”
“But you look like you want to hatch it very much, but you can’t bear to part with the World Tree Branch Liquid.”
The World Tree clone said.
Shi Yu : “…”
Since it knew, it should give him another one!!!
Wasn’t it good for them to raise this child together?
Didn’t it see that it liked its mother’s milk very much!
Shi Yu indeed wanted to hatch it.
If it was a Space Worm or an Abyssal creature, he wouldn’t be so interested.
After all, the Space Worm was basically a worm that had mastered an Infinite Devour skill.
Abyss Race… To put it bluntly, they were ducks.
There was nothing strange about it.
But the Son of the Stars.
Shi Yu really wanted to hatch it and see what skills it had.
“There’s nothing to be reluctant about.”
“Then I’ll give it to it. It doesn’t matter if I break through or not. Even if I’m level six, I can still become a world legend,” Shi Yu said.
After all, he was originally also here to win the world competition with level-six.
World Tree: “?”
“You seem very confident in your strength.”
The World Tree clone said.
It looked at Eleven and the others surrounding Shi Yu.
“Of course.” Shi Yu smiled.
At the same time, Shi Yu was puzzled.
Could the World Tree clone not tell the strength of Eleven and the others?
Including quasi-divine skills… faith skills…
Or rather, the World Tree clone didn’t even accurately judge his “self” strength at the start.
Otherwise, he should be like Divine Source Legendary and President Lin, determined that he could become the champion.
It was worse than he imagined.
Or could it be that the World Tree clone knew his strength, but there were stronger contestants?
“However, your choice was right.”
“I just said that the Beast Taming Space of human Beast Tamers is opened up by simulating a planet. The growth of the Son of the Stars is the growth of the Beast Taming Space. The growth of the Beast Taming Space is the growth of the Son of the Stars. The two will complement each other.”
“After you use the World Tree Branch Liquid to hatch it, even if you haven’t completed the contract, its ability can still assist you in increasing your cultivation speed.”
“After contracting it in the future, when the Mythical stage revives, it might be easier for you to break through to the Mythical stage than other Beast Tamers. The premise is that you all successfully grow up.”
After the World Tree finished speaking, Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He said happily, “Really?”
“Then I’ll hatch it now.”
“Think about it yourself.” The World Tree Worm stopped talking. A void vortex appeared behind it, as if it was about to leave.
It still had a mission. After figuring out the reason for the appearance of the Son of the Stars, it had no intention of staying on Shi Yu’s side anymore.
However, when the World Tree Worm was about to leave, someone panicked.
For example, Shi Yu.
“Wait, Lord World Tree, aren’t you going to see it hatch together?”
...
This was a child who had grown up after drinking its milk. Why was it leaving directly?
“I hope you don’t raise it to death.”
“In the Mythical Era, there were divine-level life forms who raised Sons of the Stars, but they all failed.”
“But I’ve never seen a human nurturing a Son of the Stars.” Before the World Tree clone left, it glanced at the Space Beast Egg. The Son of the Stars could be said to be the most difficult race to grow into.
It didn’t know if Shi Yu could successfully nurture it.
The World Tree clone left.
Only Shi Yu and the others were left on the spot in silence.
He looked at the Son of the Stars Egg that was still crying for food.
“I… want…”
Shi Yu heard the voice of the Son of the Stars through telepathy again.
Want… want to drink milk?
...
“Forget it, I’ll give it to you.” Shi Yu took out the World Tree Branch Liquid and used it to come into contact with the Space Beast Egg without hesitation.
In the next moment, a drop of white and green liquid in the World Tree Branch Liquid was directly absorbed by the white and purple-striped Space Beast Egg!
“Wuu?” “Ji?” “Yi!”
Eleven and the others widened their eyes and looked at the Space Beast Egg.
Ling’s expression also froze.
No wonder it couldn’t figure out anything no matter how it studied it.
Relying on its current intelligence level, it was ridiculous to research what the planet’s cub needed.
The Space Emperor… should have learned the hatching conditions from the Son of the Stars that he had already hatched?
At this moment, not only Ling, but even Shi Yu was more and more curious about where the Space Emperor had gone after disappearing into the starry sky.
In addition, he didn’t know if the mystic realm the Space Emperor accidentally entered was still around. Could it be that he disappeared after entering that mystic realm the second time?
The Space Egg didn’t shatter.
Instead, the light was even more dazzling.
It was as if it had evolved. At first, the light was dazzling, then the light disappeared. A new species that replaced the Space Beast Egg appeared in front of Shi Yu and the others.
“This is…”
Shi Yu and the others looked at the Son of the Stars who was trying its best to open his eyes.
It had a white spherical body and a pair of purple “cat ears” on its head, but in fact, at a glance, one could only see its upper body. The lower part and the surroundings of its back were wrapped in a rolling light purple gas. White starlight flickered from time to time in this gas. It was very beautiful.
On its white body, it had big clear eyes like a baby and a round mouth. Just as its blue-purple eyes opened, they were filled with endless curiosity about this world.
It really… hatched.
However, Shi Yu originally thought that it would be a ball. He didn’t expect it to be a ball wrapped in a nebula. Moreover, it had eyes and a mouth.
“Mi…” The Son of the Stars’s mouth trembled slightly. It looked at Shi Yu and the others before revealing a timid expression.
Its body retreated slightly with the purple nebula.
Without a doubt, there was no information about the Son of the Stars in the index.
If he wanted to know its situation, he had to understand it himself.
Shi Yu took a deep breath and stretched out his hand, trying to communicate with the Son of the Stars through telepathy.
He smiled and said,
“Little guy, come here and let Daddy see you ~”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the other pets: ???
They suspected that he wanted to take advantage of the World Tree!!
“Mi ~” The Son of the Stars hesitated for a moment and didn’t dodge Shi Yu’s hand. Then, it revealed a happy expression. Its entire body wrapped around Shi Yu’s hand and flew. Not only was the purple nebula a gas, but its white body seemed to be able to turn into gas too!
Shi Yu immediately discovered the speciality of the Son of the Stars.
At this moment, the Son of the Stars had no defense in its heart and mind. It was like a newborn baby. Shi Yu easily established a mental and spiritual connection with it and sensed its specific situation.
“Wu…”
Under Shi Yu’s perception, the physique of the Son of the Stars seemed to be especially special!
In its body, like Buggy’s spatial pocket, Susu’s Infinite Devouring Space, and Ling’s mechanical space, there was also an independent space.
However, unlike Buggy and the others, the evolution process of this space seemed to determine the abilities and forms awakened by the Son of the Stars next.
“I understand,” Shi Yu said.
The World Tree said that the growth of the Son of the Stars was the process of shaping the rules of the world. They needed to build a complete world in their bodies…
In other words, the process of nurturing the Son of the Stars was the process of creating the world in its body?

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 910 Taking Someone Else’s Path
chapters.content:
910 Taking Someone Else’s Path
“Awesome!”
No wonder the World Tree said that the Son of the Stars was difficult to nurture.
This was the rhythm of letting the cultivator become the “Creation God”.
If it wanted the Son of the Stars to take shape, its interior had to contain a complete set of laws that could support the operation of the world.
How much power of the natural order was needed?
It was already very rare for a more powerful divine-level life form to master three to four nomological divine skills, while a planet god needed even more than that.
“Earth, Blue Planet…”
Shi Yu quickly thought of various similar rules on Earth and Blue Planet.
But soon, he shook his head.
Too small, too small.
He had only seen what he had come into contact with, but he understood so many creation myths. Why didn’t he broaden his horizons?
For example, shaping the “world” into the “Three Realms of Dao”, based on the theoretical support of Yin Yang, naturally produced the three spaces of heaven, earth, and man.
For example, molding the “world” into the “World of Six Dao Reincarnations” and using the karma when he was alive as the foundation of the main world to create the Six Dao.
There was no need to be restricted to the technological world and the Beast Taming World.
As long as the rules were suitable, was it possible to create a “Immortal Cultivation World” and “Magic Battle Aura World”?
According to the World Tree clone, the complete standard of the Son of the Stars was that the inner world had the qualifications to create a “divine-level life form”.
Different divine-level lives could be created according to the different laws in the body.
In the beginning, Blue Planet had clearly taken the path of nurturing divine beasts, but now, it planned to nurture divine-level Beast Tamers.
Shi Yu looked at the Son of the Stars. He didn’t plan to let it take the same path as Blue Planet, but he hadn’t thought of what world to open up.
At the same time, the white ball with purple cat ears hid in the purple nebula and looked at Shi Yu strangely.
“Hehe.” It didn’t understand why Shi Yu was looking at it with a silly smile.
Although he had not completely thought about it, Shi Yu confirmed in a moment how to nurture this Son of Star.
Putting everything else aside, he definitely had to have the “faith law mechanism”.
How could it be easier to plunder the power of faith on Blue Planet than to create a world himself and become the only faith in this world?
At that time, Baby Ginseng would directly enter the body of the Son of the Stars and transform into a “World Tree”. Buggy would directly transform into a “Creation God Dragon”. The other pets would be the same. They would become the first batch of Creation God Spirits and the primitive gods of that world to obtain faith. Logically speaking, their strength should be able to increase greatly.
Similarly, when he nurtured Baby Ginseng, Buggy, and the others to the point where they could use the power of the natural order, it would be easier for the Son of the Stars to open a complete world with their help.
Shi Yu judged that the Mythical creatures of Blue Planet and the Mythical Era should also have this relationship of mutual achievement. However, Blue Planet might be a little higher than the Son of Star. It was an awareness born directly from the form of a planet.
If Blue Planet was a mother, then the son of a star was a daughter.
“Mi…” Just as it was born, the Son of the Stars looked extremely tired. Shi Yu could clearly sense that this guy was hungry.
“Food.”
Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng and Susu beside him.
The two of them were stunned. One took out a level-one Tree Fruit, and the other took out a diluted level-one Starry Sky Strange Water.
It was afraid that this newborn Son of Star couldn’t digest it if it was too high-level.
“Mi!”
Seeing the food, the Son of the Stars’s eyes lit up. It didn’t refuse anyone and didn’t care what it was. It directly flew over and swallowed it in one go.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh.
After eating, the Son of the Stars stopped and landed on the table. Shi Yu saw its satisfied expression.
“Stop training first.”
Shi Yu smiled at Eleven and the others.
“Let’s play with it for a while.”
As there was no contract, if they wanted to understand more about this new son of a star, Shi Yu and the others could only personally play with it and slowly come into contact with it.
…
< Name > Son of the Stars
[Attributes]: Space
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Level of Growth]: Transcendent
[Race Skill]: Inner world (Super skill, the body has a growth-type world. The growth of the world determines one’s growth and evolution.)
World Force (Super skill, can mobilize the laws, nature, faith, and other powers in the inner world to attack).
World Blessing (Super skill, can rely on the world itself to give other life blessings. The effect of the blessing depends on the world’s ability).
[Energy Points]: 10,0
After Shi Yu and the others studied it, they roughly understood the situation of the Son of the Stars.
Although he didn’t know if this was the limit of the Son of the Stars, from the abilities he had learned so far, the potential of the Son of the Stars was very strong.
Among them, the World Blessing was an ability similar to the World Tree Blessing.
The World Tree clone didn’t lie to him.
...
After the Son of the Stars blessed Shi Yu through this skill, Shi Yu could clearly sense that the speed of strengthening the Beast Taming Space had become faster.
Perhaps it was because the Son of the Stars had absorbed the World Branch Liquid that its blessing effect had a similar ability.
In fact, during the blessing period, the cultivation effect was comparable to his cultivation in the Space Emperor Ruins.
After all, the Son of the Stars was only at the transcendent level!
If it grew to the demigod level, wouldn’t its blessing effect be comparable to the blessing of the World Tree?
Moreover, under the blessed state, Shi Yu discovered that this enhancement completely didn’t conflict with the enhancement effect of the legendary ruins and the Blue Sea Ruins. His cultivation efficiency directly multiplied!
At this moment, Shi Yu was overjoyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 911 Taking Someone Else’s Path and Leaving Someone Else With No Way Out
chapters.content:
911 Taking Someone Else’s Path and Leaving Someone Else With No Way Out
The investment in the World Tree Branch Liquid was not a loss!
At the moment, the only thing that Shi Yu felt was a pity was that the Son of the Star was the same as the Time Sprite. He couldn’t teach other skills at all.
The racial restrictions were serious. Perhaps before it grew up, it could only increase its racial skills to lead its growth.
Also, its level was too low at the moment. Its inner world was not enough to support the entry of life forms “at the transcendent level and above”.
!!
As a result, even if Shi Yu and the others wanted to help it shape the world laws such as Yin Yang, they were unable to complete it.
Shi Yu decided.
After he broke through to the legendary level, he would first contract the Son of the Star and replicate its three racial skills. He would keep teaching it and let it become an overlord quickly.
At that time, it and the entire team could complement each other and quickly become stronger. At that time, with its power, he should be able to quickly break through to level eight and legendary…
“I’ll call you Little Zi. Meaning Little Purple.”
“Mi…”
After the entire team gave the Son of the Star a name, Shi Yu and the others watched as Little Zi fell asleep.
It had just been born and it had already given Shi Yu a world blessing. Little Zi was clearly very tired.
“Wu…”
After Little Zi fell asleep, Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng and the others.
“Sob.”
“Yi.”
“Ji.”
At this moment, Eleven and the others put away their smiles from playing with Little Purple just now.
Their expression was extremely serious.
Ridiculous.
It was very ridiculous.
Especially the three innermost brothers in the team, their expressions were extremely serious.
They felt that the guys who joined the team later were each more heaven-defying than the other.
Chi Tong, the power reincarnation of a Titled Legend, Susu, the strongest sea demigod reincarnation, Ling, the inheritance of a Mythical creature. In the end, another spatial law sprite and planet cub came.
Was there any way to stay in this team!
How far did they have to fight to maintain the advantage in the team?
“Well, it’s decided.”
At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly clapped and said.
“When the World Tree Fruit of the Alliance arrives, let’s see if it can be used as an evolution material for the ginseng baby to evolve in the direction of the World Tree.”
“Undying Sun Ginseng Evolution, World Ginseng.”
“When we win the world championship, let the World Tree help advise.”
“At that time, you and the Son of Star will be biological siblings of the same mother.”
This way, it and the Son of the Star might be able to support each other better.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng’s eyes lit up.
World Ginseng!
It sounded good.
“Jiu!!” Beside him, Chi Tong, who looked like a little red sparrow, immediately looked at Shi Yu eagerly.
Didn’t they agree to let it evolve after the world competition…
Why did Baby Ginseng obtain a Mythical evolution resource?
This was not scientific.
“Don’t worry, don’t worry. Don’t worry, I’ll definitely arrange the strongest evolution for you,” Shi Yu said to Chi Tong with a smile.
“The kind that can slash open a world with a sword.”
“I’ll inform them now. Ah, no, President Lin, please. Those legendary resources are all undead and fire-element.”
Chi Tong:!!
Ling: Another big show.
….
In the outside world, the preliminaries were still in full swing.
On Shi Yu’s side, after he was done with the hatching of the Son of the Star, he immediately ran over to look for President Lin anxiously.
At this moment, President Lin was still paying attention to Zou Yun and the others.
He even asked some old friends to give them temporary special training.
Although Shi Yu passed the preliminaries easily, it was still too difficult for other ordinary level-six Beast Tamers.
Shi Yu didn’t rely on pets and broke through the preliminaries himself. This was an extraordinary blow to Ji Feng, Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, and the others.
However, they were helpless. They could only comfort themselves with the fact that Shi Yu had eaten Mythical resources.
After all, the resources they used in their lifetime might not even be worth a tenth of the Undying Fruit. Thinking of this, they forcefully felt relieved.
...
“President Lin, is there any news of the resources from the alliance?”
“Legendary resources, can you give me fire-element or undead-element resources?”
In front of Shi Yu, President Lin said, “Didn’t we say that we could talk about faculties previously?”
“It’s used to strengthen Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit?”
President Lin was slightly stunned. It was difficult to imagine that Shi Yu’s current physique was even stronger than his, a titled legend. After all, he didn’t neglect training at all.
He instantly understood Shi Yu’s thoughts.
Shi Yu’s own physique, including his quasi totem-level soul power. If he was possessed by a powerful undead, wouldn’t his battle power… be even more ridiculous?
Totem-level battle power?
For a moment, President Lin was speechless. It was fine if Shi Yu had the two totem-level battle power, Eleven and Buggy, but he actually wanted to strengthen the third totem-level battle power… In other words, his and Chi Tong’s possession combination.
“Yes.” President Lin’s thoughts were actually right.
However, there was actually no need to strengthen it anymore. At the moment, the combination of Shi Yu and Chi Tong was already quite powerful. Fortunately, the Undying Fruit had strengthened Shi Yu’s soul to the quasi totem level. After combining with Chi Tong, this advantage could be even more obvious.
...
At the moment, the combination of Chi Tong and Shi Yu usually also had the battle power of an invincible overlord. If they used several undead puppets as scapegoats to slash out the strongest sword, it would be a proper totem-level sure-kill skill.
“It’s indeed better to have another trump card.”
“I’ll ask Senior Divine Source to urge them,” President Lin said.
“In addition, I’ll transmit you a piece of information.”
“This is the information on the contestants of the totem country that has just been concluded from the seven countries.”

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 912 Making Others Have No Way (3)
chapters.content:
912 Making Others Have No Way (3)
“Very important.”
“You came at the right time.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
Shi Yu’s index immediately received the information. At the same time, President Lin said,
!!
“According to statistics, there are a total of 99 totem countries participating in this world competition. Including the seven human countries, there are 106 factions.”
“There are a total of 702 contestants. Among them, there should be 136 Beast Tamers who have reached level seven.”
“Almost every totem country has a legend Beast Tamer participating.”
“At the moment, most level-six Beast Tamers in the totem country have contracted overlord lives above their level. 70% are low-level overlords of monarch races and overlords, 25% are ordinary overlords, and 5% are top-notch overlord battle power.”
“You don’t have to worry too much about this. It shouldn’t be very likely for a contestant to threaten you among level-six Beast Tamers.”
“What you have to care about is the trump cards of the nine demigod-level factions in the 99 totem countries.”
“Every one of them is almost an invincible existence among overlords. They have ‘quasi totem-level battle power’, and their battle power is enough to threaten totem-level lives.”
“The Dark Elven Prince of the Dark Night Forest, the Fire Dragon King of the Dragon Empire, the Fallen Angel of the Demon Kingdom, the Infinite Sea Region, the Void Court, the Arctic Icefield, the Eternal Desert, the Ghost Sea…”
“Among them, what you need to pay the most attention to is the Origin Land and the Dragonman Empire.”
Shi Yu was stunned, wondering if he had heard wrongly.
The place of origin needed to be taken seriously. He could understand this.
This place was actually a totem alliance that surpassed eight totem countries. It was the largest rainforest and forest area on Blue Planet, and also the area with the richest races. It was a huge faction that was not inferior to Dragon Palace City.
It was said that the current demigod, the Origin Tree God, had already undergone nine reincarnations. Every time it reincarnated, it could stand at the peak of the Origin Land again.
It was very normal to value this totem faction, but the Dragonman Empire…
The Dragonman Empire was the largest totem country in the vicinity of Dong Huang apart from Dragon Palace City. The commander was the Tyrant Dragon King. Although it was known as the strongest below the demigod level, it wasn’t a demigod yet. Therefore, the strength of the Dragonman Empire should be a little different from these true demigod factions.
“Could it be…” Shi Yu was stunned.
“They have totem levels?”
He quickly mobilized the information on the contestants of the totem country that he had just downloaded. Then, his expression changed.
As expected.
“Yes.” President Lin nodded and said, “The Origin Land, the Dragonman Empire, these two factions seem to have completed contracting totems above their level.”
“The totem of the Origin Land is the wood and lightning dual-element Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree, a plant-type life form.”
“And the totem of the Dragonman Empire is the son of the Tyrant Dragon King. It’s a dragonman hybrid, known as the most perfect dragonman hybrid.”
“The information on their contractor talent is unknown at the moment. It’s very secret.”
“But even if you ignore Beast Tamers, these two totems undoubtedly have the strength to crush overlords. They’re your great enemy. Whether you can win the championship depends on the outcome of the battle with them.”
“Of course… You also need to take the trump cards of the other demigod factions especially seriously. Each of them is only a step away from the totem level. Previously, they couldn’t break through, so they might just be accumulating their foundation. Now that they haven’t broken through, they might be worried that their contractors can’t withstand it, but if they obtain huge gains in the seven Mythical Trials, there might be hope of breaking through to the totem level.”
“At that time, they will also become your great enemy.”
“In fact, it’s even more threatening than the two totems I mentioned.”
“For example, the son of the Tyrant Dragon King is only known as the most perfect dragonman hybrid, but the Fallen Angel Prince of the Demon Kingdom is known as the most perfect hybrid. If it breaks through to the totem level, its battle power will probably be close to a top-notch totem.”
Shi Yu nodded. He had also noticed it.
For example, the Dark Elven Prince and the Fire Dragon King he had seen a few months ago. Initially, they only had about 90 million energy points, but when Shi Yu observed them again in Inatella, he realized that their energy levels were already nearly 100 million.
Even the normal energy value of the fallen angel with two souls had already exceeded 100 million, reaching the same “???” level as Eleven and Buggy.
These guys completed another round of strengthening before the World Tournament began.
“It’s indeed a little dangerous for them to obtain the inheritance in the Mythical Trial…” Shi Yu said,” I wonder what requirements the seven Mythical Trials have for the candidates. ”
“Looks like I have to get Ling to apply a Wind Blessing to me.”
“The pet attributes and types in my team are still very comprehensive. They involve various major attributes and major life forms. If I’m lucky enough to participate in all seven trials, it’ll be stable.”
“As long as I round up the seven Mythical Trial rewards, the contestants of the other totem countries won’t be able to obtain the rewards. If they can’t obtain the rewards, they won’t be able to become stronger, and they won’t be able to threaten me.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. If that was the case, it would be perfect.
Taking other people’s path left others with no path to take.
President Lin: …?
After a moment of silence, President Lin said, “Don’t forget, there are still the seven countries. Among the seven countries, the trump cards of the various countries, including Ye Xing, have also been heavily nurtured by the various countries. With all their strength, they might not necessarily lose to the trump cards of these demigod factions. If you want to cover the rewards, the legends of the other six countries will probably have to grit their teeth at you…”
It was better to be a human. It wasn’t as easy as he thought. It was impossible for him to use pandas and green dragons to kill all seven trials.
Shi Yu: …

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 913 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (1)
chapters.content:
913 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (1)
At this moment, not only did Shi Yu obtain the information of the contestants of the totem country, but the other contestants of the seven countries also obtained it.
The moment they obtained the information, the legendary contestants of Dong Huang and the others were extremely solemn.
The background and names of the invincible overlords of these demigod factions alone were very oppressive.
Moreover, the Origin Land and the Dragonman Empire were actually suspected to have Beast Tamers who contracted totems two levels higher?
What the hell!
Could they still play happily together?
“This world competition is the most ridiculous one I’ve ever watched.”
Zheng Hai accompanied his master. The Tyrannical Sea Legend looked at this information and said in a low voice, “Looks like I still underestimated the cruelty of this world competition. Even if you break through to the legend level, it’s still filled with danger.”
“Even if I deal with these contestants, including the two totems, it might take some effort.”
Zheng Hai said, “It’s alright, I’m a satisfied person. It’s fine as long as Ye Xing and the others can achieve good results on behalf of Dong Huang.”
“Well, it depends on what’s going on with this so-called Mythical Trial inheritance. If it’s a test of battle power, it won’t have any advantage for most contestants, but if it’s a test of other things, there might still be hope.”
The various totem countries also obtained the information on the legend contestants of the seven countries.
Although various countries kept it a secret, it was impossible not to leave any traces. About 60% of the information could still be detected.
Among them, the legend of Dong Huang’s army, Ye Xing, the legend of Xue Yuan’s army, Andre, the legend of Shen Feng’s army, Qiao Sen, and the Holy Maiden of the Divine Church of Light, Amelia, were all regarded by the totem country as having “Titled Legendary battle power”.
In other words, with their entire team added together and the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Talent, they had the strength to temporarily resist the totem level and could be said to be invincible among overlords.
The trump cards of the Seven Islands, Ming Hua, and Tingxiang of the lower three countries were relatively weaker in the eyes of the totem countries. This was also because these three countries had never entered the top four in the first three world competitions.
However, this world competition was extraordinary after all. The totem country also thought highly of these three countries and thought that their trump card had the battle power of an “invincible overlord” at full strength.
“And this Shi Yu…” Apart from the legendary contestants of the seven countries, the totem countries focused on Shi Yu. However, there was even less information about Shi Yu.
Apart from the title of the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang and the founder of the mechanical phantom beast, the totem country had not even investigated Shi Yu’s pet information.
Some totem countries with connections actually only investigated the so-called battle results of the National League… This thing could be used as a reference. The championship was not as valuable as the title of number one person below the legend level.
But the number one person below the legendary level… The various totem countries basically ignored this title in the past.
The information on the legendary contestants of the other seven countries was investigated more comprehensively because the totem country had started investigating very early. As for Shi Yu, his rise was too fast. Previously, he was still unknown. In addition, after becoming famous, the information was protected too well by Dong Huang, so the totem country had no way to start.
However, considering the terrifying battle power of Shi Yu’s main body and his identity as the strongest archeologist, not many people dared to underestimate Shi Yu.
In addition to his arrogant championship declaration… If he didn’t have hard strength, he definitely wouldn’t dare to talk nonsense.
For the time being, the various totem countries regarded Shi Yu as the legend battle power of the seven countries’ trump cards… Although Shi Yu had yet to reach the Legend level.
At this moment, Shi Yu still didn’t know that he had already been especially valued by the totem country. However, even if he knew, he didn’t mind. This was because no matter how the totem country investigated, it was impossible for them to know all his trump cards.
Chaos Panda, Green Dragon Buggy, Wind Kirin, mind domain, self-destruction ginseng… Go investigate!
As for Shi Yu, he didn’t believe that there was a Beast Tamer’s foundation above his in the totem countries and the seven countries.
The preliminaries were still in full swing. Shi Yu didn’t pay attention to Senior Lu, Gao Xuan, and the others. Without thinking, he knew that they were all undergoing temporary special training.
After knowing the information about the contestants of the totem country, they naturally had to prepare for battle. It was probably the same for the totem country. The various countries were at odds.
It was about the same for him. In the next two days of the Shi Yu preliminaries, one was to adjust his state, and the other was to work hard in meditation to see if he could break through to the legend level quickly.
Just like that, the preliminaries were coming to an end.
On Dong Huang’s side, it was very worth celebrating. Be it Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, or Ji Feng, they passed the preliminaries after seven days of hard work.
Gao Xuan received the guidance of the Mechanical Legendary. The Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast and other mechanical pets completed the fusion evolution and loaded a super-scale weapon developed by the Mechanical Legendary. Only then was he lucky enough to pass the preliminaries.
In the end, Ji Feng used the paywall battle strategy every time in accordance with the rules and barely passed the preliminaries with the help of more than ten battle experience.
Zou Yun had it the most difficult. The financial group that cultivated him was unwilling to see Zou Yun lose the preliminaries. They invested a lot of money in dark-element legendary resources. After Zou Yun’s pile of dark-element pets used them, they obtained the ability to increase their battle power greatly in the night. He worked hard for seven consecutive nights and only fought in the night every day. Only then did he barely win against a guardian.
It had to be said that major competitions could often stimulate one’s potential more. Although the guardian overlords of the preliminaries had low intelligence and a single battle pattern, and their incomplete life forms weren’t real life forms, their battle power was still incomparable to ordinary overlords. And now, it wasn’t just Dong Huang. Seven days later, level-six Beast Tamers from the other six countries also passed the preliminaries through various methods.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 914 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (2)
chapters.content:
914 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (2)
In the end, including the contestants of the totem country’s preliminaries, a total of 120 of the nearly 600 level-six Beast Tamers passed the preliminaries.
Moreover, more than half of these 120 people had received the rewards of the World Tree.
Of course, the best reward was still Shi Yu’s World Tree Branch Liquid. Ever since then, there had been no reward that exceeded the level of the World Tree Leaf.
This was similar to what President Lin said. Among level-six Beast Tamers, there were no contestants that Shi Yu needed to care about.
Shi Yu’s real enemy was still the trump card of those demigod factions.
…
After the preliminaries ended, President Lin immediately informed Shi Yu that the resources rewarded by the archeological Conference had arrived.
Shi Yu stopped cultivating. He was still a little far from level seven. He couldn’t help but feel that it was a pity, but when he heard that the resources had arrived, he was immediately overjoyed.
Shi Yu came out of the ruins and came to President Lin.
“Two Mythical resources. They’re the World Tree Fruit and the Soul Pearl.”
“There are also two legendary resources. They’re the undead-element Spirit World Fragment, Fire-element Hollow Flame.”
“Spirit World fragment, Space Crystal Flame?” Shi Yu looked at President Lin and asked, “What are these?”
Shi Yu naturally knew what the World Tree Fruit and the Soul Pearl were.
However, Shi Yu was very surprised by the two legendary resources President Lin brought.
He vaguely remembered that it seemed to be a spatial resource. He didn’t know if he remembered wrongly.
“These two resources can be said to have been specially found for you.”
President Lin smiled and said, “The Spirit World Fragment is actually a spatial fragment of a ruin called the Spirit World. This ruin is at the Mythical stage. It shattered for unknown reasons, and a total of seven core fragments were separated. Every one of them is a legendary resource. After refining it, it can allow the soul attack of undead-type creatures to have its own tearing effect and increase spatial attainments. Apart from that, it can also give undead-type creatures the physique to travel through space.”
“You often explore ruins and mystic realms. Resources with spatial effects are more useful to you.”
“The Heart Flame is also a similar resource. After refining it, not only can it strengthen fire-element power, but it can also increase the user’s spatial attainments, allowing its fire moves to burn the spatial crystal wall more easily. It’s considered a spatial-element Strange Fire seed.”
“I remember that General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit is proficient in mastering the power of the soul and the sun, but it’s not proficient in spatial power.”
“Indeed.” Shi Yu nodded.
Against spatial enemies, he was already used to using Eleven or Buggy.
As for the other pets, they basically relied on equipment or brute force.
For example, if Chi Tong wanted to crush a spatial pet, it just had to possess a hardened iron sword enchanted with the Space Quake effect. It was enough to kill indiscriminately.
Therefore, he didn’t let them specialize in spatial power cultivation.
It was mainly because there was a shortage of skill bars at the moment. Shi Yu couldn’t let every pet take care of everything.
When it reached the totem level, it could optimize his skills itself.
“Next is the ruins trial. Let Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit refine it and take a look. Even if it can only refine 10% of its strength, it’s not bad.”
“I’ll also give you the World Tree Fruit. Use it if you can. It can be used to increase the skill proficiency of the Chaos Panda and the Green Dragon. Although they’re powerful, they’ve just evolved. Their racial skill proficiency is still too low. It might become their shortcoming in fighting other invincible overlords and even totems.”
“As for the Soul Pearl, according to you, it’ll be safeguarded at the Dong Huang Association first.”
“Alright.” As President Lin and Shi Yu chatted, the change in the sky of Inatella Island happened quietly.
On the island, countless green worms flew into the sky and gathered.
Under the combination, a gorgeous green eagle was born.
Right on the heels of that, an eagle cry that shook the forest and stopped the clouds suddenly appeared.
Buzz!!!
Under the cry of the eagle, Shi Yu and President Lin felt the surrounding space tremble.
“It’s the World Tree clone.”
Seeing this, President Lin and Shi Yu looked up.
“Don’t tell me the Mythical Trial is about to begin so soon,” Shi Yu said.
The preliminaries had just ended less than two hours ago. Wasn’t this giving them merely two days to prepare?
However, just as Shi Yu and the others thought, the green eagle flew in the air and circled for a while. After attracting the attention of all the lives on Inatella Island, its voice sounded again.
“The Mythical Trial is about to begin. All contestants of the World Tournament, head to the location of the ‘fire-element arena’ during the preliminaries. I will awaken the divine-level creature of the Mythical Era, the ‘Boar God’, here.”
“The first Mythical Trial will be set by the ‘Boar God’.”
Boar God!
At this moment, the hundreds of factions on Inatella Island were stunned.
They had never heard of this name.
Although the Mythical Era had ended, because humans in the future had never given up on archeology, the later generations still had a little understanding of the Mythical Era. For example, the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin were the three Mythical races in the east. These were all known to people.
However, countless archeologists and legendary demigod experts present had never heard of what kind of god the Boar God was.
“Isn’t the fire-element arena Dong Huang’s side?” Shi Yu said.
President Lin nodded and said, “Yes.”
Dong Huang was already in a heated discussion.
Although they didn’t know what kind of god the Boar God was, everyone took a deep breath and understood. A divine beast that had existed since the Mythical Era was about to be awakened by the World Tree!!
They were going to see a true god.
This world competition was not in vain.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 915 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (3)
chapters.content:
915 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (3)
“What will a real god look like?” The demigod legendaries in the alternate space opened their eyes and looked in the direction of the Fire Arena.
At this moment, the green eagle continued, “The Boar God is a fire-element god. In the Mythical Era, it once destroyed countless Space Worms and made them into food to share with the gods. It gave them a taste of their own medicine. It’s very powerful.”
Holy shit!
When the World Tree clone finished speaking, not only were the lives of the various countries stunned, but even Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
!!
They had seen the Wind Kirin’s dream.
Even the Wind Kirin had to escape from the hunt of the Space Worms. This Boar God actually made the Space Worm into food?
Although the Wind Kirin was only a cub and the laws it mastered were not good at battle, the strength of the Space Worm was definitely very strong. This Boar God could survive until the end of the invasion war and use the invaders as food. Obviously, it was strong to the point of explosion.
“This Boar God must be the main battle power in that war.”
“It’s just… I wonder what form its inheritance will take.”
Everyone discussed. At the same time, the fire arena where the fire python overlord previously existed buzzed and vibrated. The surrounding space was directly red.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the entire fire-element arena instantly turned to ashes. The shocking red light seemed to have burned through this space, causing another space to descend into the world.
At this moment, on the ground in the entire outside world, spiral flames directly formed a domain in a large area. Under the burning of the void in the center, a huge figure dozens of meters tall slowly formed.
Dong…
The moment its figure was outlined, it was as if the island had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power on the island were all suppressed. Even the demigods in the alternate space felt the violent vibration around them. Moreover, it was as if their necks were being strangled. It was very difficult to breathe, and they felt their bodies heat up.
“This law strength…” The demigods were extremely shocked. Legendary Beast Tamers’ gazes were solemn to the extreme. This was the first time in their lives that they had felt such a terrifying pressure.
This Boar God gave them a feeling that although the strength in the other party’s body was very weak, if they fought, they would also be in extreme danger.
Swoosh!!!
Under the sound of laws, all the creatures on the island, including Shi Yu and the demigods who could be called Mythical races, felt the suppression from their realms.
As the voice echoed, when the living beings present reacted again, the entire island had already become a fiery red world. The sky and ground had all turned red.
“I slept for a long time.” In the center of the flames, the full appearance of a huge creature appeared in the flames. It had a humanoid body. Its legs, abdomen, and arms were filled with black muscles. A few messy dark red bristles stained its body, forming fire-like patterns.
Its head shocked many factions, because it was a pig head. Although its face had demon-like fire patterns and its long fangs were filled with deterrence, its iconic pig nose made people recognize its race at a glance.
Among the many totem countries, an inconspicuous group of pig-headed people stretched out their arms with trembling bodies and looked at the huge monster. No one expected that the very powerful Boar God in the mouth of the World Tree clone was actually a god similar to a pigman.
“Lord Boar God, according to the agreement, I’ll leave the rest to you.” At this moment, in the sky, the green World Tree Giant Eagle faced the Boar God.
“I understand, little guy.” The Boar God glanced at the green eagle and said loudly.
The conversation between the World Tree clone and the Boar God shocked everyone again.
Wait a minute, wasn’t the World Tree the clone of Blue Planet’s will? Logically speaking, shouldn’t its status be very high?
