Even if it was a god from the Mythical Era, it should have been born on Blue Planet…
Everyone kept feeling that there were secrets they didn’t know.
The Boar God looked at the World Tree clone. The others didn’t know, but as a batch of gods who had made a deal with the will of Blue Planet and were sleeping in Inatella, how could it not know?
Although the World Tree was said to be a clone of Blue Planet, it was actually just a spokesperson created by Blue Planet to accelerate the revival of the Mythical stage. Compared to a clone, it was more like a child who had inherited some of Blue Planet’s will and power. In terms of status, it was just a junior of their group of divine beasts that had experienced the invasion war.
After all, if it weren’t for them protecting Blue Planet together, Blue Planet would have long been completely destroyed, and the World Tree wouldn’t have been born.
“Are these the so-called human Beast Tamers?” At this moment, the Boar God looked at the 100,000 lives surrounding it and at the demigod experts hidden in the alternate space, revealing an interested expression.
Its huge fangs revealed light, and its red eyes revealed curiosity.
Because it had slept for a long time, the power in its body was already very weak, equivalent to the overlord level. Because the laws of the world were incomplete, its divine skill had fallen to a quasi-divine skill. However, the pressure it gave the outside world was still very powerful.
After all, with the blood of a god, even a demigod couldn’t determine the strength of this Boar God at this moment.
“Roar…” A weak hot wind blew from its mouth. After sweeping its gaze, it said,” Compared to other things, it’s indeed better to look at strength. “

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 916 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (4)
chapters.content:
916 Beginning of the Mythical Trial (4)
The huge Boar God raised its thick arm. White flames condensed and gradually formed a flaming saber. On the saber that was dozens of meters long, white flames that looked like liquid started rising with layers of life aura, spreading a shocking vitality.
Boom!
The Flame Blade was stabbed into the ground by the Boar God.
“This…” At this moment, all the demigods were shocked.
!!
Because this move of the Boar God completely defeated them. In terms of control over the power of the natural order, they were completely inferior to this Boar God. The other party… actually casually condensed a fire blade suspected to be a Mythical resource that contained quasi-power of the natural order?!!
“Next, here. With humans as the main body, you can only send fire-element creatures to battle. You guys will decide the strongest. The strongest can obtain my former weapon. It contains the law of life.”
“It’s called the ‘Spirit Ascension Blade’. With a slash, it can make a dead object give birth to a soul, turn a seed into a divine plant, and let the soul shape the body. It was my weapon at that time. Although it’s already broken, it’s still a rare treasure for creatures who have never mastered a divine skill. Come, let me see your strength. Who can take away the Flame Blade that contains the ‘law of life’ and take away the Life Fire?” It laughed and looked at the many lives.
Mythical resources!
At this moment, all the Beast Tamers with fire-element pets in the seven countries felt their hearts heat up. The eyes of all the fire-element overlords of the totem countries were filled with heat. Even the totems and demigods leading the teams looked at this “Spirit Ascending Saber” with fanaticism.
Without a doubt, this was a Mythical resource that had a huge increase in effect even for demigods.
The value of this resource was even worth a totem changing its attributes and evolving towards the fire element for it!!
“I, Punkham, want this resource!!!” At this moment, the heir of the Dragon Empire, the Fire Dragon King, who thought that it was the strongest fire-element creature in this world competition, had greedy flames in its dragon eyes.
Hahahaha, the heavens were helping it.
He didn’t expect that the first Mythical Trial required fire-element creatures.
The strongest fire element?
Wasn’t this referring to it?
The totems of the Origin Land were wood and lightning dual-element. The son of the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragonman Empire was a pure dragon-element. The dragon-element contained some wood and water properties, not fire dragons, but evolution towards the green dragon.
Neither of these two totems was qualified to compete. Ye Xing mainly cultivated the power of the stars, and his pet’s attributes were spread across various elements. Although there were fire-element pets that cultivated the power of the sun, they weren’t trump cards. They were definitely not its match. Xue Yuan’s Andre’s was an ice-element pet, Shen Feng’s Qiao Sen was a Mechanic, and Rongguang’s Amelia was also a light-element pet.
The trump cards of the other demigod factions didn’t major in fire either. The Dark Night Forest and the Demon Kingdom were dark-element, the Endless Sea Region was water-element, the Ghost Sea was undead-element, the Arctic Icefield was ice-element, the Void Court was spatial-element, and the Eternal Desert was earth-element. From the looks of it, no one could compete with it at all.
Hahahaha.
It had the strength of an invincible overlord. Coupled with the “Armored Transformation” talent of its contracted servant, it was definitely invincible among overlords and fire-element creatures.
Even if this Life Fire didn’t look like something that could increase its battle power in the short term, as long as it obtained this, this world competition wouldn’t be a loss. Even if it couldn’t win the final championship, it wouldn’t be a loss.
This could at least ensure that it stepped onto the path of a god after the Mythical Revival. This was clearly the inheritance of this Boar God!!
“Holy shit, fire-element.”
At the same time, the Flame Time King was as excited as the Flame Dragon King.
“Hehehehe.” Excited laughter also came from beside President Lin’s side. Shi Yu’s eyes burned with flames as he said, “Fire element is good, fire element is good. What a good start.”
“This, I can give it to Chi Tong too! Otherwise, it’ll say that I’m biased every day.”
He and Chi Tong cooperated. No matter what, they had to take this resource. Mine, mine, it was all mine.
—-

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 917 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (1)
chapters.content:
917 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (1)
After the boar’s words, all the fire-element creatures were extremely excited.
All the non-fire-element creatures and Beast Tamers’ expressions darkened.
As expected…
Just as the World Tree clone had said, these divine-level life forms actually restricted their attributes when choosing heirs.
!!
Shit!
“Why does it have to be fire-element!”
The tree sprite of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree,
The Green Dragon Prince of the Dragonman Empire’s gaze froze, revealing a dissatisfied gaze.
They were at the totem level. They had a huge advantage in the World Tournament, and there was a high chance of them finally obtaining the blessings of the World Tree.
But if other contestants obtained the inheritance in the seven Mythical Trials and broke through, their advantage would disappear.
This Living Fire that contained the Laws of Life was clearly a good thing.
Seeing others obtain it was even more uncomfortable than losing resources.
“Fire element!”
However, after the fire-element creatures were excited, they quickly calmed down.
Among the 106 factions present, there were actually many fire-element overlords.
Among them, even after cooperating with the Beast Tamer, there were many fire-element creatures with the strength of top-notch overlords.
But at this moment, their hearts were no longer as hot as flames.
They looked in the direction of the Dragon Empire, at the domineering Fire Dragon King.
They looked in the direction of the Lava Empire, at the powerful and domineering Lava Beast.
These two fire-element creatures should be the strongest among them.
The Dragon Empire was a demigod-level faction. As its heir, the Fire Dragon King’s strength was naturally without a doubt.
As for the Lava Empire, it was located in the largest volcano on Blue Planet and had a rich foundation.
There were many lava countries, including a lava country near the Seven Islands.
However, there was only one Lava Empire. Their territory was larger, their race was stronger, and it was even the only Lava Nation that cultivated and raised humans.
Commanders, like the Tyrant Dragon King, were close to demigods.
At this moment, the Lava Beast of the Lava Empire also stood on the ground and looked at the Life Fire with a burning gaze.
Boom!!
Be it the Fire Dragon King or it, there was a shocking deterrence eruption on their bodies. It had actually reached transcendent.
Seeing them, the hearts of the other fire-element overlords immediately felt like they had been doused with cold water.
These two were recognized as strong in the various totem countries. How could they compete with them…
Wait!
Was there a chance to watch from the sidelines?
Let the Fire Dragon King and the Lava Beast fight first and wait for both of them to suffer?
Many fire-element creatures had this thought.
Otherwise, directly fighting and competing with them was no different from courting death.
The chances of victory were too small.
“Ye Xing.” In the Dong Huang area, Divine Bell shouted for Ye Xing.
As for Ye Xing, he shook his head. “My Red Sun Rock, together with my Beast Taming Talent, is already at the limit to fight top-notch overlords. The chances of defeating them with a single pet are very small.”
After a moment of silence, Divine Bell said, “My Fire Plume Fan is the same.”
Although she was a descendant of a Mechanical Legendary, Divine Bell’s Beast Taming Talent was very strange. That was, the more ancient the contracted pet, the stronger the power it could display.
Therefore, she basically contracted some antique sword-type undead.
However, she was not very interested in archeology. With her identity, she could obtain such a pet as long as she made a request. There was no need to search for it herself.
“Jie Yi.”
In the direction of the Seven Islands, Jie Yi of the Phoenix Court was also extremely silent. Beside her, Legend Ji Xiang of the Phoenix Court pressed her shoulder and let her watch for the time being.
It was very difficult for a young man who had just broken through to the legend level to compete for that living fire.
At this moment, everyone was extremely afraid.
The rules of this Mythical Trial were very simple, to the point of being simple and crude.
Whoever was the strongest fire-element would obtain the Living Fire.
However, it was such a rough rule that made many fire-element overlords and fire-element Beast Tamers’ heads hurt.
It was better to do some complicated trials that tested talent or potential.
Comparing battle power… was that appropriate!
Wasn’t this clearly not giving anyone a chance?
“No one?”
At this moment, a huge square fire domain was formed on the red ground under the Boar God’s feet. The flames that rose surrounded a fire arena.
...
It said, “Those who are confident in their strength can come and defend the arena. There’s no need to worry about consumption. As long as you obtain a victory, I’ll bathe your entire bodies in this Life Spirit Fire, producing the fire power you consume and the injuries you suffer. Before sunset, you can finally obtain this Life Spirit Fire in this domain.”
“The process of bathing in the Life Fire is also the process of strengthening yourself. Therefore, even if you can’t stand to the end, as long as you win a battle, you can also be strengthened. The premise is… that you can survive the next battle.”
“Similarly, if you clearly have strength but don’t come up for a long time, this fire will decrease greatly under continuous consumption. Even after obtaining it, it won’t be complete.”
“So if any of you are interested, come up quickly. Stop dawdling.”
The mythical boar fell.
Everyone’s hearts tightened.
This was clearly not comfortable.
“President Lin, my luck is pretty good. I’ll win this trial.”
“I’ll go first. If I don’t go soon, I’ll be used by others.”
At this moment, Shi Yu stared at the Boar God, the Life Fire, and the Fire venue and smiled.
“Shi Yu, you…”
...
“Although your strength is very strong after Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit possesses you, won’t it be a little risky? After all, it’s only at the monarch level.”

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 918 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (2)
chapters.content:
918 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (2)
“It’s alright.”
At the same time, on President Lin’s side, his heart tightened as he looked at Shi Yu, who flew to the Fire Arena without thinking.
Shi Yu… had gone to defend the arena!
As for Shi Yu’s fire-element pet, Chi Tong seemed to be the only one. Chi Tong was only at the monarch level!
Although after possessing Shi Yu, it might have battle power comparable to an invincible overlord, the burden would definitely be very high. It would probably be very difficult to resist an invincible overlord like the Fire Dragon King.
Moreover, the Fire Dragon King also had a Beast Tamer.
Was it really alright to be the first to defend the arena just like that?
From Shi Yu’s anxious appearance, it seemed like he was afraid that others would use some of his Life Fire.
[No problem.]
As Shi Yu flew, his heart was firm.
The Boar God had said it.
It was a fire-element battle with human Beast Tamers as the main body.
In other words, if a human Beast Tamer contracted seven fire-element creatures, seven could be used in battle.
Others might not know, but Shi Yu knew that Baby Ginseng had also obtained a weak fire attribute after evolution.
Although it was the last attribute, it indeed had a fire body. In other words, he could use Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng as two pets.
In such a situation, regardless of whether it was the Fire Dragon King or the Lava Beast, even if it was at the totem level, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and his own combination might be able to fight.
Since the attributes matched him, he had to take this trial.
Living Fire…
The Law of Life…
Not bad.
When Chi Tong’s few undead skills were trained to the extreme, it might be able to touch the law of death. With another law of life, it would be the Great Dao of Life and Death.
In fact, Shi Yu felt that there was no need for the fake fire-element ginseng baby.
As long as the opponent wasn’t a totem, he and Chi Tong could kill indiscriminately!
…
After the Boar God said this, both the Fire Dragon King and the Lava Beast couldn’t sit still anymore.
They planned to be the first to go up and defend the arena.
However, the Fire Arena was the closest to Dong Huang after all. One person’s speed was faster than the others.
Everyone looked at the human figure flying under the Psychic wrap in shock.
He was wearing a dark red trench coat, and his clothes and short hair fluttered in the wind. That familiar face immediately reminded the people of the various factions of the figure who shamelessly announced the championship declaration in the preliminaries.
“I will become a new world legend!”
This kid wasn’t just saying.
In the Mythical Trial of battle power, he really dared to be the first to stand out, as if he could really defeat those invincible overlords.
“Shi Yu…”
“Shi Yu, he…”
At this moment, as Shi Yu flew to the arena and slowly landed in the fire arena, he raised his head and looked at the Boar God. Everyone was shocked.
Even the World Tree clone immediately looked at Shi Yu in silence.
This kid…
If it remembered correctly, Shi Yu’s bear and dragon were indeed very strong, but fire-element…
His fire-element pets seemed to only be at the monarch level?
How did he dare to accept this Mythical Trial?
The relationship between the totem countries and the seven countries had always been incompatible. In this competition, it was impossible to hold back.
If anything went wrong, he would die.
Although… Shi Yu might not be afraid of death.
“Shi Yu…” At this moment, as Shi Yu appeared, Senior Panda, White Brook, and the others’ expressions turned cold. No outsider knew that Baby Ginseng had evolved into a fire element. Therefore, in everyone’s impression, Shi Yu only had Chi Tong’s fire element.
The advantage of the Beast Tamers of the seven countries was to contract multiple pets. At this moment, Shi Yu clearly didn’t have this advantage. What could he use to compete with the Beast Tamers of the totem country who specialized in cultivating overlords one-on-one?
“It shouldn’t be… a problem, right?” Lu Qingyi took a deep breath. She felt that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be someone who would attack when he wasn’t confident.
In addition, even if the opponent was a totem country, they shouldn’t kill Shi Yu. After all, if Shi Yu died, no one would have an easy time.
“It’s that human archeologist.”
In the alternate space, the demigods’ gazes were deep, while the legendaries of the seven countries suddenly frowned. Even if it was the Divine Source Legendary, it was the same. He acknowledged the strength of the Chaotic Panda and the Green Dragon, but he really didn’t know much about Chi Tong.
General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit reincarnation… sounded very powerful.
But which demigod faction’s heir didn’t have titled battle power at this moment?
Was Shi Yu really that confident?
At that moment, Shi Yu stood on the arena, surprising the Boar God. It said, “I thought humans didn’t have transcendent abilities, but it turns out that they can use Psychic power. Forget it, then let me see your strength.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “A hybrid human has some transcendent abilities, but I’m not a hybrid. I’m using Psychic power developed with special resources.”
...
With that said, he looked around.
To be honest, Shi Yu didn’t want to fight a tag battle.
Even if it was himself, Shi Yu didn’t want to consume some Life Fire first.
He wanted to take back the complete Life Fire and keep it for research.
Therefore, in order to avoid endless challenges, just as Shi Yu arrived, he said to everyone, “Sorry, I want this Life Fire.”
“I hope everyone can give me face.”
“Swords have no eyes. I can’t guarantee that the challenger, especially the challenger of the totem countries, can end the battle alive.”
Boom!!
With that said, a spiritual wave comparable to an overlord bloomed from Shi Yu’s body, making everyone’s hearts skip a beat.
They were shocked by Shi Yu’s words.
The fire-element overlords of the totem country instantly revealed anger.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 919 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (3)
chapters.content:
919 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (3)
Was this human threatening them?
At this moment, all the fire-element overlords with battle power above top-notch overlords, especially the Lava Beast and the Fire Dragon King, had mocking smiles on their faces.
This human had only eaten one Undying Fruit. Wasn’t he too arrogant?
Did he really think that no one dared to kill him?
So what if a human revived into a totem? It was just the weakest totem.
For invincible overlords like them who could resist ordinary totems, resisting was really not a problem.
At this moment, after Shi Yu went up, many top-notch overlords were tempted.
Although Shi Yu had defeated a top-notch overlord alone, the guardian overlord of the preliminaries was only the weakest top-notch overlord. Many of the overlords present had the will of overlords, energy values above 80 million, and the enhancement of Beast Tamers. They were confident that they could instantly kill the guardian overlord of the preliminaries.
Therefore, when they saw Shi Yu appear, they wanted to meet him first.
At least this guy was much easier to deal with than invincible overlords like the Fire Dragon King.
As long as they could freeload on the Flame of Life once, it wouldn’t be a loss.
At most, when they encountered stronger experts next, they would directly admit defeat.
At the thought of this, many fire-element creatures jumped up excitedly.
In the west, an Undying Bird covered in blue flames suddenly flew towards the arena.
In the south, a lion covered in flames ran towards the arena.
They all had a young Beast Tamer on them, but their master and servant identities were obvious.
Shi Yu looked at these overlords and his heart turned solemn. Their energy levels were all above 80 million. There was also the will of overlords and even legend Beast Tamer servants… Their energy levels could probably easily erupt to more than 100 million. No wonder they dared to challenge him.
However…
“Roar!!!!!”
Like Shi Yu, the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, also soared into the sky. At the same time, a transcendent-level dragon might enveloped the sky and earth and directly crushed the Undying Bird and the Holy Flame Lion.
Obviously, it didn’t want anyone to beat it to it. It wanted to use its Life Fire first.
Both Shi Yu and the Fire Dragon King wanted to obtain the complete Life Fire.
Therefore, it was impossible for them to let others determine the winner on the arena first, even if was just taking a bit of life fire.
< Name > Fire Dragon King
[Attributes]: Dragon, Fire
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Energy Points: 96,990,0
Compared to the power of the Undying Bird and the Holy Flame Lion, the dragon power of the Fire Dragon King was clearly more violent.
Under the envelopment of its dragon might, the expressions of the Undying Bird, the Holy Flame Lion, and their contractors changed, and their movements instantly froze.
Their movements froze for a moment, and they couldn’t move forward at high speed anymore.
Because their rationality told them that if they continued forward, they might be waiting for the Fire Dragon King to attack first.
Boom!!!
The dragon might of the Flame Dragon King, the heir of the demigod faction, the Dragon Empire, enveloped the world. Its strong body seemed to be made of tempered red steel. Its scales were like molten iron water water watered by flames, and the color was dark red and golden. Its entire body was extremely hot, and the end of its dragon tail was even burning with dragon flames.
Not only its body, its neck, head, long tail, sharp claws, and fangs, its four strong feet, as well as its pair of fire wings, were all extremely domineering images. Just looking at them, they contained supreme power.
“Roar!!!!!”
In the distance, the Fire Dragon King flew over. On its body, a man in red armor was like an unconscious puppet. As the Fire Dragon King arrived, he actually turned into a red light and fused into the Fire Dragon King’s body.
Buzz!!!
In an instant, a layer of reddish-brown armor appeared on the already very strong body of the Fire Dragon King. Moreover, the aura of the Fire Dragon King rose steadily, reaching an even more ridiculous height.
Energy Points: ???
Shi Yu looked at the flying Fire Dragon King with a burning gaze. He was very impressed by the Dragon Empire’s technology of nurturing hybrid humans. This legendary servant of the Fire Dragon King could actually transform into battle armor and equip the Fire Dragon King’s body.
As for the Beast Tamer of the Thunder Dragon General, he had the reverse fusion talent. He could also integrate himself into the Thunder Dragon’s body.
They were all beasts as the main body.
[If we want to defeat this guy, we might have to pay a relatively high price.]
[However, at the same time, as long as we defeat this guy, the cost will be made up.]
Since this Fire Dragon King was unwilling to give him face, Shi Yu would not show mercy.
Boom!!!
The Fire Dragon King in huge armor landed on the fire arena.
At this moment, the Boar God narrowed its eyes and looked at the Flame Dragon King.
“Dragon race…”
“Also, is this the Beast Taming Talent?”
“It’s indeed very interesting. You’re very strong.”
Even the god from the Mythical Era praised the overlord-level Flame Dragon King when it saw its aura.
In the Mythical Era, not all of them were Mythical creatures. At that time, there were also many overlords, monarchs, and even commanders and transcendent.
In the eyes of the Boar God, the current state of the Fire Dragon King was considered the second tier of the overlord level even in the Mythical Era.
...
As for the first tier, it was those Mythical race overlords.
After all, the laws of the Mythical Era were very complete. And now, this Fire Dragon King could achieve such an achievement in the era before the Mythical Era revived. In the eyes of the Boar God, its talent was indeed alright.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 920 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (4)
chapters.content:
920 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (4)
In comparison, apart from Psychic power, that human who could use Psychic power had yet to show anything special. He wondered what his contracted creature looked like…
“Flame Dragon King… Punkham.”
When the Fire Dragon King ascended the arena and finished looking at Shi Yu, the expressions of the Beast Tamers from all over Dong Huang froze as they looked at the two parties facing each other solemnly.
The expressions of the Dragon Empire’s great enemy, Tingxiang, and Dragon Palace City, also suddenly darkened.
!!
Enemies were bound to meet on a narrow road…
Boom!!!
Compared to the tiny Shi Yu, the aura of the Fire Dragon King was incomparably terrifying like an erupting volcano. This made the Lava Beast in the distance fall silent. To be honest, it wasn’t confident of defeating this guy.
The Fire Dragon King of the Dragon Empire was undoubtedly very powerful.
However, even in the face of such a powerful Fire Dragon King, Shi Yu stood in the sea of fire without moving at all. Under the gaze of thousands of gazes, he looked at the Fire Dragon King and said,
“I’ve already reminded you.”
“I believe you’ve already realized it before coming up.”
“Huh??” Flames shot out of the Fire Dragon King’s huge nostrils, and its fiery red dragon eyes looked at Shi Yu in disdain.
“Kid, are you serious??”
“Did you have some misunderstanding about your strength?”
“Idiot,” At this moment, on the Demon Kingdom’s side, the Fallen Angel Aldrich said in a low voice. As for Shi Yu… He felt that he had yet to reveal his strength. Back then, the dragon might displayed by Shi Yu when he looked at him was much more terrifying than the dragon might of the Fire Dragon King in Aldrich’s opinion.
He still didn’t know what was going on with that dragon might.
Although that didn’t look like a fire-element dragon might, there must be a reason why an expert like Shi Yu dared to stand out. If the Fire Dragon King was careless, it would definitely suffer greatly.
Back then, Shi Yu and Aldrich looked at each other and he used the Green Dragon Domain to connect to Buggy’s mind at the same time. It was indeed powerful. As for now, since the Boar God wanted a fire-element battle, it would be a fire-element battle…
“Unfortunately, I’m very clear about my strength.”
Shi Yu sensed the Flame Dragon King’s current state and said very calmly.
Weaker than Eleven, weaker than Buggy. Much weaker.
In that case…
“Chi Tong.”
Shi Yu said directly.
Right on the heels of that, a purple summoning array surrounded by orange flames appeared beside Shi Yu.
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and directly reached for the summoning array. Then, he slowly pulled it out in the air. A shocking heat wave spewed out, and a red divine sword was slowly pulled out of the Beast Taming Space and appeared in Shi Yu’s hand.
“Holy shit, he’s only a level-six Beast Tamer!!!”
Seeing the color of Shi Yu’s summoning array, many people were stunned.
Initially, be it the seven countries or the totem countries, they thought that Shi Yu was so brave because he had used the World Tree Branch Liquid to break through to the Legend level.
In the end, after seeing the color of Shi Yu’s summoning array, everyone realized that this kid was still a level-six Beast Tamer.
Not to mention the other factions, even Dong Huang was stunned.
That was because it wasn’t just Shi Yu’s level. The level of the pet Shi Yu summoned also made them rather speechless.
The sword spirit that was slowly pulled out by Shi Yu.
It was a fire-element and undead-element pet.
The overlords and totems present were very certain that they had sensed correctly.
From the energy fluctuations… monarch level.
The fire sword spirit in Shi Yu’s hand was only a monarch-level life fluctuation.
“If I remember correctly, Shi Yu only has one fire-element sword spirit. The other pets… aren’t fire-element.”
“In other words, this guy plans to rely on a monarch-level sword spirit to fight the invincible Dragon King with the support of a legend Beast Tamer?!! What a joke!!”
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of the seven countries who were familiar with Shi Yu’s information were stunned.
Even if Shi Yu’s main battle power was very strong because he had eaten the Undying Fruit, they really couldn’t imagine how a combination of a level-six Beast Tamer and a monarch-level fire-element pet could defeat a combination of a level-seven legend Beast Tamer and an invincible dragon-element overlord.
“Hm?”
The Boar God was similarly puzzled. It could also clearly sense that Shi Yu and the others were much weaker in terms of levels.
Want to fight above his level?
It wasn’t impossible for geniuses to beat normal powerful people.
However, the Fire Dragon King opposite was also a top-notch genius.
“Huh??”
At that moment, the Fire Dragon King wanted to laugh the most. It originally thought that Shi Yu had broken through to the legend level, but this guy was only a level-six Beast Tamer?!
“Divine Source, what is your kid trying to do?”
The legendaries of the other six countries panicked when they saw Shi Yu go up to fight the Fire Dragon King just like that.
Especially countries like Shen Feng. After all, Shi Yu had agreed to share the mechanical phantom beast system after the World Tournament ended.
If Shi Yu died in the world competition, would this promise still be effective?
“I’m not sure, but… believe him,” Divine Source said silently. Shi Yu’s main body was so strong. In theory, after the undead possessed him, he couldn’t be weak.
However, because he didn’t know Chi Tong’s strength and the opponent was too strong, Divine Source wasn’t very confident at this moment.
...
“Kid, I’ll let you see the difference clearly.”
“Roar—!!!”
Without hesitation, the Fire Dragon King directly attacked.
First was deterrence.
Punkham opened his mouth and suddenly let out a dragon roar that resounded throughout Inatella.
A huge dragon roar swept up the dragon might, almost making all lives below the totem level cover their ears, their hearts trembling.

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 921 Killing Until No One Dares to Fight (5)
chapters.content:
921 Killing Until No One Dares to Fight (5)
This was still the result of the totems helping their audiences behind them resist the power.
The fiery red dragon roar was mainly focused on the fire arena. The main target was Shi Yu. At this moment, Shi Yu should be under the most terrifying pressure…
“Voice and deterrence… are intertwined.”
“Dragon might is powerful to begin with, not to mention that the Fire Dragon King has trained deterrence to perfection. Coupled with its voice-type unique skill…”
!!
“Even ordinary overlords will probably instantly submit to its domineering aura…”
A Beast Tamer from the totem country covered his ears and said those words. The overlord beside them couldn’t deny it either. They were very serious.
“A deterrence competition?”
“Mi! (Kill it.)” Chi Tong’s sword cry echoed. This deterrence was far inferior to Buggy’s dragon might!
“Alright, kill it.”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was holding Chi Tong, the surrounding blue Psychic waves were instantly dyed orange-red. His body began to become blurry and hot, and red fire threads erupted and lingered around him.
His blue eyes instantly turned into red, and his gaze seemed to contain flames. Apart from that, his hair color instantly changed from black to red.
“High-level undead skill, Possession!”
“This undead even knows this move.”
Suddenly, the Beast Tamers and overlords of the various countries recognized this skill and widened their eyes.
They suddenly remembered that talent skills such as fusion, possession, and loading could be used by Beast Tamers and pets together.
The enhancement of the battle power of both parties depended on the strength of the Beast Tamer and the pet.
Shi Yu’s strength was already very terrifying. How strong would he become after being possessed by an undead pet?
For a moment, the various factions couldn’t imagine it.
“That Sword Spirit Possession is very strong!!” In Ming Hua, Amy Rui, who had once controlled the Golden Phoenix Dragon Sparrow to lose to Shi Yu, and the Ming Hua Beast Tamer who had watched this battle said extremely seriously.
Unfortunately… The undead that possessed Shi Yu was still at the monarch level.
If an overlord-level undead possessed Shi Yu, it might really be able to fight the Fire Dragon King.
At this moment, Shi Yu was continuing to transform.
With a boom, countless fire threads approached. A fierce spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun turned into flames that wrapped around Shi Yu’s entire body. At this moment, Shi Yu’s entire body was thinner but more powerful!
At this moment, Shi Yu’s aura had completely changed. He no longer looked like a human. The emotions in his eyes had faded a lot, and a shocking deterrence erupted from his body.
Shi Yu’s quasi totem soul, together with the full-level possession of the undead Chi Tong, instantly made their common battle power level reach the invincible overlord level.
Boom!!!
At that moment, the deterrence of the Fire Dragon King, together with the sound wave, materialized into a fire dragon and came over violently. At this moment, Shi Yu, who had instantly completed possession, was not to be outdone.
Boom!!!
Accompanied by a high cry, the aura on the red-haired Sword God Shi Yu shot into the sky. Flames erupted, and a shocking phoenix might swept up from the flames. Orange flames that shot into the sky completely filled the sky.
The dazzling flames turned into a phoenix. The phantom of a huge fiery red bird soared in the flames in midair. The crown-like feather crown on its head displayed the might of the king of birds.
Dao Proficiency, Phoenix Might!
Bang!!!
Two substantial deterrence forces instantly fought.
Crack.
This collision immediately made the expression of the Fire Dragon King change.
Just now, the Fire Dragon King could be said to disdain Shi Yu, but at this moment, as Chi Tong’s full-level possession fused their soul power into one, it displayed the greatest possession effect and erupted with a higher proficiency deterrence. Moreover, it was the phoenix might that was not inferior to the dragon might. In an instant, the Fire Dragon King’s expression was stunned.
“Roar!!!”
“Jiu!!!”
The dragon roar and phoenix cry still echoed in Inatella. The huge deterrence collision almost made the overlords present unable to breathe. About a few seconds later, with a crack, it was as if space had shattered. The deterrence of both parties scattered.
The Fire Dragon King flew up, and its unstoppable dragon might was resisted. Its red eyes instantly looked at Shi Yu crazily.
“He… actually blocked it?!!”
At the same time, when they discovered that Shi Yu had easily resisted the Fire Dragon King’s dragon might, many spectators widened their eyes in disbelief. After all, there was an entire level of difference between the two parties!!
At that moment, all the Beast Tamers of the seven countries suddenly looked at the red-haired and red-eyed Flame Sword God. Looking at his calm face, they suddenly felt a chill. The trump cards of the seven countries, including Ye Xing, revealed incredulous expressions.
No way, this kid didn’t really have the strength to fight the Fire Dragon King, right?
“President Lin.” At this moment, President Lin had already returned to the side of the contestants of Dong Huang. When Divine Bell saw him, she immediately asked, “Do you know that Shi Yu was going to fight?”
President Lin looked into the distance in silence and said, “I know. Let him give it a try.”
“I see. One is a human fusion pet, and the other is a pet fusion human?” At the same time, the Boar God discovered that Shi Yu could really be evenly matched with the Fire Dragon King and couldn’t help but be shocked.
At their level, this increase… was indeed extraordinary. It could even be said to be terrifying.
“Wu…” Beside him, the World Tree clone was also very shocked. It didn’t expect that the hybrid sword spirit could erupt with such power after possessing Shi Yu.
Boom!!!
The battle continued. Shi Yu’s figure had already flashed from the ground and arrived in the air. He floated in the air and looked at the Fire Dragon King in front of him. He directly slashed out with his sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 922 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (6)
chapters.content:
922 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (6)
Swoosh!
Shi Yu’s sword landed.
Countless people looking at the sky felt that the light in front of them was snatched away in the blink of an eye, and the world seemed to have fallen into darkness.
At this moment, the Fire Dragon King was feeling it the most until a light appeared in front of him.
!!
A sun fireball seemed to appear in front of him. It was a sword light. A Sun Flame sword light that seemed to have broken through the darkness streaked across, turning into a terrifying fire sword aura that attacked the soul!!
“Little brat, don’t underestimate people too much!!!”
Boom!!
In the sky, the battle armor on the Fire Dragon King’s body emitted light. It released a terrifying killing intent, and its entire body was wrapped in the light of the Dragon Flame. With the huge sword light that enveloped half the venue, it flew towards Shi Yu!!
Endless sword light landed on the Fire Dragon King’s body. What shocked many people was that Shi Yu’s powerful attack actually didn’t leave any traces of injuries on the Fire Dragon King’s armor body. Instead, it was instantly absorbed. Even Shi Yu frowned slightly at this scene.
“As expected, it’s not enough.”
Seeing that Shi Yu’s attack was ineffective against the armored Flame Dragon King, many people’s hearts skipped a beat.
If it couldn’t break through its defense… How could they fight!
“Roar!!!” After resisting Shi Yu’s attack, the Fire Dragon King flew over and raised its huge dragon claw in the air. A black Dragon God phantom condensed on its claw, and together with the explosive flames, it swept up an incomparable destructive concept.
Dragon God Claw!!!
Boom.
Space kept distorting.
“This super skill is an inheritance skill of the Dragon Empire. It’s infinitely powerful. When trained to the extreme, it points to the law of destruction!”
At this moment, seeing the Fire Dragon King use this move, the expressions of many factions changed.
This move was also the signature skill of the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire, but the Black Dragon Ruler had already trained to the level of a quasi-divine skill.
With a claw, a country could be destroyed.
Although the Fire Dragon King’s Dragon God Claw had yet to reach that level, from its power, it was clearly a super skill cultivated by the Fire Dragon King.
“As expected, it’s still too difficult.” On Dong Huang’s side, Divine Source and President Lin’s hearts tightened.
Lu Qingyi, Senior Panda, the beast-eared girl, and the others also felt worried for Shi Yu.
The Dragon God Claw attacked.
On the other side, Shi Yu took a deep breath. On the sword in his hand, hot orange-red sun flames and blue-purple ghost flames condensed. The terrifying Interlocking Sword turned into a sword pressure and was released to resist the Dragon God Claw with a boom!!
“Yin Yang Interlocking Sword.”
At this moment, Shi Yu raised his arm. The Yin Yang Interlocking Sword condensed in his hand and quickly landed.
With a loud bang, at this moment, blue-purple Nether Ghost Flame lingered on Shi Yu’s body, and orange-red sun flames flowed. Under the interweaving of the two intertwining powers, Shi Yu’s aura increased further!
Boom!!!
In an instant, the Yin Yang Interlocking Sword Pressure Domain that bloomed in front of Shi Yu collided with the Dragon God Claw that the Fire Dragon King waved.
Boom!!!
The two forces squeezed together, and a world-shaking aura penetrated the sky and ground. During this process, countless fire sword shadows overlapped on Chi Tong’s body. Shi Yu and the others’ strength was still rising steadily.
Profundity, Myriad Sword Convergence.
Boom!!!
Initially, everyone thought that Shi Yu would definitely be instantly defeated under this attack. However, Shi Yu’s resistance method exceeded everyone’s imagination. A huge power erupted from the sword in Shi Yu’s hand, and the terrifying Yin Yang Interlocking Sword pressure instantly formed a confrontation with the Dragon God Claw.
“Roar!!!”
The huge Fire Dragon King waved its huge claws, and the tiny Shi Yu resisted with the sword pressure. The style of the two parties distorted at this moment. The Fire Dragon King, Punkham, had an extremely serious expression. He didn’t understand why a mere level-six Beast Tamer, together with a monarch-level pet, could take his Dragon God Claw head-on.
At this moment, Shi Yu was also extremely silent. His clothes and hair were blown by the strong wind, and his body, mind, and soul were already under pressure. He understood that under normal circumstances, it would probably be very difficult for him to be a match for this Fire Dragon King with Chi Tong.
The Interlocking Sword+Sun Flame+Nether Ghost Flame+Myriad Sword Convergence+Possession Beast actually couldn’t even break through its defense.
The invincible overlord of a demigod faction was indeed extraordinary.
“Speaking of which, is this really a battle between overlords…” The overlords of the various factions looked at the collision of the two parties in shock. They were very certain that if this wasn’t the sturdy Inatella, the surrounding venue and space would definitely have shattered.
In the alternate space, the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire looked at the two parties who collided indifferently. The Dragon God of Dragon Palace City also watched everything calmly.
The Dragon Empire and Dong Huang’s bloodline were also in a feud. It was very likely that this battle would end with one side dying. Not only did the two factions understand, but the personnel of the other countries also knew very well.
At this moment, the World Tournament had already begun.
Be it the Fire Dragon King or the Dark Elven King, these popular contestants who could win the World Tournament might die early in the Mythical Trial.
Eliminated.
“Roar!!! (Die!!!)” In midair, a violent expression flashed in the Fire Dragon King’s eyes. At this moment, what shocked many people was that the battle armor wrapped around the Fire Dragon King’s body directly turned into flowing light and gathered on the Fire Dragon King’s sharp claws.
It formed a huge claw armor. At this moment, the power of the Fire Dragon King seemed to have increased several times. With a boom, the Yin Yang Interlocking Sword pressure controlled by Shi Yu shattered with a crack. An incomparably terrifying shock wave instantly swallowed Shi Yu opposite without a trace, turning into a shocking wave that crushed the ground!!

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 923 Killing Until No One Dare to Fight (7)
chapters.content:
923 Killing Until No One Dare to Fight (7)
Boom!!!
Light flashed.
The huge Dragon God Claw wave landed on the ground. Three huge pits that were more than ten meters deep immediately appeared in the fire venue divided by the Boar God. The rift valley was filled with shocking dragon flames, and Shi Yu’s figure seemed to have been thrown into the abyss.
“Shi Yu…” Seeing this, Gao Xuan, Zou Yun, Ji Feng, and the others were suddenly shocked. They looked at the energy aftermath that had yet to disappear and searched for Shi Yu.
!!
It was over!
That abnormal Shi Yu had also failed?
“Holy shit, is that alright?” The overlords like the Prediction Owl of Imperial Capital University also said in shock.
As the cat bit the fruit, it said solemnly, “It should be fine. That kid’s other pets are very strong. They won’t be killed. At most, they’ll be eliminated because they sent more pets to violate the rules.”
The Flame Dragon King’s claw directly sent Shi Yu flying, directly letting everyone understand that level differences were indeed not that easy to cross. No matter how rich Shi Yu’s foundation was, it was still a pipe dream for him to defeat an invincible overlord like the Flame Dragon King above his level.
However, at the moment, everyone wanted to know more if Shi Yu, who had been sent flying by the Flame Dragon King, was alive or dead.
If he was dead, it should have become a totem, right?
If he was alive, where was it?
“He’s fine. He suddenly became stronger and offset that attack.” At this moment, the World Tree clone, the Boar God, looked at the shattered arena in surprise.
In the underground cave that was like a flaming abyss, Shi Yu slowly flew up with a dry cough.
At this moment, his clothes were already broken, but his state looked relatively intact. Even his expression didn’t show much abnormality.
“Hu…” At this moment, Shi Yu’s arms had almost turned into huge phoenix wings. The Flame of Regeneration repaired his injuries. After slowly flying up, he landed on a rock pillar and looked up at the Fire Dragon King.
His expression was unfriendly.
“Huh???” At this moment, the Flame Dragon King’s expression changed, and its gaze was shocked. It didn’t expect this kid to still be alive.
How was this possible?
Its attack should have heavily injured even a dragon that was also an invincible overlord.
Why didn’t this human look injured at all? Even if he had a recovery skill, it couldn’t be so thorough!!
“Shi Yu is fine!!”
“Look, he flew out again.”
“It’s better not to fight.” On Imperial Capital University’s side, Yin Zhengfan had a worried expression. Although Shi Yu had done many unscientific and extremely ridiculous things in his eyes, his opponent was the heir of a demigod faction. Such a faction had once caused ancient Dong Huang to fall into a state of collapse.
Unlike his previous opponents, it was basically impossible to create another miracle.
Initially, Yin Zhengfan, a little kid who had fought Shi Yu a few times, had already admitted that he was inferior to Shi Yu and hoped that Shi Yu could create more miracles. But now, he was only worried about Shi Yu’s safety and hoped that Shi Yu wouldn’t force things.
“There’s no problem, right? This is the first time I’ve seen Brother Shi Yu so tired.” Seeing that Shi Yu was fine, Zheng Hai and the others heaved a sigh of relief. They were first shocked by Shi Yu’s shocking possession strength, but then they were shocked by the exaggerated power of the Fire Dragon King.
Zheng Hai had seen his master’s strength. Although the strength of the Flame Dragon King was inferior to his master’s Tyrannical Sea Legend’s full strength, it had completely exceeded the standard of the legend level. Coupled with the Beast Tamer, it could already be called “Titled Legend level”.
“This human can’t be left alive.”
“Flame Dragon King Punkham, kill him.”
Voices also kept coming from the totem country.
At this moment, although they knew that Blue Planet had external enemies, after witnessing Shi Yu’s shocking potential, the various totem countries instantly felt Shi Yu’s threat.
This guy, in a level-six state with a monarch-level undead, had power comparable to an invincible overlord. If he used the World Tree Branch Liquid to break through to the legend level and his pet also reached the overlord level, how terrifying would that be?
Could it threaten a real totem level?
At that moment, no matter which totem faction participated in the world competition, they hoped that the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, could end Shi Yu in this battle, even if it meant turning him into a totem undead and eliminating him.
They couldn’t let this kid continue participating. They couldn’t let him break through to level seven. They had to kill him at level six.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, seeing that the level-six Shi Yu had successfully withstood its attack, the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, also felt a huge threat from Shi Yu. He knew that he couldn’t let this kid continue participating.
Otherwise, after he broke through, he would definitely become its third fatal threat apart from the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree and the Green Dragon Prince.
“It’s my turn, right?” Just as the Flame Dragon King, Punkham, was thinking about how to end Shi Yu’s life, Shi Yu raised his head slightly. The arms that had turned into phoenix wings recovered, and a fire sword spirit appeared in his hand again.
“Initially, I didn’t want to use this state, but from the looks of it, if I don’t use it, it’ll be very difficult to defeat you.”
“The price needed in this state will be paid with your life.”
Shi Yu looked up. His red eyes had already been smeared with an evil purple color.
If he wanted to defeat Punkham, Shi Yu had three methods. Firstly, he would activate the Taiji Domain to assist Chi Tong. Secondly, he would send Baby Ginseng to fight together. Thirdly… he would still fight with Chi Tong, but he needed to erupt with all their battle power!!

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 924 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (8)
chapters.content:
924 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (8)
Just now, the super skills Chi Tong used were all racial skills. Their proficiency didn’t exceed perfect level, so even if many skills were combined, they weren’t Punkham’s match.
However, not only did they have racial skills, but they also had super taught skills that had reached perfect proficiency and were specially tailor-made for Chi Tong!!
Perfect level, Demon Blade Curse, Perfect level, Undead Revival!!
The former could store the curse of the creatures it killed in its body and liberate it when needed. It could enter a cursed state and exchange for stronger battle power with huge side effects.
The latter could transform the lives it killed into undead puppets. At the moment, Chi Tong’s undead space had three overlord-level puppets.
Just now, Shi Yu and Chi Tong had already completed an eruption that was close to their limit, but that was only the limit under normal circumstances, the limit Shi Yu could withstand.
Since there was a limit to what it could withstand, there was naturally a limit that it couldn’t withstand. It looked like it couldn’t withstand it, but in this extreme explosive state, all the burden could be handed to the undead puppet to withstand through the combination skill of scapegoat and undead revival.
In this state, Shi Yu was invincible. Even totems needed to be shocked by an attack that used an undead puppet as a sacrifice.
However, the problem was… that it would cause the undead puppet to collapse and completely die.
Therefore, Shi Yu basically didn’t want to. However, if he used this combination profundity, it wouldn’t be a problem to kill new and stronger lives and refine them into the next undead puppet.
“I hope no one will repeat your mistake next.” Shi Yu’s words were like an echo from the cold hell, echoing in the Fire Dragon King’s ears, making it want to sneer and reveal an extremely serious expression.
Then, its expression was filled with shock.
Before the Fire Dragon King could react to its sense of danger, a strong wave suddenly erupted from Shi Yu’s body. The red flames on its body all turned into extremely evil purple flames!!
A monstrous purple flame instantly dyed the sky and ground, shocking everyone.
Shi Yu… Could it be that he had other trump cards?!
“This is…” The World Tree clone, the Boar God, and even the demigod legendaries could sense the even more terrifying and evil power that Shi Yu erupted with.
This evil power even made the hearts of the overlords of the totem country who had killed countless people tremble.
At this moment, the cyclone around Shi Yu immediately surged. The soaring purple flames wrapped around his entire body, burning his red hair and red eyes into purple hair and purple eyes.
“Mi, Mi, Mi.” In Shi Yu’s hand, under Chi Tong’s sickly and greedy voice, the purple flames that looked like a domain seemed to have burned space. Undead overlord puppets were summoned by Chi Tong through the revival of the dead.
Under the entanglement of the purple evil flames, a Green Scaled Dragon Spirit, an Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit, and a Mountain Tortoise Spirit appeared in the nether flames. Each of them also emitted a powerful overlord might. Accompanied by them appeared countless remnant souls. They were like malicious ghosts from hell as they floated in the purple flames and let out terrifying whispers, as if they were asking for Chi Tong and Shi Yu’s lives.
The incomparably huge curse power made Shi Yu’s current state look extremely evil. It was so evil that even the Fire Dragon King in the sky had a frightened expression.
How many ferocious beasts had this guy killed?
Shi Yu’s expression was indifferent. He wasn’t a good person. Chi Tong had relied on the soul of a ferocious beast to grow.
“This spirit body…!”
At this moment, as Shi Yu summoned the undead puppets, the contestants of the Heavenly Fox Nation, especially the Fox God leading the team, and the eldest daughter of the Moonlight Family who had contracted the Star Moon Fox, looked at the familiar undead puppet in shock. They kept feeling that… it was familiar. No, it was even the same!
There was something wrong with this Shi Yu! Dong Huang had something wrong!
“It’s actually two skills that can contain the law of death when trained to the extreme.” At the same time, the Boar God quickly discovered that Shi Yu’s fire sword spirit was simply ridiculous. Not only did it master the Sun Fire of extreme Yang, but it also mastered moves like Undead Revival and Demon Blade Curse that could reach the extreme of death.
All gazes landed on Shi Yu. Among them, the Black Dragon Ruler’s pupils constricted. It suddenly realized something. Just as it was hesitating if it should attack, it was already too late.
Boom!!!
Sun Flame that was pure Yang appeared on Shi Yu’s body again. The evil power of the Demon Blade Curse and Undead Revival condensed on the sword body at the same time as the pure power of the Sun Flame.
“Roar!!!!!”
At this moment, the summoned Green Scaled Dragon Spirit, Mountain Tortoise Spirit, and Ice-Eyed Tiger Spirit behind Shi Yu were instantly burned clean in the purple flames, becoming scapegoats for this attack.
“Profundity…” As Shi Yu muttered softly, the huge death aura that shot into the sky intertwined with the Sun Flame, forming a sword pressure that was like purgatory. It swept with world-shaking might and swallowed the Fire Dragon King.
Boom!
This attack pierced through the sky.
“Mere human…”
At this moment, the Fire Dragon King was still arrogant, but in the next second, its pupils instantly constricted. It sensed a fatal crisis and its entire body trembled to the extreme.
As the sword pressure approached, it exclaimed in its heart that it was impossible. It sensed the power of this attack and its entire body continued to tremble.
It was very difficult to move. The terrifying deterrence swept by this attack had already completely locked it!!

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 925 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (9)
chapters.content:
925 Kill Until No One Dares to Fight (9)
It felt like an isolated and helpless only son on a surfing board, facing a tsunami-like attack!!
“Roar!!!” Under the monstrous sword pressure, the Fire Dragon King, Punkham, let out a frightened roar. After sensing the fatal crisis, its overlord will was instantly activated, activating its incomparable potential. The huge black Dragon God phantom condensed on Punkham’s huge claws, instantly shattering the restraints of deterrence. At the same time, it smashed towards the sword pressure domain that had already been forced in front of it in anger!!
Boom!!!
In an instant, the profundities slashed out by Shi Yu and Chi Tong squeezed together with the Dragon God Claw again. The shocking collision sound shattered space and was transmitted to the ears of every alternate space’s demigod. Then, in an instant, under the unacceptable gaze of the Fire Dragon King, its body instantly relived Shi Yu’s previous situation in everyone’s incredulous gazes… It was completely swallowed!
!!
Boom!!!
Right on the heels of that, the sword pressure continued to push forward until the sky split into two!!
The red sky that appeared when the Boar God descended just now instantly shattered, directly turning into a purple phenomenon with orange-red flames.
Compared to the Nether Ghost Flame, the power brought by the Demon Blade Curse could clearly produce an even more terrifying eruption with the Sun Flame.
“Lord Fire Dragon King!!!” At this moment, it was the members of the Dragon Empire’s turn to look at the sky in shock, including the overlords like the Thunder Dragon General who had participated in the preliminaries. They looked at the sky in disbelief and couldn’t accept it.
With them were the overlords and Beast Tamers of many other totem countries.
At this moment, almost all the contestants and spectators on the island looked at the changing weather in shock.
The dust dissipated.
In the gray clouds, the figure of the Fire Dragon King could be seen. At this moment, no matter which faction it was, their gazes were extremely stunned. This was because the Fire Dragon King in the sky, not to mention the armor formed by the Beast Tamer, even its dragon scales and body had completely disappeared.
Under this attack, only half of the broken dragon bones were left. They were still being ravaged by the terrifying energy tide.
At this moment, the Dark Elven King of the Dark Night Forest, the fallen angel of the Demon Nation, the divine tree of the origin land, the Green Dragon Prince of the Dragonman Empire, and the other contestants looked at the sky in shock.
Flame Dragon King… That insufferably arrogant Flame Dragon King of the Dragon Empire… Died, died?
Not even a complete body was left behind?!!
“President Lin!!” Dong Huang, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Zheng Hai, Jiang Tianyang, Zhou Ming, and the others looked at the sky in shock. They looked at the purple-haired Shi Yu and turned to look at President Lin.
What happened?
Shi Yu, Shi Yu…
Using a monarch-level solo pet to kill the heir of a demigod faction, an invincible overlord?!!
With his strength, did he still need protection??
At this moment, President Lin also looked at this scene in shock. If Shi Yu fought the Flame Dragon King with the Chaos Panda and even the Green Dragon, he wouldn’t be shocked. However, President Lin never expected that Shi Yu could display such a terrifying battle power with Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit alone.
Tyrannical Sea Legend and the gem cat were shocked. Holy shit, why was Shi Yu’s strength so exaggerated!!
Wasn’t his trump card that panda?!
At that moment, even the demigods and legendaries watching the battle in the alternate space revealed shocked expressions as they watched everything.
Among them, the space where the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire was instantly shattered. The soaring anger made its pupils instantly turn red.
“Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God, what are you intending to do?” Its furious roar resounded through Inatella. Its terrifying anger instantly made the entire island tremble.
At this moment, many demigods knew that the trump card contestant of the Dragon Empire had been killed. This Black Dragon Ruler was probably already furious to the extreme.
“You forgot the rules.” After the Dragon God intercepted the Black Dragon Ruler who wanted to save the Fire Dragon King, she knew that there was no need for her to attack at all. In an instant, the World Tree clone and the Boar God looked at the furious Black Dragon Ruler.
Even the world competition between the seven countries allowed life and death, let alone between the seven countries and the totem countries. Although there were external enemies, the grudges of the various parties couldn’t be resolved in a short period of time.
It was impossible to hold back in such a battle.
“Roar!!!”
As many demigod-level and legendary-level gazes landed on him, the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire suppressed its anger to the extreme.
However, at this moment, no one had the time to care about the Black Dragon Ruler’s mood.
On the arena, an even more shocking scene occurred. In midair, a huge dragon spirit began to materialize out of thin air. It had fire-like armor, impressive and domineering flaming wings, a thick dragon tail, and shocking dragon eyes. If it wasn’t the Flame Dragon King that Shi Yu and Chi Tong had just killed with a sword, who was it?
However, its current form was very strange. It no longer looked like a normal life form, but… like an undead!
Although the power was still terrifying.
“Roar!!!” After the huge Fire Dragon King spirit was killed by Chi Tong and materialized through Undead Revival, it slowly landed on the ground and submitted to Shi Yu and Chi Tong.
Bang, bang, bang…
The purple-haired Shi Yu ascended the huge undead dragon body step by step and stood on it. He looked at the overlords of the totem countries with shocked and afraid gazes.
“I’ve said it before.”
“I want this Living Fire.”
“Swords have no eyes. I can’t guarantee that the challenger can end the battle alive.”
“Next, no one should want to fight with me, right?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Shi Yu returned to his black hair and eyes like a supreme demon king. The sword spirit in his hand turned into a little red sparrow and flew in the sky. He observed the new puppet in satisfaction.
Then, it landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder and stared at the various overlords with it.
The deterrence brought by the man and spirit to countless totem countries was incomparably powerful.
If anyone else came, Shi Yu and Chi Tong didn’t mind changing more undead puppets until no one dared to fight.
At this moment, be it the seven countries or the totem country, the contestants looked at this “level-six” Beast Tamer in confusion.
The Fire Dragon King… had actually revived!
Moreover, it had become the other party’s puppet!!!
Was this really a human Beast Tamer from the seven countries?
What a terrifying unorthodox method.
...
Their perception of strength was almost shattered. Was this world… broken?
This was a f*cking level-six Beast Tamer? He even threatened the entire totem countries?!
So it wasn’t Ye Xing. Shi Yu, who had eaten the Undying Fruit and strengthened his soul power and used the Undead Possession to display the strongest soul power, was Dong Huang’s strongest trump card?!

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 926 Gaze of the Abyss
chapters.content:
926 Gaze of the Abyss
As the battle between Shi Yu and the Fire Dragon King, Punkham, ended, the entire Inatella fell silent.
The fire-element overlords who had previously clamored to teach Shi Yu a lesson all had extremely weak legs.
Who would have thought that Shi Yu, a level-six Beast Tamer, could actually kill invincible overlords like dogs?
Which one dared to say that it was invincible? The Lava Beast, which had just wanted to compete with the Fire Dragon King, immediately had the thought of giving up the competition and took a step back in shock.
!!
Just as Shi Yu had said, if it went up, it would die.
Although the Life Fire was good, it had to be alive to use it.
“Dong Huang actually hid such a trump card!”
At this moment, the presidents of the associations of the various countries of the Alliance and the contestants of the World Tournament looked in Dong Huang’s direction with shocked gazes.
The number one person below the legend level? Who were they kidding!
Shi Yu, who had consumed the Mythical resource, the Undying Fruit, and this extremely strange possession sword spirit…
Without a doubt, it was Dong Huang’s hidden trump card!!!
“So this sword spirit is his trump card.” The Courtyard Sprite Annie, who had been defeated by Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast, and the Knight of Glory Lucille, who had been defeated by Ling, had complicated expressions.
Initially, they thought that… that Iron-eating Beast and that mechanical phantom beast were… In the end… Who would have thought that Shi Yu’s possession strategy was so powerful?
“This, this, this, this.” At this moment, on Dong Huang’s side, Zhou Ming, one of the legendary contestants, had a trembling expression. Holy shit, previously, he actually wanted to challenge Shi Yu to compete with him for the Sequence ranking. This guy rejected him. Could it be that it wasn’t because he was afraid that he couldn’t defeat him?
“It’s alright.” Lu Qingyi heaved a sigh of relief. She knew that Shi Yu was fine, but… the corners of her mouth twitched. When Shi Yu named Chi Tong, she was still beside him. Why did she…
“Hahaha…” At this moment, the Boar God kept laughing.
It looked around with a burning gaze at Shi Yu and the fire bird spirit on his shoulder.
Unbelievable! The World Tree was right. Humans were indeed very worth nurturing.
Even if it was a Mythical race at the monarch level, it was only so-so compared to Shi Yu and the others’ state just now.
Although the Fire Dragon King was strong, the combination of this human and the Fire Sword Spirit was clearly stronger. If they maintained this posture and grew to the Mythical stage… The Boar God could imagine what kind of enemy those invaders would have.
Killing the enemy… Reviving the dead as puppets… Sacrificing puppets to erupt and kill the enemy… Reviving the dead… This was completely top-notch battle nurturing methods. It was simply born to kill.
“Is there anyone else who wants to challenge?” The Boar God looked around.
The fire-element overlord that had just been restless fell silent.
On the arena, the Flame Dragon King was the precedent. Shi Yu and Chi Tong’s figures indeed made people unable to have any conflicting emotions.
“Lord Ice Dragon King, you…” In the direction of Dragon Palace City, the Sea Dragon King suddenly discovered that ice shards were falling from the Ice Dragon King’s eyes beside it, as if it was crying, but because of its attributes, it didn’t look like it.
“It’s nothing. I just thought of Mu Huiyin…” The frost dragon was undoubtedly very shocked just now. It originally thought that Shi Yu would become famous because of the Chaos Panda in the World Tournament, but it didn’t expect to see Shi Yu cooperate with its master’s heroic spirit and kill until no one from the totem countries dared to fight.
At that moment, it recalled the time it fought with Mu Huiyin. At that time, its strength was even inferior to this Fire Dragon King. However, at that time, when the overlord of the totem country faced them, it was the same, the same…
As time passed, its master was no longer beside it, but in another form, it still shocked countless overlords.
“Lord Boar God, do you want to continue waiting until sunset?”
At this moment, on the Fire Dragon King’s body, Shi Yu and Chi Tong looked at the god from the Mythical Era.
“No one…” The Boar God originally thought that the battle for the Living Fire would last for a long time.
It never expected that a monster that the various factions didn’t dare to fight would actually appear in the first battle.
This huge pig couldn’t help but feel a little helpless.
“Wait a little longer. If no one challenges anymore, let’s end it,” the World Tree clone said.
It was also happy to see Shi Yu receive a gift from the Boar God.
If it wasn’t wrong, that undead was a hybrid of a human and a phoenix.
At the moment, it was not in a complete state at all. It was transmigrated into an undead.
The Life Fire should be able to completely stimulate its bloodline power and make it stronger.
This inheritance was a very good choice for Shi Yu.
Just like that… Time passed bit by bit. No fire-element overlord dared to fight Shi Yu at all. Seeing this, the Boar God laughed under the shocked gazes of many lives and pulled out the “Spirit Ascending Blade” condensed from the “Life Fire”.
“In that case, this ball of Living Fire is yours. Human, report your names!!”
In the Boar God’s hand, the Life Fire gradually shrank and condensed, turning into a fist-sized flame that flew towards Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was extremely excited.
The Mythical Trial was much easier than he imagined.
Moreover, the gains were ridiculous.
In a trial, not only did he obtain Mythical resources, but he also… directly killed a world competition champion candidate.
Boom!
Shi Yu used his Psychic power to catch the Life Fire. A ball of white flames floated in his palm.
“Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Shi Yu.” At the same time, he looked at the Boar God.

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 927 Gaze of the Abyss (2)
chapters.content:
927 Gaze of the Abyss (2)
“Sword name, Chi Tong.”
“It’s the heroic spirit of General Mu Huiyin of the Dong Huang Dynasty!”
“Not bad, I’m looking forward to your next performance!” The Boar God laughed.
…
!!
“Damn it.” As they officially confirmed that Shi Yu had obtained the reward for the first Mythical Trial, the various totem factions were extremely envious.
However, there was nothing he could do.
At this moment, the various legendaries and demigods had different moods. Under their silent gazes, the World Tree clone flew in the sky and said, “When the sun rises tomorrow, I’ll awaken a second god and open the second trial.”
The second trial!
As the World Tree clone finished speaking, everyone tried their best to stop thinking about the first trial and pay attention to the second Mythical Trial mentioned by the World Tree clone.
They hoped that they could get a share of the benefits in this trial and that it would not be as rough as a single test battle power.
“This god’s name is Xuan Ming.”
“That guy.” As soon as the World Tree clone finished speaking, the Boar God’s expression turned cold. Then, it looked at the World Tree clone and said, “I suddenly feel that it’s quite interesting now. I plan to stay a little longer before sleeping.”
At the moment, due to sleeping for too long and the suppression of the world’s will, the Boar God’s strength was less than 100%. The best way to recover was to continue sleeping and wait for the Mythical Revival.
However, it was rare for it to be awakened in advance at a huge price by the World Tree. If it wanted to continue paying attention to the human Beast Tamers cultivated by the World Tree, so be it.
“Alright.” The World Tree clone didn’t refuse the Boar God’s request.
It was normal for these gods of the Mythical Era to be very curious about the situation in the future.
Not to mention them, even the World Tree itself was very curious. Every time it slept, a long, long time passed. Every time it woke up, humans could develop a new civilization, surprising it.
The most recent thing that shocked the World Tree was still the few humans named Z and Divine Source who developed the mechanic class.
It hoped that humans could also bring it more surprises this time.
“Xuan Ming is…?”
The name of Xuan Ming immediately attracted the attention of countless people. Even Shi Yu, who had just obtained a Mythical inheritance, glanced sideways.
Unfortunately, be it the World Tree clone or the Boar God, they didn’t say much. After completing the first trial, one of them turned into countless green lights again and disappeared from the sky, while the other returned to the Mythical Ruins to rest temporarily.
Only everyone was left thinking about who Xuan Ming was.
In an instant, Inatella returned to calm and berserk. Countless people suddenly looked at Shi Yu on the arena, and their gazes changed again.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu was still relatively calm. Although he had already sensed countless killing intent, he had already expected this situation before participating in the world competition.
It didn’t matter… As long as he endured until the end of the world competition, he felt that his strength could definitely increase to a higher level and he wouldn’t be afraid of anyone.
…
After the first Mythical Trial ended, Shi Yu was immediately protected layer by layer by Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City. Killing the Fire Dragon King could be said to have directly placed Shi Yu on the Dragon Empire’s blacklist.
Regarding Shi Yu’s decisiveness, Divine Source Legendary and the Dragon God were still alright. They felt that Shi Yu had done well. After all, the Western Sect had been involved in the few eastern totem battles after the Dragon Emperor. The Dragon Empire was even the main force of the invasion. He had killed well.
On the other hand, President Lin was a little helpless. After all, he was still the one governing Dong Huang next. He could already predict that after this world competition, Dong Huang would have more conflicts.
“Fortunately, I didn’t disappoint.” Shi Yu smiled when he saw the gem cat, President Lin, and the others quickly escort him away.
“Good kid!” President Lin was still excited. He didn’t expect Shi Yu and Chi Tong’s combination to be so strong. Back then, when Shi Yu said that Chi Tong had the ability to defeat a top-notch overlord alone, he originally didn’t care much. Before the power of the Chaos Panda, he completely ignored it.
In the end, Shi Yu gave him a surprise. He didn’t expect Chi Tong, who had been possessed by a Beast Tamer, to be so strong.
How strong was Shi Yu? Was he Dong Huang’s trump card?
As Shi Yu defeated the Fire Dragon King, this topic immediately spread crazily among the various factions in Inatella.
At this moment, no one dared to underestimate this level-six Beast Tamer anymore. Those quasi totem-level and totem-level world competition champion candidates were all extremely serious, thinking that Shi Yu was a huge threat.
Without a doubt, the current Shi Yu’s strength had directly entered the strongest tier of the world competition contestants.
However, Shi Yu was not arrogant. Before the Mythical Trial began tomorrow, he informed President Lin and the others before immediately burrowing back into the ruins to prepare for battle.
Firstly, he wanted to quickly recover the consumption of this battle, and secondly, he wanted to see if he could suddenly strengthen it again.
Although Shi Yu felt that in a full-strength battle, he could kill indiscriminately like a baby cup in the World Tournament, the targeting of the Mythical Trial was too strong. In fact, if he wanted to obtain resources, he might have to fight Mythical creatures. He had to constantly improve himself.
He had just obtained the legendary resource, the Heart Flame, the Spirit World Fragment, the Mythical resource, the World Tree Fruit, and the Flame of Life. Shi Yu could be said to have had a huge harvest.
Three of them were Chi Tong’s. Unfortunately, Chi Tong was not suitable to use them at the moment. Apart from that, its Sun Flame Flower and bone sword had yet to be completely used.
Although it was the most luxurious pet in the team, it was helpless.
“Mi!!!” At this moment, Chi Tong could only watch eagerly. It was extremely pitiful. After all, even the legendary resources couldn’t be absorbed with all its might, since it was afraid that it couldn’t suppress its power and break through.

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 928 Gaze of the Abyss (3)
chapters.content:
928 Gaze of the Abyss (3)
“Wuu.” “Ji ~” “Yi!” “Ning.”
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others also looked at Chi Tong’s resources eagerly.
Was this the troubles of rich people?
Legendary-level resources were alright, but Mythical-level resources…
This was the first time.
As expected, the later one evolved, the better the benefits??
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others gradually believed the “rules” concluded by Buggy.
“Don’t worry, when I break through to the legendary level, you can use them all.”
“Apart from being a breakthrough resource, these might also be used as evolution resources.”
“I’ve found a suitable evolution method,” Shi Yu said to Chi Tong with a smile, immediately making Chi Tong’s eyes light up.
“Ling.” When Shi Yu finished speaking, Ling nodded and said, “According to the information, the fallen angel of the Demon Nation, Aldrich, has mastered a special evolution skill.”
“It’s because it has this evolution skill that it’s known as one of the creatures closest to a Mythical race.”
“Its two souls in one body are also because of this skill.”
“If we have the chance to fight it, we can think of a way to get it,” Shi Yu said.
< Name > Soul Incarnation
Attributes: Undead, Spirit
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It can condense into an extremely long power incarnation. The incarnation can exist alone or fuse with the main body to complete evolution.
“Mi!?!” Chi Tong was stunned.
Ling: “This move is very suitable for you, as someone who has mastered the profundity of the Myriad Sword Convergence. Your clone’s various abilities are only one of the many abilities of the main body. Even through the infinite superposition of possession, the efficiency of energy is still not high. Moreover, the strengthening mode is single, and the burden is huge.”
“But incarnations are different. When incarnations condense, they can exist forever like scapegoats. Unless they die, where they need to condense again. In addition, every incarnation has an extremely high growth rate. They can walk a different path from their main body.”
“For example, if you’re proficient in the undead and fire elements, your incarnations can completely be proficient in the spiritual and light elements. Although their attributes are different, they have the same potential talent as the main body. The fallen angel of the Demon Nation, Aldrich, has mastered three incarnations, and every one of them is incomparably powerful. The strongest is when the main body and the three incarnations fuse into one to complete the evolution…”
This was an evolution skill that relied on cultivating clones to complete the evolution of Origin.
After Shi Yu obtained the detailed information of the Fallen Angel Aldrich, the first thing he felt was that this skill was very suitable for Chi Tong.
“Hehe, Little Chi Tong, have you heard of the ‘Immortal Slaying Sword Formation’ and the ‘Four Immortal Slaying Swords’?”
Shi Yu sat on the sofa and snapped his fingers.
“At that time, the main body and three incarnations whose strength is not inferior to the main body will form a sword formation through skills like the Interlocking Sword and the Four Symbols Star Formation and complete the evolution. Believe me, the strength will definitely be strong. After all, it’s equivalent to several times the investment of resources.”
At this moment, Chi Tong indeed had enough resources. Shi Yu felt that it didn’t seem impossible to nurture an invincible clone sword for Chi Tong?
For example, the flame that contained the Law of Life could create a Life Spirit Sword Chi Tong that was completely different from the power of Chi Tong’s undead body.
At that time, life and death would intertwine. Shi Yu felt that it was very promising.
“Mimi!!!” Chi Tong’s eyes lit up. It was quickly persuaded by Shi Yu. With a look of anticipation, it waited to crusade against the fallen angel.
“Yiya.” Baby Ginseng and the others immediately asked when they saw this.
Were there any other skills?
There were so many powerful creatures in Inatella. In theory, rare skills should be everywhere.
“Yes, I’ll record everything,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Then, he chatted with Chi Tong, Eleven, and the others for a while and exchanged the rare skills on this batch of contestants.
If he broke through to the legend level, he could quickly replicate some of it. Even if he couldn’t completely replicate it, it didn’t matter.
