Shi Yu remembered their identities. If necessary, he might still need to protect them and not let them die too early. At most, he would visit the totem country when his skill column was rich in the future.
As long as they didn’t die, there were plenty of opportunities.
With endless imagination, Shi Yu finally picked up the World Tree Fruit and decided to eat it himself.
Giving it to pets was just to increase skill proficiency. Shi Yu felt that there were many ways to increase proficiency with the skill index in the future. There was no hurry.
As long as he was given a certain amount of time, the skill level could increase.
However, if he wanted to develop the Beast Taming Talent well, he really had to rely on comprehension. It wasn’t something that could be developed with time.
If telepathy could be further developed, the cost-effective ratio would undoubtedly be higher. After all, Shi Yu had no other ways to increase it. This was one of the few opportunities.
Shi Yu ate the green World Tree Fruit. Soon, he sat cross-legged and entered a meditative state.
The incomparably clear feeling was like him memorizing words after consuming the memory water drop. The former’s memory ability had been raised to the maximum, and now, his comprehension had been raised to the maximum.
One was suitable for liberal arts… and the other was suitable for science… Taking advantage of the Mythical resources to strengthen his comprehension ability, Shi Yu immediately tried to unearth more mysterious laws of the “Taiji Domain” and “Green Dragon Domain”.
However, soon, to Shi Yu’s surprise and shock, apart from the two domain diagrams that originally existed in his pitch-black mental world, a third domain diagram slowly appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 929 Gaze of the Abyss (4)
chapters.content:
929 Gaze of the Abyss (4)
He saw a blue planet. Shi Yu originally thought that this planet was Blue Planet, but as he observed carefully, he felt that it was more like Earth than Blue Planet. At this moment, a green sapling slowly grew on the huge Earth with a dark background.
World Tree! These three words instantly turned into an unbelievable thought that echoed in Shi Yu’s heart.
“World Tree Domain?!”
He… actually had a third mental domain phenomenon! The first was the Taiji Painting, the second was the Green Dragon Painting, and the third actually appeared as he ate the World Tree Fruit.
Shi Yu was extremely happy.
“It doesn’t seem to be over.” Then, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. Not only that, but the effect of the Mythical resource had yet to be completely displayed. At this moment, Shi Yu could clearly feel that he could see more laws and power of faith contained in the Taiji Painting and the Green Dragon Painting.
Especially the Taiji Painting. Back then, when Shi Yu mobilized the Taiji Painting, it also produced a sound of laws that was comparable to a quasi-divine skill. However, Shi Yu understood that although they were both quasi-divine skills, the distance from a real divine skill was completely different.
If it was said that the quasi-divine skill of a demigod life form still needed 50 steps to touch the laws of a real divine skill, then today, that Boar God’s skill that had fallen from a divine skill to a quasi-divine skill because the laws of the world were incomplete was only 10 steps away from touching the laws.
As for Shi Yu and Eleven, the difference was clearly even greater. It was at least 100 steps away. They had yet to see much of the Yin Yang Millstone.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu could clearly feel that his use of the Taiji Painting was even clearer. This feeling was like the difference between the strengthening talent of a legend Beast Tamer and the strengthening talent of a legendary Beast Tamer.
Previously, his mind domain was equivalent to a legendary Beast Tamer with strengthening talent strengthening Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone.
And now, Shi Yu was certain that his strengthening of Eleven’s quasi-divine skill could clearly be stronger, several times stronger than before.
“Don’t stop.” Shi Yu’s heart was fanatical as he continued to develop.
This strengthening made Shi Yu feel that as long as he supported Eleven with all his might, Eleven could use a quasi-divine skill to slap ordinary totems to death. No, forget about totems, if the demigods suppressed their strength to the overlord level and used their quasi-divine skills to fight Eleven, who he supported, it was still a question if they could defeat Eleven.
….
A night of bitter cultivation.
The strengthening of comprehension brought about extreme overdraft in various aspects. Shi Yu’s body was already weak, and tonight, it directly tormented him badly, making Shi Yu not know if he should be happy or worried.
He came out of the ruins early in the morning today and met President Lin and the others from Dong Huang to wait for news of the second Mythical Trial, but in the end, it was in this state…
The only thing that relieved Shi Yu was that although he looked even weaker and had consumed more energy, he had actually become stronger.
With the two Mythical resources swallowed, in addition to his mind domain, his own foundation could be said to be completely close to those legendary Beast Tamers.
At dawn the next day, countless creatures walked out of their ruins in the seven countries and the totem countries and looked at the sky of Inatella.
As the sun slowly rose, the countless green vortex worms sleeping on the island also flew into the sky again and turned into a green eagle, looking at the world competition contestants on the island.
“The second Mythical Trial is about to begin. All contestants of the World Tournament, prepare to head to the location of the ‘water-element arena’ during the preliminaries. I will awaken the divine-level creature ‘Xuan Ming’ from the Mythical Era here.”
“The second Mythical Trial will be set by ‘Xuan Ming’.”
Water-element arena!!!
At this point, the factions with many water-element creatures in the Infinite Sea, the Ghost Sea, the Seven Islands, and even countless water-element creatures were delighted.
“Water?”
Could it be that this time… was a trial that only water-element creatures could participate in??
At this moment, the green eagle continued, “Xuan Ming is a water-element god. In the Mythical Era, it was the main force to resist the Abyss Sea, an extraterrestrial faction. At the same time, it was also the first god to take the initiative to come into contact with and master the power of the Abyss Sea without being affected in order to understand the enemy.”
“What?”
As soon as the World Tree clone finished speaking, the expressions of many people changed. Abyss Sea… There was naturally no faction present who didn’t understand this huge inheritance that came from the Mythical Era. The pollution of the abyss was incomparably terrifying and would completely corrode the will. In history, even the abyss that came later in the future had caused huge damage to Blue Planet.
If it weren’t for the existence of the Blue Sea Sprite, who knew what the sea on Blue Planet would be like now.
This god actually ran over to cultivate the power of the abyss?
Was it that crazy? They could already imagine how cruel the trial rules would be set by this crazy god.
However, at this moment, a group of people also revealed strange expressions.
It was from Dong Huang.
The gem cat, President Lin, and the others were slightly stunned.
A god who took the initiative to come into contact with and master the power of the Abyss Sea and wasn’t affected?
Why did it sound so familiar?
Wasn’t this Shi Yu’s second team, the underling of the Blue Sea Sprite Susu, Duckie!

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 930 Some Research
chapters.content:
930 Some Research
The water-element arena in the preliminaries was located in a huge lake that connected to the ocean on the island. To be precise, this sea area was the so-called water-element arena. There was no ground.
Here, transcendent life forms who couldn’t fly and weren’t good at water couldn’t fight at all. Therefore, just hearing about the venue made the various countries understand that this was definitely another extremely restrictive trial.
At this moment, as the World Tree clone said the location of the trial, the void was torn apart. The divine boar god in charge of the first trial descended again. It maintained its huge body, and flames condensed behind it that filled the sky, forming a Void Flame Throne. It slowly sat in the sky and looked at the sea area.
Under the summoning of the World Tree clone, the god in charge of the second trial was also about to revive!
Boom!!!
The humans and transcendent lives of the various countries surrounded the land and looked at the water in front of them. Under the gazes of everyone in all directions, they heard a boom, and an indescribable pressure appeared again.
Dong!!!
A baffling voice echoed in their minds and hearts. At this moment, almost no one didn’t understand what this voice was. Even spectators like Yu Shu, who weren’t even master-level Beast Tamers, had gained a lot of knowledge in this world competition.
The sound of laws.
This was a spiritual spirit that could only be emitted when a transcendent life form entered the Mythical Domain and resonated with the laws of the world. This was the symbol of a god. Be it its potential to enter the God Domain or its strength to enter the God Domain, this was the only symbol.
“It’s said that demigods also master the sound of laws.”
“With this ability, each of them can fight against the legendary Beast Tamers who control nine pets alone.”
The hearts of all creatures rippled. Divine skill, God Domain!
This was the lifelong pursuit of every life.
Although it was very difficult to achieve in this era where the laws were incomplete, there were still seven years until the Mythical stage revived. Everyone had a chance!
“This deity might even be stronger than the Boar God.”
As the sound of laws rumbled, the demigods who were currently at the top of Blue Planet and were praised by the World Tree as destined to become gods after the Mythical Revival had already sensed the power of this new god.
Whoosh!!
A figure appeared above the sea area. A black island more than a hundred meters in diameter seemed to have appeared there. After it appeared, the entire blue sea area was instantly dyed with a faint layer of black. With a whoosh, the water vibrated. This huge black island raised its head and stretched its limbs, revealing the appearance of a crocodile looking face. Its fierce face stunned many creatures!
This… should be a turtle god!
“You’re awake.”
“Lord Xuan Ming.”
After the huge turtle woke up, the Boar God sitting on the Flame Throne in the sky turned into a World Tree clone flying in the sky and spoke one after another.
“It feels so depressing.”
The black alligator turtle looked around. This was the second time it had been awakened by the World Tree clone. As expected, it was still not used to this era with incomplete laws. Just like the Boar God, Xuan Ming felt that its strength was severely suppressed.
It looked at the surrounding transcendent lives and humans, its black eyes filled with judgment.
Future creatures…
All of them looked extremely weak.
The so-called humans were only so-so.
Just from the willpower revealed in their eyes, Xuan Ming knew that these guys definitely couldn’t resist the corrosion of the abyss.
However, because of the agreement with the World Tree, it still had to let these people experience the cruelty of the Mythical Era and give rewards to those who performed well.
“Have you finished?” It looked at the Boar God in the sky.
At the end of the Mythical Era, there were not many gods left. The Boar God was a divine level that resisted the Space Worms. Meanwhile, it was the main force that resisted the Abyss Sea. The two were originally unrelated, but because they were both sleeping in Inatella, they knew each other.
“I’m done. Future creatures are indeed interesting,” the Boar God said.
“I see…” Xuan Ming looked at the countless future humans around him and said,” You guys should know what kind of disaster the Mythical Era is facing, right? ”
“At that time, the power of the Abyss Evil God that descended on Blue Planet reached the peak of the divine level, polluting more than half of Blue Planet’s ocean into an abyss. Even divine-level creatures became slaves of the Abyss Race under the influence of the power of the abyss.”
“However.”
“The abyss isn’t invincible. As long as your willpower is firm enough and you comprehend the profundity of the abyss power, this powerful power from outer space can even become a weapon in your hand.”
“I completely control the power of the abyss!”
“As for my test, it’s also very simple. I’ll pollute this sea area through the power of the abyss and let it give birth to an ‘Abyss Evil Spirit’. The ‘Abyss Evil Spirit’ has a powerful pollution power. Whoever can destroy it can obtain an Abyss Seed that I’ve finished refining.”
“This Abyss Seed contains the fusion experience of the divine-level abyss power. As long as your willpower is strong enough, there’s a chance to refine it for your own use. Just like me, you can control the power of the abyss.”
“So which one of you will do it?”
It revealed a playful smile.
At this moment, the various factions were shocked again.
As long as they defeated the Abyss Evil Spirit created by Xuan Ming, they could obtain the opportunity to master the power of the abyss?!
The Abyss was one of the three invaders who caused the destruction of the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era.
Their strength was naturally needless to say.
It definitely stood above most divine-level power. Otherwise, it was impossible for Blue Planet to be plunged into misery and suffering.

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 931 Some Research (2)
chapters.content:
931 Some Research (2)
“Abyssal power…”
At this moment, the gaze of the invincible overlord of the Endless Sea Domain, an elemental life form that was purely condensed from water elements and looked like a huge whale, the Deep Sea Emperor Whale, turned cold.
The invincible overlord of the Ghost Sea, the huge dark blue jellyfish in the form of a spirit body, was also shocked.
Just like Dragon Palace City, the Infinite Sea Region and the Ghost Sea were both huge factions in the Blue Planet Sea Region. At the same time, they were also enemies of the Abyss Sea. Dragon Palace City was alright, but the Infinite Sea Region and the Ghost Sea in the west were the first to bear the brunt of the invasion of the Abyss Sea and were corroded by the Abyss Sea.
Although the invincible overlords of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea were “still young” and had never experienced the invasion of the Abyss Sea, the demigods of their factions and the demigods of previous generations had experienced resistance to the Abyss Sea time and time again.
Their factions naturally recorded the horror of the Abyss Sea. It could be said that without the help of the Blue Sea Sprite, the endless sea area and the Ghost Sea would have long been destroyed by the invasion of the Abyss Sea.
As for the Abyss Sea of the totem era… it was only an inheritance left behind by the Abyss Sea of the Mythical Era.
The Abyss Sea of the totem era was already so powerful, so how powerful was the power of the divine-level Abyss?
In an instant, the invincible overlords of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea were extremely tempted. Not only them, but the Inatella’s Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea demigod behind them were also extremely moved.
If they could obtain the inheritance of Xuan Ming and the power of the divine-level Abyss… Even if the Abyss Sea of the Mythical Era invaded again, their factions should be able to calmly resist, right?
This inheritance had to be taken down!
Similarly shocked were the Dark Elven Empress and the Dark Elven Prince of the land faction, the Dark Night Forest.
Abyssal power.
According to the Elven Empress of Tingxiang, the Mother Life Tree had also been polluted by the Abyss and turned into the Dark Mother Tree. Including the Dark Elves, they were all affected because of this.
However, the Dark Elves were not permanently under the control of the Dark Mother Tree in the end. In the end, they successfully destroyed the Dark Mother Tree and became independent. Thinking about it carefully, if the Dark Elves were still under the influence of the Abyss bloodline, they probably wouldn’t have received the invitation of the World Tree.
Then…
Did the dark elves already master the power of the abyss? Was it possible to directly obtain the favor of the Mysterious Underworld?
Just now, Xuan Ming didn’t seem to have mentioned any restrictions.
It didn’t seem like creatures with no attributes could participate in the trial. It only said that it was enough to destroy the Abyss Evil Spirit.
“Lord Xuan Ming, there are no restrictions on participating in the abyss trial??”
At this moment, the invincible overlord of the Dark Night Forest, the Dark Elven Prince, couldn’t help but ask.
The Dark Elven King asked the question everyone wanted to ask.
“Oh?” At this moment, Xuan Ming’s gaze landed on the dark elven prince.
After sensing the extremely weak dark power of the abyss from the dark elven prince, it said, “Little brat, you also have traces of the abyss on your body.”
“However, compared to the pure power of the abyss, it’s too weak, a hundred times weaker. Its power has long been diluted.”
“As for the conditions to participate, there are no restrictions. Anyone who wants to participate can give it a try.”
The dark elven prince was overjoyed.
First, its great enemy, the Fire Dragon King, died. Then, it was tailor-made for the second Mythical Trial. It, it was simply going to go to heaven.
However, in the next moment, Xuan Ming’s words made the dark elven prince feel like he had fallen into an ice cave.
“Of course, the trial isn’t that simple. Although the Abyssal Evil Spirit I condensed is only the weakest prototype, it’s also the shadow of the power of that evil god. Not everyone can destroy it.”
“Even I avoid looking at that evil god directly. Only supreme gods like the Ancestral Dragon can resist it. Although there are weak abyss traces on your body, you would die if you tried.”
“You might fall slower. That ‘human’ beside you will definitely die faster than you.”
Beside the dark elven prince was a contractor. It was a mixed-blood maid Beast Tamer, specially born for the dark elven prince.
At this moment, her expression changed like the dark elven prince.
“It’s not the same thing as the power of the abyss you understand.”
“Don’t blame me for not reminding you. If you can’t successfully resist the Abyssal Evil Spirit and are instead polluted by the power of the Abyss, even I can’t restore you to your original state.”
“Your will will completely die and become slaves of the abyss.”
“This is a trial that involves one’s life. It’s also a trial that one has to face before controlling the power of the abyss. If one can’t even pass this most basic trial, then forget about mastering the power of the abyss.” Xuan Ming’s deep voice echoed in the hearts of all living beings.
At the same time.
A huge and darker black shadow appeared under the polluted black sea.
At this moment, the black sea area rolled.
The “Abyss Evil Spirit” Xuan Ming mentioned was about to be born.
At this moment, the dark elven prince’s heart trembled and beat crazily. He didn’t expect that Xuan Ming would bluntly determine that it would directly lose its life after participating in the abyss trial.
The expressions of the other creatures also changed drastically as they looked straight at the terrifying creature under the Abyss Sea.
Its figure was slowly outlined like a monster. It vaguely had the outline of a person, but it had a head with many tentacles like an octopus. Its body was covered in scales, and it had huge claws. There was also a pair of long and narrow wings behind it… Its image had some characteristics of octopuses, bats, and humans.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 932 Some Research (3)
chapters.content:
932 Some Research (3)
Splash.
It appeared from the Abyss Sea, dragging its bloated and fat body phantom… Its huge green body staggered out of the dark sea and walked into people’s vision… Its body emitted indescribable fear waves.
This… was the Abyss Evil God Phantom that Xuan Ming mentioned, the ultimate core of the abyssal power.
Its appearance shocked everyone even more than the appearance of the Mysterious Underworld. No, or rather, it was the embodiment of the abyssal power controlled by the Mysterious Underworld. At this moment, when they saw this Abyssal Evil Spirit, everyone seemed to have fallen into a deep nightmare.
!!
It was alright for the weak, but the stronger the person, the more they could sense the essence of the power of the abyss, and the more serious the impact, even if it was just a look…
“Ah!!!”
In an instant, a Beast Tamer who had contracted an overlord above his level screamed. The expression of the Beast Tamer with weak willpower gradually became crazy. He covered his head forcefully, and his eyes were dark green and red. Even their contractors’ gazes were filled with fear, and there seemed to be monsters muttering in their brains.
Boom!!!
The power of the abyss was terrifying. For legendary and demigod-level experts, their perception was especially obvious. The Dark Elven Empress looked at this monster called the Abyss Evil Spirit in shock. Although she sensed that its power fluctuations were only at the overlord level, the pollution contained in it at this moment, even through vision, made her, a demigod, feel threatened.
If it were an ordinary overlord, no, even a creature that had just entered the totem level… Let alone destroying it, it was still a question if it could maintain its rationality after fighting it.
“Nicholas!!”
The warning voice of the Dark Elven Empress immediately sounded in the Dark Elven Prince’s mind.
“Don’t participate in this trial. Just like what that god said, you’ll die.”
It would die.
Die!
A huge word appeared in the Dark Elven Prince’s heart, making its gaze tremble. Similarly, like the Dark Elven Empress, the demigod overlords of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea instantly experienced the horror of the Abyss Evil Spirit.
This abyss power was definitely not something the so-called “invincible overlord” could touch.
Unless it had a will that exceeded the overlord’s will or an extreme cleansing power, it was definitely unable to resist the corrosion of the abyss power.
“Don’t participate in this trial.”
In an instant, the contestants of the Dark Night Forest, the Infinite Sea, the Ghost Sea, and many other demigod factions received a warning from their demigod overlords.
Even if it was the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree that had reached the totem level, the Green Dragon Prince was the same.
“Your power doesn’t match the power of the abyss. It’s fine not to participate in this extremely risky trial.” The voice of the Genesis Tree God echoed in the heart of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree. It couldn’t lose its life because of this trial.
This Xuan Ming didn’t want anyone to obtain the inheritance at all!
“Give up,” the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragonman Empire also said to its son. The power of the abyss was more compatible with water-element life forms. Although their race also mastered the power of water, they weren’t pure water-element life forms after all. Even if they obtained it, they might not necessarily be able to master it perfectly. It wasn’t worth risking their lives to obtain it.
At this moment, no matter who it was, they were stunned by the terrifying statue of the Abyss Evil Spirit. They even gave up on the idea of participating in the trial after taking a look.
A huge fear was born in the hearts of every creature.
“Is this the power of the Abyss Sea…”
“The gods of the Mythical Era fought against this kind of thing…?”
“This is only the shadow of its power? How terrifying… will the main body be!”
An overlord-level snake-haired sea demon took a step back with a shocked expression. Just looking at it made him feel that he was about to go crazy. He really couldn’t imagine the consequences of fighting that thing.
“Don’t participate in this trial!” On the seven countries’ side, the legendaries of the various countries also gave orders to the young talents in the country. At this moment, indescribable emotions lingered in everyone’s hearts.
Seeing this…
In the sky, the Boar God and the World Tree were expressionless. Xuan Ming was also extremely calm.
It seemed to have expected this outcome.
“That guy is really not sincere.”
The Boar God muttered.
No, or rather, it was very sincere.
After all, the Abyss Seed was considered a supreme inheritance, even more precious than its Spirit Ascending Saber.
However, the premise was that a creature had to be alive to get it.
Its trial required the candidates to compete among themselves to determine the strongest. Although it was also very harsh, there would definitely be an inheritor. This guy, on the other hand, directly didn’t want any modern creatures to take the inheritance if it summoned a terrifying guy like the Abyss Evil God Phantom.
However… the goal of the World Tree should have been achieved.
It should have already made the humans of the future understand the horror of the abyss.
Unfortunately, Xuan Ming was still kind-hearted. It should make the few of them pay with their lives to be more convincing.
“Alright, come on.”
“The creatures of the future.”
Xuan Ming’s voice kept echoing.
However, at this moment, no one dared to move at all.
Just looking at this Abyssal Evil Spirit gave countless totems and overlords a pressure comparable to a demigod level.
In addition, Xuan Ming directly said that contestants at the level of the Dark Elven Prince would die… At this moment, no one was willing to bet their lives to compete for opportunities.
It wasn’t that they couldn’t bet their lives, but the premise was that they had to see hope of obtaining opportunities.

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 933 Some Research (4)
chapters.content:
933 Some Research (4)
Now, there wasn’t even hope. The demigods had even issued a warning. No one would be so stupid as to rush up and die. After all, those who could come here were all geniuses.
Moreover, even if a transcendent life form could barely withstand it, contractors, humans, and weak humans definitely couldn’t withstand the pollution of the abyss.
It would die!
This was also the reason why the demigods and legendaries didn’t let their contestants participate.
It was definitely not just pets that were being watched by the abyss.
However, the trial still had to continue. However, if no one could stand out, this battle could only end here.
…
“Looks like I have to accept the Abyss Seed too.”
Boom!!
No one replied.
This pressure made the scene very silent.
However, at this moment of silence, a figure wrapped in Psychic power slowly rose into the sky.
After Shi Yu rose into the sky with the help of his Psychic power, he looked at the Abyss Evil Spirit, making many contestants open their mouths wide and look up at him in disbelief.
Shi Yu…
That archeologist, Shi Yu.
At the moment, the greatest winner of the Mythical Trial.
What, what did he just say?!
Everyone present never expected that Shi Yu, who had just obtained the Life Fire and leaped into the championship candidate of the World Tournament, would actually stand up again.
He looked at the Abyss Evil Spirit calmly, as if he was not affected by the Abyss Evil Spirit.
“Shi Yu…”
Seeing Shi Yu suddenly walk out, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Zheng Hai, and the others widened their eyes and spoke in confusion. Wait a minute, didn’t Shi Yu hear the mechanical legend and President Lin’s warning just now?!
No, no, no!
Why… did he still go out!
Didn’t he know what kind of monster the other party was?
Shi Yu… indeed didn’t receive a reminder from the Mechanical Legendary. President Lin didn’t remind him either.
This was because the Mechanical Legendary, President Lin, and the others knew that Shi Yu had contracted the Blue Sea Sprite that had destroyed the Abyss Sea countless times. The second team even had an Abyss half-god who had mastered the power of the Abyss Sea as a pet!!
If there was anyone present who could complete this trial, it would be Shi Yu.
“How dare he?”
“Could it be that he thinks that he, in that state… can destroy this Abyss Evil Spirit?!”
After being reminded by the demigods, the invincible overlord contestants looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
At this moment, the gazes of the World Tree clone and the Boar God suddenly landed on Shi Yu.
What was this kid trying to do?
“Do you want to give it a try??” At that moment, Xuan Ming was extremely surprised. Behind the Abyss Evil Spirit, its gaze passed through the Abyss Evil Spirit and looked at Shi Yu.
He didn’t expect that someone would actually have the courage to challenge the Abyss Evil Spirit after seeing it.
“You should have heard what I just said, right?”
“The outcome of failure in the trial is only ‘death’.”
It repeated.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and flew towards the sea.
Right on the heels of that, it stopped in the sky opposite the Abyss Evil Spirit. Seeing that Shi Yu was different from most humans and could actually look directly at the Abyss Evil Spirit without his mind, heart, and will being affected, Xuan Ming was shocked again.
This human might be a little different.
“Speaking of which, I also have some research on the ‘Abyss Sea’. Perhaps I can give it a try,” Shi Yu said.
After observing the Abyss Evil Spirit for a moment, Shi Yu stood out.
This Abyss Evil Spirit should only have the strength of an overlord.
However, the pressure it brought should be comparable to an overlord-level ginseng baby self-destructing. No, it was even stronger than that. It could resist self-destruction with any power, but only the cleansing power could resist this abyss power.
This was also the reason why many factions were afraid.
However, Shi Yu felt that it shouldn’t be a problem for Susu to deal with it.
After all, its cleansing power countered the power of the abyss. Moreover, the Sea Cleansing Spirit skill had also accumulated an incomparably huge power through the Blue Sea Contract. The cleansing power far exceeded the overlord level and had already reached the totem level.
He could give it a try!
It was just that… even if Susu obtained this thing, it shouldn’t want it.
Disgusted.
If Susu didn’t want it, it might be able to give it to Duckie. After all, it was more compatible with the power of the abyss.
Unfortunately, Duckie’s strength was not high enough and it had not reached the overlord level. Moreover, it had not signed a contract with him. Otherwise, Shi Yu felt that be it Susu or Duckie, they should be able to pass this trial.
If it was given to Duckie…
Shi Yu sighed. Good heavens, there was still a batch of pets in the first team that had yet to find the Mythical path. On the other hand, the second team… All of them were about to have Mythical potential. Little Ji’s Earth Divine Dragon fossil, Duckie’s Abyss Seed… Alright, it would be troublesome if the first team couldn’t defeat the second team in the end.
...
“You have some research on the ‘Abyss Sea’?!” Xuan Ming was stunned. Then, he laughed and said, “In that case, you can give it a try!”
It wanted to see what kind of research method Shi Yu had on the Abyss Sea.
At this moment, all the spectators were stunned by Shi Yu’s words.
They recalled the information about the three invasion disasters that Shi Yu had explored…
Among them, there was indeed the Abyss Sea. Then, Shi Yu might indeed have studied the Abyss Sea.
However…
“Divine Source, what are you thinking?” The legendaries of the six countries opened their eyes again.
Shi Yu had studied the Abyss Sea. They also knew that Shi Yu could show it at the archeological Conference.
However, what Shi Yu studied should only be at the same level as the Dark Mother Tree. Even the Dark Elven Prince was determined to not die. Was it really alright for Shi Yu to go up?

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 934 Some Research (5)
chapters.content:
934 Some Research (5)
This guy couldn’t be easily defeated with that sword spirit’s possession.
They could all sense that this Abyssal Evil Spirit was almost an immortal existence. The power of pollution was similar to laws and was very difficult to destroy. It was almost impossible to completely obliterate and cleanse, even if it relied on totem-level power.
Therefore, the only outcome waiting for the challenger might be corrosion.
“Open your eyes wide.” Divine Source Legendary didn’t want to say anymore. The reason why he didn’t remind Shi Yu was because Shi Yu had contracted the Blue Sea Sprite and was prepared to let Shi Yu believe his judgment.
And now… Shi Yu stood out.
Then, did Shi Yu think that he could pass this trial?
Apart from that, Divine Source knew that even if the Blue Sea Sprite couldn’t do it, Shi Yu still had a Chaos Panda that had mastered the destructive law! With Shi Yu’s support, it should be able to obliterate everything, right? Even the power of the abyss! In short, Shi Yu should be fine!
…
“If I destroy it, does that mean that this trial will end?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Xuan Ming looked at him and said, “That’s right.”
“In addition, man of the future, your courage is commendable. Before the battle, tell me your name.”
“Alright.”
Shi Yu said.
Right on the heels of that, a purple summoning array surrounded by blue water appeared below Shi Yu on the black water.
Yesterday, Shi Yu was still at level six. Today, Shi Yu was still at level six and had yet to break through. Everyone was no longer that shocked.
This time, they were shocked from a different angle.
In this trial, Xuan Ming clearly didn’t restrict the attributes and number of summons. In other words, Shi Yu could clearly send all his pets, but he only sent one?
Moreover, this one didn’t look like Shi Yu’s strongest trump card yesterday, the sword spirit named Chi Tong?
“That’s…”
“Ning!” Under everyone’s flabbergasted gazes, a blue water slime that was not even the size of the Abyss Evil Spirit’s scales appeared on the black sea.
From the aura of life…
Monarch-level Water Slime…
“What the hell is this?”
“What does he want?”
At this moment, the contestants of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea exclaimed.
What Shi Yu said about researching the Abyss Sea… In the end, he sent a Water Slime??
“Wait a minute, it shouldn’t be that simple.”
Soon, someone realized that the Water Slime was an elemental life form. The greatest characteristic of elemental life forms was that they could mimic and change forms after mastering elementalization.
It might not be as simple as an ordinary Water Slime.
Next, Shi Yu and the others indeed proved this.
In the face of Xuan Ming’s question, Shi Yu introduced it like he was facing the Boar God.
“Dong Huang, Beast Tamer of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu.”
“Pet, Blue Sea Sprite.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, apart from the members of Dragon Palace City who were extremely excited, the others were temporarily at a loss.
However, as the blue Water Slime floating above the black sea frowned slightly and revealed an expression of disdain and disgust, and a huge wave suddenly erupted from its body, the expressions of all the confused people changed.
Including those demigods.
The contestants of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea opened their mouths wide. What did Shi Yu just say?
They looked at the sea.
A strong blue light enveloped the Water Slime!!
The cleansing light spread, and countless people’s eyes widened. In a short moment, as Susu returned to its original form, a shocking aura wave swept out, and Susu’s new figure gradually appeared from the light!!
“The abyss shouldn’t exist.” Under the cleansing light, Susu’s mental fluctuations came.
The form of the Water Slime had already outlined its mermaid-like body under the swirling water.
She had beautiful blue long hair, bright blue eyes, beautiful appearance, and a plump upper body. Her lower body was a blue fishtail that kept flowing like a wave.
Its entire body was made of water, and its aura was incomparably noble. It had an otherworldly aura. As it changed its form and held the signature weapon of the Blue Sea Sprite, the Blue Sea Sword, which symbolized the ocean and purification, everyone felt an unreachable power again.
Holy, pure, clear… Apart from that, the ocean lives even felt the vibration of the power of all the surrounding oceans.
It was as if the master of the sea had returned.
This was…
As Susu changed, all the spectators revealed incredulous expressions.
In the ocean totem factions, those factions that had once obtained the favor of the Blue Sea Sprite and even become believers of the Blue Sea Sprite looked at the creature summoned by Shi Yu in disbelief.
After being stunned, the World Tree clone widened its eyes… It knew it… It knew Shi Yu’s Water Slime’s fluctuations were so familiar!
As for Xuan Ming, as Susu returned to its original form, it also revealed an incredulous expression. It actually sensed the prototype of a supreme law divine skill from it. Through Susu’s body, it seemed to see the entire sea behind this water-element creature.
“Who are you?” Xuan Ming couldn’t help but ask.
As the cleansing wave calmed down, the full appearance of the Blue Sea Sprite appeared, as well as the pet name that Shi Yu had described clearly. Those from the various factions who knew what this name represented were extremely shocked.
As for those who didn’t know what the Blue Sea Sprite represented, when they saw the moved gazes of their elders, they were also shocked and didn’t understand what had happened.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 935 Some Research (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 935 - 935 Some Research (6)
935 Some Research (6)
In the next moment.
The Blue Sea Sprite Susu raised the Blue Sea Sword high.
Buzz!
As if its soul had left its body, a blue Sea Cleansing Spirit that looked similar to Susu’s form was born and wrapped around its entire body. Then, its body kept expanding, erupting with an incomparably huge energy wave!!
!!
This Sea Cleansing Spirit quickly expanded to a thousand meters tall. It was majestic and spectacular. The holy cleansing aura on its body was even richer, and the energy fluctuations as deep as the ocean shocked all living beings.
The monarch level displayed energy fluctuations that were enough to deter totem level.
“Blue Sea Sprite, after the Mythical Era ended, it was the guardian of the sea, the faith of the entire sea,” Shi Yu completed the answer on behalf of Susu.
In the next moment, Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit stretched out its slender hand and directly swept up an incomparably huge ocean cleansing power. Its palm was like a tsunami that flipped the sky and fell towards the Abyss Evil Spirit.
Boom!!!
At this moment, an abyss-like fog spread from the body of the evil spirit that looked incomparably terrifying just now, sweeping up an even more terrifying pollution corrosion power. However, under the illumination of this palm, for some reason, all the creatures looking at the sea felt that this evil god spirit was not that terrifying anymore.
In the next moment, a sizzling sound sounded. The mist instantly turned into ice shards and melted into blue water droplets that fell. Its palm passed through the clouds and finally landed on the Abyss Evil Spirit. In an instant, the sea rolled!!
Everyone saw that under the dazzling cleansing power, the Abyssal Evil Spirit instantly disappeared like weathered sand. At this moment, its palm continued to land. The sea that was originally dyed black by the Xuanming actually quickly turned blue under the envelopment of the white light.
“Impossible!!” At this moment, Xuan Ming was extremely shocked. Although it didn’t activate the power of the abyss with all its might, what right did this monarch-level life form have to crush the power of the abyss that was one level higher than it… so easily?
Buzz!!!
The entire black water area was directly cleansed under the baptism of Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit, which had been accumulated for a long time with the faith skill Blue Sea Contract.
Holy, pure, clean, and countless auras that were opposite to the power of the abyss spread on the Blue Sea Sprite, shocking everyone.
As a Beast Tamer, Shi Yu had seen the world. He was not surprised to see this.
…
In the direction of the totem country.
The demigods of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea could no longer sit still. They directly tore through the void and looked at the Blue Sea Sprite in shock.
This power had already confirmed that what Shi Yu had just said was the truth.
It was really the Blue Sea Sprite!
“Lord Blue Sea Sprite, who has been missing for three thousand years, appeared again?”
“Moreover, it became the pet of a human Beast Tamer?”
“How is this possible? How can that Lord Blue Sea Sprite acknowledge humans?”
Not only them, but the demigods of the other factions were also moved.
Including the World Tree clone.
The World Tree had awakened several times and also knew about creatures like the Blue Sea Sprite that were born after the Mythical Era.
After the Mythical Era ended, although the Abyss Evil God was repelled and the Abyss Race was repelled, their power was really difficult to cleanse.
An inheritance like the Abyss Sea still had some power left on Blue Planet.
It was also because of this that a huge faction that wreaked havoc in the sea in the future was born.
Originally, such a faction would have a huge impact on Blue Planet again. However, even the World Tree didn’t expect that because of the faith of the entire ocean and the determination to resist the Abyss Sea, a magical life form like the “Blue Sea Sprite” was born.
Even in the Mythical Era, no water-element god could obtain the huge ocean faith like the Blue Sea Sprite at that time.
It could be said that in the eyes of the World Tree, the Blue Sea Sprite was born in the wrong era. If it was born in the Mythical Era, it would be a peak water-element Mythical, the strongest trump card for Blue Planet to resist the abyssal faction.
However, even if it was born in the totem era, the Blue Sea Sprite was still incomparably powerful, becoming the strongest demigod below it.
The Blue Sea Sprite… was marked by the World Tree. After the Mythical Revival, it was a general that had to be roped in, but… it was actually contracted by someone?
“It’s the Blue Sea Sprite.”
“Because the entire ocean resisted the Abyss Sea and, their faith condensed into the strongest creature below the myths in the future.”
“After the Mythical Era ended, the inheritance of the Abyss Sea didn’t end, but every time it appeared, it was ultimately destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite.”
“And in order to protect the sea forever, the Blue Sea Sprite is also constantly reincarnating… I didn’t expect it to actually be contracted by humans.”
The World Tree clone introduced it to Xuan Ming. Just as it said, demigods in the future couldn’t become myths not because of talent, but because of the restrictions of the world. Every demigod had outstanding talent, and the Blue Sea Sprite was clearly the best among them.
What was wrong with this Shi Yu!!!
As soon as the World Tree clone finished speaking, Xuan Ming was shocked. A creature born because of the faith of the entire sea? Such a creature, should it have been born in the Mythical Era… It would definitely be at the peak of the divine level.
Of course, if it was the Mythical Era… Those water-element gods probably wouldn’t let the Blue Sea Sprite be successfully born. The entire sea definitely wouldn’t place all its faith on one life.
At that moment, as their elders also finished explaining to him what kind of existence the Blue Sea Sprite was, every contestant of the seven countries and the totem country and the audience also looked at the second Mythical Trial venue in shock.
Such a Blue Sea Sprite… was contracted by a human? How was this possible!
Was this what Shi Yu meant by having some research on the power of the Abyss Sea?
The research referred to contracting the strongest demigod who had destroyed the inheritance of the Abyss Sea countless times?
“That Water Slime’s identity is actually so terrifying?!!!”
Gao Xuan, White Brook, Yin Zhengfan, Xiao Shuang, and countless Dong Huang spectators who had seen Shi Yu send the Water Slime to participate in the National League had incredulous expressions.
Shi Yu… This guy… What was he doing? How, how did he do it?
Such a creature… pet?
At this moment, everyone was stunned. The contestants of the totem country who originally thought that the heroic spirit of a titled expert was Shi Yu’s strongest trump card were all stunned… They had never seen such a heaven-defying Beast Tamer.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 936 Indeed Not a Good Person (1)
chapters.content:
936 Indeed Not a Good Person (1)
The strongest ocean demigod!
Blue Sea Sprite!
Even if it was a reincarnation… No one could understand how such a transcendent life form was related to Shi Yu.
“He actually accepted the inheritance?” Legend Sea Tyrant watched in shock.
When…
“This is the strength of the Blue Sea Sprite…” Lu Qingyi was silent.
A monarch level displaying a totem attack?
No wonder Shi Yu dared to stand out!
“Master, Lu Qingyi, you… all know?” Zheng Hai and the others were completely stunned at this moment. Seeing Shi Yu display such a ridiculous pet, they were extremely confused. However, from the looks of it, many people knew the identity of that Water Slime?
“This is one of Dong Huang’s top secrets.” Beside him, President Lin said, “The identity of the Blue Sea Sprite is very important. Considering that the Blue Sea Sprite had too many enemies, Shi Yu didn’t have the ability to protect himself at that time, so he didn’t publicize it widely.”
“But now…” President Lin looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu already had the strength to reach the same height as the Blue Sea Sprite.
Initially, Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others thought that the Blue Sea Sprite would leave Shi Yu after accepting the inheritance, but as long as they maintained a friendship, it wouldn’t be a loss. However, who would have thought that the Mechanical Phantom… the Chaos Panda… the Green Dragon… Shi Yu would actually nurture existences with potential that weren’t inferior to the Blue Sea Sprite.
Perhaps this was also why the Blue Sea Sprite acknowledged and was still willing to follow Shi Yu.
“Divine Source… You guys…” The legendaries of the various factions felt even more indescribable.
Everyone originally thought that Shi Yu was strong because he had eaten the Mythical Fruit and his physique was strong because he relied on his strongest physique to fuse with a top-notch undead pet to display extremely strong battle power. This was Shi Yu’s strongest state. If he sent out his pet alone, Shi Yu would at most be at the ordinary legend standard.
But no one expected that this guy actually contracted the strongest demigod reincarnation… And was this pet’s battle power… strong? It must be strong.
Countless people looked at the clean sea with shocked gazes. The pressure the Abyss Evil Spirit gave everyone just now was real.
Even the god Xuan Ming had said that the phantom had the ability to corrode invincible overlords. However, such a terrifying evil god was directly… cleansed by a slap.
This was the strongest demigod, the Blue Sea Sprite!
With the strength of a monarch, it easily killed an overlord and casually displayed the extreme cleansing power of a totem!
At that moment, the contestants and demigods of the Infinite Sea and the Ghost Sea still looked at the scene in silence.
The Blue Sea Sprite… had an extremely high status in the endless sea and the Ghost Sea. Although the faith in the Blue Sea Sprite had dimmed in the past ten thousand years, this was also because the Blue Sea Sprite and the Abyss Sea had not appeared for too long.
But history made these two huge factions still remember the kindness of the Blue Sea Sprite.
As long as the Blue Sea Sprite appeared again and gave the order, they were still willing to follow the call of the Blue Sea Sprite to crusade the abyss together to prevent this evil faction from reviving.
However… the Blue Sea Sprite, which had always been alone, actually contracted a human. For a moment, it made the demigods of the Ghost Sea and the Endless Sea Domain feel rather complicated.
After a long silence, they finally gave the order to their contestants.
“All the subsequent trials and battles… You must not conflict with Shi Yu of Dong Huang.”
Perhaps they also had to consider if they should form an alliance with Dong Huang, just like Dragon Palace City.
This time, ordering their subordinates not to have a conflict with Shi Yu was not because of Shi Yu’s characteristics, but because of the impact of the Blue Sea Sprite.
If the Mythical Revival and the Abyss attacked again, they still had to rely on the strongest demigod, the Blue Sea Sprite.
“This…” The invincible overlords of the demigod factions, such as the Deep Sea Emperor Whale and the Mother of the Nether Ghost, also had complicated feelings.
They looked at the two peerless figures above the sea.
The Blue Sea Sprite, known as the “Blue Sea Saintess”, and the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Shi Yu, who was wearing a blue trench coat and stood at the end of the sky with blue Psychic power, looking at the Mythical creature, Xuan Ming.
“There are actually such terrifying pets in the future…” The Boar God muttered as it also looked at them.
Although it was a Mythical creature, it didn’t dare to underestimate creatures that could become the strongest in the Cultivationless Age. If such creatures were placed in the same era, their talent and achievements would definitely be above theirs.
If the divine-level creatures of the Mythical Era could settle everything, the World Tree wouldn’t have chosen life forms with outstanding talent and potential in the future.
It could only be said that these Mythical creatures had benefited from the era.
Next was the arrival of a new era.
Whether it was these old antiques who still stood at the top of Blue Planet, or the geniuses of the new era, the rise of transcendent beings, making the new era without a ship that could carry them, no one knew.
“Blue… Sea… Spirit… Sprite…”
As the host of the second trial, Xuan Ming looked at the figures of Susu and Shi Yu. After a long silence, he said, “I! I acknowledge you! What a Blue Sea Sprite, the strongest demigod in the future. I look forward to you maintaining this advantage and growing into a divine-level domain!!”
“However, after the Mythical Revival and the descent of the abyss, it’s not that simple to obtain all the faith of the ocean.”
“Of course, if it can maintain this extreme ocean cleansing power, the cleansing spirit condensed from the power of the ocean faith will definitely become the light that the abyss faction fears the most.”
“You guys passed the trial.”
“The Abyss Seed is yours.”

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 937 Indeed Not a Good Person (2)
chapters.content:
937 Indeed Not a Good Person (2)
“Come, future Sea Guardian, I’ll help you fuse with the Abyss Seed and comprehend the power of the abyss. You can better cleanse it!!” It looked at Susu.
“With your willpower and physique, you can definitely control it easily.”
At the same time, a black thing that looked like a water drop and a seed floated in front of Xuan Ming.
At this moment, all the factions were shocked. Although they had yet to recover from their identity as Blue Sea Sprites, in the current situation, was Shi Yu… about to obtain two Mythical inheritances?!
This…
Countless people’s eyes turned red. It was fine if Shi Yu ate the Mythical Undying Fruit and contracted the Blue Sea Sprite, but he actually wanted to obtain divine-level inheritances one after another?
How powerful would the Blue Sea Sprite with the strongest cleansing power be if it mastered the terrifying power of the abyss?
Why was he the only one taking all the good things!!
However, just as everyone thought that Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite would happily accept the divine-level abyssal power inheritance, to their pain, Shi Yu actually slowly spoke and rejected.
“Sorry, it might not be able to accept the inheritance of the power of the abyss.”
“Ning.” On the arena, the Blue Sea Sprite Susu recovered its Water Slime form under the lingering blue light.
It didn’t want to learn the power of the abyss. It was dirty, dirty, dirty!
Wasn’t the power of the sea of stars good?
Balls of starry sky strange water were much more interesting than the power of the abyss.
It would give it to Duckie. In any case, Duckie was no longer clean.
“Huh?!”
Shi Yu and Susu’s answer stunned Xuan Ming, as well as the Boar God and the World Tree, making everyone reveal incomprehensible expressions.
Holy shit.
Why the f*ck did they come up here if they didn’t want the Abyss Seed?! Were they so bored?!
“You don’t want the reward?!!!” Xuan Ming didn’t understand, but he was shocked. Then why did he come up? Was it just to let the Blue Sea Sprite slap the Abyss Evil Spirit he created?!
The World Tree had asked it to let the later generations experience the power of the Abyss Evil God. Xuan Ming only felt that its mission had failed. A huge failure. This Blue Sea Sprite had come out at the wrong time.
The abyss was directly countered by blood.
“No, it’s just that it can’t accept the power of the abyss. I plan to give it to another pet,” Shi Yu said. “The trial shouldn’t have said… that the creatures participating in the trial have to fuse with the Abyss Seed, right? It only said that the reward is the Abyss Seed.”
Xuan Ming: “?”
Silence.
Xuan Ming was extremely silent.
Give it to another pet???
The goal of its trial was to test if the pet participating in the trial had the ability to withstand the power of the abyss. If it couldn’t pass the test, it couldn’t absorb it even if it was given the Abyss Seed.
Was this very difficult to understand? Changing pets?
“Although I didn’t say it, it’s true that only creatures who have passed the test are qualified to fuse with the Abyss Seed. Other creatures aren’t qualified.”
“Compared to the Blue Sea Sprite, it’s indeed more compatible with the power of the abyss. Unfortunately, its strength isn’t enough, and it hasn’t contracted with me at the moment. Otherwise, I would have directly sent it out to accept the test,” Shi Yu said. “For the time being, it’s considered my second team’s pet. I think you might change your mind after meeting it.”
Perhaps it would even admire Duckie… Give it more rewards!
Team two pets!
There was no contract…
It wasn’t even the first team?
Shi Yu’s words immediately made the expressions of the Dark Elven Prince and the other transcendent experts ferocious.
A bunch of water-element overlords even wanted to abandon their superior status in the totem country and go to Shi Yu’s second team.
There was such a good thing?
“Are you serious?” Xuan Ming’s huge eyes locked onto Shi Yu. It was unbelievable. Although it was very easy for Shi Yu and the others to deal with the abyssal evil spirit, they should also know how terrifying this abyssal power was.
It was up to the Blue Sea Sprite to cleanse it easily, but that didn’t mean that other creatures were qualified to fuse with the power of the abyss!
“Alright.”
After a long time…
“If its aptitude can satisfy me, then you can deal with the Abyss Seed as you wish.” Xuan Ming’s gaze was burning. He wanted to see what other pet Shi Yu had that was qualified to withstand the power of the abyss.
As for Shi Yu, he didn’t hesitate and directly opened a spatial ripple!
This was a door that connected to the ruins space.
In the ruins.
Duckie held a water blade and fought crazily, stabbing at the Bean Bear phantom in front of it.
In the second team.
Qi went into seclusion to digest the legendary resource, the Nature Fruit.
Little Ji was also about to fuse the “Earth Divine Dragon” fossil.
A huge word “danger” filled the duck’s head.
It had no choice but to train its strength quickly.
If it became the bottom of the second team, he would definitely be made into a duck in soup.
“Duckie, your resources are here too.”
...
Boom!
The duck spear shot out like a dragon. After a water spear penetrated a layer of rust on the Bean Bear, the duck was directly sent flying by the Bean Bear.
But at the same time, its expression was shocked.
Quack?
Resources?
Buzz!
The duck was directly summoned by Shi Yu to the outside world. Then, this transcendent race commander rank Duckbill Beast was instantly watched by countless totems, overlords, and monarchs. Many gazes landed on its Duckbill Beast.
Duckie was shocked!!
What was going on?
It looked up at the huge turtle in front of it and was immediately shocked. It took a step back on the water.
“That’s it??” At this moment, Xuan Ming was immediately stunned when he saw the Duckbill Beast Shi Yu had summoned.
...
“Quack?” The Duckbill Beast was stunned. Although it didn’t know what was going on, this big turtle seemed to be very arrogant.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 938 Indeed Not a Good Person (3)
chapters.content:
938 Indeed Not a Good Person (3)
What did this big guy say?
If it had the ability, why not spar with Big Brother Eleven and Big Brother Buggy?
“The pet you’re talking about is this?” Xuan Ming looked at the blue Duckbill Beast and said.
It couldn’t tell at all how this guy was strong! It was the weakest creature on Inatella Island!
!!
“Is that… the Duckbill Beast?”
The contestants and audience of the various countries were also shocked by the so-called second team pet summoned by Shi Yu.
They had thought of many situations, but they never expected that Shi Yu’s second team was actually a transcendent Duckbill Beast.
Moreover, its growth level was indeed low, only commander rank.
Duckie: (?_?)?
Why did it feel countless disdainful gazes?
Damn it, the Tyrant Dragon was clearly the trashiest!
“What’s the background of this duck!” Yu Shu and the others shouted.
Only the gem cat, President Lin, and the few experts narrowed their eyes.
“Duck, let them see your strength and enter a full-strength state,” Shi Yu said to Duck.
Duckie: Can I, can I?
Duckie was stunned. It suddenly discovered Sister Susu in the distance and immediately expressed its understanding!!
In its full state, it was very difficult to control it, even if one mastered max-level cleansing.
But if Sister Susu was beside him, there would be no problem.
Full-strength state? Its strength?
Shi Yu’s words were obscure and difficult to understand, but it undoubtedly made many people widen their eyes. What was so extraordinary about this Duckbill Beast?
Duckie didn’t waste any time. It directly took a deep breath and took out a “Reincarnation Bean” from a worm silk spatial ring tied to its ankle.
This was a modified version of the Reincarnation Fruit created by Baby Ginseng.
Although it was small, it didn’t mean that the medicine was bad.
It was condensed into essence.
At this moment, as the Duckbill Beast took out the black Abyss Reincarnation Bean from its spatial equipment, Xuan Ming was immediately slightly stunned.
He directly sensed the power of time and the abyss from this black bean.
What was going on…
“Quack! (If a bean is swallowed, my life is up to me!)” The duck raised the Reincarnation Bean high, raised its head, and directly swallowed the Reincarnation Bean.
The scene seemed to have stopped.
One second, two seconds…
Boom!!!
A shocking abyssal power erupted from this Duckbill Beast.
Boom boom boom!!!
A black light instantly enveloped the duck. The black flames that shot into the sky directly made the water under its feet tremble. The place it stepped on was actually instantly dyed black at this moment.
“This is…”
The expressions of the people who had sensed the power fluctuations of the Abyss Evil Spirit changed, revealing incomprehensible expressions.
Abyssal power?
Moreover… from the fluctuations, it was very strong!
Although the quality couldn’t compare to that Abyss Evil Spirit, it was still unimaginably strong. Its energy level had definitely reached the overlord level.
“Quack!!!”
In the black flames, Duckie’s voice echoed.
In the next moment, its body suddenly increased to ten meters tall!
Its muscles were extremely strong!
Its blue skin began to be covered in black, leaving only a portion of dark blue patterns.
At its neck, the black water froze like a ribbon, becoming a scarf-like part that floated behind it.
In just a short moment, its image changed completely.
The terrifying aura emitted directly made countless monarchs and overlords reveal shocked expressions.
< Name > Duck
[Race]: Abyss Demon Duck (Temporary)
[Attributes]: Water, Dark
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Because it had the will of an overlord, even if the duck’s race level was transcendent, its potential level was still that of an overlord. With the help of the Time Fruit, it could be raised to the overlord level. However, what the duck swallowed was not as simple as the Time Fruit. It was an abyssal Reincarnation Fruit specially modified by Baby Ginseng with the power of the abyss and its physique.
It could stimulate the potential of the duck to the greatest extent and let it recover the power of its previous life.
In Duckie’s previous life, it was the Abyss Demon Duck. It could be said to be the only super genius in the future who came into contact with and controlled the power of the abyss. Just like Xuan Ming, it perfectly controlled the power of the abyss.
...
Although Xuan Ming might be controlling a higher-level divine-level abyss power, and Duckie was only controlling the remnant inheritance power of the abyss, it was undeniable that Duckie had shocking talent in this field and was a perfect match for Susu.
Its power was much purer than the abyss traces of the Dark Elven Prince that relied on its bloodline to continue.
“Roar…”
The duck’s deep red eyes opened. At this moment, the weaker person looking at it felt as if his spirit had fallen into an abyss. In an instant, cold sweat flowed out of his entire body. He was so frightened that he took a step back and sensed an extremely terrifying evil aura.
“This…” Xuan Ming also looked at this monster duck that also mastered the power of the abyss in shock.
“This guy is…”
At this moment, not only the totem factions of the ocean, but even the totem factions on land looked at the Abyss Demon Duck and suddenly remembered something.
All of them revealed shocked expressions.
Could it be…
“It’s the reincarnation of an abyss half-god of a certain generation in the Abyss Sea inheritance, the Abyss Demon Duck.”
“However, unlike the past Abyss demigods, the Abyss Demon Duck is a relatively special existence. It took the initiative to come into contact with the power of the abyss and perfectly mastered it without being affected at all. It can be said to be a super genius and monster.”
...
Shi Yu looked at Xuan Ming and said, “It can definitely control the Abyss Seed.”
Xuan Ming said in a trembling voice, “Little brat, are you a monster? You actually plan to contract the Blue Sea Sprite and the Abyss Demon Duck at the same time??”

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 939 Indeed Not a Good Person (4)
chapters.content:
939 Indeed Not a Good Person (4)
Not to mention Xuan Ming, at this moment, all the factions looked at Shi Yu’s second team pet in shock.
What a joke.
Previously, when everyone looked at Chi Tong and saw its evil skills, they felt that Shi Yu didn’t look like a good person.
However, when he saw the Blue Sea Sprite, they realized that Shi Yu might be a good person?
!!
Otherwise, how could it be recognized by the cleansing god?
But now, Shi Yu was indeed not a good person!
Where did he find this abyssal demigod reincarnation!!!
Second team? Did the Blue Sea Sprite agree!
Inatella was silent. The World Tree also watched everything in silence.
Only Duckie was extremely happy as it forcefully endured the corrosion of the abyss power. Quack? Was there such a good thing? Could it also be contracted? It was such a difficult thing to enter the first team.
….
As Duckie appeared, the second round of the World Tournament directly ended. Xuan Ming couldn’t evaluate Shi Yu’s behavior, but it still gave the Abyss Seed to Shi Yu according to the agreement and let Shi Yu do whatever he wanted.
If it was this duck… It wasn’t impossible for this commander rank duck to control the power of the overlord-level abyss and fuse with the Abyss Seed.
It was even more suitable than that Blue Sea Sprite.
The end of the second World Tournament trial could be said to be much crazier than the first. The divine inheritance was taken away one after another by a person. The various factions were extremely shocked, but they were extremely afraid of Shi Yu.
Yes, it wasn’t because they were afraid of Dong Huang or Dragon Palace City, but because of Shi Yu.
He had contracted the strongest demigod, the Blue Sea Sprite, and even dared to use the Abyss demigod reincarnation as the second team. Was this Shi Yu a demon?
It could be said that because of the appearance of the Blue Sea Sprite, Inatella became even more turbulent.
However, this had nothing to do with Shi Yu anymore. After obtaining the Abyss Seed, he bade farewell to Xuan Ming, the Boar God, the World Tree, and the other gods.
There was nothing else to say.
Farewell!
He had gone to nurture the second team!
Every time he obtained new resources, Shi Yu was the happiest.
This time, the World Tree didn’t reveal the information of the third trial. It only said that it would open in the afternoon.
In the outside world.
After the second trial ended, it was still not calm.
Countless representatives of the ocean totem factions came to visit Divine Source Legendary and President Lin. They wanted to see Shi Yu basically because of the Blue Sea Sprite!
….
“Quack!!!”
In the legendary ruins space.
In the battle of Susu, it wasted most of the power of the Sea Cleansing Spirit that had been condensed for a long time. It couldn’t help but feel a little heartache. After returning, it immediately worked overtime to condense again.
As for Duckie, it held the Abyss Seed excitedly and thanked Big Sister Susu.
It had already sensed the shocking power contained in this seed.
It felt that after eating it, it would become ten times stronger than eating the Abyss Reincarnation Bean.
“Don’t eat randomly.”
Shi Yu immediately reminded, “You have to try to refine it under Susu’s protection. Moreover, before you begin, break through to the monarch level first.”
“After you reach the monarch level and after Susu reaches the overlord level, you can start refining this. Only then can you ensure your safety. Susu, keep the Abyss Seed safe for Duckie first…”
“Quack!!!” Duckie agreed without hesitation. It was a small problem.
Monarch level, with hard work, it arrived in a few days.
“Ning.” Susu also sighed slightly.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, in the Mechanical Research Institute, a huge mechanical Tyrant Dragon also stuck its head out. It looked at Duckie’s Abyss Seed seriously and fell into deep thought.
Then, it looked eagerly at Ling, who was flying beside Shi Yu.
“Roar!!! (Big Sister!! When are you going to fuse the Earth Divine Dragon fossil?)”
It was anxious.
The overlord of the earth would never admit defeat!
Ling looked at it.
Similar to Shi Yu, it said heartlessly, “Let’s break through your current strength first. When you reach the monarch level.”
Be it fusing the Earth Divine Dragon fossil or fusing the Abyss Seed, it was possible for their potential to reach the Mythical stage. Therefore, they couldn’t be sloppy. At the very least, they had to be at the monarch level to try.
“Everyone, work harder.” Shi Yu also chuckled. Team Two that would counterattack and sweep Team One to death! He didn’t mind watching the commotion.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 940 Unconventional
chapters.content:
940 Unconventional
“Roar!!”
“Quack!!”
Under the temptation of the “Earth Divine Dragon fossil” and the “Abyss Seed”,
The huge Earth Dragon Little Ji and the blue fat duck prepared to continue the special training excitedly.
Boom.
Little Ji turned and left. The ground trembled, causing Duckie, who turned around together, to frown.
Noisy!
Shi Yu also had a look of disdain.
“Wait!”
At this moment, Ling, who was flying beside Shi Yu, suddenly stopped Little Ji and Duckie.
“Roar?”
“Quack?”
The overlords of the earth and ocean turned around with puzzled expressions.
What other instructions did it have!
“Go back and take a look at this.”
Ling took out two tablets and threw them to Little Ji and Duckie, who were confused.
This was…?
Ling said, “This is a brilliant video editing of your Beast Tamer’s World Tournament. It has your senior’s heroic performance. Remember to observe and learn.”
“Oh?” Shi Yu looked up at the sky at a 45-degree angle and said, “That’s thoughtful of you.”
Ling: “?”
Didn’t this guy ask it to record it?
According to Shi Yu’s requirements, Shi Yu’s performance in the World Tournament had to be super clear…
It was for the second team, even the third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, and ninth teams in the future, and even the various armies under him in the country to learn…
Little Ji, Duckie:!!
“Roar!!” “Quack!!”
Little Ji and Duckie’s eyes flickered, as if they had seen the video title through the black screen.
“Team One Information”!
Well… If they studied it carefully, they might be able to figure out the weaknesses of the members of the team!
For the sake of the future “subparity counters superiority”, this was a precious learning material!
Little Ji and Duckie put away the tablet as if they had obtained a treasure.
….
In the legendary ruins space.
Shi Yu stood on the spot and thought for a moment.
The World Tree was too much. The interval between each trial was too short.
Couldn’t they give the contestants three to four days of rest after the trial?
It didn’t take care of a “consecutive champion” contestant like him at all.
Although he didn’t consume much energy in the morning, the next trial in the afternoon made him not dare to add points randomly, afraid that it would affect his condition.
“I should continue researching telepathy!”
Although researching this thing was also exhausting, it was better than adding points.
“Ling, help me call Baby Ginseng over. Also, supervise Eleven and Buggy and tell them to control themselves.”
“Alright.”
Ling quickly flew away.
In the ruins, apart from Shi Yu’s considerate secretary, Ling, the other pets were rubbing their fists. They felt that time was passing too slowly.
Chi Tong and Susu, who had finished fighting, wanted to fight again.
As for Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, who didn’t appear, they couldn’t wait.
“These guys…” Ling looked at Eleven and Buggy, who were constantly warming up, and sighed.
Eleven was actually alright.
But it was really afraid that Buggy and Baby Ginseng wouldn’t be able to stop in time and blow up the entire Inatella.
The Yin Yang Millstone was a single-target skill. Its power was all focused on the enemy. As long as it was controlled well, the aftermath wouldn’t be too ridiculous.
However, the enemy wasn’t the only one who suffered from Buggy’s Dragon Star Group Meteorite hitting Blue Planet and Baby Ginseng’s Moon Explosion.
Moreover, it was difficult for Buggy and Baby Ginseng to control these skills…
Ling only hoped that the World Tree, Mythical creatures, and demigods could control it.
At the moment, only Ling still had rationality.
After circling around, Ling called Baby Ginseng, who was researching the Energy Fruit of the Anti-World Tournament contestants, over.
...
After obtaining the information, Baby Ginseng had already found a way to deal with every champion candidate after careful research.
“Yiya?!!!!”
At that moment, after being shouted at by Ling, Baby Ginseng took off its glasses and shook off its white coat with a pleasantly surprised expression!
It immediately pushed the door open and crawled underground to find Shi Yu.
It naturally knew why Shi Yu had called it over.
Let’s study the “heart domain, World Tree” together!
After a few experiments, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng already knew very well that the World Tree Domain was very strong.
It was completely different from the Yin Yang and Green Dragon Domains.
….
In the outside world.
After Shi Yu insta-killed the Abyss Evil Spirit, a storm brewed.
...
The legend of the Blue Sea Sprite immediately spread throughout Inatella.
Now, most people found it strange.
It was said that the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation could only accept the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins at the overlord level.
Why did Shi Yu’s Blue Sea Sprite master the racial skill of the Blue Sea Sprite at the monarch level?
Although they didn’t know what was going on, it wasn’t too important. After all, even a ridiculous thing like the Blue Sea Sprite being contracted had happened.
Now, they were more concerned about another problem.
How strong was the battle power of the Blue Sea Sprite?
The battle power of the undead possessing Shi Yu was ridiculously strong, but quasi totems were already very unsolvable. Now that there was another Blue Sea Sprite, every contestant with the intention to win the world championship was very silent.
For example, the Green Dragon Prince asked the Tyrant Dragon King.
In the dark void, the Tyrant Dragon King opened its eyes.
“There’s no need to worry. The Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation can easily defeat the Abyssal Evil Spirit. It largely depends on its ability to counter it. In terms of destructive power, that attack is even inferior to a serious totem-level attack.”
“Its growth level hasn’t reached the overlord level yet. The proficiency of the Blue Sea Contract and the Sea Cleansing Spirit won’t be very high. At this level, without several years of bitter cultivation, it can’t condense a move that’s enough to cleanse normal totems.”
“That attack should have exhausted its strength.”
“I see.” The Green Dragon Prince heaved a sigh of relief.
The demigod factions who were more familiar with the Blue Sea Sprite all deduced.
It had to be said that the deductions of many factions were already very accurate.
Even with the cheat Infinite Devour, it was not easy for Susu to condense another totem-level Sea Cleansing Spirit in a short period of time because the time it had received the inheritance was too short.

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 941 Unconventional (2)
chapters.content:
941 Unconventional (2)
“What I should consider now is whether this Shi Yu has any other trump cards. He’s too strange. Even the second team is an abyss demigod reincarnation. Where’s the first team?”
“Isn’t that even more terrifying?”
“That’s not necessarily true. Most Beast Tamers in the seven countries like to change pets. If it weren’t for the fact that the Abyss Demon Duck hasn’t grown up and doesn’t have any extra contract slots, Shi Yu might have already replaced it in the first team.”
“The talent potential of a contracted pet might not necessarily be comparable to a new pet. At most, its strength will exceed, so there’s no need to be too pessimistic. How can someone be so ridiculous with all their pets being that heaven-defying?”
“The Blue Sea Sprite is the strongest demigod reincarnation. Even the World Tree, Boar God, and Xuan Ming acknowledge the Blue Sea Sprite very much. Could it be that you think Shi Yu has a pet even more ridiculous than it?”
“The other pets should at most be on the same level as that heroic spirit. After all, that heroic spirit isn’t simple either. When it was alive, it should have been a hybrid of a totem creature and a human genius. When it was alive, its strength definitely reached close to the legendary level.”
“That’s true…”
In fact, it wasn’t surprising that the various countries would deduce this. Even those who were slightly familiar with Shi Yu felt that Susu and Chi Tong’s background potential was already very ridiculous. For example, although Lin Hongnian and the others were bragging about the Iron-eating Beast, they didn’t think that the heroic spirit reincarnation of the number one general under Emperor Shi’s command would have lower talent potential than the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
The reason why the Demon God Iron-eating Beast was strong was because it had followed Emperor Wu. If it didn’t follow Emperor Wu, it would only be Senior Ji Mengzhu’s father, the trump card of the strongest general under Emperor Wu. At most, it would be equivalent to Mu Huiyin.
No, it was even inferior. After all, General Mu Huiyin seemed to be a hybrid. Even Emperor Wu had admitted the power of hybrid humans. Although Emperor Wu’s physique was known as the strongest among pure-blooded humans, it might not be the case if it was compared to hybrids of the same level.
The reason why the low-level Beast Tamers of the totem country could contract above their level was largely because the Beast Tamers of the totem country were all hybrids specially cultivated.
“I wonder what the content of the next trial is.” In the Dong Huang area, President Lin stood high and looked at the sky.
Now, Dong Huang had already placed all its chips on Shi Yu. Outsiders might not know Shi Yu’s specific trump card, but Divine Source Legendary and President Lin knew that Shi Yu’s strength was far from the tip of the iceberg.
…
Inatella.
Light-element arena.
A loud hum made all the creatures on the island look up.
They took a look and saw that it was indeed the World Tree clone flying into the sky again.
“The third trial is about to begin in the light-element arena. The ‘Holy Divine Deer’ has already awakened!”
Light-element arena!!
The one presiding over the third trial was a light-element god!!
“Light element?” When Shi Yu came out of the mystic realm, he guessed the rules.
In his team, Eleven and Baby Ginseng both had light attributes, so it wasn’t a big problem to restrict their attributes.
It was actually not a big problem to restrict other things.
Unless only female Beast Tamers could participate in the trial, Shi Yu felt that it was not a scam.
Boom!!
The contestants of the various factions were flying in the direction of the light-element venue.
Most people were using their pets to travel. There were also transcendent creatures from large factions in charge of teleportation.
“Kids.”
In the Dong Huang area, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Lu Qingyi, and even Shi Yu, who had just come out of the ruins, looked at the direction of the light-element arena. The voice of the gem cat appeared in their hearts.
“I’ll send you over.”
Upon hearing that, Shi Yu and the others relaxed and let the gem cat teleport them.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!!
Around the light-element arena.
Light flashed.
The ten people from Dong Huang arrived.
“Shi Yu!”
After the people gathered, Zheng Hai and the others looked at Shi Yu beside them and couldn’t help but say with the corners of their mouths twitching.
“Do you have a light-type pet?”
This ridiculous guy… had already obtained two inheritances. This one shouldn’t be the case, right?
There didn’t seem to be any light-type pets in Shi Yu’s team.
“Light element, yes,” Shi Yu said with a chuckle.
Everyone: “?”
“However, none of the main attributes are light-element. They can’t even be considered secondary attributes. They can barely be considered the third attribute,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s alright.” Ye Xing looked at the horizon. His trump card was light-element, top-notch overlord battle power.
Coupled with his Beast Taming Talent, he had quasi totem battle power.
Dong Huang still had hope for this trial.
“That’s…”
At this moment, as the ground and mountains on Inatella Island shook, the surroundings of the light-element arena had already cracked into ruins, along with the surrounding space.
