Amidst the vibrations, nine-colored divine light spread from the spatial crack.
In the sky, the World Tree clone stared at the spatial crack and introduced the god.
“Light-element god, Holy Divine Deer. In the invasion war, it was in charge of an overlord army. There were a hundred generals in the army.”
“But after being strengthened by its divine skill, ‘Nine-Colored Divine Light’, these hundred generals can instantly reach the demigod level.”
As the World Tree clone introduced the identity of the Holy Divine Deer, the eyelids of many factions twitched.
...
F*ck.
100 demigods?!
What a joke.
Although they understood that demigods from the Mythical Era might not be as rare as now, when they first heard it, it was still difficult for the current creatures to imagine what an army of 100 demigods would be like.
“Holy Divine Deer.”
“This deer is also awake.”
In the sky, the Boar God and Xuan Ming also tore open a spatial crack and stood at the highest sky, looking down.

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 942 Unconventional (3)
chapters.content:
942 Unconventional (3)
Just like the Boar God, Xuan Ming didn’t sleep immediately. It was all attracted by the situation in the later era because of a test and wanted to continue seeing what other extraordinary creatures could appear in the future.
“Buzz!!!!!”
The void completely cracked. A huge creature with the appearance of a deer and nine colored light marks on its white body stepped out of the air. Its holy gaze was revealed as its eyes opened, and its figure slowly landed on the ground.
As it took a step, the surrounding nine-colored world formed, and it looked at the Boar God, Xuan Ming, and World Tree clone in the sky.
“Hm.” After the nine-colored divine deer nodded at them, it looked at the thousands of living beings around it and emitted a gentle but high and mighty female voice, naturally revealing its divine might.
“I remember the World Tree telling me that the Beast Taming Abilities of humans are very interesting. Every one of them is a support skill that can assist creatures in becoming stronger, and there are all kinds of abilities.”
“I’m more curious about this. Why don’t you show your Beast Taming Talent to me one by one…”
“There’s no need to fight. Just show it directly. I’ll decide how its potential is. The most talented person can obtain the prototype skill of my divine skill, the Nine-Colored Divine Light, the inheritance crystal with the strongest light support super ability.” The Nine-Colored Divine Deer looked down.
“Then don’t waste time. Those who want the inheritance of the ‘Nine-Colored Divine Light’ can just come out and show it,” the Holy Divine Deer said.
“I’ll give an evaluation of one to ten stars according to the talent potential.”
Boom!
Just as the nine-colored divine deer finished speaking, the contestants widened their eyes.
The World Tree clone had just finished introducing the power of the Holy Divine Deer… A skill could instantly strengthen 100 overlords to demigod battle power.
Most importantly…
Was the content of the test serious?
No longer competing in pet battle power?
Competing in the potential of the “Beast Taming Talent”?
In an instant, most of the contestants were extremely excited. Even Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, and the others felt that good things came after suffering.
For the first time, he felt that there was a trial he could participate in.
For the first time, he felt that he was a little stronger than Shi Yu in one aspect.
Shi Yu’s telepathy talent was undoubtedly a common talent. Even after transcendent creatures’ levels were high, they could master telepathy. It was not a powerful talent at all.
Even if the effect of listening to history was included, it wasn’t that rare. In every country, one could still find a few.
Although Shi Yu was very strong to have relied on such a lousy talent to reach this stage, it was probably impossible to rely on such a talent to obtain this inheritance.
“This guy has finally been punished!” The contestants of the other six countries knew that Shi Yu had a telepathy talent. They subconsciously thought of him and heaved a sigh of relief. Alright, it was already not bad for Shi Yu to be lucky enough to obtain two Mythical inheritances.
This trial finally didn’t include Shi Yu’s turn.
At that moment, Inatella had gathered the world’s elites. Although there was also a batch of ordinary strengthening talents, there were also many invincible Beast Taming Talents gathered here. These people were determined to win this trial.
This time, it should be their turn.
“What are they happy about?” At the same time, President Lin, who had also arrived, felt the gazes from all directions in Dong Huang’s direction and towards Shi Yu. He was speechless.
If Shi Yu had an ordinary telepathy talent, it would be fine even if it was a historical talent. The key was that this little monster had even developed telepathy into a telepathy domain a second time!!

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 943 Strongest Talent (1)
chapters.content:
943 Strongest Talent (1)
The third trial began intensely.
“Lord Holy Divine Deer, I!! I have a light-element strengthening talent.”
At this moment, many Beast Tamers were extremely excited. They didn’t expect to be able to directly recommend themselves to divine-level creatures.
Regardless of their Beast Taming Talent, at this moment, every contestant wanted to promote themselves to the Holy Divine Deer and win the nine-colored divine light inheritance.
!!
Soon, a legend Beast Tamer from the totem country rushed forward and cooperated with the contracted overlord to display his light-element strengthening talent.
It was relatively easy for a legendary strengthening talent to bring tens of millions of energy points strengthening to light-element energy. A light-element overlord with 60 million energy points instantly reached 81 million energy points under the strengthening of this legend Beast Tamer.
“Four-star, too weak.”
“Four-star is barely enough. Three-star.”
Although it was the trial of the Holy Divine Deer, in the sky, Xuan Ming and the Boar God couldn’t help but evaluate the Beast Taming Talent of the human Beast Tamers.
“Four-star,” the Holy Divine Deer said calmly.
Among them, attribute strengthening talents were belittled by the three gods to be worthless.
This made the corners of Zou Yun, Zheng Hai, and the other strengthening talents in the Dong Huang area twitch. For a moment, they didn’t know if they should go up.
“Although strengthening talent is common, it’s practical,” Zou Yun said indignantly.
“Then let’s give it a try. What if?” Zheng Hai sighed.
President Lin said, “There’s no hurry. This process is also a good opportunity to collect information on the Beast Taming Talent of the contestants from the totem country and the other six countries. Look carefully first.”
…
…
In a short moment, everyone discovered this pattern. Usually, Beast Tamers who broke out of the preliminaries rarely had Beast Taming Talent evaluated by the Holy Divine Deer as above six stars.
The first to exceed six stars was still a member of the nine demigod factions.
In the Void Court, a young Beast Tamer in a black robe displayed his spatial strengthening talent with his contracted overlord, the Void Mantis.
Under the spatial strengthening talent, the quasi totem-level Void Mantis didn’t use any moves. It directly slashed through the void with a saber, displaying an attack that would heavily injure even a totem-level head-on, making the expressions of the Green Dragon Prince, the Rubber Divine Tree, and the other totems change.
Although these invincible overlords had yet to reach the totem level, they still couldn’t be underestimated.
“What, spatial strengthening talent?!”
As this talent appeared, many Beast Tamers from the totem countries were shocked. Although they were all strengthening talents, the enhancement of the spatial strengthening talent was much more terrifying than the attribute strengthening talent.
“It has the same talent as the Space Emperor, and…” In the Dong Huang area, the Void Mantis beside Lu Qingyi narrowed its eyes and looked at the black-robed young man and his clansmen beside him, its thoughts drifting away.
The Void Court was its hometown. However, compared to those royal families, it could only be considered an abandoned child, and it was all thanks to the Space Emperor taking it in.
“Eight stars.”
At this moment, be it the Boar God, Xuan Ming, or the Holy Divine Deer, they all acknowledged this talent very much.
However, their evaluation also made many Beast Tamers’ balls hurt slightly.
Even the powerful spatial attribute strengthening talent was only eight stars. What was nine stars and ten stars?
Time strengthening talent?
However, it was difficult to think about time strengthening talent. In the past 3,000 years, only four Beast Tamers with time strengthening talent had been recorded.
…
Soon after, a second eight-star talent was revealed. It was the trump card legend of Xue Yuan, Andre. His Beast Taming Talent was the “Time Freeze” talent, which was also considered a time talent.
It could allow any ice-element skill of the contracted ice-element pet to have the effect of freezing time. The effect was similar to the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, but it was more comprehensive than the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy.
This talent made the three gods raise their eyebrows slightly. It was very good to let a pure ice-element creature master the power of time.
In fact, to a certain extent, it was even more useful than the Time Strengthening Talent. After all, the Time Frozen Talent only needed an ice-element pet to use, but the Time Strengthening Talent needed to be matched with a pet that had mastered time-type skills. The threshold for the latter was too high.
Of course, in terms of the upper limit, the Time Strengthening Talent was still recognized as the strongest.
…
Then, ridiculous talents appeared one after another.
The Beast Tamers carefully cultivated by a few demigod factions had their Beast Taming Talent basically evaluated as seven-star potential.
Among them, everyone originally thought that the Beast Taming Talent of the Beast Tamer who contracted a totem above his level in the Origin Land and the Dragonman Empire would be very powerful, but they realized that that was not the case at all.
The Beast Tamer of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree Totem in the origin place had a tailor-made “tree sprite” talent.
It could transform into a sprite-type tree-type life form to assist in its growth and strengthening. At the same time, the threshold of contracting a tree-type life form would decrease. Although it had successfully contracted the totem tree, in terms of overall potential, this talent was far inferior to “Space Strengthening” and “Time Freeze”.
The situation in the Dragonman Empire was similar. The contractor of the totem-level Green Dragon Prince was a hybrid of a human and a dragon. It was a “dragon blood talent”. It could rely on absorbing the blood of a dragon-type pet to reduce the difficulty of contracting this pet. The enhancement to the pet was even inferior to the tree sprite talent. There was no battle power enhancement at all.
This also made many totem countries understand the huge price of contracting totems above their level. The strength of talent and contracting above their level couldn’t be combined.
The Origin Land and the Dragonman Empire originally thought that they could rely on the potential of contracting above their level to take a gamble and win the favor of the Holy Divine Deer, but in the end, their Beast Taming Talent evaluation didn’t even have four stars.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 944 Strongest Talent (2)
chapters.content:
944 Strongest Talent (2)
On Dong Huang’s side, as they continued to watch, Shen Feng’s trump card, Qiao Sen’s Awakening Talent, the strongest Mechanic talent of the same type as the Mechanical Legendaries, was evaluated as a seven-star talent. While Gao Xuan was happy, his expression quickly darkened, because he definitely couldn’t defeat an eight-star talent.
He followed closely behind. As expected, it was only a seven-star evaluation.
Soon, a few hours passed. More than 200 contestants displayed their talent one after another. A total of five talents that were evaluated as eight-star by the Holy Divine Deer appeared.
They were the spatial strengthening talents of the Void Court and Shen Feng. Apart from the Void Court, the Shen Feng Nation also had a spatial attribute strengthening talent.
Snowfield Nation’s Time Freeze Talent.
The fusion talent of the Shen Feng Nation and the Dong Huang Nation was a talent that could allow multiple pets to fuse into one. Zhou Ming of the Dong Huang Nation also had it. In the eyes of gods like the Holy Divine Deer, this talent had extraordinary potential, especially after stepping into the God Domain. Perhaps it could easily assist the two gods in completing the combination divine skill.
Unfortunately, Dong Huang’s Star Strengthening Talent and Divine Bell’s Ancient Revival Talent were only evaluated as level 7.
After a round of testing, the expressions of the contestants from the totem country were not good.
Because compared to the seven human countries, there were still too few Beast Taming geniuses in the totem country.
From the Beast Taming Talent, one could tell how endless the Beast Taming Geniuses of the seven countries were.
Five eight-star talents, four from the seven human countries, and two from the Shen Feng Nation.
From this, the difference between the seven countries and the totem country could be seen. After all, one was made up of humans, and the other was made up of transcendent lives.
“Any more?”
At this moment, the Holy Divine Deer looked down.
Many gazes looked in Dong Huang’s direction and at Shi Yu.
As a famous figure in the World Tournament, how could Shi Yu not be paid attention? Everyone discovered that this guy who had obtained the inheritance of two trials had yet to go up and show his talent.
It looked like Shi Yu had given up. Not only him, but Lu Qingyi of Dong Huang should also have given up. Among the more than 200 contestants who had displayed their talent in the World Tournament just now, none of them had a telepathy talent. This explained a lot. It was very difficult to become an expert with a telepathy talent.
“If not, the few of you can fight to decide the inheritor.”
The expressions of the contestants on Dong Huang’s side changed slightly. They still wanted to fight?
Zhou Ming was about to cry. Although he was lucky enough to become the strongest talent owner of Dong Huang and was thought highly of by the gods, he definitely couldn’t defeat those guys.
Why not give him a one-colored divine light? He wasn’t greedy. Stop fighting and split the inheritance equally.
“Damn it.” Ye Xing and Divine Bell only felt that they were one step away. As long as there was one more star, they weren’t afraid of battle.
“I wonder how many stars I can be evaluated for a historical talent.”
At this moment, Lu Qingyi sighed slightly and tried before Shi Yu.
She walked out of the Dong Huang area and looked at the Holy Divine Deer. “Lord Holy Divine Deer, I have a telepathy talent.”
At that moment, the Holy Divine Deer and the other gods looked at Lu Qingyi, who walked out of Dong Huang.
The Holy Divine Deer said, “Telepathy… can it also be considered a talent?”
Wasn’t this the ability that every Mythical creature had since birth?
What was the use?
Lu Qingyi smiled bitterly and said, “The telepathy talent is a special Beast Taming Talent. It can help Beast Tamers communicate better with non-contracted creatures.”
“However, this is only the basic usage of telepathy. According to development, the telepathy talent can also be upgraded to the ‘listening to the Voice of History’ talent.”
“As long as it’s an ancient item that contains traces of time, Beast Tamers with the gift of telepathy can spy on history through this talent. This is also the strongest talent of archeologists in the future.”
The Holy Divine Deer nodded and said, “A talent to spy on history through the traces of time? Not bad, seven stars.”
It didn’t waste too much time on Lu Qingyi. It didn’t even have the intention to verify it and let Lu Qingyi show it. After all, compared to the Listening Talent and the Spatial Strengthening Talent, there was still a difference even if it contained some time abilities.
In any case, the telepathy talent that couldn’t increase battle power couldn’t participate in the final inheritance competition.
Seeing this, Lu Qingyi retreated helplessly.
When the contestants of the various countries saw this, they heaved a sigh of relief.
As for Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Zhou Ming, and the others, they revealed as expected expressions.
“By the way…”
At this moment, seeing that the third trial was already nearing the end, everyone had almost finished displaying their talent. Seeing that Shi Yu had yet to come up, the Boar God and Xuan Ming couldn’t sit still.
To be honest, although Shi Yu had obtained the inheritance from them, they really didn’t seem to know what Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Talent was.
In the first two trials, Shi Yu did not show his Beast Taming Talent at all.
Why didn’t this guy come up for a long time?
Could it be that the Beast Taming Talent was very lousy?
“Human kid, you haven’t come up yet, right? What Beast Taming Talent do you have??” The Boar God and Xuan Ming took the initiative to leave the arena and looked at Shi Yu as they asked.
Realizing that the Boar God and Xuan Ming were looking at Shi Yu so concernedly, the Holy Divine Deer also looked over and noticed this young human who also didn’t show his talent.
“Me? Like the beauty just now, I also have a telepathy talent,” Shi Yu said to the three gods in the sky.
Upon hearing that, the Holy Divine Deer was still alright. The Boar God and Xuan Ming were slightly stunned and looked at the World Tree clone.
This ridiculous kid was actually just holding a talent in telepathy???
Lu Qingyi, who had just come down, was also speechless. Why was he pulling her along?

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 945 Strongest Talent (3)
chapters.content:
945 Strongest Talent (3)
“Yes.” The World Tree clone had long known and was relatively calm. As the strongest archeologist of the seven countries, it was very normal for Shi Yu to have a listening talent.
“Then it’s alright. Looks like this trial has nothing to do with you,” the Boar God said with a smile.
Freak. How was he so strong with just a telepathy talent?
“Is it very special?” The Holy Divine Deer asked the Boar God and Xuan Ming, not understanding why these two were so concerned about this human.
!!
“This human passed my and Xuan Ming’s trial previously and obtained two inheritances,” the Boar God said.
“One person, two inheritances?” The Holy Divine Deer looked at the weak Shi Yu. However, although he looked weak, it could sense the huge power hidden in Shi Yu’s body.
It was only stronger than the humans who displayed their Beast Taming Talent just now, not weaker.
It’s good that this trial had nothing to do with Shi Yu!
Not to mention the contestants of the totem country, the legends of Shen Feng and Xue Yuan were delighted when they saw that Shi Yu didn’t cause any trouble.
The two legendaries already felt that this was the closest to a divine-level inheritance.
The Void Court was also silent. They were still very afraid of Shi Yu, who had obtained two inheritances in a row.
“No, it’s actually still has something to do with me.”
“I’m also a little interested in Lord Deer God’s ‘nine-colored divine light’.”
However, after being noticed, Shi Yu didn’t seem to have any intention of giving up. Psychic power enveloped his entire body and he slowly flew up and said to the three gods.
His words stunned everyone.
Everyone: “?”
What was this guy talking about when all he had was a telepathy talent?
Everyone looked at Shi Yu, who walked out, and was speechless.
Didn’t Dong Huang’s Lu Qingyi verify that her telepathy talent was at most seven stars just now? Why did he still stand out?
“Huh? Didn’t you say that you were telepathic?” The Boar God looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu said, “Although I also have a telepathy talent, telepathy talents aren’t all completely identical.”
At this moment, Shi Yu landed on the empty ground. At the same time, a purple summoning array appeared in front of him. A ginseng baby appeared on the arena.
Many factions looked at this ginseng baby and were stunned.
Especially those factions who didn’t know Shi Yu very well. When they saw that Shi Yu actually contracted a monarch-level ginseng baby, they revealed incredulous expressions.
As expected, just as they had guessed, Shi Yu’s other pets weren’t that strong?
Even Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the others were stunned when they saw this ginseng baby. Although they sensed the huge energy contained in its body, there was nothing special about it.
What was Shi Yu doing?
He wanted to use the “telepathy” talent on it?
“Yi.” At this moment, Baby Ginseng pouted. It didn’t expect that it had been summoned and wasn’t fighting at all. It couldn’t help but give bad reviews.
Forget it… Baby Ginseng sighed.
They could fight sooner or later. There was no hurry, so Shi Yu wanted to… fish first?
At this moment, Shi Yu smiled as he looked at the confused gods.
“Although Beast Taming Talents are natural, after postnatural development, abilities won’t remain the same.”
“Although there are strong and weak talents, as long as it’s developed appropriately, even if it’s a single-purpose talent, it can still display a dazzling side.”
“Dong Huang’s legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Wu, originally only had an ordinary Fusion Talent. He could only undergo a Fusion Transformation with one pet, but as he developed, the Fusion Talent was developed to an extremely high level. He could fuse with nine pets and suppress demigods with battle power.”
“And coincidentally, apart from the ability to listen to the Voice of History, I’ve also developed some other aspects of my telepathy talent.”
“Therefore… even if it’s a telepathy talent, it might not necessarily be weaker than talent potential like spatial strengthening.”
“Everything is born of the heart.”
“All existences are materialized from the heart.”
“When telepathy is cultivated to the extreme, it’s the use of the power of the heart. I call it the mind domain.”
At this point, Shi Yu slowly closed his eyes.
In the dark world, Shi Yu saw a blue planet, Earth, and the huge tree growing on it in his heart.
[World Tree Domain]!
No.
Shi Yu’s three mind domains were actually very special.
The Yin Yang Domain was the only mental domain with its own sound of laws. The effect was comparable to a quasi-divine skill. It could strengthen the power of the Yin Yang skill, but the consumption was huge. At the same time, it could suppress other powers.
The effect of the Green Dragon Domain was not as ridiculous as the Yin Yang Domain. It didn’t contain the sound of laws, but it could effectively strengthen the power of Buggy’s faith skill and increase the speed at which it mobilized the power of faith.
As for the World Tree Domain, the effect was that the plant-type creatures in the domain would be affected by the domain power and temporarily fuse with the World Tree phenomenon. Their life force would undergo a qualitative change, and their wood-element power would increase greatly.
This increase would make it easier for Baby Ginseng’s every skill to come into contact with the level of laws. Compared to the effect of the legendary World Tree’s Blessing, this domain was more like a bridge to communicate with the mortal gods of the world. Shi Yu preferred to call it: [Tree Bridge Domain].
Boom!!
Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes. At this moment, his eyes turned emerald green, containing supreme vitality.
As Shi Yu activated his mind domain, the air around him began to hum and vibrate.
The almost corporeal mental wave formed green ripples around him.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 946 Strongest Talent (4)
chapters.content:
946 Strongest Talent (4)
In the next moment, as Shi Yu’s Eye of the Heart spun, a strong wave bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
The entire world turned green.
On the ground, a sapling appeared under Baby Ginseng’s feet and quickly grew.
Soon, it grew into a towering divine tree.
During the growth process of this divine tree, it was as if it had replicated countless ginseng babies. When its branches bloomed, every ginseng baby on every branch stood on the divine tree like a fruit.
Thousands of ginseng baby figures made people unable to tell what was going on for a moment and lost their minds.
What was this!
“Could it be…” The expression of the World Tree clone changed. It sensed the power of the world from it.
At this moment, in the World Tree Domain and perfectly fused with the World Tree, Baby Ginseng was like a mortal spirit that ascended from the ground to the sky and touched the divine domain.
A vast and deep power circulated on its body. As the sweet aura, nutrients, and Time Fruit flowed on its body, its low-level skills instantly touched the power of the natural order.
Although it was far inferior to the strength of a super skill when it came into contact with the power of the natural order and couldn’t be upgraded to a quasi-divine skill, it could still be called a small divine skill…
Buzz!
A weak sound of laws still spread from the ginseng babies.
It was as if an Undying Divine Medicine had appeared, directly making the non-mythical races present feel a strong pressure and temptation.
Countless transcendent lives’ eyes instantly turned red, and they couldn’t suppress the saliva in their mouths.
“What’s this…”
The Mechanical Legendary of Shen Feng and the War Gods of Xue Yuan revealed shocked expressions.
Divine Source Legendary and President Lin were also stunned. Wait a minute, apart from the Taiji and Green Dragon Domains, Shi Yu had developed a new domain?
This form… Could it be because of the World Tree Fruit?!
Many people widened their eyes in shock and looked at the ginseng baby fruits on the divine tree.
“Buzz!!”
The sound of laws spread again.
Just like those gods, it spread from the body.
At this moment, the Beast Tamers who were evaluated as eight-star talent were stunned.
Their minds were blank, and they couldn’t understand why the telepathy talent was like this.
Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others suddenly looked at Lu Qingyi.
Lu Qingyi shook her head crazily.
“I don’t know.”
The gem cat and the Void Mantis were stunned.
Wait a minute, wasn’t this the sound of laws that could only be triggered by the prototype of a divine skill?
Why did it directly spread from Baby Ginseng!
At that moment, what concerned people the most was not the sound of laws triggered by the ginseng baby, but the tempting fragrance emitted from its body.
The fatal wave directly went into the transcendent life forms there and trembled. Their genes were shouting.
They felt that if they ate it, it could enter the God Domain.
Even the demigods in the void found it difficult to suppress the urge to eat all the fruits on this tree at this moment. No, it wasn’t just demigods. After fusing with the World Tree Domain and touching the power of the natural order with low-level nourishing skills…
The three gods who had just woken up couldn’t help but rumble. They revealed incredulous expressions and actually felt that if they ate that ginseng baby, they would accelerate the recovery of their strength.
“Divine-level resource.” At this moment, the three gods made a judgment together. They couldn’t believe that Shi Yu had actually used some unknown method to strengthen a ginseng baby to a nourishing resource comparable to a divine-level resource.
Boom!!!
The World Tree Bridge Domain, also known as the Jianmu Domain, enveloped the entire Inatella. The temptation of the ginseng baby had reached the extreme.
Living beings couldn’t believe that their hearts would actually fall instantly. They had the urge to charge forward.
What was unbelievable was that one, two, three, four…
Four different laws sounded everywhere on Inatella Island, and the void trembled.
“It smells so good.”
“The birth of a divine medicine?”
“It’s not the World Tree?”
“What a rich life force.”
Voices spread all over the island, and the void tore. A dragon-element god, a huge ox-type god, a tiger-type god, and a plant-type god directly woke up from their sleep.
At this moment, when the Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the Holy Divine Deer saw that these guys, who had also been awakened by the World Tree once, had directly woken up, their expressions changed. They looked at the huge tree. They didn’t expect that this guy’s fluctuations would actually wake those guys up together.
“I didn’t awaken them,” the World Tree clone muttered.
Because the burden of waking up was too great, the few gods told it not to awaken it in advance. The World Tree clone indeed did as it was told, only awakening the corresponding god before every trial.
But this time… since it was awakened by other creatures, it had nothing to do with it.
At this moment, Shi Yu was also quite surprised. However, as the display of his mind domain ended, he still looked at the Holy Divine Deer under everyone’s shocked gazes and said,
“In the mind domain, the abilities of the corresponding pet will be enhanced. For example, the ‘Tree Bridge Domain’ in front of us can be a laws bridge for the pet to communicate with the mortal gods of the world.”
“With the enhancement of this domain, my monarch-level ginseng baby is also half a step into the Mythical race.”
...
“Although it’s not a complete Mythical race, I think it shouldn’t have the enhancement effect of other Beast Taming Talents. It’s stronger than the telepathy talent, right?”
“So, can this be considered the strongest Beast Taming Talent?”

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 947 Strongest Talent (5)
chapters.content:
947 Strongest Talent (5)
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Inatella immediately fell silent. Countless creatures locked their gazes on Shi Yu.
Their gazes trembled.
“This beast!!!” In an instant, the gazes of countless totem half-gods exploded. What was this kid saying? He called this a telepathy talent?!!
Sensing the powerful aura on Baby Ginseng’s body and the tempting fluctuations comparable to divine-level supplements, they swallowed their saliva crazily.
!!
Especially the Black Dragon Ruler, who had a grudge with Shi Yu. Its eyes were red and its saliva flowed. If it weren’t for the fact that there were too many experts here, it would have already rushed forward.
The Holy Divine Deer’s calm expression was finally moved. This Beast Taming Talent had just strengthened a mortal spirit into a divine domain??
It even… affected its mental fluctuations?
The Holy Divine Deer didn’t sense wrongly. Just now, it definitely had the thought of tasting that ginseng baby…
“What’s this!!”
At this moment, because Baby Ginseng emitted the fragrance of a god, the four gods who were originally about to be awakened by the World Tree woke up in advance and looked at Baby Ginseng on the divine tree.
At this moment, the World Tree clone didn’t know how to explain to the four gods. It could only say, “It’s the pet of a human Beast Tamer. After being strengthened by the Beast Tamer, it temporarily became like this.”
“Human Beast Tamer? Pet?”
The four gods looked at Shi Yu, who seemed to be one with the Tree Domain, and at Baby Ginseng, who was connected to him telepathically.
It meant that it couldn’t be eaten?
At this moment, the Holy Divine Deer was silent for a moment. It looked at the ginseng baby on the divine tree and said, “You win. Among the Beast Taming Talents just now, your Beast Taming Talent is undoubtedly the strongest.”
“The inheritance crystal of the nine-colored divine light is yours.”
Skill Name: Nine-Colored Divine Light
< Introduction > It’s a light-element super skill. It contains a total of nine colors of divine light. Different colors of divine light can respectively allow the pet’s physique, life, attribute energy, energy control, affinity for natural power, affinity for spatial power, soul power, spiritual power, and willpower.
As soon as the Holy Divine Deer finished speaking, the Boar God and Xuan Ming fell silent.
The contestants of many countries, be it the totem country or the Seven Nation Alliance, found it difficult to accept.
Why…
Why… was it this guy again? How could a telepathy talent be developed to this extent? Was this Shi Yu still human?!
In theory, Shi Yu didn’t even have the qualifications to enter the trial… The contestants of the World Tournament, who originally thought that Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Talent was his greatest shortcoming, felt their brains rumble continuously.
“How did this guy’s head grow…” Legendaries like the Elven Empress of Tingxiang were very shocked.
Didn’t Shi Yu have any shortcomings?
Although Shi Yu had yet to use his mind domain in battle, looking at the phenomenon of Baby Ginseng, many creatures also completely sensed the extraordinariness of this second-developed mind domain. Their expressions couldn’t help but change drastically.
Beast Taming Talent that could help mortals enter the God Domain?
Not to mention in this competition, even in the entire history, it was a top-notch talent.
And such a talent was developed by a level-six Beast Tamer from the telepathy talent? How was this possible!!
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu had indeed successfully obtained another trial inheritance, Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others were excited. However, was it really alright?
Sensing the unfriendly, covetous, and greedy gazes of the overlords of the totem countries towards Baby Ginseng, they felt that many contestants who originally didn’t have any thoughts about Shi Yu instantly had huge evil thoughts about him.
Perhaps in the eyes of some demigods, totems, and overlords, the value of the ginseng baby was no longer inferior to a trial inheritance.
At this moment, they only wanted to know if Shi Yu did it unintentionally or if he deliberately used Baby Ginseng to bait them…
Originally, as Shi Yu displayed his strength, the hostility of many totem factions towards Shi Yu dissipated.
But now, as Shi Yu displayed further… the hostility seemed to have returned. Like they couldn’t wait to eat Shi Yu. Was Shi Yu complaining that there weren’t enough undead puppets??

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 948 Machines Can Also Divine (1)
chapters.content:
948 Machines Can Also Divine (1)
There was silence in Inatella.
The World Ginseng immediately became the most attention-grabbing.
Divine-level resources.
Shi Yu immediately strengthened a monarch-level pet into a divine-level resource through his Beast Taming Talent!
!!
Everyone could confirm that perhaps the energy level was not enough, but in terms of quality, the current ginseng baby had already exceeded most divine-level resources.
This couldn’t help but make many ferocious overlords unable to suppress the saliva in their mouths.
“What’s this guy doing!”
At this moment, the Prediction Owl’s pupils widened.
It knew this ginseng baby. After all, the first evolution of the ginseng baby was in the time mystic realm it protected.
At that time, Baby Ginseng had displayed the talent of the Undying Divine Medicine, and now, it had actually become even more exaggerated.
The Prediction Owl couldn’t suppress the saliva in its mouth. At the same time, it was worried for Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng.
It suddenly recalled its prophecy just now. Baby Ginseng was being chased by a group of totems and overlords… Could it be… that this was the cause?!
What a sin!
At that moment, the Prediction Owl didn’t know if it should be happy that another prophecy might hit or worried for Shi Yu and the others.
Its mood was especially complicated.
Without a doubt, the Beast Taming Talent displayed by Shi Yu was undoubtedly the strongest. However, at the same time, it also exposed the fact that he had contracted a supplement pet that was not inferior to divine-level resources.
This was very bad.
“Although you obtained an inheritance, you’ve also become the target of the arrows.”
The Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire was still holding a grudge.
Although the Fire Dragon King wasn’t its son and was only a disciple, it had spent a lot of effort to nurture it.
Now, it only wanted Shi Yu to pay the price.
Seeing that Shi Yu had exposed a ginseng baby that was comparable to a divine-level resource for this inheritance, it instantly knew that if there were any chaotic battle rules during the next World Tournament, Shi Yu would definitely be attacked by concentrated fire.
Originally, Shi Yu had taken so many inheritances in succession that it was enough to attract aggro. Now, with Baby Ginseng… he was definitely the enemy of the world!
A ginseng baby that contained the sound of laws in its body… After eating it, it might be able to evolve into a Mythical race!
After all, it was a divine-level supplement that shocked Mythical creatures.
“The talent of humans is actually so powerful? They can do this?”
At this moment, among the four gods awakened by Baby Ginseng, the tiger god, who was as tall as a mountain, said in surprise.
The first time it was awakened by the World Tree, the World Tree had told them about the changes in the totem era and the Beast Taming Era.
Among them, the greatest variable on Blue Planet was the rise of the human race.
Originally, the gods were very curious about humans, but now, they were even more curious.
It could be said that Shi Yu’s enhancement to that ginseng baby was not inferior to the enhancement of a support-type quasi-divine skill to a transcendent life form.
Baby Ginseng, who originally had a mortal spirit body, was actually instantly not inferior to obtaining the potential of a god. Although it was temporary, it was also commendable.
“Inheritance!”
It was another trial dominated. Shi Yu happily took the nine-colored divine light inheritance crystal that flew over from the sky.
Under the jealous gaze of the Void Mantis of the Void Court, the two Beast Tamers of the Shen Feng Nation, and a Beast Tamer of the Snowfield Nation, the crystal landed in Shi Yu’s hand.
They originally thought that the inheritance was easy to obtain, but who knew that Shi Yu would appear in the end?
Not to mention them, even those Beast Tamers who weren’t qualified to participate in the final inheritance competition felt even worse than killing their own mother when they saw Shi Yu obtain another inheritance. Their eyes were extremely red and filled with envy.
Even those demigods gritted their teeth in hatred at Shi Yu’s dog shit luck and wished they could strip Shi Yu naked.
At the same time.
The information about the crystal was received by Shi Yu’s mental consciousness.
Nine-colored divine light!
This skill could actually strengthen pets in all aspects. It was simply too abnormal.
Support strengthening skills, like healing and cleansing skills, were all very rare skills. A single skill to strengthen a certain quality was already very rare.
As for the nine-colored divine light, it could actually strengthen physique, life, energy, skill proficiency, natural power affinity, spatial power affinity, soul, spirit, will, and so on!
No wonder the nine-colored divine deer said that this was the strongest support skill.
Shi Yu didn’t know if it was bragging, but the prototype of this divine skill was definitely not inferior to Susu’s Blue Sea Contract and Sea Cleansing Spirit. It was very strong.
However…
What made the corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitch was that the inheritance power contained in this inheritance gem seemed to be too huge.
His pet… was it really alright to receive the inheritance?
“By the way.”
At this moment, after handing the inheritance crystal to Shi Yu, the Holy Divine Deer said, “Only light-element creatures can use this inheritance crystal. I originally prepared it for my clansmen and spent a lot of effort.”
“You have to be careful when you use it.”
“It’s also a strengthening resource. The power contained in it can strengthen a light-element life form to the quasi-divine level after receiving it, which is the totem level you call it as in the future. I remember that there seems to be a contract level restriction in your human Beast Taming Space. Your Beast Taming level is too low, so you probably can’t withstand the power of a quasi-divine. Therefore, I suggest that after your Beast Taming level increases, you hand the inheritance crystal to the contracted life form to use.”
Good news! The inheritance crystal… could instantly strengthen a pet to totem level!
...
Bad news! He didn’t seem to… be able to use it?!
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 949 Machines Can Also Divine (2)
chapters.content:
949 Machines Can Also Divine (2)
Why was it as scammy as the inheritance of the Blue Sea Sprite?
Couldn’t it have less inheritance points?
Who could withstand a totem level at once?
However, most inheritances were indeed like this. For example, Senior Lu’s Mythical Revival was perfect proficiency at the start after receiving it.
!!
And this nine-colored divine light was probably transcendent proficiency.
Although it still needed the user to train for countless years before it reached the level of a divine skill, this starting point was something that future creatures looked up to.
“It’s a proper divine-level inheritance resource.” At that moment, after hearing that this inheritance crystal could instantly create a totem-level support-type quasi god, the various factions were envious again.
“He can’t use it now!” However, there was also something that made the contestants of the various countries happy. Shi Yu had obtained such an inheritance treasure and couldn’t use it at the moment!
Including the previous Flame of Life and this nine-colored divine light, they were not resources that could increase battle power in a short period of time!
The Abyss Seed had also been given to the second team’s duck by Shi Yu. In other words, although Shi Yu had obtained three inheritances, his strength had not increased much because of the inheritances.
At the thought of this, the expressions of the rubber divine tree, the Green Dragon Prince, the Fallen Angel, the Void Mantis, and the other contestants couldn’t help but relax.
Good! Good! Good!
“Lord Holy Divine Deer…”
At this moment, Shi Yu was really helpless to complain about this inheritance.
When he could contract a totem level, forget about level nine, even if he contracted above his level, it would be at least level eight. At the moment, he had yet to reach level seven. He had to wait for a long time.
It was a lonely inheritance.
Shi Yu was silent and fell into deep thought.
Then, he looked in Dong Huang’s direction.
Forget it, if that was the case, he would give it to someone first. This was a skill inheritance resource and a strengthening resource. Shi Yu didn’t want the strengthening effect. It was extremely useless to him. It was mainly a skill. In any case, it could still be replicated after the skill. It was more stable to add points to transcendent than to receive the inheritance.
Light-element inheritance crystal… It was similar to a gem… Shi Yu looked at the gem cat in Dong Huang’s direction. Among the people he knew, this guy seemed to be the only one suitable. This guy’s attributes were much older, and it could use any resource.
It was better to think of a high price and sell it to Teacher Cat to trick it into working for him for 100 years.
The gem cat: !!!
The gem cat: ???!!!
Gem Cat: Σ(°△°||)_
Shi Yu… Why was this guy looking at him!
“Meow?”
Firstly, excluding the possibility that he was showing it off to it. Shi Yu wasn’t that kind of jerk.
Could it be…
The gem cat instantly raised its claws in shock.
[Looks like I can’t use it for the time being. Teacher Cat, I’ll give you the gem.] Shi Yu planned to let the gem cat accept the inheritance first before replicating the nine-colored divine light to teach his pet. This way, he would perfectly solve the problem of the excessive inheritance power.
After learning this skill, the gem cat’s strength… should be able to become a top-notch totem, or even one of the best.
After all, this skill was really strong. Not to mention strengthening others, just strengthening it to oneself could also strengthen oneself into an invincible state.
Gem Cat: ?o(╥_╥)o ?
“I’ll say.” At this moment, among the awakened gods, Inatella had a divine bull. Its entire body was golden, as if it was made of gold.
It looked around and looked at the gods who had also awakened and at the gods who had awakened earlier. “What’s the situation now?”
“How troublesome. Looks like I woke up early.” Its gaze landed on the wannabe Ginseng Emperor, who had already returned to its normal state and was making a face at everyone with a face like a punching bag.
At this moment, in the eyes of the various totem overlords, the Ginseng Emperor’s ghost face was like a beautiful woman flirting with a single person, as if it was saying, “I’m so yummy, come and eat!” and “Come and play.”
Shi Yu indeed had the intention of fishing… In any case, he had already offended what he should offend. It was better to kill more undead for Chi Tong.
If one didn’t think about eating Baby Ginseng, everyone would still be good friends, but if one thought about Baby Ginseng… Then he could only treat it as an enemy. Be it the totem country or the seven countries, this move was called luring a snake out of its hole.
The undead puppets could also inherit some of the original owner’s skills. If any undead’s skills were not bad, it could completely be raised as a backup skill column.
Or… he could use the memory water drop to squeeze out their skill experience and sell the skill water drop for money!!! It was a huge profit.
Apart from that, overlord races were everywhere here. The materials on their bodies were all top-notch, the kind that was very difficult to buy in Dong Huang. It was not a loss to collect them in case of emergencies or as evolution materials.
Shi Yu’s eyes turned green again.
In any case, with the protection of the Dragon God and the Mechanical Legendary, during the World Tournament… the World Tree wouldn’t let the demigods attack the contestants. It was very safe.
As for after the World Tournament ended… Shi Yu felt that he would definitely have broken through to the Legend level at that time. At the same time, all the members in his team would be invincible overlord quasi totems and would have their battle power strengthened at the epic level.
For example, if the Time Fruit created by the overlord-level World Ginseng was eaten by the invincible overlord of the Mythical race, it would definitely instantly have totem-level attributes. Coupled with the Taiji Domain and quasi-divine skills, Shi Yu felt that it shouldn’t be difficult to unleash a demigod attack.
Perhaps when the time came, he could hide in the Blue Sea Ruins and let Susu condense a Sea Cleansing Spirit for a year and fuse with a bunch of quasi-divine skills. Perhaps he could really do it. Legend-level battle power was close to that of a demigod. When he reached the Titled Legendary-level, he might be able to suppress demigods like the legends of the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 950 Machines Can Also Divine (3)
chapters.content:
950 Machines Can Also Divine (3)
He was only a step away from invincibility, so Shi Yu naturally wanted to do something big.
“That… is it the Golden Bull God?”
At this moment, the expressions of some Western countries suddenly changed when they saw the four new gods in the sky.
There were four gods, and one was a huge tiger that was like a mountain. It should be an earth-element god.
A plant-element god was a huge tree that contained a rich life aura. It was definitely a wood-element god.
As for the dragon god, it was completely dark and looked like a Western dragon. It should be a dragon-element god with dark secondary attributes.
The tiger god and the dragon god were relatively unfamiliar with these three gods, but the metal-element divine bull among them instantly stunned many factions.
Just like how the east knew that the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin had a Mythical race in the Mythical Era, the west also knew some information about gods through archeology.
The Golden Bull was one of the twelve known gods in the Western archeological world. It was known as the god of battle. Archeologists had archaeologically produced Mythical Ruins that recorded its information.
This guy… was very strong… and extremely belligerent!
“The current situation is that we’ve already completed three of the seven trials we agreed on at the start, and…”
The Boar God watched the commotion and didn’t mind blowing things up. Its huge pig nose trembled as it said happily, “Moreover, they were all taken by a human.”
“My Flame of Life, Xuan Ming’s Abyss Seed, Little Deer’s Nine-Colored Divine Light Inheritance Crystal…”
Holy Divine Deer: “?”
“Oh?” “Alone?”
The earth-element divine tiger, Lie Shanjun, the Dark Dragon Demon King Dragon, and even the battle god, the Golden Bull God, looked at Baby Ginseng’s Beast Tamer, Shi Yu.
From the looks of it, this was the human who had obtained the inheritance of three gods?
The World Tree woke them up and asked them to help train and nurture humans. The gods had indeed thought of their own test method.
They could confirm that the selection method of each of them was different.
Boar God, Xuan Ming, and Holy Divine Deer, their power inheritance systems were completely different.
However, in such a situation, it was the same person who passed their trial??
Their gazes stared at Shi Yu for a moment. Could this be the “son of the era” of this era??
Even in the Mythical Era, at a certain time, a super genius who crushed the current era would appear. He was known as the one with the greatest hope of charging to the peak of the Divine level. Then, in the future, it was not strange for a genius with talent to crush the current era at a certain time.
This human could actually awaken them with “that method”. He indeed had some ability.
“Since everyone has already woken up in advance…”
At this moment, the World Tree clone had already vaguely sensed what was going on with Shi Yu’s talent.
That feeling just now was definitely not wrong.
Shi Yu should have eaten the World Tree Fruit it had given to the Seven Nation Alliance. It was a mental talent developed through the World Tree Fruit.
He was indeed a genius.
Although it had the support of the fruit that contained the power of the world’s laws, it was still a shocking talent.
Next, it planned to take extra care of Shi Yu. Shi Yu, who had obtained three inheritances in a row, eaten the World Tree Fruit, and the Undying Fruit, and obtained the Son of the Stars, was already the most suitable human to obtain the World Tree’s Blessing in the eyes of the World Tree clone.
Of course, if a human more monstrous than Shi Yu appeared in the future, the World Tree clone would also be very happy to take care of him. It didn’t mind having too many geniuses, but the premise was that geniuses like Lin Feng and Shi Yu could crush the current era.
For example, the Fire Dragon King couldn’t enter the eyes of the World Tree clone at all.
“Then, the progress of the trial should be accelerated,” the World Tree clone said.
It also knew that these gods were all in an extremely weak state. They would be very tired after waking up for a long time.
In that case, it would shorten the interval between the trials.
“1, 2, 3… In other words, it’s my turn next, right?” At this moment, the mountain-like tiger god’s eyes were filled with supreme divine might. Just looking at it directly made the blood of many creatures boil.
“The deterrence of this god…” The fallen angel took a deep breath. It felt that it was even more terrifying than the deterrence it sensed from Shi Yu.
“Yes.” The World Tree clone nodded and said, “Lord Lie Shanjun, have you already decided on the content of the trial?”
“Let me think.”
“That guy, Boar God, should be looking for the strongest fire-element creature in the future, right? As for Xuan Ming, it’s looking for a creature that can inherit the power of the abyss. As for little Deer, it looks like it wants the heir chosen by comparing the human Beast Taming Talents?”
Holy Divine Deer: “?”
The gem cat: “?” Don’t talk bad about the deer! Show some respect!
Lie Shanjun judged for a moment. Then, its stone-like tiger whiskers swayed, revealing his fangs.
“After thinking about it, I originally wanted to choose an earth-element creature, but from what you said, a new life form was born because of humans. It’s called a mechanical life form, right? I’m suddenly more curious about this.”
“Hey, who among you contracted a Mechanic life form? Summon it and I’ll take a look.”
“Is the human expert who created the Mechanic class here?”
“I plan to choose a Mechanic creature that’s pleasing to the eye and pass down my inheritance.”
Boom!!
As soon as this tiger-type god finished speaking, the expressions of the Beast Tamers of the totem countries instantly darkened.
“F*ck???”
It was an earth-element god and a tiger. Why was it curious about Mechanics??
It was said that cats were curious, but why were tigers also curious!
The tigers and earth-element creatures in the totem country could be said to have instantly fallen from heaven to hell.
...
At this moment, many contestants finally knew how strange the thoughts of these gods were.

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 951 Machines Can Also Divine (4)
chapters.content:
951 Machines Can Also Divine (4)
Apart from the Boar God being more normal, the rest… didn’t follow the routine!
“Damn it!”
“This is clearly biased towards the seven countries!”
In the alternate space, the totem demigods had unfriendly expressions.
Mechanics were clearly the mainstream of the seven countries, especially the Shen Feng Nation. Almost all their contestants were expert Mechanics!!
This made the totem demigods and totem clans feel that this was clearly giving the inheritance to the Shen Feng Nation.
The Shen Feng Nation… could be said to be the human country that these totem countries hated the most.
After all, if it weren’t for the fact that the Mechanical Legendary Z of the Shen Feng Nation was the first to develop a Mechanic class, the humans definitely wouldn’t have won the totem battle so quickly.
The huge resources of the seven countries had always been envied by the totem country.
“I’m here, god.” At this moment, Shen Feng’s Mechanical Legendary Z walked out of the alternate space.
Seeing the pride of their country, the strongest Legendary, appear, the contestants of the Shen Feng Nation were also extremely excited.
The legendary of their country… was especially paid attention to by Mythical creatures!
“If it’s a Mechanic, the contestants of our Shen Feng Nation have contracts. Their contracted pets are also very powerful and have extraordinary potential,” Shen Feng Legendary Z said.
“Is that so? I heard that Mechanics can easily destroy demigods. Is that true?”
“You even modified a demigod-level mechanical divine eagle close to the Domain of the Gods?”
Lord Lie Shan showed an interested expression.
In the Mythical Era, apart from those unique Mythical races, it was also very difficult for other creatures to advance to Mythical Races.
They basically had to undergo countless evolutions to obtain the potential to enter the God Domain.
In its opinion, it was already very impressive that this human expert could mold a new life race into quasi-divine potential in this era with incomplete ;+laws.
No wonder the World Tree said that the potential of humans was extraordinary. Such methods usually only existed in those Mythical races in the Mythical Era.
“Yes, this is the pride of my life,” Z said.
“Unfortunately, because the laws of the world are incomplete, in addition to the natural flaws of the Mechanic class, it’s very difficult for them to master the power of the natural order and can’t completely enter the God Domain.”
“However, although Mechanics can’t be divine, due to the speciality of this element, I believe that one day, they can also participate in divine-level battles.”
Firepower was power.
If the skills weren’t enough, he would make up for it with the amount.
Shen Feng Mechanical Legendary Z finished.
Even the demigod-level mechanical divine eagle modified by him wasn’t a Mythical race. It had never mastered the power of laws. That mechanical divine eagle was similar to a forbidden Mechanic Weapon. It purely relied on the battle power of a demigod at the “energy level”.
Every move was equivalent to a forbidden weapon attack. It had the highest energy value on Blue Planet and was the guardian supported by the entire Shen Feng Nation. Although it didn’t master nomological skills, it still made a group of demigods tremble in fear.
“This is very normal.”
Lie Shanjun said, “The laws of the world change from incomplete to Restoration at all times. This change will subtly affect the creatures in the world.”
“If it changes to a certain point, perhaps the world won’t be able to give birth to Elemental life at this moment. If it changes to the next point, perhaps a new life form can be born in the world. Mechanics should have been born under this change.”
Lord Lie Shan’s words stunned many archeologists.
Shi Yu was also below and was slightly stunned. In that case… the reason why antique swords that could nurture spirits in ancient times couldn’t nurture spirits now was also because of the changes in the world laws?
“It doesn’t matter if it can’t reach the Divine level now. Perhaps after the Mythical Revival, the mechanical life form will undergo a new qualitative change due to the Restoration of the world’s laws.” Lie Shanjun seemed to be very close to the mechanical Legendary of the Shen Feng Nation.
It said, “In that case, the fourth trial will test the ‘Race Potential’ of the Mechanic class.”
“Let me see for myself if mechanical lives have the potential to become gods.”
“Little brats of the Contract Mechanic class, I’ll use my divine might to envelop your contracted machinery. This divine might only suppresses the ‘bloodline level’. Can you understand that it has nothing to do with strength? The higher the potential of the race’s bloodline, the longer you can last under this divine might.”
“In the end, it should be the mechanical life form with the highest racial level that can stand until the end.”
“Thus, obtaining the reward.”
“This…” As soon as Lie Shanjun finished speaking, the Mechanics of the Shen Feng Nation were almost overjoyed to the extreme.
Dong Huang, the Seven Islands, Rongguang, Ming Hua, and the Mechanics of Snowfield were also pleasantly surprised.
It had nothing to do with strength level. It only tested race potential.
This time, Gao Xuan was still as moved as in the previous trial.
With the help of the Divine Source Legendary, his Ultimate Holy Dragon Beast’s race level was also comparable to a quasi Mythical race. Otherwise, it would be impossible for it to pass the preliminaries. In that case, he also had a chance to compete for the inheritance?
He had an awakening talent and had even obtained the help of the Divine Source Legendary. In terms of the potential of mechanical lives, he might not necessarily be inferior to the Mechanics of the Shen Feng Nation.
Xue Yuan and the other mechanical countries were also extremely happy. They also had mechanical lives comparable to quasi Mythical Races.
They were all above high-level overlord races. So be it. Who was afraid of who?
At this moment, just as the Mechanics of the seven countries were very excited, the alternate space opened again.
Dong Huang’s Mechanical Legendary Divine Source walked out of the alternate space in silence. It looked at Lie Shanjun, who was like a small mountain on the ground, and said, “Lord Divine Spirit, is this trial really comparing the racial potential of mechanical lives?”

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 952 Machines Can Also Divine (5)
chapters.content:
952 Machines Can Also Divine (5)
“Yeah, is there a problem?” Lie Shanjun said.
It wanted to see how far the mechanical life form had gone during the evolution process.
The World Tree seemed to think that Mechanical lives were a very terrifying war machine? Was it that magical?
“No, no problem.” At this moment, Divine Source Legendary wanted to laugh.
!!
President Lin of Dong Huang also wanted to laugh like him.
“Heh, hehe.”
In the Dong Huang area, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others were shocked when they saw the usually unfathomable and calm President Lin suddenly unable to control the corners of their mouths.
Wait a minute, what was going on? What was wrong with President Lin?
“However…”
At this moment, Divine Source Legendary looked at Shen Feng’s Mechanical Legendary Z and said to Lie Shanjun,
“However, I have a different opinion.”
“Although Legendary Z is the founder of the Mechanic class and he is the absolute authority of the Mechanic class, but…”
“Times are improving, and talents appear in every generation. Him saying that Mechanics can’t reach the Divine level is already in the past.”
“Mechanical lives can also be divine. We, Dong Huang, already have a Mechanic who cultivated and created mechanical lives of Mythical Races!!”
“Huh??” Lord Lie Shan was stunned and looked at Divine Source Legendary.
Legendary Z’s expression also changed as he suddenly looked at Divine Source.
The Legendarys of the seven countries and the demigods of the totem country suddenly looked at him.
Divine Source Legendary… What did he just say?
Dong Huang already had a Mechanic who cultivated and created mechanical lives of Mythical Races?
“What, who??” Lord Lie Shan asked subconsciously.
“Shi Yu!” Divine Source Legendary looked at Shi Yu, who had just received the third inheritance and was still standing below.
“He happens to be a member of the contestants of this world competition.”
Shi Yu?
Shi Yu?
Why was this name so familiar?
As Divine Source Legendary spoke, countless people were stunned. Then, right on the heels of that, their brains rumbled.
They looked over in disbelief.
It was him again???
“Impossible.” Sounds appeared in the mouths of the Shen Feng Mechanics. They widened their eyes and didn’t believe Divine Source Legendary.
“What a joke.” Legendary Z’s gaze suddenly exploded as he suddenly recalled something.
At this moment, the other gods who were originally paying attention to Lord Lie Shan’s trial and waiting to watch the show, including the World Tree clone, were stunned.
Especially Boar God and Xuan Ming.
Why… was it this Shi Yu again?
At this moment, the Dong Huang audience was also at a loss.
“Him?”
“You cultivated and created a mechanical life form of a Mythical Race?!!”
Lie Shanjun’s gaze landed on Shi Yu and he was completely stunned. Wasn’t this kid… a human who had just obtained three divine inheritances in a row?
On the basis of mastering the strongest fire-element pet and a pet that could receive the power of the abyss, he also studied Mechanics?
“Uh.”
Shi Yu was also very surprised.
He felt that it was Ling’s Wind Blessing that had the Effect.
Otherwise, his luck wouldn’t be so good.
This trial was simply tailor-made for him.
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “I did nurture and create a mechanical life form of a Mythical Race.”
“Summon it and let me take a look,” Lie Shanjun said.
“Sure.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Ling, I’ll leave it to you.”
In the next moment, a purple summoning array appeared.
A green whirlwind condensed.
Ling in the form of a Rubik’s Cube appeared in midair.
At this moment, when they saw this mechanical life form, the Mechanics of the seven countries were all stunned. This was clearly just an ordinary Hundred Transformations Stone mechanical life form.
Especially Gao Xuan, who could tell at a glance that this was the champion reward of the National League that Shi Yu had won from him?!!
Mythical Race mechanical life form? Stop kidding!
“It’s a Mythical Race??”
...
At that moment, Lord Lie Shan looked straight at Ling in front of him and sensed its weak strength. Just from its appearance, one really couldn’t tell anything.
At this moment, in order to verify it, it couldn’t help but release its divine might.
It only suppressed the mechanical life form in front of it at the bloodline level.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, the sound of laws spread from the huge mountain tiger. As the ground trembled and the mountains trembled, tiger roars came from its body.
“Roar!!!!!”
An incomparable divine might turned into a transparent wave that spread in all directions. Apart from the few gods and the World Tree clones, the expressions of the surrounding experts, contestants, and audience changed.
Sensing that the power of their bloodlines was under an extremely terrifying suppression, they felt weak all over.
This was still the result of… most of Lord Lie Shan’s divine might enveloping Ling.
At this moment, in the face of Lord Lie Shan’s divine might, the white-haired loli Ling in the form of the Cube also slowly raised her head.
Because it was a Mythical race, Lord Lie Shan’s divine might that didn’t target strength and only targeted the bloodline level indeed didn’t affect it much.
...
However, under this deterrence, Ling felt that its divine power was actively rejecting the other party’s deterrence.
As if it didn’t allow the other party’s divine might to envelop him.
Every god had its own pride.
Boom!!!
As the white-haired loli Ling raised its head, the divine might of Dao Proficiency erupted from its body.
“I’m a Mythical Race.”
Under the deterrence, the surroundings were instantly affected by Ling.
The sky and ground instantly turned white. The expressions of the surrounding creatures changed again as they sensed the suppression from their bloodlines.
Legendary Z, who was still in disbelief just now, widened his eyes in shock. He sensed an indescribable and indescribable power wave that enveloped the world. Even the surrounding creatures of overlord races felt that it was difficult to breathe.

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 953 Machines Can Also Divine (6)
chapters.content:
953 Machines Can Also Divine (6)
In front of this monarch-level mechanical life form, he felt an indescribable pressure.
Dong…
At this moment, the world trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared.
Unlike the weak sound of laws that could only be produced after Baby Ginseng was strengthened by its Beast Taming Talent just now, this sound of laws lingered in the wind. Its voice resounded through the world and spread in all directions. It was extremely close to the appearance of Mythical creatures. It could even trigger huge nomological fluctuations through space!
!!
“Tian…”
“Well…”
The Elven Empress of Tingxiang and the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City were slightly stunned when they sensed the divine power released by Ling. They could clearly feel that its power was much stronger than when it was in Dragon Palace City.
If it was said that when Dragon Palace City had just awakened its quasi-divine skill where Ling was still very unfamiliar with mobilizing this power, then now, the Elven Empress of Tingxiang and the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City felt that Ling’s use of the quasi-divine skill was already approaching them.
“What’s this?”
“How is this possible…”
“I don’t believe it!”
In Shen Feng Nation, as Mechanics sensed Ling’s pressure, their expressions were filled with disbelief.
In the next moment, their eyes widened even more. Not only them, but even the expressions of Mythical creatures like the Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the Holy Divine Deer instantly changed!!
As Ling entered the Mythical Revival state, the wind of luck lingered. The form of the Rubik’s Cube was directly replaced. A deer-like white body and a light and slender creature slowly appeared.
On its body, some green patterns condensed into cloud-like hair, reflecting the image of the wind. Its entire body was like the embodiment of the wind, and its head was petite, gentle, elegant, and beautiful.
After it appeared, the flowing green-blue silk-like hair on its head also fluttered with the wind. At this moment, this familiar and unfamiliar creature appeared in front of them in the form of a mechanical life form. The pupils of the Mythical creatures suddenly constricted.
“The Kirin Race, the Wind Kirin in charge of luck! Impossible, weren’t they exterminated?”
“Wind Blessing… How can such a Skill still exist!”
“Wait…” The expression of the World Tree clone also changed. It knew that Shi Yu had used the mechanical phantom beast technology to revive the Wind Kirin, but it originally thought that it only had its form. It never expected that Shi Yu’s mechanical technology had even revived the strongest divine skill of the Wind Kirin Race.
“This…” A shocking wind of luck enveloped the sky and earth, and the power of a god spread on Ling’s body. Shen Feng’s Mechanical Legendary Z was completely stunned.
The expressions of the archeologists and Legendarys who participated in the previous archeological Conference also changed, especially Legendary Z. Their gazes exploded!!
Dogsh*t! Liar! Didn’t Shi Yu, this brat, say that the Wind Kirin’s revival wasn’t complete?!
There was a quasi-divine skill at the monarch level. Was this an incomplete revival?!!!
Didn’t they say that the seven countries didn’t lie to the seven countries?!!
“Kirin?”
“Wind Kirin!”
At that moment, the most shocked one was still Lord Lie Shan. It was very unbelievable… The Wind Kirin Race was the first to be exterminated in the early stages of the invasion war. It had not seen it for a long time. It completely didn’t expect that it could actually see the Wind Kirin that had mastered the wind luck in the future.
“How is this possible… This is a mechanical life form??” It couldn’t understand.
Shi Yu said, “This race is called mechanical phantom beasts. It can also be called mechanical illusion gods.”
“It’s a new mechanical life form created by me through the Mechanic method and using ancient fossils to revive.”
“Because it inherited the power of a god in the fossil of a Mythical creature, it inherited the power of a god and barely stepped into the God Domain.”
“From the form of life, it’s indeed a mechanical life form.”
Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, Lord Lie Shan’s expression changed again.
Pfft…
It took a step back, its entire body trembling. A smear of blood flowed out of its eyes and the corners of its mouth, revealing a shocked expression.
At the same time, seeing that Lie Shanjun suddenly seemed to have been injured, the totem half-gods and legendary experts suddenly revealed incredulous expressions.
What happened?
Why did this god suddenly look injured?
“No way…”
“Probably not…”
The expressions of the Elven Empress and the Dragon God changed slightly. Could it be…
Only the little white dragon in Dragon Palace City was the most excited. It was familiar with this!!
Back then, it was also killed for no reason when it fought Ling!
At this moment, the little white dragon was shocked. Holy shit, so the guy it was fighting was a Mythical cub?!
“That’s right, it’s the Wind Blessing!!” At this moment, in the sky, Xuan Ming said with a shocked expression, “Even among divine skills, it’s one of the stronger skills.”
“Is this the divine skill of the Wind Kirin Race…” Lord Lie Shan’s expression was ferocious as he said, “Not bad. This is the first time I’ve seen it. It can actually affect my state. If its strength was two levels higher, it might be able to directly heavily injure me.”
“Interesting… Mechanics actually revived extinct divine beasts?!”
It should be the one with the poorest Restoration among the seven gods. At the moment, it was the weakest. However, Lord Lie Shan still didn’t expect that the mechanical life form in front of him could actually rely on this inherited quasi-divine skill to directly affect its state!
Revival of Mythical power, inheritance of quasi-divine skills across races… This kind of method was rare even in the Mythical Era. Humans actually did it with Mechanics?!
At that moment, as Xuan Ming, Lie Shanjun, and the other gods spoke one after another, be it transcendent creatures or humans, they looked at Shi Yu and Ling on the arena and were completely stunned.
They suddenly recalled that the information Shi Yu was most famous for was still him being the creator of the mechanical phantom beast…
Everyone was stunned. This beast… Everyone originally thought that it was ridiculous enough for Shi Yu to barely help Baby Ginseng touch the domain with his Beast Taming Talent just now.
But now, seeing Shi Yu summon a Wind Kirin Beast that directly displayed the power of a god without any support and even forced a Mythical creature to bleed slightly, be it the humans of the seven countries or the totem clans, their mentalities completely collapsed.
The Mechanics who originally wanted to show off their might even looked like they had lost their parents, their eyes gray and white!!
...
What was wrong with this guy!!! Please, one of the gods, please take this guy in and stop let him participate in the world competition!! They really couldn’t take it anymore!

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 954 Enviable Reward
chapters.content:
954 Enviable Reward
One of the three Mythical races in the east, the Mythical Race, the Wind Kirin!
Shi Yu had revived and created a legend through Mechanic methods!
At this moment, even the divine beasts were moved.
They first thought of a problem.
“You… can revive gods through Mechanic methods with the divine fossil as a medium?”
“In other words, if I find all the Mythical fossils on Blue Planet, you can pull up an army of mechanical Illusion Gods who have mastered law divine skills?” the Boar God asked.
This was simply even more ridiculous than its laws of life.
As soon as he finished speaking, the hearts of many totem clans skipped a beat. The Shen Feng Mechanical Legendary’s heart even twitched.
Wait a minute!
It was impossible for the Mechanic class he established to be so impressive. Why didn’t he know that the Mechanic class could also create a Mythical army!
Initially, many countries already felt that the fossil recovery technology was very ridiculous, but they didn’t expect that this technology could really touch the divine domain!
“In theory… that’s the case,” Shi Yu said.
However, in reality… Shi Yu felt a little pained.
After all, the most important thing was not the fossil recovery technology at all.
Fossil recovery technology couldn’t create Mythical races.
The main reason why Ling could become a Mythical Race was because of the “Mythical Revival” Skill.
This skill was the key. This should also be a skill developed by a super big boss in the Mythical Era.
Lu Qingyi benefited, and Shi Yu benefited even more.
To put it bluntly, he still had to add points.
“Although it can revive in theory, it requires a huge price.”
No one cared about the price Shi Yu mentioned. The totem clans looked at Shi Yu with bloodshot eyes.
Especially those totem clans who had a feud with Dong Huang. They felt that even Divine Source Legendary was not as threatening as Shi Yu.
If this guy grew to the legendary level, no, even if it was only the legend level, they wouldn’t be at peace.
“Could it be that… there are still a large number of Mythical fossils on Blue Planet?”
Upon hearing the Boar God’s question, Shi Yu was slightly concerned.
Although reviving required him to work hard again, Shi Yu didn’t mind at all if there were really a large number of Mythical fossils!
After all, every Mythical fossil might have a remaining divine skill inheritance like the Wind Kirin fossil.
After screening, as long as there were a few super skills like Wind Blessing, Nine-Colored Divine Light, and Yin Yang Millstone, it wouldn’t be a loss.
At this moment, as Shi Yu asked, the totem clans began to panic. They were really afraid that the World Tree and the others would take out a pile of Mythical fossils for Shi Yu to revive.
If that was the case, wouldn’t Dong Huang be completely invincible?
Fortunately, what the World Tree said next made them feel at ease.
“Unfortunately.”
“The corpse of a god is indeed the first preservation item.”
“But the Mythical Era was too long ago compared to this age. There aren’t many divine-level fossils preserved at all,” the World Tree said.
The Mythical Era was too far away. After that, Blue Planet encountered many disasters.
Just the asteroids hitting Blue Planet had happened several times.
“Moreover, the number of gods in the Mythical Era isn’t as many as you imagine.”
In the Mythical Era, there were only a few hundred creatures that could be called divine-level above demigods.
In war, there were too few bodies that could be left behind.
After the battle, there were less than a hundred left.
There were less than a hundred gods. After reincarnations, sleeping, and dying… There would not be a large number of Mythical fossils at all.
“Unfortunately,” Lord Lie Shan and the Boar God also said.
At this moment, Lord Lie Shan looked at Legendary Z again.
As for Legendary Z, his expression froze. He didn’t know what to say at all.
Machines could also be divine… Machines could also be divine. He couldn’t understand how such an achievement could be developed by a young kid from Dong Huang.
“Are there any Mechanics from other countries who have reached the Mythical Race?”
Lord Lie Shan’s words made the Mechanics of the seven countries extremely annoyed.
Not to mention Mythical races, even if there was a high chance of growing into a totem-level quasi Mythical race, there were pitifully few.
At this moment, many factions understood that Shi Yu, this bastard, had taken the inheritance of the fourth trial again.
Unacceptable!
The Mechanics were silent.
“Then let them out for me to see too,” Lie Shanjun said.
It was indeed still curious about the Mechanic class.
However, at that moment, the Mechanic contestants were no longer as excited as before.
...
All of them cried, feeling that they were accompanying the main event.
“As for you…” Lord Lie Shan looked at Shi Yu.
As for Shi Yu and Ling, they also looked at Lord Lie Shan.
Reward!
What was this big tiger’s inheritance?
Earth-element Mythical resource?
Lie Shanjun grinned and said, “What a coincidence.”
“Although there aren’t many divine stones left from the Mythical Era, I happen to have one here.”
“However, it’s not a fossil.”
“At the end of the war, I discovered a young god that had just been born and was on the verge of death.”
“Its unlucky dead parents asked me to petrify and seal it, hoping that it can successfully survive the war.”
...
“At the moment, it’s in a petrified seal state. After the Mythical Revival, it should be able to walk out of the divine stone again.”
“That guy is also a divine-level race and has mastered the prototype of a divine skill. Why don’t I leave it to you to nurture?”
“As the inheritance of the fourth trial, the real inheritance of a god.”
A divine beast cub?
“This…”
“How can that be?”
At this moment, everyone widened their eyes and revealed incredulous expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 955 Enviable Reward (2)
chapters.content:
955 Enviable Reward (2)
The fourth trial inheritance was a divine beast cub???
“Huh?” Shi Yu was also slightly stunned. Not a divine-level resource??
Why was it a divine beast cub…
He had enough cubs. In the clueless team, Little Ji, Duckie, Qi, and Little Purple had yet to grow up.
!!
If another one came, Team One wouldn’t do anything else all day. They would just take care of their children.
“This guy!” At this moment, the Boar God and the other gods felt that the Lie Shanjun was a thief.
How could he be so perfunctory? Just this was also called an inheritance?
However, they understood Lord Lie Shan’s thoughts.
