Lord Lie Shan’s current state should be the one with the worst Restoration among them. He was extremely weak.
At the moment, they were basically equivalent to Mythical Races at the overlord level, while Lord Lie Shan was about at the monarch level.
If in this state, Lord Lie Shan didn’t happen to have an inheritance crystal like the Holy Divine Deer and instead had to distribute additional power to inherit it, his vitality would be even more heavily injured.
Therefore, throwing out a divine stone that sealed the young of the divine race from god knows where as an inheritance was indeed in line with its current state.
The gods and Shi Yu felt that this inheritance was a little careless. After all, they were all people who had seen the world. On the other hand, the totem clans and contestants of the seven countries were stunned.
A divine beast cub!!
Shi Yu already had a cub of a Mythical Race, that Wind Kirin. If there was another one, wouldn’t that be… two?
What would happen?
If he could contract two Mythical Races, even if the Beast Tamer was a pig, he could break through to the legendary level under the lead of the two Mythical cubs, right?
“Damn it…” Even the contestants from the Seven Nation Alliance, Shen Feng, Xue Yuan, and the others were extremely jealous, let alone the totem clans.
Those demigod experts were all extremely silent. If a Mythical Race was nurtured by them, their country would undoubtedly have a new general!!
Although these demigod experts weren’t Beast Tamers and couldn’t contract pets, they were also nurturing subordinates and enriching their factions.
For example, a thousand years ago, when the totem king, Yun An, was at the demigod level, he also had twelve generals with totem strength.
It could be said that if it weren’t for the fact that Emperor Wu Dynasty had other powerful Beast Tamers and guardians, Emperor Wu definitely wouldn’t be able to deal with the Yun clan alone.
King against king, general against general. Ancient and modern wars had always been like this. Therefore, even the totem country yearned for a cub with Mythical potential and was extremely envious.
Shi Yu’s reward made everyone envious again.
“What?” Lord Lie Shan narrowed his eyes and said, “From the looks of it, you’re not satisfied?”
“No, very satisfied,” Shi Yu said. Forget it, it was better than nothing. Let’s see what it is first.
“You’re lucky. That divine-level cub came from a demon race of a divine-level race. Its potential is extraordinary.”
“Let’s go, follow me.” Lord Lie Shan roared. The Mythical Ruins it slept in directly opened.
The Void crack opened, and Lord Lie Shan directly entered. At the same time, he let Shi Yu follow it.
Demon Race!
At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the spatial ripples and his expression changed slightly.
At the same time, in the outside world, when they heard Lord Lie Shan’s words, the demigods of the Demon Kingdom and the Fallen Angel Prince were also in disbelief.
On the side of the Kingdom of Glory, the Hero King, the Holy Maiden of the Divine Radiant Church, and the others couldn’t accept it.
Demon Race!!
The divine-level cub that Lie Shanjun had sealed and fossilized was actually from the Demon Race?
On Blue Planet, there were currently five divine-level races known to humans in the Mythical Era. The dragons, phoenixes, and kirins in the east, and the dragons, angels, and demons in the west.
Among them, the dragons were thought to come from the same source and were considered a race.
As for angels and demons, they were very famous in the West. The demons were even regarded as synonymous with Unholy, Darkness, Disease, and Disaster. They were the enemies of all races!
“So be it. Is there a problem?”
At this moment, Dong Huang was very open-minded. Divine Source Legendary laughed. When he thought of how Dong Huang could have a new creature with divine-level potential, he felt even more excited.
Shi Yu had even included the Abyss Demon Duck in the clueless team. So what if another demon came?
Although the reputation of the Demon Race was poor, as long as it was cultivated appropriately, what did it mean? Wasn’t the reputation of the Mechanic class also poor in the totem country?
At that moment, as Shi Yu followed Lord Lie Shan into the Mythical Ruins, the gods led by the World Tree fell silent. Among them, the Demon King Dragon’s dragon eyes circulated for a long time before it spat out a dragon breath.
“Boring. Do we still have to wait for that guy to finish searching for the divine stone and finish looking at the Mechanic class? Can my trial begin first?”
…
In Lord Lie Shan’s Mythical Ruins.
This place was more like a continuous mountain. It was all a rock environment.
After Shi Yu followed Lie Shanjun in, he immediately saw the huge divine stone in front of him.
It was completely reddish-brown and looked extremely ordinary. Apart from the strong traces of time, Shi Yu couldn’t see anything special about it.
Lord Lie Shan stood beside this huge reddish-brown divine stone and said, “Wait for me for a moment. I’ll revive this divine stone.”
“This way, even without waiting for the Mythical Revival, it can break out of the stone after adapting to this era.”
“Lord Lie Shanjun, you just said that it’s a demon?” At this moment, Shi Yu couldn’t help but be interested.
“Fallen Angel??”
“No.” Lord Lie Shan placed his huge tiger claws on the reddish-brown divine stone and said, “The Fallen Angels are only angels who have fallen to the Demon Race. They’re just one of many Demon Races.”
...

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 956 Enviable Reward (3)
chapters.content:
956 Enviable Reward (3)
“Just like how the Wind Kirin is a branch of the Kirin Race.”
“This guy, in terms of Stats and race, should be considered a poison-element demon race.” The corners of Lie Shanjun’s mouth curled up. “One of them completed a new evolution with the help of the cosmic virus on the meteorite in outer space. It’s considered an anomaly of the demon race.”
“Poison element?” Shi Yu was slightly stunned. “It can’t be related to the Abyss Evil God, right…”
If that was the case, it was even more impossible to keep it. One duck was enough to give Susu a headache.
!!
No, even if it was unrelated, Susu probably wouldn’t like poison.
“It’s unrelated. The starry sky is filled with vast secrets. Not everything is related to the Abyss Race,” Lie Shanjun said.
“Speaking of which, you humans seem to still be visitors from outer space. Although you’ve already been modified into a native race, this talent is indeed extraordinary.”
“No wonder the planet took a fancy to you.”
Lord Lie Shan’s gaze burned. Sigh, it was a pity that it wasn’t suitable to fight in the starry sky. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have fallen asleep no matter what. Instead, it would have left Blue Planet with another batch of guys.
Thump.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat after hearing Lord Lie Shan’s words.
Just now, he almost thought that Lie Shanjun had said that he was a guest from outer space and recognized his identity as a transmigrator. He was shocked. Even the World Tree couldn’t see that. However, after listening carefully, he realized that Lie Shanjun was talking about humans. The entire human race was a guest from outer space.
It had been modified into a native race of Blue Planet.
Shi Yu’s expression was slightly solemn and frozen. He looked at Lord Lie Shan and said, “Just now… what did you say??”
“Humans weren’t native races of Blue Planet at the start??”
“You don’t know?”
Lie Shanjun was stunned. When it saw Shi Yu’s shocked expression, it immediately shut up. However, the corners of its mouth twitched. “Ah, forget it. It shouldn’t be anything worth hiding. I don’t know much either. Go and ask the World Tree yourself, just don’t say that I said it.”
“If you can obtain the blessings of the World Tree, it should tell you.”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart was no longer calm. He was a little shocked. Wait a minute, if humans weren’t native races of Blue Planet, where did the first batch of humans come from?
Was it from the starry sky, or was it Earth?! Or could it be that Earth also existed somewhere in the starry sky, a starry sky mystic realm similar to Blue Planet?
In fact, had the divine beasts on Blue Planet been to Earth? Or was Earth not that simple? Did a god on Earth Relocate to Blue Planet?
To be precise, Blue Planet and Earth were indeed inextricably linked. Many myths were similar. Even Shi Yu’s mind domain could only be cultivated thanks to the divine power of the ruins on Earth, let alone the characters similar to the iron-eating beast inscription he had seen on Earth.
“Perhaps the World Tree really knows the connection between Earth and Blue Planet.” Shi Yu’s expression froze. This was what he wanted to understand the most after transmigrating.
After the World Tournament ended, he hoped to obtain more information from the World Tree. If there was a connection between the two worlds, he didn’t know if he would have a chance to return to Earth to take a look. With his current ability, he should be able to explore all the ruins on Earth in a very short period of time.
Moreover… Shi Yu wanted to know if the house he bought with the loan had been auctioned off for him after he died. His heart ached. Who knew how long he had saved for the down payment?
“Alright.” At this moment, with a boom, the huge reddish-brown divine stone shattered the outermost layer.
Lie Shanjun retracted his huge claw and looked at the core of the gravel. Shi Yu also looked over.
At this moment, the divine stone looked like a transparent reddish-brown amber. Inside was a creature that Shi Yu didn’t expect. It was less than a meter tall.
It had a reddish-brown insect body and was covered in insect armor. Green virus patterns were all over the insect armor. On its forehead, there was a thick horn, and its handsomeness was close to Little Ji. Shi Yu was immediately stunned. This f*cking demon? Wasn’t this a f*cking Horned Beetle that stood up?
“Its race is called the Horned Demon,” Lord Lie Shan said. “You can make do with nurturing it. I don’t have anything else for you.”
Shi Yu: (F*ck) As expected, he didn’t like felines like this tiger.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 957 The Strongest Dragon Trial
chapters.content:
957 The Strongest Dragon Trial
In the outside world.
The Demon King Dragon’s gaze swept across the various dragons with interest.
It even looked at the demigod-level dragons with the potential of their race to enter the God Domain through the alternate space.
Dragon Palace City, Dragon God!
!!
Dragon Empire, Black Dragon Ruler!
“Boring. Do we still have to wait for that guy to finish searching for the divine stone and finish looking at the Mechanic class? Can my trial begin first?”
This Demon King Dragon’s aura rose to the sky. Previously, the seven of them had agreed on the order of the trial. It was the fifth!
“Your Majesty.” The World Tree clone looked at the Demon King Dragon.
“What kind of trial do you plan to undergo?”
“Hahahaha.” Demon King Dragon’s laughter sounded.
“Needless to say, it’s naturally the strongest dragon trial. Only the strongest dragon is qualified to inherit my power.”
Its red dragon eyes looked at the dragons in all directions and said, “All the dragon-element creatures here will fight to determine the strongest dragon.”
“Rules, one-on-one.”
“The strongest person will obtain my dragon bone!!”
“This dragon bone is the skeleton I once shed. It contains the divine power to change races. It’s a bloodline crystal from my previous life that can allow the transplanted dragon race to evolve into a divine domain!”
“It can be seen as a divine-level evolution resource of the dragon race.”
“Little brats that want it, come, let me see your strength.”
Its aura erupted, moving all the dragons.
“This guy…” The Boar God and the other gods were not too surprised by the Demon King Dragon’s trial.
As expected, it was also a test of battle power, and it had specified the dragon race.
“Boring!” The huge Golden Bull God’s gaze was hot.
Ah.
He wanted to fight.
Compared to letting these trial-takers compete, it wanted to go down by itself and let these trial-takers please it more!
Whichever guy could let it fight to its heart’s content, it would give it some gifts.
He wondered if the creatures of the future and the brats of the new era could make it interested.
“In that case, we can indeed start first,” the World Tree clone said.
“In that case…” The Demon King Dragon looked in the direction of the Dragonman Empire.
It looked at a humanoid life form several meters tall with an extremely tall and burly figure. It had legs and arms, and its entire body was covered in green dragon scales. It had a pair of dragon-shaped long horns. It was standing there domineeringly and also looked at the Demon King Dragon with a burning gaze.
An opportunity to enter the God Domain…
It had finally arrived.
Beside it was a young man more than two meters tall with a similarly burly figure and dragon horns. The two had the same aura, as if they were twins.
They were both hybrids, but for one, the dragon bloodline occupied the dominant part, and the other, the human bloodline occupied the dominant part!
It was the Green Dragon Prince who had stepped into the totem level in the Dragonman Empire, as well as its contractor, the legendary Beast Tamer with the dragon blood talent!
In the sky, the Demon King Dragon stretched out its huge dragon claw and pointed at the Green Dragon Prince. “Little brat, I can sense that your strength is very strong and your bloodline is very special…”
“It should be the dragon with the strongest bloodline apart from those guys hiding in the alternate space.”
“Is it because it’s a human-dragon hybrid?”
At this moment, in the World Tournament, the only two totem-level contestants, the Green Dragon Prince, was even more excited when he saw the Demon King Dragon directly asking him questions.
It laughed out loud and said, “Lord Demon King Dragon, that’s right. My bloodline, the merits of the gathered dragons, the merits of the humans, and the faith of the thousands of citizens of the huge Empire…”
“It’s a well-deserved perfect dragon.”
“However, compared to Lord Demon King Dragon’s bloodline, it seems like a drop in the bucket. I’m willing to participate in this trial. If I can obtain Lord Demon King Dragon’s dragon bone, I’ll feel like I’ve been reborn!”
Bah, bootlicker!!
“Damn it.” The Fallen Angel of the Demon Nation’s expression couldn’t help but darken when she saw the Green Dragon Prince being so shameless.
However… the bloodline of the Green Dragon Prince was indeed terrifying.
It was simply carved from the same mold as the ruler of the Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King.
The Tyrant Dragon King was also a perfect combination of the dragon race and the human race. At the same time, it gathered the power of faith of the huge empire and completed the evolution.
Although the Fallen Angel Aldrich was known as the most perfect race closest to a god, it was still rather afraid of this Green Dragon Crown Prince, who was one level higher than it.
“Not bad.”
“Then, what are you going to do?” The Demon King Dragon seemed to like this very much and thought very highly of the Green Dragon Prince.
It believed in its eyesight. Apart from the Tyrant Dragon King, the Dragon God, the Black Dragon Ruler, and other hidden alternate spaces, and not the super dragons of the contestants of this world competition, the Green Dragon Prince’s bloodline was the strongest.
At the same time, its growth level seemed to be extraordinary, far exceeding the other contestants.
In addition, with the “human” bloodline specially taken care of by the World Tree, this Green Dragon Prince directly became the first choice for the Demon King Dragon.
How ridiculous.
The first four trials were actually taken by the same person, but this wouldn’t happen to it.
...
The Demon King Dragon didn’t want its inheritance to be taken away by the inheritors of other gods. This would make it look very lousy.
“I understand.” The Green Dragon Prince’s blood boiled after the Demon King Dragon’s words.
Although its current bloodline was extremely outstanding, it was nothing compared to the bloodline of a god.
The Green Dragon Prince was determined to get the Demon King Dragon Bone.
Boom!!!
A shocking dragon-shaped aura appeared on it and the contractor. Both parties leaped into the air and landed on the huge rock-element arena.

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - 958 The Strongest Dragon Trial (2)
chapters.content:
958 The Strongest Dragon Trial (2)
It faced all directions.
At the same time, extremely arrogant words came out of the Green Dragon Prince’s mouth.
“Ants, the inheritance of Lord Demon King Dragon is mine.”
“Those who aren’t convinced, come up and challenge me!!!”
!!
“However, before challenging, please be prepared to lose your life.”
“I can’t guarantee that I can control it well. The huge power in my body can not guarantee that the challenger can end the battle alive.”
Boom!!!
The Green Dragon Prince in the form of a dragonman laughed crazily. The totem-level power erupted from the inside!!
Buzz!!
With the Green Dragon Prince as the center, the dragon-shaped deterrence was like flames, sealing everything within a hundred meters of it.
The dragon wave that shot into the sky turned into a tornado and shattered the clouds. Amidst the shocking aura, one could vaguely see the Green Dragon Prince’s red and shining Berserking Eye.
Its contractor looked around coldly in the tornado and said, “Master, you’ll scare them like this.”
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
Indeed. At this moment, the overlords and legends looked at the shocking aura in extreme shock.
Not to mention Normal Legends and Normal overlords, even totem-level lives like the gem cat were extremely solemn.
“Hey, hey, hey.”
In Dragon Palace City, the Ice Dragon King found it difficult to accept. “Can such a guy really participate in the world competition?”
“Isn’t its strength a little too exaggerated?”
“How exactly did that thin human beside it complete the contract with it? Is the dragon blood talent really that magical?”
“This dragon is equivalent to the appearance of that Fire Dragon King after it advanced to the totem level. No, it’s even stronger than that.”
As the only two totem-level contestants in the World Tournament, the Green Dragon Prince and the Rubber Divine Tree had always been the focus of the various large factions!
Even if Shi Yu obtained four inheritances in a row, in the eyes of some demigods of the totem clans, in the eyes of some world competition champion candidates, he was still not as threatening as totem-level contestants like the Green Dragon Prince.
The thing that was threatening about Shi Yu was his potential. If Shi Yu was given enough time to grow to the Legend level and let him digest these inheritances, it would undoubtedly be the most terrifying.
However, from the current situation, Shi Yu probably didn’t have much time to digest it. At this moment, the totem-level contestants like the Green Dragon Prince, who really had the ability to crush all enemies, were the source of the fear of the contestants from the Ghost Sea, the Endless Sea Region, the Void Court, and the humans of the seven countries!
Even if the Green Dragon Crown Prince was at the overlord level, his strength probably wouldn’t be much inferior to them. And this guy actually successfully stepped into the competition of the World Tournament at the totem level. At this moment, even a monstrous race like the Fallen Angel wasn’t very confident in facing it.
He felt that if he wanted to defeat it, unless he also took the risk to break through to the totem level, the chances of winning were really not high.
Without a doubt, on the surface, the Green Dragon Prince and the Rubber Divine Tree were the contestants with the highest chance of winning the World Tournament.
After all… there was an entire level of difference!
“That bastard…” The Black Dragon Juggernaut looked in the direction of the Tyrant Dragon King with a burning gaze.
It was all because the news of the World Tournament came too suddenly. Otherwise, it could definitely nurture an heir not inferior to this guy.
“Is that dragonman learning from Shi Yu?”
In order to end the battle as soon as possible, Shi Yu also said ruthless words and directly killed the Fire Dragon King, making no one dare to challenge him.
And now, the totem-level Green Dragon Prince also said ruthless words.
For a moment, even some dragons who could be said to be invincible overlords among the contestants of the World Tournament became afraid.
“Divine Source, isn’t your Dong Huang very powerful? Punish it again.”
At that moment, sensing the threat of the Green Dragon Prince, Shen Feng Legendary Z’s expression was not good.
Divine Source Legendary remained silent and looked at the Green Dragon Prince below.
Then they would wait… for Shi Yu to come out of Lord Lie Shan’s place.
A mere dragonman… wanted to touch the faith of the Green Dragon?
At this moment, Inatella was silent. Countless factions looked at the Green Dragon Prince, and no one dared to fight.
If it were at the same level, most dragons would give it a try. However, with a major level difference placed here, many contestants first had to ask themselves if they had the strength to fight above their level.
“Let’s wait and see first.”
The seven countries were at a disadvantage in this kind of trial. When the legendary Dragon Tamers of the various countries heard the rules of the one-on-one battle to determine the strongest dragon, their expressions immediately darkened.
Whether the contracted pets could defeat this Green Dragon Prince in a group battle was another matter. One-on-one… was impossible.
As long as there were no restrictions on Stats and everyone was allowed to participate in the main competition of the World Tournament, the contestants of the seven countries probably had a trace of hope of defeating the Green Dragon Prince.
“Little nobody, you’re too arrogant.”
However, just as everyone was afraid of the strength of the Green Dragon Prince, to the surprise of the surrounding countries, someone stood out.
Eternal Desert!
Invincible overlord, Sand Burial Dragon!!!
“Roar!!!” A huge dragon dozens of meters tall and covered in yellow sand condensed into form with a sandstorm and suddenly roared.
Yellow sand gathered for ten thousand miles, and a huge figure condensed on the earth-element arena. In the sandstorm, under the dragon, a human Beast Tamer who looked like a desert race with a headscarf appeared with the Sand Burial Dragon.
“It’s the trump card of the Eternal Desert…”
Seeing this challenger, many factions were stunned. They didn’t expect the Eternal Desert to actually stand up and challenge the Green Dragon Prince.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 959 The Strongest Dragon Trial (3)
chapters.content:
959 The Strongest Dragon Trial (3)
Sand Burial Dragon, elements of earth, undead, and dragon.
Its life form was extremely special. It was both an Elemental life form, an undead life form, and a dragon life form.
In terms of potential, most demigods felt that the Sand Burial Dragon might not necessarily be inferior to the Green Dragon Prince.
“A nobody?” The Green Dragon Prince looked at the Sand Burial Dragon and smiled in anger.
!!
Indeed, the Dragonman Empire, which wasn’t a demigod faction, was indeed inferior to a large faction like the Eternal Desert. In the world, its reputation wasn’t obvious.
However…
Its eyes were red. The other party thought that the Dragonman Empire was weak, so it was wrong.
“You’re quite interesting too.” At this moment, the Demon King Dragon was watching the commotion. Seeing that the potential of the Sand Burial Dragon was not bad, it immediately said, “You guys, fight!”
Boom!!!
Under the urging of the Demon King Dragon, the Sand Burial Dragon directly started the battle!!
So what if it was at the totem level?
As long as he killed the burdensome Beast Tamer, the Green Dragon Prince, he could still win!!
“Roar!!!”
At the start of the battle, the contractor of the Sand Burial Dragon used the Beast Taming Talent “Spatial Gift” to strengthen the Sand Burial Dragon!!
This talent was evaluated by the Holy Divine Deer and the others as a seven-star talent. It could allow all the moves of the contracted target to have powerful spatial characteristics!
It was more comprehensive than the Nine Li Battle Beast’s Space Quake. It was similar to the talent of the Demon God Body. It was also at this moment that this Sand Burial Dragon directly had the four major Stats characteristics!
Elemental, undead, dragon, and space!
With such Stats, it was no wonder that it dared to challenge the Green Dragon Prince, who was one level higher than it.
“Space Gift!” The contractor of the Sand Burial Dragon activated its talent. It instantly etherealized and fused with the yellow sand, looking like it had disappeared without a trace.
“Roar!!!” At the same time, the huge Sand Burial Dragon swept up its strongest profundity!!
Life Corrosion!!!
Perfect proficiency earth-element super skill Absolute Corrosion, undead-element super skill Life Deprivation, dragon-element and Spirit-element super skills Dragon Soul Resistance, in addition to the spatial nature…
A sand dragon head dozens of meters tall that contained shocking might formed, shaking space as it swallowed the Green Dragon Prince.
As soon as it came up, the Sand Burial Dragon activated its super profundity.
“This is… super profundity…”
As the Sand Burial Dragon attacked, the expressions of the audience and contestants immediately changed. As expected of the invincible overlord of a demigod faction.
However.
“You do have some ability, but…” The Green Dragon Prince didn’t even have the intention to dodge. He directly stretched out his arm, raised his hand, and aimed his palm at the huge dragon head!!
Boom!!!
Everyone only heard a loud bang. A huge green tornado condensed and also swallowed the profundity of the Sand Burial Dragon. The profundity that shook the Void just now instantly made it difficult to even see the molecules that were instantly swallowed by the Gust under the change in the Sand Burial Dragon’s expression.
In just one round, the Sand Burial Dragon understood the difference.
“Its goal isn’t to fight head-on…” But soon, everyone suddenly discovered that at some point, the ground under the feet of the Green Dragon Prince’s contractor cracked with a bang, and a spatial vortex of sand appeared, as if it wanted to devour the Green Dragon Prince’s contractor.
Seeing this, the hearts of the members of the Dragonman Empire rose. But soon, their expressions relaxed. This was because in the face of the Sand Burial Dragon’s sneak attack on the human contractors, the expressions of the Green Dragon Prince and its contractors were very calm from the beginning to the end.
The contractor didn’t even need to etherealize.
He slowly lowered his head, right on the heels of that, raised his foot, and gently stepped on it.
Boom!!!
A huge pit dozens of meters in diameter directly formed. The ground caved in, and the ground trembled. The expressions of the Sand Burial Dragon opposite almost instantly trembled. Many others’ expressions also changed. They completely didn’t expect that the contractor of the Green Dragon Prince would display the attack power of an invincible overlord with just a step.
“Pfft…” As the leader of the sneak attack, it was the contractor of the Sand Burial Dragon. At this moment, with this step, he directly fell into the depths of the huge pit as if his body had shattered. He looked at the Green Dragon Crown Prince contractor floating in the sky in shock.
In the third trial, everyone knew that the dragon blood talent didn’t have any battle power enhancement for transcendent lives, but at this moment, everyone was shocked to discover that the one who obtained the enhancement seemed to be the human race itself.
Because of the dragon blood talent, not only did the contractor of the Green Dragon Prince reduce the difficulty of the contract with the Green Dragon Prince, but it could also share a portion of its strength. Its own strength was even more terrifying than Shi Yu, who had displayed astonishing strength in the preliminaries.
It was not a shortcoming at all. In fact, he could defeat most contestants alone.
“Die…” After capturing the attacker, the Green Dragon Prince didn’t show mercy, even if the other party was from a demigod faction.
“How dare you!!” The Sand Burial Dragon roared.
This battle was equally tragic.
In just a moment of confrontation, the contractor of the Sand Burial Dragon was directly suppressed and killed. The Sand Burial Dragon was even heavily injured because of this.
The Green Dragon Prince had no intention of stopping attacking at all. The muscles on its body increased exponentially. Under the frightened expression of the Sand Burial Dragon, it instantly arrived beside it.
A claw slapped over.
In an instant, the Sand Burial Dragon was swallowed by the endless storm.
“Why are they fighting?”
The Void opened, and Lord Lie Shan brought Shi Yu out of the Mythical Ruins. In the sky, Shi Yu narrowed his eyes slightly, afraid that the yellow sand would enter his eyes. He happened to see the battle between the two parties reach the most intense moment.
In just a moment, he figured out the cause and effect of the fifth inheritance trial.
The battle for the strongest dragon type…
Shi Yu didn’t expect to face a totem-level enemy so quickly. He couldn’t help but look forward to it.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 960 The Strongest Dragon Trial (4)
chapters.content:
960 The Strongest Dragon Trial (4)
He had long wanted to try that move…
On the arena, although the scene looked extremely intense, it seemed that the Green Dragon Prince was the one suppressing the Sand Burial Dragon the whole time.
“I admit defeat…” However, from the looks of it, the Green Dragon Prince was still not as decisive as Shi Yu. Although he ruthlessly killed the contractor of the Sand Burial Dragon, he couldn’t instantly kill the Sand Burial Dragon itself.
When the Sand Burial Undead Dragon admitted defeat, the demigod of the Eternal Desert quickly took the Sand Burial Undead Tornado away. It took its contestant away very smoothly, unlike how the Black Dragon Ruler was stopped by the Dragon God when it wanted to attack.
Seeing this, the Green Dragon Prince curled his lips.
“Where’s your aura just now?” In midair, the Green Dragon Prince looked at the Sand Burial Dragon that was swept away and revealed a mocking smile.
….
“They’re on completely different levels.” At this moment, as the battle between the Green Dragon Prince and the Sand Burial Dragon ended, the totem half-gods and human Legendarys had serious expressions.
If the Green Dragon Prince relied on Legendary resources to break through, its strength might not be that difficult to deal with. However, from the situation just now, this guy’s talent was impressive and his strength was incomparably terrifying. He definitely didn’t break through with resources alone.
At this moment, the rubber divine tree, which was also at the totem level, also revealed a shocked expression.
The strength of the Green Dragon Prince was undoubtedly too difficult to resolve for many contestants who wanted to win the world competition.
“This world competition…” The Eternal Desert demigod, who had swept away the Sand Burial Dragon, felt that the waters of this world competition were really too deep. There was no fairness at all.
How could they let such a totem-level creature participate?
“Its strength is incomparably solid. It’s a normal totem with extremely strong talent potential. It’s impossible for it to be defeated above its level.”
At this moment, the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire couldn’t help but fall silent. It understood that even if the Fire Dragon King wasn’t killed by that bastard Shi Yu, it wasn’t a match for this dragonman.
At the same time, the expressions of the Dragon Palace people were also solemn. They didn’t expect that the Dragonman Empire would produce another genius with excellent potential. Could the Golden Dragon Crown Prince… defeat it? It would probably be difficult not to break through to the totem level.
“Hahahaha.” At this moment, the Demon King Dragon saw that the Green Dragon Prince had easily won and couldn’t help but look at it. “Not bad. Moreover, you haven’t used your full strength, right? Your physique is very special.”
“Yes.” The Green Dragon Prince was very obedient when facing a god.
“My dragon physique is a mixture of wood and water. My self-healing ability is strong, and I can easily communicate with the power of nature. What happened just now could only be considered a warm-up.” The Green Dragon Prince had an invincible expression.
The others were actually wrong. It indeed relied on resources to break through. However, apart from several suitable legendary resources, it also borrowed the power of faith of the huge Dragonman Empire to break through, so it forged an invincible physique.
The Green Dragon Prince was extremely touched that his father could give him the power of faith. At the same time, he was determined to win the world competition and the divine inheritance.
“Your physique is indeed not bad.” The Demon King Dragon nodded.
At this moment, when they heard that the Green Dragon Prince was only warming up by dealing with the Sand Burial Dragon, the dragon overlords’ expressions darkened even more.
“Are there any more challengers?” Seeing this, the Demon King Dragon continued to ask. In any case, it felt that it was about time for this Green Dragon Prince to accept its dragon bone inheritance.
The other party’s physique, together with its dragon bone, might be able to evolve into an extremely strong Dragon God.
Silence.
Inatella was silent.
The contestants of the Eternal Desert had looks of hatred, but they were helpless.
The totem-level Green Dragon Prince was too strong. The key was that it wasn’t a totem with an unstable foundation.
It was a genius totem.
In such a situation, the difference in level was impossible to cross.
“The reward for the fifth trial is an evolution dragon bone?” At that moment, Shi Yu, who came out, immediately learned the situation from Teacher Cat’s voice transmission.
His expression couldn’t help but darken.
F*ck, why were their inheritance rewards each more lousy than the other?
When he saw the Demon King Dragon, he thought that he could find a Mythical resource for Buggy, but in the end, this was it?
He had the Dragon of Imagination as an evolution skill and the Green Dragon inheritance as an advancement path. What was the use of this lousy dragon bone?
Even if it was Little Ji, it still had the fusion of the Earth Divine Dragon fossil. It had stable Mythical potential, so it might not necessarily need this dragon bone with incompatible Stats.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. Perhaps after taking it out, it could exchange it with Dragon Palace City and hand it over to Dong Huang to exchange for other resources it needed. It was its only place to go.
“Oh??” At this moment, the Green Dragon Prince also noticed that Shi Yu had come out with Lie Shanjun.
It looked at Shi Yu, this shameless human.
It was this guy who took away four inheritances in a row.
Although it had also obtained one, it still felt very unhappy with Shi Yu.
If it encountered Shi Yu in the main competition, it would definitely kill Shi Yu.
Even if Shi Yu broke through to the Legend level, it didn’t matter. This was because after obtaining the dragon bone, it wanted to transplant and fuse it immediately!!
At that time, its strength would definitely be stronger!!
At this moment, not only the Green Dragon Prince, but many people also discovered Shi Yu’s return.
They looked at the expressionless Shi Yu floating in the sky with Psychic power. Before they could think too much, they saw Shi Yu in the sky slowly land on the arena.
This scene stunned everyone.
It stunned the various gods and the Green Dragon Prince, making them unable to react for a moment.
“It should be the fifth trial now, right? The content of the trial is… to decide the strongest dragon?”
“Are you the strongest dragon now?”
After Shi Yu landed, he said to the Green Dragon Prince in an extremely calm but arrogant tone.
At this moment, the totem clans and the humans of the seven countries found it difficult to understand. They widened their eyes. No way, could it be that Shi Yu also wanted to interfere in this trial??
Wait a minute, this trial was fundamentally different from the four just now!!
...
In the totem country, there were only two totem levels, and they were powerful dragon hybrids. They had already targeted this inheritance!!
Even if they were also at the totem level, they might not necessarily be able to defeat the Green Dragon Prince with a unique bloodline. Even legend Beast Tamers and invincible overlords were helpless in front of it, let alone Shi Yu, who was only a level-six Beast Tamer!!

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 961 Green Dragon God Relocate (1)
chapters.content:
961 Green Dragon God Relocate (1)
Earth-element venue.
Dragon Trial.
Shi Yu was already standing opposite the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor.
At this moment, the Green Dragon Prince was the most confused.
“Human, don’t tell me you want to participate in this trial?”
“You want to challenge me?”
The Green Dragon Prince’s voice was filled with disbelief, as if he was shocked by Shi Yu’s courage.
“Huh?”
Shi Yu looked puzzled and said, “Could it be that I can’t participate in this trial?”
At this moment, the Green Dragon Prince was completely impressed.
He was amused by this arrogant and ridiculous human.
Not to mention it, the Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the Holy Divine Deer looked at Shi Yu in surprise.
Wait a minute, this kid, no way?
“You have a dragon-type pet?!” The Green Dragon Prince laughed very loudly.
At the scene, not many people knew that Shi Yu had a dragon-type pet.
Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, World Tree clone… They had all seen Buggy in the form of a green dragon.
The Fallen Angel’s expression also changed because it had once sensed a dragon might that shocked it in Shi Yu’s gaze.
As for the others, they completely didn’t remember Shi Yu having a dragon-type pet.
Iron-eating Beast, Butterfly of Imagination, Baby Ginseng, Sword Spirit, Blue Sea Sprite, mechanical phantom beast…
Although the Butterfly of Imagination had sometimes created dragon-element illusions, it was still a butterfly evolved by the Green Silkworm after all. No one would think about dragons.
“You have a dragon-type contracted creature?” Apart from the Green Dragon Prince, the Demon King Dragon was also very puzzled.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu, who had previously obtained the inheritance of the four gods, to want to interfere again.
To be honest, it didn’t want to pass the inheritance to someone who repeated it.
Moreover, it didn’t think that Shi Yu could defeat this Green Dragon Prince.
“Yes, so, do you want to admit defeat?”
“To be honest, I don’t want to send it to battle.”
Shi Yu looked at the Green Dragon Prince and said, “Because that might be very troublesome for the gods.”
“What a joke.” The Green Dragon Prince laughed and said, “Shouldn’t you be the one who should get lost?”
“That Earth Dragon was lucky enough to dodge the calamity just now, but you’re not that lucky.”
“Challenging a King such as myself, are you already prepared to die??”
Shi Yu said in amusement, “Do you want to kill me?”
The Green Dragon Prince laughed. “If you give me your ginseng baby to eat, I might consider sparing your life.”
At this moment, Inatella was like the calm before a storm.
99.99% of the people looked at the venue in disbelief, not understanding why Shi Yu was so greedy.
Could it be that Shi Yu thought that no matter which inheritance it was, it could be obtained as easily as before?
The competitors this time… were already completely different from the previous creatures.
“What exactly is going on…” Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others looked at Lu Qingyi in a daze.
“How would I know… Don’t look at me for everything.” Lu Qingyi was speechless and looked at President Lin.
He looked at the gem cat.
At this moment, the gem cat was also stunned. Did Shi Yu have a dragon-element skill? The Dragon of Imagination Skill seemed to be able to temporarily give Buggy a dragon-element skill, but did this count?
Oh, wait, that Buggy seemed to have broken through to overlord. Could it be that there was a new dragon element?
But even so, wasn’t it too difficult for an overlord to challenge a totem level?
After all, this Green Dragon Prince wasn’t weak. It might not even be able to defeat it.
It was very difficult for the gem cat to understand why Shi Yu, a kid it had always protected, suddenly challenged such a monster.
“Shi Yu… does have a dragon-type pet.”
President Lin said.
At this moment, Legendary Z and the other human Legendaries, including the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, also looked at Divine Source Legendary and Shi Yu from countless distances.
They didn’t understand.
“Are you guys crazy?” Legendary Z said. He had just said it casually. Dong Huang really went to challenge? Moreover, it was that Shi Yu?
If Shi Yu died, who would share the mechanical phantom beast technology?!
Legendary Z was furious.
At that moment, Shi Yu became the center of attention.
After Shi Yu took a deep breath and heard that the other party indeed had thoughts about Baby Ginseng, he couldn’t help but smile.
“In that case, then…”
He looked at the surrounding gods, at the World Tree clone, and at the Demon King Dragon. “Dear gods, in this battle, I want to ask everyone…”
“Protect the venue to prevent the battle fluctuations from leaking.”
“Naturally.”
“Of course.”
“What do you want to do?”
Shi Yu’s words confused the divine beasts.
With them around, as the organizers of the trial, they were naturally the judges.
Battle fluctuations leaked?
With their control, how could anything happen?
Although the gods present were in an Enfeebled state, their Skill proficiency still existed.
It was not a problem to defeat totems.
As for the World Tree, it was the strongest demigod. In addition, there were so many demigods present. Not to mention the battle of overlords and Normal totems.
Even if two demigods fought, they could guarantee that the aftermath of the power would be controlled in an area range.
At this moment, when he heard the assurance of the World Tree clone and the other big shots, Shi Yu was completely relieved.
“Then let’s fight.”
Shi Yu grinned and looked at the Green Dragon Prince.
“Experience this battle well. This might be the closest you get to the target.”
He said something that no one could guess.
“Huh?”
At the same time, it made the Green Dragon Prince’s temper flare up. He looked at the human in front of him in disdain.
Even if a demigod stopped it, it would shatter this guy’s Beast Taming Space and grab that ginseng baby to eat!!

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 962 Green Dragon God Relocate (2)
chapters.content:
962 Green Dragon God Relocate (2)
Coupled with the Demon King Dragon Bone, it would stand at the peak after this battle!
….
On the venue.
Shi Yu was calm and composed. The Green Dragon Prince’s gaze locked onto it.
!!
Both parties were waiting for the Demon King Dragon’s battle command.
At this moment, the Demon King Dragon was also very curious. It wanted to see what other trump cards this Shi Yu had.
“Fight!!”
After a moment of silence, the Demon King Dragon roared.
After the competition began, Shi Yu and the Green Dragon Prince didn’t say as much as before. In an instant, the Green Dragon Prince erupted with all its might, wanting to instantly kill Shi Yu and not give him a chance to summon his pet.
Boom!!!
Its figure and the contractor’s figure attacked Shi Yu at the same time.
On the spot, there were still afterimages of the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor.
Their main bodies had already appeared in midair and headed straight for Shi Yu, turning into a beam of light.
“Huh?” Seeing this, Shi Yu raised his head and looked in the direction where the Green Dragon Prince and the others attacked.
A trace of blue and gradually golden light appeared in his gaze. A shocking Spirit deterrence was released from Shi Yu’s eyes and hit the Green Dragon Prince’s heart.
Almost instantly, the expressions of the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor changed drastically. They stopped in midair and felt threatened, not daring to attack rashly.
Spirit connection, Green Dragon Roar!
“Roar!!!!!!”
As they saw a golden light, the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor seemed to see a green divine dragon entrenched in the starry sky roaring in their spiritual world. At this moment, with a crack, their bloodlines rolled like boiling water.
It actually… sensed that its perfect bloodline that simulated a green dragon and fused with a dragon and a human was suppressed…
An incomparably ridiculous feeling rose in their hearts.
“Impossible!!”
With a roar that confused everyone, a huge purple summoning array with a radius of a hundred meters appeared under Shi Yu’s feet.
At the same time, the weather changed.
The entire sky and world seemed to have darkened.
It was still daytime just now, but at this moment, all light was stripped away.
This ability to change the weather directly made the expressions of many creatures change. They realized that this was impossible for this to be the power of a monarch-level pet.
No, it wasn’t that there was no light at all.
Although it was night, the sky was dotted with incomparably dazzling stars.
These stars all flickered with shocking light. As they Blinked and the purple summoning array appeared, an incomparably huge body outlined the starlight and connected to a shocking image.
Its appearance made the totem clans and the humans of the seven countries reveal incredulous expressions.
“Roar!!!!!”
As Shi Yu summoned it, with a dragon roar that resounded through the sky, no, even the starry sky, its huge body was displayed in the green-gold light.
Its body was ten thousand meters long, and it occupied the starry sky. It looked like a dragon, had two golden horns on its head, and was covered in green scales. Its eyes and tail seemed to be burning with golden flames of Spirit faith, and its image was extremely shocking.
The huge aura revealed on its body directly made the voices of the overlords dry and their gazes explode. Even the Green Dragon Prince couldn’t accept it.
“This…”
“How could…”
“Totem?”
“Impossible!”
The totems, including the Tyrant Dragon King, sensed energy fluctuations that far exceeded ordinary overlords, no, those invincible overlords, on the Green Dragon Buggy.
It was as if Shi Yu had summoned a totem.
However, that was impossible.
Everyone saw Shi Yu’s level clearly. It was definitely only level six.
At level six, contracting an overlord above his level was already the limit. How could he contract a totem above his level?
At this moment, everyone understood that they were wrong, very wrong.
From the beginning to the end, Shi Yu had never summoned his trump card.
Sword Spirit? Blue Sea Sprite? Wind Kirin? Baby Ginseng?
Although these pets were also very ridiculous, they were still at the monarch level.
As for Shi Yu, he had clearly contracted a pet above his level. Since they were all contracted above his level, why didn’t Shi Yu choose those four to make them overlord level?
It wasn’t difficult to imagine. Everyone didn’t believe that Shi Yu couldn’t find the resources to strengthen them. The only possibility was that Shi Yu felt that this divine dragon was more trustworthy than the strength of the pets.
Everyone indeed discovered the terrifying power of this divine dragon and its shocking power that was comparable to a totem level.
At this moment, everyone present was more willing to believe that Shi Yu had contracted an overlord above his level, but this overlord had battle power comparable to a totem!!
Plop!
Looking at this shocking divine dragon, the Tyrant Dragon King, who was also evolving towards the concept of the Green Dragon like the Green Dragon Prince, also felt its pupils tremble and felt its bloodline being suppressed.
...
At this moment, everyone opened their mouths wide. Yu Shu and the others’ gazes exploded. Shi Yu really contracted a dragon?
Also… why did they feel that this dragon-element image had such an affinity and familiar wave?
“What’s this!!!” The Green Dragon Prince shouted in shock.
Putting aside its strength, why was its bloodline power suppressed by it?
At this moment, Shi Yu’s figure had long disappeared from the ground and was teleported to its head by Buggy.
Shi Yu sat cross-legged on the dragon head, crossed his arms, and looked straight at the Tiny Dragonman below.
Before he could speak, the legends of the Snowfield Nation and the Beast Tamers of the Snowfield Nation shouted in shock!!

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 963 Green Dragon God Relocate (3)
chapters.content:
963 Green Dragon God Relocate (3)
“Green Dragon!!!”
“It’s the Green Dragon!!”
“At that time, the Green Dragon God in the starry sky!!”
The legendary contestant of the Snowfield Nation, Irina, and her Star God Bear looked at the green dragon in shock.
!!
When the God of War of Snowfield saw the green dragon image from the Space Bureau appear in Inatella, his expression was also filled with disbelief.
The world was in turmoil because of the birth of the green dragon, just like yesterday. Although the Snowfield Battle God knew that it was related to Dong Huang, he never expected that the one who completed all of this was not a new Legendary or a Titled Legend, but a level-six Beast Tamer who participated in the World Tournament.
A… newbie!
“This…” At this moment, even the Demon King Dragon was extremely shocked. It sensed a supreme power from this dragon. This power was not divine power or the most important power of the natural order to enter the Mythical Domain, but it was even richer than the power of the natural order.
Power of faith? Moreover, it had also seen many powers of faith, but it had never seen such a special power of faith. It was as if this power of faith was not only born on Blue Planet, but also from the myriad worlds.
“It’s even more complicated than the composition of the power of faith of the Blue Sea Sprite?”
This… this was a god of faith in the starry sky!
Realizing this, the expressions of many gods changed.
At the same time.
“Don’t you know it?”
On the green dragon’s head, Shi Yu looked at the green dragon prince below and said, “Aren’t you evolving towards the concept of the green dragon god?”
“Doesn’t the entire Dragonman Empire believe in the Green Dragon God?”
“You stole our power of faith. Now that the main body has descended, you… should understand what this means, right?”
Shi Yu’s words resounded in the sky.
It was like a god.
It made the gazes of the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor explode.
The creatures who knew the concept of the Green Dragon revealed incredulous expressions.
What was Shi Yu talking about?
It was impossible for anyone who could come to Inatella not to know what the Green Dragon was. It was the Eastern Guardian God, known as a supreme god on the same level as the Dragon Race’s Origin Ancestral Dragon.
Countless dragons were trying to evolve towards the Green Dragon. The Dragonman Empire was the representative. As a popular contestant in the World Tournament, how could everyone not know its racial evolution path?
And now, Shi Yu actually said… that his pet was the Green Dragon’s main body?
How was this possible!
Wasn’t that a fictional god!
Although there were many creatures who believed in the Green Dragon and had a long history, the concept of the Green Dragon had never turned into a creature. Since ancient times, there had been no creature… that could evolve into a Green Dragon!!
“You’re courting death!!!” At this moment, the Green Dragon Prince felt insulted and was furious to the extreme.
No matter how strong Shi Yu’s backing was, no matter how terrifying Shi Yu was, at this moment, it had the urge to kill Shi Yu.
Because… a wisp of fear appeared in his heart for no reason.
“Green Dragon in the Sky!”
“Great Dragon Attack!”
At this moment, the Green Dragon Prince had already noticed that the guy in the sky was just deliberately mystifying. This huge body was clearly multiplied. He couldn’t be frightened.
Unlike dealing with the Sand Burial Dragon, this time, the Green Dragon Prince directly used its strongest sure-kill move.
It wanted to crush this guy in front of it with absolute strength!!
Boom!!!
It raised its hand, and the totem-level power erupted. The dragon energy that shocked the world gathered in its entire body, wanting to compete with the divine dragon in the sky.
At this moment, Shi Yu sat down. The aura of the Green Dragon Buggy was instantly like a reversed river of stars that was restrained under the eruption of the Green Dragon Prince. At that moment, the Green Dragon Prince’s expression was extremely crazy. Beside him, the blood of the contractor boiled endlessly.
“As expected, it’s just for show.”
As soon as it finished speaking, the audience seemed to have entered its perspective. However, in the next moment, as a sigh that contained ancient vicissitudes sounded in the sky and starry sky, the expressions of the demigods instantly changed.
“It’s just for show, you say.”
“Then I’ll let you see… the true power of faith of the Green Dragon.”
Everyone’s vision turned to the huge divine dragon in the sky and looked at Shi Yu, as if they could see the golden light in his eyes.
It was a pair of golden eyes identical to the ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon. It was like the eye of a god circling in the ancient starry sky, staring at the small planet.
They even saw the light that flickered higher than him and even the green dragon.
An incomparably terrifying pressure descended from the universe!!!
At this moment, Dragon Palace City, Dragonman Empire, Dong Huang, the Seven Islands… In countless places with traces of the green dragon, all the green dragon items that had existed hundreds of millions of years ago flickered with light.
The mutation that caused Blue Planet to tremble previously happened again. In the Dong Huang audience, Yu Shu looked at the Green Dragon Ancient Pendant he was wearing in shock that was filled with light. He looked at the sky in disbelief and shock.
This bastard Shi Yu… was telling the truth…
The Green Dragon God their family believed in… actually became Shi Yu’s pet?
At this moment, Yu Shu smiled faintly and looked like he was crying. His values were even more shattered than when he saw Shi Yu’s ridiculous performance previously.
Not only it…
Any powerful creature that could sense the power of faith could see the vast power of faith wrapped in the light that fell from the starry sky.
...
Unbelievable…
Everyone widened their eyes.
Faith skill.
And it was… an attack-type faith skill!

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 964 Green Dragon God Relocate (4)
chapters.content:
964 Green Dragon God Relocate (4)
In a situation where most faith skills were support skills and reincarnation skills, attack-type faith skills were too rare. Moreover, it was a faith skill that could mobilize such a terrifying power of faith.
“Dragon, Star, Group.”
As Shi Yu’s voice fell, all the spectators were stunned. This was because in an extremely short period of less than 0.1s, the light in the sky revealed its full appearance.
It was a green-gold light that looked like a meteor. It was like a divine dragon that had descended from the starry sky. It bared its fangs and brandished its claws, coming from the starry sky with an incomparably terrifying pressure!!
!!
Looking carefully, the so-called dragon form was just flames produced by its friction with the atmosphere, and its main body was a small asteroid.
Shi Yu and Buggy had already tried their best to control the power. They had only summoned one asteroid. However, that hundred-meter-long asteroid still made the pupils of the World Tree clone and the divine beasts constrict, and their auras rose steadily.
At this moment, they finally understood why Shi Yu was so concerned about the security of the venue.
Even the World Tree clone was awakened by the fear of the meteorite hitting Blue Planet countless times.
“Impossible!!!”
In fact, from the moment light appeared in the starry sky, the huge pressure from the Dragon Star Group and the Green Dragon Roar had already locked onto the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor. Their expressions were shocked, and their gazes were incredulous. They felt that their entire bodies were trembling. The huge Skill condensed floated in their hands, but they couldn’t release it because their bodies were trembling.
“Green Dragon God…”
At this moment, no matter how slow the Green Dragon Prince’s reaction was, it understood that the Green Dragon Divine Dragon Shi Yu sat on seemed to really be the Green Dragon God that it had evolved towards as a target. An indescribable grayish-white color appeared in its pupils.
“No…” At that moment, the Tyrant Dragon King suddenly reacted. Its gaze was filled with disbelief. It directly shattered the Void and wanted to save the Green Dragon Prince, but the meteorite from the starry sky not only countered the Green Dragon Prince, but even the Tyrant Dragon King, who was also evolving towards the concept of the Green Dragon, also felt a fatal threat at this moment. Its gaze was shocked.
If it were other dragons, even the previous Flame Dragon King wouldn’t be countered like this.
They could only blame themselves for encountering the main body as pseudo green dragons.
Boom!!!!
The meteor fell, leaving traces of tearing space, as if it had divided Blue Planet into two, making the current Inatella look like a shattered starry sky.
In the eyes of the audience, the huge meteorite directly fell towards the Green Dragon Prince in midair. The unique skill it condensed in its hand was instantly obliterated into energy light the moment it came into contact with the meteorite. As for itself, under its incomprehensible shocked gaze, its body was crushed by the huge meteorite. It could only support the huge asteroid weakly with its hands!!
What made the hearts of the contestants and spectators stop was that even if the meteorite had yet to land, the aftermath of the power it brought seemed to be a totem-level attack. It was extremely shocking. At this moment, not only the Green Dragon Prince, but all the contestants of the World Tournament suddenly felt a life-and-death crisis.
“This guy!!”
“What the hell!!”
“Does this kid want to destroy this island!!”
In the incomparable commotion, everyone saw the seven gods and the World Tree clone standing in four directions, surrounding the entire venue where the meteorite fell.
A shocking divine power erupted from their bodies.
It formed a huge barrier, isolating the venue inside.
Under countless shocked gazes, there was a loud boom, and the entire Inatella produced an incomparable earthquake!!
At the same time, a monstrous tsunami almost instantly rose in the sea around Inatella Island!!
There were even dazzling light fluctuations that shot into the sky, piercing through the sky and shattering the dark starry sky, returning the world to daytime.
Only the extremely shocked Green Dragon God and the young Beast Tamer sitting cross-legged on his head pretended to be calm as they looked down.
In this attack, the Green Dragon Prince and its contractor had already disappeared.
A bottomless pit appeared on the ground in the area protected by the eight big shots.
The depth was unknown. Ten meters, a hundred meters, and a thousand meters. Many powerful creatures sensed it in a hurry in shock, but they didn’t know the depth.
At this moment, the eyes of the Tyrant Dragon King, who was also stunned just now, gradually recovered their clarity. Right on the heels of that, it was incomparably furious and shocked. In contrast, the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, the Black Dragon Ruler of the Dragon Empire, and even the totem half-gods of the other factions looked at this scene in disbelief.
That attack just now… That attack just now…
It directly crushed the Green Dragon Prince into ashes.
Not a trace of aura or hair was left.
A solid totem level was directly killed in one hit.
As if it was nothing.
At this moment, be it the totem country or the seven countries, it was difficult to accept. No matter which creature it was, their hearts were shocked.
Buggy’s huge dragon eyes looked down. At this moment, like Shi Yu, it was very high!
It felt the shocked emotions from all directions.
It, the Green Silkworm, had already grown to the point where it could kill totems!
Not long ago, it was just dreaming, dreaming of becoming a green dragon soaring in the sky.
And now, its dream had become reality.
“Roar!!!”
A shocking dragon roar spread through the sky.
It was very difficult to imagine that such a terrifying creature was actually the pet of a level-six Beast Tamer.
“How can this brat be so strong?” The Seven Islands Valkyrie’s gaze was shocked.
“When…” The Elven Empress of Tingxiang had no idea about Shi Yu’s pet.
“It’s actually him!!!” At this moment, the people from the Dragon Palace, the Sea Dragon King, and the others finally knew where the origin of the change in the faith of the world’s green dragon was.
Now that this scene had already happened, no matter how difficult it was to accept the truth, everyone had to admit that what Shi Yu said just now was not a lie. He, his contracted pet, was actually really the Green Dragon God.
That fictional god actually appeared and even became a human pet??
This was simply more difficult for these dragons to accept than Shi Yu creating a mechanical phantom beast.
A level-six body, destroying totems!!!
...
Was he still human?
The entire Inatella was still swaying. The gem cat, the Ice Dragon King, and the other totems were even trembling in fear. They didn’t understand why Shi Yu, or rather Buggy, had become so ridiculous.
This didn’t make sense!
Under the shock, only Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others were feeling their hearts bleed. As people who knew the conditions for the release of the Green Dragon faith skill, they wanted to know how much faith power this attack had consumed.
Although this paywall attack was satisfying, it consumed power of faith that was difficult to replenish in the short term.
Gulp.
At this moment, the contestants and audience of Dong Huang looked at the crack under their feet. The ground was still trembling, and they looked at Shi Yu on the green dragon again.
It wasn’t just them. At this moment, the people who thought that Shi Yu was overestimating himself by challenging the Green Dragon Prince just now only wanted to slap themselves. Ha… Hahaha… Shi Yu, this Shi Yu indeed liked to do things that ordinary people couldn’t do.
In short, he was inhumane.
Countless people’s eyes were filled with shock. So, were his footsteps really unstoppable?
At that moment, all the contestants of the World Tournament, even the totem rubber tree at the origin place, felt their bodies go weak. They took a step back, completely unwilling to meet this Shi Yu in the main competition.
...
Moreover, this was the case for it, let alone the overlords who were still very far from the totem realm. Although the pressure the Green Dragon Prince gave them was great, Shi Yu… was already a kind of trembling that came from the depths of their hearts just by seeing him!
“Sorry…”
“That guy was too strong. I could only use this move.”
At this moment, the culprit behind all of this, Shi Yu, slowly landed on the ground alone as the green dragon’s figure disappeared. He apologized to the divine beasts in all directions… Really, the green dragon prince was too strong. He couldn’t defeat it without faith and money.
But it looked like… Inatella was fine. Everyone was happy, everyone was happy.
F*ck!
The divine beasts looked at Shi Yu in shock and were already speechless.
It couldn’t understand what was going on in the future at all. The Demon King Dragon, who had thought highly of the Green Dragon Prince just now, was already stunned by Buggy. Its perception was definitely not wrong. That wasn’t the dragon of faith native to Blue Planet, but the starry sky faith god!!
It didn’t belong to this world!!
“Monster, monster, pervert!!”
This was… a human? And the pet he cultivated?
It wondered if its dragon bones… Were worthy enough for him to use for evolution…

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 965 Must-Kill Target
chapters.content:
965 Must-Kill Target
Green Dragon.
Legend had it that it was a supreme god spirit that was on par with the Ancestral Dragon, the Dragon God of Creation.
Whether it was real or fictional was no longer important.
At that time, when the Green Dragon displayed the power to crush totems, communicated, and mobilized the power of faith of countless Green Dragons, the Green Dragon completely revived from the myths and legends and descended into reality!
The world trembled because of this.
As the Green Dragon Prince was insta-killed, the importance and fear of the various factions towards Shi Yu reached the peak.
After all, that was an instant kill at the totem level!
In the entire Blue Planet, how many people had such strength?
Even if a top-notch totem came, unless it was a top-notch totem close to a demigod like the Tyrant Dragon King and the Lava Empire’s Juggernaut, they wouldn’t dare to say that they could instantly kill the Green Dragon Prince.
And all of this was done by Shi Yu, who had yet to reach the Legend level. Which demigod faction present had never fought a Legendary Beast Tamer?
Which Legendary Beast Tamer didn’t display shocking talent and strength from a low level? However, none of them were as ridiculous as Shi Yu.
Although the Blue Sea Sprite was unbelievable, it was the strongest demigod that really existed.
Although the revival of the Mythical Race’s mechanical phantom beast, the Wind Kirin, was shocking, it also relied on the Kirin fossil.
There were traces!
However, Green Dragon…
The Green Dragon had never taken the initiative to develop believers. It was all because its myths and legends were too powerful and it was the Eastern Guardian God. Therefore, many factions in the totem era used the Green Dragon as a symbol of faith, as a political correctness, and as a badge to gather the hearts of the people and rope in an alliance.
It represented a supreme symbol, just like the imperial authority.
At this moment, what exactly was going on with the Green Dragon Shi Yu sent? Countless people wanted to know. If the Green Dragon really existed, it would definitely be a top-notch Mythical Race. How could such a creature become a pet!
“Impossible, definitely impossible!!” The Tyrant Dragon King suppressed the urge to be furious and still didn’t believe that Shi Yu had contracted the Green Dragon.
It had no choice but to suppress it because in an instant, since Divine Source Legendary, the Elven Empress, the Dragon Palace Dragon God, and many other Legendary demigods directly locked onto it.
Although it was known as the existence closest to a demigod and could give demigods a headache, it had no choice but to suppress its emotions in the face of multiple legendary experts.
“You really surprise me.”
The peerless Dragon God walked out of the Void. It didn’t expect Shi Yu to complete something that the Dragon Emperor couldn’t even achieve in his life and evolve into a green dragon.
“He… he…” As the cultivator of Emperor Wu’s pet, although Ji Mengzhu mainly cultivated Iron-eating Beasts, she had also seen Emperor Shi’s pseudo Green Dragon. It had always been a pity that it couldn’t evolve into the four holy beasts that could trigger the power of faith of Elder Gu.
Emperor Wu had once said that if four holy beasts could evolve, no matter which one it was, their strength would far exceed the Demon God Iron-eating Beast and they could easily crush Yun An. Unfortunately, they didn’t succeed in the end.
“What kind of creature is this!!!” At that moment, the most confused was still the Demon King Dragon.
“Green Dragon?”
“Why haven’t I heard of it!”
Not to mention it, even the Boar God and the other gods were the same.
This was also normal. The legend of the Green Dragon had started from the totem era and had never stopped for hundreds of millions of years. It was normal for a god like it, who had been sleeping since the Mythical Era, not to know.
Its huge dragon eyes looked at Shi Yu below, extremely red.
“Green Dragon, the Eastern God formed by the seven constellations in the myths and legends.”
“In the long totem era and the Beast Taming Era in the future, it was known as the peak Dragon God like the ancestors of the dragon race, the Dragon God of Creation.”
“What!!”
“Impossible!!”
Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, the Demon King Dragon refuted. How great was the Ancestral Dragon? Even if it was divided into two, its two bodies still had the divine power to create and destroy the world.
The other gods couldn’t accept it either.
Wait a minute… Could it be that the Green Dragon was evolved from those dragons who left Blue Planet and went to the starry sky?
Or could it be a god of another planet’s civilization?
Its concept was brought back by the creature that returned to Blue Planet?
“In the future… that’s indeed how it’s spread,” Shi Yu said.
“But it’s generally believed that the Green Dragon is a fictional god.”
At this point, the Demon King Dragon’s expression softened.
Fictional god?
However, it didn’t completely ease up.
The Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the other gods recalled the special power of faith just now.
Shi Yu said, “Therefore, just like how many dragons want to return to their ancestors, there are also many creatures who want to transform into dragons and evolve into green dragons.”
“In the totem era and the Beast Taming Era, countless Legendary and demigods have done this.”
“However, they all failed.”
“And I succeeded.”
Shi Yu’s words shocked the hearts of all the members of the seven countries and totem factions.
An unbelievable strange emotion rose in their hearts.
Indeed, no one believed that a Dragon God like the Green Dragon really existed and had become a human pet.
Being able to mobilize the power of faith was secondary. The most important thing was that the Green Dragon itself was the image of a supreme god spirit.
...
However, if a human Beast Tamer cultivated a pet to evolve into a green dragon and could barely mobilize the power of faith of the green dragon, then… that was completely unacceptable!!
“Why did this guy say such a terrifying thing so calmly!!” On the Seven Islands, a Dragon Tamer from the Green Dragon God Shrine had a stunned expression.
The Demon King Dragon opened its mouth slightly. So, Shi Yu had materialized and cultivated a fictional god comparable to the Ancestral Dragon into a real creature?

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 966 Must-Kill Target (2)
chapters.content:
966 Must-Kill Target (2)
With conceptual faith, becoming a spirit and becoming a god was not impossible. The Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the others thought of the Blue Sea Sprite. The Blue Sea Sprite believed in becoming a spirit, but…
However, there was actually still an intrinsic difference.
That was, the Blue Sea Sprite was a creature born on Blue Planet and relied on Blue Planet’s existence.
However, the concept of the Green Dragon was made up of the Seven Constellations of the East. How vast was that concept? Even if Blue Planet was thrown into it, it was only a small planet.
They finally knew why the power of the green dragon was so special. It was because at this moment, it couldn’t be considered a native creature of Blue Planet at all. Even if its original body was born on Blue Planet, because of the complicated power of faith, it had already become a cosmic faith god, a cosmic life form.
Such a life form had a huge characteristic, which was that it was not restricted by the power of laws on Blue Planet. It could fly freely into the starry sky, survive in the universe, find a suitable place, and enter the God Domain.
Blue Planet’s race level was no longer suitable to describe its potential.
Inatella fell silent again.
“Well…”
At this moment, Shi Yu was standing at the edge of the huge pit. Seeing that there was no movement, he couldn’t help but say in all directions, “Is there anyone else who wants to challenge the fifth trial?”
His words echoed in everyone’s hearts.
Suddenly, everyone remembered that they were still in the trial.
However, as they looked at the bottomless pit and the destructive power caused by this attack that almost destroyed the island, the corners of countless totems and overlords’ mouths twitched.
There was no doubt that the power of this attack was already comparable to the forbidden weapons of the seven countries. It could cause a fatal blow to a country.
As a competition to choose the younger generation, what was wrong with such an attack?
“Ji!!”
At this moment, everyone suddenly realized that Shi Yu had not retracted the green dragon.
On his shoulder, a little green worm that emitted a powerful aura was looking around arrogantly.
Its golden pupils contained the color of Holy.
Countless people opened their mouths wide. Wait a minute, don’t say… Could it be that this little green worm was the green dragon just now!
“Holy shit.”
Yu Shu and the others who were familiar with Shi Yu were even more shocked. Don’t tell them that Shi Yu’s Green Dragon was evolved from the Green Silkworm that helped Shi Yu dominate the Class assessment!!
Yu Shu: “I was beaten by the Green Dragon?!?”
This, this didn’t make sense at all.
“No, we can’t compete with it.” At this moment, no matter what changes happened, the dragons’ expressions were filled with horror. The Green Dragon Prince was a lesson. Who knew if Shi Yu would summon another meteorite?
Who would have thought that the Green Dragon Prince would be directly killed not long after being arrogant?
“You…”
At this moment, the Demon King Dragon was completely convinced. Did Shi Yu know what kind of power he had displayed just now?
Not to mention ordinary totems, even revived gods like them would have to spend some effort to shatter that meteorite in their current Enfeeble state.
Otherwise, the gods wouldn’t have been so shocked just now.
At that moment, the Demon King Dragon was directly numb. Just now, it was still thinking that no matter what, it couldn’t hand the dragon bone to the repeater. But now, looking at the situation, it didn’t seem like any dragon was a match for Shi Yu and the creature named Green Dragon.
This situation was unsolvable.
“Looks like there’s no one else.”
Seeing this, the Demon King Dragon was extremely uneasy.
“Hey, human kid, looks like no one is competing with you anymore.”
“But are you sure you want my inheritance?”
At this moment, the Demon King Dragon asked a question that it wasn’t confident in.
Even if a starry sky faith god didn’t cultivate any power of the natural order, it was possible to find another ability to break through to the divine level in the starry sky.
On the contrary, fusing with the evolution of the dragon bones left behind in his previous life would conflict with the current path.
Shi Yu… Was he willing?
“Of course.”
Shi Yu smiled. If he wanted it, he definitely wanted it, but whether he used it or not was another matter.
For example, he couldn’t use the nine-colored divine light of the Holy Divine Deer now, but he could let Teacher Cat use it.
There was also the Horned Demon Divine Stone from before. Shi Yu also planned to see if it suited his taste after waking up.
Including this Demon King Dragon Bone. If he didn’t need it, he could give it to others.
Speaking of which, he seemed to have promised Mother Dragon to invest a Legendary resource. After the World Tournament ended and he had strength, he would repay it double.
Wasn’t this… resources?
Mother Dragon took such good care of him, so he couldn’t be stingy!
Investing with Legendary resources to return Mythical resources!
Even if Mother Dragon didn’t want dark-element resources, Shi Yu could completely use the dragon bone to exchange for other dragon-element and ice-element resources.
At that time, bringing a Mythical Race, an ice dragon with the strength of a demigod, to transmigrate to ancient times to see Mu Huiyin and Emperor Shi could also make Mother Dragon look better.
“Okay.”
“Then… it’s yours.”
The Demon King Dragon’s heart twitched. It didn’t expect that in the end, it still handed the inheritance to the person it didn’t want to give it to the most. However, it had to admit that the other dragons present were all trash compared to Shi Yu’s green dragon!!
...
Buzz!!!
A black light flashed. A dragon bone was taken out of the Mythical Ruins by the Demon King Dragon and floated in the sky. Shi Yu’s Psychic power locked onto it and stored it in his Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, the various factions were completely speechless. There were a total of seven trials, and now, a total of five had already fallen into Shi Yu’s hands!!

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 967 Must-Kill Target (3)
chapters.content:
967 Must-Kill Target (3)
While Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others were excited, they were also worried. Aiyo, this time, Dong Huang was going to pull the hatred of the entire world…
However, only a fool wouldn’t take divine-level resources.
They believed that with Shi Yu’s current potential, he would definitely be nurtured by the World Tree as Blue Planet’s trump card. Therefore, Dong Huang hugged the World Tree’s thigh and was not afraid of any faction.
“Human.”
!!
Just as Shi Yu put away the Dragon King Bone and Inatella was left panting, the golden giant bull god in the sky revealed an excited expression.
“How many meteors can you summon just now??”
“Looks like the power is pretty good.”
Its entire body flickered with light, and its huge bull body turned into the image of a humanoid bull. It rubbed its fists and said, “My hand is a little itchy. Find a suitable place later and let me warm up.”
“It must be very satisfying to smash a few meteorites like that.”
What!!
At this moment, as the Golden Bull God spoke, many factions looked at the battle god in the Western myths and legends in a daze.
Everyone was shocked!
What was this god trying to do…!
It wanted to warm up with the meteorite just now??
The corners of their mouths twitched. They felt that these gods were also very inhumane.
If these words were said by any non- demigod totem, they would sneer.
However, the one who said this was the Western God of Battle. They only felt that this god’s strength was unfathomable.
“My trial is this. Whoever can please me with battle and let me have my fill… Will have my inheritance.”
“Have you forgotten the order?” At this moment, the Golden Bull God was speaking excitedly. Beside him, the plant-type god spoke.
Upon hearing that, the Golden Bull God was stunned and revealed a bored expression.
“It should be my turn next.”
The plant-type god looked at the silent World Tree clone. At this moment, the World Tree clone already felt that there was no need to continue the World Tournament.
Could it be that these factions still wanted to continue fighting after seeing Shi Yu’s strength?
In any case, it no longer wanted Shi Yu to fight. If it attacked a few more times, Inatella would probably be smashed! The key was that it couldn’t prohibit Shi Yu from using it. After all, this was the Green Dragon’s skill.
The World Tree was already thinking about repairing the venue.
“My trial is very simple.”
“It’s a hunting competition limited to plant-type creatures…”
“It will test your battle determination and strength.”
“Opportunities are everywhere.”
