“I’ll create a huge hunting barrier. Inside, I’ll place a few totem-level Space Worms and countless overlord-level Space Worms. They’re all reserve food I hunted in the invasion war. They’re already dead.”
“I’ll temporarily revive them for a moment. You’ll become their prey. At the same time, they’re also your prey. Every one of them has been modified by me into ‘nutrients’ that contain powerful life essence. After killing one, the life essence will increase your strength without any side effects. At the same time, by hunting the plant-type creatures with the greatest number and quality of enemies, you can finally obtain my inheritance.”
“You…” At this moment, as the plant god mentioned its trial, the Boar God and the other gods looked at it.
Especially the Boar God, who was drooling.
They didn’t expect this guy to have stock.
“What!”
As the plant-type god said its trial rules, the plant-type overlords were immediately excited to the extreme.
Trial of conscience!!!
This was obvious. All those who participated in this trial had soup to drink. Even if they couldn’t obtain the final inheritance, they could still obtain enough power by killing the enemy. Space worms… Things that could be regarded by Mythical creatures as food reserves. How nutritious would that be?
And the previous Boar God also used the Space Worm as food.
This clearly looked like a great supplement.
The plant overlords and even the rubber totems were extremely excited.
“Oh!!!” At this moment, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up when he heard the final two trials.
It sounded like he could participate??
Be it the plant trial or the golden bull god who wanted to fight him, he met the requirements of the trial!!
It was just that the upper limit of the difficulty of these two trials… seemed to be relatively high. It was probably not that easy to perfectly clear.
“Wait a minute.”
At this moment, as the plant-type god mentioned the trial, Shi Yu suddenly thought of a problem.
If he wrapped up the plant trial too, would it be bad? He would offend too many plant factions…
It was fine if they offended the Dragon Empire and the Dragonman Empire, who had a feud with Dong Huang, but not every totem faction had a feud with Dong Huang.
They could completely become friends.
For example, the Infinite Sea Region and the Ghost Sea had the possibility of becoming allies of Dong Huang because of the Blue Sea Sprite.
Shi Yu thought for a moment. Why don’t he let the other participants hunt the overlord-level Space Worm?
He let Baby Ginseng be in charge of dealing with the totem-level Space Worms and heavily injuring a few. This way, he could still give them a favor and let the overlords hunt them easier.
As expected of him. He was really a good person. When the time came, he could make another group of friends.
...
“No.”
Shi Yu’s expression turned serious again. Wait a minute, he was a good person, but when this group of participants saw that Baby Ginseng was also participating in the trial, they wouldn’t leave the Space Worm alone and come to get Baby Ginseng, right??
After all, the temptation of the previous ginseng baby was comparable to a divine-level resource…
Forget it, if one couldn’t even suppress that desire, it was not qualified to be Dong Huang’s ally. It was just that he could only let plant-type creatures participate and couldn’t kill them with Chi Tong. It was a loss, a huge loss. This was what troubled Shi Yu the most. It didn’t match his original goal of fishing.
At that moment, all the factions were immersed in the rules of the plant hunting trial and were relatively excited. However, among them, the gazes of the Black Dragon Juggernaut and the Tyrant Dragon King ruthlessly landed on Shi Yu.
When they saw Shi Yu’s happy expression, they found it unbelievable. Wait a minute, this bastard didn’t want to use that ginseng baby to participate in this trial, right??
Their eyes were red as they suddenly had a thought. As long as Shi Yu dared to let Baby Ginseng participate in this trial, they would make Shi Yu pay the price.
Find an alliance and ask them to cooperate with the Space Worm to kill Shi Yu’s ginseng baby in the trial and let Shi Yu suffer the pain of losing his pet.
Since Shi Yu dared to kill their people…
In that case, they also wanted Shi Yu’s pet to pay the price with its life. They didn’t believe that the supplement race’s monarch-level ginseng baby could be very strong.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 968 Time Element
chapters.content:
968 Time Element
A plant-type god was called the Eternal Divine Tree.
After introducing the trial rules, it looked at Shi Yu.
It didn’t have the strange temper of the Demon King Dragon.
It didn’t matter who the human who finally obtained his inheritance was.
!!
However, Shi Yu had obtained five inheritances in a row, so it was inevitable that the Eternal Divine Tree would feel a little complicated.
Therefore, it looked at Shi Yu, who was watching the show beside it, and asked, “Human, you’ve already obtained five trial inheritances. Don’t tell me you also plan to participate in my trial?”
It remembered that Shi Yu really had a plant-type pet.
Although that pet was only at the monarch level, it had power comparable to divine-level resources. Its battle power shouldn’t be bad.
At this moment, with the Eternal Divine Tree’s question, Inatella Island was silent.
“Ah.” The totem-level contestant, Rennes, looked at Shi Yu with a pained expression, his eyes filled with fear.
No way, again???
It was a little panicked now.
Anyone who encountered a competitor of five consecutive championships would be very panicked, alright?
Shi Yu indeed had a plant-type pet, but wasn’t that a supplement race?
Its battle power must be very poor. In order to avoid becoming food for the Space Worm, it had to stay at home obediently!!
At this moment, the rubber divine tree had already made a decision.
If its strength couldn’t increase greatly in this plant trial, it would definitely have to surrender when it encountered Shi Yu in the main competition.
It didn’t want to be smashed to death by the Green Dragon meteorite.
Therefore, this plant-type trial was its only chance to change its fate.
Although it felt that Shi Yu didn’t have the right to compete with it, after watching five trials in a row, the rubber divine tree asked itself honestly. It was also afraid of a freak like Shi Yu.
It was afraid that he would cause trouble again.
When the Eternal Divine Tree asked this, countless gazes, regardless of their status, looked at Shi Yu, who had an innocent expression.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Although it’s not good to take so many trial inheritances in a row, but…”
“But I really seem to have the ability to participate in this trial.”
“My ginseng baby is also very strong… Although it’s a supplement race… It’s not a big problem to fight above its level.”
The Crown Rubber Divine Tree: …
Bastard, get lost.
The Eternal Divine Tree:…
“Alright then,” the Eternal Divine Tree said indifferently.
As for Demon King Dragon and the other divine beasts, they looked at the many totem countries without minding the trouble.
That gaze seemed to be saying, “How can you tolerate this?”
….
As the plant-type god, the Eternal Divine Tree, finished introducing the trial rules, undercurrents surged in Inatella.
Apart from the fact that plant-type participants could participate in the trial to hunt the Space Worm and would definitely cause many factions to compete, it was also related to the divine-level inheritance replenished by the Eternal Divine Tree!
The candidate who hunted the most enemies and the highest quality would obtain the divine-level inheritance, the Eternal Flower!
The user of the Eternal Flower could increase their lifespan by ten thousand years, and their life force would be strengthened to the divine level.
The user would no longer Decrepify naturally and maintain their peak state!
Even humans could use it.
As soon as this inheritance was announced, the participants became even crazier.
Even Shi Yu was slightly moved. He felt that he could use it for Baby Ginseng to study.
“Origin.”
“It’s time for you to return the favor.”
“That Shi Yu is too much. He doesn’t take you seriously at all.”
In the alternate space where the half-god Juggernaut, the Genesis Tree God, was located, the Void was torn apart. The huge Black Dragon Juggernaut and the Tyrant Dragon King descended together.
Seeing these two experts descend, the Genesis Tree God’s expression changed as it looked at the Black Dragon Juggernaut.
“200 years ago, at the critical moment of your reincarnation, you owed my Dragon Empire a huge favor. We helped you clean up your competitors. Now, it’s time for you to repay the favor.”
“Now, your Origin Region and Shi Yu will definitely fight. Without the confidence to get first place in the trial, will he participate in the trial?”
The bark of the Genesis Tree God twitched. It was also extremely annoyed by this Shi Yu.
The Eternal Flower was a rare treasure for plant-type life forms.
It was still hoping that the rubber tree could give it a few petals after winning the championship.
In the end, Shi Yu, this bastard, wanted to interfere again?
Bullying trees was too much.
“Origin Tree God, the world has suffered for a long time. Do you think the Origin Land can compete with that green dragon in the main competition? This trial is the only chance,” the Tyrant Dragon King said.
“In the trial, cripple it.”
...
“We will all support the Origin Land to obtain the World Tree inheritance. As plant-type creatures, you are the orthodox!”
“Moreover, don’t forget that during the totem war, the Origin Land also invaded Dong Huang as an invader. When Dong Huang rises, do you think the Origin Land can stay out of it?”
“I know what you mean,” the Genesis Tree God said. “But these aren’t enough.”
“If you want our contestants to take action, you have to pay an additional resource.”
They had to pay more!!
After all, Shi Yu’s potential was there, and the Genesis Tree God didn’t want to casually provoke him.
“Sure!!!” The Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Juggernaut agreed immediately.
…
A moment later, the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree received the summoning of the Genesis Tree God.
“Lord Genesis Tree God.”
The rubber divine tree had already guessed the other party’s intention of summoning it.
...
“Reyn, you should understand your situation, right?” the Genesis Tree God said to the rubber divine tree.
“Your only advantage among the totem creatures in the Origin Land is that you have a compatible human contractor.”
“If you miss the opportunity of this world competition, after returning to the Origin Land, you will quickly return to ordinary. You have no hope of becoming a demigod in your life, let alone breaking through to the Mythical Domain after the Mythical Revival.”

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 969 Time (2)
chapters.content:
969 Time (2)
“This world competition is your only chance.”
“You have to take down the next trial no matter what. Apart from that, if you can do it, I’ll allow you to devour Shi Yu’s pet.”
The Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree, Rennes, was shocked. “But that Shi Yu…”
“If you’re afraid, you can never become a big shot. That ginseng baby, together with the Space Worm as nutrients and the Eternal Flower… You can almost 100% obtain the strength of a top-notch totem.”
!!
“If you can heavily injure that Shi Yu in this trial, even if he sends out the Green Dragon in the main competition, you might not necessarily be his match.”
“And after winning the World Tournament and obtaining the blessings of the World Tree, the two of you don’t have to be afraid of Dong Huang at all. Moreover, our Origin Land isn’t afraid of the seven countries at all.”
“The difficulty this time isn’t high. Even if a monarch-level plant-type creature has a certain amount of battle power, it’s impossible for it to reach the strength of a totem.”
“Besides, you’re not alone. At that time, many totem factions will assist you. Even those Space Worms can indirectly become your help.”
The eyes of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree, Rennes, and its contractor, Carney, flickered.
“Can I eat that ginseng baby…”
In the entire Inatella, there was almost no creature that didn’t covet Baby Ginseng.
Even the owl and gem cat from the same camp drooled when they saw the ginseng baby. Even the divine beasts woke up because of its fragrance, let alone the enemies of the totem faction.
What suppressed their desire was basically Shi Yu’s strength and Dong Huang’s strength. However, the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree didn’t expect that the Genesis Tree God would actually let it take a gamble, eat that ginseng baby, and heavily injure Shi Yu.
For a moment, the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree’s thoughts stormed. In the end, the desire to become a god defeated everything.
“The bold bloat to death, and the timid starve to death.”
“I’ll give it my all.”
…
In the Dong Huang area.
When the Eternal Divine Tree created the trial barrier, Shi Yu was facing the reminder of Divine Source Legendary and President Lin.
“You have to be prepared.”
“In this trial, you’re very likely to be targeted by the various large factions together, especially when your ginseng baby reveals the aptitude of a divine-level supplement.”
“The Black Dragon Juggernaut has probably already found the Genesis Tree God.”
The two seniors were a little nervous.
After all, they couldn’t face the trial with the Green Dragon and the Panda.
Although Baby Ginseng wasn’t weak either, it was still not very stable.
Self-destruction…
Shi Yu definitely wanted to self-destruct to obtain the greatest benefits of the trial.
They knew that Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction had long had the battle record of killing totems.
The Black Meteorite Yak was killed by Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction.
However… Shi Yu should think about how to dodge the self-destruction damage first!
“Yes, I will,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s also a good opportunity to see who has ideas about us.”
“That’s true…”
The corners of President Lin’s mouth twitched. “We’re afraid that your ginseng baby won’t be able to control its Crowd Control well.”
“You saw it too. That trial barrier isn’t big.”
“If the participants of the seven countries and even you are also blown up, then…”
Shi Yu: Σ(°△°|||)_
On Dong Huang’s side, only Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were qualified to participate. They were the only two who contracted plant-type pets.
However, Lu Qingyi’s Imperial Concubine Flower was only at the monarch level. Even with Mythical Revival and Spiritual Psychic power, it could at most display the strength of an overlord. The risk of participating was too high.
Therefore, Lu Qingyi didn’t plan to participate.
But in the other six countries, there might not be many Beast Tamers who contracted plant-type pets.
At that time, if Shi Yu killed them all, it would be troublesome.
“Wu…”
Shi Yu was stunned. “On my side, I’m confident of avoiding the damage of the self-destruction.”
“When the time comes, when I attract monsters, I’ll also control it to only attract Space Worms.”
“But if contestants from other countries still court death and want to join in the fun… I indeed can’t control it.”
“It’s fine if the contestants of the totem country want to target me together and blow me up together, but as for the seven countries…”
“If they’re here to help me resist the enemy and enter the self-destruction range, I’ll cry to death.” Shi Yu cried.
“Therefore, I want you to tell the legends of the other six countries. When the time comes, stay away from me.”
Divine Source Legendary was silent.
“I should go and talk to the legends of other countries first.”
….
A moment later, Dong Huang’s Mechanical Legendary Divine Source pulled up the mental network that connected the Legendaries of the seven countries.
He started the online meeting.
...
“Divine Source, what are you doing?”
“Don’t tell me he’s here to ask for help.” Shen Feng’s Legendary Z snorted.
In his opinion, Divine Source calling them at this time was most likely because it was afraid that Shi Yu would be targeted in the next trial.
They probably wanted to ask their contestants to help Shi Yu when the time came, so they could party up and farm monsters together.
Divine Source Legendary: “I’m just discussing the next trial with everyone.”
“As expected,” Legendary Z said. “Sure, but you have to share the technology of the mechanical phantom beast without holding back.”
Divine Source Legendary: ???
“Let me finish first.”
“I don’t know how many contestants are participating in the next competition, but I want to ask them. When the time comes, stay away from Shi Yu.”
Shen Feng Mechanical Legendary, Seven Islands Valkyrie, Elven Empress of Tingxiang, Ming Hua Death God, Snowfield Battle God, Rongguang Hero King: ???
“Shi Yu’s ginseng baby is actually very strong.”
...
“A few months ago, it successfully killed a Yun clan totem.”

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 970 Time (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 970 - 970 Time (3)
970 Time (3)
“The skills are very powerful.”
“It’s probably not inferior to that meteorite.”
“And just like the meteorite of the Green Dragon just now, it’s not easy to control Crowd Control.”
“No, to be precise, it’s definitely uncontrollable.”
!!
“I’m just worried that your contestants are too close to him and will be affected and suffer an undeserved disaster, so I came to remind you.”
“That’s it. I’m hanging up.”
Beep beep…
The Legendarys of the six countries were stunned.
Wait, wait a minute, what did this old kid just say?!!!
That monarch-level ginseng baby had killed the Yun clan totem a few months ago?!
What a f*cking joke!!
….
Boom.
Soon, the Eternal Divine Tree created a huge tree barrier.
The barrier occupied one-tenth of the island. The interior was lush with branches and leaves, and various strange plants grew.
At this moment, if many contestants and spectators wanted to see the situation inside the barrier clearly, they could only fly into the sky and watch from the sky.
“Participants, come stand in front of me.”
At that moment, after creating the barrier and reviving the Space Worm, the Eternal Divine Tree spoke calmly and looked at the contestants of the various countries.
Buzz.
On the totem country’s side, many contestants from the plant kingdom walked out.
One, two, three… Among them, transcendent life forms were all at the overlord level, and human Beast Tamers were basically at the legend level.
Among them, the strongest was the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree from the origin place and the human Beast Tamer with the form of a tree sprite flying beside him.
In a short moment, 28 totem country contestants responded to the sixth trial.
However…
On the seven countries’ side, apart from Shi Yu, who followed out, the other six countries… didn’t move for a long time.
One by one, the contestants of the six countries stayed obediently in their country’s area and didn’t take a step forward. It was as if they didn’t want to participate in the trial.
At this moment, Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and Shi Yu were stunned.
What was going on?
Why didn’t they come over? It was a rare trial where all the trial challengers had a chance to eat soup!
At that moment, the contestants from the other six countries who were qualified to participate in this trial had extremely complicated feelings!
Because just now, the legendaries of their countries urgently transmitted their voices to tell them to give up this trial.
“Will Die”!
In any case, with the rubber totem tree around, the chances of obtaining the final inheritance were 0.
Was it worth it to take the risk for a hunting game while they didn’t know the strength of the feedback?
It was better… not to participate!
Apart from Shi Yu, all the Beast Tamers of the seven countries gave up participating!
This scene directly made the Beast Tamers of the totem country feel disbelief. They didn’t understand what the seven countries were up to.
The Beast Tamers of the seven countries also felt that it was unbelievable.
They didn’t expect that other countries would also give up the trial on a large scale.
No, they had given up, but not completely.
There was also a participant from the seven countries.
It was the first Shi Yu to claim that he wanted to participate…
However, could Shi Yu really do it?
After all, their legends had all said that this trial was life-and-death.
Many totem-level Space Worms, in addition to the totem-level Rubber Divine Tree, indeed didn’t look like a good place…
In the Seven Islands area, with the Phoenix Exort Tree, the Phoenix Court’s Jie Yi, who could also participate, became nervous for Shi Yu.
They didn’t understand why the legendary of Dong Huang didn’t persuade Shi Yu.
“What’s going on?” At this moment, when they saw this strange phenomenon, the totem countries suddenly felt a little panicked.
“Well, Lord Divine Spirit, I’m very sorry. I suddenly have a stomachache.” Among the 28 totem country contestants who had just responded, an ape that looked like it was made of wood suddenly turned pale and immediately said.
It hurriedly dragged its contractor away from the trial point under the stunned expression of its country’s totem. Strange, too strange. It didn’t want to participate anymore.
The Eternal Divine Tree : “…”
“This…” At this moment, the sixth trial that revealed a thick strange atmosphere made the Genesis Tree God, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the Black Dragon Juggernaut a little silent. They didn’t know what was going on.
It also made the determined Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree swallow its saliva and become a little nervous.
Even the Eternal Divine Tree had a bad feeling. What… were they doing?
….
Soon, nine of the 29 candidates who walked out withdrew from the competition one after another.
This Jiu Fang basically came with the mentality that it wouldn’t be a loss to defeat an overlord-level Space Worm and leave after getting some benefits.
However, as Shi Yu was the only one participating in the competition from the seven countries, in addition to the fact that the Dragon Empire and the Dragonman Empire had previously contacted them to deal with Shi Yu together, it immediately made Jiufang feel a little afraid.
They kept feeling that something big was going to happen. They were afraid that they would be affected, so they chose to give up.
“Is anyone else leaving?” The Eternal Divine Tree was completely speechless.
Although the remaining 19 contestants were also a little nervous, because they had Quests, they didn’t dare to take the initiative to withdraw.
“Not bad.” At this moment, Shi Yu looked calm on the surface, but in his heart, he looked at the remaining 19 totem country contestants happily.
With max-level Psychic power and telepathy, he sensed faint killing intent on them.
To Shi Yu’s surprise, after the torment of the Divine Source Legendary, the sixth trial directly became an amusement park between him and the totem factions who wanted to hunt him.
“In that case, I’ll send you into the barrier,” the Eternal Divine Tree said in silence after taking a few more looks at Shi Yu.
It gradually understood what was going on. It wanted to see what kind of sparks could be created between these factions in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 971 Time Element (4)
chapters.content:
971 Time Element (4)
….
“Look.”
After the contestants gathered, strange trees that looked like man-eating flowers spat out strange insects with juice in their huge mouths.
When they were just spat out, their bodies weren’t big. They were at most a few meters long. However, as they fell to the ground, the bodies of the worms suddenly swelled.
“Zizizi…”
Moreover, indescribable sounds came from their bodies. In a short moment, the bodies of the largest worms swelled to dozens of meters tall.
Their forms were very strange, and the characteristics of the insects were only a portion of the bodies. Their bodies contained the organs of various animals and plants, and their bodies seemed to be pieced together by more than ten species. They were extremely terrifying.
In the outside world, the contestants and audience didn’t sense much strong energy fluctuations from them, but the life aura comparable to a totem level enveloped their bodies like a vast sun.
There were a total of five totem-level Space Worms and 45 overlord-level Space Worms!
“So few!” After discovering that there were only 45 overlord-level Space Worms, less than 100, the remaining trial challengers of the totem country instantly felt that it wasn’t enough.
The rubber divine tree looked over and felt that it was enough to stuff the gaps between its teeth.
However, if it contained life force, it didn’t look that terrifying.
Even the five totem-level Space Worms didn’t look as powerful as the Green Dragon Prince who had been insta-killed just now.
At this moment, when they discovered the “unsatisfied” expressions of the candidates, the corners of the mouths of the many gods led by the Boar God suddenly curled up.
“Hehe.”
“They don’t seem to know what they’re facing…”
….
A moment later, a total of 20 contestants were teleported to different positions in the trial barrier.
At this moment, the Teleportation of the Eternal Divine Tree was very particular. Every cultivator who had just entered the trial barrier had a cosmic worm moving its body in front of them.
Their eyes were scarlet and dark green, and saliva dripped from their ferocious mouths, as if they were already hungry to the extreme. They were so hungry that they almost lost their minds.
“Space worm?”
Swoosh!!!
One by one, the overlord-level Great Light Flowers that had just entered released thousands of lights under the enhancement of the Beast Tamer’s light-element strengthening talent, attacking the evil creature in front of them that had a cockroach as the main body and the characteristics of many races, such as gorilla, willow tree, dragon, and phoenix.
Boom boom boom boom!!!
Countless attacks landed. The Space Worm stood on the spot without moving at all. The moves caused a violent explosion on its body. In the rising smoke, it only continued to move its body and walked towards its prey with red eyes.
The pupils of the overlord and the Beast Tamer constricted.
“Ah!!!!!”
In a short moment, less than a few seconds after the trial began, a candidate was torn apart by the Space Worm and swallowed into its mouth.
“…” This scene made many spectators who were paying attention to the trial barrier in the outside world widen their eyes and cover their mouths.
This situation also happened elsewhere.
In an instant, two of the 20 groups of candidates who entered died and were eaten by the Space Worm.
This made the hearts of the Beast Tamers from the seven countries who didn’t participate in the trial, as well as the Beast Tamers who had just left at the last minute, race.
After all, the first batch of Space Worms the trial-goers encountered was only at the overlord level. The five totem-level Space Worms were still searching for prey from afar.
“Quasi totem level.” At this moment, the experts watching the trial had deep gazes as they judged.
The physical strength of each of the 45 overlord-level Space Worms here was comparable to the totem level. The attacks of ordinary overlords were no different from scratching an itch for them.
Perhaps even if a top-notch overlord wanted to defeat these Space Worms, it would have to pay a heavy price. This was even if these Space Worms didn’t have any other trump cards.
“Hehe, because of the ability to devour and evolve, the physical strength of the Space Worm race is enough to crush dragons and has perfect Elemental resistance.”
Seeing this, the Boar God said, “Although these revived Space Worms are in an extremely hungry Enfeeble state, in terms of strength, they are fully deserving ferocious beasts.”
“If you underestimate them, wait for death. Oh right, it’s worth mentioning that these Space Worms in front of us can only be considered soldiers in their huge race. They only have physical strength and don’t master transcendent power. The really terrifying ones are those royal families…”
“Their abilities are all comparable to divine skills.”
“I hope we won’t encounter each other in the future.”
Upon hearing that, the expressions of many experts from the factions changed.
At this moment, there were trial challengers who basically couldn’t resist the Space Worm and could only escape.
There were also those who could barely fight the worms, and there were even those who could easily insta-kill overlord-level Space Worms.
For example, the rubber divine tree in the Origin Land had an advantage one level higher. In addition to the strengthening of the Beast Tamer, it was still easy to deal with an overlord-level Space Worm that wasn’t at its peak.
“Thunder… Heavy Strike…!!”
With a boom, a rubber tree whip wrapped in lightning swung down in space, instantly smashing the centipede-like Space Worm in front of him.
After dealing with the Space Worm, it disintegrated into a huge amount of life force that surged into the person’s body. At this moment, be it the Rubber Divine Tree or the Tree Sprite Carney, they felt that their lifespans had been strengthened for at least ten years, as well as more than a million life force points. It was very unbelievable.

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 972 Time Element (5)
chapters.content:
972 Time Element (5)
“Not bad, not bad.” The rubber divine tree’s eyes lit up. If that was the case, as long as he defeated most of the Space Worms and ate that ginseng baby, he might really have a chance to have the strength of a top-notch totem…
“We have to find that Shi Yu immediately.”
The rubber divine tree was very worried that Shi Yu had provoked a totem-level Space Worm during the process of hunting the overlord-level Space Worm, causing that ginseng baby to be eaten by someone other than it.
If that was the case, it would be a huge loss.
“Where’s Shi Yu?”
It wasn’t just the rubber divine tree.
As the Teleportation continued, many people’s gazes began to search for Shi Yu.
After all, everyone knew that many candidates definitely wouldn’t let Shi Yu’s trial go so smoothly.
“Yi.”
“This is the Space Worm.”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who was in the barrier, also saw the Space Worm near him.
It was a Space Worm that looked like a huge locust. Its body also contained the characteristics of various races. Bats, eagles, dragons… It was very strange. At the moment, it was staring at Shi Yu and the others with bloodthirst.
His entire body trembled.
This was excitement.
At the moment, the revived Space Worms only had the most instinctive desire to hunt and fight. Therefore, the only thing they could sense was whether the creature in front of them could provide them with huge nutrition after eating it.
Without a doubt, Shi Yu and the ginseng baby on his shoulder were rare supplements for the Space Worm in front of him. They were far more excited than the other Space Worms when they saw the other contestants.
“What will they do…”
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng had encountered a cosmic worm that even top-notch overlords found difficult to deal with, the audience of the various countries became serious.
If it were that green dragon, they believed that it should be able to win as easily as the rubber divine tree, but at this moment, Shi Yu only had Baby Ginseng as a plant-type pet…
“Baby Ginseng, Light Clearing Cannon.”
Shi Yu stood on the spot. Baby Ginseng was still sitting on Shi Yu’s shoulder. Everyone saw that when the Space Worm in front of them turned into an afterimage and flew over, Baby Ginseng also raised its hand.
Almost instantly, high-level skills such as the Time Fruit and Clear Sky were activated.
The sun in the starry sky was even more dazzling.
Baby Ginseng’s level had also reached the overlord level. Moreover, under the enhancement of the max-level sunny day, it released an energy storage beam that was also at the Dao Proficiency proficiency.
A ball of light the size of a marble and containing terrifying power instantly appeared in front of Baby Ginseng’s fingertip.
A dazzling light and surging energy suddenly spewed out, turning into an extended pillar of light that sent the flying cosmic worm flying!!
Crack!!!
With a sound of its body shattering, the body of the Space Worm in the air caved in. It was suddenly sent flying by this pillar of light, smashing several huge trees. Seeing this, the contestants of the seven countries widened their eyes.
This was a f*cking monarch-level supplement ginseng baby?
In a single exchange, it repelled the Space Worm, forming a sharp contrast to the overlord-level Big Light Flower that scraped the Space Worm just now.
However.
“Not enough!!!” Suddenly, some people quickly discovered that although the Space Worm was penetrated by a single attack and had considerable injuries on its body, it quickly flew up again without any major injuries.
It looked at Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng even more cruelly.
Seeing this, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng pondered slightly.
Its physical strength was indeed strong.
“No, Shi Yu and the others’ attacks can’t deal a fatal blow to that Space Worm…”
“However, the attack power can already cause greater damage and is already stronger than most contestants. It shouldn’t be difficult to defeat the Space Worm after a battle, right?”
If it were in the past, no one would have dared to guess that a monarch-level supplement pet could defeat an overlord-level Space Worm. However, at this moment, they actually felt that it wasn’t that difficult to accept.
However, what stunned everyone was…
“Baby Ginseng, let’s go.”
It would take too much effort to solve it. It wasn’t worth it.
He would wait to wipe them all out all at once.
Without another word, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng activated the Earth Escape Skill and burrowed underground together. In front of this locust-type Space Worm… they ran away… They ran away…
They directly used Earth Escape to escape.
“Ji!!!” Seeing this, not only was the audience stunned, but even the Space Worm was stunned. Then, it chased angrily, using its shocking strength to hit the ground and its sharp claws to burrow into the ground to chase after the food.
But clearly, this worm wasn’t good at digging holes, and it didn’t have the genes of a race that was good at underground battles. It was more like an earthworm.
“He ran away?”
“What’s going on?”
“Holy shit, what’s going on?”
Shi Yu chose to avoid the battle when facing an overlord-level Space Worm, immediately stunning the contestants of the seven countries. It also made the contestants of the totem country look confused.
Wait a minute.
Please don’t tell them that Shi Yu’s strategy in this trial was to watch the other contestants fight the Space Worms. Then, he would hide underground and find an opportunity to pick up scraps.
At this moment, the legendaries of the other six countries even suspected that Divine Source was lying to them.
A moment later.
...
Under everyone’s stunned gaze, Baby Ginseng’s figure appeared on the ground again. However, Shi Yu’s figure didn’t appear again.
It seemed like… He was still underground.
Shi Yu had no choice. If he wanted to avoid the damage of the self-destruction but wasn’t allowed to use equipment, he could only use Earth Escape and a certain safe distance from Baby Ginseng’s main body…

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 973 Time Element (6)
chapters.content:
973 Time Element (6)
Fortunately, under Ling’s prior calculations, there wouldn’t be any problems.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng, who had let its clone slip away with Shi Yu, stood on the ground and looked at the starry sky.
“Yi…”
It had to be it after all!
!!
Buzz!!! Buzz!! Buzz!!!
In the next moment, the ginseng baby, which was originally only the size of a radish, used the multiplication skill!!
Boom!!
Its originally small body instantly multiplied to more than a hundred meters tall.
At the same time, a shocking fragrance was released by Baby Ginseng!!
Hu!!
In an instant, this fragrance swept in all directions like a tornado.
“Wait…”
“What’s that ginseng baby doing?”
“Where’s Shi Yu??”
“Roar!!!” “Roar!!!” At that moment, demonic cries rose and fell in the trial barrier, making many people not believe their eyes.
This ginseng baby was taking the initiative to release its nourishing power to attract the enemy??
“This…” Those from the Dong Huang Region, White Brook, Gao Xuan, and the others who had watched the National League were not unfamiliar with Baby Ginseng’s behavior at this moment.
However, it was precisely because they weren’t unfamiliar that they were very shocked and confused.
Shi Yu was pulling monsters again???
Why!!
It was fine if they pulled monsters in the National League, but they were all low-level transcendent and commander-level monsters. Shi Yu and the others could easily defeat them with Eleven’s deterrence.
But now, there were six totems and dozens of top-notch overlords here!
Was Shi Yu crazy, or was Baby Ginseng crazy?
Even with the Green Dragon’s previous attack, it wasn’t that easy to deal with so many enemies together, right?
Moreover, only Baby Ginseng could fight right now.
At this moment, not to mention the totem country and the various divine beasts, even Dong Huang’s own people, apart from a very small number of people who knew, had no idea what Shi Yu wanted to do.
“Is he crazy?”
Originally, they were hoping that Rennes and the other hunters would quickly find Shi Yu’s Tyrant Dragon King, Black Dragon Juggernaut, and Origin Tree God. When they saw Shi Yu’s ginseng baby suddenly take the initiative to attract the enemy, they couldn’t help but be shocked.
“Over there.”
At this moment, as Baby Ginseng changed, dozens of Space Worms in the trial barrier looked in a direction with burning eyes.
Including the five powerful totem-level Space Worms. Although they were evaluated by the Boar God as little soldiers among the Space Worms, with the powerful strength of the overlord-level Space Worm just now as a comparison, no one dared to underestimate these guys.
Even if it was a rubber divine tree, could it deal with one alone? The audience outside had a lot of questions.
However, at this moment, this group of monsters, and even the group of totem country contestants, including the rubber divine tree, looked in the direction of Baby Ginseng’s mutation.
They were all attracted by the fluctuations it released.
“Not good!!” Especially the rubber divine tree, Rennes. When it saw this scene, it accelerated in the direction of the ginseng baby, afraid that it would be eaten by those cosmic worms.
After releasing a wave of fragrance that filled the trial barrier and became the source of all hunger, Baby Ginseng quickly returned to its normal size. It began to hide underground, waiting for a large number of enemies to gather.
Such a strange scene made many factions’ expressions solemn.
At this moment, they could only analyze that Baby Ginseng might want to attract a large number of enemies to fight a chaotic battle and reap the benefits.
As for the other possibilities, no one could analyze them.
“Do you want to win with tactics?” Even the divine beasts came to this conclusion.
No one would think in the direction where Baby Ginseng wanted to kill all the enemies alone.
“Aba Aba, oh no, oh no.”
At this moment, when it saw a large number of Space Worms and so many totems and overlords gathering, the Prediction Owl was the most panicked.
It felt that Shi Yu’s strategy of luring the enemy and guiding them to kill each other might fail!!
Because this was too similar to its prophecy. Baby Ginseng would be chased by a bunch of totems and overlords… Then, right on the heels of that… it would be eaten by a totem!!
This… If its prophecy was accurate, Shi Yu and the others would be in danger!!
No, he couldn’t play like this. He would fail!!!
“What’s wrong with you?” At this moment, the gem cat saw the pale pupils of its old friend beside it tremble.
“No, this strategy is too dangerous. You’ll be eaten, eaten,” the owl said nervously.
The gem cat: “Eh, it’s stable because it has to be eaten!!”
The owl: ???
“It was eaten!! In my premonition, Shi Yu’s ginseng baby will probably be eaten by the totem. It… is in danger!! It’s going to die!!” The Prediction Owl shouted in shock.
It caused the surrounding Beast Tamers of Dong Huang to look at it one after another. Then, their expressions turned serious and their expressions changed.
Although everyone knew that the premonition of the owl was unreliable, at this moment…
...
From the current situation, there was probably a high chance of verifying the prophecy the owl had just mentioned!
“No way.” The expressions of Gao Xuan, Yin Zhengfan, and the others changed.
“Meow, meow, meow?” At this moment, Teacher Ying looked at the owl in shock. Wait, what did this old witch say?
Baby Ginseng that had predicted Shi Yu’s pet… would be eaten??
Wait a minute, did the Future Prediction of the Owl feedback its strength every time it succeeded??
Suddenly, the gem cat looked at the Prediction Owl with a strange expression.
At the moment.
Soon, a huge group of Space Worms gathered.
Facing such a huge group of Space Mutant Insects, Rennes and the other contestants of the totem country didn’t dare to get too close.

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 974 Time Element (7)
chapters.content:
974 Time Element (7)
After all, it would be bad if this group of Space Worms targeted them.
“Could it be that that bastard wants to use others to kill us and use the Space Worm to deal with us?” At this moment, the rubber divine tree, Rennes, thought of this possibility and couldn’t help but be shocked and furious.
This was clearly their plan.
Shi Yu had actually made the first move.
!!
However, weren’t Shi Yu and the others worried about attracting death if they used Baby Ginseng to lure these Space Worms?
At that moment, with the five totem-level Space Worms in the lead, a large number of Space Worms had already gathered here.
However, when they looked at the source of the fragrance that suddenly disappeared, they couldn’t help but be extremely irritable.
For the Space Worms that had no rationality and no transcendent power at this moment, although they had all their strength, it was still too difficult to find a ginseng baby that used the power of time and Earth Escape to hide its aura.
Therefore, if used appropriately, this group of Space Worms could indeed be used as a saber to solve many Difficult problems for Baby Ginseng.
However…
When it had the strength to destroy everything, it was very unnecessary to use someone else to kill him.
Just as all the Space Worms were looking for Baby Ginseng, Baby Ginseng suddenly appeared from the ground again.
On the ground, Baby Ginseng condensed wings of light and slowly flew up, looking around.
Moreover, it emitted a shocking fragrance again.
In an instant, the Space Worms rioted.
A hundred-meter-tall starry sky worm that looked like a natural disaster spider with dozens of dragon limbs quickly stepped on the ground and moved in the direction of the fragrance.
Behind it, a large number of Space Worms chased after it.
“Ya!!” Baby Ginseng turned into light wings and turned to run. It flew in the sky and directly exposed itself to the Space Worms.
At the same time, it also exposed itself to the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree and the others.
“Don’t fall for it!!!” Seeing this, the expressions of the Genesis Tree God and the others changed.
“That ginseng baby wants you to kill each other through itself. Don’t fall for it.”
At this moment, anyone with eyes could tell that Baby Ginseng was using itself to lure the enemy to the rubber divine tree.
The various factions were very surprised that Shi Yu, who had displayed invincible strength previously, would actually choose such a strategy.
However, there was nothing he could do.
Without the strength to crush everything, this seemed to be the best strategy.
“I won’t be tricked!!” Seeing this, the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree revealed a disdainful expression and turned to leave first.
However, in the next moment, its expression changed.
A totem-level Space Flying Bug that looked like a shark directly overtook the huge spider at a shocking speed and approached Baby Ginseng.
It opened its huge abyss mouth, wanting to devour Baby Ginseng in one bite.
“Yi!!! (Help!!!)” In the sky, even if Baby Ginseng, who was waving the Wings of Light, used the Time Fruit to step into the overlord level, it still couldn’t compare to the speed of the totem-level Space Worm.
It directly shouted for help at the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree in the distance.
Beside it, there were five totem-level Space Worms and dozens of overlord-level Space Worms eyeing it covetously. In this situation, even if it was its biological father or even a contractor, they might not necessarily risk their lives to save Baby Ginseng.
However, under the rapid changes in the expression of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree, it still suddenly stretched out its huge rubber arm and grabbed Baby Ginseng.
No matter what, it didn’t want such a delicious ginseng baby to fall into the mouths of these corpse worms.
However, the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree dared to rely on its strength to stay behind at the last minute, but its allies were so frightened by the insect army that they suddenly retreated.
Because of Baby Ginseng, the Space Worms quickly approached the rubber divine tree, and Baby Ginseng was in the center of the battle between the two parties. The current situation was also extremely bad.
Life and death!
Boom!!!
The vine whip of the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree was close to Baby Ginseng.
But in the next second, what made the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree’s gaze explode was that it was still a step slower.
The shark-like Space Flying Bug’s sharp mouth had already enveloped the sky above Baby Ginseng.
….
At this moment, neither side could understand the development of this trial at all.
Everyone could basically confirm that the ginseng baby was the main body of the ginseng baby.
At that moment, Baby Ginseng was almost using its life to pull the monsters. However, before the two parties fought, it would die first!
This strategy of sitting back and reaping the benefits didn’t seem very proficient.
“Snatch!!!”
The Genesis Tree God, who was still persuading the rubber divine tree not to fall into the trap just now, was immediately extremely anxious when it saw that Baby Ginseng was about to fall into the mouth of the Space Worm.
He cursed at the rubber divine tree, not understanding why its movements were so slow.
“Damn it, faster!!!” The fusion frequency of the rubber divine tree and the contractor had already reached the most intense moment, but their movements were still slower than the Space Worm.
Everyone saw that Baby Ginseng was about to be Devoured by the Space Worm.
The World Tree, the divine beast, the demigod, the Legendaries, and the contestants were all extremely serious.
“Ahhhhhh!!!” At this moment, the owl cried out in horror.
It had predicted his friend’s death. Bad luck, bad luck, bad luck, bad luck!!!
...
“What the hell are you shouting for!!” Beside him, the gem cat cursed.
“Just wait for the breakthrough.”
When it finished speaking, countless people looked at Baby Ginseng.
It was about to be swallowed, this ginseng baby with extraordinary strength, this ginseng baby that didn’t even have a Beast Tamer beside it. It suddenly smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 975 Time Element (8)
chapters.content:
975 Time Element (8)
Its aura rose steadily.
Energy Points: 99,990,0
Firstly, the Time Fruit was activated to the maximum.
A terrifying energy wave rose from its body.
!!
This change didn’t make the rubber divine tree and the others care. They only felt that the current ginseng baby’s aura was even more tempting.
However, in the next moment, as the wood-element ginseng baby’s entire body was filled with flames, its aura became strange.
Boom!!!
Energy Points: ???
It directly exceeded 100 million!!
Baby Ginseng, who used the Fire of Life to burn its life force, had its energy level increase instantly. It was even more terrifying than the energy fluctuations on Eleven and Buggy!!
At this moment, it was like an eruption before death, making everyone suddenly look over.
“It burned its life.”
“You want to use this to escape???”
Be it divine beasts, demigods, or Legendarys, they discovered Baby Ginseng’s power at this moment and suddenly approached the totem with incredulous expressions.
A monarch-level ginseng baby’s strength could actually instantly reach the level of a totem. This was simply…
If it was the current power, it might really be able to erupt with stronger speed and escape the Devour of the Space Worm to let the Space Worm and the rubber divine tree meet.
However, what made many experts widen their eyes was that this ginseng baby that suddenly erupted with extremely strong energy didn’t want to escape with this power.
Instead…
In the next second.
The energy on Baby Ginseng’s body began to expand and explode.
Any creature present was very familiar with this familiar energy wave form change.
Self-destruction.
This ginseng baby actually started to self-destruct!
At this moment, the Black Dragon Juggernaut, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the Genesis Tree God were first stunned. Then, they revealed shocked expressions of disbelief.
The legendaries of the seven countries, the various divine beasts, and the various totem half-gods had shocked expressions. They couldn’t believe the change they were seeing in front of them.
Wait a minute.
Why?
Why did this ginseng baby choose to self-destruct?
It was clearly not in a desperate situation at all.
Using the strength of burning life force, there was still a chance to escape.
After that, it could also replenish its life force through various resources.
In the end, a series of eruptions was just for the current self-destruction?!
[This guy… Could it be… Why…]
At this moment, the one who sensed the most was still the Thunder Crown Rubber Divine Tree near Baby Ginseng.
It looked at the ginseng baby that had become a sun with a shocked expression.
They felt a hot wave coming from afar.
The Space Worms closest to Baby Ginseng were also stunned. Their bodies were purely stiff from the huge energy fluctuations.
Especially the Space Worm that swallowed the ginseng baby. It felt that it had swallowed a hot light ball.
Baby Ginseng’s domineering voice came from the light ball.
“Yi!!! (I’m the sun!!!)”
“Yi 1! (Sun and moon shining, explode!!!)”
First, through the super Skill Plant Control that was close to transcendent, it activated his potential to the maximum.
Then, it activated the maximum Time Fruit and the Fire Seed of Life and erupted with all his potential.
In the end, it ignited everything through the Moon Explosion Skill.
The strongest attack.
With a boom, Baby Ginseng fell like the sun. Endless strong light bloomed from the body that swallowed the Space Worm.
The entire body of the Space Worm was directly Devoured by strong light and flames. A terrifying energy wave shook the sky and earth, forming a spreading explosion. Everything in the range of the explosion instantly sublimated.
The entire sky first darkened. With a loud bang, it created a world that belonged to the night, changing the entire barrier phenomenon.
The dark sky and bright night moon made everything silent.
Right on the heels of that, a dazzling sun slowly rose and lingered with the moon.
Under the alternation of the sun and moon.
Boom!!!
The wave of the Moon Explosion swept out again.
Endless strong light spread in the surroundings. At this moment, the bodies of the nearby Space Worms suffered a destructive attack.
...
The rubber divine tree, which was relatively close, felt the fatal heat wave, and its eyes were still filled with an incomprehensible expression.
“Fire…” As it retreated crazily, the shocking flames in front of it still instantly arrived.
“What exactly is this…” At this moment, it still didn’t understand what had just happened.
At the same time, they didn’t understand why a monarch-level ginseng baby could release such a powerful wave when it self-destructed.
“I’m not eating anymore, I’m not eating anymore. Let me go…”
As it shouted in despair, its body gradually disappeared.
The group of Space Worms was undoubtedly instantly swallowed by the light.
The overlord-level Space Worms were almost instantly gone, and the totem-level Space Worms were also encountering an unprecedented impact according to their physiques.
As for the contestants from the totem countries who had left the battlefield at the start, they were still fleeing, but the huge explosion that inexplicably swept up from behind directly made them tremble to the extreme!!
They had no idea what was going on over there.
At this moment, their shocking desire to live made them accelerate again and escape into the distance with all their might.
...
However, the explosion spread even faster!
The light of the explosion directly enveloped most of the trial barrier with Baby Ginseng as the center. The destructive power caused by it completely destroyed everything in a breath.
The speed of the totem country contestants was not enough for them to escape such a powerful explosion. They were almost the batch of creatures who lost their lives the most pointlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 976 Time Element (9)
chapters.content:
976 Time Element (9)
At this moment, as the trial barrier created by the Eternal Divine Tree was enveloped in light, many gods opened their mouths wide. Many demigods watched all of this in shock, and the legends of the seven countries were even more stunned. They finally knew what Divine Source Legendary meant.
Self-destruction.
It was comparable to the self-destruction of a totem-level mechanical life form!!
This was the power of the top-notch forbidden weapon below divine restrictions!!!
!!
Why!!
In the outside world.
The scene inside the trial barrier was extremely spectacular.
Cracks appeared on the trial barrier near the center of the explosion as an energy wave swept past.
When a deafening voice sounded, the energy barrier of the trial barrier directly collapsed. The flying energy light instantly filled the entire sky.
The nearby totems and overlords were shocked, their hearts almost jumping out.
At this moment, the entire island could see the huge explosive energy phantom that filled the sky in the barrier.
It was a white energy body that looked like a ginseng baby. It seemed to be ten thousand meters tall. It opened its round arms and had already broken through the barrier, as if it was hugging the sun and moon in the starry sky. It was very happy.
It was happy, but the audience was shocked by it. They were very shocked, and their ears didn’t work.
“Lunatic!!! Lunatic!! Lunatic!!!”
At that moment, the demigod led by the Genesis Tree God shouted crazily.
It knew that it was definitely impossible for the rubber divine tree to survive this attack when it was weak to fire.
They felt that Shi Yu and that ginseng baby were crazy.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu and the others to actually have such a self-destruction sure-kill skill.
Moreover, he actually sacrificed its life to obtain the divine inheritance for the Eternal Flower.
No wonder Shi Yu disappeared in advance. So he had run away.
However, was it really worth sacrificing a ginseng baby comparable to a divine-level resource for the Eternal Flower?
At this moment, the Genesis Tree God, the Black Dragon Juggernaut, and the Tyrant Dragon King also felt a sense of fear. They weren’t afraid of enemies with extremely high potential, but they were afraid of such lunatics with extremely high potential.
For a divine-level resource, Shi Yu could sacrifice his pet. What else couldn’t he do??
At that moment, everyone was stunned by the self-destruction strategy Shi Yu chose.
The strong wind of the explosion spread crazily. At a speed of hundreds of meters per second, it quickly affected the entire barrier, causing damage of different scales.
Although the destructive power caused continued to weaken, it instantly made the entire trial barrier into a mess. There were no longer any plants.
As the light dissipated, the participants of the totem country were clearly all extinct.
The overlord-level Space Worms was already gone.
There was only a huge totem incomplete corpse and four huge cosmic worms that only had the slightest life aura left, but they also looked miserable. They were relatively intact on the charred ground.
It self-destructed, killed two totems, and heavily injured four totems, causing them to fall into a near-death state.
After countless Space Worms died, life essence that filled the sky floated in the air.
Such a huge life essence made many spectators outside widen their eyes.
However, what shocked them even more was that a figure was standing on the charred ground like the totem corpses.
Who else could that figure be but Shi Yu?
Under the chaotic energy tide, Shi Yu’s short black hair fluttered. He looked up at the corpses and the life essence that filled the sky and revealed a satisfied expression.
At the same time.
The Time Mark was activated.
Under the gathering of the power of time, under the stunned expressions of all the Legendary, demigod, and divine beasts, a seemingly unscathed ginseng baby with a hexagram of time flowing in its eyes gathered in the sky again.
Its petals ignited with the rich flames of life. It was in an excellent state, and its pupils were filled with invincibility.
“Yi.” Then, it gently landed on Shi Yu’s shoulder and looked at the life essence that filled the sky with him.
At this moment, the eyes of the originally shocked Black Dragon Juggernaut, the Genesis Tree God, and the other half-gods almost popped out.
It wasn’t just them. At this moment, no matter who it was, they couldn’t accept that Baby Ginseng, who had just self-destructed and used its life as the price to unleash the Resplendent Strike, was actually unscathed at this moment. It appeared on Shi Yu’s shoulder again without any effect.
If that attack didn’t self-destruct at the cost of his life, how could it have such strong destructive power?
Those were six totems and dozens of top-notch overlords!!!
“Impossible, definitely impossible!!!” The Genesis Tree God shouted in shock. The Tyrant Dragon King’s face was filled with disbelief.
As for the divine beasts, they also looked at Shi Yu and the others in the barrier in disbelief. They knew very well what had happened just now!!!
“Time Skill.”
“After it self-destructed and died, it used a time-element Skill to reverse life and death and completed its revival!!!”
In the sky, the Boar God said in shock. Revival-type time Skill. Even if this skill was only super, its rarity far exceeded most divine skills. How could it appear on a ginseng baby!!
“Time Revival Skill??”
At this moment, as the Boar God was shocked, the entire Inatella looked at Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng in the center of the self-destruction with an extremely incredulous gaze.
It was difficult to accept and unbelievable.
There was such a Skill??
Even Emperor Shi’s pet had never heard of a time-element revival skill.
...
How could this Beast Tamer, this ginseng baby…
At this moment, the contestants of the seven countries seemed to know what the life-and-death crisis their Legendary mentioned was.
That wasn’t from the Space Worm or the totem country at all.
It came from Shi Yu, a demon who often used death as the price to let monarch-level pets self-destruct and destroy totems!!
He was a monster.
As for Shi Yu, he sensed the gazes of the entire island and understood that Baby Ginseng’s time mark had been completely exposed.
However, it wasn’t a big problem.
This kind of thing was the same as the Undying Fruit. If it was said, it might make the enemy more afraid.
He couldn’t help but raise his head and look at the Boar God and the other gods in the sky. “As expected of Lord Boar God.”
“My ginseng baby has indeed mastered a time-type revival Skill. It can revive itself countless times after self-destruction.” Shi Yu smiled.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the entire island trembled.
...
The pupils of the totems and overlords who still wanted to eat the ginseng baby constricted and they suddenly shut their mouths.
However, in the next moment, what shocked the entire island was…
Not only did strong time fluctuations come from the trial barrier just now.
At this moment, in the direction of Dong Huang, a blue owl suddenly rose steadily in confusion…
“Lord Owl…” The teachers and students of Imperial Capital University suddenly looked at it.
At this moment, the most stunned was still the owl cat. After being stunned, it laughed with tears in its eyes.
“Today, I, a time-element overlord, advance to the totem realm!!!”
“As expected of me!!!”
At this moment, the factions on the entire island were even more stunned. Dong Huang… had another time-element totem?!

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 977 A Lot of Resources
chapters.content:
977 A Lot of Resources
Time element was known as the rarest attribute.
Even if the main Stats weren’t time-element, as long as the secondary Stats contained the nature of time, a Skill could easily become the skill of the strongest tier of Stats.
It was like the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy that froze time…
It was because of this skill that the frost dragon could easily live for more than two thousand years at the overlord level, still like a virgin.
!!
Just time-element Skills were already so powerful, and pets with time-element and time talent were even harder to find. It was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
For example, in this world competition, among the more than a hundred factions, apart from Baby Ginseng, no transcendent life form’s own Stats were time-element.
On Dong Huang’s side, a ginseng baby that had mastered a time-element revival skill and a totem-level time-element life form suddenly appeared. How could the totem country not be shocked?
Boom!!!
A huge aura bloomed from the Prediction Owl. The gem cat beside it bit its handkerchief and felt sour.
Back then, when it broke through to the totem level… it had accumulated decades of savings and had to face the threat of the totem before barely breaking through.
In the end, this hooligan inexplicably relied on Future Prediction to break through and become a totem. It really made the cat unhappy.
Fortunately, after obtaining the nine-colored divine light, it was a cat of another level. It was fine if the owl in front of it broke through.
“Holy shit.”
The situation at Imperial Capital University also shocked Dragon Palace City, especially the frost dragon.
What was going on…
Why was it that someone in the audience had broken through while Shi Yu was fighting to the death?
Logically speaking, shouldn’t Shi Yu and the others break through after farming monsters and obtaining a large amount of EXP?
“Totem level!!”
As the owl’s aura suddenly increased, countless gazes looked at it.
A moment later, the imposing Prediction Owl opened its eyes, and the power of the totem was undoubtedly displayed.
“Why do I feel that its aura is even weaker than my aura after breaking through?”
At the side, the gem cat’s surprised voice came.
Prediction Owl: ???
“Grandma, I’m not a battle-type pet!” the Prediction Owl shouted.
The totem countries did not react to the fact that the totem aura of the Prediction Owl was not strong.
They were still secretly shocked.
This was very normal.
It could be said that even if a time element appeared, its other aspects would be restricted because its ability was too BUG-like.
For example, the price of the Time Sprite mastering a divine skill like Space-time Travel was that its strength couldn’t be too strong, or it would interfere with the Space-time Law.
For example, the Prediction Owl had mastered a time-element Skill like Future Prediction. Apart from that, it didn’t have any other powerful attack methods.
It could only rely on Future Prediction to predict battles. It was almost impossible to destroy a city with a big move.
In the past few thousand years, be it the seven countries or the totem country, there seemed to be only one expert who could use the time element to explosive battle power.
Dong Huang’s first Legendary Emperor, Emperor Shi.
Only his time-element pet really displayed the power of time.
Pioneers were often the most difficult. As the first legendary Beast Tamer to establish the human countries, the predicament Emperor Shi faced at that time was far more difficult than the other emperors. However, he still swept through the east. Among them, the contribution of the time element could not be said to be small.
As for the future… Even a powerful legend with time talent like the first principal of the Imperial Capital University only had a thing like the Prediction Owl.
However, these were all in the past.
Although the owl’s aura had decreased, many gazes swallowed their saliva again and looked at the messy trial barrier.
Most people didn’t expect that this pet that looked like a “ginseng baby” actually had a time element!!
At the moment, people could only call it Baby Ginseng.
Its race definitely couldn’t be a ginseng baby.
Which ginseng baby’s ginseng flower could ignite all its life flames like the Sun Flower?
Which ginseng baby’s green eyes could have the pattern of a time hexagram?
Obviously, this was also a monster wearing a supplement race as sheepskin!!
Everyone could actually accept that such a race had mutated and evolved into a time-element race. After all, it was nothing for the time-element to give a supplement race.
However, what made everyone’s teeth hurt was that the explosive skills of this supplement race were ridiculously high!
Moreover, it had mastered the self-destruction skill!
After a monarch-level pet in its initial state self-destructed, its power was actually comparable to the self-destruction of a totem-level life form? Was this reasonable?
“How exactly did he train the pet!”
Even the ancient senior, Ji Mengzhu, who had seen Shi Yu blow up a totem with her own eyes, couldn’t help but be stunned again.
They felt that the power of this self-destruction was even greater than that time.
In the trial barrier, Shi Yu and the others were also very satisfied with the power of the self-destruction.
He felt that the Skill wasn’t for nothing.
The Fire of Life that was close to perfect proficiency, plant control that was close to transcendent proficiency… This was the fundamental reason why Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction power was comparable to the self-destruction of a totem-level life form!
...
At that moment, Baby Ginseng completely modified itself into the strongest forbidden weapon.
Hu hu hu…
Under the energy tide, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng were between a pile of huge corpses.
Life essence floated in the sky.
These were all condensed by the Space Worms that had been modified by the Eternal Divine Tree.
“Tough.”
At this moment, Shi Yu revealed a difficult expression in the face of so many nutrients.

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 978 A Lot of Resources (2)
chapters.content:
978 A Lot of Resources (2)
The energy of this life essence that filled the sky was huge.
But he didn’t know if he should absorb it or not.
After absorbing this, with Baby Ginseng’s current situation, it would definitely break through to the overlord level like absorbing Legendary resources.
In fact, even overlords couldn’t withstand it.
!!
There was the life essence condensed by five totem-level Space Worms here. After absorbing their life essence, there was a high chance that Baby Ginseng would leap into the totem level.
At that time, Shi Yu would definitely explode.
If he had known, he would have brought his senior in too.
This way, with her sharing some of the burden, it shouldn’t be a problem for her monarch-level Imperial Concubine Flower to be strengthened to the invincible overlord level.
“Wait, maybe we can pack it up and take it away.”
Shi Yu looked at the EXP filling the sky and fell into deep thought.
“Lord Eternal Divine Tree.” Shi Yu looked in the direction of the Eternal Divine Tree through the broken barrier and asked, “Excuse me, can I not absorb these first and takeaway?”
The Eternal Divine Tree was silent.
Motherf*cker…
This was like asking if he could pack up if he ate a buffet.
Be a human.
The Boar God, Xuan Ming, Demon King Dragon, and the others were silent.
Damn, what was wrong with this kid?
They were originally looking forward to this trial.
Looked forward to the future’s creatures being killed by the Space Worms and chased after by them.
Although these Space Worms were only small soldiers, in their opinion, they were more than enough to deal with these guys.
Even if that totem tree could resist the overlord-level Space Worm, it was definitely not its match if it fought the totem-level Space Worm.
However, to the surprise of many gods, the trial ended not long after it started.
With the help of the self-destruction and time-element revival Skill, Shi Yu, along with the cultivators, directly wiped out all the targets!!
This was a situation that these gods didn’t expect before the trial began!!
“Up to you.”
At this moment, the Eternal Divine Tree didn’t want to say anything at all. It even regretted taking out so many Space Worms.
As a result, at this moment, it could only watch helplessly as that ginseng baby used plant control to create a huge tree.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng pressed its palms together and bowed gratefully in the direction of the Eternal Divine Tree.
Thank you for the big meal, Grandma Eternal Divine Tree.
It packed it up and took it away.
These things… If they could be packed, Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng would be overjoyed.
It could be sensed that this life essence was very nourishing, especially for life force.
What did this mean?
After collecting it, Shi Yu had supplements that added points to quasi-divine skills and supplements that fused skills!!
Boom!!!
The huge tree began to absorb the life essence that filled the sky. Green fruits grew from the huge tree.
Plant Control+Mutated Fruit+Nutrition!
“Baby Ginseng, finish him off.”
At the same time, Shi Yu didn’t forget to let Baby Ginseng completely kill the four cosmic worms that hadn’t been completely blown up.
The physical strength of this group of Space Worms was still strong.
Shi Yu felt that the physical strength of some totem-level Space Worms was almost catching up to Buggy and Eleven.
This was very rare among totems.
After all, totems like the cat might not even have one-tenth of Eleven and the others’ physical strength.
Buzz!!
Fruits condensed one after another.
“Yi… (Die.)”
At the same time, Baby Ginseng attacked the totem worms that weren’t completely dead.
The physiques of these totem worms were very strong, and when they were in perfect condition, it might not necessarily be able to break through their defense even if they were attacked by the form of ginseng baby’s Time Fruit. Now that they had almost exploded, it was easier to sprinkle salt on their injuries.
Baby Ginseng only let countless branches spread out of the huge tree and stab into their bodies in the time state. Then, it easily ended their life activity through nutrient plunder and absorbed life nutrients.
At this moment, all the contestants of the totem country looked at the trial barrier with fear.
The brains of the few totem country contestants who realized the danger and withdrew from the competition at the last minute rumbled. Their faces were pale and they were filled with lingering fear.
Looking at the tragic situation in the trial barrier, they couldn’t help but be afraid. All the overlords weren’t even left with dregs.
Even at the totem level, two had been blown up. The four that barely survived were also experiencing miserable slaughter.
So scary…
...
If they had any hope at that time, they would probably have become a wisp of soul.
“Not bad.”
At this moment, as more and more fruits condensed, Shi Yu became happier and happier.
The life essence condensed by every overlord-level Space Worm was comparable to a level-eight resource of Legendary quality, and the life essence condensed by the totem-level Space Worm was completely equivalent to a Legendary resource.
Therefore, Baby Ginseng’s explosion directly exploded five Legendary resources and more than 40 quasi Legendary resources.
If he included the Eternal Flower gifted by the Eternal Divine Tree later…
Shi Yu thought for a moment. After researching it, he would definitely eat the Eternal Flower.
This way, his physique would be further strengthened. Then, it would be easier to add some quasi-divine skills.
This trial could be said to have completely blown up all the supplements Shi Yu might need to add some quasi-divine skills next.
This was more like it.
Shi Yu felt that this was the correct way to self-destruct.
...
There had to be benefits!
It could be imagined that after he accepted the Blessing of the World Tree and broke through to the legend level, he could directly use these supplements to complete a huge increase in strength first.

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 979 A Lot of Resources (3)
chapters.content:
979 A Lot of Resources (3)
The foundation for adding points had increased.
After that, he could be a heartless adding machine.
At that time, his strength would be passable. He was still a little lacking now. Shi Yu looked outside, as if he wanted to look at the Black Dragon Juggernaut, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the Genesis Tree God who had ill intentions towards him through the Void.
For the time being, he definitely couldn’t defeat them…
!!
“Damn it.”
When it met Shi Yu’s gaze, the Genesis Tree God’s heart skipped a beat and it was shocked.
As a nine-lives demigod, he was actually frightened by a level-six Beast Tamer.
“Berserk Dragon King, Black Dragon Juggernaut!!!”
At this moment, the most furious was still the Genesis Tree God. It was extremely regretful in its heart and didn’t understand why it had boarded the pirate ship of these two dragons.
Shi Yu had clearly displayed so much unscientific battle power previously, so why did it still have to rely on luck?
It didn’t feel that the rubber divine tree was dead, but it was worried that Shi Yu would target the origin place because of this. The potential and strength Shi Yu had displayed so far were enough to make them demigods afraid.
The stronger one was, the more afraid they were of death.
Moreover, the opportunity to revive the Mythical stage was right in front of them.
Without the divine inheritance, the World Tree Blessing would definitely be out of reach. They even offended such a monster. It was a complete double loss.
It was so silly, really…
“Roar!!!” The Black Dragon Juggernaut directly hid in a deeper space. The Tyrant Dragon King even looked at Shi Yu’s figure with a wavering gaze.
It completely didn’t expect that at this point, it still couldn’t affect Shi Yu at all.
“Now, no one can stop him at all.” The Tyrant Dragon King’s pupils constricted. It felt that it was even harder for it to affect Shi Yu under the multiple protections of Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang.
The champion of the World Tournament would most likely be Shi Yu.
Was there a need to continue this world competition???
The two greatest favorites to win the championship, the totem-level contestants, were directly killed before they could last until the main competition.
Dead before they could win the competition.
At the thought of its carefully cultivated descendant dying in Shi Yu’s hands just like that, at the thought that Shi Yu was the culprit behind snatching its believers, the Tyrant Dragon King found it unbearable.
It really wanted to transmigrate back to ten years ago and kill Shi Yu in his child form in advance.
Of course, those totem countries that had listened to the bewitchment of the Black Dragon Juggernaut and the Tyrant Dragon King but didn’t have their origins turned pale when they saw their contestants die tragically…
At this moment, when many contestants from the totem country saw Shi Yu, their legs had already gone weak. Even the trump cards of demigod factions like the Dark Night Forest and the Demon Kingdom had pale expressions. They had no idea how to participate in the next world competition.
Infinite self-destruction revival and meteorite falling from the sky, what was the point of fighting?
This wasn’t even counting the ridiculous Blue Sea Sprite and Shi Yu himself, who was also terrifyingly strong after possession!
Moreover, how could the Wind Kirin of the Mythical Race be weak?
Didn’t they see that a wind of luck made the divine beast bleed slightly?
If it was said that the various countries still had hope previously, but at this moment, when they saw Shi Yu kill two totems in succession in an instant, they were completely afraid!!
They felt that this world competition wasn’t f*cking for overlords to participate in!
Only at the totem level would there be an admission ticket.
Moreover, there was a high chance of being insta-killed by passing monsters. What the hell!
At this moment, the corners of the mouths of the demigods of the totem countries and the legends of the human countries twitched. Their hearts trembled. Not only were their citizens stunned, but they also found it very difficult to accept.
They didn’t understand why Dong Huang had such a monster. Why was every pet of Shi Yu so strange!!
At that moment, if there was anyone who was more excited and wanted to fight Shi Yu, it was probably the Golden Bull God.
At this moment, the Golden Bull God’s gaze was burning. Initially, it was still worried that the Green Dragon’s meteorite wouldn’t be able to satisfy it in the subsequent trial, but if this self-destruction that contained the power of fire and light was included… It felt that its blood was already boiling.
As expected.
It looked at Shi Yu. This person should be the one who could let it fight to its heart’s content after waking up.
At the thought of Shi Yu’s strength, the Golden Bull God couldn’t help but stretch its muscles.
A moment later, Shi Yu finished collecting all the Fruits of Life.
He brought Baby Ginseng out of the barrier politely and looked at the Eternal Divine Tree.
“…” The corners of the Demon King Dragon’s mouth twitched. It didn’t expect that the sixth trial would still be taken by Shi Yu.
This made it feel that the seventh one was most likely still Shi Yu. No, or rather, among them, only Shi Yu could make that cow acknowledge him.
“Take it.”
“Your performance… is not bad…”
Looking at the messy trial, the Eternal Divine Tree took out a seven-colored Eternal Flower that contained strong life force and threw it at Shi Yu.
“Thank you.”
Buzz.
When the Eternal Flower landed in Shi Yu’s hand, Shi Yu immediately felt comfortable.
Eat it and its lifespan would immediately increase by 10,000 years!
One had life force comparable to a divine level.
Pne would never Decrepify and maintain its peak state.
...
However, he only wanted to know if the eternal power of this divine-level resource could offset the additional points of the divine skill?

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 980 Ancient God Golden Bull (1)
chapters.content:
980 Ancient God Golden Bull (1)
“Hey, hey, hey, isn’t it my turn next?”
After the Eternal Flower landed in Shi Yu’s hand, the Golden Bull God in the sky could no longer hold it in.
It was a battle ancient god to begin with. The moment the World Tree woke it up and asked it to undergo the trial, Ancient God Golden Bull had already thought about it.
It would personally fight the creatures of the future and see how far they could please him!
It stood in the sky, its eyes burning with flames.
At this moment.
Many factions suddenly looked at the Golden Bull God, still recovering from the shock brought by Shi Yu just now.
So there was another trial…
Dark clouds lingered above the heads of many factions. At this moment, they were no longer interested in this trial.
