It felt like it was prepared for Shi Yu again.
What was the Golden Bull God’s trial again?
It seemed like… it wanted to fight and wanted the participant to please it?
In other words, it was still a battle of battle power…
Many factions actually didn’t doubt Ancient God Golden Bull’s strength.
This was because Western archeologists had once archeologically cracked a ruin from the Mythical Era.
This Mythical Ruins was built by the followers of Ancient God Golden Bull.
It recorded Ancient God Golden Bull’s powerful battle results.
Ancient God Golden Bull had once attacked a god with a non-divine body.
5It had never stopped fighting and liked to fight. After entering the God Realm, he even had the battle record of defeating dozens of gods.
He was a real powerhouse.
Therefore, the West called it the battle ancient god.
Facing such a god, even invincible overlords like the Fallen Angel couldn’t imagine how they could please this god better than self-destructing and meteorites.
The World Tree clone also looked at Ancient God Golden Bull with a headache.
The other gods knew that they were weak now and recuperated obediently.
This Ancient God Golden Bull was still so stubborn.
However, the World Tree clone knew a lot about Ancient God Golden Bull’s talent and strength.
It should be considered a god ranked in the first tier of divine beasts left on Blue Planet at its peak.
Although it was still inferior to those top-notch gods who had left Blue Planet, it was considered one of the best among the new gods.
At this moment, everyone looked at Ancient God Golden Bull, who had erupted with might, and looked at Shi Yu.
It was obvious that Shi Yu would definitely participate in this trial.
A battle with Ancient God Golden Bull.
With the exaggerated performance of the meteorite and self-destruction, it could definitely make this Ancient God Golden Bull happy.
After all, Ancient God Golden Bull himself had said just now that his hand was itching to smash a few meteorites to warm up.
Presumably, it had already targeted Shi Yu.
As for Ancient God Golden Bull’s words, no one doubted it.
After all, it was a battle ancient god that had stepped into the God Realm.
Not to mention a divine-level, even if it was a demigod who had mastered a quasi-divine skill, they wouldn’t be afraid of Shi Yu’s Green Dragon and Baby Ginseng if they suppressed them to the same level and relied on their Skill proficiency.
Perhaps, through Ancient God Golden Bull’s trial, they could see Shi Yu’s limit…
The Black Dragon Juggernaut and the other demigods thought with deep gazes.
At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull indeed passed by the figures of the other contestants and landed his gaze on Shi Yu.
“Human, you definitely won’t miss my trial, right?”
“I look forward to fighting you.”
“However, you’ve fought consecutively several times just now. I’ll give you some rest.”
“When the rest is over, you can fight me again!”
“Actually, there’s no need to rest…” Shi Yu looked up at Ancient God Golden Bull and said,” The battle just now didn’t consume much of our strength. ”
“Since Lord Divine Spirit wants to fight, let’s fight directly.”
Everyone: “?”
Human language???
After dealing with two totems in a row, he said that there was no consumption?
“Little brat, just rest if I tell you to. Why are you talking so much nonsense!!” At this moment, when he heard Shi Yu’s words, Ancient God Golden Bull frowned and said.
It was rare to encounter a good opponent. It didn’t want to be unable to fight Shi Yu at his peak.
In that case, it would feel unhappy.
Shi Yu: …
There was really no need.
...
The moves Buggy used were saved in advance. After Baby Ginseng revived, it was immediately full.
Most importantly, Shi Yu had no intention of letting Buggy and Baby Ginseng fight.
However, Ancient God Golden Bull didn’t agree with this.
At this moment, the Golden Bull Ancient God forcefully let Shi Yu rest, and its gaze landed on the countless invincible overlord contestants present.
For example, the Dark Elven Prince of the Dark Night Forest, the Fallen Angel Prince of the Demon Kingdom.
Its voice was like a furnace. “Although you’re a little weak, you can make do.”
“Come and warm up with me first.”
“What?” Upon hearing that, the dark elven prince, the fallen angel prince, and the others felt extremely humiliated.
He paid special attention to Shi Yu and regarded him as a key opponent. In the eyes of the Ancient God Golden Bull, they could only be considered warm-up tools.
This was simply too much.
“Stop dawdling.”
...
“You’re all overlords, right?”
“I’ve suppressed my level to the monarch level. If you can force me into a disadvantage in this state, you can tell me what you want,” Ancient God Golden Bull grinned and said domineeringly.
Upon hearing that, the expressions of the Dark Elven Prince, the Fallen Angel Prince, and the other contestants changed again.
…
At that moment, the trial had already reached the last round. Shi Yu was chased out by the Ancient God Golden Bull to rest. It pulled the Dark Elven Prince, the Fallen Angel Prince, and the other contestants to warm up.
At this point, it was no longer difficult for many factions to determine that the final inheritance of Ancient God Golden Bull was definitely still given to Shi Yu.
After all, everyone had seen Shi Yu’s strength. He should be the strongest among all the contestants at the moment.
This made the various factions very helpless. At the same time, they wanted to know how the World Tree would arrange the next world competition. Was there a need to fight?
“Shi Yu, well done.”
“And Baby Ginseng too.”
After Shi Yu returned to Dong Huang, President Lin, the gem cat, and the others were extremely excited.
The power of Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction was simply too strong.
Even the barrier known to the Eternal Divine Tree almost shattered completely.
“Rest well. As long as we fight that Ancient God Golden Bull again, the trial will all be over,” President Lin said excitedly.
The seven trial inheritances had all fallen into Dong Huang’s hands. Who else was left!
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “So be it. I can take this opportunity to see Ancient God Golden Bull’s strength.”
Ye Xing, Divine Bell, Zheng Hai, and the others had complicated expressions.
Was it still necessary?
No matter how strong it was, the other contestants were definitely not as strong as it.
In the end, the trial inheritance would definitely still be his!
Among them, only President Lin noticed the fighting spirit that also rose in Shi Yu.
He was suddenly stunned. “Shi Yu…”
“Don’t tell me you’re here to see its strength with the intention of defeating Ancient God Golden Bull?”
President Lin’s words shocked the surrounding Tyrannical Sea Legend, the gem cat, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others.
Wait a minute, what did President Lin say?
Shi Yu wanted to defeat this god?
What a joke.
That was a god.
Even a demigod was an unreachable existence.
That was a god!
Their expressions changed drastically as they looked at President Lin in disbelief, not understanding why he said that.
Although Shi Yu’s Green Dragon and Baby Ginseng were very strong, it wasn’t enough, right?
The power of the Green Dragon’s meteorite made those gods block it very easily. Although Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction had broken the barrier, that barrier was probably only one of the many insignificant methods of the Eternal Divine Tree.
They had yet to show their true divine skills.
As a battle ancient god, the Golden Bull God definitely had a supreme battle divine skill that exceeded all creatures in the modern world.
It was impossible to defeat.
In fact, being able to injure the Ancient God Golden Bull a little should be a huge achievement.
“President Lin, how do you know?” Shi Yu was extremely surprised. “You’ve also seen it. Because those gods have slept for billions of years, in addition to the incomplete laws of the world, their states are very weak.”
“The divine skill must have been suppressed and become a quasi-divine skill.”
“It should only be equivalent to a Mythical Race at the overlord level…”
“Lord Lie Shan was even affected by the Wind Kirin’s luck skill.”
“If we really fight, their current strength might not necessarily be comparable to demigods.”
“Perhaps…”
This was crazy!
At this moment, Ye Xing, Divine Bell, and the others felt that Shi Yu was crazy.
Zou Yun, Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, and the others widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu, who was analyzing seriously, in disbelief.
What did this kid say? He… really wanted to defeat a god?
And using the current strength of the gods might not necessarily be better than demigods to prove the possibility of victory?
What a joke!!
“Hahahaha!!!”
At the same time, on the battlefield, the Dark Elven Prince, who was pulled up by the Ancient God Golden Bull first, was receiving a miserable beating.
The huge Ancient God Golden Bull turned into the form of a bullman. Its entire body was like burning metal water, and its muscles were ferocious.
Golden light wrapped around its body. As an invincible overlord, the super profundities of the Dark Elven Prince landed on the Golden Bull God that suppressed its strength at the monarch level, but it actually didn’t cause any damage at all.
However, on the contrary, the Golden Bull Ancient God only slapped out with a golden palm. The shockwaveproduced by the huge golden light instantly seemed to be spatial vibration, ravaging the dark elven prince’s body until it was riddled with holes, making its pupils turn white and its body broken. It directly smashed into the ground and created a huge pit!!
“How is it?”
“My Metal Control Divine Body.”
“This is even without activating the power of the natural order. Why did you fall before I even used any strength?”
“Ugh…” In the huge pit, the dark elven prince spat out blood crazily, shocked.
When this scene fell into the eyes of all the spectators, they could only have stunned expressions and doubt the authenticity of Ancient God Golden Bull’s words.
Suppressing strength to the monarch level?
Monarch level… Facing the big move of an invincible overlord, nothing happened. In fact, it could heavily injure an invincible overlord in one hit??
Plop.
At that moment, as the Dark Elven Prince was flattened by the Golden Bull Ancient God’s palm, the legendary human Beast Tamer in charge of strengthening the Dark Elven Prince not far away saw the gaze of the Golden Bull Ancient God and his expression immediately froze. He sat on the ground.
“No, don’t kill me…”
“So weak.” At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull exercised his fists and feet in boredom, very dissatisfied with the strength of the Dark Elven Prince.
At this moment, everyone finally understood why the Ancient God Golden Bull could still show a calm expression in the face of such a meteorite and self-destruction.
Monster-like strength…
Even if it was suppressed to the monarch level, it could still defeat invincible overlords.
“Golden Bull, you’re too much of a bully.” In midair, Lie Shanjun, Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the other gods couldn’t help but say.
“He even used the prototype skill of a divine skill.”
The Metal Control Divine Body was the prototype skill of the divine body skill mastered by the Golden Bull Ancient God.
It was similar to the nine-colored divine light of the Holy Divine Deer.
It could be said to be the strongest skill below the Golden Bull Ancient God Divine Skill.
It had an indestructible attribute and an invincible attack damage ability.
It could be said that it was the metal-element physique Skill closest to the metal law.
“Sorry, I don’t have the habit of using other skills. I’ve dedicated all my cultivation to this body of mine.” The Golden Bull Ancient God grinned and said, “That’s why I suppressed my level to the monarch level.”
“I’ve already taken good care of these little brats.”
“Next.” Ancient God Golden Bull laughed and looked in the direction of the Demon Kingdom, at the pale Fallen Angel.
“Kids, don’t be afraid.”
“If you can’t even defeat me in this state, how can you face the future crisis?”
“How about this? Be it a stronger state or a divine skill, as long as you can force one out of me, you win. Come on!”
In the face of Ancient God Golden Bull’s challenge, the invincible overlords of the totem factions took a step back with wary expressions. Get lost!! This was clearly bullying!!

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 981 The Strongest Pet
chapters.content:
981 The Strongest Pet
A moment later, the Fallen Angel Prince of the Demon Kingdom was called up by Ancient God Golden Bull.
The Fallen Angel Prince of the Demon Kingdom had previously been regarded by various countries as the strongest contestant of the totem country below the Green Dragon Crown Prince and the rubber tree totem.
With two souls in one body, the Fallen Angel Race, and the dark element, a series of advantages made it the closest to a Mythical race.
In fact, when the fallen angel Aldrich was just born, the Rongguang Kingdom issued a must-kill order to it because of the phenomenon caused by its birth.
!!
At this moment, after such a monster was pulled onto the battlefield by the Ancient God Golden Bull, it actually experienced the same inhumane torture as the Dark Elven Prince just now.
“Wah, ah, ah, ah, ah!!!”
In midair, the injured Fallen Angel Prince flew in the sky. Dark light balls that filled the sky fell like a meteor shower towards Ancient God Golden Bull.
Boom!!
In the huge smoke rising, Ancient God Golden Bull, who was currently in the form of a human, directly resisted the attack and arrived in front of the fallen angel with abnormal expressions.
“Little guy, didn’t you eat?”
“Impossible!”
“Incarnation, fusion!!” In the sky, the fallen angel Aldrich was shocked. He felt that the Golden Bull Ancient God that had been suppressed to the monarch level in front of him was even more terrifying than a totem-level opponent.
A huge threat was born in its heart, making it quickly activate its strongest Skill.
Soul incarnation.
In the next moment, a Fire Demon, a Frost Demon, a Thunder Demon, and the soul embodiments of the three demons directly appeared beside the fallen angel, Aldrich.
Then, it quickly became one with it.
Fusion evolution.
Boom!!!
The Fallen Angel Aldrich directly evolved from dark to dark, Exort, Quas, and Thunder. It spread its eight pairs of wings and turned into an eight-winged Fallen Angel. At this moment, the power of different Stats lingered on each pair of wings, looking especially strong.
Seeing the skill of the Fallen Angel Aldrich, many factions were shocked.
Even Ancient God Golden Bull revealed a surprised expression.
This was the soul incarnation that Shi Yu was thinking about and wanted to replicate for Chi Tong. At this moment, it was used by Aldrich. Its aura was instantly no different from the totem level. The race was completely only a layer of paper away from the Mythical Race.
It was extremely powerful.
However.
“The Skill is not bad, but you’re too weak.” Ancient God Golden Bull laughed. Under the shocked expression of the fallen angel that had completed its evolution, he slapped out with his palm.
As for the Fallen Angel, it quickly flapped its eight wings and collided with the destructive demon power!!
Boom!!!
In the next moment, everyone saw that in the dust mist in the sky, accompanied by spatial tearing fluctuations, two figures were sent flying by the huge aftermath of the Skill collision!!
One was from Ancient God Golden Bull, and the other was from the fallen angel.
Even Ancient God Golden Bull didn’t seem to be able to face the fallen angel’s attack so easily.
But soon, everyone realized that that didn’t seem to be the case.
The two figures that were forced back in midair, the Ancient God Golden Bull, crossed its arms and made a defensive posture. There were only small scratches on its body, and a smile was on its face.
With a boom, it landed on the ground, creating a huge pit. Its entire body still stood steadily on the ground.
As for the fallen angel opposite, it was completely tragic. Its body no longer looked human, and it directly turned into a shockwave. Just like the dark elven prince just now, it completely fainted in the huge pit.
“You’re a little stronger than that guy just now,” Ancient God Golden Bull continued to move his body and said.
“However, it’s still not enough. Why don’t all of you come up together?”
As the Fallen Angel also lost, like the members of the Dark Night Forest, on the Demon Kingdom’s side, even the Fallen Angel’s Demon King father was silent.
It didn’t expect the work he was so proud of to be so weak in front of a real god.
These demigods asked themselves. If they suppressed to the monarch level, even if they used quasi-divine skills, they might not necessarily be able to firmly suppress the fallen angel Aldrich.
Were real gods all so strange?
No one replied. Be it the contestants of the seven countries or the totem country, none of them replied when they saw the miserable state of the dark elven prince and the fallen angel.
Moreover, they were afraid that Ancient God Golden Bull would call out names next.
What a joke. Even with the strength of an invincible overlord, it couldn’t affect this monster. It was useless for them to go up.
Although the dark elven prince and the fallen angel didn’t look dead, they were still half dead.
No one wanted to carry out such a battle without any suspense.
This god was even more ridiculous than the previous gods!!
“Roar!! (This is real awesome!!)”
Of course, there were also people who were more excited from the standpoint of Ancient God Golden Bull.
In the Dong Huang area, the Ox-Headed Beastmaster beside Master Qu Jie and Miss Qu Ling was extremely excited.
If he had this strength, even if he suppressed his realm, would he have to be beaten by that Iron-eating Beast every time??
He patted its old friend excitedly. In the future, just like the West, let’s believe in this Ancient God Golden Bull.
“It’s indeed strong…”
Master Qu Jie couldn’t help but say.
However, he looked at Shi Yu in the distance and kept feeling that things weren’t that simple.
...
“I say, Brother Yu, do you still want to defeat it?” At this moment, Zou Yun and the others looked at the war god-like Ancient God Golden Bull with twitching expressions.
“It didn’t even use a divine skill, and it even suppressed its strength. It’s already like this…”
At that moment, Shi Yu was meditating and recuperating in the Dong Huang area. However, his Spirit had been paying attention to the battle from the beginning to the end.
Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes and said, “Isn’t it very normal? That fallen angel’s strength isn’t strong to begin with.”
How strong could it be if it was scared away by Buggy’s bit of dragon might?
The overlord level was still the overlord level.
Zou Yun and the others: ???
“No one?? Do you have to ask me to name names?” At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull was rather speechless. Seeing that no one came up to fight him even if he didn’t name names, he couldn’t help but feel helpless.
“Let me do it.”
At this moment, in the Dong Huang area, Shi Yu had the thought of finishing early and ending work early. He controlled his Crowd Control Psychic power to float.
Most importantly, in the Beast Taming Space, Eleven was already rolling on the ground and couldn’t hold back anymore.
...
Divine beast!!
It wanted to fight a divine beast!!
After adding points for so long, Eleven felt that perhaps this awesome god could allow it to fight to its heart’s content.
It, who had yet to appear, really couldn’t tolerate it for another second.
“Huh??” At this moment, as Shi Yu flew up and spoke to him, the Ancient God Golden Bull looked at him.
“How long has it been? Have you rested well?”
Shi Yu said, “Lord Divine Spirit, didn’t you also fight two rounds just now?”
“It’s a little unfair for me to rest again.”
“Huh??” Ancient God Golden Bull was stunned, but then he laughed and said, “Alright, you do it.”
“Send all your pets to fight me to your heart’s content!!!”
“If it’s you, I won’t suppress my strength later. If you can last five minutes in my hands, you can name whatever reward or inheritance you want. How about that!”
At this moment, as Shi Yu appeared, no matter which faction he came from, they looked at the human Beast Tamer who had landed in front of Ancient God Golden Bull.
“Sorry…” However, just as everyone thought that Shi Yu was going to agree to the bet with Ancient God Golden Bull, Shi Yu said,” Can I only send one pet to fight first? ”
“It has been looking forward to the battle for a long time, but unfortunately, it hasn’t encountered a suitable opponent.”
“If it loses, I’ll send other pets to fight together.”
“This is an agreement between a Beast Tamer and a pet.”
“Huh???” At this moment, Shi Yu’s words directly made everyone reveal incredulous expressions.
What was Shi Yu saying?
They wanted to only send… one pet to fight?
Was he crazy?
The other party was a divine beast.
The Boar God, Xuan Ming, Lie Shanjun, Holy Divine Deer, and many other gods completely didn’t expect that after Shi Yu stood out, he would first say that he had only sent one pet to fight the Ancient God Golden Bull.
At this moment, they gradually understood the difference between the Beast Tamers of the totem countries and the Beast Tamers of the seven countries.
The Beast Tamers of the seven countries had a huge advantage in the number of contracted pets.
Shi Yu could completely use such a number advantage to use those abnormal pets to last five minutes in the hands of the Ancient God Golden Bull.
In the end, Shi Yu planned to send one?
What was he thinking?
Was he planning to send that green dragon?
“Divine Source, what does he mean?” The legendaries of the seven countries looked at Divine Source Legendary.
“Haha.” Ancient God Golden Bull was stunned for a moment before saying indifferently, “Are you serious?”
“But forget it. In that case, you can send one.”
“I’ll continue to suppress my strength to fight you.”
“Is it that green dragon?”
“Come on!”
At this moment, a huge purple summoning array appeared in front of Shi Yu.
The purple summoning array was filled with black and white lightning arcs.
Seeing Shi Yu’s summoning array again, the various factions still had subtle feelings.
In their respective factions, the dying dark elven prince and the fallen angel looked at the battlefield with difficulty.
He couldn’t understand why a freak like Shi Yu was still a level-six Beast Tamer and wasn’t even a legend.
Was the title of world legend really going to be taken away by a level-six Beast Tamer who wasn’t even at the legendary level??
Of course, at this moment, everyone was more concerned about Shi Yu’s summoning array.
Lightning…
From the fluctuations, it didn’t look like the appearance of the green dragon at all.
Not a Green Dragon? Or a ginseng baby?
Who was it?
“Could it be…” Ji Mengzhu, Lin Xiuzhu, Lin Hongnian, the gem cat, Lu Qingyi, White Brook, and the other Dong Huang spectators looked in that direction.
On the purple summoning array, under the lingering lightning, a bear cub about a meter tall appeared.
It had black and white fur, and on its round face was a pair of big black circles and bright and shining eyes.
Its black furry ears, big and short tail, and slightly plump body made it look silly and cute. However, the gaze in its eyes that shone like lightning told everyone not to underestimate its strength.
“Wuu.” Eleven looked at Ancient God Golden Bull with battle spirit in its eyes.
Come on.
God!
“This is???” Ancient God Golden Bull completely didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually send a pet that had never appeared before!!
“Its initial race is the Iron-eating Beast.”
“It’s the first pet I contracted, my initial companion who has accompanied me until now.”
“It’s also the strongest battle power in my team at the moment.”
“Therefore, Lord Divine Spirit, there’s no need to suppress your strength.”
“It’s very strong.”

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 982 Full Power
chapters.content:
982 Full Power
Inatella was silent again.
Although it was only language, the words coming from Shi Yu’s mouth had an incomparable impact.
Iron-eating Beast.
Initial pet.
!!
The strongest battle power in the team.
Disbelief appeared on everyone’s faces.
“What did he say…”
The Black Dragon Juggernaut, the Tyrant Dragon King, the Genesis Tree God, and the other totems had incredulous expressions.
This black and white bear was his strongest battle power?!
What a joke!
What was that green dragon and ginseng baby?!!
“Iron-eating Beast, strongest battle power…?”
At this moment, even Ji Mengzhu and the others were a little incredulous.
At the moment the overlord-level Green Dragon that Yu had contracted above his level appeared, there was no doubt that the Green Dragon had already become Shi Yu’s representative pet.
After all, even Emperor Wu had once said that if the four holy beasts evolved, they would crush the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
But now…
In the face of a god, Shi Yu stood on the battlefield and sent out the strongest pet he mentioned, the Iron-eating Beast.
“Even stronger than that green dragon?”
Only Divine Source, President Lin, the Dragon Palace, and a few others who had seen the Chaos Panda understood the meaning of Shi Yu’s words!
They didn’t know which was stronger, the Chaos Panda or the Green Dragon. After all, they had never seen the two pets use their full strength, but Shi Yu definitely knew.
They couldn’t help but stare at the arena.
“I see. Overlord level!”
“Moreover, it’s very strong!”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, Ancient God Golden Bull was also shocked. It took a closer look at this bear cub and quickly discovered that it was extraordinary.
It actually contained power that was not inferior to that green dragon in its small body.
It was completely not weaker than the invincible overlord it had defeated just now.
Unbelievable.
“Overlord level again??”
“As a level-six Beast Tamer, Shi Yu contracted two overlords above his level??”
Upon hearing Ancient God Golden Bull’s words, the other spectators were also in disbelief.
Even the Beast Tamers of the totem countries weren’t so crazy.
This guy was indeed a monster.
This way, Shi Yu’s team’s puzzle was perfect.
Overlord-level, Iron-eating Beast, Green Dragon.
Monarch level, ginseng baby, sword spirit, Blue Sea Sprite, mechanical phantom beast!
A powerful configuration!
“But it’s not enough!!!”
“Its main Stats are also metal.”
“You guys… who are you looking down on!!!” Ancient God Golden Bull’s muscles increased exponentially, and his body reached nearly five meters. His body didn’t look huge, especially compared to the little Iron-eating Beast in front of him.
It looked at Eleven with a burning gaze and said, “If you want me to erupt with stronger power, it depends on whether you have the ability!!”
Boom!!!
It still suppressed its monarch-level strength. It stepped on the ground, and golden light appeared all over its body. It attacked Eleven in the form of the Metal Control Divine Body.
The ground shattered.
No one doubted the strength of the Ancient God Golden Bull in this state. After all, the dark elf and fallen angel were examples.
Its figure was about to descend in front of Eleven in an extremely oppressive manner.
The pupils of the dark elves and fallen angels who had just been beaten up constricted.
But…
“Wuu.”
In the blink of an eye, lightning seemed to shoot out of Eleven’s eyes.
Zizizizizizi!!!
At first, its hands were filled with a large amount of electricity. Then, the electricity flowed through its entire body as if it was being controlled!!
Rip!!
Surrounded by the black and white electric current, Eleven’s black and white hair shone. It looked fluffy, soft, and had a clear texture. One couldn’t help but want to pet it!
However, what was even more terrifying was its shocking power change in the state of the lightning armor!!
...
Bang!!!
Eleven’s feet stepped on the ground. Under the eruption of lightning, it immediately displayed a terrifying explosive power. Its figure flashed like lightning. During this process, countless gravel floated in the sky because of the lightning, as if they were dancing for the impact that was about to collide.
“Interesting!!!”
As Ancient God Golden Bull laughed, he threw a punch at Eleven. Similarly, Eleven also threw a punch at Ancient God Golden Bull.
The two attacks were about to collide.
But in the next moment, the two attacks fixed the attacker and the attacker in the air due to invisible energy fluctuations.
Because the energy fluctuations between the moves were too turbulent, before the bodies of the two parties collided, the powerful power fluctuations were the first to squeeze.
Boom!!!
The sky and ground trembled.
A huge vortex seemed to have appeared in the sky, and cracks spread crazily on the ground as if it had encountered an earthquake.
In midair, Ancient God Golden Bull’s fist that was surrounded by golden light and Eleven’s fist that was surrounded by lightning were still squeezing.
...
It stunned the surrounding audience.
It appeared.
A creature that could fight against Ancient God Golden Bull appeared!!
Although it was an overlord fighting a monarch, it was also commendable.
This Shi Yu was indeed a monster!!!
However, as a few seconds passed, everyone’s expressions changed like Ancient God Golden Bull’s.
Sensing the increasingly surging power in Eleven’s attack, Ancient God Golden Bull revealed a shocked expression.
The others also suddenly heard a huge thunderstorm that resounded through the island. Their pupils constricted as they saw the power fluctuations on Ancient God Golden Bull’s side shatter with a bang.
Right on the heels of that, the Little Iron-eating Beast’s fist that seemed to have swept through a thunderstorm suddenly swallowed the Ancient God Golden Bull like a tsunami!!
Boom!!!
Under the thunder, Ancient God Golden Bull’s body was directly smashed towards like a flying meteor!!
“Wuu!!!”
In midair, Eleven looked confused. It was very confused to see someone dare to challenge it while at a lower level.
Boom!!
It slowly landed on the ground and looked at the small mountain that had collapsed after it sent Ancient God Golden Bull flying. It stretched its body and looked over again.
A moment later, gravel fell to the ground one by one. Every landing sound hit the heart.
At this moment, everyone was stunned.
They completely didn’t expect that under the collision, Ancient God Golden Bull would actually be sent flying.
Although Ancient God Golden Bull had suppressed its level to a lower level, it was still a god.
It had already easily crushed the dark elf and fallen angel above its level. How could it be sent flying by this Iron-eating Beast!!
“Golden Bull, what are you doing!!”
Seeing this, Lord Lie Shan and the others looked at the collapsed mountain in disbelief.
“Didn’t listen to my advice…”
At this moment, as the two moves collided, Shi Yu only wanted to describe Ancient God Golden Bull like this.
Was it still treating Eleven as his opponent just now?
This move… was the Lightning Armor state entered by using transcendent-level superalloy, the power of Dark Lightning and Light Lightning. Although Eleven was only in the weakest restrained state, it was still at the overlord level!!
The two opponents just now didn’t have transcendent super Skills.
In addition, Eleven was also a Mythical Race with a strong foundation. Ancient God Golden Bull was actually still using the monarch level to resist. It was simply suicidal.
“Ah!!!!!”
Boom!!
The small mountain collapsed, and Ancient God Golden Bull, who came out, also looked at the creature opposite him in shock. It didn’t expect that the other party could actually defeat him.
This attack could be said to have stunned the dark elf, fallen angel, and the others. They didn’t expect that the Ancient God Golden Bull that was hanging them up was actually sent flying by Shi Yu’s pet.
“Looks like.”
“Looks like I underestimated you guys.”
At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull didn’t feel any Affliction. He was only very surprised that the other party actually had the power to repel him.
It couldn’t help but be even more excited.
“I see. No wonder you made me go all out. So your strength is so extraordinary.”
“Very good, very good, hahahaha.” Ancient God Golden Bull laughed. At the same time, its aura rose steadily.
Boom!!!
Under everyone’s gaze, it directly recovered to its initial state and didn’t plan to suppress its strength anymore!
An earth-shattering aura and a divine aura directly made the island tremble.
In the center of the terrifying energy vortex, Ancient God Golden Bull revealed its violent eyes.
“Don’t misunderstand.”
“I unsealed my power because I want you to send out all your pets as soon as possible.”
“It’s rare for you to have so many powerful battle pets. It’s still too boring to fight alone.”
“Perhaps, if I let you understand the real difference, you’ll understand.”
In order to prove its determination, Ancient God Golden Bull’s body increased further!!
Buzz!!
A dazzling golden light bloomed from its body.
Boom…
Under the golden light, accompanied by the roar of the Great Dao laws, countless spatial fragments flew out and exploded from the void. They lined up beside Ancient God Golden Bull and were extremely dazzling.
In the center of everything, the aura of the Ancient God Golden Bull had reached an extremely terrifying level. Although its body only increased to ten meters tall, the power erupting from its physique seemed to be able to crush the Void.
Click, click, click…
At this moment, the demigods in the alternate space looked at the collapsed spatial patterns around them in shock. They realized that not only had Ancient God Golden Bull unsealed his battle power, but he had also erupted with his divine skill!!
Because the laws of the world were incomplete, Blue Planet couldn’t withstand Ancient God Golden Bull’s divine skill at all. Therefore, the power it displayed at the moment could only be considered a quasi-divine skill. But even so, it caused a huge change in the entire Blue Planet space.
The Void collapsed, and the laws rumbled!!
A huge change was brewing, making the World Tree clone and many gods fall silent. They felt that this golden bull was so crazy for battle.
Didn’t it know that it would be even weaker after such a battle??
In the collapse of space, the entire island was changing quickly. The ground and mountain began to sink. The surrounding waves raised a tsunami, and lightning appeared in the sky. The center of all the changes was the huge Golden Bull Ancient God that had recovered its bull form and landed on all four feet.
Its furnace-like eyes looked at Shi Yu and Eleven. As Shi Yu and Eleven’s expressions changed, its divine might pressed down like a galaxy that covered the sky.
At this moment, forget about creatures below the totem level, even some weaker totems trembled when they saw the terrifying might emitted by the Ancient God Golden Bull and heard the deafening sound of laws.
“This is the real Metal Control Divine Body that has touched the laws of metal. It’s the strongest batch of Skills in this era!!” Seeing this, the gods sighed with emotion at the madness of the Golden Bull God.
Boom!!!
The terrifying divine might approached Eleven and Shi Yu. Everyone could sense how much pressure they were under.
“No…” The pupils of the dark elven prince and the others constricted. Even if they weren’t the ones fighting, a trace of psychological trauma appeared.
“It’s difficult to imagine how strong these gods were at the peak of the Mythical Era!”
Under the gazes of many people, the Boar God and the other gods looked at Shi Yu and the others.
“Just give in to this cow.”
It was still too difficult to rely on just one. It was better for everyone to attack together as soon as possible. Perhaps they could last a few minutes under the mentality of the Golden Bull Ancient God wanting entertainment.

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 983 God Slaying (1)
chapters.content:
983 God Slaying (1)
Metal law?
It finally erupted with all its might?
At the same time.
Shi Yu and Eleven took a deep breath.
Metal laws should be relatively powerful origin laws.
However, in terms of level, it should be below Yin Yang.
“Wuu!!!!!!”
At this moment, Eleven sensed the other party’s terrifying aura and became rather serious.
However, it was still extremely stubborn and unwilling to end up like this.
The other teammates had already taken down the trial alone. When it came to it, no matter who the opponent was, it also wanted to take down a trial for Shi Yu alone.
It wanted to prove to everyone that Shi Yu’s words that Eleven was Shi Yu’s strongest pet were right!
Even if the opponent was a god, it could.
“Eleven.”
At this moment, Shi Yu’s thoughts were the same as Eleven’s. He wanted to be in this posture and fight a god.
He also firmly believed that Eleven, who he had carefully cultivated, wouldn’t be weaker than a god of the same level.
“What are you still hesitating for!!!”
At this moment, the huge Ancient God Golden Bull revealed a dissatisfied expression.
Even so, were Shi Yu and the others still unwilling to send all their pets to fight him with all their might?
“You can’t please me by being so willful.”
“Don’t you want the reward anymore?” Its voice resounded throughout the world.
At this moment, under the suppression of Ancient God Golden Bull’s huge divine might, Shi Yu and Eleven’s tiny bodies seemed to be on the verge of collapse.
However, to the surprise of many gods, even so, they didn’t seem to be affected at all.
It was as if the pressure of a god was only so-so.
“Of course.”
“However.”
“We will use our own methods to win.”
“Not by pleasing others, even gods.”
In the divine might, Shi Yu’s voice entered everyone’s ears clearly.
Shi Yu, Eleven, had a determined expression.
Let’s give it a try.
It was just the law of metal suppressed by the world.
From the current performance, it was indeed because Ancient God Golden Bull had more experience and was more powerful than Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone.
However, there was still Shi Yu!
Beast Tamers and pets were a whole.
If he used the Taiji Domain and the Yin Yang Millstone to form a dual-divine skill, it might not be weaker than this Metal Control Divine Body.
They had a chance to heavily injure or even defeat Ancient God Golden Bull.
BOOM!
At that moment, Eleven’s overlord will completely erupted.
A valiant battle intent rose with will.
“Please don’t underestimate us.”
“Right now, it’s not our full strength.”
“Let’s fight like this.”
Shi Yu was also Infested by Eleven’s battle intent.
It was boring to please a god.
In a battle, the premise was to defeat the opponent.
Even if the opponent was a god, there had to be a mortal spirit who dared to face the might of a god. This was the domain that Beast Tamers pursued.
“What did you say???”
At this moment, facing Shi Yu’s victory declaration, Ancient God Golden Bull felt that it was unbelievable.
However, before it could react much, with a boom, under the light, a terrifying deterrence erupted from the little Iron-eating Beast.
It began to resist the divine pressure.
In the face of the Ancient God Golden Bull that erupted with all its might, Eleven directly withdrew from its weakest restrained form and erupted with sharpness!!
Invisible white flash flames bloomed from Eleven, who was covered in white light, like an erupting volcano.
“Roar!!!”
With this shocking roar, under thousands of gazes, Eleven’s form quickly changed.
...
“It’s Inner Power. Yes, just now, that was only the weakest form of the Iron-eating Beast!!!”
Ji Mengzhu and the other Beast Tamers of Dong Huang were originally immersed in Shi Yu’s shocked speech, but in the next moment, they shouted excitedly.
Boom!!
In the giant transformation, Eleven’s form was also changing.
It enlarged to the same height as the Ancient God Golden Bull.
As the light dissipated, its entire body was wrapped in hard black armor… The armor covering its face and head had already become the color of silver lightning.
Mysterious, domineering, honorable, and wild were the auras revealed by the Iron-eating Beast today.
Nine Li Battle Beast form!
Coupled with the black and white armor and the electric current flowing on the armor, it looked extremely ferocious, like an overlord that could suppress everything!!
Such a Shapeshift, together with the declaration just now, stunned the Golden Bull Ancient God.
In the next moment, its body rumbled and changed. It returned to its impressive tauren form and slowly flew in the sky.
...
Its expression revealed dissatisfaction.
“Is that all?!!!”
In the face of Eleven’s eruption, although Ancient God Golden Bull felt that the other party’s aura was indeed powerful, it wasn’t enough!!
Boom!!!
It slapped its palm at Eleven in the sky, and an incomparable golden Illuminate shook the sky and earth.
“Can it withstand 10% of my strength??”
Ancient God Golden Bull’s domineering voice resounded in the sky.
“No…”
“At the moment, it’s just gradually adapting to stronger power.”
Shi Yu stood behind Eleven and said extremely calmly. Eleven was also cultivating hard. With the help of Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit, Eleven had already mastered its many evolution forms and perfectly fused them, allowing it to change freely.
At this moment, the eruption was the process of it completely displaying all the power it contained without holding back in order to stimulate all its potential.
At the same time, it was also a witness to its growth.
“Iron-eating Beast, Nine Li Form.”
The Nine Li form gave Eleven endless possibilities that were different from the Iron-eating Beast. Dazzling runes shone on the Iron-eating Beast’s body in the huge armor, making its overall quality complete an unprecedented increase compared to its previous restrained form.

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 984 God Slaying (2)
chapters.content:
984 God Slaying (2)
This was not an ordinary Nine Li form, but a Nine Li form built on the restrained form of the Chaos Panda.
It was a new power developed by Shi Yu and the others.
Perhaps it was nothing in the eyes of the Ancient God Golden Bull, but it was the foundation of all Eleven’s power.
Boom!!
!!
Was that all? The Ancient God Golden Bull had just said those words. In the next moment, as an inscription shone with black light, a demonic power surged from Eleven’s huge body again.
With a boom, everyone seemed to see the birth of a Demon God.
Eleven’s form changed again.
The armor and body seemed to have fused into one. The color changed from clearly silver and black to a mixture of white and gradually black.
This color was like dark metal absorbing light, dazzling and mysterious.
A terrifying Demon God aura could be released.
Although he could still see the outline of the Iron-eating Beast’s figure clearly, there was already a tight layer of Demon God Armor on the outside. With Eleven as the center, the terrifying power of the Demon God erupted like a storm. In the silhouette, the power of Yun An from the Abyss Evil God Race seemed to be roaring at the world.
Bang!!!!
Eleven raised its arm.
The shockwave formed by Ancient God Golden Bull’s palm was directly obliterated by the sweeping power of the Demon God that filled the sky, disappearing without a trace.
“Demon God Iron-eating Beast!!!”
Seeing this, Ji Mengzhu flew up excitedly, as if she had returned to the extremely dazzling Emperor Wu Dynasty.
“A form mastered by the Devouring Abyss Race?!!”
“How did they do it?”
The gods saw through the truth of this form at a glance. However, they didn’t expect that the aura of the Iron-eating Beast that had already erupted with such power was still increasing!!
Ancient God Golden Bull’s expression changed.
In the next moment, the Demon God Armor directly collapsed. Under the collision of light, darkness, and lightning, it kept disintegrating into energy essence that fused into Eleven’s body.
In less than a few seconds, under the eruption of the sharpness, Eleven completed three consecutive Shapeshifts in an extremely dazzling manner.
As Eleven entered the Chaos Explosion form, its power could be said to have been completely stimulated.
“Roar!!!!!”
At this moment, the black and white electric arcs that filled the sky seemed to have become Eleven’s hair. They kept floating like a chaotic ocean.
Eleven was like a Behemoth walking out of the chaos lightning sea, like the first Chaos Thunder God after the creation of the world.
At this moment, a god-like aura also erupted from Eleven’s body, shaking the sky and earth. The vast universe swept through the entire sea area.
This power was almost crushing for overlords, even for invincible overlords.
Even the totem half-gods and the various gods were very moved.
“Is this power enough??” Shi Yu asked.
His words resounded throughout the world, shocking Ancient God Golden Bull.
However…
It laughed out loud and said, “Not enough!!”
“If you want to defeat me, this level isn’t enough!!”
“However, it should be enough to please me.”
“Try attacking me. Come on, Human!!”
“Let’s see if your strength can make me take another step back!”
Boom!!!
A heavy sound of laws bloomed on Ancient God Golden Bull.
However, in the next moment, its expression changed.
“Then we’ll become stronger,” Shi Yu said.
BOOM!
As Shi Yu activated his mind domain, the air around him began to hum and vibrate.
The substantialized mental fluctuations formed black and white clueless fluctuations around him.
With his entire body wrapped in black and white energy, Shi Yu’s eyes quickly changed, directly turning into a spinning Taiji Painting. A vast and deep power bloomed from Shi Yu’s body!!
Buzz!
The sound of laws spread.
Ancient God Golden Bull revealed an incredulous expression.
Countless creatures opened their mouths wide.
They didn’t understand why the sound of laws would appear on a human.
As Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun, a strong force field bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
In an instant, a huge spinning Taiji Painting appeared in the sky and ground.
The entire world became black and white.
On the horizon, there was even a star that was identical to the patterns in Shi Yu’s eyes. In this domain, it replaced the sun and moon.
...
It was also a black and white circular star. It was like the manifestation of Shi Yu’s Eye of the Heart. It hung on the horizon of the domain and watched everything.
Under its gaze, the Taiji Painting spinning in the sky and ground became more and more blurry. The pattern seemed to have turned into two Yin Yang fish that appeared in motion and slowly swam around Eleven.
At the same time, as if the planet was trembling, an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared on Eleven’s body. The entire island felt a huge pressure.
The consecutive changes could be said to have shocked everyone.
At this moment, Eleven seemed to have fallen into the chaos lightning and couldn’t be seen clearly.
The Yin Yang Fish swam into its hand. On its palm, a circular metal formed. The metal was black and white, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.
The two voices of laws fused, instantly producing an even stronger world vibration, making the expressions of the World Tree clone, Boar God, Xuan Ming, and all the other gods change drastically.
“How is this possible!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 985 God Slaying (3)
chapters.content:
985 God Slaying (3)
At that moment, when they saw the power condensed in Eleven’s hand, the gods led by Ancient God Golden Bull were stunned.
At this moment, the vast aura spreading from Eleven’s body actually gave them a feeling that it wasn’t much inferior to a True God. This unbelievable scene kept attacking everyone’s understanding.
“What about this power?”
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Ancient God Golden Bull was already speechless.
!!
“Metal Control Divine Body!!!”
At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull could no longer remain calm.
What happened?
It couldn’t withstand this power!!!
If it were at its peak, although this law power was extremely high-level, it could completely ignore it with the advantage of level.
However, in this era where the power of divine skills was suppressed, everyone’s divine skills were all on the same level. It was a competition of the quality of divine skills.
It felt that its strength was completely suppressed by it. How was this possible!!
Ancient God Golden Bull’s pupils constricted, revealing a shocked expression!!!
At this moment, it actually felt his divine body being suppressed by this power of laws!!
Wait, wait!! Something was wrong!!!
It suddenly couldn’t react.
In an instant, it suddenly suspected that the person opposite it was a supreme god that had suppressed its realm and was fighting it, not a creature from an era with incomplete laws.
“Are you… monsters?!!!” It suddenly roared.
…
Below.
Everyone could clearly see that the originally calm and invincible Ancient God Golden Bull suddenly revealed a shocked expression.
Are you monsters?
Everyone trembled when they heard Ancient God Golden Bull’s roar.
Although they didn’t understand what had happened, they could confirm that the Iron-eating Beast that had undergone three consecutive Shapeshifts was also like a monster in the eyes of the Golden Bull Ancient God.
“Eleven, Yin Yang Millstone!”
At this moment, seeing Ancient God Golden Bull activate a quasi-divine skill, Shi Yu’s command was also issued.
The power of laws appeared in Eleven’s palm. Then, a stream of air surged, and the Yin Yang Millstone completely formed. Right on the heels of that, under the enlargement, it became larger and larger, as if a millstone enveloped the entire sky and smashed towards the Ancient God Golden Bull.
Buzz!!
Endless laws of metal flowed throughout Ancient God Golden Bull’s body, transforming the nature of metal in an attempt to crack this attack.
But…
Under the pupils of the Ancient God Golden Bull, it felt that its Metal Divine Body seemed incomparably small under this millstone.
Boom!!!
In order to block this attack, Ancient God Golden Bull’s body enlarged.
Endless golden light and the sound of laws spread from its body.
However, the Yin Yang Millstone crossed the Void and kept reversing and spinning, making it feel that its divine body was like a bean on the millstone, instantly broken.
“Stop for a second!!!” At this moment, Ancient God Golden Bull suddenly realized that this trial had already exceeded his tolerance range.
An attack of the Destruction Law.
An attack that heavily injured the divine body.
A large mouthful of golden blood spewed out of Ancient God Golden Bull’s mouth, dyeing the sky golden.
The bones on its body instantly shattered.
“Roar!!!” The huge Affliction made Ancient God Golden Bull let out a world-shaking scream.
A crazy gaze flowed in Ancient God Golden Bull’s eyes.
That human wasn’t bragging.
It really wanted to defeat it.
What a joke!!!
How could a future human Beast Tamer do this?
The shocking scream made Inatella fall silent.
Everyone present revealed incredulous expressions.
Everyone was stunned.
Ancient God Golden Bull’s miserable appearance completely made people lose their ability to think.
“Aba, Aba, Aba, Aba…” Under the stunned expression of the Ox-Headed Beastmaster beside Master Qu Jie, it seemed to have recalled the fear of being dominated by the Iron-eating Beast.
Impossible!!
Why could this Iron-eating Beast even suppress the bull god!!!
The destructive power of the Yin Yang Millstone directly suppressed Ancient God Golden Bull deeper into the ground.
An earthquake-like sound resounded through the entire island.
...
Wave after wave of shockwave wreaked havoc in the sky and earth.
Everyone was only stunned for a moment before discovering that the invincible Ancient God Golden Bull had been directly beaten into a deep pit more than a hundred meters deep.
Just now, Ancient God Golden Bull, who was still extremely disdainful of Shi Yu and the others, directly fell silent.
In midair.
The World Tree clone and many gods had shocked expressions. They sensed the weak aura of the Ancient God Golden Bull, and their eyes were filled with disbelief.
“The golden bull…”
“It fainted??”
An extremely ridiculous scene made the brains of the gods go blank.
They looked at Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast in extreme shock.
“That’s… a top-notch law divine skill…”
“How can they master it…”
...
On the battlefield, Eleven gradually returned to its initial restrained form.
The huge Yin Yang Taiji Domain also disappeared from Shi Yu’s body.
An extremely weak feeling appeared on Shi Yu and Eleven.
However, their gazes still looked in the direction where Ancient God Golden Bull fell.
They wanted to know how much damage this attack had caused to Ancient God Golden Bull.
If the other party still wanted to continue fighting, they could only send all their members to attack together.
However, as they waited, Shi Yu and Eleven never saw Ancient God Golden Bull fly up again.
Until Ancient God Golden Bull’s huge body was pulled up by the Psychic power of the World Tree clone.
Countless people looked at the body with closed eyes and bleeding all over. They opened their mouths wide.
Ancient God Golden Bull fainted???
What a joke!!!
That was a god from the Mythical Era!!!
…
“It, it, it, Teacher, what’s this!!!”
In the Dong Huang audience area, Lin Xiuzhu looked at everything in a daze and asked Ji Mengzhu.
She still knew about the Nine Li Battle Beast and the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
However, the Chaos Iron-eating Beast that was twined in light and darkness and filled with a chaotic lightning sea had already exceeded her understanding range.
“I…” However, even the chief trainer of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast didn’t understand what kind of evolution Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast had experienced at this moment.
As Ji Mengzhu stammered, Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu understood that an extremely unbelievable thing had happened to Shi Yu and Eleven again.
“Teacher, if I say that that Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, was still a little guy who couldn’t even awaken hardening in the breeding base a few years ago, would you believe me?”
Monster…
At this moment, many spectators finally understood why the expression of the originally calm Ancient God Golden Bull suddenly changed drastically and crazily called them monsters.
From the Normal audience to the Legendary demigods, at this moment, when they saw this scene, they were all crazy.
“You, you, it, what exactly is going on!!!” At this moment, the Boar God, Xuan Ming, Demon King Dragon, and the other gods asked Shi Yu in shock.
They never expected that Shi Yu didn’t manage to last five minutes in the hands of Ancient God Golden Bull, but… directly heavily injured Ancient God Golden Bull in one hit.
Moreover, he only used one pet.
The domain that resounded with the sound of laws and the terrifying millstone shocked even the gods present when they recalled it again.
They only wanted to help Ancient God Golden Bull understand what kind of monster the human in front of them was.
At the same time, they asked themselves if they could withstand that attack in their current state if they stood in the position of Ancient God Golden Bull.
“Wuuu!!!” At this moment, although Eleven, who had beaten a god in one hit, was weak, it cheered especially happily.
Its round face was filled with excitement.
Everyone, especially the Black Dragon Juggernaut and the Tyrant Dragon King, had frightened expressions.
When Shi Yu said that this guy was the strongest trump card in his team, no one originally felt anything.
But at this moment, they all knew the content of this sentence.
“Looks like we won.” Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief under Eleven’s cheers.
So close. It looked like these gods were completely strong on the outside but weak on the inside. They had yet to completely recover. If they were stronger, they would probably have to force out the six pet fusion mecha.
It looked like this trump card could be left to future enemies.
He won?
At this moment, when they heard Shi Yu’s words, the gods felt that it was extremely ridiculous. They completely didn’t expect that Shi Yu, who had taken their trial, was such a pervert, monster, and freak. Did he… know what he had done!!

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 986 Fast-forward to the Next Session (1)
chapters.content:
986 Fast-forward to the Next Session (1)
Inatella.
At this moment.
Everyone present suspected that Shi Yu was not human.
That unbelievable Taiji Domain that touched the sound of laws.
Was it really a Beast Taming Talent derived from telepathy?
Was he sure that he wasn’t a divine beast in human skin?
In addition, the millstone in the Iron-eating Beast’s hand that obliterated the Void and laws was a little stunned.
“Can that also be considered a mind domain?”
The Holy Divine Deer, which had tested the talent of various Beast Tamers previously, had an extremely incredulous expression.
A skill that triggered the sound of laws. If this wasn’t a divine skill, what was?
The World Tree clone originally thought that Shi Yu’s development of his mind domain was thanks to its World Tree Fruit.
But from the looks of it, that wasn’t the case at all!
This black and white domain simply crushed that World Tree domain.
Many gods present had only mastered one divine skill.
Combination divine skills were exclusive to powerful gods who cultivated two divine skills.
And if a god could combine two divine skills, it would be even rarer.
If Beast Tamers and pets were considered a whole, then Shi Yu and that pet’s behavior just now had completely crushed these gods in terms of skill.
After all, many gods present had only mastered one divine skill.
Moreover, what they sensed just now was definitely not wrong.
Be it the laws mastered by Shi Yu or that creature, they were both extremely top-notch power of laws.
For other powers, even low-level power of laws had a strong restraining effect.
Many gods and even the World Tree clones really didn’t understand why there were creatures who could cultivate such a Skill in this era with incomplete laws.
“Well.”
At this moment, Shi Yu was a little silent. He suddenly noticed that Ancient God Golden Bull had yet to wake up and couldn’t help but feel a little guilty.
It shouldn’t be a big problem.
This was the first time he had assisted Eleven in using the Yin Yang Millstone after eating the World Tree Fruit and strengthening the Taiji Domain a second time.
Although he had already expected that the power of this combination divine skill was not inferior to the law divine skills mastered by these weak gods, Shi Yu still didn’t expect Ancient God Golden Bull to be smashed so badly in an instant.
“Little brat, what did you do?” At this moment, Lord Lie Shan couldn’t help but say again.
“If you knock it out, who’s going to give you a reward?”
Shi Yu: “…?”
So this was the main point?
“Don’t awaken Ancient God Golden Bull first. It’s already in an Enfeeble state. Just now, it suffered the injury of laws. After healing and awakening, its state will also be very painful.”
“Let Ancient God Golden Bull directly enter the Mythical Ruins to sleep for a period of time. When it wakes up, we’ll discuss what happens after…” The World Tree clone said after a moment of silence.
It was mainly because it was afraid that after Ancient God Golden Bull woke up, it would fight Shi Yu again unconvinced. In the current state of waking up the gods, it was not suitable to use divine skills to fight at all. It couldn’t watch Ancient God Golden Bull do stupid things for nothing.
How aggrieved would it be if a god died in the overlord battle!
“Alright.” At this moment, when he heard that Ancient God Golden Bull was fine, Shi Yu nodded. It was good that he was fine.
As for the reward, it was fine even if it was a day or two later. In any case, Ancient God Golden Bull couldn’t run away.
A god couldn’t go back on his word, right?
At that moment, everyone was completely certain that Shi Yu had defeated a god alone. They couldn’t help but be shocked.
“By the way.”
Especially when Shi Yu, who looked quite weak at this moment, suddenly looked around.
As soon as he finished speaking, the members of the various countries swallowed their saliva again. The island fell silent.
“The trial is over. Isn’t it time for the main competition? I’m a little tired now. Why don’t we end the main competition quickly? After it’s over, I’ll go rest together.”
“During the preliminaries, I said that I would become a new world legend.”
“So now, whoever isn’t convinced, let’s attack together.” Shi Yu grinned and looked at the hundreds of contestants around him.
BOOM!
Upon hearing that, the pupils of the fallen angel, the dark elf, and the others constricted, and their hearts trembled.
This monster… first smashed the Green Dragon Totem to death, then blew up the rubber tree totem. Now that he had even defeated a god, and he was actually asking who else was willing to fight him?
The main competition?
At the thought of the main competition without many restrictions and having to face Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast, Green Dragon, Revival Self-Explosion Ginseng, Blue Sea Sprite, Sword Spirit, and mechanical phantom beast in one go, many contestants couldn’t breathe.
Not to mention all of them attacking together, even if they only faced one alone, at this moment, no contestant was confident.
Generally speaking, there was tactical cooperation between the many pets of the Beast Tamers of the seven countries.
When combined, it could display stronger battle power.
As for Shi Yu’s individual pets, they were already so ridiculous. Everyone really couldn’t imagine what they would look like when combined.
...
Not to mention contestants, even the totem that had long become famous was extremely afraid of Shi Yu.
For example, the Tyrant Dragon King.
At this moment, as a top-notch totem, it even began to wonder if it was confident of retreating unscathed if it dealt with Shi Yu alone.
Was this still a level-six Beast Tamer? He was more like a Legendary Beast Tamer!
“Hahahaha…”
At that moment, under the gazes of the Legendarys of the other six countries who couldn’t understand why such a monstrous Beast Tamer appeared in Dong Huang, Divine Source Legendary couldn’t help but laugh.
Who else was there!
With Shi Yu’s current strength, who could stop him from becoming a world legend and accepting the blessings of the World Tree!
No one!
Be it the seven countries or the totem country, no matter who it was, none of them dared to stand out in the face of Shi Yu’s challenge.
At this moment, Divine Source Legendary was even excited. He wanted to celebrate with everyone when he returned to the country.
...
The entire country would be exempted from taxes for a year!
Believe in the Green Dragon, tax exemption, paid leave!
Shi Yu could definitely become stronger.
This scene also stunned Yin Zhengfan, Gao Xuan, White Brook, and the others. They recalled the National League. The main competition had yet to begin, but the National League had already ended.
In the end, it was the same for the World Tournament? Before the main competition even began, Shi Yu had already displayed invincible strength, making all the contestants give up resisting and surrender.
However, wasn’t it just a year since the National League of University Students? How did Shi Yu grow from a national student champion to a terrifying existence that could crush gods?
This growth speed completely made Gao Xuan and the other Beast Tamers who still had the thought of surpassing Shi Yu completely unable to have any feelings of pursuit.
The difference was too great.
Even when they heard the story of the evolution Legendary Lin Feng, they didn’t think it was so ridiculous.
Was this the so-called monster born in the golden era before the Mythical Revival?
“The World Tournament is…” At this moment, the World Tree clone actually had plans long ago.
It had long felt that there was no contestant who could compete with Shi Yu in this world competition before the few trials.
In that case, there was no need to continue competing. There was only one winner in the world competition anyway.
“If there’s no one, the world competition will end here.”
“Dong Huang’s Shi Yu will receive the blessings of the World Tree and become a new world legend.”
Although it was very strange to call a level-six Beast Tamer a Titled Legend, the truth was right in front of them. Even the World Tree clone didn’t know what to say.
“Damn it!” At this moment, in the face of the World Tree clone, the contestants of the totem country and the seven countries were extremely aggrieved. They finally felt the feelings of the ordinary Beast Tamers who had once been suppressed by their light.
This was the irresistible unwillingness to compete with stronger and more monstrous monsters.
“However.”
At this moment, although the promotion had been completed, the World Tree clone said, “However, due to the special situation, I’ll hold another world competition soon.”
“It might be a year, or two, or three. It will be in seven years.”
The World Tree clone said.
In order to welcome the next new era, it planned to hold another world competition.
He hoped that at that time, another Beast Tamer like Shi Yu would appear.
A Beast Tamer with potential comparable to a peak-level divine-level.
Although the interval between the world competitions was not long, according to its understanding, Shi Yu’s growth was only a few years.
So maybe…
Another monster could appear!
“At that time, I’ll also give you my blessings.”
It was mainly because sending a blessing required a lot of its strength. In the short term, it could only be given to one person.
“The rules remain.”
“Beast Tamers under the age of 30 can participate.”
At this moment, when they heard from the World Tree that a world competition would appear soon, young Beast Tamers like Gao Xuan were delighted. Even children like Yin Zhengfan suddenly felt their blood boil.
“In addition, even if you meet the conditions to participate, as long as you obtain the Blessing of the World Tree once, you can’t participate anymore.”
In the end, the World Tree didn’t forget to ban Shi Yu from competing. It was so close. It almost forgot that this guy was still young. Even after seven years, he was still under 30.
He had to be banned.
Shi Yu: …?

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 987 Blessing of the World Tree
chapters.content:
987 Blessing of the World Tree
The World Tournament had ended. No one from the various factions expected the World Tournament to end just like that. The only good news they heard might be that there would be another World Tournament next, and that bastard Shi Yu had been banned from the competition.
Fortunately, although the process of this world competition was extremely ridiculous, most factions didn’t suffer any losses.
Not only did they obtain the information of the Mythical Revival, but many contestants from the factions also obtained the rewards of the World Tree in the preliminaries.
Only the contestants from the large factions who wanted to compete with Shi Yu for the inheritance had a very miserable outcome.
“My son…”
At this moment, the Tyrant Dragon King was still immersed in grief.
“Although that little brat Shi Yu’s strength is extraordinary and he has the Blessing of the World Tree and the protection of a demigod Legendary, if I can’t avenge you, how can I still be your father?”
“But…”
“Why did you lose to that Shi Yu? You’re simply letting down your father’s nurturing. I’m ashamed to have a son like you. It’s fine not to have such a useless son. A few years is enough. I can definitely nurture a more perfect heir.”
“In the next world competition, we must make Dong Huang pay a heavy price!”
The most important thing now was to break through to demigod as soon as possible!
…
“Is it over?”
“Can we continue sleeping?”
At this moment, when the Boar God, Xuan Ming, and the other gods saw that the trial had all ended and the World Tournament had completely ended, they, who had completed their respective missions, finally felt weak and tired.
After Ancient God Golden Bull slept, they were also going to sleep.
“Yes, it’s over.”
“Everyone, you can leave on your own.”
“If there’s anything else, I’ll inform you again,” the World Tree clone said.
At the same time, it looked at Shi Yu and couldn’t wait anymore. “Champion, next, follow me to see the main body.”
“Alright,” Shi Yu said in joy.
The blessings of the World Tree and the key to activating the skill fusion were finally here.
“Please wait a moment.”
However, at this moment, Shi Yu spoke at the last minute.
With the help of Buggy in the Beast Taming Space, he teleported behind the fallen angel of the Demon Kingdom.
At this moment, the Fallen Angel, who was still recovering from its serious injuries, didn’t expect Shi Yu to suddenly teleport behind it. As Shi Yu’s palm landed on its shoulder, the Fallen Angel’s expression immediately changed, and it dodged crazily as if it was facing a great enemy.
After all, this was a ruthless person who had killed two totems and a god.
The fallen angel even suspected that even if it broke through to the totem level, it wouldn’t be Shi Yu’s match.
“What are you doing!”
He was shocked.
Skill: Soul Incarnation
[Copy successful]
Shi Yu didn’t expect the fallen angel to have such a big reaction. He said in embarrassment, “I obtained a cub of a demon race from the Mythical Era in Lord Lie Shanjun’s inheritance.”
“I plan to visit the Demon Kingdom in the future. I don’t think you won’t welcome me, right?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“!!!” The Fallen Angel’s heart trembled and it had already lost the ability to speak.
He didn’t know how to reply to Shi Yu.
He subconsciously imagined countless scenes of meteors descending to the Demon Nation and countless ginseng babies self-destructing in the Demon Nation.
There was also the scene of that Iron-eating Beast sending him flying with a slap.
There was even a scene of countless succubi and beautiful fallen angels being snatched away by Shi Yu in the Demon Kingdom.
Who exactly was the demon?
“Agree to it.”
However, the Demon King of the Demon Nation, who was hiding in the Void, said after a moment of silence.
Shi Yu…
Although their camps were different, thinking about it carefully, there had never been any large-scale conflict between the Demon Kingdom and Dong Huang. In addition, Shi Yu had obtained the cub of the Demon God Race. This Demon King also wanted to see what Shi Yu wanted to do in the Demon Kingdom.
The myth was about to revive.
The world structure was about to be rewritten.
The enemy was about to invade.
At this moment, having another friend was better than having another enemy.
No matter how one looked at it, this Shi Yu looked like the legendary son of fate.
“Sure.” As the Fallen Angel Prince’s heart exploded, Shi Yu left without any reluctance.
Only a fool would go now that he had obtained the Skill.
What was so fun about the Demon Nation?
…
After touching the most important skill for Chi Tong’s evolution skill, Shi Yu felt that it was perfect. In his opinion, this skill was even more important than the Golden Bull God’s Metal Control Divine Body.
...
After all, it was too difficult to teach a divine skill after touching it. It was better to see what changes the skill fusion could bring to the skill pool of his team later. Perhaps he could also fuse a physique skill that contained the law of metal. In that case, there was no need to learn from others.
In comparison, evolution skills were what Shi Yu lacked the most at the moment.
“Go.”
At this moment, Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and the others looked at Shi Yu with extreme joy.
Finally, after two years, another world legend appeared in Dong Huang.
Moreover, this world legend was even more valuable than the previous two batches, no, even more so than the evolution Legendary Lin Feng.
A level-six Beast Tamer had obtained the title of world legend!
Different factions looked at Shi Yu in completely different moods. However, even those factions who were very unwilling to see Shi Yu accept the blessings of the World Tree didn’t dare to say anything at this moment.
After all, as the strongest demigod, the clone of the planet’s Resistance, the World Tree knew many gods. It was far from what these demigods could do to change their minds.
“Let’s go, let’s go.”
In the next moment, the Boar God and the other gods entered their Mythical Ruins and fell asleep again. As for the World Tree clone, it also tore open a mystic realm and invited Shi Yu to enter with it.
...
Shi Yu glanced at the outside world and took a deep breath before entering.
He understood that after leaving, if he came out again, he would reach the top of Blue Planet.
…
World Tree Mystic Realm.
It was green.
The mystic realm was not big, but in the center, there was a huge tree that reached the sky.
It was connected to the ground and contained an ancient and heavy aura. This strongest demigod in the future that had existed since ancient times displayed holy light under the golden afterglow in the sky.
Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, and the World Tree clone that had returned to its worm form entered with Shi Yu.
After entering the World Tree mystic realm, the World Tree’s clone began to turn into light spots that filled the sky and fused into the World Tree.
At the same time.
A gentle voice with surprise and joy that could encompass everything came from the World Tree and appeared in Shi Yu’s Spirit and mind world.
“Congratulations.”
“Champion.”
“As an archeologist who has traced many history of the Mythical Era, I believe you have more questions than others.”
“Before I bless you, I can answer some questions I know.”
Shi Yu listened to the World Tree quietly. Standing in the mystic realm, he and Eleven looked up at the World Tree.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and asked the question he was most concerned about.
“Lord World Tree.”
“I heard that humans aren’t native creatures of this world…”
World Tree: !!!
“Who told you that? Is this also your archeological discovery?” The World Tree was even more surprised.
Shi Yu had an innocent expression and said, “No, it was Lord Lie Shan. It said it.”
The World Tree fell silent.
It had indeed told the seven revived gods about this, but it didn’t expect Lord Lie Shan to tell them after spending a while alone with Shi Yu.
“Yes, but not exactly.”
“To be precise, it’s the most primitive batch of humans, not native life forms of Blue Planet. They were brought back by a god who left Blue Planet.”
“But the humans who have the Beast Taming Space now are new races created and reproduced according to these humans as templates. They are undoubtedly lives born on Blue Planet.”
“Your mother planet is still Blue Planet.”
“But in the depths of the starry sky, there might be other humans in other worlds.”
Shi Yu was slightly surprised.
“A god who left Blue Planet?”
“That’s right. After the Mythical Era ended, many powerful gods chose to leave Blue Planet.”
“At that time, Blue Planet still needed a long time to recover and couldn’t withstand their existence. Even if they slept, they also hoped to find a new path and explore higher domains above the divine level.”
“Among them, the arrival of humans originated from the agreement between a supreme god spirit and the Blue Planet’s Resistance. I’m not sure about more content. We might only know when the Blue Planet’s Resistance completely awakens,” the World Tree said.
“You don’t know either?”
“No.”
“I can only be considered a clone of the Blue Planet’s Will. The real Blue Planet’s Resistance is ranked at the peak of the Divine Realm like the Ancestral Dragon, the Origin Phoenix, and the other supreme gods.”
“The division of the Divine Realm… Do you know?”
“The entire divine level is divided into four realms. Among them, the supreme gods of the second, third, and peak fourth realms have already left Blue Planet. Even if they sleep, the power of Blue Planet is not enough to support their habitat.”
“Perhaps they will only return one by one when the Mythical stage completely revives.”
Shi Yu was even more shocked. “Ancestral Dragon, Yuan Feng, are they still alive?”
The World Tree said, “I don’t know.”
Shi Yu: …
Sister, why did it not know anything?
“Perhaps you’ll know after you become a divine-level,” the World Tree said. “Inatella Island has a ruin that comes from the god who brought humans.”
“It once left instructions that the first human Beast Tamer to enter the divine level can enter and understand more truth.”
“At that time, this person will head to the new world it’s in.”
“Therefore, if you want to know, reach the divine level as soon as possible. At that time, you can also tell me.”
“As the person blessed by the world closest to Mythical Revival, you might be the human with the potential closest to the God Realm.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Divine level…” Shi Yu said,” Can I know the name of that god? ”
“Sure.”
“It’s called Wa God.”
Shi Yu was shocked. Before he could think too much, the World Tree continued,
“After using the power of the world to bless you, you can definitely become a legendary Beast Tamer in seven years. When there are no shackles of the world’s laws, you can break through to the divine level when the conditions are right.”
“After all, you have two pets of Mythical Races and the Son of the Stars.”
“However…” The World Tree suddenly fell silent.
“I suddenly feel that seven years is too long for you. It will waste your talent.”
“Human, do you want to receive stronger blessings?”
“I can strengthen the World Tree Blessing and add a new effect to the original foundation.”
“Letting you have the second Beast Taming Space means that at the same level, the number of creatures you can contract will be twice that of ordinary Beast Tamers.”
“However, you need to open up this second Beast Taming Space from scratch. Similarly, after giving you a new Beast Taming Space, I hope you can nurture more pets similar to it.”
The World Tree’s gaze landed on Eleven.
This was not easy for it either. In the face of the previous world legends, it didn’t even mention it, but for Shi Yu, who had cultivated Eleven and the Green Dragon, the World Tree suddenly felt that it wasn’t necessarily a bad thing to let Shi Yu contract more pets.
He was different from other Beast Tamers. There wouldn’t be a situation where his cultivation wasn’t good.
The battle power of the six pets was evidence.
“What?”
At this moment, Shi Yu, who originally felt that the greatest effect of the World Tree Blessing was to activate the skill fusion, was suddenly stunned.
World Tree Blessing plus edition?
The second Beast Taming Space?
Talent like Yin Zhengfan?
In other words, when he reached the divine level, he could at most have 20 contract slots? There was such a good thing?

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 988 Breaking Through to Legendary
chapters.content:
988 Breaking Through to Legendary
The blessings of the World Tree had many Effects.
What Shi Yu often heard was that it could increase the comprehension of the pet contracted by the target of the blessing and increase the learning ability of the pet. In other words, if a Beast Tamer blessed by the World Tree trained a low-level Skill, the pet might become expert in a day. Two days would make it perfect, and a month would be Dao Proficiency.
Of course, this wasn’t that useful to Shi Yu. And it wasn’t that useless.
After all, the upper limit of non-racial Skills was still at transcendent and couldn’t be broken through. If he wanted to train it to a higher level in the future, he had to rely on the pet to develop it itself.
At this moment, if the pet’s learning ability was stronger, it would be very useful.
