Apart from that, the Blessing of the World Tree was equivalent to a meditation accelerator. It could allow Beast Tamers to reach the legendary level very quickly.
When Lin Feng participated in the World Tournament, he was only a Normal Legend, but after becoming the champion, he only used two years to break through two levels and enter the Legendary domain.
This was still a little useful for Shi Yu. After all, he didn’t like to meditate, but the level of the contracted pet was limited by the level of the Beast Tamer. If he could reach the maximum level quickly, he would be very happy.
At the same time, the Blessing of the World Tree could also make it easier for the contracted pet of the target to break through the racial restrictions and complete the evolution. In addition, it could increase the various abilities of the Beast Tamer. The various effects covered all aspects.
These Effects could be said to be pretty good, but for him, it was completely incomparable to having ten more contract slots!
An additional contract slot might not be useful to ordinary Beast Tamers. For example, Yin Zhengfan’s father, as a normal legend, really didn’t have that many resources and opportunities to nurture so many pets.
However, for the current rich Shi Yu, he could completely afford to pay more resources to nurture pets.
What did the more pets he contracted mean?
It meant that the more attributes the pet could give to himself.
After a Beast Tamer was strong, the effect of the Beast Taming Talent would be stronger.
Perhaps there wouldn’t be any huge changes in ordinary talent, but it was different in the Skill Index.
Thinking about it carefully, after the attribute feedback of the 20 pets, the side effects of adding points might decrease to a negligible level.
Although he might have to add points to more pets at that time, if he could easily complete the additional points for super and even divine-level skills, Shi Yu expressed that it was completely no problem.
Initially, he was still worried if his future physique could withstand the additional points of the divine skill, but if there was another pile of feedback from contracted pets, he felt that it shouldn’t be a problem.
In fact, his current physique was already very strong. He really didn’t know how much his physique would increase after contracting all pets…
This strengthening blessing was very key!
Perhaps it decided if he could support the additional points or fusion of divine skills in the future.
“No problem.”
At this moment, when he heard that the World Tree wanted to strengthen him, Shi Yu immediately agreed.
“If I have a second Beast Taming Space…”
“In seven years, I’m confident of pulling up a second team of the Mythical Race at the demigod level.”
“At that time, if Blue Planet meets an external enemy, leave it to me.”
“I’ll defeat them one by one.”
“I know.” The World Tree nodded and said, “I don’t doubt your ability.”
“The Abyss Demon Duck and the Son of the Stars are both creatures with extraordinary potential.”
“And the cub of the Demon God Race that Lord Lie Shan handed to you.”
“Ordinary Beast Tamers’ contract slots might no longer be able to satisfy you.”
“In that case, come and receive the blessings.”
“You can also summon all your contracted pets and receive the blessings together.”
…
The huge world tree that reached the sky emitted a golden light, making the mystic realm even more dazzling.
Endless light fell like a meteor shower and landed on Shi Yu’s body.
Beside it, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and the others, who had shrunk into cub forms, also looked at the flowing light descending from the sky curiously.
“Yi. (Mommy’s scent.)” Baby Ginseng.
Buggy, Chi Tong, and the other pets:??
They suspected that it wanted to cozy up to someone powerful, but there was no evidence.
Therefore, that hardworking ginseng baby also knew the benefits of acknowledging a mother?
However, this was indeed a real mother. After all, it was the will clone of the mother planet that nurtured all the creatures on Blue Planet.
“Absorb it seriously,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu wu wu!!”
Thousands of streams of light fell into their bodies. At this moment, Shi Yu felt that his already very powerful body, spirit, soul, heart, and life force had been strengthened again.
And it was a very gentle strengthening without any side effects.
“Is this the blessing of the World Tree?”
In fact, before participating in the world competition, Shi Yu had another idea.
It was to replicate the blessings of the World Tree and teach it to pets.
But now, he actually no longer had this thought.
The reason was also very simple. The Son of the Stars also knew the move World Blessing.
He already had it.
World Blessing (super Skill, can rely on the world itself to give other life blessings. The effect of the blessing depends on the world’s ability).
...
After carefully studying this skill, Shi Yu realized that the Blessing of the World Tree that he had replicated seemed to be useless.

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 989 Breaking Through to Legendary (2)
chapters.content:
989 Breaking Through to Legendary (2)
After all, the Blessing Effect depended on the world itself. The World Tree could bless on behalf of Blue Planet, but for other pets, the Blessing Effect might not necessarily be the case.
There was even a high chance that unless it was a world-type life form, it couldn’t be taught.
Therefore, it was better to slowly nurture Little Purple’s ability. In the future, it could also master abilities similar to the Blessing of the World Tree. If it weren’t for the fact that Little Purple was too weak now and didn’t even have a complete law formed in its body, Shi Yu even suspected that its Blessing power could activate its skill fusion.
Shi Yu felt that this skill fusion should also be a divine-level skill similar to the Taiji Domain. It should require the recognition of the world’s laws to be used.
Therefore, he could be said to be filled with anticipation.
Could the Wex Palm+Hardening directly fuse into a Lightning Armor Skill and have a higher upper limit than the combination skill?
Hardening+Undying Golden Body+ Tempered Steel+Reinforced Iron Bones+Overlord Body Armor+Demon God Body+Giant Transformation, could it fuse into a divine body that was not inferior to the Bull God’s Metal Control Divine Body?
It could be said that because of this skill, every pet of Shi Yu had endless possibilities.
He could upgrade a pile of low-level Skills with extreme potential into divine skills that could fight in higher domains!
Amidst Shi Yu’s anticipation, his brain rumbled.
[Technique Fusion] was unlocked!
At the same time, not only did Shi Yu’s Skill Index talent undergo a qualitative change because of the World Blessing, but Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space also underwent a qualitative change!
The Beast Taming Space, which had been stuck at the level-six bottleneck for a long time, finally completed the final transformation with the blessings of the World Tree.
The strength of the spatial crystal wall in the Beast Taming Space had reached level seven. When the color turned black, it meant that Shi Yu could already contract and control overlord-level pets normally.
“From today onwards,”
“I’m a legend.”
Shi Yu opened his eyes and felt another boom. In his body, the seed of the second Beast Taming Space was quietly born, nurturing a new sprout.
At the moment, this Beast Taming Space in a chaotic state had yet to reach level one, so it was impossible to contract a pet. However, Shi Yu felt that as long as he cultivated and opened up like the first Beast Taming Space, this Beast Taming Space could quickly be completely formed.
With his current level-seven physique and Little Purple’s World Blessing, it was simply too easy to meditate and cultivate a level-zero Beast Taming Space.
Buzz…
After all, Shi Yu clenched his fists. At this moment, his physique was even more ridiculous. The burden of contracting Eleven and Buggy above his level had completely disappeared. He only felt an unprecedented joy.
In addition to the current blessings of the World Tree, Shi Yu estimated that it would be very fast. In less than half a year, he should be able to cultivate this second Beast Taming Space to the same level as the first Beast Taming Space.
“This way, Little Ji, Duckie, and the others might have a chance to become regular members and become ‘real second team’.”
“I wonder if there’s a possibility of a ‘third team’ that can’t be contracted in the future with 20 contract slots.”
“No, compared to the three teams, it’s more suitable to describe it with believers, armies, and citizens.”
“Even if there is, it’s a creature from another world born in the body of the Son of the Stars, Little Zi.”
Under Shi Yu’s excitement, good news also came from Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and the others.
Because of the blessings of the World Tree, their super Skills that had originally not reached perfect proficiency and were just a trace away from perfect proficiency were cultivated to perfection because of the increase in comprehension.
In addition to their teaching Skills that exceeded perfect proficiency, at this moment, as Shi Yu broke through, every pet of Shi Yu no longer had the original restrictions.
They were about to break through to the overlord level in a perfect posture.
“All of them were about to become overlords.”
As Shi Yu muttered, the World Tree’s voice sounded. “Because you’ve consumed the World Tree Fruit, in addition to your special mind domain, your ginseng baby is very compatible with my world blessing power.”
“Perhaps you can try to open the mind domain and let it break through and evolve under my blessed state.”
“Because the blessing of the power of the world should still have a high chance of success.”
“Yiya, ya, ya?!” Upon hearing that, Baby Ginseng was immediately pleasantly surprised.
It said that it smelled like a mother.
“In that case.” Shi Yu also looked at Baby Ginseng.
Then let it evolve.
The Blessing of the World Tree indeed seemed to have the effect of letting the contracted pet of the target break through the racial restrictions and complete evolution.
“Mi—” “Ning…” Then, under the envious expressions of Chi Tong and the others, Baby Ginseng pressed its little flower hat profoundly with an excited expression.
At this moment, there was finally no level restriction. Shi Yu also took out Baby Ginseng’s legendary resource, the Divine Earth of Life, that had never been completely used and handed it to Baby Ginseng.
At the same time, he also took out more than 40 Fruits of Life and arranged them in a row.
The Divine Earth of Life was Dong Huang’s, and these Fruits of Life that were close and comparable to Legendary resources were resources that had erupted from the trial of the Eternal Tree and were organized by Baby Ginseng. Shi Yu originally planned to use them as supplements for himself to add points to, but since Baby Ginseng was evolving now, in order to have stronger strength and potential, the priority was naturally the highest. After all, Baby Ginseng itself was also a supplement, and it was a growth-type supplement.
Next, let’s see how much Baby Ginseng could absorb.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 990 Breaking Through to Legendary (3)
chapters.content:
990 Breaking Through to Legendary (3)
“Baby Ginseng, evolve…”
Shi Yu closed his eyes.
In the dark world, Shi Yu saw a blue planet, Earth, and the huge tree growing on it in his heart.
[World Tree Domain]
Boom!!
Shi Yu opened his eyes. At this moment, his eyes turned emerald green, containing a huge life force.
As Shi Yu activated his mind domain, the air around him began to hum and vibrate.
The substantialized mental wave formed green ripples around him.
In the next moment, as Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun, a strong wave bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world and overlapped with the World Tree mystic realm.
“No matter how many times I watch it, I still feel that it’s magical,” the World Tree couldn’t help but say.
The entire world turned green.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng’s firm gaze was connected to the Earth Chain, connecting a pile of Fruits of Life and the Divine Earth of Life.
At the same time, the light representing the World Tree’s blessing continued to descend from the sky and flow into Baby Ginseng’s body.
Boom!!!
Under the enhancement of endless power, an evolution light enveloped Baby Ginseng!!
Its form suddenly changed.
From the originally small ginseng baby form, it gradually grew strong, as if it had turned into a sapling and gradually grew into a towering divine tree.
It was dozens of meters tall. During its growth, fruits formed on the tree. When its branches bloomed, every fruit on every branch was like a new ginseng baby.
Soon, the light dissipated and it appeared in a new form.
A huge cream-colored trunk, emerald green leaves, moon-like golden branches, sun-like fiery red flowers, fruits that looked like ginseng babies, decorated this complete divine tree.
On the divine tree, as the core fruit of the entire plant life, it opened its eyes and stood on the divine tree. Its form was no different from the ginseng baby before evolution, but its aura was more than a little larger.
At this moment, this ginseng baby was looking at its world in extreme joy.
It took off!
Energy Points: ???
“It didn’t absorb more than half of the Fruit of Life for nothing.”
Of the more than 40 Legendary quality level-eight Fruits of Life, only 20 were directly absorbed by Baby Ginseng. Half of the four Legendary quality legendary Fruits of Life were also absorbed by Baby Ginseng.
Under the feedback of Baby Ginseng, no, it should be said that Shi Yu’s green eyes were also filled with surprise.
“Wuhu ~” Eleven, Buggy, and the others were also suddenly happy.
Because…
[Skill Name]: World Tree Fruit
[Level]: Super
[Stats]: Wood
< Introduction > It can increase the user’s comprehension and increase the limit of their learning ability.
Shi Yu called it heaven-defying.
The World Tree Fruit he ate was back!
Although what Baby Ginseng created was definitely not as powerful as the Mythical World Tree Fruit given by the World Tree, but… how could it be solved? It was fine to add points!
Coupled with the blessings of the World Tree, Shi Yu felt that even if it was a non-racial Skill, Eleven and the others could train to death, aiming for Dao Proficiency.
This was also the source of Eleven and the others’ excitement.
However, in this evolution, Baby Ginseng didn’t just awaken this new Skill. There was another one.
[Skill Name]: World Favor
[Level]: Quasi God-level Skill
< Introduction > It can borrow the power of the world to let skills cultivated to the extreme have the ability to touch laws and become pseudo-god skills.
Quasi-divine skill!
In other words…
< Name > Baby Ginseng
[Race]: World Ginseng
[Race Level]: Low-level Mythical Race
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Baby Ginseng had also become a Mythical Race!
The favor of the world wasn’t the strongest skill, but for Baby Ginseng, this was the most cost-effective skill.
This was an extremely comprehensive strengthening divine skill.
It had a similar effect to Shi Yu’s World Tree Domain. It could allow all the skills that Baby Ginseng had reached Dao Proficiency to be strengthened by the divine level and display an effect close to a divine skill. Even low, intermediate, and high-level skills were the same. They could be called pseudo-god skills and small divine skills.
It could be said that not only did it increase Baby Ginseng’s battle power, but it also strengthened its support, healing, and many other abilities in all aspects.
Shi Yu felt that it could be used with the World Tree Domain. The Effect was similar to the Taiji Domain and the Yin Yang Millstone.
...
“Not bad.”
At this moment, looking at the ginseng baby that had completed its evolution, the World Tree nodded and said, “It has indeed awakened an impressive skill. I can feel that it can borrow the power of the world relatively easily like me.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“However, there are also restrictions to such a Skill. That is, only a world that allows it to borrow power can maximize the effect. If you go to other worlds in the future and are rejected by the world’s will, this Skill will be useless. However, if it cooperates with your mind domain, it might be able to change this situation.”
“Then now, Baby Ginseng can also be called a Mythical Race, right?”
The World Tree said, “It can be called a low-level Mythical Race.”
Three… This way, Shi Yu would contract three creatures of Mythical Races.
The World Tree felt more and more that the potential of this world legend was very huge.
Mechanical Illusion God of a low-level Mythical Race, World Ginseng, and that Iron-eating Beast with stronger potential…
At the moment, it couldn’t determine the full potential of that Iron-eating Beast.
The full power of that divine skill might only be displayed after the Mythical Revival. Whether it was a high-level Mythical Race or a cub of a top-notch Mythical Race depended on what kind of transformation it could undergo after the Mythical Revival.
...
“Yiya!” At this moment, the evolution was completed. Under the control of the plant, Baby Ginseng sealed the entire world ginseng form in its body. It still felt that it was more convenient to move in this ginseng baby form. As for the World Tree form, it consumed too much energy. It planned to use it during battle.
Just like Eleven, Buggy, and Susu, they liked the baby form.
“By the way…” At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly recalled something. He smiled and asked the World Tree mother,
“Lord World Tree, the time of the next world competition… Can you reveal a little?”
He couldn’t participate, but he could quickly nurture an expert who could participate for Dong Huang. If there was time, he would find more resources and turn Senior Lu into an expert who could defeat the totem country. If Senior Lu exceeded the age limit, there was still Senior Panda and the beast-eared girl. At the very least, there was still the younger genius of Dong Huang. With the World Tree Blessing at its peak, he felt that it would be a loss if it was taken away by other countries.
“What do you want?” The World Tree looked at Shi Yu cautiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 991 Chi Tong Evolved Again (1)
chapters.content:
991 Chi Tong Evolved Again (1)
“What do you want?”
“Ah… I’m just curious.”
Curious?
The World Tree was silent.
If it were others who were curious, the World Tree would believe it.
However, Shi Yu… As the guy who took all the reward for the seven trial inheritances, the World Tree didn’t believe that Shi Yu was purely curious.
However…
At the time of the next world competition.
“I’m not sure either.”
If the World Tree could still predict it previously…
Then now, after giving Shi Yu the strengthened blessing, the World Tree didn’t know how long it would sleep for.
But what was certain was that he would definitely wake up within seven years.
“Alright,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
If he wasn’t sure, he would see.
If Lin Feng could go from Legend to Legendary in two years, he felt that he should be able to too.
Even if his meditation speed would be delayed because of the second Beast Taming Space, the problem was that he still had Little Zi, a cultivation support tool.
At that time, standing at the height of the legendary level and contracting a demigod-level ginseng baby, Shi Yu didn’t believe that he couldn’t nurture a Titled Legend genius who could fight totems above his level.
He also wanted the next blessing of the World Tree. He couldn’t let good things go to outsiders.
“By the way.”
At the thought of the second Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu suddenly noticed a huge problem.
He asked, “Lord World Tree, after the second Beast Taming Space is established, will it awaken a new Beast Taming Talent like the original Beast Taming Space?”
The World Tree said, “Yes.”
“But I’ve never opened up a second Beast Taming Space for humans. You’re the first.”
“Therefore, I can’t be sure what talent will awaken.”
“There’s a high chance that it’s still a telepathy talent.”
Shi Yu: “?”
Damn…
What was the use of having two telepathy talents?
Could it sense it himself?
“However, it’s also possible that it’s another Beast Taming Talent.”
“You have to explore everything yourself.”
Shi Yu scratched his face slightly. Forget it.
He could do whatever he wanted. If he awakened a strengthening talent, it would be the same as dual telepathy. Shi Yu felt that it was useless.
Considering that most Beast Taming Talents were extremely useless to him, Shi Yu no longer looked forward to it.
Even if it mutated into a new talent, it was most likely not very useful.
“Alright.” At this moment, after Baby Ginseng completed its evolution and Shi Yu completely accepted the blessing, the World Tree said, “Your other pets are also on the verge of breaking through, right?”
“After leaving here, don’t waste your cultivation.”
“Cultivate more pets.”
“Try to reach the God Realm as soon as possible. If there are no other problems, I won’t keep you.”
“After blessing you, I’ve consumed too much energy. I might have to sleep for a period of time…”
“I’ll teleport you to Dong Huang’s surroundings…”
At this point, the World Tree’s voice became weaker and weaker.
At the same time, spatial light enveloped Shi Yu and the others.
Shi Yu was shocked. He still had many things to ask.
“Wait.” Shi Yu was just about to say something when suddenly, in a flash, he, Eleven, and the others were teleported to the outside world.
In the outside world.
There was no longer Inatella Island in sight.
Shi Yu and the others appeared out of thin air above the sea.
Perhaps it was afraid that he would encounter danger. After all, there were a bunch of demigods around Inatella. The World Tree directly teleported Shi Yu to Dong Huang.
Looking at this unfamiliar and familiar environment, Shi Yu was at a loss.
Wasn’t this the sea area near the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain?
However, this was not the most important thing.
Most importantly, he had yet to receive the reward from Ancient God Golden Bull.
Why was it teleported back? Did it have to be so scammy??
...
“You want to devour my reward?” Shi Yu was stunned. No, no, that was a god.
It couldn’t run away.
“Wuu.” “Wu.” “Yi.” “Mi.” “Ning.” “Master.”
“Next, should we arrange for Chi Tong’s breakthrough?”
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others floated in the sky above the sea. Ling couldn’t help but remind them.
Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng had already broken through to the overlord level.
Eleven and Baby Ginseng were both Mythical Races at the overlord level. Buggy was a god of faith in the starry sky. It wasn’t a Mythical Race, but it was better than a Mythical Race.
Next, wasn’t it a little inappropriate for the three sisters not to break through to the overlord level?
It and Susu were not in a hurry. Susu’s Blue Sea Contract, its Wind Spirit Bead, still had room for improvement. At the moment, it was not the most perfect time to break through.
But there shouldn’t be anything to wait for on Chi Tong’s side.
It was already the best time to break through to the overlord level.
...
Under the sisterly love, seeing that the three brothers had all been strengthened at the epic level, the three sisters couldn’t wait to strengthen themselves anymore.
If he broke through, wouldn’t it be easier to add points?
“Yes.” Shi Yu looked at them.
Chi Tong indeed needed to be especially careful!
“Isn’t it time for a perfect Spirit Release?” Shi Yu asked Chi Tong.
“Mi!! Mi!!” At this moment, Chi Tong couldn’t hold it in anymore. It was looking forward to it.
Spirit Release Skill.
A bloodline atavism skill.
Every time it broke through proficiency, Chi Tong would obtain a new form.
It wasn’t completely evolution, but it was similar to evolution.
At the proficient level, Chi Tong awakened its bird spirit form and mastered flames that could recover its stamina.
At the expert level, it awakened the Phoenix Spirit Form, allowing Chi Tong to master flames and phoenix might that could heal injuries.
Then what kind of new form would it awaken at the perfect level?
Although he had already replicated the evolution skill Soul Incarnation for Chi Tong, it didn’t affect him from seeing the form of the perfect-level Spirit Release first.
“Let’s go to the ruins.”
“In addition, Buggy, send a clone to pull the ruins space back to Ping Cheng first.”
Buggy: Ji?!
The little azure dragon that looked like a Green Silkworm was shocked.
It was it again!
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others looked at Buggy.
“Wuu.” “Yi.”
Who else could it be?
The Green Dragon Kart charged forward.
“Wu.” Buggy had tears in its eyes. When would another guy with Instant Transmission come to the second team?
Little Ji, Duckie, Little Purple, Qi, and even that Horned Demon looked unreliable.
Forget it, fortunately, he was squeezing his clone dry.
….
In the Legendary Ruins space.
Shi Yu took Chi Tong’s Sun Flame Flower and bone Sword and gave them to it as breakthrough resources.
The first batch of Legendary resources prepared for Team One was almost completely used up this time.
As for divine-level resources like the Flame of Life, Chi Tong couldn’t use them in its current state.
“Mimi!!!” At this moment, the little red sword spirit, Chi Tong, flew around the Sun Flame Flower and the bone sword excitedly, already impatient to devour these two things.
“Hurry up and break through.”
“By the way, don’t keep that dragon either.”
“I feel that it’s no longer enough.”
“After that, we’ll upgrade Undead Revival to transcendent and refine the totem puppet.”
Chi Tong:!!!
Shi Yu smiled at Chi Tong. Eleven and the others had already surrounded it.
“Mi!! (Don’t look.)”
Chi Tong was a little panicked.
Chi Tong knew that it was only using a Normal Spirit Release this time, so it didn’t have much hope.
It only hoped that after the Spirit Release this time, it could be a little stronger. Then, it would be satisfied.
Now that it was being stared at by so many big shots, it felt very pressured.
“Wuu!!” “Wu!!” “Yi!!” Eleven and the others expressed that there was no problem, but they still refused to leave.
Chi Tong: …
Chi Tong didn’t care anymore. It directly burned the Fire Dragon King in the undead space to death and let it become nutrients for the Spirit Release.
In the next moment.
Boom!!
Little Chi Tong’s body emitted the light of the sun, and its body turned into a fire vortex, erupting with a huge gravity that absorbed the Sun Flame Flower and the bone Sword on the ground!!
The flames instantly fused with the Sun Flame Flower, and the bone Sword disappeared from the flames, turning into nutrients for Chi Tong’s own growth.
Although that wasn’t how the bone sword was used, Shi Yu and the others didn’t consider the cost-effective ratio of such a resource that was about to be eliminated.
During this process, Little Chi Tong’s aura gradually strengthened.
The overlord’s will was undoubtedly displayed.
A moment later, its body erupted with a soaring fire light. Its growth level directly broke through to the overlord level.
Energy Points: 75,770,0
It wasn’t like Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng breaking through and evolving, directly exceeding the limit of the overlord level.
A relatively ordinary energy value, but it was actually not bad. Just looking at the normal energy value and not looking at any other Stats, it had already reached the standard of a top-notch overlord.
The Space Emperor’s Void Mantis had just broken through and only had a little more than 60 million energy points.
Without undergoing heaven-defying evolution breakthroughs like Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong only relied on its Spirit Release Skill and standard resources to reach this level just after breaking through. Shi Yu was already very satisfied.
However, what surprised Shi Yu the most was that Chi Tong’s perfect Spirit Release this time had actually awakened a new Race Skill.
The previous two Spirit Releases had only changed the nature of the Fire and Deterrence, not a new Skill.
“This is…”
Moreover, it was a skill that Shi Yu never expected.
[Skill Name]: Sword Dao Will
Skill Level: Advanced
< Introduction > It’s a special talent skill. Creatures with this skill can cultivate sword-type skills with twice the results with half the effort. At the same time, the power of their sword moves will increase, and they can better control various sword-type Arms.
Shi Yu was very shocked.
But soon, he suddenly realized.
This was normal.
General Mu Huiyin was originally a peerless genius in the Sword Dao. From the fact that the Interlocking Sword was her signature Skill, and a pet like the Ice Dragon could only be considered a mount and a cooler, it could be seen that this was a ruthless person like Shi Yu who liked to fight himself.
In addition, Chi Tong was a heroic spirit in the form of a sword spirit. At the perfect Spirit Release stage, it was very normal for it to inherit the Sword Dao talent in Mu Huiyin’s bloodline.
Shi Yu was delighted.
This way, wouldn’t it be even more stable?
There was no need to think about the next soul clones. They had to all be sword-type clones.
There were so many different swords…
The red flames from the Sun Flame Flower, the gray soul aura from the bone sword, and the white advancement light intertwined. Soon, a figure walked out of the monstrous flames.
At this moment, Chi Tong immediately completed the Spirit Release breakthrough.
Its fourth form appeared after the sword spirit, bird spirit, and phoenix spirit.
In the flames, it was a humanoid figure! She was about 15 to 16 years old. She had a beautiful face and was peerlessly delicate. She was wearing silver armor and held a bone sword filled with flames. She had red hair and red pupils that draped over her shoulders. Outside her phantom body that looked like a soul, Phoenix spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun was wrapped. Her aura was peerless!
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others were all extremely shocked. They didn’t expect Chi Tong’s perfect Spirit Release form to actually return to its most primitive image. Looking at this form that was like the twin sister of General Mu Huiyin, Shi Yu subconsciously thought of a name.
“Chi Tong, Sword Maiden Form.”
“Mi.” Chi Tong nodded in satisfaction. Alright.
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. His pets’ strength was almost catching up to those old monsters who had lived for hundreds or thousands of years. Apart from Ling, they didn’t seem to have systematically learned human language.
Forget it, it wasn’t a big problem. In any case, he had telepathy. However, apart from Buggy, Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others didn’t seem to know how to communicate telepathically with other lives. They could only communicate passively and couldn’t take the initiative to let low-level creatures who couldn’t communicate telepathically understand his words.
It could only make faces and use expressions. Was this considered a biased subject…

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 992 It feels good to keep fusing (1)
chapters.content:
992 It feels good to keep fusing (1)
“Sword Maiden Form!!!”
At this moment, Shi Yu was smiling.
It was heartfelt joy.
This form was much more handsome than the first three forms.
It was mainly because she was beautiful and pleasing to the eye.
However, on the other side, Chi Tong seemed to be very uncomfortable.
She shook her arm stiffly and waved her sword with one hand. Then, she smiled at Shi Yu and the others in embarrassment.
It might have to adapt to this state for a while.
But it shouldn’t be long before Chi Tong could sense that the sword in its hand was just like a part of its body.
She believed that she could quickly become a female Sword Saint with extraordinary strength!
Little Chi Tong’s expression was serious.
Just slash, slash, slash.
“I’m already looking forward to the time to send the Demon King Dragon Bone to ‘Lord Ice Dragon King’.”
“I wonder if it will be shocked when it sees Chi Tong’s Sword Maiden form,” Shi Yu touched his chin and said with a bad taste.
“…” The pets were speechless at Shi Yu’s bad taste.
Can’t he do something humane when doing a good deed?
“But speaking of which.” Shi Yu looked at Chi Tong.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s image was ethereal. The fire spiritual energy on its body was like the wings of a Phoenix, and its aura was extraordinary.
Shi Yu looked at it and suddenly recalled something more important.
“Chi Tong, come here for a while.”
“What’s wrong?” The flames on Chi Tong’s body slowly faded, and the longsword in its hand disappeared with the flames. Its voice was automatically translated into human language by Shi Yu in his heart.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Hand.”
Shi Yu stretched out his hand. Sword Maiden Chi Tong slowly walked over and curiously placed her slender and hot palm on Shi Yu’s palm.
“What’s wrong?”
At this moment, Chi Tong’s expression was slightly happy. It had already expected something. Could it be that it was adding points?
It was time to teach soul incarnations.
“I plan to try the skill fusion.”
“Ling, listen to my description and record the data.”
Skill fusion?!
Chi Tong was stunned before clenching Shi Yu’s hand even more happily.
Hurry, hurry, hurry.
Shi Yu had almost forgotten to try this newly awakened function.
After looking forward to it for so long, he couldn’t take it anymore.
It was a good opportunity to test the waters with Chi Tong, who had just evolved!
“Then I’ll start.” Shi Yu touched Chi Tong’s palm and closed his eyes slightly.
At this moment, Shi Yu seemed to be able to see a huge black and white vortex furnace in the Skill Book.
Under the furnace was most of Chi Tong’s information.
Moreover, every Skill of Chi Tong flickered like a ball of light.
Shi Yu could sense that when he came into contact with a contracted pet, he could drag the pet’s skills into the furnace and synthesize them.
He tried to drag the skill light ball that represented super vision into the furnace…
There were no changes…
Right on the heels of that, he dragged the skill light ball representing Absolute Sleep into the furnace…
At this moment, the same risk notification as when teaching super skills appeared in the Skill Index!
Skill: Super Sight, Absolute Sleep
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely high
[Fusion Risk]: Very low
[Note]: The higher the skill proficiency, the higher the compatibility between the skills, and the higher the success rate of fusion. The success rate of fusion also depends on the physique of the Beast Tamer and the will of the pet.
“Eh?”
“What’s wrong?” Chi Tong saw Shi Yu suddenly sigh in confusion and opened its fiery red beautiful eyes.
“It’s nothing.”
Shi Yu was puzzled and very confused. Why was there a f*cking compatibility between super vision and absolute sleep?
What could this fusion do?
Could it be that it could activate the skill of Clairvoyance while sleeping???
The user was sleeping, but the spiritual eye can observe the entire world!
...
It sounded… useful and useless.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven and the others waved their hands. Charge, charge, charge.
“I know, I know,” Shi Yu said.
“I think we can have one more.”
Shi Yu was not in a hurry to fuse. In the next moment, he tried to drag in the Heart Strike skill that could concentrate and hit the weakness.
This was a skill replicated from Duckie. After teaching various pets to high proficiency, it had basically become a passive skill.
At this moment, after this skill dragged into the furnace, the success rate was still extremely high.
“It’s so open?”
Shi Yu couldn’t help but be happy. This skill fusion looked pretty awesome and exciting. He didn’t look forward to it for nothing.
It looked like he could throw in any trash Skill in the future to fuse it.
He would make a killing if he bet on a quasi-divine skill.
...
Shi Yu dragged the extremely special super Skill Spirit Release in again. He was only curious. In the next moment…
[Fusion success rate]: Zero
[Fusion Risk]: Unknown
Alright.
“…” Shi Yu hurriedly dragged out the Spirit Release Skill light ball and the Soul Slash skill light ball.
[Fusion Success Rate]: High
“Interesting.” Shi Yu continued to throw the Light Flame Sword’s skill light ball in as if it was free.
The success rate was still high.
Right on the heels of that, Demon Blade Curse.
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
Shi Yu finally realized that as long as he didn’t throw in super Skills, everything was fine.
The success rate of fusing these low-level Skills that he had upgraded to transcendent proficiency wouldn’t be too ridiculous.
In the end.
Shi Yu chose the five Skills of Super Sight, Absolute Sleep, Heart Strike, Light Flame Sword, and Soul Slash to try to fuse.
The success rate of fusion was still high, but if other skills were added, it would be a medium risk. Therefore, Shi Yu only chose these few at the start.
“Chi Tong, it’s best to prepare.”
Under Shi Yu’s reminder, Chi Tong, who was holding Shi Yu’s hand, nodded nervously. In the next moment, Shi Yu activated the skill fusion furnace!!

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 993 It feels good to keep fusing (2)
chapters.content:
993 It feels good to keep fusing (2)
Buzz.
Accompanied by a loud bang.
Just like when super Skills added points, Shi Yu began to have a large amount of physical fitness and life extracted!!
Shi Yu’s expression instantly turned pale, as if it had been drained dry.
On Chi Tong’s side, its Spirit also suddenly rumbled, encountering an Affliction similar to when super Skills added points.
Its expression immediately turned pale, and its expression instantly turned ugly.
However…
After all, the success rate of fusion was high. Shi Yu and Chi Tong had already experienced this burden countless times and were used to it.
Therefore, although it looked painful, it almost didn’t affect them much. They completed the final fusion.
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, flames surged from the Skill Furnace and swayed violently. As the energy inside calmed down, Chi Tong’s aura actually increased immediately!
“Well…” Chi Tong opened its eyes with difficulty and then recovered its joy.
Its energy level instantly reached 80 million!
[Fusion successful]
[Super Sight, Absolute Sleep, Heart Strike, Light Flame Sword, Soul Slash] had already fused into the [Fire Spirit Sword Body].
Skill: Flame Spirit Sword Body (Perfect Level)
< Introduction > It’s a super undead and fire-element Skill. It’s a life form with the Fire Spirit Sword Body. Its physique is transcendent. It can freely control soul power and fire power to form a fatal slash.
“This is…” Shi Yu’s expression was slightly shocked.
“Flame Spirit Sword Body…” Chi Tong also muttered. It could sense the power of this skill.
These five skills directly fused into a new super racial skill.
It directly converted the effects of the five Skills into a passive physique.
Not only did he inherit the abilities of the original five skills, but non-racial skills such as super vision, absolute sleep, and Heart Strike also received an epic increase in the upper limit of the skills because they were integrated into new racial skills.
Chi Tong looked at Buggy. Facing Buggy of such a perfect race, it could actually clearly see Buggy’s weakness at this moment. Its Heart Integrated into Sword seemed to be able to hold the sword in its hand and easily break through its powerful body, directly splitting its soul.
Shi Yu and Chi Tong could already sense how strong this sword body would be after combining it with Sword Dao Resistance and the Interlocking Sword.
Buggy: “?”
“Wu! (Don’t look at me like that!)” Buggy shrank back.
Too much.
“So strong!” Beside him, Ling, who was in charge of recording, also revealed an incredulous expression. It couldn’t understand this Beast Taming Talent.
“Wuu!!”
“Wu!!!”
At this moment, as Chi Tong completed the first round of fusion.
Eleven, Buggy, and the others were in the online meeting, discussing eagerly.
After everyone was stunned for a moment, right on the heels of that, everyone revealed excited expressions.
He felt that the fusion of skills was much better than adding points to skills.
“It does feel good,” Shi Yu said.
Although it also consumed physical strength, it was simply too happy.
“Baby Ginseng, heal me!”
“Continue.”
“Next, let’s do it once each.”
“It feels good to keep fusing!!!”
“Wuuu!!! (Eleven needs a test, Eleven needs a test!)” Eleven kept jumping around to seek its presence.
“Ji!! (I also want to train my will.)”
….
[Fusion successful]
[High Speed Healing, Super Sight, Absolute Sleep, Reinforced Iron Bones, Tempered Steel, Overlord Body Armor] had already fused into the [Parting Gold Battle Body].
Skill: Metal Battle Body (Perfect Level)
< Introduction > It’s a super metal-element, fire-element, and Spirit-element Skill. It’s a physique born for battle after being tempered by the heavenly fire. It has the characteristics of becoming stronger and stronger in battle, the Eyes of Fire and Gold, and the unyielding nature of a hundred battles. Its physical strength is peerless.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared excitedly.
It felt its physique become Enhanced again.
However, compared to this, it looked forward to the fusion of super Skills such as the Demon God Body and the Undying Golden Body more. However, considering Shi Yu’s life…
Eleven was already satisfied today.
…
[Fusion successful]
[Absolute Sleep, Strengthening, Earth Escape, Earth Chain] had already fused into [Earth Heart].
Skill: Heart of the Earth (Perfect Level)
...
< Introduction > It’s a super Race Skill. It uses the earth as a body and transforms into the heart of the earth, forming a symbiosis relationship and dominating the power of the earth.
“Yiya… (The heart of an emperor?)” Baby Ginseng’s gaze drifted away.
…
Shi Yu fused the pets one by one according to the order of drawing lots.
However, continuous fusion was more draining than he imagined.
After only fusing three times, Shi Yu couldn’t take it anymore, even if it kept providing supplements.
As a result, when Baby Ginseng fused, putting four skills in was the limit.
This made Shi Yu a little alert. Although it felt good to keep fusing, he still had to give himself some time to rest… Fortunately, he had already broken through. Otherwise, it would be equivalent to teaching three super Skill points in a row previously. He would have to squeeze him dry.
“Wu.”
Seeing Shi Yu’s pale face, Buggy, who had yet to recover even under the nourishment of the ginseng baby, spoke.
“Wu!! (Rest, rest, I’m not in a hurry.)”
...
“Master, it’s time to rest. You seemed to have consumed too much energy just now.” Ling also detected that Shi Yu’s physical state was unstable and immediately reminded him.
“Yes.” Shi Yu covered his forehead and said, “Sigh, I’m old. It’s alright. We still have the Eternal Flower and the Fruit of Life. After resting, I’ll eat the Eternal Flower and obtain ten thousand years of lifespan. When the time comes, it should be easier to fuse.”

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 994 It feels good to keep fusing (3)
chapters.content:
994 It feels good to keep fusing (3)
“I’ll fuse all super Skills into quasi-divine skills for you!”
“It’s not that urgent. There’s a lot of time next…” Ling was speechless.
The World Tournament had already ended. There were still seven years until the Mythical Revival. What was the hurry?
“This is nothing.”
“Next, we’re going to face the totem battle,” Shi Yu said. “By the way, Buggy, did you say that we’re already home?”
“Wu!!” Buggy nodded.
Even its clone had been watching television for a while.
“Ji!! (Dong Huang’s World Tournament team seems to have returned. There’s a triumphant broadcast on television.)” Buggy said.
“Is that so?”
Shi Yu said, “Then I have to contact President Lin and the others as soon as possible. They probably don’t know that I was teleported back by the World Tree in advance. High-end battle power like Divine Source Legendary and Senior Dragon God might still be waiting for me near Inatella.”
….
Ever since the team of the World Tournament went to Inatella, the people in the country had been nervously waiting for news.
For Beast Tamers who couldn’t go to Inatella personally, the outcome had already seriously affected the quality of their sleep.
Some students even sighed. They had never been so nervous when it came to the college entrance examination results, confessing to the class goddess, and cheating in the exam.
What would the outcome of the World Tournament be? This topic had already occupied the trending list of Dong Huang for a week. From top to bottom, from the legends and guardians guarding the country to the students who had yet to become Beast Tamers… They were all looking forward to it!
Therefore, when there was news that the world competition team had returned, the entire country was shocked. They all guarded the live broadcast channel of the television.
The popular hosts of the Dong Huang Radio and Television Station, Gu Yu and Han Lu, were trying their best to suppress their expressions and prepare to report the results of Dong Huang’s World Tournament to the country.
…
Ancient Capital University.
“An Chang, An Chang, the world competition team is back!!”
“Look at the cell phone live broadcast.”
Because An Chang of Ancient Capital University had obtained a temporary opportunity to participate in the National League soon, he didn’t accompany them to the World Tournament venue. Instead, he prepared to not miss any time to improve himself and chose to stay in the school to cultivate bitterly.
He planned to use the results of the National League to repay Shi Yu and the Sea Dragon King.
However, he had also been looking forward to Senior Shi Yu’s return. He believed that although Shi Yu wasn’t a legend yet, with Shi Yu’s strength, he could definitely achieve pretty good results in the World Tournament.
In the training room, An Chang, who was training, received a call from a female classmate. He was immediately shocked and quickly turned on his cell phone.
Wu Ling City.
The three new armies who were training had different statuses under their training, so they naturally didn’t have the chance to go to such a high-end place like the World Tournament venue. However, at this moment, during the break, they also stared at the live broadcast uniformly.
“I say…” In a restaurant, a group of new recruits from Ping Cheng, apothecary Qiao Liang, who had sold supplements to Shi Yu, the top student of the Quas Armored Beast, Chen Kai, and the Iron-eating Beast Tamer Zhuang Yue, who had changed their fate because of Shi Yu…
In addition, the elite apprentices of Bamboo Stone Dojo, Jiang Rui, and Little Bear Yan Qi, these fellow villagers of Ping Cheng, were having a meal during their break time and happened to wait for the live broadcast together. All of them couldn’t help but be especially nervous.
“I wonder how Shi Yu’s situation is. The news should tell us about his situation later.”
“Before going, Shi Yu was seventh in the Sequence, right? He hasn’t reached the Legend level yet. I wonder if there are any opportunities to break through to the Legend level during the World Tournament. If he can, that would be impressive, awesome.”
“It’s difficult, but even if he’s level six, as the number one person below the legend of Dong Huang, Shi Yu’s results definitely won’t be bad.”
They discussed with a smile, clearly proud to know Shi Yu.
“It’s mainly about Dong Huang’s overall results. This is the most important…”
In various places in Dong Huang… President Xia of Demon Capital, Legend Xiao of the navy, and Legend Yin Cuanqi of the Ancient Capital… These legends couldn’t go to Inatella to guard Dong Huang. They were also paying attention.
In front of the television station, Han Lu and Gu Yu took a deep breath. Their expressions were so serious that everyone swallowed their saliva.
The female host, Han Lu, said, “A total of 106 countries responded to this world competition. Among them, apart from our Seven Nation Alliance, there are also 99 totem countries.”
“Among the 106 factions, there are a total of 702 contestants. Among them, there are a total of 136 legendary Beast Tamers who have reached level seven!”
“There are countless overlord-level pets. Among the contestants of the totem country, two Beast Tamers even contracted totem-level pets above their level because of their special talent.”
“It can be said to be the cruelest world competition.”
Boom!!
At this point, the Beast Tamers everywhere in Dong Huang were stunned.
“Holy shit.”
“136?”
“You’re not kidding, right?”
“Doesn’t that mean… it’s more than all the legends in Dong Huang combined?”
“Not only that… Even including those who died in the past few decades, there aren’t that many.”
136 legends!
This time, there were a few legends participating in Dong Huang. Everyone naturally knew that the other six countries definitely wouldn’t exceed Dong Huang. However, there were actually so many legendary Beast Tamers in the totem country?
This was the first time the people of Dong Huang understood the power of the totem countries so clearly… Moreover, these were all legends under the age of 30!
In the previous world competitions, the number of legendary Beast Tamers had never exceeded 20. This time, there were directly more than 100!!
In addition, what made them most difficult to breathe was the totem-level pet? What a joke.
Wasn’t that the level that only legendary Beast Tamers were qualified to contract?
...

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 995 It feels good to keep fusing (4)
chapters.content:
995 It feels good to keep fusing (4)
Totem level, if it was a level that was easier for the people of Dong Huang to understand, was the level above overlord, the guardians of Dong Huang!!
The guardians of Dong Huang were all Legendary-level existences. They protected various places in Dong Huang and were the guardians of the commoners. Such a creature actually participated in the World Tournament?
Fight my ass.
In an instant, the hearts of the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang turned cold. They sensed the cruelty of this world competition and had a bad feeling.
Could Ye Xing, Big Boss Divine Bell, and the others deal with the totems of the totem country??
“This…” In Ancient Capital University, An Chang clenched his fists. Unbelievable. Totem level… Didn’t that mean that it was at the same level as the Sea Dragon King?
“Gulp.” Beast Tamers all over the country swallowed their saliva.
“However!!!” In the television station, Han Lu and Gu Yu’s mouths were dry. Han Lu said, “However, these are not enough to be an obstacle to the Beast Tamers of our seven countries!!”
“No matter how strong the opponent is.”
“The champion of this world competition, the Beast Tamer who obtained the title of ‘World Legend’ this time, is still from the Seven Nation Alliance!!”
“And from Dong Huang in the Seven Nation Alliance! Yes, we’re the champions!!!”
“After two years, another world legend has appeared in our Dong Huang, the strongest legend in the world!”
Bang!!!
Upon hearing this and hearing the excited shouts of the two hosts on the television news, all the Dong Huang people watching the news were stunned with incredulous expressions.
The World Tournament was held a total of three times. The first champion was Lin Feng of Dong Huang. The second and third champions were respectively taken away by Xue Yuan and Shen Feng. In this even crueler World Tournament, although the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang had a certain amount of anticipation, they didn’t have the confidence to win.
However, at this moment, as the news was announced, the Beast Tamers holding cell phones almost crushed the cell phones in their hands. The Beast Tamers in front of the computer even smashed the table fiercely, making the keyboard vibrate. As for the Beast Tamers in front of the television, they jumped up from the sofa one after another. In their minds, they were shocked by this explosive news.
“Dong Huang won the world competition again?”
“And it was won under the competition of more than 100 countries, more than 100 legends, and even two totems??”
“Is it Ye Xing?” In the navy headquarters, General Xiao Hai and many other navy generals guessed one after another. Their expressions were also extremely shocked. Ye Xing, this peerless genius, indeed had the aptitude of a Titled Legend. If he, who was good at army skills, had some fortuitous breakthroughs, he might have a chance to defeat ordinary totem level.
“Could it be Miss Divine Bell? She’s a descendant of the Divine Source Legendary. She might be Dong Huang’s secret trump card.” Divine Bell’s fans guessed.
Beast Tamers from various fields joined in the speculation and discussion.
However.
Then, on the television channel, the sweating Gu Yu said a piece of news that shocked the country.
Many people opened their mouths wide.
“This time, the Beast Tamer representing Dong Huang to win the world championship and become the new generation’s ‘world legend’. He’s from Icefield City and Ping Cheng. He’s a second-year student of Ancient Capital University, archeologist, Shi Yu!!”
“According to the news, contestant Shi Yu forcefully killed the invincible overlord of the Western Dragon Empire, the Fire Dragon King, in the preliminaries trial.”
“Killing the totem-level life form of the Dragonman Empire, the Green Dragon Prince.”
“Killed the totem-level life form of the Origin Land, the Wex Crown Divine Tree.”
“In the preliminaries, He has killed dozens of overlords and has peerless battle power. After the preliminaries end, the main competition begins. No one dares to fight the contestants of more than a hundred countries. An invincible world legend is born!”
“The world competition ended before it even started! This is also why the national team returned so quickly.”
…
Boom!!!
At this moment, Dong Huang was no different from a strong earthquake or a volcano eruption.
An Chang from Ancient Capital University’s eyes were about to pop out. The temperature of his entire body instantly increased by more than ten degrees. He felt that his heart was beating ten times faster!
“What?!!”
The expression of the young man who was delivering packages to various places on the Wings of Wind trembled.
He recalled the young man who shyly took the package from him.
“Holy shit.”
The shouts of the Ping Cheng recruits at the gathering instantly spread throughout the restaurant, making everyone’s gazes focus.
Similarly, these people’s expressions were also filled with indescribable shock.
“Shi Yu… world legend?”
No one expected Shi Yu. After all, when Shi Yu went to battle, he was only a level-six Beast Tamer.
However, the news at this moment was that Shi Yu had killed two totems above his level in the preliminaries, scaring everyone into not daring to fight and directly advancing to a world legend in the preliminaries??
“Why does this scene look familiar?” The Beast Tamer who had seen Shi Yu participate in the National League was stunned.
Killing totems??
How was this possible!!!
The totem level was a realm that even Normal legends had to look up to.
Even the basic conditions to obtain most legendary titles were only to fight against totems. They didn’t have to defeat them, let alone kill them.
And now, it actually said that Shi Yu killed two totems in a row? He even killed dozens of overlords?
Anyone who had read a few history books knew that in the thousands of years of Dong Huang’s history, only those Legendarys could easily do it.
But now… a second-year university student had completed such an Achievement in such a cruel battle. This shock almost shocked the entire country.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 996 It feels good to keep fusing (5)
chapters.content:
996 It feels good to keep fusing (5)
….
Most of Dong Huang’s personnel had already landed at the Demon Capital port. At this moment, President Lin was picking up Shi Yu’s call in confusion.
“Where are you, Shi Yu?” President Lin said.
“President Lin, I’m in Ping Cheng. After the World Tree Blessing ended, the World Tree directly teleported me back to the vicinity of Dong Huang.”
!!
“You’re actually already back…” President Lin heaved a sigh of relief and said,” Senior Divine Source, Lord Dragon God, Ying, and the other guardians of Dong Huang are still waiting for you in the Inatella Sea. ”
“But since you’re back, it’s fine. I’ll contact Senior Divine Source and the others through special methods to return.”
“You’ve worked hard,” Shi Yu said.
He should quickly get Teacher Cat back. He could imagine that the cat couldn’t wait to take away the inheritance crystal and become a top-notch totem.
“No… You’re the one who’s working hard,” President Lin said.
“Rest well first. If you have any thoughts next, tell me at any time.”
“Yes, alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
He really had an idea. After working overtime and entering seclusion for a period of time, he might not stay in Dong Huang for long…
He planned to bring Qi to the Space-time Dragon Vein to recuperate and train the Mythical Revival Skill.
In Qi’s words, as long as it used the Space-time Dragon Vein that had already recovered a portion of its energy because the Mythical stage was about to revive to quickly recover its power and absorb and store enough space-time energy, it could also transmigrate into space-time without the complete completion of the world’s laws.
However, the restrictions on transmigration would be slightly greater.
Its state was the same as Ancient God Golden Bull and the others. Even if it recovered, it was still very weak. Divine skill Space-time Travel could only be equivalent to quasi-divine skill Space-time Travel, and it couldn’t display all its strength.
Every time he transmigrated during the Cultivationless Age, he needed to consume a certain amount of the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein. Moreover, the year he transmigrated couldn’t be too long. Thousands of years was the limit. In the distant future, the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein might still be in a dried up state. If he went, he wouldn’t be able to return. It was even more extravagant to want to directly return to the Mythical Era.
Qi even suspected that because it had been too long, even if she recovered to her peak, it was still another matter if she could transmigrate back.
However, these were actually not problems. Shi Yu originally only wanted to return to the era of Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, and the empress to take a look. At the moment, he didn’t dare to have any thoughts about the Mythical Era. It was really because his strength didn’t meet the standard. He didn’t dare to go, afraid that he wouldn’t be able to return if he encountered danger.
However, if it was the era of Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, and the empress, Shi Yu felt that it was not a problem to take a trip after developing for a period of time.
The highest was the era of demigods. So be it. Who was afraid of who? If he couldn’t defeat them, couldn’t he run?
In the ancient totem battle, he wanted to be a shit stirrer.
He would bring Mother Dragon and Chi Tong to see General Mu Huiyin…
He would go and show Emperor Wu the Chaos Panda and take some inscription metal for the Fusion Skill…
Letting Susu PK Yun An and see if the Undying Dark Phoenix was Chi Tong’s biological mother… and if the empress was Chi Tong’s sister made Shi Yu look forward to it too much.
Cough, cough, cough. Of course, there was also the promise to the Dragon God to bring her to the Dragon Emperor Era. Shi Yu would definitely fulfill his promise. Master Yuan Meng was talking about him.
However, the Mythical remnant soul that injured the Dragon Emperor sounded a little fierce. He couldn’t even defeat a Legendary Beast Tamer, so Shi Yu didn’t plan to go too early. It was better to bring the Dragon God along to play after he could defeat a demigod. Otherwise, it would be sending himself to death.
He planned to use the totem war of the Emperor Wu Era to level up first. After all, the Yun Race sounded easy to fight and invincible.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 997 Contract and Awakening (1)
chapters.content:
997 Contract and Awakening (1)
Although there were many things he wanted to ask, in order to let Shi Yu rest well, President Lin didn’t talk to Shi Yu much.
Shi Yu was also happy to be free.
“Ah ~”
After Shi Yu hung up, he changed into his panda pajamas and found a bottle of Quas juice. He lay on the sofa feeling refreshed and pulled a pillow to close his eyes.
But after lying down for a while, he stood up.
“Master, Little Zi is awake.”
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to rest, but Ling suddenly called him.
“Coming, coming.”
Shi Yu directly crawled into the ruins space and entered the nursery. He looked at the white ball with clear eyes on the crib.
The Son of the Stars was still wrapped in the purple nebula. As its lying posture was squeezed into a ball, it immediately floated up happily when it saw Ling and Shi Yu flying over.
“Mi!! (Hungry.)”
“Why are you eating and sleeping… sleeping and eating?” Shi Yu stretched out his hand and let this guy land in his hand. He couldn’t help but complain.
Didn’t he just eat the World Tree Branch Liquid!
No wonder there were a large number of Sons of the Stars, but few survived…
“Mi!! (So hungry…)” The Son of the Stars said pitifully.
“Alright, alright, alright.” Shi Yu smiled.
“What do you want? Space Crystal? Or Space Strange Water? Or continue to absorb starlight?” Ling asked from the side.
No matter how knowledgeable it was, he didn’t have the slightest cultivation EXP of a Son of the Stars.
“I’ve asked the World Tree. Space crystals will do.”
Shi Yu said, “However, for a baby, these aren’t the best. The nutrients from the mother are still the best.”
Ling: “?”
Mother’s milk?
But wasn’t the World Tree Branch Liquid already fed by him?
Could it be that Shi Yu had asked the World Tree for another pile before it knew?
“There.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand. A black contract halo immediately appeared in his palm. Seeing this, Little Zi revealed a curious expression.
“Come here, then you won’t be hungry soon.”
Ling: !!!
Ling wanted to palm its forehead, but unfortunately, it didn’t have hands.
It immediately knew what Shi Yu meant. The Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space had the effect of providing nutrition and growth substances to pets.
As a level-seven legendary Beast Tamer blessed by the World Tree, if Shi Yu contracted a transcendent-level Little Purple, it was completely enough to provide it with enough growth nutrients.
“Looks like my top-notch intelligence can’t keep up with Master’s train of thought.”
“No, there’s something wrong with Master.”
As Ling complained, the Son of the Stars quickly flew over and entered the contract halo. It was contracted by Shi Yu almost without resistance and entered the Beast Taming Space.
As for the seventh contract slot in the first Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu thought for a moment and still gave it to Little Zi. After all, its growth could better lead to his breakthrough.
Level-eight, level-nine… It should be faster.
As for Little Ji and the others, they would wait for the opening of the second Beast Taming Space.
Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space was even more comfortable than the Legendary Ruins space. After entering, Little Purple was immediately obsessed.
If it were an ordinary legend Beast Tamer, the Beast Taming Space might not necessarily be as awesome and exciting as the Legendary Ruins Space, but the problem was that Shi Yu had been blessed by the World Tree.
At this moment, the comfort of his Beast Taming Space was about to exceed the Legendary Ruins and the Blue Sea Ruins.
If it weren’t for training, Eleven and the others didn’t even want to leave.
However… when Little Zi saw this bare Beast Taming Space, it felt a little desolate, forming a sharp difference from its body.
“Are you still hungry?” Shi Yu’s voice sounded in Little Zi’s ears.
“Mi! (Eating.)”
But it didn’t matter. As long as it could sleep comfortably and not be hungry, that was fine.
Little Zi immediately curled into a ball and rolled to a corner. It closed its eyes again with a satisfied expression and let its body automatically absorb the nutrients.
Shi Yu smiled and looked at Ling. “Speaking of which, I’ve reached level seven now. I think I can also modify the Beast Taming Space.”
“Yes,” Ling said.
“So troublesome.” Shi Yu sighed.
After Beast Tamers reached level seven, they could develop the Beast Taming Space. Etherealization, Sealing Technique, and Beast Taming Space modification could be mastered at this stage.
These three legendary Skills were very important to Beast Tamers.
The spatial skill of etherealization could ensure the survival of Beast Tamers in dangerous battles.
As for the sealing technique, it could allow Beast Tamers to suppress transcendent lives through the Beast Taming Space.
Any legendary Beast Tamer could restrict pets of the same level and suppress low-level pets alone as long as they were proficient in the sealing technique.
The methods Senior Ji Mengzhu used to seal the Black Meteorite Yak and the Pirate King used to seal the Vortex Demon Beast were all sealing techniques.
...
As for the modification of the Beast Taming Space, it was easier to understand. After the Beast Tamer’s Beast Taming Space reached level seven, it would also become a small world. It was actually no different from the mystic realm space and the ruins space.
Beast Tamers could use various natural treasures or Beast Taming Talents to modify the environment of the Beast Taming Space. They could transform it into an ocean environment, a forest environment, or a volcano environment…
This environment was also enhanced for the habitat of pets.
At the same time, the entire Beast Taming Space could also be fused into a large whole.
At the low level, the pets contracted by Beast Tamers were basically sleeping and half awake in the Beast Taming Space, as if they were lying in a nutritional cabin.
Apart from the pets contracted by Beast Tamers with telepathy talent, every contracted creature couldn’t communicate.
However, after the Legend level, the Beast Taming Space of a legend Beast Tamer could be like the ruins space, allowing all contracted pets to be in the same space. Moreover, in this space, the consciousness state of the pets would also be incomparably clear and they could communicate with each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 998 Contract and Awakening (2)
chapters.content:
998 Contract and Awakening (2)
However, because he had just broken through, Shi Yu had yet to modify the space.
Moreover… Even after modification, Eleven and the others couldn’t train in the Beast Taming Space.
That… would destroy Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space… It was no different from breaking free from the contract. It could directly take Shi Yu’s life.
Of course, Shi Yu felt that if it were a normal pet, just sleeping in the Beast Taming Space was much better than normal training and growth effects.
Unfortunately, Eleven and the others were abnormal. In addition, it was more efficient to add points.
Shi Yu said, “Moreover, Little Zi’s inner space has to be modified…”
“Take your time.” Shi Yu sat down again and said, “Ling, I’ll sleep for a while. Call me when Teacher Ying returns.”
“Okay.”
….
Shi Yu slept in a daze and felt that he slept very soundly.
A long time later.
“Meow!!!”
In the sky above the Demon Capital Sea, the gem cat was flying crazily in the direction of Ping Cheng!!
Boom!!
The aftermath of its flight caused monstrous waves, shocking the little fish and shrimps below.
A moment later.
Ping Cheng.
A cat appeared outside Shi Yu’s room. It looked around and kept knocking on the space.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, I’m here!!”
“I want to evolve into a nine-colored meow!”
…
“Why are you so fast!!”
Shi Yu was called out by Ling with a splitting headache. He looked at the gem cat in front of him and didn’t understand why it had rushed back from Inatella so quickly.
He felt that he had not slept for long…
“Guess.” The gem cat chuckled.
“No thanks. Take it.” Shi Yu rubbed his temples and took out the inheritance crystal of the nine-colored divine light, preparing to throw it to the gem cat.
Gem Cat: o(〃’▽’〃)o
However.
Shi Yu held the inheritance crystal and did not throw it out.
The gem cat: “?”
Wu wu wu.
The gem cat looked at the inheritance crystal eagerly.
“By the way…” Shi Yu said,” Teacher Cat, do me a favor. ”
“Tell me, tell me.” The gem cat still looked at the inheritance crystal eagerly.
“I’ll tell you when I’ve thought about it.”
The gem cat: “?”
The gem cat took the inheritance crystal and muttered, “Fine!”
It had already expected that this inheritance crystal was equivalent to a slave contract. So be it!
As long as it didn’t fight demigods, everything was fine.
“Then I’ll absorb it.” The gem cat took the inheritance crystal and immediately couldn’t wait.
As for Shi Yu, he also nodded heavily. He was curious about how far the gem cat’s strength could reach after accepting the nine-colored divine light inheritance.
If it was weak, it would stay in Dong Huang and work for him. It would be in charge of helping train the various armies.
If it was strong, he would pull it beside him and continue to be a bodyguard…
After the gem cat entered the independent space and began to enter seclusion to absorb it, Shi Yu gradually woke up.
Although he didn’t sleep for long, with various supplements in his stomach, sleep was only to better absorb the medicinal effect.
Shi Yu stretched and sat on the sofa. He was just about to watch television and see how the major media outlets were bragging about him when suddenly, the second Beast Taming Space loosened a little.
“Holy shit.”
Shi Yu was shocked and suddenly stood up. He didn’t notice it just now, but now that he sensed it carefully, his first Beast Taming Space and second Beast Taming Space were automatically strengthening?
It was as if he was meditating at all times.
Although it was much lower than his own meditation efficiency, only 1%, it was automatic.
“Is this also the benefit of contracting the Son of the Stars?” Shi Yu hurriedly sat down again. He sensed the loosening of the second Beast Taming Space. At this moment, he had also entered a meditative state.
He wanted to immediately open up the second Beast Taming Space and know what the talent attached to this Beast Taming Space was.
About two minutes later.
The chaotic second Beast Taming Space formed a transparent spatial crystal wall. A level-one Beast Taming Space that represented trainee Beast Tamers slowly opened in Shi Yu’s body.
...
Shi Yu could sense that it and the first Beast Taming Space were independent of each other. They might not be able to fuse together in the short term.
At this moment, this was not what Shi Yu was most concerned about. What concerned Shi Yu the most was…
Boom!!
Shi Yu suddenly opened his eyes.
He had really awakened a new Beast Taming Talent.
However, Shi Yu did not expect this Beast Taming Talent no matter what.
“How can it be this talent…” Shi Yu was stunned.
He wouldn’t be surprised if another telepathy talent attached to two Beast Taming Spaces.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect that he had actually awakened the “body control” talent.
That’s right, it was the body control talent of Legend Bai Chuan of the Seven Islands.
The one he plundered through the Talent Bead…
...
At this moment, the Talent Bead was still in his hand. He had actually awakened the same talent for a moment. It was no wonder that Shi Yu was stunned.
“Is this because I’ve used the Talent Control Bead too many times?”
“If that’s the case, fortunately, it didn’t awaken the ‘Awakening Talent’. This talent is really useless.”
After all, Shi Yu had no intention of changing his profession to a full-time Mechanic.
Body control talent…
Shi Yu’s expression was complicated, but soon, he smiled in satisfaction.
It was not a loss!!
It was better than some metal-element strengthening talent and fire-element strengthening talent.
Although it was inferior to talents like time, spatial strengthening, and evolution, it was still a first-rate talent.
Although he had a Body Control Talent Bead, it didn’t affect him at all.
The talent level plundered from the plundering tool depended on the talent level of the original Beast Tamer. After passing by, it couldn’t grow.
In other words, the physical control talent of the Talent Bead was equivalent to the development level of a level-seven Beast Tamer.
However, Shi Yu’s own physical control talent could be raised to legendary and divine level as the second Beast Taming Space leveled up.
For Shi Yu to better develop his body, Spirit, soul, and mental strength next, this talent was more useful than most talents.
Moreover, the physical control talent could also be used on pets. It could help pets better control their physical strength.
Perhaps… it would be helpful to help Little Zi open up its inner world and help Duckie master the abyss form.
These were all high-level usage methods. Apart from that, the body control talent could also freely control oneself. For example, if Shi Yu wanted to change his appearance and hair color, he didn’t need the Time Fruit at all.
When he developed his body control talent, he could become anything he wanted. He could even do a gender transformation. However, maintaining his new form required more physical strength.
With the talent EXP of Legend Bai Chuan’s life, Shi Yu still knew this talent very well.
“It’s another support talent like telepathy and the Skill Index. This might not be the best talent, but it should be the most suitable talent for me at the moment,” Shi Yu said.
Very good, when he went abroad to have fun later, it would be easier to rely on his physical control talent to change his appearance.
Moreover…
“Interesting.” Shi Yu activated the contract halo of the second Beast Taming Space and the summoning array.
He looked at the almost transparent summoning array in front of him and was directly amused.
Wasn’t this the formation phenomenon of a Beast Tamer intern?
“The colors of the spatial crystal wall are also separated. This way, if I contract Little Ji in the second space later and summon it, no one will think that I’m a legend Beast Tamer. Instead, they will think that I’m a low-level Beast Tamer.”
“Coupled with my physical control talent, even in front of demigods, probably no one can recognize me as Shi Yu…”
“But these are all superficial. The most important thing is to quickly increase my battle power. The truth is to be able to fight a demigod head-on.”
After awakening his new talent, Shi Yu felt that his current physical state was surprisingly good. He couldn’t help but take out the Eternal Flower he had collected.
This was a divine-level resource.
Eat it and its lifespan would immediately increase by 10,000 years!
Before its lifespan was exhausted, it would never Decrepify and would always maintain its peak state!
Shi Yu took a deep breath. Without a word, he ate the divine-level resource himself.
The World Tree Fruit that represented comprehension, the Undying Fruit that represented the soul… Now, in addition to the Eternal Flower that represented life, after eating it, Shi Yu planned to immediately try the fusion of super skills!

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 999 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (1)
chapters.content:
999 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (1)
Ping Cheng.
In an inconspicuous villa.
Shi Yu swallowed the Eternal Flower in a few bites.
At this moment, Shi Yu felt that he was more valuable than a demigod.
!!
Even demigods weren’t that extravagant with three divine-level resources!
After eating the Eternal Flower, Shi Yu immediately sensed the changes in his body.
With the help of his body’s control talent, he saw the Eternal Flower enter his body. It turned into white light and flowed to various parts of his body.
This was because at this moment, every organ and drop of blood in Shi Yu’s body seemed to be enveloped in the light of evolution, undergoing a life transition.
It wasn’t very uncomfortable. Instead, it was very comfortable.
Buzz!!
Under the watering of the life force, Shi Yu’s life aura rose steadily.
The strengthening of the physique by the power of life was incomparably powerful. It was like a life furnace shaping eternity in Shi Yu’s body. In a short moment, Shi Yu’s vitality fluctuations directly exceeded the so-called demigod!
Boom!!
Under the enhancement of ten thousand years of lifespan, tempting life source power flowed out of Shi Yu’s body. In an alternate space, the gem cat, who was receiving the inheritance, suddenly opened its eyes.
“What’s going on!”
It subconsciously wiped its saliva, thinking that Shi Yu had sent Baby Ginseng out to deliberately release its aura.
“Damn it.”
This was because at the critical moment of the inheritance, the gem cat ignored it too much and directly sealed the space even more, preventing Shi Yu from disturbing it.
At this moment, Shi Yu could clearly sense his temptation.
He… had probably become like Baby Ginseng.
He became a divine-level supplement.
Although it wasn’t as exaggerated as the Tang Monk’s meat that demons could eat and live forever, if any ferocious beast ate it, it shouldn’t be a problem to extend its lifespan by a thousand years.
“Wu…”
“Fortunately, I have the talent of physical control and can restrain all power.”
“Otherwise, there’s no need for Baby Ginseng to fish at all in the future. I’ll do it myself.”
Shi Yu opened his eyes and clenched his fists as he said casually.
BOOM!
A boom immediately appeared in his palm, as if the air had exploded.
He smiled and felt that he was even stronger now.
Awesome.
If the three top-notch Mythical resources were given to other transcendent lives, they could even spend some time to pile up a demigod. Although it didn’t seem to increase much on him and he hadn’t reached totem-level battle power, Shi Yu was abnormally satisfied.
“This way, I can better deal with high-level battles. I don’t have to worry about becoming a burden to my pet.”
Shi Yu clenched his fists again.
In beast taming battles, Beast Tamers with weak physiques were a very big weakness, especially in legendary battles. Even with etherealization, it was still not enough. However, Shi Yu felt that his current state was just right.
It was weaker than the contracted pets, but it wasn’t much weaker either. It wouldn’t become a target that the enemy could easily behead. It would also be easier for him to fight side by side with his pets.
Most importantly, in this state, he felt that he could increase his points even more crazily… This was the key!
….
After Shi Yu completed his evolution, he came to the ruins space without a word.
He directly pulled Buggy over.
Buggy was speechless.
Buggy shouted excitedly.
It was here, it was here. Its turn, fusion!!
[Space Pocket, Space Shackles, Instant Transmission, Concealment] Shi Yu first dragged four high-level spatial Skills into the furnace.
The success rate of fusion was extremely high.
This had never happened before.
This couldn’t help but make Shi Yu even bolder as he threw [Space Control] in.
The success rate was high!
This scene simply touched Shi Yu. After all, the success rate of fusing super skills previously had not reached “medium”.
This time, it directly became high.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu tried a few more skills and discovered that the success rate of the fusion of the two super skills was still low and extremely low.
However, a super Skill with a low-level skill with pretty good compatibility had a high chance of success.
Under Buggy’s expectant gaze, Shi Yu said,
“Buggy, I’ll let you try fusing three skills first.”
“Wu!! (Anything!!)” Buggy looked excited and rushed forward.
...
A moment later, Shi Yu pulled the little green dragon and began the skill fusion.
[Bug Silk, Worm Command, Ultimate Absorption] had already fused into [Queen Mother’s Power].
Skill: Queen Mother’s Power
< Introduction > It’s a bug-element super Skill. It has obtained the power of Juggernaut and can control all life and non-life.
“Damn.”
“Impressive.”
