Buggy and Shi Yu widened their eyes immediately.
Buggy was shocked and almost thought that it had become a female.
The power of a Queen Mother!
It directly turned into a Race Skill and inherited most of the Effects of the three bug-type skills.
Not only could it rely on the parasitic thread to enslave and control other lives, but it could also rely on the power of the Juggernaut to extract the enemy’s life and energy. This skill could also rely on a Spirit connection, such as through the power of faith to better borrow the power of believers and citizens.
...
In terms of the upper limit of the Skill potential, it was much stronger than the three skills.
Moreover…
After Shi Yu successfully fused a super skill for the first time, he suddenly realized that the Ultimate Absorption of the super skill that he had just fused had a deletion symbol that appeared on the Skill Index.
This stunned Shi Yu slightly. The super Skill that participated in the fusion could be directly deleted from the Skill Index?
“Continue, continue.” This time, he had only fused three skills. Although one of them was super, Shi Yu didn’t feel tired. It was purely because his current physique was too terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 1000 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (2)
chapters.content:
1000 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (2)
Soon, Shi Yu upheld the principle of proximity and fused Buggy’s [Space Pocket, Space Shackles, Instant Transmission, Concealment, and Space Control]. However, in the end, what made Shi Yu feel cheated was that he didn’t know if it succeeded or failed.
Buggy: (⊙?⊙) Wu…
The fusion of these five skills still resulted in [Space Control].
The only change was the non-racial Skill Space Control. Just like the power of the Queen Mother, it directly became Buggy’s racial Skill.
!!
It was this time that spatial control didn’t appear in the Skill column like the Ultimate Absorption. The mechanism was very strange.
Shi Yu and Buggy were stunned for a moment before ignoring it. After thinking about it, they felt that it was normal. After all, spatial control was the high-level Skill of the four high-level spatial skills. Their effects could also be achieved by spatial control, so it was natural for the fusion to be covered.
“Wu!! (Shi Yu, continue!!)” Buggy was extremely excited. As two new super Race Skills were added, it felt that its various Stats had been greatly improved.
Its battle power was stronger.
Defeating the Leader and the baby ginseng was just around the corner.
“Continue my ass!” Shi Yu looked at the greedy Buggy and said, “I’ve already fused it for you twice. It’s Susu and Ling’s turn.”
Buggy: (? ??? ???)??° Hehe, alright.
“Bring Susu here.”
“Wuu! (Roger!)” Buggy directly flashed and left, its spatial control becoming more proficient.
After experimenting with Buggy, Shi Yu realized that the more ordinary the super skill, the easier it was to fuse with other skills.
On the other hand, complicated multi-attribute rare Skills like Buggy’s Imagination Domain and the Dragon of Imagination had an extremely low fusion success rate.
At the moment, Shi Yu only fused skills with “high success rate”. It was mainly because his stamina consumption was low. It was always satisfying to fuse.
“Ning!!”
“Ning!!”
Then, Susu was teleported over by Buggy with starry eyes.
It jumped onto its blue jelly body and flew into Shi Yu’s arms.
Susu had many skills. However, because it was still at the monarch level, the proficiency of the super Race Skill had yet to be perfect, so it couldn’t be fused.
The lowest threshold for proficiency in skill fusion was perfect level. If it was too low, it couldn’t be fused.
As for Susu’s super non-racial Skills, Heavenly Frost Cold Energy and Infinite Devour, which had reached perfect proficiency, they were also skills that were almost impossible to successfully fuse.
Therefore, he could only start with low-level Skills.
Shi Yu smiled and pinched it in his hand, dragging it in one by one… He realized that the compatibility between the Time Water Droplet and other skills was the worst. Everything else was alright.
“It’s starting.”
“Ning! (Yay.)”
[Bubble, Boiling Water, Frozen Water, Water Regeneration, Water Dragon Ball, Steam Explosion, Purification, Praying Rain, Blizzard] had already fused into [Water/Quasi Elemental Control].
Shi Yu and Susu: “…?”
Huh?
Both parties were stunned, but they quickly fell silent.
There was nothing to say about this. It was a huge failure.
The situation was probably similar to the spatial control time. The Skill Effect was covered by high-level skills.
Water/Quarter Elemental Control was originally Susu’s racial Skill. This fusion made it lonely.
However, with this fusion, the proficiency of this skill, Susu, became more and more difficult to suppress. It had already reached the limit of breaking through.
This made Shi Yu realize that he had to arrange for Susu and Ling to break through as soon as possible.
But before that…
[Poison Resistance, Lightning Resistance, Star Sea, Four Symbols Star Formation, Absolute Sleep] had already fused into [Starry Sky Power].
“(?????) Ning!!!”
On the other hand, the second time he gambled blindly, he directly bet a pretty good super Skill for Shi Yu and the others.
“Aiyo, not bad,” Shi Yu said in surprise.
Skill: Power of the Starry Sky
< Introduction > It can mobilize the mysterious power in the starry sky and complete the strengthening of itself.
Not only could this skill continue to summon resources in the starry sky, but it could also directly use the power of the starry sky to recover injuries and stamina. The increase in energy and the strengthening of various Elemental resistance could be said to have not been fused for nothing.
Most importantly, it had also become a Race Skill.
Shi Yu felt that this move could still be taught to Buggy. It should also have the compatibility to learn it.
At this moment, Shi Yu was immersed in the skill fusion and couldn’t extricate himself. Although he had only fused low-level skills into super skills and had yet to fuse a divine skill, it had already made him very happy.
However, the happiest at the moment was definitely not Shi Yu, Buggy, Susu, and the others, but…
Boom!!!
With a loud bang from the outside world, a huge aura enveloped the world. Nine-colored rainbows could be seen in the sky above the entire Icefield City.
Icefield City, including the Beast Tamer Association institutions in the surrounding cities, instantly detected energy fluctuations that exceeded the level of Normal totems. They were all shocked as if they were facing a great enemy.
“Enemy attack!! Enemy attack!!!”
In the ruins space, Shi Yu also sensed the vibration of space and hurriedly ran out. He looked at the phenomenon in the sky and understood what was going on.
In midair, a gem cat with nine-colored jade-like eyes gathered between the nine-colored divine light and emitted a powerful aura. It was simply stronger than most top-notch totems Shi Yu had seen in Inatella.
...
“Oh no…” In the sky, just like how Shi Yu couldn’t immediately control the aura after eating the divine-level resource and completing his evolution, the gem cat completed the inheritance and didn’t immediately control the power, directly causing changes in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 1001 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (3)
chapters.content:
1001 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (3)
The gem cat immediately panicked, because the country prohibited life forms above the overlord level from randomly releasing their auras in non-combat venues in cities… At this moment, it probably made several associations feel like they were facing a great enemy.
In order to not cause turmoil in the various cities, the gem cat was so scared that it hurriedly restrained its strength and slipped back into the alternate space dejectedly. It spatially jumped into Shi Yu’s villa.
At the same time.
Shi Yu’s communicator sounded almost immediately.
From the association headquarters, President Lin.
“Shi Yu, what happened in Ping Cheng? You’re in Ping Cheng, right?”
“It reached the headquarters so quickly ~” Beside him, the gem cat widened its eyes and whispered.
“It’s nothing. I just gave the inheritance crystal of the nine-colored divine light to the guardian, Teacher Ying. It just broke through.”
On the other side, President Lin’s expression turned cold. “You actually gave the inheritance crystal of the nine-colored divine light to the guardian Ying??”
President Lin’s first thought was that it was a huge loss. His second thought was to forget it. After all, it belonged to Shi Yu. It was up to Shi Yu to give it to whoever he wanted.
The guardian Ying was also a part of Dong Huang.
At the same time, President Lin couldn’t help but be surprised by Shi Yu’s generosity. This was an inheritance that could be said to be a divine-level resource. He actually gave it away just like that.
“It’s good that nothing else happened. Looks like Teacher Ying’s gains are pretty good. Congratulations to her for me. Also, how’s your rest?”
“I’ve almost recovered from my Restoration. President Lin, do you have any Quests?”
“No, I just want to ask you what you think of the next world competition.”
“Did you obtain any relevant information about the next World Tournament and more information about Mythical Revival from the World Tree?”
Shi Yu said, “No.”
“The World Tree isn’t sure of the next competition time either.”
“Is that so…” President Lin fell into deep thought and said,” But speaking of which, did you say back then that you wanted to exchange for other resources for the Soul Pearl of the archeological Conference? ”
“Have you thought about what resources to exchange for?”
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “I want to change to a ‘sharp’ ‘metal Stats’ resource, but after returning, I searched the resource bank and didn’t find anything suitable…”
“This…” On the other side, President Lin said,” At the moment, Dong Huang indeed doesn’t have metal-element resources of a similar nature. ”
“But wait a while. I can see if I can buy it from other countries.”
“Actually, there’s no hurry. If you don’t have it either, forget it.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“I happen to have a goal too.”
“Oh?” President Lin was stunned. “Tell me, I’ll see if Dong Huang can help you obtain it.”
“The information I found on the Intelligence Bureau Index seems to be that there’s a suitable divine-level metal material in the ruins of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.”
“I like that one.”
“I feel that it’s better than Legendary resources.”
President Lin: “?”
“What??”
The Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation was an island country. The humans inside were similar to the Heavenly Fox Nation. It was the second largest race, a demigod-level totem faction. It was at the border between the east and west. Because it was beaten very badly by Dong Huang and the Seven Islands in the last totem battle, it had been in seclusion all year round. In addition, due to the national situation, like Dragon Palace City, it didn’t respond to this world competition.
The mechanism of the ruins of this country was trials and inheritances. It was naturally an important place. Shi Yu had targeted this place??
He regretted sending a spy here to collect information.
This directly hooked Shi Yu over. How could this be?
President Lin said, “What do you want to do…”
Shi Yu said, “Cough, cough…”
Shi Yu wanted to find metal resources, but he was actually preparing to give them to Chi Tong as evolution materials.
After he taught Chi Tong’s soul incarnation, every clone could be cultivated individually and needed a large number of cultivation resources.
Shi Yu’s idea was to nurture Chi Tong’s clone according to the template of the Immortal Slaying Four Swords.
The Immortal Slaying Sword had endless changes. Shi Yu planned to use the spatial resources, the Heart Flame and the Spirit World Fragment, to nurture it. Coupled with other spatial resources, he would specialize in array skills in the future.
Red light rose everywhere on the Immortal Trapping Sword. Shi Yu planned to nurture it into a fire-element sword.
The Immortal Slaying Sword represented “death”. Shi Yu planned to let it specialize in the power of undead.
As for the final Immortal Slaying Sword, it represented “interest”. It definitely needed metal-element resources. Shi Yu recalled that he still had the “Life Flame” that could help undead shape their entities. He couldn’t help but have the thought of turning a clone into a metal-element sharp immortal sword.
As a sword spirit, it naturally had to have a physical sword to possess it to display its strongest power.
Shi Yu’s first goal was the divine-level metal of this totem country. If he couldn’t get it, it would depend on whether Dong Huang could find a suitable one. If not, he would let Eleven create one.
However, although Eleven’s creation was not bad, it was inferior to Legendary resources, let alone divine-level resources. Shi Yu felt that if it evolved and wasn’t strong enough, its racial potential definitely couldn’t catch up to Eleven and the others.
It was still the legendary divine-level metal-element meteor iron that looked fragrant. If it was given to Chi Tong to evolve, it might be able to evolve into a Mythical Race.
“Didn’t the information say that this ruin of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation is also a trial ruin? Moreover, the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation opens it to the geniuses of the various large factions in the country every year.”
“So I want to go over and take a look and see if I can participate.”
“I’ll take out the divine-level resources inside.”
“The records on it are quite comprehensive. This ruin only tests the candidate’s Sword Dao talent. I feel that we can give it a try.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 1002 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (4)
chapters.content:
1002 It’s So exciting to pet the gem cat and run (4)
“Is that the problem…” President Lin couldn’t help but say.
You’ve just become famous in the World Tournament, and you’re going to the demigod territory?
Shi Yu said, “I can use my control talent to change my form. As long as I infiltrate a large faction, obtain a participation spot, and successfully enter the ruins, no matter the outcome, I can instantly leave that country with the Blue Sea Ruins.”
“President Lin, don’t worry. I’ve already broken through to the Legend level and am about to have a whole team of overlord.”
!!
“I definitely have to digest the inheritance of the World Tournament and have enough strength before going.”
“I won’t move for the time being.”
Shi Yu planned to wait until all the overlords had almost fused their skills and the second Beast Taming Space was almost opened up before going.
After all, Chi Tong’s skills had yet to be taught, so what was the hurry to nurture resources?
President Lin was stunned. He had already broken through to the legend level?
“Let me think…”
He fell into deep thought. Indeed, Shi Yu was no longer the child who still needed protection.
With Shi Yu’s strength, he was probably good enough to steadily rank in the top five in Dong Huang.
In this situation, in addition to the BUG Teleportation ability of the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu might not necessarily be unable to escape even if he faced a demigod.
In the end, President Lin gave up persuading him and said, “Then choose two other Legendary resources from the resource bank to increase your strength. In addition, if you want to leave the country, you have to tell me in advance.”
“No problem,” Shi Yu said.
…
“No way, no way, you’re going out to play again.” The gem cat, who had just broken through, looked at Shi Yu nervously.
What did it just say? As long as Shi Yu didn’t let it fight a demigod, anything was fine.
But why was Shi Yu going to the demigod territory to wreak havoc in the ruins in the blink of an eye?
“Eh, Teacher Ying, you want to go too?” Shi Yu said.
“I… can go too. With my current strength, I should be able to easily protect you below the demigod level,” the gem cat said with a long sigh.
“Actually, I can go myself. Teacher Cat, help me do a few things first.” Shi Yu chuckled.
He took out three things: the ruins ring, the ruins bracelet, and the Control Talent Bead.
The gem cat was stunned.
What?
“This ruin ring belongs to Bureau 11. I don’t need it anymore. Help me pass it to Principal Feng.”
This was the plant ruin that Baby Ginseng had previously used to farm. There were already many crops such as the Phoenix Fruit, Reincarnation Fruit, and Soul Heart Fruit, but now, as his Beast Taming Space blessed by the World Tree reached level seven, this was no longer needed.
It was better to farm directly in his Beast Taming Space. It was time to return it to its owner.
“As for this Talent Control Bead, I don’t need it anymore. Leave it to Senior Lu.”
Now that Shi Yu had awakened his control talent, this was useless. He hoped that Senior Lu could rely on this to develop abilities similar to the mind domain. If there was no progress, he would give it to Senior White Brook to see if she could develop a top-notch fusion talent.
In short, there were many uses. The blessings of the next World Tournament depended on them.
“As for this ruin ring, give it to Senior Lu too. Let her pass it to Fang Lan when she’s free and let her use it in Bureau 11.”
“That’s it?” The gem cat was stunned. It thought it was something big, but it turned out to be a delivery.
No, delivery? Damn it.
“What else is there to give?” the gem cat said.
“There’s one more thing you have to take good care of.” Shi Yu chuckled and said,
“Help me send the Demon King Dragon Bone to Mother Dragon in Dragon Palace City and say that it’s the return on its last investment.”
The gem cat: “?”
Demon King Dragon Bone? That divine-level evolution material?
“What investment!!”
“I want to invest too,” it immediately said.
“Go, go, go. Didn’t I already give you the legendary crystal of the nine-colored divine light? This is a gift to thank Teacher Ying. What else do you want!!”
“Ah… It’s alright, it’s alright.” The gem cat grinned. Well, not bad, very filial.
“By the way.”
“Teacher Ying.”
“Look, a flying saucer.”
The gem cat was stunned and immediately turned to look out the window.
In the next moment, it felt Shi Yu rubbing its body from head to toe.
Shi Yu had almost forgotten. He had yet to replicate the nine-colored divine light and immediately operated it!
“???”
The gem cat suddenly turned around and looked at Shi Yu, who had slipped away, in extreme anger. “Bastard kid, what are you doing!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 1003 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation
chapters.content:
1003 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation
After Shi Yu successfully replicated the nine-colored divine light from the gem cat, the gem cat was furious.
Bold!
Did he not know what it meant to respect one’s master!
Although their batch of cats had been sent to Ancient Capital University as pets for the teachers and students to pet, what was its identity now!
!!
It was angry!
The gem cat looked down at the ruins ring, ruins bracelet, and Talent Bead Shi Yu had thrown down and became angry!
This guy, it won’t deliver for him anymore!
However.
To its surprise, Shi Yu suddenly crawled back from the ruins space with a calm expression.
The gem cat: “?”
“Teacher Ying, there’s one more thing I need your help with.”
The gem cat: “?”
“After you’re done with these things, if you’re free, help me go to Inatella to take a look. That Ancient God Golden Bull still owes me a reward!”
Shi Yu was also angry. “If Inatella doesn’t open it, wait a little longer. If it’s open, go and see if the World Tree and Ancient God Golden Bull are awake.”
“If it woke up, help me urge the debt and inform me.”
The gem cat: “?”
“If the debt is urged, I’ll give you a share.”
“You can let your clone go. With Teacher Ying’s current strength, it shouldn’t be difficult to do.”
The gem cat: “Deal.”
“Sigh.” Shi Yu sighed. If Ancient God Golden Bull could awaken in a short period of time and obtain the divine-level metal-element resources it needed, Shi Yu didn’t plan to go to the totem country to play.
Although he was indeed interested in ruins and resources, there were risks after all.
Of course, Shi Yu felt that the greatest reason why he went out to have fun might still be because he couldn’t stay.
He wondered how long he could last this time…
Shi Yu and the gem cat happily made the decision to harm their clones and guard the island.
…
Then, Shi Yu continued to wreak havoc in Dong Huang’s resource bank.
After he handed over the divine-level resource, the Soul Pearl, President Lin chose to let him casually choose two Legendary resources to strengthen his strength.
President Lin should have just said it casually because he knew that Shi Yu really didn’t lack resources at the moment.
However, Shi Yu still looked at it seriously.
He planned to choose a Legendary resource for Susu and Ling to use to break through to the overlord level.
In the end, Shi Yu chose two relatively simple Legendary resources with the most common Effects for Susu and Ling.
Level-nine ice and wind energy crystals.
They were all pure strengthening-type resources that could increase one’s own Stats energy.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want a better one, but that there was nothing more suitable.
Recently, the consumption of high-level resources in Dong Huang had been very serious. Most of the more precious Legendary resources were in the hands of individuals, and there weren’t many choices left in the national resource bank.
However, although these two resources were basic, they were enough to strengthen monarch-level and overlord-level pets.
It could easily strengthen a monarch to the overlord level and strengthen an ordinary overlord to a top-notch overlord.
After applying, Shi Yu waited for the officials to deliver it to his door.
“Next, I’ll continue to work overtime!!”
By the window, the wind blew in, making Shi Yu’s hair sway messily. He took a deep breath and turned around to return to the ruins with a determined expression.
…
Two months later.
In the past two months, Shi Yu had invested all his points in the skill fusion.
Even if it was meditation, it didn’t take much time to do it. It relied on Little Purple’s automatic EXP package.
In the past two months, there had been a lot of things, but Shi Yu basically didn’t participate much.
At the celebration banquet of the World Tournament, he only ate and drank with Senior Lu and other familiar faces.
He didn’t even appear when the demigod factions like the Endless Sea and the Ghost Sea came to form an alliance. He handed them all to President Lin and the others to deal with.
There were also many other things related to Shi Yu.
On the surface, Dong Huang had a new festival, the Green Dragon Festival.
After the World Tournament ended, the country didn’t directly say that Shi Yu had cultivated a green dragon. Instead, it planned to subtly arouse people’s faith in the green dragon. Therefore, apart from some higher-ups and spectators of the World Tournament, not many ordinary Beast Tamers knew that Shi Yu had cultivated a green dragon.
It was better to maintain a mysterious and noble feeling for the gods they believed in.
Apart from that, the new National League ended. As Shi Yu didn’t participate, Ancient Capital University couldn’t get first place with their results this time, but they were also ranked in the top three.
The name of the fusion genius An Chang, who controlled the sea dragon, spread.
In the Dong Huang Recruit Martial Arts Tournament, the Nine Li Battle Beast Army led by Lin Xiuzhu also obtained first place in the entire army’s new army martial arts tournament. Their next goal was to challenge Ye Xing’s Star Army.
...
On Dragon Palace City’s side, Dragon Mother, who had obtained divine-level resources, even evolved into a Frost Demon Dragon. Just like the gem cat, she mixed into the strength of a top-notch totem and had a chance of reaching the Divine level, becoming a tyrant in Dragon Palace City.
The touched Dragon Mother took the initiative to be the Green Dragon Promotion Ambassador of Dragon Palace City and nurture believers in place of Shi Yu and Buggy.
Most importantly, Shi Yu had also gained a lot after cultivating bitterly for three months.
Firstly, Susu and Ling also used perfect proficiency Skills, Legendary resources, and overlord Resistance to break through to the overlord level.
At this point, all the members of Team One had reached overlord!
As for Little Zi… Although it was contracted in the first Beast Taming Space, clearly, Shi Yu had yet to treat it as a teammate.
Because its will level was too low. Even with the strengthening of the nine-colored divine light, it couldn’t teach super Skills at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 1004 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation (2)
chapters.content:
1004 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation (2)
Therefore, after two months of cultivation, it only reached commander rank.
Shi Yu’s cultivation focus was temporarily not on it.
Moreover, Little Zi was still a baby. It should have a happy childhood.
In the past two months, Shi Yu’s greatest gains were Eleven and the others’ skills!
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and the others had almost all their skills fused by Shi Yu!!
At this moment, there were almost no low, intermediate, or high-level skills on them. They all held several super top-notch skills.
Moreover, the proficiency of these super top-notch Skills was all perfect.
Only a few special high-level Skills that were difficult to fuse, such as the Time Fruit and the Memory Water, were still left. For the time being, there were no suitable fusion targets.
In fact, Shi Yu still wanted to continue fusing, but the remaining super skills were all extremely strong super skills. The success rate of fusing with other super skills was [extremely low].
For example, Buggy’s Green Dragon Roar, Dragon Raising Its Head, Multiplication, Absolute Sleep, Super Sight, High Speed Healing, Heart Strike, Deterrence, and a bunch of other Skills were fused by Shi Yu into [Faith Physique Skill, Green Dragon Indestructible Body].
This physique skill could be said to be awesome to the point of explosion. Without relying on other abilities, Eleven’s individual Demon God Body could only be crushed in front of the Green Dragon Indestructible Body.
This skill was the same as Susu’s Blue Sea Contract. It was really too difficult to continue fusing with other super top-notch skills.
Perhaps the skill proficiency was insufficient. Perhaps the success rate of fusion would be higher after reaching transcendent.
It was also possible that Shi Yu’s physique and pet’s will were failing again and needed to continue breaking through.
But no matter what, it couldn’t continue fusing.
However, Shi Yu felt that if the remaining Skills could be fused, they would definitely be quasi-divine skills.
For example, what if the power of the starry sky and the Blue Sea Contract fused into a Star Sea Contract?
Therefore, Shi Yu could be said to be both regretful and looking forward to it.
At the moment, he had laid the foundation. It was up to the subsequent divine-level fusion.
After completing the fusion, there were not many choices waiting for Shi Yu.
First, replicate more Skills and continue fusing.
Second, adding points to the fused super Skill, the target was close to transcendent.
Third, meditation cultivation.
Fourth, add points to quasi-divine skills.
Firstly, Shi Yu had to give up. His skill proficiency had yet to be maxed out, so it was useless to have so many skills. Fourthly, it was because of the success rate of adding points to quasi-divine skills. The Skill Index also showed that it was extremely low, so Shi Yu did not dare to take that risk for the time being.
Therefore, in the end, Shi Yu chose to add some super Skills to them. Then, he meditated and cultivated the first and second Beast Taming Space.
As for the cultivation results, they were also gratifying. Although it didn’t take much time, Shi Yu still cultivated the second Beast Taming Space to level four.
At the level of high-level Beast Tamers.
Under normal circumstances, he could contract a commander-level pet.
However, with Shi Yu’s current physique, it was definitely not a problem for him to contract a monarch above his level in the second space.
However, it was more dangerous for overlords. After all, if their physiques could withstand it, the space was difficult to withstand.
Two months was actually not long. The strength of the entire team had increased greatly. However, at this moment, Shi Yu finally couldn’t sit still anymore.
He was tired of it!
He didn’t want to add points, he didn’t want to fuse, he didn’t want to cultivate.
For people like him who couldn’t stay, it was similar to the past. Cultivating bitterly for two months was almost the limit.
If he continued to hold on, his mental state would reduce Shi Yu’s efficiency in various aspects to an extremely low level.
With no news of Ancient God Golden Bull from Teacher Gem Cat for a long time, Shi Yu had already planned to head to the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation to explore the ruins to take a breather and relax. He could also train the second team and prepare for Chi Tong’s evolution.
At the moment, the soul incarnation had also been taught and upgraded to perfect level. Chi Tong’s clones were ready. They were just short of being nurtured and fused to evolve. It was time for Shi Yu to find resources.
The Heavenly Sword Ruins of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation was his hunting target!
“Master, when are we leaving?” Ling said. “There’s still half a year until the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation’s Sword Trial. There’s plenty of time.”
“It’s not too sufficient anymore. After all, we still have to sneak into other factions and obtain the participation spot. That ruin is at the demigod’s house. We definitely can’t barge in forcefully. We can only enter normally in disguise,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu held the vanilla in his mouth and continued, “I’ll go out and tell President Lin. He seems to have said to tell him when I go out.”
“Go and take a look at Little Ji, Duckie, and the others. I’ll go over later. The main force next is them.”
“Alright ~” Secretary Ling quickly flew over.
At the same time, Shi Yu called President Lin.
“President Lin, I plan to go to the Heavenly Sword Ancient Kingdom.”
President Lin: “?”
On the other side, President Lin was stunned.
Wait a minute, didn’t you say that you wouldn’t move for the time being and would set off after you were strong?
Only two months had passed since the world competition!
“You plan to go now??” President Lin looked confused.
“By the way, are you confident?” he said worriedly.
“Don’t worry, I’m still 80 to 90% confident.” Shi Yu smiled.
Recently, he had studied the information about the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation to death.
...
The Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation was inherited from the totem era.
The origin was a demigod-level undead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 1005 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation (3)
chapters.content:
1005 Target, Heavenly Sword Nation (3)
This undead demigod was the pet of a human Beast Tamer when it was young. It was born in a sword and was a sword soul.
After the death of the human Beast Tamer, this sword soul established itself as a king and continued to pursue the Sword Dao wholeheartedly. In the end, it grew into a demigod.
Moreover, he called himself the Heavenly Sword and established the Heavenly Sword Nation. He welcomed all races to join and seek the Sword Dao together. This was the origin of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
Because of the power of the Heavenly Sword, the development of the Heavenly Sword Nation at the start was indeed not bad.
Countless royal swordsmen and transcendent lives who had mastered sword-type Skills had joined the Sword Dao family of the Heavenly Sword Nation.
Until when this demigod died, it placed its lifetime of Sword Dao EXP and the many natural treasures that could be used to forge famous swords and divine swords into an inheritance trial ruin it had built.
After that, the development of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation became better and better around this inheritance trial ruin.
At the moment, after thousands of years of development, apart from the most precious divine-level metal-element Meteorite Iron that no one had the talent potential to take away, there were no more materials left in this Heavenly Sword Ruins. There was only a large amount of Sword Dao EXP for sustainable inheritance.
Although the resources had already been taken away, these Sword Dao inheritances were also rare “resources”. The ruins had not been abandoned, but had always been worshiped as a holy land to nurture the geniuses of the Heavenly Sword Nation.
Every year, this country would hold a Sword Trial around the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
Through the potential and strength of the Sword Dao talent, they competed to see who was more qualified to enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins and seek a deeper Sword Dao inheritance.
That’s right, a sword competition.
This country was very strange.
Almost all the lives in the country used swords.
The Human Class could generally be divided into Imperial Swordsman and Beast Tamer.
Imperial Swordsmen were human Beast Tamers who contracted undead sword spirits, sword souls, and sword ghosts and let them possess them to fight themselves.
As for Beast Tamers, they were different from traditional Beast Tamers of various countries. Their pets, or rather, all the transcendent lives and pets in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation basically used swords.
They had all mastered various Sword Skills.
This was the result of generations of inheritance.
As for the most important activities in this country, the Sword Trial Conference and the Heavenly Sword Ruins trial also required Beast Tamers to only use sword-type moves to fight.
Among them, in the Sword Trial Conference, Beast Tamers who had reached a certain rank could enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins to undergo stronger trials. If their performance was outstanding, they had a chance to obtain the Sword Dao inheritance of the Heavenly Sword demigod.
Shi Yu had clearly targeted this ruin. Moreover, he wasn’t just targeting the Sword Dao inheritance.
He wanted to sneak into the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation and participate in this Sword Trial Conference. He wanted to enter the ruins and obtain the divine-level resource that no one could obtain until now.
Even in the future, sword-type demigods didn’t obtain the recognition of the Heavenly Sword demigod. It was obvious how difficult this final resource was.
Probably no one in the current Beast Tamer of the Heavenly Sword Nation wanted that.
However, after deep understanding, Shi Yu realized that he might have a chance.
He had even passed the trial of a bunch of gods, so why would he be afraid of a mere demigod’s test?
This ruin relied on testing the talent potential of the person who entered to provide a reward. At the moment, Shi Yu had already maxed out Chi Tong’s Sword Dao Resistance and fused it with other skills into a super sword body. If such a Sword Dao talent possessed him and activated the Taiji Domain to use the Interlocking Sword, it should be unique even if it wasn’t the most unique.
It wasn’t too much to take away a divine-level metal with a top-notch divine-level Sword Dao, right?
At that time, with the divine-level metal resource and the demigod’s Sword Dao inheritance in hand, Chi Tong should have evolved perfectly.
Of course, under the eyes of the demigods and totems of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, Shi Yu definitely couldn’t expose Chi Tong at the trial conference before entering the ruins. He couldn’t expose his Beast Taming level and identity. After all, the identity of a world legend was too conspicuous.
Even without these, just the legend level was too dazzling in the totem country. Young legends were almost as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns. There was definitely a problem with one suddenly appearing.
After being exposed, it was impossible to easily enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins guarded by a demigod.
However, it wasn’t like Shi Yu had no other choice.
Shi Yu planned to use the second Beast Taming Space to contract Little Ji and Duckie. As a Beast Swordsman, he would infiltrate a faction and participate in the Sword Trial. He would use the second team to quietly obtain a relatively normal ranking and obtain the opportunity to enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
Duckie, Little Ji, and the others also knew how to use swords!
Little Ji’s Space Splitting Sword and Duckie’s Water Blade!
This way, no matter how simple it was, it wouldn’t arouse the suspicion of the current demigods of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
Of course, Qi also knew how to use a sword, but as for it, the elves were too obvious. There were no elves in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
In addition, before going, he had to let Ling modify Little Ji. The mechanical dragon of the overlord race was still conspicuous. It was not bad to become an ordinary Earth Dragon. It was also a local special pet. As for Duckie, it was even easier. Although it had appeared in Inatella and exposed its Duckbill Beast form and Abyss Demon Duck form, the Duckbill Beast that had mastered the Water Blade was also a mainstream pet of the Heavenly Sword Nation. It wouldn’t attract attention at all.
Moreover, it wasn’t difficult for the duck to evolve into an excessive form before evolving into the Abyss Demon Duck.
Shi Yu could say that it had already been set up. When he entered the ruins as a high-level Beast Tamer or master-level Beast Tamer genius, without the supervision of a demigod, he could unscrupulously summon Chi Tong to attack the ruins.
After obtaining the divine-level resource, he would directly escape through the Blue Sea Ruins after coming out. Perfect.
“Is it really alright…” President Lin was silent. If Shi Yu was only going to a demigod faction to travel, he wouldn’t be worried.
However, Shi Yu was going to snatch divine-level resources under the nose of a demigod.
“No problem. I still have Senior Dragon God’s demigod protection,” Shi Yu said. “It’s unsolvable with the Teleportation of the Blue Sea Ruins. Senior Dragon God and Senior Divine Source have already confirmed it.”
“Alright then.” At this point, President Lin had nothing to say.
“But we have no foundation in the Heavenly Sword Nation. When you go there, you have to be careful. When do you plan to set off?”
“In the next two days,” Shi Yu said. He planned to nurture Little Ji and Duckie first. Just like Little Purple, he didn’t care much about these two guys. Moreover, although his second Beast Taming Space had reached level four, he hadn’t contracted a single life form. It was time to choose one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 1006 Contracting the Second Team
chapters.content:
1006 Contracting the Second Team
Legendary Ruins.
In the deep space.
As the second team’s Little Ji, Duckie, Qi, Little Purple, and the others were currently too weak, their states were easily affected by the first team’s training, so their residences were separated from the first team.
At this moment, Ling followed Shi Yu’s command and ran over to see the situation of the second team.
!!
As Little Zi was still a baby, it ate, drank, and played all day. It flew in mid-air to watch Little Ji, Duckie, and Qi get beaten up.
Little Ji and Duckie were still challenging a team of illusions.
Little Ji used a team of illusions to train its willpower and Skill proficiency.
As for Duckie, it used a team of illusions to train its control over the power of the abyss.
Ever since they joined the team, although they had never added points, their strength had also improved extraordinary under the cultivation of the scientific system.
For example, Little Ji’s will level had already reached medium Resistance.
Perhaps because it was relatively simple-minded and had an extremely clear goal of being the overlord of the earth, the speed at which it increased its Resistance was surprisingly fast.
Next was Duckie, who could already control the abyssal power brought by the Abyss Reincarnation Bean.
Both parties were at the stage where they could break through to the monarch level at any time and accept the divine inheritance. However, because Shi Yu, Ling, and Susu were busy training previously and didn’t have time to care about them, they still continued to polish themselves.
The Earth Divine Dragon fossil and the Abyss Seed were both extremely powerful inheritances. The more stable the foundation, the better.
“Ling Ling…” After Ling entered, Qi flew over excitedly surrounded by wind elements.
“I passed the eighth level!”
The current Qi had already used the Nature Fruit and was good at mobilizing the power of nature. Even if she didn’t bring equipment, she could be considered to have initial battle power.
At that moment, they were still training their willpower and battle skills without any equipment.
However, as the power of a god revived, in contrast, it also made the battle power brought by Qi using the Nature Fruit accelerate the loss.
After the development of the Mythical Revival Skill, Qi was getting closer and closer to awakening the quasi-divine skill.
However, the price of awakening a powerful Skill like Space-time Travel was that its other aspects would gradually become weaker.
Being too strong was not conducive to the passage of space and time. As the divine power awakened, her strength would be suppressed. Qi was already mentally prepared.
Apart from that, its image had also changed a little. The most obvious change was its size shrinking.
The originally small loli body shrank in a step and became a little elf about half a meter tall. Its physique, mental strength, and other Stats decreased.
Even Ling had a headache. At the moment, it didn’t have the ability to resist the laws at all.
“Roar!!!” “Quack ~!”
At this moment, as Teacher Ling came over, the members of the second team ran over to report their training situation as if it had been New Year.
After all, whether his training results could be rewarded with a feast and resources, or if his training would be doubled next, whether he lived or died… It was up to Ling to decide.
“You’re all pretty good.”
“I’m here for another matter.”
“Little Ji, Duckie!”
At that moment, as Ling spoke, Little Ji, Duckie, Qi, and the others swallowed their saliva, not knowing what fate awaited them next.
“Next, I have an important Quest for the two of you.”
“There will be many battles outside.”
“If it’s completed well, there might be a chance to advance to the monarch level and fuse with the Earth Divine Dragon fossil and the Abyss Seed.”
“Roar!!” “Quack!!!”
Little Ji, Duckie: (?`- ?c)!!
The overlords of the earth and ocean were fearless!!
Charge, charge, charge.
Let the challenge be even fiercer!
Ling looked at the eager Qi.
“Qi, continue training. You’re not suitable to carry out this Quest.”
Qi: (っ?-.)!! Ah.
“Little Zi, your infancy period has passed. Next, you’ll also start basic training.”
“Qi, you guys go together.”
Little Purple: Σ(°△°|||)!?
“Mi… (Am I? It’s only been two months.)” The cat-eared nebula’s white ball, Little Purple, was rather shocked.
On the Rubik’s Cube screen, the white-haired loli pushed up her glasses and said, “Is there a problem? I’m just one year old. Who isn’t a baby?”
Little Zi: !!!?
….
“Yo, how is it?”
After Shi Yu and President Lin ended the call, they also arrived at the second team space.
First, he went to stick to Qi and Little Purple. Then, he came to Ling and Little Ji. Duckie? What duckie? Duckie was training.
At the moment, the ten-meter-long earth-element dragon was lying on the mechanical bed, covered in earth-brown dragon scales. It was waiting to be modified.
...
“About a day,” Ling said.
“Okay.”
“Roar!!” At this moment, Little Ji turned its head and looked at Shi Yu curiously. It didn’t understand what kind of Quest it was this time that it actually had to be mechanically modified again.
“A very difficult task.”
“You look too strong now. We have to seal it.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “By the way, during the mission, you and Duckie can sign a contract with me, so do the surgery well!”
Little Ji: “Roar (Contract?)!!!”
“Yes, a contract.”
“The modification begins!” Before Little Ji could react, Ling directly used a high-intensity electric current to faint Little Ji, preparing to modify it.
Little Ji: Roar!!!
The miserable cry stopped.
Shi Yu wanted to go to the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation to secretly learn Skills and crack the ruins. Be it himself or his pet, they definitely couldn’t be too conspicuous.
...
Duckie was actually alright. In the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, the Duckbill Beast was also a mainstream water-element pet. The impact of directly contracting and sending it out to battle was not big. However, when it came to that side, Duckie definitely couldn’t use the Abyss Reincarnation Bean created by Baby Ginseng.
After the abyss form was sealed, its battle power would directly lock onto the commander rank standard.
However, with the overlord’s Resistance, even if it was a transcendent race, Duckie was undoubtedly a peak commander battle power.
On Little Ji’s side, the current dragon body was undoubtedly too conspicuous. It was not a common pet of the Heavenly Sword Nation at all. Therefore, Ling planned to modify Little Ji and let it learn to switch forms with this Mechanic Skill.
Skill: Form Switch
[Stats]: Mechanic
< Introduction > It’s a high-level Skill. It can allow mechanical lives to switch between different evolution forms.
At the moment, Little Ji had a total of two stages. One was an ordinary Tyrant Dragon, and the other was an earth-element dragon. Shi Yu and the others wanted Little Ji to be able to switch to the degenerated form of the earth-element dragon, the Earth Dragon.
[Race Name]: Earth Dragon
[Stats]: Earth
[Race Level]: Low-level monarch
< Introduction > It’s an earth-element drake. It’s good at Earth Blade attacks. It’s said that after sleeping underground for a thousand years, it has a chance of evolving into a real dragon.
The earth-element dragons of the overlord race were too conspicuous in the totem country, but if Little Ji switched to the transformation of the dragons, it wouldn’t be so conspicuous. After all, there were many Earth Dragons in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
With Little Ji and Duckie’s battle experience, Shi Yu believed that even if he sealed a portion of their strength, they should be able to kill indiscriminately.
…
About a day later.
Little Ji and Duckie stood in front of Shi Yu with serious expressions.
At this moment, Little Ji had already used its form to switch and maintain an ordinary Earth Dragon form that was three to four meters long. It looked strong and cameo-like, and its deep gray dragon eyes were filled with invincibility.
“Quack.” As for the blue fat duck, it glanced at Little Ji with a disdainful expression. As expected, no matter what form Little Ji took, it looked so annoying.
“Roar!! (Stupid duck.)” Little Ji cursed.
Shi Yu rubbed his temples and looked at them speechlessly.
He wanted to show them their dark history.
Previously, when Little Ji and Duckie were undergoing dream training… Little Ji died in the dream. Duckie cried bitterly and turned evil on the spot.
Duckie died in battle in the dream. Once Little Ji’s reverse scale was activated, it was useless no matter who came.
Although they didn’t like each other in reality, they might have already developed feelings in their hearts.
Little Ji: I am the only one who can kill Duckie!
Duckie: I’m the only one who can kill Little Ji!
It would be very difficult to end this if they didn’t get married on the spot.
“Stop arguing. In any case, neither of you can defeat the other now.”
“This mission is a very good opportunity for you to strengthen yourselves.”
“I’ll bring you to the totem country to train and use the resources there to strengthen your strength.”
“After the mission is completed, the fusion of the Earth Divine Dragon and the Abyss Seed will also be arranged. When the time comes, you guys will compete,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Roar!!!” “Quack!!!”
Little Ji and Duckie turned around and nodded heavily.
Then, he looked at the two blue contract halos that appeared in front of Shi Yu and revealed an extremely excited expression.
After enduring for so long, could he finally be contracted and enter the first team?
Didn’t Shi Yu say that one had to have the strength to defeat the first team to enter the first team and be contracted?
Forget it, forget it.
It wasn’t for nothing!!!
However, why was the color of this contract halo a little strange??
The two pets fell into deep thought, but their intelligence didn’t allow them to think too much.
It just had to enter.
….
After contracting Little Ji and Duckie, Shi Yu packed his things and prepared to set off for the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
The Ancient Kingdom of Heavenly Sword was in seclusion all year round. It was very difficult to smuggle in, but that depended on who.
Dong Huang had once sent intelligence personnel to infiltrate the Heavenly Sword Nation. The information Shi Yu obtained now was obtained at that time.
And now, as a big boss whose overall battle power was enough to rank in the top five of Dong Huang, the difficulty of infiltrating a totem country was not a problem.
He decided to let Susu do it.
It shrunk to the size of a water drop and hid in its Devour Space, letting it smuggle it in from the ocean.
“Just look like this.” Before setting off, Shi Yu stood in front of the mirror and used his body control talent to disguise himself as a young man in his twenties.
He had short black hair and a slender figure. Just by looking at his appearance, he was ordinary. He was very inconspicuous in the crowd and had an ordinary presence.
However, Shi Yu, who was used to being handsome, was still a little unaccustomed to suddenly becoming so Normal.
“Master, we’re going to the Demon Sect, right? But we don’t seem to know the location. There’s no detailed record in the Index, only saying that it’s the west.”
“Let’s talk over there. We’ll find someone to ask when the time comes.” Shi Yu smiled.
Heavenly Sword Nation.
It was divided into eight mainstream factions.
The greatest faction was the Sword God Mountain. It was where the demigods of the Heavenly Sword Nation were, and also where the Heavenly Sword Ruins were. There was a demigod presiding over it, and there were no other totem-level lives.
Next was the Sword Sect and the Demon Sect. One was good, and the other was evil. Both had Normal totems as guardians.
The strongest life form of the remaining five factions was only at the invincible overlord level. Among them, there were sect-type factions and family-type factions.
These factions had the qualifications to participate steadily in the Sword Trial. As for the other smaller factions, they were not so stable.
This time, Shi Yu infiltrated the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation and planned to enter the Demon Sect, one of the two totem factions.
It was mainly because it was said that this Demon Sect didn’t care about the origin of the disciples. Every month, they would recruit a large number of disciples on a fixed date. Their internal strength was king, and the strong preyed on the weak. If they joined here, it should be very suitable for Shi Yu to show off and quickly advance to a genius who could represent the Demon Sect in the Sword Trial.
As for whether it would be dangerous… It was just a Normal totem faction. Going there was like returning to his home. It was super comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - 1007 Demon Subduing Duck
chapters.content:
1007 Demon Subduing Duck
A day later, in the west of the Heavenly Sword Nation, in a huge river that connected to the sea, a drop of water jumped out. Right on the heels of that, a figure descended by the river.
After sending Shi Yu to the Heavenly Sword Nation, Susu returned to the Beast Taming Space almost resentfully.
Pui, pui, pui, dirty, dirty.
It was really because the quality of the environment in the nearby sea was worrying, making Susu extremely stifled.
!!
If he wanted to cleanse it, the time was not right.
“It can’t be helped. This place is relatively close to Ming Hua. The water quality over there is indeed not very clean.” Shi Yu was amused and said, “There’s no hurry. After you reach the totem level, we’ll go to the world to cleanse.”
With that said, Shi Yu slowly observed his surroundings.
Although there was a lot of information in the Intelligence Bureau Index, it was all important information about the Heavenly Sword Nation. There was really no unimportant information, such as where this was and how to go next. The Index didn’t record it at all… nor could it.
Shi Yu’s eyes were dark. He could only search for a place with people and ask around himself.
….
In a small path in the wilderness, it didn’t take long for Shi Yu to find traces of humans.
The Heavenly Sword Nation was similar to the Heavenly Fox Nation. Humans were the second largest race, so in this country, apart from the race of that demigod, humans were also above all races.
However, the group of people Shi Yu discovered didn’t seem to be in a good situation. They were in a battle and were surrounded by ferocious beasts.
Shi Yu waved a hand and turned his aura into a sword. He split open the thorns and looked into the distance. A group of people was surrounding the carriage to resist the attack of the Dead Leaf Mantis.
“Yi!!!”
On the ground, in the sky, more than ten brown mantis-type creatures that looked like dead leaves were holding large sabers. Their green eyes were always locked onto the crowd below.
Its bloodthirsty expression seemed to want to tear them apart and swallow them into its stomach.
< Name > Dead Leaf Mantis
[Stats]: Wood
[Race Level]: Low class commander
[Level of Growth]: Commander
Apart from this group of mantises, there was also a group of Duckbill Beasts…
“So there are really many Duckbill Beasts in the Heavenly Sword Nation.” Shi Yu looked over. The eight to nine people surrounding the carriage and the pets beside them were all Duckbill Beasts of high-level transcendent races, as well as the commander race evolution of the Duckbill Beast, the Duckbill Quass Beast.
However, it was normal to think about it. The Heavenly Sword Nation was an island country with many water bodies around it. It was water-element and mastered the Water Blade. Moreover, it was difficult for the Duckbill Beast race, with a huge race, not to become mainstream here.
“Ah…” But as the arm of a middle-aged guard was sliced off by the dancing Dead Leaf Mantis, blood splattered. From the current situation, Shi Yu felt that their situation was very bad.
“We finally encountered a living person. Duckie, Little Ji, chase away the insect swarm and help them. Let’s go ask for directions,” Shi Yu said. At the same time, a blue summoning array appeared beside him. A blue fat duck appeared first with a calm gaze.
“Quack.”
It stretched out its duck palm and condensed a water blade. Previously, it liked to condense the water blade into the form of a spear blade. However, after coming to the Heavenly Sword Nation, it followed the customs. This time, it directly condensed the water blade into the form of a blade and held it in its hand.
By the Sword God Duck, all the dual-blade Tyrant Dragons were trash.
Although its Water Blade proficiency had not been added points, it was already close to transcendent. After all, it was the reincarnation of a big boss, and its comprehension was very extraordinary. Moreover, it had Shi Yu’s various top-notch resources to nurture and a large amount of battle training.
Swoosh!!!
The duck’s blue figure flashed.
“Miss, we don’t have the advantage in numbers. If this stalemate continues, it’s very disadvantageous to us.”
“Next, we’re going to try to forcefully break out. Please be careful.”
In the carriage, a young woman sat nervously. She carefully pulled open the curtain and a middle-aged guard stuck to the carriage. He was covered in sweat as he looked around.
Beside him, a commander-level pet similar to the Duckbill Beast, but covered in a frost aura, was facing the Dead Leaf Mantis in midair.
Low class commander race, Duckbill Quas Beast!
“Alright… Uncle Da.” Just as the woman called Miss finished speaking, she suddenly looked at the sky in panic and said, “They’re here again!”
“Damn it.” Frost energy surged all over the middle-aged guard’s body. He activated his ice-element strengthening talent. Beside him, the Quas Blade in the Duckbill Quas Duck’s hand also spread cold air as it looked at the two commander-level Dead Leaf Mantises attacking in the sky.
The greatest disadvantage was that the Duckbill Beast couldn’t fly against the flying Dead Leaf Mantis.
The middle-aged guard and the Duckbill Quass Beast focused with all their might.
In the next moment, what made the expressions of the middle-aged guard and the girl in the car change slightly was that in the sky, a blue figure suddenly flashed and disappeared. It was indescribable, but its speed was extremely fast, even faster than the Dead Leaf Mantis that was good at flying. When the two Dead Leaf Mantises flying over saw this blue light, they almost immediately closed their blades to block as if they were facing a great enemy.
BOOM!
But in the next moment, as they touched the blue light, their sharp sickles inevitably caved in. Right on the heels of that, their entire bodies Morphed. With a huge impact, the Dead Leaf Mantis, known as the fiercest hunter in the forest, flew backward and smashed into a cloud of dust!!
Bang!!
At the same time, the owner of the blue figure descended from the sky. The Beast Tamer and the Dead Leaf Mantis in the battle were attracted by the commotion here. Under Shi Yu’s command, Duckie moved almost instantly. It slashed out twice, and the powerful power of the slash instantly sent the two ferocious beasts of the same level flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 1008 Demon Subduing Duck (2)
chapters.content:
1008 Demon Subduing Duck (2)
“Whose Duckbill Beast is it?!”
Everyone who saw this scene was stunned and couldn’t understand. The Duckbill Beast was only a life form of a transcendent race. If it didn’t evolve into a Duckbill Quas Beast, it would be very difficult to resist these commander-level Dead Leaf Mantises.
However, this unknown Duckbill Beast displayed extremely powerful strength. In a single exchange, it killed two commander-level Dead Leaf Mantises. Its strength was simply a little stronger than the Duckbill Quass in the team.
At this moment, the guards were extremely puzzled, because there was no such strong Duckbill Beast in the team.
!!
“Roar!!!” What shocked them even more was that with a dragon roar, an even more terrifying energy wave came out. These Dead Leaf Mantis were like birds startled by the twang of a bow, fleeing in all directions!!
As creatures that bullied the weak and feared the strong, the Dead Leaf Mantises knew very well what was a threat to them and what wasn’t. The fluctuations of the owner of this roar made them know that the powerful life form that arrived was a predator at the top of the food chain.
If he didn’t escape, he would die.
Their premonition was very accurate.
The huge roar not only scared the Dead Leaf Mantises away, but also made this group of people’s faces turn pale. They suddenly looked at the huge Earth Dragon walking four meters forward from the forest.
Its heavy body, ancient scales, huge body, and violent dragon eyes…
“It’s… it’s the Earth Dragon!!! It’s over!!”
“How can there be an Earth Dragon in such a place!”
For them, the commander-level insect swarm was something they could barely fight, and if the monarch race’s Earth Dragon was at the commander level, it would be fine, but if it was at the monarch level, they definitely had no chance of survival.
“Miss!!… No, there’s someone up there.” When the middle-aged man beside the owner of the carriage saw the Earth Dragon, his legs went weak from fright. However, as he saw a young man carrying a longsword standing on the huge Earth Dragon, his expression changed again!
Moreover, what shocked all of them again was that the figure of the Duckbill Beast that easily repelled the two Dead Leaf Mantises flashed again. It directly appeared beside the young man like a ninja and stepped on the Earth Dragon.
“Roar!!!” The Earth Dragon Little Ji shouted angrily, making this group of people’s hearts suddenly accelerate. However, Little Ji was actually angry that Duckie was standing on it like Shi Yu.
It was fine if it was Shi Yu, but he was a duck. Was he worthy?
However, in this situation, it couldn’t throw the duck down or slap it down with its tail.
Obstructing Shi Yu from posing was a serious crime.
“Gulp.” At this moment, looking at this mysterious expert who had arrived, the guards who also held swords and the girl in the car looked over nervously. Soon, the middle-aged man called Uncle Da beside the girl reacted and immediately went forward respectfully.
“Thank you for saving my life, sir.”
“If it weren’t for you, my lord, we would definitely have suffered heavy losses.”
“We still have some resources and resources in the car. Please accept them, sir. Treat it as a thank-you gift for saving your life.”
“Do you know how to get to the Demon Sect? I’m lost.” Shi Yu stood on Little Ji and ignored his words. Instead, he directly asked the question he was most concerned about.
Demon Sect!
At this moment, when he heard Shi Yu mention the Demon Sect, the middle-aged guard’s mouth opened slightly, and his expression changed. “Lord, you want to go to the Demon Sect?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu’s expression did not change.
“Sir, we’re from the Chen family of Lingshui County. Thank you for saving our lives, sir. We’re also going to the Demon Sect on this trip. Why don’t you follow us, sir? When we reach the Demon Sect, we’ll definitely send an even heavier thank-you gift. My brother… is an inner sect elite disciple of the Demon Sect.” At this moment, the woman who looked to be seventeen or eighteen years old also got out of the carriage.
She had a pretty face. It was obvious that she came from a good family. However, from her aura, she was a little unruly, but facing an expert like Shi Yu, she still restrained herself.
“You’re also going to the Demon Sect?” Shi Yu said in surprise. “Then do you know when the Demon Sect’s entrance assessment is?”
The middle-aged guard was stunned. “Lord, our Miss is going to participate in the Demon Sect’s entry assessment. The assessment is in a week, but in another day and a half, we can almost reach the cities around the Demon Sect.”
“…Lord, you’re also going to join the Demon Sect??” He was in disbelief. He felt that with Shi Yu’s strength, he wasn’t much inferior to their young master. He could definitely become an elite disciple of the inner sect. Such a genius had yet to enter the sect? Which family was he from?
“A day? Then I’ll follow you. However, you’re so weak. Is it really alright for you to join the Demon Sect?” Shi Yu said bluntly.
Too weak. It was so miserable for them to deal with a commander-level insect swarm. Was it really not a problem to go to the Demon Sect that was rolled to the extreme?
Even if he had an inner sect disciple brother… Shi Yu estimated that this inner sect disciple couldn’t reach the master level. What right did he have to speak?
“Well…” In the face of Shi Yu’s doubts, this group of people could only force a smile.
It wasn’t that they were weak, but that Shi Yu was too strong.
Uncle Da said, “Lord, please wait a moment. We’ll let the injured bandage some injuries first.”
“Lord, please rest in the carriage for a while…”
At this moment, Shi Yu retracted Little Ji and Duckie. The blue summoning array appeared and disappeared. Soon, these people determined Shi Yu’s level. At this moment, when they saw Shi Yu’s Beast Taming level and realized that he was a level-four Beast Tamer, no one was surprised.
However, they sighed in his heart. Shi Yu was so young, but he was actually only one step away from the master level. Moreover, he had contracted such a powerful Earth Dragon. He was simply powerful.
After entering the Demon Sect, he would probably be able to quickly become an elite disciple of the inner sect and have a chance to advance to a core disciple.
At that moment, Shi Yu slowly walked to the edge of the carriage and didn’t plan to go up. Miss Chen leaned over and said with admiration, “Lord, do you want to enter the Demon Sect for the Diamond River?”
Shi Yu looked at her.
“Because… you also contracted a Duckbill Beast. The Duckbill Beast has a total of two evolution paths. One is the Duckbill Quas Beast, and the other is the Demon Vanquishing Duck of the monarch race. With your strength, Lord, you definitely want the monarch race.”
“One of the conditions for the Duckbill Beast to evolve into a Demon Vanquishing Duck is the Diamond River Water, and only the Demon Sect has the Diamond River Water, so…”
Shi Yu was surprised.
The Demon Sect and the Diamond River?
The Duckbill Quas Beast and the Demon Vanquishing Duck were indeed evolved from the Duckbill Beast.
The Duckbill Quas Beast was relatively common, and the evolution difficulty was not high. As for the Demon Vanquishing Duck, it was actually a unique pet in the Ming Hua area.
There was a holy river in the Ming Hua area called the Diamond River. It was said that it had the ability to cleanse sin and cleanse filth. It was one of the holy lands of Ming Hua. The river water here could allow many pets to evolve under certain conditions.
The Duckbill Beast was one of them.
It could directly evolve from a high-level transcendent race into a low-level monarch race’s Demon Vanquishing Duck.
Although Shi Yu didn’t know how the Demon Sect of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation obtained the Diamond River Water from Ming Hua, one of the seven countries, it didn’t matter.
...
“Actually, my brother’s Duckbill Beast used the Diamond River of the Demon Sect to evolve into a Demon Vanquishing Duck. If you have such thoughts, I can get my brother to help you think of a way.”
“Let’s talk about it after we reach the Demon Sect,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright.” Miss Chen nodded.
In fact, Shi Yu was not interested in the other party’s family situation. However, on the way to the Demon Sect, this Miss Chen kept talking in his ear.
Coincidentally, the pet of the Chen family was the Duckbill Beast. It was precisely because of this that she knew so much about the evolution form of the Duckbill Beast.
However, it didn’t matter if Shi Yu purely evolved or not. When the duck’s strength increased, it could completely “degenerate” into an Abyss Demon Duck in one go. What Demon Vanquishing Duck? It was dispensable.
However, if Duckie had more Demon Vanquishing Duck forms, Susu should be very happy… he would sigh that Duckie had finally become successful.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 1009 Shi Yu Enters the Demon Sect
chapters.content:
1009 Shi Yu Enters the Demon Sect
On the way to the Demon Sect with the Chen family’s convoy, Shi Yu spent most of his time meditating in the carriage.
To increase the level of the first and second Beast Taming Spaces.
Regarding a young and powerful genius like Shi Yu, the Chen family and the others wanted to rope him in very much, but Shi Yu didn’t give them much of a chance. Apart from an alias called “Lin Bai”, they didn’t obtain much valuable information from Shi Yu.
Regarding this, Miss Chen Lin’er was very helpless. Was she not beautiful enough?
She had yet to despise this “Lin Bai” for looking ordinary.
Although he llooked ordinary, his strength was indeed strong…
“Miss, Young Master Lin, we’re about to reach the big city led by the Demon Sect, ‘Rock City’. We’re getting closer and closer to the sect…” As they approached the city, Uncle Da said.
“Let’s go to the inn to rest for a while. Young Master Chen should come out to receive us before the sect assessment…”
“Sure.” In the carriage, Shi Yu opened his eyes. The Demon Sect recruited servant disciples very frequently every month. Although there weren’t many people recruited every time, there were many times when they couldn’t hold back. Therefore, every recruitment was led by inner sect disciples. Only big shots weren’t so free.
In his conversation with the Chen family and the others, Shi Yu learned that if the people participating in the assessment were related to the sect members, sometimes the complicated entry assessment could even be waived and they could directly enter the sect.
As an elite disciple of the inner sect of the Demon Sect, the young master of the Chen family was one of the examiners this time. Therefore, the young lady of the Chen family was also planning to take this opportunity to use her brother’s position to find a good place.
For example, the mountain peak that helped the sect nurture spiritual plants was not only lucrative, but it was also easier than Quests elsewhere. It was really difficult to enter without some connections.
…
“A level-four Beast Tamer contracting a monarch race, a commander rank Earth Dragon, and a commander rank Duckbill Beast with extraordinary battle power?”
“Where did this Beast Tamer come from? His strength is not bad.”
That day, in the Demon Sect, a black-robed young man received a letter from his family. He was first nervous about the ferocious beast attack mentioned in the letter. Then, he was extremely curious about Shi Yu, who had saved a member of his family.
A group of Dead Leaf Mantises should have been forced to leave their habitat because a Mantis King had appeared in the forest. Even he didn’t want to face the wandering Mantis group head-on. However, such a group of ferocious beasts was actually scared away in a single exchange?
Even if it was a monarch race and a commander rank Earth Dragon, it shouldn’t be so crazy, right?
With deep confusion, Chen Luo left the sect mountain and arrived at Rock City. He found the clansmen who had rushed over from their families.
“Brother!!” In the inn, Chen Lin’er, the daughter of the Chen family, immediately said in surprise when she saw her brother.
“Little Sister, I’m sorry. I couldn’t pick you up because I had a Quest previously, so you encountered danger,” Chen Luo said. “However, it’s good that you’re fine.”
“It’s all thanks to Young Master Lin,” Chen Lin’er said.
“Let’s talk inside.”
The Beast Tamer of the Demon Sect, Chen Luo, pulled his sister into the room and said, “Do you know the origin of this Young Master Lin?”
“I’m not sure, but he should have joined the Demon Sect for the Diamond River and to evolve the Duckbill Beast. Moreover, he should have come from other places. Otherwise, he wouldn’t know so little about the west,” Chen Lin’er said.
“Brother, he’s very strong and even saved us. There shouldn’t be any harm in befriending him.”
Chen Luo fell into deep thought and said, “Although that’s the case, you also said that he’s very strong. After entering the Demon Sect, he’ll probably become an inner sect disciple soon. With the intensity of the competition in the Demon Sect, I’m afraid he’ll still have a conflict of interest with me in the future advancement assessment.”
“Fortunately, I don’t need the Diamond River Water for his goal in coming to the Demon Sect anymore. You won’t be able to use it in the short term. I can help him with this and repay his kindness.”
“Yes, yes.” Chen Lin’er nodded.
Chen Luo nodded on the surface, but he was calculating in his heart. He didn’t need the Diamond River Water. The other inner sect elite disciples needed to help Shi Yu and cause a conflict between Shi Yu and the other inner sect disciples. With Shi Yu’s strength, he could probably help him clean up a large number of competitors. This way, it wasn’t too much of a loss.
At the thought of this, he said, “Then I’ll visit that Young Master Lin.”
…
A moment later, Shi Yu, who was meditating in the inn, opened the door. He looked at this young talent with an extraordinary aura, and his expression didn’t change. The other party smiled and said, “Young Master Lin, I’m Chen Luo, an inner sect disciple of the Demon Sect, Chen Lin’er’s elder brother. Thank you, Young Master Lin, for saving my life.”
“It’s nothing,” Shi Yu said.
“No, no, no. This favor is huge. I’m very grateful,” he said. “I heard from my sister that Young Master Lin also wants to join the Demon Sect for the sake of the Diamond River. When the time comes, I’ll definitely help with all my might.”
“Also, I’m also one of the examiners for this Demon Sect entrance assessment… Can I take the liberty to ask about your strength, Young Master Lin?”
Shi Yu gestured for the other party to come in and sit. At the same time, he said, “I’m a level-four Beast Tamer. I contracted two pets. One is a monarch race, a commander rank Earth Dragon, and the other is a transcendent race, a commander rank Duckbill Beast. You should know about them.”
“Earth Dragon…” Chen Luo smiled and said,” Brother Lin’s strength is indeed extraordinary. Even among inner sect disciples, there aren’t many people who have monarch race pets. ”
The Demon Sect was divided into servant disciples, external disciples, inner disciples, and core disciples.
The servant disciples were basically all Beast Tamers intern. The outer sect disciples were all Beast Tamers who contracted transcendent pets, while the inner sect disciples were Beast Tamers who contracted commander-level pets. As for the core disciples, they had stepped into the monarch domain.
Contracting a monarch species pet was no different from stepping into the core level of the sect.
“However, the situation of the Demon Sect is relatively special. The new people recruited every month are basically all servant disciples. With your strength, Brother Lin, it’s naturally impossible for you to be a servant disciple. However, my authority isn’t enough for Brother Lin to directly enter the inner sect. At most, I can let you enter an outer peak like me.”
“If you want to enter the inner sect, I’m afraid you have to participate in the inner sect assessment yourself, Brother Lin.”
“It’s alright, as long as I can enter the Demon Sect,” Shi Yu said indifferently.
“Then why don’t I arrange for Brother Lin and Little Sister to enter the ‘Spirit Grass Peak’ together? Although there will be more missions to take care of spiritual plants, I can obtain two additional energy crystals every month.”
“There’s no need. Just arrange for me to go to a place where I can quickly advance through battle,” Shi Yu said.
Chen Luo smiled bitterly and said, “That’s true. Then let’s talk about ‘Demon Sword Peak’. The competition here is the most cruel, but with Brother Lin’s strength, it shouldn’t be a problem to deal with it. By the way, before arranging for Brother Lin to enter the Demon Sect, I’ll tell you about the situation of the Demon Sect first. Little Sister seems to have said that you don’t know much about the Demon Sect.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Speaking of the Demon Sect, it can be said to be a good place to increase strength. After entering the outer sect and becoming an outer sect disciple, you can go to the Sword Pavilion to choose a skill manual and teach it to pets. There are low, intermediate, and high-level skills.”
“There are a total of 300 Sword-type Skills. It can be said to be an important place in the sect!”
“Of course, I can only choose one at the start…”
“So many?” Shi Yu was surprised.
300 Sword Skills? Even Dong Huang didn’t have so many!
If he taught it all to Chi Tong and fused it into a Skill, how awesome would it be?
...
“Of course, if you want to learn these new Skills, you also need a certain amount of resources to assist or train in special places… However, these resources and special places can basically be exchanged directly in the sect.”
“As for what to use to exchange, money, resources, everything is fine. If it really doesn’t work, we’ll bet. In the Demon Sect, we support private bets. There’s also a battle trial established by the officials. As long as we have strength, everything is fine.”
Shi Yu expressed his understanding. Although anyone could get a sword skill for free, if he wanted to learn it, he still had to rely on the sect. As for how to get resources from the sect, he would buy them.
It was all a trick.
However, it was just a mutual benefit. The sect had to maintain its operation.
“And if outer sect disciples want to advance to the inner sect, generally speaking, they need to have a commander-level pet and pass the elder’s assessment. After entering the inner sect, there are many benefits. Every month, they have a chance to enter the mystic realm of the sect and comprehend the Sword Dao Resistance of the seniors in the sect.”
“However, only by nurturing a monarch-level pet and becoming a core disciple of the sect can you truly enter the Demon Sect. At that time, not only can you choose one of the six super sword skills inherited in the Demon Sect to teach to your pet, but you also have a chance to represent the Demon Sect in the annual Sword Trial!”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned. He needed a monarch-level pet to represent the Demon Sect to participate in the Sword Trial?
From the looks of it, he had to hurry up and raise the second Beast Taming Space to level five before letting Little Ji and Duckie break through.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, these were not difficult. He could achieve them quickly.
“As for the Diamond River Water you want, Brother Lin, you have a chance to obtain it after entering the inner sect. You need to compete with a group of inner sect disciples. It’s especially cruel. Many old people who can clearly be promoted to core disciples will stay in the inner sect for the Diamond River Water. Back then, I spent a lot of effort to bribe some strong opponents and make them give up the competition to obtain this resource,” Chen Luo said.
...
“I see.” After Shi Yu obtained this information, he nodded. Therefore, it was time to enter the outer sect and participate in the inner sect assessment.
However, he wanted to take a look at the Demon Sect Sword Pavilion that Chen Luo said outer sect disciples could enter first.
After all, after coming to the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, Shi Yu still had an idea. He wanted to nurture Duckie, Little Ji, and Chi Tong’s clones.
They still had very few skills. In this Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, there were a bunch of sword-type skills. Shi Yu felt that he could replicate them ruthlessly.
He didn’t come for nothing this time.
First, he would find his 100 Sword Skills to teach Chi Tong’s clone before fusing them. In short, this duck and Little Ji worked for Chi Tong. Of course, if there were suitable skills, they could also learn them!
“Then congratulations on entering the Demon Sect, Brother Lin…” Chen Luo looked at Shi Yu and smiled.
Shi Yu also looked at him and smiled. However, this smile immediately made Chen Luo’s heart skip a beat as he swallowed his saliva.
“This guy seems to have other thoughts?” Shi Yu looked at the other party and sensed the other party’s hidden thoughts with telepathy. However, it didn’t matter. He was just a small figure.
…
There was no need to wait until the day of the disciple recruitment. The next day, Shi Yu was arranged by Chen Luo to the so-called Demon Sword Peak in advance and obtained an outer sect disciple token and a single-story courtyard.
This single-story courtyard was located in the middle of a pile of courtyards. It looked very crowded. Chen Luo, who was leading Shi Yu, said in embarrassment, “Brother Lin, I’m sorry. I can only trouble you first. I’ve already contacted an inner sect elder I know. In a few days, you should be able to participate in the inner sect assessment…”
“After advancing to the inner sect, my residence will be much more luxurious.”
