“It’s alright. Thank you, Brother Chen. In this state, I’m an outer sect disciple of the Demon Sect, right?” Shi Yu picked up the token and looked at the sword-shaped metal token with his name engraved on it. “In other words, I can go to the Sword Pavilion to exchange for a sword skill now, right?”
“That’s indeed the case… But I still have a Quest next, so I might not be able to accompany Brother Lin.”
“I’ll go myself,” Shi Yu said. He and Chen Luo exchanged pleasantries before looking at their new residence and shaking his head.
These totem countries were really backward.
The seven countries were better. Modernization was better.
In the university dormitory of the seven countries, there was at least a television, air conditioner, and fridge.
There was nothing here. It was ridiculous. How exactly did the Beast Tamers of the totem country withstand such an environment? If it weren’t for the fact that there were hundreds of Sword-type Skills he could secretly learn next, Shi Yu would definitely get tired of staying for a few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 1010 Plans Can’t keep up with Changes
chapters.content:
1010 Plans Can’t keep up with Changes
Shi Yu arrived. After packing up, he walked around.
This mountain peak was very huge, and there were all kinds of facilities inside. It was said that there were thousands of Beast Tamers on a single mountain peak.
So many people also caused Shi Yu to walk outside. When everyone saw his new face, they were not affected at all. Everyone only had a straight face and were busy with their own things.
Taking out an energy crystal, Shi Yu went to the canteen to take a look. After successfully resolving the thought of not coming again, his goal was to reach the Demon Sect’s Sword Pavilion.
He showed the outer sect disciple token to the pavilion guardian elder who was like a doorman, but the other party actually put Shi Yu in without any reaction. The looseness made Shi Yu speechless.
However, when Shi Yu entered the pavilion, a young man in green welcomed him with a smile and said, “Senior Brother, you want to choose a Skill manual?”
“Is this your first time here, or are you exchanging contribution points?”
“This is the first time,” Shi Yu said as he looked at him.
“Alright, give me the disciple token. I’ll register. I can receive any skill the first time, but next time, I’ll have to spend contribution points.”
Shi Yu handed over the token.
The young man in green took the token and said, “Senior Brother, what Stats skills do you need? What are your requirements for level? I’ll bring you over.”
“I’ll go take a look myself,” Shi Yu said.
“No problem. Senior Brother, please go ahead. I’ll go register,” the other party said with a smile. Then, he left, leaving Shi Yu alone to walk in.
These Skill manuals… were all stored in a bamboo tube… They were placed in the display cabinet. Below the inside were their names, Stats, levels, and introductions…
Wind Suppression Sword… Low-level wind-element Skill… It could create wind blades to attack… It was suitable for wind-element pets to learn… Son of a b*tch, this was also a sword skill?
Wasn’t this a f*cking wind blade?
Did he think that he wouldn’t recognize him if he changed his name?
Leaf Blade… Low-level wood-element Skill… It could sharpen plants and slash… It was suitable for plant-type pets to learn…
Wasn’t this… a wood-element low-level Skill, Impregnating Plant?
They had all changed their surnames, right?
Shi Yu originally had a lot of anticipation for the so-called hundreds of Sword-type Skills of the Demon Sect, but just as he entered and saw the outermost skill manual, he couldn’t help but walk deeper.
The pet skills outside could be said to be of no value at all. He didn’t even need to come here. His third Index had recorded the learning method, and the transcendent lives by the roadside had a bunch of them who had mastered this skill.
Shi Yu directly crossed the Intermediate Skill area and arrived at the Advanced Skill area. Only then did he see some decent skills.
For example, the Wave Sword, a high-level water-element Skill. It could release a slash that contained the power of the wave. When cultivated to perfection, a slash could contain nine energy impacts. It was suitable for water-element pets to learn, and the learning difficulty was high.
Sunlight Slash, a high-level light-element Skill. It could accumulate sun light energy and form a light slash. Its speed was extremely fast…
Super heavy sword, a high-level earth-element Skill. It could create a rock blade that contained gravity. The weight of the rock blade was controlled by the user…
“Senior Brother, why are you here? The difficulty of learning high-level skills is too high. It’s better for you to choose a mid-level skill for the first time.” At this moment, the green-robed youth ran over and said to Shi Yu.
“It’s alright, I want this one.”
Shi Yu didn’t expect this Demon Sect to be so generous. A casual outer sect disciple had the chance to learn high-level Skills.
Wasn’t he afraid that someone would run away with the manual?
Well… there was indeed no need for high-level Skills. Moreover, high-level spatial sword skills definitely wouldn’t be placed here.
In the end, Shi Yu casually chose a super heavy sword for Little Ji, mainly because this skill was not recorded in the Dong Huang Cultivation Index.
In addition, after fusing with the Earth Divine Dragon fossil, Little Ji should awaken the power of gravity and lava. It could be considered to have laid the foundation in advance.
“Alright.” The green-robed young man didn’t say anything else. After returning the token to Shi Yu, he said, “Senior Brother, remember the sect rules.”
…
If he wanted to teach super heavy sword, firstly, he had to undergo special training in a gravity environment. Secondly, he needed to use “super heavy rock” as the main food and “sword rock” as weapons for special training. These three things could be found in the sect, but returning to its essence required money.
Of course, in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, hard currency still had to be energy crystals.
Shi Yu naturally had as many energy crystals as he wanted.
Next, Shi Yu temporarily stayed with this fake identity, but he wouldn’t stay obediently. On the surface, he would occasionally appear, but behind his back, with Buggy’s help, he replicated skills everywhere.
In this area, Beast Tamers often fought. Once they fought, they would use skills. And with Shi Yu and Buggy’s strength, it was very simple to touch their pets without anyone noticing.
On the day he arrived, Shi Yu copied an extremely rare high-level Skill, “Sword Heart”, from an inner sect disciple of the Demon Sect. This was the same as Chi Tong’s Sword Dao Resistance. It was also a Sword Dao talent skill. Shi Yu liked this passive skill that could superimpose talent comprehension.
That night.
As he felt that the environment of the courtyard was too poor, Shi Yu left Buggy to stand guard and returned to the ruins space to stay. He prepared to teach Chi Tong the Sword Heart.
“Mimi!!!”
Chi Tong, in the form of a sword spirit, flew over happily. It was very happy that it had a new skill.
“Let me think. When the Sword Heart reaches the maximum level, what Skill will it fuse with?” Shi Yu touched his chin and thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 1011 Plans Can’t keep up with Changes (2)
chapters.content:
1011 Plans Can’t keep up with Changes (2)
“Mi!! (Scapegoat!)”
“How much do you hate scapegoats? I can’t fuse it. Keep it.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
At the moment, Chi Tong indeed only had one high-level Skill, scapegoat.
< Name > Chi Tong
!!
[Race Skill]:
“Super”: Interlocking Sword (Perfect), Sun Flame (Perfect), Spirit Release (Perfect), Flame Spirit Sword Body (Perfect), Myriad Sword Convergence (Perfect), Phoenix Sword Will (Perfect), Star Fire Sword Formation (Perfect), Curse Flame (Perfect)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Advanced”: Scapegoat (transcendent)
“Super”: Undead Revival (Perfect), Soul Incarnation (Perfect)
In the two months of bitter cultivation, most of Chi Tong’s Skills had been fused by Shi Yu.
For example, the original profundity skill, Myriad Sword Convergence, was fused from possession, clone, and multiplication. It perfectly inherited the Effect of the three and its potential increased greatly. This could not only be Chi Tong’s main body, but also Shi Yu’s body, or even an enemy.
For example, the Phoenix Sword Intent was fused from Sword Dao Resistance, Phoenix Deterrence, and other Skills. In terms of pressure, it was even fiercer than simple royal max-level deterrence, catching up to the Green Dragon divine might brought by Buggy’s Green Dragon Indestructible Body.
Coupled with the Sword Skill Entanglement, there was an even greater enhancement.
The Star Fire Sword Formation was a fusion of the Energy Storage Beam, the Four Symbols Star Formation, and the Flame of Guardian. The greatest characteristic of this sword formation was that after creating it, it could automatically absorb the light of the stars and ignite the Star Fire. It was an almost eternal existence. A little Star Fire could start a prairie fire. Apart from that, the sword formation had a spirit and could also transform into a sword-shaped crystal as a protective equipment.
The Cursed Flame was the fusion of the Demon Blade Curse and the Nether Ghost Flame. Compared to the previous Nether Ghost Flame, its power would be even more terrifying when combined with the Sun Flame to execute the Interlocking Sword.
Of course, the burden would also be greater. The world where only the scapegoat was injured was born.
“As for the Sword Heart, it should be able to fuse with the Phoenix Sword Intent or the Flame Spirit Sword Body,” Shi Yu said. “Forget it, I’ll add points first.”
“Fill it up and delete it as soon as possible before replicating other Skills.”
“Mimi!!”
….
The next day.
To Shi Yu’s surprise, Chen Luo found him again so quickly.
For the past half a day, he had been adding points and successfully fused the transcendent Sword Heart into the Flame Spirit Sword Body to increase Chi Tong’s strength…
“Brother Lin, good news.”
This time, Chen Luo’s expression was a little abnormal, as if he was very emotional.
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu was surprised.
“Do you know how many countries there are outside our Heavenly Sword Nation?”
Shi Yu revealed a puzzled expression.
“There’s always someone better. I’ve heard of it before.”
“Yeah…” Chen Luo said.
“I have news that our Heavenly Sword Nation might be opening the country soon!!”
“It’s said that a while ago, news came from the outside world.”
“The era that belongs to gods is about to revive. There are even gods who have already awakened. Even under their auspices, more than 100 countries have gathered. The geniuses of more than 100 countries have carried out a battle that shocked the world.”
“Is that so?” Shi Yu was rather surprised.
“More than 100 countries?”
“Yes, it’s said that the culture of these countries is completely different from ours. What technology, magic, or even beastmen? It’s very strange.”
Wasn’t the Heavenly Sword Nation in seclusion? It looked even more feudal than the Heavenly Fox Nation. It was fine if the news of the World Tournament reached the ears of the higher-ups of the Heavenly Sword Nation, but now, even such a low-level Beast Tamer knew? Shi Yu was curious.
“I heard that in the competition at that time, legends could be said to be everywhere. Masters are inferior to dogs!”
“Moreover, these geniuses are all under the age of 30!”
“It’s worth more than our country’s Sword Trial Conference…”
“Unfortunately, I couldn’t see it with my own eyes or see the content of the battle.” Chen Luo’s expression was especially regretful.
Shi Yu was calm.
It wasn’t a big problem.
Although he didn’t see the process of the competition, he saw the world champion.
“Then…?” Shi Yu asked.
“It seems to say that such a competition will be held soon. Our Heavenly Sword Nation didn’t participate the last time, but this time, we seem to be interested in participating.”
“Everyone in the sect is discussing this now. I also learned about it from an elder with a good relationship.”
Shi Yu understood. This was because the demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation had missed the first-hand news of the Mythical Revival and was regretting it now.
Perhaps it originally thought that it was just an ordinary world competition, but who knew that it would actually expose such explosive news like Mythical Revival?
“The current situation is that this year’s Sword Trial Meeting, the Heavenly Sword Ruins trial, seems to be held in advance. It’s in a month. Moreover, it’s the largest trial. The country wants to choose a batch of geniuses with potential and immediately concentrate on nurturing them.”
“Fight in that special competition!”
“And our sect is also expanding the position of core disciple recently because of this. There’s no need for a level-five Beast Tamer or a monarch-level pet. As long as your potential and talent are not bad, you can directly become a core disciple and enjoy the cultivation of the sect. Then, you can participate in the Sword Trial next month.”
“I told that elder about your situation. He said that you can directly participate in the core disciple assessment. Of course, I can also participate.”
“Really?”
...
“Of course.”
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. Good lord, good lord. Fortunately, he came to the Heavenly Sword Nation in advance. Otherwise, if he delayed for another month, wouldn’t he have directly missed the ruins trial? He didn’t know how long it would take to enter again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 1012 Plans Can’t Keep Up with Changes (3)
chapters.content:
1012 Plans Can’t Keep Up with Changes (3)
Ling even said that there was no hurry. It would be fine if it believed it. Luck was fake!
“What’s the content of the core disciple assessment?” Shi Yu asked.
Chen Luo said, “You have to defeat a monarch-level trial beast and let the elders determine if you have the potential to become a core disciple.”
“The assessment is in three days. It will last for a week. Be it inner or outer sect disciples, they can participate in the assessment. If they are promoted to core disciples, they can directly apply for cultivation resources from the sect. Brother Lin, the Diamond River water you want might be able to directly obtain it with this opportunity.”
!!
“Then I’ll wait three days.”`
Shi Yu nodded. Wasn’t it just a requirement to have “quasi master-level battle power”?
The requirements weren’t high.
….
Three days later, at the Trial Peak.
Shi Yu arrived. At this moment, thousands of people were gathered here, surrounding a huge Duel Arena.
In the Duel arena, a pile of low-level monarch-level Sword Teeth Rhinos was standing there. Their huge bodies, sharp teeth, and metal-like bodies emitted a faint deterrence that made the surrounding Demon Sect Beast Tamers a little nervous.
Chen Luo arrived early. When he saw Shi Yu, he shouted, “Brother Lin, register and queue for the assessment here.”
“You’re an outer sect disciple now. If you want to participate in the assessment, you need to fill in the recommendation. You can just fill in ‘Elder Lu’ directly.”
“It’s fine if we don’t pass, but if we pass, Elder Lu can also have some benefits. When the time comes, after we become core disciples, he can also take care of us.”
Shi Yu said, “Alright.”
This mechanism kept making Shi Yu feel that the higher-ups of the Demon Sect encouraged their elders to rope in geniuses everywhere.
“Outer sect? Register the information.” Shi Yu went to the place Chen Luo mentioned. The registration staff handed over a brush and a booklet.
Shi Yu wrote his name and background on the booklet. As for the background, it must have been a background of a wandering genius that looked real but couldn’t be investigated after stealing the memories of many Demon Sect disciples through Buggy.
After completing it, Shi Yu went to line up.
At this moment, Chen Luo, who had been in charge of transmitting news to Shi Yu, also came over with a smile. This time, there was a man and a woman in inner sect clothes beside him.
“Brother Lin, this is Hal, this is Hong Ran. They’re both inner sect disciples, and there’s a high chance of them becoming core disciples this time. This is Brother Lin Bai, who I mentioned previously and saved my little sister.” Chen Luo introduced him to Shi Yu and the others.
Shi Yu chatted with these people with a headache.
At the same time, on the Duel Arena, the assessment of the core disciples was in full swing. On the high platform, five Beast Tamers sat on high ground, both men and women. They seemed to be the inner sect elders Chen Luo mentioned. At this moment, they were taking on the assessment of the core disciples.
Below, every person who came up had to send out their pets to fight a Sword Fang Rhinoceros in the Duel!
However, inner sect disciples were inner sect disciples after all. There were very few who had reached level five themselves, and even fewer whose pets had reached the monarch level. It was still too difficult to challenge a monarch-level Sword Fang Rhinoceros of a monarch race.
“Bang!!!” An inner sect disciple who had just gone up, under the possession of the Sword Ghost, rode a Horned Sword Horse and had a ball of Thorny Sword Grass as support. He didn’t last a round at all and was directly knocked over by the Sword Fang Rhinoceros. A huge hole was directly pushed out of the Horned Sword Horse’s body, and blood flowed continuously.
On the high platform, an assessment elder with short gray hair said calmly, “Not suitable. Next.”
The registration list was gradually transmitted to it. The expressions of these elders looked very relaxed, as if they were watching a show.
“Monarch Race, monarch-level Sword Teeth Rhinoceros… Be it that Sword Horn or Sword Teeth, they’re both shocking killing weapons. The combination of metal and earth also makes its resistance very good and very difficult to deal with. Fortunately, these Sword Teeth Rhinoceros didn’t have the intention of using super Skills and deterrence. Otherwise, none of the candidates who went up just now would have survived and would have lost even faster,” Chen Luo landed beside him and said. “Brother Lin, what do you think?” Hal and Hong Ran asked Shi Yu because even Chen Luo only knew that Shi Yu was very strong, but he had never personally verified his strength.
“It’s indeed not easy to deal with,” Shi Yu said.
These Sword Teeth Rhinos had 1 million energy points.
Little Ji, Duckie, if they didn’t erupt, it was currently tens of thousands of energy points. This was a difference of more than ten times.
In fact, it wasn’t surprising that those people lost so badly. Even he, who only used the pets of the second team to fight and didn’t expose his trump cards like the overlord’s will in normal battles, might have to be extremely serious and let Little Ji and Duckie cooperate well.
Moreover, not only did he have to defeat the enemy, but he also had to obtain recognition. In that case, he had to be even more serious, but he couldn’t be too serious.
….
“Next, Demon Sword Peak, Lin Bai.”
After a long time, Shi Yu waited for his name. So far, only two people had passed the inner sect assessment.
One was that the four pets cooperated better. Their Stats and abilities happened to counter the trial ferocious beasts.
As for the other, although the pet had yet to reach the monarch level, the Beast Tamer himself had reached level five. With the enhancement of stronger strengthening talent, he successfully defeated the trial above his level.
After hearing his name, Shi Yu looked at Chen Luo and the others, as if he was asking if they registered.
“Brother Lin, go first.” Chen Luo smiled and said, “My pet still has one injury that hasn’t recovered.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 1013 Plans Can’t Keep Up with Changes (4)
chapters.content:
1013 Plans Can’t Keep Up with Changes (4)
Shi Yu couldn’t deny it and walked towards the Duel Arena.
At this moment, as Shi Yu walked to the Duel Arena in the clothes of an outer sect disciple, the surrounding crowd instantly discussed.
“Outer sect?”
“What’s going on?”
!!
“I heard that if an elder recommends it, the outer sect can also directly participate in the core assessment. It should be a genius pulled over from the family by an elder at the last minute.”
“It depends on his strength.”
On the high platform, as Shi Yu walked out, a plump beautiful woman looked at the short and wretched old man beside her. “Elder Lu, the person you recommended.”
“Huh?” Elder Lu was stunned. At first, he had no impression of Shi Yu, but then he remembered that an inner sect disciple with pretty good talent seemed to have recommended someone to him.
Contracting an Earth Dragon of a monarch race definitely had the potential of a Master. If it grew normally, it would definitely become a core disciple.
“I casually recommended it. I don’t know its strength either, but it should be pretty good,” Elder Lu said casually. That inner sect disciple wouldn’t lie to him.
Under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu had already stepped onto the Duel Arena. On the other side, an extremely oppressive Sword Fang Rhinoceros slowly walked out from the beast crowd.
It was more than five meters long and two meters tall. Its body looked very cumbersome, but it also looked extremely strong. It was wearing thick armor-like skin, and there was a sword-like horn on its mouth. In addition to the two sword teeth under its mouth, it looked like a three-blade swordsman.
“Roar!!!” The metal-like figure roared, and a cold light flickered in its eyes.
After the huge Sword Teeth Rhinoceros was released, it moved towards Shi Yu. At this moment, under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu also summoned his pet.
Hu hu hu ~
Gusts rose, and the blue light spots quickly connected into a trajectory, forming a huge circular array that looked like a star map. It appeared on the ground.
“Blue summoning diagram, level-four Beast Tamer. This outer sect is indeed not simple.” Seeing Shi Yu’s level, everyone was slightly surprised and revealed as expected expressions.
In the next moment, their expressions were even more shocked.
“Roar!!!” Because the figure that appeared on the summoning array was actually a dragon!!! It was covered in earth-brown dragon scales, and its impressive and domineering deep gray eyes prostrated on the ground. Its body was even larger than the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros!!
“The drake of a monarch race, the Earth Dragon!! What’s his background? It’s fine if it’s a monarch race, but it’s actually a dragon.”
“Also…”
“Duckbill Beast? It’s not the Duckbill Quas Beast, but the Duckbill Beast?!”
“Wait, there are only two?” Everyone was first shocked by the pets of the monarch race, but when they saw that the second pet Shi Yu summoned was only from a transcendent race and that he had only summoned two pets, they were quickly extremely puzzled.
“Roar!!” Little Ji was smug. Trash duck, even if it retreated, it looked stronger than it.
Duckie: Damn Duckie.
Boom.
Before they could be too puzzled, as if it had sensed the threat of the Earth Dragon, the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros’s movements began to become restless. It roared and its deterrence erupted!!
Boom!!!
Fortunately, it was only a proficient-level deterrence that had yet to form a monarch aura. Little Ji and Duckie opposite were not affected at all. After all, they had a medium-level will and an overlord’s will. They were not kidding.
“Roar!!!” At the same time, the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros directly charged over. Moreover, two sword teeth and a sword horn directly flashed with golden-brown light. Seeing this, most disciples opened their mouths wide. They didn’t expect this Sword Teeth Rhinoceros to use the super Race Skill, Triangular Heavy Sword.
Was it the dragon bloodline of that Earth Dragon that gave it pressure?
“It’s a super Skill right from the start. It’s not easy for the other party to resist. They don’t even have a chance to circle around and find an opportunity.”
“Let’s see what Beast Taming Talent he has. He doesn’t look panicked. He definitely has a very powerful Beast Taming Talent…”
Everyone judged that Shi Yu’s only chance of victory was in his Beast Taming Talent. However, the subsequent development was completely different from what everyone imagined. Shi Yu had no intention of activating his Beast Taming Talent at all.
“Roar!!” In the face of the full-strength attack of the monarch race’s monarch-level Sword Teeth Rhinoceros, the huge Earth Dragon directly collided with it with red eyes. Its body collided with the triangular heavy sword. This scene directly stunned everyone.
Did he want to die!
A level lower and even withstood super Skills with his body… The challengers with holes in their bodies just now were a lesson!!
However.
Under the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros’s huge strength, everyone discovered in disbelief that the Earth Dragon’s physical strength was also terrifyingly strong. Its scales actually only shattered slightly, and fine patterns appeared. It couldn’t even be considered a light injury!
“Roar!!!” Little Ji roared.
Trash, although its energy level was limited by its low level, its physique had long exceeded ordinary commander ranks after being beaten up for so long. Moreover, with the activation of the reverse scale, Little Ji’s physical potential increased further.
“It’s the Earth Dragon’s super Race Skill, the reverse scale. This skill strengthened its strength. However, this commander-level Earth Dragon can actually control the Crowd Control reverse scale state.”
This scene also made the inner sect elders reveal surprised expressions. There were two ways for the Earth Dragon to control the Crowd Control’s reverse scale. One was the proficiency of the reverse scale, and the other was will. This Earth Dragon’s will was probably extraordinary.
However, what they didn’t know was that Little Ji was a weirdo. He purely didn’t dare to be angry and lose his mind, afraid of being beaten up.
The two Behemoths collided. In the next moment, with a boom, although it was sent flying with the Earth Dragon’s insufficient strength and its huge body was smashed out, the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros was clearly knocked out for a moment. Its body retreated and it was stunned on the spot for a moment.
In the next moment, the Duckbill Beast that had been ignored by everyone moved. It opened its closed palms, and two water blades appeared in its hands. The moment Little Ji was sent flying, its figure flashed.
Hu…
Water ripples seemed to flow out of the duck’s mouth, eyes, and mouth. With its full concentration, it had been waiting for this heart attack for a long time.
Its movements were like flowing water as it descended on the monarch-level Earth Dragon’s head that was stunned for a moment. Two water blades directly stabbed into the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros’s weakness, its eyes!!
“Roar!!!”
The water exploded!
The Sword Teeth Rhinoceros’s huge body retreated again. Its eyes, mouth, and nostrils kept bleeding as it released its Skill crazily in pain.
Under the threat, the duck stepped on its body and gently retreated, landing on the ground.
This attack was an absolute heavy blow to the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros. No one expected that this duck would only use two Skills to give an opponent one level higher than it such a fatal blow. It could still concentrate on using the Heart Strike despite the deterrence. This Duckbill Beast’s battle awareness exceeded everyone’s imagination.
...
“Quack! (Neck.)”
However, everyone realized that Shi Yu and the others’ continuous skills had yet to end. The Duckbill Beast retreated. The huge Earth Dragon that was sent flying actually didn’t look injured at all. Dust surged, and with bangs, its hands condensed Earth Blades. It kept running close to the Sword Teeth Rhinoceros and easily dodged its panicked attacks. It directly slashed at its second weakest neck.
Because of Duckie’s attack, the Sword-Toothed Rhinoceros didn’t have the consciousness to use its defense skill at all. Under Little Ji’s slash, everyone saw that the Sword-Toothed Rhinoceros’s huge body was directly sent flying by the sword. It fell to the ground and its limbs twitched.
Although it still had strength, its weakness had been attacked consecutively, and its brain’s consciousness was already blurry!
The dragon and duck quietly stuck close to each other and looked at the enemy with great tacit understanding.
As for Shi Yu, he nodded unsurprisingly. The disciples and elders watching the battle revealed shocked expressions.
This guy’s battle experience… What was going on… Not only was there no pressure to fight above his level, but he also suppressed the other party?!!
“Brother Chen, you’re wrong. This guy isn’t strong at all. This guy is abnormal.” Chen Luo’s two friends were shocked when they saw Shi Yu’s performance.
“Good!!!” At this moment, after being stunned for a moment, Elder Lu directly laughed and said, “Well fought. It’s been a long time since I’ve seen a Beast Tamer fight so cleanly among inner sect disciples.”
“You pass. From today onwards, you will also enjoy the nurturing treatment of a core disciple.”
Elder Lu was completely overjoyed. He didn’t expect Chen Luo to push a genius like this guy to him. This Lin Bai… seemed to have joined the Demon Sect for some Diamond River water? To let the Duckbill Beast evolve? This was easy. As long as he could reach level five as soon as possible, it was just Diamond River water. It was easy.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 1014 Duckie Evolution
chapters.content:
1014 Duckie Evolution
“Brother Lin is mighty…”
“He’s simply like a god descending to the mortal world.”
Shi Yu came down from the Duel Arena. After coming down, everyone looked at him in shock. Chen Luo and the others, who knew Shi Yu, opened their mouths slightly and squeezed over.
Especially Chen Luo. He knew that Shi Yu was very strong, but he didn’t expect him to be so ridiculously strong.
“It’s alright,” Shi Yu replied calmly, thinking to himself that they sure knew how to talk.
Although it was an ancient totem country, its words were much better than modern people.
If this were those Beast Tamers in university, they would definitely say “F*ck”, “Impressive, awesome”, and “lmao ~” again.
The current university student Beast Tamers were really uncultured.
“This is too clean.” Chen Luo still couldn’t help but exclaim. He guaranteed that he wouldn’t be as smooth as Shi Yu when he went up.
“It’s nothing. I just experienced too many battles when I was wandering,” Shi Yu said. “Where should I go next? I should be considered a core disciple now, right?”
The elders just now seemed to have said that he passed.
Chen Luo said, “When today’s assessment ends, an elder will take the initiative to look for you. Brother Lin, don’t worry.”
“Why don’t we celebrate first in order to congratulate Brother Lin for advancing to the core?”
“I’ll definitely do it next time. All the best. I’ll wait for the elder to contact him.” Shi Yu left cleanly, stunning Chen Luo and the others. F*ck, so what if he had advanced to the core? Why was he so reclusive?
…
After completing the core disciple assessment, Shi Yu decisively waited.
It was almost evening.
As expected, Elder Lu, who was in charge of the core assessment, appeared outside Shi Yu’s residence.
“Is Lin Bai here?”
Before he could say anything else, a Spirit Worm Silk suddenly flew out of the room.
It entered his body without him noticing.
Level-six Beast Tamers and inner sect elders were considered relatively core higher-ups.
Next, Shi Yu planned to use his identity to completely settle down in the Demon Sect to avoid endless trouble. As for being one level higher, Buggy’s influence was not that stable.
After Buggy controlled his mind through the Mother Empress’ Psychic power, this Elder Lu was immediately stunned.
Elder Lu: ( ?” ?*) Aba Aba Aba Aba, genius, genius!!!
He had to take it in as a disciple!
A moment later, not only did Shi Yu obtain the clothes and token of a core disciple, but he also became a super genius worth nurturing in Elder Lu’s eyes!
If it weren’t for Buggy constantly affecting his decisions, he would have immediately taken Shi Yu in as a personal disciple.
With a high-level tool like Elder Lu, Shi Yu felt that he should be very comfortable next.
In the room, Shi Yu held the core disciple token and analyzed it carefully.
“Inner sect disciples can enter the mystic realm on the mountain and help their pets comprehend sword intent skills.”
“Sword Intent Skill, to put it bluntly, is a skill similar to deterrence. It’s similar to Dragon Might, but the foundation is stronger than deterrence. It can directly wrap around and increase the power of the Enhancement Skill.”
“Chi Tong has already fused the Phoenix Sword Intent through max-level Sword Dao Resistance and deterrence. Learning ordinary sword intent is just icing on the cake.”
“The key is one of the super inheritances of the Demon Sect, the Nirvana Sword Intent… Before leaving, I have to learn or copy this.”
After becoming a core disciple of the Demon Sect, he would have a chance to learn one of the six super skills. The Nirvana Sword Intent was one of them, and also the most valuable one. It was a sword intent skill that contained the nature of death.
Under the attack of the Nirvana Sword Intent, all life would be severed.
However, this skill was very difficult to learn. At the moment, the Demon Sect only seemed to have two transcendent lives who had mastered it. One was the totem guardian of the Demon Sect, and the other was the trump card Sword Pet of the current Demon Sect Master.
Of these two, one was a totem-level creature, and the other was a Legend-level Beast Tamer with pretty good strength. It was probably not easy to replicate it without anyone noticing.
However, he had to take this skill.
Shi Yu wanted to replicate it and teach Chi Tong’s soul incarnation.
It was just nice to reflect the Spirit Ascending Saber given by the Boar God, life and death.
Although there was also a chance for skills like Undead Revival to cultivate the Death Law, it was not a sword-type skill that focused on attack after all.
After thinking about it, Shi Yu prepared to directly go to the Holy Land to study it when the time came. With Chi Tong’s talent and comprehension, what if it directly learned it?
But now, from Elder Lu’s memories, the most important thing now was to become a level-five Beast Tamer quickly.
If he couldn’t reach level five in a month, even if an elder recommended him, it might be very difficult to represent the Demon Sect to participate in the Sword Trial. The threshold of the Sword Trial this time might very well be raised to level five.
In short, when he reached level five, it would be the true core. During this special period, if he was valued by the elders, it was even possible to directly obtain pretty good resources!
…
Nearly a month later.
Under Elder Lu’s care, Shi Yu was like a fish in water in the Demon Sect.
As he was a genius that Elder Lu valued and nurtured, no one came to disturb Shi Yu.
Shi Yu was happy to be free and cultivated Chi Tong in depth.
First was Chi Tong’s Soul Incarnation Skill, which had been completely upgraded to transcendent by Shi Yu.
Just like the superalloy back then, Chi Tong’s evolution skill was also very extraordinary this time. Its proficiency was very high.
There were a total of four clones in the transcendent-level soul incarnation.
...
At the moment, these four clones began to be cultivated by Shi Yu one after another.
One swallowed the Heart Flame and the Spirit World fragment and mastered spatial changes, transforming into a spatial sword.
One grew with the help of the Flame of Regeneration and kept comprehending the laws of life, turning into a sword of life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 1015 Duckie Evolution (2)
chapters.content:
1015 Duckie Evolution (2)
The other entered the mystic realm with the help of Shi Yu and Elder Lu to comprehend the Nirvana Sword Intent in the Demon Sect’s mystic realm.
Because of Chi Tong’s powerful Sword Dao talent and the World Tree Fruit, Shi Yu only spent a few days without needing to replicate it. Chi Tong’s clone turned into the Sword of Death and comprehended the Nirvana Sword Intent.
As for the last one, Shi Yu had yet to nurture it. It was mainly because he lacked cultivation materials and was waiting for the divine-level meteor iron of the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
At the moment, these clones were even stronger than Eleven’s Bean Bear clone with the help of a pile of Legendary and even divine-level resources.
After more than half a month, Chi Tong’s evolution preparations could be said to be completely coming to an end.
At the same time, Shi Yu was not idle. He replicated a total of 21 sword-type Skills that were suitable for Chi Tong and taught them to Chi Tong’s various clones and even fusion.
As for why it wasn’t directly taught to the main body, it was because the nature of the transcendent-level soul incarnation was very similar to the fusion of skills.
In the end, the stronger the power mastered by the clone, the stronger the new Skill that could be awakened during fusion and evolution.
For Chi Tong’s perfect evolution, Shi Yu could be said to have been worried sick. He had never been so prepared for the evolution of other pets.
This was also because Chi Tong didn’t have a corresponding mind domain, and Shi Yu had also promised to evolve it into a stronger one. Therefore, it could only pile up foundation, foundation, and resources.
Of course, looking at the slender and beautiful Chi Tong practicing swordplay in the ruins every day was also one of the few opportunities for Shi Yu to relax during this period of time.
In addition, although he had been crazily learning Skills recently, Shi Yu’s own cultivation did not fall behind.
His second Beast Taming Space level had finally reached level five, master level. It was getting closer and closer to the level of the first Beast Taming Space.
The original Shi Yu complained every day that there weren’t enough contract slots. Now, the contract slots far exceeded the number of pets around him.
Now, without the spatial suppression of levels, Shi Yu could finally let Little Ji and Duckie break through to the monarch level.
“Lin Bai!” At the moment, Elder Lu, who had already become one of his own, completely didn’t realize that he had been working crazily for Shi Yu for the past month like a nanny.
“This is the Diamond River and the Demon Flower.”
When the short Elder Lu heard that Shi Yu had reached level five, he immediately applied for the Duckbill Beast’s evolution resource from the sect and ran over to offer it to Shi Yu.
“Let the Duckbill Beast eat the Evil Spirit Flower and come into contact with the Diamond River. Use the power of the Diamond River to cleanse the power of the Evil Spirit. If it succeeds, it can evolve into a Demon Vanquishing Duck.”
“If you fail, it might lose its will and fall into a chaotic state. It might even break free from the contract, so if you want the Duckbill Beast to evolve, you have to be prepared.”
“Good luck.”
“As long as your Duckbill Beast completes its evolution, you can contract two monarch-level pets of monarch races. Almost 100% of them can represent the Demon Sect to participate in this Sword Trial.”
“Thank you, Elder Lu,” Shi Yu thanked as he took the evolution resource.
After Elder Lu left, Shi Yu held the Diamond River Water and the Evil Demon Flower and fell into deep thought.
It was better to let Duckie evolve first.
Its skill column was really too pitiful.
During this period of time, Shi Yu did not forget to nurture Little Ji and Duckie, but the investment was definitely not as big as Team One.
At the moment, Little Ji, Duckie, and the others’ growth depended on Team One’s experiments.
For example, if Baby Ginseng didn’t use them as experiments, who would it use as experiments?
Therefore, Little Ji learned the super heavy sword, and Duckie also learned the Wave Sword. Little Ji was still alright. It had enough skills. After all, it was an overlord race.
Duckie was in trouble. It was only a transcendent race. It only had a total of four Skills.
Intermediate-level Water Blade, Heart Strike, Purification, Advanced-level, Wave Sword.
The other two were teaching skills, non-racial skills.
He didn’t know how many Skills the Devouring Abyss Seed could awaken after completely awakening the power of the abyss, but from the looks of it, its foundation was too weak.
Shi Yu’s first team couldn’t be nurtured yet, and he didn’t have time to find contracted skills for the second team to fuse with for the time being. Therefore, it was better to evolve additionally now. After all, the more evolutions there were, the stronger the foundation.
“Demon Vanquishing Duck, the evolution mechanism is to use the power of cleansing to suppress the power of demons.”
“It’s quite similar to Duckie’s current state.”
“After all, it’s also relying on max-level cleansing to suppress the power of the abyss.”
“I remember that the super Skill of the Demon Vanquishing Duck seems to be a skill to counter the power of demons. After learning this, it can be more stable after evolving into an Abyss Demon Duck, in case it goes berserk.”
Shi Yu carried the resources and walked into the room. He entered the ruins and left Buggy standing guard to isolate the spatial fluctuations, in case anyone discovered that he, Shi Yu, frequently entered and left other spaces.
In the ruins.
Duckie held the Wave Sword and was fighting Little Ji, who was holding a super heavy sword. It was training its strength and preparing for the Sword Trial.
“Roar!! (I am… the king of the earth!!)”
“Quack!!! (What king?!)” Duckie sent Little Ji flying with a Heart Wave Sword. At the same time, it was sent flying.
Boom!!!
In the dust, the two pets were sent flying. Shi Yu, who had just arrived inside, happened to appear as Little Ji flew backward.
Helpless, he caught and raised the ten-meter-long small machine with one hand and casually threw it to the side.
Bang.
Little Ji: Σ(°△°|||)_!!
Duckie flying backward: w(?Д?)w… As expected, it still couldn’t even defeat the Beast Tamer himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 1016 Duckie Evolution (3)
chapters.content:
1016 Duckie Evolution (3)
After the two pets stopped fighting, Shi Yu said, “The two of you prepare. Little Ji, go to the gravity domain created by Buggy and use the pressure of gravity to break through to the monarch level.”
“Duckie, come here and undergo an evolution breakthrough.”
“The two of you don’t have to suppress your levels anymore. Break through to the monarch level today.”
“Roar!!!” “Quack!!!”
Monarch?
Little Ji and Duckie were especially excited.
Could he finally break through?
“Roar??”
However… evolution breakthrough?
Little Ji looked at Duckie and then at Shi Yu.
“It’s the previous Demon Vanquishing Duck.”
“Roar!! (Then I’ll break through first.)” Little Ji said.
Duckie looked disgusted, not wanting to be looked at by Little Ji.
As for Shi Yu, he chuckled and directly handed the bottle of golden Diamond River Water and the black Demon Flower in the container to Duckie.
“Coming, coming, coming!!! Let me scan the evolution resources first!!”
“Ning Ning!!”
At the same time, Duckie’s big sister, Susu, and Ling, who was in charge of the team’s growth plan, also rushed to the scene immediately.
Ling was always worried that some unruly people wanted to harm them, so it scanned the resources from the outside world very strictly and seriously.
However, Susu shrugged. The evolution process of the Demon Vanquishing Duck… had to eat poison in the first place!
“Sure. Although the evolution ingredients are a little lousy, it’s enough for you,” Ling said.
“Quack # # #!!” Duckie crushed the container of the Evil Demon Flower with a tragic expression and stuffed the flower into its beak in one bite, chewing randomly.
Facing the gazes of a group of people, in the next moment, the demonic power of the Demon Flower turned into a wave that corroded Duckie’s entire body.
But…
Before it could come into contact with the Diamond River to resist the demonic power, this demonic power was directly subdued by Duckie’s powerful will and rich experience in resisting the abyssal power. Its entire body was wrapped in the demonic power, and Duckie’s expression was calm…
Quack…
That was it?
Ling: “Stop being cheeky. Activate some abyssal power to integrate into the power of the demon and come into contact with the Diamond River.”
“Quack!!!” Upon hearing that, Duckie nodded. In the next moment, it took out an Abyss Reincarnation Bean and swallowed it.
At the same time, the duck crushed the bottle containing the Diamond River Water. Golden water flowed down its arm and into its entire body!!
Its cleansing water was also filled with weak power at this moment.
In an instant.
A monstrous demonic aura first appeared on the duck’s body. Then, right on the heels of that, under the light, a holy golden light that was like a Buddha began to go against the demonic aura.
“Quack!!!”
As the duck shouted, the overlord’s will erupted, and its energy level rose steadily.
100,000… 200,000… 500,000… 1 million…
In the end, the duck’s energy level stopped at 2 million.
Shi Yu was very surprised.
Because the Demon Vanquishing Duck was only a low-level monarch race, and the proficiency of the duck’s Skill wasn’t that high, could its energy level be so high after evolution?
It should be the overlord’s Resistance, the power of the abyss, and the power of purification that strengthened the evolution Effect…
Unfortunately, there was only one super Skill.
However, even so, his Demon Vanquishing Duck shouldn’t be as simple as a low-level monarch race. He felt that it could be evaluated as a quasi overlord race.
Under the golden evolution light, Duckie’s body also reached nearly two meters tall.
The blue skin had already disappeared from its entire body. In its place was a valiant duck form that looked like it was drenched in golden water and had the color of a Vajra Buddha!!
“Quack!!!” The Duck King Kong glared, its deterrence and domineering aura revealed. Metal water lingered in its hand, and a pestle-shaped weapon condensed in its hand!!
Skill: Demon Subduing Pestle
[Level]: Super
[Stats]: Water
< Introduction > It’s a weapon skill that can eliminate various sins and destroy various evil powers.
…
< Name > Demon Vanquishing Duck
[Stats]: Water
[Race Level]: High-level monarch (Quasi overlord)
[Level of Growth]: Monarch level
[Race Skill]:
...
“Intermediate”: Water Blade (transcendent), Heart Strike (transcendent)
“Advanced”: Heart Sword (Initiate)
“Super”: Demon Vanquishing Pestle (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Intermediate”: Purification (Dao Proficiency)
“Advanced”: Wave Cannon (expert), Deterrence (Initiate)
“Roar…” At this moment, Little Ji sized up the extremely holy duck, whose energy fluctuations looked stronger than it imagined. It was slightly silent.
So fierce?
As for Susu, it was very gratified that Duckie’s Demon Vanquishing Duck form didn’t look so dirty anymore.
“Ning!!”
It was worth encouraging.
...
“Quack!!!” At this moment, Duckie excitedly displayed its strength to Shi Yu, Susu, and the others.
Apart from the Demon Subduing Pestle, there was also the Heart Sword.
Skill: Heart Sword
[Level]: High
Stats: Spirit
< Introduction > The saber slashes the body and the heart slashes the soul. The Heart Sword can cut off the seven emotions and six desires of the enemy.
“Quack!!” Duckie looked at Little Ji, indicating that it could assist it in training its reverse scale skill. The Heart Sword could suppress its anger and quickly increase the proficiency of the reverse scale, but the premise was to admit that land was also the territory of the sea!
“Roar!! (I’ll break through now. Fight after breaking through!)”
Facing the aggressive duck, Little Ji felt very pressured.
“Demon Vanquishing Duck, one of the unique pets in the Ming Hua area. It’s a little like Buddhism,” Shi Yu said. “Alright, another Buddhist and Demon dual cultivator from the second team.”
Although its evolution was a little turbulent, Shi Yu understood that it should be even smoother after it fused with the power of the abyss and mastered the abyss form after seeing Duckie successfully awaken the Heart Sword and Demon Subduing Pestle.
At least, it wouldn’t be easily lost by the power of the abyss.
“Roar, roar, roar!!!” After Duckie evolved and broke through, Little Ji also ran to the gravity area with high fighting spirit.
Damn it, seeing that Duckie was a little extraordinary after its evolution and breakthrough, Little Ji felt that the pressure of gravity alone might not be enough. It wanted to apply for a Purification breakthrough with gravity and magma with Buggy. Duck!

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 1017 Renewable Resource Yun An Appears
chapters.content:
1017 Renewable Resource Yun An Appears
After Duckie evolved and broke through, Little Ji also followed suit.
In an extremely high pressure and high temperature environment, it unearthed its potential to the extreme.
After it broke through, its energy level reached 2.5 million, steadily suppressing Duckie.
After all, Little Ji was an overlord race mechanical phantom beast modified by Ling with the Tyrant Dragon and Earth Dragon fossils. In terms of potential, it definitely exceeded ordinary Demon Vanquishing Ducks. This was also normal.
!!
The premise was that Duckie shouldn’t take medicine to awaken the power of its previous life.
In short, after both parties were done, Little Ji and Duckie started a new round of battle…
Shi Yu chose to ignore it…
As long as their battle didn’t go wrong,
It could increase each other.
He basically turned a blind eye.
…
Time passed quickly. After learning that Shi Yu had broken through, while Shi Yu continued to add points to Chi Tong. Elder Lu had already successfully recommended him as one of the Beast Tamers of the Demon Sect who represented the Demon Sect in the Sword Trial.
This time, there were a total of 32 core disciples recommended by the Demon Sect. They were all above the Master level. There was even a young sect master who had reached the legend realm.
However, perhaps in the eyes of the Demon Sect, most of the people were accompanying this junior sect master, so they didn’t pay much attention.
“The value here has almost been drained dry.” In the courtyard of the core disciple, Shi Yu counted the gains he had replicated here during this period of time and was very satisfied.
Now, they were just waiting for the final retraction…
A few days later.
Shi Yu followed the large group of the Demon Sect and crossed the west of the Heavenly Sword Nation to the Sword God Mountain in the center of the Heavenly Sword Nation.
This land was vast and boundless. The mountain was ancient and steep, like a sword that pierced into the sky. As he gradually went deeper, Shi Yu could sense that this was definitely an ancient battlefield.
Even a wild grass by the roadside had weak sword intent fluctuations.
“As expected of the Holy Land of the Heavenly Sword Nation.” Chen Luo sighed.
In a month, Shi Yu didn’t know how he broke through to level five and obtained a monarch-level pet to represent the Demon Sect in the competition.
However, after careful counting, the Beast Taming strength of the totem country was indeed far inferior to the seven countries.
“Sword God Mountain is ahead. After arriving at the Holy Land, no one is allowed to act on their own.” The leader of the Demon Sect this time was the legendary sect master of the Demon Sect, Mo Ling, a cold beautiful woman.
It was said that it was born with a sword body and had a rare Beast Taming Talent strengthened by sword intent. It was adopted by the totem guardian of the Demon Sect, the Dark Heaven Sword Feather Divine Eagle. After defeating the previous legendary sect master, it successfully succeeded the throne.
The so-called Demon Sect looked impressive and was one of the two major factions of the Heavenly Sword Nation. In fact, it was equivalent to doing odd jobs for the totem-level Dark Heaven Sword Feather Divine Eagle.
After all, compared to searching for food daily, it was more convenient to have a group of servants prepare it for him.
Every month, the sect had to offer a large number of energy crystals to totem creatures. They couldn’t miss a meal. Totems like the gem cat and the owl definitely liked this very much.
“Master, it’s someone from the Sword Sect.” Beside Mo Ling, a young man in his twenties with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes suddenly looked at the sky.
“Roar…” Several overlord-level flying dragons were dragging a huge floating palace and also flying in the direction of the Sword God Mountain.
“Don’t worry about them,” the higher-ups of the Demon Sect said calmly when they saw their greatest competitor, the Sword Sect.
Shi Yu mixed in the crowd and yawned. It had nothing to do with him. He couldn’t wait to enter the ruins anymore…
At the same time, he hummed a tune in his heart.
“Beast Taming… Young… Man. After experiencing hardships and suffering, I endured the long night…”
…
Soon, the group from the Demon Sect arrived at the Sword God Mountain and arrived at their mountaintop.
The Sword Trial Conference was a grand event in the Heavenly Sword Nation. Dozens of factions of various sizes gathered, and Beast Taming geniuses from all over the country gathered.
At the same time, it was also one of the few times when the Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Nation could worship the current demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation, the Sword Ghost God.
The current demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation was also an undead life form like the founder of the Heavenly Sword Nation.
It could even be said that they were all from the same race and were born from antique swords. In this era where antique swords couldn’t become spirits, it could be said that there were fewer and fewer old antiques like them who had survived the old era.
After Shi Yu and the others arrived at the mountaintop of the Demon Sect, they looked at the main peak. There was a white-haired old man meditating with his eyes closed.
This was the host of the Sword Trial Conference and also the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God. He was also the only titled legend Beast Tamer in the Heavenly Sword Nation. During the period when the Sword Ghost God was sleeping, he was in charge of representing all matters.
“We’re all here, right?” On various mountain peaks of various sizes, various factions had already gathered. At this moment, as more and more people gathered, the white-haired old man finally opened his eyes.
“Before the Sword Trial begins, please, Sword God!!” Although he was old, his voice was very penetrating, spreading to every tall mountain.
“Please, Sword God…” As he finished speaking, the representatives of the factions, including Sect Master Mo Ling of the Demon Sect, spoke at the same time, regardless of their status.
In fact, before Shi Yu came, he had also been taught the procedures of the Sword Trial by Elder Lu. At this moment, he was like a charlatan as he muttered with everyone.
“Please, Sword God…” It was just a sentence. He only wanted the Sword God of the Heavenly Sword Nation to quickly come out and open the door to the mystic realm for him.
After arriving, Shi Yu let Buggy secretly sense it. He didn’t sense any Heavenly Sword Ruins. As expected, it wasn’t that easy to find a ruin close to the divine level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 1018 Renewable Resource, Yun An Appears (2)
chapters.content:
1018 Renewable Resource, Yun An Appears (2)
However, when Buggy reached the totem level and its spatial control reached transcendent, it shouldn’t be that difficult.
“Sword God…” Hundreds of voices echoed in Sword God Mountain. At the same time, spatial ripples appeared in the sky.
Boom.
Under a bolt of lightning, as if a sleeping sword ghost god had been awakened, the sky immediately darkened.
Crack.
In midair, a huge spatial crack appeared. Right on the heels of that, a huge spirit body covered in dark red like a demon appeared. At this moment, its body was filled with a monstrous dark aura. Evil streams surged, radiating black light that filled the sky, and its power was incomparably vast.
“Sword God…” The voice was still echoing, but as the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God, the white-haired old man was clearly stunned when the Sword God appeared.
Because he sensed an unusual aura from the other party. It was very different from the previous years.
Including the leaders of the other factions, they also sensed the abnormality of the Sword Ghost God, but they didn’t care too much. They only thought that the Sword God had broken through again.
In the crowd, only one person’s pupils suddenly constricted, revealing an extremely incredulous expression as he looked at the sky.
This person was Shi Yu.
Because he sensed an extremely familiar Yun clan aura on the Sword Ghost God of the Heavenly Sword Nation that he couldn’t be wrong!
“How is this possible…”
“Who is it…” Shi Yu muttered in his heart.
With a boom.
Under his incredulous gaze, the Sword Ghost God that should have appeared this time to preside over the Sword Trial Conference and activated the Heavenly Sword Ruins for the geniuses in the Sword Trial Conference directly fell from the spatial ripples!! It suddenly fell!!
It was like a corpse thrown from the sky, turning into a meteor that hit the air and landed with a boom!!
Bang!!!
The corporeal spirit body of the Sword Ghost God landed on the ground, causing a huge sound, making everyone present raise their heads in shock, their gazes filled with shock, confusion, and confusion.
Looking at the huge body that had fallen in front of him, the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God, the white-haired old man, widened his eyes almost instantly. He took a step back and said in an extremely hoarse voice,
“No, impossible.”
“This is…”
“Sword God was killed!!! Alert the entire place!!!”
….
“What?!!”
“Impossible!!”
“Lord Sword God, it…”
At this moment, as the huge body landed, the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God let out an unbelievable shout. The Beast Tamers from all over the Heavenly Sword Nation who participated in the Sword Conference spoke in disbelief and shock.
Swoosh!!!
The Beast Tamers on the Demon Sect’s side instantly looked around as if they were facing a great enemy.
A demigod was killed?
What a joke.
“The enemy is in the sky!!!” Countless people looked at the sky.
In the sky, after the spatial ripples, black mist spread, and an even larger spatial crack appeared.
A terrifying might kept coming from it, shaking the sky and earth.
After the Sword Ghost God’s body was thrown down, a huge leg dozens of meters long first stretched out and stepped out. Then, the mountain-like monster descended amidst thunderous laughter!!
It was a huge ape filled with a dark aura. Its black hair gathered around its face like a demon, and its entire body was filled with an ominous aura.
Top-notch totem!!
Just as they saw this monster, some legend Beast Tamers present determined that the monster in front of them definitely had the strength of a top-notch totem!!
It was unbelievably strong.
Most Beast Tamers immediately sent out their pets.
Its body trembled as it prepared to fight.
But at the same time, they were very puzzled.
Although this guy looked very strong, what right did he have to hurt the Sword God?
“And…”
Many people were stunned and had frightened expressions, because this wasn’t the end. As it appeared, an even more terrifying aura that could crush the sky revealed a trace. Right on the heels of that, a ridiculously huge guy outlined a corner of its figure with a black shadow that covered the sky.
This seemed to be a deer-shaped creature. Its huge intertwined horns were like continuous mountains, and its entire body was filled with dazzling black light. Just looking at it, it was as if its heart would sink into the abyss in the next moment.
Its body was made of demon statues that danced around like prismatic metals superimposed. On these metals, white and black gradually changed, emitting a terrifying Demon God aura that was extremely oppressive.
Before the monster completely descended, the two totems sleeping somewhere in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation opened their eyes and revealed shocked expressions.
“Demigod…”
It wasn’t just them. At this moment, everyone on the Sword God Mountain almost fainted and crawled down after a corner of the Demon God-like monster’s figure was revealed.
At that moment, they could only see the huge black pupils and huge horns in the sky. However, it was completely enough. As the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God, the white-haired old man had even experienced the strength of the Sword God, but at this moment…
At this moment, facing this strange monster, an incomparable fear was born in the white-haired old man’s heart. He felt that this monster was much stronger than Lord Sword God…
“Hehehehe, there are quite a lot of people.” The huge black ape looked at the surrounding Beast Tamers and laughed strangely.
...
“Supreme Demon God requests to talk. Representative, please come out immediately!!”
“I advise you… not to waste time.”
At this moment, everyone could tell that this huge ape with the strength of a top-notch totem could only be considered the messenger of that dark shadow. Even if they saw their country’s Sword God fall beside them with their own eyes, this unbelievable pressure made the Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Nation and even the spokesperson of the Sword God not dare to act rashly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 1019 Renewable Resource Yun An Appears (3)
chapters.content:
1019 Renewable Resource Yun An Appears (3)
Without a doubt, the Sword Ghost God… was harmed by them!
But how was this possible…
Without anyone noticing…
It made the entire Heavenly Sword Nation not sense any movement… Lord Sword God was also a demigod!
!!
“I…” At this moment, as the spokesperson of the Sword God, the white-haired old man couldn’t help but take a step forward. This step seemed to have exhausted a huge amount of courage. He raised his head and looked at the sky.” What have you done to Lord Sword God!!! ”
“Who exactly are you!!”
“Hehehehe, oh?” The huge black ape looked at the white-haired old man and smiled strangely. “That guy isn’t dead yet, but it’s no different from dead now.”
“As for us…” The huge black ape continued to chuckle.” I’m a general of the Yun Race, the Black Meteorite Divine Ape. As for this supreme lord, he’s the king of the Yun Race, no, the king of the world, Lord Yun An! ”
“Apart from that big guy, you’re the representative of this country, right? We came this time because we heard that this country has a special meteor iron and specially came to take it away.”
“I hope you can cooperate.”
“You have to know that your Sword God became like this because he didn’t cooperate…”
The black giant ape chuckled. It hoped that these people would be more tactful.
Because the king, Yun An, had just woken up, his strength was far inferior to his peak. He urgently needed to replenish his strength.
As for the divine-level meteor iron of the Heavenly Sword Nation, it was a treasure that could quickly allow it to recover its strength.
Unfortunately, this meteorite iron was sealed in a ruins mystic realm.
Although it was easy for a demigod to destroy this ruins mystic realm with the strength of a demigod, restricted by the mechanism of the ruins, if the ruins collapsed, there would also be a risk of destruction for divine-level resources.
In order to not destroy the meteorite, the Yun Race couldn’t attack forcefully. They could only find the demigods of the Heavenly Sword Nation and try to cooperate.
Unfortunately, the demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation didn’t give him any face…
However, to the surprise of the Yun Race, the demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation was only a dabbler. He relied on the divine-level Arms left behind by the previous demigods to have the strength of a demigod. Without possessing the Arms, his battle power was ordinary.
Moreover, this Arms was also made of divine-level meteor iron from outer space. When he saw the food, Yun An naturally didn’t hold back and swallowed the meteor iron he could see first.
As for the one in the ruins…
The Yun clan, who had already figured out the mechanism of the Heavenly Sword Ruins, planned to obtain it normally first. If it didn’t work, they could only attack and bet.
“We know that it’s very difficult to take out this meteorite normally, but you still have to try,” the huge black ape said. “Everyone present, go in and try one by one.”
“If necessary, we will also help you strengthen your strength.”
“If you can succeed and obtain the meteor iron and offer it, Your Majesty will naturally reward you.”
“And if all of them fail, it’s a pity that there’s no need for this ruin and this country to exist. Not only will we directly destroy the Heavenly Sword Ruins, but we’ll also completely sink this country into the sea!!”
“Then, do you want to cooperate?”
“Time is tight. Who wants to go first?”
…
“Brother… Brother Lin… It’s over…” At this moment, under the deterrence of a demigod and a top-notch totem, most Beast Tamers had already peed their pants in fright. They never expected that what happened today would be so strange.
Firstly, the national guardian was killed. Secondly, an even stronger external enemy targeted the treasure in the Heavenly Sword Ruins and forced the Beast Tamers present to crack and take it.
If no one could take it out, they would forcefully destroy the Heavenly Sword Ruins and destroy the Heavenly Sword Nation??
Everyone trembled. They didn’t doubt at all that the two huge monsters in front of them had such strength.
However… how could that meteorite be taken out normally? Even Sword God couldn’t take it out normally!
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation panicked.
However, among everyone, the one with the most complicated emotions was definitely not the Beast Tamer of the Heavenly Sword Nation.
Instead, it was Shi Yu who finally saw Yun An with his own eyes. He couldn’t help but tremble in excitement.
Damn!
After searching for Yun An for so long, he finally found it.
It looked like Yun An had revived in the end and escaped Dong Huang’s vision.
What shocked Shi Yu the most was that he didn’t expect Yun An to have such strength just after reviving. He was considered an expert even among demigods. Shi Yu didn’t expect it at all.
At this moment, the pressure this Yun An gave him was even higher than the demigods of all the totem clans in Inatella.
Was this the super general sent by the Abyss Evil God Race to Blue Planet? As expected, it was not something ordinary demigods could compare to.
“The Yun Race has targeted the meteor iron of the Heavenly Sword Ruins?”
“That’s true. After all, Yun An is also formed from meteor iron from outer space. This resource might also be extremely important to it.”
Motherf*cker.
At this moment, Shi Yu didn’t know what to feel.
Lady Luck Ling, was this considered unlucky or lucky?
He was finally lucky to have encountered the renewable resource, Yun An.
However, the risk of taking away the divine-level meteor iron looked even greater.
“But we can’t let it succeed. Otherwise, who knows what will happen! It will definitely be harder to deal with.” Shi Yu suppressed the light in his eyes.
He never expected that he would encounter so much nonsense on his trip to the Heavenly Sword Nation. His plans couldn’t keep up with the changes.
In the beginning, the plan was fine, but it was all in chaos. At this point, Shi Yu, who originally thought that he could handle this trip, could only use his big move.
He took a deep breath…
...
[Senior Divine Source, save me!] [Dragon God, save me!] [President Lin, save me!] [Sister Elven Empress, save me]… Sister Valkyrie is fine too! Shi Yu immediately wanted to send news to Dong Huang through the Intelligence Bureau Index through special channels.
Seek external help!
However, in the next moment, Ling’s nervous voice sounded in Shi Yu’s heart.
“Master… don’t. Now that the entire Heavenly Sword Nation is blocked by a special power, not only might the signal of the Index not be transmitted, but it’s very likely to be intercepted and discovered.”
“Although the Yun clan looks high-profile this time, the preparations might be very sufficient. Even in the face of a remote country in seclusion, they don’t want to expose their traces themselves.”
Shi Yu: “?”
It meant that… there were no reinforcements? Then what the hell?
Shi Yu’s mood kept changing. He flipped through his trump cards at a speed of 100 times per second.
Wait a minute, the power of the Blue Sea Ruins didn’t seem to be blocked! Fortunately, as long as he could slip away!

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 1020 Emperor Wu Appears
chapters.content:
1020 Emperor Wu Appears
The deterrence of Yun An and the Black Ape enveloped the entire Sword God Mountain, making everyone not dare to act rashly.
Even Shi Yu could only wait and see, analyzing what to do next.
The Blue Sea Ruins was his ultimate escape method.
However, the spatial changes caused during the escape process would definitely be sensed by Yun An and alert the enemy.
!!
There was a high chance that it would obstruct it.
That didn’t matter.
Although their strength was not enough to resist demigod-level battle power, Shi Yu still had the Dragon God Protection, so he was not afraid of demigod-level interceptions.
Moreover, they weren’t pushovers themselves. It shouldn’t be a problem for them to successfully leave the battle.
This period of time was enough for the Teleportation to succeed.
However, leaving directly would definitely alert Yun An. He could forget about the divine-level meteor iron. It would definitely immediately destroy the ruins.
With Yun An’s careful appearance, after discovering the clues, he definitely wouldn’t stay here for long.
It was not easy for the Dong Huang army to successfully capture it.
“Forget it.”
After considering for a long time, Shi Yu felt that it was not appropriate to fight Yun An for the time being.
This guy wasn’t weak. It might be the strongest demigod he had seen apart from the World Tree.
It was completely not as weak as Dong Huang, him, Ji Mengzhu, and the others had expected at the start.
Even the demigod of the Heavenly Sword Nation died in the other party’s hands.
Now, Shi Yu began to be puzzled.
How exactly did Emperor Wu, who had yet to master a quasi-divine skill, suppress Yun An?
In short, it wasn’t worth it to forcefully fight Yun An in this state for the evolution materials of the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
The price would be especially high.
Since he knew that Yun An had revived, it was better to wait for the World Tree to awaken and wait for Susu to develop. He would let the two demigods of the strongest tier join forces. This way, he could steadily suppress Yun An. Moreover, he didn’t have to pay a huge price.
After analyzing with Ling, Shi Yu’s goal quickly became clear.
He couldn’t leave directly. This was equivalent to giving up on the divine-level metal.
After obtaining the divine-level metal, he would teleport away from this place.
Wanting to ask him for ruins resources? No way.
Although this way, Yun An would intercept him even more intensely, after preparing for so long, Shi Yu would definitely not be willing to let this silly Yun An snatch away the resources.
After successfully leaving, he would make Dong Huang and even the seven countries prepare for battle. After all, the Yun Race was not only Dong Huang’s enemy, but also the enemy of the entire Blue Planet.
Shi Yu retreated slightly behind everyone.
It was already determined to compete with Yun An for the ownership of the divine iron.
Sigh, after returning to the country, he would definitely be scolded again…
….
At the same time, the black ape said calmly,
“After getting the meteorite, we’ll leave. Perhaps your Sword God can still be saved.”
“But if you delay too much time, the outcome won’t be something you can withstand.”
“Huh?” It looked at the white-haired old man questioningly.
Boom!!!
As it finished speaking, a purple-red light flashed in Yun An’s eyes.
In the next moment, a huge energy storm appeared around it. In the storm, space distorted.
In the distorted space, the sky darkened, and the sky directly turned purple-red. Moreover, a sword tower that was like a heavenly sword and a thousand meters tall appeared in the outside world like a projection.
“Heavenly Sword Ruins!”
Seeing this Heavenly Sword, many Beast Tamers who had entered the Heavenly Sword Ruins were shocked.
In the past, only the Sword God could summon and find the Heavenly Sword Ruins, but now, this creature who called itself Yun An had also directly done it.
Its power was undoubtedly above the power of the ruins.
“Everyone…” Seeing this scene, the expression of the white-haired old man changed. He knew that the situation was completely irreversible.
If he didn’t follow the requirements of this Yun Race, the white-haired old man had a feeling that the Heavenly Sword Nation would really be destroyed because of this.
“At this point, for the sake of the Heavenly Sword Nation, I beg everyone to try challenging the Heavenly Sword Ruins.”
“Next, regardless of sect, family, background, or level, you can try to enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins to challenge the level.”
He looked at the Sword Ghost God that shouldn’t be considered dead. He only hoped that as time passed, the Sword Ghost God could recover from this state.
Everyone was silent.
“That’s more like it.” The black ape smiled.
“In addition, we know that the chances of you obtaining the divine iron are not high.”
“Therefore, I specially prepared a gift for you.”
Space cracked.
...
A few black metal swords landed.
It said, “This ruin can allow weapons, right?”
“These Arms are all replicas of your Sword God’s weapons and have been modified.”
“Anyone who can reach the sixth level and above can take away an Arms and try to challenge the level again.”
“It can increase your battle talent potential to a greater extent… Hehe.
“Let me think. Those who have reached the Legend level might as well come over and choose an Arms to adapt to in advance.”
“After all, you guys are the main force to crack the ruins.”
The few legend Beast Tamers present looked at the longsword filled with a black aura, their expressions constantly changing.
They all knew very well that this might be a Demon Sword with a huge price.
….
Then, under the pressure of life and death, Beast Tamers entered the Heavenly Sword Ruins one after another.
...
The Heavenly Sword Ruins was not the same space as the outside world. The people who entered seemed to have left this place.
Seeing that Yun An didn’t have the ability to half fuse the Heavenly Sword Ruins into the outside world, Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 1021 Emperor Wu Appears (2)
chapters.content:
1021 Emperor Wu Appears (2)
This way, he could even directly teleport away from the Heavenly Sword Ruins. The risk of being intercepted would be even smaller.
“I’ll give it my all.”
At this moment, many weak Beast Tamers had complicated feelings.
He looked at the Heavenly Sword Ruins with a burning gaze.
!!
Seeing such an opportunity in front of him, even if the situation of the Heavenly Sword Nation was in danger, he still chose to rush into the Heavenly Sword Ruins first.
Although the chances of helping the Yun Race obtain the divine-level meteor iron were minimal, the ruins were also a trial inheritance land. It was always beneficial to enter and stay a little longer.
Before the large factions could move, many Beast Tamers of small factions couldn’t resist the temptation and entered the ruins through the Sword World one after another.
The first level of the Sword Tower lit up.
However, most people were not qualified to enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins to begin with. In less than a minute after entering this trial ruin, they were defeated in the first level and ejected from the ruins.
The faces of the Beast Tamers who were ejected turned pale, as if they had experienced a nightmare and lost their vitality. Their expressions were very ugly.
“King…” Seeing this scene, the black giant ape was silent. Was this the standard of the Beast Tamers in this country?
Although they had placed more hope on the few legend Beast Tamers who took out the divine iron, these low-level Beast Tamers were too lousy.
There were a total of nine levels in the Heavenly Sword Ruins. They couldn’t even pass the first level?
Now, the reason why they let these low-level Beast Tamers give it a try was also because the Yun clan hoped to see if they could choose a few good seedlings to brainwash and modify.
After all, the Yun clan was weak now and urgently needed to replenish new blood.
Trafficking people from such a super faction in seclusion and secretly developing was the first step for the Yun Race to make a comeback.
If the Divine Iron was something they wanted, they also wanted humans and transcendent lives with talent and potential.
….
The Heavenly Sword Ruins could only withstand the trial of lives below the totem level. There were a total of nine levels.
The current highest record was passing the eighth level.
However, only by passing the ninth level could one obtain divine iron.
“All Beast Tamers of the Demon Sect, listen up.”
At this point, on the Demon Sect’s side, the legend sect master, Mo Ling, looked in the direction of the silent guardian’s residence and took a deep breath. “You guys should also enter the Heavenly Sword Ruins.”
“This is a rare opportunity. You should try my best to increase your strength.”
The sect master of the Demon Sect immediately guessed part of the Yun clan’s thoughts when he saw that not only did the Yun clan let legends like them prepare, but they also let a bunch of trash try the ruins trial.
Even if the Yun clan didn’t successfully obtain the divine iron in the end, as long as someone displayed enough talent value, they should still have a chance to live.
At the moment, this Heavenly Sword Ruins was the place to show its value.
In order to prevent the Demon Sect from being completely destroyed, she immediately gave the order to let the disciples of the Demon Sect enter the ruins and try their best to clear the levels to obtain strength.
At most, she would change a demigod to follow. It was better than dying. She didn’t believe that the other party could be ruthless and destroy a bunch of humans who had reached the Legend level and were willing to rely on Yun An.
However, not everyone had the same awareness as Sect Master Mo Ling. Many people’s expressions were not very good.
For example, Chen Luo looked like he had lost his parents. “How can I still be in the mood to carry out the trial inheritance now…”
“The Heavenly Sword Nation is about to fall.”
“Eh, Brother Lin, you’re not trembling anymore?”
Chen Luo saw Shi Yu recover from his trembling fear and said.
“Let’s go.”
Shi Yu glanced at the devastated Chen Luo beside him and walked towards the Sword Tower with a smile.
This smile stunned Chen Luo.
You’re still smiling? Are you crazy?
No one cared about a little guy like Shi Yu.
Too many Beast Tamers like him had entered the ruins.
Buzz!
The spatial ripples trembled slightly, and Shi Yu disappeared.
…
The Heavenly Sword Ruins had a total of nine levels. Each level had a Sword Puppet projection protecting it.
The Sword Puppet projection mastered a special super sword intent.
It could be said that every Sword Puppet was the power projection of the late Heavenly Sword demigod, carrying the Sword Dao EXP of the Heavenly Sword demigod.
Fighting them, be it victory or defeat, was the moment closest to the Sword Dao EXP of the Heavenly Sword demigod.
