Many pets with good talent comprehended a new Sword Dao Resistance in the battle with the Sword Puppet.
However, the trial had many benefits, but the difficulty was also very high.
Although the energy level of every Sword Puppet would be adjusted to the standard level of the challenger’s realm, their skill proficiency became more and more terrifying as the number of levels increased.
The first level’s sword puppet had mastered expert level super sword intent. The second level was perfect level, and the sixth level had even reached transcendent level.
If the challenger was a monarch-level pet and walked to the sixth level, it would face an enemy who had mastered transcendent proficiency super sword intent.
Even if this enemy only had monarch-level attributes and no other skills, and even had to fight many alone, just a transcendent super sword intent was not so easy to defeat.
It was precisely because of this terrifying difficulty that no one had been able to clear the Heavenly Sword Ruins until now.
...
The divine iron had also been sealed for a thousand years.
At this moment, as Shi Yu entered the Heavenly Sword Ruins, he had already arrived at an endless sword world.
He didn’t see anyone else. They had probably been teleported to different spaces.
In this red world that was like a sword tomb with many sword projections buried, Shi Yu soon saw a sword puppet slowly walking towards him.
Its image was like a terracotta soldier. It held a stone sword and was filled with sharp sword intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 1022 Emperor Wu Appears (3)
chapters.content:
1022 Emperor Wu Appears (3)
It wasn’t the only one. Even the surrounding buried sword shadows were wrapped in strong sword intent. It was indeed a holy land of swords.
Sword-type pets fought and trained here. It was difficult for their growth speed to not be fast.
“A sword puppet with only 50 million energy points?”
At that moment, Shi Yu stood in the distance and could sense its power fluctuations. It had already reached the overlord-level standard, about 50 million energy points.
!!
Shi Yu, who was wearing a black tight battle suit and a short gray shirt, a core disciple uniform of the Demon Sect, grinned.
“Interesting. Looks like the Heavenly Sword Ruins has judged my first level. Is it the first level opponent prepared for me according to the legend standard?”
“An overlord-level sword puppet that has mastered expert-level super sword intent…”
As Shi Yu muttered, a golden light suddenly appeared on the Sword Puppet.
To put it bluntly, sword intent was a special deterrence similar to dragon might and phoenix might.
A sharp sword intent erupted from the Sword Puppet and its Arms, instantly turning into a golden hurricane that attacked Shi Yu.
Expert level super metal sword intent!
The Gust’s sharp aura that was like a rain directly turned into a shocking killing weapon, stimulating the spirit and soul.
However, such an attack was too weak for Shi Yu.
In fact, if it weren’t for the fact that the power of the ruins suppressed the other power systems apart from Sword-type Skills, Shi Yu could have insta-killed it with his Psychic power.
At this moment, the feeling this ruin gave Shi Yu was that if he wanted to forcefully use other power systems, he would immediately be rejected by the ruins space.
Almost kicked out of the space.
In the Heavenly Sword Ruins, only sword-type Skills could be used.
“Forget it.”
“Chi Tong, I’ll leave it to you.”
“Test my improvement during this period of time through this ruin.”
“Mi… (Mm.)”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, a huge black summoning array appeared in front of him.
Flames rose in the sky. In the flames, a human figure appeared!
She had a beautiful face and was wearing silver armor. She had red hair and red eyes that draped over her shoulders. Her phantom body that looked like a soul body was wrapped in Phoenix spiritual aura that was like the flames of the sun. Her aura was peerless!
Its eyes were also filled with sharp sword intent.
[Name]: Chi Tong (Sword Maiden Form)
[Race Skill]:
“Super”: Interlocking Sword (Perfect+), Sun Flame (Perfect+), Spirit Release (Perfect+), Flame Spirit Sword Body (Perfect+), Myriad Sword Convergence (Perfect+), Phoenix Sword Intent (Perfect+), Star Fire Sword Formation (Perfect+), Curse Flame (Perfect+)
[Teaching Skill]:
“Advanced”: Scapegoat (transcendent+)
“Super”: Undead Revival (Perfect+), Soul Incarnation (transcendent)
Buzz!
Four sword projections appeared around Chi Tong.
In one, the sword was silver-white, containing purple light that reflected the profundity of space.
In one, the sword was bent and red, and red light lingered around the entire sword body.
In one, the darkness and blue-green death aura on the sword intertwined, containing nirvanic death fluctuations.
The last one was the most ordinary at the moment. However, red patterns lingered on the sword body, emitting the simplest sword edge.
These four sword clones were all condensed by Chi Tong through its soul incarnation and cultivated through various resources.
Three of them had already begun to show their power. Only the fourth Immortal Slaying Sword that represented “sharpness” was still lacking a piece of metal divine iron.
At this moment, facing the enemy who had mastered the sharp metal sword intent, Chi Tong decisively pulled out the Immortal Slaying Sword clone that represented sharpness.
Then, the other three sword clones dimmed. Cracks appeared on the ground where Chi Tong was, and the space where it was instantly collapsed. Its figure flashed, and as its red hair fluttered, the Arms in its hand had already collided with the Sword Puppet!!
Clang!!!
The sword in Chi Tong’s hand and the sword in the Sword Puppet’s hand were filled with a sharp metal edge.
“Mi. (I’ll accept your sword intent.)”
At this moment, Chi Tong was like a talented Sword Dao genius. In just a round of collision, all the Sword Dao EXP of the Sword Puppet that had mastered the Sharp Metal Sword Intent seemed to be unable to hide from it.
This was a top-notch Sword Dao talent brought about by the multiple nurturing of the max-level Sword Dao Resistance, Sword Heart, and World Tree Fruit.
Bang!!!
The sharpness of the sword in Chi Tong’s hand became stronger and stronger. In a breath, the sword in the Sword Puppet’s hand was smoothly divided into two, and the Sword Puppet’s entire body was also divided into two. The golden sword light was extremely sharp.
“Hu…” Chi Tong saw the figure of the enemy in front of it disappear. It gently swung its sword, and the tip of the sword touched the ground as it looked at the surrounding sword projections.
“Forget about this. It hasn’t improved you much. Even the opponent just now is a little too weak.” Shi Yu slowly walked over and patted her shoulder, indicating for her to follow.
Chi Tong:!!!
Chi Tong immediately nodded and jogged beside Shi Yu to head to the second level with him.
….
On the second level, it was a sword puppet with an energy value of 50 million and had mastered the perfect super Heavenly Thunder Sword Intent.
...
On the third level, it was a sword puppet with 50 million energy points and had mastered the super perfect super Storm Sword Intent.
The opponent was getting stronger and stronger, but without a doubt, it was killed by Chi Tong in one hit again.
They were still used by Chi Tong to train the sharpness sword in its hands.
The sharpness of lightning and the sharpness of storms. Chi Tong was like a sword master. It could accept all rivers in the sea, and any EXP could be converted for its own use.
Fourth level, fifth level… Chi Tong didn’t even use its active Skill. It only relied on a sword clone and the enhancement of the Flame Spirit Sword Body to defeat these guardian Sword Puppets like cutting melons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 1023 Emperor Wu Appears (4)
chapters.content:
1023 Emperor Wu Appears (4)
Only when they reached the sixth level did Shi Yu and Chi Tong raise their spirits slightly.
This was because although the guardian of this level only had 50 million energy points, he had mastered the transcendent super sword intent. His Skill proficiency was so high that it had even exceeded Shi Yu’s main force.
After all, even Eleven and Chi Tong had yet to master a transcendent active attack Skill.
However, this level was still not very difficult for Shi Yu and the others.
!!
After all, the opponent’s energy level was half as low as Chi Tong’s, and there was only one Skill.
Chi Tong’s sword clone alone might make it hard, but when Chi Tong used two or more super top-notch sword skills to form the combination profundity, the situation instantly reversed.
It had to be said that Chi Tong’s skills were too strong.
Moreover, they were all skills that could be combined.
Sun Flame and Curse Flame were both top-notch super Skills.
When their two intertwined swords formed an extremely terrifying power, together with the sword clone, it was enough to resist the sixth level.
On this foundation, Chi Tong could also wrap the Phoenix Sword Intent and use the Flame Spirit Sword Body to unleash a stronger and more dazzling attack.
Even this was not Chi Tong’s limit. After all, it could still use Myriad Sword Convergence to increase its battle power to the limit.
In fact, after reaching his limit, it could even possess Shi Yu and exceed his limit.
Did he think this was the limit? After all, Chi Tong’s four sword clones were all created by transcendent super Skills. They were all very powerful. When the four swords fused, they were invincible.
It was as if the totem sword god had descended.
The most terrifying thing was that the price of such an eruption could even be endured by the scapegoat of Undead Revival.
It was not easy for a trial set up by a demigod to stump Shi Yu and the others with such shocking battle potential.
“Divine iron, my divine iron…”
…
When Shi Yu was challenging the level, there was already a huge commotion in the outside world.
At the moment, the legend experts who the Yun Race had high hopes for didn’t directly enter the ruins.
Instead, they were detained by Yun An and the others to force them to adapt to new Arms and stimulate their potential.
Holding the new Arms, the expressions of the legend experts were ugly. Although the radiation power inside could greatly increase their state, the price was irreversible damage. It consumed life potential.
“Old man, you reached the eighth level previously, right? With this sword, are you confident of passing the eighth or even the ninth level??” the black giant ape asked him.
“This…” Looking at the demonic aura flowing to his arm, the spokesperson of the Sword Ghost God was already completely silent.
“At the cost of my life, there might be hope for the eighth level, but the ninth level…”
“Even if you can’t, you have to. In short, the fate of the Heavenly Sword Nation is in your hands,” the black giant ape said coldly.
Just as it finished speaking, a change occurred in the Sword Tower.
Finally, someone passed the second level.
Because most of the Beast Tamers who had just entered couldn’t even pass the second level. They even lost in the first level.
The guardian Sword Puppet in the second level had mastered the perfect super sword intent. Unless a true Legend Beast Tamer went in to challenge, even if it was a level-six Beast Tamer, there was a high chance of failure.
Everyone looked at the sword pagoda of the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
With a look… Pa, the light on the third level lit up right on the heels of that.
The Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Nation were stunned.
Right on the heels of that, the fourth level lit up.
The fifth level lit up!
The sixth level!
In a short period of time, before anyone could pass the second level, the light of the Sword Tower actually directly rose to the seventh level. Every level stopped for almost a minute, really stunning the people outside.
“What’s going on?”
“Who’s challenging the level?”
The black giant ape looked at the white-haired old man and the other legends of the Heavenly Sword Nation who were adapting to the Meteorite Sword and immediately asked.
That shouldn’t be the case.
Weren’t the high-end battle power of the Heavenly Sword Nation all here? To be able to grow to this level, their talent potential was undoubtedly the strongest in the Heavenly Sword Nation.
At the moment, the high-level records of the Heavenly Sword Ruins were all in their hands. This group of people had yet to enter, so what was the situation with the Heavenly Sword Ruins now…
“Oh?” At this moment, seeing a Beast Tamer from the Heavenly Sword Nation climb to the seventh level in just a few minutes, even Yun An’s gaze flickered slightly.
However, before they could be too surprised, the light on the eighth level flashed.
This person killed his way to the eighth level in less than ten minutes!
For thousands of years, the highest record of the Heavenly Sword Nation was only passing the eighth level and reaching the ninth level.
Now, the most talented Beast Tamer in the Heavenly Sword Nation, the white-haired legend cultivated by the Sword Ghost God as the spokesperson, had only reached the eighth level.
And now, not only did this mysterious Beast Tamer instantly reach the level of the white-haired old man, but he was also only a step away from the highest record. At this moment, the people of the Heavenly Sword Nation were stunned.
“This… How is this possible?”
“Did a legend go in?”
The white-haired old man holding the Meteorite Sword looked in the direction of the Heavenly Sword Ruins in shock.
If there was no Legend level on the eighth level, it was definitely impossible to reach this level.
...
After all, no matter how talented a monarch-level pet was, it was difficult for it to defeat an enemy who had mastered transcendent proficiency super sword intent.
“Ten minutes, eighth level?” The sect masters of the Demon Sect, the Sword Sect, and their respective legend junior sect masters also looked at the changes in the Heavenly Sword Ruins in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 1024 Emperor Wu Appears (5)
chapters.content:
1024 Emperor Wu Appears (5)
If they remembered correctly, only small figures from the various large factions had entered during this period of time.
The legends who came to the Holy Sword Mountain were clearly at the scene. The number of legends in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation could be counted on two hands!
“Interesting…”
At this moment, although it didn’t know what was going on, the black giant ape smiled.
!!
“Your Majesty.”
“Congratulations.”
“Yes.” Yun An nodded and looked at the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
This was the first time he spoke, and his voice shocked the hearts of the lives in the Heavenly Sword Nation.
“If he can pass the eighth level, we can give him a chance to become a member of the Yun Race.”
“If he can pass the ninth level and take out the divine iron…”
As the outside world was stunned by the changes in the Heavenly Sword Ruins, inside, Shi Yu was fighting the sword puppet on the eighth level.
If the sword puppet on the sixth level had mastered transcendent super sword intent…
Then, according to Shi Yu’s judgment, the sword puppet on the seventh level should increase its strength ten to twenty times on this basis.
As for the sword puppet on the eighth level, it might have already reached super Skill proficiency above (transcendent+50).
However, at the moment, Chi Tong could still steadily suppress the other party with the advantage of having more skills and high energy.
Boom!!!
The Flame Spirit Sword Body of the Myriad Sword Convergence. With the Sword of Death in hand, it formed an interlocking sword with the Sun Flame and the Curse Flame, wrapped in the Phoenix Sword Intent. The super profundity formed by the combination of these seven top-notch super skills was not much inferior to the power of the transcendent proficiency super sword intent.
In the ruins, under the light, the sword puppet that had mastered the Nirvana Sword Intent on the eighth level was killed again. Chi Tong calmly digested the Sword Dao EXP from the battle with it.
At the same time, Shi Yu didn’t breathe much. He headed straight for the ninth and final level.
It was much smoother than he imagined. Shi Yu felt that as long as the sword puppet on the ninth level didn’t master a quasi-divine skill, he might be able to clear the level without using his mind domain. As long as he sacrificed two scapegoats and possessed himself to erupt with the strongest attack, he should be able to clear it.
This way, it would save him the trouble of consuming too much strength and not having enough strength to deal with Yun An later.
At this moment, as Shi Yu ascended to the ninth level, the outside world was already completely stunned.
Due to Shi Yu’s ridiculous speed, after the Beast Tamers in the tower were eliminated, the black giant ape didn’t even let the newbies in.
At this moment, it had already become everyone staring at Shi Yu challenging the level alone.
“Who exactly is it…” The famous Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Nation looked at the Heavenly Sword Ruins in confusion.
Only a young man named Chen Luo looked for Brother Lin in confusion.
At this point, even Yun An was slightly excited.
Not bad.
Very good.
It originally didn’t have much hope of taking away the divine iron normally. It only wanted to give it a try, but it didn’t expect that there was really a Beast Tamer who had the chance to take away the divine iron normally.
If it could swallow this divine iron, not only could its strength recover, but it might even improve.
No matter who it was, it had to reward this guy well.
Everyone held their breaths and watched the changes in the Heavenly Sword Ruins…
One minute… two minutes… five minutes… ten minutes… Finally…
Buzz!!!
A miracle that had never been achieved since the establishment of the Heavenly Sword Ruins appeared in the eyes of all the Beast Tamers in the Heavenly Sword Nation in an extremely ridiculous manner on this incomparably ridiculous day.
Looking at the lit ninth level of the Heavenly Sword Ruins Sword Tower, the Beast Tamers were completely stunned.
They felt that it was extremely strange.
They were very confused.
It really passed? The ninth level???
Who exactly was it?
“The Heavenly Sword demigod reborn??” The white-haired old man was extremely confused.
Yun An and the Black Ape’s moods were also very subtle.
That was it? That was it!!
It was much easier than they imagined!
“Divine iron, my divine iron…” At this moment, Yun An finally couldn’t suppress the excitement in its heart. It waited for the person inside to appear. It loved this person to death.
It wanted to confer the position of a Yun Race general to the other party!
….
At the same time.
Shi Yu, who had red hair and burning eyes, held the sword spirit and calmly looked at the puppet that had turned into ashes in front of him.
“Mi! (If the heavens didn’t give birth to Chi Tong’s Sword Dao, it would be a long night.)” After Chi Tong exited the possession state, it said smugly. Hehe.
The ninth level wasn’t as difficult as he imagined, but in order to gain more Sword Dao EXP, he and Chi Tong didn’t fight so hard from the start. Instead, they tried their best to deal with the other party and fought for a full ten minutes.
At that moment, as the guardian Sword Puppet on the ninth level was defeated, the entire Heavenly Sword Ruins trembled slightly. Shi Yu and Chi Tong’s hearts also trembled.
No accidents happened.
...
As they cleared the level, a spatial ripple appeared. Right on the heels of that, a silver metal the size of a football appeared with a dazzling light.
The sharp and dazzling silver light almost blinded Shi Yu. The powerful energy fluctuations on it really made Shi Yu excited.
Divine-level meteor iron from outer space.
It’s you.
With this, he could create Chi Tong’s Immortal Slaying Sword clone.
At that time, the four clones would all be in place! They could fuse the four Swords into one and use their main bodies as the master to complete the evolution. For this moment, Shi Yu had been looking forward to it in this godforsaken totem ancient country for a long time.
“To get out while the going’s good strategy!!!”
“Buggy, try your best to block the spatial fluctuations.”
A little green dragon swam in Shi Yu’s sleeve.

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 1025 Emperor Wu Appears (6)
chapters.content:
1025 Emperor Wu Appears (6)
At this moment, seeing the divine iron, Shi Yu didn’t say a word and directly put it back into the ruins space. Then, right on the heels of that, he activated the ruins water drop in his hand and tried to escape!!
Buzz!!!
Blue spatial fluctuations immediately enveloped Shi Yu.
….
In the outside world were Yun An’s excited heart and trembling hands.
It stared at the Heavenly Sword Ruins and had already sensed the Teleportation fluctuations inside. However, what made Yun An’s pupils instantly solemn and serious was that this spatial Teleportation fluctuation was not teleporting here. Instead, it seemed to want to leave the Heavenly Sword Nation and teleport to an extremely far distance.
“Bastard!!!”
At this moment, Yun An’s power almost erupted with a bang. The terrifying demigod power instantly distorted space and time. It roared, shocking the entire Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, making all living beings instantly extremely afraid.
On the Sword God Mountain, including the Black Ape Totem, a group of legends was still waiting for the Beast Tamer who had passed the ninth level to come out. They didn’t understand why Yun An was so angry at this moment.
Boom!!!
Yun An’s figure was completely revealed. Its huge body shook the sky and earth. As it appeared, with a boom, the entire Heavenly Sword Ruins was directly shattered by Yun An. Space instantly collapsed, and extremely sharp spatial turbulence and sword intent storm erupted unscrupulously.
Countless sword projections were swept into the spatial turbulence and everything was destroyed in nothingness.
“Your Majesty!!!” The Black Ape Totem instantly roared, not understanding why Yun An suddenly did this.
Why did he directly destroy the Heavenly Sword Ruins?
But soon, they discovered the crack inside the Heavenly Sword Ruins and the abnormality in the depths of space.
A muscular man in a panda short-sleeved shirt floated in the air, his entire body surrounded by weak blue fluctuations.
This man’s expression was indifferent and domineering (he was very panicked). He looked at the mountains and looked at Yun An in front of him. He knew that it wasn’t that easy to slip away directly.
Yun An destroying the Heavenly Sword Ruins directly disturbed the spatial fluctuations and interfered with the Teleportation speed of the Blue Sea Ruins. In fact, if it weren’t for Buggy’s protection, he would have almost been swept into the Void. In short, before the coordinates were corrected, he couldn’t let Yun An continue to interfere.
“Who is it??” At this moment, when they saw Shi Yu, all the Beast Tamers of the Heavenly Sword Nation were stunned.
They didn’t know this person at all.
They didn’t know when he entered.
For his own bad taste, the moment Shi Yu was intercepted, he directly took off the Demon Sect’s disciple uniform, revealing the panda battle suit. At the same time, he used his body control to change his appearance into the appearance of a Emperor Wu!!
He looked down at Yun An.
As expected, when they saw the pattern of Shi Yu’s clothes and Shi Yu’s face, Yun An and the Black Ape’s pupils instantly constricted. They were stunned for a moment.
WQNMD.
“Wu Dong!! Impossible, it’s impossible for you to still be alive!!!” Yun An was shocked. Its shock and anger directly caused the Sword God Mountain to tremble, and the color of the sky changed.
Not only did it revive, but Emperor Wu also f*cking revived?
Looking at the Emperor Wu who appeared, Yun An panicked.
This panic provided Shi Yu with time.
The spatial fluctuations around Shi Yu became more and more stable.
Seeing this, Yun An was shocked.
“No, you’re not him.” Soon, Yun An recovered from its shock and anger. This person was not Emperor Wu. After understanding that it had been tricked by the person in front of it and its goal was to stall for time, it immediately said angrily, “Who exactly are you! Hand over the divine iron!!”
In its anger, its body changed at the same time in the attack. The black metal prism all over its body flowed and turned into a huge beastman form standing on two feet. It stretched out a huge palm with three claws and pinched Shi Yu.
An earth-shattering divine might also enveloped over with this pinch.
Boom!!!
The spatial tide erupted in chaos again.
Dong!!!
A colorless mist wrapped around Yun An’s entire body, and the sound of laws that resounded through the world erupted.
Looking at this ordinary squeeze, Shi Yu’s blood boiled. He felt a huge threat, a crisis from life and death. This feeling was something he had never experienced before.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Chi Tong, and Ling were clearly all ready to fight, but at this moment, Yun An’s attack still directly activated the Dragon God Protection given by the Dragon God.
“No, even if everyone erupts with all their might together, they will only be able to resist for a period of time. As time passes, they won’t be his match.” Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. He immediately analyzed the difference in battle power between the two parties through Ling.
The eruption and normal state were still incomparable. At the moment, he had yet to accumulate a killer move that was enough to kill demigods.
However…
As the blue light flashed and a drop of water was taken out, it flew towards Yun An. With it blocking in front, the Teleportation of the Blue Sea Ruins was completely stable.
Teleportation successful!
Before leaving, Shi Yu laughed out loud, stunning everyone.
“I’m indeed not Emperor Wu.”
“However, like Emperor Wu, I’m the one who will kill you.”
“Goodbye, Yun An.”
“Next time, I’ll definitely kill you.”
“Remember my name, Dong Huang’s Shi Yu. If you have the ability, come to Dong Huang to find me.”
As soon as Shi Yu’s name appeared.
The Beast Tamers of the entire Heavenly Sword Nation were shocked. They kept feeling that they had heard of this name before.
At the same time, Yun An and the Black Ape Totem were also shocked.
...
“You’re Shi Yu!?”
Buzz!!!
Similarly, the sound of laws spread.
A drop of water flew out of Shi Yu’s body and floated in the sky. Under the lingering wind, it turned into a human figure and blocked Yun An’s attack, protecting Shi Yu behind.
This figure had fair skin and dazzling white hair that naturally draped down, like a sparkling sea waterfall under the light. Her expression was emotionless, like a high and mighty god looking down on all living beings.
In the face of Yun An’s attack, she also raised her palm, as if an ocean had swept up.
“Get lost!!!” Seeing this drop of water, Yun An was shocked. He sensed the power of a demigod’s attack from it.
However, just this was not enough to stop it!!
Boom!!!
The tsunami-like water wall collided with Yun An’s attack. It only lasted for less than ten seconds before instantly shattering and rising into nothingness. Seeing this, the Dragoness frowned slightly as if she had a spirit. She looked at the huge palm attacking and said, “The next time we meet, I’ll definitely kill you.”
Splash!!!
...
The water disappeared.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu was nowhere to be seen. Yun An, who wanted to stop Shi Yu, fell silent on the spot.
Yun An, who was provoked one after another, helplessly watered the rain in midair. Then, it roared angrily.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 1026 Evolution of the Chi Tong God
chapters.content:
1026 Evolution of the Chi Tong God
Dong Huang South Sea.
In the dark deep sea.
A water cube-shaped ruins mystic realm welcomed the first light in the long silence.
“Yun An seems to be very afraid of Emperor Wu.”
“They’re all scared silly.”
“Sigh, look at how scared the child is.” Shi Yu shook his head and smiled.
Exciting.
With the divine iron in hand, he would take off.
He would arrange for Chi Tong to evolve No
He had to report to President Lin first.
Shi Yu was stunned and looked up.
Right on the heels of that, his figure appeared on the shining sea surface from the deep sea bottom.
Because they were close to Dong Huang, the communication tool immediately had a signal.
At the moment, Shi Yu’s communication tool was hurriedly calling out to President Lin.
This was because the moment he was about to leave through Teleportation, Shi Yu also teleported the edited encounter footage back to Dong Huang through the Intelligence Bureau Index.
In that situation, even if Yun An sensed it, it was useless.
Now that President Lin was in such a hurry, he probably wanted to ask about his situation.
After all, his genius had encountered the king of ancient totems on a trip. Who could withstand the stimulation?
After the World Tournament ended, Shi Yu’s name would definitely have long entered the ears of the Yun clan.
It was definitely a must-kill target of the Yun Race.
Shi Yu could imagine Yun An’s shock when he heard his name.
“President Lin.”
Shi Yu called back. Old Lin’s unstable voice immediately came from the other side. “Shi Yu, where are you now? Are you alright?”
“It’s alright. I just used a Blue Sea Ruins in the South Sea as a springboard to escape.”
“It’s good that you’re fine. It’s ridiculous. Yun An actually appeared in the Heavenly Sword Nation. I really don’t know if I should say that you’re unlucky or unlucky Is that Yun An really that strong?” President Lin said.
In Shi Yu’s message, he told Dong Huang about Yun An’s traces and the fact that it had killed the Heavenly Sword demigod.
At the same time, it reminded Dong Huang not to act rashly. Its main goal was to track and lock onto the traces of Yun An first, not to start a war directly.
“Well, it has already recovered and has demigod-level battle power.”
“Moreover, it gives me a very special feeling The combination of the Space Race and the Mythical Race allows it to have strength that far exceeds ordinary demigods,” Shi Yu said.
Some biological races, even if they didn’t master the power of the natural order, didn’t mean that they were weak.
For example, Shi Yu’s Green Dragon Buggy was a god of faith in the starry sky. In the eyes of those gods, although it had yet to master the power of laws, it was not necessarily inferior to a race that had mastered quasi-divine skills.
This Yun An was similar.
Even excluding the power of laws it mastered, it also had powerful starry sky methods similar to the Green Dragon, vaguely giving Shi Yu a huge threat.
Moreover, the law divine skill it mastered shouldn’t be weak.
It was the prototype of a high-level law, mainly the power of darkness.
Shi Yu subsequently understood that the power of laws was divided into Normal, Advanced, and Top.
For example, a single Wind Law and Frost Law were Normal Laws.
A hybrid law like Ling’s Wind of Luck was a high-level law.
As for a hybrid law divine skill formed by opposing attributes like the Yin Yang Millstone, it was clearly a top-notch law.
Of course, be it Eleven, Ling, or Yun An, they had yet to master the true laws.
Their quasi-divine skills were still in the prototype of laws. If they wanted to transform into real laws, they still had to endure training.
Moreover, the higher the level and quality of the prototype of the law, the more difficult it was to transform into a real divine skill and increase proficiency.
The difficulty of increasing the Yin Yang Millstone was several times that of the Wind Blessing. This was also reflected in the risk hint of adding points.
When these quasi-divine skills were raised to perfect proficiency, they could be upgraded to real divine skills.
And the increase in high-level and top-notch laws was so difficult. It meant that there were great benefits.
When they transformed into real law divine skills, the racial Stats of transcendent life forms would also be stronger.
For example, Ling’s race level was not at the bottom of the Mythical Race. Instead, it would be a high-level Mythical Race that would complete a new life evolution because of the transformation of a divine skill.
As for Eleven, it was a top-notch Mythical Race.
With one divine skill, it was comparable to other gods having several Normal divine skills.
This was also why Ancient God Golden Bull and the others were so shocked to see Eleven master top-notch laws.
Low-level divine-level races had an ordinary law divine skill!
A middle-level divine-level race had two Normal law divine skills!
High-level divine-level races had three Normal law divine skills or a high-level law divine skill!
A top-notch divine-level race had four Normal law divine skills, two high-level divine skills, or a top-notch law divine skill!
...
And before the divine skill took shape and was still in the quasi-divine skill stage, no matter the quality of the power of laws contained in this divine skill, it couldn’t be considered a complete law. It could only be at the bottom of the Mythical Race.
After all, no matter how high the quality potential of a quasi-divine skill was, it was inferior to the weakest divine skill.
Only by truly becoming a divine skill could one be considered to have mastered laws and be considered divine-level.
Of course, after reaching the divine level, if one wanted to increase their battle strength, it mainly depended on the proficiency of the divine skill, not the quality of the divine skill.
Moreover, there were also some top-notch laws that were not suitable for battle, such as spatial travel.
But it was undeniable that at this stage, the quality of quasi-divine skills largely determined the battle power of demigods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 1027 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (2)
chapters.content:
1027 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (2)
Yun An had a high-level quasi-divine skill in its palm, plus it was a cosmic life form.
It could be said that its life level was roughly equivalent to Buggy that had evolved again. It was very strong and could be considered a combination of a cosmic life form and a divine-level race.
Dong Huang’s initial idea was to take advantage of the fact that Yun An had just revived and was in an Enfeeble state to take its “life” while it was weak.
However, who knew that Yun An wasn’t as weak as he imagined? Instead, he was very strong. Now, even if he pulled divine forbidden Arms to fight, it would be equivalent to killing a thousand enemies and sacrificing hundreds.
If they paid a huge price and could win, Yun An would have been blown into pieces.
If it were the background of the previous era, doing this wouldn’t be a loss. After all, the Demon God Iron-eating Beast was very strong.
However, the Mythical stage was about to revive. The Demon God Iron-eating Beast was not that strategic for the Mythical Era, unless they developed more new evolution paths on this foundation.
At the same time, he could also learn more information about the abyssal factions through it.
Therefore, Shi Yu’s idea was to watch and lock onto Yun An first. When there were safer and easier battle tactics, such as the World Tree waking up and Susu breaking through, he would fight the battle.
“No wonder he could kill the Heavenly Sword demigod” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, President Lin fell silent.
“Don’t worry, Senior Divine Source has already sent its mechanical pet over. Shi Yu, come back first.” President Lin was tired and was no longer at ease to let Shi Yu out.
“Alright, I’ll return to Dong Huang later. I’ve obtained the divine-level meteorite iron of the Heavenly Sword Nation. I’ll evolve my pet first and go back after that.”
“If it’s domestic evolution, the commotion is too big.”
President Lin: “?”
“Use it as an evolution resource? Evolution again?”
President Lin was stunned and felt that it was extremely ridiculous. From the level of Shi Yu’s pets, none of them looked like they could increase their race level again!
After ending the call with President Lin, Shi Yu returned to the Legendary Ruins space excitedly, feeling that this was a treasure land for evolution.
There were no human islands nearby. Even if the evolution fluctuations leaked from the Legendary ruins, it would only affect some small fish and shrimps. Shi Yu didn’t care so much.
At this moment, all over the ruins space, the pets muttered.
Little Ji and Little Duck looked at each other from afar and cursed Yun An.
Damn Yun An.
The good Sword Trial Conference was disturbed by it.
They had prepared for so long. Who knew how hard it had been?
The inflated Little Ji and Duckie even wanted to fuse with the Earth Divine Dragon fossil and the Abyss Seed and take on the big Quest to kill Yun An.
Eleven and the others also looked regretful.
Why didn’t this Yun An come out half a year later? If it had come out half a year later, they might have had the ability to fight Yun An head-on.
At that moment, in Shi Yu’s team, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling all had methods to resist weaker top-notch totems. In fact, in certain specific situations, individual pets still had a chance to defeat top-notch totems alone.
For example, if Baby Ginseng ate the Time Fruit enhanced by a quasi-divine skill and self-destructed after igniting the flame of life, if the opponent wasn’t a spatial element that was good at escaping like the gem cat and was directly shot at, it would basically die. Even if a demigod took it head-on, they would be injured.
If Shi Yu’s mind domain, Ling’s Fusion Mecha, and Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit were included, it wasn’t impossible for all of them to deal with a demigod for a period of time.
Unfortunately, this eruption didn’t last long. It could only resist a few rounds. Even if it could cause some damage to demigods, it wouldn’t be a big deal. As long as it couldn’t be insta-killed, Shi Yu and the others would definitely lose.
After all, in a true demigod-level state, it could use quasi-divine skills ten times. As for Shi Yu and the others, because their basic level was too weak, they were only at the overlord level. If they wanted to display their power, they could only use it as a one-time eruption.
After one round, it became impotent and weak.
It was still too difficult to erupt into a normal state.
But even so, Shi Yu could be said to be a titled legend of the top echelon.
For example, ordinary titled legends could only fight against Normal totems.
relatively powerful titled legends, such as the Tyrannical Sea Legend, could defeat Normal totems and fight top-notch totems.
Top-notch titled legends, such as President Lin, were said to have defeated top-notch totems with their Contract Pets.
On Shi Yu’s side, defeating a top-notch totem was clearly not difficult.
If Yun An hadn’t come at that time and only the Black Meteorite Divine Ape had arrived, Shi Yu and the others would have killed this monkey no matter what
They just didn’t know how much battle power Chi Tong’s evolution could increase on this foundation.
“Chi Tong, come on, prepare to evolve.”
This guy He had just finished the battle and was already eating ice cream. Wasn’t he afraid of getting a stomachache?
“Wu.” When Chi Tong saw Shi Yu return, it finished the ice cream in two to three bites and quickly got up. Eleven and the others’ gazes also focused.
“Wuu. (It’s finally starting.)” Eleven rubbed its face.
For the past month, Shi Yu had been preparing for Chi Tong’s evolution. The entire team helped Chi Tong nurture and train its clones. It could be said to be the treatment of a biological daughter.
“Ji! (The last evolution won’t be weak. This isn’t a bet, it’s an analysis.)” Buggy analyzed.
Ling was the first to complete its evolution and become a Mythical Race. Susu was the second, and it became the ocean faith god. Eleven was the third to evolve and become a Mythical Race. The fourth became the starry sky faith god, and Baby Ginseng was the fifth to become a Mythical Race. It had finally reached Chi Tong. How could it be weak? Buggy calculated according to its own logic, it couldn’t be weak! Moreover, it might be ridiculously strong because of the version bonus

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 1028 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (3)
chapters.content:
1028 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (3)
“Yi!! (Charge, charge, charge!!)” Baby Ginseng cried. For Chi Tong, not only had it used up all Shi Yu’s Fruits of Life, but it had also provided various nutritional supplements.
It created a basket of World Tree Fruits.
The energy of the entire Legendary Ruins was about to be drained dry by Baby Ginseng.
Shi Yu had already planned when to eliminate this Legendary Ruins and develop Little Purple’s inner world with all his might.

To be honest, the Blue Sea Sprite Race didn’t make it feel safe
“Multiple Legendary resources, dozens of max-level Sword Dao Skills to build the foundation, two Mythical resources, and transcendent-level evolution skills. The strength is not a problem,” Ling said confidently.
Even if it was a demigod, it was impossible to gather so many resources to optimize their race without hundreds or thousands of years of accumulation.
“Now, the greatest problem is whether we can successfully survive the evolution stage.”
“Yes!!” Chi Tong clenched its pink fists, flames appearing in its eyes.
Evolution!
It, who had never evolved in the team, could finally evolve.
Shi Yu smiled. “Take your time.”
“When you’re done evolving, we’ll carry out the next team meeting.”
Chi Tong was shocked and felt that Shi Yu had healed it.
But it wasn’t a big problem.
“Let’s begin.”
As Shi Yu spoke, Chi Tong directly summoned four sword clones in the form of a Sword Maiden.
The first one was silver-white, containing purple light that reflected the profundity of space. Not only did Shi Yu use two spatial legendary resources on the sword clone, but he also gave it a few spatial skills to fuse the spatial sword intent in the Heavenly Sword Nation. Moreover, he taught a bunch of sword formation skills.
The second one was curved and red. Red light lingered around the entire sword body. The clone of this sword grew in the divine-level resource, the Life Fire, and was entangled and tempered by Chi Tong’s Phoenix Sword Intent. On this sword, Chi Tong’s Flame of Regeneration had obtained an epic increase, even stronger than its main body.
The third one, the darkness of the sword and the blue-green death aura intertwined, containing the Nirvana Death Wave. This sword clone perfectly fused the strongest Death Nirvana Sword Intent of the Demon Sect into itself through a large number of perfect-level World Tree Fruits. It was extremely close to the death law. At the same time, because Chi Tong was an undead itself, as the Sword of Death and the sword with the highest basic value, the large amount of death aura accumulated by the enemies Chi Tong’s main body killed was used as nutrients for its growth.
At the moment, the last one had only comprehended the sharp metal sword intent through the fusion of many metal-element sword skills. It was ordinary, but after the trial of the Heavenly Sword Ruins, it was actually also to show off one’s ability. It could be said that every one of these Sword clones could crush top-notch overlords alone.
And now, Shi Yu wanted them all to fuse into Chi Tong’s main body and complete the evolution!
Hu!!!!
Four swords appeared around Chi Tong. Following that, Shi Yu took out the divine-level meteor iron and floated in the air. Chi Tong controlled the Crowd Control Life Flame to wrap and melt the metal, trying to fuse it with the fourth sharp metal sword.
Under the modification of the Life Flame, the form of the divine-level meteor iron slowly changed, emitting a shocking sharp light that extremely repelled and fused into the Impregnable Metal Sword.
Clang!!!
With every fusion, the sharp metal sword bloomed and let out an ear-piercing sword cry, causing the entire Legendary ruins space to tremble!
Rip!!!
A dazzling sword light shot out, and even the Void was cut by the light from time to time.
“A clone is already so powerful.” Shi Yu was immediately forced back by the sharp light stimulated by the divine-level meteor iron.
He was looking forward to Chi Tong’s potential after evolving through so many luxurious evolution resources!
The process of tempering the sword clone in the end was indeed long.
However, Shi Yu and the others had sufficient patience to wait.
After an unknown period of time, with a hum, the space of the Legendary Ruins was pierced by sharp metal sword lights of various sizes. The Flame of Regeneration also fused into the Sword of Life again. Four sword clones that contained strong fluctuations circled around Chi Tong. With just Chi Tong’s thought, these sword clones could fuse into its body!!
“Now.”
Shi Yu gave the order and maintained telepathy with Chi Tong, hoping to know the changes in its body immediately.
Buzz!
In the next moment, the sharp metal sword that had fused with the divine-level metal meteor iron emitted a strong metal light. The power of the sharp light seemed to be able to easily split its divine body into two. Its sword body was reversed, and the tip of the sword directly stabbed into Chi Tong’s body from its chest and disappeared.
At the same time.
Its aura rose steadily again.
Shi Yu’s voice also sounded in Chi Tong’s heart.
“Immortal Slaying Sharpness, Immortal Slaying, and Immortal Trap. Red light rose everywhere, and the transformation of the Immortal Absolute was endless. The blood of the various gods dyed the clothes. Chi Tong, although your evolution template, the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, is a fiction, unlike the Green Dragon template, which has the support of the mind domain, the four sword clones are cultivated according to what you need the most, the direction you’re best at.”
“In this evolution, use the sword formation formed by multiple sword clones as weapons. You will control the sword formation as the core sword spirit.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 1029 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (4)
chapters.content:
1029 Evolution of the Chi Tong God (4)
“Believe in yourself. You will use another path to become the initial Immortal Slaying Sword Spirit, the God Slaying Sword Spirit.”
“Yes!”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Chi Tong’s gaze was firm and gentle as it fused the Sword of Life and the Sword of Space. It also hoped that it could successfully evolve. After all, it was using two divine-level resources as evolution materials to transform into Race potential!
Although it wasn’t like Eleven, who had the support of the mysterious Taiji Yin Yang Domain, this evolution shouldn’t be a problem to help Chi Tong reach the God Domain.
Under Shi Yu’s extremely expectant gaze.
With a hum, the huge projection of four hundred-meter-long swords appeared in the sky around the Legendary Ruins.
Boom!!
Space distorted.
Under the pressure of their sword intent, the entire Legendary Ruins seemed to have turned into a world of swords. Countless sword light shadows leaped, making the sword fluctuations here even exceed the levels of the Heavenly Sword Ruins.
In this sword formation domain, the pressure Eleven and the others felt reached the extreme. Their expressions were extremely solemn.
Its own consciousness warned them crazily that there was life and death danger.
It seemed to be reflecting the terrifying power of Chi Tong’s evolution.
“Metal, Space!”
As Shi Yu shouted, some information about Chi Tong’s evolution appeared in his heart.
[Pet Name]: Chi Tong
[Stats]: Undead, Fire, Metal, Space
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
Of course, Shi Yu knew that the evolution had yet to end. The power of the four sword clones had only modified Chi Tong’s body first. The powerful potential contained in them had yet to fuse together to form a new Race Skill.
This evolution was actually not 100% successful. It was the same as Eleven’s evolution. It was an extremely complicated process. Back then, Eleven had the support of Shi Yu’s Taiji Domain, but Chi Tong’s risk this time was still unknown!
The World Tree Fruit he ate in advance was a support.
He hoped to control and fuse with this new form under the strengthened state of his comprehension talent!
“Immortal Slaying Sharpness, Immortal Slaying, Immortal Trap, Red Light everywhere, Endless Immortal Transformation, the blood of the various gods dyeing the clothes” Chi Tong kept muttering the evolution template provided by Shi Yu, hoping to create such a sword formation Skill that could kill immortals.
However, as time passed, her expression became more and more difficult.
The evolution process was not very smooth.
It was still too Difficult to fuse the power of the four sword clones and promote the evolution of the main body.
Shi Yu saw it in his heart and was very worried.
“How can I help” As Chi Tong fused and evolved, Shi Yu kept trying to establish and deepen his mental connection with Chi Tong.
He wanted to activate the Taiji Domain to try to help Chi Tong fuse the power of life and death, but it wasn’t as smooth as before. The compatibility of this mind domain was still the highest with Eleven.
He wanted to use the strengthening of the World Tree Fruit to develop a new mind domain with his current connection with Chi Tong, but it wasn’t that easy.
Shi Yu tried his best to help Chi Tong.
To Shi Yu’s surprise, at the critical moment, in the dark sea of consciousness, it was because of his mental connection with Chi Tong that the Skill Index’s skill fusion furnace was activated. It was very useful.
Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes and realized that his various powers were being extracted to strengthen Chi Tong’s evolution.
No, or rather, it was used to accelerate Chi Tong’s awakening and fusion of new racial Skills.
At this moment, Shi Yu could see that under the light of evolution, Chi Tong’s body had undergone some subtle changes.
There weren’t many changes. It was as if she had grown a little taller and grown a little, but as time passed, with a boom
The scale of the four sword projections increased by more than ten times. The power on them surged and kept spreading, as if it had turned into thousands of projections that wrapped them in, forming a domain. Standing inside, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others looked around with serious expressions.
Buzz
At this moment, the vibration of the Legendary Ruins had reached an unprecedented level. The ground, sky, and Void were filled with cracks. At the same time, an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power in the Tu Tiger were all suppressed. From the quality of the power of laws, it seemed to be above ordinary laws.
“Quasi-divine skill,” Shi Yu said excitedly before his face turned pale.
Moreover, it was quite powerful.
Outside the ruins, as Shi Yu had expected, in the vast sea, millions of sea creatures looked at the sky above the sea in horror. They looked at the trembling and changing current and didn’t know what had happened.
The sound of laws that resounded through their Spirit and hearts made them involuntarily submit. However, the killing intent contained in it made them even more afraid.
“This is a killing array, a killing array that determines life and death,” Ling said seriously on Shi Yu and the others’ side.
“Master, hold on. Chi Tong’s evolution will be completed soon.” It also looked at Shi Yu worriedly.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s figure finally gradually became clear. She still looked the same, but her aura had transcendent changes, like a dragon god, containing a magical charm.
Boom!!!
The four sword projections hung in the sky like thunder rumbling. The sword light swayed and kept shrinking, flying towards Chi Tong. At the same time, they fused into four and landed in her hand. However, the huge sword formation formed by the sword intent and sword light didn’t disappear at all.
...
The current Chi Tong was like a shocking killing array in its palm. It only raised the sword in its hand slightly, and the entire Legendary space accelerated the collapse. At this moment, Shi Yu was completely overjoyed.
“Success.”
Skill Name: Immortal Slaying Sword Formation
[Stats]: Undead, Fire, Metal, Space
[Level]: Quasi Divine Skill
< Introduction > It contains special sword laws and is very powerful. In the sword formation, it’s mysterious and strange. It’s filled with endless killing intent and is filled with danger. As soon as one enters this formation, it’s instantly turned into ashes and smoke, and its life force disappears.
At this moment, Shi Yu’s heart was excited and complicated.
All the power of the four clones disintegrated, recombined, and fused into a quasi-divine skill with huge potential.
“Invincible. This time, it’s really invincible. Chi Tong and I will fight together and kill top-notch totems like dogs!” Shi Yu said excitedly.
He wanted to fight! He wanted to test his Skill! He wanted to see the Undying Dark Phoenix!
However, in the next moment, Shi Yu’s face turned pale and he fainted.
...
Unknowingly, the consumption was greater than adding some super skills continuously and fusing super skills.
“Wu wu wu!!! (Beast Tamer!)”
Seeing this, Eleven and the others were shocked.
“Ah.” Chi Tong saw that Shi Yu had consumed too much energy because of its evolution. It instantly put away the sword formation nervously and worriedly and flew over.
Crap.
Baby Ginseng, save him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 1030 Welcome to the Mythical Era
chapters.content:
1030 Welcome to the Mythical Era
Assisting Chi Tong in fusing and awakening quasi-divine skills during its evolution consumed a lot of energy.
He had consumed more than 90% of the ten thousand years of lifespan strengthened by the Eternal Flower, and his vitality was greatly injured.
Baby Ginseng nursed Shi Yu back for a day.
“Wow, wow, wow, wow!”
Shi Yu lay weakly on the big bed and looked at the familiar ceiling. A discordant voice echoed in his mouth.
“F*ck.”
“Is this the so-called ‘extremely low success rate’?”
He now felt that his body was numb and unable to exert any strength. In Ling’s words, he was finished. He should recuperate for half a month.
In the past half a month, be it the mind domain or the additional points for fusion, it was best not to use them.
Moreover, during this period of time, it was best if Baby Ginseng didn’t leave his side and carried it like a cell phone.
Now, Shi Yu was as weak as the Vortex Demon Beast, the Black Meteorite Yak, and the Ancient Gods.
This made Shi Yu’s balls hurt slightly, but it wasn’t unacceptable. At most, he would slowly meditate and rest.
In any case, Chi Tong had already completed its evolution. They had created the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation as they wished. His obsession for a short period of time was completed.
“Master, when you were sleeping, President Lin called you again,” Ling said. “I picked up on your behalf.”
“What is it?” Shi Yu said.
“When the reconnaissance machinery of the Divine Source Legendary arrived at the Heavenly Sword Nation, the Yun Race had already left. They left very quickly and couldn’t lock onto their traces.”
“I knew it,” Shi Yu muttered. “He ran really quickly But it’s alright.”
“When the World Tree awakens, it shouldn’t be difficult to find them.”
“By the way, what’s the situation in the Heavenly Sword Nation?” Shi Yu asked. If Yun An didn’t achieve his goal, the Heavenly Sword Nation would most likely suffer.
“There are no traces of damage elsewhere in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation, but it’s said that the Sword Ghost God and everyone on the Sword God Mountain have mysteriously disappeared.”
“At the same time, the two totems of the Heavenly Sword Nation disappeared.”
“Ling suspects that Yun An must have abducted them and wanted to modify them into the Yun Race. After all, the Yun Race has just revived, and their faction is far inferior to the ancient times. They urgently need to expand their faction and replenish their new blood.”
“It can be said that the Heavenly Sword Nation has no leader and has already fallen into complete chaos. Moreover, before Yun An left the Heavenly Sword Nation, he even left a message for Master. At the moment, Dong Huang is considering whether to take over the Heavenly Sword Nation.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “Don’t tell me Yun An said that he would definitely kill me?”
“Master, you’re so smart. It told you to hide in Dong Huang for the rest of your life and not go out. Otherwise, it’ll kill you every time it sees you. It knows that you ate the Undying Fruit and said that it would kill you twice, but it still won’t be able to solve the hatred in its heart.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“He’s just a demigod. So be it. I originally didn’t plan to leave Dong Huang in the short term.”
Ling: “?”
Ling was speechless.
How could he be so arrogant and say such cowardly words?
But that made sense. There was no need to fight Yun An now and develop for a while From Chi Tong’s evolution this time, Ling felt that they would be able to face demigods soon.
“President Lin He also asked you to contact him after you wake up.”
“I understand.” Shi Yu sighed. He used his Psychic power to hook the cell phone on the table and dialed President Lin.
Soon, President Lin picked up in silence.
“President Lin, I’m back in Dong Huang. How’s the situation now?”
“Ling has already told you, right?” President Lin said. “At the moment, it’s still that progress. Now, Yun An is hiding again. It’s very difficult to find. Don’t leave Dong Huang.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled, but he felt that Yun An was also bragging. Even if he left Dong Huang, unless he was especially high-profile, it was impossible for Yun An to find him.
Moreover, the next time he left Dong Huang, he would return to ancient times to play. It was even more impossible for Yun An to find him.
“But I also know that you can’t stay idle. There are also many unsolved ruins mystic realms in Dong Huang. If you really can’t stay idle, walk around Dong Huang more,” President Lin said helplessly.
As the founder of Bureau 11, didn’t he know the mindsets of Bureau 11 archeologists?
“No problem, no problem.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I happen to plan to rest for a period of time.”
President Lin said, “That’s good. In addition, if you have time, you can also help train Lu Qingyi, Lin Xiuzhu, White Brook, and the others. After all, they are the hope of Dong Huang’s next world competition.”
“Didn’t you say back then that you could also teach your Psychic skill to others?”
“With your current strength and foundation, I’m afraid there aren’t many Trainers better than you in all of Dong Huang.”
Shi Yu had a strange expression.
Why were they all women he was familiar with? President Lin definitely had other bad intentions.
“That’s not a problem. I have that thought,” Shi Yu said.
At the moment, Baby Ginseng’s World Tree Fruit was already considered mature.
This World Tree Fruit could increase one’s comprehension talent.
Coupled with the body control talent bead in Senior Lu’s hand, Shi Yu felt that it was definitely very useful.
For example, if the beast-eared girl used her body to control the Talent Bead and cooperated with the World Tree Fruit to develop the Fusion Talent, the chances of developing a top-notch Fusion Talent like Emperor Wu would increase greatly.
At that time, it wasn’t impossible for him to torture overlord-level pets at the level of a level-five Beast Tamer.
This was the aptitude of a Legendary! At the moment, because his family background was too rich, Shi Yu no longer limited his desire to nurture pets. He even wanted to nurture people.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 1031 Welcome to the Mythical Era (2)
chapters.content:
1031 Welcome to the Mythical Era (2)
President Lin said, “During this period of time, I’ve been thinking about what Dong Huang will use to welcome the Mythical Era.”
“Even during the peak of the Mythical Era, Blue Planet was only a small corner of the vast starry sky.”
“Although the World Tree entrusted the hope of Blue Planet to humans, the time left for human development is still too short. Even if every Legendary is a genius with the potential to enter the Mythical Domain in the future, there are still too few such people.”
“Dong Huang needs more geniuses like you. You’re already in front. If you can help them, that would be best.”
President Lin thought for a long time. Although Shi Yu was a genius and had extremely strong talent potential, he couldn’t place all the fate of the country on Shi Yu alone.
No one could guarantee that Shi Yu could definitely grow successfully. From President Lin’s perspective, he hoped that the entire Dong Huang was powerful and everyone was like dragons, not Shi Yu alone. Of course, the difficulty was even greater.
“Yeah.” Shi Yu nodded. He didn’t want Dong Huang to bet everything on him either.
At the thought of this, he suddenly understood Lin Feng Legendary.
Legendary Lin Feng’s goal in nurturing the second team was to let them protect Dong Huang, so he could wander around without any worries.
Instead of the current situation, where people like Divine Source Legendary were very tired and needed to sleep at all times to protect Dong Huang.
In fact, Shi Yu looked forward to being llike Lin Feng Legendary more. If he kept staying in Dong Huang, he would suffocate to death.
“Then I’ll nurture more geniuses with Legendary potential,” Shi Yu said.
Please don’t put everything on him.
Compared to staying in Dong Huang, space-time travel, starry sky travel, and the unknown place mentioned by the World Tree attracted Shi Yu to explore more.
Well He also wanted to learn from Lin Feng Legendary and nurture some second teams. He just had to leave them behind to help him take care of his acquaintances in Dong Huang.
“I’ll help,” Shi Yu said. “Dong Huang doesn’t have any other plans.”
“In order to welcome the Mythical Era, Dong Huang has already started to prepare,” President Lin said with a smile.
“Thanks to you and the Blue Sea Sprite, Dong Huang has already completed an alliance with most ocean totem factions like the Endless Sea and the Ghost Sea.”
“Now that Dong Huang has basically mastered the hegemony of the sea, it can travel the sea freely and come into contact with most totem factions through the sea.”
“Now, under the threat of external enemies and the guidance of the World Tree, Dong Huang can already try to open up world trade and earn more resources. It can even lead to upgrading the Seven Nation Alliance to the Blue Planet Alliance. If Dong Huang can become the master of the Alliance, the fate of the country will be tied to the fate of the planet. It can use a large amount of resources to change the talent potential of the Beast Tamers in the country and nurture more geniuses.”
Shi Yu said, “Blue Planet Alliance? Economic globalization? Benefiting the community?”
It was indeed not bad, but
“Not only between humans and the totem country, but there’s also a blood feud between the totem countries. Even if there’s the threat of external enemies, it’s very difficult to establish a planet alliance, right?” Shi Yu said.
“Yeah.” President Lin nodded.
“Therefore, the Seven Nation Alliance is planning to develop a large-scale ruins mystic realm that can connect the entire world and build a second virtual world with the power of technology. At that time, through the various benefits of the second world, it will lure the totem country to join. This might become a key step in establishing the Blue Planet Alliance.”
Shi Yu was stunned. A virtual game?
The Seven Nation Alliance was going to play big this time.
It sounded quite interesting, but unfortunately, he was also busy establishing the “planet world” and couldn’t spare the energy to mess around with the seven countries.
“The Heavenly Fox Nation and the Heavenly Sword Nation I’ve been to don’t have any technological foundation. Most totem countries are the same. Using the power of technology to invade culture is indeed a dimensional reduction attack,” Shi Yu said. “But this way, the technological level of the totem country will quickly get on track.”
President Lin smiled and said, “This can’t be helped. As long as high-end technology is in the hands of the seven countries, it’s fine. The most important thing now is still to welcome the Mythical Era.”
….
After talking to President Lin for a long time, Shi Yu stretched and lay on the bed again to look at the ceiling.
After the incident with Yun An, it was normal for President Lin not to want him to run around.
As for the ruins mystic realms in the country, there were indeed a few that interested Shi Yu.
For example, he had never been to the ruin that trapped the strongest person in Bureau 11 who had yet to come out.
For example, Shi Yu had yet to find the ruins corresponding to the ruins crystal that flew out of the heroic spirit ruins established by Emperor Shi. He didn’t know if it was in Dong Huang.
Shi Yu stretched again and was thinking about where to start exploring, but in the next moment, he suddenly looked in the direction of the East Sea, which was the sea area of the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain. He sensed at least two totem-level fluctuations from there.
“Ling.”
“Well, it should be the totem dragon king of Dragon Palace City. It seems to be the aura of Senior Ice Dragon. The other one is relatively unfamiliar. Golden Dragon King?” Ling said.
“Let’s go take a look,” Shi Yu said.
In the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain Sea area, as the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Department, the navy was still stationed here.
Huang Qi, Cen Mingzhi, and the others underwent special training at the sea base every day. At the moment, they were the highest commanders of this godforsaken base.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 1032 Welcome to the Mythical Era (3)
chapters.content:
1032 Welcome to the Mythical Era (3)
These two had once gone to Dragon Palace City as navy representatives and gone to the Pirate King Ruins to adventure with Shi Yu. Now, they were also pillars of the Marine Environmental Protection Department. It could be said that their future was promising.
However, they were actually very depressed because the Marine Environmental Protection Department was too f*cking free. The original highest commander, Xiao Qin, directly ran to be a general for Shi Yu’s mechanical phantom beast army because she was too free and didn’t come here at all.
Only they were left silently guarding this sea and pulling a group of Ping Cheng recruits to train, train, train They solved a large number of employment problems for Ping Cheng and Icefield City.
On this day, the wind was gentle and the sun was bright. The new recruits looked at the black dot in the distance in confusion. The invisible pressure made them swallow their saliva and reveal incredulous expressions.
“Energy Ripple No. 1, unable to detect.”
“Energy Ripple No. 2, unable to detect.”
“Energy Wave 3, 7.6 million.”
“What’s going on?” Huang Qi quickly arrived beside the reconnaissance device in the base. As he captured it, he was stunned.
It was a Western dragon and two Eastern divine dragons.
The dragon was mainly made of black and blue scales, and its might was terrifying, as if it was the leader of three creatures. As for the other two, one was a white divine dragon, and the other was an even larger golden divine dragon. When he saw them, Huang Qi was clearly stunned.
He didn’t know the dragon, but he felt that the golden divine dragon and white divine dragon were a little familiar.
“It’s the eldest and third princes of Dragon Palace City.” Beside him, Cen Mingzhi quickly said, “It’s not the enemy, it’s the divine dragons of Dragon Palace City.”
However, although it was Dragon Palace City, Huang Qi and Cen Mingzhi still quickly chose to send a signal to intercept. At the same time, they immediately informed Shi Yu.
Even members of Dragon Palace City couldn’t enter Dong Huang without official procedures.
“Roar!!!”
Countless recruits looked at the sky in shock. They had never seen such a powerful creature.
“Your Highness, Your Highness And this lord” Huang Qi and Cen Mingzhi immediately ran to welcome him.
In the sky, the Frost Demon Dragon raised its eyebrows and said, “I’m the Frost Dragon King, the in-charge of the Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City. Even I don’t know how you guys carry out your professional training.”
Huang Qi and Cen Mingzhi were shocked. The Frost Dragon King didn’t look like this. Why did it look like it had turned into a demon?
Forget it, forget it. Totem level, together with the eldest and third princes, it was most likely the Frost Dragon King.
They said, “Greetings, Lord Frost Dragon King. May I know why you’re here in Dong Huang?”
“Looking for Shi Yu,” Ice Dragon said.
“We’ve already contacted Minister Shi Yu.”
“That’s good. Let’s wait.” Ice Dragon nodded.
“Yo, yo, yo, yo, charge, charge.” Beside him, the little white dragon snorted.
“Big Brother Golden Dragon, are you really going to challenge Senior Shi Yu” It looked at the noble and incomparably powerful Nine-clawed Golden Dragon beside it.
“Yes.” The eldest son of Dragon Palace City had a calm expression.
It was the son of the Golden Dragon King of Dragon Palace City, the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City. Its talent potential had even obtained the recognition of the Dragon God.
At the monarch level, it was invincible. At the overlord level, it was invincible. Now, after multiple trials, it relied on transcendent super Race Skills, Legendary resources, and overlord Resistance to break through to the totem level.
As soon as it broke through to the totem level, it returned to Dragon Palace City from the ruins mystic realm. Right on the heels of that, it learned about the end of the world competition.
It learned about Shi Yu’s legend experience in Dong Huang from his parents.
A Beast Tamer who cultivated a Mythical Race and a Green Dragon A Beast Tamer who could instantly kill totems above his level as an overlord.
Various legendary experiences shocked the Golden Dragon Prince. When many Legendarys heard this, they really wanted the Golden Dragon Prince to challenge Shi Yu, Shi Yu’s Green Dragon, and the Mythical Race. It didn’t believe that there was a dragon stronger than it at the same level. However, after telling its father this thought, it was immediately denied.
“It’s impossible. The Green Dragon Prince of the Dragonman Empire is also at the totem level. It was insta-killed by a meteorite. Although it’s countered by the Green Dragon bloodline, it’s not much better for you to go.”
Regarding this, the Golden Dragon Prince didn’t believe it, but it wasn’t arrogant either. It chose to enter the Dragon God Ruins to train first. As soon as it entered, it was very lucky to obtain five Legendary resources. With the help of these five resources, its strength increased greatly in just two months. Its strength was close to the standard of a top-notch totem. It was completely incomparable to a totem like the Green Dragon Prince that relied on external forces to advance. Therefore, it had the thought of challenging Shi Yu’s Green Dragon again.
This time, the Golden Dragon Prince finally obtained his father’s recognition.
After asking the Dragon God, he also obtained the Dragon God’s recognition, so he came to visit Dong Huang to challenge.
At the same time, for some reason, the Dragon God even sent the Frost Dragon King to accompany it. As for the little white dragon, it was purely here to join in the fun.
“Hi.”
As the ice dragon, golden dragon, and little white dragon waited, soon, spatial ripples rippled. Shi Yu appeared out of thin air in the sky above the sea.
“So free to come to Dong Huang?”
Shi Yu floated in the sky with his Psychic power and smiled at the Ice Dragon and the little white dragon. At the same time, he looked at the powerful Nine-clawed Golden Dragon beside him in slight surprise. It was already close to top-notch totems like the Golden Dragon King
Golden Dragon Prince
Previously, he had understood that it was only an invincible overlord. It had only been a few months, but its battle power had actually reached the level of a top-notch totem?
“The Dragon God told us to.” After Mother Dragon saw Shi Yu, she immediately welcomed him with a smile. It couldn’t be helped. Shi Yu had given it a divine-level evolution resource. Apart from Mu Huiyin, Shi Yu was its closest relative!
“The Dragon God asked me to send you some equipment. She seems to be saying that you broke the one she gave you previously,” Ice Dragon said.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned and immediately realized.
The Dragon God definitely sensed the use and destruction of the Dragon God Protection.
This was creating another one for Ice Dragon to send over.
“Also, also, Big Brother Golden Dragon wants to challenge your Green Dragon, Senior Shi Yu. It said that the Green Dragon is only so-so. It can also fight with its two claws,” the little white dragon beside him said.
It immediately made the Nine-clawed Golden Dragon turn to look at it.
The eldest prince: “?”
When the f*ck did he say that?
It didn’t bully the little white dragon as much as the clueless prince.
...
“Challenge Buggy?” Shi Yu was stunned and looked at the Golden Dragon Prince.
So that was the case.
However, why was it challenging Buggy? How good was it to challenge Chi Tong?
It wasn’t that Shi Yu was afraid that Buggy couldn’t defeat it. Not only did Chi Tong fuse a pile of top-notch super skills, but Buggy and the others were also the same. Skills like the Green Dragon Indestructible Body were all explosively strong. Moreover, it was just an ordinary battle. It didn’t matter if it won or not. Shi Yu didn’t even want to use the meteorite, afraid that it would waste the power of faith. It was mainly because Chi Tong had just evolved and he hadn’t had time to see the power of the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation.
Shi Yu looked at the Golden Dragon Prince seriously. Then, he looked at the Dragon Mother, who had reached a top-notch totem and looked even fiercer than the Golden Dragon Prince. A bold idea appeared in his heart.
“Alright, I accept the challenge,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
The Undying Dark Phoenix was still a mother, and so was Mother Dragon. Why not let Chi Tong hit this mother first?
At this moment, as Shi Yu accepted the Golden Dragon Prince’s challenge, for some reason, Ice Dragon felt a cold aura and chill rising from behind

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 1033 Four Holy Beasts Descend (1)
chapters.content:
1033 Four Holy Beasts Descend (1)
The super genius from Ping Cheng, the legend of the world, Shi Yu.
Dong Huang’s most important ally, the eldest prince of the strongest ocean faction, Dragon Palace City.
To the new recruits of the Environmental Protection Department below, these two were both legendary existences that they needed to look up to.
And now, they wanted to fight in a few words after meeting, immediately making these new recruits excited.
It seemed like he was about to encounter big news.
“Minister Shi Yu do you want to fight”
Below, Huang Qi, Cen Mingzhi, and the others were also instantly excited.
There was a good show to watch.
“Oh?” Shi Yu looked down and said, “It’s none of your business. Continue training.”
“Remember to activate the Protection Facility to avoid the aftermath interference.”
In a battle of this level, how could he have the time to protect a group of new recruits?
What the hell?
“Huh?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the excited expressions of most of the people below stopped.
So heartless.
“Let’s go to the isolated island.” The eldest prince of Dragon Palace City was rather satisfied to see Shi Yu accept the challenge.
Then, Shi Yu and the others flew to an isolated island in the East Sea. During this process, Ice Dragon handed the new Dragon God Protection to Shi Yu.
During this period, the Golden Dragon Prince wanted to say something but hesitated many times. It said, “What the little white dragon said just now was nonsense. I didn’t say it.”
Although it wasn’t afraid of Shi Yu, it didn’t want to take the blame!
The little white dragon: “Ah, no? Did I remember wrongly?”
Shi Yu : “”
“It’s alright, there’s no need to overestimate it. It’s still far from the real Green Dragon,” Shi Yu said.
Ice Dragon and Little White Dragon: “Nonsense!”
They had seen the World Tournament. How could they not know if that strength was the real Green Dragon?
“Oh?” However, when the Golden Dragon Prince saw that Shi Yu had shown weakness before the battle, he became even more confident.
Soon, Shi Yu flew to an isolated island with Dragon Palace City.
After arriving, the ice dragon and the little white dragon immediately turned into melons and ran to the side excitedly.
“I’ll protect the venue,” Ice Dragon said.
“I’ll cheer you on,” the little white dragon said.
“Roar!!!! (Then I won’t hold back. Sir Shi Yu, thank you for the battle.)” In the sky, the hundred-meter-long Golden Dragon Crown Prince circled up, its golden scales shining.
Shi Yu could sense the strength of the Golden Dragon Prince’s physique. The Golden Dragon Race was also a race known for its physique. Because of the advantage of level, its current strength was even above Buggy. This time, Buggy would have a difficult battle.
Shi Yu didn’t plan to help Buggy, including the Green Dragon Domain and Spirit connection. His current body didn’t allow it either. He would treat it as letting Buggy train itself.
“Same. Please do your best, Your Highness.” Shi Yu smiled politely.
“Roar.” In the next moment, the huge black summoning array behind Shi Yu shone with a green-gold light. In the spatial ripples, a hundred-meter-long green divine dragon appeared. Its golden eyes stared at the golden dragon in front of it.
The two dragons looked at each other, their eyes especially red.
“You’re the lucky guy who evolved into a green dragon?!”
“Come on, let me see how strong the Green Dragon’s faith skill is.” The Golden Dragon Prince’s gaze was serious as he made a full battle state, wanting to see how strong the Green Dragon’s faith skill was.
“Ji. (I refuse.)” However, Buggy turned around proudly.
If he wanted to see faith skills, he had to pay more!
Golden Dragon Prince: “?”
The Golden Dragon Prince raised his eyebrows and said, “What do you mean?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Your Highness, the use of the Green Dragon Faith Skill will consume rare power of faith. It’s not suitable to use it easily.”
“We’re just sparring. There’s no need to work so hard, right? Let’s stop when it’s time.”
Golden Dragon Prince: “?”
“Roar.” The Green Dragon Buggy nodded. Yes, yes, every time a piece was smashed, its heart would ache.
There was no benefit in defeating him. Wasting the power of faith was a huge loss.
“It’s at the overlord level, and I’m at the totem level. How can it fight me without the power of faith?” The Golden Dragon Prince frowned and said, “What I want is more than just a spar. Please be more serious and do your best.”
The reason why the Golden Dragon Prince wanted to challenge was because he sensed the threat of Shi Yu and the Green Dragon Buggy.
At the moment, it was said that Dragon Palace City, such as the Frost Dragon King, the Sea Dragon King, the Azure Dragon King, and even the Dragon God, respected the Green Dragon very much.
This made it, the eldest prince, feel a sense of danger.
Under normal circumstances, after the Dragon God abdicated, it was a Dragon Palace genius with a high chance of becoming the new Dragon God.
Now, the talent and potential of the various Dragon Kings were inferior to it.
Initially, the future was incomparably beautiful, but now, a green dragon had appeared out of nowhere and was even supported by most of the factions of the Dragon Palace. How could the Golden Dragon Prince be at ease?
