It had come this time to test the Green Dragon’s trump card, but if the opponent didn’t want to expose it, what was there to be happy about even if it won with its high realm? In the end, it still didn’t obtain any information.
...
Only by defeating the overlord-level Green Dragon that erupted with all its might could it deduce the threat the Green Dragon posed to it after entering the totem level. Only then would it know how to become stronger.
No one could snatch the position of the Dragon God!
“Your Highness, don’t worry. Even if it doesn’t use the power of faith, it won’t be weak,” Shi Yu said.
The Golden Dragon Prince: “Nonsense.”
Did they even take a totem level like him seriously!
“Roar!!!” The Golden Dragon Prince’s dragon eyes flickered. Damn it, to think it had cultivated for so long before coming to challenge. In the end, the so-called world legend was actually so timid.
Shi Yu and Buggy’s attitude made the Golden Dragon Prince grit its teeth in anger. It could even use a meteorite to fight the Green Dragon Prince of the Dragonman Empire, so why couldn’t it use it on it?

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 1034 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (2)
chapters.content:
1034 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (2)
“Don’t be afraid. It’s just a little power of faith. How can the Crown Prince let you suffer? Regardless of whether you win or lose, the Crown Prince will definitely promote faith in Dragon Palace City to replenish it for you after the battle!!” Ice Dragon said from the side.
“Yes, yes,” the little white dragon also said.
“Really?” Shi Yu looked at the Golden Dragon Prince.
Golden Dragon Prince: Huh?
It looked at the Frost Dragon King and the little white dragon.
What exactly were these two dragons doing?
In the face of Shi Yu and Buggy’s gazes, the Golden Dragon Prince’s mouth opened slightly.
The few Dragon Kings of Dragon Palace City had their own spheres of influence. Although Ice Dragon was trying its best to help Shi Yu promote the Green Dragon faith in Dragon Palace City, it was not easy to touch other people’s territory.
Now, after seizing the opportunity, Ice Dragon immediately scooped up benefits for Shi Yu.
The golden dragon was silent.
Facing Shi Yu and Buggy’s burning gazes, they fell silent.
Then, it gritted its teeth.
“I’m not, I didn’t, I didn’t say it!!!” The straightforward Golden Dragon Prince didn’t fall for this. It was mainly because it didn’t have the guts to decide for its father. However, in order to let Shi Yu and the others fight with all their might, the Golden Dragon Prince still added,
“It’s not impossible for me to help, but you have to win my recognition.”
“It’s a deal.” It was unknown what switch the Golden Dragon Prince had touched. In the next moment, the Green Dragon and Shi Yu put away their perfunctory attitude.
The Golden Dragon Prince was shocked. Then, his gaze became unfriendly.
“Roar!!!”
The Golden Dragon Prince roared, and golden light flickered all over its body. It directly used its transcendent super skill, Golden Dragon Nine Revolutions.
Boom!!!
The huge golden divine dragon circled in the sky for an instant. Then, the sun in the sky burned even more fiercely. When the sunlight shone on the dragon scale, it turned into a golden beam of light with a bang, sweeping up the dragon might that filled the sky and hit the green dragon.
Golden Rainbow Piercing Sun!
Buzz!!
In the face of the golden beam, the green-gold Psychic fluctuations that filled the sky appeared out of thin air like a tide on the path of the Golden Dragon Prince’s attack. They changed qualitatively into the nature of water, wanting to turn into a huge net to slow down the Golden Dragon Prince’s attack.
Using softness to counter hardness.
However, the Golden Dragon Prince’s body didn’t stop at all. It instantly penetrated a huge hole in the Psychic Tide. The hot golden light instantly evaporated the Psychic Tide and rose.
“Roar!!!” Seeing this, Buggy roared. The power of the green dragon filled the world. It stretched out its dragon claw and slapped at the golden light.
The pure golden light immediately squeezed and collided with the green-gold light.
Boom.
In the dazzling light, the figure of the Golden Dragon Prince couldn’t be seen clearly. Buggy’s Green Dragon Divine Claw pressed against the golden light. The deterrence that intertwined and wrapped around each other instantly tore apart the clouds in the sky, causing countless cracks to appear on the ground of the island, and even making the endless waves tremble.
Seeing this, the ice dragon immediately froze the sea to prevent the aftermath from sweeping up a tsunami.
“Wuhu ~” The little white dragon was also shocked. It enjoyed watching others fight.
“What strong power.”
At the same time, after the collision, the Golden Dragon Prince was shocked to see that not only was the other party not penetrated by his Golden Rainbow Penetrating the Sun, but it also blocked him with a claw. He couldn’t believe that this was the power of an overlord.
In the huge roar, under the deterrence, the Golden Dragon Prince actually felt his bloodline body tremble.
“It’s alright.” Shi Yu’s voice came from the strong wind in the distance.
Super physique skill, Green Dragon Indestructible Body!
Multiple Skills, mainly the Green Dragon Roar and Dragon Raising Its Head, fused together, completely transforming Buggy’s physique into the Green Dragon Divine Body.
Its longing would transform into super Psychic power. Its roar would make a god tremble. Its body had extremely strong self-healing abilities. Its dragon eyes could see through all weaknesses. Apart from that, it could multiply at will and mobilize the power of faith to forge an immortal body.
“That’s all?!!” In the shocking collision, the Golden Dragon Prince roared. After the energy flowed around his body, his Stats increased greatly, and he erupted with an extremely strong power, instantly shattering the green-gold light. The golden rainbow instantly burned the Green Dragon Divine Claw of the Green Dragon Buggy pitch-black. With a crack, it broke, making half of Buggy’s claw disappear.
“Roar!!” Buggy was angry.
Then, just as the golden rainbow was about to penetrate Buggy’s body, spatial ripples flashed, and Buggy instantly disappeared in front of the Golden Dragon Prince.
Buzz!
Buggy’s figure appeared higher in the sky. It didn’t have time to look at its half-clawed hand. Instead, it quickly looked at the golden rainbow that refracted like light.
Boom!!!
Buggy immediately entered a concealed state, but the Golden Dragon Prince’s attack was already enough to distort space. With a bang, its hidden body distorted and penetrated a large wound, forcing Buggy to leave the range of the attack through Instant Transmission again to avoid being heavily injured by the hundred-meter-long golden rainbow.
Swoosh.
Buggy’s figure appeared again, but the Golden Dragon Prince’s attack became more and more fierce.
Strength, speed, and energy Stats continued to increase.
The power of the spatial distortion became stronger and stronger, blocking Buggy’s teleportation speed. This time, before Buggy could react, the golden rainbow that intertwined in the sky directly hit Buggy’s body and smashed towards the island ground.
The hundred-meter-long golden light looked like a meteor with the green divine dragon.
At the same time, the previous hot attack seemed to be accompanied by frost this time. The cold air that filled the sky dyed a layer of ice clouds, continuing to freeze Buggy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 1035 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (3)
chapters.content:
1035 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (3)
“It’s the Golden Dragon Nine Revolutions.” The little white dragon was shocked and said, “It looks like the increase is even greater. Looks like it relied on this move to advance to the totem level.”
“A skill that can continuously increase your strength?” Shi Yu frowned when he saw Buggy being suppressed.
Boom!!!
As Buggy was penetrated by the Golden Dragon Prince to the ground, a thousand-meter-wide pit appeared on the entire island. Right on the heels of that, the island began to crack in all directions. After succeeding in one hit, the Golden Dragon Prince excitedly turned into golden light again. Its body appeared in the sky and looked down at the green dragon in the huge pit below.
Moreover, its aura was still increasing.
Golden Dragon Nine Revolutions. Every time the energy flowed in his body, it could increase his strength in all aspects. He could also obtain an elemental enchantment that could mobilize the power of nature. It could increase at most nine times. As for the Golden Dragon Crown Prince, who had trained the Golden Dragon Nine Revolutions to transcendent, he could already reach the Golden Dragon Ten Revolutions. After the Ten Revolutions, he could fight top-notch totems.
“You’re not my match. It’s better to use the Faith Skill.” The Golden Dragon Prince circled in the sky, but in the next moment, its pupils constricted.
In the huge pit, the injured Green Dragon Buggy flew up without any ripples in its dragon eyes. During the process of flying up, the injuries all over its body quickly healed themselves in less than two seconds. The Green Dragon Claw that the Golden Dragon Prince was heavily injured at the start had long recovered to its original state without a trace of injury.
When Buggy completely flew up, there were no longer any injuries on its body. It was no different from before the battle.
“Impossible.” The Golden Dragon Prince was shocked when it saw this. It could sense that it had clearly heavily injured its opponent, but why Even its aura didn’t weaken much.
“Holy shit.” Ice Dragon and the little white dragon also exclaimed.
What was going on?
They had only seen the meteorite insta-kill in the World Tournament, but they didn’t expect Buggy’s other abilities to be so terrifying.
“Roar!! (I acknowledge you.)” At that moment, after Buggy flew up, it looked at the Golden Dragon Prince solemnly.
The last person who could use such a fierce attack to defeat it so badly was its Leader.
However, because of the existence of the Green Dragon Indestructible Body, it wasn’t that easy to defeat.
A heavy injury of this level could be recovered in an instant. This was not Restoration with the power of faith, but the self-healing ability of the pure Green Dragon Indestructible Body. It was a dazzling sublimation after high-speed healing combined with the Green Dragon physique. If the enemy couldn’t insta-kill it, they could only fight a battle of attrition.
If it really used the power of faith, even if it was on the verge of death, it could instantly revive. Even if it was really dead, it could use faith in rebirth and be immortal.
Unless it was at the level of a demigod, it was very difficult to defeat and exhaust Buggy’s strength.
“Continue!!” The golden dragon didn’t believe it. As its Stats rose steadily, a golden light ball directly condensed in its mouth, and a terrifying energy wave instantly sealed the space.
Boom!!!
The Golden Dragon Prince was determined to win this attack. However, after knowing that the power of the golden dragon would continue to become stronger because of the golden dragon’s nine revolutions, Shi Yu and Buggy couldn’t sit still and watch it steadily become stronger.
“Buggy, Four Holy Clones.”
“Suppress its power and don’t give it a chance to become stronger.”
Shi Yu said.
[Skill]:
“Super”: Imagination Domain (Perfect+), Dragon of Imagination (Perfect+), Dragon Star Group (Perfect+), Queen Mother’s Power (Perfect+), Space Control (Perfect+), Green Dragon Indestructible Body (Perfect+), Four Holy Clones (Perfect+), Dream Control (Perfect+)
Dream Control, Queen Mother Power, Space Control, Four Holy Clones, Green Dragon Indestructible Body These were all new skills fused by Buggy.
Each stronger than the other.
It was so powerful that the Golden Dragon Prince was very shocked and stunned.
It was so powerful that even without the power of faith and without borrowing other powers, Shi Yu was confident that Buggy could fight the totem-level Golden Dragon Prince.
The direction of the golden pillar of light’s attack was clearly sealed by the Golden Dragon Prince, but Buggy’s figure was like a mirage, quickly blurry and distorted. Almost instantly, the sky darkened. No, it seemed like everyone was dragged into another world.
Under the dazzling stars, the Golden Dragon Prince was stunned. This was the starry sky?
“Roar!!!”
When the Golden Dragon Prince reacted, the target of the golden pillar of light was no longer the Green Dragon Divine Dragon, but the huge black-striped white tiger covered in snow. The island under its feet had already disappeared, disappearing for no reason and turning into a star.
Standing on this star that contained rich metal power, the white tiger opened its mouth. Its mouth seemed to contain a black hole as it directly swallowed the golden pillar of light. The aftermath that filled the sky swept across, completely stunning the Golden Dragon Prince and stunning the Ice Dragon and the little white dragon.
When they reacted, they strangely discovered that not only had the ground changed, but the surroundings had also changed. They were indeed in the starry sky. It wasn’t just this star and the huge white tiger that appeared. There were also new gods born in other directions.
On a red star, a divine bird with the appearance of a bird and shocking flames burning on its body stared at the Golden Dragon Prince with burning eyes, and the stars around it were ignited.
On a black star, a huge black turtle was lying there. A huge green snake was wrapped around its body. Under the deep gaze of both parties, the Golden Dragon Prince immediately felt a chill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - 1036 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (4)
chapters.content:
1036 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (4)
At this moment, the Golden Dragon Prince’s original target, the Green Dragon Buggy, was already circling on another star in the starry sky, staring at the Golden Dragon Prince from a higher altitude. Seeing this, the Golden Dragon Prince’s pupils constricted, unable to understand.
Four Four Holy Beasts!!!
White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, Green Dragon!!!
The four holy beasts had all appeared?!!
“Illusion is still an illusion.” Under the Golden Dragon Prince’s roar, he directly erupted with energy and tried to break free from the illusion, but he failed. He even sensed in panic that his strength was strongly suppressed under their gaze.
“What Skill is this?” The Golden Dragon Prince was confused.
In the next moment, the Four Spirits of Heaven in four directions attacked together and locked onto the Golden Dragon Prince in the center.
Just now, it was the Golden Dragon Prince who pursued the victory. In the blink of an eye, the situation reversed, and it was attacked from both sides.
“This is the Four Holy Clones,” Shi Yu said. This was a top-notch super skill fused with the Anti-Demon Domain, Four Symbols Star Formation, and Illusory Phantom as the core. Because of the speciality of the Green Dragon Indestructible Body and Illusory Phantom, this skill could even strengthen the phantom clone with the faith equipment of the White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermillion Bird. It could be said to be the greatest gain from the fusion of the skills on Buggy.
In fact, Shi Yu even had the thought of the second team nurturing a Black Tortoise and a White Tiger. Of course, they didn’t have to use faith equipment to fight the Golden Dragon Prince now. Just the combination skill of the Imagination Domain and the Four Symbols Clones could display huge power.
When all the Four Symbols clones were present, the power of each of the Four Symbols received a legendary increase, equivalent to the main body. It also formed an army skill. It was a move that consumed a lot of energy and could also mobilize the power of the starry sky.
At the same time, under the pressure of the four Saints, the enemy’s power was greatly suppressed. All natural power and Void power were forbidden to be used.
Roar!!!!
The white tiger moved. It first formed a pair of white wings and headed towards the Golden Dragon Prince. It slapped out with its tiger palm. Boundless metal-element power and murderous aura instantly made the Golden Dragon Prince feel that it was unbelievable. He felt that this guy was even stronger than the Green Dragon’s main body at the start.
No It wasn’t that it was too strong, but that it had become weaker.
The power increased by the Golden Dragon Nine Revolutions instantly fell to the bottom under the suppression of the Four Saint Domains!
“Boom!!!” The dragon and tiger fought, and the tiger palm and dragon claws collided. The two parties were in a stalemate. The Golden Dragon Prince curled up his dragon tail and slapped at the white tiger. The white tiger also opened its huge mouth and directly attacked the dragon tail.
Under the sharp metal teeth, the dragon scales cracked and dragon blood spewed out.
“Roar!!!” The Golden Dragon Prince screamed in anger. Was this a white tiger? What kind of Creation God White Tiger bit people randomly?
“Holy shit.” Seeing this, the little white dragon was shocked again. What skill was this? So handsome, so handsome.
“Is this also a Green Dragon faith skill?” Ice Dragon was also shocked. It thought that the meteorite was the only faith skill. This was also so strong. As expected, just as it had expected, even the eldest prince was definitely not a match for abnormal Shi Yu!!
The Dragon God had sent it here to watch over Shi Yu and not let him kill the eldest prince!
However, why did this white tiger look so familiar?
What they didn’t know was that this was a white tiger created by Buggy with the gem cat as its prototype. It had very good teeth.
In the pain of biting, the Golden Dragon Prince was shocked and felt another heat wave attack. It suddenly turned around and saw a huge divine bird that swept up flames, spreading wings of fire, slashing at it.
Yes.
It was slashing over.
This guy was using its wings as a sword.
“What the hell? These are the four holy beasts?”
Flames spread on the wings, forming a Fire Blade. The Golden Dragon Prince, who was in a stalemate with the White Tiger, couldn’t resist immediately. “Jiu!!!!” Under the high cry of the Vermillion Bird, the Vermillion Bird slashed onto the Golden Dragon Prince’s body, making it let out a painful cry again!!
“Roar!!!”
It was immediately struck from the sky and smashed towards the Black Tortoise. What made the Golden Dragon Prince’s pupils shrink even more was that the Green Dragon also leaped up and flew in front of it during the process of flying backward.
Combination profundity, finishing touch!
Buggy’s gaze flickered, and the dragon-shaped fluctuations around its body enlarged. Soon, it became a ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon. The huge phantom turned into a green-gold light that collided with the Golden Dragon Prince. With a bang, it was Buggy’s turn to penetrate the Golden Dragon Prince.
“Roar!!!”
Under the intense pain, what the Golden Dragon Prince couldn’t understand was that during the process of being attacked, its life and energy were continuously absorbed. This green dragon was like a worm, and it could also suck blood and energy.
This skill really stunned the Golden Dragon Prince, and what stunned it even more was the image of the four saints.
Buggy: “I’m Buggy.”
The Golden Dragon Prince’s expression stiffened.
Shi Yu also said, “Who said this is a faith skill? The power of faith hasn’t been mobilized yet. As for a faith skill, its power is several times this.”
The Golden Dragon Prince refused to believe it.
Boom.
Under the joint attack of the Green Dragon and the Black Tortoise, the Golden Dragon Prince was immediately smashed into the depths of the starry sky with the shattering of the stars.
It had to be said that the Golden Dragon Prince was strong enough, as this couldn’t defeat it. It was just that its injuries were similar to Buggy from before. It floated in the starry sky domain broken, its dragon eyes staring intently at the four Saints in front of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 1037 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (5)
chapters.content:
1037 The Four Holy Beasts Descend (5)
“You’re telling me this isn’t a faith skill?” The Golden Dragon Prince didn’t believe it at all.
The four holy clones were all out. Wasn’t this a faith skill?
Its transcendent super Skill was even suppressed. These clones all had extremely strong strength like the main body. If this wasn’t a faith skill, what was? If not, how could it be so strong?
“It doesn’t seem to be. I don’t see any power of faith,” the little white dragon shouted.
“Indeed, there are no fluctuations of power of faith.” Ice Dragon was also quite shocked at this moment. It suddenly realized that the four holy clones weren’t faith skills.
It was actually a pure and incomparably powerful super phantom-type Skill. No, there was even the effect of an army skill and a domain skill.
The Golden Dragon Prince’s expression stiffened again and it was a little silent. Indeed, it didn’t sense the power of faith either.
The manifestations of power such as faith, nature, space, and Elemental were still different.
“Big Brother Golden Dragon, charge!!!” At this moment, the little white dragon crazily cheered and said, “Senior Shi Yu’s extraordinary power and Beast Taming Talent have yet to be used, as is Senior Buggy’s faith Skill.”
“Stop warming up. Hurry up and show your full strength to fight Senior Shi Yu seriously. Don’t worry, Senior Shi Yu will definitely work hard to obtain your recognition.” The little white dragon continued to shout, making the Golden Dragon Prince’s expression become more and more stiff.
Motherf*cker.
How could it not tell that the little white dragon was fanning the flames?
It was clearly already fighting very seriously.
However, the little white dragon’s words made the Golden Dragon Prince’s expression turn pale. He had yet to use his extraordinary power, Beast Taming Talent, and faith skills
It naturally knew what these were. So, was the other party really warming up now
To be honest, the Golden Dragon Prince regretted leaving Dragon Palace City at this moment.
He regretted even more that he had said that as long as he won its recognition, he would help Shi Yu and the others promote the Green Dragon faith in Dragon Palace City.
At this moment, the Golden Dragon Prince was in a dilemma
Monster
This was the overlord level?
“Is that all?” However, its pride as the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City didn’t allow it to admit defeat just like that!!
“Watch me tear you apart one by one!!!” The Golden Dragon Prince roared and attacked the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise that were staring at it again.
White, red, black, and green pillars of light locked onto the Golden Dragon Prince.
In an instant, the Berserking surging pillar of light swallowed the Golden Dragon Prince’s figure.
The light first compressed and focused, then light bloomed like the explosion of the sun.
Boom!!!
The Golden Dragon Prince was directly Devoured by the Four Holy Punishments. A shocking scream immediately penetrated space and spread throughout the East Sea!!
“Holy shit.” As the ice dragon and the little white dragon cried, the frozen sea also shattered, and Gusts swept out.
At the Environmental Protection Department base, the new recruits who had returned to their training state were stunned when they sensed the Gust that suddenly blew over and the screams that sounded a little like the Golden Dragon Prince coming from afar.
They looked into the distance with stunned expressions.
….
The battle finally ended in the Golden Dragon Prince’s defeat. It directly fainted and lost consciousness. Buggy was exhausted beside it and cursed this golden dragon for being too resistant to beatings.
With the strength of the Golden Dragon Prince, which was close to a top-notch totem, without paying money, also known as using the power of faith, Buggy was almost exhausted after defeating it. However, in order to show off, Buggy still pretended not to use much strength and watched the Golden Dragon land. As for it, it casually turned into a little green dragon and flew into Shi Yu’s pocket.
After the battle was completed, the little white dragon and the ice dragon gulped. They didn’t expect the Golden Dragon Prince to lose just like that. They really didn’t expect that in the end, the eldest prince actually didn’t force out some of Shi Yu’s trump cards such as extraordinary power, Beast Taming Talent, and faith skills. They originally thought that even if Shi Yu could win, he would have to spend a lot of power of faith
“Say, His Highness the Crown Prince should keep his promise and help promote the Green Dragon faith in Dragon Palace City, right?” Shi Yu muttered. A battle couldn’t be fought for nothing.
“Senior Shi Yu is impressive, awesome, Senior Buggy is impressive, awesome!! Don’t worry, if Big Brother Golden Dragon doesn’t keep his promise, I’ll go to the Dragon Palace to spread it everywhere that it doesn’t keep its word.” The little white dragon immediately took sides.
“Little white dragon, don’t be naughty.” Shi Yu looked at it with a smile. He felt that the little white dragon was becoming more and more sensible. Was this growth?
“Kid, you guys are much stronger than during the world competition again.” At this moment, Ice Dragon was also shocked at the side. Not only had Shi Yu broken through to the legend level, but Buggy was definitely much stronger than during the world competition.
It was certain that Shi Yu’s current strength had already exceeded Mu Huiyin.
“Yeah, it’s not just Buggy and me. Chi Tong has also become much stronger. Its improvement is even greater than Buggy. Mother Dragon, do you want to test Chi Tong?” Shi Yu said casually.
Chi Tong had improved so much. Its growth also had to be shared with its elders.
“Really?” Ice Dragon was delighted. Among Shi Yu’s pets, it definitely liked and cared more about Chi Tong.
“No problem” Ice Dragon laughed. It was just about to say that there was no problem, but the cold air that appeared on its back previously appeared again, making Ice Dragon’s expression stiffen. It had a bad feeling.
Its evolution this time had awakened a dangerous perception time-element Skill.
At this moment, Ice Dragon, who was just about to say that there was no problem, felt that this skill was unprecedentedly excited.
Skill: Run!!! That sword isn’t a good daughter!!!
Thump.
Ice Dragon seemed to have seen the scene of itself lying in the Dragon Palace with serious injuries. Its gaze exploded as it looked at Shi Yu and said, “No, no, no, who would want to?!!”
“Wait, with your strength, you should be able to find that Undying Dark Phoenix, right? How about I accompany you to test it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 1038 Senior Lu’s Arrival
chapters.content:
1038 Senior Lu’s Arrival
“Huh?”
Seeing Ice Dragon, who had originally agreed, suddenly change its expression, Shi Yu was completely stunned.
Why did it go back on his word?
Moreover, it even circled around so much and let the Undying Dark Phoenix take the beating in its place.
Although Shi Yu and Ice Dragon had indeed made an agreement to kill the Dark Phoenix together
“Senior Ice Dragon, Senior Shi Yu!” At this moment, when the little white dragon saw that Shi Yu and Ice Dragon were chatting happily, it couldn’t help but say,
“Aren’t you going to care about Big Brother Golden Dragon? It’s about to sink to the bottom of the sea!”
“Wuu. (It’s alright, it can’t die.)”
In Shi Yu’s pocket, Buggy, who was being treated by Baby Ginseng, popped its head out.
Its Psychic power extended infinitely and entered the ocean. Then, it pulled the Golden Dragon Crown Prince that had sunk into the sea up and placed it on the floating island.
“Wuhu. (Understood.)” Seeing the miserable state of the Golden Dragon Prince, the little white dragon nodded.
After treating Buggy, Shi Yu sent Baby Ginseng’s clone to jump down and treat the Golden Dragon Prince slightly.
“Aren’t we fighting?” At the same time, Shi Yu scratched his cheek and looked at Ice Dragon. Could it be that the Ice Dragon was afraid?
“Heh heh!” Ice Dragon looked at Shi Yu and said, “Tell me, between Chi Tong’s current strength and Buggy in your pocket, who’s stronger?”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned and looked at Buggy.
This
“Almost as strong?” Shi Yu said.
Ice Dragon took a step back, its eyes constricted, and the corners of its mouth twitched. Damn it, was this appropriate?
Why didn’t it know that its Beast Tamer’s heroic spirit could compete in strength with the Green Dragon God!
Even if Mu Huiyin was reborn, she wouldn’t dare to say that she was about as strong as that green dragon!
In Shi Yu’s pocket, Buggy also pouted. How could this be!
It had clearly never fought before, so why was it almost strong? It was definitely stronger.
After obtaining the information from Shi Yu, Ice Dragon was completely convinced that this battle shouldn’t be fought!
“Is it the effect of the World Tree’s Blessing?” Ice Dragon thought.
It quickly changed the topic and said, “So, when are you preparing to meet that guy who calls itself Chi Tong’s biological mother?”
Shi Yu said, “In a few months, I still feel that it’s unstable. After all, the Undying Dark Phoenix might have demigod battle power at its peak. Who knows if it has any backup plans?”
“Moreover, before the operation, we have to get Dong Huang to cooperate. After all, it’s too close to the city, and it’s not easy to stretch. After applying for a process, the procedures will definitely be long and smelly.”
At the moment, the Sea Cleansing Spirit Susu had accumulated could already cleanse the negative power of a top-notch totem level, but it was still a little short of the demigod level.
“Hmph,” Ice Dragon said. “It has already died once and been sealed for so long. It’s not bad to have the strength of a Normal totem. Call me when you’re ready.”
“I want to see if it’s Mu Huiyin’s biological mother or not. It made Mu Huiyin suffer so much. I have to teach it a lesson!”
“At that time, I’ll go with Chi Tong!” Ice Dragon was extremely serious.
Shi Yu looked at Ice Dragon suspiciously, suspecting that this guy was changing the topic.
“Cough, cough, roar!!!” At this moment, under the crazy healing of Baby Ginseng’s clone, the Golden Dragon Prince quickly recovered its consciousness. It suddenly widened its dragon eyes and breathed quickly.
“You’re awake.” In the sky, the little white dragon eating melons looked at the Golden Dragon Prince and said.
The Golden Dragon Prince looked at the sky with a complicated expression. Green Dragon
At this moment, the Golden Dragon Prince couldn’t accept that it had been defeated without even seeing the Green Dragon’s faith skill. It only wanted to become stronger and stronger and think of ways to become stronger.
“This It hasn’t decided if it’s going to help promote the Green Dragon Festival.”
Shi Yu realized that the Golden Dragon Prince was indeed resistant to beatings. His speed of leaving was even faster than when he attacked Buggy. He didn’t look injured at all. He clearly looked like he was running away.
“Ah, this” Ice Dragon also fell into deep thought and said, “It’s not a big problem. It can’t escape. I’ll talk to its father about this now. I’ve also delivered Lord Dragon God’s things. Shi Yu, I’m busy with Quests over there. I’ll leave first.”
“Tell Chi Tong to work hard!”
Shi Yu: “?”
In the blink of an eye, the ice dragon also let out a long roar and followed the Golden Dragon Prince, leaving behind the stunned Shi Yu and the little white dragon.
“What’s going on?”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Then, he looked at the little white dragon and said, “Little white dragon, do you want to come to my place to sit? By the way, my two second team pets are also at the monarch level”
The little white dragon:!!!
The second team, monarch level? Could it be that they wanted it to be their sparring partner?
Could it be the duck reincarnated Abyss Demon God?
The little white dragon’s pupils constricted. What a joke. That was an Abyss demigod. It immediately said, “Ah, no, I’ll help Senior Ice Dragon. I’ll supervise Big Brother Golden Dragon. Goodbye, Senior Shi Yu.”
With that said, it also slipped away at an extremely fast speed, making Shi Yu, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng look at each other.
Seeing the three Dragon Palace City members who arrived excitedly at the start leave like they were dodging a plague, Baby Ginseng couldn’t help but say, “Yi! (Beast Tamer, do you know how to socialize?)”
He scared the dragons.
Why were they fighting all the time?
Mother Dragon and the little white dragon, these two big hooligans, clearly didn’t like to fight.
“There’s no hope.” Shi Yu shrugged and said, “The Mythical Era is coming soon. I still don’t know how to quickly increase my strength.”
...
“Forget it, let’s go back.”
Shi Yu put away the new Dragon God Protection and stretched, letting Buggy bring him back to Ping Cheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 1039 Senior Lu’s Arrival (2)
chapters.content:
1039 Senior Lu’s Arrival (2)
After returning, Shi Yu informed Susu and Ling to prepare for Little Ji and Duckie’s fusion and evolution.
Previously, he had promised Little Ji, Duckie, and the others to fuse divine-level resources when the Heavenly Sword Nation Quest was done. It was time to fulfill his promise.
However, with their current growth level, it would probably be difficult to complete the fusion of power without half a month.
As for Shi Yu, he naturally listened to Ling’s suggestion and rested. He planned to hold a new team meeting after he recovered and Little Ji and Duckie completed their evolution. Then, he would head to the Space-time Dragon Vein to train in a new and best team state.
“In the past half a month, should I meditate and rest, or” Shi Yu thought about the content of his conversation with President Lin, but soon, a call made a decision for Shi Yu.
“Senior Lu” Shi Yu smiled and picked up the call. Then, he waited for Senior Lu’s arrival.
That day.
“Roar ~!!” With a roar, it roared in front of the door of Shi Yu’s villa. A dog-type creature with fluffy white hair and dignified blue eyes, its neck, limbs, body, and long tail were surrounded by black cloud patterns. It was especially domineering. It stood beside a beautiful woman in a blue and black battle suit and knocked on the door for her.
“Coming, coming.” Upon hearing the Wind Demon Lion’s cry, Shi Yu walked out of the door and welcomed Senior Lu and the others.
“Sorry, I encountered a wanted criminal on the way over. I took care of it and wasted some time,” Senior Lu said with a smile when she saw Shi Yu.
“The big dog has made a contribution again.” Shi Yu looked at the Wind Demon Lion. Because it had obtained the Evil Suppressing Lion inheritance, Senior Lu, this big dog, had the ability to sense evil thoughts. Therefore, during Senior Lu’s archeology, she would be lucky enough to make a contribution and catch bad people one by one.
“Roar!!” The Wind Demon Lion chuckled.
“This familiar configuration reminds me of the first time we met.” Shi Yu smiled and looked at the beautiful Senior Lu. “Back then, Senior, you brought the Wind Demon Lion to my place.”
“Yeah.” Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “Who knew that I would find a world legend?”
“I can’t fall behind either. I came this time to show you my new ability.”
“Senior, you really succeeded,” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes.” Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “But unlike your mind domain, it’s in another direction.”
After Shi Yu awakened his body control talent three months ago, he gave the Talent Bead to Senior Lu to develop her Beast Taming Talent.
And Senior Lu’s call just now was to tell Shi Yu that she had finally succeeded in developing it.
It also developed telepathy into a battle-type ability.
In the courtyard, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi looked at each other. Lu Qingyi said, “I named it ‘Psychic Resonance’. It’s an ability that’s a little more scientific than your mind domain.”
“Uh.”
“If during the battle, my pet’s emotions, heart, and Resistance can be in a harmonious coherence state, we can activate the ability of mental resonance.”
“In the situation of Psychic Resonance, be it my various Stats or my pet’s various Stats, they will receive a very good increase.”
“Of course the consumption is slightly greater than normal strengthening talent.”
“It can roughly be seen as the use of ‘spiritual and emotional power’.”
At the same time, Lu Qingyi’s aura beside it also changed completely. Just now, she was still a gentle senior. At this moment, she was like a valiant policewoman. Her eyes revealed a firm will and her face was filled with righteousness. Under her gaze, Shi Yu couldn’t help but feel guilty, like a child who had done something wrong had encountered a police officer.
Buzz.
Because they both had the mental characteristic of hating evil at this moment, Lu Qingyi and the Wind Demon Lion completed a perfect mental resonance. Shi Yu could sense that Senior Lu’s mental strength and the Wind Demon Lion’s various strengths were quickly increasing.
Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly. He had already seen the energy value of the overlord-level Wind Demon Lion increase to 82 million. He felt that it was extremely unbelievable. After all, the current Wind Demon Lion had yet to activate Mythical Revival.
A moment later, Lu Qingyi and the Wind Demon Lion’s state stabilized. Senior Lu recovered her smile and the corners of her mouth subconsciously curled up. “How is it?”
“It can also resonate with other pets?”
“Of course.”
“For example, my Empress Flower By the way, it’s my Imperial Concubine Flower. It evolved. It’s different from the Wind Demon Lion. Its mental characteristics and personality characteristics are that it has a proud heart. If I can adjust my mental emotions and understand its personality, I can also complete the coherence with it and undergo a mental resonance state.”
“But this is relatively difficult to do,” Senior Lu said with a helpless smile.
It was fine to make her hate evil, but to make her as arrogant as an empress flower She had tried many times, but she had only succeeded a few times.
Shi Yu couldn’t help but say, “This telepathy resonance is even more popular than the telepathy domain for many Beast Tamers with telepathy talent.”
“Senior, you’re better than me.”
“I definitely can’t do it without you.” Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “I’ve already summarized my experience and sent it to you. Let’s study it together?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 1040 Senior Lu’s Arrival (3)
chapters.content:
1040 Senior Lu’s Arrival (3)
“If you can learn it, you’ll definitely do better than me.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “But my current state is a little poor. Ling doesn’t allow me to use my talent and extraordinary power too much. I’ll talk about it in the future, but I can assist Senior in developing it deeper.”
“What’s wrong with you again?” Senior Lu looked at Shi Yu and said with concern, “Don’t tense yourself up too much. It’s fine to relax a little.”
“It was an accident, an accident,” Shi Yu said in embarrassment. He was already lazing around. It was purely a cheat.
“Senior, mind resonance, Mythical Revival, multiple eruptions. Can your pet’s energy level exceed 100 million?” Shi Yu asked.
“It’s still a little difficult now”
“It shouldn’t be a problem to train again,” Shi Yu said in surprise. “I feel that after cultivating for a while, Senior, you can also have the strength to challenge a ‘title’, right?”
“It’s still very far.” Senior Lu waved her hand and said, “But if there’s a chance, I really want to challenge the title of ‘surpasser’.”
“You already have the title of ‘world legend’. You probably won’t snatch it from me, right?” Lu Qingyi smiled.
The title of surpasser was one of the titles issued by the Seven Nation Alliance. It was specially prepared for Beast Tamers with a telepathy talent. This was because telepathy didn’t have the effect of increasing battle power. Up until now, no Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent had obtained titled battle power, which was totem battle power.
This title had naturally been vacant for a long time.
Shi Yu had clearly fulfilled the conditions previously. However, he had already obtained the world legend title in advance, so he naturally ignored the title of surpasser.
“A Beast Tamer shouldn’t be able to obtain two titles, right?” Shi Yu scratched his cheek. A title issued by the Seven Nation Alliance didn’t seem to have any substantial rewards apart from the honor bonus.
Otherwise, he felt that the Alliance still owed him the title of “Dragon King”.
The Dragon King title required him to control a dragon-type pet to fight a dragon-type totem for a day and night. This was the lowest standard, and he had already controlled a dragon-type pet to destroy a dragon-type totem and defeat a dragon-type totem. It should be given to him! This was how it was easy to make a certain young man named Yu Shu lose his dream.
“There’s indeed no precedent.” Lu Qingyi smiled and said, “Why, do you still want to try?”
“Or do you have a dream series to give every pet a title?”
“Forget it.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I don’t have the energy.”
“Senior, stay with me for a period of time. I happen to have a resource that can allow your strength to increase pretty well in a short period of time. When the time comes, let’s see the increase in effect. Perhaps you can challenge the title of ‘surpasser’ soon.”
“No, in half a month, go and challenge it and see how big the difference is.”
“Huh?” Lu Qingyi was stunned. She felt that Shi Yu was kidding. Unless it was a Mythical resource, why would she have titled battle power in half a month?
At the moment, there were only nine Beast Tamers with titles in the entire Dong Huang.
This included Shi Yu, a new titled legend.
After the World Tournament ended, Ye Xing went to challenge the title of battle pet warrior. He had already challenged it twice and had yet to succeed.
“I’m just trying out the difference. Senior, don’t tell me you think you can resist a totem in half a month?” Shi Yu asked with a smile.
“What’s wrong with that? If it’s your special training, it might really be possible.” Lu Qingyi smiled.
His so-called resources were actually Baby Ginseng’s Perfect-level World Tree Fruit and the new cultivation materials developed after the fusion Skill.
Coincidentally, Senior Lu had developed a new use of telepathy. Shi Yu was also more curious about how far she could develop with this resource.
That day, President Lin received Lu Qingyi’s application. She applied to challenge the title of “surpasser” half a month later.
He could not help but fall into deep thought.
The title of titled legend was certified and issued by the Alliance of the Seven Nation Alliance. The various countries only applied for the challenge and didn’t have the right to do the assessment.
“What exactly are Lu Qingyi and Shi Yu trying to do?” President Lin fell into deep thought. He had already learned that Lu Qingyi was undergoing special training with Shi Yu.
The title of surpasser required a Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent. When the seven pets, including the Beast Tamer, fought with all their members, it was a draw with a totem-level life form. Compared to titles like the Dragon King and the world legend, it wasn’t difficult to obtain them in terms of requirements, but the difficulty was that the battle power of a Beast Tamer with a telepathy talent was inferior to challengers with other titles.
“Forget it.” President Lin thought for a moment and still applied for Lu Qingyi. The number of applications every year from every country’s association was limited. After all, he was letting the totem guardian of the Alliance be the examiner. However, no one else from Dong Huang wanted to take the assessment anyway. It was fine to keep the opportunity, but it was the same to use it.
“I wonder when Shi Yu can become a Legendary Don’t delay his cultivation because of love”
President Lin, who had wanted Shi Yu to have a child quickly, jumped up again.
Because he had received news not long ago that Shen Feng had a new legendary Beast Tamer.
The World Tournament was held a total of four times. In the first year, Lin Feng of Dong Huang was the champion. In the second year, the Beast Tamer of Snowfield was the champion. In the year more than 20 years ago, the Shen Feng Beast Tamer was the champion. The champion of every World Tournament actually had Legendary potential, but unfortunately, apart from Lin Feng, the next two championships weren’t very awesome and exciting.
The world legend of Snowfield was directly assassinated and died by the totem faction not long after the World Tournament.
The world legend of Shen Feng was a biological modification-type Mechanic, but because of an experiment failure, a few contracted pets died, preventing him from advancing as quickly as Lin Feng. There had been no news for a long time. Who knew that recently, there was news from Shen Feng that this world legend had also become a Legendary Mechanic?
One country, two Legendarys, and one demigod!
Shen Feng vaguely showed signs of becoming the number one country.
This made President Lin extremely envious. He only hoped that Shi Yu could be faster. Otherwise, Shen Feng would probably snatch more right to speak in the next Blue Planet Alliance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 1041 Shi Yu Creates the World (1)
chapters.content:
1041 Shi Yu Creates the World (1)
When Senior Lu arrived, Shi Yu received her warmly. He directly got Baby Ginseng and Ling to prepare a big meal and the banquet started.
As for why there was also Ling, as a mechanical pet, since even a difficult form like a mecha could change, then the form of the electric rice pot and the form of the microwave would definitely be out of the question.
The all-purpose mechanical pet.
“Wuu!”
At the same time, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Susu, Qi, Little Purple, and the others were also called out by Shi Yu.
On Senior Lu’s side, the Green Phoenix, the Empress Flower, the Courtyard Sprite, the Mermaid Princess, and the Hurricane Demon were also summoned.
This wasn’t the first time the dozen or so pets had met. They reunited after a long time and immediately started a social event.
“Lord Green Dragon”
Senior Lu’s mermaid princess also had a dragon-element bloodline. In addition, she had seen the world competition and worshiped Buggy very much. As soon as she came out, she looked up at Buggy sleeping on the tree, but Buggy ignored her.
“Wu (There’s everything in dreams.)” Buggy said.
Although the mermaid princess was very beautiful, it was not interested in dragons. If this mermaid princess came to chat with it, it was better to find Shi Yu. Shi Yu definitely liked her. After all, according to what Buggy knew, humanoid creatures grew in Shi Yu’s aesthetic taste.
“Are you Qi?” Senior Lu’s Courtyard Sprite saw that the Qi it had seen in Courtyard previously had become as tall as a big coke bottle and had a blank expression.
At this moment, Qi was floating in the air with the help of the wind element. She still looked the same. Her loose pink ponytail hung on her shoulder, and a strand of hair stood up. She was wearing a silver-white battle suit with black patterns, a pleated short skirt, and a small white cloak on her back. This was not a problem. The problem was that it was too small and had shrunk a lot compared to before.
“Multiplication?” the Courtyard Sprite asked. Shi Yu’s pets indeed seemed to like multiplication and shrinking! After all, maintaining his main body’s normal state consumed too much energy.
However, what was the point of multiplying the elves? Even if the elves maintained their normal state, the consumption was not high.
“I’m Qi not multiplication But it’s also related to Skills” Qi didn’t know how to explain and sighed.” In short, I’ve become smaller, and I can’t recover anymore. ”
The Courtyard Sprite was at a loss. Then, it looked at Shi Yu, who was chatting with Lu Qingyi, and suspected that there was a problem with Shi Yu’s cultivation method.
“It’s not because Shi Yu isn’t. It’s because of myself,” Qi hurriedly explained. She waved her little hand around, afraid that Shi Yu would be misunderstood as having some strange hobby.
Ahhh, Space-time Travel!!
It made its Arms have to be customized again, like some fruit knife-sized Heavenly Thunder Blade
“ROAR!”
On the other side, the Wind Demon Lion ran to Eleven to ask how the Leader could go from barely defeating itself to defeating a god so quickly. Big boss, take me along.
The Green Phoenix ran to Chi Tong in the form of a bird spirit. As a member of the Phoenix Race, they had a deep sisterly relationship and threw Susu aside.
The empress flower stood on the spot arrogantly, her gaze landing on the cooking ginseng baby. It was difficult to imagine that this was the towering emperor who galloped through the world competition.
The Hurricane Demon, on the other hand, sized up Little Purple flying in the sky curiously. It had never seen such a pet and asked Susu what it was.
“Ning! (Sea Vegetable Rice Ball)” Susu replied.
Little Zi: Mimi?
Most of Shi Yu’s pets knew Senior Lu’s pets, but Little Zi, who had joined the team after the World Tournament, had indeed never interacted much with Lu Qingyi’s pets.
In fact, Lu Qingyi felt that Little Ji and Duckie were the most normal in Shi Yu’s team.
“Them? One is sleeping and leveling up in the mechanical room, and the other is refining the Abyss Seed in the Sea Cleansing. They’re both in a life-and-death state, so they’re not called,” Shi Yu said. “But Senior, haven’t you contracted your seventh pet?”
Lu Qingyi said, “I’ve been busy cultivating the first team recently. The seventh one is still being considered between the Iron-eating Beast and the mechanical phantom beast”
“Then we’ll decide after a while,” Shi Yu said. “Yun An has already appeared. Be it defeating Yun An or finding a new divine-level fossil, there are better choices.”
Shi Yu suddenly remembered that he still had a single-horned demon’s divine stone. Lord Lie Shan had given it to him, but he didn’t know when it could wake up.
Seriously, if he woke up now, he could at least rely on the Mythical Race to give him some Stats. It wasn’t a loss to contract it. If he didn’t wake up soon, he would wake up in seven years. What was the use of it? At that time, he definitely wouldn’t lack this bit of feedback.
Buzz!!
As the two of them chatted, suddenly, the sound of laws spread. A tempting fragrance suddenly attracted the attention of all the pets. Even Lu Qingyi, who was beside Shi Yu, was slightly stunned. Her snow-white neck trembled slightly as she turned around and looked at the wooden table.
A ginseng baby was setting up a plate with vines summoned from god knows where.
“Yi!!! (Dang dang dang dang!!!)”
On the wooden table, fruits and vegetables of various sizes were taken out by Baby Ginseng. They were extremely tempting.
Gulp.
Senior Lu’s stomach growled unconsciously. Shi Yu looked over and instantly made her blush.
“Has Baby Ginseng evolved again?”
“Well, after the World Tournament ended, Baby Ginseng completed its evolution with the blessings of the World Tree. It’s also a Mythical Race now. The nutrients it creates now are basically equal to top-notch level-eight resources. Senior, you’re in for a treat in the next half a month,” Shi Yu said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 1042 Shi Yu Creates the World (2)
chapters.content:
1042 Shi Yu Creates the World (2)
Thank you readers!
Lu Qingyi said, “You said it. Then I won’t hold back.”
“Yi!! (Don’t stand on ceremony! It’s just a little abandoned.)” Baby Ginseng nodded.
It was like this every day. If it weren’t for the Legendary ruins, Ping Cheng probably wouldn’t have lasted more than a few days.
Now, Baby Ginseng was strong and absorbing money.
< Name > Baby Ginseng
[Race Skill]:
“Advanced”: Time Fruit (Dao Proficiency)
“Super”: Time Mark (Perfect+), Moon Explosion (Perfect+), Life Fire Seed (Perfect+), World Tree Fruit (Perfect+), Green Wood Divine Body (Perfect+), Sun Forest (Perfect+), Plant Control (Perfect+36)
“Quasi Divine”: World Favor (Initiate)
In those two months of bitter cultivation, Baby Ginseng’s skills had almost been fused by Shi Yu.
The Green Wood Divine Body that was fused with Skills such as Source of Life, Heart of the Earth, Slow Healing, High Speed Healing, Multiplication, Mutation, and Deterrence. If the power of faith of the Green Dragon was excluded, its recovery ability far exceeded the Green Dragon Indestructible Body. It was also because of this physique that it was even more tempting now.
At the same time, this physique was extremely close to the natural power of earth plants and plants, and it had the effect of adapting to mutations. It could be seen as a super evolution skill, but now that it was already a Mythical Race, it was definitely even more harsh on evolution resources.
After plant control fused with sweet aura, nutritional supplements, energy fruits, lushness, and other skills, it also officially turned into a racial skill. At the moment, apart from superalloy and soul incarnation, it was a super skill with third proficiency in Shi Yu’s team.
The Sun Forest was a domain skill. The fusion of the Energy Storage Beam, Clear Sky, Four Symbols Star Formation, Clone, and other Skills allowed Baby Ginseng to create the Sun Tree Forest that controlled the power of the sun. This forest could be seen as a Sunlight Domain. It could be used in battle, assisted in Moon Explosion, and could also be used as a cultivation holy land.
Baby Ginseng used all its might to create a Sun Forest. Relying on natural sunlight, as long as it was used in moderation, it was not a problem to form an almost eternal cultivation holy land. Even if monarch-level fire-element and light-element pets lived in it, there would be huge benefits.
In addition, although the small Skills had fused, they didn’t completely disappear. Baby Ginseng still retained their usage EXP. Under the strengthening of the world, top-notch nutritional fruits and vegetables appeared on the dining table. There was also the most precious World Tree Fruit. This was the main thing.
“I’m starting!”
“Roar!!!”
….
After Senior Lu temporarily stayed with Shi Yu, Shi Yu began to help Senior Lu develop mental resonance and also let her pet participate in Eleven and the others’ special training.
This participation made Senior Lu’s pets wish they were dead.
eaglesnov1,o
Even the divine trial in the World Tournament wasn’t that cruel!
Of course, the time he spent with Senior Lu was only a small number after all. Most of the time, Shi Yu was still cultivating alone.
Back then, Shi Yu was either meditating to recover his Restoration state or trying to modify his Beast Taming Space.
Now, Shi Yu’s first Beast Taming Space had almost been modified by him.
On one hand, it relied on the resources of the outside world, and on the other hand, it relied on the power of the pet to modify it.
At that moment, his first Beast Taming Space was divided into six areas.
Eleven was in the Thunder Sea Bamboo Forest where the thunderstorm and the bamboo forest coexisted.
The cosmic meteorite group with rich cosmic power where Buggy was could live on asteroids.
The Forest of Life that Baby Ginseng was in contained more than a thousand plants.
The Sun Sword Domain Chi Tong was in. This place was born in the Sun Forest, but the trees had been cut into the shape of swords by Chi Tong.
In the Sea of Purification where Susu was, as well as the Sky City where Ling was, there were six pets and six areas. Under normal circumstances, they couldn’t interfere with each other.
As for Little Purple, it was a baby that had yet to be weaned. It just had to be led by Ling obediently.
Here, although they couldn’t let Eleven and the others undergo too exaggerated special training, because of the Blessing of the World Tree, resting in the Beast Taming Space was actually far better than special training in the Legendary Ruins.
Among them, the materials to modify the Beast Taming Space were naturally applied from Dong Huang. Shi Yu applied for a pile of rare materials that were expensive. Apart from that, he applied for more.
For example, Dong Huang, including the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise faith items of the surrounding countries, was also getting someone to help collect them and store them in the Ancient Capital Museum first.
These things were all equipment that could increase the strength of Enhancing Buggy. When necessary, they could be taken out as life-saving equipment. They had to be controlled.
Of course, Shi Yu felt that this alone was not enough. After all, a hard battle might consume many faith items. Apart from Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City helping him promote the power of faith, Shi Yu felt that he had to think of a way.
Therefore, Shi Yu also obtained a large number of resources and began to nurture Little Purple.
He finally started to nurture Little Purple.
For the past few days, the seaweed rice ball Susu mentioned had been lying in Shi Yu’s hand every day.
The resources it used were relatively Normal.
Earth-element energy crystal, wood-element energy crystal, water-element energy crystal
Previously, Little Zi only ate spatial crystals.
After eating it, it only cared about expanding the size and strength of the inner world.
Now, the area of its inner world at the commander rank had almost reached 100,000 square kilometers, far larger than the spatial pocket of the overlord-level Buggy, Susu’s Infinite Devour Space, and Ling’s mechanical space.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 1043 Shi Yu Creates the World (3)
chapters.content:
1043 Shi Yu Creates the World (3)
Thank you readers!
However, although the space in Little Zi’s body was ridiculously large, because it had yet to be modified, it was still empty. There was nothing.
And Shi Yu’s so-called cultivation was naturally to start helping it “create the world in its body”.
There were only two ways to “create”.
First, Little Purple slowly modified its inner world through eating food and using the nutrition of the food.
Second, Allowing other lives to enter the inner world, introduced foreign species, and used their power to modify the inner world.
In fact, the second method was the fastest. If Shi Yu let Eleven and the others enter Little Purple’s body, it probably wouldn’t be long before he could create a normal world where mountains and rivers flowed and the sun and moon changed. However, Little Purple was too weak at the moment, and Eleven and the others’ levels were too high.
Just like how those top-notch gods couldn’t be on Blue Planet and high-level beasts couldn’t be in the low-level Beast Taming Space, the world space would collapse.
Therefore, at the moment, Little Zi could only build the basics of the inner world with the support of Shi Yu and the others.
Of course, this method was not slow either, because Shi Yu’s physical control talent could also be used on pets.
Therefore, not only was Little Purple creating the world itself, but Shi Yu was also supporting it together. This could allow Little Purple to achieve twice the result with half the effort.
With the experience of modifying the ruins mystic realm and the Beast Taming Space as the foundation, it was still easy for Shi Yu to help Little Zi build an ordinary world that didn’t contain the power of laws.
“Sun and Moon.”
In Shi Yu’s hand, the cat-eared white ball of the purple nebula seriously created the phantom of the sun and moon through the Sun Fruit and Moon Fruit created by the ginseng baby.
“Galaxy.”
The Radiant Moon and Radiant Sun were in a vast sea of stars. Little Zi didn’t refuse anyone. It wanted to eat meteorites and cosmic strange water.
“Earth.”
“Wood.”
“Jiang He.”
Through eating the energy crystals of various elements, the earth vein in Little Purple’s inner world also contained a huge amount of natural power. With Shi Yu’s help, soon, in just a few days, this 100,000 square kilometers small world looked thriving.
It was basically no different from the outside world.
However, Shi Yu understood that these were all fake. For example, the sun and moon hanging in the sky were all illusory items condensed from energy. For example, the seemingly vast starry sky was actually a background. It looked vast, but everything was actually locked in a small space.
As for these lands, plants, and rivers, they looked extremely prosperous at the moment, but they were also built on the condition that Little Purple constantly replenished the corresponding nutrition. Only then could they function normally and have extremely short lifespans.
Once the energy was exhausted and not replenished in time, the so-called planetary resources would dry up, and the lifespan of the world would reach the end.
Compared to those real planetary life forms with lifespans of billions of years and could even rely on the stable laws formed by the internal world to delay life, Little Zi still had a long way to go.
However, this was too far away, and Shi Yu and the others couldn’t come into contact with it for the time being. The current level was more or less enough.
The reason why he wanted to help Little Zi build the basic world now was also for more power of faith.
Shi Yu planned to create a “divine kingdom world”.
Let the lives here mainly cultivate the “power of faith”.
Every life form could awaken “totems” in their minds after their mental strength took shape.
Visualizing and believing in totems could subtly change one’s strength and obtain transcendent power.
There were strong and weak totems, but it mainly depended on whether they were compatible with him.
With Shi Yu’s current strength, it was naturally not difficult to replicate this system. Totem visualization was one of the cultivation systems in this world that Shi Yu had already confirmed. The goal was to increase the strength of Enhancement Buggy and the others.
Although the life forms that could be contained in Little Zi’s body were far inferior to Blue Planet and Dong Huang in terms of strength and numbers, building a divine kingdom with Little Zi was really the only choice.
After all, as a normal human country, Dong Huang wouldn’t let ordinary people, Beast Tamers, and transcendent lives mainly cultivate the power of faith on a large scale. It wouldn’t let divine power override the law, so Shi Yu naturally couldn’t do anything.
And if he went to the totem country to steal the country, he would have to face the risk of the joint condemnation of the various totem countries. Most importantly, it was too troublesome and Difficult to change the faith of the totem country. It was not something that could be done overnight.
The greatest characteristic of Little Purple’s inner world was that it could accelerate the flow of time in the world by eating time-element resources.
As long as there were enough resources, it might have only been a year on Blue Planet, but a hundred years had passed in the world in its body. The power of faith that could be accumulated for Shi Yu in a hundred years was far inferior to a year in the outside world.
This was the speciality of it as a Son of the Stars and a planetary life form!
When Little Purple’s skill proficiency was high enough, when the world gave birth to a complete time law, Little Purple could also adjust the time flow in its inner world without the help of external resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 1044 Shi Yu Creates the World (4)
chapters.content:
1044 Shi Yu Creates the World (4)
Thank you readers!
For Shi Yu, who couldn’t bear to use the power of faith, it was clearly the most cost-effective to nurture faith himself.
As for more complicated worlds, such as the Six Paths of Reincarnation mechanism, the three realms of heaven, earth, and man, they were not something Shi Yu and the others could create at the moment. They could only use trickery to add some vitality to this world first.
“Let’s call this continent ‘Star Continent’ first,” Shi Yu said.
“Mi!!” Little Zi agreed.
Next, in order to accelerate the evolution of the Star Continent, Shi Yu and the others began to create life.
Be it Normal animals or ordinary humans, there had to be them here.
Shi Yu and the others’ method of creating life definitely couldn’t let them directly capture a portion of it from Blue Planet and throw it into the Star Continent.
Firstly, there were too many needs, and it was easy to destroy the ecology of Blue Planet. Secondly, it was too troublesome.
For example, humans on Blue Planet. After a long evolution, the Beast Taming Strength system had already been engraved in their bloodlines. It was already very difficult to change it. It was not something Little Zi could do. Humans with Beast Taming Talents would definitely go astray in the evolution direction of the world.
Therefore, Shi Yu and the others chose to learn from Nuwa.
Build it himself!
It didn’t rely on birthing.
It relied on making!
In the myths, Nuwa used mud to create humans, and Shi Yu and the others used a similar method.
Through Buggy’s power of imagination.
First, he would let Buggy pinch enough animals and humans in the Legendary Ruins. Then, Shi Yu and the others would send them into the Star Continent.
This method had the greatest problem.
At the moment, Buggy’s power of imagination had yet to cultivate a nomological divine skill, so it couldn’t really turn illusion into reality and create life out of thin air.
Therefore, the illusions it created weren’t real individuals. They couldn’t provide the power of faith.
If he wanted to change this, he had to let these illusions really develop self-awareness, break free from Buggy’s restraints, and complete new evolution.
Just like mechanical phantom beasts like Little Ji, after becoming a mechanical life form, it was no longer under Buggy’s control. It was a new individual.
And this would have to be done by Little Zi.
Back then, a top-notch god named Goddess Wa brought humans to Blue Planet. The World Tree used these humans as the template core and created native Blue Planet humans who had mastered the power of Beast Taming.
At this moment, the Dragon God of Creation named Green Dragon brought humans into the Star Continent. As the will of the world, Little Purple could also rely on the power of the world to modify these life phantoms into native life forms by eating soul crystals, Spirit Crystals, Life Crystals, and other resources.
Of course, the premise was that the essence of these illusions was Normal life forms.
Buggy only created illusions of Normal animals and ordinary humans. It wasn’t difficult for Little Purple to modify them through the power of the world.
However, if Shi Yu and the others were too arrogant and created Ultraman and Saiyans, they would definitely not be able to modify them.
“Mi!!”
In almost a few days, countless animals and humans moved on the Star Continent with ignorant understanding of the world.
At this moment, Little Zi’s inner world didn’t have extraordinary power.
Shi Yu was not in a hurry to activate the transcendent evolution of this world.
After all, the compatibility between these lives and their natives was still too low. There were too few of them, and their intelligence was not high.
It still needed to reproduce and evolve again to gradually integrate into the Star Continent.
By eating the fake god skill Time Fruit created by Baby Ginseng, Little Purple increased the speed of the Star Continent.
During the day, Shi Yu and the others trained Senior Lu. At night, Shi Yu and the others observed the changes in the new world. Just like that, half a month of Shi Yu’s recuperation quickly passed.
Because the evolution direction was different, the wild beasts obtained powerful strength, while the barbarians were relatively weak. They also developed the intelligence to rely on fire and Arms to fight the wild beasts. Both parties were evenly matched and evolved with each other. They developed well.
It was night.
Star Continent.
All life looked at the shining starry sky.
A sudden meteor shower descended at lightning speed.
Countless meteorites fell from the starry sky to the ground and ocean.
These meteorites didn’t seem to have caused any damage to the ground, but they shattered the natural power contained in the entire world.
An extraordinary power suddenly appeared in the minds of countless lives who came into contact with the meteorite.
A green dragon appeared in the minds of some humans, a white tiger in the minds of some wild beasts, a vermillion bird in the minds of some birds, and a black tortoise in the minds of some sea beasts
These Spirit Totems carried strong divine might, making these lives have the mood to submit. Some lives that regarded them as gods quickly discovered the transcendent changes produced by visualizing the bodies of these totems.
On this day, a new era began in the Star Continent. Future generations would call it the Mythical Era.
The entire Star Continent began the great cultivation era.
“With Little Zi’s current strength, no matter how they cultivate or what methods they use, there’s very little hope of their levels exceeding the transcendent level.”
“The higher you go, the harder it is to. It’s just like how no life form on Blue Planet can reach the divine level.”
“However, there are people on Blue Planet who can break through the restraints of the planet and head to the starry sky. Little Zi, Ling, do you think a super genius might appear in this Star Continent in the future, break through the world restrictions, and ascend in front of us?” On the bed, Shi Yu held Little Zi and said to Ling, who was in charge of deducing the world beside him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 1045 Earth and Ocean Overlord (1)
chapters.content:
1045 Earth and Ocean Overlord (1)
Thank you readers!
Alliance calendar, year 180.
It had been three years since Shi Yu became a Beast Tamer.
Moreover, he was still charging at the higher “Legendary Domain” and “Divine Realm”.
He originally estimated that the former would take another two years, while the latter might take seven years.
Ping Cheng, garden villa area.
A blue Psychic flew over, and the fridge door automatically opened. A bottle of Frost flew into Shi Yu’s hand.
Just as he completed the meditation cultivation in the second space, Shi Yu yawned in a daze.
His second Beast Taming Space had already reached level six. His improvement was very fast, and he was about to catch up to the level of the first Beast Taming Space.
In the second team, the ones with the fastest battle power progress were undoubtedly Little Ji and Duckie.
In half a month, with Ling’s help, Little Ji had already evolved into a land overlord of a quasi Mythical Race through fusing with the Earth Divine Dragon fossil.
As for the duck, with Susu’s help, it evolved into an ocean overlord of a quasi Mythical Race. Shi Yu preferred to call it the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck.
Because they were both new breeds, the racial names naturally followed Little Ji and Duckie’s joy. The two went against each other, each taking the racial names of land overlord and ocean overlord.
Now, Shi Yu’s half-eliminated legendary ruins space had already become a battlefield for Little Ji and Duckie. The terrain had almost been reconstructed by them.
Due to the lead of evolution and divine-level resources, their growth level had also reached the overlord level. They had the ability to change nature.
Although Shi Yu’s second space was only level six, he didn’t let them deliberately suppress their levels. After all, in his current situation, Little Ji and Duckie’s breakthrough was no longer a contract above their level.
It could completely withstand it, and the benefits of the feedback were even greater than the consumption.
“Quack!!!”
Shi Yu only took a glance at the Legendary Ruins and saw an ocean.
There was also a huge black duck five meters tall with dark blue patterns standing on the tsunami and surfing.
On its neck, the pure golden-blue water that was like cleansing water froze like a ribbon, becoming a scarf-like part that floated behind it in an extremely domineering manner.
The rain fell drop by drop like bullets, strengthening the huge tsunami.
This way, it could also better control the power of the abyss and not lose itself.
However, compared to the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck, the duck preferred to call itself an ocean overlord.
[Name]: Duckie (Race: Ocean Overlord)
Stats: Water, Dark
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Growth Level]: Overlord level

“High Level”: Wave Sword (expert+)
Energy Points: 71.1 million
The newly awakened Dark Sky Wave Rain indeed gave it the qualifications to become the overlord of the sea. A storm summon instantly drowned the continent.
If Duckie became stronger, Little Ji would as well.
At this moment, although the land was submerged by the sea, magma rose wherever it stepped. Soon, a new land was formed and they faced each other head-on.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, on the originally earth dragon-like body, Little Ji’s appearance also changed.
Many cracks that looked like dry land appeared on its skin. In the cracks, the power of magma swam. It was this power that resisted the duck’s attack.
[Name]: Little Ji (Race: Mechanical Beast, Land Overlord)
[Stats]: Machinery, Dragon (Earth, Fire)
[Race Level]: High-level overlord (Quasi Mythical)
[Growth Level]: Overlord level
[Race Skill]
“Intermediate”: Basic Intelligence (expert+)
“Advanced”: Space Splitting Sword (expert+), Dragon Breath (expert+), Deterrence (Perfect+), Clear Sky (proficient)
“Super”: Earth Domain (expert+), Earthquake (expert+), Reverse Scale (expert+), Lava Explosion (proficient), Gravity Control (proficient)
[Teaching Skill]
“Advanced”: Super Heavy Sword (expert+)
Energy Points: 73,910,0
Because the Earth Divine Dragon fossil was relatively incomplete, it only helped Little Ji awaken skills like Lava Explosion, Clear Sky, and Gravity Control. It was actually alright.
As for the divine skill of the Earth Divine Dragon, perhaps it would have to wait for Little Ji to increase the skill proficiency of the Mythical Revival like Ling before there was a chance of inheriting and awakening.
And now, Shi Yu had yet to nurture them through adding points. Clearly, quasi-divine skills were still far from Little Ji and the others.
...
It could be said that at the moment, be it Little Ji or Duckie, their potential had yet to be completely unearthed.
Little Ji still had the possibility of awakening a Mythical bloodline, and the Abyss Seed that Duckie ate, as a divine-level resource, clearly had more than this amount of strength.
However, it had temporarily turned into potential. Its Abyss Liberation was a skill to unearth more abyssal power, but when used, it was easy to lose its rationality. It needed to be restricted by skills like Purification, Diamond Staff, Heart Sword, and so on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 1046 Earth and Ocean Overlord (2)
chapters.content:
1046 Earth and Ocean Overlord (2)
Thank you readers!
After Shi Yu and the others’ torment, the battle power of the second team’s Little Ji and Duckie was considered to have taken shape.
Of course, that was for ordinary battles.
At the moment, Duckie and Little Ji’s strength was basically at the threshold of a top-notch overlord, similar to the Green Scaled Dragon Shi Yu and the others were fighting.
This couldn’t be helped. After all, their super Skill proficiency had yet to increase much. They were even inferior to Normal overlords like the gem cat previously. They didn’t even have perfect proficiency.
To have the strength of a top-notch overlord, it relied on using divine-level evolution resources. It relied on other aspects such as physique, energy, life, and Resistance to be relatively good.
It was considered an overlord with shortcomings.
However, the future was promising.
When Shi Yu had extra energy and began to add points to them, he believed that they would quickly have stronger strength and even compete in the battle of the first team to participate in the battle between gods.
“Shi Yu, are you there?”
At the stairs, Lu Qingyi walked upstairs. After approaching Shi Yu’s room, she called out to Shi Yu.
“President Lin just came to inform me to go to the ‘Battle Island’ tomorrow.”
“It should be the examiner of the Alliance.”
“We’re finally here. Battle Island? I’ll go with you too,” Shi Yu said.
He wanted to go to another place on the way.
Space-time Dragon Vein.
He had almost recovered. It was time to start a new round of bitter cultivation. Shi Yu didn’t plan to cultivate bitterly at Dong Huang. Instead, he planned to cultivate in the valleys around the Space-time Dragon Vein.
Over there, Qi could also use the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein to quickly recover the power of Space-time Travel. This was the main point.
“Alright, I wonder who the examiner sent by the Alliance is this time” Lu Qingyi was rather nervous.
After all, Ye Xing had failed to challenge titled battle pet warriors twice in a row
Although her strength had improved greatly with Shi Yu’s help in the past half a month, she still didn’t have much confidence. After all, her opponent was at the totem level.
“Relax, I’ll prepare,” Shi Yu immediately said with a smile.
He didn’t have much to prepare. He just wanted to inform his pets.
At the moment, a few pets were not beside Shi Yu. They had all run out to train alone.
For example, Buggy ran to the rural areas of various places where people believed in the four holy beasts to absorb the power of faith at a close distance. In addition, it would occasionally appear and give them some good weather.
Eleven and Susu also ran to the sea. Eleven dived into the deep sea to use the pressure of the deep sea bottom to train its sea battle ability, while Susu dived into the sea and absorbed the power of the sea to continue strengthening the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
Although it could mobilize the power of the ocean anywhere through the Blue Sea Contract, it was definitely the most efficient to mobilize it when it was in the ocean.
[Activate: Long-range call.]
Shi Yu was in Dong Huang and had a few pets beside him. His safety was guaranteed, so he let them go out to play in peace. In any case, he had top-notch telepathy. If there were any problems, he could communicate at any time.
Even if Buggy had already run to Divine Capital and was ridiculously far from him, Shi Yu could still contact it through the “online meeting”.
This was the power of a Beast Tamer with a high-level telepathy talent. His support ability was top-notch.
Of course, the reason why Shi Yu could be so fierce was also related to his strong mental strength and mastery of max-level Psychic power. The sensing range of other Beast Tamers of the same level wouldn’t be so exaggerated.
“I say, you guys, it’s time to come back.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking.
In Divine Capital, a little green worm lying on the green dragon stone statue raised its head and chirped.
It just so happened that it was hungry too.
Hu hu hu!!
“Ning. (Right away, right away.)” Somewhere in the ocean, Susu immediately replied.
Although they were both in the ocean, it wasn’t with Eleven. It was mainly because Eleven’s fighting movements at the bottom of the sea were too big. Even if it only used its body to fight, it was too disturbing.
“Eh.”
“Susu, where are you?”
“Near the Battle Island?”
In the positioning, Shi Yu suddenly realized that Susu seemed to be near the Battle Island. He couldn’t help but say, “Susu, stay there first. We’ll go over later.”
“Ning! (Alright ~ ~)” Susu.
….
Battle Island.
It was an artificial island. The specially built battle facility was one of the few artificial buildings that Dong Huang could withstand the highest battle fluctuations.
