It was also the time when Shi Yu was the most determined to survive until Blue Planet was invincible before coming out of seclusion.
“Wait, I almost forgot. Before training, let’s carry out the team meeting first!”
….
This time, Shi Yu’s determination could not be said to be small.
In the blink of an eye, half a year passed.
In half a year, although Shi Yu was paying attention to Dong Huang’s movements at all times, he resisted all the temptation and focused on adding points, meditating, and cultivating.
On Dong Huang’s side, talents appeared in large numbers in half a year.
Through the title challenge, Lu Qingyi shocked the country. Dr. Lu, who could fight with looks, instantly became a battle goddess pursued by the country.
After all, apart from Shi Yu, she was the youngest among the ten titled experts of Dong Huang.
Three months later, Ye Xing also made Dong Huang boil again through the title challenge. He had also obtained battle power to fight against Normal totems at the level of a level-seven Beast Tamer. This was very rare in the first few decades.
It had to be said that this batch of young people from Dong Huang was very lucky to have caught the first bus of Mythical Revival. Be it before or after the world competition, they had been nurtured by Dong Huang with all its resources.
However, all of this temporarily had little to do with Shi Yu. He had always been immersed in his bitter cultivation.
In terms of the level of the first Beast Taming Space, Shi Yu didn’t gain much. It was still level seven. However, he was about to reach level eight. There was hope of reaching level eight in half a year.
It was mainly because he had first spent his time on the cultivation of the second Beast Taming Space. In the past half a year, the second Beast Taming Space had successfully been cultivated to level seven by Shi Yu and achieved an achievement that was in sync with the level of the first Beast Taming Space. Qi had also been contracted under the second Beast Taming Space.
The reason why he cultivated the second Beast Taming Space first was also to upgrade his physical control talent. This way, it would be easier to do anything.
Of course, Shi Yu did not delay the first Beast Taming Space. He had developed his Beast Taming Talent. With Senior Lu’s experience, he had also developed the Psychic Resonance skill. However, because his pets were especially silly, Shi Yu was not used to using them.
Using it was the most compatible with Chi Tong. After all, it liked swords, and so did Shi Yu.
Shi Yu’s cultivation progress was improved during the break time for adding points, so there was no doubt that his gains from adding points were the greatest in half a year.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 1060 Attacking demigod-level Battle Power (5)
chapters.content:
1060 Attacking demigod-level Battle Power (5)
At the moment, the super top-notch Skills of Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, and Ling had all been added to the perfect proficiency by Shi Yu. This was the greatest gain.
Thank you readers!
Apart from quasi-divine skills that didn’t dare to add points, it could be said that their battle power had reached the pinnacle of the current overlord level.
During this period, Buggy accumulated a meteorite with the full power of a demigod-level attack through the power of faith. The nine meteorites with the full power of top-notch totems floated in the starry sky, ready to attack.
With the support of points, Susu still accumulated two Sea Cleansing Spirits that were enough to cleanse the negative power of a demigod. The two Sea Cleansing Spirits that were enough to cleanse the negative power of a top-notch totem had a rich foundation.
Ling even learned the creation method of forbidden weapons and created two “forbidden Arms” that were enough to kill top-notch totems. It stored them in its body and could be released at any time.
!!
After half a year of hard work, apart from feeling a little regretful that he had yet to reach level eight, Shi Yu could finally confidently say that he had demigod-level battle power.
Although there might be a difference between this rich heritage and veteran Legendarys like Divine Source Legendary and Legendary Z who had divine forbidden weapons, Shi Yu felt that it shouldn’t be a big problem to heavily injure weaker demigods like the Heavenly Sword demigod.
Even Yun An, who had two demigod-level cleansing moves, wasn’t very strong. He felt that with all of them together, he definitely had the qualifications to fight at 55%.
As for the second team, although Little Ji and Duckie’s skills weren’t as exaggerated as the first team’s, they had also reached a normal level and had the battle power of invincible overlords. As for Little Purple, because time was too tight, Shi Yu didn’t add much points to nurture it. At the moment, it had only reached the monarch level.
After adding points to the entire team for half a year, he was almost going to become a time management Master and a person.
At the moment, Shi Yu did not plan to continue adding points. Although Little Ji, Duckie, and Little Zi still had room to improve, Shi Yu could not sit still after holding it in for half a year.
This time, he was confident because he had already achieved all the goals he had set at the start.
He had the battle power to fight against a demigod.
And… Qi had awakened space-time travel.
In the beginning, Qi judged that it would take at least a year to awaken spatial travel through the power of the dragon vein.
However, with the help of Shi Yu’s additional points, this time was fortunately shortened by half.
In just half a year, Qi revived the Space-time Travel Skill.
At that moment, Shi Yu and the others were surrounding each other and studying the Space-time Travel Skill with Qi.
“Can we experiment now?”
“The current power can only support transmigration within 5,000 years. Moreover, the quasi-divine skill stage can’t lead to a stable future with spatial laws. It can only transmigrate to the past with incomplete spatial laws?”
In the face of Shi Yu’s question, Qi, who had already shrunk to the size of a palm, nodded.
“Think about where you’re going.” Shi Yu asked for everyone’s opinion.
“Mimi! (Emperor Shi, Emperor Shi!)” Chi Tong wanted to see Mu Huiyin.
“Ning! (Emperor Wu! Emperor Wu!)” Susu stabbed Chi Tong in the back.
Shi Yu’s pets shouted one by one.
At the moment, Shi Yu and the others were like bachelors who had been holding back for decades. When they saw beautiful girls, they were especially novel and excited.
Qi’s Space-time Travel Skill undoubtedly satisfied their novelty.
“Emperor Wu,” Shi Yu said to Chi Tong. “The minority obeys the majority. When we go to Emperor Shi Dynasty, we definitely have to call the Dragon Mother. Let’s return to Emperor Wu Dynasty to take a look first.”
“Go find Eleven’s inscription materials that don’t exist in the modern era.”
“Mi.” Chi Tong nodded. That made sense. Alright then!
“But, but!!” Qi said. “Space-time travel is still at the quasi-divine skill stage after all. After confirming the space-time coordinates, there might be a certain year of error, but… it shouldn’t be very big! Of course, it’s not a problem to return. I’ve already left a mark here.”
“Moreover, apart from me, the longer everyone stays in other spaces, the more they will be rejected by space and time, so they can’t stay for a long time. But… but now that we’ve contracted, maybe we can,” Qi said.
“Come on, don’t care so much. As long as we can come back,” Shi Yu said. “Ling, prepare some automatic mail to reply to people first.”
“Yes ~” Rubik’s Cube Ling said quickly.
“Then…” Qi couldn’t help but rub its face. It was also excited. It had finally recovered its strength. It also wanted to use it quickly.
Under the urging of Shi Yu and the others, soon, a pink and white light that enveloped Shi Yu and the others flickered first before calming down.
….
In the past space.
Dong Huang Calendar, year 548.
548 years ago, the human Legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Shi, who rose like a star, expelled the totem clans and established a unified dynasty in the east, Dong Huang.
However, the newly established Dong Huang Dynasty didn’t last for decades before it went into chaos because of Emperor Shi’s disappearance.
However, although the Dong Huang Dynasty was extremely chaotic because of Emperor Shi’s disappearance, the expelled totem clans were also heavily injured in the previous totem battle.
The collapse of the Dong Huang Dynasty wasn’t that fast.
However, without the birth of a new Legendary Beast Tamer and carrying the banner, the titled legend of the Dong Huang Dynasty alone was no longer enough to occupy the rich resources in the east.
Therefore, after the totem clans recuperated, a new round of totem battles immediately erupted.
Dong Huang collapsed and disintegrated, entering an era where heroes were divided.
After that, the Eastern Land returned to its previous chaos. However, Emperor Shi’s merits and the short peace brought by the Dong Huang Dynasty were always remembered by future generations.
Countless human Beast Tamers took it upon themselves to restore their country.
Until 500 years later, a new Legendary Beast Tamer was born in the human race.
He had a top-notch Fusion Talent and used the four holy beasts as a template to nurture pets, rising with a shocking speed.
After becoming a Legendary, he immediately killed the strongest totem king who occupied the Eastern Continent at that time, the demigod, the Heaven Eating Tiger.
Then, he even killed nine totems in a row and announced the end of the totem war with shocking battle results.
After this battle, a large number of totem clans withdrew from the Eastern Continent again. Legendary Beast Tamer Wu Dong called himself Emperor Wu and established the Dong Huang Dynasty again.
The entire east welcomed a short peace again.
However, this peace didn’t last long. The revival of the strongest creature three thousand years ago, Yun An, and the birth and rise of the Yun Race made Emperor Wu Dynasty and Dong Huang Dynasty fall into a state of internal and external trouble again.
On the chaotic and lonely sea.
Figures appeared out of thin air on this Desolate Island under the dark sky with the pink and white spatial light.
“Success?”
An excited male voice came from the group. “No signal!! Looks like it worked!!”
“Yes, yes, yes, I’m back!” A little elf in pink and white flew in the air and nodded happily.
Great.
Strength returned.
“What era is this?” Shi Yu stood on the black ground and looked at the chaotic sea. For a moment, he couldn’t tell.
“Has Emperor Wu Dynasty been established? Has it started to come into contact with the Yun clan?”
“Wuuu!! (Fight!)” Eleven climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Let’s go, let’s go to Emperor Wu Dynasty and get the remaining inscription materials.
It wanted to be a ten inscription panda!
“Roar. (Then I’ll reluctantly fight Emperor Wu’s Green Dragon.)” Buggy said.
“Yi. (I want to fight Zhong Xuan!)” Baby Ginseng said.
“I don’t know. Let’s return to the Dong Huang Continent first,” Ling said. “We’ll know when we get there.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded.
“I hope I can meet Emperor Wu. He has a top-notch Fusion Talent. We also have a few of us. Wouldn’t it be wonderful to fight?” At the moment, Shi Yu, who had demigod battle power, urgently needed an opponent.
Of course, this was not his most important goal. His most important goal was to deal with Emperor Wu. Just the iron-eating beast evolution materials were not enough. Shi Yu also wanted the development EXP of Emperor Wu’s top-notch Fusion Talent…!
“Master, I advise you to be kind…” Ling looked worried.
It was not a problem for it to fight Emperor Wu, but the problem was that when everyone fused into a mecha, the one who would be beaten up would be it, Ling! It had just finished its bitter cultivation and stepped into the threshold of the demigod/legendary level, and it was here to challenge the number one ruthless person in history. Was it serious?

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 1061 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (1)
chapters.content:
1061 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (1)
In the past, in the era of Emperor Wu, in the Infinite Sea Region, on Spacetime Island.
Thank you readers!
The waves collided, and Gust roared. Under the gloomy sky, Shi Yu and the others stood on the cliff and looked into the distance.
Upon arriving at an unfamiliar environment, Shi Yu subconsciously felt happy and stretched.
They wanted to fight quickly.
“Let’s join forces with Emperor Wu and destroy the Yun clan before returning,” Shi Yu said.
Yun An of this space and time was cowardly. According to what Shi Yu knew, Yun An of the Emperor Wu Era was not that cowardly.
They had all established their countries outside the Dong Huang Dynasty and formed a confrontation with Dong Huang.
If he didn’t use it to practice first, Shi Yu felt that he had let down his transmigration.
Emperor Wu was the main damage dealer, and he was the support. He couldn’t lose, right?
As for the reward, the meteorite fragment was enough.
“Snatch all the resources of the Yun Race! ~” Qi raised his arms and said, “I’m so looking forward to it.”
“This is the first time I’m doing this.”
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “I didn’t expect that I would experience what the Space Worm Race and the Abyss Race wanted to do. Hehe…”
Qi: “Hmph, I’ll help Shi Yu and the others become stronger. When the time comes, I’ll kill them.”
Qi was still holding a grudge.
According to Qi, in the Mythical Era, be it the Space Worm or the Abyss Race, they were very eager to snatch Qi.
It was called the most valuable resource on Blue Planet, even more precious than Blue Planet itself.
The reason was that Qi had mastered the spatial travel law that was very rare even in the entire universe.
Space-time Travel was indeed rare. Shi Yu had tried it. Even if he replicated the Space-time Travel Skill, like the time-element ginseng baby, he couldn’t learn it at all. The compatibility wasn’t enough.
According to the desire of the Space Worm and the Abyss Race at that time, there might not be many like Qi in the entire universe.
Life forms who had mastered the law of space-time travel could transmigrate time and parallel space according to the strength of their abilities.
The resources of the universe were limited, even in the starry sky universe.
However, if one could transmigrate through space and time, they could have almost unlimited resources.
At that time, both the Space Worm and the Abyss Race hoped to obtain the Time Sprite and nurture it stronger to the point where it could transmigrate with a divine level.
Since ancient times, there had been many such records.
It was said that the reason why there were many parallel universes with different historical developments in this universe was because life forms who had mastered the laws of space and time transmigrated.
And as long as a life form grew up under the training of spatial travel, it could undoubtedly become the strongest in the universe, because he enjoyed endless resources.
For example, Shi Yu had come to the ancient space and time to plunder the iron-eating beast’s evolution resources…
Of course, it might be because of this unscientific ability that a life form that had mastered the laws of space and time would be weaker the higher the proficiency of space and time travel.
“Hu, I keep feeling that we’re committing a crime,” Shi Yu said.
“Alright, Buggy, you shouldn’t have any meteorites in this space and time, right? Start condensing now, in case of emergencies.”
“Roar!!!” The green dragon, which was a few centimeters tall, nodded.
In the era of Emperor Wu… there was also the power of faith of the Green Dragon, so faith skills could still be used.
It was its inventory in this space-time that couldn’t bring this space-time.
On the other hand, because Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit was stored in its body and not the outside world, it was brought over.
“Wu wu wu!! (Let’s go!)” Eleven was eager to try and couldn’t wait anymore.
The nine inscription Skills of the Iron-eating Beast were all pretty good. They were all tailor-made for the Iron-eating Beast.
Eleven felt that after it obtained it, its battle power would definitely increase greatly and it could take revenge!!
Revenge for the team internal competition!!
Before Shi Yu and the others cultivated hard, they organized the third team competition.
The champion of the team internal competition this time was Chi Tong.
The saddest were Baby Ginseng and Susu.
They felt that this team internal competition was targeting them!
In the first team internal competition, in a normal battle, self-destruction was forbidden. Eleven won.
In the second team internal competition, a new equipment system was added. Self-destruction was forbidden, and Buggy successfully stole it!
In the third team internal competition, Shi Yu directly banned all the quasi-divine skills, the faith skill Dragon Star Group, the Sea Cleansing Spirit, and self-destruction. He felt that there was no need to waste so much effort in the team internal competition, so he added a new partner system.
Pets with possession and loading types could possess Shi Yu to fight. This way, Chi Tong’s status after the divine level evolution would directly increase in a straight line.
Therefore, in this team internal competition, Chi Tong was first, Eleven was second, Buggy was third, Ling was fourth, Baby Ginseng was fifth, and Susu was sixth.
It directly shut Baby Ginseng and Susu up.
Baby Ginseng didn’t expect that not only did its ranking not advance, but it was also at the bottom.
Susu was also depressed. It didn’t expect that after Ling joined the team, it was still at the bottom.
Under the strong request of the crying Susu, Shi Yu agreed. Soon, there would definitely be an internal team competition in the ocean venue. Only then would Susu be satisfied…
…
The territory of the Dong Huang Dynasty in the Emperor Wu Era was a little smaller than the Dong Huang in the future, but not much smaller.
For example, in the future, most of the nine first-level cities were still in Dong Huang’s territory.
As for the capital of the Emperor Wu Dynasty, it naturally continued the Emperor Shi Dynasty and was located in Ancient Capital City.
That was where Shi Yu went to school.
After Shi Yu decided to set off, he retracted most of his pets, leaving Buggy and Qi beside him.
Buggy was a transportation tool, and Qi was a space-time guide to prevent any accidents from happening.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1062 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (2)
chapters.content:
1062 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (2)
Just like that, the combination of a dragon, a man, and a little elf began to fly towards the continent.
Thank you readers!
The current sea area was undoubtedly more dangerous than the future.
But for Buggy, who had strong spatial attainments, it wasn’t difficult to travel.
Unless it was a demigod-level expert, it was very difficult to pay attention to Shi Yu and the others.
Just like that, it didn’t take long for Shi Yu to pass through the sea and reach the place where the dream began.
Icefield City, Ping Cheng, the sea area outside the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
At this moment, the area of Icefield City and Ping Cheng was called Snow City because of the snow all year round.
Shi Yu rode the Green Dragon and looked at the endless snow mountain below on the snow clouds. He knew that in this space and time, there was also a frost dragon sleeping and suppressing the Ice River Totem.
Shi Yu didn’t disturb Ice Dragon because this was also a rare cultivation opportunity for Ice Dragon.
Ice Dragon was only a representative transportation tool for Mu Huiyin, but in her later years, Mu Huiyin gave it a heavy responsibility to suppress the Ice River Totem. Wasn’t it because suppressing the Ice River Totem was the best opportunity for the hooligan Ice Dragon to break through to the totem level?
Soon, Shi Yu, who had passed through the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, descended into Snow City without anyone noticing.
Snow City was a classic ancient city. The high city wall blocked the ferocious beasts in the Icefield Snow Mountain. A large number of soldiers were stationed here to protect Snow City. It looked like Icefield City had not changed much in the past two thousand years.
It might also be related to the fact that this place was close to the East Sea and the overlord of the East Sea, Dragon Palace City, was not interested in land.
Shi Yu smiled. After letting Buggy teleport him to Snow City, only Qi was left beside him in his pocket. However, as long as Shi Yu allowed it, every pet in the Beast Taming Space could still clearly see the outside world through Shi Yu’s perspective.
In a white town, Shi Yu approached the ancient tree where the snow fell and looked at the most flat area in the town.
There were more than ten children from six to seven to ten years old.
In the square that was like a training ground, their young faces were filled with seriousness. Their hands and feet followed the movements of the animal skin wearing man in front of them.
“If you want to become a Beast Tamer, you have to have a strong physique!”
“Before your Spiritual Soul power takes shape, this stage where you can’t contract pets is one of the few times where you can train your body and build the foundation without any distractions!”
“Only by laying a good foundation can you become stronger. Only by having powerful strength can you contribute and serve the country!”
“Hmph!” Upon hearing the animal skin man’s words, although the faces of the children were red from the cold and they spat out white gas, they were still training rather seriously.
“As expected of the dynasty with the most prosperous martial arts style!”
Shi Yu was in an ordinary town in Snow City. When he saw this scene, he was in a daze.
Although he had yet to ask, Shi Yu deduced that it should be the early stages of the establishment of Emperor Wu Dynasty.
It was said that the totem battle had just ended a few years ago. The stage of the Dong Huang Dynasty’s rebirth through the flames was the most prosperous stage during the era of Emperor Wu Dynasty. From adults to children, they were proud to join the Dong Huang Army.
At a very young age, under the guidance of retired soldiers assigned to various places, children would lay the foundation for walking the path of Beast Taming.
In short, as long as there were conditions, martial arts prospered.
At the start of the dynasty, the officials were also trying their best to improve the livelihood of the people everywhere, strived to prevent things like not being full and not being warm.
Although the existence of transcendent life forms brought hardship to humans, everything was relative and two-sided. This was because of the existence of extraordinary power. As long as the strongest experts wanted to improve the lives of the people, the difficulty of improvement was far lower than in a world without extraordinary power.
“Huh?!”
Shi Yu quietly leaned against the ancient tree. He looked at the middle-aged man in animal skin who didn’t hide his breathing and existence when he taught the child fitness.
Not long after, the burly man who was teaching the child discovered this strange person in strange clothes. His expression couldn’t help but turn cold.
“You guys, continue training.”
He called out to the children and quickly walked in Shi Yu’s direction. In his opinion, the current Shi Yu was indeed strange. This was because Shi Yu was still wearing the battle suit he had trained in. The dark red interweaving battle suit was extremely luxurious. The burly man couldn’t tell what the ancient Style and modern Style were. He only knew that ordinary people definitely couldn’t afford to wear such clothes.
Could it be a young master from a rich family?
“You’re… you’re not a citizen of Bailin Town, right?”
“I’m the Beast Taming Instructor of Bailin Town, Guo Yan. We are in a sensitive period, so please explain your identity.” Guo Yan walked forward and said neither servile nor overbearing. As a crippled veteran who had retreated from the totem battle, only the Dong Huang Army was his faith.
Everything had to be carried out according to the orders issued by the army.
These children did not know, but Guo Yan had heard from his old comrade that another powerful totem country that was enough to threaten Dong Huang had appeared next door. Currently, the domestic situation was very tense.
The many policies released recently was proof of that!
“Me? I’m indeed not a resident of Bailin Town, but Snow City is my hometown.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Of course, the current Snow City is also a little unfamiliar. After all, I just returned. This time, I’m considered to have returned from training to rely on Dong Huang.”
“Yes, yes, we’re here to rely on Dong Huang!” Qi popped her head out of Shi Yu’s pocket.
“What’s this?” Guo Yan was shocked when he saw Qi in Shi Yu’s pocket and felt that it was unbelievable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 1063 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (3)
chapters.content:
1063 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (3)
Thank you readers!
A pink-haired little person?
How was this possible? How could there be a palm-sized person!
“Who exactly are you!” Guo Yan immediately acted as if he was facing a great enemy and became nervous. Although he was once a Beast Tamer, his Beast Taming Space had already shattered during combat. He had barely survived the disaster and survived. It was already impossible for him to become a Beast Tamer again. He could only teach the children.
If there were really suspicious people, he couldn’t deal with them.
“She’s an elf from the Tingxiang area, on the other side of the sea.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “I just said that I’m an orthodox Dong Huang person. It’s just that I left my hometown to train in my early years and only returned recently. Don’t worry, Instructor Guo. We’re not bad people. We just want to ask, what year is the Wu calendar now?”
“The sixth year,” Instructor Guo said after a moment of silence.
“The sixth year? Is Dong Huang still recruiting soldiers? We’re actually here for this.”
“You’re here to participate in the national conscription??” Guo Yan had lived for most of his life and had never seen such a strange combination. Tingxiang? Sprite? He didn’t know what that was, but he finally understood that the young master in front of him might be an expert.
“You didn’t come back from the sea on the snow mountain, right?” Instructor Guo Yan was shocked.
Shi Yu smiled.
“This” Guo Yan was shocked. That snow mountain was a dangerous place that even the generals of the Dong Huang Army couldn’t conquer. This young man could actually travel through it, and he returned from the sea further away?
As for the national recruitment Shi Yu mentioned
After the Dong Huang Dynasty was established, Emperor Wu immediately promoted his subordinates who followed him into battle, such as the general of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe.
However, during the totem war, Emperor Wu’s group was actually only a portion of the factions that resisted the totems. Apart from that, there were also many human factions.
At that time, after terminating most of the totems and snatching back the Ancient Capital to establish the country, the first thing Emperor Wu did was to recruit the human factions and civilian organizations elsewhere in the Dong Huang Continent.
Then, after Dong Huang completely stabilized, Emperor Wu issued a new policy, National Conscription!!
Emperor Wu knew that there were still many capable people hidden everywhere in the east. They weren’t used to it and didn’t like to join the officials. They were used to being idle, but at the moment, they had to fight for these people. Emperor Wu understood that there would definitely be a battle between Dong Huang and the Yun clan in the future.
If these hidden experts were only active in the common people, it would be too much of a pity and a waste. Apart from that, there were also some descendants of large families and experts from local factions They were all targets worth roping in. Therefore, this time, Emperor Wu promised to heavily benefit and recruit soldiers in the country.
As long as one was strong enough, it was not a problem to immediately be promoted to general. If one’s strength was outstanding, they would be rewarded with Legendary resources.
It could be said that this national conscription was the most sensational event in Dong Huang recently.
Countless experts were indeed attracted by the generous conditions of Dong Huang’s national recruitment. There were even hidden legends who appeared.
If Shi Yu was here for this, Instructor Guo would understand What understanding? How could he transmigrate the snow mountain and sea at such a young age!!
“Sort of,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
The 6th year of Dong Huang should be the year when Emperor Wu Dynasty and Yun An had just come into contact.
During this period, although Emperor Wu could already kill demigods and reach the legendary level, his battle power had yet to reach the peak. It seemed that he couldn’t fuse nine pets yet, and the Iron-eating Beast had yet to be cultivated to its strongest state.
It would probably be difficult for the current Emperor Wu to suppress Yun An.
The confrontation between Dong Huang and the Yun An faction lasted for more than ten years before the strongest experts of both parties finally perished together.
It could be said that there was still a period of time before Emperor Wu could grow to the peak.
It had actually come to this period
The most representative historical event of this period was that the newly established Emperor Wu Dynasty had already started a small-scale conflict with the Yun clan. Emperor Wu might have also met Yun An.
Emperor Wu, who knew the threat of the Yun clan, started the first national recruitment for the future of Dong Huang!
It was easy to tell which stage it was. Shi Yu smiled and thought for a moment. He planned to take the initiative to expose his legend strength through participating in the world’s recruitment and attract Emperor Wu to come out and see him. From there, he would obtain the resources of this era and directly barge into the palace to meet Emperor Wu. It was a little rude. He was afraid that he would scare Emperor Wu.
“If you” At this moment, although Guo Yan was still puzzled, seeing that Shi Yu was an expert who wanted to participate in the national recruitment, he planned to tell Shi Yu the few recruitment venues of Dong Huang. The level of Snow City was not high enough and they were not qualified to recruit.
This was because the weakest recruitment was at least at the master level. At the moment, there were only ten recruitment sites in the country.
Among them the nearest place Could it be
“Eh, where is he?” Instructor Guo Yan looked at the empty ancient tree in front of him and was stunned.
Four symbols were drawn on the snow pile on the ground.
3Q, 88. (Thank you, Bye Bye.)
The middle-aged man: “?”
….
Soon after.
Wu Ling City.
This city was Emperor Wu’s hometown.
It was currently the most famous city apart from the Ancient Capital.
At the same time, it was also one of the places for recruitment in Dong Huang.
After making the decision, Shi Yu directly came over. He planned to participate in the national recruitment here to attract Emperor Wu. The reason was simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1064 - 1064 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (4)
chapters.content:
1064 Transmigrating to the Emperor Wu Era (4)
He knew that Wu Ling City was the cultivation base of Dong Huang’s Iron-eating Beast Corps!!
Thank you readers!
Countless iron-eating beast evolution materials were all stored here.
There was even the ruins of the Iron-eating Beast Trial established by Senior Ji Mengzhu, Senior Chong Xuan, and the others. Eleven’s top-notch metals were all taken from this ruin.
At this time, the metals known as top-notch evolution materials should still be in the trial ruins, right?
Wu Ling City, Iron-eating Beast Corps training ruins.
This place was located in the center of Wu Ling City. Recently, it was the most lively place in Wu Ling City.
The characteristics of the major recruitment venues in Dong Huang were all different. For example, the recruitment benefits in Wu Ling City had something that attracted the Beast Tamers in the country.
Any Beast Tamer above the Master level had a chance to join the Iron-eating Beast Corps and obtain the Iron-eating Beast cub.
Iron-eating Beast!
This era was not the future. The trump card of the number one general under Emperor Wu was the Iron-eating Beast. Emperor Wu’s strongest army was the Iron-eating Beast Army.
There were even rumors that Emperor Wu had also contracted an Iron-eating Beast.
Now that the Iron-eating Beasts were monopolized by Emperor Wu Dynasty, who didn’t want a cute Iron-eating Beast with extraordinary potential?
Therefore, the number of people who came to Wu Ling City to participate in the recruitment was only more than those few famous big cities in history. This was also a way for Emperor Wu to attract capable people from the common people.
Relying on top-notch pets.
Now, even Shi Yu was attracted over. However, he was attracted by the iron-eating beast’s evolution materials.
After unveiling a recruitment notice that was plastered all over the city, Shi Yu came to the recruitment venue on the notice, a black and white pavilion outside the Wu Ling Ruins.
Outside the pavilion door, two Beast Tamer soldiers in armor stood guard on both sides. Although there were many people who had come to Wu Ling City to participate in the recruitment, it was impossible for there to be a crowd when the threshold was at the master level. Shi Yu had come at the right time. Outside the pavilion cabinet, they looked very free at the moment.
At this moment, Shi Yu slowly walked towards the pavilion. The gazes of the two soldiers also landed on Shi Yu. However, at this moment, a beautiful figure walked out of the pavilion.
She was about 20 years old. She was wearing a white Han suit and looked beautiful. Not to mention in this ancient era without makeup skills, even in the modern era where makeup and plastic surgery were applied, the other party still had an outstanding aura and was a gorgeous beauty.
“Ji Mengzhu?” Shi Yu was immediately stunned when he saw this face that was almost 99% similar to Senior Panda Lin Xiuzhu.
He didn’t expect to encounter someone familiar so quickly
At this moment, Ji Mengzhu, who had just come out, also saw Shi Yu, a stranger walking towards the building.
“Excuse me, is this the location of the national recruitment?” Shi Yu smiled and looked at her.
“That’s right. You’re here to participate in the recruitment?” Ji Mengzhu’s cold and straightforward voice sounded. She looked at Shi Yu, who looked much younger than her, and was surprised.
In the entire country, the lowest threshold for recruitment was fifth-grade.
Was this person’s level enough?
However, at this age, even if it was one or two levels lower, it was considered to have pretty good talent potential. He could completely join the army through other channels.
Or could it be that Shi Yu was a disciple of a hidden family and had really reached the master level?
“Where are you from, what’s your level? How old are you?” Ji Mengzhu asked one by one.
Shi Yu said, “I’m from Snow City, but I’ve been out training since I was young. The four seas are my home. This year, I’m 21 years old. As for my level…”
Shi Yu smiled. “Three, legend.”
“I wonder what resources I can obtain.”
Legend.
He had cultivated two Legends!
“Legend…”
BOOM!
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Ji Mengzhu was clearly stunned. The two soldiers standing guard were also stunned. They looked at Shi Yu in confusion. Wait, wait?!
What did this guy just say?
21 years old, Legendary?
What a joke. 21 years old, Legend?! Not to mention 21 years old, even if there was no age restriction, the Legend level of Dong Huang was rare!

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 1065 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (1)
chapters.content:
1065 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (1)
21 years old, legend level.
Thank you readers!
Ji Mengzhu immediately denied it in her heart and felt that it was impossible.
When she was 21 years old, she had only just entered level six.
After all, her father was a top legend only a step away from the Legendary Beast Tamer, the second expert of Dong Huang.
Legendary Beast Tamer Emperor Wu was equivalent to her elder.
Be it cultivation resources or cultivation resources, Ji Mengzhu had never lacked them.
But even so, it would be a few years later before she became a legend.
The level of a Beast Tamer was very resource-consuming, and birth played a decisive role.
At this speed, in the entire Dong Huang, even if it wasn’t one of the best, it could definitely be ranked in the top five.
However, it would be problematic if Ji Mengzhu believed a stranger who directly appeared in front of her and said that he was 21 years old at the Legendary level.
“Are you serious?”
She observed Shi Yu in front of her seriously again!
The dark red archeological battle suit was very special in Ji Mengzhu’s opinion. For a moment, she couldn’t determine where Shi Yu came from.
“You said you’re at the Legend level?”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “You should be able to prove it with this, right?”
As soon as he finished speaking, with a hum, Gust suddenly rose as he activated the Beast Taming Space.
The strong wind pressure made the two guards cover their faces.
Countless black light spots flickered under Shi Yu’s feet.
The light spots quickly connected into a trajectory, forming a huge circular array that looked like a star map on the ground.
Black summoning array, Legend level!
Standing on the array, Shi Yu looked at Ji Mengzhu calmly and saw her expression change drastically!
“This…” Seeing this, Ji Mengzhu lost her composure.
For a moment, they couldn’t believe their eyes.
It was really at the legend level?
At the moment, there were only 30 Legend experts in the Dong Huang Dynasty.
Since the National Conscription, only one hidden legend expert had appeared, and they were already old.
Shi Yu was the second legend since the conscription!
Moreover, it was incomparably young, ridiculously young. Even Emperor Wu had definitely not reached the legend level at this age.
Ji Mengzhu looked at Shi Yu’s spatial summoning array.
Boom.
In the next moment, she felt that her Spirit seemed to have fallen into an abyss. A terrifying pressure came from the summoning array.
Although Shi Yu didn’t summon his pet, the pressure inside had already shocked Ji Mengzhu
The person in front of him was definitely a genuine legend. Moreover, the strength of the pet was probably not weak either, reaching the overlord level.
It wasn’t like a Beast Tamer that had reached level seven but with a pet that was only a monarch-level. That would be a quasi legend.
“It’s really a legend…” Under the shocked expressions of the two guards, Shi Yu dispersed the summoning array and looked at Ji Mengzhu with a smile.” Is this alright? ”
“It’s done.” Ji Mengzhu took a deep breath and said, “Sir, follow me directly.”
“Let’s talk inside.”
“Alright.”
Soon, Shi Yu followed Ji Mengzhu into the black and white pavilion. Ji Mengzhu received him with top-notch spiritual tea and sat with Shi Yu.
She said, “I forgot to introduce myself. I’m the chief trainer of the Iron-eating Beast Corps under Emperor Wu, Ji Mengzhu.”
“Are you really here to participate in the national conscription?”
“I’ve never heard of such a person in Snow City.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s real.”
“My name is Shi Yu. I was born in Snow City, but I left Dong Huang to train overseas since I was young. I only returned recently.”
Shi Yu directly reported his real name, not afraid of affecting anything.
After all, according to the EXP of transmigrating many times, their transmigration would directly give birth to a new parallel space with a completely different historical direction. It wouldn’t affect the established history in the future.
After knowing this, Shi Yu actually wanted to know what kind of existence he was.
Because this wasn’t the first time he had transmigrated.
The first time he transmigrated was from Earth to Blue Planet.
Would he transmigrate to Blue Planet in every parallel universe, or would he transmigrate to that space-time?
Was there a transmigrator, Shi Yu, in other parallel spaces? If not, then the space-time with archeologist Shi Yu was also the only special universe in history?
“…You’re from Dong Huang??” Ji Mengzhu was even more shocked.
“Where have you been?”
She had never left Dong Huang since she was young and couldn’t help but show a curious expression.
“I’ve been to many places. The place I’ve stayed the longest is the Tingxiang area,” Shi Yu said nonsense.
“Tingxiang, where’s that?” Ji Mengzhu asked. “Is it different from our Dong Huang?”
Shi Yu said, “There are naturally many different points in the northwest of Dong Huang. There are also Beast Tamers there. However, the abilities of transcendent creatures are more commonly called magic. Apart from that, there are also many species different from Dong Huang.”
“For example, Dwarfs, Giants, Elves…”
Shi Yu chuckled. Just as he was about to knock on his pocket, he realized that Qi seemed to have fallen asleep.
Although it consumed the power of the Space-time Dragon Vein this time, it was clearly quite tired.
“Then why do you want to join the Dong Huang Army after returning this time?” Ji Mengzhu asked.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “There are too many reasons. Because I have some grudges with the Yun Race. My personal strength isn’t enough to resist the Yun Race. In addition, I’m from Dong Huang, so it shouldn’t be a problem for me to seek allies, right?”
“In addition, His Majesty Emperor Wu has ended the totem battle in the east. At the moment, Dong Huang has occupied the area with the richest resources and has also plundered the treasure vaults of countless totem countries. The resources are huge and numerous. If I want to take another step forward, I naturally have to cozy up to him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - 1066 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (2)
chapters.content:
1066 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (2)
“Moreover… I mainly want to see the legendary Beast Tamer, His Majesty Emperor Wu.”
Thank you readers!
“I wonder, Miss Ji, can you introduce me?”
Ji Mengzhu’s expression turned cold. She didn’t expect Shi Yu to know about the Yun clan. Moreover, this person spoke strangely.
Cozying up to him?
How could he say that? It felt very frivolous!
Forget it… Geniuses were always strange and that was very normal. Perhaps it was the culture of other areas.
“I understand.” Ji Mengzhu nodded and said, “However, you’re really very powerful. You’ve reached the Legendary level at this age… I think His Majesty Emperor Wu will be very happy. He’ll definitely come to see you personally.”
The last legend came to participate in the national recruitment, and Emperor Wu took it very seriously. He personally came to the other party’s place and chatted all night.
“As for you wanting to join the Dong Huang Army… If you’re below the legend level, I can make a decision. However, you’re a legend. I’m afraid you need His Majesty Emperor Wu to personally assess you.”
“If I can obtain the recognition of Emperor Wu, even you can become a general and lead an army, it’s not impossible.”
“I’ll send someone to contact His Majesty Emperor Wu. As for you, Sir Shi Yu, why don’t you rest in Wu Ling City first?” Ji Mengzhu said with a smile.
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Alright.”
“I actually have another question,” Ji Mengzhu said. “You… why don’t you go to Imperial City directly?”
“That should be able to see Sir Emperor Wu faster, right?”
Imperial City was the Ancient Capital of the future, the core capital of the Dong Huang Dynasty. Now, there was still the Dragon Vein of Luck of the Dong Huang Continent here. It had always been a place to fight for the throne. It was only in the modern era that the Dragon Vein of Luck dried up, so Dong Huang moved the capital.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Wu Ling City is relatively close to me. Also… if I want to be a general, I’m the most interested in the Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
Ji Mengzhu smiled and said, “Are you also interested in iron-eating beasts?”
“To be precise, I’m interested in the evolution materials of the Iron-eating Beast. When I join the Dong Huang Army, I should be able to choose whatever I want.” Shi Yu smiled. “My Iron-eating Beast happens to be lacking a few evolution materials.”
“Uh.” Ji Mengzhu couldn’t react for a moment.
Then, her beautiful eyes widened. “You also contracted an Iron-eating Beast?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
She said, “I see. No wonder you came to Wu Ling City.”
“Interesting, Shi Yu, right? Before His Majesty Emperor Wu arrives, are you interested in fighting me in a simple battle first?”
“It looks like you’re not completely ignorant about Dong Huang at all. Then you should know who I am, right?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Of course I know.”
“The daughter of the strongest general under Emperor Wu, the legend Beast Tamer Ji Mengzhu. I’ve heard so much about you.”
Ji Mengzhu smiled and said, “In that case, an Iron-eating Beast battle? Let me see your Iron-eating Beast.”
“After the battle, His Majesty Emperor Wu should have received the news.”
Out of curiosity about Shi Yu, she wanted to learn from him first.
“Sure, but my Iron-eating Beast is a little ridiculously strong. Do you really want to fight me…” Shi Yu said seriously.
“You mean the overlord level? This is a small problem. We can fight in the mystic realm,” Ji Mengzhu said.
She didn’t care about Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast level because she had cultivated Iron-eating Beasts of all levels and attributes.
She wanted to test Shi Yu’s strength for Emperor Wu first.
“Or do you think I’m not your match?” Ji Mengzhu smiled and said, “If you can defeat me and really join the Dong Huang Army later, I’ll cover all the evolution materials of your Iron-eating Beast. How about that?”
Shi Yu was stunned and shook his head helplessly. “Forget it, since Miss Ji says so… Let’s fight and see.”
….
The ruins of Emperor Wu in the future, the current Iron-eating Beast Corps’ training mystic realm.
In the mystic realm, many Iron-eating Beast cubs and Iron-eating Beast Corps recruits were undergoing special training.
They were only fresh blood. At this stage, the Iron-eating Beast Corps that could be thrown into battle were all guarding the border.
After Ji Mengzhu sent someone to inform Emperor Wu, she brought Shi Yu to the training mystic realm.
Just as Shi Yu entered, his heart skipped a beat. He sensed a totem-level life fluctuation that existed in the mystic realm.
[Zhong Xuan? No, not Zhong Xuan.]
Shi Yu originally thought that the big turtle, Zhong Xuan, was not beside Emperor Wu, but here. However, soon, he sensed that it didn’t look like Zhong Xuan, but another totem.
Emperor Wu’s hometown… was indeed guarded by totem-level life forms.
Shi Yu sighed.
At the same time.
In the depths of the mystic realm space, as Shi Yu and Ji Mengzhu entered the mystic realm, a huge Iron-eating Beast sitting on the ground and eating metal suddenly turned around.
It spied on the entire mystic realm.
“Roar??” It revealed a puzzled expression when it saw Ji Mengzhu bring an unfamiliar and handsome young man into the mystic realm.
It was the guardian of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe, the Iron-eating Beast God.
In this era, it was the first totem-level Iron-eating Beast.
Ji Mengzhu’s father’s trump card Iron-eating Beast was only its descendant.
Although Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast had surpassed its master, it was only its junior.
As such a guardian, its status in the Iron-eating Beast Tribe was naturally very high in the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
After relying on Emperor Wu Dynasty, which provided food and accommodation, its status in Dong Huang was naturally very high. It was the guardian of the country.
At the same time, it had watched Ji Mengzhu grow up.
Seeing Ji Mengzhu pull an unfamiliar man with terrifying strength into the mystic realm, the Iron-eating Beast’s eyes turned cold and gradually became sharp.

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - 1067 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (3)
chapters.content:
1067 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (3)
Life forms with too low a level might not be able to tell, but it could clearly sense that the man who followed Ji Mengzhu in was incomparably terrifying. His body contained shocking power, and he was not inferior to Emperor Wu.
“Who is this? Why is he like a humanoid ferocious beast?”
As he observed them, the Iron-eating Beast God called Ji Mengzhu’s mother.
“Ji Nai, your daughter brought an unfamiliar man into the mystic realm. The other party is so strange. Do you know him?”
In an office building in the Iron-eating Beast Training Mystic Realm, Ji Mengzhu’s mother, Ji Nai, was handling the needs documents of the Iron-eating Beast Corps when the Iron-eating Beast God’s voice suddenly appeared in her ear.
“Mengzhu?” The beautiful woman put down the brush in her hand and looked at the Void. “Ancestor, what happened?”
“Eh?? So they want to fight.” The Iron-eating Beast God’s surprised voice sounded.
“Forget it, teleport me over. I happened to have something to talk to Mengzhu about and asked her to get some documents. In the end, they haven’t been sent over yet.” Ji Nai revealed a helpless expression.
After bringing Shi Yu into the mystic realm, Ji Mengzhu brought him straight to the Duel Arena.
Shi Yu was actually not unfamiliar with this place. After all, in the modern era, he had been trapped here for a few months.
At that moment, there was no one in the Duel Arena. After Ji Mengzhu walked to the side, she looked at Shi Yu and said, “This is the place. It’s enough to withstand an overlord-level battle. Are you ready?”
Shi Yu said, “I can do it anytime.”
When the two of them faced each other in the Duel Arena, Ji Mengzhu’s mother was also teleported nearby by the Iron-eating Beast ancestor. Obviously, this totem-level Iron-eating Beast also had the authority to manage a portion of the ruins.
“This…”
“This…”
At this moment, be it the beautiful woman in a black Han suit who had just arrived or the Iron-eating Beast ancestor who was secretly observing the situation of the Duel Arena, they were all stunned.
That was because Ji Mengzhu and Shi Yu had already started to summon pets.
Two huge black summoning arrays appeared in front of them!!
Ji Nai naturally knew Ji Mengzhu’s level, but who was this young man who was about to fight Ji Mengzhu??
She looked at Shi Yu’s young face and could clearly determine that Shi Yu was definitely younger than Ji Mengzhu, but he was actually also at the Legend level?
Just as the Iron-eating Beast ancestor had said, who was this young man Ji Mengzhu brought back? Where did he come from? Did Dong Huang have such a young talent?
“Look!” the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said. Then, their expressions became even more serious.
“Roar!!!” On Ji Mengzhu’s side, she summoned an overlord-level Iron-eating Beast.
It was an Iron-eating Beast in pure white armor. To be precise, it was a royal Nine Li Battle Beast.
It had clearly undergone many evolutions.
Moreover, like Shi Yu’s Eleven, because it was a royal, it obtained a second Stats after evolution.
If Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast in black and silver armor had a new lightning attribute in its second Stats, it would be a metal and lightning dual-element Iron-eating Beast.
Then this one…
It was a metal and spatial Iron-eating Beast.
Shi Yu could clearly sense that when this Iron-eating Beast appeared, the surrounding space rippled. This situation was similar to when he faced the overlord-level Void Mantis.
“A royal Iron-eating Beast cultivated in the direction of the spatial element?” Shi Yu said. “But from the looks of it, it hasn’t evolved through the meteorite fragment.”
At this stage, Ji Mengzhu was still in the high-speed growth stage. Her strength had yet to reach the peak. The energy value of this Iron-eating Beast was only 69 million, on the same level as Little Ji and the others, or even lower.
However, it was not bad. At least, it was stronger than a legend like legend Hua.
“An expert.” Ji Mengzhu was surprised. This Shi Yu actually knew so much information about iron-eating beasts.
No wonder… No wonder Shi Yu wanted to deal with the Yun Race.
Perhaps he had also targeted the meteorite fragment.
Their Iron-eating Beast Tribe had been passed down to 3,000 years ago. From that time, they knew that the meteorite fragment could strengthen Iron-eating Beasts.
Therefore, when Yun An revived and the Yun clan returned, Madam Ji immediately explained the value of Yun An to Emperor Wu.
Apart from the fact that Yun An was a huge threat, Yun An was also a material comparable to a divine-level resource that could allow the Iron-eating Beast to evolve transcendent. This was also why Dong Huang attached special importance to the Yun Race.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast also appeared on the summoning array.
Ji Mengzhu was very surprised that Shi Yu knew so much about the Iron-eating Beast. Therefore, she subconsciously judged that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast was definitely not weak.
She just didn’t know how far it had been cultivated.
In the next moment, Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast, Eleven, slowly appeared.
Rip.
Accompanied by a black and white electric arc, a one-meter-tall small Iron-eating Beast stood on the summoning array with its arms crossed, looking at the giant panda opposite with a burning gaze.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven shouted. Let’s go!
“Roar!!!” Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast’s expression turned cold. It also roared, and huge sweat flowed down its forehead.
Although Eleven maintained a restrained state, Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast instantly panicked after looking at each other. It had an indescribable feeling.
“Lightning… Moreover, black and white lightning… Could that black lightning be…” At this moment, Ji Mengzhu’s expression immediately changed when she saw the black lightning lingering around Eleven.
She thought of a possibility.
She looked at the smiling Shi Yu opposite her in disbelief.
Although Eleven was still in its restrained form, the feeling this Iron-eating Beast gave them was similar to their father’s Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had already evolved again. They both had a special pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 1068 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (4)
chapters.content:
1068 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (4)
Could it be that Shi Yu and the others had already evolved through the meteorite fragment? This was also why Shi Yu said that he had a grudge with the Yun Race!
Where did he get the meteorite fragment!
“That Iron-eating Beast…” As Ji Mengzhu’s mother, Ji Nai was even more expert than Ji Mengzhu in the cultivation of Iron-eating Beasts. When she saw Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast with a special aura, her gaze turned slightly serious.
She couldn’t see through it, but it felt incomparably powerful. What was with this strange feeling?
“That little guy…” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor also looked at Eleven with a serious expression. Under its deep perception, it was extremely incredulous and shocked. It actually felt that its bloodline was trembling in front of it.
How was this possible?
“You attack first?” Shi Yu said.
“…” Ji Mengzhu’s gaze was serious. She felt that she had underestimated the other party.
Although she didn’t know why, the other party’s cultivation level of the Iron-eating Beast was very likely above hers.
At this moment, Eleven indeed had this pressure.
[Race]: Chaos Panda
[Race Skill]:
“Super”: Inner Power (Perfect+47), Space Quake (Perfect+47), Impregnable (Perfect+47), Demon God Body (Perfect+47), Leaving Gold Battle Body (Perfect+47), Thunder God Armor (Perfect+47), Nine Li Army (Perfect+47), Indestructible Golden Body (Perfect+47)
“Quasi God-level”: Yin Yang Millstone (Initiate)
[Teaching Skill]
“Super”: Superalloy (transcendent)
At the moment, Eleven was the pet with the most physique skills in Shi Yu’s team.
The previous Demon God Body, the subsequent fusion of the Leaving Gold Battle Body, and the new fusion of the Thunder God Armor and the Indestructible Golden Body made it look like a physique monster.
Buggy’s Green Dragon Indestructible Body might be able to suppress Eleven’s single physique skill, but it couldn’t suppress Eleven, who had four physiques combined.
Those were the God of War, the God of Martial Arts, and the God of Battle!
Even without using Stats energy, Eleven could still fight totems with its body alone.
This physical pressure condensed into dark clouds that lingered on Ji Mengzhu’s head, making her shout the word “Space Quake” in an unknown mood.
“Roar!!!”
Space Quake!!!
Boom!!!
The spatial Iron-eating Beast directly threw a punch, and the move hit the air. At this moment, as expected, a huge sound that could destroy the world sounded.
In the huge vibration sound, with a crack, space directly shattered. Like a broken mirror, white lightning-like cracks kept appearing!!
In the blink of an eye, an attack that contained terrifying power shattered everything, sweeping with incomparable vibration power and devouring Eleven.
Ji Mengzhu could be said to be very serious about this attack. In the training mystic realm, many soldiers and Iron-eating Beasts subconsciously looked up in shock, but at the Duel venue, Eleven… didn’t even have the intention to dodge in the face of this terrifying spatial vibration!
Boom!!!
The huge spatial shock wave directly Devoured Eleven, stunning Ji Mengzhu, the spatial Iron-eating Beast, the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor, and Ji Nai. However, in the next moment, what stunned them even more was that these spatial shock waves attacked Eleven’s body like iron. However, Eleven was like divine iron that had been tempered to the extreme. Under the impact, not a trace appeared on its body!!
In the spatial vibration storm, its expression was natural. One of its arms fell and the other waved.
Buzz!!!
A huge spatial shock wave was directly sent flying into the sky by it. The huge vibration power rushed into the sky and instantly tore open a hundred-meter-long spatial crack in the sky!!
Under the crack, Eleven walked towards the spatial Iron-eating Beast as if nothing had happened.
“Impossible!!!” At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, who was observing in the dark, was shocked. “Impossible.”
Even if it wanted to rely on its physical strength to easily resolve this move without using moves, it couldn’t be so easy.
“This…” After this attack, Ji Mengzhu widened her eyes in shock, somewhat unable to understand.
In the next moment, the expression of the spatial Iron-eating Beast changed drastically.
“Roar, roar, roar!!!!!”
Looking at the little Iron-eating Beast walking over, it smashed its fists out in the air, and the spatial shock wave swallowed Eleven like a tsunami.
However, Eleven still resisted with its physical strength!!
To be precise, not all of it. This was because its physique was already a Skill. Under the Indestructible Golden Body, the damage caused was all converted into life and Resistance!
It gave Eleven the confidence to resist the big move.
“Impossible!” In the chaotic space, Ji Mengzhu found it difficult to understand when she saw that her pet’s attack couldn’t break through the defense at all.
In the blink of an eye, Eleven had already walked in front of his opponent. At this moment, Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast was already panting from exhaustion and covered in sweat.
The attack just now could even flatten a mountain.
At this moment, the venue was indeed in a mess, but the opponent in front of him… was still unscathed!
The white Iron-eating Beast’s pupils constricted. It was difficult to accept!
Bang!!!
“Heh.” In front of it, Eleven took the Space Quake punch head-on and smiled.
“It’s our turn.” Shi Yu also smiled.
Rip!
In the next moment, a strong white electric arc appeared on Eleven’s entire arm and wrapped around it again and again, emitting a violent sound and shooting out dazzling lightning, like a lightning vambrace!

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 1069 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (5)
chapters.content:
1069 Battle of the Iron-eating Beasts (5)
Lightning wrapped around Eleven’s arm. Just as it was about to smash the Palm at its opponent, to Shi Yu and the others’ surprise, the white Iron-eating Beast teleported into the distance in panic.
It directly lost its target.
“Huh? (Instant Transmission?)” Eleven was surprised.
Shi Yu nodded. After all, it was an Iron-eating Beast that was evolving in the direction of the spatial element.
Wouldn’t it be a huge loss if he couldn’t master Instant Transmission?
But it was useless to know Instant Transmission.
“Thunder God Armor,” Shi Yu said.
Zizizizizizizi!!!
The order was given.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven roared, and black and white lightning seemed to shoot out of its mouth and eyes.
In an instant, the electric current on his arm flowed throughout his body!!
Rip!!
Surrounded by electric currents, Eleven’s black and white hair shone like a mini Chaos Panda form.
The hair looked fluffy, soft, and had a clear texture. He couldn’t help but want to pet it!
“Not good!!” Although it looked cute, Ji Mengzhu and the white Iron-eating Beast felt an even more dangerous aura!
Bang!!
At the same time that the ground was shattered by the lightning, Eleven shot out like a white blazing beam of light. Its figure had already appeared in front of its opponent, and during this period, countless gravel wrapped in electricity floated in the air!
Along the way, space was penetrated. Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast roared and teleported into the distance again.
But white light followed closely!!!
Even under Ji Mengzhu’s temporary full-strength strengthening, the Iron-eating Beast only felt a light flash in front of its eyes. Then, it felt that the entire armor seemed to be about to be defeated. With a slight pain, it was directly sent flying. Its brain rumbled, and lightning shot out in front of its eyes.
Its teleportation reaction couldn’t keep up with the other party’s speed at all!
Dust surged!
Extreme lightning speed!!!
“Wuu!!!” After gently sending the enemy flying, Eleven stopped and bowed slightly~
The white Iron-eating Beast was still flying backward, wrapped in lightning. It was extremely shocked.
“Space…” Ji Mengzhu was shocked and immediately turned around. She couldn’t believe it. She couldn’t believe that she was directly crushed like this. At the same time, she suddenly recalled what Shi Yu had said at the start.
His Iron-eating Beast was a little ridiculously strong…
Initially, Ji Mengzhu didn’t understand, but now…
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor and Ji Nai widened their eyes even more.
Even at this moment, after Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast was insta-killed, the gravel Eleven stepped on had just landed piece by piece. Every landing sound… hit their hearts.
“There’s something wrong with this kid!!” the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said. It looked at the little Iron-eating Beast in horror and even felt a little afraid.
“Who exactly is he!!!” Although Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast’s age cultivation level wasn’t very high, it still had the strength of a new top-notch overlord. How could it be so easy… Moreover, the other party didn’t use his Beast Taming Talent at all!
“Don’t worry, that attack just now controlled its strength and only sent it flying. It won’t even cause light injuries,” Shi Yu said. “I think there’s no need to continue fighting. Your Iron-eating Beast isn’t my Iron-eating Beast’s match.”
In the past half a year of bitter cultivation, as the proficiency of the super Skill increased, Eleven and the others’ control over their strength had improved a lot. They wouldn’t waste any extra physical strength at all. Most importantly, they wouldn’t accidentally destroy Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, as Shi Yu spoke, Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast indeed stood up quickly with a roar. It wasn’t injured much, but at this moment, its state was very unstable. It looked at the Iron-eating Beast opposite it in horror and felt that it was invincible. It had completely lost its Warpath.
When she arrived beside the Iron-eating Beast, Ji Mengzhu suddenly turned around. Her chest trembled. She looked at Shi Yu again in disbelief and said, “Who exactly are you? Why are you so strong?”
This Iron-eating Beast reminded her of her father’s Iron-eating Beast.
An invincible overlord that could fight totems!
However, their tribe was clearly the strongest race to nurture iron-eating beasts. Even Emperor Wu needed the cultivation EXP of their race.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Didn’t I say previously not to look at me like that… I’m really here to form an alliance.”
“Mengzhu.” At the same time, a beautiful woman in a black Han suit walked over step by step from afar. Shi Yu and the others had noticed her arrival just now, but they had been fighting previously and had no time to care.
“Mother.” When Ji Mengzhu saw Ji Nai holding the Iron-eating Beast, she immediately spoke with a complicated expression.
Shi Yu also observed Ji Mengzhu’s mother and felt a strange emotion. Ji Mengzhu’s mother was almost carved from the same mold as Ji Mengzhu. Her appearance was very similar. Compared to Senior Ji Mengzhu in the future, she was even more mature and elegant.
What was wrong with this clan? Why were they so similar?
“This is?” Ji Nai suppressed the confusion in her heart and asked Ji Mengzhu.
Ji Mengzhu was silent for a moment before looking at Shi Yu and saying, “Shi Yu, the legend Beast Tamer of Dong Huang who returned from the sea came this time to join the Dong Huang Army. Because he also contracted an Iron-eating Beast, I took the initiative to fight him.”
“I’ve already sent someone to inform His Majesty Emperor Wu… His Majesty Emperor Wu should arrive soon.”
“I see. Welcome. I’m Ji Mengzhu’s mother, Ji Nai.” When Ji Nai heard that, she immediately understood the cause and effect. However, she was more and more confused about Shi Yu. She was still puzzled about this young man’s background.
“Sorry to disturb you.” Shi Yu smiled and nodded.
“But as for His Majesty Emperor Wu…” Ji Nai looked at Ji Mengzhu and Shi Yu and said, “His Majesty Emperor Wu has been busy recently, so he might not be able to come over so quickly. Why don’t I find a place for Sir Shi Yu to stay in Wu Ling City first?”
Ji Nai felt that Shi Yu had a big secret, but perhaps only Emperor Wu could come into contact with him. Unfortunately, she knew that Emperor Wu was not in Dong Huang at the moment!
Before Ji Mengzhu’s father left, he had told her that Dong Huang would have a small-scale test against the Yun clan recently. Emperor Wu would also participate.
“Alright then.” Shi Yu was stunned before saying. However, at this moment, Shi Yu looked at Senior Ji Mengzhu. He kept feeling that the way she looked at him became more and more serious, as if she was very brooding over his loss.
Forget it, as long as he didn’t forget the evolution materials.
…
At the same time.
Yun Nation.
In an incomparably pitch-black dark space, the city-like totem king, Yun An, lay in the void, calmly absorbing the power of the meteor iron from outer space.
At this moment, spatial ripples flashed.
A black ape tore through space and headed here.
“Your Majesty Yun An, Dong Huang’s little tricks are increasing. They have already gathered an army at the border.”
Hu… Hu… Hu…
Yun An opened his eyes calmly and said, “Heh heh, Dong Huang, the army, not only that, but that human Beast Tamer who fought me once before also infiltrated our territory again.”
“He has the injuries I left on him. I won’t be wrong.”
“At the critical stage of increasing strength, I originally didn’t want to destroy this country so early, but from the looks of it, they can’t sit still anymore.”
“Your Majesty, what should we do next?” the black giant ape asked.
“Since the other party wants to test our foundation, let them test it.” Yun An’s eyes turned dark red as he laughed. “They actually dare to barge into my territory, so they have to pay the price.”
“That human named Wu Dong actually dared to leave his territory…”
“I’ve already sent a general to Dong Huang. Tell me, if that Wu Dong suddenly learns here that his hometown has been massacred into misery and suffering, I wonder what his expression will be.” Yun An smiled like thunder.
“And we’ll welcome the anger of these humans here.”
Dong Huang, Wu Ling City, the hometown of Emperor Wu. It wanted to teach this ungrateful human a lesson.
This place was different from the capital’s Imperial City. The defense power wouldn’t be too strict, but it was extraordinary for Emperor Wu. After destroying this place, Yun An felt that it was the best way to make Emperor Wu collapse.
Without Emperor Wu and the Iron-eating Beast General, there was only a pile of kittens and dogs left. How could they stop its Yun clan general with the strength of a top-notch totem?

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - 1070 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (1)
chapters.content:
1070 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (1)
Iron-eating Beast Training Mystic Realm.
Shi Yu was still standing quietly on the arena.
Little Eleven was not taken back. Instead, it gradually shrank and crawled back to Shi Yu’s shoulder.
The Iron-eating Beast just now clearly couldn’t satisfy it.
It didn’t lack powerful opponents. Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others were all very strong. However, it was more fun to fight against their own race.
It wanted to be the strongest Iron-eating Beast!
Modern Iron-eating Beasts were all too weak, but in ancient times, there were many targets Eleven could challenge.
Therefore, Eleven looked at the Void again.
From the moment Shi Yu and the others entered, they sensed that there was another totem in this ruins mystic realm.
And now, Eleven was almost certain that the totem was the Iron-eating Beast!
When the space was slightly shattered just now, the other party’s aura revealed more.
“Wuu ~” Eleven cried into the sky.
Shi Yu touched its head and smiled at Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai.
“I can wait for His Majesty Emperor Wu.”
“By the way, I’ve been very curious just now.”
“There should be a totem living in this mystic realm, right?” Shi Yu said. “Moreover, it’s also an Iron-eating Beast.”
In the alternate space, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor was stunned. Did it sense him?
“Huh?” Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai were also stunned. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to suddenly mention this.
At this moment, before they could answer, the Void was torn apart.
A two-meter-tall panda holding a green-gold bamboo and nibbling as it walked over casually.
It maintained the form of an ordinary Normal Iron-eating Beast and should be in a restrained state.
“Ancestor.” Seeing this sloppy giant panda, Ji Mengzhu called out.
“Wuu,” the giant panda replied as it looked at Shi Yu.
“You can sense my existence?” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor narrowed its eyes and also looked at Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
“Does it have a special Beast Taming Talent?”
It was indeed not simple.
As a part of the authority of this ruin, it was like a god in this ruin.
In this situation, Shi Yu and the others could actually discover their existence and determine their race.
“Sort of.”
“My main job is actually an archeologist. I have the talent to listen to history and often explore ruins mystic realms. I can roughly understand the situation of the ruins mystic realm space with a glance.” Shi Yu smiled.
In fact, it was all thanks to the three divine-level resources, his physical control talent, and the feedback of Ling and the others that Shi Yu’s perception ability was comparable to the totem level.
“Archeologist??” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor was stunned.
“Tomb raider?”
What tomb raider! Beside him, Ji Mengzhu was speechless.
However… listening to history… that special branch talent of the telepathy talent?
Ji Mengzhu looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
As one of the best second-generation heirs of Dong Huang, she naturally had some understanding of this talent. She didn’t expect that the person who defeated her was actually a telepathy talent, not a battle-type talent…
Shi Yu smiled. “There are some subtle differences…”
“By the way, you shouldn’t be a contracted battle beast of Emperor Wu, right?”
“I heard that His Majesty Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast has already stepped into the totem level. I thought it was here, but from the looks of it, it doesn’t seem like it…” Shi Yu said.
He had heard Ji Mengzhu’s greeting just now.
Iron-eating Beast Ancestor.
So that was the case.
It should be the guardian of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe.
In the future, in Ji Mengzhu’s description, this guardian died in a Yun clan invasion battle at the early stages of Emperor Wu Dynasty, so its presence was not very high.
It looked like the other party was still alive at this time.
Wait a minute, why did he remember that the period when the Iron-eating Beast ancestor died in battle was this year?
“Ancestor isn’t the contracted target of His Majesty Emperor Wu. It’s the guardian of the Iron-eating Beast Corps and the Dong Huang Dynasty,” Ji Mengzhu said.
“Hmph, that kid, Emperor Wu.” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor cursed in its heart.
Back then, when Emperor Wu stepped into the legendary level, he lacked a ninth pet and took a fancy to the Iron-eating Beast.
Initially, as a totem level, it recommended itself. It thought that although it was a totem, it wouldn’t be a loss to follow a legendary Beast Tamer.
However, Emperor Wu didn’t fancy it! He found it old!
In the end, he had paid the wrong price.
At the mention of Emperor Wu, it was angry. Sigh, it was old… It had no potential…
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Sigh.” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor still stared at Shi Yu and Eleven.
“I saw the battle just now. You guys are very strong. You actually beat this girl up so easily,” the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said.
Ji Mengzhu: “?”
“Wuu!! (Ancestor, do you want to spar too!!)” Eleven greeted the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor.
Although it wasn’t Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, it seemed to be a super expert of the Iron-eating Beast race…
Although the restrained state looked like an ordinary totem level, with the powerful accompanying moves of the Iron-eating Beast race… it wasn’t impossible to erupt with top-notch totem battle power?
Iron-eating Beast Ancestor: “?”
It looked at the eager Eleven and fell silent.
Fight my ass!
At its age, it didn’t want to waste its energy in such an unnecessary battle.
Compared to Elemental, Undead, and Dragon life forms, even if the Iron-eating Beast reached the totem level, its lifespan was not very high.
In addition, many Skills injured the body, so the Iron-eating Beast ancestor immediately entered a retirement life after the totem battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 1071 Reporting the Yun Race for Feeding (2)
chapters.content:
1071 Reporting the Yun Race for Feeding (2)
Not every Iron-eating Beast had a ginseng baby as a kitchen ginseng and medical ginseng.
Obviously, with the strength Eleven had displayed just now, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor felt that it was not its match under normal circumstances.
“This space can’t withstand my power. There’s no need,” the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said.
“I’m very curious now. You, little guy, are ridiculously strong. Your talent potential is even above mine. Moreover, you seem to have taken the evolution path of our race,” it said. “How do you know the evolution method??”
“Moreover, the aura on its body just now was the aura of a Demon God, right?”
“I almost thought you were spies of the Yun Race, but thinking about it, Yun An shouldn’t be able to nurture a Beast Tamer like you. He can’t help but eat you.”
It asked the most important question that Ji Mengzhu had wanted to ask previously.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “As I said, I’m an archeologist. This little guy’s evolution method and evolution materials were all archeological from the ruins.”
“It’s indeed eaten the meteorite fragment.”
“As for the spies of the Yun Race… that’s even more impossible. How can a spy walk into a trap and deliberately expose himself?”
They were all from archeology!
Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai, and the others thought so too. However, they looked at Eleven. Its main body was actually really the Demon God Iron-eating Beast?
At the moment, only Ji Mengzhu’s father had the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.
The meteorite fragment came from the first battle between Emperor Wu and Yun An.
After obtaining the meteorite fragment, Ji Mengzhu’s father was the first to carry out an experiment and successfully evolved.
Unfortunately, there were no more meteorite fragments. Including Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, Dong Huang’s other Iron-eating Beasts had yet to complete the evolution of the Demon God.
Shi Yu… had actually completed it?
“Archeology, what the hell?” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor had a serious expression. It looked at Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai.
Tomb robbing was so strong?
Ji Nai said, “I didn’t expect Sir Shi Yu to have a historical talent… Ancestor, this Beast Taming Talent has a chance of awakening the dusty ruins mystic realm and prying into the secrets of the ancient times.”
“Back then, ‘Zhuge Yan’ in the army had this talent. Do you still remember him?”
“The origin of the iron-eating beast’s evolution can be traced back to a long time ago. The branches are complicated, and it’s not impossible to spread to various places. Three thousand years ago, Yun An was also defeated by the Eastern Race Alliance together, so it’s indeed possible for Shi Yu to obtain the meteorite fragment that was left outside.”
The Iron-eating Beast ancestor said, “Now that you mention it, I remember. It’s that… We were exploring the ruins when he insisted on hearing a sound. In the end, the ruins collapsed all of a sudden, and a sealed overlord ferocious beast ran out. Is that the one?!?!”
The Iron-eating Beast ancestor curled its lips and said, “Strange talent. Bring him out to stay later. Don’t leave him here. Don’t destroy my mystic realm.”
Shi Yu said, “Don’t worry, this mystic realm has just been established. It hasn’t contained strong traces of time. It’s not enough to be called a ruin. It won’t resonate with my talent…”
Just as Shi Yu finished speaking.
Boom!!!
The ruins trembled
Space cracks of various sizes appeared on the ruins.
The expressions of the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, and Ji Nai suddenly changed as they looked at Shi Yu.
What did he say?
Shi Yu: “?”
Eleven: Wu wu wu?
“Something happened outside.” Shi Yu’s expression suddenly changed.
What happened?
“There’s an invader.” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor quickly reacted.
“Roar!!!” It was burning with anger.
He quickly opened the ruins and Teleported all the lives inside.
The other party might be controlling the nearby space. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have caused the ruins to change.
In the outside world.
The wind and clouds changed.
The sky of Wu Ling City was already covered in dark clouds.
A thousand-meter-long pitch-black divine dragon circled in the sky, its golden eyes staring at the entire Wu Ling City.
“Roar…” Under its dragon roar, space was quickly sealed.
The entire Wu Ling City seemed to have been sealed in a huge spatial domain. Space changed and the Void trembled.
At this moment, a terrifying Demon God Dragon Might spread. Most of the Beast Tamers in Wu Ling City sensed the change and looked at the dark-element divine dragon in the sky in shock.
The weaker people’s bodies were pressed down, and his entire body trembled in extreme fear.
After the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Shi Yu, Ji Mengzhu, and the others came out, they also looked at the monster in the sky with serious expressions.
