“The strongest totem among the 12 generals of the Yun clan, the Black Space Divine Dragon,” Jinai said with a shocked expression.
“What’s it doing here? Does the Yun Race want to start a war directly?”
The Black Space Divine Dragon was the strongest totem modified by Yun An.
Although his predecessor was only at the overlord level, because after being modified, he had spatial, dragon, and dark elements and was supported by Yun An’s resources, after stepping into the totem level, his battle power was enough to be called a top-notch totem.
After seeing it, be it the Iron-eating Beast ancestor or Ji Mengzhu and her daughter, their expressions changed as they felt a life-and-death crisis.
“It’s real.”
“Not good, the other party doesn’t come with good intentions.”
“Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai, I’ll find an opportunity to break through space. You guys try your best to escape. I’ll deal with the other party.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 1072 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (3)
chapters.content:
1072 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (3)
Sensing the terrifying pressure of the Black Space Divine Dragon and noticing that the surrounding space had been sealed, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said to Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai with a serious gaze.
“Ancestor…” The expressions of Ji Mengzhu and the others changed. Clearly, they had also sensed the change in the Iron-eating Beast ancestor’s tone.
“Don’t worry, don’t forget, I have the divine crystal bestowed by Emperor Wu. If I’m lucky, I might be able to smash it into pieces!” the Iron-eating Beast ancestor said.
It felt that in a normal battle, it was definitely not a match for this Black Space Divine Dragon.
However, it relied on the transcendent Inner Power to enter the totem level.
As an important contribution to the founding of the country, the divine-level resources bestowed by Emperor Wu were stored in its source of physical strength.
With this, it could burn its life and erupt with the strongest edge to suppress the enemy.
“You want to sacrifice yourself?”
Shi Yu’s expression also changed slightly. He had heard of an incident where Wu Ling City was invaded by the Yun clan. In this incident, it was the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor who sacrificed himself and heavily injured the Black Space Divine Dragon that prevented Wu Ling City from being destroyed. He didn’t expect that he would coincidentally catch up.
“Don’t do anything stupid.”
Shi Yu also said.
“Roar!!!!!”
At this moment, absorbing the fear that filled the city, the Black Space Divine Dragon felt comfortable.
They weren’t in a hurry to attack.
After it descended, deterrence directly enveloped the entire city, making all creatures tremble incomparably. Fear flowed out.
The fear of humans was a very good resource for it to become stronger. Now that the space was sealed, no one could escape. As a spatial element, no one could keep it down. It had to play with this group of lambs well. Otherwise, it would be meaningless for it to take the initiative to volunteer this time.
Back then, it was Dong Huang who expelled it from its hometown. Now, it could finally take revenge.
“I’m a general under the King of the Yun Race, the Black Space Divine Dragon. I’m here to destroy this city!!” The Black Space Divine Dragon laughed with a violent gaze.
Boom!!
The Beast Tamers and ordinary people in the city looked at the Black Space Divine Dragon in the sky in horror. Unlike in the modern era, in this era where the war had just ended a few years ago, people had yet to walk out of the shadow of the totem battle.
At this moment, seeing the incomparably terrifying Black Space Divine Dragon directly descend with the faith of destroying the city, in Wu Ling City, the emotions of the Beast Tamers, regardless of their level, were extremely unstable.
“Totem level!”
“Your Majesty, save me!!!”
At this moment, ordinary people immediately cried and shouted helplessly for Emperor Wu, hoping that Emperor Wu would quickly deal with this guy.
Upon hearing these subtle voices, the Black Space Divine Dragon smiled even more happily and used words to stimulate these people’s fear emotions again.
“Scream, scream. Your Emperor Wu isn’t in Dong Huang at all now.”
“You will die, and so will he.”
“This city has already been sealed by me. Don’t try to escape, don’t try to contact the outside world. It’s useless. Only death awaits you.”
“Speaking of which, aren’t there legend Beast Tamers and guardians in this city? If no one comes out to stop me, I’m going to start a massacre.” The Black Space Divine Dragon laughed loudly and waited for the strongest expert in this city to appear.
He planned to kill him first to stimulate the fear of the thousands of creatures here to a greater extent.
After this battle, it would completely stabilize its top-notch totem battle power!
“What should we do?” At this moment, as the only two legend Beast Tamers in Wu Ling City, Ji Nai and Ji Mengzhu were already anxious.
They were the strongest experts in this city!
The others didn’t understand how strong this Black Space Divine Dragon was, but they knew very well.
Even if the entire city attacked together, they wouldn’t be a match for this Black Space Divine Dragon.
“Roar…” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor growled, flames burning in its eyes. It looked up at the Black Space Divine Dragon.
It knew that it couldn’t delay any longer. Only it could deal with this guy.
However…
“Kid, are you really not an enemy?” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor was not in a hurry to enter a battle state. Instead, it was worried about Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai. Just now, it trusted Shi Yu very much, but now, with the appearance of the Black Space Divine Dragon, it immediately didn’t believe Shi Yu anymore.
They suspected that he was cooperating with the Black Space Divine Dragon.
Apart from being obtained from archeology, the meteorite fragment could also be bestowed by Yun An.
It was very afraid that once it entered a battle state and faced the Black Space Divine Dragon, Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai would encounter misfortune first.
In its eyes, Ji Mengzhu and Ji Nai were much more important than all the lives in Wu Ling City and here.
Its priority protection target was these two.
At this moment, Ji Mengzhu and the others’ gazes suddenly landed on Shi Yu again as they cautiously took a step back.
Obviously, it also sensed that something was wrong.
Shi Yu and Eleven: ???
“How can I be…” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.” Have you ever seen such a handsome spy? ”
“Forget it, I can’t be bothered to explain to you. There’s no time either.”
Iron-eating Beast Ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai: ???
“The current situation is indeed a little dangerous. Leave this guy to me to settle,” Shi Yu said as he looked at the sky.
“Wu wu wu!!! (I’ll beat it up.)” Eleven asked to fight.
“No, it’s a spatial element. The changes are a little strange. Your skill isn’t very stable. After hitting, it will cause a huge aftermath. This is a city,” Shi Yu rejected.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven cried.
Iron-eating Beast Ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai: ???

chapters.title: Chapter 1073 - 1073 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (4)
chapters.content:
1073 Report the Yun Race for Feeding (4)
What were they talking about!!
For a moment, they couldn’t react.
In the next moment.
They saw that Shi Yu’s body began to become blurry and hot. Red Fire Silk slowly erupted and lingered around him.
Then, under the illumination of the flames, his hair quickly turned bright red. His eyes even turned into the mysterious Chi Tong’s burning eyes. His skin also became even fairer under the illumination of the fire spiritual aura!
Fusion Talent? No, Undead Possession!
Soon, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, and Ji Nai realized the changes in Shi Yu.
At the same time, what shocked them even more was that the aura on Shi Yu’s body suddenly became incomparably powerful, comparable to a totem.
“Don’t worry, someone of this level can only become nutrients for the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation.”
“Remember to report the Yun Race for feeding kills.”
The red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu slowly raised his arm and aimed his palm at the Black Space Divine Dragon in the sky.
“Huh??” At this moment, as Shi Yu’s aura erupted, the Black Space Divine Dragon suddenly looked over and immediately discovered the totem-level Iron-eating Beast here, as well as the mysterious Shi Yu.
It was just about to smile and celebrate that it had found the strongest expert in this city, but suddenly, it felt that something was wrong.
Everyone in the city also discovered that something was wrong as shocking sword cries sounded. They looked at the sky in shock.
At some point in time, four huge sword phantoms suddenly hung in the sky. Each of them was a thousand meters long and looked larger than the Black Space Divine Dragon.
One of them was silver-white, containing purple light that reflected the profundity of space. One of them had a curved and red sword body, and red light lingered around the entire sword body. One of them had darkness and blue-green death aura interweaving on the sword body, containing nirvanic death fluctuations. One of them had a sharp metal sword light that pierced through the sky, extremely dazzling.
The four Swords hung in the four directions, directly trapping the Black Space Divine Dragon in the center.
“What is it?” The Black Space Divine Dragon’s gaze trembled. Suddenly, its pupils constricted, and it had a bad feeling.
Its information didn’t record such a thing in Dong Huang.
“The skill to end your life.” A voice sounded. The Black Space Divine Dragon was shocked and looked in the direction of the voice. It saw that at some point in time, a woman in silver armor had appeared in front of it. She had a beautiful face and was peerlessly delicate. She had red hair and red eyes.
“Roar!!!” The Black Space Divine Dragon roared angrily.
Above, a shocking change occurred. The incomparable four shocking immortal swords also made the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, and Ji Nai look at Shi Yu, whose aura had completely changed, with shocked expressions.
“What’s this?”
At this moment, Shi Yu and Chi Tong had actually already fused into one and completed the fusion. At the same time, their minds were in the optimal state.
“You can understand it as the final profundity that Emperor Wu has always pursued.”
“The prototype of a divine skill.”
The Spirit and soul power in his body were vast. Shi Yu’s aura rose steadily, as if it was endless. A shocking sharpness shot out of his eyes
Buzz!!!
At this moment, it was as if the world had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power in the world were all suppressed.
The air buzzed and vibrated, and the Void was pierced. The sound of laws was like the cry of a sword, like a peerless divine sword about to be unsheathed and slaughter the world.
“Roar!!!” Before anyone could react, in the next moment, extremely terrifying mixed sword intent tore through the air from the four immortal swords and penetrated space. Just as the Black Space Divine Dragon was stunned, tens of thousands of miserable sword marks instantly appeared on the thousand-meter-long divine dragon’s body with light.
A huge life wave flowed out of the sword scar, making the Black Space Divine Dragon extremely frightened.
He actually felt that he had lost a hundred years of life in an instant.
The anger that erupted just now was instantly suppressed.
“Roar!!!” The shocking pain and consumption made the Black Space Divine Dragon’s pupils reveal a shocked expression. It was shocked and let out a wail that resounded through the world.
“Divine skill!!!”
“Who are you?” It shouted in pain and looked at the cold-eyed Sword Maiden in front of it in horror.
Its eyes were filled with fear.
What exactly was going on?
Wasn’t this the supreme divine power possessed by His Majesty Yun An? Why… who was it? Who was this undead!!
“Spare me…”
At this moment, the Black Space Divine Dragon, which was trapped by the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and was still majestic just now and wanted to destroy the city, was instantly scared out of its wits, stunning countless people in the city. However, this was only the beginning.
“Roar!!!” As it shouted for mercy, the Black Space Divine Dragon forcefully entered a concealed state, wanting to escape into the Void and escape the sword intent domain.
The space around it changed exquisitely. Countless alternate spaces folded and turned into shadows.
However, this was only useless.
The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation would definitely hit after the Skill locked onto it. With Chi Tong’s current strength after possessing Shi Yu, even if a demigod came, they would have to take it head-on. The sword formation could only be broken by four demigods!
Boom!!!
Facing the Black Space Divine Dragon that used spatial moves to escape,
The four sword projections hung in the sky like thunder rumbling. The sword light swayed and kept shrinking, flying towards Sword Maiden Chi Tong. At the same time, the four fused into one and landed in her hand. However, the huge sword formation formed by the sword intent and sword light didn’t disappear.
Boom!!
Space distorted.
The entire sky seemed to have turned into a world of swords. Countless sword shadows leaped, as if forming tens of thousands of divine swords that hung in the sky, causing the sword fluctuations here to shake the sky and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 - 1074 Reporting the Yun Race for Giving Their Heads (5)
chapters.content:
1074 Reporting the Yun Race for Giving Their Heads (5)
Under the illumination of the Sword Light, the barrier sealed by the Black Space Divine Dragon just now was instantly pierced. At this moment, the Black Space Divine Dragon was in the endless sword world and lost its direction.
In the next second, under the frightened gaze of the Black Space Divine Dragon, it felt that the entire world instantly cracked, as if countless sword lights from the God Domain were destroying this world.
Crack!
Thousands of sword lights appeared.
The sword world formed by the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation collapsed with a bang under countless sword lights. As it collapsed, the Black Space Divine Dragon inside endured all the damage.
The chaotic and broken domain looked like a shattered world at this moment. Countless spatial fragments fell from the sky like meteors.
In the outside world.
The scene was even more shocking.
What shocked the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai, and even the people in the city was that as this meteor shower-like spatial fragment fell, the sword light swept across, and the Black Space Divine Dragon’s body divided into two with the naked eye. Then it divided into four, and the four divided into eight…
On its huge body, the injuries were filled with a shocking red light. In almost a few seconds, its body shattered into pieces and exploded into a blood mist that filled the sky. It was directly slashed into an incomplete corpse. The black dragon blood that enveloped the sky directly descended from the sky like a majestic rain.
Blood dyed the sky.
The entire city was shocked and didn’t know what had happened. However, this blood rain was polluted after all. Shi Yu wouldn’t let it fall. In an instant, the black blood rain also completely disappeared from the sky under the burning of the red flames during the descent.
A spatial totem-level life form with top-notch battle power was directly killed. It couldn’t even escape.
This was the power of the Chi Tong God’s evolution and possession of Shi Yu. Both parties controlled the quasi-divine skill, the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation.
Anyone below the demigod level could be killed.
The Beast Tamers below couldn’t understand. They looked at the sword concubine holding a red immortal sword in the sky as if they were looking at a god. Everything happened in a minute. They didn’t know the cause and effect at all.
Who exactly was this person?
At this moment, after completing the Killing Quests, the Sword Maiden Chi Tong, who was the array spirit, slowly dispersed its spiritual body and transferred its consciousness to Shi Yu below. At this moment, Shi Yu sighed. His red hair and red eyes had also returned to their black hair and eyes. He recalled Chi Tong to the Beast Taming Space to rest.
At the same time, he looked at the Iron-eating Beast ancestor beside him, Ji Mengzhu, and Ji Nai.
At this moment, the three of them looked at Shi Yu in shock and disbelief. They found it very difficult to understand.
Their worldview shattered.
The Black Space Divine Dragon was the number one general under Yun An, a top-notch totem battle power.
However, such a powerful top-notch totem was killed by Shi Yu easily just now.
Instant kill.
In the entire Dong Huang, probably only Emperor Wu had this strength.
However, Emperor Wu was a legendary Beast Tamer, but wasn’t Shi Yu in front of him a legend Beast Tamer?
It was two levels lower!
And that move just now… The Black Space Divine Dragon’s miserable cry… Quasi-divine skill?? Shi Yu used a quasi-divine skill just now??
Ji Mengzhu was still wondering if Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast was so strong and if his strength could reach the titled level.
But from the looks of it… her expression was stunned. Even Dong Huang’s strongest titled expert, her father, was only so-so.
“Now you believe that I’m not a spy of the Yun Race, right?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“It’s a pity that the Black Space Divine Dragon has all its resources.”
Fortunately, the undead spirit had already been captured and not wasted.
“Wu wu wu!!! (Ahhh.)” Eleven was helpless.
“Who exactly are you…” At this moment, Ji Mengzhu and her daughter indeed believed that Shi Yu wasn’t a spy of the Yun clan. However, they felt that the unknown Shi Yu was simply even more terrifying and mysterious than the Yun clan.
They could see through Yun An.
However, Shi Yu’s figure in front of him was as deep as an abyss, making it impossible to see everything about him.
What exactly was the sword spirit controlling the sword formation just now!!!
How could anyone control such a powerful sword spirit?
“Ababa, Ababa.” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor looked at Eleven, who looked unhappy that it couldn’t fight, with a frightened expression. Through the conversation between the Iron-eating Beast and Shi Yu just now, it was shocked to discover that even this little Iron-eating Beast also had the strength to kill that Black Space Divine Dragon!
Something was definitely wrong with this person! It was a little glad that it had rejected the battle with Shi Yu just now.
“Is this the main point now? The invasion of the Yun clan totem is a signal. Emperor Wu and General Ji Yun shouldn’t be in Dong Huang, right?”
Ji Nai’s expression changed. “Emperor Wu and the others… are indeed not in Dong Huang.”
“If I’m not wrong, Emperor Wu and the others are probably fighting the Yun Race now.”
“It’s even very likely that he will fight Yun An.” Shi Yu took a deep breath. In history, this was the second time Dong Huang had fought the Yun Race. Should he… support Emperor Wu and the others?

chapters.title: Chapter 1075 - 1075 Ultimate Mechanical Ling
chapters.content:
1075 Ultimate Mechanical Ling
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expressions of Ji Mengzhu, her mother, and the Iron-eating Beast ancestor changed.
Wu Ling City and Imperial City were very close.
The fact that the Black Space Divine Dragon dared to attack the city was most likely because the Yun clan had already learned that Emperor Wu wasn’t in Dong Huang.
Ji Nai knew very well that Emperor Wu and her husband had gone deep into the Yun clan’s territory to investigate information.
Shi Yu might be right.
!!
If the information was exposed, it was very likely that they had already gone against the Yun clan.
Although these two people were very strong, it was the territory of the totem demigod after all. If they were surrounded by the enemy, even if they could retreat unscathed, they would probably sacrifice a lot.
Now, not only did Wu Ling City encounter a crisis, but Emperor Wu and the others might also encounter a crisis.
“I’ll contact the other three generals and mobilize reinforcements,” Ji Nai waved her sleeve and said anxiously.
“With the support speed of the Dong Huang Dynasty, it’ll be too late by the time we rush over,” Shi Yu said.
Apart from the Space Emperor Dynasty, even in the modern era, the support speed was very slow. On the other hand, in the modern era, there were advantages that other eras didn’t have, communication.
Fortunately, Shi Yu remembered that in this encounter, the high-level and top-notch battle power damage of both parties was only totem.
On the Yun clan’s side, a totem was killed. On Dong Huang’s side, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor died in battle, but it also beat the Black Space Divine Dragon to the verge of death and barely protected Wu Ling City.
But now, if he helped the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor kill the Black Space Divine Dragon in advance, he didn’t know what would happen to the battle over there.
“I’ll go provide support,” Shi Yu said.
“You’re going to support…?”
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai, and the others looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
Shi Yu, an outsider who had yet to join the Dong Huang Dynasty, could actually do this for Dong Huang, even going deep into the dangerous areas of the totem country?
However, when they recalled the strength Shi Yu had displayed just now, everyone was relieved.
The strongest general below Yun An couldn’t even withstand one move from him. What could stop him?
With such reinforcements, it was simply like a divine weapon descending from the sky.
Ji Mengzhu quickly said, “Sir Shi Yu, can I really rely on you? I’ll go with you! I have a communication positioning jade pendant with my father. After we get close, we can quickly lock onto their location and contact them.”
Shi Yu looked at her and nodded.
“Then, it’s decided. Just in case, Senior Ji Nai, Ancestor, protect Wu Ling City and deal with the aftermath just now,” Shi Yu said to Ji Nai and the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor.
“You flatter me, you flatter me.” The Iron-eating Beast ancestor was shocked. Damn, what right did it have?
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven felt that there was no problem. After all, if it hadn’t risked its life to resist the Black Space Divine Dragon, the thousands of Iron-eating Beast cubs in the Iron-eating Beast Training Mystic Realm would have all died.
Its ancestor might be inside.
“Then you have to be careful. You have to return safely.” Ji Nai saw that Ji Mengzhu had taken the initiative to follow and had no objections. Her race had all wandered through the totem battle and had long ignored life and death.
As a legend of Dong Huang, if Ji Mengzhu couldn’t even withstand this little Quest, she would be letting down the nurturing of the entire race.
“Then how are we going?” Ji Mengzhu asked.
“On a spatial battleship.” Shi Yu looked at her and smiled, stunning Ji Mengzhu.
Boom!!!
Behind Shi Yu, a huge black summoning array that was a hundred meters in diameter appeared again. Under the shocked expressions of Ji Mengzhu, Ji Nai, and the Iron-eating Beast ancestor, a green and white whirlwind lingered and light outlined. Soon, a contracted creature they had never seen before was summoned.
As ancient people, they were naturally unfamiliar with such Arms, but if it were a modern person, they would definitely shout “machinery battleship”!
This was a super battleship that was like a futuristic Arms in a sci-fi masterpiece. It was completely white in color, and some devices lingered with green light. Its structure was abnormally complicated, and the huge cannon weaponry was perfect!
This huge battleship was filled with a sci-fi beauty. It was completely surrounded by a green whirlwind, as if it was absorbing the wind elemental power around it.
“Space battleship, Green Dragon, ready.” Ling’s mechanical and emotionless female voice sounded.
“Follow me,” Shi Yu said to the confused Ji Mengzhu.
At the moment, Buggy’s spatial control, Instant Transmission, was actually not Shi Yu’s fastest transportation.
The strongest speed in a short distance was undoubtedly Buggy, but in a long-distance journey, in terms of endurance, it was undoubtedly Ling.
And fusing their powers into one was clearly the true strongest speed.
Before the World Tournament, Ling had already become a seven-in-one mecha. Now, Ling, whose top-notch intelligence had been activated (Perfect+47), might be the mechanical life form with the highest intelligence on Blue Planet.
All kinds of mechanical operations had already been studied and mastered by it. At the moment, its race was no longer suitable to be described by the Hundred Transformations Machinery or the mechanical phantom beast, the Wind Kirin.
It was already an ultimate machine. It could do whatever other mechanical lives could do. An ultimate mechanical Skill was naturally able to form a battleship with Buggy.
< Name > Ling
[Race]: Mechanical Life (Hundred Transformations Mechanical → Mechanical Beast, Wind Kirin → Ultimate Machinery)
[Stats]: Machinery, Wind
[Level of Growth]: Overlord
[Race Skill]:
“Super”: Wind Element Control (Perfect+47), Divine Net (Perfect+47), Ultimate Machinery (Perfect+47), Turning Misfortune into Luck (Perfect+47), Wind Spirit Bead (Perfect+47)

chapters.title: Chapter 1076 - 1076 Ultimate Mechanical Ling (2)
chapters.content:
1076 Ultimate Mechanical Ling (2)
“Quasi God-level Skill”: Wind Blessing (Initiate)
[Taught Skill]
“Super”: Mythical Revival (Perfect+47), Nine-Colored Divine Light (Perfect+47)
After fusing most of Ling’s mechanical Skills and modifying it with the Divine Net, it was now the ultimate body of a mechanical life form. It used Buggy as a component in an ultimate mechanical posture. Obviously, Ling could use its power to carry out stronger spatial travel.
The Iron-eating Beast ancestor, Ji Nai, and Ji Mengzhu looked at the huge battleship in a daze. They couldn’t understand, but they were greatly shocked, especially the Iron-eating Beast ancestor. It felt that the pressure this big guy gave it was completely not inferior to the sword spirit just now and the little Iron-eating Beast on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Who exactly was this Beast Tamer named Shi Yu? Where did he come from? His pets were all… strange!
“Is this also a unique pet of Tingxiang?” Ji Mengzhu muttered in her heart. She kept feeling that the overall strength of Tingxiang was going to completely exceed the east…
….
Soon, Ji Mengzhu and Shi Yu were teleported to the control room of the mechanical battleship.
The complicated driving control room made Ji Mengzhu a little absent-minded.
“Can you hand me the communication positioning jade pendant?” Shi Yu asked Ji Mengzhu.
Upon hearing that, Ji Mengzhu immediately took out the jade pendant.
Shi Yu took it and placed it right on the heels of the heels on a glass pillar on the operating table.
Ji Mengzhu watched eagerly, feeling like a country bumpkin.
Buzz!
Then, the huge black screen in the sky opened. The image of a beautiful girl in a white, black, and red uniform appeared. She had long white hair, and her long hair was tied into a ponytail at the back of her head. There was a strand of hair on her head.
Seeing this, Ji Mengzhu retreated slightly. In the next moment, the girl slowly opened her eyes and let out a clear, experienced, and pleasant female voice. “Master, we’ll arrive in 15 minutes.”
“You’ve worked hard.”
“This is…” Ji Mengzhu was confused again.
“My contracted target, Ling,” Shi Yu said. “It’s most powerful in computational analysis. The essence of any item can be cracked. The range of that jade pendant’s extreme communication is limited, but under its cracking, it expanded and broke through to the limit.”
“We’ve already locked onto General Ji Yun and the others’ location. We are estimated to arrive in 15 minutes.”
“Look, the map.” Shi Yu pointed at the huge screen in the center. At this moment, two positions clearly appeared on the huge screen. One of the light spots was quickly moving towards the other light spot. Below, the changes in distance, speed, and estimated time were also marked. It was even more difficult for Ji Mengzhu to understand.
This wasn’t his limit!
Buggy: “?”
Buggy: I have to save my strength to fight!!
“Shi Yu… You…” Ji Mengzhu looked at the mysterious young man in front of her and felt that he had countless secrets. “Do you like beautiful women very much? Why was the sword spirit so beautiful just now? This contracted partner is also so beautiful.”
Although one was an undead and the other didn’t look like a normal life form and felt like a virtual illusion, it couldn’t change the fact that they were both very beautiful.
“Wu wu wu. (There’s also an Elemental life form.)” Eleven muttered in its heart. Susu wasn’t bad either!
Shi Yu: “?”
Was this the main point? As expected, women were boring. This was a battleship, a battleship!
It could also transform into a mecha! A mecha! How handsome!
“Wait, we… can reach the Yun Nation in 15 minutes?!!! 15 minutes?!” Ji Mengzhu, who was wearing a white Han suit, said in disbelief, her beautiful eyes widening.
“Isn’t your reflex a little long?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but complain.
Well, that was normal. The future Aunt Ji Mengzhu was also so shocked when she saw Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and Future Technology.
“I’ll enter the ruins first…” She placed her left hand into the bracelet on her right hand and said,” I’ll go change my armor. ”
Although she felt that the nearby space was also very large, it was in Shi Yu’s pet’s body after all. She felt that it was more suitable to go to the ruins space to change.
“Wait, we’re in the midst of a spatial jump. If you enter the ruins space, you’ll be thrown away.”
Shi Yu said, “In addition, I think it’s more convenient to contract armor-type equipment. Contracting five Iron-eating Beasts isn’t very meaningful…”
“Wu…” Ji Mengzhu was stunned. Her few contracted pets were indeed Iron-eating Beasts.
This wasn’t a secret…
Most of the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe were like this. At this moment, when she heard Shi Yu’s words, Ji Mengzhu nodded.
In ancient times, antique swords could still nurture spirits. Shi Yu felt that contracting a pile of such armor and Arms to equip himself was the best combination.
Be it General Mu Huiyin or Emperor Wu, they had contracted creatures similar to Arms.
Contracting a bunch of Iron-eating Beasts, even Senior Panda wasn’t this crazy…
[Not only do I have to get Eleven evolution materials, but if possible, I can also plunder more inscription evolution materials and turn Senior Panda’s Iron-eating Beast into nine inscriptions.] Shi Yu looked at the screen and thought.
“What if His Majesty Emperor Wu and the others really encounter Yun An?” Ji Mengzhu asked again.
Shi Yu shook his head and said, “I hope so…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1077 - 1077 Ultimate Mechanical Ling (3)
chapters.content:
1077 Ultimate Mechanical Ling (3)
“It’s just nice to cooperate with Emperor Wu and kill it.”
Ji Mengzhu was stunned.
Now that Yun An wasn’t that cowardly, he would kill it!
Emperor Wu had yet to grow to the peak. At this stage, Yun An shouldn’t be afraid of Emperor Wu and think that Emperor Wu was only so-so.
It was the best time to destroy Yun An.
Unlike later, in order to avoid Emperor Wu, Yun An obtained a bunch of life-saving skills that were not easy to fight at all.
“Master, we’ll approach the communication distance immediately.”
“Alright, tell your General Ji Yun.” Shi Yu looked at Ji Mengzhu beside him.
…
In the Yun Nation.
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast Corps was discovered and attacked by the two totems, causing the Iron-eating Beast Corps to fall into a bitter battle.
These two totems, a top-notch totem and an ordinary totem.
Cow and sheep combination!
Among them, the top-notch totem Black Bull was dealt with by the Iron-eating Beast General Ji Yunchong, and the Normal totems were dealt with by the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
At that moment, the members of this Iron-eating Beast Corps were not complete. Excluding Ji Yunchong’s pet, there were only four overlord-level Iron-eating Beasts and 60 monarch-level Iron-eating Beasts. This was the key to making Ji Yunchong and the others fall into a bitter battle.
Under Ji Yunzhong’s eruption, he could only fight against the top-notch totem, the Black Meteorite Yak. It was impossible to determine the winner in a short period of time.
Under the eruption of the army skills of all the members of the Iron-eating Beast Corps, although they could suppress the Black Ram, they couldn’t quickly decide the winner. Both parties directly fell into a stalemate of consumption.
At this moment, both parties had already completed a round of battle. Neither party could do anything to the other.
The Iron-eating Beast army led by Ji Yunchong and the Demon God Iron-eating Beast was pitch-black. They faced the two huge totems in front of them and temporarily stopped fighting because of their tactical choices.
Because Ji Yunchong and the others judged that if they continued fighting, there wouldn’t be much results. Therefore, all the Iron-eating Beasts used Impregnable to form a domain to resist the attack of the two totems and wait for reinforcements.
Now, Ji Yunchong’s heart was burning. They had been discovered, and the situation was very bad. If Emperor Wu didn’t come to support, it meant that Emperor Wu had also been discovered and fallen into a predicament where he couldn’t escape.
Then, he could only hope that the army far at the border would quickly discover the abnormality and come to support.
As long as all the members of the Iron-eating Beast Army gathered, a mere two totems could be defeated with the smallest price before going to support Emperor Wu.
“Ji Yunchong, a chicken, a coward, a scaredy cat, remove your domain if you have the ability.” The huge Black Meteorite Yak roared. Its attack landed on the impregnable defense formed by dozens of Iron-eating Beasts, unable to break through its defense.
“They’re stalling for time and waiting for reinforcements,” the mountain-sized black ram couldn’t help but say.
“Reinforcements, there are no reinforcements. Your reinforcements will naturally be stopped by others. Your Emperor Wu can’t even protect himself now,” the Black Meteorite Yak said.
“Let’s see how long your domain can last.”
Boom!!!
The Black Meteorite Yak spat out black light and hit the impregnable domain again, causing the ground to instantly tremble.
“Coming.” Ji Yunchong ignored the other party’s words and realized that a communication jade pendant had lit up. He couldn’t help but be delighted, but soon, General Ji Yunchong’s expression stiffened again.
Because the person who sent the message was not the legendary general of the Iron-eating Beast Corps at the border, but his daughter, Ji Mengzhu, who should be far away in Wu Ling City.
“Father, Wu Ling City was invaded by the Yun Race’s totem, the Black Space Divine Dragon. They might have already discovered that Emperor Wu isn’t in Dong Huang. Your whereabouts have been exposed. Don’t go deeper into the enemy’s territory.”
“If you haven’t encountered the enemy’s attack, please retreat immediately. If you’re already fighting, please hold on. I’ll quickly bring reinforcements to the battlefield.”
“In addition, there’s no need to worry about the situation in Wu Ling City. At that time, the national recruitment happened to conscript a powerful Beast Tamer whose strength was comparable to His Majesty Emperor Wu. He had already dealt with the Black Space Divine Dragon, and Wu Ling City wasn’t too injured. At the moment, we’re the only ones heading to your side.”
After receiving the huge communication content, General Ji Yun’s heart underwent a violent emotional change.
Ji Yunchong: “?”
The first sentence was that Wu Ling City was invaded by the top-notch totem of the Yun Race, the Black Space Divine Dragon. It almost scared his soul out of his body. After all, the Black Space Divine Dragon was the strongest general under Yun An. It was much stronger than these two.
What were those armies guarding the border doing? They didn’t even know why the Black Space Divine Dragon had entered Dong Huang.
His wife and daughter were all in Wu Ling City, so it was impossible for Ji Yunchong not to be worried.
But right on the heels of that, Ji Mengzhu sent a message saying that she had recruited a Beast Tamer whose strength was comparable to a Emperor Wu and had already defeated the Black Space Divine Dragon. This was even more ridiculous, extremely ridiculous!!
Ji Yunchong was stunned.
Who was Emperor Wu? He was the most talented Beast Tamer in the Eastern Land in the past 500 years after Emperor Shi. Such an existence was casually recruited by a national conscription? Did Dong Huang have such a Beast Tamer?

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 1078 Poor and Helpless Yun An
chapters.content:
1078 Poor and Helpless Yun An
In the Yun Nation.
The huge Ram and Yak were like small mountains together, looking down at the golden domain in front of them.
The golden domain was a semicircular barrier more than a thousand meters in diameter. It was transparent and golden.
Inside, dozens of Iron-eating Beasts supported the barrier in the form of the Five Elements Formation.
These Iron-eating Beasts had all undergone clueless evolution and were quite strong.
!!
In the center of the formation were the support pets and Beast Tamers accompanying the Iron-eating Beast Corps. They were also in charge of operating and strengthening the operation of the impregnable domain.
Army skills were the mainstream battle skills in the armies of the various dynasties. They were the key to the army defeating the strong.
At this moment, Dong Huang clearly didn’t have a single totem level, but the two totems had never been able to break through the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ array.
Standing on the Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had enlarged to more than ten meters tall and was holding a black sword, Ji Yunchong looked at the two totem generals of the Yun clan in silence.
“General, is there any news of reinforcements?” At this moment, a deputy general couldn’t help but ask when he saw Ji Yun take out the communication jade pendant.
Although they could still last for a period of time like this, it wasn’t a long-term plan after all. They couldn’t spend all their strength on defense. This was too passive.
Ji Yunzhong said, “There’s news. Everyone, hold on for a while more.”
“Roar!!!”
“Wuu!!”
“Wuu!” Upon hearing that, in the Golden Domain, the soldiers and Iron-eating Beasts worked hard, their eyes like ferocious wolves as they stared at the two totems.
Damn, when the reinforcements arrived, neither of these two totems could escape.
In fact, if it weren’t for the fact that the power on their bodies was too filthy, they would have killed them no matter what!
“Hold on a little longer, reinforcements are about to arrive!!”
The morale of the Iron-eating Beast Corps was even higher.
As for Ji Yunchong, although he was suspicious of his daughter’s message, that jade pendant could indeed only be used by Ji Mengzhu herself.
However, the situation was still too strange.
The other party wasn’t within the range, so how did he contact him?
Ji Yunchong was silent. At this point, even if it was filled with Enigma, even if it was very difficult to believe, he could only believe it for once. After all, according to the Black Meteorite Yak and Black Ram, the reinforcements at the border had probably been intercepted by the Yun clan. It wasn’t something that could be rushed over in a short period of time.
“After the reinforcements arrive.”
“Cleansing Camp, cooperate with the Thunder Camp. Blazing Flame Camp, listen to my command and prepare to launch a counterattack!!”
Boom.
At this moment, the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram were still attacking. They also knew this kind of army skill. It consumed a lot of strength, and the Iron-eating Beast Corps couldn’t last long.
As for the reinforcements, it was nonsense. Since they dared to surround the Iron-eating Beast Corps team that went deep into the country, the Yun Race was naturally sufficiently prepared. Not only the Dong Huang Army at the border, but even the interior of Dong Huang would be turned upside down.
“Roar!!!” After using its strongest Skill, Demon Mist Horn, but failing to penetrate the Golden Soup Domain, the Black Ram cursed.
“Forget it, let’s not waste our energy. Since they’re willing to wait, we’ll wait,” the Black Meteorite Yak said. “As long as we maintain the Skill, they will consume a lot of energy. Let’s rest first.”
“Alright.” The black ram stopped attacking and looked into the dazzling golden barrier. Although it couldn’t hear the voice inside, it believed that the people inside could definitely hear its voice.
“Ji Yunchong, your Emperor Wu has already died in the hands of His Majesty Yun An.”
“In addition, you don’t know, right? Our Black Dragon General has already arrived at Dong Huang’s Wu Ling City and is destroying the city. Your family and your clansmen should be there, right?”
“I think none of you want your family to lose their lives, right?”
“Now, you still have a chance. Give up resisting, and we won’t kill those who surrender!”
“Not only will you receive preferential treatment and the opportunity to be modified into the Yun clan, but your families will also be safe and sound. Don’t you want that group of Iron-eating Beasts to become as strong as your Boss? It only obtained a portion of His Majesty Yun An’s power and already has such strength. You can do it too!” After stopping the attack, the black goat carried out a verbal attack, wanting to disturb the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ morale.
Inside the domain, the expressions of the Iron-eating Beasts and Beast Tamers didn’t change.
Only the killing intent and Warpath in his eyes were even stronger.
If the morale of the Iron-eating Beast Corps could be shaken by a few words from the enemy, it wouldn’t be the number one army of Emperor Wu Dynasty.
…
“Lucky.”
At the same time.
In the void, in the spatial battleship, as the distance got closer and closer, Ling had already detected the situation on General Ji Yun and the others’ side.
On the huge screen, their situation was not very clear.
Everyone was bitterly using army skills to resist the attacks of the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram.
“Not good, there are two Yun clan totems!”
In the room, although she didn’t know why Shi Yu’s pet could suddenly see the situation on the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ side, after discovering that her father and the others were surrounded by the two totems, Ji Mengzhu’s expression immediately changed and she was a little nervous.
“Fortunate? What’s lucky about that?”
“Don’t worry, aren’t they still fine?”
“These two Yun Race totems aren’t strong. I know them!” Shi Yu licked his lips.
“One is a cow, and the other is a sheep. Moreover, they’re not strong. Even if they can’t leave their corpses intact, most of their bodies should be able to be preserved. We can completely control the situation within a controllable range.”
“After their meat is cleansed, it’s very delicious…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 1079 Poor and Helpless Yun An (2)
chapters.content:
1079 Poor and Helpless Yun An (2)
Ji Mengzhu: “?”
The Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram weren’t spatial. Moreover, the battle venue wasn’t in the city. Although he had his own people there, they were all in very safe domains. Shi Yu felt that apart from the undead, he could finally have some additional gains.
“What do you want to do…” Ji Mengzhu said in confusion.
“Kill them like how you killed the Black Space Divine Dragon just now?”
“No.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“Just now, my sword spirit used a quasi-divine skill. Both of us consumed a lot of energy. Under normal circumstances, it’s not suitable to carry out high-intensity battles for a few days.”
“Leave it to other pets to settle,” Shi Yu said.
“Buggy, you settle it. Chi Tong, harvest and carry out the final attack. Ling, remember to give Buggy a buff.”
Chi Tong’s Immortal Slaying Sword Formation was invincible against one person, and it could control the attack in a domain. The aftermath was not big, but the power was too great, and it was easy to shatter the enemy. Moreover, the attack just now had indeed greatly exhausted his and Chi Tong’s strength. They still needed to recover for a while. Next, he would only leave the last saber to Chi Tong and let it imprison the undead.
It was the same for other pets to defeat the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram.
However, he couldn’t use quasi-divine skills to fight.
Chi Tong and the others’ quasi-divine skills were all in the entry stage, and their strength control was not very good.
Therefore, it was better to use other skills with high proficiency so that he could control his strength to the greatest extent… As for power, with the enhancement of Ling’s transcendent nine-colored divine light, it was definitely not weak.
“Other pets…”
The corners of Ji Mengzhu’s mouth twitched.
It looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
As expected, his other pets were also very ridiculous, right!!!
He was clearly a legend Beast Tamer, but now he was going to face two totems, but he said that he could guarantee that the battle Crowd Control was under his control??
“Buggy is…” Ji Mengzhu asked.
“Sob.” At this moment, Eleven, who was sitting in the driver’s seat, waved at Ji Mengzhu. Eleven was here. He wasn’t Buggy.
Ji Mengzhu was silent. She knew that he wasn’t Buggy.
“Ji.” As spatial ripples appeared, a green little green worm appeared on the control table.
He looked at Eleven.
Eleven said weakly, “Wuu…”
It couldn’t be helped. After all, it would be a waste not to use the power of faith in this spacetime.
At this moment, seeing that the Buggy Shi Yu was talking about was really Buggy, Ji Mengzhu was stunned again.
She could understand the Iron-eating Beast, the sword spirit, and this mysterious battleship.
However, was Shi Yu’s Contract Pet a Green Silkworm??
“We’re about to arrive. Do you want to go together?” Shi Yu said.
…
“Again…”
A moment later, General Ji Yun suddenly realized that another message had come from the communication jade pendant.
[Reinforcements are about to arrive. Don’t withdraw the army formation, don’t attack, defend with all your might.]
Ji Yunchong: “?”
What did it mean?
He didn’t sense where the reinforcements were coming from at all. His communication jade pendant still didn’t move. How did the other party know that they were maintaining the army skill?
At this moment, General Ji Yun was deeply puzzled.
“Stubborn.”
In the outside world.
Black Ram also shook its head, disappointed in this group of stubborn guys.
Just as it was about to speak again, the Black Ram, the Black Meteorite Yak, and the entire Iron-eating Beast Corps suddenly discovered the changes in their surroundings.
Space fluctuations!!!
Boom!!!
A spatial ripple instantly attracted everyone’s attention.
After all, in this stalemate between the two armies, it was difficult for the two parties not to care if a third party entered the battlefield with a spatial jump.
“Are they reinforcements!?” The dozens of soldiers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps in the domain spoke one after another.
They looked over in unison and waited for General Ji Yun’s counterattack command.
“In the sky!!”
They quickly captured the core area of the spatial ripples. At the same time, they were puzzled, because teleporting down from the sky was not the support method of the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
Even the other armies didn’t have such a support method!
“Who is it?” The Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Goat didn’t move rashly before figuring out the identity of the person.
However, reinforcements didn’t appear.
What came were only two extremely dazzling lights that suddenly appeared in the sky.
With strong power!!!
The Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak quickly looked over, and their expressions changed drastically.
It was two green-gold lights that looked like meteors. They were like two divine dragons that had descended from the starry sky. They bared their fangs and brandished their claws, coming from the starry sky with an incomparably terrifying dragon might!!
Looking carefully, the so-called dragon form was just flames produced by their friction with the atmosphere, and its main body was two huge meteorites!
Faith skill, Dragon Star Group!!!
The incomparable meteorite made the Beast Tamers in the domain widen their eyes.
It would be a waste not to use the power of faith in this space and time. The dragon star that Shi Yu had gotten Buggy to accumulate in advance could be used at this moment.
At this moment, the Dragon Star Group had actually undergone a tremendous change compared to the World Tournament.
Apart from power, there was also Crowd Control.
After approaching transcendent proficiency, Buggy’s control over it had undergone a huge change. For example, when the current Dragon Star Group attacked, the more the enemy didn’t believe in the Green Dragon and was hostile to it, the greater the power. However, the damage and aftermath of the Dragon Star Group would be reduced to the lowest among the believers acknowledged by the Green Dragon, and they wouldn’t even be injured by the power of faith.
At the moment, although Buggy had just arrived at the Emperor Wu Era and had yet to mobilize much power of faith, it was enough to deal with the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak. After all, Shi Yu didn’t want to crush them into dregs like he did with the Green Dragon Prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080
chapters.content:
1080 Poor and Helpless Yun An (3)
Boom!!!!
The meteorite fell, leaving traces of tearing space. The huge power directly made the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak feel as if they were facing a great enemy.
“Roar!!!”
The two of them immediately wanted to leave the range of the meteorite’s attack. They quickly dodged to the left and right. At the same time, they didn’t forget to watch the trajectory of the meteorite’s descent. However, as the Void trembled and starlight condensed, a scene even more shocking than the meteorite’s descent appeared in front of the two totems.
The weather changed.
The entire sky and world seemed to have darkened.
It was still daytime just now, but at this moment, all light was stripped away.
As spatial ripples flashed, a shocking image appeared. A shocking creature more than ten thousand meters long that looked like a dragon appeared under the starry sky. It had two golden horns on its head and was covered in green scales. Its eyes and tail seemed to be burning with golden flames of Spirit faith.
“Roar!!!” Under the gaze of the divine dragon’s golden eyes, its body swayed. Two strong dragon claws directly grabbed the two meteors that had just descended beside it!!
In an instant, it grabbed the two meteors and changed their descent trajectory!!
Boom!!!
Then, it pressed down on the meteorite like it was an Arms weapon, pressing down on the shocked Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak. They wanted to move, but they realized that in an instant, the surrounding space was sealed and they couldn’t move.
It was comparable to transcendent spatial control!
Under the seal, Buggy roared. The meteorite pressed down and directly hit the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak. These two totems also instantly counterattacked. The Demon Mist Horn condensed, but Buggy, which had been strengthened by Ling’s nine-colored divine light, ignored these guys in terms of strength!
The meteorite pressed down, and with a boom, the huge horns of the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak were bent. Right on the heels of that, under their shocked expressions, their entire bodies were pressed to the ground by the dragon claws and the huge meteorite!!
Crack!
The meteorite shattered, and a huge shockwave swept out!
“Roar!!!” The two totems let out miserable cries and spat out blood.
The raging fire of faith burned their spirits, souls, and bodies, producing incomparable pain.
Boom!!!
The ground cracked, and the surrounding mountains kept shaking. Ripples kept appearing in the Golden Domain, making the Beast Tamers and Iron-eating Beasts inside open their mouths wide.
What happened?
Where did this green dragon come from!
“Faith skill??” General Ji Yun said in disbelief.
That was… the Fire of Faith!
“Who is it!!”
This wasn’t the end. After succeeding in one hit, the green divine dragon directly let go of the gravel in its hand and retreated into the sky. It didn’t continue attacking. At this moment, the Black Ram was completely heavily injured, but the Black Meteorite Yak still had a trace of mobility.
“Moo!!!!” Its huge body stood up with difficulty. Its eyes were filled with supreme anger as it pushed open the gravel that filled the sky. But in the next second, its bull eyes instantly widened, revealing an incomprehensible expression.
They saw a shocking scene.
A young man with a calm expression was standing on the dragon head and staring at it.
Behind the young man was a Beast Tamer it was very familiar with. Ji Mengzhu, the daughter of General Ji Yunchong of Dong Huang, was tugging at the young man’s clothes with a panicked expression, as if she was shocked.
“What… what a joke!!!” At this moment, the Black Meteorite Yak realized that something was wrong. Didn’t the Black Dragon General go to Wu Ling City to destroy the city? Why should the daughter of Ji Yunchong, who was guarding Wu Ling City, appear here?
And who exactly was this guy!!
“I’m showing mercy, but not to let you have the strength to resist.” As Shi Yu finished speaking, with a boom, the huge Heavenly Dragon Tail swung over again and hit the Black Meteorite Yak. With a bang, the Black Meteorite Yak’s huge body was suppressed again.
On the green dragon’s head, Ji Mengzhu’s brain lost the ability to think. She completely didn’t expect that the little green worm just now would suddenly become a ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon in such a state.
Her brain was buzzing. Although Shi Yu had already displayed his strength in Wu Ling City just now, she was still shocked again when she saw Shi Yu defeat the two totems effortlessly.
“It, it’s also at the overlord level?!!” Ji Mengzhu couldn’t understand.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Sort of, but it’s a god of faith in the starry sky, so it’s a little stronger.”
“You’ve heard of the Green Dragon, right? Emperor Wu should also be nurturing it.”
“This kind of predecessor isn’t even a totem. It’s purely an Unholy totem modified by Yun An with the power of a Demon God. It’s impossible for it to be the Green Dragon’s match,” Shi Yu said.
Ji Mengzhu’s expression changed drastically again.
Green, Green Dragon??
She had felt that something was wrong just now. At this moment, Ji Mengzhu’s mouth opened wide again. She couldn’t believe that she was on the Green Dragon God.
At the same time.
“General, there’s actually someone up there!!” Inside the golden barrier, all the Beast Tamers and pets were extremely stunned.
Their faces were filled with shock and disbelief.
The two totems that were in a stalemate with them just now and couldn’t determine the winner, forcing them to wait helplessly for reinforcements… were suppressed in one round??
“Isn’t that Miss Ji Mengzhu?!?”
At this moment, Ji Yunhai’s deputy general looked at the woman on the green dragon’s head in shock.
Who else could that woman in a white Han suit be but General Ji Yun’s daughter?
Then, who was the young man beside Ji Mengzhu?
At this moment, General Ji Yun also looked at Shi Yu in shock. Don’t tell him that this person was the powerful Beast Tamer recruited by the country after defeating the Black Space Divine Dragon that Ji Mengzhu mentioned had strength comparable to a Emperor Wu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1081 - 1081 Poor and Helpless Yun An (4)
chapters.content:
1081 Poor and Helpless Yun An (4)
It was actually true??? There was really such a person?
The miserable state of the Black Meteorite Yak and Black Goat seemed to have already told him that it was indeed!
Just as the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps were extremely shocked, in the next second, the two figures on the green dragon’s head were teleported out.
After entering the impregnable domain, he easily cracked the army skill.
At this moment, Buggy’s gaze also focused on the two totems that wanted to make a cheap shot, a cheap trick…
Chi Tong’s sister, come quickly!
…
In the domain, Shi Yu’s clearer appearance was seen clearly by all the Beast Tamers and battle pets here. He was wearing a dark red battle trench coat, and his short hair was slightly blown by the wind. His extremely young face made them a little confused.
At this moment, General Ji Yun, who was on the Demon God Iron-eating Beast, looked at Shi Yu, who had been teleported over with his daughter, with a cold expression.
“Father, this is Shi Yu. I told you just now.” Ji Mengzhu first called out to General Ji Yun.
At this moment, Ji Yunchong took a deep breath and bowed gratefully at Shi Yu with a serious expression.
Then, he looked around.
“Everyone, these are the reinforcements I told you just now. They’ve arrived.”
“I didn’t make it clear previously that the reinforcements aren’t the border army.”
“It’s the expert recruited by the national recruitment this time, Sir Shi Yu.”
“Among the two Yun clan totems just now, one of them wasn’t lying. General Black Dragon indeed invaded Dong Huang’s Wu Ling City. However, thanks to Sir Shi Yu… General Black Dragon, who invaded Wu Ling City, has already been killed by him!!”
“After that, they even sensed the danger and came to support us.”
“Sir Shi Yu, on behalf of Dong Huang, I thank you.”
As soon as he finished speaking, the brains of the other Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps instantly rumbled as they looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
They looked at Shi Yu, who had easily suppressed the two totems just now.
….
“Bastard, what exactly is going on!!!”
At the same time, in the depths of the Yun Nation.
A Demon God with a body like a city was fighting the domineering man in front of him with several totems beside him.
Yun An originally wanted to teach Emperor Wu a lesson this time, but he didn’t expect that in such a short period of time, Emperor Wu’s strength would actually improve quickly. The last time, he was even suppressed by it, but this time, he could actually suppress it.
“Is this all your tricks?” Emperor Wu stared at Yun An. Although his body was covered in injuries, Yun An in front of him and the various totems under its command were also heavily injured by him and his pets.
Looking at the totems that left Yun An’s side one by one and were teleported away by Yun An, Emperor Wu locked onto this number one enemy.
“Hahahaha.” Yun An felt a headache. It didn’t want to continue fighting for the time being, because things were a little unexpected.
At this rate, he couldn’t deal with this human Legendary at all. It was better to let him be naturally poisoned to death!
“Wu Dong, I advise you not to pester me anymore. Let me tell you, your country is currently being invaded by my other generals. If you don’t go back quickly to take a look, the dynasty you built with much difficulty will be destroyed!”
As Yun An finished speaking, Emperor Wu’s expression changed. In fact, he had already noticed that there was something wrong with the number of totems under Yun An just now.
“You don’t believe me? Hahaha, then let me communicate with them and let you see the miserable state of their perspective??” Yun An said.
It directly used a secret technique to contact the Black Space Divine Dragon, the Black Meteorite Yak, and the Black Ram.
These totems were all modified by it, so it naturally had a way to contact them like a Beast Tamer… This connection was not important.
Yun An then roared angrily with a look of disbelief.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!!”
Emperor Wu: “?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1082 - 1082 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (1)
chapters.content:
1082 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (1)
“Roar—!!”
Yun An roared at the sky, an angry roar that blew away sand and rocks, causing space to tremble.
Its angry appearance made Emperor Wu fall silent.
He had never heard Yun An’s miserable roar.
Even when he Maced the meteorite fragment, this guy didn’t even frown.
!!
“Wu Dong!!!” Yun An’s anger burned.
The current Yun An was indeed even more furious than having a few pieces of his body hammered off.
So be it if the fragment fell. As long as it absorbed enough nutrition, it could recover again anyway.
Elemental life forms were very tenacious.
However, every one of the twelve generals under it was modified by it with greater effort!
The resources spent far exceeded a few body fragments!
After all, this was transforming 12 overlords into 12 totems!
According to the probability of a Legendary resource having a one in ten chance of strengthening a totem, Yun An’s investment was at least dozens of Legendary resources!
It had invested all their assets in order to unify the east today.
3,000 years ago, Yun An woke up for the first time. Because he was too arrogant, he challenged the entire world alone and was attacked by a group.
Now, after 3,000 years, Yun An had learned to be smart.
After waking up, it directly developed carefully for many years, unearthed 12 top-notch overlords with good talent, and cultivated them.
Only when he gathered 12 powerful subordinates did he dare to come out.
These subordinates indeed made Yun An worry less.
There was no need for it to do anything personally. It didn’t take long for Yun An to understand the benefits of having power.
It could be said that the twelve totems were its hearts.
Even when fighting Emperor Wu, it was especially careful to avoid its subordinates being killed.
In fact, Yun An had done it.
However, what Yun An couldn’t accept was…
Instead, three of the four subordinates it sent had problems!
The Black Space Divine Dragon it trusted the most was sent to Dong Huang’s Wu Ling City. When Yun An used a bloodline mystic technique to contact it, it directly sensed that the Black Space Divine Dragon no longer existed.
A heart-piercing pain that was like a knife was transmitted from the bloodline contract, making Yun An widen his eyes.
It saw the scene before the Black Space Divine Dragon died.
It was in the huge Air Sword Formation, facing a red-eyed girl in silver armor.
The girl controlled the sword formation, and space was instantly sealed. Under the soaring sword intent, a wave that could even kill gods rose with a bang!
“Roar!!!” Amidst the angry roar, Yun An was also mixed with some Affliction.
“Quasi-divine skill!!!!!”
If it weren’t a quasi-divine skill that had touched the laws, it was impossible for it to feel the pain of the Black Space Divine Dragon so clearly just by relying on its bloodline connection!
How was this possible!!
Yun An couldn’t understand.
They couldn’t believe that there was still a life form who had mastered a quasi-divine skill in Dong Huang.
After all, the Emperor Wu in front of him had yet to cultivate a quasi-divine skill.
It was purely suppressed by the powerful power condensed by the fusion of multiple pets.
In terms of skill, it was far inferior. Otherwise, Yun An wouldn’t be so confident that Emperor Wu couldn’t heal its radiation injuries.
Therefore, Yun An really couldn’t understand why Dong Huang still had such an expert.
The Black Space Divine Dragon disappeared under her attack.
The bloodline connection was completely severed, and the signs of life completely disappeared.
His strongest general… was dead?
It was even to the extent that without a complete corpse, the body that contained the power of the bloodline had become nothing.
Apart from that.
The signs of life of the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Mountain Demon Goat had also completely disappeared.
Although he could sense that their bodies still existed and had yet to be completely destroyed, their life fluctuations had indeed disappeared.
The scene transmitted by them before they died also shocked Yun An.
That was the power of faith!!!
The faith skill that swept up the dragon might directly heavily injured the two totems to the verge of death.
The terrifying dragon might was even close to divine might, making the Black Ram and the Black Yak feel fear that came from their hearts.
“Ah!!!” Yun An also felt a heart-wrenching pain.
“Starry Sky Faith God!! The power of a meteor!”
“Who is it again!!”
Yun An was shocked and furious. Apart from him, there was actually such a strong cosmic life form on Blue Planet?
Moreover, from the looks of it… they were all under Emperor Wu!
Yun An was immediately extremely angry. He looked at the broken Emperor Wu and the totems behind him.
He originally thought that this battle was all under his control.
However, it didn’t expect that Dong Huang’s foundation was far richer than it imagined.
Emperor Wu dared to enter the enemy’s nest not only because he had broken through, but also because he had sufficient backup plans.
“Wu Dong, very good, very good. I underestimated you.”
“So you’re the one who’s fully prepared.”
“Life that has mastered a quasi-divine skill, Starry Sky Faith God…”
“You can actually kill the three generals I sent. Apart from you, Dong Huang actually has such a guy.” Yun An’s eyes were filled with anger.
Emperor Wu: “?”
The Emperor Wu in front of Yun An was seven meters tall. Although it retained its human form to a large extent, the beast characteristics on its body were very obvious.
Bull horns, dragon blood, tiger patterns, ghost armor, sparrow robe… All kinds of independent beast characteristics appeared on his body, making Emperor Wu look very domineering.
Although black blood was dripping and the armor was continuously cracking, Emperor Wu maintained his calm and tried his best to recover his strength.
Behind him, the huge Iron-eating Beast and the other totems that had yet to fuse with Emperor Wu were also covered in injuries, but they still stared at Yun An.

chapters.title: Chapter 1083 - 1083 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (2)
chapters.content:
1083 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (2)
However, Yun An confused them.
What was going on?
Someone… killed the three generals Yun An sent?
Moreover, Yun An even said that it was Dong Huang’s Beast Tamer?
What a joke.
Emperor Wu was silent. Why didn’t he remember that he had such a backup plan?
When Yun An just spoke, Emperor Wu was indeed a little worried.
After all, it was a fact that his whereabouts had been exposed and he was surrounded by Yun An and the eight Yun clan totems.
If it weren’t for the fact that he broke through first, he might really have failed.
His whereabouts had been exposed, and so had most likely the whereabouts of the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
With the top battle power of the dynasty not around, Emperor Wu thought from Yun An’s perspective. The Yun clan definitely wouldn’t miss this good opportunity.
Not only was it a good opportunity to destroy him and Ji Yunchong, but it was also a good opportunity to destroy the stability of Dong Huang.
If the Yun Race really did this, the confrontation situation between the two parties would be even more complicated.
If the city invaded by the Yun Race didn’t have enough defense power, the people would undoubtedly be plunged into misery and suffering.
As for the Iron-eating Beast Corps, they would definitely fall into a bitter battle.
In this situation, even if he successfully suppressed Yun An and obtained the meteorite fragment, it might not necessarily be a complete victory.
And the reality was that the situation was really developing in this direction.
However… the final direction of development was a little different from what Emperor Wu had analyzed just now.
This Yun An… had just said that the three totems it sent were all killed?
A life form that had mastered a quasi-divine skill? A starry sky faith god?
Emperor Wu was certain that Dong Huang definitely didn’t have such a life form.
“What exactly happened in the outside world?”
In an instant, Emperor Wu was also filled with confusion.
He looked at Yun An expressionlessly.
Was this guy lying to him?
“Surrender.” Just now, the blood from the injuries all over Emperor Wu’s body was still dripping and polluted by the darkness. And now, the injuries had already condensed.
After adjusting his state, he retracted his pet outside and punched in the air, ignoring what Yun An said.
“Extreme Martial Emperor Fist!” He roared and punched the huge Yun An in the air.
The surrounding Void and natural power instantly seemed to be absorbed by the fist and quickly condensed. The earth-shattering punch shattered the surrounding mountains with the fist wind alone.
“Wu ah ah ah ah!!” Yun An was furious.
It had never wanted to fight Emperor Wu before, so at this moment, it didn’t want to fight Emperor Wu even more.
“You’re already a dead person. There’s no point in fighting you anymore.” Yun An looked at Emperor Wu as if he was looking at a dead person.
“Your people killed three of my subordinates. Then, it’s not too much for you to return the favor, right?”
“That cosmic faith god, compensate me!!”
At that moment, although Yun An was furious, he suddenly discovered the nature of the skill that made the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram feel fear.
That creature… That creature’s skill… was very nutritious for it!
The Dragon Star Group contained the power of the cosmic meteorite and the power of faith, and as a meteorite life form, Yun An was a creature that ate meteorites.
Yun An decided that although Dong Huang had the advantage in this battle, it definitely couldn’t lose out!
It wanted the life form that had mastered the power of the starry sky!
“Secret skill, Corpse Reincarnation!”
It wanted to use the corpses of the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak to directly descend to where the cosmic life form was!
“Huh?” Emperor Wu was shocked.
His fist arrived with a bang and indeed landed on Yun An.
But at this moment, Yun An’s entire body was also filled with shocking light.
It was as if it had self-destructed or been swallowed. Its body was sucked into the alternate space from the inside out. At the same time, a shocking dark wave bloomed from its body.
It squeezed with the fist wave.
“You want to escape?” Emperor Wu immediately entered into the Void.
Boom!!!
A violent explosion directly turned an area of tens of thousands of meters into a radiation area.
A shocking wave shot into the starry sky.
A moment later, Emperor Wu’s figure slowly appeared. He frowned and searched for Yun An.
“This is the first time I’ve seen this skill.”
A voice from his pet quickly came from his body.
“Wu Dong, the skill it used just now is very special. It went very far. Hurry up and chase after it. It wants to pass you and attack the others!!”
“Hurry up and go to Ji Yunchong and the others. They might be in danger.”
“I know.” Emperor Wu frowned and flew quickly in the direction of the Dong Huang border.
Elemental creatures were what he hated the most.
This Yun An was too difficult to deal with. It was much harder to kill than the demigod tiger he had killed previously.
It had to be fine over there.
…
On the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ side.
With Buggy’s cooperation, Chi Tong directly finished off the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak.
It ended their lives by attacking their souls.
Their so-called souls were also directly imprisoned by Chi Tong in the undead space.
This time, Chi Tong could be said to have had a huge harvest.
Its Undead Revival Skill was a teaching skill. It had already reached transcendent proficiency and could control totem-level undead.
One Black Space Divine Dragon, one Black Ram, and one Black Yak. That was three!
It wasn’t to use them to fight, nor was it to Spirit Release them. Instead, it was to be a scapegoat.
With these three guys, Chi Tong felt that as long as it replenished its energy in time, its body could also withstand the burden of using the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation three times in a row.
At that moment, Shi Yu still received the shocked gazes of the army.

chapters.title: Chapter 1084 - 1084 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (3)
chapters.content:
1084 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (3)
Ji Mengzhu followed beside Shi Yu like a fangirl.
Too strong.
Shi Yu’s strength refreshed her understanding again.
It was really as strong as Emperor Wu.
No, it was even stronger than Emperor Wu.
Back when the totem battle ended, Emperor Wu was the same. Destroying totems was like destroying ants.
But at that time, Emperor Wu had already stepped into the Legendary stage.
And the current Shi Yu was clearly a legend.
“He shouldn’t be as young as he looks, right?” After knowing that Shi Yu was recruited by the entire country, the Beast Tamers in the Iron-eating Beast Corps were in an explosive mood.
It felt like a dream.
So the national conscription could recruit a powerful Beast Tamer who casually destroyed two totems?
In addition, Shi Yu looked too young, so they didn’t know how to accept it.
“No need to thank me.”
At this moment, Shi Yu smiled at General Ji Yun’s gratitude.
“If you want to thank me, it’s not too late to thank me when we go back…”
“Definitely!” Ji Yun looked at his daughter. Although he didn’t know where Ji Mengzhu had recruited such a Beast Tamer, but…
Ji Yunchong was shocked, but without a doubt, with the exaggerated strength of the young man in front of him, he could definitely obtain the highest level of treatment from Emperor Wu.
A titled general was not enough to match Shi Yu’s current strength.
He wondered how Emperor Wu would feel when he saw the young man in front of him…
“Not good, Emperor Wu!” Ji Yunchong was suddenly shocked. Then, he suddenly looked at Shi Yu.
“Sir Shi Yu, I have a presumptuous request. Just as the communication said, our whereabouts have already been exposed, so His Majesty Emperor Wu’s whereabouts must have also been exposed.”
“Even we were attacked by two totems. Then His Majesty Emperor Wu’s situation is definitely even more dangerous.”
“Yun An is the king of the Yun Race. His strength can be called a demigod, and he’s far stronger than the Heaven Eating Radiance Tiger that occupied the Ancient Capital previously. Previously, we had a conflict with Yun An, and His Majesty Emperor Wu almost lost his life.”
“This time, the Yun Race is prepared. His Majesty Emperor Wu might be in greater danger.”
“If possible, I hope Sir Shi Yu can travel with us to support His Majesty Emperor Wu. I, Ji Yunchong, will repay your kindness with all my might later.” General Ji Yunchong was extremely nervous.
The dynasty had just started, and only Emperor Wu couldn’t have anything happen to him.
However, at this moment, General Ji Yun also felt very apologetic.
Shi Yu had already saved Wu Ling City and even helped a large group of them escape. In the end, he actually wanted the other party to take the risk…
“Sir Shi Yu, please help.” At this moment, as General Ji Yun finished speaking, Beast Tamers in armor were about to kneel down in unison and ask Shi Yu for help.
Although they didn’t know who Shi Yu was, through the scene just now, they knew that Shi Yu was very strong.
Now, perhaps only with Shi Yu’s help could Emperor Wu be safe and sound.
The Iron-eating Beast Corps knew Yun An’s strength very well.
At that time, it was them who fought Yun An with Emperor Wu.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Cut it out.”
Boom.
Invisible Psychic power pulled the Beast Tamers back one by one, making them reveal shocked expressions.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “I don’t like this. Since I’m already here, I’m naturally here to help. There’s no need for you to request like this.”
“Don’t worry, Emperor Wu should be fine,” Shi Yu said.
He had heard from his future Aunt Ji Mengzhu that… after Emperor Wu stepped into the Legendary stage, his strength improved by leaps and bounds every year.
The first time he fought Yun An, he was still suppressed, but in the second battle, he could already vaguely suppress Yun An.
In the end, they almost chased after Yun An and beat him up. Yun An didn’t want to play anymore, so both parties started playing hide and seek.
However, it couldn’t be said that Emperor Wu was stronger, because from the final outcome, the winner was Yun An.
Avoiding battle and relying on the radiation poison to grind Emperor Wu to death was the strategy Yun An chose.
He clearly knew that he would definitely win and chose to fight passively. He didn’t want to waste more strength. Perhaps it was also Yun An’s intelligence.
This dragged on for more than ten years. In the end, Emperor Wu’s body collapsed. Instead, Yun An became stronger, and only then did the final tragic battle happen.
However, in the final battle, Yun An even said that he had underestimated Emperor Wu and relied on self-destruction to complete the mutual destruction.
As for the current time period, Emperor Wu was still at his peak. Perhaps he didn’t take Yun An’s poison seriously at all and was in an incomparably stubborn period. It was probably very difficult for Yun An to hold down such a Emperor Wu.
“Next…” Shi Yu looked at Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others.
At this moment, Buggy had already recovered to its normal size of more than a hundred meters to avoid exhausting its stamina too much.
After Chi Tong imprisoned the soul, Buggy just put the two corpses into its spatial pocket.
They would talk about cleansing later.
“Thank you very much.”
General Ji Yun thanked him excitedly.
“Shi Yu… thank you.”
The young Aunt Ji Mengzhu didn’t know what to say. She felt that Shi Yu was simply Dong Huang’s second savior.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu’s expression suddenly changed.
[Roar!! (Retract, can’t take it in.)] Buggy’s stunned voice came from the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak.
It was clearly just two totem corpses, but it actually couldn’t be put into the spatial pocket.
That shouldn’t be the case.
Previously, he had taken in the remains of the Black Meteorite Yak and kept it well.
“Mi?” Beside it, Chi Tong, who was in the form of a sword spirit, also shook the sword hilt, feeling confused for Buggy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1085 - 1085 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (4)
chapters.content:
1085 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (4)
Boom!!!!
They weren’t puzzled for long.
In the next moment, the corpses of the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak were directly filled with black light.
A strong wave instantly came from it, shocking Buggy nearby.
What erupted from the two bodies was not a powerful destructive power, but radiation fluctuations.
In fact, when Buggy crushed the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak just now, its body was inevitably infected with toxins. However, there was no need for Susu to cleanse it at all. Apart from the self-healing effect, its Green Dragon Indestructible Body also had a certain cleansing effect. It directly ignored these.
However, at this moment, the radiation poison that erupted from the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak for the second time exceeded Buggy’s imagination.
In just an instant, it felt a fatal threat. It definitely couldn’t touch it.
Buzz!!!
Buggy directly brought Chi Tong and teleported away, fleeing towards Shi Yu and the others.
“Roar!! (Not good, a corpse came back to life!!)”
“Mi!! (Fortunately, I got the soul.)”
After Buggy and Chi Tong flashed to Shi Yu’s side and shouted, Shi Yu immediately shouted, “Everyone, don’t resist.”
At that moment, before everyone could react, the entire Iron-eating Beast Corps, including Shi Yu, was directly teleported further away by Buggy.
After everyone came back to their senses, they were first stunned. Then, they looked into the distance in shock.
