Black mist spread out from the place where the corpses of the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak were just now. Space ripples kept shaking, and countless cracks appeared in the sky, releasing unknown magnetic field radiation.
Rip.
The ground instantly turned pitch-black. In the power that crushed everything, a terrifying aura rose. A ridiculously huge guy outlined a corner of its figure with a black shadow that covered the sky.
With the help of the corpses of the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Ram, its image gradually outlined. This was like a deer-shaped creature. Its huge intertwined horns were like continuous mountains, and its entire body was filled with dazzling black light. Just looking at it, it was as if its heart would sink into the abyss in the next moment.
Its body was incomparably huge, like a city. It was made of prismatic metal. On these metals, white and black gradually changed, emitting a terrifying Demon God aura. It was extremely oppressive. Because its body was too huge, its upper body was directly hidden in the black clouds. Only its two terrifying eyes could be seen through the clouds.
“Yun… Yun…” At this moment, when they saw this huge monster and sensed the terrifying aura it emitted, the pupils of the Iron-eating Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps who were teleported further away by Buggy constricted.
Their faces were filled with disbelief.
“Yun An!!!” Ji Yunchong and Ji Mengzhu said in disbelief at the same time.
The king of the Yun Race, the totem half-god, Yun An!
At that moment, these Beast Tamers knew why Shi Yu had told them not to resist. It was because Yun An had just descended, and a large area around it had directly become a silent place.
If they didn’t evacuate in time, just the radiation spreading from Yun An’s body was enough to fester the lives of these guys who weren’t even at the totem level.
At this moment, the Beast Tamers were stunned, unable to understand why Yun An would appear here.
Didn’t they say that Emperor Wu might be surrounded by Yun An?
“Roar!!!” In the sky above everyone, the Green Dragon Buggy circled in the sky and looked at Yun An in front of it in anger. It finally understood why it couldn’t put the corpses of the two totems into the spatial pocket.
So this big guy was behind this.
At that moment, Yun An’s appearance completely exceeded everyone’s expectations. Even Ji Yunchong’s eyes kept swaying. Even the number one person below the Legendary level would be shaken when facing a real demigod, and a powerful demigod like Yun An.
Demigods… were not in the same dimension as ordinary totems and top-notch totems at all!
Be it using Legendary resources or training a super Race Skill to transcendent, they were all considered Normal totems.
As for top-notch totems, they were strengthened by more Legendary resources on the foundation of Normal totems, or multiple super Skills were trained to transcendent and could be combined into profundities.
These were actually understandable for top-notch Beast Tamers. It wasn’t that difficult to deal with.
However, at the demigod level, that was already another level of battle power. Compared to a single super skill, the control of Normal totems and top-notch totems over super skills was above [64]. Very few exceeded [100], and demigods basically mastered super skills above [256].
In Shi Yu’s opinion, it was equivalent to one adding points 64 times, while the other had to add points 256 times.
Moreover, on the basis of adding 256 points, this creature still had to combine its skills with its race to optimize and evolve before it could be considered a [demigod].
This was an overwhelming advantage.
The growth brought by the upgrade of the Race Skill to this extent was unimaginably powerful.
The Beast Tamers and Iron-eating Beasts present looked at the incomparably huge Yun An, their eyes filled with fear. They took a step back in unison.
“Oh no.”
“Yun An…”
“We actually need support ourselves.”
“Your Majesty Emperor Wu…”
Some Beast Tamers looked at Yun An with their scalps numb.
In the clouds, Yun An’s eyes looked over casually and landed on Buggy circling in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1086 - 1086 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (5)
chapters.content:
1086 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (5)
This… was its goal.
“It’s you…”
“You killed my two subordinates.”
Its words directly made the hearts of the Beast Tamers present skip a beat. They also raised their heads slightly in unison and looked at the green dragon in the sky above them.
They instantly understood that Yun An was here to avenge his subordinates.
Because Shi Yu had sent his pet to kill the Black Ram and the Black Meteorite Yak, Yun An personally descended and came here.
“Set up the array!!!”
“Prepare to fight!!” General Ji Yun shouted, his forehead covered in sweat.
“Yes!!” The Beast Tamers and pets of the Iron-eating Beast Corps had just removed the Golden Domain. At this moment, they encountered such a dangerous moment and had no choice but to mobilize their army skills again.
However, be it Shi Yu or Yun An, they ignored this group of people.
Yun An asked the Green Dragon Buggy.
As Buggy’s Beast Tamer, Shi Yu also asked Yun An.
“Hey, Yun An, where’s my cow, where’s my sheep???”
An exasperated voice came from the ground.
A figure couldn’t take it anymore and floated in the sky with the help of invisible Psychic power, staring at Yun An.
Under the breeze, Shi Yu’s clothes and short hair fluttered in the wind. Words that stunned both parties came out of his mouth.
Yun An: “?”
“Master, it should have descended here with the bodies of those two totems. It’s a skill that’s not in the records,” Ling analyzed.
“I can tell.” Shi Yu was speechless.
Yun An had such a Skill?
Shi Yu felt a lingering fear. This was because in this space and time, he had brought the Black Meteorite Yak’s body with him for a long time. If he knew that Yun An had such a Skill, he wouldn’t have brought it along no matter what… Good thing it was delicious. He might have eaten all the Black Meteorite Yak before Yun An revived.
The Black Meteorite Yak and Black Ram they had just obtained were directly sacrificed by Yun An??
“Sir Shi Yu, be careful. That guy is terrifyingly strong,” General Ji Yun said solemnly. “It has mastered an unbelievable skill! Even Emperor Wu can’t take it head-on!”
“In addition, no matter what, it’s best not to let the pet come into contact with it.”
“Yes.” Ji Mengzhu looked around nervously. Yun An had actually descended here. This meant that Emperor Wu didn’t fight it!
Then where was Emperor Wu?!
Now, it wasn’t them supporting Emperor Wu at all.
Instead, they urgently needed the support of Emperor Wu!
“I know.” Shi Yu nodded.
At that moment, Yun An had no mood to care about others at all. It was all focused on the Green Dragon Buggy. It had paid a huge price to descend here with its injuries just to take away this Green Dragon.
Only in this way would its three dead totems not be a loss.
“Little worm, are you already prepared to withstand my anger by attacking my subordinates?” Yun An stared at the Green Dragon Buggy and directly attacked.
Quasi-divine skill, Annihilation!!
The ultimate strengthening skill of its Yun Race, the so-called radiation virus, was one of the manifestations of this skill.
If the Skill hit, it would definitely cause irreversible injuries.
Even if an injured person used legendary medicine, used divine medicine to eliminate it, obtained strong treatment, and obtained strong cleansing… It would only recover the appearance and suppress the power of destruction.
The true power of destruction would remain in the attacker’s body from the beginning to the end, unable to be completely cleansed.
This was the “law”.
A colorless mist wrapped around Yun An’s entire body, and the sound of laws that resounded through the world erupted.
Yun An’s body changed at the same time in the attack. The black metal prism all over his body flowed and turned into a huge beast form standing on two feet. He stretched out a huge palm with three claws and pinched the Green Dragon Buggy.
An earth-shattering divine might also wrapped around this pinch.
Boom!!!
Under the deterrence, the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ Golden Domain just condensed before collapsing unstable.
Everyone’s pupils constricted, unable to understand this terrifying power.
“Not good!!!” Ji Yunchong was shocked. He didn’t expect Yun An to use his final ultimate move the moment he came up.
But that made sense. As an existence that could easily kill a Yun clan general, the green divine dragon was worth Yun An’s treatment.
However… Could this green dragon resist Yun An?!
General Ji Yun couldn’t judge in his heart.
At the same time, in the face of this shocking squeeze, Buggy suddenly fell into memories.
Half a year ago, no, even longer ago, all of them had also faced a similar attack from Yun An.
Buggy still remembered the life-and-death threat it felt at that time.
They knew that they were unable to resist and could only take out the Dragon God Protection and use the Blue Sea Ruins to escape.
But now…
Buggy didn’t feel any life-and-death crisis when facing this attack.
With its current strength, it indeed couldn’t deal with Yun An alone. It could only be considered a top-notch totem.
However, it still had teammates! And Beast Tamer!
“Roar!!! [Ji!!! (Ji!! Beast Tamer, save me, Susu, save me!)]” In the sky, Buggy shouted.
The Annihilation Palm attacked, and a dragon roar resounded through the world.
The expressions of General Ji Yun, Ji Mengzhu, and the other Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps changed drastically.
But in the next moment, something unexpected happened.
A huge black summoning array appeared in midair under Shi Yu’s feet.
Legend array?!
At this critical moment, Shi Yu’s summoning did not attract Yun An’s attention at all, even if the array blocked the direction of its attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 1087 - 1087 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (6)
chapters.content:
1087 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (6)
A mere legend Beast Tamer.
“Legend?” The color of Shi Yu’s summoning array also stunned General Ji Yunhai and the others of the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
They originally thought that the green dragon was at the totem level. Shi Yu was also a legendary Beast Tamer like Emperor Wu.
However, the color of Shi Yu’s summoning array was only Legend?
How was this possible? What was going on?
Wasn’t the Green Dragon Shi Yu’s pet?
At this moment, they gradually couldn’t understand.
In the next moment, they were even more confused.
“Yun An!!!” In the distance, the Void tore.
Emperor Wu burned his blood essence and rushed over, letting out a heaven-shaking roar.
As he had expected, Yun An came to attack the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
However…
The situation here was a little different from what Emperor Wu had expected!
Emperor Wu, who had just descended in the distance, and the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps were suddenly stunned. They looked at this scene in the distance in confusion.
At this moment, a strong blue light condensed on the black summoning array under Shi Yu’s feet.
The light of the ocean spread, and a shocking aura wave swept out. A noble figure gradually appeared from the light!!
On the huge black summoning array, behind Shi Yu, a huge water elemental creature a hundred meters tall appeared in the sky in front of the green dragon.
She looked like a mermaid. She had beautiful blue long hair, bright blue eyes, beautiful appearance, and a body made of water. Her aura was incomparably noble, and she had an otherworldly aura.
What kind of creature was this?
In a short instant, countless people were puzzled. However, the holy, pure, and clear fluctuations emitted by Susu were enough to move anyone.
Even Yun An, who was opposite, was slightly stunned.
In the face of this attack, Shi Yu’s gaze was strict.
“Have you asked me before you tried to attack my pet?”
For the first time, Shi Yu’s voice was valued by Yun An. At this moment, it understood two things. First, the green dragon that had killed its two subordinates was this human’s pet.
Second, this summoned water elemental life form was also this human’s pet.
But… So what?
“Roar!!!” Yun An let out an angry roar.
At the same time, Susu’s power erupted.
Buzz!
As if its soul had left its body, a blue Sea Cleansing Spirit that looked similar to Susu directly covered the original body and erupted with a huge energy wave!!
Demigod level, Sea Cleansing Spirit!
Susu had accumulated two demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirits that could be said to be comparable to quasi-divine skills in half a year!
If Shi Yu and the others had anything that could resist Yun An…
Then, Susu’s demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit was undoubtedly the most effective!
“Crush it.”
Under Shi Yu’s voice.
This Sea Cleansing Spirit gradually expanded and gradually enlarged. Soon, it expanded to a height of more than a thousand meters. It was majestic and spectacular, corresponding to Yun An from afar. The Holy Purification aura on its body was even richer, and the energy fluctuations as deep as the ocean shocked Yun An for the first time.
Buzz!!!
The sound of laws sounded.
“Half-god!” Yun An’s expression suddenly changed drastically.
It never expected the creature opposite to suddenly erupt with such strong strength.
“What’s that…” In the distance, Emperor Wu’s expression also Upheaval.
Boom!!!
Under the shocked expressions of the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps below,
Susu’s huge palm directly smashed towards Yun An’s huge palm.
Right on the heels of that, a scene that shocked everyone to the extreme appeared. The two huge palms collided. In the next moment, a sizzling sound came from Yun An’s palm. Then, right on the heels of that, white smoke that was like a mist of ice spread from the huge water palm.
At this moment, Susu’s palm was like a monstrous tsunami that swept over, instantly devouring Yun An’s palm. Then, the water palm kept enlarging, covering the world, and swung at Yun An’s main body.
It was completely countered!
Facing such a ridiculous counterattack, even Yun An instantly revealed a panicked expression.
In the next moment!
“Roar!!!” A miserable cry sounded.
Yun An’s huge body seemed to have been splashed with a layer of water, and this layer of water was very strong. In an instant, it flipped Yun An, who was like a mountain peak, over!!
Moreover, the water of the Sea Cleansing was like boiling water. White mist kept blooming on Yun An’s body, interweaving with terrifying power.
“Ah!!!!” On the ground, the king of totems, the half-god Yun An, screamed in pain. His miserable shout spread in all directions.
Boom.
A huge dust mist shot into the sky and filled the sky.
At that moment, no matter who it was, they could see Yun An’s miserable appearance.
Ji Yunchong, Ji Mengzhu, and the others opened their mouths when they saw this. It was difficult to understand, and their brains gradually lost their ability to think.
Yun An… was defeated in one hit??
An attack that even Emperor Wu didn’t dare to take head-on was directly blasted back??
In the distance, Emperor Wu, who had just teleported over, froze when he saw Yun An directly defeated by this mysterious water elemental creature.
What happened?
Wait, wait, something was wrong.
At this moment, Ji Mengzhu looked confused. Didn’t Shi Yu say that he couldn’t resist the Yun Race, so he came to form an alliance with Dong Huang?
Then what was going on!!
“It’s not working?” In the sky, Shi Yu looked at Yun An, who still had the strength to struggle, and frowned.
“Roar!!!” When Yun An shouted miserably, it rolled its body and swept its gaze over again. It was no longer as impressive as before. It looked at Shi Yu, the Blue Sea Sprite Susu, and the Green Dragon Buggy in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1088 Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (7)
chapters.content:
1088  Shocking Emperor Wu for Ten Thousand Years (7)
"Who are you?! Who are you!!!"
Yun An was shocked to discover that not only was its quasi-divine skill suppressed in that attack just now, but the attack also landed on it, causing it even more damage than Emperor Wu's attack.
At this moment, its body, which was already covered in injuries, was already completely injured.
Yun An really couldn't understand what that attack was about. It had been a long time since he had suffered such a serious injury.
At the same time, Yun An suddenly sensed that the aura of a Emperor Wu had also appeared in the distance. He was even more panicked.
Not good!
"Tch." In the sky, Shi Yu looked at Yun An. No way.
The full-strength attack of the demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit only heavily injure Yun An??
Susu had saved up for half a year only to save two.
Could the next one kill Yun An?
Shi Yu wasn't confident.
He planned to use other pets to consume Yun An first.
He could sense that at this moment, Yun An at most had 70% of the strength of Yun An in the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation. From the looks of it, not only had Emperor Wu not grown up, but Yun An wasn't at his peak at this moment.
However, if Shi Yu wanted to fight, Yun An didn't seem to want to anymore.
After a round of confrontation, Yun An's heart was shocked to the extreme. It was continuously attacked by Emperor Wu and unknown Beast Tamers. At this moment, its heart was heavily injured.
Yun An had no idea that Susu only had two attacks just now. In addition, Emperor Wu had already arrived. In this situation, it crazily suppressed its urge. How could it still think about the Starry Sky Green Dragon? It directly rolled its body and instantly teleported thousands of meters away. It circled around Emperor Wu and turned to run!!
"Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!! (I'll definitely come back!!)" Yun An let out a miserable roar.
As long as there was life, there was hope.
Yun An chose to retreat strategically.
"Wait, wait!" Seeing this, the Beast Tamers of the Dong Huang Iron-eating Beast Corps, who had always regarded Yun An as their final enemy, were stunned. They widened their eyes and revealed incredulous expressions!!
situation to change so suddenly.
12:41
Who exactly was this Shi Yu? And what was that water-element life form?!
Yun An… didn't dare to fight… ran away?!
What a joke.
Didn't they say that Yun An was the strongest demigod?
They looked at Shi Yu in the sky in disbelief.
Yun An… was chased away?
The Beast Tamers who were still in fear of Yun An's descent just now completely didn't expect the situation to change so suddenly.
Who exactly was this Shi Yu? And what was that water-element life form?!
Why could it suppress Yun An?!
"Roar!!!" At that moment, seeing that Yun An was even suppressed, Buggy was abnormally excited and immediately wanted to chase after him.
Want to run after swallowing the sheep and cow? No way!
Sword Spirit Chi Tong instantly flew into position around Shi Yu.
Buggy immediately prepared to bring Shi Yu to chase after it.
"Senior Emperor Wu." As he prepared to pursue, Shi Yu sent a voice transmission to Emperor Wu.
At this moment, Shi Yu had long noticed Emperor Wu in the distance.
After noticing Emperor Wu, Shi Yu finally knew why Yun An was so weak. Before it descended, it had definitely been almost exhausted by Emperor Wu.
A Legendary, a legend. An expert like an ancient Legendary, and a genius who was a modern legend. At this moment, they finally met after crossing 2000 years of space and time.
"Do you want to go together?" Sword spirits surrounded Shi Yu, and behind him were the huge Blue Sea Sprite and the Starry Sky Green Dragon. In the distance, at this moment, Emperor Wu Dong no longer had the stability of a Legendary Beast Tamer.
Even when he fought Yun An, Emperor Wu had never been so shocked.
He looked at Shi Yu in front of him solemnly…
This person… What was going on? Could it be that he was the one Yun An mentioned… However, did he even defeat Yun An just now? What a joke!!
The corners of Emperor Wu's mouth twitched. He was very certain that he had seen the color of Shi Yu's summoning array with his own eyes. That was clearly at the Legend level!!
On this day, when he saw Shi Yu's, his perception of strength began the first step… He wanted to know where this person came from.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089 - 1089 Not From This Space and Time (1)
chapters.content:
1089 Not From This Space and Time (1)
“Your Majesty Emperor Wu!!”
At this moment, the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps and Ji Mengzhu were very shocked.
Not only was Yun An, who wanted to attack them, forced back by a single attack, but he also chose to escape.
At that moment, following Shi Yu’s invitation, they realized that the Emperor Wu they had been searching for had finally appeared.
Everyone couldn’t help but look over in joy.
“Come on,” Emperor Wu said.
In the face of Shi Yu’s invitation, Emperor Wu chose to pursue with him.
Although he couldn’t figure out what was going on, Yun An’s condition was indeed worse.
Moreover, the direction Yun An escaped in was far from Dong Huang and the crowd. This made Emperor Wu even less worried.
Right on the heels of that, the Beast Tamers of the Iron-eating Beast Corps saw a historical scene.
A green dragon tore through the air. Shi Yu stood on its head and chased after Yun An.
At the side, Emperor Wu flew in the air. Both parties were on the left and right, making Yun An, who was further ahead, howl and curse. He escaped even faster!
One was a Legendary Emperor that the Iron-eating Beast Corps was extremely familiar with, and the other was a super expert that had descended from the sky like a divine weapon and was recruited by the country. Even if the opponent was a demigod, Yun An, they had never been so at ease.
…
A moment later, Shi Yu and Emperor Wu chased.
“This again!” Emperor Wu couldn’t help but say.
With a boom, the fleeing Yun An’s entire body was filled with shocking light.
It was as if it had self-destructed or been swallowed. Its body was sucked into the alternate space from the inside out.
At the same time, a shocking dark wave bloomed from its body.
“Roar!!! (I won’t let you off!!!)”
Right on the heels of that, Yun An disappeared in front of Shi Yu and Emperor Wu. The strong explosive wave made them retreat together.
In midair, Shi Yu’s expression was uncertain.
“It should be a spatial Skill that can only be escaped by sacrificing a certain subordinate. Be it itself or its subordinates, the consumption is huge.”
Spatial attainments… were even above Buggy.
No wonder it could modify the Black Space Divine Dragon.
Shi Yu was not surprised that Yun An had successfully escaped.
He had chased after him this time because he didn’t think he could successfully defeat Yun An. Instead, he wanted to consume some energy or hammer a few more fragments.
If he really wanted to capture Yun An, he had to be more prepared.
“Your Majesty, you fought it just now, right? Did you collect its fragments?”
At this moment, Emperor Wu, who was standing in the air, looked at Shi Yu and said, “Yes.”
“In that case, don’t chase after it or look for it. Let it leave first. It can’t escape.”
“What do you mean?” Emperor Wu said. “Its current state is unprecedentedly weak. It’s the best time to completely kill it.”
Shi Yu said, “It’s impossible to succeed. Yun An has mastered the super self-destruction Skill. If it’s forced into a corner, we’ll all die. As an Elemental life form, it still has hope of reviving.”
“At most, it will wait for thousands of years to revive again, and if we die, we will completely die.”
“I don’t want to die with it.” Shi Yu smiled slightly. He wasn’t an iron-headed kid like Emperor Wu.
A demigod-level self-destruction could probably directly blow up his body and soul. The Undying Fruit was useless.
Repelling Yun An just now was the limit Shi Yu could do. He really didn’t dare to let Yun An fall into a desperate situation.
Otherwise, the outcome of Emperor Wu in history would be Shi Yu’s outcome.
“I just returned to Dong Huang and haven’t prepared enough. Since Senior Emperor Wu has obtained the meteorite fragments, it’s easy.”
“Lend me a few meteorite fragments later. Give me some time to study them. I can develop tools to locate Yun An and sealing tools to seal its self-destruction ability.”
“He might even be able to capture Yun An alive.”
Emperor Wu was stunned. “Who exactly are you? Why are you helping Dong Huang?”
Emperor Wu felt that the young man in front of him knew Yun An better than him and the Iron-eating Beast Tribe.
In terms of strength, it was probably not weaker than him, or even stronger.
However, he really couldn’t see through Shi Yu.
“Me? I’ve been training in the West since I was young and only returned recently. I was originally responding to the national conscription in Wu Ling City, but I didn’t expect to encounter such a bunch of things.” Shi Yu laughed.
“Wu Dong, don’t believe him.” When Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu, the voice of a pet in his body sounded.
“This guy… There are fluctuations that are rejected by this space and time on his body and his pet.”
“This person and his pet might not belong to this space and time!”
“You’re lying. You’re not from this space and time,” Emperor Wu said. “Who exactly are you?”
Shi Yu was slightly stunned.
He looked at Emperor Wu in surprise.
Shi Yu originally thought that if he transmigrated to the past space and time, among the five emperors of Dong Huang, only Emperor Shi of time or Emperor Kong of space could tell that he wasn’t from this space and time.
He didn’t expect that Emperor Wu also had this ability.
Was it his, or had he contracted a special pet of the time or space element?
“Has it been seen through?”
“Forget it, there’s nothing to hide anyway.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Then I’ll tell the truth. You can understand that I’m from a future parallel space where Emperor Wu Dynasty has already been destroyed and Emperor Wu has already died in battle.”
“Of course, since I’m already here, the history of this space and time might have to be rewritten.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, Emperor Wu widened his eyes in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1090 - 1090 Not From This Space and Time (2)
chapters.content:
1090 Not From This Space and Time (2)
The pet that reminded him just now was also shocked.
This guy came from the future?!
What a joke.
“I’m an archeologist from Dong Huang. I actually came this time to take a look at the local customs of Dong Huang and come to do archaeology.
“You…” Emperor Wu didn’t know if Shi Yu was telling the truth, but this was too ridiculous.
At this moment, he has redefined archeology.
It was even more ridiculous than Shi Yu defeating Yun An in one hit.
“You’re saying that I’ll die in battle? Emperor Wu Dynasty will be destroyed??”
“Yes, under normal circumstances, Senior Emperor Wu, you would have perished with Yun An, just like what I said just now… Therefore, I don’t recommend forcing Yun An so tightly,” Shi Yu said.
Emperor Wu’s expression changed slightly.
“If what you say is true, you didn’t come here just to help me, right?”
Shi Yu said, “That’s right.”
“I also took a fancy to the two things on Senior Emperor Wu and want to take away some extinct resources.”
“What?”
“The development experience of the top-notch Fusion Talent, as well as the ‘Fusion Skill’ you created, Your Majesty Emperor Wu.”
Emperor Wu was silent, but he felt that it was only natural.
These things were indeed the most unique on him.
“Of course, in exchange, I’ll assist Your Majesty in killing Yun An. In addition, Senior Emperor Wu, you can’t fight Yun An like this.”
“Its attack has the characteristic of being incurable and unable to be cleansed. Even if Senior Emperor Wu feels that the injuries on your body have been treated and cleansed, that’s only on the surface.”
“Actually, the damage it caused to you has always been hidden in your body. When a certain time comes, it will erupt again.”
“This is also why you’ll lose to Yun An in the future.”
“As for me, apart from helping you kill Yun An, I can also help you completely cleanse this kind of injury. It should be considered an equivalent exchange, right?”
The Fusion Skill was a super Skill manual developed by Emperor Wu himself according to his top-notch Fusion Talent. Only Emperor Wu mastered it. After the Emperor Wu Dynasty was destroyed, this skill was severed.
Shi Yu had also learned about it from Aunt Ji Mengzhu.
This skill, just like its name, could allow the two pets to fuse and evolve for a short period of time. It was similar to the fusion talent of the Dong Huang Sequence trainer, Zhou Ming.
However, one needed the cooperation of the Beast Tamer, and the other needed the pet to rely on its own strength.
Of course, the difficulty of learning this skill was also very high. Among Emperor Wu’s pets, it was said that only Zhong Xuan and the Nether Snake had mastered this skill.
It was specially developed by Emperor Wu to evolve the “Four Holy Beasts: Black Tortoise”. Its goal was to let the divine turtle “Zhong Xuan” and the undead “Nether Snake” fuse and evolve.
The reason why Shi Yu took a fancy to this skill was because the Green Dragon had been cultivated. Moreover, Buggy had mastered skills like the Four Holy Clones, so it naturally had the intention of cultivating the White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermillion Bird.
There were still so many vacancies in the second team. Every time he contracted an additional pet, the more attribute feedback he could obtain. In today’s history, apart from him, the closest to nurturing a green dragon was definitely the Dragon Emperor. If there was anyone closest to nurturing a black tortoise, it was undoubtedly Emperor Wu.
The Fusion Skill was the key to nurturing the Turtle Snake Black Tortoise.
“No matter who you are, since you helped Dong Huang avoid the damage of the Yun clan totem, I’ll thank you to the greatest extent,” Emperor Wu said.
….
Sixth Year in Emperor Wu Dynasty.
Dong Huang and the Yun Race had a second large-scale conflict.
In this battle, the half-god of the Yun clan and the twelve totem generals of the Yun clan all fought.
Among them, three totems were killed by Shi Yu, eight totems were heavily injured by Emperor Wu, and a totem that intercepted the reinforcements at the border of Dong Huang was urgently transferred back after Yun An discovered that the three totem generals had died in battle.
Under the situation where the half-god Yun An was also chased away, it could be said that Dong Huang’s side completely won.
“Your Majesty Emperor Wu, Sir Shi Yu!!”
At this moment, the Iron-eating Beast Corps at the border of Dong Huang had already met the Iron-eating Beast Corps in the Yun Nation. In the army, Ji Mengzhu and the others couldn’t help but have happy expressions when they saw Emperor Wu and Shi Yu return together.
“Your Majesty, where’s Yun An?”
At this moment, Emperor Wu had already recovered his appearance as a normal person. It was considered normal for him to be more than two meters tall among the body-forging Beast Tamers. He glanced at Shi Yu, who was yawning behind him, and said, “Yun An escaped.”
“Return to Dong Huang first and enter a battle state.”
“Soon, we’ll attack the Yun Nation.”
“Yes!” General Ji Yunhai immediately said.
“Your Majesty, are your injuries alright? Shi Yu, what about you? Are you injured?” Ji Mengzhu came over and asked about Emperor Wu and Shi Yu’s injuries.
“I’m fine.” Emperor Wu shook his head.
“I’m fine.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “But Emperor Wu has injuries. He’s forcing himself.”
Emperor Wu: “?”
Ji Mengzhu: “Ah…”
“But don’t worry, I have a way to treat Emperor Wu,” Shi Yu said.
Emperor Wu glanced at Shi Yu again. Did he really expect Yun An’s attack to affect him that much?
At this moment, in the eyes of Emperor Wu, Shi Yu was very much like a medicine seller in the martial world. He even said that he was sick even if he wasn’t sick.
Although he also felt that Yun An’s attack was indeed not that simple…
It was even very likely that they were exposed this time because of the remnant power of Yun An on their bodies.
“Then, I’ll leave it to you,” Ji Mengzhu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1091 - 1091 Not From This Space and Time (3)
chapters.content:
1091 Not From This Space and Time (3)
“By the way, Emperor Wu, Sir Shi Yu is a Beast Tamer recruited from all over Wu Ling City. According to the rules, you need to personally assess those at the Legend level.”
“It’s all thanks to Sir Shi Yu rushing over to save us this time. Otherwise, not only would Wu Ling City encounter a calamity, but my father’s side would probably be very dangerous.”
“I know. When we return to Dong Huang, I’ll thank Brother Shi Yu well.” Emperor Wu nodded. However, how was this a Beast Tamer recruited by the country? This was clearly a super expert who didn’t belong to this space and time.
If he wasn’t wrong, that green dragon was the real green dragon.
And that water-element life form that had mastered a quasi-divine skill and could cleanse the power of Yun An… Its identity was definitely extraordinary.
Green Dragon and quasi-divine skills were his highest pursuit. Now, he had yet to complete either, but this Shi Yu had completed them.
No wonder, although it was only at the legend level, its battle power was comparable to a Legendary. Future Beast Tamers were all so terrifying?
….
Although it was said to be returning to Dong Huang, it was actually returning to the border. The Iron-eating Beast Army, Emperor Wu, Shi Yu, and the others were temporarily resting at the border.
In the military camp, Emperor Wu invited Shi Yu to meet again.
Emperor Wu took out the 19 meteorite fragments of different sizes he had obtained this time and placed them on the table. “With these, you can locate Yun An’s location?”
“Also, develop tools to deal with it.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “But there’s no need for so much. Just give me ten. As for the rest, Your Majesty Emperor Wu, you can use it to evolve your Iron-eating Beast first.”
“After it evolves into a Demon God Iron-eating Beast, it should be considered one of the best among the top totem battle power. At the same time, after fusing with it, its attack resistance to Yun An will be stronger. It will be easier to fight Yun An in the future.”
“Alright.” Emperor Wu nodded and said, “I heard it from Mengzhu just now.”
“Brother Shi Yu, the resource you want should be the Iron-eating Beast inscription evolution resource, right? I heard from her that you also have an Iron-eating Beast. You came to Wu Ling City to respond to the national conscription for this.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu smiled and nodded. “This is what I need the most. If possible, please pack hundreds of copies for me to take away.”
“Evolution ingredients… I’d like a few hundred too.”
The corners of Emperor Wu’s mouth twitched. “Dong Huang doesn’t have more than a hundred of each of the eight evolution metals. There are even less than ten left.”
“So few.” Shi Yu was stunned.
Emperor Wu said, “This is a stable evolution ingredient of an overlord race. This number is already very terrifying. It’s all the resources of Dong Huang.”
“I’ve thought about your request just now. I can agree to it. As long as you can assist me in completely killing Yun An, I can give you the Fusion Technique, the development experience of the top-notch Fusion Talent, or any resources.”
“Really?” Shi Yu was happy.
“Well, next, I’ll get Mengzhu to get the best inscription evolution metal for you and let your Iron-eating Beast undergo perfect evolution.”
“That’s good.”
Shi Yu nodded. At the moment, only five of the eleven or nine original inscriptions were carved. They were inscriptions with spatial, wood, dark, lightning, and Spirit attributes.
There were still four to carve. After a fusion, there were four more perfect and super powerful top-notch super Skills.
Eleven cried out the whole day, waiting for these four Skills to surpass Chi Tong.
“Also,” Emperor Wu said, “you shouldn’t stay in this space and time for too long, right?”
“I can sense that this space and time are slowly rejecting you.”
“It shouldn’t be long before you…”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “Indeed. Fortunately, I’m not strong, so the rejection isn’t strong. I can still stay for a while.”
“During this period of time, let’s prepare well and try to destroy Yun An before I leave.”
Emperor Wu was silent.
“I’ll also give you the teaching method and corresponding resources of the fusion skill later. I’ll also give you the development experience of the top-notch Fusion Talent. However, I can’t guarantee that you can definitely use it after you obtain it.”
“The Fusion Skill is a skill I developed for the Turtle Race and the Snake Race. It’s not perfect. At the moment, only these two races have the highest compatibility in learning it.”
Shi Yu said, “That’s alright, because I want the fusion skill because I also want to nurture a Black Tortoise to give it a try.”
Emperor Wu raised his head and looked at Shi Yu. “Looks like your ambition is not small. It’s not enough that you’ve already cultivated a perfect green dragon, but you still have thoughts about the Black Tortoise.”
Shi Yu smiled. “Senior, don’t you also want all four holy beasts?”
Emperor Wu said, “So I haven’t succeeded in any of them.”
“It doesn’t matter. It’s not a precious Skill anyway. As for the experience for using the top-notch Fusion Talent, it’s the same. Although I don’t know what you’re using it for, it’s almost impossible to develop the same top-notch Fusion Talent with my development method.”
“I was able to develop the Fusion Talent a second time thanks to a fortuitous encounter in my early years.”
“I used the same method to teach other Beast Tamers who also mastered the Fusion Talent, but they can’t do it to my level anymore.”
Shi Yu said, “What fortuitous encounter? Did you need any resources to assist?”
On Shi Yu’s side, if he wanted to replicate the top-notch Fusion Talent in the modern era, the resources he could provide were only the World Tree Fruit that increased comprehension and the Body Control Talent Bead. However, if Emperor Wu said that he needed any other resources, he could also think of a way.

chapters.title: Chapter 1092 - 1092 Not From This Space and Time (4)
chapters.content:
1092 Not From This Space and Time (4)
Emperor Wu said, “Looks like you don’t know how my top-notch Fusion Talent came about. But that’s right. Apart from my pet and General Ji Yun, no one else knows this information.”
“When I was weak, I once obtained a divine-level resource called the ‘Wish Stone’. Have you heard of it?”
“No.” Shi Yu shook his head.
“The Stone of Wish should be a creation of a certain god. It can satisfy all the wishes of the user. It sounds very powerful, but the principle of it is an exchange.”
“It’s like a contract with a demon. If you obtain something, you have to give something.”
“At that time, I was a slave raised by the totem clans. I originally wanted invincible power to overthrow the rule of the totem clans, but I couldn’t afford the price of such a wish. Therefore, the wish I made was to have god-like talent and potential.”
“This time, the wish succeeded, and what I paid… From then on, I only have 38 years left in my lifespan. Moreover, my lifespan can’t be increased in any way.”
“This is the “law” that has to be followed in transactions with the Stone of Wishes.”
“Even after I became a legendary, my lifespan never increased.”
“The ability of that stone should be the use of the power of the natural order. It’s very difficult to break.”
“I don’t want to break it either.”
“I’m actually very grateful for this stone. If not for it, I might have died in the mouths of the ferocious beasts long ago. Even the entire Dong Huang might only be an amusement park for the totem clans.”
“Therefore, it can be said that thanks to the talent and potential gifted by the Stone of Wishes, I was able to successfully develop a top-notch Fusion Talent.” Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He looked up at Emperor Wu, wanting to know if what Emperor Wu said was true.
But soon, Shi Yu felt that what Emperor Wu said was very likely true.
After all, the actions of Emperor Wu, who didn’t care about his life and wanted to completely destroy Yun An and the totem clans, were something that many people really couldn’t understand in the historical records.
A Legendary Beast Tamer had a lifespan of hundreds of years no matter what. There was no need to be so anxious and persistent to fight a demigod.
However, if this Legendary Beast Tamer didn’t have much time to live, it was understandable that he wanted to clean up all the threats of the faction he had established as much as possible in his lifetime.
If it was true, Shi Yu felt that this was his greatest gain from transmigrating this time. He finally knew why Emperor Wu was so anxious to kill Yun An. Apart from wanting to eliminate the threat of Yun An, he also wanted to use the power of the meteorite fragment to become stronger and clean up more enemies.
“You were really wronged,” Shi Yu said.
After all, even now, a bunch of people were cursing Emperor Wu for constantly fighting and consuming the country’s strength.
Some people said that if Emperor Wu was willing to develop wretchedly, with the deterrence of a Legendary Beast Tamer, Emperor Wu Dynasty could last at least another hundred years. Perhaps it could last until the next Legendary genius appeared.
In short, Emperor Wu could be said to be very controversial.
Of course, Shi Yu was not interested in evaluating historical figures because he didn’t know the truth at all and didn’t want to evaluate it. If he had to evaluate it, Emperor Wu’s pet, Zhong Xuan, had given him so many resources. Emperor Wu would definitely be a wise monarch!
Emperor Wu: “?”
“Sigh.” Shi Yu shook his head. Forget it, he should give Emperor Wu another gift. When he returned, he would get Buggy to record “Lost History 002: Emperor Wu Legendary”. Just like proving Mu Huiyin and Ice Dragon’s names, he would also clear Emperor Wu’s name. Eh, did they forget to update Mu Huiyin’s legend…

chapters.title: Chapter 1093 - 1093 Eleven’s Evolution
chapters.content:
1093 Eleven’s Evolution
Emperor Wu’s situation exceeded Shi Yu’s expectations.
Shi Yu originally thought that the culprit behind Emperor Wu’s death was Yun An’s law injury.
In that case, actually, with Susu’s strongest cleansing, it could still be removed.
However, Shi Yu didn’t expect that apart from Yun An’s negative buff, Emperor Wu also had a law curse from a divine-level domain.
Lifespan was fixed. This could already be said to be a negative curse.
Susu could currently cleanse the negative buffs of the demigod level, but the divine level… Shi Yu estimated that it would be difficult.
Moreover, the form of this curse was also very strange. Even if the Sea Cleansing Spirit reached the divine level, it was still a question if it could be cleansed.
However, in the end, it was still because his strength was insufficient. Otherwise, if he directly let Eleven onto the Yin Yang Millstone, any power of laws could be obliterated.
The premise was that Eleven could control the power of the Yin Yang Millstone to obliterate the negative laws without accidentally injuring Emperor Wu… And now, clearly, it couldn’t. He would die if he tried.
“Therefore, when the time comes, you will still die.”
Shi Yu looked at Emperor Wu and said.
Emperor Wu said, “Actually, it’s nothing. I’m already mentally prepared.”
“Under normal circumstances, you would die in Yun An’s self-destruction. If history changes, what do you think?”
Emperor Wu stood up and said, “Of course it’s to charge into the Mythical Domain. Perhaps after stepping into the Mythical Domain, there will be a trace of life. To put it bluntly, apart from wanting to eliminate a threat for Dong Huang, I also want to use its power to nurture battle and break through to the divine level.”
“Unfortunately, the rules on Blue Planet are incomplete. There’s no hope for myths in the end, unless you leave Blue Planet and search for an opportunity in the starry sky.” Shi Yu shook his head.
Then, he raised his head and said, “Or, seal yourself and stop your life from flowing. Wait for the Mythical Revival Era thousands of years later to awaken and find an opportunity to break through.”
Shi Yu shrugged. The stronger one was, the more different the scenery they saw. It was known that the Mythical creatures that had not left Blue Planet in the Mythical Era had sealed their life activities and slept on Blue Planet, waiting for the Mythical Revival.
Then, he felt that this theory could also be used on legendary-level creatures.
As long as they found a way, those Legendary and demigods could completely seal themselves and wait for the blue planet’s laws to recover before coming back. It didn’t seem impossible.
Shi Yu could already imagine that after the Mythical Revival, gods might not be the only ones revived. Perhaps powerful ancient demigods sleeping in the ruins would also awaken one after another.
Not all the sealed ancient experts might have died.
“Unfortunately, I’ve tried. In any sealed state, my life will still flow away,” Emperor Wu said.
Emperor Wu said, “You’re very powerful. I’m only saying this because I suddenly feel a little emotional. Seeing your strength, I’m more at ease with the future of the human race. The history of the human race is the history of suffering, but even if there will still be suffering, a powerful Beast Tamer like you will ultimately appear.”
“That’s true…” Shi Yu shook his head and said,” Forget it. If you can find the Mythical Path and live to the future, you’ll realize that not only are humans suffering, but the entire Blue Planet is also having difficulties. There are many sufferings. ”
“Otherwise, I wouldn’t have come here to find resources to become stronger.”
The “good” days were still ahead.
If the Abyss Evil God, the Space Worm, and the others made a comeback, they would all die!
Emperor Wu: “?”
“Your Majesty Emperor Wu.”
“Shi Yu.”
“Are you guys there?”
At this moment, Ji Mengzhu’s voice suddenly came from the outside world.
“Come in.”
As Emperor Wu’s voice fell, Ji Mengzhu entered. She looked at Emperor Wu and Shi Yu in the room and said, “Your Majesty Emperor Wu, the various evolution metals of the Iron-eating Beast have been brought over.”
Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu.
Shi Yu also looked at the ancient Panda senior and immediately smiled. “I only want fire, earth, water, and wind evolution metals.”
Ji Mengzhu nodded repeatedly.
“The rest, pack them up.”
Ji Mengzhu: “?”
“Senior Emperor Wu, has your Iron-eating Beast already carved eight inscriptions?” Shi Yu asked.
“Apart from the meteorite fragment, all the other metals have been absorbed.” Emperor Wu nodded.
“Then why don’t we do it together?” Shi Yu looked at the pile of meteorite fragments on the table and said.
Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast talent potential was not bad.
Not every Iron-eating Beast had the chance to carve nine inscriptions. The more inscriptions it carved, the stricter the requirements on its physique.
But today, two giant pandas with nine inscriptions were probably about to be born here.
No… To be precise, Shi Yu’s Eleven was ten inscriptions.
Apart from the original nine inscriptions, there was also the exclusive superalloy inscription developed by Ling.
“Sure.” Emperor Wu nodded. He also wanted to see Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast.
…
At the border of Dong Huang.
Soon.
Shi Yu and the others arrived at a spacious land.
General Ji Yunhai rushed over when he heard the news. In a small place, one Legendary and three legends gathered at once.
After arriving outside, Emperor Wu summoned his Iron-eating Beast as he walked.
“Roar!!!”
A two-meter-tall panda in a restrained form with a domineering expression directly appeared.
This Iron-eating Beast had just finished the battle, but the injuries on its body had already healed.
Seeing that Emperor Wu had prepared a pile of healing resources for this battle, Shi Yu didn’t even have time to recommend the ginseng baby divine medicine. Apart from the incurable Yun An’s injuries, most of the other injuries had already healed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1094 - 1094 Eleven’s Evolution (2)
chapters.content:
1094 Eleven’s Evolution (2)
“Roar!!” After Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast came out, it greeted Ji Mengzhu and Ji Yunchong.
Then, it stared at Shi Yu with a burning gaze. To be precise, it was the summoning array beside Shi Yu.
“Wuu ~” The one-meter-tall Eleven appeared from the black summoning array and stretched. From its size and cuteness, it could be seen that Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast was not trained well in terms of the restraint state.
“Wuu!” As soon as Eleven came out, it also looked at the big guy beside Emperor Wu seriously.
The three Iron-eating Beasts worth challenging in Emperor Wu Dynasty, the Iron-eating Beast Ancestor, General Ji Yun’s trump card Iron-eating Beast, and Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast.
Eleven remembered it clearly in a small notebook.
“It’s called Eleven, right?” Ji Mengzhu immediately said when she saw Eleven.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded.
“Father, Emperor Wu, Eleven is very strong… My Iron-eating Beast can’t withstand a single move from it.”
Emperor Wu was not surprised. “Brother Shi Yu, your pets look very strong.”
Shi Yu called him senior, and Emperor Wu called him brother. Both parties discussed their own things…
At this moment, Emperor Wu had already understood.
Shi Yu’s pet that killed the Black Space Divine Dragon in Wu Ling City was actually another one! A mysterious sword spirit!
Green Dragon, mysterious water element, mysterious sword spirit…
Almost every one of them had the peak strength of a top-notch totem stage. It was simply ridiculous.
Although this Iron-eating Beast looked young and didn’t evolve completely, its strength shouldn’t be weak. Even if it couldn’t compare to those three, the Iron-eating Beast that could defeat Ji Mengzhu so easily definitely had the strength to defeat totems above its level.
Emperor Wu, Ji Yunhai, and the others were very certain.
“It’s alright.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Why don’t we let Eleven evolve first?” Shi Yu said. “It’s been looking forward to the remaining four inscriptions for a long time.”
These metals had already disappeared in the modern era, forcing Eleven to come to ancient times to fill in the gaps.
Rich lady, hungry, hungry, eating.
“Alright…” Ji Mengzhu hurriedly took out the four evolution metals Shi Yu wanted.
In the next moment, spatial ripples rippled slightly.
Four fist-sized special metal ores appeared in the outside world.
Each of them contained energy fluctuations above level eight.
For Shi Yu and the others, who were used to using Legendary resources, level eight was not high.
However, these resources were different.
When using resources on pets, the first thing to consider should actually be compatibility.
No matter how high the resource level was, if the compatibility with the pet was not high, the effect of using it would not be very good.
Just like feeding Chi Tong ice-element Legendary energy crystals, what he obtained was only joy and diarrhea. There was no strength!
On the other hand, if resources were tailor-made for pets, even if it was a low-level resource, it was possible to display a 200% strengthening range Effect that exceeded the strengthening range of high-level resources.
These inscription metals were clearly the metals with the highest compatibility for the Iron-eating Beast race. Every one of them had an enhancement Effect close to a Legendary resource for the Iron-eating Beast.
Moreover, these were the best evolution materials carefully selected by Ji Mengzhu.
“That’s it.”
After Ji Mengzhu took out the four metals of different colors, she placed them on the big rock.
Among the four metals, there was a completely golden “Xun Iron” that looked like a fallen leaf. The surrounding airflow was chaotic, and it should be a metal with wind and metal Stats.
There was also a “mirror stone” that looked like a water drop. The surrounding halo was messy, reflecting the surrounding scene like a mirror. It was a water and metal attribute “mirror stone”.
The other piece was brown and had a very irregular shape, like a random soil lump dug out. Its aura was the most ordinary. It was the “earth mother iron” of the earth and metal attributes.
The last piece of magma jelly swayed like a piece of fiery red molten metal that emitted a shocking heat. It looked the most dangerous. It was the “molten metal” of the fire and metal attributes.
“Gulp.” Seeing this, Eleven licked its lips. Who knew how long it had been looking forward to it?
“Let’s eat.” Shi Yu smiled. Eleven immediately ran over excitedly, grabbed the Xun Iron, and stuffed it into its mouth. This scene stunned Ji Yunchong, Ji Mengzhu, Emperor Wu, and Emperor Wu Iron-eating Beast.
“Crack.” Eleven ate the Xun Iron in one bite.
“Wait, wait a minute.” Ji Mengzhu was stunned. “Aren’t you going to recover to your normal state and carve the inscription?”
Just as she finished speaking, Boom!!!
Right on the heels of that, a golden cyclone wrapped around Little Eleven’s entire body. The violent Gust formed a tornado that directly swallowed it!!
Then, under everyone’s shocked gazes, white light began to linger on Eleven’s body! There were no inscriptions at all!
“Wuu!!”
Eleven roared, and its body was completely wrapped in white light. The surrounding metal-element Gust became stronger and stronger, carrying a murderous aura. Accompanied by Eleven’s full-level royal deterrence, Ji Mengzhu and Ji Yunhai’s pupils constricted.
“Roar!!!” In the face of Eleven in this state, Emperor Wu’s royal Iron-eating Beast, which had already carved eight inscriptions and had top-notch totem battle power, changed its expression and immediately took a step back.
“Above transcendent, almost extreme deterrence!” Emperor Wu said.
As expected, this Iron-eating Beast was also a monster!
“Don’t worry, its control over its body has already reached a very high level. There’s no need to stick to the form of fusing the evolution metal,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Transcendent-level superalloy, max-level hardening, and super body control that could freely switch between many forms. It would be strange if Eleven still needed to carve inscriptions step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 1095 - 1095 Eleven’s Evolution (3)
chapters.content:
1095 Eleven’s Evolution (3)
It only needed to eat the metal. Then, with a thought, it could reference the inscription path and let the corresponding digestion method directly circulate in its body to complete evolution.
It ate quickly, digested quickly, and evolved quickly. Soon, the evolution light dissipated. Eleven was still in its form and stood quietly on the spot. It raised its arm slightly, and the golden airflow was instantly pulled to its side with the movement of its arm.
Skill: Killing Wind
[Stats]: Metal, Wind
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It’s an extremely cold metal-element wind. It’s like the aura of withered plants in autumn. It can severely affect the life form of the enemy who comes into contact with the murderous wind, increasing the speed of the enemy’s consumption and injuries.
At this moment, as Eleven awakened its new Skill, Shi Yu smiled.
“Success…” At the side, Ji Mengzhu couldn’t help but be in disbelief when she saw Eleven complete a small evolution and successfully awaken a new Race Skill after just eating the Xun Iron.
There was really no inscription…!
“It’s actually so easy…” General Ji Yun had also lived for a long time and had an incredulous expression.
It was clearly an evolution method passed down by his ancestor, but when Shi Yu used it, he felt especially unfamiliar.
At the same time.
He could sense that the murderous wind in Eleven’s hand was extremely terrifying.
This was a skill that weakened the enemy’s state. Apart from being related to metal and wind attainments, the effect of the Skill was also related to the user’s deterrence level, battle Resistance, and strength of killing intent. The stronger these were, the colder and crueler the murderous wind. The more the enemy could feel fear, the greater the weakening state.
It could be said that it was a super Skill that could be perfectly compatible with deterrence.
The others couldn’t judge, but only the deterrence level could be judged. This Iron-eating Beast was definitely ridiculously high.
“Wuuu!!” Eleven was delighted.
This time… it wasn’t afraid of Buggy anymore.
Originally, Eleven’s aura was the strongest among all the members.
After all, it was a full-level royal deterrence.
However, with the killing wind, Eleven felt that as long as it polished it and suppressed Buggy again, it would be just around the corner. At the same time, the effect of the killing wind was also very effective against opponents with strong recovery abilities like Buggy and Baby Ginseng.
In the next team internal competition, he should be able to easily kill Buggy, right?
[Buggy:??? Wishful thinking!]
“Continue,” Shi Yu said.
Upon hearing that, Eleven ran to pick up the mirror stone and ate it.
“Mirror Stone can allow the Iron-eating Beast to awaken the ‘Mirror Reflection’ Skill, right?” Shi Yu said.
“Yes,” General Ji Yun said.
“This skill is very special. It’s tailor-made for the weakness of the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.”
“Actually, among the nine inscriptions, the first inscription developed was the Demon God inscription that evolved through the meteorite fragment.”
“And the Demon God Body Skill of the Demon God Iron-eating Beast can allow any Stats Skill to have dark-element effects. Therefore, when its other inscriptions evolve, there are so many Skill Stats in order to maximize the effect of the Demon God Body.”
“However, not all skills are to cooperate with the Demon God Body. The Demon God Iron-eating Beast is dark-element and is afraid of light Stats. Therefore, its Mirror Reflection Skill is extremely special among all skills. It’s specially born to counter light-element.”
Skill: Mirror Reflection
[Stats]: Metal, Water
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It can enter the mirror state and reflect light-element Skills. According to the skill level, it can strengthen the power of the light-element Skill reflected.
Obviously, this was a defensive skill against light. Ordinary Demon God Iron-eating Beasts were really afraid of light…
But…
“Wait, I remember…” At this moment, as Eleven entered the evolution state again, Ji Mengzhu suddenly thought of something.
“Eleven… has it mastered light-element lightning?!”
She clearly remembered that when Eleven fought her Iron-eating Beast, apart from the black Demon God lightning that represented the dark element, there was also a special white lightning!
“What?” When Ji Mengzhu finished speaking, General Ji Yunhai was stunned.
Didn’t he say previously that this guy had already evolved into a Demon God Iron-eating Beast?
Demon God Iron-eating Beast… was not compatible with light!
“Yes.” In the face of Ji Mengzhu’s question, Shi Yu nodded and smiled. He didn’t deny it. At this moment, as Eleven completed its evolution, it directly entered the Thunder God Armor state.
“Wuu!!”
Eleven roared, and white lightning shot out of its mouth and eyes.
White lightning wrapped around its entire body. Eleven’s black and white hair shone. It was like a thunder god bathed in lightning, and its body contained shocking divine power.
A moment later, Eleven dispersed the lightning and nodded in satisfaction under the incomprehensible expressions of Ji Mengzhu, Ji Yunhai, and the others.
“Wu wu wu.”
“You…” Emperor Wu couldn’t help but look at Shi Yu.
“Not bad, the Mirror Reflection Skill indeed has a certain increase in White Lightning.” Shi Yu was also very satisfied.
The White Lightning Skill was actually not as strong as the Demon God Body Skill.
Therefore, when using the power of light, darkness, and lightning daily, in order to balance the power, Eleven would reduce the use of the power of the Demon God to a certain extent, in order to balance with the power of White Lightning.

chapters.title: Chapter 1096 - 1096 Eleven’s Evolution (4)
chapters.content:
1096 Eleven’s Evolution (4)
But in the future, there might not be a need.
Although the Mirror Reflection could be used as a Defense Skill, it could also be used as a strengthening skill to strengthen Eleven’s Light Lightning power and increase its Enhancement Reflection power!
Apart from that… Eleven was overjoyed. Was Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction also light-element? Did it have any hope of reflecting the Moon Explosion?!
If possible, don’t ban it next time!
Baby Ginseng: “??? Dream on!”
After eating the second metal, Eleven was still very happy. It continued to look at the third metal.
Earth Mother Iron.
Without saying a word, the clueless guy ate it.
Skill: Turning Stone into Gold
[Stats]: Metal, Earth
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It can transform earth-element power into metal-element power!
Shi Yu was amused.
Eleven was also amused.
This skill could be said to be the skill Eleven looked forward to the most.
Turning stone into gold!
This skill was very strong.
Compared to earth-element, wind-element, water-element, wood-element, thunder-element environments… were very rare in nature.
Therefore, it was very difficult for metal-element pets to find a suitable place to fight.
But after turning stone into gold, it would no longer be a problem.
Even ordinary sand could instantly become a metal arena under the power of turning stone into gold.
For overlord-level Iron-eating Beasts, using this skill would allow them to use a smaller price to exchange for more metal-element natural power to strengthen themselves.
Because it could casually turn a stone by the roadside into metal.
Iron-eating beasts didn’t like to eat rocks, but if it was metal, it was a different story.
It could be said that this was still a chef skill.
In fact, Shi Yu had heard that if one practiced to the extreme with high proficiency, they could also transform earth-element resources into metal-element resources. Earth-element pets could be modified into metal-element pets. It was very impressive.
This skill was also useful for Eleven. After all, Eleven could really eat…
In the future, he would just let Eleven go out and eat dirt.
The choice of high-end resources was also greater. Eleven also used earth-element resources and snatched the opportunity!
“Wuuu!!” Sensing that Eleven’s excitement and aura were even stronger, Emperor Wu and the others understood that this little Iron-eating Beast had succeeded again.
Logically speaking, the pressure on the Iron-eating Beast would increase as it ate the evolution metal and carved a new inscription, but this Iron-eating Beast…
There was no pressure at all. It was like eating snacks as it ate all the evolution metals, as if its potential was endless!
It still wanted to eat!
Eleven continued to look at Molten Gold.
It had just finished eating water and soil. Now, Eleven wanted some hot food.
Seeing Eleven grab the Molten Gold with one hand, Ji Mengzhu couldn’t help but remind, “The absorption of the Molten Gold has the highest risk level apart from the meteorite fragment. The Skill it brings is also the most difficult to master. It requires the Iron-eating Beast to have extremely strong resistance to fire-element power…”
“Don’t worry.”
Shi Yu said. Fire resistance… Eleven was really quite powerful there.
Although fire countered metal, for Eleven, who had mastered (Perfect+47) the Metal Battle Body, it might be only inferior to metal resistance and lightning resistance.
“Wuu ~”
Under Ji Mengzhu’s silent gaze, Eleven directly grabbed the molten gold that could burn overlord-level lives and stuffed it into its mouth. It directly ate it. Then, it spat out a mouthful of white hot air and burped.
“Burp ~”
Its face was red, and it looked like it wanted more.
Moreover, in the next moment, a shocking heat bloomed from Eleven’s body. The rising high temperature directly melted the surrounding ground and the surrounding space. The sky instantly turned fiery red. Seeing this, the expressions of Ji Mengzhu, Ji Yunhai, and the others changed and they retreated slightly. Even Emperor Wu revealed shocked expressions.
If this high temperature was focused, it could probably instantly melt a Normal totem!
“How strong is your Iron-eating Beast’s fire resistance?” Emperor Wu couldn’t help but ask.
Even its Iron-eating Beast, after training this skill for so long, was not as powerful as Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast when it first awakened!
Skill: Molten Gold
[Stats]: Metal, Fire
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > Depending on its melting point, it can allow the metal that forms the body to release high fire-element temperatures that are close to or even exceed the temperature of its melting point. In a high temperature state, its fire-element resistance will increase greatly, and the speed of its energy flow will increase.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared excitedly.
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “Don’t worry, it will control its strength well. Its fire-element resistance is indeed not bad. After all, at the commander rank, it began to train its body through the Sun Fire and volcano magma…”
Everyone: “?”
A commander rank used Sun Fire and volcanic magma to train? It was metal-element Iron-eating Beast. Was this Shi Yu human?
Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast was shocked. At the commander level, it was still nibbling on bamboo in Ji Mengzhu’s arms. It looked at Shi Yu and felt that this Beast Tamer was too much.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven sensed its powerful strength and howled excitedly. It didn’t blame the Beast Tamer! It took the initiative to ask!
Unfortunately, the conditions at the Awakening and transcendent levels were limited, and it missed the best opportunity to build the foundation…
Perfect. At this moment, sensing the power obtained from four consecutive rounds of evolution, Eleven already had no regrets on this trip. It wanted to fight Yun An!! Fight ten!
No… Yun An was still a little dangerous… Eleven looked at the Iron-eating Beast that had been looking at it seriously.
Emperor Wu Iron-eating Beast:? What are you doing?
Eleven: (.?ˇ?ˇ?) Fight!!! Hurry up and evolve! Then, let’s experiment with a new Skill!

chapters.title: Chapter 1097 - 1097 First Law Revival
chapters.content:
1097 First Law Revival
“Thank you for the evolution materials.”
After Eleven finished evolving, Shi Yu was satisfied.
At this moment, Eleven was finally complete.
Next, he maxed out these four new Skills to nearly transcendent.
“Your Iron-eating Beast is a little ridiculously strong,” Emperor Wu said. “Although your pets can easily kill totems and even fight demigods, I can sense that they’re still at the overlord level.”
“The growth level of life has yet to reach the totem level.”
When its growth level reached the totem level, its life form would condense like the source, and it would be extremely malleable. This was also the foundation of totem-level life forms being able to optimize their race and skills.
In this state, the life fluctuations of pets would change. Life forms of the same level or even low-level might not be easy to detect, but for experts, they could vaguely sense the difference in the essence of overlord-level and totem-level life forms.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s just that the foundation is better.”
After half a year of bitter cultivation, Eleven and the others’ super racial skills were all close to transcendent. Some of the super skills taught had already reached transcendent. In addition to the growth increase brought by quasi-divine skills and Mythical Races, it could be said that even if they didn’t use quasi-divine skills and didn’t have the enhancement of Beast Tamers, Eleven and the others all had the battle power of top-notch totems.
If he used quasi-divine skills, faith skills, or obtained Shi Yu’s strengthening, he would be invincible below the demigod level. He would be at the top of top-notch totems, similar to the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragonman Empire.
If he didn’t have such strength, Shi Yu didn’t dare to say that he could fight a demigod evenly.
“From the looks of it, it’s filled with Warpath.” Emperor Wu glanced at Eleven and then looked at his Iron-eating Beast. “You should evolve soon too.”
“After evolution, let’s prepare for battle together and discuss how to deal with Yun An next.” Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu again.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I’ll get my assistant to intensify his research.”
On Ling’s side, it had already started to study how to locate Yun An and restrict his self-destruction. Actually, Dong Huang had started this research a long time ago.
Using history as an example, it was necessary to capture Yun An alive and think of a way to restrict the skill to seal Yun An. Otherwise, if Yun An self-destructed, not to mention renewable resources, even the dregs of resources would be gone.
Among them, Dong Huang had always had a backup of technological Arms that restricted self-destruction, and it wasn’t only targeted at Yun An. However, this weapon was extremely rare, and the number was comparable to divine forbidden Arms. As for the technology that targeted Yun An, it was a pity. Because the modern Yun An was too cunning and had mastered countermeasures to technology, it had yet to succeed.
However, Yun An had never seen a Mechanic in this era, so it shouldn’t have this consciousness. With its fragments as a medium, it should be easy to find it.
“In order to restrict Yun An’s self-destruction, I still need some materials…” Shi Yu said.
“What materials?” Emperor Wu asked.
“In order to evolve the four holy beasts, Your Majesty Emperor Wu, you should have gathered a lot of faith items of the four holy beasts, right?” Shi Yu chuckled.
On Ling’s side, it planned to take another path and combine Buggy’s Four Anti-Demon Saint clones and the power of technology to seal Yun An’s self-destruction. However, just its and Buggy’s power was definitely not enough to seal Yun An. It could only spend money.
The faith item of the four holy beasts was a very good paywall method. It could strengthen Buggy’s strength to the limit.
Emperor Wu’s eyelids twitched.
Items of the Four Holy Beasts? This guy sure was asking for a lot!
After hearing Shi Yu’s request, Emperor Wu suspected that Shi Yu had long been eyeing his collection.
He didn’t have other hobbies.
He liked to collect some antiques, especially antiques related to the four holy beasts. After becoming an emperor, he even placed all the faith items of the four holy beasts that could be found in Dong Huang in Imperial City.
Apart from liking it, the faith power contained in these things was also related to the cultivation of the four holy beasts. It was especially rare.
And now, Shi Yu directly asked for it. It was impossible for Emperor Wu not to feel the pinch…
“To use a portion and bring back a portion!” Shi Yu thought.
In the historical records, most of the four holy beasts of Dong Huang believed in antiques that were lost after the destruction of Emperor Wu Dynasty. Apart from the iron-eating beast evolution materials, Shi Yu was already here, so he naturally had to share some of these things.
“I understand.” In order to destroy Yun An, Emperor Wu endured it.
Next, Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast also successfully evolved into a Demon God Iron-eating Beast by devouring nine meteorite fragments. Its aura was even larger, and it vaguely showed signs of becoming Emperor Wu’s number one battle pet.
A demonic aura bloomed from the Iron-eating Beast. Its gaze was deep and filled with supreme power, and its confidence was overflowing.
“Success! Dong Huang’s second… No, wait, the third Demon God Iron-eating Beast!” Ji Mengzhu was especially happy to see this.
“I wonder when my Iron-eating Beast can evolve again.”
“Your Iron-eating Beast’s will still needs to be tempered again. Otherwise, it will be very difficult to withstand the meteorite fragment.” General Ji Yun glanced at Ji Mengzhu.
“Big Brother Ji is right. Mengzhu, you still have to improve, but that day isn’t far away. With Brother Shi Yu’s help, everyone can evolve after dealing with Yun An.” Emperor Wu smiled and looked at Ji Mengzhu. He and General Ji Yunchong were sworn brothers. Before he became emperor, it was all thanks to the help of the Iron-eating Beast Tribe. He naturally cared extremely about his daughter, Big Brother Ji Yunchong.
Otherwise, it was impossible for him to let the other party be in charge of taking care of the young royal Iron-eating Beast he chose.

chapters.title: Chapter 1098 - 1098 First Law Revival (2)
chapters.content:
1098 First Law Revival (2)
“This kid is stronger again.” And after seeing the evolution of the Emperor Wu Iron-eating Beast, Zhong Xuan cursed at the Emperor Wu pet.
From the looks of it, he probably couldn’t defeat this little bear alone without fusing with the Nether Snake.
Before Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast evolved, Emperor Wu also released his other battle pets one by one and witnessed the evolution of the Iron-eating Beast together.
Emperor Wu’s current nine battle pets were Iron-eating Beast, Pseudo Green Dragon, Pseudo White Tiger, Pseudo Vermillion Bird, Zhong Xuan, Nether Snake, Emperor Wu Armor, Divine Tree of Life, and Ethereal Time Monkey.
Among them, Shi Yu was the most familiar with Zhong Xuan. He sighed with emotion. The Zhong Xuan turtle from the original space and time definitely didn’t expect that he would actually transmigrate back and see Emperor Wu. Moreover, it planned to kill Yun An with Emperor Wu.
“Roar.” At this moment, the Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had completed its evolution glanced at Zhong Xuan and the other pets, especially the old turtle Zhong Xuan, with a rather smug expression.
From today onwards, it would be Emperor Wu’s strongest trump card!!!
It already had this foundation!
“Don’t be arrogant. Respond to its enthusiasm first.” Zhong Xuan muttered and looked at the little panda beside Shi Yu who was warming up with straight punches, straight punches, uppercuts, and left hooks.
“Roar!!!” Emperor Wu’s other pets also joined in.
As the ninth member of Emperor Wu Team, the Iron-eating Beast’s strength progress was the fastest. These seniors felt a sense of danger.
The Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had just evolved definitely had to adapt to its skills through battle. To be honest, none of them wanted to be that sparring partner.
Therefore…
In the next moment, the Iron-eating Beast looked at Eleven and the smiling Shi Yu. “…”
It was rather speechless. Did this little guy want to fight it so much?
“Cough.” Shi Yu realized that Emperor Wu’s team seemed to be quite messy. They weren’t inferior to his team. These nine pets all had the Will of overlords. They were quite impressive.
“We can indeed adapt to each other. Senior Emperor Wu, let them stop when it’s time.”
“In the future, the other pets have to understand each other and nurture tacit understanding,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes,” Emperor Wu said. “I have a quasi-divine-level ruin I carry with me. It’s a place I often train. Let them train there.”
Emperor Wu felt that Shi Yu would be a very good sparring opponent.
After reaching the Legendary domain, those who were evenly matched were all enemies. There were not many opportunities to spar at the same level. He felt that after preparing for battle with Shi Yu, his overall strength could still increase.
It was the same for Shi Yu. He felt that after sparring with Emperor Wu, who was famous for his battle power in history, his overall strength could increase greatly.
“You guys…” General Ji Yun smiled bitterly.” I wonder if I can take a look at the spar between the two Iron-eating Beasts. ”
“I want it too…” Ji Mengzhu said.
When Shi Yu heard that, he smiled and said, “Then I’ll summon all my pets too.”
With Emperor Wu’s nine totems as sparring partners, how could Eleven fight alone?
Emperor Wu nodded. Then, Shi Yu began to summon Buggy and the others. However, this summoning made Emperor Wu and the others fall silent again.
Buzz!!
A total of nine black summoning arrays appeared in all directions of Shi Yu, making Ji Mengzhu and Ji Yunchong widen their eyes.
They carefully counted… one, two, three… nine!
They rubbed their eyes and were very sure that he didn’t count wrongly.
As the nine summoning arrays appeared, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling’s clone, Little Ji, Duckie, Little Purple, and Qi came out. Even Emperor Wu was a little stunned.
Was something wrong?
The legend Beast Tamer was a level-seven space. Logically speaking, there should only be seven contract slots. However, including the Iron-eating Beast that was already outside, Shi Yu had already activated ten summoning arrays and summoned ten pets!!
After all, this was the number of contracts that only Mythical Beast Tamers had!
“Roar! ~ ~” After Buggy and the others came out, their gazes immediately landed on Emperor Wu’s group of pets, especially Buggy, who immediately locked onto Emperor Wu’s Green Dragon.
Among the pets summoned by Shi Yu, Cube Ling was only a clone. It was in charge of arranging battle plans for the other pets. Its main body was still researching the secret Arms against Yun An.
Qi had just woken up, but she was still blurry. She pulled Little Zi beside her and hugged her as a pillow. Her cherry mouth opened and she yawned.
“Ten… ten!!” Ji Mengzhu was at a loss.
However, why were most of Shi Yu’s pets so small and looked so harmless!
In fact, there was even a ginseng baby.
The only two who looked like experts were the huge lava dragon and the Demon Duck that emitted an abyss-like terrifying aura.
Shi Yu explained, “My Beast Taming Space has been strengthened, so I can contract more pets.”
At this moment, for the first time, Emperor Wu revealed an envious expression. If he could also contract more pets, his physique would definitely be stronger.
“Is this the sword spirit that killed the Black Space Divine Dragon?” Emperor Wu looked at the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation that had shrunk to the size of Qi and was like a mini Sword Maiden.
“But I’m more curious. It…”
Emperor Wu looked at the Blue Sea Sprite Susu in the form of a Water Slime and felt that it was unbelievable.
“I have some guesses about its identity and race, but I don’t know if it’s correct,” Emperor Wu said to Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1099 - 1099 First Law Revival (3)
chapters.content:
1099 First Law Revival (3)
“What guess?” Shi Yu said.
“The legendary strongest demigod, the guardian of the sea, the Blue Sea Sprite that has mastered the strongest cleansing power,” Emperor Wu said. “That Blue Sea Sprite that hasn’t appeared in 1,000 years.”
“What?!” As soon as Emperor Wu finished speaking, General Ji Yun and Ji Mengzhu suddenly looked at Susu.
“Ning.” Susu sighed. When could it escape its identity as an Blue Sea Sprite and become a Star Sea Sprite?
“Well, the reason why I said I could help Senior Emperor Wu cleanse your Yun An radiation is because of it. Unfortunately, it’s in the reincarnation stage now and hasn’t completely recovered its strength. For example, the number of times it can release the attack that repelled Yun An previously is limited,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s really the Blue Sea Sprite?” General Ji Yun said in disbelief.
This was a legendary race!
It was a hundred times longer than Yun An’s legendary history!
He looked at Shi Yu in disbelief. What exactly was this person’s background?
“You…”
After a moment of silence, Emperor Wu’s gaze swept across Shi Yu’s pets again. Among them, he couldn’t see through Little Zi and Qi the most. These two guys had the weakest strength fluctuations, but the feeling they gave him was the most special.
“Looks like there’s going to be an increase next,” Emperor Wu thought.
….
In order to prepare for the next battle with Emperor Wu, Shi Yu and the others entered Emperor Wu’s ruins space together.
