Be it Ji Mengzhu or General Ji Yun, they were both very curious about which was stronger, Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast or Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast.
“One level higher than your opponent. If you lose, don’t say we trained you.” Zhong Xuan and the other seniors encouraged Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast.
“Roar!! ~” Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast maintained its Demon God form. Its entire body was enveloped in darkness, and it kept roaring. Tch, it was so annoying. No matter how strong the opponent was, it was only at the overlord level. Everyone had nine inscriptions, so how could it lose?
Moreover, although that little Iron-eating Beast was also a royal, from the looks of it, it should have evolved towards Wex’s secondary Stats.
And it evolved towards spatial secondary Stats.
In terms of Stats, it had already suppressed the other party.
In fact, that was indeed the case. Be it Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast or Ji Yunchong and Ji Mengzhu’s Iron-eating Beast, they all evolved towards spatial secondary Stats. In comparison, Shi Yu chose lightning out of helplessness.
It wasn’t that he didn’t like space, but at that time, he really didn’t have the money to raise a spatial pet. Spatial resources were so expensive.
On the other hand, lightning… Eleven could eat anything.
However, Shi Yu didn’t regret it. The lightning wasn’t weak either!
Emperor Wu and Shi Yu didn’t plan to attack. They threw their Iron-eating Beasts over for them to spar.
If the two of them also attacked, this ruin might not necessarily be able to withstand it. As a legendary Beast Tamer, even if Emperor Wu fused with the Iron-eating Beast alone, its battle power after the fusion was enough to be called the strongest below the demigod level. It might not be impossible to hurt demigods.
If Shi Yu attacked, it would be the profundities of Eleven’s dual quasi-divine skills. He would also insta-kill whoever he saw below the demigod level. There was no need for both parties to work so hard. Therefore, just looking at the two pandas practicing with each other was enough.
“Roar!!!” Although Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast didn’t know why Eleven wanted to challenge it so much, it accepted it!
The huge Demon God Iron-eating Beast stood on the ground and looked at the little panda opposite it.
“Let’s enter the form of a Demon God,” the Iron-eating Beast said.
“Wuu.” Eleven shook its head.
“Wu wu wu. (Might not be able to win in the form of a Demon God.)”
The Iron-eating Beast was amused. “Don’t worry, I’ll show mercy.”
“Roar!!” “Yi!!” “Mi!!!” “Ning!!” Behind Eleven, Buggy and the others reminded Emperor Wu Iron-eating Beast that Eleven didn’t mean that!!
Opposite Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, Little Eleven had a serious expression and said, “Wuu! (I’m going to enter a full-strength chaotic state from the start. Senior, be careful.)”
The Iron-eating Beast was stunned. Huh?
Boom!!!
In the next moment, under the change in the expression of Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast, Little Eleven, who was opposite him, directly entered the chaos form. Its body gradually enlarged under the eruption of lightning that shot into the sky.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared at the sky.
During the enlargement process, black and white electric arcs filled the sky and fused into Eleven’s hair. They kept floating like a chaotic ocean.
Wherever it stepped, it turned into lightning. The black and white ground was connected to light and darkness.
At this moment, Eleven was like a god walking out of the chaos lightning sea.
At this moment, the aura of a supreme god also erupted from Eleven’s body, shaking the sky and earth, reversing the universe, forcing the Demon God Iron-eating Beast that had just evolved to subconsciously take a step back with a stunned expression.
What was this!!
At this moment, it wasn’t just Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast. The expressions of Ji Yunchong, Ji Yunhai, and the others were stunned again. Even Emperor Wu couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth. He looked at Shi Yu, wanting an explanation.
“I never said that it was also a Demon God Iron-eating Beast… It has already completed a new round of light and darkness evolution on the foundation of the Demon God Iron-eating Beast.”
“I name it Chaos Panda. It’s a Mythical Race,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Aba, Aba, Aba…” At this moment, the expression of the Emperor Wu Iron-eating Beast, which originally wanted to prove its strength to the seniors, stiffened. It suddenly had a bad feeling.
Zhong Xuan and the other pets also swallowed their saliva and looked at the powerful Eleven in confusion. Damn, no way. The Iron-eating Beast had already f*cking evolved so many times, but it could still evolve again? Mythical Race, what a joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100 - 1100 First Law Revival (4)
chapters.content:
1100 First Law Revival (4)
….
At the same time, in the original space.
Just as Shi Yu was going to the past to harvest resources and find a Legendary sparring partner to practice with the ancient Yun An, a huge event that affected the entire world happened here.
Boom.
As the world trembled, as a sound of laws that all life on Blue Planet could hear spread throughout the entire world, the world of Blue Planet changed drastically.
Inatella, the sleeping World Tree opened its eyes again, but it quickly fell asleep again.
It was just a sign of the revival of laws.
It was far from the stage where the laws completely recovered their Restoration.
However… there might be chaos outside. The World Tree knew this very well.
For the World Tree, for the Blue Planet’s Will, this huge change in the world was only a sign of the revival of the laws of Blue Planet, but for the other creatures on Blue Planet, it was an incomparable gift!!
With this huge change, those creatures close to the demigod level were still a little short of cultivating a quasi-divine skill. For example, the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragon Empire was shocked to discover that the power of laws that was difficult to touch previously could actually touch a threshold at this moment.
In the Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King, who was cultivating in seclusion, laughed out loud. As its aura rose steadily, its laughter shook the sky.
“Demigod. Give me a little more time. I’ll also be a demigod!!! At that time, what can a mere Dong Huang do to me?”
Apart from creatures close to quasi-divine skills who felt that it was easier to touch the power of laws, those overlords and totems suddenly realized that the natural energy in the world was even more abundant. Under the shower of rich natural energy, their growth state was unprecedentedly good.
Those overlords who were stuck at the bottleneck felt that the opportunity to break through was getting closer and closer to them.
This change that was like the recovery of natural energy was not only for high-level lives, but also for those Awakening, transcendent, commander, and monarch lives. It was also an opportunity to change their fate.
At this moment, the outside world seemed to have become a high-level ruins space and mystic realm space. No matter what life level it was, it felt that its growth speed far exceeded before.
Countless energy crystal mineral veins were born because of this, and countless natural phenomena appeared everywhere.
Apart from that, many Mythical creatures like Qi who had reincarnated gradually opened their eyes, and memories appeared.
Seven island countries.
“Little brat, do you want to become stronger? Seeing that you’ve taken care of me for so long, I’ll give you a chance to enter the God Domain.”
“…” The young man looked panicked.
“Let me ask you, do you want to become stronger?”
“As long as you listen to me, you can do it.”
“Because I’m… a god!!”
…
As the first revival of the laws, something unexpected happened in the world. The memories of the reincarnated gods woke up, and many overlords broke through to the totem level. New demigods were even born.
In the Dong Huang Association, President Lin held a high-level meeting solemnly. The main content of this meeting was the reincarnation of a god with revived memories!!
Some of these god reincarnations had just awakened their memories and mastered quasi-divine skills. Some were still very weak after awakening their memories. Some were powerful ferocious beasts that had already become famous, and even national guardians. Some were pets that had already been contracted by human Beast Tamers with different identities.
The main Quests of President Lin’s meeting this time were that Dong Huang had to actively welcome this change. Firstly, they had to rope in the reincarnations of the gods who had just awakened their memories and were wandering outside.
“I’ll leave this mission to Bureau 11…” President Lin gritted his teeth and looked at Shi Yu’s empty seat. In the end, he sighed and said, “If Shi Yu isn’t around, I’ll leave it to Lu Qingyi. Lu Qingyi is the main in-charge. Apart from searching for the god with revived memories, remember to look for Shi Yu too.”
On a certain panel of the huge conference screen, after becoming a titled legend, the more mature Lu Qingyi nodded and said, “I understand.”
“Remember to look for Shi Yu first.”
President Lin was tired. He didn’t know if the sudden revival of the laws was good or bad. As the laws revived this time, he kept feeling that Blue Planet’s battle power was about to undergo a huge update… The more factions he roped in Mythical creatures, the greater the right to speak on Blue Planet. At such a critical moment, he didn’t know where Shi Yu had gone…

chapters.title: Chapter 1101 - 1101 The Worst Demigod in History (1)
chapters.content:
1101 The Worst Demigod in History (1)
A week later, the autumn wind blew.
Eleven stood on the golden ground and looked at the fallen Demon God Iron-eating Beast opposite it. It let out a sixth triumphant roar.
It, the Panda King, was invincible!
In the blink of an eye, a week passed. Emperor Wu’s heart ached even more.
Under Baby Ginseng’s healing, his pet and Shi Yu’s pet started a week of high-intensity sparring special training.
The cruel truth was that in a one-on-one battle, Panda King Eleven, Green Dragon Buggy, Baby Ginseng Emperor, Sword Maiden Chi Tong, Star Sea Sprite Susu, and the ultimate Mechanical Ling were almost impossible to defeat.
Every pet of Emperor Wu couldn’t defeat these six pets in a one-on-one situation.
Only Little Ji, the overlord who could bully the land, and Duckie, the overlord of the ocean, found a chance of winning here.
In a week, Shi Yu had already copied the [Fusion Technique] into his hand.
Shi Yu had already obtained the EXP for Emperor Wu’s top-notch Fusion Talent development.
He even packed a lot of evolution materials and countless items of the faith of the four holy beasts.
In exchange, Susu used a portion of the demigod-level cleansing power to help Emperor Wu and the others remove the remaining incurable injuries in their bodies.
At the same time, Shi Yu provided the World Tree Fruit, allowing Emperor Wu to develop his top-notch Fusion Talent faster. The current Emperor Wu could already fuse eight pets at the same time.
It was already very close to the peak stage of the fusion of nine pets.
At that moment, Ling had also completed the positioning device and restriction Arms. Shi Yu and Emperor Wu were discussing the final overall attack.
“Yun An should still be healing his injuries now. It’s just nice to launch a Pounce on it.”
“At that time, my ginseng baby will carry out the first round of attack.”
“Buggy, Ling, you’re in charge of restricting Yun An’s escape and self-destruction and maintaining the restriction domain.”
“Then, Senior Emperor Wu, you guys launch an all-out attack. The target is Yun An.”
“Eleven, Chi Tong, and I are in charge of dealing with its generals and subsequent support.”
“This is the most ideal situation. If an accident happens, it will change according to the various directions analyzed by Ling.”
“That’s the arrangement.” Emperor Wu nodded and looked at Shi Yu seriously.
“I hope everything can go smoothly. I look forward to a real battle with you after defeating Yun An.”
Emperor Wu referred to the real battle where the Beast Tamers of both parties also participated in the battle and all their pets fought.
He admitted that he had lost in a one-on-one battle between pets.
However, if it was a full-strength battle, Emperor Wu believed that he definitely wouldn’t lose. After all, nine combined into one was enough to suppress demigods.
“Alright,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
At that time, a fusion martial artist vs a fusion mecha.
“Your Majesty Emperor Wu, Shi Yu.” As the overall attack approached, the Iron-eating Beast Corps’ defense of the border was even stricter. As a messenger, Ji Mengzhu reported to them,
“Everything is ready.”
“Alright, half a day later, at sunrise, we’ll officially launch an all-out attack!!” Emperor Wu said.
[You have to return successfully.] Ji Mengzhu didn’t sleep well this week. She had been worried that the two of them would launch an all-out attack today.
In a complete battle with Yun An, although he felt that his side had a huge advantage, the opponent wasn’t weak either…
“There’s no need to worry too much. Victory belongs to us,” Shi Yu said very confidently, as if he had seen through Ji Mengzhu’s worried heart.
In history, Emperor Wu alone could shatter Yun An. Now that he had his support and was so well prepared, if the two of them couldn’t shatter Yun An, they could directly retire on the spot.
As Shi Yu and Emperor Wu set off, at the border of Dong Huang, the fully armed Iron-eating Beast army looked into the distance. General Ji Yun stood on the high platform, waiting for the good news from the two of them.
….
At the same time, through his telepathy, Shi Yu pulled up a telepathy chat room for all his pets, Emperor Wu, and all his pets.
At this moment, Emperor Wu already knew that Shi Yu had a telepathy talent. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be so confident that the winner of the team battle with a Beast Tamer would definitely be him.
However, it was also a pity that an expert like Shi Yu only had a telepathy talent.
In the void, Shi Yu rode the Green Dragon with a compass-like tool in his hand. The Ethereal Time Monkey of Emperor Wu’s Fusion Time and Space attributes flew in the air. Everyone was using the telepathy chat room to talk.
[Shi Yu: The location of Yun An has been confirmed. The other party should be hiding in a hidden mystic realm in the Yun Nation.]
[Shi Yu: Senior Emperor Wu, how high can you fly to? Do you want to compete?]
[Emperor Wu: Don’t underestimate me.]
[Ethereal Time Monkey: Yun An is really unlucky to have encountered you.]
Emperor Wu’s pets trembled. They knew very well how disgusting Shi Yu’s next plan was.
Boom boom boom.
As Shi Yu smiled, in the void, the Green Dragon Buggy adjusted its direction and headed straight for the starry sky.
Emperor Wu also flew higher and higher.
Unfortunately, technology had yet to develop in this era. Otherwise, there would definitely be a country that could see a flash of green light suddenly arrive at the starry sky from the direction of the Blue Planet.
However, this was not Shi Yu and Emperor Wu.
Only two pets arrived in the starry sky.
To be precise, it was a pet and a phantom clone.
Buggy Phantom and Baby Ginseng!
After riding the phantom of the Green Dragon Buggy to the starry sky, Baby Ginseng absorbed the power of the sun and moon to its heart’s content.
[Baby Ginseng: Command, command, this is the ‘Bombardment Ji’ team.]
[Baby Ginseng: We have arrived at the starry sky. All the bombs are ready. Wait for the command, over.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1102 - 1102 The Worst Demigod in History (2)
chapters.content:
1102 The Worst Demigod in History (2)
[Shi Yu: Take root in the Sun, Moon, and Meteorite and prepare to attack. Over.]
[Baby Ginseng: Roger!]
Swoosh!
In Baby Ginseng’s vision, a light spot approached and streaked across a huge super meteorite that contained the power of the sun and moon.
Under the Teleportation of Buggy’s phantom, Baby Ginseng instantly arrived on it and descended from the starry sky. Its target was the mystic realm where Yun An lived.
[Emperor Wu Members: Terrifying.]
At this moment, in a hidden legendary mystic realm of the Yun Nation, Yun An was still recuperating. The injuries it suffered were far more serious than Emperor Wu.
Most importantly, Susu’s attack was too painful. It was so painful that it wanted to die.
At this moment, Yun An had already sent his subordinates to find out Susu’s identity.
It was suspected to be the strongest ocean demigod, the Blue Sea Sprite!
“Damn it.” Yun An cursed. Be it 3,000 years ago or now, its gaze was only on the east.
Who would have thought that the strongest demigod in the ocean would actually appear at this moment? Moreover, he had become the pet of a human Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu, in addition to Emperor Wu, Yun An felt that his plan to unify the east might be delayed again.
At this moment, Yun An even had the thought of going to the Western Continent.
The competition in the east was too cruel.
Why not… become a Western overlord?
However, it wasn’t convinced!!
“Eh, it smells so tempting.” Yun An, who was lying in the meteorite pile and bathing in the darkness, suddenly opened its huge eyes.
“The gains this time are not bad.”
It grunted and sensed the outside world of the mystic realm.
In order to heal its injuries, it sent many subordinates to other totem countries to find resources to recover its Restoration.
This time, when he smelled the fragrance, Yun An subconsciously thought that his subordinate had brought back supplements.
The tempting resources weren’t around either. Instead, they seemed to be high in the sky!
Yun An’s perception went infinitely upwards.
A meteorite that contained the power of the sun and moon was descending from the starry sky!
Yun An was first stunned, then it realized that something was wrong. It suddenly widened its eyes.
There was also a tree on the huge asteroid-like meteorite.
It was a towering divine tree more than ten meters tall. Fruits filled with tempting fragrance swayed on the tree.
A huge cream-colored trunk, emerald green leaves, moon-like golden branches, sun-like fiery red flowers, fruits that looked like ginseng babies, decorated this complete divine tree.
Countless ginseng baby clones pulled at the branch with tears in their eyes, afraid that they would be thrown down. Countless Sun Divine Trees grew on this meteorite, making it like a falling sun, the afterglow of the setting sun!
Strange, too strange.
Yun An felt that it was too strange.
However, the tempting aura emitted by the meteorite and the World Ginseng couldn’t help but move even Yun An, an Elemental life form.
“I want to eat it so much.”
It was this hesitation that Shi Yu and the others’ greeting gifts had already arrived.
Baby Ginseng first raised the [Time Fruit] to the [Little Divine Skill] through the [World Kindness]. Then, it used it on its own, allowing its life level to temporarily reach the totem level. Then, it transformed into the [Life Fire Seed] and burned the potential and life brought by the [Plant Control] and the [Green Wood Divine Body]. It instantly obtained battle power close to the [Demigod level].
Moreover, at the last moment, it triggered [Moon Explosion] and displayed an attack that would shock even a demigod.
In the mystic realm, Yun An originally thought that it was hidden well. Even if it was also at the demigod level, it was impossible to find it. However, looking at the meteorite falling from the sky, flames slowly burned in its eyes.
Its natural instinct to sense danger suddenly made its entire body tense.
Bang… Bang… Bang… The heart core beat crazily.
“Attack!!!” At this moment, Yun An finally realized that it wasn’t to have something fall into its lap at all. Its pupils constricted. That was a trap, an attack from the enemy!!
Moreover, its power caused an alarm in its body through a Legendary space!!
[Baby Ginseng: Successfully arrived at the designated spatial coordinates. The ‘Bombardment Ji’ team is about to use ‘Yiji Surefire Kill’. Over.]
Boom!!!!
[Contract System: Baby Ginseng has gone offline.]
A shocking light of the sun and moon bloomed in midair. The impact of the explosion instantly shattered the spatial barrier where Yun An was. The terrifying light Devoured the extremely shocked Yun An inside.
Yun An seemed to see a strong light. The feeling it gave was even more dazzling than a million suns and moons.
At the same time, light blasted in all directions!!
This was the most powerful self-destruction used by Baby Ginseng. It was rooted in Buggy’s Sun Moon Dragon Star to absorb nutrients. The self-destruction of the full buff was comparable to the full-strength attack of a demigod.
In a short moment, a huge light fireball more than ten thousand meters tall rose into the sky. An energy wave swallowed the ground, and strong light and wind mercilessly destroyed everything in the Yun Nation.
This radiation land that had been occupied by Yun An and was no longer alive instantly suffered an even more tragic blow. In almost a few seconds, one-third of the country was instantly moved to nothingness. Countless tall mountains were erased, countless lakes evaporated, and everything disappeared.
At the border of Dong Huang, the Iron-eating Beast Corps guarding here immediately felt a strong earthquake. After hearing the huge sound, they didn’t even dare to look at the strong light in the distance.
“It’s starting!!” General Ji Yun and the others’ hearts skipped a beat. They understood that the two parties had already started fighting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1103 - 1103 The Worst Demigod in History (3)
chapters.content:
1103 The Worst Demigod in History (3)
Tingxiang, Snowfield, Seven Islands, Rongguang, Ming Hua, and experts from all over the world sensed the weak atmospheric disturbance in the sky with this attack. They looked at the sky and the chaotic east.
It really didn’t stop…
[Emperor Wu Members: Monster!!!]
Looking at Baby Ginseng, who had launched the first round of attacks, the corners of Zhong Xuan, the Divine Tree of Life, and the others, who had sparred with Baby Ginseng in the mystic realm, twitched.
Was this the suicide self-destruction attack Shi Yu mentioned in the first round?
When they heard Shi Yu say that, they thought that Shi Yu was crazy.
Until Shi Yu said that his ginseng baby had mastered the time-element revival Skill…
Now, Emperor Wu and the others had finally seen the supreme art Shi Yu mentioned. Even Emperor Wu couldn’t help but feel extremely solemn!!
It was really a monster. Previously, they had completely underestimated the power of this attack.
The power of this attack was enough to destroy smaller totem countries.
Even Emperor Wu felt that he would be heavily injured by this attack in his full state.
This was still the result of the power of this attack being too scattered.
Baby Ginseng’s Moon Explosion had this disadvantage. The explosive power was too scattered.
Even if it was close to transcendent proficiency, its strength was still scattered.
This was also why it had to run into the enemy’s mouth if it wanted to maximize the effect of its self-destruction.
If its strength could completely concentrate in a small range, Shi Yu felt that there was no need for others to attack at all. Baby Ginseng could shatter a demigod itself.
Shi Yu hoped that after Moon Explosion reached transcendent, this point could be improved.
He also hoped that after the time mark reached transcendent, there would be greater changes. For example, he could revive twice in a row, or he could give others the time mark.
The greatest characteristic of the current perfect-level time mark was that it no longer needed Baby Ginseng to condense it itself. After it was consumed, it could automatically spend time to condense it, saving Baby Ginseng a lot of energy.
“Roar!!!!” A miserable cry that resounded through the sky came from the explosion.
Yun An wasn’t directly blown up.
Shi Yu and the others were not surprised by this. After all, there was a Legendary spatial defense. At this moment, in the center of the strong light and high temperature, Yun An seemed to have turned into a black hole. No matter what power was outside, it was being absorbed by it.
Sensing that the wound that had just recovered pretty well had cracked open again, Yun An let out a miserable cry, pitiful and helpless.
At this moment, although Yun An didn’t know what was going on, it only had one thought: escape!
However, before it could react, another forbidden Arms was thrown down from the deep sky.
[Ling, Buggy: This is the “Green Dragon”. The special forbidden Arms “Four Saints Domain Bullet” has been fired. Please take note.]
Yun An was shocked.
There was another boom.
A dazzling white light enveloped this area again. However, the forbidden Arms this time were not attack-type Arms, but domain-type Arms.
White light kept spreading. Soon, four phantoms ten thousand meters tall appeared in the huge range created by Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction, the phantoms of the four holy beasts!
They connected. A huge domain watered by the power of faith and the power of the starry sky enveloped and sealed most of the Yun Nation.
In the domain, all natural power and spatial power were suppressed. There was even a special power that forcefully restricted the energy flow changes in Yun An’s body.
In the sky above the center of the domain, Buggy, which had been strengthened by Ling’s transcendent nine-colored divine light, and Ling itself were maintaining the entire domain. They stared at Yun An together and restricted its movements.
“Roar!!!!” At this moment, Yun An was extremely angry and panicked. He wanted to break free, but Shi Yu and the others’ plan was very tight. Just as the power of the center of Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction receded a little, Emperor Wu tore through the Void and quickly descended from the sky!!
[Shi Yu: Senior Emperor Wu, it’s your turn. Remember not to kill Yun An and make it lose consciousness.]
[Emperor Wu: Roger.]
“Extreme Martial Emperor Fist!!!” Emperor Wu, who was wearing the armor of a ghost beast, had his eight pets fused into one. The Divine Tree of Life healed the burden of the fusion in the Beast Taming Space. The moment it descended, it threw a punch that could be said to be the ultimate profundity.
The fist wind shook the sky and earth with a majestic aura.
“Wu Dong!!!!” Seeing Emperor Wu appear, how could Yun An not know what was going on? He instantly roared and cursed.
This time, it really panicked, because it felt that its spatial Skill was completely restricted!
There was no way to escape.
“Annihilation!!!” Under the restriction and serious injuries, Yun An could only activate quasi-divine skills.
The ultimate profundities of both parties collided again.
Boom!!!
A huge wave lingered in the sky again. Space shattered, and laws trembled. The entire Yun Nation was broken like the scene of the apocalypse.
“My king!!!” The Yun Nation underwent a huge change. The totems under Yun An who were searching for resources in the surrounding countries rushed back almost immediately. At this moment, only they dared to come and see what was going on in the Yun Nation.
The other totem countries didn’t need to think to know that a huge battle had occurred between Yun An and Dong Huang. They didn’t have any intention of stepping into the muddy water. Be it the Emperor Wu who expelled them or Yun An who wanted to incorporate them, they made the surrounding totems extremely afraid and really didn’t dare to move.

chapters.title: Chapter 1104 - 1104 The Worst Demigod in History (4)
chapters.content:
1104 The Worst Demigod in History (4)
They only wanted to watch the outcome of such a big boss fight silently.
[Contract System: Baby Ginseng is online.]
[Shi Yu: You and Susu will be in charge of assisting next.]
After Baby Ginseng went online again, Shi Yu glanced at Emperor Wu and Yun An. Although Yun An was continuously heavily injured, it was still very fierce. The power of a quasi-divine skill was still extremely strong, far above Eleven’s single-target quasi-divine skill.
Most importantly, Eleven and the others couldn’t use quasi-divine skills a second time after using them once. However, at this moment, be it Yun An or Emperor Wu, they could use quasi-divine skills as Normal Skills. Shi Yu looked at them and shook his head.
They chose not to interfere in their battle and ran to harvest their resources.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, the general under Yun An, the black giant ape, was the first to rush back to the Yun Nation. However, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t let it support Yun An at this moment.
Boom!!
Before the black giant ape could react, a black and white light flashed in front of its eyes. A huge cannonball directly blasted towards it. The black giant ape was caught off guard and was directly pushed out of the Yun Nation under the huge impact.
Right on the heels of that, a hundred-meter-tall black and white Behemoth wrapped in lightning appeared amidst the lightning. It walked towards it step by step and smashed its huge fist.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared. Take this!!
[Shi Yu: Don’t kill it. Leave the last slash to us. Everyone, preserve your strength.]
With so many totem generals, how many undead scapegoats would there be!
[Eleven: Sob! (Report Beast Tamers for stealing kills!)]
On the other side, the red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu stood in the sky and looked at the black battle tiger in front of him calmly. His figure directly flashed and slashed at the huge tiger. At the same time, the huge tiger roared and swung its huge claws, colliding with the sword edge!!
Shi Yu and the others didn’t know how the progress on Emperor Wu’s side would be. They didn’t dare to use quasi-divine skills to waste their strength when dealing with these totem generals and kept some trump cards.
However, even if he didn’t use quasi-divine skills, with Eleven and the others’ foundation, it was more than enough to deal with this group of totems that Yun An had forcefully raised.
….
The main battlefield was smoother than Shi Yu imagined. Emperor Wu was indeed fierce. The power of every punch was comparable to Shi Yu and Eleven using double quasi-divine skills to completely attain the Dao with strength.
Moreover, after knowing that Shi Yu’s Susu could cleanse radiation, Emperor Wu’s battle Style today was even more reckless.
Initially, when Emperor Wu fought Yun An, he would sometimes still care about the other party’s attack and dodge if he could. But today, Yun An discovered that not only did Emperor Wu not dodge, but he also exchanged injuries every time.
Most importantly, Yun An felt that Emperor Wu’s strength had improved again from a week ago. Moreover, it couldn’t sense the original incurable injury in Emperor Wu’s body.
“Damn it!!!”
With the body fragments that filled the sky being sent flying, Yun An felt that it was really dangerous this time. Perhaps he would fail.
The other party had come prepared. Even the space here was perfectly sealed, making it impossible for it to retreat.
“Die!!!”
In order to quickly suppress Yun An, Emperor Wu didn’t care about his injuries at all. Every time he fought head-on with Yun An, in a short moment, one-tenth of Yun An’s body had already been smashed.
The meteorite fragments all over the ground made Shi Yu, who sensed the main battlefield through Ling, feel his heart ripple. There were hundreds of Demon God Iron-eating Beasts?
[Shi Yu: Senior Emperor Wu, continue. Its current state is still too good. It’s not the best time to use the Sea Cleansing Spirit!]
“Alright!!!” Emperor Wu let out a long roar and threw another punch.
Boom!!!
The wind of Emperor Wu’s fist collided with Yun An’s huge claws. As the huge claws cracked, Yun An roared angrily.
At this moment, Yun An’s mentality had already collapsed slightly. It was suppressed by Emperor Wu the whole time, causing it to be unable to counterattack at all.
He couldn’t defeat it or escape, causing Yun An to feel like giving up struggling.
It would have been fine if it was just Emperor Wu. It was all because of that human who had appeared for no reason. Yun An was furious and felt that it was all Shi Yu’s fault. If not for Shi Yu’s support, a mere Emperor Wu wouldn’t have been able to trap him!
“Roar!!!” At that moment, as he sensed the tragic deaths of his subordinates, Yun An realized that the situation was over. At this rate, forget about escaping to the west to dominate, it was even a problem if he could leave the Yun Nation alive.
“Wu Dong, you forced me!!!” Sensing that his condition was getting worse and worse, the taut string in Yun An’s heart finally snapped, and his gaze was filled with hatred and violence.
At most, they would perish together!!!
He was an elemental creature, a demigod-level elemental creature. As long as he had a small core, there was still hope of revival thousands of years later.
On the other hand, these humans would all return to dust.
Self-destruction!
Although it was self-destruction, it could completely retain a core during the self-destruction process and use the power of the self-destruction to break through this domain that suppressed the power of the Void. It could throw the core into an alternate space and teleport to an extremely far place to wait for revival.
“Roar!!!” At the thought of this, Yun An felt that he couldn’t hesitate any longer. Otherwise, in a while, he wouldn’t even have the power to self-destruct.
Boom!!!
Yun An underwent the final eruption. The energy in its body rose steadily, and the energy in its body began to expand and fuse into its body. However, in the next moment, it was like a deflated balloon. The energy that had just swelled and wanted to self-destruct was instantly suppressed!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1105 - 1105 The Worst Demigod in History (5)
chapters.content:
1105 The Worst Demigod in History (5)
Yun An: “?”
[Ling, Buggy: Detected that Yun An wants to self-destruct. It has already suppressed its energy flow with all its might!]
In the sky, in the forbidden Four Saints Domain, Buggy and Ling’s strength increased to the extreme at this moment. In order to block Yun An’s self-destruction, Buggy’s veins Critical Hit. Even with Ling’s strengthening, its body still trembled a little.
At this moment, even with Ling’s ultimate intelligence, the temperature of its entire body suddenly increased. Some of its bodies were overloading, and it was especially difficult to suppress the self-destruction power of the demigods. The many items of faith of the Four Holy Beasts as sacrifices to the array were also consumed crazily like fire.
“Yi.” “Ning.”
On Buggy and Ling, Baby Ginseng and Susu had appeared at some point in time and placed their hands on them. One was healing nourishing, and the other was Cooldown cleansing, assisting Buggy and Ling.
“Do you think I’ll let you self-destruct?” Emperor Wu immediately said when he saw Yun An’s stunned appearance.
At this moment, Yun An’s expression gradually collapsed. He completely didn’t expect that the other party had even calculated his self-destruction and actually had a way to suppress his self-destruction power.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!!” As Yun An roared angrily and collapsed, the last straw that crushed its heart fell. Yun An could only turn around and erupt with stronger power to attack Emperor Wu.
Emperor Wu had been waiting for a long time and fought Yun An again. In the huge battle, Yun An’s body was constantly broken, and the other was constantly corroded by radiation. Both parties fought desperately.
Because his initial state was better than Yun An, in addition to the fact that a Sea Cleansing Spirit had been carried by Emperor Wu before the battle, his battle intent at this moment was still very clear. On the other hand, Yun An was heavily injured consecutively, and its mind and consciousness collapsed even more.
He had tried to self-destruct many times, but he was suppressed by the forbidden Four Saints Domain created by Buggy and Ling.
In the sky, the red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu’s figure finally appeared after a long time. As the overall commander of this battle, he sensed Yun An’s current mental Resistance state and finally issued the final command.
[Shi Yu: Senior Emperor Wu, Susu, now.]
Boom.
As Shi Yu gave the order, Emperor Wu erupted with its strongest strength. It threw a punch without caring about the consequences and directly flipped Yun An’s entire body over, making its eyes almost turn white. Its consciousness was extremely blurry, and its spirit trembled.
At this moment, as the most important figure, Susu finally left Ling and launched the final attack.
A demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit!!!
All the remaining strength!
A huge figure ten thousand meters tall stretched out its water-blue arm and wrapped Yun An in the middle with its huge palm. This time, Susu didn’t attack or cleanse the radiation. Shi Yu naturally had his own reasons for choosing to let it attack last.
[Shi Yu: Susu, cleanse its will and cleanse its heart!!]
As the strongest ocean demigod, cleansing curses and plagues was only the most basic method. Its strongest point was to cleanse one Abyss Sea demigod after another, turning them from Unholy to the guardians of the sea, from bad guys to good people.
If it wanted to capture Yun An alive, this kind of cleansing was indispensable. At the same time, cleansing Yun An’s will into an extremely low Resistance could also prevent it from self-destructing again. At that time, its extremely low willpower wouldn’t allow it to have the courage to resist and self-destruct again.
It was naturally impossible for this Sea Cleansing Spirit to directly cleanse Yun An at his peak. However, if the opponent was in a situation where his strength was weak, his Resistance was blurry, and his state was extremely poor, the success rate would be greatly improved.
It was comparable to brainwashing!
Zizizizizi!!!!
“Roar!!!” Giant Susu squeezed Yun An in its palms. The power of cleansing spread, and Yun An’s miserable cry that shook the sky and earth came from inside.
Not far away, Emperor Wu, who was shocked by the aftermath, panted slightly and looked ahead quietly.
After about two to three minutes, Susu separated its palm. Yun An, who was as huge as a city, fell from the sky. At this moment, the power on its body had already been weakened to the extreme. The energy in its body had almost disappeared and had already been cleansed.
Even if it wanted to self-destruct, it didn’t have the power to self-destruct. It couldn’t pose a threat to a Legendary at all. When it fell, its eyes were listless, and it only had a faint consciousness.
“Roar… (I want to be a good person… I…)”
“What the hell?” On the other side, Emperor Wu listened to Yun An’s weak begging roar. The corners of his mouth twitched as he looked at the high and mighty Blue Sea Sprite.
It really succeeded?
The cleansing of the Blue Sea Sprite was too terrifying.
[Shi Yu: Battle over, over!]
Shi Yu smiled slightly. At this moment, he was extremely excited. It had really succeeded. The Sea Cleansing Spirit could really cleanse Yun An’s will and heart. This way, when he returned, Yun An and the Undying Dark Phoenix on his side could also do the same.
However, at the moment, the most important thing was to ask Yun An something!!
This was even more important than renewable resources.
….
After an unknown period of time.
Yun An gradually woke up. Just as he woke up, he felt intense pain in his body.
“Roar!!!” It let out a heart-wrenching scream.
It suddenly realized that its city-like huge body had already been dismantled and broken until it was only about ten meters tall. Its body was shattered and pitted, and its strength was extremely weak.
It was as if it had been stripped naked and helplessly tied up by huge technological chains. Yun An struggled with all its might, but its current strength didn’t allow it to break free.
Shi Yu, Emperor Wu, and the pets looked at Yun An in front of them. Shi Yu and the others were alright, but Emperor Wu was very silent. He felt that Yun An was the most miserable demigod. The battle where he killed the Radiance Tiger demigod back then was even more difficult than this.
This time, from Yun An’s perspective, he felt that Yun An’s house had been confiscated for no reason. The whole process was really miserable.
It was all thanks to Shi Yu.
“Roar!!! (I, I surrender!!!)” At this moment, Yun An no longer had the domineering aura of the previous king of the Yun Race. This was also normal. Its originally not low will level had already been cleansed to the lowest level by Susu. The current Yun An was completely a weakling. It was one thing if it even had the courage to self-destruct.
It looked at Emperor Wu and Shi Yu in horror.
“I’ll ask, you answer.” Shi Yu looked at Yun An and said, “You… were you sent to Blue Planet by the Abyss Race?”
“You’re from the starry sky, right?”
At this moment, this question was what Shi Yu wanted to know the most. The power of Yun An came from the same source as the power of the Abyss Sea. It was fine if the Abyss Sea was passed down to the Mythical Era, but Yun An descended on Blue Planet ten thousand years ago. It was very difficult not to suspect that it was an advance team sent to Blue Planet by the Abyss Evil God Race in advance.
If there were no Emperor Wu in the east at that time and it let Yun An develop, it was completely capable of forming large factions like the Abyss Sea and Dragon Palace City.
“What Abyss Race? No.” Yun An immediately begged for mercy and denied, making Shi Yu frown.
“I, I fled here.”
“The planet I was on was invaded by the ‘cosmic overlord army’. At that time, I was still an egg and was thrown into the starry sky to escape. I accidentally wandered to this planet.”
“I was wrong. Blue Planet took me in. I only want to be a good beast and protect Blue Planet now!”
Susu: Ning! (Hmph!)
Emperor Wu: ???
Shi Yu: “Huh?”
Shi Yu was immediately stunned. Holy shit, Yun An escaped to Blue Planet? What the hell, what was a universe overlord?

chapters.title: Chapter 1106 - 1106 Returning to the Origin Space-time
chapters.content:
1106 Returning to the Origin Space-time
During the week of communication with Emperor Wu, Shi Yu told Emperor Wu most of the information about the invading species of the Mythical Era, such as the Space Worm, the Space Behemoth, and the Abyss Evil God.
Among them, Yun An was suspected to be a member of the Abyss Evil God. This made Emperor Wu extremely serious. He didn’t expect Yun An to have such a powerful background.
This time, the two of them had another goal in crushing Yun An. That was to see if they could obtain any information about the Abyss Evil God from Yun An.
In fact, Shi Yu was already prepared for the Abyss Evil God to target Blue Planet again. In the end, Yun An said that it had escaped?
“Are you sure you don’t know about the Abyss Evil God and the Abyss Race?”
Yun An shook his deer head, indicating that he didn’t know.
“It’s the faction of the Abyss Sea.”
“Your strength comes from the same source!”
Yun An: “I really…”
Emperor Wu said, “Is it possible that they do have a relationship, but the connection isn’t that close? For example, the Beast Tamers in the west and the Beast Tamers in the east are both of the same race and have the same power system, but because of the difference in the Survival environment, the races have changed, and the power structure is completely different.”
“Yun An and the Abyss Race might belong to the same large race, but they’re not the same faction. Didn’t you say that apart from Blue Planet, humans might also exist elsewhere? Similarly, the Abyss Race might not necessarily only exist in one place.”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “What I’m most concerned about now is the universe overlord Yun An mentioned.”
“What’s that?” He looked at Yun An.
Universe overlord… What kind of creature could be called this?
Yun An: “I’m not very sure either. This information was all branded in my bloodline memories. At that time, before I was born, my mother planet was invaded.”
“A cosmic overlord is the overlord of the entire universe. It’s an extremely powerful species in the universe. Every generation, they will subdue a large number of subordinates and form an army to run rampant in the universe. They have occupied countless resource planets. My mother planet is also one of them.”
“I successfully escaped and wandered in the universe. In the end, I chose this low-level planet to grow in order to avoid encountering too strong a natural enemy.”
Yun An was extremely aggrieved.
It had already tried its best to choose low-level planets.
At that time, the rules on the current Blue Planet were incomplete. The strongest was only a demigod. There was no divine-level life form at all. It was very suitable for it to grow.
Shi Yu looked at Emperor Wu, and Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu. He felt that things were developing in a ridiculous direction.
“How many secrets are there in the starry sky?” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Then, he looked at the sky. The intermediate gods, high-level gods, and top-notch gods on Blue Planet had left Blue Planet and gone to the starry sky to work. How were they now?
These gods should have returned to Blue Planet, but the way they returned was different.
For example, the “Goddess Wa” mentioned by the World Tree had returned in a certain way and brought back the “Seed of Hope: Human”.
From this, it could be seen that the human factions and potential in the place where Goddess Wa went were definitely very huge, so much so that she treated humans as the hope of Blue Planet’s revival.
The information Yun An could obtain was still too little. Now, Shi Yu only hoped that a few of those gods who had run away from home could return and bring back some information about the entire universe.
The abyss invaded others and was also invaded by others. The universe was really chaotic.
“Starry sky universe,” Emperor Wu also looked at the sky and muttered to himself. He was even more curious about places outside Blue Planet.
“In the end, if I can’t solve the curse and break through to the divine level, I might also try to go to that place.”
Shi Yu shook his head.
Leaving Blue Planet and heading to the starry sky might not be difficult for Legendary and demigods if they work hard.
However, the nearby galaxy was not a good place to break through and stay.
Otherwise, there should have been a precedent of demigod experts breaking through to the divine level near Blue Planet.
Now that these gods had disappeared without a trace, there was an 80% chance that they had gone to a further place to wander. Shi Yu knew very well how big the universe was. Even if he rode Buggy, the god of faith in the starry sky, it was very difficult for Shi Yu to guarantee how far it could lead him in the starry sky.
After thinking about it, Shi Yu felt that if anyone below the divine level wanted to travel far in the starry sky, with the current situation, they still had to rely on technology, such as a super light speed spaceship!
Ling! Work hard.
“How do we deal with it?” Emperor Wu looked at Yun An again.
“By the way, have you dealt with its generals?”
Shi Yu: “Only five returned. The others sensed that something was wrong and ran away. In the future, Senior Emperor Wu, you can slowly search for them yourself.”
“No.” Shi Yu looked at Yun An.
“Don’t you want to do something?”
“For example, summon your subordinates or something.”
Yun An: …
It was heartbreaking!!!
…
In the end, Emperor Wu decided to raise Yun An in the ruins and let Yun An undergo self-reform.
It was too much of a pity to directly kill Yun An like this. After all, it was a quasi-divine-level renewable resource.
Now that it had been cleansed by Susu once, the threat of Yun An had decreased greatly. Moreover, Emperor Wu believed that he still had 20 years to live. During this period of time, suppressing a weak Yun An shouldn’t be a problem.
As for what happened after that, that would depend on the situation at that time.
In fact, Shi Yu also had the right to deal with Yun An. If Shi Yu wanted to take Yun An away, Emperor Wu probably wouldn’t say anything. However, when Shi Yu thought of the spatial rejection, he didn’t waste the effort.

chapters.title: Chapter 1107 - 1107 Returning to the Origin Space-time (2)
chapters.content:
1107 Returning to the Origin Space-time (2)
Apart from the Time Sprite’s main body, creatures that transmigrated through space and time would be rejected by space and time according to their strength. The longer they stayed, the stronger the rejection, until they were expelled into the space and time flux by this space and time.
As a demigod, it would consume more energy to bring Yun An to transmigrate. Secondly, it wouldn’t stay long if it brought it back to the modern era.
If he killed Yun An and turned it into an undead, he could erase its life force and consciousness and transform it into a pure puppet. Unfortunately, Chi Tong’s undead space couldn’t withstand the totem-level undead of the Mythical Race at the moment.
Moreover, that would be too wasteful. It would lose the original intention of being a sustainable resource.
However, Shi Yu wasn’t someone who would suffer a loss. After all, he had consumed all of Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit here. However, Shi Yu didn’t go overboard. He only took a small portion of the meteorite fragments as labor remuneration.
Compared to all the fragments taken from Yun An’s body, these meteorite fragments were a drop in the bucket. However, they could fully arm the modern Iron-eating Beast Corps. The number was just right.
As for later, after all, there was still Yun An in this space-time. The Yun An in this space-time was stronger and larger. With his experience fighting the ancient Yun An this time, Shi Yu believed that soon after returning, the Yun An in this space-time wouldn’t be arrogant for long.
Emperor Wu sealed Yun An in the ruins space. After Shi Yu killed all the subordinates Yun An summoned in two to three moves, the two of them looked at each other and started to return to Dong Huang.
“How long can you stay?” Emperor Wu said.
“In another three days, the strength of the spatial rejection should increase by another level,” Shi Yu said.
“Let me entertain you well for the next three days,” Emperor Wu said.
Shi Yu smiled. “It’s a deal.”
…
The battle between Shi Yu, Emperor Wu, and Yun An looked fast, but it actually took a total of four hours for them to leave the border of Dong Huang and return.
Four hours was neither long nor short. At this time, the Iron-eating Beast Corps at the border of Dong Huang and some trusted factions of Emperor Wu inside Dong Huang were extremely anxious.
The battle fluctuations of the battle between Emperor Wu and the others had already spread throughout the entire Eastern Continent, especially Dong Huang, which was closest to the Yun Nation. Places like Wu Ling City could feel an obvious vibration.
Baby Ginseng’s ultimate self-destruction even made the atmospheric fluctuations spread throughout Blue Planet, making countless experts raise their eyebrows slightly.
It could be said that if it weren’t for the fact that Ling and Buggy used the forbidden domain to restrict the range of their battle, it might be very difficult to determine the winner of this huge battle if they didn’t level the surrounding totem countries.
Before long, the outcome of this battle should spread throughout the world. The legendary Beast Tamer Emperor Wu of the Eastern Ancient Nation defeated a powerful demigod again.
After killing two demigods in a row, Dong Huang, who had Emperor Wu presiding over it, would become one of the most powerful factions on Blue Planet. Its reputation would deter thousands of potential enemies.
Without Yun An’s interference, the Emperor Wu of this space and time might lead Dong Huang into a stronger country. The evaluations of the future generations would definitely improve.
“His Majesty Emperor Wu, it’s His Majesty Emperor Wu!!!”
They naturally sensed the fluctuations of the battle. Now, be it Shi Yu or Emperor Wu, they looked to have returned intact. Did this mean that Yun An had already been killed?
“Inform the entire country… that Yun An and the twelve generals under him have been killed.” Emperor Wu walked onto the high platform step by step, and Shi Yu yawned beside him.
He didn’t let Emperor Wu preserve his merits, nor did he really want the position of general or even guardian. After all, he wasn’t from this space and time. He might not come in the future. If the people knew that apart from Emperor Wu, there was also such a powerful Beast Tamer, it would purely be an additional responsibility for nothing.
Just like Buggy’s account name, he only wanted to be a pure [Time Traveler].
Or rather, [Space-time Black Merchant].
At the same time, when everyone heard Emperor Wu say that the Yun Nation had been destroyed, these soldiers who had been tense and guarding the border for many years immediately relaxed and revealed extremely surprised expressions.
“Long live His Majesty Emperor Wu!!!”
Cheers resounded throughout the city.
Among the few people, such as Ji Mengzhu, their gazes landed on Shi Yu beside Emperor Wu. Although they didn’t know Shi Yu’s true origin like Emperor Wu, they knew very well that apart from Emperor Wu’s divine bravery, it was all thanks to this person that this battle and the previous crisis could have such a perfect outcome.
A legend Beast Tamer comparable to a Legendary expert recruited by the country!
….
That night, Shi Yu drank happily. It was rare for Eleven to eat more. It ate the meteorite fragment for a long time, but it didn’t dare to digest it.
Its Demon God Body had already reached the highest proficiency below transcendent. If it increased its level a little more, it would lead it to the totem level.
Therefore, after Eleven ate the meteorite fragment, it could only store the power of the Demon God in the source of physical strength for future eruptions.
Shi Yu felt that when his first Beast Taming Space broke through to level eight, he might be able to contract a totem level above his level.
Be it Eleven, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, or Ling, after they reached the totem level, because they were Mythical Races, they would immediately have [ demigod-level] battle power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1108 - 1108 Returning to the Origin Space-time (3)
chapters.content:
1108 Returning to the Origin Space-time (3)
It was actually very difficult to nurture a demigod. Even the strongest of Emperor Wu’s nine battle pets was only top-notch totem battle power. As for Shi Yu’s pet, because its foundation was very solid, it could completely break through to a demigod next.
If he did this, Shi Yu would dare to challenge Yun An alone even without any help.
In the next two days, Shi Yu used his identity as a black merchant to start another round of ancient procurement. Some rare resources that had already disappeared in the modern era were purchased by Shi Yu.
In the past two days, Emperor Wu had been hurriedly recovering from his injuries and adjusting his state, preparing to welcome his parting battle with Shi Yu.
In fact, Emperor Wu felt that he didn’t do much in the battle with Yun An. Be it Baby Ginseng’s explosion or the forbidden domain maintained by Ling and Buggy, they greatly reduced the pressure of his battle. For Emperor Wu, the first credit for this battle would definitely be Shi Yu’s.
Regarding Shi Yu’s unfathomable strength, even in the battle with a demigod, Emperor Wu felt that he had yet to see it clearly. Seeing that Shi Yu was about to leave, the belligerent Emperor Wu couldn’t give up this opportunity.
“After sparring with Emperor Wu tomorrow, we should go back.” Shi Yu was talking to Ling and the others about the battle tomorrow.
Ling looked pitiful. It only hoped that its teammates’ defensive Skills would be awesome and exciting. It hoped that Emperor Wu wouldn’t break through its defense and punch it.
…
A day later, Shi Yu and Emperor Wu appeared in the Yun Nation again.
At this moment, this place was already in ruins. It was best to make this place a battlefield for the second battle.
On the Desolate Land, Emperor Wu looked at Shi Yu opposite him with a serious expression.
He was certain that although Shi Yu wasn’t the Beast Tamer with the highest level of space and time in the future, he was definitely the Beast Tamer with the strongest talent and potential. Otherwise, Shi Yu wouldn’t have transmigrated into space and time, something that went against common sense.
Although it was a pity that he couldn’t fight the legendary Shi Yu, the current outcome was also very satisfying for Emperor Wu.
“Rules, everyone fights,” Emperor Wu said.
In terms of pets, Shi Yu actually had the advantage. However, Little Ji, Duckie, Little Purple, and Qi were really weak at the moment. Shi Yu didn’t plan to let them participate in this battle.
“Alright.” Opposite Emperor Wu, Shi Yu was wearing a black and red mecha suit that Emperor Wu had never seen before. He nodded seriously.
“Of course, I won’t take advantage of you. After all, my level is two levels higher. An hour, and the sparring is limited to an hour. If I can’t defeat you during this period of time, I’ll just admit defeat,” Emperor Wu said.
“During this period of time, I’ll do my best.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Really? You have to think about it carefully. You originally had a chance to win, so don’t throw this opportunity away yourself.”
“Haha.” Emperor Wu shook his head and said, “It doesn’t matter. After all, it’s just a spar. It’s impossible for us to fight with all our might. Your ginseng baby’s self-destruction and the Sea Cleansing Spirit of the Blue Sea Sprite have already been used on Yun An. The current you isn’t at your peak battle power at all.”
Boom!!!
As soon as Emperor Wu finished speaking, he directly fused with his eight pets. His two-meter-tall body suddenly increased to ten meters tall. The standard armor he was originally wearing outside immediately changed into a red Ghost Armor with a bull-horned helmet.
It was said that this was armor made of demigod-level bull bones as the main material. A new spirit was born later and was obtained and contracted by Emperor Wu. It was named Emperor Wu Armor, one of Emperor Wu’s main protective armor.
Apart from that, the characteristics of the other pets also appeared on Emperor Wu one by one, making him an ultimate monster with the image of a beast warrior.
“How are you going to face me in this form?” Emperor Wu slowly floated up and looked at Shi Yu.
This state could be said to be the peak state of fusing the level-nine Fusion Talent and the power of the nine totem lives into one. The reason why it couldn’t become a quasi-divine skill was because the power was too mixed.
After all, it came from nine different lives.
Compared to that pure single power, it was even harder to touch the corresponding laws.
However, this didn’t mean that Emperor Wu’s attack was weak. Emperor Wu’s punch was just like the huge eagle in the Shen Feng Nation that purely relied on energy levels to become demigod-level battle power. It directly completed a different Dao Validation. One relied purely on extreme energy, while the other purely relied on extreme physical strength. Although there were no quasi-divine skills, it was better than a demigod.
“Dad taught me to use magic to defeat magic,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
“Huh?” Emperor Wu revealed a confused expression. What did he mean?
Father… Shi Yu’s father… was probably also a rare super expert in the world, at leasst legendary level.
At this moment, just as Emperor Wu was in deep thought about how strong Shi Yu’s father was and who he was, Shi Yu raised his palm.
A green and white spinning Rubik’s Cube appeared in Shi Yu’s palm in the black and red mecha battle suit. Then, it kept splitting and increasing!!
“That Mechanic life form.” Emperor Wu’s heart skipped a beat.
Hu hu hu!!!
At this moment, as Ling kept splitting, it turned into a small cube that filled the sky and wrapped around Shi Yu. Soon, Shi Yu’s figure disappeared in front of Emperor Wu.
In its place, under the entanglement of the substantialized green hurricane, a huge humanoid mecha 20 meters tall gradually formed!!
The huge mecha’s entire body was white as the base. It had red, blue, and black colors as support. Its limbs, head, and body had layers of mechanical devices.

chapters.title: Chapter 1109 - 1109 Returning to the Origin Space-time (4)
chapters.content:
1109 Returning to the Origin Space-time (4)
Behind it were huge green light wings with three pairs of huge light wings as the main body. Under the Blink of the light wings, the entire ground shattered and was obliterated by shocking energy fluctuations. The huge body flew in the sky, and the gaze on its head had already completely locked onto Emperor Wu himself.
Although its body was in the form of a human, its head had the characteristics of the sheep race. Under the contrast of the white Kirin Horn, its entire face was like a white demon.
Under the witness of Emperor Wu, the energy fluctuations of this mecha were still rising steadily. In the next moment, black armor that flickered appeared again on the mecha’s white body and finally perfectly fused into the white body. Eleven was already in position.
Inside the mecha, the ten Iron-eating Beasts formed a stable army pattern on the four limbs, head, torso, and various other parts of the mecha, loading into one with the ultimate mechanical Ling.
This was Eleven’s Nine Li Army Skill. With the Bean Bear as the core, it was a super army skill that had fused impregnable and clones. At this moment, what Ling wanted was the defense power brought by the super army skill resonance.
Otherwise, they definitely wouldn’t be able to withstand a single attack from Emperor Wu.
With Eleven’s current attributes, it could indeed be said to be the strongest defense. It was also Ling’s first defense.
The mecha energy room undoubtedly became the most important energy power of the mecha. It was carried by the five-element circulation system and used water as the source, allowing the elemental power to coexist and ensuring that the mecha had unlimited energy.
In the nutritional cabin, Baby Ginseng slept here. It contributed its strength in the nutritional fluid to reduce the burden on the members. If necessary, it could even activate the time system and let everyone explode to the limit.
“Come on.”
In the mecha cockpit, Shi Yu’s expression was serious as he looked ahead. Now that Ling had mastered the ultimate machine, its loading skill was actually similar to a top-notch Fusion Talent. At the moment, it could combine the strength of Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and the others into one.
Shi Yu wanted Emperor Wu’s top-notch Fusion Talent EXP. Apart from helping others develop their Fusion Talent, he could also more or less provide Ling with a reference EXP.
“I see,” Emperor Wu muttered as he looked at the mecha in front of him.
At this moment, with a boom, the red patterns on the huge white body lit up. A huge longsword condensed in the mecha’s hand. Chi Tong, who was in the Arms warehouse, directly opened its eyes. With it already loaded, it possessed Shi Yu again.
At the same time, an unfamiliar starry sky domain formed around the mecha, as if it had dragged Emperor Wu and the mecha into the universe. Vague starlight lingered around. This time, it was Buggy’s imagination power, in order to provide the best battlefield for the mecha to suppress the other party’s strength.
Under the starry sky, the Fusion Mecha and the Fusion Emperor looked at each other from afar. Both parties could sense the shocking eruption contained in the other party’s terrifying power.
“You can also fuse.” Emperor Wu laughed very happily. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to also master the battle skill of fusing the power of many pets into one. He originally thought that he would defeat them one by one in this battle…
He liked to fight head-on.
“Come on!” Emperor Wu and Shi Yu shouted together.
As soon as the two parties started, they used their ultimate moves to greet each other.
Outside the mecha, cold air spread. It wanted to freeze time and strive for the speed of its attack, but Emperor Wu’s punch seemed to have exceeded space and time, directly making the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy ineffective. It should be the ability of the Ethereal Time Monkey.
Shi Yu also raised his arm slightly. The huge sword phantom blocked this punch and started the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation!!
In the next moment, the huge impact shattered the invisible armor wrapped around all the members of the Nine Li Army layer by layer. The Restoration characteristic brought by the Indestructible Golden Body quickly converted the damage of this punch for the mecha, but it was not as fast as the spreading speed of the fist power. At the cost of a Black Meteorite Yak scapegoat vomiting blood in the undead space, most of the damage of this attack was finally turned into luck by Ling at the critical moment.
However, the huge mecha still couldn’t help but fly backward. In the cockpit, Shi Yu’s face turned pale. Baby Ginseng quickly activated the treatment. At the same time, Emperor Wu was also trapped in the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and couldn’t escape. No matter how strong Emperor Wu was, he couldn’t break through the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation. He could only use his fist to resist the attack of the sword formation and attack in place of defense.
“Holy Martial Chain Break!!” Emperor Wu threw 17 consecutive punches.
Bang!!!
At the cost of Emperor Wu’s injuries, it shattered the spatial domain.
In an instant, Emperor Wu, who had dismantled the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, rose into the air. The injuries on his body healed at a high speed and flew into the sky with the huge mecha that reacted. Shi Yu raised the sword in his hand again and slashed with it. The sword contained the laws of the sword. The moment it touched, it formed a sword domain, forming the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation that surrounded Emperor Wu infinitely.
In the fusion state, there were many benefits. The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, which originally consumed a lot of energy and could only be used once, could be used multiple times under Susu’s unlimited energy, the nourishment of the ginseng baby, and the burden of the scapegoat.
In just two rounds of confrontation, Emperor Wu, who was trapped in the sword formation again, smiled and said, “Your attack power is not bad, and your endurance is not bad. Unfortunately, your defense is your weakness.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1110 - 1110 Returning to the Origin Space-time (5)
chapters.content:
1110 Returning to the Origin Space-time (5)
“Just the aftermath alone, you have to defend with all your might.”
“Yours is called a mecha, right? I want to try dismantling a mecha with my bare hands.”
“Feel free to try.”
In the cockpit, Shi Yu grinned. This couldn’t be helped. Even if Eleven used the army skill to defend with all its might, it was still smashed by Emperor Wu’s fist. Moreover, the other party resisted the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and wasn’t heavily injured. Its defense was clearly at the monster level like strength. It was difficult.
It was also using attack as defense. Let’s compete in endurance.
Boom!!!
The two parties collided again. This time, Emperor Wu used some kind of defensive secret skill against the Extreme Martial Tyrant Emperor. His body took the sword head-on. Although it was said to be an injury in exchange for an injury, he hit Shi Yu and the others almost unscathed.
During this process, Shi Yu and the others’ hearts were in their throats. Buggy’s mental strength circulated 200%. It wanted to teleport the mecha in the domain to dodge, but it was still a step too slow.
The entire fusion mecha was instantly sent flying like a meteor. A large dent appeared in its abdomen. Seeing this, Emperor Wu smiled in the air and said, “Profoundity, Divine Martial Defence.”
This was his strongest defense.
However, to Emperor Wu’s surprise, although most of the body of the mecha with weak defense had caved in, it seemed to still have energy during the process of flying backward and quickly repairing.
Boom boom boom!!!
Countless electromagnetic cannon missiles shot out of the mecha.
Emperor Wu was just about to smash it with his fist when his expression suddenly changed, and blood flowed out of his mouth.
Buzz.
The sound of laws of the Wind Blessing sounded.
At the same time, spatial ripples appeared again.
The huge mecha teleported behind Emperor Wu, whose old injuries had relapsed. It directly crossed its body, wanting to slash its soul and separate Emperor Wu’s fusion.
“Sorry, that punch just now happened to be blocked by the strong spatial turbulence that failed to teleport.” In the mecha, Shi Yu had lingering fears as he smiled at Emperor Wu, whose old injuries had relapsed.
It slashed down with the Soul Slash.
It attacked Emperor Wu with the electromagnetic cannon opposite.
Lucky.
However, in the next moment, Shi Yu cursed.
“Damn, martial arts clone.”
Emperor Wu directly disappeared from Shi Yu and the others’ attack range. It wasn’t a spatial skill. It was as if the one fighting Shi Yu and the others had always been a clone that disappeared into thin air.
The target of the electromagnetic cannon immediately became the mecha main body.
“Again!” Emperor Wu’s true body appeared and punched the mecha again.
In the mecha, Shi Yu took a deep breath and looked at the mecha that kept rising and falling in front of him. He couldn’t care less about its transformation rules and directly activated the Yin Yang Taiji Domain under Chi Tong’s possession state.
The huge Taiji Painting Formation covered the starry sky domain. Two stars, one yin and one yang, formed a Taiji Painting, making Emperor Wu’s expression change.
“Eleven, attack!! Do you still have strength?”
“Wuu!!!!”
“What’s this?” Emperor Wu frowned and threw a punch. Similarly, the huge mecha opposite quickly turned into a huge cannon with its left arm that didn’t have a sword. With a boom, the Yin Yang Millstone that shook the nomological space blasted towards Emperor Wu’s fist like a spinning cannonball.
Boom!!!
A huge dust mist and Illuminate swept up and swallowed the mecha and Emperor Wu. Space shattered, and the starry sky domain disappeared, almost sweeping the two of them into the spatial turbulence.
In the intense confrontation, as countless energies collapsed, another demigod-level battle occurred in the Yun Nation. Once again, it attracted the attention of the world. Although the Blue Planet experts didn’t know who was fighting this time, the terrifying energy swept through the atmosphere and produced shocking fluctuations. It was enough to prove that these were two invincible existences.
….
That night.
Emperor Wu returned to the border of Dong Huang heavily injured. Ji Mengzhu, Ji Yunchong, and the others were immediately shocked when they saw Emperor Wu return heavily injured.
They had also sensed the battle fluctuations just now and knew that Emperor Wu had gone to spar with Shi Yu. However, what kind of battle did the two of them fight?
Why was his injury even more serious than when fighting Yun An?
“Wu Dong, are you alright?” General Ji Yun said when there was no one around.
“You guys are really good. You fought for a full 11 hours.”
“Haha…” Emperor Wu smiled and shook his head.” It’s alright. ”
“Uncle Wu, who won?” Ji Mengzhu quickly asked Emperor Wu, and Emperor Wu looked at her and pondered for a moment.
“What do you think?” Emperor Wu said.
“You won?” Ji Mengzhu said.
“He won.”
“What?!” General Ji Yun and Ji Mengzhu couldn’t believe it.
Emperor Wu shook his head. Indeed, it was as Shi Yu had said. If not for that agreement, he, Wu Dong, would have won. Unfortunately, he had taken things too hard and set the one-hour agreement. According to the rules, he lost.
However, the two parties didn’t end because of this. Instead, they continued fighting.
In the end, because the mecha’s Overload couldn’t be loaded with all its members at the same time and disintegrated, Shi Yu and the others were restricted by their low levels and couldn’t continue fighting. On the other hand, Emperor Wu fused with eight pets and fought for 11 hours. In the end, even its energy was almost exhausted, but it could still rely on its physical strength to display demigod-level strength.
In the words of Emperor Wu, his fusion state could be maintained for a month at most without fighting. In high-intensity battles, it was enough to last for a day.
In the end, it was still the burden ability brought by his level. The talent enhancement gave him an advantage. Otherwise, under the same level, he might lose to Shi Yu in less than an hour.
“Where’s Sir Shi Yu?” General Ji Yun suddenly asked in confusion.
“Yes, where’s Shi Yu?” Ji Mengzhu said.
He could actually… defeat a Legendary with a legend level? How was this possible?
“He left. I wonder if he’ll return, but I look forward to fighting him again.” Emperor Wu looked at the starry sky.
….
At the same time.
Under Qi’s lead, the exhausted Shi Yu and the others returned to their space and time according to the spatial coordinates. In Qi’s words, she wanted to take advantage of her current Enfeeble weakness to transmigrate quickly. This way, her consumption would be smaller.
“Damn Emperor Wu, He doesn’t care about virtue. After an hour, I’ve already won. He just had to beg me to continue fighting.”
“It made me look like this now. He has thick eyebrows and big eyes. He’s very bad. I’ve decided. In the future, I’ll film Emperor Wu Legendary and let him be beaten up more miserably by Yun An.” After Shi Yu replied to the original space-time, he was still indignant.
It hurt.
“Sob…” Eleven and the others were also weak.
However, just as they returned to the original Space and Time Island, the expressions of Shi Yu and the others immediately changed.
“This is…”
“It’s only been a few days since I left, but the planet’s laws actually revived at this time??”
He knew that before the Mythical Revival, Blue Planet would experience several revivals of laws of different degrees, but he couldn’t determine the exact day. He didn’t expect…
“In other words, the memories of those reincarnated gods should have awakened now, right? Damn it, I wonder how many days it has been since they revived. I missed the best time to get intimate with them!!”
“It’s a huge loss.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1111 - 1111 Demigod Cat Mother Gem Cat (1)
chapters.content:
1111 Demigod Cat Mother Gem Cat (1)
After returning to the original space and time and discovering that the laws had recovered slightly, although Shi Yu felt that it was a pity that he couldn’t witness it, it wasn’t a big problem.
Sensing the changes in the entire Blue Planet, he took a deep breath and realized that the meditation efficiency had increased again!
This way, he might be able to break through to level 8 in two months.
The revival of laws this time was a huge benefit to everything on the planet.
Although it still couldn’t give legendary/ demigod-level experts the chance to break through to the divine level, low-level lives could basically grow faster.
“There will definitely be some changes in the association this time. I’ve already imagined a pile of communication records…”
Shi Yu stood on the Space and Time Island and looked at the surrounding pets. “Let’s return to Dong Huang first.”
“Wuu ~” “Wu!!” “Yi!!”
Under the response of the pets, Shi Yu rode Buggy and first left the chaotic magnetic field on the Space and Time Island. He received an emergency communication from President Lin through the tenth bureau’s Index. Then, he arrived at the edge of the Dong Huang Sea and received a bunch of messages from Senior Lu.
Their message content was basically similar. It was to ask where Shi Yu was now and when he would return to Dong Huang. It was all about the first revival of the laws.
Soon, Shi Yu descended on Dong Huang and called Senior Lu.
“Shi Yu, you’re finally here.” After the call was picked up, Senior Lu’s overjoyed voice came from the other side.
“It’s only been a few days.” Shi Yu was also helpless. “You sent a total of 11 messages and called six times.”
“It’s all because you disappeared and couldn’t be found. It’s fine usually, but after such a big thing like the revival of laws happened, you didn’t even return to Dong Huang. It’s very difficult not to think too much.”
“For example, encountering an awakened god and being smashed or something…”
Shi Yu said, “What a joke. I’m super strong now.”
He had just defeated Emperor Wu!
Although it was not the peak stage and a Emperor Wu who Shi Yu relied on the rules to win… he definitely had the strength to fight a demigod.
Senior Lu said, “Although the rules are only the revival of the initial stage, there are already many gods who have awakened because of this.”
“The gods in the best state have already recovered to the totem level. In addition to their Mythical Race and quasi-divine skills, they have demigod-level battle power. Moreover, demigods like them probably have battle power comparable to demigods who are close to the strongest ladder like the Blue Sea Sprite. Their strength even exceeds Senior Dragon God and the others.”
Had the Dragon God already become a combat measurement unit?
“The gods in poorer states have basically recovered to the overlord level, similar to most of the gods awakened by the World Tree on Inatella Island previously. However, because the rules are a little more perfect than at that time, they can already move in the outside world for a long time.”
“Of course, there are also weaker ones, such as those reincarnated gods. Their upper limits are those who awaken their memories at the totem level, and those who recover their memories at the overlord, monarch, commander, and transcendent levels. The difference in strength now is different.”
It was like this.
“But with their potential, it’s definitely not a problem for them to recover to demigod level before the Mythical stage completely revives.”
Under normal circumstances, apart from Qi, Shi Yu muttered in his heart. In the end, he asked, “It’s only been a few days, but there’s quite a lot going on.”
“Where are you now?”
Lu Qingyi: “President Lin established Bureau 14. At the moment, I’m the director. The original intention of this department was to find those divine beasts whose memories have awakened or revived from their sleep and rope them in.”
“The nature is considered a combination of the first and eleventh bureaus?”
“Now that you’re back, I’ll leave this director to you,” Lu Qingyi said tiredly. “Those divine beasts are too difficult to deal with.”
“At the moment, in Dong Huang, an Elemental-level life form revived from the Mythical Ruins. After reviving, it came out and showed its divinity before returning. It ignored me completely and didn’t open the door no matter how hard I knocked… There’s also a reincarnated divine beast that has awakened its memories. This divine beast has a contractor. It has already broken free of the contract. Fortunately, it’s still following beside the original contractor, but it has a little too many requests. It wants to rope it in and let Dong Huang take a few Mythical resources first. It’s a headache.”
Shi Yu was stunned.
A few Mythical resources were too much.
“How’s the strength of that reincarnated divine beast?”
Lu Qingyi said, “Although the strength of the divine beast that awakened its memories has only recovered to the monarch level, it has mastered a quasi-divine skill and has totem-like battle power.
