Moreover, the quasi-divine skill is very special. If they’re unwilling, we can’t even enter their house. By the way, its original contractor has also become its little brother. Ah, no, its little sister. Moreover, because its identity is a bad girl with two dead parents, it’s not easy to communicate. Now, it’s completely focused on the other party and doesn’t plan to stand on Dong Huang’s side at all. I’m thinking of a way to resolve this incident steadily.”
Shi Yu was amused. “That’s normal. A ready-made divine-level thigh. I will definitely cozy up to this.”
Lu Qingyi said, “Stop joking. Hurry up and think of a way.”
“Cough, but is it that difficult?”
“Yes.”
“Now, Teacher Ying is also assisting me beside me. Perhaps I’ve annoyed her… We can’t even get close to their 1km range now. We’re all isolated by the other party’s spider silk domain.”
Shi Yu: “Can’t get close?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1112 - 1112 demigod cat mother gem cat (2)
chapters.content:
1112 demigod cat mother gem cat (2)
“Even Teacher Ying can’t??? I’ve already given it the nine-colored divine light inheritance crystal. It already has top-notch totem battle power, why can’t it even enter the domain of a monarch-level reincarnation god?”
“Wu wu wu wu wu.” The gem cat’s cry came from the other side of the phone.
The gem cat cursed from the other side. Could it be blamed?
A cat face leaned over and said, “It’s not my fault. That big spider’s spider silk domain contains special laws. The nature of the laws is ‘indestructible’, and it has nothing to do with strength. Although its level is still low and its quasi-divine skill isn’t perfect, ordinary attacks are really useless.”
“They’ve been moving around in the city, but I don’t dare to use too powerful Skills.”
“Where’s your Instant Transmission?” Shi Yu said.
“The domain has also sealed the spatial Skill.” The gem cat.
Shi Yu said, “The proficiency is too low.”
The gem cat: “! #￥#@￥.”
The gem cat was angry.
“The other party’s spider silk domain is indeed very difficult to break. It has nothing to do with Teacher Ying, and I’m helpless… Fortunately, they didn’t do anything illegal, but they’re not interested in Dong Huang’s rope.”
Shi Yu said, “Then forget it. Some people like freedom and don’t like to be restricted. Don’t force it.”
Lu Qingyi said, “That’s indeed the case, but President Lin only feels that it’s a pity. After all, even that girl doesn’t have much of a sense of belonging to Dong Huang. It would be a pity if they left Dong Huang in the end.”
“Why don’t I take a look?” Shi Yu said.
….
After obtaining Senior Lu’s message, Shi Yu quickly arrived at the Linglan City she described. This place was backed by a continuous mountain. It was a third-level city, located in the suburbs of a second-level city. The geography was very remote.
Shi Yu directly arrived at the hotel where Senior Lu had temporarily rested and knocked on the door to enter.
The door was opened through Psychic power. At this moment, Lu Qingyi was leaning against a chair and reading with a conflicted expression. As Shi Yu entered, she put down the book and said, “Why do you look so weak again?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I just underwent a high-intensity battle. I’ve almost recovered from my Restoration.”
The supplements were all backed up in advance!
Shi Yu didn’t tell Senior Lu that he had used Qi’s power to transmigrate to an ancient parallel space. Qi didn’t want anyone other than Shi Yu to know its identity. It was mainly because Qi was afraid of being captured because its ability was always coveted. She really didn’t want to cause trouble.
The less people knew about it, the better.
“In short, you’re finally here.” Lu Qingyi stretched and said, “The director of Bureau 14 is yours. I’m off work. How do you plan to deal with that spider?”
Shi Yu said, “Let’s go take a look later.”
“Eh, what’s Teacher Ying doing? Why didn’t it welcome me?” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat in meditation.
Why was it suddenly so hardworking? Shi Yu looked at the dozen or so gem cat clones lying on the bed meditating with a strange expression.
“The revival of laws. Many countries have life forms that have awakened their divine power. Teacher Ying also wants to work hard and see if she’s the reincarnation of a god,” Lu Qingyi said with a smile.
“I feel that it’s really possible. After all, Teacher Ying’s talent is very strong, and her bloodline is very special. She doesn’t look like an ordinary gem cat.”
Shi Yu was speechless
It looked like it was working hard, but it turned out that it still wanted to take a shortcut to become stronger.
Impossible.
If it was the reincarnation of a god, Shi Yu could tell at a glance through the Mythical Revival teaching in the Skill Index.
For example, Qi. Because it was the reincarnation of a Time Sprite, even if all other skills couldn’t be taught, the Mythical Revival directly showed that it could be taught.
Teacher Ying couldn’t teach Mythical Revival, and it was only an intermediate Resistance. No matter how one looked at it, it didn’t look like the reincarnation of a big boss…
“Teacher Ying, all the best. You might really succeed,” Shi Yu said kindly. Although it was impossible to awaken, it wasn’t bad to be able to cultivate hard!
This was also worthy of that inheritance gem.
The gem cat opened its eyes and said, “Really?”
“Really,” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat: “I feel that you’re lying to me.”
Shi Yu : “…”
“Speaking of which, is Ancient God Golden Bull awake?” Shi Yu asked.
The gem cat: “Stop talking. The gods on Inatella Island are still sleeping. There’s no movement at all.”
“It’s been watching with my clone for more than half a year…” The gem cat’s main body had a pained expression.
The clones in meditation also revealed pained expressions. Although it wasn’t them and they had never seen that clone, they were both in the same boat. There was no need for them to know pain.
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “Teacher Ying, you’ve worked hard. This is for you.”
Shi Yu took out a special Reincarnation Fruit from the ruins space and threw it to the gem cat.
The gem cat was stunned and caught the Reincarnation Fruit with its Psychic power.
This…
Wasn’t this the Reincarnation Fruit that had awakened the power of the Abyss Demon Duck!!
It had wanted it previously, but Shi Yu had always rejected it with the excuse that its Resistance was too low. If it really had a previous life and was very strong, he was afraid that it would go berserk.
Was Shi Yu finally willing to give it to him?
“Alright!” The gem cat looked happy and said, “I’ll watch Inatella seriously. You guys…”
It looked at the pile of clones and said, “You guys go patrol Inatella too. Report any commotion.”
The gem cat clones: ???
Lu Qingyi: …
Shi Yu said, “There’s no need…”
The gem cat said, “Then I’ll eat?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - 1113 demigod cat mother gem cat (3)
chapters.content:
1113 demigod cat mother gem cat (3)
“If I can’t even do it after I eat this, I’ll give up.” The gem cat’s expression was serious.
Shi Yu said, “Eat, eat. No, let’s eat in the Blue Sea Ruins.”
Although the gem cat now had a medium-level Resistance, after being strengthened by its own nine-colored divine light, it was no problem for it to be comparable to a high-level Resistance, which was the overlord’s Resistance. In addition, Shi Yu was different from the past now. Nothing could happen.
Lu Qingyi said, “What’s this?”
Shi Yu said, “The resource my duck eats, the Reincarnation Fruit, is a resource that assists in activating the power of its previous life. If Teacher Ying really has a previous life and is the reincarnation of a god, it can be effective. If not, it’s useless.”
“Senior Lu, let’s take a look.”
…
A moment later, Shi Yu and the others entered the Blue Sea Ruins together.
The gem cat ate the Reincarnation Fruit excitedly.
Lu Qingyi stood beside Shi Yu and asked, “What do you think the chances of Teacher Ying having a previous life are?”
Shi Yu said, “I feel… 10%?”
Shi Yu’s judgment of whether transcendent creatures had the foundation of their previous lives was through the level of Resistance and Mythical Revival. For example, Duckie and Susu were the reincarnation of demigods, so they had the Resistance of overlords at the transcendent level.
As for Teacher Ying, it was already at the totem level, and its Resistance level was still medium. It didn’t look like the reincarnation of a big boss no matter how one looked at it. In addition, it couldn’t learn Mythical Revival. The 10% chance was because of its talent potential.
Shi Yu didn’t dare to say the chances were too low. After all, sometimes, the divine-level reincarnation of the sprite was only a precedent for the lowest Resistance…
What if?
“The taste is very strange,” the gem cat said after eating it in two bites.
“Yes, it’s a little spicy,” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat said, “It’s still acceptable, but it’s slightly spicy!”
With that said, it was suddenly stunned. A huge power spread from the gem cat’s body. Seeing this, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi were also stunned. In the next moment, the gem cat’s expression became even more serious. Then, nine-colored light slowly lingered on its body.
It was like the light of evolution.
Damn, there was really a previous life?!
At this moment, although the fragment-like power memories and identity memories were already blurry, the gem cat still recalled something.
At the same time, the power hidden in the deepest part of the bloodline appeared, causing the gem cat’s life form to undergo a huge change.
Under the lingering light of evolution, the gem cat’s figure was quickly outlined in the light, gradually forming a graceful figure. This humanoid figure grew cat ears and a long cat tail, directly stunning Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi.
Cat, cat girl?
However, before they could see clearly what the gem cat teacher would become after activating the power of its previous life, this power quickly disappeared. The gem cat returned to its original form and opened its beautiful blue gem eyes.
They were moved.
It wanted more Reincarnation Fruits!
It… actually had a previous life.
Moreover, it was a demigod!
Although it wasn’t a god, it was also the king of totems who had mastered an empire.
The experience was also very legendary. As an ordinary transcendent creature, it was knocked out by the meteor gem that descended from the sky. When it woke up, its eyes mutated and it broke through to the totem level. It could be said to be a true daughter of luck.
Long before the establishment of the human ancient countries like Dong Huang and Ming Hua, it had established a super empire that dominated an area and was known as the Goddess of Day.
However… the final form he cultivated in his previous life was actually in a humanoid form like the Dragon God?? And it was a cat girl? The reason was that this humanoid form was easier to control the power of the Meteor Gem?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - 1114 The Age of Adults Has Changed
chapters.content:
1114 The Age of Adults Has Changed
It was extremely quiet in the blue Blue Sea Ruins.
Shi Yu, Lu Qingyi, and the gem cat stared at each other.
After a long time, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi accepted this fact.
“This lazing cat was actually a demigod in its previous life!” Shi Yu couldn’t accept it.
It really succeeded in the bet?
Could this guy really go from an overlord to a demigod…
Shi Yu’s eyes were filled with tears as he felt pity for the other demigods.
Also, no wonder its Resistance was so low. It turned out that it had won without doing anything in its previous life!
In this world, there were always a few people who were so lucky that they couldn’t help but accept reality.
“Besides.”
The gem cat looked elegantly at the surrounding sea and said, “I’m not an ordinary demigod.”
It felt that in its previous life, it had not completely unearthed the power of that meteor gem.
In his previous life, it tried to transform into a cat girl to unearth more gem power.
Even the “gem cat” race was created by it to study the relationship between various gems and eyes.
In fact, even reincarnation was to unearth the power of the gem.
It could be said that it was the gem cat god.
Continuous research made the cat understand that the gem from the starry sky of the universe definitely had many secrets.
However, restricted by the laws of the world, it couldn’t be completely developed.
When the Mythical stage completely revived, it might be able to activate the complete power of the meteor gem that had fused into its body, even if its power still followed after reincarnation.
At that time, not only would it be a demigod, but they might even have hope of reaching the divine level.
“Wu wu wu wu wu… I made it through.”
The gem cat wiped its tears.
In the past, this was also an extremely extraordinary archeological Achievement.
Because the gem cat looked like an Earth ragdoll cat, it had a beautiful, cute, and elegant appearance, as well as the price of being close to the people, it was also a popular animal in the seven countries on Blue Planet.
Although the gem cats that could be seen now were constantly optimized by their race, their origin was really unknown.
It involved the origin of a world-famous race with super popularity and was also related to a demigod. It could probably double the gem cat’s net worth.
The Reincarnation Fruit was really a good thing!
However, Shi Yu definitely didn’t care about archeological Achievement of this level anymore.
“Shi Yu, you saw it, right! Give me ten boxes of Reincarnation Fruits to help me cultivate first.” The gem cat looked forward to it just thinking about it.
Demigod, demigod!
Looking at Shi Yu’s respect for the Dragon God and the importance Dong Huang attached to Dragon Palace City, the gem cat could understand that after becoming a demigod, it would directly take off on the spot.
“It’s very tiring to create the Reincarnation Fruit.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “Use the divine light to assist Baby Ginseng in creating it.”
The gem cat fell into deep thought and nodded. No problem! This was easy!
“I’ll get a hundred clones to assist Baby Ginseng!” it said generously.
Shi Yu said, “…You’ll scare Baby Ginseng.”
“Does Teacher Ying have any hope of becoming a demigod in the short term?” Lu Qingyi said. “At the moment, the Blue Planet Alliance in its prototype state is still mainly the Seven Nation Alliance. Among the seven countries, Shen Feng already has three Legendary demigods. If Teacher Ying can also become a demigod, Dong Huang might have a higher right to speak.”
The gem cat looked smug. “Although I don’t really want to be involved in this kind of thing, I have no choice… I’ll become a demigod as soon as possible. Speaking of which, Qingyi, help me apply for some resources in the association to help me cultivate!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Teacher Cat, don’t worry. There’s no need to feel too much pressure. It’s fine even if you can’t reach it. There’s still me. I’ve cultivated bitterly for half a year. Now, I can almost fight a demigod evenly. Dong Huang won’t lose out.”
The gem cat and Lu Qingyi: ????
“What kind of expression is that? According to the recovery progress of this law, demigods are probably going to be common. They’re not worth mentioning, not worth mentioning…”
Pa.
The gem cat was immediately unhappy. Its face fell. No, demigods weren’t enough. It wanted to become a god!
…
Linglan City.
In a certain luxurious mountain villa, a golden-haired girl in a baseball jacket and white shirt and a dark green short skirt was meditating with a serious expression.
Beside her was a 1.5-meter-tall humanoid white-haired spider girl in a wide white spider-patterned bathrobe.
“I’m level three.” A moment later, the blonde girl opened her eyes excitedly.
“So slow.” The spider girl beside her shook her head and said, “When you reach the level where you can contract a monarch-level creature, we’ll leave here.”
“Do we really have to leave Dong Huang?” The golden-haired girl looked hesitant and said, “This place is relatively safe. I heard that it’s very dangerous abroad.”
She looked at the spider lady in front of her. Who would have thought that a few days ago, the other party was still an Awakening-level white spider she had contracted?
In just one night, the other party broke free of the contract, and its strength became difficult to understand. It was even so resourceful that it could transform into a human form that was more suitable for this society!
“That’s only now,” the white spider girl said. “When it comes to dangerous times, the more lives there are in such a place, the more dangerous it is. The lives of this faction are too weak. There’s no need to follow them.”
“The titled expert you mentioned previously is only at that level.”
“If you’re conflicted, I won’t take you away,” the white spider girl said impatiently. If it weren’t for the fact that the other party had saved its reincarnation and even contracted it to accompany it for so long, it wouldn’t have bothered with this little girl.
“No, I’ll listen to you,” the blonde girl hurriedly said. She was still very convinced by the spider girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115 - 1115 The Age of Adults Has Changed (2)
chapters.content:
1115 The Age of Adults Has Changed (2)
After all, Lu Qingyi, one of the ten titled legends of Dong Huang, was helpless against the other party.
Before this, the blonde girl was only a level-one Beast Tamer intern, the kind who purely raised pets as pets. Although she didn’t know much about the Beast Taming Domain, she understood Dr. Lu’s value.
Seeing that Lu Qingyi, who often appeared on the Internet and the news, had suffered and been rejected by the little spider she had contracted, she definitely trusted the white spider girl now and thought that it was the most powerful. After all… this was the reincarnation of a god.
Even the previous emperors of Dong Huang and the first president of Divine Source, who established the modern Dong Huang, had yet to reach the divine level.
In short, it was enough to believe in the little spider. Now, as an orphan, not only did she level up two levels in a short few days with the other party’s help, but she also ate delicacies and lived in a villa. What else was there to ask for?
“Someone else is here. They’re really haunting me.” At this moment, the spider girl who was supervising the blonde girl’s cultivation sensed the situation outside through the spider domain.
“Someone else? That Dr. Lu?” the blonde girl said.
“No, it seems to be a male this time,” the spider girl said.
“Let me see the surveillance video.” The blonde girl took out her cell phone and pulled up the surveillance video. Then, on the mountain road, she saw a short-haired young man in a white panda short-sleeved shirt and black pants walking over with his head lowered, playing with his cell phone.
The surveillance camera was quite clear. After she saw this figure, she stared at the other party’s face carefully and kept feeling that it was a little familiar.
“Do you know him?” the spider girl said. “Forget it, ignore him. They can’t enter anyway.”
Its spider silk was indestructible.
< Name > Divine Silk
[Level]: Quasi God-level
< Introduction > It can condense spider silk that contains the indestructible law and has endless nature changes. The spider silk can’t be destroyed by any form of power.
The Spider Lady was very confident in her Skill.
But soon, its expression suddenly changed, revealing an incredulous expression.
Its change also stunned the blonde girl beside it. “What’s wrong?”
At the same time.
Shi Yu stopped and looked at the place where the reincarnation god was. He could clearly see that a huge semicircular spider silk domain wrapped the entire villa area in front of him.
The white spider silk was incomparably thin, interweaving into a cage.
“There are so many. Looks like the other party’s quasi-divine skill is of the equipment resource type. It can be condensed and stored in advance. Not bad, I can get some to make clothes. It looks much better than Buggy’s worm silk.”
“Eleven.” Shi Yu chuckled. Little Eleven crawled out of his pocket and gradually enlarged to more than a meter.
Pa.
“Wuu?” Little Eleven was shocked. As Teacher Cat had said, it was so hard.
Shi Yu said, “There’s also the connection barrier. From the looks of it, it can’t shrink and enter either… Buggy’s spatial level is inferior to Teacher Cat, and it can’t teleport. It’s indeed very difficult to deal with.”
In fact, the current spider silk was still alright. After all, it was only at the quasi-divine skill stage. There was still a chance to break it with brute force.
When it really reached the divine skill stage, this skill that contained true laws was the most troublesome.
At that time, this kind of spider silk might really be indestructible.
If they couldn’t find the right cracking method, even higher-level life forms might be helpless against the law divine skills of life forms with weak battle power.
Qi’s spatial travel meant that as long as Qi could sense the danger, no one could catch it.
The battles of laws were mostly skill battles. They often needed to crack some special laws.
However, in most cases, Shi Yu was actually invincible.
Because Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone contained destructive laws that could obliterate everything, including laws. Therefore, as long as Eleven’s divine skill proficiency level could keep up, most law divine skills could directly be obliterated by its law nature with the Millstone.
“Just give the other party a greeting gift. Don’t wait for the other party to open the door.”
“Eleven, Yin Yang Millstone.”
“Wuu!!”
Little Eleven directly stretched out its palm, and a Yin Yang Millstone the size of a teacup condensed in front of its palm.
It didn’t throw it out. It held it like this. As the millstone spun, dazzling lightning light began to obliterate everything.
< Name > Yin Yang Millstone
[Level]: Quasi God Level (Proficient)
After the battle with Emperor Wu and eating the World Tree Fruit as a fruit for half a year, Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone finally increased its proficiency by one point without adding any points.
It was even more proficient in controlling this Skill now. At this moment, just holding it in its hand, the strong destructive wave instantly obliterated the special laws on the surrounding spider silk domain.
Buzz!!!
The sound of the obliteration of the power of laws, accompanied by the huge spider silk domain that surrounded the entire villa, disintegrated into countless snow-white spider silk that flowed into the surrounding spatial cracks. In the villa, the spider girl’s expression was shocked to the extreme.
“How can it have a top-notch law?” In its understanding, those who had such laws should be top-notch gods who had already left Blue Planet.
How could it appear on a pet contracted by a human?
BOOM!
The strong law suppression made the spider girl sweat profusely, soaking her white bathrobe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116 - 1116 The Age of Adults Has Changed (3)
chapters.content:
1116 The Age of Adults Has Changed (3)
“Who’s the human who came?” it asked again.
At this moment, sensing the vibration of the entire mountain, the golden-haired girl also knew that something was wrong. Unfortunately, she didn’t pay attention to the Beast Taming Domain previously. Lu Qingyi was the same, and so was Shi Yu. She didn’t know them too well. She said uncertainly,
“Perhaps it’s a legendary Beast Tamer with a title like Dr. Lu Qingyi. The world legend, Shi Yu, seems to be known as the strongest in the younger generation,” the golden-haired girl said.
As they communicated, Shi Yu and Eleven had already cracked the spider silk domain that made things difficult for the gem cat and Lu Qingyi. With the help of Buggy’s teleportation, they teleported in front of the two of them.
Buzz.
Shi Yu and Eleven appeared. Shi Yu smiled and made a handsome gesture to greet them.
“Yo, hello, are you interested in talking?”
“Has it changed?” The spider girl had a serious expression. It realized that it was wrong, very wrong. Although they were both titled legends, this Shi Yu was clearly much more terrifying than the girl and cat from before.
“How do you have such power?”
Although that cat’s growth level was very high, it gave it the feeling that it was stupid.
However, although this bear looked harmless, the power just now directly made it feel the bloodline suppression.
“Lord Divine Spirit, times have changed. This is an era of win-win cooperation. Dong Huang might not be able to withstand your previous request, but there should be other ways to cooperate.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “My name is Shi Yu. Come and talk.”
Eleven nodded. For example, if you were a tailor, Dong Huang would pay you!
“You can’t even bear to give me divine-level resources. Why should I believe your sincerity?” the spider girl said.
Shi Yu was stunned. “That’s not true.”
Shi Yu said, “Do you know gods like the Boar God, Xuan Ming, Lie Shanjun, Demon King Dragon, Holy Divine Deer, and Ancient God Golden Bull?”
“When I went to communicate with them, they were the ones who gave me divine-level resources.”
Spider Lady: “?”
“Impossible.” There were more Western gods among these gods. The spider girl had never heard of all of them, but what was the use of gods giving you divine-level resources?
“The reason is very simple.”
“Looks like your status in the divine level isn’t high. You know even less than a human like me, and you haven’t understood the current situation on Blue Planet.”
Spider Lady: “?”
In the next moment, through the mental scene, the spider girl saw the scene of gods giving Shi Yu divine-level resources and the scene of the planet’s Resistance transforming into the World Tree to give Shi Yu blessings.
This was a mental connection.
It could sense if what the other party said was true.
“The top-notch god, Goddess Wa, brought back humans. Humans are the savior race of Blue Planet, the fate race.”
“The Mythical Revival is imminent, and external enemies will invade again. Only humans can save the world. I passed the trial of the seven ancient gods and even defeated the Ancient God Golden Bull, allowing the World Tree to finally choose me. This is the will of the mother planet.”
“You can go to the World Tree to verify it later.”
“Therefore, cooperation is a win-win situation. We need your help now.” Shi Yu smiled. “Don’t tell me you want to go against the planet’s Resistance? You don’t want to be rejected by Blue Planet, right?”
Plop.
The spider girl’s heart raced as she looked at the human in front of her in shock. She didn’t expect the other party’s background to be so big.
It was really as the other party said… Humans were actually the savior race brought back by Goddess Wa after leaving Blue Planet?
And this young man from Dong Huang in front of him was actually the savior chosen by the planet’s Resistance in this savior race?
For a moment, the spider girl really found it difficult to believe. It was indeed as Shi Yu had said. Among the junior gods who survived, it was relatively transparent.
These secrets were very impactful to it.
It didn’t take long for Shi Yu to leave. Apart from a few words, he was talking to the spider lady telepathically the whole time. Beside him, the golden-haired girl was blurry the whole time and didn’t dare to move. She saw the spider lady sweating profusely beside her, her expression constantly changing.
“Did you say anything?” The blonde girl couldn’t help but say when she saw the spider girl like this.
The spider girl was silent. After a long silence, she said, “We’re not leaving. We’ll stay in Dong Huang.”
After all, it looked like it was arranged by the Blue Planet’s Will. It… had to obey. It didn’t want to be rejected by the Blue Planet’s Will.
….
On the other side, after confirming that his Poof God template was pretty useful, Shi Yu prepared a copy for Senior Lu so that she could follow the lines of the Poof God in the future.
In these words, humans were a racial savior chosen by a top-notch god. There was nothing wrong with that. Almost no human faction knew about this information. At the moment, Dong Huang had the absolute advantage.
He had passed the trial of the Ancient God and obtained recognition, obtaining the blessings of the World Tree. There was nothing wrong with that. The whole world knew.
The only problem was that at this moment, the World Tree probably had yet to entrust the fate of Blue Planet to him. It didn’t treat him as a savior and only nurtured him as a genius with potential.
However, it wasn’t a big problem. It had the heart to be the savior of Blue Planet. It wasn’t like the World Tree would despise him suddenly… It definitely couldn’t wait for everyone to be the savior! Shi Yu only overdrawn his identity in advance.
As long as he convinced himself that he was thick-skinned enough and connected all of this together, he would have the absolute orthodox identity of the Blue Planet’s Crown Prince. It was basically not a problem to trick most wild gods into joining…

chapters.title: Chapter 1117 - 1117 The Age of Adults Has Changed (4)
chapters.content:
1117 The Age of Adults Has Changed (4)
Shi Yu returned to the hotel room. Seeing Shi Yu return so quickly, Lu Qingyi and the gem cat were stunned.
“It’s over?”
“It’s over. Is it very difficult?” Shi Yu said. “Perhaps I’m more handsome. That little girl and the spider girl were stunned.”
Lu Qingyi and the gem cat: ???
“I’m just kidding.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “I’ve concluded a set of PY templates. Senior, you guys communicate according to this later. Later, you guys can talk to that spider girl and persuade it. Its ability is quite suitable to be a tailor.”
“Tailor?”
“That’s right.” The gem cat nodded. It could tell too.
“No, no, what template? And you? Didn’t you say that you would be the director of Bureau 14?” Lu Qingyi said.
Shi Yu said, “I’ll come again if you can’t solve it. It’s basically enough with you and Teacher Ying. I still want to continue cultivating. Now that the laws have revived and with the blessings of the World Tree, I feel that… I’m not far from the level-eight Beast Taming Space.”
Lu Qingyi was stunned. “So fast.”
“Well, I should be able to break through to the Legendary level in two years like Lin Feng Legendary, or faster than him,” Shi Yu said.
This directly made Lu Qingyi and the gem cat silent and feel a little stuffy.
Legendary below the age of 25… was a little too much.
“Speaking of which, because of the revival of the laws, many people broke through. White Brook and Xiu Zhu broke through to level six. Ji Feng even broke through to legend,” Lu Qingyi said.
“By the way, I also placed the Talent Control Bead with White Brook and the others.”
Shi Yu said, “I happen to have something to do with them. I obtained a batch of iron-eating beast evolution materials here. After looking for them, I’ll go into seclusion again.”
“I’ll tell you the template first…”
“Huh…?”
….
If he wanted to pull people in, he had to show his background. This was the most convincing thing. Without the big skin of the World Tree and the Blue Planet’s Will, it was too difficult to pull gods in.
To put it bluntly, just the Dragon God, Divine Source Legendary, and the others weren’t qualified enough to slot. They couldn’t obtain the recognition of the gods. Just describing Dong Huang’s potential wasn’t convincing enough.
80% truth and 20% lies could maximize Dong Huang’s advantage. It was relatively easy to rope in a weak god like the Spider God.
After Shi Yu finished teaching Senior Lu, who had lost her way on the path of life, he headed to Wu Ling City.
Compared to Wu Ling City in Emperor Wu Space-time, the modern Wu Ling City was much more familiar to Shi Yu.
In the endless blue sky, Shi Yu lay on the ship Lady Ling in the sky. He held his cell phone and dialed Senior Lin’s number. He greeted her in advance before going over.
“Shi Yu??” On the other side of the phone, Senior Panda looked surprised. She didn’t expect Shi Yu, who had been missing for so long, to still know to contact her.
“Senior, I heard you broke through to level six. Congratulations,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Lin Xiuzhu said, “Hmph, it’s all thanks to Master (Ji Mengzhu) teaching me well.”
“I’m going to Wu Ling City now. I brought gifts for you and Senior White Brook. Wait for me.”
“What gift?” Lin Xiuzhu said.
“Hundreds of Iron-eating Beast first-stage evolution materials, thousands of Iron-eating Beast inscription evolution materials.”
“There are all nine evolution inscription materials for the Iron-eating Beast.”
“Among them, there are thousands of meteorite fragments. We should be able to arm the Iron-eating Beast Corps.”
“You can evolve to your heart’s content.”
Bang.
On the other side of the phone, Senior Panda almost threw her cell phone away, her face turning pale.
There were thousands of meteorite fragments?
You, you, you, you went to poke Yun An’s nest?
However, Senior Panda trusted Shi Yu unconditionally and didn’t think that he was kidding.
Otherwise, with this mood fluctuating, she could beat Shi Yu to death.
Senior Panda was immediately excited. Which ruin did Shi Yu obtain such a large amount of resources from? She had never heard Master Ji Mengzhu mention it.
…With these resources, wouldn’t the Iron-eating Beast Corps be invincible?
It was indeed as Shi Yu had said. Their Iron-eating Beast could also become more perfect and stronger.
Coincidentally, she and White Brook had broken through to level six and had already made an appointment with Master Qu Jie for the advancement assessment of a top-notch master. They weren’t confident yet, but if the Iron-eating Beast could evolve a few times, it would definitely be stable!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1118 - 1118 Dragon Palace Searching for the Black Tortoise
chapters.content:
1118 Dragon Palace Searching for the Black Tortoise
Wu Ling City.
Shi Yu brought a pile of evolution materials over.
Ji Mengzhu, Lin Xiuzhu, White Brook, and the others were waiting for Shi Yu early.
As Shi Yu really poured a pile of evolution materials into the Iron-eating Beast Trial ruins, everyone’s expressions were stunned.
“You, where did you get this?”
Ji Mengzhu was shocked. Even during the era of Emperor Wu Dynasty, such a large number of evolution materials couldn’t be easily taken out.
“I cracked a ruin along the way. That’s not important.” Shi Yu looked at Aunt Ji Mengzhu and smiled.
He took it from her family and his uncle Emperor Wu.
As for the meteorite fragment, it naturally farmed Yun An. However, it was an ancient dungeon ruin…
The entire parallel space was a training ruin in Shi Yu’s eyes.
“Yes, Teacher, it’s not important!” Senior Panda’s eyes flickered at the side. She directly sat on the ground and picked up and observed these evolution stones one by one. She was like a little money-grubber.
With this, she could confirm that the Iron-eating Beast would completely become Dong Huang’s number one pet!
Its status would correspond to those quasi overlord races that far exceeded other countries, national treasures that could reproduce steadily.
“Wu wu wu, my Iron-eating Beast can finally evolve.” The beast-eared girl was extremely touched. The Iron-eating Beast was good in everything, but the inscription evolution materials were too lacking!
Seeing these evolution materials, she immediately didn’t regret joining the Iron-eating Beast Corps. She wanted to contribute, she wanted to change the materials!
“By the way, Shi Yu, I have good news for you.” Lin Xiuzhu, who was holding a rock, looked at Shi Yu.
“What?”
“After the revival of the laws, the probability of reproduction of most high-level pets of high-level races has increased. The experimental data on the iron-eating beasts are also extremely obvious. Before long, ordinary Beast Tamers can also contract iron-eating beasts.” Lin Xiuzhu smiled.
This was today’s latest research report in Dong Huang.
“This rule might also be applicable to humans. You can cultivate in peace now. You don’t have to worry about having a child in the future.”
“Ah, this.” Shi Yu immediately smiled in embarrassment. It wasn’t a big problem.
Even without the revival of laws, he could still become an ordinary person through physical control and the Time Fruit. In short, it was impossible for there to be a situation where Emperor Wu cultivated like crazy until the end and couldn’t even give birth to a child. Cough, cough.
Brother Emperor Wu, miserable! When Shi Yu thought of this, he immediately didn’t blame Emperor Wu for hitting him.
He didn’t know if the few divine medicines he had left behind could help him…
Perhaps there would be a new Legendary between Emperor Wu and the empress.
“Bring me to see the current situation of the various armies. Let’s have a meal together later. I have other things to do tomorrow, so I won’t stay long,” Shi Yu said.
“Busy person.” The three of them were immediately speechless.
Shi Yu expressed that he still had to prepare for battle!
Break through to level eight and farm the Yun An in this world!
He had to do it as soon as possible. With the revival of the laws, Yun An’s strength could probably improve again.
Yun An in this spacetime was already stronger than ancient spacetime. After the revival of the laws, it was undoubtedly stronger.
If Yun An was given more time to develop, Shi Yu was worried about another problem.
The ancient Yun An only used Blue Planet as a growth place. It planned to become stronger and become an extreme demigod. After absorbing the resources of Blue Planet, it would return to the starry sky.
Yun An in this space and time was undoubtedly closer to the extreme demigod. If it saw that so many gods had revived on the “low-level planet Blue Planet” one day and took things too hard, it wouldn’t want to develop here anymore. Wouldn’t Shi Yu suffer a huge loss if it directly ran out of Blue Planet?
At that time, it would be all for nothing.
Therefore, Shi Yu thought for a moment. He really couldn’t wait for the World Tree to awaken. It was better to rely on himself than on others.
He cultivated again and called Old Master Divine Source and Sister Dragon God. With the latter two added together, the suppression power would definitely be stronger than Emperor Wu. It wasn’t a big problem.
Next, Shi Yu, Senior Panda, and the others reminisced for a long time. They looked at the current development of the Iron-eating Beast Army, the Green Silkworm Army, the Mechanical Beast Army, and the Phoenix Army.
Among them, the Phoenix Army was built later. The Beast Tamers were all mixed-blood female soldiers with the Phoenix bloodline.
The current manager was Senior Lu’s mother, Mrs. Lu.
The members were all carefully selected geniuses from various places. Shi Yu’s batch of Beast Tamers, Zhang Qianyi, was also taking a leave of absence from school to join the army.
The four armies were developing pretty well. After Shi Yu arrived to inspect them, he thought that he had money and capital now, so he casually mentioned a plan to let the Green Silkworm Army develop into spatial and dragon types.
This way, the Iron-eating Beast Army corresponded to the strongest army of Emperor Wu Dynasty, the Phoenix Army corresponded to the strongest army of the empress dynasty, the Green Silkworm Army corresponded to the strongest army of the Dragon Emperor and the Space Emperor Dynasty, and the mechanical phantom beast army corresponded to the strongest army of the modern era. It was directly perfect.
This was what an army established by an archeologist should look like…
Forget about Emperor Shi’s army. In Emperor Shi’s army, Beast Tamers and pets were not special. They relied on the equipment and resources produced by Emperor Shi’s time-element pets. The powerful one was Emperor Shi, and it had little to do with the army itself.
Baby Ginseng still had to take care of the first and second teams, Shi Yu, and the gem cat. It really didn’t have time to take the time to lead another time-element army.
However, Shi Yu felt that he could poach the time-element totem of the Prediction Owl from Imperial Capital University and let it be a dog-headed military advisor to his four armies.
He was already at the totem level and had the ability to develop other time-element Skills on his own. Although it was a little unreliable in the past, his level was high now, after all. Bringing an army shouldn’t cause him to be wiped out, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1119 - 1119 Dragon Palace Searching for Black Tortoise (2)
chapters.content:
1119 Dragon Palace Searching for Black Tortoise (2)
In a day, Shi Yu visited the in-charge of the four armies consecutively. After everyone gathered for a meal at night, Shi Yu left Wu Ling City under the cover of night.
He wanted to do the last thing before returning to Ping Cheng to cultivate.
He would go to Dragon Palace City and subdue a turtle and snake.
Today, he had already left the development EXP of the top-notch Fusion Talent to Senior White Brook and also left some resources. Coupled with the Talent Bead, she could already try to develop the talent.
!!
As for Shi Yu, he still had to use the other secret skill he had obtained from Emperor Wu, the “Turtle Snake Black Tortoise Fusion Technique”, to its effect.
At the moment, there were still four empty seats in the second team’s contract slot. He planned to catch two pets to raise first.
The feedback from the growth of pets… It would be a waste not to.
Turtle, snake, turtle, snake… This kind of thing was definitely the most common in Dragon Palace City.
After contracting the turtle snake, there were still two slots left.
Shi Yu planned to find another little cat to evolve into a white tiger.
He had already gotten Teacher Cat to help pay attention. This guy knew many felines. Perhaps there were suitable ones.
As for Vermillion Bird, let’s see if Chi Tong could cosplay through its clone.
At that time, the four holy beasts would be complete.
There was also the Horned Demon Divine Stone. This time, as the laws revived, its life aura became more active. It was just that he didn’t know when it could be unsealed.
….
As Shi Yu flew to Dragon Palace City, his communication device rang. Shi Yu arrived at the deck of the mechanical spaceship and picked up the call side by side with Yun Hai.
It was President Lin.
“You’re back? Where are you now?” On the other side of the phone, President Lin’s tone was very experienced.
“I’m back. I’m in the sky…”
President Lin: “?”
“I’m flying in the sky and about to go home.”
President Lin: …
Now that he was calling, he should be done.
“I also saw the system report from Lu Qingyi and Ji Mengzhu. It’s been hard on you for the past half a year,” President Lin sighed.
He was originally very worried about Shi Yu running out to wander for so long. However, when President Lin learned that Shi Yu had just returned and turned the gem cat into a demigod potential and strengthened the Iron-eating Beast Corps at the epic level, all the negative emotions immediately disappeared!
Young people should go out and explore more. Only then could they gain more.
“I didn’t expect you to actually find so many iron-eating beast evolution materials in foreign ruins,” President Lin said. “Just looking at the amount of materials and not looking at the origin, I almost thought you went to farm Yun An alone.”
“No, no,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
It was a Party up.
“Recently, the various facilities of the Blue Planet Alliance have basically been perfected. I’m more busy here. Please help take care of Lu Qingyi’s mission. There’s actually one more thing. I wonder if you’re interested.”
“What is it?” Shi Yu asked.
He knew that President Lin would take the time to call him out of his busy schedule. He definitely had Quests again.
“In order to compete for the right to speak in some matters, the Seven Nation Alliance plans to hold an Alliance Meeting to decide certain plans with battle. The seven countries will each send a Titled Beast Tamer below level nine, which is below the legendary level, to represent them in the battle.”
“You mean you want me to participate?” Shi Yu said.
“That’s indeed what I mean. In a month, the conference will be held. Now that the rules have revived, the titled experts of the various countries are even stronger. Those who can fight are basically the number two’s of that country. Dong Huang’s titled experts are only stronger than other countries in terms of numbers and strength. Although there are Beast Tamers like the Tyrannical Sea Legend who can fight against top-notch totems, the difference isn’t especially obvious.”
“Moreover, the rules of this meeting are 1VS1. The army tactics of many experts are restricted.”
“After thinking about it, you’re the most suitable to participate. In terms of individual pet cultivation speed, among the titled experts in the country, if you say you’re first, no one dares to say they’re second. Moreover, after half a year of training, your strength must be stronger, right?” President Lin smiled like a sly old fox.
He was right. Although the legend of the Tyrannical Sea was strong, it was only strong in army tactics.
In his Mutated Leviathan’s Infinite Devour Space, it raised an ocean army all year round as the backup power of the Mutated Leviathan.
With the support of this ocean army, the battle power of the Mutated Leviathan could easily suppress ordinary Normal totems. It was the same principle as the Iron-eating Beast Army defending against totem-level attacks at that time.
If it was the 1VS1 rule, the battle power of someone like the legend of the Tyrannical Sea would directly decrease.
Shi Yu could actually do this kind of army battle too. For example, the birth of life in Little Zi’s body was actually Shi Yu nurturing his faith army.
“Alright, I feel that in a few days, I can represent Dong Huang,” Shi Yu said.
President Lin was even happier. “Then I’ll leave it to you. By the way, you have to prepare for battle seriously.”
“The competition in this meeting will be very intense.”
“The first time the laws revived, many reincarnated gods awakened their memories. Many gods woke up from their sleep. According to what I know, the trump card of a titled expert in Rongguang is the reincarnation of the angel god. Now, they have already recovered their memories.”
“In other words, if both parties don’t break the contract, this titled expert will have the battle power of a ‘Mythical Race, overlord level’. Your solo advantage doesn’t mean that you can still rely on quasi-divine skills and faith skills to kill everyone like in the World Tournament.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1120 - 1120 Dragon Palace Searching for Black Tortoise (3)
chapters.content:
1120 Dragon Palace Searching for Black Tortoise (3)
“What you have, the opponent will also have…”
“If this situation also happens in other countries and they reach a cooperation with a certain god to contract on an equal or unequal basis, it will make this Alliance Meeting even more complicated.”
“This is also one of the reasons why I’m looking for you. It’s still a little difficult for the other titled legends of Dong Huang to fight an opponent with quasi-divine skills, but you’re different. You have the battle record of defeating Ancient God Golden Bull. Ancient God Golden Bull should be considered one of the best among the divine-level creatures at that time, right?”
Shi Yu was stunned before saying, “I understand. The opponent this time might have a contracted target of a Mythical Race, right?”
“Yes.” President Lin sighed and said, “Rongguang is really lucky.”
Shi Yu also sighed. He didn’t expect that his quasi-divine skill advantage had only been maintained for more than half a year before the version was updated.
This way, the pressure was indeed a little high. After all, he still didn’t know the situation of the opponent. If the opponent was an opponent with simple and crude elemental laws like Ancient God Golden Bull, Shi Yu didn’t mind.
He was afraid that opponents with strange rules that involved various special phenomena would be beaten up for their information.
“But during this period of time, it’s better to focus on meditation. It’s a little tiring to add quasi-divine skills, and the efficiency isn’t high. Well… I can start teaching Little Ji Mythical Revival, add points to Duckie, and let it awaken the Abyss quasi-divine skill. This way, maybe soon, there will be two more Mythical Races in my team.”
Law battles were very good at countering each other. With two more quasi-divine skills in the team, he could be more confident. Most importantly, by giving Shi Yu more power, he could open a longer and stronger domain.
After Shi Yu hung up, he continued to fly towards Dragon Palace City while telling the pets of the first and second clueless teams about the so-called Alliance Meeting.
The pets of Team One, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others, were immediately excited when they heard that there was a divine beast reincarnation to beat up.
“Roar!!!” In the Beast Taming Space, Buggy took the initiative to volunteer. The divine beast from the last time was beaten up by Eleven. Could it be left to it this time?
“Me, me, me.” Chi Tong turned into its Sword Maiden form and begged Shi Yu cutely.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, looked old. When it thought of the subsequent pile of work, it couldn’t be interested in battle at all. It only wanted to self-destruct.
As expected, work was very easy to corrode Resistance.
Shi Yu felt that the problem was very big and got Susu to cleanse Baby Ginseng…
“Don’t be excited.” Shi Yu smiled, but soon, Shi Yu realized that the first team was pretty good.
The second team was even more excited.
“Roar!!!”
“Quack!!!”
Why not let them fight the divine reincarnation this time? As long as they could also awaken quasi-divine skills, they could definitely do it!!
“Be more reserved. The opponent is an angel god, an angel god!!”
Little Ji: “Roar!! (It’s a birdman. Eat my Earthquake!)”
Duckie: “Quack? (?? Why would you use earthquakes on a flying opponent? Can you hit it? Leave it to me!)”
Shi Yu: …
As expected, he should give Little Ji some intelligence. Expert level basic intelligence wasn’t enough.
No, even elementary school students should be able to understand this kind of entry-level knowledge!!
He still couldn’t understand how Little Ji reached expert level.
Little Ji: “Roar!! (Your abyssal power is countered by the Angel’s Light, you’re the one who shouldn’t fight! I still have the Space Splitting Sword!)”
Duckie: “Quack!” (Fight me after the meeting!)
Shi Yu: …
He didn’t know that the earthquake couldn’t hit flying objects, but he knew that the Angel Light countered the power of the abyss? There was something wrong with him!
Was this guy really stupid or pretending to be stupid?
….
Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu had returned to Dragon Palace City in a long time. Out of convenience, he directly entered this time. No one discovered Buggy’s Instant Transmission.
In Dragon Palace City, probably only the Space Dragon King and the Dragon God had higher spatial attainments than Buggy.
After arriving, Shi Yu directly found the Frost Dragon King, the Frost Demon Dragon. He didn’t expect that not only did this guy not take advantage of the revival of the laws to cultivate hard, but he was also counting treasures in his Dragon Palace.
“Who…” Space ripples flashed, and the Ice Dragon King was shocked.
Then, she saw Shi Yu and the one-meter-long little green dragon flying beside him.
The corners of Ice Dragon’s mouth twitched. “…”
“Little ones, why are you here? Why didn’t you knock!!”
It was shocked and almost thought that someone was going to snatch the treasure.
Shi Yu, that was fine. This guy probably didn’t fancy this trash anymore.
Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “Didn’t you say last time that I didn’t have to be polite and just treat this place as home?”
“For convenience’s sake, I directly teleported in at once.”
Ice Dragon looked at Shi Yu and Buggy in silence. Alright, alright.
That seemed to be the case.
Ice Dragon grinned and said, “So, you didn’t come to Dragon Palace City for no reason. Is the big leader here to inspect the work? Let me tell you, the work of the Green Dragon Faith in Dragon Palace City is pretty smooth, mainly because the eldest prince, who you beat up, cooperated well.”
“Don’t worry, with me around, there’s no problem at all.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s not about that. I’m here to ask you for two people. Ah, wait, sea beasts.”
Ice Dragon: “Huh?”
Shi Yu said, “Do you have the ‘personal resumes’ of all the members of the various turtle and snake races in Dragon Palace City? I remember that Dragon Palace City is also very strict in managing personal information, right? Get me a copy.”
Ice Dragon: …
What was Shi Yu doing??
However, it was true that because of the Dong Huang Alliance, in terms of modernization, Dragon Palace City did very well compared to other totem countries! This also made it more convenient for the Dragon Kings to manage the various races under them.
“There seems to be such a thing in the Environmental Protection Department. I’ll go find it.” The Ice Dragon King took out something that looked like a shell and shouted at it, “Prime Minister Turtle, Prime Minister Turtle, are you there, are you there, are you there!!!”
“Ah… I’m here.”
“Help me find something! No turtle speed!”
…
A moment later, the Ice Dragon King’s exclusive Turtle Prime Minister flew over to the Ice Dragon Palace with a huge booklet. When it saw that Shi Yu was also here, it immediately bowed and greeted in surprise.
“Minister Shi Yu, wu wu wu…”
“Prime Minister Turtle, are there any geniuses in your Longevity Turtle Race recently?” Shi Yu smiled and took the faction booklet that included 11 turtles and seven sea snakes. At the same time, he didn’t forget to ask.
Although there weren’t many members of the Longevity Turtle, it should be the Turtle Race with the greatest power in Dragon Palace City. Its status was even above some pure-blooded dragons.
“Hehe, how can those melons in our race dare to call themselves geniuses in front of Minister Shi Yu?” the Turtle Prime Minister said.
“I’m nothing. I was just lucky. Isn’t there any relatively special member in the Turtle Race recently?” Shi Yu asked.
In fact, it didn’t matter if he was a genius or not. It didn’t matter if he was a demigod or a god reincarnated. The most important thing was that he was special. At least, he had to have some shining points to contract him.
The Turtle Prime Minister was stunned. It glanced at the Ice Dragon King, who was also thinking hard, and also thought for a moment. Then, it immediately said, “Speaking of which, recently, our Longevity Turtle Race has indeed had a kid who became stronger quite quickly. He can be said to be a genius that’s rarely seen in a hundred years…”
“It’s just that…”
Shi Yu said, “It’s what.”
The Turtle Prime Minister said, “It was just a small accident. Its father used his connections to lock it in the 0.5th level of the underwater prison to reflect! It probably won’t come out for a hundred years!”
Shi Yu was stunned. “As expected of your Longevity Turtle. One level is a hundred years. If this was a Green Silkworm, it would have long died a hundred times.”
Buggy felt aggrieved. Did it provoke him?
“Did it do something wrong?” Shi Yu shook his head. If there was a problem with the turtle quality, forget it.
The Turtle Prime Minister pondered and said, “Sort of. It… it fell in love a snake race! In the Longevity Turtle Race, the mating of races is not allowed! What a sin.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1121 - 1121 Love Across Races (1)
chapters.content:
1121 Love Across Races (1)
Shi Yu was silent.
Ice Dragon was also stunned.
A genius Longevity Turtle had fallen in love with a snake?
What was going on, little brother?
Shi Yu had a strange expression.
[Ling, is it you?]
[Ling: Huh?]
In short, Shi Yu suspected that Ling’s luck skill was giving him more trouble again.
What was he doing in Dragon Palace City this time? Finding an individual who could fuse into a Black Tortoise.
He happened to need turtles and snakes.
In the end, a tortoise and snake in a relationship came here?
This… This was simply a perfect Black Tortoise template.
Just like the Green Dragon, the Black Tortoise also had many images.
As for Emperor Wu’s Black Tortoise, its evolution direction was towards the legendary Turtle Snake Black Tortoise image.
On Earth, Black Tortoises with the image of turtles and snakes were actually popular.
For example, after the Han Dynasty, the image of the turtle and snake fusion was left behind by the ancient clans that worshiped the turtle or turtle totems and the clans that worshiped the snake totems.
From this point of view, it was very scientific for a turtle and snake to mate and produce a black tortoise!
But in reality, this was actually very unscientific.
After all, with segregation, it was impossible to mate successfully.
In nature, only pure-blooded dragons with powerful bloodlines could cross races to mate.
Presumably, this was also the reason why the Longevity Turtle Race, which had difficulty reproducing, prohibited mating with other races.
There weren’t many descendants to begin with, and they still had to waste them on other races. It was time to pass!
Shi Yu seemed to understand Father Longevity Turtle’s anger.
“Minister Shi Yu?” The Turtle Prime Minister couldn’t help but shout when it saw Shi Yu silent on the spot.
“Show me the information on these two guys you mentioned,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes.” The Turtle Prime Minister nodded and quickly flipped through their information.
Shi Yu looked at it.
[Race]: Longevity Turtle
[Stats]: Water
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Commander
< Introduction > It’s the son of the Turtle Prime Minister of the Lightning Dragon Palace. It’s talented and has a mutated body. It broke through to commander rank less than a year after it was born.
Later on, because he violated the clan rules, he was imprisoned by his father on the 0.5 level of the underwater prison to reflect…
The 0.5th floor of the underwater prison… That was a specially opened level. It was mainly used to lock disobedient second-generation heirs of the Dragon Palace. The internal environment was harsh, and it was a very terrifying place.
It was considered a childhood shadow that the experts of Dragon Palace City would casually mention to scare children when educating their heirs.
“What’s going on? He’s not even a year old, but he’s already a commander rank???” Shi Yu was stunned.
Because the Longevity Turtle had a long lifespan, its growth was very slow.
“Did the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace give it some crazy gold karats?”
The Turtle Prime Minister: “Ah… What resource is that? No, the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace said that that little guy usually eats basic food. To be able to grow so quickly, it’s purely a mutation.”
“I think it’s also because of the mutation that its mating concept is a little problematic…”
“Mutated creatures all have some strange problems. It’s not strange for them to mature early and have strange mating orientations.”
The Turtle Minister looked at Shi Yu with a gossipy expression and said, “Speaking of which, this is also related to you, Minister Shi Yu!”
Shi Yu: “?”
“What has it got to do with me?”
The Turtle Prime Minister said, “You forgot that the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace has never had any descendants because he’s too old and too strong. He even asked you for the Time Fruit…”
“It successfully had a son when it was old because it mated after eating the Time Fruit you gave it…”
Shi Yu: “?”
Ice Dragon:!!!
“After that little turtle was born, it has always had high hopes. It plans to start training when it grows up a little.”
“But who knows…”
“Who knew that that little turtle would actually have such thoughts when he was only a year old? It’s as if he has lovesickness and is obsessed with lovesickness all day. His cultivation speed has decreased greatly, making the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace furious…”
Ice Dragon: Ah, this.
Shi Yu: “He’s only one year old. No matter how I look at it, a child is insensible.”
“Moreover, how did they come into contact?”
The Turtle Minister: “It seems that because a playful little turtle was injured somewhere in the Dragon Palace and was helped by the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race.”
“Then, the two parties met again at a banquet and completely became friends.”
“Both parties are geniuses. They fight and spar every day, play every day, and grow and improve together.”
“Then, the little turtle fell in love.”
Ice Dragon: “Young people are really fancy.”
Shi Yu: “It’s good to be young.”
The Turtle Prime Minister: “The Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace thinks so too, so it’s only angry for a while before starting to personally educate it.”
“We tried to stop it. Teaching it how to mate across races won’t have a good outcome. Telling it that it’s still young and that it doesn’t know love at all. Moreover, the race rules don’t allow the mating of races.”
“The Turtle Prime Minister of the Lightning Dragon Palace originally thought that this would end and also thought that the child was insensible, but I didn’t expect that little turtle to be quite stubborn…”
“In the end, it mustered its courage and secretly took out a dragon ball from the birth gift Lord Wex Dragon King gave it. It ran to confess to the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race.”
“And in the end?” Shi Yu ate the melon excitedly.
“In the end, the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race rejected the little turtle very bluntly, making the little turtle lose its soul.”
Ice Dragon: “Tsk, tsk, tsk, standard outcome!”
The Turtle Prime Minister said, “It’s not over yet. The lost little turtle is completely listless. The Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace expected better from someone and threw it into the underwater prison to reflect. It said that it wanted it to be locked up for 100 years.”
“But actually, it definitely won’t be locked up for that long. I just hope it can wake up quickly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1122 - 1122 Love Across Races (2)
chapters.content:
1122 Love Across Races (2)
“And the interesting thing is about to come. Who knew that after hearing that the little turtle was locked in the underwater prison, the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race immediately ran to plead for leniency?”
“So the reason why the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race rejected the little turtle is because the Dragon Ball is too precious. In addition, it also knows that the racial rules of both races don’t allow interracial love, so it rejected.”
“After all, the Winter Water Snake Race is an overlord race. It’s very difficult to reproduce across races.”
“It’s precisely because it’s more rational and knows that there won’t be a result that it rejected it very directly. However, its true thoughts can’t be hidden from a group of overlords.”
“It also has a good impression of the little turtle. At this moment, it wasn’t just the Turtle Prime Minister of the Lightning Dragon Palace who was silent. The Winter Water Snake overlord also fell silent and locked its daughter in confinement. Let it reflect on itself to avoid both parties falling completely later.”
Ice Dragon was shocked. Damn it, there was also a big problem with this little Winter Snake princess.
Shi Yu looked at the information on the little princess of the Winter Water Snake.
[Race]: Winter Water Snake
[Attributes]: Water, Ice
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Commander
< Introduction > She’s the daughter of the Winter Snake overlord. Her talent is shocking. She grew to commander rank at the age of one.
It was proud.
Shi Yu: “?”
“This is also a year old! Don’t tell me…”
“Ah, right, right, right. The little princess of the Winter Water Snake was also born because of Sir Shi Yu’s Time Fruit. The Time Fruit you sent made Dragon Palace City welcome a fertility wave.”
“Among them, using this opportunity, many breeding standard soldiers were also born in the Dragon Palace. Not only did they give birth to one child, but they also gave birth to a second child, a third child!”
“I remember that these overlords who have children at an old age gave Sir Shi Yu gifts. Didn’t you receive them…”
Shi Yu: …
His memory was bad.
Perhaps the gift was too light.
If it was a legendary resource, he would definitely remember it!
Ice Dragon looked at Shi Yu. So, was there a problem with the descendants born from the Time Fruit?
Why did they all like to fall in love across races?
However, talent did sound pretty good.
“So, Minister Shi Yu, what do you want to do with the information about the Tortoise and Snake Race?” the Longevity Turtle asked.
Shi Yu was silent for a moment before looking at him and saying, “Me.”
“I plan to nurture two new pets. The race I choose is the Turtle Snake.”
“What do you think?”
The Longevity Turtle widened its eyes.
They looked incredulous.
Holy shit.
A world legend had defeated the eldest prince of Dragon Palace City, the second prince, the third prince, and the strongest super Beast Tamer of the younger generation on Blue Planet. Sir Shi Yu planned to nurture a new pet?
Moreover, it planned to contract the Turtle Race and the Snake Race in Dragon Palace City?!
“What, what, what, really?” Ice Dragon was also shocked. “What’s there to nurture in a turtle snake? Why don’t you take my goddaughter away?”
Shi Yu said, “No.”
Ice Dragon: “Ah.”
Shi Yu said, “We’ll look at the other information later. I plan to see the Longevity Tortoise and Winter Water Snake you mentioned first.”
The Ice Dragon King and the Turtle Prime Minister looked at each other.
….
Soon.
Shi Yu descended to the underwater prison. After greeting the Golden Dragon King from afar, he entered.
In the depths of the underwater prison, the corners of the Golden Dragon King’s mouth twitched, but he still came out to welcome them.
The last time the Golden Dragon Prince applied to challenge Shi Yu, it agreed. It didn’t expect that it would be a depressed son who returned.
It even lost the faith of the citizens in his territory.
What a sin.
“What brings Minister Shi Yu here?” The Golden Dragon King circled in the air and said.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “It’s nothing. I’m going to see a second-generation heir locked on the 0.5th floor. Golden Dragon King, go do your work. I can do it myself.”
“Second-generation heir, which one is it?”
“The son of the Lightning Dragon Palace’s Turtle Prime Minister.”
“It?” The Golden Dragon King had some impression. After all, it had just been locked in not long ago.
Moreover, these second-generation heirs had to be taken extra care of.
After all, the environment here was harsh. He couldn’t really let anything happen to them.
A moment later, Shi Yu arrived outside the prison. He paid attention to the inside without being detected.
Inside the lone prison surrounded by rocks, black water surged, lightning flashed, and thunder rumbled. Demonic winds howled, and it was very oppressive. A small blue turtle was quietly… training on a huge rock?
It was a Little Longevity Turtle, only half a meter tall.
It had a pair of bright red and black eyes and a wavy tail.
Its watery blue body was wrapped in a hard black shell, and its abdomen was white. It was the appearance of the Longevity Turtle when it was young.
At this moment, this little Longevity Turtle was doing “heavy lifting” with difficulty, holding the huge rock to train.
“What’s going on?” Shi Yu asked.
“Love makes turtles crazy.” The Golden Dragon King sighed. With a harem of 300, it was extremely loving and knew this very well.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched.
After a casual guess, he understood that this blue turtle probably wanted to work hard to become stronger and obtain the right to speak through strength.
Wasn’t this quite ambitious? He wasn’t depressed at all. It looked like he had understood.
Shi Yu directly teleported into the prison.
He stood on the huge rock opposite the Longevity Turtle and looked at it quietly.
“Hu… Hu…” At this moment, the Longevity Turtle was exhausted and its consciousness was blurred. It didn’t notice anyone coming at all.
“Hey.” Only when Shi Yu spoke did the Longevity Turtle, who was training, suddenly jump in fright. It broke open the stone and took a step back to look at Shi Yu in shock.
Right on the heels of that, he accidentally fell off the rock and fell flat on his face. Then, he quickly got up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1123 - 1123 Love Across Races (3)
chapters.content:
1123 Love Across Races (3)
“Hu… Hu…!” The Longevity Turtle looked at Shi Yu cautiously.
Obviously, it didn’t know who Shi Yu was.
“Looks like you don’t know me.” Shi Yu looked at it and said telepathically, “I heard that you were locked in because of your puppy love?”
“Hu!” The Longevity Turtle’s expression was firm. Don’t even think about convincing it.
Its willpower could be Gritted.
It directly regarded Shi Yu as the guy its father had sent to persuade it.
However, that was impossible!
Even if the entire world stopped it, it had to persist. It believed that as long as it worked hard, it could definitely catch up to the other party.
“Continue. We’ll meet again.” Shi Yu chuckled.
He could see the other party’s determination.
Next, it was time to see the situation of the little princess of the Winter Water Snake.
If it was really as the Turtle Prime Minister had said and also had a good impression of this blue turtle, Shi Yu didn’t mind matchmaking it and taking it away.
Wasn’t it just that it was very difficult to reproduce across races and was forbidden by his family?
Was this a problem?
Shi Yu didn’t believe that the other party would refuse if he told the Turtle Prime Minister of the Lightning Dragon Palace and the Winter Water Snake overlord to take them away to give birth to Black Tortoises.
“You’re leaving just like that?” At the same time, the Golden Dragon King, who had sent Shi Yu away, had a strange expression.
He was very confused by Shi Yu’s behavior of leaving after only whispering a few words to the Longevity Turtle.
At the same time.
Winter Water Floating Island.
In the territory of the Winter Water Snake Race.
Shi Yu descended again.
In the depths of the Winter Water Snake habitat, the Winter Water Snake overlord was suddenly shocked and quickly flew out. Then, it was shocked to see Shi Yu standing on the island.
“Minister Shi Yu??”
As a little transparent in Dragon Palace City and even the Environmental Protection Department, the Winter Water Snake overlord didn’t understand why a big shot like Minister Shi Yu would suddenly come to its territory.
This thick blue-bodied white-striped snake immediately flew over ingratiatingly and said, “Minister Shi Yu, why are you free to come to me? Do you have any instructions?”
Shi Yu looked up at the Winter Water Snake overlord that was slowly descending and smiled. “Long time no see, Winter Water overlord.”
[!!] The Winter Water Snake overlord didn’t expect Shi Yu to still have an impression of it. They had clearly only met at the Dragon Palace banquet that time, and they didn’t communicate the whole time.
“I came this time to investigate some situations. Did you give birth to a daughter after you received the Time Fruit from the Environmental Protection Department?”
The Winter Water Snake nodded crazily and thanked him happily. “Yes, yes, and the talent is quite good. Thank you, Minister Shi Yu.”
“I heard that your daughter has some problems with the son of the Lightning Dragon Palace’s Turtle Prime Minister?”
The happy expression of the Winter Water Snake overlord stopped abruptly. It said awkwardly, “It’s like this. My daughter is really useless. Her talent is so good and she’s so young, but she’s actually obsessed with love. I’ve already locked her up to reflect!”
“How is is the situation with that right now,” Shi Yu asked.
“…Not good,it hasn’t eaten in a long time. It said that when that Longevity Turtle is released from the underwater prison, it will be willing to eat. Our family is unlucky!!” The Winter Water Snake overlord’s eyes were filled with tears.
What kind of sin was this?
It was only one year old, only one year old.
Shi Yu was silent. He could understand the Winter Water Snake overlord’s mood.
If anyone’s daughter was already like this at the age of one… As a father, he would definitely go crazy.
Moreover, this was foreign love…
But from the looks of it, the little princess of the Winter Water Snake Race had pretty deep feelings for the blue turtle.
“Can I take a look?” Shi Yu asked.
…
A moment later, Shi Yu also saw the legendary proud Winter Water Snake between the cliffs where the little princess of the Winter Water Snake was imprisoned. Just like the Longevity Turtle, the fusion skill could be taught.
At this moment, it was cold on the ice Rock, relying on sleep to reduce the physical consumption of not eating.
Shi Yu looked around. Indeed, only the Turtle Race and the Snake Race could learn the fusion skill developed by Emperor Wu.
As expected, it was more suitable to change this fusion skill to Turtle Snake Fusion and Black Tortoise Fusion.
“I’ll wake it up now.” Although the Winter Water Snake overlord didn’t know why Shi Yu wanted to see its daughter, it was very happy.
No matter what, Shi Yu was half a father to its daughter!
If this could be connected, wouldn’t it take off?
“There’s no need,” Shi Yu said. “Winter Snake overlord, have you thought about what will happen in the end if you don’t stop it from developing with that Longevity Turtle?”
The Winter Snake overlord was stunned, not understanding what Shi Yu meant.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Buggy’s spirits had already invaded the dream of the little princess of the Winter Water Snake.
Now, he also had to understand the thoughts of the little princess of the Winter Water Snake. After all, he couldn’t randomly matchmake them.
In the dream.
The Winter Water Snake Princess’s subconscious was looking at the human and the green dragon in front of her in confusion.
“Do you like that Longevity Turtle?”
Shi Yu and the others went straight to the point. In Buggy’s dream control, it was very difficult for the other party to lie. Even if it was lying, they could understand the other party’s true thoughts.
At this moment, when the little blue snake heard the young man’s question, it was immediately angry. A trace of red appeared on its face as it turned around in disdain.
[Who would like a turtle?]
Shi Yu and Buggy: ???
Didn’t the information say that it had a proud personality? This was clearly a proud personality. Why was its face red and its heart beating faster!
In the outside world.
“Minister Shi Yu, you mean…” The Winter Water overlord was confused.
Shi Yu looked at it and said, “I’m just about to nurture a Black Tortoise. That Longevity Turtle and your daughter have the potential to evolve into Black Tortoise together. In the future, they might even be able to breed True God Black Tortoise. If I want to take them away from Dragon Palace City and let them train and grow together, I wonder if it’s feasible.”
Shi Yu planned to follow the thoughts of the other party’s elders. After all, both parties were only one year old and very young. Once he brought them out, they would follow him for a longer time.
The Winter Water Snake overlord opened its mouth wide in shock. Shi Yu wanted to nurture a Black Tortoise? It knew that Shi Yu had already personally cultivated an orthodox Green Dragon. Now, he wanted to nurture a Black Tortoise? Moreover, he had chosen its daughter?
“You might not believe me, but I actually think very highly of them too. However, the rules of the Longevity Turtle Race are strict. I don’t have the power to change these at all, Minister Shi Yu! My daughter’s happiness depends on you, Minister!” The Winter Water Snake overlord cried.
Shi Yu: “?”
At the side, Buggy was silent. Why did it feel that the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace would also say the same thing later… They were too real!

chapters.title: Chapter 1124 - 1124 Abnormal Two New Pets
chapters.content:
1124 Abnormal Two New Pets
Next, the Winter Water Snake overlord followed Shi Yu to the Ice Dragon Palace. It was nervous and excited along the way.
It trusted Shi Yu very much.
After all, without Shi Yu, its Winter Water Snake Race would have been cut off.
It was all thanks to Shi Yu’s miraculous revival that it could have descendants.
It didn’t know if Minister Shi Yu had received the silk banner he had given him.
It was 99% thanks to Shi Yu that this daughter could be born, so it naturally had no objections to whatever Shi Yu wanted.
Moreover, this wasn’t a bad thing. It was a huge good thing.
After all, Shi Yu had taken the Little Water Snake away to nurture the “Black Tortoise”.
Among the relatives of the transcendent creatures, there were actually far fewer strong emotions than the humans.
The evolution of races was the strongest desire of transcendent creatures to reproduce in the next generation. The goal was to pass down their best genes.
Then, he would let this race reach the peak one day. This was an obsession engraved in the bloodline genes of transcendent creatures.
Now that there was a shortcut, it would be a waste not to take it. The Winter Water Snake overlord had already decided. If the Thunder Dragon Palace’s Turtle Prime Minister didn’t know what was good for him… It would… It would…
In the Ice Dragon Palace.
After Shi Yu and the Winter Water Snake overlord arrived, they got the Turtle Prime Minister of the Ice Dragon Palace to call the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace over.
“Lord Ice Dragon King.” The Winter Water Snake followed Shi Yu and looked at the Frost Demon Dragon carefully.
It happened to be a race protected by the Ice Dragon King in the Ice Dragon King’s domain.
“Ah.” Ice Dragon nodded.
The Winter Water Snake Race was indeed beautiful.
Its body was slender, and its entire body was covered in ice-blue scales. Its abdomen was snow-white, and its scales that were like snow clouds in winter covered both sides of its head. It was extremely beautiful.
However, it still had a strange expression, not understanding why the Longevity Turtle liked snakes.
But the difference in image was too big.
As expected, there was a problem with the Time Fruit… It couldn’t eat more in the future.
“This time, it’s the Genius Tortoise that fell in love with the Hack Dragon,” Shi Yu muttered beside him. This made sense. Both parties were in the same egg group.
Unfortunately, it wasn’t the same set.
However, if he really wanted to fall in love across races, it wasn’t like Shi Yu couldn’t think of a way to reproduce.
First, both parties evolved towards the dragon element and used the powerful genes of the dragon element to reproduce.
Secondly, both parties used the Black Tortoise Fusion Technique to temporarily fuse and evolve into Black Tortoises. Then, they relied on the Black Tortoise state to reproduce the next generation of Black Tortoises.
However, no matter what, both parties were no longer the Longevity Turtle and the Winter Water Snake. Moreover, every method was very difficult for people other than Shi Yu.
Soon, the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace arrived. It was still stunned and didn’t understand why the Turtle Prime Minister of the Ice Dragon Palace had called it over.
Could it be that the Ice Dragon planned to attack the Lightning Dragon Palace?
This new Ice Dragon King had recently spread the faith of the Green Dragon in Dragon Palace City very violently. Several Dragon Kings’ spheres of influence had been corroded!
It even included the Golden Dragon King’s territory!
“No, we have to protect Lord Lightning Dragon King’s territory. No matter how many benefits the Ice Dragon King gives, we can’t…”
