“Ah, Minister Shi Yu?! The Winter Water Snake overlord is also here?”
At this moment, as they arrived at the Quas Dragon Palace, the Turtle Prime Minister of the Lightning Dragon Palace saw Shi Yu and even the Winter Water Snake overlord. He was immediately stunned again, not understanding the situation.
“I’m not looking for you, it’s it.” The Ice Dragon King saw that the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace didn’t look very smart and pointed at Shi Yu.
At this moment, after seeing the Wex Dragon Palace’s Turtle Prime Minister, Shi Yu smiled.
“Prime Minister Turtle, long time no see. I heard that after you used the Time Fruit, you finally have a son in your old age. Congratulations.”
“Wu wu wu, thank you, Minister Shi Yu.” The Wex Dragon Palace’s Turtle Prime Minister looked excited. Thank you so much.
With such a huge favor, it would not hesitate to sacrifice a trace of Lord Wex Dragon King’s benefits even if it had to climb a mountain of blades and go through a sea of flames.
“I heard that something happened between your son and the son of the Winter Water Snake overlord?” Shi Yu looked at the Winter Water Snake and then at the Turtle Prime Minister.
Upon hearing that, the Turtle Prime Minister was stunned. Then, it looked at the Winter Water Snake overlord.
“Sigh, it’s a long story! However, I’ve already controlled that kid in time. Next, I’ll definitely let it study the Sage Book hard and assist the next Dragon King well,” the Turtle Prime Minister’s heart skipped a beat and he quickly said.
“No, I mean, there’s actually no need to be so strict.”
Shi Yu said, “We can completely let our descendants fall in love freely and decide their future themselves.”
Prime Minister Turtle: Huh??
“Ever since I cultivated one of the four holy beasts, the Green Dragon, I have the intention to nurture another Black Tortoise. Your descendants, the descendants of the Winter Water Snake overlord, are the best partners in terms of compatibility. They have the potential to evolve into Black Tortoise together. In addition, they were all born because of my Time Fruit and are fated with me. If I want to take them away from Dragon Palace City and let them train and grow in the outside world together, I wonder what Prime Minister Turtle thinks.”
The Turtle Prime Minister was stunned and opened its mouth wide in shock.
Holy shit, Black Tortoise?!
Only then did Ice Dragon and the Quas Dragon Palace Prime Minister know what Shi Yu wanted to do.
Ice Dragon was immediately shocked. Why didn’t Shi Yu do anything humane all day?
The Turtle Prime Minister of the Ice Dragon Palace was even more jealous. It was still “young” and wasn’t in a hurry to have a child. If it had known, it would have given birth to a little turtle no matter what and tried its luck.
In Dragon Palace City, the faith of the Green Dragon was popular, but apart from that, the Black Tortoise was also very famous. After all, in the ocean, apart from dragons, there were also turtles.

chapters.title: Chapter 1125 - 1125 The Abnormal Two New Pets (2)
chapters.content:
1125 The Abnormal Two New Pets (2)
The Turtle Prime Minister of the Wex Dragon Palace naturally knew what the Black Tortoise was.
If it were anyone else who said this, it would definitely sneer, but the one who said this was Shi Yu.
Shi Yu had indeed cultivated a real green dragon!
The overlord-level Green Dragon killed a totem-level hybrid dragonman in one hit! It was invincible!
It even easily defeated the eldest prince. It had heard this!
These were the Four Holy Beasts!
If its descendants could evolve into a True God Black Tortoise, the Turtle Prime Minister didn’t even dare to imagine it.
After all, the Black Tortoise Race was an existence more honorable than the previous Dragon Gods of Dragon Palace City.
With a boom, the Turtle Prime Minister of the Wex Dragon Palace felt that a huge pie had hit its head.
The Turtle Prime Minister cried.
“Minister Shi Yu, you might not believe me, but I actually think very highly of them. However, the rules of the Longevity Turtle Race and the Winter Water Snake Race are strict. I don’t have the power to change these at all, Minister Shi Yu! The happiness of my child depends on you, Minister!”
“The life of parents is difficult! If Minister Shi Yu needs help, I won’t hesitate to give up my old life!”
Winter Water Snake Overlord:???
Bullshit!!!
The Winter Water Snake overlord suspected that the other party had copied its lines, but there was no evidence.
Shi Yu and Buggy: …
“In other words, you guys are actually okay with it, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Of course.” The Turtle Prime Minister and the Winter Water Snake overlord looked at each other. Was there a problem? No.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu said, “Then there’s no problem. Next, I’ll take them away directly.”
“Heh, moreover.” Shi Yu revealed a hearty smile and said, “I don’t plan to let them know all of this first.”
“I’ll train them alone first to test the determination of both parties.”
“Only if they can survive the training together will I do my best to nurture them. Therefore, the two of you have to be mentally prepared. They can be sent back at any time.”
“Gulp.” The Turtle Prime Minister and the Winter Water Snake overlord of the Wex Dragon Palace were extremely nervous.
Shi Yu said, “But don’t worry, they’re still children. I won’t give them too strict training. It’s just some basic training that the new pets in my team have to undergo.”
“No problem, right?”
The Turtle Prime Minister and the Winter Water Snake overlord of the Wex Dragon Palace heaved a sigh of relief.
Their descendants were all geniuses. It was just basic training, so it shouldn’t be a problem.
“Of course not. Minister Shi Yu, just treat it as your child,” the Turtle Prime Minister said.
“Same, the same,” the Winter Water Snake overlord said.
Shi Yu: …
No way.
Would a normal person torture their child?
But there was definitely no psychological pressure to train a blue tortoise in love.
“Then it’s decided.”
….
In the Deep Sea Prison, the unconscious Little Longevity Turtle, in the forbidden area of the Winter Water Floating Island, the Little Winter Water Snake, which had fallen asleep to offset its hunger, was put into the legendary ruins with a mysterious power with an even harsher environment.
This ruin was the battlefield of Little Ji and Duckie. The chaotic sea area and the dry land were not good places for sea creatures or land creatures.
A long time later.
The Winter Water Snake on the Chaotic Island woke up immediately. After waking up and sensing the unfamiliar environment around it, it looked around in a panic and saw Shi Yu sitting on the huge rock beside it.
“Wu wu ~” The Winter Water Snake looked at Shi Yu cautiously. It kept feeling that Shi Yu was a little familiar.
It seemed to have… seen it in a dream!!!
It recalled carefully and suddenly recalled that there seemed to be a person who had asked it if it liked the Longevity Turtle!
“Don’t be nervous,” Shi Yu said with a smile as he looked at it.
“Let me introduce myself. I’m the minister of the Ocean Environmental Protection Department of Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu. I don’t know if you’ve heard of me, but it’s alright if you don’t.”
“Now that you’re no longer in the forbidden area of the island, you were sent to me.”
The Winter Water Snake was stunned. It felt that it had indeed heard of the name Shi Yu.
It could be said that without Shi Yu, without Baby Ginseng’s Time Fruit, there wouldn’t be it. Therefore, the Winter Water Snake overlord always mentioned Shi Yu, so it naturally remembered the name Shi Yu.
“I heard about you and that Longevity Turtle. I can help you.” Shi Yu smiled.
Winter Water Snake: !!!
“Wu ~?” The Winter Water Snake looked at Shi Yu. Could Shi Yu save the Longevity Turtle from the deep sea prison?
“Of course, that’s not a problem. Not only that, I can also let you guys be together.”
“Wu ~!” The Winter Water Snake’s body stiffened. It turned its head, indicating that it couldn’t understand what Shi Yu was saying.
Shi Yu: …
Shi Yu looked at the Winter Water Snake and said,
“However, I can only help you a portion. In the end, you were stopped because your strength isn’t strong enough and you don’t have the right to make your own decisions. I can give you a venue to become stronger, a way to become stronger, and resources to become stronger. If your strength can be on par with the totem dragon king, I believe no one will stop you.”
“In another place, the Longevity Turtle will also face the same test. I’ll become your temporary Beast Tamer and let you undergo training in the Environmental Protection Department. Whether you can become stronger depends on yourselves. So, are you willing to accept the test?”
“Wu ~!” At this moment, the Winter Water Snake was stunned. It suddenly looked at Shi Yu seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126 - 1126 The Abnormal Two New Pets (3)
chapters.content:
1126 The Abnormal Two New Pets (3)
Really?
Minister Shi Yu was willing to guide it to become stronger?
“Of course.”
The Winter Water Snake’s gaze became even more serious.
Although it didn’t know why Shi Yu was willing to help it,
However, this opportunity was rare.
It indeed had a good impression of the Longevity Turtle, but after this incident, it also made the Winter Water Snake understand that strength was the most important.
It had nothing to do with the turtle. It just wanted to become stronger and control its fate. It hoped that Shi Yu could train it.
It wanted to become an existence like the Dragon God. Before that, it no longer planned to date. Love would only drag it down in its footsteps to become stronger.
It was relieved that the Longevity Turtle was fine…
As for them… Unless the Longevity Turtle could catch up to it. It would wait for the Longevity Turtle, hoping that the other party would have the same determination as it.
In addition, in return, it would serve the Environmental Protection Department and Minister Shi Yu well.
At this moment, Shi Yu sensed the change in the Winter Water Snake’s mood.
He couldn’t help but have a strange expression.
He kept feeling that something was wrong.
Just now, it was still a romance template. Why did it suddenly seem to have awakened some female lead and strong woman template?
Forget it, things had already come to this. Let’s leave it to the Longevity Turtle to have a headache. We’ll take it one step at a time.
Shi Yu said, “Alright, from today onwards, you will train here with my Spirit clone.”
….
On the other side, the Longevity Turtle was also shaken awake by Shi Yu.
After waking up and discovering that it was in a special environment and on the dry ground, the Longevity Turtle was also shocked. It suddenly shrank into its shell and slowly stuck its head out. It looked around nervously and saw Shi Yu.
The Longevity Turtle still had an impression of Shi Yu.
It was the strange life form that had suddenly entered prison.
“Hu! Hu!!” It retreated again and looked at Shi Yu cautiously, asking what Shi Yu wanted to do to it.
After the introduction, the Longevity Turtle was shocked.
“Hu! Hu!!”
Minister of the Environmental Protection Department?!
Unlike the Winter Water Snake, the Longevity Turtle was a relatively long-lived and smart race. It was also the most knowledgeable race in the faction of Dragon Palace City.
Because to assist the Dragon King, not only did they have to train their strength to grow quickly, but they also had to learn a lot of knowledge.
Although this Longevity Turtle was only a year old and had yet to start learning knowledge systematically, its knowledge reserves were not what ordinary sea beasts could compare to.
Compared to the Winter Water Snake, it knew Shi Yu’s status in Dragon Palace City better. Moreover, the Turtle Prime Minister of the Thunder Dragon Palace had mentioned Shi Yu in front of it many times.
It could be said that the transcendent lives born in Dragon Palace City because of the Time Fruit had more or less heard their parents mention Shi Yu. After all, he was Doctor Shi.
At this moment, the Little Longevity Turtle also didn’t understand why a big shot like Shi Yu would look for it.
“To put it bluntly, I like your potential.”
“In addition, you were born because of me. We’re very fated.”
“In the future, I might need your help in some things, but the premise is that you can become better.”
“I’ll give you a chance to become stronger and let you train beside me. Think about it.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “By the way, if you become stronger, you’ll have the ability to break some of the rules of the Dragon Palace and pursue your true love.”
The Longevity Turtle was stunned.
Then, seawater spread from its eyes.
After so long, after so long, was there finally someone who could understand it?
It just wanted to pursue true love. What was wrong with that? Not only did its family not understand, but the outside world also didn’t understand, let alone the Dragon Palace.
But he didn’t expect that there was actually someone willing to help it.
“Hu!!” It directly made a loyalty gesture to Shi Yu that only Prime Minister Turtle would do to assist the Dragon Kings. Its eyes were firm.
Please give it a chance to become stronger and break through the restraints. It would definitely become the most reliable Turtle Prime Minister and assist Minister Shi Yu in obtaining the position of Dragon God in Dragon Palace City!
Shi Yu: “?”
“Wait, wait, the thing I want your help with isn’t usurping the throne!”
The Longevity Turtle covered its mouth and nodded. “I understand. I can’t say it out loud. We have to quietly… turn it upside down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1127 - 1127 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill
chapters.content:
1127 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill
After coming into contact with the Winter Water Snake and the Longevity Turtle one by one, Shi Yu was certain that two more problematic children had come.
However, he had already received the goods. Shi Yu, who found it troublesome, couldn’t be bothered to return the goods.
Next, just as he had planned at the start, Shi Yu didn’t plan to let them meet early.
After all, only by separating the two places could one have the motivation to become stronger.
With a goal, it was easier to train Resistance.
At the moment, the will levels of the Winter Water Snake and the Longevity Turtle were both low.
Shi Yu could still accept it. After all, the two little guys were only a year old. It was abnormal for their Resistance levels to be too high.
It was already very good to have low-level Resistance at this age.
Shi Yu planned to train them to medium Resistance before contracting them and teaching them the system.
Emperor Wu’s Black Tortoise Fusion was a super Skill. At the very least, it would only be easy to teach it to a middle-level Resistance.
“Next, your training goal is to conquer the land.”
In the Legendary Ruins, on an island, Shi Yu said to the Winter Water Snake.
The Winter Water Snake looked confused, indicating that it didn’t understand.
“Not far away, a drought envelopes the ground, and even a trace of water will be evaporated. The hot magma devours the ocean like a demon. That’s a very harsh environment. You have to train in that harsh environment.”
“Wu wu…” After being stunned, the Winter Water Snake nodded slightly with a firm gaze.
< Name > Winter Water Snake
[Attributes]: Water, Ice
[Race Level]: Low-level overlord
[Level of Growth]: Commander
[Race Skill]: Quas Gravel (Low-level ice-element Skill), Water Spear (Low-level water-element Skill), Quas Tail (Intermediate-level ice-element Skill), Frost Water (Intermediate-level water-element Skill), Blizzard (High-level ice-element Skill), Qi Yu (High-level water-element Skill), Absolute Zero (Ice-element super Skill), Vortex Strangulation (Water-element super Skill)
The Winter Water Snakes weren’t a race that was good at attacking. Their super Race Skills were inclined towards support.
For example, Absolute Zero was an ice-element domain skill that froze energy flow and Spirit activity.
Apart from that, their high-level Skills were also mainly weather skills.
In a real battle, it was definitely weaker among overlord races.
Therefore, Shi Yu planned to let it resist the harsh natural environment to train its Resistance first. This way, it would be more efficient and he could also practice these support skills. Fighting the weather in Little Ji’s territory was also an extremely difficult special training.
“I’ll take you to the land to take a look first.”
…
On the other side of the Legendary Ruins, Shi Yu’s other Psychic clone was correcting the thoughts of the young Turtle Prime Minister with incorrect awareness and political positions.
“Hu! Hu!!” Upon hearing Shi Yu’s denial, the Longevity Turtle gradually became clear.
Too small, too small.
It was still too narrow-minded.
Minister Shi Yu was a human. Compared to the position of Dragon God in Dragon Palace City, he definitely still wanted to be the big boss of Dong Huang!!
It secretly gave Shi Yu a thumbs up.
He had to assist Shi Yu well. Only such an ambitious lord was worth following.
“You’re still too full. The training in the underwater prison doesn’t seem to be enough for you.”
Shi Yu and the Longevity Turtle were at the border between the dry land and the ocean. Shi Yu pointed at the sea opposite and said,
“Do you see over there?”
After the Longevity Turtle turned around, it nodded.
The calm Taihai Sea…
Boom.
Just as it finished speaking, dark clouds filled the sky in the distance. Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled. A monstrous black rainstorm descended, raising a tsunami more than ten meters tall, drowning an island and shattering the island.
The island sank, and a huge vortex condensed, Devouring all the shattered rocks around it. A moment later, the sea returned to calm, and the world was peaceful.
The Longevity Turtle: …
“Hu…” The Longevity Turtle retreated. Why did it feel that it was even more dangerous than an underwater prison?
“Of course. The people on the 0.5th floor of the underwater prison are all second-generation heirs. Can they really put you in danger?” Shi Yu muttered in his heart. The environment on the 1st to 6th floors of the underwater prison was much harsher than the 0.5th floor.
It was just a small black room on level 0.5.
“Next, your training goal is to conquer the ocean.”
“In this sea area, a storm interferes with the calm of the sea area. The aura of the Demon God destroys the peace of the water element. It’s a very harsh natural environment. You have to train in this harsh environment.”
“With the goal of becoming a water god, calm the roar of the sea.”
“Hu!! Hu!!” The Longevity Turtle also revealed a determined expression, indicating that there was no problem. How could the sea be peaceful? How could there be true love?
< Name > Longevity Turtle
[Stats]: Water
[Race Level]: High-level monarch
[Level of Growth]: Commander
[Race Skill]: Water Spear (Low-level Water-element Skill), Spin Impact (Low-level Water-element Skill), Spirit Water (Intermediate-level Water-element Skill), Water Shield Wall (High-level Water-element Skill), Guardian Water (High-level Water-element Skill), Water of Life (Water-element super Skill)
As for the Longevity Tortoise, Shi Yu’s training content was also very simple. After all, the Longevity Tortoise was even less good at battle than the Winter Water Snake. After calculations, the Longevity Tortoise only had two attack Skills, and they were all low-level. One relied on the turtle to spew water, and the other relied on the shell to fight head-on.
Compared to combatants, it was also more like a support. The Spirit Water could increase energy and reduce fatigue, and the Water of Life could be treated. It had nothing to do with battle.
However, that was in the past. Even Baby Ginseng could be cultivated into a combatant. There was nothing impossible with Shi Yu. One was a Longevity Turtle, and the other was a Winter Water Snake. Sooner or later, Shi Yu would have to cultivate them into real Black Tortoises.

chapters.title: Chapter 1128 - 1128 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (2)
chapters.content:
1128 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (2)
“Let’s swim around first,” Shi Yu said as he pointed at the sea that had become the Chaotic Sea due to the interference of the duck’s power.
“Hu!!” The Longevity Turtle jumped into the water with a bang.
Just like that, the Winter Water Snake and the Longevity Turtle immediately began the team entry test. However, Shi Yu’s clone, who was standing on the shore, forgot to tell them that the natural environment here was not static.
Every once in a while, two monsters would enter to fight. They also had to withstand the terrifying pressure from the aftermath of the other party’s battle.
….
After taking away the Winter Water Snake and the Longevity Turtle, Shi Yu didn’t stay in Dragon Palace City for long.
However, before leaving, he gave the Wex Dragon Palace’s Longevity Turtle and the Winter Water Snake overlord a few more Time Fruits with stronger Effects.
It meant that he was embarrassed to take away their new child…
If you guys are lonely, strike while the iron is hot. Have two more!
In any case, this pair couldn’t expect to reproduce normally for them.
Uh-huh.
After bidding farewell to Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu began to return to Ping Cheng.
During this period, his main training target was Little Ji and Duckie of the second team. He planned to completely unearth Little Ji and Duckie’s divine power.
Little Ji relied on the Mythical Revival to awaken the quasi-divine skill of the Earth Divine Dragon’s vibration law, while Duckie relied on the power of the Abyss Liberation and the Reincarnation Fruit to unearth the Abyss Seed to awaken the quasi-divine skill of its previous life.
As for the pets in Team One, they weren’t in a hurry to add points.
Apart from the few new skills that Eleven had awakened that needed to be added points, their skills were basically already maxed out. Unless they broke through to the totem level, there was no more to add. They were all in a bottleneck state.
Shi Yu’s hard work caused him to become a hindrance again.
As expected, the hard work of most individuals would only make others better…
In this situation, their training content was to train faith skills and quasi-divine skills themselves.
Buggy continued to condense the meteorite, and Susu continued to condense the Sea Cleansing Spirit. As for Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and Ling, they used the background of the first revival of the laws to quickly deepen their understanding of the use of the power of laws.
In the training of quasi-divine skills, comprehending the laws of heaven and earth was the most important. The importance of comprehension was greater than normal training. With the help of the World Tree Fruit, there would be no problem with their comprehension.
Therefore, after returning to Ping Cheng, Shi Yu immediately started to call Little Ji and Duckie
As Shi Yu took off his coat and threw it on the sofa, he went to take the drink from the fridge and said telepathically, “After the additional points are added, be careful when you go to the ruins to fight and experiment with Skills. I’ve put two newbies in.”
The two pets expressed that there was no problem, but Shi Yu was still worried. He sighed. Forget it, he had his Psychic clone watching inside anyway.
“Prepare yourselves.”
“After I finish eating…”
“Add points, begin!”
….
At the same time that he added points to his pet, Shi Yu also entered a high-intensity meditation mode. He charged to level eight and prepared for the battle with Yun An in this space and time.
Shi Yu also paid extra attention to the Alliance Meeting that President Lin and Shi Yu had mentioned previously. After all, he might face a divine beast.
During this period of time, the establishment of the Blue Planet Alliance was the most attention-grabbing thing on Blue Planet at the moment. Not only was the Seven Nation Alliance advancing Impetus, but the totem countries were also paying attention. Although President Lin had already discussed it with Shi Yu in advance, the official meeting voting and official announcement had yet to be carried out.
During Shi Yu’s bitter cultivation, President Lin held an online meeting. The ten titled legends of Dong Huang, including Shi Yu, were all invited.
Among them, apart from the two newbies, Shi Yu and Lu Qingyi, who had obtained their titles at level seven, the other eight were all level-eight Beast Tamers. The unified characteristic of these people was that they all had the battle power to resist and even defeat totem level. They were considered an important part of Dong Huang’s high-end battle power.
Apart from that, the Mechanical Army, forbidden Arms, and the national guardian were all Dong Huang’s confidence as a superpower.
“Master, it’s about to begin.” After Shi Yu’s little secretary, Ling, helped Shi Yu enter the meeting, she whispered to Shi Yu, who was meditating beside her.
“Yes.” This was the first time Shi Yu had participated in such a high-end meeting. They were all titled legends! However, it was nothing. He was relatively familiar with a few of the nine people here. This time, it was basically just a formality.
[Eh, Dr. Shi Yu is here this time too?] Before the meeting started, an old man in a gray formal suit said.
Gold legend, Jiang Wenzhou, the richest man in Dong Huang, and three of the five major financial groups in Dong Huang were all related to him. He was known as the richest titled legend. Most of the pet’s skills were paywall skills, so his battle power was very strong.
The cat’s paywall skill was probably inspired by him.
Shi Yu looked at the screen of the richest man, Jiang Shoufu. His impression of him was that one of the other party’s juniors, Jiang Tianyang, was a Sequence Beast Tamer. As for him, Shi Yu had never come into contact with him much. It should be a deliberate restriction from the association. After all, Shi Yu was considered a Beast Tamer of the official system, and the five major financial groups were equivalent to civilian capital.
[It’s indeed rare.] The legend of the Tyrannical Sea, Yu Hui, was also very surprised. After all, in recent times, there had been at least five meetings. This was the first time Shi Yu had appeared.
The first-rank Ye Xing’s grandfather, the titled legend Ye Bing, who led the three major armies of the Beast Tamer Troops, also looked at Shi Yu’s screen. The four armies under Shi Yu had developed rapidly recently. Among them, the latest information about the Iron-eating Beast Corps shocked him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1129 - 1129 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (3)
chapters.content:
1129 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (3)
Heavenly King Du Ruo: “Dr. Shi Yu is at the high-speed stage of growth. It’s a bad thing to be involved in a large number of things like us too early. For example, Qingyi is clearly young, but she looks much more haggard recently.”
Lu Qingyi: “…It’s alright.”
She could still accept finding divine beasts. It was similar to archeology. It was really tiring, but at least it wouldn’t be boring. It was much more interesting than guarding a certain place.
[Hello, seniors.] Shi Yu smiled and said: [I’ve been busy cultivating recently.]
Everyone believed it, but they also suspected something. Shi Yu was from Bureau 11. As an archeologist, he didn’t look like he could cultivate obediently no matter how they looked at it. After disappearing for so many days, didn’t he really go somewhere to explore ruins? If he was just cultivating, was there a need to miss the meeting?
At this moment, President Lin saw that the time was up and started to speak.
“The content of this meeting is about the Alliance Meeting. I believe everyone has already heard that the seven countries are going to send a Titled Beast Tamer to participate in the battle. After careful consideration, I plan to recommend Shi Yu to represent Dong Huang in the battle.”
“In this Alliance Meeting, battle power is the main criterion. Everyone has seen Shi Yu’s strength. Next, we’ll vote. If anyone has a better choice, you’re welcome to discuss it.”
As President Lin finished speaking, everyone was silent. Before Shi Yu became a titled legend, the strongest titled legend in Dong Huang was President Lin.
This kind of meeting was actually basically for the presidents of the various countries to go. In the end, President Lin didn’t go himself and chose to let Shi Yu go. What else could everyone say?
Even President Lin felt that Shi Yu was stronger than him now. They naturally didn’t think that Shi Yu didn’t have this qualification. Shi Yu, who had contracted a Mythical Race pet, was undoubtedly the strongest below the Legendary level under the one-on-one rules.
The rules this time were a dual pet 1VS1 system. Every Beast Tamer could at most have two summoning slots in each battle. They could choose two out of all the pets they contracted to fight, but in battle, they could at most send one pet to participate in the battle and fight one-on-one with the other party’s pet. Only when one side lost its ability to fight could they change pets. If either side’s two pets lost their ability to fight, they would lose.
President Lin must have also considered this kind of big matter that concerned the national interest carefully. Moreover, not many people present thought that their strength under such rules would steadily defeat Shi Yu.
Soon, the matter of Shi Yu representing Dong Huang in the Alliance Meeting was unanimously approved by Dong Huang’s top battle power! Moreover, three days later, the seven countries made a world official announcement.
The Alliance Meeting this time would be broadcasted live to the seven countries. After all, the competition this time was for worldwide influence. It could be said to make up for the regret that Shi Yu’s world competition couldn’t be broadcasted live.
That time… the main competition had ended before it even started. He had yet to tell the World Tree. Damn it.
“Hey, hey, hey, what a joke.” Three days later, after the news was broadcasted, countless Beast Tamers held their cell phones with incredulous expressions.
“The Blue Planet Alliance is about to be established. The members of the former Seven Nation Alliance will each send a Beast Tamer to participate in the Alliance Meet to represent their country in the pinnacle battle.”
What was a pinnacle battle?
According to the list announced by the Seven Nation Alliance…
Shen Feng sent the Beast Tamer, the president of the Shen Feng National Association, and the Mechanical God of War, Logan.
Ming Hua sent the Beast Tamer, the president of the Ming Hua Association, Reincarnator Ashaya.
Rongguang sent the Beast Tamer, the pope of the Divine Church of Light, the Son of Light, Ralph…
These names made the Beast Tamers of Dong Huang curse. It was really a pinnacle battle. They were just short of making the Legendarys of the various countries directly fight.
This was simply calling out the strongest Beast Tamer below the Legendary level in various countries. What were they doing?
Moreover, what shocked everyone the most was that on Dong Huang’s side, the one representing Dong Huang was not the mysterious President Lin, but another person.
Dong Huang sent the Beast Tamer, the world legend, Shi Yu!
“The Beast Tamers representing Snowfield, Shen Feng, Ming Hua, and the Seven Islands are all the current presidents of the associations. Rongguang is the pope of the Divine Church of Light, and Tingxiang’s is an unknown sprite name. Our Dong Huang is Dr. Shi Yu…”
“What’s going on? Has Dr. Shi Yu usurped the throne? According to the formation, shouldn’t it be President Lin? I’ve long felt that… he has a little too many dreams. It’s abnormal.”
“Is there a possibility that Dr. Shi Yu’s strength has already exceeded President Lin and is more suitable to represent Dong Huang in battle?”
“Is President Lin sick? I feel that Marshal Ye is more suitable…”
The content of the official announcement this time, be it outsiders or experts, was a very interesting topic.
There were very few public battles of this level. Moreover, there was a titled legend who could be said to be the strongest in every country who wanted to fight at the Alliance Meet. It was simply ridiculous.
Coupled with the establishment of the Blue Planet Alliance and the changes in the Seven Nation Alliance, many people guessed that this battle might decide something. Therefore, the strongest titled legend of the seven countries represented them in the battle.
“It has actually grown to this extent?” However, looking at the name list, many people still didn’t react. It was very unbelievable that Shi Yu could represent Dong Huang in the battle.
After all, looking at the representative list of the other countries, they were all the number one people below the Legendary level in the various countries. When it came to Dong Huang, it immediately became a young man. Although Shi Yu’s battle results from the Inatella World Tournament half a year ago were incomparably shocking, President Lin and the others had long become famous outside. In the hearts of the older generation, their recognition was even deeper.

chapters.title: Chapter 1130 - 1130 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (4)
chapters.content:
1130 Little Ji Duck’s Quasi Divine Skill (4)
President Lin had already been the president of the Dong Huang Association for a hundred years. A hundred years ago, he had the battle record of hunting totems and obtaining a title. It could be said that he had grown up with Dong Huang and was even a descendant of Lin Feng’s Legendary. He had always been known to the outside world as the number one person below Dong Huang’s Legendary.
The other Beast Tamers who represented them were also the strongest legends of the various countries who had been famous for decades. Even Ming Hua’s Reincarnator, Ashaya, had lived a second life and was a reincarnation. In her previous life, she was already a very famous ancient legend in Ming Hua, so it was very difficult for everyone to not think too much about this list.
To put it bluntly, although Shi Yu was a genius, because he was too young, the World Tournament was also a competition of the younger generation, making many people have an inherent prejudice impression. Even if Shi Yu’s battle results were already very out of reach, they were still more willing to believe in the deeply rooted authority.
At that moment, no matter how stormy the outside world was, Shi Yu still buried his head in cultivation and began to crazily add points to Little Ji and Duckie.
He first revived Little Ji’s Mythical Revival and pointed it at the transcendent level.
When Shi Yu upgraded Little Ji’s Mythical Revival to perfect level, it completed a new round of transformation, the evolution of a god.
In the Legendary Ruins, under the vibration of the sound of laws, the entire ruin, the ground, and the ocean trembled violently.
If not for the fact that Shi Yu hurriedly protected Little Quas and the turtle, they would definitely have fainted from fright.
< Name > Catastrophe
[Stats]: Earth, Space
[Level]: Quasi God-level
< Introduction > With the help of the vibration law, it triggered the vibration of the natural and spatial power of the planet and swept up a world-destroying disaster.
After the Mythical Revival reached perfection, Little Ji successfully awakened a quasi-divine skill that contained the vibration law.
This skill was considered a high-level skill of a series of vibration-type skills such as Earthquake and Space Quake.
Even among the many divine skills, the destructive power was very terrifying. In terms of the large-scale destructive power caused, the Effect was even above the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and the Yin Yang Millstone.
It was a large-scale skill at the country-destroying level, just like the Dragon Star Group.
As Shi Yu raised the Mythical Revival to transcendent, the proficiency of the Cataclysm also reached the proficient level. For the time being, it wasn’t that difficult to control Crowd Control. Little Ji’s strength had been strengthened by the epic level.
Although he had yet to upgrade other super Skills, he finally had the ability to compete with the first team.
Then, Shi Yu opened it and added points to Duckie. He mainly added points to its Abyss Liberation and Demon Subduing Pestle to nearly transcendent. At the same time, with the help of the Reincarnation Fruit, he completely stimulated the divine-level abyss power contained in the divine-level resource, the Abyss Seed.
Under the enhancement of the Abyss Liberation and the neutralization of the Demon Subduing Pestle, Duckie also successfully completed its divine evolution at the overlord level and awakened the quasi-divine skill from its previous life.
< Name > Heart of the Abyss
[Stats]: Dark, Water
[Level]: Quasi God-level
< Introduction > It contains the corrosion law and condenses all the power of the abyss into a heart and blood. By corroding one’s rationality, it accelerates the beating of the heart and the flow of blood to obtain a super strong eruption. In the state of the Abyss Heart, the attack has the corrosion Effect. It will increase the enemy’s consumption and damage.
Be it Little Ji or Duckie’s newly awakened quasi-divine skills, they were both the type that gave Shi Yu a headache.
The former’s destructive power was too great, and it was even harder to control than the Dragon Star Group. If not for the fact that he had relied on Mythical Revival to increase it to the proficient level, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t have dared to let Little Ji use it randomly.
This guy had a history of hitting his own people with an earthquake.
As for Duckie’s skill, it was the same as Little Ji’s reverse scale. It was a powerful power exchanged by sacrificing its rationality. After sacrificing its rationality, it would activate several times its battle talent and strength. It was a very dangerous move.
If it weren’t for the fact that Shi Yu had maxed out the Demon Subduing Pestle and maxed out the Heart Sword, Purification, and other skills, Duckie definitely wouldn’t be able to control this skill at the overlord level.
A month was neither fast nor slow. Shi Yu felt that before he could do anything, time had slipped away in the blink of an eye. Even Little Ji and Duckie’s other super Skills had yet to be maxed out.
However, it was already very close. Shi Yu obtained bad benefits through their attribute feedback. Their strength also had top-notch totem battle power.
At this stage, Shi Yu decisively didn’t dare to let them fight randomly. It was fine if Duckie went berserk, but if Little Ji went berserk, Icefield City might not exist anymore…
…
The next day.
When it was time to meet President Lin, Shi Yu rode his beloved aerial battleship to the sky above Alliance Island.
“Shi Yu, are you here?”
In the blue sky, Shi Yu stood on the battleship and picked up President Lin’s call.
“We’re here. I’ll go down now?”
“Come on.” President Lin was silent and did as he pleased.
During this period of time, he had thought of taking a few days to call a few guardians to be Shi Yu’s sparring partner and help him prepare for the Alliance Meeting.
Unfortunately, it was rejected by Shi Yu.
It made President Lin feel that his good intentions had been treated as ill intentions.
This was because in Shi Yu’s words at that time, it was more suitable to let Divine Source Legendary be a sparring partner…
However, it was impossible for Divine Source Legendary to be the sparring partner. In order to have a longer lifespan, Divine Source Legendary modified itself into a mechanical life form. Every time it woke up and fought, it needed to consume a lot of energy. It could only use longer sleep to make up for the consumption. It was too extravagant to be a sparring partner.
Seeing that Shi Yu was confident, President Lin didn’t force it.
After all, Shi Yu’s answer to him was that he was invincible below the demigod level in 1VS1.
The Alliance Meeting was about to begin. At this moment, the gazes of the world focused on the Alliance Island. Shi Yu slowly landed here.
In a luxurious building in the Dong Huang area, Shi Yu, who was wearing a panda casual shirt, casually knocked on the door. After waiting for an answer, he entered and greeted the young man inside.
“President Lin, you don’t look old even if you work all day. Are there any more of the resources you eat? Give me two.”
President Lin: “?”
“You ate the Eternal Flower, why do you still need such resources?”
Shi Yu: “It’s not bad to give it away as a gift.”
“No.” President Lin’s face darkened.
“There’s really no more,” Shi Yu said. He would go to the parallel universe another day to intercept its resources… Forget it, it was immoral. However, he could bring the Undying Fruit of the Phoenix Mystic Realm. If it weren’t for the fact that the Phoenix Mystic Realm hadn’t been established by the Undying Dark Phoenix before the empress era in the Emperor Wu Era, he would have gone to the Seven Islands to fly no matter what. After all, it was a divine-level resource.
“That’s it.”
“Did you look at the information I sent you seriously?” President Lin asked.
“Although some of the pet information representing Beast Tamers from these countries is dozens or tens of years ago, it still has some reference value.”
“Apart from that, you have to be careful of the new pets they might contract, such as the Angel God of the Rongguang Pontiff… The other party must have already kept this information strictly confidential.”
“In addition, your information will definitely be a key research subject of the various countries. When the time comes, you have to be especially careful.”
“If you encounter a bitter battle and an accident happens, there’s no need to force a victory. Don’t hurt yourself because of this. This Alliance Conference is only fighting for mid to low-level rights. It’s important, but not that important. It’s definitely not as important as you.”
Shi Yu nodded, but he felt that his information had even less reference value. The version update was too fast. The second team already had a Mythical Race at the overlord level. Who could have expected this?
“Then I’ll start the second team and give them a surprise,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
President Lin: “??? Although I said it’s not important, you don’t have to take it seriously, right?”
How could the second team do this!
Shi Yu said, “It’s the original mechanical Tyrant Dragon and the Abyss Demon Duck. Their strength isn’t much different from the first team now. They’ve both evolved into Mythical Races and awakened quasi-divine skills. In addition, the mental resonance I learned from Lu Qingyi is rarely matched at the level of top-notch totem battle power. Moreover, there’s still the first team at the back. If they attack later, they can also fight the opponent more specifically to avoid being targeted by the opponent.”
“What did you say???”
President Lin was stunned again. F*ck, the second team was already at the Mythical Race overlord level? What had he been doing this month!
He looked at Shi Yu seriously and realized that Shi Yu didn’t seem to be kidding.
“Forget it, it’s good that we can win.” President Lin immediately fell silent. Damn it, when the various countries were still flirting with the divine beasts, Shi Yu actually even made the second team a Mythical Race. It was too much. This time, he wanted to watch the presidents of the associations of other countries get beaten up in the audience!

chapters.title: Chapter 1131 - 1131 Too Cruel, Too Cruel
chapters.content:
1131 Too Cruel, Too Cruel
Alliance calendar, August 1, 180.
Location, Alliance Island, weather, clear sky.
Five-colored fireworks bloomed in the sky everywhere.
This Alliance Meeting was actually equivalent to a mobilization!
In order to establish the Blue Planet Alliance, they mobilized the world!
During the World Tournament, the countries already knew that the Mythical Era was about to return.
However, after that, the various countries didn’t inform the entire country immediately.
After all, there was no benefit in telling too early. It would only cause chaos. Every country still needed sufficient time to prepare.
Therefore, what they knew were secrets known by a small number of high-level Beast Tamers.
Ordinary Beast Tamers knew nothing about this.
But as the first law revived, changes occurred all over the world. The news that the Mythical Era was about to return couldn’t be hidden no matter what.
It could be said that this Alliance Conference was the stage for the various countries to officially announce the return of the Mythical Era.
For this meeting, the seven countries worked together. The Beast Tamers of the seven countries who originally didn’t have a deep connection could see the live broadcast of the Alliance Meeting on television, computers, and cell phones.
At this moment, in Dong Huang.
The major television stations were broadcasting the opening of the Alliance Meeting. The major live broadcast applications on the Internet also placed the Alliance Meeting’s live broadcast in the main recommendation slot.
Under the push of the policies of the various countries, various departments, universities, and major channels were broadcasting the venue of the Alliance Meeting live. It could be said to be the focus of the world.
There weren’t many people in the venue. They were basically Beast Tamers from various countries guarding Alliance Island.
Under the camera, the presidents of the seven countries sat down one by one, making the Beast Tamers of the various countries excited and curious.
Most Beast Tamers actually didn’t know much about the presidents of the Beast Tamer Associations of the various countries. Even they didn’t know much about their countries.
But it didn’t stop them from knowing that these seven people could be said to be Beast Tamers who stood at the peak below the Legendarys of the seven countries.
“Lin Xiao, president of the Beast Tamer Association of Dong Huang…”
“Auland…”
“Ashaya…”
Under the camera, the presidents of the various countries were introduced. Then, they began to speak one by one, announcing the complete return of the Mythical Era and the intention and goal of the seven countries to establish the Blue Planet Alliance!
“Nine months ago, in the Kingdom of Glory, at the World Archeological Conference, archeologist Shi Yu from Dong Huang used his archeological results to lift a corner of the world’s future.”
“The Mythical Era that was lost in history is about to revive in the near future. Now, there are already gods from the Mythical Era waking up all over the world… Even back in Inatella, there were gods who were awakened by the World Tree and participated in the trial of the World Tournament.”
“In this magnificent era that hasn’t happened in billions of years, we will be the first batch to enter! In the unknown era, there are endless opportunities and crises. Only by cooperating can we welcome better development!”
Beast Tamers who knew the inside story were alright, but those who didn’t, especially the Normal Beast Tamers, were stunned when they heard the official announcement.
The potato chips in his hand fell to the ground, and the soda in his hand squeezed out of the paper cup.
“Holy shit.” Everyone was stunned.
What did they hear… The Mythical Era? It was about to descend?
The era described in the movies, the divine beasts, gods, and mythical novels, was about to return?
“You’re kidding…”
“I can also witness history??”
“Really… I’m a little panicked. No matter what, long live peace.”
“The descent of the Mythical Era is definitely a good thing!”
At this moment, the world trembled.
The various forums of the various countries were farmed out immediately. Those who participated in the world competition finally heaved a sigh of relief. They could finally talk!
…
In Dong Huang, the bad girl Ai Yu, who had encountered the reincarnation of the Spider God, was also watching the live broadcast with the Spider God.
They had already been convinced to join the Dong Huang Association.
They naturally knew about the Mythical Revival long ago, but watching the live broadcast now was still a different pleasure.
The spider girl pointed at President Lin Xiao on the television and said, “The information on the return of the Mythical Era was actually developed by the previous human archeologist?”
“I thought it would be the World Tree or other gods who told humans.”
“Therefore, legend Shi Yu is indeed very strong. The presidents of the other countries personally participate in the battle, but Dong Huang sent him,” the bad girl, Ai Yu, said.
“That’s for sure.” The corners of the Spider God’s mouth twitched. That was a quasi-divine skill that contained the prototype of a top-notch law. Even if it was a god of the same level, it wasn’t easy to defeat that black and white bear.
Just watch. If the pets of the other presidents were only mortal spirits, they would definitely be killed by that black and white bear!
…
“The return information of the Mythical Era was actually developed by archeologists??” Most of the low-level Beast Tamers of the seven countries were very shocked.
Not long ago, the revival of laws and the sound of laws resounded throughout the world. Everyone realized that something had changed on Blue Planet. Everyone thought that the seven countries had hurriedly convened the Alliance Meeting because of the Mythical Revival deduced from this time.
He never expected that nine months ago, at some World Archeological Conference, archeologists would determine the exact time of the Mythical Revival.
Dong Huang, archeologist, Shi Yu. Everyone was familiar with this name.
It was said that this batch of world legends had killed two totem-level foreign races from the totem country in the World Tournament and ended the competition in the preliminaries! How could they be unfamiliar!

chapters.title: Chapter 1132 - 1132 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (2)
chapters.content:
1132 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (2)
Apart from that, Dong Huang had also traded the mechanical phantom beast technology to the other six countries at a certain price. The mechanical phantom beast technology rose in the various countries. The name of Shi Yu, the father of the mechanical phantom beast, couldn’t be unfamiliar to most Beast Tamers of the seven countries.
At this moment, more people understood why Dong Huang had sent Shi Yu to represent Dong Huang and not President Lin. This Shi Yu’s resume was really strong!
Before accepting the Blessing of the World Tree, he could kill totems and learn the information of the Mythical Era early. Now that more than half a year had passed, it was only natural for him to become stronger.
“Not only that…” There were also contestants who participated and watched the World Tournament. From the beginning to the end, they sneered. This Shi Yu was far more ridiculous than everyone imagined. After all, when he won the World Tournament, he wasn’t even a level-seven Beast Tamer.
Now that so much time had passed, who knew how strong Shi Yu, who had obtained a pile of divine inheritance, was?
However, some countries didn’t panic. Although Shi Yu was in the lead previously, fortunately, times had changed.
For example, Rongguang obtained super battle power.
Who would have thought that the angel contracted by the Holy Emperor was actually the reincarnation of a god? Moreover, he had made a deal with Rongguang and promised to help Rongguang participate in this Alliance Meeting?
Rongguang also showed the Angel God the recorded video of the World Tournament. The Angel God was very calm about the process and outcome of the battle.
Rongguang thought for a moment and became calm.
Shi Yu was indeed very strong, but he could win at that time because at that time, the laws had yet to revive for the first time. The gods who had been forcefully awakened by the World Tree were severely Enfeeble.
Now that the laws had revived for the first time, the gods who woke up at this time would be much stronger than before.
Under the revival of the laws, the gods recovered their former strength, while Shi Yu improved from scratch. It was obvious at a glance who the increase brought by the first revival of the laws was greater.
Moreover, Shi Yu being able to defeat Ancient God Golden Bull at that time was equivalent to a clueless one against one.
At that time, if there was also a Beast Tamer who could use his talent to strengthen Ancient God Golden Bull, the outcome of the battle might not be certain.
Now, although there was no Ancient God Golden Bull, there was a super expert who had been immersed in level-eight for dozens of years who could strengthen the angel god with all his might. It was still unknown who would win in the end.
Now, the only thing Rongguang was worried about was that Shi Yu had also reached level eight. If Shi Yu was still at level seven, even if his Beast Taming Talent was very ridiculous, the enhancement shouldn’t be too different from the level-eight Holy Emperor. After all, although the Holy Emperor didn’t have a divine-level talent, it was still a top-notch Beast Taming Talent.
This way, it might not be impossible to fight. Moreover, so be it if they lost. They might not necessarily have to fight for the head. Apart from Shen Feng, the other countries weren’t that enthusiastic about competing with Dong Huang… Most of them only wanted to lie flat and wait for the changes of the Mythical Era!
…
“In that case, the preview of the Alliance Conference battle is a battle between the various countries to fight for the right of the Alliance??”
“It should be!”
At this moment, the onlookers were even more looking forward to it. After announcing the relevant matters of the Mythical Era, the presidents of the associations of the various countries stood up and started to leave after greeting each other.
“Hello, everyone.”
“Hehe.”
After the presidents of the association left, spatial ripples flashed in the huge venue. A mechanical creature that looked like a cell phone appeared in the venue.
It was completely different from the serious style of the presidents of the seven countries just now.
“What’s this silly mechanical cell phone?” Its sudden appearance stunned many spectators watching the live broadcast.
The cell phone quickly introduced itself and said, “I’m a super artificial intelligence developed by the Seven Nation Alliance, Black Light.”
“Inside me, 99.99% of the information of the seven countries is recorded. My growth level is as high as a guardian. Be it my horizons or strength, I’m one of the best. I can be called an ultimate mechanical life form. Therefore, next, I’ll explain the battle between the representatives of the various countries to everyone.”
…
“Who’s this guy?” Somewhere in the venue, beside Shi Yu, who was dozing off on the railing, Ling flew out and looked at the black cell phone.
It actually dared to say that it was an ultimate mechanical life form. What a joke. It was the only ultimate mechanical life form!
“There are many strange things in the Alliance. Don’t worry about it,” Shi Yu said with a laugh.
At this moment, Beast Tamers were complaining about this cell phone everywhere. However, in a battle of this level, compared to human explanations, it indeed made the mechanical intelligence capture and explain more technical.
“Squeak, squeak, but I’m only in charge of explaining. Apart from me, there’s another person in charge of protecting the venue and acting as the judge. Next, I’ll leave the safety of this place to him.”
The black cell phone looked at the place where the presidents of the seven countries had left just now. A moment later, a young man in a black sleeveless t-shirt and purple pants with mechanical tactical goggles on his head slowly sat in the middle of the presidents of the seven countries just now.
Then, he crossed his legs and looked at the main venue.
The black cell phone: “It’s him, it’s him! The previous world legend, the legendary Beast Tamer, Mr. Wexy!!”
“This cell phone is so annoying,” Shi Yu said.
Now that he was the world legend, could he not randomly give this title to others?
As expected, one title was still not enough. He happened to come to Alliance Island. He would go and see if there were any more impressive and awesome titles later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1133 - 1133 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (3)
chapters.content:
1133 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (3)
“Right, right?” Ling also agreed that this cell phone was very annoying.
However, at this moment, the gazes of the world indeed focused on this young man named Wexy.
He couldn’t be more than 50 years old, but he had already reached the legendary level, so he looked very young. It was no longer a secret that the Shen Feng Nation had a new Legendary. Now that they finally saw him in person, the Beast Tamers of the various countries were stunned.
“Legendary Wexy, that legendary new Beast Tamer should be the youngest Legendary Beast Tamer at the moment.”
“Yeah, a Legendary under the age of 50, at the peak.”
“He’s actually the judge.”
“That’s true. After all, next is a spar between presidents of the various countries. Only Legendarys are qualified to be judges.”
The appearance of the Divine Wind Thunder Legendary was very shocking. This legendary Beast Tamer in his strongest state immediately made many experts of his generation recall some bad memories.
But his appearance was also reasonable.
The other Legendarys of the seven countries were already old people from the previous era. Because of the overload of the totem battle, their bodily functions had already begun to decrease.
For example, Dong Huang and the Shen Feng Mechanical Legendary, who had modified themselves into machines, had already stopped attacking when possible to avoid too much loss.
At this moment, only a new Legendary like Legendary Wexy could have sufficient energy to be the judge of the Alliance Meeting.
Although he was young, the capable were the first. Although the presidents of the various countries were more experienced, they were really one level inferior to legendary-level creatures. He was indeed qualified.
“Let’s begin,” Legendary Wexy said after sitting down.
The black cell phone also added, “I believe the Beast Tamers representing the various countries are already prepared. Then let’s begin. The rules this time are the 1v1 rules of the two pets. The points competition system. In other words, every Beast Tamer representing the various countries has to fight the representatives of the six countries one by one!”
The reason why the rules this time weren’t a full-strength battle, but a 1v1 battle between two pets was also because it represented the Beast Tamer in six battles. The consumption of all the members was too high.
“Next, I’ll draw lots…”
“Wuu, the first to draw the battle…”
The projection of the black cell phone’s lottery was projected in midair. Through the live broadcast, the audience could clearly see the name list on it.
In the first round, the president of the Beast Tamer Association of the Snowfield Nation, Star God Monkalov, vs a member of the Beast Tamer Association of Dong Huang, the world legend, Shi Yu.
As soon as this name list appeared, Dong Huang cursed.
He didn’t expect the first round to be so exciting.
Dong Huang, Xue Yuan, and Shen Feng. The overall national strength of the three countries was in the top three of the seven countries.
Shi Yu actually faced the president of Snowfield the moment he came up?
….
Star God Monkalov.
A rather legendary Beast Tamer was the record holder of the number of times the Seven Nation Alliance had ascended to the starry sky.
His pets were basically evolved and cultivated towards cosmic life forms. They were all very strong.
It had once ascended to the moon 64 years ago and fought and won against the unfamiliar totem on the moon. Its name shook Blue Planet.
He had personally cultivated many new racial pets such as the Star God Bear, the Star God Tiger, and the Star God Eagle.
Among them, some pets had even been cultivated to the totem level by Monkalov with the resources of the country and had totem battle power.
Unfortunately, he was limited by his Beast Taming level and couldn’t contract the totem he had personally cultivated.
Therefore, the most interesting thing about Star God Meng Kalov was that his contracted first team pets were basically invincible overlords, but some uncontracted second team pets that he personally cultivated had grown to the totem level.
It was impossible for such a figure to be unknown in the world. Star God Meng Kalov’s name had resounded on Blue Planet decades ago.
This was also the reason why most people had doubts when the news compared Shi Yu, a young man, to these older experts.
“Shi Yu…”
On the Snowfield Nation’s side, they were also very surprised to see Shi Yu drawn right from the start. The Star God Meng Kalov was slightly stunned. Shi Yu cultivating the Starry Sky Faith Divine Green Dragon had always been something that Xue Yuan cared about. He didn’t know if he could fight Shi Yu’s Green Dragon in this battle. If he could, he would ask for guidance.
“Coming, coming. The name list for the first battle is out. Let’s wait for the two legends to enter.”
“The representative of the Snowfield Nation is the fabled number one person below the Legendary level in Snowfield, President Star God Meng Kalov. He’s nearly a hundred years old now. He obtained the title of Star God 64 years ago and has a record of killing totems. He worked for Snowfield for half his life and is the soul of Snowfield!”
“The representative of Dong Huang rose with a shocking force. His strength is also enough to kill totems. Moreover, in Inatella, he passed many trials of gods and obtained the recognition of gods. He’s a super legend of the new generation, the strongest of the younger generation, Shi Yu!” the black cell phone said excitedly.
In terms of battle results, Shi Yu wasn’t weak either. Among them, Shi Yu had an even stronger battle result, which was that he had defeated an Enfeebled Divine Spirit. However, the black cell phone didn’t dare to talk nonsense. After all, Ancient God Golden Bull was only in an Enfeeble state. If it directly said that Shi Yu had defeated a Divine Spirit, wouldn’t that be disrespectful? Who knew if Ancient God Golden Bull remembered to bear a grudge? Therefore, everyone tacitly said that Shi Yu had passed the test of the Ancient Divine Spirit and obtained recognition, not defeat. After all, that wasn’t Ancient God Golden Bull’s full strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134 - 1134 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (4)
chapters.content:
1134 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (4)
“Coming, coming.”
“I’m already looking forward to it.”
“The super expert of the older generation vs the strongest of the younger generation!”
The audience of the various countries held their breaths and watched. Among them, the group of people from Dong Huang who knew Shi Yu hugged the television and stared intently. The audience who had seen Shi Yu’s shocking performance in the World Tournament also fell into deep thought.
They wondered how Shi Yu’s strength had improved after obtaining the Blessing of the World Tree. If he could defeat or equalize President Monkalov, it wouldn’t be too much to say that Shi Yu had the strength of the top ten in the world.
A moment later.
Shi Yu, who was wearing a black and red battle suit, and President Xue Yuan, who was wearing a white-gold presidential suit with fur decorations, appeared in the sky.
Shi Yu was a young man, while President Xue Yuan was a short old man with white hair and beard.
At this moment, blue Psychic power lingered around their bodies. They flew with Psychic power and didn’t seem to have pets beside them. The audience wasn’t curious about this move.
For powerful Beast Tamers, even if their pets were in the Beast Taming Space, their Skills would still affect the outside world. Most of the audience in front of the television thought that both parties were flying in mid-air with the power of their pets.
However, the experts present could sense that President Monkalov had indeed borrowed the power of his pet, but that Shi Yu was really using his Spirit Psychic power to fly in midair.
Both parties’ black hair and white hair fluttered in the wind. After Shi Yu and President Xue Yuan greeted each other slightly, they landed on the arena.
At the same time, the presidents of the other countries also returned to their seats and looked at the home ground with different feelings, including Legendary Wexy, who was the judge. He narrowed his eyes and observed Shi Yu and Monkalov, very concerned.
Be it the new generation of world legends or the current strength of Shen Feng’s old opponent, the president of Snowfield, he was very concerned. Perhaps he could spy on them through this battle.
“Thank you for the battle between the world legend and the legend of the Star God!!”
“Please send out your pets… Battle… Begin!” As both parties landed, the black cell phone looked at the home ground.
This was a huge stone square venue that looked to be only a few hundred meters in length and width. However, if one believed what they saw with their eyes, they would be wrong. This was a venue built of spatial materials, equivalent to a half-fused mystic realm space. Another space overlapped, and the area was actually quite large.
It was the highest-level battle arena in all aspects in the current Seven Nation Alliance. It was only provided to titled Beast Tamers to fight. The control core of the mystic realm was currently in the hands of Legendary Wexy.
“Charge, charge, charge, Shi Yu, blow up that old man!!”
“Blow him up.”
In Dong Huang’s Wu Ling City, some people led by the beast-eared girl were cheering crazily for Shi Yu. Beside them, Senior Panda also shouted excitedly.
“President Monkalov shouldn’t lose to a young man in his early twenties, right?”
“Although the other party has also defeated the totem guardian, including the Star God Bear guardian, President Monkalov has personally cultivated a bunch of guardians.”
On the Snowfield Nation’s side, the Beast Tamers were also analyzing.
At the scene, although Shi Yu and Monkalov had heard the command to start the battle, neither party immediately engaged in an intense battle with their swords. Instead, they calmly activated the summoning array.
At the same time, they praised each other.
“It’s rare to fight a young person. Dr. Shi Yu, you have to give in to my old bones a little. My current energy is much inferior to before,” President Monkalov said with a smile.
A huge red summoning star array appeared in front of him, and the figure of a huge beast was outlined!
Red summoning array, level-eight Beast Tamer!
He was only a step away from level-nine Legendary. For a level-eight Beast Tamer of this age, it was very difficult to break through to level-nine unless there were suitable divine-level resources. However, as the laws revived, the veteran level-eights of the various countries might have the possibility of stepping into the Legendary domain in the future.
“President Monkalov, you’re too polite,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
A black summoning array also appeared in front of Shi Yu with a bang!
A level-seven legend Beast Tamer!
Seeing that Shi Yu had already broken through to the Legend level unlike in the World Tournament, no one was surprised. After all, he had obtained the blessings of the World Tree. It was possible for him to break through to the Legendary level in a few years. At this moment, Shi Yu had yet to reach level eight, and many people were already relieved.
If Shi Yu reached level eight, it would be really difficult to resist. Titled legends like them, the strongest tier of the older generation, would be completely pulled apart by Shi Yu from various dimensions.
“Roar!!!!!”
“Roar!!!”
Under the praise of both parties, the figures of the pets of both parties completely appeared!!
A huge white leopard emperor six to seven meters long appeared in front of Monkalov. Its body was dotted with star-like spots that shone brightly. A terrifying aura bloomed, making the presidents of the various countries freeze.
“It’s President Monkalov’s Star God Leopard!!!” The black cell phone said, “It’s one of his signature pets, an invincible overlord. According to the records, 20 years ago, this Star God Leopard had two super racial Skills trained to the limit close to transcendent!! It has the ability to fight against totems alone!! It’s long been only a step away from the totem level!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1135 - 1135 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (5)
chapters.content:
1135 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (5)
“Holy shit.” As the black cell phone finished speaking, many Beast Tamers cursed.
Was this the pet of a titled legend in the strongest tier?
If a super Race Skill reached transcendent, it would be at the totem level. If two super Race Skills reached transcendent, it would be top-notch totem battle power. If this Star God Leopard wasn’t restricted by President Monkalov’s level, it would probably have long reached the totem level.
At the moment, the energy level of this Star God Leopard that appeared in front of Shi Yu had also broken through the hundred million level and reached the standard of “???”.
It could be said that with the strengthening ability of the other party as a level-eight Beast Tamer, it was indeed powerful. After all, even if it was the most ordinary strengthening talent, as long as the Beast Tamer reached level-eight, it could increase the pet’s energy level by hundreds of millions. Moreover, Monkalov was an old expert who had stayed in the level-eight domain for many years. His talent development would definitely be stronger.
“It’s indeed very strong. Even without quasi-divine skills, Little Ji Duckie and the others will feel pressure.”
Even Shi Yu, who was his opponent, had to admit that the strongest titled legends in the various countries were much stronger than the strongest titled legends in ancient times.
For example, this President Monkalov should be much stronger than the Iron-eating Beast General at the founding stage.
This was normal.
After all, these modern titled experts had relied on the power of a country to develop steadily for nearly a hundred years under the protection of forbidden Arms and Legendary experts. They were on a completely different level from the resources enjoyed by ancient Beast Tamers.
“Roar!!!” The might of the Panther Emperor enveloped the world, and a roar that contained majestic and wild will shook space.
“Roar!!!” Similarly, the pet Shi Yu sent out also displayed a ferocious dragon might. The aura of the two parties collided, instantly making the ground and sky tremble. On Shi Yu’s side, it was a ferocious pet ten meters tall with dry brown skin and the appearance of a Tyrant Dragon. It drooled and stared at its opponent with red eyes!!
It was the land overlord Little Ji, who relied on its form to switch to the Tyrant Dragon form to reduce consumption!
For a moment, both parties relied on their auras to bombard the arena.
“Overlord-level Tyrant Dragon!!!” Shi Yu’s pet surprised everyone!
“Is it a mechanical phantom beast?”
Especially Monkalov himself, who was very shocked.
After all, all Shi Yu’s contracted pets had been displayed in the World Tournament previously. Every one of them was very strong!
Those six should be Shi Yu’s absolute main force.
Although now that Shi Yu had reached level seven, there was indeed a new contract slot and he could already contract a new pet, the cultivation strength of the new pet was actually very difficult to surpass the old pet in the short term.
Half a year was too short.
However, Shi Yu still sent a new pet. This move was completely unexpected.
In this era, it was impossible for there to be a living Tyrant Dragon. Then, this Tyrant Dragon was definitely a mechanical phantom beast.
Now that the various countries had obtained the mechanical phantom beast technology, the first goal of research was the ancient earth overlord, the Tyrant Dragon. They were naturally not unfamiliar with the mechanical Tyrant Dragon…
However, they still didn’t expect Shi Yu to contract another mechanical phantom beast when he had already contracted one!
“It’s actually a new pet, and a mechanical phantom beast!” Most Beast Tamers who had experienced the world competition were very stunned.
“Not the Green Dragon, not the Iron-eating Beast. Young man, are you looking down on me?” President Monkalov said.
In the Alliance Meeting, everyone had to experience several battles. They definitely had to leave most of the stamina of the trump card to the most important opponent. In Monkalov’s opinion, Shi Yu sending a new pet to fight him was looking down on him!
“President Monkalov, please don’t underestimate it,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s really surprising. Legend Shi Yu sent out a Tyrant Dragon, an extinct earth overlord. This should be a mechanical phantom beast!!” As the black cell phone deduced, the two pets had already fought!
The white leopard emperor stepped heavily with all four feet. Its figure was like the speed of light, difficult to capture with the naked eye. Its explosive power was extremely strong, and the ground trembled under its sprint. Little Ji’s speed was crushed by the other party. Only when the other party was extremely close did Little Ji roar and activate Earthquake!!
The ground rumbled and emitted vibrations, but the Star God Leopard’s battle skills were extremely high. In the face of the shaking ground that emitted terrifying vibrations, the light seal under its feet formed, and it easily maintained the stability of its speed. It instantly arrived in front of Little Ji.
Its starry eyes stared at Little Ji.
The Star God Claw tore out, and dazzling light erupted. A shocking wave erupted, directly tearing apart Little Ji’s body, leaving a shocking wound mark on its abdomen. A brown light that was like blood spread from the wound.
Little Ji’s pile of skills was all at the initial stage of the Perfect Level and had yet to be added. Under normal circumstances, it was very difficult to deal with the Star God Leopard. If Shi Yu wasn’t wrong, this Star God Leopard should have at least three super racial skills that had reached the stage above (Perfect+45).
However, there was one thing. Little Ji wouldn’t lose to this guy, which was its physical fitness.
It was a professional at getting beaten up.
“Roar!!! (You actually dare to hurt the overlord of the earth?!!)”
Little Ji, who had widened its red eyes and resisted its opponent’s attack, activated its furious reverse scale as the light in its abdomen exploded. Its anger erupted, and its dragon tail turned into a sword. Since its speed couldn’t compare to its opponent, it used the form of an injury exchange battle. The super heavy sword swept down with gravity and instantly crushed the panther emperor that tore its chest to the ground!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1136 - 1136 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (6)
chapters.content:
1136 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (6)
Boom!!!
As its figure landed, the Star God Leopard was suppressed to the ground. Its body caved in and shattered the ground. A huge pit appeared in the ground. In the smoke, another light breath shot out of the dust mist, crushing the ground and continuing to attack Little Ji’s wound. In an instant, it also flipped Little Ji over and sent it flying again. With a rumbling sound, a scratch dozens of meters long was pulled out.
“Who has the advantage?!”
As the two overlords fought, the audience in front of the live broadcast swallowed their saliva and couldn’t tell the situation.
Only Beast Tamers above the legend level could tell that both parties were still warming up.
President Monkalov didn’t use his Beast Taming Talent, nor did Shi Yu use his Beast Taming Talent. It looked like no one wanted to exhaust themselves first.
Shi Yu stood calmly on the spot. President Monkalov’s white cloak fluttered, and his eyes were serious.
From the warm-up situation, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon was clearly at a disadvantage!
“President has the advantage!” The Beast Tamers in Snowfield were extremely happy.
Buzz!!!
A ball of light condensed in the sky. The Star God Leopard, which had been crushed into the ground by Little Ji, descended from the ball of light and appeared above the fallen Little Ji. Two long fangs of light condensed in its mouth and locked onto Little Ji’s throat.
Light lingered as it swooped down, but with a roar, hot red light flashed in Little Ji’s eyes and body on the ground. Lava that was like the light of red evolution flowed on its body and erupted!!
Countless magma balls and volcano bullets bloomed from its body, instantly forcing the Star God Leopard back and making it condense the Star God Claw. As it blasted away the magma eruption, it retreated and distanced itself from the source of the magma eruption.
“Magma? That’s not a simple mechanical Tyrant Dragon!!” Little Ji’s move immediately made people realize that it wasn’t as simple as a Tyrant Dragon.
“That mechanical phantom beast has two fossil illusions!!!” Countless Mechanics were extremely incredulous and widened their eyes.
A mechanical phantom beast could actually fuse two fossils!!
Now, this Tyrant Dragon had clearly changed its form!
Damn, apart from how to fuse the Mythical fossil, the mechanical phantom beast technology Dong Huang shared with them indeed had other aspects!!
Moreover…
The appearance of the dragon-shaped creature in front of them directly made many archeologists and presidents of associations widen their eyes.
“I said not to underestimate it.” Shi Yu was amused.
“This is… bad!”
Monkalov’s gaze was shocked. As the magma ball fell, the mechanical Tyrant Dragon that had been blasted away by the Star God Leopard also got up again. At this moment, there were no injuries at all. Or rather, its entire body had cracked.
It completely changed from a Tyrant Dragon to the appearance of another ferocious beast, making Monkalov’s expression change.
F*ck.
Everyone was shocked.
Wasn’t this…
Wasn’t this the phantom appearance of the Mythical creature, the Earth Divine Dragon, that Shi Yu had displayed at the World Archeological Conference!!
Damn, he even fused the phantom of the divine beast, the Earth Divine Dragon, on the foundation of the mechanical Tyrant Dragon??
No wonder Shi Yu contracted it!
Boom!!!
The dragon might that was filled with violent anger erupted again, making the retreating Star God Leopard’s entire body tense up, revealing an extremely serious expression. It felt that the dragon in front of it was no different from a totem level!
“Roar!!!” Little Ji roared and used gravity control. In an instant, under the shocked gaze of the Star God Leopard, the surrounding thousands of meters of domain was immediately covered by the gravity field.
A red arc of light flashed in Little Ji’s pupils.
A terrifying gravity suppressed everything around it with it as the center!!
The dust that spread was instantly suppressed by the overwhelming gravity field. The Star God Leopard, which had condensed the Wings of Light to dodge the magma eruption and retreat into the sky, also instantly sensed the aura that descended from the sky.
Bang!
A shattered rock was pressed into the arena again. The entire arena seemed to have been flattened. The violent blurry gravity field made everyone’s scalps tingle.
The Star God Leopard felt that the gravity strength displayed by the other party this time was several times the power displayed by the other party just now. It was extremely terrifying. In an instant, it lost the ability to resist and its entire body quickly fell!!
After switching to the overlord form of the land, Little Ji directly activated the transcendent Mythical Revival and immediately obtained a body, Spirit, Soul, Energy, and Life comparable to a Mythical Race. Mythical Revival was equivalent to a comprehensive attribute strengthening skill.
