In an instant, Little Ji, whose skill proficiency was inferior to the Star God Leopard, used this taught skill to crush the other party in terms of Stats!!
Boom!!!
The Star God Leopard descended like a meteor. Little Ji roared again. In the direction the other party fell, the ground shattered. An earth blade that pierced into the sky like a mountain peak rushed out of the ground and hit the falling Star God Leopard!!
Space Splitting Sword!!!
Little Ji cursed, “Fly!!!”
In an instant, the situation reversed again.
Everyone in the snowfield looked at the imminent danger of the Star God Leopard and immediately revealed incredulous expressions.
“Star Soul, Possession!” On the other side, President Monkalov, who was fighting Shi Yu, also had a serious expression. He knew that he couldn’t continue like this. He immediately activated his Beast Taming Talent with all his might before Shi Yu!

chapters.title: Chapter 1137 - 1137 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (7)
chapters.content:
1137 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (7)
Star Soul Talent. He and his pet used the power of the stars in the starry sky to condense the power of the stars into a beast-shaped star soul. The talent that possessed his pet was even stronger than ordinary strengthening talents.
“Roar!!!” As starlight enveloped President Monkalov’s surroundings, his eyes turned into the color of a vast star. The surrounding aura rose steadily, and starlight lingered around the Star God Leopard. Under the continuous entanglement of the starlight, it condensed into a silver leopard-shaped star soul that wrapped around the Star God Leopard like a starry coat.
Immediately, its energy value, which had already exceeded 100 million, almost doubled, erupting with an even more terrifying power. Its various qualities also received an all-round increase like Little Ji. At the same time, its affinity for the power of the stars was also strengthened.
“Roar!!” After the Star God Leopard obtained the possession of the Star Soul, it struggled free from the restraints of the gravity field with a boom and adjusted its position. At the same time, with the acceleration of its fall, it condensed the Star God Claw and smashed it at the Space Splitting Sword.
Boom!!!
Not only was the Space Splitting Sword shattered, but countless cracks also appeared on the ground from the aftermath. The entire gravity field shattered. Seeing this, the Beast Tamers of Snowfield heaved a sigh of relief again.
In the next moment, the Star God Leopard Emperor attacked again under Monkalov’s command. During the Beast Taming Strengthening stage, be it pets or Beast Tamers, there would be a certain burden.
At the level-eight stage, although the strengthening time of a Beast Tamer was no longer as short and weak as that of a low-level Beast Tamer, and it was not a problem to maintain it for a few hours with normal strengthening, Monkalov knew that he was already old. In addition, there was still a battle later. He was unwilling to consume too much energy here and only wanted to end the battle quickly.
“Damn it, go.” He watched as the Star God Leopard collided with Little Ji again. At this moment, the Star God Leopard seemed to have turned into a ball of light that kept hitting the huge mechanical dragon. No one could see the figure of the Star God Leopard clearly at all, and they could only hear the spatial collision sounds.
Under the other party’s fierce attack, Little Ji didn’t fall into a disadvantage. Its huge dragon claws and dragon tail swept up hot magma, wrapped in divine-level dragon might, and fought the other party fiercely. For a moment, neither side was evenly matched.
However, when this scene landed in the eyes of the presidents of the associations and the audience, it was extremely serious. They subconsciously swallowed their saliva because President Monkalov had even used his Beast Taming Talent. As for Shi Yu opposite them, he still had his arms wrapped around his chest with a calm expression. He had no intention of interfering in the battle of pets!!
That mechanical phantom beast was fighting the Star God Leopard and a level-eight Beast Tamer alone!
“Who said that it’s impossible for the younger generation to defeat the older generation? Come out and get beaten up!” Countless spectators were shocked to have one’s jaw drop and to be slack-jawed. They couldn’t believe their eyes. After all, the other party was the strongest titled legend in the Snowfield Nation. The other party had already used all his strength and used his Beast Taming Talent, but Shi Yu’s mechanical dragon was still more than enough to parry!
Large beads of sweat had already flowed down Monkalov’s head.
It couldn’t be helped. Although the transcendent Mythical Revival was a teaching Skill, once this skill was activated, Little Ji was basically no different from a pseudo totem.
However, the opponent wasn’t weak either. After all, with the combination of the two, it was really difficult to determine the winner for a moment.
Just as everyone looked at the anxious battle with burning gazes, new changes occurred.
Boom!!!
After the attack, an even greater heat spread from the overlord of this land. Sensing the threat, even during the strengthening period, the Star God Leopard stopped its fierce attack and stopped in midair, looking at the enemy cautiously.
Sensing that his opponent’s battle was getting braver, President Monkalov’s expression froze.
“The battle is so intense…” The black cell phone finally spoke with lingering fears.
“The collision between the two parties has been even for too long. The confrontation has temporarily stopped. Looks like there are new changes…”
As soon as it finished speaking, blue veins had already appeared at the edge of the Eye of the Stars.
“The most powerful is the Star Soul Fusion, Star Splitting Claw.” President Monkalov gave the order. The Star Soul wrapped around the Star God Leopard directly fused into its body, causing its muscles to increase exponentially, and its strength to increase again, entering a higher load state!
“Roar!!!”
In midair, the leopard emperor’s body had reached more than ten meters long. Its body was even stronger, and its sharp claws were filled with a shocking light, as if it could tear apart stars. An even more terrifying aura appeared on its body.
Seeing this, the black cell phone immediately pulled up the data and shouted excitedly, “It’s the final profundity of President Monkalov’s Star Soul Talent, Star Soul Fusion!!! It’s said that after the Star Soul Fusion, the pet’s next attack can unearth all the pet’s potential, gather all its strength, and release the strongest profundity. However, after the attack, it will also lose its ability to fight!!”
“Looks like President Monkalov doesn’t plan to let the Star God Leopard fight the opponent anymore. He chose to bet everything!!!”
The final profundity of the astral soul fusion!
President Monkalov was also very helpless at this moment. The rational thing to do was not to fight a freak like Shi Yu head-on. After all, Shi Yu had not even displayed his divine-level Beast Taming Talent. Leaving it to his physical strength to deal with other countries was the right thing to do.
However, President Monkalov was also a stubborn person. He didn’t want to admit defeat directly in front of a junior.
It was just stamina, so it should still be enough. This time, he didn’t plan to let this set of old bones go back comfortably in the first place. He just had to sacrifice the Star God Leopard, but it didn’t matter much. His other seven pets were also at the level of the Star God Leopard, enough to support the next battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1138 - 1138 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (8)
chapters.content:
1138 Too Cruel, Too Cruel (8)
He wanted to use all his strength to see where Shi Yu’s limit was.
Of course, President Monkalov knew that Shi Yu definitely had a trump card, his divine-level Beast Taming Talent. However, the consumption of a divine-level talent that exceeded a top-notch Beast Taming Talent was definitely several times, more than ten times, dozens of times higher than a top-notch talent like his!
The stronger the talent, the greater the consumption.
Shi Yu might not necessarily be willing to use it too early. After all, there were more opponents next. There were also opponents of Mythical Races. That should be the target Shi Yu should deal with with all his might, so he was taking a gamble.
President Monkalov’s current goal was to at least defeat this mechanical Illusion God.
It had to be said that President Monkalov made the right bet.
Shi Yu was indeed unwilling to use his mind domain at this time. Even if it was telepathy, he was unwilling to use it too early. He felt that it was a waste of energy.
However, President Monkalov made the right bet, but not completely. Apart from the enhancement of the Beast Taming Talent, Shi Yu and the others… had another trump card!
“The final profundity? It’s useless.” Shi Yu looked at his opponent.
The next moment, what Monkalov was most worried about happened.
Boom!!!
The Star God Leopard was like a flash of light, a huge dragon that shot from the sky to the ground. Countless spectators had their hearts in their throats as they watched this attack, wanting to see what kind of damage President Xue Yuan’s final profundity could cause to the opponent.
Could it change the situation in one hit?
But suddenly, the expressions of the Star God Leopard and President Monkalov changed.
Legendary Wexy, the presidents of many associations, and the audience’s expressions changed drastically.
As the enemy attacked, Little Ji looked up.
The surroundings rumbled and trembled. Accompanied by the vibration, the sound of laws resounded through the venue.
President Monkalov’s pupils constricted.
“Earth, space, the vibration of the sound of laws. As expected, not only did you fuse with the Earth Divine Dragon fossil, but you also successfully awakened its law divine skill!”
“Another Mythical Race.”
Their hearts were miserable, and their faces were pale.
What he was most worried about happened.
It understood that there was completely no room for a comeback.
Quasi-divine skill, Cataclysm!
Amidst the trembling sounds around, the ground under Little Ji’s feet quickly cracked and spread like the speed of light. In an instant, there was no intact place in a radius of hundreds of meters.
Little Ji raised its head and roared!!!
“Roar!!!”
In an instant, shocking magma flames spread from the cracks in the ground. As the ground trembled, they swept up like a tsunami, devouring the ground and sweeping with layers of power. In an instant, they spewed out like a volcano eruption!
Boom!!!
The entire arena was like a volcano. With Little Ji as the core, the ground was instantly filled with a magma sea of fire. The magma pillar of fire that was more than a hundred meters in diameter swept up the power of the shock wave and shot into the sky. It immediately Devoured the incoming light. The other party’s attack didn’t cause any ripples before it was obliterated in the endless earth and magma vibrations.
Bang!!!
The entire Alliance Island rumbled, scaring Legendary Wex Yi. However, he immediately realized that Shi Yu and the others had controlled their strength very well and didn’t affect the outside of the arena much.
“This is… a quasi-divine skill? Another mechanical Illusion God? How is this possible?” His expression was shocked.
They, Shen Feng, had studied the fusion of the Mythical fossil in detail. Even Legendary Z asserted that Shi Yu could successfully create a mechanical Illusion God purely because the Kirin Race was relatively special and had the enhancement of luck to pass down the divine skill.
However, the scene in front of him directly shattered Legendary Z’s judgment.
Shi Yu, this monster, had cultivated and created another divine pet!!!
Countless people revealed incredulous expressions.
“World Destroyer, Earth Divine Dragon!” The angel god sensed the change in the laws and also appeared beside the Rongguang Light Pope with a slightly shocked expression.
“It’s not the main body, but it’s indeed its power.”
“Is the Earth Divine Dragon very strong?” the Holy Emperor asked.
The angel god nodded and said, “It’s a god who left Blue Planet behind. It’s an existence in the first tier. Its power was actually inherited.”
Lava erupted from the ground for more than ten seconds. During the entire process, the figures of the Star God Leopard and Little Ji were Devoured without any sound.
When little bit of magma fell again, turning the entire venue into a magma venue, everyone finally discovered the figures of the two pets.
The mechanical phantom beast was still bathing in the magma and standing on the arena unscathed. However, there was no longer a trace of intactness on the body of the Star God Leopard. It lay in the magma on the verge of death and completely lost consciousness.
The so-called final profundity was instantly killed by the other party’s stronger ultimate move before it could even approach the opponent!!
In the first round, the winner was decided.
At this moment, most of the audience looked at the live broadcast in confusion. They didn’t understand.
“Damn, what’s this?!!!”
Looking at the arena that had turned into a sea of lava, countless people were stunned. Didn’t they agree on the final profundity? Why was it insta-killed by the opponent in the blink of an eye?!
What Skill was that!
They didn’t understand, but they could understand the ferocity of this move.
The divine skill scene that spewed out just now was still in everyone’s eyes, making them open their mouths wide. Even the black cell phone couldn’t say anything at this moment.
It was slightly shocked. Now that it looked back, it was clearly a one-sided battle. If Shi Yu’s pet had used this move from the start, the battle would probably have ended not long after it started!!
“You guys…”
“Pfft.” Because of consumption and Retaliation, as the Star God Leopard fell, President Monkalov directly spat out a mouthful of blood. His face was even paler as he covered his chest.
They were completely stunned by the strength of Shi Yu and the mechanical Earth Divine Dragon.
He could sense that the surging energy contained in this move had even exceeded the meteorite summoned by Shi Yu in the World Tournament! It was incomparably terrifying. In fact, this was even if the other party held back. If it erupted with all its might, it might be comparable to the mysterious millstone.
President Monkalov was directly dizzy.
The Beast Tamers of the Snowfield Nation were stunned when they saw their president’s miserable state through the live broadcast. They couldn’t accept that their president, who had been famous for decades, had been defeated by a young man.
The Beast Tamers of the various countries couldn’t believe that the president of the Snowfield Nation had actually lost a round in a crushing defeat.
Moreover, from the aura of that dragon, it seemed to still have energy? It still had energy after using such a strong skill?
How strong was Shi Yu?
“Dr. Shi Yu is impressive, awesome!!! He actually crushed the pet of the president of the Snowfield Nation Association!!!” The Beast Tamers of Dong Huang who were watching the live broadcast had excited expressions. No wonder, no wonder Dong Huang sent Shi Yu to fight!!
As expected, what did they know? Dr. Shi Yu was forever a god. Was this the strength of a mechanical phantom beast?? Was this the value of the strongest world legend?
They were definitely going to take the Mechanic class of Ancient Capital University!!
“Don’t worry, it’s fine. President Monkalov, do you want to continue?” Shi Yu said.
Fortunately, Little Ji had already finished warming up and was already familiar with the power of laws here. Otherwise, it would really be difficult to control this skill. It would be very dangerous to use it immediately. The opponent wouldn’t even be left with ashes. Now, it was alright, alright. Little Ji could already control the power of the Crowd Control… It was all thanks to the proficiency of the Cataclysm that it had reached the proficient level because of the Mythical Revival.
It could still do it again!
President Monkalov’s face darkened.
“Damn, another Mythical Race. This monster!!!” At this moment, the expressions of the presidents of the associations became even uglier.
Moreover, it was the phantom beast Earth Divine Dragon known for its destructive power!!
Now, they finally understood why Shi Yu still contracted this one even though he already had a mechanical phantom beast.
It was very normal for Shi Yu to contract a new pet. In the speculation of the various countries, even what Shi Yu would contract with in the seventh contract slot had been speculated a few times.
The countries estimated that Shi Yu was most likely to give this contract slot to the Abyss Demon Duck that had obtained the divine-level resource, the Abyss Seed, and the reincarnation of the Abyss Evil God. It was also possible to contract the cub of the Mythical Demon Race he had obtained from Lord Lie Shan!
However, in the end, it was a mechanical phantom beast! What did this mean? It meant that the potential of this mechanical phantom beast exceeded those in Shi Yu’s eyes, even exceeding that Wind Kirin phantom beast.
In fact, in their eyes, the performance of this mechanical Earth Divine Dragon was even more terrifying. It could actually control divine skills with ease!!
Just one move. Regardless of its functionality, its battle power might have already exceeded that sword spirit and the Blue Sea Sprite. Its battle potential had probably already approached or even exceeded Shi Yu’s top six pets!! This Shi Yu was even more troublesome… He had to quickly analyze the strategy to resist this mechanical Earth Divine Dragon!

chapters.title: Chapter 1139 Poor Sword Spirit
chapters.content:
Chapter 1139  Poor Sword Spirit
At the moment, Shi Yu vs Monkalov. The current situation was that Monkalov was at an absolute disadvantage!
Moreover, because he assisted the Star God Leopard in attacking with all its might, he also suffered a backlash.
"This Shi Yu is simply abnormal. It's better not to fight him." When the titled legend of Xue Yuan saw this, he couldn't help but think to himself and look at his president.
The other countries took advantage of the Mythical Revival to befriend divine beasts.
In the end, Shi Yu cultivated another one after half a year?
Moreover, in terms of strength, it was simply stronger than the pet strength he had displayed in the past.
Fight my ass.
This guy was abnormal.
Their Snowfield was relatively unlucky. Although they had successfully befriended a reincarnation divine beast, that divine beast's growth level was only at the monarch level.
Its strength had yet to recover, so it couldn't participate in a battle of this level at all.
Therefore, President Monkalov could only fight personally.
But who would have thought that the opening was disadvantageous, and it was the sharpness lost by a young Beast Tamer!
"Continue." Monkalov calmed his breathing.
Apart from the final outcome, the aura during this Alliance Meeting was also very important.
As the leader of the Snowfield Nation, if he admitted defeat to a young man and couldn't even defeat the other party's pet, the morale of the Snowfield Nation would suffer a huge blow.
This wouldn't do.
"Jiu!!!!!"
Everyone looked at the arena and saw that after President Monkalov recalled the Star God Leopard, he summoned a new pet!!
In the sky, a red summoning array appeared. A long, clear, and sharp cry with extremely strong penetration sounded.
Then, a huge vulture with a light blue body that spread its wings more than ten meters descended.
Its sharp eyes were like blue stars, looking down at the ground.
Star God Vulture!
Seeing this pet appear, the presidents of the various associations understood Monkalov's determination.
It was impossible to admit defeat. However, Monkalov didn't dare to send out his trump card.
His trump card was an ice-element Star Bear Race. It looked like he had indeed chosen to leave it to other countries.
However, this Star God Vulture was not weak either. It was not inferior to the Star God Leopard just now.
If Shi Yu's Mechanical Illusion God had used more than half of its strength in that attack just now and didn't change pets, this battle might not be easy.
"President Monkalov changed pets!!! He sent out his Star God Vulture!!"
"This pet is also quite powerful! It once defeated a totem with the support of President Monkalov!" The black cell phone shouted in introduction in shock.
However, his gaze kept stopping on Shi Yu and the mechanical divine dragon.
In the introduction, its tone suddenly froze as it looked at Shi Yu and the others.
"Roar!!!" The huge Lava Dragon suddenly turned to look at Shi Yu and its Beast Tamer.
Little Ji: I'm not playing anymore.
Shi Yu: "Oh?"
Shi Yu was rather surprised because Little Ji actually still had the strength to fight. If he gave this Star God Vulture another disaster, it should be able to insta-kill it.
But from the looks of it, Little Ji meant that it still wanted to appear more times.
Now that it had two quasi-divine skills in a row, it would definitely be crippled. Even with Baby Ginseng's treatment, it couldn't get up in the short term.
On the contrary, if he maintained this good state and received nourishment, he could still fight in a pretty good state.
Let Duckie do it!
Little Ji was very generous.
Shi Yu was even more surprised. After hearing Little Ji's analysis, he actually realized that Little Ji had become smarter and knew that battles had to be controlled.
This wasn't like its personality…
It clearly didn't add any intelligence to it.
"Alright." Shi Yu chose to listen to his pet's suggestion and put away his little phone.
According to the rules, after a pet lost its ability to fight, both parties had a chance to change pets once.
Shi Yu also decisively chose to change.
Seeing Shi Yu retract his little phone, the black cell phone immediately said in surprise, "Legend Shi Yu chose to retract his pet!"
"He's going to send out a new pet."
"Looks like that move just now consumed a lot of this pet's strength!"
It had to be said that Shi Yu's action of retracting his pet had left President Monkalov with a lot of face.
If Little Ji defeated a pet and didn't consume much stamina, and it could still pass through two opponents at once. It was simply pressing Xue Yuan's face on the ground.
Shi Yu's action of retracting his pet could instead make some people comfort themselves. Little Ji had already done its best just now.
"Change pets? Which one is it?" President Monkalov's expression turned cold.
All eyes were focused on Shi Yu's newly activated summoning array.
"I guess it's the Green Dragon. The Green Dragon is the god of faith in the starry sky. Its cultivation level will definitely be above that old kid, Monkalov's pet. It will definitely win steadily. Xue Yuan will lose face this time." President Logan of Shen Feng was also watching happily.
"The other mechanical phantom beast is also possible. The Star God Vulture is better at flying than the Star God Leopard. The Earth Divine Dragon is not easy to deal with, but the Wind Kirin, the overlord of the sky, is more suitable!"
Everyone guessed. A new pet image had already condensed. It was also at this moment that the expressions of almost all the Beast Tamers who had experienced the world competition suddenly froze.
Even President Monkalov was stunned again.
Because a duck appeared on the huge summoning array.
A huge black duck five meters tall with dark blue patterns all over its body.
On its neck, the pure golden-blue water that was like cleansing water froze like a ribbon, becoming a scarf-like part that floated behind it in an extremely domineering manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 1140 Poor Sword Spirit (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1140  Poor Sword Spirit (2)
As soon as it appeared, it looked at the ground and cursed. Seeing that the entire venue was filled with magma, Duckie immediately exploded in anger!
F*cking land overlord.
It knew that nothing good would happen if Little Ji replaced it.
Duckie immediately jumped up from the heat and roared at the sky. It was very angry.
"Quack!!!!!!"
The sky was instantly pitch-black, and black water droplets fell from the sky.
Dark Sky Wave Rain!!!
A terrifying Demon God aura lingered between the sky and the ground. A dark red light flashed past the duck's eyes. It looked at the Star God Vulture unkindly… planning to vent the anger it had suffered at home on outsiders.
"Huh??" Shi Yu summoned a new pet, the Abyss Demon Duck. It could be said that the number of people who could guess it at the scene was almost zero.
How was this possible?!
Shi Yu's first six pets, Iron-eating Beast, Green Dragon, Baby Ginseng, Sword Spirit, Blue Sea Sprite, Wind Kirin…
The seventh was the Mechanical Illusion Divine Dragon.
And now, as a level-seven Beast Tamer, Shi Yu had sent out his eighth pet!
It wasn't the first six pets that had appeared in the World Tournament. Instead, it was the abyss demigod reincarnation known as the "second team" at that time. It had temporarily not contracted and obtained the divine-level Abyss Seed.
Although the image was a little different, from the power fluctuations, it was the power of the abyss!
Holy shit.
Shi Yu had even contracted it!
Therefore, what was going on? Shi Yu had broken the contract of the first pet??? Otherwise, how could he contract two new pets in a row?
Shi Yu's previous pets were also top-notch pets. Although the Abyss Demon Duck with divine-level resources was indeed very strong, it didn't have to be broken just like that, right?
For someone of Shi Yu's status, although the side effects of breaking the contract were not difficult to recover from, it would more or less affect the relationship between Beast Tamers and pets. How could he bear to do that?
"Iron-eating Beast, impossible. That's the ferociousness that defeated the Enfeeble Divine Spirit."
"Green Dragon, even more so. That's the Eastern God in Dong Huang's heart, the god of faith in the starry sky. It's not easy to nurture it. Only a fool would abandon it."
"A time-element ginseng baby that can revive and self-destruct. Any Beast Tamer can't break the contract with such a strategic pet."
"The Blue Sea Sprite is the strongest demigod reincarnation. It's known by the gods as the strongest tier god after stepping into the Mythical Domain. It's impossible to give up."
"Could it be…"
Everyone recalled that Shi Yu had contracted a new mechanical phantom beast. Could it be that he had broken the contract with the Wind Kirin?
They quickly shook their heads. The Wind Kirin had mastered a divine skill of luck, and it was a Mythical Race. Shi Yu shouldn't be that stupid.
From the looks of it…
The greatest possibility was that Shi Yu had broken the contract with the sword spirit!
Although that sword spirit was also very strong, its performance in the World Tournament was far inferior to Shi Yu's other pets.
Compared to the Green Dragon and Baby Ginseng that killed totems and the Iron-eating Beast that defeated the Enfeeble Divine Spirit, its battle record of possessing Shi Yu had only killed an invincible overlord.
The greatest function was to possess a Beast Tamer.
Compared to other divine beast teammates, as a heroic spirit, it was severely affected by its previous life, and the upper limit of its growth was also relatively low.
Moreover, as a heroic spirit, even if it broke the contract, it wouldn't betray the Beast Tamer. It was a life and death binding. Therefore, it was very likely that the sword spirit had been broken by Shi Yu and eliminated, replaced by the current mechanical Illusion God, the Earth Divine Dragon, and the Abyss Demon Duck.
At this point, everyone felt that they were close to the truth. They couldn't help but feel pity for the sword spirit. Poor sword spirit. It was clearly very strong, but the pets later were even more monstrous.
the blink of an eye, he was enough to assist the Star God Vulture in the battle with all his might.
Boom!!!
"What are these guys imagining?" President Lin Xiao noticed that in the huge venue, even Legendary Wex Yi fell into deep thought. His expression kept changing, as if he was guessing something. He couldn't help but be stunned.
That made sense…
If Shi Yu had not told him in advance, he would definitely be equally stunned.
It was an extremely pity to break the contract of Shi Yu's pets.
But was there a possibility that Shi Yu had not removed any of them, but obtained a contract slot that was different from ordinary people under the blessings of the World Tree??
Double contract slot!
Perhaps even the legends of the previous three worlds didn't have this treatment.
"Star God Vulture, Starlight!"
While everyone was still guessing which pet had been eliminated by Shi Yu, the battle had already continued. President Monkalov was indeed experienced. Just now, he looked extremely weak, but in the blink of an eye, he was enough to assist the Star God Vulture in the battle with all his might.
Boom!!!
A huge star soul possessed the Star God Vulture. It let out a long roar. As it expelled the black rain that corroded energy and attacked its body, it summoned starlight, wanting to disperse the dark sky wave rain from the source.
"Jiu!!!!!!"
In terms of Skill proficiency and various Stats, the Star God Vulture was still better. At least, it pulled open two small steps, so with the experience provided by Little Ji, this time, as soon as Duckie came up, it activated the peerless mode, Abyss Liberation!!
It didn't want to be tortured by the other party in its normal state.
Little Ji's Cataclysm also needed to warm up to increase its control over the Skill, but it didn't need it!
Firstly, it was because the core of the move was all gathered in the body and wouldn't cause too much damage to the outside world. Secondly, it had moves that restricted quasi-divine skills.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
The Star God Vulture discovered that it could immediately disperse the dark clouds. However, with a strange thumping sound, it let out an ominous roar and circled in the sky, discovering that the dark clouds were even stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1141 - 1141 Poor Sword Spirit (3)
chapters.content:
1141 Poor Sword Spirit (3)
Under its starry coat, the powerful force shattered layers of energy shields and corroded deeper.
It looked down and immediately discovered that the so-called “bang bang bang bang” vibration came from the Demon Duck’s body!!
It was the sound of its heart!!
The strong heartbeat was like thunder. The roar of a god resounded through the entire spatial venue, making everyone’s hearts involuntarily beat faster with it.
Under the dark sky, the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck walked on the magma ground step by step. Accompanied by the dark sky’s fluctuations, Quas mist steam immediately rose and swept into water.
Buzz!!!
The sound of laws that suppressed everything also came with the beating of the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck’s heart. A terrifying Demon God aura filled the sky, making the Star God Vulture in the sky reveal a frightened expression. It also made Monkalov, who was opposite him, reveal an incomprehensible expression.
It was the sound of laws again, another quasi-divine skill!
What a joke. Was it common?
The presidents of the many associations and Beast Tamers present got up in disbelief.
“Abyss God!”
“It’s the same as that Xuan Ming. It has mastered the power of the abyss!” The angel god looked at the duck and couldn’t help but say with a look of disbelief.
“But it’s only at the overlord level… It will definitely lose its mind!”
He was only at the overlord level, but he dared to use the abyssal divine power. He had a death wish.
Wouldn’t its Resistance be corroded by the power of the abyss?
Although there was a precedent for Little Ji, no one dared to imagine that in just half a year, Shi Yu’s second team pet had crossed the restrictions of its race at the overlord level and reached the divine level.
This was already Shi Yu’s number one Mythical Race pet?!
Moreover, this was a Mythical Race that had inherited the power of the abyss, the invader of Blue Planet!!
“Damn it!!” Monkalov cursed. He finally had the intention to retreat. He felt that Shi Yu’s pet was even more ridiculous. It actually activated a quasi-divine skill the moment it came up.
Moreover, from the signs of this quasi-divine skill, it was a state-type quasi-divine skill?
He hesitated for a moment, and it was this hesitation that instantly buried the Star God Vulture.
“Quack! (Profoundity: One Thought of Buddha Demon!)”
Swoosh!
A Vajra Demon Subduing Staff turned into a holy weapon. Under the wash of the golden power, in an instant, traces of golden holy light were mixed in the black Demon God Flame of the Sea Cleansing Duck.
Boom!
The impact of the limits of the two powers.
Sonic booms sounded, and the sound was Devoured by the sound of the heart.
“What’s this?” someone exclaimed.
Under the wash of this power, the duck, whose gaze was violent just now and whose rationality was gradually losing, recovered some consciousness.
It stunned some people who originally didn’t think highly of the overlord level and tried to master the power of the divine-level abyss.
“The power of the Heart Buddha.” Ming Hua’s Reincarnator, President Ashaya, couldn’t help but stand up.
An abyssal creature had mastered the Holy power of Ming Hua?
Wait a minute, was that Demon Duck’s predecessor the Duckbill Beast… Could it be… She couldn’t believe it.
Could it be that this reincarnation cultivated both Buddhism and demonic attributes during the evolution process??
What kind of monster was this!!
Everyone was stunned.
The accelerated burning of the blood made Duckie’s figure instantly disappear from the spot.
Boom!!!
A huge pit appeared on the shattered magma ground. A black ocean lake instantly formed, replacing the magma pool.
“It disappeared!”
The breathing of the audience tightened at the same time, and their gazes quickly moved.
Where was that Demon Duck?
“In… in the sky!!!” Someone discovered Duckie’s traces.
In midair, the Star God Vulture’s mind had long been focused to the extreme, its eyes filled with seriousness.
“Jiu!!!” Under the violent and sharp cry, its figure had already turned into a divine light beam that broke through the limit in the sky. In an instant, its flying trajectory formed a five-pointed star.
Super Skill, Star Seal.
Boom!!!
The huge Star Seal was like a palm as it slapped down at the arena, enveloping and suppressing everything.
But in the next moment, the Star God Vulture and Monkalov were shocked. They suddenly realized that with a bang, a huge hole appeared in the Star Seal that enveloped a large area. Moreover, the edge of the hole was filled with black frost.
They didn’t realize how the Skill was penetrated at all.
When they reacted, the figure of the Abyss Demon Duck had already appeared behind the Star God Vulture. The pressure was very strong, making them unable to believe it.
What explosive power…
It instantly disappeared, penetrated the super Skill that was close to transcendent proficiency, and ascended to the sky again. It came to the sky behind the enemy, still invisible.
They couldn’t defeat it, they were completely not its match.
“Star God Vulture, come back,” Monkalov shouted. He finally gave up in his heart, but the speed of his voice transmission was slower than Duckie’s rapid attack.
“Quack!! (Quack crouching vulture pestle!!)” Even if its rationality was corroded, ducks could still be naughty.
At the same time as the attack, it shouted.
Space and time seemed to have frozen. The Star God Vulture was completely unable to withstand a single blow from the duck under the beating heart of the abyss. It was almost like flowing water. The duck holding the Demon Suppressing Pestle directly instilled the power of the abyss into the Demon Suppressing Pestle!!
Cracks immediately appeared on the holy weapon that shone with the light of the Buddha Demon, becoming the carrier of the duck’s attack!!
However, even this carrier was not enough to withstand all the abyssal divine power…

chapters.title: Chapter 1142 - 1142 Poor Sword Spirit (4)
chapters.content:
1142 Poor Sword Spirit (4)
But for the time being, it was enough.
Duckie directly smashed the Demon Subduing Pestle onto the Star God Vulture from top to bottom.
Boom!!!
In an instant.
The Star God Vulture fell to the ground like a stream of light and was smashed into the black lake just now. Its attack caused thousands of waves and splashed black water droplets that filled the sky. It was like a reverse dark sky wave rain, making President Monkalov’s expression immediately turn pale.
Pfft.
President Monkalov, who was opposite him, vomited blood again. With a boom, he looked at the Star God Vulture that floated up and lost consciousness, as well as the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck that had already landed and recovered its Restoration state. His heart almost exploded.
This attack also stunned all the spectators again.
Crushing?
“Stronger, ridiculously strong, right? It doesn’t look like they’re in the same dimension at all? The main force of that Star God Monkalov, who has been famous for decades, actually couldn’t even withstand a round and was insta-killed.”
“What exactly is going on with this Shi Yu?”
It was alright the first time, but after two consecutive rounds, the legend expert who had been famous for a long time were beaten up by Shi Yu. In an instant, the audience of the various countries was stunned.
“Ah, this, this.” The black cell phone was stunned. It was also shocked by the strength of Shi Yu’s Sea Cleansing Demon Duck. It only felt that it wasn’t weaker than the mechanical Illusion God machine that had previously activated a catastrophe.
It was completely crushed.
“I was wrong. It actually mastered such a perfect cleansing power and restricted the power of the abyss.” At this moment, the expression of the Angel God changed again, making the Light Pope beside him speechless.
This Shi Yu… was really not human. Even the second team’s pets were like this?
No, he didn’t believe that this Abyss Demon Duck was still the so-called second team Shi Yu had mentioned previously.
At least, in the quasi-divine skill state, it already had the battle power of a top-notch totem!
“Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit.” Dong Huang, Ancient Capital, and Yu Shu were immediately stunned when they saw that this duck was so strong. F*ck, no wonder Shi Yu would rather break the contract of General Mu Huiyin’s heroic spirit and contract this duck.
It was really strong.
However, when they recalled that General Mu Huiyin’s experience was already so miserable, and she still had to break the contract because Shi Yu liked the new and hated the old. In Dong Huang, the Beast Tamers who had seen the preview of Mu Huiyin’s legend instantly felt uncomfortable.
Scumbag!
“I lost.”
“The future belongs to you young people.”
At this point, President Monkalov, who was holding his chest, looked at Shi Yu opposite him. He already knew that he had been completely surpassed by this young man. Even if he sent other main forces, they would definitely not be his match in a one-on-one situation.
This guy’s pets were all a group of monsters.
Initially, everyone was afraid that the six pets in Shi Yu’s World Tournament would be stronger now.
However, no one expected Shi Yu to directly take out two new pets to crush everyone.
This guy… used only half a year to pull up two new pets with totem battle power!
“It’s over. Monkalov has already become this kid’s stepping stone. His growth speed is faster than I imagined,” President Shen Feng said with an ugly expression.
“You will all be stepping stones.” Only President Lin Xiao’s heart was as clear as a mirror.
Others were only stunned by the strength of Little Ji and Duckie in front of them, but these two pets were clearly still only the second team in Shi Yu’s previous evaluation!
He didn’t have the ability to challenge the first team at all! This meant that Shi Yu’s full strength was beyond imagination.
“Thank you for the fight,” Shi Yu said to Monkalov.
“Yes.” Monkalov put away the Star God Vulture and turned to leave.
At this moment, all the Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast in the world went crazy. Damn, this young world legend in his early twenties actually, actually really defeated President Monkalov, who was strong enough to enter the top 15 of the Beast Taming Domain?!
And it was… a crushing posture?!
What a joke. Who could tell them how far this Shi Yu’s full strength had reached!
Could it be that it was already close to the Legendary level?
“He took down the legend title at level six. At the legend level, it’s not impossible for his battle power to be close to the Legendary level, right?” Some spectators who had seen the world competition tried to convince themselves.
….
At the same time.
On the other side of the mountain, on the other side of the sea, on an isolated island far away from the Alliance Island.
A dark aura enveloped the entire island, and the tip of the iceberg was revealed on the huge creature’s body.
“Your Majesty, they have already infiltrated the Alliance Island.”
A black giant ape prostrated on the ground and welcomed the supreme strongest demigod in front of it, the king of totems and the king of the Yun Race.
“I finally caught an opportunity.”
Its huge eyes crossed the sea and also stared in the direction of Alliance Island.
The seven countries held the Alliance Meeting, and Dong Huang represented Shi Yu. This information was naturally received by the Yun clan.
Ever since the last time Shi Yu from the Heavenly Sword Nation snatched divine-level resources from Yun An, Yun An had been holding a grudge until now. In order to take revenge, he had already prepared for a long time.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t find any traces of Shi Yu.
However, this time, Shi Yu confirmed that he had appeared on Alliance Island. Its sacrificial soldiers and assassins had already locked onto Shi Yu.
He was definitely going to kill Shi Yu in one go.
This time, it planned to use the suicide self-destruction attack of its totem-level subordinates to kill Shi Yu’s existence!
Even if Shi Yu still had the previous Guardian equipment, it definitely couldn’t offset its carefully planned assassination!
In addition, wasn’t it wanted by the Seven Nation Alliance? It also had to give the Human Alliance a big gift!
In any case, after killing Shi Yu and venting the hatred in its heart, it didn’t plan to stay on Blue Planet anymore.
Run after fighting!
The Blue Planet god gradually woke up, making Yun An realize that this was not a low-level planet at all. It planned to go to a nearby planet to wait for the Mythical stage to completely revive and break through to the divine level before leaving this galaxy.
It could be said that Yun An originally didn’t care about Shi Yu’s growth speed if he didn’t contract the Blue Sea Sprite and the Iron-eating Beast, but Shi Yu disguised himself as Emperor Wu and snatched its resources. This was something Yun An couldn’t tolerate. It was so angry.
Blue Planet it could choose not to dominate, but Shi Yu had to die!
This was the last thing it prepared to do before leaving. If it didn’t do it, there would be a knot in its heart. It was afraid that becoming a god wouldn’t be stable. Ahhh.

chapters.title: Chapter 1143 - 1143 Assassination from Yun An
chapters.content:
1143 Assassination from Yun An
After the battle ended, with President Monkalov stepping down, Shi Yu naturally followed.
There was silence. Only Shen Feng’s new Legendary, Wexy, looked at the messy venue and fell into deep thought with the mystic realm remote control in his hand.
President Monkalov was alright.
But was this Shi Yu deliberately targeting him?
He clearly knew that there was still a battle later, and as a judge, he still had to repair the venue part-time, but in the end, he didn’t pity the venue at all?
The quasi-divine skill of the mechanical phantom beast directly changed most of the terrain of the mystic realm venue, shattering the ground and summoning countless magma from the ground.
Under the enhancement of the quasi-divine skill, the Abyss demigod reincarnation summoned harsh rain. Its battle aura also collided with the magma terrain, causing the mystic realm arena to almost shatter under the aftermath of the two!
Legendary Lightning Yi could already predict that this would be the situation in the next six battles Shi Yu participated in.
His expression couldn’t help but darken.
“Sigh.” But at this moment, the black cell phone had yet to realize the seriousness of the problem. It was still reminiscing about the battle just now. It said, “How exciting.”
“Dear audience before the live broadcast, are you very surprised by the outcome of the battle just now?”
“I’m very surprised that President Monkalov lost the competition, but this isn’t because President Monkalov is weak, but because Legend Shi Yu’s two pets are very special!”
“I have to introduce them to everyone!”
The audience in front of the live broadcast stared at the black cell phone. What the f*ck were you doing earlier? During the battle, you should have explained at the same time!
“That Tyrant Dragon and Dragon-shaped monster is indeed a mechanical phantom beast. It’s a new life form revived with the fossil as the prototype!”
“However, legend Shi Yu, Dr. Shi Yu’s mechanical phantom beast doesn’t use ordinary fossils, but a mechanical illusion god that revives with the fossil of the Mythical creature, the Earth Divine Dragon, as a template!! The Skill used just now is also the signature divine skill of the Earth Divine Dragon!! A terrifying divine skill that’s enough to destroy a continent!!”
“President Monkalov didn’t lose in vain. He mastered the prototype of a divine skill. That mechanical Illusion God can already be called a Mythical Race!! In the history of the Alliance, even Legendary Beast Tamers have never cultivated a Mythical Race pet. Dr. Shi Yu is the first!!”
“I think it doesn’t seem to be a problem to call him the legendary Mechanic!”
[Mythical Race? Holy shit…] Countless Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast widened their eyes. Divine skill? Mythical Race?
They, who only knew the overlord race and super skills, had no concept of the word Mythical at all. From the looks of it, it was really strong. It was a divine skill that was enough to destroy a continent. It was not strange for it to instantly kill the main force of the strongest echelon’s titled legend. No wonder President Monkalov looked like he had eaten sh*t!
“As for that black Demon Duck, it’s said that it’s the reincarnation of the most unholy faction, the demigod of the Abyss Sea. At the peak of its previous life, its individual existence was not inferior to a Legendary Beast Tamer. In this life, it was unearthed by legend Shi Yu and carefully cultivated. The Skill used just now is also a quasi-divine skill. Just like the Mechanical Illusion God just now, it’s also a Mythical Race!”
“President Monkalov, your loss was not unjust!”
President Monkalov, who had already left the stage, looked at the black cell phone. Listen to me, thank you… #!
Although he was bragging about Shi Yu, there was no need to emphasize that he had lost every time, right?!
President Monkalov was so angry that his beard flew up.
[Wait?! Another Mythical Race?! Didn’t they say that in the history of the Alliance, even Legendary Beast Tamers have never cultivated a Mythical Race pet!]
After introducing Duckie, the Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast were stunned again. However, it was also a fact that the second duck insta-killed the Star God Vulture even more sharply. They had all seen it.
[This is nothing. During the World Tournament, Shi Yu had already cultivated a Mythical Race. Otherwise, why do you think he could end the competition in the preliminaries and even kill totems above his level? I was at the scene at that time!] Someone exposed.
Everyone: “Huh???”
As the black cell phone introduced him, more and more information about Shi Yu was exposed, allowing more Normal Beast Tamers to instantly know a lot of ridiculous information.
“No wonder this guy could be chosen by the Blue Planet’s Will to become the savior of Blue Planet! He’s indeed powerful!” Upon hearing this, the spider girl who was beaten up by Shi Yu in Dong Huang was completely convinced.
It was not easy to nurture so many Mythical Races. Even in the Mythical Era, there wouldn’t be many creatures of Mythical Races, let alone in this Cultivationless Era.
“Next…” Soon, the black cell phone finished speaking and began to shake the two parties fighting in the second round!
Shen Feng vs Ming Hua!
The representative of Shen Feng, the Mechanical God of War, President Logan, was like a title. He was expert in the Mechanic class, and his strongest mechanical weapon, the Battle God Fist, had the battle record of heavily injuring top-notch totems.
And as a Mechanic, he could also create forbidden Arms.
In terms of battle results, he was a Beast Tamer even fiercer than President Makalov. If he really let loose and fought, even demigods would probably be unwilling to fight President Logan, who was in charge of the Shen Feng Nation.
However, the Alliance Meeting definitely restricted forbidden weapons.
And his opponent was Ming Hua’s Reincarnator, Ashaya!
This was a beautiful Beast Tamer with bright black skin. In a sense, apart from Shi Yu, she was the youngest representative of the Beast Tamer in this Alliance Meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1144 - 1144 Assassination from Yun An (2)
chapters.content:
1144 Assassination from Yun An (2)
She was in her early forties and looked to be less than 30 years old, like a young beautiful woman.
However, if it was from her previous life, she might be the oldest.
In her previous life, she accidentally ate a special resource that could allow her to reincarnate. Therefore, although she was a human, she did the same miracle as those gods and totems. After dying, she successfully reincarnated into a new baby in the future.
With the memories of an ancient legend, she began to rise again. This was also the key to her ascending to the second seat of Ming Hua in her early forties.
It could be said that every president of the associations of the seven countries had a chance to break through to the Legendary level. None of them were easy.
“I wonder if these two contracted a reincarnation god…”
After Shi Yu left the arena, he casually sat in an empty place and didn’t go to President Lin Xiao. It was mainly because he was certain that when President Lin saw him, he would definitely talk a lot again.
He clearly looked like a very profound person at the start, but recently, he was becoming more and more like Principal Feng. Sigh.
Old Lin, Old Lin, be more careful. He was already more than a hundred years old. If he didn’t take advantage of the revival of the laws to break through to the Legendary stage, there wouldn’t be anything to play with.
“Huh???” At this moment, President Logan and President Ashaya had already gone on stage.
Shi Yu’s expression suddenly changed.
His right eye instantly twitched. A huge sense of danger made him suddenly look around.
Like Shi Yu, Ling, who had suddenly sensed danger, turned into a small cube and floated beside Shi Yu, recording the battle of the Alliance Conference.
It also instantly sensed a huge crisis.
Shi Yu suddenly focused all his attention, but a moment later, nothing happened.
On the arena, the battle was very intense. The various presidents, even Legendary Wex Yi, were watching the battle intently, as if they didn’t notice anything.
Everything looked very calm, but to Shi Yu and Ling, it was so strange.
He clearly sensed danger, but he couldn’t sense anything and couldn’t find the source.
What was going on…
“Ling, you sensed it too, right?”
“Although it was only for an instant.”
“Yes, Master,” Ling said solemnly.
Not to mention the totem level.
In battle, when facing a Skill that was fatal to the enemy, one would feel a life-and-death threat from it, and their bodies would react differently.
In daily life, when facing a crisis that might attack in the next moment, it would also sense the crisis a second or even a fraction of a second in advance.
But no matter which it was, it could only be sensed when danger was about to come.
Shi Yu had long studied this ability in detail when the Seven Islands challenged the path to champion. The situation just now was very strange. They clearly sensed danger, but in the next moment, no danger descended.
Strange…
Moreover, if a crisis really descended, the Dragon God Protection should be able to be activated.
The Dragon God Protection didn’t react at all. Only they sensed it, so was there any danger?
Moreover, for them to sense danger, it had to be at least a demigod-level attack. But why would an attack of this level appear on Alliance Island? Not only did Legendary Wexy not discover it, but the defense facilities of Alliance Island also didn’t discover it?
Because this place wasn’t big, the Defense facilities were all maxed out, but it was even harder to invade than the borders of the seven countries!
“Master, according to my analysis, our perception might have been affected by my ‘Wind Blessing’ and caused me to make many predictions in advance,” Ling said after analyzing for a moment.
“However, the impact shouldn’t be too far from the real situation. The source of the threat should be on Alliance Island, and the other party has already locked onto you.”
“Are we escaping?”
The Wind Blessing involved time, space, and wind Stats. It was a divine skill of laws. Shi Yu and Ling themselves were protected by the Wind Blessing all year round. Ling thought for a moment and realized that this was the only situation.
Although the crisis they sensed didn’t descend, there was indeed a potential crisis threatening them.
“Escape…” Shi Yu was stunned.
Escape my ass!
He could already “beat” Emperor Wu. When he encountered danger, he couldn’t just think about escaping.
“You guys can’t discover anything?”
At this moment, Shi Yu was already urging Ling and Buggy.
However, in exchange, he only shook his head.
“Wu wu wu!! (The other party’s spatial attainments might be higher than mine.)” Buggy said.
Shi Yu gritted his teeth. Good heavens, who exactly was it that wanted to harm him on the Alliance Island?
Or could it be that the target wasn’t him, but the entire Alliance Island, but it would affect him?
Shi Yu couldn’t judge.
However, from the other party’s movements, he indeed had some skills. What method did he use?
“Not only is it higher than you, but it might even be one of the best among the demigods. It might even be a demigod who specializes in space. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so easy to enter the Alliance Island,” Shi Yu said.
In fact, judging from the characteristics of danger perception, Shi Yu felt that the other party was targeting him.
But he really couldn’t think of anyone who hated him so much.
Tyrant Dragon King? Yun An? Black Dragon Juggernaut? None of them looked like it. It was mainly because their spatial attainments weren’t that strong.
Could it be a revived spatial god? But he didn’t provoke anyone.
F*ck, don’t let him know who it was…
“No matter what, be prepared to deal with it with all your might first,” Shi Yu ordered everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1145 - 1145 Assassination from Yun An (3)
chapters.content:
1145 Assassination from Yun An (3)
As for whether he would really encounter danger…
Shi Yu was not very worried.
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, the other party should have used a Meld Skill that involves time space or borrowed resources that contain the power of time space. It’s not just spatial power, that’s why he hid so well.”
“Although my strength hasn’t completely recovered… I might be able to give it a try and find the other party’s location,” Qi suddenly said.
“Moreover, although the spatial power in your body isn’t enough to support one spatial travel, you should be able to dodge two fatal attacks with everyone.”
Shi Yu knew that Qi would definitely do it. After all, this was the little guy who could run the most in the Mythical Era. Even the three alien factions that invaded Blue Planet couldn’t do anything to her, let alone such an enemy.
Compared to slipping away from the Blue Sea Ruins now and giving up the Alliance Meet, Shi Yu also wanted to find the other party more and see who had ill intentions towards him.
If he didn’t figure out the other party’s identity, he would feel uncomfortable for a long time.
“Yes, I’ll leave it to you,” Shi Yu said. “Try to find the other party.”
If they dared to invade the Alliance Island, even if it was a demigod, they would make it impossible for the other party to return.
Although there weren’t many Legendarys here, there were more than ten titled legends and a bunch of forbidden machines. It was more than enough to farm a demigod.
At the same time, Shi Yu looked at President Lin Xiao in the distance and sent a voice transmission, “President Lin.”
“What’s wrong?” President Lin also sensed Shi Yu’s direction. Although he didn’t have a telepathy talent, at his level, he could completely use the power of his pet to communicate telepathically with Shi Yu.
“By the way, you did well just now. I feel that you can defeat these guys with those two second team pets. Haha… All the best.”
“Alright… President Lin, I have something to tell you.”
“Well, I seem to have been targeted by a mysterious demigod. The other party is on Alliance Island and successfully invaded this place. He’s hiding somewhere and I don’t know when he’ll attack me…”
“Of course, there’s also a certain chance that the other party’s goal is the entire Alliance Island.”
“I’m searching for its traces. In addition, I plan to continue letting Little Ji compete with Duckie to avoid alerting the enemy. We have to catch the other party this time. To be able to enter the Alliance Island without anyone noticing, leaving it alive is a disaster. Why don’t we take advantage of the crowd now and attack together to figure out the other party’s origin and goal?”
“Prepare in secret. It’s best if you can immediately contact the Legendarys of the seven countries. You can’t let anything happen to the Alliance Island, nor can you let anything happen to me.”
President Lin: “?”
….
In a special void, one, two, and three, a total of three spatial totem-level Yun clan sacrificial soldiers, were hiding in the sky above the Alliance Island with the “Heavenly Space Concealment Divine Stone” bestowed by Yun An.
They were specially cultivated by Yun An in order to kill Shi Yu. They mastered the explosive and self-destruction skills of sacrificing lives, as well as the three-in-one group connection skill, and referenced the forbidden Arms of humans.
If they attacked together, even a demigod would be in great danger. In order to get rid of Shi Yu, this big problem in his heart, Yun An could be said to have invested a lot.
In short, together with the Heavenly Space Concealment Divine Stone… Yun An’s three subordinates were enough to be called the strongest assassin team. Unfortunately, its own strength was too strong, and the Concealment Divine Stone couldn’t completely hide it. Otherwise, it would have to kill Shi Yu personally.
But forget it. After all, it was the Alliance Island. It was more dangerous. It was better to leave it to his subordinates.
Yun An followed his heart and directly chose to control it remotely.
At this moment, Yun An stared at the outside world through the eyes of the three sacrificial soldiers and said with a mental resonance, “Don’t be anxious, don’t be anxious. Before the power of the Concealment Divine Stone is exhausted, no one can discover you.”
“What you have to do is find the best opportunity. It’s best if he uses his Beast Taming Talent to fight others and launch a fatal attack when he consumes the most energy! Only then can we ensure that nothing goes wrong!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1146 Don't Think About Leaving Since You're Here (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1146  Don't Think About Leaving Since You're Here (1)
Knowing that a crisis was coming, Shi Yu's thoughts were instantly not on the Alliance Meeting.
Next, Qi secretly searched for the enemy's location. Shi Yu was also paying attention to the changes in his surroundings.
Shen Feng vs Ming Hua. The representatives of both parties decided the winner without summoning the reincarnation god. Therefore, in Shi Yu's eyes, it was a standard battle.
After the battle with Emperor Wu, his horizons had indeed increased. Although these people were titled legends of the strongest tier, pets were only at the overlord level in the end.
Moreover, it wasn't a Mythical Race at the overlord level. It was in a completely different dimension from Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others.
Boom!!!
On the mystic realm arena, under the witness of countless spectators, Reincarnator Ashaya's Netherworld Worm was suppressed by President Logan's Killer Bee mecha. It was blasted a thousand meters away by the Laser Cannon, and its worm body shattered.
"Cough." Ashaya took a step back and her expression turned ugly.
"Sorry." President Logan's calm voice came from inside the mecha.
"As expected of the Mechanical God of War," Ashaya said through gritted teeth.
After the battle between the two parties ended, Shen Feng's side was overjoyed, while Ming Hua's side sighed continuously.
"Reincarnator… Reincarnator, President Ashaya of Ming Hua is indeed special. I wonder if an ancient Legendary will revive like her in the future," Legendary Lightning Yi said in his heart as the black cell phone made a racket outside the venue.
He was not surprised that President Logan could defeat the other party.
In his opinion, only the representatives of Dong Huang, Rongguang, and Tingxiang could pose a threat to President Logan!
Dong Huang had a monster like Shi Yu, while Rongguang and Tingxiang were relatively lucky…
According to his information, these two countries had obtained the friendship and help of the reincarnation god!
"Thank you, President Logan and President Ashaya, for the peak battle you brought us."
"Sigh, I feel that I haven't seen enough at all, but next, there's going to be a new battle!" the black cell phone said.
Everyone started to look at the black cell phone again, waiting for it to draw the third round of battle.
At the moment, Dong Huang vs Xue Yuan, Shen Feng vs Ming Hua, Tingxiang, Rongguang, and the Seven Islands had never fought!
Although the rule this time was that every country would encounter the other six countries, which countries would collide first was still the focus of the audience.
"Could it be us?"
On Rongguang's side, an old man in a white suit spoke. He was the president of the Rongguang Beast Tamer Association. Beside him, an old man in a papal suit and an extremely handsome angel god watched everything calmly.
"No matter who we encounter, Lord Angel will lead us to victory." The Light Pope had already become the divine envoy of the Angel God and become a loyal lackey, henchman, and lapdog.
The old man in the white suit sighed in his heart. Sigh, with the revival of the Mythical stage, Rongguang would probably reverse history again and become a religious faction that was greater than everything.
"Mother, leave it to us."
On Tingxiang's side, the white-haired President Auland stared at the arena intently. Beside her, a green curly-haired female giant more than four meters tall who looked relatively young spoke.
Beast Tamer with a giant hybrid, Titled Legend Roland of Tingxiang!
Because she was a hybrid of a giant and had a longer lifespan, she looked relatively young, but her real age was not young.
Apart from that, she had another identity, the daughter of the president of the Tingxiang Association.
President Auland was relatively old among the presidents of the seven countries. Her condition was no longer at its peak. To everyone, it was not strange for her to be represented by her daughter, whose strength had exceeded her master.
"Please, it's not easy for our Rongguang to obtain the right to speak this time… We definitely can't disappoint Her Majesty." President Auland looked at her daughter and even at a certain god in her contract space.
The Frost Giant God that awakened its memories in Tingxiang, the embodiment of ice, happened to be one of her daughter's contracted giants!
The Tether established by both parties made the memories of the Giant God awaken. It was also willing to help Tingxiang and cooperate with Tingxiang to welcome the Mythical Era together.
"Leave it to me." The Frost Giant God's voice was cold.
That Logan, that Ashaya, and that Monkalov's pet wouldn't be its match.
Even if it was the mechanical dragon that inherited the power of the Earth Divine Dragon and the duck that inherited the Xuan Ming inheritance, it wasn't afraid. Although these two had also mastered quasi-divine skills, their foundation was too poor.
He just didn't know how the foundation of Shi Yu's other pets had improved. If the foundation wasn't good, he couldn't unleash all his strength even if he had high-quality divine skills.
The so-called foundation… was the proficiency of low-level, intermediate-level, high-level, and super Skills. These things could lead to the increase of all attributes…
"I'm afraid it's time to be reprimanded by Lord Martial God again." The president of the Seven Islands was a very strong, white-haired, white-bearded old man with a wide chest and yellow-brown skin covered in explosive muscles.
He was wearing a sleeveless black shirt and black formal pants. He still looked old and strong, but at this moment, his expression was not good. Be it Tingxiang or Rongguang… he was not confident.
Rongguang, one of the upper four countries, was already strong. Moreover, there was also information that the other party had obtained the help of the Angel God, and the originally weakest country, Tingxiang, was actually equally lucky.
This made the Seven Islands, who had yet to find the support of a suitable Mythical Race at the overlord level, very awkward.
At this moment, everyone was waiting for the results of the black cell phone draw… Finally…
"The results are out! Let me see…" The black cell phone projected onto the huge phantom in the air and directly randomized two names.

chapters.title: Chapter 1147 Don't Think About Leaving Since You're Here (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1147  Don't Think About Leaving Since You're Here (2)
"Uh…"
"Holy shit."
"Huh?"
"What's going on?"
As these two names appeared, Dong Huang's audience was stunned.
It was Rongguang vs Dong Huang.
"F*ck, is there a conspiracy!!!" In Dong Huang, the Prediction Owl watching the live broadcast at Imperial Capital University cursed.
It clearly predicted the Seven Islands vs Tingxiang.
How could it be Rongguang vs Dong Huang! There was a conspiracy! It was deliberately targeting its Great Dong Huang!
This draw result could be said to have stunned most people. President Logan, President Ashaya, Legendary Wex Yi, President Lin, who was just about to move, Shi Yu, who was secretly investigating, and the big boss of Rongguang were slightly stunned.
Especially Shi Yu.
"Well, the name list of every battle is random. It will only ensure that one side isn't allowed to fight continuously, but after one interval, it's not within the restrictions." The black cell phone explained, "Therefore, next, it's still Legend Shi Yu of Dong Huang who fights."
"And his opponent is His Holiness the Pope of the Church of Light in the Rongguang Nation, the Son of Light, Ralph!"
"Heh." On Rongguang's side, Ralph smiled. Beside him, the extremely handsome angel god, who was even slightly more handsome than Shi Yu, also looked down in surprise.
It was actually going to fight that Shi Yu so quickly?
Forget it.
In any case, the other party's two pets just now shouldn't be the strongest main force. The other party didn't use its Beast Taming Talent to consume its physical strength. It wasn't bullying this time.
"Shi Yu." President Lin, who was just about to leave to do things according to Shi Yu's instructions, looked at Shi Yu.
The opponent was not simple. If they wanted to fight, they would probably have to consume a lot of physical strength.
At that time, his condition would decrease. If there was really a crisis, he might be unable to resist!
"Hahahahaha, it's coming, it's coming. The angel beside that yellow-haired old man isn't simple. It can definitely make this Shi Yu fall into a bitter battle. The time to attack is coming soon." In the alternate space, Yun An, who had his consciousness possess him, was also overjoyed when he saw this.
He didn't expect the opportunity to come so quickly.
It suppressed its hatred and couldn't wait anymore.
However, in order to be foolproof, it still had to wait for Shi Yu to consume the greatest amount of energy before attacking!
At this moment, everyone was very surprised, especially those Beast Tamers who knew that the lineup of Rongguang this time was not simple. When they saw Rongguang meet Dong Huang so quickly, they couldn't help but lick their lips in anticipation.
Between a real reincarnated god and a god cultivated and created after birth, who was stronger?
"It's alright." And now, the lucky person, Shi Yu, shook his head helplessly and sent a voice transmission to President Lin.
"It's already checkmate."
"Crisis will no longer be a crisis."
He felt that he was really lucky.
Just now, he and Ling sensed an instant of threat again!!
Again!
This made Ling quickly deduce and analyze that the other party might want to attack at the moment when Shi Yu's battle consumption was the greatest.
Regarding the analysis of a top-notch think tank like Ling, Shi Yu quite acknowledged it. In his shoes, if he wanted to assassinate a target, he would definitely have to choose the time when the target was at its weakest Enfeeble.
However, what made Shi Yu feel lucky was not because Ling had analyzed this.
Qi was really very powerful.
Shi Yu originally thought that it might be a while before Qi could find the enemy.
However, not long after the battle between President Logan and President Ashaya ended, just as the black cell phone announced the new name list, Qi directly locked onto the other party!
He understood the other party's location and the other party's essence.
In Shi Yu's Beast Taming Space, the pink loli Qi carried Little Purple and sat on the star. Through the Beast Taming Space, her cherry-like eyes seemed to reflect the scene in another space.
"Shi Yu, it's actually the Yun Race. You're wrong! The correct answer was eliminated just now!"
"But it's not Yun An's main body. It should be its subordinate. It must have brought some super powerful tool. Otherwise, it couldn't have hidden so well."
In the face of Qi's discovery, Shi Yu was extremely silent.
Yun An…
This guy had come from the past to give his head away, and now from this time and space, he was here to give his head away. He was really something.
He didn't expect Yun An's hatred for him to be so deep. As soon as he received the news that he was coming to Alliance Island, he immediately came to assassinate him.
This was the highest holy land of humans.
Moreover, from the looks of it, the other party's preparations were very thorough. He actually hid it from everyone.
If not for the fact that the two helpers, the Time Sprite and the Luck Kirin, were around, Shi Yu felt that he would really have fallen for it.
[A top-notch totem and two Normal totems are both under Yun An. They're not strong, but since they can let us sense a life-and-death threat… That means that they have a killer move that can instantly heavily injure demigods and make demigods on the verge of death!]
Shi Yu thought for a moment. It was probably self-destruction. The modern Yun Race was researching forbidden Arms. Shi Yu knew this. If he wanted to maximize the energy efficiency, self-destruction was the best choice.
Yun An probably knew that even if the assassination was successful, its subordinates couldn't return, so the possibility of self-destruction increased again.
Shi Yu chuckled.
He was really not afraid of self-destruction.
In the past, in order to restrict Yun An's self-destruction, Buggy and Ling had practiced together for a long time. They could even temporarily suppress Yun An's self-destruction, let alone totems below the three demigods.
Since they were here, they couldn't leave.
Shi Yu thought that it was a demigod, but in the end, there were only a few of them. There was no need for President Lin to call a Legendary to save an opponent of this level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1148 - 1148 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (3)
chapters.content:
1148 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (3)
He could easily solve it himself.
Compared to being attacked passively, he still liked to take the initiative to attack.
Under everyone’s gaze, Shi Yu floated in the sky with his blue Psychic power again and flew to the arena.
At the same time, the Son of Light, Ralph, who was wearing a golden and white papal suit, also descended on the mystic realm arena in the holy light with Blink light.
In the holy light in front of him, the angel god also descended. At this moment, under the holy light, this angel god spread two pairs of incomparably dazzling wings of light, looking peerlessly handsome.
[Holy shit, angel, is that an angel?!]
[Rongguang really has an angel.]
[It’s very normal for the Light Pope to contract an angel, alright!]
[I heard that the battle power of angels even exceeds pure-blooded dragons. I wonder if it’s true!]
At this moment, as Shi Yu and Ralph appeared, especially when the contracted partner beside Ralph followed beside them, it instantly stunned many ordinary Beast Tamers who were watching the live broadcast.
“He actually appeared directly?” Many presidents present originally thought that the Angel God wouldn’t attack easily and would let Ralph’s other pets go first. Who knew that this god would take the initiative to go on stage?
“My name is Frostus.” After the angel god saw Shi Yu, he introduced himself and said, “Your potential is indeed not bad among humans. No wonder the World Tree chose you.”
“As a god who has existed since the Mythical Era, I also want to personally verify your potential like Ancient God Golden Bull and the others.”
“I look forward to fighting you.”
“Yes, legend Shi Yu, Lord Frostus and I will fight you with all our might,” the Son of Light, Ralph, said.
“Ah, ah, ah, ah.” At this moment, the black cell phone looked at the angel god, Frostus, in shock and said, “You, are you a reincarnated god!!”
Frostus didn’t say anything, but the Son of Light, Ralph, nodded and said, “Lord Frostus is a divine-level Warrior of the Angel Race in the Mythical Era. After experiencing the calamity of the Mythical Era and constantly reincarnating, I was lucky to be chosen by Lord Frostus.”
“Both of us have concluded a divine contract, so we can fight at the same time.”
The black cell phone was shocked. “An angel god?”
In Rongguang, countless basic believers of the Divine Church of Light were shocked. Their pope actually contracted an angel god from the Mythical Era?!
Although they trusted the pope very much, the power Shi Yu had displayed just now was too terrifying. They couldn’t help but be a little worried.
But now, when they learned that their pope had actually contracted a god with the god believed in by the Church and could fight side by side, they instantly felt stunned. Was this the so-called Mythical Revival!
Perhaps he could win.
“Alright.” In the face of the invitation of the Rongguang Pope and the Angel God, Shi Yu agreed immediately.
However, at this moment, he said right on the heels of that, “However, can you give me a minute?”
Shi Yu looked at the sky.
“What?” Shi Yu’s words completely confused Ralph and the angel god.
It also surprised the presidents of the various associations and Legendary Wex Yi, who was sitting high up.
What did it mean?
Give him a minute?
What was Shi Yu doing?
The audience in front of the live broadcast was also stunned. Could it be that Shi Yu had yet to rest and was still a minute away? It was just like the cooldown time of the game Skill!
But clearly, they were overthinking.
Although Shi Yu, who was looking at the sky, said to give him a minute to fight, he still summoned his pet!
Boom!!!
A black summoning array surrounded by orange flames appeared beside Shi Yu.
Shi Yu stretched out his hand and directly reached for the summoning array. Then, he slowly pulled it out in the air. A shocking heat wave spewed out, and a red divine sword was slowly pulled out of the Beast Taming Space and appeared in Shi Yu’s hand.
This scene stunned most people.
Wait a minute?
This, wasn’t this that sword spirit?
Dong Huang immediately exploded.
[Holy shit, who said Shi Yu canceled the contract with the sword spirit? Who is it? Step forward. I promise I won’t kill you. What’s with the random tempo? It clearly wasn’t canceled!]
[No, the one who was sacrificed to contract the new Mechanical Illusion God and the Abyss demigod reincarnation isn’t that sword spirit?? Could it be another Mechanical Illusion God?]
[Impossible, so annoying. I can’t guess…]
It could be said that just now, everyone was still certain that Shi Yu had most likely replaced the sword spirit, but at this moment, they were stunned.
It didn’t make sense. This sword spirit was the reincarnation of a hybrid bloodline of a titled legend. Although it was very strong, it couldn’t even be considered a demigod reincarnation. How could it not be the one replaced?
“What do you want to do!!!” The people watching the live broadcast couldn’t sense anything, but Ralph, who was very close to Shi Yu, and even the Angel God sensed the terrifying power contained in the sword spirit.
Outside the arena, countless gazes focused on Shi Yu.
In the alternate space, the Yun clan assassin, who saw Shi Yu looking at the sky slightly, suddenly felt his heart skip a beat. Even Yun An had a bad feeling.
In the next moment, Shi Yu’s voice sounded. At the same time, he entered a possession state.
The fiery red flames lingering on its body dyed its black hair and eyes red. When it turned into red hair and red eyes, its voice also fell, cold and emotionless.
“It’s nothing. It’s just that an extraterrestrial totem has invaded the Alliance Island and is plotting something. In order to avoid them disturbing the competition, it’s better to deal with them first.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, everyone was in an uproar. The black cell phone paused and instantly looked at the empty sky. In front of the live broadcast, countless spectators were instantly at a loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 1149 - 1149 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (4)
chapters.content:
1149 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (4)
What??
Before they could react, Yun An was already shocked.
“Impossible!!!” In the alternate space, after being stunned, Yun An roared in confusion.
He was discovered? How was that possible!
In the next moment, Shi Yu, who was holding an immortal sword, waved his sword at the sky. Then, right on the heels of that, an incomparably dazzling sword light of red, blue, white, and black seemed to have broken through the darkness like a divine judgment. With a crack, it shattered the Void!
A shocking sword intent enveloped the entire Alliance Island.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s Myriad Sword Convergence was with Shi Yu. In the undead space, the imprisoned totem undead endured a huge burden and cried out.
