At the same time, Shi Yu’s aura directly approached the limit of a real demigod. His instant battle power might have already exceeded a weak demigod like the Heavenly Sword Ancient Nation.
This was the peak state that a sword spirit that had evolved with two divine-level resources could reach after possessing three divine-level resources to strengthen itself.
Among the monsters like the Chaos Panda, the Green Dragon, the World Ginseng, the Blue Sea Sprite, and the Luck Divine Beast, they could also easily take down the most terrifying battle power state of the team’s first place with an absolute advantage.
Under the extremely shocked surroundings and even the Angel God, Shi Yu and the others directly successfully shattered the alternate space hidden by the Meteorite assassin under Qi’s guidance. At this moment, the sky tore apart, and the world seemed to have been divided into two.
In the eyes of the audience, space shattered almost instantly. Then, right on the heels of that, in the sky, the extraterrestrial totem Shi Yu mentioned appeared in front of everyone!!
In the shattered sky, it was pitch-black. Three poisonous beasts with extremely terrifying forms that emitted an Unholy aura and oppressive radiation were completely revealed in the sky above Alliance Island.
The black cell phone looked at the sky in shock. It had no idea when these guys had invaded. At this moment, through the live broadcast screen, people everywhere could see their terrifying faces.
A huge centipede more than a thousand meters long with at least a thousand feet and a black golden body that looked like it had been watered by ink was wriggling in the black clouds, its terrifying red eyes looking at the ground.
A scarlet-black scorpion-shaped creature was like the Sky Demon God. Black mist lingered around a huge tail spike and huge scorpion pincer, like a terrifying Arms that could destroy a city. It swayed in front of its body.
Between them, a huge calamity spider that seemed to be the embodiment of disaster and plague with eyes as deep as a pure black hole was already in an attack posture. In its mind, the will of the King of the Yun Race, Yun An, was crazily transmitted.
Destruction! Destruction!! Destruction of everything!!!
Yun An, who was extremely far away, was so frightened by Shi Yu that its heart was about to jump out. It really didn’t understand how Shi Yu discovered them. After all, before this, it had even taken other demigods and even let its subordinates enter the Alliance Island to practice in advance.
In the end, indeed, no one discovered any traces of the Yun clan assassin who had relied on the power of the Concealment Divine Stone. Even demigods couldn’t, but in this situation, how exactly did Shi Yu discover it?
At this moment, Yun An no longer cared about anything. He directly let the three assassins launch a suicide self-destruction attack. He no longer cared about the Effect and immediately activated it!
“You hid it very well. Don’t hide it again next time.”
As Shi Yu held the immortal sword tightly, the bodies of the three incomparably huge poisonous creatures had already swelled to an even greater extent in a short period of time. A shocking black light and black mist bloomed from their bodies, causing their energy to increase steadily.
Almost in an instant, every one of their auras reached the peak. An ominous wave bloomed from their bodies, as if it came from the endless malice in the hearts of intelligent life. The incomparable aura made the presidents of the various associations get up with a whoosh, and also made Legendary Wexy instantly feel as if he was facing a great enemy, revealing a shocked expression.
Invaders.
It was really as Shi Yu had said. There was a totem invader.
Moreover, from the current situation, they were plotting against the Alliance Island!
Self-destruction!
They were preparing to self-destruct!
The energy fluctuations erupting from each of them were no longer inferior to the attack of a demigod.
Three terrifying energies intertwined. Even demigods would be heavily injured. If they didn’t defend, their lives would be in danger.
If it was just three totems, coming here was courting death.
However, if three totems courting death came here, it could indeed disgust everyone.
No one was willing to take the self-destruction of a totem-level eruption head-on.
“Not good!!!” In the current state of the three sacrificial totems, even touching them would detonate them. Be it the Angel God, the presidents of the various associations, or Legendary Wexy, everyone felt threatened by this ominous aura.
In an instant, they used various methods to protect themselves, escape, or defend.
Everything happened in an extremely short period of 0.1 seconds. Just as everyone was trying their best to dodge this terrorist attack, only Shi Yu, who had prepared in advance, directly welcomed it. The other party was targeting him, so he naturally couldn’t let anything happen to the Alliance Island.
Buzz!!!
With the sword spirit in hand, when shocking sword intent shot out of Shi Yu’s eyes, he used the item of faith to cover the four holy domains of the entire Alliance Island. A huge barrier had long been instantly intertwined.
Boom!!
In an instant, under the perception of countless experts with widened eyes, for some reason, the self-destruction power of the three totems that burned their lives and activated their greatest strength to self-destruct was instantly suppressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1150 - 1150 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (5)
chapters.content:
1150 Don’t Think About Leaving Since You’re Here (5)
“What?”
What did Shi Yu do?
Everyone suddenly looked at Shi Yu, who was in the center of the domain.
He held the sword spirit and said extremely calmly,
“Did I let you die?”
“Go.”
The sword in Shi Yu’s hand shot out like a thunderclap. The sword light swayed and kept expanding. In the blink of an eye, it turned into four sword projections that hung in the sky. The four swords, Immortal Slaying, Immortal Extermination, and Immortal Trap, appeared around the three Yun clan assassins. The Immortal Slaying Sword Formation immediately formed.
Buzz!!!
At this moment, it was as if the world had trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared. The spatial power and natural power in the domain were all suppressed again.
The air buzzed and vibrated, and the Void was pierced. The sound of laws was like the cry of a sword, like a peerless divine sword about to be unsheathed and slaughter the world.
“Quasi-divine skill!” Countless experts were shocked. That sword spirit had also evolved into a Mythical Race? It was f*cking ridiculous, even stronger than its predecessor?
“Wu!!!” Before anyone could react, in the next moment, extremely terrifying mixed sword intent broke out of the four immortal swords and penetrated space. Like dazzling light needles, they intertwined on the three huge totems, making indescribable wails come from their bodies.
“Yun An, you’re courting death.” Shi Yu’s words seemed to be talking to someone. Boom!!
Space distorted and shattered. The entire sky seemed to have turned into a world of swords. Countless sword shadows leaped, forming tens of thousands of divine swords that hung in the sky, causing the sword fluctuations here to shake the sky and earth.
Even reincarnation gods like the Angel God and the Giant God felt the power of the sword intent, and their pupils constricted at the same time, their hearts trembling.
Through Shi Yu’s mental resonance, the sword that sacrificed the two totem-level scapegoats already had the initial qualifications to hurt demigods. It was almost a crushing power for anyone below the demigod level.
This power… stunned the angel god and giant god, who were still confident of fighting Shi Yu just now.
He felt that the strengthening strength of the level-eight Beast Tamer he contracted was not even half as terrifying as these two guys’ fusion.
Was this really a post-deity race and a level-seven human? In an instant, they thought this was bullshit.
Under the illumination of the sword light, the bodies of the three Yun clan totems were instantly sliced into black blood mist that filled the sky under everyone’s stunned expressions. Then, even the blood mist was obliterated by the sword intent and was directly slashed into incomplete corpses, leaving behind souls that were still wailing. They were swallowed into the endless sword world, extremely miserable.
[Shi Yu, you’re courting death!!!] In the endless distance, cracks suddenly appeared on Yun An’s body. He widened his eyes and erupted in anger again.
Why, why, why! Wu wu wu wu wu wu!!
This damn human!!
“I have to get rid of Yun An as soon as possible.” At the same time, Shi Yu felt a crisis.
He felt that Yun An probably wouldn’t let the matter rest.
And now, after Shi Yu’s battle, not only did he not consume the scapegoat, but he also obtained another one. He couldn’t help but be a little happy.
In less than a minute, Shi Yu successfully defeated the three invasion totems. He raised his hand, and the sword light in the sky flashed. The sword spirit returned to Shi Yu’s hand.
On Alliance Island, countless people had yet to react. They seemed to have recovered their calm, but in everyone’s hearts, including the new Legendary, Legendary Wexy, their hearts instantly rolled right on the heels of the heels.
He looked at Shi Yu in the arena.
What… Did he do? Everyone admitted that they were shocked just now, but not only did Shi Yu calmly use some unknown method to restrict the other party’s self-destruction, but he also instantly insta-killed three totems?!
The destructive power of that Skill… Everyone’s pupils constricted. When they recalled it, their Spirit felt like it was being pricked by needles.
Shi Yu said, “The invader, one of the three invading races of the Mythical Era, the totem half-god of the Abyss Race, Yun An. Those were just totem death warriors under it.”
“Apart from personal grudges, it looks like the other party doesn’t want to see Blue Planet’s factions successfully form an alliance.”
“But now, there shouldn’t be any threat.”
Damn, Yun An hid far enough. Shi Yu couldn’t help but complain about Yun An’s guts in his heart. However, with the three undead just now, he should be able to continue locking onto Yun An.
“Do you still want to continue the battle?” The red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu looked at the Rongguang Pope and the Angel God opposite him. At this moment, the Angel God’s eyes were still reflecting the sword light just now. Its pupils continued to constrict. What a joke!
The current it didn’t understand why Shi Yu, who was in the state of the Sword Spirit Possession, had strength almost comparable to a demigod.
Didn’t this guy feel any burden from the terrifying attack just now?!!
At that moment, everyone saw what was going on clearly. Three totem-level beasts from outer space attacked Alliance Island. Shi Yu… insta-killed three totems that had erupted to the extreme with a sword move!!
It wasn’t just the presidents of the various associations who had incomprehensible thoughts. There was also the new Legendary, Legendary Wexy, and even President Lin, who was stunned on the spot.
At this moment, the corners of President Lin’s mouth twitched incomparably. When Shi Yu told him that he was in danger just now, he was indeed shocked, but now, he was also shocked. What was wrong with this sword spirit’s skill? Why was it so powerful!!
Boom!!!
At this moment, opposite Shi Yu, the angel god Frostus couldn’t help but erupt with powerful energy. “Why is there an abyssal faction invading?”
“Those three totems just now were sent by a guy named Yun An, right?” It looked at the Rongguang Pope.
“Now is not the time to hold any Alliance Meeting. Hurry up and mobilize everyone to find that Yun An. It must not be far away.”
It wasn’t afraid, but there were priorities.
“Yes!!” The Rongguang Pope had only just recovered from the shock of the suicide self-destruction attack of the three totems. It could be said that every life present instantly sensed the same danger as Shi Yu.
They were extremely afraid now.
Especially Legendary Wexy. After the lingering fear, he was even more furious. That Yun An actually dared to invade while he was presiding over the Alliance Island.
What nonsense Alliance Meeting was this? How could it continue smoothly at this time?
This was Yun An’s provocation to him. After advancing to the Legendary level, he had never defeated a demigod. He wanted this Yun An.
Legendary Wex Yi aimed at the black cell phone and said, “Inform the seven countries. I’m very sorry. An unexpected situation occurred at the Alliance Meeting. From now on, the Alliance Meeting is temporarily suspended. At the same time, I’m issuing a wanted order to the world to hunt the Yun Race. There’s no restriction on life and death.”
Many people were still trapped in the attack just now. After constantly grunting, they suddenly realized that Shi Yu had done many terrifying things.
Especially on Dong Huang’s side, Ji Mengzhu, who was watching the live broadcast, was already stunned.
Was the Yun Race totem that easy to kill?
“What’s wrong with this kid?” No matter how slow the experts of the various countries present were, they could sense that Shi Yu had resolved a shocking crisis just now. Not only did he resolve it, but he was the first to discover it.
That move just now directly made Logan, Ashaya, President Monkalov, and the others realize how terrifying Shi Yu was. Was this guy a monster? How could his growth speed be so ridiculous? It had only been half a year, but he already had strength comparable to a demigod!!
Even Legendary Wexy was filled with fear towards Shi Yu in this state. As a Legendary and the Blesser of the World Tree, he should have been the most orthodox savior of Blue Planet, but what was going on with this Shi Yu!
In short, what was the point of fighting? It could be said that the Beast Tamers representing the few countries didn’t want to fight Shi Yu in that state at all.
Alliance Meeting, stop, stop! The most important thing was to completely eliminate the threat first!
“Do you want to hunt Yun An?” At this moment, Shi Yu saw that the angel god had decisively stopped fighting. Seeing that Legendary Wexy immediately wanted Yun An out of fear and even stopped the Alliance Meeting, he couldn’t help but leave his possession form.
“When I was detaining the souls of the three death warriors just now, I learned that that guy is in another hemisphere. It might not be easy to catch him now.”
Then, he looked at the silent President Lin in the distance. It meant that the Alliance Meeting was stopped by all parties together. It wasn’t caused by him. He already wanted to compete seriously, but from the looks of it, the various countries didn’t want to fight anymore. They all wanted to hunt Yun An?
We can’t let them succeed. We have to hurry.
“You…”
The corners of President Lin’s mouth twitched as he looked at the innocent-looking Shi Yu. The other countries instantly didn’t want to fight the Alliance Meeting. Didn’t he know why?

chapters.title: Chapter 1151 - 1151 Abyss Attack
chapters.content:
1151 Abyss Attack
Alliance Island was in chaos.
Although Shi Yu had already killed the three Yun clan totems that carried out the terrorist attack and knew that there were no longer any Yun clan totems around, from the perspective of others, he couldn’t relax at all.
Apart from Shi Yu, no one had discovered the attack just now. No one could guarantee that there wouldn’t be a second and third attack next. A huge hole had already appeared in the Alliance Island’s security system!
Legendary Wexy, who was currently presiding over the Alliance Island, immediately stopped the Alliance Meeting and let all the forces on the island strengthen their security to search for Yun An’s traces. This was the best choice to deal with the risks.
The audience of the various countries looked at the suddenly dark scene and looked at each other. As their hearts beat crazily, they realized that they might have seen a very impressive scene.
The Alliance Meeting, which was originally fine, had to be interrupted because of the attack. The information brought directly made the Beast Tamers of the various countries have an intense discussion.
[Did you hear that? These three guys don’t want to see the successful establishment of the Blue Star Alliance and come to cause trouble!]
[Although the presidents of the various countries have just finished introducing the reason for the destruction of the Mythical Era and the goal of the Blue Planet Alliance to resist the possible alien invasion civilization, I didn’t expect that they would be attacked by the remaining factions of the other party in the blink of an eye.]
The people in this world were quite accepting of extraterrestrial life forms. A long time ago, Blue Planet had already proven the existence of extraterrestrial life forms.
The threat of extraterrestrial life had always been a very popular setting in major movies. However, this time, it was completely confirmed by the officials of the seven countries.
Of course, in this official announcement, the Seven Nation Alliance didn’t introduce the horror of the three invading factions. They only said that they were the defeated parties who invaded Blue Planet and had long been defeated by the Blue Planet Divine Spirit. However, there was still a possibility of reviving and making a comeback. The establishment of the Blue Planet Alliance was to resist this invasion a second time.
In the second Mythical Era, one couldn’t rely on the returning gods for everything. They had to rely on themselves.
Therefore, not only did such a statement not make the citizens of the various countries panic, but it also stimulated the morale of the various countries.
The Mythical Era had descended, and the path to godhood had been opened. The gods of the Mythical Era could protect Blue Planet, so the current human Beast Tamers could also protect their homes. This was the point of view that the Seven Nation Alliance had mainly publicized to the various countries.
[Have you noticed…]
[When the three monsters invaded just now, the faces of the Holy Emperor and the Angel God turned green. They had panicked expressions, but who knew that legend Shi Yu would insta-kill the three monsters in the next second? The Angel God’s expression was stunned. Who said that legend Shi Yu might not necessarily be able to defeat the Angel God just now?? Why do I feel that the Angel God of Rongguang was changing the topic just now? It’s afraid and doesn’t want to fight!]
[I finally understand what legend Shi Yu meant by “give me a minute”. Holy shit, the invaders must have been stunned. They’ve already successfully invaded the Alliance Island, but they were still pulled out. How strong is legend Shi Yu? Looking at the appearance of the others, they didn’t discover anything at all, including Legendary Wexy.]
[Are those three really “totem-level creatures”? Why do I feel that it’s as easy as breathing for legend Shi Yu to kill them? In the records, only legendary-level creatures can crush totem-level creatures like this.]
[What’s the name of that sword formation just now? I don’t understand. Is that the sword spirit you mentioned just now that was eliminated and replaced by Shi Yu?]
The various countries were in an uproar. Shi Yu’s name directly spread to the various countries again with this short live broadcast. Most people didn’t watch the World Tournament, but this Alliance Meeting was a battle that everyone really saw.
Shi Yu, the strongest in the younger generation, not only easily defeated the president of the Snowfield Association, but he also easily insta-killed the three totems that made the Reincarnation God’s face turn green, directly letting Shi Yu ascend to the altar.
Apart from that, the Beast Tamers of the various countries also felt that a storm was coming. It was rare for totems to attack the Alliance Island. Usually, such a big event was the fuse of the totem war in history!
Recently, the intersection between the seven countries and the totem country had indeed been too frequent. Be it the World Tournament or this attack, it made the members of the various countries smell the aura of war.
At that moment, without the Alliance Meeting to watch, everyone could only pay attention to the final statement issued by Legendary Wexy on behalf of the Seven Nation Alliance. The Seven Nation Alliance wanted to crusade against the hunting totem half-god Yun An!
The last recorded record of the Seven Nation Alliance vs the totem half-god was before the Alliance was established. The Mechanical Legendarys used divine forbidden-type forbidden Arms to kill the totem half-gods. This time…
After more than a hundred years, the Human Alliance finally declared war on a totem demigod again?
Moreover, it was a demigod creature of an invading faction. What would the outcome be? The seven countries had just introduced the invading faction when Yun An ran out to show off his existence. It could be said that if they didn’t deal with this Yun An who destroyed the establishment of the Blue Star Alliance, it would be very difficult for the Blue Star Alliance to continue smoothly. The other totem countries would doubt the ability of the Seven Nation Alliance.
….
On Alliance Island, the experts of many countries gathered and surrounded Shi Yu.
Although ordinary people didn’t know, these experts knew that Yun An was also wanted by Shi Yu.
After the incident in the Heavenly Sword Nation, Yun An issued a must-kill order to Shi Yu in anger. At that time, the various countries were still very surprised, so they judged that it was very likely that Yun An was here for Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152 - 1152 Abyss Attack (2)
chapters.content:
1152 Abyss Attack (2)
No, or rather, it could both kill Shi Yu and destroy the establishment of the Blue Planet Alliance. This attack killed two birds with one stone.
“Legend Shi Yu, how did you discover them?” Legendary Wexy quickly descended beside Shi Yu.
Around Shi Yu, including the Light Pope and the Angel God, a group of experts felt a lingering fear.
They weren’t afraid of facing the totems head-on, but if the three totems really succeeded and launched a self-destruction sneak attack, even they would find it very troublesome.
Moreover, the Alliance Island would definitely suffer huge losses.
Shi Yu in front of him…
Everyone was shocked. It was actually so ridiculously strong. Not only was its perception shocking, but it also killed totems like chickens.
The three totems just now even used an explosive Skill before self-destructing. The surrounding energy fluctuations approached the peak of a top-notch totem. Such surging energy would explode any Beast Tamer below the Legendary and demigod level, but such a terrifying power fluctuation was instantly suppressed and obliterated by the sword formation.
Looking at Shi Yu, who had retracted his sword spirit, they simply looked at him as if they were looking at a monster.
“Danger perception.” Shi Yu looked at Legendary Wexy and said, “The other party’s killing intent is very strong.”
“But they carry hidden divine-level tools. It’s indeed difficult to find.”
Legendary Wexy’s expression turned cold. “No matter what, I have to thank you this time. If it weren’t for you, the Alliance Island would definitely have been heavily injured.”
Legendary Wexy said, “You just said that it’s in another hemisphere. Do you know its location? Do you have any other information?”
“This guy is arrogant enough to attack the Alliance. We have to make it pay a heavy price.”
“I killed the soul of the other party’s totem and saw some memories. Yun An’s main body isn’t nearby, but very far away. It’s probably already very difficult to find the other party now,” Shi Yu said.
“No matter what, I hope that legend Shi Yu can provide the coordinates of Yun An that you know,” Legendary Wexy said.
“I didn’t protect it well this time. I’ll seek justice for Sir Shi Yu.”
“This Yun An deserves to die.” The titled legends of the various countries expressed their views. No matter what, Yun An had indeed threatened their life interests this time.
Regarding this cosmic monster that came from outer space and forced Emperor Dong Huang to death, they also wanted to get rid of it very much now. At the same time, they also wanted to capture and study it. From the looks of it, this Yun An contained a big secret.
It was a very good way to understand outer space. They couldn’t be absent from the battle to hunt Yun An.
“Legend Shi Yu, we need its information,” President Logan and the others said.
Even the Angel God of Glory felt that they should capture this creature of the Abyss Race alive and see what mission it had to descend to Blue Planet 10,000 years ago.
“Sure.” Seeing this, Shi Yu naturally had no problem saying. However, he didn’t think that the other party could successfully find Yun An. If the current Yun An still stayed on the spot, it would be really stupid.
“Thank you. In addition, according to what I know, Yun An has a bounty on you and issued a must-kill order, right?”
“Next, I hope Sir Shi Yu can stay on Alliance Island. I’ll give Sir Shi Yu the highest level of protection,” Legendary Wexy said.
“Protect me?” Shi Yu looked at Legendary Wexy and looked at him playfully. “Really?”
If they could protect him, where would they have gone just now?
Legendary Wexy choked. He wanted to keep Shi Yu mainly because he wanted to use Shi Yu as bait to attract Yun An to Alliance Island, but when Shi Yu said that, he was immediately speechless.
From the battle performance just now, this Shi Yu had completely exceeded the level of “legend”. Legends, including Normal legends and Titled legends.
Even if it was him, if he could know in advance about the Yun clan’s attack and whether he could do as well as Shi Yu just now, Legendary Wexy wasn’t very confident.
But no matter what, he couldn’t let Yun An continue. Firstly, Yun An’s power was very special. He could actually modify so many special totems. It was very attractive to Legendary Wexy and Shen Feng, who were expert creatures.
The second thing was that Yun An actually dared to provoke him. Legendary Wexy’s appearance at the Alliance Meeting was also the will of the Shen Feng Nation. As a new Legendary and a legend who had the blessings of the World Tree, in theory, he was the most suitable existence to become the savior of Blue Planet recognized by the current World Tree.
Shen Feng wanted to use Legendary Wexy to fight for the right to speak in the Blue Planet Alliance.
Although Shen Feng took a fancy to the outcome of this Alliance Meeting, she didn’t take a fancy to it that much. Most importantly, it was still Wexy Legendary’s identity and strength.
However, Shen Feng never expected that not only would Legendary Wexy be slapped in the face by the invading faction during the Alliance Meeting, but he would also let Shi Yu, the later Blesser of the World Tree, show off.
This was very disadvantageous to Shen Feng’s vision of obtaining the dominance of the Alliance.
If Legendary Wexy wanted to regain his image as a leader, he had to deal with this attack appropriately. It was best if he personally captured or killed Yun An.
Ever since he advanced to the Legendary level, he had never fought a demigod. Although the Yun clan attack this time was troublesome, Legendary Wexy also realized that it was an opportunity.
As long as he could kill this invading demigod, his reputation as a savior would be even more confirmed.
However, from the looks of it, Shi Yu didn’t plan to cooperate with him. Legendary Wexy’s eyelids twitched as he looked at the young man in front of him who made him feel threatened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153 - 1153 Abyss Attack (3)
chapters.content:
1153 Abyss Attack (3)
“The Alliance Island will activate the highest protective facilities. At least, this place will be the safest next. If you kill Yun An’s subordinates, its revenge will definitely not stop, but will be even fiercer,” Legendary Wexy said.
“There’s no need to trouble Legendary Wexy,” Shi Yu said. “Yun An wants to kill me, and I also want to kill Yun An. Next, I’ll take the initiative to attack and hunt Yun An.”
“What?” Legendary Wexy was extremely stunned. The other countries were also extremely stunned.
Shi Yu actually said that he wanted to hunt demigods?
The world already knew that Yun An had once forced Emperor of Dong Huang to death and hunted the Heavenly Sword half-god. It could be said that Yun An was an extremely ferocious half-god.
In addition, it was an invading race. It could be said to have a reputation like a demon god.
Even the totem-level sacrificial soldiers he created were so threatening, and his main body was still so careful. He was simply Blue Planet’s greatest worry at the moment.
The power Shi Yu displayed just now was indeed terrifying, but don’t tell them that the current Shi Yu already had the ability to kill demigods! Why was this guy so confident?
After all, even legendary and demigod-level battle power could only resist, defeat, and not kill demigods.
It was too difficult to kill demigods, especially elemental demigods like Yun An, who had clearly studied forbidden weapons of humans. There were very few divine forbidden weapons that could counter the other party. Even if they used divine forbidden weapons, they might not necessarily be able to easily defeat the other party. Even if Legendary Wexy himself wanted to deal with Yun An, he planned to use the power of forbidden weapons.
“Dong Huang won’t let Yun An off.” At this moment, President Lin also walked out and said, “There’s no need to trouble Legendary Wexy. Finding Yun An is very important. I don’t think we should waste time here next.”
“…Then let’s work hard together.” Legendary Wexy’s eyelids twitched again as he looked at President Lin.
He had almost forgotten that behind Shi Yu was also a superpower.
Everyone’s conversation ended here. Shi Yu turned and left with President Lin.
President Lin said, “What were you talking about just now? You want to take the initiative to find Yun An??”
President Lin admitted that Shi Yu’s battle power just now shocked him very much, but wasn’t it still too difficult to take the initiative to find Yun An?
Unless there was Divine Source Legendary and the Dragon God together. It was worth a try.
Shi Yu: “President Lin, hurry up the investigation of the Dong Huang border first to prevent Yun An from flying into a rage out of humiliation and using Dong Huang as an attack target.”
“Although attacking Dong Huang directly without any targeting is not beneficial to Yun An at all, considering that its emotions might not necessarily be stable after this loss, you have to be careful.”
“It’s best to wake Senior Divine Source up from its sleep for a period of time. With its protection, Dong Huang will be foolproof,” Shi Yu said.
President Lin said, “The methods of the Yun Race this time are indeed extraordinary. They actually dodged the detection of the Alliance Island and hid from everyone present. If it really wants to take revenge and can use similar methods, the seven countries probably can’t afford such a battle of attrition.”
No country could maintain the highest level of defense at all times. The consumption of resources was too high.
“My problem, don’t worry. My battle power is far more than that. Yun An won’t live long. Go and awaken the Divine Source Legendary and find the Dragon God. I’ll see if I can use the three undead that contain Yun An’s power to track Yun An’s specific coordinates. If it succeeds, we have to counterattack immediately.”
“At least, we can’t let Yun An fall into the hands of other countries. It has very high research value. It’s an important channel for Dong Huang to understand outer space. It has to take the lead,” Shi Yu said.
“In short, give me a week to take a look. I want to search Blue Planet carpet-style and cooperate with Ling and Chi Tong to find Yun An’s traces.”
President Lin was stunned. “Tell me, it’s only been half a year. How much has your strength increased?”
Shi Yu smiled. “It won’t be weaker than ordinary new Legendarys. It might not be comparable to Emperor Wu at his peak, but with Susu and the Blue Sea Ruins, Yun An is no threat to me.”
“Moreover…”
Shi Yu looked at President Lin and said, “I want to enter seclusion while my pets help search for Yun An and try to break through to level eight. If I succeed, I think I can really have legendary battle power.”
….
Then, the seven countries mobilized together.
The Alliance Meeting ended and a global arrest warrant was issued for the Yun clan. This arrest warrant was not only for the Beast Tamers of the seven countries, but also for some demigods of the totem country.
After all, Yun An was an invading race. Firstly, it was to warn the other totem countries not to take Yun An in. Secondly, it hoped that the other party could clear its position and stand on the big side of Blue Planet to share information with the prototype Blue Planet Alliance.
At this moment, Shi Yu was also in seclusion and meditating in the Blue Sea Ruins. Ling’s clone began to circle Blue Planet and cooperate with technological methods to search for Yun An as much as possible.
In the end, not long after Shi Yu cultivated, Ling sent news.
A totem faction ignored the warnings of the seven countries and reached a cooperation with Yun An!
However, this faction was not a native faction of Blue Planet.
The power of the Abyss Sea reappeared! An ancient Abyss half-god revived and seemed to have formed a cooperative relationship with Yun An!!
The two demigods joined forces and destroyed a small sea totem country together. Including humans and other lives, tens of millions of lives died overnight, and the world trembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1154 - 1154 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer
chapters.content:
1154 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer
Wave Nation.
On the sea totem island.
The level of human civilization inside was not high. There were only scattered Hordes, even inferior to the Heavenly Sword Nation.
However, there were still tens of millions of transcendent lives living on it, involving various races.
Overnight, the Wave Nation was destroyed. Death aura enveloped the sky and shot into the stars, shocking the world. President Lin was furious.
This was because the Wave Nation was the first batch of totem factions to respond to Dong Huang and establish the Blue Planet Alliance.
Their totem guardians, like the Endless Sea and the Ghost Sea, trusted the Blue Sea Sprite more.
In the end, before they could enjoy the protection of the Blue Star Alliance, they encountered a huge crisis.
Many countries rushed to the scene to take a look and discovered that the Wave Nation and the surrounding sea area had already turned into a plague death ground. The virus radiation made this place a forbidden zone for life.
Shi Yu was also searching for Yun An’s location all over the world. When he received the news, he came to the sky above the Wave Nation with Ling and the others and looked at the dead island in silence.
The situation here was even more dangerous than the Undying Dark Phoenix’s Undead Battlefield. If weak creatures came into contact with it, they would probably instantly become Metamorphosis, so it was immediately set as a forbidden area by the Alliance.
This remnant power was extremely similar to the sign of the appearance of the Abyss Sea.
According to the speculation of the Alliance’s Astrologer Master, according to the results of the field inspection, the destruction of the country this time was suspected to be the reappearance of the laws of the Abyss Sea’s Elder Gu half-god, who had reached a cooperation with Yun An.
Unfortunately, these two demigods appeared and disappeared quickly. After devouring the creatures of the Wave Nation, they left behind a sentence and immediately disappeared.
“Blue Planet Alliance, hand over Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite.”
“Otherwise, this is only the beginning.”
This time, they weren’t just here to target Shi Yu.
At the same time, a single action made the Blue Planet Alliance, which had just formed, even more dangerous.
Now, many small totem countries were in danger. Like the Wave Nation, many small totem factions that responded to the seven human countries to establish the Blue Planet Alliance were extremely afraid. They suspected that Yun An had failed in ambushing the Alliance Island and assassinating Shi Yu. They didn’t dare to directly attack the big countries. Next, they wanted to take revenge on the small factions that had joined the Alliance!
This country-destroying action directly created a huge obstacle to the plan of the Seven Nation Alliance to establish the Blue Planet Alliance.
After all, providing material and labor resources to the Alliance in exchange for the support, protection, and opportunity for peaceful development was the original intention of the Alliance.
In the end, before it even started operating, a weak country was destroyed by an extraterrestrial faction, immediately pushing the Blue Planet Alliance to an awkward position. If the Blue Planet Alliance couldn’t deal with Yun An and the Abyss Sea in the short term, the establishment of the Blue Planet Alliance would probably completely fail.
The rulers of the seven countries instantly felt a headache, especially Legendary Wexy, who wanted to compete for the position of president of the Blue Planet Alliance. He was so angry that he gritted his teeth.
As for the request of the two Abyss demigods, it was naturally impossible for the Alliance to agree. Without Shi Yu, it would be gone. Without the Blue Sea Sprite, when the Abyss completely made a comeback, who would cleanse it?
“These two guys are courting death.”
In the sky above Wave Island, Shi Yu’s expression was unfriendly. It was fine if it directly attacked him, but it actually used this method to force him and Susu to submit. If this Yun An didn’t let it become a renewable resource for 100 million years, it would be difficult to relieve the hatred in Shi Yu’s heart.
“Ning, Ning!!” Of course, Susu was also angry, feeling very angry.
“Quack!!!” Duckie was also in so much pain that it wanted to die.
On the deck of the aerial battleship, Duckie hugged its head and howled. It realized that the abyss inheritance had been beaten to it.
The Abyss Sea inheritance was also passed down from the Mythical Era. It was left behind by the Abyss Evil God. Its characteristic was that it appeared randomly and was very difficult to completely destroy.
Every time it revived, thousands of pollution sources would appear in various places in the ocean. The creatures who came into contact with the pollution sources had all received the inheritance of the abyss.
There were strong and weak sources of pollution. The strong ones could pollute totems. It could be said that the moment they appeared, they would dye the sea with blood. Among the demons who accepted the inheritance, the first to grow to a demigod was the new Abyss Sea Leader.
This Leader could find the true inheritance land of the Abyss Sea and obtain the super-divine-level resource, the Eye of the Evil God. The Abyss half-god with the Eye of the Evil God would be stronger and could control all pollution sources to expand his faction faster.
Apart from that, the Eye of the Evil God had many magical uses. For example, transforming ordinary creatures into the Abyss Race, or devouring other lives to transform their life force into a pollution source. The pollution source was also the core power of the Abyss Race.
It could be said that this was the key that the Abyss Sea could always be passed down. Even the Blue Sea Sprite couldn’t cleanse the Evil God’s Eye. Every time the Abyss half-god died, the Evil Eye would disappear on its own and be born in a certain place.
Duckie originally wanted to wait until it broke through to the totem level and became a demigod to take over the Eye of the Evil God. In the end, where did this so-called Elder Gu Abyss half-god come from? It was so angry.
“Ning!” In short, Susu couldn’t wait to kill these two guys related to the power of the abyss immediately.
If not for Shi Yu stopping it, it would have already gone.
“We can’t be rash. The other party still dares to be so arrogant even though he’s wanted by the entire Blue Planet. He must have something to rely on,” Ling said.
“It’s not good news at all for Yun An and the unknown Abyss Sea demigod to join forces.”
“The Eye of the Evil God is an inheritance left behind by the Abyss Evil God in the Mythical Era. The Abyss Sea demigods are native abyss creatures that have accepted the Abyss inheritance, while Yun An is an extraterrestrial abyss creature from outer space that’s of the same race as the Abyss Evil God. They ignored the risk of stimulating the Blue Planet Alliance even more and started to devour creatures wantonly. They must be plotting some greater ambition.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1155 - 1155 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (2)
chapters.content:
1155 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (2)
“I suspect that the combination of the two of them will make both parties even more difficult to deal with.”
Yun An in this space-time was even harder to find than the one in the previous space-time. Ling suspected that not only did the other party have special resources to hide himself, but it was also possible that after joining forces with the Abyss Sea demigod, with the other party’s help, he could Meld into the deep sea alternate space.
Regarding that place, its investigation strength was definitely inferior to the alternate space in the outside world.
“Ning, Ning.” Susu was extremely aggrieved, making the duck beside it not know how to comfort it.
“Quack!! (Abyss Big Eye, your king is here!!)” Duckie was still angry.
“I know that even if we find them now, we’re no match for them. There are two demigods, and one is an abyss demigod holding the Eye of the Evil God. He’s not necessarily weaker than Yun An,” Shi Yu said.
Just now, President Lin also called to persuade him not to be rash.
“Susu, believe me, in a few days, we’ll launch a counterattack. We won’t let them continue to cause trouble.”
“I’ll definitely do what I promised you during the contract.”
“Ning Ning!!”
Shi Yu could sense Susu’s anxious mood to crush the Abyss Sea demigod and Yun An. If it didn’t have this mood, it wouldn’t be an Blue Sea Sprite.
However, the situation was indeed a little different now.
Unless more than twice the number of legendaries joined forces, the two demigods were confident of stopping them. Just like how Shi Yu and Emperor Wu were confident of stopping Yun An when they joined forces.
Unfortunately, according to what he understood from President Lin, apart from Dong Huang and Shen Feng, the other factions temporarily didn’t have very strong thoughts about facing the Yun Race and the Abyss.
Shen Feng had taken a fancy to the status value and research value brought by the hunting invading faction. Dong Huang was about the same.
As for the other five countries, it was very rare for them to have the ability to turn battle results into benefits. The risk was greater than the benefits.
The Mythical Era was about to revive. Legendary and demigods were the existences with the greatest hope of breaking through to the Mythical stage. At this critical moment, taking a huge risk to have a demigod battle, only the two largest countries, Shen Feng and Dong Huang, had this confidence.
As for the other factions, it was precisely because they knew that humans still had the confidence to resist demigods that most of them were watching the commotion according to President Lin.
They wanted to see if the Human Alliance had the ability to deal with the invaders and use this to consume the power of humans, they had no real intention of helping.
Even the Endless Sea and the Ghost Sea, the two demigods who were the first to respond to the Blue Sea Sprite, had no intention of directly attacking. They only provided some help.
Most factions were at most watching with support, worried that they would attract the fire, including Shen Feng. They suddenly had the intention to see Dong Huang and the invaders both suffer. After all, there was another demigod. The situation was completely different.
When the two demigods joined forces, Shen Feng immediately became afraid again. He was worried that if he hunted them, the sacrifice would be too great, and the losses and benefits would not be proportional. He was also worried that when there were losses, Dong Huang would take the opportunity to rise.
On the contrary, if Dong Huang went up himself, Dong Huang would definitely suffer a huge blow. This was an excellent opportunity to overtake.
Now that the public opinion of the entire Blue Planet Alliance was pressing on Dong Huang, Dong Huang had no choice but to attack. As long as Dong Huang didn’t work hard, it would lose the right to speak in the Alliance to a certain extent.
The Blue Star Alliance seemed to be huge, but once they really encountered something, their hearts immediately scattered.
Just one more demigod enemy immediately made the various factions on Blue Planet lose their unity. Shi Yu was actually not surprised by this. After all, according to the surviving gods, even in the Mythical Era, Blue Planet creatures had never been united.
There were people who left Blue Planet, those who surrendered, and those who resisted. If it weren’t for the fact that Blue Planet had enough powerful divine-level battle power, if it weren’t for the fact that the three invading factions weren’t united and had conflicts with each other, this battle would have been completely difficult.
At this moment, although he was facing the provocation of Yun An and the Abyss half-god, Shi Yu still endured it and continued cultivating.
After searching around, he didn’t find any traces of Yun An and the others. He confirmed that they had hidden deeper.
However, Shi Yu made an unexpected discovery on an isolated island. He discovered a Mythical Ruins that resonated with the spatial key he had obtained from the Time Emperor Ruins that could open the ruins.
This made Shi Yu understand that the key to the ruins left behind by Emperor Shi could only open this Mythical Ruins.
The mystery of Emperor Shi’s disappearance might be here.
Unfortunately, at this moment, he didn’t have the extra energy to explore this ruin.
He was still not strong enough.
Shi Yu originally thought that he already had pretty good strength to be able to fight Emperor Wu 40-60, but now, he understood that it was still not enough. After all, even Emperor Wu couldn’t protect only Dong Huang under the threat of Yun An alone.
“Instead of believing that an intelligent civilization can completely unite to fight the enemy, it’s better to pursue extreme personal strength.” Shi Yu went into seclusion to cultivate again. It wasn’t completely personal strength. At least contracted pets like Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Chi Tong, and Ling could be completely relied on.
As expected, Beast Tamers should just follow their pets.
….
“Hahahahaha, this power… Not bad, not bad.”
In the deep sea alternate space, the metal Elemental life form that looked like a camel, Yun An, was devouring a large number of pollution sources under the gaze of an abyss water elemental life form that looked like a sea frog.
Sensing the power that was quickly becoming stronger, Yun An’s heart burned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1156 - 1156 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (3)
chapters.content:
1156 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (3)
After failing to assassinate Shi Yu and being wanted worldwide, Yun An originally planned to leave Blue Planet for a period of time. Who knew that this guy who called himself an ancient abyss demigod would suddenly find it?
The Abyss Demon Frog, an ancient Abyss demigod and the ruler of the Abyss Sea a million years ago, wasn’t destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite either. Instead, it felt that it was gradually losing itself under the power of the Abyss. With the help of divine-level resources, it sealed itself. It wasn’t in the historical records.
It only woke up again when the laws revived, but it still couldn’t perfectly control the power of the abyss until it sensed Yun An’s existence. Just like humans, it thought that Yun An was an advance guard sent by the Abyss Race from outer space.
It, who believed in the Abyss Evil God, immediately found Yun An and said that it wanted to join forces with Yun An to wait for the arrival of the Abyss Race army.
As for it, before that, it had a way to make it and Yun An stronger and not be afraid of any opponent.
When Yun An heard that, he immediately fell silent, because it wasn’t the vanguard of any extraterrestrial faction at all. However, humans and most races seemed to think so.
Since everyone thought so, Yun An didn’t want to explain anything. In any case, it couldn’t be explained clearly. Its ambition to conquer Blue Planet was also true. Therefore, Yun An followed the other party’s words and wanted to see what the Abyss Demon Frog wanted to do.
In the end, to Yun An’s surprise, the source of pollution created by the other party with the power of the Evil Eye was a strengthening resource close to a divine-level meteorite. Its strength pointed to the origin and could greatly increase its strength.
Apart from that, it could also allow it, who was originally a natural metal life form, to evolve into a perfect ability to adapt to water.
This way, Yun An felt that perhaps he could cultivate two, three, or even more quasi-divine skills before the Mythical Revival, instead of just relying on one divine skill to advance to the divine level.
As for the Abyss Demon Frog, it also obtained the source of Yun An’s Yun clan.
Yun An came from outer space and was an innate Abyss Race. It could perfectly control the power of the abyss. Meanwhile, it was a postnatural Abyss Race, and its race wasn’t perfect. It couldn’t perfectly use the power of the abyss, but with the power of the Evil Eye and Yun An, it might be able to transform itself into a perfect Abyss Race and become stronger.
The pollution source was temporarily useless to the Abyss Demon Frog. It was purely the Unholy Origin that polluted more lives. If it absorbed too much, although its strength would be stronger, it would lose its rationality. However, it was very nutritious for Yun An.
As for the Yun An Origin, it was helpful for the Abyss Demon Frog to master the power of the abyss. The two parties hit it off.
This was a mutually beneficial transaction.
“The transaction is smooth…” The Abyss Demon Frog enjoyed the Yun An Origin at the same time and said to Yun An.
[If only I could completely eat this guy.]
[If only I could snatch the Eye of the Evil God.]
The two of them looked at each other with ulterior motives, but they understood that cooperation was the best plan for them now.
“Next, we have to borrow the power of the Evil Eye to transform more pollution sources,” the Abyss Demon Frog said. “Moreover, kill the Blue Sea Sprite!”
“We definitely can’t let it grow to the peak. The previous generations of Abyss Leaders were all destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite. Its power is extremely resistant to the Abyss Race.”
“Without it, even those reincarnation gods aren’t a big threat to us. On the contrary, as long as we pollute them and Blue Planet doesn’t have any cleansing methods, our strength will roll like a snowball, getting bigger and bigger.”
“This won’t be easy,” Yun An said. “That Shi Yu definitely won’t appear easily. He’s already at the Legend level and can already easily kill top-notch totems. There’s not much time left for us. His growth speed is too fast.”
It was even faster than that Wu Dong.
“I know, so we have to bait it!!” The Abyss Demon Frog said, “According to my investigation, he has a deep relationship with Dragon Palace City and even established some ‘Environmental Protection Department’. It’s extremely ridiculous. As long as we attack Dragon Palace City, he will definitely appear.”
“Dragon Palace City is Dong Huang’s ally, but there’s only one demigod presiding over it. There are no other allies, and Dong Huang’s Mechanical Legendary isn’t good at sea battles. There are very few ocean-type forbidden Arms in the various countries. Their power is far inferior to the ground, and it’s not easy to throw them into Dragon Palace City. Therefore, Dong Huang will be very passive in this attack.”
“At that time, if Dragon Palace City is polluted, the Blue Sea Sprite will definitely appear. It’s our best opportunity.”
“In addition, it’s not just them who can grow. Our cooperation can also make both of us stronger.”
Yun An said, “Dragon Palace City…”
Yun An was furious. The Dragon God of Dragon Palace City was also its sure-kill target. The last time, the Dragon God actually dared to say that it would definitely kill it the next time they met. What a joke. It was just a dragon.
“Your investigation is very comprehensive. You even know about forbidden Arms,” Yun An said.
“It’s decided. With my understanding of humans, they won’t unite to resist us soon. After we complete our evolution, we’ll attack Dragon Palace City and completely solve the hidden danger of the Blue Sea Sprite.”
“In addition, you’re also an Elemental life form, right? I’ll give you another small skill to reduce the damage of forbidden Arms. Although it can’t completely offset it, it can reduce the damage to an even lower level.” Yun An laughed.
Because it valued humans, it left behind a warning and valued the development of humans. Back in the era of Emperor Wu, humans that it had modified into meteorites had integrated into the world. This time, it was really lucky to have obtained a lot of knowledge about the Mechanic class. This was all thanks to the crazy scientists under it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1157 - 1157 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (4)
chapters.content:
1157 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (4)
Stealing the crystal of human intelligence should be the most successful.
In short, after they evolved again, three to four demigods wouldn’t be able to hold them down. At that time, they would indeed not be afraid of any opponent.
….
Three days later.
Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog appeared in a small totem country on the sea that responded to the Blue Planet Alliance again and devoured transcendent lives indiscriminately.
The countries were already more wary of these two abyss demigods, but unfortunately, they were really helpless in the short term against these two demigods.
To hold them down, there had to be at least four demigods. It was extremely difficult to let the four demigods/Legendary patrol the place where they attacked.
The technological devices of the Seven Nation Alliance were the first to detect their appearance, but they were helpless. Just as Dong Huang’s forbidden Arms locked onto them and before they could fire, the two demigods disappeared without a trace and hid in the ocean.
Ever since the power of humans’ forbidden Arms was known, there were indeed very few totems who fought head-on with forbidden Arms like when Mechanics were first developed.
“Damn guy.” Many members of the Blue Planet Alliance were furious.
The eight Legendarys of the Blue Planet Alliance had come out of seclusion and awakened, but they had never reached a unified opinion on killing the Abyssal Race demigod.
The eight Legendarys of the Blue Planet Alliance had come out of seclusion and awakened, but they had never reached a unified opinion on killing the Abyssal Race demigod.
Even if the Blue Sea Sprite Reincarnation reached its peak, like the Ming Hua Ghost God who had modified itself into an anomaly in order to extend its lifespan, Legendary Z and the others were very unwilling to directly fight to the death.
After all, in their state, even if they had cleansing methods, as long as they were polluted by the power of the abyss, whether they could last until they were cleansed was another matter.
The weak totem countries that responded to the Blue Planet Alliance also told the Blue Planet Alliance to quickly deal with the abyss invaders.
The demigods of the large totem factions were watching the commotion. Some gods who had awakened their memories and reached the demigod level and had the ability to fight were also watching the battle without any intention of attacking.
The former was also worried about being polluted and used by the Human Alliance. She wanted to use this opportunity to weaken the power of humans. At that time, even if they established some Blue Star Alliance to resist external enemies, humans wouldn’t be the only ones dominating.
The gods of the latter were relatively calm. They wanted to see what abilities the savior of Blue Planet, who was given high hopes by the World Tree, had.
In the eyes of the gods, what the two Abyss demigods were doing was still a small matter. The real Abyss Race was even more ferocious. If humans couldn’t even deal with them, even if the World Tree valued them and the Blue Planet’s Will favored them, it would be very difficult for them to believe in the abilities of humans.
From the perspective of a god, this was also a test for humans. If they couldn’t pass…
At that time, they wouldn’t listen to the request of the Blue Planet’s Will and treat humans equally.
At this moment, the Seven Nation Alliance also wanted to awaken the World Tree, but the World Tree had no intention of waking up from its sleep.
Everyone had their own considerations. At the moment, the only unified opinion of the Seven Nation Alliance was to use the stockpiles of forbidden Arms of the various countries to fight the two demigods.
After all, the one threatened was not the human faction itself, but the totem countries. Using forbidden Arms was already the limit. Legendarys didn’t want to do it themselves, but this wasn’t a long-term plan. The two Abyss half-gods had to be resolved in the end. The pressure of public opinion came to Dong Huang again.
The two abyss half-gods named Shi Yu and the Blue Sea Sprite, and both belonged to Dong Huang. Now, even Dong Huang didn’t want to risk its life. The various countries definitely wouldn’t rush to solve Dong Huang’s problem with all their might.
If Dong Huang couldn’t deal with the Abyss demigod, the ocean factions that responded to the Blue Sea Sprite would probably quickly withdraw.
“Originally, Shen Feng was the most anxious to kill Yun An. Now that the Abyss Demon Frog has appeared, they’re not in a hurry.” President Lin had been under a lot of pressure these few days.
Beside him, Divine Source Legendary, who looked like a small robot, said, “They’re very sensitive to forbidden Arms and very cautious. In the current situation, even if the Dragon God and I join forces, we probably won’t be able to deal with them. We’ll only cause Dong Huang’s vitality to be greatly injured. The various countries should be very happy to see us and them both suffer.”
“And we can’t really risk our lives to make Dong Huang fall into a weakened state because of this. Is the Blue Planet Alliance plan going to fail? It’s just the threat of two demigods.” Divine Source Legendary was annoyed.
If only Lin Feng was still around. Although this bastard didn’t suit his taste, he was the person Divine Source thought was the most suitable to replace him in charge of Dong Huang. In the end, he disappeared directly.
If Lin Feng was still around, the pressure on the Dragon God, him, Lin Feng, and Shi Yu to resist these two demigods would be much smaller. As long as they succeeded and didn’t suffer much losses, it would be as Shen Feng had expected. At that time, Dong Huang would occupy the highest position in the Blue Star Alliance and have the greatest right to speak, becoming an existence close to the alliance master.
Unfortunately…
“What’s the situation on Shi Yu’s side?” Divine Source Legendary asked.
“He’s still in seclusion.”
“Alright, as long as he’s not rash. I heard that the Blue Sea Sprite has a very stubborn temper. I’m just afraid that they’ll be rash,” Divine Source Legendary said. The Blue Star Alliance could be abandoned, and the totem allies could be abandoned, but nothing could happen to Shi Yu.
Alliances and allies were just tied together by benefits. It was far inferior to a super genius growing up being more important to Dong Huang.

chapters.title: Chapter ﻿1158 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (5)
chapters.content:
﻿1158 Breaking Through to Level 8 Beast Tamer (5)
As long as he endured until the Blue Sea Sprite grew to the peak and became the strongest demigod, these two abyss demigods could be dealt with. After thinking about it, as long as Dong Huang's homeland wasn't threatened, this was the best method Dong Huang could choose.
…
In the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu was cultivating and did not stop receiving information from the outside world.
President Lin, Divine Source Legendary, and the others' suggestion was to tolerate it for a while. In a year or two, when Shi Yu grew to the Legendary level, the Blue Sea Sprite would completely receive the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins and grow to a peak demigod before dealing with the opponent.
However, Shi Yu felt that it didn't have to be so long. He couldn't afford to wait that long. After all, Susu had always been in a low mood. Shi Yu didn't want Susu to be unhappy forever.
These two days of meditation might have been affected by many aspects, such as the revival of laws, the evolution of Little Ji and the Duck God. Shi Yu's cultivation efficiency was extremely high. Finally, seven months after he broke through to the legend level, the level of his Beast Taming Space completely loosened.
Buzz.
In the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu and the other pets who were comprehending the power of the natural order looked up one after another and sensed the change in the Beast Taming Space. A red spatial crystal wall suddenly appeared in Shi Yu's huge first Beast Taming Space before quickly disappearing.
"Testing, testing…" Ling quickly flew up.
"Wuu!!" "Wu!!" "Yi!!" The three brothers were overjoyed.
"Mi!!" "Ning!!" The plastic sisters immediately felt that their bottleneck had loosened a little, not being suppressed by the Beast Taming Space.
"Hu." In the Blue Sea Ruins, spatial ripples rippled. Shi Yu opened his eyes, and a red light similar to a spatial crystal wall flashed in his eyes.
"Level eight." The moment Shi Yu broke through to level eight, many new changes occurred in the Skill Index.
Unfortunately, it wasn't a big update like the fusion of teaching methods and skills. It was just that because of his breakthrough, his physique was strengthened again, and the risk of teaching quasi-divine skills was all reduced.
The success rate of fusing some Skills was also higher.
The difficulty of adding points to super Skills also decreased.
"This power…" Shi Yu couldn't be bothered to experience the physical strength and mental strength that could kill an overlord with this punch. He only quickly looked at Ling.
"Ling, is the analysis completed?"
"It's completed. With the strength of your current number one Beast Taming Space and physique, you can support contracting a demigod and a non- demigod totem."
For ordinary level-seven and level-eight Beast Tamers, unless their Beast Taming Talent was special, it was difficult to contract an ordinary totem-level creature.
Even if they had special talent and could contract it, with the situation of their Beast Taming Space, they could only contract one totem at most. It was very difficult to bear a second pet.
As this totem became stronger and stronger, and the demand for growth components became higher and higher, the pressure on Beast Tamers would also be greater.
However, this situation was completely broken by Shi Yu.
Because he had reached the physical limit at every level, in addition to eating three divine-level resources to strengthen himself and the super strengthening blessing of the World Tree, he had also obtained the feedback of many powerful pets, including the Son of the Stars and the Time Sprite. He was long inhuman.
He had just broken through to level eight. According to Ling's detection, his current state could actually contract a demigod and a totem.
What did this mean?
In other words, Shi Yu wouldn't feel any pressure if Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie, and Qi, these Mythical Races, immediately broke through to the totem level.
As long as they broke through to the totem level, they would have demigod-level battle power, which was the so-called demigod life form.
Apart from that, life forms like Buggy and Susu who had yet to master quasi-divine skills had a lower burden on Beast Tamers because they weren't suppressed by the world laws after breaking through to the totem level, which was the non- demigod totem life form Ling mentioned.
However, in fact, they looked like normal totems that might be divine skills, but because of the enhancement of the power of faith, after breaking through, they were definitely not much different from demigods.
Therefore, in other words, Shi Yu could completely choose two pets to let them break through to the totem level.
And this was only because he had just broken through. Shi Yu felt that when he trained his physique to the peak of level eight and his second Beast Taming Space broke through to level eight, his body control talent would also advance. He felt that perhaps he could slowly let all his pets reach the totem level without waiting to break through to level nine.
When he reached level nine, he might be able to become a whole team of demigods.
At this moment, Shi Yu clenched his fists and looked at Eleven and the others. "I plan to give Eleven and Susu two breakthrough opportunities. What do you think?"
"Wu!!" "Yi!" "Mi…" Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others looked at each other. Although they felt that it was a pity, it was nothing. This was the best choice. They had all expected it.
Next, if nothing went wrong, they would have to fight Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog.
Eleven's Yin Yang Millstone countered 99% of quasi-divine skills, including the power of the abyss and the power of the Yun Race. Susu's cleansing power was the power that countered the power of the abyss the most in the team. If they became stronger, the subsequent battles could also be easier.
"Wuu!!!" Panda King Eleven had waited for this day for god knows how long. It was as excited as a multiplied panda, indicating to Shi Yu and Susu that after breaking through, no matter what opponent it was, it could leave it to it.
After it became a demigod, it would definitely be able to suppress all enemies!
"Ning, Ning!!" When Susu heard that it had a share in breaking through, it was immediately excited to the extreme. The slime's body jumped. Although its Blue Sea Contract and Sea Cleansing Spirit were only transcendent after breaking through and couldn't immediately reach the level of a quasi-divine skill, they could also have an extraordinary increase compared to the current perfect extreme.
At that time, with Infinite Devour, creating a demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit in the ocean would probably take less than a day. It was not very different from reaching the demigod level.
The totem level was already extremely close to its peak.
"Then prepare to break through…" Shi Yu called Eleven and Susu.
Their super Race Skills were all (Perfect+47) and were long on the verge of breaking through.
Just a little more…
Just as Shi Yu and the others were preparing to break through and were about to enter the peak battle power of Blue Planet, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog appeared again.
The seven countries captured them relatively quickly this time. As the terrifying explosion that contained various powers rose, the entire Blue Planet shook, shocking the totems and demigods.
The world was silent. This time… the seven countries quickly and accurately locked onto the Abyss demigod? The forbidden Arms of the Seven Nation Alliance were fired and hit so quickly. What was the outcome?
Countless top-notch experts paid attention to the location of the forbidden explosion. This time, Dong Huang provided a divine forbidden-type forbidden-type Arms, Shen Feng provided a divine forbidden-type forbidden-type Arms, and the other countries provided a top-notch forbidden-type Arms. A total of seven forbidden-type Arms formed a series of explosions, shocking the world.
However, when the forbidden wave dissipated, the scene shocked everyone.
"Damn it, they're fishing. They're trying to see if they can resist the divine forbidden Arms, and they succeeded."
Back then, the divine forbidden Arms that successfully killed demigods in the last totem battle didn't successfully kill two demigods this time. They were still alive and appeared from the depths of the ocean again. Moreover, their forms had changed drastically. It was unimaginable.
Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog completed their evolution again on the basis of a nearly perfect demigod-level divine-level race, successfully blocking a round of forbidden attacks from the Seven Nation Alliance.
They were originally considered strong among demigods, far from what demigods killed by humans with forbidden Arms could compare to. And now, they were clearly stronger.
For the first time, the final killing move of the Mechanic class failed. Many Mechanics of the seven countries' faces were pale. They couldn't accept this outcome. Even divine forbidden-type forbidden Arms weren't working, so what else could kill them? The various totem countries were also very silent. The forbidden Arms couldn't kill them? Now, let's see what the legendaries of the seven countries did.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159 - 1159 Demigod Bear, Cat Lady
chapters.content:
1159 Demigod Bear, Cat Lady
Blue Sea Ruins.
Before preparing to add points and give Eleven and Susu the final breakthrough, Shi Yu had a big meal.
After stepping into level eight, Shi Yu’s greatest feeling was hunger.
The consumption of a powerful life level was too huge.
If there was consumption, it had to be replenished. It just had to eat. However, extravagant was really extravagant.
Under normal circumstances, if Shi Yu’s team wanted to be rich, they could eat up a small totem country and a first-level city in Dong Huang in less than a year.
A group of pigs.
If not for the ginseng baby, Shi Yu really didn’t know what to do.
Baby Ginseng was the chef of the team. As the son of the world, the World Ginseng, it could freeload on natural energy to the greatest extent and create food.
Of course, that alone wasn’t enough.
Shi Yu and the others had tried it before. If they ate a few better meals, they would have to eat an island filled with natural energy into a deserted island.
It could be said that if Baby Ginseng grew vegetables in Ping Cheng, it wouldn’t be long before the entire Icefield City would become a desolate place.
When their levels were low, for the sake of efficiency, Shi Yu and the others farmed in the ruins mystic realm and used energy crystals to replace natural energy to accelerate production.
After its level was high, be it ruins or energy crystals, they were no longer useful. As time passed, it was not a problem to eat a ruin and eat Dong Huang’s inventory. Fortunately, at this moment, Susu awakened the Blue Sea Contract.
The Blue Sea Contract could mobilize the energy of the sea without limit. Baby Ginseng and Susu combined and developed a food group that mainly relied on the energy of the sea to grow. Only then did the food crisis in the team ease.
Baby Ginseng and Susu only needed to pay a large amount of time Cost to eat their fill.
Otherwise, if it weren’t for Susu, Shi Yu and the others would probably have to plunder territory if they wanted to eat their fill. This way, the time Cost of searching for a place was a small matter. It was mainly because the areas with the most natural energy were all totem factions. It wasn’t good for Shi Yu to go over to freeload. It was easy to trigger a totem battle.
In history, many totem battles were opened by the totems in order to fill their stomachs, in order to get resources, and for their territories.
If Shi Yu’s configuration didn’t have the combination of Susu and Baby Ginseng, it would really be the fuse to start the totem battle.
Of course, the price was that Susu and Baby Ginseng had suffered a little and had to do more work. Apart from that, it was also a pity that everyone was vegetarian.
This was also why Shi Yu was so excited to see some black ram and black yak.
Meat, meat… Totem-level meat…
“I’m full.” After eating, Shi Yu looked at Eleven and the others.
Eleven, Buggy, and the others surrounded him and were predicting the energy value after breaking through.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, continued to move food. Shi Yu would be hungry after breaking through, and Eleven would definitely be even hungrier after breaking through.
As for Susu, it didn’t care. As an Elemental life form, Susu could directly use the Blue Sea Contract to absorb the growth and nutrition in the ocean.
But on Eleven’s side, no matter what, as an animal life form, it was difficult to have a nutritional recipe.
Eating lightning and metal alone was not Eleven’s most perfect recipe. It had to be matched reasonably according to Ling’s menu. Baby Ginseng wiped its sweat.
On the other side, when they heard Shi Yu say that he was full, Eleven and Susu immediately came over with shining eyes.
“Wuu!”
“Ning!”
“Let me see.” At this moment, Shi Yu looked at Eleven and Susu’s normal energy levels again.
Now, Ling had already researched that the highest-level detection device on Blue Planet could already detect energy values that exceeded 100 million, with the highest limit being 5 billion.
This meant that Ling’s scientific research ability had already reached the top of Blue Planet.
This was also normal. After all, it was a top-notch intelligence close to transcendent. In this mechanical domain where mechanical brains of Divine Source Legendary and Legendary Z didn’t have transcendent top-notch intelligence, it was a god.
As long as Ling was given enough time, materials, and technology, it wasn’t impossible to study divine forbidden Arms.
Because it had the World Tree Fruit Tree to increase its comprehension, Ling’s research of messy things was not slow. It was born to study and tinker, so it had results in a bunch of technological products that didn’t exist in the outside world.
Perhaps it wasn’t that the Mechanical Legendary couldn’t develop this, but because the cost-effective ratio wasn’t high, there was no need to study it.
At their level, they could basically sense the difference in strength, and it was an all-round perception. It was just that pure energy detection was not within their consideration.
Shi Yu looked at the few overlords in the team.
“Roar!!” Little Ji looked at Shi Yu. The normal energy value was about 130 million.
“Quack!” Duckie looked at Little Ji calmly. Its normal energy level was about 140 million, and it had an inexplicable sense of superiority.
Ever since it joined the team, its normal energy level had been suppressed by Little Ji. It finally turned around and became its master.
Even these two guys had more than 100 million energy points, and the pets in Team One were stronger.
Ling’s normal energy level was about 240 million.
Susu, about 230 million.
Chi Tong, about 310 million.
Baby Ginseng, about 350 million.
Buggy, about 280 million.
Eleven, about 370 million.
The energy values of the various pets were basically extremely ridiculous. This was only the norm, and this was still because they were only at the overlord level!
After all, they had countless explosive skills.
Under normal circumstances, Normal totems rarely had more than 500 million energy points.
The top-notch totems of the strongest tier rarely had more than 1 billion normal energy.
Eleven and the others could be said to be quite ferocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1160 - 1160 demigod bear, cat girl (2)
chapters.content:
1160 demigod bear, cat girl (2)
Of course, there were also weak Mythical Race overlords, such as Qi.
Shi Yu glanced at it.
Energy Points: 10.01 million.
As expected of it.
Qi: “What, what???”
Her energy level was low, but it was a matter of race. Don’t look!
“Cough, cough.”
At this moment, Shi Yu was curious about the level of energy Eleven and the others would reach after breaking through to the totem level.
Next, in the Blue Sea Ruins, Shi Yu first let Susu use the power of points and the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins to break through!
“Ning!!!”
Coupled with Ling’s nine-colored divine light and Susu’s own Sea Cleansing Spirit, the success rate of Shi Yu teaching their super skills had already become extremely high.
The difficulty was basically equivalent to Shi Yu teaching Eleven Hardening at the rookie stage. Standing at this stage where he didn’t have to worry about high-level supplements, that wasn’t quite easy.
This way, in a few months, Shi Yu would probably be able to nurture a divine pet with two quasi-divine skills and three quasi-divine skills.
“Ning!!!”
In the Blue Sea inheritance that was like a water pillar that reached the sky, Susu still maintained the form of a Water Slime, and its energy level rose steadily.
Under the lead of external forces and internal power, its life level underwent an extreme sublimation. Endless life source gathered in the Elemental core and slowly formed a life source.
The life source that was like a blue ball of light was like an organ that Susu could control. It could allow it to better control the changes in life, be it macro or micro.
Transcendent species that had reached this level of life level could already try to transform non-racial skills into racial skills to inherit and try to develop their own exclusive abilities. They could also optimize their race on their own and evolve without limit. They no longer needed to rely on mutated evolution and evolution skills.
Of course, be it developing new Skills or optimizing races to complete new evolution, it wasn’t easy for totems. Some totems spent their lives but didn’t develop the abilities they wanted. Some totems consumed a huge amount of resources, but they didn’t optimize the success of their race and complete the evolution of gods.
Shi Yu’s Skill Index, a rare evolution skill, was still a shortcut to a certain extent.
However, for Susu, after condensing its life source, it would welcome spring. Coupled with Infinite Devour, it might be able to try to evolve into a cosmic life form on its own. With its own directional cooperation, the success rate would be higher.
This guy had yet to forget the Star Sea Sprite pancake Shi Yu had drawn for it when it was young. The key was that it was really possible to eat this pancake.
“Ning!!!”
In the Blue Sea Ruins, under the quiet change, as Shi Yu sensed the rapid increase in the water elemental content in the Beast Taming Space, he instantly knew that Susu had already completed its breakthrough.
Shi Yu looked at Susu, who was in the inheritance and had restrained its energy.
“Your Control is not bad. It has improved greatly.” Shi Yu smiled.
Its energy level had exceeded 1 billion!
“Ning!!” Susu jumped out of the Blue Sea Ruins inheritance pillar, almost writing the word invincible on its face.
He smiled at Shi Yu, Chi Tong, and the others.
At the moment, Susu’s eight super skills were all transcendent. Ordinary totems with two transcendent skills were already entry-level top-notch totem battle power. It this…
Obviously, the strength had already exceeded the standard.
Normal Energy Points: 1,230 million
“1.2 billion.” Shi Yu was excited!
