For Susu, although it had unlimited energy, the normal foundation was also very important. After all, the more basic energy its body could accommodate, the more ocean energy it could summon in one go through the Blue Sea Contract.
If the previous Blue Sea Contract was a thin water pipe, then now it was a water cannon.
This would greatly increase the efficiency of creating the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
Previously, at the monarch level, it might have needed a long time to create a Sea Cleansing Spirit that could cleanse top-notch totems.
But now, with a casual attack, it was the Sea Cleansing Spirit that could cleanse top-notch totems like the Black Meteorite Yak and the Black Space Divine Dragon. It could be used infinitely!
It was precisely because of such a ferocious accompanying move that no matter how strong or huge the Abyss Sea faction was, they couldn’t withstand the attack Purification of the Blue Sea Sprite.
“Ning ~ ~” After breaking through, Susu indeed instantly felt extremely hungry. It immediately swallowed the ocean energy through the Blue Sea Contract and Infinite Devour.
During the eating process, vast energy fluctuations that were like the sea lingered around it, making Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others watch eagerly.
This power definitely exceeded any life form below the demigod level they had seen. Even the nine totem battle pets of Emperor Wu were like the difference between a small star and a bright moon compared to Susu in front of them!
Although the current Susu’s two exclusive skills, the Blue Sea Contract and the Sea Cleansing Spirit, had yet to reach the peak of transcendent and reach the stage of quasi-divine skills, as long as it accumulated enough Sea Cleansing Spirit, it could still be said that it had demigod-level battle power now!
“Quack!!” Duckie rubbed its hands. As expected of a big sister.
Trash Abyss Toad, you didn’t expect this, right? Although you snatched the Eye of the Evil God before me, I’ll rely on the Blue Sea Sprite!
“Wu wu wu!!!” Eleven told Duckie to calm down. There was no hurry, no hurry. It wanted to break through too!!!
“Come, come, come.” Shi Yu called Eleven.
A moment later.
Eleven, who was like the Chaos Thunder God, stood in the Blue Sea Ruins. In its terrifying physique, surging energy was crazily tempering its entire body and completing the sublimation of life.
As Shi Yu added the last points, Eleven also completed the extreme breakthrough. Shi Yu could sense the explosive energy in its body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1161 - 1161 demigod bear, cat girl (3)
chapters.content:
1161 demigod bear, cat girl (3)
“Wu!!!!!”
Boom!!!
The explosive energy in Eleven’s body only spread a little, instantly shocking Buggy and the others.
If it was said that Susu needed to use faith skills to break through to the totem level and prepare sufficiently in advance to be considered a demigod-level battle power, then Eleven had just evolved. Because of the existence of a quasi-divine skill, it could be considered a demigod battle power without any preparation!!
Eleven’s eyes that were like black and white lightning stars opened and crazily suppressed its power to return to its body. Its aura rose steadily. After breaking through, its energy level exceeded 1 billion in a short moment!
Breaking two billion!
Breaking three billion!
In the end, the normal energy value stopped at a total of 3.46 billion. Shi Yu and Ling looked at the number jumping crazily in the reconnaissance device and were secretly shocked.
Holy shit.
Impressive, awesome.
It didn’t torture so much in vain. It had indeed become very impressive.
“Normal state, 3.467 billion!” As Shi Yu spoke, Buggy and the others were stunned. Baby Ginseng also let out a cry and was immediately shocked.
Oh my god, the zeroes were too high!
“Roar!!” Buggy looked at Baby Ginseng and waved its dragon claws around. Was this the key? The key was that Eleven was going to be very hungry.
Generally speaking, totem-levels had to rely on sleeping to offset the consumption. Half-gods basically didn’t appear or fight on Blue Planet because they were afraid that the consumption would be too high. Now that a cultivation maniac half-god had been born, Baby Ginseng, you had to pray for yourself.
Baby Ginseng:???
“It’s done.” At this moment, Shi Yu already felt that it was enough. This was even without Eleven using explosive skills like Inner Power and Impregnable.
Apart from that, there were also army skills, immortal skills…
With the current configuration of Eleven’s 13 super Skills to reach transcendent proficiency, as well as the combination of the two divine skills he used together, Shi Yu could only say, “Yun An, give it to me.”
If another light resource of the same level came to Devour Yun An’s elemental core, Eleven could definitely evolve a little more.
Shi Yu had just finished being excited when his face turned pale.
Ling: “It’s relatively difficult to contract two totems above your level. Remember to eat supplements at any time.”
“But there’s still a lot of room for improvement in my physique now. You’ll slowly adapt…”
“I understand…” Shi Yu said weakly.
….
After Eleven and Susu broke through, Susu immediately continued to accumulate the Sea Cleansing Spirit and prepare for the ultimate battle. As for Eleven, it was also eating crazily. It wasn’t enough to just eat its fill. It also had to store more energy in its source of stamina to erupt.
At this moment, Shi Yu and Ling also came out of the Blue Sea Ruins.
Soon, they also learned that the seven countries couldn’t kill the Abyss demigods with two divine forbidden Arms and that they had even completed a small evolution.
“With the revival of laws, the strength of the demigods has increased by a level. Ordinary forbidden Arms aren’t enough to deal with such powerful demigods,” Shi Yu said.
The white-haired Ling in the Rubik’s Cube said, “Then let me break through to the totem level next. It’s not impossible to add points to top-notch intelligence to the quasi-divine skill stage and create God Destroying Arms!”
Shi Yu grinned. “Of course I believe you. At what point? Star-level bombs, cosmic spaceships, clueless foils, and black hole Arms are all up to you.”
Ling: “?”
“There’s an emergency call,” Ling suddenly said.
“Put it through.”
In theory, the person who called him at this time was either Divine Source Legendary or President Lin. However, this time, it really wasn’t.
It was someone Shi Yu didn’t expect.
To be precise, it wasn’t human.
Ling: “It’s Teacher Ying’s number.”
A communication projection appeared, and a virtual optical image was projected. A cat girl with smooth white hair, white cat ears, and a sexy black silk swimsuit was yawning as she looked at Shi Yu opposite her.
Shi Yu: “?”
“Huh?” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat girl: “Ah what?”
Shi Yu was shocked. “You, you didn’t break through to the demigod level so quickly, right?”
The gem cat girl: “What’s wrong with that? Isn’t this normal? Your Little Ji and Duckie can evolve into a god so quickly. What’s so strange about me evolving!”
Shi Yu: “Aba Aba Aba Aba.”
Shi Yu was shocked to discover that after the gem cat demigod evolved into a cat girl, its looks were actually not inferior to the Dragon God.
The Dragon God, the Elven Empress of Tingxiang, the Seven Islands Valkyrie, and the Gem Cat Lady were the peak-level creatures Shi Yu had seen.
Teacher Ying, you’re so good.
“I awakened a quasi-divine skill. After adapting a little, I immediately called you. Let me guess, do you want to fight Yun An and that abyss demigod?” Teacher Cat said. “With my understanding of you, you definitely will.”
“Although I don’t want to, remember to call me when you’re preparing to attack. I can help you.”
“The current me isn’t weak in battle either. Most importantly, my support ability is very strong.”
The gem cat was confident and shone. Its blue gem eyes were especially beautiful.
“Sure!! Come now, we’ll go now!” Shi Yu was quite touched. Seeing that the rascal cat was actually willing to interfere in the battle of demigods and even fight ferocious demigods like Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, he felt that Baby Ginseng didn’t raise this guy for nothing.
The gem cat girl was stunned. “What, what, so fast? Do you know their location? Isn’t it too rushed? Why don’t we prepare more?”
“No, I’ll look for you,” Shi Yu said. “I want to return to Dong Huang first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1162 - 1162 demigod bear, cat girl (4)
chapters.content:
1162 demigod bear, cat girl (4)
“Did you just say that you awakened that quasi-divine skill?”
“Yes,” the gem cat girl said.
< Name > Wish Star
[Level]: Quasi God-level
< Introduction > It can condense the Starry Sky Gem as a weapon. When it condenses into seven, it can synthesize a wish star and make a wish.
“I don’t know Yun An’s location, but you can know. What’s the difference between your skill and quasi-divine-level premonition? Blue Planet is the first!” Shi Yu said.
“Unfortunately, it can’t exceed your ability too much. Otherwise, I could just make a wish for them to die. In short, knowing a location should be easy.”
The gem cat girl: ???
“Make a wish and predict it. I’ll let Ling use the Wind of Blessing to assist you. We’ll look for the owl again and let Ling assist it in predicting the future. Hasn’t its Future Prediction also reached transcendent? Make a wish, luck, and prediction can basically activate the God’s Perspective. It’s difficult for the two of them to escape.”
It was still too difficult for an overlord like Ling to find two demigods. Shi Yu discovered that Yun An in this space-time was clearly better at hiding than the one in the past. It was probably hidden in the deep sea space mezzanine.
“The problem is, shouldn’t we call the Dragon God and Divine Source Legendary?” The gem cat girl said worriedly, “The two of us aren’t safe. I didn’t help you to give myself away!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Don’t worry, I just broke through to level eight and let the two pets break through above my level. Eleven and Susu also have demigod-level battle power.”
The gem cat girl was shocked. “Huh????”
What?
Eleven and Susu…
Demigod?
How could this be! How was this possible!
Damn, I finally broke through to the demigod level and want you to cozy up to me. What’s wrong with you!
It didn’t understand.
“Their strength is all countering Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog. In addition to your support, as well as the support of Buggy, Ling, and Baby Ginseng, I feel that it’s about the same.”
“Old Master Divine Source is too old and his life condition isn’t good. Don’t let him attack directly. I don’t think it’s good to have too much trouble with the Dragon God… Just let them help suppress the array to avoid any accidents. The main force is still us.”
“I originally planned to do it myself. Teacher Ying, you came at the right time! I’m more confident.”
“Are you excited about the demigod battle?”
The gem cat girl smiled in embarrassment… I suspect you’re making things difficult for me! Alright, so be it. I’ll give it my all.
….
That day, in Imperial Capital University.
The guardian of Imperial Capital University, the guardian of Dong Huang, and the top prophecy master of the Alliance, the owl, were silently cultivating. Yun An wreaked havoc, so it naturally heard about this…
This reminded it of an early prophecy. The Demon God Iron-eating Beast vs the unknown Demon God. Coupled with the current situation of Yun An and Shi Yu, it kept feeling a slight headache.
Could it be that Shi Yu really rushed out under Yun An’s provocation? Just as its thought fell, spatial ripples appeared in front of the temple, making the owl suddenly open its eyes.
Shi Yu and the others, as well as a cat girl whose life fluctuations made the owl feel very familiar, appeared outside its territory. When it saw Shi Yu and the others, the owl widened its eyes. What was going on…
“You, why are you here!!! You, you’re Teacher Ying?” It first looked at Shi Yu and the even more unfathomable Panda Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder. Then, it looked at the gem cat girl in shock.
Damn, why did it become like this?
Its witch-like sharp voice was shocked. It was mainly because not only had the gem cat’s form changed, but its strength had also become incomprehensible. After all, it was also at the totem level.
Why was this cat’s speed of becoming stronger so unscientific?
“Of course.” The gem cat was calm.
“Yo, Teacher Owl.” Shi Yu waved his hand and smiled. “Help me predict something.”
“Wh-what?”
“I want to know Yun An’s location. Is it enough to have a totem with its power as a sacrifice soul?” Shi Yu asked.
The Prediction Owl was shocked and said, “Holy shit, what do you want?”
Shi Yu said, “Crush! Of course it’s to crush it.”
“This…” The owl was shocked and almost fainted. Holy shit, they really wanted to fight!!! It, it wasn’t going to lie down and level up again, right? Strange, too strange!!
The gem cat girl looked at the Prediction Owl faintly and said, “Old pal, do you want to go together? Perhaps you’ll have more EXP and level up faster.”
“I’m not going. What, you’re going too?” The Prediction Owl took a step back and was stunned.
It looked at Shi Yu and the gem cat and fell silent. It kept feeling that this world was about to collapse. If it had predicted it earlier, it wouldn’t have expected that scene to actually be a demigod crusade. With its horizons at that time, it didn’t even dare to imagine it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1163 - 1163 Boring, I Want to See Blood Rivers (1)
chapters.content:
1163 Boring, I Want to See Blood Rivers (1)
“Are you serious?”
“Those are two demigods!”
“I don’t do prophecies that harm people, although my prophecies have harmed many people.”
The Prediction Owl confirmed again.
“Which is bigger? Five or two?” Shi Yu crossed his arms and asked with a smile.
“Huh?” The Prediction Owl was stunned.
Shi Yu said, “Dragon Palace City’s Dragon God, Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary. These are two demigod-level battle power.”
“In addition to Teacher Ying, who has just advanced to the demigod level…”
The gem cat girl looked up at the sky elegantly, making the Prediction Owl widen its eyes.
Demigod?
What a joke.
Everyone was mixed in with totems. It had yet to escape the battle power title of the weakest totem. This cat… This cat… How did it cross two major battle power levels in one go!
“I’m considered slow.” The mature cat girl yawned lazily.
“That panda, well, Iron-eating Beast, is already a demigod at the age of four.”
After all, she had hundreds of years of training to build the foundation.
That that panda, that panda… was this four years old?!
Yes, Eleven was already four years old, not three.
The Prediction Owl was stunned. It looked at Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder and was stunned.
Wait a minute, what did the gem cat just say?!
“Well, I broke through to level eight. After letting Eleven break through above my level, it successfully advanced to demigod battle power.”
“Apart from that, the Blue Sea Sprite has also reached the totem level. It can also be considered a demigod battle power.”
“This way, with the battle power of the five Legendary demigods, we can’t let Yun An and the others continue to be arrogant,” Shi Yu said.
The Prediction Owl opened its mouth wide.
It was unimaginable.
Dong Huang had Divine Source Legendary and the Dragon God’s ally, so it was considered the strongest faction.
In the end, a cat actually told it that there were three Legendary demigods in front of it?
It was really ridiculous to f*cking open the door… It was ridiculous to the extreme.
“Therefore, there’s no need to worry too much about battle power. The only thing to consider is how to find the enemy.”
“We came to you because we believed in your premonition.”
“Teacher Owl, don’t tell me you think five demigods will still lose when fighting two?”
The owl trembled. They should have said so earlier!
“Yes, I have to predict it!!! This is a demigod battle. I’m also indirectly participating!” The owl looked at the sky. Oh, my old Beast Tamer, look at me, look at me.
He could even participate in the demigod battle!
It was already tired of the boring life of being a charlatan at Imperial Capital University.
Boring! Right now, it only wanted to see blood flow like a river! To prove its value!
“But can I really…” The Prediction Owl was sneaky. It shrank its head and looked at Shi Yu and the others. “I just entered the totem level not long ago. It’s not necessarily accurate to predict the location of the two demigods…”
Shi Yu glanced at the gem cat and said, “Don’t worry, with the nine-colored divine light strengthening your strength and the Wind Kirin’s Blessing Wind strengthening your accuracy, I’ll bet!”
“Let’s do it!” The Prediction Owl immediately exploded. This treatment was too beautiful. A demigod and a Mythical Race creature strengthened it. Then, during the prophecy process, it was also considered a demigod?!
“In addition, during the battle… I’ll go too! To avoid any accidents, the Prophecy Skill is on standby 24 hours a day!”
“I believe you can protect me well.”
…
Next, the Prediction Owl first made a premonition with the support of various parties. The content of its premonition was where to find Yun An and the others.
Under the strengthening of the nine-colored divine light and the Wind of Blessing, the Prediction Owl felt that its soul was about to float. This was the first time it had carried out such a satisfying and clear prophecy.
The gem cat girl also helplessly took out gems from the four dimensional pocket one after another to make a wish to strengthen Ling’s reconnaissance device.
Future Prediction+Wish Divine Skill+Luck Divine Skill. The combination skill was finally understood by Shi Yu and the others.
In the end, as expected, Shi Yu and the others jointly located a location!
This could basically be confirmed to be the hiding place of Yun An and the others.
“As expected, it’s hidden in the Deep Sea Mystic Realm…” After confirming this location, a fierce glint flashed in Shi Yu’s eyes. Alright, no matter what Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog thought, he would take their lives.
“Ling, contact President Lin for me. After being chased and provoked by Yun An and the others for so long, I want the world to know how Yun An was blown up!”
…
At the moment, the world structure was in chaos. Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog had evolved and used unknown methods to resist the divine forbidden Arms, shocking the world.
“Hahaha, Dong Huang, you guys also have this day.”
In the Western Dragon Empire and the Eastern Dragonman Empire, the demigod Black Dragon Juggernaut and the quasi demigod Tyrant Dragon King only wanted to laugh when they saw Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog continuing to provoke Dong Huang.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Abyss Race was now hated by everyone, they even wanted to help Yun An a little.
The seven human countries were also very silent about the growth speed of Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog.
They felt that these two guys were becoming more and more troublesome. The key was that be it the reincarnation god or the totem half-god, before Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog provoked them, they had no intention of helping.
“President Lin, Shi Yu called.”
However, at this moment, a critical turn appeared in the Dong Huang Association with a call.
“I want to kill Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog.” President Lin had just received the call when his hand trembled and he almost threw his cell phone out.
“I broke through to level eight. Eleven reached demigod, Susu reached demigod. In addition, the gem cat also reached demigod.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1164 - 1164 Boring, I Want to See Rivers of Blood (2)
chapters.content:
1164 Boring, I Want to See Rivers of Blood (2)
“I don’t need Senior Divine Source and Senior Dragon God to participate in the battle. They just have to help hold the line. We’re confident of dealing with these two guys ourselves!”
“You, what did you say!!!” President Lin’s voice was filled with shock.
Holy shit, what was going on? It had only been a few days, why did Dong Huang have three more demigods! Was he still dreaming!!
“President Lin, I want to shock the world in this battle and let the entire Blue Planet see our fist.”
Today, his battle power had definitely stood at the top of Blue Planet.
At Imperial Capital University, Shi Yu looked at the communication device and said very confidently.
….
Western Demon Sea.
An aerial battleship was flying in the blue sky.
At that moment, this battleship was the focus of the entire Dong Huang Association.
No, it was the focus of the entire Alliance.
A video broadcast hall suddenly appeared in the Blue Star Alliance, immediately causing a huge commotion.
Title: “Dong Huang: Livestream Hunting the demigods of the Yun Race and the Abyss demigod”!
Introduction: Not every thief is qualified to provoke Dong Huang!
Such a shocking title entered the ears of the presidents of the various associations and Legendarys in less than a minute.
“Is Dong Huang crazy?”
Experts above the titled legend level from various countries entered the live-stream immediately. It was unbelievable. Even Legendarys joined in in confusion.
Their first thought was that Dong Huang had been driven crazy by Yun An and the Abyss Demon Duck, but how could such a situation happen?
But the reality was that Dong Huang’s current live broadcast of hunting two demigods was no different from crazy.
After all, the previous seven forbidden Arms couldn’t heavily injure them. Although the Alliance didn’t have 100% of the forbidden Arms used to target Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, there were still seven, and there were two divine forbidden types!
For totem half-gods, the threat of divine forbidden Arms was actually far greater than that of human Legendaries. In the eyes of many totem countries, the seven human countries had already lost this battle. Unless the legendaries of the seven human countries could cooperate and attack together, the chances were too small.
In the end, not only did the legendary cooperation of the seven countries not come, but Dong Huang went alone. This outcome stunned the other six countries.
“Could it be that Divine Source Legendary invited the Dragon God and plans to fight it out with the other party?”
“Perhaps Dong Huang found a demigod-level reincarnation god to help!”
“However, the demigods of the Yun Race and the Abyss demigod hide very deeply every time they disappear. I can’t find their location at all. Could it be that Dong Huang has already locked onto them?”
The countries were shocked. They stared at the live broadcast channel and looked at the green and white battleship in the blue sky. Some countries immediately contacted Dong Huang to ask what was going on, but they didn’t receive an answer.
“This is the Western Devil Sea Region! The territory of the Ghost Sea! It’s also the headquarters of the Abyss Sea during its rampage!”
Soon, someone noticed the location of the battleship in the sea.
Then, after a while, the battleship in the sky stopped above an isolated island.
“Someone appeared!”
When the battleship in the sky stopped, everyone looked at the deck with the camera. What they saw shocked everyone.
Because the people above weren’t Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary, President Lin of Dong Huang, or the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City. None of them were!
In the lead was a handsome young man in his twenties in a black and white battle suit and a black cap.
He lowered his hat and looked into the distance.
“We’re here.”
“That’s right.” Beside the young man was a life form in a black silk dress with white hair and white cat ears. Apart from that, there was also a blue owl with a time hexagram on its chest that was trembling as it grabbed the railing.
This magical combination completely shocked everyone. They couldn’t believe that this combination would appear in the live broadcast hall of Dong Huang’s crusade against the two demigods.
“Dong Huang legend, Shi Yu!”
“What a beautiful cat girl. She’s simply not inferior to the Seven Islands Valkyrie and the Elven Empress of Tingxiang! Who is she?”
“That owl looks a little familiar. Have you seen it in Inatella?”
“Wait, what’s with this combination? What are they doing?”
Under the shocked gazes of countless people, Shi Yu walked forward under the companionship of the beautiful cat girl.
“There should be many people watching now.”
“Perhaps you will be very puzzled.”
“But next, I’m indeed the one preparing to suppress Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog.”
“They’re destroying everything in the name of finding me. It’s time for this farce to end.”
Holy shit! Holy shit! Holy shit!!!
It was fine if Shi Yu didn’t say anything, but when he spoke, it shocked the Beast Tamers of the various countries even more.
“Your Majesty, he…” President Auland looked at the Elven Empress beside him. Sylphra shook her head, not knowing.
The Rongguang Light Pope looked at the angel god who was as confused as him and confirmed that he didn’t hear wrong.
“Is he crazy?” Shen Feng’s Legendary Z, Legendary Wexy, and President Logan still thought that Shi Yu was crazy.
“The Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary, and even that Lin Feng’s descendant are definitely here.”
They felt that Shi Yu’s words were ambiguous, as if he wanted to crusade against the two demigods himself.
If Shi Yu was alone, it wouldn’t be called a crusade at all. That would be Dong Huang responding to the request of the Abyss demigods and handing Shi Yu over!
“Qi, Ling.”
As everyone watched, Shi Yu spoke again. This time, he called out two names and a Skill name.
“Transdimensional Annihilation Cannon.”
In the ship, the pink-haired loli sat in the small cockpit and pulled down her tactical eyepiece.
“Roger.”
As soon as he finished speaking, endless light gathered at the muzzle of the battleship in the air…
On the incomparably clear scene, there were six main cannons at the bow of the ship, two large-caliber spatial cannons, and four secondary cannons on each side of the ship. Blue and white light flickered together, and huge spatial fluctuations condensed…
This was a super cannonball fired by the Sprite Qi when Ling possessed it!
Boom!!!
Countless light cannons shot out and hit the sea.
…
In the Demon Sea, in the interlayer of the deep sea alternate space, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog were relying on “dual cultivation” to recover from the damage of the forbidden weapon.
Now, they had already relied on the other party’s power to complete a small scale evolution. They were undoubtedly stronger.
After making sufficient preparations and trying to learn about the forbidden Arms of humans, their hearts swelled even more.
When the laws revived, transcendent lives would become stronger and stronger. On the contrary, the technological Arms of humans would fall further and further behind. Unless a Mechanic developed technological Arms that could use laws and change them, but was that possible?
“The next target is Dragon Palace City!”
Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog swallowed a mouthful of pollution source, and after the other swallowed a mouthful of meteorite fragments, their expressions suddenly changed.
They raised their heads and looked higher into the sky coldly.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, a huge explosion sounded. Space and time trembled, and endless spatial flux swept and wreaked havoc in the deep sea space crack, making the place they were in instantly extremely dangerous!
“Let’s go!” The two demigods sensed that the surrounding environment was gradually deteriorating. They immediately followed the flux and ran to the surface of the sea!
Splash!!!
Space shattered.
Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, who were like demon gods, were forced out of the deep space crack and appeared on the sea. Then, they immediately looked at the culprit behind all of this.
The sea trembled. Vortex, tsunami, black clouds, and thunder instantly dyed this place into an apocalypse environment.
When they saw the battleship in the sky above the island and the young man standing at the front of the battleship, they revealed shocked expressions.
Boom!
Under the gloomy sky, golden lightning struck down, illuminating Shi Yu’s face. One person and two demigods were broadcasted live to the Seven Nation Alliance by Ling.
At this moment, under the environment, not only were Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog like demon gods, but Shi Yu, who was standing opposite them, also had an aura like a demon god and was not at a disadvantage.
At this moment, the hearts of the experts of the various countries immediately accelerated. They completely didn’t expect that Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog that the seven countries couldn’t find previously had actually been really found and forced out by Dong Huang.
So what was going on now… Could it be that a demigod crusade was really about to begin!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1165 - 1165 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle!
chapters.content:
1165 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle!
No human had dared to look down at the two incomparably huge monster demigods so calmly from a high place.
Regardless of success or failure, Shi Yu’s magnificent feat was enough to be recorded in the history of the Alliance. It could be said to be a model of using his life to posture.
The experts of the entire Alliance widened their eyes and looked at the live broadcast in front of them, afraid that they would miss a scene.
A demigod battle of this scale had probably only happened a few times since the end of the Mythical Era!
“Shi Yu!!!”
At this moment, after discovering that the person behind this and forcing them to appear was Shi Yu, Yun An’s anger rose.
Boom!!!
The demon god-like aura shook the sky and earth, making the tsunami even more Berserking, making the sky tremble even more.
Energy value, 3.32 billion!
Shi Yu stared at Yun An’s normal energy level that was not even as high as Eleven’s regular energy level, his expression unchanged.
This was also normal. After all, Eleven had too many physique skills. There were a total of five transcendent top-notch super physique skills. Its terrifying physique brought shocking energy.
Apart from that, the prototype of a top-notch divine skill was not something Yun An could compare to.
Energy value, 2.96 billion!
As for the Abyss Demon Frog, it was a little inferior to Yun An, but among demigods, it was definitely incomparably powerful.
However, it wasn’t enough to leave alive today!
At this moment, the surging energy tide turned into a Demon God aura that swept over. Shi Yu looked at Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog calmly.
“Aren’t you guys looking for me?”
“Now, I’m here.”
“It’s Shi Yu!!!” The Abyss Demon Frog never expected that the human chosen by the Blue Sea Sprite would actually dare to come personally.
Endless killing intent lingered around its black water elemental body, forming a dark red aura that shook space.
“Be careful, there’s a trap.” Although Yun An was even angrier than the Abyss Demon Frog and wanted to kill Shi Yu more, it was too strange for Shi Yu to come knocking on his door.
Being touched at home made Yun An feel that there were at least two digits of demigods hiding around!
“What’s there to be afraid of!”
No matter how many strong enemies were hiding around, this was the best time for them to hunt the Blue Sea Sprite!
On this sea, if it wanted to leave, could anyone stop it, a water-element demigod!
In fact.
Yun An’s worry was right.
Although there weren’t two-digit demigods waiting for them, there was indeed an existence they couldn’t afford to offend.
A black and white panda pulled Shi Yu’s clothes and climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder. It looked at Yun An opposite it with a burning gaze.
“Wuu! (Your opponent is me.)”
demigod Eleven appeared just like that.
No one expected this.
It wasn’t the Dragon God or the Divine Source Legendary. Just as Shi Yu had said, it seemed like he really wanted to crusade against the two demigods alone.
The pet-like Iron-eating Beast stood on Shi Yu’s shoulder and challenged the two peak battle power of Blue Planet.
“Huh??”
In response to Eleven, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog’s puzzled voices sounded.
As expected, there was a trap.
Be it Yun An or the Abyss Demon Frog, they didn’t believe that Shi Yu had overestimated himself to challenge them alone.
But in fact, at the start, no one else attacked.
The Iron-eating Beast that was really only on Shi Yu’s shoulder jumped onto the railing of the battleship’s deck alone. Then, it exerted strength with its feet and suddenly jumped into the sky from the battleship.
Looking at the little guy in the sky, Yun An was furious.
This guy must have eaten a lot of its fragments.
It could feel it!
Damn it.
“Roar!!” In its roar and anger, its body changed at the same time as it attacked. The black metal prism all over its body flowed and turned into a huge Orc form with two feet. It stretched out a huge palm with three claws and swept at the little Iron-eating Beast.
An earth-shattering divine might swept up.
Boom!!!
The spatial tide erupted in chaos again.
A colorless mist wrapped around Yun An’s entire body, and the sound of laws that resounded through the world erupted.
Quasi-divine skill!
It used a divine skill killer move the moment he came up. Everyone’s pupils constricted, but they saw that there was no other battle power to support this Iron-eating Beast at all!
Could it be…
A ridiculous guess appeared in everyone’s hearts.
It wanted to fight the half-god Yun An alone!
The monster Iron-eating Beast that had once defeated the Mythical Race’s overlord-level Ancient God Golden Bull in Inatella issued a challenge to the Mythical Race’s totem-level cosmic life form!
“Roar!!!!!”
In the sky, Eleven looked straight at Yun An’s violent attack. A terrifying Wex light rose in Eleven’s gaze.
Its body kept multiplying, and its sharpness erupted, directly entering the peak state!
The transcendent Inner Power and terrifying explosive power accumulated in his body and overloaded his body. However, at the same time, the Restoration Effect brought by the transcendent Indestructible Golden Body and the eruption of overload reached a Balance in his body.
Under the enhancement of the Thunder God Armor, the Leaving Gold Battle Body, and the Demon God Body, Eleven actually didn’t use divine skills at this moment. Just its physical strength alone had battle power comparable to a Fusion Emperor.
This was the powerful battle power increase brought by the combination of the top-notch skill in the Skill Index.
Eleven looked at Yun An.
The king of the Yun Race.
He, the Panda King, got food!
Let’s fight to our heart’s content.
The loser would become food.
As Eleven roared into the sky, the black and white electric arcs that filled the sky seemed to have become Eleven’s hair. They kept floating like a chaotic ocean.
In the sky, Eleven was like a Behemoth walking out of the chaos lightning sea, like the first Chaos Thunder God after the creation of the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1166 - 1166 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (2)
chapters.content:
1166 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (2)
It fell towards Yun An. At the same time, a circular metal formed in its palm. The metal was black and white, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.
At this moment, a god-like aura also erupted from Eleven’s body, shaking the sky and earth. A vast universe swept through the entire sea area.
Yun An, who originally didn’t take Eleven seriously, suddenly had a drastic change in expression as Eleven also erupted with all its strength and displayed a quasi-divine skill.
Demigod power?!
At this moment, light and darkness were twins. Eleven, who was covered in the chaos lightning sea, completely exceeded Yun An’s expectations. Its strength shocked it!
Boom!!!
Eleven pinched the Yin Yang Millstone and turned it into a fist, directly smashing it at Yun An’s Annihilation Divine Skill!!
Laws collided!
A terrifying energy tide instantly shot into the sky and the deep sea, causing the entire ocean and sky to fall into an unprecedented chaotic stage. It was like the explosion of the seven forbidden Arms previously, shocking the world!!
The moment the two Skills came into contact, the ocean current was incomparably violent. The atmospheric disturbance in the sky began to circulate around the world. Tingxiang, Snowfield, Seven Islands, Rongguang, Ming Hua, Dong Huang, and experts from all over the world looked in the direction of the battle with this attack and revealed incredulous expressions.
As for the reincarnation gods and totem half-gods who had never come into contact with the live broadcast, they also flew into the sky with this attack and looked at the Western Demon Sea.
In the depths of the Ghost Sea, the demigod Juggernaut of the Ghost Sea was directly shocked and looked at the sky.
“What happened? Who’s fighting?! They dare to fight in my territory?!”
In the incomplete era before the Restoration of Blue Planet, a demigod-level battle was already an existence that could disturb the planet.
“Bastard!!!” At this moment, in the collision with Eleven’s skill, Yun An was shocked to discover that his power of laws was being obliterated by the other party.
Crack!!!
Yun An’s palm was directly broken like beans on a millstone under the Yin Yang Millstone.
Then, a terrifying destructive power began to follow its arm and obliterate Yun An’s entire body. Under Yun An’s shocked expression, one of its arms completely shattered. Right on the heels of that, half of its body began to crack.
At this moment, Eleven’s fist had already landed on Yun An.
Under an incomparable impact, its city-like body was directly smashed down from midair by the Chaos Panda in front of it!!
“Roar!!!” In the sky, Eleven, who had punched its opponent, let out a roar that shook the sky and earth.
As for Yun An, who was sent flying, his eyes were absent-minded. He felt his body fall apart and found it difficult to accept.
Bang!!!
A tsunami and vortex swept up in all directions, and Yun An was directly thrown into the deep sea!!
In an instant, the world fell silent. All the Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast revealed incredulous expressions.
It also made the Abyss Demon Frog beside him widen its eyes in a daze!!
Was this still the King of the Yun Race who resisted the forbidden weapon with him?
“Yun An, what are you doing!!”
It shouted in panic. Even in the face of the siege of multiple demigods, it wouldn’t be so panicked.
However, seeing its partner heavily injured by only one enemy in one hit was really difficult for the Abyss Demon Frog to understand. Didn’t it eat!!
Boom!
Just as the Abyss Demon Frog finished speaking, water elements condensed in the sky, forming a Holy phantom!
An energy wave as deep as the ocean triggered the sound of laws.
A water-blue palm formed by water directly slapped at the Abyss Demon Frog, making the Abyss Demon Frog raise its head in shock. Its body rumbled!
A quasi-divine skill exclusive to Abyss demigods, Abyss Heart!!!
But in the next moment, the Abyss Demon Frog that erupted with an incomparably huge abyssal power directly slapped down on this spot. The power was obliterated with a sharp sizzling sound and white light.
Its body also seemed to have disintegrated, shattering into black water droplets that filled the sky!!
In a short instant of collision, an energy tide that shook the sky and earth interfered with the world again. The sky and sea were instantly in chaos.
Boom!!!
At the same time, the god-like Chaos Panda, Eleven, landed heavily on the island.
The appearance of the Blue Sea Sprite, known as the Blue Sea Saintess, also completely appeared in midair.
In one round, both Eleven and Susu caused crushing damage to the enemy.
Eleven was really strong.
As for Susu, it was still a little short of the peak. However, its current strength was not fake. This was the peak state Susu had entered after eating the divine-level Time Fruit strengthened by the quasi-divine skill, World Grace!
Coupled with its unlimited energy, it was a demigod at this explosive stage!
“Are the two of you only at this level?”
At this moment, two demigod battle power appeared under Shi Yu’s battleship in the sky. The Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast looked at the extremely arrogant Shi Yu and were shocked to the extreme.
What happened?
Not to mention them, even the Dragon God and Divine Source Legendary, who had been pulled over by Shi Yu to hold the fort, watched everything in silence.
Divine Source Legendary was stunned. Although, even if, even though, could it be… He kept analyzing in his mind.
Even if he broke through to the demigod level, wasn’t this too fierce?
The corners of the gem cat girl’s mouth also twitched. Why did she feel that Eleven and the Blue Sea Sprite, demigods, were so much stronger than her?

chapters.title: Chapter 1167 - 1167 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (3)
chapters.content:
1167 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (3)
“Wahaha.” The Prediction Owl was excited. This was Yun An? This was the Abyss Demon Frog?
Eleven and Susu’s attack undoubtedly injured Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog. However, Shi Yu, who had really fought Yun An in ancient times, knew that this kind of injury was far from fatal to demigod-level Elemental life forms.
In the deep sea, Yun An suddenly widened his eyes with a shocked expression.
It couldn’t believe what it had just experienced. It didn’t understand why it felt a threat comparable to a peak-level Emperor Wu with just “one” human pet.
“Roar!!!” In the deep sea, it roared angrily and let its body fall into the deep sea, letting the seawater cool down its brain.
During this period, countless Dark Gold Elementals condensed. The injuries on its body and its shattered arm recovered again. However, at this moment, Yun An’s eyes only had the intention to retreat and had no intention of fighting anymore.
It was too fast. This Shi Yu’s growth speed was too fast. He was clearly only a level-seven legend a few days ago. Why did he nurture demigod-level battle power in just a few days!!
Moreover, it was a demigod with very ridiculous battle power!
Yun An felt that as a cosmic life form demigod, it was already strong enough. In the end, that Iron-eating Beast directly made it understand what a father was.
At that time, he indeed should have directly gotten lost from Blue Planet!
Yun An indeed didn’t want to fight anymore, but it had forgotten something important. The sea was the territory of the Blue Sea Sprite.
Even if it evolved into an underwater battle ability, its little water-element attainments still could only submit to Susu, who had signed a contract with the sea.
Boom!!!
Yun An, who originally wanted to leave directly, suddenly felt a powerful rejection from the deep sea. It was a demigod-level rejection, and the sea was rejecting everything about it.
The incomparable repulsive force directly rejected Yun An into the sea. This repulsive force shocked Yun An.
“No!!!”
“I’m not going!!”
On the sea, apart from Yun An, the Abyss Demon Frog that had just been sent flying also wanted to slip away immediately.
“Blue Sea Guardian!!!”
“It’s recovered to its peak?!!” Although the Abyss Demon Frog had never fought the Blue Sea Sprite, it had heard that the Abyss Sea had been destroyed by the Blue Sea Sprite countless times.
They had natural fear of the Blue Sea Sprite.
It understood that it was still a step slower. It hated itself for not waking up earlier and not being able to resolve the Blue Sea Sprite’s growth state earlier.
Sensing the current demigod-level power state of the Blue Sea Sprite, it completely lost the intention to resist like Yun An. It only wanted to hide until the Abyss Evil God returned to preside over the situation.
The black water droplets that filled the sky directly flew into the sky. They didn’t choose the sea, but even in the sky, there was no way to escape!
Zi!!!
When it touched the Four Holy Barrier created by Buggy and Ling with the help of faith equipment, the Abyss Demon Frog’s body seemed to be on fire in an instant, and it was forced to reveal its original form in pain.
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!!” Under the monstrous water, Yun An was immediately forced back into the sky like a drenched chicken.
The Abyss Demon Frog and Yun An appeared in the same frame again. They took deep breaths hurriedly and looked at the Beast Tamer standing on the battleship in the sky opposite with shock, as well as the two demigod lives beside him.
“Alright, looks like you’ve already understood that this is only a conventional 2VS2.”
“Then please me to your heart’s content,” Shi Yu said. “Since you want to find me so much, I’ll play with you until I’m satisfied.”
“Roar!!!” Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog on the other side cursed.
2VS2 my ass.
At this moment, the situation was extremely dangerous. Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog suddenly regretted provoking Shi Yu.
This guy was simply not human.
Which Beast Tamer contracted two demigod-level battle power?
Yun An recalled the powerful Emperor Wu. As a Legendary Beast Tamer, that guy only had nine pets fused. Only then he had demigod battle power!
In the end, Shi Yu alone had demigod battle power!
“The other party indeed came prepared. A barrier has been set up around them. If we don’t break it, we can’t leave,” the Abyss Demon Frog said.
“I #@%￥@￥#” Yun An cursed.
“Let’s fight with all our might. Break the barrier and leave this place.” At this moment, Yun An no longer had any other thoughts. His first thought was to leave.
So far, apart from Shi Yu and his pet, Yun An had yet to sense the battle power of other Legendary demigods.
However, it was worried that after a long time, other Legendary demigods would come.
At that time, it would really be over.
From the looks of it, this Shi Yu had really challenged them alone.
Although it had indeed displayed an extremely terrifying strength that was enough to suppress their strength…
“Roar!!!” At this moment, sensing the threat, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog knew that they couldn’t continue fighting Shi Yu conventionally.
After Yun An roared, he directly chose to sacrifice all his subordinates!!
At this moment, in various places on Blue Planet, the pupils of the Yun clan members who had received the power of Yun An, from the black giant ape with the strength of a top-notch totem to the ordinary Beast Tamers who had received the power of Yun An, darkened, and they revealed shocked expressions. All the strength in their bodies was drained, and they instantly became like dried corpses.
At the same time, Yun An’s strength rose steadily, making Eleven, who was opposite him, reveal a serious and excited expression.
Becoming stronger?
This was more interesting.
As for the Abyss Demon Frog, it used the Abyss Heart that Shi Yu and the others were familiar with. This abyss quasi-divine skill that contained the corrosion law and relied on sacrificing rationality to exchange for stronger strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1168 - 1168 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (4)
chapters.content:
1168 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (4)
Just now, when the Abyss Demon Frog used this move, it maintained a state where it could maintain its rationality. In this situation, it no longer cared about rationality.
It directly wore the super divine-level resource, the Eye of the Evil God!
Only an obsession to rush out was left. Then, it activated all the abyssal power.
It would completely sacrifice its rationality! Only in this way would there be hope of resisting the demigod-level Blue Sea Sprite.
Boom!!!
Be it the eruption of Yun An or the Abyss Demon Frog, it triggered an extremely large area of change in the world.
When the master demigod of the Ghost Sea finally arrived from the deep sea territory, he directly saw an extremely shocking scene in the sky.
An Iron-eating Beast that looked like a Chaos Thunder God directly endured the Annihilation Claw from the demigod of the Sky Meteorite Race from the bottom up.
Just as the terrifying wave was about to shatter the island under the iron-eating beast’s feet, the divine power immediately turned the island land into a metal arena, impregnable.
Boom!!!
Only the aftermath that was enough to sweep through the entire world was left, sweeping in all directions unscrupulously. At this moment, the Ghost Sea demigod finally knew what the battle fluctuations it sensed were.
“Demigod Iron-eating Beast, Yun An, how is this possible?” It was shocked.
In addition, what shocked it was the Blue Sea Sprite that had turned into the form of a Water Slime again. Like a great demon king, it opened its mouth and infinitely swallowed the stronger abyssal power emitted by the Abyss Demon Frog.
At this moment, the Abyss Demon Frog had indeed lost its mind. However, its body’s instinct was still warning it not to provoke the Blue Sea Sprite that was in an explosive state with the divine-level Time Fruit!
At this moment, Susu chose the shortest battle method and turned into the Devouring Demon King, directly devouring the other party’s skills and even the other party’s main body into its stomach.
Its strongest cleansing power was still in the Devouring Space that connected to the sea. As long as it directly swallowed the Abyss Demon Frog, it could instantly cleanse the other party with the combination skill of Infinite Devour, the Blue Sea Contract, and the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
At the same time, it could also prevent the Eye of the Evil God from running away again!
Eat! Eat!
“Blue Sea Sprite, Abyss half-god!” The Ghost Sea half-god was stunned. What happened? Who could tell it!
At this moment, an unprecedented battle was taking place in the Demon Sea.
The Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast completely lost their ability to think.
Especially the Human Legendarys. Looking at the Iron-eating Beast that fought crazily with Yun An with one claw and the skill of chasing after to devour it, and even the Blue Sea Sprite that wanted to devour the frog’s main body, their brains went blank.
As Yun An recalled all its strength, Eleven felt that they were evenly matched. It knew that even if Yun An, who had lived for more than ten thousand years, slept most of the time, it couldn’t be this weak.
“Wuu!!!” As Eleven roared, its body gradually shrank and compressed its strength in exchange for a stronger eruption.
Soon, it shrank to a hundred meters.
“Wu ah!!” During the process of being shattered by Eleven’s attacks consecutively, Yun An was also compressing his body to avoid too many body fragments being knocked away!!
At this moment, the rational Yun An only wanted to scold Shi Yu.
Look, what kind of pets did he raise?
The Blue Sea Sprite chased after the Abyss Demon Frog to Devour. The Blue Sea Sprite actually wanted to eat the abyssal power that other lives couldn’t dodge in time?
It remembered that according to the rumors, this was not how the Blue Sea Sprite cleansed the power of the abyss!
How exactly did this Beast Tamer nurture the Blue Sea Sprite!
As for this Iron-eating Beast, as soon as it knocked away its fragments, it immediately opened its mouth and directly used its magnetic force to attract it to Devour.
Moreover, its digestion was incomparably fast, making it really difficult for Yun An to understand.
Even Emperor Wu’s Iron-eating Beast wasn’t that fierce.
The current Yun An felt that this Iron-eating Beast was chasing after him to eat! It wasn’t a battle at all!!
This guy would rather be injured and destroy its fragment, and Yun An also discovered that its attack on it was like a scratch!
Yun An remembered that because the Iron-eating Beast had a bunch of explosive skills, its body couldn’t withstand much burden. However, this one became more and more spirited the more it fought. Apart from damage, its attacks could actually recover the other party’s health.
In addition, the other party ate the fragments to replenish its energy. Yun An really didn’t know how to fight.
Ridiculous.
At this moment, it wasn’t just Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog who were indescribably miserable. Many Beast Tamers who were watching the crusade between the King of the Yun Race and the Abyss demigod were also at a loss when they saw such a crushing and violent battle Style.
“That Iron-eating Beast… is eating Yun An!!!”
“The Blue Sea Sprite too!!! After devouring the Abyss Skill, it completed the cleansing!!”
“Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog didn’t resist the whole time!!”
“Heavens, the battle power of two demigods is actually the battle power of two demigods. That Shi Yu has two demigod pets!”
“Moreover, it’s not an ordinary demigod. It’s a super battle power that can suppress the cosmic demigod and the abyss demigod!”
At this moment, the world was shocked by Shi Yu’s strength. The demigods who couldn’t see the live broadcast sensed the shocking battle fluctuations coming from afar. They were also secretly shocked and didn’t understand what had happened.
He hurriedly gathered his subordinates and activated the information network to obtain information.
At this moment, Legendary Wexy, who was also a World Blesser like Shi Yu, was already stunned.
What a joke. Wasn’t this guy just a legend a few days ago? He suddenly exceeded a group of Legendarys!
He couldn’t accept this scene. F*ck! Could this be a f*cking video!

chapters.title: Chapter 1169 - 1169 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (5)
chapters.content:
1169 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (5)
Boom!!!
A weak earthquake caused by the aftermath of the battle came, making Legendary Wexy suddenly wake up. His eyelids twitched.
“Hahahahahaha!!!”
At this moment, because Eleven had swallowed too many meteorite fragments, the power of light on its body had already been suppressed by the power of darkness.
The current Eleven began to completely rely on the power of the Dark Demon God to fight Yun An, who was also a Dark Demon God. It began to enjoy the battle, enjoy eating, and rely on the enemy to train itself.
Demon God Eleven was a hundred meters tall, and its body was covered in black lightning. It was difficult to see clearly, and its entire body emitted terrifying dark magic power, as if it was a new Demon God.
As for Yun An opposite it, its dark aura was even above Eleven. It was the source of Eleven’s power.
“What a joke. You want to defeat me with dark-element power?!” Hot clay still had 30% of fire. The current Yun An’s will to escape had already weakened after being humiliated by the enemy. Instead, endless battle Resistance emitted.
During the battle between the two Demon Gods, the Prediction Owl suddenly felt that the scene in front of it was actually not much different from the scene it had predicted. It couldn’t help but be stunned and laugh crazily.
Its aura also rose steadily. The originally transcendent Future Prediction seemed to have been added two to three times, saving the owl a few years of bitter cultivation!!
Boom!!!
Under the lead of the upgrade of the Race Skill, the owl, which was undergoing a small breakthrough, felt that it had finally gone from the weakest totem ladder team to normal totem battle power!!
At the side, the gem cat girl was still immersed in the battle. She felt lonely. This battlefield… didn’t look like it needed her at all!!
However, it was indeed… The mission Shi Yu gave the gem cat was to use the nine-colored divine light to strengthen Ling and Buggy. Coupled with Ling’s nine-colored divine light, it would complete the double strengthening. This way, it could allow the Four Saints Domain to reach the strongest, preventing Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog from self-destructing and escaping.
Bang!!!
Bang!!!
Boom!!!
At this moment, Eleven, Yun An, the Abyss Demon Frog, and Susu could be said to be getting smaller and smaller as they fought.
As Shi Yu sensed that Susu’s eruption was about to end, he looked at Eleven, who was almost covered in injuries like Yun An, and said, “It’s about time. Let’s end the battle as soon as possible.”
“Roar!!!”
“Wuu!!!” Under the roars of Yun An and Eleven, Shi Yu’s voice was still especially clear.
At this moment, everyone was still immersed in the battle between the Iron-eating Beast and Yun An. Before they could react, they saw substantial mental fluctuations form black and white colors beside Shi Yu.
With his entire body wrapped in black and white energy, Shi Yu’s eyes quickly changed, directly turning into a spinning Taiji Painting. A vast and deep power bloomed from Shi Yu’s body!!
Buzz!
The sound of laws spread.
As Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun, a strong aura bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
An incomparably huge spinning Taiji Painting appeared in the sky and ground.
It shocked Yun An. He looked around and made Eleven stop fighting.
This scene…
The Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast swallowed their saliva again.
“I almost forgot. As a Beast Tamer, he hasn’t participated in the battle of pets!!”
The strengthening from Shi Yu was undoubtedly divine-level.
“Roar!!!” Eleven roared.
As it entered the Taiji Domain, the black and white Yin Yang Fish lingered beside Demon God Eleven and awakened its power of light again, causing the power of light and darkness on its body to reach harmony. An even greater power bloomed from Eleven’s body, making Yun An reveal a shocked expression.
“Wu wu wu wu wu!!!” Yun An cursed. F*ck, which dog said it was a fair one-on-one!!
Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!!!
Under the enhancement of the Taiji Domain, Eleven, who had recovered its strength and was strengthened, enlarged again. Its strength suddenly increased. A monstrous palm directly slapped Yun An, who was only more than ten meters tall, on the Taiji Painting.
Boom!!!
Under Yun An’s frightened expression, it was directly suppressed by the huge multiplication palm that contained the power of light and darkness, and its body shattered again.
“Ah!!!”
Yun An’s miserable cry resounded through the world.
“Yun An was suppressed again!” The experts watching the live broadcast were stunned.
On the other side, the Abyss Demon Frog, which was suppressed by the laws of the Taiji Domain and had little strength left, suddenly recovered its consciousness. Then, it also revealed an extremely shocked expression and looked at the drastic change in the environment.
Opposite it, Susu was also panting. The Little Water Slime puffed up its face. The power of the Time Fruit gradually disappeared. At the moment, it only left two demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirits to cleanse its opponent.
“Quack!!!” At this moment, the Abyss Demon Frog sensed its surprisingly poor state and swept its gaze at Yun An, who was suppressed under its palm. It went crazy.
“Yun An, wake up!!! This can’t go on!!!”
“I know!!!” There was already nothing under Eleven’s palm. In midair, Yun An Elementalized into his original body again and appeared beside the Abyss Demon Frog, panting.
It hated the Abyss Demon Frog very much now, but it also knew that if it didn’t cooperate with the Abyss Demon Frog at this moment, it would probably be difficult to break out of the situation.
“Self-destruct.”
“Self-destruct.”
However, after snuggling together, the only way to break out of the situation was to self-destruct.

chapters.title: Chapter 1170 - 1170 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (6)
chapters.content:
1170 Shi Yu’s God Sealing Battle! (6)
That barrier was enough to stop demigods. They kept trying during the battle and couldn’t escape at all. They probably could only rely on the power of self-destruction to break the barrier and use the speciality of the elemental creatures to complete their rebirth in the future Mythical descent era.
If the two of them self-destructed together, they could definitely escape!
“Humans, you forced me!!!” Yun An’s gaze was filled with hatred and brutality. He also hated Shi Yu and the Iron-eating Beast to the core.
“To that human!!!” The Abyss Demon Frog roared. If it wanted to self-destruct, it had to self-destruct beside Shi Yu!
It was best to blow Shi Yu up!!
“This!!!” The scene in front of them was an extremely magical scene for anyone. This was because the Yun Race demigod and the Abyss demigod who had previously disturbed the world were actually forced to self-destruct??
“What a joke.” In Shen Feng Nation, Legendary Z looked at Shi Yu’s god-like calm expression on the live broadcast and suddenly shook his head.
Were these two demigods stupid? This little pervert could crush them with just two pets.
How could he not be prepared for a self-destruction attack?
If he couldn’t suppress the self-destruction, he would have already suffered a self-destruction attack at the Alliance Meeting!!
It could only be said that the current Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog were completely desperate times calling for desperate measures, a drowning man will clutch at a straw.
It was almost irrational.
Boom!!!
Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog underwent their final eruption. The energy in their bodies rose steadily, and the energy in their bodies began to expand, integrating into their bodies and burning their lives. At the same time, they rushed towards Shi Yu, who was maintaining the Taiji Domain!!
It was so fast that it swept past Eleven and Susu!!
Regarding this, Eleven didn’t say anything. It directly sighed and returned to its restrained form. It was exhausted. It was finally done fighting.
It put its finger in its mouth. Strange, it had clearly eaten a lot, so why was it still starving to death…
Dragging its hungry stomach, it, Susu, and all the Beast Tamers watching the live broadcast looked at the two demigods attacking Shi Yu!!
“Die!!!” Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog shouted crazily!!!
It charged towards the battleship in the sky!!!
However, in the next moment, they were like deflated balloons. The energy that had just swelled up and wanted to self-destruct was instantly suppressed!!
“Ji.” In the cockpit, Buggy let out a mocking cry. Tch, it didn’t learn.
Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng originally wanted to come out of the battleship to protect Shi Yu and show their faces, but they were pressed down by a certain cat.
At that moment, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog could be said to be completely stunned. Sensing that the power of their self-destruction was also suppressed, they were stunned. Their expressions gradually collapsed, and their mentalities gradually exploded!!
“Wu wu wu wu wu wu!!!” As Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog roared in anger and collapsed, although they couldn’t self-destruct, they still attacked Shi Yu.
At this moment, a stunning cat girl walked out from beside Shi Yu. She shook her head and yawned lazily. “Is it over?”
“So slow. If I had attacked earlier, these two little guys would have been suppressed long ago.”
“A mere Abyss demigod…”
She stretched out her yawning palm and opened her blue gem eyes. She looked at the attacking Enfeebled Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog and applied for a showing off opportunity from Chi Tong and Baby Ginseng.
In the face of the attacking Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, she casually waved her hand. Two nine-colored gems tore through the air and emitted a shocking light. With a pop, they triggered the sound of laws and emitted a terrifying demigod-level power, making the expressions of the weak Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog change drastically!!
“Demigod!!!”
Another demigod!!!
Boom!!!
At this moment, the weak them were unable to resist the wishing star divine skill strengthened by the nine-colored divine light at all. The nine-colored gem in the void instantly enlarged, like a five-finger mountain, suppressing them!!
Under everyone’s incredulous expressions, with a bang, the two demigods were directly pressed onto the metal island by the nine-colored gem divine mountain!!
Boom!!!
Dust and smoke scattered!! Metal shattered!!!
“What a joke, another demigod!!! Who is this cat girl!!! Where did she come from!!!”
“I’ve never seen it before!!”
Countless people looked at the beautiful demigod cat girl beside Shi Yu. They never expected that from the beginning to the end, there was actually a demigod battle power beside Shi Yu!!
“This cat girl, could it be…” The pupils of the experts of Dong Huang, like legends of the Tyrannical Sea, constricted.
He thought of the Guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University who often followed beside Shi Yu… It was unlikely.
Now, with the demigod cat girl’s attack, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog were really at the end of their strength.
However, the matter was not over at all. Through the live broadcast, everyone saw an incomparably large Blue Sea palm appear again. The Blue Sea Sprite, which was ten thousand meters tall, used its vast palm to pinch Yun An and the Blue Sea Demon Frog from under the nine-colored gem divine mountain into its palm.
“Next, just leave it to Susu to cleanse.” Shi Yu exited the Taiji Domain state and sighed.
Then, he smiled and glanced at the live broadcast camera.
“Everyone, as expected, I’ll take down the Yun Race demigod and the Abyss demigod.”
“I only hope… that next time, no one will use me and my pets as a provocation.”
“Otherwise, be it a totem half-god or a reincarnation god, I’ll go take a look at your territory.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the hearts of the Beast Tamers of the various countries skipped a beat. What a joke, what a joke!!!
That Yun Race demigod, that Abyss demigod, was so easily…
Was the cat girl beside him also Shi Yu’s pet?!!! Everyone realized that the skill used by the cat girl just now seemed to be a little like the nine-colored divine light of the Holy Divine Deer!!
Didn’t Shi Yu obtain the inheritance crystal of the nine-colored divine light!!
If that was the case, everyone couldn’t describe the emotions in their hearts. This Shi Yu, one person, three demigods, and another bunch of abnormal pets… Didn’t that mean that he had already stood at the top of Blue Planet!!
No one was confident of defeating Shi Yu in this battle.
At this moment, even peak experts like the Seven Islands Valkyrie, the Elven Empress of Tingxiang, the Ming Hua Ghost God, the Shen Feng Mechanical Legendary, the Snowfield Battle God, and the Rongguang Hero King had to admit that the terrifying power displayed by Shi Yu in this battle was something they couldn’t compare to.
Boom!!!
The Void was torn apart, and the peerless Dragon God walked out in silence. Dong Huang’s Divine Source Legendary also appeared in the live broadcast. They looked at the suppressed Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog together.
“Not bad.” The Dragon God couldn’t help but praise Shi Yu, who was still a young newbie two years ago.
“Looks like it’s time to give up the position.” Divine Source Legendary also sighed deeply before the global live broadcast.
At this moment, the battle power of the five demigods of Dong Huang was in the same frame, making the various countries grimace even more. Beside them, the half-god of the Ghost Sea trembled even more, not daring to come out, afraid that Dong Huang would fuss about him not helping against the Yun Race and the Abyss.
It clearly had the battle power of five demigods, but did it mean that Shi Yu alone could suppress everything!!
The appearance of the Dragon God and Divine Source also made Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, who were gradually losing consciousness, twitch. It turned out that they had been in checkmate from the start…
Humans didn’t know any virtues at all.
Five demigods!!! How could there be such a ridiculous faction!!
In August of the 180th year of the Alliance calendar, a demigod battle that shocked Blue Planet happened. The world legend, Shi Yu, killed two foreign demigods alone and shook the world!!
….
A few hours later, the totem demigods and reincarnation gods who didn’t see the live broadcast also learned about the world-shaking battle that happened in the Western Demon Sea through their respective channels.
Shi Yu sent out two demigod battle power and easily suppressed the king of the Yun clan, Yun An, an ancient demigod of the abyss!!
Many demigods were shocked.
Many reincarnation gods revealed shocked expressions. The humans blessed by the World Tree were actually so ferocious?
In the Western Dragon Empire, the Black Dragon Juggernaut, who had been watching Dong Huang make a fool of itself these days, heard the information of its subordinates and its expression instantly changed drastically in disbelief.
In the Eastern Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King, who originally wanted to break through to the demigod level and was no longer afraid of Dong Huang, heard the news of its subordinates and its brain rumbled, almost fainting.
“Shi Yu… That Shi Yu destroyed two demigods?? How is that possible!!! Don’t even think about lying to me!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1171 - 1171 Starry Sky Era (1)
chapters.content:
1171 Starry Sky Era (1)
The battle in the Western Demon Sea shook the world.
As for Shi Yu himself, after reporting his safety to the Dragon God, Divine Source Legendary, and the others, he entered Susu’s body.
At this moment, in the Infinite Devour Space, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog had already fainted. They were imprisoned in a huge water cage formed by the Sea Cleansing Spirit and received the Purification Purification.
“Ning!” Eleven entered with Shi Yu.
At this moment, it was also covered in injuries. The injuries were similar to the injuries suffered by Emperor Wu and the others. They were incurable injuries.
After a huge battle, it was still inevitable that it would be attacked many times. Although it could also use the Yin Yang Millstone to obliterate the negative laws later, it was clearly easier to cleanse it with the endless energy of Susu.
“Wuu! (Thank you, Susu.)” Eleven bowed.
Susu was condensing a shower arm to nurture water to wash away the radiation for Eleven.
“Ning. (Is the temperature alright?)”
“Wuu! (I want hot water!)”
Shi Yu’s gaze was staring at Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog.
“Unfortunately, Yun An’s elemental core is a good thing. It’s equivalent to the best meteorite fragment. Coupled with a light-element divine-level metal resource, it must be a very good Eleven strengthening material.”
“But without this, there are no renewable resources. Forget it, I don’t lack a core. When I want it, I’ll go to parallel space and get it.”
“In short, there’s another Evil God’s Eye now. It’s not a loss at all!”
“Wu wu wu wu wu!!!”
“Ahhh!!”
As expected of demigods. They had only fainted for a few seconds before waking up under the powerful Resistance.
However, at this moment, more than half of their Unholy Resistance had already been Purification by Susu.
Next, it should be very easy to communicate.
[Susu: Be good, Demon Beast, Demon Beast. The dark power that corroded your rationality has been cleansed. Hurry up and become silly!]
At that moment, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog opened their eyes and felt the restraints of the surrounding Sea Cleansing Spirit. They panicked.
Now, their energy had been completely drained. Moreover, under the suppression of the Devour Space, they were unable to resist such a demigod-level Sea Cleansing Spirit.
Zizi!!!
The cleansing power was especially brutal.
“Shi Yu!!!”
Be it Yun An or the Abyss Demon Frog, they shouted Shi Yu’s name heartbreakingly.
Damn it, this human.
Now, Shi Yu had successfully advanced and become the person Yun An hated the most. He was even more hateful than Emperor Wu
This was because although Emperor Wu was hateful, at least he had been tortured to death by it. However, this Shi Yu made Yun An see no hope of defeating him.
“What do you want!!” The Abyss Demon Frog shouted.
It also regretted it.
Why did it take it so hard to find Yun An to hunt the Blue Sea Sprite!!
Looking at the Slime that bathed the panda, it only wanted to return to its newly awakened state and wait until the Mythical Era arrived, not appear too early.
“What do I want?” Shi Yu said. “The evil abyss faction can’t exist. It should have been cleansed in the first place.”
“Quack.”
Shi Yu’s summoning array appeared, and the Sea Cleansing Demon Duck appeared. After appearing, it immediately looked at the Abyss Demon Frog with red eyes.
“Quack!! (Yo! Your spirit is not bad. I’m the seventh battle power of the Shi Yu Guards, the ocean overlord. Nice to meet you.)”
Duckie said to the Abyss Demon Frog. Then, the power of the abyss lingered around its body.
Demon Frog: “?”
Sensing the cleansed abyssal power in its body and the huge abyssal power on the duck in front of it, the Demon Frog looked at the indifferent Blue Sea Sprite.
“Ahhh!!!” It struggled with all its might. They were f*cking double standards. It had a companion who was an abyss inheritance, but it wanted to exterminate the other abyss inheritances. It couldn’t afford to play anymore!!
“Quack!!” Duckie’s heart thumped. The quasi-divine skill of the Abyss Heart was activated. With Susu’s permission, it instantly passed through the Water Cage. The Water Technique Blade in its hand smoothly stabbed into one of the Abyss Demon Frog’s eyes. With a flash of light, it appeared behind the Abyss Demon Frog again.
At the same time, with the Demon Frog’s miserable cry, a black pearl-like eyeball appeared in Duckie’s hand.
Super divine-level resource, Eye of the Evil God!
Legend had it that it was the eye of the boss of the Abyss Race, the Abyss Evil God, who had invaded Blue Planet.
It was the culprit behind the inheritance of the Abyss Sea and the creation of countless Abyss demigods.
Generations of Blue Sea Sprites had tried to cleanse and seal it many times, but they had all failed.
It couldn’t be destroyed, and it was even harder to cleanse than the power of Yun An. It would only recognize its master in the hands of the Abyss Boss that had mastered the Heart of the Abyss. Otherwise, it would slowly disappear and be reborn elsewhere.
If he directly killed the Abyss Demon Frog, this Evil God Eye would probably disappear with it. Therefore, Shi Yu and the others had to let Duckie receive this super-divine resource.
“Ahhh! (Give me back my eye!!)” The Demon Frog roared, its eyes still flowing with water. They were black.
“Quack.” As for Duckie, it looked at this eyeball that contained the special power of the abyss and drooled. It didn’t feel that the other party was rejecting it.
Good job. With this as equipment, it could easily defeat the overlord of a mere land!!
In fact…
“This thing is too dangerous. You can’t leave it outside, and you can’t casually use it with you.” Shi Yu said to Duckie, “It’s not too late to give it to you when you can completely control it in the future.”
“At the moment, this is a research tool.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1172 - 1172 Starry Sky Era (2)
chapters.content:
1172 Starry Sky Era (2)
Duckie: QAQ.
“Ling has already developed a tool to preserve and seal the Eye of the Evil God to prevent it from disappearing. Now, it’s just short of one material to simulate the environment it needs.”
“That’s the elemental crystal of the Abyss Demon Frog. It can also be said to be the Heart of the Abyss.”
Abyss Demon Frog: Quack?
“Ahhh!!! (Wait, wait, wait!)” The Abyss Demon Frog was shocked. Beside it, Yun An was silent the whole time.
“Listen to me. Your name is Shi Yu, right! It’s the Blue Sea Sprite, right!! Since you contracted an abyss half-god of a certain generation, and since you’re willing to become companions with the abyss half-god, it means that you’re not pedantic at all!!”
“The Blue Sea Sprite is also more reasonable than I imagined.”
“Listen to me. There’s no need for us to become enemies at all. We can have a larger stage!! The Abyss Race is a very powerful faction in the starry sky of the universe. The Abyss Evil God is a super creature whose strength is even above the divine level!!”
“It’s far stronger than the gods on Blue Planet. If it weren’t for the fact that we’re fighting an away battle and fighting all the gods on Blue Planet alone, the Abyss Evil God wouldn’t have lost at all!! We have the inheritance of the Abyss Evil God, so it’s better to inherit the ambition of the Abyss Evil God. After controlling Blue Planet, we’ll rely on the abyss factions in the starry sky.”
“According to my investigation, the civilization of the abyssal factions is far higher than Blue Planet. They still exist! Yun An is the advance soldier they sent.” The Abyss Demon Frog shouted, “I’m also willing to accept the contract and acknowledge you as my master like that duck!!”
Susu: Angry.
It looked like the cleansing wasn’t complete. Although it had become silly, it was still bad.
Yun An: “How embarrassing.”
Duckie looked at the Demon Frog in disdain. “Quack! (Trash Abyss, my goal is to assist the big sister of the Blue Sea Sprite in cleansing all filth, especially the Abyss!!)”
Abyss Demon Frog: ???
Shi Yu chuckled and summoned the Sword Spirit Chi Tong in his hand. It turned into Chi Tong’s red hair and emitted endless killing intent.
“Wait!! No, no, I’m willing to rely on the Blue Sea Sprite. Trash Abyss, I also want to cleanse all filth!! From me, I’ve long been tired of this power that corrodes my rationality. I want to be myself!!” The Demon Frog roared.
“Sorry, I don’t like fence sitters.” As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation condensed and trapped the Abyss Demon Frog in the middle. The sharp sword light instantly erased any traces of existence other than its Elemental core.
Its body was obliterated, the Elemental Core was stripped away, and the Elemental Soul was imprisoned. Before it died, the Abyss Demon Frog still opened its eyes and looked at the duck, dying with grievances. Its mouth was open, as if it wanted to say something in the end… But from its expression, it didn’t look like it was saying good things.
Gulp.
The Abyss Demon Frog was killed, scaring Yun An beside it. Its heart also thumped, making Shi Yu think that it had also learned the Abyss Heart.
Yun An looked at Shi Yu and the others in shock, afraid that Shi Yu would also kill him with a sword.
“Don’t worry, I won’t kill you.” Shi Yu looked at Yun An, making him overjoyed.
It said, “That toad is right. Blue Planet is too small, far from your limit. Human, you’re the strongest Beast Tamer I’ve ever seen. I’m also willing to assist you. I’m a cosmic life form. In the future, I can bring you to the starry sky and dominate the universe!!!”
“What it knows is all from me!!”
Shi Yu said disdainfully, “You? Your race was destroyed by the army of a universe overlord. You’re just a child who escaped. What do you have to lead me to dominate the universe?”
Yun An widened his eyes.
“How do you know!!” It said in disbelief.
Then, it shouted, “It’s different, it’s different. The cosmic overlord is the strongest individual in the entire universe. Its army naturally looks down on everyone, far from what any Abyss Evil God can compare to. That’s not a goal that ordinary lives should have. Believe me, as long as you contract me, I can assist you in surpassing the divine level!!!”
“The starry sky of the universe is far vaster than Blue Planet.”
Shi Yu said, “It’s not like I don’t have cosmic life forms. I won’t kill you. Susu, continue to cleanse. From today onwards, Yun An, you will become the renewable food of Dong Huang’s Iron-eating Beast to atone for your sins.”
Yun An was stunned and shouted angrily, “Wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu wu!!”
Damn, you didn’t kill me because you wanted me to be a renewable resource?!?! How could there be someone like you?
“I won’t let you off!!”
“I’ll kill you!!” Yun An roared.
Shi Yu was speechless.
….
After some operations, Shi Yu and the others arranged Yun An, the Abyss Demon Frog, and the Eye of the Evil God.
After completing all of this, Shi Yu reappeared in the outside world.
He would meet Divine Source Legendary, the Gem Cat Lady, and the Dragon God.
At the moment, they were all on the aerial battleship and returning to Dong Huang.
