“Is it completely resolved?” On the battleship, Divine Source Legendary immediately asked when he saw Shi Yu come out.
“It’s already been resolved,” Shi Yu said. “The Abyss Demon Frog has been killed, and the Eye of the Evil God has been controlled. Yun An has completed the seal and will become the Iron-eating Beast’s renewable evolution resource!”
“Hahahaha, good, good.” Divine Source Legendary laughed.
Good kid!!
Shi Yu’s appearance could be said to have completely untied the knot in Divine Source Legendary’s heart about Lin Feng’s disappearance.
This guy was simply more outstanding than that little pervert, Lin Feng.
He was focused on increasing his battle power and was completely undisturbed by other things.
With legendary battle power in his early twenties, Dong Huang was completely rich.

chapters.title: Chapter 1173 - 1173 Starry Sky Era (3)
chapters.content:
1173 Starry Sky Era (3)
“Senior Divine Source, is what you said in the live broadcast true?” President Lin was currently presiding over Dong Huang, but he was connected to Divine Source Legendary the whole time and watching the live broadcast.
Similarly, he was stunned the whole time. He was completely stunned. He felt that the battle power Shi Yu displayed was even more terrifying than he described.
President Lin really found it difficult to believe that a person could be so abnormal. It was only when Divine Source Legendary said, “It’s time to give up the position” that President Lin woke up.
What position could he give up? Divine Source Legendary had long retreated behind the scenes. Regardless of national affairs, he was the only president of the Dong Huang Association left in the highest position. Could it be that Divine Source Legendary had specified to hand the position of president of the Dong Huang Association to Shi Yu??
Although President Lin suspected Shi Yu’s governance ability, if he could abdicate, he would be the first to agree. This was because after being kicked to the position of president of Dong Huang by Divine Source Legendary, he had been busy with national affairs and didn’t have time to cultivate at all. Now that the Mythical Revival had happened, although he was already old, it wasn’t impossible for him to break through to the Legendary or even the divine level.
If he still worked hard on national matters, it would definitely delay his cultivation speed again. Although his power was good, his strength was better. No matter how high his position was, he should be tired of it after staying for a hundred years.
“I’m just saying. With Shi Yu’s personality, he probably won’t like these, right?” Divine Source Legendary saw through people very clearly.
Shi Yu said, “Indeed.”
Of course, it was purely because he didn’t fancy it anymore. If he were to be the president of the Dong Huang Beast Tamer Association during his Beast Tamer intern period, Shi Yu would be a hundred times more willing.
“After this battle, even if Shi Yu wants to be the first president of the Blue Planet Alliance, no one will doubt him. Next, if nothing goes wrong, the Blue Planet Alliance can continue to develop very smoothly, and it’s led by Dong Huang. Kid Lin, I’ll leave this to you,” Divine Source Legendary said.
President Lin: … So the president of the Dong Huang Association is still me??
“President Dong Huang, it sounds very interesting. President Lin, if you don’t want to be president anymore, I can represent you for a few years.” Beside him, the gem cat girl licked her lips. Ever since she became stronger, she had become bolder.
What President Lin? No matter how strong President Lin was, could he defeat a demigod?!
In any case, she looked like a person now. It shouldn’t be a problem for her to be the president of the Beast Tamer Association of Dong Huang, right?
According to the public opinion, President Lin might not necessarily be able to defeat her.
“Ah, this, you want to be the president? Then I can be a think tank.” The owl that participated in the demigod crusade was also arrogant at this moment, willing to assist the gem cat girl in becoming the president of the Dong Huang Association.
President Lin and Divine Source Legendary: ???
The Dragon God: …
President Lin: “Forget it, I’ll do it myself.”
However, it was indeed time to nurture an heir. He thought for a moment. Lu Qingyi might be not bad. She was young and strong… She mainly had a close relationship with Shi Yu. She would definitely receive Shi Yu’s full help.
“By the way.” At this moment, the battle ended. Shi Yu looked at Divine Source Legendary, the Dragon God, and the others and said, “There’s something else I forgot to share with everyone.”
“What is it?” the gem cat girl said.
Shi Yu looked at the gem cat girl with an energy value of 23.33333 million.
“Yun An wasn’t sent by the Abyss Race that invaded Blue Planet in the Mythical Era,” Shi Yu said.
“However, it’s not wrong for it to be from the same race as the Abyss Race led by the Abyss Evil God. The Yun Race and the Abyss Race are all from the same large race, just like how tigers, lions, leopards, and gem cats are all felines.”
The gem cat: “?”
“Therefore, the relationship between Yun An and the Abyss Race isn’t as deep as we imagined. It’s not an invader from the Abyss Race who came to test Blue Planet, and the truth… is that it’s actually a cosmic life form that escaped!”
“Escape??” The Dragon God and the others couldn’t help but say. It was very difficult to associate the word escape with Yun An, who had grown to the point where demigods dominated the east.
“Yes, escape.” Shi Yu looked at the Dragon God with more than three billion energy points.
“Yun An was also a native race on a certain planet. There was a stronger cosmic faction that invaded their planet. Only then did it escape from that planet. At that time, Yun An, who was in the form of an egg, turned into a meteorite and began to wander in the starry sky. In the end, it landed on Blue Planet and evolved into a meteorite life form, becoming Yun An.”
“Yun An invades the lives of their planets and calls itself universe overlords. However, it’s not the universe overlords who personally invade their planets. The ones who invade are only the universe armies under the universe overlords.”
“What?!!” Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, the gem cat girl, the Prediction Owl, and the others were shocked.
This was completely different from their previous guess!!
They originally thought that Yun An was an investigation soldier sent by the former invasion faction, the Abyss, but… the truth was actually like this?
“Universe overlord, what’s that!!” The Prediction Owl was shocked.
Shi Yu shrugged and said, “I deduce that it’s probably a very powerful life form in the starry sky of the universe. To be called a cosmic overlord, it’s probably stronger than the Worm Empress, the Abyss Evil God, and the cosmic Behemoth that invaded Blue Planet.”
“Stronger than them?” President Lin was extremely serious. How was this possible?
The Worm Empress and the Abyss Evil God were the leaders of the cosmic factions that invaded Blue Planet during the Mythical Era. As for the cosmic Behemoth, it was only a single individual with no other clansmen. However, it was the strongest existence among the three.
It was also the existence that posed the greatest threat to Blue Planet.
The worm coveted the life nutrients of Blue Planet. The Abyss Evil God took a fancy to Blue Planet’s environment, and the cosmic Behemoth purely wanted to rely on Devour Planet to grow. Blue Planet’s laws were incomplete, and it contributed the most!

chapters.title: Chapter 1174 - 1174 Starry Sky Era (4)
chapters.content:
1174 Starry Sky Era (4)
These three lives were all stronger than a single top-notch god and were suspected to be above the divine level. Because of this, even if the leaders of the Blue Planet’s Dragon, Phoenix, Kirin, and Angel Demon were all top-notch gods, apart from that, even though there were still many individual top-notch gods… This battle still lasted for a long time.
They were already terrifying. Even the clansmen they created made the people of the Mythical Era suffer. They had divine-level battle power. President Lin really couldn’t imagine what kind of life form a universe overlord stronger than them was.
“It shouldn’t be fake,” Shi Yu said. “The concept of a cosmic overlord is deeply rooted in Yun An’s bloodline memories. That fear is as if it’s engraved in the depths of his bloodline. This also means that a cosmic overlord has been running rampant in the starry sky of the universe for at least countless years. It’s long been known for its ferocious reputation, making many cosmic life forms afraid.”
“Sigh, if the gods who left Blue Planet to go to the starry sky can return, perhaps they can bring more information,” Shi Yu said. “Perhaps after leaving for so long, the best of them have already exceeded the divine level and reached a higher realm.”
“However, I’m more worried that after they left Blue Planet, they no longer think that Blue Planet is their hometown or home. This situation… is very likely.” Shi Yu imagined the humans who went to big cities from remote places to hustle…
Divine Source Legendary looked at Shi Yu and fell silent.
“What do you think Dong Huang should do next?”
Shi Yu said, “I say? Continue to develop technology. Develop towards nomological technology and starry sky technology. It’s mainly to develop starry sky technology. The civilization in the universe might be more vast and diverse than we imagined.”
“The opening of the Starry Sky Era might be the future. If the goal is only to recreate the prosperity of the Mythical Era, Blue Planet will still repeat the same mistake and become the target of invasion. Only by understanding the universe can it become stronger. Of course… it might die faster.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Speaking of which, do you think there are things like cosmic ruins… The history of the Great Cosmos Era should be more magnificent, right?”
Everyone: …
Ridiculous, it was already the Starry Sky Era, and he was still thinking about archeology?? Was he still going to get the origin of the universe!
“The starry sky.” The gem cat girl was also curious. The gem it obtained had descended from outer space. She didn’t know if it was left behind by a super-divine existence ~
She hoped that it could successfully grow to the divine level!
“Looks like the future is filled with fog. Super divine level, universe overlord, it sounds very challenging.” The Dragon God’s expression was calm.
[Senior Dragon God, after a while, let’s explore the Space-time Dragon Vein together.] Shi Yu said to the Dragon God telepathically.
The Dragon God looked at Shi Yu. She was rather surprised that Shi Yu, this little guy, still remembered her despite being so strong.
“Alright, alright, we’re at Dong Huang.” Shi Yu smiled as he looked at the continent in front of him. At that time, he planned to say that he had already cracked the spatial ruins and directly transmigrate with the Dragon God.
But the truth was that the owner of the Time Dragon Vein, the Time Sprite, had already been contracted by him!
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had completely eliminated the threat of Yun An and even the Abyss Sea, also felt a huge weight drop from his heart.
Nurturing Eleven had provoked the Yun Race, nurturing Susu, and provoking the Abyss Sea, but it had already been resolved. Next, all that was left was to clean up someone’s mess for Chi Tong. Nurturing Chi Tong and provoking such a big problem like the Undying Dark Phoenix had yet to be resolved.
If he had to say it, nurturing Buggy seemed to have also offended the Dragonman Empire. After all, both parties were in a competitive relationship with the Green Dragon faith. Shi Yu was considering if he should find a time to greet it.
“I’m finally back!” At the same time, the gem cat girl looked in Dong Huang’s direction with slight anticipation. Speaking of which, Shi Yu was the first to know that it had broken through to the demigod level. Now that she had participated in the demigod battle and destroyed Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog, after returning to the Ancient Capital, she had to find someone she knew to brag about it.
She had to let the world know that the guardian overlord of her Ancient Capital University was already a demigod!
It was a pity that she didn’t have the position of president… But she had already thought about it. She wanted to be the greatest vendor on Blue Planet and earn all the money in the world to keep the money!
“Shi Yu, after returning to Dong Huang, make a trip to Ancient Capital University when you’re free. I’ll give you a surprise,” the gem cat said.
“What surprise?” Shi Yu was puzzled.
As for the Ancient Capital, he definitely had to go. Although Chi Tong’s Sun Flame level had yet to reach the transcendent level of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s curse that was enough to unseal and cleanse it, it wasn’t difficult for Chi Tong’s Sun Flame to display transcendent effects with the strengthening buffs like the Time Fruit and the nine-colored divine light.
In addition to Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit that was enough to cleanse demigods… Shi Yu could finally go and slash open the Dark Phoenix’s seal with his sword without worrying about the risk. Regardless of whether the Undying Dark Phoenix was an enemy army, he could learn more about the secrets of the empress through it.
However, the Sword couldn’t kill the Dark Phoenix seal… Shi Yu looked at Grandma Owl, who was enjoying the sea breeze, with a strange expression. Could this guy also be the reincarnation of an ancient demigod? Otherwise, how could Future Prediction be so fierce? Should he give the owl a Reincarnation Fruit?

chapters.title: Chapter 1175 - 1175 Taming the Cat
chapters.content:
1175 Taming the Cat
It was the 180th year of the Alliance calendar. This year was destined to be remembered.
After the news of Shi Yu killing two demigods swept through the world, dozens of totem countries responded to the Blue Planet Alliance again.
A faction with one demigod was already a top faction on Blue Planet, and Dong Huang had five. What kind of concept was that?
He could destroy whoever he wanted!
The most terrifying thing was that three of the five demigods were cultivated by Shi Yu!
If it was said that the various races didn’t know why the World Tree favored humans with the Beast Taming Space, they all understood now.
Any faction with some intelligence could know that Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast was only four years old!
A four-year-old Iron-eating Beast shattered the Demon God that had rampaged in the east five thousand years ago! This was a four-year-old?
After seeing Shi Yu’s Iron-eating Beast’s battle results, no one doubted Shi Yu’s cultivation ability.
Now, many demigod factions hoped to send their heirs and descendants to Shi Yu. Perhaps they had a chance of quickly becoming demigods.
Of course, it was uncertain if Shi Yu wanted it or not.
The four holy beasts had yet to be gathered.
His current thoughts were all on Emperor Shi, the empress, and the Dragon Emperor… Next, he could slowly take advantage of these emperors.
Shi Yu, who had been eating like a glutton at Emperor Wu’s place, had already fallen in love with this feeling.
“Senior Dragon God, goodbye.”
In the Dong Huang Sea Region, after Ling arrived, the Dragon God left and returned to Dragon Palace City.
Shi Yu, President Lin, and the others bid farewell to the Dragon God.
“I’ll wait for you in Dragon Palace City,” the Dragon God said to Shi Yu before leaving.
“I’m leaving too.” After the Dragon God left, Divine Source Legendary also bid farewell to Shi Yu.
“I’ve woken up for too long this time. I’m going back to sleep. During this period of sleep, Dong Huang will rely on you,” Divine Source Legendary said to Shi Yu, the gem cat, Lin Feng, and the Prediction Owl.
Although the laws had revived once, Divine Source Legendary felt that it wasn’t enough.
It was still too early. He wanted to sleep until seven years later when the Mythical Era completely returned before using his last strength to break through to the divine level.
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded. It was easy. As long as no divine-level enemies appeared on the current Blue Planet, he felt that he should be able to take good care of Dong Huang.
“I’ll be busy next. I also have to deal with the aftermath of this incident,” President Lin also said.
After everyone bid farewell to each other, only Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the owl were left.
“Next,” the gem cat girl said, “go back to your homes and rest. Your burden is definitely not small.”
“Ha ~” She yawned and said, “I’m tired too. I’ll go back and sleep first.”
The Prediction Owl: “I’ll be a guest in the Ancient Capital. Big Boss Shi Yu, when are you going to the Ancient Capital to kill the Dark Phoenix? I remember I have this prophecy, right?”
“The Undying Dark Phoenix is ultimately a risk in the Ancient Capital. With your current strength, you should be able to easily solve the hidden danger!”
It rubbed its hands with a fawning expression.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. Alright, so he hadn’t forgotten. The success of these two prophecies had made him unsatisfied.
“I’ll also go to Ancient Capital University to rest. I won’t go to Ping Cheng anymore. Teacher Cat, where’s the surprise you mentioned? Don’t do it another day. I’ll follow you back now.”
The gem cat: “Ah.”
“I’m fine. It’s fine if Eleven, Susu, and the others sleep in the Beast Taming Space.” Shi Yu took out a bag of supplement divine beans.
“Alright then.” The gem cat girl shrugged.
Shi Yu said, “Also, hehe, when you’re done resting, Teacher Ying, you have to help. Work with Susu, Ling, and Buggy to modify the Legendary ruins that sealed the Black Meteorite Yak previously and transform them into ruins that sealed Yun An.”
Then, it would be handed over to the country and become a strategic renewable resource to nurture the Iron-eating Beast Corps.
The gem cat: “?”
I knew it wouldn’t be a good thing for you to go to the Ancient Capital so early!
Her eyes rolled and she returned to her gem cat form. She lay lazily on the chair of the battleship and said, “Let me rest first! In that case, send me back.”
Shi Yu chuckled… He had already given it so many resources. Who else could he squeeze dry if not him?
Prediction Owl: Ancient Capital Charge!!!
…
Ancient Capital University.
An aerial battleship flew over.
At this moment, Dong Huang was peaceful.
Shi Yu’s demigod battle in the Western Demon Sea did not affect this side.
The live broadcast he did was only targeted at the higher-ups of the seven countries and experts above the titled level in the Alliance. There were even fewer Legendary-level experts who were qualified to see it.
In addition, although the demigod battle caused a huge commotion in the world, and the aftermath of the power was sensed by countless powerful lives, it was only limited to powerful totems and the human countries in the west.
For a country like Dong Huang, which was relatively far away and had done very good land protection work, the aftermath of the power only had a slight impact on this side. Only some changes occurred in the coastal area. Inland areas like the Ancient Capital, it was basically still the same.
“Peace is so good.” Shi Yu sighed as he chewed the divine beans planted by the ginseng baby as a snack.
“Wow.” The gem cat really couldn’t stand the sound of Shi Yu munching on beans and also ran over to split the beans.
The Prediction Owl originally wanted to split it too, but it had just popped a few and was a little tipsy.
“What surprise are you talking about?” Shi Yu said when they finally arrived above Ancient Capital University.
“Crack.” The gem cat chewed on the beans and said, “Didn’t you ask me to pay attention to pets with pretty good talent that are suitable to be cultivated into the Four Holy Beasts White Tiger?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1176 - 1176 Taming the Cat (2)
chapters.content:
1176 Taming the Cat (2)
“I’ve found it for you, but I’m not sure if you can like it.”
“Looking for a pet? I’m good at this. Why didn’t you look for me! Back then, I predicted the Blue Sea Sprite.” The owl put on a mask to take credit.
Shi Yu was helpless. These two cats…
“Then Teacher Owl, help me predict where I can contract a cosmic Behemoth cub. It’s been hard on you.”
“No prob…” The Prediction Owl’s expression stopped.
What f*cking cosmic Behemoth, the cosmic Behemoth that chased after Blue Planet?
Wasn’t this even fiercer than the Iron-eating Beast chasing after Yun An?!
Shi Yu looked at the gem cat again.
“Talent potential is not bad? Metal element?”
The gem cat said, “Of course. Of course, you still have to consider it yourself.”
Shi Yu said, “What race is it?”
The gem cat: “Cat.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Could the transcendent life form you’re talking about that can nurture the Four Spirits of Heaven be you?”
The gem cat was angry and said, “I’m a free cat. Stop thinking about me. It’s something else!”
The Prediction Owl said, “Although I don’t understand too much, you mean you want to nurture cats into tigers?”
Shi Yu said, “There’s not much of a difference. In any case, they’re all felines. They can evolve.”
The gem cat girl said, “That’s right. You also know that Ancient Capital University raises many wild cats of various races. You asked me to help find pets suitable to nurture into white tigers. I originally planned to go to a few best friends to take a look, but I didn’t expect to find suitable ones in Ancient Capital University.”
“Tell me in detail,” Shi Yu said with interest.
The gem cat said, “It’s a hybrid cat. It’s a mutated new breed. It should have been a transcendent race, but it suddenly mutated into a monarch race. Moreover, it mastered the deterrence racial skill at the Awakening level. From the breed, it should be the first in the world. I think it should be very valuable to nurture.”
“By the way, its super Skill is Metal Control.”
“If it’s a hybrid, what race are its parents?” Shi Yu said.
“The mother is a treasure-seeking cat, and the father is a gem cat that evolved with a metal-element gem, so it was born metal-element.”
Shi Yu said, “He inherited the attributes of his father? Then what did he inherit from his mother?”
The Treasure Hunting Cat was a cat of another transcendent Race. Although it was also a cat like the gem cat, there was still a difference.
Generally speaking, there would be no breeding problems between these two creatures. However, most of the young cats born would only inherit one side’s race.
For example, if they gave birth to a treasure-seeking cat cub or a gem cat cub, they wouldn’t obtain the characteristics of both parents together.
However, nothing was absolute. There was still a very small chance that the next generation could inherit the characteristics of both parents. At this moment, they would be very lucky. It was basically equivalent to breeding a new generation of transcendent races that could only be chanced upon by luck.
Generally speaking, only powerful totems like the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King were confident that their descendants could inherit the merits of both parties together. Transcendent races like the Treasure Hunting Cat and the Gem Cat were left to fate.
“It inherited its mother’s Treasure Hunting Cat’s racial form and energy talent, and its father’s Gem Eye as the basic racial Skill and Stats.”
Treasure Hunting Cat appearance?
Shi Yu recalled.
If the gem cat was like a ragdoll cat on Earth, then the Treasure Hunting Cat was more like a short-legged cat on Earth. Its legs were very short, and it liked to walk with not very smart steps to find resources that contained energy fluctuations. Its racial talent was that its energy perception was pretty good. Wild Treasure Hunting Cats could often find good things themselves. This was where its name came from…
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, the short Treasure Hunting Cat was not good at battle. It was even worse than the gem cat. The gem cat at least had a lot of evolution potential, but the Treasure Hunting Cat had nothing.
It was indeed lucky to be able to mutate into a monarch race like this.
“Cough, if that’s all, it’s just a little cat of a monarch race. I wouldn’t be in such a hurry to recommend it to you… It’s mainly because this one is a little special,” the gem cat girl said.
“Because both parents are dead, its personality is a little distorted. I feel that it will be very suitable for you.”
Shi Yu’s face was speechless. Why was a distorted personality suitable for him?
“What’s with the death of both parents?” Shi Yu still chose to ask the main point.
“Because the child is a mutated species, and the mother was also old. She died in childbirth. When the father saw his partner die, he died of depression.”
Protagonist template? Shi Yu opened his mouth slightly and said, “But such a talented little cat should be carefully taken care of by Ancient Capital University, right? There should be a lot of love and care. How can its personality be distorted?”
The gem cat girl said in embarrassment, “The one in charge of taking care of the wild cats in Ancient Capital University is my clone. There might be a mistake in the care method. In addition, this mutated species has pretty good talent and matures earlier…”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. He had almost forgotten that apart from the administrator of the Ancient Capital University’s resource bank, Teacher Ying had such an identity.
“How is his personality distorted? I don’t want it if the problem is too big.”
“This isn’t a problem child shelter.”
At this moment, they had almost arrived above Ancient Capital University. The gem cat’s Psychic power searched for a while, indicating for Shi Yu to look over with his Psychic wave.
“Here, take a look for yourself.”
Shi Yu was stunned. His Psychic power also scanned over and enveloped the wild cat area of Ancient Capital University. There was a luxurious cat nest dozens of square meters at intervals.

chapters.title: Chapter 1177 - 1177 Taming the Cat (3)
chapters.content:
1177 Taming the Cat (3)
It could be said that the cats of Ancient Capital University were living more comfortably than the Normal working class in a second-level city.
In fact, some breeds of cats with high racial levels were even equipped with air conditioners and refrigerators. It couldn’t be helped. This was the tradition of Ancient Capital University, especially since Shi Yu had appeared in Ancient Capital University. With money, they were even more extravagant in various aspects.
For example, the cat that Teacher Ying mentioned had better treatment. After all, it was a monarch race. Although it was a wild cat, there was a high chance that it would be contracted in the future. It was worth investing in.
“Holy shit.” At this moment, Shi Yu looked at the cat nest and was stunned.
They were completely stunned.
This cat nest was filled with photos of him, Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng’s competition, and interviews.
Inside, a white short-legged cat was lying on a pillow with a printed university ginseng, sleeping soundly.
“Mi ~” He was still smiling and drooling.
“As you can see, this cat seems to have heard something from Ancient Capital University. It’s a little obsessed with celebrities. It’s your fanatical fan.”
“I reckon it doesn’t fancy other Beast Tamers anymore, but I feel that it’s still fated with you. If it’s suitable to nurture into a white tiger, just take it away. If it’s not suitable, just throw it away. In any case, Ancient Capital University can afford to raise it.” The gem cat girl was tired of talking. She took out a coconut from the fourth dimension spatial pocket and drank the juice.
Shi Yu: “?”
“No, although, explain why chasing celebrities and liking me makes its personality is distorted.”
The gem cat: “Ah, this, this, is this normal?”
The Prediction Owl also watched in a daze and said, “It’s abnormal. Why didn’t it worship the powerful Guardian overlord of Ancient Capital University and instead chased after a human? Ah Ying, is your charm so low?”
The gem cat: “?”
If you don’t know how to talk, you don’t have to say it. Climb, I’ll twist your head off!
“Forget it,” Shi Yu said.
“Since you say so, I’ll bring it to nurture for a few days to see if it can persist.”
“If it can adapt, it’ll subdue the contract. If it can’t, I’ll send it back to you.”
He had just taken a few looks. The level of its Resistance was extremely low, so it shouldn’t be the reincarnation of a big boss. The Mythical Revival didn’t react either. He felt that it was just as the gem cat girl had said, a genius hybrid cat with a mutated race.
To be honest, Shi Yu didn’t decide to bring it back to train for a few days because of the other party’s talent and the gem cat’s recommendation.
It was purely because he felt that this cat had very good taste. This kind of structure was very extraordinary. Perhaps it would do something big. This didn’t seem like something a young cat of a monarch race could do.
“That’s good.” The gem cat girl heaved a sigh of relief.
“Why do you look so happy?” Shi Yu looked at the gem cat suspiciously.
“No.” The gem cat immediately became serious.
It was mainly because this little cat was very annoying. It chased after its clone every day and said that it wanted to see Shi Yu, causing the clone to complain.
Now that Shi Yu was willing to bring it back and nurture it for two days, this cat should completely give up.
It had seen the extent of the inner scroll in Shi Yu’s team. Even it couldn’t bear to look at it. It didn’t think that this cat could last at all.
“Ah!” Suddenly, the Prediction Owl was shocked, scaring the gem cat.
“What are you doing?”
The owl said, “I just did a divination for that short cat a bit. I predicted that the other party’s strength will quickly exceed yours.”
The gem cat girl: Are you polite??? Can you not predict blindly if you don’t know how to predict? Stop talking!

chapters.title: Chapter 1178 - 1178 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (1)
chapters.content:
1178 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (1)
It was unknown if its race name should be Treasure Hunting Cat or Gem Cat. At this moment, it was still sleeping in the cat nest.
Out of respect for Teacher Ying, Shi Yu would call it the Treasure Hunting Cat for the time being.
“After all, it’s cultivated towards the Four Spirit White Tiger of Heaven. If it succeeds, it indeed has potential that exceeds mine, but it’s too much in a short period of time,” the gem cat girl said.
The Prediction Owl said, “But that green dragon is even younger than the Iron-eating Beast. It’s only three years old.”
“Wind Kirin, not even two years old.”
“At this speed…”
Gem Cat Lady: ￥% #@￥
“But I still suspect that this thing can really evolve into a white tiger.” The Prediction Owl looked at the short-legged treasure-hunting cat.
At that time, a short-legged white tiger? It imagined it. It was completely lacking in deterrence.
While the two of them were still arguing, Shi Yu had already gone down and landed outside the cat nest of the treasure-hunting cat.
This was a little female cat. It was less than a year old, but its level had already reached the transcendent level.
When Shi Yu approached, the other party was still unconscious until Shi Yu knocked on the wall of the cat bed beside him.
Knock, knock, knock.
The short cat’s four legs trembled. It opened its black gem-like eyes and turned to look in the direction of the voice.
Then, he saw Shi Yu.
“Mi…”
It first blinked, then turned its head around again and closed it again. It lay back down and continued sleeping.
Shi Yu: “?”
About two seconds after sleeping back, the short white cat suddenly opened its eyes again and felt that something was wrong.
Although it was very weak, it sensed clear energy fluctuations. This was something it couldn’t sense in its dream.
“Mi!” It immediately rolled down from the pillow and stood on the ground with its four short legs. It looked at Shi Yu, and its cute face gradually froze.
In the next second.
It ran quickly. Although its limbs were very short, it didn’t seem to affect its running speed at all.
In an instant, this medium-sized and slightly long fat guy bumped into Shi Yu’s thigh and hugged it fiercely without letting go.
Cat to cozy up to someone powerful.jpg
“Mi!”
“Mi!! Mi!!”
Shi Yu was speechless. He was now in level-seven physical control and level-eight telepathy. The former could allow him to restrain his power close to a totem and reduce his consumption. His control over his body was even better than an overlord life form. The latter could long allow him to sense the changes in the emotions of other life forms.
For example, the change in the emotional fluctuations of this transcendent-level cat couldn’t be hidden from Shi Yu at all. Shi Yu immediately sensed its excited emotions. This emotional fluctuation actually far exceeded the excitement when the owl broke through previously. This made Shi Yu feel that perhaps Teacher Cat was right.
This little cat was indeed a little fanatical about chasing celebrities. It was far from as simple as it looked.
At this moment, the cat looked up at Shi Yu eagerly, looking like it couldn’t bear to let go.
“It’s pretty cute.”
Shi Yu bent down and pinched the back of its neck. He lifted it up and said, “I heard about you. Teacher Ying told me. Do you want to be my contracted pet?”
The short cat was stunned. It immediately nodded like a sewing machine with a look of anticipation, but then it was afraid that Shi Yu would refuse. It immediately shook its head like a rattle drum.
“Mi, Mi!!” It stared eagerly, meaning that it was good as long as it could follow beside Shi Yu. It knew everything, so it didn’t matter if it contracted it or not.
It, who treated Shi Yu and the others as idols, followed the self-disciplined Iron-eating Beast Legendary circulating in Ancient Capital University.
Regarding his knowledge standard, it was according to the university ginseng Legendary circulating in Ancient Capital University.
If it really couldn’t follow beside it, it was alright to let it take a photo with everyone. The short cat kept lowering its requirements humbly.
“This is cat boot licking, right!” In the battleship, the Prediction Owl said.
The gem cat girl said, “You don’t know the influence of Shi Yu and the others in Ancient Capital University. Fortunately, Shi Yu doesn’t live on campus anymore. Otherwise, the entrance of his dormitory would definitely be surrounded by ‘Shi Yu’s Fan Support Club’ every day.”
“The area around Shi Yu’s team at my resource bank is selling very well. As a bonus, it completely drives the sales of other resources.”
The Prediction Owl:???
Damn, so the surroundings of this cat nest were caused by him?
What kind of black-hearted business was he doing all day!
The Prediction Owl seemed to understand a little why it, the pet of the first-generation principal of the Imperial Capital University, had always been on the same level as a gem cat. This guy’s business sense seemed to be a little better than its own?
“Wait…” The Prediction Owl suddenly looked back at the cat nest.
At this moment, Shi Yu had already sat on the sofa. The short-legged cat was already lying on Shi Yu’s thigh, letting Shi Yu pet it as he pleased. Shi Yu was also petting it happily.
“No way, how did their relationship become so good so quickly!”
The gem cat girl said, “No one can resist the temptation of petting a cat. Shi Yu finally exposed his hobby! From the last time he ambushed me, I saw through his wolf ambition.”
“This guy definitely likes cats too.”
“It’s good to subdue a cat, lest it plots against me in the future.”
The Prediction Owl: “Ah, tell me in detail.”
Below, Shi Yu had already reached a consensus with the Treasure Hunting Shorty.
“You can follow beside me, but it’s very dangerous beside me. If you want to become my contracted pet, you have to undergo a certain test.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1179 - 1179 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (2)
chapters.content:
1179 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (2)
“Meow ~” The short white cat enjoyed being petted happily. It felt that Shi Yu was gentler than it imagined.
“If you don’t pass the test, it’s dangerous to follow beside me. I’ll even send you back when the time comes.”
“There are still two newbies who want to undergo the test like you. One is a turtle, and the other is a snake.”
“Meow ~” The short cat no longer had anything to ask for. It didn’t matter. The test should be more violent!! In order to buy Shi Yu’s merchandise, it had lived frugally for a few months. It had already endured it and felt that there was nothing that could stump it.
Shi Yu smiled and continued to stroke it. It felt pretty good. Its fur was very smooth, much smoother than a panda’s fur. He just didn’t know if the other party could rely on this fanatical pursuit of celebrities to withstand the basic willpower training.
If it could succeed, the four holy beasts were almost searched.
At this moment, the gem cat and the Prediction Owl also got off the battleship and came to the cat nest.
“Teacher Ying, in that case, I’ll take this little guy away first.” At this moment, the Treasure Hunting Cat also discovered the gem cat and its eyes immediately lit up.
“Mi ~”
“Well, take it away, take it away,” the gem cat said indifferently. “I’m going back to sleep.”
“In addition, little guy, be mentally prepared,” it reminded the Treasure Hunting Cat.
He had already obtained the opportunity to become stronger. Whether he could persist depended on his love for Shi Yu and the others.
The cat looked confused.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Hurry up and go. It’ll be easier to work after you wake up.”
The gem cat: “?”
Are you still human? I just got home!
“Hehe.” The Prediction Owl also spread its wings and said, “I’ll get Principal Feng to hold a banquet to celebrate Shi Yu’s victory.”
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. “You’re hungry yourself, right? Don’t bring me along. I’ll go sleep first.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu stood up and picked up the little white cat. “In short, welcome to the team. I’ll send you to the dormitory first and let you see your beloved university ginsengs.”
Dwarf Cat: Mi (?????)?!!!
….
Shi Yu returned to the university dormitory after a long time. After returning, he fell asleep and threw the short cat to Ling, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng to take care of. He planned to let this cat be happy for a few days first…
Eleven, Susu, and the others were also sleeping like Shi Yu. Susu was alright next, but after Eleven woke up, the rhythm of life might change drastically.
The previous training intensity was no longer possible. Even if Blue Planet had already revived once, Eleven had to reduce the training intensity. No, it couldn’t train anymore. Otherwise, the entire team would have to provide for it.
At the moment, the graduation level in Shi Yu’s team was at the demigod level. At this level, even if they wanted to cause trouble again, they would be stopped by Shi Yu. At least, they had to wait until Blue Planet opened a higher level.
“Next goal… All demigods…” Shi Yu hugged his pillow and fell asleep. Although he had only activated the Taiji Domain for a while, this was activated by Shi Yu under the burden of a contract above his level. After defeating Yun An, he was also very tired.
Even if he had eaten a lot of supplements, his body couldn’t digest it so quickly. He needed his body’s control and deep sleep to adjust his state.
On the other side, Principal Feng didn’t disturb Shi Yu after knowing that he had returned. It probably wasn’t that easy for Shi Yu and the others to recover from the demigod battle.
In fact, that was the case. About a week later, Shi Yu showed signs of waking up. As for Eleven, it was the same. It slept even more soundly than Shi Yu.
If it weren’t for the fact that the pets had confirmed that Shi Yu was still alive, it would be very difficult not to feel that they had already fallen asleep.
“Ha ~ ~” A week later, Shi Yu stretched with full spirit. Secretary Ling quickly flew over and looked at Shi Yu, who was rubbing his eyes.
“I…”
“Seven days and seven hours,” Ling said.
“You answered very well. Don’t answer before me next time.” Shi Yu shook his head and said, “I slept for a long time.”
“It can’t be helped. Eleven resting in the Beast Taming Space will also consume your stamina, Master. It’s now at the demigod level. It just finished the battle and only recovered for a week. It’s all thanks to Baby Ginseng.”
“Therefore, the reason why I slept for so long is most likely because Eleven is draining my stamina… Let’s fight less next time,” Shi Yu said gloomily. “Speaking of which, Ling, have you calculated the strength of my physique that has reached the limit of my current level?”
“At that time, how many totem levels can it support?”
Ling had a headache. “There are too many unpredictable variables. If we don’t consider the attribute feedback of the contracted new pet, the breakthrough feedback of the contracted pet, and the feedback of the upgrade in the second space…”
“Master, train your physique to the current limit. It’s basically not a problem for your two pets to break through to the totem demigod level. After eating three divine-level resources, your advantage before the divine level will be very obvious, Master.”
“Two demigods?”
“This is only a conservative estimate. Little Purple’s breakthrough, Buggy’s evolution and breakthrough, and the upgrade of the second space and physical control talent… The variables brought by these are very big.”
“I understand,” Shi Yu said. “The most important thing now is to rely on adding points and nutritional supplements to quickly train my physique.”
“How’s that cat?” Shi Yu asked.
“As for Teacher Ying, she’s still sleeping. As for the short cat, it has already run to train with Turtle, Little Ice, and the others. The instructor is Buggy,” Ling said in a classification discussion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1180 - 1180 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (3)
chapters.content:
1180 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (3)
“It started so quickly?”
“It said to adapt to life here as soon as possible.”
Shi Yu said, “Then how’s its adaptation?”
“Wu…” Ling said,” At the start, its body couldn’t withstand it much, but it was exhausted after a while. But when Buggy gave the reward mechanism, as long as it passed a Resistance test, it could obtain the entire team’s premium figurine. It immediately broke through the limit, and its Resistance level went from extremely low to low. From the current situation, it might have a chance to rely on the reward mechanism to withstand the test all the way. ”
Shi Yu : “…”
Buggy had become proficient in creating the Dragon God Phantom figurine. It had changed its profession to creating its own figurine.
“That’s good.” Shi Yu rubbed his temples and said, “I’ll go take a look at their training later.”
“Are Chi Tong and Susu alright?”
“It’s alright.”
Shi Yu touched his chin and said, “Then let Baby Ginseng wake Teacher Ying up when it’s free. I think it has also eaten a lot of supplements. Sleeping for a week is long enough. Wake her up. It’s time to work.”
“Oh, no, before I work, let her accompany me to the Undead Battlefield to take a look and meet the Undying Dark Phoenix.”
Before sleeping, Shi Yu had been thinking about the Undying Dark Phoenix. Now, he could go and meet it.
….
Half a day later.
The gem cat, which had been woken up by Shi Yu and the others, cursed and followed Shi Yu to the Undead Battlefield.
Initially, Shi Yu also wanted to call the owl, but as a rare time-element totem that could predict the future, this guy was temporarily summoned to the Alliance by President Lin. It seemed like he wanted it to be a high-level official. After the Prediction Owl heard that, it decisively went over.
When Shi Yu learned of this, he held his forehead. He didn’t know if it was reliable, but such a time totem that could predict the future was indeed worth offering.
At this moment, the team that headed to the Undying Dark Phoenix together was very powerful.
There was no need to talk about Shi Yu. Beside him, the one-meter-tall Panda King Eleven, Chi Tong in the form of a loli Sword Maiden, the green dragon in the form of a green worm, the ginseng baby in the form of a ginseng baby, Susu in the form of a water slime, Ling in the form of a Rubik’s Cube, and the gem cat in the form of a cat girl… The lineup could be said to be the strongest on Blue Planet.
On the surface, there were two demigod battle power.
In addition, Baby Ginseng could use the Time Fruit to temporarily turn its teammate into a demigod for a while. It could be said that it was fine if the Undying Dark Phoenix wasn’t an enemy, but if it was really an enemy… It wouldn’t be able to escape even if it had wings.
At this moment, after the gem cat’s morning anger disappeared, it also began to look forward to it.
There were too many secrets on this Undying Dark Phoenix. Curiosity was also exclusive to cats.
“I hope the rescue goes smoothly,” Shi Yu said.
After all, one Mythical resource and two legendary resources!
He looked at the other party like a good person!
“Mm…” Chi Tong frowned, not knowing how to deal with it. At its level, it recalled and felt that it indeed had the same bloodline as the Undying Dark Phoenix.
At this moment, when the army arrived at the Undead Battlefield, Shi Yu began to recall what the Undying Dark Phoenix had said at that time.
More than 2000 years ago, the Phoenix Race gave birth to hybrids and purebloods.
The mixed-blood faction pursued change and hoped to use mixed-bloods to make the Phoenix Race stronger. It was mainly to give their bloodline to humans who were close to the Phoenix and had huge potential. However, the pure-blooded faction pursued pure bloodlines and was unwilling to let humans share the resources of the Phoenix Race. Because of this, there was a conflict between the two parties.
The Undying Dark Phoenix was a powerful supporter of the mixed-blood faction.
Mu Huiyin was the first daughter created by the Undying Dark Phoenix. However, at this moment, the pureblood faction was huge. For the sake of its daughter’s safety, it had no choice but to send her away.
When the power of the hybrid faction occupied the top, it created a second daughter and supported her as the empress of Dong Huang. It even helped humans solve the totem battle after Emperor Wu Dynasty.
Unfortunately, the purebloods made a comeback at this moment. Not only did they kill it and let it enter a cursed state, but they also caused the empress dynasty to fall into war. The empress was nowhere to be found…
…
Outside the Ancient Capital, the Undead Battlefield.
At the bottom of the deep and dark cave.
A creature that looked like a dark Phoenix, its back covered in black feathers, its wings and tail wrapped in black and red flames, was still sleeping.
Ever since the Undying Dark Phoenix’s rampage ended, it had fallen into a deep sleep. It should have consumed a lot of strength.
Even if it was at the demigod level when it was alive, it should be Enfeebled after being sealed for so long.
In the outside world, above the seal, Shi Yu and the others shouted for a long time, but there was no reaction.
Buggy tried to enter the dream of the Undying Dark Phoenix first, but it couldn’t penetrate the seal.
“I only realized now. What a strong seal. Although I can forcefully break it with the power of a demigod, it should accidentally injure the Undying Dark Phoenix,” the gem cat girl said.
“I just studied it. The other party might not have lied previously. The core of this seal is similar to the sun. Unlocking it might also require the power of the sun.”
“I still want to talk to the Undying Dark Phoenix before unsealing it. In that case, let’s do it directly. Buggy, Ling, prepare yourselves. I’ll directly let Chi Tong try to break through the ruins,” Shi Yu said.
“Wu!” Buggy and Ling nodded and ran to create the second seal to prevent the Undying Dark Phoenix from going berserk after coming out.
At the same time, the loli Sword Maiden glanced at Shi Yu.
After Shi Yu nodded, it returned to its normal state and looked at the underground seal with a serious expression. It closed its eyes slightly and sensed inside.
In order to let Chi Tong crack the Effect better, the gem cat applied a nine-colored divine light to it and strengthened Chi Tong completely.
Boom!
In an instant, Chi Tong’s strength increased. It opened its eyes and took a deep breath. The sword in its hand slashed down, and the Sun Flame Sword light directly landed in the eye of the ruins with a boom. The earth space shattered!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1181 - 1181 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (4)
chapters.content:
1181 Sword Undying Dark Phoenix (4)
Buzz!!!
In the next moment, orange-red Sun Flame power rose from the ruins.
Effective!
Sun Flame could really unlock this ruin with the lowest strength!
“Jiu!!!!!” At the same time, in the depths of the ruins.
The Undying Dark Phoenix, which was bathed in black and red flames, suddenly opened its eyes and let out a cry.
A terrifying creature gradually revived with the cry of a phoenix and the death flames.
At this moment, it was suddenly awakened. The Undying Dark Phoenix was still puzzled, but a moment later, it was overjoyed.
It was unsealed.
Someone began to unseal it through the Sun Flame.
It immediately sensed the familiar bloodline fluctuations.
“I didn’t expect my good daughter to grow to this extent in such a short period of time. What a powerful bloodline power…”
The Undying Dark Phoenix was extremely excited.
This was actually its second awakening during this period of time.
The first time it woke up was when the laws revived. At that time, it was awakened.
Unfortunately, he still couldn’t break through the seal with the change in the environment. Soon, he fell asleep again.
This time, it was really awakened.
It was extremely excited. It looked like the investment in the Undying Fruit and the two Sun Flame Flowers was not wrong. After the other party mastered the ability to unseal this ruin, it immediately came to save it. Its speed was faster than it imagined.
Because although the resources it left behind could allow Chi Tong to quickly increase to the totem level, that Beast Tamer would most likely be a burden, but from the looks of it, there didn’t seem to be?
But it had only been such a short period of time. There was no reason for that young man to have reached the legendary level. Could it be that after the revival of the laws, it was easier for humans to increase their level?
Forget it, forget it.
After the ruins broke through, the Undying Dark Phoenix directly dragged its body and bathed in the cursed flames and sun flames as it flew into the sky outside.
In the next second.
The Undying Dark Phoenix flew in the outside world. Its huge evil flame body that was nearly a hundred meters tall made it look majestic. After flying in the outside world, its eyes flickered with a dark light as it stared at Shi Yu and Chi Tong in the form of a Sword Maiden.
“Hahahahahaha ~ ~” A huge laugh resounded through the Undead Battlefield.
“Good daughter, thank you.”
“I’m really touched, but it’s better to do good things to the end.” It stared at Chi Tong and said, “I’m so hungry, so hungry, so hungry… You’re already so strong. You should give me some.”
“After absorbing your power, I should be able to return to the peak.”
Demigod level… And a powerful demigod not inferior to a dragon!!!
“Jiu!!!!” In the next moment, it let out a high cry again, as if it had activated some special Skill. On the other side, Chi Tong’s expression suddenly changed. It felt that the power of the Phoenix bloodline in its body immediately left its control and was about to be pulled out.
Chi Tong could sense that the Undying Dark Phoenix opposite was not strong and not at the demigod level, but it had a very powerful restraining effect on it, making it very difficult for it to resist with the power passed down by Mu Huiyin.
It was as if the other party had used some skill that specialized in countering the descendants of his bloodline.
“What are you doing?” Chi Tong’s eyes were filled with anger as it looked at the Undying Dark Phoenix.
However, although it couldn’t resist with the bloodline power passed down by Mu Huiyin, as the sword intent lingered in Chi Tong’s eyes, shocking sword aura erupted from its body. In an instant, the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation broke through all restrictions. A shocking nomological Sword Chant erupted, instantly cutting off the bloodline connection between the Undying Dark Phoenix and Chi Tong!!
Boom!!!
The four swords lingered, and the cry of the Law Sword resounded through the world, shattering all the flames. Sword aura lingered, making the Undying Dark Phoenix opposite suddenly widen its eyes.
Quasi-divine skill, how was this possible!
“Hey, what a joke.” At this moment, not only Chi Tong, but Shi Yu and the others also had unfriendly expressions.
Boom!!!
Demigod Eleven suddenly increased to a hundred meters tall and entered the Chaos Panda form. It looked at the Undying Dark Phoenix tyrannically.
The gem cat girl revealed an as expected expression. With a swing of its tail, its aura rose steadily. The power of a demigod was undoubtedly displayed. The luster of the gem eye spread as it looked at the Undying Dark Phoenix in shock.
Wasn’t this guy a little too anxious? He had just come out and dared to attack without figuring out the situation?
So what the other party said should be fake? Then what was the truth? The gem cat felt that it should know after completing the “cleansing”.
Boom!!!
The full-level deterrence from Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Ling, and the others rose with a bang and suppressed over. At this moment, the Undying Dark Phoenix, which was just about to absorb the power of Chi Tong’s bloodline, was suddenly stunned. Its eyes widened even more, and it almost felt that it was difficult to breathe.
“Two demigods…” It looked at the panda in shock and felt that it was a little familiar. Then, it looked at the cat girl and also felt that the other party’s life fluctuations were a little familiar.
Weren’t these two guys the bear and cat that followed this human Beast Tamer when it first woke up?
It remembered that among the two at that time, one was clearly only commander rank, and the other was only overlord rank.
How long had it been? How could it have reached the demigod level? Impossible!!!
It could still understand why Chi Tong’s level had increased so quickly. No, it couldn’t understand at all. At this moment, the Undying Dark Phoenix couldn’t understand at all why Chi Tong had mastered a quasi-divine skill with just two Sun Flame Flowers and an Undying Fruit!!
It even completely escaped the restraints of a top-notch bloodline and cultivated a sword-type quasi-divine skill that exceeded its race!
Shi Yu said, “Come on, I forgot. You haven’t had time to cleanse your curse and plague. Looks like your rationality has been corroded. It’s not too late to cleanse now.”
“Impossible!!!” The Undying Dark Phoenix shouted, almost covered in sweat.
He kept feeling that it was a little different from the script he had expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - 1182 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty
chapters.content:
1182 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty
Undead Battlefield.
The Undying Dark Phoenix was extremely afraid, not understanding why such a plot would happen.
“Wait!!”
Seeing that Shi Yu and the others were about to attack, the Undying Dark Phoenix stopped them repeatedly.
“I just hallucinated because I was sealed for too long and was too hungry.”
As it spoke… it suddenly let out a sharp phoenix cry. The nether flames on its body immediately increased, and it wanted to fly away.
Under Shi Yu’s gaze, its energy level instantly increased from one billion to more than a billion and quickly approached two billion.
This was because the undead everywhere in the Undead Battlefield began to Spirit Release and become its nutrients because of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s breakthrough.
This scene made Shi Yu’s gaze involuntarily freeze. Fortunately, he didn’t come to save the Undying Dark Phoenix too early.
Not only did this guy have a connection with all the undead born from plagues and curses in the Undead Battlefield, but it could also instantly decide their life and death. It even maintained a very special connection with Chi Tong. If it were Chi Tong before its evolution, it would probably instantly become its bloodline nutrients.
However, even if the Undying Dark Phoenix had many trump cards, its first thought when it saw Shi Yu and the others was still to escape!
The Undying Dark Phoenix suspected that it was still dreaming and felt that it was too strange. It had only slept. When did demigod-level and quasi-divine skills become so common?
In its current state, it was definitely unwilling to fight a demigod head-on.
However, the Undying Dark Phoenix wanted to leave and continue absorbing the undead in the Undead Battlefield, but it had to ask Shi Yu and the others if they agreed.
Before long, the Undying Dark Phoenix’s expression changed. It realized that the space here was completely sealed.
Then, the young man opposite turned into a red-haired and red-eyed person. The shocking Sun Flame Sword Formation locked onto it around it.
“Wuu!!!” A black and white millstone crossed space and appeared above its head.
Apart from that, another sound of laws vibrated. The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at the phantom of the Blue Sea Saintess behind Shi Yu in shock.
“Third demigod, aren’t you the Blue Sea Sprite!!!”
“Why are you here too!”
It had seen the Blue Sea Sprite at its peak 3,000 years ago, but because of this, it couldn’t understand why the figure of the Blue Sea Sprite appeared here.
“Sun Flame, Yin Yang Millstone, Sea Cleansing Spirit, three cleansing Skills. Do you like them?” Shi Yu said.
The pupils of the Undying Dark Phoenix constricted.
Under the sympathetic expressions of Buggy, the gem cat, and Ling, a miserable cry came from the spatial barrier.
The towering emperor covered his ears and sighed. Pitiful, pitiful, even Yun An wasn’t in such a miserable state.
However, what depressed Baby Ginseng was that in this operation, it was also acting as a support healer and team doctor.
“Ah!!!!!!!”
The Undying Dark Phoenix’s scream was extremely penetrating, like a woman in labor. Shi Yu’s face tensed up when he heard it.
…
“Susu, Devour and seal it for a second cleansing.”
…
In the Infinite Devour Space, this was the third time a guest had come recently.
Previously, it was the Abyss demigod and the Yun Race demigod. This time, the Undying Dark Phoenix was considered the worst.
At the moment, Yun An was still undergoing purification.
Its mind and Resistance had yet to be completely cleansed.
Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit was very powerful when purified to the greatest effect. It could really make a bad person turn over a new leaf.
In history, many of the Abyss demigods who were lucky enough not to be killed by Susu had been completely cleansed by Susu of the power of the abyss and became the guardians of the sea.
If Yun An was cleansed to this extent, even if it was released, it wouldn’t pose a threat to Dong Huang. It might even become Dong Huang’s environmental ambassador.
However, the reality was that it definitely couldn’t be cleansed to this extent. After all, if it was completely cleansed, what if its meteorite fragment didn’t have the evolution Effect?
Therefore, at the moment, it was only a targeted partial cleansing. At least, it didn’t have too strong a resistance when it tried to atone for its penitence.
On the Undying Dark Phoenix’s side, after being imprisoned, it also continued to receive the baptism of the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
Susu didn’t hold back against this guy. It directly underwent the greatest power cleansing. Not only did it have to cleanse its mind and Resistance, but it also had to cleanse the power on its body. After all, this guy’s entire body was covered in plague and curses. Apart from creating uncontrollable ferocious spirits, there was no other use for it.
Because this guy’s strength was insufficient for a demigod, and the most suitable was a quasi demigod like the Tyrant Dragon King, it was not difficult to cleanse.
“Ah!!!!!”
After a long time, the Undying Dark Phoenix woke up from its coma. Its strength had already been weakened by various cleansing methods.
It opened its eyes with difficulty and saw Shi Yu and the others standing neatly in front of it. Its eyes were dead.
“Kill me…”
“Congratulations, the plague and curse on your body have already been cleansed. In theory, you should have recovered your self-awareness and rationality,” Shi Yu congratulated.
“Why are you so anxious to die?”
“Otherwise, why would you spend so much effort to find someone to save and cleanse you?”
“Or is what you said previously a lie?”
The Undying Dark Phoenix opened its mouth slightly and finally looked at the Sword Maiden Chi Tong standing beside Shi Yu in silence. It closed its eyes again, not wanting to explain too much.
“It does seem to have sobered up a little, but it’s still not enough,” the gem cat girl said curiously.
So what exactly was going on?
“Are you planning to say something? Is there something you can’t say?” Shi Yu asked. “If you don’t want to say it, we’ll extract your memories. It might cause you a certain amount of damage.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1183 - 1183 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (2)
chapters.content:
1183 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (2)
“Of course, even if you say it, we might do it in the end, but gently.”
As the Undying Dark Phoenix really had a bloodline connection with Chi Tong, Shi Yu and the others were not in a hurry to attack. After all, the other party was still fundamentally different from Yun An and the others.
“Ask away.” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the Undying Dark Phoenix didn’t open its eyes, but it spoke weakly.
Without the brutality when it just broke through the seal, its mind was cleansed by Susu and calmed down. Its mental force field also changed.
“Looking at your current attitude, what you told us previously is that the two internal strife between the Phoenix Race because of the hybrids and purebloods should be a fabricated story, right?”
“What exactly is your identity?”
The Undying Dark Phoenix opened its eyes again and looked at Shi Yu. “That story is true. From the perspective of the Phoenix Race, I’m indeed the mother of Mu Huiyin and the empress, but from the perspective of humans…”
“I was wrong about this. In the end, I brought this upon myself. I’ve understood that perhaps my soul dissipating is my best fate now.”
“I’ll tell you everything I know. Then, please let it end me,” the Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Chi Tong and said weakly.
“Tell me.” Shi Yu felt that the history hidden behind it might not be simple, so he asked.
The Undying Dark Phoenix said, “The origin of everything still starts from the Mythical Era…”
“According to the records of the Phoenix Race, the Mythical Era ended because of the war, and Blue Planet shattered. After that, the powerful gods of the Phoenix Race left Blue Planet one after another.”
“Only a small portion of the Phoenix Race that didn’t become gods stayed behind and evolved into the Phoenix Race in the future.”
“After a long time, the Phoenix Race slowly forgot about the Mythical Era. History was annihilated in time, but one day, a half-god of the Phoenix Race went to the starry sky to break through to the divine level.”
“However, it couldn’t break through to the divine level on this trip, so it was forced to return because it couldn’t withstand the environment of the starry sky.”
“At this moment, its lifespan is already coming to an end. It only wants to die in its hometown.”
“However, during the process of returning, it accidentally entered a Phoenix Race ruin in the starry sky.”
“That’s a mystic realm created by a Phoenix God who left Blue Planet in the Mythical Era. Inside is a secret treasure it brought back from the depths of the starry sky.”
“In terms of resource level, that secret treasure is even above the divine level. Back then, the Phoenix Race ancestor who brought it back called it a resource that exceeded the divine level.”
“Gaining a secret treasure. This Phoenix Race ancestor was originally very happy and thought that this was its hope of breaking through to the divine level, but soon, it regretfully discovered it.”
“This super divine-level secret treasure is sealed in the ruins. It doesn’t have the ability to take it away at all.”
When the Undying Dark Phoenix finished speaking, the expressions of Shi Yu and the others changed slightly.
“It brought the ruins back to Blue Planet and the Phoenix Race before dying.”
“Later, after the Phoenix Race’s research, they discovered that if they want to take away the resources, they probably need divine-level power.”
“Just demigod-level isn’t enough.”
“But in an era where the laws are incomplete, it’s impossible for divine-level power to appear.”
“At that time, in order to study the ruins, the Phoenix Race had already consumed a large amount of resources, causing the Phoenix Race to become much weaker. It was directly surpassed by the Dragon Race. After discussion in the race, in order to not let the Phoenix Race continue its endless investment and decline because of this ruin, they decided to seal the ruins and leave behind ancestral teachings. They would wait for the Mythical Revival before opening it.”
“From then on, this ruin became a forbidden area for the Phoenix Race and the most important place.”
“Until, in our generation, the Phoenix Race gave birth to two demigods. One was me, and the other was my sister.” The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and the others.
“Sister’s talent has been better than mine since she was young. She suppressed me in every aspect. In the end, it was also this one who became the Phoenix Race Leader.”
“We all have the bloodline of the Sun God Phoenix, but it was even more outstanding. It took a step further and successfully evolved towards the Four Spirits of Heaven, the Vermillion Bird. At that time, it was known as the creature closest to the Vermillion Bird.”
“It even established a huge country and was worshiped as a god. Its citizens were spread throughout various races, and among them, the number of humans was the greatest.”
“At that time, I was very indignant. I wanted to surpass it, but there was nothing I could do.”
“Until I had a premonition dream.”
“The premonition dream told me that humans are the key to opening that Starry Sky Phoenix Race ruin. As long as I can open this ruin, I can become the strongest of the Phoenix Race and lead the Phoenix Race to a more prosperous peak, surpassing Sister. For some reason, I believed this premonition dream.”
“No, or rather, this dream only provided me with an excuse. I’ve long had this thought.”
“In the end, I chose an unacceptable path.”
“The Phoenix Race pursues the purity of bloodline, but in order to become stronger, I began to modify my bloodline and valued the potential of humans. I tried to modify the human body of human Beast Tamers and modify them into hybrids of the Phoenix Race. I hope to use hybrid humans as nutrients to make me stronger.”
“In fact, if I can use humans to break through to the divine level, I can lead the Phoenix Race to a new chapter.”
“During this period, tens of thousands of humans died because of my hybrid experiment. Some of them were captured from outside the Phoenix Nation, but their talent was not very good. In the end, I aimed at the humans who had undergone the Purification of the Phoenix Mystic Realm and had superior bloodlines. They were all believers of the Vermillion Bird and had outstanding talent.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1184 - 1184 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (3)
chapters.content:
1184 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (3)
“However, the truth always comes out, there is no concealing the truth. I was discovered by my sister and it was very angry. It immediately forbidden me from continuing to modify my bloodline and stop this nonsense. It also wanted to judge me. According to the clan rules, it wanted to lock me up for a thousand years to reflect. I was naturally unwilling, so I led the clansmen who followed me to fight it.”
“During this period, I secretly sent one of my proudest daughters, who contains my bloodline, out of the Phoenix Nation in advance, worried that she would be injured.” The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Chi Tong.
“The internal strife lasted for a long time.”
“We suffered a crushing defeat in this battle, but on account of our old feelings, we were lucky enough to successfully escape. I led a portion of the Phoenix Race to leave the Phoenix Nation and come to Dong Huang to find that perfect hybrid.”
“Unfortunately, I can’t find her anymore.”
“In addition, our vitality was greatly injured, so we opened a new mystic realm and fell into a deep sleep to recuperate. This sleep lasted for a thousand years.”
“After waking up again, I picked up the plan and continued to create a large number of Phoenix hybrids, establishing a new faction in the east, the Phoenix Empire.”
“Because there were no totem demigods in the east at that time, we quickly became the number one faction.”
“A large number of mixed-blood Beast Tamers of the Phoenix Race also became the batch of human Beast Tamers with the best talent in the east at that time. Among them, Huang Xi was the Empress Dong Huang you mentioned. She was one of them.”
“In the beginning, her talent potential was actually not good among the many Phoenix hybrids.”
“She’s a late bloomer. No one expected her to become a legendary Beast Tamer who can fight demigods in the end.”
“Actually, from the moment we woke up and rebuilt the Phoenix Empire, Sister has already noticed us.”
“Seeing that we don’t repent and continue to challenge the Phoenix Race’s rules, it’s completely angry this time.”
“The Phoenix Race won’t allow their bloodline to flow to other races at all, nor will they allow the bloodline of their race to be tainted.”
“Therefore, the Phoenix Nation, which was far away on the overseas island, became the greatest enemy of the Phoenix Empire.”
“Both parties started the totem battle again.”
“Retrieving my home and proving that I’m the orthodox one, taking away the super-divine-level resources left behind by the ancestor of the Phoenix Race, has also become the primary goal of the Phoenix Empire I lead.”
“This time, because of the existence of the hybrid Beast Tamer, we’re not at a disadvantage.”
“In fact, as Huang Xi exceeded everyone’s expectations and became a Legendary Beast Tamer, our strength has already exceeded the Phoenix Nation, forcing Sister and the others to retreat step by step.”
“At this moment, I realize that the time is ripe. We’ve tampered with every hybrid Beast Tamer. We can use them as sacrifices and turn them into nutrients for our growth.”
“I judge that if I absorb Huang Xi, my strength can definitely become a peak demigod not inferior to the Blue Sea Sprite. I can even surpass the demigod level and become a divine level.”
“Therefore, I attacked. However, I didn’t expect that I had underestimated her. Her strength had long escaped my control. Although the backup plan I left behind was useful, I was still killed by her.”
“However, because I ate the Undying Fruit, I successfully revived and became an undead.”
“Perhaps it’s also because of kinship. After that, she didn’t completely kill me. She only sealed me.”
“This is all I’ve experienced since I was sealed here…” The Undying Dark Phoenix sighed.” Huang Xi is a good child. You look very similar. I’ve let you down. I actually wanted to use this method to become stronger. ”
The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Chi Tong and repented.
Shi Yu and the others also fell into deep thought.
On the other hand, Chi Tong heaved a sigh of relief. After completely confirming that it didn’t have a deep mother-daughter relationship with the Undying Dark Phoenix, it was relieved. If Mu Huiyin didn’t acknowledge its bloodline, it was the same. It only needed Shi Yu.
This bloodline brought too much suffering to Mu Huiyin, and it even made Mu Huiyin take the initiative to strip the bloodline away later. After Little Chi Tong heard the source of the bloodline, if it weren’t for the fact that this bloodline could bring him strength and allow him to protect Shi Yu better, he would also want to give it up.
As expected, it felt that there was a reason why it liked the sword skill Mu Huiyin left behind more and not the power of the Phoenix.
“What happened after that?” Shi Yu asked.
“How did the empress dynasty perish and how did you become like this?”
The Undying Dark Phoenix said, “In the end… after I was sealed, Huang Xi changed the national name of the Phoenix Empire to Dong Huang. Compared to the identity of the Phoenix Race, she acknowledges her identity as a human more.”
“The Phoenix Totem Nation finally became a human country.”
“She ended the totem war in the east in one go. With the strength of a Legendary Beast Tamer, she let the east enter a peaceful era again. However, many years later, Sister broke through and started a war with Dong Huang again.”
“The years of war have already made the conflict between the two parties irresolvable.”
“Sister is much stronger than me, but after Huang Xi grew to the peak, she became even stronger. Not only am I not her match, even after Sister broke through, she’s no longer her match.”
“She led the Phoenix Army alone and blocked Sister and the others outside the country.”
“After having the advantage, Huang Xi wants to take another step forward and take away the legendary super-divine-level resources left in the Phoenix Race.”
“She’s been very strong since she was young. Legendary isn’t the end she wants. This resource might be able to allow her to take another step forward.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1185 - 1185 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (4)
chapters.content:
1185 The Truth of the Empress Dynasty (4)
“However, when Sister saw that Huang Xi had targeted a super-level resource, she also fought back with all her might.”
“In the end, according to what I know, Sister and Huang Xi perished together in the final battle. Huang Xi wanted to take away the super-divine-level resource in the Phoenix Race, but she encountered a trap set up by Sister in advance. The entire ruin disintegrated because of this battle, causing them and the entire ruin to fall into the spatial flux.”
“In the seal, after learning about their situation, I began to think of cracking the seal and obtaining a new life. I studied the seal and absorbed the death aura that filled this place to continue modifying my bloodline. In the end, I modified myself into this ghost appearance. Not only did I not crack the seal, but I also turned the surroundings into a dead land. The so-called curse and plague were also the consequences of my own actions.”
After the Undying Dark Phoenix finished speaking, it said, “I’ve already told you everything I know. Because of me, the entire Phoenix Race was almost exterminated. My daughter, who was originally close to me, also left me, and Sister lost her life because of this. The sins on my body no longer allow me to live in this world.”
The Undying Dark Phoenix was indeed very regretful now. If it hadn’t betrayed the Phoenix Race back then, the Phoenix Race wouldn’t have weakened to this extent. If it had reflected in time and didn’t attack the empress or make the empress become enemies with the Phoenix Race, perhaps the empress would be the one with the greatest hope of leading the Phoenix Race to the peak.
Unfortunately, every mistake caused so many evil consequences. Now that it had finally been rescued from the seal by a daughter, it still made the wrong choice. The Undying Dark Phoenix felt that its life was a failure.
Shi Yu and the others were silent.
They didn’t know if it was because Susu’s Sea Cleansing Spirit had taken effect, but they could feel that the Undying Dark Phoenix was indeed sincerely repenting.
However, what surprised Shi Yu, the gem cat, and the others was that so many twists and turns had happened during the era of the empress dynasty.
“Where’s the location of that cosmic ruin?” Shi Yu asked.
The Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and shook its head. “On a huge island, it’s called Phoenix Island. It’s the initial headquarters of the Phoenix Race.”
“However, if you’re also thinking about that super-level resource, I advise you to give up. The entire cosmic ruin was swept into the spatial flux because of the battle between Huang Xi and my sister. Phoenix Island also sank because of the war. It’s impossible to find it again.”
The Undying Dark Phoenix said, “Can you kill me now?”
The gem cat said, “Unfortunate. Aren’t super-level resources on the same level as the Eye of the Evil God!!”
The cat felt pity.
The Phoenix Race was really rich.
“Chi Tong.” Shi Yu looked at Chi Tong in the form of a Sword Maiden. Chi Tong shook its head, indicating that the Undying Dark Phoenix had nothing to do with her. Shi Yu could decide whatever he wanted.
In the end, Shi Yu was silent. He swept the gem cat and the others out of the Devour Space.
He planned to think about it before deciding how to deal with the Undying Dark Phoenix.
It couldn’t die yet. At least, it had to let Buggy enter a dream, Susu’s memory water drop, and verify its words to obtain more details.
….
“The empress actually perished with the sister of the Undying Dark Phoenix, a demigod who evolved towards the Vermillion Bird.”
“When the Undying Dark Phoenix was alive, it was really a demigod.”
“Super divine-level resources in the Phoenix Race…”
“The predecessor of the empress dynasty, the totem country, the Phoenix Empire…”
Shi Yu and the others, who had received countless information at once, felt an itch in their hearts. So this was how the Phoenix Race was almost exterminated.
Among them, Shi Yu couldn’t forget it the most.
He wanted Qi to bring them back to the era of the empress dynasty to take a look. Chi Tong’s little sister, the empress, died just like that. It was a pity. He had seen Emperor Wu, and he also wanted to see the empress very much.
So what was the super-level resource brought back by the Phoenix Race’s ancestor from the starry sky? Did the gods of Blue Planet really make a name for themselves in the starry sky?
He also wanted to ask how strong that genius sister of the Undying Dark Phoenix who was evolving towards the Vermillion Bird was.
“Everyone, I want to return to the space and time of the empress era to take a look. What about you?” Shi Yu asked his contracted pets and immediately received cheers from everyone.
Only Qi hit her head and said, “You’ve all broken through. I, I, I’ll be exhausted. Unless, Shi Yu, you help me add some quasi-divine skills to increase the proficiency of Space-time Travel. If you break through, you should be able to add some quasi-divine skills, right?”
Shi Yu’s face turned pale. He would die too…

chapters.title: Chapter 1186 - 1186 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (1)
chapters.content:
1186 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (1)
Ancient Capital University!
Shi Yu and the gem cat solved the hidden danger of the Ancient Capital, the Undead Battlefield, without anyone noticing.
He hid his merits and reputation and returned to Back School.
Unfortunately, from now on, the Undead Battlefield would be crippled, and there would be fewer and fewer undead.
But it wasn’t a big problem. This kind of training place was too dangerous, so it was fine not to.
When the time came, Shi Yu could completely build a better training place for the Ancient Capital.
To put it bluntly, the Undead Battlefield was a dangerous place affected by a top-notch totem that had fallen from a demigod.
Which pet in Shi Yu’s team was inferior to it?
