Shi Yu casually patted his head and could think of ten training locations that were not inferior to the Undead Battlefield.
Then, Shi Yu and the gem cat girl returned to Ancient Capital University.
He found Principal Feng.
“Shi Yu, you’re awake??”
Principal Feng, who was watering the plants and stepping into retirement, was very surprised to see Shi Yu and the gem cat girl appear.
He could be said to have nothing else to ask for now.
The school had the strongest Legendary and the weakest demigod. What else was there to work hard for? They just had to lie flat.
His name would definitely be recorded in history with the names of Shi Yu and the gem cat.
After a few days of fermentation, although the world still didn’t know which level Shi Yu had broken through to, that battle directly changed Shi Yu’s title from “world legend” to “strongest Legendary”.
After being numb for a few days, Principal Feng gradually accepted it.
After all, even his granddaughter had become a titled legend. It was not a big deal for Shi Yu and the gem cat to become Legendary battle power and demigod battle power.
“From the looks of it, you don’t look like you just woke up.”
Principal Feng looked at the energetic Shi Yu and the others with unsatisfied expressions.
“Roar, roar, roar.” Eleven, who was following beside Shi Yu, touched its stomach and asked if the university could still provide food.
A Yin Yang Millstone had just come. Although it had controlled its power, it was still hungry.
Principal Feng’s expression darkened. “I… It can’t anymore!”
Shi Yu, this panda, was already at the demigod level. It could eat all of Ancient Capital University alone!
Shi Yu’s entire team… could eat up the Ancient Capital!
Shi Yu had slept for seven days since Shi Yu returned and Principal Feng could tell that he was no longer human!
It was better to let Shi Yu and the others think of a way to solve it themselves!
“Wu…” Eleven lowered its head aggrievedly. Principal Feng, you’ve changed. In the past, you always made me eat everything.
“Indeed, I didn’t just wake up. After waking up, I dragged Teacher Ying to the Undead Battlefield for a walk,” Shi Yu said.
Principal Feng: “I went to the Undead Battlefield for a walk…”
He suddenly had a bad feeling.
“What did you do?”
“I let the Undying Dark Phoenix out along the way,” the gem cat girl said.
Principal Feng’s eyes rolled back and he almost fainted from fright. Why did they act on their own!!
But soon, he realized that… it didn’t seem to be a big problem?
He instantly imagined the scene of the Undying Dark Phoenix breaking through the seal and seeing three to four demigods surrounding him.
That felt so good…
“So, so is what the Undying Dark Phoenix said previously true?” Principal Feng immediately asked.
Shi Yu and the gem cat girl looked at each other and said to Principal Feng, “It’s Yun An’s neighbor now.”
Principal Feng understood. Villain, right? He knew that this Phoenix wasn’t a good person!
“But the Undying Dark Phoenix is indeed the empress’s mother.”
Principal Feng widened his eyes and immediately had an extremely hungry expression. “Quick, tell me…”
Who wasn’t an archeologist?
“Wait, a message,” Shi Yu said in embarrassment. “President Lin.”
A moment later, Shi Yu finished replying.
Principal Feng asked, “What is it?”
Shi Yu said, “It’s nothing. He brought the Prediction Owl to a meeting in the Alliance. Teacher Owl suddenly broke through for a while in the meeting and asked me what was going on.”
“Forget about them. Let’s continue.”
Principal Feng: …
The gem cat: “Damn it!”
…
Then, Shi Yu told Principal Feng the secret of the empress dynasty.
Principal Feng sighed continuously!
After satisfying his curiosity, Principal Feng fell into a sigh.
He really wanted to witness it personally!
It could be said that it wasn’t just Shi Yu. Every archeological Beast Tamer had the feeling of wanting to participate personally after learning a lost history.
Unfortunately, they didn’t pray.
“Well, so I’ll leave the Undead Battlefield to you to deal with the aftermath,” Shi Yu said.
Principal Feng : “…”
He knew that Shi Yu’s goal in telling him about this was definitely to push the blame.
“I understand, I understand. Leave the rest to me.”
“Are you going back to the icy plain?” Principal Feng asked.
“No, I still have to stay here for a period of time,” Shi Yu said.
Shi Yu temporarily had no intention of leaving Ancient Capital University. After all, he still had to work with the gem cat to seal Yun An.
If the gem cat worked harder, Buggy and the others could work less…
The premise was that the gem cat didn’t let him take care of food.
“Alright, I’ll see if I can call Qingyi back,” Principal Feng said. “She definitely wants to know about the empress. When the time comes, you can tell her.”
“No problem.” Shi Yu nodded.
About a week later.
Yun An was sealed in the Legendary Ruins by Shi Yu and the others and sent to Wu Ling City.
Senior Ji Mengzhu’s hands were almost trembling as she took the ruin she had personally given Shi Yu.
She didn’t expect that after going around in circles, the family heirloom would return to her. Moreover, it had changed from a tool to seal a top-notch totem to a tool to seal the half-god Yun An.

chapters.title: Chapter 1187 - 1187 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (2)
chapters.content:
1187 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (2)
Ji Mengzhu looked at the item and thought about him. She felt that at this moment, Emperor Wu and her father’s spirits in heaven could also be comforted.
“Your progress is still too slow.” After Shi Yu and the others left, Ji Mengzhu said to Lin Xiuzhu, “Shi Yu… When I met him, he was only a level-six Beast Tamer. Now, he’s already the strongest Legendary. If you want to catch up to him like this, according to the normal training method, it’s completely not enough.”
Senior Panda smiled bitterly. “Then what should we do? It’s alright, I won’t chase anymore. I’ll nurture the Iron-eating Beast Corps for him.”
Ji Mengzhu sighed. Yes, what should they do? Shi Yu was like Emperor Shi of the Time Emperor Era, Emperor Wu of the Emperor Wu Era. No, he was stronger than them.
In this situation, how could his peers catch up? Even if they had Legendary aptitude, it was completely insufficient.
After all, the current Shi Yu was recognized as the strongest Legendary on Blue Planet.
On Shi Yu’s side, without the Legendary Ruins, the turtle, Little Ice, and the short cat had also changed their training environment.
It wasn’t the Blue Sea Ruins, but a portable mystic realm created by Buggy itself.
This way, it would be easier for it to modify the training environment, and it would be more convenient to train the will of the four heavenly beasts’ followers.
After finishing his work here, Shi Yu could finally busy himself.
His current goal was to become a demigod. It was best to wait until the Mythical stage completely revived. Once he broke through, he would directly be invincible at the divine level.
…
Shi Yu’s first goal was to add points to Little Ji and Duckie and pull their super Skills to the current limit.
Using this and Baby Ginseng’s supplements to increase his physique…
As for Qi’s spatial travel, the current success rate of teaching was extremely low. Shi Yu really didn’t dare to teach it. He decisively threw Qi to Buggy to continue the special training of Resistance. At least, he had to have the overlord’s Resistance before coming!
If he wanted to add points, he could train his Resistance!
As for Duckie and the others’ quasi-divine skills that already had the overlord’s Resistance, Shi Yu actually dared to teach them. This was because as he broke through, the success rate of teaching those quasi-divine skills had already reached a low level.
Coupled with multiple supports, although the consumption was huge, there might be a success rate.
Apart from that, because of this breakthrough, a pile of super top-notch Skills with a success rate of 0 also had a success rate. Unfortunately, it was also extremely low.
For example, Eleven’s Demon God Body and Thunder God Armor could actually be fused. Although the success rate was extremely low, Shi Yu was also very curious about what kind of skill could be fused.
From the difficulty, it was most likely a quasi-divine skill!
Quasi-divine physique skill!
He felt that… if it fused, it could definitely defeat Ancient God Golden Bull’s physique quasi-divine skill.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t want to try this extremely low level easily at the moment… He planned to go from frugal to extravagant.
After the demigod battle in the Demon Sea that shook the world, the strongest Legendary Shi Yu disappeared from everyone’s vision again.
Shi Yu returned to the icy plain and started cultivating again.
First was Duckie’s Demon Subduing Staff, Abyss Liberation, Death Vortex, and Dark Sky Wave Rain. They were all chosen by Shi Yu (Perfect+47).
Low-level Skills could also be fused, but because there were too few accompanying moves, Shi Yu didn’t move for the time being. He planned to replicate more Skills like Team One in the future and give it customized fusion skills.
At this moment, Duckie’s battle power, together with the Heart of the Abyss, could be said to be very fierce. Its battle power was close to the first team. What it lacked was replication of top-notch skills and exclusive cultivation.
Of course, if the duck became stronger, Little Ji would definitely become stronger. They were both super Skills, but they were all upgraded to (Perfect+47). Among them, because the compatibility between the Earth Domain and the earthquake was too high, Shi Yu conveniently fused it into Earth Control.
It could be said that apart from basic intelligence, everything else was already the limit.
At this moment, apart from Little Purple and Qi, the contracted pets in Shi Yu’s team already had the overlord’s Resistance.
Shi Yu did not stop adding points. He continued to add points crazily and attacked Little Purple.
Although Little Purple’s Resistance was lacking, after suffering a little, super Skills could still be added.
On the other hand, although Eleven and Susu’s super Skill could already continue to increase points from transcendent to Dao Proficiency, Shi Yu didn’t want to.
On Eleven’s side, it was because the stronger it was, the greater its appetite, and the greater the burden on the Beast Tamer. The physique Shi Yu received from feedback was completely incomparable to the burden. If he continued to add points to it, it was better to add points to Little Purple. After Little Purple became stronger, not only was it free of burden, but it could also strengthen the Beast Taming Space and continue to reduce the burden.
It was obvious who it was that was more comfortable for the Beast Tamer.
As for Susu, it didn’t need to add any points at all. It just needed to use Infinite Devour to digest the inheritance of the Blue Sea Ruins. At the totem level, its acceptance speed was even faster. Shi Yu didn’t need to trouble himself with the two inheritance skills from transcendent to Dao Proficiency.
In fact, for the sake of Shi Yu’s state, he had to take it easy.
Just like that, two months later, Shi Yu’s physique finally had a small breakthrough. Ling thought that he could contract a totem demigod above his level.
In theory, it was best to choose Little Purple, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy for this totem.
Among them, Little Zi had broken through to the totem level. Its feedback to the Beast Taming Space was definitely the greatest. However, Little Zi only had medium Resistance at the moment. It had just become an overlord. Continuing to add points to the totem level would consume too much energy.
Baby Ginseng could break through immediately. At that time, it could strengthen Shi Yu’s recovery ability. The supplements it created would also have stronger effects.
It was the same for Buggy. After breaking through, its Dragon of Imagination could be raised to transcendent. It could allow it to evolve again. At that time, Shi Yu estimated that Buggy would also be a Mythical Race. As a spatial element, its feedback to Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space would be second only to Little Purple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1188 - 1188 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (3)
chapters.content:
1188 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (3)
Apart from that, there was also a more comprehensive attribute feedback.
However, in the end, no one of these three were chosen.
He used Chi Tong as the first candidate. This was an additional reward for being first in the previous team. Apart from that, there was another reason. Shi Yu and the others were tired of staying and planned to go to the empress era to play.
Shi Yu and the others’ current situation was that because the breakthrough had become too strong, the pressure when Qi transmigrated would be much greater than before.
However, due to the restriction of Qi’s will, it was too early to add points. Although Qi later expressed that she didn’t mind and could transmigrate with Shi Yu and the others if she consumed more energy, Shi Yu couldn’t bear to.
Therefore, after two months of training, Shi Yu successfully did something else.
Shi Yu transferred Qi from the contract of the second Beast Taming Space to the first Beast Taming Space and officially promoted Qi to the first team.
After arriving at the first team and enjoying the nourishment of the level-eight space, Qi was immediately strengthened. At this moment, the consumption would be much lower if she transmigrated with Shi Yu and the others.
Unfortunately, Shi Yu had only trained his body in the past two months and ignored the upgrade of the second space. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have gone through so much trouble to let Qi move.
As he was going to the empress era next, keeping the breakthrough opportunity for Chi Tong was definitely the best choice.
Because the empress dynasty was the era of the Phoenix. At that time, opportunities were everywhere for the Phoenix. If Chi Tong wasn’t allowed to break through and evolve in one wave, it would simply be a waste of the opportunity to transmigrate.
He also wanted to take a look at the super divine-level resources of the Phoenix Race. It was said that only divine-level power could take them away. If Chi Tong wasn’t even a demigod, it would definitely be difficult for Shi Yu to take them away.
If Chi Tong reached the demigod level, could possess him, eat the Time Fruit, and sacrifice more than ten totem-level scapegoats… Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t impossible to instantly reach divine-level battle power.
In the past two months, Chi Tong had done nothing else. It took out its bird spirit and phoenix spirit form, which was the bloodline from the Undying Dark Phoenix, and squeezed them into clones.
This way, not only could it escape the influence of the Undying Dark Phoenix, but it could also only inherit Mu Huiyin’s talent and be itself.
As for the Phoenix clone, Shi Yu and the others planned to nurture it towards the Vermillion Bird to see if it could succeed. Apart from the existing cultivation methods, Shi Yu was also about to return and learn from the Undying Dark Phoenix’s sister. Wasn’t the other party known as the Sun God Phoenix that had mastered the power of the Starry Sky Vermillion Bird, the demigod closest to the Vermillion Bird…
Therefore, now, Chi Tong’s image had already become a humanoid sword spirit. The one standing on the Phoenix clone and holding the sword… was the Phoenix Sword Maiden!
The next stage of evolution was the Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden holding the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation.
…
“Let’s go!!!” After cultivating bitterly for two months, Shi Yu was extremely excited. He could finally travel through space and time again.
They chose an auspicious day and quickly set off.
Shi Yu flew through Psychic power and didn’t ride on his pet to enjoy the vastness of the sky.
However, just as Shi Yu passed through the Demon Capital, he suddenly braked and stopped flying towards the Space Island.
He looked at his cell phone with a surprised expression.
It was a person who sent a message in the Bureau 11 group.
The sender was Gu Yun.
The only person who was absent from the last Bureau 11 meeting.
It was that veteran of Bureau 11, the former strongest archeologist of Dong Huang who could be said to be the director of Bureau 11.
Through the ruins, this senior had helped Dong Huang obtain two Mythical resources alone. More than ten legendary resources. He was quite a legendary figure.
Unfortunately, it was said that he had gone to explore a Mythical Ruins and had not come out for five years.
At the same time, he told no one to disturb him and look for him. Otherwise, not only would they not help him, but they would also do something bad with good intentions.
An Expert like him was indeed qualified not to let others point fingers.
At this moment, he sent a group message. This meant that… he had successfully cracked the Mythical Ruins and came out??
The message was just sent a few seconds ago. In the ruins for several years, it was also rare for cell phones to still have electricity. It should be a mechanical life form.
Gu Yun: “I’m out. I’m outside that ruin now. My pet and I haven’t eaten for a long time and have lost our mobility. We’re very hungry now. Anyone. Hurry up and send some food over…”
In the group: “!!!”
Lu Qingyi: “Senior Gu?!”
Li Lianping: “Who’s near the Demon Capital?”
Ke Yingzong: “Senior Gu, don’t worry. I’m contacting the president of the Demon Capital Association, but the food of the seven overlords might take a while to prepare.”
Fang Lan looked at the chat and trembled.
Shi Yu looked at the coordinates and was silent for a moment. “I happen to be near the Demon Capital. It’s very close. I’ll send some food to Senior Gu first.”
Lu Qingyi: “Shi Yu, are you there? Please.”
Shi Yu didn’t expect to encounter a senior from Bureau 11 who cracked the ruins and came out of seclusion on the way.
Staying in the Mythical Ruins for six years… The resources brought at the start were probably completely insufficient to support the other party’s activities.
They had finally come out this time. They must be starving.
Shi Yu’s entire team could understand the feeling of hunger.
After looking at the coordinates, Shi Yu quickly ran towards the location of the Demon Capital Mythical Ruins recorded in Bureau 11’s Index.
It didn’t take long for Shi Yu to reach the location.
At this moment, Senior Gu Yun was lying weakly on the ground with seven overlord-level pets. The surroundings were like a primitive forest. The old Senior Gu was already skin and bones. His overlord-level pets were also extremely weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 1189 - 1189 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (4)
chapters.content:
1189 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (4)
From the looks of it, after using the last of his strength to send the message, Shi Yu saw that the other party’s overlord mechanical pet that looked like an Index had already been completely switched off and fell into a dormant state.
When Shi Yu saw Senior Gu like this, he immediately took out a sachet and dispersed the fragrance.
In the next moment, the white-haired Senior Gu Yun and the pets immediately looked better and slowly opened their eyes.
“Senior Gu, eat.” Shi Yu took out some spirit food with relatively mild nutrition that the team usually ate and used his Psychic power to control it to float in front of Senior Gu and the others.
Smelling the fragrance, they were like hungry ghosts as they crazily ate it.
After wolfing it down, the pale Senior Gu Yun’s face instantly turned much redder. At this moment, Gu Yun was very surprised. He had only drunk a few mouthfuls of milk tea and eaten a few dried fruits, but his body immediately felt warm and quickly recovered to a healthy state?
What kind of food was this?
Gu Yun knew very well how poor his condition was. What kind of food could allow him to recover so quickly so gently?
“Roar!!!” At the same time, he could also sense that his overlord pets had clearly only eaten a small portion, but they immediately became spirited. It was simply unbelievable.
“You are…” At this moment, after recovering slightly, Senior Gu Yun, who was sitting on the ground and leaning against a tree, finally noticed Shi Yu in front of him.
A young man in his early twenties.
He got up with Shi Yu’s help.
“Senior Gu, my name is Shi Yu, a newbie of Bureau 11. Lu Qingyi invited me to join the bureau. I happened to be near the Demon Capital. After seeing the message, I was the first to rush over,” Shi Yu said.
Senior Gu Yun looked at Shi Yu. “Newbie…”
“Yeah, it’s been six years.”
“Shi Yu, the food you gave us just now must be very precious. Thank you.”
He was sincerely grateful.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “You don’t have to worry about it. They’re all Normal food. They’re very nutritious and suitable for Enfeebled people to absorb.”
“Qingyi has invited an impressive genius,” Senior Gu Yun said kindly. How could those be Normal food? To be able to carry these things with him, this newbie from Bureau 11 was probably impressive.
He was definitely an archeologist with a legend aptitude and was being heavily nurtured by the association.
He wondered if Lu Qingyi had broken through to the legend level in six years.
“Senior Gu, are you feeling better?” Shi Yu asked. “I still have food here.”
Old Gu Yun hurriedly waved his hand and said, “There’s no need. It’s enough. I say, kid, do you know where this is…”
“Haha, Mythical Ruins.” The old man suddenly laughed.
“I’ve already cracked it. From it, I even obtained a Mythical resource! Haha, a Mythical resource in six years, not a loss!!!”
Senior Gu Yun looked at Shi Yu and said, “But this ruin is really dangerous. I almost couldn’t return. I was lucky to bring this Mythical resource back this time. You juniors, don’t take such a risk in the future.”
Gu Yun had already expected Shi Yu’s shocked expression. After all, Mythical resources and such archeological gains were enough to shock the archeological world.
“Mythical resource?!!” However, to Gu Yun’s surprise, this newbie, Shi Yu, was very composed. He was only slightly surprised.
Elder Gu was stunned. Not bad, not bad. His mental fortitude was not bad.
This newbie from Bureau 11 was quite outstanding.
In the current era where Bureau 11 was deficient, it was rare and precious. Gu Yun sighed. After this, he was prepared to retire and really didn’t have the energy to mess around with ruins. It was better to invest his energy in these new generations of Bureau 11 and nurture them.
He felt that Shi Yu, who had come to deliver food to him immediately, was not bad.
“Senior Gu!!!”
At this moment, the sound of a helicopter suddenly appeared in the sky. At the same time, a broadcast-like loudspeaker sounded. A helicopter-type mechanical life form suddenly landed here.
The helicopter landed not far away. A slightly plump middle-aged man in a gray formal suit immediately ran over nervously with a group of medical staff.
“Senior Gu!!! Are you alright!!”
“Little Huo.” When Senior Gu saw this middle-aged fatty, he immediately smiled and said, “I’m fine.”
“You’re a step too late. I’ve already been saved. It’s all thanks to Shi Yu. He happened to be nearby.”
The middle-aged man in front of him was the president of the Demon Capital Association, the legend Beast Tamer, Huo Di.
“Sorry, sorry, Senior Gu, we’re late.” At this moment, President Huo Di’s attention suddenly shifted as he looked at Shi Yu, who was nodding at him.
“President Huo, Senior Gu sent a message to Bureau 11. I happened to be nearby, so I rushed over first. However, he still has to undergo a full checkup. I’ll leave it to you,” Shi Yu said.
President Huo’s eyes widened.
“Legendary Shi Yu?!”
Holy shit.
Bureau 11 actually sent this god.
He almost suffocated.
As a Legend, he was already qualified to know some things and understand how terrifying the young man in front of him was.
One person killed two demigods!
The recognized strongest Legendary Beast Tamer of the Blue Star Alliance.
Speaking of which, the first time he heard of Shi Yu was at the Feeding Conference… Who would have thought that in a short period of time, this young man who was first unearthed by Bureau 11 had already grown to such a ridiculous extent?

chapters.title: Chapter 1190 - 1190 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (5)
chapters.content:
1190 Transmigrating to the Empress Era (5)
Blue Planet’s strongest!
Perhaps not every legend in Dong Huang knew this title, and he happened to have channels to know some inside information.
It could be said that this was publicly acknowledged in the world. Even Divine Source Legendarys were inferior to the young man in front of them.
President Huo didn’t expect that the first to rush to Senior Gu’s side was actually Shi Yu.
“Legendary Shi Yu, I understand. I’ll immediately bring Senior Gu to undergo a full inspection.” As President Huo finished speaking, Senior Gu beside him was stunned.
What, what, Shi Yu Legendary? What kind of strange title was this??
He didn’t understand why Huo Di was so strange.
The surrounding medical staff were also stunned. They also knew Shi Yu.
World legend Shi Yu!
However, why did President Huo call him Legendary Shi Yu?
“Senior Gu, your body shouldn’t be in any major problems anymore, but it’s better to do a full checkup,” Shi Yu said.
There was a professional medical-type mechanical overlord in a first-level city. From a professional perspective, it was considered a fusion of Baby Ginseng and Ling. Although Shi Yu was already certain that the other party was fine, it was better to professionally check it according to the process. It could let the other party know his physical condition more clearly and save him the trouble.
“Alright…” Senior Gu nodded as he spoke telepathically to the junior he was more familiar with, Huo Di.
[Little Huo, why were you calling Shi Yu just now a Legendary?? What kind of strange name is this?!] He was confused.
President Huo smiled bitterly. He suddenly realized that Elder Gu had explored the ruins for six years… He probably knew nothing about the changes in the outside world.
He gathered his thoughts and let Elder Gu sense them.
[Elder Gu, Legendary Shi Yu. Although he’s a newbie of Bureau 11, he has already taken over your title and become the strongest archeologist on Dong Huang, no, Blue Planet. Apart from that, in two months, he even personally led three totem half-gods to kill the totem half-god who destroyed Emperor Wu Dynasty, Yun An, and the ancient Abyss Sea half-god. He’s already the recognized strongest Legendary on Blue Planet. Even Divine Source Legendary has decided to give him the position…]
[Elder Gu, times have changed. The young man in front of you is the strongest human on Blue Planet now.]
Gu Yun: “?”
The old man suddenly widened his eyes and looked at Shi Yu. He had just been saved, and now he suddenly had a heart disease.
Shi Yu: …
….
One after another, the members of Bureau 11 rushed to the Demon Capital. Elder Gu suppressed his emotions and accepted the inspection, mainly because he also suspected that there was a problem with his reception of information from the outside world.
“Shi Yu, why are you near the Demon Capital?” Lu Qingyi, who had rushed over, nudged Shi Yu and asked.
“Thanks to you, Elder Gu looks more energetic than I imagined.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’m preparing to travel overseas.”
“Oh, where?” Senior Lu said.
“I told you previously. Although the Undying Dark Phoenix said that Phoenix Island, the enemy faction of the empress dynasty, has sunk, I still want to find it. Why, do you want to go together?” Shi Yu smiled.
Lu Qingyi shook her head and said, “Forget it, forget it. Invite me along when you find it. I still have many things to do here.”
“Alright then (Great),” Shi Yu said. “Senior, after Elder Gu receives the treatment, greet him for me. I won’t stay here any longer.”
Lu Qingyi: “So anxious?…”
“Archeology.”
There was a reason why Shi Yu went to the dragon vein today. Today was the most active stage of the dragon vein. If he used the power of the dragon vein to transmigrate, the consumption would be reduced to the minimum. If he was a little later, he would have to wait for a long time. Otherwise, why would it be called an auspicious day?
…
Location, Space-time Dragon Vein.
After Shi Yu and the others finally arrived, as Qi exerted strength, a pink and white light that enveloped Shi Yu and the others first flickered before calming down.
In the past space.
Dong Huang Calendar, 955 years.
At the same time, after the destruction of Emperor Wu Dynasty, the totem world was in chaos!
In the east, the Phoenix Empire in the Central Plain was known as the strongest totem country and occupied the richest area.
In the surroundings, there were hundreds of countries. Totem countries of various sizes and human cities dotted the east.
It could be said that in the east, there were hundreds of races standing in a forest. Outstanding heroes were divided, and geniuses kept appearing.
Among them, the hybrid Beast Tamer of the Phoenix Race was the most famous…
The most representative was the daughter of a demigod, Princess Huang Xi of the Phoenix Empire.
…
On the chaotic and silent sea.
Figures appeared out of thin air on this Desolate Island under the dark sky with the pink and white spatial light.
“Coming, coming, Qi, is there another time deviation?!”
“Wu wu, the time seems to be a little earlier than expected.”
“Forget it, forget it. It’s better to be earlier than later. In short, let’s go to Dong Huang to take a look first.” Shi Yu and the others pounced onto the Dong Huang Continent excitedly like wolves, planning to see the current situation in the east first.
This time, Shi Yu and the others had several goals… One of them was to take away the super-divine resources and plunder the Seven Islands Treasure Vault of the Undying Dark Phoenix again!
Also, he wanted to give the empress a spoiler of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s crooked thoughts. He wanted to see the ancient version of motherly filial piety.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1191 - 1191 Promotion, Riches, Marrying the Empress (1)
chapters.content:
1191 Promotion, Riches, Marrying the Empress (1)
In the sky above the endless sea, a cloud flew at a high speed, targeting Dong Huang.
Ling, Wind Element Control, Flying Nimbus Cloud!
Shi Yu sat on the cloud, chilling.
At one end of the cloud was a listless little panda.
After transmigrating, Qi immediately went to the Beast Taming Space to sleep and rest.
After all, there was still the mission to send Shi Yu and the others back to the original space and time later. Driving tirelessly was not enough.
Only Shi Yu and the others were left to conquer this space and time and head to Dong Huang.
As Eleven’s current level was the highest, it was strictly forbidden by Shi Yu to train. In order to avoid it being bored, Shi Yu brought it beside him to watch.
As for the other pets, they were still growing in the Beast Taming Space, leaving only Ling’s Cloud in charge of transportation.
It was mainly because this consumption was relatively small and Buggy’s appetite was too big. At the moment, Shi Yu was becoming more and more careful… He rarely used transportation vehicles like Buggy that lost money.
After all, Baby Ginseng could only ensure that the entire team wasn’t hungry. If it wanted to eat well, Shi Yu still had to think of additional ways…
“Sob.” Eleven suggested that when they reached land, they should find a famous mountain first.
It wanted to thank nature for its gift through turning stone into gold and the Lightning Needle.
Shi Yu said, “That one isn’t filling and even destroys the ecological environment. Let’s go hunt.”
“There’s a big metal-element bird behind. Did you notice? Although it’s a little weak, it can be roasted and eaten.”
Eleven: “Wu wu wu!!”
Eleven felt that it wasn’t good. After all, there was no grudge between them…
Shi Yu took out a metal-element fruit that Eleven usually ate. A tempting fragrance immediately spread.
Eleven couldn’t help but drool as it watched with its black eyes. Unfortunately, this was tomorrow’s portion of food and couldn’t be eaten anymore.
It wiped its saliva and understood that the bad Beast Tamer was going to fish again.
“Jiu!!!!!”
At the same time, in the distant sky, in the clouds, a black dot kept enlarging. Then, under the golden light, a birdman frowned and began to accelerate with joy.
Boom!!!
Golden light shuttled through. Soon, a figure appeared above Shi Yu and the others.
“Stop!”
It looked down at the pair of lives below from a high altitude. The two guys looked very weak. Their energy fluctuations were pitifully weak. It was obvious that they were not nutritious.
On the other hand, the cloud they rode contained a lot of wind essence. It looked like a very good dessert.
Apart from that, the metal-element spiritual fruit in the human’s hand also made it difficult for the golden-winged bird to control its saliva.
Even in the palace, it had never seen such an attractive spiritual fruit.
“Hand over the treasure and I’ll spare your lives.”
Its voice sounded, and its golden sharp claws emitted a dazzling light. It directly grabbed the metal-element spiritual fruit in Shi Yu’s hand. At the same time, its claws enlarged. It looked like it wanted to grab the Flying Nimbus too.
Shi Yu and Eleven looked up at the huge golden-winged bird.
“Damn it.”
The other party’s image disappointed Shi Yu!
After observing it up close, Shi Yu was very dissatisfied with the other party’s image.
It was actually a big bird person with a bird face and a human body and wings. It felt like it was coming from Ming Hua.
If it was a pure bird, Shi Yu wouldn’t feel any psychological pressure if he roasted it. However, why did this guy cultivate a humanoid body? How could he eat this? He couldn’t pass the psychological barrier.
“Eleven.” Shi Yu called out to the listless Eleven listlessly.
“Wuu…” The black and white bear looked at the golden-winged bird in the sky in boredom and stretched out its finger.
“Huh?” At this moment, the Golden-Winged Roc could be said to be determined to get the spiritual fruit in front of it. Seeing that the other party still wanted to resist, it couldn’t help but sneer.
But in the next moment, as the white Wex light flashed below, the golden claw light was instantly obliterated. The terrifying lightning arc instantly made the pupils of the golden-winged bird shrink in disbelief.
“Totem!” It shouted in shock.
He sensed the fluctuations of death from the electric arc.
“Don’t kill me! My father is…”
Buzz.
In the next moment, Wex light flashed. The Golden-Winged Roc in the air was instantly charred and smoking. Smoke lingered in its mouth and eyes as it fell into a heavily injured state.
There was still a trace of strength…
The Golden-Winged Roc turned and fled with difficulty, knowing that it had provoked a guy not to be trifled with.
But in the blink of an eye, the human young man and the bear race who were riding the cloud just now blocked the escape path.
“Stop.” This time, it was Shi Yu and the others who said stop.
“You want to run after attacking?” Shi Yu stood up and said, “What kind of logic is this?”
“It’s a misunderstanding.” The Golden-Winged Roc’s expression tightened as it looked at the black and white bear in disbelief. It didn’t expect this to be a totem.
He had kicked an iron plate.
What was the identity of the person and bear in front of him!
“Sir, my father is a Golden-Winged Roc God. I was wrong this time. Why don’t we pretend that nothing happened and give my father face?” It looked at Eleven and said.
“What level is your father at?” Shi Yu asked.
“My father is a demigod, the king of the Garuda Empire!” the Golden-Winged Roc said.
Energy Points: 90.1 million
The Golden-Winged Roc in front of Shi Yu was still an invincible overlord. It was not bad.
In the modern era, it was at least the heir level of a demigod faction.
If not for that, Shi Yu would have killed it directly.
Even if he didn’t eat it, it wasn’t bad to burn it into ashes as fertilizer.
But if it was the son of a demigod… It wasn’t a loss.
“A demigod is nothing. What face does it have?” Shi Yu said. “Robbing you, take out a Mythical resource. Otherwise, die.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1192 - 1192 Promoting, Getting Rich, Marrying the Empress (2)
chapters.content:
1192 Promoting, Getting Rich, Marrying the Empress (2)
The Golden-Winged Roc:???
The golden-winged bird was immediately furious. It looked at Eleven and said, “Do you really want to be my enemy?”
Eleven: “?”
What did it have to do with him? Look at him and say it. It wasn’t something he could decide.
“I’m the Crown Prince of the Garuda Empire!! My father is a demigod, you have to think carefully!”
Shi Yu said, “You don’t have it. Let’s call your father to redeem you with resources. You have the clone Skill, right? Leave your main body behind as bird hostage and call your clone back to call someone.”
“Wuu.” Eleven pointed at the other party again, and lightning flashed in its hand.
“You!” The Golden-Winged Roc had a shocked expression. It was unbelievable. Who exactly was this guy in front of it? He actually dared to threaten a demigod.
Did he want to die?
What it didn’t know was that Shi Yu, who had transmigrated here, had no restrictions at all. There was no need to care about anything. If he were on Blue Planet, Shi Yu might still care about the impact, afraid that he would cause trouble for Dong Huang.
However, in ancient space and time, didn’t that mean that he could do whatever he wanted? This big bird bumped into it itself and didn’t look delicious. If he didn’t extort it, he would really be letting Eleven down.
“Zi!”
“Ah!!!” Another electric arc directly made the Golden-Winged Roc cry out.
“Sure, sure, we’ll do as you say!”
Madman, the Golden-Winged Roc realized. The bear in front of it was completely a lunatic. It was better not to reason with it.
“It would have been better if it were like this earlier.” Shi Yu chuckled.
A divine-level resource, Get!
Wasn’t this faster than Senior Gu Yun spending six years exploring Mythical Ruins?
As for whether the Golden-Winged Roc God didn’t want to give it to him? That was even easier. When Chi Tong broke through, at least three demigods would visit it. Whether it wanted to give it to him or not was up to him.
His son attacked first. It was too much to refuse to compensate when he was in the wrong.
“Don’t tell me you don’t have any resources on you now?” Shi Yu looked at the charred Golden-Winged Roc.
“I…”
“Zi zi zi…” Electric rings spread from Eleven’s fingertips, making the Golden-Winged Roc look like it was crying.” Yes, yes. I happen to have a metal-element Legendary resource on me. I’m willing to give it to you. ”
“Lord, please spare me.”
“Don’t electrocute me.”
With that said, the Golden-Winged Roc panicked and took out a Legendary resource from its portable ruins. It was a golden flower. It was especially beautiful, blooming like a peacock feather.
“Wuuu!!!” Seeing this, Eleven was overjoyed. It directly sucked it over with the electromagnetic force and held it in its hand before looking at Shi Yu.
“Eat,” Shi Yu said.
“Wuu!” Eleven stuffed it into its mouth happily and wolfed it down with its eyes wide open.
Before it could react, it saw that the feather of the ruins it carried was directly taken away by Psychic power, shocking the Golden-Winged Roc again.
“My ruins!…”
“Eh, there’s really only one Legendary resource. You, the son of a demigod, are so poor,” Shi Yu, who was holding the Feather of the Ruins, couldn’t help but say in disdain.
Apart from a Legendary resource, there was only a pile of resources below level eight inside.
Upon hearing that, the Golden-Winged Roc cursed.
However, at this moment, it was a little puzzled. The way this human and totem interacted… Who was the master?
In the beginning, it felt that the totem was the master and the human were servants, but from the looks of it, that wasn’t the case. What was going on!
“Forget it, I’ll return it to you.” Shi Yu directly threw the Feather of the Ruins back. The Golden-Winged Roc looked surprised.
“Lord…”
“Hurry up and recover your physical fitness through the resources inside. Then, condense a clone and go back to get the resources,” Shi Yu said. “In your current state, I’m afraid you don’t have the strength to move.”
The Golden-Winged Roc:???
The Golden-Winged Roc cursed again.
Right on the heels of that, under Shi Yu’s supervision, it treated its injuries and Restoration with tears in its eyes. It condensed a clone and went home to report. As for its main body, it was directly locked by Shi Yu’s side.
“Alright.” Shi Yu was satisfied. “Next, as long as we cooperate happily, I won’t hurt your life. I only want money and not killing.”
He cursed.
“Lord, hehe, Lord.” The Golden-Winged Roc cursed in its heart, but in order to not be electrocuted, it smiled respectfully.
Although it felt that its father wouldn’t use divine-level resources to redeem it. After all, it wasn’t favored either, it was certain that its father would definitely come to take the dog life of the person in front of it after being slapped in the face.
Damn it, it could tolerate it.
“I won’t control you anymore, but don’t even think about running. I know where your home is. You don’t want the Garuda Empire to be made a mess, right?” Shi Yu said.
The golden-winged bird: ???
Why couldn’t it understand this person’s words? He was really arrogant!
“Then, Lord, where are we going next?” The Golden-Winged Roc looked like it was about to cry. Why was it captured by such a lunatic?
Even if it were other demigods, as long as they knew that it was the crown prince of the Garuda Empire, they would not argue with a child on account of its demigod father.
“It should be called the Phoenix Empire now.” Shi Yu was not sure either. “In any case, it’s the continent in front. You just have to keep up.”
Qi said that it was a little early. Then, it was still another matter if the empress was at the legendary level. Shi Yu felt that the empress dynasty had yet to be established, but he wasn’t very sure.
“Phoenix Empire?! You’re going to the Phoenix Empire too? Could it be…” The Golden-Winged Roc was stunned.
Shi Yu looked at it and said, “You too?”
“Why are you going?”
The Golden-Winged Roc looked like it was about to cry. “Proposal.”
Shi Yu: “Proposal?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1193 - 1193 Promoting, Getting Rich, Marrying the Empress (3)
chapters.content:
1193 Promoting, Getting Rich, Marrying the Empress (3)
The Golden-Winged Roc said, “Don’t you know? The Phoenix Empire has a specific ‘Phoenix Prayer Festival’ every year. The demigods of the Phoenix Empire like humans very much and often recruit human geniuses as live-in sons-in-law. It’s on this festival!”
“You have to know that the Phoenix Race has always pursued pure blood. This situation is simply too rare.”
“It’s rare for there to be such an open Phoenix Race faction. My father called me to propose and see if I can marry the Phoenix Race.” The Golden-Winged Roc continued to cry. “However, I don’t think the chances are especially high. After all, I’ve only heard that the Phoenix Race’s demigod likes humans, but I’ve never heard of them liking mixed blood with other races.”
“Besides, the gift I brought to propose was also eaten just now…”
Eleven : “…”
What a sin, what a sin. Wu wu wu.
Shi Yu said, “Who do you want to propose to?”
“Princess Huang Xi of the Phoenix Empire! I heard that she became a level-eight Beast Tamer at a young age. Not only does she have a demigod bloodline, but she’s also the most doted on daughter of the Phoenix Empire’s demigods. She also has Legendary aptitude. If I can obtain her favor and sign an engagement with her…” The Golden-Winged Roc suddenly smiled foolishly.
Its father would definitely take it seriously!!!
Although the other party had a human bloodline, it also had a Phoenix bloodline. It was also a bird, alright.
Rip.
An electric arc flew past.
“Ah!!!” The Golden-Winged Roc let out a miserable cry.
“Why did you electrocute me again?”
Shi Yu said, “I’m unhappy to see you daydreaming.”
“Why don’t you look in the mirror… Princess Huang Xi has already contracted a totem above her level at level eight. Even if it’s her overlord-level pet, defeating you is as easy as breathing.”
“You’re not even worthy of the Phoenix she contracted, and you still want to propose to her. Tell me, why did I electrocute you?”
The Golden-Winged Roc:???
As it cursed in its heart, it was speechless. “Lord, don’t tell me you’re going to the Phoenix Empire to participate in the Phoenix Court Festival too. Could it be that the target is also Princess Huang Xi…”
Rip.
Before the electric arc could fly out, the Golden-Winged Roc was so scared that its soul flew out.
“Sorry, I really didn’t know that Princess Huang Xi was so strong. I wanted to be out of one’s league and punch above one’s weight. It’s all my father’s fault…”
“Cut the crap. Lead the way,” Shi Yu said. “To the Phoenix Empire.”
At this moment, Shi Yu roughly knew the time. As expected, the empress had yet to become a Legendary Beast Tamer. Was she only level eight?
Moreover, the Phoenix Prayer Festival… Shi Yu had also learned a little about it in the incomplete memories of the Undying Dark Phoenix.
The Phoenix Empire established by the Undying Dark Phoenix had always been researching hybrids, so it naturally needed many talented human geniuses.
This Phoenix Seeking Festival was actually a different kind of martial arts competition.
The Phoenix Empire had always used this method to attract human geniuses to join the Phoenix Empire and combine with those hybrid Beast Tamers with the Phoenix bloodline a second time before giving birth to a second-generation hybrid.
Needless to say, many human geniuses were really attracted. In the incomplete memories of the Undying Dark Phoenix, before the empress became a Legendary, there had always been a terrifying number of suitors.
The Phoenix had always been an auspicious totem believed in by humans, so those human factions didn’t reject the Phoenix Empire very much. In this chaotic world, if they could join the Phoenix Empire, it was undoubtedly a good choice.
It could be said that the current human race occupied 99.9999% of the Phoenix Empire. It was completely the prototype of the future empress dynasty.
Among the many princesses of the Phoenix Empire, the strongest and most talented Princess Huang Xi was clearly the goal of all the geniuses. Not only were the human geniuses tempted, but even a second-generation foreign race like the Golden-Winged Roc was tempted. It could be said that whoever could obtain the favor of the young empress was completely relying on a super big white leg.
Unfortunately, the level-eight empress was already invincible. She was one of the top experts in the Phoenix Empire. Her strength was probably only inferior to the state before the Undying Dark Phoenix died. No one could defeat her in the Phoenix Seeking Phoenix Festival at all. Her strength was far inferior, let alone obtain the other party’s favor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1194 - 1194 Proposing to the Empress
chapters.content:
1194 Proposing to the Empress
The capital of the Phoenix Empire, Phoenix City, was actually the Ancient Capital, but each dynasty had its own name.
After confirming that their destination was the Phoenix Empire, Shi Yu and Eleven pulled the bird-type Golden-Winged Roc over.
At this moment, after arriving at Phoenix City, the Golden-Winged Roc no longer had the intention to propose. After all, it was electrocuted the moment it had the thought.
It only wanted to wait obediently for its father to save it.
Under Shi Yu’s suppression, the demigod son restrained his aura and turned into a two-meter-tall birdman, looking ordinary.
As the Phoenix Empire was still a totem country in essence and not a human country, many mixed-blood foreign races would gather. After restraining itself, its characteristics were not especially conspicuous.
It could be said that hybrid humans had become the target of acceptance by humans from before and after the empress dynasty. They were completely different from Emperor Shi and Emperor Wu Dynasty at that time, who were rejected and treated as an anomaly.
At least… people wouldn’t make a fuss and panic after seeing it.
“Damn it, Phoenix City was supposed to be a stage for me to show off my skills.”
“Why did I take it so hard and bump into such a lunatic?” The demigod’s son, the Golden-Winged Roc, was very resentful. It looked at Shi Yu in front of it and the black and white bears that followed beside his legs who looked around curiously.
Son of a b*tch, why was a totem level acting cute?
The Ancient Capital was in every dynasty with different styles. Before and after the empress dynasty, the Phoenix Race emblem was very obvious. Ancient Phoenix trees were planted on both sides of the street, extremely gorgeous. There were hundreds of birds living on it, chattering and echoing with the busy city.
On the wide street that was as wide as a square, there was traffic, horses, and voices. As far as the eye could see, it was pitch-black. If he didn’t say it, Shi Yu would definitely think that this was a human ancient country.
The most important thing that proved that this was the totem country was that phoenixes of various colors flew past from time to time in the sky. The human Beast Tamers here seemed to be very used to this situation.
“As expected of the Phoenix Race.” The humanoid Golden-Winged Roc couldn’t help but look at the two overlord-level Phoenixes that had just flown past… It felt that their power fluctuations were far stronger than the overlords of its country.
The Golden-Winged Roc was very respectful to the Phoenix Race, which was at the same level as the Dragon Race. When it was young, because it used drakes as food, it was used to eating dragons and thought that the Dragon Race was only so-so. In the end, when it went out one day, it encountered a pure-blooded divine dragon of the same level in Dragon Palace City. The two parties fought. If it weren’t for the fact that it ran fast, it would probably have died.
“This guy is even more terrifying than a dragon.” The Golden-Winged Roc thought of Shi Yu, this unlucky thing, and was on the brink of tears.
“Lord, we’ve arrived at Phoenix City. What’s next?” the Golden-Winged Roc asked.
Shi Yu said, “I’m going to find Princess Huang Xi. You play by yourself, but don’t even think about running.”
“Wuu.” Shi Yu found Eleven. Eleven immediately came over and patted the Golden-Winged Roc, making it shiver.
“We branded a lightning mark on you. After leaving the range of Phoenix City, the mark will trigger the heavenly lightning to kill you.”
The Golden-Winged Roc: Ah…
[This guy is even more useless than the little white dragon…] Shi Yu thought.
With that said, Shi Yu directly headed to the empress’s residence. Little Eleven followed beside him. One of Shi Yu’s goals this time was to meet the empress and discuss with her about the Phoenix Empire that swallowed the Undying Dark Phoenix.
Then, he began to trade across space and time. As this was Dong Huang’s predecessor, Shi Yu couldn’t start directly for the sake of Eastern stability.
He and the empress joined forces to incorporate the Phoenix Empire and even the Phoenix Race. It was the best choice. This way, not only could Shi Yu earn very comfortably, but the empress dynasty could also be successfully established at the smallest cost. The Phoenix Race wouldn’t be exterminated. Then, with the empress in power and in charge of Dong Huang, Dong Huang could also develop relatively steadily and have a deeper foundation than the official history!
“Lord, wait for me…” After Shi Yu left, the Golden-Winged Roc was on the brink of tears. Don’t leave, it was afraid.
It was afraid that once Shi Yu and the others left and were a distance away, the lightning mark on its body would misfire. It didn’t dare to take the gamble.
…
Not long ago, Princess Huang Xi of the Phoenix Empire destroyed a totem country alone, making her famous and becoming the most famous genius in the east.
It made her already famous overseas name resound again.
Apart from overconfident guys like the Golden-Winged Roc, basically no one was here for her on this Phoenix Prayer Festival. After all, most people knew their limits.
Now, Princess Huang Xi, who was already a rare titled expert in the Phoenix Empire, had already moved outside the Phoenix Palace mystic realm to live alone. The name of the mystic realm residence was: Star Scenery Palace.
It was the intention of the Phoenix.
From the outside, it looked like an incomparably glorious palace group, but inside, it was a completely different world. It belonged to the Legendary mystic realm and was a residence bestowed by the demigod of the Phoenix Empire.
When Shi Yu arrived outside the glorious palace, there were many young talents outside. Many human geniuses had gathered and were chatting happily.
On the main door, a spatial ripple flashed.
A young man in a red robe and a Star Flame Sparrow walked out covered in injuries.
“Brother Zhuo, how’s the battle result?”
After he came out, someone shouted.
The young man who was enfeebled put away the Star Flame Sparrow and said, “I’m not a match for the Star Servant either.”
“Zhuo Qing of South Sea City also lost.”
“What a joke. I didn’t expect that a bunch of geniuses couldn’t even defeat Princess Huang Xi’s maid. So I’m not the only trash.”
“Brother, what’s going on here? Don’t tell me you’re proposing?” After Shi Yu, Eleven, and the peacock roc arrived, the roc grabbed a young man and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1195 - 1195 Proposing to the Empress (2)
chapters.content:
1195 Proposing to the Empress (2)
Its bird hair instantly shocked the other party.
“What… What marriage?”
“How can ordinary people like us be worthy of Princess Huang Xi?”
“It’s just that Princess Huang Xi has recruited capable people in the world and set a test in her residence. Anyone who passes the test can work under Princess Huang Xi.”
When the peacock roc heard that, it curled its lips. Boring.
Shi Yu looked at the mystic realm and fell into deep thought. Legendary mystic realm… It looked like he could only enter through the main door.
“Is Princess Huang Xi inside?” Shi Yu asked.
“I don’t know, but one of Princess Huang Xi’s contracted Phoenix is here, and her 12 Star Servants are also here. Princess Huang Xi is most likely also in the palace, but we definitely have to pass the test to see her.” The passers-by looked at the strange combination of Shi Yu, the Peacock Roc, and the black and white bear and felt strange.
These guys were so strange.
“Let’s go.” After understanding, Shi Yu followed Eleven towards the mystic realm residence.
According to the Undying Dark Phoenix’s guess, the empress should have long known its ambition, so she had always been wary of it.
Long ago, after having some strength, the empress was already preparing for “rebellion”. When young talents like the Phoenix Prayer Festival gathered in Phoenix City, it was probably the empress who prepared in advance to recruit all the capable people in the world to do things for her.
At this moment, the young man in a red robe was beaten out. Shi Yu walked over right on the heels of that, attracting the gazes of many people.
“Who is this person?”
“No, I’ve never heard of it.”
“That pet of his… Why haven’t I seen it before? What kind of bear is that? It looks so harmless, haha.”
Eleven listened to everyone’s discussion and snorted.
The Emperor Wu Dynasty in this space and time was destroyed normally. The Iron-eating Beast Race was exterminated by the Yun Race and hid their identities. After five hundred years, it was normal for not many young people to know pandas.
“Damn it…” At this moment, as Shi Yu directly entered the Scenic Star Manor, the Golden-Winged Roc was stunned. It didn’t know if it should follow. It fell into deep thought on the spot.
…
At the same time, in the Star Palace.
In a Phoenix Wood Teahouse, five young talents were drinking tea and chatting.
On the huge Phoenix Ancient Tree opposite, a Quas Phoenix Feather was sitting here. Below it were twelve mixed-blood female servants with outstanding looks.
The five people in the teahouse were all genius Beast Tamers who had passed a test and were left behind to entertain them.
Among them, a legendary genius and four top-notch Masters with top-notch Beast Taming Talents could be left behind. This meant that their strength and potential were much stronger than those in the outside world.
“I wonder if there will be a sixth person today,” the legendary genius of the hidden Beast Tamer Family, Zhang Yan, said after taking a sip of tea.
“Princess Huang Xi… Sigh, looks like there’s no hope of seeing her today,” he said regretfully.
In the beginning, he originally thought that his legendary strength could be valued by Princess Huang Xi, but who knew that he didn’t even see her now?
Of course, he also knew that he was too weak and was directly insta-killed in the second test… He was not qualified to see the princess in person.
“There’s not much hope. With the overlord of the Quas Phoenix here, it should be handed full responsibility. However, if we can work seriously under Princess Huang Xi, we’ll be able to see her sooner or later, right? No one can surpass you, Young Master Zhang,” another young man said with a smile.
A group of people knew that it was impossible to pursue Princess Huang Xi, a female supreme, and silently chose to be bootlickers, hoping that there would be a day when they would be lucky.
As everyone chatted, spatial ripples flashed. Someone entered the huge martial arts arena entrance again.
It was a black-haired young man in a black and gray ancient battle suit. Beside him was a black and white bear with full Spirit.
After robbing a Legendary resource and eating it to maintain this restrained and shrunken state, Eleven could maintain its Spirit for a long time.
After Shi Yu entered, one of the twelve female guards guarding the martial arts arena, a mixed-blood Beast Tamer with red hair, walked forward. She looked at Shi Yu with her ruby-like eyes and said, “Princess Huang Xi has recruited all the capable people in the world. Those who want to join, their names, ages, levels, and identities need to be reported.”
“At that time, defeating one of the twelve Star Servants will be considered to have passed the first test. You can stay.”
“After obtaining the recognition of the Quas Phoenix overlord, you will have passed the second test and can see Princess Huang Xi.”
“I wonder where you’re from.”
Many young talents who had passed the test looked at Shi Yu. The Ice Phoenix overlord on the Phoenix Tree also glanced over.
Shi Yu first looked around.
Energy Points: 121,220,000
Good lord, the energy value of the empress’s overlord-level Quas Phoenix was definitely at the top of the overlord-level pets Shi Yu had seen.
It was not inferior to or even exceeded the trump card pet of the presidents of the seven modern countries’ associations.
However, this was definitely not the empress’s trump card. After all, when the empress was also at level eight, she contracted a totem above her level because of her mixed blood.
[Trash roc, you’re indeed trying to be out of one’s league, to want to punch above one’s weight.]
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I wonder if I can pass the first test and directly carry out the second test. I want to see Princess Huang Xi as soon as possible.”
Boom!
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the empress’s 12 Star Servants were stunned and looked at Shi Yu in unison.
The young talents in the teahouse also went “Huh?” For a moment, they looked at this guy of unknown origin in shock.
It was fine if it didn’t follow the rules, but it even wanted to see Princess Huang Xi as soon as possible??
“You’re a legend?” The red-haired Star Servant looked at Shi Yu. The 12 Star Servants were all level-six Beast Tamers. If this young man wanted to pass the first test, didn’t that mean that he was at the legend level?

chapters.title: Chapter 1196 - 1196 Proposing to the Empress (3)
chapters.content:
1196 Proposing to the Empress (3)
“I’m Shi Yu, a level-eight Beast Tamer,” Shi Yu said.
At the same time, the surrounding spatial ripples flickered. A huge red summoning array appeared under Shi Yu’s feet. The strong spatial fluctuations directly stunned the 12 Star Servants present and the five young geniuses in the tea house.
“Titled level.” Even the Ice Phoenix on the Phoenix Tree was slightly stunned. It looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
Wait a minute, this guy who looked even younger than Huang Xi was actually a titled Beast Tamer??
How was this possible? What was the other party’s background? Why had they never heard of such a guy?
“Who is this person?”
The five young talents in the teahouse stood up in unison and were very shocked. They looked at Shi Yu, who was in his early twenties, with blank expressions. Where did this monster come from?
“Who are you? Your goal shouldn’t be as simple as joining the Star Palace, right?” On the Phoenix Tree, the Quas Phoenix got up slightly and raised its head. It stared at Shi Yu and asked about Shi Yu’s origin and goal.
The empress’s 12-star maids looked at Shi Yu and instantly understood that this person probably didn’t come to join Princess Huang Xi.
At this age and level, it was definitely rare in the entire world. From Princess Huang Xi’s situation, one could tell how rare a level-eight Beast Tamer in her twenties was.
How could such a person rely on a genius of the same level?
Then, there was only one possibility.
The young man in front of him definitely came with the intention of proposing to Princess Huang Xi because of the Phoenix Praying Festival. Compared to the surrounding geniuses, his talent was completely qualified.
The surrounding young talents also instantly thought of this possibility with indignant expressions. Damn, how could there really be a monster with the same talent as Princess Huang Xi?
“Indeed not. I want to talk to Princess Huang Xi about other things. I think… I don’t have to fight anymore, right?” Shi Yu didn’t fight if he could now, not doing meaningless battles because it was purely a waste of energy.
Of course, if the opponent was the empress’s pet, Shi Yu actually didn’t mind… If he didn’t fight the current Legendary after transmigrating once, it would be a pity. It was just that this one… was a little weak. It was better to change to a totem level.
The Quas Phoenix was silent.
The Quas Phoenix immediately communicated with the Beast Tamers who weren’t here through their bloodline connection.
At the same time, in another mystic realm of Dong Huang, a woman in a long dress fluttered, her black hair fluttered, and her figure was peerless. Her aura was transcendent as she spoke slightly. Her voice carried an ethereal immortal charm and an imposing aura.
“What happened?”
Quas Phoenix: “Huang Xi, bad news. A level-eight Beast Tamer younger than you came to propose to you. He doesn’t come with good intentions.”
Princess Huang Xi’s eyes flickered. A level-eight Beast Tamer even younger than her?
It was also because of the Phoenix bloodline that she improved at lightning speed by contracting the level of the Phoenix pet. It was difficult to imagine that there was actually someone who could surpass her in this aspect.
As expected, capable people appeared in large numbers in the world.
“I understand. Help me test his ability first. I’ll personally meet him when I return,” Feng Xi said.
“I’ll watch you.”
If she could subdue a young level-eight Beast Tamer, he would definitely be a general for her to expand her territory in the future.
Jing Xing Palace.
After a moment of silence, the Quas Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and said, “Unfortunately, Princess Huang Xi isn’t here. Even if you’re a level-eight Beast Tamer, you still have to obtain my recognition if you want to see her. According to the rules, you have to defeat me in a one-on-one battle!”
Shi Yu shrugged and said, “Then let’s do it.”
“But even if you’re Princess Huang Xi’s pet, I won’t show mercy.”
The Quas Phoenix flew up and chuckled.
“Arrogant.”
Even if Shi Yu was a level-eight Beast Tamer and his pet was at the overlord level, so what? It was a pure-blooded Phoenix!
It could be said to be the creature closest to a Mythical Race.
…
The situation in front of them completely exceeded the expectations of the 12 Star Servants and the five young talents who stayed here.
This mysterious level-eight Beast Tamer was going to fight the Quas Phoenix!
“Young Master Zhang, what do you think the outcome will be…” In the tea house, a young man asked.
Legend Zhang was silent.
“Princess Huang Xi’s contracted Phoenix is ridiculously strong. Its battle power is close to a totem.”
“My overlord pet was also instantly frozen and insta-killed under the enhancement of my Beast Taming Talent.”
“Although this mysterious person is at level eight, his pet should also be at the overlord level. However, his level is higher than mine. Perhaps… he has a chance of fighting the Quas Phoenix overlord.”
“It’s hard to say who will win. After all, I don’t know what his Beast Taming Talent is, but in terms of pet battles alone, his pet is definitely not a match for the Quas Phoenix overlord.”
“Indeed, but at this level, his Beast Taming Talent definitely won’t be weak.” Everyone was silent.
…
The Quas Phoenix circled in midair opposite the martial arts arena.
The 12 Star Servants took a deep breath and retreated together.
“Roar.”
Eleven was extremely energetic and planned to appear, but it was stopped by Shi Yu.
Because the team’s voice room was noisy.
Baby Ginseng: “Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi Yi!!!”
It, Baby Ginseng, had not fought for a long time. It had been assisting for a long time. Wu wu wu, leave the battle opportunity with the empress’s pet to it.
He, a demigod, still wanted to snatch an overlord-level opponent?
Eleven : “…”
Eleven, as the Leader, retreated very politely.
At the same time, Shi Yu’s red summoning array appeared again. On the martial arts arena, under the silent expressions of the four geniuses, a… big white radish less than half a meter tall?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1197 - 1197 Proposing to the Empress (4)
chapters.content:
1197 Proposing to the Empress (4)
“This is… Baby Ginseng?!!”
Although there were some subtle differences, everyone was stunned and stunned the moment they saw this pet.
“Yiya!” Baby Ginseng stood on the ground and looked at the Quas Phoenix with a burning gaze, ignoring the gazes of mortals.
However, the Quas Phoenix was also a little stunned.
It didn’t know the black and white bear beside Shi Yu. That was fine, but what was wrong with this supplement pet?
Of course, most importantly, Shi Yu’s pet aura and energy were all very restrained. Even the Quas Phoenix couldn’t tell the strength of the ginseng baby at all.
“Are you serious?” The Quas Phoenix raised its eyebrows. Of course, it didn’t dare to be sloppy.
“Attack as much as you want,” Shi Yu said.
Upon hearing that, the Quas Phoenix’s eyes flashed. In that case…
“Jiu!!”
It let out a phoenix cry. The sky and ground instantly turned extremely cold, and the white clouds instantly turned into ice clouds.
In the tea house, the Beast Tamers suddenly trembled and saw a layer of frost forming on the hot tea.
Crack! Crack! Crack!!!
Similarly, the huge martial arts arena instantly froze. In an instant, the entire Scenic Star Mystic Realm turned countless degrees colder.
Ice… Age!!
In the sky, the Quas Phoenix condensed a super ultimate move to attack Baby Ginseng. It was almost not surprising. In an instant, the lively Baby Ginseng was directly frozen in the snow.
Cold wind howled, and the martial arts arena became a land of ice and snow. A white ice sculpture stood on it. It was Baby Ginseng.
“Is that all…” The Quas Phoenix was stunned in disbelief. Everyone also swallowed their saliva and sighed with emotion at the power of the Quas Phoenix.
However, the resonance of the bloodline stunned the Quas Phoenix.
“Don’t be careless.” Princess Huang Xi’s voice sounded, stunning the Quas Phoenix. In the next moment, it saw Shi Yu standing in the snow with a smile.
“Baby Ginseng, Thousand-Handed Guanyin.”
Shi Yu crossed his arms, making the Quas Phoenix feathers opposite him stand up. He suddenly had a bad feeling.
In the next moment, with a boom, the ice and snow that filled the sky shattered. The wood-element ginseng baby walked out of the freeze unscathed and crossed its arms like Shi Yu.
The ground behind it directly cracked, and a huge wooden Buddha statue with a thousand huge arms grew out.
The huge wooden Buddha statue instantly exceeded the Frozen Cloud at a height of ten thousand meters.
But the cold temperature couldn’t leave any traces on it.
It was dark!
Ten-thousand-meter-long Guanyin!
Thousand hands covered the sky.
“What’s this!!!” In an instant, the Star Servant and the five Beast Tamers were extremely shocked. What move was this?
Sensing the deterrence wrapped around the Thousand-Handed Guanyin, the Quas Phoenix was stunned.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, countless huge hands covered the Quas Phoenix. Space almost shattered, making the pupils of the Quas Phoenix shrink.
“Jiu!!!” It blew out a snowstorm. The huge hand that covered the sky in front of it was instantly frozen into frost, but under the swing of the huge hand, the frost instantly shattered.
“Impossible!!!” As the Quas Phoenix was shocked, countless huge hands directly covered it and slapped it to the snow.
Bang!!!
The ground and space trembled. The move condensed by the plant control behind Baby Ginseng disappeared, leaving only the messy and broken arena and the Quas Phoenix on the ground.
Baby Ginseng looked up at the sky. As expected of it. The main force of the empress was easily controlled.
Everyone present was completely stunned.
At the same time.
“Who exactly are you?”
In the distance, the young empress, who was rushing towards her residence, trembled slightly, and her eyes shot out an incredulous light. Who exactly was this guy? What was his goal? How could that attack just now be made by an overlord? Was he really here to propose?

chapters.title: Chapter 1198 - 1198 Large Family Recognition Scene
chapters.content:
1198 Large Family Recognition Scene
Jing Xing Palace was in an uproar.
No one expected that Princess Huang Xi’s invincible Quas Phoenix would instantly be suppressed by the harmless supplement ginseng baby in front of them.
The huge Buddha statue that towered into the clouds was incomparably shocking. It was simply even more terrifying than the full-strength attack of a totem. It was simply unbelievable. That was only a ginseng baby less than half a meter tall instantly condensed. It really shattered their values.
“Lord Quas Phoenix.” The future empress, the Twelve Star Servant, looked at the Ice Phoenix lying on the ground in disbelief.
In this attack, the Quas Phoenix almost fainted. Its consciousness was blurred, and it could be considered a one-hit kill. It was no wonder that Princess Huang Xi, who was in the distance, was so shocked. Even if it was an ordinary totem level, it was definitely impossible to defeat her Quas Phoenix so easily.
“What kind of monster is this person?” The overlord-level Quas Phoenix was considered a core power in the Phoenix Race, let alone Princess Huang Xi’s contracted Phoenix. Seeing that the Quas Phoenix overlord was defeated without even being able to resist, the five Beast Tamer geniuses who came to apply for the job were shocked.
The overlord of the Quas Phoenix was so miserable!
Was this really a ginseng baby?
Initially, everyone was still surprised, but soon, the last doubt was gone.
“Baby Ginseng.” Under Shi Yu’s command, Baby Ginseng lowered one of its two white arms that were wrapped around its chest and aimed the other at the Quas Phoenix. In the next moment, the Green Wood Divine Body revealed rich life fluctuations.
In an instant, just the fluctuations alone made hundreds of flowers bloom in the Stars View Palace. White and green fluctuations also wrapped around the Ice Phoenix. In an instant, the Ice Phoenix that was smashed flat recovered its injuries visibly.
Boom!
In less than a second, the aura of the Quas Phoenix rose steadily. From the life fluctuations, it was actually even more vigorous than when it first attacked. With a cry, the Ice Phoenix, which had walked out of the gates of hell, quickly flew up in shock. It was covered in sweat and extremely nervous as it faced Shi Yu and the others.
“I clearly almost died just now, so why did I instantly recover to the peak, even better than my state before I attacked?”
The Quas Phoenix in the air found it difficult to understand, so it looked at the human youth and Baby Ginseng in shock. It felt that everything was controlled. This feeling was simply even more helpless than facing top-notch totem battle power.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng lowered its arm in an unfathomable manner. Sigh, its main Class was a healer. For it, Restoration for a heavily injured overlord was easier than defeating a peak overlord.
“Wuuu, wuu, wuu, wuu.” Eleven clapped for Baby Ginseng and created two lightning fluorescent metal bars to cheer for Baby Ginseng.
The towering emperor was powerful. It worshiped it so much. It actually defeated the empress’s main force so easily.
Baby Ginseng’s expression darkened… Why was it being so polite for no reason?
It understood that Eleven would definitely eat extra with it tonight.
As the team’s chef, as the food demand in the team increased, Baby Ginseng’s throne was self-evident. Among the three brothers, Eleven and Buggy had to give Baby Ginseng some face. Otherwise, they would only eat a fixed portion of food. Although they wouldn’t starve to death, they were unhappy.
And if it wanted to eat more food, Baby Ginseng had to work overtime. This depended on Baby Ginseng’s mood.
“Now, I’m finally qualified to see… Princess Huang Xi, right?” Shi Yu almost said the word empress when he didn’t notice.
“I, I understand. Wait a moment. Princess Huang Xi will be back soon.” The Quas Phoenix’s expression was extremely serious. It felt that what happened today was very magical. It was like a totem-like ginseng baby, a black and white bear with strange behavior, and this ridiculously young level-eight Beast Tamer. It was very confused.
In particular, the other party didn’t even use its Beast Taming Talent in the battle with it. This made the Quas Phoenix afraid of Shi Yu. This was also normal. After all, the attacks of Shi Yu’s pet were all wrapped in max-level deterrence. Being defeated once was inevitable. If it attacked with all its might, it could even make its descendants traumatized over its image.
It sighed in its heart. This time, it really didn’t come with good intentions, but it also knew that Huang Xi wasn’t interested in romance. How would Huang Xi face this mysterious young man this time?
“Alright, I’ll wait then. Eleven, let’s go to the teahouse to wait. Baby Ginseng, help him repair the venue,” Shi Yu said.
Eleven: “Wuu.”
Baby Ginseng: “Yi…”
Shi Yu signaled to the Quas Phoenix and the 12 Star Servants slightly before walking towards the teahouse where five young people were sitting… The teahouse opposite was calm and composed the whole time, looking extremely relaxed.
“Aba, Aba, Aba…” The five young men opposite couldn’t sit still. They didn’t know what was going on.
The Quas Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and the others in silence before sweeping its gaze at the five geniuses who had passed the first test. “This is the end of today. Please leave first. Someone will contact you in three days. In addition, please keep what happened just now a secret.”
The Quas Phoenix directly hit them and warned them not to publicize its loss.
The five young men were at a loss. They really wanted to stay here and see Princess Huang Xi. Seeing that the Quas Phoenix was chasing them away, the few of them had no choice but to carry it out. They stiffly cupped their fists and were still chased out of the mansion mystic realm.
…
“Today’s assessment will end here. Those who are interested, please come another day.”
In the outside world, a Star Servant sent five people out and made a declaration. It immediately made the Beast Tamers in the outside world sigh. Then, they looked at the five geniuses who could stay behind in envy.
However, what puzzled them was why the expressions of these five geniuses who had passed the test were very strange?

chapters.title: Chapter 1199 - 1199 Large Recognition Scene (2)
chapters.content:
1199 Large Recognition Scene (2)
“Wait a minute, why isn’t the last young man in? Has he passed the test? Legend Zhang and the others have already come out, why don’t I see him?” Someone discovered something strange.
“Mo Wen.” A young man who came out of the residence stopped an acquaintance who came to ask. He was silent.
In the crowd, the Golden-Winged Roc pursed its beak, not knowing where to go.
Shi Yu must have stayed behind to get intimate with the princess. Damn it, what about it? Now, the Golden-Winged Roc’s lungs were about to explode from anger. It felt that its father was too slow. It no longer wanted to wait in the Phoenix Empire for a moment.
As the crowd dispersed, the demigod son sat on a rock by the roadside sadly and looked at the sky.
At the same time.
In the Star Palace, Shi Yu drank the hot tea served by the beautiful Star Servant and waited calmly. The Quas Phoenix turned into a small Phoenix two to three meters tall. After scattering the Star Servants, it landed beside the tea house and looked at Shi Yu, Panda, and Baby Ginseng, who were holding tea, with a burning gaze.
“How long until your Beast Tamer arrives?” Shi Yu asked as he drank his tea.
The Quas Phoenix said, “In half an incense’s time. Before that, can you tell me your background? I don’t believe that a level-eight Beast Tamer in his twenties is unknown, but I’ve indeed never heard of the name Shi Yu.”
“If you want to propose to our Princess Huang Xi, it’s time…”
Eleven and Baby Ginseng: “Pfft.”
The two of them almost spat out hot tea and looked at Shi Yu in confusion. A marriage proposal?
They had serious expressions and felt that the seniority was a little messy. Chi Tong was hatched by Shi Yu. Shi Yu was equivalent to a father, Chi Tong was equivalent to a daughter, and in terms of bloodline, the empress was Chi Tong’s sister. This seniority…
“What marriage proposal?” Shi Yu’s face darkened.
Quas Phoenix: “Huh? You’re not here to propose to Huang Xi?”
Why didn’t it believe it? It specially chose the Phoenix Seeking Phoenix Festival to come over. Its age and strength were similar. They didn’t have any interaction previously. Didn’t it hear of Huang Xi’s beautiful name and come to ask for marriage? Could it be that it really came to rely on her?
Not to mention making friends, even a bird wouldn’t believe such nonsense. Which man didn’t have some thoughts when he saw a beautiful woman and only wanted to make friends?
Shi Yu put down the hot tea and said, “I just have a business to talk to Princess Huang Xi about. When it comes, I’ll tell her personally.”
Quas Phoenix: Hehe…
This was even more unreliable than making a friend after admiring it for a long time. It wanted to see what business there was to talk about when the time came.
“Wait, your name can’t be a descendant of Emperor Shi, right!” The Quas Phoenix suddenly thought of a possibility and suddenly looked at Shi Yu. Perhaps only the descendants of the Legendary Emperor could have such potential.
Shi Yu was speechless. “Stop guessing. Emperor Shi’s surname isn’t Shi.”
Seeing Shi Yu deny it, the Quas Phoenix also sighed. Although Emperor Shi’s surname wasn’t Shi, after Emperor Shi Dynasty was destroyed, it was possible for his descendants to change their surnames to avoid their enemies!
