“I have nothing to do with Emperor Shi,” Shi Yu said.
Now was not the time to flirt with Emperor Shi.
This Emperor Shi was an even more important transaction target. The old principal of the Imperial Capital University was also a time-element talent. Why was it so miserable that there weren’t even many time-element pets and time-element resources?
Part of the reason was that most of the rare time-element resources had been almost used up by Emperor Shi when he rose, causing subsequent time-element creatures to not have many resources to grow up. As time passed, time-element creatures became more and more rare and difficult to nurture.
Therefore, if Shi Yu could go to the Emperor Shi Era, he would definitely ask Emperor Shi for more resources before leaving.
…
A moment later, in the Star Palace, a spatial ripple attracted Shi Yu and the others’ attention, making them look at the sky.
“It’s finally here.” Shi Yu took a deep breath and looked at the Dong Huang Empress who had left a deep mark in Dong Huang’s history with slight anticipation.
In midair, spatial ripples flickered, as if a door that crossed space had been opened. Accompanied by the light of the phoenix, a figure descended into the Star Palace. Her skin was smooth, and her eyes were like stars. When her body landed in the teahouse and looked at Shi Yu, her white clothes fluttered. Her white and gray dress with the words of the Phoenix Flower spread out. Every move she made emitted extreme beauty, but it wasn’t simple beauty. She had a transcendent aura and aura like the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, who wanted to stand in the sky.
As expected of the future empress.
“Wuu…”
“Yi…” Eleven and Baby Ginseng hugged their teacups and were a little stunned. This was because the other party’s form was very similar to Chi Tong’s Sword Maiden form. They were indeed like sisters. Apart from the huge difference in aura, they were very similar.
“You must be Young Master Shi Yu.” Princess Huang Xi’s voice was very pleasant, and her eyes were also very beautiful. Compared to Mu Huiyin, there were fewer mixed-blood characteristics on her body. However, Shi Yu could confirm that the powerful power on her body was much stronger than Mu Huiyin, who was also at level eight.
“I am. I’ve heard so much about you, Princess Huang Xi.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Iron-eating Beast, what’s your relationship with Emperor Wu and Ji Yunchong?” Huang Xi’s gaze landed on the Iron-eating Beast. Unlike the others, she actually recognized Eleven’s race at a glance.
Shi Yu was not surprised. After all, the Emperor Wu Dynasty and the empress dynasty were only hundreds of years apart. The Phoenix Empire had occupied the Ancient Capital, so it was normal for them to know some history that ordinary Beast Tamers didn’t know.
“What, is it related to Emperor Wu?” The Quas Phoenix didn’t expect that it would actually be wrong. The surname Shi wasn’t related to Emperor Shi, but Emperor Wu?

chapters.title: Chapter 1200 - 1200 Large Family Recognition Scene (3)
chapters.content:
1200 Large Family Recognition Scene (3)
Shi Yu smiled and said, “As for General Ji Yun, I have a good relationship with his descendants. As for Emperor Wu, I was once lucky enough to fight Emperor Wu and was lucky enough to defeat him by one move.”
Although it wasn’t in the same space and time, it was the truth. Little kid, did you have a lot of question marks?
Princess Huang Xi: “?”
Quas Phoenix: ???
No matter how much Princess Huang Xi valued Shi Yu, as Shi Yu spoke, she still felt that it was extremely strange and ridiculous.
Emperor Wu Dong was an ancient from hundreds of years ago!
Humans had short lifespans. How could they live for so long? They weren’t transcendent creatures.
Shi Yu smiled and looked at the future empress. He felt that the feeling of communicating with the ancients through channels was very satisfying.
“Sir, stop kidding. Who exactly are you and what’s your goal?” Princess Huang Xi said.
As a legendary ruthless person who had blown up two demigods, it would be strange if Huang Xi believed Shi Yu, a level-eight Beast Tamer. She instantly felt that Shi Yu was unreasonable.
“A deal,” Shi Yu said. “I’ve already said just now that I’m here to make a deal with you.”
After a moment of silence, Princess Huang Xi said, “Please tell me.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Before that, why don’t we acknowledge each other first? This way, there might be less estrangement.”
With that said, Shi Yu activated the summoning array again. The red summoning array gradually outlined a figure with red fire spiritual energy.
Her red hair was draped over her shoulders, as smooth as silk. Her eyes were bright and she was wearing a silver-white standard armor. Black protective equipment wrapped around her beautiful figure, outlining perfect curves. Fire spiritual aura lingered around her body, and her aura was peerless.
“Impossible.” The Quas Phoenix was immediately shocked when it saw Chi Tong. This was because the spirit body in front of it was very similar to Princess Huang Xi, as if it was the younger Princess Huang Xi!
“Spirit body.” When Princess Huang Xi saw this spirit body that looked similar to her, she was also slightly stunned in her heart, but she didn’t react yet. However, as a mini Phoenix formed by orange-red flames landed on Sword Maiden Chi Tong’s shoulder, Princess Huang Xi immediately felt that it was unbelievable.
She instantly felt the bloodline power in her body boil. She only had this strong feeling when she saw her “mother”!
At this moment, Chi Tong was also observing the empress curiously and revealed a happy smile. She was ten thousand times more beautiful than the empress in the movie!!
Chi Tong, who watched dramas all year round, loved to watch movies of the empress dynasty the most. After all, the empress was her sister. Chi Tong didn’t have much feelings for the Undying Dark Phoenix, but she had a different attitude towards the empress. Firstly, the empress was the same as Mu Huiyin. Her fate wasn’t controlled by her. It was all born because of the Undying Dark Phoenix’s ambition. Secondly, the empress’s successful experience of resisting fate alone made Chi Tong very impressed.
[Sister Huang Xi!] Chi Tong said telepathically.
“It’s your little sister,” Shi Yu said.
Forget it, although Chi Tong’s bloodline was born first, it was only hatched in the future after all. Sister and sister seemed to be fine.
Princess Huang Xi couldn’t help but say, “Who exactly are you?”
She was completely confused.
Shi Yu said, “You’ve studied the history of the Emperor Wu Era, so you definitely know the history of the Phoenix Race, right? You should know why the Phoenix Empire left Phoenix Island, right?”
“Your ‘mother’ started a war with the pureblood Phoenix Race because she studied hybrids and violated the clan rules. In the end, she was expelled from Phoenix Island and established the Phoenix Empire in the Dong Huang Continent after sleeping for a thousand years.”
“In terms of the Phoenix Race bloodline in front of you, she’s indeed your sister. She was the first hybrid life form created by your ‘mother’ to perfectly inherit its bloodline at that time. Unfortunately, because of the Phoenix Race’s internal war, she was separated from your ‘mother’.”
“Then, due to some coincidence, we signed a contract. Its existence is also the most important reason why I came to you.”
Princess Huang Xi took a deep breath and looked at Chi Tong in disbelief. She immediately believed most of what Shi Yu said.
Because she indeed knew that she had another sister whose talent was only inferior to her own. She had learned from her “mother” that her mother had regretted this lost sister for a long time. Another thing was that bloodline affinity didn’t lie.
However, what shocked her was that this sister who had been lost for a thousand years would actually one day be contracted by a human in the form of an undead and appear in front of her.
At the side, the Quas Phoenix was already stunned.
“Sister…?” At this moment, Princess Huang Xi was unwilling to accept this title.
She said, “In that case, why are you looking for me? You should look for Mother. She will definitely be very happy.”
Chi Tong felt aggrieved.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Are you really willing to push your sister into the fire pit? You should already know the purpose of the Phoenix Empire’s establishment and your mother’s intention of leading the clansmen who support hybrids to nurture a large number of hybrid Beast Tamers, right?”
“How long have you been preparing for a rebellion?”
Princess Huang Xi’s pupils constricted.
“How dare you!!!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, the Quas Phoenix was suddenly stunned. However, Eleven and Baby Ginseng’s aura locked onto it together, making it instantly feel like it had fallen into an ice cave. Its brain rumbled and it calmed down.
Shi Yu said, “Calm down. We’re family. It can be said that you and my Chi Tong are both sacrifices of its ambition. Be it you or her, when they grow to a certain level and it finds out, they will definitely become nutrients for its breakthrough.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1201 - 1201 Large Family Recognition Scene (4)
chapters.content:
1201 Large Family Recognition Scene (4)
“Even an outsider like me knows so much. The famous and extremely intelligent Princess Huang Xi must have long known her situation.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “You must feel a sense of danger now.”
“So, can we talk about the deal now?”
Princess Huang Xi stretched out her arm, indicating for the shocked Ice Phoenix to calm down. She looked at Shi Yu and Chi Tong and said, “I see. It’s precisely because she’s worried that her bloodline will be controlled by ‘Queen Mother’ that she stripped her bloodline and molded it into a clone.”
“Looks like you’ve already made sufficient preparations and understand very well, but you still don’t have the confidence to resist the hidden danger of the ‘ demigod threat’, so you came to me to seek cooperation.”
Eleven and Baby Ginseng were silent. That wasn’t the case. Shi Yu probably wanted to tell them in advance that he would let them clean up someone’s mess after they left.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “You can understand it that way, but our strength is stronger than you imagine. Perhaps we can settle everything ourselves without you needing to do anything.”
Huang Xi looked at Shi Yu and said, “What do you want to do?”
Shi Yu asked, “How far are you from the legendary level? How long do you think it will take to break through?”
Huang Xi said calmly, “I can break through at any time.”
Shi Yu was shocked.???
Holy shit.
Damn, he instantly understood. The empress was probably suppressing her level! Because he wasn’t confident of fighting the Undying Dark Phoenix, she planned to break through when he was sufficiently prepared.
After all, after breaking through, even if she didn’t attack, the Undying Dark Phoenix would take the initiative to attack.
Women… were really ruthless.
When Huang Xi saw Shi Yu’s calm expression change to surprise for the first time, she couldn’t help but smile in her heart. So this mysterious man wasn’t omniscient or omnipotent.
“Sure, I underestimated you,” Shi Yu said. “Then, we might be able to cooperate more happily.”
“My goal is actually very simple. How about we join forces to overthrow the half-gods of the Phoenix Empire and the half-gods of Phoenix Island and incorporate the entire Phoenix Race?” Shi Yu smiled.
“At that time, you will lead the Phoenix Race, and I only want a portion of the resources of the Phoenix Empire and the Phoenix Race. How about that?”
When Princess Huang Xi saw that Shi Yu had revealed his true intentions, she was immediately speechless. So he wanted the resources of the Phoenix Empire and the Phoenix Race.
However, this was also the most realistic transaction.
“I think your appetite is a little too big,” Princess Huang Xi said.
Just the Queen Mother of the Phoenix Empire was a huge mountain pressing down on her head. Even if she broke through to the Legendary stage now, she wasn’t confident of resisting her Queen Mother. After all, her bloodline was suppressed. And if she imitated Chi Tong in front of her and stripped her bloodline, she couldn’t use the power of her Beast Taming, so it was very unsolvable…
It was even difficult to solve the current predicament, let alone the strength of the Phoenix Race. Even in the entire Blue Planet, it was enough to be ranked at the top, the Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod at the top.
“Humans have to have dreams. We can definitely do it if we join forces,” Shi Yu said. “At that time, the Phoenix Race that we’ve incorporated will be the guardian of humans. Wouldn’t everyone be happy if you established a new generation that’s mainly humans after the Emperor Shi Dynasty and the Emperor Wu Dynasty?”
“If you become the empress, I won’t fight with you for the throne. This should be your dream, right?”
Princess Huang Xi’s gaze turned cold again. She felt that her entire body had been seen through by Shi Yu. If it was said that she could still understand what had happened previously, but Shi Yu actually knew the dream hidden in the depths of her heart. This really made Princess Huang Xi feel incredulous.
[Sister Huang Xi, we’re not bad people.]
[We just want to help you.] Chi Tong looked at the empress with a sincere heart.
She still wanted to watch dramas with the empress and let the empress personally scold the screenwriter.
Princess Huang Xi looked at Chi Tong in silence… You just called me sister.
However… sensing Chi Tong’s sincere mental fluctuations, Princess Huang Xi was slightly touched.
“We can cooperate, but you have to listen to me and not act on your own,” Princess Huang Xi said. “Although you’re very strong, I feel that your behavior is very unreliable.”
Shi Yu laughed and said, “Don’t talk nonsense. I’m an honest person. I won’t cause trouble…”
Princess Huang Xi said, “By the way, is that bird person with pretty good strength outside the mystic realm residence your friend? I think it’s been paying attention to this place.”
Shi Yu said, “It’s the son of the Golden-Winged Roc God of the Garuda Empire, the son of a demigod.”
Huang Xi was slightly surprised and said, “Looks like you have a lot of connections.”
Shi Yu said, “When I was heading here, I encountered it trying to snatch my things, so I suppressed it and kept it as bird hostage. I’ve already informed its demigod father to use divine-level resources to redeem it. I wonder how long it will take to send the resources over…”
Princess Huang Xi’s vision darkened and she almost fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1202 - 1202 Roasting demigod bird wings
chapters.content:
1202 Roasting demigod bird wings
At this moment, Huang Xi wished she could kill the person in front of her with a sword.
Her feeling was indeed right. The Shi Yu in front of her was very unreliable.
First, it said that it had fought and won against Emperor Wu, and then it said that it had held the demigod son hostage to wait for the ransom?
Whether it was true or false, it showed that the person in front of him was really out of place.
“Is it really the son of a demigod? Golden-Winged Roc God, I know, the new demigod of the Ming Hua Continent.”
Princess Huang Xi couldn’t help but say, “Are you sure it’s being held hostage by you?”
“You guys should be friends, right? Do you have any intention of cooperating? At a time like this, can you be more serious?”
“Wu…” The Quas Phoenix looked at Princess Huang Xi. Princess Huang Xi, who usually felt very calm, gradually became unstable in front of this mysterious young man.
Shi Yu said in amusement, “We’re really not friends. If you don’t believe me, you can ask it.”
“It’s just that I’ve placed a death restriction on it, so it doesn’t dare to run.”
“Roar, roar,” Eleven said.
“Yi.” Baby Ginseng liked it. Actually, it could too, but it was definitely not as threatening as Eleven’s Wex Mark.
Princess Huang Xi opened her mouth slightly. Seeing Shi Yu’s serious appearance, her beautiful face revealed a hint of anger.
She naturally didn’t doubt that Shi Yu had the strength to defeat that birdman.
Although it was the son of a demigod, the golden-winged bird was clearly a little lousy.
But…
“Are you here to help me or to cause trouble for me?”
A demigod mother who was eyeing her covetously was enough to make her unable to breathe. In the end, the partner who had just formed an alliance brought another demigod threat?
If Shi Yu had brought a demigod ally, she would undoubtedly be very grateful to Shi Yu, but bringing a demigod enemy…
For a moment, Princess Huang Xi really wanted to give Shi Yu two punches and cut ties, although it didn’t matter.
At the same time.
All the totem countries and human cities in the east looked at the sky in fear.
Boom!!!
A huge golden-winged divine bird with a wingspan of a hundred meters was erupting with all its might and moving in a direction at a high speed.
“Jiu!!!”
At the same time, it let out an angry cry.
The demigod of the Garuda Empire, the Golden-Winged Roc God, and the Golden Roc demigod!
“Demigod level!”
“Which District’s totem king is it!”
In the east, many totems and top-notch overlords looked at the figure in the sky in shock.
“In that direction, the Phoenix Empire…”
“Is a war about to begin?”
As everyone knew, in a large District, under normal circumstances, there was only one totem half-god as the absolute Juggernaut.
At the moment, the totem half-god of the Dong Huang Continent was the Sun God Phoenix half-god of the Phoenix Empire.
At this moment, this Golden Roc demigod had come from god knows where. It was aggressive and flew towards the Phoenix Empire’s territory with strong anger, immediately waking up many lives.
The golden-winged roc’s cry for help was very fast.
The speed at which the Golden Roc demigod descended was also very fast.
As a new demigod of the Ming Hua Continent, it had just advanced to a demigod not long ago and was provoked. This was undoubtedly a challenge to its authority.
No matter who the other party was, it swore to make the other party pay a heavy price, a miserable price known to the world!
In a short moment, the Golden Roc demigod crossed the sea, crossed the land, and approached the border of the Phoenix Empire.
Its approach instantly made the Phoenix Guardians in the Phoenix Empire feel as if they were facing a great enemy.
However, a demigod-level was still a demigod-level after all. In addition, the Golden Roc demigod was known for its speed. There were probably not many in the east who could stop it.
In the depths of the Phoenix Palace, at this moment, as it sensed the demigod invader, a Phoenix wrapped in the Sun God Exort slowly opened its eyes from its sleep.
“Useless thing!” Just as it approached the Phoenix Empire, the Golden Roc demigod sensed the bloodline of the Golden-Winged Little Roc.
The Golden Roc demigod gritted its teeth at this good-for-nothing son.
However, it was its seed after all. It couldn’t really ignore the other party being captured.
At this moment, Princess Huang Xi still couldn’t believe that Shi Yu was so bold as to provoke a demigod.
Because this was indeed a little unbelievable.
However, it was a coincidence that the Golden Roc demigod came especially quickly.
As the future empress, the current second expert of the Phoenix Empire, Princess Huang Xi naturally had spies all over the country.
Therefore, as the Golden Roc demigod descended into the Phoenix Empire, she was almost the first to know.
Then, he looked at Shi Yu in disbelief.
“You…”
“Are you really crazy?” She didn’t expect what Shi Yu said to come true so quickly.
The enemy demigod was really here!
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu was stunned.
Princess Huang Xi gritted her teeth and said, “If what you said just now is true, that demigod really came to the Phoenix Empire!!”
“What?” The Quas Phoenix beside him was shocked.
Eleven, Baby Ginseng, and the others were stunned before eager to give it a try.
“So fast?” Shi Yu was also stunned.
Then, he immediately got up and looked at the empty teacup. “Looks like Little Golden Roc is especially valued.”
“It’s getting late. You came at the right time.”
“After all… I don’t have much time. If I can solve it as soon as possible, I’ll do it as soon as possible.”
“Don’t worry, I’ll handle that Golden-Winged Roc God well. I won’t let the faction behind it become your trouble. I’ll settle this matter myself. You don’t have to get too involved.”
With that said, Shi Yu directly called Eleven and the others and left the Star Palace.
Only Princess Huang Xi was left silent on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 1203 - 1203 Roasting demigod bird wings (2)
chapters.content:
1203 Roasting demigod bird wings (2)
[Little Sister, leave it to us! After settling everything, we’ll…] Before Chi Tong left, it didn’t forget to greet the empress, but before it could finish speaking, it was put back into the space by Shi Yu and Baby Ginseng.
What was there to talk about? Let’s go fight first!
“Huang Xi, demigod Garuda really came??? He’s not lying?”
At this moment, the Quas Phoenix overlord was stunned and couldn’t believe it.
“That’s right. At this moment, I’m afraid the totem guardians of the entire Phoenix Empire have already sensed it.”
“Mother might also be awakened.”
“I don’t understand this guy at all.” Princess Huang Xi continued to grit her teeth.
“Is he really crazy? No, the origin of this group of people is too mysterious. We can’t completely trust them.” The Quas Phoenix looked at its Beast Tamer and said seriously, “Even if that spiritual body is your bloodline relative, bloodlines are still unreliable…”
“Moreover, he actually provoked a demigod…”
If it was reliable, the current demigod of the Phoenix Empire should be the person closest to the empress, but in fact, it was the empress’s greatest enemy.
“But… I do feel that they don’t look like enemies,” Huang Xi said.
This didn’t rely on any bloodline perception, but purely the intuition of a quasi Legendary Beast Tamer.
The future empress was silent.
“No matter what, let’s go take a look first. I want to see if they’re crazy or if they really have some trump card.”
…
In the outside world.
The Golden-Winged Roc had waited for a long, long time.
The moment the Golden Roc demigod entered the Phoenix Empire, it also sensed the bloodline power from its father and sensed the soaring aura in the distance. It couldn’t help but be excited and nervous.
“Father, Father, you’re finally here.”
“I’ve waited so long.”
It had just returned to its original form when a huge aura was revealed. It wanted to fly into the sky and welcome its father, but its movements stopped.
Because at this moment, Shi Yu happened to come out of the mystic realm of the residence.
“Where are you going?” Shi Yu, who came out, looked at the golden-winged roc in midair with Eleven beside him.
The golden-winged roc looked like it was about to cry. It looked at Shi Yu and said, “Lord, have you seen Princess Huang Xi?”
Shi Yu said, “I saw it. It’s indeed beautiful.”
The Golden-Winged Roc was shocked and said, “How beautiful is it? What color are its wings? Forget it… This isn’t important. Lord, my father seems to have come. It brought a ransom to redeem me. Don’t hurt me. We agreed.”
“Wait a little longer… Wait a little longer…”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “I already know, but this isn’t a very good trading place. Follow me. We’ll welcome your father.”
The Golden-Winged Roc’s expression was bitter.
It felt that this time, no matter the outcome, it would definitely be beaten up by its father when it returned.
At this moment, because of the descent of the Golden Roc demigod, several Phoenix Guardians in the Phoenix Empire woke up from various places and flew into the sky.
In an instant, the entire Phoenix Empire was enveloped in dark clouds.
“Move!!!” However, the Golden Roc demigod ignored these guys and flew straight ahead.
Facing the powerful aura of the Golden Roc demigod, these Phoenix Guardians didn’t dare to forcefully stop it.
Similarly, because its goal was not the Phoenix Empire, the Golden Roc demigod was unwilling to offend the Phoenix Race. It only wanted to find Shi Yu.
It knew that the Phoenix Empire also had demigods, but as long as it was clear about this kind of thing, it believed that the demigods of the Phoenix Empire would definitely make things convenient.
After all, demigods rarely made enemies easily, especially demigods with their own factions. Neither party could afford the price.
“Stop!!!”
At this moment, apart from Shi Yu and Princess Huang Xi, probably only the Sun God Phoenix demigod could stop the Golden Roc demigod in the Phoenix Empire.
In Phoenix City, all life trembled. The hot sun in the sky was even hotter.
Under the intersection of the golden light and the hot sun, in the light of the sun, an incomparably huge orange-red Phoenix God swept up the sun, emitting a monstrous aura. It spread out fire patterns that filled the sky and sealed the Phoenix City.
Boom!!!
This was also the first time the Golden Roc demigod, who was close to Phoenix City, stopped in its tracks. Its sharp gaze stared intently into the city.
“It’s His Majesty, the Divine Phoenix.” At this moment, the huge phantom of the future Dark Phoenix of the Sun Divine Phoenix lingered in the sky above Phoenix City.
The lives in the city who sensed the interweaving of two huge auras trembled, not knowing what had happened.
“Are there any enemies?”
“Who’s the other very terrifying aura?”
Under the panic of countless people, the Golden Roc demigod also faced the Sun God Phoenix.
“Your Majesty Divine Phoenix, I’m the Juggernaut of the Garuda Empire. Please forgive me for disturbing you. An evil person kidnapped my son and even used its life to extort resources from me. He’s in the city. Can you do me a favor and let me take him away?”
A demigod had barged into its territory. The Sun God Phoenix was originally very angry and nervous, thinking that it was its sister. Seeing that it was actually a Golden Roc demigod that came from nowhere and that its goal wasn’t the Phoenix Empire, it heaved a sigh of relief.
The Phoenix Empire was currently in the stage of prosperity and development. At the moment, it couldn’t withstand the torment.
“So it’s the Juggernaut of the Garuda Empire. I wonder who’s so bold to actually dare to hold your son hostage.” The Sun God Phoenix felt that it was unbelievable. Who dared to provoke a demigod and even threaten the other party to use resources to redeem him?
This person was definitely not from the Phoenix Empire. Its country didn’t have such a lunatic.

chapters.title: Chapter 1204 - 1204 Roasting demigod bird wings (3)
chapters.content:
1204 Roasting demigod bird wings (3)
“It’s not a problem to take him, but please don’t fight in the Phoenix Empire.”
“Alright, I’ll definitely cut him into a thousand pieces!!!” The Golden Roc demigod looked in a direction angrily.
In that direction, a light happened to be speeding over.
It was Shi Yu, who was flying in midair with Psychic power, with a mini panda sitting on his shoulder, and a golden-winged roc with a bird face and a human body behind them.
“Father!!!” At this moment, it was getting closer and closer to the Golden Roc demigod. The Golden Roc was aggrieved like a fatty weighing 20,000 pounds. It let out a miserable cry and flew towards the Golden Roc demigod.
Its cry naturally became the focus.
Shi Yu didn’t stop it from flying towards the Golden Roc demigod. He was happy the whole time. As the Golden Roc flew over, the Golden Roc demigod was furious.
“Useless guy, get lost,” it said, immediately shocking the Golden-Winged Roc. It flew around and didn’t dare to make a sound.
However, at this moment, the little roc looked at Shi Yu arrogantly.
Ask for it, ask for it. My father is here, but you want resources.
It wasn’t the only one. The Sun God Phoenix and Princess Huang Xi, who was in the distant residence, looked at Shi Yu with dark expressions.
Princess Huang Xi was still alright. She already knew the cause and effect, but it was still the Undying Dark Phoenix of the Sun God Phoenix. However, this was the first time it saw Shi Yu. It was stunned. Don’t tell it that it was this young man in front of it who had hijacked the son of the Golden Roc demigod and even threatened it…
This was too f*cking ridiculous.
“They’re all here. Not bad.” At this moment, Shi Yu was flying in midair. He looked at the gathered Golden Roc demigod and Sun God Phoenix and sighed in his heart.
Alright, there was going to be another fierce battle. He liked it.
“Demigod of the Garuda Empire, have you brought the divine-level resources? I’ve returned your son to you unscathed. Give me the resources next.”
Shi Yu stood in the sky and said.
Princess Huang Xi: …
Sun God Phoenix: …
The golden-winged roc looked at Shi Yu, this incurable lunatic, in shock.
Did this guy not recognize the current situation?
The Golden Roc demigod was also furious. It looked at Shi Yu as if he was a dead person.
“How bold.”
“Alright, resources, right? I want to see if you’re alive to take them.”
“Jiu!!!” It roared at the sky, completely forgetting the warning of the Sun God Phoenix just now, telling it not to attack in the Phoenix Empire.
Its golden sharp claws emitted a dazzling light as it directly grabbed at Shi Yu. At the same time, its claws enlarged, and phantoms spread, lingering with the deterrence of a demigod, as if it could crush a city.
In the Golden Roc demigod’s opinion, teaching such an arrogant guy a lesson was not a battle at all.
Even if the opponent had top-notch totem battle power, it could suppress it in an instant and not affect the Phoenix Empire.
“He’s already fainted from anger.” The Sun God Phoenix turned a blind eye when it saw this.
It thought about it. If its carefully cultivated daughter was captured and used to threaten it, it would also go berserk.
The Sun God Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and the others, who were attacking the core of the huge claw phantom, and felt that it was ridiculous. Where did this young man come from? He actually had the strength to defeat the son of a demigod and was so bold as to threaten a demigod.
Young people didn’t know no fear. They had a death wish.
“Not good.”
The Golden Roc half-god attacked, and Princess Huang Xi’s expression couldn’t help but change slightly.
This bastard.
This was what he said? He was an honest person and wouldn’t cause trouble?
“Ahahahahaha.” The golden-winged little roc directly laughed crazily at this moment. After enduring the humiliation for so long, after this, it would definitely enslave Shi Yu and the others for 100 years to vent the hatred in its heart. It wouldn’t even be satisfied if it directly ate them!!
“Sigh…”
At this moment, although the demigod’s angry attack wasn’t a quasi-divine skill, it was also a unique skill with the conviction to kill.
However, in the face of this attack, Shi Yu only sighed slightly.
He knew that the Golden Roc demigod wouldn’t take out divine-level resources so easily. They definitely had to fight.
He could fight.
However, at that time, it wasn’t something a divine-level resource could solve.
Apart from divine-level resources, they also had to replenish the consumption of their battle.
The demigod attack attracted the attention of the entire city. Countless totem phoenixes who rushed over also looked at this attack in shock.
But in the next moment, an even more shocking scene appeared.
On Shi Yu’s shoulder, it was unknown if the speed of the small black and white bear was fast or slow. It felt very fast, but in everyone’s eyes, it was very slow. Just like that, black and white electric arcs lingered around its body as it blocked the sharp claws that were enough to tear apart the totem dragon.
There were no aftermath, no vibration, no sound.
Time seemed to have stopped.
The Sun God Phoenix, Princess Huang Xi, the Golden-Winged Little Roc, and the Golden Roc half-god looked at the scene in front of them in disbelief.
The huge claw phantom that enveloped dozens of meters was directly blocked in the air by the small black and white bear with a finger surrounded by black and white lightning.
A finger blocked the demigod’s angry attack.
This scene was especially shocking, simply shattering the values of countless experts.
“Take it away. You just ate a Legendary resource. You deal with this opponent.” As Shi Yu finished speaking, an even more shocking scene appeared.
Accompanied by the lingering black and white lightning, with a crack, the huge claw phantom seemed to have been penetrated and instantly shattered.
At the same time, the energy fluctuations on the little black and white bear’s body increased exponentially, and its figure was blurry. Black and white lightning intertwined, as if it was wearing lightning armor. With a boom, it turned into a black and white beam of light that hit the Golden Roc demigod under its incomprehensible shocked gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1205 - 1205 Roasting demigod bird wings (4)
chapters.content:
1205 Roasting demigod bird wings (4)
Bang!!!
Under the vibration of a loud bang that resounded through Phoenix City, the huge Golden Roc demigod was directly sent flying by this beam of light. In a beautiful arc, accompanied by a miserable cry under the lightning, it was knocked out of the Phoenix Empire!!
Shi Yu definitely couldn’t fight the Golden Roc demigod in Phoenix City. After all, if there was a conflict, it wouldn’t be good if this place was destroyed. If the Dragon Vein of Phoenix City was destroyed, it would be a small matter if it wasn’t easy to ask for resources from the empress. There were also many ordinary people living here, so it would be a sin if it affected them.
Therefore, Shi Yu directly got Eleven to push the Golden Roc demigod out of the Phoenix Empire, planning to talk to it in the Desolate Land.
Du Ling Mountain Range.
At the border of the Phoenix Empire, a relatively desolate mountain range belonged to the totem battlefield during the founding of the Phoenix Empire.
Because a battle had happened before, this side was like a dead mountain. It was lifeless and without any life. Not to mention life, even undead were very few.
At this moment, accompanied by a black and white lightning in the sky, a huge golden figure was pushed by the light beam and smashed into a mountain.
Boom!!!
A huge mountain was directly flattened.
Everything around him instantly turned into a sea of lightning.
“Jiu!!!” The Golden Roc demigod’s miserable cry continued. It hurt, it hurt too much.
The super explosive power brought about by the combination of transcendent Inner Power, Thunder God Armor, Demon God Body, superalloy, and many other top-notch super skills was not inferior to low-quality quasi-divine skills.
At this moment, the Golden Roc demigod could be said to be completely stunned. It was speechless and didn’t understand what had happened.
On the other side.
Shi Yu was still in the sky above Phoenix City under the shocked expressions of the Sun God Phoenix, the Future Empress, and the others.
“Let’s go.” Shi Yu’s voice sounded. An alternate space door appeared in front of him. It was created by Buggy and opened the spatial passage to the battlefield.
Shi Yu stepped in.
“Who are you!!!” Before stepping in, he heard the shocked voice of the Sun God Phoenix.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu didn’t have the time to care about this. He used his Psychic power to pinch the frightened golden-winged roc and left.
“Ahhhhhh!!!” The golden-winged little roc was completely crazy.
“No, Father!!! Don’t joke around with me.”
…
Spirit Capital Mountain Range.
Shi Yu crossed the Void. At this moment, the Golden-Winged Roc God was also roaring angrily. It flapped its wings and repelled Eleven.
Or rather, Eleven took the initiative to take a step back.
Although this Golden-Winged Roc God was very lousy and its normal energy level was only 100 million higher than the cat, far inferior to a demigod like Eleven who held more than ten super top-notch skills and had no blind spots in all aspects and mastered top-notch quasi-divine skills, every demigod had their own unique points. Unless necessary, Shi Yu didn’t want to force the other party…
“Ahhh, Father!!!” The Golden-Winged Roc was captured. Looking at the miserable Golden Roc demigod, its expression collapsed. Wu wu, what was going on?
“Now, do I have the life to take that resource?” Shi Yu said in midair.
“What a joke!!! Die!!!”
The Golden Roc half-god let out a roar that tore through the sky. Its Exort Eye flickered like the sun and moon, and its divine iron-like strong mouth emitted divine light like an iron hook. It was like the sound of laws interweaving between steel and Gust, directly resounding in all directions.
Although this place was already far from human habitation, it still made the transcendent life forms closest to it instantly crawl in fear. It also made the Sun God Phoenix demigod and the others in the distance reveal shocked expressions and accelerate to see the situation.
Quasi-divine skill!
The Golden Roc demigod directly used a quasi-divine skill that contained the law of tearing and penetration to attack Shi Yu and the others.
“Wuu.” Seeing that the other party was so stubborn, Eleven blocked in front of the other party again. Divine power erupted, and behind its body, ten Chaos Panda phantoms appeared. Including the main body, there were eleven Chaos Pandas!!
Nine Li Army!!
It was an army skill fused with many skills such as the Bean Bear, Impregnable, Clone, and Four Symbols Star Formation.
Not only did it inherit the nature of the bean army that could be condensed in advance, but the effect was even stronger. The ten Chaos Bean Bear clones in front of him were clearly condensed by Eleven a long time ago. At this moment, the eleven Chaos Pandas worked together to block it, forming an army resonance. It was another non-quasi-divine skill to resist a quasi-divine skill!!
Boom!!!
The powerful attack of the Golden Roc demigod penetrated the huge golden light screen pushed up by Eleven’s palm in front of him. Only a few cracks appeared and it couldn’t penetrate at all. Then, these cracks actually quickly repaired, shocking the Golden Roc demigod.
“Who exactly are you?” At this moment, the Golden Roc demigod finally panicked.
Quasi-divine Skill… was actually blocked by a Normal Skill!!!
The Sun God Phoenix and the other experts who rushed over also looked at this scene in the sky in shock.
“That’s the Iron-eating Beast? The trump card of the Legendary Emperor Wu?” Like Huang Xi, the Sun God Phoenix finally sensed what race Eleven was.
However, he still couldn’t understand.
Why… who exactly were they?
“Are you giving me divine-level resources?” Shi Yu asked again.
“This is too much!!!” The Golden Roc demigod roared angrily again. Its energy level began to increase steadily. Seeing this, Shi Yu was helpless.
Eleven, who had blocked the Golden Roc demigod with one hand, raised its other hand without saying a word.
In his palm, a circular metal formed. The metal was black and white, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious. Everything around it seemed to have turned into chaos, disintegrating and being obliterated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1206 - 1206 Roasting demigod bird wings (5)
chapters.content:
1206 Roasting demigod bird wings (5)
It had yet to come into contact with the Golden Roc half-god and had yet to completely take shape, but it had already triggered the sound of laws that obliterated everything. In an instant, the Golden Roc half-god bloodline trembled. The quasi-divine skill seemed to have been heavily injured and was instantly suppressed and obliterated.
The pupils of the Golden Roc demigod constricted, revealing a shocked expression!!!
“Father!!!” The golden-winged little roc was also shocked by this skill. Not to mention it, even the Sun God Phoenix was instantly stunned when it sensed this skill that was even more terrifying than its quasi-divine skill.
From the moment he woke up until now, he didn’t know what had happened.
“He, he…” As for Princess Huang Xi, she was also shocked when she saw Shi Yu so bravely suppressing a demigod.
Wasn’t this guy only a level-eight Beast Tamer?
How could it be so strong?
Even a legendary Beast Tamer couldn’t rely on a single pet to suppress a demigod, right?
Even if it was a Emperor Wu, only the combination of the nine pets could suppress a demigod!!
Was this Shi Yu’s confidence in calmly extorting demigods?
[Emperor Wu? I once fought him and was lucky enough to win by a move.] Suddenly, Princess Huang Xi recalled what Shi Yu had told her and almost blacked out again.
However, at this moment, she was even more confused. This guy’s goal in cooperating with her.
“Wait, wait.” At that moment, the most shocked was still the Golden Roc demigod. This move, this move hitting it was definitely a huge injury!
It looked at the Sun God Phoenix crazily and shouted, “Your Majesty, help me…”
Sun God Phoenix: “What a joke. Who are you?”
The Golden Roc demigod: “?”
It looked at the top-notch quasi-divine skill that gradually formed but never formed in panic again.
Although it had yet to take shape, it could feel the terrifying power of this Skill the most.
“Last chance,” Shi Yu said.
The Golden Roc demigod was also about to cry. It cursed the Golden-Winged Little Roc in its heart and said, “Sir, we have no grudges. There’s no need to fight to the death, right?”
“3, 2…” Shi Yu counted down.
“I don’t have divine-level resources, Legendary-level resources, three Legendary-level resources!!!”
Shi Yu frowned.
Seeing this, what was unbelievable to the Sun God Phoenix and the others was that opposite Shi Yu, the Golden Roc half-god’s expression kept changing as it suddenly severed its wings decisively.
Boom.
The huge demigod wings fell, and strong energy fluctuations lingered on them. The Golden Roc demigod said, “Although there are no divine-level resources, my wings can also be considered a divine-level resource. Sir, I admit defeat this time. Let’s each take a step back and have a bright future. Otherwise, even if I self-destruct, I won’t let you have an easy time.”
Not to mention the Sun God Phoenix and the others, even Shi Yu was shocked. He cursed in his heart. He didn’t expect the Golden Roc demigod to be so decisive and ruthless.
Although he wasn’t afraid of a demigod self-destructing and had already studied it thoroughly, he was speechless for a moment.
The reason why he didn’t attack immediately was that he really didn’t want to fight to the death and let Eleven and the others waste too much strength. After all, there were a lot of tough battles ahead… But at this moment, seeing the Golden Roc demigod fold its wings, Shi Yu was really impressed for a moment.
This was the most decisive enemy he had ever seen.
“Father…” The golden-winged roc was completely stunned.
Shi Yu looked at the demigod wings and calculated its value. He also sighed slightly and said, “Forget it, forget it. You guys can leave. Take your son and leave immediately.”
“Jiu!!!” The Golden-Winged Roc God looked at its unfilial son, and a furious glint flashed in its eyes. When it heard Shi Yu’s words, it used energy without a word and swept the golden Gust away with the Golden-Winged Roc.
It had a premonition that this was the best outcome. This human young man was very strange. He was definitely a Beast Tamer. He actually contracted a top-notch demigod as a pet. It couldn’t guarantee that if this continued, the other party wouldn’t take out other pets.
If the wings were gone, it could recuperate again and grow back. If it lost its life, everything would be gone.
Boom!!!
The Golden Roc demigod directly took away its heir, leaving only two pairs of huge demigod wings. When Shi Yu saw this, he suddenly thought of something and shouted in that direction,
“Wait, don’t forget those three Legendary resources!!!”
The golden light escaped even faster.
The Sun God Phoenix and the other Phoenixes had frightened expressions. What kind of person was this?
At this moment, Shi Yu was beautiful. He burst with joy as he looked at his wings and said to Eleven, “Good stuff. Go roast it first.”
“I’ve never eaten demigod-level wings before. I can have a big meal. This isn’t a loss. I have the Restoration items in the future. As for wings, they’re barely edible!”
“Wuu…” Eleven dispersed the Yin Yang Millstone and touched its stomach. Could this thing really be eaten?
“Probably…”
“It shouldn’t be inferior to the Phoenix Wings, right? Although we’ve never eaten the Phoenix Wings…” Shi Yu said.
At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at the Sun God Phoenix, the future empress, and the others who had been watching just now.
As Shi Yu’s gaze landed, the Sun God Phoenix was shocked.
Panic and fear subconsciously appeared in its eyes.
What was wrong with this person, what was going on! He could actually suppress a demigod, making him not hesitate to spend his wings and not be willing to continue fighting.
Why had he never heard of such a monster in the east?
Moreover… they still wanted to eat Phoenix wings and demigod wings?!! What the hell!
“Sir, who are you!!” The Sun God Phoenix couldn’t help but ask, its heart thumping.
She only hoped that the other party wasn’t an enemy.
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Just a member of Mother Hunter.”
The Sun God Phoenix was at a loss. “What do you mean?!”
Why did this faction sound a little fierce?

chapters.title: Chapter 1207 - 1207 Mother Hunting
chapters.content:
1207 Mother Hunting
Mother Hunter!
The Divine Phoenix half-god might not know what it meant, but how could the future empress beside him not know?
Xi’er, have you heard of Mother Hunter?
In the face of the Divine Phoenix demigod’s question, Princess Huang Xi had mixed feelings.
“I’ve never heard of it…”
She just didn’t know if that Shi Yu had included him.
At this moment, Shi Yu still had plenty of energy to force the Golden Roc demigod back without much effort.
He saw that the Sun God Phoenix had also come to the wilderness and couldn’t help but want to save trouble.
Now, only the Sun God Phoenix and Princess Huang Xi followed.
The other totem phoenixes were ordered by the Sun God Phoenix to stay in the Phoenix Empire to guard.
At this moment, he was alone. If he didn’t attack now, when would he?
“Your Majesty Divine Phoenix.” Shi Yu smiled and waved his hand.
It put the two pairs of huge wings of the Golden Roc demigod into the ruins space.
“Sir, what can I do for you?”
The voice of the Sun God Phoenix was like a high and mighty empress. At this moment, it was still rather dignified. However, it also sensed that Eleven was extraordinary and was very polite.
Energy Points: 2,980 million
The peak-level Mother Phoenix was neither strong nor weak. However, Shi Yu and the others had participated in too many demigod battles. It had long been considered veterans.
“Let me introduce myself in detail again.”
“My name is Shi Yu, a Beast Tamer. It’s Iron-eating Beast Eleven, my pet.”
Shi Yu introduced himself to the Sun God Phoenix.
“Shi Yu… Good name. By the way, it’s my fault for letting that huge golden bird disturb your elegance when you came to my Phoenix Empire as a guest.” The Sun God Phoenix was extremely apologetic. “Please don’t take offense.”
“I didn’t know before that it was the son of the golden bird who provoked you first. If I knew, I would definitely uphold justice for you.”
“I’ve always admired a human expert like you. Why don’t… the Phoenix Race treat you well again?”
“My daughter, Huang Xi, is similar in age to you. There must be countless topics to talk about.”
“In addition, I wonder if you’re interested in the Phoenix Race… Of course, I don’t mean eating! In the Empire, there are countless Phoenix Divine Birds with outstanding talent. If they can follow you and both parties contract, I believe they can definitely become your reliable companions.”
When the Sun God Phoenix saw Shi Yu’s strength, it immediately expressed goodwill.
The situation of the Phoenix Empire was still relatively stable, but the Sun God Phoenix knew that they still had a huge threat, the orthodox Phoenix Race of the Phoenix Island. Therefore, the Phoenix Empire needed more allies now.
In short, she couldn’t increase the number of enemies.
“Phoenix? Of course I like it very much, but forget about the contract. I already have a contract target with the bloodline of the Phoenix Race.” Shi Yu smiled.
“This…” The Sun God Phoenix was shocked.” Really? ”
Only Phoenix Island and the Phoenix Empire had the Phoenix Race bloodline.
“Yes, it’s her.” Shi Yu summoned the array without another word.
In the next moment, the Sword Maiden Chi Tong, who had a mini Phoenix clone on its shoulder, walked out of the red array.
Her red hair fluttered, and her red eyes looked around calmly at the Sun God Phoenix.
“Huh??”
A second ago, the Sun God Phoenix was still silent, worried that Shi Yu was related to Phoenix Island.
But in the next second, it was stunned twice.
They were first stunned by Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space level.
Level eight.
How did a level-eight Beast Tamer contract demigod-level battle power?!
Even if Shi Yu was a level-nine Legendary, it was actually a little ridiculous. This was because according to the Sun God Phoenix’s understanding, no Legendary Beast Tamer had cultivated a demigod pet.
Perhaps Emperor Shi, Emperor Wu, and the others had hope, but unfortunately, these people died due to various accidents before they could reach the limit of their lifespans.
Therefore, a young Beast Tamer like Shi Yu who contracted a demigod was especially unbelievable in the eyes of the Sun God Phoenix.
At this moment, what was even more unbelievable was that Shi Yu wasn’t even at the legendary level, but a level-eight Beast Tamer, just like its daughter.
Although its daughter, Huang Xi, could also contract totems above her level, that was because she was a hybrid. The bloodline of Beast Tamers and pets was similar. Moreover, even if she succeeded, she would only contract ordinary totem battle power above her level.
Contracting a totem demigod above his level was very ridiculous in the eyes of the Sun God Phoenix, a Phoenix Race Expert who had studied Beast Tamers very thoroughly.
Of course, this was only a temporary shock. Then, what shocked it even more was the contracted target Shi Yu summoned.
Almost instantly, the Divine Phoenix demigod felt its bloodline connection with it!!
It looked at the calm-looking Spirit Body Sword Maiden in front of it in shock and at the mini Phoenix clone on its shoulder. It suddenly said in disbelief, “You…”
“Wait, what’s going on?”
“Your bloodline… You’re Xi’er??”
This was the name it gave Mu Huiyin.
The Divine Phoenix half-god instantly determined that the person in front of him was the daughter, Huang Xi, who had perfectly inherited her bloodline among countless experimental subjects a thousand years ago!!
When it went to find the other party, the other party’s bloodline aura had clearly disappeared completely, but it didn’t expect to see it again here!
Although it had become a spirit body, it wouldn’t feel wrong about that bloodline power.
“Xi’er…” When the Sun God Phoenix saw Chi Tong’s state, it instantly knew that the other party’s experience must be very complicated.
It was understandable that he couldn’t find the other party at that time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1208 - 1208 Mother Hunting Group (2)
chapters.content:
1208 Mother Hunting Group (2)
“You know each other?”
At this moment, Shi Yu was also very “surprised”.
Seeing that the Divine Phoenix demigod was so excited, he couldn’t help but ask.
“This, this, this…” The Divine Phoenix half-god was more than excited. It sensed Chi Tong’s bloodline power that was only slightly inferior to Huang Xi and was extremely excited.
If it used Xi’er and Xi’er as nutrients, both of the Xi’s, wouldn’t it become a god 100%!!
Unfortunately, Xi’er had already been contracted by a human Beast Tamer, and this human was ridiculously strong. This was difficult for the Divine Phoenix demigod to accept and have a headache.
“It, it’s my daughter.”
The Sun God Phoenix didn’t care so much. With this relationship, even if it didn’t Devour its daughter, it wouldn’t be a loss to establish an ally with this human expert.
“Daughter??”
“Are you sure?”
Shi Yu emphasized.
The Sun God Phoenix said, “It should have sensed it. The power of its bloodline won’t lie!!”
“Good daughter, do you remember me? It’s me…”
Chi Tong was calm the whole time and didn’t react at all. After all, it already knew the true purpose of the “Undying Dark Phoenix” to create them.
“In other words, you’re its mother…” Shi Yu said.
The half-god of the Divine Phoenix surrounded by the orange-red Sun God Exort nodded excitedly and said, “It’s my daughter that I lost a thousand years ago. Daughter, Mother has looked for you so hard.”
“Spirit body, you actually turned into an undead. What exactly have you experienced all these years…”
“It’s my fault…”
The Sun God Phoenix acknowledged its kin excitedly, but suddenly, it felt that something was wrong.
From the moment it saw Shi Yu until this moment, every word Shi Yu had said quickly flashed through its mind.
Daughter, mother…
Shi Yu, Mother Hunter…
Huh?
The divine phoenix demigod’s language stopped. It looked at Shi Yu and the others and blinked. “What group did you just say you were?”
Shi Yu was silent.
Then, it said something that almost made the Sun God Phoenix’s heart explode.
Shi Yu grinned and said, “So you’re its mother. When I contracted it, I discovered something fishy about its bloodline power. This is a ‘nutritional bloodline’ that can be suppressed and absorbed by a higher-level bloodline. Therefore, at that time, I felt that its parents were definitely not good people.”
“It’s precisely because of this that the Mother Hunter Group was established. The goal is to help it solve its hidden danger one day.”
“Looks like that guy is you.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Chi Tong took a deep breath. Its red hair fluttered, and a red sword spirit condensed in its hand.
Little Chi Tong was very emotional now.
Shi Yu was finally not such a guy who went around acknowledging mothers…
From recognizing a mother to hunting a mother, this period represented the growth of their strength!
“Buzz!” Chi Tong summoned the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and locked onto the Phoenix demigod!
The Sword of Laws vibrated.
At this moment, the Sun God Phoenix was completely stunned. Its entire body felt like it had fallen into a ice cave.
Quasi-quasi-divine skill?
Another one?
Moreover, what stunned it even more was that Shi Yu suddenly shouted, “Princess Huang Xi, we formed an alliance just now. You’re also a member of Mother Hunter. If we don’t get rid of the hidden danger together now, when will we?”
In the distance, Princess Huang Xi was also quite shocked that her sister had actually mastered a quasi-divine skill.
Was it a demigod again?
Her expression turned cold as she gritted her teeth. This damn guy.
She had already said not to let him mess around.
He would listen to her own actions.
In the end, what was going on?
Why did it take action immediately after the alliance? How could it be so fast?
At this moment, she could be said to be completely unprepared.
Of course, the one who was least prepared at the moment, the most shocked and stunned, and the one who was shocked to the extreme was still the Divine Phoenix demigod.
Its brain couldn’t react for a moment.
Its heart skipped a beat.
Mother Hunter Group… Not only did it hunt this mother, but she was also a member of the group and its current daughter?
It looked at Shi Yu and the others in confusion and shock, as well as its daughter, Feng Xi, whose expression suddenly changed in the distance. For a moment, what Shi Yu had just said repeated endlessly in its heart.
She completely didn’t expect his plan to be exposed. Even his two daughters had already met in advance.
“What nonsense are you talking about!!! Xi’er, don’t tell me you believe his nonsense!!!”
The Sun God Phoenix immediately panicked, but what made it even more panicked was that many summoning arrays suddenly appeared in all directions.
“Roar!!!” The huge Green Dragon Buggy that flew out of the array and occupied the sky had supreme might in its dragon eyes.
The super battleship that looked like a city in the sky slowly revealed itself.
The Water Slime condensed in midair enlarged infinitely, turning into a Devouring Demon King with its huge mouth open.
There was also Baby Ginseng, who walked out of the summoning array and gradually turned into a World Tree.
Buzz!!!
Ling’s Blessing Wind, Susu’s Sea Cleansing Contract, Baby Ginseng’s world kindness, Chi Tong’s Immortal Slaying Sword Formation, Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone, and the Green Dragon Buggy’s Four Holy Domain. The pressure of two faith skills immediately rose.
It directly stunned the Sun God Phoenix again, feeling that it was dreaming.
What was going on?
This guy summoned a group of something messed up.
“Impossible, impossible, impossible!!!” As the sound of multiple laws resounded, the power of faith spread. The Sun God Phoenix didn’t even have time to determine that Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Ling, and the others weren’t demigods at all before it was suddenly stunned by this pile of laws.
In the stereotype, mastering a quasi-divine skill was a demigod.

chapters.title: Chapter 1209 - 1209 Mother Hunting Group (3)
chapters.content:
1209 Mother Hunting Group (3)
Shi Yu summoned four demigods at once. Who could withstand this?
“What kind of monster is this guy!”
The future empress was also shocked by this shocking lineup. Seeing that the ginseng baby that defeated the Quas Phoenix had become another world tree and emitted the sound of laws, as well as seeing equally terrifying companions beside it, she almost stopped thinking.
“Xi’er!!! Help me!!!” At this moment, the Sun God Phoenix could be said to be completely afraid.
It was a little regretful that it didn’t help the Golden Roc demigod deal with Shi Yu just now. If it were at that time, it could at least have gotten a demigod ally. In the end, there was only one daughter left.
In fact, even this daughter might not be able to stand on its side.
However, it could only give it a try now.
“Xi’er!!! Do you believe me or an outsider!!”
At this moment, Princess Huang Xi’s expression kept changing. In the end, her aura began to climb steadily.
Boom!!!
Eight huge golden summoning arrays, representing legendary symbols, appeared around her.
Just as Huang Xi had said, she could break through at any time. However, she had yet to make up her mind to fall out with the Sun God Phoenix.
At this moment, seeing Shi Yu’s strong lineup, she knew that she had to express something.
“Jiu!!!!” Apart from the future empress, its many overlord-level Phoenixes also broke through to the totem level the moment they descended and achieved the achievement of all totems.
The Divine Phoenix demigod was shocked. Legendary level?
“What a joke. Who are you?” However, in the face of the Sun God Phoenix’s request for help, the empress said.
It almost made the Divine Phoenix half-god’s vision go dark and his heart attack kill him.
“From the day I learned of your ambition, you were no longer my mother. Moreover, when I was weak, you had never fulfilled your obligations as a mother. In the end, we mixed-blood Beast Tamers are only human experimental subjects you injected with the Phoenix bloodline.”
Divine Phoenix Demigod: “?”
“Ahhh, unfilial daughter!!!” At this moment, the Divine Phoenix demigod’s mentality completely collapsed. Its eyes widened, and its aura erupted.
She understood what the so-called Mother Hunter combination was…
On the other side, it was just about to call the domestic totems to help when it suddenly realized that it was already trapped in a completely sealed barrier.
The entire Du Ling Mountain Range was enveloped by a huge barrier. The phantoms of the Green Dragon, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and White Tiger guarded the four directions of the barrier, extremely shocked.
“Happy cooperation.” Shi Yu retreated to the empress’s side and stood beside her with a smile.
“I…” At this moment, the empress couldn’t say anything. She felt that she was completely pushed by this guy.
She hoped that this guy was really a good person.
….
In the past space and time, in the empress dynasty, Shi Yu held hands with the future empress and directly started a mother hunt in the Du Ling Mountain Range.
A day later.
The entire Phoenix Empire was shocked.
The half-god of the Divine Phoenix died and “died accidentally”. Princess Huang Xi, who had the most orthodox bloodline of the half-god of the Divine Phoenix, succeeded the throne and was titled empress to take over the Phoenix Empire.
For a moment, the entire Phoenix Empire fell into bad news. Countless Phoenix Race members couldn’t believe it, and many Phoenix Race totems couldn’t accept Princess Huang Xi directly succeeding the throne. This was because the death of the Divine Phoenix half-god was too strange, but they were suppressed by the empress’s eight totem-level Phoenixes.
The empress directly displayed the strongest battle power of the Phoenix Empire.
In addition, over the years, the empress had also secretly cultivated her trusted aides, including the Phoenix pets beside her. They had been raised by her since she was young. Their subsequent races also directly became her help to ascend the throne.
At this moment, the culprit who directly changed the Phoenix Empire’s fate had already arrived at the Phoenix Empire’s national treasury.
“Sigh, you were pretty ruthless when you fought. In the end, you still couldn’t bear to be ruthless.” When he entered the country’s mystic realm, Shi Yu couldn’t help but complain about the empress.
After a battle, they only killed the Divine Phoenix half-god once. After it revived through the Undying Fruit, just like in history, the empress chose to seal its undead in a Legendary ruin.
As for the demigod corpse, it was also taken away by the empress. As for Shi Yu, he could freely take all the resources in the Phoenix Empire according to the agreement.
After witnessing Shi Yu’s strength, it was impossible for the empress to regret it. After all, the ones who could win this battle despite her bloodline being suppressed were mainly Shi Yu and the others.
This also meant that she didn’t have the strength to regret it in front of Shi Yu.
She was forced to ascend the throne the whole time.
It even made the empress feel that she was a puppet empress.
“I wonder how the Mother Feng that Teacher Cat is watching is doing. If it knew that it was being hunted jointly before it even attacked in another space-time, what would its expression be…”
When he entered the country, Shi Yu sighed. Before he transmigrated, he sealed the Undying Dark Phoenix in the original space and time and threw it to the gem cat to watch. After all, bringing an additional totem to transmigrate consumed more energy. He tried his best not to bring a burden.
However, the Undying Dark Phoenix in the original space-time was a burden, but its memories were good things.
According to the memories of the Undying Dark Phoenix, at this time, the Phoenix Empire had yet to fall into war all year round. Most of the resources of the Phoenix Empire were still stored in the mystic realm of the Ancient Capital Phoenix City and had not been transferred away by the Undying Dark Phoenix.
For example, the Undying Fruit and the Sun Flame Flower were still here.
Under normal circumstances, only the Undying Dark Phoenix and its trusted aides could open the Phoenix Empire’s treasury. However, Shi Yu and the others had obtained the opening method from the Undying Dark Phoenix “in person”.
“Alright, I’m in!”
Boom.
Space trembled.
Shi Yu and the others entered the Empire mystic realm together.
“Wuu…” “Wu…” “Yi!” “Mi…” “Ning…” “Mm!”
Under the hard work of Shi Yu and the others, they directly entered the Phoenix Empire’s national treasury at the most chaotic moment. Beside Shi Yu were hungry pets.
Especially Eleven. It had clearly just finished eating a Legendary resource, but it was still hungry after fighting two demigods consecutively as the main force.
It wanted to see how many good things… were in the Phoenix Empire’s national treasury!!
After entering the huge national treasury, Shi Yu directly swept the entire map with his Psychic power. Then, he was pleasantly surprised.
“Six legendary resources, three Sun Flame Flowers that contain the power of the sun. The other three are all heart crystals of the totem-level Phoenix Race. They are respectively wind, light, and Quas…”
“A divine-level resource is the Undying Fruit.”
“It’s alright, it’s alright. Although there aren’t many high-level resources, resources below level eight involve various Stats and types. This time, even if we only take a small portion, you can all have a full meal in the short term.”
“It’s mainly this Undying Fruit!!!”
After Shi Yu entered, he looked at an Undying Fruit sealed on a mountain in this mystic realm that was like the Phoenix Mountain Range.
It was the one he had eaten!
Shi Yu looked at the pet beside him.
“I’ve already eaten one. This, who wants to eat it???”
“Wu wu wu.”
Many pets suddenly looked at Baby Ginseng.
Baby Ginseng was stunned. It stretched out its white finger and pointed at itself.
The pets nodded.
A fruit that could only be used to its greatest effect after dying once…
It must be a ginseng baby that could easily revive even if it died. In exchange, it just had to cook more usually. He just didn’t know what Baby Ginseng would become after eating the Undying Fruit…

chapters.title: Chapter 1210 - 1210 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (1)
chapters.content:
1210 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (1)
“Ling, bring everyone to move the resources first.”
“Remember, only take those that are useful to us…”
“If it’s not that useful. Leave it for the empress.”
“After all, we’re not bandits…”
In the Phoenix Empire’s national treasury, Shi Yu waved his hand and had already gotten his pets to move.
However, Shi Yu’s words made things very difficult for everyone.
The members of the team involved various Stats. There was more than one rare time-element pet. Basically, they could use any resource.
Didn’t that mean that they would all move away?
“Take it according to what I say!” Ling sighed. This job was clearly given to it by Shi Yu.
This involved a utilization rate and cost-effective ratio.
Shi Yu probably couldn’t be bothered to take a look or think about it. He could only let it do it.
“Undying Fruit, take it away first.”
“Three Sun Flame Flowers, two.”
“Three Phoenix Crystals, take one wind-element one.”
“Resources below the legendary level are mainly edible.”
The huge national treasury was wreaked by Shi Yu and the others. Soon, everything Shi Yu and the others needed was packed and taken away.
Shi Yu smiled and walked out of the country with a group of bandits.
In midair outside.
Her green clothes fluttered in the wind. The empress, who was in the air, fell silent when she saw Shi Yu come out.
After Shi Yu and the others came out, they looked up at the empress. Shi Yu scratched his cheek and said, “You’re so worried about us, and you even came to supervise us amidst your busy schedule. Look, I really only took a portion.”
“Is this enough?” the empress said. “You can take some more.”
If you only take so little, I won’t inherit this country steadily…
Before Shi Yu went to the national treasury, Empress Huang Xi was already prepared to spend a lot.
She had already forcefully convinced herself that if she didn’t have Shi Yu’s help and changed the dynasty herself, the Phoenix Empire’s resources would only be consumed more.
It could be said that she was already mentally prepared for Shi Yu to take away all the divine and legendary resources.
However, to the empress’s surprise, Shi Yu still kept three Legendary resources. He only took less than a fifth of the resources below the legendary level.
Although from the perspective of an Empire, this was already a very large resource, Shi Yu actually had the strength to take it all away. She was helpless to resist. It was beyond the empress’s expectations to only take so little.
After all, from the start, Shi Yu had been complaining that he only wanted resources and was completely after resources.
“Don’t think so badly of us. This is enough. You still need these resources for the next development of the Dong Huang Dynasty.” Shi Yu chuckled and said, “Moreover, after taking these resources, we won’t let you suffer.”
“Next, you’ll confer me as the Diplomacy Ambassador of the Dong Huang Dynasty. I’ll help you solve the hidden danger of the Phoenix Race on Phoenix Island. How about that? These resources will be your reward.”
“I’ll try to persuade the pure-blooded Phoenix Race to become Dong Huang’s ally. At that time, we can avoid a battle and save a lot of resources.”
“Wuu!” Eleven and the others expressed that they were good people.
Using these resources was purely out of helplessness. His family really couldn’t afford it.
These were all life-saving rice. Apart from high-level resources, low-level resources definitely didn’t take any extra needles or threads. They only took what could be eaten!
Shi Yu had also calculated that in the orthodox history, when the empress and the Undying Dark Phoenix fell out, the Undying Dark Phoenix did not leave much resources for the empress’s Dong Huang Dynasty.
For example, the Undying Fruit and the Sun Flame Flower had already been moved away by the Undying Dark Phoenix in advance.
Low-level resources had also been consumed most of them in the battle between the Phoenix Empire and Phoenix Island.
Therefore, Shi Yu leaving these things behind was already very luxurious. It could definitely make the empress dynasty live more comfortably than the original history.
Apart from that, he happened to be going to Phoenix Island. If it went smoothly, he could also save the empress dynasty from a battle. He wouldn’t have to exhaust his luck so quickly and destroy the country.
It could be said that this empress space-time was also about to walk out of a completely different history.
“Impossible.” At this moment, Empress Huang Xi already trusted and had a better impression of Shi Yu. She landed beside Shi Yu and said, “Even if it’s her biological sister, that Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod didn’t show any mercy and exiled it out of the island.”
“The current Phoenix Empire will definitely be a thorn in that Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod’s side…”
“If it weren’t for the special geographical location of the Phoenix Empire, which is in the center of many totem countries, Phoenix Island would have already started a war with this side. Even if it hasn’t completely started a war, there have always been small-scale friction.”
“This battle is inevitable. The conflict between pure-blooded and hybrids is impossible to mediate with the Phoenix Race.”
Shi Yu said, “Don’t worry…”
“Shi Yu, stay. Let’s strengthen the Dong Huang Dynasty together. With you around, even if we start a war, Dong Huang won’t be afraid of Phoenix Island.” Feng Xi looked at Shi Yu and invited, “Apart from this country, I can give you anything else you want. As long as this country can develop according to my wishes.”
Shi Yu was stunned. He shook his head and said, “Sorry, I previously said that I wouldn’t stay here for long.”
“However, I believe you can also manage Dong Huang well yourself.”
Empress Huang Xi was silent. Was it still not enough?
[We’ll help Dong Huang deal with the hidden danger of Phoenix Island.] Chi Tong also wanted to help its sister, but unfortunately, they didn’t have much time left in this space and time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1211 - 1211 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (2)
chapters.content:
1211 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (2)
“Don’t worry, there’s no conflict that can’t be mediated. As long as everything’s is in place…” Shi Yu said.
The empress: “Huh?”
“As long as your emotions are sincere and your attitude is sincere, anything is possible.”
“Actually, Mother is right,” Shi Yu said.
The empress’s face darkened. Why did he call her mother more smoothly than her? Was this a Mother Hunter Beast Tamer?
“Do you know why the Mythical Era ended?” Shi Yu smiled.
“Do you know the origin of humans and what mission they shoulder?”
Shi Yu smiled. At this place, he explained to the empress the reason for the end of the Mythical Era. He told her about the reason why Goddess Wa brought back the Human Seed and wanted the World Tree to nurture humans. He also told her about the time of the future Mythical Revival.
Shocking secrets made Empress Huang Xi open her mouth slightly in disbelief. She had forgotten her original goal in coming here.
“Therefore, humans are indeed a special race. Researching hybrids with humans might really be able to develop a path to become a god or even surpass the divine level. After all, we humans are a special race recognized by even supreme gods,” Shi Yu said.
“It’s very likely that it originated from a higher civilization in the depths of the universe.”
“What exactly are you…” The empress wanted to ask who Shi Yu was and why he knew so many unimaginable things.
However, in the next moment, he was interrupted by Shi Yu. Shi Yu continued, “Therefore, the Vermillion Bird Demigod of Phoenix Island can choose not to give face to your sister, but it has to give face to the world’s will, right?”
“To put it bluntly, the clan rules were only set by the ancestor of the Phoenix Race, but even the ancestor of the Phoenix Race is only a life born on Blue Planet.”
“On a larger scale, Blue Planet’s mother is the greatest… It’s not too much to change the rules of the Phoenix Race, right? Phoenixes are dead, but the rules of the race are alive.”
The empress: “?”
She looked stunned. She kept feeling that something was wrong.
However, why did Shi Yu call Blue Planet Mom… They seemed to be very familiar with each other. Moreover, was it really alright for him to call her by that combination name?
She raised her head slightly. The Blue Planet’s Will was called Heaven in ancient times.
She was very afraid that a heavenly tribulation would strike down and kill Shi Yu…
“Stop looking. The Blue Planet’s Will is sleeping.”
“Let’s go. I’ll go to Phoenix Island myself. You stay here and deal with the mess here first,” Shi Yu said.
With that said, Shi Yu slipped away, mainly because he couldn’t wait to let Baby Ginseng eat the Undying Fruit to see the effect.
Of course, although Shi Yu had left, Chi Tong stayed behind to see if there was anything it could help with.
Seeing that Shi Yu left without any reluctance, leaving Chi Tong behind, the empress was speechless. She looked at this “sister”.
“So… why exactly are you helping me?” The empress looked at Sword Maiden Chi Tong and felt a headache.
[Call me sister,] Chi Tong said.
The empress was stunned and said with difficulty, “Alright, Sister, can you tell me now?”
Chi Tong: “Guess for yourself.”
The empress: “?”
Chi Tong raised its chin. Even Emperor Wu could tell, but it couldn’t? No, stupid sister, guess for yourself!
…
In the Blue Sea Ruins.
Shi Yu and the others jogged back.
At this moment, he had obtained another pile of resources. For Shi Yu, training pets was the most important thing. For Eleven and the others, the most important thing was to eat after the battle.
The half-god of the Divine Phoenix was simply too difficult to hammer. The difficulty was even higher than Yun An. Not only did it eat the Undying Fruit, but it also had a transcendent-level Bathing Flame Rebirth. Eleven and the others spent a lot of effort.
“Wuuu!” Eleven ran to nibble on the metal.
“Wuu ka ka ka.” Buggy nibbled on the spiritual fruit.
“Ning.” Susu looked at them speechlessly and turned into a quiet beautiful girl. It continued to devour the power of the ocean in big mouthfuls, saving Shi Yu a lot of effort.
At this moment, Shi Yu weighed the Undying Fruit and looked at Baby Ginseng. He asked Ling, “After this thing eats it, will it immediately break through?”
Ling said, “No, the Undying Fruit isn’t a strengthening-type divine-level resource. However, Baby Ginseng is on the verge of breaking through after all. When eating it, it still needs it to suppress the increase in soul power and transform it into potential. Fortunately, its soul power isn’t its outstanding point. It’s fine to use it now.”
“Baby Ginseng, did you hear that?” Shi Yu said.
“Yi wu wu wu!” Baby Ginseng nodded.
It wasn’t a big deal, a token.
Its Green Wood Divine Body had the effect of a mutation. It had a super mutation physique. Coupled with the control of the plant, it was not a problem to perfectly absorb a divine-level fruit!
“Alright, alright, come on then.” Shi Yu threw the Undying Fruit to Baby Ginseng. Baby Ginseng didn’t say a word. It enlarged its mouth and ate the Undying Fruit in one bite.
In the next second, in order to better absorb the power of the Undying Fruit, Baby Ginseng returned to its normal state from the form of a big white radish to the form of a huge tree.
A huge cream-colored trunk, emerald green leaves, moon-like golden branches, sun-like fiery red flowers, fruits that looked like ginseng babies, decorated this complete divine tree.
A gray soul halo lingered on the entire divine tree, and the entire huge tree began to slowly change.
Apart from the nature of reviving dead lives into undead, the Undying Fruit also had the nature of strengthening soul power. These two processes were both modifications to the body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1212 - 1212 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (3)
chapters.content:
1212 When Baby Ginseng Eats the Undying Fruit (3)
In Shi Yu’s team, apart from Chi Tong and Shi Yu, the other life forms didn’t mainly cultivate soul power. It was the same for Baby Ginseng. At this moment, eating the Undying Fruit was undoubtedly an epic strengthening of its soul power.
“Yi Na!!!” The World Tree Ginseng shouted, trying its best to digest the power of the Undying Fruit. One second, two seconds…
A moment later, under the pleasantly surprised gazes of Shi Yu and Ling, Baby Ginseng actually completed a small scale evolution. Just like the Nine Li Battle Beast carving a Normal inscription, it awakened a new Race Skill. Its form didn’t change drastically.
If one had to say, there was. On Baby Ginseng’s huge normal tree, there was a pile of fruits that Baby Ginseng could create. Time Fruit, World Tree Fruit… At this moment, there was another one, a gray Soul Fruit that looked like a honeydew!
< Name > Soul Fruit
[Stats]: Wood, Undead
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It’s a fruit that can increase the soul power of the eater and repair the damage to the eater’s soul. If developed to the extreme, it can allow the eater to live a second life in the form of a soul.
“Ling, Ling, do you sense it!” Shi Yu excitedly pulled Ling, who had a look of disdain beside him.
It had actually awakened a supplement skill related to soul power!
As the team’s healer, the most powerful thing about Baby Ginseng was actually still healing and replenishing blood, which was to replenish life force and physical fitness.
This also led to the Effect being the best when it treated Eleven and Buggy. When it healed Chi Tong, Ling, and Susu, the Effect was inferior.
It wasn’t that Shi Yu had never thought of replicating some supplement skills that specialized in dealing with soul power, but they were too rare. In addition, it wasn’t that Baby Ginseng couldn’t heal souls, but it wasn’t as expert as repairing life. Moreover, Chi Tong had also mastered soul repair skills, so Shi Yu found it troublesome and didn’t look for it seriously.
