At the moment, Baby Ginseng eating the Undying Fruit and modifying itself through the Green Wood Divine Body and plant control had immediately made up for Shi Yu’s team’s shortcomings in this aspect. No, it wasn’t a shortcoming either. It was just that now, it had been strengthened even more!
Moreover, the most important thing was that Baby Ginseng’s Soul Fruit had inherited the final nature of the Undying Fruit. In the future, it had a chance of mass-producing divine-level resources like the Undying Fruit!
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng was excited. As expected of it.
This way, the name of its previous evolution, the Undying Ginseng, lived up to its name.
As long as it studied this skill thoroughly, it could completely have multiple modes!
In its normal state, it would fight directly. If it couldn’t defeat the enemy, it would self-destruct!
However, Baby Ginseng also understood that even if it self-destructed at the demigod level, it would be very difficult to blow up that pile of monster demigods…
For example, Eleven’s transcendent-level Indestructible Golden Body, the Nine Li Army, and a bunch of physique skills weren’t for show.
Now that Eleven was facing self-destruction head-on, it wasn’t afraid. It was the same even if Baby Ginseng broke through to a demigod.
Baby Ginseng could be said to not even have the confidence to heavily injure Eleven.
However, this wasn’t the first time it self-destructed. After the self-destruction ended, it revived and the Undead Ginseng self-destructed for the second time!
Right on the heels of that, the time mark revived. Baby Ginseng was another hero.
This wasn’t the end. At the moment, a perfect-level time mark could only condense one time mark.
However, a transcendent-level time mark could already condense a second mark.
In other words…
When Baby Ginseng reached the demigod level and its Soul Fruit was maxed out, its time mark would upgrade and it could self-destruct four times in a row!
Quadruple Explosion!
Even if it self-destructed once and didn’t kill demigods of the same level, what about four times?
Not to mention demigods, even if it was a primary-level god, Baby Ginseng felt that it wasn’t impossible to kill someone above its level.
If he cultivated Moon Explosion, Time Mark, and Soul Fruit into quasi-divine skills and added three quasi-divine skills to his body, Baby Ginseng felt that the position of the strongest demigod of the Blue Sea Sprite should change hands.
What was the combination of the strongest Skill?
Baby Ginseng was the first clear in the team!
The overlords and totem first clear in the team were all maintained in Baby Ginseng’s hands. At this moment, Baby Ginseng smiled foolishly, feeling that the divine level was also its.
It had already named this combination profundity.
It was called the Death Quartet!
“Yiya!” Baby Ginseng gave Shi Yu and the others a thumbs up. Giving the Undying Fruit to it to eat was really a clear choice.
“Indeed.” Shi Yu was also excited. “This way, I won’t have to trouble Qi to transmigrate to other parallel spaces to get the Undying Fruit. In the future, I’ll directly let you create it in batches.”
“Eleven, Buggy, even Duckie, Teacher Gem Cat. When the time comes, we’ll each have one. There are even more and more types of gifts for the new year.”
Baby Ginseng exclaimed and was completely stunned. Wait, damn it, only then did it react. The Soul Fruit was another supplement skill that the entire team could eat!! Its vision darkened and it felt a little weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 1213 - 1213 Making Things Up (1)
chapters.content:
1213 Making Things Up (1)
Shi Yu and the others recuperated in the Phoenix Empire for a day.
The resources he obtained should be eaten and drunk. He wanted to recover to his peak state as soon as possible.
When it was about time, Shi Yu and the others didn’t delay. They directly headed to Phoenix Island as envoys of the Phoenix Empire.
…
Phoenix Island was located in the southern sea area of the Dong Huang Continent, covering hundreds of thousands of square kilometers.
Unfortunately, it had completely disappeared after the end of the empress dynasty and was sunk by the battle between the empress and the Phoenix Race’s patriarch.
This time, Shi Yu could be considered to have studied the sunken civilization on the ground.
In the sky, a huge battleship flew. Shi Yu enjoyed the beauty of the sky with Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Little Ji, Duckie, and the others.
After arriving above Phoenix Island, Shi Yu, Eleven, and the others looked at each other, wondering how to call the Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod out next.
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven sensed that the natural energy here was abundant and took the initiative to volunteer. It climbed onto the railing and stood there.
“Eleven? Alright.”
“Wuu!”
Shi Yu signaled. Eleven immediately nodded and roared down.
Boom!!!
A deafening sound immediately spread throughout the entire Phoenix Island, making many creatures look up at the sky in shock.
Dark clouds instantly appeared on the island. The sky was pitch-black, and black lightning was Blinking. The thunder was deafening!
Then, white lightning streaked across the sky again. The condensation level made the thunderclouds turn into lightning pools. The thunderclaps didn’t stop, and the sky turned from dark to bright. Black and white lightning intertwined, as if Doomsday had descended.
The huge sound of lightning wrapped around the power of a demigod. It was as if a heavenly tribulation had descended, making all the lives on Phoenix Island look at the phenomenon condensed in the sky in horror.
“Where’s the Phoenix Race Patriarch?”
The thunderclap turned into a mental wave that resounded in the heart of the high-level life form.
“Who is it!”
In the Phoenix Race, the half-sleeping Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod was awakened and sensed an especially terrifying demigod power.
Its strength… might not be inferior to it!
It let out a cry and tore through the air, flying into the sky. On the island, the Phoenixes at the totem level also flew into the sky together to find the source of the phenomenon.
This power of lightning was too terrifying, enough to carpet bombard Phoenix Island. At that time, all lives below the totem level would probably die from the lightning. He had to figure out the source!
When a totem half-god and eleven Normal and top-notch totem phoenixes arrived in the sky, they were directly shocked by the scene in front of them.
A black and white bear more than a meter tall was bathing in the lightning sea. It seemed to have released the lightning, but it mobilized the lightning and triggered stronger lightning in the world. It seemed to have another goal!
It was eating!
Many Phoenixes saw that this black and white bear was devouring the natural power of lightning condensed around Devour in big mouthfuls. Among the eleven totem phoenixes, a thunder-element phoenix was shocked and said,
“Stop!! Stop it! If this continues, the natural lightning on Phoenix Island will be eaten!”
“At that time, Phoenix Island will become a country that loses lightning.”
“Wuu!” On the other side, Eleven’s deterrence shook the sky and earth like a thunder god. When it heard the shout from the other side, it revealed a disdainful expression and immediately stopped eating. Petty person, what was wrong with eating some of your lightning?
This Phoenix Island was indeed a treasure land. The quality of the surrounding natural energy was very high, far exceeding any country Shi Yu had been to. When Eleven came, it immediately didn’t want to leave. It felt that it could be full for a long time just by eating natural lightning here.
“The current patriarch of the Phoenix Race!” Eleven returned to Shi Yu’s side and Shi Yu shouted. At this moment, many Phoenixes, the current patriarch of the Phoenix Race, and the sister of the Undying Dark Phoenix looked at Shi Yu and the others solemnly because the power Eleven displayed was too strong.
However, from the looks of it… that human was the leader.
Shi Yu faced the many Phoenixes and slowly said,
“I’ve been jointly entrusted by the seven gods of the Blue Planet’s Will, the Boar God of the Mythical Era, Xuan Ming, the Holy Divine Deer, Lord Lie Shan, the Demon King Dragon, the Eternal Divine Tree, and the Ancient God Golden Bull to mediate the conflict between your race and the human race and take away your race’s super resources.”
Shi Yu stood on the battleship with his hands behind his back. He looked calmly at the totem half-god in front of him, the Phoenix Race Patriarch.
3.8 billion energy points!
This was the guy with the highest normal energy value Shi Yu had ever seen, even higher than Eleven. As expected of the Phoenix Race Leader who had lived for thousands of years and had always steadily suppressed the Undying Dark Phoenix. At the same time, it had mastered quasi-divine skills and faith skills.
It had probably eaten a lot of divine-level resources… There was even a pile for Undying Dark Phoenix, so the other party definitely had more.
However, no matter how impressive the other party was, Shi Yu’s aura was also very strong this time.
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, the red divine bird was clearly stunned. Then, it revealed an extremely ridiculous expression.
Huh???
It wasn’t the only one. All the Phoenix Race was stunned.
Adjust the conflict between the Phoenix Race and the human race?
What a joke. What conflict did their Phoenix Race have with humans?
On Phoenix Island, the humans lived in peace and enjoyed longevity. They were the happiest batch of humans on Blue Planet. Their Phoenix Race had also always been known as auspicious totems. They were loved by all races, including humans. Shi Yu’s entire story was nonsense!
Also, take away the super resources of the Phoenix Race?
What a joke. How could a human like Shi Yu take away something left behind by his ancestor when exploring the starry sky just like that?
He was even entrusted by the Blue Planet’s Will, the World Tree, and the seven gods of the Mythical Era. Who was this Poof!

chapters.title: Chapter 1214 - 1214 Making Things Up (2)
chapters.content:
1214 Making Things Up (2)
“Hahahahahaha…” After the current patriarch of the Phoenix Race, the Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod, heard this, he even threw his head back and laughed. He was stunned by this funny joke and laughed and cursed,” Sir, you didn’t come to my Phoenix Race to tell a joke, right? ”
If it weren’t for the fact that the black and white bear was a demigod, they would have long attacked together.
“You don’t believe me?” Shi Yu’s expression was still very calm. He closed his eyes slightly and opened them!
Boom!!
As Shi Yu opened his eyes, his eyes turned emerald green.
The air around him began to hum and vibrate. The almost corporeal mental fluctuations formed green ripples around him.
In the next moment, Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun. A strong aura bloomed from his body, and with him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
In the domain, the phantom of a huge tree that was infinitely tall emitted a faint golden light. It stood behind Shi Yu, revealing a miracle.
In the mind domain, the World Tree Domain changed the form of the World Tree!
After undergoing the strengthened Blessing of the World Tree, because Shi Yu had the mind domain and had eaten the World Tree Fruit, he had another ability that other Blessers didn’t have, which was to reveal the will of the World Tree.
Although it also consumed a lot of physical strength and didn’t have any battle enhancement effect, Shi Yu felt that sometimes, this ability was not bad. It was equivalent to an identity verification.
As the envoy of the World Tree, Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog could ignore him, but he, a native life form of Blue Planet, couldn’t ignore it, right?
The phantom of the huge world tree that reached the sky was filled with a golden light. The light from the sky made Shi Yu even more dazzling, emitting an aura that was not inferior to totems, like the Juggernaut of the world.
Endless light fell like a meteor shower and landed on Shi Yu’s body, as well as the pet bodies beside Shi Yu.
The power of the world in all directions submitted to Shi Yu, producing a huge affinity. Shi Yu glanced at it and moved. At this moment, it was as if he could obtain the favor of Blue Planet. Many totem phoenixes, at their level, could see with their own eyes that the endless power of the world acted coquettishly beside Shi Yu as if they had seen their father. Shi Yu, this human, seemed to be able to casually touch the laws of this world!
How could this be… Many Phoenixes were shocked. What was this?
Boom!
Under the shocked expressions of the Phoenixes, the ginseng baby beside Shi Yu’s feet yawned and also opened its green eyes. A World Tree Fruit condensed on the tip of its finger. First, it activated the favor of the quasi-divine skill world, then the World Tree Fruit. Similarly, the power that represented the Resistance of the World Tree spread on its body!
“Quasi-divine skill!”
The Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod and the Phoenixes were immediately shocked. Wasn’t that a ginseng baby? A trash supplement that the Phoenix couldn’t even be bothered to eat. However, how could a ginseng baby master a quasi-divine skill? Moreover, this quasi-divine skill… could actually mobilize the power of the entire world!
“Isn’t that the World Tree Fruit!!” The Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod was shocked and saw the fruit created by Baby Ginseng.
Perhaps the other races didn’t know, but in the Phoenix Race, because it originated from the Mythical Era like the dragons, it had a long history and had records of some rare resources. Among them, the fruit of the World Tree was one of them.
“Is this enough to verify my identity?” Under the blessing of the World Tree, Shi Yu said, “This is the authentication the World Tree gave me. Seeing me is like seeing her.”
“Apart from that, my ginseng baby has also received the blessings of the World Tree. It can be considered to have completed its evolution under the love of the World Tree and inherited the power of the World Tree.”
“If this isn’t enough and you still can’t trust me.” Shi Yu knocked his forehead helplessly. Beside it, Eleven took a step forward and revealed the might of a demigod. The quasi-divine skill entered a ready state and triggered the sound of laws!
Buzz!!
Black and white colors lingered around it. In an instant, two sounds of laws vibrated and resounded through the sky. It was extremely shocking, making the eleven totem phoenixes feel an incomparably strong bloodline suppression and widen their eyes.
Apart from that, this wasn’t the end. The wind of luck lingered around Ling, who had turned into a battleship. The sound of laws was triggered again, three sounds of laws!
Chi Tong, who was in the form of an energy-efficient loli Sword Maiden, stretched out its finger slightly. Four small swords lingered on its fingertip, and the four sounds of laws were triggered!
“Roar!!!” “Quack!!!” Little Ji and Duckie took a step forward. The Cataclysm and the Heart of the Abyss were directly released!!
It was like the sound of laws of an earthquake and a heartbeat!
Five, six… The sound of laws rose crazily and intertwined, almost collapsing the Void, making the world dark. It was filled with the low whispers of gods and demons, making the Phoenix Race Patriarch sweat profusely and extremely shocked.
The other totem Phoenixes didn’t even fight. Under the collective aura of Shi Yu, their bodies were so weak that they couldn’t move. They were completely stunned.
How was this possible!! They suspected that they were dreaming!!!
“Retract.” Then, it was such a terrifying scene. Under Shi Yu’s command, the pets collectively retracted. Shi Yu said, “This way, can you believe my identity?”
“Don’t tell me you think that apart from the envoys of the World Tree and the humans chosen by the gods, there are other humans who can nurture so many terrifying pets and obtain the certification of the world’s will?”
“Alright, my patience has reached its limit,” Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1215 - 1215 Making Things Up (3)
chapters.content:
1215 Making Things Up (3)
“I couldn’t confirm your identity just now. I was rude. Please forgive me.” Opposite Shi Yu, the Phoenix Race Patriarch directly restrained her aura and said in shock with rapid breathing.
At this moment, it completely believed it. After all, this ridiculous lineup really made it very difficult for it not to believe.
“This, this, this, this…” The other totem Phoenixes were also shocked. The envoy of the World Tree had come looking for them.
What was wrong with their Phoenix Race?
With such a terrifying lineup, at least six quasi-divine skills were enough to easily destroy the Phoenix Race!
Moreover, there were also a few harmless-looking pets that didn’t show their strength at all!
“It’s alright. It’s normal not to believe it easily. The World Tree only shared her power with me because it considered the specialness of this identity,” Shi Yu said. “Since you believe it now, you can sit down and talk.”
“I’m here for a total of two things…”
The Phoenix Race’s patriarch was silent. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “Lord Envoy, we’re helpless in your request. There are indeed super-divine resources in the Phoenix Race, but we can’t take them out at all.”
“Moreover, I wonder what’s the use of this resource, Lord.”
Shi Yu said, “I know.”
“But this resource is very important. It’s an item Lord World Tree specified to obtain.”
“In the Mythical Era, the three cosmic races invaded Blue Planet. Countless gods died in battle, and Blue Planet shattered. Although we finally won, those invading races weren’t completely destroyed. Instead, they escaped back to the starry sky.”
“At that time, Blue Planet was no longer suitable for gods to live in, so under Blue Planet’s suggestion, they went to the starry sky to find a new home. Apart from that, they had another mission, which was to go deep into the universe and investigate those invaders.”
“The super-divine resources brought back by your race are very likely to be an important item and some kind of news. Therefore, this thing is very likely to affect the future, life, and death of Blue Planet. This is also why the World Tree asked me to take it away.”
The Phoenix Race’s patriarch and a bunch of totem Phoenixes listened to Shi Yu in a daze.
Shi Yu was not done speaking. “The future of Blue Planet is filled with misfortune. That divine-level Phoenix that returned from the starry sky and brought back super-divine resources is actually not the first god to bring the resources of the outside world back to Blue Planet.”
“Long before it, Goddess Wa, who was also a top-notch god and supreme god spirit like the Ancestral Dragon and the Origin Phoenix, brought back another resource.”
“It’s called Human.”
“Humans, a large race in the starry sky of the universe, aren’t native life forms of Blue Planet. However, later on, they were modified by the World Tree and became a member of Blue Planet. Human Beast Tamers are jointly regarded by many gods and even the World Tree as the hope of Blue Planet life forms to break through and surpass the divine level.”
“This is also why she chose me as an envoy.”
“My other Quests this time are to pass this news to the Leader of the human race and a Leader of a large race like the Phoenix Race. This is also convenient and better to welcome the future calamity of Blue Planet.”
“I know that the Phoenix Race has always treated humans well. This might also be because your ancestors received instructions from the World Tree.”
“Don’t worry, I’m prepared. I heard that the super resources brought back by that Senior Phoenix Divine Spirit are in a ruin and have set restrictions. Only those that contain the Phoenix bloodline can explore.”
“Apart from that, it’s difficult to take away that resource with the power of a demigod alone.”
“This is indeed not easy… Therefore, after receiving the order from the World Tree, I made targeted preparations. I’ve long contracted a pet with the Phoenix bloodline in the outside world. We can work together to try to crack the ruins.”
“If it can’t be cracked, forget it. Perhaps the time hasn’t come yet. Only when the Mythical Era descends again and breaks through to the divine level will there be hope.”
“If it’s successfully cracked, I can learn what information that senior brought back earlier and make targeted preparations.”
“Please assist me, especially you, the current patriarch of the Phoenix Race.”
At this moment, the Phoenix Race, who had learned many secrets from Shi Yu, was completely stunned.
Even the Vermillion Bird demigod had never learned so much explosive information at once.
However, throughout the whole process, Shi Yu’s pets were very silent. Was this the power of transmigrating to the past and getting bad information? They almost believed it!
Even with Ling’s top-notch intelligence, it couldn’t analyze anything wrong for a moment.
“This…” The Phoenix Race was also deceived by Shi Yu’s extremely complete statement.
“A pet with the bloodline of the Phoenix Race?” The Phoenix Race’s patriarch, the sister of the Undying Dark Phoenix, had a surprised expression.
“Yes.” Shi Yu looked at Chi Tong. At this moment, the loli Chi Tong had dispersed the Four Immortal Slaying Swords and the Phoenix clone slowly condensed on the tip of its finger.
The power of his bloodline erupted.
The powerful Phoenix bloodline from a demigod directly made all the Phoenixes present widen their eyes.
Among them, the Phoenix Race’s patriarch, the sister of the Undying Dark Phoenix, was even suddenly stunned. She looked at the spiritual body Chi Tong in disbelief and said, “This bloodline… is the Phoenix bloodline entrusted to humans?”
Then, it almost exploded.
“Calm down!!!” Shi Yu shouted. “Have you forgotten what I just said? I still have another goal, which is to mediate the conflict between you and humans. This conflict also includes the conflict between the pure-blooded Phoenix and the mixed-blood Phoenix.”
“Human hybrids are also a testable path discussed by all races and the World Tree back then. However, this path is very difficult. The Phoenix Race didn’t try it first, but it was carried out by the dragons with more domineering bloodlines first. Human and phoenix hybrids have never been rejected by the Phoenix Race. Your clan rules should have been updated long ago.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1216 - 1216 Making Things Up (4)
chapters.content:
1216 Making Things Up (4)
The Phoenix Race’s Patriarch and a group of totem phoenixes were in disbelief.
“The reason why I contracted it is also because it’s a hybrid of a human and a Phoenix. It was Lord World Tree who told me its location and thought that it had the potential to surpass the divine level. This is the advantage brought by the hybrid.”
“Of course, hybrids are dangerous. The chances of success are less. It’s also right for the Phoenix Race not to try easily. However, there’s no need to treat successful cases as heretics and kill them all.”
“Unfortunately, Lord World Tree sleeps all year round. It can only completely awaken after the Mythical Revival. Otherwise, with its guidance, the rules of the various races on Blue Planet wouldn’t be so chaotic.” Shi Yu sighed.
“Impossible…” At this moment, when it heard Shi Yu say that the ancestor of the Phoenix Race supported hybrids, the Phoenix Vermillion Bird demigod had a look of disbelief.” Impossible. Could it be that Sister… ”
Shi Yu said, “Your sister is indeed wrong. It took the wrong path. It’s completely the right thing for you to stop it. Its goal in nurturing hybrid humans is to use them as nutrients. They belong to the category of siblings killing each other. Its methods are harmful to the world, and it’s easy to go berserk.”
“The most harmonious path is still for human Beast Tamers to sign an equal contract with the Phoenix Race to grow together and help together. Mixed blood is just another extreme path, and your sister is even more extreme.”
“However, when its crazy method was only carried out halfway, it indeed cultivated two talented hybrids.”
“One is the spirit body in front of you, and the other is Princess Huang Xi of the Phoenix Empire.”
“You’ve seen my sister?” The Phoenix Race Patriarch was stunned.
“Not only have I seen it, but I’ve also helped its daughter, the hybrid Beast Tamer, Princess Huang Xi, overthrow it. Its path isn’t recognized by the World Tree, and it’s easy to lead the Phoenix Race and humans to destruction. On the other hand, Patriarch, you’re highly trusted by the World Tree. This time, I came because I hope that you can hold hands with the Phoenix Race and the human countries that Princess Huang Xi is about to establish to develop in harmony and form an alliance,” Shi Yu said.
“Humans have to cooperate with all races sooner or later. It’s the trend.”
“As for Princess Huang Xi, as a human with the Phoenix bloodline, I think she’s a very good support target for the Phoenix Race.”
The expression of the Phoenix Race’s patriarch changed. She felt that it was unbelievable. She felt that what she had learned today was very dreamy.
If this were said by others, it definitely wouldn’t believe it. However, it couldn’t not believe Shi Yu… this World Tree Envoy.
In the end, the Phoenix Race Patriarch was silent for a long time before looking at Shi Yu and Chi Tong.
Chi Tong in front of him indeed had terrifying talent and had actually mastered a quasi-divine skill. After all, in the thousands of years, only it and its sister had cultivated a quasi-divine skill, and both parties had used it for a long time.
This hybrid didn’t look very old at all. Could it be that… hybrids really had such a huge advantage?
“How… do I assist you?” the Phoenix Race Patriarch said.
Shi Yu said, “It’s very simple. Although it has already mastered a quasi-divine skill, it’s actually only at the overlord level. The Mythical Race at the overlord level still has very powerful potential.”
“At the moment, it’s already on the verge of breaking through and can break through at any time. If it breaks through, it’ll be a demigod. I plan to let it gather you, Patriarch, and your sister’s forte to complete the breakthrough.”
“Then, with my support, there will be a high chance of opening the super-divine ruins.”
The Phoenix Race Patriarch was in disbelief again. An overlord could master a quasi-divine skill??? Was this the strength of the World Tree Envoy? If it weren’t for the gift of the world’s will, it couldn’t imagine how a life form could touch the laws of the planet at the overlord level.
“Alright… I can assist you.” The Phoenix Race Patriarch thought for a long time and finally made up her mind.
At the same time, Shi Yu felt strange. That was it? He didn’t expect that he was quite talented. With a round of Poof, he made the Phoenix Race Patriarch take the initiative to offer super-divine resources and even take the initiative to help nurture Chi Tong… Not bad!
He felt that in the future, relying on a fixed template, he seemed to be able to deceive the resources of other large races. It was not good to fight and kill. Using information to exchange for resources was beneficial to both parties! It was just that it might be easy to get beaten up by the World Tree after learning about it…
“I wonder if my current strength can defeat the World Tree…” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. He still felt that it was difficult. As the true strongest demigod, he felt that the World Tree had at least dozens of quasi-divine skills…

chapters.title: Chapter 1217 - 1217 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (1)
chapters.content:
1217 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (1)
“We can assist you in trying to crack the super-divine ruins.”
“However, what’s the specific method?”
The Phoenix Race Patriarch stared at Shi Yu and the others on the battleship in silence.
This super-divine ruin had already made the Phoenix Race consume a lot of strength. It was useless even if they threw it.
It already believed Shi Yu’s watertight words.
He also felt that it was more valuable to let Shi Yu and the others crack the ruins and take out key information that affected the survival of Blue Planet.
As the envoy of the World Tree, there should be something unique about it that could crack ruins that others couldn’t, right?
“As for the specific method…”
“Before cracking the ruins, I want it to evolve and break through to its strongest state.”
“At the moment, not only has it perfectly inherited the power of the Sun God Phoenix, but it has also walked its own path and mastered a Sword-type quasi-divine skill.”
“For the sake of success rate, I also want its clone to walk the same path as you, Patriarch, and become a quasi Vermillion Bird.”
“This way, the power of the Phoenix, the divine power of the Sword Skill, and the power of faith, together with the power of humans, can definitely have the battle power of a god.”
“According to the deduction results of the Phoenix Race, with divine-level battle power, you can crack this ruin, right?” Shi Yu said.
“What?” Many Phoenix totems were shocked. So Shi Yu had gotten the patriarch to help him cultivate with this idea!
Vermillion Bird evolution method!
When the Phoenix Race Patriarch heard that, her red eyes flickered. “I see. Unfortunately, I can’t help you with this.”
“Evolution into quasi Vermillion Bird… I also don’t have a systematic evolution plan because of many coincidences.”
“Oh?” Although Shi Yu and the others felt that it was a pity, they also felt that it was normal.
“It’s also within my expectations,” Shi Yu said.
Alright then, but there were always more ways than Difficult.
Shi Yu said, “You don’t have to worry about that.”
“I’m the Envoy of the World Tree and have the fruit of the World Tree. You should know the effect of the World Tree, right?”
“It can increase comprehension and learning ability.”
“Patriarch, you only need to showcase the Vermillion Bird faith skill you have mastered and give me a legendary feather that contains your own spiritual power and the power of the Vermillion Bird faith. We can deduce the Vermillion Bird Path ourselves.”
The Phoenix Race Patriarch was stunned. “Are you sure?”
What a joke.
How could it be so easy to evolve into a Vermillion Bird? It felt that Shi Yu and the others might fail at this step.
“Feel free to help. I’ll think of a way,” Shi Yu said.
The Phoenix Patriarch’s expression calmed down. After thinking about it again and again, she finally nodded.
In that case, it wanted to see how the other party could evolve into a Vermillion Bird by observing faith skills and a Vermillion Bird feather!
“Sure.” The red divine bird that the Phoenix worshiped immediately took out a feather.
In the next moment, the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire was lit on the red feather!
< Name > Vermillion Bird Divine Fire
[Stats]: Exort
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It’s a faith skill. The divine fire formed by burning the power of faith can even burn the laws of the planet!
Boom!!!
The divine fire was ignited. In an instant, it was as if a sun had fallen above Shi Yu and the others’ heads. The season instantly changed from winter to summer, and the temperature changed greatly.
The blue sky and white clouds instantly turned into red clouds because of the appearance of this palm-sized bird-shaped divine fire.
This small bird-shaped fire was especially powerful. Under Shi Yu’s perception, the threat level even exceeded some quasi-divine skills.
The Phoenix Race Leader in front of it had mastered quasi-divine skills and faith skills at the same time. It could be said that it was indeed ridiculously strong. It was no wonder that the Undying Dark Phoenix couldn’t defeat it, and it was also sad that the empress could only perish with it.
Shi Yu sighed. The enemies faced by Legendary emperors like Dong Huang were really not simple.
Yun An was a cosmic life form with a quasi-divine skill. The Phoenix Race’s patriarch had mastered the Vermillion Bird Faith Skill and a quasi-divine skill.
They were not what ordinary demigods could compare to.
“How is it?” At this moment, using the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, the dignified queen’s voice of the Phoenix Race’s patriarch sounded. Shi Yu in front of him was indeed powerful. He had contracted a bunch of pets who had mastered quasi-divine skills.
If it fought Shi Yu, it would also have a headache.
However, the Phoenix Patriarch was certain that in a one-on-one situation, it was invincible.
Because it was the Vermillion Bird faith god! It had the backing of the entire Phoenix Nation.
Under the enhancement of countless power of faith, its Vermillion Bird Divine Fire could even burn the laws of divine skills.
“Not bad.” Shi Yu revealed a satisfied expression. Unfortunately, the Phoenix Race’s patriarch only mastered one faith skill, the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire.
Unlike Buggy, who had two faith skills the moment it evolved, and one of them had even been fused into a top-notch faith skill like the Green Dragon Indestructible Body.
“Eleven.” Shi Yu gave the order. Eleven flew out electromagnetically. As the Phoenix Patriarch was stunned, it directly pinched the bird-shaped Vermillion Bird Divine Fire in its hand.
Boom!!!
Under the hot temperature, Eleven was excited. What a strong flame. Even with the transcendent Leaving Gold Battle Body, Indestructible Golden Body, and Molten Gold Skill, its Exort Resistance was extremely high. It felt the damage.
If such a strong flame was used to temper the body, the Effect would definitely be very good!
He hoped that Chi Tong’s sister would learn it quickly!
At that time, Buggy’s Dragon Star meteorite would train its fist, and Chi Tong’s Vermillion Bird Divine Fire would train its body. Perfect!
“Impossible!” Seeing Eleven pinch the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, the Phoenix Race Patriarch said in disbelief.
The other totem Phoenixes were also shocked. They could sense that the Iron-eating Beast in front of them was a metal-element creature.

chapters.title: Chapter 1218 - 1218 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (2)
chapters.content:
1218 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (2)
However, a metal-element life form countered by fire could actually hold a fire faith skill?
The Phoenix Patriarch couldn’t understand. Even if this Vermillion Bird Divine Fire only fused a trace of faith power to avoid wasting the power of faith, even the most basic Vermillion Bird Divine Fire could easily kill a totem.
At this moment, it was actually being played with by a metal-element creature?
“It has loved to play with fire since it was young. Its Exort Resistance is pretty good,” Shi Yu said.
Accompanied by Chi Tong, Shi Yu took a few steps forward and turned into a red-haired Chi Tong. He took the Vermillion Bird Feather that had its faith extinguished.
[Recording successful].
Shi Yu directly replicated the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire Skill.
No matter what kind of coincidence it was, it was his in the next second.
Many Phoenixes looked at Shi Yu, who was holding the Vermillion Bird Feather, in disbelief.
“Then, let’s try to break through and evolve first. It won’t be long before we return.”
“Please wait patiently.”
The red-haired and red-eyed Shi Yu smiled. Right on the heels of that, the entire sky darkened.
As a Green Silkworm on the battleship leaped up and jumped into the sky, with a boom, starlight flickered.
“Roar!!!”
In the dragon roar and green-gold light, its huge body was displayed.
Under the starry sky, the Green Dragon Faith God that looked like a dragon with two golden horns on its head and was covered in green scales descended directly. Its eyes and tail seemed to be burning with the fire of golden Spirit faith.
The group of Phoenix Race members was shocked again. Just now, Shi Yu’s group of pets had displayed quasi-divine skills. It was extremely spectacular, but among them, the Green Silkworm and the Water Slime were only watching from the side.
They were originally curious about who these two were. At this moment, as the Phoenix Race Patriarch spoke in disbelief, all the Phoenixes were stunned and understood its identity.
“Green Dragon…” The Phoenix Race Patriarch said in disbelief. She sensed the vast power of faith from Buggy, who was also an evolver of the Four Saints. In terms of faith, the other party… might have evolved even further than her!
The Phoenixes saw Shi Yu and a bunch of pets boarding the Green Dragon from the battleship. The huge battleship also turned into a Rubik’s Cube and landed on Shi Yu.
Their goal was the starry sky.
He was going to the starry sky to evolve and break through.
Boom!
Its dragon body swayed, and Buggy looked at the starry sky. Its entire body was quickly wrapped in golden light as it rushed out of Blue Planet.
“Patriarch…” Many Phoenix Race members looked at the Vermillion Bird demigod.
The Phoenix Race Patriarch was silent, sensing Shi Yu’s horror again. This World Tree Envoy was simply a monster. Every contracted creature under him was extremely ridiculous.
Was it true that humans were the supreme race brought back by a top-notch god from the starry sky? It looked at the starry sky. In the end, the Phoenix Vermillion Bird wings spread out and let out a long cry before flying into the starry sky too.
“I’ll go take a look.”
….
As Buggy flew into the starry sky, Shi Yu planned the subsequent breakthrough evolution.
At the moment, although Shi Yu had replicated the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, he couldn’t teach it to Chi Tong yet. The Skill compatibility wasn’t enough.
The current Chi Tong wasn’t a god of faith in the starry sky yet. It couldn’t learn faith skills at all.
However, Shi Yu believed that it would be done soon.
Wait a minute, after arriving at the starry sky, let Chi Tong turn some of the undead imprisoned in the undead space into nutrients to break through and grow first through the “Spirit Release Skill”. It could easily break through to the totem level.
Right on the heels of that, after reaching the totem level, Chi Tong had the ability to “optimize its bloodline race”.
At that time, even without using evolution skills, the totem creatures could perfect their race and evolve themselves.
Of course, for ordinary totems, this process was extremely long…
If totem-level life forms were regarded as students and evolution as a research topic, then it was rare for one in a million students to study this research topic thoroughly.
There was a difference in the learning ability of every life form. Just like giving a knowledge domain, no matter how hard one studied, they couldn’t get started. Some people could easily study a domain to the extreme and create a new domain. The difference between a genius and a mortal spirit would increase after the totem level.
Chi Tong’s aptitude was clearly already considered a little genius. In addition to the cheat, the World Tree Fruit, it should be able to progress very smoothly on the path of totem-level self-optimization of its race.
Although it was more difficult to evolve into a Vermillion Bird, Shi Yu wasn’t the only cheat that could assist it.
There was also Buggy’s Four Holy Clones that could assist it in mobilizing the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird to perfect its race. There was also Ling’s Blessing Wind. It could increase Chi Tong’s luck and let it find a shortcut to evolution as soon as possible. With so much help, it ensured that Chi Tong could complete its evolution like the Phoenix Clan Leader.
Could it be that these things couldn’t compare to the opportunity of the Phoenix Race’s patriarch?
Moreover, there was no need for perfect evolution.
After slightly optimizing its bloodline, Chi Tong could increase its compatibility with the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire. At that time, through Shi Yu’s additional points, it could absorb the skill EXP of the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire. It shouldn’t be a problem for its clone to evolve into a Vermillion Bird.
Perhaps it could even stand on the shoulder of the Phoenix Race’s patriarch and walk further than it.
In the incomparably vast starry sky, in the vast universe where the sun could be seen at a glance, the Green Dragon brought Shi Yu and the others up and left the restraints of Blue Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1219 - 1219 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (3)
chapters.content:
1219 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (3)
“Roar!!!”
In the starry sky, the green dragon roared.
The moment they entered the starry sky, apart from Buggy, Shi Yu and the others more or less felt some suppression. This suppression would become stronger and stronger as they left the planet and went deeper into the starry sky.
Generally speaking, only cosmic life forms could move relatively freely outside the planet. If it were other races, they would be like fish out of water. They would feel very uncomfortable.
This suppression was also the reason why some gods on Blue Planet didn’t have the ability to sail far.
Unless they could optimize their bloodlines and modify themselves into a cosmic race. However, there was still the same problem. Not every life form had the aptitude to complete their evolution.
However, although it couldn’t survive in the universe for a long time, at Shi Yu and the others’ level, it was still not a problem to stay for a few hours.
This period of time was enough.
“Chi Tong.” After flying to the starry sky, Shi Yu called out. Chi Tong, who was in the energy-efficient form beside him, nodded and returned to its growth form.
Sword Maiden Chi Tong, who was wearing silver-white armor and had red hair draped over her shoulders, directly summoned the Sun God Phoenix clone.
[Then I’ll go.] Chi Tong turned around and looked at Shi Yu with its red eyes.
Shi Yu nodded.
“Jiu!! ~ ~ ~”
Then, the orange-red Sun God Phoenix clone flew out under the illumination of the sun. Fire spiritual aura lingered on Chi Tong’s body, and it directly changed from Buggy to the Phoenix clone.
“Wu wu wu!!” “Roar!!” “Yi!!” “Ning!!” “All the best!!”
Eleven and the others cheered for Chi Tong. Chi Tong nodded heavily and rode the Phoenix clone away from Shi Yu and the others. During this process, the fire power on its body was even stronger!!
The power on the Phoenix clone was Sun Flame, the Sun God Fire Exort, and the power that had been stripped away by Chi Tong. However, she could still control it, and her own flames were the flames of life, flames that belonged to her.
Under the lingering of the double flames, the Yun clan totem undead imprisoned by Chi Tong in its undead space burned one after another, turning into Spirit Release nutrients that assisted Chi Tong in breaking through, leaving only the Abyss Demon Frog, a demigod puppet.
Soul aura that filled the sky surged and lingered around Chi Tong and the Phoenix clone, causing their joint aura to increase steadily.
Apart from that, Chi Tong also used the World Tree Fruits prepared in advance by Baby Ginseng and the Sun Flame Flowers plundered from the Phoenix Empire’s national treasury.
Under the enhancement of many resources, its original 300 million normal energy points began to take a qualitative leap.
It began to break through!!!
Strength turned into life source!
1 billion… 2 billion… 2.5 billion… 3 billion…
Soon, Chi Tong’s normal energy level also exceeded the three billion mark. Without a doubt, once it broke through, it would be at the demigod level.
This time, Shi Yu was most concerned about the change in Chi Tong’s “Spirit Release” Skill.
The proficient level, expert level, and perfect level Spirit Release allowed Chi Tong to have the bird spirit form, phoenix spirit form, and Sword Maiden form. Then what about the transcendent level Spirit Release this time?
Shi Yu and Chi Tong didn’t know, but soon, they knew. They saw the red breakthrough light become stronger and stronger. The flames that filled the sky seemed to have wrapped them into a huge fireball that reflected the starry sky.
“This is…” When the Phoenix Patriarch also flew into the starry sky, she immediately saw the scene in front of her.
“This is…” When the Phoenix Patriarch also flew into the starry sky, she immediately saw the scene in front of her.
On Blue Planet.
At this moment, any life form that looked up could also discover that two suns seemed to have appeared in the sky.
This special phenomenon directly confused and shocked many lives.
Shi Yu and the others on the green dragon were stunned before immediately reacting.
The transcendent-level Spirit Release directly made Chi Tong’s bloodline form return to the essence power of the Sun God Phoenix, the power of the sun!
At this moment, Chi Tong seemed to have obtained the true body of the sun and could freely transform into the form of the sun.
However, this was not a Skill. Just like the previous Flame of Regeneration and the Flame of Restoration, it was just a derived form of Spirit Release to increase proficiency.
In this state, it would be even easier for Chi Tong to mobilize the power of the sun.
Boom!!!
In an instant, the light of the sun swept in all directions. In the incomparably dazzling hot sun, a figure with surging sword intent and an aura that pierced through the starry sky walked out. It was Sword Maiden Chi Tong.
She was still beautiful, and her figure was even more dazzling in the sun.
At this moment, Chi Tong had already completed its breakthrough, but it had yet to complete its evolution. After looking at Shi Yu and the others through the starry sky, Shi Yu and Buggy’s mouths curled up and they smiled.
“Buggy, I’ll leave the rest to you.”
“Roar!!!”
Under Buggy’s roar, it directly activated the Four Holy Clones Skill. One round of the Four Holy Vermillion Bird clones, which was originally created with Chi Tong as the prototype, mobilized the power of faith from the Vermillion Bird faith items collected by Shi Yu and the others to help Chi Tong undergo the Awakening Purification.
Chi Tong was also trying its best to use the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird to optimize the bloodline of its Phoenix clone.
“This is…”
The Phoenix Race Patriarch, who had followed, couldn’t help but be stunned when he saw the huge Vermillion Bird phantom flying behind Chi Tong and mobilizing the power of faith to help it modify its bloodline.
It suddenly looked at the ten-thousand-meter-long green dragon. Why… why could this green dragon even mobilize the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird!
This didn’t make sense!
“Moreover, my Vermillion Bird Feather…” The Phoenix Race Patriarch suddenly realized that the current Chi Tong was already disintegrating its Vermillion Bird Feather. It seemed to be really as Shi Yu had said. They were simulating the evolution path of the Vermillion Bird through deduction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1220 - 1220 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (4)
chapters.content:
1220 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (4)
“How is it?” Ling asked beside Shi Yu.
On the green dragon, Shi Yu, who had red hair and red eyes and was still in the possession state of the Sword Spirit clone, chuckled and said, “It’s even smoother than your deduction.”
“In just an instant, the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire is in a teachable state.”
Ling: “Great, this way, we might be able to walk an evolution path more perfect than the Phoenix Race’s patriarch.”
“Yeah.” Shi Yu stretched out his palm and faced Chi Tong from afar. He entered a mental resonance state and closed his eyes slightly. Then, right on the heels of that, he seemed to have entered a dark world. In this world, only he and Chi Tong were back to back, sticking closely to each other.
As he was in the state of clone possession and mental resonance, Shi Yu directly added points from afar and imparted the skill EXP of the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire to Chi Tong in the optimization race.
In the next moment, scarlet light also lingered on Shi Yu’s body. In the distance, the Fire of Spirit Faith ignited in Chi Tong’s mind. With a boom, an even stronger light bloomed from her body. The sun phantom was even larger and more dazzling, covering everything about them.
During this process, the Phoenix Race’s patriarch sensed the gradually growing power of its sister’s mixed-blood daughter in confusion the whole time. It felt that it was getting closer and closer to the orthodox Vermillion Bird.
In fact… it would soon surpass him.
“Jiu!!!!!!”
The Vermillion Bird Divine Fire that filled the sky lingered in the sun phantom. A Vermillion Bird seemed to have really been slowly born inside, shocking the Phoenix Clan Leader’s jaw.
That was… its Vermillion Bird Divine Fire? Why…
It had only been a few minutes since they flew into the starry sky. In these few minutes, a life form directly completed its evolution towards the Vermillion Bird and completed the path it successfully walked under countless opportunities. This… it couldn’t accept!
Finally, the gathering of the power of faith and the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire perfected the last body of the Vermillion Bird Constellation.
Accompanied by a sparrow cry that resounded through the starry sky, its body completely formed under the red evolution light.
The Phoenix derived the power of the Vermillion Bird, and the red starlight that filled the sky turned into a parasol tree. The Vermillion Bird that came out of the morning sun spread its wings and flew from its habitat state. Its body was covered in the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire and finally burned. Its vigorous life force was as vast as the sun. It was in the form of a divine bird completely made of fire. It was wearing a golden Fire Feather coat, like an Elemental life form, like a divine transformation of fire.
It flew out of the hot sun. On its body stood a woman with red hair draped over her shoulders and agile eyes. She was also wearing a Fire Feather Shirt. It was Chi Tong.
At this moment, Shi Yu was very excited. It was completed. Her main body maintained the form of a Sword Maiden. With the Four Immortal Slaying Swords in hand, she transformed into the evolved Vermillion Bird form and formed the super-divine mode of the Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden!!
This wave was invincible!
“Ling, record the analysis Skill.” At this moment, although Shi Yu was immersed in Chi Tong’s evolution, he didn’t forget to share the information with Ling.
In this evolution, Chi Tong had learned a total of three Skills.
Shi Yu felt that it was simply ridiculous. After all, Buggy had only awakened two faith skills when it evolved through the Green Dragon Domain.
Of course, one of them was replicated by Chi Tong.
The first was that the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire had successfully turned into a racial skill during Chi Tong’s evolution.
The second was an undead skill.
< Name > Soul Guiding
[Attributes]: Undead
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > Consuming the power of faith can allow the believer’s soul to not be destroyed after death and undergo soul reincarnation!
Shi Yu didn’t know how to evaluate this skill. There were actually very few lives with reincarnation abilities, and Chi Tong’s ridiculous thing was that its faith skill could allow believers to reincarnate.
Buggy’s Green Dragon Indestructible Body only used the power of faith to reincarnate and revive itself.
“In the pre-Qin era, the Vermillion Bird was thought to be able to guide the souls of the dead to rise in the sky and was related to the soul. Could it be that Chi Tong’s spiritual body form happened to match some requests?”
The third Skill…
< Name > Sun True Body
[Stats]: Exort
[Level]: Super
< Introduction > It can burn the power of faith and turn itself into a sun, burning everything, reflecting the starry sky and burning stars.
And the skill that Shi Yu felt was the most ridiculous was still the third. This should be the Vermillion Bird Faith Skill awakened by Chi Tong by combining its race and the power of faith.
It should be considered a high-level faith skill of the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire. The Vermillion Bird Divine Fire was only the combination of Normal Fire and the power of faith, but the Sun True Body was the combination of the Sun God Exort and the power of faith. Its power was even stronger.
It was a faith Skill that could destroy stars when trained to the extreme. Just like the Dragon Star Group, it could directly Devour a planet into the sun.
At this moment, Chi Tong’s attributes were quite perfect. Not only did its main body master the quasi-divine sword skill, but its clone also mastered three faith skills. The combination of the two made its energy level increase steadily to 3.53 billion.
It had already exceeded Eleven, who had just broken through, but after the current Eleven swallowed Yun An and ate a pile of resources, its normal energy level had long been even more ridiculous. Chi Tong had yet to completely catch up.
“Chi Tong!” In the starry sky, Shi Yu condensed his mental strength and shouted. Chi Tong, who was opposite him, directly absorbed the Vermillion Bird clone into its body, like a Nine Heavens Goddess who had descended from the starry sky, leaning towards Shi Yu and the others.
She smiled.
Chi Tong felt that it might be able to keep defending the championship in the team!
Susu and Ling definitely couldn’t defeat her.
“Wuu!!!” Eleven and the others sensed Chi Tong’s current state and were indeed shocked and envious. They felt that even if Chi Tong didn’t possess Shi Yu, it could still pose a strong threat to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1221 - 1221 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (5)
chapters.content:
1221 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (5)
“Roar!!!” Seeing Chi Tong’s perfect state, Buggy couldn’t help but want to break through too. After it broke through, the Dragon of Imagination could let it evolve again. This time, Chi Tong had a quasi-divine skill to evolve into a faith skill, while Buggy hoped that it had a faith skill to evolve into a quasi-divine skill. This way, it wouldn’t fall behind its teammates too much.
It cried to death. It had said that the one who evolved first would definitely fall behind the version.
Back then, it was so glorious for it to evolve into a green dragon. In the end, Chi Tong had already evolved twice in a row. One was the evolution of a god, and the other was the evolution of faith. It… was still waiting in line.
“Mi.” When Sword Maiden Chi Tong flew over, it gradually turned into the form of a sword spirit and turned into a fiery red longsword that landed in Shi Yu’s hand.
Then, both parties entered a complete possession state, and their auras were even more terrifying. Shi Yu was like a fire god that had walked out of the starry sky as he looked at the Phoenix Patriarch who had followed outside Blue Planet.
Under the fiery red flames, Shi Yu’s Chi Tong was as dazzling as the sun.
“Patriarch, can you take us to crack the ruins now?”
“This power should be enough, right?”
Chi Tong, who was at the demigod level, possessed Shi Yu, who had eaten world, immortal, and eternal resources. At this moment, Shi Yu felt that he could defeat the Phoenix Patriarch, who the peak empress had used all her might to defeat, in a “one-on-one”.
There was definitely no problem.
“You guys…” The Phoenix Race Patriarch had a shocked expression. She felt a huge pressure from Shi Yu and the others.
How could this be… Could it be that they had really become gods?!!
….
Phoenix Race, Super God Ruins.
The Phoenix Race’s patriarch, Shi Yu, returned from the starry sky. Under the Phoenix Race’s patriarch’s lead, Shi Yu entered the meteorite-like starry sky ruins in the red universe.
Upon seeing the ruins, Shi Yu suddenly recalled that although the demigod of the Phoenix Race couldn’t crack the ruins either, he had moved the entire ruin back from the universe…
The ruins were dead. If there were no living creatures inside, even if he couldn’t crack it, he might be able to move the ruins back to the original space and time first. There was still time in the future?
“This is the place.” After leading Shi Yu into the super ruins, Shi Yu and the others seemed to have entered a petrified world.
The entire world was gray. There was nothing on the petrified ground and the petrified sky. There was only a stone pillar standing in the center of the ruins. On the stone pillar was a spherical gem quietly.
It was like a glass bead. On its transparent appearance, a green crescent-shaped pattern was embedded inside.
Although it had yet to approach this glass bead, anyone could sense its powerful energy fluctuations that exceeded the divine level.
“On the stone pillar is that super-divine-level resource. We don’t know its use at the moment, and we can’t take it away.”
“But as long as you get close, the ruins space will produce a strong rejection. Even demigods can’t stop this rejection.”
“In addition, the Phoenix Race has also confirmed that only creatures with the bloodline of the Phoenix Race can approach the stone pillar. Otherwise, there will be an even stronger rejection.” The Phoenix Race Patriarch, who had turned into a few meters tall, looked at the World Tree Envoy in a fusion state beside him.
Because of the possession, the current Shi Yu and Chi Tong shared the Phoenix bloodline.
“Among them, it’s not like the Phoenix Race hasn’t tried letting the Undead Phoenix possess a human to take away resources, but they all failed.”
“However, this is the first time a demigod-level undead Phoenix has possessed someone. In the history of the Phoenix Race, although a demigod-level undead Phoenix has been born, we’ve never found a human who can withstand its possession power, let alone a human that both parties contracted.”
“So…” The Phoenix Clan Leader felt that this time, it might really succeed.
The power on Shi Yu and the others definitely crushed ordinary demigods.
It was already considered an expert among demigods.
However, in this state, Shi Yu was still not confident.
“I’ll give it a try.” Shi Yu nodded. Then, under the Phoenix Patriarch’s gaze, he approached the stone pillar.
The Phoenix Race Patriarch’s gaze was solemn. According to her past experience, the entire ruins space should reject Shi Yu and the others next.
According to the speculation of the past demigods, one had to at least have divine-level power to withstand this spatial rejection!
However, the next scene made the Phoenix Clan Leader a little at a loss. He saw Shi Yu and the others approach the stone pillar step by step. The so-called spatial rejection never appeared.
This situation stunned the Phoenix Patriarch. Seeing that Shi Yu was getting closer and closer to the stone pillar, it began to suspect that there was a malfunction in the ruins!
“How is this possible?” It also tried to approach, but in the next moment, a spatial repulsive force that was like divine might directly acted on this demigod, making its expression change.
Boom!!
It retreated slightly.
The huge commotion made the red-haired Shi Yu in front of him turn around and say, “Are you alright?”
“Why, why don’t the ruins reject you?” The Phoenix Patriarch couldn’t understand.
“What’s going on?” Shi Yu was also very puzzled. He sensed his surroundings and indeed didn’t feel any rejection power.
Could it be that he had heard of his famous name in this ruin??
Just as Shi Yu was puzzled, something unexpected happened. The glass bead on the stone pillar suddenly emitted an even stronger light.
The light kept strengthening. In the end, in midair of the ruins, it condensed into the phantom of a white Phoenix, emitting a divine pressure.
“This…” The Phoenix Clan Leader was still in shock and had yet to react. The super-divine resource had appeared??

chapters.title: Chapter 1222 - 1222 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (6)
chapters.content:
1222 Demigod-level Vermillion Bird Sword Maiden (6)
“Uh…” Shi Yu and Chi Tong, who had possessed him, also revealed confused expressions. What was going on?
“Patriarch, this should be a normal reaction, right? A part of the rejection? Is there still a battle test?”
“Test my ass!” The Phoenix Clan Leader was shocked. This was the first time the ruins had such a reaction after their ancestor brought it back!
At this moment, the Light Phoenix in the air was like a god. The Phoenix patriarch judged that it was very likely to be the ancestor who left Blue Planet in the Mythical Era and brought back super-divine resources.
At this moment, this Phoenix Race ancestor seemed to have just woken up and was very tired. Shi Yu and the others could sense that this phantom was no longer its real body, but a fixed program similar to illusions, mental bodies, and ruins spirits!!
In fact, because it had been too long, even the consciousness to think on its own had already disappeared. It was completely like an order.
“I’m finally seeing you again, Lord Blue Planet.”
The moment the Phoenix Race god spoke, it shocked the Phoenix Race’s patriarch.
“You might not be Lord Blue Planet, but you should be a member of the Phoenix Race with a deep relationship with Lord Blue Planet.”
“No matter who you are, after obtaining this resource, please hand it to Lord Blue Planet.”
“Next, please listen to me.”
“After leaving Blue Planet, Lord Origin Phoenix led us to the depths of the starry sky. During the long voyage, many gods sacrificed themselves, but in the end, we still successfully arrived at another civilization.”
Shi Yu and the others were suddenly stunned as they listened to the other party seriously.
Then, what made Shi Yu and the others’ expressions change was that this phantom was like a stutter. Its voice was blurry and it couldn’t let out normal voices.
“#@￥%@##@￥”.
After a pile of characters that Shi Yu and the others couldn’t understand, the thought body left behind by the Phoenix Divine Spirit finally spat out the words clearly again.
“This stone is the key to connecting Blue Planet to a cosmic civilization. Please decide if you want to use it after careful consideration, Lord Blue Planet.”
“Opening it might bring new life to Blue Planet, but it might also completely destroy Blue Planet.”
“Its use is equivalent to a ruin key. It can allow the user to open a door. No matter where they are, they can directly enter another super planet. It can be seen as an interstellar Teleportation tool. Not only can it teleport over, but it can also teleport back.”
“This super planet is a very special neutral planet in the universe. In terms of level, it exceeds you, Lord Blue Planet, by two growth levels. On it live the myriad races of the starry sky. Be it the cosmic Behemoth, the cosmic worm, or the human race, they’re only members of the myriad races of the starry sky. Their civilization level has to a certain extent already exceeded Blue Planet, which is located in a remote star area.”
“In short, through this key stone, we can let Blue Planet and the cosmic civilization intersect. Before the two parties come into contact, we will try our best to increase the status of Blue Planet Races in the universe…”
“Its opening method… 2#%￥@#% #￥%.”
Bang!
This phantom was like an old and broken machine. As it spoke, it directly shattered.
Shi Yu and the Phoenix Race Patriarch: ???
“F*ck.” Shi Yu directly cursed. Finish f*cking speaking. After saying that, then it could be scrapped!!
The Phoenix phantom was completely destroyed, but the suppression of the ruins space did not completely disappear. The Phoenix Patriarch was still rejected by the ruins, but Shi Yu could still advance easily until he picked up the so-called key stone in confusion.
After the words just now, Shi Yu was stunned. The Phoenix Race said that cracking this ruin required divine-level battle power. Therefore, before he entered, he let Chi Tong break through first.
In the end, what he wanted was not divine-level battle power, but Blue Planet’s direct descendant identity??
“You… This thing is indeed as you said. It’s very important to Blue Planet.” At this moment, when he heard that the phantom of the Phoenix Divine Spirit had confirmed Shi Yu’s identity, the Phoenix Patriarch, who originally trusted Shi Yu 99%, could be said to have directly reached 100% trust.
It hit the jackpot.
Shi Yu’s pile of Poofs had been verified.
Shi Yu held the key stone in silence.
A Teleportation Device to another super planet in the universe??? Are you serious??

chapters.title: Chapter 1223 - 1223 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (1)
chapters.content:
1223 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (1)
In the Phoenix Race ruins, Shi Yu, who was holding the key stone, looked at the Phoenix Race Patriarch.
It meant, look!
I knew it. I have an official identity.
Moreover, this key stone was extremely important. It was left behind by the Phoenix Race’s ancestor for Blue Planet’s Great Resistance!
The lies were all made up!
Could it be that Ling was assisting again?
Shi Yu felt that he had made an impressive discovery in this archeology test.
The original space and time, this key stone, had undoubtedly been snatched away by the two unlucky things, the Phoenix Race Patriarch and the empress. Fortunately, he could transmigrate back to the ancient parallel space.
Otherwise, it would really be an unjust account.
“Lord Envoy…” The Phoenix Race Patriarch had mixed feelings.
“What a pity,” Shi Yu said. “The most important information was lost.”
“It’s been too long, but if I bring it back to repair Blue Planet’s Will, there might be a possibility of emergency treatment.”
The Phoenix Clan Leader: “I understand.”
Although this high and mighty Phoenix Race Patriarch also wanted to obtain the right to hold the key stone and take a look at a higher starry sky world, he also knew that this thing was not something it could grasp.
However, it believed that as long as it followed Blue Planet’s footsteps, it and the Phoenix Race would definitely benefit the most in the future.
After all, this thing was brought back by the Phoenix Race ancestor.
The Phoenix Race god was working hard in the universe. How could the Blue Planet’s Will mistreat the descendants of the Phoenix Race here?
At this moment, the Phoenix Race’s patriarch had already made up his mind to follow the world’s will well and develop steadily with Shi Yu.
“Next, I’ll take this key stone away.”
“In addition, prepare to head to Dong Huang to form an alliance with Princess Huang Xi.”
“I feel that the key to opening the interstellar passage might be on humans. Otherwise, why would Goddess Wa bring humans back?” Shi Yu continued to deceive Poof.
“I see.” The more the Phoenix Race Patriarch thought about it, the clearer it became. Her eyes lit up, and then her expression darkened. Unfortunately, her stupid sister had originally grabbed the right direction, but she went astray.
The next Phoenix Race couldn’t take the wrong path. They had to get along with the humans according to the will of the world…
“There’s one more thing.” Shi Yu returned to the starting point and exited the energy-consuming possession form. The sword spirit, Chi Tong, floated beside Shi Yu in the form of a sword.
Shi Yu said to the Phoenix Clan Leader with a weak expression, “In order to let you believe our identities just now, I consumed a lot of energy.”
“We came out in a hurry and didn’t bring much food…”
“Mi…” Chi Tong was also hungry. Was this the power of a demigod? It was too hungry!!
It now understood Foodie Eleven a little.
The Phoenix Race Patriarch was stunned. “Sorry, I actually forgot to entertain the envoy. I’ll get my clansmen to prepare food now. I’ll definitely let you return full.”
Shi Yu revealed a satisfied smile. This Phoenix was worth teaching.
…
The next pause made the Phoenix Race Patriarch’s heart bleed.
It wasn’t too much to say that the Phoenix Race of Phoenix Island was a huge faction comparable to Dragon Palace City.
Such a faction naturally had a huge amount of internal resources. Divine-level resources and Legendary-level resources were everything.
However, the Phoenix Race’s patriarch discovered that even so, they still couldn’t afford to entertain a god like Shi Yu!
“Patriarch, they’ve finished the new legendary food again.”
As the Phoenix Race prepared the gift to establish diplomatic relations with the empress, they served Shi Yu food. In a short period of time, the resource reserves quickly decreased.
“What, it’s finished again?!” The Phoenix Clan Leader was shocked.
A wood-element totem Phoenix cried and said, “Patriarch, that’s at least six creatures who have mastered quasi-divine skills. They can all be seen as demigods. Not to mention us, I’m afraid no faction can afford their appetite.”
“Fortunately, it’s just today’s meal. Next time… I can’t entertain them anymore. Otherwise, Phoenix Island will definitely be eaten up.”
The Phoenix Race Patriarch was silent and said, “I understand, but try your best to let them eat well…”
Logically speaking, with the gift of Blue Planet, the envoy of the World Tree shouldn’t have come to the Phoenix Race to freeload, right? No, it wasn’t to freeload. Perhaps it was purely because the Phoenix Race was too weak now and couldn’t afford to entertain the other party. The Phoenix Patriarch’s heart was depressed.
At the same time.
Shi Yu and the others, who were freeloading, completed this spatial travel perfectly.
Not only did he obtain the resources, but Chi Tong’s clone also completed the evolution of the Vermillion Bird and changed the history of the Phoenix Race and the empress dynasty perishing together in the future. It could be said that it could return perfectly.
However, the archeological results this time made Shi Yu very conflicted.
The key stone that connected to another super planet… If that super planet was regarded as a large ruins space, then this, like the ruins prop, was a login device.
However… it was different from ordinary ruins props. Ordinary methods couldn’t activate it at all.
The usage method was lost…
Forget it, even if he didn’t lose it, Shi Yu didn’t dare to try it easily. What if this thing broke over time?
What if it couldn’t return after the Teleportation? Even if that Phoenix said that it could teleport back and forth, it was still a huge pit for people who didn’t master the usage method.
Shi Yu decided to take it back and study it first.
…
Phoenix Empire.
After Empress Huang Xi succeeded the throne, she had been using lightning methods to gather the power of the Empire. However, in the short term, it was still unlikely for the Phoenix Empire to change its name to the Dong Huang Dynasty and become the Human Empire. After all, the Empire was troubled internally and externally now, and there were many things to deal with.

chapters.title: Chapter 1224 - 1224 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (2)
chapters.content:
1224 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (2)
Even if the empress wanted to incorporate the Eastern humans, she would need to work hard for a long time.
Now, a well-known enemy of the Phoenix Empire was the Phoenix Race of Phoenix Island. Although ordinary people didn’t know about the small-scale conflict between the Phoenix Empire and Phoenix Island, the human experts and totem creatures in the east knew very well.
Before the empress displayed strength comparable to the Phoenix Race, not many people were willing to join a country with huge war hidden dangers.
In the Phoenix Palace, Empress Huang Xi looked into the distance in silence. She had always been very worried about Shi Yu going to Phoenix Island. Previously, when the dual sun phenomenon appeared in the sky, she suspected that something had happened to Phoenix Island.
“Sister Empress!” Just as the empress’s thoughts were heavy, a voice entered her ears, making her face darken. However, at the same time, she was delighted. She looked at the sky. This voice appeared in her heart and belonged to telepathy.
A moment later, the empress rose into the sky and looked at Shi Yu and the others sitting on the cloud, as well as a pile of round Shi Yu pets. “You guys…”
She looked stunned.
Wait a minute, what was going on with them?
She looked at Shi Yu, Eleven, the big worm, and the others who had become fatter. She suspected that Shi Yu had gone to roast and eat all the Phoenixes of the Phoenix Race.
“This is for you.” Shi Yu threw out a bottle that contained a drop of water. Shi Yu said, “I’ve already negotiated with the Phoenix Race. From today onwards, the Phoenix Race is an ally of the Dong Huang Human Race.”
“This is the entire process of me talking to them. digest it and wait for the Phoenix Race to visit.”
“As for me, I might have to leave. I might return, or I might not return.”
“What?” When Shi Yu finished speaking, the empress was in disbelief. The Phoenix Race… was resolved just like that??
At the same time, Shi Yu’s other words instantly made the empress very concerned.
“Leave? You won’t come back. What do you mean?”
“The literal meaning is that you should understand after digesting these memories. If you don’t return, it means that we’ve gone to explore a higher realm.” Shi Yu smiled.
Shi Yu believed that without the threat of the Phoenix Race, as a hybrid Legendary, it wasn’t impossible for the empress to live until the Mythical Revival a thousand years later.
With the empress presiding over Dong Huang in this space and time, he was relieved…
In the next moment, the empress received Shi Yu’s memories as a World Tree Envoy and memories of the Phoenix Race’s super-divine ruins. She knew what Shi Yu’s “identity” and the super-divine resources of the Phoenix Race were.
Just like the Phoenix Race Patriarch, she was extremely shocked.
Shi Yu also left and began to digest his gains in this space and time.
After a long time…
The empress looked at Shi Yu and the others’ disappearing backs. In the end, she returned to the Phoenix Palace in silence and waited for the Phoenix Race to arrive.
For a period of time, Shi Yu secretly paid attention to the entire process of the empress dynasty and the Phoenix Race successfully establishing diplomatic relations. When the spatial rejection reached the maximum, they were teleported back to the original space and time by the awakened Qi.
However, after leaving, Shi Yu kept feeling that he had forgotten something.
Only when he saw the pair of Golden-Winged Roc wings in the ruins did Shi Yu remember that there were still three Legendary resources that he had yet to ask the Garuda Empire for!
“What a big loss!”
On the ocean, Shi Yu, who was rushing back to Dong Huang, let out a heart-wrenching cry.
“Ling, why didn’t you remind me?”
Ling: “After eating so many Legendary resources in the Phoenix Race… haven’t you eaten enough?”
“No matter how small a mosquito is, it’s still meat.”
Ling: “It’s indeed my mistake. Looks like there’s still a bug in intelligence. It might have to be raised to transcendent to be able to calculate everything.”
“The next one to break through to the demigod level can be me.”
Shi Yu waved his hand and said with a dark expression, “Stop tricking me. Next… let Buggy do it. If there’s no special situation like the Phoenix Race Ruins, our breakthrough order will be according to the order of entry into the team.”
“Don’t fight between any of you. It’s fair.”
Chi Tong was an accident this time. It was definitely not because of the treatment of a biological daughter.
“Ji?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, on the cloud, Buggy cried and crawled out of the cotton cloud. Look, what did it hear!!
This was the most humane thing it had heard from Shi Yu this year.
“Ji!!!” Buggy pounced on Shi Yu with tears streaming down its face. Beast Tamer!! Love you!!
“Alright!!” Ling said helplessly, “This is also good. We can strengthen the spatial strength in advance.”
“Alright, let me see the message first,” Shi Yu said.
It had been a few days since Shi Yu and the others transmigrated. All kinds of information had been stored.
Among them, there was a pile of trash information.
For example, Teacher Owl had gotten to know a few beautiful dragons, beautiful butterflies, and beautiful moths, wanting to introduce them to Buggy.
It was obvious that he had ill intentions and wanted to manually promote the success of the prophecy.
Shi Yu decisively deleted it…
Buggy didn’t need love!
He had to let the owl predict one wrong prophecy.
The prophecy was all correct. Shi Yu was afraid that it would become arrogant.
However, when he saw the owl, Shi Yu suddenly wanted to change direction. “Let’s go to the capital first.”
“Ling, call Teacher Ying and let it come too.”
“We’ll use the dual divine skills to assist in premonition and let Teacher Owl predict the relevant information about the super-divine resource brought back.”
“With a physical medium, its prediction accuracy can also be higher.”
“Alright.” Ling nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1225 - 1225 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (3)
chapters.content:
1225 Space Emperor and Evolution Legendary (3)
…
Before he studied the Teleportation Key Stone, Shi Yu thought of letting the gem cat use the wishing divine skill. Ling would use the luck divine skill to assist the owl in predicting its information.
As long as there was a trace, it could save them a lot of research energy.
In the sky above the capital.
When Shi Yu and the others arrived at Imperial Capital University, they happened to meet the gem cat that Ling had shaken over.
The cat girl rubbed her temples and looked at Shi Yu and the others. “Why are you using my Skill again when you just returned? You’re busy.”
“What’s the matter this time?”
On the cloud, Shi Yu looked at the cat girl who had changed into a suit and said happily, “Teacher Ying, you’re wearing pretty formal clothes.”
The cat girl in the suit said calmly, “That’s true. I’m the sect master cat of the Gem Financial Group now… My super multinational corporation is about to officially operate. When I earn big money, you won’t have to worry about food and drink.”
Shi Yu’s face darkened. This guy was really doing this. Was he trying to snatch business from the Blue Planet Alliance?
The gem cat: “Hey, hey, hey, what kind of expression is that? This is also under the Blue Planet Alliance. It’s legal.”
Shi Yu said, “That’s good… Didn’t I go to the sunken Phoenix Island to do archeology according to the memories of the Undying Dark Phoenix?”
The gem cat nodded. Yes, yes, so?
“Then, I obtained some trinkets, but there was too little relevant information. I needed to rely on premonition ability to provide some clues.”
Shi Yu also decided to replicate Teacher Owl’s Future Prediction this time. It was too troublesome to keep looking for it to predict the future.
However, Shi Yu kept feeling that Teacher Owl’s Future Prediction was more accurate than normal Future Prediction.
Other premonition pets weren’t as fierce as it. Overlords could predict demigods.
If he predicted it himself, it might not necessarily have such an Effect.
Unfortunately, the owl didn’t react at all when it fed the owl the Reincarnation Fruit, making Shi Yu, who thought that it was the reincarnation of a god, give up on this guess.
Perhaps it was really just that Teacher Owl was talented and had gained enlightenment?
Otherwise, there were higher-level secrets hidden on it.
“Huh? You really gained something.” At this moment, the gem cat was slightly stunned. It felt surprised, but not that surprised. She sighed. Forget it, she should have known. The ruins that Shi Yu had targeted definitely had to be tested before he would stop.
“Yeah, let’s go.” Shi Yu smiled.
The territory of the Prediction Owl was still the capital, but at this moment, as its identity leveled up, it had already moved away from the Imperial Capital University. With its current totem level identity, it was already the national guardian. It was a little wasteful to predict this and that prophecy for its students.
It was directly assigned a mystic realm under the arrangements of the association. When Shi Yu and the others arrived, Teacher Owl had already come out enthusiastically to welcome them.
