“Shi Yu!! Shi Yu!! Did you bring Brother Green Dragon Buggy for a blind date?” Grandma owl’s sharp voice was filled with joy. She was especially happy to see Shi Yu and the others arrive.
“Don’t even think about it. Buggy doesn’t need to date. Dating will only affect its speed of becoming stronger,” Shi Yu said.
“Come, help me predict an item.”
The owl’s expression turned bitter. “Wuu… Speaking of which, Shi Yu, your team won’t be single for the rest of their lives, right? You too…”
Shi Yu: “Aren’t you too?”
The owl : “…”
The gem cat girl said, “Hurry, hurry, hurry, old witch, predict it first. Hurry up. Time is money!”
“I know, I know. Come, come, come, what do you want to predict this time!” the Prediction Owl said.
Shi Yu and the others followed into the mystic realm. First, they gave the Prediction Owl a bunch of buffs. Then, Shi Yu threw out the key stone he had obtained from parallel space.
At this moment, as Shi Yu took out this special super gem, the gem cat girl’s eyes widened.
“This is…”
“It’s a trash stone. Don’t mind it…” Shi Yu said.
The gem cat girl: “Nonsense! You went to dig gems yourself behind my back again. Wu wu wu wu.”
“This, this can’t be the super-divine resource the Undying Dark Phoenix mentioned, right!”
“Didn’t it lose it with the empress and the others? Where did you find it!”
“You’re too ridiculous…”
“This thing…” The Prediction Owl had a serious expression. It could tell that this resource was extraordinary and that there were complicated traces of time flowing on its body.
It took a deep breath. It didn’t know if it could successfully predict the relevant information…
Shi Yu said, “I want to know if its usage method can help predict where the opportunity for us to obtain its usage method is in the future. If it really doesn’t work, any relevant information is fine.”
“I’ll give it a try…” the Prediction Owl said.
The hexagram in front of his chest glowed slightly. He looked at the key stone in front of him and closed his eyes…
Then, it spoke…
“Well, why does your prediction feel strange?”
“Superdivine-level resource… Damn it, I, the owl overlord, can predict demigods. Now that I’ve reached the totem level and with two divine skill buffs, I can definitely predict transcendent-level!”
“The heavens didn’t give birth to me, the owl…” The Prediction Owl encouraged itself as it predicted.
Shi Yu and the others looked at the owl solemnly. Then, the owl’s expression suddenly froze.
“This is…”
After being stunned, it right on the heels of shouting that it was impossible!
In the dark premonition scene, the Prediction Owl seemed to be racing. Its vision shuttled crazily, as if it had passed through the cosmic starry sky and arrived at another planet. At the same time, the energy on its body was also crazily consumed!!
In the end, it saw two figures.
These two figures were sometimes blurry and sometimes clear. The Prediction Owl saw a pile of similar rocks in front of them!!
The Prediction Owl believed in these two figures and definitely wasn’t wrong.
“Space Emperor, Lin Feng Legendary… How can it be them??”
It was the legendary emperor of Dong Huang, the Space Emperor, who had already disappeared in the starry sky of the universe, and the legendary Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, Lin Feng, who had also suddenly disappeared!
Moreover, the vast divine power on their bodies made the Prediction Owl feel that it far exceeded the Legendary, demigod, and even demigod-level reincarnation gods it had seen!
These two figures were not the past Space Emperor and Lin Feng, but the current or future Space Emperor and Lin Feng. The Prediction Owl was very certain.
It shouted in disbelief. At the same time, its feathers quickly withered, and its aura kept weakening, as if it had aged dozens of years. Its life aura disappeared very quickly, faster than any premonition in the past:
“Holy shit, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng are still alive and might have broken through to the divine level. They’re on another planet. They also have a stone like you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1226 - 1226 Space (1)
chapters.content:
1226 Space (1)
The owl’s premonition this time completely exceeded Shi Yu’s expectations.
Emperor Kong and Legendary Lin Feng were still alive?
Moreover, it broke through to the divine level?
Moreover, they also had a pile of similar rocks in their hands?
Legendaries like the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, who had not disappeared in battle and were relatively close to the modern era, were still alive in a certain place. Shi Yu was actually not very surprised.
However, if the owl said that they were on another planet and also held the Teleportation Key Stone, Shi Yu would be overthinking.
“Hey, hey, hey, what are you talking about?”
The gem cat girl was also stunned. Why did he predict the usage method to the Space Emperor and Lin Feng!
Was the Beast Tamer of the Void Mantis really still alive? And that legendary Feng…
“Cough…” The owl interrupted them and lay on the ground on the verge of death. Before it could say the word “save”, a ginseng baby had already started to save it!!
“Teacher Owl, hold on!” Shi Yu said.
The owl: “I’m going to die… I’m going to die…”
“Don’t worry, with my rich EXP consumption, with the supplements of the ginseng baby, you can recover in less than half a month.”
The owl’s vision darkened. After a while, it was pulled back by Baby Ginseng and sat on the ground. It widened its eyes while panting and felt a lingering fear.
Damn it, it looked at the Teleportation Key Stone in horror and decided not to predict this thing anymore.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng made the owl believe in its technology.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought beside him. In his mind, he recalled what the owl had just said.
Could it be that after the Space Emperor and Lin Feng disappeared, they went to this super planet that the Teleportation Key Stone led to?
They also had the Teleportation Key Stone in their hands. Did this mean that the gods had not only brought back one key stone, but a pile?
Many missing legendaries and demigods left through this method.
No, according to the description, this key stone could return. Why didn’t they return again?
Even if Blue Planet couldn’t withstand the divine level at the moment, they shouldn’t have broken through to the divine level just after arriving at other planets, right?
As long as a returnee left behind information, Blue Planet wouldn’t be completely ignorant about that super planet at the moment.
Shi Yu got Ling to analyze it. Although he instantly analyzed many possibilities, he couldn’t be very certain of any of them.
However, what was certain was that if Shi Yu went out to wander the starry sky one day…
Perhaps he could encounter the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
“I feel that Teacher Owl still predicted loneliness. In the end, I still can’t confirm the opening method of the Teleportation Key Stone…”
…
In the depths of the universe, on a high-level planet.
A handsome and elegant man met another young man who looked very weak in the sky.
“Lin Feng.” Seeing the young man’s Enfeeble appearance, the handsome man said calmly, “You’re working too hard.”
The young man named Lin Feng smiled and said, “The consumption of deducing the super divine-level evolution path is too huge. It can’t be helped. Senior Space Emperor, you also sensed it, right?”
“Someone is deducing our traces of existence. The one with this ability should be a super-divine-level god, right? I wonder if it’s friend or foe.”
“That’s not important. The main point is that there’s still no news of the mother planet on Kai’s Planet?”
“No, could it be that an accident happened to them? Logically speaking, they should have already sent the key stone to their home planet at this time.” Lin Feng felt that it was strange.
“It can’t be helped. Let’s wait a little longer.”
“I wonder how Dong Huang is now under the governance of Old Man Divine Source,” Lin Feng sighed.
Emperor Kong said, “If there’s no news in a year, join forces with them and send out another team. We have to contact Blue Planet before the revival of the laws of Blue Planet.”
The Space Emperor looked at the starry sky and fell into memories.
He wondered what had become of Blue Planet.
Back then, when he explored the starry sky, he accidentally entered the universe void and was teleported to an extremely far place from Blue Planet.
After working hard and breaking through to the divine level, he realized that this was the center of the universe. Only then did he see an even vaster world.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t go back now.
Even if he broke through to the divine level and contracted ten spatial divine beasts, it was still difficult for him to return to his mother planet.
Although it was a pity, there was nothing he could do. However, to the Space Emperor’s surprise, he also discovered the faction left behind by the gods of the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era in the center of the universe.
Dragon Race, Phoenix Race, Angel Race, Demon Race… Many gods from Blue Planet had already left their traces in the universe.
It was even to the extent that the leader among them had already exceeded the divine level.
However, even so, it was still difficult for these gods to return to Blue Planet.
Firstly, the laws of that starry sky had been broken and couldn’t withstand their existence. Secondly, the consumption of the return trip was too huge. It was Difficult to lock onto the location, and the return cost-effective ratio wasn’t high. There was nothing worth staying for on Blue Planet anymore.
After the baptism of time, these large races had even long forgotten that their mother planet was Blue Planet. Most of the initial batch of gods had already died. These could only be considered descendants.
It could be said that although he had come into contact with them, the Space Emperor didn’t feel the friendship of being from the same hometown from them.
Only when hundreds of years passed did another kid named Lin Feng, who claimed to be from Dong Huang, find him did the Space Emperor learn that he wasn’t the only one who had accidentally transmigrated from Blue Planet to the depths of the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1227 - 1227 Space (2)
chapters.content:
1227 Space (2)
This person named Lin Feng had better talent than him. Unfortunately, Lin Feng had also lost the direction of Blue Planet like him.
Compared to the divine factions of the Mythical Era, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng had a deeper obsession with Blue Planet, no, or rather, Dong Huang. As they became stronger, they also searched for a way to return.
After their hard work, they indeed found a way. Even the gods of the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era had tried this method, but there was basically no result, so they left it at that.
In the universe, above the divine level was the super divine level, and above the super divine level was the cosmic level.
In the starry sky of the universe, there were a total of five cosmic life forms, four cosmic emperors, and a cosmic overlord.
Among the four cosmic emperors, one was a cosmic planetary life form. It was the only super planet in the universe. This planet could be said to be the most prosperous place in the universe.
Many cosmic races that could gallop through the universe had something similar to a ruin stone. It was equivalent to the coordinates of a spatial teleportation array. They could freely teleport to this planet or freely teleport back to their mother planet.
Back then, the Blue Planet gods who entered the universe had tried to send the rare Teleportation Stone back to their mother planet and build the connection between Blue Planet and the universe through this stone.
However, it was unknown if it had failed to return or if Blue Planet had given up on connecting to the universe. There was still no news of Blue Planet.
As the Teleportation Key Stone was also a very precious treasure, and the price of returning to Blue Planet was too high, the gods who left Blue Planet didn’t try many times.
In fact, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng didn’t know very well what these gods had done. After all, it had been too long. It was already very difficult to see the initial gods. They had all returned to dust and earth. Not many had lost their lives in pursuit of higher realms.
The starry sky of the universe was even more of a cruel battlefield.
Now, as the time for the revival of the Blue Planet’s laws approached, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng started the second return plan. They found the large races that walked out of Blue Planet and joined forces with them to find Blue Planet’s coordinates. They sent a team to send a new batch of Teleportation Key Stones to Blue Planet.
This time, the Blue Planet faction was very cooperative. Firstly, it was mainly the Space Emperor and Lin Feng who contributed.
The second was because Lin Feng had received the blessings of the World Tree and confirmed that the revival of the laws on Blue Planet was in the near future.
The factions of Blue Planet weren’t doing well in the universe either. If Blue Planet could recover to the foundation of the Mythical Era and connect to a cosmic civilization, take another step forward and become a high-level planet, as direct descendants of Blue Planet, they could also obtain more benefits.
Both parties hit it off and carried out a new contact mother planet plan together. They were already waiting for the arrival of the Blue Planet rookies on the cosmic planet, World King Planet.
Now, these factions from Blue Planet only hoped that the newbies from Blue Planet would have better talent and replenish their new blood.
They didn’t have high requirements either. They were already satisfied if their talent was comparable to the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, two humans who had walked out of Blue Planet. These Blue Planet factions could be said to be extremely surprised that Blue Planet had actually started to nurture humans.
Was it a human seed brought back by a god?…
Humans were also very special races in the starry sky of the universe. Although their ranking among the ten thousand races in the starry sky was not high, for some special reasons, the position of humans in the universe was irreplaceable.
All the races in the starry sky were basically related to humans. They grew together in a one-on-one equal contract. Even universe overlord who destroyed planets rarely destroyed human planets. Ordinary people didn’t know why.
…
Blue Planet…
After leaving the owl, Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng to slack off and not let himself think too much.
It was useless to think too much. After all, he hadn’t even reached the maximum level of the current version of Blue Planet. He wasn’t qualified to explore the starry sky at all.
His own Beast Taming level was still one level away from level nine. Among his pets, only Eleven and Chi Tong had reached the demigod level. Susu was barely considered half.
Moreover, even Eleven and Chi Tong had yet to reach the pinnacle of the demigod level. After all, quasi-divine skills could still continue to add points. Only when the points were perfect could they be considered to have advanced to the divine level.
“Ling, I’ll leave it to you. There’s no hurry to study this thing. Just leave it to the clone to tinker with.”
After returning, Shi Yu threw the Teleportation Key Stone to Ling. Right on the heels of that, under the angry expression of Ling’s clone, he pulled Ling’s main body to see the situation of the three new pets.
Turtle, Little Quas Snake, and Dwarf Cat.
A candidate pet for the Black Tortoise and White Tiger cultivation plan.
Now that he had the Green Dragon and the Vermillion Bird, Shi Yu felt that it was time to put the other two on the agenda.
At the moment, after Shi Yu used the Legendary Ruins to seal Yun An, these three guys had all moved to Little Purple’s star world to train.
Little Purple was a planetary life form, the Son of the Stars. Now that it had reached the overlord level, it was completely no problem to put the commander-level Turtle, Little Quas, and transcendent-level short-legged cat into its inner world.
After the inner world reached perfect proficiency, it was basically no problem to put a life form that was also at the overlord level into the inner world.
Under Shi Yu’s additional points, Little Purple’s world upper limit had long been raised to the overlord level. Shi Yu could also enter.
At the moment, although Little Purple was only an overlord-level life form, the growth Effect in Little Purple’s inner world had already exceeded ordinary legendary ruins. The Son of the Stars Race could be said to be very awesome and exciting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1228 - 1228 Space (3)
chapters.content:
1228 Space (3)
“Mi!!” After being summoned by Shi Yu, Little Purple curled into a ball and rubbed against Shi Yu’s hand. It looked at Shi Yu eagerly and asked when it could participate in the battle.
Shi Yu smiled bitterly at this question. What did Eleven and the others instill in this guy again?
“Mi!”
Little Zi looked serious. It didn’t want to be beaten up like Blue Planet!
“No hurry, no hurry. You’ll only be considered an adult when you reach the divine level. It’s still too early.”
In fact, in the beginning, Shi Yu only wanted to nurture Little Zi as a support.
A planetary life form was only a support in the first place.
Generally speaking, planetary life forms had three common Race Skills, inner world, world power, and world blessing.
The first move was to increase the size of the inner world and the upper limit of one’s level. It was not used in battle. It was a cultivation-type Skill, similar to the upgrade of the Beast Taming Space.
It was a proper support skill.
Second, the power of the world could mobilize the various natural powers, the power of the Void, the power of faith, the power of laws, and many other power systems in the inner world to attack. This was indeed the attack method of a planetary life form, but the problem was that it was easy to transfer it out, but it was difficult to replenish it.
Back then, Blue Planet also participated in the war of the Mythical Era. Apart from being related to the battle of other divine-level creatures, Blue Planet also participated in the war.
Without the help of Blue Planet, the chances of the life on Blue Planet defeating the three invaders were very small.
After this battle, Blue Planet consumed a lot of energy and would only recover after recuperating for countless years. One could imagine the price of a planetary life form consuming the power of its world.
At the moment, Little Zi had just entered the overlord level. Its absorption of external nutrition was already comparable to a totem.
When it reached the totem level, its consumption would probably be comparable to the divine level.
If it weren’t for the fact that it also had more feedback to Beast Tamers, Shi Yu definitely wouldn’t be able to afford to raise this guy in the future.
Therefore, although there were attack methods, this attack couldn’t be used easily. The higher the level, the more it couldn’t be used.
Using a little would cause the weather in the inner world to change and a natural disaster to appear. This was very unfriendly to the life in the body.
Therefore, ordinary planetary life forms cultivated the lives in their bodies. Like a Beast Tamer, they let the lives born in their bodies harvest resources in their place to protect themselves.
This way, their consumption could be reduced to the minimum. Only if they had no choice would the planet life form attack themselves.
It was precisely because of this that Shi Yu didn’t want Little Zi to fight too… His family was really at a loss.
Third, the World Blessing. This was also a cultivation method for planetary life forms. It could bring various magical strengthenings to other lives.
For example, the World Tree Blessing Shi Yu received was a type of world blessing.
The Effect of this world’s blessing depended on the direction of the planet’s upgrade. For example, the cultivation system of the Star Continent in Little Purple’s body mainly cultivated the power of faith of the four holy beasts. Therefore, Little Purple could also mobilize the power of faith of the four holy beasts and give birth to various blessings.
For example, providing Buggy with the power of faith, or giving it Black Tortoise and White Tiger Blessings when the turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty trained in its body.
This way, they could evolve faster in this direction.
From the three Skills, planetary life forms were not very suitable for their own battles. Therefore, Shi Yu had never nurtured Little Purple as a combatant.
However, Shi Yu should have expected it long ago. There would definitely be a problem if he handed Little Purple to Eleven, Buggy, and the others to train their Resistance…
Shi Yu could only temporarily suppress Little Purple’s battle desire…
At least, the battle Skills he could come into contact with now were not suitable for the life forms on Little Purple’s planet to learn. Just like Qi, it couldn’t learn anything. Shi Yu could only wait until he went to the starry sky in the future to see if there were any planet battle Skills suitable for Little Purple to learn that didn’t affect him.
At that time, he would replicate their skills!
For example, what the Phoenix God had said about a super planet that exceeded Blue Planet by two levels. Shi Yu had already started to look forward to whether it had any Superdivine Planet Skills.
“Master, Master…” Beside him, Ling saw Shi Yu begin to smile unconsciously again. It was suddenly distracted and was very helpless. It kept feeling that Shi Yu would definitely have Alzheimer’s when he was old.
“Cough.” Shi Yu patted his face and looked at Little Purple floating in front of him.
“In the next period of time, I’ll add points to Little Purple to the peak of the overlord level first and personally supervise the Resistance training of Turtle, Little Quas, and the Shorty.”
“I feel that I should be able to contract a new demigod when the time comes, right?” Shi Yu asked Ling.
Ling nodded and said, “It’s about the same. Little Purple, let me ask you. What’s the equivalent of adding 3×47 points?”
“Next, it’s your turn to add points again!”
“Mi… (1221 times.)” Little Zi revealed a bitter expression. It wanted to add points again. Although it also liked it, it had to control itself… It might have the most complicated emotions towards adding points in the team.
Because as soon as it came up, it added some super Skills. Accompanied by the comfortable feeling of leveling up and the huge Affliction, it was painful and happy.
Unlike Eleven and the others, who had the joy of laying the foundation for a bunch of low-level Skills.
The race level was too high, and there were no trash Skills. The consequence of not being able to learn trash Skills was that there was a Resistance requirement from the start.
Shi Yu: “1221? Ling, did you teach Little Purple how to count well?”
Ling: “If it really doesn’t work, let’s empower it through the memory water drop. I can’t teach it anymore.”
Shi Yu slapped his forehead. Sigh, it must be that the nutrition of Blue Planet’s sap was not enough and did not lay the foundation for Little Purple.
Why was its planetary life form still a bottom-feeder, even inferior to Little Ji’s basic intelligence?
Little Zi: Mi?
Did it calculate wrongly? Did it calculate wrongly? It started to argue solemnly… 3×47… 3×4 = 12, 3×7 = 21, 1221. That’s right.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 1229 - 1229 Dragon Palace Rebellion (1)
chapters.content:
1229 Dragon Palace Rebellion (1)
In the inner world of the Son of the Stars, Little Purple, there were three otherworldly islands in the Star Continent.
It was called Turtle Island, Snake Island, and Cat Island.
Shi Yu’s three clones were trainers. They were respectively on the island, accompanying Turtle, Little Quas Snake, and Shorty to train their Resistance.
His main body was working overtime in the outside world. As he added points to Little Purple, he meditated and cultivated.
At the moment, the star world in Little Purple’s body was developing pretty well. Although Shi Yu didn’t understand in detail, he also knew that a monarch-level life form and several commander-level life forms had already been born inside.
As Little Purple broke through, the native lives of the Star Continent obtained many benefits.
However, what was more speechless was that high-level lives were all wild beasts. Not long after the cultivation era began in Little Zi’s body, the evolution speed of wild beasts began to far exceed that of humans.
Although humans could also cultivate the power of totems and strengthen themselves, the strongest at the moment had yet to exceed the transcendent level. Just like the humans on Blue Planet, compared to transcendent lives, their battle power was very weak. They just had some insignificant special abilities.
This made Shi Yu feel that there was something wrong with the laws of the universe. Why was it so targeted at humans? This was even the result of Little Zi taking extra care of humans.
Otherwise, humans would probably have long been destroyed by transcendent beasts.
Shi Yu also felt that this couldn’t continue, so he got Little Purple to change the cultivation system of humans. It was still that humans could sign a contract with transcendent lives. Moreover, the growth of transcendent lives could feedback to human Stats and accelerate human cultivation speed.
This way, the growth of the humans in the Star Continent might be smoother.
…
While Shi Yu was working overtime, Shi Yu’s other pets were not idle either.
In the second Beast Taming Space, Little Ji and Duckie gathered together and played Gomoku to determine the winner.
In the Beast Taming Space, there was not allowed to be too much commotion. As time passed, the martial arts battle could only become a literary battle.
In any case, it was equivalent to training their intelligence. Little Ji and Duckie felt that it wasn’t a waste of time.
This situation also happened on Team One’s side.
Ling was obsessed with research and Susu received inheritance. Chi Tong pulled Buggy to film a historical movie and let Qi comment as an audience. Baby Ginseng farmed, and Eleven slept…
It finally didn’t look that complicated. What everyone did basically had nothing to do with training, apart from Susu running away secretly and chasing after Chi Tong.
During this period, Shi Yu and Buggy’s [Time Traveler] account finally updated one after another.
For example, once “Emperor Wu Legendary” and “Empress Legendary” were released, they exploded on the Internet and finally lifted the veil of lost history.
“As expected of the strongest archeologist.”
Elder Gu of Bureau 11, who had explored the Mythical Ruins, sat in the garden with President Lin. As he drank tea, he watched the videos Shi Yu had updated.
At this moment, Gulao, who had lost contact with the outside world for six years, was already completely convinced. He knew that this newbie from Bureau 11 was extraordinary.
Although he still felt like he had left reality, with the truth in front of him, he had to admit that the current Shi Yu was the strongest archeologist, the strongest Legendary on Blue Planet…
“The ice dragon of the Emperor Shi Dynasty was awakened by him.”
“He resolved the great enemy of Emperor Wu Dynasty, Yun An.”
“It was also the one who dealt with the source of disaster left behind by the empress dynasty, the Undying Dark Phoenix.”
“Now, the connections of the five dynasties of Dong Huang can almost be pieced together.”
“I really didn’t expect that the strongest Beast Tamer today would actually be a new archeologist.” Gu Yun still sighed.
“Is this the so-called evolution era under the revival of laws? I really don’t know if more strange geniuses will appear in the future.”
“It’s probably very difficult,” President Lin said. “I feel that Shi Yu’s aptitude has already exceeded the restrictions of Blue Planet. Probably only the vast universe starry sky can find a genius who can compete with him.”
“For example, my great-grandfather, Lin Feng. Who would have thought that he had already broken through to the divine level and started to wander the starry sky of the universe?” President Lin Xiao smiled.
“I wonder how he will feel if he knows that Dong Huang has a Beast Tamer more talented than him.”
“Space Emperor, the confirmation of Lin Feng’s Legendary traces is indeed very shocking. However, can Teacher Owl’s premonition really be taken seriously?”
At this moment, President Lin had already learned Shi Yu’s premonition results from the Prediction Owl.
This outcome was undoubtedly shocking. However, considering the uncertainty of the premonition, everyone couldn’t be happy too early.
Elder Gu had this doubt. Of course, he looked forward to it being true more. This way, he might have a chance to see those Legendary ancients in the future.
“This is what we’re going to discuss in the next meeting,” President Lin said. He had already decided to hold the highest meeting to discuss the owl prophecy and study how to contact Lin Feng and the others.
If this premonition result was correct, then Dong Huang’s development of technology to explore the starry sky was undoubtedly the right path.
President Lin put down his teacup and was just about to get up when his expression suddenly changed.
He had just received the news.
Intense energy fluctuations continued to appear in the East Sea.
“Something happened in Dragon Palace City,” President Lin said. Beside him, Elder Gu was also shocked.
Dragon Palace City.
Although they were allies with Dong Huang, one was a totem faction, the other was a human faction, the other was far away in the Deep Sea Mystic Realm, and the other was on land. Apart from some important things, the connection wasn’t that close.

chapters.title: Chapter 1230 - 1230 Dragon Palace Rebellion (2)
chapters.content:
1230 Dragon Palace Rebellion (2)
Generally speaking, both parties had their own operating systems and rarely interfered.
But this time, President Lin looked in the direction of the East Sea solemnly…
A demigod-level dispute?
Before President Lin could ask for more information, a familiar voice suddenly sounded in his heart.
His special contact information with Great-grandfather Lin Feng’s second team pet…
At the same time, a miserable and heavily injured figure had already arrived.
“Senior Sea Dragon King.”
“What happened?”
Seeing this figure, President Lin was slightly shocked. He looked at its injuries and quickly asked what had happened.
“Little Lin.” The Sea Dragon King shrunk to a form of more than ten meters. After arriving in a very weak Enfeeble state, it immediately looked at President Lin.
It was Lin Feng’s second team pet. During its growth stage, President Lin had received a lot of care from it, so it could naturally be called Little Lin.
The Sea Dragon King said, “In the Dragon Palace’s coup, three dragon gods of the Mythical Era revived from the Dragon God Ruins.”
“Moreover, they want to snatch Dragon Palace City!”
“What?!” President Lin was shocked.
After the revival of the laws, many Mythical creatures revived. As the inheritance of the Mythical Era, theoretically speaking, there would definitely be gods revived.
Initially, President Lin was still thinking that at that time, Dong Huang’s allies could expand further.
Unexpectedly, he directly heard the news of the Dragon Palace’s coup from the Sea Dragon King.
The Sea Dragon King panted and said solemnly, “The three revived gods are all pursuers of the Ancestral Dragon. They were once generals under the top-notch Divine Ancestral Dragon.”
“Dragon Palace City is an inheritance left behind by the dragon race. They’re very dissatisfied with the change in faith in Dragon Palace City.”
“All the sources originated from Dragon Palace City. Some areas changed to the faith of the Green Dragon. They think that the Green Dragon and the Ancestral Dragon being put together is blasphemy.
“The three revival gods casually destroyed the things related to the Green Dragon, causing an internal dispute in Dragon Palace City. Lord Dragon God was forced to abdicate, and Lord Dragon God was unwilling, so the two parties fought.”
“However, Lord Dragon God is one against three and can’t resist well at all. She’s not their match. The two parties are still in a confrontation.”
“Fortunately, the three gods shouldn’t be willing to have a big battle in Dragon Palace City and destroy the mystic realm, so it’s only a small-scale collision at the moment.”
“Ridiculous.” After President Lin heard that, his anger burned. But soon, it was as if a basin of cold water had been splashed on him. This was because Dragon Palace City was indeed an inheritance faction of the Mythical Dragon Race, and the faith of the Green Dragon was derived later.
Now that the original owner had returned, it was also within expectations to reorganize Dragon Palace City.
However, President Lin still found it difficult to accept.
“What has it got to do with the Green Dragon? The Mythical Era has already ended for so long. The Green Dragon Legendary has long gone deep into Dragon Palace City. The faith of the Green Dragon has already spread throughout the world. Many generations of the Ancient Dragon God Dynasty’s Green Dragon have evolved.”
The sword of the previous dynasty was here to kill the officials of this dynasty?
“We also advised Lord Dragon God to admit defeat first, but she refused.” The Sea Dragon King had a bitter expression.
“Therefore, I can only come and ask Dong Huang for help.”
“After all, a portion of the Green Dragon faith in Dragon Palace City is Shi Yu. He’s currently the greatest beneficiary of the Green Dragon faith. Perhaps he still has to come out and help.”
President Lin felt a headache.
This matter was indeed not easy to deal with.
After this generation’s Dragon God succeeded the throne, the faith in the Green Dragon in Dragon Palace City had indeed relaxed a lot.
It was mainly because the Dragon Emperor had also cultivated a green dragon, and the Dragon God had also participated.
Therefore, the Dragon God had far more feelings for the faith of the Green Dragon than the faith of the Ancestral Dragon.
In addition, Shi Yu had also cultivated a green dragon. It was not too difficult to let the Dragon God watch them destroy the green dragon in Dragon Palace City.
Gu Yun said solemnly, “We can’t give up Dragon Palace City.”
“I know. I’ll contact Shi Yu immediately.”
“Perhaps only Shi Yu can solve this matter,” President Lin said.
Not only was Shi Yu an envoy of the World Tree, but he was also Dong Huang’s strongest battle power at the moment.
The opponent was three demigods. At the moment, Divine Source Legendary was sleeping. With the gem cat not good at battle, only Shi Yu could reinforce the Dragon God and see if he could rely on his identity as the World Tree Envoy to cool down the anger of the three Mythical Era divine dragons.
The Sea Dragon King said, “Tell Shi Yu to be careful. A god that has been suppressed to the strength of a demigod is far stronger than ordinary demigods on Blue Planet. It’s very difficult for Lord Dragon God to fight one alone…”
“Moreover, there are still three opponents. It can be said that every one of them has battle power above Yun An.”
President Lin felt a headache.
But in the next moment, he felt an even greater headache.
“I can’t contact Shi Yu again. I can’t contact him in any way!!!”
“Where did this kid go at such a critical moment?”
Elder Gu and the Sea Dragon King were stunned.
“I’ll contact Teacher Ying first and let her find it.” President Lin was numb.
…
At this moment, the Shi Yu Dong Huang was searching for was training in the starry sky.
It was easy to get sick from holding it in in one place all the time.
Shi Yu would occasionally cultivate bitterly in Ping Cheng and occasionally go to other places to change his mood.
After a round of cultivation, Shi Yu’s realm quickly increased.
Not long ago, his second Beast Taming Space had reached level eight.
After the second Beast Taming Space broke through to level eight, Shi Yu immediately received powerful feedback, and his physical fitness increased exponentially.
According to Ling’s judgment, it was no longer a problem for Shi Yu to contract another demigod.
As for this new demigod, Shi Yu planned to join the team according to what he had said previously and chose Buggy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1231 - 1231 Dragon Palace Rebellion (3)
chapters.content:
1231 Dragon Palace Rebellion (3)
Outside Blue Planet, in the starry sky, Buggy had been looking forward to it for a long time.
This breakthrough was not only an increase in growth level, but also an evolution. When the Dragon of Imagination reached transcendent proficiency, it would take it one step closer to the Green Dragon.
“During this breakthrough, I want to try the fusion of a top-notch super Skill.”
“I’ll try to fuse a quasi-divine skill for you.” Shi Yu stood on the meteorite and smiled at the green dragon in front of him.
Buggy’s pile of top-notch super Skills should have a higher success rate after reaching transcendent proficiency.
For Buggy’s breakthrough, Shi Yu and the others could be said to be fully armed.
Baby Ginseng had long run to Shi Yu and connected its life to Shi Yu’s to prevent Shi Yu from dying.
In the starry sky, Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and the others also looked at Buggy in disdain.
Although Buggy shouted that it would evolve first and that there was definitely nothing good about breaking through first, it was more excited than anyone to break through to the demigod level first. No one was willing to give in to the order.
“Roar!! (Beast Tamer, charge, charge!!)”
Buggy said excitedly.
“Then I’ll start,” Shi Yu said.
“Roar!!!” In the meteorite group, the green dragon Buggy’s golden eyes filled with light as it roared and nodded.
Boom!!!
In the next moment, a terrifying dragon might erupted from Shi Yu’s body. His black eyes also turned into golden eyes.
Psychic Domain, Green Dragon Domain!
Apart from that, Shi Yu also directly activated mental resonance and connected his and Buggy’s hearts.
This way, it could better assist Buggy in breaking through and evolving through the power of points.
“Hu!” Shi Yu prepared to add points with one hand and used the illusory Book of Skills with the other to open the furnace page of skill fusion.
Dragon of Imagination.
Increase points!
Boom!!!
As Shi Yu added points, Buggy’s aura rose steadily. Energy surged in its entire body, and it was filled with the light of upgrade.
At the same time, Shi Yu had also tried to drag skills that had reached transcendent into the skill fusion interface many times!
Skill: Imagination Domain, Dream Control, Four Holy Clones, Queen Mother’s Power
[Fusion success rate]: Low
[Fusion Risk]: High
The success rate of these four Skills was low, but if all four of them fused, there was also a low success rate.
Shi Yu couldn’t help but be speechless.
However, when he saw this scene, the current Shi Yu only had madness in his eyes. It was the madness of a gambler.
“Hahahaha, is this the peak of level eight? What if it reaches level nine?”
Shi Yu laughed crazily, making Eleven and the others speechless.
“Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, Susu, Ling, Little Purple, get ready!”
With Shi Yu’s command, many pets prepared to support and add points. Now, Little Zi’s World Blessing Skill had also reached (Perfect+47). It was completely not inferior to the super support of other pets.
Not only could it assist Buggy’s evolution through the power of faith, but it could also give Shi Yu blessings and reduce his burden.
“Roar!!!” At the same time, Buggy began to stop suppressing its strength and completely activated the power of the transcendent-level Dragon of Imagination, allowing itself to advance to a more perfect green dragon image.
This time, the evolution materials Shi Yu prepared for Buggy were similar to the evolution materials of Chi Tong’s Vermillion Bird clone. They were faith items he had gathered from various spaces!
The power of faith inside!
Boom!!!
Under the lead of the power of skill upgrade, the power of skill fusion, and the power of faith of the Green Dragon, the energy on Buggy’s body became more and more terrifying.
Like a self-destructing ginseng baby, its energy level kept expanding.
“Ah!!!!!”
“Roar!!!”
Under the light of the green-gold breakthrough evolution that illuminated the starry sky, Shi Yu and Buggy let out heart-wrenching Affliction sounds at the same time. Even with the support of Baby Ginseng, Susu, and many other pets, it was quite difficult this time.
Of course, this was the first time he was fusing with a top-notch super Skill. Shi Yu didn’t care about the Affliction anymore. As long as he saw Buggy become stronger, he felt that everything was worth it.
In this evolution, Shi Yu sensed that Buggy’s form had actually not changed much. The greatest change was its size.
Under the full multiplication eruption, the shocking body of a cosmic life form that was tens of thousands of meters tall occupied the outside of the star. It was as if the power of a claw was enough to destroy a city.
A terrifying aura swept through the starry sky for 50,000 kilometers.
“Roar!!!”
Of course, the benefits of Shi Yu’s evolution breakthrough at the cost of his old age and white hair were far more than this.
Boom…
Under the lingering power of faith, it was like the sound of the world trembling. With Buggy’s body as the plane, the entire starry sky seemed to have been torn apart and opened, developing the ground and sky, forming a new world.
In the blink of an eye, Eleven, Chi Tong, and the others were shocked to discover that there were no longer any traces of the starry sky around them. They seemed to have entered another space.
This space was extremely real. The feeling it gave Eleven and the others didn’t feel like Buggy’s Imagination Domain.
Among them, Baby Ginseng in Shi Yu’s arms widened its eyes in surprise. It had discovered that its World Grace Skill could actually borrow the power of the world from this place. It was as if this was really a complete world!
After all, after leaving Blue Planet and arriving at the starry sky, its World Grace Skill couldn’t be used anymore. What was going on now?
In the Desolate World, the world had just opened and was endless. At some point in time, clouds had condensed and spring rain fell. Every drop of spring rain stimulated a weak sound of laws. The sound shocked the heart, but it gently nourished the ground.
When it dripped on the soil, a thousand-kilometer-long green grass, flowers, and saplings grew out of the soil. During their growth, the sound of wood-element life laws intertwined with the sound of water.
In the clouds, the phantom of the green dragon was faintly visible. When they saw its figure, Eleven and the others immediately felt their bodies reverse and the universe reverse. It was as if they were facing the god of creation. They involuntarily lost all control of themselves and were under the pressure of the world.
“Wuu!!” Eleven and the others resisted with serious expressions.
In the next moment.
“Roar!!!” As the green dragon roared, the world shattered. Shi Yu and the others returned to the starry sky.
The weak Shi Yu was first stunned before being overjoyed.
Evolution was a huge success.
[Imagination Domain, Dream Control, Four Holy Clones, Queen Mother’s Power] had already fused into the [Creation Domain].
Skill: Creation Domain
[Level]: Quasi God-level Faith Skill
< Introduction > The world is set up. The four dimensions are connected. Whether it’s death or life, everything is done.
It contained the laws of creation and could borrow the power of faith to create everything, derived the laws of heaven and earth corresponding to the power of faith.
It was a rare top-notch divine skill that could give birth to many laws!

chapters.title: Chapter 1232 - 1232 Creation Green Dragon God (1)
chapters.content:
1232 Creation Green Dragon God (1)
In the starry sky, the huge body of the Green Dragon Buggy occupied the outside of the meteorite group.
The green-gold light lit up the dark universe.
Be it Shi Yu or the pets who were saving Shi Yu, they looked at Buggy, who had completed a new round of evolution, in a daze.
“Creation Domain!”
Shi Yu shouted in disbelief.
What kind of Skill was this?
Creation Domain?
Damn, I made a killing.
Shi Yu was immediately blinded by joy.
It was as excited as Eleven when it awakened the Yin Yang Millstone.
He felt that the Dragon of Imagination wouldn’t have such a huge gain.
Most likely, it was still the skill fusion and the Green Dragon Domain that underwent a qualitative change.
The laws of creation… After all, even if the legendary Green Dragon was a Creation God, his Buggy was only at the demigod level at the moment.
The Creation Domain could create the world, four dimensions, life and death, and everything!
It could even give birth to many laws in its world.
For example, the rain law Shi Yu and the others had seen previously, the wood life law.
Or it could be combined into the law of spring.
A Skill contained many power of laws.
Just now, Buggy even felt that it could evolve plants into transcendent life forms in the Creation Domain with a thought.
It completely had the bearing of a Creation God.
But soon, Shi Yu realized that although the current Buggy’s strength had exploded, it was still too early to be called a Creation God.
The Legendary Green Dragon was first created and then believed in.
It didn’t rely on the power of faith at all. It had the ability to create the world in the first place, and it didn’t even care about the power of faith.
As for the current Buggy, it could only mobilize the laws of creation with the power of faith. The causal order was reversed. Although it was still powerful, it could still be seen that there was still a difference between it and the real Green Dragon.
Evolution was still not complete.
But even so, Shi Yu was quite satisfied.
Moreover, this skill could not only be used by mobilizing the power of faith.
Borrowing the power of faith could only make it stronger, but even without the power of faith, Buggy could control everything in the Creation Domain like a master of creation.
It perfectly included the nature of Skills such as the Imagination Domain, Dream Control, and the power of the Queen Mother. However, it couldn’t use the creation law.
The Law of Creation was undoubtedly a top-notch law. Moreover, it was even more perfect and functional than Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone.
These two guys were simply a god of creation and a god of destruction now.
Although this Creation Domain… consumed a lot of faith power, once it was activated, Buggy was invincible.
As long as it consumed enough power of faith, it wasn’t impossible to instantly suppress and insta-kill demigods. In the Creation Domain, as the Creation God, Buggy was like a divine level when facing demigods.
Without a doubt, it was another forbidden move in the team competition.
“Roar!!!” At this moment, Buggy could be said to be overjoyed.
Quasi-divine-level faith skill!!
Faith skills could also be cultivated into quasi-divine skills. For example, the Blue Sea Contract of the peak Blue Sea Sprite was both a faith skill and a quasi-divine skill.
Now, Buggy finally got its wish and became a Mythical Race.
[Name]: Buggy
[Race]: Green Silkworm → Green Silkworm cocoon → Butterfly of Imagination → Green Dragon (Second stage, in evolution)
[Race Level]: Low-level Mythical (Starry Sky Faith God)
[Level of Growth]: Totem level
[Race Skill]
“Super”: Dragon of Imagination (transcendent), Faith Skill, Dragon Star Group (transcendent), Space Control (transcendent), Faith Skill, Green Dragon Indestructible Body (transcendent)
“Quasi God-level”: Faith Skill, Creation Domain (Proficient)
Energy Points: 4,120 million
Because it was the fusion of four transcendent super Skills, Buggy had inherited a lot of EXP, so Buggy felt that it wasn’t unfamiliar with using this new Skill.
It looked at Shi Yu, who had been healing for a long time and didn’t heal much. It roared and activated the small Range Creation Domain, pulling Shi Yu and the others into a new world. It stretched out its claws and aimed at Shi Yu. The Spring Law was activated, and they strengthened and nourished Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu together.
“Yi ~” Baby Ginseng let out a comfortable cry and trembled.
“Stop, stop, stop.” Shi Yu hurriedly shouted for them to stop. He sensed that he was quickly recovering his Restoration state and panicked.
“There’s not much power of faith left, not much, don’t waste it…”
“Roar!!! (I’ll definitely do it next time!)” Buggy looked at Shi Yu’s Enfeeble appearance. So be it. His health was more important!
“Mi!!” Chi Tong pulled Susu and looked. Why did it feel that Buggy’s faith skill was much cooler than its?
“Ning…” Susu cried. Stop talking. It was the only one in the first team who wasn’t a Mythical Race.
Fortunately, it was also fast. It could immediately rely on itself to cultivate the Blue Sea Contract and the Sea Cleansing Spirit into quasi-divine skills through the power of inheritance!
“Wuu!” Eleven rubbed its fists. Not bad, not bad. The law of creation. It didn’t know if its Yin Yang Millstone could smash the world created by Buggy. But soon, it was pestered by Little Purple, indicating that it wanted to treasure and love the world!
Little Zi pulled the excited Eleven and looked at Buggy in admiration. So powerful. Although it could also do similar things, it couldn’t do something like Buggy, which derived the sound of laws.
Eleven pulled Little Purple away and stared at it. So which one of them was the creator of the universe?
….
After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu and the others rode the shrunken Green Dragon back to Blue Planet.
On the Green Dragon’s body, the pets were very excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 1233 - 1233 Creation Green Dragon God (2)
chapters.content:
1233 Creation Green Dragon God (2)
Too strong.
The Skill fused by the four top-notch super Skills was too strong.
Not only was it a quasi-divine skill, but it was also a quasi-divine skill that contained top-notch laws.
Even Eleven, who was holding the Yin Yang Millstone, couldn’t help but feel tempted. It wanted to fuse its other super top-notch Skills again.
Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, and the others, who were holding a pile of super top-notch Skills, had the same thought.
At that time, if he could have three to four quasi-divine skills, he would definitely be invincible.
However, in fact, only Shi Yu realized that the food crisis in the team might be even more serious next.
As Buggy broke through to the totem level and had demigod battle power, the pressure came to Baby Ginseng again.
“Gulp…”
“Yi…” Listening to Buggy’s stomach rumble, Baby Ginseng pouted. Buggy could already create the law of spring. Creating a fruit or something was much better than it.
It was recommended to be self-sufficient…
“Roar!” Buggy expressed that it wasn’t impossible, but it was a little wasteful of the power of faith. Forget it.
At most… it could run to the starry sky to eat small stars in the future and more or less relieve its hunger.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng stood on the Green Dragon Buggy with its hands on its hips, indicating that it was teasing it.
It wasn’t a big problem!
The next was for Baby Ginseng to break through.
It didn’t believe that a demigod-level world ginseng like it couldn’t afford to raise the entire team of demigods.
It had the World Grace Skill and could mobilize the power of the world on Blue Planet. It could choose not to believe it, but it had to believe that Blue Planet could afford to raise a few demigods.
At that time, the consumption of it using the world should be much smaller, unlike when it was at the overlord level. In short, at that time, there would be no pressure to freeload on Blue Planet’s nutrition.
“Ning, Ning!!” Susu expressed its support at the side. It was grateful for the gift of nature. It, who could connect to the sea, had never been hungry!
As the strongest ocean demigod, it made sense for Susu. Other demigods were still worried about food, but its food was inexhaustible. How could it not be strong?
However, Susu was still worried that it wouldn’t be able to connect to the sea on Blue Planet when it explored the starry sky in the future. It looked at Shi Yu eagerly, so when would it evolve into a Star Sea Sprite? It wanted to sign a contract with the Star Sea!
“Don’t worry, don’t worry… It’s your turn next.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “When the time comes, I’ll also use the skill fusion to assist in breakthrough evolution.”
“Let’s see if we can fuse your Star Sea Body with the Blue Sea Contract…”
“Ning!!”
“Master, Master.” As Shi Yu and the others were chatting, Ling suddenly said, “Not good.”
It looked panicked.
“President Lin sent a message saying that in the Dragon Palace City’s coup, three divine dragons from the Mythical Era revived in the Dragon God Ruins. Because they wanted to destroy the faith of the Green Dragon in Dragon Palace City, the Dragon God fought with them.”
“Now, not only do they want to let the Dragon God abdicate, but they also want to force a marriage.”
“Roar!!!”
As soon as Ling finished speaking, the entire team was stunned. Among them, Buggy even roared.
“Destroying the faith of the Green Dragon and forcing the Dragon God to marry?” Shi Yu immediately frowned.
“Are you sure??”
Everyone knew that the Dragon God had protected Dong Huang for more than a thousand years because of her deep relationship with the Dragon Emperor. Now that the Dragon Emperor of Dong Huang had died, the revived god of Dragon Palace City actually targeted the Dragon God. When Shi Yu heard that, he was immediately angry.
Revival of a god? Was he tired of living?
Buggy had just evolved and was worried that there was no place to test the power of the Creation Domain.
“Ling, lock onto the location. Buggy, accelerate.”
…
On the East Sea.
At this moment, everyone was paying attention.
Three gods had revived in Dragon Palace City. If they wanted to take back the power of Dragon Palace City and have a conflict with the current Dragon God, it couldn’t be hidden from the entire world.
The impact of demigod-level battle fluctuations on this incomplete planet was too great.
Perhaps only after the rules of Blue Planet were completely perfected could a demigod-level battle become a small battle.
Because both parties were worried about destroying Dragon Palace City, after a high-intensity confrontation, the battlefield gradually shifted to the East Sea.
At that moment, there were three divine dragons hundreds of meters long. Each of them had an energy aura as vast as a star, and the power of a demigod was undoubtedly displayed.
The leading one was covered in black and golden scales and emitted a very terrifying aura.
Its huge dragon eyes actually narrowed slightly.
Opposite them was the already rather miserable Dragon God covered in injuries, as well as the gem cat girl with a serious expression, and President Lin.
Apart from that, demigods from all over the world who had rushed over to watch the show because of the battle fluctuations were also hidden in all directions, including awakening gods.
For example, the Black Dragon lord of the Western Dragon Empire had finally broken through to the demigod-level, the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragonman Empire. These dragons were very concerned about the conflict in Dragon Palace City.
These three revival divine dragons probably had the intention to lead all the dragons. They guessed.
“You’re not bad. As a future god, you can fight me to this extent.”
“Seeing that your cultivation is not easy, as long as you agree to become our partner, you can still be the Dragon God of Dragon Palace City. We won’t interfere too much in the matters of Dragon Palace City, but we still have to eliminate all the messy Green Dragon faith.”
Dragons were perverted by nature. After sleeping for so long, they suddenly encountered a female with outstanding strength like the Dragon God. Although they went against each other at the start, soon, the Black Gold Divine Dragon and the others were gradually attracted by the Dragon God’s strength and special looks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1234 - 1234 Creation Green Dragon God (3)
chapters.content:
1234 Creation Green Dragon God (3)
The Dragon God panted deeply. It was naturally impossible for her to agree to the other party. However, every one of these three gods was very strong. It was probably not that easy to deal with.
“What if she doesn’t agree?” The Dragon God couldn’t be bothered with the other party, but the violent gem cat girl cursed.
“Don’t agree? Then I’ll let you forcefully agree. Treat it as atonement for betraying the faith of the Ancestral Dragon,” the Black Gold Divine Dragon said.
“Sir, do you really want to be enemies with our Dong Huang?” President Lin’s expression was dark. Previously, he had even taken out the World Tree, but these revived divine dragons were still unmoved, saying that this was an internal matter of the dragon race.
This made President Lin understand that they were not easy to deal with.
These guys were completely different from those individual gods.
The dragon race, the head of the five god races in the Mythical Era, actually ignored the World Tree?
However, President Lin also knew that he was indeed suspected of being ridiculous. The relationship between the World Tree and Dong Huang was far from that deep. Instead, the dragon race was a Mythical race that had contributed to protecting the world.
Even the World Tree was considered a junior in front of it. Unless the true body of the Blue Planet’s Will woke up, only then could they respect it.
“You guys??” The Black Gold Divine Dragon couldn’t help but become more and more annoyed when it saw a little cat and human who had appeared out of nowhere and wanted to interfere in the internal affairs of the dragon race.
“When Shi Yu comes, you’re all finished,” the gem cat girl muttered.
It knew that this group of people had destroyed a pile of Green Dragon statues in Dragon Palace City and killed many Green Dragon believers. The ice dragon that came out to stop them was also heavily injured and on the verge of death.
With Shi Yu’s temper, he would definitely make this group of dragons pay the price.
“Roar!!!” With a disagreement, the two parties started fighting again. The Black Gold Divine Dragon’s dragon claw gently pointed at the Dragon God.
Boom!
The black light ball turned into a dark tide and Devoured in the direction of the Dragon God.
“They’re going to fight…” Around them, many demigods were watching the commotion. However, these people had no intention of interfering.
After all, the revived Mythical Dragon Race might be the most difficult existence among the revived gods. Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog weren’t even qualified to carry their shoes.
Even if the three gods only had demigod battle power now, they definitely suppressed the world. No one expected that not long after, Dong Huang would be in big trouble again.
The Dragon God’s expression turned cold. The gem cat girl revealed a bitter expression. They were going to fight again… But then, the gem cat girl was delighted and looked at the sky.
At this moment, many demigods sensed a terrifying aura descending from the sky.
Moreover, it was accompanied by a voice that resounded through the hearts of all living beings.
“Damn, which idiot came to provoke me again? Can the Green Dragon Faith be smashed just like that?” Shi Yu’s telepathy resounded through the world, stunning everyone.
“Don’t you know that the Green Dragon is a pet cultivated by your father, me?”
As the voice spread, the three Dragon Palace City gods were stunned. The Western Black Dragon Lord was stunned, and the Tyrant Dragon King of the Dragonman Empire was stunned.
“Wow,” the gem cat exclaimed.
With a boom, the sound of laws that sounded like the creation of the world sounded. A small crack appeared in the attack trajectory of the Black Gold Divine Dragon and enlarged with a bang, opening the world. A new world formed. Be it the two parties facing each other or all the demigods watching, they were shocked to discover that they were pulled into an unfamiliar place without being able to resist at all.
Buzz…
In an instant, the black dark tide was obliterated and dispersed. Moreover, in the clouds in the sky, an indescribably majestic divine might enveloped down. In an instant, the demigods looked at the sky in shock and saw three divine lightning descend from the sky.
A divine lightning was like a world falling. Its aura was terrifying, as if it could destroy the world.
Boom!!
Facing the Creation God Lightning, one of the killer moves derived from the Creation Domain, the pupils of the three divine dragons suddenly constricted. They felt a huge threat, and their hearts beat crazily. They felt that they had heard the laws of lightning, heard the laws of heaven and earth, and seen the laws of life. It was simply unbelievable.
Although every sound of laws was very weak, they actually combined to form a terrifying killer move.
“Who is it?” The three divine dragons, a black-gold divine dragon, a blue divine dragon, and a green-purple divine dragon wanted to resist in unison, but in the Creation Domain, they were like lambs waiting to be killed. They instantly widened their dragon eyes and endured the unbearable pressure. Their faces were pale as they felt a vast world pressure.
“Divine level!!!” They shouted in disbelief.
“Impossible. It’s impossible for there to be a divine level existence on Blue Planet at the moment.”
Boom.
The divine lightning descended. With a crack, their bodies were wrapped in lightning, and their dragon scales instantly exploded. The violent lightning penetrated their life source. In just an instant, the skin and flesh of their bodies exploded from the lightning, and dragon blood splattered.
“Roar!!!” The miserable cries of the three divine dragons shook the sky and earth.
Under the suppression of the lightning, they were instantly penetrated into the ground and smashed to the ground.
Their huge dragon eyes bled and were filled with disbelief. Around them, President Lin, the gem cat, and the spectating demigods also looked at the three Dragon Palace City gods in extreme disbelief.
The Dragon God also looked in the sky in extreme disbelief.
“Who is it? The Beast Tamer of the Green Dragon! The faith statues you destroyed is all mine.” The phantom of the Green Dragon, which was tens of thousands of meters long, circled under the starry sky. The figures of Shi Yu and his pets slowly descended into the lower realm. Seeing that it was indeed Shi Yu, the surrounding demigods revealed shocked expressions, not understanding what had happened.
They didn’t understand why the skin and flesh of the three demigod-level Enfeebled gods exploded in an instant!
That was a divine-level dragon body.
“Blasphemer! You’re disrespecting the Ancestral Dragon!” At this moment, the three revival divine dragons tried their best to break free from the Creation God Lightning. They looked at the phantom of the Creation Green Dragon God in the sky in anger and at Shi Yu, who had descended. At the same time, they felt that it was unbelievable.
However, Shi Yu’s next words made their brains rumble and they were even angrier.
“Then let the Ancestral Dragon say it himself. The three low-level gods have a death wish. Buggy, crush them.” Shi Yu’s heart ached at this moment. After all, this time, the power of faith of the Green Dragon would probably be exhausted.
Therefore, he had to find resources from these three divine dragons. With a boom, the huge green dragon claw crossed the Void and pinched the three divine dragons. They widened their eyes and tried their best to activate quasi-divine skills to hit the green dragon claw.
Boom, boom, and vibration. The Green Dragon Claw was instantly broken but instantly repaired. As long as there was enough power of faith for the transcendent Green Dragon Indestructible Body, even if Buggy died, it could instantly revive like Baby Ginseng.
With a puff, the Green Dragon Claw resisted the three quasi-divine skills but didn’t break. It pinched the three divine dragons in its hand and squeezed hard. The powerful dragon body of the divine-level dragon instantly exploded like a piece of paper, badly mangled. Only its last breath was left, waiting to be dealt with.
In an instant, everyone fell silent.
Shi Yu looked at the Dragon God and said, “Sorry, Senior Dragon God. Buggy and I are training in the starry sky and are late.”
The Dragon God was silent. A moment later, she looked at the green dragon phantom in the sky and said, “What’s going on?”
The Black Dragon Lord, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the other demigods who were still trapped in the creation domain also peed their pants in fright. They wanted to leave, but they didn’t know how to leave this damn place. They looked like they had seen a ghost. What the f*ck was going on!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1235 - 1235 Invincible (1)
chapters.content:
1235 Invincible (1)
The current situation was extremely strange for President Lin and the others.
After all, previously, Shi Yu still needed two demigods to resist Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog for a period of time.
But which of the three gods in front of him wasn’t a stronger existence?
However, they felt that Shi Yu’s Buggy crushed them almost effortlessly.
“Buggy broke through to the totem level and took another step forward to the Green Dragon. Now, it can fight with the power of faith. It can fight a True God above its level as a demigod.”
“It’s naturally not a problem to deal with three low-level gods whose levels have been suppressed,” Shi Yu said.
He explained to President Lin and the others why Buggy was so fierce.
Damn, he had almost spent all the power of faith. How could he not be fierce?
The key was that it couldn’t easily solve the current situation without paying.
“Meow!!!” The gem cat was stunned. What a joke. Why were your pets getting more and more ridiculous after evolution?
Why, why did Shi Yu want to kill a True God above its level just as it reached the demigod level?
“Senior Dragon God, don’t worry. From today onwards, Buggy and I will protect you,” Shi Yu said to the Dragon God.
Sigh, femme fatale.
The Dragon God was speechless.
“This dispute seems to have attracted many guys to watch the battle.” Shi Yu looked around again.
“One, two clueless, three, four, five, six, seven… There are actually seven demigods.”
“There seems to be a familiar face.”
“President Lin, have the Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord joined the Blue Planet Alliance?”
“No.”
“The surrounding demigods didn’t join the Blue Planet Alliance.”
As President Lin finished speaking, Shi Yu grinned and looked around with ill intentions.
The Tyrant Dragon King was also a demigod. He had killed its son in the World Tournament, so it must have been hating him.
The Black Dragon Lord had also killed a general of their Dragon Empire. This had definitely been holding a grudge.
They were all potential enemies.
Among them, the Dragonman Empire and the Dragon Empire were also great enemies of Dong Huang in the previous totem battles. Shi Yu felt that since the Creation Domain had already been opened, it was better to deal with more enemies along the way.
This way, the cost-effective ratio could be maximized.
“Then…” Shi Yu’s eyes turned golden. The Green Dragon Domain spread out and fused with the Creation Domain.
Under the starry sky, the divine aura of the Green Dragon was even more terrifying. The seven surrounding demigods were basically here to watch the commotion. Among them, there were three demigods from the post-Blue Planet era, and four were demigod-level reincarnation gods.
Boom!!
At this moment, the green dragon’s killing intent lingered again. The miserable state of the three revived divine dragons just now had already scared the seven surrounding demigods into peeing. Even if four of them were reincarnation gods, they were extremely afraid of Shi Yu’s power.
He felt that Shi Yu was even more terrifying than the last time he resisted the Abyss Race.
Moreover, this guy was simply crazy.
Not only was he ruthless in killing invading races, but he was also ruthless to the dragons who had contributed in the war of the Mythical Era.
In an instant, the three dragon generals were crushed.
Was he really not afraid of anything?
“Berserk Dragon King.”
“Black Dragon Lord Juggernaut.”
“Buggy, crush them too.”
At this moment, as Shi Yu spoke, the divine might of the Green Dragon Buggy suppressed the surroundings. In the entire Creation Domain, deterrence shook the sky and earth. The pupils of the seven demigods, especially the Tyrant Dragon King and the Juggernaut Black Dragon Lord, constricted.
Damn.
This kid really wanted to continue attacking.
It still wanted to kill them.
At this moment, the two demigods were furious.
But in the next moment, it was very cowardly.
Because the miserable state of Dragon Palace City’s revived gods was still vivid in his mind.
They believed that their strength couldn’t exceed the three gods.
“Roar!!!”
Under the wreaking of divine might, the demigods in all directions of the Creation Domain instantly let out furious roars, feeling that Shi Yu wanted to kill them all.
“Shi Yu, do you want to start a war!!”
The Tyrant Dragon King was furious, but in the next moment, the Creation God might that had condensed, compressed, and tempered to the extreme gathered on its huge humanoid body.
The sound of Spirit laws shook in all directions.
President Lin was stunned. He didn’t expect Shi Yu to attack other demigods.
Was it really alright?
With a crack, in the Creation Domain, the Tyrant Dragon King, who had just advanced to a demigod, had yet to resist when its body transformed under the substantialized divine-level dragon might. The hard dragon bone in its body instantly shattered.
His brain rumbled, and dragon blood flowed out of his eyes. He spat out blood crazily, and his eyes gradually turned white.
With a boom, it was suppressed to the ground and thrown to the ground like a meteor. The surrounding demigods were extremely shocked.
Suppressing a demigod with deterrence?
What exactly was going on with this strange domain and strange world!
“The laws of heaven and earth are all controlled by it, like the world it created.” A reincarnation god was extremely shocked as he looked at the miserable state of the Tyrant Dragon King.
“This is… the law of creation!! Impossible, no creature can master such power.”
“I…” At this moment, the Tyrant Dragon King was extremely afraid, but it couldn’t say the word ‘submit’. Its body directly exploded from the pressure of deterrence and turned into a blood mist. Just like the divine dragons, it only had one breath left and waited to be dealt with.
“Shi Yu, that black dragon wants to run. Hurry up and hit it!” The gem cat was extremely surprised.
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to become so fierce again after a few days.
It had long wanted to beat up this black dragon.
They actually didn’t give their Gem Financial Group face.
This was an opportunity!
“Roar!!!” The Black Dragon Lord retreated in shock and retreated crazily. A quasi-divine skill condensed. It spat out a World Destruction Dragon Breath and aimed at Shi Yu, but it was only for show. It was instantly taken head-on by a dragon claw that swung over. The sweeping dragon claw slapped towards the Juggernaut’s Black Dragon Lord.

chapters.title: Chapter 1236 - 1236 Invincible (2)
chapters.content:
1236 Invincible (2)
Just like the Divine Claw, this was the true power that could sweep through the world and destroy everything.
In the Creation Domain, Buggy was both a Creation God and a World Destruction God.
“Shi Yu, you lunatic!!”
The dark figure approached, and the Black Dragon Lord was taken by surprise as Shi Yu seemed determined to completely annihilate them, disregarding any consequences.
“Our Dragon Empire also has gods.”
“Senior, save me…” Black Dragon Lord looked at one of the reincarnation gods, but the other party was indifferent. It was filled with fear toward the Green Dragon.
The pupils of the Black Dragon Lord constricted…
With a boom, it was pinched by a huge claw. Its body shattered, and a blood mist exploded.
From beginning to end, the colossal main body of Buggy merely hovered in the sky, casually moving its small claws throughout the entire process.
“Roar!!!”
After destroying five demigods in a row, Buggy’s battle intent rose to the extreme as it locked onto the next target.
“Wait, wait, I have no grudge with Dong Huang.” The remaining demigod of the later era of Blue Planet roared.
This was an Icy Snow Dragon from the Snowfield, an elemental life form. It wasn’t a dragon, but it was in dragon form.
In the Creation Domain, Buggy was a god of death. Ordinary demigods couldn’t withstand a single move from it, but that was normal. After all, this was a top-notch law enhanced by all the power of faith of the Green Dragon on Shi Yu and the others.
Apart from that, Shi Yu’s Green Dragon Domain also strengthened Buggy’s faith skill.
It gave Buggy true divine power!
“Roar, roar, roar!” Eleven and the others cheered. Buggy, kill, kill, kill.
If Buggy used up all the power of faith here, it wouldn’t be able to participate in the team internal competition!
Buggy was indeed fierce, shocking Eleven and the others. They hurriedly prayed that Buggy would use up its terrifying power.
“They have gone mad with killing.” Now, the other reincarnated gods dared not make any rash moves, as they had no grievances or enmity with Shi Yu. They didn’t believe that Shi Yu would massacre them all, but deep down, they couldn’t deny that they were worried and afraid.
They couldn’t imagine how Shi Yu and the others had erupted with divine-level power in the Cultivationless Age.
This was the Green Dragon?
It felt like the Ancestral Dragon was suppressed in the demigod realm, and that was his limit of power.
The humans’ hearts were in panic. Previously, they didn’t feel much, but at this moment, they sensed the terrifying power of the Seed of Hope brought by Goddess Wa.
Even if the ones they left on Blue Planet were only low-level gods, it was really unimaginable for them to be killed indiscriminately by demigods of the later era.
“Don’t worry.” After heavily injuring the Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord in one go, Shi Yu smiled gently and said, “Dong Huang loves peace and will never initiate aggression. It’s purely because the factions of those two guys once invaded Dong Huang, so I taught them a lesson.”
“Moreover, they didn’t join the Blue Planet Alliance. It’s obvious that they aren’t guys who yearn for peace. Eliminating them is also eliminating harm for Blue Planet, in case they become traitors and rely on extraterrestrial factions.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the other five demigods felt their teeth hurt. They had yet to betray anyone, but he had already drawn conclusions. Who could argue with him?
“I’m willing to join the Blue Planet Alliance!!” Icy Snow Dragon was the first to shout, afraid that Shi Yu would attack.
President Lin’s vision darkened. He didn’t expect that the demigods from those difficult-to-communicate factions would be willing to join the Blue Planet Alliance in this manner.
“Welcome.” Shi Yu smiled.
“Alright, next, I want to think about how to deal with these three guys.”
Shi Yu looked towards the three Mythical Dragon Race members who were heavily injured and unconscious. He turned to the Dragon God and asked, “Senior Dragon God, with me here, you can rest assured that no one can snatch your position as the Dragon God. Even if Ancestral Dragon returns, he won’t succeed.”
“How should we deal with these three detestable guys?”
“Why don’t we roast them and eat them? We’ll split them with everyone in Dragon Palace City.”
It was Shi Yu’s idea to expand the faith of the Green Dragon in Dragon Palace City. Now that Dragon Palace City had been left in ruins by these three guys and many Green Dragon believers had died, Shi Yu really felt bad.
Only by dismembering these three guys and giving their dragon blood, meat, tendons, and ball to everyone in Dragon Palace City as resources could Shi Yu feel more comfortable.
“You’ll get into big trouble like this…” At this moment, the Dragon God’s mind was also greatly shaken. She found Shi Yu and Buggy’s god-like battle power unbelievable.
However, after killing three divine dragons of the Mythical Era like this, she felt she would be in big trouble next.
“They might not be the only gods of the Dragon Palace. Perhaps other divine dragons will revive one after another.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s not a big problem. I just want to kill all the enemies. If they’re friends, I’ll welcome them.”
Shi Yu’s words made the corners of the mouths of President Lin, the gem cat, and the others twitch.
Shi Yu was definitely arrogant, but this exaggerated battle power was simply even more terrifying than the previous strongest Legendary title.
He could completely be said to be invincible. He even casually killed awakened gods!
“Roar…”
At this moment, the three divine dragons that had been crushed by Buggy slowly recovered some strength under their self-healing. Seeing this, Shi Yu immediately commanded Chi Tong.
“Just kill them.”
“Mi!!!” Chi Tong, who was flying around in the sky in the form of a sword, had long been waiting for Shi Yu’s words.
Its aura rose steadily, and its energy erupted, revealing the power of a demigod and shocking the people beside it.
It was unexpected that Shi Yu’s sword spirit had also reached the demigod level.
“Boom!!!”
In the next second.
Chi Tong turned into a sword light and slashed at the three divine dragons, planning to harvest their souls first.
“Don’t kill them!!!” At this moment, just as Chi Tong attacked, a voice suddenly sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1237 - 1237 Invincible (3)
chapters.content:
1237 Invincible (3)
Shi Yu originally thought that it was one of the surrounding reincarnation gods. However, upon closer listening, he felt something was amiss, as the voice sounded somewhat familiar.
Crack.
In an instant.
In this Cultivationless Age, the Creation Domain that was comparable to a true divine skill was instantly torn apart.
An invisible power of the world turned into a huge hand that instantly blocked Chi Tong and gently bounced it away.
“Shi Yu, stop!!”
After the green worm the size of an arm tore open the Creation Domain and blocked Chi Tong, it shouted nervously, afraid that Shi Yu would be fast enough to kill the three divine dragons.
“World Tree!!!”
At this moment, when they saw this little green vortex worm, the cat, the Dragon God, President Lin, and the surrounding demigods were shocked.
They didn’t expect the World Tree, or rather, the World Tree clone, to suddenly appear here.
“Mi!!”
At this moment, Chi Tong and Buggy were rather shocked. They felt that their strength was easily resolved by the World Tree clone, the little green vortex worm.
Shi Yu was also extremely silent. As he looked at the incoming World Tree clone, he kept feeling that there was big trouble…
It wouldn’t be so easy to use the three divine dragons as resources.
“Senior World Tree…”
Boom.
The Creation Domain shattered, and the environment returned to its original state. The three divine dragons fell into the sea. The Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord also fell into a near-death state.
The other demigods had lingering fears. Since the World Tree was here, Shi Yu couldn’t go crazy anymore, right?
“Lord World Tree, the three of them attacked first. I was defending myself!” At this moment, Shi Yu complained. He didn’t expect the World Tree to wake up at this moment.
“I know. I’ve already understood the cause and effect.”
