“However, they have contributed to the Mythical War after all. Shi Yu, spare their lives. I promise you that they won’t interfere in the Dragon Palace anymore.” The World Tree had an extremely bad headache.
It didn’t expect such a big thing to happen when it woke up.
Naturally, it couldn’t let Shi Yu kill these three revival gods. If it did, what would the other gods who had contributed to Blue Planet think?
However, the World Tree had special feelings for Shi Yu. When it woke up, it realized that not only had Shi Yu killed Yun An and the Abyss Demon Frog and become the strongest human, but he could also easily kill five demigods. The World Tree was shocked and delighted.
It was also very concerned about a genius like Shi Yu. Moreover, this time, these three gods were indeed too violent, so the World Tree could only be a peacemaker.
“I’ll use the power of the world to recover the casualties of Dragon Palace City,” the World Tree clone said.
The Dragon God said, “Thank you, Lord World Tree. Shi Yu, let’s forget it.”
At this moment, since the World Tree had already said this, the Dragon God didn’t want Shi Yu to offend the gods too much either.
Shi Yu frowned and said, “Alright, since Mother said so… But the Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord…”
The World Tree clone said, “I’m not your mother.”
“You can do whatever you want with those two guys. I don’t care anymore.”
The World Tree clone felt a headache. Below, the three revival gods were directly put into an alternate space by it. At the same time, the green vortex worm glanced at Shi Yu and the others and said, “Shi Yu, let this matter come to an end.”
“You… follow me to Inatella.”
“I have something important to tell you.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “Has the Ancient God Golden Bull woken up? It still owes me a divine-level resource…”
The World Tree clone shook its head. “No…!”
…
This time, the World Tree suddenly woke up and even said that something big had happened. Shi Yu decisively followed the World Tree.
In almost the blink of an eye, they were brought to Inatella by the World Tree.
After arriving, the World Tree clone looked at Shi Yu with a rather complicated expression.
It didn’t expect Shi Yu’s improvement speed to be so fast. He had reached the invincible level so quickly.
“Little brat, your strength has improved very quickly. On Blue Planet, you can be said to be invincible even when facing these gods who have awakened from their sleep.”
Shi Yu said in embarrassment, “I’m still not your match.”
World Tree clone: “?”
You still want to be my match?
The World Tree clone said, “You’re indeed invincible, but the problem now is that the reason why I woke up is because I sensed a batch of powerful extraterrestrials approaching the galaxy where Blue Planet is.”
“The opponent is incredibly powerful. Although not at the divine level, they have reached the pinnacle of the demigod realm. They might possess three, four, five, or even six or seven quasi-divine skills. I’m not sure if they’re friends or foes! It’s as if they come from a world with more perfected rules, or perhaps a lifeform born from a planet even mightier than Blue Planet.”
“If they’re enemies, Blue Planet will be in danger.”
Shi Yu was stunned, and his expression changed. Holy shit, you just said that I’m invincible, but an enemy is coming from the sky?

chapters.title: Chapter 1238 - 1238 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (1)
chapters.content:
1238 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (1)
At this moment, Shi Yu had mixed feelings.
They might have three, four, five, or even more quasi-divine skills?
They were indeed very terrifying guests from outer space.
In the Cultivationless Age of Blue Planet, apart from the Blue Planet lineage, there were at most two records of quasi-divine skills.
For example, the Blue Sea Sprite.
It was called the strongest demigod because it had two quasi-divine skills that could be used together, and one of them was a quasi-divine-level faith skill.
On the Blue Planet in the Cultivationless Age, cultivating two quasi-divine skills was already a heavenly talent.
Whoever cultivated three would definitely be invincible in the world.
But the alien guest mentioned by the World Tree this time didn’t seem to be reasonable at all.
Four to five quasi-divine skills?
He felt that even if Eleven and the others had quasi-divine skills that contained top-notch laws, they wouldn’t be able to fight easily.
After all, having multiple pets with quasi-divine skills wasn’t the same concept as having multiple quasi-divine skills with one pet. The latter’s strength was a qualitative leap.
Perhaps it could even use a combination divine skill.
However, Shi Yu wasn’t afraid of them if they really fought head-on.
It wasn’t difficult for him to let Eleven and the others each have multiple quasi-divine skills.
“In the same realm, I’m invincible, even if it’s a cosmic demigod,” Shi Yu said.
“As long as Lord World Tree provides enough resources to make me stronger, I’ll kill whoever comes. When the resources are in place, even God Realm experts will be useless. You have no idea, I now have four totem contracts that surpass my level, and our team is almost overflowing. We can barely manage to keep everyone fed,” said Shi Yu with a grin.
As long as the World Tree gave him resources, he would win this battle!
He would guard the Blue Planet…!
“So you know that you haven’t even reached the Legendary level.” The corners of the World Tree clone’s mouth twitched. “I brought you to Inatella because I want you to stay and not get involved in these troublesome matters.”
“If it’s an enemy, I’ll settle it. You can just cultivate here obediently.”
Shi Yu: “?”
The World Tree naturally believed what Shi Yu said.
If the World Tree wasn’t wrong, Shi Yu’s skill that crushed the five demigods just now contained the law of creation. It was a quasi-divine-level faith skill.
If such a skill could be cultivated into a divine skill and had enough power of faith to support it, then Green Dragon…
Green Dragon would absolutely not be inferior to top-notch gods like Ancestral Dragon and Original Phoenix. Green Dragon would be a future entity with the potential to become a top-notch god, unparalleled among peers, and no one at the same level could be its match.
In addition to that panda who had mastered the destructive law, when Shi Yu grew up, he was definitely a good seedling that far exceeded any top-notch god back then.
Perhaps there was the hope of resisting super divine life forms like the Abyss Evil God, the Space Behemoth, and the Worm Empress alone.
Regarding such a genius, the World Tree naturally couldn’t let Shi Yu face a strong enemy too early.
If anything happened to Shi Yu before he reached the divine level, the World Tree would cry to death. Not only would the World Tree have lost a super genius, but it would also feel that its previous blessings had been thrown away and wasted.
Therefore, the World Tree planned to protect Shi Yu well in Inatella when external enemies invaded. If they were really powerful enemies, the World Tree would deal with them.
Although excessive consumption of the power of the world would delay the recovery of the laws, there was no other way.
Who would have thought that someone from the starry sky would come at this time?
“You want me to cultivate here??” Shi Yu was stunned. He really didn’t expect the World Tree to call him over not to let him, the strongest expert on Blue Planet, fight the external enemies, but to protect him instead.
But thinking about it carefully, there was nothing wrong with that.
He was still a child who had yet to grow up.
“That’s right.” Apart from that, the World Tree was also worried that Shi Yu would suddenly kill a few more reincarnation gods outside.
Now, Shi Yu had the complete aptitude of a super divine. It wasn’t something the low-level gods on Blue Planet could compare to at all. Just as Shi Yu had said, he was invincible in the same realm.
“Then… will you provide food?” Shi Yu suddenly asked.
“If food and accommodation are provided, and Lord World Tree, if you take good care of Dong Huang, Dragon Palace City, and my friends, then I have no problem!”
“Of course, I don’t want something like today to happen again. If it weren’t for the fact that Lord World Tree said that you could revive the casualties of Dragon Palace City, I would have killed those three gods no matter what to commemorate those believers.”
Shi Yu grinned.
The World Tree said, “Sure, no problem. I’ll punish them well.”
“I’ll pay extra attention to your country and your friends. With this awakening, I won’t sleep any time soon. With me awake, a situation like the one that appeared in Dragon Palace City previously will definitely not happen again.”
“I’ll take over the right of Blue Planet’s Will to temporarily manage Blue Planet.”
“Then thank you, Lord Blue Planet!!” Shi Yu was excited. Awesome. The World Tree provided food and accommodation. Didn’t that mean that Eleven and the others could train unscrupulously on Inatella’s side?
In fact, a demigod-level team battle could even be arranged.
On the other hand, he worked hard to meditate and strived to break through to level nine as soon as possible!
In that case, Shi Yu was willing to suppress his restless heart.
It was the same to level up first before going to have fun.
“By the way.” Shi Yu suddenly recalled something and said, “My friend previously had a premonition.”
“The premonition was that a legendary Beast Tamer from Dong Huang, who disappeared while exploring the starry sky, and Lin Feng, a Beast Tamer from Dong Huang, who once received your blessings and also disappeared, are still alive.”
“After they disappeared, they arrived at a certain place in the starry sky and broke through to the divine level.”
The World Tree was stunned. It looked at Shi Yu and said, “It’s a premonition.”
“There’s indeed such a possibility. In the starry sky, no, even on Blue Planet, there are many things that the will of the planet doesn’t know, just like how ordinary people can’t know every minute phenomenon in their bodies.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1239 - 1239 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (2)
chapters.content:
1239 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (2)
“It’s not impossible for them to reach deeper into the starry sky due to certain peculiar phenomena.”
“Even in the Mythical Era, there have been cases of gods disappearing when exploring the starry sky.”
“Including the high-level gods who left the Blue Planet after the Mythical Era ended… The reason why I said that I don’t know if the guests from outer space are friends or foes is also because of this.”
“Blue Planet is gradually reviving. Those who return might be enemies, but they might also be old friends.”
“I hope… things can develop in a good direction.” The World Tree clone looked out of Blue Planet again.
Shi Yu pursed his lips. World Tree clone, why don’t you know anything? Is this why you don’t know that I’m a transmigrator?
…
At the same time.
As the World Tree pulled Shi Yu away, Shi Yu took away the Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord. Many demigods immediately dispersed.
The non-Dong Huang demigod left dejectedly, while the Dragon God returned to Dragon Palace City to preside over the overall situation. The previous conflict had long thrown the Dragon Palace City into chaos.
There was even a batch of surrenderers who had joined the gods. The Dragon God wanted to settle the score.
As for President Lin and the gem cat, they couldn’t help but heave a sigh of relief when they saw that the matter had ended successfully. President Lin said, “Teacher Ying, can I leave the matter of incorporating the Dragonman Empire to you next?”
“The Dragonman Empire is in the west and has the Dragon God presiding over it. It’s not easy to deal with, but we can take back the Dragonman Empire’s Green Dragon faith for Shi Yu.”
The gem cat girl’s eyes lit up. “Leave it to me.”
This was a good thing for her!
The battle of Dong Huang ended here.
However, the end of the battle confused the various realms.
The coup of Dragon Palace City and the revival of the three divine dragons to seize Dragon Palace City were definitely not known only to a few demigods.
In fact, the various factions on Blue Planet, including the Seven Nation Alliance, quickly got wind of the news.
However, only demigods dared to watch this kind of thing up close.
According to various speculations, this conflict would definitely cause a super earthquake on the Blue Planet. After all, three revival gods were involved, and they were powerful dragon gods, as well as the strongest faction in the post-era of Blue Planet, the Dong Huang Alliance.
No one believed that they couldn’t fight.
But in reality, the feeling this battle gave them was really no different from not fighting.
The factions that didn’t have the guts to come to the scene to watch the battle had no idea why the East Sea was suddenly silent.
The Creation Domain was too terrifying, directly isolating the new world at that time from the Blue Planet system.
Everything that happened took place in another newly created world, beyond the perception of the outside world, which was entirely normal.
At the moment, on Blue Planet, probably only the Blue Planet’s Will could sense the Creation Domain and interfere.
“What exactly happened in the East Sea? Why isn’t there any movement?”
All around the world, there was considerable confusion and puzzlement over the sudden cessation of the great war.
However, the most terrifying thing was that after the demigods who were watching the battle up close left the East Sea, they also kept silent about this battle, afraid that they would get into trouble.
The internal waters of the Ancient God of the Dragon Race and the Blesser of the World Tree were too deep, and they were unwilling to interfere.
“Could it be that Dong Huang and the Dragon God have agreed to some conditions…”
Before everyone could figure out the truth of this matter, another big event happened.
All legendary and demigod-levels could sense very powerful auras approaching the Blue Planet from the starry sky.
They were rather shocked and didn’t understand what had happened in the starry sky. The extraterrestrial visitors this time made no effort to conceal their power, displaying it freely, fearing that the inhabitants of the Blue Planet might not notice them.
Their aura was incomparably terrifying. Even if they were outside the planet, they still shocked the legendary demigods on the Blue Planet.
“Alien invaders?”
Inatella.
Boom.
Space trembled. The gods sleeping here were also shocked by this powerful wave. The Ancient God Golden Bull and the other gods woke up and looked at the starry sky in confusion.
“What’s going on… Are the invaders here again? Moo!!!” The Ancient God Golden Bull roared, his voice resounding through Inatella.
Lord Lie Shan, the Holy Divine Deer, the Demon King Dragon, and the other gods stared at the starry sky with serious expressions.
They felt that the enemy… was getting closer and closer.
“Ancient God Golden Bull!!” At this moment, when he heard these sounds, the one who was most surprised was none other than Shi Yu.
Damn, this guy has finally woken up!
Shi Yu immediately shouted at the Ancient God Golden Bull, who had awakened from the Mythical Ruins.
At the same time, the Ancient God Golden Bull was also stunned as he looked in Shi Yu’s direction.
He saw the World Tree clone with a similarly serious expression and Shi Yu, who was waving at him.
“Bull God, it’s me.” Shi Yu summoned Eleven, wanting to remind the Ancient God Golden Bull of him.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven also waved at the Ancient God Golden Bull.
Resources! Resources! Resources had yet to be given.
When the Ancient God Golden Bull saw Shi Yu, his expression darkened. Damn, why is this guy still here after I wake up?
“It’s you.” The Ancient God Golden Bull frowned and said, “What is it?”
“What else could it be? You haven’t given us the resources we earned from passing the test in the World Tournament. Give us a metal-element resource!” Shi Yu’s requirements weren’t high. He just wanted a mythical metal-element resource that could fill Eleven’s stomach.
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven nodded, suddenly feeling that the Ancient God Golden Bull had become much stronger after a few days!
Even so… he still had to give them resources!
Since the Ancient God Golden Bull dared to agree to the World Tree being an examiner, he shouldn’t be as poor as the Golden-Winged Roc to rely on shedding his own body to produce resources, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1240 - 1240 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (3)
chapters.content:
1240 Alien Beast Tamer Descends to Blue Planet (3)
Although the steak was pretty delicious, Shi Yu didn’t want to eat familiar faces. He treated Inatella’s friendly gods as good friends!
“#￥@#￥￥%” The Ancient God Golden Bull cursed in his heart and said, “I know, I won’t shortchange you.”
“You little kid… No, you actually mastered a skill of that level. Not bad, you’re really not bad. Kid, you can have resources, but when you’re free, fight with me again!!!” The Ancient God Golden Bull said indignantly.
The Ancient God Golden Bull’s power, after the revival of the rules and a period of slumber, had also been restored to the totem level.
It was no longer the original overlord level.
In other words, it also had demigod battle power now, and as an awakened god, it was definitely stronger than demigods in the later era of the Blue Planet!
Sensing that the level of his quasi-divine skill had increased as the laws revived, the Ancient God Golden Bull gritted his teeth, wanting to spar with Shi Yu and the others again.
The last time, because of the suppression of laws, the Ancient God Golden Bull never collided with Shi Yu and the others. But this time, the Ancient God Golden Bull believed that it was definitely not a problem. The higher-level usage of its Golden Mountain Divine Body had already been unlocked with the revival of his power.
The Ancient God Golden Bull could rely on overload to obtain physical strength that exceeded that of demigods. He wasn’t afraid of even the prototype of a top-notch divine skill…
“No problem,” Shi Yu agreed readily. In any case, with the World Tree providing food and accommodation, the losses from the battle shouldn’t be a big problem, right?
Seeing the cow’s temper, he felt that the Ancient God Golden Bull could agree to another resource.
“You guys…” At this moment, the World Tree clone was rather speechless. “Is this the time to talk about this? My other clone has already gone to the starry sky to intercept the invaders.”
“A huge battle might break out at any moment.”
“You woke up at the right time. If a battle happens, please lend me your vitality. The power of the world that I can mobilize is limited. If the opponent is too strong, I might still need the life of Blue Planet to contribute a portion of my strength.”
“It’s indeed an invader!” When the World Tree clone said that, the awakened gods became serious. Shi Yu also looked at the starry sky, wanting to know what was going on.
…
At the same time.
In the incomparably dark starry sky, four huge flash meteors hit the Blue Planet.
The four meteors weren’t big, and each was less than a hundred meters in diameter. But with their strength, if they hit the Blue Planet, it would definitely be an unimaginable disaster.
“This is…” At this moment, the Green Dragon, the 50% power clone of the World Tree, was already flying outside the Blue Planet, looking at the four meteorites flying over with a burning gaze.
It immediately thought of a meteorite life form like Yun An.
However, in fact, these four huge meteors were like controllable aircraft. After flying close to the Blue Planet, although they were still filled with huge fluctuations, their speed became slower and slower.
Boom!!!
When they were extremely close to the Blue Planet, or rather, the World Tree clone’s Green Dragon, the four meteorites actually slowly stopped in midair in unison. Then, a door-like arc of light appeared on the four meteorites. They slowly opened like the doors of a spaceship.
Right on the heels of that, eight figures appeared together inside. Even the World Tree was rather shocked to see these eight figures.
Four of them were humans, two men, and two women.
From their appearances, they were all young men in their 20s. The men were handsome, and the women were beautiful. They were wearing clothes that were different from those of any country on Blue Planet. They wrapped their bodies tightly, only revealing the black battle suit on their heads. It was perfectly coordinated with the power of the starry sky, as if it was a super equipment prepared for the starry sky battle.
Apart from that, the source of the power sensed by the World Tree clone was also behind them.
A blue-purple Star Dragon whose body seemed to be covered in star spots was only more than ten meters tall, but its aura far exceeded any demigod on the Blue Planet at the moment. The feeling it gave the World Tree clone was even stronger than that of the peak Blue Sea Sprite.
There was also a huge phoenix with a red body and blue wings. Every feather was as deep as a nebula. Just like the previous Star Dragon, it was a cosmic life form that emitted powerful fluctuations.
In addition to that, he was an extraordinary humanoid life form with multiple platinum-colored angelic wings. With a handsome face and golden eyes, he was undoubtedly an angel. The sacred aura emanating from him was already approaching the level of a divine being.
The last life form was a female demon with black and red wings that looked like bat wings. She displayed her fiery figure vividly with a smile on her face. She sized up the World Tree clone curiously and licked her lips, looking rather tempting.
These four formidable demigod-level beings came out together with the four humans. They appeared to be of equal status, without any distinction of importance. However, there seemed to be a connection between them. The World Tree clone quickly deduced that each pair of these arrivals might have some sort of mutual contract or covenant.
“Lord Blue Planet…” The Beast Tamer of the Star Dragon, a mature woman with long black hair, walked out of the meteorite in the air and said telepathically, “We’ve finally arrived. You’re the will clone of this planet, right?”
“Who… are you?” At this moment, the World Tree clone had already guessed, but it still asked.
“My name is Zi Lan. My teacher is a Beast Tamer who walked out of this planet. His former title here was the Space Emperor. This time, our group has come from the Cosmic Sea, bringing with us tools that can help the Blue Planet integrate with the universe.”
“At present, the gods who walked out of the Blue Planet in the Mythical Era have already established several super-divine-level factions in the Cosmic Sea and stabilized their foundation. After learning that their mother planet is about to undergo restoration, they plan to welcome their mother planet and help it complete further evolution.”
At this moment, the World Tree clone was rather shocked. It didn’t expect that just as Shi Yu told it about the Space Emperor, a Beast Tamer sent by the Space Emperor would appear.
Who was Shi Yu’s friend who had the premonition? He was incredible.
A disciple of the Space Emperor?
It was unbelievable.
Sensing the powerful aura of this long-haired mature sister and the Star Dragon beside her, the World Tree felt that their strength wasn’t much inferior to Shi Yu. What kind of existence had that Space Emperor become?
The Beast Tamers of Dong Huang were all monsters!
Moreover, the World Tree also heard an important piece of news. After the Mythical Era ended, the gods who left the Blue Planet and settled in the universe had made significant breakthroughs, and some individuals even broke through to the super divine level!!
The World Tree clone heaved a sigh of relief. Fortunately, they weren’t enemies. At the same time, the World Tree clone was excited and thrilled. Although it had some doubts about why these divine beings were doing well but were unwilling to bring back resources from the universe to help the Blue Planet recover quickly, it couldn’t dwell on that now. As long as they still acknowledged their home planet, the World Tree clone felt content.
“Welcome, children,” the World Tree clone said happily.
The Beast Tamer of the Star Dragon, the long-haired mature sister, smiled and said, “Lord Blue Planet, we brought four Teleportation Key Stones this time. These keystones act as relic teleportation devices, allowing at least four individuals from the Blue Planet to enter another super planet. When that time comes, our teacher and others will be waiting for you on that super planet.”
“More details might require you to communicate with them personally, Lord Blue Planet.”
“No problem,” the World Tree clone said. “You’ve traveled a long way, and I appreciate your efforts. Let me take you to the Blue Planet first.”
The long-haired mature sister should be a figure similar to a captain. She looked at everyone and nodded. “Then I’ll leave it to you, Lord Blue Planet. We spent several years on this voyage and consumed a lot of energy. We even sacrificed a teammate.”
“There were a total of five of us at the start. Unfortunately… the representative of the Kirin Race died in the starry sky because of a cosmic accident. Before we reach our restoration state, we might have to disturb the Blue Planet for a period of time before daring to return.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1241 - 1241 The Look of the Starry Sky (1)
chapters.content:
1241 The Look of the Starry Sky (1)
Under the lead of the World Tree clone, the eight guests from the starry sky followed it to the Blue Planet and descended on Inatella.
When they transmigrated to the atmosphere, the eight guests from the starry sky immediately sensed that their strength was suppressed.
Among them, the golden-haired and blue-eyed man who contracted the angel said, “In such a broken world, I’m afraid they can’t even cultivate a slightly powerful demigod, let alone a divine being.”
“I feel that any battle on this planet will cause the color of the world to change, causing an impact worldwide.”
“Cut it out. Don’t you know that the mother planet is still recovering?” The angel with platinum wings said elegantly, “If the mother planet can nurture an expert like Master God, then after its recovery, it’ll surely ascend to become an advanced planet.”
“Sorry, sorry, Lord Blue Planet, I didn’t mean anything else.” The golden-haired man scratched his head with a smile.
In theory, the Blue Planet was the mother planet of the Angel Race, but it wasn’t his. He was only a descendant of the Cosmic Human Race who joined the Angel Race later.
Blue Planet was considered a relative.
After enduring countless hardships, he finally arrived on the Blue Planet. He originally wanted to spar with the powerful beings from his mother planet, but it seemed better not to. Setting aside whether this place was suitable for battles or not, under such fragmented laws, it was unlikely that any strong beings could be cultivated here.
“Lord Blue Planet, if you can contact the World King Planet, there might be a way for you to accelerate your restoration,” the female succubus said with a faint smile. However, she couldn’t help but wonder in her heart whether they could truly find any geniuses in such a low-level planet system back in their own clan.
She felt that she could defeat all the invincible people on Blue Planet alone… Apart from the Blue Planet’s Will clone in front of her.
The World Tree was still strong. Even if a top-notch god suppressed it to the demigod level, they might not necessarily be its match. After all, its main body was the Blue Planet itself.
The World Tree clone sighed, feeling rejected.
At the side, the mature woman with long black hair and the Phoenix man who had contracted the Star Phoenix were relatively calm. To be precise, the two of them, including the sacrificed teammate, weren’t on the same team as the other two.
The three of them were followers of the human faction established by the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. Although their pets came from the Dragon, the Phoenix, and the Kirin races, and both parties were in an equal contract relationship, they were still led by humans this time and mainly came to help Dong Huang.
As for the other two parties, they came from the Blue Planet’s Angel Race and the Demon Race. They were led by transcendent lives, and their goals were different.
“Lord Blue Planet, I wonder if Dong Huang, the hometown of Teacher and Lord Lin Feng, is alright?” Zi Lan, the captain of the few of them, asked.
The World Tree clone said, “Dong Huang… is developing very well.”
Zi Lan heaved a sigh of relief. This way, after their teacher and Lord Lin Feng learn about it, they should be able to relax.
…
Inatella.
Shi Yu and the seven gods sleeping here looked at the eight experts brought by the World Tree clone in a daze. Just now, they had already learned from the World Tree clone that the newcomers weren’t enemies.
Instead, they were the Blue Planet’s experts who left and ventured into the universe, eventually returning with knowledge of the universe’s starry sky.
“Oh?” After this group of aliens descended to Inatella, they also observed the awakened gods of Inatella curiously.
“Let me introduce you.”
The World Tree clone immediately introduced themselves to each other. First, it introduced the origin of this group of aliens again, and then it introduced the sleeping gods.
This made the group of people sigh. Sealing and slumbering truly turned out to be an effective method, allowing them to survive for so long.
The Ancestral Dragon, Yuan Feng, and the top divine ancestors who had left the Blue Planet were all dead. However, this group of low-level gods was actually still alive.
“This is Shi Yu. At the moment, he’s the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet and is also from Dong Huang. He’s currently cultivating with me.” The World Tree clone introduced Shi Yu, who immediately attracted everyone’s attention more than an awakened god.
This was because they knew that those who remained on the Blue Planet were only junior gods, and the divine skills they had mastered during their peak were only entry-level. Perhaps even in their prime, they might not be able to defeat those who ventured out. Apart from having a bit more experience, there was nothing else worthy of attention. They were all at the bottom of the Mythical Era.
They were different from the Beast Tamers who could become the strongest Beast Tamers on the Blue Planet in the Cultivationless Age. One was the last tier of an era, and the other was the top tier of an era. Obviously, the latter was more worth paying attention to.
Especially since Shi Yu looked so young…
Moreover, he also came from the same country as the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, shocking everyone.
Not to mention these guys, even the Ancient God Golden Bull and the other gods were shocked. They looked at Shi Yu and wondered when he had become the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet.
Not long ago, wasn’t he only the strongest in the younger generation… However, when they thought of this kid’s terrifying talent and the favorable opinion of the World Tree, they came to terms with it.
Only the Ancient God Golden Bull fell into deep thought.
Why does it feel like this guy’s growth speed is faster than my restoration?
“You’re from Dong Huang??” The long-haired mature sister, Zi Lan, looked at Shi Yu, who wore a shy expression and had a cute panda lying on his shoulder, with a very surprised expression on her face.
She remembered that Lord Lin Feng had told her that the ruler of Dong Huang should be a mechanical old man named Divine Source. Moreover, Divine Source Legendary couldn’t be considered the number one Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet. She didn’t expect that after a hundred years, the Blue Planet and Dong Huang would have already undergone such a huge change.
“Sister, are you Senior Space Emperor’s disciple? Hello, I’ve been looking up to Senior Space Emperor for a long time. I’m still good friends with the second team pet, the Void Mantis, that Senior Space Emperor left on the Blue Planet. I also know some of the descendants of Senior Space Emperor,” Shi Yu said warmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1242 - 1242 The Look of the Starry Sky (2)
chapters.content:
1242 The Look of the Starry Sky (2)
This is great.
Prediction Owl, you’re the best!
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng are really still alive.
They even sent someone back to the Blue Planet.
Shi Yu felt that they definitely had the method to use the Teleportation Key Stone!
Tears welled up in Shi Yu’s eyes. The experts who left Blue Planet finally sent someone back. He felt that once he gained their support, he could venture into the universe fearlessly and accomplish great things!
It was awesome. He was long tired of playing on the Blue Planet. If it weren’t for the fact that he had a parallel space to go to, he would have died of boredom.
“Really? Then you have to bring me to see them later.” Zi Lan smiled. She didn’t expect that the top expert on the Blue Planet would be someone as young as them. She thought it would be an old man.
“No problem,” Shi Yu said.
The Space Emperor’s disciple, Zi Lan, was very happy. Having just arrived on the Blue Planet, hearing such good news was undoubtedly a huge gain. This time, apart from the main quests, the Space Emperor also told her a bunch of things about his past on the Blue Planet. She also knew about the Void Mantis, but she didn’t expect it to still be alive.
Teacher will definitely be very happy to hear that the Void Mantis is alive.
“Little handsome, I feel that you’re only in your 20s. You’ve become the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet at this age. How exaggerated.” The person with a contracted demon had a beautiful face like a demon and was a charming woman. She gave Shi Yu a flirtatious glance and also felt quite amazed.
The female succubus beside her also thought highly of Shi Yu. She felt that this was the genius the race wanted. Unfortunately, he was part of the Space Emperor and the others’ race…
“It’s all because the seniors are old that we juniors have a chance. If it were their peak, I definitely wouldn’t have any hope,” Shi Yu said humbly with a smile.
Shi Yu’s words earned the approval of the angel and the Phoenix men. They looked at Shi Yu’s ridiculously young appearance and couldn’t tell at all from his appearance that he was the strongest being on the planet.
Although this planet was already broken like a low-level planet, it was still a quasi-high-level planet that had produced several top-notch gods and defeated three super divine invaders…
How could the strongest Beast Tamer look like this?
“The current situation on the Blue Planet is that the sleeping ancient gods are gradually waking up, and the new generation of geniuses is gradually growing. Although it might take a while to recover to their previous state, without the threat of the outside world, it’s only a matter of time.”
“Those invaders shouldn’t descend to the Blue Planet again, right? Is there any news of them in the universe?” the World Tree clone asked.
Zi Lan smiled and said, “In the starry sky of the universe, planets are the life forms that contain the greatest resources. Low-level planets that can’t give birth to divine beings might not be worth the effort for powerhouses to invade. The gains from a single invasion may not even outweigh the costs of a long journey. However, it’s a different story for intermediate or high-level planets.”
“So much time has passed. The enemies who invaded the Blue Planet back then might no longer exist or have forgotten the Blue Planet, but new invaders will definitely be born as the planet upgrades. However, don’t worry, with Teacher and the others’ current factions, it’s completely no problem to protect the Blue Planet.”
“In the universe, the divine level is also known as the star level, and the super divine level is also known as the radiant sun level. The latter can be understood as an expert as dazzling as a star in the entire starry sky of the universe. There won’t be more than 1,000 such experts in the universe. As for Lord Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng, the two of them once joined forces and killed a super divine life form above their level.”
“Apart from that, a super divine life form was also born among the five divine-level races that walked out of Blue Planet, the Dragon Race, the Phoenix Race, the Kirin Race, the Angel Race, and the Demon Race.”
“Even in the starry sky of the universe, the Blue Planet lineage isn’t a weak faction,” Zi Lan said.
“You have to know that there are only five lives above the super divine level at the moment. Apart from the four universe emperors and that universe overlord, the super divine level is already the strongest in the universe.”
“Therefore, you can rest assured and recover. You can even come into contact with the cosmic civilization and obtain more cosmic resources to complete the evolution. This way, be it the Blue Planet itself or Teacher and the others who left the Blue Planet, they can benefit.”
“Teacher and the others should have prepared a ‘planet transfer plan’ to let you leave this desolate star domain and head to the Cosmic Sea. There, the laws of the universe are more perfect and more suitable for the evolution of planets. It can be said to be the center of the universe.”
“Of course, this plan might take several decades or even over a hundred years to complete. The first priority is for both sides to establish contact through the Teleportation Key Stones.”
As soon as Zi Lan finished speaking, the few awakened gods were rather shocked. Having experienced the Mythical War, they naturally knew how terrifying the super divine level was. Back then, the three super divine level beings almost destroyed the Blue Planet. They could still accept that one of the five large races that walked out of the Blue Planet could break through to the super divine level, but what did they just hear… Two humans joined forces and killed a super divine being?
In addition, the aliens in front of them were also mysterious and had powerful auras. The gods suddenly understood why Goddess Wa brought back the Human Seed for the Blue Planet…
Its potential was too terrifying. In the universe, humans must be a very powerful race.
Could it be… that there were humans among the four universe emperors or universe overlords?
“I see…” The World Tree clone said, “I heard from you just now that you brought four Teleportation Key Stones that can lead to a super planet called ‘World King Planet’?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1243 - 1243 The Look of the Starry Sky (3)
chapters.content:
1243 The Look of the Starry Sky (3)
“At least four life forms can go there?”
“That’s right. Each Teleportation Key Stone can only be bound to one life form. It’s a binding tool.”
“Therefore, in theory, a Teleportation Key Stone can only teleport one life form over.”
“However, there’s also a shortcut, which is to bind the Teleportation Key Stone to humans. This is because the unique contract talent of humans can allow the Key Stone to treat humans and their contracted targets as a whole. This way, more individuals can enter the World King Planet at the same time.”
“Moreover, the generated consumption only depends on the individual’s level, making it the most efficient usage for humans. By the way, ‘World King’ refers to the planet will of the World King Planet, a cosmic-level planetary life. Currently, it’s the most advanced type of planet in the universe,” Zi Lan explained.
At this moment, the few gods on the Blue Planet couldn’t help but stomp their feet again.
When they heard that they could use the Teleportation Key Stone to head to some super planet, they were initially quite happy and felt that there was a better environment to increase their strength.
However… the other party had only brought four Teleportation Key Stones, and they were still bound to a single life form.
Binding a transcendent life form meant they could only send one individual over.
However, binding a human Beast Tamer could teleport multiple lives over, and the consumption was the lowest? This was unreasonable!!
The gods were anxious. In the end, the Blue Planet’s Will would definitely give it to humans.
What about them?
Could it be that they had to lower themselves and sign a contract with a human to hitch a ride?
At the moment, perhaps only Shi Yu was calm. He was very happy to be born a human.
“I wonder what it takes to activate the Teleportation Key Stone.” The World Tree clone asked the most important question.
“Cosmic crystal, divine-level cosmic crystal. It’s a resource that only planetary life forms can absorb the power of the universe to condense. In theory, a divine-level cosmic crystal can allow a Level 9 human to teleport to the World King Star one-way once.”
“The reason why I used Level 9 as an example is that at least a Level 9 life form can withstand the burden of teleportation. This is the rule set by Lord World King.”
“If you want to teleport back, you also need a divine-level cosmic crystal. If it’s a divine life form, you need a super-divine-level cosmic crystal… The stronger the target of the teleportation, the further away from the World King Planet, the greater the consumption, and so on.”
“It’s worth mentioning that a god who was once at the divine level but was suppressed to a lower level because of the incomplete world is also considered a divine level… If you want to go to the World King Planet, you have to consume super-divine-level resources.”
As soon as Zi Lan finished speaking, the seven awakened gods were even more stunned.
The World Tree’s heart skipped a beat.
Shi Yu, who was beside him, took a deep breath. So the method to activate the Teleportation Key Stone was a cosmic crystal… He knew this!
Little Zi could also condense it.
However, the current Little Zi couldn’t even condense a legendary cosmic crystal, let alone a divine-level cosmic crystal.
It was impossible to activate the Teleportation Key Stone.
At this moment, when it heard Zi Lan’s words, not only did the World Tree’s heart skip a beat, but its vision also darkened.
Obviously, condensing a divine-level cosmic crystal wasn’t an easy task for the current Blue Planet.
In addition, after Shi Yu came to a realization, he was also worried. His expression couldn’t help but turn bitter because he wasn’t Level 9 yet.
The lowest usage level of the Teleportation Key Stone was Level 9??
What a joke.
Upon hearing the laws of the World King, Shi Yu’s heart turned cold.
Now, he had yet to reach the level of cosmic crystals and teleportation.
He wanted to cultivate! No one could stop him!
“You should have brought enough cosmic crystals, right?” the World Tree clone asked.
Zi Lan said regretfully, “Actually, we originally brought five Teleportation Key Stones and kept them on five people, respectively. We also drove on different routes to the Blue Planet, worried that something would happen during the voyage.”
“In the end, whatever we were worried about came. The Cosmic Sea is also as unpredictable as the ocean. We encountered a starry sky storm. A teammate was the first to bear the brunt and died in the starry sky, disappearing with a Teleportation Key Stone, so there are only four left.”
“And we also consumed a lot of energy because of this accident. Among them, because the energy consumed to sail is also cosmic crystals, not to mention cosmic crystals that can be used on the Blue Planet, even the cosmic crystals we need to return to our home have been completely consumed.”
“In addition, we actually also have our own key stone that allows us to freely head to World King Planet, but now, because our resources have been exhausted, we can’t even teleport to World King Planet to find Teacher and the others to ask for cosmic crystals.”
“Therefore, we might have to rely on you, Lord Blue Planet. In theory, we only need one piece. At that time, we can take back more cosmic crystals from Teacher.”
At this moment, the few cosmic Beast Tamers and cosmic life forms looked at the World Tree clone eagerly. Now, it was all up to the Blue Planet. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to return home.
This godforsaken place… They didn’t want to stay for a moment longer. Only by successfully returning could they receive the rewards for this mission from the Space Emperor and the clan.
If they couldn’t go back, there was nothing left for them.
“I understand.” The World Tree nodded and said, “I’ll think of a way to get the cosmic crystal.”
“But these four Teleportation Key Stones…” The World Tree said, “Looks like we have to distribute them to humans to maximize the benefits.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1244 - 1244 The Look of the Starry Sky (4)
chapters.content:
1244 The Look of the Starry Sky (4)
Zi Lan said, “Here’s the thing. My suggestion is to distribute them to the strongest humans and let the demigods with the strongest battle power sign an equal contract with them. There are many opportunities on the World King Planet. Only by sending them there can we potentially gain greater rewards.”
“The resources on Teacher and the others’ side aren’t very sufficient for this return. It might be a little difficult to rely on them alone in this plan.”
“We also need the experts of the Blue Planet to work hard themselves.”
“Among them, according to Teacher’s request, at least two of the five Teleportation Key Stones have to be assigned to Dong Huang.”
“Little Brother Shi Yu, do you have any thoughts of exploring the starry sky?” Zi Lan asked Shi Yu with a smile.
“Of course,” Shi Yu said. Eleven, who was on his shoulder, also cried out. It felt even more motivated.
“Teacher and the others will definitely be very happy to see a young genius like you. You became the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet at such a young age. After arriving at World King Planet, your improvement speed will definitely be faster,” Zi Lan said. “According to what I know, there’s still a significant gap between the cultivation systems on the Blue Planet and those of the human race in the starry sky of the universe.”
“Therefore, you still have a lot of room for improvement. Your future is promising.”
Shi Yu: …
Was she implying that he was very lousy now?
“Is there anything different?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask.
The Phoenix man beside Shi Yu looked at him and said, “Beast Tamers on the Blue Planet should only have one Beast Taming Ability, right? Lord Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng seemed to be like this at the start.”
Shi Yu and the others were stunned. Could it be…
“In the Cosmic Sea, humans can cultivate freely. Although their cultivation speed and final battle power are inferior to other races, they are the race with the best strength system.”
“In the words of the Blue Planet, a Beast Tamer can rely on himself to cultivate two, three, four, five, or even 10 types of Beast Taming Talents. Apart from being born with Beast Taming Talents, they can also rely on themselves to cultivate additional talents the day after tomorrow to assist in contracting the target or strengthening themselves.”
“For example, Captain Zi Lan, the strongest among the few of us, developed four Beast Taming Talents in depth. Among them, she has even cultivated spatial strengthening talent to the level of a ‘quasi-divine skill’. On a low-level planet, she should be able to easily trigger the sound of laws and strengthen an ordinary totem-level spatial life form to possess the power of a demigod.”
“If used with other Beast Taming Talents, its battle power will be even stronger.”
The Phoenix Man even looked at the Star Dragon. This big guy had four quasi-divine skills.
Coupled with Zi Lan, it should be a crushing battle power for the life forms on this planet.
He felt that it was the limit for the demigods of this planet to have two quasi-divine skills. If there were more, they would be severely suppressed by the laws of the world and couldn’t advance further.
Zi Lan smiled and said, “Teacher taught me well.”
When the Phoenix man finished speaking, Shi Yu was stunned.
A Beast Tamer can have dozens of Beast Taming Talents? Isn’t this purely cheating!
“Multiple Beast Taming Talents? Quasi-divine-level Beast Taming Talent? Then, isn’t this considered invincible?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
The Ancient God Golden Bull and the other gods looked at Shi Yu. Holy shit, wasn’t this talking about Shi Yu?
In their opinion, Shi Yu’s telepathy, the World Tree Domain, and the Taiji Domain that could trigger the sound of laws were no different from multiple Beast Taming Talents.
This was also why they felt that Shi Yu was more monstrous than other Beast Tamers.
So such Beast Tamers were everywhere in the starry sky of the universe?
However, why was Shi Yu so shocked? This little girl could only let the spatial strengthening talent touch the sound of laws as a Level 9 Legendary Beast Tamer. Shi Yu himself had already done it at Level 6.
Could he look himself in the eye first?
Although they were shocked by the power of the cosmic Beast Tamer, these gods also felt that Shi Yu was even more ridiculous.
They began to wonder if he was a native human of the Blue Planet.
Zi Lan smiled. “It’s alright. Time and energy are necessary to cultivate. Ordinary people can only cultivate three to four abilities to use together.”
The World Tree was also silent at the side. The humans who had transformed into native life forms on the Blue Planet were indeed inferior to the initial batch of Human Seeds brought back by Goddess Wa.
That batch of Human Seeds had stronger talent potential and had become like this because, at that time, the Blue Planet couldn’t nurture humans of this level and didn’t have enough planetary resources.
“In short, at that time, as a newbie on the World King Planet, you will have many opportunities to become stronger. If you grasp it, advancing to the divine level will definitely not be a problem,” Zi Lan said.
“Lord Blue Planet.” Zi Lan looked at the World Tree and said, “That’s all. Next, I wonder how you plan to arrange things.”
The World Tree clone sighed in its heart and said, “You guys rest on the Blue Planet first. I’ll condense a cosmic crystal first. In the Blue Planet’s current state, it’ll probably take a while to condense only one.”
“I have to focus my attention on condensing a cosmic crystal. I can’t entertain you anymore.”
“It’s alright.” Zi Lan expressed that there was no problem. “Then we’ll rest on the Blue Planet first. We can go to the ancestral lands of the various races to take a look first.”
“Little Brother Shi Yu, please take us to Dong Huang.”
“As for the two of them, they should be going to the west. Just let them go over themselves.”
In the face of Zi Lan’s words, the angel man and the female demon shrugged.
Because this mission was led by the Space Emperor, the Space Emperor’s disciple was the captain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1245 - 1245 The Look of the Starry Sky (5)
chapters.content:
1245 The Look of the Starry Sky (5)
At the same time, the Space Emperor’s disciple was indeed strong. They couldn’t defeat the captain, so they still had to be obedient.
“Uh.”
“No problem.” However, at this moment, Shi Yu was also stunned. He asked the World Tree, “Then can I still return?”
Shi Yu remembered that the World Tree had previously provided food and accommodation for him to train in Inatella, right?
Now that the World Tree didn’t even keep the extraterrestrial guests, Shi Yu felt that…
“I’m going to condense a cosmic crystal for you with all my might. Inatella might also close… I won’t keep you,” the World Tree said. “By the way, Shi Yu, you shouldn’t have killed the Tyrant Dragon King and the Black Dragon Lord yet, right?”
Shi Yu’s expression darkened. “Yeah, what’s wrong?”
The World Tree said, “Leave them to me. Creating cosmic crystals can be done faster with the power of other demigods. I plan to let them and those three guys assist me in creating cosmic crystals. When they’re created, they’ll be distributed to Dong Huang first.”
“Uh, is that alright?” Zi Lan was stunned. This mother planet was ruthless. It actually wanted to squeeze demigods to accelerate the creation of cosmic crystals. It wasn’t easy for the current Blue Planet to produce a demigod, right? However, it was for the best. They just had to obtain cosmic crystals as soon as possible.
“It’s alright,” the World Tree said regretfully. “Unfortunately, you killed the Abyss Demon Frog too quickly…”
Otherwise, they could also be pulled over to mine.
Shi Yu was stunned, and the corners of his mouth twitched. He had Little Zi, so he naturally knew the thoughts of the World Tree. To put it bluntly, it was free labor. “Alright, then my cosmic crystal depends on you.”
“When the time comes, remember to give me more…”
“Yes.” The World Tree nodded. If not Shi Yu, who else could it give the cosmic crystals to?
Shi Yu, who had a double contract slot, definitely had to be nurtured as the main force.
“In that case, I’ll leave Inatella too,” the Ancient God Golden Bull said.
“Me too. Condensing a cosmic crystal is more important,” the Boar God said.
A few gods who were originally sleeping and recovering their restoration power on Inatella’s side spoke one after another.
What a joke.
What if the Blue Planet didn’t like them one day and pulled them to mine too?
They couldn’t stay here for long.
Shi Yu was stunned. He said to the Ancient God Golden Bull and the others, “Then seniors, why don’t you come to Dong Huang too?”
The few gods looked at each other and said, “As long as Dong Huang welcomes us, there’s naturally no problem.”
After hearing about the power of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng and realizing the extraordinariness of the human race, joining Dong Huang was undoubtedly the best choice.
In any case, they had nothing to worry about. Shi Yu was also a big shot in front of the World Tree. They had also given Shi Yu benefits, so how could Dong Huang treat them badly?
…
After Zi Lan and the others handed the four key stones to the World Tree, Inatella was closed.
Shi Yu and the others separated. Shi Yu brought Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the Ancient God Golden Bull to Dong Huang.
As for the angel man, the female demon, and the others, they went to their ancestral lands.
Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man were both from the Dong Huang bloodline and were followers of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. They had contracted descendants of the dragon and Phoenix Race. At the moment, they could find more members of the same race in Dong Huang.
At this moment, during the process of heading to Dong Huang, Shi Yu had many questions and wanted to understand more about the appearance of the starry sky.
“Sister Zi Lan, is that cosmic overlord very powerful? Previously, there was a Yun Race invader on the Blue Planet. My hometown seemed to have been destroyed by the cosmic overlord’s army.”
“How big is the difference in strength between a cosmic overlord and a cosmic emperor?”
Zi Lan said, “I don’t know either. Their strengths are worlds apart, even compared to a super divine level. I’m afraid even Teacher and the others don’t know how strong a cosmic-level life form is. However, what’s certain is that killing a super divine being should be as easy as breathing for them. Destroying a planet should be just a matter of moving a finger.”
“After all, even in the army of a cosmic overlord… there are also a bunch of super-divine-level subordinates. We can’t afford to provoke them. Both parties are in two different worlds, not in the same dimension. After you enter the starry sky, don’t offend them.”
“Alright, don’t think too much first. Our most important thing now is to wait for Lord Blue Planet to condense a cosmic crystal. At that time, you can personally see the appearance of the starry sky.”
“You’re a newbie of the World King Star and the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet. At that time, you can get Lord Blue Planet to invest more resources in you. You can participate in the God Sealing Battle of the World King Star. If you can achieve pretty good results, you’ll harvest great gains. It’s hugely beneficial to the evolution of the Blue Planet.”
The Phoenix man said, “It’s a little difficult. His foundation is still a little inferior to those guys in the starry sky. Even the Space Emperor, Lord Lin Feng, and the others suffered a lot at the start.”
Zi Lan said, “What’s wrong? I think he’s much stronger than you. He became a Legendary Beast Tamer at this age and is the strongest expert on the planet. Do you think you can achieve the same things on a low-level planet?”
The Phoenix man was speechless.
At this moment, the Ancient God Golden Bull and the other gods also looked at Shi Yu silently.
After a moment of silence, the Ancient God Golden Bull said, “Shi Yu, you were only a Level 6 Beast Tamer when you participated in the World Tournament. Why did you become a Legendary Beast Tamer so quickly? Did the World Tree give you some special treatment?”
The Ancient God Golden Bull was considering whether to fight Shi Yu. Although he loved to fight, it was too difficult to do so in the Blue Planet’s current situation. If it were a one-sided retaliation, it might be manageable, but the Ancient Bull God wasn’t foolish enough to risk being beaten up again.
He might as well give the resources to Shi Yu and forget about the battle…
“No, Lord World Tree only said that I’m the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet, but he didn’t say that I’m a Legendary Beast Tamer. I’m only at Level 8 now. When I return, I have to cultivate as soon as possible. Otherwise, I won’t be able to use the Teleportation Key Stone.” Shi Yu hated it.
“Sister Zi Lan, do you have any relatively powerful meditation techniques that can accelerate leveling up?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Zi Lan and the Phoenix man paused and suddenly looked at Shi Yu.
Level 8?
Wasn’t the current upper limit of Blue Planet Level 9?
Lord Lin Feng, the Space Emperor, and the others had all reached Level 9 on the Blue Planet.
Among them, Lord Lin Feng said that even Mechanical Legendaries stronger than him at that time couldn’t become the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet.
And this guy was Level 8?
He had become the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet, certified by the World Tree?
What was going on?!
What about the other legendaries?
Were they all dead?
“Uh,” Shi Yu said. “No?”
“Oh, I see. You just reached Level 8 and already became the strongest Beast Tamer by surpassing levels, huh? Impressive, just like back then.” Several gods who had experienced the World Tournament and were well aware of Shi Yu’s extraordinary strength nodded in agreement. It turned out he was stronger in terms of combat power, even if his level hadn’t caught up yet. It was understandable and very much like Shi Yu, always full of surprises.
The Holy Divine Deer said, “Shi Yu could easily kill a totem-level being when he was a Level 6 Beast Tamer. Now that he’s Level 8, it’s barely acceptable for him to become the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet.”
The Demon King Dragon said, “He’ll definitely be considered a monster if placed in the universe.”
“No, no. It’s all luck.” Shi Yu didn’t dare show off in front of this group of aliens, afraid of being beaten up. At the moment, he felt that he couldn’t defeat them. He would wait until his strength developed for a period of time!!
Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man: ???
The two of them fell into deep thought and looked at the harmless Shi Yu. Why did they feel that there was something wrong with this guy?

chapters.title: Chapter 1246 - 1246 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (1)
chapters.content:
1246 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (1)
The arrival of aliens received a lot of attention.
All parties were probing and maintaining vigilance against the impending “enemy” from the starry sky.
Dong Huang was no exception.
Just as they finished experiencing the Dragon Palace coup, an abnormality suddenly appeared in the starry sky. The higher-ups of Dong Huang, who knew some inside information about the universe, were worried.
President Lin and the gem cat originally wanted to deal with the related incidents of the Dragonman Empire, but they also stopped.
“The other party… has come to Dong Huang?” President Lin’s expression changed.
“Yes… the other party’s energy fluctuation has appeared on the East Sea.”
“In the Demon Capital,” the gem cat girl said with a sigh. She suddenly felt that becoming a demigod wasn’t a good thing.
In the past, she only needed to eat, drink, and sleep at Ancient Capital University. But now, there was a pile of troublesome matters.
She was just a cat!
She was frustrated and furious.
“However, it doesn’t seem to be an enemy… Shi Yu is also there?”
The gem cat subsequently sensed that Shi Yu, who had just left with the World Tree, was also with the group of cosmic guests.
There was even… a pile of familiar fluctuations.
For example, Shi Yu had been asking her to find Niu Niu.
Ah, could the clone finally get off work?
“Let’s go take a look.” President Lin fell into deep thought. Was it related to Shi Yu being called away by the World Tree?
The gem cat and President Lin immediately rushed to the East Sea.
Shi Yu and the others were teleported to the East Sea by the World Tree.
As everyone chatted, they talked about Shi Yu, the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet, who was only Level 8 at the moment.
This really made Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the Starry Dragon Phoenix feel incredulous.
For a moment, they didn’t know if they should say that Shi Yu was strong, or that the other legendary beings were too lousy.
“He became the strongest being at Level 8?” Zi Lan realized that she had underestimated Shi Yu previously.
“Qi Mu, why don’t you spar with Shi Yu? I suddenly want to know his strength.”
“Little Brother Shi Yu, what do you think?” Zi Lan looked at Shi Yu and asked.
“I’m suddenly very curious about your strength too. You can satisfy my little request, right?”
As for Shi Yu, the corners of his mouth twitched. “Let’s not.”
“Aren’t you guys in a very poor state?”
In addition, Shi Yu had just fought five demigods.
Although it mainly consumed his power of faith, at this moment, his desire to fight wasn’t very strong.
He was in Sage Mode.
After all, he had just activated the Green Dragon Domain for a while and was quite tired.
“It’s alright.”
When the Phoenix man heard the captain’s command, his expression first turned bitter, but soon, he said naturally, “We can still take it if we spar appropriately.”
He didn’t want to either, but on second thought, this wasn’t a bad job.
The plan for the joint effort between the Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng’s forces, along with the five god races of the Floating Planet, to guide the mother planet had caused quite a stir over there.
It could be said to have received attention from many parties.
The various factions were waiting for the news to be transmitted back.
And if he defeated the most talented and powerful Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet, wouldn’t he become famous after the Floating Planet learned about it?
The level of this mission was very high. He had to achieve something!
“…” Shi Yu was silent.
This kid.
“Let’s give it a try and fight.” When the Ancient God Golden Bull saw this, he was stunned for a moment before suddenly provoking the aliens.
“It sounds pretty interesting.” The seven sleeping gods revealed intrigued expressions.
Between an extraterrestrial Beast Tamer and the most monstrous Beast Tamer genius on the Blue Planet, who was stronger?
“With the seven of us demigods around, nothing will happen.” They all joined in the provocation.
“Didn’t you want special meditation techniques previously?” Zi Lan smiled and said, “We don’t have special meditation techniques, but we have a bunch of cultivation skills in the starry sky of the universe.”
“For example, skills to develop the third and fourth talents…”
“I even have the skill to develop the spatial strengthening talent.”
“If you win, I’ll pack it up for you.”
The Ancient God Golden Bull and the others were stunned.
Damn.
Shi Yu, this kid, was already monstrous enough. If Shi Yu still had multiple Beast Taming Talents, they couldn’t imagine how strong he would be when the time came.
“This…”
At this moment, Shi Yu felt that even if they didn’t fight, Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, and the others would still give these skills to Dong Huang.
However, it wouldn’t be bad if he could obtain it in advance.
“This… Alright then.” Shi Yu smiled.
Forget it, so be it.
“Wu wu wu.”
Eleven looked at the Star Phoenix with a serious expression.
The Star Phoenix seemed like a strong enemy.
“Hm?”
The Star Phoenix looked at Eleven calmly.
Everyone was very satisfied with the outcome.
“Meow~”
At this moment, two spatial ripples blinked.
The gem cat girl brought President Lin here.
At this moment, just as President Lin arrived, he saw the group of Inatella gods behind Shi Yu, and couldn’t help but be stunned.
However, when he saw Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the Starry Dragon Phoenix behind them, he was even more shocked.
“Yo, President Lin, Teacher Ying,” Shi Yu said. “You’re here.”
Zi Lan and the others also looked at President Lin Xiao and the gem cat girl.
“Shi Yu, they are…” President Lin said.
“Let me introduce you. This is Zi Lan, the disciple of the Senior Space Emperor. This is Qi Mu, a follower of Senior Lin Feng.”
“These two are descendants of the Blue Planet Dragon and Phoenix Races in the Mythical Era. They have a contractual relationship with Zi Lan and Qi Mu.”
“This time, they were entrusted by Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, and the others in the Cosmic Sea to bring the Teleportation Key Stones to help the Blue Planet connect to the starry sky. Next, they have to rest in Dong Huang for a period of time,” Shi Yu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1247 - 1247 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (2)
chapters.content:
1247 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (2)
“What!” After Shi Yu introduced them, President Lin was shocked.
“You’re Lord Lin Feng’s great-grandson?” Upon hearing President Lin’s identity, Zi Lan and the Phoenix man were both very surprised.
At this moment, President Lin and the gem cat girl were stunned. They had the same thought as Shi Yu.
The owl… The owl’s premonition was right again???
No, it shouldn’t be a prediction about the future. From the timeline, it looked like the owl had spied on the past and seen the Space Emperor and Lin Feng handing the key stones to these people.
What’s wrong with the owl?
Is he on steroids? He’s so impressive.
“And these gods also plan to come to Dong Huang to stay for a few days,” Shi Yu said.
“I’m Lin Xiao. Welcome, everyone.” At this moment, President Lin was shocked. Although Divine Source Legendary was sleeping, he had already decided to wake the old man up later.
This world was about to change.
Sensing the powerful auras on the Starry Dragon Phoenix, Zi Lan, and Qi Mu, he felt that these two young people were stronger than any Legendary Beast Tamer he had ever seen.
Great-grandfather… What level of expert had his great-grandfather become in the universe?
And Inatella’s gods were also here… President Lin took a deep breath and was extremely excited. He felt that Dong Huang’s rise was already unstoppable!
“This place isn’t suitable to receive everyone. Let’s go to Dong Huang first,” President Lin said.
“There’s no hurry. Qi Mu and Little Brother Shi Yu still have to spar.” Zi Lan smiled and said, “Let’s do it here. There’s basically no one around.”
President Lin and the gem cat: ???
They looked at Shi Yu.
President Lin opened his mouth slightly and felt a headache. His heart almost stopped.
Shi Yu, Shi Yu, aren’t they guests? Why do you want to fight them the moment they arrived?
Furthermore, didn’t you just fight five demigods? Can your body take it!
With a boom, a huge island was pulled out of the sea.
Shi Yu looked at it and said, “Thank you.”
Lie Shanjun: “You’re welcome.”
In midair, Zi Lan said, “Qi Mu is at Level 9. Little Brother Shi Yu, you’re at Level 8. This spar is a little unfair to you, so I’ll reveal some information about him to you.”
Shi Yu looked at the Phoenix man.
Qi Mu: “Go ahead.”
Zi Lan smiled and said, “He mainly cultivates four abilities. One is fire-element strengthening, the other is light-element strengthening, the other is fusion, and the other is star flame. It’s a relatively normal ability configuration among contractors in the Cosmic Sea.”
“He has also cultivated other skills such as telepathy and spiritual power, but he doesn’t major in them, and doesn’t use them well. Only those four were developed to his current level.”
He had four Beast Taming Talents?
No, it was more than four!
President Lin and the gem cat, who still didn’t know that cosmic Beast Tamers could have multiple Beast Taming Talents, were stunned.
Wait, this worked?
“His partner, Feng Jiu, is at the demigod level. She has mastered three quasi-divine skills, one fire-element attack-type quasi-divine skill, one light-element attack-type quasi-divine skill, and one defensive-type quasi-divine skill to strengthen the Phoenix bloodline and body.”
“When they partner up, they’re very strong. Even Lord Lin Feng acknowledges them very much.”
Zi Lan introduced with a smile, wanting to see Shi Yu’s shocked expression.
Shi Yu was indeed very shocked. Three quasi-divine skills…
They weren’t easy opponents.
President Lin and the gem cat started to have toothaches.
Damn, just now, they were still worried if it would be bad for Shi Yu to bully the person sent by the Space Emperor and the others.
But now, when President Lin heard the other party’s ability configuration, he felt that it was ridiculous.
This ability configuration was completely overpowering experts on the Blue Planet indiscriminately.
“Don’t worry, we’ll show mercy,” the Star Phoenix said.
“Don’t be nervous. Relax. Just treat it as a normal spar,” the Phoenix man said.
“We’re not weak either.”
President Lin and the others pursed their lips. Indeed.
Although Shi Yu didn’t have a pet that had mastered three quasi-divine skills, he had four demigod-level pets that had mastered one quasi-divine skill each.
Previously, the way the Green Dragon effortlessly dealt with five demigods seemed anything but merciful or lenient.
“Alright.” The Phoenix man smiled.
“I remember that the contract system on the Blue Planet is used to a Beast Tamer contracting multiple pets, right?” Zi Lan asked.
“Yes, this is the Beast Taming System of the Human Nation.” Shi Yu nodded.
“That’s what Teacher and Lord Lin Feng said too. But in the Cosmic Sea, for various reasons, more humans only contract one beast and then concentrate on resources and energy to nurture it.”
“In this way, the strength of both parties can actually increase faster,” Zi Lan said.
“I learned from Teacher that the Legendary Beast Tamers on the Blue Planet basically haven’t cultivated demigod-level pets, but in the Cosmic Sea, although humans only contract one beast at the legendary level, the contracted Beast Tamer basically has demigod battle power… There are very few who haven’t reached the demigod level.”
“One pursues numbers, while the other pursues elite cultivation. They’re considered two different directions.”
“Therefore, if Little Brother Shi Yu has also contracted many pets, you can send them all out next to fight Qi Mu, Feng Jiu, and the others. Only then will it be fair.”
“They’re a pair, but you don’t have to fight 1v1.”
“Then I won’t hold back.” Shi Yu smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1248 - 1248 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (3)
chapters.content:
1248 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (3)
Shi Yu could also understand this. After all, Feng Jiu should be a natural Mythical Race with multiple quasi-divine skills. Just nurturing such a top-notch contracted beast would consume countless resources.
In short, at this moment, when he heard that the opponent only had one contracted beast and that the other party didn’t mind him sending out all his contracted pets, Shi Yu was slightly more confident in this battle.
Sigh, he didn’t have a pet with three quasi-divine skills. The quality wasn’t enough. Fortunately, he could make up for it with numbers.
Shi Yu didn’t believe that Eleven and the others couldn’t defeat the other party when they attacked together.
They weren’t to be trifled with either.
If Shi Yu remembered correctly, divine-level talents seemed to be very rare in the universe, but he had mastered them at Level 6. This was his advantage.
Between him and the cosmic Beast Tamer, it was still uncertain who was stronger.
“Then let’s begin.”
The Phoenix Man landed on the ground. For the time being, he had no intention of fusing with the Star Phoenix and entering the strongest mode.
He planned to let the Star Phoenix fight Shi Yu and the others one-on-one first.
“Send out your contracted beasts.” The Star Phoenix flew in front of the Phoenix man and looked at Shi Yu, who had landed opposite it.
Shi Yu was silent… Then he… would really send out all his pets!
Don’t blame him for bullying them!
Under the gazes of Zi Lan, President Lin, the gem cat girl, and many gods…
Shi Yu’s short black hair swayed slightly with the wind, and his expression became serious. At the same time, five huge red summoning star arrays appeared around his body!
“Come out, everyone.”
One, two, three, four, five… six…!
This number made Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, and the others nod.
It looked like Shi Yu wasn’t that greedy to nurture eight pets.
How could he nurture all eight of them?
The resources needed to break through to the divine level were almost a sea of resources. One was enough.
Next, it depended on the cultivation level of Shi Yu’s pets.
Because it wanted to fight, Ling left its energy-efficient form and directly revealed the powerful fluctuations of the Mythical Race at the overlord level.
“Mechanic.” The Phoenix man didn’t care. He sensed that Ling wasn’t very strong.
Therefore, this was the disadvantage of contracting multiple pets. It couldn’t be helped that not all of them would be very powerful.
However, as the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet, he didn’t believe that Shi Yu didn’t have more tricks up his sleeve.
As expected, as Ling was the first to come out of the summoning array beside Shi Yu, it directly armed Shi Yu’s body and turned into a tactical eyepiece!
Shi Yu pressed the tactical eyepiece slightly and moved it in front of him.
Boom!!!
His aura began to climb steadily. Nine-colored light spread in his eyes, and his perception of the outside world reached an extreme state.
“Ling, activate support battle mode.”
“This is…”
After Ling loaded itself onto Shi Yu, in addition to Shi Yu’s terrifying body that had been trained to the extreme, Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the Inatella Gods were surprised to discover that Shi Yu’s aura was actually comparable to that of a demigod.
Although it was a weaker demigod, the Phoenix man was still very surprised to see this. After all, Shi Yu was only Level 8.
“What a strong physique. The fusion compatibility between the two parties is quite high.”
“That’s the nine-colored divine light,” the Holy Divine Deer said.
With the enhancement of the skill and the fusion of the Beast Tamer, have both parties actually temporarily reached demigod battle power?
Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man both acknowledged Shi Yu.
In fact, Shi Yu only wanted Ling to be a support at this moment.
After all, his current state wasn’t very good. He needed the gentle, nine-colored divine light to strengthen him!
Then, to Zi Lan and the Phoenix man’s surprise, with a hum, an invisible wind of luck wrapped around Shi Yu.
Seeing this, Zi Lan was shocked. “Isn’t this… the race divine skill of the Wind Kirin that has already been exterminated in the Kirin Race, the Wind of Blessing?”
The inheritance of the Wind Kirin still exists on the Blue Planet???
The Phoenix Man was also astonished. Showcasing the prototype of a divine skill coupled with the energy fluctuations of the demigod level, without a doubt, the Shi Yu before them could be considered to possess the power of a demigod.
No wonder he was the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet.
“Roar!!!” After Ling’s appearance, the sky darkened. The Green Dragon, Buggy, flew out of the sky array. Under the flickering of the starlight, the shocking dragon roar made the pupils of the Star Dragon beside it shrink and look over.
The Star Phoenix was also suddenly shocked by Buggy’s aura eruption. Under the multiple enhancements of quasi-divine skills, faith skills, and cosmic life physiques, Buggy’s individual foundation was barely passable.
The pressure it gave Phoenix Man and the others was undoubtedly that of a demigod.
“Another demigod-level battle power…” At this moment, the Phoenix man was stunned.
So that was the case. He was a demigod and had a demigod dragon. No wonder he could become the strongest Beast Tamer.
As for the two demigods, he suddenly felt that this battle could be slightly more interesting.
However, in the next moment, the expressions of the Phoenix Man and the Star Phoenix changed.
“Jiu!!!!!”
The summoning array appeared in the sky once again. Under the spreading of the Sun Flame, the terrifying temperature inside rose, as if it could burn everything. A Sun Vermillion Bird flew out and released the powerful power of fire. Its energy fluctuations were close to those of a demigod, but it was only a clone.
On its body stood a beautiful girl with a cold expression. She held a red sword and looked down at the Star Phoenix and the Phoenix Man from a high place. A demigod-level sword intent erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1249 - 1249 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (4)
chapters.content:
1249 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (4)
The auras of both parties overlapped. The shocking sword intent that was enough to crush ordinary demigods made its aura not inferior to the Green Dragon at all.
This guy named Shi Yu was Level 8 and contracted two demigods? Moreover, he could reach demigod-level battle power himself?
What a freak!
Although the Star Phoenix felt that the aura of one of the lives summoned by Shi Yu was inferior to it, they had to take them seriously when three appeared at once.
The Star Phoenix felt that… it would take a little effort.
But this… wasn’t the end at all.
In the interweaving of red and blue, Susu transformed into the form of a Blue Sea Sprite, rejuvenated by the convergence of water elements, and descended upon this place. On the Blue Planet, it possessed boundless energy, allowing it to erupt without restraint. Empowered by the Time Fruit, it wielded a demigod level of strength, manifesting as vast energy fluctuations akin to the ocean, directly emanating from Susu’s being.
Another demigod!
At this moment, the Phoenix man suddenly felt a little numb. Four demigod-level battle power…
How was that possible?
Boom!!!
Four was far from the limit. In the array on the ground, the World Ginseng rose from the ground in the form of a divine tree and activated a quasi-divine skill. It communicated with the power of the world and activated the Time Fruit on the tree to enter a life-burning state.
“Pop…” The sound of laws resounded, and the tree fruit swayed. The demigod power that wasn’t inferior to Susu, Shi Yu, and the others also erupted with a bang, making the towering emperor standing on the tree very smug.
“Yi! (I’m the towering emperor. Alien, come!)”
The fifth demigod battle power!
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, Eleven, who was in a restrained, energy-efficient state, also leaped down from Shi Yu’s shoulder. As it walked onto the battlefield, it gradually enlarged and turned into a hundred-meter-tall behemoth. Black and white lightning intertwined on its body, and it entered the Chaos Panda form.
