The final demigod also ascended the battlefield.
Panda King, go!
Zi Lan, Phoenix Man, and the others were stunned!
Six demigods!
Those without totem levels could also rely on various methods to temporarily reach demigod battle power, and they weren’t weak demigods.
As Shi Yu finished speaking, on the other side, after seeing Shi Yu, a Level 8 Beast Tamer, send out six demigod battle powers, the Phoenix Man and the Star Phoenix were already stunned.
“This is impossible,” they couldn’t help but say.
The Ancient God Golden Bull also widened his bull eyes with a stunned expression. When the gods and spirits saw Shi Yu’s posture, they were all moved.
Holy shit, this was too much.
Was this really Shi Yu, a low-level Beast Tamer, challenging a higher-level Beast Tamer??
Why did they feel that something was wrong?
In short, the Phoenix Man and the Star Phoenix were stunned. Although they recalled that as the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet, Shi Yu would be stronger than ordinary legendary Beast Tamers, his strength should be limited.
After all, according to their understanding, the legendaries of the Blue Planet didn’t even have the ability to nurture demigod-level battle power.
As the strongest Beast Tamer, it was enough for Shi Yu to have two demigod battle powers.
However, who would have thought that Shi Yu would take out six demigod battle powers at once?
Was he playing with them?
“This, this, this, this.” This was the first time Zi Lan, the disciple of the Space Emperor, had seen such a ridiculous Level 8 Beast Tamer. Even on the floating planet, she had never seen a Level 8 Beast Tamer with the battle power of multiple demigods.
At Level 9, she might be able to find them, such as the Space Emperor and Lin Feng at that time, but at Level 8, she had never seen them before.
“Ha… Ha, let’s just say that this kid is very abnormal. Although you guys come from a big place, the Blue Planet also has monsters not inferior to starry sky geniuses,” the Ancient God Golden Bull, who was a rough person, said dryly.
It was mainly because the stronger Shi Yu was, the less unjust his loss to him was!
“Qi Mu…”
At this moment, Zi Lan was unable to predict the battle’s outcome.
Although the Phoenix Man had a huge individual battle power advantage, the other party had too many people of the same level. Six demigods could indeed pose a threat to him.
However… he shouldn’t lose, right?
“Well, we’re going to attack,” Shi Yu shouted.
At this moment, the Phoenix man could be said to be extremely serious. He no longer had his previous arrogance.
However, apart from being serious, he was also encouraging himself. Although Shi Yu had displayed the battle power of six demigods, the Phoenix man could also tell that a few of them had demigod battle power temporarily obtained with skills.
With his and Feng Jiu’s combined strength, they should be invincible on the Blue Planet. Then it shouldn’t be difficult to defeat those six demigods one by one. It wasn’t a big problem.
If he did, how could he face his companions or return to the Floating Planet…
“Come on,” the Phoenix man shouted, his warpath raised. As expected of Lord Lin Feng’s home planet. So there was such a genius, but he wouldn’t admit defeat!
“Taiji Domain, open!” On the other side, as the battle began, Shi Yu directly activated the mind domain he had developed.
“Eleven, Yin Yang Millstone.”
It used its strongest unique skill to test the strength of the enemy.
As Shi Yu’s Psychic Eye spun, a strong domain bloomed from his body. With him as the center, it quickly formed a domain that enveloped the world.
In an instant, an incomparably huge spinning Taiji Painting appeared in the sky and ground.
The Phoenix man and the Star Phoenix were stunned. Their expressions changed as they instantly felt their bloodlines being suppressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1250 - 1250 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (5)
chapters.content:
1250 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (5)
The entire world became black and white.
On the horizon, there was even a star that was identical to the patterns in Shi Yu’s eyes. In this domain, it replaced the sun and moon.
That was the manifestation of Shi Yu’s Eye of the Heart. It hung on the horizon of the domain and watched everything!
Under its gaze, the pattern in the Taiji Painting spinning in the sky and ground seemed to have turned into two Yin Yang fish that slowly appeared and wrapped around Eleven.
At the same time, the planet trembled, and an incomparably deep sound of laws appeared on Eleven’s body. Its hands swayed as the Yin Yang Fish swam. The laws fused, and a huge pressure appeared on the entire island.
“It’s this move!” The Ancient God Golden Bull was afraid.
The consecutive changes could be said to have shocked Zi Lan and the Phoenix man.
“Roar!!!” The main attacker, Eleven, had the Yin Yang Fish swim into its hand. On its palm, a circular metal formed, showing black and white colors, one yin and one yang, one light and one dark. It was filled with two-colored lightning that fused, converted, and collided. It was extremely mysterious.
All around, everything turned into a chaotic void, the balance shattered and was erased by its influence.
The two voices of law fused and directly completed the combination of a quasi-divine skill!!
No, this wasn’t a simple combination of Eleven and Shi Yu. There was also Ling’s help. After all, Ling’s Armor greatly increased the strength of Shi Yu.
At this moment, as Shi Yu used a baffling ability, the Phoenix man was stunned.
What the f*ck is this? The Phoenix man was extremely shocked. Beast Taming Talent? Did the Beast Taming Talent that Shi Yu used just now trigger the sound of laws?
Wait a minute, isn’t Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Talent a talent in mental strength? Just now, when they saw Shi Yu use psychic power to fly and even know telepathy, they originally thought that it was a talent in this aspect.
In addition, the Beast Tamers on the Blue Planet basically only had one Beast Taming Talent, so they didn’t think about it much at all. But at this moment, what was this thing Shi Yu used?
A divine-level talent that triggered the sound of laws? Among the younger generation below the Floating Planet’s divine level, only Zi Lan, the personal disciple of the Space Emperor, had mastered a divine-level spatial talent.
Moreover, she had mastered it at Level 9.
But how did Shi Yu master a divine-level ability at Level 8?
Moreover, due to the law’s fluctuations, they even felt suppression. This was undoubtedly a top-notch law skill. Be it what pets or Beast Tamers used, they were all top-notch law skills that complemented each other!!
Destructive power, breaking the laws!
“Impossible!!” The Phoenix man couldn’t believe this fact. He couldn’t believe that Shi Yu had actually mastered such a strong skill. Moreover, that black and white bear was actually a pet with top-notch divine aptitude.
However, the attack was completed.
Sensing the huge pressure, although he was shocked, he had to accept it.
“Holy sh*t, do you have to be so… Feng Jiu!” The Phoenix man himself shouted. His body directly turned into a beam of light and fused into the Star Phoenix.
At this moment, the Star Phoenix was also stunned. What the hell?
Although it had three quasi-divine skills, it didn’t have top-notch quasi-divine skills.
It was fine if there were six demigods of the same level, but why was there such a monster among them?
“Jiu…”
In the next second, the starlight flickered. A birdman with a human body but four limbs and wings with the characteristics of the Star Phoenix circled in the sky under the starlight.
Explosive fluctuations that shook the stars came from their bodies, but the Phoenix man didn’t become as calm as before at all. He was still extremely nervous.
“Fire-element strengthening, activate, light-element strengthening, activate!”
“Bloodline strengthening, activate!”
Buzz!!
A terrifying energy eruption that was indeed stronger than Eleven and the others alone shook the entire Blue Planet.
However, facing the huge panda that leaped over with a huge millstone in hand, they were still extremely nervous.
“Profundity, Feather Fall Star.” The Phoenix man gritted his teeth. His body spun 360 degrees in the air, and his wings flew. Blue and red starlight bloomed, and like the speed of light, it also triggered the sound of multiple laws.
Light, fire, and bloodline divine techniques astonishingly formed the essence of the three law quasi-divine skills. Beneath the swirling wings, they now resembled falling stars, carving a tricolored light trace across the void—incredibly dazzling and magnificent. They collided with the eleven strikes from the Yin Yang Millstone wielded in hand.
Boom!!!
The collision of mountains and seas and shocking stars immediately caused space to shatter, shattering the Taiji Domain as if it was pulling both parties into another world.
“What exactly is this?” Zi Lan looked at the shattered Taiji Domain fragment and found it unbelievable.
President Lin said, “Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Talent developed a second time through telepathy, Psychic Domain…”
Zi Lan was shocked. “You mean he developed other talents on the basis of only one telepathy talent??”
How was this possible?
Even the geniuses in the universe developed other talents through the cultivation methods passed down. Where did Shi Yu get the cultivation methods on this planet?
Zi Lan was stunned. Moreover, it was a Level 8 talent that had cultivated to the divine level… Could it be that they’re telling them that Shi Yu was really a peerless genius? His talent even far exceeded that of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng?
“Roar!!!”
“Damn it.”
In the incomparably violent collision, this was the first time Shi Yu and the others suffered in such an all-out state. Eleven’s painful roar came from the shattered spatial tide. Although the Yin Yang Millstone created by the ultimate combination of it, Shi Yu, and Ling sent the Phoenix Man flying, Eleven’s own Yin Yang Millstone was also shattered by the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 1251 - 1251 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (6)
chapters.content:
1251 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (6)
As the Yin Yang Millstone was still incomplete, it couldn’t successfully obliterate and destroy the other party’s divine skill profundities. In the collision of power, it was slightly inferior. The Phoenix Man was sent flying, and Eleven was flipped over and rolled backward. Both parties suffered a certain amount of backlash. To be precise, the backlash on Shi Yu and the others’ side was more serious. Even though Eleven had the Indestructible Golden Body, the backlash was still very serious. However, the Phoenix Man wasn’t happy at all.
He had almost forgotten that this wasn’t a one-on-one battle between him and the black and white bear at all. Shi Yu still had a bunch of pets that had yet to attack!
“Roar!!!” In the Creation Domain, the Green Dragon, Buggy, occupied the starry sky and stared at the ground with its dragon eyes. On the ground, spring instantly overflowed. Countless plants grew lushly, and the plants slowed down Eleven’s impact and made it slowly roll to a stop.
It had already used up the power of faith it carried. At this moment, Buggy could only use the power of faith drifting on the Blue Planet with the Creation Domain.
The Green Dragon’s power of faith was divided into three parts. One was the power of faith carried on by the antiques he had collected from various spaces on the Blue Planet. This had always been carried by Buggy, but it had already been used up when fighting the gods of Dragon Palace City previously.
After this was gone, Shi Yu and the others still had the power of faith of the Green Dragon lingering around the various life forms on the Blue Planet to use, as well as the power of faith of the Green Dragon in Little Zi’s body.
There were still too few in Little Zi’s body, and Shi Yu had always been reluctant to use the ones of the Blue Planet. However, when he recalled that he had just destroyed the Tyrant Dragon King and that the power of faith in the Dragonman Empire was about to belong to him, Shi Yu felt a little more generous.
“Yi! (Are you alright?)” The Divine Tree Ginseng Emperor controlled the plants to catch Eleven. Through the kindness of the world, it combined Buggy’s spring law and revived Eleven.
“Wuu!! (Revival!)” Eleven instantly revived to full health. It pressed down on the ground and crawled up, looking excitedly at the Phoenix Man, who was still flying backward in the sky. The cosmic Beast Tamer was so strong.
It still wanted to continue!
Eleven and Shi Yu thought so, but the Phoenix man didn’t feel that he was strong at all. As he forcefully stopped flying backward, he looked at the huge Green Dragon in the sky in shock.
“Roar!!!” The dragon breath that contained lightning fire triggered the power of destruction and spat at the Phoenix man.
Boom.
Under the touch of the sound of laws, he was stunned again.
This domain was undoubtedly created by it. Looking at this Creation Domain condensed from the power of faith, a few words appeared in his and the Star Phoenix’s minds.
“Faith in a quasi-divine skill, the Law of Creation? This is… the Green Dragon?”
“Impossible! How can someone nurture a Green Dragon of this level in this place!” he exclaimed.
Their figures were instantly drowned by the dragon’s breath, but at the critical moment, the wings turned into a huge light ball that wrapped around their bodies.
The star-like light ball and dragon breath kept squeezing. Unfortunately, in the end, the dragon breath still couldn’t suppress the light ball. But even so, the aftermath of the violent explosion produced by both parties still sent the Phoenix man flying again, leaving them covered in injuries.
“Holy shit.” At this moment, sensing Buggy’s god-like dignity in the sky, the Demon King Dragon and the others were stunned. The Law of Creation… They knew that Shi Yu’s Green Dragon’s power of imagination had a chance of advancing to the Law of Creation, but in the end, did it really succeed?
However, Zi Lan was even more stunned than them. She raised her hand and pointed at the Green Dragon shakily.
“Green Dragon… How did he nurture it?”
Zi Lan was speechless. “The Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise are all suspected to be four cosmic life forms from the last cosmic era. No one knows if they exist, but there are many ruins related to the four saints in the universe. Archeology discovered a large number of antiques that contain the power of the four saints and the power of faith of Elder Gu.”
“Therefore, many lives in the Cosmic Sea are evolving towards these four lives.”
“The faith of the Green Dragon, White Tiger, Vermillion Bird, and Black Tortoise is everywhere in the universe. Blue Planet also has it. I’m not surprised. It’s just that the Green Dragon that has mastered the laws of creation is very rare. It’s already considered quite perfect in evolution. Even in the universe, a Green Dragon of this level is rare.”
“They… How did they do it?” Zi Lan found it unbelievable. Even if it was Lord Lin Feng with the evolution talent, it probably wasn’t easy to raise and evolve a Green Dragon of this level.
As Zi Lan finished speaking, the gods, President Lin, and the others were shocked. There were also four holy beasts in the universe?
Moreover, it was suspected to be a cosmic life form from the last cosmic era. There were still many ruins?
“Could it be that there are some special ruins on the Blue Planet that contain the divine power of the Green Dragon?” Zi Lan only thought of the possibility that Shi Yu could nurture a Green Dragon of this level.
However, she was only half right. Shi Yu didn’t come into contact with any ruins that contained the divine power of the Green Dragon on the Blue Planet, but on Earth.
At the moment, the most important thing was still the battle. The power Shi Yu displayed consecutively had already completely made Zi Lan fall silent. Be it divine-level talent or the Creation Green Dragon pet, they were extremely unbelievable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1252 - 1252 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (7)
chapters.content:
1252 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (7)
Was he really a Level 8 Beast Tamer from a low-level planet?
“Ah…” She and the Star Dragon looked at the Phoenix Man’s miserable state and were speechless. However, the Phoenix Man was indeed powerful. If it were a demigod from the Blue Planet, even if it was an awakened god, those two moves just now would easily cause him to be insta-killed. From the shocked expressions of the Ancient God Golden Bull and the others, it could be seen how terrifying Shi Yu’s attack was.
However, he still survived. The Phoenix man, who looked like he had only suffered a portion of his injuries and couldn’t even be considered a fatal injury, felt that the pressure was huge. After stabilizing his body, he looked at the panda that had been heavily injured by him and revived by that tree baby. His mentality collapsed slightly.
“Damn it…” At this moment, the Phoenix man realized that the Green Dragon and the Panda weren’t to be trifled with. He immediately locked onto Susu, who was closer.
Firstly, it was because Susu was the closest. Secondly, of the energy fluctuations, Susu and Shi Yu’s fluctuations were the weakest. It was unrealistic to directly attack Shi Yu. Shi Yu was protected at the back, so they chose to start with Susu and defeat them one by one.
The Phoenix man had a beautiful plan in mind and wanted to defeat Shi Yu and the others one by one. If Shi Yu’s six pets were only at the level of the gem cat, the Phoenix man’s plan would definitely succeed.
However, the problem was that the battle power specifications of Shi Yu and the others had already exceeded those of ordinary demigods. Among the four totem-level pets, the weakest Susu was also the strongest demigod on the Blue Planet previously!
Although the battle power of every individual was inferior to it, when combined, they could suppress him, preventing him from breaking through Shi Yu’s lineup. He could only passively act like a rubber ball and couldn’t find a breakthrough.
“Feather Fall Stars!!” The Phoenix Man used the final profundity again and attacked Susu. These three quasi-divine skills and the move strengthened by the three Beast Taming Talents couldn’t even be withstood by Eleven, who was enhanced by Shi Yu, let alone Susu.
However, imagination was very beautiful, but the reality was very cruel.
“Huh?” Seeing someone attempting to attack her close sister, Chi Tong’s sword in hand flashed and shot out, resonating like thunder and constantly expanding and spanning the void. In an instant, it transformed into four sword projections suspended in the sky. The four sword clones of Immortal Slaying, Immortal Killing, Immortal Extermination, and Immortal Trap formed the Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and trapped the Phoenix Man’s attack.
“Sword law that contains many changes…”
Sensing that he was trapped, the Phoenix man didn’t panic. This move was much weaker than the black-and-white millstone. He could even shatter that, and this could also be easily broken!
Boom.
The sword formation trembled, and cracks appeared on the four divine sword phantoms.
The Phoenix Wings penetrated the sword formation under the shadow of the myriad swords and continued to attack Susu. In the blink of an eye, he widened his eyes.
“I’m coming.” Chi Tong, who was standing on the Vermillion Bird, had unknowingly arrived behind Susu in the form of a Blue Sea Sprite and pressed its palm on its shoulder.
Susu pursed its lips and nodded. The huge Vermillion Bird clone immediately turned into the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire and flowed into the water elemental body. The red and blue light was extremely dazzling, wrapping Chi Tong and Susu together. Shockingly, Chi Tong had used possession on Susu.
It fused its power with Susu’s power.
“Water and fire possession—are you crazy?” The Phoenix man who attacked didn’t stop, but he had a ridiculous thought. This was because the energies that countered each other were extremely difficult to coordinate. The higher the level, the more it was like this.
Perhaps at a low level, it could still rely on its powerful Crowd Control to complete the Interlocking Combination Skill, but the water-element elemental and fire-element undead in front of it both had demigod-level battle power. In theory, it was impossible to fuse the strongest quasi-divine skill and achieve an explosive increase in battle power.
But in the next moment, the Phoenix man’s expression changed.
The blue and red lights on Susu’s and the others’ bodies flourished. Under the light, a Taiji Painting formed by water and fire actually appeared. With a roar, Chi Tong and Susu’s fusion seemed to have undergone a qualitative change in life!
Boom!!
A moment later, a Water Element General with red hair and eyes appeared in front of everyone with a fire sword in hand.
At the same time, a divine sword fused with water and fire condensed in their hands. The Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, Sea Cleansing Spirit, and Interlocking Sword!!
The fusion of fire and water was indeed a very difficult operation. It could even succeed at this moment. The Gemini Silver Armor back then and General Mu Huiyin’s Interlocking Sword were no longer the most important factors.
That was the cultivation result of Shi Yu assisting Chi Tong and Susu in practicing many times through the Taiji Domain. All of this added up was the reason why they could successfully combine and easily slash out an attack that exceeded the limits of both parties’ attacks.
Chi Tong and Susu’s combination attack collided with the Phoenix Man’s Phoenix Wings.
At the same time.
Shi Yu and Buggy underwent a spirit connection and mental resonance!
It activated the Taiji Domain again! With Buggy’s cooperation, it activated the Taiji Domain in its Creation Domain!!
Domain fusion.
As if the world had just opened, the power of the red and blue Taiji Painting fused into General Mu Huiyin’s body, formed by Chi Tong and Susu, raising their strength to the extreme.
On Susu’s side, the sound of laws spread. That was the cleansing law of the ocean. On Chi Tong’s side, it was the burning of the fire of faith. The intersection of water and fire of quasi-divine skills, and faith skills instantly erupted with extremely dazzling power. Under the shocked expression of the Phoenix Man, he was sent flying like a tennis ball with a boom. His body was cleansed and burned in the explosion!
“Pfft…” The three attacks of the mind, spirit, and physical body made the Phoenix man’s eyes turn white. He was just about to explode and launch a counterattack when he felt the energy in his body suddenly roll.

chapters.title: Chapter 1253 - 1253 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (8)
chapters.content:
1253 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (8)
It was actually a little unaccustomed to the environment. An enfeebling power surged into its body. It was surprisingly the aftermath of starry sky travel and the descent to a low-level planet.
“Roar!!!” When Eleven leaped over, the huge red and blue Taiji world suddenly turned into a black and white Taiji world again. Eleven held the dazzling Yin Yang Millstone and directly smashed it onto the Phoenix man, smashing them into the ground from the sky.
This time, the Phoenix man’s eyes really turned white. He spat out a mouthful of blood and fell like a star.
From the beginning to the end, he was being kicked like a rubber ball by Shi Yu and the others.
President Lin, the gem cat, and the seven gods opened their mouths wide and looked at the Phoenix man who was ruthlessly suppressed. Their hearts skipped a beat. Shi Yu was the strongest on the Blue Planet, while the Phoenix man was a cosmic genius. In their eyes, they were all very strong. At this moment, seeing the Phoenix man ruthlessly suppressed by Shi Yu, an indescribable emotion appeared in their hearts.
Shi Yu, this monster, could even beat up a genius in the universe like this?
What a joke. Take it easy and don’t kill them.
Below, the World Ginseng rooted in the ground realized that it was finally time for it to appear. However, at this moment, Zi Lan suddenly shouted with a serious expression,
“Wait, this is the end. He lost.”
“This is the Ocean Faith God and the Vermillion Bird? A combination of quasi-divine skills and faith skills?” She had a serious expression. What a joke.
“Cough, cough.” In the sky, the falling Phoenix man suddenly divided into two, turning into two landing trajectories. The human was alright, but the Star Phoenix was directly covered in scales and injuries. It was very miserable.
Eleven’s last attack directly obliterated the defense layer on the Phoenix man in the enfeebled state and completely heavily injured them!
Boom!
The two figures landed and fainted. The scene was silent.
“Hu, Hu, Hu…”
Shi Yu was also opposite him, panting slightly.
“Then I won’t fight, I won’t fight.”
“Baby Ginseng, heal!”
Ling exited the loading mode.
Baby Ginseng fell into deep thought.
“Sister Zi Lan, I won. Remember the bet.”
However, it wasn’t that easy. In a one-on-one situation, Shi Yu felt that it would be very difficult. As long as he leveled up to Level 9, there might be hope.
With this in mind, Shi Yu took a deep breath and became even more serious.
If he wanted to go to the universe, he had to make more preparations. Otherwise, at that time, he definitely wouldn’t be able to defeat anyone.
“I understand…” Zi Lan’s expression was solemn, and her heart was shocked. Even she would have to spend some effort to defeat Qi Mu and Feng Jiu.
What was wrong with this Shi Yu!
Was he a monster?
She really didn’t expect the other party to be defeated by a lower-level opponent.
If the people on the Floating Planet knew, there would definitely be a huge shock.
“I…” On the ground in the distance, the Phoenix man trembled and moved his finger. He no longer believed in the nonsense of easily suppressing enemies on a lower-level planet.
…
The battle in the East Sea shook the planet again. For example, the Dragon God, who had returned to Dragon Palace City, and the World Tree, who was just about to condense a cosmic crystal, were shocked.
“What, what, what?” The World Tree was shocked. Sensing the familiar battle fluctuations, it immediately felt a headache. It understood that Shi Yu and the others had caused trouble.
In order to avoid any accidents, it immediately ran over to see what was going on. Then, it saw the scene of the Phoenix Man being suppressed and beaten up by Shi Yu the whole time. It saw the scene of the so-called alien genius basically being unable to fight back against Shi Yu and being defeated by someone below his level. The World Tree fell into deep thought.
That was it?
In the west, in the Demon Kingdom.
The female succubus and another female Beast Tamer were like high and mighty queens. They sat in the palace of the Demon Kingdom and communicated with the demon demigod and the Fallen Angel Prince below.
At this moment, the demigod and the Fallen Angel Prince looked at them in extreme shock.
They didn’t expect that the guest from outer space this time was actually a descendant of the Demon God Race that had left the Mythical Era.
Sensing the terrifying pressure on their bodies that was comparable to a god, the Fallen Angel father and son were pleasantly surprised and afraid.
“Don’t worry, we won’t eat you. We only came back this time to bring the clansmen of the Blue Planet to the universe.” The female succubus smiled calmly.
“We’ve already communicated with the Blue Planet’s Will. Next, you just have to cooperate with us.”
“By the way, do you know Shi Yu?” the female succubus asked.
Because Shi Yu was praised by the World Tree as the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet, they definitely had to know more about him.
“Not long ago, he defeated two abyss demigods in a battle.”
“Very powerful.”
“I see. That’s not bad,” the female succubus said. “Don’t worry, as long as you do things seriously, your strength can surpass him sooner or later.”
“I believe you!” The Fallen Angel Prince looked at the incomparably beautiful Succubus Queen in front of him excitedly and almost wanted to offer its loyalty.

chapters.title: Chapter 1254 - 1254 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (9)
chapters.content:
1254 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (9)
The female succubus smiled and said, “Although Shi Yu is very strong in your eyes, he’s completely insignificant in the starry sky of the universe. For example, in our team this time, even the weakest angel man can crush him.”
“Wu…” The other alien nodded in confusion. Weren’t they the weakest?
Regarding their words, the demon demigod couldn’t deny it. It had already decided to cozy up to this group of aliens ruthlessly.
This group of people was indeed very strong.
Just looking at them made it feel powerless to resist.
This was something it didn’t even feel when facing those demigod-level awakening gods.
He felt that even those gods would be insta-killed by the demon woman in front of him.
Was the extraterrestrial civilization really so terrifying?
But at this moment…
Boom.
In the east, the battle fluctuations of another space were also transmitted here, causing the entire Demon Kingdom to tremble and shocking the demon demigod.
At this moment, the female contractor also quickly got up and looked into the distance in disbelief.
“We’ve lost contact with Qi Mu and Feng Jiu.”
“They should have lost consciousness.”
“What happened?”
In order to avoid any accidents, the few team members heading to the Blue Planet had built telepathy in advance. If an accident happened on one side, the other parties could sense it.
“An accident?”
What could happen on the Blue Planet?
The female succubus couldn’t understand.
[There’s no need to be nervous.] Just as the Succubus Queen of the Demon Kingdom, the Angel Man of Rongguang, and the others sensed that something had happened to the Phoenix Man, Zi Lan’s heavy voice sounded, and she immediately explained.
[Keep a low profile and don’t be too arrogant. The Blue Planet is filled with crouching tigers and hidden dragons. This Shi Yu… is very strong.]
What a joke.
What exactly happened over there?
How could Shi Yu defeat the Phoenix Man?
Among the four of them, although the Phoenix Man’s strength ranking wasn’t at the top, he could still be ranked third, even stronger than their demon combination.
If the Phoenix Man lost, didn’t that mean that they weren’t a match for the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet?
“Lord, what happened?” the Fallen Angel Prince asked carefully.
The female succubus suddenly looked at it and asked, “Let me ask you, what’s wrong with that Shi Yu? Is his battle power really as simple as defeating two demigods?”
Under the terrifying demon pressure, the Fallen Angel Prince was shocked. “Lord, that’s his latest battle information. He improved too quickly. He became the strongest in just four years after becoming a Beast Tamer. We don’t know how much strength he’s hiding.”
“By the way, when he defeated the two demigods, he should still be a Level 8 Beast Tamer. If he breaks through to the legendary level, he might become stronger.”
Upon hearing that, the female succubus was stunned. He had only been a Beast Tamer for four years, but he had become the strongest on a planet?
What kind of cosmic joke was this?
“I want his detailed information,” another alien immediately said solemnly.
The Demon Kingdom naturally gathered information about Shi Yu. Soon, the female succubus and the others obtained the information they wanted. They wouldn’t have known if they hadn’t looked at it, but they were immediately shocked.
Because there was a line that surprisingly said that at the level of a Level 6 Beast Tamer, he had activated the divine-level talent that triggered the sound of top-notch laws and assisted his pet in defeating the Enfeebled Divine Spirit that had fallen to the overlord level.
“He mastered a divine-level talent at Level 6…?” The female succubus widened her eyes and received the information with a look of disbelief.
Her breathing quickened. How could a human reach this level? She didn’t believe that this was a Blue Planet person!
…
“Why are you guys fighting again!!”
The World Tree wanted to cry now. When it sent Shi Yu and the others away, it clearly saw that Shi Yu was very obedient and was very close to this group of aliens.
Why did they fight in the blink of an eye, and Shi Yu even beat him up?
It took on Baby Ginseng’s mission and treated Shi Yu, the others, and the Phoenix Man.
“Cough, cough.” The Phoenix Man and the Star Phoenix crawled up with depressed expressions.
They looked at Shi Yu with incomprehensible gazes.
She had just bragged about how powerful the alien Beast Taming System was, but in the blink of an eye, their people were beaten up by a lower-level opponent. If this news spread, no one would probably believe it.
“Well, Shi Yu’s strength is indeed not bad.” The World Tree didn’t deny it.
Now, it had already placed its hope of the Blue Planet’s rise on Shi Yu.
It felt like Shi Yu should be a mutant.
It should be atavistic.
It felt like his talent potential was much stronger than that of ordinary Blue Planet people now.
It was definitely comparable to the batch of Human Seeds that Goddess Wa brought back at the start.
“His strength is alright, right?” The World Tree was very excited to see Shi Yu beat up the aliens.
It suddenly felt like cosmic civilizations were only so-so.
As expected of my child.
The corners of Zi Lan’s mouth twitched. It was alright…
Considering Shi Yu’s age, he was simply a monster, alright?
The group of them was already close to 40 years old, while Shi Yu was only in his early 20s!
Its potential couldn’t be said to be small.

chapters.title: Chapter 1255 - 1255 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (10)
chapters.content:
1255 The Alien’s Mentality Collapsed (10)
Now, he could fight a Level 9 opponent. When he reached Level 9, he would be even more impressive.
“Cough, cough, why, what’s with your divine-level talent?”
“And your Green Dragon.”
The Phoenix Man was unconvinced by his loss. He should have been the one with a higher cultivation system, but in the end, Shi Yu made his mentality collapse.
“I also want to ask. Logically speaking, Blue Planet shouldn’t have such a cultivation system.”
“Your Green Dragon cultivation speed also far exceeds some Green Dragon faith factions in the starry sky of the universe.”
Zi Lan was curious.
“I just heard that there are also four holy beasts in the starry sky of the universe, right?” Shi Yu looked at them.
The Phoenix Man: “?”
He wasn’t even fully focused on the battle?
“Well, they’re suspected to be universe gods from the last era,” Zi Lan said.
Shi Yu said, “When I was in archeology, I accidentally entered a ruin. These powers are all related to that ruin, but I’ve only entered it once and couldn’t crack it. I don’t know anything more.”
Zi Lan was stunned. “What, you’re also an archeologist?”
President Lin said, “Shi Yu… should be the most outstanding archeologist on the Blue Planet.”
Zi Lan was very surprised. “Archeologists… are also a very popular profession in the universe, especially those archeologists qualified to explore the ruins of the last era. They are all targets of competition by the various large factions.”
“Meow…” The gem cat girl was stunned. “Space ruins…”
She was silent for a moment before looking at Shi Yu, whose eyes were shining. She kept feeling that something was about to be wreaked by Shi Yu again.
“As everyone knows, the lifespan of the universe is only 10 billion years. Every 10 billion years, the universe will restart and start a new cosmic era. At that time, basically no life form can live to the next cosmic era, including cosmic life forms.”
“However, when the universe restarts, there will be some special places that will become cosmic ruins in the form of cosmic spatial fragments and appear in a new era. Exploring these cosmic ruins can often yield very shocking secrets.”
“It’s said that the current cosmic supreme master, that cosmic overlord, likes to collect and explore cosmic ruins very much.”
“I understand. You definitely accidentally entered the cosmic ruins of the last cosmic era and came into contact with some special divine power,” Zi Lan said. She felt that she had finally deduced why Shi Yu was so strong.
This guy was the chosen one—a super lucky person!
He actually accidentally entered the Green Dragon Ruins of the last cosmic era and even archeologically carried divine-level power.
At the side, the Phoenix man was also stunned. Was this for real? What kind of f*cking dog shit luck was this? An archeologist from a low-level planet accidentally entered the ruins of a cosmic god from the last cosmic era and even obtained benefits?
Everyone was stunned when they heard Zi Lan’s deduction.
Including Shi Yu himself.
He fell into deep thought. He felt that there were even more enigmas about his transmigration.
“If those large factions know that you’ve entered the cosmic ruins, they’ll definitely be willing to nurture an archeologist like you. In fact, even if you serve that cosmic overlord, there’s a high chance.”
“However, exploring cosmic ruins is still too dangerous. Even if one reaches the super divine level, there are countless people who die in cosmic ruins.”
“According to what I know, the ancestor of the Blue Planet’s Kirin Race explored the ruins of the universe back then and was the first to die.”
“Therefore, archeologists are also a high-risk profession,” Zi Lan said.
World Tree: “?”
Why was the Kirin the first to die again?
“No way…” Shi Yu muttered,” Speaking of which, the cosmic ruin you’re talking about…”
Zi Lan said, “Hmm?”
“Are there many of them?” Shi Yu said. “Are there any less dangerous trial-type ruins? I like this kind.”
World Tree and President Lin: ???
Shouldn’t this kid think of a way to let the Blue Planet rise after entering the starry sky? Why was he thinking about the cosmic ruins again?

chapters.title: Chapter 1256 - 1256 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (1)
chapters.content:
1256 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (1)
“Green Dragon, Cosmos God…”
The battle just happened above the sea area of Dragon Palace City. The Dragon God naturally sensed it long ago.
She revealed her figure and appeared beside the gem cat.
They had clearly heard some of Shi Yu and the others’ conversation just now.
“Senior Dragon God, you’re here too,” President Lin Xiao immediately said when he saw this.
“Senior Dragon God, it shouldn’t have affected Dragon Palace City, right? I especially got Buggy to activate its domain,” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say when he saw the Dragon God come out.
Phoenix Man: “?”
Was he being polite?
He was still controlling the battle fluctuations?
Also, Buggy? He looked at the Green Dragon in the sky. This was the name for the Green Dragon that had evolved to this level?
How could he do this?
If he were the Green Dragon, he would definitely rebel.
Buggy: 0.0
“Of course, it’s affected,” the Dragon God said.
Shi Yu: “Then it’s alright… How’s the situation in Dragon Palace City?”
The Dragon God said, “It’s all thanks to Lord World Tree. The injured have all recovered, the dead have all revived, and the damaged buildings have completely recovered.”
The World Tree clone said, “It’s only right… In addition, I also blessed these creatures. It’ll be easier for them to break through the bottleneck next.”
“This is…” Zi Lan looked at the Dragon God and thought for a moment before saying, “Senior Dragon God of Dragon Palace City?”
The Dragon God nodded slightly and looked at this cosmic Beast Tamer.
Zi Lan said excitedly, “Hello, Senior Dragon God. I’m a disciple of the Space Emperor. Teacher asked me to greet you and invited you to go to the Cosmic Sea if you have the chance.”
“If there’s a chance, yes.” The Dragon God nodded.
“I just heard that the Green Dragon is suspected to be a cosmic god from the last cosmic era. Is that true?” the Dragon God said.
“That should be the case. Although they’re all archeological discoveries, it’s basically the consensus of cosmic civilization,” the Star Dragon said.
The Dragon God looked at Shi Yu and Buggy and said, “Shi Yu, are you interested in the position of Dragon God in Dragon Palace City? With my current strength, I might no longer be able to manage Dragon Palace City. Why don’t I leave this position of Dragon God to that little guy?”
“Cosmos God, Green Dragon, it’s not a disgrace to the inheritance left behind by the Ancestral Dragon.”
“Roar?” The Green Dragon, Buggy, was stunned.
“Ah, really? It’s not impossible,” Shi Yu said.
President Lin and the gem cat: “?”
Why did he agree so quickly?
Didn’t he know to be polite?
Shi Yu understood what the Dragon God meant. If the other party did this, he could legitimately establish the Green Dragon Faith in Dragon Palace City.
If there was still the revival of the ancient divine dragon, with the current strength of the Dragon God, it would indeed be impossible to suppress it. Even the Dragon God Ruins might be occupied.
In that case, the Dragon Dog thought it was better to directly give it to someone she knew. Shi Yu was undoubtedly the best choice.
No revival god could defeat the Green Dragon.
When the World Tree clone saw this, it was slightly stunned. Alright, Shi Yu and the others could do whatever they wanted.
Even if the Ancestral Dragon was revived, if it knew that its inheritance Dragon Palace had been occupied by the Green Dragon, it probably wouldn’t have a temper.
After all, the Green Dragon was two levels higher than the Ancestral Dragon. Who would have thought?
Perhaps after arriving in the universe, even the Ancestral Dragon evolved towards the Green Dragon.
“Then Buggy, go back to Dragon Palace City with Senior Dragon God. If there’s nothing else, don’t come back first,” Shi Yu said to Buggy.
The family no longer has money to support you, Buggy.
Buggy: Roar???
Shi Yu frowned.
Are you stupid? We’ve never explored the Dragon God Ruins before. There’s a pile of legendary and mythical resources inside!
If there’s no food, you can go to Dragon Palace City to find food yourself.
“Then, I’ll leave with it first.” The Dragon God looked at Buggy and bid farewell to everyone present.
“Senior Dragon God, I’ll visit later,” President Lin said.
“Me too,” Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man said. After that, they also wanted to visit Lin Feng’s second team pet.
Everyone bid farewell, and the Dragon God brought the excited Buggy to Dragon Palace City to ascend the throne.
No matter what Buggy thought, it didn’t expect that it would actually go from a Green Silkworm to the Lord of Dragon Palace City.
…
In Dragon Palace City.
After experiencing the Dragon Palace’s coup, the revival of casualties, and everything going back, all the creatures were still in a stunned state.
Under the Dragon God’s command, the few Dragon Kings organized themselves and gathered in the Dragon Palace.
Just now, the Dragon God said that there was a big matter to announce. The various Dragon Kings guessed that it should be related to this Dragon Palace coup.
At this moment, even the Sea Dragon King, who had run to seek help, still didn’t know how the Dragon Palace’s coup had been resolved.
It didn’t understand why those casualties would be directly revived.
“It should have been Shi Yu who helped,” the Ice Dragon King said proudly.
“Hmph, I knew that three-headed guy was over once it dared to hit me.”
“Oh yeah.” The little white dragon followed behind the Sea Dragon King and the Azure Dragon King and said happily. It had to be Senior Shi Yu!
“Looks like it should be. When I went to Dong Huang, Shi Yu wasn’t around, but if we could successfully resolve it, Shi Yu must have returned.” The Sea Dragon King sighed.
It wasn’t impossible for Shi Yu, the Dragon God, Divine Source Legendary, and the others to defeat the three demigods together.
At this moment, the Sea Dragon King, Ice Dragon King, Thunder Dragon King, and his son, Gold Dragon King, and his son, as well as the families of the Turtle and the Little Quas Snake, were all present.

chapters.title: Chapter 1257 - 1257 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (2)
chapters.content:
1257 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (2)
The Dragon God had indeed gathered everyone in the Dragon Palace to announce Shi Yu and the others’ help. However, before she could, she was attracted by the fluctuations of the battle again.
“Lord Dragon God is back!” In Dragon Palace City, as the world changed color, a huge wave came. The Sea Dragon King looked up at the sky.
The figure of the Dragon God slowly descended under the gazes of millions of Dragon Palace’s elites. After her, everyone was surprised to discover that beside her was a huge Green Dragon that occupied the sky and was a thousand meters long.
“That’s… Buggy?? Shi Yu and the others are here too?” Seeing this, the Ice Dragon and the others were slightly stunned.
The Golden Dragon Prince and the other second-generation dragons who had been beaten by Buggy were also slightly stunned.
However, as the totem dragon kings sensed the aura on Buggy’s body that was even stronger than that of the Dragon God, their pupils couldn’t help but shrink in disbelief.
At this moment, after the Dragon God descended, she said to the Dragon Palace people, “Not long ago, the ancient god of the dragon race revived and destroyed the faith of the Green Dragon to fight for the position of the Dragon God, causing Dragon Palace City to be in chaos.”
“In the face of three revived gods, my strength isn’t enough to protect Dragon Palace City.”
“Fortunately, the matter was resolved. Now, the three awakened divine dragons are all suppressed by the new Dragon God. From today on, I will abdicate and cultivate bitterly. The new Dragon God will be the contracted Green Dragon of the Minister of Environmental Protection of Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu.”
“Its strength has already exceeded mine. Not only did it suppress three ancient gods, but it also suppressed the new demigod of the Dragonman Empire, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the Western Dragon Empire’s Lord Black Dragon Lord.”
“With it leading Dragon Palace City, Dragon Palace City can definitely become stronger. From today onwards, it is the new Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.”
“Roar!!! (From today onwards, I’m the Dragon God.)” The Green Dragon, Buggy, roared in the air. As expected of it.
After the Dragon God finished speaking, the Dragon Palace people suddenly fell silent and were stunned. The eldest prince, the second prince, and the third prince looked at Buggy in a daze.
What?
The position of Dragon God was gone?
“Ahhh??” The little white dragon looked at Big Brother Buggy in extreme shock, not understanding why Big Brother Buggy, who was still a butterfly two years ago, had become the new Dragon God.
Even if it defeated the eldest prince, it was too exaggerated to go from a human-contracted beast to a Dragon God at once and suppress five dragon demigods alone.
“#￥#@￥…” The Golden Dragon Prince, who had always wanted to take revenge, also looked at the Green Dragon Buggy in confusion.
What did it mean for a dragon to crush five dragon demigods?
Most of the totem dragon kings present were stunned.
“Oh, damn.” The Turtle Prime Minister looked at the bewildered Thunder Dragon King. His own son, Little Turtle, was also cultivating diligently under Shi Yu’s guidance. In terms of relationships, Little Turtle was classmates with the new Dragon God, and the Turtle Prime Minister was the old man of Little Turtle. So, how should they describe the relationship between him and the Thunder Dragon King going forward?
Of course, the one that felt the most ridiculous was still the Ice Dragon King, who had watched Buggy grow up from the Green Silkworm. The corners of its mouth twitched as it looked at the Green Dragon Buggy brought back by the Dragon God. Then, it patted its good friend, the Azure Dragon King, beside it.
The Azure Dragon King: “?”
The Azure Dragon King and the Sea Dragon King looked at their son, the little white dragon, with disdain.
Trash.
The little white dragon: Huh???
…
Buggy followed the Dragon God to Dragon Palace City. After the battle, Shi Yu and the others could finally return to Dong Huang.
On President Lin’s side, there were too many things he wanted to know from Zi Lan and the others.
However, the guests had just arrived after all. In addition, he still had to awaken the Divine Source Legendary. President Lin only prepared a place for them and the seven gods to rest first.
There was no hurry to communicate.
“For you, for you.” At this moment, Shi Yu also began to collect the debt.
After the Ancient God Golden Bull gave the divine-level resources he owed to Shi Yu, he said, “So Shi Yu, let’s talk about battle next time. You consumed a lot of energy in the battle just now.”
“Alright, alright, alright.” Shi Yu suspected that the Ancient God Golden Bull was afraid. However, seeing that the other party had finally paid the debt, Shi Yu didn’t care so much.
“Wu wu wu.” At this moment, Eleven, who was on Shi Yu’s shoulder, looked at the resources given by the Ancient God Golden Bull with a surprised expression.
This was a white metal gem filled with warpath killing intent. It made Eleven feel that it was a divine-level resource that could increase the proficiency of his Killing Wind Skill.
After eating this, its Killing Wind Skill might be able to increase from transcendent to close to a quasi-divine skill.
“This is a platinum gem born on the Mythical Battlefield. It’s the core of a metal-element mineral vein. I can’t bear to use it yet. I’ll give it to you,” the Ancient God Golden Bull said in pain.
“If embedded in a weapon, it can become a divine weapon.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu smiled in surprise. “You go ahead, sir. I’m going to ask for the extraterrestrial cultivation manual.”
Platinum Gem!
As he left under the gaze of the Ancient God Golden Bull, Shi Yu weighed it and said to Eleven, “It’s useless even if you want this thing.”
Eleven: “?”
“You’re already a demigod. With the Blue Planet’s current conditions, ordinary divine-level resources will only strengthen you a bit. I think it’s better to keep it for the cat and see if it can be used.”
Let it evolve into a metal cat!
“It’s not the gem cat, but the short-legged gem cat. This can be kept as a white tiger evolution resource,” Shi Yu said. “Teacher gem cat is also a demigod. She doesn’t lack these resources.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1258 - 1258 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (3)
chapters.content:
1258 The Dragon God Abdicates, Buggy Ascends (3)
Eleven was stunned. A short white tiger.
The Four Spirits of Heaven were actually all Cosmic Gods. Then the cultivation value was undoubtedly even greater.
After Shi Yu asked for a metal-element gem, he decisively went to Zi Lan.
At this moment, the disciple of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan, had already changed into a long dress in the Dong Huang style. She was waiting for President Lin to call the Void Mantis, Fang Lan, and the others related to the Space Emperor over.
Before Shi Yu could say anything, the other party knew that Shi Yu was there to collect a debt. She couldn’t help but sigh and hand the concluded cultivation method to Shi Yu.
“This is the development method of 18 talents such as Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Light, Darkness, and Darkness, Spirit, and Soul Space Fusion.”
“I originally thought you could use it to increase your enhancement strength, so I planned to give it to you.”
“But now, I actually don’t recommend you waste your energy cultivating these additionally.”
“After you obtained benefits from the cosmic ruins, the talent you developed is considered one of the best abilities even on the Floating Planet. I feel that my divine-level spatial talent is inferior, so it’s better for you to devote yourself to that.”
“These abilities are all relatively common. What I can come into contact with won’t increase your strength much. Now, I’m afraid only those rarer abilities can increase your strength. However, unfortunately, there are no such abilities on the Floating Planet. If you want to obtain them, you might have to search for them on the World King Planet yourself,” Zi Lan said.
“There are capable people from various planets gathered there. The abilities they cultivate are strange. Although it’s harder to cultivate, it’s also stronger and more special.”
“Alright, alright. Then it shouldn’t be a problem for me to teach these to my friends, right?” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Of course, he also knew that for him, there wasn’t much need to cultivate metal-element strengthening, fire-element strengthening, and water-element strengthening talents. However, if he didn’t use such a good thing, someone else would.
“Of course, you can deal with it yourself. It’s not anything relatively precious,” Zi Lan said with a smile.
“Wu wu wu wu wu!!!” As the two of them chatted, in the outside world, spatial ripples flickered. A big black mantis shouted, “Where’s the Space Emperor’s disciple? Where!!”
“I knew it. The Space Emperor is still alive. Hahahahaha.”
“I’m going to rise!”
“Chaos Panda, Green Dragon, get down!”
It was the Void Mantis.
Shi Yu shrugged. Alright, the most excited ones when the Space Emperor and Lin Feng sent someone back should be the second team pets of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
“Yo.” After the Void Mantis entered, Shi Yu greeted it, stunning the Void Mantis and stopping its smile.
Then, he returned to Ping Cheng and started to sleep.
He helped Buggy evolve and activate the Green Dragon Domain to fight the five demigods and the aliens in the Taiji Domain… Even after experiencing the joint treatment of Baby Ginseng and the World Tree, the current Shi Yu was still tired.
If there were no other big things, he would sleep for two days first…
Two days later, Shi Yu woke up. At this moment, Zi Lan had already finished communicating with President Lin and the Divine Source Legendary.
Dong Huang could at least be assigned two Teleportation Key Stones. Dong Huang’s distribution method for these two was one for Shi Yu and one for the Dragon God.
The Divine Source Legendary voluntarily gave up the opportunity to go to the World King Planet to break through to the divine level and decided to continue staying on the Blue Planet to protect Dong Huang and wait for the Mythical Revival.
As for President Lin Xiao, he felt that he couldn’t break through to the legendary level in the short term, so he gave up the opportunity to obtain the Teleportation Key Stone.
As for the keystone, it was still the most cost-effective ratio for human Beast Tamers. Therefore, Shi Yu, the most talented figure in Dong Huang and even Blue Planet, definitely had one.
However, Shi Yu also needed to reach Level 9 as soon as possible.
As for the remaining piece, Dong Huang decided to give it to the Dragon God. After all, the Dragon God Protection had protected Dong Huang for a thousand years, and the position of the Dragon God had also been passed to Buggy. This gift should be given to her.
Although the Dragon God could also be contracted and hitched a ride, because the Dragon God’s seniority was too high in Dong Huang, probably no one dared to mention it like this.
“There’s no need to split it so carefully.” After Shi Yu woke up and learned, he couldn’t help but mutter to himself. In any case, after contacting the Space Emperor and the others, he could just ask for a few more.
Yes… However, considering that the Space Emperor and the others might not necessarily be very generous, Shi Yu felt that it wasn’t a big problem for him to think of a way after he entered the World King Planet.
He had the Skill Index, so he should still be able to become stronger quickly. The Space Emperor and Lin Feng could both quickly rise in the universe. His achievements on the Blue Planet far exceeded those of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. In theory, he should be able to adapt quickly to the universe.
At that time, if he could quickly become a super divine, it wasn’t impossible for him to let everyone he knew have a Teleportation Key Stone.
With this in mind, Shi Yu decided to cultivate bitterly first and strive to reach the legendary level before the World Tree condensed a cosmic crystal.
However, before that, Shi Yu felt that there was one more thing. It was best to do it before the legendary level.
To the Dragon Emperor Era…
After all, after breaking through to the legendary level, the pressure to transmigrate would definitely be even greater.
Therefore, after waking up, Shi Yu first arrived at Dragon Palace City.
At this moment, Buggy was eating and drinking here. It was living too comfortably.
However, Buggy still had a conscience and knew to leave many good things for Shi Yu and the others.
For the Dragon God, going to the Cosmic Sea to obtain the opportunity to climb to a higher realm probably didn’t make her care more than returning to the Dragon Emperor Era.
“Now?” The Dragon God appeared and took a deep breath. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “Are you confident?”
“Yes, but according to my research, utilizing the Space-Time Dragon Vein for traversal will encounter temporal rejection based on strength. Even if we succeed, we might not be able to stay in that time period for too long.”
“In addition, even if we change the fact that the Dragon Emperor was killed by the remnant soul of a god, it should only evolve into a new parallel space. It won’t affect the current situation and revive the Dragon Emperor. Can you accept such an outcome?”
The Dragon God was silent for a moment before saying, “It’s alright. Even if I only return to the past and don’t interfere in anything, I’ll be satisfied if you let me understand some of the truth.”
Shi Yu said, “There’s no need to be so careful. We can go back and directly kill the remnant soul that harmed the Dragon Emperor. Then, we can destroy the Dragon Empire, the great enemy of the Dragon Emperor Dynasty at that time!”
The Dragon God smiled and said, “Are you sure that what we do isn’t breaking the laws of the universe? If there are any maintainers in the universe, we’ll probably be punished.”
Shi Yu was stunned. Don’t scare me. In the beginning, you were the one who seduced me into transmigrating into space and time. I’ve already transmigrated twice! Nothing happened!
…
At the same time, at Ancient Capital University.
The gem cat girl looked up at the starry sky.
She also participated in the previous Teleportation Key Stones distribution meeting.
To be honest, she also wanted to go to the starry sky of the universe to take a look, but unfortunately, there were so few Teleportation Key Stones. It would take a while until a hooligan cat like her got a turn.
She only hoped that Shi Yu could quickly rise in the universe.
At that time, Shi Yu should give her a keystone and a pile of cosmic crystals… After all, she couldn’t run to sign a contract with Shi Yu, right?
Since she was free, the gem cat girl looked up at the starry sky and made a wish with a quasi-divine skill, wanting to be bestowed a Teleportation Key Stone by the heavens!
This way, there was no need to beg anyone.
The gem cat was actually just giving it a try for fun.
However.
After making the wish… something unexpected happened.
In the universe, a spatial crack appeared. Inside, a meteor streaked across.
A tool that looked like a wish keystone rowed towards the Blue Planet and landed in Dong Huang, Ancient Capital, and Ancient Capital University.
The gem cat girl stared at the increasingly clear meteor and fell into deep thought. She stretched out her hand and grabbed it in midair.
She looked down and fell into deep thought.
Damn.
No way!
The cat was stunned.
Her wish skill had also become strange, like the owl’s prophecy skill?
The gem cat looked at the Teleportation Key Stone in her hand and was at a loss.
Therefore, was this the keystone brought by the unlucky person from the Kirin Race who came to the Blue Planet with Zi Lan and the others but died in the Starry Sky Storm, or the keystone that fell into the spatial crack after the battle between the empress and the Vermillion Bird demigod?? The gem cat fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1259 - 1259 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (1)
chapters.content:
1259 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (1)
In Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu and the Dragon God agreed to set off for the spatial ruins in a day.
At that moment, the new Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, Green Dragon Buggy, had already carved its statue into a pile of dragon statues.
Moreover, it was the most conspicuous position, the center spot.
Apart from that, it also created faith clones through the Creation Domain and spread them all over the Dragon Palace. When it wasn’t around, it protected Dragon Palace City.
It was similar to the faith clone of the Fox God of the Heavenly Fox Nation previously.
After all, Buggy couldn’t stay in the Dragon Palace forever. Cloning to work was clearly the most classic method.
As long as the power of faith the Dragon Palace had for it was strong enough, this faith clone could receive the power of many believers and easily defeat demigod-level enemies.
Eleven and the others were the happiest when Buggy ascended the throne. They enjoyed the delicacies of the Dragon Palace.
After a few days, Shi Yu’s backpack was empty again. The resources he harvested from the empress era, such as the Sun Flame Flower, were used for Chi Tong’s evolution. For example, the wind-element Phoenix Heart was packed for Senior Lu.
Now, there was only one Teleportation Key Stone left. In the blink of an eye, he was extremely poor.
Shi Yu had yet to study this Teleportation Key Stone when someone informed him of its usage. He didn’t plan to let Ling continue researching, but he didn’t plan to keep it in his hand.
He wanted to find an opportunity to send it back to the empress. After all, as long as he contacted the Space Emperor, the Blue Planet wouldn’t lack Teleportation Key Stones. There was no need for Shi Yu to use this risky Teleportation Key Stone.
This Teleportation Key Stone belonged to the World King Planet in another space and time. If he activated the teleportation in this space and time, it would be fine if it could succeed, but if it failed, who knew what the consequences would be?
If he died during the teleportation, it would be too much.
Since he didn’t lack any more, there was no need for Shi Yu to take this risk. It was better to keep it for the empress to use herself.
“The few of you, if you’re full, sleep. Save energy!”
In the Dragon Palace hall, Shi Yu looked at Eleven and the others who were eating unsteadily at the banquet and warned.
“Wu wu wu…” Eleven and the other pets lay on the ground, indicating that they understood. They hadn’t eaten so full in a long time, but it should only be this time. After all, they could squander extravagantly this time to celebrate Buggy’s ascension.
If they kept eating like this in the future, Dragon Palace City couldn’t afford it. If they ate up the Dragon Palace until it was poor, the Green Dragon believers would have to rebel. After all, food was the priority of the people.
“Roar!!” However, Buggy expressed that it wasn’t a big problem. Eat more, eat more. Upon hearing that, Eleven, Baby Ginseng, Little Ji, and Duckie surrounded it and continued eating crazily.
On the other side, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, Qi, and Little Zi looked at these guys speechlessly and shook their heads continuously. Very good. Since these guys were so full, they would be in charge of the next battle.
…
In Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu even chatted with the Ice Dragon and the Sea Dragon King for a long time.
After learning the information about the starry sky outside, the Ice Dragon was still alright. In any case, it was already alone and had no desires. As long as it could retire steadily in Dragon Palace City under the protection of Shi Yu and the others, it would be satisfied.
As for the Sea Dragon King, it was extremely excited, almost as excited as the previous Void Mantis. It had been raised by Lin Feng as the Sea Dragon King from a carp. It would be a lie to say that it had no feelings and didn’t miss Lin Feng.
Unfortunately, after being the Sea Dragon King for so long, it didn’t have much ambition. It only wanted to live steadily with its wife. Its only wish was for the little white dragon to become more mature. However, after glancing at the little white dragon beside it, it felt that Lin Feng wouldn’t fancy this kid no matter what. It couldn’t help but sigh again.
After spending the night in Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu and the Dragon God began to set off.
They transmigrated through the ocean and arrived at the Space-Time Island, the Space-Time Dragon Vein.
Shi Yu was wearing a modern black and red archeological suit, a panda holding bamboo hanging from his shoulder. Beside him was a peerless and elegant dragon girl in ancient clothes. Be it in modern or ancient times, they were a strange combination.
“Squeak.” Eleven took a bite of the bamboo.
Eleven had taken this from the Dragon Palace City and couldn’t bear to eat it yet. It planned to rely on licking and grinding its teeth to maintain its daily life.
When the Dragon God saw this, she couldn’t help but fall silent. She didn’t know when Shi Yu’s pets would start to care about their image. The demigods on the Blue Planet weren’t so ridiculous.
“I’ve already come to study it once previously. I’m confident of activating and controlling the spatial ruins, but I need Senior Dragon God’s cooperation. Don’t resist and suppress your strength,” Shi Yu said.
The Dragon God nodded and said, “Alright.”
With that said, she began to suppress her strength as much as possible and give up all resistance. She was defenseless against the power of the outside world. At this moment, Shi Yu had already arrived above the dragon vein. He pretended to close his eyes and pretend to use his talent of listening to the Voice of History to communicate with the spatial ruins.
Then, he mouthed a strange incantation that the Dragon God couldn’t understand.
For example, something like “I want to be a transmigrator. Grandpa and Grandma are so happy. Give me my favorite cookie.”
As Shi Yu spoke in Chinese, it was normal for the Dragon God to not understand. She only felt that it was unfathomable. At the same time, Shi Yu used his psychic power to draw a huge time hexagram array like the one on the owl’s chest on the ground, wrapping him and the Dragon God inside.
From the looks of it, Shi Yu was working hard to communicate with the Space-Time Dragon Vein, but in fact, it was Qi communicating with the power of the Dragon Vein in Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space, preparing to Teleport Shi Yu and the Dragon God back to the Dragon Emperor Era.

chapters.title: Chapter 1260 - 1260 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (2)
chapters.content:
1260 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (2)
At the side, the Dragon God looked at the serious Shi Yu with a burning gaze. In fact, when she first asked Shi Yu for help, she didn’t have much hope. She didn’t think that Shi Yu could crack the Space-Time Dragon Vein. Although Shi Yu had cracked the Blue Sea Ruins, the Space-Time Ruins were clearly higher-level.
“Can it succeed?” The Dragon God prayed in her heart. Slowly, pink and white light spread from the Space-Time Dragon Vein under the island, surging and sweeping up the time hexagram Shi Yu had drawn.
Buzz!
In the next moment, the power of the Space-Time Dragon Vein turned into a domain that wrapped around Shi Yu, the Dragon God, and the others. With a spatial wave, they directly disappeared from this space-time.
…
1100 years ago.
On the chaotic and lonely sea.
Three figures appeared out of thin air on this Desolate Island in pink and white spatial light.
The Dragon God fell from the sky through teleportation and immediately stabilized her body with a confused expression.
Shi Yu, on the other hand, was already experienced. He steadily caught Eleven, pressed it back onto his shoulder, and sized up his surroundings.
“Senior Dragon God, I succeeded,” Shi Yu said in surprise. “I really succeeded!”
[Qi: Disgusted face.]
“We’ve already returned to a thousand years ago.” Shi Yu woke up the Dragon God, who was a little dizzy. At this moment, the Dragon God looked around in disbelief and was shocked by the spatial rejection power.
“We really succeeded??”
“Of course. I only studied the mere Space-Time Ruins for two days before cracking it. However, the energy in the dragon vein might only be able to support us messing around this time,” Shi Yu said.
[Qi: Hmph, hmph, hmph…] In the ruins space, Qi had dark circles under her eyes. Forget it, whatever Shi Yu said. However, the most gossipy thing now was what the Dragon God planned to do and how to face the Dragon Emperor of this era.
Of course, Shi Yu also shared the gossip news about the Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor with his pets. What would the Dragon God do if it was love that crossed a thousand years?
Chi Tong, Susu, Qi, and the others sat on stools, hugging sunflowers and munching on melon seeds. Beside them was a big watermelon, sharing Shi Yu’s vision and paying attention to the outside world.
“Shi Yu…” The Dragon God looked at Shi Yu and was silent for a long time. “I think I better not appear. Can you help me deal with the mythical remnant soul in the ruins Long Qingyun brought?”
“Aren’t you going to do it yourself?” Shi Yu was stunned. “Not appear? You won’t even see Senior Dragon Emperor?”
“Don’t tell them my identity either.”
Perhaps the Dragon God also felt that it wasn’t suitable, so she planned to only ask him to save the Dragon Emperor and take a look from afar?
“Actually, we can change our appearance. right?” Shi Yu said. “Why don’t…”
The Dragon God shook her head. “No need, just do as I say.”
Shi Yu : “…”
“Wu wu wu!” Eleven patted Shi Yu and told him to give up. Women’s hearts were like needles at the bottom of the sea. It was better not to care!
It stretched out the bamboo in front of Shi Yu and asked him if he wanted to take a bite.
“Give it to me.” Shi Yu pulled the bamboo over and used his psychic power to strengthen his teeth. Under Eleven’s shocked expression, he took a bite and ate it before putting the remaining bamboo back into the ruins.
With his monster physique and physical control, Shi Yu could also absorb the nutrition of the metal-element bamboo, but his digestion was slower.
“Eat later. Next, we have to do business. Let’s find the Dragon Emperor first,” Shi Yu said to Eleven, who was holding out its palm with tears in its eyes.
Bamboo… Bamboo… Eleven couldn’t help but collapse.
On this day, Eleven recalled the fear of being dominated by the bamboo shoots again.
He understood. The team was in a famine. Was Shi Yu also a beggar who can’t be a chooser?!
…
Shi Yu and the Dragon God headed straight to Dong Huang.
However, just as they advanced halfway, they changed their itinerary and advanced toward Dragon Palace City.
They sensed that in the East Sea, a large number of powerful sea creatures were gathering towards Dragon Palace City, as if something big had happened over there.
Shi Yu captured an overlord old turtle to ask before learning that the Dragon Palace had undergone a coup. The new Dragon God, the Heavenly Sea Divine Dragon, was about to ascend the throne, and the various factions had to pay their respects.
Shi Yu, the Dragon God, Eleven, Buggy in the Beast Taming Space : “…”
What a coincidence.
“Could it be that the current time node is that Dong Huang’s Legendary Emperor and Dragon Emperor have just joined forces with you to overthrow the previous Dragon God’s rule of Dragon Palace City, Senior?”
“In theory, Senior Dragon Emperor should also be in the Dragon Palace for this celebration banquet, right?”
The Dragon God said, “Well, at this time, I don’t have the strength of a demigod yet. I’m only close, but soon, and he’s already a Legendary Beast Tamer. For a long time, he’s been exploring the ruins of the Dragon Palace to cultivate and staying in Dragon Palace City.”
“Let’s go, let’s go take a look.” Shi Yu couldn’t wait anymore. Not only could he see the Dragon Emperor, but he could also see the Dragon God!
“Wait, wait.” The Dragon God suddenly stopped.

chapters.title: Chapter 1261 - 1261 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (3)
chapters.content:
1261 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (3)
“What’s wrong?” Shi Yu flew in midair with his psychic power and turned around in confusion. He saw the Dragon God stammering over there. In the end, the Dragon God sighed and said, “It’s alright. Let’s go.”
Shi Yu raised his eyebrows. Something was wrong. Could it be that she didn’t want him to bump into anything?
…
At this moment, the door of Dragon Palace City was open. It welcomed the sea beasts from all over the world to witness the new Dragon God ascend the throne.
The current new Dragon God’s strength had yet to reach demigod level and wasn’t enough to suppress the East Sea. However, because she had formed an alliance with the current strongest faction on land, Dong Huang, no one dared to have any thoughts.
After all, the Dragon Emperor of Dong Huang was ferocious. Not only did he kill the demigods who occupied the east, but he also joined forces with the new Dragon God to kill the Dragon Palace’s Old Dragon God. The battle results of the two demigods killing were already considered the first tier of experts on the Blue Planet.
Now, a large number of sea beasts had entered Dragon Palace City. Those subdued totem dragon kings were presiding over the overall situation, and the two protagonists of the Dragon God Dragon Palace who had caused this huge incident were communicating here.
One of the protagonists had the body of an Eastern dragon. Its color was like the fusion of the sky and the ocean. Its entire body was coordinated with nature. Just from its expression, one could tell that it was a little female dragon. It was delicate and had a proud aura.
“Long Qingyun, are you hiding something from me?”
“I’ve already let you explore the Dragon God Ruins. It’s time to tell me what you’ve discovered, right?”
The other protagonist was a young man in his 30s in a black and golden dragon robe. He smiled and said, “Sister Ah Tian, I did discover something, but it’s not that important.”
The Dragon God frowned and said, “I’m the Dragon God now.”
The Dragon Emperor shrugged and said, “Alright, Your Majesty Dragon God, it’s just that the Mythical Ruins I obtained when I was young might indeed be controlled by a mastermind, and I wonder what the mastermind’s goal is.”
After a moment of silence, the Dragon God said, “Then what do you plan to do?”
Long Qingyun said, “I’ve never used it after reaching the legendary level, but I plan to open it again when I’m free.”
“No matter what the goal of the spirit of the ruins is, it has helped me so much. I’ve accepted its inheritance, so there’s no reason not to face it once.”
“Don’t worry, it’ll be fine. My life is up to me, not the heavens. No one can control my fate,” the Dragon Emperor said confidently. On the other side, the Dragon God was rather silent.
“Cough, cough, cough, cough. Sorry to disturb you.” Just as the two parties were communicating, a discordant voice sounded. Shi Yu walked in while the expressions of the ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor changed.
Shi Yu looked at the Dragon Emperor, who was shouting “My life is up to me”, and the Dragon God, who seemed to be used to this, in confusion.
[He’s always been like this.] In the dark, the Dragon God, who had come from the modern era, observed the Dragon Emperor, Long Qingyun. At first, she felt absent-minded and nostalgic, then she felt a headache.
Long before the legendary tales of the Dragon Emperor and Long Qingyun came to be, she had already formed a blood feud with the old Dragon God of Dragon Palace City, and Dragon Palace City also coveted Long Qingyun’s Dragon Race Mythical Ruins. The enemy of her enemy became her friend.
Both parties were super geniuses. The Dragon God was the daughter of two totems and had the aptitude of a demigod. As for the Dragon Emperor, he naturally had legendary aptitude.
They joined forces and were unstoppable. In the end, both parties overthrew the regime of Dragon Palace City together. They could be said to be comrades with very good relationships. The Dragon God naturally knew Long Qingyun very well. Using the Dragon God’s own evaluation, he was a very proud and responsible human genius.
After a thousand years, the Dragon God couldn’t help but feel emotional when she saw her old comrade and her young self.
[Shi Yu, I’ll leave it to you.] After the Dragon God finished speaking, Shi Yu had already faced the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor. The two of them looked at Shi Yu, who had entered the Dragon Palace without anyone noticing, as if they were facing a great enemy, and were shocked.
He actually invaded here without them noticing. Who was this young man?
“Roar!!!” The young Dragon God could be said to be quite irritable. It immediately erupted with a strong dragon’s might and suppressed the others.
Seeing that she was so reckless when she was young, the Dragon God couldn’t help but fall silent. She had already expected this outcome…
As expected, Shi Yu and Eleven’s expressions didn’t change in the face of this dragon’s might that was close to demigod pressure.
Pa. Beside Shi Yu’s leg, Panda King Eleven patted its stomach. It immediately exploded like a thunderclap. All the dragon’s might disintegrated, making the expressions of the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor change drastically.
“Who are you?” the Dragon Emperor said in disbelief. Although the Dragon God had yet to reach the demigod level, she was only a step away. She was much stronger than his trump card pet. Unless it was a group battle, it was impossible for him to defeat the Dragon God.
The dragon’s might just now could be said to be enough to make ordinary, top-notch totems fall into a difficult situation. However, this black and white bear in front of him only patted its stomach and broke the dragon’s might?
It was at demigod level!
In an instant, the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor understood that they had come with ill intentions.
The mysterious human and demigod-level pet… This combination really made it difficult for both parties to determine Shi Yu’s identity. This configuration was unprecedented.
“Well, I’m not an enemy. Don’t be excited.” Shi Yu scratched his cheek that was strangely itchy from the dragon’s might with one finger and said, “Let me introduce myself. My name is Shi Yu.”
“Lord Dragon God, Lord Dragon Emperor, hello.”
Shi Yu?
He had never heard of him!
Seeing the person in front of them suddenly enter and address them so politely, the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were even more puzzled and nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1262 - 1262 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (4)
chapters.content:
1262 Shi Yu, Dragon Emperor, Dragon God (4)
“What’s your goal?”
He looked at the Dragon Emperor, and in an instant, the Dragon Emperor frowned and emanated a formidable presence as he said, “I don’t remember that I have a grudge with you.”
“Don’t misunderstand. The enemy I’m referring to is that,” Shi Yu said. “Have you obtained the recognition of a Mythical Ruins and bound to it?”
“In that Mythical Ruins, there’s the remnant soul of a god from the Mythical Era. I have a grudge with it.”
“So you covet my treasure.” Seeing this, the Dragon Emperor finally knew Shi Yu’s goal. Just like the Dragon Palace’s totem dragon king back then, he coveted his Mythical Ruins.
