“No, although that’s a treasure, it might also take your life. The goal of the Mythical remnant soul inside nurturing you is to build a compatible body and possess you. If you don’t give it to me and mess around yourself, something will definitely happen in the end.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the pupils of the Dragon Emperor and the young Dragon God constricted.
The person in front of him knew something.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Since you don’t believe me, I’ll chat with it and watch carefully. Let it come out itself.”
Shi Yu directly used telepathy to communicate with the Mythical Ruins carried by the Dragon Emperor from afar and said, “The guy inside, if you can hear me, get out.”
“Do you want to know what happened after the Ancestral Dragon brought the Mythical Dragon Race to the starry sky of the universe?”
“Do you want to know how I beat up the three dragon gods left on the Blue Planet?”
“Do you want to know what news the Phoenix Race god who left the Blue Planet brought to the Phoenix Race from the starry sky of the universe?”
“Do you want to know how the ancestor of the Kirin Race died after entering the Universe Sea?”
“After hiding for so long, aren’t you prepared to attack?” Shi Yu said playfully.
Every word he said shocked the Dragon Emperor and the Dragon God opposite him. The Ancestral Dragon brought the Mythical Dragon Race to the starry sky? He beat up the Dragon Race god? The Phoenix Race god… brought back news?
What was going on?
At the same time.
Within the mythical relic carried by the Dragon Emperor, a lustrous radiance emanated from a dragon pupil that resembled a dark star. In its iris, there was also a profound sense of shock.
Who was it?
Shi Yu’s words directly awakened the Mythical remnant soul in the Mythical Ruins.
As expected…
Space cracks appeared, and endless black mist spread out from the dimensional ruins. An aura that was terrifying enough to crush totems leaked from the spatial cracks.
“You…” At this moment, sensing that Shi Yu had really awakened the Mythical remnant soul in the Mythical Ruins with a few words, the Dragon Emperor’s expression changed drastically.
It realized that something was wrong.
“Bastard, do you know what you’re doing?”
He didn’t expect Shi Yu to really awaken the sleeping Mythical remnant soul.
It wasn’t a good thing for this guy to wake up.
Although he had said that he didn’t know if the other party was friend or foe, he judged that it was very likely an enemy.
Because, according to his investigation and deduction, the mastermind behind the Mythical Ruins that recognized him as the master was very likely the ancestor of the dragon race, the Ancestral Dragon!
No, or rather, it was the dark side of the Ancestral Dragon!
In the legends, in the Mythical Era, the ancestor of the dragon race, the Ancestral Dragon, had the power to create the world and destroy the world. In order to break through and surpass the divine level, it thought of countless methods. In the end, it came to the conclusion that the power in its body was too complicated and not conducive to transcendence.
Therefore, it completely separated a portion of the uncoordinated power and divided itself into two.
After separating the power, the Ancestral Dragon not only didn’t weaken in strength, but further honed its abilities. However, what the Ancestral Dragon didn’t anticipate was that the power it split off became a World Destruction Demon Dragon.
It became the ancestor of the dragon bloodline.
In the end, the Ancestral Dragon’s main body suppressed the World Destruction Dragon, leaving only this Legendary section.
According to the Dragon Emperor’s deduction, the mastermind of the Mythical Ruins he had obtained was very likely the remnant soul of the World Destruction Dragon that had separated from the Ancestral Dragon!

chapters.title: Chapter 1263 - 1263 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (1)
chapters.content:
1263 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (1)
“Roar!!!!!”
As Shi Yu provoked it, space shattered and black mist spread. A terrifying creature was awakening.
At this moment, the Dragon Emperor, who was carrying the Mythical Ruins, could be said to have an extremely dark expression.
“No, I can’t let it out!”
The Dragon Emperor suppressed the ruins with all his might, but he realized that his identity as the owner of the ruins was useless.
“Kid, so you’ve already reached this level.”
“I almost overslept.”
“Looks like I woke up at the right time.”
Laughter came from the ruins.
Soon, a gray-black dragon soul that looked like a combination of a dinosaur and a Western dragon slowly formed.
Its blood-colored eyes lit up, and it spat out gray mist. Its entire body emitted gust-like fluctuations, and the entire Dragon God Palace suddenly trembled because of its appearance.
In the Dragon Palace mystic realm, the bloodlines of those creatures with dragon bloodlines also began to tremble at this moment. They looked in the direction of the Dragon God Palace in confusion, not knowing what had happened.
Buzz!
After the black dragon appeared, its body kept enlarging. It suddenly stretched out its hand and grabbed the Dragon Emperor, its eyes flickering.
Seeing this, the Dragon Emperor’s expression changed drastically, but he felt that it was difficult to even move. The dragon pet in the Beast Taming Space was even worse off than his state!
“Not good, Long Qingyun, dodge quickly!” The Ancient Dragon God immediately shouted anxiously.
Under the bloodline pressure, it was actually difficult for it to move. It was still overcoming it!
After they sensed the powerful power of this dragon’s soul, they were all shocked. They felt that the power of this dragon’s soul was more than several times stronger than that of the old Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.
Who exactly was this guy!
The Dragon Gods of the two eras were stunned by the power of the World Annihilation Dragon.
This voice seemed to have broken through the frozen space. The Dragon Emperor retreated in relief and panted crazily.
In fact, apart from them being very stunned, Shi Yu was also very stunned.
“What’s wrong with this guy?” At this moment, Shi Yu and Eleven also looked at the Mythical remnant soul in confusion.
Logically speaking, a Mythical remnant soul should be even weaker than those gods who had awakened from their sleep, but why did it feel that this guy was so fierce?
It gave Shi Yu the feeling that it was almost close to the Phoenix Man’s Phoenix.
“I seem to have awakened some impressive guy,” Shi Yu muttered to himself as he looked at the revived Demon Dragon.
“Dragon Emperor, do you know where this guy comes from?”
When Shi Yu asked, the World Destruction Demon Dragon and the Dragon Emperor looked at Shi Yu.
“#￥@%￥#@￥”
The Dragon Emperor, who had retreated, cursed. This guy didn’t know what was in the ruins, so he woke it up casually?
How could he want to kill someone he didn’t know?
Although he didn’t know the operating principle of Shi Yu awakening the divine dragon’s remnant soul with just a few words, the Dragon Emperor gritted his teeth in hatred towards Shi Yu.
He originally wanted to deal with such a dangerous guy alone and try to come into contact with him. Shi Yu’s arrival caught the Dragon Emperor off guard, and he was completely unprepared.
This time, it was over. Something big was about to happen. The Dragon Emperor felt that it was troublesome.
Shi Yu, this… This guy seems to be another side of the Ancestral Dragon! The World Destruction Demon Dragon is separated from the Ancestral Dragon!!
Because it wanted to replace the Ancestral Dragon’s main body and destroy the Blue Planet, it was suppressed by the Ancestral Dragon. It’s a very dangerous guy. I didn’t expect it to still be alive!
In the Beast Taming Space, Qi and Ling reminded Shi Yu with pleasantly surprised expressions.
It was a top-notch Mythical resource!
“What?”
Shi Yu had already sensed that the big guy in front of him was extraordinary. At this moment, when he learned its identity, he was stunned.
“You’re the clone of the Ancestral Dragon?” Shi Yu asked in shock.
Upon hearing that, the expressions of the two Dragon Gods and the young Dragon Emperor changed.
The Dragon Emperor didn’t expect Shi Yu to also recognize the other party’s identity. This way, his guess was even more confirmed.
If it was really that guy, he might encounter the greatest crisis in history.
The two Dragon Gods were purely shocked.
Compared to humans, as dragons, they were clearly more sensitive to the word Ancestral Dragon.
As for the World Annihilation Dragon, that was a more sensitive term.
Even the dragon race was very afraid of this ancestor. It could be said that the dragon bloodline was very lucky to be passed down. With what the World Annihilation Dragon had done at that time, it was reasonable for this race to be completely destroyed.
“Roar!!!!!!”
At this moment, the one with the most intense emotional change was the World Annihilation Demon Dragon, whose movements were interrupted.
It was awakened by Shi Yu’s special telepathy. It originally planned to communicate with Shi Yu after it was done with its things.
But now, it had the urge to crush Shi Yu again.
“Ant, who are you calling that guy’s clone??” Its huge head was high and mighty as it looked down at Shi Yu and Eleven beside his leg.
Boom!!!
An Asura-like death aura pushed in all directions like illumination from the World Annihilation Dragon.
“Not good…”
The young Dragon God was forced back again. Waves of the dragon’s might came from the Dragon Emperor’s body. Nine dragons appeared and protected his body, but they couldn’t help but retreat.
Everyone was shocked by the power of the World Annihilation Dragon, but at the same time, they were worried about the current situation.
“Can you not randomly use deterrence?” At this moment, Shi Yu covered his face with his arm to block the killing intent and bad breath. He couldn’t help but say.

chapters.title: Chapter 1264 - 1264 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (2)
chapters.content:
1264 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (2)
What was going on?
In the end, it was the dragon ancestor separated by the Ancestral Dragon?
A guy with peak strength comparable to a top-notch god?
Logically speaking, shouldn’t such a guy be unable to stay on the Blue Planet?
However, Shi Yu looked at its state. At the moment, it was only a remnant soul. It couldn’t be considered a complete World Destruction Demon Dragon at all. Perhaps this was why it could still stay on the Blue Planet?
Alright, as long as he didn’t lose out!
There were no feelings involved. It was all business.
“It’s actually you!” At the same time, the transmigrated Dragon God, who had been secretly paying attention, also had a complicated expression.
She naturally knew the legend of the Ancestral Dragon splitting into two.
So the Dragon Emperor at that time was facing an enemy of this level alone?
In fact, what the Dragon God wanted to know the most when she followed Shi Yu this time was whether the Dragon Emperor had successfully dealt with that Mythical remnant soul.
According to various signs, the outcome was that the Dragon Emperor and the Mythical remnant soul perished together. However, the Dragon God couldn’t be sure.
At this moment, after determining the identity of the Mythical remnant soul, the Dragon God had momentarily conflicting feelings. Even if she acknowledged the Dragon Emperor’s strength, she was a little hesitant.
She didn’t think that the Dragon Emperor could defeat the other side of the Ancestral Dragon. After all, although it wasn’t a complete individual and was only a remnant soul, the ancestor of the dragon bloodline was still in existence with top-notch divine battle power at the peak.
However, even if the Dragon Emperor couldn’t deal with the Mythical remnant soul… it didn’t matter.
As long as the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon was still alive, when they returned to the original space and time, they could continue to take revenge for the Dragon Emperor!!
[Shi Yu, do you need help?] the Dragon God asked telepathically.
“There’s no need.”
“So be it. Why are you roaring so loudly?” Shi Yu lowered his arm and looked at the dragon opposite him with disdain.
“Roar!!!” The remnant soul of the World Destruction Demon Dragon roared and looked at Shi Yu and the others fiercely.
“Ant, remember my true name, the World Annihilation Dragon.”
“This guy doesn’t look like a good dragon at a glance. When I beat it up later, you won’t help it, right?”
“Don’t interfere. This guy is my hunting target.” Shi Yu gritted his teeth and revealed a smile, his eyes bright.
“As for you guys, just watch obediently from the side and protect Dragon Palace City.”
At this moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, the World Annihilation Dragon was suddenly furious.
“You have a death wish!!”
The Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were also a little stunned.
What exactly was the background of this human?
After knowing the other party’s identity, what nonsense was he saying?
Did he really want to hunt the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon?
At that moment, the brains of the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were still in a mess. Because things had completely exceeded their imagination and the scope of their ability to solve them, they didn’t know what to do for a moment.
However, there was no need for them to make a choice. In the next moment, what stunned the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor was that Shi Yu really attacked.
The black and white bear that had been following Shi Yu rushed out.
In the face of the deterrence of the World Destruction Demon Dragon, it was completely calm.
Although they had just realized that this black and white bear was very strong, seeing it attack so calmly, they still couldn’t imagine it.
The World Annihilation Dragon was the true ancestor of the dragon race.
It was at the top of the creatures.
In theory, any life form was subject to its suppression, but this black and white bear collided with it like flowing water!
“Wuu!! (Eleven works, Chi Tong eats more, charge, charge!)” Eleven roared.
Zi. Zi. Zi.
With a flash of black and white lightning on its body, nine Iron-eating Beast phantoms appeared on its body. With a boom, under the enhancement of these phantoms, it turned into a bolt of lightning. As the floor of the Dragon God Palace shattered and space trembled, the World Annihilation Demon Dragon couldn’t believe that there was actually an ant who dared to challenge it. It immediately waved its angry dragon claws!!
Boom!!!
Under the incomparable collision, the surrounding Dragon God Palace instantly turned into powder. Eleven’s figure stopped in midair and collided, but it was stopped by the World Annihilation Dragon’s dragon claw. The two parties were at a stalemate. Between the dragon’s claw and its body, the energy tide was violent, like an erupting volcano, constantly leaking and shaking everything.
The dazzling buildings of the Dragon God Palace were shattered by the aftermath of this leak.
After all, this Dragon God Palace was specially built with many very expensive and rare materials in order to ascend the throne.
At this moment, probably only the Dragon God herself paid attention to her aggrieved gaze and broken heart when she was young.
She couldn’t help but sigh.
Forget it, this was a worldly possession. When she was young, she wasn’t mature yet. At the moment, the most important thing should be the battle.
“Is that all?” At this moment, a claw blocked the impact of Eleven. The remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon sensed Eleven’s power and sneered.
“Turn into dregs.” However, at this moment, sensing that Eleven’s strength was still increasing and even wanting to defeat it in the power collision, the World Annihilation Dragon continued to show a disdainful expression. Its other dragon claw was smashed over again!
This time, it wasn’t an ordinary attack. There was also a strong destructive power wrapped around it. Under the trembling of the sound of laws, not only the Dragon God Palace, but the entire island began to collapse, and the entire Dragon Palace mystic realm began to tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1265 - 1265 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (3)
chapters.content:
1265 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (3)
Even outside the Dragon Palace, the changes in the currents became chaotic. Countless sea creatures seemed to have sensed the arrival of the cataclysm and fled.
An attack that contained the power of the Destruction of the World!
Such a quasi-divine skill directly made the expressions of the Dragon Emperor and the Ancient Dragon God change drastically, and they were continuously moved.
“Tian, let’s help this bastard. At this rate, forget about Dragon Palace City, a huge disaster will happen to the entire Blue Planet!” the Dragon Emperor said to the Ancient Dragon God.
“Alright|” Due to the suppression of its bloodline, the Ancient Dragon God really couldn’t resist at this moment. However, in the face of the Dragon Emperor’s words, it still nodded heavily.
However, just as the two of them decided to help Shi Yu, they suddenly stopped and were stunned by the scene in front of them.
“What’s this?!”
The World Annihilation Dragon didn’t smash out with the Destruction Dragon Claw attack. Instead, it suddenly stopped in midair. This was because Eleven, who was opposite him, also stretched out its palm. On it, the Yin Yang Millstone spun, and the destructive power similarly emitted the sound of laws. Under the interweaving of the two sounds of laws, it was as if the world had been destroyed. Countless cracks appeared on Dragon God Island, and it swayed.
The terrifying big moves were both in the hands of both parties.
In terms of destructive power, they were on par.
“Go ahead, hit us.” Shi Yu was amused. He could tell that the World Annihilation Dragon opposite was putting on an act.
Although the other party was strong, it wasn’t that strong either. In this era before the revival of the laws, there were more things they were afraid of.
“You don’t want the soul that’s finally about to recover from its restoration to be injured again, right?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but chuckle when he saw the current situation of the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul.
At this moment, looking at Eleven’s skill, the pupils of the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul constricted. It couldn’t believe that the attack had never been thrown, and Eleven opposite was also maintaining restraint.
At that moment, when they saw the World Annihilation Claw Attack of the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul and the Yin Yang Millstone in Eleven’s hand, the Dragon Emperor and the Ancient Dragon God had incredulous expressions.
These two guys were both monsters.
It was fine if the World Annihilation Dragon mastered such a powerful skill, but what was wrong with the guy opposite?
However…
If this continued, the entire Dragon Palace City would be destroyed by their battle.
“If this continues, neither of us will gain any advantage.”
“What did you mean just now? What do you know? Who exactly are you? Your goal shouldn’t be as simple as provoking me, right?” At this moment, after the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon sensed Eleven’s power, it wasn’t that aggressive anymore.
He wanted to sit down with Shi Yu and communicate well.
Seeing this, the expressions of the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor tensed.
However, in the next moment, their eyes widened in unison. They saw the black and white bear slap over, making the pupils of the World Annihilation Dragon tremble. It roared and smashed its dragon claws over too!
Boom!!!
The attacks of the two parties collided, and the power of the Destruction World bloomed. Just as the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were shocked and thought that Dragon Palace City was about to be destroyed, something unexpected happened.
Outside the aftermath, the world had just formed. Shi Yu and the others were directly pulled into another starry sky world by Buggy through the Creation Domain.
With a violent sound, the World Destroying Demon Dragon and Eleven flew backward and were smashed into two asteroids in the aftermath.
The Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor looked around.
Then, he saw a righteous scene.
A group fight.
“Roar!!!” The angry roar of the World Annihilation Dragon came from the starry sky. The color of the vast sky instantly changed, dyeing it dark blood red.
But then, the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul was stunned.
He looked at the dragon’s body, which was like a god of creation higher in the starry sky, and the huge claw it smashed over.
Another demigod enemy!
“The power of creation?”
At this moment, it thought that the Ancestral Dragon had arrived, but when it saw the appearance of the huge Green Dragon God circling the starry sky, it realized that it was wrong. However, this power that exceeded everything, the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul thought that it wasn’t wrong.
It blocked in shock, but it was instantly sent flying by the huge claw that covered the sky like a rubber ball, along with the asteroid.
Boom!
The asteroid shattered and turned into cosmic gravel, while the World Annihilation Dragon’s spiritual body continued to fall into the starry sky like a meteor.
“Green Dragon?!!!” At this moment, the Dragon Emperor, who was watching, sensed the loss of the power of the pile of Green Dragon faith tools he carried. He couldn’t help but look at the Green Dragon in the starry sky in shock and disbelief.
This was a Green Dragon?
In the next moment, the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were shocked to discover that another asteroid had shattered.
“Roar!!!”
It was Eleven, who had been sent flying like the World Annihilation Dragon just now. Because its body was intact, its current defense was much stronger than the World Annihilation Dragon.
It was nothing to withstand the aftermath just now.
Eleven enlarged in the starry sky and turned into a cosmic behemoth thousands of meters tall. In the roar, it slapped again. The Wex Palm, surrounded by black and white lightning, directly sent the World Annihilation Dragon flying again under the dizzy consciousness of the remnant soul.
The direction it was sent flying was where Shi Yu and the others were.
Seeing that the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon had been transmitted, Shi Yu’s expression was calm.
Under the incredulous expressions of the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor, it turned into a red-haired and red-eyed posture, spreading soaring flames. It held a red sword spirit and slashed out a sword light that was enough to crush stars.
Boom!
Under the vibration of the starry sky, the sword light flew out and instantly divided the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul into two.
The remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon encountered the attack that countered Stats the most. Its originally unconscious consciousness instantly woke up, but after sensing its state, it immediately let out a miserable roar.
“Roar!!!”
The voice shook the starry sky, filled with confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1266 - 1266 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (4)
chapters.content:
1266 Wuwu Dragon God Palace, My Dragon God Palace (4)
“Who… exactly are you?”
“Don’t say it so early. How do you know I can’t defeat you before the end?” As Shi Yu finished speaking, he put away his sword and imprisoned the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul in Chi Tong’s undead space.
Crack.
In the next moment, the Creation Domain shattered. After Shi Yu finished work, everyone returned to the Dragon Palace mystic realm.
Shi Yu also exited the possession state, leaving a panda that had almost deflated floating back to Shi Yu’s side. Shi Yu smiled and paid attention to the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon in Chi Tong’s undead space. He felt that he had gained a lot.
“This…”
At this moment, the Dragon God who had come with Shi Yu was still alright, but the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor had already completely lost their ability to think. They looked at Shi Yu and couldn’t believe what they had seen and sensed.
The true ancestor of the dragon bloodline separated by the Ancestral Dragon, the remnant soul of the World Destruction Dragon, was killed effortlessly by the Beast Tamer in front of him?
Those were… three demigod levels just now?
They were certain that, be it the black and white bear, the Green Dragon, or the undead that possessed Shi Yu, they were all demigod-level lives.
The person in front of him actually contracted three demigod-level pets?
Who exactly was he… The current them, like the World Annihilation Dragon just now, were once again deeply confused by Shi Yu’s identity.
At the same time, they retreated again as if facing a great enemy.
“Don’t worry, I said I’m not the enemy. My goal is only it,” Shi Yu said. “The remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, its undead crystal, should contain top-notch world-destroying laws. If it was at its peak or in an era where laws revived, it would definitely be extremely difficult to hunt it.”
“This time, I picked up a bargain.” Shi Yu smiled.
No matter how strong the World Annihilation Dragon was, in this era with incomplete laws, it was at most at the demigod level.
Moreover, it was a remnant soul. In terms of individual battle power, it was at most comparable to the Phoenix Man’s Star Phoenix. It was simply too easy to deal with.
At this moment, as Shi Yu finished speaking, the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor were shocked.
Shi Yu chased after the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon for resources?
The target was a resource dropped by a top-notch god after its death? Did this make sense?
Both parties opened their mouths wide. They had never seen it before, nor did they dare to imagine that there would be such a crazy Beast Tamer.
She felt that with Shi Yu’s help, she and the Dragon Emperor in the past would gradually have a wrong understanding of the world.
“By the way, you should know that there’s such a thing in the ruins you’re carrying, right?” At this moment, Shi Yu asked the Dragon Emperor.
“Have you thought about what method you would choose and where to deal with it if I didn’t appear?”
“What do you want?” The Dragon Emperor was still rather cautious.
Shi Yu was silent. What else could I want?
If your plan fails, perhaps I can still rely on clues to kill the remnant soul of the Origin Space-Time World Annihilation Dragon that you haven’t resolved!
At that time, I will have double the resources!
“Forget it, there’s no hurry. Think about it carefully. In short, I’ve helped you solve such a big hidden danger. You can invite me to participate in the Dragon God Ascension ceremony and treat us to a meal, right?” Shi Yu asked.
“Wu wu wu!!!” Eleven, who was beside Shi Yu’s leg, also raised its hand.
Food, food!
Give Shi Yu food quickly. They couldn’t let Shi Yu snatch its bamboo anymore.
The Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor looked at each other and fell into deep thought. Although they felt that these guys had mysterious origins, they really didn’t look like enemies??
The request was only as simple as eating.
“Sure,” the young Dragon God said after a moment of silence.
“It’s over.” Upon hearing her young self say this, the Dragon God from a thousand years later fell silent. She felt that her young self’s coronation banquet might fail midway.

chapters.title: Chapter 1267 - 1267 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (1)
chapters.content:
1267 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (1)
Wu wu wu wu wu~
Roar, roar, roar~
Yiya, ya, ya~
Delightful cries resounded on an island in the Dragon Palace mystic realm with the background music released by Ling.
“Little ones, eat to your heart’s content. Don’t stand on ceremony.”
Shi Yu held the Dragon Blood Wine and gulped it down. Although he felt that it was disgusting, it would be a pity not to drink such a precious thing.
“Nom!” Eleven wolfed down the metal resources like a crazy bear.
Although Buggy had evolved into a dragon, it still continued its eating habits during the worm era and ate legendary fruits.
Baby Ginseng, on the other hand, gulped down rare water and watered itself.
Although Shi Yu and the others had just eaten before coming, they were consuming it at a high speed at all times. It was equivalent to eating breakfast and lunch. It wasn’t a problem at all.
“Lord Dragon God… No, something’s wrong!”
The Turtle Prime Minister, who was in charge of the coronation banquet, ran over to report to the Dragon God with tears in his eyes. “The high-level food prepared for the overlords and totems at the coronation banquet has already been consumed halfway in just 10 minutes.”
“If this continues, after the coronation banquet starts… the Dragon Kings might not even have food.”
The Dragon God : “…”
The Dragon Emperor : “…”
“We saw it.”
The two of them had actually seen it the whole time. Shi Yu summoned another pile of monster pets. All of them had shocking appetites. Even Shi Yu’s appetite was comparable to that of a totem dragon. It really made the Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor speechless.
They originally thought that Shi Yu’s words of “inviting me to a banquet and treating me to a meal” were just polite, but they didn’t expect it to be a trap.
With just Shi Yu summoning this pile of guys, it might not be long before he could eat Dragon Palace City up just by eating.
Other people were basically sleeping at the demigod level…
Shi Yu, on the other hand, brought several demigods to fight every day. If they didn’t starve, who would?
“Shi Yu, Shi Yu, I’ve already disintegrated that remnant soul.” The mini sword Ji Chi Tong, who was sitting on the floating spiritual sword, didn’t eat the food of Dragon Palace City with everyone. Instead, it was disintegrating the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon alone.
After the decomposition was completed, it immediately communicated with Shi Yu telepathically.
“How is it? Did you obtain any useful information?” Shi Yu asked.
Chi Tong shook its head and said, “No, the other party’s memories are all incomplete. This should be a little remnant soul that escaped after being suppressed by the Ancestral Dragon back then. Apart from some skill EXP, there’s almost no useful information left. However, the other party is indeed guiding the Dragon Emperor step by step, wanting to nurture him and the nine dragon pets into his body.”
“Since you don’t have it, forget it. You absorb it.” Shi Yu took a bite of a prawn leg.
“Alright~” Chi Tong was very happy. It felt that the Destruction EXP mastered by the World Annihilation Dragon was very compatible with the Vermillion Bird Divine Fire.
“There’s no hurry. Let’s talk about it when your Spirit Release proficiency is high. When the time comes, the Effect of the Spirit Release will be better,” Shi Yu said.
The Destruction Law was also the prototype of a top-notch law, corresponding to the Creation Law.
Back then, when the Ancestral Dragon was in its complete form, it mastered the two top-notch laws of creation and destruction. It was very powerful, so it was known as the Dragon of Creation and Destruction.
However, in fact, it proved that mastering two opposing top-notch laws wasn’t necessarily a good thing.
Because of this, the Ancestral Dragon was at a bottleneck for a long time. Only when it separated from the World Destruction Dragon did its strength improve.
It was also because of the impressive titles of the Ancestral Dragon Creation and the Dragon of Destruction that, after the Green Dragon Legendary was created, in the future, people placed it side by side with the Green Dragon.
But in fact, although the Ancestral Dragon was very strong, the power it mastered was still a little different from that of the Green Dragon.
In terms of the quality of the divine skill alone, the creation law contained in Buggy’s creation domain was clearly above the creation law of the Ancestral Dragon. After all, the creation law was the ability of planet-type life forms to open up a world. Of course, Buggy couldn’t be considered to have mastered the complete creation law now. It needed to rely on the power of faith to use it, and the restrictions were too big.
But when Buggy left the power of faith and could also use the laws of creation, it would definitely be much stronger than the Ancestral Dragon.
This was also suitable for Eleven and the World Annihilation Dragon.
In Shi Yu’s opinion, Eleven’s Destruction Law was also more practical than the World Annihilation Dragon’s Destruction Law. Although these two divine skills were similar, the former was actually more microscopic, while the latter was more macroscopic.
In terms of destroying a country, perhaps the World Annihilation Dragon was better, but in terms of destroying the enemy’s battle intent, stats, memories, and deeper things, Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone was better.
Shi Yu estimated that when Eleven’s Yin Yang Millstone level increased, it should be able to even obliterate Baby Ginseng’s time mark and make its revival fail.
“If the original space and time still have the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, I’ll refine it for Little Ji.”
Shi Yu muttered to himself in his heart. It was relatively difficult for Eleven to absorb this. The types of resources didn’t match, and the benefits were decreasing. On the other hand, Little Ji, as a mechanical life form, didn’t refuse anything. It could let Ling help modify and evolve.
Its Cataclysm Skill was only a Normal divine skill, but due to its nature, it was more compatible with the Destruction Law. After absorbing it, it could undoubtedly make the divine skill stronger, and the cost-effective ratio was extremely high.
“Roar?” Little Ji, who was eating dirt, raised its head slightly and looked at the thoughtful Shi Yu. Although Shi Yu had yet to say anything, it kept feeling like something good would happen recently.
After watching Shi Yu, Little Ji looked at the young Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor who were walking over.
“Sir Shi Yu, are you satisfied?” The young Dragon God looked at the messy food on the ground in pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1268 - 1268 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (2)
chapters.content:
1268 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (2)
“Not bad, I’m quite satisfied. It’s just that the dishes are served a little slowly.” Shi Yu smiled and said, “Sit, sit, let’s talk.”
The corners of the young Dragon God’s and the Dragon Emperor’s mouths twitched. They didn’t doubt that Shi Yu had this ability.
“Do you also have a grudge with the demigods of the Dragon Empire?” the Dragon Emperor said. “Also, what does our Dong Huang mean?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It means that I’m also from Dong Huang. Emperor Wu, the empress, and I are all friends. I hope to become friends with you today.”
The Dragon Emperor was slightly stunned, but soon, he realized that the person in front of him was probably an old antique who had lived for thousands of years.
Although he didn’t know how Shi Yu, a human, had lived for so long, Long Qingyun wasn’t shocked at all when he heard Shi Yu say that he knew Emperor Wu and the empress. After all, these were nothing compared to Shi Yu easily dealing with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon.
“We’re willing to be friends with you.”
“However, I won’t trouble you with the Dragon Empire. Although the Western Dragon Empire has some friction with Dragon Palace City and the Dong Huang Dynasty, the existence of such a potential enemy from afar is a good thing for the development of Dong Huang and Dragon Palace City,” Long Qingyun said.
“Born in worry and suffering, you die in peace. If you don’t even have enemies, many internal conflicts will gradually arise. With me around, the Dragon Empire can’t cause any waves.”
Facing the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, the Dragon Emperor was helpless. However, it was only a demigod faction in the later era. He was fully confident that he could resist it.
Under the alliance between Dong Huang and the Dragon Palace, if they were even afraid of a Dragon Empire, they wouldn’t be able to survive.
“Uh.” Shi Yu was slightly silent. It was mainly because he wanted to harvest resources! However, Shi Yu thought for a moment. The Dragon Empire started a war with Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang after the Dragon Emperor died. Only the Dragon God dealt with it alone.
Even so, the two parties still fought for hundreds of years until the Space Emperor rose and defeated the Dragon Empire.
Now that he had dealt with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, the Dragon Empire indeed didn’t seem to be a threat to Dragon Palace City and Dong Huang.
[Shi Yu, let’s not interfere too much. Leave the Dragon Empire to the two of them to deal with.] The Ancient Dragon God spoke to Shi Yu telepathically.
“Uh.” Shi Yu suspected that the Dragon God wanted to matchmake the Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor of this space and time to give them more opportunities to fight side by side, but he had no evidence.
[Senior Dragon God, come and eat too. Show your face.]
Dragon God: “No.”
Shi Yu was helpless. She just watched after coming here. Seriously…
“Sir Shi Yu, is the question you asked me just now very important to you?” the Dragon Emperor said.
“At that time, after I learned this information, I vaguely felt a sense of danger and thought of ways to solve it.”
“What measures?” Shi Yu asked.
“If the opponent is really the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, then no matter how hard I work, I can’t defeat it. Therefore, the method I will choose is to seal it.”
“When I explored the Dragon God Ruins this time, I specifically searched for a seal-type divine-level resource.”
“Seal…” Shi Yu muttered. That made sense. With the strength of the Dragon Emperor, it wasn’t impossible for him to fight a powerful demigod like Yun An and a demigod-level enfeeble god. It was still uncertain who would win, but it was too difficult for him to fight the Dragon Ancestor.
Although it was a remnant soul, it was also a huge challenge for the Dragon Emperor, who had dragon pets.
Relying on sealing might be the only choice.
From the original history, all the Dragon Emperors had died in this battle, and the enemy was nowhere to be found. Therefore, did the seal fail or succeed?
But at least it was certain that the other party didn’t successfully possess it.
“Can you show me the sealing tool?” Shi Yu said.
When Long Qingyun heard that, he nodded and took out a pearl. “This is said to be a tool left behind by the Mythical Dragon Race to seal the enemy… But I don’t know how to use it yet.”
Pearl…
Shi Yu stared at the pearl the Dragon Emperor took out. After a moment of silence, he suddenly stood up.
Damn.
This was…
“Sir Shi Yu?” Seeing Shi Yu suddenly stand up, the Dragon Emperor was stunned. The young Dragon God beside him also looked at Shi Yu, whose expression had changed drastically, in confusion.
“What’s wrong with this tool?”
“Damn.” Shi Yu couldn’t help but curse as he looked straight at the sealing pearl the Dragon Emperor took out.
He had come into contact with this thing!!
On the eve of the World Tournament, at the Rongguang Archeological Conference.
As the winner, Shi Yu obtained the opportunity to choose two mythical resources of the alliance as prizes.
Heart of Eternal Frost, Soul Pearl, and World Tree Fruit. He chose the last two of the three optional mythical resources!
Among them, he ate the World Tree Fruit. Because it was useless to him, Chi Tong’s level at that time was suppressed, and it couldn’t be swallowed. Therefore, Shi Yu gave it to the Dong Huang Association to study.
He would first study whether the mythical remnant soul inside was friend or foe first.

chapters.title: Chapter 1269 - 1269 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (3)
chapters.content:
1269 Top-notch Divine Resources Times Two (3)
Holy shit, don’t tell me that the Soul Pearl that the Dong Huang Association was working hard to study has the World Annihilation Dragon sealed inside…
Wait a minute, the problem doesn’t seem to be big. Now, Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the seven gods were still in Dong Huang. Even if the World Annihilation Dragon wakes up, it won’t be able to cause much trouble. However, it’ll still cause huge damage…
No, I have to go back quickly to get it back. It’ll be safer.
[Senior Dragon God, I’ve seen this pearl before. It’s one of my rewards at the Rongguang Archeological Conference. The Dragon Emperor has successfully sealed the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, but from the looks of it, it was at the cost of his life. That sealing pearl is in Dong Huang! The original Space-Time World Annihilation Dragon isn’t dead yet.]
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the expression of the hidden Dragon God changed slightly. Then, she nodded.
[Then we… should go back. Let’s settle the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon in the original space and time as soon as possible.]
[Alright, but are you really not coming out?] Shi Yu couldn’t help but ask again when he saw that the Dragon God was going back in the blink of an eye.
[No.]
“Alright.” When Shi Yu saw this, he couldn’t help but shake his head.
He looked at the Ancient Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor and said, “I remembered something just now… In short, there’s no problem with this pearl. You guys keep it and continue researching.”
“Alright, I’m not eating anymore. I suddenly remembered that I have other things to do. Let’s meet again when we have the chance.” Shi Yu wiped his mouth and said, “By the way, before I leave, I have to remind you of a few things.”
“After 1129, the laws of the world will revive and the Mythical Era will descend again. Many opportunities and challenges will appear on Blue Planet. Try to think of a way to live until then and work hard to become stronger.”
“At that time, the world will be even more exciting.”
Shi Yu wouldn’t take the resources of the Dragon Palace. After all, Senior Dragon God was still watching beside him. He felt a little apologetic for taking all the assets of the young Dragon God.
After Shi Yu finished speaking, the Dragon Emperor and the young Dragon God were slightly shocked. In the next moment, Shi Yu took out a pendant-like accessory from his ruins space and threw it to the Dragon Emperor.
It was like a water drop that had been penetrated.
After taking the accessory, the Dragon Emperor was puzzled.
Seeing this accessory, the Dragon God of modern space and time was slightly stunned.
Shi Yu said, “This accessory is called ‘Dragon God Protection’. An elder of mine gave it to me when I was weak and young. Although it’s no longer very useful to your current strength, on account of our friendship… I’ll give it to you. Remember to keep it well.”
The Dragon God Protection was a tool given to Shi Yu by the Dragon God for the second time. The first tool was used when it stopped Yun An’s attack. Then, the Dragon God gave another one. However, before Shi Yu could use it, his strength had already exceeded that of the Dragon God, so he naturally didn’t need it.
As for the future, whether the Dragon Emperor could rely on this to analyze what happened today wasn’t Shi Yu’s business.
They looked at the strange Shi Yu, but at this moment, Shi Yu had already planned to leave. Eleven and the others had already packed up and didn’t waste any food.
“Let’s go.” Shi Yu gave the order. Buggy began to leave Dragon Palace City with Shi Yu and the others.
The Dragon God, who had secretly seen all of this, sighed slightly.
“Thank you, Shi Yu,” she said after a long sigh. In the dark, the Dragon God took one last look at the Dragon Palace City from the past space and time, as well as the young her and the Dragon Emperor. In the end, she retracted her gaze and left with Shi Yu. In addition, her heart had unknowingly undergone a transformation, and her strength had increased.
This way, although she still had regrets, she was already satisfied. Now, the Dragon God only wanted to return to the original space and time and deal with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon that killed the Space-Time Dragon Emperor.
At that time, the obsession of a thousand years would be removed. She planned to climb to a higher realm.
…
The Space-Time Movement of the Dragon Emperor Dynasty was the space-time that Shi Yu stayed in the shortest. After dealing with the enemy, he followed the old method and brought the Dragon God back to the original space-time.
After returning, Shi Yu quickly took out his communication device and called President Lin.
At the same time, it was still rushing in the direction of Dong Huang.
On the other side, President Lin also picked up very quickly.
“Shi Yu, what’s the matter?”
“President Lin, is the Soul Pearl I obtained from the Rongguang Archeological Conference still around? I’ll go get it now. That thing is very dangerous.”
“I just learned the origin of that thing.”
On the other side, President Lin was under the guidance of Divine Source Legendary and cultivating hard. When he heard Shi Yu’s words, he was immediately stunned. “At the moment, that thing is being studied by Gu Yun, who just returned…”
“Stop researching! That’s a tool used by the Dragon Emperor to seal the Mythical remnant soul that killed him. Inside is thedestruction side separated by the Ancestral Dragon. The remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon is very strong and has a very fierce personality. It’s not an ally. Why did this sealing tool fall into the hands of the alliance…”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, President Lin’s heart skipped a beat.
Ancestral Dragon clone, World Annihilation Dragon remnant soul?!!
What a joke.
At the thought that he had also studied the Soul Pearl for a long time, President Lin almost blacked out. What was the divine-level resource that Shi Yu chose?
He was really the chosen one!
“I’ll inform Gu Yun to hand it over to you to deal with,” President Lin immediately said.
“Sigh, so when did this happen? The first thing you think of is to hand an emergency situation to Shi Yu,” he muttered.
President Lin said, “Then Senior Divine Source, do you… want to deal with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon?”
Divine Source Legendary waved his hand and said, “It’s better to leave it to the young people to settle…”
Son of a b*tch, the demigods of the later era were enough to give him a headache. The remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon? He felt that it couldn’t be solved with forbidden arms.
As for Shi Yu, he could even easily defeat a demigod-level awakening god and a super demigod cultivated by the Space Beast Tamer. Divine Source Legendary couldn’t help but sigh. The times had changed.
At the thought that Lin Feng had also reached the divine level in the starry sky of the universe and even joined forces with the Space Emperor to kill a super divine life form above his level, the Divine Source Legendary could only admit defeat.
He only wanted to see what expression that little pervert, Lin Feng, would have after witnessing the power of this big pervert, Shi Yu.
Soon, Shi Yu and the others arrived at Dong Huang. After Elder Gu Yun learned the origin of the Soul Pearl from President Lin, he handed this thing to Shi Yu in shock and fear, feeling that he had walked to the gates of hell.
“Elder Gu, thank you for your hard work.” Shi Yu took the Soul Pearl and felt that it was indeed cool of him. He had participated in an archeological Conference and easily obtained a top-notch divine remnant soul as a resource reward… Although no normal person regarded this thing as a reward…

chapters.title: Chapter 1270 - 1270 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (1)
chapters.content:
1270 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (1)
“Senior Dragon God, this thing… How should I deal with it? I’ll think of a way to get it out, and you’ll kill it?”
After leaving the Elder Gu Research Institute, Shi Yu floated in midair and asked the Senior Dragon God if she wanted to take revenge personally.
The Dragon God was silent. “Do you think I’m that guy’s match?”
Even if she believed that she was considered an expert in the first tier of demigods in the post-Blue Planet era, she still didn’t have the confidence to defeat a top-notch divine remnant soul that had mastered top-notch laws.
Shi Yu said, “I can beat the other party half to death first.”
“There’s no need,” the Dragon God said. “It’s enough to see it fall into your hands. I’m not that paranoid.”
“You should feed this guy to that undead too.”
If it fell into Shi Yu’s hands, it probably wouldn’t be able to survive. After confirming that the culprit who killed the Dragon Emperor was destined to die and wouldn’t be free outside, the knot in her heart had been untied.
Shi Yu was silent for a moment before saying, “Alright, then I’ll take care of this guy. Senior Dragon God, what are your plans next?”
The Dragon God looked at the sky and said, “Continue to increase your strength. Your strength is gradually surpassed by Wang Kong, Lin Feng, and you juniors. I also want to reach a higher domain to take a look.”
“Now, my greatest wish has been achieved, and Dragon Palace City has been handed to you. Dong Huang doesn’t need my protection either. Next, I can completely relax and cultivate wholeheartedly.”
“Don’t slack off either.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “By the way, Senior Dragon God, please keep the fact that I cracked the Space-Time Dragon Vein Ruins a secret for me. Just as you said, this might also be a forbidden ability in the universe.”
“I know.” The Dragon God smiled and said, “Thank you.”
“No, no. This is something I’ve long promised you, Senior Dragon God,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
At this moment, Emperor Wu, the empress, and the Dragon Emperor had already left. Shi Yu also felt a sense of loss. The more he understood the buried history, the more tired he became.
He was still short of the two dynasties…
Forget about the Space Emperor’s space and time. The Space Emperor was still alive, and he was living history. There was no need to explore. As for Emperor Shi… Although Shi Yu had learned a lot about the Emperor Shi Dynasty from the Ice Dragon, he still wanted to see this first-generation Legendary Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, the Legendary Beast Tamer with the highest evaluation in ancient history.
The premise was…
Emperor Shi was already dead.
Shi Yu looked at the ruins crystal he had obtained from the heroic spirit ruins that had been sealed in space for a long time. This thing… shouldn’t he use it to explore?
It was said that Emperor Shi had disappeared because he was exploring ruins.
And the ruins behind this ruin key were very likely to be the clue to Emperor Shi’s disappearance.
Now, there shouldn’t be any ruins on the Blue Planet that could stop him and put him in danger, right?
He was about to go into the universe. Returning consumed a lot of energy. Who knew when he would return? Shi Yu planned to take the time to see the origin of the ruins guided by the ruins crystal later so that he wouldn’t have any regrets.
…
Not long after separating from Senior Dragon God, Shi Yu directly headed to the place that resonated with the ruins crystal according to the location in his memory.
It was still an isolated island. Shi Yu discovered that many ruins spaces were on the ocean island. It was the same for the spatial ruins, and it was the same for the Mythical Ruins related to Emperor Shi.
“Wuu.”
At this moment, after descending on the isolated island, the six main pets surrounded Shi Yu and looked around cautiously. Shi Yu also held the ruins crystal that had been resonating and looked at the area with the strongest resonance fluctuations in front of him.
“What do you think it will be?” Shi Yu asked.
Some said that in order to pursue immortality and a higher realm to explore the Mythical Ruins, Emperor Shi was slapped to death by the sleeping divine beast inside.
Some said that Emperor Shi sensed that it was impossible to become a god in the current era and predicted the time of the Mythical Revival, so he found a good place and sealed himself, waiting for the opportunity to become a god.
Some people also said…
In short, there were various rumors about Emperor Shi’s disappearance, but in fact, Shi Yu felt that none of them were reliable. Under the suppression of the world’s laws, the strongest level was at the demigod level. With only the primary gods left on the Blue Planet, the strength of these divine beasts was limited. They didn’t look like they could kill Emperor Shi.
Even if it was a demigod at the level of the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul, Shi Yu felt that it couldn’t pose a threat to Emperor Shi.
After all, if the time element couldn’t defeat it, couldn’t it predict it and escape?
Of course, there was also a possibility that a bunch of divine beasts were sleeping in the Mythical Ruins. Then, it might still be a little dangerous for ordinary legendaries.
However, this possibility wasn’t high, because, after the Mythical Era ended, there weren’t many gods left. There were even fewer junior gods left on the Blue Planet, and there were very few who could survive until now. Half of them basically slept to death. The Earth Divine Dragon that was smashed to death by the meteorite in its sleep was a classic.
As for the rumors of Emperor Shi sealing himself, it was unlikely. He had worked so hard to establish the Dong Huang Dynasty, so how could he directly throw it down and seal himself without leaving any backup plans, causing the dynasty to be destroyed?
Of course, since someone raised this guess, they definitely gave a reasonable explanation. That was, the pile of things like the heroic spirit ruins were all backup plans left behind by Emperor Shi. Emperor Shi even predicted that even after the first generation of the Dong Huang Dynasty was destroyed, there would still be new legendaries like Emperor Wu, Empress, Dragon Emperor, and the Space Emperor who would rebuild Dong Huang and pass it down. Only then would they be at ease and seal themselves… If that was the case, they were too strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1271 - 1271 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (2)
chapters.content:
1271 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (2)
This was also a kind of explanation, but as for what the truth was, he might still have to explore it personally to know.
Shi Yu followed the method of using the ruins crystal and squeezed hard in the resonance area.
Pa.
The ruins crystal turned into powder. Right on the heels of that, a special frequency of spatial fluctuations came from inside. In an instant, with a boom, an air vibration sounded like the sound of thunder. Then, a special space gradually overlapped with the Blue Planet space!!
“Roar!!” Buggy roared and resisted the spatial vibration. Shi Yu looked at the surrounding spatial changes calmly. In the blink of an eye, space alternated, and they arrived at a blank world!
This completely blank world was very strange.
Until Shi Yu and the others saw an illusory figure slowly turning into a physical body.
It was a robust middle-aged man, dressed in a black and gold robe embroidered with the pattern of a soaring starry dragon. Beneath the surging golden waves at the hem of his robe, his sleeves billowed high in the wind. His arched eyebrows were raised in a confident manner, and his eyes below were like autumn water, like cold stars, like precious gems, sharp and compelling.
“Roar!” Eleven, Buggy, and the others growled as they looked at this figure.
Chi Tong and the other pets frowned slightly in disbelief.
Emperor Shi??
How was that possible?
How could Emperor Shi appear so easily?
Shi Yu also fell silent and looked at the man in front of him quietly.
“We meet again.” The man’s first words shocked Shi Yu, and he found them unbelievable.
“Emperor Shi,” Shi Yu said.
“Back then, when I was talking to General Mu Huiyin in front of the heroic spirit ruins, you crossed time to look at me from afar. I knew that we would meet again one day.” The middle-aged man smiled and laughed. “Junior, what’s your name?”
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu cupped his fists and said, “I’m Shi Yu, a Beast Tamer of Dong Huang from the future.”
“You actually cultivated Mu Huiyin’s bloodline heroic spirit to this extent. No matter which era it is, it’s extremely rare.” Emperor Shi’s gaze landed on Chi Tong, then on Eleven and the others, and he praised.
“However, that’s normal…”
“Senior Emperor Shi, your current state is…” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
He completely didn’t expect that Emperor Shi actually had self-awareness and had been here the whole time.
It was unbelievable.
“I know why you’re here,” Emperor Shi said. “This isn’t my main body. My main body is trapped in another ruin.”
“Back then, when I explored the ruins here, I was originally sufficiently prepared. I didn’t expect to still be trapped inside.”
“However, I’ve already calculated this outcome. Your appearance is a turning point for me to leave the ruins!”
Shi Yu took a deep breath.
He wondered if this was a scam by someone pretending to be the emperor.
For some reason, he suddenly recalled this deception and dispersed it.
No, the figure in front of him was definitely Emperor Shi.
Only he knew what had happened in the heroic spirit ruins.
Could it be that Emperor Shi could return?
He was going to revive Emperor Shi!
“Senior Emperor Shi, what can I do to help you?” Shi Yu asked.
“How’s the situation on the Blue Planet now? Can the mythical stage be revived?”
“Not yet, but soon. In a few years, the divine-level should be born and gradually unsealed.”
“Is that so… far from enough.”
Emperor Shi said, “After the Blue Planet’s Mythical Revival, help the Blue Planet increase the upper limit of its level again. My main body’s realm has already reached above the divine level, and I’m trapped in the ruins. Only by connecting to the Blue Planet in a stable spatial passage can I return.”
“The Blue Planet of the Mythical Era should be able to accommodate supreme gods like the Ancestral Dragon at the highest level, but life forms of a higher life level are helpless. Therefore, it still needs to take another step forward. Otherwise, I won’t be able to open the spatial passage.”
Shi Yu, Eleven, Buggy, and the others: ???
“???”
“Above the divine level?” Shi Yu said in shock, “Senior Emperor Shi, stop kidding me.”
Super divine level?
Emperor Shi looked at Shi Yu and said calmly, “The ruins I went to should have come from the last cosmic era. During the exploration process, I obtained the divine power inheritance, and my realm increased by two levels, exceeding the divine level, but I was trapped inside because of this.”
“You’re very special.”
“Your telepathy is very similar to the current me. You should have entered the ruins of the last cosmic era, right?”
“In the beginning, I only thought that you were a future archeological master, but from the looks of it, you’re not that simple. Your identity is more special than I imagined.”
“The listening talent derived from this telepathy is indeed more convenient for exploring ruins. I only underwent a qualitative change in telepathy after entering this ruin, and you should have had this telepathy at that time.”
Shi Yu fell silent.
What a joke!
So what Emperor Shi explored wasn’t some Mythical Ruins, but the cosmic ruins of the last era?
The fortuitous experience imagined by the disciple of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan, actually really happened to Emperor Shi?
As for what Emperor Shi said, it also confirmed Shi Yu’s guess a second time.
Earth should be the Blue Planet from the last cosmic era.
Not only did he transmigrate into space, but he might have also transmigrated into time, and it was an incomparably long time.
He had transmigrated to the end of the cosmic lifespan that all life forms in the universe thought was definitely impossible to resist.
This way, Shi Yu could understand the similarities between the Blue Planet and Earth. It was equivalent to two reincarnations.

chapters.title: Chapter 1272 - 1272 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (3)
chapters.content:
1272 Shi Yu and Emperor Shi’s Meeting (3)
Back then, the Taiji Ruins and the Green Dragon Ruins he explored on Earth…
From the current perspective, it was indeed an era’s ruins.
Emperor Shi nodded and said, “Looks like we’re all pretty lucky people. Alright, I don’t have much time.”
“According to the normal trajectory, I don’t know how long it will take for the Blue Planet to improve. In addition, the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era once encountered a huge calamity. If such a calamity appears again, the time I’m trapped here will be infinitely delayed.”
“After arriving here, I realized that the universe contains endless profundities. The divine level is only the beginning.”
“Next, I’ll teach you a method. It’s something I comprehended after breaking through to the divine level. It’s a telepathy skill specially used to crack ruins. There’s even a chance to peek at the ruins of the cosmic era. With it, I hope you can quickly become stronger and feed the Blue Planet.”
“If you can help me out within a hundred years, I’ll owe you three favors.”
“Three favors?”
“No… Your Majesty, your contribution to establishing the Dong Huang Dynasty spans thousands of years. As the Beast Tamer of Dong Huang, who benefited, it’s only right for me to help Your Majesty.” Shi Yu had a righteous expression and said, “Don’t worry, even if I risk my life, I’ll help the Blue Planet increase its level as soon as possible and build a stable spatial passage.”
Emperor Shi was silent.
The pets around Shi Yu were also very silent. As if they would believe him.
He was excited as hell inside.
Three favors from a super divine being…
After all, Zi Lan had said that there were less than 1,000 super divine beings in the entire universe.
Moreover, Emperor Shi was a time-element big boss. He was even impressive enough to crack the ruins of the era.
Three favors from him were enough for countless beings to fight over.
The Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the other experts who had left the Blue Planet originally wanted to help the Blue Planet increase its levels. Now, Shi Yu could be said to have done it with little effort.
In short, if he saved Emperor Shi, he would have a super backer. As long as he didn’t provoke those five cosmic monsters, he should be able to do whatever he wanted in the starry sky of the universe.
“Listen carefully…”
…
Although he didn’t know why Emperor Shi subconsciously equated “archeology of ruins” with “strengthening”, Shi Yu still liked the ruins cracking skill taught by Emperor Shi.
This was more likable to him than anything that could double his meditation speed.
Could it even crack the ruins of the cosmic era? This was simply the best gift before he left the Blue Planet and headed to the starry sky.
Ruins, your king is coming!
Emperor Shi didn’t dare be sloppy. He cultivated over and over again. He had never even meditated so seriously. Beside him, a pile of pets assisted Shi Yu. A few of them had already fainted from hunger and turned into energy-efficient forms to enter sleep mode.
After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu finally opened his eyes.
“I didn’t expect that this skill would also include the development methods of the Time Strengthening Talent and Space Strengthening Talent.”
“I haven’t had time to learn the spatial strengthening talent Zi Lan brought from the floating planet, but I learned it from Emperor Shi first.”
Among the 18 talent development skills brought by Zi Lan, only the spatial strengthening talent and the Fusion Talent were things Shi Yu planned to study when he was free…
Impressive.
After Shi Yu opened his eyes, his first thought was that Emperor Shi was too strong.
Not only did he crack the ruins of the cosmic era and become the first Blue Planet human suspected to have reached the super divine level, but he also broke through the restrictions of the Blue Planet humans and developed the self-study and teaching methods of the second and third talents.
In comparison, the talent of those extraterrestrial geniuses who could obtain talent cultivation methods didn’t look as terrifying as that of these native big shots on the Blue Planet.
“Wait, what’s going on?” After Shi Yu woke up, he suddenly realized that his first Beast Taming Space seemed to be very close to level nine.
“It should be the feedback from developing the mental talent, learning the spatial strengthening talent, and the time strengthening talent,” Ling said beside him.
“How long have I digested it?” Shi Yu looked at the environment of the surrounding isolated island and asked.
“About half a month has passed since Emperor Shi taught you the skill.”
“Half a month…” Shi Yu scratched his head. So long? Why did it feel like it had passed in the blink of an eye?
In his memories, he only kept asking Susu for memory water droplets and Baby Ginseng for the World Tree Fruit.
“Forget it, so be it. I feel that if I meditate for another two months, I have a chance of breaking through to the legendary level!” Shi Yu said.
“It can still be faster!!”
Ling said, “Your current Beast Taming Space has been strengthened by your talent. You already contracted a fifth demigod above your level. Hurry up and arrange for Baby Ginseng.”
“Most importantly, the children are about to faint from hunger. In order to look after you, Buggy and the others didn’t go to Dragon Palace City to freeload. They relied on Susu and Baby Ginseng to provide food for half a month! And after Baby Ginseng breaks through, it can bid farewell to the famine!”
Shi Yu was stunned. He scratched his head and said, “I understand, I understand. If you’re hungry, go find food yourselves. Don’t always wait for me to bring you to eat. You’re not young anymore. It’s time to learn to be guests of other demigod factions.”
“But I feel that my mental state is pretty good.”
Ling : “…”
Yes, the entire team had been taking care of him for the past half a month.
It was like taking care of a vegetative person.
“Where’s Baby Ginseng? Hurry up and call Baby Ginseng to break through.” Shi Yu immediately got up and said, “World Tree Domain, Time Strengthening Talent, additional points, and skill fuse! This time, let’s see how far it can reach.”
“Yi…” In the team, Eleven and Buggy were the easiest to starve, and Baby Ginseng and Susu were the least likely to starve, regardless of nutritional value.
Susu had the Blue Sea Contract and unlimited energy, while Baby Ginseng could maintain its livelihood by photosynthesis and drinking water. With Susu, a supplier who could casually condense Level 9 water-element energy crystals, it was very easy to fill its stomach. It only needed them to spend more time each.
Therefore, now, Baby Ginseng’s vitality wasn’t bad, unlike Eleven and Buggy, who had rolled off to sleep.
“Call everyone out.” When Shi Yu called out, he looked at the jumping ginseng baby.
“Yiya!! (Wu wu wu, it’s finally my turn.)” Baby Ginseng cried excitedly. Ling silently gathered its tears beside it.
It could be food for Duckie.
[Race Skill]
“Super”: Time Mark (Perfect+47), Moon Explosion (Perfect+47), Life Fire Seed (Perfect+47), World Tree Fruit (Perfect+47), Green Wood Divine Body (Perfect+47), Sun Forest (Perfect+47), Plant Control (Perfect+47), Soul Fruit (Perfect+47)
At the same time, Shi Yu looked at Baby Ginseng’s super Skill.
“Well…”
“According to Buggy’s experience last time, if I fuse a few skills…”
“It’s very likely that you’ll become the first guy in the team to have two quasi-divine skills. You’re invincible. Come, I’ll add points to transcendent first and see which skills have a high fusion!” As Shi Yu finished speaking, Eleven, Buggy, and the others also woke up and were immediately not sleepy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1273 - 1273 Demigod-level Chef (1)
chapters.content:
1273 Demigod-level Chef (1)
“Yiya, Yiya, Yiya!”
Baby Ginseng shouted the slogan and stood on Shi Yu’s shoulder.
Shi Yu flew on the ocean, far from the island just now.
Because Baby Ginseng would definitely freeload a lot of the power of the world this time, it was better to stay away from that side.
Emperor Shi had just asked him to increase the power of the world on Blue Planet, but he had turned around and drained the power of the world over there. It was a little disrespectful to his seniors.
“This is the place.” In the end, Shi Yu casually found a mythical, mystic realm on the ocean.
This should be the former residence and habitat of the creatures from the Mythical Era.
From the traces, no creature had lived here for many years.
If it were in the past, it would definitely not have been so easy for Shi Yu to find the ruins of the mystic realm and enter the Mythical Ruins. However, after learning Emperor Shi’s special telepathy skill, Shi Yu was now a ruins radar and walking key.
Shi Yu named this technique “Telepathy: Passage of Time” talent.
No wonder Emperor Shi thought that if he learned this skill, he could become stronger faster. He definitely could.
For example, although there were no physical resources in this ruin, the accumulated natural energy strength was many times stronger than in the outside world, comparable to a treasure land like Dragon Palace City.
Although it wasn’t as big as Dragon Palace City, there were many benefits for Shi Yu to casually use such an ownerless place.
For example, if Baby Ginseng evolved next, it would definitely consume a large amount of the natural power of the world. If Shi Yu and the others broke through in Dong Huang, they would definitely instantly turn a city into a desolate city, but if it was here, there was no problem.
“Open!”
After Shi Yu pried open this mythical residence, Baby Ginseng immediately took root on the ground inside.
Eleven, Buggy, Duckie, and the others followed behind and cheered for Baby Ginseng. Whether the team could eat their fill in the future depended on Baby Ginseng this time!
Demigod-level chef, charge.
“Yiya! (Noisy!)” Baby Ginseng exploded in anger.
It didn’t break through to become a chef.
It wanted to be the boss of the team!
“Come on.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Baby Ginseng turned around and put on its intelligent doctorate hat. It took a deep breath and connected to the power of the ground.
Its Green Wood Divine Body could mutate and multiply. It could perfectly absorb the natural power of the earth to grow and carry the source of life. It could be said to be its basic physique skill as a divine-level supplement.
Apart from that, its quasi-divine skill, the world, could mobilize the power of the world. The power of the world was the source of a world and could evolve into all the natural power possessed by this world. It was equivalent to a perfect skill to mobilize the natural power of the world.
In a place where natural energy was desolate, other overlords might not be able to mobilize natural power at all, but Baby Ginseng was different. It could directly ignore distance through this skill and mobilize natural power from all over the world.
Logically speaking, with this skill, it should be easier for Baby Ginseng to freeload natural energy than for Susu.
However, it couldn’t help it. The favor of the world consumed much more energy than the use of the Blue Sea Contract, and its level was lower than Susu. This caused it to constantly drag down the freeloading progress, and the time cost it had to pay was too high.
Sometimes, it might only be possible to feed Eleven after working for a day.
However, when it reached the totem level, everything would be solved.
In the ruins, Baby Ginseng turned into the main body of the World Ginseng, a towering divine tree.
Shi Yu also activated talents like the World Tree Domain and Psychic Resonance to assist Baby Ginseng in breaking through.
The fusion of the shadow of the World Tree and the World Ginseng made its efficiency of freeloading the power of the world a little faster. However, this wasn’t the main thing. The main thing was to increase points.
With the support of the various pets, Shi Yu first added some time marks to Baby Ginseng. A halo enveloped the divine tree. With the power of Shi Yu’s points, the time mark with the highest proficiency at the perfect level directly reached transcendence!
At this moment, the maximum number of time marks that could be condensed was “1”. Soon, it’d be “2”!
In other words, Baby Ginseng could finally condense two time marks and revive twice.
If it didn’t encounter an enemy that could even obliterate the skill effect, he would be simply invincible.
“Yi!” On the divine tree, Baby Ginseng’s clone was extremely surprised.
In the next moment, the World Tree Fruit… transcended to a transcendent-level World Tree Fruit. Its ability to increase comprehension was even stronger. If it was said that it only increased comprehension at the last minute, it could completely increase comprehension and learning ability permanently now.
Of course, there was also an upper limit, but it was absolutely no problem to turn a mediocre person into a genius. After eating it, no matter how stupid the eater was, as long as he was willing to work hard, he could basically train the super racial skill to perfection and advance to an overlord in their lifetime.
Then, the Soul Fruit also reached transcendence!
This skill was Chi Tong’s favorite because it could increase the soul power of the enhancement.
If the Soul Fruit was cultivated into a divine skill, it could even create a divine-level resource, the Undying Fruit, allowing the eater to live a second life in the form of an undead life form.
As for the current transcendence stage, it was alright. The main thing was to increase the effect of repairing the soul. Even if it was beaten into a remnant soul, as long as it was used enough, it could recover into a perfect soul.
It was equivalent to saying that if a person was torn into pieces and their body shattered into pieces, they could still be saved. It should be the most beloved resource of the World Annihilation Dragon’s remnant soul…
Physical, spiritual, and soul restorations were each more difficult than the other. Baby Ginseng was an expert in the former, but now, its shortcomings had finally been made up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1274 - 1274 Demigod-level Chef (2)
chapters.content:
1274 Demigod-level Chef (2)
Right on the heels of that… Moon Explosion, Life Fire Seed, Sun Forest, Green Wood Divine Body, Plant Control, and Baby Ginseng’s pile of super skills were pulled to transcendence by Shi Yu. Beside him, Baby Ginseng’s clone, Baby Ginseng Phantom, who was in charge of nourishing Shi Yu, looked at it gradually becoming stronger with surprise and envy.
This wasn’t the end…
Skill: Moon Explosion, Fire Seed of Life, Sun Forest
[Fusion success rate]: Low
[Fusion Risk]: High
In the end, Shi Yu chose three skills from Baby Ginseng’s pile that weren’t that “big” and fused them.
However, although this was the one with the highest success rate of fusion among Baby Ginseng’s pile of skills, the consumption was still very terrifying. After all, Shi Yu’s current physique was comparable to a normal totem, but after starting to fuse, his vision, hearing, and body still quickly decreased, and his body became stiff… His skin began to shrink, crack, and wrinkle, and his black hair turned pale. Be it his energy or life force, they quickly fell.
Even his soul began to blur.
Especially this time, without Baby Ginseng’s main body in charge of healing crazily, the pressure on Shi Yu was even greater without the support of a healer. However, he still went all out. Under the encouragement of Ling, Susu, and the other pets, he saw the light of success in his gradually dizzy consciousness.
Boom…
At this moment, as Baby Ginseng broke through, all the natural power of the Mythical Ruins was drained by it and turned into Desolate Ruins. At the same time, outside the ruins, the light of the sun and moon seemed to be even stronger. Even in some places during the day, they could see the grand occasion of the sun and moon shining together.
In an ocean not far from the place where Shi Yu and the others broke through, a totem-level life form left the sea and stared at the sky in surprise!!
“This is… is a new demigod born?”
“It can actually plunder the power of the sun and moon at such a speed. Who exactly is it? Why don’t I have any impression of it at all? No… Perhaps it’s the revival of a god who mainly cultivates the power of the sun and moon!”
“What a fast absorption speed.” On the other side, the demigod Lord Genesis Tree God of the Origin Land looked at the speed at which the power of the sun was absorbed and at the Sun Torrent between the sun and the Blue Planet with a shocked expression. If it had such a speed to absorb the power of the sun, would it still need to rely on sleep to offset the consumption?
Who exactly was it?
Baby Ginseng’s skill fusion this time was undoubtedly fused with the power of the sun and moon. Because it was a breakthrough on the Blue Planet, the starry sky phenomenon caused by it wasn’t covered, so many experts sensed it.
Angel man, female succubus…
The group of outsiders also looked at the sky in surprise.
“It looks like a pretty okay life form has also been born on the Blue Planet.”
It was as if even they, who had high horizons, acknowledged this skill.
“Success!!”
In the Mythical Ruins of Desolate, Shi Yu spoke with a shriveled mouth. His wrinkled face condensed into a chrysanthemum shape with a happy expression, and his eyes were green.
Eleven and the other pets were also moved.
The most excited was still Baby Ginseng, who had successfully reached the demigod level.
Breaking through was secondary. It casually broke through from the overlord level to the totem level.
But the key was the new skill brought by the skill fusion!
[Moon Explosion, Fire of Life, Sun Forest] had already fused into [Sun and Moon Brilliance].
Skill: Sun and Moon Brilliance
[Level]: Quasi God-level
<Introduction> The Fire of Sun is born in the body of the Fire of Moon. It can automatically absorb the Sun and Moon Essence to store them in the body.
The Sun and Moon Essence could be converted into the energy needed for life activity, or it could become a fire seed that detonated life force.
When detonated, it could maximize the mobilization of the laws of the sun and moon, producing the phenomenon of the sun and moon shining together!
“A passive restoration-type divine skill that can self-destruct!!” The moment he saw this skill, Shi Yu felt that the luck of the Kirin Race had been inherited by Ling.
Then it was shared with him.
What he lacked came.
A passive skill to absorb the power of the sun and moon and transform it into its own energy?
This was simply easier than Susu’s Blue Sea Contract.
After all, Susu had to take the initiative to mobilize that. It would take a lot of time to mobilize too much energy.
However, this fire seed that automatically absorbed the power of the sun and moon not only saved time cost, but also greatly increased the endurance of the ginseng baby!
Moreover, it was a quasi-divine-level Passive Restoration skill. This meant that the Restoration Effect would definitely not be bad. At that time, with the kindness of the world, at least the food for the team would be completely free.
Apart from that, the self-destruction of a quasi-god directly raised Baby Ginseng’s battle power to an unbelievable level.
Perhaps it really had hope of getting the first clear of killing a god in the team.
Unfortunately, this skill was the same as the kindness of the world. The restriction was a little big. The kindness of the world could only be used in the body of a world life form. For example, on the Blue Planet, in Little Zi’s body, in the Creation Domain, and on the World King Star…
