As for the Sun and Moon shining together, if the power of the sun and moon stored in the body was used up, it could only display the effect in places with the sun and moon.
Fortunately, there were similar stars and moons in most places in the starry sky of the universe.
Such planets were also very important. They were the cosmic resources that many life planets, like the Blue Planet, needed to rely on. For example, after the laws of the Blue Planet were shattered, maintaining the operation of the planet mainly relied on the power of the stars in the universe.
However, in the mouths of aliens like Zi Lan, the sun and moon in the galaxy, where the Blue Planet was, were relatively ordinary. In the universe, there were also a small number of stars that gave birth to autonomy. Because their energy was so huge, after evolution was successful, they basically had the power of super divine. The super divine level was also known as the radiant sun level. This was how it came about.

chapters.title: Chapter 1275 - 1275 Demigod-level Chef (3)
chapters.content:
1275 Demigod-level Chef (3)
Even the cosmic behemoths that ate planets didn’t dare provoke such stellar life forms easily.
“Yi!!!” At this moment, as Baby Ginseng broke through to the demigod level, it felt so good.
Especially its control over the World Grace Skill, which was even stronger.
It turned out that Baby Ginseng’s use of the world was equivalent to a primary school ginseng running to ask its mother for 100 yuan and having to help do housework. It was happy, but not completely.
And now, the graduated ginseng had directly inherited a portion of the family’s assets. Even if it worked a little, compared to the huge gains, the cost-effective ratio was undoubtedly very high.
“Yiya!!! (Watch me!)” Under Baby Ginseng’s happy cry, it directly controlled a Crowd Control vine to tie Shi Yu up. The natural power of plants from all over the Blue Planet was mobilized by Baby Ginseng and converted into life force.
Through contact, these vines continuously transmitted life force to Shi Yu. In the blink of an eye, Shi Yu’s extremely weak and enfeebled body immediately recovered its strength. His pale hair gradually turned black, and his shriveled skin returned to normal.
After completing all of this, Baby Ginseng was a little panty. It was mainly because it had just accepted the skill fusion, and it was also very tiring. Fortunately, Susu had been watering it with the Sea Cleansing Spirit. Otherwise, it and Shi Yu would probably find it very difficult to withstand.
However, it was rare for it to evolve. In order to let everyone see how powerful it was, after healing Shi Yu, Baby Ginseng continued to mobilize the kindness of the world. It passively took the initiative to accelerate the absorption of the power of the sun and moon and condense a new fruit!
Although he said he didn’t want to be a chef, his body was still very honest.
The power of the world turned into metal-element power. A legendary Iron Bamboo grew in front of Eleven, stunning it.
“Wuu!! (As expected of you!!)” Eleven expressed its love and directly pulled it out.
On the huge ginseng tree, legendary spatial fruits, Sun Fruits, Earth Fruits, and Wind Fruits condensed one by one.
It was handed to Buggy, Chi Tong, Little Ji, and Ling through the vines.
It was a mass production of legendary resources!
Once beyond reach, the legendary resources that Shi Yu once aspired to acquire were now within reach for Baby Ginseng, who could now utilize the power of the Blue Planet to mass-produce them!
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng stood on the tree with its hands on its hips. However, its breathing became even heavier, and its body began to shrivel. It quickly treated itself.
“Not bad.” Shi Yu smiled.
But at this moment, Susu looked at its teammates eating food. A big question mark appeared on its head, and it looked at Baby Ginseng.
“Ning!! Ning!!” Susu protested. Where’s my food?
“Quack!! Duck!!!” Duckie also protested. Where’s my food?
It suspected that the towering emperor was targeting Big Sister and it.
“Yiya!” Baby Ginseng looked at Susu and Duckie and was slightly stunned.
“Yi! (Susu, aren’t you infinitely energetic? I’m a little tired now. I’ll definitely do it tomorrow! In order to thank you for your help, I’ll prepare a custom-made meal tomorrow!)”
Susu puffed up its face.
“Quack!!! (What about me?)” Duckie was anxious. Could it be that it wanted Big Sister Susu to take care of its meals again? Duckie originally thought that after Baby Ginseng became a demigod, it could change chefs.
Susu was indeed in charge of its ordinary meals. However, Susu always liked to add ingredients to the duck’s water-element crystal, such as adding some cleansing power to turn it into a cleansing crystal. It wasn’t very suitable for the Abyss Duck’s taste.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng pointed at Ling and saw Ling directly hand the tears of the ginseng baby it had gathered previously to Duckie.
Duckie: “?”
“Alright, from the current situation, it shouldn’t be a problem for the entire team to be full in the future.” Shi Yu smiled. Although he had been treated at the moment, the aftermath had yet to recover. After all, the burden of contracting so many pets above his level was also present, and he needed to gradually adapt. He said tiredly, “Let’s go back.”
“I’ve been out for so long, but I haven’t told Dong Huang about Emperor Shi.”
“When they know, they’ll definitely be very excited.”
“I’ll go back and rest for two days before continuing to add points.”
“Wu wu wu!!!” At this moment, Eleven, who was nibbling on bamboo, looked at Shi Yu and raised its head slightly.
“Wu wu! (Shi Yu, Shi Yu, didn’t you agree previously to explore the Time Emperor Ruins with Senior Lu? Why did you explore it alone?)”
Shi Yu was just about to leave when he was stunned.
He recalled the night he obtained the ruins crystal and didn’t know what it was. Then, Senior Lu came over to explain and agreed to explore the Time Emperor Ruins together…
Shi Yu’s heart skipped a beat. He looked at Eleven and said, “Why didn’t you remind me earlier?”
Eleven felt aggrieved. “Wu wu wu! (Isn’t this Ling’s job?)”
Ling frowned, indicating that it didn’t want to take the blame. “I wasn’t born at that time, alright?”
Shi Yu said in amusement, “Forget it, I’m just kidding. There’s no need to remind me. I remember it clearly. However, I was worried that the ruins would be dangerous, so I deliberately didn’t call Senior Lu.”
The pets looked doubtful, while Susu’s heart ached for its memory water drop. Why was Shi Yu’s memory still so poor after giving it to Shi Yu? Could it be the after-effect of adding points? Indeed… as he got older, it was easy for his memory to decline.
“Yi! (It’s time to nourish!)” Baby Ginseng waved. It looked like it felt like it could do it again.
…
Shi Yu and the others returned to Dong Huang again. During this period of time, nothing big happened. It was just that the seven Inatella gods, Zi Lan, and the Phoenix man were in Dong Huang. Dong Huang really couldn’t afford to entertain them.
This group of people also knew, so they only used Dong Huang as a resting place. After eating a few meals and dealing with their own matters, they fell asleep one by one and waited for the World Tree to be completed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1276 - 1276 Demigod-level Chef (4)
chapters.content:
1276 Demigod-level Chef (4)
On the other hand, the angel man and the female succubus were very active in the west. At the moment, the demigod-level and awakened gods of the Blue Planet already knew that an extraterrestrial life form had descended and of the existence of an extraterrestrial civilization. For example, the angels and demons of the Blue Planet had already joined the other party.
Through them, the various factions knew even more clearly that Dong Huang wasn’t to be trifled with. After all, the combination of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng was comparable to a super divine. This caused Dong Huang to become a unique existence on the Blue Planet.
In the Blue Planet Alliance, Dong Huang’s right to speak had also increased to the maximum.
This was the opposite of the universe. In the universe, there was also a Blue Planet Alliance formed by the five major god races of the Blue Planet, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng’s faction, the Floating Planet. However, among them, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng’s faction were the smallest and newest…
After returning to Dong Huang, Shi Yu directly pulled up an online meeting through Ling and invited Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and Lu Qingyi.
The matter of Emperor Shi was very important, and it wasn’t appropriate for too many people to know. Shi Yu only called the two leaders of Dong Huang and Senior Lu to let Senior Lu know about Emperor Shi. He didn’t bring her to explore the ruins to make up for it…
“Shi Yu? What’s the matter? Has the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon been resolved?” After Shi Yu returned, President Lin immediately asked.
They thought that Shi Yu had gone to deal with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon in the past half a month of “seclusion”.
Shi Yu said, “No, I haven’t paid attention to that dragon.”
“By the way, I don’t think I’ve reported this before… It’s been very long. Senior Lu, do you remember when I explored the heroic spirit ruins in the Ancient Capital’s Undead Battlefield and obtained a ruin crystal?”
Lu Qingyi was originally puzzled as to why Shi Yu had pulled her into such a high-level meeting, but after hearing Shi Yu’s words, she immediately remembered.
“I remember!”
“Yes, when I was exploring the heroic spirit ruins, I heard the Voice of History. Then, I saw the communication scene between Emperor Shi and Mu Huiyin. Right on the heels of that, Emperor Shi saw me through the River of Time!”
“Moreover, he threw out a ruin crystal from the heroic spirit ruins.”
“What!!!” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Divine Source Legendary and President Lin widened their eyes.
“Don’t be afraid of what I’m going to say next,” Shi Yu said. “Emperor Shi is actually still alive. I followed the hint of that crystal to explore Emperor Shi’s ruins.”
“Then I saw the phantom left behind by Emperor Shi.”
“What?!!” After Shi Yu finished speaking, Divine Source Legendary, President Lin, and Lu Qingyi widened their eyes. Through the screen, Shi Yu’s ears rang.
“Cough, the problem now is that Emperor Shi is trapped in the ruins and can’t come out. He needs our help,” Shi Yu said.
“Save! We have to save Emperor Shi no matter what.” Divine Source Legendary immediately shouted. The emperor he respected the most was Emperor Shi.
“Let me finish… This isn’t something Dong Huang can afford to save by itself.” Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu told the few of them that Emperor Shi had already broken through to the super divine level and was trapped in the ruins of the cosmic era. At this moment, the three of them were already stunned.
Everyone was stunned, their hearts still beating crazily.
They originally thought that it was the greatest surprise that the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were still alive. Who would have thought that Emperor Shi was still alive and that he was the one who was doing the best among the five emperors of Dong Huang?
Shi Yu, this kid, got a super divine level senior?!!
Ridiculous!
Shi Yu also sighed with emotion. From the looks of it, in this space and time, among the seven legends of Dong Huang, only Emperor Wu, the empress, and the Dragon Emperor had died.
“I hope they can… do better in parallel space.” Shi Yu prayed in his heart.
Next, Shi Yu communicated with Divine Source Legendary and the others about Emperor Shi. Then, with the excuse of dealing with the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon, he hung up the meeting.
Just as the meeting ended, Shi Yu hurriedly sent Senior Lu a private message.
“Sorry, Senior Lu. I promised you to explore together previously, but after all, it’s a ruin that might have caused Emperor Shi to disappear. I was worried that there was danger, so I didn’t call you.”
Lu Qingyi: Fist.jpg
Shi Yu scratched his cheek. It looked like he didn’t mind. Alright, let’s recuperate first!!
…
Next, Shi Yu returned to Ping Cheng. After recuperating, he continued cultivating.
He first used a large number of transcendent-level World Tree Fruits to increase his enhancement learning ability. He spent 11 days developing his spatial strengthening talent to Level 8.
As for the time-strengthening talent, it was a little difficult to develop. At the moment, it was still at Level 5, so Shi Yu wasn’t in a hurry.
After his spatial strengthening talent reached Level 8, Shi Yu’s spatial strength increased a little more. Shi Yu began to boldly add points to Little Zi. He originally wanted Ling to break through to the demigod level first, according to the order of entry, but Ling said that the cost-effective ratio was too low.
Little Zi’s breakthrough should be able to directly lead Shi Yu’s first Beast Taming Space to the legendary level. It was better to let Little Zi do it first.
Right on the heels of that, Shi Yu reached the legendary level. At that time, it and Qi could also break through to the demigod level.
Even at that time, he could let Little Ji and Duckie breakthrough in the second Beast Taming Space.
It saved time and effort.
After a moment of silence, Shi Yu expressed that he liked rational people like Ling.
“Add points, add points, add points…” Shi Yu began to add the last points to Little Zi.
Accompanied by the purple light of points.
The power of the world, transcendence! The inner world, transcendence! World Blessing, transcendence!
Boom!!
A vast star-like power bloomed from Little Zi’s body. Its life level immediately reached the totem level.
At the same time.
The moment Little Zi broke through, the shackles of Shi Yu’s first Beast Taming Space finally loosened. He didn’t rely on meditation much and directly relied on constantly adding points to let his pets give feedback to complete the breakthrough.
The red spatial crystal wall completely turned golden. The upper limit of the Beast Taming level immediately increased. Shi Yu’s physique even directly obtained legendary strengthening!
Shi Yu had reached the legendary level!

chapters.title: Chapter 1277 - 1277 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (1)
chapters.content:
1277 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (1)
Legendary level.
It was very symbolic.
In the starry sky of the universe, it might only be as simple as Level 9 of the Beast Taming System.
However, in the world of the Blue Planet, where the highest was only Level 9, it was just like the name given to it by the Blue Planet. It was an epic expert who could leave its name even after thousands or ten thousand years.
The Beast Taming Space could basically accommodate nine totem-level creatures!
One person was an army of totems.
In the 2500 years of Dong Huang’s history, there were only seven Legendary Beast Tamers. This was still a testable country that had produced the most Legendary Beast Tamers.
And now, Shi Yu had transmigrated to the Beast Taming World. In nearly four years, he had finally reached this level with his shocking growth speed.
Three years, legendary level!
Ice Dragon Snow Mountain, Shi Yu, and the others’ backyard.
Shi Yu held a world of stars in his hand. The light of advancement lingered between the two parties.
Little Zi’s breakthrough halo seemed to have dyed the sky into a milky way, dazzling and resplendent. Golden light spread from Shi Yu’s body, dazzling.
“Sob.” Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, and Qi surrounded the icy plain and looked at Shi Yu, who was breaking through, with shining eyes.
At this moment, the small world represented by Shi Yu’s first Beast Taming Space seemed to have evolved. Its size suddenly increased, and a large amount of natural power surged in, changing the world here.
As contracted pets of the first Beast Taming Space, Eleven and the others enjoyed the feedback of Shi Yu’s breakthrough almost instantly.
In the past few days, as Baby Ginseng broke through, the food crisis on the team had already eased a lot.
The reason why Eleven and the others were hungry wasn’t only because they were too strong and had too much activity, but also because of Shi Yu. Because his contract was above their level and spatial level, it wasn’t enough to support the growth of so many pets.
But now, as Shi Yu broke through, Shi Yu’s Beast Taming Space immediately became like a world-favored skill. It crazily extracted the nutrients from the outside world and converted them into special nutrients to provide to pets.
This was only the most basic change. Apart from that, on the basis of their original strength, Eleven and the others instantly sensed that they had been strengthened. There was comprehensive feedback, and the quality of their various stats increased by 5 to 10%.
This time, it was Shi Yu’s upgrade that led to the growth of the pets.
Beast Tamers and pets had always provided feedback to each other and improved together.
“Wuuu!!!” As Shi Yu broke through, Eleven and the others celebrated happily. Little Ji and Duckie high-fived each other, and Duckie was sent flying, cursing Little Ji for being sinister.
At this moment, Shi Yu was still immersed in the breakthrough and had yet to enjoy the full benefits of the breakthrough.
Body… Spirit… Soul…
Shi Yu had also broken through the bottleneck and reached a new realm after breaking through.
Physical strength, spirit power, soul power… They had all reached the standard of the totem level. Coupled with skills like spiritual power and the Taiji Domain, it was no longer a problem to fight a totem being alone.
Perhaps when it reached the pinnacle of this level, it could be invincible below the demigod level. If it learned the high-level battle skills in the universe and let the second Beast Taming Space develop, it might also be considered to have demigod battle power.
Shi Yu’s battle power was almost catching up to his pets. Although humans weren’t suitable for cultivation, they couldn’t withstand his unique conditions.
Of course, this was still not what Shi Yu was most concerned about. He was most concerned about the change in his Beast Taming Talent!
The increase in the Beast Taming Space would automatically increase the original Beast Taming Talent by a level.
When Shi Yu’s first Beast Taming Space reached Level 9, the accompanying telepathy and skill index would be upgraded.
As for the spatial and time-strengthening talent of physical control and subsequent learning, the former had to follow the level of the second Beast Taming Space, while the latter could only be developed by oneself and couldn’t enjoy the benefits of leveling up.
[The telepathy effect has indeed increased.] Shi Yu closed his eyes and immediately sensed that the greatest range of telepathy had already reached the transnational level.
The range was half of the Blue Planet!
Even if the contracted pet was half as far away from it as the Blue Planet, both parties could still maintain telepathy and communicate. At the same time, they also had special abilities that could help other lives build a mental connection!
For example, if an ordinary person who couldn’t communicate telepathically wanted to communicate with a few beasts who couldn’t talk or communicate telepathically, Shi Yu was completely capable of establishing a telepathy connection for the two of them and letting them communicate normally for a certain period of time.
Apart from that, Taiji, the Green Dragon, the World Tree, and the resonance skills also upgraded as the telepathy leveled up.
Unfortunately, the Passage of Time skill required time and the support of spatial strengthening talent. The increase wasn’t especially big.
On the other hand, the skill index finally produced a new qualitative change after no qualitative upgrade twice.
Apart from the new page count that Shi Yu no longer cared about, an additional page appeared in the skill index, and a compass-like pattern appeared.
What was this?
With the precedent of the previous skill fusion furnace, Shi Yu immediately became excited and probed carefully.
Then, he was rather shocked.
[Skill Deduction]
<Introduction> It can assist contracted pets in developing new skills by confirming the effect of the skill. It can reduce the learning method of this skill. The stronger the skill deduced, the greater the consumption of the Beast Tamer.
Shi Yu was shocked. He was originally hesitating, but as he tried, he immediately confirmed the horror of this ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 1278 - 1278 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (2)
chapters.content:
1278 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (2)
As everyone knew, after reaching the totem level, transcendent life forms could independently optimize and transform taught skills into racial skills, enhance these racial skills, and even autonomously develop new skills as needed.
And this skill deduction was the ability to assist Beast Tamers in helping their pets develop new skills on their own.
[Contract Pet]: Baby Ginseng
[Skill Effect]: It can create a special medicine that can turn females into males and males into females, and it’s permanently irreversible.
Shi Yu tried to conceptualize a new Skill. Then, the Skill Deduction Compass immediately spun.
[Deduction success rate]: Low
[Deduction Risk]: High
[Do you want to continue deducing?]
Shi Yu was stunned and gave up on deducing. It was useless for him to let his pet learn this skill.
Such a trashy skill had huge risks?
Perhaps the irreversible effect was more important.
However, would such a skill definitely kill Senior Lin Feng?
Shi Yu shook his head and continued to let his imagination run wild.
[Contract Pet]: Baby Ginseng
[Skill Effect]: Space-Time Travel.
[Deduction success rate]: 0
Shi Yu: “?”
[Skill Effect]: It can create a special fruit that can allow the user to automatically meditate and cultivate without any burden when sleeping after eating it to increase the level of the Beast Tamer.
[Deduction success rate]: Extremely low
[Deduction Risk]: Extremely high
“Is that necessary! Why is it more difficult than adding some quasi-divine skills?” Shi Yu was rather dissatisfied when he saw this.
However, after thinking about it again, Shi Yu understood.
He and his pet bore the burden of adding points to super skills and fusing skills.
And this skill deduction was completely borne by him, so the difficulty… might be greater.
However, at this moment, Shi Yu was still completely obsessed. He felt that this was a peerless good thing.
It was more convenient to train pets.
He could actually customize the skill effect and deduce the skill learning method of this Effect. This way, although it might be more troublesome than replicating other people’s skills, the advantage was that he had one more choice. As long as the teaching method given required conditions that he had never heard of, it was fine.
“The skill index is actually so powerful.” Shi Yu fell into deep thought. If Earth was really Blue Planet from the last era and he was really from the last era, would the skill index also be some treasure he had brought from the last era? Would it be similar to the Taiji Domain and the Green Dragon Domain?
“Wu wu wu, wu wu wu.”
In the outside world, Eleven and the others were already anxious.
Shi Yu’s breakthrough fluctuations had long stopped.
However, Shi Yu was still there with his eyes closed, his expression changing extremely richly.
Be it the totem Little Zi that Shi Yu was holding, or Eleven and the others who had surrounded him, they looked at Shi Yu in confusion.
Finally, Eleven couldn’t help but call out to Shi Yu before waking him up from the trial segment.
Shi Yu slowly opened his eyes and looked at the pets surrounding him. The corners of his mouth subconsciously curled up. “I have good news for you.”
“For example, the success rate of adding points to super skills has already reached an extremely high level. Do you understand what I mean? The super skill has been upgraded to Dao Proficiency. Then, under the development of your own race, it’s a quasi-divine skill. It’s not very difficult to develop the support of Baby Ginseng’s fruit. In other words, the era of seven or eight quasi-divine skills is about to come!!”
“The pets of those alien Beast Tamers have a bunch of quasi-divine skills. You guys can do it next!”
“Cheers, little ones!!”
Eleven and the others looked at each other and were overjoyed.
This was a Legendary Beast Tamer!!!
Great!!
“Wuuu!!!” The pets cheered excitedly, excited to the extreme. Eleven took the lead to cheer because it had the most super skills.
“Apart from that, the success rate of adding points to quasi-divine skills has also greatly increased. For example, Eleven, the success rate of your Yin Yang Millstone has gone from extremely low to low. It shouldn’t be that difficult to withstand.”
“For example, Chi Tong’s Immortal Slaying Sword Formation and Ling’s Blessing Wind have even reached the middle success rate of adding points. It’s not difficult to add points to near perfection.”
However, at the side, Little Ji and Duckie cried silently for some reason. They understood that their skills were trash and they weren’t worthy.
Shi Yu smiled and felt that the legendary level was really good. It was actually so easy to even add some quasi-divine skills. For example, Little Ji’s Cataclysm, Duckie’s Heart of the Abyss, and Baby Ginseng’s World Grace were easier to add. The success rate was pretty good!
Shi Yu thought for a moment. He would definitely prioritize giving Baby Ginseng the World Grace. This was the most cost-effective ratio.
As for why the skill World Grace was so easy to allocate points to, Shi Yu speculated that it was likely related to its nature. Only when the current world’s will permitted, could it use World Grace to mobilize the power of the world. If the world’s will didn’t allow it, then this skill would be useless.
When he arrived at the World King Planet, Shi Yu estimated that this skill couldn’t be used anymore. After all, the World King Planet was a cosmic life form. Even if the World Grace advanced to a divine skill and became a transcendent-level divine skill, it probably couldn’t forcefully plunder the power of the World King Planet. Instead, it would be slapped to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1279 - 1279 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (3)
chapters.content:
1279 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (3)
However, once its proficiency was high, it should be quite useful to go to those low-level planets.
At that time, it wouldn’t be the world’s bestowal upon Baby Ginseng, but Baby Ginseng bestowing its power upon them!
“Well, the success rate of the fusion of super skills has also improved. I’ll think about it. Now, let’s break through for Ling first.”
Shi Yu rubbed Little Zi, who had changed shape due to his pinching. He smiled and said, “Little Zi, your body has also evolved and upgraded, right?”
“Mi!!” Little Zi nodded heavily.
It was about to be a low-level planet.
In the starry sky of the universe, planets were divided into four levels. Low-level planets, intermediate-level planets, high-level planets, and super planets.
They corresponded to the totem demigod level, divine level, super divine level, and cosmic level.
At the moment, Little Zi was about to approach the standard of a low-level planet. It had to be said that it should be considered the planet with the fastest growth. There was basically no pressure to grow all the way.
For other planets to grow rapidly like this, they would need to suspend themselves in the starry sky of the universe, harnessing the power of the universe to endure potential dangers that might exist in the cosmos. Through the passage of countless ages, they might ascend to become low-level planets. However, Little Zi’s growth could be expedited simply by allocating skill points.
For planetary life forms, reaching a low-level planet was the start of evolution and the entry-level. Shi Yu thought that it was time to start cultivating Little Zi.
Shi Yu also learned something from Zi Lan.
Apart from humans, cosmic life forms were also a race very well taken care of by the World King Planet.
After all, both parties were of the same race.
Apart from humans being able to bring more contracted beasts to transmigrate to the World King Planet, planetary life forms could too.
As for humans contracting a cosmic life form and then loading a pile of lives in the cosmic life form, that was the perfect cheat method.
After the Space Emperor broke through to the divine level, the tenth pet he contracted was a planetary life form. He had long experimented with this method.
After learning from the Void Mantis that Shi Yu had inherited the Son of the Stars left behind by the Space Emperor, Zi Lan naturally introduced this cheat method to Shi Yu.
The additional consumption would all be borne by the World King Planet itself.
Unfortunately, there were still some restrictions.
The World King Planet wasn’t a fool. Beast Tamers could at most contract a few lives, but it was possible for tens of billions of transcendent lives to exist in the bodies of planetary life forms. Therefore, it also customized rules for the teleportation of planetary life forms.
1. Life forms that can be teleported with it must be natives of the planet’s life forms or have completed assimilation.
For example, if Shi Yu didn’t contract the Turtle, the Little Quas Snake, and the Shorty, he could bring them to the World King Planet through Little Zi’s body, but he had to let Little Zi transform them into native lives in its body first.
Just like back then, Blue Planet modified foreign humans into native humans.
This rule made a large number of people give up. After all, this process might be the same as it was for the humans on the Blue Planet back then. They would lose their talent and abilities, and their lives would degenerate. There was a certain risk.
2. The life level of a planetary life form cannot exceed the master/monarch level. For humans, Level 4 was the limit. For transcendent life forms, the commander rank was the limit…
This rule made Shi Yu very helpless. However, although there were many restrictions, it was also extremely tempting. The environment of the World King Planet was much superior to other places in the universe. Even the surroundings of the World King Planet have always been surrounded by a bunch of planets. It was said that there were even nine super-divine stars.
Shi Yu originally wanted to exploit the cheat method, but there were too many restrictions.
This rule should have been customized by the World King Planet to support planetary life. Although he couldn’t cheat now, that didn’t mean that he couldn’t in the future.
Just like how the Blue Planet would give some life blessings, the World King Planet sometimes also did. If the opportunity was good and one obtained the favor of the World King Planet, the rules could also be changed for individuals.
Therefore, apart from thinking of a way to earn a large number of Teleportation Key Stones and cosmic crystals on the World King Planet, thinking of a way to let Little Zi acknowledge another mother was also a stable way to connect the World King Planet and Blue Planet. However, the latter was undoubtedly more difficult.
“Don’t let the life in its body evolve too quickly. Suppress the world level. Then, remember to look after those three little guys,” Shi Yu said to Little Zi, pointing at Turtle, Little Quas Snake, and Shorty in its body. The willpower and special training of these guys should be enough.
“Mi! ~” Little Zi agreed repeatedly. At this moment, the energetic Shi Yu looked at Ling again.
“After I finish eating, I’ll give you some points to break through. Baby Ginseng, serve the dishes first!”
Baby Ginseng: “Yi!” Ling: “Well~”
…
Ling’s breakthrough was relatively easy. There were only two skills suitable for fusion. One was an ultimate machine, and the other was the Divine Net. The former was considered a different kind of mechanical control, almost all-encompassing. Ling could basically do what other mechanics of the same level could do, while the latter had top-notch intelligence.
Previously, the success rate of fusing these two skills was extremely low. Now that it had become a medium-level, Shi Yu easily helped Ling complete its breakthrough and evolution.
[Ultimate Machinery, Divine Net] had already fused into [Mechanical Spirit].
Skill: Mechanical Spirit
[Level]: Quasi God-level
<Introduction> It can transform into a mechanical spirit and have god-like mechanical control abilities and intelligence that can spy on the truth.
After the fusion of these two skills, Ling underwent a very special change. Its main body went from the Hundred Transformations Machine to an illusory body that looked like a holographic projection. Although it was still burrowing inside the Rubik’s Cube and showing through the screen, Shi Yu knew that its main body had already changed. It would be even less likely to be injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 1280 - 1280 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (4)
chapters.content:
1280 Breaking Through to Legendary Beast Tamer (4)
“This way, it’s not just a transcendent top-notch intelligence, but the prototype of a divine-level intelligence!”
Double quasi-divine skills!
Ling became the third life form in the team to have two quasi-divine skills after Baby Ginseng.
As for the second, it was Susu. During this period, it completely swallowed the inheritance power of the Blue Sea Ruins and reached its peak. Its Blue Sea Contract and Sea Cleansing Spirit had finally recovered to the stage of a quasi-divine skill.
Although the spirit of the ruins estimated that Susu’s inheritance would take a decade, it didn’t expect Susu to reach the totem level so quickly through other methods, as well as the transcendent Infinite Devour to assist in its digestion!
It was too slow to obediently accept the inheritance. Susu could just swallow it directly!
At the side, Eleven, Buggy, and the others pointed at each other. Buggy nagged at Eleven for a long time and said that there were benefits to breaking through later.
Look, Eleven was the only one left with a quasi-divine skill. Although it only had one, it was a quasi-divine skill after all.
Eleven was dissatisfied. “…Wuu! (Then what’s Susu? I broke through to demigod with it!)”
As the two beasts chirped, Shi Yu was also rather emotional.
“Divine-level intelligence prototype…” In the starry sky of the universe, there was also the machinery race, but they had yet to reach the cosmic level. The strongest was only at the super divine level and had super divine intelligence. Although Ling had become the number one on the Blue Planet, there were still improvements to be made.
“I suddenly realize that you have few attack skills, Ling. Is there anything you want?” Shi Yu was rarely generous.
He would give the first instance of skill deduction ability to Ling.
“Let me think…” Ling was stunned. After thinking for a moment, it said, “I want to learn the Starry Sky Storm! The cosmic disaster that those people encountered midway made the Kirin die!”
Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Was Ling worried that it would also encounter a cosmic storm when it transformed into a cosmic battleship and brought the entire team to travel in the Cosmic Sea?
But indeed… cosmic travel was very dangerous.
Just like how one would encounter vortexes, hidden reefs, storms, and tsunamis when sailing in the sea, cosmic navigation was even more dangerous. Therefore, the starry sky civilization compared the core area of the universe to the Cosmic Sea.
There were too many dangers to experience if one wanted to reach there.
If there was no outstanding “seafarer” leading the way, examples like the Kirin Race weren’t rare.
Why did the Space Emperor and the others send five people to let them choose different routes? It was to be wiped out all at once by the cosmic disaster.
Therefore, if Shi Yu didn’t want to encounter an accident in the Cosmic Sea, it seemed very important to nurture one of his pets into a qualified “seafarer”.
“Starry Sky Storm, easy… I’ll leave the important mission of us being able to travel the starry sky safely in the future to you!”
Buggy: “?”
“Wu!!” As the first cosmic life form in the team, Buggy felt that its ability had been doubted and was immediately dissatisfied!!
However, in the blink of an eye, when it thought that it could escape its mission of transportation, it went limp again and chose to lie flat. Alright, alright, let Ling be the transportation if it wanted. When the time came, it would definitely be the trump card combatant on the cosmic battleship.
In a battle in the starry sky, how could it lose to a panda? This was like fighting on the ground. It was as unscientific as if ferocious beasts would lose to fish!

chapters.title: Chapter 1281 - 1281 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (1)
chapters.content:
1281 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (1)
Shi Yu felt that he still had some energy, so he deduced the learning method of the Starry Sky Storm.
[Deduction success rate]: Extremely low
[Deduction Risk]: Extremely high
[Do you want to continue deducing?]
“Deduce my ass.”
Shi Yu cursed and planned to increase his physique first.
The Starry Sky Storm was definitely a powerful skill. Although it was far inferior to the Black Hole God, it was still a famous disaster in the universe.
A huge cosmic storm was even afraid of super divine levels.
However, as long as the success rate wasn’t 0, Shi Yu was confident of success.
After all, with the support of a bunch of skills, the risk could still be reduced!
“Here are the arrangements after the Starry Sky Storm. Qi, Little Ji, Duckie, you guys can break through too. I’ll help you!”
After Shi Yu finished speaking, he looked at the three little guys on the team who weren’t at the totem level yet.
Now, he had already reached the standard level to use the Teleportation Key Stones. Before going to the universe, he had to increase his strength as much as possible.
After all, the stronger one was, the greater the opportunity.
“Yay~” Qi.
“Roar~”
“Quack~”
“Ling, since your research ability has increased, study how to transform the sealing pearl that sealed the remnant soul of the World Annihilation Dragon into a tool for Little Ji to inherit the Destruction Law.” Shi Yu turned to look at Ling again.
“Alright.” Ling had long wanted to fight. It said, “Eleven, help me. I’m worried that my remnant soul will run out when I’m researching the sealing pearl. I can’t defeat that guy.”
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven expressed that there was no problem.
“Do well!” Shi Yu smiled and started a new round of crazy overtime.
…
In the blink of an eye, two months had passed since the aliens descended on the Blue Planet.
Another month and a half had passed since Shi Yu broke through to the legendary level.
In the past month and a half, Shi Yu had gained a lot.
They strengthened Ling, Qi, Little Ji, Duckie, and Little Zi to the demigod level, one after another.
A lot of the power of the world was used to make up for the points and daily consumption.
Shi Yu believed that this little bit of world power should be a drop in the bucket for the World Tree, so he didn’t stand on ceremony.
From then on, out of the 10 pets Shi Yu contracted, eight were in the first space, and two were in the second space. They were all demigod-level!
Among them, quasi-divine skills like World Grace, Abyss Heart, Cataclysm, Wind of Luck, and Space-Time Travel were even strengthened by Shi Yu to the demigod limit (expert+11).
If it took another step forward, Baby Ginseng, Duckie, Little Ji, Ling, and Qi could break through to the divine level.
At that time, there would be a qualitative change in them!
After a quasi-divine skill perfectly advanced to a divine skill, not only would it lead to an increase in growth level, but the life source condensed by a transcendent life form at the totem level would also gradually transform into an invisible [Heart of God]. The [Heart of God] would help the pet transform the energy of its body into [divine power].
The strength of [divine power] was an important standard to measure the battle power of divine-level life forms.
As for the increase in [divine power], it was also very simple. It was still increased by training the level of divine skills or absorbing resources.
The growth levels of the four divine levels, primary-level god, intermediate-level god, high-level god, and top-notch god, depended on the quality of [divine power].
As long as the divine power was strong enough, even normal divine skills could defeat top-notch divine skills.
Of course, under the same divine power, high-quality divine skills were still better. To put it bluntly, divine power was the [energy points] that belonged to the divine level, but it was more important than [energy points].
This was because [divine power] could also subtly optimize the race and increase physique, lifespan, spirit, soul… It could measure the battle power of a divine-level life form better than [energy points].
At the moment, on the Blue Planet, because the laws of the world were incomplete and the divine power of the gods had dissipated, it was restricted to the demigod level or even lower. However, when Shi Yu headed to the World King Planet, this restriction should disappear.
What gave Shi Yu a headache was that he didn’t seem to be able to play the contract above his level anymore.
According to the description of Zi Lan and the others, Levels 9 and 10 were a threshold. One represented the peak of a normal life form, and the other represented becoming a god. Until now, there had never been a precedent of contracting a divine level above one’s level in the universe, even if one had a special talent.
When Shi Yu heard that, he gave up. The advantage of his previous contract above his level was nothing more than his strong physique, sufficient supplements, and the blessings of the World Tree. However, it was impossible for those geniuses from super divine factions and even cosmic-level factions in the universe not to have these things, and they were definitely better.
However, this was also good. He didn’t have to suffer anymore. As long as he tempered Eleven and the others to the extreme of the demigod level, it was the same to fight above his level.
Even someone like the Ancient God Golden Bull once defeated a low-level god on the Blue Planet with a divine weapon that contained divine power at the demigod level. It was clearly not a big problem for him.
Since he couldn’t contract above his level, he would just add points to them until they were comparable to the divine level, despite being at demigod level!
As Shi Yu worked hard to work overtime, Blue Planet’s gears were also slowly operating. On the basis of the World Tree working hard and squeezing out the five demigods Shi Yu had given it, it finally condensed into a cosmic crystal!
Looking at the cosmic crystal that had spent a Herculean effort to condense in front of it, tears streamed down its face.
In order to condense this lousy thing, the Blue Planet originally needed six to seven years to recover its body. At least, it was delayed for a few years and consumed a lot of the power of the world before it was rushed out in two months.
However, it believed that as long as it used this divine-level cosmic crystal to contact the Space Emperor and the others, this loss should be made up quickly!

chapters.title: Chapter 1282 - 1282 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (2)
chapters.content:
1282 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (2)
The World Tree glanced at the exhausted skeleton, the Tyrant Dragon King, and the other demigods, who no longer had much life force. After a moment of silence, it quickly informed everyone!!
“Everyone, I’m the World Tree. The first cosmic crystal has already been condensed.”
“So fast?” Zi Lan, who woke up from her sleep, was slightly surprised. She understood that the Blue Planet was also impatient and had probably paid a considerable price.
“Just in time.” The angel man and female succubus, who were guests in Rongguang and the Demon Kingdom respectively, smiled.
In two months, they had also chosen pretty good geniuses.
It wasn’t the demigods of the Demon Kingdom or the legendary Hero King of Rongguang.
Although these guys were at Level 9, their talent wasn’t worth a Teleportation Key Stone and a cosmic crystal in their opinion.
“You, follow us to see Lord World Tree.”
In the Demon Kingdom, the demigod-level Succubus King and the tall woman she contracted looked at the Fallen Angel Aldrich, who was kneeling on one knee, and were very satisfied.
This guy had two souls in one body and even knew the rare skill, the Soul Incarnation. Now that it was only at Level 8, it already had battle power close to that of a demigod, and it was a rare Fallen Angel Demon Race. Even on the Demon Planet, it could be considered a rare genius. Its talent had yet to be completely developed on the Blue Planet, and it was very worth nurturing.
The one chosen by the Demon Race was the Fallen Angel Prince, who was first shocked by Buggy in Rongguang. Then, in the World Tournament, he was beaten up by the Ancient God Golden Bull and was later traumatized by Shi Yu and Eleven’s valiant battle power.
“Yes, Lord!!” The Fallen Angel Prince was extremely excited. He never expected that this final opportunity would land in his hands.
These adults said that even if it couldn’t reach the World King Planet now, with his talent, the Demon Race should think of a way to nurture him in the future.
This made the Fallen Angel Prince extremely excited.
Shi Yu… At the thought of Shi Yu, an unreachable mountain, the Fallen Angel Prince was still uncertain. After all, he had heard that Shi Yu had even beaten up an alien genius like the Phoenix Man. However, he still felt that this was an opportunity to overtake Shi Yu.
After all, the Demon Race had a super divine life form. On Dong Huang’s Floating Planet, there were only two peak divine levels.
The Demon God Race was clearly stronger than the Dong Huang humans!
As long as he performed well…
The originally overshadowed heart that had been compared started becoming active again.
Rongguang.
It was a woman with long golden hair, a beautiful face, a full figure, and a holy aura. Like the Fallen Angel Prince Aldrich, she was a contestant who participated in the last world competition. She was the representative of the Kingdom of Glory, the Holy Maiden of the Divine Church of Light, Amelia.
She was also a genius living under Shi Yu’s shadow.
Now, after the World Tournament ended, she had already reached Level 8. Her growth rate was very fast. The reason was that not long after the first revival of the laws, Amelia awakened the memories of her previous life. She was actually also a reincarnation.
Moreover, she had reincarnated from a transcendent life form into a human.
In her previous life, she was a low-level angel goddess of the Angel Race in the Mythical Era. She was also a god of the Mythical Era, like the male angel who was frightened by Shi Yu at the alliance meeting.
This situation of the gods transforming into humans was very rare. It wasn’t that it was difficult, but very few gods did this. This was even harder than hybrids. This exception naturally became the first choice of the angel man from outer space, temporarily treating her as a super genius that the angels wanted to rope in.
It was a little strange to say that she was a genius. After all, with the seniority of Amelia’s previous life, she could be said to be the ancestor of the current alien angel race.
At this moment, when everyone heard the summoning of the World Tree, they began to take action. In the icy plain, Shi Yu also stretched and revealed an expectant expression.
“Little ones, let’s go. It shouldn’t be long before we can go to the World King Planet!!!”
“Wu wu wu!!”
“Roar!!”
Under Shi Yu’s call, the pets surrounding the icy plain and eating hotpot were overjoyed. Baby Ginseng heaved a sigh of relief.
“Yi~!!”
Great!
When they arrived at the World King Planet, the world’s energy should be very abundant. It could even afford to raise super divine levels. After Eleven and the other demigods went over, their need for food shouldn’t be as big as now, right?
“Yiya! (It’s time to work hard!)” Baby Ginseng had already planned to go there and try its best to downplay its identity as a chef.
For example, a divine-level first clear.
“Let’s go!!!” Shi Yu said.
Ling said, “Wait, shouldn’t we call Teacher Ying? Didn’t it also pick up the Teleportation Key Stones?”
“Oh, there’s also this guy.” Shi Yu was speechless.
He still didn’t want to believe that a cat could casually make a wish to obtain the Teleportation Key Stones.
Shi Yu still remembered the smug expression on the gem cat’s face when it laughed arrogantly at him in the video.
…
Inatella.

chapters.title: Chapter 1283 - 1283 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (3)
chapters.content:
1283 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (3)
Zi Lan and the Star Dragon represented the Space Emperor and the dragon race respectively. There was nothing wrong with choosing the senior of the Space Emperor and the previous Dragon God of Dragon Palace City.
The Demon Race chose the most talented Aldrich of the Demon Race at the moment. They planned to wait for him to reach the legendary stage. The Angel Race chose the Ancestral God Reincarnation. They weren’t strange choices.
“They’re all familiar faces.” After arriving, Shi Yu looked at Aldrich and the Rongguang Holy Maiden in surprise.
He originally thought that it would be some foreign legends.
Why were they all children who had participated in the world competition?
“Have you reached Level 9?”
Upon hearing Shi Yu’s words, the Fallen Angel Prince and the Rongguang Holy Maiden fell silent. They didn’t want to talk to Shi Yu.
Seeing how smug Shi Yu was, she knew that Shi Yu was definitely Level 9.
They felt that this was also normal. After all, Shi Yu had obtained the Blessing of the World Tree and defeated the Phoenix Man. He had the battle record of defeating a bunch of demigods. It would be strange if he wasn’t at Level 9.
[Level 9…]
The World Tree sensed Shi Yu’s level and couldn’t help but be pleasantly surprised. No wonder he was so arrogant. He had leveled up again. Not bad.
Zi Lan and the Phoenix Man also suddenly looked at Shi Yu. Shi Yu had leveled up?
[Not good.] The Phoenix man’s expression darkened. Shi Yu was already so powerful at Level 8. How much more impressive would he be at Level 9?
He had already thought that there would be rumors of his defeat on the Floating Planet.
Most important was… how to defeat Shi Yu!!
“Eh, it’s???” At this moment, the World Tree looked at the eager gem cat girl beside it in confusion and looked at Shi Yu. Could it be that Shi Yu planned to contract it too and go to the World King Planet together?
At least for now, there was no contract… In short, he wasn’t here to sightsee, right?
“Lord World Tree, I’m a demigod of Dong Huang. Don’t you remember? I also participated in the battle of Shi Yu hunting the demigods of the Yun Race. I have a very good relationship with Shi Yu,” the gem cat girl said. “Well, I picked up a Teleportation Key Stone not long ago, so if you distribute the cosmic crystals in the future, don’t forget me!!”
“I’ll also work hard to help the Blue Planet collect evolution resources!” The cat waved.
Everyone: “?”
“Ah, this.” The World Tree was also stunned.
What was going on!
It didn’t understand.
This wasn’t a joke, right?
Shi Yu had a headache. “It has a quasi-divine skill of making wishes. Its luck has always been very good.”
After a moment of silence, the World Tree didn’t say anything else. In any case, it only had one cosmic crystal now. It was too early to say this. It said, “Now that I’ve finally condensed a cosmic crystal, should I give this cosmic crystal to you?”
The World Tree looked at Zi Lan.
Zi Lan smiled and said, “Yes, Lord Blue Planet. The four of us also have our own Teleportation Key Stones. Next, I’ll use this Teleportation Key Stone to head to the World King Planet and contact Teacher. Then, I’ll explain the Blue Planet’s situation to him.”
“I was teleported to the World King Planet from here, so if I return, I’ll also return here. At that time, I’ll bring more cosmic crystals from the World King Planet to ensure that everyone can go over together.”
“As for time, it will also be very fast. When I get there, I can immediately contact Teacher. The Floating Planet is hanging beside the World King Planet. We also have our own territory on the World King Planet. Both parties can communicate.”
“Captain, I’ll leave it to you.” The Phoenix Man, the Angel Man, and the Demon Lady prayed. They could finally go home. As long as Zi Lan brought back the cosmic crystal from the various races…
At least before the revival of the laws, they didn’t want to stay in this godforsaken place for a moment longer.
It was a barren land!
“Sister Zi Lan, I’ll leave it to you. We’ll wait for you.” Shi Yu also looked forward to it. Although the World King Planet sounded very far, with the Teleportation Key Stones, Shi Yu didn’t feel that it was a long trip. He only felt that he was going to a fresher place to see the world.
The exploration technique taught by Emperor Shi could only be used in larger places!
“Alright, in that case, I’ll leave this cosmic crystal to you.” The World Tree handed the only cosmic crystal to the Space Emperor’s disciple, Zi Lan.
After Zi Lan nodded, she couldn’t wait to take out her Teleportation Key Stone.
“Then I’ll go and come back quickly,” she said. Then, she recalled the Star Dragon and directly controlled the Crowd Control Teleportation Key Stone. She absorbed the cosmic crystal and chose to activate the teleportation device.
In the next moment, light flickered. Accompanied by this special spatial wave, they only left a spatial coordinate here. Then, right on the heels of that, they disappeared from the Blue Planet with the white light.
Zi Lan disappeared, and the remaining natives of the Blue Planet sensed everything around them in surprise.
The gem cat girl fell into deep thought and was very curious. Not bad, it was a spatial expert… but it actually couldn’t understand the teleportation just now!
If he used the Teleportation Key Stones and cosmic crystals well, wouldn’t his escape ability be maxed out?
[I know what you’re thinking, but I advise you not to rely on this when the time comes. I feel that as long as you have a divine-level ability, it’s very easy to interrupt this teleportation.] Shi Yu looked at the gem cat and said telepathically. He had long guessed Teacher Cat’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1284 - 1284 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (4)
chapters.content:
1284 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (4)
The gem cat looked at Shi Yu: “?”
Tsk.
“Erm, beautiful sister, the Teleportation Key Stone in your hand…” At this moment, the female succubus suddenly smiled and said to the gem cat girl, “Do you have any thoughts of selling it? We can buy it at a high price.”
The gem cat was stunned and said, “No! This is a gift from the heavens!!”
Seeing this, Shi Yu also looked at the World Tree and ignored the gem cat doing business. In any case, the gem cat had just explained its relationship with him. There shouldn’t be anyone on the Blue Planet who could forcefully buy and sell under the nose of the World Tree.
“Well, I also have something to do.” Shi Yu sensed the World Tree telepathically and said, “Change the map. Private chat?”
The World Tree was stunned. Why was he being so mysterious?
What Shi Yu wanted to say… was naturally about Emperor Shi…
…
At the same time.
World King Planet.
Sky City.
The big city closest to the Floating Planet outside the World King Planet was also a faction established by the Space Emperor when he was working hard on the World King Planet. Later on, Lin Feng joined it.
At this moment, in a room in the Floating City, with a flash of light, Zi Lan directly arrived from the Blue Planet.
“Hu…” Sensing that the world energy on the World King Planet was more than a thousand times richer than on the Blue Planet, Zi Lan was like a fish returning to water, revealing a comfortable expression.
“As expected… this place is still more comfortable.”
“But if it’s the first time the Blue Planet and the others come, they should have to adapt for a period of time. After all, the gravity here is stronger.”
She stretched happily and quickly left the room, heading to the only place in Sky City where she could communicate with the Floating Planet.
The news of the Blue Planet would definitely shock Teacher!!
Zi Lan and the others could be considered to have gone out on important missions. According to the estimated time, Zi Lan and the others should have been able to transmit the news two years ago, but they were so slow. It was very difficult not to guess that something had happened.
Fortunately, Zi Lan returned first. Her appearance immediately made the entire Sky City tremble. Because the news she brought back was the highest secret, they immediately cooperated with her and contacted the Space Emperor far away on the floating planet.
On the intermediate-level planet, Floating Planet, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng had also been waiting for news of Zi Lan and the others for a long time. They had even met and deduced it a few times, but unfortunately, there were no results.
Until this time…
“Lord Space Emperor, Lord Space Emperor, there’s news from Sky City from the communication department. Lord Zi Lan is back.” The moment the Space Emperor received the message, he directly headed to Sky City on the World King Planet from the Floating Planet.
For such a huge matter, if he wanted to see Zi Lan personally, there were too many hidden dangers if he only relied on interstellar communication.
After an unknown period of time, Zi Lan, who was waiting in Sky City, finally saw her teacher, the Space Emperor. This was a long-haired man in a black robe. He had an imposing aura and was very extraordinary.
“Teacher!!” After seeing the Space Emperor, Zi Lan, who could be said to be the strongest Beast Tamer on the Blue Planet as the joint captain of the few large factions, immediately had tears flickering in her eyes like a little girl. After all, this voyage was too dangerous. If it weren’t for the Kirin Race offering sacrifices to the heavens and suffering the main damage of the cosmic storm for them, their group might have been completely destroyed.
“Lan’er, what happened? Tell me slowly.” When the Space Emperor saw Zi Lan like this, he knew that they had experienced many setbacks and couldn’t help but comfort her.
“Teacher, the reason why we’re a little later than expected is that we encountered a cosmic storm. Fortunately, only the third team sacrificed themselves. The other four teams only consumed more cosmic crystals when they left,” Zi Lan quickly explained, making the Space Emperor fall silent.
“I understand. It’s been hard on you.” The Space Emperor sighed in his heart. As expected, an accident still happened.
“I’ll deal with the undead.”
“Well, then the rest of us successfully arrived on the Blue Planet. I only successfully returned after Blue Planet’s Will condensed a new cosmic crystal,” Zi Lan said.
Emperor Kong said, “How’s the situation on the Blue Planet now?”
Zi Lan said, “The current laws have yet to revive. It should take a few years.”
“What about Dong Huang?”
Zi Lan said, “Very good. Now, it’s the greatest faction on the Blue Planet. Under the protection of the Divine Source Legendary for hundreds of years, no totem wars occurred again. However, he’s too old and often sleeps. Usually, Lord Lin Feng’s great-grandson is basically running the country…”
The Space Emperor smiled. He didn’t expect Dong Huang to be so powerful under the lead of the old man that Lin Feng mentioned.
“However, the greatest contributor to making Dong Huang the number one country on the Blue Planet is actually someone else.”
“Oh?” The Space Emperor was curious.
Zi Lan said, “His name is Shi Yu. He’s from Ping Cheng, Dong Huang’s Icefield. He’s 21 years old now and became a Beast Tamer three years ago. He’s an expert in various fields, such as expert feeding, archeology, machinery, and battle. He’s even known by the World Tree as the strongest Beast Tamer on Blue Planet.”
“What???” The Space Emperor couldn’t help but say, “How old is he?”
“21 years old, and he only became a Beast Tamer three years ago??”
“Blue Planet’s strongest Beast Tamer??”
Although on World King Planet and Floating Planet, human children could start cultivating at the age of six or seven, if the Space Emperor remembered correctly, on Blue Planet, human Beast Tamers basically started cultivating when they were in their teens.
It was already too late for Shi Yu to start cultivating at the age of 17 or 18. He didn’t look like a descendant of a Beast Tamer family, but he actually became the recognized strongest on Blue Planet in just three years? How was that possible?
“Icefield, Ping Cheng, why haven’t I heard of it?” The Space Emperor fell into deep thought. If it wasn’t those famous capitals, it meant that Shi Yu’s family background might not be strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1285 - 1285 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (5)
chapters.content:
1285 Shocking the Space Emperor for Ten Thousand Years (5)
“It was once a third-level city in Dong Huang. Shi Yu was only an orphan at the start before he was unearthed by Dong Huang. He belonged to the type of super genius in the true sense of the word.” Zi Lan couldn’t help but say, “Teacher, Qi Mu… fought with Shi Yu previously.”
“Moreover, Qi Mu lost.”
The Space Emperor was stunned.
“Because Shi Yu is suppressed by the laws of the world, no pet has mastered two quasi-divine skills. There are no creatures on Blue Planet with more than two quasi-divine skills, but Qi Mu and the others still lost.”
“Moreover, the most important thing is…”
“Shi Yu is only a Level 8 Beast Tamer… He hasn’t reached Level 9. He defeated Qi Mu, who’s above his level.”
“But now, he should have reached Level 9.”
As Zi Lan finished speaking, even the Space Emperor, who had heard that the Phoenix Man had lost to the natives of the Blue Planet and was relatively calm, was completely unable to calm down.
“What??”
“He’s only at Level 8. How can he defeat Qi Mu?” The Space Emperor was in disbelief.
After all, on the Blue Planet, when he was Level 8, he could only kill a top-notch totem. He couldn’t even defeat normal demigods.
Although Qi Mu wasn’t considered an expert among the younger generation of the Floating Planet, on the Blue Planet, it would definitely be a case of overkill.
He was actually defeated by someone below his level?
Zi Lan smiled bitterly and said, “So I was also very shocked at that time. He’s a freak. Although he was only at Level 8, he contracted at least four demigod-level pets above his level…”
Emperor Kong: “?”
“Moreover, the others on the Blue Planet are just as you and Lord Lin Feng said. They only have one Beast Taming Talent, but he developed a new Beast Taming ability on the foundation of a Beast Taming Talent…”
“Moreover, it’s a divine-level talent that can trigger the sound of laws.”
“By the way, it’s said that it was developed at Level 6. It’s said that he can already easily kill totems at Level 6.”
Emperor Kong: “?”
“After we communicated, I finally confirmed that it’s very likely that Shi Yu entered the ruins of the last cosmic era and obtained the inheritance.”
“In fact, he was also unearthed by Dong Huang because of his archeological talent. His growth all the way through was inseparable from archeology. Now, he’s even known as the strongest archeologist on Blue Planet.”
The Space Emperor fell into deep thought and was shocked. He had never expected that the news brought back by Zi Lan and the others could shock him. Even in his current position, he felt that Shi Yu was a living little monster.
After all, a place like the Blue Planet…
An archeologist who could crack the ruins of the cosmic era and obtain benefits?
Such an archeological genius could be counted on one hand, even on the World King Planet.
“How’s his personality?” The Space Emperor asked the most important question.
Zi Lan said, “He’s alright. Based on the Divine Source Legendary and President Lin Xiao… and what we’ve learned from many parties, his greatest problem is that he’s restless and likes to take risks everywhere. He’s not a down-to-earth person. After communicating with us, he’s also very curious about the cosmic ruins. It should be… common for archeologists?”
“By the way, he also successfully awakened your second team’s pet, Senior Void Mantis, from the ruins and inherited the Son of the Stars Egg you left behind. According to Senior Void Mantis, Shi Yu isn’t bad. He has received its guidance and is considered half a disciple of it. Don’t worry. Moreover, Shi Yu also took good care of the bloodline descendants you left on Blue Planet.”
“…” The Space Emperor fell silent again. He didn’t expect that this guy was still his inheritor?
After a long time, he kept feeling that something was wrong. A super archeological genius, restless, cosmic ruins… Thinking of the Kirin Race ancestor who led most of the elites of the Kirin Race to die in the ruins of the era, why did he feel that this genius wasn’t that reliable to nurture in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 1286 - 1286 Preparations Before Leaving (1)
chapters.content:
1286 Preparations Before Leaving (1)
Next, Zi Lan passed more information about Shi Yu, Dong Huang, and Blue Planet to the Space Emperor.
However, in the end, the Space Emperor was indeed only attracted by Shi Yu alone and asked more.
“The contracted pets are actually so interesting. As expected of an archeological genius.”
“Although we and the Kirin Race each lost a genius this time, I didn’t expect Shi Yu to actually recover the Wind Kirin Race’s inheritance. This way, the Kirin Race might be very surprised,” the Space Emperor said.
In the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era, several races were destroyed. The Wind Kirin Race was the first to bear the brunt. At the end of the war, there were only a few Kirin Gods with powerful battle powers left in the entire Kirin Race.
With the difficulty of reproduction at the divine level and the situation on the Blue Planet at that time, this was basically no different from being exterminated.
At that time, a batch of descendants of divine beasts left the Blue Planet, and another batch of descendants of divine beasts stayed behind. The Dragon, Phoenix, Angel, and Demon Races had descendants left behind, but only the Kirin Race didn’t. From this, it could be seen how serious the damage to the Kirin Race was.
However, later on, after the few Kirin Gods entered the Cosmic Sea, their luck was pretty good. It was easier to reproduce on high-level planets, and it wasn’t difficult for divine levels to reproduce. In the end, they successfully spread their branches, grew stronger again, and weren’t completely extinct.
Unfortunately, good times didn’t last.
The Kirin Ancestor directly died in the ruins of the era with a batch of elites.
It made the Kirin Race the race with the fewest members, the weakest faction, and the most incomplete inheritance among the five major divine races.
If it weren’t for the fact that the five god races of the Blue Planet had been hugging each other for warmth, the Kirin Race might not have survived until now.
The Kirin Race once suspected that it was because the Wind Kirin was the first to be targeted and the luck inheritance was severed that their luck was so poor. After all, the Wind Kirin Race had always been the responsibility of the luck of the Kirin Race. Now that the Blue Planet actually had the Wind Kirin inheritance, the Kirin Race should be very concerned.
“We have to protect Shi Yu well. We can’t let him be snatched away by the Dragon, Phoenix, and Kirin Races,” the Space Emperor said. “He has nothing to do with the Demon Race and the Angel Race, right?”
The Space Emperor had already expected that at that time, the six major factions on Blue Planet, the five major divine races, and the humans they represented would crazily compete for the geniuses on Blue Planet.
Although the Blue Planet had declined, at its peak, it was a quasi-high-level planet after all, so there were many people on it.
Zi Lan said, “He seems to have obtained a sleeping divine race demon egg, but the laws of the Blue Planet are incomplete. It shouldn’t have hatched yet.”
“I see.” The Space Emperor pondered. This way, apart from the Angel Race, wouldn’t the four major gods be related to Shi Yu?
Shi Yu was suspected of having entered the ruins of the Green Dragon Era and cultivated the Green Dragon that had mastered the Creation God skill. He would definitely be noticed by the Blue Planet’s Dragon Race.
There would probably be a lot of threats.
“It’s alright. Since he’s a Dong Huang human, at that time, he will definitely choose the Floating Planet. What we need to do is provide him with enough cultivation resources and carefully nurture him after he arrives.”
“If Shi Yu is really as talented as you say, perhaps we can use the fastest speed and the smallest price to let the Blue Planet complete its restoration and even evolve.” The Space Emperor smiled and said, “If we can get into the top 10, or even first place…”
“Have you told him about the God Sealing Battle?”
Zi Lan said, “I’ve mentioned it to him, but I didn’t talk about it in detail… Teacher, the first place is too far away. It’s been so long, how many times has the Blue Planet gotten first place?”
“The disciples you and Lord Lin Feng taught haven’t even gotten into the top 100…”
The Space Emperor frowned. “It’s all because you guys are disappointing.”
Zi Lan: “…”
Sorry, I’m trash.
“But isn’t Shi Yu very strong? Give him some time to adapt. He might be able to break the record.” The Space Emperor felt that it was very interesting.
The God Sealing Battle was a super competition organized by the World King Planet. The factions on the World King Planet and the surrounding major planets could participate. The contestants were limited to those below the divine level.
It was held almost every year, and the top 100 had huge benefits.
It was considered a way for the World King Planet to distribute resources.
The benefits of first place could even make super divine levels envious.
However, it was precisely because it was held too frequently and the benefits were too great that a batch of factions cultivated a bunch of geniuses who were stuck at the demigod level and didn’t break through.
Every year, they would participate and be prize hunters.
The God Sealing Battle was an important channel for the various super divine factions and divine-level factions to obtain a large number of cosmic crystals and Teleportation Key Stones.
Therefore, in the annual God Sealing Battle, there might be dozens of representatives of super-divine factions and thousands of divine-level factions participating. Among them, it wasn’t strange for demigods to appear who were hundreds or thousands of years old and had lifespans exceeding tens of thousands of years.
It was even possible for some geniuses to participate in dozens of consecutive competitions for first place.
The competition was quite intense.
Unfortunately, he and Lin Feng didn’t know about this competition at the time. They broke through to the divine level on other planets but couldn’t participate successfully. However, he and Lin Feng had watched the battle.
The top 100 were indeed monsters. The previous first place was even determined that as long as they didn’t die, they would definitely become super divines. He and Lin Feng felt that even if they cultivated bitterly at the legendary level for dozens or hundreds of years, it would still be quite difficult to charge through. It depended on luck.
If Shi Yu was really as strong as Zi Lan said, the Space Emperor felt that it shouldn’t be a problem for Shi Yu to try entering the top 10 after training for a few years.
In fact, in the top five, top three, and first place!
At that time, the number of cosmic crystals, Teleportation Key Stones, and rare resources they would obtain would be more than what divine-level experts like them would earn after working hard for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1287 - 1287 Preparations Before Leaving (2)
chapters.content:
1287 Preparations Before Leaving (2)
“When he reaches the World King Planet, I’ll personally explain the God Sealing Battle to him. He’s still young, so he doesn’t have to try to break through to the divine level so early. The right path for him is to train more and broaden his horizons with the geniuses of the myriad races in the starry sky,” the Space Emperor Kong said.
…
Blue Planet…
World Tree Mystic Realm.
At this moment, after hearing Shi Yu’s information about Emperor Shi, the World Tree was completely stunned.
“What did you say!!!” The World Tree was extremely shocked.
On the Blue Planet, there was another place that connected to the ruins of the cosmic era.
Moreover, Emperor Shi of Dong Huang actually successfully explored and cracked the ruins and broke through to the super divine level.
Such explosive news was simply even more unbelievable to the World Tree than learning that the five divine races had super-divine beings.
“That’s what happened, so when I reach the World King Planet, I’ll help the Blue Planet find evolution resources as much as possible. I’ll also share this information with the Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, and the others and work hard for Blue Planet’s evolution!”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Therefore, Lord World Tree, when I reach there, I’m unfamiliar with the place and should be leaving soon. Is there any more help you can provide?”
The World Tree looked at Shi Yu with mixed feelings. Archeology actually raised a time-element super-divine human?
Ridiculous!
At the peak of the Blue Planet, it was only at the peak of the divine level and had yet to reach the super divine level.
The three strongest enemies who threatened Blue Planet’s Mythical Era were only at the super divine level.
In the end, a human who was born inside the Blue Planet more than 2000 years ago was already a super divine?
Thinking again about the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, the World Tree’s approval rating for humans as the saviors of the Blue Planet reached an unprecedented ten thousand percent.
This was really a miracle race.
The World Tree gritted its teeth.
“Alright.”
Shi Yu was delighted. He knew that it would definitely be beneficial to tell the World Tree about Emperor Shi.
Although it could only be used to replenish consumption and was the cheapest divine-level resource, it was definitely very useful to Shi Yu.
Considering that there was abundant energy over there, perhaps he wouldn’t have to worry about resources for a few years?
No, considering the huge consumption of points, perhaps it could last for a few months. In short, it wasn’t bad.
“I know you contracted more pets, so the burden might be greater. After leaving Blue Planet, don’t use Baby Ginseng’s World Grace randomly.”
“These energy crystals should be enough for you to use for a period of time to replenish your consumption.”
“The rest is up to you.”
“Thank you,” Shi Yu said sincerely. “Don’t worry, after I get there, I’ll definitely work hard and improve every day. I’ll strive to make a name for myself and repay my mother planet.”
After a moment of silence, the World Tree said, “There’s no need to work so hard. You’re still young. As long as you remember not to cause trouble, you’re a good child.”
The universe was filled with opportunities, but it was also dangerous. No one knew if the future was good or bad for the Blue Planet once it came into contact with the starry sky.
“Don’t worry,” Shi Yu said.
“No, I’m worried,” the World Tree said. “No, I’ll remind you more.”
“When the time comes, I’ll also instruct them.”
Among the five cosmic-level factions, only the World King Planet was close to a planetary life form. The other four were natural enemies with planetary life forms. There were enemies everywhere, so how could the World Tree be at ease?
When a genius left the planet, he couldn’t possibly lure the enemy over when he returned.
…
In the outside world.
As Zi Lan had said, she didn’t make everyone wait long.
After Zi Lan obtained the universal resource, the cosmic crystal, she rushed back immediately.
“Captain, did it go smoothly? How’s the situation?” Phoenix Man and the others were extremely happy.
After Zi Lan returned, Shi Yu finally escaped from the nagging World Tree. His head was about to explode.
At this moment, looking at everyone, Zi Lan smiled and said, “I saw Teacher. I brought nine cosmic crystals from there first.”
Nine pieces!!
Zi Lan looked at the gem cat and said, “The distribution rule is that we each get a piece. Little cat, I also got one piece for you.”
The gem cat was extremely touched. Thank you, big boss.
“Meow~”
“But you’re so weak. You have to be careful when you get there. The environment over there is still quite unfriendly to newbies. The gravity is very strong. If you have big-sized pets, it’s best to let them be prepared. Before you have strength, there’s no need to not become big. Small bodies can better save physical strength,” Zi Lan reminded kindly.
The gem cat: “?”
Me, weak? No! Ridiculous!
The cat was angry and was definitely going to make a name for itself.
Blue Planet and World King Planet were connected. This was the early stage of the bonus. In its judgment, it was best not to miss the first bus.
Everyone nodded… They had already understood.
“Apart from that, I also brought back a batch of resources jointly prepared by the six major races, mainly to help Blue Planet accelerate its restoration. In addition…”
She looked at the Fallen Angel Prince and the Holy Maiden and said, “Those of you who haven’t reached Level 9, reach it as soon as possible so that you can activate the Teleportation Key Stones.”
“Thank you,” the Fallen Angel Prince and the Holy Maiden said.
“For you.” Zi Lan handed a handful of cosmic crystals to everyone with the keystone. At the same time, she said, “The teleportation locations connected to your keystone are different. Shi Yu, Senior Dragon God, you’re connected to the Sky City of the World King Planet. The other two are Demon City and Angel City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1288 - 1288 Preparations Before Leaving (3)
chapters.content:
1288 Preparations Before Leaving (3)
“After you’re ready, you can teleport over at any time. Someone will receive you over there.”
“And apart from bringing these back, I also brought back some news. Teacher and Lord Lin Feng asked me to convey messages to their pets on the Blue Planet… and also to Lord Blue Planet. So, I still have to stay on the Blue Planet for a period of time.”
“Next, I’ll be the messenger of both parties,” Zi Lan said.
“You’ve worked hard,” the World Tree said.
Zi Lan smiled and said, “This is what I should do.”
“Me too.” Shi Yu held the cosmic crystal and said, “I plan to go over in two days. I still have to bid farewell to my acquaintances.”
Zi Lan said, “It’s alright, you can go over when you want. But the three of you, they’re calling you back to the World King Planet. It’s best to go as soon as possible.” She looked at Phoenix Man and the others.
The Phoenix Man said, “I understand. I’ll go back now. I’ve long missed my mom.”
