Zi Lan’s return made everyone obtain the cosmic crystal. She threw the resources prepared by the Angel Race and the Demon Race to the Angel Man and the Demon Lady. Then, she looked at the World Tree, and looked like she also planned to chat with it privately.
She also brought a large number of resources to distribute to the World Tree, Dong Huang, and even the second team pets of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng…
At this moment, Shi Yu weighed the cosmic crystal and looked at Senior Dragon God and the gem cat with mixed emotions. “Senior Dragon God, Teacher Ying, you shouldn’t be in a hurry to go over. Let’s go together when the time comes.”
“I plan to bid farewell to President Lin, Principal Feng, and the others first and pack my things.”
The Dragon God nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll wait for you here.”
The gem cat said, “Hey, hey, hey, I’m even less anxious. I’ll wait a year and a half before going over. I have a lot to deal with. Shi Yu, go test the water first.”
“If it’s too dangerous, I’ll sell the stone. I’ve already discussed it with that beautiful sister. Of course, if Dong Huang has needs, I’ll hand them over first!”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Alright.” Shi Yu was helpless. Right on the heels of that, he looked at everyone and said, “Everyone, I’ll take my leave first. I’m going to move my luggage. See you on the World King Planet.”
“Handsome, see you on the World King Planet.” The female succubus waved at Shi Yu and said, “Come to my place as a guest when the time comes. Let’s cultivate together.”
Shi Yu was stunned and felt tempted.
“See you on the World King Planet,” the Phoenix Man also curled his lips and said. He hoped that these bastards wouldn’t publicize his loss to Shi Yu when they arrived at Sky City.
The angel man and the others looked at Shi Yu. The Fallen Angel and the Holy Maiden were slightly silent. From the looks of it, Shi Yu had arrived at the World King Planet before them. However, they would also go over as soon as possible.
“Go and prepare.” As the World Tree finished speaking, Shi Yu took a deep breath and nodded. He turned around and left Inatella with the gem cat.
…
Shi Yu indeed had a pile of things to prepare. For example, there were a bunch of friends he wanted to bid farewell to for the time being.
Space crystals looked pretty precious. He didn’t plan to return in the short term. He planned to cultivate bitterly over there for a period of time to adapt.
He first returned to Ping Cheng and watched this thriving city from a high altitude. Soon, Baby Ginseng was summoned by Shi Yu to his shoulder, and Buggy was also summoned to his side.
“Baby Ginseng, Buggy, help upgrade the surrounding environment of Ping Cheng.”
“Yi! (Alright ~)”
“Ji! (Leave it to me!)” Buggy nodded. Ping Cheng was also its hometown. It was born on an ordinary tree in the forest outside Ping Cheng. It crawled through many places and finally stopped on a persimmon tree, caught by Shi Yu.
At the thought of this, tears welled up in Buggy’s eyes. Although it wasn’t that it wasn’t coming back, for some reason, this was the first time it had strong feelings of leaving its hometown.
Perhaps… the distance was too far?
“Ji.” Under Shi Yu’s request, Buggy and Baby Ginseng helped modify Ping Cheng through the power of creation and the power of the world. The steam raised the energy standard of this small city to the level of a first-level city, comparable to big cities like the Ancient Capital and the Divine Capital.
At the same time, Eleven also flew back to the Bamboo Forest Breeding Base and mixed into a group of panda cubs. It turned a big earth mountain into a golden mountain with some stones and shocked a bunch of feeders.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven strolled leisurely as if it was home.
It wasn’t easy for ordinary people to detect subtle modifications in other places.
However, it was very sensitive to Beast Tamers and pets.
“Holy shit, the laws revived again?” On the Beast Tamer Troops’ side, the Beast Tamers were shocked.
In the Beast Tamer Association, President Feng, who had once helped Shi Yu a lot, walked to the window and looked at the flower pot. As the level-one spiritual plant inside instantly increased by two levels, he was immediately stunned.
“Uncle Feng.” After being stunned, he was shocked by the figure floating in the air beside the window and almost threw away the wolfberry water.
“Shi Yu, why are you here… This, you did this??” He was shocked. He sensed that the surrounding environment was getting stranger and stranger and couldn’t help but say in shock.
The pets in his Beast Taming Space began to remind him. He felt that there were more nutrients in the outside world.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “The plant pet has broken through. Help green the city and experiment with this skill. Next, the resource evaluation of Ping Cheng should be able to increase to level one. Uncle Feng, remember to plan it yourself.”
“You brat.” President Feng smiled. He knew that Shi Yu had come to give feedback on Ping Cheng again. In the past two years, Shi Yu, this genius, had helped a lot in the development and construction of Ping Cheng. He was about to change Ping Cheng’s name to Shi Yu City.
“It’s rare for you to come. Want a drink?” President Feng invited.
“No, there’s something else,” Shi Yu said.
“I understand. Go ahead,” President Feng said. “But take care of your health. You’ve been weak since you were young. Now that you’re so powerful, why do you still look weak…”
Shi Yu was called over by Buggy. Buggy accidentally discovered a person in Ping Cheng.
It was an artistic young man sitting by the street, drawing. Beside him was a Rainbow Light Mushroom. When he saw him, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. Then, he smiled and recalled.
When he was a newbie, in order to help Buggy train the power of imagination and simulate an ice dragon, he prepared many props, including the ice dragon statue, and the ice dragon painting. Among them, the ice dragon painting was drawn by someone… The person in front of him was originally a passerby he had met once. He didn’t expect that the other party was still developing in Ping Cheng. He went from a student to a handsome, artsy young man.
He didn’t know if the other party knew that the buyer he had drawn for the Ice Dragon had directly let his pet materialize the Ice Dragon Phantom and kill everyone in the class assessment… Shi Yu looked at the Green Dragon the other party was drawing now and thought for a moment. The other party probably knew.
“Eh???” Finally, after painting the Green Dragon’s eyes, the artistic young man on the street heaved a sigh of relief. However, he was shocked to discover that the painting flickered with light. The Green Dragon in it seemed to have come alive and flown out of the painting. Then, it circled in midair and let out a strong and deafening dragon roar. It took a look at them and returned to the painting, adding more extraordinary power to the painting.
The young man looked around in shock and realized that the passers-by hadn’t noticed the abnormality just now. He looked at his pet again and saw that it was also looking at him in confusion.
“Coo, coo!!” The Rainbow Light Mushroom asked what was wrong with the Green Dragon just now.
“This painting…” The arty young man was stunned. “The Green Dragon God appeared??”
He was stunned for a long time before quickly getting up and saying, “I’m not selling this painting anymore. Let’s go home!”
“Let’s go.” The other party went home. In the sky, Shi Yu also called Buggy to leave. He turned around and took out his cell phone to call Senior Lu.
A puzzled voice came from the other side. “Shi Yu? What’s wrong?”
“Senior Lu, come to the Ancient Capital. I’ll treat you to a meal with Principal Feng and the others tonight. I’m going to World King Planet to take a look someday. I wonder how long it will take me to return.” After Shi Yu finished speaking, there was a long silence. Then, he whispered, “Is there any way to bring me along?”
Shi Yu smiled bitterly and said, “What can we do? If you want to go over, break through to the legendary level quickly. I’ll try to get you more Teleportation Key Stones and cosmic crystals.”
“Ah, alright.”
In Ancient Capital, Shi Yu returned to Ancient Capital University after going around in circles. He planned to bid farewell to Principal Feng first. Didn’t the other party always hate him for not reporting when he went out to have fun? He would report it this time. Well, he would also call Master Qu Jie along.
Didn’t Master Qu Jie like the Bull Race very much? He felt that he could introduce the Ancient God Golden Bull to him before leaving and cooperate with him to become a legendary examiner in the future!

chapters.title: Chapter 1289 - 1289 Departure (1)
chapters.content:
1289 Departure (1)
“Teacher Ying, after I leave, don’t just focus on earning money.”
“Help me bring Lu Qingyi, Lin Xiuzhu, and the others.”
After Shi Yu arrived at Ancient Capital University, he found the gem cat girl who was lazing around.
It looked like this guy really didn’t plan to go to the World King Planet now.
It reflected one word: cowardice.
The gem cat girl stretched on the sofa with a tired expression.
“Damn it~ You couldn’t even be bothered to help them level up when you were on Blue Planet. You asked me to.” She wasn’t a nanny.
“Take this.” Shi Yu took out a spatial bag and threw it to her. “Inside are a large number of resources and a new gem fruit developed by Baby Ginseng after it broke through. Try it.”
The gem cat girl supported herself up and took the spatial bag with a glint in her eyes. “What else do you want?”
Shi Yu said, “After I set off, remember to make a wish every day and let my life go smoothly.”
The gem cat took out a gem fruit and said, “I understand, I understand!! But don’t blame me if the wish fails. After suffering, good things come!”
Shi Yu curled his lips and said, “I want to never suffer. Only when I’m sick in the head will I want good things to come after suffering.”
The gem cat also curled its lips and said, “Whatever you say. Just like how I think it’s bitter. I’m just afraid that you’ll encounter setbacks when you get there, so I’ll give you some spirit chicken soup first.”
“Alright, I’ll go find Principal Feng. Senior Lu should be here later.” Shi Yu waved.
Shi Yu planned to greet all his acquaintances after leaving this time.
Even individuals like Zou Yun, Gao Xuan, Ji Feng, Yu Shu, and Yin Zhengfan received greetings from Shi Yu, aiming to ignite their fighting spirit!
If a normal person saw this, they would definitely be angry. After all, they had been beaten up by Shi Yu before, but Shi Yu had brought a gift.
They weren’t ready-made.
They are all treasure maps of relics.
There were treasures in the ruins.
Of course, it wasn’t a Mythical Ruins or Legendary Ruins that Shi Yu had found through the “Passage of Time” skill.
These places were too dangerous and not friendly to young people.
They were all pillars of Dong Huang, so they couldn’t take too much risk.
Those ruins were all built by Shi Yu himself in the mystic realm space he built with Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng.
There were all kinds of checkpoints that weren’t human. Of course, there were also prizes.
After a few hundred years, it should be able to be called a ruin. He would let his own people mess around first.
Apart from that, there were also a few secret ones hidden all over the world. There was also one on the Ice Dragon Snow Mountain.
It was a little prank before leaving, waiting for the fated person to arrive.
As for juniors like An Chang and Fang Lan, the gifts Shi Yu prepared were relatively direct. He planned to entrust Principal Feng to bring them.
“Principal Feng.” After Shi Yu arrived at Principal Feng’s courtyard, he saw him trimming flowers with the Void Mantis.
“Shi Yu.” Principal Feng stopped.
“Shi Yu!!” After the Void Mantis saw Shi Yu, it immediately ran over and said, “Is there any news from the World Tree?”
Shi Yu said, “Yeah, Zi Lan has already returned to the World King Planet and brought back another batch of resources. In two days, I should also go to the World King Planet.”
“Brilliant.” The Void Mantis was extremely excited. When it chatted with Zi Lan, Zi Lan said that when it came the second time, she would definitely ask the Space Emperor for a pile of upgrade resources and guarantee that it would reach the demigod level. Then, she would give it the Teleportation Key Stones and cosmic crystals and send it to the Space Emperor.
It had been looking forward to it for a long time.
Even it felt that its current invincible overlord strength wasn’t enough.
“Shi Yu, after you reach the Space Emperor first, you’re not allowed to say that you defeated me. Just say that I’ve guided you for a long time and am a teacher and friend. Do you hear me?” the Void Mantis said.
Shi Yu’s teeth hurt. “You’ve already reminded me several times. I understand, I understand, Teacher Mantis.”
Didn’t he just want the Space Emperor to think highly of him?
It wasn’t a big deal.
They were brothers.
Moreover, the Void Mantis had indeed taught Buggy for a long time.
“Wu wu wu wu.” The Void Mantis’s eyes were filled with tears. A good person would have a safe life. When it became stronger than Shi Yu, it would definitely be gentle when taking revenge.
Principal Feng felt a headache when he heard that. He said, “As expected, we still have to go, but we’re actually leaving so quickly. Have you told Qingyi?”
“She’ll come over later. Let’s have a meal tonight,” Shi Yu said. “Call all the familiar faces. Master Qu Jie, Director Hao, and the others, I’ll cook!”
“Alright!” Principal Feng also knew that Shi Yu had hardened his wings. Not to mention him, even President Lin, Divine Source Legendary, and the World Tree probably couldn’t stop this guy’s exploration.
Soon, Senior Lu arrived at Ancient Capital University one step behind Shi Yu.
Just as she arrived in the courtyard, she saw Shi Yu promoting supplements to Principal Feng. Her face darkened. “Grandpa, when did you use supplements too?”
Principal Feng glared and said, “Don’t you see my age? If I don’t nourish myself, I won’t even be able to water the plants.”
“Alright, alright, alright.” Lu Qingyi stopped talking. She looked at Shi Yu and said, “When are you leaving?”
Shi Yu said, “Tomorrow. I’ll go to Wu Ling City and Dragon Palace City to take a look tomorrow.”
“Then when do you plan to come back?” Lu Qingyi asked.
Shi Yu thought for a moment and said, “Previously, Zi Lan seemed to have recommended me to participate in some competition. Perhaps I’ll go take a look. In short, I’ll adapt over there first and come back to take a look after seeing the world. In any case, it’s just a cosmic crystal. I didn’t ask the Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng for it. They can’t not give it to me, right?”
Lu Qingyi said helplessly, “Competition again? Class competition, national competition, and world competition. You’re going to the universe to compete again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1290 - 1290 Departure (2)
chapters.content:
1290 Departure (2)
Shi Yu was amused. “The competition is relatively safe. Aren’t you going to give it a try when you go over? I’ll go test the situation first. By the way, didn’t the World Tree say that there was another world competition? Senior, try to win this first.”
“I’ll fight for it.”
“After Baby Ginseng broke through, I left another pile of resources here. Use them as you see fit,” Shi Yu also threw Lu Qingyi a spatial bag and said.
Lu Qingyi grabbed it with one hand and said, “Then I won’t hold back.”
At the side, Principal Feng shook his head and said, “Qingyi, don’t join in the fun. Don’t you know your own talent? Be good and stay on the Blue Planet!”
“Ugh~” Lu Qingyi rejected. “Blue Planet doesn’t have any era ruins. I’ve never seen them.”
Blue Planet didn’t have many secrets anymore.
“The ruins of the era?” Principal Feng was stunned. “What’s that?”
“Cough, it’s nothing.” Lu Qingyi waved her hand and said, “You should rest.”
Shi Yu chuckled and said, “By the way, Senior Lu, there’s a map I wrote in the spatial bag. On it are many locations of ruins and mystic realms. I’ve confirmed the location, but I didn’t explore it. There are many Mythical Ruins among them. You can pull Teacher Ying along when you’re free.”
He pondered and said, “There are also a few life-saving tools made by Eleven and the others inside. Logically speaking… there shouldn’t be any danger, right? Well, it’s not a big problem. In any case, the World Tree said to help take care of Dong Huang. If there are any problems, just look for it.” Shi Yu clapped his fists. The plan worked.
“Really? How much did you store? After I explore the ruins, we’ll split the good stuff 50-50,” Lu Qingyi couldn’t help but say.
“50-50, sure.” Shi Yu chuckled.
“Shi Yu, don’t I have any farewell gifts?” The Void Mantis couldn’t help but interrupt. This was too much. Principal Feng had supplements, and Lu Qingyi had the ruins map. What about it?
Shi Yu said in disdain, “Senior Space Emperor must have brought you a pile of good things. Stop thinking about me. Why don’t we wait for Zi Lan to come and I’ll see what good things the Space Emperor brought you? Let’s change??”
The Void Mantis was furious. “Don’t even think about it.”
Shi Yu smiled. “Then you can follow Senior Lu and the others to explore the ruins. There will definitely be a pile of good things inside. Perhaps there will be a pile of mythical resources.”
The Void Mantis said, “It’s not impossible.”
It didn’t sound like exploring ruins, but more like picking up treasures.
The sky gradually darkened. On the Ancient Capital’s side, Shi Yu called Master Qu Jie, Dean Hao, Grandma Li, who had helped make Eleven’s evolution armor, and a group of people related to his growth began to entertain him.
Although most people didn’t know why Shi Yu was so generous today and wanted to treat them to a big meal, it would be a waste not to go.
In the end, Shi Yu even wrote an introduction letter to Master Qu Jie and introduced him to the Ancient God Golden Bull… After all, he and Grandpa Bull worshiped the Bull God…
The next day.
Shi Yu arrived at Wu Ling City again and came to see Lin Hongnian and the others.
There were also many familiar faces here. Senior Panda, Senior Beast Ear, Legend Hua, Butterfly God, and the others were all training here.
“Shi Yu, why are you here?” Lin Xiuzhu, who was researching new inscriptions, glanced at Shi Yu, who knocked on the door and entered. She was rather surprised and immediately put down her work and got up.
“Wu wu wu!!” Eleven, who was beside Shi Yu’s leg, said unhappily. Fine, ignore me.
Senior Panda was stunned. “Eleven, you heard wrong. I was talking about Eleven. Why are you here?”
Eleven was happy. So that was the case.
Shi Yu’s face darkened. Why would she believe what she said? She just said that they looked a little alike, but they were already demigods. Their hearing couldn’t be bad, right?
“It’s nothing. I was bored, so I came to take a look. Are you busy today? Call everyone over and treat you to a big meal. I’m going on a long trip tomorrow. I might not be back for a while.”
“Iron-eating Beast Corps and whatnot, give them half a day off too.”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven expressed that this was fine. How could the Iron-eating Beast Corps take a break?
“Then let’s let them train more. Let’s eat while they train more,” Shi Yu said.
Senior Panda nodded and smiled. “Sure, then sit for a while. I’ll call Teacher, Father, and the others. By the way, some time ago, Teacher Owl from Imperial Capital University also joined here to be a military advisor. It’s also here.”
“Alright, call them all.” Shi Yu also smiled. It seemed like he had left out the owl last time.
It was mainly to gather the Emperor Shi Army.
As Lin Xiuzhu went out, he said to Eleven beside him, “Aren’t you going to cheer for the Iron-eating Beast Corps?”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven shook its head. No, it was still thinking about how to spread the name of the Iron-eating Beast in the starry sky of the universe.
He would set an example for these little pandas, who had yet to leave the Blue Planet.
Among the cosmic races that resounded through the universe, there shouldn’t be an Iron-eating Beast Race, right? It wanted to be the first!
“What idea have you thought of?”
Eleven looked at Shi Yu with a burning gaze.
“Wuu! (Add points!)” Eleven raised its arms and cheered.
Shi Yu rolled his eyes and said, “I’ve used a lot of the power of Blue Planet’s world recently. I’ll add more when I get there.”
Shi Yu took a step forward and looked at the content that Senior Panda was currently researching. The tenth new inscription…
Good lord, he had dabbled deeply enough.
“Ling, look at this. Is it reliable? It should be of the same nature as the previous superalloy inscription,” Shi Yu said.
Ling appeared and glanced at it. “Well, similar, but Sister Panda should be researching high-level inscriptions, not super inscriptions. It’s relatively simple. I’ve taken a look and have already deduced the latter half. Do you want me to help write it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1291 - 1291 Departure (3)
chapters.content:
1291 Departure (3)
Shi Yu said, “No, Senior Lin is about to succeed. It must be a greater sense of accomplishment to develop it yourself.”
Ling was surprised. “Alright~”
“But this is too simple. Give her a few difficult cultivation questions, such as superalloy inscriptions. Give her a start.”
Ling, Eleven: ???
Was he a demon? Why was he tormenting this little girl like this?
“Master, I suspect that you’re jealous of the other party’s feeding talent.”
“Nonsense, I’m first in the Feeding Conference!”
…
At noon that day, the Emperor Wu Ruins in Wu Ling City was also very lively. The beast-eared girl even smugly told Shi Yu that she had already developed a top-notch Fusion Talent and could already fuse two pets at the same time!
She even performed for Shi Yu a few times.
Between her and Lin Xiuzhu, one passed the top-notch Fusion Talent and the other passed the Demon God Iron-eating Beast. They even easily passed the legend assessment from Master Qu Jie.
Shi Yu and the others were also full this time. However, at a good banquet, there were also birds who didn’t do proper things. For example, the owl pulled Buggy over to instill wrong thoughts in him.
“On this trip to the starry sky, you’ll definitely encounter many beautiful starry sky butterflies. Seize the opportunity!”
“I’ll watch you on Blue Planet, watch, watch.”
“Ji!!” Buggy expressed its disdain. Tch, starry butterflies? Was it as beautiful as the butterfly it created?
“Huh?” The owl was shocked. What did Buggy mean?
Could it be that this guy wanted to optimize itself into a race that reproduced asexually??
It wasn’t like there weren’t such cases. Although the talent potential of the descendants born of two powerful creatures might be higher, it was difficult. But if it was reproduction itself and passed down, the difficulty could decrease greatly…
“Yi! (Don’t worry about Buggy’s marriage. Now, it only has eyes for roaming the starry sky!)” Baby Ginseng crawled to their side and pointed. It told the owl that if it had the time to bewitch it, it might as well predict Shi Yu and the others’ legendary experience in the starry sky in the next two days!
Perhaps it could freeload on demigods!
The owl felt that what he said made sense. After eating, it immediately ran to enter seclusion.
After lunch, Shi Yu and the others walked around and arrived at Dragon Palace City. As the current Dragon God, Buggy still had to make more preparations before leaving.
In Dragon Palace City, Shi Yu also left behind a ruin.
However, it wasn’t a self-built ruin this time.
Instead, they left the Blue Sea Ruins behind and left Blue Planet. It was useless to want this. The inheritance power inside had already disappeared, and nothing existed anymore. Only the teleportation function remained.
Susu left behind a few memory crystals and created a new Blue Sea inheritance. From today on, it was going to the Cosmic Sea to pursue the Star Sea Sprite. It hoped that one day, a new Blue Sea Sprite could be born on the Blue Planet.
These were all gifts it had left for the other party. Sooner or later, the fated person would inherit this power.
“Big Brother, Big Brother, you guys go first. I’ll follow later!”
After bidding farewell to the Ice Dragon King, the Sea Dragon King, and the others, Shi Yu was pestered by the little white dragon.
When the Sea Dragon King communicated with Zi Lan, the Phoenix Man, and the others, it expressed that it had given up on returning to Lin Feng’s side. It only hoped that Lin Feng could bring the little white dragon over to nurture it if he had the chance. It was fine to find a cosmic genius to contract and then leave.
It was time for this guy to wander.
Unfortunately, apart from Shi Yu, the little white dragon didn’t fancy anyone else.
It expressed that it wanted to wait for a demigod and go to the World King Planet itself. It didn’t need other Beast Tamers.
“You’re a little far from a demigod, right?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
The little white dragon said, “That’s right, so I hope that when I’m a demigod, Big Brother, you’ve already become a universe overlord over there!”
“No, I can’t talk nonsense with you anymore.” Shi Yu had other things to do. He didn’t want to daydream with this guy.
“Huh?” The little white dragon watched Shi Yu leave with tears in its eyes. Big Brother, a universe overlord was the highest level it could think of. Wasn’t it enough??
…
After bidding farewell to the Ice Dragon King, the Sea Dragon King, and the others, Shi Yu entered Little Zi’s body.
Turtle Island.
A blue Longevity Turtle had been cultivating bitterly for several months. During this period, it experienced various difficult natural environments and fought many ferocious beast phantoms. It was experienced.
A few days ago, its resistance level had already reached intermediate.
As the food provided by Shi Yu wasn’t bad, its growth level wasn’t suppressed. It reached the monarch level.
Monarchs couldn’t be brought directly to the World King Planet, so Shi Yu had come this time to plan to contract them.
In a few months, the resistance had gone from low to medium. At least, be it this turtle, that snake, or the cat, they had persevered. Shi Yu was quite satisfied.
“Hu!!!” The muscular, little Longevity Turtle sat on the rock. After training, it gulped down the Spirit Soda. There was a huge cross scar on its chest, a wound left behind from battle. Originally, it could have used the Water of Life to heal it at that time, but in order to prove that it was a man, it decisively stayed behind and planned to meet the Little Quas Snake in the future.
It, the Longevity Turtle, had been working hard!
“Have you completed the training mission?” Shi Yu’s sudden appearance shocked the Longevity Turtle. It immediately jumped down from the rock and pointed at the calm sea.
Tsunami Suppression Quests Completed!
“Hu hu hu!!!” The Longevity Turtle looked smug. Easy!
Shi Yu smiled and shook his head. Although the current Longevity Turtle and the others had been trained for a few months, they still mainly relied on resistance. Their battle power wasn’t high. This guy was so smug now, but it would get beaten up later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1292 - 1292 Departure (4)
chapters.content:
1292 Departure (4)
However, his resistance wasn’t low anymore. When the time came, his crying shouldn’t be that intense.
It wanted to destroy its turtle prime minister dream.
Turtle: ???
“Hu hu hu!!!” The turtle was shocked and found it difficult to accept.
“Hu hu!! (Lord, why didn’t you call me when you usurped the throne? Why!!)”
“Hu hu!! (Didn’t we agree to let me assist you in snatching Dragon Palace City!!)” The turtle was immediately nervous. It seemed like it was too weak now?
“Hu hu hu!! (Sorry, I’ll work hard. I’ll definitely be able to help the next time I snatch power from Dong Huang!!)”
Shi Yu rolled his eyes and said, “There’s no need. Next, I’m leaving Blue Planet. Do you want to come with me? When we’re there, you can assist me in completing the Spring and Autumn great undertakings. However, the experts over there are much stronger than on Blue Planet.”
“A finger can crush Blue Planet.”
The turtle was stunned. Water steam suddenly emitted from its body and ignited. It gave Shi Yu a thumbs up.
As expected of the lord, the target was actually the universe?
“Hu!!! (I’m willing to go through fire and water for my lord!!)” The little Longevity Turtle immediately expressed its loyalty.
Shi Yu was silent. Because of telepathy, he could confirm that this guy wasn’t pretending, but was really so clueless.
“Then let’s contract it. From today on, you can stop training. You still have to move. You’ll have two new neighbors, the dragon monster and the duck monster that fought in the training ruins previously.”
“Huh?” The turtle was stunned.
Next, Shi Yu activated the third contract of the second Beast Taming Space and contracted this Little Longevity Turtle. He planned to bring it to the World King Planet to nurture it. He definitely had to explore the ruins of the Four Holy Beasts Era.
At that time, the benefits he explored would be received by the four holy beasts he cultivated.
The third contract was completed. As the little turtle was too weak now, Shi Yu didn’t receive any feedback. On the other hand, this Longevity Turtle, whose resistance had passed the slot and whose battle power was still a little difficult, suddenly increased its aura as it entered the Beast Taming Space, scaring itself.
Its battle power jumped from normal to top-notch monarch.
“Roar! (A newbie.)”
“Quack! (Hello, duck, do you remember me? It’s me.)”
“Hu… (How… are… you guys?)”
The short gem cat had also experienced a few months of training. Under the temptation of the sharpness around Shi Yu, the training progress of this fanatical fan also improved by leaps and bounds.
It was clearly a transcendent race, but under the nutritious food of the intermediate resistance training, its growth level easily broke through the limit and reached commander rank.
As Shi Yu arrived, its gem eyes immediately lit up like stars. It directly bumped into Shi Yu’s leg and hugged his thigh fiercely.
“Mi!!! (Idol, you’re finally back. Wu wu wu, I missed you so much.)”
Shi Yu lifted the little female cat up and said with a headache, “How many times have I told you? Girls have to be more reserved. You have to learn from Teacher Ying and use her as an example.”
Shorty was first aggrieved, then suspicious. Really?
Was it really going to use Teacher Ying as an example?
“Alright, let’s use that panda as an example,” Shi Yu said.
Sigh, Teacher Ying had worked hard for hundreds of years, no, two lifetimes, but its resistance had been surpassed by a young cat a few months old.
He really couldn’t let Shorty use Teacher Ying as an example against his will.
Shorty expressed its understanding!
“Mi!!” Moreover, as Shi Yu arrived, the short gem cat immediately wanted to praise him.
Its training quests were exceedingly well completed.
The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched, so he didn’t understand why Turtle and Little Quas had spent a lot of effort to complete the special training at that time. This cat had completed it extra for a few photos.
However, it was good that it was completed. As a cat, it was much stronger than Teacher Ying. With the aptitude of Panda King Eleven, if only it could have a little more of the demeanor of an expert.
“Congratulations, the test has been completed. Next, are you interested in leaving Blue Planet with me and taking a risk in the universe? When the time is right, I’ll start to bring you to battle and explore. Of course, what you have to experience might be even more dangerous than now,” Shi Yu said to Shorty.
After all… even the ancestor of the Kirin Race was hanging in the ruins of the era…
“Meow, meow, meow, meow!!!” The short gem cat was unhappy. Was this doubting its courage!
It had long been prepared for everything!! It planned to fight for Shi Yu and make all the lives in the universe become fans of Shi Yu.
The stars were clear, and the stars were dazzling. All the fans, meow, meow, meow, meow! It raised its palm with a determined attitude.
Shi Yu: …
Great, another one who wanted to go to the universe to preach.
How talented.
The second Beast Taming Space, the fourth contract, activate!
Soon, in the second Beast Taming Space, the turtle, who was sitting obediently on a rock and trembling, was asked by Little Ji and Duckie which was the boss, earth or ocean. It finally saw a straw to clutch at.
It looked excitedly at the short-legged gem cat that appeared with a white flash.

chapters.title: Chapter 1293 - 1293 Departure (5)
chapters.content:
1293 Departure (5)
“Hu, Hu!! (There’s a newbie, go and ask it!!)” The turtle immediately shifted its grudge.
Little Ji and Duckie were also stunned and looked at the new short-legged gem cat.
Unexpectedly, when the short gem cat saw them, its eyes immediately lit up, and it started meowing.
“Meow!! (Most handsome and domineering, the embodiment of disaster, the overlord of the earth, Senior Little Ji!!)”
“Meow!! (The coolest and most stylish, ruler of the abyss, master of the ocean, esteemed Duckie!!)”
Little Ji and Duckie looked at each other. This newbie’s words were really nice. It was much better than the turtle that only knew how to shrink its shell.
“Roar!!”
“Quack!!”
Turtle: ???
…
In the end, Shi Yu came to Little Quas on Snake Island. Like the turtle, it had also reached medium resistance. At the same time, its growth level had also reached the monarch level.
During this period of time, it worked hard enough. In order to complete various training quests, it had squeezed itself to the limit.
It was considered the most normal of the three pets. Under Shi Yu’s attention, he could confirm that it could persist because it relied on its faith of becoming stronger. It was ten thousand times more reliable than the faith of chasing celebrities.
Because falling in love with a turtle that crossed races wasn’t allowed. It wanted to become stronger and control its fate, not wanting to be restricted by rules.
This was because Shi Yu had extended a helping hand and saved it from confinement, giving it hope and the opportunity to become stronger. It wanted to become stronger and serve Minister Shi Yu.
These were the two faiths in the Little Quas Snake’s heart that fed its desire to become stronger.
But there were problems.
He was more or less a little arrogant.
If not for Shi Yu’s telepathy and being able to sense the little guys’ emotional fluctuations, the Little Quas Snake would have even started to doubt itself.
It was clearly still worried about the turtle. It became stronger because of this, but it insisted that it had nothing to do with the other party, and that it was purely to control its fate that it became stronger.
It was clearly very grateful to the turtle and had secretly made up its mind to seriously pass the test and become stronger to repay it, but he had never been as straightforward as the turtle. It just trained silently and never expressed anything.
There was once when Shi Yu really couldn’t help but ask questions. It directly made the snake blush for the whole day and almost burned it into a roasted snake.
Right on the heels of that, it broke through to the monarch level.
It was also from that day onward that the Little Quas Snake underwent a transformation.
It should have trained and grown. Its personality had changed drastically, and it could face anything calmly.
Her personality transformed from being proud and tsundere to truly becoming a queen-like character, displaying strong determination.
This made Shi Yu feel very sorry for Brother Turtle. He felt that it would suffer in the future.
“Little Quas, stop training.” After Shi Yu arrived, he immediately stopped it. The Little Quas Snake looked at Shi Yu with a serious expression. “Wu~ (Hello, Minister).”
Shi Yu said, “I’m going to the starry sky next. It’s very dangerous there.”
The Little Quas Snake revealed a serious expression. “Wu! (Bring me along. It won’t be long before I can help.)”
“Alright, alright, alright.” Shi Yu smiled helplessly and said, “In addition, congratulations on passing the test. I’ll let you meet an old friend. Come on.”
The Little Quas Snake was stunned. It thought of something and looked at the fourth contract of the second Beast Taming Space activated by Shi Yu.
At the same time.
Little Ji, Duckie, and the others didn’t expect newbies to come so frequently.
Just as Shorty was introducing Little Ji and Senior Duckie’s glorious deeds to the turtle, a light flashed, and a noble and rich-looking blue and white Quas Snake appeared in the Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, when it saw the Quas Snake, the turtle suddenly got up in disbelief.
“Quack? (Do you know her?)”
“Hu, hu, hu!!! (It, it, it’s my girlfriend!!!)” The turtle’s eyes were filled with tears, and its entire body trembled. It didn’t expect to finally see its girlfriend after half a year.
Under the shocked gazes of Little Ji, Duckie, and Shorty, the turtle ran excitedly toward the elegant and noble Quas Snake.
At this moment, the Little Quas Snake also discovered the turtle and the surrounding seniors. It had mixed feelings. However, in the face of the excited turtle, it still raised its head and looked at the turtle with its noble eyes.
Bang!!!
When the turtle ran over, Little Quas directly stopped it with a Quas tail, froze it, and sent it flying.
“Wu~ (Looks like you’ve completely wasted the past half a year. Come again when you become stronger than me.)” The Little Quas Snake pushed away the frozen block of ice and went to visit the seniors under the stunned expression of the turtle in the ice.
The turtle was stunned. It didn’t understand why Little Quas, who was fine with it previously, suddenly didn’t acknowledge it.
“Hu! (No!!!! Little Quas!!)” The turtle was heartbroken.
What did it do wrong?
At this moment, Shi Yu, who had secretly glanced at the Beast Taming Space, sighed. It was alright. The relationship between the two parties was still there, but the female was a little stronger. It wasn’t a big problem.
At the moment, the turtles of the monarch race and the Longevity Turtle weren’t good at battle, so it was indeed very difficult to defeat the Winter Water Snakes of the overlord race. However, it just had to work hard.
It wasn’t a big problem if it couldn’t defeat the snake.
In terms of fighting, it seemed like the snake was indeed on top of the turtle?
“Snow~ Flowers fluttering~ The north wind is whistling, and the world is vast.” Shi Yu hummed a song, ending the contract of the three new pets.
Apart from that, he actually had a Demon Divine Stone. The demon cub sealed inside was in a state of suspended animation, but in the current environment of the Blue Planet, he couldn’t awaken it before the revival of the laws. Shi Yu didn’t know if he could bring it to the World King Planet, so he simply threw it to the gem cat before coming and let it watch first.

chapters.title: Chapter 1294 - 1294 Departure (6)
chapters.content:
1294 Departure (6)
Now, Shi Yu’s intention of nurturing the Demon Race wasn’t very strong. He only wanted to go to the universe to catch a cosmic behemoth to play with.
…
Shi Yu left the Dragon Palace and finally called President Lin.
“Are you ready?” President Lin knew that Shi Yu had been bidding farewell to him in the past two days. At this moment, when he saw Shi Yu calling him, he knew that he was almost ready and planned to set off.
“Yeah,” Shi Yu said. “Is Senior Divine Source beside you?”
“Yes,” President Lin said.
“President Lin, Senior Divine Source, is there anything else you want to tell me?” Shi Yu asked.
“Yes.” Senior Divine Source’s shout came from the other side. “If you see that kid Lin Feng and he says bad things about me, note it down in your little notebook and bring it back for me to see in the future.”
Shi Yu and President Lin: “…”
“Also, he must have started a family over there and cultivated many genius descendants. There’s no need to be polite. Try your best to display your talent and shock him.”
Shi Yu and President Lin: “…”
President Lin: “Alright, that’s all Senior Divine Source has to say…”
“No, I’m not done…”
“When you get there, it’s different from here. Be careful,” President Lin said in the end. Shi Yu nodded heavily.
In the end, after bidding farewell to President Lin and Senior Divine Source, Shi Yu flew around the Blue Planet and finally returned to Inatella. At this moment, Senior Dragon God was still waiting here. Zi Lan had already left Inatella and headed for Dong Huang. The other three aliens, as well as the chosen Fallen Angel and the Holy Maiden, also went where they should go.
There was also the World Tree waiting silently for Shi Yu’s arrival.
“Coming?” When the World Tree clone saw Shi Yu, who had descended, it threw Shi Yu a leaf that contained 100 elemental divine-level energy crystals.
“Your things.”
After Shi Yu put it away, he nodded and said, “Thank you.”
“Alright, go if there’s nothing else,” the World Tree clone said with heartache. It was free just now and checked the accounts again. It realized that not only had it consumed a lot of world power to condense the cosmic crystal, but Shi Yu had also really taken a lot of time recently.
It was simply harder than raising a divine level.
Go, go. At least, he could return after it completed its restoration.
“Alright, Senior Dragon God~!!” Shi Yu shouted. The Dragon God, who was cultivating elsewhere on the island, also opened her eyes and flew up to look at Shi Yu.
After she landed, she said, “Are you ready?”
Shi Yu nodded. “I’m ready. Let’s go.”
The World Tree clone took a deep breath and said, “Have a safe trip, the two of you.”
The Dragon God nodded and thanked him. “Thank you for your nurturing these two days, Lord World Tree.”
Obviously, the World Tree had also prepared a lot of good things for the Dragon God in the past two days.
Shi Yu smiled.
“Senior Dragon God, you first?”
He looked at Senior Dragon God, who revealed a helpless expression on her beautiful face. “Are you still afraid that something will happen?”
“How could that be? Then I’ll go first?” Shi Yu smiled and took out the Teleportation Key Stone and cosmic crystal.
Logically speaking, this teleportation was relatively safe, right?
The Teleportation Key Stones were all produced by the World King Planet. The World King was the top life form in the universe. There couldn’t be an accident, right?
Looking at the prop in his hand, he took a deep breath and was a little nervous and excited.
“Are you ready?” Shi Yu finally asked the pets, who had already gathered in the Beast Taming Space and were also filled with anticipation.
“Wuu!!” Eleven said this and waved its bamboo. Ready, starry sky, charge!
“Ji~” In the form of a green worm, Buggy looked up at the starry sky and at a higher stage.
“Yiya!! (My divine-level first clear!)” Baby Ginseng couldn’t wait anymore.
“Mi. (Will there be more good dramas?)” Chi Tong cared about this. In any case, it had watched most of the domestic and overseas shows on Blue Planet.
“Ning!! (Opportunity of the Star Sea Sprite!)” Susu’s eyes were filled with starlight. Shi Yu was most worried about this guy.
This was because among the five cosmic-level factions in the starry sky, apart from the cosmic overlord army, the cosmic behemoth race, and the World King Planet, there was another one that was relatively similar to the Abyss Race and the Yun Race… Forget it, it wouldn’t think too much.
“Let’s go!” Ling said.
The basketball-sized Qi hugged Little Zi, who was the size of a rice ball, and was a little nervous. “Ahhh, it must be even more dangerous over there. More people want to catch me.”
Ling was helpless. So it asked it to stay on the Blue Planet, but it insisted on following. Now, it was afraid.
“Mm, I’ve never left Blue Planet…” Qi was also very curious.
“Roar!!” “Quack!!!” In the second space, under the influence of Little Ji and Duckie’s fearless and disdainful auras, Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty felt good.
As the saying goes, youth knew no fear. The few of them were the most excited.
What trash universe? Was it as powerful as the earth and ocean? Little Ji and Duckie thought.
“Farewell, Blue Planet.” After hearing the responses of his pets, Shi Yu finally activated the Teleportation Key Stone.
“All the best, you guys are the strongest,” the World Tree said again.
Go, wreak havoc on the World King Planet!
“See you over there.” The Dragon God also directly activated the Teleportation Key Stone.
“Yes, see you over there.”
As the cosmic crystal fused into the Teleportation Key Stone, Shi Yu raised his head and glanced at the World Tree clone and the Dragon God.
Then, his entire body was wrapped in a strong white light. Following that, he disappeared from the Blue Planet and headed to the new world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1295 - 1295 Mad Journey (1)
chapters.content:
1295 Mad Journey (1)
“Welcome to the World King Planet.”
“Shi Yu, Senior Dragon God, you’re finally here.”
Cosmic Sea, World King Planet.
Before Shi Yu could open his eyes, he heard a familiar voice.
At this moment, he felt that his head was a mess, and he was dizzy.
This teleportation process was even more disgusting than he imagined.
After activating the Teleportation Key Stone, Shi Yu entered a pitch-black world.
Then, this world seemed to have started to travel up and down like a roller coaster. It was ten thousand times more serious than that, almost making Shi Yu spit out everything he had eaten previously.
Until now, he still felt uncomfortable, as if Eleven was pressing down on him.
After opening his eyes, Shi Yu saw the scene in front of him clearly.
This was a huge square. There were hundreds of huge altars inside, and he was on a certain altar.
In front of him was a young man in fashionable clothes. He stood not far away and looked at him with a bitter expression.
“Qi Mu.”
When Shi Yu saw the other party, he immediately realized that this was the Phoenix man.
“This is Sky City. Next, I’ll bring you to Lord Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng,” the Phoenix man said.
It looked like he had been thrown over by the Space Emperor and Lin Feng as a guide.
“Is this the World King Planet?” Shi Yu heard the voice and looked over. He realized that Senior Dragon God had also successfully arrived at the altar beside him. At this moment, she was standing on the altar and looking up at the sky.
It was still the blue sky and white flowing clouds. However, several huge suns could be seen in the starry sky, and there were five clearer ones.
“Looks like we’re here. It feels very good.” Shi Yu also sensed the surrounding natural energy excitedly. His Beast Taming Space had never been so happy.
For example, Ling and the others instantly sensed that the world suppression that had once restricted their growth had completely disappeared.
In this place, one could easily break through to the divine level.
At this energy level, even if demigod creatures lacked food resources and relied on natural nurturing, they wouldn’t need to “hibernate” to reduce their energy consumption.
Moreover, in such a place with sufficient natural energy, there was no lack of high-level spiritual plants and divine plants.
Awesome.
Shi Yu felt that they would definitely be able to fight in this place!
It was this gravity… Eleven and the others were alright, but Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty might have to adapt for a long time.
In addition, Shi Yu also sensed the strength of this world.
On the incomplete Blue Planet, demigod-level battles could cause the world to tremble. On this side, it would probably take some effort for demigods to level a mountain.
After all, the main body of this world was a cosmic life form. If it wanted to break through the defense of a cosmic life form… It was even difficult for it to be at the super divine level, let alone a demigod.
“Cough, cough.” The corners of Phoenix Man’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch when he saw Shi Yu and Senior Dragon God ignoring him.
He introduced,
“The realm where Sky City is located is outside the top 10,000. It’s considered a relatively ordinary realm with relatively ordinary resources. Even the Blue Planet at its peak should be inferior. The realm at the top of the number is where the natural resources are rich.”
“When I’m free, I can bring you guys on a trip.”
“Uh.” Shi Yu was stunned. “It’s even inferior to the peak Blue Planet?”
Qi Mu nodded and said, “Resources are always concentrated at the head. Although the World King Planet is a cosmic star, the districts that ordinary factions can use can’t be the core.”
“Otherwise, why do you think the five god races didn’t stay on the World King Planet and wanted to help their mother planet break through to the super divine level before returning?”
“Even Lord Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng usually stay on the divine-level star contracted by Lord Space Emperor, not here. Although the World King Planet isn’t bad, there are too many factions above, and the resources aren’t enough.”
“Alright, I’ll bring you to see Lord Space Emperor and the others first,” the Phoenix man said. “They’ve long been waiting here.”
After Shi Yu and the Dragon God looked at each other, they nodded and looked at the Phoenix man. “You’ve worked hard. Lead the way.”
…
After Shi Yu and the Dragon God arrived at the World King Planet, Phoenix Man quickly contacted the Space Emperor and Lin Feng.
Then, he led Shi Yu and the Dragon God to where the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were.
Just like the name of Sky City, this was a huge floating city in the sky.
The altar they came out of was still higher in the city.
Flying out of here, although there weren’t many tall buildings, there were countless extremely spectacular buildings. They were even more luxurious than the big cities of the Shen Feng Nation.
The aircraft in the sky flowed continuously. Many overlord-level robots maintained public order in the city. Even the cleaning robots had extraordinary battle power.
“Follow me,” the Phoenix man called out and flew towards the tallest building in Sky City, a Sky Tower that shot into the sky.
Shi Yu and the Dragon God followed behind. As they sized up the city, they observed the tall tower in front of them.
At the top of the tall tower, outside a building hall that looked like a temple, two men stood there. One was a middle-aged man in a black robe with long hair and an extraordinary aura, and the other was a short-haired young man in a human-like formal suit with a weak expression. Their expressions were slightly excited.
Swoosh!
As the Phoenix Man and the others arrived, the two of them looked at the Dragon God excitedly.
“Senior Dragon God, long time no see. I’ve finally waited for you.” Be it the Space Emperor or Lin Feng, they were respectful when they saw the Dragon God, as if they had seen their elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1296 - 1296 Mad Journey (2)
chapters.content:
1296 Mad Journey (2)
At the side, the Phoenix man couldn’t help but sigh. This Dragon God was indeed powerful. The incomparably powerful Lord Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng had obtained her protection before they grew up. It was said that Shi Yu was the same. Next, the Dragon God might become the one with the most extraordinary status among the factions of the Floating Planet.
Now, seeing that she couldn’t see through the power of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng, and that their divine power was incomparably distant, the Dragon God herself sighed.
“Senior Dragon God, let’s talk inside,” the Space Emperor said.
“Also, this is Shi Yu, right?” He looked at Shi Yu beside him and smiled. “I’ve heard Zi Lan introduce you. Let’s go in together.”
“Alright, Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng.” Shi Yu also smiled. He had finally seen a living person.
Next, he had to have a good chat. He had many things to ask.
“Qi Mu, go back first.” Lin Feng glanced at Qi Mu and said, “I’ll call you later.”
“Yes, Lord Lin Feng.” Qi Mu nodded repeatedly and didn’t disturb the Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng from catching up with their hometown.
In the blink of an eye, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng led Shi Yu and the Dragon God into the hall of the divine hall. Tea had already been prepared here and it was very quiet. After inviting Shi Yu and the Dragon God to sit, the Space Emperor Kong said, “Senior Dragon God, my little friend Shi Yu, what do you think of this World King Planet and this Sky City?”
The Dragon God said, “It’s indeed not bad. Looks like I can finally break through the bottleneck after being stuck for so long.”
“Hahaha, Senior Dragon God, I didn’t expect you to look so young at more than a thousand years old.” Lin Feng laughed and said, “I thought you would…”
The Dragon God cast an unfriendly gaze, making Lin Feng suddenly shut his mouth.
The Space Emperor coughed. He also knew that Lin Feng was out of place. He couldn’t hide his gaze that wanted to stab someone.
Shi Yu also revealed an awkward and polite smile at the side. Damn, this Senior Lin Feng really dared to say it. Did he want to say that he thought the Dragon God had become Granny Dragon?
“Senior Dragon God, don’t be in a hurry to break through. I heard that there’s a super competition on World King Planet that can only be participated in by those below the divine level. When the time comes, we can all participate and take a look.” Shi Yu helped change the topic.
The Space Emperor nodded and said, “Indeed, there are many special things on the World King Planet. For example, only those below the divine level can participate in the God Sealing Battle. If time and conditions allow, it’s better to try your best to reach the extreme of a realm before breaking through. This way, not only will the foundation after breaking through be more solid, but you can also accumulate a lot of foundation for the future path.”
“Back then, Lin Feng and I only came to the World King Planet after reaching the divine level, so we missed many opportunities.”
“Yeah,” Lin Feng said. “Next, you guys rest well in Sky City and adapt for a period of time. The technological civilization on the World King Planet is still relatively developed, and it’s easier to accept information. I’ll give you a data chip later. Through intelligent mechanical lives, you can connect to the virtual network here and quickly understand the local customs here.”
“By the way, Senior Dragon God, do you not have mechanical equipment?” Lin Feng said.
Although technology had also developed on the Blue Planet later, he felt that Senior Dragon God didn’t seem to know how to come into contact with mechanics.
“Well, I indeed don’t have that kind of thing,” the Dragon God said.
“Sorry to trouble you,” the Dragon God said. “My current strength is far inferior to yours. Then I’ll work hard to increase my strength first. After breaking through to the divine level, I’ll see if there’s anything I can help you with.”
“You’re welcome, you’re welcome.” Lin Feng smiled and said, “There’s nothing I need help with for the time being. This is a long-term big project. You should experience the World King Planet first. This place is very big. Without the teleportation array, even if a top-notch god travels with all his might, it’s impossible to walk halfway in his life.”
“And the God Sealing Battle Shi Yu mentioned just now is also a competition very worth trying. If we can achieve good results in this competition, not only can we become a little famous in the Cosmic Sea, but we can also help Blue Planet accelerate its evolution!”
“Oh?” The Dragon God said, “I’ve heard you guys talk about the God Sealing Battle just now. I haven’t understood it yet. Can you tell me in detail?”
The Space Emperor nodded and said, “It’s a super competition organized by the World King Planet in which demigods can participate. The essence is to compete in battle power.”
“The top 10,000 have rich rewards. Among them, every contestant in the top 100 can obtain a Teleportation Key Stone. According to their ranking, they can also obtain different numbers of divine-level cosmic crystals. They are the only source and outlet of the Teleportation Key Stones.”
“Therefore, the various large factions attached to the World King Star are especially concerned about this competition.”
“Every year, millions of demigods participate.”
Shi Yu and the Dragon God were shocked. No wonder it was said that obtaining good results in this competition could accelerate Blue Planet’s evolution.
Divine-level cosmic crystals, Teleportation Key Stones… They were all good things that could allow Blue Planet to connect to the starry sky faster!
“Among them, the reward for first place is even better. Even super divine levels will be envious.” The Space Emperor said, “Guess what it is?”
“What?” Shi Yu asked.
Emperor Kong said, “The second to ten thousand are all physical rewards, but the first place is an opportunity.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1297 - 1297 Mad Journey (3)
chapters.content:
1297 Mad Journey (3)
“Opportunity?”
“Yes, an opportunity. If you obtain first place in the God Sealing Battle, you can obtain a challenge opportunity. The opponent is a real divine-level, and it’s not as simple as a new god.”
“Defeat it and you can obtain the ‘World King Planet Permanent Teleportation Array’. It ignores the user’s strength and number of non-consumable Permanent Teleportation Arrays.”
The Space Emperor smiled and said, “Although it’s just a Permanent Teleportation Array, its value is very high. It largely determines the development speed of a planet’s civilization.”
“If a planet and a faction really want to grow up, they still have to wander in the starry sky and open up their own territory. Only then can they unearth more resources and be permanently protected by the World King Planet. It’s impossible to transcend. And with this teleportation array, they can escape immediately in times of danger. When their territory obtains huge gains, they can trade with the factions on the World King Planet at any time.”
“Even if I don’t need this, countless planetary life forms and super divine factions are willing to pay a huge price to buy it. Its value is immeasurable. Even if I rent it out, the benefits it brings are incomparably huge.”
“If we can build this teleportation array on Blue Planet, after Blue Planet develops for a period of time, it can be said to have advanced to a high-level planet.”
The Dragon God was silent. So that was the case. No wonder it was so popular. This reward was indeed tempting. It was a reward that could continuously bring huge benefits!
“But it’s probably very difficult to take it…” Shi Yu said.
The first place wouldn’t be given the teleportation array, only an opportunity to grab it!
He felt like it was a trap.
“Well, it’s indeed very difficult to obtain good results in this competition, because it can participate again,” the Space Emperor said. “Even if you obtain first place, as long as you obtain that opportunity and fail the challenge, you can still participate in the God Sealing Battle again. Unless the challenge is successful, you will be banned from the competition. Therefore, it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens to obtain first place. Countless ridiculous demigod-levels have already accumulated in the God Sealing Battle.”
“In the recent God Sealing Battle, one person has already been first place 79 times. However, he hasn’t successfully challenged it. I wonder how long he will last.”
“The current second place winner previously won the championship for 101 consecutive years and didn’t successfully challenge it. However, after being defeated by the current first place, she has always been in second place.”
“Pfft.” After the Space Emperor finished speaking, Shi Yu almost choked.
Damn, among so many contestants, he won 79 consecutive championships? 101 championships?
What level of monster was this?
The Dragon God beside him also fell into deep thought.
Shi Yu was speechless.
This competition was very sneaky. There were rewards for the second to ten thousandth place, but he obtained the first place. It was very likely that there were no rewards at all?
“This is actually quite normal. The highest record seems to be that there was a Beast Tamer who got first place for more than a thousand years but didn’t succeed in the challenge.” Lin Feng smiled.
“Is it worth it?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say, “With this time, he might have broken through to the super divine level.”
“Haha, the super divine level is even harder than this,” Lin Feng said. “By the way, do you know the conditions to break through to a super divine level?”
Shi Yu shook his head.
He made a guess. “Could it be that the divine skill has to reach a certain level?”
Lin Feng shook his head and said, “No, at the divine level, when the divine skill is trained to perfection, it will be at a bottleneck and can’t increase anymore.”
“Unless I advance to the super divine level, it’s possible to continue increasing.”
“And there are only three ways to advance to the super divine level.”
“The first is that in the universe, a mysterious substance can be born every 100,000 years. It’s called the source of transcendence by all races. After absorbing it, you can advance to the super divine level. Although it’s also difficult to absorb, as long as it’s a top-notch god, it should be able to succeed. The difficulty is to obtain the source of transcendence.”
“Every time this thing is born, it will cause a storm of blood. The divine blood will dye the starry sky.”
“The second method is to hunt life forms that have already reached super divine levels. When super divine levels fall, there’s a chance of dropping the source of transcendence and being absorbed by the divine levels around them who kill them.”
“This method is also incomparably difficult, so in the universe, there are often rumors of battles below. For this, perhaps there’s no aggro. It’s just to take another step forward.”
“Back then, Senior Space Emperor and I went to the battlefield and assassinated a weak, super divine foreign race that had just ended the battle. Unfortunately, although we succeeded, it didn’t drop the source of transcendence.”
“The third method is that in the universe, apart from the source of transcendence that’s naturally born every 100,000 years, there’s another place where there might be a transcendent source. There might be a source of transcendence left in the ruins of the last era.”
“Many lucky people who accidentally entered the ruins of the era accidentally found the source of transcendence.”
“For example, the current five super divine levels of our Blue Planet’s five major divine races. Back then, they were the top five geniuses of the five major divine races who had all reached the top Divine Realm. Their relationship was very good. For the sake of opportunity, they explored the ruins of the era together.”
“The chances of failure in exploring the ruins of the era are greater than success. It’s very dangerous. However, they’re very lucky. Apart from that genius of the Kirin Race who was heavily injured, the others are harmless. Moreover, they successfully found five sources of transcendence and were able to break through.”
“Therefore, this period of time is the most prosperous period of the five divine races.”
“However, the super divines of the five divine races also know that they were lucky and knew what kind of trash they were. In order to not be hunted by other divine-level geniuses above their level and become nutrients, they went into seclusion for millions of years and didn’t come out. Until now, they’re still in seclusion most of the time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1298 - 1298 Mad Journey (4)
chapters.content:
1298 Mad Journey (4)
“The World King Planet wars with the other three cosmic factions all year round. As super divines of the World King Planet, they have never been to the battlefield, so they’re very disliked by the World King Planet. Therefore, although they’re super divines, compared to the other super divines killed, the territory resources aren’t very good.”
“This is also the reason why the five god races joined forces with us to contact our mother planet this time, hoping to help our mother planet break through. If Blue Planet advances to a high-level planet, the resources on it are at least better than their current territory.”
“Oh right, other races need the source of transcendence to break through to the super divine level, but only planetary life forms don’t need it. They can directly absorb the origin of the universe and directly advance. They can be considered to have a unique talent, but the time needed will be a little long. Sometimes, without special opportunities, they can’t successfully break through even after cultivating for a cosmic era.”
After Lin Feng finished speaking, Shi Yu and the Dragon God fell silent again.
They didn’t expect it to be so difficult to advance to the super divine level.
Especially Shi Yu. His heart turned cold. He couldn’t just rely on adding points?
If he had the source of transcendence, it wasn’t difficult to advance to the super divine level. Any top-notch god should be able to advance.
But the problem was that this source of transcendence sounded too difficult to obtain.
“I see. However, are the leaders of the five god races so… stable?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but complain.
He thought that since the Blue Planet had five super divines, they should be doing pretty well here, right? In the end, from the sound of it, because they didn’t go to the battlefield, they were neglected by the World King Planet? Moreover, they didn’t dare to go out and establish their own sect, afraid of being hunted? This was too miserable.
It was probably very brave to go to the Blue Planet to establish themselves and return to their mother planet.
Lin Feng laughed and said, “Yes, they’re cowards. But if they weren’t so careful, it’s indeed not easy for them to live for so long. Although super divines are strong, the mortality rate in the dark forest of the universe isn’t low.”
“This is the closest the five god races of the Blue Planet are to rising. If we don’t seize the good opportunity and develop steadily, it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens to produce five super divines together next time.”
“Actually, they’re not the only ones. There should be many super divine-level experts in seclusion and hiding. After all, no one wants to be treated as prey all day.”
“Senior Space Emperor and I… I reckon our path to super divine still has to be on the battlefield. We failed last time and missed the best opportunity. How unfortunate.” Lin Feng was helpless.
“Battlefield?” the Dragon God asked.
Lin Feng said, “Well, on the battlefield, in the starry sky of the universe, there are a total of five cosmic life forms, representing five cosmic factions. They are respectively the cosmic emperor, the World King. The members under them are mainly planetary life forms, and they nurture many races. The most representative are the myriad races in the starry sky. They mainly occupy the Cosmic Sea and are in the center of the universe.”
“The Cosmic Emperor Beast King is the king of the cosmic Behemoth Race. His territory is north of the Cosmic Sea. His race eats planets, so he’s a great enemy of the World King bloodline. Both parties fight all year round.”
“The Cosmic Emperor Dark King, much like the Abyss Evil God that once invaded the Blue Planet, as well as Yun An, who was defeated by Emperor Wu, are all life forms under the command of the Dark King. Their distinctive power lies in their strong contaminating nature, capable of transforming various forms of life, including planets, into their own kind. Their territory is in the western expanse of the Cosmic Sea, and they are in an irreconcilable conflict with the World King bloodline.”
“The Cosmic Emperor Insect Queen of the Insect Race is the king of the Space Insect Race. She controls countless insect armies under her command and completes the reproduction of her race by devouring life forms. Her territory is the south of the Cosmic Sea.”
“The last one, the one who occupies the north of the Cosmic Sea, is the faction of a cosmic overlord. It doesn’t have a similar race, or rather, its race is only it alone. However, it controls a huge universe overlord army and is invincible, recruiting countless experts. The other four universe emperors are unwilling to provoke them. Their main businesses are also the gentlest. They just excavate the ruins of the cosmic era and constantly colonize other planets, sell planetary resources, and earn money as cosmic mercenaries.”
“Of course, the other three parties are also enemies with each other. Therefore, the current situation of the universe is very chaotic. However, in essence, it’s just a competition for resources. There are still several cosmic life forms who won’t personally take action.”
Shi Yu and the Dragon God gradually understood that the current situation of the universe was very similar to the Blue Planet’s Mythical Era.
“Then, Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng, do you know the way to break through to the cosmic level?” Shi Yu asked.
This stumped Emperor Kong and Lin Feng.
After a moment of silence, they said, “No one knows. I’m afraid only the five cosmic-level experts know.”
The Space Emperor looked at Shi Yu and said, “Little Friend Shi Yu, I’ve long heard of your talent potential. Lin Feng and I think very highly of you. If you work hard for a few years, you might have a chance to charge into first place in the God Sealing Battle. After all, you’re still young.”
“Moreover, human Beast Tamers are the race with the greatest advantage in the God Sealing Battle. After all, they can fight with many creatures they contract.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1299 - 1299 Mad Journey (5)
chapters.content:
1299 Mad Journey (5)
“On the contrary, if the other races in the starry sky don’t have partners with humans, they can only fight alone.”
“In short, maybe you have a chance to break through to the super divine level before Lin Feng and me and become the first super divine Beast Tamer of the Dong Huang Human Race!!”
At the side, the Dragon God also thought so. From Blue Planet’s performance, Shi Yu was indeed more monstrous than Wang Kong and Lin Feng.
“No, seniors, you’ve overestimated me.” Shi Yu smiled bitterly.
Lin Feng said, “There’s no need to undervalue yourself. We all know about you.”
Shi Yu said, “No, what I mean is that someone on the Blue Planet has already broken through to the super divine level. If I want to break through, I can only be the second.”
He was ashamed.
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng: ????
“What did you say?” The Space Emperor was stunned.
Lin Feng was also stunned and looked confused.
What did he mean?
Shi Yu said, “Because Emperor Shi is still alive and has already broken through to the super divine level.”
Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Dragon God: ???
Shi Yu quickly explained, “Senior, you also know that I’m an archeologist, so I’ve studied the history of the few legendary emperors very deeply.”
“Among them, the mystery of Emperor Shi’s disappearance has always been what I’m most concerned about.”
“Fortunately, before leaving Blue Planet, I successfully found Emperor Shi.”
“He only accidentally entered an era ruin on the Blue Planet. Then, he might have obtained a large amount of source of transcendence inside and broke through to the super divine level. Right on the heels of that, because he was too strong, he was trapped inside and couldn’t return to the Blue Planet.”
“Before leaving, Emperor Shi also entrusted me to help the Blue Planet evolve into a high-level planet as soon as possible so that he can come out. However, I think this matter might still require everyone from Dong Huang to work hard together.”
“After all, I’m only at the legendary level at the moment.”
Emperor Kong, Lin Feng, Dragon God: ???
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng were stunned.
Their brains buzzed and shut down.
What?!
Emperor Shi was still alive?!
Moreover, he accidentally entered the ruins of the era on Blue Planet and reached the super divine level?
They looked at Shi Yu in a daze, making him shiver.
The Space Emperor Kong immediately got up and said, “Is what you said true??”
“Yes, I’m definitely not lying.” Shi Yu nodded. Emperor Kong still found it unbelievable.
Lin Feng looked at Shi Yu in a daze. Damn, what was wrong with this kid? Although he had heard that he was an archeologist and had accidentally entered the era ruins, he had found another era ruin and found Emperor Shi from it. Moreover, it was a super divine level Emperor Shi. Wasn’t this a little exaggerated?
“Don’t tell the five god races about this for the time being.” The Space Emperor’s scalp went numb. “Lin Feng and I still have to consider it at length. Senior Emperor Shi is actually still alive and has reached the super divine level… This…”
It was simply more shocking than him learning Shi Yu’s strength from Zi Lan.
Initially, he and Lin Feng were still worried that before they reached the super divine level, even if Blue Planet upgraded, it might become a paradise for the five major divine races again. Dong Huang would gradually decline. However, if they saved Emperor Shi, the Dong Huang humans wouldn’t be afraid anymore.
This ancestor would definitely be the first to disagree if anyone dared to bully Dong Huang.
At that time, it would definitely not be a problem to share the resources of high-level planets on the Blue Planet with the five major god races.
“Kid, you’re really impressive. I, Lin Feng, have never admired anyone in my life. You’re ruthless. You’re only at the legendary level, but you’ve already been to two era ruins.” Lin Feng couldn’t help but click his tongue.
“I feel that if you can break through to the super divine level in the future, the source of transcendence will definitely be found in the ruins of the era…”
Shi Yu smiled awkwardly and said, “You flatter me…”
On the side, the Dragon God was silent. She understood the shock of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng. After all, this was a monster archeologist who had even cracked the spatial ruins.
Now that he had dug out a super divine being, it was understandable.
Emperor Kong said, “This matter is very important. We’ll consider it. Shi Yu, I heard that you like to explore ruins very much, but after coming here, before your strength reaches the top Divine Realm, I still suggest that you cultivate in peace.”
“If you walk by the river often, there will always be a day when your shoes are wet. Next, I’ll give it to you. Also, Senior Dragon God, you have a certain amount of elemental divine-level energy crystals. This is the universal high-level currency of the World King Planet. It can be bought to exchange for other resources or used to directly cultivate. You’re all demigods now. It’s better to come into contact with the World King Planet from the ‘God Sealing Battle’ first.”
“Leave the rest to us.”
“Alright, thank you, Senior Space Emperor, Senior Lin Feng,” Shi Yu said.
Emperor Kong said, “One more thing. Don’t come into contact with the five divine races too much first. If they want to see us, we’ll also help you reject them. However, Shi Yu, it might be very difficult to reject the Kirin Race.”
“The Wind Kirin that has already been exterminated is the source of luck for the Kirin Race. Now that you’ve obtained the Wind Kirin inheritance, perhaps even the super divine Ancestor of the Kirin Race will be alarmed.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “I’ve already thought of it. Senior Space Emperor, you can tell that to them.”
“I inherited the Wind of Blessing Skill with a Mechanic method. Moreover, I also reversed the development and cultivation methods of the Wind of Blessing divine skill. Under the care of the luck of the Kirin Race, I’m willing to give the development method of the Wind of Blessing to the Kirin Race for free.”
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng were stunned.
What? Shi Yu had deduced the development method of the Wind of Blessing divine skill??
In fact, Shi Yu had long expected this day. Therefore, when he was on Blue Planet, he first used his skill to deduce the development and learning method of the Wind of Blessing quasi-divine skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1300 - 1300 Mad Journey (6)
chapters.content:
1300 Mad Journey (6)
Although the success rate was extremely low and almost made him die, it was completely worth it to exchange for the friendship of a large race with a super divine level life form.
The other party couldn’t really freeload, right?
At this moment, looking at the serious Shi Yu, the Space Emperor, and Lin Feng were completely impressed by Shi Yu. Although Shi Yu was only at the legendary level, everything he did was extremely heaven-defying.
Lin Feng pondered and said, “I have a good relationship with the Kirin Race. Apart from the Wind of Blessing development method, I’ll help them deduce the Wind Kirin evolution path. Perhaps there’s a chance of reviving the Wind Kirin Race. They owe us a huge favor. Shi Yu, don’t worry. When the time comes, the benefits will definitely not be lacking for you.”
Shi Yu said, “Thank you, Senior Lin Feng. I’ll give you the development method of the Wind of Blessing first?”
Shi Yu placed a reusable memory crystal that recorded the development method of the Wind of Blessing on the table. To be honest, the development method for it was very difficult. If he wanted to develop it from scratch, he would have to go through a headache. Fortunately, Ling directly knew the Wind of Blessing and didn’t have to go through so much trouble to learn it.
However, the cosmic storm that had yet to be deduced made Shi Yu worried that it would be equally troublesome…
“Alright.” Seeing that Shi Yu had even prepared the memory crystal, Lin Feng knew that it wasn’t a coincidence that Shi Yu could reach this day.
Then, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng chatted with Shi Yu and the Dragon God for a long time.
He had also prepared accommodations and data chips for them.
Apart from that, Shi Yu and the Dragon God also obtained 100 elemental divine-level energy crystals each.
Including what the World Tree had given him, Shi Yu had 200 elemental energy crystals in his hand at once. He felt that it was enough to enter seclusion to cultivate for a long time.
It wasn’t until the sky darkened that Shi Yu and the others were sent to their respective residences by the Space Emperor to start a new life on World King Planet.
Shi Yu was arranged to be in a mountain villa with an inner grotto heaven. It was located in a quiet place, far from the center of the city. The surrounding natural resources were richer, and no one disturbed him.
“This is our new home from now on.” After Shi Yu entered the big villa, he directly released Eleven and the others.
Until now, he had yet to calm down. He felt that it was very novel.
“Wu!!!”
“Roar~!!”
“Yi!!!”
After Eleven and the others arrived at their new home, they were also very excited. When they were in the Beast Taming Space, they sensed the beauty of the World King Planet. Now that they had come out, they felt equally good.
During resistance training, gravity training was only a basic skill.
Only Turtle, Little Quas, and Shorty silently started gravity training in the Beast Taming Space. With their current foundation, they were still a little pressured to withstand the gravity pressure of the World King Planet.
Oh right, there was also Qi. She expressed that she still had to observe in the Beast Taming Space for a period of time. She felt that there were always bad people who wanted to harm her.
“How comfortable! You guys clean up and organize it first. I’ll rest for a while!” After Shi Yu lay on the sofa, he handed the data chip Lin Feng gave him to Ling and said, “Ling, load it. Help me find information about the God Sealing Battle first.”
