“Our first big goal next is to obtain a Permanent Teleportation Array.”
“Let’s see when the next God Sealing Battle is first. I forgot to ask just now.”
“Alright.” Ling took the data chip and directly started to activate it.
After a while, it said, “It seems to be eleven months later, Master.”
“Do you have the information on the contestant who placed first multiple times that Senior Space Emperor and the others mentioned?” Shi Yu asked right on the heels of the heels.
He wanted to see how strong the number one demigod/legendary being on World King Planet was.
After a while, Ling pondered and said, “Master, the first place in the last God Sealing Battle is called Zavay. He’s not a human, but a member of the Cosmic Crow Race. He’s a rare cosmic life form that didn’t contract with a human and relied on itself to reach first place. As for the other 2 to 10, they’re basically in the form of a contracted partner.”
“Cosmic Crow Race…” Shi Yu said, “What’s that?”
Ling said, “Among the races in the starry sky, it’s ranked 30th. It was born with six elements and is very powerful.”
“The six elements are respectively metal, wood, water, fire, earth, and time.”
“This Cosmic Crow, Zavay, has mastered 15 quasi-divine skills that have been cultivated to the extreme. Among them, there are two quasi-divine skills of the five elements, metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. There are a total of 10 of them. It can circulate five elements and form two sets of divine profundities. It’s the attack and defense profundities that can break through the true divine level and the true divine skill of defense.”
“The other six skills are all time-element. They are Time Stop, Time Acceleration, Time Deceleration, Time Backtrack, and Time Mark…”
Ling looked up in confusion. Beside it, Eleven, Buggy, and the others, who were listening to Ling’s report, were also stunned on the spot.
Especially Baby Ginseng.
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng widened its eyes. What a joke. This was a demigod? Why did this guy also have Time Mark? It wasn’t convinced!!
“Roar?” “Quack?” Little Ji and the others couldn’t help but look up. What the hell? Was this a monster?
They thought that Eleven, Buggy, and the others in the team were already powerful enough.
In the end…
Shi Yu also fell into deep thought. It was stronger than he imagined.
Damn, to think he was still so happy after defeating the Phoenix Man.
“No wonder the Space Emperor and the others said that it’s not easy to get first place in the God Sealing Battle.” The corners of Shi Yu’s mouth twitched. F*ck, there were still five time-element quasi-divine skills that had been cultivated to the extreme…

chapters.title: Chapter 1301 - 1301 Mad Journey (7)
chapters.content:
1301 Mad Journey (7)
“Ling, if we fight now, what are our chances of winning?”
Ling said, “If everyone attacks together, the chances of getting first place, no, the top three aren’t high. The top three have all gotten first place, so we can barely give it a try to squeeze into the top 10.”
“But in eleven months, I think we can fight for first place.”
“I think so too. Fortunately, there are still eleven months,” Shi Yu said. Although the Space Emperor and Lin Feng meant for him to cultivate for a few years or even more than ten years before considering charging for first place, Shi Yu couldn’t wait that long.
He had only become a Beast Tamer less than four years ago. How could he waste so much time at the demigod level?
In the next batch, he would try to get first place.
At the stage below the super divine level, it should still be useful to add points.
“But I’m worried that even if we get first place and obtain the challenge opportunity, what if we can’t defeat that divine-level examiner?” Shi Yu said. “Doesn’t that mean that the opportunity is wasted? We won’t be able to obtain a reward.”
He felt that he would suffer a huge loss by taking first place like this.
Ling said, “That’s easy to resolve.”
“The God Sealing Battle and the final challenge are calculated separately.”
“It’s not necessary to use the lineup to participate in the God Sealing Battle.”
“I’ve studied the rules. Master, you can completely let Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Little Ji, Duckie, and the others register separately and register themselves as individuals.”
“In this way, we can wrap up the front row. As long as you get first place, you will have the opportunity to challenge first place and the rewards for other rankings.”
“If we’re lucky, we’ll get into the top 10.”
“Let the God Sealing Battle become a team civil war.”
“However, this way, when fighting monsters like Zavay, we might not be able to attack together. If we want Eleven and the others to defeat it one-on-one and face other experts one-on-one, it might be a little difficult. This is a risk that needs to be evaluated.”
“But if you succeed, you can obtain the most rewards. During the final challenge, you can take back all your pets and challenge them together.”
“I think we can give it a try. If each of us doesn’t have the strength to get into the top 20 individually, even if we work together to challenge that divine level, the chances of winning aren’t high.”
Shi Yu: “?”
“Can this still be done? The rules allow pets to leave the Beast Tamer and participate alone?”
“It’s allowed! With such a record, they just failed. After all, not every Beast Tamer has conditions like ours.”
After being stunned for a long time, Shi Yu suddenly licked his lips. Let the God Sealing Battle become a team internal battle that included rewards for the top 10…
It sounded pretty interesting, but it was easy to offend people. However, for the reward, he would give it his all.
It looked like their path to becoming a god was destined to be a crazy process.
“Since Zavay can get first place without relying on Beast Tamers, you guys can too. Isn’t it just 15 quasi-divine skills? Next, work overtime!! Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, Chi Tong, Susu, Ling, Little Ji, Duckie, the top 10 is too much. We’ll strive to enter the top 50. The eight of you will participate and see whose ranking is higher. At that time, I’ll see who I’ll fight with…”
“Can you withstand the crazy sprint in the next eleven months? Not only do you have to add points, but you also have to learn new skills specifically. Otherwise, it won’t be safe.” Shi Yu’s motivation rose again.
Many pets’ gazes were sharp. What a joke. They were looking forward to it very much, alright? Beat the cosmic God Sealing Battle into an internal team competition! The first place in the team this time would definitely be very valuable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1302 - 1302 World-Destroying Dragon Little Ji (1)
chapters.content:
1302 World-Destroying Dragon Little Ji (1)
World King Planet, Sky City.
As the amount of information was too large, it would probably take Shi Yu and the others a while to completely receive it.
Apart from Ling.
First, he would let Ling receive all of it. Then, after filtering out the trash information, Shi Yu and the others would receive it.
As they had just arrived, Shi Yu and the others were in different moods.
For example, Little Ji and Duckie were in a daze for a long time after learning that the most powerful things in the universe weren’t earth disasters and ocean disasters.
Especially on the World King Planet. Not to mention being the overlord of the land, Little Ji was a gopher with its epic-level combat power weakened.
“Roar!!!” Little Ji was on the brink of tears as it dug the ground in the garden area and sensed the power of the ground.
Although it had become more intense, why did the deeper layers of power seem elusive?
“Quack!!!” Duckie was also on the brink of tears. This was because it had watched some videos and realized that the Abyss Race seemed to be hated by everyone.
There were a bunch of arrest warrants.
The two of them were the most pessimistic, comparable to Qi. In short, they didn’t look very smart.
“Ling, how’s the modification of the inheritance pearl?”
In the backyard of the villa, Shi Yu had just finished swimming. He comfortably lay on a chair and opened a drink before asking Ling.
Although Ling wasn’t beside him, it was just a thought.
Before coming to the World King Planet, on the Blue Planet, Ling shouted for Eleven and the others to let the World Annihilation Dragon out of the sealing pearl.
After releasing the World Annihilation Dragon inside, Eleven, Buggy, and Chi Tong easily defeated it, leaving behind the other party’s soul crystal that contained the power of the destructive law.
This thing was the key to modifying Little Ji.
From then on, Ling started to study how to transform this into a mechanical inheritance tool.
As long as the modification was successful and Little Ji fused, its battle power would immediately take a qualitative leap.
With Little Ji’s current strength, it was completely cannon fodder if it wanted to participate in the God Sealing Battle.
Even Ling, Susu, and the others were identical.
After arriving at the World King Planet, Shi Yu’s entire team could be said to have experienced an epic weakening.
Buggy’s power of faith was restricted, and Susu couldn’t summon the power of the Blue Planet’s ocean. With the infinite energy advantage gone, Ling basically didn’t have any powerful attack skills. It couldn’t really rely on luck to get into the top 10, right?
Just as Ling had analyzed, if the entire team, including Shi Yu and Little Zi, attacked together, there was still some hope of reaching the front.
If he signed up alone and didn’t make good use of these eleven months, he would have a death wish!
He had to make every one of them become experts who could take charge as soon as possible.
“I’ll try to finish it in two days. There’s a lot of public cosmic mechanical knowledge in the virtual network. I want to learn it first. At that time, my research speed should be faster,” Ling said.
“Master, you can add points to Little Ji first to make its foundation stronger.”
“At that time, it will be easier to accept the inheritance.”
“Alright, I’ll add points to Little Ji’s other skills first,” Shi Yu said.
“Let’s start with Little Ji, followed by Duckie. Sigh, I still have to register Duckie another day. It’s troublesome. Sky City doesn’t have a branch of the Environmental Protection Association…” Shi Yu sighed.
In Shi Yu’s entire team, Duckie was a troublesome thing.
Because as an Abyss Race, ducks were forbidden to be cultivated on the World King Planet!
It was impossible to directly participate in the God Sealing Battle.
It was banned from competition!
Including cosmic behemoths and Space Worms, cultivation was forbidden.
After all, World King Planet and these large factions had always been in a battle state.
However, World King Planet wasn’t that unreasonable.
If he wanted to nurture the Abyss Race, the Yun Race, the Space Worm, the Space Behemoth, and so on, he could, but he needed to register his identity with an official organization.
On the battlefield, Beast Tamers often contracted the Abyss Race and the Yun Race or cultivated their power. After all, these races were really strong.
For such a person, as long as he registered his identity and participated in an assessment to ensure that the pet’s rationality wouldn’t be corroded by the power of the abyss, he could train and participate normally.
Regarding the races of the Dark King faction, identification certificates needed to be processed at the headquarters of the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association or various branches on the World King Planet.
There was actually such a faction.
Shi Yu didn’t know about Duckie, but Susu definitely wanted to take a look at this place.
In short, it was said that the assessment of the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association was very difficult to pass. Therefore, before Shi Yu went to register Duckie, he had to ensure that it learned two to three cleansing quasi-divine skills.
He would add points to Little Ji so that it could successfully fuse with the World Annihilation Dragon inheritance and add points to Duckie so that it could successfully apply for an identity certificate at the Cosmic Sea Environmental Protection Association!
This was Shi Yu’s short-term mission goal.
The latter had to be done as soon as possible. Otherwise, without proof, the Environmental Protection Association had the right to directly detain and deal with the abyssal creatures after discovering them.
The big place was troublesome… It was better to be a boss on Blue Planet.
“Little Ji, come here.”
Shi Yu shouted for the Earth Dragon which had shrunk to the size of a lizard and was still digging the ground outside.
“Roar!!!” Little Ji ran over eagerly and widened its eyes, asking what was going on.
“What else can it be but to increase points?” Shi Yu said. “I’ll strengthen your strength first, lest you fail to accept the World Annihilation Dragon inheritance later.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1303 - 1303 World-Destroying Dragon Little Ji (2)
chapters.content:
1303 World-Destroying Dragon Little Ji (2)
Little Ji was wild with joy.
On the other side.
Not long after the Phoenix man returned, he received a call from his companion.
He stopped cultivating and fell silent after looking at the name “Lin Rui” on his cell phone.
In the end, he chose to answer.
“Lin Rui, what is it?” he asked directly.
Laughter came from the other side. “Little Seven, you’re finally back. You wasted so much cultivation time on this quest. I wonder if the mission rewards are rich?”
Qi Mu said, “It’s alright.”
“How’s the Blue Planet? Is it fun? I heard that you were beaten up by the Blue Planet’s Beast Tamer? His name seems to be Shi Yu?”
“What’s the battle situation like? Tell me!”
“Wasn’t the Blue Planet beaten into a low-level planet? How can there be someone stronger than you?”
Qi Mu widened his eyes, not understanding where the news came from.
Zilan definitely wouldn’t say, and the Sky Emperor and Lord Lin Feng didn’t need to either. Could it be the Angel Clan and the Demon Clan? How annoying.
“What does it have to do with you? It’s just a spar,” Qi Mu said unhappily.
Damn, he knew this day would come.
Lin Rui said, “I’m just concerned about you. Do you know where Shi Yu lives? The people from Blue Planet should have already arrived at the World King Planet, right? Introduce me. Many people here want to get to know him.”
Qi Mu said, “I don’t know. I’m hanging up! I advise you not to cause trouble. Be careful or your grandfather will beat you up.”
With that said, he quickly hung up.
Lin Rui was one of the descendants of Lin Feng after starting a family here. He was a grandson, and his seniority was even higher than that of President Lin Xiao. His strength was also much stronger than Qi Mu, and he could catch up to the disciple of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan.
After Qi Mu finished talking to the other party on the phone, she knew the other party’s intention. He definitely wanted to spar with Shi Yu.
“Forget it, if he dares to go, he’ll definitely be beaten up.” Qi Mu saw everything clearly. Even the Space Emperor and Lin Feng had to call the Dragon God senior. Whoever provoked her was purely courting death.
“If only Shi Yu was really so bored as to spar with them and win. This way, I won’t be the only one to lose to Shi Yu… If he breaks through to the legendary level, he might not be weaker than Captain Zi Lan. Yes! It might not be a bad thing for me for them to spar!”
As long as everyone had been beaten up by the natives of the Blue Planet, he wouldn’t be so special. There would be fewer people who came to ask him questions.
He quickly took out his cell phone and found Shi Yu’s contact information. Apart from the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and the Dragon God, he might be one of the few people here who had Shi Yu’s contact information.
Qi Mu sent Shi Yu a message: “Brother Shi Yu, are you used to it here? You can look for me as a guide if you want to go somewhere to play. The Sky Arena of Sky City is quite interesting. The geniuses of the various factions on Floating Planet are basically mixed here. You can see many cosmic life forms that you can’t see on the Blue Planet. If you’re interested, I can bring you there to take a look.”
The first message was revealed.
After sending it, Phoenix Man began to wait for the message. However, after a while, Shi Yu replied.
Shi Yu: “Sky Arena? Alright, I’ll take a look in a few days. I’ll contact you then!”
Qi Mu was delighted and immediately replied: “Alright.”
…
At this moment, Shi Yu was adding points to Little Ji.
Qi Mu’s invitation was exactly what Shi Yu wanted.
After arriving, Shi Yu also thought it through. Just adding points might not be enough.
The myriad of races in the starry sky were too ridiculous. For example, Zavay from the Cosmic Crow Clan’s accompanying move was ridiculous to the extreme.
Shi Yu was extremely envious of his time skills and wanted to replicate them.
Of course, there was definitely no chance now.
Even if he didn’t have a chance, he could get other people’s skills.
On Sky City’s side, although it was only Floating Planet’s territory on World King Planet, there should be many rare Space Contract Beasts, right?
Even Phoenix Man, Zi Lan, and the contracted beast had three to four quasi-divine skills. There were probably a few other geniuses. It seemed like they could finally get back to their old ways after a long time.
It didn’t matter if the skill quality was high. If they replicated more, they could still fuse it!
A pile of trash skills could always fuse into a top-notch skill.
At the thought of this, Shi Yu continued to add points and fuse them with Little Ji.
“Roar!!! (Mm~~)” Little Ji roared. It felt like it was getting closer and closer to becoming number one on the team.
Awesome.
It only took two to three days to add points from a transcendent super skill to Dao Proficiency.
Of course, if he used skill fusion, he might be able to fuse the two super skills into a quasi-divine skill faster. Naturally, he had to rest longer.
On the third day of arriving at the World King Planet, Shi Yu upgraded Little Ji’s Earth Control from transcendent to Dao Proficiency. Then, Little Ji cultivated it into a quasi-divine skill [Earth Control] through Baby Ginseng’s World Tree Fruit, containing the laws of the earth.
It also became the owner of two quasi-divine skills in the team.
“Roar!!!” After adding points, Little Ji was very smug. It felt that Duckie was only so-so now. Even Big Sister Ling might not necessarily be able to defeat it.
They were both quasi-divine skills. Look, what was its quasi-divine skill? Cataclysm! Earth Control!

chapters.title: Chapter 1304 - 1304 World-Destroying Dragon, Little Ji (3)
chapters.content:
1304 World-Destroying Dragon, Little Ji (3)
Just look at Big Sister Ling’s quasi-divine skill, Wind of Blessing and Mechanical Spirit!
“Ling, do you think this is alright?” After completing the additional points, Shi Yu called Ling out. Ling saw the silly dragon with magma saliva in the additional points room, its mouth wide open, and it looked up at the sky with a smile. “Is the basic intelligence still at the expert level?”
Shi Yu said, “Yes.”
“Fill it up,” Ling said. “I’m afraid that with its current intelligence, it will be affected by the World Annihilation Dragon inheritance. Or perhaps, increase the proficiency of the reverse scale a little more. When the time comes, it will fuse with it.”
“Roar?” Little Ji was stunned and recovered. Damn it!!! It said I was stupid again.
It was clearly the one who won every time it played chess with Duckie.
Little Ji felt very superior in terms of intelligence.
However, at the thought of continuing to add points, Little Ji wiped its saliva and nodded heavily. It’ll listen to Big Sister!
Next, on the fourth day, Shi Yu added some points to Little Ji according to Ling’s suggestion. Right on the heels of that, it was finally the time that Little Ji and Ling looked forward to.
It was time to help Little Ji receive the World Annihilation Dragon inheritance!
At this moment, although Shi Yu and the others no longer had the ruins space they carried, Little Zi’s body had taken on this important job again.
Be it adding points or cultivating, Shi Yu ran to Little Zi’s body. With the World Blessing, the efficiency could be higher.
Star Continent, on the unworldly island, in the Mechanical Research Institute.
“Roar!!!”
Little Ji returned to its main body, which was in the form of a hundred-meter-tall Earth Dragon. On its skin, there were many cracks that looked like dry land. In the cracks, the power of magma swam. It was quite shocking.
Apart from that, its body was also filled with mechanical devices of various sizes. Its chest was directly opened by Ling with a 40-meter-long mechanical saber, and the World Annihilation Dragon inheritance pearl that looked like a heart was stuffed into Ling’s body.
“Master, Master, I still need your support,” Ling said. “I need to rely on skill fusion to assist it in developing new skills.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu stood in the research institute and looked at the little machine tied up by mechanical tools in front of him. “I’m long prepared.”
Little Ji, who was tied up, shouted excitedly, “Roar!! (Charge, charge, charge!!)”
From today onwards, it would stand tall in the sky!
“Shut up! Aren’t you the king of the earth? Why are you going to the sky?” Ling lectured. “The next process will be painful, don’t make any noise, and don’t cause chaos in this world.”
Shi Yu said, “I’m still worried. Can we get Buggy to hypnotize it and let it go to the dream world to withstand the affliction and accept the inheritance? It won’t be good if Little Zi is injured later.”
Little Ji: “?”
How much did they not trust him!!
However, before Little Ji could resist, Shi Yu called Buggy and Baby Ginseng over. One used hypnosis and the other used strong medicine, turning Little Ji into sleep mode.
“Yiya!” “Roar!” After that, Baby Ginseng and Buggy looked at this big guy at the side. Baby Ginseng started babbling.
After Little Ji finished accepting the inheritance, shouldn’t it be its turn to add points next? The supplement effect would be better if it added points to the World Tree Fruit, Plant Control, Green Wood Divine Body, and turned them into quasi-divine skills!
Baby Ginseng opened its big and yearning eyes and cracked Shi Yu’s fingers to analyze.
Shi Yu said helplessly, “I know, I know, but we have to do it after Duckie or at the same time.”
“Now, let’s deal with this big guy first.” Shi Yu looked up at the sleeping Little Ji again and directly entered a mental resonance state!!
“Roar!! I’m the overlord of the earth!!!” Shi Yu brewed his emotions and activated the overlord’s resistance before successfully resonating with Little Ji, who had entered the dream world.
At the side, the corners of Ling, Baby Ginseng, and Buggy’s mouths twitched… In the future, if they fused the super divine resource, the Eye of the Evil God, for Duckie, they would probably have to enter a resonance state to assist.
At that time, Shi Yu would probably have to be the overlord of the ocean again!
Skill: Dragon Breath, Form Switch, Reverse Scale, Deterrence, Mythical Revival, Basic Intelligence
[Fusion success rate]: Medium
[Fusion Risk]: Medium
Ling said, “Next, the World Annihilation Dragon Pearl I assisted in fusing will act as the same effect as the previous mind domain to assist in the fusion and evolution. Listen to my countdown…”
“3…”
“2…”
“1! Fusion!”
As Ling finished speaking, Shi Yu took a deep breath and directly fused. Ling also assisted Little Ji in fusion and evolution through mechanical control!!
In the dream world, Little Ji’s consciousness was trapped by Buggy.
“Roar!!!” It let out a painful cry.
“I am the overlord of the earth!!!” Its eyes were red, and the destructive power on its body spread. It fell into the reverse scale berserk mode. The Destruction Dragon Breath condensed in its mouth, and its consciousness was gradually corroded by the destructive power. It turned around and leveled a mountain with a boom.
It was right to pull Little Ji into a new world.
Otherwise, the one destroyed wouldn’t be the world it created, but Little Zi.
“Roar!! (I really want to give you a claw.)” Buggy looked at the arrogant Little Ji and couldn’t help but say.

chapters.title: Chapter 1305 - 1305 World-Destroying Dragon, Little Ji (4)
chapters.content:
1305 World-Destroying Dragon, Little Ji (4)
In the outside world.
Eleven, Chi Tong, Susu, Duckie, and the others were also here. Some played support while others watched the show.
Among them, Duckie looked at Little Ji, whose aura was gradually strengthening, with tears in its eyes. Although it would also accept adding points to become stronger next, was it going to be temporarily suppressed by this idiot??
It was unwilling!!
How embarrassing!
Suddenly.
“Roar!!!” Little Ji, who was tied up, suddenly opened its blood-red eyes. After destroying the dream world, it returned to reality and glared at Duckie with bloody eyes.
“Roar!!! (I am the overlord of the earth!!)” It roared. Then, Susu splashed cold water on it and it looked at Duckie excitedly.
It slowly raised its arm and stretched out three fingers…
Duckie: “?”
“Roar!! (Three, three quasi-divine Skills!!!)”
Little Ji was invincible!
As Little Ji recovered its restoration consciousness, its entire body was also enveloped by red light. The World Annihilation Dragon inheritance pearl completely fused into its body.
[Dragon Breath, Form Switch, Reverse Scale, Deterrence, Mythical Revival, Basic Intelligence] had already fused into the [Destruction Body].
[Skill]: Body of Destruction
[Stats]: Dragon, Machinery
[Level]: Quasi God-level
< Introduction > It contains the law of destruction. Its mechanical body contains destructive power.
No wonder Little Ji was so arrogant. The fusion was very successful, and Little Ji successfully mastered a quasi-divine skill that contained top-notch laws!!
Quake Law, Cataclysm, Earth Law, Earth Control, Destruction Law, Destruction Body!!
At this moment, Little Ji’s strength had indeed completely pulled away from Little Duck, who had only mastered the Heart of the Abyss. It was enough to compete with a team of six pets.
“From today onwards, your new race will be called the World Destruction Dragon,” Shi Yu, who had a weak expression, said.
Little Ji bowed to Shi Yu with a bang…
“Wu wu wu!! (Thank you!!)” Little Ji looked at Shi Yu excitedly. Thank you, Beast Tamer. Wu wu wu, I’m so strong!!
In the God Sealing Battle, I’ll definitely perform well!
I won’t disappoint your cultivation.
Leave that Cosmic Crow to me!
“Although its intelligence isn’t too high, its strength is alright.”
Shi Yu also heaved a sigh of relief and smiled. Alright, he didn’t become an old man this time. How rare.
Moreover, the skills obtained were also very powerful. They actually easily destroyed the dream world created by Buggy.
After all, Buggy had used the Creation Domain to do this.
Although it didn’t borrow the power of faith, it was also a quasi-divine skill, but it was destroyed by the same quasi-divine skill. Little Ji had potential.
“Quack!!! (Beast Tamer—!!!)” At this moment, looking at Little Ji’s smug face, Duckie cried. It couldn’t take it anymore and ran over to hug Shi Yu’s thigh.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the others sighed at the side. Was the second team going to counterattack?
So be it. In any case, the three brothers weren’t at the bottom.
They looked at the three plastic sisters, especially Susu, who had lost the Blue Sea Contract.
At that time, it would be interesting if Ling was defeated by Little Ji and Susu was defeated by Duckie.
Susu: “?”
“Cough, cough, cough. Tomorrow, definitely tomorrow. I’m tired today.” At this moment, Shi Yu spoke.
….
After completing the evolution of Little Ji, Shi Yu ran to receive the nourishing treatment of Baby Ginseng and the others. He had to increase Baby Ginseng’s level first. Not to mention more than ten quasi-divine skills, at least the supplement skills had to be maxed out. Otherwise, the restoration efficiency would indeed not increase.
“Wu wu wu!!” When Shi Yu was free, his pets leaned over one by one.
Eleven held a tablet and opened an interface to show Shi Yu the [Ranking Battle of All Races].
This was also a competition. Eleven felt that it was much more interesting than the God Sealing Battle.
The so-called ranking battle of all races was a competition where all races in the starry sky used their race as a symbol to compete in battle power.
For example, the previous Cosmic Crow Race, Zavay. Its race was ranked 30th among the races in the starry sky. This ranking was obtained in this competition.
The specific ranking algorithm wouldn’t only consider the battle power of the peak individuals representing the race, but also the average strength of the race. In short, the more contestants there were in the same race and the better their results, the higher the race ranking might be.
Eleven searched. The Iron-Eating Beast Race didn’t enter the top 10,000 among the races in the starry sky at all.
Even the top 100,000 didn’t have the name of the Iron-Eating Beast Race.
As for the races below the 100,000 rankings, their names weren’t entered.
Therefore, Eleven wanted to help the Iron-Eating Beast Race rank at the top.
Shi Yu took a look at the rules and curled his lips. “You’re the only one participating. Even if you fight in the front, the overall ranking of the Iron-Eating Beast Race won’t be high.”
“If you want to increase your ranking, apart from you, the other members of the Iron-eating Beast Race have to fight for a very high ranking in this competition. It’s a comprehensive view.”
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven cried. So when could Lin Xiuzhu and the others come over? Everyone was ranked together!
It was a high score.
Eleven thought: Sigh, if only Emperor Wu is still alive.
“I’ll bring you to fight after I add points to you. You’re only at the demigod level now, so your ranking won’t be high even if you participate.” Shi Yu shrugged. This competition was carried out at all times throughout the year. As long as he went to a specific place, he could match opponents of different races to fight.
Moreover, even divine and super-divine levels could participate.
So, Eleven participating in the race for the race ranking was just a waste of effort and wouldn’t bring any benefits.
“Wu wu wu!! (It’s a deal!!)” After Eleven and Shi Yu high-fived, they hugged the tablet and continued to understand the starry sky information. At the same time, they made up their minds. They had to at least push the Iron-Eating Beast Race’s ranking to the top 100!
This was a long-term goal!
Even if it couldn’t be ranked first among the races in the starry sky, it had to become the number one bear race in the universe!
After Eleven, Buggy came again. It had found an unsolved Green Dragon Ruins with a public address, and it was an era ruin.
Also, it saw an auction advertisement that might auction a Green Dragon faith item from the last era. Buggy, who was in urgent need of the power of faith of the Green Dragon, was very envious.
When it arrived at the World King Planet, it couldn’t use the wandering power of faith of the Green Dragon. There were too many divine-level Green Dragons that couldn’t snatch them at all. Therefore, its current source of power of faith could only be faith equipment, and the power of faith of the Green Dragon condensed from the life in Little Zi’s body.
“Climb, climb, climb.”
Shi Yu naturally chased Buggy away. Where would it get the strength to explore the ruins of the era now? Stop tempting it. Where would it get the money to buy the Green Dragon faith item from the last era? Didn’t it know that they were poor?
He had only come to the World King Planet for a few days, but Shi Yu had already used three of the 200 divine-level elemental energy crystals. He felt that he had returned to the poor stage of the newbie period.
There were indeed many better things on the World King Planet. There were also many super divine resources in large-scale auctions, but they didn’t have the money to buy them!
Shi Yu felt that it was time to earn money. He wondered if the benefits from the Kirin Race had been gathered. He seemed to have a Demon Divine Stone on Blue Planet that could hatch demons from the Mythical Era. He wondered if the Demon Race wanted to buy it…
In short, it was to earn money.
After recovering, Shi Yu stretched. He thought of something and took out his cell phone to contact Phoenix Man.
The call quickly went through.
“It’s me, Shi Yu. I want to take a look at the Sky Arena today. Are you free?”
On the other side, a surprised voice immediately came. “Yes, yes. Good lord, you finally plan to come out. How’s your adaptation?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “It’s almost adapted. It just upgraded a pet. Its strength has been reborn, so it wants to find a place to experiment with its battle power.”
At the same time… he would replicate some skills for backup!
“Not bad.” The Phoenix man was excited. Amazing, it was time to wash away his humiliation.
As long as Shi Yu broke through to the legendary level, he believed that Shi Yu still had a high chance of winning against the Floating Planet genius. After all, this was a monster who could defeat him above his level.
In addition, he was quite curious about which of the six pets Shi Yu had sent to gang up on him had been reborn again to make Shi Yu so happy. However, in short, it was good that it had become stronger!
Little Ji: [Not just a team, but an underling!]
Even if he was beaten to death, Phoenix Man would never have expected that the one strengthened at the epic level this time was Shi Yu’s second team’s pet. Moreover, this second team had even received the dark inheritance of the Blue Planet’s Ancestral Dragon…
At this moment, Phoenix Man was only thinking about whether he had led a wolf into the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 1306 - 1306 The First Battle in the Universe (1)
chapters.content:
1306 The First Battle in the Universe (1)
The Sky Arena was the only battle facility in Sky City.
Back then, the tallest building in Sky City that Shi Yu and the others saw was the Sky Arena.
There were a total of 100 levels here. It supported transcendent to demigod-level battles. It was built by the Sky City Lord, the Space Emperor.
Although the Sky Arena was only a high-tech tower, there was a different world inside. Every level was like a small world, especially huge.
The higher the floor, the higher the battle level it could withstand.
Outside the tower of the Sky Arena, the Phoenix man in big pants and a flowery shirt was waiting for Shi Yu outside. Beside him was a Star Phoenix more than two meters long that was clearly in a shrunken state. It was also waiting. After a while, they were stunned.
In the distance, Shi Yu, who was wearing a panda casual suit, led a two-meter-tall wingless dragon with a yellow belly and patterns and a brown body over as if they were shopping.
“Roar!!” Little Ji followed Shi Yu excitedly and swung its dragon tail. Ah~ The treatment of a leader~
Today was a sweet duo with the Beast Tamer.
“We’re here…” After discovering Shi Yu, the Phoenix man called out. At the same time, he looked confused. What was this pet?
“Coming.” Shi Yu brought Little Ji to the front of the Phoenix man.
“This is?” The Phoenix man couldn’t help but ask. Feng Jiu, the Star Phoenix beside it, also had a puzzled expression.
“It’s the pet whose strength has improved by leaps and bounds,” Shi Yu said.
“Roar!! (I’m the overlord of the earth!!)” Little Ji introduced itself, leaving the Phoenix man and the Star Phoenix stunned. Wasn’t it the six Shi Yu had sent previously?
“Why didn’t I see it when we fought previously…” the Star Phoenix asked.
Shi Yu said, “At that time, it was still at the overlord level. Didn’t I say that there were still a few pets with low growth rates? I didn’t send them at that time.”
Phoenix Man and Feng Jiu: “! @#! @#”
So, it was the second team?
So what he meant now was that he wanted to bring the second team’s pets to play?
“Alright… Then let’s go in first?” the Phoenix man said. Forget it, in any case, when the second team couldn’t defeat it, Shi Yu would definitely send a team. It wasn’t a big problem.
“Then let’s go,” Shi Yu said.
This was the first time he had come to the Sky Arena. Be it fighting or being an audience member, he needed to go through relatively complicated procedures. It was even more troublesome for outsiders like Shi Yu.
Therefore, Phoenix Man directly brought Shi Yu to choose the VIP passage.
Moreover, he gave Shi Yu a high-level battle card that had been prepared in advance and said, “If you want to fight, just write your name on the card. When the time comes, just swipe the farm card.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu took the battle card without being polite. Then, the two of them arrived at the 79th level. At this moment, there was a Level 9 arena battle!
In the arena of the Sky Arena, two parties fought. The loser was eliminated, and the winner was the arena lord. He continued to accept the next person’s challenge. It was a relatively high-pressure battle mode.
The reward for victory was secondary. It was mainly to obtain a large amount of battle EXP.
Although Qi Mu didn’t know why Shi Yu wanted to fight in the arena and whether he could withstand fighting so many people in a row, it was fine as long as Shi Yu was happy.
Boom!!!
Sitting on the teleportation platform, Shi Yu and his companions were directly transported to two adjacent spectator seats. Each seat was individual, encircling the arena in a circle suspended in the air. Below, on the vast, rocky arena, two individuals were engaged in combat.
“Lu Ran, all the best!!!”
“Goddess Zhao, all the best!!”
Although there weren’t many spectators here, only about a hundred people in total, the atmosphere was completely in place. They cheered for the Beast Tamers fighting below.
Below, a man and a woman looked to be Level 9 Beast Tamers. The male Beast Tamer named Lu Ran enhanced a huge spherical life form.
It looked like a planetary life form, but on closer look, it was actually an elemental life form.
Shi Yu had already found the other party’s information through Ling’s updated index.
< Name > Sun God Rock
< Introduction > It’s a divine-level Exort Rock Elemental life form born from bathing in the power of the sun.
< Race Divine Skill > Sun Disaster
The female Beast Tamer opposite was partnered by a snake-haired sea demon who controlled the water of the stars.
The creatures contracted by the two humans were both at the totem demigod level. On the Blue Planet, they were enough to suppress an area, but here, no matter how they fought, the aftermath was also sealed on the battlefield.
“Do you know them?” Shi Yu asked Qi Mu beside him. The other party nodded and said, “They’re all familiar faces. Lu Ran and Zhao Miao’er’s strengths were inferior to mine previously. If we fight them, we might not be able to let you have your fill.”
“Roar??” Little Ji, who was standing beside Shi Yu, was stunned. If it was even weaker than them, how could it showcase its strength!
Shi Yu said, “Ahem, no need. We’re just here to experience it.”
Inferior to Qi Mu… Shi Yu wasn’t surprised. After all, he was also considered a genius on the Floating Planet.
Qi Mu was the adopted son of a family established by Lin Feng here. He was adopted because of his outstanding talent and was more or less considered a young master. His status wasn’t low, and he had successfully contracted a member of the Blue Planet’s Phoenix God Race.
On the Floating Planet, there were a total of four large factions. They were the Wang, Lin, Zhao, and Lu families. The Wang family represented Space Emperor Kong, and the Lin family represented Lin Feng. As for the other two families, they were the ones that married after the Space Emperor and Lin Feng arrived.
Back then, as newbies in the universe, no matter how talented the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were, they needed the support of factions. In the end, the Space Emperor abducted the daughter of the Zhao family, and Lin Feng abducted the daughter of the Lu family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1307 - 1307 The First Battle of the Universe (2)
chapters.content:
1307 The First Battle of the Universe (2)
However, the Space Emperor and Lin Feng were indeed awesome and exciting. Their strength improved quickly, and soon, they could take charge. The Space Emperor passed the World King Planet’s Realm Lord assessment. After the World King Planet became a Realm Lord and had its own territory and established its own faction, the Zhao family and a bunch of the Space Emperor’s friends responded one after another and slowly formed the current Floating Planet and Sky City.
The Lu Ran and Goddess Zhao mentioned by the audience here should be the descendants of the geniuses from the family of the Space Emperor and Lin Feng’s wife.
“Let’s take a look first,” Shi Yu said.
“Yes.” The Phoenix man nodded.
Below, the skills of the Sun God Rock and the snake-haired sea demon were both long-range types. After colliding a few times to a draw, the contractors also went into battle. Zhao Miao’er directly fused with the snake-haired sea demon, and the Sun God Rock directly turned into a rock spear that was held in Lu Ran’s hand.
“Sun Meteorite.” Lu Ran shouted loudly. The hot sun was in the sky, and the arena instantly droughted and exploded. Fire spread all over his body, turning into a flame. The spear shot out like a dragon, and his entire body and the spear formed by the Sun God Rock seemed to have turned into a fire dragon that shuttled over, erupting with strong power and spreading double law ripples.
Because the laws of the World King Planet were perfect, divine-level races were everywhere. There was nothing strange about quasi-divine skills here. They wouldn’t trigger any sound of laws, and they didn’t look much different from ordinary skills.
Only by reaching the stage of a true divine skill would it cause a law phenomenon.
On the other side, the snake-haired sea demon, which had become even prettier and stronger after fusing, originally summoned a large number of water rings and prepared to counterattack, but under the surrounding fire power, it quickly evaporated. The Guardian Water Shield that automatically condensed was penetrated by the spear flames, and the Water God Armor on its body was also penetrated. The power of the explosion instantly sent it flying.
“Pfft…” The snake-haired sea demon that suddenly hit the energy shield directly spat out blood. Then, its body was divided into two and turned into two individuals again.
“Holy shit.” The Phoenix man exclaimed. The one named Lu Ran had already pressed the spearhead against the other person’s neck. “Before I went to Blue Planet, Lu Ran only contracted one quasi-divine skill, and it was natural. Did he cultivate another one himself?”
“That eruption just now was definitely a quasi-divine skill. A quasi-divine skill that burned other powers in exchange for an eruption.”
“In comparison, Zhao Miao’er doesn’t seem to have any improvement.”
“Is that so?” While the Phoenix man was shocked, Shi Yu fell into deep thought. The treatment of the Beast Tamers on World King Planet was really generous.
Legends were everywhere, and legendary-level was no longer the patent of the older generation. The best of the younger generation could also reach it. Only the divine level seemed to be the dividing line.
This was all because this side had a deeper understanding of the Beast Taming Space and the development and research of contracts. Even a Beast Tamer intern could contract a divine beast cub through a little modification of the Beast Taming Space. Then, both parties could promote each other’s growth.
This way, as long as there were conditions to contract a divine beast cub, it was completely no problem for it to become legendary in the twenties. As for the divine beast cub, it could also enjoy the resources alone in the modified Beast Taming Space and quickly become a demigod or even a divine level. The only flaw was that the modified Beast Taming Space could only contract one pet.
From this point of view, the legend of the Blue Planet was actually quite impressive. After all, it was a legend that cultivated weak pets and relied on its own strength to grow, not a legend that relied on the growth of divine beasts to quickly reach.
“After this Lu Ran cultivated a combination divine skill, his strength has indeed increased greatly! If he participates in the God Sealing Battle this time, he should be able to enter the top 1 million, right?” In the audience seats, other Floating Planet geniuses also discussed.
After the battle ended, Zhao Miao’er was teleported out. As for Lu Ran, he took out restoration supplements for himself and the Sun God Rock to use, as if he still planned to continue fighting.
“Can I fight him?” Shi Yu asked the Phoenix man beside him. The other party’s skill was inclined towards the sun fire element. Little Ji, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and the others could use it. Although he felt that there was nothing strange, one was similar to Clear Sky, a quasi-divine skill version of Clear Sky, and the other was similar to the Fire Seed of Life, it was better than nothing. He would choose him and wait for others to challenge him.
“Sure, sure. Just insert the battle card here.” The Phoenix man patted the armrest beside the audience and said, “You can directly apply for the arena from here.”
“Alright.” Shi Yu followed the Phoenix Man’s guidance and inserted the battle card into the card slot. Then, right on the heels of that, a virtual image interface popped up in front of him.
…
At the same time, below, Lu Ran was resting and waiting for his next opponent. The reason why he worked so hard was because he wanted to use the pressure of a strong enemy to train the two quasi-divine skills to the extreme. Fortunately, he had an outstanding performance in the next God Sealing Battle.
As the greatest competition on the World King Planet, the importance of the God Sealing Battle was self-evident. If one stood out on this, the benefits would be endless. The ranking here was just like the ranking of Earth’s college entrance examination. To a certain extent, it determined a person’s future life.
Beep beep…
“Who is it this time?” There weren’t many Level 9 geniuses from the Floating Planet in Sky City. Lu Ran almost knew all of them. Seeing that someone wanted to spar with him again, he couldn’t help but activate the virtual bracelet and look at the light information thrown.
[Applicant for the challenge: Shi Yu; Level: Level 9.]
[Please confirm the battle time…]
“Shi Yu? Why didn’t I hear…” Lu Ran frowned. Could it be someone from another city who came to travel?

chapters.title: Chapter 1308 - 1308 The First Battle in the Universe (3)
chapters.content:
1308  The First Battle in the Universe (3)
For a moment, he couldn't remember who it was, so he simply confirmed the challenge time. It didn't matter who the opponent was.
"He seems to have accepted it. The battle is in five minutes," Shi Yu said to the audience.
"I wonder if the other party knows you…" At this moment, the corners of the Phoenix man's mouth twitched as he suddenly thought of something.
At this moment, he already knew who spread the news of him losing to Shi Yu.
He originally thought that it was those two guys from the Angel and Demon Race, but later on, he realized that it was Lord Lin Feng who spouted nonsense and spread it… Damn it!!
However, it was Lord Lin Feng. He couldn't say anything. No wonder Lin Feng's grandchildren were the first to contact him.
"I don't think so. Aren't you stronger than him? If he knew that I defeated you before, he definitely wouldn't have accepted it so cleanly without even resting," Shi Yu analyzed with a smile.
Phoenix Man, Star Phoenix: ! @#@!¥
"Roar!!" Beside Shi Yu, Little Ji was already excited.
At the same time, the preview of the next round had already been updated in the various audience seats.
Most people looked at the words [Lu Ran vs Shi Yu] and were at a loss. Who was Shi Yu?
However, very few people suddenly widened their eyes after thinking about it.
In a certain seat, a young man in luxurious clothes was stunned for a moment. Then, right on the heels of that, he looked around and searched for something. He took out his communication device and made a call.
After picking up, he immediately said, "Cousin, cousin, the Shi Yu you mentioned previously is Shi Yu from the Blue Planet. He appeared in the Sky Arena."
Shi Yu's name was neither unfamiliar nor familiar, but a portion of people knew him. After these people reacted, they immediately informed each other.
Soon, many people rushed towards the Sky Arena.
Even Zhao Miao'er, who had just been beaten down, returned to the audience to recuperate. When she saw Shi Yu's name, she was slightly stunned and felt that it was a little familiar.
"Could it be… that Shi Yu?" she thought weakly.
On the other side, Shi Yu was almost done waiting. When the five minutes were up, he and Little Ji were teleported to the arena below by a spatial power in the audience.
Because the venue of the previous battle was broken, it automatically changed into a new lawn venue at the same time.
"You're Shi Yu? Why haven't I heard of you before? You're not a local, right?" Below, Lu Ran and the Sun God Rock had been waiting for a long time. They saw Shi Yu in a panda suit and the brown dragon beside Shi Yu and asked.
"Yes, I've just come to Sky City for half a month," Shi Yu replied.
"I see." Lu Ran nodded and said, "But even if you're a guest, we won't show mercy."
As soon as he finished speaking, a strong heat wave erupted from the Sun God Rock and turned into deterrence, reminding him of the start of the battle. At the same time, Lu Ran also activated a dual-element strengthening method to assist the Sun God Rock in increasing its strength.
"Sun Flame…" Lu Ran waved his hand and indeed didn't hold back. He attacked immediately.
Hu hu hu…
A monstrous heat wave spread from the Sun God Rock's body. It instantly turned into a real sun. After several huge spiral flames rose from its body, nine huge sun fireballs condensed around it and flew out!
It used a transcendent super skill to test him.
"Roar!!!" At the same time, in the face of the nine huge sun fireballs flying over, Little Ji also roared and ran forward. Seeing this, many spectators in the audience watched intently.
Those who didn't know Shi Yu and were a little familiar with his name paid attention to the battle.
"He really doesn't plan to send other pets??" The Phoenix man was also silent. Although the style of the genius Beast Tamer on the World King Planet was to only contract a mythical cub, this wasn't a tradition on the Blue Planet. Shi Yu clearly had a bunch of pets, but he only sent a second team pet now. Was it alright?
"Roar!!!" Then, Little Ji, who had followed Shi Yu over, used its actions to prove that it alone was enough. It first pulled away from Shi Yu to avoid the aftermath of the move affecting Shi Yu. Then, it stood on the spot and raised its head. It looked at the nine huge fireballs falling domineeringly and was indifferent.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom boom!!!
Nine big fireballs fell onto Little Ji's body. Its expression didn't change as it directly endured it. Fiery red smoke rose from all directions. After many people were slightly shocked, with a huge dragon roar, the deterrence wave directly collapsed the fire.
Under the lingering of the Fire Exort Snakes that filled the sky, Little Ji entered a battle state. It blew away the smoke and revealed its uninjured body. The yellow patterns and stomach directly flowed with the power of magma. Its huge tail smashed into the ground, and it looked at the Sun God Rock and Lu Ran opposite it with an invincible gaze.
As the overlord of the earth, it wasn't even afraid of seawater, let alone fire!
Of course, most importantly, the Destruction Body not only gave Little Ji the power to destroy everything, but it also made its body incomparably strong and difficult to destroy!
"He's a tough nut!!" After discovering that Little Ji was especially violent, many spectators revealed interested expressions and looked at Shi Yu in the panda suit.
Without using its strengthening ability, the pet relied on its own body to resist the other party's strengthened move. It wasn't simple. This time, Lu Ran might have encountered a strong enemy.
"Don't underestimate us. Just use that move just now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1309 - 1309 The First Battle in the Universe (4)
chapters.content:
1309 The First Battle in the Universe (4)
“That combination divine skill.”
“We’re here to learn this.” Shi Yu stood opposite and smiled at Lu Ran on the other side.
On the other side, Lu Ran frowned and said, “Is that so? Alright, you don’t look like you can easily deal with it.”
He was also here to practice the quasi-divine combination skill. Since Shi Yu had a request, he immediately stretched out his arm. The Sun God Rock turned into a Rock Sun Spear again and appeared in Lu Ran’s hand.
“Be careful. I feel that the other party isn’t simple. That dragon’s eyes are filled with invincibility. It’s either an expert or a fool,” the Sun God Rock, which had turned into a spear, reminded.
“Let’s do it too.” At that moment, when Shi Yu saw that the other party had entered a state, he looked at Little Ji.
Little Ji was stunned and understood. It couldn’t help but feel excited.
Fusion!
Shi Yu wanted to fuse with it!!
It could brag for the rest of its life!
Yes, now, Shi Yu had also cultivated his Fusion Talent. Although it hadn’t been developed to a very high level and couldn’t increase Little Ji’s strength greatly, it was enough.
He developed the Fusion Talent only to conveniently use the pet’s body to touch the other party and replicate skills.
Shi Yu slowly walked forward. Like Little Ji, his body was filled with red light, turning into a light rainbow that filled the sky. In the next moment, they seemed to have fused. With a hum, a terrifying might erupted in the light.
Boom!!
After the deterrence turned into a gust that collapsed the light, one of the monster dragonmen, who was more than four meters tall and had a strong body, appeared shockingly under the endless spirit deterrence. Its clothes exploded, and red magma flowed between its muscles and dragon scales. Two pairs of dragon horns grew behind its head.
This was the first time Shi Yu had entered this state. He shook his body and looked at the spearman opposite him with red eyes. “Alright, come on.”
“Hey, hey, hey…” Lu Ran, who had originally not realized how strong Shi Yu and the others were, suddenly frowned as Shi Yu and Little Ji fused. This was because the dragon’s might emitted from Shi Yu and the others was too terrifying, making even the fire afraid.
“…” Not to mention him, this was the first time the Phoenix man had seen this state. He took a deep breath and felt that Shi Yu had changed… After coming into contact with cosmic civilization, this Blue Planet monster seemed to have become stronger.
On the arena, the warpath fluctuations became stronger and stronger. After being cautious, Lu Ran still chose to attack.
“Sun Disaster, Sun Meteorite!” Lu Ran shouted. Under the Sun Disaster, the sun condensed, and the grass field instantly turned into a sea of fire. The ground cracked for a thousand miles. Fire also spread all over his body, turning into a flame. His spear shot out like a dragon and pierced over.
Boom!!!
The sun flame explosion that spread on their bodies seemed to have turned them into an Illuminate. It was very strong and instantly pierced the spot in front of Shi Yu, who was in his dragonman form. But in the next moment, with a bang, the entire place fell silent.
The profundity spear formed by the two quasi-divine skills was directly pinched in the hand of the tall dragonman in front of him. Shi Yu stretched out his arm and pinched the tip of the sun spear with his palm. His body allowed the flames to burn and the power impale didn’t move at all.
On the other hand, the pinched spear and Lu Ran, who was holding the spear, widened their eyes and trembled in disbelief.
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Great… Disaster!”
Boom!!!
On the dragon’s body, a top-notch destructive power spread and fused into the vibration disaster. Shi Yu’s body was like an erupting volcano, surging with shocking power. With a wave of Shi Yu’s arm, Lu Ran and the spear were raised by him. After squeezing hard, the spear shattered. Then, as Shi Yu turned around, another punch suddenly hit Lu Ran’s abdomen, making him vomit blood. His eyes were shocked. Right on the heels of that, he immediately flew out like a meteor.
Bang!!!
It hit the energy protective shield opposite. At the same time, the Sun God Rock that had been crushed into powder condensed again. But before it could react, its huge dragon tail whipped and directly pulled it back to the Beast Tamer’s side, shattering again.
“Little Ji, your strength is pretty good.” Shi Yu stood on the shattered ground and lowered his arm to praise.
“Roar!! (It’s thanks to your increase, Beast Tamer!!)” In its body, Little Ji praised him back.
In short, a one-hit kill.
For a moment, the entire place was silent.
“This…”
Zhao Miao’er and the snake-haired sea demon, who had just been defeated by Lu Ran, said in disbelief, “The prototype of a top-notch law, a combination divine skill that integrates the power of destruction.”
“What the hell?” The Phoenix man suddenly stood up and looked at Shi Yu, whose battle power was peerless, in confusion. He widened his eyes and felt that Shi Yu in his current state was definitely not inferior to him after fusing with the Star Phoenix. He might even be stronger.
Holy shit, what was going on? Why did this dragon also master the prototype of a top-notch law?
No one expected the battle to end so quickly. At this moment, the Lin family’s genius, Lin Rui, who rushed over while panting, also held the railing and looked at the venue in front of him with a burning gaze, reminiscing about the scene just now.
“The prototype of a top-notch law… No wonder he could defeat Qi Mu, but why do I remember that he contracted so many pets? Which one is this?”
As soon as the destructive power appeared, not to mention the audience, one of the Space Emperor’s pets, a Void Divine Dragon in charge of suppressing the Sky Arena, also suddenly opened its eyes and looked at this level.
“It’s him. Wang Kong said that this kid isn’t at ease. As expected, it’s been less than half a month, and he couldn’t help but come to the arena… The power of destruction is indeed extraordinary. I hope nothing happens. Why don’t I contact Wang Kong? Forget it, it shouldn’t be…” It muttered to itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 1310 - 1310 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (1)
chapters.content:
1310 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (1)
[Copy successful]
< Name > Sun Disaster
< Introduction > It’s a quasi-divine-level fire-element skill.
It contained the law of fire drought.
The effect was to trigger the disaster of the sun and create an absolute high temperature. It increased the strength of the sun and weakened the strength of the water-element power.
[Copy successful]
< Name > Sun Meteor
< Introduction > It’s a quasi-divine-level fire-element skill.
It contained the law of fire burning.
The effect was to burn life force and create a weapon that was enough to fall the sun.
“…”
On the arena, as Shi Yu grabbed Lu Ran’s arms, shattered them, and sent him flying, he had already successfully replicated two quasi-divine skills.
After taking a closer look at the Skill Effect, Shi Yu realized that both skills were alright. At least, they weren’t useless.
In Shi Yu’s team, Chi Tong, Baby Ginseng, and Little Ji could all learn sun-related Skills. These two skills happened to be the most suitable for Little Ji in the arena.
With the Sun Disaster Skill, it could better target the ocean. Putting aside the increase in battle power, it could mainly make Little Ji more excited, providing it with emotional value.
No wonder Lu Ran could deal with the snake-haired sea demon so easily. So he had a fire-element skill that specialized in countering water-element…
As for the Sun Meteorite skill, it could also allow Little Ji, who was used to using the Space Splitting Sword and a super heavy sword, to have a more convenient weapon.
He shall see who still wanted to fly into the sky and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the sun. They would directly use the Sun Meteorite Sword to warn them!
Although they weren’t the prototypes of powerful divine skills, at least they weren’t completely useless. Moreover, they could still be fused in the future.
Shi Yu wasn’t that greedy. He wanted to be lucky enough to replicate top-notch skills the moment he came up and slowly search for them.
“The battle is over. The winner is Shi Yu!”
“Information update. Shi Yu has already become the new arena lord.”
At this moment, the battle ended. A mechanical voice came from somewhere in the spatial battlefield and announced the results.
“Roar!!” Under Little Ji’s triumphant roar, Shi Yu and it removed their fusion state.
Shi Yu’s upper body clothes had already exploded. He took out a new shirt from his space and hung it on his shoulder. He smiled at his opponent.
Lu Ran suffered one attack, and the Sun God Rock suffered two. At this moment, Lu Ran almost fainted, and the Sun God Rock could only be considered a serious injury. It could still continue fighting.
But at this point, the AI of the arena tower had already determined that there was no need to continue.
“Cough, cough.” Lu Ran, who was opposite him, opened his eyes with difficulty. His entire body twitched. At this moment, Shi Yu took out a nutritional fruit from his spatial pocket and accurately threw it beside the Sun God Rock.
“What are you doing?” The Sun God Rock formed a rock arm and caught the nutritional fruit. Its body was stunned as it sensed that this was a relatively high-level restoration item.
“It’s nothing. I just attacked a little too seriously. This is a special medicine for the attack just now. After giving it to him, he’ll recover quickly.”
Shi Yu maintained his smile. Even if he had the Crowd Control power, the injuries caused by the vibration power of destruction were very deep. Apart from Baby Ginseng’s medicine, Shi Yu was really worried that the other medicines weren’t good enough.
“No…” The Sun God Rock was just about to refuse, not wanting to accept its opponent’s charity, when they were teleported back to the audience seats by the arena. Only Shi Yu and the others were left in the arena.
“Roar!!!” Standing on the dry ground, Little Ji raised its head and roared again.
“I am the overlord of the earth!!!”
“No fear, all challenges!! Come to the water element!”
In order to better introduce itself to many spectators, Little Ji used the language of the mind. This was the universal language, a skill to transform telepathy into language. All races knew how to cultivate it.
As long as one wanted to use it, anyone could. It depended on whether they wanted to spend the effort.
While Shi Yu and the others were still below, the expressions of the Floating Planet geniuses in the audience were already extremely solemn.
“Who is this… So strong, he actually insta-killed Lu Ran.”
“Could it be a contractor who entered the top 10,000 before the God Sealing Battle?”
“What God Sealing Battle? He’s from Blue Planet, from the mother planet of the Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng. He’s a genius dug up by the Space Emperor and Lord Lin Feng from their mother planet! He just arrived at the World King Planet recently!” Someone among the geniuses who had just arrived at the arena said.
In an instant, Shi Yu’s identity exploded.
A genius dug up from his mother planet by the Space Emperor and Lin Feng?!
“No wonder he’s so strong.” The contractor of the snake-haired sea demon, Zhao Miao’er, saw that Lu Ran, who had easily defeated her, was easily insta-killed. Apart from being shocked, she was extremely curious about Shi Yu.
The Space Emperor and Lin Feng were the strongest Beast Tamers on the Floating Planet. Countless juniors were extremely curious about their identities and experiences.
Now that a genius from their hometown had appeared, how could they not care?
What kind of treasure land was this Blue Planet?
Not only did five god races appear, but there were also experts like the Space Emperor and Lin Feng who could fight above their level.
Now, another Beast Tamer had contracted and mastered the prototype of a top-notch destruction law at a young age!
Shi Yu’s identity immediately stimulated the desire of many people to win.
“Qi Mu, you’re indeed here.” Lin Rui, Lin Feng’s grandson, finally found Qi Mu, who was watching the show. He couldn’t help but say, “What’s going on? You brought him here?”
“Ah, Lin Rui.” When the Phoenix man saw the other party, he chuckled and said, “More or less. By the way, didn’t you want to get to know Shi Yu previously? Now that there’s a chance, go.”
He pointed down, meaning that Lin Rui would be able to get to know Shi Yu by challenging him.
Lin Rui’s expression was calm as he said, “You think I don’t dare? I’m not trash, Lu Ran. Although the prototype of top-notch laws is powerful, a prototype is still a prototype in the end. Moreover, from the looks of it, their cultivation level isn’t high.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1311 - 1311 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (2)
chapters.content:
1311 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (2)
“Then go.” The Phoenix man was amused.
As long as Shi Yu wanted to, he could casually summon six to seven demigods. Was this something a normal person could withstand?
Even if those demigods only had one quasi-divine skill, their numbers were f*cking crushing.
1+1+1+1+1+1+1 Even if it couldn’t be equal to 7, it shouldn’t be a problem for it to be greater than 4, right?
“Heh, so be it. I’ll fight him,” Lin Rui said with a cold snort. He directly found the battle card and applied for a challenge.
Seeing this, the Phoenix man adjusted his nonexistent glasses, and a glint flashed in his eyes.
The plan worked.
…
At the same time, below, Shi Yu also discovered the challenge application and accepted it without hesitation. He wanted to fight immediately and didn’t want to waste time.
As for resting? There was no need. When he was tired, he could just summon Baby Ginseng to heal him. If it really didn’t work, he could still change pets and go on stage.
At the same time, while the various spectators were still shocked by Shi Yu’s identity, the preview of the next battle had already been updated.
The words [Shi Yu vs Lin Rui] stunned many people.
“Lin Rui, he’s here too?”
The snake-haired sea demon and Zhao Miao’er were very surprised to see this name. Lin Rui was the grandson of the second expert of the Floating Planet, Lin Feng. His strength could rank him in the top five of the third-generation Beast Tamers of the Floating Planet. He had once obtained the best result in the God Sealing Battle and entered the top 10,000 once.
It was in a completely different dimension from Lu Ran and the others.
Of course, Shi Yu didn’t know this, but he wouldn’t feel anything even if he knew. The stronger the opponent, the happier he was. After all, the stronger the opponent, the stronger the skill he might carry.
“Oh my god.” At this moment, the Void Divine Dragon, who was guarding the arena to spy on this side, couldn’t help but fall silent when it saw that Lin Feng’s grandson was here.
It glanced over again and realized that not only was Lin Feng’s grandson here, but it also discovered a tall woman in a black one-piece dress in an audience seat.
“Qing Qing…” The Void Divine Dragon felt a headache.
The Space Emperor’s favorite granddaughter was also here.
These two people were the same as the disciples of the Space Emperor, Zi Lan. They were outstanding among the third-generation Beast Tamers of the Floating Planet. The Void Divine Dragon estimated that they were both attracted by the news of Shi Yu’s appearance.
So strong…
Soon, a minute passed. Lin Feng’s grandson, Lin Rui, was teleported down. The moment he came down, he saw Shi Yu, who was shirtless, and the dragon that had mastered destructive power staring at them.
“Your name is Lin Rui. What’s your relationship with Senior Lin Feng?” Shi Yu asked with a smile.
“He’s my grandfather. You’re Shi Yu from Blue Planet, right? Grandpa has a very high opinion of you. Come, let me spar with you.” Lin Rui summoned the golden array with a calm expression. In the array, a golden-yellow light dragon in armor appeared beside him. Its aura was several times stronger than that of the Sun God Rock, enough to compete with Zi Lan’s Star Dragon.
“I see.” Shi Yu came to a realization.
How nice.
Emperor Kong and Lin Feng had a lot of descendants.
When would he have a son? No, a daughter was better.
“Roar!!!”
At this moment, the Light Dragon appeared and also looked at Little Ji with a serious expression.
“Hey, you’re from Blue Planet, right? Why can it even master the prototype of a top-notch law?”
Obviously, the Light Dragon also paid attention to the battle just now.
It was a descendant of the dragon race among the five major god races on Blue Planet. It was born with the inheritance of the four divine skills. After stepping into the divine level, it was a high-level Mythical Race and a noble among the dragons on Blue Planet. According to what it knew, the dragons left on Blue Planet were basically the descendants of low-level god races and even demigods.
The theory that it had mastered was at most a normal divine skill with some talent. At most, it would cultivate the prototype of a high-level divine skill later. However, the dragon beside Shi Yu that had come from Blue Planet had mastered the prototype of a top-notch divine skill. This was a little unacceptable to it. It felt that it was completely inferior.
Why did a mere low-level dragon master the prototype of a top-notch divine skill that even a high-level dragon like it didn’t master!
“Do you want to know? It’s not a secret. I’ll tell you after the battle.” Shi Yu chuckled.
Just as he finished speaking, with a boom, the Light Dragon turned into a beam of light and instantly appeared in front of Little Ji. Its speed was so fast that no one could react at all. Its right claw condensed into a fist, and the Lightspeed Fist instantly hit Little Ji’s stomach.
Lightspeed Fist, Lightspeed Law! It could allow one to exceed the limits of their body’s endurance and display extreme speed!
Almost no one present saw this attack clearly.
In fact, the Light Dragon’s Lightspeed Fist had also instantly killed Lin Rui’s opponent many times before his opponent could react.
“This…”
When everyone reacted, they stared at the arena in a daze. With a boom, accompanied by a huge sound, the ground behind Little Ji was flipped over. Countless sands and dust swept up the Illuminate to form a storm, and the sky cracked. However, to everyone’s surprise, in the face of this sudden punch, this brown dragon still didn’t move at all!
Instead, it slowly raised its head and looked at the Light Dragon that had punched it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1312 - 1312 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (3)
chapters.content:
1312 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (3)
At this moment, the Light Dragon was also very stunned.
Apart from the vibration law and the destruction law, the dragon Shi Yu sent also mastered the earth law!
The laws of the earth stood where the ground was. Even the sky and the ocean were as stable as the ground. It could even casually create land, forming ocean islands and empty islands.
At the same time, it connected to the ground and controlled all the power of the earth.
Little Ji still let the other party’s attack hit it, and the dignity of the earth’s overlord was undoubtedly displayed. The Light Dragon felt that the attack had hit the ground of the World King Planet. Although it could cause damage, it couldn’t cause a destructive attack.
“Roar!!! (Little Brother, what’s wrong with you! I’m the overlord of the earth!!)” Little Ji was very unhappy to be ambushed. It seemed to have received the skill with light injuries, but it was actually slow and couldn’t dodge, so it was very unhappy.
It turned its head and released a destructive dragon’s breath, but the Light Dragon dodged with a flash. Its speed was extremely fast.
“It’s useless. Its attack can’t hit.” Seeing that Shi Yu didn’t use his talent to join the battlefield for a long time, Lin Rui didn’t join the battlefield either. Both parties watched the two contracted beasts fight.
“Is that so?” Shi Yu didn’t believe it, nor did Little Ji. It directly covered the entire place with strong gravity. The world instantly blurred, filled with endless gravity black lines, but the Light Dragon still flew easily in midair. The gravity didn’t seem to affect it at all.
Shi Yu knew that it was another quasi-divine skill similar to a mirage where light and space intertwined, deceiving all attacks.
“Shi Yu was suppressed by Young Master Lin.” At this moment, such voices began to appear in the audience.
Seeing that Little Ji was helpless against the Light Dragon, everyone couldn’t help but recall the pain of being tortured by Lin Rui’s Lightspeed Law and the Light Dream Law.
“Bullshit.”
Only the Phoenix man had a calm expression. This was nothing. Shi Yu had a bunch of pets. Even if in this match, it was difficult to determine the winner, just casually sending a few more could change the situation.
Moreover, with this Earth Dragon’s defense and attack power, it wasn’t easy for the Light Dragon to easily defeat it.
“See, as long as we want to, we can be invincible.” In the arena, Lin Rui smiled and said, “So, can you tell us first?”
Lin Rui himself also felt that he had a huge advantage.
Seeing this, Shi Yu was amused.
“Do you really want to know?” Shi Yu crossed his arms and said, “I’m afraid that if I say it, this battle will end.”
“Huh?” Lin Rui and the Light Dragon were stunned.
Shi Yu said, “The origin of its destruction law prototype is also very simple. Do you know the Ancestral Dragon, which is the ancestor of the dragons among the five major god races on Blue Planet, or rather, the first dragon on Blue Planet?”
“In the Mythical Era of Blue Planet, the Ancestral Dragon divided into two, turning into the main body of the Creation God Dragon and the clone of the World Destruction Demon Dragon. Among them, the World Destruction Demon Dragon mastered the power of destruction and gave birth to the Dragon Race. However, because it was too brutal, it wanted to destroy the world and was suppressed by the Ancestral Dragon.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “However, actually, the World Destruction Demon Dragon didn’t completely die. In the future, it wreaked havoc again. Coincidentally, we encountered it. Therefore, we helped the Ancestral Dragon clean up and completely killed the World Destruction Demon Dragon. At the same time, we digested its power.”
“This is how destructive power comes about.”
“If I’m not wrong, you’re also a descendant of the World Annihilation Demon Dragon, right?” Shi Yu looked at the Light Dragon Lin Rui had contracted.
What he said had a huge impact on Lin Rui and the Light Dragon.
It also had an incomparable impact on all the geniuses present.
Many people widened their eyes and looked at Shi Yu and Little Ji. They… destroyed and absorbed the dark side of the Ancestral Dragon on Blue Planet??
So this was how the destructive power came about?
Ancestral Dragon, World Destruction Demon Dragon… An ancestor of the Blue Planet Dragon Race…
Even the pupils of the Space Emperor Divine Pet in the void were constricted.
“Impossible…” The Light Dragon was angry. Although their ancestors had long abandoned the dark and joined the light, no one would be in a good mood if they told you in person that they destroyed your ancestors.
However, as Little Ji raised its head, a dark red light flashed in its eyes. The bodies of the Light Dragon and Lin Rui trembled at the same time.
“Roar!!!” A terrifying dragon might spread from the Destruction Body. The destructive power wrapped itself around deterrence, shocking everyone.
“Then feel the suppression of the bloodline.”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, Little Ji’s dragon’s might directly caused space to tremble. The substantial dragon’s might swept through everything, just like how the Dragon God and the Dragon Emperor couldn’t resist the World Annihilation Dragon’s might at that time. As a descendant of the Blue Planet Dragon Race, the Light Dragon in front of them was as afraid as they were after facing it.
It indeed sensed the suppression of the bloodline power, and its thoughts, consciousness, and physical movements became extremely slow.
As the deterrence erupted, time seemed to have frozen. The entire arena fell silent.
“Roar!!!”
Little Ji raised its head and roared!!!
It attacked again.
Amidst the trembling sounds around, the ground under Little Ji’s feet quickly cracked and spread quickly. In an instant, there was no intact place in the arena.
Quasi-divine skill, Cataclysm!
To be precise, it was a combination quasi-divine skill after fusing the destructive power and combining it with Earth Control!

chapters.title: Chapter 1313 - 1313 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (4)
chapters.content:
1313 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (4)
World-destroying disaster!
Because this wasn’t a planet at all, theoretically speaking, Little Ji’s effect of using the Cataclysm here was greatly reduced.
However, the reason why Shi Yu added some Earth Control to Little Ji first was to avoid this situation.
With the control of the ground, even if it was in the sky and the starry sky, Little Ji could make the land it stood on become the ground, displaying the perfect effect as much as possible!
Now, it had even fused with the destructive power. Compared to the original World Destroyer, the Earth Divine Dragon, the current Little Ji should be better known as the World Destroyer!!
It had already surpassed its master.
“Roar!!” Everyone felt the horror of this move.
In an instant, shocking magma flames spread from the crack in the ground. As the ground trembled, they swept up like a tsunami, devouring the ground and sweeping with layers of power. In an instant, they spewed out like a volcano eruption!
Boom!!!
The entire venue was like a volcano. With Little Ji as the core, the magma sea of fire rolled. The magma pillar of fire more than a thousand meters in diameter swept the destructive power of the shock wave into the sky and devoured the Light Dragon!
Everyone held their breaths and could see that the frightened Lin Rui and the Light Dragon wanted to resist, but their trembling bodies made the audience very clear…
The other party was shocked by the deterrence and found it difficult to move!
Deterrence of the same level rarely happened. Then, there was only one possibility. What Shi Yu said was true.
They really destroyed the dark side of the Ancestral Dragon and absorbed its power. Only in this way would the Light Dragon, a descendant of the World Destruction Demon Dragon, and its contractor feel such strong and irresistible pressure.
“No…” As the Light Dragon shouted, the magma swallowed it with a bang. The magma rain that filled the sky exploded, shaking the energy shield. At this moment, the World Annihilation Dragon might finally dissipate. On the other side, Lin Rui’s face was pale. He panted to the limit and looked at the scene in front of him in disbelief.
Bang bang bang bang bang!! Lava balls fell, and the Light Dragon also fell.
“Light Enhancement, activate!”
