“Healing strengthening, activate…!” Lin Rui quickly shouted in succession. At the same time, he activated all the strength in his body. Law ripples lingered on his body. He had actually developed and mastered a divine-level talent like Zi Lan.
Under his strengthening, the surrounding light seemed to have been absorbed by the fallen Light Dragon. The explosive burns on its body quickly recovered their restoration, suspected to be the ability of a quasi-divine skill to absorb light to recover from injuries.
“Lin Rui lost!” Seeing this, no one dared to believe it, but the truth was so ridiculous. It was another insta-kill battle, and it even triggered the news of a shocking explosion. It was big news that was enough to shock the dragons of the five major god races on Blue Planet.
“Just one more attack!”
At the moment, although Lin Rui quickly helped the Light Dragon recover its restoration, anyone could tell that as long as Shi Yu attacked in a hurry, victory was in his grasp.
“Let’s see who’s still talking about me!!” The Phoenix Man and the Star Phoenix were also very shocked. They didn’t expect that this silly-looking dragon could actually be considered a different Ancestral Dragon inheritance.
No wonder Shi Yu said that its strength had increased greatly and it had been reborn.
Moreover, he had also seen the combination skill just now. The earth-element and spatial disaster, together with the earth-element Earth Control and the destructive power, was simply perfect. This was a real disaster-type skill!
This was much more perfect than the quasi-divine skill of that Light Dragon.
At this moment, the Phoenix man even had a feeling that this dragon was Shi Yu’s strongest pet now.
No matter what, even Lord Lin Feng’s biological grandson had been defeated. There shouldn’t be anyone complaining about his loss, right!
“This guy is indeed very strong…” The Space Emperor’s granddaughter also looked at this scene in silence and said, “However, Lin Rui losing so quickly is also related to that dragon being suppressed by its bloodline. If it were me…”
“Is that so? Then do you want to challenge it too?” At this moment, another voice sounded. Wang Qingqing looked over and said, “Sister Zi Lan, why are you here?”
“It’s nothing. I just came to take a look.” Zi Lan sat beside Wang Qingqing and smiled. “Sister Qingqing, go challenge it and take a look.”
Wang Qingqing kept feeling that her grandfather’s disciple wanted to harm her, but there was no evidence.
As the Floating Planet genius who led the team to the Blue Planet, Zi Lan definitely knew Shi Yu’s strength the best.
“As long as you win, I’ll give you the Skill Crystal you’ve been thinking about for a long time,” Zi Lan said.
Wang Qingqing was stunned. “It’s a deal?”
“Well… However, the battle doesn’t seem to be over…” Zi Lan suddenly looked at the arena.
Shi Yu didn’t add fuel to the fire. Instead, he and Little Ji watched the other party recover his Restoration calmly. This stunned many people. They didn’t expect Shi Yu to be a “gentleman”.
At this moment, on the other side, Lin Rui and the Light Dragon were rather miserable, but they quickly recovered and looked at Shi Yu in shock.
Shi Yu walked to Little Ji’s side and smiled at them.
“Continue. The best way to eliminate fear is to face fear. Come, don’t waste this battle. Let’s attack together in the second round,” Shi Yu invited Lin Rui.
“You…” At this moment, be it Lin Rui, the Light Dragon, or the audience, their hearts trembled.
“Could it be…” The Space Emperor’s granddaughter was slightly surprised.
Was Shi Yu trying to help Lin Rui and the Light Dragon overcome their weakness??

chapters.title: Chapter 1314 - 1314 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (5)
chapters.content:
1314 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (5)
He recalled that Shi Yu had just given his defeated opponent, Lu Ran, restoration items. In an instant, many people began to have a new understanding of this genius Beast Tamer from the Blue Planet.
On the other side, Lin Rui was also stunned when he heard Shi Yu’s words. Then, he was completely convinced.
“Come on!!!” He shouted. Just as Shi Yu had said, he couldn’t waste this battle. The best way to eliminate fear was to face it! He and the Light Dragon didn’t want to experience the situation again!!
At this moment, Shi Yu and Little Ji fused.
He was too excited just now and forgot to replicate the skill. Moreover, the other party still had a quasi-divine skill that he had yet to use. He could only activate the second round.
This time, he had to show some mercy.
However, the other party was so arrogant just now, so he couldn’t show too much mercy. He still had to beat the other party up!
…
Next, Lin Rui and the Light Dragon were undoubtedly beaten out by the dragonman that Shi Yu and Little Ji had fused into.
However, this time, Lin Rui lost wholeheartedly. After being beaten up and having his Skill replicated, he was actually grateful to Shi Yu for being a sparring partner and helping them undergo weakness training.
“Unbelievable…”
At this moment, as Shi Yu easily defeated Lin Rui, many geniuses of the Floating Planet fell silent. They didn’t expect this Blue Planet person to be so strong.
He actually relied on the Fusion Talent to defeat Lin Rui, who used several talents and divine-level talent to strengthen the Light Dragon.
In the next moment, to everyone’s surprise, the battle preview of [Shi Yu vs Wang Qingqing] followed closely.
Moreover, a minute later.
“Doesn’t this guy need to rest?” In the audience, Wang Qingqing, who was challenging Zi Lan to a bet, looked confused.
After the arena lord encountered a challenge, he could freely choose the next battle time in 1 to 120 minutes.
Generally speaking, they would choose according to consumption and use their free time to recover. However, Wang Qingqing didn’t expect that Shi Yu would accept her challenge again just as she finished fighting, and it was immediate.
She looked at the arena. The current World Annihilation Dragon, Little Ji, had clearly used quasi-divine skills many times in a row. Its stamina should be at its limit!
Moreover, Shi Yu and the dragon’s injuries were also extremely obvious. It wasn’t that they weren’t injured at all.
“Did they press the wrong button? After all, this is their first time here,” Wang Qingqing said.
Wang Qingqing: “?”
Before she could be puzzled, she was teleported to the arena. As Wang Qingqing appeared, Lu Ran, Lin Rui, and the other Floating Planet geniuses also looked at the arena solemnly.
At this moment, Wang Qingqing finally had a chance to ask Shi Yu.
She looked seriously at Shi Yu, who had untied his fusion with Little Ji, and said, “Don’t you guys need to rest? It’s only been a minute. Even if I win, I’ll feel that it was an unfair victory.”
“His surname is Wang. What’s your relationship with Senior Space Emperor?” Shi Yu asked.
Wang Qingqing said, “That’s my grandfather.”
“Another grandfather…” Shi Yu was silent. That guy should have many rare spatial skills like Zi Lan. Shi Yu smiled and said, “You don’t have to worry. Our consumption isn’t much.”
“Hm?”
Under Wang Qingqing’s confused expression, Shi Yu pulled open another summoning array. Under the stunned expressions of many geniuses, he summoned a radish less than half a meter tall. No, it was Baby Ginseng!
“Yiya.” After Baby Ginseng came out, it directly aimed its two small palms at Little Ji and Shi Yu and released green airwaves. At the same time, nomological fluctuations surrounded it.
The rich energy directly allowed Little Ji and Shi Yu, whose energy auras had decreased a little because of the two battles, to restore to their peak again!
There was no obstacle that Baby Ginseng couldn’t solve! It was just two battles, and the consumption was much smaller than adding points and fusing!
Baby Ginseng could be considered to have trained it.
“You’ve worked hard. Stay beside us and heal us,” Shi Yu said to Baby Ginseng after receiving the healing.
“Roar!!! (Thank you, towering emperor!!)” Little Ji was also very satisfied. Impressive.
It felt like it was filled with strength again!
It could still fight for 10 rounds!
At this moment, seeing that Shi Yu had returned to the peak, the Space Emperor’s granddaughter opposite was already stunned.
“A demigod-level supplement-type plant life form.”
She suddenly recalled that Shi Yu and her grandfather came from the same place. In that case, the tradition over there was that one person could have many pets!!
The Beast Tamers over there couldn’t directly contract divine pets. They had to rely on cultivating low-level pets to slowly grow. They lost to their race and won in numbers!
Then Shi Yu was the same?
However, she felt that the race level of that World Destruction Dragon wasn’t low either!!! It wasn’t inferior to the divine beast cub here at all!
“Yiya!!” At this moment, many Floating Planet geniuses were stunned when they saw Baby Ginseng directly take root in a corner and watch the battle happily. No way…
This guy had many pets?!
Only Phoenix Man and Zi Lan revealed calm expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1315 - 1315 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (6)
chapters.content:
1315 The Space Emperor Who Became Sorrowful (6)
Therefore, they said that the most scammy thing about Shi Yu was that he had contracted a bunch of demigods alone. Speaking of which, was this guy really not worried that he couldn’t afford to raise pets in the future? It was alright now, but after the divine level, that was a pit.
If Shi Yu wanted to nurture every pet to the super divine level, it would be even harder. Where could he find a two-digit source of transcendence? In his dreams?
“He contracted many, but he only sent one… You mean…”
At this moment, when she realized that Shi Yu had a bunch of pets but only took one out to fight her, it was definitely because he looked down on her. The Space Emperor’s granddaughter was a little angry and directly attacked.
In the void, the Void Divine Dragon was still silent. It shouldn’t be a problem for a junior to fight, right…
Forget it, it was indeed better to inform the Space Emperor.
…
On the Floating Planet, the Space Emperor, who was handling important matters, suddenly received telepathy from the Void Divine Dragon in Sky City.
“Wang Kong, Wang Kong, are you there?”
The Space Emperor stood on the spot and said, “I’m here. What’s wrong?”
The Void Divine Dragon said, “That Shi Yu from the Blue Planet came to the arena.”
After being stunned, the Space Emperor said, “Oh, that’s normal. He should have already adapted to the environment of the World King Planet and wanted to walk around. Why, is he fighting anyone? With his strength, there shouldn’t be anyone among the three generations of the Floating Planet who’s his match.”
The Void Divine Dragon said, “Lu Ran of the Lu family was easily defeated by him with a dragon-type pet.”
“Lin Feng’s grandson, Lin Rui, was also easily defeated by him with a dragon-type pet.”
The Space Emperor said, “Huh? That kid Lin Rui lost too? I have to tell Lin Feng later. The dragon-type pet is that Green Dragon? It’s actually so strong? Even if it mastered the laws of creation, it shouldn’t be able to defeat Lin Rui alone, right? Could it be that Shi Yu consumed a large amount of power of faith? Or does that Green Dragon have other quasi-divine skills?”
The Void Divine Dragon said, “It’s not the Green Dragon, but another one. It should be the so-called mechanical phantom beast. Most importantly, this pet has mastered the Destruction Law, which is also a top-notch law! According to Shi Yu, it’s the destructive power they absorbed and mastered after destroying the Ancestral Dragon clone of the World Destruction Demon Dragon left on the Blue Planet. That Earth Dragon is simply as strong as the World Destruction Dragon.”
“I wonder how the dragons will feel.”
On the other side, the Space Emperor fell into deep thought and also had a shocked expression. Shi Yu… had even destroyed the remnant soul of the Ancestral Dragon clone, the World Destruction Demon Dragon, on Blue Planet?
This was news that Zi Lan hadn’t reported previously. How many secrets was Shi Yu hiding?
“It’s alright,” the Space Emperor said. “Under the competition of the younger generation, it’s good too. I’ll also let these little guys on the Floating Planet experience the dangers of the universe.”
“Hasn’t that grandson Lin Feng been arrogant for a long time? Haha.”
The Void Divine Dragon said, “Don’t be amused. Just now, your most beloved granddaughter, Wang Qingqing, was also knocked out by Shi Yu.”
Emperor Kong: “?”
“Now, the second-generation disciples of the Floating Planet are also here. Your good-for-nothing son, who hasn’t reached the divine level, has also come. What if he also wants to challenge Shi Yu? I feel that he’s not his match. Are you going to let your son and granddaughter be beaten up? At that time, Lin Feng will definitely laugh even more arrogantly than you.”
The Space Emperor was stunned.
“This Shi Yu, didn’t I ask him to go to the Environmental Protection Association to apply for the identity certificate of the abyss pet as soon as possible? Why did he go to the arena again!” The Space Emperor couldn’t help but say angrily, “What if the pet is captured as an unregistered person! You, remind him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1316 - 1316 Space Disaster Research Institute (1)
chapters.content:
1316 Space Disaster Research Institute (1)
After obtaining the Space Emperor’s command, the Void Divine Dragon muttered in its heart.
The other party is fighting well, and it’ll be too obvious for me to suddenly stop him from fighting. It’ll be too much.
I, the Void Divine Dragon, can’t afford to lose that dragon.
“Wait, I have it.” The Void Divine Dragon suddenly thought of a brilliant plan.
At the same time.
After Shi Yu successfully replicated the skill from the Space Emperor’s granddaughter, he became more and more addicted.
Strong people were addicted.
They felt that this Sky Arena, no, this World King Planet, was really a good place.
On Blue Planet, it was too difficult to find a demigod who knew quasi-divine skills.
If he wanted to replicate the skill, a fight would have to alarm the world. It was a troublesome batch, and the consumption was huge.
However, on this World King Planet, as long as it was a genius of a large faction, everyone would contract a divine beast cub. The divine beast cub had many quasi-divine skills. Regardless of the quality, just in terms of numbers, it was too comfortable.
After replicating hundreds of quasi-divine skills and fusing them, wouldn’t he be invincible at the divine level in the future?
“This guy… They really don’t seem to have consumed any energy.”
“His condition is simply better than when he just started!”
“Did you notice that Shi Yu used other enhancements just now!”
“I feel it too. Although he fused previously, I can tell that the compatibility between the two parties isn’t very high, but in this battle, the other party seems to have even fused his mind.”
“Apart from that, there should also be a spatial strengthening talent. Shi Yu also cultivated a spatial strengthening ability!”
At this moment, when they saw Shi Yu and Little Ji easily defeat Wang Qingqing after being healed by Baby Ginseng, the expressions of many Floating Planet geniuses darkened.
They had the intention of facing a common enemy. After all, in the end, Shi Yu was still an outsider.
“Is there anyone else!” Below, Shi Yu didn’t care much and planned to continue.
Wang Qingqing was indeed not easy to fight. The spatial element was too difficult to fight, unlike the dragon element just now, which could be suppressed by bloodlines. Therefore, apart from fusing, Shi Yu and Little Ji entered a mental resonance state. At the same time, he also used his spatial strengthening talent.
After all, the Fusion Talent was cultivated later and wasn’t proficient. As for telepathy, it was a natural talent. It was better for Shi Yu to use it to strengthen the effect.
It was like a walking disaster!
“Roar!!!!” They won another battle. Under Little Ji’s roar, the weak Wang Qingqing was teleported out with an indignant expression.
At the same time, Baby Ginseng stretched again. Its palm faced Shi Yu and Little Ji as it released restoration fluctuations.
“Yiya!!”
A moment later, Shi Yu and Little Ji recovered to their peak state energetically. This scene was extremely ridiculous, making the corners of the mouths of the geniuses in the audience twitch.
In addition to Shi Yu’s declaration that he wanted to continue defending the arena, for a moment, many people looked at each other, wanting to see who could really punish Shi Yu.
Even if Shi Yu looked like a good person, they couldn’t let him keep winning in Sky City.
“Sister Qingqing, are you alright?” After the Space Emperor’s granddaughter was teleported back, Zi Lan immediately asked with concern.
“Sister Zi Lan, you harmed me,” Wang Qingqing said as soon as she returned. However, the Space Emperor’s disciple, Zi Lan, smiled and said, “No, you were the one who swore that you could defeat him.”
Wang Qingqing revealed an expression of great injustice.
Zi Lan chuckled, but she was actually quite shocked in her heart. After all, when Shi Yu was on Blue Planet, although his pets were very strong and had demigod battle power, she could tell that no matter which individual it was, they were still inferior to the cosmic partner they contracted.
At that time, no matter which pet Shi Yu took out alone, it was impossible for it to defeat the Star Phoenix that was resting on the tree.
He had to rely on a bunch of pets to win. Although it was indeed easy to win, in the end, it relied on numbers.
But now, given the current situation, Shi Yu alone had enough to sweep through three generations of Beast Tamers on the Floating Planet. How long had it been? This growth speed was simply too terrifying.
As the strongest on Blue Planet, he indeed had some farming skills.
Now that he had come into contact with a cosmic civilization, his improvement was even faster. Perhaps Shi Yu really had a chance to become famous in the God Sealing Battle and in the starry sky.
However, what concerned Zi Lan even more was that the arena had yet to announce the preview of the next battle.
After Shi Yu defeated Wang Qingqing, no one applied for the next battle. This situation made the corners of Zi Lan’s eyes twitch. Could it be… After hearing Shi Yu say that he still had a bunch of pets, no Beast Tamer on the Floating Planet dared to challenge him?
“Tsk.” Phoenix Man also discovered that the previews of the previous battles were seamlessly connected, but after this battle, no one challenged.
Hahaha, the direct descendants of Lord Lin Feng and Lord Space Emperor had lost. Let’s see who still muttered about him as an adopted son.
It would be best if more people lost!
“Sister Zi Lan, you’re stronger than me. Aren’t you going? You should know him the best and have the greatest hope of defeating him, right?” At this moment, the defeated Wang Qingqing said to Zi Lan, making Zi Lan fall into deep thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1317 - 1317 Space Disaster Research Institute (2)
chapters.content:
1317 Space Disaster Research Institute (2)
“Could it be that you’re also here to spar with him?” he said to the bearded geek beside him.
The person in front of him was one of the sons of the Space Emperor. He was relatively profligate. Although he was profligate, he was still a second-generation Beast Tamer of the Floating Planet after all. He had lived longer and had accumulated a richer foundation than the third-generation Beast Tamer.
The bearded otaku named Uncle Wang was stunned. He turned to look at Lin Rui and said, “Little Rui… Sigh, I’m just here to watch the commotion. Why should I interfere in the sparring between you juniors…”
“But don’t you like to spar with us juniors?” Lin Rui curled his lips and said. This guy couldn’t defeat the top geniuses of the same generation. He always liked to bully third-generation disciples in the name of guiding battles. His reputation was already far-reaching.
However, one way or another, the other party’s strength was indeed alright. After all, he had been stuck at Level 9 for a long time. In name, it was to fight in the God Sealing Battle for a few more years, but in fact, he was unwilling to compete with the geniuses who had already stepped into the divine level in the same batch. He planned to eat and wait for death at Level 9.
“Uncle Wang, go and guide him,” Lin Rui encouraged.
“That’s true…” The bearded otaku named Uncle Wang fell into a dilemma. It was mainly because he couldn’t see through Shi Yu. Who knew how many pets Shi Yu still had? He didn’t want to fight a battle he wasn’t confident in. If he could confirm that he would win 100%, he would have long gone up.
However, now that he was facing the urging of a junior, Uncle Wang was in a dilemma.
This situation was happening everywhere in the audience. Now that many people saw that no one was challenging Shi Yu, they immediately panicked. How could this be?
The genius of the Floating Planet was tortured by the genius of the Blue Planet. In the end, no one dared to fight. How ugly would it be if word got out?
If the other five god races and other factions on the Blue Planet who were on good terms with the Floating Planet heard about it, they would feel very apologetic.
However, in reality, the current Shi Yu was indeed not easy to fight. He came from a remote Blue Planet, and no one knew his background. Even if they wanted to fight, they wanted to see more before fighting, not rush out without any information.
For a moment, the arena was awkward. Even Shi Yu began to wonder why no one continued to challenge him.
At this moment, finally, a mechanical voice resounded through the entire Sky Arena, saving this awkward situation.
[Dear members of the Sky Arena:
We will maintain the battle facilities of the Sky Arena in 10 minutes. During the maintenance, the Sky Arena will be temporarily closed.
We are very sorry for the impact on the members. Please understand that because this is an emergency maintenance, the maintenance time is pending. We will inform you immediately after the maintenance is completed.]
Shi Yu: “?”
Shi Yu was still waiting for the next challenger, but he didn’t expect an arena maintenance announcement.
“Roar?” Little Ji was stunned. What was going on?
“So unlucky,” Shi Yu muttered.
This was too coincidental and unlucky. He had caught up to the maintenance the first time he came to the arena, and had yet to replicate enough.
“Unfortunately, the arena has to be maintained. Looks like this battle can’t be carried out in the short term.” Zi Lan placed the battle card in the slot and said regretfully to Wang Qingqing beside her. Wang Qingqing also had a puzzled expression. Maintained?
“Sigh, I didn’t expect to meet the maintenance time just as I arrived,” the good-for-nothing son of the Space Emperor said regretfully.
In an instant, those who were instigated by their companions and were still hesitating if they should challenge Shi Yu heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, they had regretful expressions on their faces. They were quite dissatisfied with the maintenance this time.
“Damn it, it’s only been three rounds!” The Phoenix man was also quite dissatisfied.
He hadn’t seen enough.
Seeing the person he knew being beaten up by Shi Yu, he was even happier than Shi Yu.
“Son of a b*tch…” At this moment, in the void, the Void Divine Dragon, who was secretly controlling everything, sensed the complaints in the arena and cursed.
What was he mumbling about!
Not being able to visit for two days to protect the arena was still better than all of them being ravaged by Shi Yu!
How embarrassing would it be if it spread to the five major divine races!
A group of guys who didn’t know how to be grateful.
First, they would maintain it for two days. Then, during this period of time, they would think of a way to join forces with the Space Emperor and chase Shi Yu to the Environmental Protection Association to register!!
…
“What a pity, what a pity. I actually made it in time for the maintenance today. When the arena opens, I’ll call you.”
After the arena closed, Shi Yu bid farewell to the regretful Phoenix Man and shook his head to return to his place.
Then, he concluded the gains from the three battles.
In the first round, in his battle against Lu Ran, he replicated [Sun Disaster] and [Sun Meteorite]!
It could be taught to Little Ji.
In the second round, he fought Lin Rui and replicated [Light Speed Fist], [Holy Light Divine Healing], [Light Interlocking], and [Star God Cannon]!
One was a fast attack skill, the other was a healing skill, the other was a dodging skill, and the other was an attack skill.
To be honest, they were all too normal.
They were all quasi-divine skills advanced by ordinary super skills that weren’t top-notch.
Compared to the pile of top-notch skills specially concocted by Shi Yu’s pets, it was completely incomparable.
It couldn’t even be considered a complete law of light. It could only be considered a part of the usage of the law of light, a scrap.
Moreover, in the team, only Eleven could be relatively compatible with these four skills. Baby Ginseng, Ling, and the others weren’t very good and couldn’t be taught.
Among them, Baby Ginseng could learn the Holy Light Divine Healing, but the meaning wasn’t very great. The Sun and Moon Glory Skill also had the same effect, and it was stronger…
However, Shi Yu still replicated it, planning to see if he could fuse it into [Light Control] and advance to a complete light law divine skill.
As for Light Control, it was a high-level divine skill after all. It was alright for Light and Darkness Panda Eleven. When the time came, it still needed to prepare Dark Control.

chapters.title: Chapter 1318 - 1318 Space Disaster Research Institute (3)
chapters.content:
1318 Space Disaster Research Institute (3)
As for the third round, the battle with Wang Qingqing, Shi Yu was very helpless. He only replicated one skill because the other party’s pet had only used one quasi-divine skill from the beginning to the end.
Unfortunately, Buggy had this skill. Although it wasn’t a quasi-divine skill yet and was only at the super skill stage, and it had yet to master a quasi-divine skill, it could increase sooner or later, so it replicated loneliness.
Therefore, Shi Yu didn’t find this girl as pleasing to the eye as the two men in front. He didn’t know if her pet really only had one quasi-divine skill or if the other skills weren’t suitable for battle.
However, although there was only one quasi-divine skill, the strength of the other party’s contracted beast was alright. It wasn’t weaker than the Light Dragon with four quasi-divine skills, or even stronger.
As expected of the spatial element. As long as the development level was high and the quality of the skill was high, sometimes, a skill could crack everything.
“Roar!!!”
After returning, Little Ji helplessly ate dirt in the room, feeling that it had yet to fight to its heart’s content.
With its current strength, which was enough to fight for the top three or even first place in the team, it shouldn’t end with just three battles like this.
“Roar!! (I’m invincible~ How lonely~)” Little Ji shook its head.
“Ji. (This guy is arrogant!)” Buggy and the others also pointed at Little Ji. Damn it.
They didn’t expect that there would be a day when the second team rose.
Especially Buggy. It felt that without the power of faith, it was no longer Little Ji’s match.
The pets in the first team felt a sense of danger.
If it weren’t for the support of the “weakest evolution first” theory, Buggy would have suspected that Buggy had given birth. It couldn’t believe that it would be surpassed by Little Ji one day.
After Shi Yu saw Little Ji’s battle power after adding points, he didn’t brag or mock it. He indeed felt that Little Ji could currently fight for the top three in the team.
The benefits of adding points first…
However, at the moment, Shi Yu couldn’t add any more points. After making a decision, he could only add points one by one according to the cost-effective ratio order.
After all, this was a very critical moment. The goal was the God Sealing Battle in 10 months, so the order of adding points couldn’t be messy…
“We’re done fighting. In fact, it proves that as long as you raise your top-notch super skills to the quasi-divine skill stage, you don’t need a lot of them to defeat those divine beast cubs with quality.”
Shi Yu used the mental conference room to hold a small meeting for his pets and said,
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng was delighted.
“This is also to make it easier for you to participate in the Environmental Protection Department’s assessment next and get an identity card.”
“Quack!!” Duckie cried. It had troubled the Beast Tamer. Thank you, Beast Tamer! Now, Duckie felt that Little Ji’s tail could slap it to death. When had it, the Duck Emperor, suffered such grievances!
“It’s still not safe for Duckie to refine the Eye of the Evil God itself, so it needs Susu’s support. Therefore, next, Susu, I’ll also try to fuse your Blue Sea Contract. Now that we’ve left Blue Planet, the Blue Sea Contract isn’t very useful. Let’s try to see if we can upgrade it to a stronger skill.”
“You’re also the core of the upgrade!”
“Ning!!” Susu was also nervous. Little Ji had fused with the World Annihilation Dragon’s soul crystal, and Duckie wanted to refine the eye of the Abyss Evil God. It was really worried that if it didn’t become stronger quickly, it wouldn’t even be able to defeat the second team.
“I’ve investigated. There seem to be a lot of evolution materials suitable for you in the Environmental Protection Department. When the time comes, I’ll think of a way to buy some. Then, you can use Infinite Devour to evolve and become stronger,” Shi Yu said with a smile.
Now that he was in the starry sky, it was time to fulfill the promise of the Star Sea Sprite.
“Ning!! (Yay~!)” Susu was happy.
“As for Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, Ling, you guys, wait first. One by one. Don’t worry, there are still 10 months. We still have plenty of time. We won’t leave you behind. In the end, we’ll definitely challenge the God Sealing Battle in our best state!”
“Ling, I’ll ask Senior Space Emperor later if there’s any way to use your Starry Sky Storm.”
Shi Yu said at the end.
Back then, when he had just unlocked the skill deduction, he had promised Ling to deduce a powerful skill for it first. Shi Yu didn’t go back on his word. After increasing its physique on Blue Planet, he deduced the Starry Sky Storm for it one after another, laying the foundation for him to befriend the Kirin Race and deducing the Wind of Blessing.
Among them, Shi Yu had already obtained the method for Ling to learn and develop the Starry Sky Storm.
[Exclusive Learning Method]: Firstly, modify yourself into a cosmic mechanical life form that is adapted to the starry sky. Secondly, enter the Starry Sky Storm and use the “Turning Misfortune into Luck” skill to absorb the power of the Starry Sky Storm into your body. Finally, try to add the power of the Starry Sky Storm to the “Wind Spirit Bead”. Practice repeatedly, and there’s a chance of learning the Starry Sky Storm.
This learning method was neither difficult nor simple. Ling’s turning misfortune into luck could indeed absorb dangerous Skills. Ling’s Wind Spirit Bead could indeed absorb and adapt to most energy, but learning the Starry Sky Storm through this exclusive method was still too dangerous.
After all, this was a cosmic disaster.
It was very likely that it would, unfortunately, die during the adaptation process and repeat the mistake of that unlucky Kirin Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1319 - 1319 Space Disaster Research Institute (4)
chapters.content:
1319 Space Disaster Research Institute (4)
After all, the most ordinary cosmic storm could kill divine-level cosmic disasters.
“Wu wu wu!!” “Roar!!” “Mi~!” “I understand.”
The pets naturally had no objections to Shi Yu’s arrangements. In any case, the pets had already decided that before they finished adding points, they would definitely not fight in the team, in case they were bullied by the second team.
…
Then, Shi Yu began to add points to Baby Ginseng, Duckie, and Susu.
However, less than two days later, the Space Emperor contacted Shi Yu and asked him when he planned to register the Abyss Duck.
“Senior Space Emperor, I’m worried that it can’t pass the assessment, so I’m still training its cleansing power,” Shi Yu replied with his cell phone.
“Well, it’s good that you remember. Before registering, don’t casually send it out. It’s best if you don’t even fight much. Even if you don’t send it out, some guys from the Environmental Protection Department can sense it,” the Space Emperor said.
“Actually, you don’t have to worry so much about the assessment. It’s not as difficult as you think.”
“I understand. After I’m done here, I’ll immediately register my identity,” Shi Yu said. “By the way, Senior Space Emperor, I want to ask you. Do you know any place where I can come into contact with a cosmic storm that’s not that dangerous?”
Emperor Kong: “?”
Why did the Space Emperor feel that the Starry Sky Storm and not that dangerous couldn’t be connected?
“What do you want to do?” the Space Emperor asked.
Shi Yu said, “Mechanical pets and I have analyzed and developed a set of methods to learn the Starry Sky Storm. However, we need to come into contact with the real Starry Sky Storm.”
The Space Emperor gritted his teeth and said, “Are you crazy? How can you master such a cosmic disaster just like that? Even Lin Feng and I don’t dare to fight the cosmic storm head-on, let alone hear of a cosmic life form taking things too hard to come into contact with the cosmic storm.”
Shi Yu was really not easy to deal with.
“The cosmic disasters like the Starry Sky Storm are so powerful. Isn’t there any cosmic life form who wants to master them??” Shi Yu asked.
Emperor Kong said, “The reason why disasters are called disasters is because it’s too difficult to control them. If you want to master them, I’m afraid only those super divines have the chance to do it, and the risk is also very high. I suggest you give up.”
Perhaps worried that Shi Yu would take things too hard and really go to the starry sky to find some cosmic storm, the Space Emperor right on the heels of that and said, “Your understanding of the danger of the cosmic storm is definitely not direct.”
“Let me recommend a place for you. It’s called the ‘Space Disaster Research Institute’. An old friend of mine holds an important position in that place. He mainly studies cosmic disasters, including ‘Cold Silence’, ‘Space Tide’, ‘Starry Sky Storm’, and ‘Black Hole’. It’s all involved. If you have time, you can learn it.”
“They also occasionally simulate cosmic disasters in various ways. If you really don’t give up, go here and give it a try. Although I don’t know if I can satisfy your request, I only allow you to go here. Don’t think of coming into contact with the real cosmic storm. Otherwise, don’t blame me for locking you up,” the Space Emperor said.
The Space Emperor was silent. At hundreds of years old, Shi Yu, a little brat in his twenties, was indeed a child!
Emperor Kong said, “Alright, I’ll inform that old friend in advance and write you a recommendation letter. You can go to the Environmental Protection Department to register your identity and learn for a period of time.”
“In three days, come to the temple. This is the first time you’ve left Sky City. I’ll give you some protective things, or rather, do you need me to send you a guide and bodyguard?”
Shi Yu said, “No need, no need. There’s no need to trouble others. Just give me a few spatial Teleportation Talismans that can escape the super divine level.”
Emperor Kong: “?”
Could it escape the spatial Teleportation Talisman of a super divine level? What was it trying to do?

chapters.title: Chapter 1320 - 1320 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (1)
chapters.content:
1320 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (1)
Even if he did, he might not necessarily be willing to give it to Shi Yu.
After all, this kind of thing was quite a rare treasure, even for divine and super-divine levels, let alone demigods.
Therefore, three days later, Shi Yu only obtained six divine-level spatial stones from the Space Emperor.
Three of them were used for defense and could resist divine-level attacks.
The remaining three were used for teleportation. They could escape the divine-level pursuit. They were all equipment carefully created by the Space Emperor’s pet.
…
After obtaining life-saving equipment from the Space Emperor and the keepsake needed to go to the Environmental Protection Association and the disaster research institute, Shi Yu obediently returned to his residence.
After obtaining the item, he wasn’t in a hurry to leave. He didn’t think he was completely prepared.
Therefore, he continued to add points. First, he added points to Baby Ginseng according to the plan.
About two days later.
Baby Ginseng had become like this.
[Baby Ginseng]
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Time Mark (transcendent), World Tree Fruit (transcendent), Soul Fruit (transcendent), Reincarnation Fruit (transcendent)
“Quasi God-level”: World Grace (expert+11), Sun and Moon Splendor (proficient), Wood Control (proficient), Life Divine Body (proficient)
Compared to the previous Baby Ginseng, its Time Fruit had advanced to the Reincarnation Fruit with the potential to advance to a divine skill under its optimization.
< Name > Reincarnation Fruit
< Attributes >: Wood, Time
< Introduction > Creatures that can create the Reincarnation Fruit and eat the Reincarnation Fruit can obtain one of the following abilities by consuming the power of time reincarnation.
2. Awakening the ability of the previous life.
Baby Ginseng didn’t spend much effort to optimize the Time Fruit to the Reincarnation Fruit. After all, the research work of the Reincarnation Fruit had long started on the Blue Planet with Shi Yu and the others.
Now, it was completely perfect.
Without a doubt, this was a very powerful skill.
There was no need to talk about the effect of the Time Fruit. The awakening of the abilities of its previous life had already been very well verified on the gem cat, Duckie, and the others.
However, this awakening also had restrictions. It had to reference the strength of the Baby Ginseng and the eater. Previously, with the current Baby Ginseng, it was still alright to help the reincarnation of a totem in his previous life recover its strength.
However, if Baby Ginseng helped the super divine and cosmic-level reincarnations of his previous life recover the abilities of their previous lives, it would be a daydream. It would probably have to upgrade the Reincarnation Fruit to a real divine skill and raise it to a perfect level to do it.
As for the ability to obtain a reincarnation opportunity, it could only allow the reincarnated to level up again from the awakening-level cub and lose all abilities and memories. It could be used together with the ability to awaken the abilities of their previous life. This also greatly guaranteed that Shi Yu and the others wouldn’t be restricted by their lifespans.
At first glance, the Reincarnation Fruit had a support ability, but in fact, as long as it still had the nature of the previous Time Fruit, it was still a powerful explosive skill.
Shi Yu estimated that after upgrading the Reincarnation Fruit to a quasi-divine skill, it wouldn’t be a problem for Baby Ginseng to erupt with the battle power of a junior god for a period of time. Then, with skills like Sun and Moon Glory, it wouldn’t be a dream to kill a junior god.
Second.
After Baby Ginseng’s super skill Plant Control was added to the maximum level, it was optimized by Baby Ginseng’s race into a quasi-divine skill [Wood Control].
In terms of the use of wood-element laws, Baby Ginseng was already close to the peak below the Divine Realm.
The effects of the various supplements and foods it created had already greatly improved.
After that, it was the Green Wood Divine Body. After being upgraded to the maximum level, it was optimized by Baby Ginseng to a quasi-divine-level [Life Divine Body]. The Life Divine Body contained the laws of life. Not only was it a source of life and a divine-level life supplement, but it could also rely on nutrients such as soil, light, and water to have tenacious vitality similar to an immortal elemental life form.
At this moment, Baby Ginseng’s strengthening work had completely come to an end.
Upon receiving permission from the world’s will, the opportunity arose to manipulate the natural laws of the planet, graced by the blessings of the world containing the laws of the sun and moon, wielding control over the rules of wood, and embodying the essence of the rules of life—the divine law of life!
If Little Ji, who had been strengthened previously, really had a chance to compete with Eleven, Buggy, and Baby Ginseng for first place in the team, then with Baby Ginseng adding points, the current strongest battle power throne in the team would definitely be it.
However, battle power was secondary. The current supplement ability of Baby Ginseng was what excited Shi Yu the most.
The efficiency of adding points increased greatly. After entering the near-death weak state, the speed and comfort of reviving at full health increased greatly!
Therefore.
With this motivation, Shi Yu started the strongest evolution for Susu again.
“Ning…” Under the gaze of Baby Ginseng and Shi Yu, Susu was nervous.
[Skill]: Blue Sea Contract, Star Sea Body
[Fusion success rate]: Extremely low
[Fusion Risk]: Very high
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng patted its chest, indicating that there was no problem.
If it couldn’t hold on, at most, it would immediately stop the fusion. With it around, how could Shi Yu die?
It was fine if it died. It was nothing.
At most, it would become undead and reincarnate. With it, Buggy, and Chi Tong, a bunch of pets who had mastered the ability to revive, it would be difficult for Shi Yu to die, even if he wanted to!

chapters.title: Chapter 1321 - 1321 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (2)
chapters.content:
1321 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (2)
As for Susu itself, with its quasi-divine-level cleansing skill, it shouldn’t be that difficult to withstand the affliction.
It wasn’t like he had never tried a fusion with an extremely low success rate. The only thing he should care about now was the effect of the fused skill.
“Leave it to me!” This depended on Ling’s luck and how much it could give Susu.
Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the other pets also came out to cheer as Shi Yu finally wanted to help Susu evolve into a Star Sea Sprite.
Optimizing skills was actually also a form of evolution. However, its form might not necessarily change.
As for what would become, it still depended on fate. Even Ling found it difficult to analyze and calculate the most complicated thing, evolution.
“Ning.” Finally, Susu jumped onto Shi Yu’s hand and applied a water ring-shaped Sea Cleansing Spirit to Shi Yu’s head.
Then, it also entered the state of the Sea Cleansing Spirit.
“Charge.” After Shi Yu shouted resolutely, he began to add points.
After all, the last time, the extremely low success rate was to help Chi Tong evolve and awaken a quasi-divine skill. At that time, he had just finished eating the Eternal Flower and obtained ten thousand years of lifespan.
In an experiment, even with the support of various parties, it directly consumed 90% of its life force and almost died.
This time, Shi Yu’s physique increased by two levels in a row compared to back then. However, the success rate was still extremely low. Fortunately, the support abilities of his pets had also been strengthened, so Shi Yu felt that he should be able to give it a try.
Buzz!!
Shi Yu and Susu entered the skill fusion state together. In an instant, various powers flowed out of Shi Yu’s body, and Susu’s will began to undergo a crazy impact.
However, they were too familiar with this state. Compared to caring about this, Shi Yu and Susu were more concerned about the changes in Susu when the skills fused!!
“Ning!!!” With a painful cry, the light blue Water Slime Susu’s entire body was covered in light of various colors, such as blue, white, purple, black, and yellow. Light spots flickered on its body.
Its body kept reflecting various beautiful colors, as deep and charming as the starry sky.
This made Eleven and the others nervous and curious. Now, Susu seemed to want to evolve from the Water Slime to the Starry Sky Slime!
At this moment, Shi Yu and the others didn’t notice that there was an abnormality in the Cosmic Sea because of their skill fusion.
World King Planet’s main city, World King City.
On the World King Planet, according to the environmental difference, districts could roughly be divided into three levels. Third-level realms, second-level realms, and first-level realms. Among them, the environment of the third-level realms was the worst, and the environment of the first-level realms was the best.
Among them, the realm where Sky City was located was the second-level realm, and World King City was the largest realm among the 196 first-level realms on World King Planet.
The Environmental Protection Association that Shi Yu wanted to go to had branches in various first-level realms, and its headquarters were in this World King City.
The Environmental Protection Association was one of the official institutions of the World King Planet. It mainly protected the environment of the World King Planet and the Cosmic Sea. At the same time, it was also the main force of the World King faction against the Dark King faction.
In this department, the core members were all divine-level life forms who had mastered the power of divine-level cleansing. There were even super divine life forms who were familiar with the power of cleansing presiding.
In the Environmental Protection Association, there was also a special department at all times to supervise the changes in the universe, for one thing.
This hadn’t happened for a long time, but the Environmental Protection Association was still paying attention day after day.
Until today.
The Cosmic Sea was abnormal. The Environmental Protection Association and the World King Star Elephant Research Institute received a mysterious set of data.
After difficult deciphering, some researchers came to a conclusion.
“A new cleansing star spirit has been born, and it’s around World King Planet!” said the white-haired old man excitedly.
“It’s not easy. This is the first time in nearly 100,000 years, right?”
“That’s right, we’re really lucky! We have to find a way to find it!”
“Cultivate it hard. As long as it can grow to the peak of the divine level, it’s enough to be called a super divine battle power for the Dark King Army.”
Everyone in the Environmental Protection Department was shocked by this matter, and even the super divine life forms presiding over it were alarmed.
A super divine life form personally gave the order to find the new cleansing star spirit.
The so-called cleansing star spirit was a type of Starry Sky Sprite born from the faith of the planet.
After the Dark King grew into a cosmic emperor, formed the Dark King Army, and began to expand in the universe, many planets became abysses and lands of fall, completely corroded.
In such a context, a race called cleansing star spirits was born. They mastered powerful cleansing powers, could communicate with the power of the starry sky to the greatest extent, and could heavily injure the dark matter life forms that polluted the stars.
The first president of the Environmental Protection Association was to cleanse the Star Spirit Race. He was even ranked 77th among the races in the starry sky and squeezed into the top 100. He was very powerful.
Unfortunately, although there were many members of this race, there weren’t many. Most importantly, apart from being born naturally, there was no way to reproduce.
Moreover, their stats and forms were too random, and they weren’t that easy to find.
It could be said that cleansing star spirits were fresh blood that the Environmental Protection Association loved to nurture and rope in. They were known as having the strongest cleansing abilities.
As long as he nurtured this race with all his might, even if he couldn’t advance to the super divine level, as long as he was at the peak of the divine level, he could be seen as a super divine life form when dealing with the Dark King Army.

chapters.title: Chapter 1322 - 1322 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (3)
chapters.content:
1322 Strange Star Sea Sprite Appears (3)
The cleansing of the Star Spirit Race had left too many legends in the Environmental Protection Association. At the moment, the strongest expert of the Environmental Protection Association was still the cleansing star spirit.
Sky City.
Shi Yu’s skill fusion with Susu was already coming to an end.
At this moment, Susu had already completely turned into a Starry Sky Slime. Its round body was like a vast starry sky, flickering with beautiful starlight. It was very beautiful.
As for Shi Yu, who was holding it, he was only skin and bones. Even his white hair had fallen off, leaving only three hairs.
Behind it, Baby Ginseng was also covered in sweat. Finally, after a long, difficult moment, they heaved a sigh of relief together.
Shi Yu’s withered face lit up.
“F*ck…”
After cursing, Shi Yu couldn’t help but be overjoyed.
[Fusion successful]
[Skill Name]: Star Sea Contract
[Stats]: Water, Space, Spirit
[Level]: Quasi Divine-level faith skill
< Introduction > Contract with the Star Sea. Its responsibility is to protect the starry sky environment. It can infinitely mobilize the energy of the starry sky and increase its own cleansing skills. When it loses faith, the contract will automatically be broken.
Star Sea Contract!
It really… really came!!
The Blue Sea Contract’s advancement version is the Star Sea Contract!!
Infinite energy!
With this skill, even after leaving Blue Planet, Susu could still have unlimited energy.
Moreover, Shi Yu could sense that Susu in front of him had indeed become a cosmic life form!!
If it weren’t a cosmic life form, if it went to the starry sky, its body would be corroded by the mysterious substance contained in the universe. Its state would increase its consumption and it would become more and more weak. It would be like a fish out of water and couldn’t survive for a long time.
The fact that Susu could become a cosmic life form also made Shi Yu closer and closer to the title of cosmic Beast Tamer.
“Ning!! Ning!!” At this moment, Shi Yu and Susu were quite happy. However, Susu looked at Shi Yu and hurriedly urged Baby Ginseng to treat Shi Yu.
“Yiya!! (It’s replenishing, it’s replenishing.)” Baby Ginseng wiped the bean-sized sweat and kept connecting to Shi Yu’s life force like it was imparting strength, losing its life force to Shi Yu.
“From today onwards, Susu, your race will be called the Star Sea Sprite!!” Shi Yu chuckled.
“No, wait, this skill seems to have a greater restriction than the Blue Sea Contract…”
“Although it can infinitely mobilize the energy of the starry sky, it can no longer be used by any skill. It can only increase one’s cleansing skill??”
“Ning!!” Susu expressed that it was already very good.
“Moreover, when you lose faith, the contract will automatically be broken… In that case, we have to participate in the war of a few universe-level big shots in the future…”
“No, no, it’s still too much of a loss to only increase your own cleansing skill. Although your Sea Cleansing Spirit is powerful, its power isn’t very high. Let’s see if we can fuse the Sea Cleansing Spirit too and become an even more powerful divine skill!”
“Ning! (Alright.)” Susu’s starry sky jelly-like body was poked by Shi Yu. It was very happy. Melt, it could even melt!!
“Yiya!!” As Shi Yu and Susu were secretly discussing, Baby Ginseng was angry at the side. It hadn’t healed it yet. Could it wait until it was healed before thinking of the next step?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1323 - 1323 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (1)
chapters.content:
1323 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (1)
At night, the river of stars was dazzling.
In the room, on the sofa, a limp body was holding a ginseng-type creature while watching the battle video on the screen.
“Ha~” Shi Yu yawned. He was tired and sleepy.
At this moment, Shi Yu was weak and fragile. His face was pale, and he looked like he was about to die. However, magically, his vitality increased visibly.
“Yi…” Baby Ginseng, who was being held by Shi Yu, held a transparent crystal in its hand and sucked it.
After Shi Yu assisted Susu in evolving into a Star Sea Sprite, Baby Ginseng kept using quasi-divine skills to heal Shi Yu for a day.
It had consumed a total of three divine-level stat-free energy crystals and was about to heal Shi Yu.
The consumption was a little high, but for Shi Yu, resources should be used. It was just 200 divine-level energy crystals.
Although Blue Planet and the Space Emperor estimated that these resources were enough for Shi Yu to use for decades at the divine level…
However, as long as he could save cultivation time and quickly become stronger, Shi Yu didn’t mind using it up in a few months.
After becoming stronger, wouldn’t there be as many resources as there were? If he really took first place in the God Sealing Battle and successfully challenged the divine level, it was worth it to consume more resources.
Only by daring to spend resources could he have greater gains!
“I’m not watching anymore. It’s boring.” Shi Yu switched off the television with a bored expression.
Seeing a pile of rare skills but having nowhere to replicate them was like looking at something that couldn’t be done.
Yes, it was like watching a food video on an empty stomach but not being able to eat.
It couldn’t quench his thirst at all.
As Shi Yu was being nursed, he paid attention to the Beast Taming Space.
After arriving on the World King Planet, the pets began to work hard again. Because they couldn’t cause a big commotion in the Beast Taming Space, the special training methods were strange (studying how to target teammates). No one wanted their battle power to be at the bottom.
It turned out that it was alright. It was just that they were fighting in the team, but this time, they were going to turn the cosmic God Sealing Battle into an internal team competition. If it was embarrassing, it would be thrown into the universe.
If this was ranked at the bottom, it could be said to be a lifetime humiliation.
For example, if he thought of how to counter Baby Ginseng’s time mark, he would indirectly gain the experience to resist the time mark of the Time Crow Zavay.
“Yi!” Baby Ginseng wiped its sweat and looked at Shi Yu, who was still unsatisfied. It was on the brink of tears. It looked like it would have to work overtime again.
However, when it thought about how the team’s energy crystals had been used by it, it was equivalent to covering the entire team’s high-level resources to farm skill proficiency, Baby Ginseng accepted it.
It was an additional channel to increase the proficiency of the skill compared to Eleven and the others. It wasn’t a loss!
“Ning!” A moment later, with Susu as the lead, a group of pets ran out.
He couldn’t miss adding points and fusing skills. As the saying went, knowing oneself and the enemy was the way to win a hundred battles. If he didn’t even know what skills his teammates had fused, he would lose at the starting line.
Of course, when a pet came to fuse the skills, the other pets still obediently assisted and wouldn’t fuss about this kind of thing.
“Next, let’s try the development and fusion of the Sea Cleansing Spirit and the Origin Wave.”
Shi Yu said nervously, “In theory, there’s a success rate.”
The other pets fell into deep thought. The Sea Cleansing Spirit and the Origin Wave were both super top-notch skills. What else could they fuse?
“Ning! (Who cares? The bold will die from overeating, and the timid will starve to death. Just bet!)” Stars flickered in Susu’s eyes. It had already completely taken on the shape of a gambler, commonly known as an addiction.
“Then let’s do it.” Shi Yu also grinned.
Although the Star Sea Contract was powerful, if it wanted to be more powerful, it still had to cooperate with top-notch cleansing skills.
It was a little wasteful to only use it with the normal water-element cleansing power in the control of the water element.
Even with the signature skill of the Blue Sea Sprite, the Sea Cleansing Spirit, it was only powerful in cleansing. It had some shortcomings in other aspects.
Therefore, Shi Yu tried to see if he could fuse the Sea Cleansing Spirit with Susu’s attack skill, Origin Wave.
Of course, it was still extremely high risk, but it didn’t matter.
This risk referred to whether Shi Yu could withstand the consumption of the fusion alone. It was naturally dangerous for him alone, but with the support of a bunch of pets, the truth had already proven that the success rate was definitely above 50%. It was just that the process would be a little more tragic. It was completely acceptable.
“Ning…!!!” Next, in Buggy’s domain, Chi Tong possessed them, and Ling increased its strength. The pets displayed their abilities. Shi Yu and Susu were crying for food and in so much pain that they wanted to die. They were very much like a bunch of doctors and nurses delivering a patient.
“Wu wu wu!! (All the best!! All the best!! Hold on, work harder, the fusion is about to succeed!!)” Eleven encouraged their morale and increased Shi Yu and Susu’s resistance.
Just like before, after experiencing many difficulties, Shi Yu and Susu, who were covered in sweat, gradually calmed down.
“Ning…” Susu’s weak face collapsed.
“Let me learn the skill…” Shi Yu was in a twilight state, but he didn’t forget to look at the skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 1324 - 1324 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (2)
chapters.content:
1324 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (2)
With a look, Shi Yu’s eyes widened.
< Name > Origin Wave
[Stats]: Water
[Level]: Quasi-divine level
< Introduction > It contains the zero law.
Effect: It can cleanse and eliminate impurities that the user thinks are unnecessary or harmful.
When developed to the extreme, it could completely eliminate the traces of a life form’s existence, including the traces of its existence in the memories of other life forms!
Shi Yu and Susu were originally immersed in their weaknesses, but after sensing the new skill, they widened their eyes almost at the same time.
“What the hell?” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
“Ning, Ning!” Susu was also stunned.
“What, what?” At this moment, seeing Shi Yu and Susu’s expressions, Ling couldn’t help but ask.
“Another top-notch law!!” Shi Yu said in shock, almost dying.
He immediately shared the information about the origin fluctuations with the pets present.
In the next moment, not only Shi Yu, but the entire team was stunned.
Zero law!
It can cleanse and eliminate impurities that the user thinks are unnecessary or harmful.
This concept was a little ridiculous.
Susu thought that Eleven’s metal nature was a harmful impurity, but it could be cleansed!
Susu thought that Baby Ginseng’s time mark was a harmful impurity, but it could be cleansed!
Susu believed that the traces of the existence of a certain enemy were the impurities of this world and could also be eliminated!
Moreover, when developed to the extreme, it was still ridiculous. It was a powerful skill that could affect unrelated people!
Shi Yu hurriedly compared the difficulty of adding points to the origin wave and realized that, without a doubt, it was another top-notch law divine skill.
This was already strong enough. If it was combined with the Star Sea Contract which could strengthen the power of cleansing, wouldn’t it be invincible?
“Ning, Ning, Ning, Ning, Ning!!” Susu also slapped the table excitedly like jelly and was overjoyed. It gradually realized that the starry sky of the universe would be the stage for the Demon King Susu!
What cosmic emperor, the Dark King? Die!
But in the next second, extreme joy turned into sorrow.
Under the stunned expressions of many pets, Shi Yu directly fainted. Baby Ginseng was so scared that it immediately increased its strength and even entered the Time Fruit state!!
“Susu, hurry up and use the origin wave,” Ling said. “In theory, if you treat Master’s negative state as an impurity, you can also cleanse it!”
“Ning!!” After being stunned, Susu expressed its understanding.
It directly activated the Star Sea Contract and origin wave at the same time and aimed at Shi Yu. In the next moment, blue ripples appeared on Shi Yu’s body. With a hum, Shi Yu only used a few seconds to recover to his peak state under the blue wave and slowly opened his eyes.
It was lively and full of vitality.
It was even more spirited than before, adding some points to Susu.
Shi Yu suddenly got up and said, “What happened?”
This scene stunned Shi Yu’s Baby Ginseng on the spot.
“Yi!!! (Impossible!!!)” The towering emperor was shocked.
Every pet was shocked.
Through the origin fluctuations, Susu directly reduced Shi Yu’s consumption to its previous state before adding points.
How was this a cleansing skill? It had clearly cultivated Time Reversal into a divine skill!
It was complete in an instant. The nourishing effect was much stronger than that of Baby Ginseng.
As for Susu, who had the energy of the Infinite Star Sea to strengthen the origin fluctuations, it consumed almost zero!!
This made Baby Ginseng look at Susu like it had been struck by lightning.
Susu also looked at Baby Ginseng in a daze.
Although Susu didn’t say anything, Baby Ginseng kept feeling that it had been mocked.
“This…” After Shi Yu reacted, he sensed his body’s state in disbelief.
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng even felt that… it was going to be fired.
“I see, considering fatigue, aging, weakness, and other negative states as impurities purification is indeed more powerful than the previous Sea Cleansing Spirit. Previously, it only purified negative emotions, indirectly boosting resistance to resist them, but now, it’s eradication.”
“Wait a minute.” Shi Yu stretched out his hands and muttered to himself, “This way, with the energy of the Infinite Star Sea, won’t we be able to cheat and let the entire team graduate overnight…”
After hearing Shi Yu’s words, before the entire team could be pleasantly surprised, Susu started to exhort solemnly!!
“Ning… (I don’t think… you can.)”
“Oh?” Shi Yu and the others looked at Susu.
Ling said, “It’s because of the intention to use it, right?”
“The Star Sea Contract’s responsibility is to protect the cosmic environment. Only then can it infinitely mobilize the energy of the starry sky and increase its own cleansing skill.”
“Just now, Susu used the Star Sea Contract to strengthen the origin fluctuations to help Master cleanse and eliminate all negative states. There’s a high chance that it’s outside the ‘contract’.”
“Ning!” Susu nodded. Just as it finished cleansing, it sensed that its compatibility with the Star Sea contract had decreased a little.
Although it didn’t affect it now, if it went on for a long time, there would definitely be a problem.
As the saying went, when one lost their faith, the contract would automatically be broken. Although the Star Sea Contract was stronger, the restrictions seemed to be greater.
“So scammy,” Shi Yu couldn’t help but say.
Ling said, “Looks like the restraints of the starry sky faith on the user are greater than the restraints of the Blue Planet’s ocean faith on the user.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1325 - 1325 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (3)
chapters.content:
1325 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (3)
“In that case, doesn’t that mean that Susu will be affected in the future when enemies like the Abyss, the Yun Race, and so on use the power of the Star Sea Contract?” Shi Yu said.
Ling said, “There’s a high chance that’s the case, but there shouldn’t be a need to worry too much. As long as Susu works hard to protect the cosmic environment in the future, its authority to mobilize the power of the sea of stars should gradually increase.”
“Now that it has just signed a contract with Star Sea, it’s definitely only equivalent to a newbie. It seems normal to have some restrictions.”
“Ning!!” Susu nodded and agreed with Ling. As long as it worked hard to protect the Guardian cosmic environment, the power of the Star Sea Contract’s feedback would definitely increase.
“Wu…”
“This is also good…” Shi Yu said, “It’s alright. Since I’ve obtained strength, it’s only right to fulfill my obligations.”
“I wonder if adding some points to the Star Sea Contract to increase the level of the contract can slow down this backlash.”
“Susu, unless necessary, don’t use the Star Sea Contract first. The effect of the Star Sea Contract on the origin fluctuations is indeed a little ridiculous.”
“But I think even if you don’t use the Star Sea Contract to strengthen it, the effect shouldn’t be bad if you use the origin fluctuations alone.”
“A single source wave, together with Baby Ginseng to eliminate and nourish my weak state, should be able to increase the efficiency of adding points.”
“Ning Ning!!” Susu’s eyes lit up, indicating that there was no problem.
“Yiya!!” Baby Ginseng was stunned. It looked like it had been laid off, but not completely.
Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others also looked at each other.
First, he was happy that Susu had become stronger, and that the next points could be more efficient and happy. Then, he fell into deep thought.
Even Eleven and Buggy began to feel afraid. Susu’s combination skill was too ridiculous!!
They really didn’t want to face the origin fluctuations…
They didn’t want to face it even more than Baby Ginseng’s self-destruction revival.
Chi Tong looked at its good sister eagerly. Why did it feel that even with its rich accompanying moves, there was still a huge risk of being beaten up by Susu?
Hopefully… Buggy’s theory was right.
The later it was strengthened, the stronger it was!
…
After Shi Yu added points, the current Susu was like Little Ji, reborn.
[Susu]
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Water/Quasi Elemental Control (transcendent), Inheritance Water Droplet (transcendent), Heavenly Frost Cold Energy (transcendent)
“Quasi Divine-level”: Faith skill, Star Sea Contract (Proficient), Origin Wave (Proficient)
[Taught Skill]
[Super]: Infinite Devour (transcendent)
Among them, two quasi-divine skills were fused again by the original quasi-divine skill, the Sea Cleansing Spirit, and the top-notch super skill, Origin Wave, that had been fused many times.
The inheritance water drop was developed by Susu through the combination of the memory water drop and the World Tree Fruit. The Reincarnation Fruit was developed by itself and repaired the shortcomings of some memory water drops. For example, if it inputted memories, it would also lose its memory.
The effect of this inheritance water drop was undoubtedly stronger. If it was developed into a divine skill and could become the carrier of laws, Shi Yu could earn money through this and the World Tree Fruit as a divine skill teacher.
As for the Heavenly Frost Cold Energy, it was originally taught as a skill. It was also optimized into Race Skills with the support of the World Tree Fruit after Susu reached the totem level and had the ability to optimize its race.
Unfortunately, Susu had yet to successfully optimize the most cost-effective skill, Infinite Devour. Shi Yu judged that this Infinite Devour should be an inheritance skill left behind by the Space Worm Race on the Blue Planet.
It was because of this abnormal skill that the Space Worm Race could dominate the starry sky.
From the looks of it, the Tyrannical Sea Legend was the Son of Heaven’s Will. When the mythical stage revived and Blue Planet had sufficient resources, he might be the strongest batch of legendary and even Mythical Beast Tamers in Dong Huang.
“Next, it’s time to strengthen Duckie,” Shi Yu said. “I can also let Duckie try to see if it can completely control the Eye of the Evil God.”
After strengthening Susu, Shi Yu now felt that it was no problem to strengthen Duckie to its heart’s content. Even if he fused the super divine level resource, the Eye of the Evil God, with Duckie, it definitely couldn’t go berserk under the pressure of Big Sister Susu.
“Quack!!!” Upon hearing that, Duckie cried. This day had finally come.
30 years changed many things. It had been dodging the sharpness of the opportunity these days and living quietly. Whether it could rise against the tide and step on the ground next depended on this time.
In Little Zi’s body, the world of stars.
Shi Yu and the others carefully took out the Superdivine resource, the Eye of the Evil God, obtained from killing the Blue Planet’s Abyss Sea.
The abyss demigod with the Eye of the Evil God would be stronger. Moreover, he could control all pollution sources and expand his faction faster.
Apart from that, the Eye of the Evil God had many magical uses. For example, transforming normal creatures into the Abyss Race, or devouring other lives to transform life force into a pollution source. The pollution source was also the core power of the Abyss Race.
Generations of abyss demigods had mastered the Eye of the Evil God. No, or rather, the Eye of the Evil God had created generations of abyss demigods.
Even the Blue Sea Sprite at its peak couldn’t cleanse this tool, but this time, Susu, who had evolved into a Star Sea Sprite, suppressed the Eye of the Evil God with a Star Sea Contract origin wave.
“Not bad.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1326 - 1326 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (4)
chapters.content:
1326 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (4)
“Ning!!” The Starry Sky Slime Susu floated in the air and continued to emit origin fluctuations to cleanse the Eye of the Evil God. At this moment, just as Ling had speculated, not only did the Star Sea Contract not have any backlash, but its strength was also continuing to increase, assisting Susu in cleansing the Eye of the Evil God.
It was at the demigod level. At this moment, even the inheritance power left behind by a super divine level could be easily cleansed.
Shi Yu was certain that there were very few people in the World King Planet’s Environmental Protection Association who could do this. It was very difficult to find a second one.
Of course, Susu’s current goal was not to directly destroy the Eye of the Evil God. What it needed to do was cleanse the Eye of the Evil God into an ownerless item, a pure strengthening resource, and give it to Duckie.
This way, firstly, it could use waste, and secondly, Duckie could control the Eye of the Evil God to the greatest extent and not be affected by the Eye of the Evil God.
“Quack!! (Big Sister Susu, all the best!!)” At this moment, looking at the Eye of the Evil God pressed to the ground by Susu’s origin fluctuations, Duckie swallowed its saliva. The thought of counterattacking the first team in its mind slowly dissipated. As expected, the idea of completely crushing Little Ji was more reliable and realistic.
“Susu, how long do you estimate?” Shi Yu asked.
“Ning. (More than a day.)” Susu said.
Shi Yu said, “Alright, I’ll add some other skills to Duckie first. We’ll wait for you.”
“Quack!!” Duckie nodded heavily.
A day later.
Susu finally finished cleansing the Eye of the Evil God. The most ridiculous thing was that after continuously using two quasi-divine skills to cleanse for a day, it didn’t consume any energy at all. Apart from its spirit being a little tired, its condition was almost full.
This made Shi Yu, Ling, and the others deeply realize how terrifying the current Star Sea Sprite race was when dealing with the abyss bloodline.
This was simply heaven’s jinx.
After purification, the Eye of the Evil God turned from an unholy, dark, big eye to something like a contact lens. It was very small and completely black. The patterns at the core of the pupil were like the pattern of a V-shaped red bird.
“Ning, Ning!” Under Susu’s gaze, Duckie trembled and picked up the Eye of the Evil God. It looked around and realized that Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and all the other seniors had come here to see it fuse.
Little Ji was also here.
“Quack… (Thank you for your concern, everyone. Come and see me. I’ll do my best.)” Duckie was nervous.
Little Ji said, “Roar!!! (Don’t think too much. Everyone is here just to ensure that I can kill you immediately after you go berserk.)”
Duckie: “?”
“Don’t listen to Little Ji’s nonsense. I won’t beat you to death, but a beating is definitely inevitable,” Shi Yu said with a kind smile.
“All the best.”
“Quack!!!!” Duckie covered its eyes and cried out in pain.
Although it had only been stuffed into one eye, the same pattern appeared even in its right eye. Duckie covered its eye with both hands and resisted with difficulty.
At the same time, a large amount of abyssal power erupted from its body. In an instant, it polluted the entire island, turning it into an abyss island.
Fortunately, with Susu around, it could instantly cleanse this little pollution wave.
At this moment, it was even more difficult for Duckie than for the previous abyss demigods. This was because it wanted to completely control the Eye of the Evil God, so the pressure was even greater.
“Baby Ginseng, World Tree Fruit.” “Yi.”
“Susu, cleanse.” “Ning!”
“Duckie, hold on a little longer. I’ll support you.”
Shi Yu and Duckie directly entered a mental resonance state to assist Duckie.
“Quack!!! (I am the overlord of the ocean!!! Don’t even think about interfering with me with the power of the abyss!!)”
Duckie roared at the sky. It had yet to forget the agreement between the two parties when Shi Yu first subdued it.
Defeat the abyss together!
The power of the abyss could only be its weapon, but it couldn’t interfere with it. This was the determination Duckie had made in its heart when it accepted the abyss inheritance in its previous life.
Boom!!!
An incomparably terrifying abyssal deterrence erupted from Duckie’s body like an Asura Demon God, continuing to push back everyone except Susu. This terrifying aura shocked Eleven, Buggy, and the others, and even Little Ji.
It felt that the deterrence of the current duck was even more terrifying than its destructive dragon’s might. It could affect the mind more.
“Roar…” Little Ji growled. That made sense. The World Destruction Demon Dragon was only a clone of the top-notch Divine Ancestral Dragon, but the Abyss Evil God was one of the three super divine existences that had disturbed Blue Planet…
Little Ji trembled. Son of a b*tch, no way. It felt the aura of Duckie gradually strengthening its enhancement. It felt more pain. Could it be that it would be suppressed by Duckie again after being arrogant for a few days?
“Roar!!” A moment later, Little Ji looked at Duckie, who had fused the affliction with the Evil God’s beautiful eyes, and abandoned all thoughts. It cheered for Duckie first.
“Roar!! (Damn duck, all the best. As long as the fusion is successful and you control it, you can surpass me. Do you want to fail?)”
Little Ji’s encouragement felt even more effective than Shi Yu’s Psychic Resonance support. After Duckie vaguely heard it, its resistance suddenly increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 1327 - 1327 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (5)
chapters.content:
1327 Susu Duck’s Epic Enhancement (5)
“Quack!!”
After an unknown period of time, the abyssal power released by the duck finally disappeared.
At the same time, Duckie looked up.
Shi Yu, Susu, Ling, Little Ji, and the others heaved a sigh of relief at the same time, but they didn’t completely relax.
“Quack. (I’m blind, but I’ve become stronger.)” Duck closed its eyes, stuffed its hands in its pockets, and looked up at the starry sky.
It stretched out its hand and condensed a golden cloth with the power of Demon Vanquishing to tie it to its eyes.
Eleven, Buggy, Baby Ginseng, and the other pets were shocked. Blind?
“Wu wu wu?? (Baby Ginseng, can you treat it?)”
Baby Ginseng: “Yiya! (I want to know.)”
“Stop fooling around,” Shi Yu said. “It’s fine. It’s just that the Eye of the Evil God has formed a new ability with the liberation of the abyss and the development of deterrence.”
“Quack!” Duckie gave the entire team a thumbs up and chuckled.
< Name > Eye of the Evil God
[Stats]: Dark, Water, Spirit, Space
[Level]: Quasi Divine-level faith skill
< Introduction > After opening its eyes, it can directly grab the dark negative energy drifting in the universe and strengthen its abyssal power.
The so-called negative energy came from all the negative emotional energy such as envy, framing, comparison, greed, and laziness in life forms. It was considered a different faith skill. It could directly allow Duckie’s strength to erupt by a level, but it was also extremely dangerous.
However, the strength of this Evil God’s Eye was that it would never lose its source of power. Even if all life in the universe was extinct, the negative energy couldn’t disappear.
Even if the universe was destroyed and a new cosmic era was changed, negative energy would still be everywhere in the universe.
Obviously, this was an ability similar to the Blue Sea and Star Sea Contract!
“Are you sure you can control this power well?” Shi Yu asked.
“Quack! (If I can’t control it, I’ll let Big Sister Susu destroy me.)” Duckie covered its eyes and said very confidently.
“Ning!! (I won’t go easy on you!)”
“Roar!! (Me too.)” Little Ji.
“Alright, I hope you won’t be affected by these skills and can maintain yourself at all times,” Shi Yu said.
“Quack!! (No problem, as long as you help me increase the purification skill!!)” Duckie was blind, but its heart wasn’t. It rubbed its hands and still said with desire.
“Roar!! (More?)” Little Ji was angry.
At this moment, Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others believed in the theory that the later they added points, the stronger they would be. Hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, it’s their turn!
…
At the moment, although using the Star Sea Contract would reduce the contract speed, fortunately, the origin fluctuations could still be used alone. Under the joint efforts of Susu and Baby Ginseng, the speed at which Shi Yu added points to Duckie quickly increased.
In just a day, Duckie had become like this.
< Name > Duck
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Death Vortex (transcendent), Dark Sky Wave Rain (transcendent), Water Element Control (perfect)
“Quasi Divine-level”: Heart of the Abyss (expert+11), Vajra Demon Subduing Staff (Proficient), Eye of the Evil God (Initiate), Wave Vision, Heart Eye (Proficient)
Just like Little Ji, they both had four quasi-divine skills.
Among them, the Heart of the Abyss was the standard skill of the demigods of the Blue Planet’s Abyss Sea.
It was an explosive skill that corroded oneself to obtain powerful battle power.
The Eye of the Evil God was similar. It was a powerful, explosive skill.
With the two skills stacked together, Shi Yu estimated that Duckie could immediately fly into the sky. Its battle power would explode, and it would become the coolest person in the Abyss Race.
The Abyss Race probably didn’t believe that it wasn’t an Abyss Race.
The Vajra Demon Subduing Staff was a skill after the duck evolved into a Demon Subduing Duck’s racial skill, the Demon Subduing Pestle, which was strengthened to the quasi-divine skill stage.
It was a very powerful skill for purging evil forces, serving as a type of purification skill that combined offense and defense.
The current form of the duck was a huge duck with a black body and dark blue patterns. On its neck and eyes, pure water that looked like silk strips condensed from the golden-blue cleansing power of the Demon Vanquishing was tied!!
