It also held a Vajra Demon Subduing Staff condensed from golden water in its hand. It was extremely holy.
It looked like the Abyss Race, but not completely.
At the moment, although the duck couldn’t open its eyes casually because the power of the abyss was too powerful, it didn’t stop it from sensing everything in the outside world with its mental strength and wave power.
Among them, the Wave Vision, Heart Eye, was the result of Duckie’s cultivation in this aspect.
This was both a reconnaissance skill and a cleansing skill.
Wave Vision, Heart Eye, was fused with Duckie’s Water Blade, Heart Strike, Heart Sword, Purification, Wave Sword, Super Sight, and a bunch of other skills. Apart from that, it also fused a critical skill.
Susu’s origin fluctuated.
Shi Yu replicated Susu’s water elemental control and origin wave and taught it to Duckie.
Unfortunately, the Duck had no compatibility with it at all. Otherwise, it would be the strongest cleansing envoy in the Abyss Race.
However, even now, with the origin wave as the core, after fusing with a pile of cleansing skills, the wave vision Heart Eye formed was an extremely strong cleansing skill.
This was a mind ocular skill that could directly let Duckie open its Heart Eye and enter the wave vision state. After entering, it could maintain absolute calmness, predict danger, and also see negative energy dark matter. It could also condense cleansing fluctuations and accurately attack their weaknesses. Its power would double, and its ability to control the power of the abyss would double.
Four quasi-divine skills, two Abyss Explosion skills, and two cleansing skills. For a moment, it was hard to say if it was an Abyss Race or a member of the Environmental Protection Association.
At this point, Shi Yu felt that it was time to go to the Environmental Protection Association to register Duckie’s identity. At the same time, he also planned to join the official Environmental Protection Association.
With Susu and Duckie’s current cleansing abilities, he believed that the Environmental Protection Association would definitely welcome him very much. What nonsense assessment? Come on!

chapters.title: Chapter 1328 - 1328 Examination (1)
chapters.content:
1328 Examination (1)
“The Environmental Association that’s conveniently on the way to the Disaster Research Institute… this one!”
First-level world, Blue Wave World, main city, Blue Wave City.
Only in first-level realms would there be branches of the Environmental Protection Association.
As for this Blue Wave City, not only was there a branch of the Environmental Protection Association, but the disaster research institute introduced by the Space Emperor was also here, so Shi Yu definitely had to go there.
Shi Yu, who was seriously looking at the map, realized that the first-level realm closest to the Floating Realm was actually still the realm occupied by the five god races on Blue Planet.
Among the five god races on Blue Planet, the dragon, phoenix, and Kirin races occupied a first-level realm, and the angels and demons occupied a first-level realm.
Unfortunately, it wasn’t on the way to the disaster research institute. In order to not waste time, he didn’t do it.
After all, teleportation money was very expensive.
The size of the World King Planet was impossible to estimate.
If he wanted to go far, using the inter-world teleportation array was the only choice.
However, the price of using the inter-world teleportation array wasn’t cheap.
Even if it was a divine level, it would take a long time to go on a long trip.
If it was at the demigod level, it would be bankrupt.
Therefore, every year, as long as it was the God Sealing Battle and when it was time to go to a first-level domain to register and participate, the organizers could rely on the ticket money to earn a lot.
After all, the organizer and the faction that established the teleportation arrays of the various realms were both the officials of World King Planet.
Such things with huge benefits were all monopolized. Even if the Space Emperor himself knew how to build teleportation arrays, he couldn’t build them randomly. He could only build them within the range of his realm.
If there were any facilities in Sky City that didn’t belong to the Space Emperor, then the Realm Teleportation Array was one of them.
Fortunately, the God Sealing Battle didn’t need any registration fee. Otherwise, the number of participants could be halved. Even now, not every demigod had the energy to participate continuously. After all, it was alright if they were rich, but if they were still weak and poor, if they were beaten up a little more miserably one time, they would have to recuperate for a few years before they could fight again.
[Senior Space Emperor, I’m going to set off. My goal is Blue Wave City. When I reach there, I’ll tell you that I’m safe. Don’t miss me. – Shi Yu.]
After Shi Yu left a message for the Space Emperor, he set off directly.
“This is his first time going out to train. There shouldn’t be any accidents, right?”
…
Half a month after arriving at the World King Planet, Shi Yu finally left Sky City and headed to other unfamiliar places to train in a larger district.
Shi Yu took the identity card that the Space Emperor had given him and easily completed the teleportation process.
There was nothing special about the so-called identity card. It recorded the name and the realm it belonged to, not even caring about gender, age, and level.
Name: Shi Yu, Affiliation: Floating Realm.
The latter was the most important thing. After Shi Yu arrived at the Environmental Protection Department, he also had to use this to prove that he wasn’t someone of unknown origin before he could give Duckie an identity certificate.
With this, it was basically equivalent to a realm lord vouching for the user of the identity card. He was a citizen of their realm.
If Shi Yu himself didn’t belong to any domain, then if he brought Duckie to the Environmental Protection Department, he would probably be suppressed as an unregistered person before he even accepted the assessment.
In short, travel between realms was as troublesome as going abroad on Earth. In fact, every realm could indeed be seen as a country.
The local customs in every place were different. Even the Internet wasn’t enough to connect all places together. Some realms didn’t welcome mechanical life at all, and some realms even set up exclusive local area networks. Shi Yu’s trip this time was equivalent to a trip abroad.
However, he had already completed the transplanetary trip. Traveling abroad wasn’t a big deal.
After paying another teleportation fee worth several level-nine resources, Shi Yu felt the pinch.
F*ck.
Ordinary Beast Tamers would probably never be able to leave the Floating Realm in their lifetime!
However, there was no need for ordinary Beast Tamers to go out. The Floating Realm of the Space Emperor, as the world overlord, was larger than more than ten Dong Huangs. Just this side was enough.
“Wu wu wu.” In the luxurious Teleportation Tower, Eleven climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder and pointed at the sky.
Look~ Gray Machine~
“Yes.” Shi Yu also looked up at the sky through the transparent glass. A huge, totem-level passenger plane had just flown over. He didn’t know where it was heading.
Sitting on a mechanical life form was also an important transportation tool to sail in the universe on the World King Planet. The price was much cheaper than a spatial teleportation array, but the time needed would definitely be longer.
Sky City also had divine-level transportation that crossed domains, but Shi Yu found it too time-consuming and couldn’t be bothered to take it. How could such transportation be as convenient as a spatial teleportation array? He could reach his destination in the blink of an eye.
“Let’s go. It’s about time.” Shi Yu glanced at the time.
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven pointed ahead with one arm. Charge!!!
Although he had been in the limelight in the Sky City Arena a few days ago, Shi Yu still seemed to be a small transparent figure in Sky City. No one knew him at all.
If he wanted to go to other further realms, he would probably have to empty three to four stations. The teleportation fee would be super doubled!

chapters.title: Chapter 1329 - 1329 Examination (2)
chapters.content:
1329 Examination (2)
…
The Blue Wave Domain was known as the Plant Sea Kingdom.
The most eye-catching characteristic was its vast grassland. The endless green grassland was as dazzling as a wave under the wind.
The entire realm was wrapped in various novel spiritual plants and divine plants. It was famous for producing various plant resources in the surroundings. The surrounding realms maintained a good trade relationship with the Blue Wave Realm.
This was because the Lord of the Blue Wave World was a plant life form at the super divine level. In this world, plant-type creatures were the mainstream. Countless plant-type divines had lived here for a long time. The human races left in this world had also been on good terms with these plant-type divines for generations. Both parties maintained a long contract and cooperated with each other.
This was a realm filled with the aura of nature and close to nature, but modern facilities didn’t fall behind. When Shi Yu Teleported over, he discovered that the technological level here seemed to be about to exceed Sky City…
The foundation of a first-level realm was still strong.
Moreover, there weren’t many people in the Teleportation Tower in Sky City, and there were very few staff.
However, Shi Yu realized that there was a sea of people in the Teleportation Tower here. Under the guidance of the staff, after leaving the teleportation room, Shi Yu saw an endless stream of experts coming to the Blue Wave World through the teleportation array from other realms.
He was squeezed into the sea of people and almost lost his way for a moment.
“Damn, why is it even more lively than the metro in the city? Are all of you so rich?” Shi Yu accompanied the crowd. He left the Teleportation Tower and entered Blue Wave City.
Then, standing outside the Teleportation Tower, he looked at this big city that was perfectly combined with nature. After thinking for a moment, he decided to rely on Senior Space Emperor’s old friend, the director of the cosmic disaster research institute in Blue Wave City, Dr. Moen.
No… It was better to take the assessment first.
There was an Environmental Protection Department here. There should be a bunch of Environmental Protection Hunters. It wouldn’t be good if he was caught in advance.
“Ling.” Shi Yu called Ling and said, “Let’s see if we can connect to the Internet here. Help me book a place to stay. I want a better environment. Money isn’t a problem.”
Shi Yu also realized that the natural energy of the Blue Wave Realm was much more abundant than the Floating Realm. Baby Ginseng should like this place very much.
“Then, confirm the location of the Environmental Protection Department. We’ll go over now.”
“Roger,” Ling’s clone, which had turned into a mechanical bracelet and was hanging on Shi Yu’s wrist, immediately replied.
“Wu wu wu.” At this moment, after arriving at the destination, Eleven crawled out of Shi Yu’s pocket that was connected to the Beast Taming Space and climbed onto Shi Yu’s shoulder to look around.
“Don’t you feel very strange? The natural atmosphere is clearly rich, but the tempo is very fast.” Shi Yu stood by the street and looked at the endless stream of people as he said to Eleven.
“Sob.” Eleven nodded. At this moment, Ling spoke and said, “Master, it’s been reserved. The location of the Environmental Protection Department has been confirmed. I’ll activate the navigation for you. We can use the public teleportation array in the city to go over.”
“In addition, I discovered that the Environmental Protection Department here seems to have opened an online appointment channel.”
“I’ll also make an appointment for you.”
“Alright, let’s go.” Shi Yu, who was wearing a panda suit, had a panda on his shoulder. He hummed a tune and began to head to the Environmental Protection Department.
…
Environmental Protection Association, Blue Wave Branch.
It was located in the north of Blue Wave City and occupied a huge building complex alone.
Soon, Shi Yu arrived. He realized that there were green sprouts and blue water droplets hanging everywhere. It looked like this was the right place.
Before entering the building complex of the Environmental Protection Department, Shi Yu sensed a magnificent cleansing aura coming at him. In the building complex, various spiritual plants that cleansed the air instantly made Shi Yu and Eleven, who was on his shoulder, almost intoxicated.
“Wood element pets are also experts in cleansing. Baby, now that you have the control of wood, apart from cooking, you can also study other usage methods, such as cleansing and using poison,” Shi Yu said.
In the research institute of the Beast Taming Space, Baby Ginseng snorted. Hehe, needless to say, it had long prepared to add different toxins to every self-destruction.
At that time, with a few strong toxins mixed together, even if it couldn’t blow up the opponent, it could still poison him to death!
“Wu wu wu.” Eleven despised it. Poison was meaningless. Wasn’t it better to fight head-on!!
“Let’s go in.” There were also many people here. In the Environmental Protection Association building complex, people came and went. There was basically no existence weaker than Level 7, which was the legendary level.
From time to time, he would encounter two guys he couldn’t see through. Shi Yu could also confirm that they were divine-level big shots.
After entering the Environmental Protection Association building complex, he didn’t encounter any obstacles. There were several buildings here that were handling business. Shi Yu casually entered a tall building, and immediately, a tall receptionist welcomed him.
“Hello, is there anything you need to do?”
“I have an appointment to give the abyss pet an identity certificate,” Shi Yu said directly.
In the Environmental Protection Association, there were many businesses that could be handled. To a certain extent, this place also bore some of the functions of the hospital. They could spend money to find a cleanser to help cleanse various negative toxins and relieve mental pressure. Apart from that, if they wanted to join the Environmental Protection Association and buy cleansing equipment, they could do it here.
“Alright, please tell me your appointment number.” The receptionist was surprised. She glanced at Eleven on Shi Yu’s shoulder and found a tablet on a pillar table to pick it up before continuing to communicate with Shi Yu.

chapters.title: Chapter 1330 - 1330 Examination (3)
chapters.content:
1330 Examination (3)
“4675.” The business Shi Yu handled was indeed rare. Issuing certificates to the abyss pets was basically done by the members of the Environmental Protection Association who had gone to the Abyss Battlefield. They were the group who came into contact with the abyss pets the most.
As for young people like Shi Yu, who wasn’t a member of the Environmental Protection Association, it was very rare for him to contract an abyss pet. After all, which normal person would contract that thing?
Of course, although it was rare, it wasn’t impossible. After all, the number of outsiders to World King Planet wasn’t small. Beast Tamers from other planets were migrating over at all times.
“Well… The cleanser in charge of handling your business is our association’s divine-level cleanser, Master Adolf. I’ll bring you over,” the receptionist said.
“Alright, thank you.” Shi Yu nodded.
At the same time, in a private building in the Environmental Protection Association building complex, an old man with gray curly hair was leisurely drinking tea. Just as he put down the empty cup, a black-haired young woman with tanned skin beside him poured him another cup.
“Little Chun, prepare yourself. An abyss contractor will come to apply for an identity certificate later. You’re in charge of assessing him.”
“Me? Teacher, what about you?” The woman named Little Chun was stunned. “I just returned from the battlefield…”
Master Adolf laughed and said, “It’s precisely because of this that I let you come. You’ve been gone for three years. It’s a good opportunity to see your improvement during this period of time. You’re not far from the divine level, right?”
“Alright, alright.” Little Chun put down the teapot and said, “In that case, the person who came to settle the business is also at Level 9?”
“Yes, otherwise, it wouldn’t be assigned to me,” Master Adolf said.
Assessment of a Level 9 should have been done by him, a divine-level cleansing master. However, with him watching, it wasn’t a problem to deal with his obedient disciple.
Adolf smiled and looked at his disciple. At Level 9, his student should be extremely outstanding. He had contracted two demigod-level pets, one of which was a wood-element pet that had mastered the cleansing divine skill, and the other was a Yi Race pet of the Wood element that had mastered the power of poison pollution.
Purification-type pets were the other party’s initial pets.
As for the Yi Race, just like the Yun Race and the Abyss Race, they were both factions of the Dark King. The Yun Race was metal, the Abyss Race was water, and the Yi Race was wood. They were all races with very powerful pollution abilities.
Originally, as an Environmental Protection Hunter of the Environmental Protection Association, Little Chun shouldn’t have contracted a pet of the clan. However, in order to understand the enemy better and carry out some special battles, she still chose to contract and nurture a hostile pet from scratch, and she cultivated and got along pretty well with it.
Such a combination also made it best for Little Chun to obtain good results in the God Sealing Battle and enter the top 10,000.
In the entire World King Planet, the entire battle result was already enough to be called a proud daughter of heaven. It was definitely more than enough to give ordinary Level 9 assessments.
After all, she wasn’t a flower in a greenhouse, but an environmental hunter who had been to the Starry Sky Battlefield.
“The other party is here,” Master Adolf said. “Oh? He’s quite young.”
As Master Adolf finished speaking, the receptionist brought Shi Yu over.
“Master Adolf, this Mr. Shi Yu has made an appointment for the identity assessment of the Abyssal pet,” the receptionist said.
“I understand. You can go down first,” Master Adolf said.
At the same time, he looked at Shi Yu.
At this moment, Shi Yu also looked at Master Adolf and the woman beside him.
A divine level… and a Level 9…
“Master Adolf, hello. My name is Shi Yu, and I’m from the Floating Realm.” Shi Yu immediately introduced himself.
“Hello.” Master Adolf stood up and focused his attention on Eleven. “There’s no need to be nervous. Let’s talk first. This is also part of the identification process.”
“The abyss pet you contracted shouldn’t be this, right?”
“How many pets have you contracted?”
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I have another one.”
“Come on, tell me first. Where did you contract your abyss pet?” Master Adolf said.
“My mother planet was once invaded by the Abyss Race. Although the seniors on my mother planet repelled the Abyss Race, the other party still left an inheritance on my mother planet, causing many native lives to be turned into an abyss.”
“The abyss pet I contracted is one of them. It was originally an ordinary water-element life form. After coming into contact with the power of the abyss, its stats changed. However, its talent isn’t bad, and it can control the power of the abyss.”
“I see. How long have you been on the World King Planet?” Master Adolf said.
“It’s been less than a month,” Shi Yu said.
Master Adolf smiled and said, “Well, next, you need to send your abyss pet to complete a battle. Your examiner is also a life form who has mastered similar powers. What you need to do is maintain your rationality under the other party’s pollution. This is one of the assessments. There’s no problem, right?”
“No problem.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “However, are we taking the assessment here?”
“Yes, here is fine.”
“Little Chun, I’ll leave it to you.” Adolf sat down again and said to the woman beside him.
The woman sighed and looked at Shi Yu. “My name is Xia Zhichun. Next, I’ll be your examiner. Now, you can summon your abyss pet.”
After saying that, she also activated the summoning array. In the golden summoning array, a huge black mushroom with colorful stripes appeared beside her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1331 - 1331 Examination (4)
chapters.content:
1331 Examination (4)
“Alright.” At the same time, Shi Yu also activated the summoning array and summoned the nervous duck.
In the next second, on the golden summoning array, the huge black duck with its eyes covered appeared on the spot.
“Quack!!!”
As Duckie appeared, Xia Zhichun said, “Is that it? What’s wrong with its eyes?”
Shi Yu said, “A seal. Its abyssal power is too strong. It’s usually sealed.”
“Remove it,” Xia Zhichun said. “Let it erupt with all its might with the power of the abyss. During this process, I’ll let it lure your abyss pet into continuing to go berserk through pollen. I want to see the strength of your control over the power of the abyss.”
“Ah.” Shi Yu and Duckie were stunned.
“Why, is there a problem?” Xia Zhichun frowned.
“No.” Shi Yu was originally worried that Duckie’s explosive power was too strong, but when he recalled that there was a divine-level cleanser beside him, he instantly wasn’t worried anymore.
“In that case, Duckie, unlock the seal of the Eye of the Evil God.”
“Quack!!!” Duckie nodded and directly pulled open the sealed eyeband, revealing its closed eyes. It began to slowly open them.
On the other side, the mushroom of the Yi Race also began to activate a special poisonous domain, turning the surroundings into a purple poisonous world.
In the poisonous world, invisible poisonous pollen began to enter Duckie’s body through its skin. This should be a quasi-divine skill. In an instant, Duckie felt that the abyssal power in its body was like a wild horse that had escaped its restraints. It began to become irritable and out of control.
Bang bang bang bang bang bang.
Duckie’s heart began to beat strongly. The Heart of the Abyss was activated. At the same time, as it opened its dark red eyes, a terrifying aura gradually spread on Duckie.
Initially, Master Adolf was still sitting there to watch the commotion, but suddenly, his expression became serious.
“Quack!!!” At this moment, as the Eye of the Evil God and the Heart of the Abyss opened together, a shocking aura wave swept out. Duckie’s entire body crazily absorbed the negative energy drifting in the starry sky of the universe, transforming into a monstrous abyss wave that shook the sky and earth. It instantly formed an endless abyss aura!!
Abyssal fluctuations swept up with vast might, instantly making the poisonous domain wrapped around the battlefield tremble, as if it would collapse at any time!!
Boom!!!
Duckie looked at the examiner with its dark red eyes. In the next second, the poisonous domain completely collapsed. The terrifying abyssal deterrence directly forced the mushroom and Xia Zhichun of the Yi Race, whose expressions changed drastically, back.
The domain creator, the Poison Mushroom of the Yi Race, who had endured the main pressure of the abyssal fluctuations, looked into the duck’s eyes as if it had seen a terrifying existence. It directly revealed a shocked expression, and its eyes couldn’t help but turn white.
“Impossible,” Xia Zhichun said in shock.
Master Adolf’s expression suddenly changed. At this moment, the abyssal fluctuations erupting from Duckie’s body were comparable to the divine level. For a moment, the terrifying abyssal fluctuations caused the Environmental Protection Association to tremble.
Strange, unholy, powerful, and deep. At this moment, the Eye of the Evil God vividly displayed these adjectives. Duckie’s current aura was powerful enough to instantly affect the mind of a demigod.
It didn’t look like an abyss demigod at all, but the real Abyss God in the Abyss Battlefield.
“What the hell.” Seeing this, Adolf was in disbelief. He couldn’t understand why this duck hid such terrifying abyssal power.
It actually instantly knocked out the other demigod-level life form?
He immediately summoned his divine-level partner to prevent this duck from going berserk. In his opinion, if he didn’t control the Crowd Control in time, something big would happen.
“Wait, Master Adolf.” However, at this moment, Shi Yu immediately said, “It can control it.”
“Quack!!!” Just as Shi Yu finished speaking, Duckie roared. Golden light spread from its body, and the Wave Vision, Heart Eye, activated. The Vajra Demon Subduing Staff,whicht was filled with holy light condensed in its hand. Two power fluctuations, one gold and one black, spread on Duckie’s body.
“Quack!!!”
With the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff in hand, the duck was like a Buddha and a demon. With a shake of its arm, all the filth in its eyes was instantly shattered accurately by it. The abyssal power that was stimulated by the other party’s pollen was immediately suppressed by the duck.
Boom!!!
Two different powers, one holy and one unholy, intertwined on Duckie’s body, making Master Adolf and Xia Zhichun suddenly tremble. This… How was this possible?
What was with this holy power? It had mastered both an abyss-type quasi-divine skill and a cleansing-type quasi-divine skill?
“Quack!!!” As the two examiners were shocked, when the golden cloak behind Duckie fluttered, it stabbed the Demon Subduing Pestle into the ground. In the next moment, the abyssal fluctuations on its body completely disappeared, and only the power of cleansing was left on its body.
At this moment, Master Adolf and Xia Zhichun were stunned. They looked at the monster duck in front of them in confusion.
Firstly, it was the initial abyssal fluctuations, the abyssal fluctuations that were like Superdivine. Secondly, the cleansing fluctuations that were on par with the abyssal fluctuations made it difficult for them to understand.
Just now, Master Adolf almost thought that a divine-level assassin of the Abyss Race had infiltrated the Environmental Protection Association.
“What’s with the power of your abyss pet? Don’t tell me that a native life form of a planet polluted by the abyss can control the power of the abyss to this extent!” Master Adolf said.
Shi Yu said, “The Abyss Race Leader who invaded our mother planet is a super divine Abyss Evil God. The inheritance it left behind is one of its eyes.”
“We found this Eye of the Evil God. After purification, we fused it into its body, so the abyssal power contained in its body is indeed a little greater than ordinary abyssal pets.”
“However, it’s definitely not a problem to control it normally.”
A demigod fused the eye of the super divine Abyss Evil God into its body and even successfully suppressed it?
When Adolf heard that, he looked at Shi Yu and Duckie with trembling pupils. Kid, what the f*ck was this joke? Where did you get it? How could the super divine level Eye of the Evil God be cleansed just like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 1332 - 1332 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (1)
chapters.content:
1332 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (1)
In the Environmental Protection Association of Blue Wave City, the soaring abyssal aura shocked everyone almost immediately.
“An unfamiliar divine-level abyss aura… Who is it?”
In the president’s office of the Environmental Protection Association, a beautiful woman in a white cheongsam looked at Master Adolf’s workplace.
In the Environmental Protection Association, it wasn’t that no one contracted abyss pets, nor was it that there weren’t divine-level abyss pets. However, every one of them was registered, and everyone was already very familiar with it.
However, this time, under the stimulation of the Duckie Race, the abyssal aura produced by the resonance of the Eye of the Evil God and the Abyss Heart was completely unfamiliar. Moreover, the high-quality abyssal power of the Evil God’s Eye made those environmental hunters who had been to the Abyss Battlefield feel like a super divine abyssal life suppression power had descended into the Environmental Protection Association.
Almost without hesitation, many divine-level purifiers, including the president of the Blue Wave Branch of the Environmental Protection Association, headed to the assessment venue where the Duck had descended.
Then, they saw a scene that surprised them. Master Adolf was stunned on the spot. Master Adolf’s disciple and her pet supported themselves on the spot with difficulty, almost fainting.
At the scene, there were no abyss pets at all. There was only an unfamiliar young man and a dark blue duck filled with golden holy light holding the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff.
“Quack…” At this moment, Duckie also noticed that many powerful lives filled with the power of divine-level cleansing had come around. It couldn’t help but swallow its saliva.
Shi Yu was also silent. From the looks of it, Duckie’s Crowd Control of the abyssal power was still not very good. When the other party stimulated it, it almost went berserk. This was only a demigod-level life form.
However, this was also related to Duckie taking the initiative to withstand it. If Duckie directly used the Wave Vision to cooperate with the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff, the other party’s poisonous pollen couldn’t come into contact with Duckie at all.
“President…” At that moment, Master Adolf also noticed the dozen or so divine-level purifiers who had suddenly descended here. Among them, he looked at the beautiful woman in the lead and immediately knew that she was attracted by the abyssal fluctuations of the duck just now.
It was mainly because he really didn’t expect that a demigod-level abyss pet could erupt with such a rich abyss deterrence. Otherwise, it would definitely be able to control the commotion of the assessment in this building area.
“Master Adolf, what’s going on here?” Xing Nan, the president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, looked at the messy courtyard and asked.
“Yeah, Master Adolf, what happened to the fluctuations just now? It was spread from you, right?” The other higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Association also asked Master Adolf.
“This…” Master Adolf’s disciple, Xia Zhichun, swallowed his saliva crazily as he comforted his companion.
He wanted to tell many seniors present that the terrifying abyssal fluctuations just now were released by the demigod-level duck that looked incomparably holy now. Although it was ridiculous, it was the truth!
“Seniors, I’m very sorry. The aura just now was accidentally created by us,” Shi Yu said.
“Quack!! (Sorry, sorry.)” Duckie also waved the Demon Subduing Staff and said, “Sorry to disturb you!!”
Under everyone’s puzzled expressions, Master Adolf said, “That’s right. I’m giving this young man an abyss pet assessment. I just didn’t expect the abyssal power in this Abyss Duck’s body to be so rich and huge.”
“Abyss assessment??” President Xing Nan looked at Shi Yu and Duckie in confusion. The other divine-level purifiers also looked at the duck in confusion. At this moment, the Vajra Demon Subduing Staff and the Wave Vision were open at the same time. The purifying power of Duckie’s body was incomparably dazzling. Such a strong purifying wave was enough to be at the top, even in the demigod-level cleansing life of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association.
“Well, the abyssal power just now indeed erupted from this Abyss Duck. Moreover, this Abyss Duck also mastered a relatively powerful cleansing power. It can suppress the abyssal power at will,” Master Adolf said with a toothache. “This is the first time I’ve seen such a strange life form.”
How did this young man in front of him let the abyssal power and cleansing power of this duck reach such a powerful level?
“Young people.” At this moment, President Xing Nan looked at Shi Yu and Duckie and said, “Can you display the abyss form just now?”
“Alright.” Shi Yu looked at Duckie.
“Quack!!” In the next moment, Duckie nodded and closed its golden eyes again. Under the gaze of many divine-level purifiers, right on the heels of that, it opened its eyes again.
Eye of the Evil God, activate!
With a bang, the Eye of the Heart that contained the power of cleansing directly turned into a dark red Evil God Eye with a V-shaped pattern. Accompanied by the sound of heartbeats, the golden-blue fluctuations on the duck’s body were instantly dyed by the black fluctuations of the tide. It was like a painting splashed with ink, and magic power surged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1333 - 1333 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (2)
chapters.content:
1333 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (2)
“Roar!!!” Under the duck’s roar, abyssal fluctuations shot into the sky and danced in the nine heavens. The infinitely spreading abyssal fluctuations outside its body instantly made the cleansing spiritual plants in this courtyard wither, making the air wail and the sky change color.
When the terrifying abyssal aura swept in all directions, the pupils of the Poison Mushroom of the Yi Race that had just been awakened by Xia Zhichun trembled again. It was shocked and fainted again.
The surrounding divine-level purifiers and their partner who had mastered the divine-level cleansing power sensed this extremely high-quality abyssal power and subconsciously protected themselves. They condensed the effect of the cleansing wave to interfere with the abyssal power and revealed incredulous expressions.
They looked at this huge dark blue duck with incredulous expressions.
The power of the abyss previously was actually displayed by this duck that had mastered the powerful cleansing power?
Moreover, at this moment, looking at this demigod-level duck that erupted with abyssal fluctuations comparable to divine-level, it was still calm and sober, making these divine-level purifiers feel that it was ridiculous.
“Master Adolf, what’s wrong with them?” President Xing Nan couldn’t help but ask.
It was very difficult to imagine that such a ridiculous combination would appear in their Blue Wave Branch.
Master Adolf said, “His name is Shi Yu. He’s from the second-level realm, the Floating Realm. He only came to the World King Planet in the past month. According to him, his mother planet was invaded by a super divine level abyss life form very long ago and won a battle.”
Many divine-level purifiers revealed surprised expressions. What? It was invaded by the super divine level Abyss Race and even successfully won?
“However, although it expelled the enemy, that Abyss Evil God left behind an eye. As an abyss inheritance, it continued to wreak havoc on that planet.”
“This Abyss Duck is a local transcendent life form that was infected by the power of the abyss and mutated into an abyss life form.”
“At the same time, what I don’t understand is that they said that in the end, they found the Eye of the Evil God and successfully cleansed and absorbed it. That’s why they can have such powerful abyssal power.”
“What??” As soon as Master Adolf finished speaking, the surrounding divine-level purifiers were shocked again. Successfully cleansing the super divine level Eye of the Evil God? How was this possible?
“Tell me, where are you from?” President Xing Nan was shocked and asked Shi Yu again.
Shi Yu said, “The Floating Realm.”
“The Floating Realm…” Upon hearing the name of this realm, many divine-level purifiers felt that it was a little familiar. President Xing Nan pondered for a moment and said, “The realm lord of your realm is the one who once successfully hunted a super divine life form above his level in the Void Battlefield.”
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “I’m from the same hometown as the World King. He just received me on the World King Planet recently. He was the one who asked me to come to the Environmental Protection Association to register the identity of the abyss pet.”
When Shi Yu finished speaking, the surrounding divine-level purifiers were stunned. Then, they whispered to each other. The Floating Realm. No wonder it sounded so familiar.
Decades ago, there was a battle that ended with the death of the super divine life form on the World King Planet. However, the enemy camp’s super divine life form also suffered a huge loss of vitality and was extremely weak. Originally, with the death of the super divine life form, the situation on this battlefield had already been determined, but no one expected that two divine-level Beast Tamers who didn’t care about their lives would enter the enemy camp and successfully hunt the weak super divine life form, reversing the situation on this battlefield.
One of them was the Space Emperor. The other was Lin Feng, who was pulled to the battlefield by the Space Emperor.
The two of them were also bold. They directly targeted the weak super divine life form and wanted to see if it could drop the source of transcendence.
No one expected Shi Yu to actually come from the same planet as that World Master Wang Kong.
“I see.” President Xing Nan looked at the Abyss Duck that had suppressed the abyss aura again, as well as Shi Yu, who still had a black and white bear race hanging on his shoulder. “Master Adolf, since his abyss pet can control the power of the abyss that exceeds its level and won’t lose itself, he’ll pass the assessment.”
“Next, I just have to confirm with the Floating Realm and help him complete his identity verification.”
“Yes,” Master Adolf said with a nod.
At that moment, many divine-level purifiers still sized up Duckie in surprise.
Therefore, the so-called Eye of the Evil God was probably helped cleanse this young man by the Realm Lord of the Floating Realm.
They could only think of this possibility. Although they felt that the Space Emperor himself didn’t have the ability to cleanse the super divine level Eye of the Evil God, such a world overlord who could kill a super divine life form above his level definitely had rich connections and foundation. It wasn’t impossible to find a way to cleanse the Eye of the Evil God.
And to be nurtured by the Realm Lord of the Floating Realm like this, Shi Yu was definitely a genius the other party thought very highly of.
Well, with the strength of this Abyss Duck, it was indeed so!!
They felt that this Abyss Duck definitely had the level to enter the top 1,000 before the God Sealing Battle. If the Beast Tamer was also outstanding and mastered the divine-level strengthening ability, if the two parties cooperated well, it might have the ability to charge into the top 100!!
At this level, it would be strange if a second-level realm didn’t nurture him. Even in a first-level realm, he was a rare genius.
Now, Master Adolf’s disciple, Xia Zhichun, had a complicated expression. She was the person who had experienced Duckie’s power the most directly. Her companion from the Mo Race was definitely not weak. In the end, she was knocked out by an abyssal deterrent of the same level. This was completely unimaginable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1334 - 1334 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (3)
chapters.content:
1334 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (3)
If she didn’t know Shi Yu’s level in advance, she would definitely think that the duck was at the divine level.
“Thank you, President, thank you, Master Adolf.” At the same time, when Shi Yu heard that the assessment was smooth and he could immediately help Duckie register its identity, he couldn’t help but smile.
After the registration was completed, he could send Duckie out to battle without worrying about any impact. Alright.
Waiting for Duckie to kill in the God Sealing War, the eyes of the Abyss Evil God had already been given to Duckie. If it couldn’t defeat a bunch of demigods, Duckie would leave the group!
“By the way.” Shi Yu suddenly said, “Well, Masters… I still want to join the Environmental Protection Association.”
The Environmental Protection Association was the largest purification-type resource purchase platform on the World King Planet, and it was also the only channel to legally buy abyss-type resources. It could even go to the Abyss Battlefield through the Environmental Protection Association. Shi Yu felt that if one day, he and Susu wanted to show off in the starry sky and join the Environmental Protection Association, it was an inevitable choice.
“Huh? Do you want to join the Environmental Protection Association?” President Xing Nan smiled and looked at the Abyss Duck. Although this duck was an abyss pet, it cultivated the power of the abyss and the power of purification at the same time…
As long as he mastered the Purification Skill, he could join the Environmental Protection Association. Not only did Shi Yu meet the criteria, but he also far exceeded it. It was also a good thing for such a genius to join their Blue Wave Branch.
“Yes.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I heard that an Environmental Protection Hunter who becomes an Environmental Protection Association can go to the Abyss Battlefield. My mother planet was once invaded by the Abyss Race, and I suffered a lot because of this. Even my contracted partner was infected and became an Abyss Race and suffered a lot. It’s my dream to be an Environmental Protection Hunter and counterattack the Abyss Race since I was young.”
Duckie: Eh?
Really?
Why did it remember that it took the initiative to receive the power of the abyss?
Eleven cast its gaze at Duckie. It was very normal. Shi Yu purely wanted to have another dream. Calm down.
“Good, good.” President Xing Nan’s eyes lit up. He was actually a genius who wanted to go to the Abyss Battlefield.
That was even rarer.
After all, the battlefield where the Dark King Army fought was extremely dangerous. Not everyone from the Environmental Protection Association was willing to fight on the battlefield.
Usually, those members of the Environmental Protection Association who were willing to go to the battlefield to fight had another name, Environmental Protection Hunter.
Shi Yu had the intention to go to the battlefield, so it was even more worth absorbing. The various environmental associations lacked such ambitious people.
“Young man, not bad. Your courage is commendable.” The surrounding divine-level cleansing masters also smiled and nodded.
“Alright, Master Adolf, please arrange for him to join the association again,” President Xing Nan said. “After joining the Environmental Protection Association, you can call yourself a ‘purifier’. I’ll give you a purifier license. Moreover, according to the different purifying abilities, I’ll arrange different benefits for you. Shi Yu, right? With the purifying level of your Abyss Duck, you can probably become a one-star purifier.”
“As for the assessment, there’s no need.”
In the Environmental Protection Association, for example, the power of the abyss that could cleanse the overlord-level power of the abyss could be called a trainee purifier.
Those that could cleanse the power of the divine-level abyss would be called a two-star purifier.
The highest was a three-star purifier that could cleanse the power of the abyss at the super divine level.
Typically, at this level, only super divine beings who were masters of purification, as well as divine-level beings who possessed the abilities of Beast Tamers through racial talents, combined with various means, could achieve it at the peak of divine-level purification life forms.
The basic requirement of the branch presidents of the Environmental Protection Associations of the various first-level realms was to be a three-star cleanser.
“Well, President,” Shi Yu whispered after President Xing Nan finished speaking.
A one-star purifier… How poor were the benefits?
He didn’t join the Environmental Protection Association for the treatment of one-star, but… three-star!
“Why don’t I take the assessment? I want to participate in the three-star purifier assessment,” Shi Yu said.
“What did you say?” Master Adolf was stunned.
President Xing Nan originally wanted to leave, but when he heard that, he immediately stopped in his tracks. He turned around and looked at Shi Yu. “You just said that you want to participate in the three-star purifier assessment?”
As Shi Yu finished speaking, the purifiers present were speechless. Xia Zhichun, who wasn’t far from Shi Yu, widened his eyes even more and suspected that there was something wrong with his ears.
“Do you know what a three-star purifier represents?” The corners of President Xing Nan’s mouth twitched as he asked.
“It’s not impossible for your Abyss Duck to barely try the two-star purifier assessment, but three-star requires the ability to cleanse the power of the super divine level abyss!!”
Shi Yu nodded and said, “I know. Before coming to the assessment, I’ve done sufficient investigation. I think we have this ability now. That super divine Eye of the Evil God was cleansed by us. Therefore, I still want to give it a try.”
President Xing Nan: “?”
Master Adolf and the other divine-level purifiers:???
Huh?
What did Shi Yu just say? The super divine Eye of the Evil God was cleansed by them?
Wasn’t it the Floating Realm Master who used his connections to find someone he knew to cleanse it?
“Impossible.” The middle-aged beautiful woman, President Xing Nan, stared at Shi Yu decisively and said, “If you want to cleanse the power of the abyss at the super divine level, even if you use various favorable conditions, you have to at least have the strength of a top-notch Divine Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1335 - 1335 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (4)
chapters.content:
1335 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (4)
“You’re only at Level 9, and only at the demigod level. Just based on this, you want to cleanse the power of the super divine level abyss?”
Xia Zhichun, who was about the same age as Shi Yu, also looked at Shi Yu with a ridiculous expression. If Shi Yu said that he wanted to take the two-star purifier assessment, she would still feel that Shi Yu was impressive and admired him. However, no matter how she heard it, a three-star purifier sounded like a daydream.
In the entire Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, President Xing Nan was the only three-star purifier.
“It’s not this duck…” Shi Yu said, “I have another pet that specializes in the power of cleansing.”
“It’s the cleansed Eye of the Evil God. Eh, in short, I just want to give it a try.”
With that said, Shi Yu directly summoned Susu, who looked like the current Starry Sky Slime. The appearance of Susu, who was the size of a basketball, stunned everyone, and felt that it was ridiculous.
This person had contracted quite a lot of pets. However, the pet Shi Yu mentioned that could cleanse the power of the super divine level abyss was such a guy?
This… Why did it look so similar to a slime?
Pets like slimes weren’t rare. On the major planets, they were mainstream low-level elemental life forms.
“Quack!!! (Big Sister Susu is awesome. It taught me my cleansing ability.)” At this moment, the duck praised Susu at the side. Its words directly stunned the purifiers present.
Did they hear wrongly? The cleansing power of this duck was taught by this slime?
What a joke. This worked?
“This is an ore that has been infected by the radiation of the Yun Race. If you’re really as powerful as you say, cleanse it and take a look.” At this moment, after a moment of silence, President Xing Nan directly took out an ore from her spatial equipment.
A huge, black rock that was one meter tall and wide appeared on the scene. It was filled with violent radiation fluctuations that kept radiating the surrounding environment. The feeling it gave Shi Yu was quite similar to Yun An’s power fluctuations.
At this moment, when this ore was taken out, many purifiers narrowed their eyes and could tell that this was an ore that had been polluted by the life of the divine-level Yun Race.
Although it couldn’t compare to the power of the super divine level abyss, even they would have to spend a lot of effort to cleanse it. The cleansing time ranged from a few minutes to a few hours.
“Alright.” At the same time, Shi Yu nodded.
“Ning!!” At this moment, as President Xingnan took out this ore, Susu was also very clean.
Just as everyone was planning to see if Shi Yu was bragging, Susu turned around. Under the combination of the Star Sea Contract and the origin wave, faint blue ripples spread on the rock it saw!
In almost a few seconds, with all the purifiers in disbelief and opening their mouths wide, the radiation and dark color of the ore faded, turning into a divine-level metal ore shining with golden light.
In less than ten seconds, the cleansing was successful.
Not to mention these two-star purifiers, even President Xing Nan himself was stunned on the spot.
As for Master Adolf’s disciple, he looked like he had seen a ghost. He suspected that he had fainted like his pet and had yet to wake up!
“How is this possible!!!” Many people exclaimed.
What the hell? How was this possible? What happened just now? They looked at the calm Starry Sky Slime as if they had seen a ghost.
President Xing Nan’s breathing was also rapid. She felt that it was unbelievable. She took out another flower-type resource that had been polluted by the power of the divine-level Yi Race. Susu didn’t say a word and continued to cleanse the origin fluctuations.
This time, in less than a minute, the gray-purple petal was directly cleansed into pink. The color was incomparably bright, filled with life fluctuations, and the pollution source was gone.
“Ning!!! (Is there anything else? It can all be cleansed!)” Susu was eager to try.
After cleansing these, the Star Sea Contract didn’t backfire. Alright!
This time, it wasn’t just President Xing Nan. The various two-star purifiers also took out the resources they were cleansing. Susu casually looked over. It cleansed more than ten things at the same time without any effort. It only took less than a minute to cleanse them all.
At this moment, all the purifiers were shocked to the extreme.
“What race is it?” President Xing Nan asked in shock.
“It’s a little sprite born from the power of faith condensed by the ocean creatures on our mother planet who hope to cleanse the abyss,” Shi Yu said.
“Well… But after arriving at the starry sky, it evolved again.”
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone’s expressions stiffened.
“Cleansing star spirit… It’s definitely the cleansing star spirit!!!” Master Adolf suddenly said.
“You guys… follow me.” At this moment, President Xing Nan’s expression was shocked. She directly stepped forward and pulled Shi Yu to a place.
Shi Yu, Susu, and Eleven were stunned. Duckie jogged and followed.
The purifiers present realized something and followed.
Shi Yu was initially stunned, but soon, he understood where the other party had brought him. This was a special building. In the building was a black pearl polluted by the power of the super divine abyss.
“You guys… try cleansing this.” After President Xing Nan opened the seal of the building, he looked at the abyssal fluctuations spreading in the room and said to Shi Yu and Susu.
“Alright.” Although Shi Yu felt that the abyssal power of this black pearl was even richer than the Eye of the Evil God, and that Susu might need to cleanse for a few days, they only needed to prove that Susu could indeed cleanse the power of the super divine level abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 1336 - 1336 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (5)
chapters.content:
1336 Becoming the President of the Environmental Protection Association in Seconds (5)
The purifiers present weren’t unfamiliar with this pearl. Every branch of the Environmental Protection Association had a fixed mission every year, such as cleansing a certain number of polluted resources. Among them, cleansing resources polluted by the power of the super divine level was also one of the quest indicators.
Even President Xing Nan would probably have to cleanse with difficulty for a period of time.
However, at this moment, under everyone’s stunned expressions, as the Starry Sky Slime let out a cry, a huge wave of power bloomed from its body. In an instant, the wave of the color of the starry sky directly suppressed the abyss power on the pearl. Moreover, all the purifiers could sense that the abyss power on the pearl was slowly being eliminated. Although the speed wasn’t as fast as before, it was really slowly disappearing!!
The power of the super divine level abyss couldn’t counter the pollution-cleansing wave. Instead, it was suppressed by the cleansing wave until it couldn’t resist.
It was very difficult for the purifiers present to believe that such a ridiculous scene was something a demigod-level life form could do.
“Impossible. Even if it’s a cleansing star spirit, it’s impossible to cleanse the power of the super divine level abyss at the demigod level…” Xia Zhichun, who had heard her teacher’s words just now, shook her head fiercely and looked at this scene.
“Indeed, it’s impossible to purely cleanse a star spirit, but what if this cleansing star spirit also masters a cleansing divine skill that contains top-notch laws?” President Xing Nan said.
The strength of the cleansing star spirit race was that they could freely mobilize the power of the starry sky to strengthen cleansing-type moves. Their racial ability was to infinitely mobilize the power of the starry sky, but the cleansing methods were different. It was possible for metal, wood, water, fire, earth, light, wind, spirit, time, and various other elements.
Therefore, even if they were both cleansing star spirits, there were still differences in strength. As for Shi Yu’s contract, to be able to master such a strong cleansing power and ignore consumption, there was no doubt that he had definitely signed a contract with the starry sky.
But even so, cleansing a divine-level pollution source above his level should be the limit.
But in front of them, it could easily cleanse the super divine level pollution source without the support of a Beast Tamer. Apart from the combination of the Starry Sky Contract and a top-notch cleansing divine skill, they couldn’t think of a second one.
President Xing Nan’s pupils trembled. He felt that he had discovered a rare treasure.
“This… It might take a few days to cleanse this. We should be considered to have met the standard of a three-star purifier, right?” Shi Yu scratched his head and said.
The purifiers present were speechless. Not only did they meet the standard, but this ability could even be the branch president of an environmental protection association in a first-level realm.
“You just said that you want to join our Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association, right?” The president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association pressed Shi Yu’s shoulder and said excitedly, “Little guy, you have to keep your word. From today onwards, you’re the vice president of our Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association.”
Xia Zhichun: “?”
Shi Yu, Susu, Duckie: !!!
Holy shit, he had just joined the Environmental Protection Association and was already the vice president of a branch. Was it so exciting?
“You might not know what your ability represents, but please believe that joining the Environmental Protection Association is definitely your best choice. Next, I’ll arrange a place for you to stay. You can stay at the Environmental Protection Association first and treat this place as your home,” President Xing Nan said with a gentle expression.
The purifiers beside him had never noticed that their president had such a kind side.
A hundred years later, perhaps there would be another super divine existence expert in the power of cleansing.
He had just arrived in an unfamiliar place and was instantly appointed president of the Environmental Protection Association. His status might not be inferior to that of the Space Emperor and Senior Lin Feng!
…
That day, in the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association in World King City, ever since they captured the traces of the birth of the cleansing star spirit the last time, they immediately began to set up search work. They even found a time-element god who was an expert in premonition.
However, they didn’t expect that before they could start the search, the news of the cleansing star spirit had already come from the branch first.
The information about Shi Yu, Susu, and Duckie immediately spread from the Blue Wave Branch to the ears of a super divine level figure in the headquarters.
Floating Realm, Sky City.
The Space Emperor was originally cultivating daily, but with this abnormality, he took out his World King Token and fell into deep thought.
Apart from being a symbol of identity, the World King Token could also be seen as a communication device for the official factions of the World King Planet to contact the world overlords of the various realms. Generally speaking, only super divine experts from official institutions had the right to directly contact the various world overlords through the World King Token.
At this moment, the Space Emperor was more puzzled. He couldn’t think of anyone who would contact him through the World King Token.
In the next moment, the Space Emperor activated the World King Token. A cold voice came from the other side.
“Floating Realm Master, I’m the vice president of the World King City’s Environmental Protection Association. Shi Yu is from your Floating Realm, right?”
Uh…
Upon hearing this voice, the Space Emperor Kong’s heart almost skipped a beat, and he almost blacked out. He suddenly had a bad feeling. Shi Yu, this kid, went to register an identity card for the abyss pet. Why did he ridiculously let a super divine level Beast Tamer find him!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1337 - 1337 Making Me Stronger (1)
chapters.content:
1337 Making Me Stronger (1)
The vice president of the Environmental Protection Association, Bing Ling.
Emperor Kong had heard of this name.
She was one of the few super divine level humans on World King Planet.
Moreover, she and her contracted partner had both reached the super divine level, which was rare.
Unlike the five super divines of the Blue Planet Divine Alliance who were unwilling to go to the battlefield, she was a real combatant and had always been on the Dark King Army’s must-kill list.
It could be said that although they were all super divines, she was definitely one of the super divines at the top of the World King Planet. As for the super divines of the five major god races on Blue Planet, they could only be considered local powerhouses.
The difference between the two parties was roughly equivalent to the difference between normal totems and totem half-gods. There were also strong and weak super divines.
Because of this, the Space Emperor was puzzled. Why would such a big shot look for him?
What exactly did Shi Yu… do outside?
“Lord Bing Ling… Shi Yu is indeed from the Floating Realm. May I ask… what happened?”
The Space Emperor asked carefully.
According to what he knew, Shi Yu was a person who never stopped.
If Shi Yu really caused something and involved a super divine level, it would be troublesome.
Of course, the Space Emperor really couldn’t imagine what trouble Shi Yu could cause.
Could it be that he could tear down the Environmental Protection Association like how he cracked the ruins? The Space Emperor had already worked very hard to let his imagination run wild.
“Naturally.”
“Floating Realm Master, you’ve done very well. You unearthed such a genius for the Environmental Protection Association,” Bing Ling said.
The Space Emperor was stunned.
Huh?
He had unearthed such a genius for the Environmental Protection Association?
She was talking about Shi Yu?
He thought for a moment. How could it be Shi Yu?
The Environmental Protection Association had always only taken in members who were experts at cleansing.
Did Shi Yu have it? Yes, he did. Shi Yu had contracted a Blue Sea Sprite condensed from the cleansing faith of the Blue Planet’s ocean…
But logically speaking, it couldn’t be because of this…
Although not every planet could condense a life form like the Blue Sea Sprite, there was a chance for such a race to be born on any planet above mid-level.
In the entire universe, although the races of Blue Sea Sprites needed to rely on the right time, place, and sharpness to condense, it was definitely not a small number.
In addition, such a faith god was only considered powerful on its planet. If it left its territory, its ability would decrease very much.
Therefore, the Space Emperor didn’t think that Shi Yu could alarm the super divine expert of the Environmental Protection Association headquarters by contracting only one Blue Sea Sprite.
Even the higher-ups of the Environmental Protection Association of the Blue Wave World probably wouldn’t take another look at Shi Yu because of the Blue Sea Sprite.
“Lord Bing Ling… What… do you mean?”
“The genius you’re talking about… is Shi Yu?” The Space Emperor was stunned.
“Looks like you don’t understand his situation,” Bing Ling said.
The Space Emperor was all ears.
He wanted to see what Shi Yu was up to again.
“Shi Yu of the Floating Realm passed the three-star purifier assessment in the Blue Wave Realm. Now, he has already become the vice president of the Blue Wave Realm Environmental Protection Association of the first-level realm.”
“His status is already equivalent to you, a second-level world overlord.”
“In his twenties, such an achievement isn’t bad.”
As soon as Bing Ling finished speaking, the Space Emperor immediately coughed.
He widened his eyes and looked at the World King Token in his hand in disbelief.
“What did you say???” At this moment, the Space Emperor completely suspected that his ears were spoilt and he had heard wrongly!
Damn it, he wanted Shi Yu to go to the Environmental Protection Association to get an identity card for the abyss pet. This kid directly became the vice president?
What a joke.
“Lord Bing Ling, how is this possible…” The Space Emperor still couldn’t believe it.
“Ha, congratulations.”
“The planet-level cleansing faith sprite he contracted successfully evolved into a cleansing star spirit.”
“Moreover, he has displayed extremely extraordinary talent. With his talent, he will come to the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association to be nurtured sooner or later. I’m informing you now only because I want to understand more from you and need your cooperation in doing some work.”
“Cleansing star spirit??” The Space Emperor’s brain rumbled when he heard that.
The Blue Sea Sprite evolved into a cleansing star spirit?
That cleansing star spirit ranked 77th among the races in the starry sky?
The Space Emperor naturally knew this heaven-defying race. They were known to have the strongest cleansing talent. Although their overall battle power wasn’t the strongest, against the Dark King Army, cleansing star spirits were definitely the strongest race.
The strongest experts of the Environmental Protection Association in the past had all been cleansing star spirits, and now, it was no exception.
However, why did Shi Yu’s Blue Sea Sprite evolve into a cleansing star spirit?
Planet faith god, cosmic faith god. This was on a completely different level!
The Space Emperor was shocked. If it was a cleansing star spirit, he finally understood why it would alarm the super divine experts of the Environmental Protection Association.
Such a race would definitely be nurtured by the Environmental Protection Association with all its might!
As long as the cleansing star spirit grew up, it would definitely be a general of the Environmental Protection Association.
“Yes, you understand now, right?”
“I understand…” The Space Emperor gritted his teeth.
Therefore, Shi Yu became the vice president of the Blue Wave World Environmental Protection Association??
The Blue Wave Domain was a first-level domain, and the world overlord was a super divine level. The status of the president of an official organization branch like the Environmental Protection Association was also stronger than that of an ordinary second-level domain overlord.
Therefore, with Shi Yu’s current status as the vice president and his identity as a three-star purifier, it was completely no problem for him to be on equal footing with ordinary second-level world overlords.

chapters.title: Chapter 1338 - 1338 Making Me Stronger (2)
chapters.content:
1338 Making Me Stronger (2)
At the thought that Shi Yu had caught up to the status he had worked hard for hundreds of years in the starry sky in less than a month, the Space Emperor felt that it was very ridiculous.
He felt that his life of chasing women, training in life and death, and cultivating hard had all been wasted.
Wasn’t Shi Yu an archeologist???
He thought that Shi Yu would become famous in the Cosmic Sea through the ruins of the archeological era in the future, but why didn’t the current situation follow his prediction?
To be honest, he felt that Shi Yu’s Chaos Panda, Green Dragon, World Destruction Dragon, and other pets were already ridiculous. He didn’t expect another cleansing star spirit to appear. This was the most ridiculous!
“That’s good,” President Bing Ling said.
“Floating Realm Master, the lives that walk out of your Blue Planet are really not simple.”
“If I’m not wrong, you’re planning to let your mother planet wander to the surroundings of the Cosmic Sea’s World King Planet, right?”
With the size of the Environmental Protection Association, they naturally knew that the Space Emperor, Lin Feng, and Blue Planet had the same mother planet.
So many geniuses had been born on an intermediate-level planet. Bing Ling didn’t believe that it was just an ordinary intermediate-level planet. Even if it was a high-level planet, there weren’t many ridiculous ones.
Now, she was quite interested in Blue Planet.
“Yes, Lord Bing Ling, we do have such a plan,” the Space Emperor said.
This wasn’t anything strange. Many experts who had successfully worked hard on World King Planet would guide their mother planet to the surroundings of World King Planet.
“Next, our Environmental Protection Association can provide some support and help to your mother planet relocation plan. What do you think?” Bing Ling said.
“It would naturally be best if we can obtain the help of the Environmental Protection Association,” the Space Emperor said with a cold expression.
In the starry sky of the universe, there were many dangers. A planet wandering was far more dangerous than sailing alone.
But if there was the protection of a large faction like the Environmental Protection Association, the risk would be reduced to the minimum!
The Space Emperor really didn’t expect that Shi Yu, Lin Feng, and the five god races would find another breakthrough in less than a month after coming to the World King Planet.
“Yeah.”
“I’ll personally follow up on the subsequent matters. In addition, Shi Yu will still be a member of your Floating Realm. He’s still too weak now. Before the divine level, I shouldn’t bring him to the headquarters, nor will I let him go to the battlefield.”
“I understand.” The Space Emperor said, “I’ll let Shi Yu train seriously during this period of time. He seems to have the intention to participate in the God Sealing Battle. Before the divine level, the Floating Realm will do its best to nurture him.”
Bing Ling said, “Perhaps… with his current ability, he can already obtain a large number of growth resources on his own. Therefore, you just have to protect him well first.”
“The God Sealing Battle is indeed a very good training venue. I’ll set a small goal for him first to get into the top 10 before advancing to the divine level.”
The Space Emperor was stunned. This was… him being Shi Yu’s bodyguard!
At the moment, although Shi Yu had huge potential, it was impossible for the Environmental Protection Association to lock Shi Yu up like a bird in a cage. After all, even if he was a genius, he would go to the battlefield sooner or later. However, Shi Yu was indeed too weak at the moment. It had to protect him.
It was impossible to send a super divine to protect him. A super divine was not so free. No matter how talented Shi Yu was, he wasn’t qualified to be protected by a super divine, and there weren’t many suitable candidates either. After thinking about it, with the Space Emperor who defeated a super divine expert above his level and was from Shi Yu’s hometown, he was undoubtedly the best candidate…
After all, Shi Yu’s subsequent growth would also be beneficial to the Floating Realm.
The Space Emperor would definitely spend much more effort to protect Shi Yu than others.
“Alright.” At this moment, after understanding the intention of the Environmental Protection Association, the Space Emperor nodded and admitted it.
Wasn’t it just being a bodyguard…
However, after hearing the small goal President Bing Ling mentioned, the Space Emperor hesitated. Shi Yu, in the top 10… who was she looking down on??
Although the cleansing star spirit wasn’t good at battle, Shi Yu didn’t just have this.
In his opinion, Shi Yu definitely had the potential to charge into first place. In a few years, this big shot of the Environmental Protection Association would definitely be extremely shocked!
Now… Sigh, he should personally go to Blue Wave World first.
The Space Emperor still couldn’t accept the change in identity.
Why was Shi Yu suddenly on equal footing with him?
No, according to the headquarters of the Environmental Protection Association, he had to protect Shi Yu well. This clearly valued Shi Yu more than a second-level world overlord like him…
The corners of the Space Emperor’s mouth twitched. Why don’t he let Lin Feng be Shi Yu’s bodyguard? The Space Emperor felt that Lin Feng was more free than him.
He was clearly more talented than him, but he didn’t know how to work hard. It was really ridiculous for him to travel leisurely all day. It was just right for him to be Shi Yu’s bodyguard. He could even help Shi Yu deduce the evolution path of the pet…
…
At the same time.
Shi Yu had already carried his bag and checked in.
He moved into the luxurious, mystic realm villa prepared by the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association for the vice president.
It was even more beautiful than his residence in Sky City.
A fresh cleansing aura filled every corner. Even if he cultivated some skunks and bugs here, it would probably be fragrant.
“Wuhu~” Shi Yu let out the little white dragon’s cry happily.
“Looks like… the reserved room is going to be rejected…” Ling’s clone, who had been on Shi Yu’s wrist, sighed slightly when it saw this. Therefore, plans couldn’t keep up with changes…

chapters.title: Chapter 1339 - 1339 Making Me Stronger (3)
chapters.content:
1339 Making Me Stronger (3)
Soon, in the room, Shi Yu was lying freely on the sofa. He glanced at Duckie, Susu, and the others in front of him and chuckled.
“Hehe, I didn’t expect to become the vice president just like that. Not bad. The vice president is also good. I probably just have to hold a position. There’s no need to be in charge like the president,” Shi Yu said as he stretched lazily.
“Ning, Ning!!” Susu jumped onto the table and waved left and right, showing off its ambitions and looking at the future, indicating that it was still not enough.
Its eyes lit up. They were the highest command of the Environmental Protection Department on Blue Planet. How could they be satisfied with a vice president of a branch here?
So when would he fight for the highest position, that of President of the Environmental Protection Association headquarters?
It looked at Shi Yu with starry eyes. As long as it added points and followed, it shouldn’t be a big problem!
“Quack!! Quack!!” Duckie reported to the big sister. If it wanted to plan this, it might need the clueless team’s turtle to be the military advisor.
This… it was very good at!
Duckie had already started to look forward to it.
At that time, it would let the turtle assist it and become the commander of the Dark King Army. Then, it would let the turtle assist Susu and become the president of the Environmental Protection Association.
Directly turning a cosmic battle into a civil war, wasn’t this more exciting than the God Sealing Civil War!
Shi Yu: “…?”
They might as well kill the two cosmic emperors, Dark King and World King!
“Wu wu wu.” After walking around, Eleven walked to Shi Yu and tugged at him. It drooled and had watery eyes. So it had become the vice president of the Environmental Protection Association. What good stuff was there?
For example, food that it had never seen before.
“I reckon that as for the Blue Wave World Environmental Protection Association, there will definitely be a lot of vegetables and fruits that cleanse the body and mind…” Shi Yu said, “As for bamboo, I can’t guarantee it…”
“Roar!!” Eleven expressed that it was fine. It felt that it had fallen too far behind recently.
Ever since its level became higher and it was inconvenient to undergo special training, it hadn’t made up for the hard work debt through adding points for a long, long time.
At the thought of this, Eleven couldn’t help but cover its eyes. It was determined to cleanse its lazy heart through this meal.
“Ning!” Susu frowned at the side, indicating that it could help Eleven cleanse.
“Wu wu wu! (No, it has to be cleansed by eating.)” Eleven argued reasonably.
“Ning! (You just want to eat different things.)” Susu saw through it at a glance.
“Quack!! Duck!!” Duckie nodded at the side, indicating that what Big Sister Susu said made sense!!
Eleven was stunned. Damn it, it was just a panda. Was it wrong to want to eat? Was it wrong?
Also, why didn’t Duckie respect it recently!!!
“Wu…” As the pets communicated, beside them, Shi Yu had already observed every corner of this mystic realm villa with his psychic power to understand this new home.
Then, he looked outside the villa.
A person was slowly coming over.
Who else could it be but President Xing Nan?
“Shi Yu, are you there?” Outside, when President Xing Nan walked over with a smile, she called out to Shi Yu.
“I’m here.” Shi Yu hurriedly went out to welcome her. He looked at the beautiful woman in a white cheongsam embroidered with pink peach patterns and felt that this president was a little similar to Legend Hua Xiajin.
“President, what’s wrong?”
“It’s nothing, I came to take a look. How is it? Are you satisfied with this place?”
“Very satisfied… Speaking of which, President Xing Nan, do you really want me to be the vice president of the Blue Wave Branch?” Shi Yu said in embarrassment.
“I’m afraid I don’t have much experience. After all, I just joined the Environmental Protection Association. Isn’t it a little inappropriate…”
Shi Yu mainly wanted to ask if he could only be the vice president and not work.
President Xing Nan smiled and said, “It’s just a vice president. The requirements aren’t that strict. With your current ability, no one can say anything. At most, you just need to carry out some missions to cleanse the pollution source regularly. This shouldn’t be a problem for you, right?”
Shi Yu said, “That’s not a problem.”
“Moreover, I’ve just contacted the headquarters. In fact, the moment Susu evolved into a cleansing star spirit, the headquarters sensed the birth of a new cleansing star spirit. If nothing goes wrong, the vice president of a branch is just your starting point. There will be a larger stage waiting for you in the future.”
“Therefore, you just have to treat this place as a stepping stone to train yourself.”
Cleansing star spirit…
Shi Yu looked at Susu. Therefore, although he had named Susu’s new race the Star Sea Sprite, in the eyes of the people on the World King Planet, its current race should be the cleansing star spirit.
Such a race didn’t seem to be unique in the universe, but it was still very strong.
Ranked 77th among the races in the starry sky… In the entire universe, it was already a very impressive number.
Eleven had always wanted to get a racial ranking, but it didn’t expect Susu to evolve in one go.
“Apart from that… is there nothing else I need to do?” Shi Yu asked.
President Xing Nan said, “There’s no need to do anything. You can do whatever you originally planned to do next. The headquarters seems to plan to invite you to work at the headquarters after you enter the divine level.”
“As for now, you just have to use the two identities of a three-star purifier and the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association to grow as soon as possible.”
“Use your advantage well. Your growth resources shouldn’t be lacking much.” After President Xing Nan followed Shi Yu into the room, she smiled and sat on the sofa.

chapters.title: Chapter 1340 - 1340 Making Me Stronger (4)
chapters.content:
1340 Making Me Stronger (4)
“Do you know why the Environmental Protection Association cares so much about cleansing star spirits? Why can every cleansing star spirit at least grow to a top-notch divine level, or even to a super divine level?”
“Yes!” President Xing Nan said, “Our World King Planet fights the Dark King Army under the Dark King all year round.”
“The soldiers of the Dark King Army are all from the Yun Race, the Yi Race, the Abyss Race, and the others you’re familiar with. These races are mobile pollution sources themselves. Not only will their power pollute life, but it will also pollute resources, planets, and the starry sky, and the pollution is very strong.”
“Therefore, a purifier is an indispensable profession on the World King Planet.”
“In every battle with the Dark King Army, we can seize many contaminated resources. These resources are basically handed to the purifiers to cleanse before being thrown into the market.”
“Some powerful purifiers will also be invited to cleanse the planet after the battle.”
“And the purifiers helping cleanse items aren’t free. They can charge a certain fee according to the difficulty of cleansing and then obtain benefits.”
“Although ordinary purifiers collect fees, they will also consume energy and need to be replenished. However, for the cleansing star spirit with unlimited cleansing power, no matter what it cleanses, there will be no substantial consumption at all. Therefore, the cleansing star spirits can obtain a large amount of remuneration through the cleansing work at all times.”
“Exchanging these rewards for growth resources, even if you use a pile of resources, the cleansing star spirit that isn’t good at battle can also obtain very strong battle power and increase to a very high level.”
“Now, you have the ability to cleanse the super divine pollution source. And do you know that I’m the only one in the entire Blue Wave World who has the ability to cleanse the super divine pollution source? Moreover, every cleansing requires a long time and a huge amount of consumption. Of course, the remuneration you can obtain every time is also very huge, but for you, there’s no need to consider all of this. Therefore, with just a little time, you can obtain a large number of divine-level resources. There’s no more cost-effective deal than this. Therefore, you know now how smooth your next path will be, right?” President Xing Nan said enviously.
Shi Yu understood. Wasn’t it just legal freeloading of the power of the starry sky to obtain excessive resources?
He often did similar things on Blue Planet!
