He was very familiar with it.
“The basic quests of the Environmental Protection Association are nothing to you. You can completely cleanse the pollutants continuously. This way, it’s equivalent to having an endless supply of resources.”
“Now that you’ve become a three-star purifier and the vice president of the Blue Wave Association, your greatest advantage is actually that you can legitimately come into contact with many divine and super divine level pollutants.”
At this moment, after hearing President Xing Nan’s words, Shi Yu’s eyes lit up as he looked at Susu.
Although he couldn’t use the Star Sea Contract to add points, it didn’t seem bad to be able to use the Star Sea Contract to cleanse the pollution source and obtain a large amount of rewards.
This was also part of maintaining the environment of the sea of stars!
“I’ll work hard.” Shi Yu was full of energy. He didn’t expect to find a job on the World King Planet so quickly.
It was a pity that Teacher Cat didn’t follow. This place was filled with opportunities. What was so fun about staying on Blue Planet?
“Ning!! Ning!!” Susu was also eager to give it a try. Daily cleansing of the pollution source was definitely a very boring job for other pets, but after Susu heard that, it was very excited.
Not only could it earn money to subsidize the family, but it could also protect the star sea environment. It could also take the opportunity to train its skill proficiency. It was simply killing three birds with one stone.
Why was she in such a hurry to tie Shi Yu to the Blue Wave Association through the position of vice president?
It was all because this way, the additional pollutants cleansed by Shi Yu could also be considered the performance of the Blue Wave Branch…
This way, the performance of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association wouldn’t be ranked at the bottom of the various environmental branches every year.
President Xing Nan and Shi Yu looked at each other. The two of them understood that this was a win-win situation.
President Xing Nan smiled. The other branches would probably be so envious that their mucus would flow out.
“Apart from that, there’s also this.” President Xing Nan took out a tool that looked like a crystal ball and said, “This is the cultivation method of the ‘Cleansing Enhancement Talent’ and the ‘Cleansing Hand’. I wonder if you’ve cultivated it.”
“No…” Shi Yu took a look and said after hesitation.
At the moment, he had only cultivated telepathy (Psychic Domain, Psychic Resonance), Space Strengthening Talent, Body Control Talent, Fusion Talent, Time Strengthening Talent. Well… Psychic Power could barely be considered one. After all, it could strengthen mental strength.
“I knew it,” President Xing Nan said. “The Cleansing Enhancement Talent can allow you to increase the strength of the pet’s cleansing skill. As for the Cleansing Hand, it can allow you to cultivate the cleansing ability yourself. If you encounter any powerful pollution source in the future that causes you to suffer a backlash through the contract, these things are life-saving abilities. There’s no harm in cultivating them.”
She put down the crystal ball, hoping that Shi Yu could wholeheartedly develop his purifier profession.

chapters.title: Chapter 1341 - 1341 Making Me Stronger (5)
chapters.content:
1341 Making Me Stronger (5)
“Well… If you have spare energy, it’s best to cultivate even the water-element strengthening talent.”
“Alright…” Shi Yu smiled bitterly. F*ck, why couldn’t the skill index give him more points?
Now that he had a pile of talent abilities and had to meditate, he already had a headache.
Why did he have to learn his Beast Taming Talent again after joining an Environmental Protection Association and becoming the vice president…
It looked like he had to quickly develop resources that could automatically cultivate…
Even if the success rate was extremely low, he had to deduce it for Baby Ginseng quickly. Otherwise, he couldn’t live like this anymore.
“I’ll take the time to cultivate.” Shi Yu took the crystal ball and said, “President Xing Nan, is there anything else you need?”
“Don’t worry, there are still some things to explain.”
“This is for you.” At this moment, President Xing Nan took out an identity card and said, “This is an identity card representing you as the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association. In the Blue Wave World, you can use it in many places. Take it and put it away.”
“At the same time, you can also use this identity card to log into the Environmental Protection Association’s official website and buy the resources you need.”
“As a three-star purifier, you should have a lot of initial cleansing points. With your current points, they should be enough for you to exchange for a resource that exceeds divine quality.”
“Really?” When President Xing Nan finished speaking, Shi Yu’s eyes immediately lit up. Didn’t he join the Environmental Protection Association for this?
“Yes.” President Xing Nan smiled and said, “But speaking of which, I noticed just now that you contracted a lot of pets, right?”
She looked at Eleven, Susu, Duckie, and even Ling’s clone on Shi Yu’s wrist.
“Yes,” Shi Yu said. “What’s wrong?”
“It’s nothing.” President Xing Nan smiled and said, “It’s just that this situation is very rare, but the world overlords of your Floating Realm are the same. It should be a tradition on your mother planet, right?”
“On World King Planet, there aren’t many Beast Tamers who contract multiple pets.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Well, it’s a tradition over there, but I still like this model.”
There were pros and cons to contracting multiple pets. For example, Shi Yu’s current Beast Taming Space could originally provide 100 growth nutrients to pets. If he only contracted Eleven, Eleven could enjoy these 100 growth nutrients alone or even more.
But now, only more than ten pets could split the 100 nutrients equally. Moreover, Beast Tamers had to prepare more growth resources. With one pet, it was too easy to drag down a Beast Tamer. However, Shi Yu had added points, so this impact was negligible.
Contracting so many pets with different abilities could increase his efficiency in adding points.
Moreover, it was too lonely to only contract one pet. Shi Yu had transmigrated himself and was an orphan to begin with. With so many pets contracted, they were considered his family. Naturally, it would be more lively if there were more of them.
As if he could tell that Shi Yu was very satisfied with the current model, President Xing Nan didn’t say much. She only smiled and said, “In that case, I won’t disturb you anymore. You can familiarize yourself first. Just look for me if you need anything.”
As a purifier, it was also good to contract two more pets. After all, pets that were experts in the power of cleansing were basically not very good at battle. Coupled with a pet that was an expert in battle, it was a perfect match.
“Lastly, if there’s nothing urgent, you can stay in the Blue Wave Realm for a longer time. The cultivation environment here is still relatively good compared to the Floating Realm. It’s more suitable for you to cultivate. I’ll talk to the Floating Realm Master about the Floating Realm,” President Xing Nan said before leaving.
“No problem,” Shi Yu said with a nod.
He originally planned to stay in the Blue Wave World for a while longer. The Environmental Protection Association was only one of his goals. Next, he still had to take the time to go to the Cosmic Disaster Research Institute to take a look and find a way to learn powerful skills there!
In addition, there were definitely more powerful lives and top-notch skills in the Blue Wave Domain than in the second-level Floating Realm. Shi Yu planned to replicate more Skills here to prepare for the God Sealing Battle ten months later.
Moreover, the God Sealing Battle could only be registered and participated in at the first-level domain. Next, he would probably spend more days in the Blue Wave Domain than in Sky City.
“President, I’ll send you off.” Then, after explaining what to do, President Xing Nan left.
After Shi Yu sent the other party away, he looked at the talent crystal ball and identity card sent by the other party and fell into deep thought.
“Sob, sob.” After the guest left, the pets became active again.
When Shi Yu heard the pets’ cries, he nodded.
“Ling, log onto the Environmental Protection Association’s official website and see what good things are here first.”
“Roger.” Ling’s main body gradually fused with its clone. After taking out the identity card, it projected a virtual screen in midair.
Then, Shi Yu, Eleven, Susu, Duckie, and the others widened their eyes and looked.
However, as he watched, he fell into deep thought.
“This isn’t bad…”
“That’s not bad either.”
“Why don’t I buy this first…”
“Quack!! (Quack wants this!!)”
Soon, Ling closed the projection and said, “Master, I suggest you deduce the skills you need first. Skill learning might involve a lot of materials. Think of what you need before you find resources, and your thoughts will be clearer than now. Otherwise, you guys… want everything.”
It sighed. Even if it was rich, it couldn’t help but be picky like this.
Shi Yu, who was leaning on the sofa, also had difficulty choosing. When he heard Ling’s words, he scratched his messy hair and looked at the evil talent crystal ball. He sighed.
“That’s true.”
“Let’s deduce the cultivation fruit first. The first Beast Taming Space is still quite far from Level 10, and the second Beast Taming Space hasn’t reached Level 9. There’s still a pile of talent that hasn’t been cultivated. Ah, it’s so annoying.”
Eleven shrugged.
Forgive it for being helpless and unable to cultivate for Shi Yu.
“Ning…” Susu also sighed.
Although Susu wanted to help Shi Yu cleanse his laziness, Shi Yu rejected it forcefully.
For Shi Yu, he would rather think of a way to rely on things like the cultivation fruit to take advantage of the situation than become a cultivation maniac. It was too scary.
Under Ling’s suggestion, the goal was to deduce the cultivation fruit first. Shi Yu immediately brought his pets to Little Zi’s inner world, the Star Continent.
Star Continent, Baby Ginseng Research Institute.
“Yiya…” Baby Ginseng, who was wearing a white coat, looked at the menacing Shi Yu with a cold expression.
Had this day finally come?
As expected, Shi Yu’s laziness was the best nutrition for its growth and strengthening.
Although the cultivation fruit might not be a battle skill, it should more or less be able to lead to its growth.
“Baby Ginseng, come, deduce the cultivation fruit,” Shi Yu said casually after arriving.
At the same time, he started to call his friends and pets who should be called over to support.
[Contract Pet]: Baby Ginseng
[Skill Effect]: It can create a special fruit that can allow the user to automatically meditate and cultivate without any burden when sleeping after eating it to increase the level of the Beast Tamer.
[Deduction success rate]: Extremely low
[Deduction Risk]: Extremely high
[Do you want to continue deducing?]
Shi Yu opened the Skill Deduction interface and looked at the skill he had dreamed of again. He swallowed his saliva. However, in order to pursue strictness, he tried a few more times.
For example, changing the practice of automatic meditation during sleep, which carried no load, to enhancing the level and talent of Beast Tamers during sleep.
Oh, the success rate was still extremely low!
For example, [Skill Effect]: It can create a special fruit that can allow the user to directly break through to the divine level after eating it.
But this time, the success rate was zero…
Shi Yu was speechless.
After continuous attempts, Shi Yu finally found the one with the highest cost-effective ratio.
Then, he steeled his heart and looked at Susu and Baby Ginseng. “Charge.”
As long as he succeeded, he, Shi Yu, would increase their points during the day and sleep at night. He would cultivate tirelessly all day and could even level up. He would definitely be invincible!
This was definitely a fruit that was more strategic than the World Tree Fruit which increased comprehension!
Moreover, it could definitely open a huge business market on World King Planet and make a bunch of rich second-generation heirs stomp their feet in surprise.
“Yi!!” “Ning!!” Baby Ginseng and Susu expressed that they should charge.
…
A long time later.
Shi Yu lay weakly in front of the Ginseng Baby Research Institute.
At the same time.
[Deduction successful]
[Exclusive Learning Method]: The first step is to choose the parents’ book [Time Fruit Clone] and [World Tree Fruit Clone] to prepare for hybridization. The parent plant must be produced by the learner himself. The second step… remove the males…
Baby Ginseng’s body tightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1342 - 1342 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (1)
chapters.content:
1342 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (1)
“Aba, Aba, Aba…”
To put it bluntly, the entire teaching content was to complete the cultivation of the cultivation fruit through the hybridization of the World Tree Fruit and the Time Fruit. The hybridization process also required the support of various top-notch resources such as memory water drop, azure starlight, and dense aura.
Although he felt that it was ridiculous, when he thought about it carefully, Shi Yu felt that there was still a scientific basis. To put it bluntly, the Cultivation Fruit was to let the body move and cultivate on its own. The Time Fruit that could obtain future power, the World Tree Fruit that could increase comprehension, and the memory water drop that could increase memory ability. When these things were mixed together, wouldn’t it be just nice for the body to form physical memories and cultivate on its own?
Amazing! After careful analysis, that was really possible, but the current pressure was on Baby Ginseng again. Shi Yu looked at the frowning Baby Ginseng. Many pets looked at the frowning Baby Ginseng. A moment later, Baby Ginseng’s expression was determined. In any case, suffering belonged to the clone. Let’s do it!
“Yi!!!” Baby Ginseng patted its chest, indicating that it would leave it to him. Wasn’t it just researching a new plant fruit? It wasn’t a big deal. With its rich experience in researching anti-teammate energy fruits, it was the best at this kind of thing. Now that it had even given the development steps, if it still couldn’t develop it, it wouldn’t be called a research ginseng.
“As expected of you. Fortunately, you attended many classes at Ancient Capital University…” Shi Yu’s eyes were filled with tears.
“Then you guys… work hard?” After the deduction was completed, Shi Yu temporarily didn’t want to care about the follow-up. His eyes were blurry as he said to Secretary Ling, “Ling, you can directly help buy resources from various channels if we don’t have them.”
“If you don’t have enough money or can’t find resources, tell me… Alright, I’m going to sleep first. During the sleep process, Baby Ginseng, Susu, don’t forget to continue healing me…” Shi Yu wasn’t very worried about these two points. It was fine if he lacked rare resources on Blue Planet, but if he didn’t even have them on World King Planet, he would definitely tear down the reputation of World King Planet, the center of the universe.
…
Following that, Shi Yu returned to the vice president’s exclusive, mystic realm villa and fell asleep. There were infusion vines on his body that flickered from time to time, looking very sick.
During this period, Secretary Ling began to silently search for the fertilizer needed for the cultivation fruit. Fortunately, the memory water drop could be created by Susu, so there was no need to find an additional place to buy it. However, seven to eight divine-level resources such as Illuminated Starlight and Enshrouding Breath weren’t cheap. Together, they were even more expensive than super divine resources with low quality. It couldn’t help but make Butler Ling black out.
Fortunately, it could be bought through the channels of the Environmental Protection Association, but unfortunately, not only was the large initial funds Shi Yu had just obtained after joining the Environmental Protection Association insufficient, but he might also have to pay for it out of his own pocket.
“Sigh~” Ling sighed. It looked at the team spending money like water and felt a little heartache. After all, it had yet to find materials to transform itself into a cosmic life form. If it didn’t become a cosmic life form, without the law cosmic storm, it couldn’t bring Shi Yu and the others to sail the starry sky. This was another large sum of money.
It felt that the initial funds Shi Yu obtained from Blue Planet and the Space Emperor might not necessarily all be invested in points. There were still many places to use it… From the looks of it, it had to let Susu work hard!
After an unknown period of time, Shi Yu was shaken awake by Ling. Shi Yu said vaguely, “What’s wrong? Is it time for dinner?”
The white Rubik’s Cube flew in midair. The white-haired loli on the screen said, “No! Senior Space Emperor is here. He’s outside.”
“Oh?? Senior Space Emperor is here?” Shi Yu gradually woke up and rubbed his eyes. However, he was still a little out of breath. After crawling up, he immediately ran to welcome the Space Emperor.
Outside the garden area, the Space Emperor sized up this luxurious mystic realm villa and shook his head secretly. Why didn’t he receive such good treatment when he first came to the universe? First, he was teleported to a war-torn planet and relied on the spatial advantage to survive the war. Then, he experienced thousands of difficulties and dangers and successfully arrived at the World King Planet. It took him another hundred years to stabilize himself…
Compared to the current Shi Yu, the Space Emperor couldn’t help but curse in his heart.
“Senior Space Emperor, why are you here?” Shi Yu asked in surprise after walking out.
“What do you think? You became a three-star purifier and even the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association. Such a big thing happened, and even the Floating Realm was alarmed. How can I not come and take a look?” The Space Emperor said after a moment of silence.
The Space Emperor felt that Shi Yu had benefited and was still pretending to be obedient. He couldn’t help but say, “Alright, I’ve already met and chatted with President Xing Nan. Next, you can cultivate in the Blue Wave World. This opportunity is rare. Seize it. If you become core figures of the Environmental Protection Association in the future, it will be hugely beneficial to Dong Huang and even the entire Blue Planet. Of course, the greatest beneficiary is still yourselves.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1343 - 1343 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (2)
chapters.content:
1343 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (2)
“I understand.” Shi Yu nodded and said, “I have the same intention. It’s also convenient to participate in the God Sealing Battle if I stay here for the time being.”
The Space Emperor smiled, but in the next moment, he looked at Shi Yu’s expression and said, “Why do you look so weak like Lin Feng?”
“Uh, is that so?” Shi Yu said. “Perhaps it’s because I consumed too much energy to use my Beast Taming ability… It’s alright, I’ll be fine in a while.”
The Space Emperor pondered for a moment. “It’s good that you’re fine. From the looks of it, you haven’t gone to the disaster research institute, right? Are you free now? I’ll bring you over to take a look. It’s just nice to meet an old friend of mine.”
“Yes.” Shi Yu was stunned and immediately said, “I indeed haven’t had time to go.”
“Alright, then follow me,” the Space Emperor said. Since Shi Yu wanted to stay in the Blue Wave World to cultivate, he had to personally ask these old friends to take care of Shi Yu more.
Soon, Shi Yu, who had packed up, followed the Space Emperor to the Space Disaster Research Institute of the Blue Wave Domain. The Space Disaster Research Institute was also an official organization similar to the Environmental Protection Association. There were all kinds of first-level domains. For the factions on the World King Planet, starry sky navigation was a common occurrence. This way, it was inevitable that they would encounter many cosmic disasters. As for how to avoid and crack these disasters, it was the research topic of a bunch of researchers from the Space Disaster Research Institute.
Generally speaking, many large factions would hire one or two disaster researchers to travel with them on interstellar voyages to avoid any accidents.
The Space Emperor and the director of the Space Disaster Research Institute of the Blue Wave World were friends. The reason why Zi Lan and the other five could successfully encounter the Starry Sky Storm and only one person died was because the other four successfully escaped the disaster. Apart from being lucky to be on the verge of the disaster, it was also because they had obtained much emergency equipment from the Space Disaster Research Institute before leaving.
…
In a technologically advanced white building complex in Blue Wave City, the Space Emperor and Shi Yu were waiting outside the door. Eleven lay on Shi Yu’s shoulder and looked around. Ling, who had turned into a bracelet, was also paying attention to its surroundings at all times.
It knew that if it wanted to obtain strength next, the opportunity might be here. Perhaps the mechanical materials needed to transform itself into a cosmic mechanical life form could only be bought here. After looking at the channels of the Environmental Protection Association in Sky City, Ling wasn’t very satisfied.
“Wang Kong…” Shi Yu and the others didn’t wait long. Soon, in the research institute building complex, a middle-aged man in a white coat with a brown mustache walked out. He laughed and said, “Old Wang, why are you suddenly free to come to my side?”
“Old Lei, can’t I come and see you?” The Space Emperor smiled and said, “I didn’t disturb you, right?”
“Of course not, but you definitely didn’t just come to see me, right?” The Western-looking middle-aged man named Old Lei looked at Shi Yu and said, “He’s the junior you contacted me previously and said that he wanted to send him to my research institute to study for a period of time?”
“Yeah,” the Space Emperor said. “His name is Shi Yu.”
Shi Yu said, “Hello, Dr. Lei Nuo.”
Dr. Lei Nuo smiled and said, “Hello, Wang Kong, didn’t you say that he would come over himself? Why did it become you bringing him over again?”
The Space Emperor said helplessly, “Plans can’t keep up with changes…”
“Let’s talk inside,” Dr. Lei Nuo invited. “I’ve prepared drinks and snacks.”
“Alright.” The Space Emperor nodded. Then, the three of them walked into the research institute. After arriving at the luxurious living room, they chatted again.
“We haven’t seen each other for more than ten years, right? Speaking of which, who is this person to you?” Dr. Lei Nuo sat in his seat with his legs crossed. He blew the magma water, and looked at the Space Emperor and Shi Yu.
“You guys drink too. Drink more magma. It’s good for your body.”
Shi Yu looked at the red, unknown liquid on the table. He could confirm that this wasn’t the magma he understood. It should really be drinkable?
“A genius junior fetched from the mother planet,” the Space Emperor said.
Dr. Lei Nuo said in surprise, “You guys succeeded.”
“But little kid, how did you think of coming to the disaster research institute to study? It’s not that easy to study here.”
Shi Yu said cautiously, “Dr. Lei Nuo, I’ve been very playful since I was young. I like to travel everywhere and have the dream of traveling to every corner. After coming out of my mother planet, I was even infinitely curious about the starry sky of the universe and wanted to start a new trip in the starry sky of the universe. However, the universe is really too dangerous. I understand that messing around without a certain foundation is no different from tempting fate. Therefore, my dream is to first become an outstanding cosmic disaster researcher. Well, with my pet.”
The Space Emperor fell into deep thought at the side. So, this was the reason why Shi Yu wanted his pet to learn the Starry Sky Storm? As an archeologist, Shi Yu indeed had to go to archeology. Perhaps Shi Yu had seen the genius of the Kirin Race die in the Starry Sky Storm and had the thought of understanding the cosmic disaster first?
So that was the case. At this moment, the Space Emperor was actually a little gratified. At least, Shi Yu wasn’t a reckless person who ignored danger. He knew that it was very good to be afraid of the universe. It could greatly increase his survival rate.
“Haha, I see.” At this moment, when Dr. Lei Nuo heard Shi Yu’s dream, he also smiled and said, “Because we like to travel everywhere and are filled with endless curiosity about the cosmic starry sky, we want to become an outstanding cosmic disaster researcher first? I have to say, your train of thought is right. Our cosmic disaster researcher is an indispensable member of the cosmic fleet of the various realms.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1344 - 1344 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (3)
chapters.content:
1344 I Have a Hundred Million Dreams (3)
“Alright, Old Wang, then I’ll help you. He can stay here and be a trainee disaster researcher first. However, I can’t guarantee that he can teach it how much useful knowledge he can obtain in the end. It still depends on his own hard work.”
“Uh…” Dr. Lei Nuo was stunned and revealed a difficult expression. Even if he and the Space Emperor had gone through life-and-death, this kind of thing indeed didn’t follow the rules. The information was alright, but some high-level research authority couldn’t be touched casually. If there was an experimental accident, not to mention juniors like Shi Yu, even divine-level experts like them would have to die!
“No, this is a matter of principle,” Dr. Lei Nuo rejected.
“Unless.”
“The mechanical pet he contracted has mastered transcendent super intelligence.”
The Space Emperor was stunned and looked at Shi Yu. He knew that Shi Yu had contracted a mechanical pet, but he didn’t know if Shi Yu’s mechanical pet had transcendent super intelligence.
However, the Space Emperor knew the founder of the mechanic class on Blue Planet, Legendary Z, and the second Mechanical Legendary, Divine Source. The super intelligence they mastered was also a step away from the transcendent level, so the possibility of Shi Yu having it… shouldn’t be high.
Mechanical intelligence skills were very difficult to increase in proficiency. It was much more difficult to increase than battle-type and support-type skills of the same level. The difficulty of increasing them was only inferior to the time-type. After all, such skills could bring too much help to contractors and were suitable for various industries. Moreover, there were no natural races in the mechanic class that had to be nurtured from scratch.
Therefore, transcendent-level super intelligence was comparable to a quasi-divine skill in the universe.
Quasi-divine-level intelligence was comparable to real divine skills with high proficiency in other functions.
As for mechanical lives with perfect divine-level intelligence, their status on World King Planet wasn’t much inferior to other super divine level life forms.
“Kid, what level has its intelligence level reached?” After Dr. Lei Nuo saw a listless black and white panda hanging on Shi Yu’s shoulder, although he was a little suspicious of his identity as a mechanical genius, he also noticed the mechanical life form in Shi Yu’s hand.
At least… there were still mechanical pets.
“Shi Yu, is it enough for the conditions Dr. Lei Nuo mentioned?” the Space Emperor also asked.
Shi Yu fell into deep thought and said, “It’s enough. Moreover, it far exceeds it.”
Dr. Lei Nuo was stunned.
At that moment, Shi Yu raised his wrist slightly, and in the next instant, a holographic projection-like figure appeared. It was an ethereal being dressed in a shipgirl outfit, a girl-like mechanical spirit with long white hair tied into a ponytail that hung naturally, and a single strand of hair sticking up from the top of her head.
After the mechanical spirit, Ling, which was the size of a figurine and only revealed the upper half of its body, appeared, it opened its blue eyes and said, “Dr. Lei Nuo, I’m Master’s mechanical assistant.”
“Oh, oh…” When Dr. Lei Nuo saw Ling, his eyelids suddenly twitched.
As expected, in the next moment, Ling, who continued to talk, began to stimulate Dr. Lei Nuo’s heart with every word. Ling said, “At the moment, I’ve mastered the prototype of a divine skill in high-level computational deduction laws. In the state of the mechanical spirit, I also have almost divine-level mechanical control, so it’s completely no problem for me to participate in the disaster research.”
The prototype of a divine-level mechanical control ability!
After Ling finished reporting, Dr. Lei Nuo was stunned. He suddenly got up and looked at Shi Yu, Ling, and the Space Emperor.
“Is this for real?”
“Are you sure?”
It wasn’t easy to calculate the prototype of a divine skill, and it was a high-level quality. At the moment, he was the only one in the huge Blue Wave World’s Space Disaster Research Institute who had mastered divine-level intelligence. Shi Yu’s mechanical pet’s intelligence level was no longer inferior to those high-level mechanic researchers.
Moreover, it was the prototype of a divine skill combination of divine-level mechanical control and divine-level intelligence?
At this moment, the Space Emperor was also stunned. He looked at Shi Yu in surprise. Wait a minute, did Shi Yu’s mechanical pets all have the prototype of divine-level intelligence?? Why did it exceed the founder of the Blue Planet’s Mechanic class by two large versions!
Shi Yu was also silent at the side. Wasn’t this all thanks to the skill fusion…
“Wait, I remember that it’s still… the Kirin Beast?” the Space Emperor said.
“Yes, apart from that, I also have the prototype of a high-level divine skill of luck that can increase my research success rate greatly. The combination of the Wind of Blessing and the mechanical spirit can allow me to have research abilities comparable to divine-level intelligence. This is my current basic configuration. Dr. Lei Nuo, don’t worry. We’ll study hard and improve every day,” Ling said seriously and obediently.
In order to prove its words, a wisp of wind of luck condensed in front of it. At the same time, its finger pointed at the nomological ripples. In the next moment, the nomological ripples disintegrated and reconstructed, turning into dense data codes.
Shockingly enough, it could spy on the calculation, analysis, and deduction ability on the law level!
If not for this ability, Ling wouldn’t have been able to help Little Ji master the prototype of a top-notch law through mechanical modification.
This scene made Dr. Lei Nuo, who was beside him, open his mouth slightly and be even more shocked.
“It’s actually true…”
A mechanical life form that had mastered a high-level divine skill of luck and had the prototype of a divine-level intelligence? What kind of ridiculous configuration was this? He looked at the Space Emperor and said, “Old Wang, you’re serious.”
“Do you really plan to let them learn from me??”
He knew that it had only been more than 100 years since his old friend’s mother planet developed someone from the mechanic class. He didn’t have much hope for the mechanic geniuses on this planet at all.
But at this moment, Dr. Lei Nuo could be said to be completely stunned.
With this talent potential, forget about here, even if he went to the headquarters of the Space Disaster Research Institute to further his studies, many doctors stronger than him would fight to take him in as an assistant.
“Isn’t it because I trust you, Old Lei?” At this moment, after hearing Shi Yu’s mechanical pet configuration, the corners of the Space Emperor’s mouth twitched. He knew about the Wind of Blessing, but he really didn’t know about the prototype of divine-level intelligence. And when these two skills were combined, even if they couldn’t compare to the super combination divine skill of the cleansing star spirit, they wouldn’t be much inferior.
Ridiculous. Shi Yu was actually really a seedling of a genius researcher?
“…Cough, cough.” At this moment, Shi Yu was also smiling awkwardly and politely at the side. So, could they come into contact with the disaster simulation device here? It was quite urgent!
“Alright, since you don’t mind, I won’t be polite. Shi Yu, right? Learn well. I’ll do my best to teach you all my abilities. As long as you can learn them, it won’t be a problem to let you be deputy directors. Haha,” Dr. Lei Nuo said happily under the Space Emperor’s extremely strange expression.
Moreover, it was a genius with corresponding dreams. That was even rarer.
Genius mechanics were easy to find, but genius mechanics with the “dream” of becoming outstanding cosmic disaster researchers weren’t easy to find!

chapters.title: Chapter 1345 - 1345 Sword Bird (1)
chapters.content:
1345 Sword Bird (1)
[Can you not make promises with deputy directors and vice presidents all the time?]
[Even if you want to rope in geniuses, you can’t rope them in like this, right!]
As Dr. Lei Nuo was excited, the Space Emperor beside him couldn’t help but mutter in his heart.
Shi Yu’s advancement was so fast that it would make him, a senior, look very embarrassed.
When the large group from Blue Planet arrived at World King Planet and asked around…
“What?! Shi Yu surpassed the Space Emperor in a month after coming to the World King Planet?”
Even if he didn’t care, what would the juniors of the Wang family think…
“Then Dr. Lei Nuo, thank you for the next period of time.” At this moment, after confirming that he had joined the disaster research institute, Shi Yu was also quite happy.
Very good, this way, he would have another big shot supporting him.
Even if after that, he immorally included all the top 10 of the God Sealing Battle. If someone didn’t like him, they would also take into account these official organizations…
Unfortunately, the person in charge of the disaster research institute wasn’t a rich woman, but an uncle…
“No problem, I wonder what your thoughts are,” Dr. Lei Nuo said.
After Shi Yu and Ling looked at each other, Shi Yu said, “I heard from Senior Space Emperor that the Space Disaster Research Institute has the ability to simulate cosmic disasters…”
“We have an idea. If we can proficiently simulate disasters and ‘master disaster skills’, won’t we not have to worry about encountering disasters in the universe…”
“Before we came to the research institute, we were researching how to learn the ‘Starry Sky Storm’ Skill, but we’ve never had a clue, so we hope to find some inspiration in the disaster research institute.”
“This…” Dr. Lei Nuo was stunned. He was stunned. What, they still wanted to study and learn the Starry Sky Storm?
He had a strange expression and said, “Is that really what you think?”
“Is there anything wrong?” Shi Yu asked.
Dr. Lei Nuo laughed and said, “Not bad, your dream isn’t bad, and you’re ambitious. There’s nothing wrong with that. However, let me tell you, this is very difficult.”
“Ever since our Space Disaster Research Institute was established, there are very few people who can control ‘space disasters’ to a certain extent. Generally speaking, if you master a ‘disaster’, you will have the qualifications to compete for the director of the Space Disaster Research Institute.”
“Not a branch like the Blue Wave World, but the chief of the research headquarters.”
“At the moment, among the nearly 200 disaster research institutes, there are less than ten researchers who have mastered a ‘disaster’. They are all famous gods in the academic and mechanical worlds, so you know the difficulty.”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “This is more interesting. Dr. Lei Nuo, I wonder what disasters the Blue Wave Research Institute can simulate.”
Dr. Lei Nuo said, “You came to the right place. I’m mainly researching the Starry Sky Storm. Although I’m also involved in other disasters, my profession has specializations and I’m greedy. At the moment, the simulation environment of the Starry Sky Storm is the closest to a real disaster in the Blue Wave Research Institute. It’s fine to not talk about anything else. If you want to involve yourself in the future, I can take you to the headquarters or other research institutes to study.”
“Starry Sky Storm…” Shi Yu said, “No problem. We happen to want to study this too.”
While Shi Yu did have an interest in studying various phenomena like black holes, white holes, cosmic tides, and the chilling silence, he knew it would be unwise to spread himself too thin. First, he wanted to tackle the cosmic storm before delving into the rest.
After nibbling this down, he would definitely have a status in the disaster research institute. At that time, it might be easier to directly flirt with other gods who had mastered disasters and directly replicate skills.
“Looks like your communication is pretty smooth.” The corners of the Space Emperor’s mouth twitched. “In that case, I’m relieved.”
“Of course.” Dr. Lei Nuo smiled and looked away. With such a genius assistant, who knew how much the research progress of the Blue Wave Research Institute could increase.
After all, even he hadn’t been able to control the Starry Sky Storm. His progress hadn’t even reached the 60% passing slot line. If he could study it with Shi Yu and gain something, it would be their achievement.
Although he was already a famous researcher, he wouldn’t underestimate such a newbie with really huge potential. Which big boss hadn’t come from the newbie stage?
Even now, he was still surprised. How did Shi Yu nurture such a genius mechanical assistant? Contracting a mechanic was different from contracting other races. On World King Star, the other gods were born into divine-level races. There were many who had multiple quasi-divine skills.
However, there was no such thing as a natural god in the mechanic class. They were all postnatural races. Even the best mechanical life forms only had super skills when they were just born. They didn’t have divine-level intelligence from birth. Any divine skill had to be slowly upgraded the day after tomorrow, so this was also why divine-level intelligence was so rare.
It could be said that in the beginning, mechanical-type pets relied on mechanics to nurture the most. At the same time, after growing up, they were also the race that could help Beast Tamers the most.
Dr. Lei Nuo estimated that Shi Yu had probably spent a lot of effort to nurture such a divine-level mechanical assistant… Shi Yu was so young, so he had probably devoted 99% of his time to mechanic research…
“By the way, Old Lei, let me remind you one last time. If there’s any research that spends a lot of time, it’s best to communicate with Shi Yu in advance. He’s also a three-star purifier of the Environmental Protection Association, the vice president of the Blue Wave Environmental Protection Association. The Environmental Protection Association also takes him very seriously. I’m afraid that you’ll take up too much time here and the Environmental Protection Association will be quite dissatisfied. It won’t be good if President Xing Nan comes to find trouble with you again, haha,” the Space Emperor added. He was very worried that the Disaster Research Institute and the Environmental Protection Association would fight in the direction of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1346 - 1346 Sword Bird (2)
chapters.content:
1346 Sword Bird (2)
This situation wasn’t rare. Even a school and a professional could snatch outstanding students, let alone organizations like the Disaster Research Institute and the Environmental Protection Association…
“No problem. I’ve always…” Dr. Lei Nuo agreed with a smile, but suddenly, his smile stopped. He widened his eyes and looked at the Space Emperor, Shi Yu, and the others in shock, even more so than when he learned that Ling had mastered the prototype of a divine-level intelligence.
“Pfft… What did you say?!!”
…
Next, Shi Yu’s cultivation life in the Blue Wave Domain officially began. With the goal of the God Sealing Battle, Shi Yu planned to let Ling learn from the Disaster Research Institute first and undergo its own upgrade and modification to become a cosmic life form that could adapt to the cosmic storm.
As for Susu, it helped cleanse the pollution source to earn money from the Environmental Protection Association and buy resources to feedback to the entire team.
In addition, Baby Ginseng was developing the cultivation fruit. As for Shi Yu himself, he planned to temporarily lean the cultivation focus on Eleven and Chi Tong.
Although their current pile of skills was very powerful, they would definitely be stronger after fusion.
However, before that, Shi Yu first taught the skills he had replicated in the arena to his pets.
The quasi-divine skills [Sun Disaster] and [Sun Meteorite] were taught to Little Ji.
Moreover, after fusing [Clear Sky] into the [Sun Disaster], nothing happened.
After fusing the [Super Heavy Sword] into the [Gravity Control], nothing happened.
Only when it fused the [Space Splitting Sword] into the [Sun Meteorite] did some changes happen.
The [Sun Meteorite] skill had been fused and upgraded to the [Sun Meteorite Sword]. The original effect of the Sun Meteorite was to burn its life force and create a weapon that fell from the sun. Now, it had become that if the condensed weapon was a sword-type arms, its power would slightly increase compared to other Arms.
At this point, Little Ji’s skill page became even richer, directly possessing five quasi-divine skills!
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Lava Explosion (transcendent), Gravity Control (transcendent)
“Quasi God-level”: Cataclysm (Expert+11), Earth Control (Proficient), Destruction Body (Proficient), Sun Meteorite Sword (Initiate), Sun Disaster (Initiate)
After that, Shi Yu threw Little Ji to the side and let it fight Duckie.
Although the two of them still had a few super skills that had yet to be raised to the quasi-divine skill stage and the quasi-divine skills weren’t at their peak, Shi Yu had already invested a lot of energy in them recently.
It was time to increase the battle power of Eleven, Buggy, Chi Tong, and the others in Team One. As for Little Ji and Duckie, he would care about them in the end…
Then, Shi Yu taught Eleven the four light-element quasi-divine skills that he had replicated: [Lightspeed Fist], [Holy Light Divine Healing], [Light Interlocking], and [Star God Cannon].
Moreover, it successfully fused the four skills into a high-level quasi-divine skill, [Light Control].
This way, Eleven’s battle power increased greatly again.
However, teaching six quasi-divine skills in a row and undergoing skill fusion made Shi Yu’s already undesirable state even worse…
Of course, this wasn’t the most important thing. Most importantly, the development resources of the cultivation fruit Ling bought had finally arrived today. This made Shi Yu a little sad. This was good. When he developed the cultivation fruit and slept later, he finally didn’t have to waste time. He could automatically cultivate!
The person who sent the resources this time was still someone he knew. It was President Xing Nan.
This was because after Ling bought it, the goods weren’t sent to them for a long time, almost making Shi Yu anxious to death. Only then did he ask President Xing Nan to see what was going on.
Outside the mystic realm villa, President Xing Nan came to visit.
“Shi Yu, the resources you want have arrived.”
“Sorry for the wait. There are a few things that the Blue Wave World doesn’t produce, and the place of production isn’t close to the Blue Wave World. However, its speed is indeed a little slow. If there’s such a thing next time, just tell me.”
“It’s alright, it’s good that you’re here. Thank you, President Xing Nan.” After Shi Yu received President Xing Nan, he took the package gratefully. At this moment, President Xing Nan asked curiously, “Did you buy these with your initial points? They seem to be resources to nurture cultivation spiritual plants?”
“You also have research in this area?”
Shi Yu smiled and said, “Yes, I’ve studied it a little…”
“I didn’t expect it.” President Xing Nan smiled and said, “I have a pretty good relationship with the president of the Plant Association of the Blue Wave Realm. If you have any problems, I can introduce you to him. Because the master of the Blue Wave Realm is a plant-element super divine life form, our realm’s attainments in this aspect are also at the top of many first-level realms. The basic problems should be able to help you solve them…”
“If I have any difficulties, I’ll look for you immediately,” Shi Yu said. Plant Association… He knew that to put it bluntly, it was an official association established by the plant races on World King Planet. It was mainly in charge of the research of the spiritual plants and divine plants on World King Planet. At the moment, more than 90% of the rare divine fruits and special plant-type resources on World King Planet were cultivated here.
“Alright… But don’t forget to cultivate.” Before leaving, President Xing Nan didn’t forget to remind Shi Yu to cultivate his cleansing ability…
She had also received orders from President Bing Ling at the headquarters to nurture Shi Yu well.
If Shi Yu went to the headquarters and she didn’t have any cleansing ability, she would definitely be held accountable…
“…” After President Xing Nan bid farewell, Shi Yu immediately gave the pile of fertilizer he had bought to Baby Ginseng. Why would he ask the Plant Association for help? He would put it away first. With the skill teaching process, Baby Ginseng shouldn’t be stuck in research and not be able to produce cultivation fruits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1347 - 1347 Sword Bird (3)
chapters.content:
1347 Sword Bird (3)
“Yi!!” Outside the Baby Ginseng Research Institute, after obtaining the feed resource, Baby Ginseng was full of energy. It turned around and started working.
He took a look. Eleven’s pile of skills didn’t have a very high success rate of fusion. Now, Baby Ginseng and Susu should focus on work and couldn’t invest most of their energy in healing him.
He didn’t successfully develop the cultivation fruit either. In his weak state, most of his time would be wasted. Therefore, it was better to fuse it with Eleven after Baby Ginseng succeeded.
On Chi Tong’s side, the success rate of fusion of its pile of skills wasn’t very low.
Therefore, Shi Yu planned to fuse the skill for Chi Tong first.
[Chi Tong]
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Interlocking Sword, Sun Flame, Spirit Release, Flame Spirit Sword Body, Myriad Sword Convergence, Phoenix Sword Intent, Star Fire Sword Formation, Curse Flame, Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, Soul Guiding, Sun True Body
“Quasi Divine-level”: Immortal Slaying Sword Formation
[Taught Skill]
“Advanced”: Scapegoat
“Super Level”: Undead Revival, Soul Incarnation
Chi Tong and Eleven were undoubtedly good embryos. They both had skills above super level. One could imagine how powerful these two guys would become after fusing them.
“Are you ready?” Shi Yu looked at the mini sword spirit in his hand and said.
“Mi!!” Chi Tong maintained its sword spirit form and nodded heavily. Although it had many skills, its compatibility was quite high, unlike Eleven, who had various stats such as metal, wood, water, fire, earth, spiritual space, wind, lightning, light, darkness, and darkness. It was messy, and there was no way to fuse it.
“Then let’s do it.” Shi Yu grinned.
[Skill]: Sun Flame, Phoenix Sword Intent, Star Fire Sword Formation, Vermillion Bird Divine Fire, Sun True Body, Soul Incarnation
[Fusion success rate]: Medium
[Fusion Risk]: Medium
Fusion in progress…
[Fusion successful]
[Skill]: Vermillion Bird Clone
< Introduction > Possesses undying faith and self-preservation. The Vermillion Bird clone feeds on the power of the star and masters the sun divine power that can burn stars. The Vermillion Bird Feather can transform into the Vermillion Bird Sword Intent that can cut down stars. Any ability mastered by the Vermillion Bird clone can be strengthened by the power of faith!
Boom!!!
As soon as the skill was successfully fused, the sun flames that filled the sky immediately wrapped around Chi Tong. This fusion didn’t consume much Shi Yu’s strength because the Vermillion Bird clone didn’t have any ridiculous abilities compared to those materials skills.
It was just that compared to the clone he directly created previously, the essence of its life was closer to the Vermillion Bird. Its attributes and potential in various aspects were stronger.
If it was said that the previous Vermillion Bird clone and the current Vermillion Bird clone were fighting for the power of faith of the Vermillion Bird at the same time, then the winner would definitely be the current Vermillion Bird clone.
The current Vermillion Bird clone would also have a higher use of the power of faith. This was very useful on World King Planet. It could save Shi Yu a lot of money. If it were the Vermillion Bird Civil War, Chi Tong’s Vermillion Bird clone wouldn’t be suppressed by the bloodlines of other Vermillion Birds.
“Jiu, Mi!!!” The Sun Flame dissipated. In the sky in front of Shi Yu, a mini Vermillion Bird flew around with a sword in its mouth. It was Chi Tong’s Vermillion Bird clone and main body.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh…
The Vermillion Bird clone flew in the sky and turned into a Sword Bird. It felt that if it used the Vermillion Bird Sword Skill in this state, the combination of the two swords would be even stronger.
Using the Interlocking Sword as a container, it integrated the Vermillion Bird Sword Intent and…
Chi Tong was stunned in midair. It realized that there didn’t seem to be any other skills that matched the Vermillion Bird’s sword intent.
“So, it’s not over yet. Don’t be anxious. We’ll come again after I rest.” Shi Yu stretched out his hand and recalled Chi Tong, letting it land in his hand again to plan the next round of fusion.
…
[Skill]: Spirit Release, Curse Flame, Soul Guiding, Flame Spirit Sword Body, Scapegoat, Undead Revival
[Fusion success rate]: Low
[Fusion Risk]: High
Therefore, Shi Yu said that if he liked Chi Tong, be it the previous Vermillion Bird skill or the current undead skill, the compatibility was extraordinary.
“Jiumi~”
After the Vermillion Bird clone and Chi Tong’s main body said that they were ready at the same time, Shi Yu directly fused!
Fusion in progress…
A long time later.
[Fusion successful]
[Skill]: Death Control
[Level]: Quasi-divine level
< Introduction > It’s in charge of the laws of death and transforms into a death god.
As soon as the fusion ended, not only Chi Tong, but Shi Yu also instantly sank into the world of death until a wisp of death flames was ignited.
The Flame of Death burned all life.
Undead Puppet, Scapegoat.
It could turn undead into nutrients for its own growth, deprive the power of the living and turn them into undead. It could also revive the dead and turn them into creatures.
In the hellish space, Chi Tong slowly opened its eyes and turned into the Death God. The death power that appeared on its body seemed to be able to create an undead disaster at any time.
As soon as this skill fused, Chi Tong’s main body directly underwent a small evolution again. First was the sword in the mouth of the Vermillion Bird clone. Immediately, the power of death spread, turning into a black sword embroidered with fire stripes and into the sword of the Death God.
Secondly, after transforming into the form of a Sword Maiden, Chi Tong’s image also changed completely. The silver armor turned into a black shirt that fluttered in the wind. A black sword was held at its waist, and Chi Tong under its red hair was filled with the charm of death.
“Jiu…” After the Vermillion Bird clone landed on the Sword Maiden’s shoulder, Chi Tong turned to look at Shi Yu and smiled. It said telepathically: “It feels pretty good.”
“Not bad… You’ve become a big sister who can scare children to tears.” Shi Yu sat on the ground and supported his body with both hands. He looked at the even more slender Death God Chi Tong and immediately grinned. Baby Ginseng, Susu, Ling, and the others beside him also blinked at the Death God Chi Tong.
Death Law! Death Control!
Just like the law of life, it was a law divine skill with very extraordinary value. This time, it felt comfortable.
[Race Skill]
“Super Level”: Interlocking Sword (transcendent), Myriad Sword Convergence (transcendent)
“Quasi Divine-level”: Immortal Slaying Sword Formation (Proficient), Death Control (Proficient), Vermillion Bird Clone (Proficient)
In an instant, Chi Tong’s skills immediately became fewer and stronger. Shi Yu said excitedly, “Death and Fire. I still have spatial control here. I’ll teach you later. When the time comes, I’ll replicate another metal control divine skill and see if you can learn it.”
“At that time, with the four quasi-divine skills as fuel and the fusion of the Interlocking Sword, the strengthened Immortal Slaying Sword Formation will definitely be stronger.”
[Alright!!] Chi Tong returned to its Sword Bird form and was very excited. It could finally become stronger!!
“Speaking of which, have Eleven and Buggy set off?” At this moment, Shi Yu suddenly noticed that Eleven wasn’t here. From telepathy, it seemed to be very far away. He couldn’t help but ask.
Ling said, “Yes, Eleven has already set off.”
There was an entrance to participate in the ranking battle of all races in the Blue Wave World. Eleven planned to give it a try before the skill fused to see the strength comparison before and after the strengthening.
Eleven felt that it was no longer a child and didn’t need to trouble Shi Yu for such a small matter. Therefore, it reported and set off on its own, letting Shi Yu and the others wait for the good news…
However, Buggy was worried about Eleven, so it accompanied it.
…
Blue Wave City.
“Wu wu wu!”
A panda cub carrying a backpack and a Green Silkworm on its shoulder looked at the city in front of it and swallowed its saliva. It, Wang Eleven, was here in the ranking battle of all races!
“Ji ji!!! (Eleven, all the best. Beat it until the sky darkens and do the tribulation of the myriad races in the starry sky!!)” Buggy cheered for Eleven.

chapters.title: Chapter 1348 - 1348 Ranking Battle of All Races (1)
chapters.content:
1348 Ranking Battle of All Races (1)
On World King Planet, there were too many competitions of various sizes. There were even many large competitions of a starry sky nature.
It was organized by the Starry Sky Myriad Races Committee. At all times, it was a peak battle between races in the various first-level realms.
The lowest threshold for participation was the quasi-divine level, which was the totem level. The upper limit of the participation level wasn’t capped.
Among them, the venue of the Myriad Race Ranking Battle in the Blue Wave World was in the Myriad Region of Blue Wave City. After Eleven and Buggy spent a lot of effort to come here, they looked around like country people entering the city.
“Wu wu wu.”
“Ji ji.”
Eleven and Buggy realized that there were too many cosmic life forms everywhere in this area without humans following them.
They didn’t seem to be a strange combination?
One moment, a Space Tree Spirit walked past, and the next moment, a kobold with a gun in its pocket walked past, making Eleven and Buggy especially curious.
As expected of a place for the ranking battle of all races.
The two of them looked at each other and started to head to the registration venue.
…
“Excuse me, do you need any help?” Fang Qin looked at the short black and white Bear Race in front of her and the Green Silkworm hanging on its shoulder and asked.
She was a student who had graduated from the Blue Wave Academy and was currently interning at the Myriad Races Committee… Her job content was to help the new races register for the Myriad Race Ranking Battle.
At this moment, although Eleven, who was more than a meter tall, and the even smaller Buggy looked pretty strange, her good professional attitude still made her speak very respectfully.
Although it looked strange, many big shots had such a hobby. For example, there were many old monsters who had lived for thousands or tens of thousands of years who disguised themselves as cute creatures.
It was also very common for some behemoth-level races to shrink themselves in order to save physical strength.
Therefore, she didn’t make a fuss because Eleven and Buggy looked like cubs.
“Wuu! (I want to register for the ranking battle of all races!)” Eleven said.
“Alright, have you registered your race?” Fang Qin said.
“Wuu. (I don’t know.)”
“Sob. (Iron-eating Beast Race-Chaos Panda Evolution Branch.)” Eleven said.
“Sorry, neither the Chaos Panda nor the Iron-eating Beast have any registration information. If you want to participate, you might have to register a new one,” Fang Qin said.
Eleven scratched its head. Fortunately, it had already expected this and said, “Sob. (Then let’s register a new one.)”
On his shoulder, Buggy nodded indifferently. Because there were too many life races, the ranking battle of all races could represent the origin race in the battle, or it could also represent the evolution branch race in the battle.
For Eleven, the Iron-eating Beast was its origin race, its source race. For its current individual, the Chaos Panda was its evolution branch race, its current race.
According to their investigation, if they wanted to achieve good results in the ranking battle of all races, they usually used the Origin Race to register and represent the Origin Race to participate. After all, generally speaking, there were more clansmen of the Origin Race. It was easier for everyone to achieve good results if they participated together.
If Eleven used the Chaos Panda to participate, it would definitely be a lone contestant.
Soon, Eleven registered the information.
< Name > Eleven
[Level of Growth]: Quasi Divine
[Belonging Domain]: Floating Realm
[Race Name]: Iron-eating Beast
“As the Iron-eating Beast Race is a newly registered participating race, if another Iron-eating Beast Race registers to participate in the future, it needs to be present with you to undergo the bloodline homology test,” Fang Qin said.
“The first three battles are the positioning competition. They determine the initial race ranking. In addition, if within a certain period of time, your registered race doesn’t have a record of participating in the ranking battle of all races, your race ranking will fall and even be removed.”
“Wu wu wu! (No problem.)” Eleven nodded.
“Next, we still need to test your age. Age is also an important reference criteria for calculating the ranking after every battle. Of course, we can also not test it. That way, the system will calculate according to the lowest weight,” the staff member, Fang Qin, said.
“Wuu. (Calculate it.)” Eleven didn’t refuse anyone. Since it wanted to fight for a high ranking, it naturally had to follow the easiest way.
From the looks of it, the other party meant that the younger one was, the higher their battle power. This meant that their race was stronger. Although Eleven felt that it was no longer a child, compared to seniors like the Dragon God, the gem cat, and the owl, it should still be considered young!
“Alright, this is a life test paper. You just have to input a trace of energy.” Fang Qin took out a white test paper and handed it to Eleven.
Eleven, who was sitting on a chair, took the test paper from the counter and inputted energy. This was the first time it had seen such a high-tech thing. Could this be used to measure age?
Eleven followed the other party’s request and directly inputted energy. In the next moment, four red bars appeared on the white test paper. Seeing this, Eleven looked up in confusion and handed the test paper to the staff.
At this moment, the staff named Fang Qin looked at the test paper in shock and looked at Eleven.
A red bar represented a year old.
She was stunned.
Even on some low-level planets, ordinary bear races that weren’t transcendent races hadn’t reached adulthood at the age of four, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1349 - 1349 Ranking Battle of All Races (2)
chapters.content:
1349 Ranking Battle of All Races (2)
This Iron-eating Beast was most likely a divine-level race. In the long life of the divine race, four years old was really a cub among cubs.
It was really a child?
In fact, it wasn’t even as old as her? She was already 25 years old!
“Four… four years old…” Fang Qin was stunned.
“Sob… (So I’m not five yet?)” Eleven fell into deep thought, but it felt like it should be soon.
“Ji!! (Can you test it for me too?)” Buggy looked at the test paper in curiosity. Now… was it four or three years old? It had forgotten if it had celebrated its birthday!
“Sure, sure. The test paper can be used repeatedly.” The staff handed the life test paper to Buggy again. In the next moment, after Buggy finished testing, Fang Qin was stunned again.
One of the four red bars was missing…
Three, three years old…
She looked at Eleven and Buggy ridiculously. So whose “children” were these two? Wait, could it be that the test paper was spoilt?
…
The ranking battles of all races below the divine level were all carried out offline. The so-called offline battles were carried out in the various realms and the real world of World King Star.
As for battles above the divine level, they would be carried out in the online space. One could enter the [Second World] from the entrances of the various first-level realms. The [Second World] was a world specially opened by the World King Planet for battle.
It could be seen that a super big arena, be it the ranking battle of all races or the God Sealing Battle, would be carried out in the [Second World].
The reason why Shi Yu said that it was easier to fight God Sealing Battles in the Blue Wave World was because there was no Teleportation entrance to the second world in the Floating Realm at all. Only first-level realms existed.
At this moment, after registering, Eleven began to take the battle certificate and follow Buggy to find an opponent that matched it.
In the Myriad Region, space overlapped. There were many teleportation arrays and many miles of space. Eleven felt a headache, making Buggy extremely smug. Fortunately, it came with Eleven. Otherwise, the leader would definitely get lost!!
“Ji…!!” Under Buggy’s lead, Eleven finally found the so-called battlefield number 4399.
At this moment, on the battlefield, a pair of partners had been waiting for a long time. It was a human young man and a huge dragon with two jaws filled with teeth, a raised horn crown, and green plants growing all over its body.
“Roar!! (Looks like the opponent is here.)” The green dragon saw Eleven and Buggy coming in from the entrance to fight on the battlefield and said.
“Yeah.” The young man in the dark green trench coat also looked over and frowned. Seeing that it wasn’t a combination of humans and cosmic life forms, but strange bears and bugs, he couldn’t help but fall into deep thought.
Just as Eleven and Buggy were looking at the young man and the green dragon opposite them, a robot suddenly flew out from the side of the open-air battlefield. “Detected that the two parties have arrived. Please head to the arena. I’ll be the judge next.”
“This is a positioning competition. Newbie, representative of the Iron-eating Beast Race, Eleven, ranked 9212th among the myriad races in the starry sky, representative of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race, Gorka.”
“Why is it a positioning competition?” Upon hearing the battle information reported by the referee robot of the Myriad Races Committee, the young man was speechless.
“Roar.” The green dragon also shook its head with a bored expression.
Even if they won the positioning competition, the points added would be very little. Moreover, the opponents were usually very weak and couldn’t have any training effects.
“Gorka, end the battle quickly and start a battle,” the young man said to his contracted green dragon.
“Roar. (I understand.)” The green dragon spread its leaf-like wings and flew to the arena. Its green eyes looked at Eleven and Buggy.
“Ji!!” At the same time, Buggy at the entrance congratulated Eleven.
Their luck was pretty good. The opponent of the positioning competition was actually matched with a race ranked in the top 10,000 of the cosmic races. If they won, their initial ranking would definitely not be low!
The Blue Wave Green Dragon in front of him was definitely not the strongest expert of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race. It should be a junior member of the Blue Wave Green Dragon Race. Usually, the strongest experts in this race ranked in the top ten thousand of the myriad races were basically outstanding among top-notch Divine Realm experts. Moreover, there were divine-level experts everywhere in the race. Otherwise, it was impossible for them to reach this ranking.
“Wu wu wu! (Yay.)” At this moment, Eleven also walked to the arena happily. Buggy crawled to the green dragon’s contractor and asked, “Ji ji…”
“Ji!! (Hello, are you this big guy’s Beast Tamer?)” Buggy asked.
“What are you doing?” The young man looked at the worm in front of him with a dark expression.
Buggy said in the universal language, “I’m the guardian worm of that Iron-eating Beast. I’m very happy to fight you.”
“You won’t be happy later.”
At that moment, the contractor of the Blue Wave Green Dragon confirmed again that the opponent was a newbie. Usually, relatively powerful gods would form an alliance with suitable human families and let them sign an equal contract with the cubs of their race to grow together.
Not only was this black and white bear called the Iron-eating Beast a new race in the ranking battle of all races, but it also didn’t have a human partner who came with it. Instead, it was protected by a green worm. What was going on?
“You guys are unlucky.” The young man crossed his arms and looked at the arena.
The ranking battle of all races was different from the God Sealing Battle. Humans weren’t allowed to interfere in the battle between contracted pets. If humans wanted to participate, they had to register themselves and represent humans in the battle. At the same time, they couldn’t use the power of their pets and could only fight themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 1350 - 1350 Ranking Battle of All Races (3)
chapters.content:
1350 Ranking Battle of All Races (3)
Therefore, no human was so bored as to participate in this thing. The status of humans didn’t need to be proven with this competition.
“Ji. (Big talk.)” Buggy despised.
“Battle, begin!!!”
At the same time, as the Blue Wave Green Dragon entered the central venue, the robot of the Myriad Races Committee, who was in charge of being the judge, directly gave the battle command.
“Roar!!!” The Blue Wave Green Dragon looked at the Iron-eating Beast not far away mockingly and didn’t say anything. According to the Beast Tamer, it planned to end the battle quickly.
Boom!!!
It stood on the spot and didn’t move at all. The ground directly rumbled and cracked, and many trees quickly grew out. The trees seemed to have been uprooted, forming a forest in an instant. It sealed the venue, and countless tree trunks rose into the sky, forming a tree prison that attacked Eleven.
“Wuu!!” Eleven stood on the spot and shook its arms. Space Quake was activated, and strong spatial fluctuations instantly intertwined with these huge trees. However, on Blue Planet, the vibration that was enough to shatter a ruin mystic realm and shatter space could only break the thinner branches and leaves like the wind. It couldn’t even pull out the roots.
Moreover, even if it was a broken branch, green light instantly filled the air and quickly healed. It turned into an immortal sea of trees again and devoured Eleven.
“Ji!! (Wood Law, Wood Control?!)” Seeing the perfect nature of these huge trees and the faint law ripples spreading, Buggy said.
“The Blue Wave Green Dragon Race has inherited two high-level divine skills and several ordinary divine skills. They’re top-notch gods. That’s why I said that you’re very unlucky to have encountered us in the positioning competition.” The young man said happily, “You don’t even know the Blue Wave Green Dragon. You’re really newborn calves.”
“Ji. (Don’t worry, don’t worry.)” Buggy curled its lips. The battle wasn’t over yet. Eleven was just testing the waters with the transcendent Space Quake. What was there to be smug about?
As expected, seeing that a single Space Quake couldn’t cause any damage to the other party’s moves, Eleven revealed an excited expression and its warpath rose.
“Roar!!” It roared and stood on the spot without moving. A hot aura bloomed from its body. The fiery red high temperature turned into a substantial wave. This time, Eleven activated the Molten Gold skill and seemed to have turned into a sun furnace, spreading monstrous heat.
This move was indeed more effective than Space Quake against these crazy plants. Sensing the high temperature, the attacks of the plants instantly slowed down. With the Golden Battle Body as the foundation, the current temperature of the Molten Gold wasn’t inferior to the prototype of an ordinary divine skill. It immediately made many plants close to it wither, but in the next second, the withered plants immediately filled with dense vitality and instantly recovered.
Boom!!!
The endless sea of trees directly stabbed at Eleven and trapped it inside. The flames instantly disappeared and were replaced by the sound of bombardment that resounded through the entire venue.
“It’s useless.” Seeing this, the young man couldn’t help but say, “How can ordinary high temperatures stop the law of wood and the law of life?”
However, before he could finish speaking, something unexpected happened in the next second. The flames disappeared, but white light instantly appeared in the dark sea of trees!!
“What?” He was rather surprised.
Boom!!!
The expression of the Blue Wave Green Dragon changed, and a layer of divine wood armor immediately appeared on its body. As the light bullets landed on its body, incomparably rich smoke rose.
It was the Light Control that he had just learned!
“It’s useless.” Although an accident had happened, the young man was still calm. As expected, as the smoke dissipated, the green dragon in the Divine Wood Armor was unscathed. It was looking at Eleven opposite it with a dark green gaze.
Eleven’s Light Control was only at the entry-level. Although the effect was good, it couldn’t play a decisive role at all.
“Even if ten thousand more such attacks come, they can’t break through its defense,” the young man said.
“Wu wu wu!!!” At this moment, Eleven also realized that although the Light Control could crush the other party with speed, due to the low proficiency, the attack power didn’t seem to be enough to crush the other party with the Law of Life.
Not only that, even if he directly used the Yin Yang Millstone… it was probably not enough to kill in one hit.
Eleven frowned.
In that case…
“Wuu!!!” After thinking it through, Eleven directly erupted on the spot. A huge amount of energy was released from its body, and the soaring flames began to shake the messy arena. In an instant, the energy in its body increased by more than a few times.
In the dazzling white flames, platinum electric arcs blinked from time to time. Since direct attacks couldn’t break through the defense, Eleven entered explosive mode.
Seeing this, the contractor for the Blue Wave Green Dragon was amused. “Are you going all out?”
In his opinion, Eleven had already bet the outcome of the battle on the next attack when it entered the explosive mode of overload.

chapters.title: Chapter 1351 - 1351 Ranking Battle of All Races (4)
chapters.content:
1351 Ranking Battle of All Races (4)
As long as the Blue Wave Green Dragon endured it, the other party would collapse from exhaustion.
Boom!!!
At this moment, Eleven, who had entered the sharp mode and the state of the Thunder God Armor, had indeed reached the peak of the explosive mode. Under the light lightning reaction with the Light Control, its speed and attack reached a higher peak. It instantly appeared in front of the green dragon with its shocked expression.
“Wuu!!” The green dragon only felt a flash of light in its eyes. With a boom, its wooden armor was shattered by a fist at the speed of light and it was sent flying.
However, the attack power was still not strong enough!
Although it instantly broke through the green dragon’s defense and injured it, under the huge life force, the injuries Eleven dealt to the green dragon’s body recovered visibly. No, it could be said that it instantly recovered!!
“Roar!!! (Come on!!)” The green dragon, which had suddenly stopped, roared loudly. Its warpath was also aroused as it provoked Eleven.
In the next second, an attack that it couldn’t see clearly instantly arrived and hit its head. In an instant, a third of its head disappeared, but it still instantly recovered.
Boom.
Under the infinite light-speed impact, the green dragon directly became a sandbag, a sandbag that could be infinitely reborn. It was beaten up by Eleven.
About a minute later, the green dragon was still unscathed, but Eleven’s attack was still fierce.
This made the young man frown and say, “How is that possible?”
Such an overload eruption, this black and white bear actually lasted for so long??
What he didn’t know was that although it was an overload eruption, Eleven’s divine-level physique was too strong. Its limit was unfathomable. Moreover, the restoration effect brought by the Indestructible Golden Body also made a lot of contributions to Eleven’s explosive endurance.
“Roar!!”
Soon, the green dragon, which had exploded from the beating, finally found an opportunity to transform itself into a poisonous physique through wood control.
Not only did it become a poisonous physique, but poisonous gas also bloomed from its body.
Boom!!!
When Eleven attacked, it was accidentally infected by the toxin.
In the double negative state of overload eruption and poison, the young man lowered his arm. He didn’t believe that this black and white bear still had the strength to turn the situation around.
“Roar!!!” Three minutes later, accompanied by the green dragon’s roar, it finally found the gap in Eleven’s attack. Its dragon tail directly sent Eleven, who had ended its explosive period, flying.
Bang!!!
Eleven was sent flying to the ground. The green dragon was covered in sweat and panted heavily with a look of lingering fear.
This time, although he felt that victory was in his grasp, the young man didn’t dare to talk too early.
“Ji! (Coming.)” Buggy said.
As expected, as Buggy spoke, the young man’s expression changed.
On the arena, Eleven, who should have ended the eruption and entered an enfeebled state, was filled with a monstrous warpath, as if the fire of will had been ignited. An unstoppable wave erupted from its body.
“Roar!!!” Eleven stood up again amidst the roar and activated Impregnable. This was a second explosive skill that could only be activated after entering a near-death state. Under the extremely ridiculous expressions of the young man and the green dragon, Eleven entered an explosive state again. Black and white lightning filled its body, and as if a corpse had come back to life, a Yin Yang Millstone condensed in its hand!!
Boom!!!
Under the obliteration of the terrifying Yin Yang lightning, the toxins on Eleven’s body were directly cleansed. At the same time, Eleven, who had completed its second strengthening through Impregnable and Inner Power and entered a more peak state, instantly crushed the green dragon by a level.
“Roar!!!” Seeing Eleven, who should have been on the verge of death, directly destroy the toxin and stand up again, the green dragon roared in disbelief. At the same time, it felt a strong threat from Eleven.
“What a joke. This is… the prototype of a top-notch divine skill?” The young man’s pupils also constricted. He instantly looked at a light shadow and pressed the Yin Yang Millstone that suddenly appeared on the green dragon’s stomach.
Boom!!!
The strong destructive power directly obliterated the healing effect of the Law of Life. With an incomparable impact, it sent the green dragon flying with a roar. Even its warpath and consciousness were obliterated. In an instant, the green dragon’s eyes turned white, and it fainted. It was sent flying a hundred meters away, drawing an abyss and sending dust flying.
“Wu wu wu!!!” At the same time, Eleven, who had erupted with clueless speed, also fell to the ground like a kite with a broken string.
The young man looked at the unconscious green dragon and Iron-eating Beast and fell into deep thought with an incredulous expression.
However, in the next moment, what made him feel even more ridiculous was that a moment later, the Iron-eating Beast’s body was filled with a shocking warpath again. It dragged its weak body and erupted with an unstoppable force. It looked around to find the enemy. When it saw that the green dragon had completely fallen to the ground, it couldn’t help but heave a sigh of relief. It called Buggy and prepared to leave.
“Ji!! (As expected, the current Eleven is still too weak. It’s already so difficult to fight a plant dragon. It still needs to be strengthened.)” Buggy muttered and crawled away from the young man.
Upon hearing that, the young man widened his eyes.
Say that again?
At the same time, the robot that was the judge finally announced the winner.
At this moment, Eleven and Buggy had already slipped away, leaving the young man looking at the green dragon in confusion.
He suddenly looked in the direction Eleven and Buggy left in. What a joke… Who exactly were these two guys?
He and Gorka were geniuses ranked in the top 500 of the God Sealing Battle!!!
Iron-eating Beast??? What race was this? How could it defeat the Blue Wave Green Dragon among the races in the starry sky!!
“No, I have to find out.”
…
On the other side, in the mystic realm villa, Shi Yu yawned. He sensed that Eleven and the others had already ended and was about to call them back for dinner when Baby Ginseng’s main body suddenly shouted.
“Yi!!! (Shi Yu, the Hanging Fruit has been successfully developed. Hurry up and give it a try!!!)”
“Huh?” Shi Yu instantly forgot about Eleven and Buggy. He immediately ran to Baby Ginseng to take it, and he looked at the golden fruit in Baby Ginseng’s hand.
“Wow.” Shi Yu was instantly attracted by the fruit. His eyes lit up as he said, “Can we eat it now?”
“Yi!!” Baby Ginseng nodded. It could eat, but the taste nature of this fruit was a little difficult to change.
“What do you mean?”
“Yi! (It’s just possible. It doesn’t taste that delicious. It’s very disgusting. The taste is like…)”
“It’s alright, I can still take this little pain.” Shi Yu directly took the fruit and took a bite. In the next moment, his face turned green and purple. After feeling dizzy, he fainted from the smell and entered a cultivation state.
Seeing this, Baby Ginseng looked worried. What should it do? If it wasn’t improved, it wouldn’t be easy to sell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1352 - 1352 Battle God Bear Eleven (1)
chapters.content:
1352 Battle God Bear Eleven (1)
Shi Yu had never eaten anything so disgusting.
After all, he was a human with the will of an overlord who had almost experienced life, old age, illness, and death!
Even if 90% of his life force was instantly extracted, he would definitely be extremely calm.
